One of them betook himself to Allah, so Allah took him into His grace and mercy and accommodated him, the second felt shy from Allah, so Allah sheltered Him in His mercy (and did not punish him), while the third turned his face from Allah and went away, so Allah turned His face from him likewise
hi: Abu Waqid Al-Laithi (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) masjid mein baithe the ke teen aadmi aaye. Do Aap ke saamne aaye, teesra chala gaya. Do log kuch der khade rahe, phir ek halqe mein jagah paakar baith gaya, dusra majlis ke peechhe baith gaya, aur teesra chala gaya. Jab Aap ne apni baat khatam ki to farmaya: "Kya main tumhe in teen logon ke baare mein na bataun? Ek ne Allah ki taraf rukh kiya, to Allah ne use apni rehmat mein le liya aur jagah di. Doosre ne Allah se haya ki, to Allah ne use bhi (apni rehmat mein) jagah di. Teesra Allah se mun phera kar chala gaya, to Allah ne bhi usse mun pher liya."

e: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Bakra's father:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) was riding his camel and a man was holding its rein. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "What is the day today?" We kept quiet, thinking that he might give that day another name. He said, "Isn't it the day of Nahr (slaughtering of the animals of sacrifice)" We replied, "Yes." He further asked, "Which month is this?" We again kept quiet, thinking that he might give it another name. Then he said, "Isn't it the month of Dhul-Hijja?" We replied, "Yes." He said, "Verily! Your blood, property and honor are sacred to one another (i.e. Muslims) like the sanctity of this day of yours, in this month of yours and in this city of yours. It is incumbent upon those who are present to inform those who are absent because those who are absent might comprehend (what I have said) better than the present audience
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Bakra (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke waalid se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) apne oont par sawar the, ek shaks uski rasi thaame hue tha. Aap ne pucha: "Aaj kaun sa din hai?" Hum khamosh rahe, sochte hue ke Aap iska koi doosra naam bata sakte hain. Aap ne farmaya: "Kya yeh Yaum-un-Nahr (qurbani ka din) nahi hai?" Humne kaha: "Haan." Phir pucha: "Yeh kaun sa mahina hai?" Hum phir khamosh rahe. Aap ne farmaya: "Kya yeh Zul-Hijjah nahi hai?" Humne kaha: "Haan." Aap ne farmaya: "Beshak tumhara khoon, tumhara maal aur tumhari izzat ek dusre par usi tarah haram hai jaise is din, is mahine aur is shehar ki hurmat hai. Jo yahan maujood hai woh in baaton ko un logon tak pahunchaye jo maujood nahi hain, kyunke ho sakta hai gair-maujood log inhe behtar samjhein."

e: Narrated Ibn Mas`ud:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to take care of us in preaching by selecting a suitable time, so that we might not get bored. (He abstained from pestering us with sermons and knowledge all the time)
hi: Ibn Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) hamesha waqt ka khayal rakhte hue naseehat karte the, taake hum bore na hon.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Facilitate things to people (concerning religious matters), and do not make it hard for them and give them good tidings and do not make them run away (from Islam)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Logon ke liye (deeni maamlaat) asaan karo, mushkil na banao, khushkhabri do, unhe (deen se) bezaar na karo."

e: Narrated Abu Wail:`Abdullah used to give a religious talk to the people on every Thursday. Once a man said, "O Aba `Abdur-Rahman! (By Allah) I wish if you could preach us daily." He replied, "The only thing which prevents me from doing so, is that I hate to bore you, and no doubt I take care of you in preaching by selecting a suitable time just as the Prophet (ﷺ) used to do with us, for fear of making us bored
hi: Abu Wail bataate hain ke Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) har jumeraat logon ko waaz kiya karte the. Ek shaks ne kaha: "Aye Abu Abdur-Rahman! Kaash aap hume roz naseehat karte." Unhone jawab diya: "Mujhe rokta hai ke tumhe bore karunga, kyunke main tumhara wahi khayal rakhta hoon jaise Nabi (ﷺ) waqt ka khayal rakh kar naseehat karte the — humein bore na karne ke liye."

e: Narrated Muawiya:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "If Allah wants to do good to a person, He makes him comprehend the religion. I am just a distributor, but the grant is from Allah. (And remember) that this nation (true Muslims) will keep on following Allah's teachings strictly and they will not be harmed by any one going on a different path till Allah's order (Day of Judgment) is established
hi: Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke maine Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ko farmate suna: "Jise Allah bhalaai dena chahta hai, use deen ki samajh ata karta hai. Main to sirf taqseem karta hoon, ata karne wala Allah hai. Aur yeh ummat (sacche Musalman) Allah ki taleemaat par qaim rahegi, aur koi mukhalifat karne wala unhe qayamat tak nuqsan nahi pahuncha sakega."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:We were with the Prophet (ﷺ) and fresh dates of a palm tree were brought to him. On that he said, "Amongst the trees, there is a tree which resembles a Muslim." I wanted to say that it was the datepalm tree but as I was the youngest of all (of them) I kept quiet. And then the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It is the date-palm tree
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke hum Nabi (ﷺ) ke saath the aur khajoor ke taaza phal laaye gaye. Aap ne farmaya: "Darakhton mein ek darakht hai jo Musalman jaisa hai." Main kehna chahta tha ke woh khajoor ka darakht hai, magar sabse chota hone ki wajah se khamosh raha. Phir Nabi ne khud farmaya: "Yeh khajoor ka darakht hai."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Mas`ud:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not wish to be like anyone except in two cases. (The first is) A person, whom Allah has given wealth and he spends it righteously; (the second is) the one whom Allah has given wisdom (the Holy Qur'an) and he acts according to it and teaches it to others." (Fath-al-Bari page 177 Vol)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Kisi se hasad na karo siwaye do logon ke: 1. Jise Allah ne maal diya ho aur woh usay sahih raah mein kharch kare; 2. Jise Allah ne hikmat (Quran) di ho aur woh usi ke mutabiq amal kare aur doosron ko sikhaye."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:That he differed with Hur bin Qais bin Hisn Al-Fazari regarding the companion of (the Prophet) Moses. Ibn `Abbas said that he was Al Khadir. Meanwhile, Ubai bin Ka`b passed by them and Ibn `Abbas called him, saying "My friend (Hur) and I have differed regarding Moses' companion, whom Moses asked the way to meet. Have you heard the Prophet (ﷺ) mentioning something about him? He said, "Yes. I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "While Moses was sitting in the company of some Israelites, a man came and asked him. "Do you know anyone who is more learned than you? Moses replied: "No." So Allah sent the Divine Inspiration to Moses: 'Yes, Our slave Khadir (is more learned than you.)' Moses asked (Allah) how to meet him (Khadir). So Allah made the fish as a sign for him and he was told that when the fish was lost, he should return (to the place where he had lost it) and there he would meet him (Al-Khadir). So Moses went on looking for the sign of the fish in the sea. The servant-boy of Moses said to him: Do you remember when we betook ourselves to the rock, I indeed forgot the fish, none but Satan made me forget to remember it. On that Moses said: 'That is what we have been seeking' (18.64). So they went back retracing their footsteps, and found Khadir. (And) what happened further to them is narrated in the Holy Qur'an by Allah. (18.54 up to)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) ka Hur bin Qais se Musa (علیہ السلام) ke sathi ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hua. Ibn Abbas ne kaha woh Khadir the. Isi waqt Ubai bin Ka'b (رضی اللہ عنہ) guzre, Ibn Abbas ne unhe bulaya aur pucha: "Humara ikhtilaaf hai Musa ke us sathi ke baare mein jiska raasta unhone poocha tha — kya aapne Nabi (ﷺ) se iske baare mein kuch suna hai?" Unhone kaha: "Haan. Maine Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ko farmate suna: Musa Bani Israel ke kuch logon ke saath baithe the ke ek shaks aaya aur pucha: 'Kya aap kisi ko jaante hain jo aapse zyada ilm wala ho?' Musa ne kaha: 'Nahi.' Tab Allah ne Musa par wahi ki: 'Haan, humara banda Khadir (tumse zyada ilm wala hai).' Musa ne Allah se pucha unse kaise milein. Allah ne machhli ko nishani banaya aur bataya ke jahan machhli gum ho jaye, wapas jaakar wahan unse milna. Musa machhli ki nishani talaash karte hue samundar ke kinare chal rahe the. Musa ke khadim ne kaha: 'Yaad hai jab hum us chatan par theyre the, main machhli bhool gaya tha, shaitan ke siwa kisi ne mujhe yaad rakhne se gaflat mein nahi daala.' Musa ne kaha: 'Yehi to hum dhoond rahe the' (18:64). Phir woh apne raaste wapas gaye aur Khadir ko paaya. Aage jo hua woh Quran mein Allah ne bayan kiya hai (18:54 tak)."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) embraced me and said, "O Allah! Bestow on him the knowledge of the Book (Qur'an)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne unhe seene se lagaya aur farmaya: "Aye Allah! Ise Kitab (Quran) ka ilm ata farma."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Once I came riding a she-ass and had (just) attained the age of puberty. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was offering the prayer at Mina. There was no wall in front of him and I passed in front of some of the row while they were offering their prayers. There I let the she-ass loose to graze and entered the row, and nobody objected to it
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain ke main gadhi par sawar hokar aaya, us waqt main balig hone ke qareeb tha. Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) Mina mein namaz padha rahe the, Aap ke aage koi deewar nahi thi. Main kuch saf ke saamne se guzra jabke log namaz padh rahe the. Maine gadhi ko charne ke liye chhod diya aur khud saf mein shamil ho gaya, kisi ne mujhe mana nahi kiya.

e: Narrated Mahmud bin Rabi`a:When I was a boy of five, I remember, the Prophet (ﷺ) took water from a bucket (used for getting water out of a well) with his mouth and threw it on my face
hi: Mahmud bin Rabi'a (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke jab main paanch saal ka tha, mujhe yaad hai Nabi (ﷺ) ne kuye ke dol se apne mun mein paani liya aur mere chehre par chhidak diya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:that he differed with Hur bin Qais bin Hisn Al-Fazari regarding the companion of the Prophet Moses (ﷺ). Meanwhile, Ubai bin Ka`b passed by them and Ibn `Abbas called him saying, "My friend (Hur) and I have differed regarding Moses' companion whom Moses asked the way to meet. Have you heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) mentioning something about him?" Ubai bin Ka`b said: "Yes, I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) mentioning something about him (saying) while Moses was sitting in the company of some Israelites, a man came and asked him: "Do you know anyone who is more learned than you?" Moses replied: "No." So Allah sent the Divine Inspiration to Moses: '--Yes, Our slave Khadir is more learned than you.' Moses asked Allah how to meet him (Al-Khadir). So Allah made the fish a sign for him and he was told when the fish was lost, he should return (to the place where he had lost it) and there he would meet him (Al-Khadir). So Moses went on looking for the sign of the fish in the sea. The servant-boy of Moses said: 'Do you remember when we betook ourselves to the rock, I indeed forgot the fish, none but Satan made me forget to remember it. On that Moses said, 'That is what we have been seeking.' So they went back retracing their footsteps, and found Khadir. (and) what happened further about them is narrated in the Holy Qur'an by Allah." (18.54 up to)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) ka Hur bin Qais se Musa ke sathi ke baare mein ikhtilaaf tha. Ubai bin Ka'b (رضی اللہ عنہ) guzre, Ibn Abbas ne unse yeh sawaal poocha (jaisa upar zikar hua), aur Ubai ne wahi jawab diya jo hadith 74 mein bayan hua.

e: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The example of guidance and knowledge with which Allah has sent me is like abundant rain falling on the earth, some of which was fertile soil that absorbed rain water and brought forth vegetation and grass in abundance. (And) another portion of it was hard and held the rain water and Allah benefited the people with it and they utilized it for drinking, making their animals drink from it and for irrigation of the land for cultivation. (And) a portion of it was barren which could neither hold the water nor bring forth vegetation (then that land gave no benefits). The first is the example of the person who comprehends Allah's religion and gets benefit (from the knowledge) which Allah has revealed through me (the Prophet) and learns and then teaches others. The last example is that of a person who does not care for it and does not take Allah's guidance revealed through me (He is like that barren land)
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Jo hidayat aur ilm Allah ne mujhe deke bheja hai, uski misaal us zabardast baarish ki tarah hai jo zameen par barse. Kuch zameen zarkhez thi, usne paani soakh kar khoob ghaas aur sabza ugaya. Kuch zameen sakht thi, usne paani rok liya aur log usse paani pite, apne janwaron ko pilaate aur khetiwaari karte. Aur kuch zameen banjar thi, jisne na paani roka na sabza ugaya. Pehli misaal us shaks ki hai jo Allah ke deen ko samjhe, us ilm se faida uthaye jo Allah ne mere zariye nazil kiya, khud seekhe aur doosron ko sikhaye. Aakhri misaal us shaks ki hai jo iski parwa na kare aur Allah ki us hidayat ko qubool na kare jo mere zariye aayi."

e: Narrated Anas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "From among the portents of the Hour are (the following): -1. Religious knowledge will be taken away (by the death of Religious learned men). -2. (Religious) ignorance will prevail. -3. Drinking of Alcoholic drinks (will be very common). -4. There will be prevalence of open illegal sexual intercourse
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Qiyamat ki alaamaton mein se: 1. Deeni ilm utha liya jayega (ulama ke intiqal se). 2. Jahalat phailegi. 3. Sharab ka rivaj barh jayega. 4. Zina khullam-khulla ho jayega."

e: Narrated Anas:I will narrate to you a Hadith and none other than I will tell you about after it. I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying: From among the portents of the Hour are (the following): -1. Religious knowledge will decrease (by the death of religious learned men). -2. Religious ignorance will prevail. -3. There will be prevalence of open illegal sexual intercourse. -4. Women will increase in number and men will decrease in number so much so that fifty women will be looked after by one man
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai: "Main tumhe ek hadith bataunga jo mere baad shayad koi na bataye. Maine Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ko farmate suna: Qiyamat ki alaamaton mein: 1. Deeni ilm kam ho jayega (ulama ke intiqal se). 2. Jahalat phailegi. 3. Zina khullam-khulla ho jayega. 4. Aurton ki tadaad badh jayegi aur mardon ki kam ho jayegi, yahan tak ke ek mard paanch aurton ka nigraan hoga."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "While I was sleeping, I saw that a cup full of milk was brought to me and I drank my fill till I noticed (the milk) its wetness coming out of my nails. Then I gave the remaining milk to `Umar Ibn Al-Khattab" The companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "What have you interpreted (about this dream), O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" He replied, "(It is religious) knowledge
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Khwab mein maine dekha ke mujhe doodh se bhara ek pyala diya gaya, maine itna piya ke uski taazgi meri nakhoon se nikalte dekhi. Baqi doodh maine Umar bin Khattab (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko de diya." Sahaba ne pucha: "Iski kya tabeer hai, Ya Rasoolallah?" Farmaya: "(Deeni) ilm."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr bin Al `Aas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stopped (for a while near the Jimar) at Mina during his last Hajj for the people and they were asking him questions. A man came and said, "I forgot and got my head shaved before slaughtering the Hadi (sacrificing animal)." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There is no harm, go and do the slaughtering now." Then another person came and said, "I forgot and slaughtered (the camel) before Rami (throwing of the pebbles) at the Jamra." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do the Rami now and there is no harm." The narrator added: So on that day, when the Prophet (ﷺ) was asked about anything (as regards the ceremonies of Hajj) performed before or after its due time, his reply was: "Do it (now) and there is no harm
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Aas (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) apne aakhri Hajj mein Mina ke qareeb thehre aur log sawaal poochte rahe. Ek shaks ne kaha: "Main bhool gaya aur qurbani se pehle sar munwa liya." Nabi ne farmaya: "Koi harj nahi, ab qurbani kar lo." Doosre ne kaha: "Main bhool gaya aur Rami se pehle qurbani kar li." Farmaya: "Ab Rami kar lo, koi harj nahi." Rawi kehte hain: Us din jo bhi (Hajj ke ahkaam mein) waqt se pehle ya baad mein karne ke baare mein poochta, Aap ka yehi jawab hota: "Ab kar lo, koi harj nahi."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Somebody said to the Prophet (during his last Hajj), "I did the slaughtering before doing the Rami.' The Prophet (ﷺ) beckoned with his hand and said, "There is no harm in that." Then another person said, "I got my head shaved before offering the sacrifice." The Prophet (ﷺ) beckoned with his hand saying, "There is no harm in that
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke kisi ne Nabi (ﷺ) se (aakhri Hajj mein) kaha: "Maine Rami se pehle qurbani kar li." Aap ne haath se ishara karke farmaya: "Koi harj nahi." Doosre ne kaha: "Maine qurbani se pehle sar munwa liya." Aap ne ishara karke farmaya: "Koi harj nahi."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "(Religious) knowledge will be taken away (by the death of religious scholars) ignorance (in religion) and afflictions will appear; and Harj will increase." It was asked, "What is Harj, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" He replied by beckoning with his hand indicating "killing." (Fath-al-Bari Page 192, Vol)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "(Deeni) ilm utha liya jayega (ulama ke intiqal se), jahalat aur fitne phailenge, aur 'Harj' badh jayega." Pucha gaya: "Harj kya hai, Ya Rasoolallah?" Aap ne haath ke ishare se "qatl" ka matlab batalaya.

e: Narrated Asma':I came to `Aisha while she was praying, and said to her, "What has happened to the people?" She pointed out towards the sky. (I looked towards the mosque), and saw the people offering the prayer. Aisha said, "Subhan Allah." I said to her, "Is there a sign?" She nodded with her head meaning, "Yes." I, too, then stood (for the prayer of eclipse) till I became (nearly) unconscious and later on I poured water on my head. After the prayer, the Prophet (ﷺ) praised and glorified Allah and then said, "Just now at this place I have seen what I have never seen before, including Paradise and Hell. No doubt it has been inspired to me that you will be put to trials in your graves and these trials will be like the trials of Masih-ad-Dajjal or nearly like it (the sub narrator is not sure which expression Asma' used). You will be asked, 'What do you know about this man (the Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ))?' Then the faithful believer (or Asma' said a similar word) will reply, 'He is Muhammad Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who had come to us with clear evidences and guidance and so we accepted his teachings and followed him. And he is Muhammad.' And he will repeat it thrice. Then the angels will say to him, 'Sleep in peace as we have come to know that you were a faithful believer.' On the other hand, a hypocrite or a doubtful person will reply, 'I do not know, but I heard the people saying something and so I said it.' (the same)
hi: Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain ke main Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas aayi jab woh namaz padh rahi thi, maine pucha: "Logon ko kya hua?" Unhone aasman ki taraf ishara kiya (maine dekha log masjid mein namaz padh rahe the). Ayesha ne kaha: "Subhan Allah." Maine pucha: "Kya koi nishani hai?" Unhone sar hilaya, "Haan." Main bhi (kasoof ki namaz ke liye) khadi ho gayi yahan tak ke behosh hone ke qareeb ho gayi, phir apne sar par paani dala. Namaz ke baad Nabi (ﷺ) ne Allah ki hamd-o-sana ki aur farmaya: "Abhi is jagah maine woh dekha jo pehle kabhi nahi dekha tha, Jannat aur Dozakh bhi. Mujhe wahi hui hai ke tumhe apni qabron mein aazmaaya jayega, jaisa Masih Dajjal ke fitne jaisa aazmaaish ho sakta hai. Tumse pucha jayega: 'Tum is shaks (Nabi Muhammad ﷺ) ke baare mein kya jaante ho?' Momin (ya isi jaisa lafz) jawab dega: 'Yeh Muhammad Rasoolallah hain, jo hamare paas roshan daleel aur hidayat le kar aaye, humne unki taleemat qubool ki aur unki pairvi ki.' Aur woh yeh teen martaba dohrayega. Tab farishte kahenge: 'Sukoon se so jao, hum jaan chuke ke tum momin the.' Doosri taraf, munafiq ya shakki shaks jawab dega: 'Mujhe kuch nahi pata, maine logon ko kuch kehte suna to main bhi wahi keh diya.'"

e: Narrated Abu Jamra:I was an interpreter between the people and Ibn `Abbas. Once Ibn `Abbas said that a delegation of the tribe of `Abdul Qais came to the Prophet (ﷺ) who asked them, "Who are the people (i.e. you)? (Or) who are the delegates?" They replied, "We are from the tribe of Rabi`a." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said to them, "Welcome, O people (or said, "O delegation (of `Abdul Qais).") Neither will you have disgrace nor will you regret." They said, "We have come to you from a distant place and there is the tribe of the infidels of Mudar intervening between you and us and we cannot come to you except in the sacred month. So please order us to do something good (religious deeds) and that we may also inform our people whom we have left behind (at home) and that we may enter Paradise (by acting on them.)" The Prophet ordered them to do four things, and forbade them from four things. He ordered them to believe in Allah Alone, the Honorable the Majestic and said to them, "Do you know what is meant by believing in Allah Alone?" They replied, "Allah and His Apostle know better." Thereupon the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "(That means to testify that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah and that Muhammad is His Apostle, to offer prayers perfectly, to pay Zakat, to observe fasts during the month of Ramadan, (and) to pay Al-Khumus (one fifth of the booty to be given in Allah's cause)." Then he forbade them four things, namely Ad-Dubba.' Hantam, Muzaffat (and) An-Naqir or Muqaiyar (These were the names of pots in which alcoholic drinks used to be prepared). The Prophet (ﷺ) further said, "Memorize them (these instructions) and tell them to the people whom you have left behind
hi: Abu Jamra bataate hain ke main logon aur Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) ke darmiyan tarjuma karta tha. Unhone bataya ke Abdul Qais qabile ka wafd Nabi (ﷺ) ke paas aaya... (yeh hadith Book 2 mein pehle tarjuma ho chuki hai — Abdul Qais qabile ke chaar ahkaam aur chaar mumaniyat ka waqia).

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abi Mulaika:`Uqba bin Al-Harith said that he had married the daughter of Abi Ihab bin `Aziz. Later on a woman came to him and said, "I have suckled (nursed) `Uqba and the woman whom he married (his wife) at my breast." `Uqba said to her, "Neither I knew that you have suckled (nursed) me nor did you tell me." Then he rode over to see Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) at Medina, and asked him about it. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "How can you keep her as a wife when it has been said (that she is your foster-sister)?" Then `Uqba divorced her, and she married another man
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Mulaika bataate hain ke Uqba bin Al-Harith ne Abi Ihab bin Aziz ki beti se shaadi ki. Baad mein ek aurat aayi aur kaha: "Maine Uqba aur uski biwi dono ko apna doodh pilaya hai." Uqba ne kaha: "Mujhe na pata tha na tumne bataya." Woh Madina Nabi (ﷺ) ke paas gaye aur pucha. Aap ne farmaya: "Tum use biwi kaise rakh sakte ho jabke (kaha ja raha hai ke woh) tumhari doodh-shareek bahen hai?" Uqba ne use talaq de di aur usne kisi doosre se shaadi kar li.

e: Narrated `Umar:My Ansari neighbor from Bani Umaiya bin Zaid who used to live at `Awali Al-Medina and I used to visit the Prophet (ﷺ) by turns. He used to go one day and I another day. When I went I used to bring the news of that day regarding the Divine Inspiration and other things, and when he went, he used to do the same for me. Once my Ansari friend, in his turn (on returning from the Prophet), knocked violently at my door and asked if I was there." I became horrified and came out to him. He said, "Today a great thing has happened." I then went to Hafsa and saw her weeping. I asked her, "Did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) divorce you all?" She replied, "I do not know." Then, I entered upon the Prophet (ﷺ) and said while standing, "Have you divorced your wives?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied in the negative. On that I said, "Allahu-Akbar (Allah is Greater)." (See Hadith No. 119, Vol. 3 for details)
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke unke Ansari padosi (Bani Umaiya bin Zaid se) aur woh baari-baari Nabi (ﷺ) se milne jaate the — ek din woh jaata, ek din main. Jab main jaata to us din ki wahi aur doosri khabrein leke aata, aur jab woh jaata to waisa hi karta. Ek din unke Ansari dost ne (Nabi se wapas aakar) sakhti se mera darwaza khatkhataya. Main dara-sahma bahar aaya. Usne kaha: "Aaj bahut badi baat ho gayi hai." Main Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas gaya, unhe rote dekha. Maine pucha: "Kya Allah ke Rasool ne tum sab ko talaq de di?" Unhone kaha: "Mujhe nahi pata." Phir main Nabi (ﷺ) ke paas gaya aur khade hokar pucha: "Kya aapne apni biwiyon ko talaq de di?" Aap ne farmaya "Nahi." Maine kaha: "Allahu Akbar."

e: Narrated Abu Mas`ud Al-Ansari:Once a man said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I may not attend the (compulsory congregational) prayer because so and so (the Imam) prolongs the prayer when he leads us for it. The narrator added: "I never saw the Prophet (ﷺ) more furious in giving advice than he was on that day. The Prophet said, "O people! Some of you make others dislike good deeds (the prayers). So whoever leads the people in prayer should shorten it because among them there are the sick the weak and the needy (having some jobs to do)
hi: Abu Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ansari (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke ek shaks ne Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) se kaha: "Ya Rasoolallah, main (jamaat ki) namaz mein nahi aata kyunke falaan Imam namaz lambi kar deta hai." Rawi kehte hain: Maine Nabi (ﷺ) ko kabhi is din se zyada gussa naseehat karte nahi dekha. Aap ne farmaya: "Logon! Tum mein se kuch log doosron ko nekiyon (namaz) se bezaar kar dete hain. Jo bhi logon ki imamat kare, use halki namaz padhani chahiye, kyunke unme bimaar, kamzor aur zaroorat-mand log hote hain."

e: Narrated Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani:A man asked the Prophet (ﷺ) about the picking up of a "Luqata" (fallen lost thing). The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Recognize and remember its tying material and its container, and make public announcement (about it) for one year, then utilize it but give it to its owner if he comes." Then the person asked about the lost camel. On that, the Prophet (ﷺ) got angry and his cheeks or his Face became red and he said, "You have no concern with it as it has its water container, and its feet and it will reach water, and eat (the leaves) of trees till its owner finds it." The man then asked about the lost sheep. The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "It is either for you, for your brother (another person) or for the wolf
hi: Zaid bin Khalid (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Juhani (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke ek shaks ne Nabi (ﷺ) se "Luqata" (giri hui khoi cheez) ke baare mein pucha. Aap ne farmaya: "Uski rasi aur bartan yaad rakho, aur ek saal tak elaan karo, phir istemaal kar lo lekin agar maalik aa jaye to use de do." Phir usne khoye oont ke baare mein pucha. Nabi gussa ho gaye, chehra sur ho gaya, farmaya: "Tumhe uska kya lena? Uske paas apna paani ka thaila aur paon hain, woh khud paani tak pahunch jayega aur darakhton se khaata rahega yahan tak ke maalik use dhoond le." Usne khoi hui bhed ke baare mein pucha. Farmaya: "Woh tumhare liye hai, ya tumhare bhai ke liye, ya bhediye ke liye."

e: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) was asked about things which he did not like, but when the questioners insisted, the Prophet got angry. He then said to the people, "Ask me anything you like." A man asked, "Who is my father?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Your father is Hudhafa." Then another man got up and said, "Who is my father, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ?" He replied, "Your father is Salim, Maula (the freed slave) of Shaiba." So when `Umar saw that (the anger) on the face of the Prophet (ﷺ) he said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We repent to Allah (Our offending you)
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) se aise sawaal poochhe gaye jo Aap ko pasand nahi the, magar jab poochhne wale ziyada zor daalte to Aap gussa hote. Phir farmaya: "Jo poochna hai poocho." Ek shaks ne pucha: "Mera baap kaun hai?" Farmaya: "Tera baap Hudhafa hai." Doosra khada hua aur pucha: "Mera baap kaun hai, Ya Rasoolallah?" Farmaya: "Tera baap Salim hai, Shaiba ka azaad kiya gulaam." Jab Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Nabi (ﷺ) ke chehre par gussa dekha to kaha: "Ya Rasoolallah, hum Allah se tauba karte hain."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:One day Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came out (before the people) and `Abdullah bin Hudhafa stood up and asked (him) "Who is my father?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Your father is Hudhafa." The Prophet (ﷺ) told them repeatedly (in anger) to ask him anything they liked. `Umar knelt down before the Prophet (ﷺ) and said thrice, "We accept Allah as (our) Lord and Islam as (our) religion and Muhammad as (our) Prophet." After that the Prophet (ﷺ) became silent
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke ek din Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) bahar aaye, Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Hudhafa khade hue aur pucha: "Mera baap kaun hai?" Nabi ne farmaya: "Tera baap Hudhafa hai." Phir Aap ne baar-baar farmaya (gusse mein): "Jo poochna hai poocho." Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) Aap ke saamne ghutne tek kar teen baar bole: "Hum Allah ko Rab, Islam ko deen, aur Muhammad ko Nabi maante hain." Iske baad Aap khamosh ho gaye.

e: Narrated Anas:Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) asked permission to enter, he knocked the door thrice with greeting and whenever he spoke a sentence (said a thing) he used to repeat it thrice. (See Hadith No. 261, Vol)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke jab Nabi (ﷺ) kisi ghar mein daakhil hone ki ijazat mangte, to salaam ke saath teen baar darwaza khatkhataate, aur jab koi baat kehte to teen baar dohraate.

e: Narrated Anas:Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) spoke a sentence (said a thing), he used to repeat it thrice so that the people could understand it properly from him and whenever he asked permission to enter, (he knocked the door) thrice with greeting
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) jab koi baat kehte to teen baar dohraate taake log achhi tarah samajh jayein, aur jab andar aane ki ijazat mangte to salaam ke saath teen baar (darwaza khatkhataate).

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) remained behind us in a journey. He joined us while we were performing ablution for the `Asr prayer which was over-due. We were just passing wet hands over our feet (not washing them properly) so the Prophet (ﷺ) addressed us in a loud voice and said twice or thrice, "Save your heels from the fire
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke ek safar mein Nabi (ﷺ) hum se peechhe reh gaye. Aap hum se milte jab hum Asr ki takheer shuda namaz ke liye wudu kar rahe the, sirf paon par haath pher rahe the. Nabi ne buland awaaz se do-teen martaba farmaya: "Apne panon ko (dozakh ki) aag se bachao."

e: Narrated Abu Burda's father: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said "Three persons will have a double reward: 1. A Person from the people of the scriptures who believed in his prophet (Jesus or Moses) and then believed in the Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ) (i.e. has embraced Islam). 2. A slave who discharges his duties to Allah and his master. 3. A master of a woman-slave who teaches her good manners and educates her in the best possible way (the religion) and manumits her and then marries her
hi: Abu Burda ke waalid se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Teen logon ko dohra ajr milega: 1. Ahl-e-Kitab ka woh shaks jo apne Nabi (Isa ya Musa) par iman laaya, phir Nabi Muhammad (ﷺ) par bhi iman laaya (Islam qubool kiya). 2. Woh gulam jo Allah aur apne aaqa ke haqooq poore kare. 3. Woh maalik jo apni launDi ko achhe akhlaq sikhaye, behtareen taleem (deen) de, phir use azaad karke usse nikah kar le."

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas: Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came out while Bilal was accompanying him. He went towards the women thinking that they had not heard him (i.e. his sermon). So he preached them and ordered them to pay alms. (Hearing that) the women started giving alms; some donated their ear-rings, some gave their rings and Bilal was collecting them in the corner of his garment
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) bahar aaye, Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) unke saath the. Aap aurton ki taraf gaye, yeh samajh kar ke unhone Aap ka khutba nahi suna. Aap ne unhe waaz kiya aur sadqa dene ka hukum diya. (Yeh sunkar) aurtein sadqa dene lagin — koi baali de rahi thi, koi angoothi, aur Bilal apni chadar ke kinare mein unhe jama karte jaa rahe the.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I said: "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Who will be the luckiest person, who will gain your intercession on the Day of Resurrection?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: "O Abu Huraira! I have thought that none will ask me about it before you as I know your longing for the (learning of) Hadiths. The luckiest person who will have my intercession on the Day of Resurrection will be the one who said sincerely from the bottom of his heart "None has the right to be worshipped but Allah
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Maine pucha: 'Ya Rasoolallah! Qiyamat ke din sabse khush-naseeb kaun hoga jise aapki shifa'at milegi?' Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne farmaya: 'Aye Abu Huraira! Mujhe pata tha ke yeh sawaal tumse pehle koi nahi poochega, kyunke main jaanta hoon tumhe hadith seekhne ka kitna shauq hai. Qiyamat ke din sabse khush-naseeb jise meri shifa'at milegi, woh hoga jisne apne dil ki gehraiyon se sacche dil se kaha: La ilaha illallah.'"

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr bin Al-`As:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "Allah does not take away the knowledge, by taking it away from (the hearts of) the people, but takes it away by the death of the religious learned men till when none of the (religious learned men) remains, people will take as their leaders ignorant persons who when consulted will give their verdict without knowledge. So they will go astray and will lead the people astray
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Aas (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke maine Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ko farmate suna: "Allah ilm ko (achanak) logon ke dilon se nahi chheenta, balki ulama ke intiqal se ilm khatam hota hai, yahan tak ke jab koi aalim baaqi nahi rahega, log jahil logon ko apna rahnuma bana lenge, jo bina ilm ke fatwa denge — woh khud gumraah honge aur logon ko bhi gumraah karenge."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Some women requested the Prophet (ﷺ) to fix a day for them as the men were taking all his time. On that he promised them one day for religious lessons and commandments. Once during such a lesson the Prophet said, "A woman whose three children die will be shielded by them from the Hell fire." On that a woman asked, "If only two die?" He replied, "Even two (will shield her from the Hell-fire)
hi: Abu Saeed Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke aurton ne Nabi (ﷺ) se guzarish ki ke unke liye bhi koi din muqarrar karein kyunke mard poora waqt le lete the. Aap ne unke liye ek din deeni sabaq ke liye rakh diya. Ek din sabaq mein Nabi ne farmaya: "Jis aurat ke teen bachche fauth ho jayen, woh us aurat ko Dozakh ki aag se hifazat karenge." Ek aurat ne pucha: "Agar do fauth hon?" Farmaya: "Do bhi (hifazat karenge)."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:as above (the sub narrators are different). Abu Huraira qualified the three children referred to in the above mentioned Hadith as not having reached the age of committing sins (i.e. age of puberty)
hi: Abu Saeed Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) se yeh hadith isi tarah riwayat hai (dusre raviyon se), aur Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne is hadith mein "teen bachchon" ki qeed lagai ke woh gunah karne ki umar (baalig hone) se pehle fauth hue hon.

e: Narrated Ibn Abu Mulaika:Whenever `Aisha (the wife of the Prophet) heard anything which she did not understand, she used to ask again till she understood it completely. Aisha said: "Once the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever will be called to account (about his deeds on the Day of Resurrection) will surely be punished." I said, "Doesn't Allah say: "He surely will receive an easy reckoning." (84.8) The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "This means only the presentation of the accounts but whoever will be argued about his account, will certainly be ruined
hi: Ibn Abu Mulaika bataate hain ke Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) jab koi baat na samjhein to samajh aane tak dobara poochti thin. Ayesha ne bataya: "Ek baar Nabi ne farmaya: 'Jiska hisaab liya jayega use zaroor saza milegi.' Maine kaha: 'Kya Allah nahi kehta — Usay asaan hisaab diya jayega (84:8)?' Nabi ne farmaya: 'Iska matlab sirf hisaab dikhana hai, magar jiske hisaab par behas ki jayegi woh zaroor tabaah ho jayega.'"

e: Narrated Sa`id:Abu Shuraih said, "When `Amr bin Sa`id was sending the troops to Mecca (to fight `Abdullah bin Az-Zubair) I said to him, 'O chief! Allow me to tell you what the Prophet (ﷺ) said on the day following the conquests of Mecca. My ears heard and my heart comprehended, and I saw him with my own eyes, when he said it. He glorified and praised Allah and then said, "Allah and not the people has made Mecca a sanctuary. So anybody who has belief in Allah and the Last Day (i.e. a Muslim) should neither shed blood in it nor cut down its trees. If anybody argues that fighting is allowed in Mecca as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did fight (in Mecca), tell him that Allah gave permission to His Apostle, but He did not give it to you. The Prophet (ﷺ) added: Allah allowed me only for a few hours on that day (of the conquest) and today (now) its sanctity is the same (valid) as it was before. So it is incumbent upon those who are present to convey it (this information) to those who are absent." Abu- Shuraih was asked, "What did `Amr reply?" He said `Amr said, "O Abu Shuraih! I know better than you (in this respect). Mecca does not give protection to one who disobeys (Allah) or runs after committing murder, or theft (and takes refuge in Mecca)
hi: Sa'id bataate hain ke Abu Shuraih (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Amr bin Sa'id se kaha, jab woh Mecca ki taraf fauj bhej rahe the: "Aye ameer! Mujhe woh baat batane do jo Nabi (ﷺ) ne Mecca ki fatah ke agle din farmayi thi. Meri kaanon ne suna, mere dil ne samjha, aur meri aankhon ne dekha jab Aap ne yeh farmaya. Aap ne Allah ki hamd-o-sana ki, phir farmaya: 'Allah ne Mecca ko haram banaya hai, logon ne nahi. Jo Allah aur Yaum-e-Aakhirat par iman rakhta ho, woh yahan na khoon bahaye na darakht kaate. Agar koi kahe ke jung yahan jaiz hai kyunke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne yahan jung ki, to use bata do ke Allah ne sirf apne Rasool ko ijazat di thi, tumhe nahi.' Nabi ne farmaya: 'Mujhe sirf kuch ghanton ke liye ijazat mili thi, aur aaj bhi Mecca ki hurmat waisi hi hai jaisi pehle thi. Jo yahan maujood hai woh gair-maujood ko yeh baat pahunchaye.'" Abu Shuraih se pucha gaya: "Amr ne kya jawab diya?" Unhone kaha: "Amr ne kaha: 'Aye Abu Shuraih! Main tumse behtar jaanta hoon — Mecca us shaks ko panah nahi deta jo (Allah ki) nafarmani kare, ya qatl ya chori karke bhaage.'"

e: Narrated Abu Bakra:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No doubt your blood, property, the sub-narrator Muhammad thought that Abu Bakra had also mentioned and your honor (chastity), are sacred to one another as is the sanctity of this day of yours in this month of yours. It is incumbent on those who are present to inform those who are absent." (Muhammad the Sub-narrator used to say, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) told the truth.") The Prophet (ﷺ) repeated twice: "No doubt! Haven't I conveyed Allah's message to you
hi: Abu Bakra (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Beshak tumhara khoon, tumhara maal aur tumhari izzat ek dusre par usi tarah haram hai jaise is din, is mahine ki hurmat hai. Jo yahan maujood hai woh gair-maujood ko yeh baat pahunchaye." Nabi ne yeh do baar farmaya: "Kya maine Allah ka paighaam tumhe pahuncha diya?"

e: Narrated `Ali:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not tell a lie against me for whoever tells a lie against me (intentionally) then he will surely enter the Hell-fire
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Mujh par jhoot mat bandho, jo bhi meri taraf jaan-boojh kar jhoot mansoob kare, woh zaroor Dozakh mein jayega."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Az-Zubair:I said to my father, 'I do not hear from you any narration (Hadith) of Allah's Apostle as I hear (his narration) from so and so?" Az-Zubair replied, 'I was always with him (the Prophet) and I heard him saying, "Whoever tells a lie against me (intentionally) then (surely) let him occupy, his seat in Hellfire
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke maine apne waalid se kaha: "Main aapse Nabi (ﷺ) ki hadith usi tarah nahi sunta jaise falaan se sunta hoon." Zubair ne kaha: "Main hamesha Aap ke saath rehta tha, maine Aap ko farmate suna: 'Jo mujh par jaan-boojh kar jhoot bandhe, woh apna thikana Dozakh mein bana le.'"

e: Narrated Anas:The fact which stops me from narrating a great number of Hadiths to you is that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Whoever tells a lie against me intentionally, then (surely) let him occupy his seat in Hell-fire
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai: "Jo baat mujhe tumhe zyada hadith batane se rokti hai woh yeh hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne farmaya: 'Jo mujh par jaan-boojh kar jhoot bandhe, woh apna thikana Dozakh mein bana le.'"

e: Narrated Salama:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Whoever (intentionally) ascribes to me what I have not said then (surely) let him occupy his seat in Hell-fire
hi: Salama (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai: "Maine Nabi (ﷺ) ko farmate suna: 'Jo jaan-boojh kar mere naam se woh baat mansoob kare jo maine nahi kahi, woh apna thikana Dozakh mein bana le.'"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Name yourselves with my name (use my name) but do not name yourselves with my Kunya name (i.e. Abul Qasim). And whoever sees me in a dream then surely he has seen me for Satan cannot impersonate me. And whoever tells a lie against me (intentionally), then (surely) let him occupy his seat in Hell-fire
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Apna naam mere naam par rakho, magar meri kunniyat (Abul Qasim) na rakho. Jo mujhe khwab mein dekhe, usne mujhe hi dekha kyunke shaitan meri shakl nahi bana sakta. Aur jo mujh par jaan-boojh kar jhoot bandhe, woh apna thikana Dozakh mein bana le."

e: Narrated Ash-Shu`bi:Abu Juhaifa said, "I asked `Ali, 'Have you got any book (which has been revealed to the Prophet (ﷺ) apart from the Qur'an)?' `Ali replied, 'No, except Allah's Book or the power of understanding which has been bestowed (by Allah) upon a Muslim or what is (written) in this sheet of paper (with me).' Abu Juhaifa said, "I asked, 'What is (written) in this sheet of paper?' `Ali replied, it deals with The Diyya (compensation (blood money) paid by the killer to the relatives of the victim), the ransom for the releasing of the captives from the hands of the enemies, and the law that no Muslim should be killed in Qisas (equality in punishment) for the killing of (a disbeliever)
hi: Ash-Shu'bi bataate hain ke Abu Juhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Ali (Alayhis Salam) se pucha: "Kya aapke paas (Quran ke ilawa) koi aur kitaab hai?" Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: "Nahi, siwaye Allah ki Kitaab, ya Musalman ko di gayi samajh, ya jo is kaghaz ke tukde mein hai." Abu Juhaifa ne pucha: "Iss kaghaz mein kya hai?" Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: "Diyat (khoon-bahaa) ke ahkaam, qaidiyon ki rihaai, aur yeh usool ke koi Musalman kisi kaafir ke badle Qisas mein qatl na kiya jaye."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:In the year of the Conquest of Mecca, the tribe of Khuza`a killed a man from the tribe of Bani Laith in revenge for a killed person, belonging to them. They informed the Prophet (ﷺ) about it. So he rode his Rahila (she-camel for riding) and addressed the people saying, "Allah held back the killing from Mecca. (The sub-narrator is in doubt whether the Prophet (ﷺ) said "elephant or killing," as the Arabic words standing for these words have great similarity in shape), but He (Allah) let His Apostle and the believers over power the infidels of Mecca. Beware! (Mecca is a sanctuary) Verily! Fighting in Mecca was not permitted for anyone before me nor will it be permitted for anyone after me. It (war) in it was made legal for me for few hours or so on that day. No doubt it is at this moment a sanctuary, it is not allowed to uproot its thorny shrubs or to uproot its trees or to pick up its Luqat (fallen things) except by a person who will look for its owner (announce it publicly). And if somebody is killed, then his closest relative has the right to choose one of the two-- the blood money (Diyya) or retaliation having the killer killed. In the meantime a man from Yemen came and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Get that written for me." The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered his companions to write that for him. Then a man from Quraish said, "Except Al-Idhkhir (a type of grass that has good smell) O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), as we use it in our houses and graves." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Except Al-Idhkhir i.e. Al-Idhkhir is allowed to be plucked
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Fatah-e-Mecca ke saal, Khuza'a qabile ne Bani Laith ke ek shaks ko apne aadmi ke badle qatl kar diya. Nabi (ﷺ) ko bataya gaya. Aap apni sawari par sawar hokar khade hue aur logon se farmaya: "Allah ne Mecca mein qatl (ya hathi) ko rok diya, magar Allah ne apne Rasool aur momino ko Mecca ke kaafiron par ghalba diya. Khabardar! (Mecca haram hai) — mujhse pehle na kisi ke liye yahan jung jaiz thi, na mere baad kisi ke liye hogi. Mujhe sirf chand ghanton ke liye ijazat mili thi. Aaj bhi yeh haram hai — na uski jhaadiyan ukhadi jayein, na darakht kaate jayein, na koi cheez uthai jaye siwaye us shaks ke jo maalik dhoondne ka elaan kare. Aur jo qatl ho jaye, uske sabse qareebi rishtedaar ko ikhtiyar hai — diyat le le ya qatil ko qatl karaye." Isi waqt Yemen ka ek shaks aaya aur kaha: "Ya Rasoolallah, mere liye yeh likh dijiye." Nabi ne apne sahaba ko likhne ka hukum diya. Phir Quraish ke ek shaks ne kaha: "Idhkhir (khushbudaar ghaas) ko chhod dein, Ya Rasoolallah, hum use apne gharon aur qabron mein istemaal karte hain." Nabi ne farmaya: "Idhkhir ko chhod do (uski ijazat hai)."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:There is none among the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) who has narrated more Hadiths than I except `Abdullah bin `Amr (bin Al-`As) who used to write them and I never did the same
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai: "Nabi (ﷺ) ke sahaba mein mujhse zyada hadith kisi ne bayan nahi ki, siwaye Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Aas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke, kyunke woh likh liya karte the aur main nahi likhta tha."

e: Narrated 'Ubaidullah bin `Abdullah:Ibn `Abbas said, "When the ailment of the Prophet (ﷺ) became worse, he said, 'Bring for me (writing) paper and I will write for you a statement after which you will not go astray.' But `Umar said, 'The Prophet is seriously ill, and we have got Allah's Book with us and that is sufficient for us.' But the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) differed about this and there was a hue and cry. On that the Prophet (ﷺ) said to them, 'Go away (and leave me alone). It is not right that you should quarrel in front of me." Ibn `Abbas came out saying, "It was most unfortunate (a great disaster) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was prevented from writing that statement for them because of their disagreement and noise. (Note: It is apparent from this Hadith that Ibn `Abbas had witnessed the event and came out saying this statement. The truth is not so, for Ibn `Abbas used to say this statement on narrating the Hadith and he had not witnessed the event personally. See Fath Al-Bari Vol. 1, p.220 footnote.) (See Hadith No. 228, Vol)
hi: Ubaidullah bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Jab Nabi (ﷺ) ki bimari shadeed ho gayi, Aap ne farmaya: 'Mere liye (likhne ke liye) kaghaz lao, main tumhare liye ek tehreer likh dun ke tum uske baad gumraah na ho.' Magar Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: 'Nabi bahut bimaar hain, humare paas Allah ki Kitaab hai jo hamare liye kaafi hai.' Sahaba ke darmiyan ikhtilaaf ho gaya aur shor uth gaya. Nabi ne farmaya: 'Chale jao (mujhe tanha chhod do), yeh theek nahi ke tum mere saamne jhagdo.'" Ibn Abbas ne bahar aakar kaha: "Yeh bahut bada nuqsaan hai ke Allah ke Rasool woh tehreer likhne se ruk gaye unke ikhtilaaf aur shor ki wajah se."

e: Narrated Um Salama:One night Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got up and said, "Subhan Allah! How many afflictions have been descended tonight and how many treasures have been disclosed! Go and wake the sleeping lady occupants of these dwellings (his wives) up (for prayers). A well-dressed (soul) in this world may be naked in the Hereafter
hi: Um Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain ke ek raat Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) uthe aur farmaya: "Subhan Allah! Aaj raat kitne fitne nazil hue hain aur kitne khazane zahir hue hain! Jaakar apni sone wali biwiyon ko jagao (namaz ke liye). Duniya mein khoob sajaa-sajaya (rooh) shayad Aakhirat mein nanga ho."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) led us in the `Isha' prayer during the last days of his life and after finishing it (the prayer) (with Taslim) he said: "Do you realize (the importance of) this night?" Nobody present on the surface of the earth tonight will be living after the completion of one hundred years from this night
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne apni zindagi ke aakhri dinon mein Isha ki namaz padhai, aur (salaam ke baad) farmaya: "Kya tumhe pata hai yeh raat ki ahmiyat kya hai? Aaj zameen par jo koi bhi maujood hai, woh sau saal ke baad zinda nahi hoga."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I stayed overnight in the house of my aunt Maimuna bint Al-Harith (the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ) ) while the Prophet (ﷺ) was there with her during her night turn. The Prophet (ﷺ) offered the `Isha' prayer (in the mosque), returned home and after having prayed four rak`at, he slept. Later on he got up at night and then asked whether the boy (or he used a similar word) had slept? Then he got up for the prayer and I stood up by his left side but he made me stand to his right and offered five rak`at followed by two more rak`at. Then he slept and I heard him snoring and then (after a while) he left for the (Fajr) prayer
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain ke main apni khala Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Al-Harith (رضی اللہ عنہا, Nabi ki biwi) ke ghar raat guzarta tha jab Nabi (ﷺ) unki baari mein wahan hote. Nabi ne Isha padhi (masjid mein), ghar aakar chaar rakat padhi phir so gaye. Baad mein raat ko uthe, pucha "kya bacha (ya isi tarah ka lafz) so gaya?" Phir namaz ke liye khade hue, main unke baayen taraf khada hua magar Aap ne mujhe apni dahini taraf kar diya, aur paanch rakat padhi, phir do rakat aur. Phir so gaye, main unki khurraati suni, phir (Fajr ki) namaz ke liye nikal gaye.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:People say that I have narrated many Hadiths (The Prophet's narration). Had it not been for two verses in the Qur'an, I would not have narrated a single Hadith, and the verses are: "Verily those who conceal the clear sign and the guidance which We have sent down . . . (up to) Most Merciful." (2:159-160). And no doubt our Muhajir (emigrant) brothers used to be busy in the market with their business (bargains) and our Ansari brothers used to be busy with their property (agriculture). But I (Abu Huraira) used to stick to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) contented with what will fill my stomach and I used to attend that which they used not to attend and I used to memorize that which they used not to memorize
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Log kehte hain maine bahut hadith bayan ki hain. Agar Quran ki do ayatein na hoti to main ek bhi hadith na bataata: 'Beshak jo log woh saaf nishaniyaan aur hidayat chhupaate hain jo humne nazil ki...' (2:159-160). Humare Muhajir bhai bazaar mein apne karobaar mein mashghool rehte the aur Ansaar bhai apni zameendari mein — magar main Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke saath laga rehta, sirf pet bharne par qanaa'at karta, aur woh majlisein hazir hota jinme woh log nahi hote, aur woh baatein yaad rakhta jo woh nahi rakhte."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) "I hear many narrations (Hadiths) from you but I forget them." Allah's Apostle said, "Spread your Rida' (garment)." I did accordingly and then he moved his hands as if filling them with something (and emptied them in my Rida') and then said, "Take and wrap this sheet over your body." I did it and after that I never forgot any thing. Narrated Ibrahim bin Al-Mundhir: Ibn Abi Fudaik narrated the same as above (Hadith...119) but added that the Prophet (ﷺ) had moved his hands as if filling them with something and then he emptied them in the Rida' of Abu Huraira
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) se kaha: 'Main aapse bahut hadithein sunta hoon magar bhool jaata hoon.' Aap ne farmaya: 'Apni chadar phaila do.' Maine waisa hi kiya, phir Aap ne apne haath is tarah harkat diye jaise kisi cheez se bharte hon, phir woh meri chadar mein daal di, aur farmaya: 'Ise apne jism par lapet lo.' Maine waisa hi kiya, aur uske baad main kuch nahi bhoola."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I have memorized two kinds of knowledge from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . I have propagated one of them to you and if I propagated the second, then my pharynx (throat) would be cut (i.e. killed)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) se do tarah ka ilm yaad kiya hai. Ek tumhe bata diya, agar doosra bataun to mera galaa kaat diya jayega."

e: Narrated Jarir:The Prophet (ﷺ) said to me during Hajjat-al-Wida`: Let the people keep quiet and listen. Then he said (addressing the people), "Do not (become infidels) revert to disbelief after me by striking the necks (cutting the throats) of one another (killing each other)
hi: Jarir (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne Hajjat-ul-Wida ke waqt farmaya: "Logon ko khamosh raho aur suno." Phir farmaya: "Mere baad kufr ki taraf na lautna ke ek dusre ki gardanein kaato (aapas mein qatl karo)."

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:I said to Ibn `Abbas, "Nauf-Al-Bakali claims that Moses (the companion of Khadir) was not the Moses of Bani Israel but he was another Moses." Ibn `Abbas remarked that the enemy of Allah (Nauf) was a liar. Narrated Ubai bin Ka`b: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Once the Prophet Moses (ﷺ) stood up and addressed Bani Israel. He was asked, "Who is the most learned man amongst the people. He said, "I am the most learned." Allah admonished Moses as he did not attribute absolute knowledge to Him (Allah). So Allah inspired to him "At the junction of the two seas there is a slave amongst my slaves who is more learned than you." Moses said, "O my Lord! How can I meet him?" Allah said: Take a fish in a large basket (and proceed) and you will find him at the place where you will lose the fish. So Moses set out along with his (servant) boy, Yusha` bin Noon and carried a fish in a large basket till they reached a rock, where they laid their heads (i.e. lay down) and slept. The fish came out of the basket and it took its way into the sea as in a tunnel. So it was an amazing thing for both Moses and his (servant) boy. They proceeded for the rest of that night and the following day. When the day broke, Moses said to his (servant) boy: "Bring us our early meal. No doubt, we have suffered much fatigue in this journey." Moses did not get tired till he passed the place about which he was told. There the (servant) boy told Moses, "Do you remember when we betook ourselves to the rock, I indeed forgot the fish." Moses remarked, "That is what we have been seeking. So they went back retracing their footsteps, till they reached the rock. There they saw a man covered with a garment (or covering himself with his own garment). Moses greeted him. Al-Khadir replied saying, "How do people greet each other in your land?" Moses said, "I am Moses." He asked, "The Moses of Bani Israel?" Moses replied in the affirmative and added, "May I follow you so that you teach me of that knowledge which you have been taught." Al-Khadir replied, "Verily! You will not be able to remain patient with me, O Moses! I have some of the knowledge of Allah which He has taught me and which you do not know, while you have some knowledge which Allah has taught you which I do not know." Moses said, "Allah willing, you will find me patient and I will disobey no order of yours. So both of them set out walking along the seashore, as they did not have a boat. In the meantime a boat passed by them and they requested the crew of the boat to take them on board. The crew recognized Al-Khadir and took them on board without fare. Then a sparrow came and stood on the edge of the boat and dipped its beak once or twice in the sea. Al-Khadir said: "O Moses! My knowledge and your knowledge have not decreased Allah's knowledge except as much as this sparrow has decreased the water of the sea with its beak." Al- Khadir went to one of the planks of the boat and plucked it out. Moses said, "These people gave us a free lift but you have broken their boat and scuttled it so as to drown its people." Al-Khadir replied, "Didn't I tell you that you will not be able to remain patient with me." Moses said, "Call me not to account for what I forgot." The first (excuse) of Moses was that he had forgotten. Then they proceeded further and found a boy playing with other boys. Al-Khadir took hold of the boy's head from the top and plucked it out with his hands (i.e. killed him). Moses said, "Have you killed an innocent soul who has killed none." Al-Khadir replied, "Did I not tell you that you cannot remain patient with me?" Then they both proceeded till when they came to the people of a town, they asked them for food, but they refused to entertain them. Then they found there a wall on the point of collapsing. Al-Khadir repaired it with his own hands. Moses said, "If you had wished, surely you could have taken wages for it." Al-Khadir replied, "This is the parting between you and me." The Prophet added, "May Allah be Merciful to Moses! Would that he could have been more patient to learn more about his story with Al-Khadir
hi: Sa'id bin Jubair bataate hain: "Maine Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kaha ke Nauf Al-Bakali ka daawa hai ke (Khadir ke sathi) Musa, Bani Israel ke Musa nahi the, balki koi doosre Musa the." Ibn Abbas ne kaha: "Allah ka woh dushman jhoot bolta hai." (Phir) Ubai bin Ka'b (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat: Nabi (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Musa (علیہ السلام) khade hue aur Bani Israel se khitaab kiya. Unse pucha gaya: 'Sabse zyada ilm wala kaun hai?' Unhone kaha: 'Main sabse zyada ilm wala hoon.' Allah ne Musa ko tanbeeh ki kyunke unhone poora ilm Allah ki taraf mansoob nahi kiya. Allah ne wahi ki: 'Do samundaron ke sangam par mera ek banda hai jo tumse zyada ilm wala hai.' Musa ne pucha: 'Aye mere Rab, main usse kaise milun?' Allah ne kaha: 'Ek machhli ek tokri mein le jao, jahan machhli gum ho jaye wahin woh milega.' Musa apne khadim Yusha bin Noon ke saath nikle, machhli tokri mein leke, yahan tak ke ek chatan tak pahunche jahan unhone sar rakh kar so gaye. Machhli tokri se nikal kar samundar mein ek surakh se guzar gayi. Yeh Musa aur unke khadim dono ke liye ajeeb baat thi. Woh raat aur din chalte rahe. Subah ko Musa ne apne khadim se kaha: 'Hamara nashta lao, is safar mein hum bahut thak gaye hain.' Musa tab tak nahi thake jab tak woh us jagah se aage nikal gaye jiske baare mein unhe bataya gaya tha. Wahan khadim ne kaha: 'Yaad hai jab hum us chatan par theyre the, main machhli bhool gaya tha.' Musa ne kaha: 'Yehi to hum dhoond rahe the.' Woh apne raaste wapas gaye, chatan tak pahunche, wahan ek shaks apni chadar mein lipta hua dekha. Musa ne salaam kiya. Khadir ne jawab diya: 'Tumhare ilaqe mein log kaise salaam karte hain?' Musa ne kaha: 'Main Musa hoon.' Usne pucha: 'Bani Israel ke Musa?' Musa ne 'haan' kaha aur poocha: 'Kya main aapke saath rahoon taake aap mujhe woh ilm sikhaein jo aapko sikhaya gaya hai?' Khadir ne kaha: 'Tum mere saath sabr nahi kar sakoge, Aye Musa! Mujhe Allah ka woh ilm hai jo tumhe nahi, aur tumhe woh ilm hai jo mujhe nahi.' Musa ne kaha: 'Insha Allah, tum mujhe sabr karta paoge, aur main aapki kisi baat ki nafarmani nahi karunga.' Phir dono samundar ke kinare chal diye, kyunke unke paas kashti nahi thi. Ek kashti guzri, unhone sawari ke liye guzarish ki. Kashti wale Khadir ko jaan gaye aur bina kiraye ke unhe sawar kar liya. Ek chidiya aayi aur kashti ke kinare baith kar apni chonch samundar mein ek-do baar dubaayi. Khadir ne kaha: 'Aye Musa! Mera aur tumhara ilm Allah ke ilm ko utna hi kam nahi kar saka jitna is chidiya ne apni chonch se samundar ka paani kam kiya.' Phir Khadir ne kashti ka ek takhta ukhad diya. Musa ne kaha: 'Inhone humein muft sawari di aur aapne unki kashti tod kar unhe dubane ki koshish ki?' Khadir ne kaha: 'Kya maine nahi kaha tha ke tum sabr nahi kar sakoge?' Musa ne kaha: 'Jo main bhool gaya uska mujhse hisaab na lena.' Yeh Musa ka pehla bahana tha. Phir woh chal diye, ek bacche ko doosre bacchon ke saath khelte paaya. Khadir ne uska sar pakad kar ukhad diya (use qatl kar diya). Musa ne kaha: 'Kya aapne ek be-gunah jaan ko qatl kar diya jisne kisi ko qatl nahi kiya?' Khadir ne kaha: 'Kya maine nahi kaha tha ke tum sabr nahi kar sakoge?' Phir dono proceeded till when they came to the people of a town, unhone khana maanga magar unhone inkaar kiya. Wahan unhe ek deewar mili jo girne ke qareeb thi. Khadir ne apne haathon se use theek kar diya. Musa ne kaha: 'Agar aap chahte to iski mazdoori le sakte the.' Khadir ne kaha: 'Yahi mera aur tumhara judaai ka waqt hai.'" Nabi ne farmaya: "Allah Musa par reham kare, kaash woh aur sabr karte to unki Khadir wali kahani ke baare mein aur bhi jaante."

e: Narrated Abu Musa:A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What kind of fighting is in Allah's cause? (I ask this), for some of us fight because of being enraged and angry and some for the sake of his pride and haughtiness." The Prophet (ﷺ) raised his head (as the questioner was standing) and said, "He who fights so that Allah's Word (Islam) should be superior, then he fights in Allah's cause
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke ek shaks Nabi (ﷺ) ke paas aaya aur pucha: "Ya Rasoolallah, Allah ki raah mein jung kaun hai? Kyunke hum mein se koi gusse mein ladta hai, koi ghairat ke liye." Nabi ne sar utha kar (kyunke sawaal karne wala khada tha) farmaya: "Jo isliye ladta hai ke Allah ka kalma (Islam) buland ho, woh Allah ki raah mein hai."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Ammar:I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) near the Jamra and the people were asking him questions (about religious problems). A man asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have slaughtered the Hadi (animal) before doing the Rami." The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Do the Rami (now) and there is no harm." Another person asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I got my head shaved before slaughtering the animal." The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Do the slaughtering (now) and there is no harm." So on that day, when the Prophet (ﷺ) was asked about anything as regards the ceremonies of Hajj performed before or after its due time his reply was, "Do it (now) and there is no harm
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ammar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke maine Nabi (ﷺ) ko Jamra ke qareeb dekha, log sawaal poochh rahe the. Ek shaks ne pucha: "Ya Rasoolallah, maine Rami se pehle qurbani kar li." Nabi ne farmaya: "Ab Rami kar lo, koi harj nahi." Doosre ne kaha: "Ya Rasoolallah, maine qurbani se pehle sar munwa liya." Farmaya: "Ab qurbani kar lo, koi harj nahi." Us din Aap ka har sawaal ka jawab yehi tha: "Ab kar lo, koi harj nahi."

e: Narrated `Abdullah:While I was going with the Prophet (ﷺ) through the ruins of Medina and he was reclining on a date-palm leaf stalk, some Jews passed by. Some of them said to the others: Ask him (the Prophet) about the spirit. Some of them said that they should not ask him that question as he might give a reply which would displease them. But some of them insisted on asking, and so one of them stood up and asked, "O Abul-Qasim ! What is the spirit?" The Prophet (ﷺ) remained quiet. I thought he was being inspired Divinely. So I stayed till that state of the Prophet (while being inspired) was over. The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "And they ask you (O Muhammad) concerning the spirit --Say: The spirit -- its knowledge is with my Lord. And of knowledge you (mankind) have been given only a little
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke main Nabi (ﷺ) ke saath Madina ke khandaraat mein ja raha tha, Aap khajoor ke patte ke danday par tik kar chal rahe the. Kuch Yahudi guzre, unme se kuch ne kaha: "Inse rooh ke baare mein poocho." Kuch ne kaha yeh sawaal na poocho kyunke jawab pasand nahi aayega. Phir bhi kisi ne poochne ki zid ki, ek khada hokar bola: "Aye Abul Qasim! Rooh kya hai?" Nabi khamosh rahe. Maine socha Aap par wahi utar rahi hai, main wahin rukka rahaa yahan tak ke woh haalat khatam hui. Phir Nabi ne farmaya: "Aur (aye Muhammad) yeh log tumse rooh ke baare mein poochte hain — kaho: rooh ka ilm mere Rab ke paas hai, aur tumhe (insaano ko) sirf thoda sa ilm diya gaya hai."

e: Narrated Aswad:Ibn Az-Zubair said to me, "Aisha used to tell you secretly a number of things. What did she tell you about the Ka`ba?" I replied, "She told me that once the Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'O `Aisha! Had not your people been still close to the pre-Islamic period of ignorance (infidelity)! I would have dismantled the Ka`ba and would have made two doors in it; one for entrance and the other for exit." Later on Ibn Az-Zubair did the same
hi: Aswad bataate hain ke Ibn Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne mujhse pucha: "Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) tumhe khufia baatein bataati thin. Unhone Ka'ba ke baare mein kya bataya?" Maine kaha: "Unhone bataya ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne farmaya: 'Aye Ayesha! Agar tumhari qaum abhi bhi jahiliyat ke qareeb na hoti, to main Ka'ba ko gira kar dobara banwaata aur usme do darwaze rakhta — ek dakhle ke liye, ek nikalne ke liye.'" Baad mein Ibn Zubair ne yehi kiya.

e: Narrated Abu at-Tufail:The above mentioned Statement of `Ali
hi: Abu at-Tufail se yehi bayan Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke baare mein riwayat hai (jo upar zikar hua).

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:"Once Mu`adh was along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as a companion rider. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O Mu`adh bin Jabal." Mu`adh replied, "Labbaik and Sa`daik. O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" Again the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Mu`adh!" Mu`adh said thrice, "Labbaik and Sa`daik, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "There is none who testifies sincerely that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah and Muhammad is his Apostle, except that Allah, will save him from the Hell-fire." Mu`adh said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ! Should I not inform the people about it so that they may have glad tidings?" He replied, "When the people hear about it, they will solely depend on it." Then Mu`adh narrated the above-mentioned Hadith just before his death, being afraid of committing sin (by not telling the knowledge)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai: "Mu'adh Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke saath sawari par saathi the. Nabi ne farmaya: 'Aye Mu'adh bin Jabal (رضی اللہ عنہ)!' Mu'adh ne kaha: 'Labbaik wa Sa'daik, Ya Rasoolallah!' Nabi ne phir farmaya: 'Aye Mu'adh!' Mu'adh ne teen baar kaha: 'Labbaik wa Sa'daik, Ya Rasoolallah!' Nabi ne farmaya: 'Jo sacche dil se gawahi de ke Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahi aur Muhammad uske Rasool hain, Allah use Dozakh se bacha lega.' Mu'adh ne kaha: 'Ya Rasoolallah, kya main logon ko yeh khushkhabri na de dun?' Farmaya: 'Jab log sunenge to sirf isi par bharosa kar baithenge.'" Mu'adh ne apni maut se pehle yeh hadith bataai, is dar se ke ilm chhupane ka gunah na ho.

e: Narrated Anas:I was informed that the Prophet (ﷺ) had said to Mu`adh, "Whosoever will meet Allah without associating anything in worship with Him will go to Paradise." Mu`adh asked the Prophet, "Should I not inform the people of this good news?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "No, I am afraid, lest they should depend upon it (absolutely)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko bataya gaya ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne Mu'adh se farmaya: "Jo bhi Allah se milega bina kisi ko shareek kiye, woh Jannat mein jayega." Mu'adh ne pucha: "Kya main logon ko yeh khushkhabri na dun?" Nabi ne farmaya: "Nahi, mujhe dar hai ke woh sirf isi par bharosa kar baithenge."

e: Narrated Um Salama:Um-Sulaim came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "Verily, Allah is not shy of (telling you) the truth. Is it necessary for a woman to take a bath after she has a wet dream (nocturnal sexual discharge?) The Prophet replied, "Yes, if she notices a discharge." Um Salama, then covered her face and asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Does a woman get a discharge?" He replied, "Yes, let your right hand be in dust (An Arabic expression you say to a person when you contradict his statement meaning "you will not achieve goodness"), and that is why the son resembles his mother
hi: Um Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain ke Um Sulaim Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke paas aayi aur kaha: "Allah sach batane mein sharm nahi karta — kya aurat ko khwab mein (jinsi) inzaal hone par ghusl zaroori hai?" Nabi ne farmaya: "Haan, agar usse mayi ka asar dikhe." Um Salama ne apna chehra dhaanp kar pucha: "Ya Rasoolallah, kya aurat ko bhi inzaal hota hai?" Farmaya: "Haan, (tumhara haath khaak-aalooda ho, agar aisa na ho) — isi liye to bacha apni maa jaisa hota hai."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Amongst the trees there is a tree, the leaves of which do not fall and is like a Muslim, tell me the name of that tree." Everybody started thinking about the trees of the desert areas and I thought of the date-palm tree but felt shy (to answer). The others asked, "O Allah's Apostle! inform us of it." He replied, "It is the date-palm tree." I told my father what had come to my mind and on that he said, "Had you said it I would have preferred it to such and such a thing that I might possess
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Darakhton mein ek darakht hai jiske patte nahi girte, Musalman jaisa — batao uska naam." Log sehra ke darakhton ke baare mein sochne lage, mujhe khajoor khyal aaya magar sharm ki wajah se bol na saka. Logon ne pucha: "Ya Rasoolallah, bataiye." Aap ne farmaya: "Yeh khajoor ka darakht hai." Maine apne waalid ko apna khayal bataya, unhone kaha: "Agar tum bol dete to mujhe falaan-falaan cheez se zyada pasand hota."

e: Narrated `Ali:I used to get the emotional urethral discharge frequently so I requested Al-Miqdad to ask the Prophet (ﷺ) about it. Al-Miqdad asked him and he replied, "One has to perform ablution (after it)." (See Hadith No)
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: "Mujhe (jinsi) rassi ka mazi aksar aata tha, isliye maine Miqdad (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kaha ke woh Nabi se pucha len. Miqdad ne poocha, Nabi ne farmaya: 'Iske liye wudu karna kaafi hai.'"

e: Narrated Nafi`:`Abdullah bin `Umar said: "A man got up in the mosque and said: 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) At which place you order us that we should assume the Ihram?' Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, 'The residents of Medina should assure the Ihram from Dhil-Hulaifa, the people of Syria from Al-Juhfa and the people of Najd from Qarn." Ibn `Umar further said, "The people consider that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had also said, 'The residents of Yemen should assume Ihram from Yalamlam.' " Ibn `Umar used to say, "I do not remember whether Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said the last statement or not
hi: Nafi' bataate hain, Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) ne kaha: "Ek shaks masjid mein khada hokar bola: 'Ya Rasoolallah, hum kahan se Ihram baandhein?' Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne farmaya: 'Madina ke log Dhil-Hulaifa se, Syria ke log Al-Juhfa se, aur Najd ke log Qarn se Ihram baandhein.'" Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Log kehte hain Aap ne yeh bhi farmaya tha ke Yemen ke log Yalamlam se Ihram baandhein." Ibn Umar khud kehte the: "Mujhe yaad nahi ke Allah ke Rasool ne yeh aakhri baat kahi ya nahi."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:A man asked the Prophet (ﷺ) : "What (kinds of clothes) should a Muhrim (a Muslim intending to perform `Umra or Hajj) wear? He replied, "He should not wear a shirt, a turban, trousers, a head cloak or garment scented with saffron or Wars (kinds of perfumes). And if he has no slippers, then he can use Khuffs (socks made from thick fabric or leather) but the socks should be cut short so as to make the ankles bare." (See Hadith No. 615, Vol)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke ek shaks ne Nabi (ﷺ) se pucha: "Muhrim (Ihram wala Musalman) kya pehne?" Aap ne farmaya: "Woh kurta, pagdi, pajama, sar ka kapda ya zafraan/wars se rangi hui koi cheez na pehne. Agar juti na ho to Khuff (mote kapde ya chamde ke jute) pehen sakta hai, magar unhe kaat kar takhno tak chhota kar de."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The prayer of a person who does Hadath (passes urine, stool or wind) is not accepted till he performs the ablution." A person from Hadaramout asked Abu Huraira, "What is 'Hadath'?" Abu Huraira replied, " 'Hadath' means the passing of wind
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Jis shaks se hadath ho jaye (peshab, paikhana ya hawa), uski namaz qubool nahi hoti jab tak woh wudu na kar le." Hadaramaut ke ek shaks ne Abu Huraira se pucha: "Hadath kya hai?" Unhone jawab diya: "Hawa ka nikalna."

e: Narrated Nu`am Al-Mujmir:Once I went up the roof of the mosque, along with Abu Huraira. He performed ablution and said, "I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "On the Day of Resurrection, my followers will be called "Al-Ghurr-ul- Muhajjalun" from the trace of ablution and whoever can increase the area of his radiance should do so (i.e. by performing ablution regularly)
hi: Nu'am Al-Mujmir bataate hain ke main Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath masjid ki chhat par gaya. Unhone wudu kiya aur kaha: "Maine Nabi (ﷺ) ko farmate suna: 'Qiyamat ke din meri ummat ko wudu ke asraat ki wajah se Al-Ghurr-ul-Muhajjalun (chamakte hue chehre-haath-paon wale) kaha jayega, jo apni chamak barhaana chahe, zyada wudu kare.'"

e: Narrated `Abbad bin Tamim:My uncle asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about a person who imagined to have passed wind during the prayer. Allah's Apostle replied: "He should not leave his prayers unless he hears sound or smells something
hi: Abbad bin Tamim bataate hain ke unke chacha ne Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) se pucha us shaks ke baare mein jise namaz mein shak ho ke hawa nikli hai. Aap ne farmaya: "Jab tak awaaz na sune ya badbu na aaye, namaz na tode."

e: Narrated Kuraib:Ibn `Abbas said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) slept till he snored and then prayed (or probably lay till his breath sounds were heard and then got up and prayed)." Ibn `Abbas added: "I stayed overnight in the house of my aunt, Maimuna, the Prophet (ﷺ) slept for a part of the night, (See Fath-al-Bari page 249, Vol. 1), and late in the night, he got up and performed ablution from a hanging water skin, a light (perfect) ablution and stood up for the prayer. I, too, performed a similar ablution, then I went and stood on his left. He drew me to his right and prayed as much as Allah wished, and again lay and slept till his breath sounds were heard. Later on the Mu'adh-dhin (call maker for the prayer) came to him and informed him that it was time for Prayer. The Prophet (ﷺ) went with him for the prayer without performing a new ablution." (Sufyan said to `Amr that some people said, "The eyes of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sleep but his heart does not sleep." `Amr replied, "I heard `Ubaid bin `Umar saying that the dreams of Prophets were Divine Inspiration, and then he recited the verse: 'I (Abraham) see in a dream, (O my son) that I offer you in sacrifice (to Allah)." (37.102) (See Hadith No)
hi: Kuraib bataate hain ke Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) ne kaha: "Nabi (ﷺ) so gaye yahan tak ke unki khurraati aane lagi, phir namaz padhi." Ibn Abbas ne bataya: "Main apni khala Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke ghar raat guzar raha tha, Nabi kuch der so gaye, phir raat ke aakhri hisse mein uthe aur latakti hui mashkiza se halka lekin mukammal wudu kiya, aur namaz ke liye khade ho gaye. Maine bhi waisa hi wudu kiya, phir jaakar unke baayen taraf khada hua, unhone mujhe apni dahini taraf kar liya, aur jitni Allah ne chahi namaz padhi, phir dobara so gaye yahan tak ke khurraati aane lagi. Baad mein Muazzin aaye aur namaz ka waqt bataya. Nabi bina naya wudu kiye unke saath namaz ke liye chale gaye."

e: Narrated Usama bin Zaid:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) proceeded from `Arafat till when he reached the mountain pass, he dismounted, urinated and then performed ablution but not a perfect one. I said to him, ("Is it the time for) the prayer, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" He said, "The (place of) prayer is ahead of you." He rode till when he reached Al-Muzdalifa, he dismounted and performed ablution and a perfect one, The (call for) Iqama was pronounced and he led the Maghrib prayer. Then everybody made his camel kneel down at its place. Then the Iqama was pronounced for the `Isha' prayer which the Prophet (ﷺ) led and no prayer was offered in between the two . prayers (`Isha' and Maghrib)
hi: Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) Arafat se chal kar ghaate tak pahunche, utre, peshab kiya aur halka wudu kiya (mukammal nahi). Maine pucha: "Namaz ka waqt hai, Ya Rasoolallah?" Aap ne farmaya: "Namaz ki jagah aage hai." Aap sawar hue yahan tak ke Muzdalifa pahunche, wahan utre aur mukammal wudu kiya. Iqamat hui aur Aap ne Maghrib padhai. Phir sabne apne oont apni jagah baithaye. Phir Isha ki iqamat hui jo Nabi ne padhai, aur donon namazon ke darmiyan kuch aur namaz nahi padhi gayi.

e: Narrated `Ata' bin Yasar:Ibn `Abbas performed ablution and washed his face (in the following way): He ladled out a handful of water, rinsed his mouth and washed his nose with it by putting in water and then blowing it out. He then, took another handful (of water) and did like this (gesturing) joining both hands, and washed his face, took another handful of water and washed his right forearm. He again took another handful of water and washed his left forearm, and passed wet hands over his head and took another handful of water and poured it over his right foot (up to his ankles) and washed it thoroughly and similarly took another handful of water and washed thoroughly his left foot (up to the ankles) and said, "I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) performing ablution in this way
