hi: Ata bin Yasar bataate hain ke Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne wudu karke apna chehra dhoya: unhone ek hatheli paani li, kulli ki aur naak mein paani daal kar saaf kiya, phir doosri hatheli li aur donon haath jodkar chehra dhoya, phir ek aur hatheli se dahina baazu (kohni tak) dhoya, phir ek aur hatheli se baayan baazu dhoya, phir sar par haath phera, phir ek aur hatheli se paani apne dahine paon par daal kar (takhne tak) achhi tarah dhoya, isi tarah baayan paon bhi dhoya, aur farmaya: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ko isi tarah wudu karte dekha hai."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If anyone of you on having sexual relations with his wife said (and he must say it before starting) 'In the name of Allah. O Allah! Protect us from Satan and also protect what you bestow upon us (i.e. the coming offspring) from Satan,' and if it is destined that they should have a child then, Satan will never be able to harm that offspring
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Jab koi apni biwi se humbistari se pehle kahe: 'Allah ke naam se. Aye Allah! Humein shaitan se bacha aur jo tu humein de (aulad) usay bhi shaitan se bacha,' aur agar unki taqdeer mein aulad ho, to shaitan use kabhi nuqsan nahi pahuncha sakta."

e: Narrated Anas:Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) went to answer the call of nature, he used to say, "Allah-umma inni a`udhu bika minal khubuthi wal khaba'ith i.e. O Allah, I seek Refuge with You from all offensive and wicked things (evil deeds and evil spirits)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) jab bhi qaza-e-hajat ke liye jaate, farmate: "Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal khubuthi wal khaba'ith" (Aye Allah! Main tujhse har buri cheez aur bure shaitanon se panah maangta hoon).

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) entered a lavatory and I placed water for his ablution. He asked, "Who placed it?" He was informed accordingly and so he said, "O Allah! Make him (Ibn `Abbas) a learned scholar in religion (Islam)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) ek baar bait-ul-khala mein gaye aur maine wudu ke liye paani rakh diya. Aap ne pucha: "Kisne rakha?" Bataya gaya to Aap ne farmaya: "Aye Allah! Ise (Ibn Abbas ko) deen ka aalim bana."

e: Narrated Abu Aiyub Al-Ansari:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If anyone of you goes to an open space for answering the call of nature he should neither face nor turn his back towards the Qibla; he should either face the east or the west
hi: Abu Aiyub Al-Ansari (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Jab tum khule maidan mein qaza-e-hajat ke liye jao to Qibla ki taraf mun ya pusht na karo, mashriq ya magrib ki taraf mun karo."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:People say, "Whenever you sit for answering the call of nature, you should not face the Qibla or Baitul-Maqdis (Jerusalem)." I told them, "Once I went up the roof of our house and I saw Allah's Apostle answering the call of nature while sitting on two bricks facing Baitul-Maqdis (Jerusalem) (but there was a screen covering him. ' (Fath-al-Bari, Page 258, Vol)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai: "Log kehte hain ke qaza-e-hajat ke waqt Qibla ya Baitul-Maqdis ki taraf mun na karo. Maine bataya: 'Ek baar main apne ghar ki chhat par gaya aur Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ko do eenton par baithe qaza-e-hajat karte dekha, Baitul-Maqdis ki taraf mun karke (lekin aad mein parda tha).'"

e: Narrated `Aisha:The wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) used to go to Al-Manasi, a vast open place (near Baqi` at Medina) to answer the call of nature at night. `Umar used to say to the Prophet (ﷺ) "Let your wives be veiled," but Allah's Apostle did not do so. One night Sauda bint Zam`a the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ) went out at `Isha' time and she was a tall lady. `Umar addressed her and said, "I have recognized you, O Sauda." He said so, as he desired eagerly that the verses of Al-Hijab (the observing of veils by the Muslim women) may be revealed. So Allah revealed the verses of "Al-Hijab" (A complete body cover excluding the eyes)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain ke Nabi (ﷺ) ki biwiyan raat ko Al-Manasi (Madina ke qareeb khula maidan) jaati thin qaza-e-hajat ke liye. Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) Nabi se kehte: "Apni biwiyon ko parda karayein," magar Aap ne nahi kiya. Ek raat Sauda (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Zam'a (Nabi ki biwi), jo qad-aawar thin, Isha ke waqt bahar nikli. Umar ne unhe pehchaan kar kaha: "Main tumhe jaan gaya, aye Sauda." Yeh unhone isliye kaha kyunke woh chahte the ke Hijab ki ayaat nazil ho. Chunanche Allah ne Hijab ki ayaat nazil farmayi.

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said to his wives, "You are allowed to go out to answer the call of nature
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne apni biwiyon se farmaya: "Tumhe qaza-e-hajat ke liye bahar jaane ki ijazat hai."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:I went up to the roof of Hafsa's house for some job and I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) answering the call of nature facing Sham (Syria, Jordan, Palestine and Lebanon regarded as one country) with his back towards the Qibla. (See Hadith No)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain ke main Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke ghar ki chhat par kaam se gaya aur Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ko qaza-e-hajat karte dekha, Sham ki taraf mun aur Qibla ki taraf pusht karke.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Once I went up the roof of our house and saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) answering the call of nature while sitting over two bricks facing Baitul-Maqdis (Jerusalem). (See Hadith No)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain ke main apne ghar ki chhat par gaya aur Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ko do eenton par baithe, Baitul-Maqdis ki taraf mun karke, qaza-e-hajat karte dekha.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went to answer the call of nature, I along with another boy used to accompany him with a tumbler full of water. (Hisham commented, "So that he might wash his private parts with it)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke jab Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) qaza-e-hajat ke liye jaate, main aur ek doosra ladka paani se bhara bartan lekar unke saath jaate (taake woh isse safai kar sakein).

e: Narrated Anas:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went to answer the call of nature, I along with another boy from us used to go behind him with a tumbler full of water
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke jab Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) qaza-e-hajat ke liye jaate, main aur ek doosra ladka paani ka bartan lekar unke peechhe jaate.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went to answer the call of nature, I along with another boy used to carry a tumbler full of water (for cleaning the private parts) and a short spear (or stick)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke jab Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) qaza-e-hajat ke liye jaate, main aur ek doosra ladka paani ka bartan aur ek chhoti chhadi le jaate.

e: Narrated Abu Qatada:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whenever anyone of you drinks water, he should not breathe in the drinking utensil, and whenever anyone of you goes to a lavatory, he should neither touch his penis nor clean his private parts with his right hand
hi: Abu Qatada (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Jab koi paani piye to bartan mein saans na le, aur jab koi bait-ul-khala jaye to apne aala se haath na lagaye ya apni sharmgaah dahine haath se saaf na kare."

e: Narrated Abu Qatada:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whenever anyone of you makes water he should not hold his penis or clean his private parts with his right hand. (And while drinking) one should not breathe in the drinking utensil
hi: Abu Qatada (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Jab koi peshab kare to apna aala dahine haath se na pakde ya sharmgaah dahine haath se saaf na kare. (Aur paani peete waqt) bartan mein saans na le."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I followed the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was going out to answer the call of nature. He used not to look this way or that. So, when I approached near him he said to me, "Fetch for me some stones for ' cleaning the privates parts (or said something similar), and do not bring a bone or a piece of dung." So I brought the stones in the corner of my garment and placed them by his side and I then went away from him. When he finished (from answering the call of nature) he used, them
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Main Nabi (ﷺ) ke peechhe gaya jab Aap qaza-e-hajat ke liye ja rahe the. Aap idhar-udhar nahi dekhte the. Jab main qareeb aaya, Aap ne farmaya: 'Mere liye sharmgaah saaf karne ke patthar la do (ya isi tarah kuch kaha), aur haddi ya gobar na lana.' Main apni chadar ke pallu mein patthar leke aaya aur unke paas rakh diya, phir wapas chala gaya. Jab Aap qaza-e-hajat se faarigh hue to unhe istemaal kiya."

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) went out to answer the call of nature and asked me to bring three stones. I found two stones and searched for the third but could not find it. So I took a dried piece of dung and brought it to him. He took the two stones and threw away the dung and said, "This is a filthy thing
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Nabi (ﷺ) qaza-e-hajat ke liye gaye aur mujhe teen patthar laane ko kaha. Mujhe do mil gaye, teesra na mila, to main sukha gobar le aaya. Aap ne do patthar rakh liye aur gobar phenk diya, aur farmaya: 'Yeh napaak cheez hai.'"

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) performed ablution by washing the body parts only once
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne wudu ke ang sirf ek-ek baar dhoye.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Zaid:The Prophet (ﷺ) performed ablution by washing the body parts twice
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne wudu ke ang do-do baar dhoye.

e: Narrated Humran: (the slave of 'Uthman) I saw 'Uthman bin 'Affan asking for a tumbler of water (and when it was brought) he poured water over his hands and washed them thrice and then put his right hand in the water container and rinsed his mouth, washed his nose by putting water in it and then blowing it out. then he washed his face and forearms up to the elbows thrice, passed his wet hands over his head and washed his feet up to the ankles thrice. Then he said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said 'If anyone performs ablution like that of mine and offers a two-rak'at prayer during which he does not think of anything else (not related to the present prayer) then his past sins will be forgiven
hi: Humran (Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke azaad kiye gulaam) bataate hain ke maine Uthman bin Affan (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko paani ka bartan mangte dekha (jab laaya gaya) unhone haathon par paani daal kar teen baar dhoya, phir dahine haath se paani lekar kulli ki, naak mein paani daal kar saaf kiya, phir teen baar chehra, teen baar kohniyon tak baazu dhoye, sar par haath phera aur teen baar takhno tak paon dhoye. Phir unhone kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne farmaya: 'Jo mere jaise wudu kare aur do rakat namaz padhe jisme dil kisi aur cheez mein na laga ho, uske pichhle gunah maaf ho jayenge.'"

e: After performing the ablution 'Uthman said, "I am going to tell you a Hadith which I would not have told you, had I not been compelled by a certain Holy Verse (the sub narrator 'Urwa said:This verse is: "Verily, those who conceal the clear signs and the guidance which we have sent down...)" (2:159). I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, 'If a man performs ablution perfectly and then offers the compulsory congregational prayer, Allah will forgive his sins committed between that (prayer) and the (next) prayer till he offers it
hi: Wudu ke baad Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Main tumhe woh hadith bataunga jo agar Quran ki ek ayat na hoti to na bataata: 'Beshak jo log woh saaf nishaniyaan chhupaate hain jo humne nazil ki...' (2:159). Maine Nabi (ﷺ) ko farmate suna: 'Jo mukammal wudu kare aur farz namaz jamaat ke saath padhe, Allah uske gunah is namaz aur agli namaz ke darmiyan maaf kar dega.'"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever performs ablution should clean his nose with water by putting the water in it and then blowing it out, and whoever cleans his private parts with stones should do it with odd number of stones
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Jo wudu kare, naak mein paani daal kar saaf kare, aur jo pathron se safai kare, taaq (odd) tadaad mein kare."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If anyone of you performs ablution he should put water in his nose and then blow it out and whoever cleans his private parts with stones should do so with odd numbers. And whoever wakes up from his sleep should wash his hands before putting them in the water for ablution, because nobody knows where his hands were during sleep
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Wudu karne wala naak mein paani daal kar saaf kare, aur pathron se safai karne wala taaq tadaad mein kare. Aur jo neend se uthe, apne haath dhoye pehle wudu ke paani mein daale, kyunke kisi ko nahi pata uske haath neend mein kahan the."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:The Prophet (ﷺ) remained behind us on a journey. He joined us while we were performing ablution for the `Asr prayer which was overdue and we were just passing wet hands over our feet (not washing them thoroughly) so he addressed us in a loud voice saying twice , "Save your heels from the fire
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) ek safar mein humse peechhe reh gaye, hum takheer shuda Asr ki namaz ke liye wudu kar rahe the aur sirf paon par haath phair rahe the. Nabi ne buland awaaz se do baar farmaya: "Apne panon ko (dozakh ki) aag se bachao."

e: Narrated Humran:(the freed slave of `Uthman bin `Affan) I saw `Uthman bin `Affan asking (for a tumbler of water) to perform ablution (and when it was brought) he poured water from it over his hands and washed them thrice and then put his right hand in the water container and rinsed his mouth and washed his nose by putting water in it and then blowing it out. Then he washed his face thrice and (then) forearms up to the elbows thrice, then passed his wet hands over his head and then washed each foot thrice. After that `Uthman said, "I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) performing ablution like this of mine, and he said, 'If anyone performs ablution like that of mine and offers a two-rak`at prayer during which he does not think of anything else (not related to the present prayer) then his past sins will be forgiven
hi: Humran (Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke azaad gulaam) bataate hain ke maine Uthman bin Affan ko wudu ke liye paani mangte dekha, unhone haathon par paani daal kar teen baar dhoya, kulli ki, naak saaf ki, teen baar chehra, teen baar kohniyon tak baazu, sar par haath phera aur teen-teen baar har paon dhoya. Iske baad Uthman ne kaha: "Maine Nabi (ﷺ) ko isi tarah wudu karte dekha, aur Aap ne farmaya: 'Jo mere jaise wudu kare aur do rakat namaz padhe jisme dil kisi aur taraf na jaye, uske pichhle gunah maaf ho jayenge.'"

e: Narrated Muhammad Ibn Ziyad:I heard Abu Huraira saying as he passed by us while the people were performing ablution from a utensil containing water, "Perform ablution perfectly and thoroughly for Abul-Qasim (the Prophet) said, 'Save your heels from the Hell-fire
hi: Muhammad Ibn Ziyad bataate hain ke Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) humare paas se guzre jab log ek bartan se wudu kar rahe the, unhone kaha: "Mukammal aur achhi tarah wudu karo, kyunke Abul-Qasim (Nabi) ne farmaya: 'Apne panon ko Dozakh ki aag se bachao.'"

e: Narrated `Ubaid Ibn Juraij:I asked `Abdullah bin `Umar, "O Abu `Abdur-Rahman! I saw you doing four things which I never saw being done by anyone of you companions?" `Abdullah bin `Umar said, "What are those, O Ibn Juraij?" I said, "I never saw you touching any corner of the Ka`ba except these (two) facing south (Yemen) and I saw you wearing shoes made of tanned leather and dyeing your hair with Hinna (a kind of red dye). I also noticed that whenever you were in Mecca, the people assume Ihram on seeing the new moon crescent (1st of Dhul-Hijja) while you did not assume the Ihlal (Ihram) -(Ihram is also called Ihlal which means 'Loud calling' because a Muhrim has to recite Talbiya aloud when assuming the state of Ihram) - till the 8th of Dhul-Hijja (Day of Tarwiya). `Abdullah replied, "Regarding the corners of Ka`ba, I never saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) touching except those facing south (Yemen) and regarding the tanned leather shoes, no doubt I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) wearing non-hairy shoes and he used to perform ablution while wearing the shoes (i.e. wash his feet and then put on the shoes). So I love to wear similar shoes. And about the dyeing of hair with Hinna; no doubt I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) dyeing his hair with it and that is why I like to dye (my hair with it). Regarding Ihlal, I did not see Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) assuming Ihlal till he set out for Hajj (on the 8th of Dhul-Hijja)
hi: Ubaid Ibn Juraij bataate hain ke maine Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha: "Aye Abu Abdur-Rahman! Maine aapko chaar aisi baatein karte dekha hai jo aapke kisi sathi ko karte nahi dekha?" Unhone pucha: "Woh kya hain, Aye Ibn Juraij?" Maine kaha: "Aap Ka'ba ke sirf Yemen ki taraf wale konon ko chhute hain, chamde ke joote pehente hain, apne baal Hinna se rangte hain, aur Mecca mein hote hue chaand dekh kar Ihram nahi baandhte jab tak 8 Zul-Hijja na aa jaye." Abdullah ne jawab diya: "Ka'ba ke konon ke baare mein — maine Allah ke Rasool ko sirf Yemen ki taraf wale konon ko chhute dekha. Chamde ke jute — maine Nabi ko baal-rahit joote pehente dekha, Aap wudu bhi jute pehen kar karte the, isliye mujhe waise joote pasand hain. Hinna se rangna — maine Nabi ko Hinna se rangte dekha, isliye mujhe woh pasand hai. Ihram ke baare mein — maine Nabi ko Ihram tab tak nahi baandhte dekha jab tak woh Hajj ke liye nikalte."

e: Narrated Um-`Atiya:That the Prophet (ﷺ) at the time of washing his deceased daughter had said to them, "Start from the right side beginning with those parts which are washed in ablution
hi: Um Atiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne apni marhooma beti ko ghusl dete waqt farmaya: "Dahine taraf se shuru karo, wudu wale hisson se."

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to like to start from the right side on wearing shoes, combing his hair and cleaning or washing himself and on doing anything else
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) joote pehente, baal kanghi karte, safai karte ya koi bhi kaam karte waqt dahine taraf se shuru karna pasand karte the.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) when the `Asr prayer was due and the people searched for water to perform ablution but they could not find it. Later on (a pot full of) water for ablution was brought to Allah's Apostle. He put his hand in that pot and ordered the people to perform ablution from it. I saw the water springing out from underneath his fingers till all of them performed the ablution (it was one of the miracles of the Prophet)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Asr ka waqt tha aur logon ne wudu ke liye paani dhoonda magar nahi mila. Baad mein Allah ke Rasool ke liye paani ka bartan laaya gaya. Aap ne apna haath usme daala aur logon ko usse wudu karne ka hukum diya. Maine dekha paani Aap ki ungliyon se ubhar raha tha yahan tak ke sab logon ne wudu kar liya (yeh Nabi ka ek mojza tha).

e: Narrated Ibn Seereen:I said to `Abida, "I have some of the hair of the Prophet (ﷺ) which I got from Anas or from his family." `Abida replied. "No doubt if I had a single hair of that it would have been dearer to me than the whole world and whatever is in it
hi: Ibn Seereen bataate hain ke maine Abida se kaha: "Mere paas Nabi (ﷺ) ke kuch baal hain jo mujhe Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ya unke ghar se mile." Abida ne kaha: "Beshak agar mujhe usse ek baal mil jaaye to woh mujhe poori duniya se zyada pyara ho."

e: Narrated Anas:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got his head shaved, Abu- Talha was the first to take some of his hair
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke jab Allah ke Rasool ke sar mundwaya gaya, Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) sabse pehle unke baal lene wale the.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If a dog drinks from the utensil of anyone of you it is essential to wash it seven times
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Agar kutta kisi ke bartan se paani piye, to use saat baar dhona zaroori hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A man saw a dog eating mud from (the severity of) thirst. So, that man took a shoe (and filled it) with water and kept on pouring the water for the dog till it quenched its thirst. So Allah approved of his deed and made him to enter Paradise
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Ek shaks ne dekha ke ek kutta pyaas ki shiddat se mitti chaat raha hai. Usne apna joota utaar kar usme paani bhara aur kutte ko pilata raha jab tak uski pyaas na bujh gayi. Allah ne uske amal ko qubool kiya aur use Jannat mein daakhil kar diya."

e: And narrated Hamza bin 'Abdullah:My father said. "During the lifetime of Allah's Apostle, the dogs used to urinate, and pass through the mosques (come and go), nevertheless they never used to sprinkle water on it (urine of the dog)
hi: Hamza bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke unke waalid ne kaha: "Nabi (ﷺ) ke zamane mein kutte masjid mein peshab karte aur guzarte the, magar log us jagah paani nahi chhidakte the."

e: Narrated `Adi bin Hatim:I asked the Prophet (about the hunting dogs) and he replied, "If you let loose (with Allah's name) your tamed dog after a game and it hunts it, you may eat it, but if the dog eats of (that game) then do not eat it because the dog has hunted it for itself." I further said, "Sometimes I send my dog for hunting and find another dog with it. He said, "Do not eat the game for you have mentioned Allah's name only on sending your dog and not the other dog
hi: Adi bin Hatim (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke maine Nabi (ﷺ) se (shikari kutton ke baare mein) pucha, Aap ne farmaya: "Agar tum apna sikhaya hua kutta (Allah ka naam lekar) shikar par chhodo aur woh use maar de, to khaa sakte ho, magar agar kutta khud khaa le to na khaao kyunke usne apne liye shikar kiya." Maine kaha: "Kabhi mera kutta shikar par jaata hai aur usse doosra kutta bhi mil jaata hai." Farmaya: "Woh shikar na khaao kyunke tumne sirf apne kutte ko bhejte waqt Allah ka naam liya, doosre ko nahi."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "A person is considered in prayer as long as he is waiting for the prayer in the mosque as long as he does not do Hadath." A non-Arab man asked, "O Abu Huraira! What is Hadath?" I replied, "It is the passing of wind (from the anus) (that is one of the types of Hadath)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Jab tak koi hadath na kare, woh masjid mein namaz ka intezar karte hue namaz ki halat mein hi samjha jaata hai." Ek ghair-Arab shaks ne pucha: "Aye Abu Huraira! Hadath kya hai?" Maine kaha: "Hawa ka nikalna."

e: Narrated `Abbad bin Tamim:My uncle said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "One should not leave his prayer unless he hears sound or smells something
hi: Abbad bin Tamim bataate hain ke unke chacha ne kaha: Nabi ne farmaya: "Koi apni namaz na tode jab tak awaaz na sune ya badbu na aaye."

e: Narrated `Ali:I used to get emotional urethral discharges frequently and felt shy to ask Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about it. So I requested Al-Miqdad bin Al-Aswad to ask (the Prophet (ﷺ) ) about it. Al-Miqdad asked him and he replied, "One has to perform ablution (after it)
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: "Mujhe jinsi rassi ka mazi aksar aata tha, sharm ki wajah se maine Nabi se poochne ke liye Miqdad (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Aswad se kaha. Unhone poocha, Nabi ne farmaya: 'Iske liye wudu karna kaafi hai.'"

e: Narrated Zaid bin Khalid:I asked `Uthman bin `Affan about a person who engaged in intercourse but did no discharge. `Uthman replied, "He should perform ablution like the one for an ordinary prayer but he must wash his penis." `Uthman added, "I heard it from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." I asked `Ali Az-Zubair, Talha and Ubai bin Ka`b about it and they, too, gave the same reply. (This order was canceled later on and taking a bath became necessary for such cases)
hi: Zaid bin Khalid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke maine Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Affan (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha us shaks ke baare mein jo humbistari kare magar inzaal na ho. Uthman ne jawab diya: "Woh maamooli namaz jaisa wudu kare, magar apna aala zaroor dhoye." Unhone kaha: "Maine yeh Allah ke Rasool se suna hai." Maine Ali (Alayhis Salam), Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ), Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Ubai bin Ka'b (رضی اللہ عنہ) se bhi pucha, unhone bhi yehi jawab diya. (Baad mein yeh hukum badal gaya aur ghusl zaroori ho gaya.)

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent for a Ansari man who came with water dropping from his head. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Perhaps we have forced you to hurry up, haven't we?" The Ansari replied, "Yes." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) further said, "If you are forced to hurry up (during intercourse) or you do not discharge then ablution is due on you (This order was canceled later on, i.e. one has to take a bath)
hi: Abu Saeed Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne ek Ansari shaks ko bulwaya jo sar se paani tapkate hue aaya. Nabi ne farmaya: "Shayad humne tumhe jaldi karne majboor kar diya?" Ansari ne kaha: "Haan." Farmaya: "Agar (humbistari mein) jaldi ho jaye ya inzaal na ho, to bhi wudu zaroori hai (baad mein yeh hukum badal gaya, ghusl zaroori ho gaya)."

e: Narrated Usama bin Zaid:"When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) departed from `Arafat, he turned towards a mountain pass where he answered the call of nature. (After he had finished) I poured water and he performed ablution and then I said to him, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Will you offer the prayer?" He replied, "The Musalla (place of the prayer) is ahead of you (in Al-Muzdalifa)
hi: Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Jab Allah ke Rasool Arafat se rawana hue, ghaate ki taraf mud kar qaza-e-hajat ki. (Baad mein) maine paani daala aur Aap ne wudu kiya, phir maine pucha: 'Ya Rasoolallah, namaz padhenge?' Farmaya: 'Namaz ki jagah aage hai (Muzdalifa mein).'"

e: Narrated Al-Mughira bin Shu`ba:I was in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on one of the journeys and he went out to answer the call of nature (and after he finished) I poured water and he performed ablution; he washed his face, forearms and passed his wet hand over his head and over the two Khuff (socks made from thick fabric or leather)
hi: Al-Mughira bin Shu'ba (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke main ek safar mein Allah ke Rasool ke saath tha, Aap qaza-e-hajat ke liye gaye (baad mein) maine paani daala aur Aap ne wudu kiya, chehra aur baazu dhoye, aur sar aur donon Khuffon (mote kapde/chamde ke jute) par haath phera.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abbas:That he stayed overnight in the house of Maimuna the wife of the Prophet, his aunt. He added: I lay on the bed (cushion transversally) while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and his wife lay in the lengthwise direction of the cushion. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) slept till the middle of the night, either a bit before or a bit after it and then woke up, rubbing the traces of sleep off his face with his hands. He then, recited the last ten verses of Sura Al-`Imran, got up and went to a hanging water-skin. He then Performed the ablution from it and it was a perfect ablution, and then stood up to offer the prayer. I, too, got up and did as the Prophet had done. Then I went and stood by his side. He placed his right hand on my head and caught my right ear and twisted it. He prayed two rak`at, then two rak`at and then two rak`at and then two rak`at and then two rak`at and then two rak`at (separately six times), and finally one rak`a (the witr). Then he lay down again in the bed till the Mu'adh-dhin came to him where upon the Prophet (ﷺ) got up, offered a two light rak`at prayer and went out and led the Fajr prayer
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain ke woh apni khala Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki biwi) ke ghar raat guzarte. Unhone bataya: "Main takiye ki chaudi taraf leta, jabke Allah ke Rasool aur unki biwi lambi taraf leti thi. Nabi aadhi raat tak so gaye, thoda pehle ya baad, phir uthe, apne haathon se sone ka asar chehre se saaf kiya, phir Surah Al-Imran ki aakhri das ayaat tilawat ki, uthe aur latakti mashkiza tak gaye, mukammal wudu kiya, namaz ke liye khade hue. Main bhi utha aur waisa hi kiya, phir jaakar unke paas khada hua. Aap ne apna dahina haath mere sar par rakha aur mera dahina kaan pakad kar mod diya. Aap ne do-do rakat karke chhe baar namaz padhi, phir ek rakat (witr). Phir dobara so gaye yahan tak ke Muazzin aaye, Aap uthe, do halki rakat padhi aur bahar jaakar Fajr ki namaz ki imamat ki."

e: Narrated Asma' bint Abu Bakr:I came to `Aisha the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ) during the solar eclipse. The people were standing and offering the prayer and she was also praying. I asked her, "What is wrong with the people?" She beckoned with her hand towards the sky and said, "Subhan Allah." I asked her, "Is there a sign?" She pointed out, "Yes." So I, too, stood for the prayer till I fell unconscious and later on I poured water on my head. After the prayer, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) praised and glorified Allah and said, "Just now I have seen something which I never saw before at this place of mine, including Paradise and Hell. I have been inspired (and have understood) that you will be put to trials in your graves and these trials will be like the trials of Ad-Dajjal, or nearly like it (the sub narrator is not sure of what Asma' said). Angels will come to every one of you and ask, 'What do you know about this man?' A believer will reply, 'He is Muhammad, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) , and he came to us with self-evident truth and guidance. So we accepted his teaching, believed and followed him.' Then the angels will say to him to sleep in peace as they have come to know that he was a believer. On the other hand a hypocrite or a doubtful person will reply, 'I do not know but heard the people saying something and so I said the same
hi: Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Abu Bakr (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain ke main Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas surya-grahan ke waqt aayi. Log khade namaz padh rahe the aur woh bhi. Maine pucha: "Logon ko kya hua?" Unhone haath se aasman ki taraf ishara kiya aur kaha: "Subhan Allah." Maine pucha: "Kya koi nishani hai?" Unhone ishara kiya: "Haan." Main bhi khadi ho gayi yahan tak ke behosh hone ke qareeb ho gayi, phir apne sar par paani dala. Namaz ke baad Allah ke Rasool ne Allah ki hamd-o-sana ki aur farmaya: "Abhi is jagah maine woh dekha jo pehle kabhi nahi dekha, Jannat aur Dozakh bhi. Mujhe wahi hui hai ke tumhe apni qabron mein aazmaaya jayega, jaisa Dajjal ke fitne jaisa. Farishte har ek se poochenge: 'Tum is shaks ke baare mein kya jaante ho?' Momin jawab dega: 'Yeh Muhammad Rasoolallah hain, jo hamare paas roshan haqq aur hidayat le kar aaye, humne unki taleemat qubool ki, iman laaye aur unki pairvi ki.' Tab farishte use sukoon se sone ko kahenge kyunke woh jaan gaye ke woh momin tha. Doosri taraf munafiq ya shakki jawab dega: 'Mujhe nahi pata, maine logon ko kuch kehte suna to wahi keh diya.'"

e: Narrated Yahya Al-Mazini:A person asked `Abdullah bin Zaid who was the grandfather of `Amr bin Yahya, "Can you show me how Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to perform ablution?" `Abdullah bin Zaid replied in the affirmative and asked for water. He poured it on his hands and washed them twice, then he rinsed his mouth thrice and washed his nose with water thrice by putting water in it and blowing it out. He washed his face thrice and after that he washed his forearms up to the elbows twice and then passed his wet hands over his head from its front to its back and vice versa (beginning from the front and taking them to the back of his head up to the nape of the neck and then brought them to the front again from where he had started) and washed his feet (up to the ankles)
hi: Yahya Al-Mazini bataate hain ke ek shaks ne Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) (Amr bin Yahya ke dada) se pucha: "Kya aap dikha sakte hain Allah ke Rasool kaise wudu karte the?" Unhone haan kaha aur paani mangwaya. Haathon par daal kar do baar dhoya, phir teen baar kulli ki aur naak saaf ki, teen baar chehra dhoya, phir do baar kohniyon tak baazu dhoye, phir sar par haath phera aage se peechhe aur peechhe se aage, aur (takhno tak) paon dhoye.

e: Narrated `Amr:My father saw `Amr bin Abi Hasan asking `Abdullah bin Zaid about the ablution of the Prophet. `Abdullah bin Zaid asked for earthenware pot containing water and in front of them performed ablution like that of the Prophet (ﷺ) . He poured water from the pot over his hand and washed his hands thrice and then he put his hands in the pot and rinsed his mouth and washed his nose by putting water in it and then blowing it out with three handfuls of water. Again he put his hand in the water and washed his face thrice and washed his forearms up to the elbows twice; and then put his hands in the water and then passed them over his head by bringing them to the front and then to the rear of the head once, and then he washed his feet up to the ankles
hi: Amr bataate hain ke unke waalid ne dekha ke Amr bin Abi Hasan ne Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) se Nabi ke wudu ke baare mein pucha. Abdullah ne mitti ke bartan mein paani mangwaya aur unke saamne wudu kiya jaisa Nabi karte the: haathon par paani daal kar teen baar dhoya, kulli ki, naak saaf ki teen hathelian paani se, phir chehra teen baar, kohniyon tak baazu do baar, sar par ek baar aage-peechhe haath phera, aur paon (takhno tak) dhoye.

e: Narrated Abu Juhaifa:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to us at noon and water for ablution was brought to him. After he had performed ablution, the remaining water was taken by the people and they started smearing their bodies with it (as a blessed thing). The Prophet (ﷺ) offered two rak`at of the Zuhr prayer and then two rak`at of the `Asr prayer while a short spear (or stick) was there (as a Sutra) in front of him
hi: Abu Juhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Allah ke Rasool dopahar ko humare paas aaye, wudu ke liye paani laaya gaya. Wudu ke baad baqi paani logon ne le liya aur apne badan par mal liya (barkat ke liye). Nabi ne Zuhr ki do rakat aur Asr ki do rakat padhi jabke unke saamne ek chhoti chhadi (Sutra) rakhi hui thi.

e: Abu Musa said:The Prophet asked for a tumbler containing water and washed both his hands and face in it and then threw a mouthful of water in the tumbler and said to both of us (Abu Musa and Bilal), "Drink from the tumbler and pour some of its water on your faces and chests
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Nabi ne paani ka bartan mangwaya, apne haath-mun dhoye, phir ek mun-bhar paani bartan mein daal kar Abu Musa aur Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) se farmaya: "Ismein se piyo aur apne chehre aur seene par bhi dalo."

e: Narrated Ibn Shihab:Mahmud bin Ar-Rabi` who was the person on whose face the Prophet (ﷺ) had ejected a mouthful of water from his family's well while he was a boy, and `Urwa (on the authority of Al-Miswar and others) who testified each other, said, "Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) , performed ablution, his companions were nearly fighting for the remains of the water
hi: Ibn Shihab bataate hain ke Mahmud bin Ar-Rabi (رضی اللہ عنہ), jinke chehre par Nabi ne bachpan mein unke ghar ke kuye se mun-bhar paani chhidka tha, aur Urwa bataate hain: "Jab bhi Nabi wudu karte, sahaba baqi paani ke liye taqreeban ladte the."

e: Narrated As-Sa'ib bin Yazid:My aunt took me to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! This son of my sister has got a disease in his legs." So he passed his hands on my head and prayed for Allah's blessings for me; then he performed ablution and I drank from the remaining water. I stood behind him and saw the seal of Prophethood between his shoulders, and it was like the "Zir-al-Hijla" (means the button of a small tent, but some said 'egg of a partridge.' etc)
hi: As-Sa'ib bin Yazid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke unki khala unhe Nabi ke paas le gayi aur kaha: "Ya Rasoolallah, meri bhen ke bete ke paon mein bimari hai." Nabi ne mere sar par haath phera aur meri barkat ki dua ki, phir wudu kiya aur main baqi paani piya. Main unke peechhe khada hua aur unke shoulders ke beech Nabuwwat ki mohar dekhi, jo ek chhote khaimay ke button jaisi (ya titar ke ande jaisi) thi.

e: Narrated `Amr bin Yahya:(on the authority of his father) `Abdullah bin Zaid poured water on his hands from a utensil containing water and washed them and then with one handful of water he rinsed his mouth and cleaned his nose by putting water in it and then blowing it out. He repeated it thrice. He, then, washed his hands and forearms up to the elbows twice and passed wet hands over his head, both forwards and backwards, and washed his feet up to the ankles and said, "This is the ablution of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
hi: Amr bin Yahya bataate hain, apne waalid ke hawale se: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne bartan se haathon par paani daal kar dhoye, ek hatheli se kulli ki aur naak saaf ki, teen baar dohraya. Phir haath aur baazu do baar kohniyon tak dhoye, sar par aage-peechhe haath phera, aur paon (takhno tak) dhoye, aur kaha: "Yeh Allah ke Rasool ka wudu hai."

e: Narrated `Amr bin Yahya:My father said, "I saw `Amr bin Abi Hasan asking `Abdullah bin Zaid about the ablution of the Prophet. `Abdullah bin Zaid asked for an earthenware pot containing water and performed ablution in front of them. He poured water over his hands and washed them thrice. Then he put his (right) hand in the pot and rinsed his mouth and washed his nose by putting water in it and then blowing it out thrice with three handfuls of water Again he put his hand in the water and washed his face thrice. After that he put his hand in the pot and washed his forearms up to the elbows twice and then again put his hand in the water and passed wet hands over his head by bringing them to the front and then to the back and once more he put his hand in the pot and washed his feet (up to the ankles.)" Narrated Wuhaib: That he (the Prophet (ﷺ) in narration 191 above) had passed his wet hands on the head once only
hi: Amr bin Yahya bataate hain, unke waalid ne dekha ke Amr bin Abi Hasan ne Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) se Nabi ke wudu ke baare mein pucha. Unhone mitti ke bartan mein paani mangwaya aur wudu kiya: haathon par paani daal kar teen baar dhoya, kulli ki, naak saaf ki teen baar, chehra teen baar dhoya, kohniyon tak baazu do baar dhoye, sar par aage-peechhe haath phera ek baar, paon (takhno tak) dhoye. Wuhaib ne kaha ke (upar wali riwayat mein) Nabi ne sar par sirf ek baar haath phera tha.

e: Narrated 'Abdullah bin 'Umar:"During the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) men and women used to perform ablution together
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai: "Nabi ke zamane mein mard aur aurtein saath wudu karte the."

e: Narrated Jabir:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to visit me while I was sick and unconscious. He performed ablution and sprinkled the remaining water on me and I became conscious and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! To whom will my inheritance go as I have neither ascendants nor descendants?" Then the Divine verses regarding Fara'id (inheritance) were revealed
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Allah ke Rasool mujhse milne aaye jab main bimar aur behosh tha. Aap ne wudu kiya aur baqi paani mujh par chhidak diya, main hosh mein aaya aur kaha: "Ya Rasoolallah, mera warasat kise milegi kyunke mere na aage na peechhe koi hai?" Tab Miras (waris) ki ayaat nazil hui.

e: Narrated Anas:It was the time for prayer, and those whose houses were near got up and went to their people (to perform ablution), and there remained some people (sitting). Then a painted stove pot (Mikhdab) containing water was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). The pot was small, not broad enough for one to spread one's hand in; yet all the people performed ablution. (The sub narrator said, "We asked Anas, 'How many persons were you?' Anas replied 'We were eighty or more"). (It was one of the miracles of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke namaz ka waqt hua, jinke ghar qareeb the woh apne ghar wudu ke liye gaye, kuch log baithe rahe. Phir Allah ke Rasool ke paas ek rangeen bartan (Mikhdab) mein paani laaya gaya, jo chhota tha, haath phailane jitna bhi bada nahi tha, magar phir bhi sab logon ne usse wudu kiya. (Rawi ne pucha: "Tum kitne log the?" Anas ne kaha: "Assi ya usse zyada" — yeh Allah ke Rasool ka ek mojza tha.)

e: Narrated Abu Musa:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) asked for a tumbler containing water. He washed his hands and face in it and also threw a mouthful of water in it
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke ek baar Nabi ne paani ka bartan mangwaya, usme haath-chehra dhoya aur mun-bhar paani usme daala.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Zaid:Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to us and we brought out water for him in a brass pot. He performed ablution thus: He washed his face thrice, and his forearms to the elbows twice, then passed his wet hands lightly over the head from front to rear and brought them to front again and washed his feet (up to the ankles)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Allah ke Rasool humare paas aaye, hum unke liye pital ke bartan mein paani laaye. Aap ne isi tarah wudu kiya: teen baar chehra dhoya, do baar kohniyon tak baazu, phir halke se sar par aage se peechhe haath phera aur wapas laaya, aur (takhno tak) paon dhoye.

e: Narrated `Aisha:When the ailment of the Prophet (ﷺ) became aggravated and his disease became severe, he asked his wives to permit him to be nursed (treated) in my house. So they gave him the permission. Then the Prophet came (to my house) with the support of two men, and his legs were dragging on the ground, between `Abbas, and another man." 'Ubaidullah (the sub narrator) said, "I informed `Abdullah bin `Abbas of what `Aisha said. Ibn `Abbas said: 'Do you know who was the other man?' I replied in the negative. Ibn `Abbas said, 'He was `Ali (bin Abi Talib)." `Aisha further said, "When the Prophet (ﷺ) came to my house and his sickness became aggravated he ordered us to pour seven skins full of water on him, so that he might give some advice to the people. So he was seated in a Mikhdab (brass tub) belonging to Hafsa, the wife of the Prophet. Then, all of us started pouring water on him from the water skins till he beckoned to us to stop and that we have done (what he wanted us to do). After that he went out to the people
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain ke jab Nabi ki bimari shadeed ho gayi, Aap ne apni biwiyon se mere ghar mein ilaaj ki ijazat maangi, unhone de di. Phir Nabi do aadmiyon (Abbas aur ek doosre shaks) ke sahaare mere ghar aaye, aapke paon zameen par ghisat rahe the. (Ubaidullah ne Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko yeh bataya, Ibn Abbas ne pucha ke doosra shaks kaun tha, maine nahi bataya, unhone kaha woh Ali (Alayhis Salam) the.) Ayesha ne bataya: "Jab Nabi mere ghar aaye aur bimari badh gayi, Aap ne hukum diya ke saat mashkiza paani unpar dala jaye taake woh logon ko naseehat kar sakein. Unhe Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke Mikhdab (pital ke tub) mein baitha diya gaya, humne unpar paani daalna shuru kiya yahan tak ke unhone ishara kiya bas ho gaya. Phir woh logon ke paas bahar gaye."

e: Narrated `Amr bin Yahya:(on the authority of his father) My uncle used to perform ablution extravagantly and once he asked `Abdullah bin Zaid to tell him how he had seen the Prophet (ﷺ) performing ablution. He asked for an earthenware pot containing water, and poured water from it on his hands and washed them thrice, and then put his hand in the earthenware pot and rinsed his mouth and washed his nose by putting water in it and then blowing it out thrice with one handful of water; he again put his hand in the water and took a handful of water and washed his face thrice, then washed his hands up to the elbows twice, and took water with his hand, and passed it over his head from front to back and then from back to front, and then washed his feet (up to the ankles) and said, "I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) performing ablution in that way
hi: Amr bin Yahya bataate hain, apne waalid ke hawale se: unke chacha zyada paani se wudu karte the, ek baar unhone Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha kaise Nabi ne wudu kiya tha. Unhone mitti ke bartan mein paani mangwaya, haathon par daal kar teen baar dhoya, kulli ki, naak saaf ki teen baar ek hatheli se, chehra teen baar dhoya, haath kohniyon tak do baar dhoye, sar par aage-peechhe haath phera, paon (takhno tak) dhoye, aur kaha: "Maine Nabi ko isi tarah wudu karte dekha."

e: Narrated Thabit:Anas said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) asked for water and a tumbler with a broad base and not so deep, containing a small quantity of water, was brought to him whereby he put his fingers in it." Anas further said, 'I noticed the water springing out from amongst his fingers.' Anas added, 'I estimated that the people who performed ablution with it numbered between seventy to eighty
hi: Thabit bataate hain ke Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Nabi ne paani mangwaya, ek chaudi lekin gehri na hone wali tumbler laayi gayi jisme thoda paani tha, Aap ne ungliyan usme daali." Anas ne kaha: "Maine paani ko unki ungliyon se ubharte dekha." Anas ne andaza lagaya ke us paani se sattar-assi log wudu kar chuke the.

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to take a bath with one Sa` up to five Mudds (1 Sa` = [??] Mudds) of water and used to perform ablution with one Mudd of water
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ek Sa (chaar Mudd) se paanch Mudd tak paani se ghusl karte aur ek Mudd se wudu karte.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) passed wet hands over his Khuffs (socks made from thick fabric or leather)." `Abdullah bin `Umar asked `Umar about it. `Umar replied in the affirmative and added, "Whenever Sa`d narrates a Hadith from the Prophet, there is no need to ask anyone else about it
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain ke Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Nabi ne apne Khuffon par wudu mein haath phera." Abdullah ne Umar se iske baare mein pucha, unhone haan kaha aur farmaya: "Jab Sa'd Nabi se koi hadith bayan karein to kisi aur se poochne ki zaroorat nahi."

e: Narrated Al-Mughira bin Shu`ba:Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went out to answer the call of nature and I followed him with a tumbler containing water, and when he finished, I poured water and he performed ablution and passed wet hands over his Khuffs (socks made from thick fabric or leather)
hi: Al-Mughira bin Shu'ba (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Allah ke Rasool qaza-e-hajat ke liye gaye, main paani ka bartan lekar unke peechhe gaya. Jab woh faarigh hue, maine paani daala aur unhone wudu karke apne Khuffon par haath phera.

e: Narrated Ja`far bin `Amr bin Umaiya Ad-Damri:My father said, "I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) passing wet hands over his Khuffs (socks made from thick fabric or leather)
hi: Ja'far bin Amr bin Umaiya Ad-Damri bataate hain, apne waalid ke hawale se: "Maine Nabi ko Khuffon par haath phirte dekha."

e: Narrated Ja`far bin `Amr:My father said, "I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) passing wet hands over his turban and Khuffs (socks made from thick fabric or leather)
hi: Ja'far bin Amr bataate hain, apne waalid ke hawale se: "Maine Nabi ko pagdi aur Khuffon par haath phirte dekha."

e: Narrated `Urwa bin Al-Mughira:My father said, "Once I was in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) on a journey and I dashed to take off his Khuffs (socks made from thick fabric or leather). He ordered me to leave them as he had put them after performing ablution. So he passed wet hands over them
hi: Urwa bin Al-Mughira bataate hain, apne waalid ke hawale se: "Main ek safar mein Nabi ke saath tha, main foran unke Khuff utaarne laga. Aap ne mujhe rukne ka hukum diya kyunke unhone wudu ke baad hi Khuff pehne the. Aap ne un par haath phera."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ate a piece of cooked mutton from the shoulder region and prayed without repeating ablution
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne bhed ke shoulder ka pakka gosht khaaya aur bina wudu dohraaye namaz padhi.

e: Narrated Ja`far bin `Amr bin Umaiya:My father said, "I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) taking a piece of (cooked) mutton from the shoulder region and then he was called for prayer. He put his knife down and prayed without repeating ablution
hi: Ja'far bin Amr bin Umaiya bataate hain, apne waalid ke hawale se: "Maine Allah ke Rasool ko bhed ke shoulder se gosht khate dekha, phir unhe namaz ke liye bulaya gaya. Aap ne chhuri rakhi aur bina wudu dohraye namaz padhi."

e: Narrated Suwaid bin Al-Nu`man:In the year of the conquest of Khaibar I went with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) till we reached Sahba, a place near Khaibar, where Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) offered the `Asr prayer and asked for food. Nothing but saweeq was brought. He ordered it to be moistened with water. He and all of us ate it and the Prophet (ﷺ) got up for the evening prayer (Maghrib prayer), rinsed his mouth with water and we did the same, and he then prayed without repeating the ablution
hi: Suwaid bin Al-Nu'man (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Khaibar ki fatah ke saal main Allah ke Rasool ke saath Sahba tak gaya, jahan Aap ne Asr padhi aur khana mangwaya. Sirf saweeq (bhuna aata) laaya gaya jise paani mein bhigaya gaya. Aap aur hum sabne khaaya, phir Aap Maghrib ke liye uthe, paani se kulli ki aur hum sabne bhi, phir Aap ne bina wudu dohraye namaz padhi.

e: Narrated Maimuna:The Prophet (ﷺ) ate (a piece of) mutton from the shoulder region and then prayed without repeating the ablution
hi: Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne bhed ke shoulder ka gosht khaya, phir bina wudu dohraye namaz padhi.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) drank milk, rinsed his mouth and said, "It has fat
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne doodh piya, kulli ki aur farmaya: "Ismein charbi hai."

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If anyone of you feels drowsy while praying he should go to bed (sleep) till his slumber is over because in praying while drowsy one does not know whether one is asking for forgiveness or for a bad thing for oneself
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jab kisi ko namaz mein oongh aane lage, use so jaana chahiye yahan tak ke oongh khatam ho, kyunke oongh mein woh nahi jaanta ke maafi maang raha hai ya khud ke liye bura maang raha hai."

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If anyone of you feels drowsy while praying, he should sleep till he understands what he is saying (reciting)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Jab kisi ko namaz mein oongh aaye, so jaaye yahan tak ke samajh aa jaaye woh kya keh raha hai."

e: Narrated `Amr bin `Amir:Anas said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) used to perform ablution for every prayer." I asked Anas, "What did you used to do?' Anas replied, "We used to pray with the same ablution until we break it with Hadath
hi: Amr bin Amir bataate hain ke Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Nabi har namaz ke liye naya wudu karte the." Maine pucha: "Aap kya karte the?" Anas ne kaha: "Hum ek hi wudu se kai namazein padhte the jab tak koi hadath na ho jaaye."

e: Narrated Suwaid bin Nu`man:In the year of the conquest of Khaibar I went with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) till we reached As-Sahba' where Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) led the `Asr prayer and asked for the food. Nothing but saweeq was brought and we ate it and drank (water). The Prophet (ﷺ) got up for the (Maghrib) Prayer, rinsed his mouth with water and then led the prayer without repeating the ablution
hi: Suwaid bin Nu'man (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Khaibar ki fatah ke saal Allah ke Rasool ke saath As-Sahba tak gaye, jahan Aap ne Asr ki imamat ki aur khana mangwaya, sirf saweeq laaya gaya jise humne khaaya aur paani piya. Nabi Maghrib ke liye uthe, kulli ki aur bina wudu dohraye namaz ki imamat ki.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Once the Prophet, while passing through one of the graveyards of Medina or Mecca heard the voices of two persons who were being tortured in their graves. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "These two persons are being tortured not for a major sin (to avoid)." The Prophet (ﷺ) then added, "Yes! (they are being tortured for a major sin). Indeed, one of them never saved himself from being soiled with his urine while the other used to go about with calumnies (to make enmity between friends). The Prophet (ﷺ) then asked for a green leaf of a date-palm tree, broke it into two pieces and put one on each grave. On being asked why he had done so, he replied, "I hope that their torture might be lessened, till these get dried
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke Nabi Madina ya Mecca ke ek qabristan se guzre aur do logon ki qabron mein azaab ki awaazein suni. Nabi ne farmaya: "Yeh dono kisi bade gunah ki wajah se azaab mein nahi hain (phir farmaya) haan, ek shaks apne peshab ki safai mein lapervah tha, doosra chugli karta tha." Nabi ne khajoor ki taazi patti mangwai, uske do tukde kiye aur har qabra par ek rakh diya. Pucha gaya kyun kiya, farmaya: "Ummeed hai jab tak yeh sukh na jaaye, unka azaab kam ho jaaye."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) went to answer the call of nature, I used to bring water with which he used to clean his private parts
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke jab Nabi qaza-e-hajat ke liye jaate, main paani laata jisse woh apni sharmgaah saaf karte.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) once passed by two graves and said, "These two persons are being tortured not for a major sin (to avoid). One of them never saved himself from being soiled with his urine, while the other used to go about with calumnies (to make enmity between friends)." The Prophet (ﷺ) then took a green leaf of a date-palm tree, split it into (pieces) and fixed one on each grave. They said, "O Allah's Apostle! Why have you done so?" He replied, "I hope that their punishment might be lessened till these (the pieces of the leaf) become dry." (See the footnote of Hadith)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke Nabi do qabron se guzre aur farmaya: "Yeh dono kisi bade gunah ki wajah se azaab mein nahi hain. Ek apne peshab mein lapervah tha, doosra chugli karta tha." Nabi ne khajoor ki taazi patti li, do tukde karke har qabra par rakh diya. Logon ne pucha: "Ya Rasoolallah, aapne yeh kyun kiya?" Farmaya: "Ummeed hai jab tak yeh sukhe na, unka azaab kam ho jaaye."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) saw a Bedouin making water in the mosque and told the people not to disturb him. When he finished, the Prophet (ﷺ) asked for some water and poured it over (the urine)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne ek dehati ko masjid mein peshab karte dekha aur logon ko use na rokne ko kaha. Jab woh faarigh hua, Nabi ne paani mangwa kar us jagah dala.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:A Bedouin stood up and started making water in the mosque. The people caught him but the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered them to leave him and to pour a bucket or a tumbler of water over the place where he had passed the urine. The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "You have been sent to make things easy and not to make them difficult
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke ek dehati masjid mein peshab karne khada ho gaya. Logon ne use pakad liya magar Nabi ne unhe chhodne ka hukum diya aur ek bucket ya bartan paani us jagah dalne ka hukum diya. Nabi ne farmaya: "Tumhe asaani ke liye bheja gaya hai, mushkil banane ke liye nahi."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said as above
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne isi tarah bayan kiya.

e: Narrated `Aisha:(the mother of faithful believers) A child was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and it urinated on the garment of the Prophet. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked for water and poured it over the soiled place
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ke paas ek bacha laaya gaya jisne Nabi ke kapde par peshab kar diya. Nabi ne paani mangwa kar us jagah dala.

e: Narrated Um Qais bint Mihsin:I brought my young son, who had not started eating (ordinary food) to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who took him and made him sit in his lap. The child urinated on the garment of the Prophet, so he asked for water and poured it over the soiled (area) and did not wash it
hi: Um Qais bint Mihsin (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain ke woh apne chhote bete ko (jo abhi khana nahi khata tha) Allah ke Rasool ke paas laayi, unhone use godi mein baitha liya. Bacche ne Nabi ke kapde par peshab kiya, Aap ne paani mangwa kar us jagah dala, magar dhoya nahi.

e: Narrated Hudhaifa:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) went to the dumps of some people and passed urine while standing. He then asked for water and so I brought it to him and he performed ablution
hi: Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Nabi kuch logon ke kachre ke dher ke paas gaye aur khade hokar peshab kiya. Phir paani mangwaya, main laaya aur Aap ne wudu kiya.

e: Narrated Hudhaifa':The Prophet (ﷺ) and I walked till we reached the dumps of some people. He stood, as any one of you stands, behind a wall and urinated. I went away, but he beckoned me to come. So I approached him and stood near his back till he finished
hi: Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke main aur Nabi chalte-chalte ek kachre ke dher tak pahunche. Aap khade hue, jaise tum khade hote ho, ek deewar ke peechhe aur peshab kiya. Main door chala gaya, magar Aap ne mujhe ishara karke bulaya, main aakar unki pusht ke paas khada raha yahan tak ke woh faarigh hue.

e: Narrated Abu Wail:Abu Musa Al-Ash`ari used to lay great stress on the question of urination and he used to say, "If anyone from Bani Israel happened to soil his clothes with urine, he used to cut that portion away." Hearing that, Hudhaifa said to Abu Wail, "I wish he (Abu Musa) didn't (lay great stress on that matter)." Hudhaifa added, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went to the dumps of some people and urinated while standing
hi: Abu Wail bataate hain ke Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ash'ari peshab ke maamle mein bahut ehtiyaat karte the aur kehte the: "Bani Israel mein jiske kapde peshab se ganda ho jaate, woh usse kaat kar phenk dete." Yeh sunkar Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Kaash woh (Abu Musa) itni sakhti na karte." Hudhaifa ne bataya: "Allah ke Rasool kachre ke dher ke paas gaye aur khade hokar peshab kiya."

e: Narrated Asma':A woman came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "If anyone of us gets menses in her clothes then what should she do?" He replied, "She should (take hold of the soiled place), rub it and put it in the water and rub it in order to remove the traces of blood and then pour water over it. Then she can pray in it
hi: Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain ke ek aurat Nabi ke paas aayi aur pucha: "Agar humare kapde mein haiz ka khoon lag jaye to kya karein?" Aap ne farmaya: "Us jagah ko ragad kar paani mein daalo aur ragdo taake khoon ke nishaan mit jayen, phir paani daalo. Phir usme namaz padh sakti hai."

e: Narrated `Aisha:Fatima bint Abi Hubaish came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) I get persistent bleeding from the uterus and do not become clean. Shall I give up my prayers?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, "No, because it is from a blood vessel and not the menses. So when your real menses begins give up your prayers and when it has finished wash off the blood (take a bath) and offer your prayers." Hisham (the sub narrator) narrated that his father had also said, (the Prophet (ﷺ) told her): "Perform ablution for every prayer till the time of the next period comes
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke Fatima (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Abi Hubaish Nabi ke paas aayi aur kaha: "Ya Rasoolallah, mujhe musalsal khoon aata hai aur main paak nahi hoti. Kya main namaz chhod dun?" Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Nahi, yeh ek rag se hai, haiz nahi. Jab tumhara asli haiz shuru ho to namaz chhod do, aur jab khatam ho jaye to ghusl karke namaz padho." (Hisham ne bataya ke Nabi ne yeh bhi farmaya: "Har namaz ke liye wudu karo jab tak agla haiz na aa jaye.")

e: Narrated `Aisha:I used to wash the traces of Janaba (semen) from the clothes of the Prophet (ﷺ) and he used to go for prayers while traces of water were still on it (water spots were still visible)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain ke main Nabi ke kapdon se janaba (mani) ke nishaan dhoti thi aur woh paani ke dhabbon ke saath hi namaz ke liye chale jaate.

e: Narrated Sulaiman bin Yasar:I asked `Aisha about the clothes soiled with semen. She replied, "I used to wash it off the clothes of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he would go for the prayer while water spots were still visible
hi: Sulaiman bin Yasar bataate hain ke maine Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se mani se ganda kapde ke baare mein pucha. Unhone kaha: "Main Allah ke Rasool ke kapdon se ise dhoti thi aur woh paani ke nishaan ke saath hi namaz ke liye jaate."

e: Narrated `Amr bin Maimun:I heard Sulaiman bin Yasar talking about the clothes soiled with semen. He said that `Aisha had said, "I used to wash it off the clothes of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he would go for the prayers while water spots were still visible on them
hi: Amr bin Maimun bataate hain ke maine Sulaiman bin Yasar ko yeh baat karte suna. Unhone kaha ke Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne bataya: "Main Nabi ke kapdon se mani dhoti thi aur woh namaz ke liye jaate jabke paani ke nishaan abhi bhi dikhte."

e: Narrated `Aishah:I used to wash the semen off the clothes of the Prophet (ﷺ) and even then I used to notice one or more spots on them
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai: "Main Nabi ke kapdon se mani dhoti thi, phir bhi mujhe ek ya usse zyada nishaan dikhte."

e: Narrated Abu Qilaba:Anas said, "Some people of `Ukl or `Uraina tribe came to Medina and its climate did not suit them. So the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered them to go to the herd of (Milch) camels and to drink their milk and urine (as a medicine). So they went as directed and after they became healthy, they killed the shepherd of the Prophet and drove away all the camels. The news reached the Prophet (ﷺ) early in the morning and he sent (men) in their pursuit and they were captured and brought at noon. He then ordered to cut their hands and feet (and it was done), and their eyes were branded with heated pieces of iron, They were put in 'Al-Harra' and when they asked for water, no water was given to them." Abu Qilaba said, "Those people committed theft and murder, became infidels after embracing Islam and fought against Allah and His Apostle
hi: Abu Qilaba bataate hain ke Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Ukl ya Uraina qabile ke kuch log Madina aaye, wahan ki aab-o-hawa unke liye theek nahi thi. Nabi ne unhe Milch oonton ki taraf jaakar unka doodh aur peshab (dawa ke tor par) peene ka hukum diya. Woh gaye aur theek hone ke baad Nabi ke charwahe ko qatl karke sab oont leke bhaag gaye. Nabi ko subah pata chala, unhone unka peecha karne wale bheje, unhe dopahar tak pakad kar laaya gaya. Nabi ne unke haath-paon kaatne ka hukum diya, aankhon mein garam lohe se daagh lagaya gaya, unhe Al-Harra mein daala gaya, aur jab unhone paani maanga, nahi diya gaya." Abu Qilaba ne kaha: "Un logon ne chori, qatl, Islam qubool karne ke baad kufr, aur Allah-Rasool ke khilaf jung ki thi."

e: Narrated Anas:Prior to the construction of the mosque, the Prophet (ﷺ) offered the prayers at sheep-folds
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke masjid banne se pehle Nabi bhed-bakriyon ke ahaaton mein namaz padhte the.

e: Narrated Maimuna:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked regarding ghee (cooking butter) in which a mouse had fallen. He said, "Take out the mouse and throw away the ghee around it and use the rest
hi: Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool se ghee (jisme chuha gir gaya ho) ke baare mein pucha gaya. Farmaya: "Chuha nikaal do aur uske aas-paas ka ghee phenk do, baqi istemaal karo."

e: Narrated Maimuna:The Prophet (ﷺ) was asked regarding ghee in which a mouse had fallen. He said, "Take out the mouse and throw away the ghee around it (and use the rest)
hi: Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) se yeh isi tarah riwayat hai.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A wound which a Muslim receives in Allah's cause will appear on the Day of Resurrection as it was at the time of infliction; blood will be flowing from the wound and its color will be that of the blood but will smell like musk
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Woh zakhm jo Musalman ko Allah ki raah mein lage, Qiyamat ke din waisa hi hoga jaisa lagne ke waqt tha — khoon bahta hoga, rang khoon ka hoga, magar khushbu kasturi jaisi hogi."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "We (Muslims) are the last (people to come in the world) but (will be) the foremost (on the Day of Resurrection)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Hum (Musalman) sabse baad mein aaye magar Qiyamat ke din sabse aage honge."

e: The same narrator said that the Prophet (ﷺ) had said: "You should not pass urine in stagnant water which is not flowing then (you may need to) wash in it
hi: Wahi rawi bataate hain ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Thehre hue (na behte) paani mein peshab na karo, kyunke phir tumhe usse ghusl karna pad sakta hai."

e: Narrated `Abdullah:While Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was prostrating (as stated below). Narrated `Abdullah bin Mas`ud: Once the Prophet (ﷺ) was offering prayers at the Ka`ba. Abu Jahl was sitting with some of his companions. One of them said to the others, "Who amongst you will bring the Abdominal contents (intestines, etc.) of a camel of Bani so and so and put it on the back of Muhammad, when he prostrates?" The most unfortunate of them got up and brought it. He waited till the Prophet (ﷺ) prostrated and then placed it on his back between his shoulders. I was watching but could not do any thing. I wish I had some people with me to hold out against them. They started laughing and falling on one another. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was in prostration and he did not lift his head up till Fatima (Prophet's daughter) came and threw that (camel's Abdominal contents) away from his back. He raised his head and said thrice, "O Allah! Punish Quraish." So it was hard for Abu Jahl and his companions when the Prophet invoked Allah against them as they had a conviction that the prayers and invocations were accepted in this city (Mecca). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! Punish Abu Jahl, `Utba bin Rabi`a, Shaiba bin Rabi`a, Al-Walid bin `Utba, Umaiya bin Khalaf, and `Uqba bin Al Mu'it [??] (and he mentioned the seventh whose name I cannot recall). By Allah in Whose Hands my life is, I saw the dead bodies of those persons who were counted by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the Qalib (one of the wells) of Badr
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke ek baar Nabi Ka'ba mein namaz padh rahe the, Abu Jahl apne sathiyon ke saath baitha tha. Ek ne kaha: "Kaun falaan qabile ke oont ki oonton laakar Muhammad ki pusht par rakh de jab woh sajda kare?" Sabse badnaseeb shaks utha aur laaya. Usne Nabi ke sajda karne ka intezar kiya, phir unki pusht par shoulders ke beech rakh diya. Main dekh raha tha magar kuch nahi kar saka, kaash mere paas madad hoti. Woh has-hasa kar ek-doosre par girne lage. Nabi sajda mein rahe, sar nahi utaya yahan tak ke Fatima (Alayhas Salam) aayi aur woh cheez unki pusht se hataya. Aap ne sar utha kar teen baar farmaya: "Aye Allah! Quraish ko saza de." Yeh Abu Jahl aur uske sathiyon ko bahut bhaari laga kyunke unhe yaqeen tha ke is shehar mein dua qubool hoti hai. Nabi ne farmaya: "Aye Allah! Abu Jahl, Utba bin Rabi'a, Shaiba bin Rabi'a, Al-Walid bin Utba, Umaiya bin Khalaf, aur Uqba bin Al-Mu'it ko saza de (aur saatven ka naam yaad nahi)." Us zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, maine unke murda jism Badr ke kuye mein dekhe jaise Nabi ne unka naam liya tha.

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) once spat in his clothes
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne ek baar apne kapde mein thooka.

e: Narrated Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "All drinks that produce intoxication are Haram (forbidden to drink)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Har woh mashrub jo nasha de, Haram hai."

e: Narrated Abu Hazim:Sahl bin Sa`d As-Sa`idi, was asked by the people, "With what was the wound of the Prophet (ﷺ) treated?" Sahl replied, "None remains among the people living who knows that better than I. `Ali [??] used to bring water in his shield and Fatima used to wash the blood off his face. Then straw mat was burnt and the wound was filled with it
hi: Abu Hazim bataate hain ke Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) As-Sa'idi se pucha gaya: "Nabi ke zakhm ka ilaaj kis se hua?" Sahl ne kaha: "Ab is baare mein mujhse zyada koi nahi jaanta. Ali (Alayhis Salam) apne shield mein paani laate the aur Fatima (Alayhas Salam) Nabi ke chehre se khoon saaf karti thin. Phir ek chatai jalayi gayi aur uski rakh zakhm mein bhar di gayi."

e: Narrated Abu Burda:My father said, "I came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and saw him carrying a Siwak in his hand and cleansing his teeth, saying, 'U' U'," as if he was retching while the Siwak was in his mouth
hi: Abu Burda bataate hain, apne waalid ke hawale se: "Main Nabi ke paas aaya, unke haath mein Siwak tha aur woh apne daant saaf kar rahe the, 'U' 'U' kar rahe the jaise Siwak mun mein hone ki wajah se kuch reaction ho rahi ho."

e: Narrated Hudhaifa:Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) got up at night, he used to clean his mouth with Siwak
hi: Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke jab Nabi raat ko uthte, Siwak se mun saaf karte.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I dreamt that I was cleaning my teeth with a Siwak and two persons came to me. One of them was older than the other and I gave the Siwak to the younger. I was told that I should give it to the older and so I did
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Maine khwab mein dekha ke Siwak se daant saaf kar raha hoon, do log aaye, ek dusre se bada. Maine Siwak chote ko de diya. Mujhe bataya gaya ke bade ko dena chahiye tha, to maine waisa kar diya."

e: Narrated Al-Bara 'bin `Azib:The Prophet (ﷺ) said to me, "Whenever you go to bed perform ablution like that for the prayer, lie on your right side and say, "Allahumma aslamtu wajhi ilaika, wa fauwadtu `Amri ilaika, wa alja'tu Zahri ilaika raghbatan wa rahbatan ilaika. La Malja'a wa la manja minka illa ilaika. Allahumma amantu bikitabika-l-ladhi anzalta wa bina-biyika-l ladhi arsalta" (O Allah! I surrender to You and entrust all my affairs to You and depend upon You for Your Blessings both with hope and fear of You. There is no fleeing from You, and there is no place of protection and safety except with You O Allah! I believe in Your Book (the Qur'an) which You have revealed and in Your Prophet (Muhammad) whom You have sent). Then if you die on that very night, you will die with faith (i.e. on the religion of Islam). Let the aforesaid words be your last utterance (before sleep)." I repeated it before the Prophet (ﷺ) and when I reached "Allahumma amantu bikitabika-l-ladhi anzalta (O Allah I believe in Your Book which You have revealed)." I said, "Wa-rasulika (and your Apostle)." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No, (but say): 'Wanabiyika-l-ladhi arsalta (Your Prophet whom You have sent), instead
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne mujhse farmaya: "Jab bhi bistar par jao, namaz jaisa wudu karo, dahini taraf leto aur kaho: 'Allahumma aslamtu wajhi ilaika, wa fauwadtu amri ilaika, wa alja'tu zahri ilaika raghbatan wa rahbatan ilaika. La malja'a wa la manja minka illa ilaika. Allahumma amantu bikitabika-l-ladhi anzalta wa binabiyika-l-ladhi arsalta' (Aye Allah! Main apna chehra (khud ko) tere supurd karta hoon, apna maamla tujhe sonp deta hoon, teri hi taraf ummeed aur khauf ke saath panah leta hoon. Tujhse bhagne ki koi jagah nahi siwaye teri hi taraf. Aye Allah! Main teri Kitaab par iman laata hoon jo tune nazil ki, aur tere Nabi par jise tune bheja hai).' Agar tum us raat mar jao, to iman ki halat mein maroge. Ye alfaaz sone se pehle aakhri hon." Maine yeh Nabi ke saamne dohraya, aur jab main 'Allahumma amantu bikitabika-l-ladhi anzalta' tak pahuncha, maine kaha 'wa rasulika' (aur tere Rasool). Nabi ne farmaya: "Nahi, (balki kaho): 'Wa nabiyika-l-ladhi arsalta' (tera Nabi jise tune bheja)."

e: Narrated `Aisha:Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) took a bath after Janaba he started by washing his hands and then performed ablution like that for the prayer. After that he would put his fingers in water and move the roots of his hair with them, and then pour three handfuls of water over his head and then pour water all over his body
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke jab Nabi (ﷺ) janaba ke baad ghusl karte, pehle haath dhote, phir namaz jaisa wudu karte. Iske baad apni ungliyan paani mein daal kar baalon ki jadon tak pahunchate, phir teen martaba sar par paani daalte, phir poore badan par paani bahate.

e: Narrated Maimuna:(the wife of the Prophet) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) performed ablution like that for the prayer but did not wash his feet. He washed off the discharge from his private parts and then poured water over his body. He withdrew his feet from that place (the place where he took the bath) and then washed them. And that was his way of taking the bath of Janaba
hi: Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) namaz jaisa wudu karte magar paon nahi dhote. Woh apni sharmgaah ka asar dhote, phir poore badan par paani bahate. Phir us jagah se hat kar paon dhote. Yeh unka janaba ke ghusl ka tareeqa tha.

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) and I used to take a bath from a single pot called 'Faraq
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke woh aur Nabi (ﷺ) ek hi bartan (Faraq naam ka) se ghusl karte the.

e: Narrated Abu Salama:`Aisha's brother and I went to `Aisha and he asked her about the bath of the Prophet. She brought a pot containing about a Sa` of water and took a bath and poured it over her head and at that time there was a screen between her and us
hi: Abu Salama bataate hain ke main aur Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke bhai unke paas gaye, unhone Nabi ke ghusl ke baare mein pucha. Ayesha ne ek Sa (paimana) bhar paani laaya, ghusl kiya aur sar par dala, us waqt humare aur unke darmiyan parda tha.

e: Narrated Abu Ja`far:While I and my father were with Jabir bin `Abdullah, some people asked him about taking a bath. He replied, "A Sa` of water is sufficient for you." A man said, "A Sa` is not sufficient for me." Jabir said, "A Sa` was sufficient for one who had more hair than you and was better than you (meaning the Prophet)." And then Jabir (put on) his garment and led the prayer
hi: Abu Ja'far bataate hain ke main aur mere waalid Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas the, kuch logon ne unse ghusl ke baare mein pucha. Unhone jawab diya: "Ek Sa paani tumhare liye kaafi hai." Ek shaks ne kaha: "Mujhe kaafi nahi." Jabir ne kaha: "Ek Sa us shaks ke liye kaafi tha jinke tumse zyada baal the aur woh tumse behtar the (yaani Nabi)." Phir Jabir ne apna libaas pehna aur namaz ki imamat ki.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) and Maimuna used to take a bath from a single pot
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) aur Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) ek hi bartan se ghusl karte the.

e: Narrated Jubair bin Mut`im:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "As for me, I pour water three times on my head." And he pointed with both his hands
hi: Jubair bin Mut'im (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Main to apne sar par teen martaba paani daalta hoon," aur donon haathon se ishara kiya.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to pour water three times on his head
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) apne sar par teen martaba paani daalte the.

e: Narrated Abu Ja`far:Jabir bin `Abdullah said to me, "Your cousin (Hasan bin Muhammad bin Al-Hanafiya) came to me and asked about the bath of Janaba. I replied, 'The Prophet (ﷺ) used to take three handfuls of water, pour them on his head and then pour more water over his body.' Al-Hasan said to me, 'I am a hairy man.' I replied, 'The Prophet (ﷺ) had more hair than you
hi: Abu Ja'far bataate hain ke Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne mujhse kaha: "Tumhara chachazad bhai (Hasan bin Muhammad) aaya aur janaba ke ghusl ke baare mein pucha. Maine bataya: 'Nabi teen chullu paani sar par daalte, phir baaki badan par paani bahate.' Hasan ne kaha: 'Mere bahut baal hain.' Maine jawab diya: 'Nabi ke tumse zyada baal the.'"

e: Narrated Maimuna:I placed water for the bath of the Prophet. He washed his hands twice or thrice and then poured water on his left hand and washed his private parts. He rubbed his hands over the earth (and cleaned them), rinsed his mouth, washed his nose by putting water in it and blowing it out, washed his face and both forearms and then poured water over his body. Then he withdrew from that place and washed his feet
hi: Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain ke maine Nabi ke ghusl ke liye paani rakha. Aap ne do-teen baar haath dhoye, phir baayen haath par paani daal kar apni sharmgaah dhoi. Haathon ko zameen par ragad kar (saaf) kiya, kulli ki, naak saaf ki, chehra aur donon baazu dhoye, phir poore badan par paani bahaya. Phir us jagah se hat kar paon dhoye.

e: Narrated `Aisha:Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) took the bath of Janaba (sexual relation or wet dream) he asked for the Hilab or some other scent. He used to take it in his hand, rub it first over the right side of his head and then over the left and then rub the middle of his head with both hands
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke jab Nabi (ﷺ) janaba ka ghusl karte, Hilab ya koi aur khushbu mangte, apne haath mein leke pehle sar ke dahine hisse par malte, phir baayen, phir donon haathon se sar ke beech mein malte.

e: Narrated Maimuna:I placed water for the bath of the Prophet (ﷺ) and he poured water with his right hand on his left and washed them. Then he washed his private parts and rubbed his hands on the ground, washed them with water, rinsed his mouth and washed his nose by putting water in it and blowing it out, washed his face and poured water on his head. He withdrew from that place and washed his feet. A piece of cloth (towel) was given to him but he did not use it
hi: Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain ke maine Nabi ke ghusl ke liye paani rakha, Aap ne dahine haath se baaye haath par paani daal kar donon dhoye. Phir sharmgaah dhoi, haath zameen par ragde, paani se dhoye, kulli ki, naak saaf ki, chehra dhoya aur sar par paani daala. Phir us jagah se hat kar paon dhoye. Aapko ek tauliya diya gaya magar Aap ne istemaal nahi kiya.

e: Narrated Maimuna:The Prophet (ﷺ) took the bath of Janaba. (sexual relation or wet dream). He first cleaned his private parts with his hand, and then rubbed it (that hand) on the wall (earth) and washed it. Then he performed ablution like that for the prayer, and after the bath he washed his feet
