hi: Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne janaba ka ghusl kiya. Pehle apne haath se sharmgaah saaf ki, phir haath deewar (ya zameen) par ragad kar dhoya. Phir namaz jaisa wudu kiya, aur ghusl ke baad paon dhoye.

e: Narrated Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) and I used to take a bath from a single pot of water and our hands used to go in the pot after each other in turn
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke woh aur Nabi (ﷺ) ek hi bartan se ghusl karte the, humare haath bari-bari bartan mein jaate.

e: Narrated `Aisha:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took a bath of Janaba, he washed his hands first
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke jab Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) janaba ka ghusl karte, pehle haath dhote.

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) and I used to take a bath from a single pot of water after Janaba
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke woh aur Nabi (ﷺ) janaba ke baad ek hi bartan se ghusl karte the.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) and one of his wives used to take a bath from a single pot of water. (Shu`ba added to Anas' Statement "After the Janaba)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) aur unki ek biwi ek hi bartan se ghusl karte the (Shu'ba ne joda: janaba ke baad).

e: Narrated Maimuna:I placed water for the bath of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he poured water over his hands and washed them twice or thrice; then he poured water with his right hand over his left and washed his private parts (with his left hand). He rubbed his hand over the earth and rinsed his mouth and washed his nose by putting water in it and blowing it out. After that he washed his face, both fore arms and head thrice and then poured water over his body. He withdrew from that place and washed his feet
hi: Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain ke maine Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke ghusl ke liye paani rakha, Aap ne haathon par paani daal kar do-teen baar dhoya, phir dahine haath se baaye par paani daal kar sharmgaah dhoi (baaye haath se). Haath zameen par ragad kar dhoye, kulli ki, naak saaf ki. Iske baad chehra, donon baazu aur sar teen baar dhoye, phir poore badan par paani bahaya. Phir us jagah se hat kar paon dhoye.

e: Narrated Maimuna bint Al-Harith:I placed water for the bath of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and put a screen. He poured water over his hands, and washed them once or twice. (The sub-narrator added that he did not remember if she had said thrice or not). Then he poured water with his right hand over his left one and washed his private parts. He rubbed his hand over the earth or the wall and washed it. He rinsed his mouth and washed his nose by putting water in it and blowing it out. He washed his face, forearms and head. He poured water over his body and then withdrew from that place and washed his feet. I presented him a piece of cloth (towel) and he pointed with his hand (that he does not want it) and did not take it
hi: Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Al-Harith (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain ke maine Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke ghusl ke liye paani rakha aur parda kiya. Aap ne haathon par paani daal kar ek-do baar dhoya (rawi ko yaad nahi teen baar bhi kaha ya nahi), phir dahine haath se baaye par paani daal kar sharmgaah dhoi. Haath zameen ya deewar par ragad kar dhoye. Kulli ki, naak saaf ki, chehra, baazu aur sar dhoye. Poore badan par paani bahaya, phir us jagah se hat kar paon dhoye. Maine tauliya paish kiya, Aap ne ishara se mana kar diya aur nahi liya.

e: Narrated Muhammad bin Al-Muntathir:on the authority of his father that he had asked `Aisha (about the Hadith of Ibn `Umar). She said, "May Allah be Merciful to Abu `Abdur-Rahman. I used to put scent on Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he used to go round his wives, and in the morning he assumed the Ihram, and the fragrance of scent was still coming out from his body
hi: Muhammad bin Al-Muntathir bataate hain, apne waalid ke hawale se ke unhone Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se (Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki hadith ke baare mein) pucha. Unhone kaha: "Allah Abu Abdur-Rahman (Ibn Umar) par reham kare. Main Allah ke Rasool ko khushbu lagati thi, phir woh apni biwiyon ke paas jaate, aur subah Ihram baandh lete jabke khushbu ki mehak abhi bhi unke badan se aa rahi hoti."

e: Narrated Qatada:Anas bin Malik said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) used to visit all his wives in a round, during the day and night and they were eleven in number." I asked Anas, "Had the Prophet (ﷺ) the strength for it?" Anas replied, "We used to say that the Prophet (ﷺ) was given the strength of thirty (men)." And Sa`id said on the authority of Qatada that Anas had told him about nine wives only (not eleven)
hi: Qatada bataate hain ke Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Nabi apni gyarah biwiyon se din-raat mein bari-bari milte the." Maine Anas se pucha: "Kya Nabi mein itni taaqat thi?" Unhone jawab diya: "Hum kehte the ke Nabi ko teen mardon ki taaqat di gayi thi." Sa'id ne Qatada ke hawale se Anas se sirf nau biwiyon ka zikar kiya (gyarah nahi).

e: Narrated `Ali:I used to get emotional urethral discharge frequently. Being the son-in-law of the Prophet (ﷺ) I requested a man to ask him about it. So the man asked the Prophet (ﷺ) about it. The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Perform ablution after washing your organ (penis)
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: "Mujhe (jinsi) rassi ka mazi aksar aata tha. Nabi ke damaad hone ki wajah se, maine ek shaks se kaha Aap se yeh poochein. Usne poocha, Nabi ne farmaya: 'Apna aala dhokar wudu karo.'"

e: Narrated Muhammad bin Al-Muntathir:on the authority of his father that he had asked `Aisha about the saying of Ibn `Umar (i.e. he did not like to be a Muhrim while the smell of scent was still coming from his body). `Aisha said, "I scented Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he went round (had sexual intercourse with) all his wives, and in the morning he was Muhrim (after taking a bath)
hi: Muhammad bin Al-Muntathir bataate hain, apne waalid ke hawale se ke Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki baat ke baare mein pucha (ke woh khushbu ki mehak ke saath Ihram baandhna pasand nahi karte the). Ayesha ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool ko khushbu lagai, woh apni sab biwiyon ke paas gaye, aur subah (ghusl karke) Ihram baandh liya."

e: Narrated `Aisha:It is as if I am just looking at the glitter of scent in the parting of the Prophet's head hair while he was a Muhrim
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai: "Goya main abhi tak Nabi ke sar ki maang mein khushbu ki chamak dekh rahi hoon jab woh Ihram mein the."

e: Narrated Hisham bin `Urwa:(on the authority of his father) `Aisha said, "Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took the bath of Janaba, he cleaned his hands and performed ablution like that for prayer and then took a bath and rubbed his hair, till he felt that the whole skin of the head had become wet, then he would pour water thrice and wash the rest of the body." `Aisha further said, "I and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to take a bath from a single water container, from which we took water simultaneously
hi: Hisham bin Urwa, apne waalid ke hawale se, Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha: "Jab Allah ke Rasool janaba ka ghusl karte, pehle haath saaf karte, phir namaz jaisa wudu karte, phir ghusl karte aur apne baalon ko malte yahan tak ke poore sar ki khaal geeli mehsoos hoti, phir teen baar paani daalte aur baaki badan dhote." Ayesha ne yeh bhi kaha: "Main aur Allah ke Rasool ek hi bartan se ghusl karte, saath-saath paani lete."

e: Narrated Hisham bin `Urwa:(on the authority of his father) `Aisha said, "Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took the bath of Janaba, he cleaned his hands and performed ablution like that for prayer and then took a bath and rubbed his hair, till he felt that the whole skin of the head had become wet, then he would pour water thrice and wash the rest of the body." `Aisha further said, "I and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to take a bath from a single water container, from which we took water simultaneously
hi: (Yehi hadith dobara riwayat hui hai jaisa upar bayan hua.)

e: Narrated Maimuna:Water was placed for the ablution of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) after Janaba. He poured water with his right hand over his left twice or thrice and then washed his private parts and rubbed his hand on the earth or on a wall twice or thrice and then rinsed his mouth, washed his nose by putting water in it and then blowing it out and then washed his face and forearms and poured water over his head and washed his body. Then he shifted from that place and washed his feet. I brought a piece of cloth, but he did not take it and removed the traces of water from his body with his hand
hi: Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain ke Allah ke Rasool ke janaba ke wudu ke liye paani rakha gaya. Aap ne dahine haath se baaye par do-teen baar paani daal kar sharmgaah dhoi, haath zameen ya deewar par do-teen baar ragde, kulli ki, naak saaf ki, chehra aur baazu dhoye, sar par paani daala aur badan dhoya. Phir us jagah se hat kar paon dhoye. Main tauliya laayi magar Aap ne nahi li, apne haath se paani ka asar khud saaf kiya.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Once the call (Iqama) for the prayer was announced and the rows were straightened. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came out; and when he stood up at his Musalla, he remembered that he was Junub. Then he ordered us to stay at our places and went to take a bath and then returned with water dropping from his head. He said, "Allahu-Akbar", and we all offered the prayer with him
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke ek baar iqamat ho chuki thi aur safein seedhi ho chuki thin. Allah ke Rasool bahar aaye, jab apni jagah khade hue to yaad aaya ke woh Junub hain. Aap ne humein wahin rukne ka hukum diya aur ghusl karne gaye, sar se paani tapkaate wapas aaye, "Allahu Akbar" kaha aur humne saath namaz padhi.

e: Narrated Maimuna:I placed water for the bath of the Prophet (ﷺ) and screened him with a garment. He poured water over his hands and washed them. After that he poured water with his right hand over his left and washed his private parts, rubbed his hands with earth and washed them, rinsed his mouth, washed his nose by putting water in it and then blowing it out and then washed his face and forearms. He poured water over his head and body. He then shifted from that place and washed his feet. I gave him a piece of cloth but he did not take it and came out removing the water (from his body) with both his hands
hi: Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain ke maine Nabi ke ghusl ke liye paani rakha aur kapde se parda kiya. Aap ne haathon par paani daal kar dhoya, phir dahine se baaye haath par paani daal kar sharmgaah dhoi, haath zameen par ragad kar dhoye, kulli ki, naak saaf ki, chehra aur baazu dhoye, sar aur badan par paani daala. Phir us jagah se hat kar paon dhoye. Maine tauliya diya, Aap ne nahi liya, apne dono haathon se paani ka asar hataate hue bahar aaye.

e: Narrated Aisha:Whenever any one of us was Junub, she poured water over her head thrice with both her hands and then rubbed the right side of her head with one hand and rubbed the left side of the head with the other hand
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke jab hum mein se koi Junub hoti, teen baar donon haathon se apne sar par paani daalti, phir ek haath se sar ke dahine hisse aur doosre haath se baaye hisse ko malti.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'The (people of) Bani Israel used to take bath naked (all together) looking at each other. The Prophet Moses (ﷺ) used to take a bath alone. They said, 'By Allah! Nothing prevents Moses from taking a bath with us except that he has a scrotal hernia.' So once Moses went out to take a bath and put his clothes over a stone and then that stone ran away with his clothes. Moses followed that stone saying, "My clothes, O stone! My clothes, O stone! till the people of Bani Israel saw him and said, 'By Allah, Moses has got no defect in his body. Moses took his clothes and began to beat the stone." Abu Huraira added, "By Allah! There are still six or seven marks present on the stone from that excessive beating
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Bani Israel nange hokar ek-doosre ko dekhte hue ghusl karte the. Musa (علیہ السلام) akele ghusl karte. Woh kehte: 'Allah ki qasam, Musa humare saath ghusl karne se sirf isliye bachte hain kyunke unhe koi khaas bimari (hernia) hai.' Ek baar Musa ghusl karne gaye aur apne kapde ek chatan par rakhe, chatan unke kapde leke bhaag gayi. Musa uske peechhe daudte hue kehte rahe: 'Mere kapde, aye chatan! Mere kapde, aye chatan!' yahan tak ke Bani Israel ne unhe dekh liya aur kaha: 'Allah ki qasam, Musa ke jism mein koi khaami nahi.' Musa ne apne kapde liye aur chatan ko pitna shuru kar diya." Abu Huraira ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, us chatan par abhi bhi chhe-saat nishaan hain us maar ki wajah se."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When the Prophet Job (Aiyub) (ﷺ) was taking a bath naked, golden locusts began to fall on him. Job started collecting them in his clothes. His Lord addressed him, 'O Job! Haven't I given you enough so that you are not in need of them.' Job replied, 'Yes! By Your Honor (power)! But I cannot dispense with Your Blessings
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Jab Nabi Ayyub (علیہ السلام) nange hokar ghusl kar rahe the, unpar sone ki tiddiyan girne lagin. Ayyub unhe apne kapde mein samet-ne lage. Unke Rab ne unse farmaya: 'Aye Ayyub! Kya maine tumhe itna nahi diya ke tumhe iski zaroorat na rahe?' Ayyub ne jawab diya: 'Haan! Teri izzat ki qasam, magar mujhe teri barkaton se koi be-niyaz nahi kar sakta.'"

e: Narrated Um Hani bint Abi Talib:I went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the year of the conquest of Mecca and found him taking a bath while Fatima was screening him. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "Who is it?" I replied, "I am Um-Hani
hi: Um Hani bint Abi Talib (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain ke woh Fatah-e-Mecca ke saal Allah ke Rasool ke paas gayi aur unhe ghusl karte paaya jabke Fatima (Alayhas Salam) parda kar rahi thi. Nabi ne pucha: "Kaun hai?" Maine kaha: "Main Um-Hani hoon."

e: Narrated Maimuna:I screened the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was taking a bath of Janaba. He washed his hands, poured water from his right hand over his left and washed his private parts. Then he rubbed his hand over a wall or the earth, and performed ablution similar to that for the prayer but did not wash his feet. Then he poured water over his body, shifted from that place, and washed his feet
hi: Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain ke maine Nabi (ﷺ) ke janaba ke ghusl ke waqt parda kiya. Aap ne haath dhoye, dahine se baaye haath par paani daal kar sharmgaah dhoi. Phir haath deewar ya zameen par ragde, namaz jaisa wudu kiya magar paon nahi dhoye. Phir badan par paani daala, us jagah se hat kar paon dhoye.

e: Narrated Um-Salama:(the mother of the believers) Um Sulaim, the wife of Abu Talha, came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Verily Allah is not shy of (telling you) the truth. Is it necessary for a woman to take a bath after she has a wet dream (nocturnal sexual discharge)?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, "Yes, if she notices a discharge
hi: Um Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain ke Um Sulaim (Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki biwi) Allah ke Rasool ke paas aayi aur kaha: "Ya Rasoolallah, Allah sach batane mein sharm nahi karta — kya aurat ko khwab mein (jinsi) inzaal hone par ghusl zaroori hai?" Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Haan, agar usse asar dikhe."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) came across me in one of the streets of Medina and at that time I was Junub. So I slipped away from him and went to take a bath. On my return the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Abu Huraira! Where have you been?" I replied, "I was Junub, so I disliked to sit in your company." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Subhan Allah! A believer never becomes impure
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Nabi (ﷺ) Madina ki ek gali mein mujhse mile, us waqt main Junub tha. Main chupke se hat gaya aur ghusl karne chala gaya. Wapas aane par Nabi ne pucha: "Aye Abu Huraira! Kahan the?" Maine kaha: "Main Junub tha, isliye aapki sohbat mein baithna napasand kiya." Nabi ne farmaya: "Subhan Allah! Momin kabhi napaak nahi hota."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to visit all his wives in one night and he had nine wives at that time
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) ek raat mein apni sab biwiyon se milte, us waqt unki nau biwiyan thin.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came across me and I was Junub. He took my hand and I went along with him till he sat down I slipped away, went home and took a bath. When I came back, he was still sitting there. He then said to me, "O Abu Huraira! Where have you been?' I told him about it. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Subhan Allah! O Abu Huraira! A believer never becomes impure
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Allah ke Rasool mujhse mile, main Junub tha. Aap ne mera haath pakda aur main unke saath chala yahan tak ke woh baith gaye. Main chupke se ghar gaya aur ghusl kiya. Jab wapas aaya, Aap wahin baithe the. Aap ne pucha: "Aye Abu Huraira! Kahan the?" Maine bataya. Nabi ne farmaya: "Subhan Allah! Aye Abu Huraira! Momin kabhi napaak nahi hota."

e: Narrated Abu Salama:I asked `Aisha "Did the Prophet (ﷺ) use to sleep while he was Junub?" She replied, "Yes, but he used to perform ablution (before going to bed)
hi: Abu Salama bataate hain ke maine Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se pucha: "Kya Nabi Junub halat mein sote the?" Unhone jawab diya: "Haan, magar sone se pehle wudu kar lete."

e: Narrated `Umar bin Al-Khattab:I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) "Can any one of us sleep while he is Junub?" He replied, "Yes, if he performs ablution, he can sleep while he is Junub
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Khattab (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Maine Allah ke Rasool se pucha: 'Kya koi Junub halat mein so sakta hai?' Farmaya: 'Haan, agar wudu kar le to Junub halat mein bhi so sakta hai.'"

e: Narrated `Aisha:Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) intended to sleep while he was Junub, he used to wash his private parts and perform ablution like that for the prayer
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke jab Nabi Junub halat mein sona chahte, apni sharmgaah dhote aur namaz jaisa wudu karte.

e: Narrated `Abdullah:`Umar asked the Prophet (ﷺ) "Can anyone of us sleep while he is Junub?" He replied, "Yes, if he performs ablution
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Nabi se pucha: "Kya koi Junub halat mein so sakta hai?" Farmaya: "Haan, agar wudu kar le."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:`Umar bin Al-Khattab told Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), "I became Junub at night." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, "Perform ablution after washing your private parts and then sleep
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain ke Umar bin Khattab (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Allah ke Rasool se kaha: "Raat ko main Junub ho gaya." Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Sharmgaah dhokar wudu karo, phir so jao."

e: Narrated Hisham:as the following Hadith 290. Narrated Abu Huraira: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When a man sits in between the four parts of a woman and did the sexual intercourse with her, bath becomes compulsory
hi: Hisham ne isi tarah bayan kiya jaisa hadith 290. Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Jab koi mard aurat ke chaar hisson ke darmiyan baith kar humbistari kare, ghusl zaroori ho jaata hai."

e: Narrated Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani:I asked `Uthman bin `Affan about a man who engaged in the sexual intercourse with his wife but did not discharge. `Uthman replied, "He should perform ablution like that for the prayer after washing his private parts." `Uthman added, "I heard that from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." I asked `Ali bin Abi Talib, Az-Zubair bin Al-`Awwam, Talha bin 'Ubaidullah and Ubai bin Ka`b and they gave the same reply. (Abu Aiyub said that he had heard that from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ) (This order was canceled later on so one has to take a bath. See, Hadith No)
hi: Zaid bin Khalid (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Juhani (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke maine Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Affan se pucha us shaks ke baare mein jo biwi se humbistari kare magar inzaal na ho. Uthman ne kaha: "Sharmgaah dhokar namaz jaisa wudu kare." Unhone kaha: "Maine yeh Allah ke Rasool se suna hai." Maine Ali (Alayhis Salam), Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ), Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Ubai bin Ka'b (رضی اللہ عنہ) se bhi pucha, unhone bhi yehi jawab diya. (Abu Aiyub ne bhi Nabi se yehi suna tha — baad mein yeh hukum badla, ab ghusl zaroori hai.)

e: Narrated Ubai bin Ka`b:I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about a man who engages in sexual intercourse with his wife but does not discharge. He replied, "He should wash the parts which comes in contact with the private parts of the woman, perform ablution and then pray." (Abu `Abdullah said, "Taking a bath is safer and is the last order)
hi: Ubai bin Ka'b (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Maine Allah ke Rasool se pucha us shaks ke baare mein jo biwi se humbistari kare magar inzaal na ho. Farmaya: 'Woh hisse dhoye jo aurat ki sharmgaah se mile the, wudu kare, phir namaz padhe.'" (Abu Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) kehte hain: Ghusl zyada mehfooz aur aakhri hukum hai.)

e: Narrated Al-Qasim:`Aisha said, "We set out with the sole intention of performing Hajj and when we reached Sarif, (a place six miles from Mecca) I got my menses. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to me while I was weeping. He said 'What is the matter with you? Have you got your menses?' I replied, 'Yes.' He said, 'This is a thing which Allah has ordained for the daughters of Adam. So do what all the pilgrims do with the exception of the Tawaf (Circumambulation) round the Ka`ba." `Aisha added, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sacrificed cows on behalf of his wives
hi: Al-Qasim bataate hain ke Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha: "Hum sirf Hajj ki niyyat se nikle the, jab Sarif (Mecca se chhe mil door) pahunche, mujhe haiz aa gaya. Allah ke Rasool mere paas aaye jab main ro rahi thi. Aap ne pucha: 'Kya baat hai? Kya haiz aaya hai?' Maine kaha: 'Haan.' Farmaya: 'Yeh woh cheez hai jo Allah ne Adam ki betiyon ke liye muqarrar ki hai. Tum wahi karo jo baaki Hajji karte hain, siwaye Ka'ba ke Tawaf ke.'" Ayesha ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool ne apni biwiyon ki taraf se gaayein qurbani kin."

e: Narrated `Aisha:While in menses, I used to comb the hair of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai: "Haiz ki halat mein bhi main Allah ke Rasool ke baalon mein kanghi karti thi."

e: Narrated `Urwa:A person asked me, "Can a woman in menses serve me? And can a Junub woman come close to me?" I replied, "All this is easy for me. All of them can serve me, and there is no harm for any other person to do the same. `Aisha told me that she used to comb the hair of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while she was in her menses, and he was in I`tikaf (in the mosque). He would bring his head near her in her room and she would comb his hair, while she used to be in her menses
hi: Urwa bataate hain ke ek shaks ne mujhse pucha: "Kya haiz wali aurat meri khidmat kar sakti hai? Aur kya Junub aurat mere qareeb aa sakti hai?" Maine kaha: "Yeh sab mere liye asaan hai. Woh sab meri khidmat kar sakti hain, kisi aur ke liye bhi koi harj nahi." Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne bataya ke woh haiz ki halat mein Allah ke Rasool ke baalon mein kanghi karti thi jabke Aap masjid mein I'tikaf mein hote. Aap apna sar unke kamre ki taraf laate aur woh kanghi karti, jabke woh haiz mein hoti.

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to lean on my lap and recite Qur'an while I was in menses
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) mere goad mein takiya laga kar Quran padhte, jabke main haiz mein hoti.

e: Narrated Um Salama:While I was laying with the Prophet (ﷺ) under a single woolen sheet, I got the menses. I slipped away and put on the clothes for menses. He said, "Have you got "Nifas" (menses)?" I replied, "Yes." He then called me and made me lie with him under the same sheet
hi: Um Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain ke jab main Nabi (ﷺ) ke saath ek hi oon ki chadar mein leti thi, mujhe haiz aa gaya. Main chupke se hat gayi aur haiz ke kapde pehen liye. Nabi ne pucha: "Kya Nifas (haiz) aa gaya?" Maine kaha: "Haan." Phir Aap ne mujhe bulaya aur usi chadar mein saath lita liya.

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) and I used to take a bath from a single pot while we were Junub. During the menses, he used to order me to put on an Izar (dress worn below the waist) and used to fondle me. While in I`tikaf, he used to bring his head near me and I would wash it while I used to be in my periods (menses)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai: "Main aur Nabi (ﷺ) Junub halat mein ek hi bartan se ghusl karte the. Haiz ke waqt Aap mujhe Izar (kamar ke neeche ka kapda) pehenne ka hukum dete aur mujhse pyar karte. I'tikaf mein Aap apna sar mere qareeb laate aur main use dhoti, jabke main haiz mein hoti."

e: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin Al-Aswad:(on the authority of his father) `Aisha said: "Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) wanted to fondle anyone of us during her periods (menses), he used to order her to put on an Izar and start fondling her." `Aisha added, "None of you could control his sexual desires as the Prophet (ﷺ) could
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Al-Aswad bataate hain, apne waalid ke hawale se: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha: "Jab Allah ke Rasool humein haiz ki halat mein pyar karna chahte, Izar pehenne ka hukum dete aur pyar karte." Ayesha ne joda: "Tum mein se koi bhi apni khwahishaat par itna qaboo nahi rakh sakta jitna Nabi rakhte the."

e: Narrated Maimuna:When ever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) wanted to fondle any of his wives during the periods (menses), he used to ask her to wear an Izar
hi: Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke jab Allah ke Rasool apni kisi biwi ko haiz ki halat mein pyar karna chahte, unhe Izar pehenne ko kehte.

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went out to the Musalla (to offer the prayer) of `Id-al-Adha or Al-Fitr prayer. Then he passed by the women and said, "O women! Give alms, as I have seen that the majority of the dwellers of Hell-fire were you (women)." They asked, "Why is it so, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ?" He replied, "You curse frequently and are ungrateful to your husbands. I have not seen anyone more deficient in intelligence and religion than you. A cautious sensible man could be led astray by some of you." The women asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What is deficient in our intelligence and religion?" He said, "Is not the evidence of two women equal to the witness of one man?" They replied in the affirmative. He said, "This is the deficiency in her intelligence. Isn't it true that a woman can neither pray nor fast during her menses?" The women replied in the affirmative. He said, "This is the deficiency in her religion
hi: Abu Saeed Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke ek baar Allah ke Rasool Eid-ul-Adha ya Eid-ul-Fitr ki namaz ke liye Musalla gaye. Aap aurton ke paas se guzre aur farmaya: "Aye aurton! Sadqa do, kyunke maine dekha ke Dozakh mein zyada tar tum (aurtein) ho." Unhone pucha: "Kyun, Ya Rasoolallah?" Aap ne farmaya: "Tum aksar laanat karti ho aur apne shohar ki na-shukri karti ho. Maine tumse zyada aqal aur deen mein kami wali koi nahi dekhi, jo hoshiyar mard ko bhi gumraah kar de." Aurton ne pucha: "Ya Rasoolallah, hamari aqal aur deen mein kya kami hai?" Aap ne farmaya: "Kya do aurton ki gawahi ek mard ki gawahi ke barabar nahi hoti?" Unhone kaha: "Haan." Farmaya: "Yehi uski aqal ki kami hai. Kya yeh sach nahi ke aurat haiz mein na namaz padh sakti hai na roza rakh sakti hai?" Unhone kaha: "Haan." Farmaya: "Yehi uske deen ki kami hai."

e: Narrated `Aisha:We set out with the Prophet (ﷺ) for Hajj and when we reached Sarif I got my menses. When the Prophet (ﷺ) came to me, I was weeping. He asked, "Why are you weeping?" I said, "I wish if I had not performed Hajj this year." He asked, "May be that you got your menses?" I replied, "Yes." He then said, "This is the thing which Allah has ordained for all the daughters of Adam. So do what all the pilgrims do except that you do not perform the Tawaf round the Ka`ba till you are clean
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai: "Hum Nabi ke saath Hajj ke liye nikle, jab Sarif pahunche mujhe haiz aa gaya. Jab Nabi mere paas aaye, main ro rahi thi. Aap ne pucha: 'Kyun ro rahi ho?' Maine kaha: 'Kaash is saal Hajj na karti.' Aap ne pucha: 'Shayad haiz aa gaya?' Maine kaha: 'Haan.' Farmaya: 'Yeh woh cheez hai jo Allah ne Adam ki sab betiyon ke liye muqarrar ki hai. Tum wahi karo jo Hajji karte hain, siwaye Ka'ba ke Tawaf ke jab tak paak na ho jao.'"

e: Narrated `Aisha:Fatima bint Abi Hubaish said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I do not become clean (from bleeding). Shall I give up my prayers?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied: "No, because it is from a blood vessel and not the menses. So when the real menses begins give up your prayers and when it (the period) has finished wash the blood off your body (take a bath) and offer your prayers
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke Fatima (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Abi Hubaish ne Allah ke Rasool se kaha: "Ya Rasoolallah, main paak nahi hoti (khoon musalsal aata hai). Kya namaz chhod dun?" Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Nahi, yeh rag se hai haiz nahi. Jab asli haiz shuru ho namaz chhodo, jab khatam ho (ghusl karke) khoon dho lo aur namaz padho."

e: Narrated Asma' bint Abi Bakr:A woman asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What should we do, if the blood of menses falls on our clothes?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, "If the blood of menses falls on the garment of anyone of you, she must take hold of the blood spot, rub it, and wash it with water and then pray in (with it)
hi: Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Abi Bakr (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain ke ek aurat ne Allah ke Rasool se pucha: "Ya Rasoolallah, agar haiz ka khoon kapde par lag jaye to kya karein?" Farmaya: "Us jagah ko pakad kar ragdo, paani se dhoo lo, phir usme namaz padho."

e: Narrated `Aisha:Whenever anyone of us got her menses, she, on becoming clean, used to take hold of the blood spot and rub the blood off her garment, and pour water over it and wash that portion thoroughly and sprinkle water over the rest of the garment. After that she would pray in (with) it
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke jab bhi hum mein se koi haiz se paak hoti, khoon wali jagah pakad kar ragadti, paani daal kar achhi tarah dhoti aur baaki kapde par paani chhidak deti. Phir usme namaz padhti.

e: Narrated `Aisha:Once one of the wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) did I`tikaf along with him and she was getting bleeding in between her periods. She used to see the blood (from her private parts) and she would perhaps put a dish under her for the blood. (The sub-narrator `Ikrima added, `Aisha once saw the liquid of safflower and said, "It looks like what so and so used to have)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ki ek biwi unke saath I'tikaf mein thin aur unhe haiz ke darmiyan khoon aata tha. Woh khoon dekhtin aur shayad apne neeche ek bartan rakh leti (Ikrima ne joda: Ayesha ne ek baar Safflower ka rang dekha aur kaha "yeh waisa hi hai jaisa falaan ke paas hota tha").

e: Narrated `Aisha:"One of the wives of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) joined him in I`tikaf and she noticed blood and yellowish discharge (from her private parts) and put a dish under her when she prayed
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai: "Nabi ki ek biwi unke saath I'tikaf mein thi, unhe khoon aur peela sa mawaad (mahwaari ke darmiyan) aata tha, aur namaz ke waqt woh apne neeche ek bartan rakh leti."

e: Narrated `Aisha:One of the mothers of the faithful believers (i.e. the wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) ) did I`tikaf while she was having bleeding in between her periods
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ki ek biwi ne I'tikaf kiya jabke unhe apne haiz ke darmiyan khoon aata tha.

e: Narrated `Aisha:None of us had more than a single garment and we used to have our menses while wearing it. Whenever it got soiled with blood of menses we used to apply saliva to the blood spot and rub off the blood with our nails
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai: "Humare paas ek-ek hi kapda hota tha, hum usi mein haiz guzarti thi. Jab usme khoon lag jaata, hum thook lagakar apne naakhoon se khoon ragad dete."

e: Narrated Um-`Atiya:We were forbidden to mourn for a dead person for more than three days except in the case of a husband for whom mourning was allowed for four months and ten days. (During that time) we were not allowed to put kohl (Antimony eye power) in our eyes or to use perfumes or to put on colored clothes except a dress made of `Asb (a kind of Yemen cloth, very coarse and rough). We were allowed very light perfumes at the time of taking a bath after menses and also we were forbidden to go with the funeral procession
hi: Um-Atiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai: "Humein kisi mayyat ke liye teen din se zyada sog manaane se mana kiya gaya tha, siwaye shohar ke, jiske liye chaar mahine das din sog manane ki ijazat thi. (Us waqt) humein kohl lagane, khushbu lagane, ya rangeen kapde pehenne ki (Asb kapde ke ilawa) ijazat nahi thi. Haiz ke baad ghusl ke waqt halki khushbu lagane ki ijazat thi, aur janaze ke saath jaane se mana kiya gaya tha."

e: Narrated `Aisha:A woman asked the Prophet (ﷺ) about the bath which is taken after finishing from the menses. The Prophet (ﷺ) told her what to do and said, "Purify yourself with a piece of cloth scented with musk." The woman asked, "How shall I purify myself with it?" He said, "Subhan Allah! Purify yourself (with it)." I pulled her to myself and said, "Rub the place soiled with blood with it
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke ek aurat ne Nabi se haiz ke baad ke ghusl ke baare mein pucha. Nabi ne bataya kya karna hai aur farmaya: "Kasturi lagi hui ek kapde se apne aap ko paak karo." Aurat ne pucha: "Isse kaise paak karoon?" Farmaya: "Subhan Allah! Isse paak ho jao." Maine (Ayesha) usse apni taraf khinch kar kaha: "Khoon wali jagah par isse ragdo."

e: Narrated `Aisha:An Ansari woman asked the Prophet (ﷺ) how to take a bath after finishing from the menses. He replied, "Take a piece of cloth perfumed with musk and clean the private parts with it thrice." The Prophet (ﷺ) felt shy and turned his face. So I pulled her to me and told her what the Prophet (ﷺ) meant
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke ek Ansari aurat ne Nabi se haiz ke baad ghusl ke baare mein pucha. Aap ne farmaya: "Kasturi lagi ek kapda lo aur usse apni sharmgaah teen baar saaf karo." Nabi ko sharm mehsoos hui aur unhone mun pher liya. Main usse apni taraf khinch kar Nabi ka matlab samjhaya.

e: Narrated `Aisha:In the last Hajj of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) assumed the Ihram for Hajj along with Allah's Apostle. I was one of those who intended Tamattu` (to perform Hajj and `Umra) and did not take the Hadi (animal for sacrifice) with me. I got my menses and was not clean till the night of `Arafa I said, "O Allah's Apostle! It is the night of the day of `Arafat and I intended to perform the Hajj Tamattu` with `Umra. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) told me to undo my hair and comb it and to postpone the `Umra. I did the same and completed the Hajj. On the night of Al-Hasba (i.e. place outside Mecca where the pilgrims go after finishing all the ceremonies of Hajj at Mina) he (the Prophet) ordered `Abdur Rahman (`Aisha's brother) to take me to at-Tan`im to assume the Ihram for `Umra in lieu of that of Hajj-at-Tamattu` which I had intended to perform
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai: "Allah ke Rasool ke aakhri Hajj mein main un logon mein se thi jinhone Tamattu (Hajj aur Umrah dono) ki niyyat ki aur apne saath qurbani ka janwar nahi laayi thi. Mujhe haiz aa gaya aur Arafat ki raat tak paak na hui. Maine kaha: 'Ya Rasoolallah, yeh Arafat ke din ki raat hai aur maine Tamattu Hajj-Umrah ki niyyat ki thi.' Allah ke Rasool ne mujhe apne baal khol kar kanghi karne ko kaha aur Umrah ko taal dene ko kaha. Maine waisa hi kiya aur Hajj mukammal kiya. Al-Hasba ki raat, Aap ne Abdur Rahman (mere bhai) ko mere saath at-Tan'im bheja taake main Umrah ke liye Ihram baandhun (jo Tamattu Hajj ke badle mein tha)."

e: Narrated `Aisha:On the 1st of Dhul-Hijja we set out with the intention of performing Hajj. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Any one who likes to assume the Ihram for `Umra he can do so. Had I not brought the Hadi with me, I would have assumed the Ihram for `Umra. "Some of us assumed the Ihram for `Umra while the others assumed the Ihram for Hajj. I was one of those who assumed the Ihram for `Umra. I got menses and kept on menstruating until the day of `Arafat and complained of that to the Prophet. He told me to postpone my `Umra, undo and comb my hair, and to assume the Ihram of Hajj and I did so. On the night of Hasba, he sent my brother `Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Bakr with me to at-Tan`im, where I assumed the Ihram for `Umra in lieu of the previous one. Hisham said, "For that (`Umra) no Hadi, fasting or alms were required
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai: "1 Zul-Hijja ko hum Hajj ki niyyat se nikle. Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: 'Jo Umrah ka Ihram baandhna chahe, baandh sakta hai. Agar main apne saath qurbani ka janwar na laata, to main bhi Umrah ka Ihram baandhta.' Kuch logon ne Umrah ka aur kuch ne Hajj ka Ihram baandha. Main Umrah wali thi. Mujhe haiz aaya aur Arafat ke din tak jaari raha, maine Nabi se shikayat ki. Aap ne mujhe Umrah taal kar baal khol kar kanghi karne aur Hajj ka Ihram baandhne ko kaha, maine waisa kiya. Hasba ki raat Aap ne mere bhai Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Bakr ko mere saath at-Tan'im bheja, jahan maine pehle wale ke badle Umrah ka Ihram baandha." Hisham ne kaha: "Iske liye qurbani, roza, ya sadqa zaroori nahi tha."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "At every womb Allah appoints an angel who says, 'O Lord! A drop of semen, O Lord! A clot. O Lord! A little lump of flesh." Then if Allah wishes (to complete) its creation, the angel asks, (O Lord!) Will it be a male or female, a wretched or a blessed, and how much will his provision be? And what will his age be?' So all that is written while the child is still in the mother's womb
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Har rehm par Allah ek farishta muqarrar karta hai jo kehta hai: 'Aye Rab! Nutfa. Aye Rab! Jama hua khoon. Aye Rab! Gosht ka tukda.' Phir agar Allah uski takhleeq poori karna chahe, farishta poochta hai: 'Mard hoga ya aurat, badnaseeb ya khush-naseeb, aur uski rozi kitni hogi? Uski umar kitni hogi?' Yeh sab bacche ke maa ke pet mein hote hue hi likh diya jaata hai."

e: Narrated `Urwa:`Aisha said, "We set out with the Prophet (ﷺ) in his last Hajj. Some of us intended to perform `Umra while others Hajj. When we reached Mecca, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Those who had assumed the Ihram for `Umra and had not brought the Hadi should finish his Ihram and whoever had assumed the Ihram for `Umra and brought the Hadi should not finish the Ihram till he has slaughtered his Hadi and whoever had assumed the Ihram for Hajj should complete his Hajj." `Aisha further said, "I got my periods (menses) and kept on menstruating till the day of `Arafat, and I had assumed the Ihram for `Umra only (Tamattu`). The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered me to undo and comb my head hair and assume the Ihram for Hajj only and leave the `Umra. I did the same till I completed the Hajj. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) sent `Abdur Rahman bin Abi Bakr with me and ordered me to perform `Umra from at-Tan`im in lieu of the missed `Umra
hi: Urwa bataate hain ke Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha: "Hum Nabi ke saath unke aakhri Hajj mein nikle. Kuch logon ne Umrah ki niyyat ki, kuch ne Hajj ki. Jab Mecca pahunche, Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: 'Jinhone Umrah ka Ihram baandha aur qurbani nahi laayi, woh apna Ihram khatam kar de. Jinhone Umrah ka Ihram baandha aur qurbani bhi laayi, woh apna Ihram khatam na kare jab tak qurbani na kar le. Jinhone Hajj ka Ihram baandha, woh apna Hajj poora kare.' Ayesha ne kaha: 'Mujhe haiz aaya aur Arafat ke din tak jaari raha, maine sirf Umrah (Tamattu) ka Ihram baandha tha. Nabi ne mujhe baal khol kar kanghi karne aur sirf Hajj ka Ihram baandhne aur Umrah chhodne ka hukum diya. Maine waisa hi kiya jab tak Hajj mukammal na ho gaya. Phir Nabi ne mere saath Abdur Rahman bin Abi Bakr ko bheja aur mujhe at-Tan'im se Umrah karne ka hukum diya, chhoote hue Umrah ke badle.'"

e: Narrated `Aisha:Fatima bint Abi Hubaish used to have bleeding in between the periods, so she asked the Prophet (ﷺ) about it. He replied, "The bleeding is from a blood vessel and not the menses. So give up the prayers when the (real) menses begins and when it has finished, take a bath and start praying
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke Fatima (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Abi Hubaish ko haiz ke darmiyan khoon aata tha, usne Nabi se iske baare mein pucha. Aap ne farmaya: "Yeh rag ka khoon hai, haiz nahi. Jab asli haiz shuru ho namaz chhodo, jab khatam ho ghusl karke namaz shuru karo."

e: Narrated Mu`adha:A woman asked `Aisha, "Should I offer the prayers that which I did not offer because of menses" `Aisha said, "Are you from the Huraura' (a town in Iraq?) We were with the Prophet (ﷺ) and used to get our periods but he never ordered us to offer them (the Prayers missed during menses)." `Aisha perhaps said, "We did not offer them
hi: Mu'adha bataati hain ke ek aurat ne Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se pucha: "Kya main haiz mein chhooti hui namazein qaza karoon?" Ayesha ne kaha: "Kya tum Huraura (Iraq ke ek shehar) se ho? Hum Nabi ke saath rehti thi aur haiz aata tha, magar Aap ne kabhi humein woh namazein qaza karne ka hukum nahi diya." Ayesha ne shayad kaha: "Hum unhe qaza nahi karti thi."

e: Narrated Zainab bint Abi Salama:Um-Salama said, "I got my menses while I was lying with the Prophet (ﷺ) under a woolen sheet. So I slipped away, took the clothes for menses and put them on. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Have you got your menses?' I replied, 'Yes.' Then he called me and took me with him under the woolen sheet." Um Salama further said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) used to kiss me while he was fasting. The Prophet (ﷺ) and I used to take the bath of Janaba from a single pot
hi: Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Abi Salama bataati hain ke Um Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha: "Mujhe haiz aaya jab main Nabi ke saath ek oon ki chadar mein leti thi. Main chupke se hat gayi aur haiz ke kapde pehen liye. Allah ke Rasool ne pucha: 'Kya haiz aa gaya?' Maine kaha: 'Haan.' Phir Aap ne mujhe bulaya aur apne saath usi chadar mein le liya." Um Salama ne yeh bhi kaha: "Nabi mujhe roza rakhte hue bhi bosa dete the. Main aur Nabi ek hi bartan se janaba ka ghusl karte the."

e: Narrated Um Salama:While I was lying with the Prophet (ﷺ) under a woolen sheet, I got my menses. I slipped away and put on the clothes for menses. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Have you got your menses?" I replied, "Yes." He called me and I slept with him under the woolen sheet
hi: Um Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain ke jab main Nabi ke saath oon ki chadar mein leti thi, mujhe haiz aaya. Main chupke se hat gayi aur haiz ke kapde pehne. Nabi ne pucha: "Kya haiz aa gaya?" Maine kaha: "Haan." Aap ne mujhe bulaya aur main unke saath oon ki chadar mein so gayi.

e: Narrated Aiyub:Hafsa said, 'We used to forbid our young women to go out for the two `Id prayers. A woman came and stayed at the palace of Bani Khalaf and she narrated about her sister whose husband took part in twelve holy battles along with the Prophet (ﷺ) and her sister was with her husband in six (out of these twelve). She (the woman's sister) said, "We used to treat the wounded, look after the patients and once I asked the Prophet, 'Is there any harm for any of us to stay at home if she doesn't have a veil?' He said, 'She should cover herself with the veil of her companion and should participate in the good deeds and in the religious gathering of the Muslims.' When Um `Atiya came I asked her whether she had heard it from the Prophet. She replied, "Yes. May my father be sacrificed for him (the Prophet)! (Whenever she mentioned the Prophet (ﷺ) she used to say, 'May my father be sacrificed for him) I have heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, 'The unmarried young virgins and the mature girl who stay often screened or the young unmarried virgins who often stay screened and the menstruating women should come out and participate in the good deeds as well as the religious gathering of the faithful believers but the menstruating women should keep away from the Musalla (praying place).' " Hafsa asked Um `Atiya surprisingly, "Do you say the menstruating women?" She replied, "Doesn't a menstruating woman attend `Arafat (Hajj) and such and such (other deeds)?
hi: Aiyub bataate hain ke Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha: "Hum apni jawan aurton ko dono Eid ki namazon ke liye jaane se rokte the. Ek aurat aayi aur Bani Khalaf ke mahal mein thehri, usne apni behn ke baare mein bataya jiske shohar ne Nabi ke saath baarah jungein ladi thin, aur woh unme se chhe mein apne shohar ke saath thi. Usne kaha: 'Hum zakhmiyon ka ilaaj karte, bimaron ki dekhbhaal karte, aur ek baar maine Nabi se pucha: kya kisi ke liye ghar rehna theek hai agar uske paas parda (chadar) na ho?' Aap ne farmaya: 'Woh apni sathi ki chadar odh le aur nekiyon aur Musalmanon ki majlison mein shareek ho.'" Jab Um Atiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) aayi, maine unse pucha kya unhone yeh Nabi se suna hai. Unhone kaha: "Haan. Mere baap unpar qurban hon! (Jab bhi woh Nabi ka zikar karti, kehti 'mere baap unpar qurban hon') Maine Nabi ko farmate suna: 'Kunwari, jawan, aur mahfooz rehne wali ladkiyan, aur haiz wali aurtein bhi baahar aayen aur nekiyon aur Musalmanon ki majlison mein shareek hon, magar haiz wali Musalla (namaz ki jagah) se door rahen.'" Hafsa ne hairat se pucha: "Kya tum haiz wali aurton ki baat kar rahi ho?" Unhone jawab diya: "Kya haiz wali aurat Arafat (Hajj) mein aur falaan-falaan kaam mein shareek nahi hoti?"

e: Narrated `Aisha:Fatima bint Abi Hubaish asked the Prophet, "I got persistent bleeding (in between the periods) and do not become clean. Shall I give up prayers?" He replied, "No, this is from a blood vessel. Give up the prayers only for the days on which you usually get the menses and then take a bath and offer your prayers
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke Fatima (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Abi Hubaish ne Nabi se pucha: "Mujhe musalsal khoon aata hai (haiz ke darmiyan) aur main paak nahi hoti. Kya namaz chhod dun?" Aap ne farmaya: "Nahi, yeh rag ka khoon hai. Sirf un dinon namaz chhodo jinme aksar haiz aata hai, phir ghusl karke namaz padho."

e: Narrated Um `Atiya:We never considered yellowish discharge as a thing of importance (as menses)
hi: Um Atiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai: "Hum peele mawaad ko (haiz jaisi) ahmiyat nahi dete the."

e: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) Um Habiba got bleeding in between the periods for seven years. She asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about it. He ordered her to take a bath (after the termination of actual periods) and added that it was (from) a blood vessel. So she used to take a bath for every prayer
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke Um Habiba ko saat saal tak haiz ke darmiyan khoon aata raha. Usne Allah ke Rasool se pucha. Aap ne use (asli haiz khatam hone ke baad) ghusl karne ka hukum diya aur farmaya ke yeh rag ka khoon hai. Woh har namaz ke liye ghusl karti thi.

e: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) I told Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that Safiya bint Huyai had got her menses. He said, "She will probably delay us. Did she perform Tawaf (Al-Ifada) with you?" We replied, "Yes." On that the Prophet (ﷺ) told her to depart
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: "Maine Allah ke Rasool ko bataya ke Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Huyai ko haiz aa gaya hai." Aap ne farmaya: "Woh humein rok degi. Kya usne tumhare saath Tawaf-e-Ifada kiya tha?" Humne kaha: "Haan." Tab Nabi ne use jaane ko kaha.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:A woman is allowed to leave (go back home) if she gets menses (after Tawaf-Al-Ifada). Ibn `Umar formerly used to say that she should not leave but later on I heard him saying, "She may leave, since Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave them the permission to leave (after Tawaf-Al-Ifada)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke agar (Tawaf-e-Ifada ke baad) aurat ko haiz aa jaye, woh (ghar) jaa sakti hai. Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) pehle kehte the ke woh na jaaye, magar baad mein maine unhe kehte suna: "Woh jaa sakti hai, kyunke Allah ke Rasool ne unhe (Tawaf-e-Ifada ke baad) jaane ki ijazat di thi."

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said to me, "Give up the prayer when your menses begin and when it has finished, wash the blood off your body (take a bath) and start praying
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne mujhse farmaya: "Jab haiz shuru ho namaz chhod do, jab khatam ho khoon dho lo (ghusl karo) aur namaz shuru karo."

e: Narrated Samura bin Jundub:The Prophet (ﷺ) offered the funeral prayer for the dead body of a woman who died during delivery (i.e. childbirth) and he stood by the middle of her body
hi: Samura bin Jundub (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne ek aurat ke janaze ki namaz padhai jiska intiqal bachche ki paidaish ke waqt hua tha, aur Aap uske jism ke beech mein khade hue.

e: Narrated Maimuna:(the wife of the Prophet) During my menses, I never prayed, but used to sit on the mat beside the mosque of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He used to offer the prayer on his sheet and in prostration some of his clothes used to touch me
hi: Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai: "Haiz ke dauran main kabhi namaz nahi padhti thi, magar Allah ke Rasool ki masjid ke qareeb chatai par baith jaati. Aap apni chadar par namaz padhte aur sajde mein Aap ke kuch kapde mujhse chhoo jaate."

e: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) We set out with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on one of his journeys till we reached Al- Baida' or Dhatul-Jaish, a necklace of mine was broken (and lost). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stayed there to search for it, and so did the people along with him. There was no water at that place, so the people went to Abu- Bakr As-Siddiq and said, "Don't you see what `Aisha has done? She has made Allah's Apostle and the people stay where there is no water and they have no water with them." Abu Bakr came while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was sleeping with his head on my thigh, He said, to me: "You have detained Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and the people where there is no water and they have no water with them. So he admonished me and said what Allah wished him to say and hit me on my flank with his hand. Nothing prevented me from moving (because of pain) but the position of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on my thigh. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got up when dawn broke and there was no water. So Allah revealed the Divine Verses of Tayammum. So they all performed Tayammum. Usaid bin Hudair said, "O the family of Abu Bakr! This is not the first blessing of yours." Then the camel on which I was riding was caused to move from its place and the necklace was found beneath it
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: "Hum Allah ke Rasool ke saath ek safar mein nikle yahan tak ke Al-Baida ya Zaat-ul-Jaish pahunche, mera ek haar toot kar gum ho gaya. Allah ke Rasool wahin thehr gaye use dhoondhne ke liye, aur log bhi unke saath rukk gaye. Wahan paani nahi tha, log Abu Bakr Siddiq (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas gaye aur kaha: 'Kya aap dekh rahe hain Ayesha ne kya kiya? Unhone Allah ke Rasool aur logon ko aise jagah rok diya hai jahan paani nahi hai aur unke paas paani bhi nahi.' Abu Bakr aaye jabke Allah ke Rasool mere goad mein sar rakh kar so rahe the. Unhone mujhse kaha: 'Tumne Allah ke Rasool aur logon ko rok liya hai jahan na paani hai na unke paas hai.' Unhone mujhe daanta aur jo Allah ne chaha kaha, aur mere paseeliyon par haath se maara. Mujhe hilne se sirf Allah ke Rasool ka mere goad mein sar hona rok raha tha. Subah hui aur paani nahi tha. Tab Allah ne Tayammum ki ayaat nazil farmayi. Sab logon ne Tayammum kiya. Usaid bin Hudair ne kaha: 'Aye Abu Bakr ke ghar walo! Yeh tumhari pehli barkat nahi hai.' Phir jis oont par main sawar thi, use hataya gaya to haar uske neeche mil gaya."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I have been given five things which were not given to any one else before me. -1. Allah made me victorious by awe, (by His frightening my enemies) for a distance of one month's journey. -2. The earth has been made for me (and for my followers) a place for praying and a thing to perform Tayammum, therefore anyone of my followers can pray wherever the time of a prayer is due. -3. The booty has been made Halal (lawful) for me yet it was not lawful for anyone else before me. -4. I have been given the right of intercession (on the Day of Resurrection). -5. Every Prophet used to be sent to his nation only but I have been sent to all mankind
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Mujhe paanch aisi cheezein di gayi hain jo mujhse pehle kisi ko nahi di gayin: 1. Allah ne mujhe ek mahine ki masaafat tak rob (khauf) se madad di. 2. Zameen mere (aur meri ummat ke) liye namaz ki jagah aur Tayammum ka zariya bana di gayi, isliye meri ummat ka koi bhi shaks jahan bhi namaz ka waqt aa jaye wahin padh sakta hai. 3. Mere liye maal-e-ghanimat halal kiya gaya, jo mujhse pehle kisi ke liye nahi tha. 4. Mujhe shifa'at ka haqq diya gaya. 5. Har Nabi sirf apni qaum ki taraf bheja jaata tha, magar mujhe saari insaniyat ki taraf bheja gaya hai."

e: Narrated `Urwa's father:Aisha said, "I borrowed a necklace from Asma' and it was lost. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent a man to search for it and he found it. Then the time of the prayer became due and there was no water. They prayed (without ablution) and informed Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about it, so the verse of Tayammum was revealed." Usaid bin Hudair said to `Aisha, "May Allah reward you. By Allah, whenever anything happened which you did not like, Allah brought good for you and for the Muslims in that
hi: Urwa ke waalid bataate hain ke Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha: "Maine Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) se ek haar udhar liya tha, woh gum ho gaya. Allah ke Rasool ne ek shaks ko dhoondhne bheja aur woh mil gaya. Iske baad namaz ka waqt aa gaya aur paani nahi tha. Logon ne (bina wudu) namaz padh li aur Allah ke Rasool ko bataya, tab Tayammum ki ayaat nazil hui." Usaid bin Hudair ne Ayesha se kaha: "Allah tumhe ajr de. Allah ki qasam, jab bhi tumhare saath koi aisi baat hoti hai jo tumhe napasand ho, Allah usme tumhare aur Musalmanon ke liye bhalai nikaal deta hai."

e: Narrated Abu Juhaim Al-Ansari:The Prophet (ﷺ) came from the direction of Bir Jamal. A man met him and greeted him. But he did not return back the greeting till he went to a (mud) wall and wiped his face and hands with its dust (performed Tayammum) and then returned back the greeting
hi: Abu Juhaim Al-Ansari (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Nabi (ﷺ) Bir Jamal ki taraf se aaye. Ek shaks unse mila aur salaam kiya. Aap ne salaam ka jawab nahi diya jab tak ek deewar ke paas jaakar apne chehre aur haathon par uski mitti se Tayammum na kiya, phir salaam ka jawab diya.

e: Narrated `Abdur Rahman bin Abza [??]:A man came to `Umar bin Al-Khattab and said, "I became Junub but no water was available." `Ammar bin Yasir said to `Umar, "Do you remember that you and I (became Junub while both of us) were together on a journey and you didn't pray but I rolled myself on the ground and prayed? I informed the Prophet (ﷺ) about it and he said, 'It would have been sufficient for you to do like this.' The Prophet then stroked lightly the earth with his hands and then blew off the dust and passed his hands over his face and hands
hi: Abdur Rahman bin Abza bataate hain ke ek shaks Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Khattab (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Main Junub ho gaya magar paani nahi mila." Ammar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Yasir ne Umar se kaha: "Kya aapko yaad hai, hum dono ek safar mein saath Junub hue the — aapne namaz nahi padhi magar main zameen par lot kar namaz padh li. Maine Nabi ko bataya, Aap ne farmaya: 'Itna kaafi tha.'" Phir Nabi ne halke se zameen par haath maara, phir phoonk maari aur apne chehre aur haathon par phera.

e: Narrated Sa`id bin `Abdur Rahman bin Abza:(on the authority of his father who said) `Ammar said so (the above Statement). And Shu`ba stroked lightly the earth with his hands and brought them close to his mouth (blew off the dust) and passed them over his face and then the backs of his hands. `Ammar said, "Ablution (meaning Tayammum here) is sufficient for a Muslim if water is not available
hi: Sa'id bin Abdur Rahman bin Abza bataate hain, apne waalid ke hawale se, ke Ammar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne yehi baat kahi. (Shu'ba ne bataya ke Nabi ne halke se zameen par haath maara, mun ke qareeb laakar phoonk maari, phir chehre aur haathon ki pusht par phera.) Ammar ne kaha: "Agar paani na mile to Musalman ke liye (Tayammum) kaafi hai."

e: Narrated `Abdur Rahman bin Abza:that while he was in the company of `Umar, `Ammar said to `Umar, "We were in a detachment and became Junub and I blew the dust off my hands (performed the rolling over the earth and prayed)
hi: Abdur Rahman bin Abza bataate hain ke woh Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath the, Ammar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Umar se kaha: "Hum ek toli mein the aur Junub ho gaye, maine apne haathon se dhool phoonk kar (zameen par lot kar namaz padhi)."

e: Narrated `Abdur Rahman bin Abza:`Ammar said to `Umar "I rolled myself in the dust and came to the Prophet (ﷺ) who said, 'Passing dusted hands over the face and the backs of the hands is sufficient for you
hi: Abdur Rahman bin Abza bataate hain ke Ammar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kaha: "Main dhool mein lot gaya aur Nabi ke paas aaya, Aap ne farmaya: 'Chehre aur haathon ki pusht par dhool wale haath phirana kaafi hai.'"

e: Narrated `Ammar:As above
hi: Ammar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se yehi riwayat hai (jaisa upar bayan hua).

e: Narrated `Ammar:The Prophet (ﷺ) stroked the earth with his hands and then passed them over his face and the backs of his hands (while demonstrating Tayammum)
hi: Ammar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne zameen par haath maara aur apne chehre aur haathon ki pusht par phera (Tayammum dikhate hue).

e: Narrated `Imran:Once we were traveling with the Prophet (ﷺ) and we carried on traveling till the last part of the night and then we (halted at a place) and slept (deeply). There is nothing sweeter than sleep for a traveler in the last part of the night. So it was only the heat of the sun that made us to wake up and the first to wake up was so and so, then so and so and then so and so (the narrator `Auf said that Abu Raja' had told him their names but he had forgotten them) and the fourth person to wake up was `Umar bin Al- Khattab. And whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) used to sleep, nobody would wake him up till he himself used to get up as we did not know what was happening (being revealed) to him in his sleep. So, `Umar got up and saw the condition of the people, and he was a strict man, so he said, "Allahu Akbar" and raised his voice with Takbir, and kept on saying loudly till the Prophet (ﷺ) got up because of it. When he got up, the people informed him about what had happened to them. He said, "There is no harm (or it will not be harmful). Depart!" So they departed from that place, and after covering some distance the Prophet (ﷺ) stopped and asked for some water to perform the ablution. So he performed the ablution and the call for the prayer was pronounced and he led the people in prayer. After he finished from the prayer, he saw a man sitting aloof who had not prayed with the people. He asked, "O so and so! What has prevented you from praying with us?" He replied, "I am Junub and there is no water. " The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Perform Tayammum with (clean) earth and that is sufficient for you." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) proceeded on and the people complained to him of thirst. Thereupon he got down and called a person (the narrator `Auf added that Abu Raja' had named him but he had forgotten) and `Ali, and ordered them to go and bring water. So they went in search of water and met a woman who was sitting on her camel between two bags of water. They asked, "Where can we find water?" She replied, "I was there (at the place of water) this hour yesterday and my people are behind me." They requested her to accompany them. She asked, "Where?" They said, "To Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ." She said, "Do you mean the man who is called the Sabi, (with a new religion)?" They replied, "Yes, the same person. So come along." They brought her to the Prophet (ﷺ) and narrated the whole story. He said, "Help her to dismount." The Prophet (ﷺ) asked for a pot, then he opened the mouths of the bags and poured some water into the pot. Then he closed the big openings of the bags and opened the small ones and the people were called upon to drink and water their animals. So they all watered their animals and they (too) all quenched their thirst and also gave water to others and last of all the Prophet (ﷺ) gave a pot full of water to the person who was Junub and told him to pour it over his body. The woman was standing and watching all that which they were doing with her water. By Allah, when her water bags were returned they looked like as if they were more full (of water) than they had been before (Miracle of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)) Then the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered us to collect something for her; so dates, flour and Sawiq were collected which amounted to a good meal that was put in a piece of cloth. She was helped to ride on her camel and that cloth full of foodstuff was also placed in front of her and then the Prophet (ﷺ) said to her, "We have not taken your water but Allah has given water to us." She returned home late. Her relatives asked her: "O so and so what has delayed you?" She said, "A strange thing! Two men met me and took me to the man who is called the Sabi' and he did such and such a thing. By Allah, he is either the greatest magician between this and this (gesturing with her index and middle fingers raising them towards the sky indicating the heaven and the earth) or he is Allah's true Apostle." Afterwards the Muslims used to attack the pagans around her abode but never touched her village. One day she said to her people, "I think that these people leave you purposely. Have you got any inclination to Islam?" They obeyed her and all of them embraced Islam. Abu `Abdullah said: The word Saba'a means "The one who has deserted his old religion and embraced a new religion." Abul 'Ailya [??] said, "The S`Abis are a sect of people of the Scripture who recite the Book of Psalms
hi: Imran (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Hum Nabi ke saath safar mein the, raat ke aakhri hisse tak chalte rahe, phir (rukkar) gehri neend so gaye. Musafir ke liye raat ke aakhri hisse ki neend se zyada meethi koi cheez nahi hoti. Humein sirf dhoop ki garmi ne jagaya. Sabse pehle falaan uthe, phir falaan, phir falaan (Auf ne bataya Abu Raja ne unke naam bataye the magar bhool gaye), chautha Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Khattab (رضی اللہ عنہ) uthe. Jab bhi Nabi sote, koi unhe khud jagne tak nahi jagaata kyunke humein nahi pata hota tha unke khwab mein kya wahi ho rahi hai. Umar uthe, logon ki halat dekhi, woh sakht mizaaj the, unhone 'Allahu Akbar' kaha aur buland awaaz mein Takbeer kehte rahe yahan tak ke Nabi uski wajah se jaag gaye. Jab Aap uthe, logon ne unhe bataya kya hua. Aap ne farmaya: 'Koi harj nahi. Chalo!' Woh wahan se chal diye, kuch doori tay karne ke baad Nabi ruk gaye aur wudu ke liye paani mangwaya. Wudu kiya, Iqamat hui aur Aap ne namaz ki imamat ki. Namaz khatam hone ke baad, Aap ne ek shaks ko alag baitha dekha jisne jamaat ke saath namaz nahi padhi thi. Aap ne pucha: 'Aye falaan! Kya cheez ne tumhe humare saath namaz padhne se roka?' Usne jawab diya: 'Main Junub hoon aur paani nahi hai.' Nabi ne farmaya: 'Saaf mitti se Tayammum karo, yeh tumhare liye kaafi hai.' Phir Nabi aage badhe, logon ne pyaas ki shikayat ki. Aap utre aur ek shaks (jiska naam Auf ne bataya tha magar bhool gaya) aur Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko bulakar paani laane ka hukum diya. Woh paani dhoondhne gaye aur ek aurat mili jo do mashkeeza paani ke darmiyan apne oont par baithi thi. Unhone pucha: 'Paani kahan milega?' Usne jawab diya: 'Main kal is waqt wahan thi, mere log mere peechhe hain.' Unhone use unke saath chalne ko kaha. Usne pucha: 'Kahan?' Unhone kaha: 'Allah ke Rasool ke paas.' Usne pucha: 'Kya woh jisko Sabi (naye deen wala) kehte hain?' Unhone kaha: 'Haan, wahi. Chalo.' Woh use Nabi ke paas laaye aur poora waqia bataya. Aap ne farmaya: 'Use utarne mein madad karo.' Nabi ne ek bartan mangwaya, mashkeezon ke mun khole aur usme thoda paani daala. Phir bade mun band karke chhote khol diye aur logon ko peene aur apne janwaron ko pilaane ko bulaya gaya. Sab logon ne apne janwar pilaaye, khud bhi pyaas bujhai aur doosron ko bhi diya, aur aakhir mein Nabi ne us Junub shaks ko ek bartan bhar paani dekar apne badan par dalne ko kaha. Aurat khadi dekh rahi thi jo uske paani se ho raha tha. Allah ki qasam, jab uske mashkeeze wapas kiye gaye, woh pehle se zyada bhare lag rahe the (Allah ke Rasool ka mojza). Phir Nabi ne humein uske liye kuch jama karne ka hukum diya; khajoor, aata aur saweeq jama hua jo ek achha khana ban gaya, ek kapde mein rakha gaya. Use oont par sawar hone mein madad ki gayi aur khane se bhara kapda uske saamne rakha gaya, phir Nabi ne usse kaha: 'Humne tumhara paani nahi liya, balki Allah ne humein paani diya hai.' Woh der se ghar pahunchi. Uske rishtedaaron ne pucha: 'Aye falaan, itni der kyun lagi?' Usne kaha: 'Ajeeb baat hui! Do aadmi mile aur mujhe us shaks ke paas le gaye jise Sabi kehte hain, usne aisa-aisa kiya. Allah ki qasam, woh ya to is aasman-zameen ke darmiyan sabse bada jaadugar hai ya Allah ka sachcha Rasool hai.' Iske baad Musalman uske ilaaqe ke aas-paas ke mushrikon par hamla karte magar uske gaon ko chhu nahi karte. Ek din usne apni qaum se kaha: 'Mujhe lagta hai ye log jaan-boojh kar tumhe chhod rahe hain. Kya tumhe Islam ki taraf koi rujhaan hai?' Unhone uski baat maani aur sab Islam le aaye." Abu Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) kehte hain: "Saba'a" ka matlab hai woh shaks jo apna purana deen chhod kar naya deen apna le.

e: Narrated Abu Wail:Abu Musa said to `Abdullah bin Mas`ud, "If one does not find water (for ablution) can he give up the prayer?" `Abdullah replied, "If you give the permission to perform Tayammum they will perform Tayammum even if water was available if one of them found it cold." Abu Musa said, "What about the statement of `Ammar to `Umar?" `Abdullah replied, "`Umar was not satisfied by his statement
hi: Abu Wail bataate hain ke Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha: "Agar (wudu ke liye) paani na mile to kya namaz chhod sakte hain?" Abdullah ne jawab diya: "Agar tum Tayammum ki ijazat de doge to log paani hone par bhi Tayammum karenge, sirf isliye ke unhe woh thanda lage." Abu Musa ne pucha: "Ammar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kahi baat ka kya?" Abdullah ne jawab diya: "Umar us baat se santusht nahi hue the."

e: Narrated Shaqiq bin Salama:I was with `Abdullah and Abu Musa; the latter asked the former, "O Abu `Abdur-Rahman! What is your opinion if somebody becomes Junub and no water is available?" `Abdullah replied, "Do not pray till water is found." Abu Musa said, "What do you say about the statement of `Ammar (who was ordered by the Prophet (ﷺ) to perform Tayammum). The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him: "Perform Tayammum and that would be sufficient." `Abdullah replied, "Don't you see that `Umar was not satisfied by `Ammar's statement?" Abu- Musa said, "All right, leave `Ammar's statement, but what will you say about this verse (of Tayammum)?" `Abdullah kept quiet and then said, "If we allowed it, then they would probably perform Tayammum even if water was available, if one of them found it (water) cold." The narrator added, "I said to Shaqiq, "Then did `Abdullah dislike to perform Tayammum because of this?" He replied, "Yes
hi: Shaqiq bin Salama bataate hain: "Main Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath tha, Abu Musa ne Abdullah se pucha: 'Aye Abu Abdur-Rahman! Aapki kya raay hai agar koi Junub ho jaye aur paani na mile?' Abdullah ne jawab diya: 'Paani milne tak namaz na padho.' Abu Musa ne pucha: 'Ammar ki us baat ka kya jinme Nabi ne unhe Tayammum karne ka hukum diya tha aur farmaya: Yeh kaafi hoga?' Abdullah ne jawab diya: 'Kya tumhe nahi pata ke Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) Ammar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki baat se santusht nahi hue the?' Abu Musa ne kaha: 'Theek hai, Ammar ki baat chhodo, magar is ayat (Tayammum ki) ke baare mein kya kahoge?' Abdullah khamosh rahe, phir kaha: 'Agar humne ijazat di, to log paani hone par bhi Tayammum karenge agar unhe thanda lage.'" Rawi ne kaha: "Maine Shaqiq se pucha: 'To kya Abdullah isi wajah se Tayammum ko napasand karte the?' Unhone kaha: 'Haan.'"

e: Narrated Al-A`mash:Shaqiq said, "While I was sitting with `Abdullah and Abu Musa Al-Ash`ari, the latter asked the former, 'If a person becomes Junub and does not find water for one month, can he perform Tayammum and offer his prayer?' (He replied in the negative). Abu Musa said, 'What do you say about this verse from Sura "Al-Ma'ida": When you do not find water then perform Tayammum with clean earth? `Abdullah replied, 'If we allowed it then they would probably perform Tayammum with clean earth even if water were available but cold.' I said to Shaqiq, 'You then disliked to perform Tayammum because of this?' Shaqiq said, 'Yes.' (Shaqiq added), "Abu Musa said, 'Haven't you heard the statement of `Ammar to `Umar? He said: I was sent out by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for some job and I became Junub and could not find water so I rolled myself over the dust (clean earth) like an animal does, and when I told the Prophet (ﷺ) of that he said, 'Like this would have been sufficient.' The Prophet (ﷺ) (saying so) lightly stroked the earth with his hand once and blew it off, then passed his (left) hand over the back of his right hand or his (right) hand over the back of his left hand and then passed them over his face.' So `Abdullah said to Abu- Musa, 'Don't you know that `Umar was not satisfied with `Ammar's statement?' " Narrated Shaqiq: While I was with `Abdullah and Abu Musa, the latter said to the former, "Haven't you heard the statement of `Ammar to `Umar? He said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent you and me out and I became Junub and rolled myself in the dust (clean earth) (for Tayammum). When we came to Allah's Apostle I told him about it and he said, 'This would have been sufficient,' passing his hands over his face and the backs of his hands once only
hi: Al-A'mash bataate hain ke Shaqiq ne kaha: "Main Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ash'ari ke saath baitha tha, Abu Musa ne Abdullah se pucha: 'Agar koi Junub ho jaye aur ek mahine tak paani na mile, kya woh Tayammum karke namaz padh sakta hai?' (Unhone na mein jawab diya). Abu Musa ne kaha: 'Surah Al-Ma'ida ki is ayat ke baare mein kya kahoge: Jab paani na mile to saaf mitti se Tayammum karo?' Abdullah ne jawab diya: 'Agar humne ijazat di, to log paani hone par bhi mitti se Tayammum karenge agar unhe thanda lage.'" Rawi ne kaha: "Maine Shaqiq se pucha: 'To aap isi wajah se Tayammum ko napasand karte the?' Unhone kaha: 'Haan.'" (Shaqiq ne joda:) "Abu Musa ne kaha: 'Kya tumne Ammar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kahi baat nahi suni? Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool ne mujhe kisi kaam ke liye bheja, main Junub ho gaya aur paani na mila, to main janwar ki tarah dhool mein lot gaya, jab Nabi ko bataya to Aap ne farmaya: Itna hi kaafi tha. Nabi ne zameen par ek baar halke se haath maara, phoonk maari, phir (baaye) haath ko (dahine) haath ki pusht par ya (dahine) ko (baaye) ki pusht par phera, phir chehre par phera.'" Abdullah ne Abu Musa se kaha: "Kya tumhe nahi pata ke Umar Ammar ki baat se santusht nahi hue the?" Shaqiq bataate hain: "Main Abdullah aur Abu Musa ke saath tha, Abu Musa ne Abdullah se kaha: 'Kya tumne Ammar ki Umar se kahi baat nahi suni? Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool ne humein bheja, main Junub ho gaya aur dhool mein lot gaya. Jab hum Allah ke Rasool ke paas aaye maine unhe bataya, Aap ne farmaya: Itna hi kaafi tha, aur apne haath ek hi baar chehre aur haathon ki pusht par phere.'"

e: Narrated `Imran bin Husain Al-Khuza`i:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw a person sitting aloof and not praying with the people. He asked him, "O so and so! What prevented you from offering the prayer with the people?" He replied, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I am Junub and there is no water." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Perform Tayammum with clean earth and that will be sufficient for you
hi: Imran bin Husain (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Khuza'i (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Allah ke Rasool ne ek shaks ko alag baitha dekha jo logon ke saath namaz nahi padh raha tha. Aap ne pucha: "Aye falaan! Kya cheez ne tumhe logon ke saath namaz padhne se roka?" Usne kaha: "Ya Rasoolallah, main Junub hoon aur paani nahi hai." Nabi ne farmaya: "Saaf mitti se Tayammum karo, yeh tumhare liye kaafi hai."

e: Narrated Abu Dhar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "While I was at Mecca the roof of my house was opened and Gabriel descended, opened my chest, and washed it with Zamzam water. Then he brought a golden tray full of wisdom and faith and having poured its contents into my chest, he closed it. Then he took my hand and ascended with me to the nearest heaven, when I reached the nearest heaven, Gabriel said to the gatekeeper of the heaven, 'Open (the gate).' The gatekeeper asked, 'Who is it?' Gabriel answered: 'Gabriel.' He asked, 'Is there anyone with you?' Gabriel replied, 'Yes, Muhammad I is with me.' He asked, 'Has he been called?' Gabriel said, 'Yes.' So the gate was opened and we went over the nearest heaven and there we saw a man sitting with some people on his right and some on his left. When he looked towards his right, he laughed and when he looked toward his left he wept. Then he said, 'Welcome! O pious Prophet and pious son.' I asked Gabriel, 'Who is he?' He replied, 'He is Adam and the people on his right and left are the souls of his offspring. Those on his right are the people of Paradise and those on his left are the people of Hell and when he looks towards his right he laughs and when he looks towards his left he weeps.' Then he ascended with me till he reached the second heaven and he (Gabriel) said to its gatekeeper, 'Open (the gate).' The gatekeeper said to him the same as the gatekeeper of the first heaven had said and he opened the gate. Anas said: "Abu Dhar added that the Prophet (ﷺ) met Adam, Idris, Moses, Jesus and Abraham, he (Abu Dhar) did not mention on which heaven they were but he mentioned that he (the Prophet (ﷺ) ) met Adam on the nearest heaven and Abraham on the sixth heaven. Anas said, "When Gabriel along with the Prophet (ﷺ) passed by Idris, the latter said, 'Welcome! O pious Prophet and pious brother.' The Prophet (ﷺ) asked, 'Who is he?' Gabriel replied, 'He is Idris." The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "I passed by Moses and he said, 'Welcome! O pious Prophet and pious brother.' I asked Gabriel, 'Who is he?' Gabriel replied, 'He is Moses.' Then I passed by Jesus and he said, 'Welcome! O pious brother and pious Prophet.' I asked, 'Who is he?' Gabriel replied, 'He is Jesus. Then I passed by Abraham and he said, 'Welcome! O pious Prophet and pious son.' I asked Gabriel, 'Who is he?' Gabriel replied, 'He is Abraham. The Prophet (ﷺ) added, 'Then Gabriel ascended with me to a place where I heard the creaking of the pens." Ibn Hazm and Anas bin Malik said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Then Allah enjoined fifty prayers on my followers when I returned with this order of Allah, I passed by Moses who asked me, 'What has Allah enjoined on your followers?' I replied, 'He has enjoined fifty prayers on them.' Moses said, 'Go back to your Lord (and appeal for reduction) for your followers will not be able to bear it.' (So I went back to Allah and requested for reduction) and He reduced it to half. When I passed by Moses again and informed him about it, he said, 'Go back to your Lord as your followers will not be able to bear it.' So I returned to Allah and requested for further reduction and half of it was reduced. I again passed by Moses and he said to me: 'Return to your Lord, for your followers will not be able to bear it. So I returned to Allah and He said, 'These are five prayers and they are all (equal to) fifty (in reward) for My Word does not change.' I returned to Moses and he told me to go back once again. I replied, 'Now I feel shy of asking my Lord again.' Then Gabriel took me till we reached Sidrat-il-Muntaha (Lote tree of; the utmost boundary) which was shrouded in colors, indescribable. Then I was admitted into Paradise where I found small (tents or) walls (made) of pearls and its earth was of musk
hi: Abu Dharr (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Jab main Mecca mein tha, mere ghar ki chhat khol di gayi aur Jibreel utre, mera seena chaak kiya aur Zamzam ke paani se dhoya. Phir sone ki ek thaali laaye jo hikmat aur iman se bhari thi, uska maal mere seene mein dala aur band kar diya. Phir mera haath pakad kar mujhe qareebi aasman tak le gaye. Jab hum wahan pahunche, Jibreel ne darwaze ke muhafiz se kaha: 'Khol do.' Usne pucha: 'Kaun hai?' Jibreel ne kaha: 'Jibreel.' Usne pucha: 'Aapke saath koi hai?' Jibreel ne kaha: 'Haan, Muhammad mere saath hain.' Usne pucha: 'Kya unhe bulaya gaya hai?' Jibreel ne kaha: 'Haan.' Darwaza khula aur hum qareebi aasman par gaye, wahan ek shaks ko dekha jinke dahine-baaye kuch log baithe the. Jab woh dahine dekhte, hasste; jab baaye dekhte, rote. Unhone kaha: 'Khush-aamdeed, nek Nabi aur nek bete!' Maine Jibreel se pucha: 'Yeh kaun hain?' Unhone bataya: 'Yeh Adam hain, unke dahine-baaye unki aulad ki roohein hain. Dahine wale Jannati hain, baaye wale Jahannami — isi liye woh dahine dekhkar hasste aur baaye dekhkar rote hain.' Phir hum doosre aasman tak gaye, Jibreel ne wahan bhi yehi kaha, aur darwaza khul gaya." Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne bataya ke Abu Dharr ne joda ke Nabi ne Adam, Idris, Musa, Isa aur Ibrahim (علیہم السلام) se mulaqat ki, magar yeh nahi bataya kis aasman par kaun the, siwaye Adam (pehle aasman par) aur Ibrahim (chhathe aasman par). Anas ne bataya ke jab Jibreel Nabi ke saath Idris ke paas se guzre, unhone kaha: "Khush-aamdeed, nek Nabi aur nek bhai!" Nabi ne pucha: "Yeh kaun hain?" Jibreel ne bataya: "Yeh Idris hain." Nabi ne farmaya: "Phir main Musa ke paas se guzra, unhone kaha: 'Khush-aamdeed, nek Nabi aur nek bhai!' Maine Jibreel se pucha: 'Yeh kaun hain?' Bataya: 'Yeh Musa hain.' Phir Isa ke paas se guzra, unhone kaha: 'Khush-aamdeed, nek bhai aur nek Nabi!' Maine pucha: 'Yeh kaun hain?' Bataya: 'Yeh Isa hain.' Phir Ibrahim ke paas se guzra, unhone kaha: 'Khush-aamdeed, nek Nabi aur nek bete!' Maine Jibreel se pucha: 'Yeh kaun hain?' Bataya: 'Yeh Ibrahim hain.'" Nabi ne farmaya: "Phir Jibreel mujhe uss jagah le gaye jahan qalamon ki cheen-cheen ki awaaz sunayi di." Ibn Hazm aur Anas bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne bataya ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Phir Allah ne meri ummat par pachaas namazein farz kin. Jab main yeh hukum lekar wapas laut raha tha, Musa ke paas se guzra, unhone pucha: 'Allah ne tumhari ummat par kya farz kiya?' Maine kaha: 'Pachaas namazein.' Musa ne kaha: 'Apne Rab ke paas wapas jao, tumhari ummat itni taaqat nahi rakhti.' (Main wapas gaya aur kami ki darkhwast ki) aur aadhi kar di gayi. Jab main dobara Musa ke paas se guzra aur bataya, unhone kaha: 'Apne Rab ke paas wapas jao, tumhari ummat itni bhi taaqat nahi rakhti.'
