Main wapas gaya aur phir kami ki darkhwast ki, aadhi aur kam ho gayi. Main phir Musa ke paas se guzra, unhone kaha: 'Apne Rab ke paas wapas jao, tumhari ummat itni bhi taaqat nahi rakhti.' Main wapas gaya, Allah ne farmaya: 'Yeh paanch namazein hain, magar ajr pachaas ke barabar hai, kyunke mera farmaan badalta nahi.' Main Musa ke paas wapas aaya, unhone kaha phir jao. Maine kaha: 'Ab mujhe apne Rab se dobara maangne mein sharm aati hai.' Phir Jibreel mujhe Sidrat-ul-Muntaha tak le gaye jo alag-alag rangon mein lipti hui thi jinka bayan mumkin nahi. Phir mujhe Jannat mein daakhil kiya gaya, wahan moti ke chhote khaimay the aur uski mitti kasturi thi."

e: Narrated `Aisha:the mother of believers: Allah enjoined the prayer and when He enjoined it, it was two rak`at only (in every prayer) both when in residence or on journey. Then the prayers offered on journey remained the same, but (the rak`at of) the prayers for non-travelers were increased
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai: "Namaz farz ki gayi to shuru mein har namaz do-do rakat thi, chahe safar mein ho ya ghar mein. Phir safar ki namazein wahi rahin, magar ghar ki namazon ki rakatein badha di gayin."

e: Narrated Um `Atiya:We were ordered to bring out our menstruating women and veiled women in the religious gatherings and invocation of Muslims on the two `Id festivals. These menstruating women were to keep away from their Musalla. A woman asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ' What about one who does not have a veil?" He said, "Let her share the veil of her companion
hi: Um Atiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai: "Humein hukum diya gaya tha ke dono Eid ke deeni ijtimaon aur dua mein haiz wali aurton aur parda-nasheen aurton ko bhi laayen, magar haiz wali apni Musalla se door rahein." Ek aurat ne pucha: "Ya Rasoolallah, jiske paas parda na ho uska kya?" Farmaya: "Woh apni sathi ka parda le le."

e: Narrated Muhammad bin Al-Munkadir:Once Jabir prayed with his Izar tied to his back while his clothes were Lying beside him on a wooden peg. Somebody asked him, "Do you offer your prayer in a single Izar?" He replied, "I did so to show it to a fool like you. Had anyone of us two garments in the lifetime of the Prophet?
hi: Muhammad bin Al-Munkadir bataate hain ke Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne apna Izar peeth ke peechhe baandh kar namaz padhi jabke unke kapde ek khunti par latak rahe the. Kisi ne pucha: "Kya aap sirf ek Izar mein namaz padhte hain?" Unhone jawab diya: "Maine yeh isliye kiya taake tumhare jaise ko dikha sakoon. Kya Nabi ke zamane mein hum mein se kisi ke paas do kapde hote the?"

e: Narrated Muhammad bin Al Munkadir:I saw Jabir bin `Abdullah praying in a single garment and he said that he had seen the Prophet (ﷺ) praying in a single garment
hi: Muhammad bin Al-Munkadir bataate hain ke maine Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko ek kapde mein namaz padhte dekha, unhone kaha ke unhone Nabi ko bhi ek kapde mein namaz padhte dekha tha.

e: Narrated `Umar bin Abi Salama:The Prophet (ﷺ) prayed in one garment and crossed its ends
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Salama bataate hain ke Nabi ne ek kapde mein namaz padhi aur uske dono sire (shoulders par) crossed kiye.

e: Narrated `Umar bin Abi Salama:I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) offering prayers in a single garment in the house of Um-Salama and he had crossed its ends around his shoulders
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Salama bataate hain ke maine Nabi ko Um Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke ghar mein ek kapde mein namaz padhte dekha, uske sire shoulders par crossed kiye hue.

e: Narrated `Umar bin Abi Salama:In the house of Um-Salama I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) offering prayers, wrapped in a single garment around his body with its ends crossed round his shoulders
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Salama bataate hain ke Um Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke ghar mein maine Allah ke Rasool ko ek kapde mein poore badan par lapet kar, uske sire shoulders par crossed karke, namaz padhte dekha.

e: Narrated Abu Murra:(the freed slave of Um Hani) Um Hani, the daughter of Abi Talib said, "I went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the year of the conquest of Mecca and found him taking a bath and his daughter Fatima was screening him. I greeted him. He asked, 'Who is she?' I replied, 'I am Um Hani bint Abi Talib.' He said, 'Welcome! O Um Hani.' When he finished his bath he stood up and prayed eight rak`at while wearing a single garment wrapped round his body and when he finished I said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ! My brother has told me that he will kill a person whom I gave shelter and that person is so and so the son of Hubaira.' The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'We shelter the person whom you have sheltered.' " Um Hani added, "And that was before noon (Duha)
hi: Abu Murra bataate hain (Um Hani ke azaad kiye gulaam), Um Hani bint Abi Talib ne kaha: "Main Fatah-e-Mecca ke saal Allah ke Rasool ke paas gayi aur unhe ghusl karte paaya jabke unki beti Fatima (Alayhas Salam) parda kar rahi thi. Maine salaam kiya. Aap ne pucha: 'Yeh kaun hai?' Maine kaha: 'Main Um Hani bint Abi Talib hoon.' Farmaya: 'Khush-aamdeed, Aye Um Hani.' Ghusl khatam karke Aap khade hue aur ek kapde mein lipat kar aath rakat namaz padhi. Iske baad maine kaha: 'Ya Rasoolallah! Mere bhai ne kaha hai ke woh us shaks ko qatl karenge jise maine panah di hai, aur woh shaks falaan bin Hubaira ka beta hai.' Nabi ne farmaya: 'Jise tumne panah di, humne bhi panah di.'" Um Hani ne joda: "Yeh Duha (dopahar se pehle) ka waqt tha."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:A person asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about the offering of the prayer in a single garment. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, "Has every one of you got two garments?
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke ek shaks ne Allah ke Rasool se ek kapde mein namaz ke baare mein pucha. Allah ke Rasool ne jawab diya: "Kya tum sabke paas do kapde hain?"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "None of you should offer prayer in a single garment that does not cover the shoulders
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Koi bhi ek aise kapde mein namaz na padhe jo shoulders na dhake."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever prays in a single garment must cross its ends (over the shoulders)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jo ek kapde mein namaz padhe, uske sire (shoulders par) crossed kare."

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Al-Harith:I asked Jabir bin `Abdullah about praying in a single garment. He said, "I traveled with the Prophet (ﷺ) during some of his journeys, and I came to him at night for some purpose and I found him praying. At that time, I was wearing a single garment with which I covered my shoulders and prayed by his side. When he finished the prayer, he asked, 'O Jabir! What has brought you here?' I told him what I wanted. When I finished, he asked, 'O Jabir! What is this garment which I have seen and with which you covered your shoulders?' I replied, 'It is a (tight) garment.' He said, 'If the garment is large enough, wrap it round the body (covering the shoulders) and if it is tight (too short) then use it as an Izar (tie it around your waist only)
hi: Sa'id bin Al-Harith bataate hain ke maine Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) se ek kapde mein namaz padhne ke baare mein pucha. Unhone kaha: "Main Nabi ke saath ek safar mein tha, main raat ko kisi zaroorat se unke paas aaya aur unhe namaz padhte paaya. Us waqt main ek kapda pehne tha jisse maine shoulders dhak liye the aur unke saath namaz padhi. Jab Aap ne namaz khatam ki, pucha: 'Aye Jabir, tumhe kya lekar aaya?' Maine bataya kya chahta tha. Jab main faarigh hua, Aap ne pucha: 'Aye Jabir, yeh kapda kaisa hai jo maine dekha jisse tumne shoulders dhak liye?' Maine kaha: 'Yeh tang kapda hai.' Aap ne farmaya: 'Agar kapda kaafi bada ho to poore badan par lapeto (shoulders sameit), agar tang (chhota) ho to Izar ki tarah kamar par baandho.'"

e: Narrated Sahl:The men used to pray with the Prophet (ﷺ) with their Izars tied around their necks as boys used to do; therefore the Prophet (ﷺ) told the women not to raise their heads till the men sat down straight (while praying)
hi: Sahl (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke mard Nabi ke saath apne Izar gardan se baandh kar namaz padhte the jaise bachche karte hain, isliye Nabi ne aurton ko kaha ke woh sar na uthayen jab tak mard seedhe baith na jayen.

e: Narrated Mughira bin Shu`ba:Once I was traveling with the Prophet (ﷺ) and he said, "O Mughira! take this container of water." I took it and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went far away till he disappeared. He answered the call of nature and was wearing a Syrian cloak. He tried to take out his hands from its sleeve but it was very tight so he took out his hands from under it. I poured water and he performed ablution like that for prayers and passed his wet hands over his Khuff (socks made from thick fabric or leather) and then prayed
hi: Mughira bin Shu'ba (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke main ek safar mein Nabi ke saath tha, Aap ne farmaya: "Aye Mughira! Yeh paani ka bartan lo." Maine liya, Allah ke Rasool door tak gaye yahan tak ke ghayab ho gaye. Aap ne qaza-e-hajat ki, aur Shami libaas pehna tha. Aap apni aasteen se haath nikalne ki koshish ki magar woh tang thi, to haath neeche se nikale. Maine paani daala aur Aap ne namaz jaisa wudu kiya aur apne Khuffon par haath phera, phir namaz padhi.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:While Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was carrying stones (along) with the people of Mecca for (the building of) the Ka`ba wearing an Izar (waist-sheet cover), his uncle Al-`Abbas said to him, "O my nephew! (It would be better) if you take off your Izar and put it over your shoulders underneath the stones." So he took off his Izar and put it over his shoulders, but he fell unconscious and since then he had never been seen naked
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke jab Allah ke Rasool Mecca walon ke saath Ka'ba (ki tameer) ke liye patthar utha rahe the, Izar pehne huye, unke chacha Al-Abbas ne kaha: "Aye mere bhatije! (Behtar hoga) agar tum apna Izar utaar kar patthron ke neeche apne shoulders par rakh lo." Aap ne Izar utaar kar shoulders par rakh liya, magar behosh ho gaye, aur uske baad kabhi nange nahi dekhe gaye.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:A man stood up and asked the Prophet (ﷺ) about praying in a single garment. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Has every one of you two garments?" A man put a similar question to `Umar on which he replied, "When Allah makes you wealthier then you should clothe yourself properly during prayers. Otherwise one can pray with an Izar and a Rida' (a sheet covering the upper part of the body.) Izar and a shirt, Izar and a Qaba', trousers and a Rida, trousers and a shirt or trousers and a Qaba', Tubban and a Qaba' or Tubban and a shirt." (The narrator added, "I think that he also said a Tubban and a Rida)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke ek shaks khada hokar Nabi se ek kapde mein namaz ke baare mein pucha. Nabi ne farmaya: "Kya tum sabke paas do kapde hain?" Ek shaks ne Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se bhi yehi sawaal kiya, unhone jawab diya: "Jab Allah tumhe maldaar kare, namaz mein achhi tarah kapde pehno. Warna Izar aur Rida (upar ka kapda), Izar aur qamees, Izar aur Qaba, pajama aur Rida, pajama aur qamees, ya pajama aur Qaba, Tubban aur Qaba, ya Tubban aur qamees (mein padho)." (Rawi ko lagta hai Umar ne "Tubban aur Rida" bhi kaha.)

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:A person asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), "What should a Muhrim wear?" He replied, "He should not wear shirts, trousers, a burnus (a hooded cloak), or clothes which are stained with saffron or Wars (a kind of perfume). Whoever does not find a sandal to wear can wear Khuffs (socks made from thick fabric or leather), but these should be cut short so as not to cover the ankles
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke ek shaks ne Allah ke Rasool se pucha: "Muhrim kya pehne?" Farmaya: "Woh qamees, pajama, hooded chogha (burnus), ya zafraan/wars se rangi cheez na pehne. Agar juti na mile to Khuff pehen sakta hai, magar takhno se neeche kaat de."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade Ishtimal-As-Samma' (wrapping one's body with a garment so that one cannot raise its end or take one's hand out of it). He also forbade Al-Ihtiba' (sitting on buttocks with knees close to `Abdomen and feet apart with the hands circling the knees) while wrapping oneself with a single garment, without having a part of it over the private parts
hi: Abu Saeed Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne Ishtimal-As-Samma (ek hi kapde mein poora lapetna jisse haath na nikaal sako) se mana kiya. Aap ne Al-Ihtiba (ghutne moad kar baithna, kapde ke bina sharmgaah dhake) se bhi mana kiya.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade two kinds of sales i.e. Al-Limais and An-Nibadh (the former is a kind of sale in which the deal is completed if the buyer touches a thing, without seeing or checking it properly and the latter is a kind of a sale in which the deal is completed when the seller throws a thing towards the buyer giving him no opportunity to see, touch or check it) and (the Prophet (ﷺ) forbade) also Ishtimal-As-Samma' and Al-Ihtiba' in a single garment
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne do tarah ki bikri se mana kiya — Al-Limais aur An-Nibadh (bina dekhe chhookar ya phenk kar sauda pakka karna), aur Ishtimal-As-Samma aur Al-Ihtiba ek hi kapde mein bhi mana kiya.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:On the Day of Nahr (10th of Dhul-Hijja, in the year prior to the last Hajj of the Prophet (ﷺ) when Abu Bakr was the leader of the pilgrims in that Hajj) Abu Bakr sent me along with other announcers to Mina to make a public announcement: "No pagan is allowed to perform Hajj after this year and no naked person is allowed to perform the Tawaf around the Ka`ba. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent `Ali to read out the Surat Bara'a (at-Tauba) to the people; so he made the announcement along with us on the day of Nahr in Mina: "No pagan is allowed to perform Hajj after this year and no naked person is allowed to perform the Tawaf around the Ka`ba
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Yaum-un-Nahr (10 Zul-Hijja) ko Abu Bakr ne mujhe doosre elaan karne walon ke saath Mina bheja yeh elaan karne: "Is saal ke baad koi mushrik Hajj nahi kar sakta, aur koi nanga shaks Ka'ba ka Tawaf nahi kar sakta." Phir Allah ke Rasool ne Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko Surah Bara'a (At-Tauba) padhne bheja; unhone Yaum-un-Nahr ko Mina mein humare saath yehi elaan kiya.

e: Narrated Muhammad bin Al-Munkadir:I went to Jabir bin `Abdullah and he was praying wrapped in a garment and his Rida was Lying beside him. When he finished the prayers, I said "O `Abdullah! You pray (in a single garment) while your Rida' is lying beside you." He replied, "Yes, I did it intentionally so that the ignorant ones like you might see me. I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) praying like this
hi: Muhammad bin Al-Munkadir bataate hain ke main Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas gaya, woh ek kapde mein lipat kar namaz padh rahe the jabke unka Rida bagal mein pada tha. Namaz khatam hone par maine kaha: "Aye Abdullah! Aap ek kapde mein namaz padhte hain jabke Rida bagal mein hai." Unhone jawab diya: "Haan, maine jaan-boojh kar kiya taake tumhare jaise nadaan mujhe (aise) dekh sakein. Maine Nabi ko isi tarah namaz padhte dekha."

e: Narrated `Abdul `Aziz:Anas said, 'When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) invaded Khaibar, we offered the Fajr prayer there (early in the morning) when it was still dark. The Prophet (ﷺ) rode and Abu Talha rode too and I was riding behind Abu Talha. The Prophet (ﷺ) passed through the lane of Khaibar quickly and my knee was touching the thigh of the Prophet (ﷺ) . He uncovered his thigh and I saw the whiteness of the thigh of the Prophet. When he entered the town, he said, 'Allahu Akbar! Khaibar is ruined. Whenever we approach near a (hostile) nation (to fight) then evil will be the morning of those who have been warned.' He repeated this thrice. The people came out for their jobs and some of them said, 'Muhammad (has come).' (Some of our companions added, "With his army.") We conquered Khaibar, took the captives, and the booty was collected. Dihya came and said, 'O Allah's Prophet! Give me a slave girl from the captives.' The Prophet said, 'Go and take any slave girl.' He took Safiya bint Huyai. A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! You gave Safiya bint Huyai to Dihya and she is the chief mistress of the tribes of Quraidha and An-Nadir and she befits none but you.' So the Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Bring him along with her.' So Dihya came with her and when the Prophet (ﷺ) saw her, he said to Dihya, 'Take any slave girl other than her from the captives.' Anas added: The Prophet (ﷺ) then manumitted her and married her." Thabit asked Anas, "O Abu Hamza! What did the Prophet (ﷺ) pay her (as Mahr)?" He said, "Her self was her Mahr for he manumitted her and then married her." Anas added, "While on the way, Um Sulaim dressed her for marriage (ceremony) and at night she sent her as a bride to the Prophet (ﷺ) . So the Prophet was a bridegroom and he said, 'Whoever has anything (food) should bring it.' He spread out a leather sheet (for the food) and some brought dates and others cooking butter. (I think he (Anas) mentioned As-Sawaq). So they prepared a dish of Hais (a kind of meal). And that was Walima (the marriage banquet) of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
hi: Abdul Aziz bataate hain ke Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Jab Allah ke Rasool ne Khaibar par hamla kiya, humne wahan andhere mein Fajr padhi. Nabi sawar hue, Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) bhi sawar hue, main Abu Talha ke peechhe tha. Nabi jaldi se Khaibar ki gali se guzre, meri ghutni Nabi ki jaang se chhoo rahi thi. Aap ne apni jaang se kapda hataya, maine unki jaang ki safedi dekhi. Jab Aap shehar mein daakhil hue, farmaya: 'Allahu Akbar! Khaibar barbaad ho gaya. Jab hum kisi (dushman) qaum ke qareeb jaate hain to jinhe khabardar kiya gaya unki subah buri hoti hai.' Aap ne yeh teen baar dohraya. Log apne kaam ke liye nikal aaye, kuch ne kaha 'Muhammad (aa gaye)' (kuch sathiyon ne joda 'apni fauj ke saath'). Humne Khaibar fatah kiya, qaidi pakde, maal-e-ghanimat jama hua. Dihya aaye aur kaha: 'Aye Allah ke Nabi! Mujhe qaidiyon mein se ek launDi dedo.' Nabi ne farmaya: 'Jaao, koi bhi launDi le lo.' Unhone Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Huyai ko liya. Ek shaks Nabi ke paas aaya aur kaha: 'Ya Rasoolallah, aapne Safiya bint Huyai Dihya ko de di, woh Quraiza aur Nadir qabilon ki sardaraani hai, sirf aapke laayak hai.' Nabi ne farmaya: 'Use uske saath laao.' Dihya use lekar aaye, aur jab Nabi ne use dekha, Dihya se kaha: 'Qaidiyon mein se koi aur launDi le lo.' Anas ne joda: Nabi ne use azaad karke shaadi kar li." Thabit ne Anas se pucha: "Aye Abu Hamza! Nabi ne uska Mahr kya diya?" Unhone kaha: "Uski aazadi hi uska Mahr thi, kyunke Aap ne use azaad karke shaadi ki." Anas ne joda: "Raaste mein Um Sulaim ne use dulhan ki tarah sajaya aur raat ko Nabi ke paas dulhan ban kar bheja. Nabi dulha the aur farmaya: 'Jiske paas kuch (khana) ho, laaye.' Aap ne chamde ki chatai bichhai, kuch log khajoor laaye, kuch ghee (aur shayad Sawaq bhi). Unhone Hais (ek qisam ka khana) taiyaar kiya. Yehi Allah ke Rasool ka Walima tha."

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to offer the Fajr prayer and some believing women covered with their veiling sheets used to attend the Fajr prayer with him and then they would return to their homes unrecognized
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool Fajr ki namaz padhte the aur kuch momin aurtein chadar odh kar unke saath Fajr mein shareek hoti, phir bina pehchane apne gharon wapas chali jaati.

e: Narrated `Aisha:the Prophet (ﷺ) prayed in a Khamisa (a square garment) having marks. During the prayer, he looked at its marks. So when he finished the prayer he said, "Take this Khamisa of mine to Abu Jahm and get me his Inbijaniya (a woolen garment without marks) as it (the Khamisa) has diverted my attention from the prayer." Narrated `Aisha: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'I was looking at its (Khamisa's) marks during the prayers and I was afraid that it may put me in trial (by taking away my attention)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne ek Khamisa (naqsh-wala chaukor kapda) mein namaz padhi. Namaz mein Aap ne uske nishaanon ki taraf dekha. Namaz khatam karke farmaya: "Yeh Khamisa Abu Jahm ke paas le jao aur unka Inbijaniya (bina naqsh wala oon ka kapda) le aao, kyunke isne mera dhyan namaz se hataya." Ayesha se yeh bhi riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Main namaz mein iske nishaan dekh raha tha aur mujhe dar tha yeh mujhe fitne mein daal de (dhyan hata kar)."

e: Narrated Anas:`Aisha had a Qiram (a thin marked woolen curtain) with which she had screened one side of her home. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Take away this Qiram of yours, as its pictures are still displayed in front of me during my prayer (i.e. they divert my attention from the prayer)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas ek Qiram (naqsh wala patla oon ka parda) tha jisse unhone apne ghar ka ek hissa parda kiya hua tha. Nabi ne farmaya: "Apna yeh Qiram hata do, kyunke iski tasveerein namaz mein mere saamne aati rehti hain (mera dhyan hataati hain)."

e: Narrated `Uqba bin 'Amir:The Prophet (ﷺ) was given a silken Farruj [??] as a present. He wore it while praying. When he had finished his prayer, he took it off violently as if with a strong aversion to it and said, "It is not the dress of Allah-fearing pious people
hi: Uqba bin Amir (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ko ek resham ka Farruj (libaas) tohfe mein diya gaya. Aap ne usme namaz padhi. Namaz khatam karke, Aap ne use sakhti se utaar diya jaise usse sakht napasandidgi ho, aur farmaya: "Yeh Allah se darne walon ka libaas nahi hai."

e: Narrated Abu Juhaifa:I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in a red leather tent and I saw Bilal taking the remaining water with which the Prophet had performed ablution. I saw the people taking the utilized water impatiently and whoever got some of it rubbed it on his body and those who could not get any took the moisture from the others' hands. Then I saw Bilal carrying a short spear (or stick) which he planted in the ground. The Prophet came out tucking up his red cloak, and led the people in prayer and offered two rak`at (facing the Ka`ba) taking a short spear (or stick) as a Sutra for his prayer. I saw the people and animals passing in front of him beyond the stick
hi: Abu Juhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Maine Allah ke Rasool ko ek laal chamde ke khaimay mein dekha, aur Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko Nabi ke wudu ka baqi paani lete dekha. Maine logon ko woh paani beqarari se lete dekha, jise mila usne apne badan par mala, jise nahi mila usne doosron ke haathon se namee li. Phir maine Bilal ko ek chhoti chhadi le jaate dekha jise unhone zameen mein gaad diya. Nabi apna laal libaas samet kar bahar aaye aur namaz ki imamat ki, do rakat padhi (Ka'ba ki taraf) chhadi ko Sutra banate hue. Maine log aur janwar chhadi ke aage se guzarte dekhe."

e: Narrated Abu Hazim:Sahl bin Sa`d was asked about the (Prophet's) pulpit as to what thing it was made of? Sahl replied: "None remains alive amongst the people, who knows about it better than I. It was made of tamarisk (wood) of the forest. So and so, the slave of so and so prepared it for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . When it was constructed and place (in the Mosque), Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood on it facing the Qibla and said 'Allahu Akbar', and the people stood behind him (and led the people in prayer). He recited and bowed and the people bowed behind him. Then he raised his head and stepped back, got down and prostrated on the ground and then he again ascended the pulpit, recited, bowed, raised his head and stepped back, got down and prostrated on the ground. So, this is what I know about the pulpit." Ahmad bin Hanbal said, "As the Prophet (ﷺ) was at a higher level than the people, there is no harm according to the above-mentioned Hadith if the Imam is at a higher level than his followers during the prayers
hi: Abu Hazim bataate hain ke Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) se Nabi ke mimbar ke baare mein pucha gaya ke woh kis cheez ka bana tha. Sahl ne jawab diya: "Ab isse behtar koi nahi jaanta. Yeh jungle ke tamarisk lakdi ka bana tha. Falaan, falaan ke gulam ne Allah ke Rasool ke liye isse banaya. Jab yeh bana aur masjid mein rakha gaya, Allah ke Rasool ispar khade hokar Qibla ki taraf mun karke 'Allahu Akbar' kaha, log unke peechhe khade hue. Aap ne tilawat ki aur ruku kiya, log bhi unke peechhe ruku mein gaye. Phir sar utha kar peechhe hate, neeche utar kar zameen par sajda kiya, phir dobara mimbar par chadhe, tilawat ki, ruku kiya, sar utha kar peechhe hate, neeche utar kar sajda kiya. Yehi mujhe mimbar ke baare mein pata hai." Ahmad bin Hanbal ne kaha: "Chunke Nabi logon se oonchi jagah par the, is hadith ke mutabiq Imam ka apne muqtadiyon se oonchi jagah namaz padhana koi harj nahi."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) fell off a horse and his leg or shoulder got injured. He swore that he would not go to his wives for one month and he stayed in a Mashruba [??] (attic room) having stairs made of date palm trunks. So his companions came to visit him, and he led them in prayer sitting, whereas his companions were standing. When he finished the prayer, he said, "Imam is meant to be followed, so when he says 'Allahu Akbar,' say 'Allahu Akbar' and when he bows, bow and when he prostrates, prostrate and if he prays standing pray, standing. After the 29th day the Prophet (ﷺ) came down (from the attic room) and the people asked him, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! You swore that you will not go to your wives for one month." He said, "The month is 29 days
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke ek baar Allah ke Rasool ghode se gir gaye aur unki taang ya shoulder zakhmi ho gaya. Unhone qasam khai ke ek mahine apni biwiyon ke paas nahi jayenge, aur ek Mashruba (khajoor ke tanon ki seedhi wala kamra) mein rahe. Sahaba unse milne aaye, Aap ne baithe-baithe unki imamat ki jabke sahaba khade the. Namaz khatam karke farmaya: "Imam ki pairvi ki jaati hai, jab woh 'Allahu Akbar' kahe, tum bhi kaho, jab ruku kare, ruku karo, jab sajda kare, sajda karo, aur agar woh khade hokar padhe to tum bhi khade hokar padho." Unatis din baad Nabi (Mashruba se) neeche aaye, logon ne pucha: "Ya Rasoolallah, aapne to ek mahine ki qasam khai thi?" Farmaya: "Mahina unatis din ka bhi hota hai."

e: Narrates `Abdullah bin Shaddad:Maimuna said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was praying while I was in my menses, sitting beside him and sometimes his clothes would touch me during his prostration." Maimuna added, "He prayed on a Khumra (a small mat sufficient just for the face and the hands while prostrating during prayers)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Shaddad bataate hain ke Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool namaz padh rahe the jabke main haiz mein unke qareeb baithi thi, sajda mein kabhi-kabhi Aap ke kapde mujhse chhoo jaate." Maimuna ne joda: "Aap Khumra (chhoti chatai, sirf chehre-haathon ke liye) par namaz padhte the."

e: Narrated 'Is-haq:Anas bin Malik said, "My grandmother Mulaika invited Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for a meal which she herself had prepared. He ate from it and said, 'Get up! I will lead you in the prayer.' " Anas added, "I took my Hasir, washed it with water as it had become dark because of long use and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood on it. The orphan (Damira or Ruh) and I aligned behind him and the old lady (Mulaika) stood behind us. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) led us in the prayer and offered two rak`at and then left
hi: Ishaq bataate hain ke Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Meri dadi Mulaika ne Allah ke Rasool ko apne haath ka pakaya khana khilaane bulaya. Aap ne khaya aur farmaya: 'Utho, main tumhari imamat karunga.'" Anas ne joda: "Maine apna Hasir (chatai) liya, paani se dhoya kyunke woh purana istemaal se kaali ho chuki thi, aur Allah ke Rasool uspar khade hue. Yateem (Damira ya Ruh) aur main unke peechhe qatar mein khade hue, aur budhi aurat (Mulaika) humare peechhe. Allah ke Rasool ne humari imamat ki, do rakat padhi aur chale gaye."

e: Narrated Maimuna:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to pray on Khumra
hi: Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool Khumra par namaz padhte the.

e: Narrated Abu Salama:`Aisha the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I used to sleep in front of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and my legs were opposite his Qibla and in prostration he pushed my legs and I withdrew then and when he stood, I stretched them.' `Aisha added, "In those days the houses were without lights
hi: Abu Salama bataate hain ke Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki biwi) ne kaha: "Main Allah ke Rasool ke saamne sone leti thi, meri taangein unke Qibla ki taraf hoti thin, sajda mein Aap mere paon halke se hataate aur main hata leti, jab Aap khade hote, main phir phaila deti." Ayesha ne joda: "Us waqt gharon mein roshni nahi hoti thi."

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Apostle prayed while I was lying like a dead body on his family bed between him and his Qibla
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne namaz padhi jabke main mayyat ki tarah unke aur Qibla ke darmiyan (bistar par) leti thi.

e: Narrated `Urwa:The Prophet (ﷺ) prayed while `Aisha was lying between him and his Qibla on the bed on which they used to sleep
hi: Urwa bataate hain ke Nabi ne namaz padhi jabke Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) unke aur Qibla ke darmiyan usi bistar par leti thi jispar woh sote the.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:We used to pray with the Prophet (ﷺ) and some of us used to place the ends of their clothes at the place of prostration because of scorching heat
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke hum Nabi ke saath namaz padhte, garmi ki shiddat ki wajah se kuch log apne kapdon ke sire sajda ki jagah bicha lete.

e: Narrated Abu Maslama:Sa`id bin Yazid Al-Azdi: I asked Anas bin Malik whether the Prophet (ﷺ) had ever, prayed with his shoes on. He replied "Yes
hi: Abu Maslama, Sa'id bin Yazid Al-Azdi bataate hain: "Maine Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha kya Nabi ne kabhi juton samet namaz padhi. Unhone jawab diya: 'Haan.'"

e: Narrated Ibrahim:Hammam bin Al-Harith said, "I saw Jarir bin `Abdullah urinating. Then he performed ablution and passed his (wet) hands over his Khuffs (socks made from thick fabric or leather), stood up and prayed. He was asked about it. He replied that he had seen the Prophet (ﷺ) doing the same." They approved of this narration as Jarir was one of those who embraced Islam very late
hi: Ibrahim bataate hain ke Hammam bin Al-Harith ne kaha: "Maine Jarir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko peshab karte dekha. Phir unhone wudu kiya aur apne Khuffon par haath phera, khade hokar namaz padhi. Unse iske baare mein pucha gaya. Unhone jawab diya ke unhone Nabi ko bhi aisa hi karte dekha tha." Logon ne is riwayat ko qubool kiya kyunke Jarir Islam mein bahut baad mein aaye the.

e: Narrated Al-Mughira bin Shu'ba: I helped the Prophet (ﷺ) in performing ablution and he passed his wet hands over his Khuffs and prayed
hi: Al-Mughira bin Shu'ba (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Maine Nabi ko wudu mein madad ki aur Aap ne apne Khuffon par gile haath phere aur namaz padhi."

e: Narrated Hudhaifa that he saw a person bowing and prostrating imperfectly. When he finished his Salat, Hudhaifa told him that he had not offered Salat. The subnarrator added, "I think that Hudhaifa also said:Were you to die you would die on a "Sunna" (legal way) other than that of Muhammad (ﷺ)
hi: Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne ek shaks ko namaz mein na-mukammal ruku-sajda karte dekha. Namaz khatam hone par Hudhaifa ne use bataya ke usne namaz padhi hi nahi. Rawi ko lagta hai Hudhaifa ne yeh bhi kaha: "Agar tum aisi (na-mukammal namaz ki) tareeke par marte, to Muhammad ke tareeqe (Sunnat) se hat kar marte."

e: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Malik: Ibn Buhaina, "When the Prophet (ﷺ) prayed, he used to separate his arms from his body so widely that the whiteness of his armpits was visible
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik, Ibn Buhaina se riwayat karte hain: "Jab Nabi namaz padhte, apne baazu badan se itni door rakhte ke unki bagal ki safedi dikhai deti."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever prays like us and faces our Qibla and eats our slaughtered animals is a Muslim and is under Allah's and His Apostle's protection. So do not betray Allah by betraying those who are in His protection
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jo humari tarah namaz padhe, humara Qibla ki taraf mun kare, aur humara zabah kiya hua khaana khaye, woh Musalman hai aur Allah aur uske Rasool ki panah mein hai. Isliye Allah ki panah mein aaye logon ko dhoka na do."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I have been ordered to fight the people till they say: 'None has the right to be worshipped but Allah.' And if they say so, pray like our prayers, face our Qibla and slaughter as we slaughter, then their blood and property will be sacred to us and we will not interfere with them except legally and their reckoning will be with Allah
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Mujhe hukum diya gaya hai ke logon se jung karoon jab tak woh yeh na kahen: 'Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahi.' Agar woh yeh kahen, humari tarah namaz padhen, humara Qibla apnayen, aur humari tarah zabah karen, to unka khoon aur maal humare liye mehfooz ho jayega, siwaye haqq ke, aur unka hisaab Allah ke zimme hai."

e: Narrated Maimun bin Siyah that he asked Anas bin Malik, "O Abu Hamza! What makes the life and property of a person sacred?" He replied, "Whoever says, 'None has the right to be worshipped but Allah', faces our Qibla during the prayers, prays like us and eats our slaughtered animal, then he is a Muslim, and has got the same rights and obligations as other Muslims have
hi: Maimun bin Siyah bataate hain ke unhone Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha: "Aye Abu Hamza! Kis cheez se kisi ki jaan aur maal mehfooz hota hai?" Unhone jawab diya: "Jo kahe 'Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahi', namaz mein humara Qibla apnaye, humari tarah namaz padhe, aur humara zabah kiya khaana khaye, woh Musalman hai, aur uske wahi huqooq-o-farz hain jo doosre Musalmanon ke hain."

e: Narrated Abu Aiyub Al-Ansari:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "While defecating, neither face nor turn your back to the Qibla but face either east or west." Abu Aiyub added. "When we arrived in Sham we came across some lavatories facing the Qibla; therefore we turned ourselves while using them and asked for Allah's forgiveness
hi: Abu Aiyub Al-Ansari (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Qaza-e-hajat ke waqt Qibla ki taraf mun ya pusht na karo, mashriq ya magrib ki taraf karo." Abu Aiyub ne joda: "Jab hum Sham pahunche, wahan kuch bait-ul-khala Qibla ki taraf bane hue paaye, isliye humne khud ko mod liya aur Allah se maafi maangi."

e: Narrated `Amr bin Dinar:I asked Ibn `Umar, "Can a person who has performed the Tawaf around the Ka`ba for `Umra but has not performed the (Sa`i) Tawaf of Safa and Marwa, have a sexual relation with his wife?" Ibn `Umar replied "When the Prophet (ﷺ) reached Mecca he performed the Tawaf around the Ka`ba (circumambulated it seven times) and offered a two-rak`at prayer (at the place) behind the station (of Abraham) and then performed the Tawaf (Sa`i) of Safa and Marwa, and verily in Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) you have a good example." Then we put the same question to Jabir bin `Abdullah and he too replied, "He should not go near his wife (for sexual relation) till he has finished the Tawaf of Safa and Marwa
hi: Amr bin Dinar bataate hain: "Maine Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha: 'Kya Umrah ke liye Ka'ba ka Tawaf karne wala shaks, jisne Safa-Marwa ka Sa'i nahi kiya, apni biwi se humbistari kar sakta hai?' Ibn Umar ne jawab diya: 'Jab Nabi Mecca pahunche, unhone Ka'ba ka Tawaf (saat baar) kiya, Maqam-e-Ibrahim ke peechhe do rakat padhi, phir Safa-Marwa ka Sa'i kiya, aur beshak Allah ke Rasool mein tumhare liye behtareen namoona hai.'" Phir humne yehi sawaal Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kiya, unhone bhi kaha: "Woh apni biwi ke qareeb na jaaye jab tak Safa-Marwa ka Sa'i poora na kare."

e: Narrated Mujahid:Someone came to Ibn `Umar and said, "Here is Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entering the Ka`ba." Ibn `Umar said, "I went there but the Prophet (ﷺ) had come out of the Ka`ba and I found Bilal standing between its two doors. I asked Bilal, 'Did the Prophet (ﷺ) pray in the Ka`ba?' Bilal replied, 'Yes, he prayed two rak`at between the two pillars which are to your left on entering the Ka`ba. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came out and offered a two-rak`at prayer facing the Ka`ba
hi: Mujahid bataate hain ke kisi ne Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kaha: "Dekho, Allah ke Rasool Ka'ba mein daakhil ho rahe hain." Ibn Umar ne kaha: "Main gaya magar Nabi Ka'ba se bahar aa chuke the, maine Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko dono darwazon ke beech khada paaya. Maine Bilal se pucha: 'Kya Nabi ne Ka'ba mein namaz padhi?' Bilal ne jawab diya: 'Haan, Aap ne do sutoon ke darmiyan do rakat padhi jo Ka'ba mein dakhil hote waqt aapki baayi taraf hain.' Phir Allah ke Rasool bahar aaye aur Ka'ba ki taraf mun karke do rakat padhi."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When the Prophet (ﷺ) entered the Ka`ba, he invoked Allah in each and every side of it and did not pray till he came out of it, and offered a two-rak`at prayer facing the Ka`ba and said, "This is the Qibla
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke jab Nabi Ka'ba mein daakhil hue, har taraf Allah se dua ki magar namaz nahi padhi jab tak bahar na nikle, phir Ka'ba ki taraf mun karke do rakat padhi aur farmaya: "Yeh Qibla hai."

e: Narrated Bara' bin `Azib:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prayed facing Baitul-Maqdis for sixteen or seventeen months but he loved to face the Ka`ba (at Mecca) so Allah revealed: "Verily, We have seen the turning of your face to the heaven!" (2:144) So the Prophet (ﷺ) faced the Ka`ba and the fools amongst the people namely "the Jews" said, "What has turned them from their Qibla (Baitul-Maqdis) which they formerly observed"" (Allah revealed): "Say: 'To Allah belongs the East and the West. He guides whom He wills to a straight path'." (2:142) A man prayed with the Prophet (facing the Ka`ba) and went out. He saw some of the Ansar praying the `Asr prayer with their faces towards Baitul-Maqdis, he said, "I bear witness that I prayed with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) facing the Ka`ba." So all the people turned their faces towards the Ka`ba
hi: Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne solah ya satrah maheene Baitul-Maqdis ki taraf mun karke namaz padhi, magar Ka'ba ki taraf mun karna pasand karte the. Tab Allah ne nazil farmaya: "Beshak Humne dekha tera chehra baar-baar aasman ki taraf uthna" (2:144). Nabi ne Ka'ba ki taraf mun kiya, aur bewaqoof log yani Yahudi kehne lage: "Inhe kis cheez ne unke Qibla (Baitul-Maqdis) se, jise woh pehle maante the, phera diya?" (Allah ne nazil farmaya): "Kaho: Mashriq aur Magrib Allah hi ke hain, woh jise chahe seedhe raaste ki hidayat de." (2:142). Ek shaks ne Nabi ke saath (Ka'ba ki taraf mun karke) namaz padhi aur bahar nikla. Usne kuch Ansaar ko Asr padhte dekha jinka mun Baitul-Maqdis ki taraf tha, usne kaha: "Main gawahi deta hoon ke maine Allah ke Rasool ke saath Ka'ba ki taraf mun karke namaz padhi hai." Yeh sunkar sab logon ne apna mun Ka'ba ki taraf kar liya.

e: Narrated Jabir:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to pray (optional, non-obligatory prayer) while riding on his mount (Rahila) wherever it turned, and whenever he wanted to pray the compulsory prayer he dismounted and prayed facing the Qibla
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool apni sawari par (nafil) namaz padhte the jidhar bhi sawari mudti, magar farz namaz ke liye utar kar Qibla ki taraf mun karte.

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) prayed (and the sub-narrator Ibrahim said, "I do not know whether he prayed more or less than usual"), and when he had finished the prayers he was asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Has there been any change in the prayers?" He said, "What is it?' The people said, "You have prayed so much and so much." So the Prophet (ﷺ) bent his legs, faced the Qibla and performed two prostration's (of Sahu) and finished his prayers with Taslim (by turning his face to right and left saying: 'As-Salamu `Alaikum- Warahmat-ullah'). When he turned his face to us he said, "If there had been anything changed in the prayer, surely I would have informed you but I am a human being like you and liable to forget like you. So if I forget remind me and if anyone of you is doubtful about his prayer, he should follow what he thinks to be correct and complete his prayer accordingly and finish it and do two prostrations (of Sahu)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne namaz padhi (Ibrahim raawi ko yaad nahi zyada padhi ya kam), namaz khatam karke pucha gaya: "Ya Rasoolallah! Kya namaz mein koi tabdeeli hui?" Aap ne pucha: "Kya baat hai?" Logon ne kaha: "Aapne itni-itni rakat padhi." Nabi ne apni taangein mod kar Qibla ki taraf mun kiya aur do sajde (Sahu) kiye, phir Taslim se namaz khatam ki. Jab humari taraf mudte, farmaya: "Agar namaz mein koi tabdeeli hoti to zaroor batata, magar main bhi tumhari tarah insaan hoon, tumhari tarah bhool sakta hoon. Isliye agar main bhool jaun to mujhe yaad dilao, aur agar tum mein koi shak ho apni namaz mein, to jo sahih lage usi par amal karo aur namaz poori karke do Sahu ke sajde kar lo."

e: Narrated `Umar (bin Al-Khattab):My Lord agreed with me in three things: -1. I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), I wish we took the station of Abraham as our praying place (for some of our prayers). So came the Divine Inspiration: And take you (people) the station of Abraham as a place of prayer (for some of your prayers e.g. two rak`at of Tawaf of Ka`ba)". (2.125) -2. And as regards the (verse of) the veiling of the women, I said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I wish you ordered your wives to cover themselves from the men because good and bad ones talk to them.' So the verse of the veiling of the women was revealed. -3. Once the wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) made a united front against the Prophet (ﷺ) and I said to them, 'It may be if he (the Prophet) divorced you, (all) that his Lord (Allah) will give him instead of you wives better than you.' So this verse (the same as I had said) was revealed
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Khattab (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Mere Rab ne teen baaton mein meri raay se muwafiqat ki. Maine kaha: 'Ya Rasoolallah, kaash hum Maqam-e-Ibrahim ko namaz ki jagah banate.' Tab wahi nazil hui: 'Aur Maqam-e-Ibrahim ko namaz ki jagah banao' (2:125). Aurton ke parde ke baare mein maine kaha: 'Ya Rasoolallah, kaash aap apni biwiyon ko mardon se parda karne ka hukum dete, kyunke acche-bure sab unse baat karte hain.' Tab parda ki ayat nazil hui. Ek baar Nabi ki biwiyon ne Aap ke khilaf ittehad kar liya, maine unse kaha: 'Ho sakta hai agar woh (Nabi) tumhe talaq de dein, to unka Rab unhe tumse behtar biwiyan de.' Tab yehi ayat (jo maine kaha tha) nazil hui."

e: Narrated Anas:as above
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se yehi riwayat hai (jaisa upar).

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:While the people were offering the Fajr prayer at Quba' (near Medina), someone came to them and said: "It has been revealed to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) tonight, and he has been ordered to pray facing the Ka`ba." So turn your faces to the Ka`ba. Those people were facing Sham (Jerusalem) so they turned their faces towards Ka`ba (at Mecca)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke jab log Quba (Madina ke qareeb) mein Fajr padh rahe the, kisi ne aakar kaha: "Aaj raat Allah ke Rasool par wahi nazil hui hai aur unhe Ka'ba ki taraf mun karke namaz padhne ka hukum diya gaya, isliye apna mun Ka'ba ki taraf karo." Woh log Sham (Jerusalem) ki taraf mun kiye the, isliye unhone apna mun Ka'ba (Mecca) ki taraf mod liya.

e: Narrated `Abdullah:"Once the Prophet (ﷺ) offered five rak`at in Zuhr prayer. He was asked, "Is there an increase in the prayer?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "And what is it?" They said, "You have prayed five rak`at.' So he bent his legs and performed two prostrations (of Sahu)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Ek baar Nabi ne Zuhr mein paanch rakat padh di. Pucha gaya: 'Kya namaz mein izafa hua hai?' Nabi ne pucha: 'Kya baat hai?' Logon ne kaha: 'Aapne paanch rakat padhi.' Aap ne apni taangein mod kar do Sahu ke sajde kiye."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) saw some sputum in the direction of the Qibla (on the wall of the mosque) and he disliked that and the sign of disgust was apparent from his face. So he got up and scraped it off with his hand and said, "Whenever anyone of you stands for the prayer, he is speaking in private to his Lord or his Lord is between him and his Qibla. So, none of you should spit in the direction of the Qibla but one can spit to the left or under his foot." The Prophet (ﷺ) then took the corner of his sheet and spat in it and folded it and said, "Or you can do this
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne Qibla ki taraf (masjid ki deewar par) balgham dekha, unhe napasand aaya aur unke chehre par napasandidgi zahir hui. Aap uthe aur ise apne haath se khurach diya, aur farmaya: "Jab bhi koi namaz ke liye khada ho, woh apne Rab se sirgoshi kar raha hota hai, ya uska Rab uske aur uske Qibla ke darmiyan hota hai. Isliye koi bhi Qibla ki taraf na thooke, balki baayen taraf ya paon ke neeche thooke." Phir Nabi ne apni chadar ka konna leke usme thooka, mod diya aur farmaya: "Ya aisa kar sakte ho."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw sputum on the wall of the mosque in the direction of the Qibla and scraped it off. He faced the people and said, "Whenever any one of you is praying, he should not spit in front of him because in the prayer Allah is in front of him
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne masjid ki deewar par Qibla ki taraf balgham dekha aur use khurach diya. Aap ne logon ki taraf mun karke farmaya: "Jab bhi koi namaz padh raha ho, apne saamne na thooke kyunke namaz mein Allah uske saamne hota hai."

e: Narrated `Aisha:(the mother of faithful believers) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw some nasal secretions, expectoration or sputum on the wall of the mosque in the direction of the Qibla and scraped it off
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne masjid ki deewar par Qibla ki taraf naak ya balgham ka kuch asar dekha aur use khurach diya.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira and Abu Sa`id:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw some expectoration on the wall of the mosque; he took gravel and scraped it off and said, "If anyone of you wanted to spit he should neither spit in front of him nor on his right but he could spit either on his left or under his left foot
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Abu Saeed (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne masjid ki deewar par kuch balgham dekha, kanker liya aur khurach diya, aur farmaya: "Agar kisi ko thookna ho to apne saamne ya dahine taraf na thooke, balki baayen taraf ya baaye paon ke neeche thooke."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira and Abu Sa`id:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw some expectoration on the wall of the mosque; he took gravel and scraped it off and said, "If anyone of you wanted to spit, he should neither spit in front of him nor on his right but could spit either on his left or under his left foot
hi: (Yehi hadith Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Abu Saeed se dobara riwayat hui hai.)

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "None of you should spit in front or on his right but he could spit either on his left or under his foot
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Koi bhi apne saamne ya dahine taraf na thooke, balki baayen ya paon ke neeche thooke."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A faithful believer while in prayer is speaking in private to his Lord, so he should neither spit in front of him nor to his right side but he could spit either on his left or under his foot
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Momin namaz mein apne Rab se sirgoshi kar raha hota hai, isliye woh na saamne thooke na dahine taraf, balki baayen ya paon ke neeche."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id:The Prophet (ﷺ) saw sputum on (the wall of) the mosque in the direction of the Qibla and scraped it off with gravel. Then he forbade Spitting in front or on the right, but allowed it on one's left or under one's left foot
hi: Abu Saeed (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne masjid mein Qibla ki taraf balgham dekha aur kanker se khurach diya. Phir saamne ya dahine thookne se mana kiya, magar baayen ya baaye paon ke neeche ki ijazat di.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Spitting in the mosque is a sin and its expiation is to bury it
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Masjid mein thookna gunah hai, uska kaffara use dafn karna hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Prophet said, "If anyone of you stands for prayer, he should not spit in front of him because in prayer he is speaking in private to Allah and he should not spit on his right as there is an angel, but he can spit either on his left or under his left foot and bury it (i.e. expectoration)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Jab koi namaz ke liye khada ho, apne saamne na thooke kyunke namaz mein woh Allah se sirgoshi kar raha hota hai, dahine bhi na thooke kyunke wahan farishta hota hai, balki baayen ya baaye paon ke neeche thooke aur dafn kar de."

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) saw expectoration (on the wall of the mosque) in the direction of the Qibla and scraped it off with his hand. It seemed that he disliked it and the sign of disgust was apparent from his face. He said, "If anyone of you stands for the prayer, he is speaking in private to his Lord, (or) his Lord is between him and his Qibla, therefore he should not spit towards his Qibla, but he could spit either on his left or under his foot." Then he took the corner of his sheet and spat in it, folded it and said, "Or do this
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne Qibla ki taraf balgham dekha aur apne haath se khurach diya. Aisa lagta tha ke unhe napasand aaya, chehre par napasandidgi zahir thi. Farmaya: "Jab koi namaz ke liye khada ho, woh apne Rab se sirgoshi kar raha hota hai, (ya) uska Rab uske aur uske Qibla ke darmiyan hota hai, isliye Qibla ki taraf na thooke, balki baayen ya paon ke neeche." Phir apni chadar ka konna leke usme thooka, mod diya aur farmaya: "Ya yeh karo."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Do you consider or see that my face is towards the Qibla? By Allah, neither your submissiveness nor your bowing is hidden from me, surely I see you from my back
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Kya tum samajhte ho mera mun sirf Qibla ki taraf hai? Allah ki qasam, na tumhara khushu na tumhara ruku mujhse chhupa hai, main tumhe apni pusht se bhi dekhta hoon."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) led us in a prayer and then got up on the pulpit and said, "In your prayer and bowing, I certainly see you from my back as I see you (while looking at you)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne humari namaz padhai, phir mimbar par khade hokar farmaya: "Tumhari namaz aur ruku mein, main tumhe apni pusht se bhi utna hi dekhta hoon jitna (saamne se) dekhta hoon."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered for a horse race; the trained horses were to run from a place called Al-Hafya' to Thaniyat Al-Wada` and the horses which were not trained were to run from Al-Thaniya to the Masjid (mosque of) Bani Zuraiq. The sub narrator added: Ibn `Umar was one of those who took part in the race
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne ghudsawaari ki race karayi; sikhaye hue ghode Al-Hafya se Thaniyat-ul-Wada tak, aur bina sikhaye hue ghode Al-Thaniya se Bani Zuraiq ki masjid tak daudte. (Rawi ne joda: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bhi in daud lagane walon mein se the.)

e: Narrated Anas:Some goods came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) from Bahrain. The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered the people to spread them in the mosque --it was the biggest amount of goods Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had ever received. He left for prayer and did not even look at it. After finishing the prayer, he sat by those goods and gave from those to everybody he saw. Al-`Abbas came to him and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! give me (something) too, because I gave ransom for myself and `Aqil". Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) told him to take. So he stuffed his garment with it and tried to carry it away but he failed to do so. He said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Order someone to help me in lifting it." The Prophet (ﷺ) refused. He then said to the Prophet: Will you please help me to lift it?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) refused. Then Al-`Abbas threw some of it and tried to lift it (but failed). He again said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) Order someone to help me to lift it." He refused. Al-`Abbas then said to the Prophet: "Will you please help me to lift it?" He again refused. Then Al-`Abbas threw some of it, and lifted it on his shoulders and went away. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) kept on watching him till he disappeared from his sight and was astonished at his greediness. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not get up till the last coin was distributed
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Bahrain se Allah ke Rasool ke paas maal aaya. Nabi ne logon ko use masjid mein failaane ka hukum diya — yeh sabse zyada maal tha jo Allah ke Rasool ko kabhi mila tha. Aap namaz ke liye chale gaye aur usme dekha bhi nahi. Namaz khatam karke, us maal ke paas baithe aur jise bhi dekhte usme se dete. Abbas aaye aur kaha: "Ya Rasoolallah! Mujhe bhi kuch dein, kyunke maine apni aur Aqil ki fidya di thi." Allah ke Rasool ne unhe lene ko kaha. Unhone apna libaas usse bhar liya aur le jaane ki koshish ki magar na uthaa sake. Kaha: "Ya Rasoolallah! Kisi ko hukum dein ke mujhe uthane mein madad kare." Nabi ne mana kiya. Unhone kaha: "Kya aap khud madad karenge?" Nabi ne phir mana kiya. Phir Abbas ne kuch maal wapas gira diya aur uthane ki koshish ki (magar phir na uthaa sake). Unhone dobara kaha: "Ya Rasoolallah! Kisi ko madad ke liye bhejein." Nabi ne mana kiya. Kaha: "Kya aap khud madad karenge?" Phir mana kiya. Tab Abbas ne kuch maal gira diya, baaki shoulders par utha kar chale gaye. Allah ke Rasool unhe dekhte rahe yahan tak ke woh nazron se ojhal ho gaye, unki hirs par hairat huyi. Allah ke Rasool tab tak nahi uthe jab tak aakhri sikka bhi taqseem na ho gaya.

e: Narrated Anas:I found the Prophet (ﷺ) in the mosque along with some people. He said to me, "Did Abu Talha send you?" I said, "Yes". He said, "For a meal?" I said, "Yes." Then he said to his companions, "Get up." They set out and I was ahead of them
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Maine Nabi ko masjid mein kuch logon ke saath paaya. Aap ne mujhse pucha: 'Kya Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne tumhe bheja?' Maine kaha: 'Haan.' Pucha: 'Khane ke liye?' Maine kaha: 'Haan.' Phir Aap ne apne sathiyon se kaha: 'Utho.' Woh chale, main unse aage tha."

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:A man said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! If a man finds another man with his wife, (committing adultery) should the husband kill him?" Later on I saw them (the man and his wife) doing Li`an in the mosque (taking oaths, one accusing, and the other denying adultery)
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke ek shaks ne pucha: "Ya Rasoolallah! Agar koi apni biwi ke saath doosre mard ko paaye (zina karte), kya shohar use qatl kar de?" Baad mein maine unhe (mard-aurat ko) masjid mein Li'an (qasam khaate hue ek-doosre par ilzaam lagate) dekha.

e: Narrated `Itban bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) came to my house and said, "Where do you like me to pray?" I pointed to a place. The Prophet then said, "Allahu Akbar", and we aligned behind him and he offered a two-rak`at prayer
hi: Itban bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Nabi mere ghar aaye aur pucha: "Kahan padhoon namaz?" Maine ek jagah ishara kiya. Nabi ne "Allahu Akbar" kaha, hum unke peechhe qatar mein khade hue, aur Aap ne do rakat padhi.

e: Narrated `Itban bin Malik:who was one of the companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and one of the Ansars who took part in the battle of Badr: I came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) I have weak eyesight and I lead my people in prayers. When it rains the water flows in the valley between me and my people so I cannot go to their mosque to lead them in prayer. O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I wish you would come to my house and pray in it so that I could take that place as a Musalla. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said. "Allah willing, I will do so." Next day after the sun rose high, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr came and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked for permission to enter. I gave him permission and he did not sit on entering the house but said to me, "Where do you like me to pray?" I pointed to a place in my house. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood there and said, 'Allahu Akbar', and we all got up and aligned behind him and offered a two-rak`at prayer and ended it with Taslim. We requested him to stay for a meal called "Khazira" which we had prepared for him. Many members of our family gathered in the house and one of them said, "Where is Malik bin Al-Dukhaishin or Ibn Al-Dukhshun?" One of them replied, "He is a hypocrite and does not love Allah and His Apostle." Hearing that, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Do not say so. Haven't you seen that he said, 'None has the right to be worshipped but Allah' for Allah's sake only?" He said, "Allah and His Apostle know better. We have seen him helping and advising hypocrites." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah has forbidden the (Hell) fire for those who say, 'None has the right to be worshipped but Allah' for Allah's sake only
hi: Itban bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ), jo Allah ke Rasool ke sahaba mein se the aur Badr ki jung mein shareek Ansaar mein se the, bataate hain: "Main Allah ke Rasool ke paas gaya aur kaha: 'Ya Rasoolallah! Meri nazar kamzor hai aur main apni qaum ki imamat karta hoon. Jab baarish hoti hai, mere aur unke darmiyan wadi mein paani bhar jaata hai, isliye main unki masjid tak imamat karne nahi ja sakta. Ya Rasoolallah! Kaash aap mere ghar aakar namaz padhein taake main use Musalla bana sakoon.' Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: 'Insha Allah, main aisa karunga.' Agle din, dhoop chadhne ke baad, Allah ke Rasool aur Abu Bakr aaye, Allah ke Rasool ne andar aane ki ijazat maangi. Maine di, aur woh andar aakar baithe nahi, balki mujhse pucha: 'Kahan padhoon namaz?' Maine apne ghar mein ek jagah ishara ki. Allah ke Rasool wahan khade hue aur 'Allahu Akbar' kaha, hum sab uthe aur unke peechhe qatar mein khade hue, do rakat padhi aur Taslim se khatam ki. Humne unse khazira (khana) khaane ki darkhwast ki jo humne unke liye taiyaar kiya tha. Humare bahut se ghar wale wahan jama ho gaye, kisi ne pucha: 'Malik bin Al-Dukhaishin ya Ibn Al-Dukhshun kahan hai?' Kisi ne jawab diya: 'Woh munafiq hai, Allah aur uske Rasool se mohabbat nahi karta.' Yeh sunkar Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: 'Aisa mat kaho. Kya tumne nahi dekha ke usne Allah ke liye "La ilaha illallah" kaha?' Unhone kaha: 'Allah aur uske Rasool behtar jaante hain. Humne dekha hai woh munafiqon ki madad aur salaah karta hai.' Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: 'Allah ne unpar dozakh haram kar di hai jinhone Allah ke liye "La ilaha illallah" kaha.'"

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to start every thing from the right (for good things) whenever it was possible in all his affairs; for example: in washing, combing or wearing shoes
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke Nabi apne har kaam mein, jahan mumkin ho, dahine se shuru karna pasand karte the — chahe wudu ho, kanghi ho, ya joota pehnana.

e: Narrated `Aisha:Um Habiba and Um Salama mentioned about a church they had seen in Ethiopia in which there were pictures. They told the Prophet (ﷺ) about it, on which he said, "If any religious man died amongst those people they would build a place of worship at his grave and make these pictures in it. They will be the worst creature in the sight of Allah on the Day of Resurrection
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke Um Habiba aur Um Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne Habsha mein dekhe gaye ek girje ka zikar kiya jisme tasveerein thi. Unhone Nabi ko bataya, Aap ne farmaya: "In logon mein jab koi neik shaks intiqal karta, uski qabar par ibadatgah bana dete aur usme yeh tasveerein banate. Yeh Qiyamat ke din Allah ke nazdeek badtareen makhlooq hongi."

e: Narrated Anas:When the Prophet (ﷺ) arrived in Medina he dismounted at `Awali-il-Medina amongst a tribe called Banu `Amr bin `Auf. He stayed there For fourteen nights. Then he sent for Bani An-Najjar and they came armed with their swords. As if I am looking (just now) as the Prophet (ﷺ) was sitting over his Rahila (Mount) with Abu Bakr riding behind him and all Banu An-Najjar around him till he dismounted at the courtyard of Abu Aiyub's house. The Prophet (ﷺ) loved to pray wherever the time for the prayer was due even at sheep-folds. Later on he ordered that a mosque should be built and sent for some people of Banu-An-Najjar and said, "O Banu An-Najjar! Suggest to me the price of this (walled) piece of land of yours." They replied, "No! By Allah! We do not demand its price except from Allah." Anas added: There were graves of pagans in it and some of it was unleveled and there were some date-palm trees in it. The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered that the graves of the pagans be dug out and the unleveled land be levelled and the date-palm trees be cut down . (So all that was done). They aligned these cut date-palm trees towards the Qibla of the mosque (as a wall) and they also built two stone side-walls (of the mosque). His companions brought the stones while reciting some poetic verses. The Prophet (ﷺ) was with them and he kept on saying, "There is no goodness except that of the Hereafter, O Allah! So please forgive the Ansars and the emigrants
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke jab Nabi Madina pahunche, Awali-il-Madina mein Banu Amr bin Auf qabile mein utre. Chaudah raatein wahan rahe. Phir Banu An-Najjar ko bulwaya, woh apni talwaron ke saath aaye. Goya main abhi Nabi ko apni sawari par baithe dekh raha hoon, Abu Bakr unke peechhe sawar, aur Banu An-Najjar unke charon taraf, yahan tak ke woh Abu Aiyub ke ghar ke sehen mein utre. Nabi jahan bhi namaz ka waqt aata, wahin padhna pasand karte, chahe bhed-bakriyon ke ahaate mein ho. Baad mein Aap ne masjid banwane ka hukum diya, Banu An-Najjar ke kuch logon ko bulwaya aur kaha: "Aye Banu An-Najjar! Is (deewar wali) zameen ki keemat batao." Unhone kaha: "Nahi! Allah ki qasam, hum iski keemat sirf Allah se maangte hain." Anas ne joda: Usme mushrikon ki qabrein thin, kuch hissa onchi-niche tha, aur khajoor ke darakht bhi the. Nabi ne mushrikon ki qabrein khudwane, zameen barabar karwane aur khajoor katwane ka hukum diya. Katte hue khajoor Qibla ki taraf laga diye gaye (deewar ki tarah), aur do pattharon ki side-deewarein bhi banwai gayin. Sahaba she'r padhte hue patthar laate, Nabi bhi unke saath the aur kehte rahe: "Sirf Aakhirat ki bhalai asli bhalai hai, Aye Allah! Ansaar aur Muhajireen ko maaf farma."

e: Narrated Abu Al-Taiyah [??]:Anas said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) prayed in the sheep fold." Later on I heard him saying, "He prayed in the sheep folds before the construction of the, mosque
hi: Abu At-Taiyah bataate hain ke Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Nabi ne bhed-bakriyon ke ahaate mein namaz padhi." Baad mein maine unhe kehte suna: "Aap ne masjid banne se pehle bhed-bakriyon ke ahaaton mein namaz padhi."

e: Narrated Nafi`:"I saw Ibn `Umar praying while taking his camel as a Sutra in front of him and he said, "I saw the Prophet doing the same
hi: Nafi bataate hain: "Maine Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko apne oont ko Sutra banate hue namaz padhte dekha, unhone kaha: 'Maine Nabi ko bhi aisa hi karte dekha.'"

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abbas:The sun eclipsed and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) offered the eclipse prayer and said, "I have been shown the Hellfire (now) and I never saw a worse and horrible sight than the sight I have seen today
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke suraj grahan hua aur Allah ke Rasool ne kasoof ki namaz padhi aur farmaya: "Mujhe (abhi) Dozakh dikhai gayi hai, aur maine aaj jaisa bura aur khaufnaak manzar kabhi nahi dekha."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) had said, "Offer some of your prayers (Nawafil) at home, and do not take your houses as graves
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Apni kuch (nafil) namazein ghar mein padho, apne gharon ko qabristan mat banao."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Do not enter (the places) of these people where Allah's punishment had fallen unless you do so weeping. If you do not weep, do not enter (the places of these people) because Allah's curse and punishment which fell upon them may fall upon you
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Un logon ki (halaak-shuda) jagahon mein na jao jinpar Allah ka azaab utra, siwaye rote hue. Agar rone ka dil na kare, wahan mat jao, kyunke jo Allah ka azaab unpar utra woh tum par bhi aa sakta hai."

e: Narrated `Aisha:Um Salama told Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about a church which she had seen in Ethiopia and which was called Mariya. She told him about the pictures which she had seen in it. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If any righteous pious man dies amongst them, they would build a place of worship at his grave and make these pictures in it; they are the worst creatures in the sight of Allah
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke Um Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne Allah ke Rasool ko Habsha mein dekhe gaye 'Mariya' naam ke girje ka bataya jisme unhone tasveerein dekhi thi. Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "In logon mein jab koi neik shaks intiqal karta hai, uski qabar par ibadatgah banate aur usme tasveerein banate — yeh Allah ke nazdeek badtareen makhlooq hain."

e: Narrated `Aisha and `Abdullah bin `Abbas:When the last moment of the life of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came he started putting his 'Khamisa' on his face and when he felt hot and short of breath he took it off his face and said, "May Allah curse the Jews and Christians for they built the places of worship at the graves of their Prophets." The Prophet (ﷺ) was warning (Muslims) of what those had done
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) aur Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہم) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ke aakhri lamhaat mein Aap apni Khamisa (chadar) apne chehre par daalte, aur jab garmi aur saans lene mein mushkil hoti, hata dete, aur farmate: "Allah Yahudiyon aur Isaiyon par laanat kare, unhone apne Nabiyon ki qabron par ibadatgah bana lin." (Nabi Musalmanon ko unke amal se khabardar kar rahe the.)

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "May Allah's curse be on the Jews for they built the places of worship at the graves of their Prophets
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Allah ki laanat ho Yahudiyon par, unhone apne Nabiyon ki qabron par ibadatgah banayi."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I have been given five things which were not given to any amongst the Prophets before me. These are: -1. Allah made me victorious by awe (by His frightening my enemies) for a distance of one month's journey. -2. The earth has been made for me (and for my followers) a place for praying and a thing to perform Tayammum. Therefore my followers can pray wherever the time of a prayer is due. -3. The booty has been made Halal (lawful) for me (and was not made so for anyone else). -4. Every Prophet used to be sent to his nation exclusively but I have been sent to all mankind. -5. I have been given the right of intercession (on the Day of Resurrection)
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Mujhe paanch aisi cheezein di gayi hain jo mujhse pehle kisi Nabi ko nahi milin: 1. Allah ne mujhe ek mahine ki masaafat tak rob se madad di. 2. Zameen mere (aur meri ummat ke) liye namaz ki jagah aur Tayammum ka zariya bana di gayi, isliye meri ummat jahan bhi namaz ka waqt aa jaye wahin padh sakti hai. 3. Maal-e-ghanimat mere liye halal kiya gaya (jo doosron ke liye nahi tha). 4. Har Nabi sirf apni qaum ki taraf bheja jaata tha, magar mujhe saari insaniyat ki taraf bheja gaya. 5. Mujhe shifa'at ka haqq diya gaya."

e: Narrated `Aisha:There was a black slave girl belonging to an 'Arab tribe and they manumitted her but she remained with them. The slave girl said, "Once one of their girls (of that tribe) came out wearing a red leather scarf decorated with precious stones. It fell from her or she placed it somewhere. A kite passed by that place, saw it Lying there and mistaking it for a piece of meat, flew away with it. Those people searched for it but they did not find it. So they accused me of stealing it and started searching me and even searched my private parts." The slave girl further said, "By Allah! while I was standing (in that state) with those people, the same kite passed by them and dropped the red scarf and it fell amongst them. I told them, 'This is what you accused me of and I was innocent and now this is it.' " `Aisha added: That slave girl came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and embraced Islam. She had a tent or a small room with a low roof in the mosque. Whenever she called on me, she had a talk with me and whenever she sat with me, she would recite the following: "The day of the scarf (band) was one of the wonders of our Lord, verily He rescued me from the disbelievers' town. `Aisha added: "Once I asked her, 'What is the matter with you? Whenever you sit with me, you always recite these poetic verses.' On that she told me the whole story
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai: Ek Arab qabile ki ek kaali launDi thi jise unhone azaad kar diya magar woh unke saath rahi. LaunDi ne bataya: "Ek din qabile ki ek ladki laal chamde ka, keemti pattharon se sajaya hua scarf pehne bahar aayi. Woh gir gaya ya usne kahin rakh diya. Ek chil udte hue guzri, use gosht samajh kar uthaa kar le gayi. Logon ne bahut dhoondha magar nahi mila. Unhone mujh par chori ka ilzaam laga diya aur meri talashi li, mere jism ke poshida hisson tak." LaunDi ne aage bataya: "Allah ki qasam, main wahin khadi thi ke wahi chil dobara guzri aur scarf gira diya, jo unke saamne aakar gira. Maine unse kaha: 'Yehi hai jiska ilzaam tumne mujh par lagaya, main be-gunah thi, aur yeh raha.'" Ayesha ne joda: Woh launDi Allah ke Rasool ke paas aayi aur Islam qubool kiya. Uska masjid mein ek chhota khaimah ya kamra tha. Jab bhi woh mujhse milne aati, baat karti, aur jab bhi mere saath baithti yeh she'r padhti: "Scarf ka din mere Rab ke ajeeb karishmon mein se ek tha, beshak usne mujhe kaafiron ke shehar se bacha liya." Ayesha ne kaha: "Ek baar maine usse pucha: 'Kya baat hai, jab bhi tum mere saath baithti ho yeh she'r padhti ho?' Usne mujhe poora waqia sunaya."

e: Narrated Nafi`:`Abdullah bin `Umar said: I used to sleep in the mosque of the Prophet (ﷺ) while I was young and unmarried
hi: Nafi bataate hain ke Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Jab main jawan aur bin-shaadi-shuda tha, Nabi ki masjid mein sota tha."

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went to Fatima's house but did not find `Ali there. So he asked, "Where is your cousin?" She replied, "There was something between us and he got angry with me and went out. He did not sleep (midday nap) in the house." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked a person to look for him. That person came and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! He (Ali) is sleeping in the mosque." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went there and `Ali was lying. His upper body cover had fallen down to one side of his body and he was covered with dust. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) started cleaning the dust from him saying: "Get up! O Aba Turab. Get up! O Aba Turab (literally means: O father of dust)
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Allah ke Rasool Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ke ghar gaye magar Ali (Alayhis Salam) wahan nahi mile. Aap ne pucha: "Tumhara chachazad bhai kahan hai?" Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ne jawab diya: "Humare darmiyan kuch baat hui, woh mujhse naraz hokar chala gaya, ghar mein (dopahar ki neend) nahi soya." Allah ke Rasool ne kisi ko unhe dhoondhne bheja. Woh aakar bola: "Ya Rasoolallah! Woh (Ali (Alayhis Salam)) masjid mein so rahe hain." Allah ke Rasool wahan gaye, Ali (Alayhis Salam) lete hue the, unki chadar ek taraf se gir chuki thi aur woh dhool se atay huye the. Allah ke Rasool ne unse dhool saaf karte hue kaha: "Utho, Aye Abu Turab! Utho, Aye Abu Turab (yaani 'dhool ke baap')!"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I saw seventy of As-Suffa men and none of them had a Rida' (a garment covering the upper part of the body). They had either Izars (only) or sheets which they tied round their necks. Some of these sheets reached the middle of their legs and some reached their heels and they used to gather them with their hands lest their private parts should become naked
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai: "Maine As-Suffa ke sattar aadmi dekhe, kisi ke paas Rida (upar ka kapda) nahi tha. Sirf Izar (ya chadarein) thi jo unhone gardan se baandh rakhi thi. Kuch chadarein aadhi pindli tak thi, kuch edi tak, jinhe woh apne haathon se pakde rehte the taake sharmgaah zahir na ho."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) in the mosque (the sub-narrator Mis`ar thought that Jabir had said, "In the forenoon.") He ordered me to pray two rak`at. He owed me some money and he repaid it to me and gave more than what was due to me
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Main masjid mein Nabi ke paas gaya (Mis'ar ko lagta hai Jabir ne 'subah' kaha), Aap ne mujhe do rakat padhne ka hukum diya. Unpar mera kuch qarz tha, unhone woh ada kiya aur mujhe jitna haqq tha usse zyada diya."

e: Narrated Abu Qatada Al-Aslami:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If anyone of you enters a mosque, he should pray two rak`at before sitting
hi: Abu Qatada (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Aslami (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jab koi masjid mein daakhil ho, baithne se pehle do rakat padhe."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The angels keep on asking Allah's forgiveness for anyone of you, as long as he is at his Musalla (praying place) and he does not pass wind (Hadath). They say, 'O Allah! Forgive him, O Allah! be Merciful to him
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Farishte tum mein se kisi ke liye Allah se maafi maangte rehte hain jab tak woh apni Musalla par ho aur hadath (wudu tootne wali cheez) na ho. Woh kehte hain: 'Aye Allah! Ise maaf kar. Aye Allah! Ispar reham kar.'"

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:In the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) the mosque was built of adobes, its roof of the leaves of date-palms and its pillars of the stems of date-palms. Abu Bakr did not alter it. `Umar expanded it on the same pattern as it was in the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) by using adobes, leaves of date-palms and changing the pillars into wooden ones. `Uthman changed it by expanding it to a great extent and built its walls with engraved stones and lime and made its pillars of engraved stones and its roof of teak wood
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ke zamane mein masjid kachi eenton ki bani thi, chhat khajoor ke patton ki thi, aur sutoon khajoor ke tanon ke. Abu Bakr ne isme koi tabdeeli nahi ki. Umar ne isko wahi tareeqe se, kachi eenton aur patton se, badhaya, magar sutoon lakdi ke banwaye. Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne isko kaafi badhaya, naqsh-wali pattharon aur choone se deewarein banwaein, naqsh-wale pattharon ke sutoon aur saagwaan ki chhat banwai.

e: Narrated `Ikrima:Ibn `Abbas said to me and to his son `Ali, "Go to Abu Sa`id and listen to what he narrates." So we went and found him in a garden looking after it. He picked up his Rida', wore it and sat down and started narrating till the topic of the construction of the mosque reached. He said, "We were carrying one adobe at a time while `Ammar was carrying two. The Prophet (ﷺ) saw him and started removing the dust from his body and said, "May Allah be Merciful to `Ammar. He will be inviting them (i.e. his murderers, the rebellious group) to Paradise and they will invite him to Hell-fire." `Ammar said, "I seek refuge with Allah from affliction
hi: Ikrima bataate hain ke Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne mujhse aur apne bete Ali (Alayhis Salam) se kaha: "Abu Saeed ke paas jao aur woh jo bayan karte hain suno." Hum gaye aur unhe bagiche mein dekhbhal karte paaya. Unhone apna Rida uthaya, pehna aur baith kar bayan karna shuru kiya yahan tak ke masjid ki tameer ka zikar aaya. Unhone kaha: "Hum ek-ek eent uthaate the jabke Ammar (رضی اللہ عنہ) do-do uthate the. Nabi ne unhe dekha aur unke jism se dhool saaf ki, farmaya: 'Allah Ammar par reham kare. Woh unhe (apne qatil giroh ko) Jannat ki taraf bulaayega aur woh use Dozakh ki taraf bulayenge.'" Ammar ne kaha: "Main fitne se Allah ki panah maangta hoon."

e: Narrated Sahl:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent someone to a woman telling her to "Order her slave, carpenter, to prepare a wooden pulpit for him to sit on
hi: Sahl (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Allah ke Rasool ne ek aurat ke paas kisi ko bheja yeh kehte huye: "Apne gulam, jo badhai hai, ko hukum do ke mere baithne ke liye ek lakdi ka mimbar banaye."

e: Narrated Jabir:A woman said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shall I get something constructed for you to sit on as I have a slave who is a carpenter?" He replied, "Yes, if you like." So she had that pulpit constructed
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke ek aurat ne kaha: "Ya Rasoolallah! Kya main aapke baithne ke liye kuch banwa dun, mere paas ek badhai gulam hai?" Aap ne jawab diya: "Haan, agar tum chaho." To usne woh mimbar banwaya.

e: Narrated 'Ubaidullah Al-Khaulani:I heard `Uthman bin `Affan saying, when people argued too much about his intention to reconstruct the mosque of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), "You have talked too much. I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, 'Whoever built a mosque, (Bukair thought that `Asim, another sub-narrator, added, "Intending Allah's Pleasure"), Allah would build for him a similar place in Paradise
hi: Ubaidullah Al-Khaulani bataate hain: "Maine Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Affan ko yeh kehte suna, jab log unke Nabi ki masjid dobara banwane ke iraade par bahut behas kar rahe the: 'Tumne bahut baat ki. Maine Nabi ko farmate suna: Jo koi masjid banaye (Bukair ko lagta hai doosre raawi Asim ne joda 'Allah ki raza ke liye'), Allah uske liye Jannat mein waisi hi jagah banayega.'"

e: Narrated `Amr:I heard Jabir bin `Abdullah saying, "A man passed through the mosque carrying arrows. Allah's Apostle said to him, 'Hold them by their heads
hi: Amr bataate hain: "Maine Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko kehte suna: 'Ek shaks teer lekar masjid se guzra. Allah ke Rasool ne usse kaha: unhe unke nokon se pakdo (taake kisi ko chot na lage).'"
