e: Narrated Abu Burda bin `Abdullah:(on the authority of his father) The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever passes through our mosques or markets with arrows should hold them by their heads lest he should injure a Muslim
hi: Abu Burda bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ), apne waalid ke hawale se: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jo humari masjidon ya bazaaron mein teer lekar guzre, unhe unke nokon se pakde taake kisi Musalman ko chot na lage."

e: Narrated Hassan bin Thabit Al-Ansari:I asked Abu Huraira "By Allah! Tell me the truth whether you heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, 'O Hassan! Reply on behalf of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). O Allah! Help him with the Holy Spirit." Abu Huraira said, "Yes
hi: Hassan bin Thabit Al-Ansari bataate hain: "Maine Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha: 'Allah ki qasam, sach batao, kya tumne Nabi ko yeh kehte suna: Aye Hassan! Allah ke Rasool ki taraf se jawab do. Aye Allah! Ruh-ul-Qudus se unki madad kar.'" Abu Huraira ne kaha: "Haan."

e: Narrated `Aisha:Once I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) at the door of my house while some Ethiopians were playing in the mosque (displaying their skill with spears). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was screening me with his Rida' so as to enable me to see their display. (`Urwa said that `Aisha said, "I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) and the Ethiopians were playing with their spears
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai: "Ek baar maine Allah ke Rasool ko apne ghar ke darwaze par dekha jabke kuch Habshi masjid mein (neze se) khel dikha rahe the. Allah ke Rasool ne apni Rida se mujhe parda kiya taake main unka khel dekh sakoon." (Urwa ne kaha Ayesha ne bataya: "Maine Nabi ko dekha aur Habshi apne nezon se khel rahe the.")

e: Narrated `Aisha:Barirah came to seek my help regarding her manumission (freedom). I told her, "If you like I would pay your price to your masters but your Wala' (allegiance) would be for me." Her masters said, "If you like, you can pay what remains (of the price of her manumission), (Sufyan the sub-narrator once said), or if you like you can manumit her, but her (inheritance) Al-Wala would be for us. "When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came, I spoke to him about it. He said, "Buy her and manumit her. No doubt Al-Wala' is for the manumitted." Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood on the pulpit (or Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ascended the pulpit as Sufyan once said), and said, "What about some people who impose conditions which are not present in Allah's Book (Laws)? Whoever imposes conditions which are not in Allah's Book (Laws), his conditions will be invalid even if he imposed them a hundred times
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai: "Barirah apni azaadi ke silsile mein meri madad maangne aayi. Maine kaha: 'Agar chaho to main tumhari qeemat tumhare maalikon ko de dun, magar tumhari Wala (waraasat ka rishta) meri hogi.' Uske maalikon ne kaha: 'Agar chaho to baaki qeemat de do (Sufyan ne kaha) ya azaad kar do, magar Wala humari hogi.' Jab Allah ke Rasool aaye, maine unse baat ki. Aap ne farmaya: 'Use khareed kar azaad kar do, Wala hamesha azaad karne wale ki hoti hai.' Phir Allah ke Rasool mimbar par khade hue (ya chadhe, jaise Sufyan ne kaha) aur farmaya: 'Kuch logon ko kya ho gaya hai jo aisi shartein lagate hain jo Allah ki Kitaab mein nahi hain? Jo koi Allah ki Kitaab mein na hone wali shart lagaye, uski shart batil hai, chahe woh sau baar lagaye.'"

e: Narrated Ka`b:In the mosque, I asked Ibn Abi Hadrad to pay the debts which he owed to me and our voices grew louder. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) heard that while he was in his house. So he came to us raising the curtain of his room and said, "O Ka`b!" I replied, "Labaik, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" He said, "O Ka`b! reduce your debt to one half," gesturing with his hand. I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have done so." Then Allah's Apostle said (to Ibn Abi Hadrad), "Get up and pay the debt to him
hi: Ka'b (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Masjid mein maine Ibn Abi Hadrad se apna qarz maangne ko kaha, humari awaazein buland ho gayin. Allah ke Rasool ne apne ghar se yeh suna. Aap apne kamre ka parda uthaate hue humare paas aaye aur farmaya: 'Aye Ka'b!' Maine kaha: 'Labbaik, Ya Rasoolallah!' Aap ne haath se ishara karke farmaya: 'Apna qarz aadha kar do.' Maine kaha: 'Ya Rasoolallah, maine kar diya.' Phir Allah ke Rasool ne (Ibn Abi Hadrad se) kaha: 'Utho aur ada karo.'"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:A black man or a black woman used to sweep the mosque and he or she died. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked about her (or him). He was told that she (or he) had died. He said, "Why did you not inform me? Show me his grave (or her grave)." So he went to her (his) grave and offered her (his) funeral prayer
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke ek kaala aadmi ya aurat masjid saaf kiya karta tha aur uska intiqal ho gaya. Nabi ne uske baare mein pucha, bataya gaya woh guzar chuka hai. Aap ne farmaya: "Tumne mujhe kyun nahi bataya? Mujhe uski qabar dikhao." Aap uski qabar par gaye aur uski namaz-e-janaza padhi.

e: Narrated `Aisha:When the verses of Surat "Al-Baqara"' about the usury Riba were revealed, the Prophet (ﷺ) went to the mosque and recited them in front of the people and then banned the trade of alcohol
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke jab Surah Al-Baqarah ki sood (Riba) ki ayaat nazil hui, Nabi masjid gaye aur logon ke saamne tilawat ki, phir sharab ki tijarat ko haram kar diya.

e: Narrated Abu Rafi: Abu Huraira said, "A man or a woman used to clean the mosque." (A sub-narrator said, 'Most probably a woman..') Then he narrated the Hadith of the Prophet
hi: Abu Rafi (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain, Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Ek mard ya aurat masjid saaf karta tha." (Raawi ne kaha shayad aurat thi.) Phir unhone yeh hadith bayan ki (jaisa upar).

e: Narrated Abu Huraira: "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Last night a big demon (afreet) from the Jinns came to me and wanted to interrupt my prayers (or said something similar) but Allah enabled me to overpower him. I wanted to fasten him to one of the pillars of the mosque so that all of you could See him in the morning but I remembered the statement of my brother Solomon (as stated in Quran): My Lord! Forgive me and bestow on me a kingdom such as shall not belong to anybody after me (38.35)." The sub narrator Rauh said, "He (the demon) was dismissed humiliated
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai: Nabi ne farmaya: "Kal raat Jinnon ka ek bada shaitan mere paas aaya, meri namaz mein rukawat daalna chahta tha (ya isi tarah kuch kaha), magar Allah ne mujhe uspar ghalba diya. Maine chaha use masjid ke ek sutoon se baandh dun taake tum sab subah use dekh sako, magar mujhe apne bhai Suleiman ki dua yaad aayi: 'Mere Rab! Mujhe maaf kar aur mujhe aisi saltanat de jo mere baad kisi ke liye na ho' (38:35)." Rawi Rauh ne bataya: "Woh (shaitan) ruswa hokar bheja gaya."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) sent some horsemen to Najd and they brought a man called Thumama bin Uthal from Bani Hanifa. They fastened him to one of the pillars of the mosque. The Prophet (ﷺ) came and ordered them to release him. He went to a (garden of) date-palms near the mosque, took a bath and entered the mosque again and said, "None has the right to be worshipped but Allah and Muhammad is His Apostle" (i.e. he embraced Islam)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne kuch sawaar Najd bheje, woh Bani Hanifa se Thumama bin Uthal naam ke shaks ko pakad laaye. Unhone use masjid ke ek sutoon se baandh diya. Nabi aaye aur use chhodne ka hukum diya. Woh masjid ke qareeb khajoor ke bagiche mein gaya, ghusl kiya aur masjid mein wapas aakar kaha: "Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahi aur Muhammad uske Rasool hain" (yaani Islam qubool kar liya).

e: Narrated `Aisha:On the day of Al-Khandaq (battle of the Trench) the medial arm vein of Sa`d bin Mu`ad [??] was injured and the Prophet (ﷺ) pitched a tent in the mosque to look after him. There was another tent for Banu Ghaffar in the mosque and the blood started flowing from Sa`d's tent to the tent of Bani Ghaffar. They shouted, "O occupants of the tent! What is coming from you to us?" They found that Sa`d's wound was bleeding profusely and Sa`d died in his tent
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke Khandaq ki jung ke din Sa'd bin Muadh ki kohni ki rag zakhmi ho gayi, Nabi ne unki dekhbhal ke liye masjid mein ek khaimah lagwaya. Wahan Banu Ghaffar ka bhi ek khaimah tha, khoon Sa'd ke khaimay se Banu Ghaffar ke khaimay tak behne laga. Unhone chilla kar kaha: "Aye khaimay walo! Yeh kya cheez humari taraf aa rahi hai?" Unhone paaya ke Sa'd ka zakhm bahut khoon beh raha tha, aur Sa'd apne khaimay mein intiqal kar gaye.

e: Narrated Um Salama:I complained to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that I was sick. He told me to perform the Tawaf behind the people while riding. So I did so and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was praying beside the Ka`ba and reciting the Sura starting with "Wat-tur wa kitabin mastur
hi: Um Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: "Maine Allah ke Rasool se apni bimari ki shikayat ki. Aap ne mujhe sawari par log tawaf ke peechhe se Tawaf karne ko kaha. Maine waisa hi kiya, jabke Allah ke Rasool Ka'ba ke qareeb namaz padh rahe the aur 'Wat-Tur wa Kitabin Mastur' wali Surah tilawat kar rahe the."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Two of the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) departed from him on a dark night and were led by two lights like lamps (going in front of them from Allah as a miracle) lighting the way in front of them, and when they parted, each of them was accompanied by one of these lights till he reached their (respective) houses
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ke do sahaba ek andheri raat unse (mil kar) alag hue, unke aage do roshniyan chirag jaisi (Allah ki taraf se mojze ke tor par) raasta dikhati chal rahin, aur jab woh judaa hue, har ek ke saath ek roshni tab tak rahi jab tak woh apne apne ghar na pahunche.

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) delivered a sermon and said, "Allah gave a choice to one of (His) slaves either to choose this world or what is with Him in the Hereafter. He chose the latter." Abu Bakr wept. I said to myself, "Why is this Sheikh weeping, if Allah gave choice to one (of His) slaves either to choose this world or what is with Him in the Here after and he chose the latter?" And that slave was Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) himself. Abu Bakr knew more than us. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Abu Bakr! Don't weep. The Prophet (ﷺ) added: Abu- Bakr has favored me much with his property and company. If I were to take a Khalil from mankind I would certainly have taken Abu Bakr but the Islamic brotherhood and friendship is sufficient. Close all the gates in the mosque except that of Abu Bakr
hi: Abu Saeed Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne khutba diya aur farmaya: "Allah ne apne ek bande ko duniya aur uske paas jo Aakhirat mein hai, in dono mein se ek chunne ka ikhtiyar diya. Usne doosra chuna." Abu Bakr rone lage. Maine socha: "Yeh Sheikh kyun ro rahe hain, agar Allah ne apne ek bande ko ikhtiyar diya aur usne Aakhirat chuni?" Woh banda khud Allah ke Rasool the. Abu Bakr humse zyada jaante the. Nabi ne farmaya: "Aye Abu Bakr! Mat ro." Aap ne joda: "Abu Bakr ne apne maal aur sohbat se mujhpar bahut ehsaan kiya hai. Agar main insaano mein se koi khaleel (gehra dost) banata to Abu Bakr ko banata, magar Islami bhaichaara aur dosti kaafi hai. Masjid ke sab darwaze band kar do siwaye Abu Bakr ke darwaze ke."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:"Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in his fatal illness came out with a piece of cloth tied round his head and sat on the pulpit. After thanking and praising Allah he said, "There is no one who had done more favor to me with life and property than Abu Bakr bin Abi Quhafa. If I were to take a Khalil, I would certainly have taken Abu- Bakr but the Islamic brotherhood is superior. Close all the small doors in this mosque except that of Abu Bakr
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai: "Allah ke Rasool apni aakhri bimari mein sar par kapda baandhe bahar aaye aur mimbar par baithe. Allah ki hamd-o-sana karne ke baad farmaya: 'Kisi ne bhi mere jaan-maal se itna ehsaan nahi kiya jitna Abu Bakr bin Abi Quhafa ne kiya. Agar main koi khaleel banata to Abu Bakr ko banata, magar Islami bhaichaara zyada bada hai. Is masjid ke sab chhote darwaze band kar do siwaye Abu Bakr ke darwaze ke.'"

e: Narrated Nafi`:Ibn `Umar said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) arrived at Mecca and sent for `Uthman bin Talha. He opened the gate of the Ka`ba and the Prophet, Bilal, Usama bin Zaid and `Uthman bin Talha entered the Ka`ba and then they closed its door (from inside). They stayed there for an hour, and then came out." Ibn `Umar added, "I quickly went to Bilal and asked him (whether the Prophet (ﷺ) had prayed). Bilal replied, 'He prayed in it.' I asked, 'Where?' He replied, 'Between the two pillars.' "Ibn `Umar added, "I forgot to ask how many rak`at he (the Prophet) had prayed in the Ka`ba
hi: Nafi bataate hain, Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Nabi Mecca pahunche aur Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko bulaya. Usne Ka'ba ka darwaza khola, aur Nabi, Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ), Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Uthman bin Talha andar gaye aur darwaza band kar liya. Woh wahan ek ghante rahe, phir bahar aaye." Ibn Umar ne joda: "Main jaldi se Bilal ke paas gaya aur pucha (kya Nabi ne namaz padhi). Bilal ne jawab diya: 'Haan, Aap ne wahan namaz padhi.' Maine pucha: 'Kahan?' Unhone kaha: 'Do sutoon ke darmiyan.'" Ibn Umar ne joda: "Main bhool gaya poochna Nabi ne Ka'ba mein kitni rakat padhi."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent some horse men to Najd and they brought a man called Thumama bin Uthal from Bani Hanifa. They fastened him to one of the pillars of the mosque
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne kuch sawaar Najd bheje, woh Bani Hanifa se Thumama bin Uthal naam ke shaks ko pakad laaye. Unhone use masjid ke ek sutoon se baandh diya.

e: Narrated Al-Sa'ib bin Yazid:I was standing in the mosque and somebody threw a gravel at me. I looked and found that he was `Umar bin Al-Khattab. He said to me, "Fetch those two men to me." When I did, he said to them, "Who are you? (Or) where do you come from?" They replied, "We are from Ta'if." `Umar said, "Were you from this city (Medina) I would have punished you for raising your voices in the mosque of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
hi: As-Sa'ib bin Yazid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Main masjid mein khada tha, kisi ne mujh par kanker maara. Dekha to woh Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Khattab (رضی اللہ عنہ) the. Unhone kaha: 'Un do logon ko mere paas lao.' Jab laaya, unhone pucha: 'Tum kaun ho? (Ya) kahan se ho?' Unhone kaha: 'Hum Ta'if se hain.' Umar ne kaha: 'Agar tum is shehar (Madina) ke hote to main tumhe saza deta, Allah ke Rasool ki masjid mein awaaz uthane par.'"

e: Narrated Ka`b bin Malik:During the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) I asked Ibn Abi Hadrad in the mosque to pay the debts which he owed to me and our voices grew so loud that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) heard them while he was in his house. So he came to us after raising the curtain of his room. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Ka`b bin Malik!" I replied, "Labaik, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." He gestured with his hand to me to reduce the debt to one half. I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), I have done it." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said (to Ibn Abi Hadrad), "Get up and pay it
hi: Ka'b bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Allah ke Rasool ke zamane mein maine masjid mein Ibn Abi Hadrad se apna qarz maangne ko kaha, humari awaazein itni buland ho gayin ke Allah ke Rasool ne apne ghar se sun li. Aap apne kamre ka parda uthaate hue humare paas aaye. Nabi ne farmaya: 'Aye Ka'b bin Malik!' Maine kaha: 'Labbaik, Ya Rasoolallah.' Aap ne haath se ishara karke qarz aadha karne ko kaha. Maine kaha: 'Ya Rasoolallah, maine kar diya.' Allah ke Rasool ne (Ibn Abi Hadrad se) kaha: 'Utho aur ada karo.'"

e: Narrated Nafi`:Ibn `Umar said, "While the Prophet (ﷺ) was on the pulpit, a man asked him how to offer the night prayers. He replied, 'Pray two rak`at at a time and then two and then two and so on, and if you are afraid of the dawn (the approach of the time of the Fajr prayer) pray one rak`a and that will be the witr for all the rak`at which you have offered." Ibn `Umar said, "The last rak`at of the night prayer should be odd, for the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered it to be so
hi: Nafi bataate hain, Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Nabi mimbar par the, ek shaks ne raat ki namaz ke baare mein pucha. Aap ne farmaya: 'Do-do rakat karke padho, aur agar Fajr ka waqt hone ka dar ho to ek rakat padho, yeh saari padhi hui rakaton ka Witr ban jayega.'" Ibn Umar ne kaha: "Raat ki aakhri rakat taaq honi chahiye, kyunke Nabi ne yehi hukum diya."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was delivering the sermon and asked him how to offer the night prayers. The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, 'Pray two rak`at at a time and then two and then two and so on and if you are afraid of dawn (the approach of the time of the Fajr prayer) pray one rak`a and that will be the witr for all the rak`at which you have prayed." Narrated 'Ubaidullah bin `Abdullah bin `Umar: A man called the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was in the mosque
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke ek shaks Nabi ke paas khutba dete waqt aaya aur raat ki namaz ke baare mein pucha. Nabi ne farmaya: "Do-do rakat padho, aur agar Fajr ka dar ho to ek rakat padho, yeh Witr ban jayega." Ubaidullah bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks ne Nabi ko bulaya jabke Aap masjid mein the.

e: Narrated Abu Waqid al-Laithi:While Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was sitting in the mosque (with some people) three men came, two of them came in front of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and the third one went away, and then one of them found a place in the circle and sat there while the second man sat behind the gathering, and the third one went away. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) finished his preaching, he said, "Shall I tell you about these three persons? One of them betook himself to Allah and so Allah accepted him and accommodated him; the second felt shy before Allah so Allah did the same for him and sheltered him in His Mercy (and did not punish him), while the third turned his face from Allah, and went away, so Allah turned His face from him likewise
hi: Abu Waqid Al-Laithi (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Allah ke Rasool masjid mein (kuch logon ke saath) baithe the, teen aadmi aaye, do Aap ke saamne aaye, teesra chala gaya. Ek halqe mein jagah paakar baith gaya, doosra majlis ke peechhe baith gaya, aur teesra chala gaya. Jab Allah ke Rasool ne apna waaz khatam kiya, farmaya: 'Kya main tumhe in teen logon ke baare mein na bataun? Ek ne Allah ki taraf rukh kiya, Allah ne use qubool kiya aur jagah di; doosre ne Allah se haya ki, Allah ne bhi (usi tarah) usse haya ki aur apni rehmat mein panah di (saza nahi di); teesra Allah se mun mod kar chala gaya, Allah ne bhi usse mun mod liya.'"

e: Narrated `Abbad bin Tamim:that his uncle said, "I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) lying flat (on his back) in the mosque with one leg on the other." Narrated Sa`id bin Al-Musaiyab that `Umar and `Uthman used to do the same
hi: Abbad bin Tamim, apne chacha ke hawale se: "Maine Allah ke Rasool ko masjid mein chit lete dekha, ek taang doosri par rakhe hue." Sa'id bin Al-Musaiyab bataate hain ke Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bhi aisa hi karte the.

e: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) I had seen my parents following Islam since I attained the age of puberty. Not a day passed but the Prophet (ﷺ) visited us, both in the mornings and evenings. My father Abu Bakr thought of building a mosque in the courtyard of his house and he did so. He used to pray and recite the Qur'an in it. The pagan women and their children used to stand by him and look at him with surprise. Abu Bakr was a Softhearted person and could not help weeping while reciting the Qur'an. The chiefs of the Quraish pagans became afraid of that (i.e. that their children and women might be affected by the recitation of Qur'an)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai: "Jab se main balig hui, maine apne maa-baap ko Islam par paaya. Koi din aisa nahi guzarta jab Nabi humare paas subah-shaam na aate. Mere waalid Abu Bakr ne apne ghar ke aangan mein ek masjid banane ka socha aur banai. Woh usme namaz padhte aur Quran padhte. Mushrik aurtein aur unke bachche unke paas khade hokar hairat se unhe dekhte. Abu Bakr bahut narm-dil the, Quran padhte hue rone se khud ko rok nahi paate the. Quraish ke mushrik sardar iss baat se pareshan hue (ke unke bachche aur aurtein Quran ki tilawat se mutassir na ho jayen)."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The prayer offered in congregation is twenty five times more superior (in reward) to the prayer offered alone in one's house or in a business center, because if one performs ablution and does it perfectly, and then proceeds to the mosque with the sole intention of praying, then for each step which he takes towards the mosque, Allah upgrades him a degree in reward and (forgives) crosses out one sin till he enters the mosque. When he enters the mosque he is considered in prayer as long as he is waiting for the prayer and the angels keep on asking for Allah's forgiveness for him and they keep on saying: 'O Allah! Be Merciful to him, O Allah! Forgive him, as long as he keeps on sitting at his praying place and does not pass wind. (See Hadith No)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Jamaat ki namaz akele padhi namaz se (chahe ghar mein ho ya bazaar mein) pachees guna behtar hai, kyunke jab koi mukammal wudu karta hai aur sirf namaz ki niyyat se masjid ki taraf nikalta hai, to har qadam par Allah uska darja badhata hai aur ek gunah mitaata hai, jab tak woh masjid mein daakhil na ho jaaye. Jab masjid mein daakhil ho jaata hai, woh namaz mein hi shumar hota hai jab tak namaz ka intezar kare, aur farishte uske liye Allah se maafi maangte rehte hain: 'Aye Allah! Ispar reham kar. Aye Allah! Ise maaf kar,' jab tak woh apni jagah baitha rahe aur hadath (wudu tootne wali cheez) na ho."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar or Ibn `Amr:The Prophet (ﷺ) clasped his hands, by interlacing his fingers
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ya Ibn Amr (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne apni ungliyan aapas mein jorin (haath baandhne ka ishara).

e: Narrated `Abdullah:That Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O `Abdullah bin `Amr! What will be your condition when you will be left with the sediments of (worst) people?" (They will be in conflict with each other)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Aye Abdullah bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ)! Us waqt tumhara kya haal hoga jab tum (badtareen) logon ke baaqiyaat ke saath rah jaoge?" (Jo aapas mein ladte rahenge)

e: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A faithful believer to a faithful believer is like the bricks of a wall, enforcing each other." While (saying that) the Prophet (ﷺ) clasped his hands, by interlacing his fingers
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Ek momin doosre momin ke liye deewar ki eenton ki tarah hai, ek-doosre ko mazboot karte hain." Yeh kehte huye Nabi ne apni ungliyan aapas mein jorin.

e: Narrates Ibn Seereen:Abu Huraira said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) led us in one of the two `Isha' prayers (Abu Huraira named that prayer but I forgot it)." Abu Huraira added, "He prayed two rak`at and then finished the prayer with Taslim. He stood up near a piece of wood Lying across the mosque and leaned on it in such a way as if he was angry. Then he put his right hand over the left and clasped his hands by interlacing his fingers and then put his right cheek on the back of his left hand. The people who were in haste left the mosque through its gates. They wondered whether the prayer was reduced. And amongst them were Abu Bakr and `Umar but they hesitated to ask the Prophet. A long-handed man called Dhul-Yadain asked the Prophet, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Have you forgotten or has the prayer been reduced?' The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, 'I have neither forgotten nor has the prayer been reduced' The Prophet (ﷺ) added, 'Is what Dhul Yadain has said true?' They (the people) said, 'Yes, it is true.' The Prophet (ﷺ) stood up again and led the prayer, completing the remaining prayer, forgotten by him, and performed Taslim, and then said, 'Allahu Akbar.' And then he did a prostration as he used to prostrate or longer than that. He then raised his head saying, 'Allahu Akbar; he then again said, 'Allahu Akbar', and prostrated as he used to prostrate or longer than that. Then he raised his head and said, 'Allahu Akbar.' " (The subnarrator added, "I think that they asked (Ibn Seereen) whether the Prophet (ﷺ) completed the prayer with Taslim. He replied, "I heard that `Imran bin Husain had said, 'Then he (the Prophet) did Taslim
hi: Ibn Seereen bataate hain ke Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool ne humein do Isha namazon mein se ek ki imamat ki" (Abu Huraira ne naam liya tha magar rawi bhool gaye). Abu Huraira ne joda: "Aap ne do rakat padhi, phir Taslim se namaz khatam ki. Aap masjid mein padi ek lakdi ke qareeb khade hokar usse tek lagai, jaise naraz ho. Phir dahina haath baaye par rakha, ungliyan aapas mein jorin aur apna dahina gaal baaye haath ki pusht par rakha. Jaldbaaz log masjid ke darwazon se nikal gaye, unhe shak hua namaz kam ho gayi. Unme Abu Bakr aur Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bhi the magar Nabi se poochne mein hichkichaye. Dhul-Yadain naam ka ek lambe-haathon wale shaks ne pucha: 'Ya Rasoolallah! Kya aap bhool gaye ya namaz kam ho gayi?' Nabi ne jawab diya: 'Na bhoola hoon na namaz kam hui.' Nabi ne joda: 'Kya jo Dhul-Yadain ne kaha sach hai?' Logon ne kaha: 'Haan, sach hai.' Nabi phir khade hue aur baaki namaz padhai, jo bhool gaye the, Taslim ki, phir 'Allahu Akbar' kaha aur ek sajda kiya jaisa ya usse lamba karte the. Phir sar utha kar 'Allahu Akbar' kaha, phir dobara 'Allahu Akbar' kaha aur sajda kiya jaisa ya usse lamba. Phir sar utha kar 'Allahu Akbar' kaha." (Rawi ne joda: mujhe lagta hai unhone Ibn Seereen se pucha kya Nabi ne Taslim se namaz mukammal ki, unhone jawab diya: "Maine suna hai Imran bin Husain (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, phir Aap ne Taslim ki.")

e: Narrated Fudail bin Sulaiman:Musa bin `Uqba said, "I saw Salim bin `Abdullah looking for some places on the way and prayed there. He narrated that his father used to pray there, and had seen the Prophet (ﷺ) praying at those very places." Narrated Nafi` on the authority of Ibn `Umar who said, "I used to pray at those places." Musa the narrator added, "I asked Salim on which he said, 'I agree with Nafi` concerning those places, except the mosque situated at the place called Sharaf Ar-Rawha
hi: Fudail bin Sulaiman bataate hain ke Musa bin Uqba ne kaha: "Maine Salim bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko raaste mein kuch jagahein dhoondhte aur wahan namaz padhte dekha. Unhone bataya ke unke waalid wahan namaz padhte the, aur unhone Nabi ko bhi unhi jagahon par namaz padhte dekha tha." Nafi, Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke hawale se bataate hain: "Main un jagahon par namaz padhta tha." Musa ne joda: "Maine Salim se pucha, unhone kaha: 'Main un jagahon ke baare mein Nafi se muttafiq hoon, siwaye Sharaf Ar-Rawha ki masjid ke.'"

e: The narrated Hadith is about the various places on the way from Medina to Mecca where the Prophet (ﷺ) prayed and is not translated
hi: (Yeh Hadith Madina se Mecca ke raaste par Nabi ke namaz padhne ki mukhtalif jagahon ka silsilewaar bayaan hain — inka tarjuma nahi kiya jaata, kyunke asal kitaab mein bhi yeh sirf jagahon ke naam ki fehrist hai, koi naya matlab wala hukum nahi.)

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Once I came riding a she-ass when I had just attained the age of puberty. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was offering the prayer at Mina with no wall in front of him and I passed in front of some of the row. There I dismounted and let my she-ass loose to graze and entered the row and nobody objected to me about it
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: "Ek baar main gadhi par sawar hokar aaya, us waqt main balig hone ke qareeb tha. Allah ke Rasool Mina mein namaz padha rahe the, Aap ke saamne koi deewar nahi thi. Main kuch saf ke saamne se guzra. Wahan maine gadhi ko charne ke liye chhod diya aur saf mein shamil ho gaya, kisi ne mujhe mana nahi kiya."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came out on `Id day, he used to order that a Harba [??] (a short spear) to be planted in front of him (as a Sutra for his prayer) and then he used to pray facing it with the people behind him and used to do the same while on a journey. After the Prophet (ﷺ) , this practice was adopted by the Muslim rulers (who followed his traditions)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke jab bhi Allah ke Rasool Eid ke din bahar nikalte, apne saamne ek Harba (chhota neza) gaadne ka hukum dete (Sutra ke liye), phir uski taraf mun karke namaz padhte, log peechhe hote. Aap safar mein bhi aisa hi karte. Nabi ke baad, Musalman hukmaranon ne yehi tareeqa apnaya.

e: Narrated `Aun bin Abi Juhaifa:I heard my father saying, "The Prophet (ﷺ) led us, and prayed a two-rak`at Zuhr prayer and then a two-rak` at `Asr prayer at Al-Batha' [??] with a short spear (planted) in front of him (as a Sutra) while women and donkeys were passing in front of him (beyond that stick)
hi: Aun bin Abi Juhaifa bataate hain: "Maine apne waalid ko kehte suna: 'Nabi ne humari imamat ki aur Al-Batha mein do rakat Zuhr aur do rakat Asr padhi, saamne ek chhota neza gaada hua tha, jabke aurtein aur gadhe uske aage se guzarte the.'"

e: Narrated Sahl (bin Sa`d):The distance between the Musalla of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and the wall was just sufficient for a sheep to pass through
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ki Musalla aur deewar ke darmiyan itni jagah thi ke ek bhed guzar sake.

e: Narrated Salama:The distance between the wall of the mosque and the pulpit was hardly enough for a sheep to pass through
hi: Salama (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke masjid ki deewar aur mimbar ke darmiyan itni jagah thi ke bamushkil ek bhed guzar sake.

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to get a Harba planted in front of him (as a Sutra) and pray behind it
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi apne saamne Harba gaadwate aur uske peechhe namaz padhte.

e: Narrated `Aun bin Abi Juhaifa:that he had heard his father saying, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to us at midday and water was brought for his ablution. He performed ablution and led us in Zuhr and `Asr prayers with a short spear (or stick) planted in front of him (as a Sutra), while women and donkeys were passing beyond it
hi: Aun bin Abi Juhaifa, apne waalid ke hawale se: "Allah ke Rasool dopahar ko humare paas aaye, wudu ke liye paani laaya gaya. Aap ne wudu kiya aur humari Zuhr-Asr namaz ki imamat ki, saamne ek chhota neza gaada hua tha, jabke aurtein aur gadhe uske peechhe se guzarte the."

e: Narrated Anas Ibn Malik:Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) went for answering the call of nature, I and another boy used to go after him with a staff, a stick or a short spear (or stick) and a tumbler of water and when he finished from answering the call of nature we would hand that tumbler of water to him
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke jab bhi Nabi qaza-e-hajat ke liye jaate, main aur ek doosra ladka ek chhadi, danda ya neza aur paani ka gilaas leke unke peechhe jaate, aur jab Aap faarigh ho jaate, hum unhe paani dete.

e: Narrated Abu Juhaifa:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came out at midday and offered a two-rak`at Zuhr and `Asr prayers at Al-Batha and a short spear (or stick) was planted in front of him (as a Sutra). He performed ablution and the people took the remaining water left after his ablution and rubbed their bodies with it
hi: Abu Juhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Allah ke Rasool dopahar ko nikle aur Al-Batha mein do rakat Zuhr aur Asr padhi, saamne ek chhota neza gaada hua tha. Aap ne wudu kiya aur logon ne baqi paani leke apne badan par mala.

e: Narrated Yazid bin Al `Ubaid:I used to accompany Salama bin Al-Akwa` and he used to pray behind the pillar which was near the place where the Qur'ans were kept. I said, "O Abu Muslim! I see you always seeking to pray behind this pillar." He replied, "I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) always seeking to pray near that pillar
hi: Yazid bin Al-Ubaid bataate hain: "Main Salama bin Al-Akwa (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath rehta tha, woh us sutoon ke peechhe namaz padhte jo Qurano ke rakhne ki jagah ke qareeb tha. Maine kaha: 'Aye Abu Muslim! Main dekhta hoon aap hamesha isi sutoon ke peechhe padhna chahte hain.' Unhone jawab diya: 'Maine Allah ke Rasool ko hamesha usi sutoon ke qareeb padhna chahte dekha.'"

e: Narrated Anas:I saw the most famous people amongst the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) hurrying towards the pillars at the Maghrib prayer before the Prophet (ﷺ) came for the prayer
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai: "Maine Nabi ke mashhoor sahaba ko Maghrib ki namaz se pehle Nabi ke aane se pehle hi sutoon ki taraf jaldi jaate dekha."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) entered the Ka`ba along with Usama bin Zaid, `Uthman bin Talha and Bilal and remained there for a long time. When they came out, I was the first man to enter the Ka`ba. I asked Bilal "Where did the Prophet (ﷺ) pray?" Bilal replied, "Between the two front Pillars
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke Nabi Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ), Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath Ka'ba mein daakhil hue aur der tak rahe. Jab woh bahar aaye, main sabse pehle Ka'ba mein daakhil hone wala tha. Maine Bilal se pucha: "Nabi ne kahan namaz padhi?" Bilal ne jawab diya: "Do agle sutoon ke darmiyan."

e: Narrated Nafi`:`Abdullah bin `Umar said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered the Ka`ba along with Usama bin Zaid, Bilal and `Uthman bin Talha Al-Hajabi and closed the door and stayed there for some time. I asked Bilal when he came out, 'What did the Prophet (ﷺ) do?' He replied, 'He offered prayer with one pillar to his left and one to his right and three behind.' In those days the Ka`ba was supported by six pillars." Malik said: "There were two pillars on his (the Prophet's) right side
hi: Nafi bataate hain, Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ), Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Hajabi ke saath Ka'ba mein daakhil hue aur darwaza band karke kuch der rahe. Jab woh bahar aaye, maine Bilal se pucha: 'Nabi ne kya kiya?' Unhone jawab diya: 'Aap ne namaz padhi, ek sutoon apni baayi taraf, ek dahini taraf, aur teen peechhe rakhe.' Us waqt Ka'ba chhe sutoon par khada tha." Malik ne kaha: "Nabi ki dahini taraf do sutoon the."

e: Narrated Nafi':Whenever 'Abdullah entered the Ka'bah, he used to go ahead leaving the door of the Ka'bah behind him. He would proceed on till the remaining distance between him and the opposite wall was about three cubits. Then he would offer prayer there where the Prophet (ﷺ) had offered Salat, as Bilal informed me. Ibn 'Umar said, "It does not matter for any of us to offer prayers at any place inside the Ka'bah
hi: Nafi bataate hain: "Jab bhi Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) Ka'ba mein daakhil hote, darwaze ko peechhe chhodte hue aage badhte yahan tak ke saamne wali deewar se taqreeban teen haath ki doori reh jaati. Phir wahan namaz padhte jahan Nabi ne padhi thi, jaisa Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne bataya." Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Ka'ba ke andar kisi bhi jagah namaz padhna theek hai."

e: Narrated Nafi`:"The Prophet (ﷺ) used to make his she-camel sit across and he would pray facing it (as a Sutra)." I asked, "What would the Prophet (ﷺ) do if the she-camel was provoked and moved?" He said, "He would take its camel-saddle and put it in front of him and pray facing its back part (as a Sutra). And Ibn `Umar used to do the same." (This indicates that one should not pray except behind a Sutra)
hi: Nafi bataate hain: "Nabi apni oontni ko aade rukh baithate aur uski taraf mun karke namaz padhte." Maine pucha: "Agar oontni bhadak kar hil jaye to Nabi kya karte?" Unhone jawab diya: "Aap uski zeen leke apne saamne rakh dete aur uski pusht ki taraf mun karke padhte." Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bhi aisa hi karte the. (Yeh dikhata hai ke Sutra ke bina namaz na padhni chahiye.)

e: Narrated `Aisha:Do you make us (women) equal to dogs and donkeys? While I used to lie in my bed, the Prophet (ﷺ) would come and pray facing the middle of the bed. I used to consider it not good to stand in front of him in his prayers. So I used to slip away slowly and quietly from the foot of the bed till I got out of my guilt
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai: "Kya tum humein (aurton ko) kutton aur gadhon ke barabar samajhte ho? Jab main apne bistar par leti hoti, Nabi aakar bistar ke beech ki taraf mun karke namaz padhte. Mujhe Aap ke saamne khada hona theek nahi lagta, isliye main dheere se paayintī ki taraf se sarak jaati yahan tak ke bistar se bahar nikal jaati."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, (what is ascribed to him in the following Hadith): Narrated Abu Salih As-Samman: I saw Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri praying on a Friday, behind something which acted as a Sutra. A young man from Bani Abi Mu'ait [??] , wanted to pass in front of him, but Abu Sa`id repulsed him with a push on his chest. Finding no alternative he again tried to pass but Abu Sa`id pushed him with a greater force. The young man abused Abu Sa`id and went to Marwan and lodged a complaint against Abu Sa`id and Abu Sa`id followed the young man to Marwan who asked him, "O Abu Sa`id! What has happened between you and the son of your brother?" Abu Sa`id said to him, "I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, 'If anybody amongst you is praying behind something as a Sutra and somebody tries to pass in front of him, then he should repulse him and if he refuses, he should use force against him for he is a Shaitan (a Satan)
hi: Abu Saeed (رضی اللہ عنہ) se yeh riwayat hai. Abu Salih As-Samman bataate hain: "Maine Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko Jumme ke din kisi cheez ko Sutra banakar namaz padhte dekha. Bani Abi Mu'ait qabile ka ek jawan unke saamne se guzarna chahta tha, magar Abu Saeed ne use seene par dhakka dekar rok diya. Kuch aur raasta na paakar usne phir koshish ki, Abu Saeed ne zyada zor se dhakka diya. Jawan ne Abu Saeed ko gaali di aur Marwan ke paas shikayat lekar gaya. Abu Saeed bhi jawan ke peechhe Marwan ke paas gaye. Marwan ne pucha: 'Aye Abu Saeed! Tumhare aur apne bhatije ke darmiyan kya hua?' Abu Saeed ne jawab diya: 'Maine Nabi ko farmate suna: Agar koi Sutra ke peechhe namaz padh raha ho aur koi uske saamne se guzarne ki koshish kare, to use roke, aur agar woh na mane to zabardasti roke, kyunke woh shaitan hai.'"

e: Narrated Busr bin Sa`id:that Zaid bin Khalid sent him to Abi Juhaim to ask him what he had heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about a person passing in front of another person who was praying. Abu Juhaim replied, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'If the person who passes in front of another person in prayer knew the magnitude of his sin he would prefer to wait for 40 (days, months or years) rather than to pass in front of him." Abu An-Nadr said, "I do not remember exactly whether he said 40 days, months or years
hi: Busr bin Sa'id bataate hain ke Zaid bin Khalid (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne unhe Abu Juhaim ke paas bheja yeh poochne ke Allah ke Rasool se namaz padhne wale ke saamne se guzarne ke baare mein kya suna. Abu Juhaim ne jawab diya: "Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: 'Agar namaz padhne wale ke saamne se guzarne wala apne gunah ki shiddat jaanta, to chalis (din, mahine, ya saal) intezar karna behtar samajhta, saamne se guzarne se.'" Abu An-Nadr ne kaha: "Mujhe yaad nahi unhone 40 din kaha, mahine ya saal."

e: Narrated `Aisha:The things which annul the prayers were mentioned before me. They said, "Prayer is annulled by a dog, a donkey and a woman (if they pass in front of the praying people)." I said, "You have made us (i.e. women) dogs. I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) praying while I used to lie in my bed between him and the Qibla. Whenever I was in need of something, I would slip away. for I disliked to face him
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke unke saamne un cheezon ka zikar hua jo namaz todti hain. Logon ne kaha: "Namaz kutta, gadha, aur aurat (agar saamne se guzarein) se toot jaati hai." Ayesha ne kaha: "Tumne humein (aurton ko) kutton jaisa bana diya. Maine Nabi ko namaz padhte dekha jabke main unke aur Qibla ke darmiyan apne bistar par leti hoti. Jab bhi mujhe kisi cheez ki zaroorat hoti, main chupke se sarak jaati kyunke mujhe unke saamne aana napasand tha."

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to pray while I was sleeping across in his bed in front of him. Whenever he wanted to pray witr, he would wake me up and I would pray witr
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke Nabi namaz padhte jabke main unke saamne bistar par aade leti hoti. Jab Witr padhna chahte, mujhe jaga dete aur main Witr padh leti.

e: Narrated `Aisha:the wife of the Prophet, "I used to sleep in front of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with my legs opposite his Qibla (facing him); and whenever he prostrated, he pushed my feet and I withdrew them and whenever he stood, I stretched them." `Aisha added, "In those days there were no lamps in the houses
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai: "Main Allah ke Rasool ke saamne leti thi, meri taangein unke Qibla ki taraf hoti. Jab bhi Aap sajda karte, mere paon halke se hataate aur main hata leti, jab khade hote, main phaila deti." Ayesha ne joda: "Us waqt gharon mein chirag nahi hote the."

e: Narrated `Aisha:The things which annul prayer were mentioned before me (and those were): a dog, a donkey and a woman. I said, "You have compared us (women) to donkeys and dogs. By Allah! I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) praying while I used to lie in (my) bed between him and the Qibla. Whenever I was in need of something, I disliked to sit and trouble the Prophet. So, I would slip away by the side of his feet
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke unke saamne namaz todne wali cheezon ka zikar hua — kutta, gadha, aurat. Maine kaha: "Tumne humein gadhon aur kutton ke barabar kar diya. Allah ki qasam, maine Nabi ko namaz padhte dekha jabke main unke aur Qibla ke darmiyan bistar par leti hoti. Jab bhi mujhe kisi cheez ki zaroorat hoti, mujhe baith kar Nabi ko taklif dena napasand tha, isliye main unke paon ki taraf se sarak jaati."

e: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to get up at night and pray while I used to lie across between him and the Qibla on his family's bed
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool raat ko uthte aur namaz padhte jabke main unke aur Qibla ke darmiyan unke ghar ke bistar par aade leti hoti.

e: Narrated Abu Qatada Al-Ansari:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was praying and he was carrying Umama the daughter of Zainab, the daughter of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and she was the daughter of 'As bin Rabi`a bin `Abd Shams. When he prostrated, he put her down and when he stood, he carried her (on his neck)
hi: Abu Qatada (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ansari (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool namaz padh rahe the aur apni naati Umama (Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) ki beti, jo Allah ke Rasool ki beti thi, aur Aas bin Rabi'a bin Abd Shams ki beti bhi) ko goud mein liye huye the. Jab sajda karte, use zameen par rakh dete, jab khade hote, use (kandhe par) utha lete.

e: Narrated Maimuna bint Al-Harith:My bed was beside the praying place (Musalla) of the Prophet (ﷺ) and sometimes his garment fell on me while I used to lie in my bed
hi: Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Al-Harith (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: "Mera bistar Nabi ki Musalla ke bagal mein hota, kabhi-kabhi unke kapde mujh par gir jaate jabke main apne bistar par leti hoti."

e: Narrated Maimuna:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to pray while I used to sleep beside him during my periods (menses) and in prostration his garment used to touch me
hi: Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke Nabi namaz padhte jabke main haiz ke dauran unke bagal mein soti, sajda mein unke kapde mujhse chhoo jaate.

e: Narrated `Aisha:It is not good that you people have made us (women) equal to dogs and donkeys. No doubt I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) praying while I used to lie between him and the Qibla and when he wanted to prostrate, he pushed my legs and I withdrew them
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai: "Achha nahi ke tum logon ne humein (aurton ko) kutton aur gadhon ke barabar kar diya. Maine Allah ke Rasool ko namaz padhte dekha jabke main unke aur Qibla ke darmiyan leti hoti, jab sajda karna chahte, mere paon hataate aur main hata leti."

e: Narrated `Amr bin Maimun [??]:`Abdullah bin Mas`ud said, "While Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was praying beside the Ka`ba, there were some Quraish people sitting in a gathering. One of them said, 'Don't you see this (who does deeds just to show off)? Who amongst you can go and bring the dung, blood and the Abdominal contents (intestines, etc.) of the slaughtered camels of the family of so and so and then wait till he prostrates and put that in between his shoulders?' The most unfortunate amongst them (`Uqba bin Abi Mu'ait) went (and brought them) and when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prostrated, he put them between his shoulders. The Prophet remained in prostration and they laughed so much so that they fell on each other. A passerby went to Fatima, who was a young girl in those days. She came running and the Prophet (ﷺ) was still in prostration. She removed them and cursed upon the Quraish on their faces. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) completed his prayer, he said, 'O Allah! Take revenge on Quraish.' He said so thrice and added, 'O Allah! take revenge on `Amr bin Hisham, `Utba bin Rabi`a, Shaiba bin Rabi`a, Al-Walid bin `Utba, Umaiya bin Khalaf, `Uqba bin Abi Mu'ait and `Umara bin Al-Walid." `Abdullah added, "By Allah! I saw all of them dead in the battle field on the day of Badr and they were dragged and thrown in the Qalib (a well) at Badr: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then said, 'Allah's curse has descended upon the people of the Qalib (well)
hi: Amr bin Maimun bataate hain, Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Jab Allah ke Rasool Ka'ba ke qareeb namaz padh rahe the, Quraish ke kuch log baithe the. Ek ne kaha: 'Dekho iss dikhawe wale ko. Tum mein se kaun falaan qabile ke kisi ke oont ka gobar, khoon aur aanten la sake aur sajda karne tak intezar karke unke shoulders ke beech rakh de?' Sabse badnaseeb shaks (Uqba bin Abi Mu'ait) gaya (aur laaya) aur jab Allah ke Rasool ne sajda kiya, usne unke shoulders ke beech rakh diya. Nabi sajde mein rahe, aur woh log itna hanse ke ek-doosre par girne lage. Ek guzarne wala Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ke paas gaya, jo us waqt jawan ladki thi. Woh daudti hui aayi, Nabi tab bhi sajde mein the. Usne woh cheezein hataayi aur Quraish par unke mun par laanat bheji. Namaz khatam karke, Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: 'Aye Allah! Quraish se badla le.' Yeh teen baar kaha aur joda: 'Aye Allah! Amr bin Hisham, Utba bin Rabi'a, Shaiba bin Rabi'a, Al-Walid bin Utba, Umaiya bin Khalaf, Uqba bin Abi Mu'ait aur Umara bin Al-Walid se badla le.'" Abdullah ne joda: "Allah ki qasam, maine unme se har ek ko Badr ke din maidan-e-jung mein murda dekha, aur unhe ghaseet kar Badr ke kuye mein phenka gaya. Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: 'Kuye walon par Allah ki laanat utar chuki hai.'"

e: Narrated Ibn Shihab:Once `Umar bin `Abdul `Aziz delayed the prayer and `Urwa bin Az-Zubair went to him and said, "Once in 'Iraq, Al-Mughira bin Shu`ba delayed his prayers and Abi Mas`ud Al-Ansari went to him and said, 'O Mughira! What is this? Don't you know that once Gabriel came and offered the prayer (Fajr prayer) and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prayed too, then he prayed again (Zuhr prayer) and so did Allah's Apostle and again he prayed (`Asr prayers and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did the same; again he prayed (Maghrib-prayer) and so did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and again prayed (`Isha prayer) and so did Allah's Apostle and (Gabriel) said, 'I was ordered to do so (to demonstrate the prayers prescribed to you)?'" `Umar (bin `Abdul `Aziz) said to `Urwa, "Be sure of what you Say. Did Gabriel lead Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) at the stated times of the prayers?" `Urwa replied, "Bashir bin Abi Mas`ud narrated like this on the authority of his father." `Urwa added, "Aisha told me that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to pray `Asr prayer when the sunshine was still inside her residence (during the early time of `Asr)
hi: Ibn Shihab bataate hain ke ek baar Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdul Aziz ne namaz mein der ki, Urwa bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) unke paas gaye aur kaha: "Ek baar Iraq mein Al-Mughira bin Shu'ba (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne namaz mein der ki, Abi Mas'ud Al-Ansari unke paas gaye aur kaha: 'Aye Mughira! Yeh kya hai? Kya tumhe nahi pata ke Jibreel aaye aur namaz padhi (Fajr), Allah ke Rasool ne bhi padhi; phir dobara padhi (Zuhr) aur Allah ke Rasool ne bhi padhi; phir padhi (Asr) aur Allah ke Rasool ne bhi wahi kiya; phir padhi (Maghrib) aur Allah ke Rasool ne bhi wahi kiya; phir padhi (Isha) aur Allah ke Rasool ne bhi wahi kiya, aur (Jibreel ne) kaha: Mujhe yeh (namazon ke waqt dikhane ka) hukum diya gaya tha.'" Umar (bin Abdul Aziz) ne Urwa se kaha: "Achhi tarah yaqeen kar lo jo keh rahe ho. Kya Jibreel ne Allah ke Rasool ki imamat muqarrar waqton par ki thi?" Urwa ne jawab diya: "Bashir bin Abi Mas'ud ne apne waalid ke hawale se yehi bayan kiya." Urwa ne joda: "Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne mujhe bataya ke Allah ke Rasool Asr padhte the jab dhoop abhi unke kamre mein hoti thi (Asr ke shuru waqt mein)."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:"Once a delegation of `Abdul Qais came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "We belong to such and such branch of the tribe of Rabi'ah and we can only come to you in the sacred months. Order us to do something good so that we may take it from you and also invite to it those whom we have left behind (at home)." So he said, "I order you to do four things and forbid you from four things: To believe in Allah" - and then he explained it to them "to testify that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah and that I am Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), to establish the prayers (at the stated times), to pay the Zakat (obligatory charity), to hand me the Khumus (fifth) if you acquire spoils of war. And I forbid from (using) Dubba, Hantam, Muqaiyyar, and Naqir (all these were utensils used for the preparation of alcoholic drinks)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai: "Abdul Qais qabile ka wafd Allah ke Rasool ke paas aaya aur kaha: 'Hum Rabia qabile ki falaan shaakh se hain, hum sirf haram maheenon mein aap tak pahunch sakte hain. Humein koi achhi baat batayein jise hum apni jagah wapas jaakar apne peechhe chhode logon ko bhi bata sakein.' Aap ne farmaya: 'Main tumhe chaar baaton ka hukum deta hoon aur chaar se rokta hoon: Allah par iman lao' — phir Aap ne samjhaya — 'gawahi do ke Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahi aur main Allah ka Rasool hoon, namaz qaim karo, zakat do, aur maal-e-ghanimat ka paanchwan hissa (Khumus) mujhe do. Aur main tumhe Dubba, Hantam, Muqaiyyar aur Naqir (yeh sab sharab banane ke bartan the) istemal karne se mana karta hoon.'"

e: Narrated Jarir bin `Abdullah:I gave the pledge of allegiance to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for to offer prayers perfectly, to pay Zakat regularly, and to give good advice to every Muslim
hi: Jarir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Maine Allah ke Rasool se namaz achhi tarah padhne, zakat baqaidgi se dene, aur har Musalman ka khair-khwaah rehne par bai'at ki."

e: Narrated Shaqiq:that he had heard Hudhaifa saying, "Once I was sitting with `Umar and he said, 'Who amongst you remembers the statement of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about the afflictions?' I said, 'I know it as the Prophet (ﷺ) had said it.' `Umar said, 'No doubt you are bold.' I said, 'The afflictions caused for a man by his wife, money, children and neighbor are expiated by his prayers, fasting, charity and by enjoining (what is good) and forbidding (what is evil).' `Umar said, 'I did not mean that but I asked about that affliction which will spread like the waves of the sea.' I (Hudhaifa) said, 'O leader of the faithful believers! You need not be afraid of it as there is a closed door between you and it.' `Umar asked, Will the door be broken or opened?' I replied, 'It will be broken.' `Umar said, 'Then it will never be closed again.' I was asked whether `Umar knew that door. I replied that he knew it as one knows that there will be night before the tomorrow morning. I narrated a Hadith that was free from any misstatement" The subnarrator added that they deputized Masruq to ask Hudhaifa (about the door). Hudhaifa said, "The door was `Umar himself
hi: Shaqiq bataate hain ke unhone Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko kehte suna: "Ek baar main Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath baitha tha, unhone kaha: 'Tum mein se kise Allah ke Rasool ki fitno ke baare mein kahi baat yaad hai?' Maine kaha: 'Mujhe yaad hai jaise Nabi ne kahi thi.' Umar ne kaha: 'Beshak tum himmat wale ho.' Maine kaha: 'Mard ki fitne uski biwi, maal, aulad aur padosi se hoti hain, jinka kaffara namaz, roza, sadqa aur amr-bil-ma'roof-nahi-anil-munkar se ho jaata hai.' Umar ne kaha: 'Mera matlab yeh nahi tha, mera matlab us fitne se tha jo samundar ki lehron ki tarah phailegi.' Maine kaha: 'Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen! Aapko iski fikar nahi honi chahiye, kyunke aapke aur uske darmiyan ek band darwaza hai.' Umar ne pucha: 'Kya darwaza toota jayega ya khola jayega?' Maine jawab diya: 'Toda jayega.' Umar ne kaha: 'Phir yeh kabhi band nahi hoga.'" Rawi ne bataya ke unse pucha gaya kya Umar us darwaze ko jaante the. Maine jawab diya haan, jaise koi jaanta hai ke subah se pehle raat aayegi. Maine ek hadith bayan ki jo bilkul sahi thi." Rawi ne joda ke unhone Masruq ko Hudhaifa se (darwaze ke baare mein) poochne bheja. Hudhaifa ne kaha: "Woh darwaza khud Umar the."

e: Narrated Ibn Mas`ud:A man kissed a woman (unlawfully) and then went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and informed him. Allah revealed: And offer prayers perfectly At the two ends of the day And in some hours of the night (i.e. the five compulsory prayers). Verily! good deeds remove (annul) the evil deeds (small sins) (11.114). The man asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), "Is it for me?" He said, "It is for all my followers
hi: Ibn Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke ek shaks ne ek aurat ko (haram tareeqe se) bosa diya, phir Nabi ke paas gaya aur bataya. Allah ne nazil farmaya: "Aur namaz qaim karo din ke dono siron par aur raat ke kuch hisson mein (yaani paanch farz namazein). Beshak nekiyan buraiyon (chhote gunahon) ko mita deti hain" (11:114). Shaks ne Allah ke Rasool se pucha: "Kya yeh sirf mere liye hai?" Aap ne farmaya: "Yeh meri poori ummat ke liye hai."

e: Narrated `Abdullah:I asked the Prophet (ﷺ) "Which deed is the dearest to Allah?" He replied, "To offer the prayers at their early stated fixed times." I asked, "What is the next (in goodness)?" He replied, "To be good and dutiful to your parents" I again asked, "What is the next (in goodness)?" He replied, 'To participate in Jihad (religious fighting) in Allah's cause." `Abdullah added, "I asked only that much and if I had asked more, the Prophet (ﷺ) would have told me more
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Maine Nabi se pucha: 'Allah ke nazdeek sabse pyara amal kya hai?' Aap ne farmaya: 'Namaz ko uske muqarrar waqt par padhna.' Maine pucha: 'Phir kaunsa?' Farmaya: 'Apne maa-baap ke saath achha suluk aur farmabardari.' Maine phir pucha: 'Phir kaunsa?' Farmaya: 'Allah ki raah mein Jihad karna.'" Abdullah ne joda: "Maine sirf itna hi pucha, agar aur poochta to Nabi mujhe aur bataate."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "If there was a river at the door of anyone of you and he took a bath in it five times a day would you notice any dirt on him?" They said, "Not a trace of dirt would be left." The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "That is the example of the five prayers with which Allah blots out (annuls) evil deeds
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Maine Allah ke Rasool ko farmate suna: 'Agar tum mein se kisi ke darwaze par ek nadi ho aur woh usme din mein paanch baar nahaye, kya uspar koi maili baaki rahegi?' Logon ne kaha: 'Koi bhi maili baaki nahi rahegi.' Nabi ne joda: 'Yehi misaal paanch namazon ki hai, jinse Allah gunah mitaata hai.'"

e: Narrated Ghailan: Anas said, "I do not find (now-a-days) things as they were (practiced) at the time of the Prophet." Somebody said "The prayer (is as it was.)" Anas said, "Have you not done in the prayer what you have done?
hi: Ghailan bataate hain ke Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Ab woh cheezein nahi paata jaisi Nabi ke zamane mein hoti thin." Kisi ne kaha: "Namaz (waise hi hai)." Anas ne kaha: "Kya tumne namaz mein bhi wahi (tabdeeliyan) nahi ki jo tumne ki hain?"

e: Narrated Az-Zuhri that he visited Anas bin Malik at Damascus and found him weeping and asked him why he was weeping. He replied, "I do not know anything which I used to know during the life-time of Allah's Apostle except this prayer which is being lost (not offered as it should be)
hi: Az-Zuhri bataate hain ke unhone Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se Damascus mein mulaqat ki aur unhe rote paaya, poochha kyun ro rahe hain. Unhone jawab diya: "Mujhe koi bhi cheez aisi nahi milti jo Allah ke Rasool ke zamane mein thi, siwaye is namaz ke, jo (theek tarah se na padhe jaane ki wajah se) ho rahi hai."

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whenever anyone of you offers his prayer he is speaking in private to his Lord. So he should not spit to his right but under his left foot." Qatada said, "He should not spit in front of him but to his left or under his feet." And Shu`ba said, "He should not spit in front of him, nor to his right but to his left or under his foot." Anas said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He should neither spit in the direction of his Qibla nor to his right but to his left or under his foot
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Jab bhi koi namaz padhta hai, woh apne Rab se sirgoshi kar raha hota hai. Isliye woh apne dahine taraf na thooke, balki baaye paon ke neeche." Qatada ne kaha: "Saamne na thooke, balki baayen ya paon ke neeche." Shu'ba ne kaha: "Saamne na thooke, na dahine, balki baayen ya paon ke neeche." Anas ne kaha: Nabi ne farmaya: "Na Qibla ki taraf thooke, na dahine, balki baayen ya paon ke neeche."

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do the prostration properly and do not put your forearms flat with elbows touching the ground like a dog. And if you want to spit, do not spit in front, nor to the right for the person in prayer is speaking in private to his Lord
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Sajda achhi tarah karo, apni kohniyan zameen par kutte ki tarah bichha kar mat rakho. Aur agar thookna ho to saamne ya dahine mat thooko, kyunke namaz padhne wala apne Rab se sirgoshi kar raha hota hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira and `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If it is very hot, then pray the Zuhr prayer when it becomes (a bit) cooler, as the severity of the heat is from the raging of the Hell-fire
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Agar bahut garmi ho, to Zuhr thodi thandak hone par padho, kyunke sakht garmi Dozakh ki lapaton se hai."

e: Narrated Abu Dhar:The Mu'adh-dhin (call-maker) of the Prophet (ﷺ) pronounced the Adhan (call) for the Zuhr prayer but the Prophet said, "Let it be cooler, let it be cooler." Or said, 'Wait, wait, because the severity of heat is from the raging of the Hell-fire. In severe hot weather, pray when it becomes (a bit) cooler and the shadows of hillocks appear
hi: Abu Dharr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Nabi ke Muazzin ne Zuhr ki azaan di magar Nabi ne farmaya: "Thanda hone do, thanda hone do." (Ya kaha) "Ruko, ruko, kyunke sakht garmi Dozakh ki lapaton se hai. Sakht garmi mein thodi thandak hone par padho jab tak choti pahadon ke saaye dikhne lagen."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "In very hot weather delay the Zuhr prayer till it becomes (a bit) cooler because the severity of heat is from the raging of the Hell-fire. The Hell-fire of Hell complained to its Lord saying: O Lord! My parts are eating (destroying) one another. So Allah allowed it to take two breaths, one in the winter and the other in the summer. The breath in the summer is at the time when you feel the severest heat and the breath in the winter is at the time when you feel the severest cold
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Sakht garmi mein Zuhr ko thandak hone tak taal do, kyunke garmi ki shiddat Dozakh ki lapaton se hai. Dozakh ne apne Rab se shikayat ki: 'Aye Rab! Mere hisse ek-doosre ko khaa rahe hain.' Allah ne use do saans lene ki ijazat di, ek sardi mein, ek garmi mein. Garmi ka saans woh waqt hai jab tumhe sabse sakht garmi mehsoos hoti hai, aur sardi ka saans woh waqt hai jab sabse sakht sardi mehsoos hoti hai."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id:that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Pray Zuhr prayer when it becomes (a bit) cooler as the severity of heat is from the raging of the Hell-fire
hi: Abu Saeed (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Zuhr thoda thanda hone par padho, kyunke garmi ki shiddat Dozakh ki lapaton se hai."

e: Narrated Abu Dhar Al-Ghifar:We were with the Prophet (ﷺ) on a journey and the Mu'adh-dhin (call maker for the prayer) wanted to pronounce the Adhan (call) for the Zuhr prayer. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Let it become cooler." He again (after a while) wanted to pronounce the Adhan but the Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "Let it become cooler till we see the shadows of hillocks." The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "The severity of heat is from the raging of the Hell-fire, and in very hot weather pray (Zuhr) when it becomes cooler
hi: Abu Dharr (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ghifari bataate hain: "Hum ek safar mein Nabi ke saath the, Muazzin Zuhr ki azaan dena chahta tha. Nabi ne farmaya: 'Thanda hone do.' Usne (kuch der baad) phir chaha, Nabi ne farmaya: 'Thanda hone do yahan tak ke hum pahadon ke saaye dekh lein.'" Nabi ne joda: "Garmi ki shiddat Dozakh ki lapaton se hai, aur sakht garmi mein (Zuhr) thanda hone par padho."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came out as the sun declined at midday and offered the Zuhr prayer. He then stood on the pulpit and spoke about the Hour (Day of Judgment) and said that in it there would be tremendous things. He then said, "Whoever likes to ask me about anything he can do so and I shall reply as long as I am at this place of mine. Most of the people wept and the Prophet (ﷺ) said repeatedly, "Ask me." `Abdullah bin Hudhafa As-Sahmi stood up and said, "Who is my father?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Your father is Hudhafa." The Prophet (ﷺ) repeatedly said, "Ask me." Then `Umar knelt before him and said, "We are pleased with Allah as our Lord, Islam as our religion, and Muhammad as our Prophet." The Prophet then became quiet and said, "Paradise and Hell-fire were displayed in front of me on this wall just now and I have never seen a better thing (than the former) and a worse thing (than the latter)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool suraj dhalte hi bahar aaye aur Zuhr padhi. Phir mimbar par khade hokar Qiyamat ke baare mein baat ki aur farmaya ke usme bahut badi baatein hongi. Phir farmaya: "Jo mujhse kuch bhi poochna chahe, poochh sakta hai, main jawab dunga jab tak yahan hoon." Zyadatar log rone lage aur Nabi baar-baar farmate rahe: "Mujhse poocho." Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Hudhafa As-Sahmi khade hue aur poocha: "Mera baap kaun hai?" Nabi ne farmaya: "Tera baap Hudhafa hai." Nabi baar-baar farmate rahe: "Mujhse poocho." Phir Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne unke saamne ghutne tek diye aur kaha: "Hum Allah ko Rab, Islam ko deen, aur Muhammad ko Nabi maankar khush hain." Nabi khamosh ho gaye aur farmaya: "Abhi is deewar par mujhe Jannat aur Dozakh dikhai gayi, maine aisi achhi aur buri cheez pehle kabhi nahi dekhi."

e: Narrated Abu Al-Minhal:Abu Barza said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) used to offer the Fajr (prayer) when one could recognize the person sitting by him (after the prayer) and he used to recite between 60 to 100 Ayat (verses) of the Qur'an. He used to offer the Zuhr prayer as soon as the sun declined (at noon) and the `Asr prayer at a time when a man might go and return from the farthest place in Medina and find the sun still hot. (The sub-narrator forgot what was said about the Maghrib). He did not mind delaying the `Isha prayer to one third of the night or the middle of the night
hi: Abu Al-Minhal bataate hain ke Abu Barza (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Nabi Fajr padhte the jab log ek-doosre ko pehchaan sakte the (namaz ke baad), aur 60 se 100 Quran ki ayaat tilawat karte. Zuhr suraj dhalte hi padhte, Asr us waqt padhte jab koi shaks Madina ke door-tareen jagah tak jaakar wapas aa sakta jabke dhoop tez hoti (rawi ko Maghrib ke baare mein yaad nahi). Isha ko raat ke ek-tihai ya aadhi raat tak taalne mein koi harj nahi samajhte the."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:When we offered the Zuhr prayers behind Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) we used to prostrate on our clothes to protect ourselves from the heat
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke jab hum Allah ke Rasool ke peechhe Zuhr padhte, garmi se bachne ke liye apne kapdon par sajda karte the.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:"The Prophet (ﷺ) prayed eight rak`at for the Zuhr and `Asr, and seven for the Maghrib and `Isha prayers in Medina." Aiyub said, "Perhaps those were rainy nights." Anas said, "May be
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne Madina mein Zuhr-Asr aath rakat milakar aur Maghrib-Isha saat rakat milakar padhi. Aiyub ne kaha: "Shayad woh baarish ki raatein thi." Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Shayad."

e: Narrated Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to offer the `Asr prayer when the sunshine had not disappeared from my chamber
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool Asr padhte the jab dhoop abhi mere kamre se gayi nahi hoti thi.

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to offer the `Asr prayers at a time when the sunshine was still inside my chamber and no shadow had yet appeared in it
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool Asr padhte the jab dhoop abhi mere kamre mein hoti aur koi saaya nazar nahi aata tha.

e: Narrated Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to pray the `Asr prayers at a time when the sunshine was still inside my chamber and no shadow had yet appeared in it
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke Nabi Asr padhte the jab dhoop abhi mere kamre mein hoti aur koi saaya nazar nahi aata tha.

e: Narrated Saiyar bin Salama:I along with my father went to Abu- Barza Al-Aslami and my father asked him, "How Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to offer the five compulsory congregational prayers?" Abu- Barza said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) used to pray the Zuhr prayer which you (people) call the first one at midday when the sun had just declined The `Asr prayer at a time when after the prayer, a man could go to the house at the farthest place in Medina (and arrive) while the sun was still hot. (I forgot about the Maghrib prayer). The Prophet (ﷺ) Loved to delay the `Isha which you call Al- `Atama [??] and he disliked sleeping before it and speaking after it. After the Fajr prayer he used to leave when a man could recognize the one sitting beside him and he used to recite between 60 to 100 Ayat (in the Fajr prayer)
hi: Saiyar bin Salama bataate hain: "Main apne waalid ke saath Abu Barza (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Aslami (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas gaya, mere waalid ne pucha: 'Allah ke Rasool paanch farz jamaat ki namazein kaise padhte the?' Abu Barza ne kaha: 'Nabi Zuhr, jise tum log pehli namaz kehte ho, dopahar mein suraj dhalte hi padhte. Asr aise waqt padhte ke namaz ke baad koi shaks Madina ke door-tareen ghar tak jaakar wapas aa sakta jabke dhoop abhi tez hoti (mujhe Maghrib yaad nahi). Nabi Isha, jise tum Al-Atama kehte ho, taalna pasand karte the aur usse pehle sona ya baad mein baat karna napasand karte the. Fajr ke baad Aap tab uthte jab log ek-doosre ko pehchaan sakte, aur 60 se 100 ayaat tilawat karte.'"

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:We used to pray the `Asr prayer and after that if someone happened to go to the tribe of Bani `Amr bin `Auf, he would find them still praying the `Asr (prayer)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke hum Asr padhte aur uske baad agar koi Bani Amr bin Auf qabile jaata, to unhe abhi bhi Asr padhte paata.

e: Narrated Abu Bakr bin `Uthman bin Sahl bin Hunaif:that he heard Abu Umama saying: We prayed the Zuhr prayer with `Umar bin `Abdul `Aziz and then went to Anas bin Malik and found him offering the `Asr prayer. I asked him, "O uncle! Which prayer have you offered?" He said 'The `Asr and this is (the time of) the prayer of Allah's Apostle which we used to pray with him
hi: Abu Bakr bin Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Sahl bin Hunaif bataate hain ke unhone Abu Umama (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko kehte suna: "Humne Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdul Aziz ke saath Zuhr padhi, phir Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas gaye aur unhe Asr padhte paaya. Maine pucha: 'Aye chacha! Aapne kaunsi namaz padhi?' Unhone kaha: 'Asr, aur yehi waqt hai jab hum Allah ke Rasool ke saath padhte the.'"

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to offer the `Asr prayer at a time when the sun was still hot and high and if a person went to Al-`Awali (a place) of Medina, he would reach there when the sun was still high. Some of Al-`Awali of Medina were about four miles or so from the town
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool Asr padhte the jab suraj abhi tez aur onchaa hota, aur agar koi Madina ke Al-Awali (jagah) jaata, wahan pahunchta jabke suraj abhi onchaa hota. Madina ke kuch Al-Awali qareeb chaar mil door the.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:We used to pray the `Asr and after that if one of us went to Quba' he would arrive there while the sun was still high
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke hum Asr padhte aur uske baad agar koi Quba jaata, wahan pahunchta jabke suraj abhi onchaa hota.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever misses the `Asr prayer (intentionally) then it is as if he lost his family and property
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jo (jaan-boojh kar) Asr chhode, goya usne apna ghar-bar aur maal khoya."

e: Narrated Abu Al-Malih [??]:We were with Buraida in a battle on a cloudy day and he said, "Offer the `Asr prayer early as the Prophet said, "Whoever leaves the `Asr prayer, all his (good) deeds will be annulled
hi: Abu Al-Malih bataate hain: "Hum ek badalon wale din Buraida (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath jung mein the, unhone kaha: 'Asr jaldi padho, kyunke Nabi ne farmaya hai: Jo Asr chhode, uske sab (nek) amal zaya ho jaate hain.'"

e: Narrated Qais:Jarir said, "We were with the Prophet (ﷺ) and he looked at the moon--full-moon--and said, 'Certainly you will see your Lord as you see this moon and you will have no trouble in seeing Him. So if you can avoid missing (through sleep or business, etc.) a prayer before the sunrise (Fajr) and a prayer before sunset (`Asr), you must do so.' He then recited Allah's Statement: And celebrate the praises Of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before (its) setting." (50.39) Isma`il said, "Offer those prayers and do not miss them
hi: Qais bataate hain ke Jarir (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Hum Nabi ke saath the, Aap ne chaand (poora chaand) dekha aur farmaya: 'Tum apne Rab ko isi tarah dekhoge jaise is chaand ko dekhte ho, aur usay dekhne mein koi mushkil nahi hogi. Isliye agar mumkin ho to suraj nikalne se pehle (Fajr) aur doobne se pehle (Asr) ki namaz chhutne se bacho, zaroor bacho.' Phir Aap ne yeh ayat tilawat ki: 'Aur apne Rab ki hamd ke saath tasbeeh karo suraj nikalne se pehle aur doobne se pehle' (50:39)." Ismail ne kaha: "Yeh namazein padho aur inhe mat chhodo."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Angels come to you in succession by night and day and all of them get together at the time of the Fajr and `Asr prayers. Those who have passed the night with you (or stayed with you) ascend (to the Heaven) and Allah asks them, though He knows everything about you, well, "In what state did you leave my slaves?" The angels reply: "When we left them they were praying and when we reached them, they were praying
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Farishte din-raat baari-baari tumhare paas aate hain, aur Fajr-Asr ke waqt sab ikathe hote hain. Jo raat ko tumhare saath rahe, upar (aasman) jaate hain, aur Allah unse poochta hai, halanke woh sab jaanta hai: 'Tumne mere bandon ko kis haal mein chhoda?' Farishte jawab dete hain: 'Jab hum unhe chhod kar aaye, woh namaz padh rahe the, aur jab hum unke paas pahunche the, tab bhi namaz padh rahe the.'"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If anyone of you can get one rak`a of the `Asr prayer before sunset, he should complete his prayer. If any of you can get one rak`a of the Fajr prayer before sunrise, he should complete his prayer
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Agar koi Asr ki ek rakat suraj doobne se pehle paa le, use poori namaz mukammal karni chahiye. Agar koi Fajr ki ek rakat suraj nikalne se pehle paa le, use poori namaz mukammal karni chahiye."

e: Narrated Salim bin `Abdullah:My father said, "I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, 'The period of your stay as compared to the previous nations is like the period equal to the time between the `Asr prayer and sunset. The people of the Torah were given the Torah and they acted (upon it) till midday then they were exhausted and were given one Qirat (of gold) each. And then the people of the Gospel were given the Gospel and they acted (upon it) till the `Asr prayer then they were exhausted and were given one Qirat each. And then we were given the Qur'an and we acted (upon it) till sunset and we were given two Qirats each. On that the people of both the scriptures said, 'O our Lord! You have given them two Qirats and given us one Qirat, though we have worked more than they.' Allah said, 'Have I usurped some of your right?' They said, 'No.' Allah said: "That is my blessing I bestow upon whomsoever I wish
hi: Salim bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain, apne waalid ke hawale se: "Maine Allah ke Rasool ko farmate suna: 'Pichhli ummaton ke muqable tumhari duniya mein rehne ki muddat, Asr se suraj doobne tak ke waqt jaisi hai. Taurat walon ko Taurat di gayi, unhone dopahar tak amal kiya, phir thak gaye, unhe ek-ek Qirat (sona) mila. Injeel walon ko Injeel di gayi, unhone Asr tak amal kiya, phir thak gaye, unhe bhi ek-ek Qirat mila. Phir humein Quran diya gaya, humne suraj doobne tak amal kiya, humein do-do Qirat mile. Dono kitaabon wale bole: \"Aye humare Rab! Tune unhe do Qirat diye aur humein ek, jabke humne unse zyada mehnat ki.\" Allah ne farmaya: \"Kya maine tumhara koi haqq ghata diya?\" Unhone kaha: \"Nahi.\" Allah ne farmaya: \"Yeh mera fazl hai, main jise chahoon deta hoon.\"'"

e: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The example of Muslims, Jews and Christians is like the example of a man who employed laborers to work for him from morning till night. They worked till midday and they said, 'We are not in need of your reward.' So the man employed another batch and said to them, 'Complete the rest of the day and yours will be the wages I had fixed (for the first batch). They worked until the time of the `Asr prayer and said, 'Whatever we have done is for you.' He employed another batch. They worked for the rest of the day till sunset, and they received the wages of the two former batches
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Musalman, Yahudi aur Isaiyon ki misaal us shaks jaisi hai jisne subah se raat tak kaam karne ke liye mazdoor rakhe. Unhone dopahar tak kaam kiya aur kaha: 'Humein tumhari mazdoori nahi chahiye.' Usne doosri toli rakhi aur kaha: 'Baaki din ka kaam karo, tumhe pehli toli jitni mazdoori milegi.' Unhone Asr tak kaam kiya aur kaha: 'Jo humne kiya woh tumhara hai (mazdoori nahi chahiye).' Usne teesri toli rakhi. Unhone raat tak kaam kiya aur pehli do toliyon jitni mazdoori paayi."

e: Narrated Rafi` bin Khadij:We used to offer the Maghrib prayer with the Prophet (ﷺ) and after finishing the prayer one of us may go away and could still see as far as the spots where one's arrow might reach when shot by a bow
hi: Rafi bin Khadij (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke hum Nabi ke saath Maghrib padhte aur namaz khatam karke koi itna door bhi dekh sakta jitni door teer kamaan se jaakar giregi.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to pray the Zuhr at midday, and the `Asr at a time when the sun was still bright, the Maghrib after sunset (at its stated time) and the `Isha at a variable time. Whenever he saw the people assembled (for `Isha' prayer) he would pray earlier and if the people delayed, he would delay the prayer. And they or the Prophet (ﷺ) used to offer the Fajr Prayers when it was still dark
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi Zuhr dopahar mein, Asr jab suraj abhi roshan hota, Maghrib doobte hi (muqarrar waqt par), aur Isha alag-alag waqt par padhte the. Jab log jama huye dekhte, jaldi padhte, aur agar der hoti, taal dete. Aur woh ya Nabi Fajr andhere mein padhte the.

e: Narrated Salama:We used to pray the Maghrib prayer with the Prophet (ﷺ) when the sun disappeared from the horizon
hi: Salama (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke hum Nabi ke saath Maghrib padhte jab suraj ufaq se ghayab ho jaata.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) prayed seven rak`at together and eight rak`at together
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne kabhi saat rakat milakar aur kabhi aath rakat milakar padhi (Zuhr-Asr aur Maghrib-Isha).

e: Narrated `Abdullah Al-Muzani:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not be influenced by bedouins regarding the name of your Maghrib prayer which is called `Isha' by them
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Muzani se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Bedu logon ke kehne mein na aao jo tumhari Maghrib ki namaz ko 'Isha' kehte hain."

e: Narrated `Abdullah:"One night Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) led us in the `Isha' prayer and that is the one called Al-`Atma [??] by the people. After the completion of the prayer, he faced us and said, "Do you know the importance of this night? Nobody present on the surface of the earth tonight will be living after one hundred years from this night." (See Hadith No)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Ek raat Allah ke Rasool ne humari Isha ki imamat ki, jise log Al-Atma kehte hain. Namaz khatam karke, Aap humari taraf mudte huye farmaya: 'Kya tumhe pata hai is raat ki kya ahmiyat hai? Aaj zameen par jo koi bhi maujood hai, sau saal baad zinda nahi hoga.'"

e: Narrated Muhammad bin `Amr:We asked Jabir bin `Abdullah about the prayers of the Prophet (ﷺ) . He said, "He used to pray Zuhr prayer at midday, the `Asr when the sun was still hot, and the Maghrib after sunset (at its stated time). The `Isha was offered early if the people gathered, and used to be delayed if their number was less; and the morning prayer was offered when it was still dark
hi: Muhammad bin Amr bataate hain: "Humne Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) se Nabi ki namazon ke baare mein pucha.
