Unhone kaha: 'Aap Zuhr dopahar mein padhte, Asr jab suraj abhi tez hota, aur Maghrib suraj doobte hi (muqarrar waqt par). Isha jaldi padhte agar log jama ho jaate, aur taal dete agar tadaad kam hoti. Fajr andhere mein padhte the.'"

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) once delayed the `Isha' prayer and that was during the days when Islam still had not spread. The Prophet (ﷺ) did not come out till `Umar informed him that the women and children had slept. Then he came out and said to the people of the mosque: "None amongst the dwellers of the earth has been waiting for it (`Isha prayer) except you
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke ek baar Allah ke Rasool ne Isha mein der ki, yeh un dinon ki baat hai jab Islam abhi phaila nahi tha. Nabi tab tak bahar nahi aaye jab tak Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne unhe bataya ke aurtein aur bachche so gaye hain. Phir Aap bahar aaye aur masjid walon se farmaya: "Zameen par tumhare siwa kisi ne bhi is (Isha ki) namaz ka intezar nahi kiya."

e: Narrated Abu Musa:My companions, who came with me in the boat and I landed at a place called Baqi [??] Buthan [??] . The Prophet (ﷺ) was in Medina at that time. One of us used to go to the Prophet (ﷺ) by turns every night at the time of the `Isha prayer. Once I along with my companions went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he was busy in some of his affairs, so the `Isha' prayer was delayed to the middle of the night He then came out and led the people (in prayer). After finishing from the prayer, he addressed the people present there saying, "Be patient! Don't go away. Have the glad tiding. It is from the blessing of Allah upon you that none amongst mankind has prayed at this time save you." Or said, "None except you has prayed at this time." Abu Musa added, 'So we returned happily after what we heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Mere sathi jo mere saath kashti mein aaye, hum Baqi Buthan naam ki jagah utre. Us waqt Nabi Madina mein the. Humme se koi ek har raat baari-baari Isha ke waqt Nabi ke paas jaata. Ek baar main apne sathiyon ke saath Nabi ke paas gaya, Aap kisi kaam mein mashghool the, isliye Isha aadhi raat tak taali gayi. Phir Aap bahar aaye aur logon ki imamat ki. Namaz khatam karke, wahan maujood logon se khitaab karte huye farmaya: 'Sabr karo! Mat jao. Khushkhabri suno. Yeh Allah ki tumpar barkat hai ke insaniyat mein se sirf tumne is waqt namaz padhi hai.'" (Ya kaha: "Sirf tumne is waqt padhi.") Abu Musa ne joda: "To hum Allah ke Rasool se yeh sunkar khushi-khushi wapas laute."

e: Narrated Abu Barza:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) disliked to sleep before the `Isha' prayer and to talk after it
hi: Abu Barza (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool Isha se pehle sona aur uske baad baat karna napasand karte the.

e: Narrated Ibn Shihab from `Urwa:`Aisha said, "Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) delayed the `Isha' prayer till `Umar reminded him by saying, "The prayer!" The women and children have slept. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) came out and said, 'None amongst the dwellers of the earth has been waiting for it (the prayer) except you." `Urwa said, "Nowhere except in Medina the prayer used to be offered (in those days)." He further said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) used to offer the `Isha' prayer in the period between the disappearance of the twilight and the end of the first third of the night
hi: Ibn Shihab, Urwa ke hawale se: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha: "Ek baar Allah ke Rasool ne Isha itni taal di ke Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne yaad dilaya: 'Namaz!' Aurtein aur bachche so gaye. Phir Nabi bahar aaye aur farmaya: 'Zameen par tumhare siwa kisi ne is (namaz) ka intezar nahi kiya.'" Urwa ne kaha: "Us waqt Madina ke ilawa kahin aur yeh namaz nahi padhi jaati thi." Unhone yeh bhi kaha: "Nabi Isha shafaq (roshni) khatam hone se raat ke pehle tihai tak ke darmiyan padhte the."

e: Narrated Ibn Juraij from Nafi`:`Abdullah bin `Umar said, "Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was busy (at the time of the `Isha'), so the prayer was delayed so much so that we slept and woke up and slept and woke up again. The Prophet (ﷺ) came out and said, 'None amongst the dwellers of the earth but you have been waiting for the prayer." Ibn `Umar did not find any harm in praying it earlier or in delaying it unless he was afraid that sleep might overwhelm him and he might miss the prayer, and sometimes he used to sleep before the `Isha' prayer. Ibn Juraij said, "I said to `Ata', 'I heard Ibn `Abbas saying: Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) delayed the `Isha' prayer to such an extent that the people slept and got up and slept again and got up again. Then `Umar bin Al-Khattab, stood up and reminded the Prophet (ﷺ) of the prayer.' `Ata' said, 'Ibn `Abbas said: The Prophet came out as if I was looking at him at this time, and water was trickling from his head and he was putting his hand on his head and then said, 'Hadn't I thought it hard for my followers, I would have ordered them to pray (`Isha' prayer) at this time.' I asked `Ata' for further information, how the Prophet had kept his hand on his head as he was told by Ibn `Abbas. `Ata' separated his fingers slightly and put their tips on the side of the head, brought the fingers downwards approximating them till the thumb touched the lobe of the ear at the side of the temple and the beard on the face. He neither slowed nor hurried in this action but he acted like that. The Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Hadn't I thought it hard for my followers I would have ordered them to pray at this time
hi: Ibn Juraij, Nafi ke hawale se: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Ek baar Allah ke Rasool (Isha ke waqt) mashghool the, namaz itni taali gayi ke hum so gaye, jaage, phir so gaye, phir jaage. Nabi bahar aaye aur farmaya: 'Zameen par tumhare siwa kisi ne namaz ka intezar nahi kiya.'" Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ise jaldi ya der se padhne mein koi harj nahi samajhte the, siwaye jab unhe dar hota ke neend unpar ghalba na kar le aur namaz chhoot jaaye, aur kabhi-kabhi woh Isha se pehle so bhi jaate the. Ibn Juraij ne kaha: "Maine Ata se kaha: 'Maine Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko kehte suna: Ek baar Allah ke Rasool ne Isha itni taal di ke log so gaye, uthe, phir so gaye, phir uthe. Phir Umar bin Khattab (رضی اللہ عنہ) khade hue aur Nabi ko namaz yaad dilai.' Ata ne kaha: 'Ibn Abbas ne kaha: Nabi bahar aaye, goya main abhi unhe dekh raha hoon, paani unke sar se tapak raha tha aur woh haath sar par rakhe hue the, phir farmaya: Agar mujhe apni ummat ke liye mushkil na hoti, to main unhe is waqt (Isha) padhne ka hukum deta.'" Maine Ata se aur poocha ke Nabi ne apna haath kaise sar par rakha jaisa Ibn Abbas ne bataya. Ata ne apni ungliyan halke se alag karke unke sire sar ke kinare rakhe, phir unhe neeche laate huye is tarah paas laaye ke angoothaa kaan ki lau aur daadhi ke baalon ko chhoo gaya, na dheere na jaldi, isi tarah kiya. Nabi ne farmaya: "Agar mujhe apni ummat ke liye mushkil na hoti, to main unhe is waqt padhne ka hukum deta."

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) delayed the `Isha' prayer till midnight and then he offered the prayer and said, "The people prayed and slept but you have been in prayer as long as you have been waiting for it (the prayer)." Anas added: As if I am looking now at the glitter of the ring of the Prophet (ﷺ) on that night
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne Isha ko aadhi raat tak taal diya, phir namaz padhai aur farmaya: "Log namaz padh kar so gaye, magar tum jab tak namaz ka intezar karte rahe, namaz mein hi the." Anas ne joda: "Goya main abhi bhi us raat Nabi ki angoothi ki chamak dekh raha hoon."

e: Narrated Jarir bin `Abdullah:We were with the Prophet (ﷺ) on a full moon night. He looked at the moon and said, "You will certainly see your Lord as you see this moon, and there will be no trouble in seeing Him. So if you can avoid missing (through sleep, business, etc.) a prayer before the rising of the sun (Fajr) and before its setting (`Asr) you must do so. He (the Prophet (ﷺ) ) then recited the following verse: And celebrate the praises Of Your Lord before The rising of the sun And before (its) setting
hi: Jarir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Hum ek poore chaand ki raat Nabi ke saath the. Aap ne chaand dekha aur farmaya: 'Tum apne Rab ko isi tarah dekhoge jaise is chaand ko dekhte ho, aur usay dekhne mein koi mushkil nahi hogi. Isliye agar mumkin ho to suraj nikalne se pehle (Fajr) aur doobne se pehle (Asr) ki namaz chhutne se bacho, zaroor bacho.'" (Nabi ne) phir yeh ayat tilawat ki: "Aur apne Rab ki hamd ke saath tasbeeh karo suraj nikalne se pehle aur doobne se pehle."

e: Narrated Abu Bakr bin Abi Musa:My father said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Whoever prays the two cool prayers (`Asr and Fajr) will go to Paradise
hi: Abu Bakr bin Abi Musa, apne waalid ke hawale se: "Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: 'Jo do thandi namazein (Asr aur Fajr) padhe, woh Jannat mein jayega.'"

e: Narrated Anas:Zaid bin Thabit said, "We took the "Suhur" (the meal taken before dawn while fasting is observed) with the Prophet (ﷺ) and then stood up for the (morning) prayer." I asked him how long the interval between the two (Suhur and prayer) was. He replied, 'The interval between the two was just sufficient to recite fifty to sixty 'Ayat
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain, Zaid bin Thabit (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Humne Nabi ke saath Sehri khai, phir (Fajr ki) namaz ke liye khade hue." Maine unse pucha in dono (Sehri aur namaz) ke darmiyan kitna waqfa tha. Unhone jawab diya: "Itna waqfa jitne mein pachaas se saath ayaat padhi ja sakein."

e: Narrated Qatada:Anas bin Malik said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) and Zaid bin Thabit took the 'Suhur' together and after finishing the meal, the Prophet (ﷺ) stood up and prayed (Fajr prayer)." I asked Anas, "How long was the interval between finishing their 'Suhur' and starting the prayer?" He replied, "The interval between the two was just sufficient to recite fifty 'Ayat." (Verses of the Qur'an)
hi: Qatada bataate hain ke Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Nabi aur Zaid bin Thabit (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne saath Sehri khai, khaana khatam karke Nabi khade hue aur (Fajr ki) namaz padhi." Maine Anas se pucha unke Sehri khatam karne aur namaz shuru karne ke darmiyan kitna waqfa tha. Unhone jawab diya: "Itna waqfa jitne mein pachaas ayaat padhi ja sakein."

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:I used to take the "Suhur" meal with my family and hasten so as to catch the Fajr (morning prayer) with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Main apne ghar walon ke saath Sehri khaata aur jaldi karta taake Allah ke Rasool ke saath Fajr padh saku."

e: Narrated `Aisha:The believing women covered with their veiling sheets used to attend the Fajr prayer with Allah's Apostle, and after finishing the prayer they would return to their home and nobody could recognize them because of darkness
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke momin aurtein chadar odh kar Allah ke Rasool ke saath Fajr mein shareek hoti, phir namaz khatam karke apne gharon wapas jaati, andhere ki wajah se koi unhe pehchaan nahi paata.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever could get one rak`a (of the Fajr prayer) before sunrise, he has got the (morning) prayer and whoever could get one rak`a of the `Asr prayer before sunset, he has got the (`Asr) prayer
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jo Fajr ki ek rakat suraj nikalne se pehle paa le, usne (Fajr ki) namaz paa li. Jo Asr ki ek rakat suraj doobne se pehle paa le, usne (Asr ki) namaz paa li."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever could get one rak`a of a prayer, (in its proper time) he has got the prayer
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jo bhi namaz ki ek rakat (uske sahih waqt mein) paa le, usne woh namaz paa li."

e: Narrated `Umar:"The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade praying after the Fajr prayer till the sun rises and after the `Asr prayer till the sun sets." Narrated Ibn `Abbas: Some people told me the same narration (as above)
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai: "Nabi ne Fajr ke baad suraj nikalne tak aur Asr ke baad suraj doobne tak namaz padhne se mana kiya." Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se bhi yehi riwayat hai, kuch logon ne mujhe yehi bataya.

e: Narrated Hisham's father:Ibn `Umar said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Do not pray at the time of sunrise and at the time of sunset.' " Ibn `Umar said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'If the edge of the sun appears (above the horizon) delay the prayer till it becomes high, and if the edge of the sun disappears, delay the prayer till it sets (disappears completely)
hi: Hisham ke waalid bataate hain ke Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: 'Suraj nikalte waqt aur doobte waqt namaz na padho.'" Ibn Umar ne yeh bhi kaha: "Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: 'Agar suraj ka kinara nikalna shuru ho, namaz ko taal do jab tak woh poora opar na aa jaaye, aur agar suraj ka kinara doobna shuru ho, namaz ko taal do jab tak woh poori tarah doob na jaaye.'"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade two kinds of sales, two kinds of dresses, and two prayers. He forbade offering prayers after the Fajr prayer till the rising of the sun and after the `Asr prayer till its setting. He also forbade "Ishtimal-Assama [??] " and "al-Ihtiba" in one garment in such a way that one's private parts are exposed towards the sky. He also forbade the sales called "Munabadha" and "Mulamasa." (See Hadith No. 354 and 355 Vol)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne do tarah ki bikri, do tarah ke libaas, aur do namazon se mana kiya. Fajr ke baad suraj nikalne tak aur Asr ke baad suraj doobne tak namaz padhne se mana kiya. Aap ne Ishtimal-As-Samma aur Al-Ihtiba se bhi mana kiya jisse sharmgaah aasman ki taraf khul jaaye. Aap ne "Munabadha" aur "Mulamasa" bikri se bhi mana kiya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "None of you should try to pray at sunrise or sunset
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Tum mein se koi bhi suraj nikalte ya doobte waqt namaz padhne ki koshish na kare."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "There is no prayer after the morning prayer till the sun rises, and there is no prayer after the `Asr prayer till the sun sets
hi: Abu Saeed Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Maine Allah ke Rasool ko farmate suna: 'Fajr ke baad suraj nikalne tak koi namaz nahi, aur Asr ke baad suraj doobne tak koi namaz nahi.'"

e: Narrated Muawiya:You offer a prayer which I did not see being offered by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) when we were in his company and he certainly had forbidden it (i.e. two rak`at after the `Asr prayer)
hi: Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai: "Tum ek aisi namaz padhte ho jo maine Allah ke Rasool ko humari sohbat mein padhte nahi dekha, aur Aap ne isse mana bhi kiya tha" (yaani Asr ke baad do rakat).

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the offering of two prayers: -1. after the morning prayer till the sunrises. -2. after the `Asr prayer till the sun sets
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne do namazon se mana kiya: 1. Fajr ke baad suraj nikalne tak. 2. Asr ke baad suraj doobne tak.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:I pray as I saw my companions praying. I do not forbid praying at any time during the day or night except at sunset and sunrise
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai: "Main waisi namaz padhta hoon jaisi maine apne sathiyon ko padhte dekha, main kisi bhi waqt din ya raat mein namaz se mana nahi karta, siwaye suraj doobte aur nikalte waqt."

e: Narrated `Aisha:By Allah, Who took away the Prophet. The Prophet (ﷺ) never missed them (two rak`at) after the `Asr prayer till he met Allah and he did not meet Allah till it became heavy for him to pray while standing so he used to offer most of the prayers while sitting. (She meant the two rak`at after `Asr) He used to pray them in the house and never prayed them in the mosque lest it might be hard for his followers and he loved what was easy for them
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai: "Allah ki qasam, jisne Nabi ko wafaat di, Nabi ne Asr ke baad woh do rakat kabhi nahi chhodi jab tak Allah se mile, aur woh (aakhri waqt) tak khade hokar namaz padhna unke liye mushkil ho gaya tha, isliye woh aksar baithkar namaz padhte." (Ayesha ka matlab Asr ke baad ki do rakat se tha.) Aap unhe ghar mein padhte, kabhi masjid mein nahi padhte, is dar se ke unki ummat ke liye mushkil ho, aur Aap unke liye asaani chahte the.

e: Narrated Hisham's father:`Aisha (addressing me) said, "O son of my sister! The Prophet (ﷺ) never missed two prostrations (i.e. rak`at) after the `Asr prayer in my house
hi: Hisham ke waalid bataate hain: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne (mujhse) kaha: "Aye mere bhaanje! Nabi ne mere ghar mein Asr ke baad do sajde (yaani do rakat) kabhi nahi chhode."

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) never missed two rak`at before the Fajr prayer and after the `Asr prayer openly and secretly
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne Fajr se pehle aur Asr ke baad ki do rakat, khule aur chhupe dono tarah se, kabhi nahi chhodi.

e: Narrated `Aisha:Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) come to me after the `Asr prayer, he always prayed two rak`at
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke jab bhi Nabi Asr ke baad mere paas aate, hamesha do rakat padhte.

e: Narrated Ibn Abu Malih [??]:I was with Buraida on a cloudy day and he said, "Offer the `Asr prayer earlier as the Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Whoever leaves the `Asr prayer will have all his (good) deeds annulled." (See Hadith No. 527 and)
hi: Ibn Abu Malih bataate hain: "Main ek badalon wale din Buraida (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath tha, unhone kaha: 'Asr jaldi padho, kyunke Nabi ne farmaya: Jo Asr chhode, uske sab (nek) amal zaya ho jaate hain.'"

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abi Qatada:My father said, "One night we were traveling with the Prophet (ﷺ) and some people said, 'We wish that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) would take a rest along with us during the last hours of the night.' He said, 'I am afraid that you will sleep and miss the (Fajr) prayer.' Bilal said, 'I will make you get up.' So all slept and Bilal rested his back against his Rahila and he too was overwhelmed (by sleep) and slept. The Prophet (ﷺ) got up when the edge of the sun had risen and said, 'O Bilal! What about your statement?' He replied, 'I have never slept such a sleep.' The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Allah captured your souls when He wished, and released them when He wished. O Bilal! Get up and pronounce the Adhan for the prayer.' The Prophet (ﷺ) performed ablution and when the sun came up and became bright, he stood up and prayed
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Qatada, apne waalid ke hawale se: "Ek raat hum Nabi ke saath safar mein the, kuch logon ne kaha: 'Kaash Allah ke Rasool raat ke aakhri hisse mein humare saath aaram karte.' Aap ne farmaya: 'Mujhe dar hai tum so jaoge aur (Fajr) namaz chhoot jayegi.' Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: 'Main tumhe jagaunga.' To sab so gaye, Bilal apni sawari se tek lagakar baitha, magar woh bhi (neend se) ghalba khaakar so gaye. Nabi tab uthe jab suraj ka kinara nikal chuka tha, farmaya: 'Aye Bilal! Tumhare waade ka kya hua?' Unhone jawab diya: 'Maine kabhi aisi neend nahi soi.' Nabi ne farmaya: 'Allah ne tumhari roohein li jab usne chaha, aur unhe azaad kiya jab usne chaha. Aye Bilal! Utho aur namaz ki azaan do.' Nabi ne wudu kiya aur jab suraj poora nikal kar roshan ho gaya, khade hue aur namaz padhi."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:On the day of Al-Khandaq (the battle of trench.) `Umar bin Al-Khattab came cursing the disbelievers of Quraish after the sun had set and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) I could not offer the `Asr prayer till the sun had set." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "By Allah! I, too, have not prayed." So we turned towards Buthan, and the Prophet (ﷺ) performed ablution and we too performed ablution and offered the `Asr prayer after the sun had set, and then he offered the Maghrib prayer
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Khandaq ki jung ke din, Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Khattab (رضی اللہ عنہ) suraj doobne ke baad Quraish ke kaafiron ko kosne aaye aur kaha: "Ya Rasoolallah! Main Asr padh na saka jab tak suraj na doob gaya." Nabi ne farmaya: "Allah ki qasam, maine bhi nahi padhi." Hum Buthan ki taraf mude, Nabi ne wudu kiya, hum sabne bhi wudu kiya, aur suraj doobne ke baad Asr padhi, phir Maghrib padhi.

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If anyone forgets a prayer he should pray that prayer when he remembers it. There is no expiation except to pray the same." Then he recited: "Establish prayer for My (i.e. Allah's) remembrance
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Agar koi namaz bhool jaye, to jab yaad aaye tab padhe. Iska koi aur kaffara nahi siwaye usi namaz ko padhna." Phir Aap ne tilawat ki: "Namaz qaim karo meri (Allah ki) yaad ke liye."

e: Narrated Jabir:`Umar came cursing the disbelievers (of Quraish) on the day of Al-Khandaq (the battle of Trench) and said, "I could not offer the `Asr prayer till the sun had set. Then we went to Buthan and he offered the (`Asr) prayer after sunset and then he offered the Maghrib prayer
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) Khandaq ki jung ke din Quraish ke kaafiron ko kosne aaye aur kaha: "Main Asr na padh saka jab tak suraj na doob gaya." Phir hum Buthan gaye, Umar ne suraj doobne ke baad (Asr) namaz padhi, phir Maghrib padhi.

e: Narrated Abu-l-Minhal:My father and I went to Abi Barza Al-Aslami and my father said to him, "Tell us how Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to offer the compulsory congregational prayers." He said, "He used to pray the Zuhr prayer, which you call the first prayer, as the sun declined at noon, the `Asr at a time when one of US could go to his family at the farthest place in Medina while the sun was still hot. (The narrator forgot what Abu Barza had said about the Maghrib prayer), and the Prophet (ﷺ) preferred to pray the `Isha' late and disliked to sleep before it or talk after it. And he used to return after finishing the morning prayer at such a time when it was possible for one to recognize the person sitting by his side and he (the Prophet) used to recite 60 to 100 'Ayat' (verses) of the Qur'an in it
hi: Abu Al-Minhal bataate hain: "Main aur mere waalid Abi Barza Al-Aslami ke paas gaye, mere waalid ne unse kaha: 'Humein bataiye Allah ke Rasool paanch farz jamaat namazein kaise padhte the.' Unhone kaha: 'Aap Zuhr, jise tum pehli namaz kehte ho, dopahar mein suraj dhalte hi padhte. Asr aise waqt padhte ke koi shaks Madina ke door-tareen ghar tak jaakar aa sakta jabke dhoop abhi tez hoti (rawi ko Maghrib ke baare mein yaad nahi). Nabi Isha ko taalna pasand karte aur usse pehle sona ya baad mein baat karna napasand karte. Aap Fajr ke baad tab jaate jab log ek-doosre ko pehchaan sakte, aur usme 60 se 100 ayaat tilawat karte.'"

e: Narrated Qurra bin Khalid:Once he waited for Al-Hasan and he did not show up till it was about the usual time for him to start his speech; then he came and apologized saying, "Our neighbors invited us." Then he added, "Narrated Anas, 'Once we waited for the Prophet (ﷺ) till it was midnight or about midnight. He came and led the prayer, and after finishing it, he addressed us and said, 'All the people prayed and then slept and you had been in prayer as long as you were waiting for it." Al-Hasan said, "The people are regarded as performing good deeds as long as they are waiting for doing good deeds." Al-Hasan's statement is a portion of Anas's [??] Hadith from the Prophet (ﷺ)
hi: Qurra bin Khalid bataate hain: "Ek baar unhone Al-Hasan ka intezar kiya, magar woh apni tilawat ka waqt ho jaane tak nahi aaye; phir aakar maafi maangi kehte huye: 'Humare padosi ne humein bulaya tha.' Phir unhone bataya: 'Anas ne bataya: Ek baar humne Nabi ka intezar kiya yahan tak ke aadhi raat ya us jaisa waqt ho gaya. Aap aaye aur namaz padhai, khatam karke humein khitaab kiya aur farmaya: Sab log namaz padh kar so gaye, magar tum jab tak intezar karte rahe, namaz mein hi the.'" Al-Hasan ne kaha: "Log tab tak nek amal karne wale samjhe jaate hain jab tak woh nek amal karne ka intezar karte hain." Al-Hasan ki yeh baat Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki Nabi se riwayat ka ek hissa hai.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) prayed one of the `Isha' prayer in his last days and after finishing it with Taslim, he stood up and said, "Do you realize (the importance of) this night? Nobody present on the surface of the earth tonight would be living after the completion of one hundred years from this night." The people made a mistake in grasping the meaning of this statement of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and they indulged in those things which are said about these narrators (i.e. some said that the Day of Resurrection will be established after 100 years etc.) But the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Nobody present on the surface of earth tonight would be living after the completion of 100 years from this night"; he meant "When that century (people of that century) would pass away
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne apni aakhri zindagi mein ek Isha padhi, Taslim se khatam karke khade hue aur farmaya: "Kya tumhe is raat ki ahmiyat pata hai? Aaj zameen par jo koi bhi maujood hai, sau saal poore hone ke baad zinda nahi hoga." Logon ne Allah ke Rasool ki is baat ka galat matlab liya aur un cheezon mein pad gaye jo in raawiyon ke baare mein kahi jaati hain (yaani kuch logon ne socha ke Qiyamat 100 saal baad aayegi waghera). Magar Nabi ka matlab tha: "Zameen par aaj jo koi maujood hai, sau saal ke poora hone ke baad zinda nahi hoga" — yaani jab woh sadi (us sadi ke log) guzar jayegi.

e: Narrated Abu `Uthman:`Abdur Rahman bin Abi Bakr said, "The Suffa Companions were poor people and the Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Whoever has food for two persons should take a third one from them (Suffa companions). And whosoever has food for four persons he should take one or two from them' Abu Bakr took three men and the Prophet (ﷺ) took ten of them." `Abdur Rahman added, my father my mother and I were there (in the house). (The sub-narrator is in doubt whether `Abdur Rahman also said, 'My wife and our servant who was common for both my house and Abu Bakr's house). Abu Bakr took his supper with the Prophet (ﷺ) and remained there till the `Isha' prayer was offered. Abu Bakr went back and stayed with the Prophet (ﷺ) till the Prophet (ﷺ) took his meal and then Abu Bakr returned to his house after a long portion of the night had passed. Abu Bakr's wife said, 'What detained you from your guests (or guest)?' He said, 'Have you not served them yet?' She said, 'They refused to eat until you come. The food was served for them but they refused." `Abdur Rahman added, "I went away and hid myself (being afraid of Abu Bakr) and in the meantime he (Abu Bakr) called me, 'O Ghunthar (a harsh word)!' and also called me bad names and abused me and then said (to his family), 'Eat. No welcome for you.' Then (the supper was served). Abu Bakr took an oath that he would not eat that food. The narrator added: By Allah, whenever any one of us (myself and the guests of Suffa companions) took anything from the food, it increased from underneath. We all ate to our fill and the food was more than it was before its serving. Abu Bakr looked at it (the food) and found it as it was before serving or even more than that. He addressed his wife (saying) 'O the sister of Bani Firas! What is this?' She said, 'O the pleasure of my eyes! The food is now three times more than it was before.' Abu Bakr ate from it, and said, 'That (oath) was from Satan' meaning his oath (not to eat). Then he again took a morsel (mouthful) from it and then took the rest of it to the Prophet. So that meal was with the Prophet. There was a treaty between us and some people, and when the period of that treaty had elapsed the Prophet (ﷺ) divided us into twelve (groups) (the Prophet's companions) each being headed by a man. Allah knows how many men were under the command of each (leader). So all of them (12 groups of men) ate of that meal
hi: Abu Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain, Abdur Rahman bin Abi Bakr ne kaha: "Suffa ke sathi gareeb log the, Nabi ne farmaya: 'Jiske paas do logon ka khana ho, teesra (Suffa ke sathiyon mein se) le le. Jiske paas chaar logon ka khana ho, ek ya do le le.' Abu Bakr teen aadmi le gaye, Nabi dus le gaye." Abdur Rahman ne joda: "Mere waalid, meri waalida aur main (ghar mein) the." (Rawi ko shak hai Abdur Rahman ne yeh bhi kaha: "Meri biwi aur humara khadim jo mere aur Abu Bakr ke ghar donon ke liye tha.") Abu Bakr ne Nabi ke saath khana khaya aur Isha tak wahin rahe. Abu Bakr wapas gaye aur Nabi ke saath rahe yahan tak ke Nabi ne khana khaya, phir Abu Bakr raat ka kaafi hissa guzarne ke baad apne ghar wapas aaye. Abu Bakr ki biwi ne kaha: "Aapko apne mehmanon (ya mehman) se kis cheez ne roka?" Unhone kaha: "Kya tumne unhe khana nahi khilaya?" Usne kaha: "Unhone aapke aane tak khane se inkaar kiya. Khana unke saamne rakha gaya magar unhone inkaar kiya." Abdur Rahman ne joda: "Main chala gaya aur chup gaya (Abu Bakr se darte hue), isi waqt unhone mujhe pukara: 'Aye Ghunthar!' (ek sakht lafz) aur mujhe bura-bhala kaha, phir (apne ghar walon se) kaha: 'Khao. Tumhare liye koi khush-aamdeed nahi.' Phir (khana pesh hua). Abu Bakr ne qasam khai ke woh yeh khana nahi khayenge." Rawi ne joda: "Allah ki qasam, jab bhi hum mein se koi (main aur Suffa ke mehmaan) khane se kuch uthaate, woh neeche se aur badh jaata. Hum sab pet bhar kar khaye aur khana pehle se zyada ho gaya. Abu Bakr ne dekha (khane ko) aur paaya ke woh pehle jitna hi hai ya usse bhi zyada. Unhone apni biwi se kaha: 'Aye Bani Firas ki behn! Yeh kya hai?' Usne kaha: 'Aye meri aankhon ki thandak! Khana ab pehle se teen guna zyada hai.' Abu Bakr ne usme se khaya aur kaha: 'Woh (qasam) shaitan ki taraf se thi' (yaani unki khana na khaane ki qasam). Phir unhone usme se ek lukma liya aur baaki Nabi ke paas le gaye. Woh khana Nabi ke paas raha. Humare aur kuch logon ke darmiyan ek muahida (samjhauta) tha, jab uski muddat khatam hui, Nabi ne humein baarah (giroh) mein taqseem kiya, har giroh ka ek sardar tha, Allah hi jaanta hai har sardar ke maatehat kitne log the. To un sab (baarah giroh) ne us khane mein se khaya."

e: Narrated Anas:The people mentioned the fire and the bell (they suggested those as signals to indicate the starting of prayers), and by that they mentioned the Jews and the Christians. Then Bilal was ordered to pronounce Adhan for the prayer by saying its wordings twice, and for the Iqama (the call for the actual standing for the prayers in rows) by saying its wordings once. (Iqama is pronounced when the people are ready for the prayer)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke logon ne aag aur ghanti ka zikar kiya (namaz ka waqt bataane ke liye), aur isse woh Yahudi aur Isaiyon ka tareeqa samajhte the. Phir Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko hukum diya gaya ke woh Adhan ke alfaaz do-do baar aur Iqama ke alfaaz ek-ek baar kahen (Iqama tab kahi jaati hai jab log namaz ke liye taiyaar hon).

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:When the Muslims arrived at Medina, they used to assemble for the prayer, and used to guess the time for it. During those days, the practice of Adhan for the prayers had not been introduced yet. Once they discussed this problem regarding the call for prayer. Some people suggested the use of a bell like the Christians, others proposed a trumpet like the horn used by the Jews, but `Umar was the first to suggest that a man should call (the people) for the prayer; so Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered Bilal to get up and pronounce the Adhan for prayers
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke jab Musalman Madina pahunche, woh namaz ke liye jama hote aur waqt ka andaza lagate, us waqt Adhan ka rivaj shuru nahi hua tha. Ek din unhone iska hal sochne ke liye baat ki. Kuch logon ne Isaiyon jaisi ghanti ki tajweez di, kuch ne Yahudiyon jaisa turahi (sing) baja, magar Umar sabse pehle ye tajweez laaye ke koi shaks logon ko namaz ke liye bulaye. Isliye Allah ke Rasool ne Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko khade hokar Adhan dene ka hukum diya.

e: Narrated Anas:Bilal was ordered to repeat the wording of the Adhan for prayers twice, and to pronounce the wording of the Iqama once except "Qad-qamat-is-salat
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko Adhan ke alfaaz do-do baar aur Iqama ke alfaaz ek-ek baar (siwaye "Qad-qamat-is-salat" ke) kehne ka hukum diya gaya.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:When the number of Muslims increased they discussed the question as to how to know the time for the prayer by some familiar means. Some suggested that a fire be lit (at the time of the prayer) and others put forward the proposal to ring the bell. Bilal was ordered to pronounce the wording of Adhan twice and of the Iqama once only
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke jab Musalmanon ki tadaad badhi, unhone namaz ka waqt jaanne ke liye kisi jaani-pehchani cheez ke baare mein baat ki. Kuch ne aag jalane ki tajweez di, kuch ne ghanti bajaane ki. Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko Adhan ke alfaaz do-do baar aur Iqama ek-ek baar kahne ka hukum diya gaya.

e: Narrated Abu Qilaba:Anas said, "Bilal was ordered to pronounce the wording of Adhan twice and of Iqama once only." The sub narrator Isma`il said, "I mentioned that to Aiyub and he added (to that), "Except Iqama (i.e. Qad-qamat-is-salat which should be said twice)
hi: Abu Qilaba bataate hain ke Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko Adhan ke alfaaz do-do baar aur Iqama ek-ek baar kehne ka hukum diya gaya." Rawi Ismail ne kaha: "Maine yeh Aiyub ko bataya, unhone joda: 'Siwaye Iqama ke (yaani Qad-qamat-is-salat do baar kahi jaati hai).'"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When the Adhan is pronounced Satan takes to his heels and passes wind with noise during his flight in order not to hear the Adhan. When the Adhan is completed he comes back and again takes to his heels when the Iqama is pronounced and after its completion he returns again till he whispers into the heart of the person (to divert his attention from his prayer) and makes him remember things which he does not recall to his mind before the prayer and that causes him to forget how much he has prayed
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jab Adhan di jaati hai, shaitan peeth phera kar bhaag jaata hai aur hawa (paadta) chhodta hua bhaagta hai taake Adhan na sun sake. Jab Adhan khatam hoti hai, woh wapas aa jaata hai, phir Iqama shuru hote hi wapas bhaag jaata hai, khatam hone par phir aa jaata hai yahan tak ke woh namazi ke dil mein waswasa daalta hai (uska dhyan namaz se hataane ke liye) aur usay woh baatein yaad dilaata hai jo namaz se pehle usne khayaal mein nahi rakhi thi, jisse woh bhool jaata hai usne kitni rakat padhi hain."

e: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman:Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri told my father, "I see you liking sheep and the wilderness. So whenever you are with your sheep or in the wilderness and you want to pronounce Adhan for the prayer raise your voice in doing so, for whoever hears the Adhan, whether a human being, a jinn or any other creature, will be a witness for you on the Day of Resurrection." Abu Sa`id added, "I heard it (this narration) from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
hi: Abdur-Rahman bataate hain ke Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne unke waalid se kaha: "Main dekhta hoon tumhe bhed-bakriyon aur jungle mein rehna pasand hai. Isliye jab tum apne bhed-bakriyon ke saath ya jungle mein ho aur namaz ke liye Adhan dena chaho, apni awaaz buland karo, kyunke jo bhi Adhan sunta hai, chahe insaan ho, jinn ho ya koi aur makhlooq, Qiyamat ke din tumhare liye gawah banega." Abu Saeed ne joda: "Maine yeh Allah ke Rasool se suna hai."

e: Narrated Humaid:Anas bin Malik said, "Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) went out with us to fight (in Allah's cause) against any nation, he never allowed us to attack till morning and he would wait and see: if he heard Adhan he would postpone the attack and if he did not hear Adhan he would attack them." Anas added, "We reached Khaibar at night and in the morning when he did not hear the Adhan for the prayer, he (the Prophet ) rode and I rode behind Abi Talha and my foot was touching that of the Prophet. The inhabitants of Khaibar came out with their baskets and spades and when they saw the Prophet (ﷺ) they shouted 'Muhammad! By Allah, Muhammad and his army.' When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw them, he said, "Allahu-Akbar! Allahu-Akbar! Khaibar is ruined. Whenever we approach a (hostile) nation (to fight), then evil will be the morning of those who have been warned
hi: Humaid bataate hain ke Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Jab bhi Nabi humare saath kisi qaum se jung ke liye nikalte, hume subah tak hamla karne ki ijazat nahi dete, Aap intezar karte: agar Adhan sunte to hamla taal dete, agar na sunte to hamla karte." Anas ne joda: "Hum raat ko Khaibar pahunche, subah jab Adhan nahi suni, Aap (Nabi) sawar hue, main Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke peechhe sawar hua, mera paon Nabi ke paon se chhoo raha tha. Khaibar ke log apni tokariyan aur belchein lekar bahar aaye, jab unhone Nabi ko dekha, chillaye: 'Muhammad! Allah ki qasam, Muhammad aur unki fauj.' Allah ke Rasool ne unhe dekh kar farmaya: 'Allahu Akbar! Allahu Akbar! Khaibar barbaad ho gaya. Jab hum kisi (dushman) qaum ke qareeb jaate hain to jinhe khabardar kiya gaya unki subah buri hoti hai.'"

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whenever you hear the Adhan, say what the Mu'adh-dhin is saying
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jab bhi tum Adhan suno, wahi kaho jo Muazzin keh raha ho."

e: Narrated `Isa bin Talha:that he had heard Muawiya repeating the words of Adhan up to "Wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan rasulul-lah (and I testify that Muhammad is Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
hi: Isa bin Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke unhone Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko Adhan ke alfaaz "Wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan Rasoolullah" tak dohraate suna.

e: Narrated Yahya as above (586) and added:"Some of my companions told me that Hisham had said, "When the Mu'adh-dhin said, "Haiyi `alassala (come for the prayer)." Muawiya said, "La hawla wala quwata illa billah (There is neither might nor any power except with Allah)" and added, "We heard your Prophet saying the same
hi: Yahya se yehi riwayat hai (jaisa upar), aur joda: "Mere kuch sathiyon ne mujhe bataya ke Hisham ne kaha: 'Jab Muazzin ne "Haiyi ala-s-salah" (namaz ke liye aao) kaha, Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha "La hawla wala quwata illa billah" (Allah ke siwa na koi taaqat hai na quwwat)' aur joda: 'Humne tumhare Nabi ko bhi yehi kehte suna.'"

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever after listening to the Adhan says, 'Allahumma Rabba hadhihi-dda` watit-tammah, was-salatil qa'imah, ati Muhammadan al-wasilata wal-fadilah, wa b`ath-hu maqaman mahmudan-il-ladhi wa`adtahu' [O Allah! Lord of this perfect call (perfect by not ascribing partners to You) and of the regular prayer which is going to be established, give Muhammad the right of intercession and illustriousness, and resurrect him to the best and the highest place in Paradise that You promised him (of)], then my intercession for him will be allowed on the Day of Resurrection
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jo bhi Adhan sunkar kahe: 'Allahumma Rabba hadhihi-d-da'watit-tammah, was-salatil-qa'imah, aati Muhammadan al-wasilata wal-fadilah, wa ba'ath-hu maqaman mahmudan-illadhi wa'adtahu' (Aye Allah, is mukammal pukaar aur qaim namaz ke Rab, Muhammad ko wasila aur fazeelat de, aur unhe us mahmood (sarahniya) makaam par uthaana jiska tune waada kiya hai), to Qiyamat ke din uske liye meri shifa'at jaiz hogi."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If the people knew the reward for pronouncing the Adhan and for standing in the first row (in congregational prayers) and found no other way to get that except by drawing lots they would draw lots, and if they knew the reward of the Zuhr prayer (in the early moments of its stated time) they would race for it (go early) and if they knew the reward of `Isha' and Fajr (morning) prayers in congregation, they would come to offer them even if they had to crawl
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Agar logon ko Adhan dene aur pehli saf mein khade hone ka sawaab pata hota, aur unhe iske liye qura-andaazi (lottery) ke siwa koi raasta na milta, to woh qura-andaazi karte. Agar unhe Zuhr (uske shuru waqt mein) padhne ka sawaab pata hota, woh iske liye daud lagate (jaldi jaate). Aur agar unhe Isha aur Fajr jamaat ka sawaab pata hota, woh reng kar bhi aate."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Al-Harith:Once on a rainy muddy day, Ibn `Abbas delivered a sermon in our presence and when the Mu'adhdhin pronounced the Adhan and said, "Haiyi `ala-s-sala(t) (come for the prayer)" Ibn `Abbas ordered him to say 'Pray at your homes.' The people began to look at each other (surprisingly). Ibn `Abbas said. "It was done by one who was much better than I (i.e. the Prophet (ﷺ) or his Mu'adh-dhin), and it is a license
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Harith bataate hain ke ek baarish-bhare kichad wale din, Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne humare saamne khutba diya, jab Muazzin ne Adhan di aur "Haiyi ala-s-salah" kaha, Ibn Abbas ne use kehne ka hukum diya: "Apne gharon mein namaz padho." Log ek-doosre ko hairat se dekhne lage. Ibn Abbas ne kaha: "Yeh usne kiya jo mujhse kahin behtar the (yaani Nabi ya unke Muazzin), aur yeh ijazat hai."

e: Narrated Salim bin `Abdullah:My father said that Allah's Apostle said, "Bilal pronounces 'Adhan at night, so keep on eating and drinking (Suhur) till Ibn Um Maktum pronounces Adhan." Salim added, "He was a blind man who would not pronounce the Adhan unless he was told that the day had dawned
hi: Salim bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain, apne waalid ke hawale se: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) raat ko Adhan deta hai, isliye Ibn Um Maktum ki Adhan tak khaana-peena (Sehri) jaari rakho." Salim ne joda: "Woh andhe the, aur din nikal aane ki khabar mile bina Adhan nahi dete the."

e: Narrated Hafsa:When the Mu'adh-dhin pronounced the Adhan for Fajr prayer and the dawn became evident the Prophet ordered a two rak`at light prayer (Sunna) before the Iqama of the compulsory (congregational) prayer
hi: Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke jab Muazzin Fajr ki Adhan deta aur subah zahir ho jaati, Nabi farz jamaat ki Iqama se pehle do halki rakat (Sunnat) padhne ka hukum dete.

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to offer two light rak`at between the Adhan and the Iqama of the Fajr prayer
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke Nabi Fajr ki Adhan aur Iqama ke darmiyan do halki rakat padhte the.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Bilal pronounces the Adhan at night, so keep on eating and drinking (Suhur) till Ibn Um Maktum pronounces the Adhan
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) raat ko Adhan deta hai, isliye Ibn Um Maktum ki Adhan tak khaana-peena (Sehri) jaari rakho."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Mas`ud:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The Adhan pronounced by Bilal should not stop you from taking Suhur, for he pronounces the Adhan at night, so that the one offering the late night prayer (Tahajjud) from among you might hurry up and the sleeping from among you might wake up. It does not mean that dawn or morning has started." Then he (the Prophet) pointed with his fingers and raised them up (towards the sky) and then lowered them (towards the earth) like this (Ibn Mas`ud imitated the gesture of the Prophet). Az-Zuhri gestured with his two index fingers which he put on each other and then stretched them to the right and left. These gestures illustrate the way real dawn appears. It spreads left and right horizontally. The dawn that appears in the high sky and lowers down is not the real dawn
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki Adhan tumhe Sehri khaane se na roke, kyunke woh raat ko Adhan deta hai, taake tum mein se tahajjud padhne wala jaldi kare aur sone wala jaag jaaye. Iska matlab yeh nahi ke fajr ya subah ho gayi hai." Phir Nabi ne apni ungliyon se ishara kiya, unhe upar (aasman ki taraf) uthaya, phir neeche (zameen ki taraf) laaye (Ibn Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Nabi ka yeh ishara dikhaya). Az-Zuhri ne apni do ungliyaan ek-doosre par rakh kar dahine-baayen phaila kar ishara kiya. Yeh ishare asli fajr ke phailne ka tareeqa dikhate hain, jo dahine-baayen euphuk mein phailti hai. Jo fajr oonchi jagah aasman mein zahir hokar neeche aati hai, woh asli fajr nahi hoti.

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Bilal pronounces the Adhan at night, so eat and drink (Suhur) till Ibn Um Maktum pronounces the Adhan
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) raat ko Adhan deta hai, isliye Ibn Um Maktum ki Adhan tak khao-piyo (Sehri)."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Mughaffal Al-Muzani:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said thrice, "There is a prayer between the two Adhans (Adhan and Iqama)," and added, "For the one who wants to pray
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Mughaffal Al-Muzani (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne teen baar farmaya: "Do Adhanon (Adhan aur Iqama) ke darmiyan namaz hai," aur joda: "Jo padhna chahe uske liye."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:"When the Mu'adh-dhin pronounced the Adhan, some of the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) would proceed to the pillars of the mosque (for the prayer) till the Prophet (ﷺ) arrived and in this way they used to pray two rak`at before the Maghrib prayer. There used to be a little time between the Adhan and the Iqama." Shu`ba said, "There used to be a very short interval between the two (Adhan and Iqama)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai: "Jab Muazzin Adhan deta, Nabi ke kuch sahaba masjid ke sutoon ki taraf jaate (namaz ke liye) yahan tak ke Nabi aa jaate, is tarah woh Maghrib se pehle do rakat padhte. Adhan aur Iqama ke darmiyan thoda waqt hota tha." Shu'ba ne kaha: "Dono ke darmiyan bahut kam waqt hota tha."

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to pray two light rak`at before the morning (compulsory) prayer after the day dawned and the Mu'adh-dhin had finished his Adhan. He then would lie on his right side till the Mu'adh-dhin came to pronounce the Iqama
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool subah ki (farz) namaz se pehle, jab din nikal chuka hota aur Muazzin apni Adhan khatam kar chuka hota, do halki rakat padhte. Phir Iqama tak apni dahini taraf let jaate.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Mughaffal:The prophet said, "There is a prayer between the two Adhans (Adhan and Iqama), there is a prayer between the two Adhans." And then while saying it the third time he added, "For the one who wants to (pray)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Mughaffal (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne kaha: "Do Adhanon ke darmiyan namaz hai, do Adhanon ke darmiyan namaz hai," aur teesri baar kehte huye joda: "Jo padhna chahe uske liye."

e: Narrated Malik bin Huwairith:I came to the Prophet (ﷺ) with some men from my tribe and stayed with him for twenty nights. He was kind and merciful to us. When he realized our longing for our families, he said to us, "Go back and stay with your families and teach them the religion, and offer the prayer and one of you should pronounce the Adhan for the prayer when its time is due and the oldest one amongst you should lead the prayer
hi: Malik bin Huwairith (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Main apne qabile ke kuch logon ke saath Nabi ke paas aaya aur bees raatein unke saath rahe. Aap humare saath bahut mehrbaan aur reham dil the. Jab unhe ehsaas hua ke hum apne gharwalon ko yaad kar rahe hain, farmaya: 'Wapas jao aur apne gharwalon ke saath raho aur unhe deen sikhaao, aur namaz padho, aur jab uska waqt aaye tum mein se koi Adhan de, aur sabse bada (umr mein) imamat kare.'"

e: Narrated Abu Dhar:We were in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) on a journey and the Mu'adh-dhin wanted to pronounce the Adhan for the (Zuhr) prayer. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "Let it become cooler." Then he again wanted to pronounce the Adhan but the Prophet; said to him, "Let it become cooler." The Mu'adh-dhin again wanted to pronounce the Adhan for the prayer but the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Let it become cooler," till the shadows of the hillocks become equal to their sizes. The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "The severity of the heat is from the raging of Hell
hi: Abu Dharr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Hum Nabi ke saath safar mein the, Muazzin Zuhr ki Adhan dena chahta tha. Nabi ne usse kaha: 'Thanda hone do.' Usne phir chaha, Nabi ne kaha: 'Thanda hone do.' Muazzin ne phir chaha, Nabi ne kaha: 'Thanda hone do,' yahan tak ke pahadon ke saaye unke qad ke barabar ho gaye." Nabi ne joda: "Garmi ki shiddat Dozakh ki lapaton se hai."

e: Narrated Malik bin Huwairith:Two men came to the Prophet (ﷺ) with the intention of a journey. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When (both of) you set out, pronounce Adhan and then Iqama and the oldest of you should lead the prayer
hi: Malik bin Huwairith (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke do log Nabi ke paas safar ke iraade se aaye. Nabi ne farmaya: "Jab tum dono nikalo, Adhan do phir Iqama, aur tum mein se bada (umr mein) imamat kare."

e: Narrated Malik:We came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and stayed with him for twenty days and nights. We were all young and of about the same age. The Prophet (ﷺ) was very kind and merciful. When he realized our longing for our families, he asked about our homes and the people there and we told him. Then he asked us to go back to our families and stay with them and teach them (the religion) and to order them to do good things. He also mentioned some other things which I have (remembered or [??] ) forgotten. The Prophet (ﷺ) then added, "Pray as you have seen me praying and when it is the time for the prayer one of you should pronounce the Adhan and the oldest of you should lead the prayer
hi: Malik bataate hain: "Hum Nabi ke paas aaye aur bees din-raatein unke saath rahe. Hum sab jawan aur taqreeban hum-umr the. Nabi bahut mehrbaan aur reham dil the. Jab unhe ehsaas hua ke hum apne gharwalon ko yaad kar rahe hain, unhone humare gharon aur wahan ke logon ke baare mein pucha, humne bataya. Phir unhone humein wapas jaakar apne gharwalon ke saath rehne, unhe (deen) sikhane, aur achhe kaam karne ka hukum diya. Aap ne kuch aur baatein bhi kahin jo mujhe (yaad hai ya) bhool gaya. Nabi ne joda: 'Waisi namaz padho jaisi tumne mujhe padhte dekha hai, aur jab namaz ka waqt ho, tum mein se koi Adhan de aur sabse bada imamat kare.'"

e: Narrated Nafi`:Once in a cold night, Ibn `Umar pronounced the Adhan for the prayer at Dajnan (the name of a mountain) and then said, "Pray at your homes", and informed us that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to tell the Mu'adh-dhin to pronounce Adhan and say, "Pray at your homes" at the end of the Adhan on a rainy or a very cold night during the journey
hi: Nafi bataate hain ke ek sardi ki raat, Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Dajnan (ek pahad ka naam) mein Adhan di aur kaha: "Apne gharon mein namaz padho," aur humein bataya ke Allah ke Rasool Muazzin ko kehte the ke Adhan ke aakhir mein baarish ya sakht sardi ki raat safar mein "Apne gharon mein namaz padho" kahe.

e: Narrated `Aun bin Abi Juhaifa:My father said, "I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) at a place called Al-Abtah. Bilal came and informed him about the prayer and then came out with a short spear (or stick) and planted it in front of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) at Al-Abtah and pronounced the Iqama
hi: Aun bin Abi Juhaifa bataate hain, apne waalid ke hawale se: "Maine Allah ke Rasool ko Al-Abtah naam ki jagah dekha. Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) aaye aur unhe namaz ke baare mein bataya, phir ek chhota neza lekar bahar aaye aur Allah ke Rasool ke saamne Al-Abtah mein gaad diya, aur Iqama di."

e: Narrated `Aun bin Abi Juhaifa:My father said, "I saw Bilal turning his face from side to side while pronouncing the Adhan for the prayer
hi: Aun bin Abi Juhaifa bataate hain, apne waalid ke hawale se: "Maine Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko Adhan dete waqt apna chehra idhar-udhar mod te dekha."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abi Qatada:My father said, "While we were praying with the Prophet (ﷺ) he heard the noise of some people. After the prayer he said, 'What is the matter?' They replied 'We were hurrying for the prayer.' He said, 'Do not make haste for the prayer, and whenever you come for the prayer, you should come with calmness, and pray whatever you get (with the people) and complete the rest which you have missed
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Qatada bataate hain, apne waalid ke hawale se: "Hum Nabi ke saath namaz padh rahe the, unhone kuch logon ki awaaz suni. Namaz ke baad Aap ne pucha: 'Kya baat hai?' Unhone jawab diya: 'Hum namaz ke liye jaldi mein the.' Aap ne farmaya: 'Namaz ke liye jaldbaazi mat karo, aur jab bhi namaz ke liye aao, sukoon se aao, aur jo (rakatein) mil jayein padho, aur jo chhoot gayi hain unhe poori karo.'"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When you hear the Iqama, proceed to offer the prayer with calmness and solemnity and do not make haste. And pray whatever you are able to pray and complete whatever you have missed
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Jab Iqama suno, sukoon aur waqar ke saath namaz ke liye jao, jaldbaazi mat karo. Jo (rakatein) mil jayein padho, aur jo chhoot gayi hain unhe poori karo."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abi Qatada:My father said. "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'If the Iqama is pronounced then do not stand for the prayer till you see me (in front of you)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Qatada bataate hain, apne waalid ke hawale se: "Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: 'Agar Iqama ho jaaye to namaz ke liye tab tak khade na ho jab tak mujhe (apne saamne) na dekh lo.'"

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abi Qatada: My father said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'If the Iqama is pronounced, then do not stand for the prayer till you see me (in front of you) and do it calmly
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Qatada bataate hain, apne waalid ke hawale se: "Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: 'Agar Iqama ho jaaye to namaz ke liye tab tak khade na ho jab tak mujhe na dekh lo, aur sukoon se karo.'"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went out (of the mosque) when the Iqama had been pronounced and the rows straightened. The Prophet (ﷺ) stood at his Musalla (praying place) and we waited for the Prophet (ﷺ) to begin the prayer with Takbir. He left and asked us to remain in our places. We kept on standing till the Prophet returned and the water was trickling from his head for he had taken a bath (of Janaba)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool bahar aaye (masjid se) jab Iqama ho chuki thi aur safein seedhi ho chuki thin. Nabi apni Musalla par khade hue aur hum Takbir ka intezar karte rahe. Aap wapas gaye aur humein apni jagah rukne ko kaha. Hum khade rahe yahan tak ke Nabi wapas aaye, unke sar se paani tapak raha tha kyunke unhone (janaba ka) ghusl kiya tha.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Once Iqama was pronounced and the people had straightened the rows, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went forward (to lead the prayer) but he was Junub, so he said, "Remain in your places." And he went out, took a bath and returned with water trickling from his head. Then he led the prayer
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke ek baar Iqama ho chuki thi aur log safein seedhi kar chuke the, Allah ke Rasool aage badhe (imamat ke liye) magar woh Junub the, isliye farmaya: "Apni jagah raho." Aap bahar gaye, ghusl kiya aur sar se paani tapkaate wapas aaye. Phir imamat ki.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:On the day of Al-Khandaq (the trench), `Umar bin Al-Khattab went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! By Allah, I could not pray (the `Asr) till the sun had set." `Umar told this to the Prophet at the time when a fasting person had done Iftar (taken his meals). The Prophet (ﷺ) then went to Buthan and I was with him. He performed ablution and offered the `Asr prayer after the sun had set and then the Maghrib prayer
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Khandaq ki jung ke din, Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Khattab (رضی اللہ عنہ) Nabi ke paas gaye aur kaha: "Ya Rasoolallah! Allah ki qasam, main (Asr) padh na saka jab tak suraj na doob gaya." Umar ne yeh Nabi ko us waqt bataya jab roza rakhne wala Iftar kar chuka tha. Nabi Buthan gaye, main unke saath tha. Aap ne wudu kiya aur suraj doobne ke baad Asr padhi, phir Maghrib.

e: Narrated Anas:Once the Iqama was pronounced and the Prophet (ﷺ) was talking to a man (in a low voice) in a corner of the mosque and he did not lead the prayer till (some of) the people had slept (dozed in a sitting posture)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke ek baar Iqama ho chuki thi aur Nabi masjid ke ek kone mein kisi shaks se (dheemi awaaz mein) baat kar rahe the, Aap ne imamat tab tak nahi ki jab tak (kuch) log baithe-baithe (thodi der) so nahi gaye.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Once Iqama was pronounced a man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and detained him (from the prayer)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke ek baar Iqama ho chuki thi, ek shaks Nabi ke paas aaya aur unhe (namaz se) rok liya.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "By Him in Whose Hand my soul is I was about to order for collecting firewood (fuel) and then order Someone to pronounce the Adhan for the prayer and then order someone to lead the prayer then I would go from behind and burn the houses of men who did not present themselves for the (compulsory congregational) prayer. By Him, in Whose Hands my soul is, if anyone of them had known that he would get a bone covered with good meat or two (small) pieces of meat present in between two ribs, he would have turned up for the `Isha' prayer
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Us zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, mera dil chahta tha ke lakdiyan jama karwaun, phir kisi ko Adhan dene ka hukum dun, phir kisi ko imamat karne ka hukum dun, phir main un logon ke gharon mein aag laga dun jo (farz) namaz mein hazir nahi hote. Us zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, agar unhe pata hota ke unhe achha gosht laga ek achha haddi ka tukda ya do achhi boti milegi, to woh zaroor Isha ke liye aate."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The prayer in congregation is twenty seven times superior to the prayer offered by a person alone
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jamaat ki namaz akele padhi namaz se sattaais guna behtar hai."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The prayer in congregation is twenty five times superior to the prayer offered by a person alone
hi: Abu Saeed Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Jamaat ki namaz akele padhi namaz se pachees guna behtar hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The reward of the prayer offered by a person in congregation is twenty five times greater than that of the prayer offered in one's house or in the market (alone). And this is because if he performs ablution and does it perfectly and then proceeds to the mosque with the sole intention of praying, then for every step he takes towards the mosque, he is upgraded one degree in reward and his one sin is taken off (crossed out) from his accounts (of deeds). When he offers his prayer, the angels keep on asking Allah's Blessings and Allah's forgiveness for him as long as he is (staying) at his Musalla. They say, 'O Allah! Bestow Your blessings upon him, be Merciful and kind to him.' And one is regarded in prayer as long as one is waiting for the prayer
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jamaat mein padhi namaz ka sawaab akele (ghar mein ya bazaar mein) padhi namaz se pachees guna zyada hai. Isliye ke agar koi mukammal wudu kare aur sirf namaz ki niyyat se masjid jaaye, to har qadam par uska darja badhta hai aur ek gunah mit jaata hai. Namaz padhte huye, farishte Allah se uske liye rehmat aur maafi maangte rehte hain jab tak woh apni Musalla par ho. Woh kehte hain: 'Aye Allah! Ispar apni rehmatein utaar, ispar reham kar.' Aur namaz ka intezar karne wala bhi namaz mein hi shumar hota hai."

e: Narrated Abu Salama bin `Abdur Rahman:Abu Huraira said, "I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, 'The reward of a prayer in congregation is twenty five times greater than that of a prayer offered by a person alone. The angels of the night and the angels of the day gather at the time of Fajr prayer.' " Abu Huraira then added, "Recite the Holy Book if you wish, for "Indeed, the recitation of the Qur'an in the early dawn (Fajr prayer) is ever witnessed." (17:)
hi: Abu Salama bin Abdur Rahman bataate hain ke Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool ko farmate suna: 'Jamaat ki namaz ka sawaab akele padhi namaz se pachees guna zyada hai. Fajr ke waqt raat aur din ke farishte ikathe hote hain.'" Abu Huraira ne joda: "Chaho to Kitaab (Quran) padho: 'Beshak Fajr ki tilawat mushahide mein hoti hai' (17:78)."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The reward of the congregational prayer is twenty seven times greater (than that of the prayer offered by a person alone)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke jamaat ki namaz ka sawaab (akele padhi namaz se) sattaais guna zyada hai.

e: Narrated Salim:I heard Um Ad-Darda' saying, "Abu Ad-Darda' entered the house in an angry mood. I said to him. 'What makes you angry?' He replied, 'By Allah! I do not find the followers of Muhammad doing those good things (which they used to do before) except the offering of congregational prayer." (This happened in the last days of Abu Ad-Darda' during the rule of `Uthman)
hi: Salim bataate hain ke unhone Um Ad-Darda ko kehte suna: "Abu Ad-Darda ghar mein gusse ki halat mein aaye. Maine pucha: 'Aapko kis baat ne naraz kiya?' Unhone jawab diya: 'Allah ki qasam, mujhe Muhammad ke pairokaron mein woh achhi baatein (jo pehle karte the) nahi milti, siwaye jamaat ki namaz ke.'" (Yeh Abu Ad-Darda ki zindagi ke aakhri dinon ki baat hai, Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki hukumat mein.)

e: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The people who get tremendous reward for the prayer are those who are farthest away (from the mosque) and then those who are next farthest and so on. Similarly one who waits to pray with the Imam has greater reward than one who prays and goes to bed
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Namaz ke liye sabse zyada sawaab paane wale woh log hain jo (masjid se) sabse door hain, phir unse kam door, waghera. Aur jo Imam ke saath namaz ka intezar kare, uska sawaab us shaks se zyada hai jo namaz padh kar so jaaye."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "While a man was going on a way, he saw a thorny branch and removed it from the way and Allah became pleased by his action and forgave him for that." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Five are martyrs: One who dies of plague, one who dies of an Abdominal disease, one who dies of drowning, one who is buried alive (and) dies and one who is killed in Allah's cause." (The Prophet (ﷺ) further said, "If the people knew the reward for pronouncing the Adhan and for standing in the first row (in the congregational prayer) and found no other way to get it except by drawing lots they would do so, and if they knew the reward of offering the Zuhr prayer early (in its stated time), they would race for it and if they knew the reward for `Isha' and Fajr prayers in congregation, they would attend them even if they were to crawl
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Ek shaks raaste par ja raha tha, usne ek kaante wali daali dekhi aur use raaste se hataya, Allah usse khush hua aur uske gunah maaf kar diye." Phir Nabi ne farmaya: "Paanch shaheed hain: Woh jo taun (plague) se mare, jo pait ki bimari se mare, jo doobne se mare, jo dab kar mare, aur jo Allah ki raah mein qatl ho." (Nabi ne yeh bhi farmaya: "Agar logon ko Adhan dene aur pehli saf mein khade hone ka sawaab pata hota, aur unhe iske liye qura-andaazi ke siwa koi raasta na milta, to woh aisa karte. Agar unhe Zuhr jaldi padhne ka sawaab pata hota, woh iske liye daud lagate. Aur agar unhe Isha aur Fajr jamaat ka sawaab pata hota, woh reng kar bhi aate.")

e: Narrated Humaid:Anas said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'O Bani Salima! Don't you think that for every step of yours (that you take towards the mosque) there is a reward (while coming for prayer)?" Mujahid said: "Regarding Allah's Statement: "We record that which they have sent before (them), and their traces" (36.12). 'Their traces' means 'their steps.' " And Anas said that the people of Bani Salima wanted to shift to a place near the Prophet (ﷺ) but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) disliked the idea of leaving their houses uninhabited and said, "Don't you think that you will get the reward for your footprints." Mujahid said, "Their foot prints mean their foot steps and their going on foot
hi: Humaid bataate hain ke Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Nabi ne farmaya: 'Aye Bani Salima! Kya tumhe nahi lagta ke (masjid ki taraf) har qadam ka ajr hai?'" Mujahid ne kaha, is ayat ke baare mein: "Hum likhte hain jo unhone bheja aur unke nishaan" (36:12) — 'nishaan' ka matlab hai 'unke qadam'. Anas ne bataya ke Bani Salima ke log Nabi ke qareeb shift hona chahte the, magar Allah ke Rasool ne unke gharon ko khaali chhodna napasand kiya aur kaha: "Kya tumhe nahi lagta ke tumhe apne qadmon ke nishaanon ka bhi sawaab milega?" Mujahid ne kaha: "'Unke nishaan' ka matlab hai unke qadam aur paidal chalna."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No prayer is heavier upon the hypocrites than the Fajr and the `Isha' prayers and if they knew what is in them (in reward), they would have attended them, even if (it was) crawling. Certainly, I felt the urge to order the Mu'adh-dhin (call-maker) so that he would pronounce Iqama, then order a man to lead the people (in prayer), then take a flame of fire so that I burn (the houses) upon those who had not left for the prayer yet
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Munafiqon par Fajr aur Isha se bhaari koi namaz nahi, aur agar unhe pata hota inme kya (sawaab) hai, to woh zaroor aate, chahe reng kar. Beshak mera dil chahta tha ke Muazzin ko Iqama dene ka hukum dun, phir kisi ko logon ki imamat karne ka hukum dun, phir aag ki mashaal lekar un logon ke gharon ko jala dun jo abhi tak namaz ke liye nahi nikle."

e: Narrated Malik bin Huwairith:Prophet said (to two persons), "Whenever the prayer time becomes due, you should pronounce Adhan and then Iqama and the older of you should lead the prayer
hi: Malik bin Huwairith (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne (do logon se) farmaya: "Jab bhi namaz ka waqt aaye, Adhan do phir Iqama, aur tum mein bada (umr mein) imamat kare."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The angels keep on asking for Allah's Blessing and Forgiveness for anyone of you as long as he is at his Musalla (praying place) and does not do Hadath (passes wind). The angels say, 'O Allah! Forgive him and be Merciful to him.' Each one of you is in the prayer as long as he is waiting for the prayer and nothing but the prayer detains him from going to his family
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Farishte tum mein se kisi ke liye Allah se maafi aur rehmat maangte rehte hain jab tak woh apni Musalla par ho aur hadath (wudu tootne wali cheez) na ho. Farishte kehte hain: 'Aye Allah! Ise maaf kar. Aye Allah! Ispar reham kar.' Tum mein se har ek namaz mein hi hota hai jab tak namaz ka intezar kare, aur namaz ke siwa koi cheez use apne gharwalon ke paas jaane se na roke."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah will give shade, to seven, on the Day when there will be no shade but His. (These seven persons are) a just ruler, a youth who has been brought up in the worship of Allah (i.e. worships Allah sincerely from childhood), a man whose heart is attached to the mosques (i.e. to pray the compulsory prayers in the mosque in congregation), two persons who love each other only for Allah's sake and they meet and part in Allah's cause only, a man who refuses the call of a charming woman of noble birth for illicit intercourse with her and says: I am afraid of Allah, a man who gives charitable gifts so secretly that his left hand does not know what his right hand has given (i.e. nobody knows how much he has given in charity), and a person who remembers Allah in seclusion and his eyes are then flooded with tears
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Allah saat logon ko us din saaya dega jab uske saaye ke siwa koi saaya nahi hoga: 1. Adil hukmaran. 2. Woh jawan jo Allah ki ibadat mein pala-badha ho. 3. Woh shaks jiska dil masjidon se juda ho. 4. Woh do log jo sirf Allah ke liye ek-doosre se mohabbat karte hon, isi ke liye milte-bichhadte hon. 5. Woh mard jise ek khoobsurat aur sharif khandaan ki aurat (haram tareeqe se) bulaye aur woh kahe: 'Main Allah se darta hoon.' 6. Woh shaks jo itni khufia sadqa de ke uske baaye haath ko pata na chale uske dahine haath ne kya diya. 7. Woh shaks jo tanhai mein Allah ko yaad kare aur uski aankhein aansuon se bhar jayein."

e: Narrated Humaid:Anas was asked, "Did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) wear a ring?" He said, "Yes. Once he delayed the `Isha' prayer till midnight and after the prayer, he faced us and said, 'The people prayed and have slept and you remained in prayer as long as you waited for it.' " Anas added, "As if I were just now observing the glitter of his ring
hi: Humaid bataate hain ke Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha gaya: "Kya Allah ke Rasool angoothi pehante the?" Unhone kaha: "Haan. Ek baar Aap ne Isha aadhi raat tak taal di, aur namaz ke baad humari taraf mudte huye farmaya: 'Log namaz padh kar so gaye, magar tum jab tak intezar karte rahe, namaz mein hi the.'" Anas ne joda: "Goya main abhi unki angoothi ki chamak dekh raha hoon."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah will prepare for him who goes to the mosque (every) morning and in the afternoon (for the congregational prayer) an honorable place in Paradise with good hospitality for (what he has done) every morning and afternoon goings
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Jo subah-shaam masjid jaaye (jamaat ki namaz ke liye), Allah uske liye Jannat mein har baar (subah-shaam) jaane ke liye izzat wali jagah aur mehmaan-nawazi taiyaar karega."

e: Narrated Malik Ibn Buhaina:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) passed by a man praying two rak`at after the Iqama (had been pronounced). When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) completed the prayer, the people gathered around him (the Prophet) or that man and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him (protesting), Are there four rak`at in Fajr prayer? Are there four rak`at in Fajr prayer?
hi: Malik Ibn Buhaina (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ek shaks ke paas se guzre jo Iqama ke baad do rakat padh raha tha. Namaz mukammal karke, log us shaks ke ya Nabi ke aas-paas jama ho gaye, aur Allah ke Rasool ne (aitraaz karte huye) usse pucha: "Kya Fajr mein chaar rakat hoti hain? Kya Fajr mein chaar rakat hoti hain?"

e: Narrated Al-Aswad:"We were with `Aisha discussing the regularity of offering the prayer and dignifying it. She said, 'When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) fell sick with the fatal illness and when the time of prayer became due and Adhan was pronounced, he said, 'Tell Abu Bakr to lead the people in prayer.' He was told that Abu Bakr was a softhearted man and would not be able to lead the prayer in his place. The Prophet (ﷺ) gave the same order again but he was given the same reply. He gave the order for the third time and said, 'You (women) are the companions of Joseph. Tell Abu Bakr to lead the prayer.' So Abu Bakr came out to lead the prayer. In the meantime the condition of the Prophet (ﷺ) improved a bit and he came out with the help of two men one on each side. As if I was observing his legs dragging on the ground owing to the disease. Abu Bakr wanted to retreat but the Prophet (ﷺ) beckoned him to remain at his place and the Prophet (ﷺ) was brought till he sat beside Abu Bakr." Al-A`mash was asked, "Was the Prophet (ﷺ) praying and Abu Bakr following him, and were the people following Abu Bakr in that prayer?" Al- A`mash replied in the affirmative with a nod of his head. Abu Muawiya said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) was sitting on the left side of Abu Bakr who was praying while standing
hi: Al-Aswad bataate hain: "Hum Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke saath namaz ki paabandi aur baqaidgi ke baare mein baat kar rahe the. Unhone kaha: 'Jab Allah ke Rasool apni aakhri bimari mein bimaar hue aur namaz ka waqt aaya aur Adhan hui, Aap ne farmaya: Abu Bakr se kaho logon ki imamat karein. Unhe bataya gaya ke Abu Bakr narm-dil hain aur aapki jagah imamat nahi kar sakenge. Nabi ne dobara wahi hukum diya magar wahi jawab mila. Aap ne teesri baar hukum diya aur farmaya: Tum (aurtein) Yusuf ki sathi ho. Abu Bakr se kaho imamat karein. To Abu Bakr imamat karne aaye. Isi dauran Nabi ki halat kuch behtar hui aur Aap do aadmiyon ke sahaare bahar aaye, har taraf ek-ek. Goya main abhi unke paon bimari ki wajah se zameen par ghisatte dekh rahi hoon. Abu Bakr peeche hatna chahte the magar Nabi ne unhe apni jagah rehne ka ishara kiya, aur Nabi ko Abu Bakr ke paas baithaya gaya.'" Al-A'mash se pucha gaya: "Kya Nabi namaz padh rahe the aur Abu Bakr unki pairvi kar rahe the, aur log Abu Bakr ki pairvi kar rahe the?" Al-A'mash ne sar hila kar haan kaha. Abu Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Nabi Abu Bakr ke baayen baithe the jabke Abu Bakr khade hokar imamat kar rahe the."

e: Narrated `Aisha:"When the Prophet (ﷺ) became seriously ill and his disease became aggravated he asked for permission from his wives to be nursed in my house and he was allowed. He came out with the help of two men and his legs were dragging on the ground. He was between Al-`Abbas and another man." 'Ubaidullah said, "I told Ibn `Abbas what `Aisha had narrated and he said, 'Do you know who was the (second) man whose name `Aisha did not mention'" I said, 'No.' Ibn `Abbas said, 'He was `Ali Ibn Abi Talib
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai: "Jab Nabi sakht bimar hue aur bimari badh gayi, Aap ne apni biwiyon se meri dekhbhal ke liye mere ghar mein rehne ki ijazat maangi, unhone ijazat di. Aap do aadmiyon ke sahaare bahar aaye, unke paon zameen par ghisat rahe the. Aap Abbas aur ek doosre shaks ke beech the." Ubaidullah ne kaha: "Maine Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko Ayesha ki yeh baat batai, unhone pucha: 'Kya tumhe pata hai woh (doosra) shaks kaun tha jiska naam Ayesha ne nahi liya?' Maine kaha: 'Nahi.' Ibn Abbas ne kaha: 'Woh Ali (Alayhis Salam) Ibn Abi Talib the.'"

e: Narrated Nafi`:Once on a very cold and stormy night, Ibn `Umar pronounced the Adhan for the prayer and then said, "Pray in your homes." He (Ibn `Umar) added. "On very cold and rainy nights Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to order the Mu'adh-dhin to say, 'Pray in your homes
hi: Nafi bataate hain ke ek sakht sardi aur toofani raat, Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Adhan di aur kaha: "Apne gharon mein namaz padho." Unhone joda: "Sakht sardi aur baarish ki raaton mein, Allah ke Rasool Muazzin ko yeh kehne ka hukum dete: 'Apne gharon mein namaz padho.'"

e: Narrated Mahmud bin Rabi` Al-Ansari:`Itban bin Malik used to lead his people (tribe) in prayer and was a blind man, he said to Allah's Apostle , "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! At times it is dark and flood water is flowing (in the valley) and I am a blind man, so please pray at a place in my house so that I can take it as a Musalla (praying place)." So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went to his house and said, "Where do you like me to pray?" 'Itban pointed to a place in his house and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), offered the prayer there
hi: Mahmud bin Rabi Al-Ansari bataate hain ke Itban bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) apni qaum ki imamat karte the aur andhe the, unhone Allah ke Rasool se kaha: "Ya Rasoolallah! Kabhi andhera ho jaata hai aur (wadi mein) baarish ka paani beh raha hota hai, aur main andha hoon, isliye meri gharelu jagah par namaz padh dijiye taake main use Musalla bana sakoon." To Allah ke Rasool unke ghar gaye aur pucha: "Kahan padhoon namaz?" Itban ne apne ghar mein ek jagah ishara ki, Allah ke Rasool ne wahan namaz padhi.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Al-Harith:Ibn `Abbas addressed us on a (rainy and) muddy day and when the Mu'adh-dhin said, "Come for the prayer" Ibn `Abbas ordered him to say, "Pray in your homes." The people began to look at one another with surprise as if they did not like it. Ibn `Abbas said, "It seems that you thought ill of it but no doubt it was done by one who was better than I (i.e. the Prophet). It (the prayer) is a strict order and I disliked to bring you out." Ibn `Abbas narrated the same as above but he said, "I did not like you to make you sinful (in refraining from coming to the mosque) and to come (to the mosque) covered with mud up to the knees
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Harith bataate hain ke Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne ek baarish-bhare kichad wale din khutba diya, jab Muazzin ne "Namaz ke liye aao" kaha, Ibn Abbas ne use "Apne gharon mein namaz padho" kehne ka hukum diya. Log hairat se ek-doosre ko dekhne lage jaise unhe yeh pasand na aaya ho. Ibn Abbas ne kaha: "Lagta hai tumne ise bura samjha, magar yeh usne kiya jo mujhse behtar the (yaani Nabi). Yeh (Jumme ki namaz) sakhti se zaroori hukum hai, aur main tumhe (kichad mein) nikalne par majboor nahi karna chahta tha." Ibn Abbas ne yehi baat is tarah bhi bayan ki: "Maine tumhe gunahgaar nahi banana chahta tha, aur na hi tumhe ghutnon tak kichad mein bhigo kar (masjid) laana chahta tha."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:A cloud came and it rained till the roof started leaking and in those days the roof used to be of the branches of date-palms. Iqama was pronounced and I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prostrating in water and mud and even I saw the mark of mud on his forehead
hi: Abu Saeed Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke ek baadal aaya aur itni baarish hui ke chhat se paani tapakne laga (us zamane mein chhat khajoor ki daaliyon se banti thi). Iqama hui aur maine Allah ke Rasool ko paani aur kichad mein sajda karte dekha, yahan tak ke maine unke maathe par kichad ka nishaan bhi dekha.

e: Narrated Anas bin Seereen:I heard Anas saying, "A man from Ansar said to the Prophet, 'I cannot pray with you (in congregation).' He was a very fat man and he prepared a meal for the Prophet (ﷺ) and invited him to his house. He spread out a mat for the Prophet, and washed one of its sides with water, and the Prophet (ﷺ) prayed two rak`at on it." A man from the family of Al-Jaruid [??] asked, "Did the Prophet (ﷺ) used to pray the Duha (forenoon) prayer?" Anas said, "I did not see him praying the Duha prayer except on that day
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Seereen bataate hain ke unhone Anas ko kehte suna: "Ek Ansari shaks ne Nabi se kaha: 'Main aapke saath namaz nahi padh sakta.'
