Woh bahut mota shaks tha, usne Nabi ke liye khaana taiyaar kiya aur unhe apne ghar bulaya. Usne Nabi ke liye chatai bichhai aur uska ek taraf paani se dhoya, aur Nabi ne usi par do rakat padhi." Al-Jaruid khandaan ke ek shaks ne pucha: "Kya Nabi Duha (dopahar se pehle) ki namaz padhte the?" Anas ne kaha: "Maine unhe Duha padhte sirf us din dekha."

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If supper is served, and Iqama is pronounced one should start with the supper
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Agar khana pesh ho aur Iqama ho jaaye, khana khaana shuru karo (pehle)."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If the supper is served start having it before praying the Maghrib prayer and do not be hasty in finishing it
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Agar khana pesh ho, use Maghrib padhne se pehle khana shuru karo, aur jaldbaazi mat karo."

e: Narrated Nafi`:Ibn `Umar said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'If the supper is served for anyone of you and the Iqama is pronounced, start with the supper and don't be in haste (and carry on eating) till you finish it." If food was served for Ibn `Umar and Iqama was pronounced, he never came to the prayer till he finished it (i.e. food) in spite of the fact that he heard the recitation (of the Qur'an) by the Imam (in the prayer)
hi: Nafi bataate hain, Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: 'Agar kisi ka khana pesh ho aur Iqama ho jaaye, pehle khana shuru karo, aur jaldbaazi mat karo jab tak khatam na ho.'" Agar Ibn Umar ko khana pesh hota aur Iqama ho jaati, woh namaz ke liye tab tak nahi jaate jab tak (khana) khatam na kar lete, chahe woh Imam ki tilawat sun rahe hon.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If anyone of you is having his meals, he should not hurry up till he is satisfied even if the prayer has been started
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Agar tum mein se koi khana kha raha ho, jaldbaazi mat karo jab tak pet na bhar jaaye, chahe namaz shuru ho chuki ho."

e: Narrated Ja`far bin `Amr bin Umaiya:My father said, "I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) eating a piece of meat from the shoulder of a sheep and he was called for the prayer. He stood up, put down the knife and prayed but did not perform ablution
hi: Ja'far bin Amr bin Umaiya, apne waalid ke hawale se: "Maine Allah ke Rasool ko bhed ke shoulder ka gosht khate dekha, unhe namaz ke liye bulaya gaya. Aap uthe, chhuri rakh di aur namaz padhi, magar wudu nahi kiya."

e: Narrated Al-Aswad:That he asked `Aisha "What did the Prophet (ﷺ) use to do in his house?" She replied, "He used to keep himself busy serving his family and when it was the time for prayer he would go for it
hi: Al-Aswad bataate hain ke unhone Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se pucha: "Nabi apne ghar mein kya karte the?" Unhone jawab diya: "Woh apne ghar walon ki khidmat karte rehte, aur jab namaz ka waqt aata, woh nikal jaate."

e: Narrated Aiyub:Abu Qilaba said, "Malik bin Huwairith came to this Mosque of ours and said, 'I pray in front of you and my aim is not to lead the prayer but to show you the way in which the Prophet (ﷺ) used to pray.' " I asked Abu Qilaba, "How did he use to pray?' " He replied, "(The Prophet (ﷺ) used to pray) like this Sheikh of ours and the Sheikh used to sit for a while after the prostration, before getting up after the first rak`a
hi: Aiyub bataate hain ke Abu Qilaba ne kaha: "Malik bin Huwairith (رضی اللہ عنہ) humari is masjid mein aaye aur kaha: 'Main tumhare saamne namaz padhta hoon, mera maksad imamat karna nahi balki tumhe Nabi ke padhne ka tareeqa dikhana hai.'" Maine Abu Qilaba se pucha: "Woh kaise padhte the?" Unhone jawab diya: "(Nabi isi tarah padhte the jaise) humare yeh Sheikh, aur Sheikh pehli rakat ke bad sajde ke baad uthne se pehle thodi der baith jaate the."

e: Narrated Abu Musa:"The Prophet (ﷺ) became sick and when his disease became aggravated, he said, "Tell Abu Bakr to lead the prayer." `Aisha said, "He is a softhearted man and would not be able to lead the prayer in your place." The Prophet (ﷺ) said again, "Tell Abu Bakr to lead the people in prayer." She repeated the same reply but he said, "Tell Abu Bakr to lead the people in prayer. You are the companions of Joseph." So the messenger went to Abu Bakr (with that order) and he led the people in prayer in the lifetime of the Prophet
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai: "Nabi bimar hue, jab bimari badh gayi, farmaya: 'Abu Bakr se kaho logon ki imamat karein.' Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha: 'Woh narm-dil hain aur aapki jagah imamat nahi kar sakenge.' Nabi ne phir farmaya: 'Abu Bakr se kaho logon ki imamat karein.' Unhone wahi jawab dohraya, Aap ne farmaya: 'Abu Bakr se kaho logon ki imamat karein. Tum Yusuf ki sathi ho.' To qasid Abu Bakr ke paas gaya, aur unhone Nabi ki zindagi mein hi logon ki imamat ki."

e: Narrated `Aisha:the mother of the believers: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in his illness said, "Tell Abu Bakr to lead the people in prayer." I said to him, "If Abu Bakr stands in your place, the people would not hear him owing to his (excessive) weeping. So please order `Umar to lead the prayer." `Aisha added I said to Hafsa, "Say to him: If Abu Bakr should lead the people in the prayer in your place, the people would not be able to hear him owing to his weeping; so please, order `Umar to lead the prayer." Hafsa did so but Allah's Apostle said, "Keep quiet! You are verily the Companions of Joseph. Tell Abu Bakr to lead the people in the prayer. " Hafsa said to `Aisha, "I never got anything good from you
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai: "Allah ke Rasool ne apni bimari mein farmaya: 'Abu Bakr se kaho logon ki imamat karein.' Maine unse kaha: 'Agar Abu Bakr aapki jagah khade honge, log unhe (rone ki wajah se) sun nahi payenge. Kripya Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko imamat karne ka hukum dein.'" Ayesha ne joda: "Maine Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) se kaha: 'Unse kaho: Agar Abu Bakr aapki jagah imamat karenge, log unhe rone ki wajah se sun nahi payenge, isliye Umar ko hukum dein.' Hafsa ne aisa kiya magar Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: 'Khamosh raho! Tum Yusuf ki sathi ho. Abu Bakr se kaho imamat karein.'" Hafsa ne Ayesha se kaha: "Mujhe tumse kabhi kuch achha nahi mila."

e: Narrated Az-Zuhri:Anas bin Malik Al-Ansari, told me, "Abu Bakr used to lead the people in prayer during the fatal illness of the Prophet (ﷺ) till it was Monday. When the people aligned (in rows) for the prayer the Prophet (ﷺ) lifted the curtain of his house and started looking at us and was standing at that time. His face was (glittering) like a page of the Qur'an and he smiled cheerfully. We were about to be put to trial for the pleasure of seeing the Prophet, Abu Bakr retreated to join the row as he thought that the Prophet (ﷺ) would lead the prayer. The Prophet (ﷺ) beckoned us to complete the prayer and he let the curtain fall. On the same day he died
hi: Az-Zuhri bataate hain: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ansari ne mujhe bataya: "Abu Bakr Nabi ki aakhri bimari mein logon ki imamat karte rahe, yahan tak ke Somvar aaya. Jab log safon mein khade hue, Nabi ne apne ghar ka parda uthaya aur humein dekhte huye khade rahe. Unka chehra Quran ke safhe jaisa (roshan) tha, aur woh khush-mizaji se muskuraye. Hum khushi se Nabi ko dekh kar fitne mein padte-padte bache, Abu Bakr peeche hate saf mein shamil hone ke liye, unhe laga Nabi khud imamat karenge. Nabi ne humein namaz poori karne ka ishara kiya aur parda gira diya. Usi din unka intiqal ho gaya."

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) did not come out for three days. The people stood for the prayer and Abu Bakr went ahead to lead the prayer. (In the meantime) the Prophet (ﷺ) caught hold of the curtain and lifted it. When the face of the Prophet (ﷺ) appeared we had never seen a scene more pleasing than the face of the Prophet (ﷺ) as it appeared then. The Prophet (ﷺ) beckoned to Abu Bakr to lead the people in the prayer and then let the curtain fall. We did not see him (again) till he died
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi teen din bahar nahi aaye. Log namaz ke liye khade hue aur Abu Bakr aage imamat ke liye badhe. (Isi dauran) Nabi ne parda pakad kar uthaya. Jab Nabi ka chehra nazar aaya, humne kabhi Nabi ke us waqt ke chehre se zyada khushnuma manzar nahi dekha. Nabi ne Abu Bakr ko imamat karte rehne ka ishara kiya aur parda gira diya. Humne unhe (dobara) tab tak nahi dekha jab tak unka intiqal na ho gaya.

e: Narrated Hamza bin `Abdullah:My father said, "When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) became seriously ill, he was told about the prayer. He said, 'Tell Abu Bakr to lead the people in the prayer.' `Aisha said, 'Abu Bakr is a softhearted man and he would be overpowered by his weeping if he recited the Qur'an.' He said to them, 'Tell him (Abu Bakr) to lead the prayer. The same reply was given to him. He said again, 'Tell him to lead the prayer. You (women) are the companions of Joseph
hi: Hamza bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ), apne waalid ke hawale se: "Jab Allah ke Rasool sakht bimar hue, unhe namaz ke baare mein bataya gaya. Aap ne farmaya: 'Abu Bakr se kaho logon ki imamat karein.' Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha: 'Abu Bakr narm-dil hain, Quran padhte huye rone se ghalba khaa jayenge.' Aap ne unhe phir kaha: 'Usse kaho imamat kare.' Wahi jawab mila. Aap ne phir kaha: 'Usse kaho imamat kare. Tum (aurtein) Yusuf ki sathi ho.'"

e: Narrated Hisham ibn `Urwa's father:`Aisha said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered Abu Bakr to lead the people in the prayer during his illness and so he led them in prayer." `Urwa, a sub narrator, added, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) felt a bit relieved and came out and Abu Bakr was leading the people. When Abu Bakr saw the Prophet (ﷺ) he retreated but the Prophet beckoned him to remain there. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sat beside Abu Bakr. Abu Bakr was following the prayer of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and the people were following the prayer of Abu Bakr
hi: Hisham ibn Urwa, apne waalid ke hawale se: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool ne apni bimari mein Abu Bakr ko logon ki imamat karne ka hukum diya, to unhone imamat ki." Urwa ne joda: "Allah ke Rasool ko thodi rahat mehsoos hui aur woh bahar aaye jabke Abu Bakr imamat kar rahe the. Jab Abu Bakr ne Nabi ko dekha, peeche hatne lage magar Nabi ne unhe wahin rehne ka ishara kiya. Allah ke Rasool Abu Bakr ke bagal mein baith gaye. Abu Bakr Allah ke Rasool ki namaz follow kar rahe the, aur log Abu Bakr ki namaz follow kar rahe the."

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d As-Sa`idi:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went to establish peace among Bani `Amr bin `Auf. In the meantime the time of prayer was due and the Mu'adh-dhin went to Abu Bakr and said, "Will you lead the prayer, so that I may pronounce the Iqama?" Abu Bakr replied in the affirmative and led the prayer. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came while the people were still praying and he entered the rows of the praying people till he stood in the (first row). The people clapped their hands. Abu Bakr never glanced sideways in his prayer but when the people continued clapping, Abu Bakr looked and saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) beckoned him to stay at his place. Abu Bakr raised his hands and thanked Allah for that order of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and then he retreated till he reached the first row. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went forward and led the prayer. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) finished the prayer, he said, "O Abu Bakr! What prevented you from staying when I ordered you to do so?" Abu Bakr replied, "How can Ibn Abi Quhafa (Abu Bakr) dare to lead the prayer in the presence of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Why did you clap so much? If something happens to anyone during his prayer he should say Subhan Allah. If he says so he will be attended to, for clapping is for women
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) As-Sa'idi (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool Bani Amr bin Auf ke darmiyan sulah karwane gaye. Isi dauran namaz ka waqt aa gaya, Muazzin Abu Bakr ke paas gaya aur kaha: "Kya aap imamat karenge taake main Iqama dun?" Abu Bakr ne haan kaha aur imamat ki. Allah ke Rasool aaye jabke log abhi namaz padh rahe the, Aap safon mein daakhil hokar pehli saf mein khade ho gaye. Logon ne taaliyan bajayin. Abu Bakr apni namaz mein kabhi idhar-udhar nahi dekhte the, magar jab log taaliyan bajate rahe, Abu Bakr ne dekha aur Allah ke Rasool ko paaya. Allah ke Rasool ne unhe apni jagah rehne ka ishara kiya. Abu Bakr ne apne haath uthaye aur Allah ke Rasool ke is hukum par Allah ka shukr ada kiya, phir peeche hate yahan tak ke pehli saf mein pahunch gaye. Allah ke Rasool aage badhe aur imamat ki. Namaz khatam karke, Aap ne farmaya: "Aye Abu Bakr! Jab maine tumhe (apni jagah rehne ka) hukum diya to tumhe kisne rukne se roka?" Abu Bakr ne jawab diya: "Ibn Abi Quhafa (Abu Bakr) ki himmat kaise ho sakti hai ke Allah ke Rasool ki maujoodgi mein imamat kare?" Phir Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Tumne itni taaliyan kyun bajayin? Agar namaz mein kisi ko kuch kehna ho to 'Subhan Allah' kahe. Agar aisa kahega to uski taraf tawajjo di jayegi, taaliyan bajaana aurton ke liye hai."

e: Narrated Malik bin Huwairith:We went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and we were all young men and stayed with him for about twenty nights. The Prophet (ﷺ) was very merciful. He said, "When you return home, impart religious teachings to your families and tell them to offer perfectly such and such a prayer at such and such a time and such and such a prayer at such and such a time. And at the time of the prayer one of you should pronounce the Adhan and the oldest of you should lead the prayer
hi: Malik bin Huwairith (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Hum Nabi ke paas gaye, hum sab jawan the aur unke paas taqreeban bees raatein rahe. Nabi bahut reham dil the. Unhone farmaya: 'Jab ghar wapas jao, apne gharwalon ko deeni taleem do aur unhe batao ke falaan namaz falaan waqt par aur falaan namaz falaan waqt par mukammal padhein. Aur namaz ke waqt tum mein se koi Adhan de aur sabse bada imamat kare.'"

e: Narrated `Itban bin Malik Al-Ansari:The Prophet (came to my house and) asked permission for entering and I allowed him. He asked, "Where do you like me to pray in your house?" I pointed to a place which I liked. He stood up for prayer and we aligned behind him and he finished the prayer with Taslim and we did the same
hi: Itban bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ansari (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (mere ghar aakar) andar aane ki ijazat maangi, maine di. Aap ne pucha: "Aap kahan chahenge main aapke ghar mein namaz padhun?" Maine ek jagah ishara ki jo mujhe pasand thi. Aap khade hue namaz ke liye, hum unke peechhe qatar mein khade hue, aur Aap ne Taslim se namaz khatam ki, humne bhi waisa hi kiya.

e: Narrated 'Ubaidullah Ibn `Abdullah bin `Utba:I went to `Aisha and asked her to describe to me the illness of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). `Aisha said, "Yes. The Prophet became seriously ill and asked whether the people had prayed. We replied, 'No. O Allah's Apostle! They are waiting for you.' He added, 'Put water for me in a trough." `Aisha added, "We did so. He took a bath and tried to get up but fainted. When he recovered, he again asked whether the people had prayed. We said, 'No, they are waiting for you. O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ),' He again said, 'Put water in a trough for me.' He sat down and took a bath and tried to get up but fainted again. Then he recovered and said, 'Have the people prayed?' We replied, 'No, they are waiting for you. O Allah's Apostle.' He said, 'Put water for me in the trough.' Then he sat down and washed himself and tried to get up but he fainted. When he recovered, he asked, 'Have the people prayed?' We said, 'No, they are waiting for you. O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! The people were in the mosque waiting for the Prophet (ﷺ) for the `Isha prayer. The Prophet (ﷺ) sent for Abu Bakr to lead the people in the prayer. The messenger went to Abu Bakr and said, 'Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) orders you to lead the people in the prayer.' Abu Bakr was a softhearted man, so he asked `Umar to lead the prayer but `Umar replied, 'You are more rightful.' So Abu Bakr led the prayer in those days. When the Prophet (ﷺ) felt a bit better, he came out for the Zuhr prayer with the help of two persons one of whom was Al-`Abbas. while Abu Bakr was leading the people in the prayer. When Abu Bakr saw him he wanted to retreat but the Prophet (ﷺ) beckoned him not to do so and asked them to make him sit beside Abu Bakr and they did so. Abu Bakr was following the Prophet (in the prayer) and the people were following Abu Bakr. The Prophet (prayed) sitting." 'Ubaidullah added "I went to `Abdullah bin `Abbas and asked him, Shall I tell you what Aisha has told me about the fatal illness of the Prophet?' Ibn `Abbas said, 'Go ahead. I told him her narration and he did not deny anything of it but asked whether `Aisha told me the name of the second person (who helped the Prophet (ﷺ) ) along with Al-Abbas. I said. 'No.' He said, 'He was `Ali (Ibn Abi Talib)
hi: Ubaidullah Ibn Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Utba bataate hain: "Main Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas gaya aur unse Allah ke Rasool ki bimari ke baare mein pucha. Ayesha ne kaha: 'Haan. Nabi sakht bimar hue aur pucha kya logon ne namaz padh li. Humne kaha: Nahi, Ya Rasoolallah! Woh aapka intezar kar rahe hain. Aap ne farmaya: Mere liye tashtari mein paani rakho.' Ayesha ne kaha: 'Humne aisa kiya. Aap ne ghusl kiya aur uthne ki koshish ki magar behosh ho gaye. Jab hosh aaya, phir poocha kya logon ne namaz padh li. Humne kaha: Nahi, Ya Rasoolallah, woh aapka intezar kar rahe hain. Aap ne phir farmaya: Mere liye tashtari mein paani rakho. Aap baithe aur ghusl kiya aur phir uthne ki koshish ki magar phir behosh ho gaye. Hosh mein aakar phir poocha: Kya logon ne namaz padh li. Humne kaha: Nahi, woh aapka intezar kar rahe hain. Aap ne kaha: Mere liye tashtari mein paani rakho.' Log masjid mein Isha ke liye Nabi ka intezar kar rahe the. Nabi ne Abu Bakr ko logon ki imamat karne ke liye bulwaya. Qasid Abu Bakr ke paas gaya aur kaha: 'Allah ke Rasool aapko logon ki imamat karne ka hukum dete hain.' Abu Bakr narm-dil the, isliye unhone Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se imamat karne ko kaha, magar Umar ne kaha: 'Aap zyada haqdar hain.' To un dinon Abu Bakr ne imamat ki. Jab Nabi ko thodi rahat mehsoos hui, Aap Zuhr ke liye do logon ke sahaare bahar aaye, jinme se ek Abbas the, jabke Abu Bakr imamat kar rahe the. Jab Abu Bakr ne unhe dekha, peeche hatna chaha magar Nabi ne unhe rehne ka ishara kiya aur unhe Abu Bakr ke bagal mein bithaya gaya, aisa hi kiya gaya. Abu Bakr Nabi ki namaz follow kar rahe the aur log Abu Bakr ki. Nabi (baithkar) namaz padh rahe the.'" Ubaidullah ne joda: "Main Abdullah bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas gaya aur pucha: 'Kya main aapko bataun jo Ayesha ne mujhe Nabi ki aakhri bimari ke baare mein bataya?' Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: 'Bataiye.' Maine unhe unki riwayat batai, unhone kisi baat ka inkaar nahi kiya, magar pucha kya Ayesha ne dusre shaks ka naam bataya jo Abbas ke saath the. Maine kaha: 'Nahi.' Unhone kaha: 'Woh Ali (Alayhis Salam) (Ibn Abi Talib) the.'"

e: Narrated Aisha:the mother of the believers: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) during his illness prayed at his house while sitting whereas some people prayed behind him standing. The Prophet (ﷺ) beckoned them to sit down. On completion of the prayer, he said, 'The Imam is to be followed: bow when he bows, raise up your heads (stand erect) when he raises his head and when he says, 'Sami`a l-lahu liman hamidah' (Allah heard those who sent praises to Him) say then 'Rabbana wa laka l-hamd' (O our Lord! All the praises are for You), and if he prays sitting then pray sitting
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne apni bimari mein ghar par baithkar namaz padhi jabke kuch log unke peechhe khade hokar padh rahe the. Nabi ne unhe baithne ka ishara kiya. Namaz khatam karke farmaya: "Imam ki pairvi ki jaati hai — jab woh ruku kare, tum bhi karo; jab sar utha kar khade ho, tum bhi khade ho; aur jab woh 'Sami' Allahu liman hamidah' kahe, tum 'Rabbana wa lakal-hamd' kaho; aur agar woh baithkar padhe, to tum sab bhi baithkar padho."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) rode a horse and fell down and the right side (of his body) was injured. He offered one of the prayers while sitting and we also prayed behind him sitting. When he completed the prayer, he said, "The Imam is to be followed. Pray standing if he prays standing and bow when he bows; rise when he rises; and if he says, 'Sami`a l-lahu-liman hamidah, say then, 'Rabbana wa laka lhamd' and pray standing if he prays standing and pray sitting (all of you) if he prays sitting." Humaid said: The saying of the Prophet (ﷺ) "Pray sitting, if he (Imam) prays sitting" was said in his former illness (during his early life) but the Prophet (ﷺ) prayed sitting afterwards (in the last illness) and the people were praying standing behind him and the Prophet (ﷺ) did not order them to sit. We should follow the latest actions of the Prophet
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke ek baar Allah ke Rasool ghode se gire aur unki dahini taraf zakhmi ho gayi. Aap ne ek namaz baithkar padhi, hum bhi unke peechhe baithkar padhe. Namaz khatam karke, Aap ne farmaya: "Imam ki pairvi ki jaati hai. Agar woh khade hokar padhe, tum bhi khade hokar padho, aur jab woh ruku kare, tum bhi karo; jab woh sar utha kar khade ho, tum bhi ho; aur jab woh 'Sami' Allahu liman hamidah' kahe, tum 'Rabbana wa lakal-hamd' kaho; aur agar woh khade hokar padhe, khade padho, aur agar baithkar padhe, (sab) baithkar padho." Humaid ne kaha: Nabi ka yeh farmaan "agar Imam baithkar padhe to tum bhi baithkar padho" unki pehli bimari (zindagi ke shuru mein) ke waqt kaha gaya tha, magar baad mein (aakhri bimari mein) Nabi baithkar padhte aur log unke peechhe khade padhte, Nabi ne unhe baithne ka hukum nahi diya. Humein Nabi ke aakhri amal ki pairvi karni chahiye.

e: Narrated Al-Bara:(and he was not a liar) When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Sami`a l-lahu liman hamidah" none of us bent his back (for prostration) till the Prophet (ﷺ) prostrated and then we would prostrate after him
hi: Al-Bara (رضی اللہ عنہ), jo jhoot nahi bolte the, bataate hain: "Jab Allah ke Rasool 'Sami' Allahu liman hamidah' kehte, hum mein se koi apni kamar tab tak nahi jhukata jab tak Nabi sajda na kar lete, phir hum unke baad sajda karte."

e: Narrated Abu 'Is-haq:As above
hi: Abu Ishaq se yehi riwayat hai (jaisa upar).

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Isn't he who raises his head before the Imam afraid that Allah may transform his head into that of a donkey or his figure (face) into that of a donkey?
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Kya jo Imam se pehle sar uthaata hai, use dar nahi ke Allah uska sar gadhe ke sar mein ya uski shakl gadhe ki shakl mein badal de?"

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:When the earliest emigrants came to Al-`Usba [??] a place in Quba', before the arrival of the Prophet- Salim, the slave of Abu Hudhaifa, who knew the Qur'an more than the others used to lead them in prayer
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke jab sabse pehle Muhajireen Al-Usba (Quba ki ek jagah) mein aaye, Nabi ke aane se pehle, Salim (Abu Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke azaad kiye gulaam), jo doosron se zyada Quran jaante the, unki imamat karte the.

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Listen and obey (your chief) even if an Ethiopian whose head is like a raisin were made your chief
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Suno aur (apne ameer ki) itaa'at karo, chahe tumhara ameer ek Habshi (kaale) ko banaya jaye jiska sar kishmish jaisa ho."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If the Imam leads the prayer correctly then he and you will receive the rewards but if he makes a mistake (in the prayer) then you will receive the reward for the prayer and the sin will be his
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Agar Imam sahih imamat kare, use aur tumhe sawaab milega, magar agar woh (namaz mein) galti kare, tumhe namaz ka sawaab milega aur gunah usi ka hoga."

e: Narrated 'Ubaid-Ullah bin Adi bin Khiyar:I went to 'Uthman bin Affan while he was besieged, and said to him, "You are the chief of all Muslims in general and you see what has befallen you. We are led in the Salat (prayer) by a leader of Al-Fitan (trials and afflictions etc.) and we are afraid of being sinful in following him." 'Uthman said. "As-Salat (the prayers) is the best of all deeds so when the people do good deeds do the same with them and when they do bad deeds, avoid those bad deeds." Az-Zuhri said, "In our opinion one should not offer Salat behind an effeminate person unless there is no alternative
hi: Ubaidullah bin Adi bin Khiyar bataate hain: "Main Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Affan ke paas gaya jabke woh ghire hue the, maine kaha: 'Aap sab Musalmanon ke sardar hain, aur dekhiye aap par kya guzri hai. Humari imamat ek fitno ke Imam kar rahe hain aur humein uski pairvi karne mein gunahgaar hone ka dar hai.' Uthman ne kaha: 'Namaz sabse behtareen amal hai, isliye jab log achhe kaam karein, unke saath karo, aur jab woh bure kaam karein, un bure kaamon se bacho.'" Az-Zuhri ne kaha: "Humari raay mein, agar koi doosra raasta na ho to hi kisi zanana-mizaaj (be-akhlaq) shaks ke peechhe namaz padhni chahiye."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said to Abu-Dhar, "Listen and obey (your chief) even if he is an Ethiopian with a head like a raisin
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne Abu Dharr (رضی اللہ عنہ) se farmaya: "Suno aur (apne ameer ki) itaa'at karo, chahe woh ek Habshi ho jiska sar kishmish jaisa ho."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Once I passed the night in the house of my aunt Maimuna. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) offered the `Isha' prayer and then came to the house and offered four rak`at and slept. Later on, he woke up and stood for the prayer and I stood on his left side. He drew me to his right and prayed five rak`at and then two. He then slept till I heard him snoring (or heard his breath sounds). Afterwards he went out for the morning prayer
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: "Ek raat maine apni khala Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke ghar guzari. Allah ke Rasool ne Isha padhi, phir ghar aakar chaar rakat padhi aur so gaye. Baad mein uthe aur namaz ke liye khade hue, main unki baayi taraf khada hua. Aap ne mujhe apni dahini taraf khinch liya aur paanch rakat padhi, phir do. Phir so gaye yahan tak ke maine unki khurraati suni. Iske baad Aap Fajr ke liye nikal gaye."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:One night I slept at the house of (my aunt) Maimuna and the Prophet (ﷺ) was there on that night. He performed ablution and stood up for the prayer. I joined him and stood on his left side but he drew me to his right and prayed thirteen rak`at and then slept till I heard his breath sounds. And whenever he slept, he used to breathe with audible sounds. The Mu'adh-dhin came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he went out and prayed the morning prayer) without repeating the ablution
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: "Ek raat main Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke ghar soya aur Nabi bhi us raat wahan the. Aap ne wudu kiya aur namaz ke liye khade hue. Main unke saath shamil hua aur unki baayi taraf khada hua magar Aap ne mujhe apni dahini taraf khinch liya aur terah rakat padhi, phir so gaye yahan tak ke main unki khurraati sunta raha. (Jab bhi Aap sote, awaaz ke saath saans lete the.) Muazzin Nabi ke paas aaye aur Aap bahar aaye aur (subah ki) namaz padhi bina wudu dohraye."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Once I passed the night in the house of my aunt Maimuna. The Prophet (ﷺ) stood for the night prayer and I joined him and stood on his left side but he drew me to his right by holding me by the head
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: "Ek raat maine apni khala Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke ghar guzari. Nabi raat ki namaz ke liye khade hue, main unke saath shamil hua aur unki baayi taraf khada hua magar Aap ne mera sar pakad kar mujhe apni dahini taraf khinch liya."

e: Narrated Mu`adh bin Jabal:I used to pray the `Isha prayer with the Prophet (ﷺ) and then go to lead my people in the prayer
hi: Mu'adh bin Jabal (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Main Nabi ke saath Isha padhta aur phir apni qaum ki imamat karne jaata."

e: Narrated `Amr:Jabir bin `Abdullah said, "Mu`adh bin Jabal used to pray with the Prophet (ﷺ) and then go to lead his people in prayer Once he led the `Isha' prayer and recited Surat "Al-Baqara." Somebody left the prayer and Mu`adh criticized him. The news reached the Prophet (ﷺ) and he said to Mu`adh, 'You are putting the people to trial,' and repeated it thrice (or said something similar) and ordered him to recite two medium Suras of Mufassal." (`Amr said that he had forgotten the names of those Suras)
hi: Amr bataate hain ke Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Mu'adh bin Jabal (رضی اللہ عنہ) Nabi ke saath namaz padhte aur phir apni qaum ki imamat karne jaate. Ek baar unhone Isha ki imamat ki aur Surah Al-Baqarah tilawat ki. Kisi ne namaz chhod di, Mu'adh ne uski buraai ki. Yeh baat Nabi tak pahunchi, unhone Mu'adh se farmaya: 'Tum logon ko fitne mein daal rahe ho,' aur teen baar (ya isi jaisi baat) dohrayi, aur unhe Mufassal ki do darmiyani Surahtein padhne ka hukum diya." (Amr ne kaha unhe un Surahton ke naam yaad nahi rahe.)

e: Narrated Abu Mas`ud:A man came and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! By Allah, I keep away from the morning prayer only because So and so prolongs the prayer when he leads us in it." The narrator said, "I never saw Allah's Apostle more furious in giving advice than he was at that time. He then said, "Some of you make people dislike good deeds (the prayer). So whoever among you leads the people in prayer should shorten it because among them are the weak, the old and the needy
hi: Abu Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke ek shaks aaya aur kaha: "Ya Rasoolallah! Allah ki qasam, main Fajr ki jamaat se sirf isliye door rehta hoon kyunke falaan shaks namaz lambi kar deta hai jab woh humari imamat karta hai." Rawi ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool ko us din se zyada gussa naseehat karte kabhi nahi dekha." Aap ne farmaya: "Tum mein se kuch log doosron ko nekiyon (namaz) se bezaar kar dete hain. Isliye jo bhi imamat kare, use namaz halki karni chahiye kyunke unme kamzor, budhe aur zaroorat-mand log hote hain."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If anyone of you leads the people in the prayer, he should shorten it for amongst them are the weak, the sick and the old; and if anyone among you prays alone then he may prolong (the prayer) as much as he wishes
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Agar tum mein se koi logon ki imamat kare, namaz halki kare kyunke unme kamzor, bimar aur budhe log hote hain; aur agar koi akela namaz padhe, to jitni lambi chahe padh sakta hai."

e: Narrated Abu Mas`ud:A man came and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I keep away from the morning prayer because so-and-so (Imam) prolongs it too much." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) became furious and I had never seen him more furious than he was on that day. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O people! Some of you make others dislike the prayer, so whoever becomes an Imam he should shorten the prayer, as behind him are the weak, the old and the needy
hi: Abu Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke ek shaks aaya aur kaha: "Ya Rasoolallah! Main Fajr ki jamaat se door rehta hoon kyunke falaan (Imam) usse bahut lamba kar deta hai." Allah ke Rasool gusse ho gaye, maine unhe us din se zyada gussa mein kabhi nahi dekha. Nabi ne farmaya: "Aye logon! Tum mein se kuch log doosron ko namaz se bezaar kar dete hain, isliye jo bhi Imam bane, namaz halki kare, kyunke uske peechhe kamzor, budhe aur zaroorat-mand log hote hain."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah Al-Ansari:Once a man was driving two Nadihas (camels used for agricultural purposes) and night had fallen. He found Mu`adh praying so he made his camel kneel and joined Mu`adh in the prayer. The latter recited Surat 'Al-Baqara" or Surat "An-Nisa", (so) the man left the prayer and went away. When he came to know that Mu`adh had criticized him, he went to the Prophet, and complained against Mu`adh. The Prophet said thrice, "O Mu`adh ! Are you putting the people to trial?" It would have been better if you had recited "Sabbih Isma Rabbika-l-A`la (87)", Wash-shamsi wa duhaha (91)", or "Wal-laili idha yaghsha (92)", for the old, the weak and the needy pray behind you." Jabir said that Mu`adh recited Sura Al-Baqara in the `Isha' prayer
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ansari (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Ek shaks do khetiwaari ke oont chala raha tha aur raat ho chuki thi. Usne Mu'adh ko namaz padhte paaya, usne apna oont bithaya aur Mu'adh ke saath namaz mein shamil ho gaya. Mu'adh ne Surah Al-Baqarah ya An-Nisa tilawat ki, (isliye) shaks namaz chhod kar chala gaya. Jab use pata chala ke Mu'adh ne uski buraai ki, woh Nabi ke paas gaya aur Mu'adh ki shikayat ki. Nabi ne teen baar farmaya: 'Aye Mu'adh! Kya tum logon ko fitne mein daal rahe ho? Behtar hota agar tum "Sabbihisma Rabbika-l-A'la" (87), "Wash-shamsi wa duhaha" (91), ya "Wal-laili idha yaghsha" (92) padhte, kyunke tumhare peechhe budhe, kamzor aur zaroorat-mand log namaz padhte hain.'" Jabir ne kaha ke Mu'adh ne Isha mein Surah Al-Baqarah padhi thi.

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to pray a short prayer (in congregation) but used to offer it in a perfect manner
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (jamaat mein) chhoti magar mukammal namaz padhte the.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin 'Abi Qatada:My father said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'When I stand for prayer, I intend to prolong it but on hearing the cries of a child, I cut it short, as I dislike to trouble the child's mother
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Qatada, apne waalid ke hawale se: "Nabi ne farmaya: 'Jab main namaz ke liye khada hota hoon, use lamba karna chahta hoon, magar kisi bacche ke rone ki awaaz sunkar main namaz chhoti kar deta hoon, kyunke mujhe uski maa ko taklif dena napasand hai.'"

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:I never prayed behind any Imam a prayer lighter and more perfect than that behind the Prophet (ﷺ) and he used to cut short the prayer whenever he heard the cries of a child lest he should put the child's mother to trial
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai: "Maine kabhi kisi Imam ke peechhe Nabi ki namaz se zyada halki aur mukammal namaz nahi padhi. Aap kisi bacche ke rone ki awaaz sunkar namaz chhoti kar dete, taake uski maa ko museebat mein na daalein."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When I start the prayer I intend to prolong it, but on hearing the cries of a child, I cut short the prayer because I know that the cries of the child will incite its mother's passions
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Jab main namaz shuru karta hoon, use lamba karna chahta hoon, magar bacche ke rone ki awaaz sunkar namaz chhoti kar deta hoon, kyunke mujhe pata hai bacche ka rona uski maa ko bechain kar dega."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet, said, "Whenever I start the prayer I intend to prolong it, but on hearing the cries of a child, I cut short the prayer because I know that the cries of the child will incite its mother's passions
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Jab bhi main namaz shuru karta hoon, use lamba karna chahta hoon, magar bacche ke rone ki awaaz sunkar namaz chhoti kar deta hoon, kyunke mujhe pata hai bacche ka rona uski maa ko bechain kar dega."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:Mu`adh used to pray with the Prophet (ﷺ) and then go and lead his people (tribe) in the prayer
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Mu'adh Nabi ke saath namaz padhte aur phir apni qaum ki imamat karne jaate.

e: Narrated `Aisha:When the Prophet, became ill in his fatal illness, Someone came to inform him about the prayer, and the Prophet (ﷺ) told him to tell Abu Bakr to lead the people in the prayer. I said, "Abu Bakr is a softhearted man and if he stands for the prayer in your place, he would weep and would not be able to recite the Qur'an." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Tell Abu Bakr to lead the prayer." I said the same as before. He (repeated the same order and) on the third or the fourth time he said, "You are the companions of Joseph. Tell Abu Bakr to lead the prayer." So Abu Bakr led the prayer and meanwhile the Prophet (ﷺ) felt better and came out with the help of two men; as if I see him just now dragging his feet on the ground. When Abu Bakr saw him, he tried to retreat but the Prophet (ﷺ) beckoned him to carry on. Abu Bakr retreated a bit and the Prophet (ﷺ) sat on his (left) side. Abu Bakr was repeating the Takbir (Allahu Akbar) of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for the people to hear
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai: "Jab Nabi apni aakhri bimari mein bimar hue, kisi ne unhe namaz ke baare mein bataya, Nabi ne kaha Abu Bakr se logon ki imamat karne ko kaho. Maine kaha: 'Abu Bakr narm-dil hain, agar aapki jagah khade honge, ro denge aur Quran nahi padh sakenge.' Nabi ne (phir) farmaya: 'Abu Bakr se kaho imamat karein.' Maine wahi baat dohrayi. Teesri ya chauthi baar Aap ne farmaya: 'Tum Yusuf ki sathi ho. Abu Bakr se kaho imamat karein.' To Abu Bakr ne imamat ki. Isi dauran Nabi ko rahat mehsoos hui aur woh do aadmiyon ke sahaare bahar aaye; goya main abhi unhe paon ghisatte dekh rahi hoon. Jab Abu Bakr ne unhe dekha, peeche hatna chaha magar Nabi ne unhe jaari rakhne ka ishara kiya. Abu Bakr thoda peeche hate aur Nabi unke (baayen) taraf baith gaye. Abu Bakr Allah ke Rasool ki Takbir logon tak (buland awaaz mein) pahunchate."

e: Narrated `Aisha:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) became seriously ill, Bilal came to him for the prayer. He said, "Tell Abu Bakr to lead the people in the prayer." I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Abu Bakr is a softhearted man and if he stands in your place, he would not be able to make the people hear him. Will you order `Umar (to lead the prayer)?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Tell Abu Bakr to lead the people in the prayer." Then I said to Hafsa, "Tell him, Abu Bakr is a softhearted man and if he stands in his place, he would not be able to make the people hear him. Would you order `Umar to lead the prayer?' " Hafsa did so. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Verily you are the companions of Joseph. Tell Abu Bakr to lead the people in the prayer." So Abu Bakr stood for the prayer. In the meantime Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) felt better and came out with the help of two persons and both of his legs were dragging on the ground till he entered the mosque. When Abu Bakr heard him coming, he tried to retreat but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) beckoned him to carry on. The Prophet (ﷺ) sat on his left side. Abu Bakr was praying while standing and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was leading the prayer while sitting. Abu Bakr was following the Prophet (ﷺ) and the people were following Abu Bakr (in the prayer)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai: "Jab Allah ke Rasool sakht bimar hue, Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) namaz ke liye aaye. Nabi ne farmaya: 'Abu Bakr se kaho imamat karein.' Maine kaha: 'Ya Rasoolallah! Abu Bakr narm-dil hain, agar aapki jagah khade honge, logon ko sunaa nahi payenge. Kya aap Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko hukum denge?' Nabi ne farmaya: 'Abu Bakr se kaho imamat karein.' Phir maine Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) se kaha: 'Unse kaho, Abu Bakr narm-dil hain, agar unki jagah khade honge, logon ko sunaa nahi payenge. Kya aap Umar ko hukum denge?' Hafsa ne aisa hi kiya. Nabi ne farmaya: 'Tum sach mein Yusuf ki sathi ho. Abu Bakr se kaho imamat karein.' To Abu Bakr namaz ke liye khade hue. Isi dauran Allah ke Rasool ko rahat mehsoos hui aur woh do logon ke sahaare bahar aaye, unke donon paon zameen par ghisat rahe the yahan tak ke woh masjid mein daakhil hue. Jab Abu Bakr ne unhe aate suna, peeche hatna chaha magar Allah ke Rasool ne unhe jaari rakhne ka ishara kiya. Nabi unke (baayen) taraf baith gaye. Abu Bakr khade hokar namaz padh rahe the aur Allah ke Rasool baithkar imamat kar rahe the. Abu Bakr Nabi ki pairvi kar rahe the, aur log Abu Bakr ki pairvi kar rahe the."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prayed two rak`at (instead of four) and finished his prayer. Dhul-Yadain asked him whether the prayer had been reduced or whether he had forgotten. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked the people whether Dhul-Yadain was telling the truth. The people replied in the affirmative. Then Allah's Apostle stood up, offered the remaining two rak`at and then finished his prayer with Taslim and then said, "Allahu Akbar." He followed it with two prostrations like ordinary prostrations or a bit longer
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke ek baar Allah ke Rasool ne do rakat (chaar ke bajaye) padh kar namaz khatam kar di. Dhul-Yadain ne pucha kya namaz kam hui ya Nabi bhool gaye. Allah ke Rasool ne logon se pucha kya Dhul-Yadain sach keh rahe hain. Logon ne haan kaha. Phir Allah ke Rasool khade hue, baaki do rakat padhi, phir Taslim se namaz khatam ki, phir "Allahu Akbar" kaha aur usi jaisa ya kuch lamba do sajda kiya.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) prayed two rak`at of Zuhr prayer (instead of four) and he was told that he had prayed two rak`at only. Then he prayed two more rak`at and finished them with the Taslim followed by two prostrations
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne Zuhr mein do rakat (chaar ke bajaye) padhi, unhe bataya gaya ke Aap ne sirf do rakat padhi hain. Phir Aap ne do aur rakat padhi aur Taslim se khatam karke do sajde kiye.

e: Narrated `Aisha:the mother of the faithful believers: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in his last illness said, "Tell Abu Bakr to lead the people in the prayer." I said, "If Abu Bakr stood in your place, he would not be able to make the people hear him owing to his weeping. So please order `Umar to lead the prayer." He said, "Tell Abu Bakr to lead the people in the prayer." I said to Hafsa, "Say to him, 'Abu Bakr is a softhearted man and if he stood in your place he would not be able to make the people hear him owing to his weeping. So order `Umar to lead the people in the prayer.' " Hafsa did so but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Keep quiet. Verily you are the companions of (Prophet) Joseph. Tell Abu Bakr to lead the people in the prayer." Hafsa said to me, "I never got any good from you
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai: "Allah ke Rasool ne apni aakhri bimari mein farmaya: 'Abu Bakr se kaho imamat karein.' Maine kaha: 'Agar Abu Bakr aapki jagah khade honge, ro denge aur logon ko sunaa nahi payenge, Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko hukum dijiye.' Aap ne farmaya: 'Abu Bakr se kaho imamat karein.' Maine Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) se kaha: 'Unse kaho, Abu Bakr narm-dil hain, agar unki jagah khade honge, sunaa nahi payenge, Umar ko hukum dein.' Hafsa ne aisa hi kiya, magar Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: 'Khamosh raho! Tum Yusuf (Nabi) ki sathi ho. Abu Bakr se kaho imamat karein.'" Hafsa ne mujhse kaha: "Mujhe tumse kabhi kuch achha nahi mila."

e: Narrated An-Nu`man bin 'Bashir:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Straighten your rows or Allah will alter your faces
hi: An-Nu'man bin Bashir (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Apni safein seedhi karo, warna Allah tumhare chehre badal dega (ya dilon mein ikhtilaaf daal dega)."

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Straighten your rows, for I see you from behind my back
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Apni safein seedhi karo, kyunke main tumhe apni pusht se bhi dekhta hoon."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Once the Iqama was pronounced and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) faced us and said, "Straighten your rows and stand closer together, for I see you from behind my back
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke ek baar Iqama ho chuki thi, Allah ke Rasool humari taraf mud kar farmaya: "Safein seedhi karo aur paas-paas khade ho, kyunke main tumhe apni pusht se bhi dekhta hoon."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Martyrs are those who die because of drowning, plague, an Abdominal disease, or of being buried alive by a falling building." And then he added, "If the people knew the Reward for the Zuhr prayer in its early time, they would race for it. If they knew the reward for the `Isha' and the Fajr prayers in congregation, they would join them even if they had to crawl. If they knew the reward for the first row, they would draw lots for it
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Shaheed woh hain jo doobne se, taun se, pait ki bimari se, ya imaarat ke neeche dab kar mare." Phir joda: "Agar logon ko Zuhr jaldi padhne ka sawaab pata hota, woh iske liye daud lagate. Agar unhe Isha aur Fajr jamaat ka sawaab pata hota, woh reng kar bhi aate. Aur agar unhe pehli saf ka sawaab pata hota, woh iske liye qura-andaazi karte."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The Imam is (appointed) to be followed. So do not differ from him, bow when he bows, and say, "Rabbana-lakal hamd" if he says "Sami`a l-lahu liman hamidah"; and if he prostrates, prostrate (after him), and if he prays sitting, pray sitting all together, and straighten the rows for the prayer, as the straightening of the rows is amongst those things which make your prayer a correct and perfect one. (See Hadith No)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Imam ki pairvi ki jaati hai, isliye uske khilaaf mat karo. Jab woh ruku kare, tum bhi karo, aur jab woh 'Sami' Allahu liman hamidah' kahe, tum 'Rabbana lakal-hamd' kaho; jab sajda kare, tum bhi karo; aur agar woh baithkar padhe, sab baithkar padho; aur safein seedhi karo, kyunke safon ka seedha hona namaz ki sehat-o-kamal mein shamil hai."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Straighten your rows as the straightening of rows is essential for a perfect and correct prayer
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Safein seedhi karo, kyunke safon ka seedha hona mukammal aur sahih namaz ka hissa hai."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:I arrived at Medina and was asked whether I found any change since the days of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). I said, "I have not found any change except that you do not stand in alignment in your prayers
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai: "Main Madina pahuncha aur mujhse pucha gaya kya Allah ke Rasool ke zamane se koi tabdeeli maine dekhi. Maine kaha: 'Mujhe koi tabdeeli nazar nahi aayi siwaye is ke ke tum log namaz mein safon mein seedhe khade nahi hote.'"

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Straighten your rows for I see you from behind my back." Anas added, "Everyone of us used to put his shoulder with the shoulder of his companion and his foot with the foot of his companion
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Safein seedhi karo, kyunke main tumhe apni pusht se bhi dekhta hoon." Anas ne joda: "Hum mein se har ek apna shoulder apne sathi ke shoulder se aur apna paon apne sathi ke paon se milata tha."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I prayed with the Prophet (ﷺ) one night and stood on his left side. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) caught hold of my head from behind and drew me to his right and then offered the prayer and slept. Later the Mu'adh-dhin came and the Prophet (ﷺ) stood up for prayer without performing ablution
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: "Main ek raat Nabi ke saath namaz padhi, unki baayi taraf khada hua. Allah ke Rasool ne mera sar peechhe se pakad kar mujhe apni dahini taraf khinch liya, phir namaz padhi aur so gaye. Baad mein Muazzin aaye aur Nabi bina wudu dohraye namaz ke liye khade hue."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:One night an orphan and I offered the prayers behind the Prophet (ﷺ) in my house and my mother (Um Sulaim) was standing behind us (by herself forming a row)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke ek raat main aur ek yateem, Nabi ke peechhe mere ghar mein namaz padhi, aur meri maa (Um Sulaim) humare peechhe (akele ek saf banakar) khadi thi.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:One night I stood to the left of the Prophet (ﷺ) in the prayer but he caught hold of me by the hand or by the shoulder (arm) till he made me stand on his right and beckoned with his hand (for me) to go from behind (him). (Al-Kashmaihani [??] , Fath-ul-Bari
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: "Ek raat main namaz mein Nabi ki baayi taraf khada hua, magar Aap ne mera haath ya shoulder pakad kar mujhe apni dahini taraf khada kiya aur haath se ishara kiya (mujhe unke) peechhe se jaane ko."

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to pray in his room at night. As the wall of the room was low, the people saw him and some of them stood up to follow him in the prayer. In the morning they spread the news. The following night the Prophet (ﷺ) stood for the prayer and the people followed him. This went on for two or three nights. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not stand for the prayer the following night, and did not come out. In the morning, the people asked him about it. He replied, that he way afraid that the night prayer might become compulsory
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool raat ko apne kamre mein namaz padhte the. Kamre ki deewar neechi thi, isliye log unhe dekh lete aur kuch unke saath namaz mein shamil ho jaate. Subah unhone yeh baat phaila di. Agli raat Nabi phir khade hue namaz ke liye aur log unke saath shamil hue. Yeh silsila do-teen raatein chala. Iske baad Allah ke Rasool agli raat namaz ke liye khade nahi hue aur bahar nahi aaye. Subah logon ne iske baare mein pucha. Aap ne jawab diya ke unhe dar tha ke raat ki namaz farz na ho jaaye.

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) had a mat which he used to spread during the day and use as a curtain at night. So a number of people gathered at night facing it and prayed behind him
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ke paas ek chatai thi jo woh din mein bichhate aur raat ko parde ki tarah istemal karte. Ek raat kuch log jama ho gaye aur usi ki taraf mun karke unke peechhe namaz padhi.

e: Narrated Zaid bin Thabit:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) made a small room in the month of Ramadan (Sa`id said, "I think that Zaid bin Thabit said that it was made of a mat") and he prayed there for a few nights, and so some of his companions prayed behind him. When he came to know about it, he kept on sitting. In the morning, he went out to them and said, "I have seen and understood what you did. You should pray in your houses, for the best prayer of a person is that which he prays in his house except the compulsory prayers
hi: Zaid bin Thabit (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne Ramadan ke mahine mein ek chhota kamra banaya (Sa'id ka khayal hai Zaid bin Thabit ne kaha yeh chatai se bana tha), aur wahan kuch raaton tak namaz padhi, isliye unke kuch sahaba unke peechhe namaz padhne lage. Jab Nabi ko iska pata chala, woh baithe rahe. Subah unke paas gaye aur farmaya: "Maine dekha aur samjha jo tumne kiya. Apne gharon mein namaz padho, kyunke insaan ki behtareen namaz woh hai jo woh apne ghar mein padhe, siwaye farz namaz ke."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik Al-Ansari:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) rode a horse and fell down and the right side of his body was injured. On that day he prayed one of the prayers sitting and we also prayed behind him sitting. When the Prophet (ﷺ) finished the prayer with Taslim, he said, "The Imam is to be followed and if he prays standing then pray standing, and bow when he bows, and raise your heads when he raises his head; prostrate when he prostrates; and if he says "Sami`a l-lahu liman hamidah", you should say, "Rabbana wa laka l-hamd.:
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ansari (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ghode par sawar hue aur gir gaye, unki dahini taraf zakhmi ho gayi. Us din unhone ek namaz baithkar padhi, hum bhi unke peechhe baithkar padhe. Taslim se namaz khatam karke, Aap ne farmaya: "Imam ki pairvi ki jaati hai, agar woh khade hokar padhe, tum bhi khade hokar padho, aur jab woh ruku kare, tum bhi karo; jab woh sar utha kar khade ho, tum bhi ho; aur jab woh 'Sami' Allahu liman hamidah' kahe, tum 'Rabbana wa lakal-hamd' kaho."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) fell from a horse and got injured so he led the prayer sitting and we also prayed sitting. When he completed the prayer he said, "The Imam is to be followed; if he says Takbir then say Takbir, bow if he bows; raise your heads when he raises his head, when he says, 'Sami`a l-lahu liman hamidah say, 'Rabbana laka l-hamd', and prostrate when he prostrates
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ghode se gire aur zakhmi hue, isliye unhone baithkar imamat ki, hum bhi baithkar padhe. Namaz mukammal karke, Aap ne farmaya: "Imam ki pairvi ki jaati hai; jab woh Takbir kahe, tum bhi kaho; jab woh ruku kare, tum bhi karo; jab sar utha kar khade ho, tum bhi ho; jab woh 'Sami' Allahu liman hamidah' kahe, tum 'Rabbana lakal-hamd' kaho; aur jab woh sajda kare, tum bhi karo."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The Imam is to be followed. Say the Takbir when he says it; bow if he bows; if he says 'Sami`a l-lahu liman hamidah', say, ' Rabbana wa laka l-hamd', prostrate if he prostrates and pray sitting altogether if he prays sitting
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Imam ki pairvi ki jaati hai. Jab woh Takbir kahe, tum bhi kaho; jab woh ruku kare, tum bhi karo; jab woh 'Sami' Allahu liman hamidah' kahe, tum 'Rabbana wa lakal-hamd' kaho; jab sajda kare, tum bhi karo; aur agar woh baithkar padhe, sab baithkar padho."

e: Narrated Salim bin `Abdullah:My father said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to raise both his hands up to the level of his shoulders when opening the prayer; and on saying the Takbir for bowing. And on raising his head from bowing he used to do the same and then say "Sami`a l-lahu liman hamidah, Rabbana wa laka l-hamd." And he did not do that (i.e. raising his hands) in prostrations
hi: Salim bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain, apne waalid ke hawale se: "Allah ke Rasool namaz shuru karte waqt apne donon haath shoulders tak uthate; aur ruku ki Takbir kehte waqt bhi. Ruku se sar utha te waqt bhi yehi karte aur kehte 'Sami' Allahu liman hamidah, Rabbana wa lakal-hamd.' Sajde mein yeh (haath uthana) nahi karte the."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:I saw that whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood for the prayer, he used to raise both his hands up to the shoulders, and used to do the same on saying the Takbir for bowing and on raising his head from it and used to say, "Sami`a l-lahu liman hamidah". But he did not do that (i.e. raising his hands) in prostrations
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai: "Maine dekha ke jab bhi Allah ke Rasool namaz ke liye khade hote, apne donon haath shoulders tak uthate, aur ruku ki Takbir kehte waqt bhi yehi karte, aur ruku se sar uthate waqt bhi, aur kehte 'Sami' Allahu liman hamidah.' Magar sajde mein yeh (haath uthana) nahi karte the."

e: Narrated Abu Qilaba:I saw Malik bin Huwairith saying Takbir and raising both his hands (on starting the prayers and raising his hands on bowing and also on raising his head after bowing. Malik bin Huwairith said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did the same
hi: Abu Qilaba bataate hain: "Maine Malik bin Huwairith (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko Takbir kehte aur donon haath uthaate dekha (namaz shuru karte waqt, aur ruku karte waqt, aur ruku se sar uthate waqt bhi)." Malik bin Huwairith ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool bhi yehi karte the."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) opening the prayer with the Takbir and raising his hands to the level of his shoulders at the time of saying the Takbir, and on saying the Takbir for bowing he did the same; and when he said, "Sami`a l-lahu liman hamidah ", he did the same and then said, "Rabbana wa laka lhamd." But he did not do the same on prostrating and on lifting the head from it
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai: "Maine Allah ke Rasool ko namaz Takbir se shuru karte aur Takbir ke waqt apne haath shoulders tak uthaate dekha, aur ruku ki Takbir mein bhi yehi karte; aur jab 'Sami' Allahu liman hamidah' kehte, yehi karte aur phir 'Rabbana wa lakal-hamd' kahte. Magar sajde mein aur sajde se uthte waqt yeh (haath uthana) nahi karte the."

e: Narrated Nafi`:Whenever Ibn `Umar started the prayer with Takbir, he used to raise his hands: whenever he bowed, he used to raise his hands (before bowing) and also used to raise his hands on saying, "Sami`a l-lahu liman hamidah", and he used to do the same on rising from the second rak`a (for the 3rd rak`a). Ibn `Umar said: "The Prophet (ﷺ) used to do the same
hi: Nafi bataate hain: "Jab bhi Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) namaz Takbir se shuru karte, apne haath uthate; jab ruku karte, haath uthate (ruku se pehle); aur 'Sami' Allahu liman hamidah' kehte waqt bhi haath uthate; aur doosri rakat se teesri ke liye uthte waqt bhi." Ibn Umar ne kaha: "Nabi bhi yehi karte the."

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:The people were ordered to place the right hand on the left forearm in the prayer. Abu Hazim said, "I knew that the order was from the Prophet (ﷺ)
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke logon ko namaz mein dahina haath baaye baazu par rakhne ka hukum diya gaya. Abu Hazim ne kaha: "Mujhe pata hai yeh hukum Nabi ki taraf se aaya."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "You see me facing the Qibla; but, by Allah, nothing is hidden from me regarding your bowing and submissiveness and I see you from behind my back
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Tum dekhte ho main Qibla ki taraf mun kiye hun, magar Allah ki qasam, na tumhara khushu na tumhara ruku mujhse chhupa hai, main tumhe apni pusht se bhi dekhta hoon."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Perform the bowing and the prostrations properly. By Allah, I see you from behind me (or from behind my back) when you bow or prostrate
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Ruku aur sajda achhi tarah karo. Allah ki qasam, main tumhe apne peechhe se (ya apni pusht se) dekhta hoon jab tum ruku ya sajda karte ho."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet, Abu Bakr and `Umar used to start the prayer with "Al hamdu li l-lahi Rabbi l-`alamin (All praise is but to Allah, Lord of the Worlds)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi, Abu Bakr aur Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) namaz "Al-hamdu lillahi Rabbil-'aalamin" se shuru karte the.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to keep silent between the Takbir and the recitation of Qur'an and that interval of silence used to be a short one. I said to the Prophet (ﷺ) "May my parents be sacrificed for you! What do you say in the pause between Takbir and recitation?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I say, 'Allahumma, baa`id baini wa baina khatayaya kama baa`adta baina l-mashriqi wa l-maghrib. Allahumma, naqqini min khatayaya kama yunaqqa th-thawbu l-abyadu mina d-danas. Allahumma, ighsil khatayaya bi l-maa'i wa th-thalji wa l-barad (O Allah! Set me apart from my sins (faults) as the East and West are set apart from each other and clean me from sins as a white garment is cleaned of dirt (after thorough washing). O Allah! Wash off my sins with water, snow and hail
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool Takbir aur Quran ki tilawat ke darmiyan thoda khamosh rehte, aur yeh waqfa chhota hota tha. Maine Nabi se pucha: "Mere maa-baap aap par qurban hon! Aap Takbir aur tilawat ke darmiyan kya kehte hain?" Nabi ne farmaya: "Main kehta hoon: 'Allahumma ba'id baini wa baina khatayaya kama ba'adta bainal-mashriqi wal-maghrib. Allahumma naqqini min khatayaya kama yunaqqath-thawbul-abyadu minad-danas. Allahummaghsil khatayaya bil-ma'i wath-thalji wal-barad' (Aye Allah! Mere aur mere gunahon ke darmiyan itni door kar de jitna tune mashriq aur magrib ke darmiyan ki hai. Aye Allah! Mujhe apne gunahon se aise saaf kar jaise safed kapda maile se saaf hota hai. Aye Allah! Mere gunahon ko paani, baraf aur ole se dho de)."

e: Narrated Asma' bint Abi Bakr:The Prophet (ﷺ) once offered the eclipse prayer. He stood for a long time and then did a prolonged bowing. He stood up straight again and kept on standing for a long time, then bowed a long bowing and then stood up straight and then prostrated a prolonged prostration and then lifted his head and prostrated a prolonged prostration. And then he stood up for a long time and then did a prolonged bowing and then stood up straight again and kept on standing for a long time. Then he bowed a long bowing and then stood up straight and then prostrated a prolonged prostration and then lifted his head and went for a prolonged prostration. On completion of the prayer, he said, "Paradise became so near to me that if I had dared, I would have plucked one of its bunches for you and Hell became so near to me that I said, 'O my Lord will I be among those people?' Then suddenly I saw a woman and a cat was lacerating her with its claws. On inquiring, it was said that the woman had imprisoned the cat till it died of starvation and she neither fed it nor freed it so that it could feed itself
hi: Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Abi Bakr (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne ek baar kasoof (grahan) ki namaz padhi. Aap der tak khade rahe, phir lamba ruku kiya. Phir seedhe khade hue aur der tak khade rahe, phir lamba ruku kiya. Phir seedhe hokar lamba sajda kiya, phir sar utha kar phir lamba sajda kiya. Phir der tak khade rahe, phir lamba ruku kiya. Phir seedhe khade hue aur der tak khade rahe. Phir lamba ruku kiya, phir seedhe hokar lamba sajda kiya, phir sar utha kar phir lamba sajda kiya. Namaz khatam karke, Aap ne farmaya: "Jannat mujhse itni qareeb ho gayi ke agar main himmat karta to tumhare liye uska ek gucchha tod leta, aur Dozakh mujhse itni qareeb ho gayi ke maine kaha: 'Aye mere Rab! Kya main bhi un logon mein se hoonga?' Phir achanak maine ek aurat dekhi jisse ek billi apne panjon se noch rahi thi. Poochne par bataya gaya ke us aurat ne billi ko band karke bhooka rakha yahan tak ke woh mar gayi, na use khilaya na azaad kiya taake woh khud khaana dhoond sake."

e: Narrated Abu Ma`mar:We asked Khabbab whether Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to recite (the Qur'an) in the Zuhr and the `Asr prayers. He replied in the affirmative. We said, "How did you come to know about it?" He said, "By the movement of his beard
hi: Abu Ma'mar bataate hain: "Humne Khabbab (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha kya Allah ke Rasool Zuhr aur Asr mein tilawat karte the. Unhone haan mein jawab diya. Humne pucha: 'Aapko kaise pata chala?' Unhone kaha: 'Unki daadhi ki harkat se.'"

e: Narrated Al-Bara:(And Al-Bara was not a liar) Whenever we offered prayer with the Prophet (ﷺ) and he raised his head from the bowing, we used to remain standing till we saw him prostrating
hi: Al-Bara (رضی اللہ عنہ), jo jhoote nahi the, bataate hain: "Jab bhi hum Nabi ke saath namaz padhte aur woh ruku se sar uthate, hum khade rehte yahan tak ke unhe sajda karte dekhte."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abbas:Once solar eclipse occurred during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He offered the eclipse prayer. His companions asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We saw you trying to take something while standing at your place and then we saw you retreating." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I was shown Paradise and wanted to have a bunch of fruit from it. Had I taken it, you would have eaten from it as long as the world remains
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai: "Ek baar Nabi ki zindagi mein suraj grahan hua. Aap ne kasoof ki namaz padhi. Sahaba ne pucha: 'Ya Rasoolallah! Humne dekha aap apni jagah khade hokar kuch pakadne ki koshish kar rahe the, phir humne dekha aap peeche hat rahe the.' Nabi ne farmaya: 'Mujhe Jannat dikhai gayi aur maine uska ek gucchha lena chaha. Agar main woh le leta, to tum us waqt tak usse khaate jab tak duniya baaki rehti.'"

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) led us in prayer and then went up to the pulpit and beckoned with both hands towards the Qibla of the mosque and then said, "When I started leading you in prayer, I saw the display of Paradise and Hell on the wall of the mosque (facing the Qibla). I never saw good and bad as I have seen today." He repeated the last statement thrice
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne humari imamat ki, phir mimbar par gaye aur masjid ke Qibla wali deewar ki taraf donon haathon se ishara karke farmaya: "Jab maine tumhari imamat shuru ki, mujhe (masjid ki) deewar par Jannat aur Dozakh dikhayi gayi. Maine aaj jaisa achha aur bura pehle kabhi nahi dekha." Aap ne yeh baat teen baar dohrayi.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "What is wrong with those people who look towards the sky during the prayer?" His talk grew stern while delivering this speech and he said, "They should stop (looking towards the sky during the prayer); otherwise their eyesight would be taken away
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Un logon ko kya hua jo namaz mein aasman ki taraf dekhte hain?" Yeh kehte huye Aap ki baat mein sakhti aa gayi aur farmaya: "Unhe iss se ruk jaana chahiye, warna unki nazar cheeni jaayegi."

e: Narrated `Aisha:I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about looking hither and thither in prayer. He replied, "It is a way of stealing by which Satan takes away (a portion) from the prayer of a person
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke maine Allah ke Rasool se namaz mein idhar-udhar dekhne ke baare mein pucha. Aap ne jawab diya: "Yeh chori ka ek tareeqa hai jisse shaitan namazi ki namaz ka ek hissa churaa leta hai."

e: Narrated `Aisha:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) prayed on a Khamisa with marks on it and said, "The marks on it diverted my attention, take this Khamisa to Abu Jahm and bring an Inbijaniya (from him)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke ek baar Nabi ne ek Khamisa (naqsh-wale kapde) mein namaz padhi jisme nishaan the, aur farmaya: "Iske nishaanon ne mera dhyan hataya, ise Abu Jahm ke paas le jao aur unka Inbijaniya (sada kapda) le aao."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) saw expectoration in the direction of the Qibla of the mosque while he was leading the prayer, and scratched it off. After finishing the prayer, he said, "Whenever any of you is in prayer he should know that Allah is in front of him. So none should spit in front of him in the prayer
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne masjid ke Qibla wali taraf thook dekha jabke Aap imamat kar rahe the, aur ise khurach diya. Namaz khatam karke farmaya: "Jab bhi koi namaz mein ho, use pata hona chahiye ke Allah uske saamne hai. Isliye koi apne saamne na thooke."

e: Narrated Anas:While the Muslims were offering the Fajr prayer, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) suddenly appeared before them by lifting the curtain of the dwelling place of `Aisha, looked towards the Muslims who were standing in rows. He smiled with pleasure. Abu Bakr started retreating to join the row on the assumption that the Prophet wanted to come out for the prayer. The Muslims intended to leave the prayer (and were on the verge of being put to trial), but the Prophet (ﷺ) beckoned them to complete their prayer and then he let the curtain fall. He died in the last hours of that day
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke jabke Musalman Fajr ki namaz padh rahe the, Allah ke Rasool achanak Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke ghar ka parda uthaakar unke saamne aa gaye aur safon mein khade Musalmanon ki taraf dekha aur khushi se muskuraye. Abu Bakr peeche hat kar saf mein shamil hone lage, unhe laga Nabi bahar aakar khud imamat karenge. Musalman namaz chhodne wale hi the (fitne ke qareeb), magar Nabi ne unhe namaz mukammal karne ka ishara kiya aur parda gira diya. Usi din ki aakhri ghanton mein Aap ka intiqal ho gaya.

e: Narrated Jabir bin Samura:The People of Kufa complained against Sa`d to `Umar and the latter dismissed him and appointed `Ammar as their chief . They lodged many complaints against Sa`d and even they alleged that he did not pray properly. `Umar sent for him and said, "O Aba 'Is-haq! These people claim that you do not pray properly." Abu 'Is-haq said, "By Allah, I used to pray with them a prayer similar to that of Allah's Apostle and I never reduced anything of it. I used to prolong the first two rak`at of `Isha prayer and shorten the last two rak`at." `Umar said, "O Aba 'Is-haq, this was what I thought about you." And then he sent one or more persons with him to Kufa so as to ask the people about him. So they went there and did not leave any mosque without asking about him. All the people praised him till they came to the mosque of the tribe of Bani `Abs; one of the men called Usama bin Qatada with a surname of Aba Sa`da stood up and said, "As you have put us under an oath; I am bound to tell you that Sa`d never went himself with the army and never distributed (the war booty) equally and never did justice in legal verdicts." (On hearing it) Sa`d said, "I pray to Allah for three things: O Allah! If this slave of yours is a liar and got up for showing off, give him a long life, increase his poverty and put him to trials." (And so it happened). Later on when that person was asked how he was, he used to reply that he was an old man in trial as the result of Sa`d's curse. `Abdul Malik, the sub narrator, said that he had seen him afterwards and his eyebrows were overhanging his eyes owing to old age and he used to tease and assault the small girls in the way
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Samura (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Kufa walon ne Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se Sa'd ki shikayat ki, Umar ne unhe hataakar Ammar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko unka sardar banaya. Unhone Sa'd ke khilaf bahut shikayatein daakhil kin, yahan tak ke ilzaam lagaya ke woh sahih tareeke se namaz nahi padhte. Umar ne unhe bulwaya aur kaha: "Aye Aba Ishaq! Yeh log kehte hain aap sahih namaz nahi padhte." Abu Ishaq (Sa'd) ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, main unke saath waisi namaz padhta tha jaisi Allah ke Rasool padhte the, kabhi kami nahi ki. Main Isha ki pehli do rakat lambi aur aakhri do chhoti karta tha." Umar ne kaha: "Aye Aba Ishaq, mera bhi tumhare baare mein yehi khayaal tha." Phir Umar ne ek ya usse zyada aadmi unke saath Kufa bheje taake log unke baare mein pucha jaaye. Woh gaye aur har masjid mein unke baare mein poocha. Sab logon ne unki tareef ki yahan tak ke Bani Abs ki masjid mein pahunche; Usama bin Qatada naam ke ek shaks, jinki kunniyat Abu Sa'da thi, khade hue aur kaha: "Jab aapne humein qasam de di hai, to main aapko batana zaroori samajhta hoon ke Sa'd khud fauj ke saath nahi jaate the, maal-e-ghanimat barabar taqseem nahi karte the, aur faisle mein insaaf nahi karte the." Yeh sunkar Sa'd ne kaha: "Main Allah se teen cheezon ki dua karta hoon: Aye Allah! Agar tera yeh banda jhoota hai aur dikhawe ke liye khada hua hai, to use lambi umr de, uska ghurbat badha, aur usse aazmaish mein daal." (Aisa hi hua.) Baad mein jab us shaks se poocha jaata woh kaisa hai, kehta: "Main budha aadmi hoon aazmaish mein, Sa'd ki badua ki wajah se." Rawi Abdul Malik ne kaha unhone use baad mein dekha, umr ki wajah se uski bhaunhein aankhon par lataki hui thin, aur woh raste mein chhoti bachiyon ko chhedata aur pareshaan karta.

e: Narrated 'Ubada bin As-Samit:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever does not recite Al-Fatiha in his prayer, his prayer is invalid
hi: Ubada bin As-Samit (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jo apni namaz mein Al-Fatiha na padhe, uski namaz batil hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered the mosque and a person followed him. The man prayed and went to the Prophet and greeted him. The Prophet (ﷺ) returned the greeting and said to him, "Go back and pray, for you have not prayed." The man went back prayed in the same way as before, returned and greeted the Prophet who said, "Go back and pray, for you have not prayed." This happened thrice. The man said, "By Him Who sent you with the Truth, I cannot offer the prayer in a better way than this. Please, teach me how to pray." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When you stand for Prayer say Takbir and then recite from the Holy Qur'an (of what you know by heart) and then bow till you feel at ease. Then raise your head and stand up straight, then prostrate till you feel at ease during your prostration, then sit with calmness till you feel at ease (do not hurry) and do the same in all your prayers
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool masjid mein daakhil hue aur ek shaks unke peechhe aaya. Us shaks ne namaz padhi aur Nabi ke paas jaakar salaam kiya. Nabi ne salaam ka jawab diya aur farmaya: "Wapas jaao aur namaz padho, kyunke tumne namaz nahi padhi." Woh wapas gaya aur pehle jaisi namaz padhi, phir aakar salaam kiya. Nabi ne phir farmaya: "Wapas jaao aur namaz padho, kyunke tumne namaz nahi padhi." Yeh teen baar hua. Shaks ne kaha: "Us zaat ki qasam jisne aapko haqq ke saath bheja, main isse behtar namaz nahi padh sakta. Mujhe sikhaiye kaise padhun." Nabi ne farmaya: "Jab namaz ke liye khado, Takbir kaho, phir jo Quran yaad ho tilawat karo, phir ruku karo yahan tak ke sukoon mehsoos karo, phir sar utha kar seedhe khade ho, phir sajda karo yahan tak ke sajde mein sukoon mehsoos karo, phir khamoshi se baitho yahan tak ke sukoon mehsoos karo (jaldi na karo), aur apni sab namazon mein yehi karo."

e: Narrated Jabir bin Samura:Sa`d said, "I used to pray with them a prayer similar to that of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (the prayer of Zuhr and `Asr) reducing nothing from them. I used to prolong the first two rak`at and shorten the last two rak`at." `Umar said to Sa`d "This was what we thought about you
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Samura bataate hain ke Sa'd ne kaha: "Main unke saath waisi namaz padhta tha jaisi Allah ke Rasool (Zuhr aur Asr ki namaz) padhte the, kuch kami nahi karta tha. Pehli do rakat lambi aur aakhri do chhoti karta tha." Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Sa'd se kaha: "Yehi hum tumhare baare mein sochte the."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abi Qatada:My father said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) in Zuhr prayers used to recite Al-Fatiha along with two other Suras in the first two rak`at: a long one in the first rak`a and a shorter (Sura) in the second, and at times the verses were audible. In the `Asr prayer the Prophet (ﷺ) used to recite Al-Fatiha and two more Suras in the first two rak`at and used to prolong the first rak`a. And he used to prolong the first rak`a of the Fajr prayer and shorten the second
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Qatada, apne waalid ke hawale se: "Nabi Zuhr mein pehli do rakat mein Al-Fatiha ke saath do aur Surahtein padhte the: pehli rakat mein lambi, doosri mein chhoti, aur kabhi-kabhi ayaat aawaaz mein aa jaati. Asr mein bhi pehli do rakat mein Al-Fatiha aur do Surahtein padhte the aur pehli rakat lambi karte the. Fajr ki pehli rakat lambi aur doosri chhoti karte the."

e: Narrated Abu Ma`mar:I asked Khabbab whether the Prophet (ﷺ) used to recite the Qur'an in the Zuhr and the `Asr prayers. He replied in the affirmative. We said, "How did you come to know that?" He said, "From the movement of his beard
hi: Abu Ma'mar bataate hain: "Maine Khabbab (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha kya Nabi Zuhr-Asr mein Quran padhte the. Unhone haan mein jawab diya. Humne pucha: 'Aapko kaise pata chala?' Unhone kaha: 'Unki daadhi ki harkat se.'"

e: Narrated Abu Ma`mar:I asked Khabbab bin Al-Art whether the Prophet (ﷺ) used to recite the Qur'an in the Zuhr and the `Asr prayers. He replied in the affirmative. I said, "How did you come to know that?" He replied, "From the movement of his beard
hi: Abu Ma'mar bataate hain: "Maine Khabbab (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Aratt se pucha kya Nabi Zuhr-Asr mein Quran padhte the. Unhone haan mein jawab diya. Maine pucha: 'Aapko kaise pata chala?' Unhone jawab diya: 'Unki daadhi ki harkat se.'"

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abi Qatada:My father said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) used to recite Al-Fatiha along with another Sura in the first two rak`at of the Zuhr and the `Asr prayers and at times a verse or so was audible to us
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Qatada, apne waalid ke hawale se: "Nabi Zuhr-Asr ki pehli do rakat mein Al-Fatiha ke saath ek aur Surah padhte the, kabhi-kabhi ek-do ayaat humein sunayi dein."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:(My mother) Umu-l-Fadl heard me reciting "Wal Mursalati `Urfan" (77) and said, "O my son! By Allah, your recitation made me remember that it was the last Sura I heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He recited it in the Maghrib prayer
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: (Meri maa) Umm-ul-Fadl ne mujhe "Wal Mursalati Urfan" (77) padhte suna aur kaha: "Aye mere bete! Allah ki qasam, tumhari tilawat ne mujhe yaad dilaya ke yehi aakhri Surah thi jo maine Allah ke Rasool se suni thi. Aap ne yeh Maghrib mein padhi thi."

e: Narrated Marwan bin Al-Hakam:Zaid bin Thabit said to me, "Why do you recite very short Suras in the Maghrib prayer while I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) reciting the longer of the two long Suras?
hi: Marwan bin Al-Hakam bataate hain ke Zaid bin Thabit (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne mujhse kaha: "Tum Maghrib mein bahut chhoti Surahtein kyun padhte ho jabke maine Nabi ko un do lambi Surahon mein se lambi wali padhte suna hai?"

e: Narrated Jubair bin Mut`im:My father said, "I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) reciting "at-Tur" (52) in the Maghrib prayer
hi: Jubair bin Mut'im bataate hain, apne waalid ke hawale se: "Maine Allah ke Rasool ko Maghrib mein 'At-Tur' (52) padhte suna."

e: Narrated Abu Rafi`:I offered the `Isha' prayer behind Abu Huraira and he recited, "Idha s-samaa'u n-shaqqat" (84) and prostrated. On my inquiring, he said, "I prostrated behind Abul-Qasim (the Prophet) (when he recited that Sura) and I will go on doing it till I meet him
hi: Abu Rafi (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Maine Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke peechhe Isha padhi, unhone 'Idha s-samaa'u n-shaqqat' (84) padhi aur sajda kiya. Poochne par unhone kaha: 'Maine yeh Abul-Qasim (Nabi) ke peechhe (yehi Surah padhte huye) sajda kiya tha, aur jab tak unse na miloon, karta rahunga.'"

e: Narrated Al-Bara:The Prophet (ﷺ) was on a journey and recited in one of the first two rak`at of the `Isha' prayer "Wa t-teeni wa z-zaitun
hi: Al-Bara (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Nabi ek safar mein Isha ki pehli do rakaton mein se ek mein "Wat-teeni waz-zaitun" padhte.

e: Narrated Abu Rafi`:Once I prayed the `Isha' prayer with Abu Huraira and he recited, "Idha s-samaa'u n-shaqqat" (84) and prostrated. I said, "What is that?" He said, "I prostrated behind Abul-Qasim, (the Prophet) (when he recited that Sura) and I will go on doing it till I meet him
hi: Abu Rafi (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Ek baar maine Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath Isha padhi, unhone 'Idha s-samaa'u n-shaqqat' (84) padhi aur sajda kiya. Maine pucha: 'Yeh kya hai?' Unhone kaha: 'Maine Abul-Qasim (Nabi) ke peechhe (yehi Surah padhte huye) sajda kiya tha, aur jab tak unse na miloon, karta rahunga.'"

e: Narrated Al-Bara:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) reciting wa t-teeni wa z-zaitun" (95) in the `Isha' prayer, and I never heard a sweeter voice or a better way of recitation than that of the Prophet
hi: Al-Bara (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke maine Nabi ko Isha mein "Wat-teeni waz-zaitun" (95) padhte suna, aur maine kabhi Nabi se zyada meethi awaaz ya achhi qiraat nahi suni.
