e: Narrated Jabir bin Samura:`Umar said to Sa`d, "The people complained against you in everything, even in prayer." Sa`d replied, "Really I used to prolong the first two rak`at and shorten the last two and I will never shorten the prayer in which I follow Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." `Umar said, "You are telling the truth and that is what I think about you
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Samura bataate hain ke Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Sa'd se kaha: "Logon ne har cheez mein tumhari shikayat ki, yahan tak ke namaz mein bhi." Sa'd ne jawab diya: "Sach mein, main pehli do rakat lambi aur aakhri do chhoti karta tha, aur us namaz mein kabhi kami nahi karunga jisme Allah ke Rasool ki pairvi karta hoon." Umar ne kaha: "Tum sach keh rahe ho, aur yehi mera tumhare baare mein khayaal tha."

e: Narrated Saiyar bin Salama:My father and I went to Abu Barza-al-Aslami to ask him about the stated times for the prayers. He replied, "The Prophet (ﷺ) used to offer the Zuhr prayer when the sun just declined from its highest position at noon; the `Asr at a time when if a man went to the farthest place in Medina (after praying) he would find the sun still hot (bright). (The sub narrator said: I have forgotten what Abu Barza said about the Maghrib prayer). The Prophet (ﷺ) never found any harm in delaying the `Isha' prayer to the first third of the night and he never liked to sleep before it and to talk after it. He used to offer the morning prayer at a time when after finishing it one could recognize the person sitting beside him and used to recite between 60 to 100 verses in one or both the rak`at
hi: Saiyar bin Salama bataate hain: "Main aur mere waalid Abu Barza (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Aslami (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas gaye namazon ke waqt poochne. Unhone jawab diya: 'Nabi Zuhr padhte the jab suraj dopahar se dhal jaata; Asr aise waqt padhte ke agar koi shaks (namaz ke baad) Madina ke door-tareen jagah tak jaata, wapas aane par suraj abhi tez hota.' (Rawi ko Maghrib ke baare mein yaad nahi.) "Nabi Isha ko raat ke pehle tihai tak taalne mein koi harj nahi samajhte the, aur usse pehle sona ya baad mein baat karna napasand karte the. Aap subah ki namaz us waqt padhte jab namaz ke baad koi apne pados mein baithe shaks ko pehchaan sakta, aur ek ya donon rakaton mein 60 se 100 ayaat tilawat karte."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Qur'an is recited in every prayer and in those prayers in which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) recited aloud for us, we recite aloud in the same prayers for you; and the prayers in which the Prophet (ﷺ) recited quietly, we recite quietly. If you recite "Al-Fatiha" only it is sufficient but if you recite something else in addition, it is better
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai: Quran har namaz mein padha jaata hai — jin namazon mein Allah ke Rasool humein aawaaz mein tilawat sunaate the, hum unhe tumhe bhi aawaaz mein sunaate hain, aur jin namazon mein Nabi khamoshi se padhte the, hum bhi khamoshi se padhte hain. Agar tum sirf Al-Fatiha padho, kaafi hai, magar agar kuch aur bhi padho to behtar hai.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) set out with the intention of going to Suq `Ukaz (market of `Ukaz) along with some of his companions. At the same time, a barrier was put between the devils and the news of heaven. Fire commenced to be thrown at them. The Devils went to their people, who asked them, "What is wrong with you?" They said, "A barrier has been placed between us and the news of heaven. And fire has been thrown at us." They said, "The thing which has put a barrier between you and the news of heaven must be something which has happened recently. Go eastward and westward and see what has put a barrier between you and the news of heaven." Those who went towards Tihama came across the Prophet at a place called Nakhla and it was on the way to Suq `Ukaz and the Prophet (ﷺ) was offering the Fajr prayer with his companions. When they heard the Qur'an they listened to it and said, "By Allah, this is the thing which has put a barrier between us and the news of heaven." They went to their people and said, "O our people; verily we have heard a wonderful recital (Qur'an) which shows the true path; we believed in it and would not ascribe partners to our Lord." Allah revealed the following verses to his Prophet (Sura 'Jinn') (72): "Say: It has been revealed to me." And what was revealed to him was the conversation of the Jinns
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke Nabi apne kuch sahaba ke saath Suq Ukaz (Ukaz ka bazaar) jaane ke iraade se nikle. Isi waqt shayateen aur aasman ki khabron ke darmiyan ek rukawat daal di gayi, aur unpar aag pheki jaane lagi. Shaytaan apni qaum ke paas gaye, unse pucha gaya: "Kya baat hai?" Unhone kaha: "Humare aur aasman ki khabron ke darmiyan rukawat aa gayi hai, aur humpar aag pheki gayi." Unhone kaha: "Jis cheez ne tumhare aur aasman ki khabron ke darmiyan rukawat daali hai, woh zaroor koi nayi baat hai. Mashriq aur magrib mein jaakar dekho kya cheez rukawat bani hai." Jo Tihama ki taraf gaye, unhe Nakhla naam ki jagah Nabi mile, jo Suq Ukaz ke raaste mein Fajr ki namaz apne sahaba ke saath padha rahe the. Jab unhone Quran suna, dhyaan se sunte rahe aur kaha: "Allah ki qasam, yehi cheez hai jisne humare aur aasman ki khabron ke darmiyan rukawat daali." Woh apni qaum ke paas gaye aur kaha: "Aye humari qaum! Humne ek ajeeb qiraat (Quran) suni hai jo seedha raasta dikhati hai, humne usme iman laa liya hai aur ab hum kabhi apne Rab ke saath kisi ko shareek nahi karenge." Allah ne apne Nabi par yeh ayaat nazil ki (Surah Jinn 72): "Kaho: Mujh par wahi ki gayi hai..." Aur jo unpar wahi ki gayi, woh jinnon ki guftagu thi.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) recited aloud in the prayers in which he was ordered to do so and quietly in the prayers in which he was ordered to do so. "And your Lord is not forgetful." "Verily there was a good example for you in the ways of the Prophet
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke Nabi jin namazon mein buland aawaaz se padhne ka hukum diya gaya tha, unme buland aawaaz se padhte, aur jin mein khamoshi se padhne ka hukum tha, khamoshi se padhte. "Aur tera Rab bhoolne wala nahi hai." "Beshak Nabi ke tareeqe mein tumhare liye behtareen namoona hai."

e: Anas said:One of the Ansar used to lead the Ansar in Salat in the Quba' mosque and it was his habit to recite Qul Huwal-lahu Ahad whenever he wanted to recite something in Salat. When he finished that Surah, he would recite another one with it. He followed the same procedure in each Rak'a. His companions discussed this with him and said, "You recite this Surah and do not consider it sufficient and then you recite another. So would you recite it alone or leave it and recite some other." He said, "I will never leave it and if you want me to be your Imam on this condition then it is all right ; otherwise I will leave you." They knew that he was the best amongst them and they did not like someone else to lead them in Salat. When the Prophet (ﷺ) went to them as usual, they informed him about it. The Prophet (ﷺ) addressed him and said, "O so-and-so, what forbids you from doing what your companions ask you to do ? Why do you read this Surah particularly in every Rak'a?" He replied, "I love this Surah." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Your love for this Surah will make you enter Paradise
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ansaar ka ek shaks Quba ki masjid mein Ansaar ki imamat karta tha, aur uski aadat thi ke jab bhi namaz mein kuch padhna chahta, "Qul Huwallahu Ahad" padhta. Jab woh Surah khatam kar leta, uske saath ek aur Surah bhi padhta. Har rakat mein yehi karta. Uske sathiyon ne is baare mein baat ki aur kaha: "Tum yeh Surah padhte ho aur ise kaafi nahi samajhte, phir doosri padhte ho. To ya isko akela padho ya isko chhod kar koi aur padho." Usne kaha: "Main ise kabhi nahi chhodunga, agar tum chaho ke main is shart par imamat karoon to theek hai, warna main tumhari imamat chhod dunga." Woh jaante the ke woh unme sabse behtar hai, aur kisi aur ko imamat karte dekhna nahi chahte the. Jab Nabi unke paas aaye jaisa hamesha aate, unhone yeh baat batai. Nabi ne us shaks se pucha: "Aye falaan! Kis cheez ne tumhe apne sathiyon ki baat maanne se roka? Tum har rakat mein khaas taur par yeh Surah kyun padhte ho?" Usne jawab diya: "Mujhe is Surah se mohabbat hai." Nabi ne farmaya: "Iss Surah se tumhari mohabbat tumhe Jannat mein daakhil karayegi."

e: Narrated Abu Wa'il:A man came to Ibn Mas`ud and said, "I recited the Mufassal (Suras) at night in one rak`a." Ibn Mas`ud said, "This recitation is (too quick) like the recitation of poetry. I know the identical Suras which the Prophet (ﷺ) used to recite in pairs." Ibn Mas`ud then mentioned 20 Mufassal Suras including two Suras from the family of (i.e. those verses which begin with) Ha, Meem [??] (which the Prophet (ﷺ) used to recite) in each rak`a
hi: Abu Wail bataate hain: "Ek shaks Ibn Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas aaya aur kaha: 'Maine raat ko Mufassal (Surahtein) ek hi rakat mein padh dein.' Ibn Mas'ud ne kaha: 'Yeh (jaldi) padhna shayari padhne jaisa hai. Mujhe woh Surahtein pata hain jo Nabi jodakar padhte the.'" Ibn Mas'ud ne phir bees Mufassal Surahon ka zikar kiya, jinme "Ha-Meem" wali do Surahtein bhi shamil thin (jo Nabi har rakat mein padhte the).

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abi Qatada:My father said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) uses to recite Al-Fatiha followed by another Sura in the first two rak`at of the prayer and used to recite only Al-Fatiha in the last two rak`at of the Zuhr prayer. Sometimes a verse or so was audible and he used to prolong the first rak`a more than the second and used to do the same in the `Asr and Fajr prayers
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Qatada, apne waalid ke hawale se: "Nabi namaz ki pehli do rakat mein Al-Fatiha ke saath ek aur Surah padhte, aur Zuhr ki aakhri do rakaton mein sirf Al-Fatiha padhte. Kabhi-kabhi ek ayaat humein sunayi deti. Pehli rakat doosri se lambi karte, aur Asr-Fajr mein bhi yehi karte."

e: Narrated Abu Ma`mar:We said to Khabbab "Did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to recite in Zuhr and `Asr prayers?" He replied in the affirmative. We said, "How did you come to know about it?" He said, "By the movement of his beard
hi: Abu Ma'mar bataate hain: "Humne Khabbab (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha: 'Kya Allah ke Rasool Zuhr-Asr mein tilawat karte the?' Unhone haan mein jawab diya. Humne pucha: 'Aapko kaise pata chala?' Unhone kaha: 'Unki daadhi ki harkat se.'"

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abi Qatada:My father said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) used to recite Al-Fatiha along with another Sura in the first two rak`at of the Zuhr and `Asr prayers. A verse or so was audible at times and he used to prolong the first rak`a
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Qatada, apne waalid ke hawale se: "Nabi Zuhr-Asr ki pehli do rakat mein Al-Fatiha ke saath ek aur Surah padhte the. Kabhi-kabhi ek ayaat sunayi deti, aur pehli rakat lambi karte the."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abi Qatada:My father said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) used to prolong the first rak`a of the Zuhr prayer and shorten the second one and used to do the same in the Fajr prayer
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Qatada, apne waalid ke hawale se: "Nabi Zuhr ki pehli rakat lambi aur doosri chhoti karte the, aur Fajr mein bhi yehi karte."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Say Amin" when the Imam says it and if the Amin of any one of you coincides with that of the angels then all his past sins will be forgiven." Ibn Shihab said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to Say "Amin
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Jab Imam 'Amin' kahe, tum bhi kaho, kyunke jiska 'Amin' farishton ke 'Amin' se mil jaata hai, uske pichhle gunah maaf ho jaate hain." Ibn Shihab ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool 'Amin' kaha karte the."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If any one of you says, "Amin" and the angels in the heavens say "Amin" and the former coincides with the latter, all his past sins will be forgiven
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Agar tum mein se koi 'Amin' kahe aur aasman ke farishte bhi 'Amin' kahen, aur dono ka waqt mil jaaye, uske sab pichhle gunah maaf ho jaate hain."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Say Amen when the Imam says 'Ghairi l-maghdubi `alaihim wala d-daalleen' (not the path of those who earn Your Anger (such as Jews) nor of those who go astray (such as Christians)); all the past sins of the person whose saying (of Amin) coincides with that of the angels, will be forgiven
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jab Imam 'Ghairil-maghdubi alaihim walad-daalleen' kahe, tum 'Amin' kaho, kyunke jiska (Amin kehna) farishton ke saath mil jaaye, uske pichhle gunah maaf ho jaate hain."

e: Narrated Abu Bakra:I reached the Prophet (ﷺ) in the mosque while he was bowing in prayer and I too bowed before joining the row. I mentioned it to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he said to me, "May Allah increase your love for the good. But do not repeat it again (bowing in that way)
hi: Abu Bakra (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Main masjid mein Nabi ke paas pahuncha jabke Aap ruku mein the, main bhi saf mein shamil hone se pehle ruku kar liya. Maine yeh Nabi ko bataya, Aap ne farmaya: 'Allah tumhari (deen ke prati) mohabbat aur badhaye, magar dobara aisa mat karna.'"

e: Narrated `Imran bin Husain:I offered the prayer with `Ali in Basra and he made us remember the prayer which we used to pray with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). `Ali said Takbir on each rising and bowing
hi: Imran bin Husain (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke maine Basra mein Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke saath namaz padhi, unhone humein woh namaz yaad dilai jo hum Allah ke Rasool ke saath padhte the. Ali (Alayhis Salam) har khade hone aur ruku par Takbir kehte the.

e: Narrated Abu Salama:When Abu Huraira led us in prayer he used to say Takbir on each bowing and rising. On the completion of the prayer he used to say, "My prayer is more similar to the prayer of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) than that of anyone of you
hi: Abu Salama bataate hain ke jab Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) humari imamat karte, har ruku aur uthne par Takbir kehte. Namaz mukammal karke woh kehte: "Meri namaz tum sabki namaz se zyada Allah ke Rasool ki namaz jaisi hai."

e: Narrated Mutarrif bin `Abdullah:`Imran bin Husain and I offered the prayer behind `Ali bin Abi Talib. When `Ali prostrated, he said the Takbir, when he raised his head, he said the Takbir and when he got up for the third rak`a he said the Takbir. On completion of the prayer `Imran took my hand and said, "This (i.e. `Ali) made me remember the prayer of Muhammad" Or he said, "He led us in a prayer like that of Muhammad
hi: Mutarrif bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke main aur Imran bin Husain (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Ali (Alayhis Salam) bin Abi Talib ke peechhe namaz padhi. Jab Ali (Alayhis Salam) sajda karte, Takbir kehte, jab sar utha te, Takbir kehte, aur teesri rakat ke liye uthte waqt bhi Takbir kehte. Namaz mukammal hone par Imran ne mera haath pakda aur kaha: "Isne (Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne) mujhe Muhammad ki namaz yaad dilai," ya kaha: "Unhone humari imamat Muhammad jaisi ki."

e: Narrated `Ikrima:I saw a person praying at Muqam-Ibrahim (the place of Abraham by the Ka`ba) and he was saying Takbir on every bowing, rising, standing and sitting. I asked Ibn `Abbas (about this prayer). He admonished me saying: "Isn't that the prayer of the Prophet?
hi: Ikrima bataate hain: "Maine ek shaks ko Maqam-e-Ibrahim par namaz padhte dekha, woh har ruku, uthne, khade hone aur baithne par Takbir kehta tha. Maine Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se (iske baare mein) pucha. Unhone naseehat karte huye kaha: 'Kya yeh Nabi ki namaz nahi hai?'"

e: Narrated `Ikrima:I prayed behind a Sheikh at Mecca and he said twenty two Takbirs (during the prayer). I told Ibn `Abbas that he (i.e. that Sheikh) was foolish. Ibn `Abbas admonished me and said, "This is the tradition of Abul-Qasim
hi: Ikrima bataate hain: "Main Mecca mein ek Sheikh ke peechhe namaz padhi, unhone baais (22) Takbirein kahin (namaz mein). Maine Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko bataya ke woh (Sheikh) bewaqoof tha. Ibn Abbas ne mujhe naseehat karte huye kaha: 'Yeh Abul-Qasim (Nabi) ki Sunnat hai.'"

e: And narrated Abu Huraira:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood for the prayer, he said Takbir on starting the prayer and then on bowing. On rising from bowing he said, "Sami`a llahu liman hamidah," and then while standing straight he used to say, "Rabbana laka-l hamd" (Al- Laith said, "(The Prophet (ﷺ) said), 'Wa laka l-hamd'." He used to say Takbir on prostrating and on raising his head from prostration; again he would Say Takbir on prostrating and raising his head. He would then do the same in the whole of the prayer till it was completed. On rising from the second rak`a (after sitting for at-Tahiyyat), he used to say Takbir
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab bhi Allah ke Rasool namaz ke liye khade hote, namaz shuru karte waqt Takbir kehte, phir ruku ke waqt bhi. Ruku se sar uthate waqt "Sami' Allahu liman hamidah" kehte, phir seedhe khade hote huye "Rabbana lakal-hamd" kehte (Al-Laith ne kaha: "Wa lakal-hamd"). Sajda karte waqt Takbir kehte, aur sajde se sar uthate waqt bhi Takbir kehte; phir dobara sajda karte waqt Takbir aur sar uthate waqt Takbir. Aap poori namaz mein yehi karte. Doosri rakat se (Tahiyyat baithne ke baad) uthte waqt bhi Takbir kehte.

e: Narrated Mus`ab bin Sa`d:I offered prayer beside my father and approximated both my hands and placed them in between the knees. My father told me not to do so and said, "We used to do the same but we were forbidden (by the Prophet) to do it and were ordered to place the hands on the knees
hi: Mus'ab bin Sa'd bataate hain: "Maine apne waalid ke bagal mein namaz padhi aur apne donon haath paas laakar ghutnon ke beech rakh diye. Mere waalid ne mujhe mana kiya aur kaha: 'Hum bhi yehi karte the magar humein (Nabi ne) mana kiya aur haath ghutnon par rakhne ka hukum diya.'"

e: Narrated Zaid bin Wahb:Hudhaifa saw a person who was not performing the bowing and prostration perfectly. He said to him, "You have not prayed and if you should die you would die on a religion other than that of Muhammad
hi: Zaid bin Wahb bataate hain: Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne ek shaks ko dekha jo ruku-sajda achhi tarah nahi kar raha tha. Unhone usse kaha: "Tumne namaz nahi padhi, aur agar tum is (na-mukammal) tareeke par maro, to tum Muhammad ke deen ke ilawa kisi aur deen par maroge."

e: Narrated Al-Bara:The bowing, the prostration the sitting in between the two prostrations and the standing after the bowing of the Prophet (ﷺ) but not qiyam (standing in the prayer) and qu`ud (sitting in the prayer) used to be approximately equal (in duration)
hi: Al-Bara (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ke ruku, sajda, do sajdon ke beech baithna, aur ruku ke baad khade hona — sab taqreeban barabar waqt ke hote the, siwaye Qiyaam (khade hone) aur Qu'ud (baithne) ke.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) entered the mosque, a man came in, offered the prayer and greeted the Prophet. The Prophet returned his greeting and said to him, "Go back and pray again for you have not prayed." The man offered the prayer again, came back and greeted the Prophet. He said to him thrice, "Go back and pray again for you have not prayed." The man said, "By Him Who has sent you with the truth! I do not know a better way of praying. Kindly teach Me how to pray." He said, "When you stand for the prayer, say Takbir and then recite from the Qur'an what you know and then bow with calmness till you feel at ease, then rise from bowing till you stand straight. Afterwards prostrate calmly till you feel at ease and then raise (your head) and sit with Calmness till you feel at ease and then prostrate with calmness till you feel at ease in prostration and do the same in the whole of your prayer
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke ek baar Nabi masjid mein daakhil hue, ek shaks aaya, namaz padhi aur Nabi ko salaam kiya. Nabi ne salaam ka jawab diya aur farmaya: "Wapas jaao aur dobara padho, kyunke tumne namaz nahi padhi." Woh shaks dobara namaz padh kar aaya aur salaam kiya. Aap ne teen baar farmaya: "Wapas jaao aur dobara padho, kyunke tumne namaz nahi padhi." Shaks ne kaha: "Us zaat ki qasam jisne aapko haqq ke saath bheja, mujhe isse behtar tareeka nahi aata. Mujhe sikhaiye kaise padhun." Nabi ne farmaya: "Jab namaz ke liye khado, Takbir kaho, phir jo Quran yaad ho tilawat karo, phir sukoon se ruku karo yahan tak ke sukoon mehsoos karo, phir ruku se seedhe khade ho jao. Phir sukoon se sajda karo yahan tak ke sajde mein sukoon mehsoos karo, phir sar utha kar sukoon se baitho yahan tak ke sukoon mehsoos karo, phir sukoon se sajda karo yahan tak ke sajde mein sukoon mehsoos karo, aur poori namaz mein yehi karo."

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to say in his bowing and prostrations, "Subhanaka l-lahumma Rabbana wa bihamdika; Allahumma ghfir li.' (Exalted [from unbecoming attributes] Are you O Allah our Lord, and by Your praise [do I exalt You]. O Allah! Forgive me
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke Nabi apne ruku aur sajde mein kehte the: "Subhanaka Allahumma Rabbana wa bihamdika, Allahummaghfir li" (Aye Allah! Hamare Rab, tu paak hai aur teri hi tareef hai. Aye Allah! Mujhe maaf kar de).

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:When the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Sami`a l-lahu liman hamidah," (Allah heard those who sent praises to Him), he would say, "Rabbana wa laka l-hamd." On bowing and raising his head from it the Prophet (ﷺ) used to say Takbir. He also used to say Takbir on rising after the two prostrations. (See Hadith No)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke jab Nabi "Sami' Allahu liman hamidah" kehte, phir kehte "Rabbana wa lakal-hamd." Ruku karte aur sar uthate waqt Takbir kehte the. Do sajdon ke baad uthte waqt bhi Takbir kehte the.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When the Imam says, "Sami`a l-lahu liman hamidah," you should say, "Allahumma Rabbana laka l-hamd." And if the saying of any one of you coincides with that of the angels, all his past sins will be forgiven
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jab Imam 'Sami' Allahu liman hamidah' kahe, tum kaho 'Allahumma Rabbana lakal-hamd,' aur jiska (yeh kehna) farishton ke saath mil jaaye, uske pichhle gunah maaf ho jaate hain."

e: Narrated Abu Salama:Abu Hurairah said, "No doubt, my Salat is similar to that of the Prophet (ﷺ)." Abu Hurairah used to recite Qunut after saying Sami' Allahu liman hamida in the last Rak'a of the Zuhr, Isha and Fajr Prayers. He would ask Allah's Forgiveness for the true believers and curse the disbelievers
hi: Abu Salama bataate hain ke Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Beshak, meri namaz Nabi ki namaz jaisi hai." Abu Huraira Zuhr, Isha aur Fajr ki aakhri rakat mein "Sami' Allahu liman hamida" ke baad Qunut padhte the. Woh sacche momino ke liye maafi maangte aur kaafiron par laanat karte.

e: Narrated Anas:The qunut [supplication before going down for prostration] used to be recited in the Maghrib and the Fajr prayers
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Qunut (sajde se pehle ki dua) Maghrib aur Fajr mein padhi jaati thi.

e: Narrated Rifa`a bin Rafi` Az-Zuraqi:One day we were praying behind the Prophet. When he raised his head from bowing, he said, "Sami`a l-lahu liman hamidah." A man behind him said, "Rabbana wa laka l-hamdu, hamdan kathiran taiyiban mubarakan fihi" (O our Lord! All the praises are for You, many good and blessed praises). When the Prophet completed the prayer, he asked, "Who has said these words?" The man replied, "I." The Prophet said, "I saw over thirty angels competing to write it first." Prophet rose (from bowing) and stood straight till all the vertebrae of his spinal column came to a natural position
hi: Rifa'a bin Rafi Az-Zuraqi bataate hain: "Ek din hum Nabi ke peechhe namaz padh rahe the. Jab Aap ne ruku se sar utha kar 'Sami' Allahu liman hamidah' kaha, unke peechhe ek shaks ne kaha: 'Rabbana wa lakal-hamdu, hamdan kathiran taiyiban mubarakan fihi' (Aye humare Rab! Bahut, achhi aur mubarak tareef teri hi hai). Namaz mukammal karke Nabi ne pucha: 'Yeh alfaaz kisne kahe?' Us shaks ne kaha: 'Maine.' Nabi ne farmaya: 'Maine teesse zyada farishton ko ise sabse pehle likhne ki hodh mein dekha.'" Nabi (ruku se) uthkar tab tak seedhe khade rehte jab tak unki reedh ki sab haddiyan apni sahih jagah par na aa jaatin.

e: Narrated Thabit:Anas used to demonstrate to us the prayer of the Prophet (ﷺ) and while demonstrating, he used to raise his head from bowing and stand so long that we would say that he had forgotten (the prostration)
hi: Thabit bataate hain ke Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) humein Nabi ki namaz dikhaya karte, aur dikhate huye woh ruku se sar utha kar itni der khade rehte ke hum kehte ke woh (sajda) bhool gaye.

e: Narrated Al-Bara':The bowing, the prostrations, the period of standing after bowing and the interval between the two prostrations of the Prophet (ﷺ) used to be equal in duration
hi: Al-Bara' (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ke ruku, sajda, ruku ke baad khade hone aur do sajdon ke darmiyan (baithne) ka waqt taqreeban barabar hota tha.

e: Narrated Aiyub:Abu Qilaba said, "Malik bin Huwairith used to demonstrate to us the prayer of the Prophet (ﷺ) at times other than that of the compulsory prayers. So (once) he stood up for prayer and performed a perfect Qiyam (standing and reciting from the Holy Qur'an) and then bowed and performed bowing perfectly; then he raised his head and stood straight for a while." Abu Qilaba added, "Malik bin Huwairith in that demonstration prayed like this Sheikh of ours, Abu Yazid." Abu Yazid used to sit (for a while) on raising his head from the second prostration before getting up
hi: Aiyub bataate hain ke Abu Qilaba ne kaha: "Malik bin Huwairith (رضی اللہ عنہ) humein farz namaz ke ilawa doosre waqt Nabi ki namaz dikhaya karte the. To woh khade hue aur mukammal Qiyaam kiya, phir ruku kiya aur mukammal ruku kiya, phir sar utha kar thodi der seedhe khade rahe." Abu Qilaba ne joda: "Malik bin Huwairith ne is namoone mein waisi hi namaz padhi jaisi humare yeh Sheikh Abu Yazid padhte hain." Abu Yazid doosre sajde se uthte waqt thodi der baith jaate the.

e: Narrated Abu Bakr bin `Abdur Rahman Ibn Harith bin Hisham and Abu Salama bin `Abdur Rahman:Abu Huraira used to say Takbir in all the prayers, compulsory and optional -- in the month of Ramadan or other months. He used to say Takbir on standing for prayer and on bowing; then he would say, "Sami`a l-lahu liman hamidah," and before prostrating he would say "Rabbana wa laka lhamd." Then he would say Takbir on prostrating and on raising his head from the prostration, then another Takbir on prostrating (for the second time), and on raising his head from the prostration. He also would say the Takbir on standing from the second rak`a. He used to do the same in every rak`a till he completed the prayer. On completion of the prayer, he would say, "By Him in Whose Hands my soul is! No doubt my prayer is closer to that of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) than yours, and this was His prayer till he left this world
hi: Abu Bakr bin Abdur Rahman Ibn Harith bin Hisham aur Abu Salama bin Abdur Rahman bataate hain: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) sab namazon mein Takbir kehte the — farz ho ya nafil, Ramadan mein ho ya doosre mahine mein. Woh namaz shuru karte waqt aur ruku ke waqt Takbir kehte; phir "Sami' Allahu liman hamidah" kehte, aur sajda se pehle "Rabbana wa lakal-hamd" kehte. Phir sajda karte waqt Takbir aur sar uthate waqt bhi Takbir kehte, phir dobara sajda karte waqt Takbir aur sar uthate waqt Takbir. Doosri rakat se uthte waqt bhi Takbir kehte. Har rakat mein yehi karte yahan tak ke namaz mukammal ho jaati. Namaz khatam karke woh kehte: "Us zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, meri namaz tum sabse zyada Allah ke Rasool ki namaz jaisi hai, aur yehi unki namaz thi duniya se jaane tak."

e: And Abu Huraira said, "When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) raised his head from (bowing) he used to say "Sami`a l-lahu liman hamidah, Rabbana wa laka l-hamd." He Would invoke Allah for some people by naming them:"O Allah! Save Al-Walid bin Al-Walid and Salama bin Hisham and `Aiyash bin Abi Rabi`a and the weak and the helpless people among the faithful believers O Allah! Be hard on the tribe of Mudar and let them suffer from famine years like that of the time of Joseph." In those days the Eastern section of the tribe of Mudar was against the Prophet
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne bhi kaha: "Jab Allah ke Rasool sar uthate, kehte 'Sami' Allahu liman hamidah, Rabbana wa lakal-hamd.' Aap kuch logon ke liye naam lekar dua karte: 'Aye Allah! Al-Walid bin Al-Walid, Salama bin Hisham, Aiyash bin Abi Rabi'a, aur sacche momino mein kamzor-behas logon ko bacha. Aye Allah! Mudar qabile par sakhti kar aur unhe Yusuf ke zamane jaisa akaal (famine) mein daal.'" Us zamane mein Mudar qabile ka mashriqi hissa Nabi ke khilaf tha.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) fell from a horse and the right side of his body was injured. We went to inquire about his health meanwhile it was time for the prayer and he led the prayer sitting and we also prayed while sitting. On completion of the prayer he said, "The Imam is to be followed; say Takbir when he says it; bow when he bows; rise when he rises and when he says "Sami`a l-lahu liman hamidah," say, "Rabbana wa laka l-hamd", and prostrate if he prostrates." Sufyan narrated the same from Ma`mar. Ibn Juraij said that his (the Prophet's) right leg had been injured
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ghode se gire aur unki dahini taraf zakhmi ho gayi. Hum unke haal ki khabar lene gaye, isi dauran namaz ka waqt aa gaya, Aap ne baithkar imamat ki aur hum bhi baithkar padhe. Namaz khatam karke farmaya: "Imam ki pairvi ki jaati hai; jab woh Takbir kahe, tum bhi kaho; jab woh ruku kare, tum bhi karo; jab woh sar utha kar khade ho, tum bhi ho; aur jab woh 'Sami' Allahu liman hamidah' kahe, tum 'Rabbana wa lakal-hamd' kaho; aur jab woh sajda kare, tum bhi karo." Ibn Juraij ne kaha ke Nabi ki dahini taang zakhmi hui thi.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The people said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shall we see our Lord on the Day of Resurrection?" He replied, "Do you have any doubt in seeing the full moon on a clear (not cloudy) night?" They replied, "No, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" He said, "Do you have any doubt in seeing the sun when there are no clouds?" They replied in the negative. He said, "You will see Allah (your Lord) in the same way. On the Day of Resurrection, people will be gathered and He will order the people to follow what they used to worship. So some of them will follow the sun, some will follow the moon, and some will follow other deities; and only this nation (Muslims) will be left with its hypocrites. Allah will come to them and say, 'I am Your Lord.' They will say, 'We shall stay in this place till our Lord comes to us and when our Lord will come, we will recognize Him. Then Allah will come to them again and say, 'I am your Lord.' They will say, 'You are our Lord.' Allah will call them, and As-Sirat (a bridge) will be laid across Hell and I (Muhammad) shall be the first amongst the Apostles to cross it with my followers. Nobody except the Apostles will then be able to speak and they will be saying then, 'O Allah! Save us. O Allah Save us.' There will be hooks like the thorns of Sa'dan [??] in Hell. Have you seen the thorns of Sa'dan [??]?" The people said, "Yes." He said, "These hooks will be like the thorns of Sa'dan [??] but nobody except Allah knows their greatness in size and these will entangle the people according to their deeds; some of them will fall and stay in Hell forever; others will receive punishment (torn into small pieces) and will get out of Hell, till when Allah intends mercy on whomever He likes amongst the people of Hell, He will order the angels to take out of Hell those who worshipped none but Him alone. The angels will take them out by recognizing them from the traces of prostrations, for Allah has forbidden the (Hell) fire to eat away those traces. So they will come out of the Fire, it will eat away from the whole of the human body except the marks of the prostrations. At that time they will come out of the Fire as mere skeletons. The Water of Life will be poured on them and as a result they will grow like the seeds growing on the bank of flowing water. Then when Allah had finished from the Judgments amongst his creations, one man will be left between Hell and Paradise and he will be the last man from the people of Hell to enter paradise. He will be facing Hell, and will say, 'O Allah! Turn my face from the fire as its wind has dried me and its steam has burnt me.' Allah will ask him, "Will you ask for anything more in case this favor is granted to you?' He will say, "No by Your (Honor) Power!" And he will give to his Lord (Allah) what he will of the pledges and the covenants. Allah will then turn his face from the Fire. When he will face Paradise and will see its charm, he will remain quiet as long as Allah wills. He then will say, 'O my Lord! Let me go to the gate of Paradise.' Allah will ask him, 'Didn't you give pledges and make covenants (to the effect) that you would not ask for anything more than what you requested at first?' He will say, 'O my Lord! Do not make me the most wretched, amongst Your creatures.' Allah will say, 'If this request is granted, will you then ask for anything else?' He will say, 'No! By Your Power! I shall not ask for anything else.' Then he will give to his Lord what He will of the pledges and the covenants. Allah will then let him go to the gate of Paradise. On reaching then and seeing its life, charm, and pleasure, he will remain quiet as long as Allah wills and then will say, 'O my Lord ! Let me enter Paradise.' Allah will say, May Allah be merciful unto you, O son of Adam! How treacherous you are! Haven't you made covenants and given pledges that you will not ask for anything more than what you have been given?' He will say, 'O my Lord! Do not make me the most wretched amongst Your creatures.' So Allah will laugh and allow him to enter Paradise and will ask him to request as much as he likes. He will do so till all his desires have been fulfilled . Then Allah will say, 'Request more of such and such things.' Allah will remind him and when all his desires and wishes; have been fulfilled, Allah will say "All this is granted to you and a similar amount besides." Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri, said to Abu Huraira, 'Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah said, 'That is for you and ten times more like it.' "Abu Huraira said, "I do not remember from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) except (his saying), 'All this is granted to you and a similar amount besides." Abu Sa`id said, "I heard him saying, 'That is for you and ten times more the like of it
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke logon ne pucha: "Ya Rasoolallah! Kya hum Qiyamat ke din apne Rab ko dekhenge?" Aap ne farmaya: "Kya tumhe poore chaand ko saaf raat mein dekhne mein koi shak hota hai?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi, Ya Rasoolallah!" Farmaya: "Kya tumhe bina badal ke suraj dekhne mein koi shak hota hai?" Unhone na mein jawab diya. Farmaya: "Isi tarah tum Allah (apne Rab) ko dekhoge. Qiyamat ke din logon ko jama kiya jayega, aur Allah unhe hukum dega ke woh apni ibadat ki hui cheezon ki pairvi karein. Kuch suraj ki pairvi karenge, kuch chaand ki, kuch aur mabudon ki, aur sirf yeh ummat (Musalman) apne munafiqon ke saath bachegi. Allah unke paas aayega aur kahega: 'Main tumhara Rab hoon.' Woh kahenge: 'Hum yahin thaherenge yahan tak ke humara Rab humare paas aaye, aur jab woh aayega, hum use pehchaan lenge.' Phir Allah dobara aayega aur kahega: 'Main tumhara Rab hoon.' Woh kahenge: 'Tu humara Rab hai.' Allah unhe bulayega, aur Dozakh par Sirat (pul) bichhai jayegi, aur main (Muhammad) sabse pehle Rusul mein apne pairokaron ke saath usse guzarunga. Sirf Rusul hi us waqt bol sakenge, aur woh kahenge: 'Aye Allah! Humein bacha. Aye Allah! Humein bacha.' Dozakh mein Sa'dan (kaanton wale darakht) jaise kaante honge — kya tumne Sa'dan ke kaante dekhe hain?" Logon ne kaha: "Haan." Aap ne farmaya: "Yeh kaante Sa'dan jaise honge, magar sirf Allah jaanta hai unki bhayaanki, aur yeh logon ko unke amal ke mutabiq pakdenge — kuch apne amal ki wajah se (Dozakh mein) gir kar hamesha rahenge, kuch saza pa kar (tukde-tukde hokar) bahar nikal aayenge, yahan tak ke jab Allah Dozakh walon mein se jise chahe reham karne ka iraada karega, farishton ko hukum dega ke un logon ko bahar nikaalen jinhone sirf Allah ki ibadat ki thi. Farishte unhe sajde ke nishaanon se pehchaan kar bahar nikaalenge, kyunke Allah ne aag ko un nishaanon ko khaane se mana kiya hai. To woh Aag se bahar aayenge, Aag ne poore jism ko khaa liya hoga siwaye sajde ke nishaan ke. Us waqt woh mahz haddiyaan (skeleton) hokar bahar aayenge. Un par Aab-e-Hayat (zindagi ka paani) dala jayega aur woh isi tarah ug aayenge jaise behte paani ke kinare beej ugte hain. Phir jab Allah apne makhlooq ka faisla kar chuka hoga, ek shaks Dozakh aur Jannat ke darmiyan reh jayega, woh Dozakh walon mein se aakhri shaks hoga jo Jannat mein daakhil hoga. Uska mun Dozakh ki taraf hoga, woh kahega: 'Aye Allah! Mera mun aag se pher de, iski hawa ne mujhe sukha diya hai aur iski bhaap ne mujhe jala diya hai.' Allah usse pucheega: 'Agar yeh nemat mil jaaye, kya tum aur kuch maangoge?' Woh kahega: 'Nahi, teri izzat ki qasam!' Aur woh apne Rab ko jo waade aur ehad de sake dega. Allah uska mun Aag se pher dega. Jab woh Jannat ki taraf mun karega aur uski khoobsurati dekhega, woh khamosh rahega jab tak Allah chahega. Phir kahega: 'Aye mere Rab! Mujhe Jannat ke darwaze tak jaane de.' Allah usse pucheega: 'Kya tumne waade aur ehad nahi diye the ke tum apni pehli maang se zyada kuch nahi maangoge?' Woh kahega: 'Aye mere Rab! Mujhe apni makhlooq mein sabse badnaseeb na banaana.' Allah kahega: 'Agar yeh mil jaaye, kya tum aur kuch maangoge?' Woh kahega: 'Nahi! Teri izzat ki qasam! Main aur kuch nahi maangunga.' Phir woh apne Rab ko jo waade-ehad de sake dega. Allah use Jannat ke darwaze tak jaane dega. Wahan pahunchkar aur uski zindagi, khoobsurati aur khushi dekhkar, woh khamosh rahega jab tak Allah chahega, phir kahega: 'Aye mere Rab! Mujhe Jannat mein daakhil kar de.' Allah kahega: 'Allah tumpar reham kare, Aye Adam ke bete! Tum kitne dhoke-baaz ho! Kya tumne waade-ehad nahi diye the ke jo diya gaya usse zyada kuch nahi maangoge?' Woh kahega: 'Aye mere Rab! Mujhe apni makhlooq mein sabse badnaseeb na banaana.' To Allah hansega aur usse Jannat mein daakhil hone dega, aur usse jitna chahe maangne ko kahega. Woh maangega yahan tak ke uski sab khwahishein poori ho jayengi. Phir Allah kahega: 'Aur falaan-falaan cheezein bhi maango.' Allah use yaad dilaayega, aur jab uski sab khwahishein aur wishes poori ho jayengi, Allah kahega: 'Yeh sab tumhe di gayi hain aur isse dus guna zyada bhi.'" Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Abu Huraira se kaha: 'Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Allah ne kaha: 'That is for you and ten times more like it.'"' Abu Huraira ne kaha: "Mujhe Allah ke Rasool se sirf itna yaad hai: 'Yeh sab tumhe diya gaya hai aur usi jitna aur.'" Abu Saeed ne kaha: "Maine unhe kehte suna: 'Yeh tumhare liye hai aur dus guna usi jaisa aur.'"

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Malik bin Buhaina:Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) used to offer prayer he used to keep arms away (from the body) so that the whiteness of his armpits was visible
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik bin Buhaina (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke jab bhi Nabi namaz padhte, apne baazu (badan se) itni door rakhte ke unki bagal ki safedi dikhai deti.

e: Narrated Abu Wail:Hudhaifa said, "I saw a person not performing his bowing and prostrations perfectly. When he completed the prayer, I told him that he had not prayed." I think that Hudhaifa added (i.e. said to the man), "Had you died, you would have died on a tradition other than that of the Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ)
hi: Abu Wail bataate hain: Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Maine ek shaks ko ruku-sajda achhi tarah na karte dekha. Namaz khatam hone par maine usse kaha ke usne namaz nahi padhi." Mujhe lagta hai Hudhaifa ne yeh bhi joda: "Agar tum (isi tareeke par) marte, to Nabi Muhammad ke tareeqe ke ilawa kisi aur tareeqe par marte."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) was ordered (by Allah) to prostrate on seven parts and not to tuck up the clothes or hair (while praying). Those parts are: the forehead (along with the tip of nose), both hands, both knees, and (toes of) both feet
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ko saat hisson par sajda karne ka hukum diya gaya, aur kapde ya baal na samet-ne ka. Yeh saat hisse hain: maathaa (naak ki nok samet), donon haath, donon ghutne, aur donon paon (ungliyaan).

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "We have been ordered to prostrates on seven bones and not to tuck up the clothes or hair
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Humein saat haddiyon par sajda karne ka hukum diya gaya hai, aur kapde ya baal samet-ne ka nahi."

e: Narrated Al-Bara' bin `Azib:(He was not a liar) We used to pray behind the Prophet (ﷺ) and when he said, "Sami`a l-lahu liman hamidah", none of us would bend his back (to go for prostration) till the Prophet (ﷺ) had placed his, forehead on the ground
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ), jo jhoote nahi the, bataate hain: "Hum Nabi ke peechhe namaz padhte the, aur jab Aap 'Sami' Allahu liman hamidah' kehte, hum mein se koi apni kamar tab tak nahi jhukata jab tak Nabi apna maathaa zameen par na rakh dete (sajda karte)."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I have been ordered to prostrate on seven bones i.e. on the forehead along with the tip of the nose and the Prophet (ﷺ) pointed towards his nose, both hands, both knees and the toes of both feet and not to gather the clothes or the hair
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Mujhe saat haddiyon par sajda karne ka hukum diya gaya — maathaa (naak ki nok samet) — Nabi ne apni naak ki taraf ishara kiya — donon haath, donon ghutne, aur donon paon ki ungliyaan, aur kapde ya baal samet-ne ka nahi."

e: Narrated Abu Salama:Once I went to Abu- Sa`id Al-Khudri and asked him, "Won't you come with us to the date-palm trees to have a talk?" So Abu Sa`id went out and I asked him, "Tell me what you heard from the Prophet (ﷺ) about the Night of Qadr." Abu Sa`id replied, "Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) performed I`tikaf (seclusion) on the first ten days of the month of Ramadan and we did the same with him. Gabriel came to him and said, 'The night you are looking for is ahead of you.' So the Prophet (ﷺ) performed the I`tikaf in the middle (second) ten days of the month of Ramadan and we too performed I`tikaf with him. Gabriel came to him and said, 'The night which you are looking for is ahead of you.' In the morning of the 20th of Ramadan the Prophet (ﷺ) delivered a sermon saying, 'Whoever has performed I`tikaf with me should continue it. I have been shown the Night of "Qadr", but have forgotten its date, but it is in the odd nights of the last ten nights. I saw in my dream that I was prostrating in mud and water.' In those days the roof of the mosque was made of branches of date-palm trees. At that time the sky was clear and no cloud was visible, but suddenly a cloud came and it rained. The Prophet (ﷺ) led us in the prayer and I saw the traces of mud on the forehead and on the nose of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). So it was the confirmation of that dream
hi: Abu Salama bataate hain: "Ek baar main Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas gaya aur kaha: 'Kya aap humare saath khajoor ke darakhton tak chalenge, kuch baat karein?' Abu Saeed bahar aaye, maine unse pucha: 'Batayiye aapne Nabi se Shab-e-Qadr ke baare mein kya suna.' Abu Saeed ne jawab diya: 'Ek baar Allah ke Rasool ne Ramadan ke pehle das dinon mein I'tikaf kiya, humne bhi unke saath kiya. Jibreel unke paas aaye aur kaha: Jis raat ki talaash mein ho, woh aage hai. Nabi ne phir Ramadan ke doosre das dinon mein I'tikaf kiya, hum bhi unke saath the. Jibreel aaye aur kaha: Jis raat ki talaash mein ho, woh aage hai. 20 Ramadan ki subah Nabi ne khutba diya aur farmaya: Jisne mere saath I'tikaf kiya, woh jaari rakhe. Mujhe Shab-e-Qadr dikhai gayi thi magar main uski tareekh bhool gaya, magar yeh Ramadan ke aakhri das dinon ki taaq raaton mein hai. Maine khwab mein dekha ke main kichad-paani mein sajda kar raha hoon.' Us zamane mein masjid ki chhat khajoor ki daaliyon ki thi. Us waqt aasman saaf tha aur koi baadal nazar nahi aa raha tha, magar achanak ek baadal aaya aur baarish hui. Nabi ne humari imamat ki, aur maine Allah ke Rasool ke maathe aur naak par kichad ke nishaan dekhe. Isi tarah woh khwab sach hua.'"

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:The people used to pray with the Prophet (ﷺ) tying their Izars around their necks because of their small sizes and the women were directed that they should not raise their heads from the prostrations till the men had sat straight
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke log Nabi ke saath apne Izar gardan se baandh kar namaz padhte the kyunke woh chhote hote the, aur aurton ko hukum diya gaya tha ke woh sajde se tab tak sar na uthayen jab tak mard seedhe baith na jayen.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) was ordered to prostrate on seven bony parts and not to tuck up his clothes or hair
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ko saat haddiyon par sajda karne ka hukum diya gaya, aur kapde ya baal na samet-ne ka.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I have been ordered to prostrate on seven (bones) and not to tuck up the hair or garment
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Mujhe saat (haddiyon) par sajda karne ka hukum diya gaya, aur baal ya kapda na samet-ne ka."

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to say frequently in his bowing and prostrations "Subhanaka l-lahumma Rabbana wa bihamdika, Allahumma ghfir li" (Exalted [from unbecoming attributes] Are you O Allah our Lord, and by Your praise [do I exalt you]. O Allah! Forgive me). In this way [??] he was acting on what was explained to him in the Holy Qur'an
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke Nabi apne ruku-sajde mein aksar kehte: "Subhanaka Allahumma Rabbana wa bihamdika, Allahummaghfir li" — isi tarah woh us hukum par amal kar rahe the jo Quran mein unhe samjhaya gaya.

e: Narrated Abu Qilaba:Once Malik bin Huwairith said to his friends, "Shall I show you how Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to offer his prayers?" And it was not the time for any of the compulsory congregational prayers. So he stood up (for the prayer) bowed and said the Takbir, then he raised his head and remained standing for a while and then prostrated and raised his head for a while (sat up for a while). He prayed like our Sheikh `Amr Ibn Salama. (Aiyub said, "The latter used to do a thing which I did not see the people doing i.e. he used to sit between the third and the fourth rak`a). Malik bin Huwairith said, "We came to the Prophet (after embracing Islam) and stayed with him. He said to us, 'When you go back to your families, pray such and such a prayer at such and such a time, pray such and such a prayer at such and such a time, and when there is the time for the prayer then only of you should pronounce the Adhan for the prayer and the oldest of you should lead the prayer
hi: Abu Qilaba bataate hain: "Ek baar Malik bin Huwairith (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne apne doston se kaha: 'Kya main tumhe dikhaun Allah ke Rasool kaise namaz padhte the?' Yeh farz jamaat ka waqt nahi tha. To woh khade hue, Takbir kahi aur ruku kiya, phir sar utha kar thodi der khade rahe, phir sajda kiya aur thodi der (do sajdon ke beech) baithe. Unhone humare Sheikh Amr Ibn Salama jaisi namaz padhi." (Aiyub ne kaha: "Woh (Sheikh) ek aisi baat karte the jo maine logon ko karte kabhi nahi dekha — teesri aur chauthi rakat ke beech baithte the.") Malik bin Huwairith ne kaha: "Hum (Islam qubool karne ke baad) Nabi ke paas aaye aur unke saath rahe. Aap ne humein kaha: 'Jab apne gharwalon ke paas wapas jao, falaan namaz falaan waqt par aur falaan namaz falaan waqt par padho, aur jab namaz ka waqt aaye, tum mein se koi Adhan de aur sabse bada imamat kare.'"

e: Narrated Al-Bara':The time taken by the Prophet (ﷺ) in prostrations, bowing, and the sitting interval between the two prostrations was about the same
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain ke Nabi ke sajde, ruku, aur do sajdon ke beech baithne ka waqt taqreeban barabar tha.

e: Narrated Thabit:Anas said, "I will leave no stone unturned in making you offer the prayer as I have seen the Prophet (ﷺ) making us offer it." Anas used to do a thing which I have not seen you doing. He used to stand after the bowing for such a long time that one would think that he had forgotten (the prostrations) and he used to sit in-between the prostrations so long that one would think that he had forgotten the second prostration
hi: Thabit bataate hain ke Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Main koshish karunga ke tumhe wahi namaz padhaun jaisi maine Nabi ko humein padhate dekha." Anas ek aisi cheez karte the jo maine tumhe karte nahi dekha — woh ruku ke baad itni der khade rehte ke lagta unhe (sajda) bhool gaya, aur do sajdon ke beech itni der baithte ke lagta doosra sajda bhool gaye.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Be straight in the prostrations and none of you should put his forearms on the ground (in the prostration) like a dog
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Sajde seedhe (theek tarah) karo, apni kohniyan kutte ki tarah zameen par mat bichhaao."

e: Narrated Malik bin Huwairith Al-Laithi:I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) praying and in the odd rak`at, he used to sit for a moment before getting up
hi: Malik bin Huwairith (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Laithi bataate hain: "Maine Nabi ko namaz padhte dekha, taaq rakat mein woh uthne se pehle thodi der baithte the."

e: Narrated Aiyub:Abu Qilaba said, "Malik bin Huwairith came to us and led us in the prayer in this mosque of ours and said, 'I lead you in prayer but I do not want to offer the prayer but just to show you how Allah's Apostle performed his prayers." I asked Abu Qilaba, "How was the prayer of Malik bin Huwairith?" He replied, "Like the prayer of this Sheikh of ours-- i.e. `Amr bin Salima." That Sheikh used to pronounce the Takbir perfectly and when he raised his head from the second prostration he would sit for a while and then support himself on the ground and get up
hi: Aiyub bataate hain ke Abu Qilaba ne kaha: "Malik bin Huwairith (رضی اللہ عنہ) humare paas aaye aur humari is masjid mein imamat ki, aur kaha: 'Main tumhari imamat kar raha hoon, magar mera maksad khud namaz padhna nahi, balki tumhe Allah ke Rasool ki namaz dikhana hai.'" Maine Abu Qilaba se pucha: "Malik bin Huwairith kaise padhte the?" Unhone jawab diya: "Humare Sheikh Amr bin Salima ki tarah." Woh Sheikh Takbir mukammal tareeke se kehte, aur jab doosre sajde se sar uthte, thodi der baithte, phir zameen ka sahara lekar uthte.

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Al-Harith:Abu Sa`id led us in the prayer and said the Takbir aloud on arising from the prostration, and on prostrating, on rising again, and on getting up from the second rak`a. Abu Sa`id said, "I saw the Prophet doing the same
hi: Sa'id bin Al-Harith bataate hain ke Abu Saeed ne humari imamat ki aur sajde se uthte waqt, sajda karte waqt, dobara uthte waqt, aur doosri rakat se uthte waqt buland aawaaz se Takbir kahi. Abu Saeed ne kaha: "Maine Nabi ko isi tarah karte dekha."

e: Narrated Mutarrif:`Imran and I prayed behind `Ali bin Abi Talib and he said Takbir on prostrating, on rising and on getting up after the two rak`at (i.e. after the second rak`a). When the prayer was finished, `Imran took me by the hand and said, "He (`Ali) has prayed the prayer of Muhammad" (or said, "He made us remember the prayer of Muhammad)
hi: Mutarrif bataate hain: "Main aur Imran ne Ali (Alayhis Salam) bin Abi Talib ke peechhe namaz padhi, unhone sajda karte waqt, uthte waqt, aur do rakat ke baad (yaani doosri rakat ke baad) uthte waqt Takbir kahi. Namaz khatam hone par Imran ne mera haath pakda aur kaha: 'Isne (Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne) Muhammad ki namaz padhi hai,' ya kaha: 'Unhone humein Muhammad ki namaz yaad dilai.'"

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abdullah:I saw `Abdullah bin `Umar crossing his legs while sitting in the prayer and I, a mere youngster in those days, did the same. Ibn `Umar forbade me to do so, and said, "The proper way is to keep the right foot propped up and bend the left in the prayer." I said questioningly, "But you are doing so (crossing the legs)." He said, "My feet cannot bear my weight
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah bataate hain: "Maine Abdullah bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko namaz mein taangein cross karke baithe dekha, aur main, us zamane mein ek naujawan, waisa hi kiya. Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne mujhe mana kiya aur kaha: 'Sahih tareeka yeh hai ke dahina paon khada rakho aur baaya moda huwa rakho namaz mein.' Maine hairat se kaha: 'Magar aap khud (cross karke baithe) hain!' Unhone kaha: 'Mere paon mera wazan nahi utha sakte.'"

e: Narrated Muhammad bin `Amr bin `Ata':I was sitting with some of the companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and we were discussing about the way of praying of the Prophet. Abu Humaid As-Sa`idi said, "I remember the prayer of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) better than any one of you. I saw him raising both his hands up to the level of the shoulders on saying the Takbir; and on bowing he placed his hands on both knees and bent his back straight, then he stood up straight from bowing till all the vertebrate took their normal positions. In prostrations, he placed both his hands on the ground with the forearms away from the ground and away from his body, and his toes were facing the Qibla. On sitting In the second rak`a he sat on his left foot and propped up the right one; and in the last rak`a he pushed his left foot forward and kept the other foot propped up and sat over the buttocks
hi: Muhammad bin Amr bin Ata bataate hain: "Main Allah ke Rasool ke kuch sahaba ke saath baitha tha aur hum Nabi ki namaz padhne ke tareeqe par baat kar rahe the. Abu Humaid As-Sa'idi ne kaha: 'Mujhe tum sabse zyada Allah ke Rasool ki namaz yaad hai. Maine dekha unhone Takbir kehte waqt donon haath shoulders tak uthaye; ruku mein donon haath ghutnon par rakhkar apni kamar seedhi rakhi, phir ruku se seedhe khade hue yahan tak ke sab haddiyan apni jagah aa gayin. Sajde mein donon haath zameen par rakhe, kohniyan zameen se aur badan se door, aur unki ungliyaan Qibla ki taraf hoti. Doosri rakat mein Aap apne baaye paon par baithte aur dahina khada rakhte; aakhri rakat mein baaye paon ko aage badhte aur doosre paon ko khada rakhte aur sarin par baithte.'"

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Buhaina:(he was from the tribe of Uzd Shanu'a [??] and was the ally of the tribe of `Abdul-Manaf and was one of the companions of the Prophet): Once the Prophet (ﷺ) led us in the Zuhr prayer and stood up after the second rak`a and did not sit down. The people stood up with him. When the prayer was about to end and the people were waiting for him to say the Taslim, he said Takbir while sitting and prostrated twice before saying the Taslim and then he said the Taslim
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Buhaina (رضی اللہ عنہ), jo Uzd Shanu'a qabile se the aur Abdul-Manaf qabile ke saathi the, bataate hain: "Ek baar Nabi ne Zuhr ki imamat ki aur doosri rakat ke baad khade ho gaye, baithe nahi. Log unke saath khade ho gaye. Jab namaz khatam hone ke qareeb thi aur log Taslim ka intezar kar rahe the, Nabi ne baithe-baithe Takbir kahi aur Taslim se pehle do sajde kiye, phir Taslim ki."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Malik bin Buhaina:Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) led us in the Zuhr prayer and got up (after the prostrations of the second rak`a) although he should have sat (for the Tashahhud). So at the end of the prayer, he prostrated twice while sitting (prostrations of Sahu)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik bin Buhaina (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke ek baar Allah ke Rasool ne Zuhr ki imamat ki aur (doosri rakat ke sajdon ke baad) khade ho gaye jabke unhe (Tashahhud ke liye) baithna chahiye tha. Isliye namaz ke aakhir mein, Aap ne baithe-baithe do sajde kiye (Sahu ke sajde).

e: Narrated Shaqiq bin Salama:`Abdullah said, "Whenever we prayed behind the Prophet (ﷺ) we used to recite (in sitting) 'Peace be on Gabriel, Michael, peace be on so and so. Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) looked back at us and said, 'Allah Himself is As-Salam (Peace), and if anyone of you prays then he should say, at-Tahiyatu li l-lahi wa ssalawatu wa t-taiyibat. As-salamu `alalika aiyuha n-Nabiyu wa rahmatu l-lahi wa barakatuh. Assalamu `alaina wa `ala `ibadi l-lahi s-salihin. (All the compliments, prayers and good things are due to Allah; peace be on you, O Prophet, and Allah's mercy and blessings [be on you]. Peace be on us an on the pious subjects of Allah). (If you say that, it will reach all the subjects in the heaven and the earth). Ash-hadu al-la ilaha illa l-lah, wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan `Abduhu wa Rasuluh. (I testify that there is no Deity [worthy of worship] but Allah, and I testify that Muhammad is His slave and His Apostle
hi: Shaqiq bin Salama bataate hain ke Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Jab bhi hum Nabi ke peechhe namaz padhte, hum (baithkar) kehte the: 'Salaam ho Jibreel par, Mikaeel par, salaam ho falaan-falaan par.' Ek baar Allah ke Rasool ne humari taraf mud kar farmaya: 'Allah khud As-Salam hai, isliye agar tum mein se koi namaz padhe, use kehna chahiye: At-Tahiyyatu lillahi was-salawatu wat-taiyibat. As-salamu alaika aiyuhan-Nabiyyu wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh. Assalamu alaina wa ala ibadillahis-saaliheen (Sab tareefein, duayein aur achhi cheezein Allah hi ke liye hain; salaam ho aap par, Aye Nabi, aur Allah ki rehmat aur barkatein [aap par]. Salaam ho humpar aur Allah ke neik bandon par). (Agar tum yeh kaho, to yeh aasman aur zameen ke har neik bande tak pahunchega.) Ash-hadu alla ilaha illallah, wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan Abduhu wa Rasuluh (Main gawahi deta hoon ke Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahi, aur main gawahi deta hoon ke Muhammad uske banda aur Rasool hain).'"

e: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to invoke Allah in the prayer saying "Allahumma inni a`udhu bika min `adhabi l-qabr, wa a`udhu bika min fitnati l-masihi d-dajjal, wa a`udhu bika min fitnati l-mahya wa fitnati l-mamat. Allahumma inni a`udhu bika mina l-ma'thami wa l-maghram. (O Allah, I seek refuge with You from the punishment of the grave, from the afflictions of the imposter- Messiah, and from the afflictions of life and death. O Allah, I seek refuge with You from sins and from debt)." Somebody said to him, "Why do you so frequently seek refuge with Allah from being in debt?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "A person in debt tells lies whenever he speaks, and breaks promises whenever he makes (them)." `Aisha also narrated: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in his prayer seeking refuge with Allah from the afflictions of Ad-Dajjal
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki biwi) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool namaz mein yeh dua kehte the: "Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min adhabil-qabr, wa a'udhu bika min fitnatil-Masihid-Dajjal, wa a'udhu bika min fitnatil-mahya wa fitnatil-mamat. Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-ma'thami wal-maghram" (Aye Allah! Main teri panah maangta hoon qabar ke azaab se, Masih Dajjal ke fitne se, zindagi aur maut ke fitne se. Aye Allah! Main teri panah maangta hoon gunahon aur qarz se). Kisi ne pucha: "Aap qarz se panah kyun itni baar maangte hain?" Nabi ne jawab diya: "Qarzdaar jab bhi baat karta hai, jhoot bolta hai, aur jab waada karta hai, todd deta hai." Ayesha ne yeh bhi bataya: "Maine Allah ke Rasool ko namaz mein Dajjal ke fitne se panah maangte suna."

e: Narrated Abu Bakr As-Siddiq:I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to teach me an invocation so that I may invoke Allah with it in my prayer. He told me to say, "Allahumma inni zalumtu nafsi zulman kathiran, Wala yaghfiru dh-dhunuba illa anta, fa ghfir li maghfiratan min `indika, wa r-hamni, innaka anta l-ghafuru r-rahim (O Allah! I have done great injustice to myself and none except You forgives sins, so bestow on me a forgiveness from You, and Have Mercy on me, You are the Forgiver, the Merciful)
hi: Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Maine Allah ke Rasool se ek dua sikhane ko kaha jo main namaz mein padh sakoon. Aap ne mujhe kehne ko kaha: 'Allahumma inni zalamtu nafsi zulman kathiran, wala yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa anta, faghfir li maghfiratan min indika, warhamni, innaka antal-ghafurur-rahim' (Aye Allah! Maine apni jaan par bahut zulm kiya hai, aur gunah teri siwa koi maaf nahi karta, isliye mujhe apni taraf se maafi de aur mujhpar reham kar, tu hi bakshne wala, reham karne wala hai)."

e: Narrated `Abdullah:When we prayed with the Prophet (ﷺ) we used to say, "Peace be on Allah from His slaves and peace be on so and so." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Don't say As-Salam be on Allah, for He Himself is As-Salam, but say, at-tahiyatu li l-lahi wa s-salawatu wa t-taiyibat. As-salamu `alaika aiyuha n-Nabiyu wa rahmatu l-lahi wa barakatuh. As-salamu `alaina wa `ala `ibadi l-lahi s-salihin. (If you say this then it will reach all the slaves in heaven or between heaven and earth). Ash-hadu al la-ilaha illa l-lah, wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan `Abduhu wa Rasuluh.' Then select the invocation you like best and recite it." (See Hadith No)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Jab hum Nabi ke saath namaz padhte, hum kehte: 'Salaam ho Allah par uske bandon ki taraf se, aur salaam ho falaan-falaan par.' Nabi ne farmaya: 'Allah par Salaam mat kaho, kyunke woh khud As-Salam hai, balki kaho: At-Tahiyyatu lillahi was-salawatu wat-taiyibat. As-salamu alaika aiyuhan-Nabiyyu wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh. Assalamu alaina wa ala ibadillahis-saaliheen. (Agar tum yeh kaho, yeh aasman ke har bande, ya aasman-zameen ke darmiyan har bande tak pahunchega.) Ash-hadu alla ilaha illallah, wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan Abduhu wa Rasuluh. Phir jo dua tumhe pasand ho chun kar padho.'"

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prostrating in mud and water and saw the mark of mud on his forehead
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Maine Allah ke Rasool ko kichad-paani mein sajda karte dekha, aur unke maathe par kichad ka nishaan dekha."

e: Narrated Um Salama:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) finished his prayers with Taslim, the women would get up and he would stay on for a while in his place before getting up. Ibn Shihab said, "I think (and Allah knows better), that the purpose of his stay was that the women might leave before the men who had finished their prayer
hi: Um Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke jab bhi Allah ke Rasool Taslim se namaz khatam karte, aurtein uthkar chali jaatin, aur Aap uthne se pehle thodi der apni jagah rehte. Ibn Shihab ne kaha: "Mera khayaal hai (Allah behtar jaanta hai) ke Aap isliye rukte the taake aurtein mardon se pehle nikal jaayein jinhone namaz khatam ki thi."

e: Narrated `Itban bin Malik:We prayed with the Prophet (ﷺ) and used to finish our prayer with the Taslim along with him
hi: Itban bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Hum Nabi ke saath namaz padhte the aur unke saath Taslim se namaz khatam karte."

e: Narrated Mahmud bin Ar-Rabi`:I remember Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and also the mouthful of water which he took from a bucket in our house and ejected (on me). I heard from `Itban bin Malik Al-Ansari, who was one from Bani Salim, saying, "I used to lead my tribe of Bani Salim in prayer. Once I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said to him, 'I have weak eyesight and at times the rainwater flood intervenes between me and the mosque of my tribe and I wish that you would come to my house and pray at some place so that I could take that place as a place for praying (mosque). He said, "Allah willing, I shall do that." Next day Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) along with Abu Bakr, came to my house after the sun had risen high and he asked permission to enter. I gave him permission, but he didn't sit till he said to me, "Where do you want me to pray in your house?" I pointed to a place in the house where I wanted him to pray. So he stood up for the prayer and we aligned behind him. He completed the prayer with Taslim and we did the same simultaneously
hi: Mahmud bin Ar-Rabi (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Mujhe Allah ke Rasool yaad hain, aur woh mun-bhar paani bhi jo unhone humare ghar ke ek dol se leke (mere chehre par) chhidka tha." Maine Itban bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ansari se, jo Bani Salim mein se the, suna, unhone kaha: "Main apni Bani Salim qaum ki imamat karta tha. Ek baar main Nabi ke paas gaya aur kaha: 'Meri nazar kamzor hai, aur kabhi baarish ka paani mere aur meri qaum ki masjid ke darmiyan bhar jaata hai. Mera dil chahta hai aap mere ghar aayein aur kisi jagah namaz padhein taake main use apna Musalla bana sakoon.' Aap ne farmaya: 'Insha Allah, main aisa karunga.' Agle din, Allah ke Rasool aur Abu Bakr, jab suraj kaafi onchaa ho chuka tha, mere ghar aaye aur andar aane ki ijazat maangi. Maine di, magar Aap baithe nahi jab tak mujhse pucha: 'Aap mere ghar mein kahan namaz padhwana chahenge?' Maine ghar mein ek jagah ishara ki jahan main chahta tha. To Aap namaz ke liye khade hue aur hum unke peechhe qatar mein khade hue. Aap ne Taslim se namaz khatam ki, humne bhi saath hi Taslim ki."

e: Narrated Abu Ma`bad:(the freed slave of Ibn `Abbas) Ibn `Abbas told me, "In the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) it was the custom to celebrate Allah's praises aloud after the compulsory congregational prayers." Ibn `Abbas further said, "When I heard the Dhikr, I would learn that the compulsory congregational prayer had ended
hi: Abu Ma'bad (Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke azaad kiye gulaam) bataate hain ke Ibn Abbas ne unhe bataya: "Nabi ke zamane mein farz jamaat namazon ke baad buland aawaaz se Allah ki hamd karna riwaaj tha." Ibn Abbas ne joda: "Jab main Zikr (yeh awaaz) sunta, mujhe pata chalta ke farz jamaat namaz khatam ho gayi."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I used to recognize the completion of the prayer of the Prophet (ﷺ) by hearing Takbir
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai: "Main Nabi ki namaz khatam hone ka pata Takbir ki awaaz se lagaya karta tha."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Some poor people came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "The wealthy people will get higher grades and will have permanent enjoyment and they pray like us and fast as we do. They have more money by which they perform the Hajj, and `Umra; fight and struggle in Allah's Cause and give in charity." The Prophet said, "Shall I not tell you a thing upon which if you acted you would catch up with those who have surpassed you? Nobody would overtake you and you would be better than the people amongst whom you live except those who would do the same. Say "Subhana l-lah", "Al hamdu li l-lah" and "Allahu Akbar" thirty three times each after every (compulsory) prayer." We differed and some of us said that we should say, "Subhan-al-lah" thirty three times and "Al hamdu li l-lah" thirty three times and "Allahu Akbar" thirty four times. I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) who said, "Say, "Subhan-al-lah" and "Al hamdu li l-lah" and "Allahu Akbar" all together [??], thirty three times
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke kuch gareeb log Nabi ke paas aaye aur kaha: "Ameer log oonche darje paayenge aur hamesha ki naimatein bhogenge, woh humari tarah namaz padhte hain aur humari tarah roze rakhte hain. Unke paas zyada maal hai jisse Hajj-Umrah karte hain, jung karte hain, aur sadqa dete hain." Nabi ne farmaya: "Kya main tumhe woh cheez na bataun jisse amal karke tum un logon se aage nikal jao jo tumse aage badh gaye hain, aur tumse aage koi na jaaye, aur tum apne aas-paas ke logon se behtar ho jao siwaye jo yehi karein? Har (farz) namaz ke baad 'Subhan Allah,' 'Alhamdulillah,' aur 'Allahu Akbar' teenttees-teenttees (33) baar kaho." Humein ikhtilaaf ho gaya, kisi ne kaha shayad 'Subhan Allah' 33, 'Alhamdulillah' 33, aur 'Allahu Akbar' chauntees (34) baar. Main Nabi ke paas gaya, unhone farmaya: "'Subhan Allah,' 'Alhamdulillah,' aur 'Allahu Akbar' sab milakar teenttees-teenttees baar kaho."

e: Narrated Warrad:(the clerk of Al-Mughira bin Shu`ba) Once Al-Mughira dictated to me in a letter addressed to Muawiya that the Prophet (ﷺ) used to say after every compulsory prayer, "La ilaha illa l-lahu wahdahu la sharika lahu, lahu l-mulku wa lahu l-hamdu, wa huwa `ala kulli shay'in qadir. Allahumma la mani`a lima a`taita, wa la mu`tiya lima mana`ta, wa la yanfa`u dhal-jaddi minka l-jadd. [There is no Deity but Allah, Alone, no Partner to Him. His is the Kingdom and all praise, and Omnipotent is He. O Allah! Nobody can hold back what you gave, nobody can give what You held back, and no struggler's effort can benefit against You]." And Al-Hasan said, "Al-jadd' means prosperity [??]
hi: Warrad (Al-Mughira bin Shu'ba (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke munshi) bataate hain: Ek baar Al-Mughira ne mujhe Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke naam ek khat mein likhwaya ke Nabi har farz namaz ke baad kehte the: "La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, wa huwa ala kulli shai'in Qadir. Allahumma la mani'a lima a'taita, wa la mu'tiya lima mana'ta, wa la yanfa'u dhal-jaddi minkal-jadd" (Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahi, akela, uska koi shareek nahi, uski hi hukumat aur tareef hai, aur woh har cheez par qaadir hai. Aye Allah! Jo tu de use koi rok nahi sakta, aur jo tu roke use koi de nahi sakta, aur kisi ki daulat [ya mehnat] tere saamne kaam nahi aati). Al-Hasan ne kaha: "'Al-jadd' ka matlab hai khushhaali/daulat."

e: Narrated Samura bin Jundub:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to face us on completion of the prayer
hi: Samura bin Jundub (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi namaz khatam karke humari taraf mun karte the.

e: Narrated Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani:The Prophet (ﷺ) led us in the Fajr prayer at Hudaibiya after a rainy night. On completion of the prayer, he faced the people and said, "Do you know what your Lord has said (revealed)?" The people replied, "Allah and His Apostle know better." He said, "Allah has said, 'In this morning some of my slaves remained as true believers and some became non-believers; whoever said that the rain was due to the Blessings and the Mercy of Allah had belief in Me and he disbelieves in the stars, and whoever said that it rained because of a particular star had no belief in Me but believes in that star
hi: Zaid bin Khalid (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Juhani (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne humari Fajr ki imamat Hudaibiya mein ek baarish-bhari raat ke baad ki. Namaz khatam karke, Aap logon ki taraf mud kar farmaya: "Kya tumhe pata hai tumhare Rab ne kya farmaya (nazil kiya)?" Logon ne kaha: "Allah aur uska Rasool behtar jaante hain." Aap ne farmaya: "Allah ne farmaya: 'Aaj subah mere kuch bande sacche momin rahe aur kuch kaafir ho gaye — jisne kaha ke baarish Allah ki rehmat aur karam se hui, woh mujh par iman laaya aur sitaron ka inkaar kiya; aur jisne kaha ke falaan sitare ki wajah se baarish hui, usne mujh par iman nahi laaya balki us sitare par iman laaya.'"

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) delayed the `Isha' prayer until midnight and then came to us. Having prayed he faced us and said, "The people had prayed and slept but you were in the prayer as long as you were waiting for it
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke ek baar Nabi ne Isha aadhi raat tak taal di, phir humare paas aaye. Namaz padhkar humari taraf mud kar farmaya: "Log namaz padh kar so gaye, magar tum jab tak intezar karte rahe, namaz mein hi the."

e: Narrated Nafi:Ibn Umar used to offer prayers (Nawafil) at the place where he had offered the compulsory prayer. Al-Qasim (bin Muhammad bin Abi Bakr) did the same. The narration coming from Abu Hurairah (from the Prophet (ﷺ)) forbidding the Imam from offering prayers (optional prayer) at the same place where he was offered the compulsory prayer is incorrect
hi: Nafi bataate hain ke Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) farz namaz padhne ki usi jagah nafil namaz bhi padhte the. Al-Qasim (bin Muhammad bin Abi Bakr) bhi aisa hi karte the. Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se (Nabi ke hawale se) yeh riwayat ki gayi hai ke Imam usi jagah nafil na padhe jahan usne farz padhi ho, magar yeh riwayat sahih nahi hai.

e: Narrated Um Salama:"The Prophet (ﷺ) after finishing the prayer with Taslim used to stay at his place for a while." Ibn Shihab said, "I think (and Allah knows better), that he used to wait for the departure of the women who had prayed." Ibn Shihab wrote that he had heard it from Hind bint Al-Harith Al-Firasiya from Um Salama, the wife of the Prophet (Hind was from the companions of Um Salama) who said, "When the Prophet (ﷺ) finished the prayer with Taslim, the women would depart and enter their houses before Allah's Apostle departed
hi: Um Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai: "Jab bhi Allah ke Rasool Taslim se namaz khatam karte, thodi der apni jagah rukte." Ibn Shihab ne kaha: "Mera khayaal hai (Allah behtar jaanta hai) ke Aap namaz padh chuki aurton ke jaane ka intezar karte the." Ibn Shihab ne likha ke unhone yeh Hind bint Al-Harith Al-Firasiya se suna, jo Um Salama (Nabi ki biwi) se riwayat karti hain, (Hind Um Salama ki sathiyon mein se thi): "Jab Nabi Taslim se namaz khatam karte, aurtein uthkar apne gharon mein chali jaatin ise se pehle ke Allah ke Rasool jaate."

e: Narrated `Uqba:I offered the `Asr prayer behind the Prophet (ﷺ) at Medina. When he had finished the prayer with Taslim, he got up hurriedly and went out by crossing the rows of the people to one of the dwellings of his wives. The people got scared at his speed . The Prophet (ﷺ) came back and found the people surprised at his haste and said to them, "I remembered a piece of gold Lying in my house and I did not like it to divert my attention from Allah's worship, so I have ordered it to be distributed (in charity)
hi: Uqba (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Maine Madina mein Nabi ke peechhe Asr padhi. Taslim se namaz khatam karke, Aap jaldi se uthe aur safon ko paar karte hue apni ek biwi ke ghar chale gaye. Log Aap ki jaldi se dar gaye. Nabi wapas aaye aur logon ko hairaan dekh kar farmaya: 'Mujhe yaad aaya ke ghar mein sone ka ek tukda pada hai, mujhe pasand nahi tha ke woh mera dhyan Allah ki ibadat se hataye, isliye maine hukum diya ke use (sadqa mein) taqseem kar diya jaaye.'"

e: Narrated `Abdullah:You should not give away a part of your prayer to Satan by thinking that it is necessary to depart (after finishing the prayer) from one's right side only; I have seen the Prophet (ﷺ) often leave from the left side
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai: "Apni namaz ka koi hissa shaitan ko na do yeh sochkar ke namaz khatam karke sirf dahini taraf se hi jaana zaroori hai. Maine Nabi ko aksar baayi taraf se jaate dekha hai."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:During the holy battle of Khaibar the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever ate from this plant (i.e. garlic) should not enter our mosque
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke Khaibar ki jung ke waqt Nabi ne farmaya: "Jo bhi is paudhe (lehsun) se khaaye, woh humari masjid mein na aaye."

e: Narrated `Ata':I heard Jabir bin `Abdullah saying, "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Whoever eats (from) this plant (he meant garlic) should keep away from our mosque." I said, "What does he mean by that?" He replied, "I think he means only raw garlic
hi: Ata bataate hain: "Maine Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko kehte suna: 'Nabi ne farmaya: Jo bhi yeh paudha (unka matlab lehsun tha) khaaye, woh humari masjid se door rahe.'" Maine pucha: "Iska matlab kya hai?" Unhone jawab diya: "Mujhe lagta hai unka matlab sirf kaccha lehsun tha."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever eats garlic or onion should keep away from our mosque or should remain in his house." (Jabir bin `Abdullah, in another narration said, "Once a big pot containing cooked vegetables was brought. On finding unpleasant smell coming from it, the Prophet (ﷺ) asked, 'What is in it?' He was told all the names of the vegetables that were in it. The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered that it should be brought near to some of his companions who were with him. When the Prophet (ﷺ) saw it he disliked to eat it and said, 'Eat. (I don't eat) for I converse with those whom you don't converse with (i.e. the angels)
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Jo bhi lehsun ya pyaaz khaaye, woh humari masjid se door rahe ya apne ghar mein hi rahe." (Jabir bin Abdullah, ne ek doosri riwayat mein bataya: "Ek baar pakayi hui sabziyon se bhara bada bartan laaya gaya. Nabi ko usse aane wali napasandeeda badbu ka pata chala, poocha: 'Ismein kya hai?' Unhe usme shamil sab sabziyon ke naam bataye gaye. Nabi ne hukum diya ke woh apne kuch sahaba ke qareeb le jaya jaaye jo unke saath the. Jab Nabi ne dekha, khud khaana napasand kiya aur kaha: 'Khao. (Main nahi khaunga) kyunke main un se baat karta hoon jinse tum baat nahi karte (yaani farishton se).'")

e: Narrated `Abdul `Aziz:A man asked Anas, "What did you hear from the Prophet (ﷺ) about garlic?" He said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Whoever has eaten this plant should neither come near us nor pray with us
hi: Abdul Aziz bataate hain: "Ek shaks ne Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha: 'Aapne Nabi se lehsun ke baare mein kya suna?' Unhone kaha: 'Nabi ne farmaya: Jo yeh paudha khaaye, woh na humare qareeb aaye na humare saath namaz padhe.'"

e: Narrated Sulaiman Ash-Shaibani:I heard Ash-Shu`bi saying, "A person who was accompanying the Prophet (ﷺ) passed by a grave that was separated from the other graves told me that the Prophet (ﷺ) once led the people in the (funeral) prayer and the people had aligned behind him. I said, "O Aba `Amr! Who told you about it?" He said, "Ibn `Abbas
hi: Sulaiman Ash-Shaibani bataate hain: "Maine Ash-Shu'bi ko kehte suna: 'Nabi ke saath rehne wale ek shaks ne, jo ek qabar se guzra jo doosri qabron se alag thi, mujhe bataya ke ek baar Nabi ne (janaze ki) namaz ki imamat ki aur log unke peechhe safon mein khade hue.' Maine pucha: 'Aye Aba Amr! Aapko yeh kisne bataya?' Unhone kaha: 'Ibn Abbas.'"

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Ghusl (taking a bath) on Friday is compulsory for every Muslim reaching the age of puberty
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Jumme ke din har baaligh Musalman ke liye ghusl karna zaroori hai."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:One night I slept at the house of my aunt Maimuna and the Prophet (ﷺ) slept (too). He got up (for prayer) in the last hours of the night and performed a light ablution from a hanging leather skin. (`Amr, the sub-narrator described that the ablution was very light). Then he stood up for prayer and I got up too and performed the ablution in the same way and joined him on his left side. He pulled me to the right and prayed as much as Allah will. Then he lay down and slept and I heard his breath sounds till the Mu'adh-dhin came to him to inform him about the (Fajr) prayer. He left with him for the prayer and prayed without repeating the ablution. (Sufyan the sub-narrator said: We said to `Amr, "Some people say, 'The eyes of the Prophet (ﷺ) sleep but his heart never sleeps.' " `Amr said, "'Ubai bin `Umar said, 'The dreams of the Prophets are Divine Inspirations. Then he recited, '(O my son), I have seen in dream that I was slaughtering you (offering you in sacrifice)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: "Ek raat main apni khala Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke ghar soya, Nabi bhi so gaye.
