Aap raat ke aakhri hisse mein uthe aur latakti hui mashkiza se halka wudu kiya. (Amr ne bataya ke wudu bahut halka tha.) Phir Aap namaz ke liye khade hue, main bhi utha aur isi tarah wudu karke unki baayi taraf jaakar khada hua. Aap ne mujhe dahini taraf khinch liya aur jitna Allah ne chaha namaz padhi. Phir let kar so gaye yahan tak ke main unki khurraati sunta raha, phir Muazzin aaye aur namaz ke baare mein bataya. Aap unke saath namaz ke liye gaye, bina wudu dohraye." (Sufyan raawi ne kaha: humne Amr se pucha: "Kuch log kehte hain ke Nabi ki aankhein sotin thi magar dil nahi sota tha." Amr ne kaha: "Ubai bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: Nabiyon ke khwab wahi hote hain." Phir unhone tilawat ki: "(Aye mere bete), maine khwab mein dekha ke main tumhe zabah kar raha hoon (qurbani mein pesh kar raha hoon).")

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:My grandmother Mulaika invited Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for a meal which she had prepared specially for him. He ate some of it and said, "Get up. I shall lead you in the prayer." I brought a mat that had become black owing to excessive use and I sprinkled water on it. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood on it and prayed two rak`at; and the orphan was with me (in the first row), and the old lady stood behind us
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai: "Meri dadi Mulaika ne Allah ke Rasool ko khaas taur par unke liye taiyaar kiya hua khana khaane bulaya. Aap ne kuch khaya aur farmaya: 'Utho, main tumhari imamat karunga.' Main ek chatai laaya jo istemal se kaali ho chuki thi aur usme paani chhidka. Allah ke Rasool uspar khade hue aur do rakat padhi; yateem mere saath (pehli saf mein) tha, aur budhi aurat humare peechhe khadi thi."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Once I came riding a she-ass and I, then, had just attained the age of puberty. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was leading the people in prayer at Mina facing no wall. I passed in front of the row and let loose the sheass for grazing and joined the row and no one objected to my deed
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: "Ek baar main gadhi par sawar hokar aaya, tab main balig hone ke qareeb tha. Allah ke Rasool Mina mein namaz padha rahe the, koi deewar unke saamne nahi thi. Main safon ke saamne se guzra, gadhi ko charne ke liye chhod diya aur khud saf mein shamil ho gaya, kisi ne aitraaz nahi kiya."

e: Narrated `Aisha:Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) delayed the `Isha' prayer till `Umar informed him that the women and children had slept. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came out and said: "None from amongst the dwellers of earth have prayed this prayer except you." In those days none but the people of Medina prayed
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke ek baar Allah ke Rasool ne Isha itni taal di ke Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne unhe bataya ke aurtein aur bachche so gaye hain. Phir Allah ke Rasool bahar aaye aur farmaya: "Zameen par tumhare siwa kisi ne yeh namaz nahi padhi." Us zamane mein Madina walon ke siwa aur kahin yeh namaz nahi padhi jaati thi.

e: Narrated `Abdur Rahman bin `Abis:A person asked Ibn `Abbas, "Have you ever presented yourself at the (`Id) prayer with Allah's Apostle?" He replied, "Yes." And had it not been for my kinship (position) with the Prophet (ﷺ) it would not have been possible for me to do so (for he was too young). The Prophet (ﷺ) went to the mark near the house of Kathir bin As-Salt and delivered a sermon. He then went towards the women. He advised and reminded them and asked them to give alms. So the woman would bring her hand near her neck and take off her necklace and put it in the garment of Bilal. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) and Bilal came to the house
hi: Abdur Rahman bin Abis bataate hain ke ek shaks ne Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha: "Kya aap kabhi Eid ki namaz mein Allah ke Rasool ke saath hazir hue?" Unhone kaha: "Haan, aur agar mera Nabi se rishta na hota to yeh mumkin na hota (kyunke woh bahut chote the)." Nabi Kathir bin As-Salt ke ghar ke qareeb nishaan tak gaye aur khutba diya. Phir woh aurton ki taraf gaye, unhe naseehat ki aur sadqa dene ko kaha. Aurtein apna haath gardan tak leke jaatin aur apna haar utaar kar Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke kapde mein daaltin. Phir Nabi aur Bilal ghar wapas gaye.

e: Narrated `Aisha:Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) delayed the `Isha' prayer till `Umar informed him that the women and children had slept. The Prophet (ﷺ) came out and said, "None except you from amongst the dwellers of earth is waiting for this prayer." In those days, there was no prayer except in Medina and they used to pray the `Isha' prayer between the disappearance of the twilight and the first third of the night
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke ek baar Allah ke Rasool ne Isha itni taal di ke Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne unhe bataya ke aurtein aur bachche so gaye hain. Nabi bahar aaye aur farmaya: "Zameen par tumhare siwa kisi ne yeh namaz ka intezar nahi kiya." Us zamane mein sirf Madina mein yeh namaz padhi jaati thi, aur woh Isha shafaq khatam hone se raat ke pehle tihai ke darmiyan padhte the.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If your women ask permission to go to the mosque at night, allow them
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Agar tumhari aurtein raat ko masjid jaane ki ijazat maangein, unhe ijazat do."

e: Narrated Um Salama:(the wife of the Prophet) In the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) the women used to get up when they finished their compulsory prayers with Taslim. The Prophet (ﷺ) and the men would stay on at their places as long as Allah will. When the Prophet (ﷺ) got up, the men would then get up
hi: Um Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki biwi) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ke zamane mein, aurtein Taslim se farz namaz khatam karte hi uth jaati thin. Nabi aur mard apni jagah tab tak rukte jab tak Allah chahta. Jab Nabi uthte, mard bhi uthte.

e: Narrated `Aisha:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) finished the Fajr prayer, the women would leave covered in their sheets and were not recognized owing to the darkness
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke jab Allah ke Rasool Fajr ki namaz khatam karte, aurtein apni chadaron mein lipat kar chali jaatin, andhere ki wajah se koi unhe pehchaan nahi paata.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abi Qatada Al-Ansari:My father said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whenever I stand for prayer, I want to prolong it but on hearing the cries of a child, I would shorten it as I dislike to put its mother in trouble
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Qatada Al-Ansari bataate hain, apne waalid ke hawale se: "Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: 'Jab main namaz ke liye khada hota hoon, use lamba karna chahta hoon, magar kisi bacche ke rone ki awaaz sunkar main use chhota kar deta hoon, kyunke mujhe uski maa ko museebat mein daalna napasand hai.'"

e: Narrated `Aisha:Had Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) known what the women were doing, he would have forbidden them from going to the mosque as the women of Bani Israel had been forbidden. Yahya bin Sa`id (a sub-narrator) asked `Amra (another sub-narrator), "Were the women of Bani Israel forbidden?" She replied "Yes
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai: "Agar Allah ke Rasool ko pata hota ke aurtein (baad mein) kya karengi, to Aap unhe masjid jaane se mana karte, jaise Bani Israel ki aurton ko mana kiya gaya tha." Yahya bin Saeed ne Amra se pucha: "Kya Bani Israel ki aurton ko mana kiya gaya tha?" Unhone kaha: "Haan."

e: Narrated Um Salama:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) completed the prayer with Taslim, the women used to get up immediately and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) would remain at his place for some time before getting up. (The sub-narrator (Az-Zuhri) said, "We think, and Allah knows better, that he did so, so that the women might leave before men could get in touch with them
hi: Um Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai: "Jab bhi Allah ke Rasool Taslim se namaz khatam karte, aurtein foran uth jaatin, aur Allah ke Rasool thodi der rukte uthne se pehle." (Az-Zuhri ne kaha: "Mera khayaal hai, Allah behtar jaanta hai, ke Aap isliye aisa karte the taake aurtein mardon se milne se pehle chali jaayein.")

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) prayed in the house of Um Sulaim; and I, along with an orphan stood behind him while Um Sulaim (stood) behind us
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne Um Sulaim ke ghar mein namaz padhi; main aur ek yateem unke peechhe khade hue, aur Um Sulaim humare peechhe khadi thi.

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to offer the Fajr prayer when it was still dark and the believing women used to return (after finishing their prayer) and nobody could recognize them owing to darkness, or they could not recognize one another
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool Fajr ki namaz andhere mein padhte the aur momin aurtein namaz ke baad wapas jaatin, andhere ki wajah se koi unhe pehchaan nahi paata, ya woh ek-doosre ko bhi nahi pehchaan patin.

e: Narrated Salim bin `Abdullah:My father said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'If the wife of any one of you asks permission (to go to the mosque) do not forbid her
hi: Salim bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain, apne waalid ke hawale se: "Nabi ne farmaya: 'Agar tum mein se kisi ki biwi (masjid jaane ki) ijazat maange, use mana mat karo.'"

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) prayed in the house of Um Sulaim; and I, along with an orphan stood behind him while Um Sulaim (stood) behind us
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne Um Sulaim ke ghar mein namaz padhi; main aur ek yateem unke peechhe khade hue, aur Um Sulaim humare peechhe khadi thi.

e: Narrated Umm Salama:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) completed the Salat with Taslim, the women used to get up immediately and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) would remain at his place for sometime before getting up. The sub-narrator (Az-Zuhri) said, "We think, and Allah knows better, that he did so, so that the women might leave before the men could catch up with them
hi: Um Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwayat hai: "Jab bhi Allah ke Rasool Namaz Taslim se khatam karte, aurtein foran uth jaatin, aur Allah ke Rasool thodi der rukte uthne se pehle." (Az-Zuhri ne kaha: "Mera khayaal hai, Allah behtar jaanta hai, ke Aap isliye karte the taake aurtein mardon se milne se pehle chali jaayein.")

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "We (Muslims) are the last (to come) but (will be) the foremost on the Day of Resurrection though the former nations were given the Holy Scriptures before us. And this was their day (Friday) the celebration of which was made compulsory for them but they differed about it. So Allah gave us the guidance for it (Friday) and all the other people are behind us in this respect: the Jews' (holy day is) tomorrow (i.e. Saturday) and the Christians' (is) the day after tomorrow (i.e. Sunday)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Maine Allah ke Rasool ko farmate suna: 'Hum (Musalman) sabse baad mein aaye magar Qiyamat ke din sabse aage honge, jabke pichhli ummaton ko humse pehle kitaabein di gayi thin. Aur yeh (Jumma) unka din tha, jiska mannana unpar farz kiya gaya tha magar unhone usme ikhtilaaf kar diya. To Allah ne humein iske liye hidayat di, aur baaki sab log is maamle mein humse peechhe hain — Yahudiyon ka (din) kal (yaani Saturday) hai aur Isaiyon ka parson (yaani Sunday).'"

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Anyone of you attending the Friday (prayers) should take a bath
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jo bhi Jumme (ki namaz) mein hazir ho, ghusl kare."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:While `Umar bin Al-Khattab was standing and delivering the sermon on a Friday, one of the companions of the Prophet, who was one of the foremost Muhajirs (emigrants) came. `Umar said to him, "What is the time now?" He replied, "I was busy and could not go back to my house till I heard the Adhan. I did not perform more than the ablution." Thereupon `Umar said to him, "Did you perform only the ablution although you know that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to order us to take a bath (on Fridays)?
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain ke ek Jumme ke din, jab Umar bin Khattab (رضی اللہ عنہ) khade hokar khutba de rahe the, Nabi ke sahaba mein se ek shaks, jo pehle Muhajireen mein se the, aaye. Umar ne unse kaha: "Ab kya waqt hai?" Unhone jawab diya: "Main kaam mein mashghool tha aur ghar wapas nahi ja saka jab tak Adhan nahi suni, isliye maine sirf wudu kiya." Yeh sunkar Umar ne kaha: "Sirf wudu kiya, jabke tumhe pata hai Allah ke Rasool humein ghusl (Jumme ke din) karne ka hukum dete the?"

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The taking of a bath on Friday is compulsory for every male (Muslim) who has attained the age of puberty
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jumme ke din ghusl karna har baaligh Musalman mard ke liye zaroori hai."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id:I testify that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The taking of a bath on Friday is compulsory for every male Muslim who has attained the age of puberty and (also) the cleaning of his teeth with Siwak, and the using of perfume if it is available." `Amr (a sub-narrator) said, "I confirm that the taking of a bath is compulsory, but as for the Siwak and the using of perfume, Allah knows better whether it is obligatory or not, but according to the Hadith it is as above
hi: Abu Saeed (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Main gawahi deta hoon ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: 'Jumme ke din ghusl karna har baaligh Musalman mard ke liye zaroori hai, aur Siwak se daant saaf karna, aur agar khushbu mile to lagana.'" Amr (raawi) ne kaha: "Main ghusl ke zaroori hone ki tasdeeq karta hoon, magar Siwak aur khushbu ke baare mein Allah behtar jaanta hai kya woh farz hai ya nahi, magar hadith ke mutabiq yeh upar bataye tareeke se hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Any person who takes a bath on Friday like the bath of Janaba and then goes for the prayer (in the first hour i.e. early), it is as if he had sacrificed a camel (in Allah's cause); and whoever goes in the second hour it is as if he had sacrificed a cow; and whoever goes in the third hour, then it is as if he had sacrificed a horned ram; and if one goes in the fourth hour, then it is as if he had sacrificed a hen; and whoever goes in the fifth hour then it is as if he had offered an egg. When the Imam comes out (i.e. starts delivering the Khutba), the angels present themselves to listen to the Khutba
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jo Jumme ke din Janaba jaisa ghusl kare aur (namaz ke liye) pehle ghante mein jaaye, goya usne (Allah ki raah mein) ek oont qurbani ki. Jo doosre ghante mein jaaye, goya usne gaay qurbani ki. Jo teesre ghante mein jaaye, goya usne singon wala mengha qurbani ki. Jo chauthe ghante mein jaaye, goya usne murgi qurbani ki. Aur jo paanchve ghante mein jaaye, goya usne anda pesh kiya. Jab Imam bahar aata hai (khutba dena shuru karta hai), farishte khutba sunne aane lagte hain."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:While `Umar (bin Al-Khattab) was delivering the Khutba on a Friday, a man entered (the mosque). `Umar asked him, "What has detained you from the prayer?" The man said, "It was only that when I heard the Adhan I performed ablution (for the prayer)." On that `Umar said, "Did you not hear the Prophet saying: 'Anyone of you going out for the Jumua prayer should take a bath'?
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke jab Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Khattab (رضی اللہ عنہ) ek Jumme ko khutba de rahe the, ek shaks (masjid mein) daakhil hua. Umar ne pucha: "Kis cheez ne tumhe namaz se roka?" Shaks ne kaha: "Sirf itna, ke jab maine Adhan suni, wudu kiya (namaz ke liye)." Yeh sunkar Umar ne kaha: "Kya tumne Nabi ko yeh farmate nahi suna: 'Jo bhi tum mein se Jumme ki namaz ke liye nikle, ghusl kare'?"

e: Narrated Salman-Al-Farsi:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever takes a bath on Friday, purifies himself as much as he can, then uses his (hair) oil or perfumes himself with the scent of his house, then proceeds (for the Jumua prayer) and does not separate two persons sitting together (in the mosque), then prays as much as (Allah has) written for him and then remains silent while the Imam is delivering the Khutba, his sins in-between the present and the last Friday would be forgiven
hi: Salman (رضی اللہ عنہ)-Al-Farsi (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Jo Jumme ke din ghusl kare, jitna mumkin ho khud ko paak kare, phir apna tel lagaye ya apne ghar ki khushbu lagaye, phir (Jumme ki namaz ke liye) nikle aur do baithe hue logon ke darmiyan (ghus kar) unhe alag na kare, phir jitni Allah ne likhi hai namaz padhe, aur Imam ke khutba dete waqt khamosh rahe, uske gunah is Jumme aur pichhle Jumme ke darmiyan maaf kar diye jaate hain."

e: Narrated Tawus:I said to Ibn `Abbas, "The people are narrating that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Take a bath on Friday and wash your heads (i.e. take a thorough bath) even though you were not Junub and use perfume'." On that Ibn `Abbas replied, "I know about the bath, (i.e. it is essential) but I do not know about the perfume (i.e. whether it is essential or not)
hi: Tawus bataate hain: "Maine Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kaha: 'Log yeh riwayat kar rahe hain ke Nabi ne farmaya: Jumme ke din ghusl karo aur apna sar (achhi tarah) dhoo lo, chahe Junub na ho, aur khushbu lagao.'" Ibn Abbas ne jawab diya: "Mujhe ghusl ke baare mein pata hai (ke yeh zaroori hai), magar khushbu ke baare mein mujhe nahi pata (kya yeh zaroori hai ya nahi)."

e: Narrated Tawus:Ibn `Abbas mentioned the statement of the Prophet (ﷺ) regarding the taking of a bath on Friday and then I asked him whether the Prophet (ﷺ) had ordered perfume or (hair) oil to be used if they could be found in one's house. He (Ibn `Abbas) replied that he did not know about it
hi: Tawus bataate hain: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Nabi ke Jumme ke ghusl ke hukum ka zikar kiya, phir maine unse pucha kya Nabi ne khushbu ya tel lagane ka hukum diya tha agar ghar mein mile. Unhone (Ibn Abbas ne) jawab diya ke unhe iske baare mein pata nahi.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:`Umar bin Al-Khattab saw a silken cloak (being sold) at the gate of the Mosque and said to Allah's Apostle, "I wish you would buy this to wear on Fridays and also on occasions of the arrivals of the delegations." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, "This will be worn by a person who will have no share (reward) in the Hereafter." Later on similar cloaks were given to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he gave one of them to `Umar bin Al-Khattab. On that `Umar said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! You have given me this cloak although on the cloak of Atarid (a cloak merchant who was selling that silken cloak at the gate of the mosque) you passed such and such a remark." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, "I have not given you this to wear". And so `Umar bin Al-Khattab gave it to his pagan brother in Mecca to wear
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain ke Umar bin Khattab (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne masjid ke darwaze par ek resham ka chogha (bikte huye) dekha aur Allah ke Rasool se kaha: "Kaash aap ise khareed lein, Jumme ke din aur wafdon ke aane ke mauqon par pehnne ke liye." Allah ke Rasool ne jawab diya: "Ise woh shaks pehnega jiska Aakhirat mein koi hissa nahi hoga." Baad mein Allah ke Rasool ko isi tarah ke chogha tohfe mein mile, unhone ek Umar bin Khattab ko diya. Umar ne kaha: "Ya Rasoolallah! Aapne mujhe yeh chogha diya jabke Atarid (ek chogha bechne wala jo yehi resham chogha masjid ke darwaze par bech raha tha) ke chogha ke baare mein aapne aisi baat kahi thi." Allah ke Rasool ne jawab diya: "Maine yeh tumhe pehnne ke liye nahi diya." To Umar bin Khattab ne ise Mecca mein apne mushrik bhai ko pehnne ke liye de diya.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If I had not found it hard for my followers or the people, I would have ordered them to clean their teeth with Siwak for every prayer
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Agar mujhe apni ummat ya logon ke liye mushkil na hoti, to main unhe har namaz ke liye Siwak se daant saaf karne ka hukum deta."

e: Narrated Anas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I have told you repeatedly to use the Siwak. (The Prophet (ﷺ) put emphasis on the use of the Siwak
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Maine tumhe baar-baar Siwak istemal karne ko kaha hai." (Nabi ne Siwak ke istemal par bahut zor diya.)

e: Narrated Hudhaifa:When the Prophet (ﷺ) got up at night (for the night prayer), he used to clean his mouth
hi: Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke jab Nabi raat ko (namaz ke liye) uthte, apna mun saaf karte the (Siwak se).

e: Narrated `Aisha:`Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Bakr came holding a Siwak with which he was cleaning his teeth. Allah's Apostle looked at him. I requested `Abdur-Rahman to give the Siwak to me and after he gave it to me I divided it, chewed it and gave it to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Then he cleaned his teeth with it and (at that time) he was resting against my chest
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: "Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Bakr ek Siwak leke aaye jisse woh apne daant saaf kar rahe the. Allah ke Rasool ne unki taraf dekha. Maine Abdur-Rahman se Siwak mujhe dene ko kaha, unhone diya to maine use (nishaan) taqseem kiya, chaba kar naram kiya aur Allah ke Rasool ko diya. Phir unhone usse daant saaf kiye (us waqt) Aap mere seene se tek lagaye hue the."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to recite the following in the Fajr prayer of Friday, "Alif, Lam, Mim, Tanzil" (Suratas- Sajda #32) and "Hal-ata-ala-l-Insani" (i.e. Surah-Ad-Dahr)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Nabi Jumme ki Fajr namaz mein "Alif, Lam, Mim, Tanzil" (Surah As-Sajda #32) aur "Hal-ata-ala-l-Insani" (yaani Surah Ad-Dahr) padhte the.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The first Jumua prayer which was offered after a Jumua prayer offered at the mosque of Allah's Apostle took place in the mosque of the tribe of `Abdul Qais at Jawathi in Bahrain
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain ke Allah ke Rasool ki masjid mein padhi gayi Jumme ki namaz ke baad sabse pehli Jumme ki namaz Bahrain ke Jawathi mein Abdul Qais qabile ki masjid mein padhi gayi.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "All of you are Guardians." Yunus said: Ruzaiq bin Hukaim wrote to Ibn Shihab while I was with him at Wadi-al-Qura saying, "Shall I lead the Jumua prayer?" Ruzaiq was working on the land (i.e. farming) and there was a group of Sudanese people and some others with him; Ruzaiq was then the Governor of Aila. Ibn Shihab wrote (to Ruzaiq) ordering him to lead the Jumua prayer and telling him that Salim told him that `Abdullah bin `Umar had said, "I heard Allah's Apostle saying, 'All of you are guardians and responsible for your wards and the things under your care. The Imam (i.e. ruler) is the guardian of his subjects and is responsible for them and a man is the guardian of his family and is responsible for them. A woman is the guardian of her husband's house and is responsible for it. A servant is the guardian of his master's belongings and is responsible for them.' I thought that he also said, 'A man is the guardian of his father's property and is responsible for it. All of you are guardians and responsible for your wards and the things under your care
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: "Maine Allah ke Rasool ko farmate suna: 'Tum sab nigraan (zimmedar) ho.'" Yunus ne kaha: Ruzaiq bin Hukaim ne Ibn Shihab ko likha jabke main unke saath Wadi-al-Qura mein tha, poocha: "Kya main Jumme ki imamat karoon?" Ruzaiq zameen par kaam (kheti) kar rahe the, aur unke saath kuch Sudani log aur doosre bhi the; Ruzaiq us waqt Aila ke gawarnar the. Ibn Shihab ne (Ruzaiq ko) Jumme ki imamat karne ka hukum diya aur bataya ke Salim ne unse bataya ke Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool ko farmate suna: 'Tum sab nigraan ho aur apne zimme mein aane wali cheezon ke zimmedar ho. Imam (yaani hukmaran) apni raiyat ka nigraan hai aur unka zimmedar hai. Mard apne ghar walon ka nigraan hai aur unka zimmedar hai. Aurat apne shohar ke ghar ki nigraan hai aur uski zimmedar hai. Naukar apne aaqa ke maal ka nigraan hai aur uska zimmedar hai.' Mujhe lagta hai unhone yeh bhi kaha: 'Mard apne baap ki maal ka nigraan hai aur uska zimmedar hai. Tum sab nigraan ho aur apne zimme mein aane wali cheezon ke zimmedar ho.'"

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "Anyone of you coming for the Jumua prayer should take a bath
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: "Maine Allah ke Rasool ko farmate suna: 'Jo bhi tum mein se Jumme ki namaz ke liye aaye, ghusl kare.'"

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The taking of a bath on Friday is compulsory for every Muslim who has attained the age of puberty
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jumme ke din ghusl karna har baaligh Musalman ke liye zaroori hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said "We are the last (to come amongst the nations) but (will be) the foremost on the Day of Resurrection. They were given the Holy Scripture before us and we were given the Quran after them. And this was the day (Friday) about which they differed and Allah gave us the guidance (for that). So tomorrow (i.e. Saturday) is the Jews' (day), and the day after tomorrow (i.e. Sunday) is the Christians'." The Prophet (ﷺ) remained silent (for a while) and then said, "It is obligatory for every Muslim that he should take a bath once in seven days, when he should wash his head and body
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Hum (qaumon mein) sabse baad mein aaye magar Qiyamat ke din sabse aage honge. Unhe humse pehle Kitaab (Aasmaani Kitaabein) di gayi aur humein unke baad Quran diya gaya. Aur yeh (Jumme ka) din tha jiske baare mein unhone ikhtilaaf kiya, aur Allah ne humein iski hidayat di. Isliye kal (Saturday) Yahudiyon ka din hai, aur parson (Sunday) Isaiyon ka." Nabi (thodi der) khamosh rahe, phir farmaya: "Har Musalman par zaroori hai ke woh saat dinon mein ek baar ghusl kare, jisme woh apna sar aur badan dhoye."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira through different narrators that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It is Allah's right on every Muslim that he should take a bath (at least) once in seven days
hi: Alag-alag raawiyon ke zariye Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwayat hai ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Yeh Allah ka haqq hai har Musalman par ke woh saat dinon mein ek baar ghusl kare."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allow women to go to the Mosques at night
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Aurton ko raat ko masjidon mein jaane ki ijazat do."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:One of the wives of `Umar (bin Al-Khattab) used to offer the Fajr and the `Isha' prayer in congregation in the Mosque. She was asked why she had come out for the prayer as she knew that `Umar disliked it, and he has great ghaira (self-respect). She replied, "What prevents him from stopping me from this act?" The other replied, "The statement of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) : 'Do not stop Allah's women-slaves from going to Allah's Mosques' prevents him
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain ke Umar bin Khattab (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki ek biwi jamaat ke saath masjid mein Fajr aur Isha padhti thi. Unse pucha gaya kyun woh namaz ke liye bahar aati hain jabke unhe pata hai Umar ise napasand karte hain, aur unme bahut ghairat hai. Unhone jawab diya: "Unhe mujhe iss se rokne se kya cheez rokti hai?" Doosre ne jawab diya: "Allah ke Rasool ka farmaan: 'Allah ki bandiyon ko Allah ki masjidon mein jaane se mat roko' unhe rokta hai."

e: Narrated Muhammad bin Seereen:On a rainy day Ibn `Abbas said to his Mu'adh-dhin, "After saying, 'Ash-hadu anna Muhammadan Rasulullah' (I testify that Muhammad is Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)), do not say 'Haiya 'Alas-Salat' (come for the prayer) but say 'Pray in your houses'." (The man did so). But the people disliked it. Ibn `Abbas said, "It was done by one who was much better than I (i.e. the Prophet (ﷺ) ). No doubt, the Jumua prayer is compulsory but I dislike to put you to task by bringing you out walking in mud and slush
hi: Muhammad bin Seereen bataate hain ke ek baarish-bhare din Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne apne Muazzin se kaha: "'Ash-hadu anna Muhammadan Rasulullah' kehne ke baad, 'Haiya 'Alas-Salat' (namaz ke liye aao) mat kaho, balki kaho 'Apne gharon mein namaz padho'." (Shaks ne aisa hi kiya.) Magar logon ko yeh napasand aaya. Ibn Abbas ne kaha: "Yeh usne kiya jo mujhse kahin behtar the (yaani Nabi). Beshak Jumme ki namaz zaroori hai magar mujhe napasand hai ke main tumhe kichad-mitti mein chalne ki takleef doon."

e: Narrated Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) The people used to come from their abodes and from Al-`Awali (i.e. outskirts of Medina up to a distance of four miles or more from Medina). They used to pass through dust and used to be drenched with sweat and covered with dust; so sweat used to trickle from them. One of them came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who was in my house. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "I wish that you keep yourself clean on this day of yours (i.e. take a bath)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki biwi) bataati hain: Log apne gharon aur Al-Awali (Madina ke bahar ke ilaaqe, char mil ya usse zyada door) se aate the. Woh dhool mein se guzarte aur paseene mein bhig jaate; unse paseena tapakta. Unme se ek Allah ke Rasool ke paas aaya jo mere ghar mein the. Nabi ne unse farmaya: "Kaash tum apne is din (Jumme ke din) khud ko saaf-suthra rakho (yaani ghusl karo)."

e: Narrated Yahya bin Sa`id:I asked `Amra about taking a bath on Fridays. She replied, " Aisha said, 'The people used to work (for their livelihood) and whenever they went for the Jumua prayer, they used to go to the mosque in the same shape as they had been in work. So they were asked to take a bath on Friday
hi: Yahya bin Saeed bataate hain: "Maine Amra se Jumme ke din ghusl karne ke baare mein pucha. Unhone jawab diya: 'Ayesha ne kaha: Log kaam karte the (rozi kamane ke liye), aur jab woh Jumme ki namaz ke liye jaate, usi haalat mein masjid jaate jisme woh kaam kar rahe hote. Isliye unhe Jumme ke din ghusl karne ko kaha gaya.'"

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to offer the Jumua prayer immediately after midday
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Nabi dopahar hote hi Jumme ki namaz padhte the.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:We used to offer the Jumua prayer early and then have an afternoon nap
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke hum Jumme ki namaz jaldi padhte aur phir dopahar ki neend lete.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to offer the prayer earlier if it was very cold; and if it was very hot he used to delay the prayer, i.e. the Jumua prayer
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Nabi sakht garmi mein Jumme ki namaz taal dete, aur sakht sardi mein jaldi padhte.

e: Narrated Abu `Abs:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Anyone whose feet are covered with dust in Allah's cause, shall be saved by Allah from the Hell-Fire
hi: Abu Abs (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Maine Nabi ko farmate suna: 'Jiske paon Allah ki raah mein dhool se atay huye hon, Allah use Dozakh ki aag se bacha lega.'"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "If the prayer is started do not run for it but just walk for it calmly and pray whatever you get, and complete whatever is missed
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Maine Allah ke Rasool ko farmate suna: 'Agar namaz shuru ho chuki ho to uski taraf daud kar mat jao, balki sukoon se chalo aur jo (rakatein) mil jayein padho, aur jo chhoot gayi hain unhe poori karo.'"

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abi Qatada on the authority of his father:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not stand up (for prayer) unless you see me, and observe calmness and solemnity
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Qatada, apne waalid ke hawale se: Nabi ne farmaya: "(Namaz ke liye) tab tak khade mat ho jab tak mujhe (apne saamne) na dekh lo, aur sukoon aur waqar se raho."

e: Narrated Salman Al-Farsi:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Anyone who takes a bath on Friday and cleans himself as much as he can and puts oil (on his hair) or scents himself; and then proceeds for the prayer and does not force his way between two persons (assembled in the mosque for the Friday prayer), and prays as much as is written for him and remains quiet when the Imam delivers the Khutba, all his sins in between the present and the last Friday will be forgiven
hi: Salman (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Farsi (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jo Jumme ke din ghusl kare aur jitna mumkin ho khud ko saaf kare, aur apna tel ya khushbu lagaye; phir (namaz ke liye) nikle aur do baithe hue logon ke darmiyan zabardasti ghus kar unhe alag na kare, aur jitni Allah ne likhi hai namaz padhe, aur Imam ke khutba dete waqt khamosh rahe, uske gunah is Jumme aur pichhle Jumme ke darmiyan maaf ho jaate hain."

e: Narrated Ibn Juraij:I heard Nafi' saying, "Ibn `Umar, said, 'The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade that a man should make another man to get up to sit in his place' ". I said to Nafi`, 'Is it for Jumua prayer only?' He replied, "For Jumua prayer and any other (prayer)
hi: Ibn Juraij bataate hain: "Maine Nafi ko kehte suna: 'Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: Nabi ne mana kiya ke koi kisi ko uski jagah se uthakar khud baith jaaye.'" Maine Nafi se pucha: "Kya yeh sirf Jumme ki namaz ke liye hai?" Unhone jawab diya: "Jumme ke liye bhi aur kisi bhi (namaz ke) liye."

e: Narrated As-Saib bin Yazid:In the lifetime of the Prophet, Abu Bakr and `Umar, the Adhan for the Jumua prayer used to be pronounced when the Imam sat on the pulpit. But during the Caliphate of `Uthman when the Muslims increased in number, a third Adhan at Az-Zaura' was added. Abu `Abdullah said, "Az-Zaura' is a place in the market of Medina
hi: As-Saib bin Yazid bataate hain: Nabi, Abu Bakr aur Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke zamane mein, Jumme ki namaz ke liye Adhan tab di jaati thi jab Imam mimbar par baith jaate. Magar Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki khilafat mein jab Musalmanon ki tadaad badh gayi, Az-Zaura mein ek teesri Adhan bhi jodi gayi. Abu Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Az-Zaura Madina ke bazaar mein ek jagah ka naam hai."

e: Narrated As-Saib bin Yazid:The person who increased the number of Adhans for the Jumua prayers to three was `Uthman bin `Affan and it was when the number of the (Muslim) people of Medina had increased. In the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) there was only one Mu'adh-dhin and the Adhan used to be pronounced only after the Imam had taken his seat (i.e. on the pulpit)
hi: As-Saib bin Yazid bataate hain ke jinhone Jumme ki Adhanon ki tadaad teen tak badhai, woh Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Affan the, aur yeh tab hua jab Madina ke (Musalman) logon ki tadaad badh gayi thi. Nabi ke zamane mein sirf ek Muazzin hota tha, aur Adhan sirf tab di jaati thi jab Imam apni jagah (mimbar par) baith jaate.

e: Narrated Abu Umama bin Sahl bin Hunaif:I heard Muawiya bin Abi Sufyan (repeating the statements of the Adhan) while he was sitting on the pulpit. When the Mu'adh-dhin pronounced the Adhan saying, "Allahu-Akbar, Allahu Akbar", Muawiya said: "Allah Akbar, Allahu Akbar." And when the Mu'adh-dhin said, "Ash-hadu an la ilaha illal-lah (I testify that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah)", Muawiya said, "And (so do) I". When he said, "Ash-hadu anna Muhammadan Rasulullah" (I testify that Muhammad is Allah's Apostle), Muawiya said, "And (so do) I". When the Adhan was finished, Muawiya said, "O people, when the Mu'adh-dhin pronounced the Adhan I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on this very pulpit saying what you have just heard me saying
hi: Abu Umama (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Sahl bin Hunaif bataate hain: "Maine Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Sufyan ko (Adhan ke alfaaz dohraate) suna jabke woh mimbar par baithe the. Jab Muazzin ne kaha 'Allahu-Akbar, Allahu Akbar', Muawiya ne kaha: 'Allah Akbar, Allahu Akbar.' Aur jab Muazzin ne kaha 'Ash-hadu an la ilaha illal-lah' (Main gawahi deta hoon ke Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahi), Muawiya ne kaha: 'Aur main bhi (gawahi deta hoon).' Jab usne kaha 'Ash-hadu anna Muhammadan Rasulullah' (Main gawahi deta hoon ke Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain), Muawiya ne kaha: 'Aur main bhi.' Jab Adhan khatam hui, Muawiya ne kaha: 'Aye logon! Jab Muazzin ne Adhan di, maine Allah ke Rasool ko isi mimbar par wahi kehte suna jo tumne mujhe kehte suna.'"

e: Narrated As-Sa'ib bin Yazid:`Uthman bin `Affan introduced the second Adhan on Fridays when the number of the people in the mosque increased. Previously the Adhan on Fridays used to be pronounced only after the Imam had taken his seat (on the pulpit)
hi: As-Sa'ib bin Yazid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Affan ne Jumme ke din doosri Adhan shuru ki jab masjid mein logon ki tadaad badh gayi. Pehle Jumme ke din Adhan sirf tab di jaati thi jab Imam apni jagah (mimbar par) baith jaate.

e: Narrated Az-Zuhri:I heard As-Saib bin Yazid, saying, "In the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and Abu Bakr and `Umar, the Adhan for the Jumua prayer used to be pronounced after the Imam had taken his seat on the pulpit. But when the people increased in number during the caliphate of `Uthman, he introduced a third Adhan (on Friday for the Jumua prayer) and it was pronounced at Az-Zaura' and that new state of affairs remained so in the succeeding years
hi: Az-Zuhri bataate hain: "Maine As-Saib bin Yazid ko kehte suna: 'Allah ke Rasool, Abu Bakr aur Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke zamane mein, Jumme ki namaz ke liye Adhan Imam ke apni jagah (mimbar par) baithne ke baad di jaati thi. Magar jab Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki khilafat mein log badh gaye, unhone ek teesri Adhan shuru ki, jo Az-Zaura mein di jaati thi, aur yeh silsila aage ke saalon mein bhi jaari raha.'"

e: Narrated Abu Hazim bin Dinar:Some people went to Sahl bin Sa`d As-Sa`idi and told him that they had different opinions regarding the wood of the pulpit. They asked him about it and he said, "By Allah, I know of what wood the pulpit was made, and no doubt I saw it on the very first day when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took his seat on it. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent for such and such an Ansari woman (and Sahl mentioned her name) and said to her, 'Order your slave-carpenter to prepare for me some pieces of wood (i.e. pulpit) on which I may sit at the time of addressing the people.' So she ordered her slave-carpenter and he made it from the tamarisk of the forest and brought it (to the woman). The woman sent that (pulpit) to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who ordered it to be placed here. Then I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) praying on it and then bowed on it. Then he stepped back, got down and prostrated on the ground near the foot of the pulpit and again ascended the pulpit. After finishing the prayer he faced the people and said, 'I have done this so that you may follow me and learn the way I pray
hi: Abu Hazim bin Dinar bataate hain: Kuch log Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) As-Sa'idi ke paas gaye aur bataya ke unme mimbar ki lakdi ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hai. Unhone poocha, aur Sahl ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, mujhe pata hai mimbar kis lakdi se bana tha, aur mujhe yaad hai jab Allah ke Rasool ne pehli baar usme baitha. Allah ke Rasool ne falaan Ansari aurat (Sahl ne unka naam liya) ko bulwaya aur kaha: 'Apne badhai gulam ko hukum do ke mere baithne ke liye kuch lakdi ke tukde (yaani mimbar) taiyaar kare taake main logon se khitaab karte waqt uspar baith sakoon.' Usne apne badhai gulam ko hukum diya, usne jungle ki jhau lakdi se ise banaya aur (aurat ko) laakar diya. Aurat ne (mimbar) Allah ke Rasool ke paas bhijwaya, jinhone ise yahan rakhne ka hukum diya. Phir maine Allah ke Rasool ko usme namaz padhte dekha, phir usme ruku kiya. Phir peeche hate, neeche utre aur mimbar ke paaon ke qareeb zameen par sajda kiya, phir dobara mimbar par chadhe. Namaz khatam karke, logon ki taraf mud kar farmaya: 'Maine yeh isliye kiya taake tum meri pairvi karo aur mera namaz padhne ka tareeka seekho.'"

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to stand by a stem of a date-palm tree (while delivering a sermon). When the pulpit was placed for him we heard that stem crying like a pregnant she-camel till the Prophet (ﷺ) got down from the pulpit and placed his hand over it
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Nabi (khutba dete waqt) khajoor ke ek tane se tek lagate the. Jab unke liye mimbar rakha gaya, humne us tane ko pregnant oontni ki tarah rote suna, yahan tak ke Nabi mimbar se utre aur usme apna haath rakha.

e: Narrated Salim:My father said , "I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) delivering the Khutba on the pulpit and he said, 'Whoever comes for the Jumua prayer should take a bath (before coming)
hi: Salim bataate hain: Mere waalid ne kaha: "Maine Nabi ko mimbar par khutba dete suna, unhone farmaya: 'Jo bhi Jumme ki namaz ke liye aaye, ghusl kare (aane se pehle).'"

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to deliver the Khutba while standing and then he would sit, then stand again as you do now-a-days
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain ke Nabi khade hokar khutba dete, phir baith jaate, phir dobara khade hote, jaise tum aajkal karte ho.

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:One day the Prophet (ﷺ) sat on the pulpit and we sat around him
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek din Nabi mimbar par baithe aur hum unke aas-paas baithe.

e: Narrated Fatima bint Al-Mundhir:Asma' bint Abi Bakr As-Siddiq said, "I went to 'Aishah and the people were offering Salat. I asked her, 'What is wrong with the people ?' She pointed towards the sky with her head. I asked her, 'Is there a sign ?' 'Aishah nodded with her head meaning 'Yes'." Asma' added, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prolonged the Salat to such an extent that I fainted. There was a waterskin by my side and I opened it and poured some water on my head. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) finished Salat, and the solar eclipse had cleared, the Prophet (ﷺ) addressed the people and praised Allah as He deserves and said, 'Amma ba'du'." Asma' further said, "Some Ansari women started talking, so I turned to them in order to make them quiet. I asked 'Aishah what the Prophet (ﷺ) had said. 'Aishah said: 'He said, 'I have seen things at this place of mine which were never shown to me before; (I have seen) even Paradise and Hell. And, no doubt it has been revealed to me that you (people) will be put in trial in your graves like or nearly like the trial of Masih Ad-Dajjal. (The angels) will come to everyone of you and ask him, 'What do you know about this man (Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ)) ?" The faithful believer or firm believer (Hisham was in doubt which word the Prophet (ﷺ) used), will say, 'He is Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he is Muhammad (ﷺ) who came to us with clear evidences and guidance. So we believed him, accepted his teachings and followed and trusted his teaching.' Then the angels will tell him to sleep (in peace) as they have come to know that he was a believer. But the hypocrite or a doubtful person (Hisham is not sure as to which word the Prophet (ﷺ) used), will be asked what he knew about this man (Prophet Muhammed (ﷺ)). He will say, 'I do not know but I heard the people saying something (about him) so I said the same' " Hisham added, "Fatima told me that she remembered that narration completely by heart except that she said about the hypocrite or a doubtful person that he will be punished severely
hi: Fatima (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Al-Mundhir bataati hain: Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Abi Bakr (رضی اللہ عنہا) As-Siddiq ne kaha: "Main Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas gayi aur log namaz padh rahe the. Maine pucha: 'Logon ko kya hua?' Unhone apne sar se aasman ki taraf ishara kiya. Maine pucha: 'Kya koi nishani hai?' Ayesha ne sar hilaya, matlab 'Haan'." Asma ne joda: "Allah ke Rasool ne namaz itni lambi ki ke main behosh hone lagi. Mere paas ek mashkiza thi, maine use khol kar apne sar par paani daala. Jab Allah ke Rasool ne namaz khatam ki aur suraj grahan hat gaya, Nabi ne logon ko khitaab kiya, Allah ki hamd-o-sana ki, aur kaha: 'Amma ba'du.'" Asma ne aage kaha: "Kuch Ansari aurtein baatein karne lagin, isliye main unki taraf mudi unhe khamosh karne ke liye. Maine Ayesha se pucha Nabi ne kya kaha. Ayesha ne kaha: 'Aap ne farmaya: Maine is jagah aisi cheezein dekhi jo mujhe pehle kabhi nahi dikhai gayin — Jannat aur Dozakh bhi. Aur beshak mujhe wahi hui hai ke tumhe apni qabron mein aazmaaya jayega, Masih Dajjal ke fitne jaisi ya usse milti-julti aazmaish. Har ek se (farishte) poochenge: Tum is shaks (Nabi Muhammad) ke baare mein kya jaante ho? Sacha momin (Hisham ko yaad nahi Nabi ne kaunsa lafz istemal kiya) kahega: Yeh Allah ke Rasool hain, Muhammad, jo humare paas roshan daleel aur hidayat le kar aaye. Humne unhe qubool kiya, unki taleemat maani aur unki pairvi ki. Tab farishte use sone ko kahenge (sukoon se) kyunke woh jaan gaye ke woh momin tha. Magar munafiq ya shakki shaks (Hisham ko yaad nahi kaunsa lafz tha) se poocha jayega is shaks ke baare mein kya jaanta hai. Woh kahega: Mujhe kuch nahi pata, maine logon ko kuch kehte suna to main bhi wahi keh diya.'" Hisham ne joda: "Fatima ne mujhe bataya ke unhe yeh poori riwayat yaad thi, siwaye ke unhone munafiq ya shakki shaks ke baare mein kaha ke usse sakht saza di jayegi."

e: Narrated `Amr bin Taghlib:Some property or something was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he distributed it. He gave to some men and ignored the others. Later he got the news of his being admonished by those whom he had ignored. So he glorified and praised Allah and said, "Amma ba'du. By Allah, I may give to a man and ignore another, although the one whom I ignore is more beloved to me than the one whom I give. But I give to some people as I feel that they have no patience and no contentment in their hearts and I leave those who are patient and self-content with the goodness and wealth which Allah has put into their hearts and `Amr bin Taghlib is one of them." `Amr added, By Allah! Those words of Allah's Apostle are more beloved to me than the best red camels
hi: Amr bin Taghlib (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ke paas kuch maal ya cheez laayi gayi, unhone use taqseem kiya. Kuch logon ko diya aur kuch ko chhod diya. Baad mein unhe pata chala ke jinhe chhod diya gaya woh naraz hain. To Allah ke Rasool ne Allah ki hamd-o-sana ki aur farmaya: "Amma ba'du. Allah ki qasam, main kabhi kisi ko deta hoon aur doosre ko chhod deta hoon, jabke jise main chhodta hoon woh mujhe usse zyada pyara hota hai jise main deta hoon. Magar main un logon ko deta hoon jinke dil mein sabr aur santosh kam hai, aur unhe chhod deta hoon jo sabr aur apne dilon mein Allah ki di hui bhalai se santusht hain, aur Amr bin Taghlib unme se ek hai." Amr ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, Allah ke Rasool ke yeh alfaaz mujhe behtareen laal oonton se zyada pyare hain."

e: Narrated Aisha:Once in the middle of the night Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went out and prayed in the mosque and some men prayed with him. The next morning the people spoke about it and so more people gathered and prayed with him (in the second night). They circulated the news in the morning, and so, on the third night the number of people increased greatly. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came out and they prayed behind him. On the fourth night the mosque was overwhelmed by the people till it could not accommodate them. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came out only for the Fajr prayer and when he finished the prayer, he faced the people and recited "Tashah-hud" (I testify that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah and that Muhammad is His Apostle), and then said, "Amma ba'du. Verily your presence (in the mosque at night) was not hidden from me, but I was afraid that this prayer (Prayer of Tahajjud) might be made compulsory and you might not be able to carry it out
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ek baar aadhi raat ko Allah ke Rasool bahar aaye aur masjid mein namaz padhi, kuch log unke saath padhe. Agli subah logon ne iske baare mein baat ki, aur zyada log jama hokar unke saath padhe (doosri raat). Subah phir yeh baat phaili, isliye teesri raat logon ki tadaad bahut badh gayi. Allah ke Rasool bahar aaye aur log unke peechhe padhe. Chauthi raat masjid logon se itni bhar gayi ke jagah nahi bachi. Allah ke Rasool sirf Fajr ki namaz ke liye bahar aaye, aur namaz khatam karke logon ki taraf mud kar Tashahhud padha (Main gawahi deta hoon ke Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahi aur Muhammad uske Rasool hain), phir farmaya: "Amma ba'du. Beshak tumhari (raat ki) maujoodgi mujhse chhupi nahi thi, magar mujhe dar tha ke yeh namaz (Tahajjud) tum par farz na kar di jaaye aur tum ise nibha na sako."

e: Narrated Abu Hummaid As-Sa`idi:One night Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up after the prayer and recited "Tashah-hud" and then praised Allah as He deserved and said, "Amma ba'du
hi: Abu Humaid As-Sa'idi bataate hain: Ek raat Allah ke Rasool namaz ke baad khade hue, Tashahhud padha, phir Allah ki laayiq hamd-o-sana ki aur farmaya: "Amma ba'du."

e: Narrated Al-Miswar bin Makhrama:Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got up for delivering the Khutba and I heard him after "Tashah-hud" saying "Amma ba'du
hi: Al-Miswar bin Makhrama (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Allah ke Rasool khutba dene ke liye khade hue, maine unhe Tashahhud ke baad "Amma ba'du" kehte suna.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) ascended the pulpit and it was the last gathering in which he took part. He was covering his shoulder with a big cloak and binding his head with an oily bandage. He glorified and praised Allah and said, "O people! Come to me." So the people came and gathered around him and he then said, "Amma ba'du." "From now onward the Ansar will decrease and other people will increase. So anybody who becomes a ruler of the followers of Muhammad and has the power to harm or benefit people then he should accept the good from the benevolent amongst them (Ansar) and overlook the faults of their wrong-doers
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Ek baar Nabi mimbar par chadhe, yeh unki aakhri majlis thi jisme woh shareek hue. Woh apne shoulder par ek badi chadar odhe hue the aur sar par tel wali patti baandhe hue the. Unhone Allah ki hamd-o-sana ki aur kaha: "Aye logon! Mere paas aao." Log aakar unke aas-paas jama ho gaye, phir unhone kaha: "Amma ba'du. Ab se Ansaar kam hote jayenge aur doosre log badhte jayenge. Isliye jo bhi Muhammad ke pairokaron ka hukmaran bane aur logon ko nuqsan ya faida pahunchane ki taaqat rakhta ho, use unme se (Ansaar mein se) neik logon ki achhaai qubool karni chahiye aur unke buraai karne walon ki galtiyon ko nazar-andaaz karna chahiye."

e: Narrated `Abdullah Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to deliver two Khutbas and sit in between them
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain ke Nabi do khutbe dete aur unke darmiyan baithte the.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When it is a Friday, the angels stand at the gate of the mosque and keep on writing the names of the persons coming to the mosque in succession according to their arrivals. The example of the one who enters the mosque in the earliest hour is that of one offering a camel (in sacrifice). The one coming next is like one offering a cow and then a ram and then a chicken and then an egg respectively. When the Imam comes out (for Jumua prayer) they (i.e. angels) fold their papers and listen to the Khutba
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Jumme ke din, farishte masjid ke darwaze par khade hokar aane wale logon ke naam silsilewaar unki aamad ke mutabiq likhte rehte hain. Jo sabse pehle ghante mein masjid mein daakhil hota hai, uski misaal oont qurbani karne wale jaisi hai. Jo uske baad aata hai, gaay qurbani karne jaisa, phir mengha, phir murgi, phir anda pesh karne jaisa. Jab Imam bahar aata hai (Jumme ki namaz ke liye), woh (farishte) apne kaghaz samet lete hain aur khutba sunte hain."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:A person entered the mosque while the Prophet (ﷺ) was delivering the Khutba on a Friday. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "Have you prayed?" The man replied in the negative. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Get up and pray two rak`at
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks masjid mein daakhil hua jabke Nabi ek Jumme ko khutba de rahe the. Nabi ne unse pucha: "Kya tumne namaz padh li?" Shaks ne na mein jawab diya. Nabi ne farmaya: "Utho aur do rakat padho."

e: Narrated Jabir:A man entered the Mosque while the Prophet (ﷺ) was delivering the Khutba. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "Have you prayed?" The man replied in the negative. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Pray two rak`at
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks masjid mein daakhil hua jabke Nabi khutba de rahe the. Nabi ne unse pucha: "Kya tumne namaz padh li?" Shaks ne na mein jawab diya. Nabi ne farmaya: "Do rakat padho."

e: Narrated Anas:While the Prophet (ﷺ) was delivering the Khutba on a Friday, a man stood up and said, "O, Allah's Apostle! The livestock and the sheep are dying, so pray to Allah for rain." So he (the Prophet) raised both his hands and invoked Allah (for it)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek Jumme ko jabke Nabi khutba de rahe the, ek shaks khada hokar bola: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Maweshi aur bhed mar rahe hain, Allah se baarish ki dua kijiye." Nabi ne apne donon haath uthaye aur dua ki.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Once in the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) the people were afflicted with drought (famine). While the Prophet (ﷺ) was delivering the Khutba on a Friday, a Bedouin stood up and said, "O, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Our possessions are being destroyed and the children are hungry; Please invoke Allah (for rain)". So the Prophet (ﷺ) raised his hands. At that time there was not a trace of cloud in the sky. By Him in Whose Hands my soul is as soon as he lowered his hands, clouds gathered like mountains, and before he got down from the pulpit, I saw the rain falling on the beard of the Prophet. It rained that day, the next day, the third day, the fourth day till the next Friday. The same Bedouin or another man stood up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! The houses have collapsed, our possessions and livestock have been drowned; Please invoke Allah (to protect us)". So the Prophet (ﷺ) raised both his hands and said, "O Allah! Round about us and not on us". So, in whatever direction he pointed with his hands, the clouds dispersed and cleared away, and Medina's (sky) became clear as a hole in between the clouds. The valley of Qanat remained flooded, for one month, none came from outside but talked about the abundant rain
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Nabi ke zamane mein log akaal (sookha/famine) mein mubtila hue. Jumme ko jabke Nabi khutba de rahe the, ek dehati (Bedouin) khada hokar bola: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Humara maal-maweshi barbaad ho raha hai aur bachche bhookhe hain; Allah se dua kijiye (baarish ke liye)." Nabi ne apne haath uthaye. Us waqt aasman mein baadal ka koi nishaan nahi tha. Us zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, jaise hi Nabi ne apne haath neeche kiye, baadal pahadon ki tarah jama hone lage, aur Nabi ke mimbar se utarne se pehle hi maine unki daadhi par baarish ki boondein girti dekhin. Us din, agle din, teesre, chauthe din tak baarish hoti rahi, agle Jumme tak. Wahi ya koi doosra dehati khada hokar bola: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Ghar gir gaye hain, humara maal-maweshi doob gaya hai; Allah se dua kijiye (humein bachaane ke liye)." Nabi ne donon haath uthaye aur kaha: "Aye Allah! Hamare aas-paas, humpar nahi." Jidhar bhi unhone haath se ishara kiya, baadal wahan se hat gaye, aur Madina ka aasman saaf ho gaya, jaise baadalon ke beech ek khaali surakh. Qanat wadi ek mahine tak paani se bhari rahi, aur bahar se koi bhi aata to isi zabardast baarish ki baat karta.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When the Imam is delivering the Khutba, and you ask your companion to keep quiet and listen, then no doubt you have done an evil act
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jab Imam khutba de raha ho, aur tum apne sathi se khamosh rehne aur sunne ko kaho, to beshak tumne ek bura kaam kar liya."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) talked about Friday and said, "There is an hour (opportune time) on Friday and if a Muslim gets it while praying and asks something from Allah, then Allah will definitely meet his demand." And he (the Prophet) pointed out the shortness of that time with his hands
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Allah ke Rasool ne Jumme ke baare mein baat ki aur farmaya: "Jumme mein ek (khaas) ghadi hai, agar koi Musalman namaz padhte huye usse paa le aur Allah se kuch maange, Allah zaroor uski maang poori karega." Aur Nabi ne apne haathon se us waqt ki chhoti-si muddat ka ishara kiya.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:While we were praying (Jumua Khutba & prayer) with the Prophet (ﷺ), some camels loaded with food, arrived (from Sham). The people diverted their attention towards the camels (and left the mosque), and only twelve persons remained with the Prophet. So this verse was revealed: "But when they see Some bargain or some amusement, They disperse headlong to it, And leave you standing
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab hum Nabi ke saath (Jumme ki) namaz padh rahe the, khane se laade huye kuch oont (Sham se) aaye. Logon ka dhyan un oonton ki taraf gaya (aur woh masjid chhod kar chale gaye), sirf barah log Nabi ke saath rah gaye. Isi waqt yeh ayat nazil hui: "Magar jab woh koi tijarat ya khel-tamasha dekhte hain, foran usi ki taraf bhaag jaate hain, aur tumhe khada chhod dete hain."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to pray two rak`at before the Zuhr prayer and two rak`at after it. He also used to pray two rak`at after the Maghrib prayer in his house, and two rak`at after the `Isha' prayer. He never prayed after Jumua prayer till he departed (from the Mosque), and then he would pray two rak`at at home
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain ke Allah ke Rasool Zuhr se pehle do rakat aur uske baad do rakat padhte the. Woh Maghrib ke baad bhi apne ghar mein do rakat padhte, aur Isha ke baad bhi do rakat. Aap kabhi Jumme ki namaz ke baad (masjid mein) nahi padhte jab tak (masjid se) chale nahi jaate, phir ghar jaakar do rakat padhte.

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:There was a woman amongst us who had a farm and she used to sow Silq (a kind of vegetable) on the edges of streams in her farm. On Fridays she used to pull out the Silq from its roots and put the roots in a utensil. Then she would put a handful of powdered barley over it and cook it. The roots of the Silq were a substitute for meat. After finishing the Jumua prayer we used to greet her and she would give us that food which we would eat with our hands, and because of that meal, we used to look forward to Friday
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Humare paas ek aurat thi jiska khet tha, woh apne khet mein naalon ke kinare Silq (ek qisam ki sabzi) ugaati thi. Jumme ke din woh Silq ki jadein nikaal kar ek bartan mein daalti. Phir woh usme mutthi bhar jau ka aata daalkar pakati. Silq ki jadein gosht ka kaam deti thin. Jumme ki namaz khatam karke hum unse milte aur woh humein woh khana deti jise hum apne haathon se khaate, aur us khane ki wajah se hum Jumme ka intezar karte.

e: Narrated Sahl:As above with the addition: We never had an afternoon nap nor meals except after offering the Jumua prayer
hi: Sahl bataate hain (jaisa upar), aur joda: Hum na dopahar ki neend lete the na khana khaate the, siwaye Jumme ki namaz padhne ke baad.

e: Narrated Anas:We used to offer the Jumua prayer early and then have the afternoon nap
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Jumme ki namaz jaldi padhte aur phir dopahar ki neend lete.

e: Narrated Sahl:We used to offer the Jumua prayer with the Prophet (ﷺ) and then take the afternoon nap
hi: Sahl bataate hain: Hum Nabi ke saath Jumme ki namaz padhte aur phir dopahar ki neend lete.

e: Narrated Shu'aib:I asked Az-Zuhri, "Did the Prophet (ﷺ) ever offer the Fear Prayer?" Az-Zuhri said, "I was told by Salim that `Abdullah bin `Umar had said, 'I took part in a holy battle with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in Najd. We faced the enemy and arranged ourselves in rows. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up to lead the prayer and one party stood to pray with him while the other faced the enemy. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and the former party bowed and performed two prostrations. Then that party left and took the place of those who had not prayed. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prayed one rak`a (with the latter) and performed two prostrations and finished his prayer with Taslim. Then everyone of them bowed once and performed two prostrations individually
hi: Shu'aib bataate hain: "Maine Az-Zuhri se pucha: 'Kya Nabi ne kabhi Khauf (dushman ke khauf/dar ki) Namaz padhi?' Az-Zuhri ne kaha: 'Mujhe Salim ne bataya ke Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: Main Allah ke Rasool ke saath Najd mein ek jihad mein shareek hua. Hum dushman ke saamne aaye aur safein bana lin. Phir Allah ke Rasool namaz padhane khade hue, ek giroh unke saath khada hokar namaz mein shamil hua jabke doosra giroh dushman ki taraf mun karke khada raha. Allah ke Rasool aur pehle giroh ne ruku kiya aur do sajde kiye. Phir woh giroh chala gaya aur un logon ki jagah le li jinhone abhi namaz nahi padhi thi. Allah ke Rasool ne (doosre giroh ke saath) ek rakat padhi aur do sajde kiye aur Taslim se namaz khatam ki. Phir har ek ne akele ek-ek ruku aur do-do sajde kiye.'"

e: Narrated Nafi`:Ibn `Umar said something similar to Mujahid's saying: Whenever (Muslims and non-Muslims) stand face to face in battle, the Muslims can pray while standing. Ibn `Umar added, "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'If the number of the enemy is greater than the Muslims, they can pray while standing or riding (individually)
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Mujahid ki baat jaisi hi baat kahi: Jab bhi (Musalman aur ghair-Musalman) jung mein aamne-saamne khade hon, Musalman khade-khade bhi namaz padh sakte hain. Ibn Umar ne joda: "Nabi ne farmaya: 'Agar dushman ki tadaad Musalmanon se zyada ho, to woh khade ho kar ya sawari par (akele-akele) namaz padh sakte hain.'"

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) led the fear prayer and the people stood behind him. He said Takbir (Allahu-Akbar) and the people said the same. He bowed and some of them bowed. Then he prostrated and they also prostrated. Then he stood for the second rak`a and those who had prayed the first rak`a left and guarded their brothers. The second party joined him and performed bowing and prostration with him. All the people were in prayer but they were guarding one another during the prayer
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Ek baar Nabi ne Khauf ki namaz ki imamat ki aur log unke peechhe khade hue. Aap ne Takbir kahi aur logon ne bhi kahi. Aap ne ruku kiya aur kuch logon ne bhi kiya. Phir Aap ne sajda kiya aur woh bhi karne lage. Phir Aap doosri rakat ke liye khade hue, aur jinhone pehli rakat padhi thi woh chale gaye aur apne bhaiyon ki hifazat karne lage. Doosra giroh unke saath shamil hua aur unke saath ruku-sajda kiya. Sab log namaz mein the magar namaz ke dauran ek-doosre ki hifazat kar rahe the.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:On the day of the Khandaq `Umar came, cursing the disbelievers of Quraish and said, "O Allah's Apostle! I have not offered the `Asr prayer and the sun has set." The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "By Allah! I too, have not offered the prayer yet. "The Prophet (ﷺ) then went to Buthan, performed ablution and performed the `Asr prayer after the sun had set and then offered the Maghrib prayer after it
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Khandaq ki jung ke din Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) aaye, Quraish ke kaafiron ko koste huye, aur kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Maine Asr ki namaz nahi padhi aur suraj doob gaya hai." Nabi ne jawab diya: "Allah ki qasam! Maine bhi abhi tak namaz nahi padhi." Phir Nabi Buthan gaye, wudu kiya aur suraj doobne ke baad Asr padhi, phir uske baad Maghrib padhi.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:When the Prophet (ﷺ) returned from the battle of Al-Ahzab (The confederates), he said to us, "None should offer the 'Asr prayer but at Bani Quraiza." The 'Asr prayer became due for some of them on the way. Some of them decided not to offer the Salat but at Bani Quraiza while others decided to offer the Salat on the spot and said that the intention of the Prophet (ﷺ) was not what the former party had understood. And when that was told to the Prophet (ﷺ) he did not blame anyone of them
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Jab Nabi Al-Ahzab (Khandaq) ki jung se laute, humse farmaya: "Koi bhi Asr ki namaz sirf Bani Quraiza mein hi padhe." Kuch logon ke liye Asr ka waqt raaste mein hi aa gaya. Kuch ne socha namaz sirf Bani Quraiza pahunch kar hi padhenge, jabke kuchhne wahin (raaste mein) padh li aur kaha ke Nabi ka matlab woh nahi tha jo pehle giroh ne samjha. Jab yeh baat Nabi ko batai gayi, unhone kisi ko bhi bura-bhala nahi kaha.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) offered the Fajr prayer when it was still dark, then he rode and said, 'Allahu Akbar! Khaibar is ruined. When we approach near to a nation, the most unfortunate is the morning of those who have been warned." The people came out into the streets saying, "Muhammad and his army." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) vanquished them by force and their warriors were killed; the children and women were taken as captives. Safiya was taken by Dihya Al-Kalbi and later she belonged to Allah's Apostle, who married her and her Mahr was her manumission
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Allah ke Rasool ne Fajr ki namaz andhere mein padhi, phir sawar hue aur farmaya: "Allahu Akbar! Khaibar barbaad ho gaya. Jab hum kisi (dushman) qaum ke qareeb jaate hain to jinhe khabardar kiya gaya unki subah buri hoti hai." Log galiyon mein nikal aaye, keh rahe the: "Muhammad aur unki fauj." Allah ke Rasool ne unhe zabardast shikast di, unke jangju maare gaye; bachche aur aurtein qaid kar li gayin. Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko Dihya Al-Kalbi ne liya, baad mein woh Allah ke Rasool ki ho gayin, jinhone unse shaadi ki aur unka Mahr unki aazadi tha.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:`Umar bought a silk cloak from the market, took it to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Take it and adorn yourself with it during the `Id and when the delegations visit you." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, "This dress is for those who have no share (in the Hereafter)." After a long period Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent to `Umar a cloak of silk brocade. `Umar came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with the cloak and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! You said that this dress was for those who had no share (in the Hereafter); yet you have sent me this cloak." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him, "Sell it and fulfill your needs by it
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain ke Umar ne bazaar se resham ka ek chogha khareeda, use Allah ke Rasool ke paas le gaye aur kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Ise le lijiye aur Eid ke din aur jab wafdon se milein tab pehniye." Allah ke Rasool ne jawab diya: "Yeh libaas un logon ke liye hai jinka (Aakhirat mein) koi hissa nahi hai." Kaafi waqt baad, Allah ke Rasool ne Umar ke paas resham ke kaam wala ek chogha bheja. Umar ne woh chogha lekar Allah ke Rasool ke paas aakar kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Aapne kaha tha yeh libaas un logon ke liye hai jinka (Aakhirat mein) koi hissa nahi hai; magar aapne mujhe yeh chogha bheja hai." Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: "Ise becho aur apni zaroorat poori karo."

e: Narrated Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to my house while two girls were singing beside me the songs of Buath (a story about the war between the two tribes of the Ansar, the Khazraj and the Aus, before Islam). The Prophet (ﷺ) lay down and turned his face to the other side. Then Abu Bakr came and spoke to me harshly saying, "Musical instruments of Satan near the Prophet (ﷺ) ?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) turned his face towards him and said, "Leave them." When Abu Bakr became inattentive, I signaled to those girls to go out and they left. It was the day of `Id, and the Black people were playing with shields and spears; so either I requested the Prophet (ﷺ) or he asked me whether I would like to see the display. I replied in the affirmative. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) made me stand behind him and my cheek was touching his cheek and he was saying, "Carry on! O Bani Arfida," till I got tired. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked me, "Are you satisfied (Is that sufficient for you)?" I replied in the affirmative and he told me to leave
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool mere ghar aaye jabke do ladkiyan mere paas Buath ke geet ga rahi thi (Islam se pehle Ansaar ke do qabile Khazraj aur Aus ke darmiyan jung ki ek kahani). Nabi let gaye aur apna chehra doosri taraf mod liya. Phir Abu Bakr aaye aur mujhse sakhti se kaha: "Nabi ke qareeb shaitan ke saaz?" Allah ke Rasool ne apna chehra unki taraf karke kaha: "Unhe rehne do." Jab Abu Bakr ka dhyan hat gaya, maine un ladkiyon ko ishara kiya bahar jaane ka aur woh chali gayin. Yeh Eid ka din tha, aur kaale log dhaal aur nezon se khel dikha rahe the; ya to maine Nabi se guzarish ki ya unhone khud pucha kya main dekhna chahti hoon. Maine haan mein jawab diya. Phir Nabi ne mujhe apne peechhe khada kiya, mera gaal unke gaal se chhoo raha tha, aur woh keh rahe the: "Jaari rakho! Aye Bani Arfida," yahan tak ke main thak gayi. Nabi ne pucha: "Kya tumhe kaafi hai?" Maine haan mein jawab diya aur unhone mujhe jaane ko kaha.

e: Narrated Al-Bara':I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) delivering a Khutba saying, "The first thing to be done on this day (first day of `Id ul Adha) is to pray; and after returning from the prayer we slaughter our sacrifices (in the name of Allah) and whoever does so, he acted according to our Sunna (traditions)
hi: Al-Bara (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Maine Nabi ko khutba dete suna: 'Aaj ke din (Eid-ul-Adha ka pehla din) sabse pehle jo cheez karni hai woh namaz hai; aur namaz se wapas aakar hum apni qurbani ka janwar zabah karte hain (Allah ke naam par), aur jo aisa kare, usne humari Sunnat ke mutabiq amal kiya.'"

e: Narrated Aisha:Abu Bakr came to my house while two small Ansari girls were singing beside me the stories of the Ansar concerning the Day of Buath. And they were not singers. Abu Bakr said protestingly, "Musical instruments of Satan in the house of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) !" It happened on the `Id day and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O Abu Bakr! There is an `Id for every nation and this is our `Id
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Abu Bakr mere ghar aaye jabke do choti Ansari ladkiyan mere paas Ansaar ki Buath ki kahaniyan ga rahi thin. Woh koi pesha-war gaayikayen nahi thin. Abu Bakr ne aitraaz karte huye kaha: "Allah ke Rasool ke ghar mein shaitan ke saaz!" Yeh Eid ke din hua, aur Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: "Aye Abu Bakr! Har qaum ki apni Eid hoti hai, aur yeh humari Eid hai."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) never proceeded (for the prayer) on the Day of `Id-ul-Fitr unless he had eaten some dates. Anas also narrated: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to eat odd number of dates
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool Eid-ul-Fitr ke din tab tak (namaz ke liye) nahi nikalte the jab tak kuch khajoor na khaa lein. Anas ne yeh bhi bataya: Nabi taaq (odd) tadaad mein khajoor khaate the.

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever slaughtered (his sacrifice) before the `Id prayer, should slaughter again." A man stood up and said, "This is the day on which one has desire for meat," and he mentioned something about his neighbors. It seemed that the Prophet (ﷺ) believed him. Then the same man added, "I have a young she-goat which is dearer to me than the meat of two sheep." The Prophet (ﷺ) permitted him to slaughter it as a sacrifice. I do not know whether that permission was valid only for him or for others as well
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jo bhi Eid ki namaz se pehle (apni qurbani) zabah kare, use dobara zabah karni chahiye." Ek shaks khada hokar bola: "Yeh woh din hai jab gosht ki khwahish hoti hai," aur usne apne padosiyon ke baare mein kuch kaha. Aisa lagta hai Nabi ne uski baat maan li. Phir usi shaks ne joda: "Mere paas ek jawan bakri hai jo mujhe do bhedon ke gosht se zyada pyari hai." Nabi ne use ise qurbani ke tor par zabah karne ki ijazat di. Mujhe nahi pata yeh ijazat sirf uske liye thi ya doosron ke liye bhi.

e: Narrated Al-Bara' bin `Azib:The Prophet (ﷺ) delivered the Khutba after offering the prayer on the Day of Nahr and said, "Whoever offers the prayer like us and slaughters like us then his Nusuk (sacrifice) will be accepted by Allah. And whoever slaughters his sacrifice before the `Id prayer then he has not done the sacrifice." Abi Burda bin Niyar, the uncle of Al-Bara' said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have slaughtered my sheep before the `Id prayer and I thought today as a day of eating and drinking (not alcoholic drinks), and I liked that my sheep should be the first to be slaughtered in my house. So I slaughtered my sheep and took my food before coming for the prayer." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The sheep which you have slaughtered is just mutton (not a Nusuk)." He (Abu Burda) said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have a young she-goat which is dearer to me than two sheep. Will that be sufficient as a Nusuk on my behalf? "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Yes, it will be sufficient for you but it will not be sufficient (as a Nusuk) for anyone else after you
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Yaum-un-Nahr (Eid-ul-Adha) ke din namaz padhne ke baad khutba diya aur farmaya: "Jo humari tarah namaz padhe aur humari tarah zabah kare, uska Nusuk (qurbani) Allah ke haan qubool hogi. Aur jo apni qurbani Eid ki namaz se pehle zabah kare, usne qurbani nahi ki." Al-Bara ke chacha Abi Burda bin Niyar ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Maine apni bhed Eid ki namaz se pehle zabah kar li thi kyunke maine socha aaj khane-peene ka din hai (haram sharab nahi), aur main chahta tha meri bhed sabse pehle mere ghar mein zabah ho. Isliye maine apni bhed zabah karke namaz se pehle khana khaya." Nabi ne farmaya: "Jo bhed tumne zabah ki hai woh sirf gosht hai (Nusuk nahi)." Unhone (Abu Burda ne) kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Mere paas ek jawan bakri hai jo do bhedon se zyada pyari hai. Kya woh mere taraf se Nusuk ke tor par kaafi hogi?" Nabi ne farmaya: "Haan, yeh tumhare liye kaafi hai magar tumhare baad kisi aur ke liye Nusuk ke tor par kaafi nahi hogi."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to proceed to the Musalla on the days of Id-ul-Fitr and Id-ul-Adha; the first thing to begin with was the prayer and after that he would stand in front of the people and the people would keep sitting in their rows. Then he would preach to them, advise them and give them orders, (i.e. Khutba). And after that if he wished to send an army for an expedition, he would do so; or if he wanted to give an order, he would do so, and then depart. The people followed this tradition till I went out with Marwan, the Governor of Medina, for the prayer of Id-ul-Adha or Id-ul-Fitr. When we reached the Musalla, there was a pulpit made by Kathir bin As-Salt. Marwan wanted to get up on that pulpit before the prayer. I got hold of his clothes but he pulled them and ascended the pulpit and delivered the Khutba before the prayer. I said to him, "By Allah, you have changed (the Prophet's tradition)." He replied, "O Abu Sa`id! Gone is that which you know." I said, "By Allah! What I know is better than what I do not know." Marwan said, "People do not sit to listen to our Khutba after the prayer, so I delivered the Khutba before the prayer
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi Eid-ul-Fitr aur Eid-ul-Adha ke dinon mein Musalla jaate; sabse pehle namaz padhte, phir logon ke saamne khade hote jabke log apni safon mein baithe rehte. Phir Aap unhe waaz karte, naseehat dete aur hukum dete (yaani khutba dete). Uske baad agar koi fauj bhejni hoti, bhejte, ya koi hukum dena hota, dete, phir chale jaate. Yeh riwaaj tab tak chalta raha jab tak main Madina ke gawarnar Marwan ke saath Eid-ul-Adha ya Eid-ul-Fitr ki namaz ke liye nahi gaya. Jab hum Musalla pahunche, wahan Kathir bin As-Salt ka banaya hua ek mimbar tha. Marwan namaz se pehle uspar chadhna chahta tha. Maine unke kapde pakde magar unhone chhuda liye aur mimbar par chadh kar namaz se pehle khutba di. Maine unse kaha: "Allah ki qasam, aapne (Nabi ki riwayat) badal di hai." Unhone jawab diya: "Aye Abu Saeed! Woh cheez jo tum jaante ho, ab guzar chuki hai." Maine kaha: "Allah ki qasam! Jo main jaanta hoon woh usse behtar hai jo main nahi jaanta." Marwan ne kaha: "Log namaz ke baad humara khutba sunne ke liye nahi baithte, isliye maine namaz se pehle khutba di."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to offer the prayer of `Id-ul-Adha and `Id-ul-Fitr and then deliver the Khutba after the prayer
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool Eid-ul-Adha aur Eid-ul-Fitr ki namaz padhte, phir namaz ke baad khutba dete.

e: Narrated Ibn Juraij:`Ata' said, "Jabir bin `Abdullah said, 'The Prophet (ﷺ) went out on the Day of `Id-ul-Fitr and offered the prayer before delivering the Khutba, Ata told me that during the early days of Ibn Az-Zubair, Ibn `Abbas had sent a message to him telling him that the Adhan for the `Id Prayer was never pronounced (in the life time of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)) and the Khutba used to be delivered after the prayer. Ata told me that Ibn `Abbas and Jabir bin `Abdullah, had said, "There was no Adhan for the prayer of `Id-ul-Fitr and `Id-ul-Aqha." `Ata' said, "I heard Jabir bin `Abdullah saying, 'The Prophet (ﷺ) stood up and started with the prayer, and after it he delivered the Khutba. When the Prophet of Allah (ﷺ) finished (the Khutba), he went to the women and preached to them, while he was leaning on Bilal's hand. Bilal was spreading his garment and the ladies were putting alms in it.' " I said to Ata, "Do you think it incumbent upon an Imam to go to the women and preach to them after finishing the prayer and Khutba?" `Ata' said, "No doubt it is incumbent on Imams to do so, and why should they not do so?
hi: Ibn Juraij bataate hain: Ata ne kaha: "Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne bataya: 'Nabi Eid-ul-Fitr ke din bahar gaye aur khutba se pehle namaz padhi.'" Ata ne mujhe bataya ke Ibn Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke shuru ke dinon mein, Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne unhe ek paighaam bheja ke Eid ki namaz ke liye kabhi Adhan nahi di jaati thi (Allah ke Rasool ke zamane mein), aur khutba namaz ke baad di jaati thi. Ata ne mujhe bataya ke Ibn Abbas aur Jabir bin Abdullah ne kaha: "Eid-ul-Fitr aur Eid-ul-Aqha ki namaz ke liye koi Adhan nahi thi." Ata ne kaha: "Maine Jabir bin Abdullah ko kehte suna: 'Nabi khade hue aur pehle namaz shuru ki, uske baad khutba di. Jab Allah ke Nabi khutba khatam kar chuke, woh aurton ki taraf gaye aur unhe waaz kiya, jabke Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke haath ka sahara le rahe the. Bilal apna libaas failaaye huye the aur aurtein usme sadqa daal rahi thin.'" Maine Ata se pucha: "Kya aapko lagta hai Imam ke liye zaroori hai ke woh namaz aur khutba khatam karke aurton ke paas jaakar unhe waaz kare?" Ata ne kaha: "Beshak Imamon ke liye yeh zaroori hai, aur woh aisa kyun na karein?"
