e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I offered the `Id prayer with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), Abu Bakr, `Umar and `Uthman and all of them offered the prayer before delivering the Khutba
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: "Maine Allah ke Rasool, Abu Bakr, Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath Eid ki namaz padhi, aur unme se sab ne khutba dene se pehle namaz padhi."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), Abu Bakr and `Umar! used to offer the two `Id prayers before delivering the Khutba
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool, Abu Bakr aur Umar khutba dene se pehle dono Eid ki namazein padhte the.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) offered a two rak`at prayer on the Day of Id ul Fitr and he did not pray before or after it. Then he went towards women along with Bilal and ordered them to pay alms and so they started giving their earrings and necklaces (in charity)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne Eid-ul-Fitr ke din do rakat padhi aur usse pehle ya baad koi (aur namaz) nahi padhi. Phir Aap Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath aurton ki taraf gaye aur unhe sadqa dene ka hukum diya, isliye unhone apni baaliyaan aur haar (sadqa mein) dene shuru kiye.

e: Narrated Al-Bara' bin `Azib:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The first thing that we should do on this day of ours is to pray and then return to slaughter the sacrifice. So anyone who does so, he acted according to our Sunna (tradition), and whoever slaughtered the sacrifice before the prayer, it was just meat which he presented to his family and would not be considered as Nusuk." A person from the Ansar named Abu Burda bin Niyar said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I slaughtered the Nusuk (before the prayer) but I have a young shegoat which is better than an older sheep." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Sacrifice it in lieu of the first, but it will not be sufficient (as a sacrifice) for anybody else after you
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Humein sabse pehle jo karna chahiye woh namaz hai, phir qurbani ke liye wapas jaana. Jo aisa kare, usne humari Sunnat ke mutabiq amal kiya, aur jisne namaz se pehle apni qurbani zabah ki, woh sirf gosht tha jo usne apne ghar walon ko diya, use Nusuk nahi maana jayega." Ansaar ke ek shaks, Abu Burda bin Niyar naam ke, ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Maine Nusuk (namaz se pehle) zabah ki magar mere paas ek jawan bakri hai jo ek purani bhed se behtar hai." Nabi ne farmaya: "Ise pehli ke badle mein zabah kar do, magar tumhare baad kisi aur ke liye yeh kaafi nahi hogi (qurbani ke tor par)."

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:I was with Ibn `Umar when a spear head pierced the sole of his foot and his foot stuck to the paddle of the saddle and I got down and pulled his foot out, and that happened in Mina. Al-Hajjaj got the news and came to inquire about his health and said, "Alas! If we could only know the man who wounded you!" Ibn `Umar said, "You are the one who wounded me." Al-Hajjaj said, "How is that?" Ibn `Umar said, "You have allowed the arms to be carried on a day on which nobody used to carry them and you allowed arms to be carried in the Haram even though it was not allowed before
hi: Sa'id bin Jubair bataate hain: Main Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath tha jab ek neze ki nok unke paon ke talwe mein ghus gayi aur unka paon zeen ki paidal mein phans gaya. Main utra aur unka paon nikaala, yeh Mina mein hua. Al-Hajjaj ko pata chala aur woh unki tabiyat poochhne aaye aur kaha: "Kaash humein pata hota kisne aapko zakhmi kiya!" Ibn Umar ne kaha: "Tumne hi mujhe zakhmi kiya hai." Al-Hajjaj ne pucha: "Woh kaise?" Ibn Umar ne kaha: "Tumne uss din hathiyaar le jaane ki ijazat di jab pehle koi nahi le jaata tha, aur tumne haram mein hathiyaar le jaane ki ijazat di jabke pehle aisa nahi hota tha."

e: Narrated Sa`id bin `Amr bin Sa`id bin Al-`Aas:Al-Hajjaj went to Ibn `Umar while I was present there. Al-Hajjaj asked Ibn `Umar, "How are you?" Ibn `Umar replied, "I am all right," Al-Hajjaj asked, "Who wounded you?" Ibn `Umar replied, "The person who allowed arms to be carried on the day on which it was forbidden to carry them (he meant Al-Hajjaj)
hi: Sa'id bin Amr bin Sa'id bin Al-Aas bataate hain: Al-Hajjaj Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas gaye jabke main wahan maujood tha. Al-Hajjaj ne Ibn Umar se pucha: "Aap kaise hain?" Ibn Umar ne jawab diya: "Main theek hoon." Al-Hajjaj ne pucha: "Aapko kisne zakhmi kiya?" Ibn Umar ne jawab diya: "Woh shaks jisne uss din hathiyaar le jaane ki ijazat di jab yeh mana tha" (unka matlab khud Al-Hajjaj se tha).

e: Narrated Al-Bara':The Prophet (ﷺ) delivered the Khutba on the day of Nahr (`Id-ul-Adha) and said, "The first thing we should do on this day of ours is to pray and then return and slaughter (our sacrifices). So anyone who does so he acted according to our Sunna; and whoever slaughtered before the prayer then it was just meat that he offered to his family and would not be considered as a sacrifice in any way. My uncle Abu Burda bin Niyar got up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I slaughtered the sacrifice before the prayer but I have a young she-goat which is better than an older sheep." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Slaughter it in lieu of the first and such a goat will not be considered as a sacrifice for anybody else after you
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Nabi ne Yaum-un-Nahr (Eid-ul-Adha) ke din khutba di aur farmaya: "Humein sabse pehle jo karna chahiye woh namaz hai, phir wapas jaakar zabah karna. Jo aisa kare, usne humari Sunnat ke mutabiq amal kiya; aur jisne namaz se pehle zabah kiya, woh sirf gosht hai jo usne apne ghar walon ko diya, ise kisi bhi tarah qurbani nahi mana jayega." Mere chacha Abu Burda bin Niyar khade hue aur kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Maine qurbani namaz se pehle zabah kar li magar mere paas ek jawan bakri hai jo ek purani bhed se behtar hai." Nabi ne farmaya: "Ise pehli ke badle mein zabah kar do, aur aisi bakri tumhare baad kisi aur ke liye qurbani nahi maani jayegi."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No good deeds done on other days are superior to those done on these (first ten days of Dhul Hijja)." Then some companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Not even Jihad?" He replied, "Not even Jihad, except that of a man who does it by putting himself and his property in danger (for Allah's sake) and does not return with any of those things
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "In dinon (Zul-Hijja ke pehle das dinon) mein kiye gaye neik amal se behtar koi neik amal doosre dinon mein nahi hote." Kuch sahaba ne pucha: "Jihad bhi nahi?" Aap ne jawab diya: "Jihad bhi nahi, siwaye us shaks ke jo apni jaan aur maal dono khatre mein daal kar (Allah ke liye) nikle aur kuch bhi wapas na laaye."

e: Narrated Muhammad bin Abi Bakr Al-Thaqafi:While we were going from Mina to `Arafat, I asked Anas bin Malik, about Talbiya, "How did you use to say Talbiya in the company of the Prophet?" Anas said: "People used to say Talbiya and their saying was not objected to and they used to say Takbir and that was not objected to either
hi: Muhammad bin Abi Bakr Al-Thaqafi bataate hain: Jab hum Mina se Arafat ja rahe the, maine Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se Talbiya ke baare mein pucha: "Nabi ki sohbat mein aap kaise Talbiya kehte the?" Anas ne kaha: "Log Talbiya kehte the aur unhe roka nahi jaata tha, aur woh Takbir bhi kehte the aur unhe bhi roka nahi jaata tha."

e: Narrated Um `Atiya:We used to be ordered to come out on the Day of `Id and even bring out the virgin girls from their houses and menstruating women so that they might stand behind the men and say Takbir along with them and invoke Allah along with them and hope for the blessings of that day and for purification from sins
hi: Um Atiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Humein hukum diya jaata tha ke Eid ke din bahar aayen, kunwari ladkiyon aur haiz wali aurton ko bhi apne gharon se laayen taake woh mardon ke peechhe khadi hokar unke saath Takbir kahen aur Allah se dua karein, aur us din ki barkaton aur gunahon se paaki ki ummeed rakhein.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar: On the day of `Id-ul-Fitr and `Id-ul-Adha a spear used to be planted in front of the Prophet (as a Sutra for the prayer) and then he would pray
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Eid-ul-Fitr aur Eid-ul-Adha ke din Nabi ke saamne ek neza gaada jaata (Sutra ke tor par), phir Aap namaz padhte.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to proceed to the Musalla and an 'Anaza used to be carried before him and planted in the Musalla in front of him and he would pray facing it (as a Sutra)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi Musalla jaate the, aur unke aage ek Anaza (chhota neza) le jaya jaata jo Musalla mein unke saamne gaada jaata, aur Aap uski taraf mun karke (Sutra ke tor par) namaz padhte.

e: Narrated Muhammad:Um 'Atiyya said: "Our Prophet ordered us to come out (on `Id day) with the mature girls and the virgins staying in seclusion." Hafsa narrated the above mentioned Hadith and added, "The mature girls or virgins staying in seclusion but the menstruating women had to keep away from the Musalla
hi: Muhammad bataate hain: Um Atiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha: "Humare Nabi ne humein hukum diya ke hum baaligh ladkiyon aur parda-nasheen kunwari ladkiyon ko bhi (Eid ke din) leke aayen." Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne yehi hadith bayan ki aur joda: "Baaligh ladkiyan ya parda-nasheen kunwari ladkiyan, magar haiz wali aurtein Musalla se door rahein."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I (in my boyhood) went out with the Prophet (ﷺ) on the day of `Id ul Fitr or Id-ul-Adha. The Prophet (ﷺ) prayed and then delivered the Khutba and then went towards the women, preached and advised them and ordered them to give alms
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Main (bachpan mein) Nabi ke saath Eid-ul-Fitr ya Eid-ul-Adha ke din bahar gaya. Nabi ne namaz padhi, phir khutba di, phir aurton ki taraf gaye, unhe naseehat ki aur sadqa dene ka hukum diya.

e: Narrated Al-Bara':The Prophet (ﷺ) went towards Al-Baqi (the graveyard at Medina) on the day of Id-ul-Adha and offered a two-rak`at prayer (of `Id-ul-Adha) and then faced us and said, "On this day of ours, our first act of worship is the offering of prayer and then we will return and slaughter the sacrifice, and whoever does this concords with our Sunna; and whoever slaughtered his sacrifice before that (i.e. before the prayer) then that was a thing which he prepared earlier for his family and it would not be considered as a Nusuk (sacrifice.)" A man stood up and said, "O, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I slaughtered (the animal before the prayer) but I have a young she-goat which is better than an older sheep." The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "Slaughter it. But a similar sacrifice will not be sufficient for anybody else after you
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Nabi Eid-ul-Adha ke din Al-Baqi (Madina ka qabristan) ki taraf gaye aur (Eid-ul-Adha ki) do rakat namaz padhi, phir humari taraf mud kar farmaya: "Aaj ke din humari sabse pehli ibadat namaz hai, phir hum wapas jaakar qurbani zabah karenge, aur jo aisa kare, usne humari Sunnat ke mutabiq amal kiya; aur jisne usse pehle (namaz se pehle) apni qurbani zabah ki, woh ek cheez thi jo usne apne ghar walon ke liye pehle se taiyaar ki thi aur use Nusuk (qurbani) nahi maana jayega." Ek shaks khada hokar bola: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Maine zabah kiya (namaz se pehle) magar mere paas ek jawan bakri hai jo ek purani bhed se behtar hai." Nabi ne unse kaha: "Ise zabah kar do. Magar tumhare baad kisi aur ke liye aisi qurbani kaafi nahi hogi."

e: Narrated `Abdur Rahman bin `Abis:Ibn `Abbas was asked whether he had joined the Prophet (ﷺ) in the `Id prayer. He said, "Yes. And I could not have joined him had I not been young. (The Prophet (ﷺ) came out) till he reached the mark which was near the house of Kathir bin As-Salt, offered the prayer, delivered the Khutba and then went towards the women. Bilal was accompanying him. He preached to them and advised them and ordered them to give alms. I saw the women putting their ornaments with their outstretched hands into Bilal's garment. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) along with Bilal returned home
hi: Abdur Rahman bin Abis bataate hain: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha gaya kya woh Nabi ke saath Eid ki namaz mein shareek hue the. Unhone kaha: "Haan. Aur main shareek na ho paata agar main jawan (chhota) na hota. (Nabi bahar gaye) yahan tak ke woh us nishaan tak pahunche jo Kathir bin As-Salt ke ghar ke qareeb tha, namaz padhi, khutba di, phir aurton ki taraf gaye. Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) unke saath the. Aap ne unhe waaz kiya, naseehat di aur sadqa dene ka hukum diya. Maine dekha aurtein apne zewar Bilal ke libaas mein daal rahi thin, apne haath badhaate huye. Phir Nabi Bilal ke saath ghar wapas gaye."

e: Narrated Ibn Juraij:`Ata' told me that he had heard Jabir bin `Abdullah saying, "The Prophet (ﷺ) stood up to offer the prayer of the `Id ul Fitr. He first offered the prayer and then delivered the Khutba. After finishing it he got down (from the pulpit) and went towards the women and advised them while he was leaning on Bilal's hand. Bilal was spreading out his garment where the women were putting their alms." I asked `Ata' whether it was the Zakat of `Id ul Fitr. He said, "No, it was just alms given at that time. Some lady put her finger ring and the others would do the same." I said, (to `Ata'), "Do you think that it is incumbent upon the Imam to give advice to the women (on `Id day)?" He said, "No doubt, it is incumbent upon the Imams to do so and why should they not do so?
hi: Ibn Juraij bataate hain: Ata ne mujhe bataya ke unhone Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko kehte suna: "Nabi Eid-ul-Fitr ki namaz padhane khade hue. Aap ne pehle namaz padhi, phir khutba di. Khutba khatam karke, Aap (mimbar se) utre aur aurton ki taraf gaye aur unhe naseehat di, jabke Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke haath ka sahara le rahe the. Bilal apna libaas failaaye huye the jahan aurtein sadqa daal rahi thin." Maine Ata se pucha kya yeh Eid-ul-Fitr ki Zakat thi. Unhone kaha: "Nahi, yeh sirf us waqt diya gaya sadqa tha. Koi aurat apni angoothi deti, doosri bhi waisa hi karti." Maine (Ata se) pucha: "Kya aapko lagta hai Imam ke liye aurton ko (Eid ke din) naseehat dena zaroori hai?" Unhone kaha: "Beshak, Imamon ke liye yeh zaroori hai, aur woh aisa kyun na karein?"

e: Al-Hasan bin Muslim told me that Ibn `Abbas had said, "I joined the Prophet, Abu Bakr, `Umar and `Uthman in the `Id ul Fitr prayers. They used to offer the prayer before the Khutba and then they used to deliver the Khutba afterwards. Once the Prophet (ﷺ) I came out (for the `Id prayer) as if I were just observing him waving to the people to sit down. He, then accompanied by Bilal, came crossing the rows till he reached the women. He recited the following verse:'O Prophet! When the believing women come to you to take the oath of fealty to you . . . (to the end of the verse) (60.12).' After finishing the recitation he said, "O ladies! Are you fulfilling your covenant?" None except one woman said, "Yes." Hasan did not know who was that woman. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Then give alms." Bilal spread his garment and said, "Keep on giving alms. Let my father and mother sacrifice their lives for you (ladies)." So the ladies kept on putting their Fatkhs (big rings) and other kinds of rings in Bilal's garment." `Abdur-Razaq said, " 'Fatkhs' is a big ring which used to be worn in the (Pre-Islamic) period of ignorance
hi: Al-Hasan bin Muslim ne mujhe bataya ke Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Main Nabi, Abu Bakr, Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath Eid-ul-Fitr ki namazon mein shareek hua. Woh khutba se pehle namaz padhte aur uske baad khutba dete. Ek baar Nabi bahar aaye (Eid ki namaz ke liye), goya main unhe dekh raha hoon logon ko baithne ka ishara karte huye. Phir woh, Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath, safon ko paar karte hue aurton tak pahunche. Unhone yeh ayat tilawat ki: 'Aye Nabi! Jab momin aurtein tumse bai'at karne aayein...' (poori ayat tak) (60:12). Tilawat khatam karke Aap ne kaha: 'Aye aurton! Kya tum apna ahd nibhaa rahi ho?' Sirf ek aurat ne 'Haan' kaha (Hasan ko yaad nahi kaun thi). Nabi ne farmaya: 'To sadqa do.' Bilal ne apna libaas failaaya aur kaha: 'Sadqa dete raho. Mere maa-baap aap (aurtein) par qurban hon.' To aurtein apne Fatkh (bade angoothiyaan) aur doosri qism ki angoothiyaan Bilal ke libaas mein daalne lagin." Abdur-Razaq ne kaha: "'Fatkh' ek badi angoothi thi jo jahiliyat ke zamane mein pehni jaati thi."

e: Narrated Aiyub:Hafsa bint Seereen said, "On Id we used to forbid our girls to go out for `Id prayer. A lady came and stayed at the palace of Bani Khalaf and I went to her. She said, 'The husband of my sister took part in twelve holy battles along with the Prophet (ﷺ) and my sister was with her husband in six of them. My sister said that they used to nurse the sick and treat the wounded. Once she asked, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! If a woman has no veil, is there any harm if she does not come out (on `Id day)?' The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Her companion should let her share her veil with her, and the women should participate in the good deeds and in the religious gatherings of the believers.' " Hafsa added, "When Um-`Atiya came, I went to her and asked her, 'Did you hear anything about so-and-so?' Um-`Atiya said, 'Yes, let my father be sacrificed for the Prophet (ﷺ). (And whenever she mentioned the name of the Prophet (ﷺ) she always used to say, 'Let my father be sacrificed for him'). He said, 'Virgin mature girls staying often screened (or said, 'Mature girls and virgins staying often screened--Aiyub is not sure as which was right) and menstruating women should come out (on the `Id day). But the menstruating women should keep away from the Musalla. And all the women should participate in the good deeds and in the religious gatherings of the believers'." Hafsa said, "On that I said to Um-`Atiya, 'Also those who are menstruating?' " Um-`Atiya replied, "Yes. Do they not present themselves at `Arafat and elsewhere?
hi: Aiyub bataate hain: Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Seereen ne kaha: "Eid ke din hum apni ladkiyon ko Eid ki namaz ke liye bahar jaane se rokte the. Ek aurat aayi aur Bani Khalaf ke mahal mein thehri, main unse milne gayi. Usne kaha: 'Meri behn ke shohar ne Nabi ke saath barah jungein ladi thin, aur meri behn unme se chhe mein apne shohar ke saath thi.' Meri behn ne kaha: 'Hum bimaron ki dekhbhal karte aur zakhmiyon ka ilaaj karte the. Ek baar usne pucha: Ya Allah ke Rasool! Agar aurat ke paas parda (chadar) na ho, to kya usse (Eid ke din) bahar na aana koi harj hai?' Nabi ne farmaya: 'Uski sathi apna parda usse baant le, aur aurton ko neik kaamon aur Musalmanon ki majlison mein shareek hona chahiye.'" Hafsa ne joda: "Jab Um-Atiya aayi, main unse milne gayi aur pucha: 'Kya aapne falaan ke baare mein kuch suna hai?' Um-Atiya ne kaha: 'Haan, mera baap Nabi par qurban ho.' (Jab bhi woh Nabi ka naam letin, kehti: 'Mera baap unpar qurban ho.') 'Aap ne farmaya: Baaligh kunwari ladkiyan aur parda-nasheen ladkiyan (ya kaha: baaligh aur parda-nasheen kunwari ladkiyan — Aiyub ko yaqeen nahi kaun sahi tha) aur haiz wali aurtein sab bahar aayen (Eid ke din). Magar haiz wali Musalla se door rahen. Aur sab aurton ko neik kaamon aur Musalmanon ki majlison mein shareek hona chahiye.'" Hafsa ne kaha: "Iske baad maine Um-Atiya se pucha: 'Haiz wali bhi?' Um-Atiya ne jawab diya: 'Haan. Kya woh Arafat aur doosri jagahon par (Hajj mein) maujood nahi hoti?'"

e: Narrated Um-`Atiya:We were ordered to go out (for `Id) and also to take along with us the menstruating women, mature girls and virgins staying in seclusion. (Ibn `Aun said, "Or mature virgins staying in seclusion)." The menstruating women could present themselves at the religious gathering and invocation of Muslims but should keep away from their Musalla
hi: Um-Atiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Humein hukum diya gaya tha ke hum (Eid ke liye) bahar jaayein aur apne saath haiz wali aurton, baaligh ladkiyon aur parda-nasheen kunwari ladkiyon ko bhi lein jaayein. (Ibn Aun ne kaha: "Ya baaligh parda-nasheen kunwari ladkiyan.") Haiz wali aurtein Musalmanon ki deeni majlis aur dua mein shareek ho sakti thin magar apni Musalla se door rehti thin.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to Nahr or slaughter sacrifices at the Musalla (on `Id-ul-Adha)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi Musalla mein hi Nahr karte ya qurbaniyan zabah karte the (Eid-ul-Adha ke din).

e: Narrated Al-Bara' bin `Azib:On the day of Nahr Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) delivered the Khutba after the `Id prayer and said, "Anyone who prayed like us and slaughtered the sacrifice like we did then he acted according to our (Nusuk) tradition of sacrificing, and whoever slaughtered the sacrifice before the prayer, then that was just mutton (i.e. not sacrifice)." Abu Burda bin Niyar stood up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! By Allah, I slaughtered my sacrifice before I offered the (Id) prayer and thought that today was the day of eating and drinking (non-alcoholic drinks) and so I made haste (in slaughtering) and ate and also fed my family and neighbors." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "That was just mutton (not a sacrifice)." Then Abu Burda said, "I have a young she-goat and no doubt, it is better than two sheep. Will that be sufficient as a sacrifice for me?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Yes. But it will not be sufficient for anyone else (as a sacrifice), after you
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Yaum-un-Nahr ke din Allah ke Rasool ne Eid ki namaz ke baad khutba di aur farmaya: "Jo humari tarah namaz padhe aur humari tarah qurbani zabah kare, usne humari (Nusuk) qurbani ki riwayat ke mutabiq amal kiya, aur jisne namaz se pehle apni qurbani zabah ki, woh sirf gosht hai (yaani qurbani nahi)." Abu Burda bin Niyar khade hue aur kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Allah ki qasam, maine (Eid ki) namaz padhne se pehle apni qurbani zabah kar li thi aur socha ke aaj khane-peene ka din hai (halal cheezon ka), isliye maine jaldi ki (zabah karke) aur khaya aur apne ghar walon aur padosiyon ko bhi khilaya." Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Woh sirf gosht tha (qurbani nahi)." Phir Abu Burda ne kaha: "Mere paas ek jawan bakri hai, aur beshak woh do bhedon se behtar hai. Kya woh meri taraf se qurbani ke liye kaafi hogi?" Nabi ne jawab diya: "Haan. Magar tumhare baad kisi aur ke liye (qurbani ke tor par) kaafi nahi hogi."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) offered the prayer on the day of Nahr and then delivered the Khutba and ordered that whoever had slaughtered his sacrifice before the prayer should repeat it, that is, should slaughter another sacrifice. Then a person from the Ansar stood up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! because of my neighbors (he described them as being very needy or poor) I slaughtered before the prayer. I have a young she-goat which, in my opinion, is better than two sheep." The Prophet (ﷺ) gave him the permission for slaughtering it as a sacrifice
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Yaum-un-Nahr ke din namaz padhi, phir khutba di aur hukum diya ke jisne namaz se pehle apni qurbani zabah ki hai, woh dobara zabah kare, yaani doosri qurbani zabah kare. Phir Ansaar mein se ek shaks khada hokar bola: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Apne padosiyon (jinhe unhone bahut zaroorat-mand ya gareeb bataya) ki wajah se maine namaz se pehle zabah kar liya. Mere paas ek jawan bakri hai jo mere khayaal se do bhedon se behtar hai." Nabi ne unhe ise qurbani ke tor par zabah karne ki ijazat di.

e: Narrated Jundab:On the day of Nahr the Prophet (ﷺ) offered the prayer and delivered the Khutba and then slaughtered the sacrifice and said, "Anybody who slaughtered (his sacrifice) before the prayer should slaughter another animal in lieu of it, and the one who has not yet slaughtered should slaughter the sacrifice mentioning Allah's name on it
hi: Jundab (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Yaum-un-Nahr ke din Nabi ne namaz padhi, khutba di, phir qurbani zabah ki aur farmaya: "Jisne namaz se pehle apni qurbani zabah ki hai, use uske badle mein ek aur janwar zabah karna chahiye, aur jisne abhi tak zabah nahi ki, use zabah karte waqt Allah ka naam le."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:On the Day of `Id the Prophet (ﷺ) used to return (after offering the `Id prayer) through a way different from that by which he went
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Eid ke din Nabi (Eid ki namaz padhne ke baad) wapas usse doosre raaste se jaate the jis raaste se woh gaye the.

e: Narrated `Urwa on the authority of `Aisha:On the days of Mina, (11th, 12th, and 13th of Dhul-Hijjah) Abu Bakr came to her while two young girls were beating the tambourine and the Prophet (ﷺ) was lying covered with his clothes. Abu Bakr scolded them and the Prophet (ﷺ) uncovered his face and said to Abu Bakr, "Leave them, for these days are the days of `Id and the days of Mina." `Aisha further said, "Once the Prophet (ﷺ) was screening me and I was watching the display of black slaves in the Mosque and (`Umar) scolded them. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Leave them. O Bani Arfida! (carry on), you are safe (protected)
hi: Urwa, Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke hawale se bataate hain: Mina ke dinon (Zul-Hijja ki 11, 12, 13 taareekh) mein Abu Bakr unke paas aaye jabke do jawan ladkiyan daf (tambourine) baja rahi thin aur Nabi apne kapdon mein lipat kar let gaye the. Abu Bakr ne unhe daanta, aur Nabi ne apna chehra khol kar Abu Bakr se kaha: "Unhe rehne do, kyunke yeh Eid ke din hain aur Mina ke din hain." Ayesha ne aage kaha: "Ek baar Nabi mujhe parda kar rahe the aur main masjid mein kaale gulamon ka khel dekh rahi thi, (Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ)) ne unhe daanta. Nabi ne farmaya: 'Unhe rehne do. Aye Bani Arfida! (Jaari rakho), tum mehfooz ho.'"

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) went out and offered a two rak`at prayer on the Day of `Id ul Fitr and did not offer any other prayer before or after it and at that time Bilal was accompanying him
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi bahar gaye aur Eid-ul-Fitr ke din do rakat namaz padhi, aur usse pehle ya baad koi doosri namaz nahi padhi, aur us waqt Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) unke saath the.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar: Once a person asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about the night prayer. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) replied, "The night prayer is offered as two Rak`at followed by two Rak`at and so on and if anyone is afraid of the approaching dawn (Fajr prayer) he should pray one Rak`ah and this will be a Witr for all the Rak`at which he has prayed before
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Ek baar kisi ne Allah ke Rasool se raat ki namaz ke baare mein pucha. Allah ke Rasool ne jawab diya: "Raat ki namaz do-do rakat karke padhi jaati hai, aur agar Fajr ka waqt hone ka dar ho, to ek rakat padho, yeh saari padhi hui rakaton ka Witr ban jayega."

e: Nafi` told that `Abdullah bin `Umar used to say Taslim between (the first) two Rak`at and (the third) odd one in the Witr prayer, when he wanted to attend to a certain matter (during that interval between the Rak`at)
hi: Nafi bataate hain ke Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) Witr ki namaz mein (pehli) do rakat aur (teesri) taaq rakat ke darmiyan Taslim kehte the, jab unhe kisi kaam se (beech mein) uthna hota.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Once I passed the night in the house of Maimuna (his aunt). I slept across the bed while Allah's Apostle and his wife slept length-wise. The Prophet (ﷺ) slept till midnight or nearly so and woke up rubbing his face and recited ten verses from Surat "Al-`Imran." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went towards a leather skin and performed ablution in the most perfect way and then stood for the prayer. I did the same and stood beside him. The Prophet (ﷺ) put his right hand on my head, twisted my ear and then prayed two rak`at five times and then ended his prayer with witr. He laid down till the Mu'adh-dhin came then he stood up and offered two rak`at (Sunnah of Fajr prayer) and then went out and offered the Fajr prayer. (See Hadith)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Ek baar main Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) (apni khala) ke ghar raat guzari. Main takiye ki chaudi taraf leta, jabke Allah ke Rasool aur unki biwi lambi taraf lete. Nabi aadhi raat tak ya usse kuch kam so gaye, phir apna chehra malte hue uthe aur Surah Al-Imran ki das ayaat tilawat ki. Allah ke Rasool ek chamde ke mashkize ki taraf gaye aur behtareen tareeke se wudu kiya, phir namaz ke liye khade hue. Maine bhi waisa hi kiya aur unke bagal mein khada hua. Nabi ne apna dahina haath mere sar par rakha, mera kaan halke se moda, phir do rakat paanch baar padhi, aur apni namaz Witr par khatam ki. Phir let gaye yahan tak ke Muazzin aaye, phir uthe aur do rakat (Fajr ki Sunnat) padhi, phir bahar gaye aur Fajr ki namaz padhi.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Night prayer is offered as two rak`at followed by two rak`at and so on, and if you want to finish it, pray only one rak`a which will be witr for all the previous rak`at." Al-Qasim said, "Since we attained the age of puberty we have seen some people offering a three-rak`at prayer as witr and all that is permissible. I hope there will be no harm in it
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Raat ki namaz do-do rakat karke padhi jaati hai, aur agar tum ise khatam karna chaho, sirf ek rakat padho jo pichhli sab rakaton ka Witr ban jayegi." Al-Qasim ne kaha: "Jab se hum balig hue hain, humne kuch logon ko teen rakaton ka Witr padhte dekha hai, aur yeh sab jaiz hai. Mujhe ummeed hai isme koi harj nahi."

e: Narrated `A'isha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to pray eleven rak`at at night and that was his night prayer and each of his prostrations lasted for a period enough for one of you to recite fifty verses before Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) raised his head. He also used to pray two rak`at (Sunnah) before the (compulsory) Fajr prayer and then lie down on his right side till the Mu'adh-dhin came to him for the prayer
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain ke Allah ke Rasool raat ko gyarah rakat padhte the, yehi unki raat ki namaz thi, aur har sajda itni der ka hota tha ke usme tum mein se koi paanch ayaat tilawat kar sakta, isse pehle ke Allah ke Rasool apna sar uthaate. Aap Fajr ki farz namaz se pehle bhi do rakat (Sunnat) padhte, phir dahini karvat let jaate yahan tak ke Muazzin unhe namaz ke liye bulane aata.

e: Narrated Anas bin Seereen:I asked Ibn `Umar, "What is your opinion about the two rak`at before the Fajr (compulsory) prayer, as to prolonging the recitation in them?" He said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) used to pray at night two rak`at followed by two and so on, and end the prayer by one rak`ah witr. He used to offer two rak`at before the Fajr prayer immediately after the Adhan." (Hammad, the sub-narrator said, "That meant (that he prayed) quickly
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Seereen bataate hain: "Maine Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha: 'Fajr se pehle ki do rakat ke baare mein aapki kya raay hai — kya unme lambi tilawat ki jaaye?' Unhone jawab diya: 'Nabi raat ko do-do rakat karke padhte the aur namaz ek rakat Witr par khatam karte. Aap Adhan ke foran baad Fajr se pehle do rakat padhte the.'" (Hammad, doosre raawi ne kaha: "Iska matlab hai woh jaldi padhte the.")

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) offered witr prayer at different nights at various hours extending (from the `Isha' prayer) up to the last hour of the night
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain ke Allah ke Rasool alag-alag raaton mein alag-alag waqton par Witr padhte the, jo Isha ke baad se raat ke aakhri ghante tak phaila hota tha.

e: Narrated `A'isha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to offer his night prayer while I was sleeping across in his bed. Whenever he intended to offer the witr prayer, he used to wake me up and I would offer the witr prayer too
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain ke Nabi apni raat ki namaz padhte the jabke main unke bistar par aade leti hoti. Jab bhi Witr padhna chahte, mujhe jaga dete aur main bhi Witr padh leti.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Make witr as your last prayer at night
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Witr ko apni raat ki aakhri namaz banao."

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Yasar:I was going to Mecca in the company of `Abdullah bin `Umar and when I apprehended the approaching dawn, I dismounted and offered the witr prayer and then joined him. `Abdullah bin `Umar said, "Where have you been?" I replied, "I apprehended the approaching dawn so I dismounted and prayed the witr prayer." `Abdullah said, "Isn't it sufficient for you to follow the good example of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" I replied, "Yes, by Allah." He said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to pray witr on the back of the camel (while on a journey)
hi: Sa'id bin Yasar bataate hain: Main Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath Mecca ja raha tha, jab mujhe Fajr ka waqt aane ka dar hua, main utra aur Witr padhi, phir unse jaakar mila. Abdullah bin Umar ne pucha: "Kahan the?" Maine jawab diya: "Mujhe Fajr ka waqt aane ka dar tha isliye utar kar Witr padh li." Abdullah ne kaha: "Kya tumhare liye Allah ke Rasool ki achhi misaal ki pairvi karna kaafi nahi?" Maine kaha: "Haan, Allah ki qasam." Unhone kaha: "Allah ke Rasool oont ki pusht par (safar mein) Witr padha karte the."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to offer (Nawafil) prayers on his Rahila (mount) facing its direction by signals, but not the compulsory prayer. He also used to pray witr on his (mount) Rahila
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain ke Nabi apni Rahila (sawari) par (Nafil) namazein padhte, jidhar bhi Rahila mudti, ishare se (Qibla ki taraf) mun karte, magar farz namaz aise nahi padhte the. Aap apni Rahila par Witr bhi padhte the.

e: Narrated Muhammad bin Seereen:Anas was asked, "Did the Prophet (ﷺ) recite Qunut in the Fajr prayer?" Anas replied in the affirmative. He was further asked, "Did he recite Qunut before bowing?" Anas replied, "He recited Qunut after bowing for some time (for one month)
hi: Muhammad bin Seereen bataate hain: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha gaya: "Kya Nabi Fajr ki namaz mein Qunut padhte the?" Anas ne haan mein jawab diya. Unse phir pucha gaya: "Kya woh ruku se pehle Qunut padhte the?" Anas ne jawab diya: "Aap ne ruku ke baad, kuch waqt tak (ek mahine ke liye), Qunut padhi."

e: Narrated `Asim:I asked Anas bin Malik about the Qunut. Anas replied, "Definitely it was (recited)". I asked, "Before bowing or after it?" Anas replied, "Before bowing." I added, "So and so has told me that you had informed him that it had been after bowing." Anas said, "He told an untruth (i.e. "was mistaken," according to the Hijazi dialect). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) recited Qunut after bowing for a period of one month." Anas added, "The Prophet (ﷺ) sent about seventy men (who knew the Qur'an by heart) towards the pagans (of Najd) who were less than they in number and there was a peace treaty between them and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (but the Pagans broke the treaty and killed the seventy men). So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) recited Qunut for a period of one month asking Allah to punish them
hi: Asim bataate hain: "Maine Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se Qunut ke baare mein pucha. Anas ne jawab diya: 'Zaroor (padhi jaati thi).' Maine pucha: 'Ruku se pehle ya baad mein?' Anas ne jawab diya: 'Ruku se pehle.' Maine kaha: 'Falaan shaks ne mujhe bataya ke aapne unhe bataya tha yeh ruku ke baad thi.' Anas ne kaha: 'Usne galat baat kahi (yaani ghalti ki, Hijazi lehje mein).' Allah ke Rasool ne ek mahine tak ruku ke baad Qunut padhi." Anas ne joda: "Nabi ne taqreeban sattar aadmi (jo Quran hifz karte the) mushrikon (Najd ke) ki taraf bheje, jo tadaad mein unse kam the, aur unke aur Allah ke Rasool ke darmiyan sulah ka mu'ahida tha (magar mushrikon ne mu'ahida tod kar un sattar logon ko qatl kar diya). Isliye Allah ke Rasool ne ek mahine tak Qunut padhi, Allah se unhe saza dene ki dua karte huye."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) recited Qunut for one month (in the Fajr prayer) asking Allah to punish the tribes of Ral and Dhakwan
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne (Fajr ki namaz mein) ek mahine tak Qunut padhi, Allah se Ral aur Dhakwan qabilon ko saza dene ki dua karte huye.

e: Narrated Anas:The Qunut used to be recited in the Maghrib and the Fajr prayers
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Qunut Maghrib aur Fajr ki namazon mein padhi jaati thi.

e: Narrated `Abbad bin Tamim's uncle:The Prophet (ﷺ) went out to offer the Istisqa' prayer and turned (and put on) his cloak inside out
hi: Abbad bin Tamim, apne chacha ke hawale se: Nabi Istisqa ki namaz padhne bahar gaye aur apna chogha (ulta karke) pehna.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira;:Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) lifted his head from the bowing in the last rak`a he used to say: "O Allah! Save `Aiyash bin Abi Rabi`a. O Allah! Save Salama bin Hisham. O Allah! Save Walid bin Walid. O Allah! Save the weak faithful believers. O Allah! Be hard on the tribes of Mudar and send (famine) years on them like the famine years of (Prophet) Joseph ." The Prophet (ﷺ) further said, "Allah forgive the tribes of Ghifar and save the tribes of Aslam." Abu Az-Zinad (a sub-narrator) said, "The Qunut used to be recited by the Prophet (ﷺ) in the Fajr prayer
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab bhi Nabi aakhri rakat mein ruku se sar uthate, kehte: "Aye Allah! Aiyash bin Abi Rabi'a ko bacha. Aye Allah! Salama bin Hisham ko bacha. Aye Allah! Walid bin Walid ko bacha. Aye Allah! Kamzor sacche momino ko bacha. Aye Allah! Mudar qabilon par sakhti kar aur unhe Yusuf ke akaal jaisa akaal (famine) mein daal." Nabi ne yeh bhi farmaya: "Allah Ghifar qabilon ko maaf kare aur Aslam qabilon ko bacha le." Abu Az-Zinad ne kaha: "Yeh Qunut Nabi Fajr ki namaz mein padhte the."

e: Narrated Masruq:We were with `Abdullah and he said, "When the Prophet (ﷺ) saw the refusal of the people to accept Islam he said, "O Allah! Send (famine) years on them for (seven years) like the seven years (of famine during the time) of (Prophet) Joseph." So famine overtook them for one year and destroyed every kind of life to such an extent that the people started eating hides, carcasses and rotten dead animals. Whenever one of them looked towards the sky, he would (imagine himself to) see smoke because of hunger. So Abu Sufyan went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Muhammad! You order people to obey Allah and to keep good relations with kith and kin. No doubt the people of your tribe are dying, so please pray to Allah for them." So Allah revealed: "Then watch you For the day that The sky will bring forth a kind Of smoke Plainly visible ... Verily! You will return (to disbelief) On the day when We shall seize You with a mighty grasp. (44.10-16) Ibn Mas`ud added, "Al-Batsha (i.e. grasp) happened in the battle of Badr and no doubt smoke, Al-Batsha, Al-Lizam, and the verse of Surat Ar-Rum have all passed
hi: Masruq bataate hain: Hum Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath the, unhone kaha: "Jab Nabi ne logon ka Islam qubool karne se inkaar dekha, farmaya: 'Aye Allah! Unpar (akaal ke) saat saal utaar de jaise Yusuf ke zamane mein saat saal ka akaal aaya tha.' To ek saal akaal aaya jisne har qisam ki zindagi barbaad kar di, yahan tak ke log khaal, murda janwar aur galay-sadhe janwar khane lage. Jab bhi koi aasman ki taraf dekhta, bhookh ki wajah se use dhuan dikhta. Isliye Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ) Nabi ke paas gaye aur kaha: 'Aye Muhammad! Aap log ko Allah ki itaa'at aur rishtedaron se achha suluk rakhne ka hukum dete hain. Beshak aapki qaum mar rahi hai, isliye unke liye Allah se dua kijiye.' To Allah ne nazil farmaya: 'Tab dekho us din ka intezar jab aasman saaf dikhne wala dhuan lekar aayega... Beshak tum wapas jaoge (kufr ki taraf) us din jab hum tumhe sakht pakad se pakdenge' (44:10-16)." Ibn Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne joda: "Al-Batsha (yaani pakad) Badr ki jung mein hui, aur dhuan, Al-Batsha, Al-Lizam, aur Surah Ar-Rum ki ayat — sab guzar chuki hain."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Dinar:My father said, "I heard Ibn `Umar reciting the poetic verses of Abu Talib: And a white (person) (i.e. the Prophet) who is requested to pray for rain and who takes care of the orphans and is the guardian of widows." Salim's father (Ibn `Umar) said, "The following poetic verse occurred to my mind while I was looking at the face of the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was praying for rain. He did not get down till the rain water flowed profusely from every roof-gutter: And a white (person) who is requested to pray for rain and who takes care of the orphans and is the guardian of widows . . . And these were the words of Abu Talib
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Dinar bataate hain: Mere waalid ne kaha: "Maine Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko Abu Talib ke she'r padhte suna: 'Aur ek saaf-safed (shaks — yaani Nabi) jinse baarish ki dua maangi jaati hai, jo yateemon ki dekhbhal karte hain aur bewaon ke hami hain.'" Salim ke waalid (Ibn Umar) ne kaha: "Yeh she'r tab mere zehen mein aaya jab main Nabi ka chehra dekh raha tha jabke woh baarish ke liye dua kar rahe the. Aap tab tak (mimbar se) nahi utre jab tak har chhat ke naale se paani nahi bahne laga: 'Aur ek saaf-safed jinse baarish ki dua maangi jaati hai, jo yateemon ki dekhbhal karte hain aur bewaon ke hami hain...' Aur yeh Abu Talib ke alfaaz the."

e: Narrated Anas:Whenever drought threatened them, `Umar bin Al-Khattab, used to ask Al-Abbas bin `Abdul Muttalib to invoke Allah for rain. He used to say, "O Allah! We used to ask our Prophet to invoke You for rain, and You would bless us with rain, and now we ask his uncle to invoke You for rain. O Allah ! Bless us with rain."(1) And so it would rain
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab bhi sookha (akaal) ka khatra hota, Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Khattab (رضی اللہ عنہ) Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib se baarish ke liye Allah se dua karne ko kehte the. Umar kehte: "Aye Allah! Hum apne Nabi se aapse baarish maangte the, to aap humein baarish se nawazte the, aur ab hum unke chacha se dua karwa rahe hain. Aye Allah! Humein baarish se nawaz." Aur baarish ho jaati.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Zaid:The Prophet (ﷺ) turned his cloak inside out on Istisqa
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Istisqa ke waqt apna chogha ulta kar pehna.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Zaid:The Prophet (ﷺ) went towards the Musalla and invoked Allah for rain. He faced the Qibla and wore his cloak inside out, and offered two rak`at
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi Musalla gaye aur Allah se baarish ki dua ki. Aap ne Qibla ki taraf mun kiya, apna chogha ulta pehna, aur do rakat padhi.

e: Narrated Sharik bin `Abdullah bin Abi Namir:I heard Anas bin Malik saying, "On a Friday a person entered the main Mosque through the gate facing the pulpit while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was delivering the Khutba. The man stood in front of Allah's Apostle and said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! The livestock are dying and the roads are cut off; so please pray to Allah for rain.' " Anas added, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) raised both his hands and said, 'O Allah! Bless us with rain! O Allah! Bless us with rain! O Allah! Bless us with rain!' " Anas added, "By Allah, we could not see any trace of cloud in the sky and there was no building or a house between us and (the mountains of) Sila." Anas added, "A heavy cloud like a shield appeared from behind it (i.e. Sila' Mountain). When it came in the middle of the sky, it spread and then rained." Anas further said, "By Allah! We could not see the sun for a week. Next Friday a person entered through the same gate and at that time Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was delivering the Friday's Khutba. The man stood in front of him and said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! The livestock are dying and the roads are cut off, please pray to Allah to withhold rain.'" Anas added, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) raised both his hands and said, 'O Allah! Round about us and not on us. O Allah! On the plateaus, on the mountains, on the hills, in the valleys and on the places where trees grow.' So the rain stopped and we came out walking in the sun." Sharik asked Anas whether it was the same person who had asked for the rain (the last Friday). Anas replied that he did not know
hi: Sharik bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Namir bataate hain: "Maine Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko kehte suna: 'Ek Jumme ko ek shaks mimbar ke saamne wale darwaze se masjid mein daakhil hua jabke Allah ke Rasool khutba de rahe the. Woh shaks Allah ke Rasool ke saamne khada hokar bola: Ya Allah ke Rasool! Maal-maweshi mar rahe hain aur raaste band ho gaye hain; Allah se baarish ki dua kijiye.'" Anas ne joda: "Allah ke Rasool ne donon haath uthaye aur kaha: 'Aye Allah! Humein baarish se nawaz! Aye Allah! Humein baarish se nawaz! Aye Allah! Humein baarish se nawaz!'" Anas ne joda: "Allah ki qasam, humein aasman mein baadal ka koi nishaan nahi dikha tha, aur humare aur Sila (pahad) ke darmiyan koi imaarat ya ghar nahi tha." Anas ne joda: "Ek bhaari baadal dhaal ki tarah uske (Sila pahad ke) peechhe se nazar aaya. Jab woh aasman ke beech pahuncha, phail gaya aur baarish shuru ho gayi." Anas ne aage kaha: "Allah ki qasam! Hum ek hafte tak suraj nahi dekh sake. Agle Jumme ko usi darwaze se ek shaks daakhil hua, aur us waqt Allah ke Rasool Jumme ka khutba de rahe the. Shaks unke saamne khada hokar bola: 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Maal-maweshi mar rahe hain aur raaste band hain, Allah se baarish rokne ki dua kijiye.'" Anas ne joda: "Allah ke Rasool ne donon haath uthaye aur kaha: 'Aye Allah! Humare aas-paas, humpar nahi. Aye Allah! Pathareeli zameenon par, pahadon par, tibbon par, wadiyon mein, aur un jagahon par jahan darakht ugte hain.' To baarish ruk gayi aur hum dhoop mein bahar nikle." Sharik ne Anas se pucha kya yeh wahi shaks tha jisne pichhle Jumme baarish maangi thi. Anas ne kaha unhe nahi pata.

e: Narrated Sharik:Anas bin Malik said, "A person entered the Mosque on a Friday through the gate facing the Daril- Qada' and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was standing delivering the Khutba (sermon). The man stood in front of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), livestock are dying and the roads are cut off; please pray to Allah for rain.' So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) raised both his hands and said, 'O Allah! Bless us with rain. O Allah! Bless us with rain. O Allah! Bless us with rain!" Anas added, "By Allah, there were no clouds in the sky and there was no house or building between us and the mountain of Sila'. Then a big cloud like a shield appeared from behind it (i.e. Sila' Mountain) and when it came in the middle of the sky, it spread and then rained. By Allah! We could not see the sun for a week. The next Friday, a person entered through the same gate and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was delivering the Friday Khutba and the man stood in front of him and said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! The livestock are dying and the roads are cut off; Please pray to Allah to withhold rain.' " Anas added, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) raised both his hands and said, 'O Allah! Round about us and not on us. O Allah!' On the plateaus, on the mountains, on the hills, in the valleys and on the places where trees grow.' " Anas added, "The rain stopped and we came out, walking in the sun." Sharik asked Anas whether it was the same person who had asked for rain the previous Friday. Anas replied that he did not know
hi: Sharik bataate hain: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Ek shaks Jumme ke din masjid mein Daril-Qada ke saamne wale darwaze se daakhil hua, aur Allah ke Rasool khade hokar khutba de rahe the. Shaks Allah ke Rasool ke saamne khada hokar bola: 'Ya Allah ke Rasool, maal-maweshi mar rahe hain aur raaste band hain; Allah se baarish ki dua kijiye.' To Allah ke Rasool ne donon haath uthaye aur kaha: 'Aye Allah! Humein baarish se nawaz. Aye Allah! Humein baarish se nawaz. Aye Allah! Humein baarish se nawaz!'" Anas ne joda: "Allah ki qasam, aasman mein koi baadal nahi tha aur humare aur Sila pahad ke darmiyan koi ghar ya imaarat nahi thi. Phir ek bada baadal dhaal ki tarah uske peechhe se nazar aaya aur jab woh aasman ke beech pahuncha, phail gaya aur baarish hone lagi. Allah ki qasam! Hum ek hafte tak suraj nahi dekh sake. Agle Jumme ko, ek shaks usi darwaze se daakhil hua aur Allah ke Rasool Jumme ka khutba de rahe the, shaks unke saamne khada hokar bola: 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Maal-maweshi mar rahe hain aur raaste band hain; Allah se baarish rokne ki dua kijiye.'" Anas ne joda: "Allah ke Rasool ne donon haath uthaye aur kaha: 'Aye Allah! Humare aas-paas, humpar nahi. Aye Allah!' Pathareeli zameenon par, pahadon par, tibbon par, wadiyon mein, aur un jagahon par jahan darakht ugte hain.'" Anas ne joda: "Baarish ruk gayi aur hum dhoop mein bahar nikle." Sharik ne Anas se pucha kya yeh wahi shaks tha jisne pichhle Jumme baarish maangi thi. Anas ne kaha unhe nahi pata.

e: Narrated Qatada:Anas said, "While Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was delivering the Friday Khutba (sermon) a man came and said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Rain is scarce; please ask Allah to bless us with rain.' So he invoked Allah for it, and it rained so much that we could hardly reach our homes and it continued raining till the next Friday." Anas further said, "Then the same or some other person stood up and said, 'O Allah's Apostle! Invoke Allah to withhold the rain.' On that, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'O Allah! Round about us and not on us.'" Anas added, "I saw the clouds dispersing right and left and it continued to rain but not over Medina
hi: Qatada bataate hain: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Jabke Allah ke Rasool Jumme ka khutba de rahe the, ek shaks aaya aur kaha: 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Baarish kam hai; Allah se humein baarish se nawazne ki dua kijiye.' To Aap ne Allah se dua ki, aur itni baarish hui ke hum bamushkil apne gharon tak pahunch paaye, aur yeh agle Jumme tak jaari rahi." Anas ne aage kaha: "Phir wahi ya koi doosra shaks khada hokar bola: 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Allah se baarish rokne ki dua kijiye.' Yeh sunkar Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: 'Aye Allah! Humare aas-paas, humpar nahi.'" Anas ne joda: "Maine baadal dahine-baayen bikharte dekhe, aur baarish jaari rahi magar Madina par nahi."

e: Narrated Anas:A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "Livestock are destroyed and the roads are cut off." So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) invoked Allah for rain and it rained from that Friday till the next Friday. The same person came again and said, "Houses have collapsed, roads are cut off, and the livestock are destroyed. Please pray to Allah to withhold the rain." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (stood up and) said, "O Allah! (Let it rain) on the plateaus, on the hills, in the valleys and over the places where trees grow." So the clouds cleared away from Medina as clothes are taken off
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks Nabi ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Maal-maweshi barbaad ho gaye hain aur raaste band hain." To Allah ke Rasool ne Allah se baarish ki dua ki aur us Jumme se agle Jumme tak baarish hoti rahi. Wahi shaks phir aaya aur kaha: "Ghar gir gaye hain, raaste band hain, aur maal-maweshi barbaad ho gaye hain. Kripya Allah se baarish rokne ki dua kijiye." Allah ke Rasool ne (khade hokar) kaha: "Aye Allah! Pathareeli zameenon par, tibbon par, wadiyon mein, aur un jagahon par jahan darakht ugte hain." To baadal Madina se aise hat gaye jaise kapde utaar diye jaate hain.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:A man came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Livestock are destroyed and the roads are cut off. So please invoke Allah." So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prayed and it rained from that Friday to the next Friday. Then he came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Houses have collapsed, roads are cut off and the livestock are destroyed." So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prayed, "O Allah! (Let it rain) on the tops of mountains, on the plateaus, in the valleys and over the places where trees grow." So the clouds cleared away from Medina as clothes are taken off
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks Allah ke Rasool ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Maal-maweshi barbaad ho gaye hain aur raaste band hain. Kripya Allah se dua kijiye." To Allah ke Rasool ne dua ki aur us Jumme se agle Jumme tak baarish hoti rahi. Phir woh Allah ke Rasool ke paas aakar bola: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Ghar gir gaye hain, raaste band hain aur maal-maweshi barbaad ho gaye hain." To Allah ke Rasool ne dua ki: "Aye Allah! (Baarish ho) pahadon ki chotiyon par, pathareeli zameenon par, wadiyon mein, aur un jagahon par jahan darakht ugte hain." To baadal Madina se aise hat gaye jaise kapde utaar diye jaate hain.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:A man complained to the Prophet (ﷺ) about the destruction of livestock and property and the hunger of the offspring. So he invoked (Allah for rain. The narrator (Anas) did not mention that the Prophet (ﷺ) had worn his cloak inside out or faced the Qibla
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks ne Nabi se maal-maweshi aur maal ki tabaahi aur bachchon ki bhookh ki shikayat ki. To Aap ne dua ki. Raawi (Anas) ne yeh zikar nahi kiya ke Nabi ne apna chogha ulta pehna tha ya Qibla ki taraf mun kiya tha.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:A man came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Livestock are destroyed and the roads are cut off; so please invoke Allah." So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prayed for rain and it rained from that Friday till the next Friday. Then a man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! The houses have collapsed, roads are cut off and the livestock are destroyed." So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O Allah ! (Let it rain) on the tops of the mountains, on the plateaus, in the valleys and over the places where trees grow." So the clouds cleared away from Medina as clothes are taken off
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks Allah ke Rasool ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Maal-maweshi barbaad ho gaye hain aur raaste band hain; Allah se dua kijiye." To Allah ke Rasool ne baarish ki dua ki aur us Jumme se agle Jumme tak baarish hoti rahi. Phir ek shaks Nabi ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Ghar gir gaye hain, raaste band hain aur maal-maweshi barbaad ho gaye hain." To Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: "Aye Allah! (Baarish ho) pahadon ki chotiyon par, pathareeli zameenon par, wadiyon mein, aur un jagahon par jahan darakht ugte hain." To baadal Madina se aise hat gaye jaise kapde utaar diye jaate hain.

e: Narrated Masruq:One day I went to Ibn Mas`ud who said, "When Quraish delayed in embracing Islam, the Prophet (ﷺ) invoked Allah to curse them, so they were afflicted with a (famine) year because of which many of them died and they ate the carcasses and Abu Sufyan came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, 'O Muhammad! You came to order people to keep good relation with kith and kin and your nation is being destroyed, so invoke Allah.' So the Prophet (ﷺ) recited the Holy verses of Surat-Ad-Dukhan: 'Then watch you For the day that The sky will Bring forth a kind Of smoke Plainly visible.' (44.10) When the famine was taken off, the people renegade once again as nonbelievers. The statement of Allah, (in Sura "Ad- Dukhan"-44) refers to that: 'On the day when We shall seize You with a mighty grasp.' (44.16) And that was what happened on the day of the battle of Badr." Asbat added on the authority of Mansur, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prayed for them and it rained heavily for seven days. So the people complained of the excessive rain. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'O Allah! (Let it rain) around us and not on us.' So the clouds dispersed over his head and it rained over the surroundings
hi: Masruq bataate hain: Ek din main Ibn Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas gaya, unhone kaha: "Jab Quraish ne Islam qubool karne mein der ki, Nabi ne unpar laanat ki dua ki, isliye unpar ek akaal ka saal aaya jiski wajah se unme se bahut mar gaye aur woh murda janwar khane lage. Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ) Nabi ke paas gaye aur kaha: 'Aye Muhammad! Aap rishtedaron se achha suluk rakhne ka hukum dene aaye the aur aapki qaum tabaah ho rahi hai, isliye Allah se dua kijiye.' Tab Nabi ne Surah Ad-Dukhan ki paak ayaat tilawat ki: 'Tab dekho us din ka intezar jab aasman saaf dikhne wala dhuan lekar aayega' (44:10). Jab akaal khatam hua, log dobara kaafir ban gaye." Allah ke farmaan (Surah Ad-Dukhan mein) "Jis din hum tumhe sakht pakad se pakdenge" (44:16) ka ishara isi taraf hai — aur yehi Badr ki jung ke din hua. Asbat ne Mansur ke hawale se joda: "Allah ke Rasool ne unke liye dua ki aur saat din tak zabardast baarish hui. Log zyada baarish ki shikayat karne lage. Nabi ne farmaya: 'Aye Allah! Hamare aas-paas, humpar nahi.' To baadal unke sar ke upar se bikhar gaye aur aas-paas ke ilaaqon mein baarish hui."

e: Narrated Anas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was delivering the Khutba (sermon) on a Friday when the people stood up, shouted and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! There is no rain (drought), the trees have dried and the livestock are destroyed; Please pray to Allah for rain." So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said twice, "O Allah! Bless us with rain." By Allah, there was no trace of cloud in the sky and suddenly the sky became overcast with clouds and it started raining. The Prophet (ﷺ) came down the pulpit and offered the prayer. When he came back from the prayer (to his house) it was raining and it rained continuously till the next Friday. When the Prophet started delivering the Friday Khutba (sermon), the people started shouting and said to him, "The houses have collapsed and the roads are cut off; so please pray to Allah to withhold the rain." So the Prophet (ﷺ) smiled and said, "O Allah! Round about us and not on us." So the sky became clear over Medina but it kept on raining over the outskirts (of Medina) and not a single drop of rain fell over Medina. I looked towards the sky which was as bright and clear as a crown
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool Jumme ko khutba de rahe the jab log khade hokar chillaye: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Baarish nahi hai (sookha hai), darakht sookh gaye hain aur maal-maweshi barbaad ho gaye hain; Allah se baarish ki dua kijiye." To Allah ke Rasool ne do baar kaha: "Aye Allah! Humein baarish se nawaz." Allah ki qasam, aasman mein baadal ka koi nishaan nahi tha, achanak aasman baadalon se bhar gaya aur baarish shuru ho gayi. Nabi mimbar se utre aur namaz padhi. Jab woh namaz se wapas aaye (apne ghar), baarish ho rahi thi aur yeh agle Jumme tak lagataar hoti rahi. Jab Nabi ne agle Jumme ka khutba shuru kiya, log chillaane lage aur kaha: "Ghar gir gaye hain aur raaste band hain; Allah se baarish rokne ki dua kijiye." To Nabi muskuraye aur kaha: "Aye Allah! Humare aas-paas, humpar nahi." To Madina ka aasman saaf ho gaya, magar Madina ke bahar ke ilaaqon mein baarish hoti rahi, Madina par ek boond bhi nahi giri. Maine aasman ki taraf dekha jo taaz jaisa roshan aur saaf tha.

e: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Yazid Al-Ansari that he went out with Al-Bara' bin 'Azib, and Zaid bin Arqam and invoked for rain. He ('Abdullah bin Yazid) stood up but not on a pulpit and invoked Allah for rain and then offered two Rak'a prayers with loud recitation without pronouncing Adhan or Iqama. Abu Ishaq said that 'Abdullah bin Yazid had seen the Prophet (ﷺ) (doing the same)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Yazid Al-Ansari bataate hain ke woh Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Zaid bin Arqam (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath bahar gaye aur baarish ki dua ki. Woh (Abdullah bin Yazid) khade hue, magar mimbar par nahi, aur Allah se baarish ki dua ki, phir buland aawaaz mein tilawat karte huye do rakat padhi, bina Adhan ya Iqama ke. Abu Ishaq ne kaha ke Abdullah bin Yazid ne Nabi ko (yehi karte) dekha tha.

e: Narrated `Abbad bin Tamim:that his uncle (who was one of the companions of the Prophet) had told him, "The Prophet (ﷺ) went out with the people to invoke Allah for rain for them. He stood up and invoked Allah for rain, then faced the Qibla and turned his cloak (inside out) and it rained
hi: Abbad bin Tamim bataate hain ke unke chacha (jo Nabi ke sahaba mein se the) ne unhe bataya: "Nabi logon ke saath baarish ki dua karne bahar gaye. Aap khade hue aur Allah se baarish ki dua ki, phir Qibla ki taraf mun karke apna chogha (ulta) mod liya, aur baarish hone lagi."

e: Narrated `Abbad bin Tamim:from his uncle who said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) went out to invoke Allah for rain. He faced the Qibla invoking Allah. He turned over his cloak (inside out) and then offered two rak`at and recited the Qur'an aloud in them
hi: Abbad bin Tamim, apne chacha ke hawale se: "Nabi baarish ki dua karne bahar gaye. Aap Qibla ki taraf mun karke dua ki. Apna chogha ulta pehna, phir do rakat padhi aur unme buland aawaaz se Quran tilawat ki."

e: Narrated `Abbad bin Tamim from his uncle:"I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) on the day when he went out to offer the Istisqa' prayer. He turned his back towards the people and faced the Qibla and asked Allah for rain. Then he turned his cloak inside out and led us in a two rak`at prayer and recited the Qur'an aloud in them
hi: Abbad bin Tamim, apne chacha ke hawale se: "Maine Nabi ko us din dekha jab woh Istisqa ki namaz padhne gaye. Aap ne logon ki taraf pusht karke Qibla ki taraf mun kiya aur Allah se baarish maangi. Phir apna chogha ulta pehna aur humari do rakat namaz ki imamat ki jisme buland aawaaz se Quran tilawat ki."

e: Narrated `Abbad bin Tamim from his uncle who said:"The Prophet (ﷺ) invoked Allah for rain and offered a two rak`at prayer and he put his cloak inside out
hi: Abbad bin Tamim, apne chacha ke hawale se: "Nabi ne Allah se baarish ki dua ki aur do rakat namaz padhi, aur apna chogha ulta pehna."

e: Narrated `Abbad bin Tamim from his uncle who said:"The Prophet (ﷺ) went out to the Musalla to offer the Istisqa' prayer, faced the Qibla and offered a two rak`at prayer and turned his cloak inside out." Narrated Abu Bakr, "The Prophet (ﷺ) put the right side of his cloak on his left side
hi: Abbad bin Tamim, apne chacha ke hawale se: "Nabi Musalla gaye Istisqa ki namaz padhne, Qibla ki taraf mun kiya aur do rakat namaz padhi aur apna chogha ulta pehna." Abu Bakr ne bataya: "Nabi ne apne chogha ki dahini taraf baayi taraf par rakh li (yaani ulta kiya)."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Zaid Al-Ansari:The Prophet (ﷺ) went out towards the Musalla in order to offer the Istisqa' prayer and when he intended to invoke (Allah) or started invoking, he faced the Qibla and turned his cloak inside out
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ansari (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi Musalla ki taraf gaye Istisqa ki namaz padhne, aur jab dua ka iraada kiya ya dua shuru ki, Qibla ki taraf mun kiya aur apna chogha ulta pehna.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:A bedouin came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on a Friday and said, "O Allah's Messenger ! The livestock, the offspring, and the people have perished." So, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) raised both his hands invoking Allah (for rain) and the people too raised their hands with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) invoking Allah (for rain). We had not left the mosque when it started raining. It rained till the next Friday when the same man came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger! The travelers are compelled to postpone their journeys (because of excessive rain) and the roads are overflowed
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek dehati (Bedouin) Jumme ko Allah ke Rasool ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Maal-maweshi, aulad aur log tabaah ho rahe hain." To Allah ke Rasool ne donon haath uthaye Allah se dua karte huye (baarish ke liye), aur log bhi Allah ke Rasool ke saath apne haath uthaye Allah se dua karne lage. Hum abhi masjid se nikle bhi nahi the ke baarish shuru ho gayi. Baarish agle Jumme tak jaari rahi jab wahi shaks Allah ke Rasool ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Musafir apne safar taal-ne par majboor hain (zyada baarish ki wajah se) aur raaste paani se bhar gaye hain."

e: The narrator Anas added that the Prophet (ﷺ) raised his hands (during the invocation) to such an extent that the whiteness of his armpits was visible
hi: Raawi Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne joda ke Nabi ne (dua karte waqt) apne haath itne uthaye ke unki bagal ki safedi dikhai deti thi.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) never raised his hands for any invocation except for that of Istisqa' and he used to raise them so much that the whiteness of his armpits became visible. (Note: It may be that Anas did not see the Prophet (ﷺ) raising his hands, but it is narrated that the Prophet (ﷺ) used to raise his hands for invocations other than Istisqa. See Hadith No. 807 & 808 and also see Hadith No. 612, Vol
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kabhi kisi doosri dua ke liye apne haath itna nahi uthaye jitna Istisqa ke liye, aur woh unhe itna uthate ke unki bagal ki safedi dikhai deti. (Note: Ho sakta hai Anas ne Nabi ko doosri duaon mein haath uthate na dekha ho, magar riwayat hai ke Nabi doosri duaon mein bhi haath uthate the.)

e: Narrated Aisha:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw the rain, he used to say, "O Allah! Let it be a strong fruitful rain
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab bhi Allah ke Rasool baarish dekhte, kehte: "Aye Allah! Ise ek zabardast, phal-dar baarish bana."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:In the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) the people were afflicted with a (famine) year. While the Prophet was delivering the Khutba (sermon) on the pulpit on a Friday, a Bedouin stood up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! The livestock are dying and the families (offspring) are hungry: please pray to Allah to bless us with rain." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) raised both his hands towards the sky and at that time there was not a trace of cloud in the sky. Then the clouds started gathering like mountains. Before he got down from the pulpit I saw rainwater trickling down his beard. It rained that day, the next day, the third day, the fourth day and till the next Friday, when the same Bedouin or some other person stood up (during the Friday Khutba) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! The houses have collapsed and the livestock are drowned. Please invoke Allah for us." So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) raised both his hands and said, "O Allah! Around us and not on us." Whichever side the Prophet (ﷺ) directed his hand, the clouds dispersed from there till a hole (in the clouds) was formed over Medina. The valley of Qanat remained flowing (with water) for one month and none, came from outside who didn't talk about the abundant rain
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ke zamane mein, log ek akaal ke saal mein mubtila hue. Jabke Nabi Jumme ko mimbar par khutba de rahe the, ek dehati khada hokar bola: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Maal-maweshi mar rahe hain aur khandan bhookhe hain; kripya Allah se baarish ki dua kijiye." Allah ke Rasool ne donon haath aasman ki taraf uthaye, aur us waqt aasman mein baadal ka koi nishaan nahi tha. Phir baadal pahadon ki tarah jama hone lage. Mimbar se utarne se pehle hi maine unki daadhi par baarish ka paani tapakte dekha. Us din baarish hui, agle din, teesre din, chauthe din, aur agle Jumme tak, jab wahi dehati ya koi doosra shaks khada hokar bola: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Ghar gir gaye hain aur maal-maweshi doob gaye hain. Kripya humare liye dua kijiye." To Allah ke Rasool ne donon haath uthaye aur kaha: "Aye Allah! Humare aas-paas, humpar nahi." Jidhar bhi Nabi ne apna haath dikhaya, baadal wahan se hat gaye yahan tak ke Madina ke upar ek surakh (khaali jagah) ban gayi. Qanat wadi ek mahine tak bahti rahi, aur bahar se koi bhi aata to isi zabardast baarish ki baat karta.

e: Narrated Anas:Whenever a strong wind blew, anxiety appeared on the face of the Prophet (fearing that wind might be a sign of Allah's wrath)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab bhi tez hawa chalti, Nabi ke chehre par pareshaani zahir hoti (is dar se ke kahin yeh Allah ke gusse ki nishani na ho).

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I was granted victory with As-Saba and the nation of 'Ad was destroyed by Ad- Dabur (westerly wind)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Mujhe As-Saba (poorvi hawa) se fatah di gayi, aur Aad qaum Ad-Dabur (pashchimi hawa) se barbaad ki gayi."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The Hour (Last Day) will not be established until (religious) knowledge will be taken away (by the death of religious learned men), earthquakes will be very frequent, time will pass quickly, afflictions will appear, murders will increase and money will overflow amongst you." (See Hadith No. 85 Vol)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Qiyamat tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak (deeni) ilm utha na liya jaaye (ulama ke intiqal se), zalzale bahut aam na ho jayein, waqt jaldi na guzarne lage, fitne zahir na hon, qatl na badh jayein, aur maal tum mein bahut zyada na ho jaaye."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:(The Prophet) said, "O Allah! Bless our Sham and our Yemen." People said, "Our Najd as well." The Prophet again said, "O Allah! Bless our Sham and Yemen." They said again, "Our Najd as well." On that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There will appear earthquakes and afflictions, and from there will come out the side of the head of Satan
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: (Nabi ne) farmaya: "Aye Allah! Humare Sham aur humare Yemen ko barkat de." Logon ne kaha: "Humare Najd ko bhi." Nabi ne phir farmaya: "Aye Allah! Humare Sham aur Yemen ko barkat de." Unhone phir kaha: "Humare Najd ko bhi." Iske jawab mein Nabi ne farmaya: "Wahan zalzale aur fitne zahir honge, aur wahin se shaitan ke sar ka kinara nikalega."

e: Narrated Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) led the morning prayer in Al-Hudaibiya and it had rained the previous night. When the Prophet (ﷺ) had finished the prayer he faced the people and said, "Do you know what your Lord has said?" They replied, "Allah and His Apostle know better." (The Prophet (ﷺ) said), "Allah says, 'In this morning some of My worshipers remained as true believers and some became non-believers; he who said that it had rained with the blessing and mercy of Allah is the one who believes in Me and does not believe in star, but he who said it had rained because of such and such (star) is a disbeliever in Me and is a believer in star
hi: Zaid bin Khalid (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Juhani (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Al-Hudaibiya mein Fajr ki namaz padhai, pichli raat baarish hui thi. Namaz khatam karke Nabi ne logon ki taraf mun kiya aur farmaya: "Kya tumhe pata hai tumhare Rab ne kya farmaya?" Unhone kaha: "Allah aur uske Rasool behtar jaante hain." (Nabi ne farmaya): "Allah kehta hai: 'Aaj subah mere kuch bande sacche momin rahe aur kuch mera inkaar karne wale ho gaye — jisne kaha ke baarish Allah ki rehmat aur karam se hui, woh mujh par iman rakhta hai aur sitare ka inkaar karta hai, magar jisne kaha ke baarish falaan-falaan (sitare) ki wajah se hui, woh mera inkaar karta hai aur sitare par iman rakhta hai.'"

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Keys of the unseen knowledge are five which nobody knows but Allah . . . nobody knows what will happen tomorrow; nobody knows what is in the womb; nobody knows what he will gain tomorrow; nobody knows at what place he will die; and nobody knows when it will rain
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Ghaib ke ilm ki chaabiyaan paanch hain jinhe sirf Allah jaanta hai... koi nahi jaanta kal kya hoga; koi nahi jaanta rehm mein kya hai; koi nahi jaanta woh kal kya kamaayega; koi nahi jaanta woh kahan marega; aur koi nahi jaanta kab baarish hogi."

e: Narrated Abu Bakra:We were with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) when the sun eclipsed. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up dragging his cloak till he entered the Mosque. He led us in a two-rak`at prayer till the sun (eclipse) had cleared. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The sun and the moon do not eclipse because of someone's death. So whenever you see these eclipses pray and invoke (Allah) till the eclipse is over
hi: Abu Bakra (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Allah ke Rasool ke saath the jab suraj grahan hua. Allah ke Rasool khade hue aur apna chogha ghaseette hue masjid mein daakhil hue. Aap ne humari do rakat namaz ki imamat ki jab tak suraj (grahan) saaf na ho gaya. Phir Nabi ne farmaya: "Suraj aur chaand kisi ki maut ki wajah se grahan nahi hote. Isliye jab tum yeh grahan dekho, namaz padho aur dua karo jab tak grahan khatam na ho."

e: Narrated Abu Mas`ud:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The sun and the moon do not eclipse because of the death of someone from the people but they are two signs amongst the signs of Allah. When you see them stand up and pray
hi: Abu Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Suraj aur chaand logon mein se kisi ki maut ki wajah se grahan nahi hote, balki yeh Allah ki nishaniyon mein se do nishaniyan hain. Jab tum unhe dekho to khade hokar namaz padho."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The sun and the moon do not eclipse because of the death or life (i.e. birth) of someone but they are two signs amongst the signs of Allah. When you see them offer the prayer
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Suraj aur chaand kisi ki maut ya zindagi (yaani paidaish) ki wajah se grahan nahi hote, balki yeh Allah ki nishaniyon mein se do nishaniyan hain. Jab tum unhe dekho to namaz padho."

e: Narrated Al-Mughira bin Shu`ba:"The sun eclipsed in the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the day when (his son) Ibrahim died. So the people said that the sun had eclipsed because of the death of Ibrahim. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The sun and the moon do not eclipse because of the death or life (i.e. birth) of someone. When you see the eclipse pray and invoke Allah
hi: Al-Mughira bin Shu'ba (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Allah ke Rasool ke zamane mein suraj grahan hua us din jab (unke bete) Ibrahim ka intiqal hua. Log kehne lage ke suraj grahan Ibrahim ki maut ki wajah se hua. Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: 'Suraj aur chaand kisi ki maut ya zindagi (paidaish) ki wajah se grahan nahi hote. Jab grahan dekho, namaz padho aur Allah se dua karo.'"

e: Narrated `Aisha:In the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) the sun eclipsed, so he led the people in prayer, and stood up and performed a long Qiyam, then bowed for a long while. He stood up again and performed a long Qiyam but this time the period of standing was shorter than the first. He bowed again for a long time but shorter than the first one, then he prostrated and prolonged the prostration. He did the same in the second rak`a as he did in the first and then finished the prayer; by then the sun (eclipse) had cleared. He delivered the Khutba (sermon) and after praising and glorifying Allah he said, "The sun and the moon are two signs amongst the signs of Allah; they do not eclipse on the death or life of anyone. So when you see the eclipse, remember Allah and say Takbir, pray and give Sadaqa." The Prophet then said, "O followers of Muhammad! By Allah! There is none who has more ghaira (self-respect) than Allah as He has forbidden that His slaves, male or female commit adultery (illegal sexual intercourse). O followers of Muhammad! By Allah! If you knew that which I know you would laugh little and weep much
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool ke zamane mein suraj grahan hua, Aap ne logon ki namaz padhai, khade hue aur lamba Qiyam kiya, phir lambi der tak ruku kiya. Phir dobara khade hue aur lamba Qiyam kiya magar pehle se kam. Phir dobara lambi der tak ruku kiya magar pehle se kam, phir sajda kiya aur sajde ko lamba kiya. Doosri rakat mein bhi yehi kiya jaisa pehli mein kiya tha, phir namaz khatam ki; is waqt tak suraj (grahan) saaf ho chuka tha. Aap ne khutba diya aur Allah ki hamd-o-sana ke baad farmaya: "Suraj aur chaand Allah ki nishaniyon mein se do nishaniyan hain; yeh kisi ki maut ya zindagi ki wajah se grahan nahi hote. Isliye jab tum grahan dekho, Allah ko yaad karo, Takbir kaho, namaz padho aur sadqa do." Phir Nabi ne farmaya: "Aye Muhammad ke pairokaro! Allah ki qasam, Allah se zyada koi ghairat wala nahi jo apne bandon, mard ya aurat, ko zina karte dekhna napasand kare. Aye Muhammad ke pairokaro! Allah ki qasam! Agar tumhe pata hota jo main jaanta hoon, to tum kam hasste aur zyada rote."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:"When the sun eclipsed in the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) an announcement was made that a prayer was to be offered in congregation
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: "Allah ke Rasool ke zamane mein jab suraj grahan hua, elaan kiya gaya ke namaz jamaat mein padhi jayegi."

e: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ) In the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) the sun eclipsed and he went to the Mosque and the people aligned behind him. He said the Takbir (starting the prayer) and prolonged the recitation (from the Qur'an) and then said Takbir and performed a prolonged bowing; then he (lifted his head and) said, "Sami allahu liman hamidah" (Allah heard him who sent his praises to Him). He then did not prostrate but stood up and recited a prolonged recitation which was shorter than the first recitation. He again said Takbir and then bowed a prolonged bowing but shorter than the first one and then said, "Sami`a l-lahu Lyman hamidah Rabbana walak-lhamd, (Allah heard him who sent his praises to Him. O our Sustainer! All the praises are for You)" and then prostrated and did the same in the second rak`a; thus he completed four bowing and four prostrations. The sun (eclipse) had cleared before he finished the prayer. (After the prayer) he stood up, glorified and praised Allah as He deserved and then said, "The sun and the moon are two of the signs of Allah. They do not eclipse because of the death or the life (i.e. birth) of someone. When you see them make haste for the prayer." Narrated Az-Zuhri: I said to 'Urwa, "When the sun eclipsed at Medina your brother (`Abdullah bin Az-Zubair) offered only a two-rak`at prayer like that of the morning (Fajr) prayer." 'Urwa replied, "Yes, for he missed the Prophet's tradition (concerning this matter)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki biwi) bataati hain: Nabi ke zamane mein suraj grahan hua, Aap masjid gaye aur log unke peechhe safon mein khade hue. Aap ne Takbir kahi (namaz shuru ki) aur lambi tilawat ki, phir Takbir kahi aur lambi der tak ruku kiya; phir (sar utha kar) kaha "Sami' Allahu liman hamidah." Phir Aap ne sajda nahi kiya balki khade hokar phir lambi tilawat ki jo pehli se chhoti thi. Aap ne phir Takbir kahi aur lambi der tak ruku kiya jo pehli se chhota tha aur phir kaha "Sami' Allahu liman hamidah, Rabbana walak-lhamd," phir sajda kiya, aur doosri rakat mein bhi yehi kiya; isi tarah Aap ne chaar ruku aur chaar sajde mukammal kiye. Suraj (grahan) namaz khatam hone se pehle hi saaf ho gaya tha. (Namaz ke baad) Aap khade hue, Allah ki laayiq hamd-o-sana ki aur farmaya: "Suraj aur chaand Allah ki do nishaniyan hain. Yeh kisi ki maut ya zindagi (paidaish) ki wajah se grahan nahi hote. Jab tum unhe dekho, namaz ke liye jaldi karo." Az-Zuhri bataate hain: Maine Urwa se kaha: "Jab Madina mein suraj grahan hua, aapke bhai (Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ)) ne sirf Fajr jaisi do rakat padhi." Urwa ne jawab diya: "Haan, unhone Nabi ki riwayat miss kar di."
