e: Narrated Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) On the day when the sun Khasafat (eclipsed) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prayed; he stood up and said Takbir and recited a prolonged recitation, then he performed a prolonged bowing, then he raised his head and said, "Sami`a l-lahu Lyman Hamidah," and then remained standing and recited a prolonged recitation which was shorter than the first. Then he performed a prolonged bowing which was shorter than the first. Then he prostrated and prolonged the prostration and he did the same in the second rak`a as in the first and then finished the prayer with Taslim. By that time the sun (eclipse) had cleared He addressed the people and said, "The sun and the moon are two of the signs of Allah; they do not eclipse (Yakhsifan) because of the death or the life (i.e. birth) of someone. So when you see them make haste for the prayer
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki biwi) bataati hain: Jis din suraj Khasafat (grahan) hua, Allah ke Rasool ne namaz padhi; khade hue aur Takbir kahi aur lambi tilawat ki, phir lambi der tak ruku kiya, phir sar utha kar kaha "Sami' Allahu liman Hamidah," aur khade rehte hue lambi tilawat ki jo pehli se chhoti thi. Phir lambi der tak ruku kiya jo pehli se chhota tha. Phir sajda kiya aur sajde ko lamba kiya, aur doosri rakat mein bhi pehli jaisa hi kiya, phir Taslim se namaz khatam ki. Is waqt tak suraj (grahan) saaf ho chuka tha. Aap ne logon se khitaab karke farmaya: "Suraj aur chaand Allah ki do nishaniyan hain; yeh kisi ki maut ya zindagi (paidaish) ki wajah se grahan (Yakhsifan) nahi hote. Isliye jab tum unhe dekho, namaz ke liye jaldi karo."

e: Narrated Abu Bakra:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: "The sun and the moon are two signs amongst the signs of Allah and they do not eclipse because of the death of someone but Allah frightens His devotees with them
hi: Abu Bakra (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Suraj aur chaand Allah ki do nishaniyan hain aur yeh kisi ki maut ki wajah se grahan nahi hote, balki Allah inse apne bandon ko dara raha hota hai."

e: Narrated `Amra bint `Abdur-Rahman:A Jewess came to ask `Aisha (the wife of the Prophet) about something. She said to her, "May Allah give you refuge from the punishment of the grave." So `Aisha ' asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) "Would the people be punished in their graves?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) after seeking refuge with Allah from the punishment of the grave (and thus replied in the affirmative). Then one day, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) rode to go to some place but the sun eclipsed. He returned in the forenoon and passed through the rear of the dwellings (of his wives) and stood for the (eclipse) prayer, and the people stood behind him. He stood up for a long period and then performed a prolonged bowing which was shorter than the first bowing. Then he raised his head and prostrated. Then he stood up (for the second rak`a) for a long while but the standing was shorter than that of the first rak`a. Then he performed a prolonged bowing which was shorter than the first one. Then he raised his head and prostrated. Then he stood up for a long time but shorter than the first. Then he performed a prolonged bowing but shorter than the first. Then he raised his head and prostrated and finished the prayer and (then delivered the sermon and) said as much as Allah wished. And then he ordered the people to seek refuge with Allah from the punishment of the grave
hi: Amra bint Abdur-Rahman bataati hain: Ek Yahudi aurat Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki biwi) se kuch poochhne aayi. Usne unse kaha: "Allah aapko qabar ke azaab se panah de." Isliye Ayesha ne Allah ke Rasool se pucha: "Kya logon ko unki qabron mein saza di jayegi?" Allah ke Rasool ne qabar ke azaab se Allah ki panah maangi (yaani haan mein jawab diya). Phir ek din Allah ke Rasool kahin jaane ke liye sawar hue magar suraj grahan ho gaya. Aap subah wapas aaye aur (apni biwiyon ke) gharon ke peechhe se guzarte huye grahan ki namaz ke liye khade hue, aur log unke peechhe khade hue. Aap lambi der tak khade rahe, phir lambi der tak ruku kiya jo pehle ruku se chhota tha. Phir sar utha kar sajda kiya. Phir (doosri rakat ke liye) lambi der tak khade rahe magar pehli rakat se chhota. Phir lambi der tak ruku kiya jo pehle se chhota tha. Phir sar utha kar sajda kiya. Phir lambi der tak khade rahe magar pehli se chhota. Phir lambi der tak ruku kiya magar pehle se chhota. Phir sar utha kar sajda kiya aur namaz khatam ki, (phir khutba dete huye) jitna Allah ne chaha kaha. Phir Aap ne logon ko qabar ke azaab se Allah ki panah maangne ka hukum diya.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:When the sun eclipsed in the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and an announcement was made that the prayer was to be held in congregation. The Prophet (ﷺ) performed two bowing in one rak`a. Then he stood up and performed two bowing in one rak`a. Then he sat down and finished the prayer; and by then the (eclipse) had cleared `Aisha said, "I had never performed such a long prostration
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ke zamane mein jab suraj grahan hua aur elaan kiya gaya ke namaz jamaat mein hogi. Nabi ne ek rakat mein do ruku kiye. Phir khade hue aur (doosri rakat mein) do ruku kiye. Phir baithe aur namaz khatam ki; is waqt tak (eclipse) saaf ho chuka tha. Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha: "Maine kabhi itna lamba sajda nahi kiya tha."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abbas:The sun eclipsed in the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) . Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) offered the eclipse prayer and stood for a long period equal to the period in which one could recite Surat-al-Baqara. Then he bowed for a long time and then stood up for a long period which was shorter than that of the first standing, then bowed again for a long time but for a shorter period than the first; then he prostrated twice and then stood up for a long period which was shorter than that of the first standing; then he bowed for a long time which was shorter than the previous one, and then he raised his head and stood up for a long period which was shorter than the first standing, then he bowed for a long time which was shorter than the first bowing, and then prostrated (twice) and finished the prayer. By then, the sun (eclipse) had cleared. The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "The sun and the moon are two of the signs of Allah. They eclipse neither because of the death of somebody nor because of his life (i.e. birth). So when you see them, remember Allah." The people said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We saw you taking something from your place and then we saw you retreating." The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "I saw Paradise and stretched my hands towards a bunch (of its fruits) and had I taken it, you would have eaten from it as long as the world remains. I also saw the Hell-fire and I had never seen such a horrible sight. I saw that most of the inhabitants were women." The people asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Why is it so?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Because of their ungratefulness." It was asked whether they are ungrateful to Allah. The Prophet said, "They are ungrateful to their companions of life (husbands) and ungrateful to good deeds. If you are benevolent to one of them throughout the life and if she sees anything (undesirable) in you, she will say, 'I have never had any good from you
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ke zamane mein suraj grahan hua. Allah ke Rasool ne grahan ki namaz padhi aur Surah Al-Baqarah jitni lambi der tak khade rahe. Phir lambi der tak ruku kiya, phir khade hue jo pehli der se chhota tha, phir dobara lambi der tak ruku kiya magar pehle se chhota; phir do sajde kiye, phir khade hue jo pehli der se chhota tha; phir lambi der tak ruku kiya jo pichhli der se chhota tha, phir sar utha kar khade hue jo pehli der se chhota tha, phir lambi der tak ruku kiya jo pehle ruku se chhota tha, phir sajde kiye (do) aur namaz khatam ki. Is waqt tak suraj (grahan) saaf ho chuka tha. Nabi ne phir farmaya: "Suraj aur chaand Allah ki do nishaniyan hain. Yeh kisi ki maut ya kisi ki zindagi (paidaish) ki wajah se grahan nahi hote. Isliye jab tum unhe dekho, Allah ko yaad karo." Logon ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Humne dekha aap apni jagah se kuch pakadne ki koshish kar rahe the, phir humne dekha aap peeche hat rahe the." Nabi ne jawab diya: "Maine Jannat dekhi aur apne haath uske ek gucchhe ki taraf badhaye, agar main use le leta, to tum duniya rehte tak usse khaate. Maine Dozakh bhi dekhi aur aisa khaufnaak manzar maine kabhi nahi dekha tha. Maine dekha zyada tar bashinde aurtein hain." Logon ne pucha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Kyun?" Nabi ne jawab diya: "Unki na-shukri ki wajah se." Poocha gaya kya woh Allah ki na-shukri karti hain. Nabi ne farmaya: "Woh apne saathi (shohar) ki na-shukri karti hain aur nekiyon ki na-shukri karti hain. Agar tum unme se kisi ke saath poori zindagi achhaai karo, phir woh tumhare andar koi (napasandida) cheez dekh le, to kahegi: 'Maine tumse kabhi koi bhalai nahi paai.'"

e: Narrated Fatima bint Al-Mundhir:Asma' bint Abu Bakr said, "I came to `Aisha the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ) during the solar eclipse. The people were standing and offering the prayer and she was also praying too. I asked her, 'What has happened to the people?' She pointed out with her hand towards the sky and said, 'Subhan-Allah'. I said, 'Is there a sign?' She pointed out in the affirmative." Asma' further said, "I too then stood up for the prayer till I fainted and then poured water on my head. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had finished his prayer, he thanked and praised Allah and said, 'I have seen at this place of mine what I have never seen even Paradise and Hell. No doubt, it has been inspired to me that you will be put to trial in the graves like or nearly like the trial of (Masih) Ad-Dajjal. (I do not know which one of the two Asma' said.) (The angels) will come to everyone of you and will ask what do you know about this man (i.e. Muhammad). The believer or a firm believer (I do not know which word Asma' said) will reply, 'He is Muhammad, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who came to us with clear evidences and guidance, so we accepted his teachings, believed and followed him.' The angels will then say to him, 'Sleep peacefully as we knew surely that you were a firm believer.' The hypocrite or doubtful person (I do not know which word Asma' said) will say, 'I do not know. I heard the people saying something so I said it (the same)
hi: Fatima (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Al-Mundhir bataati hain: Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Abu Bakr (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha: "Main Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki biwi) ke paas surya-grahan ke waqt aayi. Log khade namaz padh rahe the aur woh bhi padh rahi thi. Maine pucha: 'Logon ko kya hua?' Unhone haath se aasman ki taraf ishara kiya aur kaha: 'Subhan-Allah.' Maine pucha: 'Kya koi nishani hai?' Unhone haan mein ishara kiya." Asma ne aage kaha: "Main bhi namaz mein shamil hui yahan tak ke behosh hone ke qareeb ho gayi, phir apne sar par paani daala. Jab Allah ke Rasool ne namaz khatam ki, Allah ka shukr aur hamd ada kiya aur kaha: 'Maine is jagah aisi cheezein dekhi jo maine Jannat aur Dozakh mein bhi kabhi nahi dekhi. Beshak mujhe wahi hui hai ke tumhe qabron mein waisi hi ya usse milti-julti aazmaish di jayegi jaisi (Masih) Ad-Dajjal ki aazmaish hogi (mujhe nahi pata Asma ne kaunsa lafz istemal kiya). (Farishte) tum mein se har ek ke paas aakar poochenge tumhe is shaks (yaani Muhammad) ke baare mein kya pata hai. Momin ya pakka momin (mujhe nahi pata Asma ne kaunsa lafz kaha) jawab dega: 'Yeh Muhammad hain, Allah ke Rasool, jo humare paas roshan daleel aur hidayat le kar aaye, isliye humne unki taleemat qubool ki, iman laaye aur unki pairvi ki.' Farishte usse kahenge: 'Sukoon se so jao, kyunke humein pata tha tum pakka momin the.' Munafiq ya shakki shaks (mujhe nahi pata Asma ne kaunsa lafz kaha) kahega: 'Mujhe nahi pata. Maine logon ko kuch kehte suna to main bhi wahi keh diya.'"

e: Narrated Asma:No doubt the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered people to manumit slaves during the solar eclipse
hi: Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi ne suraj grahan ke waqt gulamon ko azaad karne ka hukum diya.

e: Narrated `Amra bint `Abdur-Rahman:A Jewess came to `Aisha to ask her about something and then she said, "May Allah give you refuge from the punishment of the grave." So `Aisha asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), "Would the people be punished in their graves?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked Allah's refuge from the punishment of the grave (indicating an affirmative reply). Then one day Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) rode (to leave for some place) but the sun eclipsed. He returned on the forenoon and passed through the rear of the dwellings (of his wives) and stood up and started offering the (eclipse) prayer and the people stood behind him. He stood for a long period and then performed a long bowing and then stood straight for a long period which was shorter than that of the first standing, then he performed a prolonged bowing which was shorter than the first bowing, then he raised his head and prostrated for a long time and then stood up (for the second rak`a) for a long while, but the standing was shorter than the standing of the first rak`a. Then he performed a prolonged bowing which was shorter than that of the first one. He then stood up for a long time but shorter than the first, then again performed a long bowing which was shorter than the first and then prostrated for a shorter while than that of the first prostration. Then he finished the prayer and delivered the sermon and) said what Allah wished; and ordered the people to seek refuge with Allah from the punishment of the grave
hi: Amra bint Abdur-Rahman bataati hain: Ek Yahudi aurat Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se kuch poochhne aayi aur kaha: "Allah aapko qabar ke azaab se panah de." Isliye Ayesha ne Allah ke Rasool se pucha: "Kya logon ko unki qabron mein saza di jayegi?" Allah ke Rasool ne qabar ke azaab se Allah ki panah maangi (haan mein jawab). Ek din Allah ke Rasool kahin jaane ke liye sawar hue magar suraj grahan ho gaya. Aap subah wapas aaye aur (apni biwiyon ke) gharon ke peechhe se guzarte huye grahan ki namaz ke liye khade hue, aur log unke peechhe khade hue. Aap lambi der tak khade rahe, phir lambi der tak ruku kiya, phir seedhe khade hue jo pehli der se chhota tha, phir lambi der tak ruku kiya jo pehle se chhota tha, phir sar utha kar lambi der tak sajda kiya, phir (doosri rakat ke liye) lambi der tak khade rahe magar pehli rakat se chhota. Phir lambi der tak ruku kiya jo pehle se chhota tha. Phir lambi der tak khade rahe magar pehli se chhota, phir dobara lambi der tak ruku kiya jo pehle se chhota tha aur phir pehli se chhoti der tak sajda kiya. Phir Aap ne namaz khatam ki (aur khutba dete huye) jo Allah ne chaha kaha; aur logon ko qabar ke azaab se Allah ki panah maangne ka hukum diya.

e: Narrated Abu Mas`ud:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The sun and the moon do not eclipse because of someone's death or life but they are two signs amongst the signs of Allah, so pray whenever you see them
hi: Abu Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Suraj aur chaand kisi ki maut ya zindagi ki wajah se grahan nahi hote, balki yeh Allah ki nishaniyon mein se do nishaniyan hain, isliye jab bhi tum unhe dekho, namaz padho."

e: Narrated `Aisha:In the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) the sun eclipsed and the Prophet (ﷺ) stood up to offer the prayer with the people and recited a long recitation, then he performed a prolonged bowing, and then lifted his head and recited a prolonged recitation which was shorter than the first. Then he performed a prolonged bowing which was shorter than the first and then lifted his head and performed two prostrations. He then stood up for the second rak`a and offered it like the first. Then he stood up and said, "The sun and the moon do not eclipse because of someone's life or death but they are two signs amongst the signs of Allah which He shows to His worshipers. So whenever you see them, make haste for the prayer
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi ke zamane mein suraj grahan hua aur Nabi logon ke saath namaz padhne khade hue aur lambi tilawat ki, phir lambi der tak ruku kiya, phir sar utha kar lambi tilawat ki jo pehli se chhoti thi. Phir lambi der tak ruku kiya jo pehle se chhota tha, phir sar utha kar do sajde kiye. Phir doosri rakat ke liye khade hue aur pehli jaisi hi padhi. Phir khade hue aur farmaya: "Suraj aur chaand kisi ki zindagi ya maut ki wajah se grahan nahi hote, balki yeh Allah ki nishaniyon mein se do nishaniyan hain jo woh apne bandon ko dikhaata hai. Isliye jab tum unhe dekho, namaz ke liye jaldi karo."

e: Narrated Abu Musa:The sun eclipsed and the Prophet (ﷺ) got up, being afraid that it might be the Hour (i.e. Day of Judgment). He went to the Mosque and offered the prayer with the longest Qiyam, bowing and prostration that I had ever seen him doing. Then he said, "These signs which Allah sends do not occur because of the life or death of somebody, but Allah makes His worshipers afraid by them. So when you see anything thereof, proceed to remember Allah, invoke Him and ask for His forgiveness
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Suraj grahan hua aur Nabi is dar se ke kahin yeh Qiyamat (ki ghadi) na ho, uth khade hue. Aap masjid gaye aur sabse lambi Qiyam, ruku aur sajde ke saath namaz padhi jo maine unhe kabhi karte nahi dekha tha. Phir Aap ne farmaya: "Yeh nishaaniyan jo Allah bhejta hai, kisi ki zindagi ya maut ki wajah se nahi hoti, balki Allah inse apne bandon ko darata hai. Isliye jab tum inme se kuch dekho, Allah ko yaad karne, usse dua karne aur maafi maangne mein lag jao."

e: Narrated Al-Mughira bin Shu`ba:On the day of Ibrahim's death, the sun eclipsed and the people said that the eclipse was due to the death of Ibrahim (the son of the Prophet). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The sun and the moon are two signs amongst the signs of Allah. They do not eclipse because of someone's death or life. So when you see them, invoke Allah and pray till the eclipse is clear
hi: Al-Mughira bin Shu'ba (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ibrahim ki maut ke din suraj grahan hua aur log kehne lage ke grahan Ibrahim (Nabi ke bete) ki maut ki wajah se hua. Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Suraj aur chaand Allah ki do nishaniyan hain. Yeh kisi ki maut ya zindagi ki wajah se grahan nahi hote. Isliye jab tum unhe dekho, Allah se dua karo aur namaz padho jab tak grahan saaf na ho jaaye."

e: And this was narrated by Asma' who said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) finished the eclipse prayer and by then the sun (eclipse) had cleared. Then he delivered the Khutba (religious talk) and praised Allah as He deserved and then said Amma ba'du
hi: Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne bataya: "Allah ke Rasool ne grahan ki namaz khatam ki jab tak suraj (grahan) saaf ho chuka tha. Phir unhone khutba diya aur Allah ki laayiq hamd ki, phir kaha 'Amma ba'du.'"

e: Narrated Abu Bakra:In the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) the sun eclipsed and then he offered a two rak`at prayer
hi: Abu Bakra (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ke zamane mein suraj grahan hua aur Aap ne do rakat namaz padhi.

e: Narrated Abu Bakra:In the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) the sun eclipsed and he went out dragging his clothes till he reached the Mosque. The people gathered around him and he led them and offered two rak`at. When the sun (eclipse) cleared, he said, "The sun and the moon are two signs amongst the signs of Allah; they do not eclipse because of the death of someone, and so when an eclipse occurs, pray and invoke Allah till the eclipse is over." It happened that a son of the Prophet (ﷺ) called Ibrahim died on that day and the people were talking about that (saying that the eclipse was caused by his death)
hi: Abu Bakra (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ke zamane mein suraj grahan hua aur Aap apne kapde ghaseette hue bahar aaye yahan tak ke masjid pahunche. Log unke aas-paas jama ho gaye aur Aap ne unki imamat karke do rakat padhi. Jab suraj (grahan) saaf ho gaya, Aap ne farmaya: "Suraj aur chaand Allah ki do nishaniyan hain; yeh kisi ki maut ki wajah se grahan nahi hote, isliye jab grahan ho, namaz padho aur Allah se dua karo jab tak grahan khatam na ho jaaye." Aisa hua ke Nabi ke bete Ibrahim ka intiqal usi din hua, aur log iske baare mein baat kar rahe the (ke grahan unki maut ki wajah se hua).

e: Narrated Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) led us and performed four bowing in two rak`at during the solar eclipse and the first rak`a was longer
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi ne humari imamat ki aur do rakat mein chaar ruku kiye suraj grahan ke waqt, aur pehli rakat lambi thi.

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) recited (the Qur'an) aloud during the eclipse prayer and when he had finished the eclipse prayer he said the Takbir and bowed. When he stood straight from bowing he would say "Sami 'allahu liman hamidah Rabbana wa laka l-hamd." And he would again start reciting. In the eclipse prayer there are four bowing and four prostrations in two rak`at. Al-Auza'i and others said that they had heard Az-Zuhri from 'Urwa from `Aisha saying, "In the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) the sun eclipsed, and he made a person to announce: 'Prayer in congregation.' He led the prayer and performed four bowing and four prostrations in two rak`at." Narrated Al-Walid that `Abdur-Rahman bin Namir had informed him that he had heard the same. Ibn Shihab heard the same. Az-Zuhri said, "I asked ('Urwa), 'What did your brother `Abdullah bin Az-Zubair do? He prayed two rak`at (of the eclipse prayer) like the morning prayer, when he offered the (eclipse) prayer in Medina.' 'Urwa replied that he had missed (i.e. did not pray according to) the Prophet's tradition." Sulaiman bin Kathir and Sufyan bin Husain narrated from Az-Zuhri that the prayer for the eclipse used to be offered with loud recitation
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi ne grahan ki namaz mein buland aawaaz se tilawat ki, aur jab grahan ki namaz khatam kar li, Takbir kahi aur ruku kiya. Ruku se seedhe khade hote huye kaha "Sami' Allahu liman hamidah Rabbana wa laka l-hamd." Aur Aap ne phir tilawat shuru ki. Grahan ki namaz mein do rakaton mein chaar ruku aur chaar sajde hote hain. Al-Auza'i aur doosron ne kaha ke unhone Az-Zuhri ko Urwa ke, Ayesha ke hawale se kehte suna: "Allah ke Rasool ke zamane mein suraj grahan hua, aur unhone kisi se elaan karwaya: 'Namaz jamaat mein.' Aap ne imamat ki aur do rakaton mein chaar ruku aur chaar sajde kiye." Al-Walid ne bataya ke Abdur-Rahman bin Namir ne unhe bataya ke unhone bhi yehi suna. Ibn Shihab ne bhi yehi suna. Az-Zuhri ne kaha: "Maine (Urwa se) pucha: 'Aapke bhai Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kya kiya?' Unhone Fajr jaisi do rakat (grahan ki namaz) padhi jab Madina mein grahan ki namaz padhai. Urwa ne jawab diya ke unhone Nabi ki riwayat miss ki (uske mutabiq amal nahi kiya)." Sulaiman bin Kathir aur Sufyan bin Husain ne Az-Zuhri se riwayat ki ke grahan ki namaz buland aawaaz mein padhi jaati thi.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Mas`ud:The Prophet (ﷺ) recited Surat an-Najm (53) at Mecca and prostrated while reciting it and those who were with him did the same except an old man who took a handful of small stones or earth and lifted it to his forehead and said, "This is sufficient for me." Later on, I saw him killed as a non-believer
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Mecca mein Surah An-Najm (53) tilawat ki aur usme sajda kiya, aur unke saath maujood log bhi karne lage, siwaye ek budhe shaks ke jisne kanker ya mitti ka ek mutthi bhar liya aur apne maathe tak uthaya, aur kaha: "Yeh mere liye kaafi hai." Baad mein maine unhe kaafir hokar qatl hote dekha.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:On Fridays the Prophet (ﷺ) used to recite Alif Lam Mim Tanzil-As-Sajda (in the first rak`a) and Hal ata `alal-insani i.e. Surat ad-Dahr (LXXVI) (in the second rak`a), in the Fajr prayer
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jumme ke din Nabi Fajr ki namaz mein "Alif Lam Mim Tanzil-As-Sajda" (pehli rakat mein) aur "Hal ata alal-insani" yaani Surah Ad-Dahr (76) (doosri rakat mein) tilawat karte the.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The prostration of Sa`d is not a compulsory one but I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) prostrating while reciting it
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Sa'd ka sajda (Surah Sad ka sajda) farz nahi hai magar maine Nabi ko usme sajda karte dekha.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Mas`ud:The Prophet (ﷺ) recited Surat-an-Najm (53) and prostrated while reciting it and all the people prostrated and a man amongst the people took a handful of stones or earth and raised it to his face and said, "This is sufficient for me." Later on I saw him killed as a non-believer
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Surah An-Najm (53) tilawat ki aur usme sajda kiya, aur sab log bhi sajda karne lage, siwaye ek shaks ke jisne mutthi bhar patthar ya mitti li aur apne chehre tak uthai aur kaha: "Yeh mere liye kaafi hai." Baad mein maine use kaafir hokar qatl hote dekha.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) prostrated while reciting An-Najm and with him prostrated the Muslims, the pagans, the jinns, and all human beings
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne An-Najm tilawat karte huye sajda kiya aur unke saath Musalman, mushrik, jinn aur sab insaanon ne sajda kiya.

e: Narrated `Ata' bin Yasar:I asked Zaid bin Thabit about prostration on which he said that he had recited An-Najm before the Prophet, yet he (the Prophet) had not performed a prostration
hi: Ata bin Yasar bataate hain: Maine Zaid bin Thabit (رضی اللہ عنہ) se sajde ke baare mein pucha, unhone jawab diya ke unhone Nabi ke saamne An-Najm tilawat ki thi, magar Aap ne (usme) sajda nahi kiya.

e: Narrated Zaid bin Thabit:I recited An-Najm before the Prophet, yet he did not perform a prostration
hi: Zaid bin Thabit (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi ke saamne An-Najm tilawat ki, magar Aap ne sajda nahi kiya.

e: Narrated Abu Salama:I saw Abu Huraira reciting Idha-Sama' un-Shaqqat and he prostrated during its recitation. I asked Abu Huraira, "Didn't I see you prostrating?" Abu Huraira said, "Had I not seen the Prophet (ﷺ) prostrating, I would not have prostrated
hi: Abu Salama bataate hain: Maine Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko "Idha-Sama' un-Shaqqat" tilawat karte dekha aur unhone usme sajda kiya. Maine Abu Huraira se pucha: "Kya maine aapko sajda karte nahi dekha?" Abu Huraira ne kaha: "Agar maine Nabi ko sajda karte na dekha hota, to main bhi sajda na karta."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:When the Prophet (ﷺ) recited a Sura that contained the prostration he would prostrate and we would do the same and some of us (because of the heavy rush) could not find a place for prostration
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Jab Nabi kisi Surah ki tilawat karte jisme sajda ho, Aap sajda karte aur hum bhi karte, aur kuch log (bhaari bhirr ki wajah se) sajde ke liye jagah nahi paate.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:When the Prophet (ﷺ) recited Surat As-Sajda and we were with him, he would prostrate and we also would prostrate with him and some of us (because of the heavy rush) would not find a place (for our foreheads) to prostrate on
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Jab Nabi Surah As-Sajda tilawat karte aur hum unke saath hote, Aap sajda karte aur hum bhi unke saath sajda karte, aur kuch log (bhaari bhirr ki wajah se) apne maathe rakhne ki jagah nahi paate.

e: Narrated Rabi`a:`Umar bin Al-Khattab recited Surat-an-Nahl on a Friday on the pulpit and when he reached the verse of Sajda he got down from the pulpit and prostrated and the people also prostrated. The next Friday `Umar bin Al-Khattab recited the same Sura and when he reached the verse of Sajda he said, "O people! When we recite the verses of Sajda (during the sermon) whoever prostrates does the right thing, yet it is no sin for the one who does not prostrate." And `Umar did not prostrate (that day). Added Ibn `Umar "Allah has not made the prostration of recitation compulsory but if we wish we can do it
hi: Rabia bataate hain: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Khattab (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Jumme ko mimbar par Surah An-Nahl tilawat ki, aur jab woh sajde ki ayat tak pahunche, mimbar se utar kar sajda kiya aur log bhi sajda karne lage. Agle Jumme, Umar bin Khattab ne wahi Surah phir tilawat ki, aur jab sajde ki ayat tak pahunche, kaha: "Aye logon! Jab hum sajde ki ayaat (khutba ke dauran) tilawat karte hain, jo sajda kare woh sahi karta hai, magar jo na kare, uspar koi gunah nahi." Aur Umar ne (us din) sajda nahi kiya. Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne joda: "Allah ne tilawat ka sajda farz nahi kiya, magar agar hum chahen to kar sakte hain."

e: Narrated Abu Rafi`:I offered the `Isha' prayer behind Abu Huraira and he recited Idhas-Sama' Un-Shaqqat, and prostrated. I said, "What is this?" Abu Huraira said, "I prostrated behind Abul-Qasim and I will do the same till I meet him
hi: Abu Rafi (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke peechhe Isha padhi, unhone "Idhas-Sama' Un-Shaqqat" tilawat ki aur sajda kiya. Maine pucha: "Yeh kya hai?" Abu Huraira ne kaha: "Maine Abul-Qasim (Nabi) ke peechhe sajda kiya tha aur jab tak unse na miloon, karta rahunga."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar.:Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) recited the Sura which contained the prostration of recitation he used to prostrate and then we too, would prostrate and some of us did not find a place for prostration
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Jab bhi Nabi tilawat ke sajde wali Surah tilawat karte, Aap sajda karte, phir hum bhi sajda karte, aur kuch logon ko sajde ki jagah nahi milti.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) once stayed for nineteen days and prayed shortened prayers. So when we travelled (and stayed) for nineteen days, we used to shorten the prayer but if we traveled (and stayed) for a longer period we used to offer the full prayer
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ek baar unatis din tak (kahin) rukke aur (namaz) qasr (chhoti karke) padhi. Isliye jab bhi hum unatis din tak (kahin) rukte, hum bhi namaz qasr karte, magar agar hum usse zyada rukte, poori namaz padhte.

e: Narrated Yahya bin 'Is-haq:I heard Anas saying, "We traveled with the Prophet (ﷺ) from Medina to Mecca and offered two rak`at (for every prayer) till we returned to Medina." I said, "Did you stay for a while in Mecca?" He replied, "We stayed in Mecca for ten days
hi: Yahya bin Ishaq bataate hain: Maine Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko kehte suna: "Hum Nabi ke saath Madina se Mecca gaye aur (har namaz mein) do rakat padhte rahe yahan tak ke wapas Madina aa gaye." Maine pucha: "Kya aap Mecca mein kuch der ruke the?" Unhone jawab diya: "Hum Mecca mein das din ruke the."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:I offered the prayer with the Prophet, Abu Bakr and `Umar at Mina and it was of two rak`at. `Uthman in the early days of his caliphate did the same, but later on he started praying the full prayer
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Maine Nabi, Abu Bakr aur Umar ke saath Mina mein namaz padhi aur woh do rakat thi. Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne apni khilafat ke shuru ke dinon mein bhi yehi kiya, magar baad mein poori namaz padhne lage.

e: Narrated Haritha bin Wahab:The Prophet (ﷺ) led us in the prayer at Mina during the peace period by offering two rak`at
hi: Haritha bin Wahab bataate hain: Nabi ne humari imamat Mina mein sulah ke zamane mein do rakat padha kar ki.

e: Narrated `Abdur Rahman bin Yazid:We offered a four rak`at prayer at Mina behind Ibn `Affan . `Abdullah bin Mas`ud was informed about it. He said sadly, "Truly to Allah we belong and truly to Him we shall return." And added, "I prayed two rak`at with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) at Mina and similarly with Abu Bakr and with `Umar (during their caliphates)." He further said, "May I be lucky enough to have two of the four rak`at accepted (by Allah)
hi: Abdur Rahman bin Yazid bataate hain: Humne Mina mein Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke peechhe chaar rakat padhi. Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko iska pata chala. Unhone dukhi hokar kaha: "Beshak hum Allah ke hain aur usi ki taraf lautenge." Aur joda: "Maine Allah ke Rasool ke saath Mina mein do rakat padhi, aur isi tarah Abu Bakr aur Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) (unki khilafat mein) ke saath." Phir unhone kaha: "Kaash chaar rakaton mein se meri do rakatein (Allah ke haan) qubool ho jaayein."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) and his companions reached Mecca in the morning of the 4th Dhul-Hijja reciting Talbiya (O Allah! We are obedient to your orders, we respond to your call) ... intending to perform Hajj. The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered his companions to assume the Ihram for Umra instead of Hajj, excepting those who had Hadi (sacrifice) with them
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi aur unke sahaba 4 Zul-Hijja ki subah Talbiya kehte huye Mecca pahunche, Hajj ki niyyat se. Nabi ne apne sahaba ko Hajj ke bajaye Umrah ka Ihram baandhne ka hukum diya, siwaye un logon ke jinke paas Hadi (qurbani ka janwar) tha.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A woman should not travel for more than three days except with a Dhi-Mahram (i.e. a male with whom she cannot marry at all, e.g. her brother, father, grandfather, etc.) or her own husband
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Aurat ko teen din se zyada safar nahi karna chahiye siwaye Dhi-Mahram (jaise bhai, baap, dada waghera) ya apne shohar ke saath."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A woman should not travel for more than three days except with a Dhi-Mahram
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Aurat ko teen din se zyada safar nahi karna chahiye siwaye Dhi-Mahram ke."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It is not permissible for a woman who believes in Allah and the Last Day to travel for one day and night except with a Mahram
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jo aurat Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par iman rakhti hai, uske liye ek din-raat se zyada safar karna, Mahram ke bina, jaiz nahi."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik: I offered four rak`at of Zuhr prayer with the Prophet (ﷺ) at Medina and two rak`at at Dhul-Hulaifa. (i.e. shortened the `Asr prayer)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Madina mein Nabi ke saath Zuhr ki chaar rakat padhi, aur Dhul-Hulaifa mein do rakat (yaani Asr ki namaz qasr ki).

e: Narrated `Aisha:"When the prayers were first enjoined they were of two rak`at each. Later the prayer in a journey was kept as it was but the prayers for non-travelers were completed." Az-Zuhri said, "I asked `Urwa what made Aisha pray the full prayers (in journey)." He replied, "She did the same as `Uthman did
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: "Jab pehli baar namazein farz ki gayin, woh do-do rakat thi. Baad mein safar ki namaz waisi hi rahi magar (ghar par) na safar karne walon ki namazein poori kar di gayin." Az-Zuhri ne kaha: "Maine Urwa se pucha kis wajah se Ayesha safar mein bhi poori namaz padhti thi." Unhone jawab diya: "Unhone wahi kiya jo Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kiya."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:"I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) delaying the Maghrib prayer till he offered it along with the `Isha' prayer whenever he was in a hurry during the journey." Salim narrated, "Ibn `Umar used to do the same whenever he was in a hurry during the journey." And Salim added, "Ibn `Umar used to pray the Maghrib and `Isha' prayers together in Al-Muzdalifa." Salim said, "Ibn `Umar delayed the Maghrib prayer because at that time he heard the news of the death of his wife Safiya bint Abi `Ubaid. I said to him, 'The prayer (is due).' He said, 'Go on.' Again I said, 'The prayer (is due).' He said, 'Go on,' till we covered two or three miles. Then he got down, prayed and said, 'I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) praying in this way, whenever he was in a hurry during the journey.' `Abdullah (bin `Umar) added, "Whenever the Prophet was in a hurry, he used to delay the Maghrib prayer and then offer three rak`at (of the Maghrib) and perform Taslim, and after waiting for a short while, Iqama used to be pronounced for the `Isha' prayer when he would offer two rak`at and perform Taslim. He would never offer any optional prayer till the middle of the night (when he used to pray the Tahajjud)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: "Maine Allah ke Rasool ko dekha ke jab woh safar mein jaldi mein hote, Maghrib ki namaz Isha ke saath jodkar taal dete." Salim ne bataya: "Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bhi jab safar mein jaldi mein hote, yehi karte." Salim ne joda: "Ibn Umar Muzdalifa mein Maghrib aur Isha ek saath padhte." Salim ne kaha: "Ibn Umar ne Maghrib is liye taali kyunke us waqt unhe apni biwi Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Abi Ubaid ki maut ki khabar mili. Maine unse kaha: 'Namaz (ka waqt aa gaya hai).' Unhone kaha: 'Chalte raho.' Maine phir kaha: 'Namaz (ka waqt).' Unhone kaha: 'Chalte raho,' yahan tak ke humne do-teen mil tay kar liye. Phir woh utre, namaz padhi aur kaha: 'Maine Nabi ko isi tarah namaz padhte dekha hai, jab bhi woh safar mein jaldi mein hote.'" Abdullah bin Umar ne joda: "Jab bhi Nabi jaldi mein hote, Maghrib taal dete, phir teen rakat (Maghrib ki) padhkar Taslim karte, aur thodi der baad Isha ki Iqama hoti jisme woh do rakat padhte aur Taslim karte. Aap kabhi bhi aadhi raat se pehle koi nafil namaz nahi padhte the (jab woh Tahajjud padhte)."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin 'Amir from his father who said:I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) offering the prayer on his mount (Rahila) whatever direction it took
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amir, apne waalid ke hawale se: "Maine Nabi ko apni sawari (Rahila) par namaz padhte dekha, jidhar bhi woh mudti."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to offer the Nawafil, while riding, facing a direction other than that of the Qibla
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi Nawafil (nafil namazein) sawari par padhte the, Qibla ke ilawa kisi bhi taraf mun karke.

e: Narrated Nafi`:Ibn `Umar (while on a journey) used to offer the prayer and the witr on his mount (Rahila). He said that the Prophet (ﷺ) used to do so
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) (safar mein) namaz aur Witr apni sawari (Rahila) par padhte the. Unhone kaha ke Nabi bhi aisa hi karte the.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Dinar:On traveling, `Abdullah bin `Umar used to offer the prayer on his Mount by signs whatever direction it took. `Abdullah said that the Prophet (ﷺ) used to do so
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Dinar bataate hain: Safar mein, Abdullah bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) apni sawari par ishare se namaz padhte, jidhar bhi sawari mudti. Abdullah ne kaha ke Nabi bhi aisa hi karte the.

e: Narrated 'Amir bin Rabi`a:I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) on his Mount praying Nawafil by nodding his head, whatever direction he faced, but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) never did the same in offering the compulsory prayers
hi: Amir bin Rabia bataate hain: Maine Nabi ko apni sawari par sar hilate huye Nawafil padhte dekha, jidhar bhi woh mun karte, magar Allah ke Rasool ne kabhi farz namaz mein aisa nahi kiya.

e: Narrated Salim:At night `Abdullah bin `Umar used to offer the prayer on the back of his animal during the journey and never cared about the direction he faced. Ibn `Umar said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to offer the optional prayer on the back of his Mount facing any direction and also used to pray the witr on it but never offered the compulsory prayer on it
hi: Salim bataate hain: Raat ko Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) safar mein apne janwar ki pusht par namaz padhte aur jidhar mun hota uski parwa nahi karte. Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool apni sawari ki pusht par kisi bhi taraf mun karke nafil namaz padhte, aur usi par Witr bhi padhte, magar kabhi usi par farz namaz nahi padhte the."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to pray (the Nawafil) on his Mount facing east and whenever he wanted to offer the compulsory prayer, he used to dismount and face the Qibla
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi apni sawari par mashriq ki taraf mun karke (Nawafil) padhte the, aur jab farz namaz padhni hoti, utar kar Qibla ki taraf mun karte.

e: Narrated Anas bin Seereen:We went to receive Anas bin Malik when he returned from Sham and met him at a place called 'Ain at-Tamr. I saw him praying riding the donkey, with his face to this direction, i.e. to the left of the Qibla. I said to him, "I have seen you offering the prayer in a direction other than that of the Qibla." He replied, "If I had not seen Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) doing it, I would not have done it
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Seereen bataate hain: Hum Anas bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko lene gaye jab woh Sham se wapas aa rahe the, aur unse Ain at-Tamr naam ki jagah mile. Maine unhe gadhe par sawar namaz padhte dekha, unka mun is taraf tha, yaani Qibla ki baayi taraf. Maine unse kaha: "Maine aapko Qibla ke ilawa kisi aur taraf namaz padhte dekha." Unhone jawab diya: "Agar maine Allah ke Rasool ko aisa karte na dekha hota, to main bhi na karta."

e: Narrated Hafs bin `Asim:Ibn `Umar went on a journey and said, "I accompanied the Prophet (ﷺ) and he did not offer optional prayers during the journey, and Allah says: 'Verily! In Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) you have a good example to follow
hi: Hafs bin Asim bataate hain: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ek safar par gaye aur kaha: "Main Nabi ke saath tha, aur Aap safar mein nafil namazein nahi padhte the, aur Allah farmata hai: 'Beshak Allah ke Rasool mein tumhare liye behtareen namoona hai.'"

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:I accompanied Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he never offered more than two rak`at during the journey. Abu Bakr, `Umar and `Uthman used to do the same
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Main Allah ke Rasool ke saath tha aur Aap safar mein kabhi do rakat se zyada nahi padhte the. Abu Bakr, Umar aur Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bhi yehi karte the.

e: Narrated Ibn Abu Laila:Only Um Hani told us that she had seen the Prophet (ﷺ) offering the Duha (forenoon prayer). She said, "On the day of the conquest of Mecca, the Prophet (ﷺ) took a bath in my house and offered eight rak`at. I never saw him praying such a light prayer but he performed perfect prostration and bowing
hi: Ibn Abu Laila bataate hain: Sirf Um Hani ne humein bataya ke unhone Nabi ko Duha (dopahar se pehle) ki namaz padhte dekha tha. Unhone kaha: "Fatah-e-Mecca ke din, Nabi ne mere ghar ghusl kiya aur aath rakat padhi. Maine unhe kabhi itni halki namaz padhte nahi dekha, magar unke ruku-sajda mukammal the."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Amir that his father had told him that he had seen the Prophet (ﷺ) praying Nawafil at night on the back of his Mount on a journey, facing whatever direction it took
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amir bataate hain, apne waalid ke hawale se ke unhone Nabi ko raat mein apni sawari ki pusht par Nawafil padhte dekha, ek safar mein, jidhar bhi sawari mudti.

e: Narrated Salim bin `Abdullah:Ibn `Umar said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to pray the Nawafil on the back of his Mount (carriage) by signs facing any direction." Ibn `Umar used to do the same
hi: Salim bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool apni sawari ki pusht par ishare se, kisi bhi taraf mun karke, Nawafil padhte the." Ibn Umar bhi yehi karte the.

e: Narrated Salim's father:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to offer the Maghrib and `Isha' prayers together whenever he was in a hurry on a journey
hi: Salim ke waalid bataate hain: Jab bhi Nabi safar mein jaldi mein hote, Maghrib aur Isha ek saath padhte.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to offer the Zuhr and `Asr prayers together on journeys, and also used to offer the Maghrib and `Isha' prayers together. Narrated Anas bin Malik: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to offer the Maghrib and the `Isha' prayers together on journeys
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool safar mein Zuhr-Asr ek saath aur Maghrib-Isha ek saath padhte the. Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi safar mein Maghrib-Isha ek saath padhte the.

e: Narrated Anas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to offer these two prayers together on journeys i.e. the Maghrib and the `Isha
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool safar mein yeh do namazein — Maghrib aur Isha — ek saath padhte the.

e: Narrated Az-Zuhri:Salim told me, "`Abdullah bin `Umar said, 'I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) delaying the Maghrib prayer till he offered it along with the `Isha prayer whenever he was in a hurry during the journey.' " Salim said, "Abdullah bin `Umar used to do the same whenever he was in a hurry during the journey. After making the call for Iqama, for the Maghrib prayer he used to offer three rak`at and then perform Taslim. After waiting for a short while, he would pronounce the Iqama for the `Isha' prayer and offer two rak`at and perform Taslim. He never prayed any Nawafil in between the two prayers or after the `Isha' prayers till he got up in the middle of the night (for Tahajjud prayer)
hi: Az-Zuhri bataate hain: Salim ne mujhe bataya: "Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: 'Maine Allah ke Rasool ko dekha ke jab woh safar mein jaldi mein hote, Maghrib ki namaz Isha ke saath jodkar taal dete.'" Salim ne kaha: "Abdullah bin Umar bhi jab safar mein jaldi mein hote, yehi karte. Maghrib ki Iqama ke baad woh teen rakat padhte, phir Taslim karte. Thodi der intezar karke, Isha ki Iqama karte aur do rakat padhkar Taslim karte. Woh donon namazon ke beech ya Isha ke baad koi Nawafil nahi padhte the, jab tak aadhi raat na ho jaati (Tahajjud ke liye)."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) started a journey before noon, he used to delay the Zuhr prayer till the time of `Asr and then offer them together; and if the sun declined (at noon) he used to offer the Zuhr prayer and then ride (for the journey)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab bhi Nabi dopahar se pehle safar shuru karte, Zuhr ki namaz Asr ke waqt tak taal dete aur donon ek saath padhte; aur agar suraj dhal chuka hota (dopahar ho chuki hoti), Zuhr padh kar (safar ke liye) sawar hote.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) started the journey before noon, he used to delay the Zuhr prayer till the time for the `Asr prayer and then he would dismount and pray them together; and whenever the sun declined before he started the journey he used to offer the Zuhr prayer and then ride (for the journey)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab bhi Nabi dopahar se pehle safar shuru karte, Zuhr ki namaz Asr ke waqt tak taal dete, phir utar kar donon ek saath padhte; aur jab bhi suraj dhal jaata safar shuru karne se pehle, Zuhr padh kar (safar ke liye) sawar hote.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) started on a journey before noon, he used to delay the Zuhr prayer till the time for the 'Asr prayer and then he would dismount and offer them together; and whenever the sun declined before he started on a journey he used to offer the Zuhr prayers and then ride (for journey)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab bhi Nabi dopahar se pehle safar shuru karte, Zuhr Asr ke waqt tak taal dete, phir utar kar donon ek saath padhte; aur jab bhi suraj dhal jaata safar shuru karne se pehle, Zuhr padh kar (safar ke liye) sawar hote.

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prayed in his house while sitting during his illness and the people prayed behind him standing and he pointed to them to sit down. When he had finished the prayer, he said, "The Imam is to be followed and so when he bows you should bow; and when he lifts his head you should also do the same
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool ne apni bimari mein ghar mein baithkar namaz padhi aur log unke peechhe khade padhe, Aap ne unhe baithne ka ishara kiya. Namaz khatam karke farmaya: "Imam ki pairvi ki jaati hai, isliye jab woh ruku kare, tum bhi karo; aur jab woh sar utha kar khade ho, tum bhi ho."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) fell down from a horse and his right side was either injured or scratched, so we went to inquire about his health. The time for the prayer became due and he offered the prayer while sitting and we prayed while standing. He said, "The Imam is to be followed; so if he says Takbir, you should also say Takbir, and if he bows you should also bow; and when he lifts his head you should also do the same and if he says: Sami`a l-lahu liman hamidah (Allah hears whoever sends his praises to Him) you should say: Rabbana walakal-Hamd (O our Lord! All the praises are for You.") (See Hadith No. 656 Vol)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ghode se gire aur unki dahini taraf zakhmi ya chhili gayi, isliye hum unki tabiyat poochhne gaye. Namaz ka waqt aaya aur Aap ne baithkar namaz padhi, hum khade padhe. Aap ne farmaya: "Imam ki pairvi ki jaati hai; isliye agar woh Takbir kahe, tum bhi kaho, aur agar woh ruku kare, tum bhi karo; aur jab woh sar utha kar khade ho, tum bhi ho, aur agar woh kahe: 'Sami' Allahu liman hamidah,' tum kaho: 'Rabbana walakal-Hamd' (Aye humare Rab! Sab tareef teri hi hai)."

e: Narrated `Imran bin Husain:(who had piles) I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about the praying of a man while sitting. He said, "If he prays while standing it is better and he who prays while sitting gets half the reward of that who prays standing; and whoever prays while Lying gets half the reward of that who prays while sitting
hi: Imran bin Husain (رضی اللہ عنہ), jinhe bawaseer (piles) thi, bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool se baithkar namaz padhne ke baare mein pucha. Aap ne farmaya: "Khade hokar padhna behtar hai, aur jo baithkar padhe use khade hokar padhne wale se aadha sawaab milta hai; aur jo let kar padhe use baithkar padhne wale se aadha sawaab milta hai."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Buraida:`Imran bin Husain had piles. Once Abu Ma mar narrated from `Imran bin Husain had said, "I asked the Prophet (ﷺ) about the prayer of a person while sitting. He said, 'It is better for one to pray standing; and whoever prays sitting gets half the reward of that who prays while standing; and whoever prays while Lying gets half the reward of that who prays while sitting
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Buraida (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Imran bin Husain (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko bawaseer thi. Ek baar Abu Ma'mar ne Imran bin Husain se riwayat ki ke unhone kaha: "Maine Nabi se baithkar namaz padhne ke baare mein pucha. Aap ne farmaya: 'Khade hokar padhna behtar hai; jo baithkar padhe use khade wale se aadha sawaab milta hai; aur jo let kar padhe use baithkar padhne wale se aadha sawaab milta hai.'"

e: Narrated `Imran bin Husain: I had piles, so I asked the Prophet (ﷺ) about the prayer. He said, "Pray while standing and if you can't, pray while sitting and if you cannot do even that, then pray Lying on your side
hi: Imran bin Husain (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Mujhe bawaseer thi, isliye maine Nabi se namaz ke baare mein pucha. Aap ne farmaya: "Khade hokar padho, aur agar na kar sako, baithkar padho, aur agar woh bhi na kar sako, to apne pehlu par let kar padho."

e: Narrated Aisha:(the mother of the faithful believers) I never saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) offering the night prayer while sitting except in his old age and then he used to recite while sitting and whenever he wanted to bow he would get up and recite thirty or forty verses (while standing) and then bow
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Ummul-Momineen) bataati hain: Maine kabhi Allah ke Rasool ko raat ki namaz baithkar padhte nahi dekha siwaye unki budhape mein, aur us waqt woh baithkar tilawat karte, aur jab bhi ruku karna chahte, khade hote aur teen ya chaalees ayaat (khade hokar) tilawat karte, phir ruku karte.

e: Narrated `Aisha:(the mother of the faithful believers) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (in his last days) used to pray sitting. He would recite while sitting, and when thirty or forty verses remained from the recitation he would get up and recite them while standing and then he would bow and prostrate. He used to do the same in the second rak`a. After finishing the Prayer he used to look at me and if I was awake he would talk to me and if I was asleep, he would lie down
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Ummul-Momineen) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (apni aakhri zindagi mein) baithkar namaz padhte the. Woh baithkar tilawat karte, aur jab tilawat mein teen ya chaalees ayaat baaki reh jaatin, khade hokar unhe padhte, phir ruku aur sajda karte. Doosri rakat mein bhi yehi karte. Namaz khatam karke Aap meri taraf dekhte, agar main jaagi hoti to mujhse baat karte, aur agar main soti hoti to let jaate.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When the Prophet (ﷺ) got up at night to offer the Tahajjud prayer, he used to say: Allahumma lakal-hamd. Anta qaiyyimus-samawati wal-ard wa man fihinna. Walakal-hamd, Laka mulkus-samawati wal-ard wa man fihinna. Walakal-hamd, anta nurus-samawati wal-ard. Wa lakal-hamd, anta-l-haq wa wa'duka-lhaq, wa liqa'uka Haq, wa qauluka Haq, wal-jannatu Han wan-naru Haq wannabiyuna Haq. Wa Muhammadun, sallal-lahu'alaihi wasallam, Haq, was-sa'atu Haq. Allahumma aslamtu Laka wabika amantu, wa 'Alaika tawakkaltu, wa ilaika anabtu wa bika khasamtu, wa ilaika hakamtu faghfir li ma qaddamtu wama akh-khartu wama as-rartu wama'a lantu, anta-l-muqaddim wa anta-l-mu akh-khir, la ilaha illa anta (or la ilaha ghairuka). (O Allah! All the praises are for you, You are the Holder of the Heavens and the Earth, And whatever is in them. All the praises are for You; You have the possession of the Heavens and the Earth And whatever is in them. All the praises are for You; You are the Light of the Heavens and the Earth And all the praises are for You; You are the King of the Heavens and the Earth; And all the praises are for You; You are the Truth and Your Promise is the truth, And to meet You is true, Your Word is the truth And Paradise is true And Hell is true And all the Prophets (Peace be upon them) are true; And Muhammad is true, And the Day of Resurrection is true. O Allah ! I surrender (my will) to You; I believe in You and depend on You. And repent to You, And with Your help I argue (with my opponents, the non-believers) And I take You as a judge (to judge between us). Please forgive me my previous And future sins; And whatever I concealed or revealed And You are the One who make (some people) forward And (some) backward. There is none to be worshipped but you . Sufyan said that `Abdul Karim Abu Umaiya added to the above, 'Wala haula Wala quwata illa billah' (There is neither might nor power except with Allah)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Jab Nabi raat ko Tahajjud ke liye uthte, kehte: "Allahumma lakal-hamd. Anta qaiyyimus-samawati wal-ard wa man fihinna. Walakal-hamd, Laka mulkus-samawati wal-ard wa man fihinna. Walakal-hamd, anta nurus-samawati wal-ard. Wa lakal-hamd, anta-l-haq wa wa'duka-lhaq, wa liqa'uka Haq, wa qauluka Haq, wal-jannatu Haq wan-naru Haq wannabiyuna Haq. Wa Muhammadun, sallal-lahu alaihi wasallam, Haq, was-sa'atu Haq. Allahumma aslamtu Laka wabika amantu, wa 'Alaika tawakkaltu, wa ilaika anabtu wa bika khasamtu, wa ilaika hakamtu faghfir li ma qaddamtu wama akh-khartu wama as-rartu wama'a lantu, anta-l-muqaddim wa anta-l-mu akh-khir, la ilaha illa anta" (Aye Allah! Sab tareef teri hi hai, Tu aasman-zameen aur jo bhi unme hai unka sambhalne wala hai. Sab tareef teri hi hai; teri hi hukumat hai aasman-zameen aur jo unme hai uspar. Sab tareef teri hi hai; Tu aasman-zameen ka noor hai. Sab tareef teri hi hai; Tu haqq hai aur tera waada haqq hai, aur tujhse milna haqq hai, tera kalaam haqq hai, Jannat haqq hai, Dozakh haqq hai, tamam Nabi haqq hain, aur Muhammad haqq hain, aur Qiyamat haqq hai. Aye Allah! Main teri farmabardari mein aa gaya, tujh par iman laaya, tujh par bharosa kiya, teri taraf lauta, tere zariye jhagda karta hoon, aur tujhi ko faisla maanta hoon, isliye mere agle-pichhle gunah maaf kar, jo maine chhupaya aur zahir kiya. Tu hi aage badhane wala hai aur peechhe hatane wala, tere siwa koi mabood nahi). Sufyan ne kaha Abdul Karim Abu Umaiya ne isme joda: "Wala haula Wala quwata illa billah" (Allah ke siwa na koi taaqat hai na quwwat).

e: Narrated Salim's father:In the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) whosoever saw a dream would narrate it to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). I had a wish of seeing a dream to narrate it to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) I was a grown up boy and used to sleep in the Mosque in the lifetime of the Prophet. I saw in the dream that two angels caught hold of me and took me to the Fire which was built all round like a built well and had two poles in it and the people in it were known to me. I started saying, "I seek refuge with Allah from the Fire." Then I met another angel who told me not to be afraid. I narrated the dream to Hafsa who told it to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). The Prophet said, "Abdullah is a good man. I wish he prayed Tahajjud." After that `Abdullah (i.e. Salim's father) used to sleep but a little at night
hi: Salim ke waalid bataate hain: Nabi ke zamane mein jo bhi koi khwab dekhta, Allah ke Rasool ko sunata. Mujhe bhi khwahish thi ke koi khwab dekhun jo Allah ke Rasool ko suna sakoon. Main ek badha hua ladka tha aur Nabi ke zamane mein masjid mein sota tha. Maine khwab mein dekha ke do farishte mujhe pakad kar Aag ki taraf le gaye jo kuye ki tarah bani hui thi aur usme do sutoon the aur usme jo log the woh mere jaan-pehchaan ke the. Main kehne laga: "Main Aag se Allah ki panah maangta hoon." Phir mujhe ek doosra farishta mila jisne kaha dar mat. Maine yeh khwab Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko sunayi jinhone Allah ke Rasool ko bataya. Nabi ne farmaya: "Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) achha shaks hai. Kaash woh Tahajjud padhta." Iske baad Abdullah (Salim ke waalid) raat ko bahut kam sote the.

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to offer eleven rak`at and that was his prayer. He used to prolong the prostration to such an extent that one could recite fifty verses (of the Qur'an) before he would lift his head. He used to pray two rak`at (Sunna) before the Fajr prayer and then used to lie down on his right side till the call-maker came and informed him about the prayer
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool gyarah rakat padhte the, yehi unki namaz thi. Aap sajde ko itna lamba karte ke usme koi paanch ayaat tilawat kar sakta, isse pehle ke Aap sar uthate. Aap Fajr se pehle bhi do rakat (Sunnat) padhte, phir dahini karvat let jaate yahan tak ke bulane wala (Muazzin) aakar namaz ke baare mein batataa.

e: Narrated Jundab:The Prophet (ﷺ) became sick and did not get up (for Tahajjud prayer) for a night or two
hi: Jundab (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi bimar hue aur ek-do raat (Tahajjud ke liye) nahi uthe.

e: Narrated Jundab bin `Abdullah:Gabriel did not come to the Prophet (for some time) and so one of the Quraish women said, "His Satan has deserted him." So came the Divine Revelation: "By the forenoon And by the night When it is still! Your Lord (O Muhammad) has neither Forsaken you Nor hated you
hi: Jundab bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jibreel Nabi ke paas (kuch waqt tak) nahi aaye, isliye Quraish ki ek aurat ne kaha: "Unke shaitan ne unhe chhod diya hai." Isi waqt yeh wahi nazil hui: "Chasht ki qasam, aur raat ki jab woh sukoon paaye! Tumhare Rab (Aye Muhammad) ne na tumhe chhoda hai na tumse naraz hue hain."

e: Narrated Um Salama:One night the Prophet (ﷺ) got up and said, "Subhan Allah! How many afflictions Allah has revealed tonight and how many treasures have been sent down (disclosed). Go and wake the sleeping lady occupants of these dwellings up (for prayers), perhaps a well dressed in this world may be naked in the Hereafter
hi: Um Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ek raat Nabi uthe aur kaha: "Subhan Allah! Aaj raat Allah ne kitne fitne aur khazane nazil kiye hain (zahir kiye hain). Jaao aur in kamron mein sone wali aurton ko jagao (namaz ke liye), shayad duniya mein kapde pehnne wali Aakhirat mein nangi ho."

e: Narrated `Ali bin Abi Talib:One night Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to me and Fatima, the daughter of the Prophet (ﷺ) and asked, "Won't you pray (at night)?" I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Our souls are in the hands of Allah and if He wants us to get up He will make us get up." When I said that, he left us without saying anything and I heard that he was hitting his thigh and saying, "But man is more quarrelsome than anything
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bin Abi Talib (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek raat Allah ke Rasool mere aur Fatima (Alayhas Salam) (Nabi ki beti) ke paas aaye aur pucha: "Kya tum (raat ko) namaz nahi padhoge?" Maine kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Humari roohein Allah ke haath mein hain, agar woh humein uthana chahega, uthaega." Yeh sunkar Aap bina kuch kahe chale gaye, aur maine suna woh apni jaang par haath maar te huye keh rahe the: "Magar insaan sabse zyada jhagdalu hai."

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to give up a good deed, although he loved to do it, for fear that people might act on it and it might be made compulsory for them. The Prophet (ﷺ) never prayed the Duha prayer, but I offer it
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool kabhi-kabhi ek achha amal chhod dete, chahe unhe woh pasand ho, is dar se ke kahin log usse (waajib samajh kar) amal na karne lagen aur woh unpar farz na ho jaaye. Nabi ne kabhi Duha ki namaz nahi padhi, magar main padhti hoon.

e: Narrated `Aisha the mother of the faithful believers:One night Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) offered the prayer in the Mosque and the people followed him. The next night he also offered the prayer and too many people gathered. On the third and the fourth nights more people gathered, but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not come out to them. In the morning he said, "I saw what you were doing and nothing but the fear that it (i.e. the prayer) might be enjoined on you, stopped me from coming to you." And that happened in the month of Ramadan
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Ummul-Momineen) bataati hain: Ek raat Allah ke Rasool ne masjid mein namaz padhi aur log unke saath shamil hue. Agli raat Aap ne phir namaz padhi aur bahut zyada log jama ho gaye. Teesri aur chauthi raat aur zyada log jama hue, magar Allah ke Rasool unke paas bahar nahi aaye. Subah Aap ne farmaya: "Maine dekha tum log kya kar rahe the, aur mujhe sirf is dar ne roka ke kahin yeh (namaz) tum par farz na kar di jaaye." Yeh Ramadan ke mahine mein hua.

e: Narrated Al-Mughira:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to stand (in the prayer) or pray till both his feet or legs swelled. He was asked why (he offered such an unbearable prayer) and he said, "Should I not be a thankful slave?
hi: Al-Mughira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (namaz mein) itna khade rehte ke unke donon paon ya pindliyan soojh jaatin. Poocha gaya kyun (Aap itni mushkil namaz padhte hain), Aap ne farmaya: "Kya main shukr-guzaar banda na banoon?"

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr bin Al-`As:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) told me, "The most beloved prayer to Allah is that of David and the most beloved fasts to Allah are those of David. He used to sleep for half of the night and then pray for one third of the night and again sleep for its sixth part and used to fast on alternate days
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Aas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne mujhse kaha: "Allah ke haan sabse pyari namaz Dawud (علیہ السلام) ki namaz hai, aur sabse pyare roze Dawud ke roze hain. Woh aadhi raat sote, phir raat ke ek-tihai hisse mein namaz padhte aur phir ek-chhathe hisse mein sote, aur woh ek din chhod kar roza rakhte the."

e: Narrated Masruq:I asked `Aisha which deed was most loved by the Prophet. She said, "A deed done continuously." I further asked, "When did he used to get up (in the night for the prayer)." She said, "He used to get up on hearing the crowing of a cock
hi: Masruq bataate hain: Maine Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se pucha kaunsa amal Nabi ko sabse zyada pasand tha. Unhone kaha: "Woh amal jo musalsal kiya jaaye." Maine phir pucha: "Aap kab uthte (raat ki namaz ke liye)?" Unhone kaha: "Woh murgi ki bang sunkar uthte."

e: Narrated Al-Ashath:He (the Prophet (ﷺ) ) used to get up for the prayer on hearing the crowing of a cock
hi: Aap (Nabi) murgi ki bang sunkar namaz ke liye uthte the.

e: Narrated `Aisha:In my house he (Prophet (ﷺ) ) never passed the last hours of the night but sleeping
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Mere ghar mein Aap (Nabi) kabhi raat ke aakhri ghante so-ne ke siwa aur kuch nahi karte the.

e: Narrated Qatada:Anas bin Malik said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) and Zaid bin Thabit took their Suhur together. When they finished it, the Prophet (ﷺ) stood for the (Fajr) prayer and offered it." We asked Anas, "What was the interval between their finishing the Suhur and the starting of the morning prayer?" Anas replied, "It was equal to the time taken by a person in reciting fifty verses of the Qur'an
hi: Qatada bataate hain: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Nabi aur Zaid bin Thabit (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne saath Sehri khai. Jab khatam ki, Nabi (Fajr ki) namaz ke liye khade hue aur padhi." Humne Anas se pucha: "Sehri khatam karne aur Fajr ki namaz shuru karne ke darmiyan kitna waqfa tha?" Anas ne jawab diya: "Itna waqfa jitne mein koi shaks Quran ki pachaas ayaat tilawat kar sake."

e: Narrated Abu-Wail:`Abdullah said, "One night I offered the Tahajjud prayer with the Prophet (ﷺ) and he kept on standing till an ill-thought came to me." We said, "What was the ill-thought?" He said, "It was to sit down and leave the Prophet (standing)
hi: Abu Wail bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Ek raat maine Nabi ke saath Tahajjud padhi, aur Aap khade rahte gaye yahan tak ke mere dil mein ek bura khayaal aaya." Humne pucha: "Woh bura khayaal kya tha?" Unhone kaha: "Baith jaana aur Nabi ko khade chhod dena."

e: Narrated Hudhaifa:Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) got up for Tahajjud prayer he used to clean his mouth (and teeth) with Siwak
hi: Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab bhi Nabi Tahajjud ke liye uthte, apna mun (aur daant) Siwak se saaf karte.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:A man said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! How is the prayer of the night?" He said, "Two rak`at followed by two rak`at and so on, and when you apprehend the approaching dawn, offer one rak`a as witr
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Ek shaks ne pucha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Raat ki namaz kaise padhi jaati hai?" Aap ne farmaya: "Do-do rakat karke, aur jab Fajr ka waqt aane ka dar ho, ek rakat Witr ke tor par padho."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The prayer of the Prophet (ﷺ) used to be of thirteen rak`at, i.e. of the night prayer
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ki namaz (raat ki namaz) terah rakat ki hoti thi.

e: Narrated Masruq:I asked Aisha about the night prayer of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and she said, "It was seven, nine or eleven rak`at besides the two rak`at of the Fajr prayer (i.e. Sunna)
hi: Masruq bataate hain: Maine Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se Allah ke Rasool ki raat ki namaz ke baare mein pucha, unhone jawab diya: "Woh saat, nau ya gyarah rakat hoti thi, Fajr ki do rakat (Sunnat) ke ilawa."

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to offer thirteen rak`at of the night prayer and that included the witr and two rak`at (Sunna) of the Fajr prayer
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi terah rakat raat ki namaz padhte the, jisme Witr aur Fajr ki do rakat (Sunnat) shamil thi.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Sometimes Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) would not fast (for so many days) that we thought that he would not fast that month and he sometimes used to fast (for so many days) that we thought he would not leave fasting throughout that month and (as regards his prayer and sleep at night), if you wanted to see him praying at night, you could see him praying and if you wanted to see him sleeping, you could see him sleeping
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Kabhi Allah ke Rasool itne roze rakhte ke humein lagta poore mahine roze rakhte rahenge, aur kabhi itne kam roze rakhte ke humein lagta poore mahine roze nahi chhodenge. (Aur unki namaz aur neend ke baare mein), agar tum unhe raat ko namaz padhte hue dekhna chahte, dekh sakte the, aur agar sote hue dekhna chahte, dekh sakte the.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Satan puts three knots at the back of the head of any of you if he is asleep. On every knot he reads and exhales the following words, 'The night is long, so stay asleep.' When one wakes up and remembers Allah, one knot is undone; and when one performs ablution, the second knot is undone, and when one prays the third knot is undone and one gets up energetic with a good heart in the morning; otherwise one gets up lazy and with a mischievous heart
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi sota hai, shaitan uske sar ke peechhe teen gantthein baandh deta hai. Har gaanth par woh phoonk marta hai aur kehta hai: 'Raat lambi hai, sote raho.' Jab koi jaagta hai aur Allah ko yaad karta hai, ek gaanth khul jaati hai; aur jab woh wudu karta hai, doosri gaanth khul jaati hai; aur jab namaz padhta hai, teesri gaanth khul jaati hai aur woh subah taazgi aur achhe dil ke saath uthta hai; warna woh sust aur bure dil ke saath uthta hai."

e: Narrated Samura bin Jundab:The Prophet (ﷺ) said in his narration of a dream that he saw, "He whose head was being crushed with a stone was one who learnt the Qur'an but never acted on it, and slept ignoring the compulsory prayers
hi: Samura bin Jundub (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne apne khwab ke bayan mein kaha: "Jiska sar patthar se koocha ja raha tha, woh us shaks ki tasveer thi jisne Quran seekha magar kabhi uspar amal nahi kiya, aur farz namaz ko nazar-andaaz karke sota raha."

e: Narrated `Abdullah:A person was mentioned before the Prophet (ﷺ) and he was told that he had kept on sleeping till morning and had not got up for the prayer. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Satan urinated in his ears
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ke saamne ek shaks ka zikar hua aur bataya gaya ke woh subah tak sota raha aur namaz ke liye nahi utha. Nabi ne farmaya: "Shaitan ne uske kaanon mein peshab kiya."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Our Lord, the Blessed, the Superior, comes every night down on the nearest Heaven to us when the last third of the night remains, saying: "Is there anyone to invoke Me, so that I may respond to invocation? Is there anyone to ask Me, so that I may grant him his request? Is there anyone seeking My forgiveness, so that I may forgive him?
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Hamara Rab, jo mubarak aur azeem hai, har raat qareebi aasman par utarta hai jab raat ka aakhri tihai hissa baaki reh jaata hai, aur kehta hai: 'Hai koi jo mujhse dua kare, main uski dua qubool karun? Hai koi jo mujhse maange, main use de dun? Hai koi jo mujhse maafi maange, main use maaf kar dun?'"

e: Narrated Al-Aswad:I asked `Aisha "How is the night prayer of the Prophet?" She replied, "He used to sleep early at night, and get up in its last part to pray, and then return to his bed. When the Mu'adh-dhin pronounced the Adhan, he would get up. If he was in need of a bath he would take it; otherwise he would perform ablution and then go out (for the prayer)
hi: Al-Aswad bataate hain: Maine Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se pucha: "Nabi ki raat ki namaz kaisi thi?" Unhone jawab diya: "Woh raat ke shuru mein sote aur aakhri hisse mein namaz ke liye uthte, phir apne bistar par wapas jaate. Jab Muazzin Adhan dete, uthte. Agar ghusl ki zaroorat hoti, karte; warna wudu karke (namaz ke liye) bahar jaate."

e: Narrated Abu Salma bin `Abdur Rahman:I asked `Aisha, "How is the prayer of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) during the month of Ramadan." She said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) never exceeded eleven rak`at in Ramadan or in other months; he used to offer four rak`at-- do not ask me about their beauty and length, then four rak`at, do not ask me about their beauty and length, and then three rak`at." Aisha further said, "I said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Do you sleep before offering the witr prayer?' He replied, 'O `Aisha! My eyes sleep but my heart remains awake
hi: Abu Salma bin Abdur Rahman bataate hain: Maine Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se pucha: "Ramadan mein Allah ke Rasool ki namaz kaisi thi?" Unhone kaha: "Allah ke Rasool Ramadan mein ya kisi aur mahine mein gyarah rakat se zyada nahi padhte the; woh chaar rakat padhte — mujhse unki khoobsurati aur lambai ke baare mein na poochho — phir chaar rakat — mujhse unki khoobsurati aur lambai ke baare mein na poochho — phir teen rakat." Ayesha ne aage kaha: "Maine pucha: 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Kya aap Witr padhne se pehle sote hain?' Aap ne jawab diya: 'Aye Ayesha! Meri aankhein sotin hain magar mera dil jaagta rehta hai.'"

e: Narrated `Aisha:I did not see the Prophet (ﷺ) reciting (the Qur'an) in the night prayer while sitting except when he became old; when he used to recite while sitting, and when thirty or forty verses remained from the Sura, he would get up and recite them and then bow
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine Nabi ko kabhi raat ki namaz baithkar tilawat karte nahi dekha siwaye jab woh budhe ho gaye; tab woh baithkar tilawat karte, aur jab Surah ki teen ya chaalees ayaat baaki reh jaatin, khade hote aur unhe tilawat karke ruku karte.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:At the time of the Fajr prayer the Prophet (ﷺ) asked Bilal, "Tell me of the best deed you did after embracing Islam, for I heard your footsteps in front of me in Paradise." Bilal replied, "I did not do anything worth mentioning except that whenever I performed ablution during the day or night, I prayed after that ablution as much as was written for me
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Fajr ki namaz ke waqt, Nabi ne Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha: "Mujhe apna woh behtareen amal batao jo tumne Islam qubool karne ke baad kiya, kyunke maine Jannat mein apne aage tumhare qadmon ki awaaz suni." Bilal ne jawab diya: "Maine koi khaas amal nahi kiya siwaye is ke ke jab bhi main din ya raat mein wudu karta, uske baad utni namaz padhtaa jitni mere naseeb mein likhi hoti."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik Once the Prophet (ﷺ) entered the Mosque and saw a rope hanging in between its two pillars. He said, "What is this rope?" The people said, "This rope is for Zainab who, when she feels tired, holds it (to keep standing for the prayer.)" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Don't use it. Remove the rope. You should pray as long as you feel active, and when you get tired, sit down
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Nabi masjid mein daakhil hue aur dekha ek rassi do sutoon ke darmiyan latki hui hai. Aap ne pucha: "Yeh rassi kya hai?" Logon ne kaha: "Yeh Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke liye hai, jab woh thak jaati hain to isse pakad kar (namaz mein) khade rehti hain." Nabi ne farmaya: "Ise mat istemal karo. Rassi hataa do. Jitni der tak taaza mehsoos karo namaz padho, aur jab thak jao to baith jao."

e: Narrated 'Aisha: A woman from the tribe of Bani Asad was sitting with me and Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) came to my house and said, "Who is this?" I said, "(She is) So and so. She does not sleep at night because she is engaged in prayer." The Prophet (ﷺ) said disapprovingly: Do (good) deeds which is within your capacity as Allah never gets tired of giving rewards till you get tired of doing good deeds
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Bani Asad qabile ki ek aurat mere paas baithi thi aur Allah ke Rasool mere ghar aaye aur pucha: "Yeh kaun hai?" Maine kaha: "Falaan hai. Yeh raat ko nahi soti kyunke ibadat mein masroof rehti hai." Nabi ne napasandidgi se kaha: "Utne hi amal karo jitni tumhari taaqat ho, kyunke Allah (sawaab dete-dete) kabhi nahi thakta jab tak tum khud (nek amal karte-karte) thak na jao."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr bin Al-`As:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me, "O `Abdullah! Do not be like so and so who used to pray at night and then stopped the night prayer
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Aas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne mujhse kaha: "Aye Abdullah! Falaan jaise mat bano jo raat ki namaz padhta tha, phir usne raat ki namaz chhod di."

e: Narrated 'Abdullah bin 'Amr:Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me, "I have been informed that you offer Salat (prayer) all the night and observe Saum (fast) during the day." I said, "(Yes) I do so." He said, "If you do so, your eye sight will become weak and you will become weak. No doubt, your body has right on you, and your family has right on you, so observe Saum (for some days) and do not observe it (for some days), offer Salat (for sometime) and then sleep
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Allah ke Rasool ne mujhse kaha: "Mujhe bataya gaya hai ke tum poori raat namaz padhte ho aur din mein roza rakhte ho." Maine kaha: "Haan, main aisa hi karta hoon." Aap ne farmaya: "Agar tum aisa karoge, tumhari nazar kamzor ho jayegi aur tum khud kamzor ho jaoge. Beshak tumhare jism ka bhi tumpar haqq hai, aur tumhare ghar walon ka bhi haqq hai. Isliye (kabhi) roza rakho aur (kabhi) na rakho, namaz padho aur so bhi jao."

e: Narrated 'Ubada bin As-Samit:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever gets up at night and says: -- 'La ilaha il-lallah Wahdahu la Sharika lahu Lahu-lmulk, waLahu-l-hamd wahuwa 'ala kullishai'in Qadir. Al hamdu lil-lahi wa subhanal-lahi wa la-ilaha il-lal-lah wa-l-lahu akbar wa la hawla Wala Quwata il-la-bil-lah.' (None has the right to be worshipped but Allah. He is the Only One and has no partners . For Him is the Kingdom and all the praises are due for Him. He is Omnipotent. All the praises are for Allah. All the glories are for Allah. And none has the right to be worshipped but Allah, And Allah is Great And there is neither Might nor Power Except with Allah). And then says: -- Allahumma, Ighfir li (O Allah! Forgive me). Or invokes (Allah), he will be responded to and if he performs ablution (and prays), his prayer will be accepted
hi: Ubada bin As-Samit (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jo bhi raat ko uthe aur kahe: 'La ilaha il-lallah Wahdahu la Sharika lahu Lahu-lmulk, waLahu-l-hamd wahuwa ala kullishai'in Qadir. Al hamdu lil-lahi wa subhanal-lahi wa la-ilaha il-lal-lah wa-l-lahu akbar wa la hawla Wala Quwata il-la-bil-lah' (Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahi, woh akela hai aur uska koi shareek nahi. Uski hi hukumat hai aur sab tareef usi ke liye hai. Woh har cheez par qaadir hai. Sab tareef Allah ke liye hai, sab pakizgi Allah ke liye hai, Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahi, Allah sabse bada hai, aur Allah ke siwa koi taaqat ya quwwat nahi), phir kahe: 'Allahumma, Ighfir li' (Aye Allah! Mujhe maaf kar) — ya Allah se dua kare, uski dua qubool hogi, aur agar woh wudu karke (namaz padhe), uski namaz qubool hogi."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:That once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Your brother, i.e. `Abdullah bin Rawaha does not say obscene (referring to his verses): Amongst us is Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), who recites His Book when it dawns. He showed us the guidance, after we were blind. We believe that whatever he says will come true. And he spends his nights in such a way as his sides do not touch his bed. While the pagans were deeply asleep
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Tumhare bhai, yaani Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Rawaha, badi baat nahi kehte (unke she'r ke hawale se): 'Humare darmiyan Allah ke Rasool hain, jo subah hote hi Allah ki Kitaab tilawat karte hain.
