Unhone humein hidayat dikhai, isse pehle ke hum andhe the. Hum yaqeen rakhte hain jo woh kehte hain sach hoga. Aur woh raatein aise guzarte hain ke unki paseliyan apne bistar ko chhooti bhi nahi, jabke mushrik gehri neend mein sote hain.'"

e: Narrated Nafi`:Ibn `Umar said, "In the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) I dreamt that a piece of silk cloth was in my hand and it flew with me to whichever part of Paradise I wanted. I also saw as if two persons (i.e. angels) came to me and wanted to take me to Hell. Then an angel met us and told me not to be afraid. He then told them to leave me. Hafsa narrated one of my dreams to the Prophet (ﷺ) and the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Abdullah is a good man. Would that he offer the night prayer (Tahajjud)!" So after that day `Abdullah (bin `Umar) started offering Tahajjud. The companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) used to tell him their dreams that (Laila-tul-Qadr) was on the 27th of the month of Ramadan. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I see that your dreams agree on the last ten nights of Ramadan and so whoever is in search of it should seek it in the last ten nights of Ramadan
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Nabi ke zamane mein maine khwab dekha ke ek resham ka tukda mere haath mein tha aur woh mujhe le kar Jannat ke jis hisse mein main jaana chahta udta gaya. Maine yeh bhi dekha ke do log (yaani farishte) mere paas aaye aur mujhe Dozakh le jaana chahte the, phir ek farishta mila jisne mujhe dar mat kehne ko kaha. Usne unhe mujhe chhodne ko kaha. Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne mera yeh khwab Nabi ko sunaya, Nabi ne farmaya: 'Abdullah achha shaks hai. Kaash woh raat ki namaz (Tahajjud) padhta!' Isi din se Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) (bin Umar) Tahajjud padhne lage." Nabi ke sahaba unhe apne khwab batate ke Laila-tul-Qadr Ramadan ki 27 taareekh ko hai. Nabi ne farmaya: "Mujhe lagta hai tumhare khwab Ramadan ke aakhri das raaton par muttafiq hain, isliye jo bhi ise dhoondhta ho, Ramadan ki aakhri das raaton mein dhoondhe."

e: Narrated `Aisha;:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) offered the `Isha' prayer (and then got up at the Tahajjud time) and offered eight rak`at and then offered two rak`at while sitting. He then offered two rak`at in between the Adhan and Iqama (of the Fajr prayer) and he never missed them
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Isha padhi (aur Tahajjud ke waqt uthkar) aath rakat padhi, phir do rakat baithkar padhi. Phir Fajr ki Adhan aur Iqama ke beech do rakat padhi jise Aap kabhi nahi chhodte the.

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to lie down on his right side, after offering two rak`at (Sunna) of the Fajr prayer
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi Fajr ki (Sunnat) do rakat ke baad apni dahini karvat let jaate the.

e: Narrated `Aisha:After offering the Sunna of the Fajr prayer, the Prophet (ﷺ) used to talk to me, if I happened to be awake; otherwise he would lie down till the Iqama call was proclaimed (for the Fajr prayer)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Fajr ki Sunnat padhne ke baad, Nabi mujhse baat karte agar main jaagi hoti; warna Iqama tak let jaate.

e: Narrated `Aisha:After offering the two rak`at (Sunna) the Prophet (ﷺ) used to talk to me, if I happened to be awake; otherwise he would lie down
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Do rakat (Sunnat) padhne ke baad, Nabi mujhse baat karte agar main jaagi hoti; warna let jaate.

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) was never more regular and particular in offering any Nawafil than the two rak`at (Sunna) of the Fajr prayer
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi kisi bhi Nawafil mein itne mustaqil aur ehtemaam se nahi padhte the jitna Fajr ki (Sunnat) do rakat mein.

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to offer thirteen rak`at in the night prayer and on hearing the Adhan for the morning prayer, he used to offer two light rak`at
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool raat ki namaz mein terah rakat padhte the, aur subah ki Adhan sunkar do halki rakat padhte.

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to make the two rak`at before the Fajr prayer so light that I would wonder whether he recited Al-Fatiha (or not)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi Fajr se pehle ki do rakat itni halki karte ke mujhe shak hota ke kya unhone Al-Fatiha bhi padhi ya nahi.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to teach us the way of doing Istikhara (Istikhara means to ask Allah to guide one to the right sort of action concerning any job or a deed), in all matters as he taught us the Suras of the Qur'an. He said, "If anyone of you thinks of doing any job he should offer a two rak`at prayer other than the compulsory ones and say (after the prayer): -- 'Allahumma inni astakhiruka bi'ilmika, Wa astaqdiruka bi-qudratika, Wa as'alaka min fadlika Al-`azlm Fa-innaka taqdiru Wala aqdiru, Wa ta'lamu Wala a'lamu, Wa anta 'allamu l-ghuyub. Allahumma, in kunta ta'lam anna hadha-lamra Khairun li fi dini wa ma'ashi wa'aqibati `Amri (or 'ajili `Amri wa'ajilihi) Faqdirhu wa yas-sirhu li thumma barik li Fihi, Wa in kunta ta'lamu anna hadha-lamra shar-run li fi dini wa ma'ashi wa'aqibati `Amri (or fi'ajili `Amri wa ajilihi) Fasrifhu anni was-rifni anhu. Waqdir li al-khaira haithu kana Thumma ardini bihi.' (O Allah! I ask guidance from Your knowledge, And Power from Your Might and I ask for Your great blessings. You are capable and I am not. You know and I do not and You know the unseen. O Allah! If You know that this job is good for my religion and my subsistence and in my Hereafter--(or said: If it is better for my present and later needs)--Then You ordain it for me and make it easy for me to get, And then bless me in it, and if You know that this job is harmful to me In my religion and subsistence and in the Hereafter--(or said: If it is worse for my present and later needs)--Then keep it away from me and let me be away from it. And ordain for me whatever is good for me, And make me satisfied with it). The Prophet (ﷺ) added that then the person should name (mention) his need
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi humein Istikhara (Allah se hidayat maangna kisi kaam ke baare mein) karna sikhate the, jaise Quran ki Surahtein sikhate the. Aap ne farmaya: "Agar tum mein se koi kisi kaam ke baare mein sochta hai, use farz ke ilawa do rakat padhni chahiye aur (namaz ke baad) yeh dua padhni chahiye: 'Allahumma inni astakhiruka bi'ilmika, Wa astaqdiruka bi-qudratika, Wa as'alaka min fadlika Al-azlm Fa-innaka taqdiru Wala aqdiru, Wa ta'lamu Wala a'lamu, Wa anta 'allamu l-ghuyub. Allahumma, in kunta ta'lam anna hadha-lamra Khairun li fi dini wa ma'ashi wa'aqibati Amri (ya 'ajili Amri wa'ajilihi) Faqdirhu wa yas-sirhu li thumma barik li Fihi, Wa in kunta ta'lamu anna hadha-lamra shar-run li fi dini wa ma'ashi wa'aqibati Amri (ya fi'ajili Amri wa ajilihi) Fasrifhu anni was-rifni anhu. Waqdir li al-khaira haithu kana Thumma ardini bihi' (Aye Allah! Main tere ilm se hidayat maangta hoon, aur teri qudrat se taaqat maangta hoon, aur tere azeem fazl se sawaal karta hoon. Tu qaadir hai aur main nahi hoon, tu jaanta hai aur main nahi jaanta, aur tu ghaib ka poora jaanne wala hai. Aye Allah! Agar tujhe pata hai ke yeh kaam mere deen, meri rozi aur mere anjaam ke liye behtar hai (ya mere is jahaan aur agle jahaan ke liye behtar hai), to ise mere liye muqarrar kar de aur asaan bana de, phir usme barkat de. Aur agar tujhe pata hai ke yeh kaam mere liye mere deen, rozi aur anjaam ke liye bura hai (ya is jahaan aur agle jahaan ke liye bura hai), to ise mujhse door kar de aur mujhe usse door kar de. Aur mere liye jahan bhi bhalai ho wahi muqarrar kar, phir mujhe usi par razi kar de).'" Nabi ne joda ke phir shaks apni zaroorat ka naam le.

e: Narrated Abu Qatada bin Rabi Al-Ansari:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If anyone of you enters a Mosque, he should not sit until he has offered a two-rak`at prayer
hi: Abu Qatada (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Rabi Al-Ansari bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Agar tum mein se koi masjid mein daakhil ho, use baithne se pehle do rakat padhni chahiye."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) led us and offered a two rak`at prayer and then went away
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne humari imamat ki aur do rakat padhkar chale gaye.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:I offered with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) a two rak`at prayer before the Zuhr prayer and two rak`at after the Zuhr prayer, two rak`at after Jumua, Maghrib and `Isha' prayers
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool ke saath Zuhr se pehle do rakat aur Zuhr ke baad do rakat padhi, Jumme, Maghrib aur Isha ke baad bhi do-do rakat.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:While delivering a sermon, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If anyone of you comes while the Imam is delivering the sermon or has come out for it, he should offer a two rak`at prayer
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Khutba dete waqt, Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Agar tum mein se koi Imam ke khutba dete waqt aaye ya usi ke liye nikala ho, use do rakat padhni chahiye."

e: Narrated Mujahid:Somebody came to the house of Ibn `Umar and told him that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had entered the Ka`ba. Ibn `Umar said, "I went in front of the Ka`ba and found that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had come out of the Ka`ba and I saw Bilal standing by the side of the gate of the Ka`ba. I said, 'O Bilal! Has Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) prayed inside the Ka`ba?' Bilal replied in the affirmative. I said, 'Where (did he pray)?' He replied, '(He prayed) Between these two pillars and then he came out and offered a two rak`at prayer in front of the Ka`ba.' " Abu `Abdullah said: Abu Huraira said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) advised me to offer two rak`at of Duha prayer (prayer to be offered after sunrise and before midday). " Itban (bin Malik) said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr, came to me after sunrise and we aligned behind the Prophet (ﷺ) and offered two rak`at
hi: Mujahid bataate hain: Kisi ne Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke ghar aakar bataya ke Allah ke Rasool Ka'ba mein daakhil hue hain. Ibn Umar ne kaha: "Main Ka'ba ke saamne gaya aur paaya ke Allah ke Rasool Ka'ba se bahar aa chuke hain, aur maine Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko Ka'ba ke darwaze ke paas khada dekha. Maine Bilal se pucha: 'Kya Nabi ne Ka'ba ke andar namaz padhi?' Bilal ne haan mein jawab diya. Maine pucha: 'Kahan (padhi)?' Unhone jawab diya: '(Aap ne padhi) In do sutoon ke darmiyan, phir bahar aakar Ka'ba ke saamne do rakat padhi.'" Abu Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Nabi ne mujhe Duha ki do rakat padhne ki naseehat di" (suraj nikalne aur dopahar ke beech padhi jaane wali namaz). Itban (bin Malik) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool aur Abu Bakr suraj nikalne ke baad mere paas aaye aur hum Nabi ke peechhe qatar mein khade hue aur do rakat padhi."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:I offered with the Prophet (ﷺ) two rak`at before the Zuhr and two rak`at after the Zuhr prayer; two rak`at after Maghrib, `Isha' and the Jumua prayers. Those of the Maghrib and `Isha' were offered in his house. My sister Hafsa told me that the Prophet (ﷺ) used to offer two light rak`at after dawn and it was the time when I never went to the Prophet
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Maine Nabi ke saath Zuhr se pehle do rakat aur Zuhr ke baad do rakat padhi; Maghrib, Isha aur Jumme ke baad bhi do-do rakat. Maghrib aur Isha wali (do rakat) unke ghar mein padhi jaati thin. Meri behn Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne mujhe bataya ke Nabi Fajr ke baad do halki rakat padhte the, aur usi waqt main kabhi Nabi ke paas nahi jaata tha.

e: Narrated `Amr:I heard Abu Ash-sha'tha' Jabir saying, "I heard Ibn `Abbas saying, 'I offered with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) eight rak`at (of Zuhr and `Asr prayers) together and seven rak`at (the Maghrib and the `Isha' prayers) together.' " I said, "O Abu Ash-shatha! I think he must have prayed the Zuhr late and the `Asr early; the `Isha early and the Maghrib late." Abu Ash-sha'tha' said, "I also think so." (See Hadith No. 518 Vol)
hi: Amr bataate hain: Maine Abu Ash-Sha'tha Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko kehte suna: "Maine Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko kehte suna: 'Maine Allah ke Rasool ke saath aath rakat (Zuhr-Asr milakar) ek saath aur saat rakat (Maghrib-Isha milakar) ek saath padhi.'" Maine kaha: "Aye Abu Ash-Sha'tha! Mujhe lagta hai unhone Zuhr der se aur Asr jaldi padhi hogi, aur Isha jaldi aur Maghrib der se." Abu Ash-Sha'tha ne kaha: "Mujhe bhi yehi lagta hai."

e: Narrated Muwarriq:I asked Ibn `Umar "Do you offer the Duha prayer?" He replied in the negative. I further asked, "Did `Umar use to pray it?" He (Ibn `Umar) replied in the negative. I again asked, "Did Abu Bakr use to pray it?" He replied in the negative. I again asked, "Did the Prophet (ﷺ) use to pray it?" Ibn `Umar replied, "I don't think he did
hi: Muwarriq bataate hain: Maine Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha: "Kya aap Duha ki namaz padhte hain?" Unhone na mein jawab diya. Maine phir pucha: "Kya Umar ise padhte the?" Unhone na kaha. Maine phir pucha: "Kya Abu Bakr ise padhte the?" Unhone na kaha. Maine phir pucha: "Kya Nabi ise padhte the?" Ibn Umar ne jawab diya: "Mujhe nahi lagta unhone padhi."

e: Narrated `Abdur Rahman bin Abi Laila:Only Um Hani narrated to me that she had seen the Prophet (ﷺ) offering the Duha prayer. She said, "On the day of the conquest of Mecca, the Prophet (ﷺ) entered my house, took a bath and offered eight rak`at (of Duha prayers. I had never seen the Prophet (ﷺ) offering such a light prayer but he performed bowing and prostrations perfectly
hi: Abdur Rahman bin Abi Laila bataate hain: Sirf Um Hani ne mujhe bataya ke unhone Nabi ko Duha ki namaz padhte dekha tha. Unhone kaha: "Fatah-e-Mecca ke din, Nabi mere ghar daakhil hue, ghusl kiya aur aath rakat (Duha ki) padhi. Maine Nabi ko kabhi itni halki namaz padhte nahi dekha, magar unke ruku-sajda mukammal the."

e: Narrated `Aisha:I never saw the Prophet (ﷺ) offering the Duha prayer but I always offer it
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine Nabi ko kabhi Duha ki namaz padhte nahi dekha, magar main hamesha padhti hoon.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:My friend (the Prophet) advised me to do three things and I shall not leave them till I die, these are: To fast three days every month, to offer the Duha prayer, and to offer witr before sleeping
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Mere dost (Nabi) ne mujhe teen baaton ki naseehat di aur main unhe apni maut tak nahi chhodunga: har mahine teen din roza rakhna, Duha ki namaz padhna, aur sone se pehle Witr padhna.

e: Narrated Anas bin Sirin: I heard Anas bin Malik al-Ansari saying, "An Ansari man, who was very fat, said to the Prophet, 'I am unable to present myself for the prayer with you.' He prepared a meal for the Prophet (ﷺ) and invited him to his house. He washed one side of a mat with water and the Prophet (ﷺ) offered two Rakat on it." So and so, the son of so and so, the son of Al-Jarud asked Anas, "Did the Prophet (ﷺ) use to offer the Duha prayer?" Anas replied, "I never saw him praying (the Duha prayer) except on that day
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Seereen bataate hain: Maine Anas bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ansari ko kehte suna: "Ek Ansari shaks, jo bahut mota tha, ne Nabi se kaha: 'Main aapke saath namaz mein hazir nahi ho sakta.' Usne Nabi ke liye khana taiyaar kiya aur unhe apne ghar bulaya. Usne ek chatai ka ek hissa paani se dhoya aur Nabi ne usi par do rakat padhi." Falaan, falaan ke bete, Al-Jarud ke bete ne Anas se pucha: "Kya Nabi Duha ki namaz padhte the?" Anas ne jawab diya: "Maine unhe (Duha padhte) sirf us din dekha."

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar: I remember ten Rakat of Nawafil from the Prophet, two Rakat before the Zuhr prayer and two after it; two Rakat after Maghrib prayer in his house, and two Rakat after 'Isha' prayer in his house, and two Rakat before the Fajr prayer and at that time nobody would enter the house of the Prophet. Hafsa told me that the Prophet (ﷺ) used to offer two Rakat after the call maker had made the Adhan and the day had dawned
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Mujhe Nabi ki das rakat Nawafil yaad hain — Zuhr se pehle do rakat aur baad mein do; Maghrib ke baad unke ghar mein do rakat, aur Isha ke baad unke ghar mein do rakat, aur Fajr se pehle do rakat, aur us waqt koi bhi Nabi ke ghar nahi jaata tha. Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne mujhe bataya ke Nabi Adhan aur subah ho jaane ke baad do rakat padhte the.

e: Narrated Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) never missed four rak`at before the Zuhr prayer and two rak`at before the Fajr prayer
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi ne kabhi Zuhr se pehle ki chaar rakat aur Fajr se pehle ki do rakat nahi chhodi.

e: Narrated `Abdullah Al-Muzani:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Pray before the Maghrib (compulsory) prayer." He (said it thrice) and in the third time, he said, "Whoever wants to offer it can do so." He said so because he did not like the people to take it as a tradition
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Muzani bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Maghrib (ki farz namaz) se pehle (nafil) padho." (Aap ne yeh teen baar kaha) aur teesri baar farmaya: "Jo padhna chahe, padh sakta hai." Aap ne yeh isliye kaha kyunke Aap nahi chahte the log ise ek pakki riwaayat samajh len.

e: Narrated Marthad bin `Abdullah Al-Yazani:I went to `Uqba bin 'Amir Al-Juhani and said, "Is it not surprising that Abi Tamim offers two rak`at before the Maghrib prayer?" `Uqba said, "We used to do so in the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." I asked him, "What prevents you from offering it now?" He replied, "Business
hi: Marthad bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Yazani bataate hain: Main Uqba bin Amir (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Juhani ke paas gaya aur kaha: "Kya yeh ajeeb baat nahi ke Abi Tamim Maghrib se pehle do rakat padhte hain?" Uqba ne kaha: "Hum Allah ke Rasool ke zamane mein bhi aisa karte the." Maine pucha: "Ab aapko kya cheez isse rokti hai?" Unhone jawab diya: "Kaam-kaaj."

e: Narrated Mahmud bin Ar-rabi' Al-Ansari:that he remembered Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he also remembered a mouthful of water which he had thrown on his face, after taking it from a well that was in their house. Mahmud said that he had heard `Itban bin Malik, who was present with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the battle of Badr saying, "I used to lead my people at Bani Salim in the prayer and there was a valley between me and those people. Whenever it rained it used to be difficult for me to cross it to go to their mosque. So I went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, 'I have weak eyesight and the valley between me and my people flows during the rainy season and it becomes difficult for me to cross it; I wish you would come to my house and pray at a place so that I could take that place as a praying place.' Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'I will do so.' So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr came to my house in the (next) morning after the sun had risen high. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked my permission to let him in and I admitted him. He did not sit before saying, 'Where do you want us to offer the prayer in your house?' I pointed to the place where I wanted him to pray. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up for the prayer and started the prayer with Takbir and we aligned in rows behind him; and he offered two rak`at, and finished them with Taslim, and we also performed Taslim with him. I detained him for a meal called "Khazir" which I had prepared for him.--("Khazir" is a special type of dish prepared from barley flour and meat soup)-- When the neighbors got the news that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was in my house, they poured in till there were a great number of men in the house. One of them said, 'What is wrong with Malik, for I do not see him?' One of them replied, 'He is a hypocrite and does not love Allah and His Apostle.' On that Allah's Apostle said, 'Don't say this. Haven't you seen that he said, 'None has the right to be worshipped but Allah for Allah's sake only.' The man replied, 'Allah and His Apostle know better; but by Allah, we never saw him but helping and talking with the hypocrites.' Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, 'No doubt, whoever says. None has the right to be worshipped but Allah, and by that he wants the pleasures of Allah, then Allah will save him from Hell." Mahmud added, "I told the above narration to some people, one of whom was Abu Aiyub, the companion of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the battle in which he (Abu Aiyub) died and Yazid bin Mu'awiya was their leader in Roman Territory. Abu Aiyub denounced the narration and said, 'I doubt that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ever said what you have said.' I felt that too much, and I vowed to Allah that if I remained alive in that holy battle, I would (go to Medina and) ask `Itban bin Malik if he was still living in the mosque of his people. So when he returned, I assumed Ihram for Hajj or `Umra and then I proceeded on till I reached Medina. I went to Bani Salim and `Itban bin Malik, who was by then an old blind man, was leading his people in the prayer. When he finished the prayer, I greeted him and introduced myself to him and then asked him about that narration. He told that narration again in the same manner as he had narrated it the first time
hi: Mahmud bin Ar-Rabi (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ansari bataate hain ke unhe Allah ke Rasool yaad hain, aur woh mun-bhar paani bhi yaad hai jo unhone unke chehre par chhidka tha, ek kuye se jo unke ghar mein tha. Mahmud ne bataya ke unhone Itban bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko, jo Badr ki jung mein Allah ke Rasool ke saath maujood the, kehte suna: "Main apni Bani Salim qaum ki imamat karta tha, aur mere aur unke darmiyan ek wadi thi. Jab baarish hoti, use paar karke unki masjid tak jaana mushkil ho jaata. Main Allah ke Rasool ke paas gaya aur kaha: 'Meri nazar kamzor hai, aur mere aur meri qaum ke darmiyan wadi baarish ke mausam mein bharri rehti hai jise paar karna mushkil hai; kaash aap mere ghar aayein aur kisi jagah namaz padhein taake main use apna Musalla bana sakoon.' Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: 'Main aisa karunga.' To Allah ke Rasool aur Abu Bakr mere ghar (agli) subah aaye, suraj kaafi buland ho chuka tha. Allah ke Rasool ne andar aane ki ijazat maangi aur maine di. Woh baithe nahi jab tak unhone pucha: 'Aap apne ghar mein kahan namaz padhwana chahenge?' Maine woh jagah dikhai jahan main chahta tha. To Allah ke Rasool namaz ke liye khade hue, Takbir kahi aur humne unke peechhe safein bana lin; Aap ne do rakat padhi aur Taslim ki, humne bhi unke saath Taslim ki. Maine unhe 'Khazir' (jau ke aate aur gosht ke shorbe se bana ek khaas khana) khilane ke liye roka jo maine unke liye taiyaar kiya tha. Jab padosiyon ko pata chala ke Allah ke Rasool mere ghar mein hain, woh jama hone lage yahan tak ke ghar mein bahut log ho gaye. Unme se ek ne kaha: 'Malik ko kya hua, main use nahi dekh raha?' Doosre ne jawab diya: 'Woh munafiq hai, Allah aur uske Rasool se mohabbat nahi karta.' Yeh sunkar Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: 'Aisa mat kaho. Kya tumne nahi dekha usne \'La ilaha illallah\' kaha, sirf Allah ki raza ke liye?' Shaks ne jawab diya: 'Allah aur uske Rasool behtar jaante hain; magar Allah ki qasam, humne use hamesha munafiqon ki madad karte aur unse baat karte dekha hai.' Allah ke Rasool ne jawab diya: 'Beshak, jo bhi La ilaha illallah kahe, aur isse sirf Allah ki raza chahe, Allah use Dozakh se bacha lega.'" Mahmud ne joda: "Maine yeh riwayat kuch logon ko batai, unme se ek Abu Aiyub the, jo Allah ke Rasool ke sathi the us jung mein jisme Abu Aiyub shaheed hue, jab Yazid bin Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) Roman ilaqe mein unke leader the. Abu Aiyub ne is riwayat ko inkaar kiya aur kaha: 'Mujhe shak hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne kabhi aisa kaha jaisa tumne bataya.' Mujhe bahut bura laga, aur maine Allah se qasam khai ke agar main us jang mein zinda raha, to (Madina jaakar) Itban bin Malik se poochunga kya woh abhi bhi apni qaum ki masjid mein zinda hain. Jab main wapas aaya, maine Hajj ya Umrah ka Ihram baandha aur Madina pahuncha. Main Bani Salim gaya, aur Itban bin Malik, jo ab budhe aur andhe ho chuke the, apni qaum ki imamat kar rahe the. Namaz khatam hone par, maine unhe salaam kiya, apna taaruf karaya, aur unse yeh riwayat pucha. Unhone wahi riwayat dobara bilkul waisi hi bataai jaisi unhone pehli baar batai thi."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Offer some of your prayers in your houses and do not make them graves
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Apni kuch namazein apne gharon mein padho, unhe qabristan mat banao."

e: Narrated Quza'a: I heard Abu Said saying four words. He said, "I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) (saying the following narrative)." He had participated in twelve holy battles with the Prophet
hi: Quza'a bataate hain: Maine Abu Saeed ko chaar baatein kehte suna. Unhone kaha: "Maine Nabi ko yeh (agli hadith mein bayan) farmate suna." (Abu Saeed) Nabi ke saath barah jungein lad chuke the.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not set out on a journey except for three Mosques i.e. Al-Masjid-Al-Haram, the Mosque of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) , and the Mosque of Al-Aqsa, (Mosque of Jerusalem)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Sirf teen masjidon ke liye khaas safar karo: Al-Masjid-Al-Haram, Allah ke Rasool ki Masjid (Madina), aur Masjid Al-Aqsa (Jerusalem ki Masjid)."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "One prayer in my Mosque is better than one thousand prayers in any other mosque excepting Al-Masjid-Al-Haram
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Meri masjid mein ek namaz doosri kisi bhi masjid mein hazar namazon se behtar hai, siwaye Al-Masjid-Al-Haram ke."

e: Narrated Nafi`:Ibn `Umar never offered the Duha prayer except on two occasions: (1) Whenever he reached Mecca; and he always used to reach Mecca in the forenoon. He would perform Tawaf round the Ka`ba and then offer two rak`at at the rear of Maqam Ibrahim. (2) Whenever he visited Quba, for he used to visit it every Saturday. When he entered the Mosque, he disliked to leave it without offering a prayer. Ibn `Umar narrated that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to visit the Mosque of Quba (sometime) walking and (sometime) riding. And he (i.e. Ibn `Umar) used to say, "I do only what my companions used to do and I don't forbid anybody to pray at any time during the day or night except that one should not intend to pray at sunrise or sunset
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Duha ki namaz sirf do mauqon par padhi: 1. Jab bhi woh Mecca pahunchte — aur woh hamesha subah ke waqt Mecca pahunchte — Ka'ba ka Tawaf karte, phir Maqam-e-Ibrahim ke peechhe do rakat padhte. 2. Jab bhi woh Quba jaate, kyunke woh har Hafte ko Quba jaate. Jab woh masjid mein daakhil hote, bina namaz padhe jaana napasand karte. Ibn Umar ne bataya ke Allah ke Rasool kabhi paidal aur kabhi sawar hokar Masjid-e-Quba jate the. Aur woh (Ibn Umar) kehte: "Main sirf woh karta hoon jo mere sathi (Sahaba) karte the, aur main kisi ko din-raat ke kisi bhi waqt namaz padhne se mana nahi karta, siwaye is ke ke koi jaan-boojh kar suraj nikalne ya doobne ke waqt namaz na padhe."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Dinar:Ibn `Umar said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) used to go to the Mosque of Quba every Saturday (sometimes) walking and (sometimes) riding." `Abdullah (Ibn `Umar) used to do the same
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Dinar bataate hain: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Nabi har Hafte Masjid-e-Quba jate the, kabhi paidal, kabhi sawar hokar." Abdullah (Ibn Umar) bhi yehi karte the.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to go to the Mosque of Quba (sometimes) walking and sometimes riding. Added Nafi` (in another narration), "He then would offer two rak`at (in the Mosque of Quba)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi kabhi paidal aur kabhi sawar hokar Masjid-e-Quba jate the. Nafi ne (ek doosri riwayat mein) joda: "Phir Aap wahan do rakat padhte (Masjid-e-Quba mein)."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Zaid Al-Mazini:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Between my house and the pulpit there is a garden of the gardens of Paradise
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Mazini (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Mere ghar aur mimbar ke darmiyan Jannat ke baagon mein se ek baag hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Between my house and my pulpit there is a garden of the gardens of Paradise, and my pulpit is on my fountain tank (i.e. Al-Kauthar)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Mere ghar aur mere mimbar ke darmiyan Jannat ke baagon mein se ek baag hai, aur mera mimbar mere Haud (Al-Kauthar) par hai."

e: Narrated Qaza'a Maula:(freed slave of) Ziyad: I heard Abu Sa`id Al-khudri narrating four things from the Prophet (ﷺ) and I appreciated them very much. He said, conveying the words of the Prophet. (1) "A woman should not go on a two day journey except with her husband or a Dhi-Mahram. (2) No fasting is permissible on two days: `Id-ul-Fitr and `Id-ul-Adha. (3) No prayer after two prayers, i.e. after the Fajr prayer till the sunrises and after the `Asr prayer till the sun sets. (4) Do not prepare yourself for a journey except to three Mosques, i.e. Al-Masjid-Al-Haram, the Mosque of Aqsa (Jerusalem) and my Mosque
hi: Qaza'a, Ziyad ke azaad kiye gulaam, bataate hain: Maine Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko Nabi se chaar baatein batate suna aur mujhe woh bahut pasand aayi. Unhone Nabi ke alfaaz bayan kiye: 1. "Aurat ko do din ke safar par nahi jaana chahiye siwaye apne shohar ya Dhi-Mahram ke saath." 2. "Do dinon mein roza jaiz nahi hai: Eid-ul-Fitr aur Eid-ul-Adha." 3. "Do namazon ke baad koi (nafil) namaz nahi — yaani Fajr ke baad suraj nikalne tak aur Asr ke baad suraj doobne tak." 4. "Sirf teen masjidon ke liye khaas safar taiyaar karo — Al-Masjid-Al-Haram, Masjid Al-Aqsa (Jerusalem), aur meri masjid (Madina)."

e: Narrated Kuraib Maula Ibn `Abbas:`Abdullah bin `Abbas said that he had passed a night in the house of Maimuna the mother of the faithful believers , who was his aunt. He said, "I slept across the bed, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) along with his wife slept lengthwise. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) slept till midnight or slightly before or after it. Then Allah's Apostle woke up, sat, and removed the traces of sleep by rubbing his hands over his face. Then he recited the last ten verses of Surat-Al `Imran (2). Then he went towards a hanging leather watercontainer and performed a perfect ablution and then stood up for prayer." `Abdullah bin `Abbas added, "I got up and did the same as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had done and then went and stood by his side. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then put his right hand over my head and caught my right ear and twisted it. He offered two rak`at, then two rak`at, then two rak`at, then two rak`at, then two rak`at, then two rak`at and then offered one rak`a witr. Then he lay down till the Mu'adh-dhin came and then he prayed two light rak`at and went out and offered the early morning (Fajr) prayer
hi: Kuraib, Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke azaad kiye gulaam, bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne bataya ke unhone ek raat apni khala Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Ummul-Momineen) ke ghar guzari. Unhone kaha: "Main takiye ki chaudi taraf leta, jabke Allah ke Rasool aur unki biwi lambi taraf lete. Allah ke Rasool aadhi raat tak, ya usse thoda pehle ya baad, so gaye. Phir Allah ke Rasool uthe, baithe aur apne haathon se chehre se neend ka asar hataya. Phir Surah Al-Imran ki aakhri das ayaat tilawat ki. Phir woh latakti hui chamde ki mashkiza ki taraf gaye aur mukammal wudu kiya, phir namaz ke liye khade hue." Abdullah bin Abbas ne joda: "Main utha aur waisa hi kiya jaisa Allah ke Rasool ne kiya tha, phir jaakar unke bagal mein khada hua. Allah ke Rasool ne apna dahina haath mere sar par rakha aur mera dahina kaan pakad kar moda. Aap ne do rakat, phir do, phir do, phir do, phir do, phir do padhi, aur ek rakat Witr padhi. Phir let gaye yahan tak ke Muazzin aaye, phir do halki rakat padhi aur bahar jaakar Fajr ki namaz padhi."

e: Narrated `Abdullah:We used to greet the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was praying and he used to answer our greetings. When we returned from An-Najashi (the ruler of Ethiopia), we greeted him, but he did not answer us (during the prayer) and (after finishing the prayer) he said, "In the prayer one is occupied (with a more serious matter)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Nabi ko salaam karte the jabke woh namaz mein hote, aur Aap humare salaam ka jawab dete the. Jab hum An-Najashi (Ethiopia ke hukmaran) ke paas se wapas aaye, humne unhe salaam kiya, magar Aap ne (namaz mein) jawab nahi diya, aur (namaz khatam karke) farmaya: "Namaz mein insaan (kisi zyada zaroori kaam mein) masroof hota hai."

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The same as No. 290. from the Prophet
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) se Nabi ke hawale se yehi (upar wali) riwayat hai.

e: Narrated Zaid bin Arqam:In the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) we used to speak while praying, and one of us would tell his needs to his companions, till the verse, 'Guard strictly your prayers (2.238) was revealed. After that we were ordered to remain silent while praying
hi: Zaid bin Arqam (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ke zamane mein hum namaz mein baat kiya karte the, aur koi apne sathi ko apni zaroorat bata deta, yahan tak ke yeh ayat nazil hui: "Apni namazon ki sakhti se hifazat karo" (2:238). Iske baad humein khamosh rehne ka hukum diya gaya.

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:The Prophet (ﷺ) went out to affect a reconciliation between the tribes of Bani `Amr bin `Auf and the time of the prayer became due; Bilal went to Abu Bakr and said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) is detained. Will you lead the people in the prayer?" Abu Bakr replied, "Yes, if you wish." So Bilal pronounced the Iqama and Abu Bakr led the prayer. In the meantime the Prophet (ﷺ) came crossing the rows (of the praying people) till he stood in the first row and the people started clapping. Abu Bakr never looked hither and thither during the prayer but when the people clapped too much, he looked back and saw the Prophet (ﷺ) in the (first) row. The Prophet (ﷺ) waved him to remain at his place, but Abu Bakr raised both his hands and sent praises to Allah and then retreated and the Prophet (ﷺ) went forward and led the prayer. (See Hadith No)
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi Bani Amr bin Auf qabile ke darmiyan sulah karwane gaye aur namaz ka waqt aa gaya; Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) Abu Bakr ke paas gaye aur kaha: "Nabi rukke hue hain. Kya aap logon ki imamat karenge?" Abu Bakr ne jawab diya: "Haan, agar aap chahen." To Bilal ne Iqama di aur Abu Bakr ne imamat ki. Isi dauran Nabi safon ko paar karte hue aaye yahan tak ke pehli saf mein khade ho gaye, aur log taaliyan bajane lage. Abu Bakr namaz mein kabhi idhar-udhar nahi dekhte the, magar jab log zyada taaliyan bajane lage, unhone peeche dekha aur Nabi ko (pehli) saf mein paaya. Nabi ne unhe apni jagah rehne ka ishara kiya, magar Abu Bakr ne apne donon haath uthaye, Allah ki hamd ki, phir peeche hate aur Nabi aage badhkar imamat karne lage.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Mas`ud:We used to say the greeting, name and greet each other in the prayer. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) heard it and said:--"Say, 'at-tahiyyatu lil-lahi was-salawatu wat-taiyibatu . Assalamu 'Alaika aiyuha-n-Nabiyu warahmatu- l-lahi wa-barakatuhu. _ Assalamu alaina wa-'ala 'ibadi-l-lahi as-salihin.. Ashhadu an la ilaha illa-l-lah wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan `Abdu hu wa Rasuluh. (All the compliments are for Allah and all the prayers and all the good things (are for Allah). Peace be on you, O Prophet, and Allah's mercy and blessings (are on you). And peace be on us and on the good (pious) worshipers of Allah. I testify that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah and that Muhammad is His slave and Apostle.) So, when you have said this, then you have surely sent the greetings to every good (pious) worshipper of Allah, whether he be in the Heaven or on the Earth
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum namaz mein Allah ko salaam karte, aur naam lekar ek-doosre ko salaam karte. Allah ke Rasool ne yeh suna aur farmaya: "Kaho: 'At-tahiyyatu lil-lahi was-salawatu wat-taiyibatu. Assalamu Alaika aiyuha-n-Nabiyu warahmatu-l-lahi wa-barakatuhu. Assalamu alaina wa-'ala 'ibadi-l-lahi as-salihin. Ashhadu an la ilaha illa-l-lah wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan Abduhu wa Rasuluh' (Sab tareefein, duayein aur achhi cheezein Allah ke liye hain. Salaam ho aap par, Aye Nabi, aur Allah ki rehmat aur barkatein [aap par]. Salaam ho humpar aur Allah ke neik bandon par. Main gawahi deta hoon ke Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahi aur main gawahi deta hoon ke Muhammad uske banda aur Rasool hain). Isliye jab tum yeh kaho, to tum aasman aur zameen ke har neik Allah ke bande ko salaam pahuncha chuke ho."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The saying 'Subhan Allah' is for men and clapping is for women." (If something happens in the prayer, the men can invite the attention of the Imam by saying "Subhan Allah". And women, by clapping their hands)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "'Subhan Allah' kehna mardon ke liye hai aur taaliyan bajanaa aurton ke liye." (Agar namaz mein kuch ho jaaye, mard 'Subhan Allah' kehkar Imam ka dhyan khinch sakte hain, aur aurtein taaliyan bajakar.)

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The saying 'Subhan Allah' is for men and clapping is for women
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "'Subhan Allah' kehna mardon ke liye hai aur taaliyan bajanaa aurton ke liye."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik: While Abu Bakr was leading the people in the morning prayer on a Monday, the Prophet (ﷺ) came towards them suddenly having lifted the curtain of 'Aisha's house, and looked at them as they were standing in rows and smiled. Abu Bakr tried to come back thinking that Allah's Apostle wanted to come out for the prayer. The attention of the Muslims was diverted from the prayer because they were delighted to see the Prophet. The Prophet (ﷺ) waved his hand to them to complete their prayer, then he went back into the room and let down the curtain. The Prophet expired on that very day
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek Somvar ke din jab Abu Bakr logon ki Fajr ki imamat kar rahe the, achanak Nabi Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke ghar ka parda uthaakar unki taraf aaye, unhe safon mein khade dekha aur muskuraye. Abu Bakr peeche hatna chahte the, yeh soch kar ke Allah ke Rasool namaz ke liye bahar aana chahte hain. Musalmanon ka dhyan namaz se hat gaya kyunke woh Nabi ko dekh kar khush the. Nabi ne unhe apni namaz mukammal karne ka ishara kiya, phir kamre mein wapas gaye aur parda gira diya. Usi din Nabi ka intiqal ho gaya.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "A woman called her son while he was in his hermitage and said, 'O Juraij' He said, 'O Allah, my mother (is calling me) and (I am offering) my prayer (what shall I do)?' She again said, 'O Juraij!' He said again, 'O Allah ! My mother (is calling me) and (I am offering) my prayer (what shall I do)?' She again said, 'O Juraij' He again said, 'O Allah! My mother (is calling me) and (I am offering) my prayer. (What shall I do?)' She said, 'O Allah! Do not let Juraij die till he sees the faces of prostitutes.' A shepherdess used to come by his hermitage for grazing her sheep and she gave birth to a child. She was asked whose child that was, and she replied that it was from Juraij and that he had come out from his hermitage. Juraij said, 'Where is that woman who claims that her child is from me?' (When she was brought to him along with the child), Juraij asked the child, 'O Babus, who is your father?' The child replied, 'The shepherd.' " (See Hadith No 662. Vol)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Ek aurat ne apne bete ko pukara jabke woh apni ibadatgah mein tha aur kaha: 'Aye Juraij!' Usne kaha: 'Aye Allah, meri maa (bula rahi hai) aur main namaz mein hoon (main kya karoon?)' Usne phir kaha: 'Aye Juraij!' Usne phir kaha: 'Aye Allah! Meri maa (bula rahi hai) aur main namaz mein hoon (kya karoon?)' Usne phir kaha: 'Aye Juraij!' Usne phir kaha: 'Aye Allah! Meri maa (bula rahi hai) aur main namaz mein hoon. (Kya karoon?)' Aakhirkaar usne kaha: 'Aye Allah! Juraij ko tab tak mat maar jab tak woh fahisha aurton ke chehre na dekh le.' Ek charwahi bakriyan charane uski ibadatgah ke paas aati thi, usne ek bachhe ko janam diya. Poocha gaya woh bachcha kiska hai, usne kaha woh Juraij ka hai aur Juraij apni ibadatgah se nikal aaya hai. Juraij ne kaha: 'Woh aurat kahan hai jo dawa karti hai uska bachcha mera hai?' (Jab use bachche samet laaya gaya), Juraij ne bachche se pucha: 'Aye Babus, tera baap kaun hai?' Bachche ne jawab diya: 'Charwaha.'"

e: Narrated Mu'aiqib:The Prophet (ﷺ) talked about a man leveling the earth on prostrating, and said, "If you have to do so, then do it once
hi: Mu'aiqib (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne ek shaks ke sajde mein zameen barabar karne (kanker hatane) ke baare mein baat ki aur farmaya: "Agar aisa karna zaroori ho, to sirf ek baar karo."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:We used to pray with the Prophet (ﷺ) in scorching heat, and if someone of us could not put his face on the earth (because of the heat) then he would spread his clothes and prostrate over them
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum sakht garmi mein Nabi ke saath namaz padhte the, aur agar hum mein se koi (garmi ki wajah se) apna chehra zameen par nahi rakh sakta tha, to apna kapda bichhakar usme sajda karta.

e: Narrated Aisha:I used to stretch my legs towards the Qibla of the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was praying; whenever he prostrated he touched me, and I would withdraw my legs, and whenever he stood up, I would restretch my legs
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Main apni taangein Nabi ke Qibla ki taraf phaila deti jabke Aap namaz padhte; jab bhi Aap sajda karte, mujhe chhoo jaate aur main apni taangein samet leti, aur jab khade hote, main phir phaila deti.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) once offered the prayer and said, "Satan came in front of me and tried to interrupt my prayer, but Allah gave me an upper hand on him and I choked him. No doubt, I thought of tying him to one of the pillars of the mosque till you get up in the morning and see him. Then I remembered the statement of Prophet Solomon, 'My Lord ! Bestow on me a kingdom such as shall not belong to any other after me.' Then Allah made him (Satan) return with his head down (humiliated)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Nabi ne namaz padhi aur farmaya: "Shaitan mere saamne aaya aur meri namaz mein rukawat daalne ki koshish ki, magar Allah ne mujhe uspar ghalba diya aur maine use gala dabakar pakad liya. Beshak maine socha ise masjid ke kisi sutoon se baandh dun taake tum subah use dekh sako. Phir mujhe Nabi Suleiman ka farmaan yaad aaya: 'Mere Rab! Mujhe aisi saltanat de jo mere baad kisi ke liye na ho.' Tab Allah ne use (shaitan ko) sar jhukaye (zaleel karke) wapas bhej diya."

e: Narrated Al-Azraq bin Qais:We were at Al-Ahwaz fighting the Al-Haruriya (tribe). While I was at the bank of a river a man was praying and the reins of his animal were in his hands and the animal was struggling and he was following the animal. (Shu`ba, a sub-narrator, said that man was Abu Barza Al-Aslami). A man from the Khawarij said, "O Allah! Be harsh to this sheik." And when the sheik (Abu Barza) finished his prayer, he said, "I heard your remark. No doubt, I participated with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in six or seven or eight holy battles and saw his leniency, and no doubt, I would rather retain my animal than let it return to its stable, as it would cause me much trouble
hi: Al-Azraq bin Qais bataate hain: Hum Al-Ahwaz mein Al-Haruriya qabile se jung kar rahe the. Main ek nadi ke kinare tha, ek shaks namaz padh raha tha aur uske janwar ki lagaam uske haath mein thi, aur janwar tadap raha tha aur woh usi ke peechhe ja raha tha. (Shu'ba, doosre raawi ne kaha, woh shaks Abu Barza (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Aslami (رضی اللہ عنہ) the.) Khawarij qabile ke ek shaks ne kaha: "Aye Allah! Is Sheikh par sakhti kar." Jab Sheikh (Abu Barza) namaz khatam kar chuke, unhone kaha: "Maine tumhari baat suni. Beshak maine Allah ke Rasool ke saath chhe, saat ya aath jungon mein hissa liya, aur unki narmi dekhi, aur beshak main apne janwar ko rokanaa behtar samajhta hoon uske bajaye ke woh apne tabele mein wapas jaaye, kyunke isse mujhe bahut takleef hoti."

e: Narrated `Aisha:Once the sun eclipsed and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up for the prayer and recited a very long Sura and then bowed for a long while and then raised his head and started reciting another Sura. Then he bowed, and after finishing, he prostrated and did the same in the second rak`a and then said, "These (lunar and solar eclipses) are two of the signs of Allah and if you see them, pray till the eclipse is over. No doubt, while standing at this place I saw everything promised to me by Allah and I saw (Paradise) and I wanted to pluck a bunch (of grapes) therefrom, at the time when you saw me stepping forward. No doubt, I saw Hell with its different parts destroying each other when you saw me retreating and in it I saw `Amr bin Luhai who started the tradition of freeing animals (set them free) in the name of idols
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ek baar suraj grahan hua aur Allah ke Rasool namaz ke liye khade hue aur bahut lambi Surah tilawat ki, phir lambi der tak ruku kiya, phir sar utha kar doosri Surah tilawat karne lage. Phir ruku kiya, aur khatam karke sajda kiya, aur doosri rakat mein bhi yehi kiya, phir farmaya: "Yeh (chaand-suraj ke grahan) Allah ki do nishaniyan hain, aur agar tum unhe dekho, to namaz padho jab tak grahan khatam na ho. Beshak, jab main is jagah khada tha, maine har woh cheez dekhi jiska Allah ne mujhse waada kiya tha, aur maine (Jannat) dekhi aur uska ek gucchha todnaa chaha, jab tumne mujhe aage badhte dekha. Beshak, maine Dozakh dekhi jiske alag-alag hisse ek-doosre ko khaa rahe the, jab tumne mujhe peeche hatte dekha, aur usme maine Amr bin Luhai ko dekha jinhone butoon ke naam par janwaron ko azaad chhodane ka riwaaj shuru kiya."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) saw some sputum on the wall facing the Qibla of the mosque and became furious with the people of the mosque and said, "During the prayer, Allah is in front of everyone of you and so he should not spit (or said, 'He should not expectorate')." Then he got down and scratched the sputum with his hand. Ibn `Umar said (after narrating), "If anyone of you has to spit during the prayer, he should spit to his left
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne masjid ki Qibla wali deewar par thook dekha aur masjid walon par gussa hue, aur farmaya: "Namaz mein, Allah tum mein se har ek ke saamne hota hai, isliye koi na thooke (ya kaha, use thookna nahi chahiye)." Phir Aap utre aur apne haath se thook khurach diya. Ibn Umar ne (yeh bayan karne ke baad) kaha: "Agar tum mein se kisi ko namaz mein thookna ho, use apne baayen taraf thookna chahiye."

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whenever anyone of you is in prayer, he is speaking in private to his Lord and so he should neither spit in front of him nor on his right side but to his left side under his left foot
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jab bhi tum mein se koi namaz mein hota hai, woh apne Rab se khufia baat kar raha hota hai, isliye use na apne saamne thookna chahiye na apne dahine taraf, balki apne baaye taraf apne baaye paon ke neeche."

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:The people used to offer the prayer with the Prophet (ﷺ) with their waist-sheets tied round their necks because of the shortness of the sheets and the women were ordered not to lift their heads till the men had sat straight
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Log Nabi ke saath apne kamar ke kapde gardan se baandh kar namaz padhte the kyunke woh chhote hote the, aur aurton ko hukum diya gaya tha ke woh sar tab tak na uthayen jab tak mard seedhe baith na jayen.

e: Narrated `Abdullah:I used to greet the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was in prayer and he would return my greeting, but when we returned (from Ethiopia) I greeted the Prophet (while he was praying) but he did not return the greeting, and (after finishing the prayer) he said, "In the prayer one is occupied (with a more serious matter)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Nabi ko salaam karta tha jabke woh namaz mein hote, aur Aap mera salaam ka jawab dete, magar jab hum (Ethiopia se) wapas aaye, maine Nabi ko (namaz mein) salaam kiya magar Aap ne jawab nahi diya, aur (namaz khatam karke) farmaya: "Namaz mein insaan (zyada zaroori kaam mein) masroof hota hai."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent me for some job and when I had finished it I returned and came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and greeted him but he did not return my greeting. So I felt so sorry that only Allah knows it and I said to myself,, 'Perhaps Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) is angry because I did not come quickly, then again I greeted him but he did not reply. I felt even more sorry than I did the first time. Again I greeted him and he returned the greeting and said, "The thing which prevented me from returning the greeting was that I was praying." And at that time he was on his Rahila and his face was not towards the Qibla
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne mujhe kisi kaam ke liye bheja, jab maine kaam khatam kiya, main wapas aakar Nabi ke paas gaya aur unhe salaam kiya magar unhone jawab nahi diya. Mujhe itna bura laga ke sirf Allah jaanta hai, aur maine khud se kaha: 'Shayad Allah ke Rasool naraz hain kyunke main jaldi nahi aaya.' Phir maine dobara salaam kiya magar Aap ne jawab nahi diya. Mujhe pehle se zyada bura laga. Phir maine tisri baar salaam kiya aur Aap ne jawab diya aur farmaya: "Jis cheez ne mujhe salaam ka jawab dene se roka woh yeh thi ke main namaz padh raha tha." Us waqt Aap apni sawari (Rahila) par the aur unka mun Qibla ki taraf nahi tha.

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:The news about the differences amongst the people of Bani `Amr bin `Auf at Quba reached Allah's Apostle and so he went to them along with some of his companions to affect a reconciliation. Allah's Apostle was delayed there and the time for the prayer became due. Bilal came to Abu Bakr and said, "O Abu Bakr! Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) is detained (there) and the time for the prayer is due. Will you lead the people in prayer?" Abu Bakr replied, "Yes, if you wish." So Bilal pronounced the Iqama and Abu Bakr went forward and the people said Takbir. In the meantime, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came piercing through the rows till he stood in the (first) row and the people started clapping. Abu Bakr, would never look hither and thither during the prayer but when the people clapped much he looked back and saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). The Prophet (ﷺ) beckoned him to carry on. Abu Bakr raised both his hands, praised Allah and retreated till he stood in the row and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went forward and led the people in the prayer. When he had finished the prayer, he addressed the people and said, "O people! Why did you start clapping when something happened to you in the prayer? Clapping is for women. Whenever one is confronted with something unusual in the prayer one should say, 'Subhan Allah'." Then the Prophet looked towards Abu Bakr and asked, "What prevented you from leading the prayer when I beckoned you to carry on?" Abu Bakr replied, "It does not befit the son of Al Quhafa to lead the prayer in the presence of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Bani Amr bin Auf qabile ke Quba mein aapasi ikhtilaaf ki khabar Allah ke Rasool tak pahunchi, isliye Aap kuch sahaba ke saath unke darmiyan sulah karwane gaye. Allah ke Rasool wahan der se aaye aur namaz ka waqt aa gaya. Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) Abu Bakr ke paas aaye aur kaha: "Aye Abu Bakr! Allah ke Rasool rukke hue hain aur namaz ka waqt aa gaya hai. Kya aap logon ki imamat karenge?" Abu Bakr ne jawab diya: "Haan, agar aap chahen." To Bilal ne Iqama di aur Abu Bakr aage badhe aur logon ne Takbir kahi. Isi dauran, Allah ke Rasool safon ko cheerte hue aaye yahan tak ke (pehli) saf mein khade ho gaye, aur log taaliyan bajane lage. Abu Bakr namaz mein kabhi idhar-udhar nahi dekhte the, magar jab log zyada taaliyan bajane lage, unhone peeche dekha aur Allah ke Rasool ko dekha. Nabi ne unhe jaari rakhne ka ishara kiya. Abu Bakr ne apne donon haath uthaye, Allah ki tareef ki, aur peeche hat kar saf mein khade ho gaye, aur Allah ke Rasool aage badhkar logon ki imamat karne lage. Namaz khatam karke Aap ne logon se khitaab kiya aur farmaya: "Aye logon! Jab namaz mein kuch ho jaaye to tum taaliyan kyun bajane lage? Taaliyan aurton ke liye hain. Jab bhi namaz mein kuch anokhi baat ho, 'Subhan Allah' kehna chahiye." Phir Nabi ne Abu Bakr ki taraf dekha aur pucha: "Jab maine tumhe jaari rakhne ka ishara kiya, tumhe imamat karte rehne se kis cheez ne roka?" Abu Bakr ne jawab diya: "Al-Quhafa ke bete (yaani mujhe) yeh shobha nahi deta ke woh Allah ke Rasool ki maujoodgi mein imamat kare."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:It was forbidden to keep the hands on the hips during the prayer. (This is narrated by Abu Huraira from the Prophet)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Namaz mein haath kamar par rakhne se mana kiya gaya tha. (Yeh Abu Huraira ne Nabi ke hawale se riwayat ki hai.)

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:It was forbidden to pray with the hands over one's hips
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Haath kamar par rakh kar namaz padhna mana kiya gaya tha.

e: Narrated `Uqba bin Al-Harith:I offered the `Asr prayer with the Prophet (ﷺ) and after finishing the prayer with Taslim he got up quickly and went to some of his wives and then came out. He noticed the signs of astonishment on the faces of the people caused by his speed. He then said, "I remembered while I was in my prayer that a piece of gold was Lying in my house and I disliked that it should remain with us throughout the night, and so I have ordered it to be distributed
hi: Uqba bin Al-Harith (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi ke saath Asr ki namaz padhi, aur Taslim se namaz khatam karke Aap jaldi se uthe aur apni kisi biwi ke paas gaye, phir bahar aaye. Aap ne logon ke chehron par hairat ke asaraat dekhe unki jaldi ki wajah se. Aap ne farmaya: "Mujhe namaz mein yaad aaya ke ghar mein sone ka ek tukda pada hai, aur mujhe napasand tha ke woh raat bhar humare paas rahe, isliye maine hukum diya ke use taqseem kar diya jaaye."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When the Adhan for the prayer is pronounced, then Satan takes to his heels passing wind so that he may not hear the Adhan and when the Mu'adh-dhin finishes, he comes back; and when the Iqama is pronounced he again takes to his heels and when it is finished, he again comes back and continues reminding the praying person of things that he used not to remember when not in prayer till he forgets how much he has prayed." Abu Salama bin `Abdur-Rahman said, "If anyone of you has such a thing (forgetting the number of rak`at he has prayed) he should perform two prostrations of Sahu (i.e. forgetfulness) while sitting." Abu Salama narrates this from Abu Huraira
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jab namaz ki Adhan di jaati hai, shaitan hawa (paadta) chhodtaa hua bhaag jaata hai taake Adhan na sun sake, aur jab Muazzin khatam karta hai, woh wapas aa jaata hai; aur jab Iqama hoti hai, woh phir bhaag jaata hai, aur khatam hone par phir wapas aata hai, aur namazi ko un cheezon ki yaad dilata rehta hai jo woh namaz se pehle yaad nahi rakhta tha, yahan tak ke woh bhool jaata hai usne kitni rakat padhi hai." Abu Salama bin Abdur Rahman ne kaha: "Agar tum mein se kisi ke saath aisa ho (rakaton ki tadaad bhool jaana), use baithkar do Sahu ke sajde karne chahiye." Abu Salama ne yeh Abu Huraira se riwayat ki.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:People say that I narrate too many narrations of the Prophet; once I met a man (during the lifetime of the Prophet) and asked him, "Which Sura did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) recite yesterday in the `Isha' prayer?" He said, "I do not know." I said, "Did you not attend the prayer?" He said, "Yes, (I did)." I said, "I know. He recited such and such Sura
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Log kehte hain maine bahut zyada hadithein bayan ki hain. Ek baar (Nabi ke zamane mein) main ek shaks se mila aur pucha: "Kal Isha ki namaz mein Allah ke Rasool ne kaunsi Surah tilawat ki?" Usne kaha: "Mujhe nahi pata." Maine kaha: "Kya tum namaz mein hazir nahi the?" Usne kaha: "Haan, (tha)." Maine kaha: "Mujhe pata hai. Aap ne falaan-falaan Surah tilawat ki."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Buhaina:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) once led us in a prayer and offered two rak`at and got up (for the third rak`a) without sitting (after the second rak`a). The people also got up with him, and when he was about to finish his prayer, we waited for him to finish the prayer with Taslim but he said Takbir before Taslim and performed two prostrations while sitting and then finished the prayer with Taslim
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Buhaina (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Allah ke Rasool ne humari imamat ki aur do rakat padhkar (teesri rakat ke liye) bina baithe khade ho gaye. Log bhi unke saath khade ho gaye, aur jab Aap namaz khatam karne wale the, hum Taslim ka intezar karne lage, magar Aap ne Taslim se pehle Takbir kahi aur baithe-baithe do sajde kiye, phir Taslim se namaz khatam ki.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Buhaina:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got up after the second rak`a of the Zuhr prayer without sitting in between (the second and the third rak`at). When he finished the prayer he performed two prostrations (of Sahu) and then finished the prayer with Taslim
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Buhaina (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool Zuhr ki doosri rakat ke baad bina beech mein baithe (teesri rakat ke liye) khade ho gaye. Namaz khatam karke Aap ne do sajde (Sahu ke) kiye, phir Taslim se namaz khatam ki.

e: Narrated' `Abdullah:Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) offered five rak`at in the Zuhr prayer, and somebody asked him whether there was some increase in the prayer. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "What is that?" He said, "You have offered five rak`at." So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) performed two prostrations of Sahu after Taslim
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Allah ke Rasool ne Zuhr mein paanch rakat padh di, kisi ne poocha kya namaz mein izafa hua hai. Allah ke Rasool ne pucha: "Woh kya hai?" Usne kaha: "Aapne paanch rakat padhi." To Allah ke Rasool ne Taslim ke baad do sajde (Sahu ke) kiye.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) led us in the `Asr or the Zuhr prayer and finished it with Taslim. Dhul-Yadain said to him, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Has the prayer been reduced?" The Prophet (ﷺ) asked his companions in the affirmative. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) offered two more rak`at and then performed two prostrations (of Sahu). Sa`d said, "I saw that 'Urwa bin Az-Zubair had offered two rak`at in the Maghrib prayer and finished it with Taslim. He then talked (and when he was informed about it) he completed the rest of his prayer and performed two prostrations, and said, 'The Prophet (ﷺ) prayed like this
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne humari Asr ya Zuhr ki imamat ki aur Taslim se namaz khatam ki. Dhul-Yadain ne unse kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Kya namaz kam hui hai?" Nabi ne apne sahaba se pucha aur unhone haan mein jawab diya. To Allah ke Rasool ne do aur rakat padhi, phir do sajde (Sahu ke) kiye. Sa'd ne kaha: "Maine dekha Urwa bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Maghrib mein do rakat padh kar Taslim se namaz khatam kar di. Phir woh baat karne lage (aur jab unhe bataya gaya), unhone baaki namaz mukammal ki aur do sajde kiye, aur kaha: 'Nabi ne isi tarah padhi thi.'"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira.:Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) offered two rak`at and finished his prayer. So Dhul-Yadain asked him, "Has the prayer been reduced or have you forgotten?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Has Dhul-Yadain spoken the truth?" The people replied in the affirmative. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up and offered the remaining two rak`at and performed Taslim, and then said Takbir and performed two prostrations like his usual prostrations, or a bit longer, and then got up
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Allah ke Rasool ne do rakat padh kar namaz khatam kar di. Dhul-Yadain ne unse pucha: "Kya namaz kam hui hai ya aap bhool gaye?" Allah ke Rasool ne pucha: "Kya Dhul-Yadain sach keh rahe hain?" Logon ne haan kaha. Phir Allah ke Rasool khade hue, baaki do rakat padhi aur Taslim ki, phir Takbir kahi aur apne mamool jaisa ya usse thoda lamba do sajde kiye, phir uthe.

e: Narrated Salama bin 'Alqama:I asked Muhammad (bin Seereen) whether Tashah-hud should be recited after the two prostrations of Sahu. He replied, "It is not (mentioned) in Abu Huraira's narration
hi: Salama bin Alqama bataate hain: Maine Muhammad (bin Seereen) se pucha kya do Sahu ke sajdon ke baad Tashahhud padhna chahiye. Unhone jawab diya: "Yeh Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki riwayat mein (zikar) nahi hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) offered one of the evening prayers (the sub-narrator Muhammad said, "I think that it was most probably the `Asr prayer") and he finished it after offering two rak`at only. He then stood near a piece of wood in front of the Mosque and put his hand over it. Abu Bakr and `Umar were amongst those who were present, but they dared not talk to him about that (because of excessive respect for him), and those who were in a hurry went out. They said, "Has the prayer been reduced?" A man who was called Dhul-Yadain by the Prophet (ﷺ) said (to the Prophet), "Has the prayer been reduced or have you forgotten?" He said, "Neither have I forgotten, nor has the prayer been reduced." He said, "Certainly you have forgotten." So the Prophet (ﷺ) offered two more rak`at and performed Taslim and then said Takbir and performed a prostration of Sahu like his ordinary prostration or a bit longer and then raised his head and said Takbir and then put his head down and performed a prostration like his ordinary prostration or a bit longer, and then raised his head and said Takbir
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne shaam ki namazon mein se ek padhi (Muhammad, doosre raawi ne kaha: "Mujhe lagta hai yeh Asr thi") aur sirf do rakat padh kar khatam kar di. Phir Aap masjid ke saamne ek lakdi ke tukde ke paas khade hue aur apna haath uspar rakha. Abu Bakr aur Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bhi wahan the, magar unhone (adab ki wajah se) is baare mein baat karne ki himmat nahi ki, aur jaldi mein the woh log bahar chale gaye. Unhone kaha: "Kya namaz kam hui?" Ek shaks, jise Nabi ne Dhul-Yadain kaha, ne (Nabi se) pucha: "Kya namaz kam hui ya aap bhool gaye?" Nabi ne kaha: "Na main bhoola hoon na namaz kam hui." Usne kaha: "Beshak aap bhool gaye hain." To Nabi ne do aur rakat padhi aur Taslim ki, phir Takbir kahi aur apne mamool jaisa ya usse thoda lamba ek sajda kiya, phir sar utha kar Takbir kahi, phir sar zameen par rakha aur apne mamool jaisa ya usse thoda lamba sajda kiya, phir sar utha kar Takbir kahi.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Buhaina Al-Asdi:(the ally of Bani `Abdul Muttalib) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up for the Zuhr prayer and he should have sat (after the second rak`a but he stood up for the third rak`a without sitting for Tashah-hud) and when he finished the prayer he performed two prostrations and said Takbir on each prostration while sitting, before ending (the prayer) with Taslim; and the people too performed the two prostrations with him instead of the sitting he forgot
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Buhaina (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Asdi (رضی اللہ عنہ) (Bani Abdul Muttalib ke saathi) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool Zuhr ki namaz ke liye khade hue, aur unhe baithna chahiye tha (doosri rakat ke baad), magar woh (Tashahhud ke bina) teesri rakat ke liye khade ho gaye. Namaz khatam karke, Aap ne do sajde kiye aur har sajde par baithe-baithe Takbir kahi, Taslim se pehle; aur log bhi unke saath sajde karne lage, un bhoole hue baithne ke badle mein.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When the call for prayer is made, Satan takes to his heels passing wind so that he may not hear the Adhan and when the call is finished he comes back, and when the Iqama is pronounced, Satan again takes to his heels, and when the Iqama is finished he comes back again and tries to interfere with the person and his thoughts and say, "Remember this and that (which he has not thought of before the prayer)", till the praying person forgets how much he has prayed. If anyone of you does not remember whether he has offered three or four rak`at then he should perform two prostrations of Sahu while sitting
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jab namaz ki Adhan di jaati hai, shaitan hawa (paadta) chhodta hua bhaag jaata hai taake Adhan na sun sake, aur jab Adhan khatam hoti hai, woh wapas aa jaata hai; aur jab Iqama hoti hai, shaitan phir bhaag jaata hai, aur khatam hone par phir wapas aata hai aur namazi ko uske khayaalon mein rukawat daalne ki koshish karta hai aur kehta hai: 'Yeh yaad karo, woh yaad karo' (jo usne namaz se pehle nahi socha tha), yahan tak ke namazi bhool jaata hai usne kitni rakat padhi hain. Agar tum mein se koi yaad na rakh sake ke usne teen padhi ya chaar, use baithkar do Sahu ke sajde karne chahiye."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When anyone of you stands for the prayers, Satan comes and puts him in doubts till he forgets how many rak`at he has prayed. So if this happens to anyone of you, he should perform two prostrations of Sahu while sitting
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi namaz ke liye khada hota hai, shaitan aakar use shak mein daal deta hai yahan tak ke woh bhool jaata hai usne kitni rakat padhi hain. Isliye agar aisa ho jaaye, use baithkar do Sahu ke sajde karne chahiye."

e: Narrated Kuraib:I was sent to Aisha by Ibn `Abbas, Al-Miswar bin Makhrama and `Abdur-Rahman bin Azhar . They told me to greet her on their behalf and to ask her about the offering of the two rak`at after the `Asr prayer and to say to her, "We were informed that you offer those two rak`at and we were told that the Prophet had forbidden offering them." Ibn `Abbas said, "I along with `Umar bin Al-Khattab used to beat the people whenever they offered them." I went to Aisha and told her that message. `Aisha said, "Go and ask Um Salama about them." So I returned and informed them about her statement. They then told me to go to Um Salama with the same question with which they sent me to `Aisha. Um Salama replied, "I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) forbidding them. Later I saw him offering them immediately after he prayed the `Asr prayer. He then entered my house at a time when some of the Ansari women from the tribe of Bani Haram were sitting with me, so I sent my slave girl to him having said to her, 'Stand beside him and tell him that Um Salama says to you, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have heard you forbidding the offering of these (two rak`at after the `Asr prayer) but I have seen you offering them." If he waves his hand then wait for him.' The slave girl did that. The Prophet (ﷺ) beckoned her with his hand and she waited for him. When he had finished the prayer he said, "O daughter of Bani Umaiya! You have asked me about the two rak`at after the `Asr prayer. The people of the tribe of `Abdul-Qais came to me and made me busy and I could not offer the two rak`at after the Zuhr prayer. These (two rak`at that I have just prayed) are for those (missed) ones
hi: Kuraib bataate hain: Mujhe Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ), Al-Miswar bin Makhrama (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Abdur-Rahman bin Azhar ne Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas bheja. Unhone mujhse kaha unhe unki taraf se salaam kahun aur unse Asr ke baad ki do rakat ke baare mein pucchun, aur kahun: "Humein bataya gaya hai ke aap yeh do rakat padhti hain, aur humein yeh bhi bataya gaya hai ke Nabi ne inhe padhne se mana kiya tha." Ibn Abbas ne kaha: "Main Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Khattab (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath, jab bhi log yeh padhte, unhe rokne ke liye maarte the." Main Ayesha ke paas gaya aur unhe yeh sandesh diya. Ayesha ne kaha: "Jaao aur Um Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) se pucho." To main wapas gaya aur unhe unka jawab bataya. Unhone mujhse kaha wahi sawaal Um Salama se bhi puchun jo Ayesha se poocha tha. Um Salama ne jawab diya: "Maine Nabi ko inhe padhne se mana karte suna. Baad mein maine unhe Asr ki namaz ke foran baad yeh padhte dekha. Woh mere ghar aaye us waqt jab kuch Ansari aurtein Bani Haram qabile ki mere paas baithi thin, isliye maine apni launDi ko unke paas bheja yeh kehte huye: 'Unke bagal mein khadi ho jaao aur kaho ke Um Salama kehti hain: Ya Allah ke Rasool! Maine aapko yeh (Asr ke baad ki do rakat) padhne se mana karte suna hai, magar maine aapko yeh padhte bhi dekha hai. Agar woh haath se ishara karein to unka intezar karo.' LaunDi ne aisa hi kiya. Nabi ne apne haath se ishara kiya aur usne intezar kiya. Jab Aap namaz khatam kar chuke, farmaya: 'Aye Bani Umaiya ki beti! Tumne mujhse Asr ke baad ki do rakat ke baare mein poocha. Abdul-Qais qabile ke log mere paas aaye the aur mujhe masroof kar diya, isliye main Zuhr ke baad ki do rakat na padh saka. Yeh (jo maine abhi padhi hain) unhi (chhooti hui) ke liye hain.'"

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d As-Sa`idi:The news about the differences amongst the people of Bani `Amr bin `Auf reached Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and so he went to them along with some of his companions to effect a reconciliation between them. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was delayed there, and the time of the prayer was due. Bilal went to Abu Bakr and said to him, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has been delayed (there) and the time of prayer is due. So will you lead the people in prayer?" Abu Bakr said, "Yes, if you wish." Bilal pronounced the Iqama and Abu Bakr, went forward and said Takbir for the people. In the meantime Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came crossing the rows (of the praying people) and stood in the (first) row and the people started clapping. Abu Bakr, would never glance sideways in his prayer but when the people clapped much he looked back and saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) beckoned him to carry on the prayer. Abu Bakr raised his hands and thanked Allah, and retreated till he reached the (first) row. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went forward and led the people in the prayer. When he completed the prayer he faced the people and said, "O people! Why did you start clapping when something unusual happened to you in the prayer? Clapping is only for women. So whoever amongst you comes across something in the prayer should say, 'Subhan-Allah' for there is none who will not turn round on hearing him saying Subhan-Allah. O Abu Bakr! What prevented you from leading the people in the prayer when I beckoned you to do so?" Abu Bakr replied, "How dare the son of Abu Quhafa lead the prayer in the presence of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ?
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) As-Sa'idi (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Bani Amr bin Auf qabile ke logon ke aapasi ikhtilaaf ki khabar Allah ke Rasool tak pahunchi, isliye Aap kuch sahaba ke saath unke darmiyan sulah karwane gaye. Allah ke Rasool wahan der se aaye aur namaz ka waqt aa gaya. Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) Abu Bakr ke paas gaye aur unse kaha: "Allah ke Rasool rukke hue hain aur namaz ka waqt aa gaya hai. Kya aap logon ki imamat karenge?" Abu Bakr ne kaha: "Haan, agar aap chahen." Bilal ne Iqama di aur Abu Bakr aage badhe aur logon ke liye Takbir kahi. Isi dauran Allah ke Rasool safon ko cheerte hue aaye aur (pehli) saf mein khade ho gaye, aur log taaliyan bajane lage. Abu Bakr namaz mein kabhi idhar-udhar nahi dekhte the, magar jab log zyada taaliyan bajane lage, unhone peeche dekha aur Allah ke Rasool ko dekha. Allah ke Rasool ne unhe namaz jaari rakhne ka ishara kiya. Abu Bakr ne apne haath uthaye, Allah ka shukr ada kiya, aur peeche hat kar (pehli) saf mein pahunch gaye. Allah ke Rasool aage badhe aur logon ki imamat ki. Namaz mukammal karke, Aap ne logon ki taraf mud kar farmaya: "Aye logon! Jab tumhare saath namaz mein kuch anokhi baat ho to tum taaliyan kyun bajane lage? Taaliyan sirf aurton ke liye hain. Isliye jo bhi tum mein se namaz mein kuch dekhe, use 'Subhan-Allah' kehna chahiye, kyunke koi bhi 'Subhan-Allah' sunkar mudne se nahi rukega. Aye Abu Bakr! Jab maine tumhe imamat jaari rakhne ka ishara kiya to tumhe kis cheez ne roka?" Abu Bakr ne jawab diya: "Abu Quhafa ke bete (yaani main) ki himmat kaise ho sakti hai ke Allah ke Rasool ki maujoodgi mein imamat kare?"

e: Narrated Asma':I went to `Aisha and she was standing praying and the people, too, were standing (praying). So I said, "What is the matter with the people?" She beckoned with her head towards the sky. I said, "(Is there) a sign?" She nodded intending to say, "Yes
hi: Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Main Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas gayi, woh khadi namaz padh rahi thin aur log bhi khade (namaz padh rahe) the. Maine pucha: "Logon ko kya hua?" Unhone apne sar se aasman ki taraf ishara kiya. Maine pucha: "(Kya koi) nishani (hai)?" Unhone haan (kehna) ka ishara kiya.

e: Narrated `Aisha the wife of the Prophet:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) during his illness prayed in his house sitting, whereas some people followed him standing, but the Prophet (ﷺ) beckoned them to sit down. On completion of the prayer he said, "The Imam is to be followed. So, bow when he bows, and raise your head when he raises his head." (See Hadith No. 657 Vol 1 for taking the verdict)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki biwi) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool ne apni bimari mein apne ghar mein baithkar namaz padhi, jabke kuch log unke peechhe khade padh rahe the, magar Nabi ne unhe baithne ka ishara kiya. Namaz mukammal karke Aap ne farmaya: "Imam ki pairvi ki jaati hai. Isliye jab woh ruku kare, tum bhi karo, aur jab woh sar utha ta hai, tum bhi utha o."

e: Narrated Abu Dhar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Someone came to me from my Lord and gave me the news (or good tidings) that if any of my followers dies worshipping none (in any way) along with Allah, he will enter Paradise." I asked, "Even if he committed illegal sexual intercourse (adultery) and theft?" He replied, "Even if he committed illegal sexual intercourse (adultery) and theft
hi: Abu Dharr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Mere paas mere Rab ki taraf se koi aaya aur khushkhabri di ke jo bhi mera pairokar Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek kiye bina mare, woh Jannat mein jayega." Maine pucha: "Chahe usne zina aur chori bhi ki ho?" Aap ne jawab diya: "Chahe usne zina aur chori bhi ki ho."

e: Narrated `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Anyone who dies worshipping others along with Allah will definitely enter the Fire." I said, "Anyone who dies worshipping none along with Allah will definitely enter Paradise
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jo bhi Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek karte hue mare, woh zaroor Dozakh mein jayega." Maine kaha: "Jo bhi bina shirk kiye mare, woh zaroor Jannat mein jayega."

e: Narrated Al-Bara' bin `Azib:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered us to do seven things and forbade us to do other seven. He ordered us: to follow the funeral procession. to visit the sick, to accept invitations, to help the oppressed, to fulfill the oaths, to return the greeting and to reply to the sneezer: (saying, "May Allah be merciful on you," provided the sneezer says, "All the praises are for Allah,"). He forbade us to use silver utensils and dishes and to wear golden rings, silk (clothes), Dibaj (pure silk cloth), Qassi and Istabraq (two kinds of silk cloths)
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne humein saat baaton ka hukum diya aur saat baaton se roka. Aap ne hukum diya: janaze ke saath jaana, bimaar ki tabiyat poochhna, dawaton ka qubool karna, mazloom ki madad karna, qasmein poori karna, salaam ka jawab dena, aur chheenk lene wale ka jawab dena (yaani "Yarhamukallah" kehna, agar chheenkne wala "Alhamdulillah" kahe). Aap ne mana kiya: chandi ke bartan istemal karne se, sone ki angoothi pehnne se, resham, Dibaj (khaalis resham ka kapda), Qassi aur Istabraq (do qisam ke resham ke kapde) pehnne se.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "The rights of a Muslim on the Muslims are five: to respond to the salaam, visiting the sick, to follow the funeral processions, to accept an invitation, and to reply to those who sneeze. (see Hadith)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool ko farmate suna: "Ek Musalman ke doosre Musalmanon par paanch haqq hain: salaam ka jawab dena, bimaar ki tabiyat poochhna, janaze ke saath jaana, dawat qubool karna, aur chheenk lene wale ka jawab dena."

e: Narrated `Aisha:Abu Bakr came riding his horse from his dwelling place in As-Sunh. He got down from it, entered the Mosque and did not speak with anybody till he came to me and went directly to the Prophet, who was covered with a marked blanket. Abu Bakr uncovered his face. He knelt down and kissed him and then started weeping and said, "My father and my mother be sacrificed for you, O Allah's Prophet! Allah will not combine two deaths on you. You have died the death which was written for you." Narrated Abu Salama from Ibn `Abbas : Abu Bakr came out and `Umar , was addressing the people, and Abu Bakr told him to sit down but `Umar refused. Abu Bakr again told him to sit down but `Umar again refused. Then Abu Bakr recited the Tashah-hud (i.e. none has the right to be worshipped but Allah and Muhammad is Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)) and the people attended to Abu Bakr and left `Umar. Abu Bakr said, "Amma ba'du, whoever amongst you worshipped Muhammad, then Muhammad is dead, but whoever worshipped Allah, Allah is alive and will never die. Allah said: 'Muhammad is no more than an Apostle and indeed (many) Apostles have passed away before him ..(up to the) grateful.' " (3.144) (The narrator added, "By Allah, it was as if the people never knew that Allah had revealed this verse before till Abu Bakr recited it and then whoever heard it, started reciting it)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Abu Bakr apne ghar (As-Sunh) se ghode par sawar aaye. Woh utre, masjid mein daakhil hue, aur kisi se baat kiye bina meri taraf aaye, seedhe Nabi ke paas gaye, jo naqsh-daar chadar se dhake hue the. Abu Bakr ne unka chehra khola. Woh ghutne tek kar baithe aur unhe bosa diya, phir rone lage aur kaha: "Mere maa-baap aap par qurban hon, Aye Allah ke Nabi! Allah aapko do maut nahi dega. Aap woh maut mar chuke hain jo aapke liye likhi thi." Abu Salama, Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke hawale se: Abu Bakr bahar aaye jabke Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) logon se khitaab kar rahe the, Abu Bakr ne unhe baithne ko kaha magar Umar ne mana kiya. Abu Bakr ne phir baithne ko kaha magar Umar ne phir mana kiya. Phir Abu Bakr ne Tashahhud padha (yaani Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahi aur Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain) aur log Abu Bakr ki taraf mutawajjeh ho gaye aur Umar ko chhod diya. Abu Bakr ne kaha: "Amma ba'du, jo bhi tum mein se Muhammad ki ibadat karta tha, to Muhammad ka intiqal ho chuka hai, magar jo Allah ki ibadat karta tha, Allah zinda hai aur kabhi nahi marega. Allah ne farmaya: 'Muhammad sirf ek Rasool hain, aur unse pehle bhi (bahut) Rasool guzre hain... shukr-guzaar' (3:144)."
