(Raawi ne joda: "Allah ki qasam, aisa lagta tha jaise logon ko is ayat ke nazil hone ka pata hi nahi tha jab tak Abu Bakr ne use na padha, phir jisne bhi suna, usi ayat ko padhne lage.")

e: Narrated Kharija bin Zaid bin Thabit:Um Al-`Ala', an Ansari woman who gave the pledge of allegiance to the Prophet (ﷺ) said to me, "The emigrants were distributed amongst us by drawing lots and we got in our share `Uthman bin Maz'un. We made him stay with us in our house. Then he suffered from a disease which proved fatal when he died and was given a bath and was shrouded in his clothes, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came I said, 'May Allah be merciful to you, O Abu As-Sa'ib! I testify that Allah has honored you'. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'How do you know that Allah has honored him?' I replied, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Let my father be sacrificed for you! On whom else shall Allah bestow His honor?' The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'No doubt, death came to him. By Allah, I too wish him good, but by Allah, I do not know what Allah will do with me though I am Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). ' By Allah, I never attested the piety of anyone after that." Al-Laith also narrated as above
hi: Kharija bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Thabit (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Um Al-Ala, ek Ansari aurat jinhone Nabi se bai'at ki thi, ne mujhse kaha: "Muhajireen ko humare beech qura-andaazi se taqseem kiya gaya, aur hamare hisse mein Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Maz'un aaye. Humne unhe apne ghar mein rakha. Phir unhe ek bimari ho gayi jo aakhirkaar unki maut ka sabab bani, unhe ghusl diya gaya aur kapdon mein kafan diya gaya, Allah ke Rasool aaye. Maine kaha: 'Aye Abu As-Sa'ib! Allah aap par reham kare, main gawahi deti hoon ke Allah ne aapki izzat ki hai.' Nabi ne pucha: 'Tumhe kaise pata Allah ne unki izzat ki hai?' Maine jawab diya: 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Mere maa-baap aap par qurban hon! Aur kisi par to Allah izzat karega?' Nabi ne farmaya: 'Beshak, maut unke paas aa gayi. Allah ki qasam, main bhi unke liye bhalai chahta hoon, magar Allah ki qasam, mujhe nahi pata Allah mere saath kya karega, jabke main khud Allah ka Rasool hoon.'" Allah ki qasam, iske baad maine kabhi kisi ki neki ki gawahi nahi di. Al-Laith ne bhi yehi riwayat ki.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:When my father was martyred, I lifted the sheet from his face and wept and the people forbade me to do so but the Prophet (ﷺ) did not forbid me. Then my aunt Fatima began weeping and the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It is all the same whether you weep or not. The angels were shading him continuously with their wings till you shifted him (from the field)
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab mere waalid shaheed hue, maine unke chehre se chadar hataai aur roya, log mujhe rokne lage magar Nabi ne nahi roka. Phir meri phuphi Fatima (Alayhas Salam) rone lagin, Nabi ne farmaya: "Chahe tum roho ya na roho, farishte hamesha apne paron se unhe saaya kar rahe the yahan tak ke tumne unhe (maidan se) utha liya."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) informed (the people) about the death of An-Najashi on the very day he died. He went towards the Musalla (praying place) and the people stood behind him in rows. He said four Takbirs (i.e. offered the Funeral prayer)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne usi din An-Najashi ki maut ki khabar di jis din unka intiqal hua. Aap Musalla ki taraf gaye aur log unke peechhe safon mein khade hue. Aap ne chaar Takbirein kahin (yaani Namaz-e-Janaza padhi).

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Zaid took over the flag and was martyred. Then it was taken by Jafar who was martyred as well. Then `Abdullah bin Rawaha took the flag but he too was martyred and at that time the eyes of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) were full of tears. Then Khalid bin Al-Walid took the flag without being nominated as a chief (before hand) and was blessed with victory
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Zaid ne jhanda sambhala aur shaheed hue. Phir Jafar ne liya aur woh bhi shaheed hue. Phir Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Rawaha ne jhanda liya magar woh bhi shaheed hue, aur us waqt Allah ke Rasool ki aankhon mein aansu bhare the. Phir Khalid bin Al-Walid ne bina pehle se muqarrar kiye jhanda liya aur unhe fatah nasib hui."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas.:A person died and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to visit him. He died at night and (the people) buried him at night. In the morning they informed the Prophet (about his death). He said, "What prevented you from informing me?" They replied, "It was night and it was a dark night and so we disliked to trouble you." The Prophet (ﷺ) went to his grave and offered the (funeral) prayer
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Ek shaks ka intiqal hua, Allah ke Rasool unse milne jate the. Woh raat ko mare aur logon ne unhe raat ko hi dafn kar diya. Subah unhone Nabi ko (unki maut ke baare mein) bataya. Aap ne pucha: "Tumhe mujhe batane se kis cheez ne roka?" Unhone jawab diya: "Raat thi aur andheri raat thi, isliye humein aapko taklif dena napasand hua." Nabi unki qabar par gaye aur (janaze ki) namaz padhi.

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A Muslim whose three children die before the age of puberty will be granted Paradise by Allah due to his mercy for them
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jis Musalman ke teen bachche baaligh hone se pehle mar jaayen, Allah apni rehmat se use Jannat dega."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id:The women requested the Prophet, "Please fix a day for us." So the Prophet (ﷺ) preached to them and said, "A woman whose three children died would be screened from the Hell Fire by them," Hearing that, a woman asked, "If two died?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Even two (would screen her from the (Hell) Fire. " And Abu Huraira added, "Those children should be below the age of puberty
hi: Abu Saeed (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Aurton ne Nabi se guzarish ki: "Kripya humare liye bhi ek din muqarrar kijiye." To Nabi ne unhe naseehat ki aur kaha: "Jis aurat ke teen bachche mar jaayen, woh Dozakh ki aag se un bachchon ki wajah se bach jaayegi." Yeh sunkar ek aurat ne pucha: "Agar do mar jaayen?" Nabi ne jawab diya: "Do bhi (bacha lenge Dozakh se)." Aur Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne joda: "Yeh bachche baaligh hone se pehle ke hone chahiye."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No Muslim whose three children died will go to the Fire except for Allah's oath (i.e. everyone has to pass over the bridge above the lake of fire)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Kisi Musalman ke jiske teen bachche mar jaayen, Dozakh ki aag nahi chhuegi, siwaye Allah ki qasam poori karne ke (yaani sab ko pul se guzarna hoga)."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) passed by a woman who was sitting and weeping beside a grave and said to her, "Fear Allah and be patient
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ek qabar ke paas se guzre jahan ek aurat baithi ro rahi thi, aur Aap ne usse farmaya: "Allah se dar aur sabr kar."

e: Narrated Um 'Atiyya al-Ansariya:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to us when his daughter died and said, "Wash her thrice or five times or more, if you see it necessary, with water and Sidr and then apply camphor or some camphor at the end; and when you finish, notify me." So when we finished it, we informed him and he gave us his waist-sheet and told us to shroud the dead body in it
hi: Um Atiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) Al-Ansariya bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool humare paas aaye jab unki beti ka intiqal hua aur farmaya: "Isse teen ya paanch baar, ya usse zyada agar zaroori samjho, paani aur Sidr (ber ke patton) se dhoo lo, aur aakhir mein kafoor (ya thoda kafoor) lagao; aur jab khatam kar lo, mujhe bataana." Jab humne khatam kiya, humne unhe bataya aur Aap ne humein apna Izar diya aur usme kafan dene ko kaha.

e: Narrated Um 'Atiyya:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to us and we were giving a bath to his (dead) daughter and said, "Wash her three, five or more times with water and Sidr and sprinkle camphor on her at the end; and when you finish, notify me." So when we finished, we informed him and he gave us his waist-sheet and told us to shroud her in it. Aiyub said that Hafsa narrated to him a narration similar to that of Muhammad in which it was said that the bath was to be given for an odd number of times, and the numbers 3, 5 or 7 were mentioned. It was also said that they were to start with the right side and with the parts which were washed in ablution, and that Um 'Atiyya also mentioned, "We combed her hair and divided them in three braids
hi: Um Atiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool humare paas aaye jabke hum unki (marhooma) beti ko ghusl de rahe the, aur farmaya: "Isse teen, paanch ya usse zyada baar paani aur Sidr se dhoo lo, aur aakhir mein kafoor chhidak do; aur jab khatam kar lo, mujhe bataana." Jab humne khatam kiya, humne unhe bataya aur Aap ne humein apna Izar diya aur usme kafan dene ko kaha. Aiyub ne kaha ke Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne unhe Muhammad ki riwayat jaisi hi riwayat batayi jisme kaha gaya tha ke ghusl taaq (odd) tadaad mein dena chahiye, aur 3, 5 ya 7 ka zikar hua. Yeh bhi kaha gaya ke dahini taraf aur wudu wale hisson se shuru karna chahiye, aur Um Atiya ne yeh bhi bataya: "Humne unke baal kanghi karke teen lediyon mein baant diye."

e: Narrated Um 'Atiyya:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) , concerning his (dead) daughter's bath, said, "Start with the right side, and the parts which are washed in ablution
hi: Um Atiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool ne apni (marhooma) beti ke ghusl ke baare mein farmaya: "Dahini taraf se shuru karo, aur wudu wale hisson se."

e: Narrated Um 'Atiyya:When we washed the deceased daughter of the Prophet, he said to us, while we were washing her, "Start the bath from the right side and from the parts which are washed in ablution
hi: Um Atiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab humne Nabi ki marhooma beti ko ghusl diya, Aap ne humse kaha jabke hum unhe dhoo rahe the: "Ghusl dahini taraf se aur wudu wale hisson se shuru karo."

e: Narrated Um 'Atiyya:The daughter of the Prophet (ﷺ) expired, and he said to us, "Wash her three or five times, or more if you see it necessary, and when you finish, notify me." So, (when we finished) we informed him and he unfastened his waist-sheet and told us to shroud her in it
hi: Um Atiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi ki beti ka intiqal hua, Aap ne humse kaha: "Isse teen ya paanch baar, ya usse zyada agar zaroori samjho, dhoo lo, aur jab khatam kar lo, mujhe bataana." To (jab humne khatam kiya) humne unhe bataya aur Aap ne apna Izar khol kar humein diya aur usme kafan dene ko kaha.

e: Narrated Muhammad:Um 'Atiyya said, "One of the daughters of the Prophet (ﷺ) died and he came out and said, 'Wash her three or five times or more, if you think it necessary, with water and Sidr, and last of all put camphor (or some camphor) and when you finish, inform me.' " Um Atiyya added, "When we finished we informed him and he gave us his waist-sheet and said, 'Shroud her in it.' " And Um 'Atiyya (in another narration) added, "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Wash her three, five or seven times or more, if you think it necessary.' " Hafsa said that Um 'Atiyya had also said, "We entwined her hair into three braids
hi: Muhammad bataate hain: Um Atiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha: "Nabi ki betiyon mein se ek ka intiqal hua aur Aap bahar aakar farmaya: 'Isse teen ya paanch baar, ya usse zyada agar zaroori samjho, paani aur Sidr se dhoo lo, aur aakhir mein kafoor (ya thoda kafoor) lagao, aur jab khatam kar lo, mujhe bataana.'" Um Atiya ne joda: "Jab humne khatam kiya, humne unhe bataya aur Aap ne humein apna Izar diya aur kaha: 'Isme kafan do.'" Aur Um Atiya ne (ek doosri riwayat mein) joda: "Nabi ne farmaya: 'Isse teen, paanch ya saat baar, ya usse zyada agar zaroori samjho, dhoo lo.'" Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne bataya ke Um Atiya ne yeh bhi kaha: "Humne unke baal teen lediyon mein baant diye."

e: Narrated Hafsa bint Seereen:Um 'Atiyya said that they had entwined the hair of the daughter of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in three braids. They first undid her hair, washed and then entwined it in three braids
hi: Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Seereen bataati hain: Um Atiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha ke unhone Allah ke Rasool ki beti ke baal teen lediyon mein baante. Pehle unhone unke baal khole, dhoye, phir teen lediyon mein baant diye.

e: Narrated Ibn Seereen:Um 'Atiyya (an Ansari woman who gave the pledge of allegiance to the Prophet (ﷺ) ) came to Basra to visit her son, but she could not find him. She narrated to us, "The Prophet (ﷺ) came to us while we were giving bath to his (dead) daughter, he said: 'Wash her three times, five times or more, if you think it necessary, with water and Sidr, and last of all put camphor, and when you finish, notify me.' " Um 'Atiyya added, "After finishing, we informed him and he gave us his waist sheet and told us to shroud her in it and did not say more than that
hi: Ibn Seereen bataate hain: Um Atiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) (ek Ansari aurat jinhone Nabi se bai'at ki thi) Basra apne bete se milne aayin magar unhe na paayin. Unhone humein bataya: "Nabi humare paas aaye jabke hum unki (marhooma) beti ko ghusl de rahe the, Aap ne farmaya: 'Isse teen baar, paanch baar ya usse zyada agar zaroori samjho, paani aur Sidr se dhoo lo, aur aakhir mein kafoor lagao, aur jab khatam kar lo, mujhe bataana.'" Um Atiya ne joda: "Khatam karne ke baad, humne unhe bataya aur Aap ne humein apna Izar diya aur usme kafan dene ko kaha, aur isse zyada kuch nahi kaha."

e: Narrated Um 'Atiyya:We entwined the hair of the dead daughter of the Prophet (ﷺ) into three braids. Waki said that Sufyan said, "One braid was entwined in front and the other two were entwined on the sides of the head
hi: Um Atiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Humne Nabi ki marhooma beti ke baal teen lediyon mein baante. Waki ne kaha ke Sufyan ne bataya: "Ek ledi saamne aur baaki do sar ke donon taraf baandhi gayi thin."

e: Narrated Um 'Atiyya:One of the daughters of the Prophet (ﷺ) expired and he came to us and said, "Wash her with Sidr (water) for odd number of times, i.e. three, five or more, if you think it necessary, and in the last, put camphor or (some camphor on her), and when you finish, notify me." So when we finished we informed him. He gave his waist-sheet to us (to shroud her). We entwined the hair (of the deceased girl) in three braids and made them fall at her back
hi: Um Atiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi ki ek beti ka intiqal hua aur Aap humare paas aaye aur farmaya: "Isse Sidr (paani) se taaq tadaad mein dhoo lo, yaani teen, paanch ya usse zyada agar zaroori samjho, aur aakhir mein kafoor (ya thoda kafoor) lagao, aur jab khatam kar lo, mujhe bataana." Jab humne khatam kiya, humne unhe bataya. Aap ne apna Izar humein diya (kafan ke liye). Humne (marhooma ladki ke) baal teen lediyon mein baant kar unki pusht par dale.

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was shrouded in three Yemenite white Suhuliya (pieces of cloth) of cotton, and in them there was neither a shirt nor a turban
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool ko teen Yemeni safed Suhuliya (cotton) kapdon mein kafan diya gaya, aur unme na koi qamees thi na pagdi.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:While a man was riding (his Mount) in `Arafat, he fell down from it (his Mount) and broke his neck (and died). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Wash him with water and Sidr and shroud him in two pieces of cloth, and neither perfume him, nor cover his head, for he will be resurrected on the Day of Resurrection saying, 'Labbaik,' (i.e. like a pilgrim)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Ek shaks Arafat mein apni sawari par tha ke woh gir gaya aur uski gardan toot gayi (aur woh mar gaya). Nabi ne farmaya: "Ise paani aur Sidr se dhoo lo aur do kapdon mein kafan do, aur na khushbu lagao na sar dhako, kyunke woh Qiyamat ke din 'Labbaik' kehte hue uthega (jaise Hajji karta hai)."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:While a man was at `Arafat (for Hajj) with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), he fell down from his Mount and broke his neck (and died). So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Wash him with water and Sidr and shroud him in two pieces of cloth and neither perfume him nor cover his head, for Allah will resurrect him on the Day of Resurrection and he will be saying 'Labbaik
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Ek shaks Arafat mein (Hajj ke liye) Allah ke Rasool ke saath tha ke woh apni sawari se gir gaya aur uski gardan toot gayi (aur mar gaya). To Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Ise paani aur Sidr se dhoo lo aur do kapdon mein kafan do aur na khushbu lagao na sar dhako, kyunke Allah use Qiyamat ke din uthaega jabke woh 'Labbaik' keh raha hoga."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:A man was killed by his camel while we were with the Prophet (ﷺ) and he was a Muhrim. So the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Wash him with water and Sidr and shroud him in two pieces of cloth and neither perfume him nor cover his head, for Allah will resurrect him on the Day of Resurrection and he will be saying 'Labbaik
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Ek shaks apne oont se gir kar mar gaya jabke hum Nabi ke saath the aur woh Muhrim (Ihram mein) tha. To Nabi ne farmaya: "Ise paani aur Sidr se dhoo lo aur do kapdon mein kafan do aur na khushbu lagao na sar dhako, kyunke Allah use Qiyamat ke din uthaega jabke woh 'Labbaik' keh raha hoga."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:A man fell from his Mount and died while he was with the Prophet (ﷺ) at `Arafat. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Wash him with water and Sidr and shroud him in two pieces of cloth and neither perfume him nor cover his head, for he will be resurrected on the Day of Resurrection saying, 'Labbaik
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Ek shaks apni sawari se girkar mar gaya jabke woh Nabi ke saath Arafat mein tha. Nabi ne farmaya: "Ise paani aur Sidr se dhoo lo aur do kapdon mein kafan do aur na khushbu lagao na sar dhako, kyunke woh Qiyamat ke din 'Labbaik' kehte hue uthega."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:When `Abdullah bin Ubai (the chief of hypocrites) died, his son came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Please give me your shirt to shroud him in it, offer his funeral prayer and ask for Allah's forgiveness for him." So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave his shirt to him and said, "Inform me (When the funeral is ready) so that I may offer the funeral prayer." So, he informed him and when the Prophet intended to offer the funeral prayer, `Umar took hold of his hand and said, "Has Allah not forbidden you to offer the funeral prayer for the hypocrites? The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I have been given the choice for Allah says: '(It does not avail) Whether you (O Muhammad) ask forgiveness for them (hypocrites), or do not ask for forgiveness for them. Even though you ask for their forgiveness seventy times, Allah will not forgive them. (9.80)" So the Prophet (ﷺ) offered the funeral prayer and on that the revelation came: "And never (O Muhammad) pray (funeral prayer) for any of them (i.e. hypocrites) that dies
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Jab Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ubai (munafiqon ka sardar) ka intiqal hua, uska beta Nabi ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Kripya mujhe apni qamees dein taake main use usme kafan dun, aur uski namaz-e-janaza padhein aur uske liye Allah se maafi maangein." Allah ke Rasool ne apni qamees usse di aur kaha: "Mujhe bataana (jab janaza taiyaar ho) taake main namaz padh sakoon." To usne bataya, aur jab Nabi namaz padhne lage, Umar ne unka haath pakda aur kaha: "Kya Allah ne aapko munafiqon ki namaz-e-janaza padhne se mana nahi kiya?" Nabi ne farmaya: "Mujhe ikhtiyar diya gaya hai, kyunke Allah farmataa hai: '(Iska koi faida nahi) Chahe (Aye Muhammad) tum unke (munafiqon ke) liye maafi maango ya na maango. Chahe tum unke liye sattar baar bhi maafi maango, Allah unhe kabhi maaf nahi karega' (9:80)." To Nabi ne namaz-e-janaza padhi, aur usi waqt yeh wahi nazil hui: "Aur (Aye Muhammad) kabhi in mein se kisi ki bhi (janaze ki) namaz na padhna jo mar jaaye."

e: Narrated Jabir:The Prophet (ﷺ) came to (the grave of) `Abdullah bin Ubai after his body was buried. The body was brought out and then the Prophet (ﷺ) put his saliva over the body and clothed it in his shirt
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ubai ki (qabar par) uski dafn ke baad gaye. Jism ko bahar nikala gaya aur Nabi ne apna thook uspar lagaya aur use apni qamees pehnayi.

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) was shrouded in three pieces of cloth which were made of Suhul (a type of cotton), and neither a shirt nor a turban were used
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi ko teen kapdon mein kafan diya gaya jo Suhul (ek qisam ki cotton) ke bane the, aur na koi qamees na pagdi istemal hui.

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was shrouded in three pieces of cloth and neither a shirt nor a turban were used
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool ko teen kapdon mein kafan diya gaya aur na koi qamees na pagdi istemal hui.

e: Narrated Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was shrouded in three pieces of cloth which were made of white Suhul and neither a shirt nor a turban were used
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool ko safed Suhul ke teen kapdon mein kafan diya gaya, aur na koi qamees na pagdi istemal hui.

e: Narrated Sa`d from his father:Once the meal of `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf was brought in front of him, and he said, "Mus`ab bin `Umair was martyred and he was better than I, and he had nothing except his Burd (a black square narrow dress) to be shrouded in. Hamza or another person was martyred and he was also better than I and he had nothing to be shrouded in except his Burd. No doubt, I fear that the rewards of my deeds might have been given early in this world." Then he started weeping
hi: Sa'd, apne waalid ke hawale se: Ek baar Abdur Rahman bin Auf (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saamne khana laaya gaya, unhone kaha: "Mus'ab bin Umair shaheed hue aur woh mujhse behtar the, aur unke paas sirf unka Burd (kaala chaukor kapda) tha jisme unhe kafan diya gaya. Hamza ya koi aur shaheed hue aur woh bhi mujhse behtar the, aur unke paas bhi sirf unka Burd tha jisme kafan diya gaya. Beshak mujhe dar hai ke mere amal ka ajr isi duniya mein jaldi de diya gaya ho." Phir woh rone lage.

e: Narrated Ibrahim:Once a meal was brought to `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf and he was fasting. He said, "Mus`ab bin `Umair was martyred and he was better than I and was shrouded in his Burd and when his head was covered with it, his legs became bare, and when his legs were covered his head got uncovered. Hamza was martyred and was better than I. Now the worldly wealth have been bestowed upon us (or said a similar thing). No doubt, I fear that the rewards of my deeds might have been given earlier in this world." Then he started weeping and left his food
hi: Ibrahim bataate hain: Ek baar Abdur-Rahman bin Auf ke paas khana laaya gaya jabke woh roza rakhe hue the. Unhone kaha: "Mus'ab bin Umair shaheed hue aur woh mujhse behtar the, aur unhe unke Burd mein kafan diya gaya, aur jab unka sar dhaka gaya to unke paon nange reh gaye, aur jab paon dhake gaye to sar nanga reh gaya. Hamza shaheed hue aur woh bhi mujhse behtar the. Ab humein duniyawi daulat di gayi hai (ya isi jaisi baat kahi). Beshak mujhe dar hai ke mere amal ka ajr isi duniya mein jaldi de diya gaya ho." Phir woh rone lage aur khana chhod diya.

e: Narrated Khabbab:We emigrated with the Prophet (ﷺ) in Allah's cause, and so our reward was then surely incumbent on Allah. Some of us died and they did not take anything from their rewards in this world, and amongst them was Mus`ab bin `Umair; and the others were those who got their rewards. Mus`ab bin `Umair was martyred on the day of the Battle of Uhud and we could get nothing except his Burd to shroud him in. And when we covered his head his feet became bare and vice versa. So the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered us to cover his head only and to put idhkhir (a kind of shrub) over his feet
hi: Khabbab (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Nabi ke saath Allah ki raah mein hijrat kar ke aaye, isliye hamara ajr zaroor Allah par farz hai. Hum mein se kuch mar gaye aur unhone is duniya mein apne ajr se kuch nahi liya, unme Mus'ab bin Umair bhi the; aur baaki woh log the jinhe unka ajr mil gaya. Mus'ab bin Umair Uhud ki jung ke din shaheed hue aur humein unke sirf Burd ke ilawa kuch nahi mila unhe kafan dene ke liye. Jab humne unka sar dhaka to unke paon nange ho jaate, aur ulta. Isliye Nabi ne humein sirf sar dhakne aur paon par Idhkhir (ek qisam ki jhaadi) rakhne ka hukum diya.

e: Narrated Sahl:A woman brought a woven Burda (sheet) having edging (border) to the Prophet, Then Sahl asked them whether they knew what is Burda, they said that Burda is a cloak and Sahl confirmed their reply. Then the woman said, "I have woven it with my own hands and I have brought it so that you may wear it." The Prophet (ﷺ) accepted it, and at that time he was in need of it. So he came out wearing it as his waist-sheet. A man praised it and said, "Will you give it to me? How nice it is!" The other people said, "You have not done the right thing as the Prophet (ﷺ) is in need of it and you have asked for it when you know that he never turns down anybody's request." The man replied, "By Allah, I have not asked for it to wear it but to make it my shroud." Later it was his shroud
hi: Sahl (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek aurat ek buni hui Burda (chadar) jisme kinaari thi, Nabi ke paas laayi. (Rawi ne, Sahl se pucha kya unhe pata hai Burda kya hoti hai, unhone haan mein jawab diya ke Burda ek chogha hoti hai, aur Sahl ne is jawab ki tasdeeq ki.) Phir aurat ne kaha: "Maine ise apne haathon se bunaa hai aur main laayi hoon taake aap ise pehnen." Nabi ne ise qubool kiya, aur us waqt Aap ko iski zaroorat thi. To Aap ise apna Izar banakar pehne hue bahar aaye. Ek shaks ne iski tareef ki aur kaha: "Kya aap mujhe yeh de sakte hain? Yeh kitni achhi hai!" Doosre logon ne kaha: "Tumne achha nahi kiya, Nabi ko iski zaroorat thi aur tumne yeh maang liya jabke tumhe pata hai Aap kabhi kisi ki darkhwast wapas nahi karte." Shaks ne jawab diya: "Allah ki qasam, maine ise pehnne ke liye nahi maanga, balki apna kafan banane ke liye." Baad mein woh usi ka kafan bana.

e: Narrated Um 'Atiyya:We were forbidden to accompany funeral processions but not strictly
hi: Um Atiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Humein janazon ke saath jaane se mana kiya gaya tha, magar sakhti se nahi.

e: Narrated Muhammad bin Seereen:One of the sons of Um 'Atiyya died, and when it was the third day she asked for a yellow perfume and put it over her body, and said, "We were forbidden to mourn for more than three days except for our husbands
hi: Muhammad bin Seereen bataate hain: Um Atiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke ek bete ka intiqal hua, aur jab teesra din hua unhone peeli khushbu mangwai aur apne badan par lagayi, aur kaha: "Humein shohar ke ilawa kisi doosre ke liye teen din se zyada sog manaane se mana kiya gaya tha."

e: Narrated Zainab bint Abi Salama:When the news of the death of Abu Sufyan reached from Sham, Um Habiba on the third day, asked for a yellow perfume and scented her cheeks and forearms and said, "No doubt, I would not have been in need of this, had I not heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying: "It is not legal for a woman who believes in Allah and the Last Day to mourn for more than three days for any dead person except her husband, for whom she should mourn for four months and ten days
hi: Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Abi Salama bataati hain: Jab Sham se Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki maut ki khabar aayi, Um Habiba ne teesre din peeli khushbu mangwai aur apne gaalon aur baazuoon par lagayi, aur kaha: "Beshak mujhe iski zaroorat na hoti, agar maine Nabi ko yeh farmate na suna hota: 'Jo aurat Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par iman rakhti hai, uske liye kisi bhi murda ke liye teen din se zyada sog manaana jaiz nahi, siwaye apne shohar ke, jiske liye woh chaar mahine das din sog manaaye.'"

e: Narrated Zainab bint Abi Salama:I went to Um Habiba, the wife of Prophet, who said, "I heard the Prophets saying, 'It is not legal for a woman who believes in Allah and the Last Day to mourn for any dead person for more than three days except for her husband, (for whom she should mourn) for four months and ten days'." Later I went to Zainab bint Jahsh when her brother died; she asked for some scent, and after using it she said, "I am not in need of scent but I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, 'It is not legal for a woman who believes in Allah and the Last Day to mourn for more than three days for any dead person except her husband, (for whom she should mourn) for four months and ten days
hi: Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Abi Salama bataati hain: Main Um Habiba (Nabi ki biwi) ke paas gayi, unhone kaha: "Maine Nabi ko farmate suna: 'Jo aurat Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par iman rakhti hai, uske liye kisi bhi murda ke liye teen din se zyada sog manaana jaiz nahi, siwaye apne shohar ke, (jiske liye woh) chaar mahine das din sog manaaye.'" Baad mein main Zainab bint Jahsh (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas gayi jab unke bhai ka intiqal hua; unhone kuch khushbu mangwai, aur istemal karne ke baad kaha: "Mujhe khushbu ki zaroorat nahi thi magar maine Allah ke Rasool ko farmate suna: 'Jo aurat Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par iman rakhti hai, uske liye kisi bhi murda ke liye teen din se zyada sog manaana jaiz nahi, siwaye apne shohar ke, (jiske liye woh) chaar mahine das din sog manaaye.'"

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) passed by a woman who was weeping beside a grave. He told her to fear Allah and be patient. She said to him, "Go away, for you have not been afflicted with a calamity like mine." And she did not recognize him. Then she was informed that he was the Prophet (ﷺ) . so she went to the house of the Prophet (ﷺ) and there she did not find any guard. Then she said to him, "I did not recognize you." He said, "Verily, the patience is at the first stroke of a calamity
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ek qabar ke paas se guzre jahan ek aurat ro rahi thi. Aap ne usse Allah se darne aur sabr karne ko kaha. Usne kaha: "Chale jaao, tumpar meri jaisi museebat nahi aayi." Aur usne Aap ko pehchana nahi. Phir usse bataya gaya ke woh Nabi the, isliye woh Nabi ke ghar gayi aur wahan koi darban nahi mila. Usne kaha: "Maine aapko pehchana nahi tha." Aap ne farmaya: "Asli sabr museebat ki pehli chot par hota hai."

e: Narrated Usama bin Zaid:The daughter of the Prophet (ﷺ) sent (a messenger) to the Prophet (ﷺ) requesting him to come as her child was dying (or was gasping), but the Prophet (ﷺ) returned the messenger and told him to convey his greeting to her and say: "Whatever Allah takes is for Him and whatever He gives, is for Him, and everything with Him has a limited fixed term (in this world) and so she should be patient and hope for Allah's reward." She again sent for him, swearing that he should come. The Prophet (ﷺ) got up, and so did Sa`d bin 'Ubada, Mu`adh bin Jabal, Ubai bin Ka`b, Zaid bin Thabit and some other men. The child was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while his breath was disturbed in his chest (the sub-narrator thinks that Usama added: ) as if it was a leather water-skin. On that the eyes of the Prophet (ﷺ) started shedding tears. Sa`d said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What is this?" He replied, "It is mercy which Allah has lodged in the hearts of His slaves, and Allah is merciful only to those of His slaves who are merciful (to others)
hi: Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ki beti ne (ek qasid ke zariye) Nabi ko bulwaya kyunke uska bachcha marne wala tha (ya saans le rahi thi). Nabi ne qasid ko wapas bhej diya aur kehne ko kaha: "Jo Allah leta hai woh usi ka hai, aur jo woh deta hai woh bhi usi ka hai, aur uske paas har cheez ki (is duniya mein) muddat muqarrar hai, isliye woh sabr kare aur Allah ke ajr ki ummeed rakhe." Usne dobara qasam de kar bulwaya ke Nabi zaroor aayein. Nabi uthe aur unke saath Sa'd bin Ubada (رضی اللہ عنہ), Mu'adh bin Jabal (رضی اللہ عنہ), Ubai bin Ka'b (رضی اللہ عنہ), Zaid bin Thabit (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur kuch aur log bhi gaye. Bachche ko Allah ke Rasool ke paas laaya gaya jabke uska saans seene mein tez chal raha tha (rawi ka khayaal hai ke Usama ne joda: jaise woh ek chamde ka mashkiza ho). Yeh dekh kar Nabi ki aankhon se aansu behne lage. Sa'd ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Yeh kya hai?" Aap ne jawab diya: "Yeh rehmat hai jo Allah ne apne bandon ke dilon mein rakhi hai, aur Allah sirf un bandon par reham karta hai jo (doosron par) reham karte hain."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:We were (in the funeral procession) of one of the daughters of the Prophet (ﷺ) and he was sitting by the side of the grave. I saw his eyes shedding tears. He said, "Is there anyone among you who did not have sexual relations with his wife last night?" Abu Talha replied in the affirmative. And so the Prophet told him to get down in the grave. And so he got down in her grave
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Nabi ki ek beti ke janaze mein the aur Aap qabar ke kinare baithe the. Maine unki aankhon se aansu behte dekhe. Aap ne pucha: "Kya tum mein koi hai jisne kal raat apni biwi se humbistari na ki ho?" Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne haan mein jawab diya. To Nabi ne unhe qabar mein utarne ko kaha, aur woh unki (marhooma ki) qabar mein utar gaye.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin 'Ubaidullah bin Abi Mulaika:One of the daughters of `Uthman died at Mecca. We went to attend her funeral procession. Ibn `Umar and Ibn `Abbas were also present. I sat in between them (or said, I sat beside one of them. Then a man came and sat beside me.) `Abdullah bin `Umar said to `Amr bin `Uthman, "Will you not prohibit crying as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has said, 'The dead person is tortured by the crying of his relatives.?" Ibn `Abbas said, "`Umar used to say so." Then he added narrating, "I accompanied `Umar on a journey from Mecca till we reached Al-Baida. There he saw some travelers in the shade of a Samura (A kind of forest tree). He said (to me), "Go and see who those travelers are." So I went and saw that one of them was Suhaib. I told this to `Umar who then asked me to call him. So I went back to Suhaib and said to him, "Depart and follow the chief of the faithful believers." Later, when `Umar was stabbed, Suhaib came in weeping and saying, "O my brother, O my friend!" (on this `Umar said to him, "O Suhaib! Are you weeping for me while the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The dead person is punished by some of the weeping of his relatives?" Ibn `Abbas added, "When `Umar died I told all this to Aisha and she said, 'May Allah be merciful to `Umar. By Allah, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not say that a believer is punished by the weeping of his relatives. But he said, Allah increases the punishment of a non-believer because of the weeping of his relatives." Aisha further added, "The Qur'an is sufficient for you (to clear up this point) as Allah has stated: 'No burdened soul will bear another's burden.' " (35.18). Ibn `Abbas then said, "Only Allah makes one laugh or cry." Ibn `Umar did not say anything after that
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ubaidullah bin Abi Mulaika bataate hain: Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki ek beti ka Mecca mein intiqal hua. Hum unke janaze mein shareek hone gaye. Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bhi maujood the. Main unke beech mein baitha (ya kaha, unme se ek ke bagal mein baitha; phir ek shaks aakar mere bagal mein baith gaya). Abdullah bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Amr bin Uthman se kaha: "Kya aap rone ko mana nahi karenge, jabke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: 'Marhoom ko uske rishtedaron ke rone se azaab hota hai'?" Ibn Abbas ne kaha: "Umar aisa kaha karte the." Phir unhone bataya: "Main Umar ke saath ek safar mein Mecca se Al-Baida tak gaya. Wahan unhone kuch musafiron ko Samura (ek jangli darakht) ke saaye mein dekha. Unhone (mujhse) kaha: 'Jaao dekho yeh musafir kaun hain.' Main gaya aur dekha unme se ek Suhaib (رضی اللہ عنہ) the. Maine Umar ko bataya, unhone mujhse unhe bulane ko kaha. Main Suhaib ke paas wapas gaya aur kaha: 'Chaliye, Ameer-ul-Momineen ke saath jaayein.' Baad mein, jab Umar ko chhura mara gaya, Suhaib rote hue andar aaye aur keh rahe the: 'Aye mere bhai, aye mere dost!' Isspar Umar ne unse kaha: 'Aye Suhaib! Kya tum mere liye ro rahe ho jabke Nabi ne farmaya tha: Marhoom ko uske rishtedaron ke kuch rone se saza hoti hai?'" Ibn Abbas ne aage kaha: "Jab Umar ka intiqal hua, maine yeh sab Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko bataya, unhone kaha: 'Allah Umar par reham kare. Allah ki qasam, Allah ke Rasool ne yeh nahi kaha tha ke momin ko uske rishtedaron ke rone se saza hoti hai. Balki Aap ne farmaya tha ke Allah kaafir ki saza uske rishtedaron ke rone ki wajah se badhata hai.'" Ayesha ne yeh bhi joda: "Tumhare liye Quran hi kaafi hai (is baat ko samjhne ke liye), kyunke Allah ne farmaya hai: 'Koi bojh uthane wala doosre ka bojh nahi uthaega' (35:18)." Ibn Abbas ne phir kaha: "Sirf Allah hansataa hai aur rulataa hai." Ibn Umar ne iske baad kuch nahi kaha.

e: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) passed by (the grave of) a Jewess whose relatives were weeping over her. He said, "They are weeping over her and she is being tortured in her grave
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki biwi) bataati hain: Ek baar Allah ke Rasool ek Yahudi aurat (ki qabar) ke paas se guzre jiske rishtedaar uspar ro rahe the. Aap ne farmaya: "Yeh log usspar ro rahe hain jabke woh apni qabar mein azaab mein hai."

e: Narrated Abu Burda:That his father said, "When `Umar was stabbed, Suhaib started crying: O my brother! `Umar said, 'Don't you know that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: The deceased is tortured for the weeping of the living'?
hi: Abu Burda bataate hain, apne waalid ke hawale se: Jab Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko chhura mara gaya, Suhaib (رضی اللہ عنہ) rone lage: "Aye mere bhai!" Umar ne kaha: "Kya tumhe nahi pata ke Nabi ne farmaya: Marhoom ko zinda logon ke rone se saza hoti hai?"

e: Narrated Al-Mughira:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Ascribing false things to me is not like ascribing false things to anyone else. Whosoever tells a lie against me intentionally then surely let him occupy his seat in Hell-Fire." I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "The deceased who is wailed over is tortured for that wailing
hi: Al-Mughira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi ko farmate suna: "Mujh par jhoot bandhna kisi aur par jhoot bandhne jaisa nahi hai. Jo bhi jaan-boojh kar mujh par jhoot bandhe, use zaroor Dozakh mein apni jagah samajh leni chahiye." Maine Nabi ko yeh bhi farmate suna: "Jis marhoom par wailawa (rona-dhona) hota hai, use us wailawe ki wajah se saza milti hai."

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar from his father: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The deceased is tortured in his grave for the wailing done over him." Narrated Shu'ba: The deceased is tortured for the wailing of the living ones over him
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain, apne waalid ke hawale se: Nabi ne farmaya: "Marhoom ko uski qabar mein uspar hue wailawe ki wajah se saza hoti hai." Shu'ba bataate hain: "Marhoom ko zinda logon ke uspar wailawa karne ki wajah se saza hoti hai."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:On the day of the Battle of Uhud, my father was brought and he had been mutilated (in battle) and was placed in front of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and a sheet was over him. I went intending to uncover my father but my people forbade me; again I wanted to uncover him but my people forbade me. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave his order and he was shifted away. At that time he heard the voice of a crying woman and asked, "Who is this?" They said, "It is the daughter or the sister of `Amr." He said, "Why does she weep? (or let her stop weeping), for the angels had been shading him with their wings till he (i.e. the body of the martyr) was shifted away
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Uhud ki jung ke din, mere waalid ko laaya gaya, unka jism kaat-daala gaya tha, aur unhe Allah ke Rasool ke saamne rakha gaya, ek chadar unpar dali hui thi. Main apne waalid ka chehra khol na chahta tha magar mere log ne roka; maine phir chaha magar phir roka gaya. Allah ke Rasool ne hukum diya aur unhe hataya gaya. Us waqt Aap ne ek rone wali aurat ki awaaz suni aur pucha: "Yeh kaun hai?" Logon ne kaha: "Yeh Amr ki beti ya behn hai." Aap ne farmaya: "Woh kyun ro rahi hai? (ya use rone do), kyunke farishte hamesha apne paron se unhe (shaheed ke jism ko) saaya kar rahe the yahan tak ke woh (shaheed ka jism) hataya gaya."

e: Narrated `Abdullah:the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who slaps his cheeks, tears his clothes and follows the ways and traditions of the Days of Ignorance is not one of us
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jo apne gaal peete, kapde phaade, aur jahiliyat ke zamane ke tareeqon ki pairvi kare, woh humme se nahi."

e: Narrated 'Amir bin Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas:That his father said, "In the year of the last Hajj of the Prophet (ﷺ) I became seriously ill and the Prophet (ﷺ) used to visit me inquiring about my health. I told him, 'I am reduced to this state because of illness and I am wealthy and have no inheritors except a daughter, (In this narration the name of 'Amir bin Sa`d is mentioned and in fact it is a mistake; the narrator is `Aisha bint Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas). Should I give two-thirds of my property in charity?' He said, 'No.' I asked, 'Half?' He said, 'No.' then he added, 'One-third, and even one-third is much. You'd better leave your inheritors wealthy rather than leaving them poor, begging others. You will get a reward for whatever you spend for Allah's sake, even for what you put in your wife's mouth.' I said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Will I be left alone after my companions have gone?' He said, 'If you are left behind, whatever good deeds you will do will upgrade you and raise you high. And perhaps you will have a long life so that some people will be benefited by you while others will be harmed by you. O Allah! Complete the emigration of my companions and do not turn them renegades.' But Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) felt sorry for poor Sa`d bin Khaula as he died in Mecca." (but Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas lived long after the Prophet (ﷺ)
hi: Amir bin Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (رضی اللہ عنہ), apne waalid ke hawale se: Nabi ke aakhri Hajj ke saal, main sakht bimar ho gaya aur Nabi meri tabiyat poochhne aate rahe. Maine unse kaha: "Main is haal mein hoon bimari ki wajah se, aur main maldaar hoon, aur mere siwa koi waaris nahi siwaye ek beti ke (is riwayat mein Amir bin Sa'd ka naam galti se aaya hai, asal mein raawi Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas hain). Kya main apna do-tihai maal sadqa kar dun?" Aap ne kaha: "Nahi." Maine pucha: "Aadha?" Aap ne kaha: "Nahi." Phir farmaya: "Ek-tihai, aur ek-tihai bhi bahut hai. Apne waarison ko maldaar chhodna behtar hai bajaye is ke ke woh gareeb ho kar logon se maangte phirein. Tum jo bhi Allah ki raah mein kharch karoge, uska ajr milega, chahe woh ek lukma ho jo tum apni biwi ke mun mein daalo." Maine kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Kya mere sathiyon ke jaane ke baad main akela reh jaunga?" Aap ne farmaya: "Agar tum peeche reh gaye, to tum jo bhi neik amal karoge, tumhara darja badhega aur tumhe oonchaai milegi. Aur shayad tumhari lambi umr ho jisse kuch log faida uthaayenge aur kuch nuqsaan. Aye Allah! Mere sathiyon ki hijrat mukammal kar de aur unhe (deen se) mud-ne wala mat bana." Magar Allah ke Rasool ko gareeb Sa'd bin Khaula ke liye afsos hua kyunke unka Mecca mein intiqal hua tha. (Magar Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas khud Nabi ke baad bahut lambi zindagi jiye.)

e: Narrated Abu Burda bin Abi Musa:Abu Musa got seriously ill, fainted and could not reply to his wife while he was lying with his head in her lap. When he came to his senses, he said, "I am innocent of those, of whom Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was innocent. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) is innocent of a woman who cries aloud (or slaps her face) who shaves her head and who tear off her clothes (on the falling of a calamity)
hi: Abu Burda bin Abi Musa bataate hain: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) sakht bimar hue, behosh ho gaye aur apni biwi ko jawab na de sake jabke unka sar unki godi mein tha. Jab hosh mein aaye, unhone kaha: "Main un logon se bezaar hoon jinse Allah ke Rasool bezaar the. Allah ke Rasool us aurat se bezaar the jo (museebat par) chilla kar roti hai (ya apna chehra peetti hai), jo apna sar mundwati hai, aur jo apne kapde phaadti hai."

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who slaps the cheeks, tears the clothes and follows the tradition of the Days of Ignorance is not from us
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jo apne gaal peete, kapde phaadte, aur jahiliyat ke zamane ke tareeqon ki pairvi kare, woh humme se nahi."

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who slaps the cheeks, tears the clothes and follows the traditions of the Days of Ignorance is not from us
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jo apne gaal peete, kapde phaade, aur jahiliyat ke zamane ke tareeqon ki pairvi kare, woh humme se nahi."

e: Narrated `Aisha:When the Prophet (ﷺ) got the news of the death of Ibn Haritha, Ja`far and Ibn Rawaha he sat down and looked sad and I was looking at him through the chink of the door. A man came and told him about the crying of the women of Ja`far. The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered him to forbid them. The man went and came back saying that he had told them but they did not listen to him. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Forbid them." So again he went and came back for the third time and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! By Allah, they did not listen to us at all." (`Aisha added): Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered him to go and put dust in their mouths. I said, (to that man) "May Allah stick your nose in the dust (i.e. humiliate you)! You could neither (persuade the women to) fulfill the order of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) nor did you relieve Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) from fatigue
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab Nabi ko Ibn Haritha, Jafar aur Ibn Rawaha ki maut ki khabar mili, Aap baith gaye aur udaas nazar aaye, aur main darwaze ki dararon se unhe dekh rahi thi. Ek shaks aaya aur Jafar ki aurton ke rone ke baare mein bataya. Nabi ne use unhe rokne ka hukum diya. Woh shaks gaya aur wapas aakar kaha ke usne unhe kaha magar unhone uski baat nahi maani. Nabi ne kaha: "Unhe roko." Phir woh phir gaya aur teesri baar wapas aakar kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Allah ki qasam, unhone humari koi baat nahi maani." (Ayesha ne joda:) Allah ke Rasool ne use hukum diya jaakar unke munh mein mitti daale. Maine kaha: "Allah tumhari naak mitti mein rakhe (yaani tumhein zaleel kare)! Na to tum Allah ke Rasool ke hukum ko poora kar sake, na Allah ke Rasool ko takleef se bacha sake."

e: Narrated Anas:When the reciters of Qur'an were martyred, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) recited Qunut for one month and I never saw him (i.e. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)) so sad as he was on that day
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Quran ke qari (hafiz) shaheed hue, Allah ke Rasool ne ek mahine tak Qunut padhi, aur maine unhe us din se zyada udaas kabhi nahi dekha.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:One of the sons of Abu Talha became sick and died and Abu Talha at that time was not at home. When his wife saw that he was dead, she prepared him (washed and shrouded him) and placed him somewhere in the house. When Abu Talha came, he asked, "How is the boy?" She said, "The child is quiet and I hope he is in peace." Abu Talha thought that she had spoken the truth. Abu Talha passed the night and in the morning took a bath and when he intended to go out, she told him that his son had died, Abu Talha offered the (morning) prayer with the Prophet (ﷺ) and informed the Prophet (ﷺ) of what happened to them. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "May Allah bless you concerning your night. (That is, may Allah bless you with good offspring)." Sufyan said, "One of the Ansar said, 'They (i.e. Abu Talha and his wife) had nine sons and all of them became reciters of the Qur'an (by heart)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke ek bete bimar hue aur intiqal kar gaye, us waqt Abu Talha ghar par nahi the. Jab unki biwi ne dekha woh mar chuka hai, unhone use taiyaar kiya (ghusl-kafan) aur ghar mein kahin rakh diya. Jab Abu Talha aaye, unhone pucha: "Bacha kaisa hai?" Usne kaha: "Bacha khamosh hai aur mujhe ummeed hai woh aaraam se hai." Abu Talha ne socha usne sach kaha hai. Abu Talha ne raat guzari aur subah ghusl kiya, aur jab bahar jaane ka iraada kiya, usne unhe bataya ke unka beta mar chuka hai. Abu Talha ne Nabi ke saath Fajr ki namaz padhi aur unhe apne saath jo hua bataya. Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Allah tumhari raat mein barkat de" (yaani Allah tumhe achhi aulad se nawaze). Sufyan ne kaha: "Ansaar mein se kisi ne kaha: 'Unke (Abu Talha aur unki biwi ke) nau bete hue aur sab Quran ke Hafiz bane.'"

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The real patience is at the first stroke of a calamity
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Asli sabr museebat ki pehli chot par hota hai."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:We went with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to the blacksmith Abu Saif, and he was the husband of the wet-nurse of Ibrahim (the son of the Prophet). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took Ibrahim and kissed him and smelled him and later we entered Abu Saif's house and at that time Ibrahim was in his last breaths, and the eyes of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) started shedding tears. `Abdur Rahman bin `Auf said, "O Allah's Apostle, even you are weeping!" He said, "O Ibn `Auf, this is mercy." Then he wept more and said, "The eyes are shedding tears and the heart is grieved, and we will not say except what pleases our Lord, O Ibrahim ! Indeed we are grieved by your separation
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Allah ke Rasool ke saath lohar Abu Saif ke paas gaye, jo Nabi ke bete Ibrahim ki dai maa ke shohar the. Allah ke Rasool ne Ibrahim ko liya, bosa diya, sungha, aur baad mein hum Abu Saif ke ghar mein daakhil hue jabke Ibrahim apni aakhri saans le rahe the, aur Allah ke Rasool ki aankhon se aansu behne lage. Abdur-Rahman bin Auf ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool, aap bhi ro rahe hain!" Aap ne farmaya: "Aye Ibn Auf, yeh rehmat hai." Phir Aap aur zyada roye aur kaha: "Aankhein aansu bahati hain aur dil gham mein hai, aur hum sirf woh kahenge jo hamare Rab ko pasand aaye. Aye Ibrahim! Beshak tumhari judaai se hume gham hai."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Sa`d bin 'Ubada became sick and the Prophet (ﷺ) along with `Abdur Rahman bin `Auf, Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas and `Abdullah bin Mas`ud visited him to inquire about his health. When he came to him, he found him surrounded by his household and he asked, "Has he died?" They said, "No, O Allah's Apostle." The Prophet (ﷺ) wept and when the people saw the weeping of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) they all wept. He said, "Will you listen? Allah does not punish for shedding tears, nor for the grief of the heart but he punishes or bestows His Mercy because of this." He pointed to his tongue and added, "The deceased is punished for the wailing of his relatives over him." `Umar used to beat with a stick and throw stones and put dust over the faces (of those who used to wail over the dead)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Sa'd bin Ubada (رضی اللہ عنہ) bimar hue aur Nabi, Abdur-Rahman bin Auf, Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Abdullah bin Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath unki tabiyat poochhne gaye. Jab Aap unke paas pahunche, unhe apne ghar walon se ghire paaya aur pucha: "Kya unka intiqal ho gaya?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi, Ya Allah ke Rasool." Nabi rone lage, aur jab logon ne Allah ke Rasool ko rote dekha, sab rone lage. Aap ne farmaya: "Kya tum sunte nahi? Allah aansu bahane par ya dil ke gham par saza nahi deta, balki isse (zubaan se) saza deta hai ya reham karta hai," aur apni zubaan ki taraf ishara karke joda: "Marhoom ko uske rishtedaron ke wailawe se saza hoti hai." Umar (marhoom par) wailawa karne walon ko chhadi se maarte aur patthar phenkte aur unke chehron par mitti daalte the.

e: Narrated Aisha:When the news of the martyrdom of Zaid bin Haritha, Ja`far and `Abdullah bin Rawaha came, the Prophet sat down looking sad, and I was looking through the chink of the door. A man came and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! The women of Ja`far," and then he mentioned their crying . The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered him to stop them from crying. The man went and came back and said, "I tried to stop them but they disobeyed." The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered him for the second time to forbid them. He went again and came back and said, "They did not listen to me, (or "us": the sub-narrator Muhammad bin Haushab is in doubt as to which is right). " (`Aisha added: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Put dust in their mouths." I said (to that man), "May Allah stick your nose in the dust (i.e. humiliate you)." By Allah, you could not (stop the women from crying) to fulfill the order, besides you did not relieve Allah's Apostle from fatigue
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab Zaid bin Haritha, Jafar aur Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Rawaha ki shahadat ki khabar aayi, Nabi baith gaye aur udaas dikhne lage, aur main darwaze ki daraar se dekh rahi thi. Ek shaks aaya aur kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Jafar ki aurtein," aur unke rone ka zikar kiya. Nabi ne use unhe rokne ka hukum diya. Woh shaks gaya aur wapas aakar kaha: "Maine unhe rokne ki koshish ki magar unhone meri baat nahi maani." Nabi ne dobara unhe rokne ka hukum diya. Woh phir gaya aur wapas aakar kaha: "Unhone meri (ya humari, raawi Muhammad bin Haushab ko yaqeen nahi kaunsa sahi hai) baat nahi maani." (Ayesha ne joda:) Nabi ne kaha: "Unke muh mein mitti daalo." Maine (us shaks se) kaha: "Allah tumhari naak mitti mein rakhe." Allah ki qasam, tum na (aurton ko rokne ka) hukum poora kar sake, na Allah ke Rasool ko takleef se bacha sake.

e: Narrated Um 'Atiyya:At the time of giving the pledge of allegiance to the Prophet (ﷺ) one of the conditions was that we would not wail, but it was not fulfilled except by five women and they are Um Sulaim, Um Al-`Ala', the daughter of Abi Sabra (the wife of Mu`adh), and two other women; or the daughter of Abi Sabra and the wife of Mu`adh and another woman
hi: Um Atiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi se bai'at karte waqt, ek shart yeh thi ke hum wailawa nahi karenge, magar sirf paanch aurton ne isse poora kiya: Um Sulaim, Um Al-Ala, Abi Sabra ki beti (Mu'adh ki biwi), aur do doosri aurtein; ya Abi Sabra ki beti, Mu'adh ki biwi, aur ek aur aurat.

e: Narrated 'Amir bin Rabi`a:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whenever you see a funeral procession, stand up till the procession goes ahead of you." Al-Humaidi added, "Till the coffin leaves you behind or is put down
hi: Amir bin Rabia (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jab bhi tum janaza dekho, khade ho jao jab tak woh tumse aage nikal jaaye." Al-Humaidi ne joda: "Ya jab tak taboot rakha na jaaye."

e: Narrated 'Amir bin Rabi`a:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If any one of you sees a funeral procession and he is not going along with it, then he should stand and remain standing till he gets behind it, or it leaves him behind, or the coffin is put down before it goes ahead of him
hi: Amir bin Rabia (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Agar tum mein se koi janaza dekhe aur uske saath na ja raha ho, to use khada ho jaana chahiye aur khada rehna chahiye jab tak woh uske peechhe na aa jaaye, ya woh usse aage nikal jaaye, ya taboot rakh na diya jaaye isse pehle ke woh aage badhe."

e: Narrated Sa`id Al-Maqburi:That his father said, "While we were accompanying a funeral procession, Abu Huraira got hold of the hand of Marwan and they sat down before the coffin was put down. Then Abu Sa`id came and took hold of Marwan's hand and said, "Get up. By Allah, no doubt this (i.e. Abu Huraira) knows that the Prophet forbade us to do that." Abu Huraira said, "He (Abu Sa`id) has spoken the truth
hi: Sa'id Al-Maqburi bataate hain, apne waalid ke hawale se: Ek baar hum ek janaze mein the, Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Marwan ka haath pakda aur woh taboot rakhe jaane se pehle hi baith gaye. Phir Abu Saeed aaye aur Marwan ka haath pakad kar kaha: "Utho. Allah ki qasam, isse (yaani Abu Huraira ko) pata hai ke Nabi ne humein aisa karne se mana kiya tha." Abu Huraira ne kaha: "Unhone (Abu Saeed ne) sach kaha."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When you see a funeral procession, you should stand up, and whoever accompanies it should not sit till the coffin is put down
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jab tum janaza dekho, khade ho jao, aur jo uske saath jaaye woh (taboot) rakhe jaane tak baithe nahi."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:A funeral procession passed in front of us and the Prophet (ﷺ) stood up and we too stood up. We said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! This is the funeral procession of a Jew." He said, "Whenever you see a funeral procession, you should stand up
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek janaza humare saamne se guzra aur Nabi khade ho gaye aur hum bhi khade ho gaye. Humne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Yeh to ek Yahudi ka janaza hai." Aap ne farmaya: "Jab bhi tum janaza dekho, khade ho jao."

e: Narrated `Abdur Rahman bin Abi Laila:Sahl bin Hunaif and Qais bin Sa`d were sitting in the city of Al-Qadisiya. A funeral procession passed in front of them and they stood up. They were told that funeral procession was of one of the inhabitants of the land i.e. of a non-believer, under the protection of Muslims. They said, "A funeral procession passed in front of the Prophet (ﷺ) and he stood up. When he was told that it was the coffin of a Jew, he said, "Is it not a living being (soul)?
hi: Abdur Rahman bin Abi Laila bataate hain: Sahl bin Hunaif aur Qais bin Sa'd Al-Qadisiya shehar mein baithe the. Ek janaza unke saamne se guzra aur woh khade ho gaye. Unhe bataya gaya ke woh janaza ilaqe ke ek bashinde ka hai, yaani ek ghair-Musalman ka jo Musalmanon ki panah mein tha. Unhone kaha: "Ek janaza Nabi ke saamne se guzra tha aur Aap khade ho gaye the. Jab unhe bataya gaya ke yeh ek Yahudi ka taboot hai, Aap ne farmaya: 'Kya woh (bhi) ek zinda rooh nahi thi?'"

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, When the funeral is ready and the men carry it on their shoulders, if the deceased was righteous it will say, 'Present me (hurriedly),' and if he was not righteous, it will say, 'Woe to it (me)! Where are they taking it (me)?' Its voice is heard by everything except man and if he heard it he would fall unconscious
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jab janaza taiyaar hoti hai aur log ise apne shoulders par utha kar le jaate hain, agar marhoom neik tha, woh kehta hai: 'Mujhe jaldi pahunchao,' aur agar neik nahi tha, woh kehta hai: 'Haaye afsos! Yeh mujhe kahan le jaa rahe hain?' Uski awaaz har cheez sunti hai siwaye insaan ke aur agar woh sun le to behosh ho jaaye."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Hurry up with the dead body for if it was righteous, you are forwarding it to welfare; and if it was otherwise, then you are putting off an evil thing down your necks
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Murda jism ke saath jaldi karo, agar woh neik tha, to tum use jald bhalaai ki taraf bhej rahe ho; aur agar aisa nahi tha, to tum ek buri cheez ko apni gardanon se jald utaar rahe ho."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When a funeral is ready and the men carry the deceased on their necks (shoulders), if it was pious then it will say, 'Present me quickly', and if it was not pious, then it will say, 'Woe to it (me), where are they taking it (me)?' And its voice is heard by everything except mankind and if he heard it he would fall unconscious
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jab janaza taiyaar hoti hai aur log marhoom ko apni gardanon (shoulders) par utha kar le jaate hain, agar woh neik tha, woh kehta hai: 'Mujhe jaldi pahunchao,' aur agar neik nahi tha, woh kehta hai: 'Haaye afsos, yeh mujhe kahan le jaa rahe hain?' Aur uski awaaz har cheez sunti hai siwaye insaan ke, aur agar insaan sun le to behosh ho jaaye."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) offered the funeral prayer for An-Najashi and I was in the second or third row
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne An-Najashi ki namaz-e-janaza padhai aur main doosri ya teesri saf mein tha.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) informed his companions about the death of An-Najashi and then he went ahead (to lead the prayer) and the people lined up behind him in rows and he said four Takbir
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne apne sahaba ko An-Najashi ki maut ki khabar di, phir aage badhkar (imamat ki), log unke peechhe safon mein khade hue, aur Aap ne chaar Takbirein kahin.

e: Narrated Ash-Shaibani:Ash-Shu`bi said, "I was informed by a man who had seen the Prophet (ﷺ) going to a grave that was separate from the other graves and he aligned the people in rows and said four Takbir." I said, "O Abu `Amr! who narrated (that) to you"? He said, "Ibn `Abbas
hi: Ash-Shaibani bataate hain: Ash-Shu'bi ne kaha: "Mujhe ek shaks ne bataya jisne Nabi ko dekha tha ek aisi qabar ki taraf jate huye jo baaki qabron se alag thi, aur unhone logon ki safein banayi aur chaar Takbirein kahin." Maine pucha: "Aye Abu Amr! Yeh aapko kisne bataya?" Unhone kaha: "Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ)."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Today a pious man from Ethiopia (i.e. An Najashi) has expired, come on to offer the funeral prayer." (Jabir said): We lined up in rows and after that the Prophet (ﷺ) led the prayer and we were in rows. Jabir added, I was in the second row
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Aaj Ethiopia ka ek neik shaks (yaani An-Najashi) intiqal kar gaya hai, aao unki namaz-e-janaza padhein." (Jabir ne kaha:) Humne safein bana lin, aur uske baad Nabi ne imamat ki aur hum safon mein the. Jabir ne joda: "Main doosri saf mein tha."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) passed by a grave of a deceased who had been buried at night. He said, "When was this (deceased) buried?" The people said, "Yesterday." He said, "Why did you not inform me?" They said, "We buried him when it was dark and so we disliked to wake you up." He stood up and we lined up behind him. (Ibn `Abbas said): I was one of them, and the Prophet (ﷺ) offered the funeral prayer
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ek marhoom ki qabar ke paas se guzre jisse raat ko dafn kiya gaya tha. Aap ne pucha: "Ise kab dafn kiya gaya?" Logon ne kaha: "Kal." Aap ne pucha: "Tumne mujhe kyun nahi bataya?" Unhone kaha: "Hum andhere mein dafn kar rahe the isliye humein aapko jagana napasand hua." Aap khade hue aur hum unke peechhe safon mein khade ho gaye. (Ibn Abbas ne kaha:) Main bhi unme se tha, aur Nabi ne namaz-e-janaza padhi.

e: Narrated Ash-Shaibani:Ash-Shu`bi said, "Somebody who passed along with your Prophet (ﷺ) by a grave that was separate from the other graves informed me (saying), "The Prophet (ﷺ) led us (in the prayer) and we aligned behind him." We said, "O Abu `Amr! Who told you this narration?" He replied, "Ibn `Abbas
hi: Ash-Shaibani bataate hain: Ash-Shu'bi ne kaha: "Jo shaks tumhare Nabi ke saath ek aisi qabar ke paas se guzra jo baaki qabron se alag thi, usne mujhe bataya: 'Nabi ne humari imamat ki aur hum unke peechhe safon mein khade hue.'" Humne pucha: "Aye Abu Amr! Yeh riwayat aapko kisne bataai?" Unhone jawab diya: "Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ)."

e: Narrated Nafi`:Ibn `Umar was told that Abu Huraira said, "Whoever accompanies the funeral procession will have a reward equal to one Qirat." Ibn `Umar said, "Abu Huraira talks of a too enormous reward." Aisha attested Abu Huraira's narration and said, "I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying like that." Ibn `Umar said, "We have lost numerous Qirats
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko bataya gaya ke Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Jo bhi janaze ke saath jaaye, use ek Qirat ke barabar ajr milega." Ibn Umar ne kaha: "Abu Huraira bahut bade ajr ki baat karte hain." Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne Abu Huraira ki riwayat ki tasdeeq karte huye kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool ko yehi farmate suna." Ibn Umar ne kaha: "Hum ne bahut se Qirat kho diye hain."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever attends the funeral procession till he offers the funeral prayer for it, will get a reward equal to one Qirat, and whoever accompanies it till burial, will get a reward equal to two Qirats." It was asked, "What are two Qirats?" He replied, "Like two huge mountains
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jo bhi janaze mein hazir ho yahan tak ke namaz-e-janaza padh le, use ek Qirat ke barabar ajr milega, aur jo dafn tak saath rahe, use do Qirat ke barabar ajr milega." Poocha gaya: "Do Qirat kya hain?" Aap ne jawab diya: "Do bade pahadon jitne."

e: Narrated 'Amir:Ibn `Abbas (who was at that time a boy) said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to a grave and the people said, 'He or she was buried yesterday.' " Ibn `Abbas added, "We aligned behind the Prophet (ﷺ) and he led the funeral prayer of the deceased
hi: Amir bataate hain: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) (jo us waqt ek ladka tha) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool ek qabar ke paas aaye aur logon ne kaha: 'Woh (mard ya aurat) kal dafn kiya gaya tha.'" Ibn Abbas ne joda: "Humne Nabi ke peechhe safein banayi aur Aap ne marhoom ki namaz-e-janaza padhai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) informed about the news of the death of An-Najash (King of Ethiopia) on the day he expired. He said, "Ask Allah's forgiveness for your brother. " Narrated Abu Huraira: The Prophet (ﷺ) made them align in rows at the Musalla and said four Takbir
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne usi din An-Najash (Ethiopia ke hukmaran) ki maut ki khabar di jis din unka intiqal hua. Aap ne farmaya: "Apne bhai ke liye Allah se maafi maango." Abu Huraira bataate hain: Nabi ne unhe Musalla mein safon mein khada kiya aur chaar Takbirein kahin.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The Jew brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) a man and a woman from amongst them who had committed (adultery) illegal sexual intercourse. He ordered both of them to be stoned (to death), near the place of offering the funeral prayers beside the mosque
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Yahudi Nabi ke paas apne mein se ek mard aur ek aurat le aaye jinhone zina kiya tha. Aap ne dono ko masjid ke paas, namaz-e-janaza padhi jane ki jagah ke qareeb, sangsaar (pathrao) karne ka hukum diya.

e: Narrated `Urwa:Aisha said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) in his fatal illness said, 'Allah cursed the Jews and the Christians because they took the graves of their Prophets as places for praying."' Aisha added, "Had it not been for that, the grave of the Prophet (ﷺ) would have been made prominent but I am afraid it might be taken (as a) place for praying
hi: Urwa bataate hain: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha: "Nabi ne apni aakhri bimari mein farmaya: 'Allah ne Yahudiyon aur Isaiyon par laanat ki, kyunke unhone apne Nabiyon ki qabron ko namaz padhne ki jagah bana liya.'" Ayesha ne joda: "Agar yeh na hota, Nabi ki qabar ko bhi khula (prominent) banaya jaata, magar mujhe dar hai isse (namaz padhne ki) jagah na bana liya jaaye."

e: Narrated Samura bin Jundab:I offered the funeral prayer behind the Prophet (ﷺ) for a woman who had died during childbirth and he stood up by the middle of the coffin
hi: Samura bin Jundub (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi ke peechhe ek aurat ki namaz-e-janaza padhi jiski maut bachche ki paidaish ke waqt hui thi, aur Aap taboot ke beech mein khade hue.

e: Narrated Samura bin Jundab:I offered the funeral prayer behind the Prophet (ﷺ) for a woman who had died during childbirth and he stood up by the middle of the coffin
hi: Samura bin Jundub (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi ke peechhe ek aurat ki namaz-e-janaza padhi jiski maut bachche ki paidaish ke waqt hui thi, aur Aap taboot ke beech mein khade hue.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) informed about the news of the death of An-Najash on the day he died. He went out with us to the Musalla and we aligned in rows and he said four Takbirs for An-Najashi's funeral prayer
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne usi din An-Najash ki maut ki khabar di jis din unka intiqal hua. Aap humare saath Musalla gaye aur humne safein banayin, aur Aap ne An-Najashi ki namaz-e-janaza ke liye chaar Takbirein kahin.

e: Narrated Jabir:The Prophet (ﷺ) offered the funeral prayer of As-Hama An-Najash and said four Takbir
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne As-Hama An-Najashi ki namaz-e-janaza padhi aur chaar Takbirein kahin.

e: Narrated Talha bin `Abdullah bin `Auf:I offered the funeral prayer behind Ibn `Abbas and he recited Al-Fatiha and said, "You should know that it (i.e. recitation of Al-Fatiha) is the tradition of the Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ)
hi: Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Auf bataate hain: Maine Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke peechhe namaz-e-janaza padhi, unhone Al-Fatiha padhi aur kaha: "Tumhe pata hona chahiye ke yeh (Al-Fatiha padhna) Nabi Muhammad ki Sunnat hai."

e: Narrated Sulaiman Ash-Shaibani:I heard Ash-Shu`bi saying, "I was told by a man who had passed with the Prophet (ﷺ) by a grave that was separate from the other graves that he (the Prophet (ﷺ) ) led them in the prayer and they prayed behind him." I said, "O Abu `Amr! Who narrated that to you?" He replied, "Ibn `Abbas
hi: Sulaiman Ash-Shaibani bataate hain: Maine Ash-Shu'bi ko kehte suna: "Mujhe ek shaks ne bataya jo Nabi ke saath ek aisi qabar ke paas se guzra tha jo baaki qabron se alag thi, ke Aap ne unki imamat ki aur woh unke peechhe padhe." Maine pucha: "Aye Abu Amr! Yeh aapko kisne bataya?" Unhone jawab diya: "Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ)."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:A black person, a male or a female used to clean the Mosque and then died. The Prophet (ﷺ) did not know about it . One day the Prophet (ﷺ) remembered him and said, "What happened to that person?" The people replied, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! He died." He said, "Why did you not inform me?" They said, "His story was so and so (i.e. regarded him as insignificant)." He said, "Show me his grave." He then went to his grave and offered the funeral prayer
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek kaale (mard ya aurat) masjid saaf kiya karta tha aur intiqal kar gaya. Nabi ko iska pata nahi tha. Ek din Nabi ko unki yaad aayi aur pucha: "Us shaks ka kya hua?" Logon ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Unka intiqal ho gaya." Aap ne pucha: "Tumne mujhe kyun nahi bataya?" Unhone kaha: "Unki kahani aisi-aisi thi (yaani unhe ahmiyat nahi di)." Aap ne farmaya: "Mujhe unki qabar dikhao." Aap unki qabar par gaye aur namaz-e-janaza padhi.

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When a human being is laid in his grave and his companions return and he even hears their foot steps, two angels come to him and make him sit and ask him: What did you use to say about this man, Muhammad ? He will say: I testify that he is Allah's slave and His Apostle. Then it will be said to him, 'Look at your place in the Hell-Fire. Allah has given you a place in Paradise instead of it.' " The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "The dead person will see both his places. But a non-believer or a hypocrite will say to the angels, 'I do not know, but I used to say what the people used to say! It will be said to him, 'Neither did you know nor did you take the guidance (by reciting the Qur'an).' Then he will be hit with an iron hammer between his two ears, and he will cry and that cry will be heard by whatever approaches him except human beings and jinns
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jab insaan ko qabar mein rakha jaata hai aur uske saathi wapas laut jate hain, aur woh unke qadmon ki awaaz tak sunta hai, do farishte uske paas aakar use baithate hain aur poochhte hain: 'Tum is shaks, yaani Muhammad, ke baare mein kya kehte the?' Woh kahega: 'Main gawahi deta hoon ke woh Allah ke banda aur Rasool hain.' Phir usse kaha jaayega: 'Apni jagah Dozakh mein dekho. Allah ne uski jagah Jannat mein tumhe di hai.'" Nabi ne joda: "Marhoom apni dono jagahein dekhega. Magar kaafir ya munafiq farishton se kahega: 'Mujhe nahi pata, main sirf woh kehta tha jo log kehte the!' Usse kaha jaayega: 'Na tumhe pata tha na tumne (Quran padh kar) hidayat li.' Phir use lohe ke hathode se dono kaanon ke beech maara jaayega, aur woh chillaega, aur uski chilLahat insaano aur jinnon ke siwa har cheez sunegi jo uske paas se guzre."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The angel of death was sent to Moses and when he went to him, Moses slapped him severely, spoiling one of his eyes. The angel went back to his Lord, and said, "You sent me to a slave who does not want to die." Allah restored his eye and said, "Go back and tell him (i.e. Moses) to place his hand over the back of an ox, for he will be allowed to live for a number of years equal to the number of hairs coming under his hand." (So the angel came to him and told him the same). Then Moses asked, "O my Lord! What will be then?" He said, "Death will be then." He said, "(Let it be) now." He asked Allah that He bring him near the Sacred Land at a distance of a stone's throw. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Were I there I would show you the grave of Moses by the way near the red sand hill
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maut ka farishta Musa (علیہ السلام) ke paas bheja gaya, jab woh unke paas gaya, Musa ne use zor se ek thappad maara jisse uski ek aankh phoot gayi. Farishta apne Rab ke paas wapas gaya aur kaha: "Tune mujhe aise bande ke paas bheja jo marna nahi chahta." Allah ne uski aankh theek kar di aur kaha: "Wapas jaao aur usse (Musa se) kaho apna haath ek bail ki pusht par rakhe, kyunke usse jitne baal uske haath ke neeche aayenge, utne saal ki umr use di jayegi." Musa ne pucha: "Aye mere Rab! Phir kya hoga?" Allah ne kaha: "Phir maut hogi." Musa ne kaha: "(To yeh) abhi ho jaaye." Unhone Allah se dua ki ke unhe Baitul-Muqaddas ke qareeb, ek patthar ke phenkne ki doori par, le jaaye. Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Agar main wahan hota, to main tumhe unki qabar dikhata, raaste mein, laal reti ke tibbe ke qareeb."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) offered the funeral prayer of a man one night after he was buried, he and his companions stood up (for the Prayer). He had asked them about him before standing, saying, "Who is this?" They said, "He is so and so and was buried last night." So all of them offered the funeral prayer
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne ek shaks ki namaz-e-janaza padhi ek raat unhe dafn karne ke baad, Aap aur unke sahaba khade hue (namaz ke liye). Aap ne khade hone se pehle unke baare mein poocha: "Yeh kaun hai?" Unhone kaha: "Falaan, aur pichhli raat dafn kiya gaya." To sab ne namaz-e-janaza padhi.

e: Narrated `Aisha:When the Prophet (ﷺ) became ill, some of his wives talked about a church which they had seen in Ethiopia and it was called Mariya. Um Salma and Um Habiba had been to Ethiopia, and both of them narrated its (the Church's) beauty and the pictures it contained. The Prophet (ﷺ) raised his head and said, "Those are the people who, whenever a pious man dies amongst them, make a place of worship at his grave and then they make those pictures in it. Those are the worst creatures in the Sight of Allah
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab Nabi bimar hue, unki kuch biwiyon ne ek girje ka zikar kiya jo unhone Ethiopia mein dekha tha aur uska naam Mariya tha. Um Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) aur Um Habiba Ethiopia gayi thin, aur donon ne uski khoobsurati aur usme maujood tasveeron ka zikar kiya. Nabi ne apna sar uthaya aur farmaya: "Yeh woh log hain, jab bhi unme koi neik shaks intiqal karta, uski qabar par ibadatgah banate aur usme yeh tasveerein banate. Yeh Allah ke nazdeek badtareen makhlooq hain."

e: Narrated Anas:We were in the funeral procession of the daughter of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was sitting near the grave and I saw his eyes full of tears. He said, "Is there anyone amongst you who did not have sexual relations with his wife last night?" Abu Talha replied in the affirmative. And so Allah's Apostle told him to get down in her grave and he got down in her grave and buried her
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Allah ke Rasool ki beti ke janaze mein the aur Allah ke Rasool qabar ke qareeb baithe the, aur maine unki aankhon mein aansu bhare dekhe. Aap ne pucha: "Kya tum mein koi hai jisne kal raat apni biwi se humbistari na ki ho?" Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne haan mein jawab diya. To Allah ke Rasool ne unhe unki (marhooma ki) qabar mein utarne ko kaha, aur woh unki qabar mein utar kar unhe dafn karne lage.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) collected every two martyrs of Uhud in one piece of cloth, then he would ask, "Which of them had (knew) more of the Qur'an?" When one of them was pointed out for him, he would put that one first in the grave and say, "I will be a witness on these on the Day of Resurrection." He ordered them to be buried with their blood on their bodies and they were neither washed nor was a funeral prayer offered for them
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Uhud ke har do shaheedon ko ek kapde mein jama kiya, phir puchte: "Inme se kisko Quran zyada aata tha?" Jab ek ko ishara kiya jaata, Aap use pehle qabar mein rakhte aur kehte: "Main Qiyamat ke din inpar gawah hoonga." Aap ne hukum diya ke unhe unke khoon samet dafn kiya jaaye, aur na unhe dhoya gaya na unki namaz-e-janaza padhi gayi.

e: Narrated `Uqba bin 'Amir:One day the Prophet (ﷺ) went out and offered the funeral prayers of the martyrs of Uhud and then went up the pulpit and said, "I will pave the way for you as your predecessor and will be a witness on you. By Allah! I see my Fount (Kauthar) just now and I have been given the keys of all the treasures of the earth (or the keys of the earth). By Allah! I am not afraid that you will worship others along with Allah after my death, but I am afraid that you will fight with one another for the worldly things
hi: Uqba bin Amir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek din Nabi bahar gaye aur Uhud ke shaheedon ki namaz-e-janaza padhi, phir mimbar par chadhe aur farmaya: "Main tumhare aage-aage raasta banaunga jaise tumhara pehla (paishrau) tha, aur tumpar gawah hoonga. Allah ki qasam! Main abhi apna Haud (Kauthar) dekh raha hoon, aur mujhe zameen ke sab khazanon ki chaabiyaan (ya zameen ki chaabiyaan) di gayi hain. Allah ki qasam! Mujhe dar nahi ke tum mere baad Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek karoge, magar mujhe dar hai ke tum duniyawi cheezon ke liye aapas mein lad-jhagdo ge."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) buried every two martyrs in of Uhud in one grave
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Uhud ke har do shaheedon ko ek hi qabar mein dafn kiya.

e: Narrated Jabir:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Bury them (i.e. martyrs) with their blood." (that was) On the day of the Battle of Uhud. He did not get them washed
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Inhe (yaani shaheedon ko) unke khoon samet dafn karo" — yeh Uhud ki jung ke din hua. Aap ne unhe dhulwaya nahi.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) shrouded every two martyrs of Uhud in one piece of cloth and then he would ask, "Which of them knew more Qur'an?"
