When one of them was pointed out he would put him first in the grave. He said, "I am a witness on these." Then he ordered them to be buried with blood on their bodies. Neither did he offer their funeral prayer nor did he get them washed. (Jabir bin `Abdullah added): Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to ask about the martyrs of Uhud as to which of them knew more of the Qur'an." And when one of them was pointed out as having more of it he would put him first in the grave and then his companions. (Jabir added): My father and my uncle were shrouded in one sheet
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Uhud ke har do shaheedon ko ek kapde mein kafan diya, phir puchte: "Inme se kisko Quran zyada aata tha?" Jab ek ko ishara kiya jaata, Aap use pehle Lahd (qabar ka andar wala hissa) mein rakhte. Aap ne kaha: "Main inpar gawah hoon." Phir hukum diya ke unhe unke khoon samet dafn kiya jaaye, aur na unki namaz-e-janaza padhi gayi na unhe dhoya gaya. (Jabir bin Abdullah ne joda:) Allah ke Rasool Uhud ke shaheedon ke baare mein poochte the ke inme se kisko Quran zyada aata hai, aur jise zyada bataya jaata, use pehle Lahd mein rakhte, phir uske sathiyon ko. (Jabir ne joda:) Mere waalid aur mere chacha ek hi chadar mein kafan diye gaye.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah has made Mecca a sanctuary (sacred place) and it was a sanctuary before me and will be so after me. It was made legal for me (to fight in it) for a few hours of the day. None is allowed to uproot its thorny shrubs or to cut its trees or to chase its game or to pick up its fallen things except by a person who announces it publicly." On that Al-Abbas said (to the Prophet), "Except Al- Idhkhir for our goldsmiths and for our graves." And so the Prophet (ﷺ) added, "Except Al-Idhkhir. " And Abu Huraira narrated that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Except Al-Idhkhir for our graves and houses." And Ibn `Abbas said, "For their goldsmiths and houses
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Allah ne Mecca ko haram (muqaddas jagah) banaya, aur yeh mujhse pehle bhi haram thi aur mere baad bhi rahegi. Yeh mere liye din ke kuch ghanton ke liye halal ki gayi thi (yaani sirf ek din ke liye jang ki ijazat mili). Kisi ko isse (yani Mecca se) kaante-daar jhaadiyan ukhadane, darakht kaatne, uske jaanwaron ka shikaar karne, ya uski gum-shuda cheezein uthane ki ijazat nahi, siwaye woh shaks jo isse aam elaan kare." Isspar Abbas ne (Nabi se) kaha: "Siwaye Idhkhir ke, humare sunaron aur humari qabron ke liye." Isliye Nabi ne joda: "Siwaye Idhkhir ke." Aur Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne bataya ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Siwaye Idhkhir ke, humari qabron aur gharon ke liye." Aur Ibn Abbas ne kaha: "Unke sunaron aur gharon ke liye."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to `Abdullah bin Ubai (a hypocrite) after his death and he had been laid in his pit (grave). He ordered (that he be taken out of the grave) and he was taken out. Then he placed him on his knees and threw some of his saliva on him and clothed him in his (the Prophet's) own shirt. Allah knows better (why he did so). `Abdullah bin Ubai had given his shirt to Al-Abbas to wear. Abu Harun said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) at that time had two shirts and the son of `Abdullah bin Ubai said to him, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Clothe my father in your shirt which has been in contact with your skin.' ' Sufyan added, "Thus people think that the Prophet (ﷺ) clothed `Abdullah bin Ubai in his shirt in lieu of what he (Abdullah) had done (for Al-`Abbas, the Prophet's uncle)
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool Abdullah bin Ubai (ek munafiq) ke paas unki maut ke baad gaye, jabke unhe unki qabar mein rakha ja chuka tha. Aap ne (unhe qabar se bahar nikaalne ka) hukum diya aur unhe bahar nikaala gaya. Phir Aap ne unhe apne ghutnon par rakha aur unpar apna thook chhidka, aur unhe apni qamees pehnayi. Allah behtar jaanta hai (kyun aisa kiya). Abdullah bin Ubai ne apni qamees Abbas ko pehnne ke liye di thi. Abu Harun bataate hain: Us waqt Allah ke Rasool ke paas do qamiseen thin, aur Abdullah bin Ubai ke bete ne unse kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Mere baap ko apni woh qamees pehna dijiye jo aapki jild se laga chuki hai." Sufyan ne joda: "Isliye log samajhte hain ke Nabi ne Abdullah bin Ubai ko apni qamees usne (Al-Abbas, Nabi ke chacha, ke liye) jo kiya tha uske badle mein pehnayi."

e: Narrated Jabir:When the time of the Battle of Uhud approached, my father called me at night and said, "I think that I will be the first amongst the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) to be martyred. I do not leave anyone after me dearer to me than you, except Allah's Messenger's (ﷺ) soul and I owe some debt and you should repay it and treat your sisters favorably (nicely and politely)." So in the morning he was the first to be martyred and was buried along with another (martyr). I did not like to leave him with the other (martyr) so I took him out of the grave after six months of his burial and he was in the same condition as he was on the day of burial, except a slight change near his ear
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Uhud ki jung ka waqt qareeb aaya, mere waalid ne mujhe raat ko bulaya aur kaha: "Mujhe lagta hai main Nabi ke sahaba mein sabse pehle shaheed hounga. Main tumse zyada kisi ko pyara nahi chhodta, siwaye Allah ke Rasool ki jaan ke, aur mujh par kuch qarz hai jo tumhe chukana chahiye, aur apni behnon se achha suluk rakhna." Subah woh sabse pehle shaheed hue aur unhe kisi doosre (shaheed) ke saath dafn kiya gaya. Mujhe unhe kisi aur ke saath chhodnaa pasand nahi tha, isliye maine unhe chhe mahine baad qabar se nikaala aur woh usi haalat mein the jaise dafn ke din, siwaye unke kaan ke qareeb thodi si tabdeeli.

e: Narrated Jabir:A man was buried along with my father and I did not like it till I took him (i.e. my father) out and buried him in a separate grave
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks mere waalid ke saath dafn kiya gaya tha, aur mujhe yeh napasand tha, yahan tak ke maine unhe (mere waalid ko) bahar nikaala aur unhe alag qabar mein dafn kiya.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) collected every two martyrs of Uhud (in one grave) and then he would ask, "Which of them knew the Qur'an more?" And if one of them was pointed out for him as having more knowledge, he would put him first in the Lahd. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I will be a witness on these on the Day of Resurrection." Then he ordered them to be buried with their blood on their bodies and he did not have them washed
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Uhud ke har do shaheedon ko (ek qabar mein) jama kiya, phir puchte: "Inme se kisko Quran zyada aata tha?" Jab ek ko zyada bataya jaata, Aap use Lahd mein pehle rakhte. Nabi ne farmaya: "Main Qiyamat ke din inpar gawah hoonga." Phir hukum diya ke unhe unke khoon samet dafn kiya jaaye, aur unhe dhulwaya nahi.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:`Umar set out along with the Prophet (ﷺ) with a group of people to Ibn Saiyad till they saw him playing with the boys near the hillocks of Bani Mughala. Ibn Saiyad at that time was nearing his puberty and did not notice (us) until the Prophet (ﷺ) stroked him with his hand and said to him, "Do you testify that I am Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" Ibn Saiyad looked at him and said, "I testify that you are the Messenger of illiterates." Then Ibn Saiyad asked the Prophet (ﷺ), "Do you testify that I am Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" The Prophet (ﷺ) refuted it and said, "I believe in Allah and His Apostles." Then he said (to Ibn Saiyad), "What do you think?" Ibn Saiyad answered, "True people and liars visit me." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You have been confused as to this matter." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "I have kept something (in my mind) for you, (can you tell me that?)" Ibn Saiyad said, "It is Al-Dukh (the smoke)." (2) The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Let you be in ignominy. You cannot cross your limits." On that `Umar, said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Allow me to chop his head off." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If he is he (i.e. Dajjal), then you cannot overpower him, and if he is not, then there is no use of murdering him." (Ibn `Umar added): Later on Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) once again went along with Ubai bin Ka`b to the date-palm trees (garden) where Ibn Saiyad was staying. The Prophet (ﷺ) wanted to hear something from Ibn Saiyad before Ibn Saiyad could see him, and the Prophet (ﷺ) saw him lying covered with a sheet and from where his murmurs were heard. Ibn Saiyad's mother saw Allah's Apostle while he was hiding himself behind the trunks of the date-palm trees. She addressed Ibn Saiyad, "O Saf ! (and this was the name of Ibn Saiyad) Here is Muhammad." And with that Ibn Saiyad got up. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Had this woman left him (Had she not disturbed him), then Ibn Saiyad would have revealed the reality of his case
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Umar Nabi ke saath kuch logon ke saath Ibn Saiyad ke paas nikle yahan tak ke unhone use Bani Mughala ke tibbon ke qareeb bacchon ke saath khelte dekha. Ibn Saiyad us waqt balig hone ke qareeb tha aur usne (humein) tab tak notice nahi kiya jab tak Nabi ne apne haath se use chhua aur usse kaha: "Kya tum gawahi dete ho ke main Allah ka Rasool hoon?" Ibn Saiyad ne unhe dekha aur kaha: "Main gawahi deta hoon ke aap un-padhon ke Rasool hain." Phir Ibn Saiyad ne Nabi se pucha: "Kya aap gawahi dete hain ke main Allah ka Rasool hoon?" Nabi ne is baat ka inkaar kiya aur kaha: "Main Allah aur uske Rasoolon par iman rakhta hoon." Phir Aap ne (Ibn Saiyad se) pucha: "Tumhe kya lagta hai?" Ibn Saiyad ne jawab diya: "Sachche aur jhoote log mere paas aate hain." Nabi ne kaha: "Tum is maamle mein confuse ho gaye ho." Phir Nabi ne usse kaha: "Maine tumhare liye (apne zehen mein) kuch chhupaya hai (kya tum bata sakte ho)?" Ibn Saiyad ne kaha: "Yeh Al-Dukh hai (yaani dhuan)." Nabi ne kaha: "Tum zaleel ho jao. Tum apni hadd paar nahi kar sakte." Isspar Umar ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe ijazat dein main iska sar kaat dun." Nabi ne farmaya: "Agar yeh wahi (Dajjal) hai, to tum isse kabhi ghalba nahi paoge, aur agar yeh woh nahi hai, to ise qatl karne ka koi fayda nahi." (Ibn Umar ne joda:) Baad mein Allah ke Rasool ek baar phir Ubai bin Ka'b (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath khajoor ke darakhton (bagiche) ki taraf gaye jahan Ibn Saiyad thehra hua tha. Nabi Ibn Saiyad se kuch sunna chahte the isse pehle ke Ibn Saiyad unhe dekh sake, aur Nabi ne use ek chadar mein lipta hua leta dekha jahan se uski bud-bud awaazein aa rahi thi. Ibn Saiyad ki maa ne Allah ke Rasool ko dekha jabke Aap khajoor ke tanon ke peechhe chhupe hue the. Usne Ibn Saiyad se kaha: "Aye Saf! (yeh Ibn Saiyad ka naam tha) Yeh Muhammad hain." Isi ke saath Ibn Saiyad uth gaya. Nabi ne farmaya: "Agar yeh aurat use na chhedati (na disturb karti), to Ibn Saiyad apni asliyat zahir kar deta."

e: Narrated Anas:A young Jewish boy used to serve the Prophet (ﷺ) and he became sick. So the Prophet (ﷺ) went to visit him. He sat near his head and asked him to embrace Islam. The boy looked at his father, who was sitting there; the latter told him to obey Abul-Qasim and the boy embraced Islam. The Prophet (ﷺ) came out saying: "Praises be to Allah Who saved the boy from the Hell-fire
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek jawan Yahudi ladka Nabi ki khidmat karta tha aur bimar ho gaya. To Nabi unse milne gaye. Aap unke sar ke paas baithe aur unhe Islam qubool karne ko kaha. Ladke ne apne waalid ki taraf dekha, jo wahin baithe the, aur unhone use Abul-Qasim (Nabi) ki baat maanne ko kaha, aur ladke ne Islam qubool kar liya. Nabi bahar aakar keh rahe the: "Allah ki hamd ho jisne is ladke ko Dozakh ki aag se bacha liya."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:My mother and I were among the weak and oppressed. I from among the children, and my mother from among the women
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Meri maa aur main kamzor aur mazloom logon mein se the — main bachchon mein se, aur meri maa aurton mein se.

e: Narrated Ibn Shihab:The funeral prayer should be offered for every child even if he were the son of a prostitute as he was born with a true faith of Islam (i.e. to worship none but Allah Alone). If his parents are Muslims, particularly the father, even if his mother were a non-Muslim, and if he after the delivery cries (even once) before his death (i.e. born alive) then the funeral prayer must be offered. And if the child does not cry after his delivery (i.e. born dead) then his funeral prayer should not be offered, and he will be considered as a miscarriage. Abu Huraira, narrated that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Every child is born with a true faith (i.e. to worship none but Allah Alone) but his parents convert him to Judaism or to Christianity or to Magianism, as an animal delivers a perfect baby animal. Do you find it mutilated?" Then Abu Huraira recited the holy verses: 'The pure Allah's Islamic nature (true faith i.e. to worship none but Allah Alone), with which He has created human beings
hi: Ibn Shihab bataate hain: Har bachche ki namaz-e-janaza padhi jaani chahiye, chahe woh ek fahisha aurat ka beta ho, kyunke woh Islam ke sacche iman (yaani sirf Allah ki ibadat) ke saath paida hota hai. Agar uske maa-baap Musalman hain, khaas kar baap, chahe maa ghair-Musalman ho, aur agar woh paidaish ke baad (chahe ek baar bhi) roye us se pehle ke woh mare (yaani zinda paida ho), tab uski namaz-e-janaza zaroor padhi jaani chahiye. Aur agar bachcha paidaish ke baad na roya (yaani murda paida hua), to uski namaz-e-janaza nahi padhi jaayegi, aur usse miscarriage samjha jaayega. Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne riwayat ki ke Nabi ne farmaya: "Har bachcha sacche iman ke saath paida hota hai, magar uske maa-baap use Yahudi, Isaai ya Majoosi bana dete hain, jaise koi janwar poora bachcha janamta hai. Kya tumhe usme koi kami dikhti hai?" Phir Abu Huraira ne yeh paak ayaat padhi: "Allah ki paak fitrat (asli deen, yaani sirf Allah ki ibadat), jispar usne insaano ko paida kiya."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Every child is born with a true faith of Islam (i.e. to worship none but Allah Alone) but his parents convert him to Judaism, Christianity or Magianism, as an animal delivers a perfect baby animal. Do you find it mutilated?" Then Abu Huraira recited the holy verses: "The pure Allah's Islamic nature (true faith of Islam) (i.e. worshipping none but Allah) with which He has created human beings. No change let there be in the religion of Allah (i.e. joining none in worship with Allah). That is the straight religion (Islam) but most of men know, not
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Har bachcha Islam ke sacche iman ke saath paida hota hai (yaani sirf Allah ki ibadat), magar uske maa-baap use Yahudi, Isaai ya Majoosi bana dete hain, jaise koi janwar poora bachcha janamta hai. Kya tumhe usme koi kami dikhti hai?" Phir Abu Huraira ne yeh paak ayaat padhi: "Allah ki paak fitrat (Islam ka sachcha iman) (yaani sirf Allah ki ibadat) jispar usne insaano ko paida kiya. Allah ke deen mein koi tabdeeli na ho (yaani Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek na karna). Yehi seedha deen (Islam) hai, magar zyada tar log jaante nahi."

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Al-Musaiyab from his father:When the time of the death of Abu Talib approached, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went to him and found Abu Jahl bin Hisham and `Abdullah bin Abi Umaiya bin Al-Mughira by his side. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to Abu Talib, "O uncle! Say: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah, a sentence with which I shall be a witness (i.e. argue) for you before Allah. Abu Jahl and `Abdullah bin Abi Umaiya said, "O Abu Talib! Are you going to denounce the religion of `Abdul Muttalib?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) kept on inviting Abu Talib to say it (i.e. 'None has the right to be worshipped but Allah') while they (Abu Jahl and `Abdullah) kept on repeating their statement till Abu Talib said as his last statement that he was on the religion of `Abdul Muttalib and refused to say, 'None has the right to be worshipped but Allah.' (Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I will keep on asking Allah's forgiveness for you unless I am forbidden (by Allah) to do so." So Allah revealed (the verse) concerning him (i.e. It is not fitting for the Prophet (ﷺ) and those who believe that they should invoke (Allah) for forgiveness for pagans even though they be of kin, after it has become clear to them that they are companions of the fire
hi: Sa'id bin Al-Musaiyab, apne waalid ke hawale se: Jab Abu Talib ki maut ka waqt qareeb aaya, Allah ke Rasool unke paas gaye aur wahan Abu Jahl bin Hisham aur Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Umaiya bin Al-Mughira ko unke paas paaya. Allah ke Rasool ne Abu Talib se kaha: "Aye chacha! Kaho: Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahi, ek aisa kalma jiske zariye main Allah ke saamne aapki (janib se) gawahi dunga." Abu Jahl aur Abdullah bin Abi Umaiya ne kaha: "Aye Abu Talib! Kya aap Abdul Muttalib ke deen ko chhodne wale hain?" Allah ke Rasool ise (yaani 'Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahi') kehne ki dawat dete rahe, jabke woh (Abu Jahl aur Abdullah) apni baat dohrate rahe, yahan tak ke Abu Talib ne apni aakhri baat mein kaha ke woh Abdul Muttalib ke deen par hain, aur 'Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahi' kehne se inkaar kiya. Phir Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Main aapke liye Allah se maafi maangta rahunga jab tak mujhe (Allah ki taraf se) mana na kiya jaaye." To Allah ne unke baare mein (ayat) nazil ki: "Nabi (ﷺ) aur momino ke liye jaiz nahi ke woh mushrikon ke liye maafi maangen, chahe woh rishtedaar hi kyun na hon, jabke unhe pata chal chuka hai ke woh Dozakh wale hain."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) once passed by two graves, and those two persons (in the graves) were being tortured. He said, "They are being tortured not for a great thing (to avoid). One of them never saved himself from being soiled with his urine, while the other went about committing slander (to make enmity between friends). He then took a green leaf of a date-palm tree split it into two pieces and fixed one on each grave. The people said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Why have you done so?" He replied, "I hope that their punishment may be lessened till they (the leaf) become dry
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ek baar do qabron ke paas se guzre, aur unme (dafn) do log azaab mein the. Aap ne farmaya: "Unhe kisi badi baat (se bachne mein kotahi) ke liye azaab nahi ho raha. Ek apne peshab se khud ko bachataa nahi tha, aur doosra chughli khataa tha (dosto ke darmiyan dushmani paida karne ke liye)." Phir Aap ne khajoor ke ek hare patte ko liya, use do tukdon mein baanta aur har qabar par ek tukda gaad diya. Logon ne pucha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Aapne aisa kyun kiya?" Aap ne jawab diya: "Mujhe ummeed hai ke unka azaab kam ho jaaye jab tak yeh (patte) sukh na jaayein."

e: Narrated `Ali:" We were accompanying a funeral procession in Baqi-I-Gharqad. The Prophet (ﷺ) came to us and sat and we sat around him. He had a small stick in his hand then he bent his head and started scraping the ground with it. He then said, "There is none among you, and not a created soul, but has place either in Paradise or in Hell assigned for him and it is also determined for him whether he will be among the blessed or wretched." A man said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Should we not depend on what has been written for us and leave the deeds as whoever amongst us is blessed will do the deeds of a blessed person and whoever amongst us will be wretched, will do the deeds of a wretched person?" The Prophet said, "The good deeds are made easy for the blessed, and bad deeds are made easy for the wretched." Then he recited the Verses:-- "As for him who gives (in charity) and is Allah-fearing And believes in the Best reward from Allah
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Hum Baqi-al-Gharqad mein ek janaze mein the. Nabi humare paas aaye aur baith gaye, hum bhi unke aas-paas baith gaye. Unke haath mein ek chhoti chhadi thi, phir unhone apna sar jhukaya aur zameen khurachne lage. Phir farmaya: "Tum mein se koi bhi, aur koi bhi paida ki hui rooh, aisi nahi jiske liye Jannat ya Dozakh mein jagah muqarrar na ki gayi ho, aur yeh bhi tay ho chuka hai ke woh khush-naseeb hoga ya badnaseeb." Ek shaks ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! To kya hum sirf apne liye jo likha ja chuka hai uspar bharosa karke amal chhod dein, kyunke jo khush-naseeb hoga woh khush-naseebon ke kaam karega, aur jo badnaseeb hoga woh badnaseebon ke kaam karega?" Nabi ne farmaya: "Khush-naseeb ke liye neik kaam asaan kar diye jaate hain, aur badnaseeb ke liye bure kaam asaan kar diye jaate hain." Phir Aap ne yeh ayaat padhi: "Jo (sadqa mein) deta hai aur Allah se darta hai, aur behtareen (Jannat ke) ajr par iman rakhta hai..."

e: Narrated Thabit bin Ad-Dahhak:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever intentionally swears falsely by a religion other than Islam, then he is what he has said, (e.g. if he says, 'If such thing is not true then I am a Jew,' he is really a Jew). And whoever commits suicide with piece of iron will be punished with the same piece of iron in the Hell Fire." Narrated Jundab the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A man was inflicted with wounds and he committed suicide, and so Allah said: My slave has caused death on himself hurriedly, so I forbid Paradise for him
hi: Thabit bin Ad-Dahhak bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jo bhi jaan-boojh kar Islam ke ilawa kisi doosre deen ki jhoothi qasam khaye (yaani kahe: 'Agar yeh sach nahi, to main Yahudi hoon'), woh waqai woh ban jaata hai jo usne kaha. Aur jo koi lohe ke tukde se khudkushi kare, use Dozakh mein usi tukde se saza di jaayegi." Jundab bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Ek shaks zakhmi hua aur usne khudkushi kar li, isliye Allah ne farmaya: 'Mere bande ne jaldi se apni maut khud ko de di, isliye main uspar Jannat haram karta hoon.'"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira-:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who commits suicide by throttling shall keep on throttling himself in the Hell Fire (forever) and he who commits suicide by stabbing himself shall keep on stabbing himself in the Hell-Fire
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jo gala ghont kar khudkushi kare, woh Dozakh mein hamesha apna gala ghontta rahega, aur jo chhura maar kar khudkushi kare, woh Dozakh mein hamesha khud ko chhura maarta rahega."

e: Narrated `Umar bin Al-Khattab:When `Abdullah bin Ubai bin Salul died, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was called upon to offer his funeral prayer. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up to offer the prayer, I got up quickly and said, "O Allah's Apostle! Are you going to pray for Ibn Ubai and he said so and so on such and such occasions?" And started mentioning all that he had said. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) smiled and said, "O `Umar! Go away from me." When I talked too much he said, "I have been given the choice and so I have chosen (to offer the prayer). Had I known that he would be forgiven by asking for Allah's forgiveness for more than seventy times, surely I would have done so." (`Umar added): Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) offered his funeral prayer and returned and after a short while the two verses of Surat Bara' were revealed: i.e. "And never (O Muhammad) pray for any of them who dies . . . (to the end of the verse) rebellion (9.84)" -- (`Umar added), "Later I was astonished at my daring before Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on that day. And Allah and His Apostle know better
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Khattab (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ubai bin Salul ka intiqal hua, Allah ke Rasool ko unki namaz-e-janaza padhne ke liye bulwaya gaya. Jab Allah ke Rasool namaz ke liye khade hue, main jaldi se uthkar kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Kya aap Ibn Ubai ke liye dua karenge jabke usne aisa-aisa (bura) kaha tha falaan-falaan mauqon par?" aur maine unki kahi hui sab baaton ka zikar kiya. Allah ke Rasool muskuraye aur kaha: "Aye Umar! Mujhse door ho jao." Jab maine zyada baat ki, Aap ne farmaya: "Mujhe ikhtiyar diya gaya hai, isliye maine (namaz padhne ko) chuna. Agar mujhe pata hota ke sattar se zyada baar maafi maangne se woh maaf ho jaayenge, to zaroor karta." (Umar ne joda:) Allah ke Rasool ne unki namaz-e-janaza padhi aur wapas aaye, aur thodi der baad Surah Bara'a ki do ayaat nazil hui: "Aur (Aye Muhammad) kabhi in mein se kisi ki bhi (janaze ki) namaz na padhna jo mar jaaye... (aakhri hisse tak) baghawat" (9:84). (Umar ne joda:) "Baad mein mujhe us din Allah ke Rasool ke saamne apni himmat par hairat hui. Aur Allah aur uske Rasool behtar jaante hain."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:A funeral procession passed and the people praised the deceased. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It has been affirmed to him." Then another funeral procession passed and the people spoke badly of the deceased. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It has been affirmed to him". `Umar bin Al-Khattab asked (Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ), "What has been affirmed?" He replied, "You praised this, so Paradise has been affirmed to him; and you spoke badly of this, so Hell has been affirmed to him. You people are Allah's witnesses on earth
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek janaza guzra aur logon ne marhoom ki tareef ki. Nabi ne farmaya: "Uske liye (Jannat) tay ho gayi." Phir doosra janaza guzra aur logon ne marhoom ki buraai ki. Nabi ne farmaya: "Uske liye (Dozakh) tay ho gayi." Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Khattab (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne pucha: "Kya tay ho gaya?" Aap ne jawab diya: "Tumne is (pehle) ki tareef ki, isliye uske liye Jannat tay ho gayi; aur tumne is (doosre) ki buraai ki, isliye uske liye Dozakh tay ho gayi. Tum zameen par Allah ke gawah ho."

e: Narrated Abu Al-Aswad:I came to Medina when an epidemic had broken out. While I was sitting with `Umar bin Al-Khattab a funeral procession passed by and the people praised the deceased. `Umar said, "It has been affirmed to him." And another funeral procession passed by and the people praised the deceased. `Umar said, "It has been affirmed to him." A third (funeral procession) passed by and the people spoke badly of the deceased. He said, "It has been affirmed to him." I (Abu Al-Aswad) asked, "O chief of the believers! What has been affirmed?" He replied, "I said the same as the Prophet (ﷺ) had said, that is: if four persons testify the piety of a Muslim, Allah will grant him Paradise." We asked, "If three persons testify his piety?" He (the Prophet) replied, "Even three." Then we asked, "If two?" He replied, "Even two." We did not ask him regarding one witness
hi: Abu Al-Aswad bataate hain: Main Madina aaya jab wahan ek waba phaili hui thi. Jabke main Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Khattab (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath baitha tha, ek janaza guzra aur logon ne marhoom ki tareef ki. Umar ne kaha: "Uske liye tay ho gaya." Doosra janaza guzra aur logon ne marhoom ki tareef ki. Umar ne kaha: "Uske liye tay ho gaya." Teesra (janaza) guzra aur logon ne marhoom ki buraai ki. Unhone kaha: "Uske liye tay ho gaya." Maine (Abu Al-Aswad ne) pucha: "Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen! Kya tay ho gaya?" Unhone jawab diya: "Maine wahi kaha jo Nabi ne kaha tha, ke agar chaar log kisi Musalman ki neki ki gawahi den, Allah use Jannat dega." Humne pucha: "Agar teen log gawahi dein?" (Nabi ne) jawab diya: "Teen bhi." Phir humne pucha: "Agar do?" Unhone jawab diya: "Do bhi." Humne ek gawah ke baare mein nahi poocha.

e: Narrated Al-Bara' bin 'Azib : The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When a faithful believer is made to sit in his grave, then (the angels) come to him and he testifies that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah and Muhammad is Allah's Apostle. And that corresponds to Allah's statement: Allah will keep firm those who believe with the word that stands firm . . . (14.27). Narrated Shu'ba: Same as above and added, "Allah will keep firm those who believe . . . (14.27) was revealed concerning the punishment of the grave
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jab ek sacche momin ko uski qabar mein baithaya jaata hai, (farishte) uske paas aate hain aur woh gawahi deta hai ke Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahi aur Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain. Aur yeh Allah ke farmaan ke mutabiq hai: 'Allah unhe jo iman rakhte hain, mazboot lafz par jama rahne dega' (14:27)." Shu'ba bataate hain (yehi upar wali riwayat) aur joda: "'Allah unhe jo iman rakhte hain mazboot rakhega' (14:27) yeh ayat qabar ke azaab ke baare mein nazil hui."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) looked at the people of the well (the well in which the bodies of the pagans killed in the Battle of Badr were thrown) and said, "Have you found true what your Lord promised you?" Somebody said to him, "You are addressing dead people." He replied, "You do not hear better than they but they cannot reply
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne un logon ke kuye (jisme Badr ki jung mein maare gaye mushrikon ke jisme daale gaye the) walon ki taraf dekha aur farmaya: "Kya tumne paaya ke tumhare Rab ne jo waada tumse kiya woh sach tha?" Kisi ne unse kaha: "Aap murda logon se baat kar rahe hain." Aap ne jawab diya: "Tum unse zyada nahi sunte, magar woh jawab nahi de sakte."

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "They now realize that what I used to tell them was the truth. "And Allah said, 'Verily! You cannot make the dead to hear (i.e. benefit them, and similarly the disbelievers) nor can you make the deaf hear
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Ab unhe pata chal gaya hai ke maine unhe jo bataya tha woh sach tha." Aur Allah ne farmaya: "Beshak tum murdo ko sunwa nahi sakte (yaani unhe faida nahi pahucha sakte, aur isi tarah kaafiron ko bhi), na hi tum bahron ko sunwa sakte."

e: Narrated Masruq:`Aisha said that a Jewess came to her and mentioned the punishment in the grave, saying to her, "May Allah protect you from the punishment of the grave." `Aisha then asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about the punishment of the grave. He said, "Yes, (there is) punishment in the grave." `Aisha added, "After that I never saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) but seeking refuge with Allah from the punishment in the grave in every prayer he prayed
hi: Masruq bataate hain: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha ke unke paas ek Yahudi aurat aayi aur qabar ke azaab ka zikar karte huye kaha: "Allah aapko qabar ke azaab se panah de." Isliye Ayesha ne Allah ke Rasool se qabar ke azaab ke baare mein pucha. Aap ne kaha: "Haan, (hai) qabar mein azaab." Ayesha ne joda: "Iske baad maine kabhi Allah ke Rasool ko apni har namaz mein qabar ke azaab se Allah ki panah maangte hue paaya."

e: Narrated Asma' bint Abi Bakr:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) once stood up delivering a sermon and mentioned the trial which people will face in the grave. When he mentioned that, the Muslims started shouting loudly
hi: Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Abi Bakr (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ek baar Allah ke Rasool khade hokar khutba de rahe the aur qabar mein aane wali aazmaish ka zikar kiya. Jab Aap ne yeh kaha, Musalman zor se rone lage.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When (Allah's) slave is put in his grave and his companions return and he even hears their footsteps, two angels come to him and make him sit and ask, 'What did you use to say about this man (i.e. Muhammad)?' The faithful Believer will say, 'I testify that he is Allah's slave and His Apostle.' Then they will say to him, 'Look at your place in the Hell Fire; Allah has given you a place in Paradise instead of it.' So he will see both his places." (Qatada said, "We were informed that his grave would be made spacious." Then Qatada went back to the narration of Anas who said;) Whereas a hypocrite or a non-believer will be asked, "What did you use to say about this man." He will reply, "I do not know; but I used to say what the people used to say." So they will say to him, "Neither did you know nor did you take the guidance (by reciting the Qur'an)." Then he will be hit with iron hammers once, that he will send such a cry as everything near to him will hear, except Jinns and human beings. (See Hadith No)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jab (Allah ka) banda apni qabar mein rakha jaata hai aur uske saathi wapas laut jate hain, aur woh unke qadmon ki awaaz tak sunta hai, do farishte uske paas aakar use baithate hain aur puchte hain: 'Tum is shaks (yaani Muhammad) ke baare mein kya kehte the?' Sacha momin kahega: 'Main gawahi deta hoon ke woh Allah ke banda aur Rasool hain.' Phir usse kaha jaayega: 'Apni jagah Dozakh mein dekho, Allah ne uski jagah Jannat mein tumhe di hai.'" (Qatada ne kaha: "Humein bataya gaya ke uski qabar kushaada kar di jaayegi.") Phir Qatada Anas ki riwayat par wapas gaye jinhone kaha: "Jabke munafiq ya kaafir se puchha jaayega: 'Tum is shaks ke baare mein kya kehte the?' Woh kahega: 'Mujhe nahi pata; main sirf woh kehta tha jo log kehte the.' Isliye unse kaha jaayega: 'Na tumhe pata tha na tumne (Quran padh kar) hidayat li.' Phir use lohe ke hathodon se ek baar maara jaayega, aur woh aisi chilLahat dega jo uske paas ki har cheez sunegi, siwaye jinnon aur insaano ke."

e: Narrated Abi Aiyub:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) went out after sunset and heard a dreadful voice, and said, "The Jews are being punished in their graves
hi: Abi Aiyub bataate hain: Ek baar Nabi suraj doobne ke baad bahar gaye aur ek khaufnaak awaaz suni, aur farmaya: "Yahudi apni qabron mein saza paa rahe hain."

e: Narrated Musa bin `Uqba:(From the daughter of Khalid bin Sa`id bin Al-`Asi) who said that she had heard the Prophet (ﷺ) seeking refuge with Allah from the punishment in the grave
hi: Musa bin Uqba, Khalid bin Sa'id bin Al-Aasi ki beti ke hawale se: unhone Nabi ko qabar ke azaab se Allah ki panah maangte suna.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to invoke (Allah): "Allahumma ini a`udhu bika min 'adhabi-l-Qabr, wa min 'adhabi-nnar, wa min fitnati-l-mahya wa-lmamat, wa min fitnati-l-masih ad-dajjal. (O Allah! I seek refuge with you from the punishment in the grave and from the punishment in the Hell fire and from the afflictions of life and death, and the afflictions of Al-Masih Ad-Dajjal)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool yeh dua padhte the: "Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min 'adhabi-l-Qabr, wa min 'adhabi-nnar, wa min fitnati-l-mahya wa-lmamat, wa min fitnati-l-masih ad-dajjal" (Aye Allah! Main teri panah maangta hoon qabar ke azaab se, Dozakh ke azaab se, zindagi-maut ke fitne se, aur Masih Dajjal ke fitne se).

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) once passed by two graves and said, "They (the deceased persons in those graves) are being tortured not for a great thing to avoid." And then added, "Yes, (they are being punished for a big sin), for one of them used to go about with calumnies while the other never saved himself from being soiled with his urine." (Ibn `Abbas added): Then he took a green leaf of a date-palm) and split it into two pieces and fixed one piece on each grave and said, "May their punishment be abated till these (two pieces) get dry
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ek baar do qabron ke paas se guzre aur farmaya: "Yeh (marhoom) kisi badi cheez (se bachne mein kotahi) ke liye azaab nahi paa rahe." Phir joda: "Haan, (unhe kisi bade gunah ki saza mil rahi hai), kyunke ek chughli khataa tha, aur doosra kabhi apne peshab se khud ko nahi bachata tha." (Ibn Abbas ne joda:) Phir Aap ne khajoor ka ek hara patta liya, use do tukdon mein baanta aur har qabar par ek tukda gaad diya, aur kaha: "Shayad unka azaab kam ho jaaye jab tak yeh (patte) sukh na jaayein."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When anyone of you dies, he is shown his place both in the morning and in the evening. If he is one of the people of Paradise; he is shown his place in it, and if he is from the people of the Hell-Fire; he is shown his place there-in. Then it is said to him, 'This is your place till Allah resurrect you on the Day of Resurrection
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi mar jaata hai, use subah-shaam uski (Aakhirat ki) jagah dikhai jaati hai. Agar woh Jannat walon mein se hai, use Jannat mein uski jagah dikhai jaati hai, aur agar woh Dozakh walon mein se hai, use Dozakh mein uski jagah dikhai jaati hai. Phir usse kaha jaata hai: 'Yeh tumhari jagah hai jab tak Allah tumhe Qiyamat ke din nahi uthaega.'"

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When the funeral is ready (for its burial) and the people lift it on their shoulders, then if the deceased is a righteous person he says, 'Take me ahead,' and if he is not a righteous one then he says, 'Woe to it (me)! Where are you taking it (me)?' And his voice is audible to everything except human beings; and if they heard it they would fall down unconscious
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jab janaza taiyaar hoti hai aur log ise apne shoulders par utha lete hain, agar marhoom neik tha, woh kehta hai: 'Mujhe aage le chalo,' aur agar neik nahi tha, woh kehta hai: 'Haaye afsos! Yeh mujhe kahan le jaa rahe hain?' Aur uski awaaz har cheez sunti hai siwaye insaan ke; aur agar woh sun le, behosh ho jaaye."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Any Muslim whose three children died before the age of puberty will be granted Paradise by Allah because of His mercy to them
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jis Musalman ke teen bachche baaligh hone se pehle mar jaayen, Allah apni rehmat se use Jannat dega."

e: Narrated Al-Bara':When Ibrahim (the son of Prophet) expired, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "There is a wet-nurse for him in Paradise
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Jab Ibrahim (Nabi ke bete) ka intiqal hua, Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jannat mein unke liye ek dai maa hai."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked about the children of (Mushrikeen) pagans. The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Since Allah created them, He knows what sort of deeds they would have done
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool se mushrikon ke bachchon ke baare mein pucha gaya. Nabi ne jawab diya: "Chunke Allah ne unhe paida kiya, woh jaanta hai woh kaise amal karte."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) was asked about the offspring of pagans (Mushrikeen); so he said, "Allah knows what sort of deeds they would have done
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi se mushrikon ki aulad ke baare mein pucha gaya, to unhone kaha: "Allah jaanta hai woh kaise amal karte."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Every child is born with a true faith of Islam (i.e. to worship none but Allah Alone) and his parents convert him to Judaism or Christianity or Magianism, as an animal delivers a perfect baby animal. Do you find it mutilated?
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Har bachcha Islam ke sacche iman (yaani sirf Allah ki ibadat) ke saath paida hota hai, magar uske maa-baap use Yahudi, Isaai ya Majoosi bana dete hain, jaise koi janwar poora bachcha janamta hai. Kya tumhe usme koi kami dikhti hai?"

e: Narrated Samura bin Jundab:Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) finished the (morning) prayer, he would face us and ask, "Who amongst you had a dream last night?" So if anyone had seen a dream he would narrate it. The Prophet (ﷺ) would say: "Ma sha'a-llah" (An Arabic maxim meaning literally, 'What Allah wished,' and it indicates a good omen.) One day, he asked us whether anyone of us had seen a dream. We replied in the negative. The Prophet said, "But I had seen (a dream) last night that two men came to me, caught hold of my hands, and took me to the Sacred Land (Jerusalem). There, I saw a person sitting and another standing with an iron hook in his hand pushing it inside the mouth of the former till it reached the jawbone, and then tore off one side of his cheek, and then did the same with the other side; in the meantime the first side of his cheek became normal again and then he repeated the same operation again. I said, 'What is this?' They told me to proceed on and we went on till we came to a man Lying flat on his back, and another man standing at his head carrying a stone or a piece of rock, and crushing the head of the Lying man, with that stone. Whenever he struck him, the stone rolled away. The man went to pick it up and by the time he returned to him, the crushed head had returned to its normal state and the man came back and struck him again (and so on). I said, 'Who is this?' They told me to proceed on; so we proceeded on and passed by a hole like an oven; with a narrow top and wide bottom, and the fire was kindling underneath that hole. Whenever the fire-flame went up, the people were lifted up to such an extent that they were about to get out of it, and whenever the fire got quieter, the people went down into it, and there were naked men and women in it. I said, 'Who is this?' They told me to proceed on. So we proceeded on till we reached a river of blood and a man was in it, and another man was standing at its bank with stones in front of him, facing the man standing in the river. Whenever the man in the river wanted to come out, the other one threw a stone in his mouth and caused him to retreat to his original position; and so whenever he wanted to come out the other would throw a stone in his mouth, and he would retreat to his original position. I asked, 'What is this?' They told me to proceed on and we did so till we reached a well-flourished green garden having a huge tree and near its root was sitting an old man with some children. (I saw) Another man near the tree with fire in front of him and he was kindling it up. Then they (i.e. my two companions) made me climb up the tree and made me enter a house, better than which I have ever seen. In it were some old men and young men, women and children. Then they took me out of this house and made me climb up the tree and made me enter another house that was better and superior (to the first) containing old and young people. I said to them (i.e. my two companions), 'You have made me ramble all the night. Tell me all about that I have seen.' They said, 'Yes. As for the one whose cheek you saw being torn away, he was a liar and he used to tell lies, and the people would report those lies on his authority till they spread all over the world. So, he will be punished like that till the Day of Resurrection. The one whose head you saw being crushed is the one whom Allah had given the knowledge of Qur'an (i.e. knowing it by heart) but he used to sleep at night (i.e. he did not recite it then) and did not use to act upon it (i.e. upon its orders etc.) by day; and so this punishment will go on till the Day of Resurrection. And those you saw in the hole (like oven) were adulterers (those men and women who commit illegal sexual intercourse). And those you saw in the river of blood were those dealing in Riba (usury). And the old man who was sitting at the base of the tree was Abraham and the little children around him were the offspring of the people. And the one who was kindling the fire was Malik, the gatekeeper of the Hell-fire. And the first house in which you have gone was the house of the common believers, and the second house was of the martyrs. I am Gabriel and this is Michael. Raise your head.' I raised my head and saw a thing like a cloud over me. They said, 'That is your place.' I said, 'Let me enter my place.' They said, 'You still have some life which you have not yet completed, and when you complete (that remaining portion of your life) you will then enter your place
hi: Samura bin Jundub (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab bhi Nabi (Fajr ki) namaz khatam karte, humari taraf mud kar puchte: "Tum mein se kisi ne kal raat koi khwab dekha?" Agar kisi ne khwab dekha hota, woh batataa. Nabi kehte: "Ma sha'a-llah" (jo Allah ne chaha). Ek din Aap ne humse pucha kya kisi ne khwab dekha. Humne na mein jawab diya. Nabi ne farmaya: "Magar maine kal raat khwab dekha ke do log mere paas aaye, mera haath pakda aur mujhe Baitul-Muqaddas (paak zameen) le gaye. Wahan maine ek shaks baitha dekha aur doosra khada, uske haath mein lohe ka hook tha, jisse woh pehle ke mun mein daal kar uski jabde ki haddi tak le ja raha tha, phir uske gaal ka ek taraf phaad deta, phir doosri taraf se bhi wahi karta; isi dauran pehli taraf ka gaal wapas theek ho jaata aur woh phir se yehi kaam dohrata. Maine pucha: 'Yeh kya hai?' Unhone mujhe aage badhne ko kaha, aur hum aage badhe yahan tak ke hum ek shaks ko peeth ke bal leta paaya, aur ek doosra shaks uske sar ke paas khada patthar ya chattaan ka tukda leke uska sar koochne (kuchalne) laga. Jab bhi woh maarta, patthar door lud jata, woh shaks uthane jaata aur jab tak woh wapas aata, kuchla hua sar wapas theek ho jaata aur woh phir maarta. Maine pucha: 'Yeh kaun hai?' Unhone mujhe aage badhne ko kaha; so hum aage badhe yahan tak ke hum ek tandoor jaisi bhatti ke paas se guzre jiska mun tang aur pendi chaudi thi, aur uske neeche aag jal rahi thi. Jab bhi aag ki lapat oopar uthti, log itne uthe ke woh bahar aane wale hote, aur jab aag halki hoti, woh wapas neeche chale jate, aur usme nange mard-aurat the. Maine pucha: 'Yeh kaun hai?' Unhone mujhe aage badhne ko kaha. So hum aage badhe yahan tak ke ek khoon ki nadi ke paas pahunche jisme ek shaks tha, aur doosra shaks nadi ke kinare khada tha jiske saamne patthar the, woh nadi ke andar khade shaks ki taraf mun kiye hue tha. Jab woh nadi wala shaks bahar aana chahtaa, doosra uske mun mein patthar phenkta jisse woh phir apni jagah wapas chala jata; aur isi tarah jab bhi woh bahar aana chahta, woh dobara patthar phenkta aur woh wapas chala jata. Maine pucha: 'Yeh kya hai?' Unhone mujhe aage badhne ko kaha, aur hum aage badhe yahan tak ke ek hara-bhara khoobsurat baag mein pahunche jisme ek bada darakht tha, aur uski jadd ke qareeb ek budha shaks kuch bachchon ke saath baitha tha. (Maine dekha) darakht ke qareeb ek aur shaks tha, uske saamne aag thi jisse woh sulgata raha tha. Phir woh dono (yaani mere do sathi) mujhe darakht par chadhane lage aur mujhe ek ghar mein le gaye jaisa maine pehle kabhi nahi dekha tha. Usme kuch budhe log, kuch jawan, aurtein aur bachche the. Phir woh mujhe us ghar se nikaal kar phir darakht par chadhane lage aur mujhe ek doosre ghar mein daakhil kiya jo pehle se behtar aur oncha tha, jisme budhe aur jawan log the. Maine unse (yaani apne do sathiyon se) kaha: 'Tumne mujhe poori raat ghumaya. Ab mujhe batao maine jo dekha uska kya matlab hai.' Unhone kaha: 'Haan. Jiska gaal phaada jaate dekha, woh jhoota tha, jhoot bola karta tha, aur log uski baat aage phaila dete the yahan tak ke woh poori duniya mein phail jaati; isliye use Qiyamat tak yehi saza milegi. Jiska sar kuchla jaate dekha, woh woh shaks tha jise Allah ne Quran ka ilm diya tha (yaani woh hifz karta tha) magar woh raat ko sota rehta tha (yaani tilawat nahi karta) aur din mein Quran ke hukmon par amal nahi karta tha; yehi saza use Qiyamat tak milegi. Jinhe tumne tandoor jaisi jagah mein dekha, woh zaani (zina karne wale) mard-aurat the. Jinhe tumne khoon ki nadi mein dekha, woh Riba (sood) khane wale the. Aur jo budha shaks darakht ki jadd ke paas baitha tha, woh Ibrahim (علیہ السلام) the, aur unke aas-paas ke chhote bachche insaano ki aulad (jo baaligh hone se pehle mar gaye) the. Aur jo shaks aag sulgata tha, woh Malik hai, Dozakh ka darban. Aur jis pehle ghar mein tum gaye, woh aam Musalmanon ka ghar tha, aur doosra ghar shaheedon ka tha. Main Jibreel hoon aur yeh Mikaeel hain. Ab apna sar utha o.' Maine sar utha kar dekha, mere upar badal jaisi ek cheez thi. Unhone kaha: 'Yeh tumhari jagah hai.' Maine kaha: 'Mujhe apni jagah mein daakhil hone do.' Unhone kaha: 'Tumhari zindagi mein abhi kuch baaki hai jo tumne poora nahi kiya, aur jab tum use poora karoge, tab tum apni jagah mein daakhil hoge.'"

e: Narrated Hisham's father:Aisha said, "I went to Abu Bakr (during his fatal illness) and he asked me, 'In how many garments was the Prophet (ﷺ) shrouded?' She replied, 'In three Suhuliya pieces of white cloth of cotton, and there was neither a shirt nor a turban among them.' Abu Bakr further asked her, 'On which day did the Prophet die?' She replied, 'He died on Monday.' He asked, 'What is today?' She replied, 'Today is Monday.' He added, 'I hope I shall die sometime between this morning and tonight.' Then he looked at a garment that he was wearing during his illness and it had some stains of saffron. Then he said, 'Wash this garment of mine and add two more garments and shroud me in them.' I said, 'This is worn out.' He said, 'A living person has more right to wear new clothes than a dead one; the shroud is only for the body's pus.' He did not die till it was the night of Tuesday and was buried before the morning
hi: Hisham ke waalid bataate hain: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha: "Main Abu Bakr (unki aakhri bimari mein) ke paas gayi, unhone pucha: 'Nabi ko kitne kapdon mein kafan diya gaya?' Maine jawab diya: 'Teen safed cotton Suhuliya kapdon mein, aur unme na qamees thi na pagdi.' Abu Bakr ne phir pucha: 'Nabi ka intiqal kis din hua?' Maine jawab diya: 'Somvar ko.' Unhone pucha: 'Aaj kaunsa din hai?' Maine jawab diya: 'Aaj Somvar hai.' Unhone kaha: 'Mujhe ummeed hai main aaj subah se raat ke beech mar jaunga.' Phir unhone apna kapda dekha jo woh apni bimari mein pehne hue the, jisme kesar ke daag lage the, aur kaha: 'Mera yeh kapda dho do aur do aur kapde jodkar isme mujhe kafan do.' Maine kaha: 'Yeh to purana ho chuka hai.' Unhone kaha: 'Zinda insaan ko naye kapdon ka murda se zyada haqq hai; kafan sirf jism ki galahat ke liye hai.'" Woh Mangal ki raat tak zinda rahe aur subah hone se pehle dafn kar diye gaye.

e: Narrated Aisha:A man said to the Prophet (ﷺ), "My mother died suddenly and I thought that if she had lived she would have given alms. So, if I give alms now on her behalf, will she get the reward?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied in the affirmative
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ek shaks ne Nabi se kaha: "Meri maa achanak intiqal kar gayin, aur mujhe lagta hai agar woh zinda hotin, sadqa deti. Isliye agar main unki taraf se ab sadqa dun, kya unhe iska ajr milega?" Nabi ne haan mein jawab diya.

e: Narrated `Aisha:During his sickness, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asking repeatedly, "Where am I today? Where will I be tomorrow?" And I was waiting for the day of my turn (impatiently). Then, when my turn came, Allah took his soul away (in my lap) between my chest and arms and he was buried in my house
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Apni bimari mein Allah ke Rasool baar-baar puch rahe the: "Aaj main kahan hoon? Kal main kahan hounga?" Aur main apni baari ka intezar kar rahi thi (betaabi se). Phir jab meri baari aayi, Allah ne unki jaan qabz ki (jabke unka sar mere seene aur baazuoon ke beech tha) aur unhe mere ghar mein dafn kiya gaya.

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in his fatal illness said, "Allah cursed the Jews and the Christians, for they built the places of worship at the graves of their prophets." And if that had not been the case, then the Prophet's grave would have been made prominent before the people. So (the Prophet (ﷺ) ) was afraid, or the people were afraid that his grave might be taken as a place for worship
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool ne apni aakhri bimari mein farmaya: "Allah ne Yahudiyon aur Isaiyon par laanat ki, unhone apne Nabiyon ki qabron par ibadatgah bana lin." Aur agar aisa na hota, to Nabi ki qabar ko khula (prominent) banaya jaata, magar (Nabi) darte the, ya log darte the ke kahin unki qabar ko namaz padhne ki jagah na bana liya jaaye.

e: Narrated Abu Bakr bin `Aiyash:Sufyan at-Tammar told me that he had seen the grave of the Prophet (ﷺ) elevated and convex
hi: Abu Bakr bin Aiyash bataate hain: Sufyan at-Tammar ne mujhe bataya ke unhone Nabi ki qabar oonchi aur uthi hui dekhi thi.

e: Narrated `Urwa:When the wall fell on them (i.e. graves) during the caliphate of Al-Walid bin `Abdul Malik, the people started repairing it, and a foot appeared to them. The people got scared and thought that it was the foot of the Prophet. No one could be found who could tell them about it till I (`Urwa) said to them, "By Allah, this is not the foot of the Prophet (ﷺ) but it is the foot of `Umar
hi: Urwa bataate hain: Jab Al-Walid bin Abdul Malik ki khilafat mein deewar (qabron par) gir gayi, log use theek karne lage, aur unhe ek paon nazar aaya. Log dar gaye aur socha yeh Nabi ka paon hai. Koi nahi bata saka jab tak maine (Urwa ne) unhe kaha: "Allah ki qasam, yeh Nabi ka paon nahi hai, balki Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ka paon hai."

e: Aisha narrated that she made a will to `Abdullah bin Zubair, "Do not bury me with them (the Prophet (ﷺ) and his two companions) but bury me with my companions (wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) ) in Al-Baqi as I would not like to be looked upon as better than I really am (by being buried near the Prophet)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne bataya ke unhone Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko wasiyat ki: "Mujhe unke (Nabi aur unke do sathiyon) ke saath dafn mat karna, balki mujhe apni sathiyon (Nabi ki biwiyon) ke saath Al-Baqi mein dafn karna, kyunke main apne aap ko itna achha nahi samajhti (ke Nabi ke qareeb dafn hone ke laayak samjhi jaaun)."

e: Narrated `Amr bin Maimun Al-Audi:I saw `Umar bin Al-Khattab (when he was stabbed) saying, "O `Abdullah bin `Umar! Go to the mother of the believers Aisha and say, `Umar bin Al-Khattab sends his greetings to you,' and request her to allow me to be buried with my companions." (So, Ibn `Umar conveyed the message to `Aisha.) She said, "I had the idea of having this place for myself but today I prefer him (`Umar) to myself (and allow him to be buried there)." When `Abdullah bin `Umar returned, `Umar asked him, "What (news) do you have?" He replied, "O chief of the believers! She has allowed you (to be buried there)." On that `Umar said, "Nothing was more important to me than to be buried in that (sacred) place. So, when I expire, carry me there and pay my greetings to her (`Aisha ) and say, `Umar bin Al-Khattab asks permission; and if she gives permission, then bury me (there) and if she does not, then take me to the graveyard of the Muslims. I do not think any person has more right for the caliphate than those with whom Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was always pleased till his death. And whoever is chosen by the people after me will be the caliph, and you people must listen to him and obey him," and then he mentioned the name of `Uthman, `Ali, Talha, Az-Zubair, `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf and Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas. By this time a young man from Ansar came and said, "O chief of the believers! Be happy with Allah's glad tidings. The grade which you have in Islam is known to you, then you became the caliph and you ruled with justice and then you have been awarded martyrdom after all this." `Umar replied, "O son of my brother! Would that all that privileges will counterbalance (my short comings), so that I neither lose nor gain anything. I recommend my successor to be good to the early emigrants and realize their rights and to protect their honor and sacred things. And I also recommend him to be good to the Ansar who before them, had homes (in Medina) and had adopted the Faith. He should accept the good of the righteous among them and should excuse their wrongdoers. I recommend him to abide by the rules and regulations concerning the Dhimmis (protectees) of Allah and His Apostle, to fulfill their contracts completely and fight for them and not to tax (overburden) them beyond their capabilities
hi: Amr bin Maimun Al-Audi bataate hain: Maine Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Khattab (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko (jab unhe chhura mara gaya) kehte suna: "Aye Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ)! Ummul-Momineen Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas jaao aur kaho, 'Umar bin Khattab aapko salaam bhejte hain,' aur unse guzarish karo ke mujhe apne sathiyon ke saath dafn hone ki ijazat dein." (Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne yeh sandesh Ayesha ko diya.) Unhone kaha: "Mera iraada tha yeh jagah apne liye rakhun, magar aaj main use (Umar ko) apne aap par tarjeeh deti hoon." Jab Abdullah bin Umar wapas aaye, Umar ne pucha: "(Kya khabar) tumhare paas?" Unhone jawab diya: "Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen! Unhone aapko ijazat de di hai." Isspar Umar ne kaha: "Mere liye is (muqaddas) jagah mein dafn hone se zyada zaroori kuch nahi tha. Isliye jab mera intiqal ho jaaye, mujhe wahan le jaana aur unhe (Ayesha ko) mera salaam kehna aur kehna, 'Umar bin Khattab ijazat maangte hain'; agar woh ijazat de dein, mujhe wahan dafn karna, aur agar na den, mujhe Musalmanon ke qabristan mein le jaana. Mera khayaal nahi ke Nabi ke intiqal tak jinse woh khush rahe, unse zyada khilafat ka koi haqdaar hai. Aur jise mere baad log chunen, woh khalifa hoga, aur tumhe uski baat sunni aur maani chahiye," phir unhone Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ), Ali (Alayhis Salam), Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ), Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ), Abdur-Rahman bin Auf aur Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke naam liye. Isi waqt Ansaar ka ek jawan aaya aur kaha: "Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen! Allah ki khush-khabri se khush ho jaaiye. Islam mein aapka jo darja hai woh aapko pata hai, phir aap khalifa bane aur insaaf se hukumat ki, aur ab aapko is sab ke baad shahadat mili hai." Umar ne jawab diya: "Aye mere bhatije! Kaash yeh sab (ajr) barabar ho jaaye (na mujhe faida ho na nuqsaan). Main apne jaanasheen ko naseehat karta hoon ke woh pehle Muhajireen ke saath achha suluk kare, unke huqooq ka khayaal rakhe aur unki izzat aur muqaddas cheezon ki hifazat kare. Main yeh bhi naseehat karta hoon ke woh Ansaar ke saath achha suluk kare, jo unse pehle (Madina mein) ghar aur iman apna chuke the. Woh unme se neik logon ki achhaai qubool kare aur unke buraai karne walon ko maaf kare. Main use Allah aur uske Rasool ki panah mein aaye Dhimmis (ghair-Musalman raiyat) ke huqooq ka khayaal rakhne, unke muahide poore karne, unki hifazat ke liye jung karne, aur unpar unki taaqat se zyada tax na lagaane ki naseehat karta hoon."

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Don't abuse the dead, because they have reached the result of what they forwarded
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Murdo ko bura-bhala mat kaho, kyunke woh apne kiye huye amal ka nateeja pa chuke hain."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas.:Abu Lahab, may Allah curse him, once said to the Prophet (ﷺ), "Perish you all the day." Then the Divine Inspiration came: "Perish the hands of Abi Lahab! And perish he
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Abu Lahab (Allah uspar laanat kare) ne ek baar Nabi se kaha: "Tum sab barbaad ho." Isspar yeh wahi nazil hui: "Barbaad ho Abu Lahab ke haath! Aur woh khud barbaad ho gaya."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) sent Mu`adh to Yemen and said, "Invite the people to testify that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah and I am Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and if they obey you to do so, then teach them that Allah has enjoined on them five prayers in every day and night (in twenty-four hours), and if they obey you to do so, then teach them that Allah has made it obligatory for them to pay the Zakat from their property and it is to be taken from the wealthy among them and given to the poor
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne Mu'adh ko Yemen bheja aur farmaya: "Logon ko dawat do gawahi dene ki ke Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahi aur main Allah ka Rasool hoon. Agar woh yeh maan lein, to unhe sikhaao ke Allah ne unpar din-raat (chaubees ghanton) mein paanch namazein farz ki hain. Agar woh yeh bhi maan lein, to unhe sikhaao ke Allah ne unke maal par Zakat farz ki hai, jo unke maldaaron se li jaaye aur unke gareebon ko di jaaye."

e: Narrated Abu Aiyub:A man said to the Prophet (ﷺ) "Tell me of such a deed as will make me enter Paradise." The people said, "What is the matter with him? What is the matter with him?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He has something to ask. (What he needs greatly) The Prophet (ﷺ) said: (In order to enter Paradise) you should worship Allah and do not ascribe any partners to Him, offer prayer perfectly, pay the Zakat and keep good relations with your Kith and kin." (See Hadith No. 12, Vol)
hi: Abu Aiyub (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks ne Nabi se kaha: "Mujhe koi aisa amal batayein jo mujhe Jannat mein daakhil kare." Logon ne kaha: "Isse kya hua? Isse kya hua?" Nabi ne farmaya: "Isse kuch poochhna hai (jiski isse sakht zaroorat hai)." Nabi ne farmaya (Jannat mein daakhil hone ke liye): "Allah ki ibadat karo aur usme kisi ko shareek na karo, namaz mukammal padho, Zakat do, aur apne rishtedaron se achha suluk rakho."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:A Bedouin came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "Tell me of such a deed as will make me enter Paradise, if I do it." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Worship Allah, and worship none along with Him, offer the (five) prescribed compulsory prayers perfectly, pay the compulsory Zakat, and fast the month of Ramadan." The Bedouin said, "By Him, in Whose Hands my life is, I will not do more than this." When he (the Bedouin) left, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever likes to see a man of Paradise, then he may look at this man." Narrated Abu Zur'a: From the Prophet (ﷺ) the same as above
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek dehati (Bedouin) Nabi ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Mujhe koi aisa amal batayein jo mujhe Jannat mein daakhil kare, agar main use karoon." Nabi ne farmaya: "Allah ki ibadat karo, usme kisi ko shareek mat karo, farz (paanch) namazein mukammal padho, farz Zakat do, aur Ramadan ke roze rakho." Dehati ne kaha: "Us zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, main isse zyada kuch nahi karunga." Jab woh chala gaya, Nabi ne farmaya: "Jo Jannat wale insaan ko dekhna chahe, isse dekh le." Abu Zur'a bataate hain: (yehi upar wali) Nabi ke hawale se riwayat.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:A delegation of the tribe of `Abdul Qais came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We are from the tribe of Rabi`a, and the infidels of the tribe of Mudar stand between us and you; so we cannot come to you except during the Sacred Months. Please order us to do something (religious deeds) which we may carry out and also invite to it our people whom we have left behind." The Prophet said, "I order you to do four things and forbid you four others: (I order you) to have faith in Allah, and confess that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah, (and the Prophet (ﷺ) gestured with his hand like this (i.e. one knot) and to offer prayers perfectly and to pay the Zakat, and to pay one-fifth of the booty in Allah's Cause. And I forbid you to use Dubba', Hantam, Naqir and Muzaffat (all these are the names of utensils used for preparing alcoholic drinks)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Abdul Qais qabile ka ek wafd Nabi ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Hum Rabia qabile se hain, aur Mudar qabile ke kaafir humare aur aapke darmiyan hain, isliye hum sirf haram maheenon mein aapke paas aa sakte hain. Kripya humein kuch (deeni) kaam karne ka hukum dein jise hum khud amal mein laa sakein aur unhe bhi bata sakein jinhe hum peechhe chhod aaye hain." Nabi ne farmaya: "Main tumhe chaar cheezon ka hukum deta hoon aur chaar se rokta hoon: (Hukum deta hoon) Allah par iman lao, aur gawahi do ke Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahi (aur Nabi ne apne haath se ek ghantthh jaisa ishara kiya), aur namaz mukammal padho, aur Zakat do, aur Allah ki raah mein maal-e-ghanimat ka paanchwan hissa do. Aur main tumhe Dubba, Hantam, Naqir aur Muzaffat (sab sharab banane ke bartanon ke naam) istemal karne se mana karta hoon."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died and Abu Bakr became the caliph some Arabs renegade (reverted to disbelief) (Abu Bakr decided to declare war against them), `Umar, said to Abu Bakr, "How can you fight with these people although Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'I have been ordered (by Allah) to fight the people till they say: "None has the right to be worshipped but Allah, and whoever said it then he will save his life and property from me except on trespassing the law (rights and conditions for which he will be punished justly), and his accounts will be with Allah.' " Abu Bakr said, "By Allah! I will fight those who differentiate between the prayer and the Zakat as Zakat is the compulsory right to be taken from the property (according to Allah's orders) By Allah! If they refuse to pay me even a she-kid which they used to pay at the time of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . I would fight with them for withholding it" Then `Umar said, "By Allah, it was nothing, but Allah opened Abu Bakr's chest towards the decision (to fight) and I came to know that his decision was right
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool ka intiqal hua aur Abu Bakr khalifa bane, kuch Arab murtad (deen se pher gaye) ho gaye (Abu Bakr ne unke khilaf jung ka faisla kiya). Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Abu Bakr se kaha: "Aap in logon se kaise lad sakte hain jabke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya tha: 'Mujhe hukum diya gaya hai (Allah ki taraf se) ke main logon se laadung jab tak woh yeh na kahen: \"Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahi,\" aur jo isse kahe, woh apni jaan aur maal mujhse mehfooz kar leta hai, siwaye haqq ke (jiske liye insaaf se saza di jaayegi), aur uska hisaab Allah ke zimme hoga'?" Abu Bakr ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam! Main un logon se zaroor laadunga jo namaz aur Zakat ke darmiyan farq karte hain, kyunke Zakat maal par farz haqq hai (Allah ke hukum ke mutabiq). Allah ki qasam! Agar unhone mujhe ek chhoti bakri bhi dene se inkaar kiya jo woh Allah ke Rasool ke zamane mein dete the, main isi wajah se unse jung karunga." Phir Umar ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, yeh kuch aur nahi tha, balki Allah ne Abu Bakr ka dil is faisle ki taraf khol diya, aur mujhe pata chal gaya ke unka faisla sahih tha."

e: Narrated Jarir bin `Abdullah:I gave the pledge of allegiance to the Prophet (ﷺ) for offering prayer perfectly, giving Zakat, and giving good advice to every Muslim
hi: Jarir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi se namaz mukammal padhne, Zakat dene, aur har Musalman ka khair-khwaah rehne par bai'at ki.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "(On the Day of Resurrection) camels will come to their owner in the best state of health they have ever had (in the world), and if he had not paid their Zakat (in the world) then they would tread him with their feet; and similarly, sheep will come to their owner in the best state of health they have ever had in the world, and if he had not paid their Zakat, then they would tread him with their hooves and would butt him with their horns." The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "One of their rights is that they should be milked while water is kept in front of them." The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "I do not want anyone of you to come to me on the Day of Resurrection, carrying over his neck a sheep that will be bleating. Such a person will (then) say, 'O Muhammad! (please intercede for me,) I will say to him. 'I can't help you, for I conveyed Allah's Message to you.' Similarly, I do not want anyone of you to come to me carrying over his neck a camel that will be grunting. Such a person (then) will say "O Muhammad! (please intercede for me)." I will say to him, "I can't help you for I conveyed Allah's message to you
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "(Qiyamat ke din) oont apne maalik ke paas aaenge unki sabse achhi tandurusti ki halat mein (jaisi duniya mein kabhi na thi), aur agar usne unki Zakat nahi di, to woh use apne paon se koochenge; isi tarah bhedein apne maalik ke paas aayengi unki sabse achhi tandurusti ki halat mein, aur agar usne unki Zakat nahi di, to woh use apne khuron se koochengi aur singon se maarengi." Nabi ne joda: "Unke haqqon mein se ek yeh hai ke unhe doodh nikaalte waqt unke saamne paani rakha jaaye." Nabi ne aage farmaya: "Main nahi chahta ke tum mein se koi Qiyamat ke din mere paas apni gardan par ek bhed liye aaye jo mimya rahi ho. Woh shaks kahega: 'Aye Muhammad! (Kripya meri shifa'at kijiye)', main usse kahunga: 'Main tumhari koi madad nahi kar sakta, kyunke maine tum tak Allah ka paighaam pahuncha diya tha.' Isi tarah, main nahi chahta ke tum mein se koi mere paas apni gardan par ek oont liye aaye jo bulbulaa raha ho. Woh shaks (tab) kahega 'Aye Muhammad! (Kripya meri shifa'at kijiye)'; main usse kahunga: 'Main tumhari koi madad nahi kar sakta, kyunke maine tum tak Allah ka paighaam pahuncha diya tha.'"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever is made wealthy by Allah and does not pay the Zakat of his wealth, then on the Day of Resurrection his wealth will be made like a baldheaded poisonous male snake with two black spots over the eyes. The snake will encircle his neck and bite his cheeks and say, 'I am your wealth, I am your treasure.' " Then the Prophet (ﷺ) recited the holy verses:-- 'Let not those who withhold . . .' (to the end of the verse)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jise Allah ne maldaar banaya aur usne apne maal ki Zakat nahi di, to Qiyamat ke din uska maal ek gunje aur zehreele mard saanp jaisa bana diya jaayega, jiski aankhon par do kaale nishaan honge. Saanp uski gardan ke gird lipat jaayega aur uske gaal kaatega aur kahega: 'Main tera maal hoon, main tera khazana hoon.'" Phir Nabi ne yeh paak ayaat padhi: "Aur jo log rok kar rakhte... (aakhri hisse tak)."

e: Narrated Khalid bin Aslam:We went out with 'Abdullah bin 'Umar and a bedouin said (to 'Abdullah), "Tell me about Allah's saying: "And those who hoard up gold and silver (Al-Kanz - money, gold, silver etc., the Zakat of which has not been paid) and spend it not in the Way of Allah (V.9:34)." Ibn 'Umar said, "Whoever hoarded them and did not pay the Zakat thereof, then woe to him. But these holy Verses were revealed before the Verses of Zakat. So when the Verses of Zakat were revealed, Allah made Zakat a purifier of the property
hi: Khalid bin Aslam bataate hain: Hum Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath bahar gaye, aur ek dehati ne (Abdullah se) kaha: "Mujhe batao Allah ke farmaan ka kya matlab hai: 'Aur jo log sona-chandi jama kar ke rakhte hain (Al-Kanz — jinki Zakat nahi di gayi) aur Allah ki raah mein kharch nahi karte' (9:34)." Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Jisne bhi unhe jama kiya aur unki Zakat nahi di, uspar afsos hai. Magar yeh paak ayaat Zakat ki ayaat se pehle nazil hui thin. Isliye jab Zakat ki ayaat nazil hui, Allah ne Zakat ko maal ko paak karne wali cheez bana diya."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "No Zakat is due on property mounting to less than five Uqiyas (of silver), and no Zakat is due on less than five camels, and there is no Zakat on less than five Wasqs." (A Wasqs equals 60 Sa's) & (1 Sa=3 K gms App)
hi: Abu Saeed (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Paanch Uqiya (chandi) se kam maal par Zakat nahi hai, paanch oonton se kam par Zakat nahi hai, aur paanch Wasq se kam par Zakat nahi hai." (Ek Wasq 60 Sa ke barabar hota hai, aur ek Sa taqreeban 3 kg ka hota hai.)

e: Narrated Zaid bin Wahab:I passed by a place called Ar-Rabadha and by chance I met Abu Dhar and asked him, "What has brought you to this place?" He said, "I was in Sham and differed with Muawiya on the meaning of (the following verses of the Qur'an): 'They who hoard up gold and silver and spend them not in the way of Allah.' (9.34). Muawiya said, 'This verse is revealed regarding the people of the scriptures." I said, It was revealed regarding us and also the people of the scriptures." So we had a quarrel and Mu'awiya sent a complaint against me to `Uthman. `Uthman wrote to me to come to Medina, and I came to Medina. Many people came to me as if they had not seen me before. So I told this to `Uthman who said to me, "You may depart and live nearby if you wish." That was the reason for my being here for even if an Ethiopian had been nominated as my ruler, I would have obeyed him
hi: Zaid bin Wahb bataate hain: Main Ar-Rabadha naam ki jagah se guzra aur wahan achanak Abu Dharr (رضی اللہ عنہ) se mulaqat hui, maine unse pucha: "Aapko yahan kya laaya?" Unhone kaha: "Main Sham mein tha aur Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) se is ayat ke matlab par ikhtilaaf hua: 'Jo log sona-chandi jama karte hain aur Allah ki raah mein kharch nahi karte' (9:34). Muawiya ne kaha: 'Yeh ayat Ahl-e-Kitaab ke baare mein nazil hui hai.' Maine kaha: 'Yeh humare aur Ahl-e-Kitaab dono ke baare mein nazil hui hai.' Isliye hamara jhagda hua aur Muawiya ne Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko mere khilaaf shikayat bheji. Uthman ne mujhe Madina bulaya, aur main Madina aaya. Bahut se log mujhse milne aaye jaise unhone mujhe pehle kabhi na dekha ho. Maine yeh Uthman ko bataya, unhone mujhse kaha: 'Tum jaao aur agar chaho to qareeb kahin ruk kar raho.' Yehi wajah thi ke main yahan raha, kyunke agar ek Ethiopian bhi mera hukmaran banaya jaata, main uski itaa'at karta."

e: Narrated Al-Ahnaf bin Qais:While I was sitting with some people from Quraish, a man with very rough hair, clothes, and appearance came and stood in front of us, greeted us and said, "Inform those who hoard wealth, that a stone will be heated in the Hell-fire and will be put on the nipples of their breasts till it comes out from the bones of their shoulders and then put on the bones of their shoulders till it comes through the nipples of their breasts the stone will be moving and hitting." After saying that, the person retreated and sat by the side of the pillar, I followed him and sat beside him, and I did not know who he was. I said to him, "I think the people disliked what you had said." He said, "These people do not understand anything, although my friend told me." I asked, "Who is your friend?" He said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to me), 'O Abu Dhar! Do you see the mountain of Uhud?' And on that I (Abu Dhar) started looking towards the sun to judge how much remained of the day as I thought that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) wanted to send me to do something for him and I said, 'Yes!' He said, 'I do not love to have gold equal to the mountain of Uhud unless I spend it all (in Allah's cause) except three Dinars (pounds). These people do not understand and collect worldly wealth. No, by Allah, Neither I ask them for worldly benefits nor am I in need of their religious advice till I meet Allah, The Honorable, The Majestic
hi: Al-Ahnaf bin Qais bataate hain: Jabke main Quraish ke kuch logon ke saath baitha tha, ek shaks bahut khurdare baalon, kapdon aur shakl-o-surat wala aaya aur humare saamne khada hokar salaam kiya aur kaha: "Un logon ko khabar do jo maal jama karte hain ke ek patthar Dozakh ki aag mein garam kiya jaayega aur unke seene ke nokon par rakha jaayega yahan tak ke woh unke shoulders ki haddiyon se bahar aa jaayega, phir shoulders ki haddiyon par rakha jaayega yahan tak ke woh unke seene ki nokon se bahar aa jaayega, aur yeh patthar hilta aur takrata rahega." Yeh kehkar woh peeche hata aur ek sutoon ke paas baith gaya. Main uske peechhe gaya aur uske bagal mein baitha, mujhe pata nahi tha woh kaun hai. Maine unse kaha: "Mujhe lagta hai logon ko aapki baat napasand aayi." Unhone kaha: "Yeh log kuch nahi samajhte, halanke mere dost ne mujhe bataya tha." Maine pucha: "Aapke dost kaun hain?" Unhone kaha: "Nabi ne (mujhse) farmaya tha: 'Aye Abu Dharr (رضی اللہ عنہ)! Kya tumhe Uhud pahad dikh raha hai?' Aur us waqt main (Abu Dharr) suraj ki taraf dekhne laga yeh andaza lagane ke liye din mein kitna waqt baaki hai, kyunke mujhe laga Allah ke Rasool mujhe kisi kaam se bhejna chahte hain. Maine kaha: 'Haan!' Aap ne farmaya: 'Mujhe pasand nahi ke mere paas Uhud pahad jitna sona ho, siwaye teen Dinaron ke, magar main sab kharch kar dun (Allah ki raah mein).' Yeh log samajhte nahi aur duniyawi maal jama karte hain. Nahi, Allah ki qasam, na main unse duniyawi faida maangta hoon, na mujhe unki deeni salaah ki zaroorat hai, jab tak main Allah, jo izzat wala aur azeem hai, se na miloon."

e: Narrated Ibn Mas`ud:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "There is no envy except in two: a person whom Allah has given wealth and he spends it in the right way, and a person whom Allah has given wisdom (i.e. religious knowledge) and he gives his decisions accordingly and teaches it to the others
hi: Ibn Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi ko farmate suna: "Rashk sirf do logon par karna jaiz hai: ek woh shaks jisse Allah ne maal diya aur woh use sahih raaste mein kharch karta hai, aur ek woh shaks jisse Allah ne hikmat (deeni ilm) di aur woh usi ke mutabiq faisle karta hai aur doosron ko sikhata hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If one gives in charity what equals one date-fruit from the honestly earned money and Allah accepts only the honestly earned money --Allah takes it in His right (hand) and then enlarges its reward for that person (who has given it), as anyone of you brings up his baby horse, so much so that it becomes as big as a mountain
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Agar koi imandaari se kamaye hue maal se ek khajoor ke barabar bhi sadqa de — aur Allah sirf imandaari se kamaya hua maal qubool karta hai — Allah use apne dahine (haath) se leta hai aur uska ajr badhata hai, jaise tum mein se koi apne ghode ke bachche ko palta hai, yahan tak ke woh (sadqa) ek pahad jitna bada ho jaata hai."

e: Narrated Haritha bin Wahab:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "O people! Give in charity as a time will come upon you when a person will wander about with his object of charity and will not find anybody to accept it, and one (who will be requested to take it) will say, "If you had brought it yesterday, would have taken it, but today I am not in need of it
hi: Haritha bin Wahab (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi ko farmate suna: "Aye logon! Sadqa do, kyunke ek waqt aayega jab koi shaks apna sadqa lekar ghumega aur koi use lene wala nahi milega, aur ek (jise dena chaha jayega) kahega: 'Agar tum ise kal laate to main le leta, magar aaj mujhe iski zaroorat nahi.'"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The Hour (Day of Judgment) will not be established till your wealth increases so much so that one will be worried, for no one will accept his Zakat and the person to whom he will give it will reply, 'I am not in need of it
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Qiyamat (ki ghadi) tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak tumhara maal itna na badh jaaye ke koi pareshan ho jaaye kyunke koi uski Zakat qubool nahi karega, aur jise woh dega, woh jawab dega: 'Mujhe iski zaroorat nahi.'"

e: Narrated `Adi bin Hatim:While I was sitting with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) two persons came to him; one of them complained about his poverty and the other complained about the prevalence of robberies. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "As regards stealing and robberies, there will shortly come a time when a caravan will go to Mecca (from Medina) without any guard. And regarding poverty, The Hour (Day of Judgment) will not be established till one of you wanders about with his object of charity and will not find anybody to accept it And (no doubt) each one of you will stand in front of Allah and there will be neither a curtain nor an interpreter between him and Allah, and Allah will ask him, 'Did not I give you wealth?' He will reply in the affirmative. Allah will further ask, 'Didn't I send a messenger to you?' And again that person will reply in the affirmative Then he will look to his right and he will see nothing but Hell-fire, and then he will look to his left and will see nothing but Hell-fire. And so, any (each one) of you should save himself from the fire even by giving half of a date-fruit (in charity). And if you do not find a half date-fruit, then (you can do it through saying) a good pleasant word (to your brethren). (See Hadith No. 793 Vol)
