hi: Adi bin Hatim (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jabke main Allah ke Rasool ke saath baitha tha, do log unke paas aaye; ek ne apni ghurbat ki shikayat ki aur doosre ne dako aur chorion ke phailne ki. Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Chori-dakoi ke baare mein, jald hi aisa waqt aayega jab ek qafila Mecca (Madina se) bina kisi rakhwale ke jaayega. Aur ghurbat ke baare mein, Qiyamat (ki ghadi) tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak koi apna sadqa lekar na ghumega aur koi use lene wala nahi milega. Aur (beshak) tum mein se har ek Allah ke saamne khada hoga aur na koi parda hoga na koi tarjuman uske aur Allah ke darmiyan, aur Allah usse poochega: 'Kya maine tumhe maal nahi diya?' Woh haan mein jawab dega. Allah phir poochega: 'Kya maine tumhare paas Rasool nahi bheja?' Aur woh phir haan mein jawab dega. Phir woh apni dahini taraf dekhega aur usse sirf Dozakh ki aag ke siwa kuch nazar nahi aayega, phir woh apni baayi taraf dekhega aur wahan bhi sirf Dozakh ki aag nazar aayegi. Isliye, tum mein se har ek ko chahiye ke woh khud ko Dozakh ki aag se bachaye, chahe aadhi khajoor de kar. Aur agar aadhi khajoor bhi na mile, to (tum aisa kar sakte ho keh) apne bhai se ek achha, aziz lafz kaho."

e: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A time will come upon the people when a person will wander about with gold as Zakat and will not find anybody to accept it, and one man will be seen followed by forty women to be their guardian because of scarcity of men and great number of women
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Ek waqt aayega jab koi apna Zakat ka sona lekar ghumega aur use lene wala koi nahi milega, aur ek mard chalis aurton ke pariwara (rakshak) ke tor par dikhega, kyunke mardon ki kami aur aurton ki bahutayat hogi."

e: Narrated Abu Mas`ud:When the verses of charity were revealed, we used to work as porters. A man came and distributed objects of charity in abundance. And they (the people) said, "He is showing off." And another man came and gave a Sa (a small measure of food grains); they said, "Allah is not in need of this small amount of charity." And then the Divine Inspiration came: "Those who criticize such of the believers who give in charity voluntarily and those who could not find to give in charity except what is available to them
hi: Abu Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab sadqa ki ayaat nazil hui, hum boojh uthaane ka kaam karte the. Ek shaks aaya aur usne bahut zyada sadqa taqseem kiya. Log kehne lage: "Yeh dikhawa kar raha hai." Doosra shaks aaya aur usne ek Sa (thodi maqdaar) diya; log kehne lage: "Allah ko is thodi si sadqa ki zaroorat nahi." Tab Allah ki wahi nazil hui: "Woh log jo un momino par aitraaz karte hain jo apni marzi se sadqa dete hain, aur unpar bhi jinke paas sirf itna hi hai jo woh de sakein..."

e: Narrated Abu Mas`ud Al-Ansari:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered us to give in charity, we used to go to the market and work as porters and get a Mudd (a special measure of grain) and then give it in charity. (Those were the days of poverty) and today some of us have one hundred thousand
hi: Abu Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ansari (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab bhi Allah ke Rasool humein sadqa dene ka hukum dete, hum bazaar jate aur boojh uthaane ka kaam karte aur ek Mudd (ek khaas maqdaar ka anaaj) kamate, phir usse sadqa mein dete. (Yeh gareebi ke din the) aur aaj hum mein se kuch ke paas ek lakh (dirham) tak hai.

e: Narrated `Adi bin Hatim heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying:"Save yourself from Hell-fire even by giving half a date-fruit in charity
hi: Adi bin Hatim (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Nabi ko farmate suna: "Aadhi khajoor sadqa dekar bhi apne aap ko Dozakh ki aag se bacha lo."

e: Narrated Aisha:A lady along with her two daughters came to me asking (for some alms), but she found nothing with me except one date which I gave to her and she divided it between her two daughters, and did not eat anything herself, and then she got up and went away. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) came in and I informed him about this story. He said, "Whoever is put to trial by these daughters and he treats them generously (with benevolence) then these daughters will act as a shield for him from Hell-Fire." (See Hadith No. 24, Vol)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ek aurat apni do beti ke saath (kuch maangne) mere paas aayi, magar mere paas sirf ek khajoor thi jo maine usse di aur usne apni donon betiyon mein baant di aur khud kuch nahi khaya, phir woh uthkar chali gayi. Phir Nabi aaye aur maine unhe yeh waqia bataya. Aap ne farmaya: "Jo bhi in betiyon ke zariye aazmaya jaaye aur unke saath achha suluk kare, yeh betiyan uske liye Dozakh se bachav ki dhaal banengi."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Which charity is the most superior in reward?" He replied, "The charity which you practice while you are healthy, niggardly and afraid of poverty and wish to become wealthy. Do not delay it to the time of approaching death and then say, 'Give so much to such and such, and so much to such and such.' And it has already belonged to such and such (as it is too late)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks Nabi ke paas aaya aur pucha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Kaunsa sadqa ajr mein sabse behtareen hai?" Aap ne jawab diya: "Woh sadqa jo tum tab do jab tum tandurust ho, kanjoosi mehsoos karte ho, gareebi se darte ho aur maldaar bane rehna chahte ho. Ise us waqt tak taal na do jab maut qareeb ho aur phir kaho: 'Falaan ko itna do, falaan ko itna do,' jabke woh maal to us waqt tak falaan-falaan ka ho hi chuka hoga (kyunke ab tum us par ikhtiyar nahi rakhte)."

e: Narrated `Aisha:Some of the wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) asked him, "Who amongst us will be the first to follow you (i.e. die after you)?" He said, "Whoever has the longest hand." So they started measuring their hands with a stick and Sauda's hand turned out to be the longest. (When Zainab bint Jahsh died first of all in the caliphate of `Umar), we came to know that the long hand was a symbol of practicing charity, so she was the first to follow the Prophet (ﷺ) and she used to love to practice charity. (Sauda died later in the caliphate of Muawiya)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi ki kuch biwiyon ne unse pucha: "Humme se sabse pehle aapki pairvi (yaani wafaat) kaun karega?" Aap ne farmaya: "Jiska haath sabse lamba ho." To woh chhadi se apne haath naapne lagi aur Sauda (رضی اللہ عنہا) ka haath sabse lamba nikla. (Jab Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Jahsh (رضی اللہ عنہا) sabse pehle Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki khilafat mein intiqal kar gayi), humein pata chala ke lamba haath sadqa dene ka ishara tha, isliye woh sabse pehle Nabi ki pairvi karne wali thi, aur woh sadqa dena bahut pasand karti thin. (Sauda baad mein Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki khilafat mein intiqal ho gayin.)

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "A man said that he would give something in charity. He went out with his object of charity and unknowingly gave it to a thief. Next morning the people said that he had given his object of charity to a thief. (On hearing that) he said, "O Allah! All the praises are for you. I will give alms again." And so he again went out with his alms and (unknowingly) gave it to an adulteress. Next morning the people said that he had given his alms to an adulteress last night. The man said, "O Allah! All the praises are for you. (I gave my alms) to an adulteress. I will give alms again." So he went out with his alms again and (unknowingly) gave it to a rich person. (The people) next morning said that he had given his alms to a wealthy person. He said, "O Allah! All the praises are for you. (I had given alms) to a thief, to an adulteress and to a wealthy man." Then someone came and said to him, "The alms which you gave to the thief, might make him abstain from stealing, and that given to the adulteress might make her abstain from illegal sexual intercourse (adultery), and that given to the wealthy man might make him take a lesson from it and spend his wealth which Allah has given him, in Allah's cause
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Ek shaks ne kaha woh kuch sadqa dega. Woh apna sadqa lekar bahar gaya aur anjaane mein ek chor ko de diya. Agli subah logon ne kaha ke usne apna sadqa chor ko de diya. (Yeh sunkar) usne kaha: 'Aye Allah! Teri hi hamd hai. Main phir sadqa dunga.' To woh phir apna sadqa lekar nikla aur (anjaane mein) ek zaani aurat ko de diya. Agli subah logon ne kaha ke usne raat apna sadqa ek zaani aurat ko de diya. Shaks ne kaha: 'Aye Allah! Teri hi hamd hai. (Maine apna sadqa) ek zaani aurat ko diya. Main phir sadqa dunga.' To woh phir apna sadqa lekar nikla aur (anjaane mein) ek maldaar shaks ko de diya. (Logon ne) agli subah kaha ke usne apna sadqa ek maldaar shaks ko de diya. Usne kaha: 'Aye Allah! Teri hi hamd hai. (Maine sadqa diya) ek chor ko, ek zaani aurat ko, aur ek maldaar shaks ko.' Phir koi aaya aur usse kaha: 'Jo sadqa tumne chor ko diya, ho sakta hai usse woh chori chhod de, aur jo zaani aurat ko diya, ho sakta hai usse woh zina chhod de, aur jo maldaar shaks ko diya, ho sakta hai usse woh sabaq le aur Allah ne use jo maal diya hai usse Allah ki raah mein kharch kare.'"

e: Narrated Ma'n bin Yazid:My grandfather, my father and I gave the pledge of allegiance to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). The Prophet (ﷺ) got me engaged and then got me married. One day I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) with a complaint. My father Yazid had taken some gold coins for charity and kept them with a man in the mosque (to give them to the poor) But I went and took them and brought them to him (my father). My father said, "By Allah! I did not intend to give them to you. " I took (the case) to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . On that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O Yazid, you will be rewarded for what you intended. O Ma'n, whatever you have taken is yours
hi: Ma'n bin Yazid bataate hain: Mere dada, mere waalid aur maine Allah ke Rasool se bai'at ki. Nabi ne meri mangni karwai aur phir meri shaadi karwai. Ek din main Nabi ke paas ek shikayat lekar gaya. Mere waalid Yazid ne sadqa ke liye kuch sone ke sikke lekar masjid mein ek shaks ke paas rakh diye the (gareebon ko dene ke liye). Magar main gaya aur woh sikke uthakar unhe (apne waalid ko) le gaya. Mere waalid ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam! Mera iraada tumhe dene ka nahi tha." Main yeh maamla Allah ke Rasool ke paas le gaya. Isspar Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Aye Yazid, tumhe jo tumne niyyat ki uska ajr milega. Aye Ma'n, jo bhi tumne liya, woh tumhara hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Seven people will be shaded by Allah under His shade on the day when there will be no shade except His. They are: (1) a just ruler; (2) a young man who has been brought up in the worship of Allah, (i.e. worship Allah (Alone) sincerely from his childhood), (3) a man whose heart is attached to the mosque (who offers the five compulsory congregational prayers in the mosque); (4) two persons who love each other only for Allah's sake and they meet and part in Allah's cause only; (5) a man who refuses the call of a charming woman of noble birth for an illegal sexual intercourse with her and says: I am afraid of Allah; (6) a person who practices charity so secretly that his left hand does not know what his right hand has given (i.e. nobody knows how much he has given in charity). (7) a person who remembers Allah in seclusion and his eyes get flooded with tears
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Saat log Allah ke saaye mein saaya paayenge us din jab uske saaye ke siwa koi saaya nahi hoga: (1) Adil hukmaran; (2) woh jawan jo Allah ki ibadat mein pala-badha ho (yaani apne bachpan se hi khaas Allah ki ibadat karta ho); (3) woh shaks jiska dil masjid se juda ho (jo paanch farz jamaat namazein masjid mein padhta ho); (4) woh do log jo sirf Allah ke liye ek-doosre se mohabbat karte hon, aur sirf Allah ki khaatir hi milte-bichhadte hon; (5) woh mard jo ek khoobsurat aur sharif khandaan ki aurat ki (haram tareeqe se) dawat ko thukra de aur kahe: main Allah se darta hoon; (6) woh shaks jo itni khufia sadqa de ke uske baaye haath ko pata na chale uske dahine haath ne kya diya (yaani koi nahi jaanta usne kitna sadqa diya); (7) woh shaks jo tanhai mein Allah ko yaad kare aur uski aankhein aansuon se bhar jaayein."

e: Narrated Haritha bin Wahab Al-Khuza`i:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "(O people!) Give in charity (for Allah's cause) because a time will come when a person will carry his object of charity from place to place (and he will not find any person to take it) and any person whom he shall request to take it, will reply, 'If you had brought it yesterday I would have taken it, but today I am not in need of it
hi: Haritha bin Wahab Al-Khuza'i (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi ko farmate suna: "(Aye logon!) Sadqa do (Allah ki khaatir), kyunke ek waqt aayega jab koi shaks apna sadqa lekar jagah-jagah ghumega (aur use koi lene wala nahi milega), aur jisko woh dena chaahega usse yeh kahega: 'Agar tum ise kal laate to main le leta, magar aaj mujhe iski zaroorat nahi.'"

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When a woman gives in charity some of the foodstuff (which she has in her house) without spoiling it, she will receive the reward for what she has spent, and her husband will receive the reward because of his earning, and the storekeeper will also have a reward similar to it. The reward of one will not decrease the reward of the others
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jab koi aurat khana (jo uske ghar mein ho) usse bigade bina sadqa deti hai, use uske diye hue ka ajr milega, aur uske shohar ko uski kamaai ka ajr milega, aur bhandaari (store-keeper) ko bhi utna hi ajr milega. Ek ka ajr doosre ka ajr kam nahi karega."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The best charity is that which is practiced by a wealthy person. And start giving first to your dependents
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Behtareen sadqa woh hai jo ek maldaar shaks de. Aur pehle apne zeriwaron (jo aap par nirbhar hain) ko dena shuru karo."

e: Narrated Hakim bin Hizam:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The upper hand is better than the lower hand (i.e. he who gives in charity is better than him who takes it). One should start giving first to his dependents. And the best object of charity is that which is given by a wealthy person (from the money which is left after his expenses). And whoever abstains from asking others for some financial help, Allah will give him and save him from asking others, Allah will make him self-sufficient
hi: Hakim bin Hizam (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Oopar wala haath neeche wale haath se behtar hai (yaani jo sadqa deta hai woh usse behtar hai jo leta hai). Pehle apne zeriwaron ko dena shuru karo. Aur behtareen sadqa woh hai jo ek maldaar shaks apni zaroorat ke baad bacha hue maal se de. Aur jo bhi doosron se maangne se bacha rahe, Allah use khud-kifayat (self-sufficient) banataa hai."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while he was on the pulpit speaking about charity, to abstain from asking others for some financial help and about begging others, saying, "The upper hand is better than the lower hand. The upper hand is that of the giver and the lower (hand) is that of the beggar
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool ko mimbar par sadqa ke baare mein baat karte suna, doosron se madad na maangne aur bheek maangne ke baare mein, aur kaha: "Oopar wala haath neeche wale haath se behtar hai. Oopar wala haath dene wale ka hai, aur neeche wala bheek maangne wale ka."

e: Narrated `Uqba bin Al-Harith:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) offered the `Asr prayer and then hurriedly went to his house and returned immediately. I (or somebody else) asked him (as to what was the matter) and he said, "I left at home a piece of gold which was from the charity and I disliked to let it remain a night in my house, so I got it distributed
hi: Uqba bin Al-Harith (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Nabi ne Asr ki namaz padhi aur jaldi se apne ghar gaye aur foran wapas aaye. Maine (ya kisi aur ne) unse pucha (kya baat hai), Aap ne farmaya: "Main ghar mein sadqa ka ek tukda sona chhod aaya tha, aur mujhe pasand nahi tha ke woh raat bhar mere ghar mein rahe, isliye maine use taqseem karwa diya."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) went out for the `Id prayer on the `Id day and offered a two rak`at prayer; and he neither offered a prayer before it or after it. Then he went towards the women along with Bilal. He preached them and ordered them to give in charity. And some (amongst the women) started giving their forearm bangles and earrings
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi Eid ke din Eid ki namaz ke liye bahar gaye aur do rakat padhi, aur usse pehle ya baad koi (aur namaz) nahi padhi. Phir Aap Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath aurton ki taraf gaye. Aap ne unhe naseehat ki aur sadqa dene ka hukum diya. Kuch aurton ne apni baaliyaan aur kaan ki angoothiyan dena shuru kiya.

e: Narrated Abu Burda bin Abu Musa:that his father said, "Whenever a beggar came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) or he was asked for something, he used to say (to his companions), "Help and recommend him and you will receive the reward for it; and Allah will bring about what He will through His Prophet's tongue
hi: Abu Burda bin Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain, apne waalid ke hawale se: Jab bhi koi bheek maangne wala Allah ke Rasool ke paas aata ya Aap se kuch maanga jaata, Aap (apne sahaba se) kehte: "Uski madad karo aur usse sifarish karo, tumhe iska ajr milega; aur Allah apne Nabi ki zubaan se jo chahega woh karega."

e: Narrated Asma:The Prophet (ﷺ) said to me, "Do not withhold your money, (for if you did so) Allah would withhold His blessings from you." Narrated `Abda: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not withhold your money by counting it (i.e. hoarding it), (for if you did so), Allah would also withhold His blessings from you
hi: Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi ne mujhse kaha: "Apna maal roko mat, warna Allah apni rehmatein tumse rok lega." Abda ke hawale se: Nabi ne farmaya: "Apna maal gin-gin kar roko mat (yaani jama karke rakho), warna Allah bhi apni rehmatein tumse rok lega."

e: Narrated Asma' bint Abu Bakr:that she had gone to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he said, "Do not shut your money bag; otherwise Allah too will withhold His blessings from you. Spend (in Allah's Cause) as much as you can afford
hi: Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Abu Bakr (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Woh Nabi ke paas gayi thin aur Aap ne farmaya: "Apna theli mat band karo, warna Allah bhi apni rehmatein tumse rok lega. Jitna de sakti ho utna (Allah ki raah mein) kharch karo."

e: Narrated Abu Wail:Hudhaifa said, "`Umar said, 'Who amongst you remembers the statement of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about afflictions'?' I said, 'I know it as the Prophet (ﷺ) had said it.' `Umar said, 'No doubt, you are bold. How did he say it?' I said, 'A man's afflictions (wrong deeds) concerning his wife, children and neighbors are expiated by (his) prayers, charity, and enjoining good.' (The sub-narrator Sulaiman added that he said, 'The prayer, charity, enjoining good and forbidding evil.') `Umar said, 'I did not mean that, but I ask about that affliction which will spread like the waves of the sea.' I said, 'O chief of the believers! You need not be afraid of it as there is a closed door between you and it.' He asked, 'Will the door be broken or opened?' I replied, 'No, it will be broken.' He said, 'Then, if it is broken, it will never be closed again?' I replied, 'Yes.' " Then we were afraid to ask what that door was, so we asked Masruq to inquire, and he asked Hudhaifa regarding it. Hudhaifa said, "The door was `Umar. "We further asked Hudhaifa whether `Umar knew what that door meant. Hudhaifa replied in the affirmative and added, "He knew it as one knows that there will be a night before the tomorrow morning
hi: Abu Wail bataate hain: Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne pucha: 'Tum mein se kise Allah ke Rasool ki fitno ke baare mein kahi baat yaad hai?' Maine kaha: 'Mujhe yaad hai jaise Nabi ne kahi thi.' Umar ne kaha: 'Beshak tum himmat wale ho. Unhone kaise kaha?' Maine kaha: 'Mard ki fitne uski biwi, aulad aur padosi se hoti hain, jinka kaffara namaz, sadqa aur amr-bil-ma'roof se ho jaata hai.' (Sulaiman, doosre raawi ne joda: 'namaz, sadqa, amr-bil-ma'roof aur nahi-anil-munkar.') Umar ne kaha: 'Mera matlab yeh nahi tha, mera matlab us fitne se tha jo samundar ki lehron ki tarah phailegi.' Maine kaha: 'Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen! Aapko iski fikar nahi honi chahiye, kyunke aapke aur uske darmiyan ek band darwaza hai.' Umar ne pucha: 'Kya darwaza toota jayega ya khola jayega?' Maine jawab diya: 'Toda jayega.' Umar ne kaha: 'Phir yeh kabhi band nahi hoga?' Maine kaha: 'Haan.'" Iske baad humein us darwaze ke baare mein poochne se dar lagta tha, isliye humne Masruq ko Hudhaifa se poochne bheja. Hudhaifa ne kaha: "Woh darwaza khud Umar the." Humne Hudhaifa se yeh bhi poocha kya Umar jaante the woh darwaza kya hai. Hudhaifa ne haan mein jawab diya aur joda: "Unhe utna hi pata tha jitna kisi ko pata hota hai ke subah se pehle raat aayegi."

e: Narrated Hakim bin Hizam:I said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), "Before embracing Islam I used to do good deeds like giving in charity, slave-manumitting, and the keeping of good relations with Kith and kin. Shall I be rewarded for those deeds?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "You became Muslim with all those good deeds (Without losing their reward)
hi: Hakim bin Hizam (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool se kaha: "Islam qubool karne se pehle main kuch neik amal karta tha, jaise sadqa dena, gulaam azaad karna, aur rishtedaron se achha suluk rakhna. Kya mujhe in amalon ka ajr milega?" Nabi ne jawab diya: "Tum Musalman huye in sab neik amalon ke saath (unke ajr kho bina)."

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When a woman gives in charity from her husband's meals without wasting the property of her husband, she will get a reward for it, and her husband too will get a reward for what he earned and the storekeeper will have the reward likewise
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jab koi aurat apne shohar ke khane se, uska maal barbaad kiye bina, sadqa deti hai, use uska ajr milta hai, aur uske shohar ko bhi uski kamaai ka ajr milta hai, aur bhandaari ko bhi utna hi ajr milta hai."

e: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "An honest Muslim storekeeper who carries out the orders of his master and pays fully what he has been ordered to give with a good heart and pays to that person to whom he was ordered to pay, is regarded as one of the two charitable persons
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Ek imandaar Musalman bhandaari jo apne aaqa ke hukum poore karta hai aur achhe dil se poora dena chahiye jo dene ka hukum diya gaya hai, use woh dene wala jise dene ka hukum tha, yeh do sadqa karne walon mein se ek maana jaayega."

e: Narrated 'Aishah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If a woman gives in charity from her husband's house ..." (See next hadith)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Agar aurat apne shohar ke ghar se sadqa deti hai..." (agli hadith dekhein)

e: Narrate Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If a woman gives in charity from her husband's house .." The Prophet (ﷺ) also said, "If a lady gives meals (in charity) from her husband's house without spoiling her husband's property, she will get a reward and her husband will also get a reward likewise. The husband will get a reward because of his earnings and the woman because of her spending
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Agar aurat apne shohar ke ghar se sadqa deti hai..." Nabi ne yeh bhi farmaya: "Agar koi aurat apne shohar ke ghar se khana (sadqa mein) deti hai, uske shohar ka maal barbaad kiye bina, use ajr milega, aur uske shohar ko bhi utna hi ajr milega. Shohar ko uski kamaai ki wajah se ajr milega, aur aurat ko uske kharch karne ki wajah se."

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When a woman gives in charity from her house meals in Allah's Cause without spoiling her husband's property, she will get a reward for it, and her husband will also get the reward for his earnings and the storekeeper will get a reward likewise
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jab koi aurat apne ghar se Allah ki raah mein khana sadqa deti hai, apne shohar ka maal barbaad kiye bina, use uska ajr milta hai, aur uske shohar ko bhi uski kamaai ka ajr milta hai, aur bhandaari ko bhi utna hi ajr milta hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Every day two angels come down from Heaven and one of them says, 'O Allah! Compensate every person who spends in Your Cause,' and the other (angel) says, 'O Allah! Destroy every miser
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Har din do farishte aasman se utarte hain, aur unme se ek kehta hai: 'Aye Allah! Har us shaks ko badla de jo teri raah mein kharch karta hai,' aur doosra kehta hai: 'Aye Allah! Har kanjoos ko barbaad kar de.'"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The example of a miser and an almsgiver is like the example of two persons wearing iron cloaks." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) also said, "The example of an almsgiver and a miser is like the example of two persons who have two iron cloaks on them from their breasts to their collar bones, and when the almsgiver wants to give in charity, the cloak becomes capacious till it covers his whole body to such an extent that it hides his fingertips and covers his footprints (obliterates his tracks). (1) And when the miser wants to spend, it (the iron cloak) sticks and every ring gets stuck to its place and he tries to widen it, but it did not become wide
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Kanjoos aur sadqa dene wale ki misaal do logon jaisi hai jinhone loahe ke chogha pehne hue hon." Allah ke Rasool ne yeh bhi farmaya: "Sadqa dene wale aur kanjoos ki misaal do logon jaisi hai jinke seene se lekar gale tak loahe ke chogha hon, aur jab sadqa dene wala sadqa dena chahta hai, chogha kushaada ho jaata hai yahan tak ke uske poore jism ko dhak leta hai, itna ke uski ungliyon ki nokon tak chhup jaati hain aur uske paon ke nishaan mit jaate hain. Aur jab kanjoos kharch karna chahta hai, chogha chipak jaata hai aur har kadi apni jagah phans jaati hai, aur woh use chaudaa karne ki koshish karta hai magar woh chaudaa nahi hota."

e: See previous hadith
hi: (Pichhli hadith dekhein.)

e: Narrated Abu Burda:from his father from his grandfather that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Every Muslim has to give in charity." The people asked, "O Allah's Prophet! If someone has nothing to give, what will he do?" He said, "He should work with his hands and benefit himself and also give in charity (from what he earns)." The people further asked, "If he cannot find even that?" He replied, "He should help the needy who appeal for help." Then the people asked, "If he cannot do that?" He replied, "Then he should perform good deeds and keep away from evil deeds and this will be regarded as charitable deeds
hi: Abu Burda bataate hain, apne waalid ke hawale se, unke dada ke hawale se: Nabi ne farmaya: "Har Musalman ko sadqa dena chahiye." Logon ne pucha: "Ya Allah ke Nabi! Agar kisi ke paas dene ko kuch na ho, to woh kya kare?" Aap ne farmaya: "Use apne haathon se kaam karna chahiye jisse use aur usse mile paison se sadqa dene mein faida ho." Logon ne phir pucha: "Agar usse yeh bhi na mile?" Aap ne jawab diya: "Use zaroorat-mand ki madad karni chahiye jo madad maange." Log phir pucha: "Agar woh yeh bhi na kar sake?" Aap ne jawab diya: "To use neik kaam karne chahiye aur bure kaamon se bachna chahiye, aur yehi sadqa mana jaayega."

e: Narrated Um 'Atiyya:A sheep was sent to me (Nusaiba Al-Ansariya) (in charity) and I sent some of it to `Aisha. The Prophet asked `Aisha for something to eat. `Aisha replied that there was nothing except what Nusaiba Al-Ansariya had sent of that sheep. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to her, "Bring it as it has reached its place
hi: Um Atiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ek bhed mujhe (Nusaiba Al-Ansariya ko) bheji gayi (sadqa mein) aur maine usme se kuch Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko bheja. Nabi ne Ayesha se khane ke liye kuch maanga. Ayesha ne jawab diya ke unke paas sirf woh hai jo Nusaiba Al-Ansariya ne us bhed mein se bheja hai. Nabi ne unse kaha: "Woh laao, kyunke woh apni jagah (yaani halal khaana) pahunch chuki hai."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "There is no Zakat on less than five camels and also there is no Zakat on less than five Awaq (of silver). (5 Awaq = 22 Fransa Riyals of Yemen or 200 Dirhams.) And there is no Zakat on less than five Awsuq. (A special measure of food-grains, and one Wasq equals 60 Sa's.) (For gold 20, Dinars i.e. equal to 12 Guinea English. No Zakat for less than 12 Guinea (English) of gold or for silver less than 22 Fransa Riyals of Yemen.) Narrated Abi Sa`id Al-Khudri: I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying (as above)
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Paanch oonton se kam par Zakat nahi, aur paanch Awaq (chandi) se kam par Zakat nahi (5 Awaq = Yemen ke 22 Fransa Riyal ya 200 Dirham), aur paanch Awsuq (anaaj ki khaas maqdaar, ek Wasq 60 Sa ke barabar) se kam par Zakat nahi." (Sone ke liye 20 Dinar, yaani 12 English Guinea ke barabar. 12 Guinea se kam sone par ya 22 Fransa Riyal se kam chandi par Zakat nahi.) Abu Saeed Al-Khudri se yeh bhi riwayat hai: Maine Nabi ko yehi farmate suna.

e: Narrated Anas:Abu Bakr wrote to me what Allah had instructed His Apostle (ﷺ) to do regarding the one who had to pay one Bint Makhad (i.e. one year-old she-camel) as Zakat, and he did not have it but had got Bint Labun (two year old she-camel). (He wrote that) it could be accepted from him as Zakat, and the collector of Zakat would return him 20 Dirhams or two sheep; and if the Zakat payer had not a Bint Makhad, but he had Ibn Labun (a two year old he-camel) then it could be accepted as his Zakat, but he would not be paid anything
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Bakr ne mujhe likha jo Allah ne apne Rasool ko hukum diya tha us shaks ke baare mein jisse ek Bint Makhad (ek saal ki oontni) Zakat mein deni ho aur uske paas na ho magar uske paas Bint Labun (do saal ki) ho — (unhone likha) yeh Zakat mein qubool ki jaayegi, aur Zakat lene wala use 20 Dirham ya do bhedein wapas dega; aur agar Zakat dene wale ke paas Bint Makhad na ho magar Ibn Labun (do saal ka nar oont) ho, to woh bhi Zakat mein qubool kiya jaayega, magar usse kuch wapas nahi diya jaayega.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I am a witness that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) offered the Id prayer before delivering the sermon and then he thought that the women would not be able to hear him (because of the distance), so he went to them along with Bilal who was spreading his garment. The Prophet (ﷺ) advised and ordered them to give in charity. So the women started giving their ornaments (in charity). (The sub-narrator Aiyub pointed towards his ears and neck meaning that they gave ornaments from those places such as earrings and necklaces)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Main gawah hoon ke Allah ke Rasool ne khutba dene se pehle Eid ki namaz padhi, phir socha ke aurten (doori ki wajah se) unhe sun nahi payengi, isliye woh Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath unke paas gaye, jo apna libaas failaaye hue the. Nabi ne unhe naseehat ki aur sadqa dene ka hukum diya. To aurtein apne zewar (sadqa mein) dene lagi. (Aiyub, doosre raawi ne apne kaanon aur gardan ki taraf ishara kiya, yaani woh baaliyaan aur haar de rahi thi.)

e: Narrated Anas:Abu Bakr wrote to me what was made compulsory by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and that was (regarding the payments of Zakat): Neither the property of different people may be taken together nor the joint property may be split for fear of (paying more, or receiving less) Zakat
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Bakr ne mujhe likha jo Allah ke Rasool ne (Zakat ke baare mein) farz kiya tha: "Na alag-alag logon ka maal ek saath jama kiya jaaye, na jama maal ko alag kiya jaaye (Zakat zyada dene ya kam lene ke dar se)."

e: Narrated Anas:Abu Bakr wrote to me what Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has made compulsory (regarding Zakat) and this was mentioned in it: If a property is equally owned by two partners, they should pay the combined Zakat and it will be considered that both of them have paid their Zakat equally
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Bakr ne mujhe likha jo Allah ke Rasool ne (Zakat ke baare mein) farz kiya tha, aur isme yeh bhi tha: "Agar do saathi barabar maal ke maalik hain, to woh dono milkar Zakat ada karenge aur yeh samjha jaayega ke donon ne barabar Zakat di."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:A Bedouin asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about the emigration. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "May Allah have mercy on you! The matter of emigration is very hard. Have you got camels? Do you pay their Zakat?" The Bedouin said, "Yes, I have camels and I pay their Zakat." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, Work beyond the seas and Allah will not decrease (waste) any of your good deeds." (See Hadith No. 260 Vol)
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek dehati ne Allah ke Rasool se hijrat ke baare mein pucha. Nabi ne farmaya: "Allah tumpar reham kare! Hijrat ka maamla bahut mushkil hai. Kya tumhare paas oont hain? Kya tum unki Zakat dete ho?" Dehati ne kaha: "Haan, mere paas oont hain aur main unki Zakat deta hoon." Nabi ne farmaya: "Samundar paar (bahut door) kaam karo, Allah tumhare kisi bhi neik amal ko kam nahi karega."

e: Narrated Anas:Abu Bakr , wrote to me about the Zakat which Allah had ordered His Apostle to observe: Whoever had to pay Jadha (Jadha means a four-year-old she-camel) as Zakat from his herd of camels and he had not got one, and he had Hiqqa (three-year-old she-camel), that Hiqqa should be accepted from him along with two sheep if they were available or twenty Dirhams (one Durham equals about 1/4 Saudi Riyal) and whoever had to pay Hiqqa as Zakat and he had no Hiqqa but had a Jadha, the Jadha should be accepted from him, and the Zakat collector should repay him twenty Dirhams or two sheep; and whoever had to pay Hiqqa as Zakat and he had not got one, but had a Bint Labun (two-year-old she-camel), it should be accepted from him along with two sheep or twenty Dirhams; and whoever had to pay Bint Labun and had a Hiqqa, that Hiqqa should be accepted from him and the Zakat collector should repay him twenty Dirhams or two sheep; and whoever had to pay Bint Labun and he had not got one but had a Bint Makhad (one-year-old she camel), that Bint Makhad should be accepted from him along with twenty Dirhams or two sheep
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Bakr ne mujhe Zakat ke baare mein likha jo Allah ne apne Rasool ko hukum diya tha: Jise apne oonton ke jhund se Jadha (chaar saal ki oontni) Zakat mein deni ho aur uske paas na ho magar uske paas Hiqqa (teen saal ki oontni) ho, to woh Hiqqa qubool ki jaayegi, saath do bhedein (agar mile) ya bees Dirham (ek Dirham taqreeban ek-chauthai Saudi Riyal); aur jise Hiqqa deni ho aur uske paas na ho magar Jadha ho, to Jadha qubool ki jaayegi, aur Zakat lene wala use bees Dirham ya do bhedein wapas karega; aur jise Hiqqa deni ho aur uske paas na ho magar Bint Labun (do saal ki oontni) ho, to woh do bhedon ya bees Dirham ke saath qubool ki jaayegi; aur jise Bint Labun deni ho aur uske paas Hiqqa ho, to Hiqqa qubool ki jaayegi aur usse bees Dirham ya do bhedein wapas ki jaayengi; aur jise Bint Labun deni ho aur uske paas na ho magar Bint Makhad (ek saal ki) ho, to woh bees Dirham ya do bhedon ke saath qubool ki jaayegi.

e: Narrated Anas:When Abu Bakr; sent me to (collect the Zakat from) Bahrain, he wrote to me the following:-- (In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful). These are the orders for compulsory charity (Zakat) which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had made obligatory for every Muslim, and which Allah had ordered His Apostle to observe: Whoever amongst the Muslims is asked to pay Zakat accordingly, he should pay it (to the Zakat collector) and whoever is asked more than that (what is specified in this script) he should not pay it; for twenty-four camels or less, sheep are to be paid as Zakat; for every five camels one sheep is to be paid, and if there are between twenty-five to thirty-five camels, one Bint Makhad is to be paid; and if there are between thirty-six to forty-five (camels), one Bint Labun is to be paid; and if there are between forty-six to sixty (camels), one Hiqqa is to be paid; and if the number is between sixty-one to seventy-five (camels), one Jadha is to be paid; and if the number is between seventy-six to ninety (camels), two Bint Labuns are to be paid; and if they are from ninety-one to one-hundredand twenty (camels), two Hiqqas are to be paid; and if they are over one-hundred and-twenty (camels), for every forty (over one-hundred-and-twenty) one Bint Labun is to be paid, and for every fifty camels (over one-hundred-and-twenty) one Hiqqa is to be paid; and who ever has got only four camels, has to pay nothing as Zakat, but if the owner of these four camels wants to give something, he can. If the number of camels increases to five, the owner has to pay one sheep as Zakat. As regards the Zakat for the (flock) of sheep; if they are between forty and one-hundred-and-twenty sheep, one sheep is to be paid; and if they are between one-hundred-and-twenty to two hundred (sheep), two sheep are to be paid; and if they are between two-hundred to three-hundred (sheep), three sheep are to be paid; and for over three-hundred sheep, for every extra hundred sheep, one sheep is to be paid as Zakat. And if somebody has got less than forty sheep, no Zakat is required, but if he wants to give, he can. For silver the Zakat is one-fortieth of the lot (i.e. 2.5%), and if its value is less than two-hundred Dirhams, Zakat is not required, but if the owner wants to pay he can
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Abu Bakr ne mujhe Bahrain (Zakat jama karne) bheja, unhone mujhe likha: "(Allah ke naam se, jo bada meherbaan, nihaayat reham karne wala hai) Yeh farz sadqe (Zakat) ke hukum hain jo Allah ke Rasool ne har Musalman par farz kiye the, jinhe Allah ne apne Rasool ko poora karne ka hukum diya. Musalmanon mein se jisse iske mutabiq Zakat maangi jaaye, use deni chahiye, aur jisse isse zyada maanga jaaye, use nahi deni chahiye; chaubees ya usse kam oonton par bhedein di jaayengi Zakat mein; har paanch oonton par ek bhed; agar pachchees se paintis oont hon, ek Bint Makhad di jaayegi; aur agar chhattees se paintalis, ek Bint Labun; aur agar chhiyalis se saath, ek Hiqqa; aur agar ekaasath se pachhattar, ek Jadha; aur agar chhihattar se navve, do Bint Labun; aur agar ekaanave se ek sau bees, do Hiqqa; aur agar ek sau bees se zyada, har chaalees (ek sau bees se upar) par ek Bint Labun, aur har pachaas par ek Hiqqa; aur jiske paas sirf chaar oont hon, uspar Zakat nahi, magar agar maalik kuch dena chahe, de sakta hai. Agar tadaad paanch tak pahunche, maalik ko ek bhed Zakat mein deni hogi. Bhedon ki Zakat ke baare mein: agar chaalees se ek sau bees bhedein hon, ek bhed deni hai; agar ek sau bees se do sau, do bhedein; agar do sau se teen sau, teen bhedein; aur teen sau se upar, har sau par ek bhed. Agar kisi ke paas chaalees se kam bhedein hon, Zakat zaroori nahi, magar agar woh dena chahe, de sakta hai. Chandi ki Zakat ek-chaalisvaan hissa hai (yaani 2.5%), aur agar iski qeemat do sau Dirham se kam ho, Zakat zaroori nahi, magar agar maalik dena chahe, de sakta hai."

e: Narrated Anas:Abu Bakr wrote to me what Allah had ordered His Apostle (about Zakat) which goes: Neither an old nor a defected animal, nor a male-goat may be taken as Zakat except if the Zakat collector wishes (to take it)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Bakr ne mujhe likha jo Allah ne apne Rasool ko (Zakat ke baare mein) hukum diya tha: "Na buda ya kamzor janwar, na nar bakra Zakat mein liya jaaye, siwaye jab Zakat lene wala khud chahe."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Abu Bakr said, "By Allah! If they (pay me the Zakat and) withhold even a young (female) goat which they used to pay during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), I will fight with them for it." `Umar said, "It was nothing but Allah Who opened Abu Bakr's chest towards the decision to fight, and I came to know that his decision was right
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Bakr ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam! Agar unhone (Zakat dete waqt) ek chhoti bakri bhi roki jo woh Allah ke Rasool ke zamane mein dete the, main isi wajah se unse jung karunga." Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Yeh kuch aur nahi tha, balki Allah ne Abu Bakr ka dil is faisle ki taraf khol diya, aur mujhe pata chal gaya ke unka faisla sahih tha."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent Mu`adh to Yemen, he said (to him), "YOU are going to people of a (Divine) Book. First of all invite them to worship Allah (alone) and when they come to know Allah, inform them that Allah has enjoined on them, five prayers in every day and night; and if they start offering these prayers, inform them that Allah has enjoined on them, the Zakat. And it is to be taken from the rich amongst them and given to the poor amongst them; and if they obey you in that, take Zakat from them and avoid (don't take) the best property of the people as Zakat
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool ne Mu'adh ko Yemen bheja, unhone (unse) kaha: "Tum aisi qaum ke paas ja rahe ho jo Ahl-e-Kitaab (Aasmaani Kitaab wale) hain. Sabse pehle unhe Allah (akele) ki ibadat karne ki dawat do, aur jab woh Allah ko pehchaan jaayen, unhe bataao ke Allah ne unpar din-raat mein paanch namazein farz ki hain; aur agar woh yeh namazein padhna shuru kar dein, unhe bataao ke Allah ne unpar Zakat farz ki hai. Aur yeh unke maldaaron se li jaayegi aur unke gareebon ko di jaayegi; aur agar woh isme tumhari itaa'at karen, unse Zakat lo, magar logon ka sabse achha maal Zakat mein na lo (na leo)."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "No Zakat is imposed on less than five Awsuq of dates; no Zakat is imposed on less than five Awaq of silver, and no Zakat is imposed on less than five camels
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Paanch Awsuq khajoor se kam par Zakat farz nahi; paanch Awaq chandi se kam par Zakat farz nahi; aur paanch oonton se kam par Zakat farz nahi."

e: Narrated Abu Dhar:Once I went to him (the Prophet (ﷺ) ) and he said, "By Allah in Whose Hands my life is (or probably said, 'By Allah, except Whom none has the right to be worshipped) whoever had camels or cows or sheep and did not pay their Zakat, those animals will be brought on the Day of Resurrection far bigger and fatter than before and they will tread him under their hooves, and will butt him with their horns, and (those animals will come in circle): When the last does its turn, the first will start again, and this punishment will go on till Allah has finished the judgments amongst the people
hi: Abu Dharr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar main unke (Nabi ke) paas gaya aur Aap ne farmaya: "Us zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai (ya shayad kaha: Us zaat ki qasam jiske siwa koi mabood nahi), jiske paas oont, gaay ya bhedein hon aur usne unki Zakat nahi di, Qiyamat ke din woh janwar pehle se bhi bade aur mote hokar laaye jaayenge, aur woh use apne khuron se koochenge aur singon se maarenge. Aur (yeh janwar chakkar mein aayenge): jab aakhri ki baari khatam hogi, pehla phir se shuru karega, aur yeh saza tab tak jaari rahegi jab tak Allah logon ke darmiyan faisla mukammal na kar le."

e: Narrated 'Is-haq bin `Abdullah bin Abi Talha:I heard Anas bin Malik saying, "Abu Talha had more property of date-palm trees gardens than any other amongst the Ansar in Medina and the most beloved of them to him was Bairuha garden, and it was in front of the Mosque of the Prophet (ﷺ) . Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to go there and used to drink its nice water." Anas added, "When these verses were revealed:--'By no means shall you Attain righteousness unless You spend (in charity) of that Which you love. ' (3.92) Abu Talha said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Allah, the Blessed, the Superior says: By no means shall you attain righteousness, unless you spend (in charity) of that which you love. And no doubt, Bairuha' garden is the most beloved of all my property to me. So I want to give it in charity in Allah's Cause. I expect its reward from Allah. O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Spend it where Allah makes you think it feasible.' On that Allah's Apostle said, 'Bravo! It is useful property. I have heard what you have said (O Abu Talha), and I think it would be proper if you gave it to your Kith and kin.' Abu Talha said, I will do so, O Allah's Apostle.' Then Abu Talha distributed that garden amongst his relatives and his cousins
hi: Ishaq bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko kehte suna: "Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas Madina ke Ansaar mein sabse zyada khajoor ke baag the, aur unhe sabse pyara Bairuha naam ka baag tha, jo Nabi ki masjid ke saamne tha. Allah ke Rasool wahan jate aur uska achha paani pite." Anas ne joda: "Jab yeh ayaat nazil hui: 'Tum kabhi neki ko nahi paoge jab tak us cheez ko sadqa na do jo tumhe pyari ho' (3:92), Abu Talha ne Allah ke Rasool se kaha: 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Allah, jo mubarak aur azeem hai, farmata hai: Tum kabhi neki ko nahi paoge jab tak us cheez ko sadqa na do jo tumhe pyari ho. Aur beshak Bairuha baag mera sabse pyara maal hai. Isliye main use Allah ki raah mein sadqa dena chahta hoon. Mujhe Allah se iska ajr chahiye. Ya Allah ke Rasool! Ise wahan kharch karein jahan Allah aapko munasib lage.' Isspar Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: 'Wah! Yeh faidamand maal hai. Maine jo tumne kaha suna hai (Aye Abu Talha), aur mujhe lagta hai theek hoga agar tum ise apne rishtedaron ko de do.' Abu Talha ne kaha: 'Main aisa hi karunga, Aye Allah ke Rasool.' Phir Abu Talha ne woh baag apne rishtedaron aur chachazaad bhaiyon mein taqseem kar diya."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:On `Id ul Fitr or `Id ul Adha Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went out to the Musalla. After finishing the prayer, he delivered the sermon and ordered the people to give alms. He said, "O people! Give alms." Then he went towards the women and said, "O women! Give alms, for I have seen that the majority of the dwellers of Hell-Fire were you (women)." The women asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What is the reason for it?" He replied, "O women! You curse frequently, and are ungrateful to your husbands. I have not seen anyone more deficient in intelligence and religion than you. O women, some of you can lead a cautious wise man astray." Then he left. And when he reached his house, Zainab, the wife of Ibn Mas`ud, came and asked permission to enter It was said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! It is Zainab." He asked, 'Which Zainab?" The reply was that she was the wife of Ibn Mas'ud. He said, "Yes, allow her to enter." And she was admitted. Then she said, "O Prophet of Allah! Today you ordered people to give alms and I had an ornament and intended to give it as alms, but Ibn Mas`ud said that he and his children deserved it more than anybody else." The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Ibn Mas`ud had spoken the truth. Your husband and your children had more right to it than anybody else
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Eid-ul-Fitr ya Eid-ul-Adha ke din Allah ke Rasool Musalla gaye. Namaz khatam karke, Aap ne khutba diya aur logon ko sadqa dene ka hukum diya. Aap ne kaha: "Aye logon! Sadqa do." Phir woh aurton ki taraf gaye aur kaha: "Aye aurton! Sadqa do, kyunke maine dekha hai ke Dozakh mein zyada tar bashinde tum (aurtein) ho." Aurton ne pucha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Iski kya wajah hai?" Aap ne jawab diya: "Aye aurton! Tum aksar laanat karti ho, aur apne shohar ki na-shukri karti ho. Maine tumse zyada aqal aur deen mein kami wali koi nahi dekhi jo hoshiyar aqalmand ko bhi bahka de." Phir Aap chale gaye. Jab Aap apne ghar pahunche, Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا), Ibn Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki biwi, aayin aur andar aane ki ijazat maangi. Kisi ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Yeh Zainab hain." Aap ne pucha: "Kaunsi Zainab?" Jawab mila Ibn Mas'ud ki biwi. Aap ne kaha: "Haan, unhe andar aane do." Aur unhe andar aane diya gaya. Phir unhone kaha: "Aye Allah ke Nabi! Aaj aapne logon ko sadqa dene ka hukum diya, aur mere paas ek zewar tha jo main sadqa dena chahti thi, magar Ibn Mas'ud ne kaha ke woh aur unke bachche isse zyada haqdaar hain." Nabi ne jawab diya: "Ibn Mas'ud ne sach kaha. Tumhare shohar aur tumhare bachche isse zyada haqdaar hain."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "There is no Zakat either on a horse or a slave belonging to a Muslim
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Kisi Musalman ke ghode ya gulaam par Zakat nahi."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There is no Zakat either on a slave or on a horse belonging to a Muslim
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Kisi Musalman ke gulaam ya ghode par Zakat nahi."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) sat on a pulpit and we sat around him. Then he said, "The things I am afraid of most for your sake (concerning what will befall you after me) is the pleasures and splendors of the world and its beauties which will be disclosed to you." Somebody said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Can the good bring forth evil?" The Prophet (ﷺ) remained silent for a while. It was said to that person, "What is wrong with you? You are talking to the Prophet (ﷺ) while he is not talking to you." Then we noticed that he was being inspired divinely. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) wiped off his sweat and said, "Where is the questioner?" It seemed as if the Prophet (ﷺ) liked his question. Then he said, "Good never brings forth evil. Indeed it is like what grows on the banks of a water-stream which either kill or make the animals sick, except if an animal eats its fill the Khadira (a kind of vegetable) and then faces the sun, and then defecates and urinates and grazes again. No doubt this wealth is sweet and green. Blessed is the wealth of a Muslim from which he gives to the poor, the orphans and to needy travelers. (Or the Prophet said something similar to it) No doubt, whoever takes it illegally will be like the one who eats but is never satisfied, and his wealth will be a witness against him on the Day of Resurrection
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Nabi mimbar par baithe aur hum unke aas-paas baithe. Aap ne farmaya: "Jo cheez mujhe tumhare liye sabse zyada khauf dilati hai (tumhare baad mein hone wale haalaat ke baare mein) woh duniya ki khushiyaan aur uski chamak-damak hain jo tumhare saamne khol di jaayengi." Kisi ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Kya achhi cheez se bura nikal sakta hai?" Nabi khamosh rahe. Us shaks se kaha gaya: "Tumhe kya hua? Tum Nabi se baat kar rahe ho jabke Aap tumse baat nahi kar rahe." Phir humne dekha unpar wahi utar rahi hai. Nabi ne apna paseena poncha aur pucha: "Sawaal karne wala kahan hai?" Lagta tha Nabi ko uska sawaal pasand aaya. Phir Aap ne farmaya: "Achhi cheez se bura nahi nikalta. Beshak yeh (duniyawi maal) uski tarah hai jo nadi ke kinare ugta hai jo ya to janwaron ko maar deta hai ya bimar kar deta hai, siwaye us janwar ke jo pet bhar Khadira (ek qisam ki sabzi) khaake, suraj ki taraf mun karke, phir peshab-paakhana karke phir se charne lagta hai. Beshak yeh maal meetha aur hara-bhara hai. Mubarak hai woh Musalman ka maal jisse woh gareebon, yateemon aur zaroorat-mand musafiron ko deta hai." (Ya Nabi ne isse milti-julti baat kahi.) "Beshak, jo bhi ise ghair-qanooni tareeqe se leta hai, woh us shaks jaisa hai jo khaata hai magar kabhi santusht nahi hota, aur uska maal Qiyamat ke din uske khilaaf gawah banega."

e: Narrated `Amr bin Al-Harith:Zainab, the wife of `Abdullah said, "I was in the Mosque and saw the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, 'O women ! Give alms even from your ornaments.' " Zainab used to provide for `Abdullah and those orphans who were under her protection. So she said to `Abdullah, "Will you ask Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) whether it will be sufficient for me to spend part of the Zakat on you and the orphans who are under my protection?" He replied "Will you yourself ask Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ?" (Zainab added): So I went to the Prophet and I saw there an Ansari woman who was standing at the door (of the Prophet (ﷺ) ) with a similar problem as mine. Bilal passed by us and we asked him, 'Ask the Prophet (ﷺ) whether it is permissible for me to spend (the Zakat) on my husband and the orphans under my protection.' And we requested Bilal not to inform the Prophet (ﷺ) about us. So Bilal went inside and asked the Prophet (ﷺ) regarding our problem. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "Who are those two?" Bilal replied that she was Zainab. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Which Zainab?" Bilal said, "The wife of `Abdullah (bin Mas`ud)." The Prophet said, "Yes, (it is sufficient for her) and she will receive a double reward (for that): One for helping relatives, and the other for giving Zakat
hi: Amr bin Al-Harith bataate hain: Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا), Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) (bin Mas'ud) ki biwi, ne kaha: "Main masjid mein thi aur maine Nabi ko farmate suna: 'Aye aurton! Sadqa do, chahe apne zewar mein se ho.'" Zainab Abdullah aur unke pariwara mein rehne wale yateemon ki dekhbhal karti thi. Isliye unhone Abdullah se kaha: "Kya tum Allah ke Rasool se pucchoge kya Zakat ka kuch hissa tumpar aur mere pariwara ke yateemon par kharch karna kaafi hoga?" Unhone jawab diya: "Kya tum khud Allah ke Rasool se pucchogi?" (Zainab ne joda:) Isliye main Nabi ke paas gayi aur wahan ek Ansari aurat ko dekha jo darwaze par khadi thi, uski bhi yehi mushkil thi jaisi meri. Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) humare paas se guzre aur humne unse kaha: "Nabi se poochhein kya Zakat mera shohar aur mere pariwara ke yateemon par kharch karna jaiz hai." Aur humne Bilal se guzarish ki ke woh humare naam Nabi ko na batayen. To Bilal andar gaye aur Nabi se humari mushkil pucchi. Nabi ne pucha: "Yeh dono kaun hain?" Bilal ne jawab diya Zainab. Nabi ne pucha: "Kaunsi Zainab?" Bilal ne kaha: "Abdullah (bin Mas'ud) ki biwi." Nabi ne farmaya: "Haan, (jaiz hai), aur unhe dohra ajr milega: ek rishtedaron ki madad ka, aur doosra Zakat dene ka."

e: Narrated Zainab:(the daughter of Um Salama) My mother said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shall I receive a reward if I spend for the sustenance of Abu Salama's offspring, and in fact they are also my sons?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Spend on them and you will get a reward for what you spend on them
hi: Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Um Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) ki beti) bataati hain: Meri maa ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Kya mujhe ajr milega agar main Abu Salama ki aulad ki parvarish ke liye kharch karun, jabke woh mere bhi bete hain?" Nabi ne jawab diya: "Unpar kharch karo, tumhe jo bhi kharch karogi uska ajr milega."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered (a person) to collect Zakat, and that person returned and told him that Ibn Jamil, Khalid bin Al-Walid, and `Abbas bin `Abdul Muttalib had refused to give Zakat." The Prophet said, "What made Ibn Jamil refuse to give Zakat though he was a poor man, and was made wealthy by Allah and His Apostle ? But you are unfair in asking Zakat from Khalid as he is keeping his armor for Allah's Cause (for Jihad). As for `Abbas bin `Abdul Muttalib, he is the uncle of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and Zakat is compulsory on him and he should pay it double
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne (kisi ko) Zakat jama karne ka hukum diya, aur woh shaks wapas aakar bataya ke Ibn Jamil, Khalid bin Al-Walid, aur Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib ne Zakat dene se inkaar kar diya hai. Nabi ne farmaya: "Ibn Jamil ne kis wajah se Zakat dene se inkaar kiya jabke woh gareeb tha aur Allah aur uske Rasool ne use maldaar banaya? Magar tum Khalid se Zakat maangne mein na-insaafi kar rahe ho, kyunke woh apna zire-e-jang (hathiyaar) Allah ki raah mein (Jihad ke liye) rakhte hain. Rahi baat Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib ki, woh Allah ke Rasool ke chacha hain aur unpar Zakat farz hai aur unhe woh dohri deni chahiye."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Some Ansari persons asked for (something) from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he gave them. They again asked him for (something) and he again gave them. And then they asked him and he gave them again till all that was with him finished. And then he said "If I had anything. I would not keep it away from you. (Remember) Whoever abstains from asking others, Allah will make him contented, and whoever tries to make himself self-sufficient, Allah will make him self-sufficient. And whoever remains patient, Allah will make him patient. Nobody can be given a blessing better and greater than patience
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Kuch Ansaar logon ne Allah ke Rasool se (kuch) maanga aur Aap ne unhe diya. Unhone phir maanga aur Aap ne phir diya. Aur phir maanga aur Aap ne phir diya, yahan tak ke Aap ke paas jo tha sab khatam ho gaya. Phir Aap ne farmaya: "Agar mere paas kuch hota, main use tumse chhupata nahi. (Yaad rakho) Jo bhi doosron se maangne se bacha rahe, Allah use santusht kar dega, aur jo khud-kifayat banne ki koshish kare, Allah use khud-kifayat banata hai. Aur jo sabr karega, Allah use sabr dega. Kisi ko sabr se behtar aur bada tohfa nahi diya gaya."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "By Him in Whose Hand my life is, it is better for anyone of you to take a rope and cut the wood (from the forest) and carry it over his back and sell it (as a means of earning his living) rather than to ask a person for something and that person may give him or not
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Us zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, tum mein se kisi ke liye behtar hai ke woh ek rassi lekar jungle se lakdi kaate aur apni pusht par le jaakar bech de (rozi kamane ke liye), bajaye is ke ke woh kisi se kuch maange, chahe woh de ya na de."

e: Narrated Az-Zubair bin Al-`Awwam:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It is better for anyone of you to take a rope (and cut) and bring a bundle of wood (from the forest) over his back and sell it and Allah will save his face (from the Hell-Fire) because of that, rather than to ask the people who may give him or not
hi: Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Awwam (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Tum mein se kisi ke liye behtar hai ke woh ek rassi (lekar kaat kar) apni pusht par lakdi ka gathar laaye, aur ise bech de, aur Allah is wajah se uska chehra (Dozakh ki aag se) bacha lega, bajaye is ke ke woh logon se maange jo use dein ya na dein."

e: Narrated `Urwa bin Az-Zubair and Sa`id bin Al-Musaiyab:Hakim bin Hizam said, "(Once) I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (for something) and he gave it to me. Again I asked and he gave (it to me). Again I asked and he gave (it to me). And then he said, "O Hakim! This property is like a sweet fresh fruit; whoever takes it without greediness, he is blessed in it, and whoever takes it with greediness, he is not blessed in it, and he is like a person who eats but is never satisfied; and the upper (giving) hand is better than the lower (receiving) hand." Hakim added, "I said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) , 'By Him (Allah) Who sent you with the Truth, I shall never accept anything from anybody after you, till I leave this world.' " Then Abu Bakr (during his caliphate) called Hakim to give him his share from the war booty (like the other companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) ), he refused to accept anything. Then `Umar (during his caliphate) called him to give him his share but he refused. On that `Umar said, "O Muslims! I would like you to witness that I offered Hakim his share from this booty and he refused to take it." So Hakim never took anything from anybody after the Prophet (ﷺ) till he died
hi: Urwa bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Sa'id bin Al-Musaiyab bataate hain: Hakim bin Hizam (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "(Ek baar) maine Allah ke Rasool se (kuch) maanga aur Aap ne diya. Phir maine maanga aur Aap ne diya. Phir maine maanga aur Aap ne diya, aur phir farmaya: 'Aye Hakim! Yeh maal ek meethe, taaze phal jaisa hai; jo bina lalach ke use leta hai, usme barkat hoti hai, aur jo lalach se leta hai, usme barkat nahi hoti, aur woh us shaks jaisa hai jo khaata hai magar kabhi santusht nahi hota; aur oopar wala (dene wala) haath neeche wale (lene wale) haath se behtar hai.'" Hakim ne joda: "Maine Allah ke Rasool se kaha: 'Us zaat ki qasam jisne aapko haqq ke saath bheja, aapke baad main kabhi kisi se kuch nahi loonga, jab tak duniya nahi chhodta.'" Baad mein Abu Bakr (apni khilafat mein) ne Hakim ko bulaya unka hissa dene ke liye (jaise doosre sahaba ko diya jaata tha), unhone kuch bhi lene se inkaar kiya. Phir Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) (apni khilafat mein) ne bhi bulaya unka hissa dene ke liye, magar unhone phir inkaar kiya. Isspar Umar ne kaha: "Aye Musalmano! Main chahta hoon tum gawah raho ke maine Hakim ko unka hissa is maal-e-ghanimat mein se pesh kiya aur unhone lene se inkaar kiya." Isliye Hakim ne Nabi ke baad kabhi kisi se kuch nahi liya, jab tak unka intiqal na ho gaya.

e: Narrated `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to give me something but I would say to him, "would you give it to a poorer and more needy one than l?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said to me, "Take it. If you are given something from this property, without asking for it or having greed for it take it; and if not given, do not run for it
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool mujhe kuch dete the magar main unse kehta: "Kya aap ise kisi zyada gareeb aur zaroorat-mand ko de sakte hain?" Nabi ne mujhse kaha: "Ise le lo. Agar tumhe is maal mein se bina maange ya lalach kiye kuch diya jaaye, use le lo; aur agar na diya jaaye, uske peechhe mat bhaago."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A man keeps on asking others for something till he comes on the Day of Resurrection without any piece of flesh on his face." The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "On the Day of Resurrection, the Sun will come near (to, the people) to such an extent that the sweat will reach up to the middle of the ears, so, when all the people are in that state, they will ask Adam for help, and then Moses, and then Muhammad (ﷺ) ." The sub-narrator added "Muhammad will intercede with Allah to judge amongst the people. He will proceed on till he will hold the ring of the door (of Paradise) and then Allah will exalt him to Maqam Mahmud (the privilege of intercession, etc.). And all the people of the gathering will send their praises to Allah
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Ek shaks doosron se maangte-maangte Qiyamat ke din aisa aayega ke uske chehre par gosht ka koi tukda nahi hoga." Nabi ne joda: "Qiyamat ke din suraj (logon ke) itna qareeb aayegi ke paseena kaanon ke beech tak pahunchega. Isliye jab sab log is haal mein honge, woh Adam se madad maangenge, phir Musa se, phir Muhammad se." Doosre raawi ne joda: "Muhammad Allah se logon ke darmiyan faisla karne ki shifa'at karenge. Woh chalte jayenge yahan tak ke (Jannat ke) darwaze ki kondi pakd lenge, phir Allah unhe Maqam-e-Mahmood (shifa'at ka darja) tak buland karega. Aur (mahshar ke maidan mein) sab log Allah ki tareef karenge."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The poor person is not the one who asks a morsel or two (of meals) from the others, but the poor is the one who has nothing and is ashamed to beg from others
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Gareeb woh nahi jo doosron se ek-do lukma khaana maangta hai, balki gareeb woh hai jiske paas kuch nahi aur jise doosron se maangne mein sharm aati hai."

e: Narrated Ash-Shu`bi:The clerk of Al-Mughira bin Shu`ba narrated, "Muawiya wrote to Al-Mughira bin Shu`ba: Write to me something which you have heard from the Prophet (ﷺ) ." So Al-Mughira wrote: I heard the Prophet saying, "Allah has hated for you three things: -1. Vain talks, (useless talk) that you talk too much or about others. -2. Wasting of wealth (by extravagance) -3. And asking too many questions (in disputed religious matters) or asking others for something (except in great need). (See Hadith No. 591, Vol. Ill)
hi: Ash-Shu'bi bataate hain: Al-Mughira bin Shu'ba (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke munshi ne bataya: "Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Al-Mughira bin Shu'ba ko likha: 'Mujhe woh cheez likho jo tumne Nabi se suni ho.'" To Al-Mughira ne likha: "Maine Nabi ko farmate suna: 'Allah ne tumhare liye teen cheezein napasand ki hain: 1. Faaltu baatein (bekaar baatein, jaise zyada baatein karna ya doosron ke baare mein), 2. Maal barbaad karna (fizoolkharchi), 3. Aur zyada sawaal poochhna (deeni jhagdon mein) ya doosron se (bina zaroorat) maangna.'"

e: Narrated Sa`d (bin Abi Waqqas):Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) distributed something (from the resources of Zakat) amongst a group of people while I was sitting amongst them, but he left a man whom I considered the best of the lot. So, I went up to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and asked him secretly, "Why have you left that person? By Allah! I consider him a believer." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Or merely a Muslim (Who surrender to Allah)." I remained quiet for a while but could not help repeating my question because of what I knew about him. I said, "O Allah's Apostle! Why have you left that person? By Allah! I consider him a believer. " The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Or merely a Muslim." I remained quiet for a while but could not help repeating my question because of what I knew about him. I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Why have you left that person? By Allah! I consider him a believer." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Or merely a Muslim." Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I give to a person while another is dearer to me, for fear that he may be thrown in the Hell-fire on his face (by reneging from Islam)
hi: Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kuch (Zakat ke maal mein se) kuch logon mein taqseem kiya jabke main unme baitha tha, magar Aap ne ek shaks ko chhod diya jise main sabse achha samajhta tha. Isliye main Allah ke Rasool ke paas gaya aur khufia tor par pucha: "Aapne usse kyun chhoda? Allah ki qasam, main use momin samajhta hoon." Nabi ne farmaya: "Ya sirf Musalman (jo Allah ke saamne surrender kar chuka ho)." Main thodi der khamosh raha magar apna sawaal dohraye bina na rah saka, kyunke mujhe uske baare mein jo pata tha uski wajah se. Maine kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Aapne usse kyun chhoda? Allah ki qasam, main use momin samajhta hoon." Nabi ne farmaya: "Ya sirf Musalman." Main thodi der khamosh raha magar apna sawaal dohraye bina na rah saka. Maine kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Aapne usse kyun chhoda? Allah ki qasam, main use momin samajhta hoon." Nabi ne farmaya: "Ya sirf Musalman." Phir Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Main ek shaks ko deta hoon jabke doosra mujhe zyada pyara hota hai, is dar se ke kahin woh (Islam se murtad hokar) chehre ke bal Dozakh mein na daala jaaye."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The poor person is not the one who goes round the people and ask them for a mouthful or two (of meals) or a date or two but the poor is that who has not enough (money) to satisfy his needs and whose condition is not known to others, that others may give him something in charity, and who does not beg of people
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Gareeb woh nahi jo logon ke aas-paas ghum kar ek-do lukma ya ek-do khajoor maangta hai, balki gareeb woh hai jiske paas apni zaroorten poori karne ke liye paisa na ho aur jiske haalat ka doosron ko pata na ho taake woh use sadqa dein, aur jo khud logon se bheek nahi maangta."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No doubt, it is better for a person to take a rope and proceed in the morning to the mountains and cut the wood and then sell it, and eat from this income and give alms from it than to ask others for something
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Beshak, kisi shaks ke liye behtar hai ke woh ek rassi le aur subah pahadon ki taraf jaakar lakdi kaate aur bech de, aur usi se khaaye aur sadqa de, bajaye is ke ke woh doosron se kuch maange."

e: Narrated Abu Humaid As-Sa`idi:We took part in the holy battle of Tabuk in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) and when we arrived at the Wadi-al-Qura, there was a woman in her garden. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked his companions to estimate the amount of the fruits in the garden, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) estimated it at ten Awsuq (One Wasaq = 60 Sa's) and 1 Sa'= 3 kg. approximately). The Prophet (ﷺ) said to that lady, "Check what your garden will yield." When we reached Tabuk, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There will be a strong wind tonight and so no one should stand and whoever has a camel, should fasten it." So we fastened our camels. A strong wind blew at night and a man stood up and he was blown away to a mountain called Taiy, The King of Aila sent a white mule and a sheet for wearing to the Prophet (ﷺ) as a present, and wrote to the Prophet (ﷺ) that his people would stay in their place (and will pay Jizya taxation.) (1) When the Prophet (ﷺ) reached Wadi-al- Qura he asked that woman how much her garden had yielded. She said, "Ten Awsuq," and that was what Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had estimated. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I want to reach Medina quickly, and whoever among you wants to accompany me, should hurry up." The sub-narrator Ibn Bakkar said something which meant: When the Prophet (ﷺ) saw Medina he said, "This is Taba." And when he saw the mountain of Uhud, he said, "This mountain loves us and we love it. Shall I tell you of the best amongst the Ansar?" They replied in the affirmative. He said, "The family of Bani-n-Najjar, and then the family of Bani Sa`ida or Bani Al-Harith bin Al-Khazraj. (The above-mentioned are the best) but there is goodness in all the families of Ansar
hi: Abu Humaid As-Sa'idi (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Nabi ke saath Tabuk ki jung mein shareek hue, aur jab hum Wadi-al-Qura pahunche, wahan ek aurat apne baag mein thi. Nabi ne apne sahaba se baag mein phalon ki tadaad andaza lagane ko kaha, aur Allah ke Rasool ne khud das Awsuq andaza lagaya (ek Wasq 60 Sa ke barabar hai, aur ek Sa taqreeban 3 kg ka hota hai). Nabi ne us aurat se kaha: "Dekho tumhara baag kitna paidawaar dega." Jab hum Tabuk pahunche, Nabi ne farmaya: "Aaj raat tez hawa chalegi, isliye koi khada na ho, aur jiske paas oont ho, use bandh de." Isliye humne apne oont bandh diye. Raat ko tez hawa chali aur ek shaks khada tha aur woh Taiy naam ke pahad tak udaa diya gaya. Aila ke raja ne Nabi ko tohfe mein ek safed khachchar aur pehnne ka libaas bheja, aur Nabi ko likha ke uski qaum apni jagah rahegi (aur Jizya tax degi). Jab Nabi Wadi-al-Qura pahunche, unhone us aurat se pucha uske baag mein kitna paida hua. Usne kaha: "Das Awsuq," aur yehi wahi tha jo Allah ke Rasool ne andaza lagaya tha. Phir Nabi ne farmaya: "Main jaldi Madina pahunchna chahta hoon, aur tum mein se jo mere saath aana chahe, use jaldi karni chahiye." Ibn Bakkar (doosre raawi) ne bataya ke jab Nabi ne Madina dekha, farmaya: "Yeh Taba hai." Aur jab unhone Uhud pahad dekha, farmaya: "Yeh pahad humse mohabbat karta hai aur hum isse. Kya main tumhe Ansaar mein sabse behtareen bataun?" Unhone haan mein jawab diya. Aap ne farmaya: "Bani An-Najjar ka pariwara, phir Bani Sa'ida ka ya Bani Al-Harith bin Al-Khazraj ka." (Yeh mentioned hain sabse behtareen, magar Ansaar ke sab pariwaron mein bhalai hai.)

e: Narrated Salim bin `Abdullah from his father:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "On a land irrigated by rain water or by natural water channels or if the land is wet due to a near by water channel Ushr (i.e. one-tenth) is compulsory (as Zakat); and on the land irrigated by the well, half of an Ushr (i.e. one-twentieth) is compulsory (as Zakat on the yield of the land)
hi: Salim bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ), apne waalid ke hawale se: Nabi ne farmaya: "Baarish ke paani se ya qudrati paani ki nehron se sinchi hui zameen par, ya agar zameen paas ki nehr ki wajah se geeli ho, Ushr (yaani ek-dasvaan hissa) Zakat mein farz hai; aur kue se sinchi hui zameen par, aadha Ushr (yaani ek-bisvaan hissa) Zakat mein farz hai (zameen ki paidawaar par)."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There is no Zakat on less than five Awsuq (of dates), or on less than five camels, or on less than five Awaq of silver
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Paanch Awsuq (khajoor) se kam par Zakat nahi, ya paanch oonton se kam par, ya paanch Awaq chandi se kam par."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Dates used to be brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) immediately after being plucked. Different persons would bring their dates till a big heap collected (in front of the Prophet). Once Al-Hasan and Al-Husain were playing with these dates. One of them took a date and put it in his mouth. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) looked at him and took it out from his mouth and said, "Don't you know that Muhammad's offspring do not eat what is given in charity?
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Khajoor todne ke foran baad Allah ke Rasool ke paas laayi jaati thi. Alag-alag log apni khajoorein laate yahan tak ke Nabi ke saamne ek bada dher jama ho jaata. Ek baar Al-Hasan (Alayhis Salam) aur Al-Husain (Alayhis Salam) in khajooron ke saath khel rahe the. Unme se ek ne ek khajoor lekar apne mun mein daal li. Allah ke Rasool ne unhe dekha aur unke mun se nikaalte huye kaha: "Kya tumhe nahi pata Muhammad ki aulad sadqe mein diya hua khaana nahi khaati?"

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) had forbidden the sale of dates till they were good (ripe), and when it was asked what it meant, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Till there is no danger of blight
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne khajoor ki bikri se mana kiya jab tak woh pak (paki) na ho jaaye, aur poocha gaya iska matlab kya hai, Nabi ne farmaya: "Jab tak keede lagne ka khatra na rahe."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) had forbidden the sale of fruits till they were ripe (free from blight)
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne phalon ki bikri se mana kiya jab tak woh pak (paki) na ho jaayen (keedon se mehfooz ho jaayen).

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the selling of fruits until they were ripe. The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "It means that they become red
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne phalon ki bikri se mana kiya jab tak woh pak (pake) na ho jaaye. Nabi ne joda: "Iska matlab hai jab tak woh laal na ho jaaye."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:`Umar bin Al-Khattab gave a horse in charity in Allah's Cause and later he saw it being sold in the market and intended to purchase it. Then he went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and asked his permission. The Prophet said, "Do not take back what you have given in charity." For this reason, Ibn `Umar never purchased the things which he had given in charity, and in case he had purchased something (unknowingly) he would give it in charity again
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Umar bin Khattab (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Allah ki raah mein ek ghoda sadqa mein diya, aur baad mein use bazaar mein bikte dekha aur ise khareedne ka iraada kiya. Woh Nabi ke paas gaye aur ijazat maangi. Nabi ne farmaya: "Jo sadqa mein de chuke, use wapas mat lo." Isi wajah se Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kabhi woh cheezein wapas nahi khareedi jo unhone sadqa mein di thi, aur agar (anjaane mein) kuch khareedte, use phir sadqa kar dete.

e: Narrated `Umar:Once I gave a horse in Allah's Cause (in charity) but that person did not take care of it. I intended to buy it, as I thought he would sell it at a low price. So, I asked the Prophet (ﷺ) about it. He said, "Neither buy, nor take back your alms which you have given, even if the seller were willing to sell it for one Dirham, for he who takes back his alms is like the one who swallows his own vomit
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar maine Allah ki raah mein ek ghoda sadqa diya magar us shaks ne uski dekhbhal nahi ki. Maine ise khareedne ka iraada kiya, ye soch kar ke woh use kam qeemat mein bechega. Isliye maine Nabi se iske baare mein pucha. Aap ne farmaya: "Na khareedo, na apna diya hua sadqa wapas lo, chahe bechne wala ise ek Dirham mein bechne ko taiyaar ho, kyunke jo apna sadqa wapas leta hai, woh us shaks jaisa hai jo apni khud ki ulti nigal jaata hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Al-Hasan bin `Ali took a date from the dates given in charity and put it in his mouth. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Expel it from your mouth. Don't you know that we do not eat a thing which is given in charity?
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Al-Hasan bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne sadqe mein di gayi khajooron mein se ek khajoor uthakar apne mun mein daal li. Nabi ne farmaya: "Ise apne mun se nikaal do. Kya tumhe nahi pata hum sadqe mein di gayi cheez nahi khate?"

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) saw a dead sheep which had been given in charity to a freed slave-girl of Maimuna, the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ) . The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Why don't you get the benefit of its hide?" They said, "It is dead." He replied, "Only to eat (its meat) is illegal
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne ek murda bhed dekhi jo Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki biwi) ki azaad ki hui launDi ko sadqa mein di gayi thi. Nabi ne farmaya: "Kyun na tum iske chamde ka fayda uthaao?" Unhone kaha: "Yeh to murda hai." Aap ne jawab diya: "Sirf khana haram hai (khaal ka istemal nahi)."

e: Narrated Al-Aswad:`Aisha intended to buy Barira (a slave-girl) in order to manumit her and her masters intended to put the condition that her Al-wala would be for them. `Aisha mentioned that to the Prophet (ﷺ) who said to her, "Buy her, as the "Wala" is for the manumitted." Once some meat was presented to the Prophet (ﷺ) and `Aisha said to him, "This (meat) was given in charity to Barira." He said, "It is an object of charity for Barira but a gift for us
hi: Al-Aswad bataate hain: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne Barira (رضی اللہ عنہا) (ek launDi) ko khareedne ka iraada kiya taake use azaad kar sakein, aur uske maalikon ne shart rakhi ke uski Wala (waraasat ka rishta) unke paas rahegi. Ayesha ne yeh Nabi ko bataya, jinhone unhe kaha: "Ise khareed lo, kyunke Wala azaad karne wale ki hoti hai." Ek baar Nabi ko kuch gosht pesh kiya gaya, Ayesha ne unse kaha: "Yeh (gosht) Barira ko sadqa mein diya gaya tha." Aap ne farmaya: "Barira ke liye yeh sadqa hai, magar humare liye ek tohfa."

e: Narrated Um 'Atiyya Al-Ansariya:The Prophet (ﷺ) went to `Aisha and asked her whether she had something (to eat). She replied that she had nothing except the mutton (piece) which Nusaiba (Um 'Atiyya) had sent to us (Barira) in charity." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It has reached its place and now it is not a thing of charity but a gift for us
hi: Um Atiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) Al-Ansariya bataati hain: Nabi Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas gaye aur pucha kya unke paas kuch (khane ko) hai. Unhone jawab diya ke unke paas kuch nahi siwaye us bakri ke tukde ke jo Nusaiba (Um Atiya) ne unhe (Barira (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke zariye) sadqa mein bheja tha. Nabi ne farmaya: "Yeh apni jagah pahunch chuka hai, ab yeh sadqa nahi balki humare liye ek tohfa hai."
