e: Narrated Anas:Some meat was presented to the Prophet (ﷺ) and it had been given to Barira (the freed slave-girl of Aisha) in charity. He said, "This meat is a thing of charity for Barira but it is a gift for us
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ko kuch gosht pesh kiya gaya jo Barira (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ki azaad ki hui launDi) ko sadqa mein diya gaya tha. Aap ne farmaya: "Yeh gosht Barira ke liye sadqa hai, magar humare liye ek tohfa."

e: Narrated Abu Ma`bad:(the slave of Ibn `Abbas) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to Mu`adh when he sent him to Yemen, "You will go to the people of the Scripture. So, when you reach there, invite them to testify that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah, and that Muhammad is His Apostle. And if they obey you in that, tell them that Allah has enjoined on them five prayers in each day and night. And if they obey you in that tell them that Allah has made it obligatory on them to pay the Zakat which will be taken from the rich among them and given to the poor among them. If they obey you in that, then avoid taking the best of their possessions, and be afraid of the curse of an oppressed person because there is no screen between his invocation and Allah
hi: Abu Ma'bad (Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke gulam) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Mu'adh se, jab unhe Yemen bhej rahe the, kaha: "Tum Ahl-e-Kitaab logon ke paas jaoge. Isliye jab tum wahan pahucho, unhe gawahi dene ki dawat do ke Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahi aur Muhammad uske Rasool hain. Aur agar woh isme tumhari itaa'at karen, unhe bataao ke Allah ne unpar har din-raat paanch namazein farz ki hain. Aur agar woh isme tumhari itaa'at karen, unhe bataao ke Allah ne unpar Zakat farz ki hai jo unke maldaaron se li jaayegi aur unke gareebon ko di jaayegi. Agar woh isme tumhari itaa'at karen, unke sabse achhe maal lene se bacho, aur mazloom ki badua se daro, kyunke uski dua aur Allah ke darmiyan koi parda nahi."

e: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Abu Aufa : Whenever a person came to the Prophet (ﷺ) with his alms, the Prophet (ﷺ) would say, "O Allah! Send your Blessings upon so and so." My father went to the Prophet (ﷺ) with his alms and the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! Send your blessings upon the offspring of Abu Aufa
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Aufa bataate hain: Jab bhi koi shaks Nabi ke paas apna sadqa lekar aata, Nabi kehte: "Aye Allah! Falaan par apni rehmatein utaar." Mere waalid apna sadqa lekar Nabi ke paas gaye, aur Nabi ne farmaya: "Aye Allah! Abu Aufa ki aulad par apni rehmatein utaar."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A man from Bani Israel asked someone from Bani Israel to give him a loan of one thousand Dinars and the later gave it to him. The debtor went on a voyage (when the time for the payment of the debt became due) but he did not find a boat, so he took a piece of wood and bored it and put 1000 Dinars in it and threw it into the sea. The creditor went out and took the piece of wood to his family to be used as fire-wood." (See Hadith No. 488 B, Vol. 3). And the Prophet (ﷺ) narrated the narration (and said), "When he sawed the wood, he found his money
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Bani Israel ke ek shaks ne doosre Bani Israel se hazaar Dinar ka qarz maanga aur usne de diya. Qarzdaar ek safar par gaya (jab qarz wapas karne ka waqt aaya) magar usse koi kashti nahi mili, isliye usne ek lakdi ka tukda lekar usme surakh kiya aur usme hazaar Dinar rakhkar samundar mein phenk diya. Qarz dene wala bahar gaya aur us lakdi ke tukde ko apne ghar leke gaya jalane ke liye." Aur Nabi ne yeh kahani (aage) bayan ki (aur kaha): "Jab usne lakdi kaati, usne apna paisa paaya."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "There is no compensation for one killed or wounded by an animal or by falling in a well, or because of working in mines; but Khumus is compulsory on Rikaz
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Kisi janwar se ya kuye mein girne se, ya khaan (mine) mein kaam karte hue marne ya zakhmi hone par koi mua'wza nahi, magar Rikaz (dafn khazaana) par Khumus (paanchwan hissa) farz hai."

e: Narrated Abu Humaid Al-Sa`idi:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) appointed a man called Ibn Al-Lutbiya, from the tribe of Al-Asd to collect Zakat from Bani Sulaim. When he returned, (after collecting the Zakat) the Prophet (ﷺ) checked the account with him
hi: Abu Humaid Al-Sa'idi (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Ibn Al-Lutbiya naam ke shaks ko, jo Al-Asd qabile se tha, Bani Sulaim se Zakat jama karne ke liye muqarrar kiya. Jab woh wapas aaya (Zakat jama karke), Nabi ne uska hisaab jaancha.

e: Narrated Anas:Some people from `Uraina tribe came to Medina and its climate did not suit them, so Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) allowed them to go to the herd of camels (given as Zakat) and they drank their milk and urine (as medicine) but they killed the shepherd and drove away all the camels. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent (men) in their pursuit to catch them, and they were brought, and he had their hands and feet cut, and their eyes were branded with heated pieces of iron and they were left in the Harra (a stony place at Medina) biting the stones. (See Hadith No. 234, Vol)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Uraina qabile ke kuch log Madina aaye aur Madina ki aab-o-hawa unhe raast nahi aayi, isliye Allah ke Rasool ne unhe (Zakat mein aaye) oonton ke jhund ki taraf jane ki ijazat di aur unhone unka doodh aur peshab (dawa ke tor par) piya, magar unhone charwahe ko qatl kar diya aur sab oont hankaar le gaye. To Allah ke Rasool ne unhe pakadne ke liye (log) bheje, aur unhe pakad kar laaya gaya, aur unke haath-paon kaat diye gaye, aur unki aankhon mein garam loahe se daag diya gaya, aur unhe Al-Harra (Madina ki ek patharili jagah) mein chhod diya gaya jahan woh patthar chabate rahe.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:I took `Abdullah bin Abu Talha to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to perform Tahnik for him. (Tahnik was a custom among the Muslims that whenever a child was born they used to take it to the Prophet (ﷺ) who would chew a piece of date and put a part of its juice in the child's mouth). I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) and he had an instrument for branding in his hands and was branding the camels of Zakat
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko Allah ke Rasool ke paas laaya taake Aap unke liye Tahnik karein. (Tahnik Musalmanon mein ek riwaaj tha ke jab bhi koi bachcha paida hota, use Nabi ke paas le jaate jo khajoor chaba kar uska rasa bachche ke mun mein daalte.) Maine Nabi ko dekha aur unke haath mein daagne ka aala tha aur woh Zakat ke oonton ko daag rahe the.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) enjoined the payment of one Sa' of dates or one Sa' of barley as Zakat-ul-Fitr on every Muslim slave or free, male or female, young or old, and he ordered that it be paid before the people went out to offer the `Id prayer. (One Sa' = 3 Kilograms approx)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne har Musalman par — gulaam ya azaad, mard ya aurat, jawan ya budha — ek Sa khajoor ya ek Sa jau Zakat-ul-Fitr ke tor par farz ki, aur hukum diya ke yeh Eid ki namaz ke liye jaane se pehle di jaaye. (Ek Sa taqreeban 3 kg ke barabar hai.)

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) made it incumbent on all the slave or free Muslims, male or female, to pay one Sa' of dates or barley as Zakat-ul-Fitr
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne sab gulaam ya azaad Musalmanon, mard ya aurat, par ek Sa khajoor ya jau Zakat-ul-Fitr ke tor par farz kiya.

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id:We used to give one Sa' of barley as Sadaqat-ul-Fitr (per head)
hi: Abu Saeed (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum ek Sa jau (har sar par) Sadqat-ul-Fitr ke tor par dete the.

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:We used to give one Sa' of meal or one Sa' of barley or one Sa' of dates, or one Sa' of cottage cheese or one Sa' of Raisins (dried grapes) as Zakat-ul-Fitr
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum ek Sa aata, ya ek Sa jau, ya ek Sa khajoor, ya ek Sa panir, ya ek Sa kishmish Zakat-ul-Fitr ke tor par dete the.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered (Muslims) to give one Sa' of dates or one Sa' of barley as Zakat-ul-Fitr. The people regarded two Mudds of wheat as equal to that
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne ek Sa khajoor ya ek Sa jau Zakat-ul-Fitr ke tor par dene ka hukum diya. Log do Mudd gehun ko iske barabar samajhne lage.

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:In the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) we used to give one Sa' of food or one Sa' of dates or one Sa' of barley or one Sa' of Raisins (dried grapes) as Sadaqat-ul-Fitr. And when Muawiya became the Caliph and the wheat was (available in abundance) he said, "I think (observe) that one Mudd (of wheat) equals two Mudds (of any of the above mentioned things)
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ke zamane mein hum ek Sa khaana, ya ek Sa khajoor, ya ek Sa jau, ya ek Sa kishmish Sadqat-ul-Fitr ke tor par dete the. Jab Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) khalifa bane aur gehun (bahutayat mein) mila, unhone kaha: "Mera khayaal hai ek Mudd (gehun) do Mudd (upar batayi cheezon mein se) ke barabar hai."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered the people to pay Zakat-ul-Fitr before going to the `Id prayer
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne logon ko Eid ki namaz ke liye jaane se pehle Zakat-ul-Fitr dene ka hukum diya.

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:In the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) , we used to give one Sa' of food (edible things) as Sadaqat-ul-Fitr (to the poor). Our food used to be either of barley, raisins (dried grapes), cottage cheese or dates
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ke zamane mein hum ek Sa khaane ki cheez Sadqat-ul-Fitr ke tor par dete the. Humara khaana jau, kishmish, panir, ya khajoor hota tha.

e: Narrated Nafi`:Ibn `Umar said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) made incumbent on every male or female, free man or slave, the payment of one Sa' of dates or barley as Sadaqat-ul-Fitr (or said Sadaqa-Ramadan)." The people then substituted half Sa' of wheat for that. Ibn `Umar used to give dates (as Sadaqat-ul-Fitr). Once there was scarcity of dates in Medina and Ibn `Umar gave barley. 'And Ibn `Umar used to give Sadaqat-ul- Fitr for every young and old person. He even used to give on behalf of my children. Ibn `Umar used to give Sadaqat-ul-Fitr to those who had been officially appointed for its collection. People used to give Sadaqat-ul-Fitr (even) a day or two before the `Id
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Nabi ne har mard-aurat, azaad-gulaam par ek Sa khajoor ya jau Sadqat-ul-Fitr (ya kaha Sadqa-Ramadan) ke tor par farz kiya." Baad mein logon ne iski jagah aadha Sa gehun dena shuru kiya. Ibn Umar khajoor dete the (Sadqat-ul-Fitr ke tor par). Ek baar Madina mein khajoor ki kami hui aur Ibn Umar ne jau diya. Ibn Umar har jawan-budhe ke liye Sadqat-ul-Fitr dete the. Woh mere bachchon ki taraf se bhi dete the. Ibn Umar Sadqat-ul-Fitr un logon ko dete jo iske jama karne ke liye rasmi tor par muqarrar kiye gaye the. Log Sadqat-ul-Fitr Eid se ek ya do din pehle dete the.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has made Sadaqat-ul-Fitr obligatory, (and it was), either one Sa' of barley or one Sa' of dates (and its payment was obligatory) on young and old people, and on free men as well as on slaves
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Sadqat-ul-Fitr farz kiya, (aur woh) ya to ek Sa jau ya ek Sa khajoor tha (aur iska dena farz tha) jawan-budhe, azaad-gulaam sab par.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abbas:Al-Fadl (his brother) was riding behind Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and a woman from the tribe of Khath'am came and Al-Fadl started looking at her and she started looking at him. The Prophet (ﷺ) turned Al-Fadl's face to the other side. The woman said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! The obligation of Hajj enjoined by Allah on His devotees has become due on my father and he is old and weak, and he cannot sit firm on the Mount; may I perform Hajj on his behalf?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Yes, you may." That happened during the Hajj-al-Wida (of the Prophet (ﷺ)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Al-Fadl (unke bhai) Allah ke Rasool ke peechhe sawar the aur Khath'am qabile ki ek aurat aayi, Al-Fadl usse dekhne lage aur woh unhe. Nabi ne Al-Fadl ka chehra doosri taraf mod diya. Aurat ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Allah ne apne bandon par Hajj farz kiya hai, aur mere waalid budhe aur kamzor hain, woh sawari par theek se baith nahi sakte; kya main unki taraf se Hajj kar sakti hoon?" Nabi ne jawab diya: "Haan, kar sakti ho." Yeh Hajj-al-Wida (Nabi ke aakhri Hajj) ke waqt hua.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:I saw that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to ride on his Mount at Dhul Hulaifa and used to start saying, "Labbaik" when the Mount stood upright
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Maine dekha ke Allah ke Rasool Dhul-Hulaifa mein apni sawari par sawar hote aur jab sawari seedhi khadi ho jaati, Talbiya kehna shuru karte.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) started saying, "Labbaik" from Dhul-Hulaifa when his Mount stood upright carrying him
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Dhul-Hulaifa se Talbiya kehna shuru kiya jab unki sawari unhe le kar seedhi khadi ho gayi.

e: Narrated 'Aishah:The Prophet (ﷺ) sent my brother, 'Abdur Rahman with me to Tan'im for the 'Umra, and he made me ride on the packsaddle (of a camel). 'Umar said, "Be ready to travel for Hajj as it (Hajj) is one of the two kind of Jihad
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi ne mere bhai Abdur Rahman ko mere saath Tan'im bheja Umrah ke liye, aur unhone mujhe (oont ki) paiksaddal par sawar karwaya. Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Hajj ke safar ke liye taiyaar raho, kyunke yeh do tarah ke Jihad mein se ek hai."

e: Narrated Thumama bin `Abdullah bin Anas:Anas performed the Hajj on a packsaddle and he was not a miser. Anas said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) performed Hajj on a packsaddle and the same Mount was carrying his baggage too
hi: Thumama bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Anas ne paiksaddal par Hajj kiya aur woh kanjoos nahi the. Anas ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool ne bhi paiksaddal par Hajj kiya, aur usi sawari par unka saaman bhi tha."

e: Narrated Al-Qasim bin Muhammad:`Aisha said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! You performed `Umra but I did not." He said, "O `Abdur-Rahman! Go along with your sister and let her perform `Umra from Tan`im." `Abdur-Rahman made her ride over the packsaddle of a she-camel and she performed `Umra
hi: Al-Qasim bin Muhammad bataate hain: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Aapne Umrah kiya magar maine nahi kiya." Aap ne kaha: "Aye Abdur-Rahman! Apni behn ke saath jaao aur unhe Tan'im se Umrah karne do." Abdur-Rahman ne unhe oontni ki paiksaddal par sawar karwaya aur unhone Umrah kiya.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) was asked, "Which is the best deed?" He said, "To believe in Allah and His Apostle." He was then asked, "Which is the next (in goodness)?" He said, "To participate in Jihad in Allah's Cause." He was then asked, "Which is the next?" He said, "To perform Hajj-Mabrur
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi se pucha gaya: "Kaunsa amal sabse behtareen hai?" Aap ne kaha: "Allah aur uske Rasool par iman lana." Phir pucha gaya: "Uske baad kaunsa?" Aap ne kaha: "Allah ki raah mein Jihad karna." Phir pucha gaya: "Uske baad kaunsa?" Aap ne kaha: "Hajj-e-Mabroor (qubool shuda Hajj)."

e: Narrated `Aisha:(the mother of the faithful believers) I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We consider Jihad as the best deed." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The best Jihad (for women) is Hajj Mabrur
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Ummul-Momineen) bataati hain: Maine kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Hum Jihad ko sabse behtareen amal samajhte hain." Nabi ne farmaya: "Aurton ke liye behtareen Jihad Hajj-e-Mabroor hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever performs Hajj for Allah's pleasure and does not have sexual relations with his wife, and does not do evil or sins then he will return (after Hajj free from all sins) as if he were born anew
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jo Allah ki raza ke liye Hajj kare aur apni biwi se humbistari na kare, aur na koi bura amal ya gunah kare, woh (Hajj ke baad) is tarah wapas aayega jaise woh naya paida hua ho (gunahon se bilkul paak)."

e: Narrated Zaid bin Jubair:I went to visit `Abdullah bin `Umar at his house which contained many tents made of cotton cloth and these were encircled with Suradik (part of the tent). I asked him from where, should one assume Ihram for Umra. He said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had fixed as Miqat (singular of Mawaqit) Qarn for the people of Najd, Dhul-Hulaifa for the people of Medina, and Al-Juhfa for the people of Sham
hi: Zaid bin Jubair bataate hain: Main Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke ghar unse milne gaya, jisme cotton kapde ke bahut se khaimay the aur Suradiq (khaimay ka hissa) se ghire hue the. Maine unse pucha kahan se Umrah ke liye Ihram baandhna chahiye. Unhone kaha: "Allah ke Rasool ne Najd walon ke liye Qarn, Madina walon ke liye Dhul-Hulaifa, aur Sham walon ke liye Al-Juhfa ko Miqat (Ihram baandhne ki jagah) muqarrar kiya tha."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The people of Yemen used to come for Hajj and used not to bring enough provisions with them and used to say that they depend on Allah. On their arrival in Medina they used to beg the people, and so Allah revealed, "And take a provision (with you) for the journey, but the best provision is the fear of Allah
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Yemen ke log Hajj ke liye aate the aur apne saath kaafi saaman nahi laate the, aur kehte: "Hum Allah par bharosa rakhte hain." Madina pahunchkar woh logon se maangte the, isliye Allah ne yeh ayat nazil ki: "Aur safar ke liye saaman lekar chalo, magar behtareen saaman Allah ka khauf hai."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) made Dhul-Hulaifa as the Miqat for the people of Medina; Al-Juhfa for the people of Sham; Qarn-al-Manazil for the people of Najd; and Yalamlam for the people of Yemen; and these Mawaqit are for the people at those very places, and besides them for those who come through those places with the intention of performing Hajj and `Umra; and whoever is living within these boundaries can assume Ihram from the place he starts, and the people of Mecca can assume Ihram from Mecca
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Madina walon ke liye Dhul-Hulaifa, Sham walon ke liye Al-Juhfa, Najd walon ke liye Qarn-al-Manazil, aur Yemen walon ke liye Yalamlam ko Miqat muqarrar kiya, aur yeh Miqat un logon ke liye hain jo wahin rehte hain, aur unke ilawa un logon ke liye bhi jo un jagahon se guzarte huye Hajj-Umrah karne ka iraada rakhte hain; aur jo in seemaon ke andar rehta hai, woh jahan se chalna shuru kare wahin se Ihram baandh sakta hai, aur Mecca wale Mecca se hi Ihram baandhen.

e: Narrated Nafi`:`Abdullah bin `Umar said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'The people of Medina should assume Ihram from Dhul-Hulaifa; the people of Sham from Al-Juhfa; and the people of Najd from Qarn." And `Abdullah added, "I was informed that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said, 'The people of Yemen should assume Ihram from Yalamlam
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: 'Madina wale Dhul-Hulaifa se, Sham wale Al-Juhfa se, aur Najd wale Qarn se Ihram baandhen.'" Aur Abdullah ne joda: "Mujhe bataya gaya ke Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: 'Yemen wale Yalamlam se Ihram baandhen.'"

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had fixed Dhul Hulaifa as the Miqat for the people of Medina; Al-Juhfa for the people of Sham; and Qarn Ul-Manazil for the people of Najd; and Yalamlam for the people of Yemen. So, these (above mentioned) are the Mawaqit for all those living at those places, and besides them for those who come through those places with the intention of performing Hajj and `Umra and whoever lives within these places should assume Ihram from his dwelling place, and similarly the people of Mecca can assume Ihram from Mecca
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Madina walon ke liye Dhul-Hulaifa, Sham walon ke liye Al-Juhfa, aur Najd walon ke liye Qarn-ul-Manazil, aur Yemen walon ke liye Yalamlam ko Miqat muqarrar kiya. To, yeh (upar bataye) Miqat un sab logon ke liye hain jo wahin rehte hain, aur unke ilawa un logon ke liye bhi jo un jagahon se guzarte huye Hajj-Umrah karne ka iraada rakhte hain, aur jo in jagahon ke andar rehta hai woh apni jagah se hi Ihram baandhe, aur isi tarah Mecca wale Mecca se Ihram baandh sakte hain.

e: Narrated Salim from his father who said:"The Prophet (ﷺ) had fixed the Mawaqit as follows: (No)
hi: Salim bataate hain, apne waalid ke hawale se: "Nabi ne Mawaqit (Ihram ki jagahein) muqarrar ki thi (koi tafseel nahi)."

e: Narrated Salim bin `Abdullah from his father:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "The Miqat for the people of Medina is Dhul-Hulaifa; for the people of Sham is Mahita; (i.e. Al-Juhfa); and for the people of Najd is Qarn. And said Ibn `Umar, "They claim, but I did not hear personally, that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The Miqat for the people of Yemen is Yalamlam
hi: Salim bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ), apne waalid ke hawale se: Maine Allah ke Rasool ko farmate suna: "Madina walon ka Miqat Dhul-Hulaifa hai; Sham walon ka Mahyat (yaani Al-Juhfa); aur Najd walon ka Qarn." Aur Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Log kehte hain, magar maine khud nahi suna, ke Nabi ne farmaya: 'Yemen walon ka Miqat Yalamlam hai.'"

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) fixed Dhul-Hulaifa as the Miqat for the people of Medina, Al-Juhfa, for the people of Sham, Yalamlam for the people of Yemen, and Qarn for the people of Najd. And these Mawaqit are for those living at those very places, and besides them for those who come through those places with the intention of performing Hajj and Umra; and whoever is living inside these places can assume Ihram from his own dwelling place, and the people of Mecca can assume Ihram from Mecca
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne Madina walon ke liye Dhul-Hulaifa, Sham walon ke liye Al-Juhfa, Yemen walon ke liye Yalamlam, aur Najd walon ke liye Qarn ko Miqat muqarrar kiya. Aur yeh Mawaqit un sab logon ke liye hain jo wahin rehte hain, aur unke ilawa un logon ke liye bhi jo un jagahon se guzarte huye Hajj-Umrah karne ka iraada rakhte hain; aur jo in jagahon ke andar rehta hai woh apni jagah se hi Ihram baandh sakta hai, aur Mecca wale Mecca se Ihram baandh sakte hain.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) fixed Dhul-Hulaifa as the Miqat for the people of Medina, Al-Juhfa for the people of Sham, Qarn-al-Manazil for the people of Najd, and Yalamlam for the people of Yemen; and these Mawaqit are for those living at those very places, and besides them for those whom come through them with the intention of performing Hajj and Umra; and whoever is living within these Mawaqit should assume Ihram from where he starts, and the people of Mecca can assume Ihram from Mecca
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne Madina walon ke liye Dhul-Hulaifa, Sham walon ke liye Al-Juhfa, Najd walon ke liye Qarn-al-Manazil, aur Yemen walon ke liye Yalamlam ko Miqat muqarrar kiya; aur yeh Mawaqit un sab logon ke liye hain jo wahin rehte hain, aur unke ilawa un logon ke liye bhi jo un jagahon se guzarte huye Hajj-Umrah karne ka iraada rakhte hain; aur jo in Mawaqit ke andar rehta hai woh jahan se chalna shuru kare wahin se Ihram baandhe, aur Mecca wale Mecca se Ihram baandh sakte hain.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:When these two towns (Basra and Kufa) were captured, the people went to `Umar and said, "O the Chief of the faithful believers! The Prophet (ﷺ) fixed Qarn as the Miqat for the people of Najd, it is beyond our way and it is difficult for us to pass through it." He said, "Take as your Miqat a place situated opposite to Qarn on your usual way. So, he fixed Dhatu-Irq (as their Miqat)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Jab Basra aur Kufa fatah huye, log Umar ke paas gaye aur kaha: "Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen! Nabi ne Najd walon ke liye Qarn ko Miqat muqarrar kiya tha, magar woh humare raaste se hat kar hai aur usse guzarna mushkil hai." Umar ne kaha: "Apne raaste par Qarn ke saamne wali jagah ko apna Miqat bana lo." Isliye unhone Dhatu-Irq ko (unka Miqat) muqarrar kiya.

e: Narrated Nafi`:`Abdullah bin `Umar' said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) made his camel sit (i.e. he dismounted) at Al-Batha' in Dhul-Hulaifa and offered the prayer." `Abdullah bin `Umar used to do the same
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool ne Dhul-Hulaifa mein Al-Batha naam ki jagah apna oont bithaya (yaani utre) aur namaz padhi." Abdullah bin Umar bhi aisa hi karte the.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to go (for Hajj) via Ash-Shajara way and return via Muarras way; and no doubt, whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went to Mecca, he used to offer the prayer in the Mosque of Ash-Shajara; and on his return, he used to offer the prayer at Dhul-Hulaifa in the middle of the valley, and pass the night there till morning
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool Ash-Shajara raaste se (Hajj ke liye) jate aur Muarras raaste se wapas aaate; aur jab bhi Allah ke Rasool Mecca jate, Ash-Shajara ki masjid mein namaz padhte, aur wapasi mein Dhul-Hulaifa mein wadi ke beech mein namaz padhte aur wahin raat guzarte subah tak.

e: Narrated `Umar:In the valley of Al-`Aqiq I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "To night a messenger came to me from my Lord and asked me to pray in this blessed valley and to assume Ihram for Hajj and `Umra together
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Al-Aqiq wadi mein maine Allah ke Rasool ko farmate suna: "Aaj raat mere Rab ki taraf se ek qasid mera paas aaya aur usne kaha ke main is mubarak wadi mein namaz padhun aur Hajj aur Umrah dono ka Ihram ek saath baandhun."

e: Narrated Musa bin `Uqba:Salim bin `Abdullah's father said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) said that while resting in the bottom of the valley at Muarras in Dhul-Hulaifa, he had been addressed in a dream: 'You are verily in a blessed valley.' " Salim made us to dismount from our camels at the place where `Abdullah used to dismount, aiming at the place where Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had rested and it was below the Mosque situated in the middle of the valley in between them (the residence) and the road
hi: Musa bin Uqba bataate hain: Salim bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke waalid ne kaha: "Nabi ne bataya ke jab Muarras naam ki jagah, Dhul-Hulaifa ki wadi ke neeche, aaram farma rahe the, unhe khwab mein bataya gaya: 'Tum ek mubarak wadi mein ho.'" Salim ne humein wahin apne oont bithane ko kaha jahan Abdullah bithate, us jagah ka nishaana lekar jahan Allah ke Rasool ne aaram kiya tha, jo wadi ke beech mein bani masjid ke neeche thi, unke (ghar) aur raaste ke darmiyan.

e: Narrated Safwan bin Ya'la:Ya'la said to 'Umar, "Show me the Prophet (ﷺ) when he is being inspired Divinely." While the Prophet (ﷺ) was at Ji'rana (in the company of some of his Companions) a person came and asked, "O Allah's Messenger! What is your verdict regarding that person who assumes Ihram for 'Umra and is scented with perfume ?" The Prophet (ﷺ) kept quiet for a while and he was Divinely inspired (then). 'Umar beckoned Ya'la. So he came, and the Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was shaded with sheet. Ya'la put his head in and saw that the face of Allah's Messenger was red and he was snoring. When the state of the Prophet (ﷺ) was over, he (ﷺ) asked, "Where is the person who asked about 'Umra?" Then that person was brought and the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Wash the perfume off your body thrice and take off the cloak and do the same in 'Umra as you do in Hajj
hi: Safwan bin Ya'la bataate hain: Ya'la ne Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kaha: "Mujhe Nabi ko us waqt dikhaiye jab unpar wahi utar rahi ho." Jabke Nabi Ji'rana mein the (kuch sahaba ke saath), ek shaks aaya aur pucha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Uss shaks ke baare mein aapki kya raay hai jo Umrah ka Ihram baandhta hai aur khushbu lagaye hue hai?" Nabi kuch der khamosh rahe aur unpar wahi utri (usi waqt). Umar ne Ya'la ko ishara kiya. Woh aaye, aur Allah ke Rasool ko ek chadar se dhaka gaya tha. Ya'la ne apna sar andar daala aur dekha Allah ke Rasool ka chehra laal ho gaya tha aur woh khurraati le rahe the. Jab Nabi ki halat khatam hui, unhone pucha: "Umrah ke baare mein poochhne wala kahan hai?" Phir usse laaya gaya aur Nabi ne farmaya: "Apne badan se khushbu teen baar dho lo aur chogha utaar do, aur Umrah mein wahi karo jo Hajj mein karte ho."

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:Ibn `Umar used to oil his hair. I told that to Ibrahim who said, "What do you think about this statement: Narrated Aswad from `Aisha: As if I were now observing the glitter of the scent in the parting of the hair of the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was Muhrim?
hi: Sa'id bin Jubair bataate hain: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) apne baalon mein tel lagate the. Maine yeh Ibrahim ko bataya, unhone kaha: "Iss riwayat ke baare mein aapki kya raay hai: Aswad ne Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke hawale se kaha: 'Goya main abhi bhi Nabi ke baalon ki maang mein khushbu ki chamak dekh rahi hoon jabke Aap Muhrim (Ihram mein) the'?"

e: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ) I used to scent Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) when he wanted to assume Ihram and also on finishing Ihram before the Tawaf round the Ka`ba (Tawaf-al-ifada)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki biwi) bataati hain: Main Allah ke Rasool ko khushbu lagaati thi jab woh Ihram baandhna chahte, aur jab Ihram khatam karte Ka'ba ke Tawaf (Tawaf-al-Ifada) se pehle bhi.

e: Narrated Salim from his father:I heard that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) assumed Ihram with his hair matted together
hi: Salim, apne waalid ke hawale se: Maine suna ke Allah ke Rasool ne Ihram baandha jabke unke baal jat (matted) hue the.

e: Narrated Salim bin `Abdullah:I heard my father saying, "Never did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) assume Ihram except at the Mosque, that is, at the Mosque of Dhul-Hulaifa
hi: Salim bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine apne waalid ko kehte suna: "Allah ke Rasool ne kabhi kisi masjid ke ilawa Ihram nahi baandha, siwaye Dhul-Hulaifa ki masjid ke."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:A man asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What kind of clothes should a Muhrim wear?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, "He should not wear a shirt, a turban, trousers, a headcloak or leather socks except if he can find no slippers, he then may wear leather socks after cutting off what might cover the ankles. And he should not wear clothes which are scented with saffron or Wars (kinds of Perfumes)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Ek shaks ne pucha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Muhrim kya libaas pehne?" Allah ke Rasool ne jawab diya: "Woh qamees, pagdi, pajama, hooded chadar, ya khuff (moze) na pehne siwaye jab usse juti na mile, tab woh Khuff pehen sakta hai magar takhno se neeche kaat kar. Aur woh zafraan ya Wars (khushbudaar cheezein) se rangi cheezein na pehne."

e: Narrated 'Ubaidullah bin `Abdullah:Ibn `Abbas' said, "Usama rode behind Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) from `Arafat to Al-Muzdalifa; and then Al-Fadl rode behind Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) from Al-Muzdalifa to Mina." Ibn `Abbas added, "Both of them said, 'The Prophet kept on reciting Talbiya till he did the Rami of Jamrat-Al-`Aqaba
hi: Ubaidullah bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Usama Allah ke Rasool ke peechhe sawar hokar Arafat se Al-Muzdalifa gaye, phir Al-Fadl Allah ke Rasool ke peechhe sawar hokar Al-Muzdalifa se Mina gaye." Ibn Abbas ne joda: "Donon ne kaha: 'Nabi Talbiya kehte rahe jab tak unhone Jamrat-Al-Aqaba ka Rami (kanker maarna) nahi kiya.'"

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) with his companions started from Medina after combing and oiling his hair and putting on two sheets of Ihram (upper body cover and waist cover). He did not forbid anyone to wear any kind of sheets except the ones colored with saffron because they may leave the scent on the skin. And so in the early morning, the Prophet (ﷺ) mounted his Mount while in Dhul-Hulaifa and set out till they reached Baida', where he and his companions recited Talbiya, and then they did the ceremony of Taqlid (which means to put the colored garlands around the necks of the Budn (camels for sacrifice). And all that happened on the 25th of Dhul-Qa'da. And when he reached Mecca on the 4th of Dhul-Hijja he performed the Tawaf round the Ka`ba and performed the Tawaf between Safa and Marwa. And as he had a Badana and had garlanded it, he did not finish his Ihram. He proceeded towards the highest places of Mecca near Al-Hajun and he was assuming the Ihram for Hajj and did not go near the Ka`ba after he performed Tawaf (round it) till he returned from `Arafat. Then he ordered his companions to perform the Tawaf round the Ka`ba and then the Tawaf of Safa and Marwa, and to cut short the hair of their heads and to finish their Ihram. And that was only for those people who had not garlanded Budn. Those who had their wives with them were permitted to contact them (have sexual intercourse), and similarly perfume and (ordinary) clothes were permissible for them
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi apne sahaba ke saath Madina se apne baal kanghi aur tel lagaakar, aur Ihram ke do kapde (upar aur kamar ke liye) pehnkar chale. Aap ne kisi bhi qisam ki chadar pehnne se mana nahi kiya siwaye zafraan se rangi hui, kyunke usse jism par nishaan reh sakte the. Isliye subah-savere, Nabi apni sawari par Dhul-Hulaifa mein baithe aur chal pade yahan tak ke woh Baida pahunche, jahan unhone aur unke sahaba ne Talbiya kahi, phir unhone Taqlid ki rasam ki (yaani rangi hui maalayen Budn — qurbani ke oonton — ki gardan mein daali). Yeh sab 25 Zul-Qa'da ko hua. Aur jab woh 4 Zul-Hijja ko Mecca pahunche, unhone Ka'ba ka Tawaf kiya aur Safa-Marwa ka Sa'i kiya. Aur chunke unke paas Badana (qurbani ka oont) tha aur unhone use maalaayen pehnayi thi, Aap ne apna Ihram khatam nahi kiya. Woh Mecca ke sabse oonche hisse, Al-Hajun ke qareeb, gaye aur Hajj ka Ihram baandhe hue rahe aur Ka'ba ke qareeb tab tak nahi gaye jab tak woh Arafat se wapas na aa gaye. Phir unhone apne sahaba ko hukum diya ke woh Ka'ba ka Tawaf karein, phir Safa-Marwa ka Tawaf, aur apne sar ke baal chhote karein, aur apna Ihram khatam karein. Aur yeh sirf un logon ke liye tha jinke paas Budn nahi thi jise unhone maalaayen pehnayi ho. Jinke saath unki biwiyan thi, unhe unse humbistari (rishta) ki ijazat thi, aur isi tarah khushbu aur (aam) kapde bhi unke liye jaiz ho gaye.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) offered four rak`at in Medina and then two rak`at at Dhul Hulaifa and then passed the night at Dhul-Hulaifa till it was morning and when he mounted his Mount and it stood up, he started to recite Talbiya
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Madina mein Zuhr ki chaar rakat padhi, phir Dhul-Hulaifa mein Asr ki do rakat, phir Dhul-Hulaifa mein raat guzari yahan tak ke subah hui, aur jab woh apni sawari par baithe aur woh khadi ho gayi, Talbiya kehna shuru kiya.

e: Narrated Abu Qilaba:Anas bin Malik said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) offered four rak`at of the Zuhr prayer in Medina and two rak`at of `Asr prayer at Dhul-Hulaifa." I think that the Prophet (ﷺ) passed the night there till morning
hi: Abu Qilaba bataate hain: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Nabi ne Madina mein Zuhr ki chaar rakat padhi aur Dhul-Hulaifa mein Asr ki do rakat." Mera khayaal hai Nabi ne wahin raat guzari subah tak.

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) offered four rak`at of the Zuhr prayer in Medina and two rak`at of the `Asr prayer in Dhul-Hulaifa and I heard them (the companions of the Prophet) reciting Talbiya together loudly to the extent of shouting
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Madina mein Zuhr ki chaar rakat padhi aur Dhul-Hulaifa mein Asr ki do rakat, aur maine unhe (sahaba ko) buland aawaaz mein, chillaate huye, Talbiya kehte suna.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The Talbiya of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was : 'Labbaika Allahumma labbaik, Labbaika la sharika Laka labbaik, Inna-l-hamda wan-ni'mata Laka walmulk, La sharika Laka' (I respond to Your call O Allah, I respond to Your call, and I am obedient to Your orders, You have no partner, I respond to Your call All the praises and blessings are for You, All the sovereignty is for You, And You have no partners with You)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ki Talbiya thi: "Labbaika Allahumma labbaik, Labbaika la sharika Laka labbaik, Inna-l-hamda wan-ni'mata Laka walmulk, La sharika Laka" (Main teri hazir hoon, Aye Allah, main teri hazir hoon, aur main teri farmabardari mein hoon, tera koi shareek nahi, main teri hazir hoon. Sab tareefein aur naimatein teri hain, sari saltanat teri hai, aur tera koi shareek nahi).

e: Narrated `Aisha:I know how the Prophet (ﷺ) used to say (Talbiya) and it was: 'Labbaika Allahumma Labbaik, Labbaika la sharika Laka labbaik, Inna-l-hamda wan-ni'mata Laka walmu Lk, La sharika Laka
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Mujhe pata hai Nabi kaise Talbiya kahte the: "Labbaika Allahumma Labbaik, Labbaika la sharika Laka labbaik, Inna-l-hamda wan-ni'mata Laka walmulk, La sharika Laka" (Main teri hazir hoon, Aye Allah, main teri hazir hoon, aur main teri farmabardari mein hoon, tera koi shareek nahi, main teri hazir hoon. Sab tareefein aur naimatein teri hain, sari saltanat teri hai, aur tera koi shareek nahi).

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) offered four rak`at of Zuhr prayer at Medina and we were in his company, and two rak`at of the `Asr prayer at Dhul-Hulaifa and then passed the night there till it was dawn; then he rode, and when he reached Al-Baida', he praised and glorified Allah and said Takbir (i.e. Al hamdu-li l-lah and Subhanallah(1) and Allahu-Akbar). Then he and the people along with him recited Talbiya with the intention of performing Hajj and Umra. When we reached (Mecca) he ordered us to finish the Ihram (after performing the Umra) (only those who had no Hadi (animal for sacrifice) with them were asked to do so) till the day of Tarwiya that is 8th Dhul-Hijja when they assumed Ihram for Hajj. The Prophet sacrificed many camels (slaughtering them) with his own hands while standing. While Allah's Apostle was in Medina he sacrificed two horned rams black and white in color in the Name of Allah
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Madina mein Zuhr ki chaar rakat padhi jabke hum unke saath the, aur Dhul-Hulaifa mein Asr ki do rakat, phir wahin raat guzari yahan tak ke subah hui; phir sawar hue, aur jab Al-Baida pahunche, Allah ki hamd-sana aur Takbir kahi (yaani Al-hamdu-li-l-lah, Subhanallah aur Allahu-Akbar). Phir unhone aur unke saath ke logon ne Hajj aur Umrah ki niyyat se Talbiya kahi. Jab hum (Mecca) pahunche, Aap ne humein Ihram khatam karne ka hukum diya (Umrah karne ke baad) (sirf woh jinke paas Hadi — qurbani ka janwar — nahi tha) yahan tak ke Tarwiya ka din aaya, yaani 8 Zul-Hijja, jab woh Hajj ka Ihram baandhne lage. Nabi ne apne haathon se khade hokar bahut se oont zabah kiye. Jab Allah ke Rasool Madina mein the, unhone Allah ke naam par do singon wale menghon ko, kaale aur safed rang ke, qurbani ki.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) recited Talbiya when he had mounted his Mount and was ready to set out
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne Talbiya kahi jab woh apni sawari par sawar hoke chalne ke liye taiyaar the.

e: Narrated Nafi', 'Whenever Ibn 'Umar finished his morning Salat at Dhul-Hulaifa he would get his Rahila (mount) prepared. Then, he would ride on it, and after it had stood up straight (ready to set out), he would face Al-Qiblah (the Ka'bah at Makkah) while sitting (on his mount) and recite Talbiya. When he had reached the boundaries of the Haram (or Makkah), he would stop recitation of Talbiya till he reached Dhi-Tuwa (near Makkah) where he would pass the night till it was dawn. After offering the morning Salat, he would take a bath. He claimed that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had done the same
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Jab bhi Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) Dhul-Hulaifa mein Fajr ki namaz khatam karte, apni sawari taiyaar karwate. Phir usme sawar hote, aur jab woh khadi ho jaati (chalne ke liye taiyaar), baithe hue Qibla ki taraf mun karte aur Talbiya kahte. Jab woh Haram (Mecca ki seemaon) tak pahunch jate, Talbiya kehna band kar dete, aur Dhi-Tuwa (Mecca ke qareeb) pahunch kar raat guzarte subah tak. Fajr ki namaz padhne ke baad ghusl karte. Woh dawa karte ke Allah ke Rasool ne bhi aisa hi kiya tha.

e: Narrated Nafi`:Whenever Ibn `Umar intended to go to Mecca he used to oil himself with a sort of oil that had no pleasant smell, then he would go to the Mosque of Al-Hulaifa and offer the prayer, and then ride. When he mounted well on his Mount and the Mount stood up straight, he would proclaim the intention of assuming Ihram, and he used to say that he had seen the Prophet (ﷺ) doing the same
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Jab bhi Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) Mecca jane ka iraada karte, khud par ek tel lagate jisme koi khushbu na hoti, phir Al-Hulaifa ki masjid jate aur namaz padhte, phir sawar hote. Jab woh apni sawari par achhi tarah baith jate aur sawari seedhi khadi ho jaati, Ihram ki niyyat karte, aur woh kahte ke unhone Nabi ko bhi aisa hi karte dekha tha.

e: Narrated Mujahid:I was in the company of Ibn `Abbas and the people talked about Ad-Dajjal and said, "Ad-Dajjal will come with the word Kafir (non-believer) written in between his eyes." On that Ibn `Abbas said, "I have not heard this from the Prophet (ﷺ) but I heard him saying, 'As if I saw Moses just now entering the valley reciting Talbyia
hi: Mujahid bataate hain: Main Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath tha aur log Dajjal ke baare mein baat kar rahe the aur kaha: "Dajjal apni donon aankhon ke beech 'Kafir' likha hua lekar aayega." Isspar Ibn Abbas ne kaha: "Maine yeh Nabi se nahi suna, magar maine unhe kehte suna: 'Goya main abhi Musa ko wadi mein daakhil hote dekh raha hoon, Talbiya kehte hue.'"

e: Narrated Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ) We set out with the Prophet (ﷺ) in his last Hajj and we assumed Ihram for Umra. The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "Whoever has the Hadi with him should assume Ihram for Hajj along with `Umra and should not finish the Ihram till he finishes both." I was menstruating when I reached Mecca, and so I neither did Tawaf round the Ka`ba nor Tawaf between Safa and Marwa. I complained about that to the Prophet (ﷺ) on which he replied, "Undo and comb your head hair, and assume Ihram for Hajj (only) and leave the Umra." So, I did so. When we had performed the Hajj, the Prophet sent me with my brother `Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Bakr to Tan`im. So I performed the `Umra. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to me, "This `Umra is instead of your missed one." Those who had assumed Ihram for `Umra (Hajj-at-Tamattu) performed Tawaf round the Ka`ba and between Safa and Marwa and then finished their Ihram. After returning from Mina, they performed another Tawaf (between Safa and Marwa). Those who had assumed Ihram for Hajj and `Umra together (Hajj-al-Qiran) performed only one Tawaf (between Safa and Marwa)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki biwi) bataati hain: Hum Nabi ke saath unke aakhri Hajj mein nikle aur Umrah ka Ihram baandha. Nabi ne farmaya: "Jiske paas Hadi ho, use Hajj-Umrah dono ka Ihram ek saath baandhna chahiye aur dono khatam kiye bina Ihram na khole." Main Mecca pahunchte hi haiz mein aa gayi, isliye maine na Ka'ba ka Tawaf kiya na Safa-Marwa ka Sa'i. Maine yeh Nabi se shikayat ki, jinhone jawab diya: "Apne sar ke baal khol kar kanghi karo, aur sirf Hajj ka Ihram baandho aur Umrah chhod do." Maine aisa hi kiya. Jab humne Hajj mukammal kiya, Nabi ne mujhe mere bhai Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Bakr ke saath Tan'im bheja. To maine Umrah kiya. Nabi ne mujhse kaha: "Yeh Umrah tumhare chhoote hue Umrah ke badle mein hai." Jinhone sirf Umrah ka Ihram baandha tha (Hajj-at-Tamattu), unhone Ka'ba ka Tawaf aur Safa-Marwa ka Sa'i kiya aur apna Ihram khol diya. Mina se wapas aakar unhone ek aur Tawaf kiya (Safa-Marwa ke beech). Jinhone Hajj-Umrah dono ka Ihram ek saath baandha tha (Hajj-al-Qiran), unhone sirf ek Tawaf kiya (Safa-Marwa ke beech).

e: Narrated Ata:Jabir said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered `Ali to keep on assuming his Ihram." The narrator then informed about the narration of Suraqa
hi: Ata bataate hain: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Nabi ne Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko apna Ihram jaari rakhne ka hukum diya." Raawi ne phir Suraqa ki riwayat bataayi.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:`Ali came to the Prophet (ﷺ) from Yemen (to Mecca). The Prophet (ﷺ) asked `Ali, "With what intention have you assumed Ihram?" `Ali replied, "I have assumed Ihram with the same intention as that of the Prophet." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If I had not the Hadi with me I would have finished the Ihram." Muhammad bin Bakr narrated extra from Ibn Juraij, "The Prophet (ﷺ) said to `Ali, "With what intention have you assumed the Ihram, O `Ali?" He replied, "With the same (intention) as that of the Prophet." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Have a Hadi and keep your Ihram as it is
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ali (Alayhis Salam) Yemen se Nabi ke paas (Mecca) aaye. Nabi ne Ali (Alayhis Salam) se pucha: "Tumne kis niyyat se Ihram baandha?" Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne jawab diya: "Maine wahi niyyat ki jo Nabi ne ki." Nabi ne farmaya: "Agar mere paas Hadi na hota, main apna Ihram khol deta." Muhammad bin Bakr ne Ibn Juraij se ek izafa riwayat ki: "Nabi ne Ali (Alayhis Salam) se kaha: 'Tumne kis niyyat se Ihram baandha, Aye Ali (Alayhis Salam)?' Unhone jawab diya: 'Wahi (niyyat) jo Nabi ki thi.' Nabi ne farmaya: 'Tumhare paas Hadi ho to apna Ihram waisa hi rehne do.'"

e: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) sent me to some people in Yemen and when I returned, I found him at Al-Batha. He asked me, "With what intention have you assumed Ihram (i.e. for Hajj or for Umra or for both?") I replied, "I have assumed Ihram with an intention like that of the Prophet." He asked, "Have you a Hadi with you?" I replied in the negative. He ordered me to perform Tawaf round the Ka`ba and between Safa and Marwa and then to finish my Ihram. I did so and went to a woman from my tribe who combed my hair or washed my head. Then, when `Umar came (i.e. became Caliph) he said, "If we follow Allah's Book, it orders us to complete Hajj and Umra; as Allah says: "Perform the Hajj and Umra for Allah." (2.196). And if we follow the tradition of the Prophet (ﷺ) who did not finish his Ihram till he sacrificed his Hadi
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne mujhe kuch logon ke paas Yemen bheja, aur jab main wapas aaya, maine unhe Al-Batha mein paaya. Aap ne mujhse pucha: "Tumne kis niyyat se Ihram baandha (yaani Hajj, Umrah ya dono ke liye)?" Maine jawab diya: "Maine Nabi jaisi niyyat se Ihram baandha." Aap ne pucha: "Kya tumhare paas Hadi hai?" Maine na mein jawab diya. Aap ne mujhe Ka'ba ka Tawaf aur Safa-Marwa ka Sa'i karke Ihram khatam karne ka hukum diya. Maine aisa kiya aur apne qabile ki ek aurat ke paas gaya jisne mere baal kanghi ya dhoye. Baad mein, jab Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) (khalifa) bane, unhone kaha: "Agar hum Allah ki Kitaab ki pairvi karen, woh humein Hajj-Umrah mukammal karne ka hukum deti hai; Allah farmata hai: 'Hajj aur Umrah Allah ke liye poore karo' (2:196). Aur agar hum Nabi ki Sunnat ki pairvi karen, unhone apna Hadi zabah karne tak Ihram nahi khola."

e: Narrated Al-Qasim bin Muhammad:' Aisha said, "We set out with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the months of Hajj, and (in) the nights of Hajj, and at the time and places of Hajj and in a state of Hajj. We dismounted at Sarif (a village six miles from Mecca). The Prophet (ﷺ) then addressed his companions and said, "Anyone who has not got the Hadi and likes to do Umra instead of Hajj may do so (i.e. Hajj-al-Tamattu`) and anyone who has got the Hadi should not finish the Ihram after performing ' `Umra). (i.e. Hajj-al-Qiran). Aisha added, "The companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) obeyed the above (order) and some of them (i.e. who did not have Hadi) finished their Ihram after Umra." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and some of his companions were resourceful and had the Hadi with them, they could not perform Umra (alone) (but had to perform both Hajj and Umra with one Ihram). Aisha added, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to me and saw me weeping and said, "What makes you weep, O Hantah?" I replied, "I have heard your conversation with your companions and I cannot perform the Umra." He asked, "What is wrong with you?' I replied, ' I do not offer the prayers (i.e. I have my menses).' He said, ' It will not harm you for you are one of the daughters of Adam, and Allah has written for you (this state) as He has written it for them. Keep on with your intentions for Hajj and Allah may reward you that." Aisha further added, "Then we proceeded for Hajj till we reached Mina and I became clean from my menses. Then I went out from Mina and performed Tawaf round the Ka`ba." Aisha added, "I went along with the Prophet (ﷺ) in his final departure (from Hajj) till he dismounted at Al-Muhassab (a valley outside Mecca), and we too, dismounted with him." He called ' `Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Bakr and said to him, ' Take your sister outside the sanctuary of Mecca and let her assume Ihram for ' `Umra, and when you have finished `Umra, return to this place and I will wait for you both till you both return to me.' " ' Aisha added, " So we went out of the sanctuary of Mecca and after finishing from the ' `Umra and the Tawaf we returned to the Prophet (ﷺ) at dawn. He said, 'Have you performed the ' `Umra?' We replied in the affirmative. So he announced the departure amongst his companions and the people set out for the journey, and the Prophet: too left for Medina
hi: Al-Qasim bin Muhammad bataate hain: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha: "Hum Allah ke Rasool ke saath Hajj ke maheenon mein, Hajj ki raaton mein, Hajj ke waqt aur jagahon par, aur Hajj ki haalat mein nikle. Hum Sarif (Mecca se chhe mil ki jagah) mein utre. Nabi ne apne sahaba se khitaab kiya aur kaha: 'Jiske paas Hadi na ho aur woh Hajj ke bajaye Umrah karna chahe, kar sakta hai (yaani Hajj-al-Tamattu), aur jiske paas Hadi ho use Umrah ke baad Ihram khatam nahi karna chahiye (yaani Hajj-al-Qiran).'" Ayesha ne joda: "Nabi ke sahaba ne is hukum ki itaa'at ki aur kuch (jinke paas Hadi nahi tha) ne Umrah ke baad Ihram khatam kar diya." Allah ke Rasool aur kuch sahaba, jo bahut saadhan sampann the, unke paas Hadi tha, isliye woh sirf Umrah nahi kar sakte the (magar unhe Hajj-Umrah dono ek Ihram mein karna pada). Ayesha ne joda: "Allah ke Rasool mere paas aaye aur mujhe rote dekha, poocha: 'Aye Hantah! Tum kyun ro rahi ho?' Maine jawab diya: 'Maine aapki apne sahaba se guftagu suni hai aur main Umrah nahi kar sakti.' Aap ne pucha: 'Kya baat hai?' Maine jawab diya: 'Main namaz nahi padh rahi (yaani mujhe haiz aaya hai).' Aap ne farmaya: 'Isse tumhein nuqsaan nahi hoga, kyunke tum bhi Adam ki betiyon mein se ho, aur Allah ne tumhare liye (yeh haalat) waisi hi likhi hai jaisi unke liye likhi hai. Apni Hajj ki niyyat jaari rakho aur Allah tumhe iska ajr dega.'" Ayesha ne aage joda: "Phir hum Hajj ke liye chale yahan tak ke Mina pahunche aur main haiz se paak ho gayi. Phir main Mina se nikal kar Ka'ba ka Tawaf karne gayi." Ayesha ne joda: "Main Nabi ke saath unki aakhri wapasi mein gayi yahan tak ke woh Al-Muhassab (Mecca ke bahar ek wadi) mein utre, aur hum bhi unke saath utre." Aap ne Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Bakr ko bulaya aur unse kaha: "Apni behn ko Mecca ki seema se bahar le jaao aur unhe Umrah ka Ihram baandhne do, aur jab woh Umrah khatam kar lein, wapas is jagah aana, main tum dono ka intezar yahin karunga jab tak tum wapas na aa jao." Ayesha ne joda: "Isliye hum Mecca ki seema se bahar gaye, aur Umrah aur Tawaf khatam karke, hum subah hote hi Nabi ke paas wapas aa gaye. Aap ne pucha: 'Kya tumne Umrah kar liya?' Humne haan mein jawab diya. To Aap ne apne sahaba ke darmiyan wapas jaane ka elaan kiya aur log safar ke liye nikle, aur Nabi bhi Madina ke liye chal pade."

e: Narrated Al-Aswad:' Aisha said, We went out with the Prophet (from Medina) with the intention of performing Hajj only and when we reached Mecca we performed Tawaf round the Ka`ba and then the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered those who had not driven the Hadi along with them to finish their Ihram. So the people who had not driven the Hadi along with them finished their Ihram. The Prophet's wives, too, had not driven the Hadi with them, so they too, finished their Ihram." `Aisha added, "I got my menses and could not perform Tawaf round the Ka`ba." So when it was the night of Hasba (i.e. when we stopped at Al-Muhassab), I said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Everyone is returning after performing Hajj and `Umra but I am returning after performing Hajj only.' He said, 'Didn't you perform Tawaf round the Ka`ba the night we reached Mecca?' I replied in the negative. He said, 'Go with your brother to Tan`im and assume the Ihram for `Umra, (and after performing it) come back to such and such a place.' On that Safiya said, 'I feel that I will detain you all.' The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'O 'Aqra Halqa! Didn't you perform Tawaf of the Ka`ba on the day of sacrifice? (i.e. Tawaf-al-ifada) Safiya replied in the affirmative. He said, (to Safiya). 'There is no harm for you to proceed on with us.' " `Aisha added, "(after returning from `Umra), the Prophet (ﷺ) met me while he was ascending (from Mecca) and I was descending to it, or I was ascending and he was descending
hi: Al-Aswad bataate hain: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha: "Hum Nabi ke saath (Madina se) sirf Hajj ki niyyat se nikle, aur jab hum Mecca pahunche, humne Ka'ba ka Tawaf kiya, phir Nabi ne un logon ko jo apne saath Hadi nahi laaye the, Ihram khatam karne ka hukum diya. Isliye jo log apne saath Hadi nahi laaye the, unhone Ihram khatam kar diya. Nabi ki biwiyan bhi apne saath Hadi nahi laayi thi, isliye unhone bhi Ihram khatam kar diya." Ayesha ne joda: "Mujhe haiz aa gaya aur main Ka'ba ka Tawaf nahi kar sakti thi. Isliye jab Hasba ki raat aayi (yaani jab hum Al-Muhassab mein rukke), maine kaha: 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Sab log Hajj-Umrah dono karke wapas ja rahe hain magar main sirf Hajj karke.' Aap ne pucha: 'Kya tumne us raat Ka'ba ka Tawaf nahi kiya jab hum Mecca pahunche the?' Maine na mein jawab diya. Aap ne kaha: 'Apne bhai ke saath Tan'im jaao aur Umrah ka Ihram baandho, (aur usse mukammal karke) falaan jagah wapas aana.' Isspar Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha: 'Mujhe lagta hai main tum sabko rok lungi.' Nabi ne farmaya: 'Aye Aqra Halqa! Kya tumne Yaum-un-Nahr (qurbani ke din) Ka'ba ka Tawaf nahi kiya tha? (yaani Tawaf-al-Ifada)' Safiya ne haan mein jawab diya. Aap ne (Safiya se) kaha: 'To tumhein humare saath jaari rehne mein koi harj nahi.'" Ayesha ne joda: "(Umrah se wapas aane ke baad), Nabi mujhse mile jabke woh (Mecca se) chadh rahe the aur main utar rahi thi, ya main chadh rahi thi aur woh utar rahe the."

e: Narrated `Aisha:We set out with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (to Mecca) in the year of the Prophet's Last Hajj. Some of us had assumed Ihram for `Umra only, some for both Hajj and `Umra, and others for Hajj only. Allah's Apostle assumed Ihram for Hajj. So whoever had assumed Ihram for Hajj or for both Hajj and `Umra did not finish the Ihram till the day of sacrifice. (See Hadith No. 631, 636, and)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Hum Allah ke Rasool ke saath (Mecca) nikle Nabi ke aakhri Hajj ke saal. Hum mein se kuch ne sirf Umrah ka Ihram baandha, kuch ne Hajj-Umrah dono ka, aur baaki ne sirf Hajj ka. Allah ke Rasool ne Hajj ka Ihram baandha. Isliye jisne bhi Hajj ka ya Hajj-Umrah dono ka Ihram baandha, usne Yaum-un-Nahr (qurbani ke din) tak Ihram nahi khola.

e: Narrated Marwan bin Al-Hakam:I saw `Uthman and `Ali. `Uthman used to forbid people to perform Hajj-at-Tamattu` and Hajj-al-Qiran (Hajj and `Umra together), and when `Ali saw (this act of `Uthman), he assumed Ihram for Hajj and `Umra together saying, "Labbaik for `Umra and Hajj," and said, "I will not leave the tradition of the Prophet (ﷺ) on the saying of somebody
hi: Marwan bin Al-Hakam bataate hain: Maine Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko dekha. Uthman logon ko Hajj-at-Tamattu aur Hajj-al-Qiran (Hajj-Umrah ek saath) se mana karte the, aur jab Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne yeh (Uthman ka amal) dekha, unhone Hajj-Umrah dono ka Ihram ek saath baandha aur kaha: "Labbaik Umrah aur Hajj ke liye," aur kaha: "Main kisi ke kehne par Nabi ki riwayat nahi chhodunga."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The people (of the Pre-Islamic Period) used to think that to perform `Umra during the months of Hajj was one of the major sins on earth. And also used to consider the month of Safar as a forbidden (i.e. sacred) month and they used to say, "When the wounds of the camel's back heal up (after they return from Hajj) and the signs of those wounds vanish and the month of Safar passes away then (at that time) `Umra is permissible for the one who wishes to perform it." In the morning of the 4th of Dhul- Hijja, the Prophet (ﷺ) and his companions reached Mecca, assuming Ihram for Hajj and he ordered his companions to make their intentions of the Ihram for `Umra only (instead of Hajj) so they considered his order as something great and were puzzled, and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What kind (of finishing) of Ihram is allowed?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Finish the Ihram completely like a non-Muhrim (you are allowed everything)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: (Jahiliyat ke zamane ke) log samajhte the ke Hajj ke maheenon mein Umrah karna zameen par sabse bade gunahon mein se ek hai. Aur woh Safar ke mahine ko bhi haram (muqaddas) mahina samajhte the aur kehte: "Jab oont ki pusht ke zakhm theek ho jaayen (Hajj se wapas aane ke baad) aur unke nishaan mit jaayen aur Safar ka mahina guzar jaaye, tab (yaani us waqt) Umrah jaiz hai jo karna chahe." Subah ko, 4 Zul-Hijja, Nabi aur unke sahaba Mecca pahunche, Hajj ka Ihram baandhe hue, aur unhone apne sahaba ko sirf Umrah ki niyyat karne ka (Hajj ke bajaye) hukum diya, isliye unhone iss hukum ko badi baat samjha aur hairan ho gaye, aur kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Kis tarah ka Ihram khatam karna jaiz hai?" Nabi ne jawab diya: "Poore tarah se Ihram khatam karo jaise ek ghair-Muhrim (jise sab kuch jaiz hai)."

e: Narrated Abu Musa: I came to the Prophet (from Yemen and was assuming Ihram for Hajj) and he ordered me to finish the Ihram (after performing the `Umra)
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Nabi ke paas aaya (Yemen se, Hajj ka Ihram baandhe hue) aur unhone mujhe Ihram khatam karne ka hukum diya (Umrah karne ke baad).

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Hafsa the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Why have the people finished their Ihram after performing `Umra but you have not finished your Ihram after performing `Umra?" He replied, "I have matted my hair and garlanded my Hadi. So I will not finish my Ihram till I have slaughtered (my Hadi)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki biwi) ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Logon ne Umrah karne ke baad Ihram khatam kar diya magar aapne apna Ihram khatam nahi kiya?" Aap ne jawab diya: "Maine apne baal jat kar liye hain aur apne Hadi ko maalaayen pehnayi hain. Isliye main apna Ihram tab tak khatam nahi karunga jab tak (apna Hadi) zabah na kar loon."

e: Narrated Shu`ba:Abu Jamra Nasr bin `Imran Ad-Duba'i said, "I intended to perform Hajj-at-Tamattu` and the people advised me not to do so. I asked Ibn `Abbas regarding it and he ordered me to perform Hajj-at- Tammatu'. Later I saw in a dream someone saying to me, 'Hajj-Mabrur (Hajj performed in accordance with the Prophet's tradition without committing sins and accepted by Allah) and an accepted `Umra.' So I told that dream to Ibn `Abbas. He said, 'This is the tradition of Abul-Qasim.' Then he said to me, 'Stay with me and I shall give you a portion of my property.' " I (Shu`ba) asked, "Why (did he invite you)?" He (Abu Jamra) said, "Because of the dream which I had seen
hi: Shu'ba bataate hain: Abu Jamra Nasr bin Imran Ad-Duba'i ne kaha: "Maine Hajj-at-Tamattu karne ka iraada kiya aur logon ne mujhe aisa na karne ki salaah di. Maine Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se iske baare mein pucha aur unhone mujhe Hajj-at-Tamattu karne ka hukum diya. Baad mein maine khwab mein dekha koi mujhe keh raha tha: 'Hajj-Mabroor (Nabi ki riwayat ke mutabiq bina gunah kiye padha gaya, Allah ke haan qubool shuda Hajj) aur qubool shuda Umrah.' Isliye maine woh khwab Ibn Abbas ko sunaya. Unhone kaha: 'Yeh Abul-Qasim (Nabi) ki Sunnat hai.' Phir unhone mujhse kaha: 'Mere saath raho aur main tumhe apni maal ka ek hissa dunga.'" Maine (Shu'ba ne) pucha: "Kyun (unhone yeh dawat di)?" Unhone (Abu Jamra ne) kaha: "Us khwab ki wajah se jo maine dekha tha."

e: Narrated Abu Shihab:I left for Mecca for Hajj-at-Tamattu` assuming Ihram for `Umra. I reached Mecca three days before the day of Tarwiya (8th Dhul-Hijja). Some people of Mecca said to me, "Your Hajj will be like the Hajj performed by the people of Mecca (i.e. you will lose the superiority of assuming Ihram from the Miqat). So I went to `Ata' asking him his view about it. He said, "Jabir bin `Abdullah narrated to me, 'I performed Hajj with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the day when he drove camels with him. The people had assumed Ihram for Hajj-al-Ifrad. The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered them to finish their Ihram after Tawaf round the Ka`ba, and between Safa and Marwa and to cut short their hair and then to stay there (in Mecca) as non-Muhrims till the day of Tarwiya (i.e. 8th of Dhul-Hijja) when they would assume Ihram for Hajj and they were ordered to make the Ihram with which they had come as for `Umra only. They asked, 'How can we make it `Umra (Tamattu`) as we have intended to perform Hajj?' The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Do what I have ordered you. Had I not brought the Hadi with me, I would have done the same, but I cannot finish my Ihram till the Hadi reaches its destination (i.e. is slaughtered).' So, they did (what he ordered them to do)
hi: Abu Shihab bataate hain: Main Mecca ke liye Hajj-at-Tamattu ke liye nikla, Umrah ka Ihram baandhe hue. Main Tarwiya ke din (8 Zul-Hijja) se teen din pehle Mecca pahuncha. Mecca ke kuch logon ne mujhse kaha: "Aapka Hajj Mecca walon ke Hajj jaisa hoga (yaani aap Miqat se Ihram baandhne ki fazeelat kho denge)." Isliye main Ata ke paas gaya unse iske baare mein raay poochne. Unhone kaha: "Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne mujhe bataya: 'Maine Allah ke Rasool ke saath Hajj kiya us din jab woh apne saath oont lekar aaye the. Log Hajj-al-Ifrad ka Ihram baandhe hue the. Nabi ne unhe Ka'ba ka Tawaf aur Safa-Marwa ka Sa'i karke, aur apne baal chhote karke, Ihram khatam karne ka hukum diya, aur phir wahan (Mecca mein) ghair-Muhrim ki tarah rehne ka hukum diya Tarwiya ke din (8 Zul-Hijja) tak, jab woh Hajj ka Ihram baandhenge, aur unhe hukum diya gaya ke jis Ihram ke saath woh aaye the usse Umrah ka Ihram samjhen. Unhone pucha: "Hum ise Umrah (Tamattu) kaise banayein jabke humne Hajj ki niyyat ki thi?" Nabi ne farmaya: "Jo maine tumhe hukum diya woh karo. Agar main apna Hadi na laaya hota, main bhi wahi karta, magar main apna Ihram tab tak khatam nahi kar sakta jab tak Hadi apni jagah (zabah hone ki jagah) na pahunch jaaye." Isliye unhone (Nabi ke hukum ke mutabiq) kiya.'"

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Al-Musaiyab:`Ali and `Uthman differed regarding Hajj-at-Tamattu` while they were at 'Usfan (a familiar place near Mecca). `Ali said, "I see you want to forbid people to do a thing that the Prophet (ﷺ) did?" When `Ali saw that, he assumed Ihram for both Hajj and `Umra
hi: Sa'id bin Al-Musaiyab bataate hain: Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ka Hajj-at-Tamattu ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hua jabke woh Usfan (Mecca ke qareeb ek jaani-pehchani jagah) mein the. Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: "Mujhe lagta hai aap ek aisi cheez se logon ko roknaa chahte hain jo Nabi ne khud ki thi?" Jab Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne yeh dekha, unhone Hajj-Umrah dono ka Ihram ek saath baandha.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:We came with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (to Mecca) and we were saying: 'Labbaika Allahumma Labbaik' for Hajj. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered us to perform `Umra with that Ihram (instead of Hajj)
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Allah ke Rasool ke saath (Mecca) aaye aur "Labbaika Allahumma Labbaik" kehte the Hajj ke liye. Allah ke Rasool ne humein usi Ihram se Umrah karne ka hukum diya (Hajj ke bajaye).

e: Narrated `Imran:We performed Hajj-at-Tamattu` in the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and then the Qur'an was revealed (regarding Hajj-at-Tamattu`) and somebody said what he wished (regarding Hajj-at-Tamattu`) according his own opinion
hi: Imran (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Humne Allah ke Rasool ki zindagi mein Hajj-at-Tamattu kiya, phir Quran nazil hua (Hajj-at-Tamattu ke baare mein), aur kisi ne apni raay ke mutabiq jo chaha kaha.

e: Ibn 'Abbas said that he has been asked regarding Hajj-at-Tamattu' on which he said:"The Muhajirin and the Ansar and the wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) and we did the same. When we reached Makkah, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Give up your intention of doing the Hajj (at this moment) and perform 'Umra, except the one who had garlanded the Hady." So, we performed Tawaf round the Ka'bah and [Sa'y] between As-safa and Al-MArwa, slept with our wives and wore ordinary (stitched) clothes. The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "Whoever has garlanded his Hady is not allowed to finish the Ihram till the Hady has reached its destination (has been sacrificed)". Then on the night of Tarwiya (8th Dhul Hijjah, in the afternoon) he ordered us to assume Ihram for Hajj and when we had performed all the ceremonies of Hajj, we came and performed Tawaf round the Ka'bah and (Sa'y) between As-Safa and Al-Marwa, and then our Hajj was complete, and we had to sacrifice a Hady according to the statement of Allah: "... He must slaughter a Hady such as he can afford, but if he cannot afford it, he should observe Saum (fasts) three days during the Hajj and seven days after his return (to his home)…." (V. 2:196). And the sacrifice of the sheep is sufficient. So, the Prophet (ﷺ) and his Companions joined the two religious deeds, (i.e. Hajj and 'Umra) in one year, for Allah revealed (the permissibility) of such practice in His book and in the Sunna (legal ways) of His Prophet (ﷺ) and rendered it permissible for all the people except those living in Makkah. Allah says: "This is for him whose family is not present at the Al-Masjid-Al-Haram, (i.e. non resident of Makkah)." The months of Hajj which Allah mentioned in His book are: Shawwal, Dhul-Qa'da and Dhul-Hijjah. Whoever performed Hajj-at-Tamattu' in those months, then slaughtering or fasting is compulsory for him. The words: 1. Ar-Rafatha means sexual intercourse. 2. Al-Fasuq means all kinds of sin, and 3. Al-Jidal means to dispute
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se Hajj-at-Tamattu ke baare mein pucha gaya, unhone jawab diya: "Muhajireen, Ansaar, aur Nabi ki biwiyon, aur humne bhi yehi kiya. Jab hum Mecca pahunche, Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: 'Apni Hajj ki niyyat chhod do (abhi ke liye) aur Umrah karo, siwaye us shaks ke jisne Hadi ko maalaayen pehnayi hon.' Isliye humne Ka'ba ka Tawaf aur Safa-Marwa ka Sa'i kiya, apni biwiyon ke saath soye, aur aam (silai wale) kapde pehne." Nabi ne joda: "Jisne apne Hadi ko maalaayen pehnayi hain, use Hadi apni jagah pahunchne (zabah hone) tak Ihram khatam karne ki ijazat nahi." Phir Tarwiya ki raat (8 Zul-Hijja ki sham), unhone humein Hajj ka Ihram baandhne ka hukum diya, aur jab humne Hajj ke sab arkaan mukammal kiye, hum aaye aur Ka'ba ka Tawaf aur Safa-Marwa ka Sa'i kiya, phir hamara Hajj mukammal ho gaya, aur humein Hadi zabah karni thi Allah ke is farmaan ke mutabiq: "...usse jo mumkin ho Hadi zabah karni chahiye, magar agar woh na kar sake, to Hajj ke teen din aur wapas jaane ke baad saat din roza rakhna chahiye..." (2:196). Aur ek bhed ki qurbani kaafi hai. Isliye Nabi aur unke sahaba ne ek hi saal do ibaadatein (Hajj aur Umrah) jodi, kyunke Allah ne apni Kitaab aur apne Nabi ki Sunnat mein iski ijazat di, aur sab logon ke liye ise jaiz kiya siwaye Mecca ke rehne walon ke. Allah farmataa hai: "Yeh us shaks ke liye hai jiska pariwara Al-Masjid-Al-Haram ke paas maujood na ho (yaani Mecca ka rehne wala na ho)." Hajj ke mahine jo Allah ne apni Kitaab mein bataye hain: Shawwal, Zul-Qa'da aur Zul-Hijja. Jo bhi in maheenon mein Hajj-at-Tamattu kare, uspar qurbani ya roza farz hai. 1. Ar-Rafath ka matlab hai humbistari. 2. Al-Fusuq ka matlab hai har qisam ka gunah. 3. Al-Jidal ka matlab hai jhagda karna.

e: Narrated Nafi`:On reaching the sanctuary of Mecca, Ibn `Umar used to stop, reciting Talbiya and then he would pass the night at Dhi-Tuwa and then offer the Fajr prayer and take a bath. He used to say that the Prophet (ﷺ) used to do the same
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Mecca ke Haram (seema) mein pahunchte hi, Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) Talbiya kehte huye ruk jate, phir Dhi-Tuwa mein raat guzarte, phir Fajr ki namaz padhte aur ghusl karte. Woh kehte the ke Nabi bhi aisa hi karte the.

e: Narrated Nafi`:' Ibn `Umar said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) passed the night at Dhi-Tuwa till it was dawn and then he entered Mecca." Ibn `Umar used to do the same
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Nabi ne Dhi-Tuwa mein raat guzari yahan tak ke subah hui, phir Mecca mein daakhil hue." Ibn Umar bhi aisa hi karte the.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to enter Mecca from the high Thaniya and used to leave Mecca from the low Thaniya
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool Mecca mein oonchi Thaniya (rasta) se daakhil hote aur neechi Thaniya se nikalte.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered Mecca from Kada' from the highest Thaniya which is at Al-Batha' and used to leave Mecca from the low Thaniya
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool Mecca mein Kada se daakhil hote, jo Al-Batha mein sabse oonchi Thaniya hai, aur neechi Thaniya se nikalte.

e: Narrated `Aisha:When the Prophet (ﷺ) came to Mecca he entered from its higher side and left from its lower side
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab Nabi Mecca aaye, woh isse oonchi taraf se daakhil hue aur neechi taraf se nikale.

e: Narrated `Aisha':In the year of the conquest of Mecca, the Prophet (ﷺ) entered Mecca from Kada' and left Mecca from Kuda, from the higher part of Mecca
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Fatah-e-Mecca ke saal, Nabi Kada se Mecca mein daakhil hue aur Kuda se, jo Mecca ke oonche hisse mein hai, nikale.

e: Narrated `Aisha:In the year of the conquest of Mecca, the Prophet (ﷺ) entered Mecca from Kada' at the higher place of Mecca. (Hisham, a sub-narrator said, " `Urwa used to enter (Mecca) from both Kada' and Kuda and he often entered through Kada' which was nearer to his dwelling place
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Fatah-e-Mecca ke saal, Nabi Kada se Mecca mein daakhil hue, jo Mecca ke oonche hisse mein hai. (Hisham, doosre raawi ne kaha: "Urwa Kada aur Kuda dono se daakhil hote the, magar aksar Kada se kyunke woh unke ghar ke zyada qareeb tha.")

e: Narrated Hisham:`Urwa said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) entered Mecca in the year of the conquest of Mecca from the side of Kada' which is at the higher part of Mecca." `Urwa often entered from Kada' which was nearer of the two to his dwelling place
hi: Hisham bataate hain: Urwa ne kaha: "Nabi Fatah-e-Mecca ke saal Kada ki taraf se Mecca mein daakhil hue, jo Mecca ke oonche hisse mein hai." Urwa aksar Kada se hi daakhil hote the kyunke woh do jagahon mein unke ghar ke zyada qareeb tha.

e: Narrated Hisham from his father:In the year of the conquest of Mecca, the Prophet (ﷺ) entered Mecca from the side of Kada. `Urwa used to enter through both places and he often entered through Kada' which was nearer of the two to his dwelling place
hi: Hisham, apne waalid ke hawale se: Fatah-e-Mecca ke saal, Nabi Kada ki taraf se Mecca mein daakhil hue. Urwa dono jagahon se daakhil hote the, magar aksar Kada se kyunke woh unke ghar ke zyada qareeb tha.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:When the Ka`ba was built, the Prophet (ﷺ) and `Abbas went to bring stones (for its construction). Al `Abbas said to the Prophet, "Take off your waist sheet and put it on your neck." (When the Prophet (ﷺ) took it off) he fell on the ground with his eyes open towards the sky and said, "Give me my waist sheet." And he covered himself with it
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Ka'ba banaya ja raha tha, Nabi aur Abbas patthar laane gaye. Abbas ne Nabi se kaha: "Apna kamar ka kapda utaar kar apni gardan par rakh lijiye." (Jab Nabi ne ise utaara) woh zameen par gir gaye, unki aankhein aasman ki taraf khuli thi, aur unhone kaha: "Mujhe mera kamar ka kapda do." Aur unhone use dobara pehna.

e: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to her, "Do you know that when your people (Quraish) rebuilt the Ka`ba, they decreased it from its original foundation laid by Abraham?" I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Why don't you rebuild it on its original foundation laid by Abraham?" He replied, "Were it not for the fact that your people are close to the Pre-Islamic Period of ignorance (i.e. they have recently become Muslims) I would have done so." The sub-narrator, `Abdullah (bin `Umar ) stated: `Aisha 'must have heard this from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for in my opinion Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had not placed his hand over the two corners of the Ka`ba opposite Al-Hijr only because the Ka`ba was not rebuilt on its original foundations laid by Abraham
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki biwi) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne unse kaha: "Kya tumhe pata hai jab tumhari qaum (Quraish) ne Ka'ba dobara banwaya, unhone ise Ibrahim ki daali hui asli buniyaad se chhota kar diya?" Maine kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Aap ise Ibrahim ki asli buniyaad par kyun nahi dobara banate?" Aap ne jawab diya: "Agar aisi baat na hoti ke tumhari qaum abhi haal hi mein jahiliyat se nikli hai (yaani hal hi mein Musalman hui hai), main zaroor aisa karta." Doosre raawi Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) (bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ)) ne bataya: "Ayesha ne yeh zaroor Allah ke Rasool se suna hoga, kyunke mere khayaal mein Allah ke Rasool ne Ka'ba ke un donon konon par jo Hijr ke saamne hain kabhi haath nahi rakha, sirf isliye kyunke Ka'ba Ibrahim ki asli buniyaad par dobara nahi banaya gaya tha."

e: Narrated `Aisha:I asked the Prophet (ﷺ) whether the round wall (near Ka`ba) was part of the Ka`ba. The Prophet (ﷺ) replied in the affirmative. I further said, "What is wrong with them, why have they not included it in the building of the Ka`ba?" He said, "Don't you see that your people (Quraish) ran short of money (so they could not include it inside the building of Ka`ba)?" I asked, "What about its gate? Why is it so high?" He replied, "Your people did this so as to admit into it whomever they liked and prevent whomever they liked. Were your people not close to the Pre-Islamic Period of ignorance (i.e. they have recently embraced Islam) and were I not afraid that they would dislike it, surely I would have included the (area of the) wall inside the building of the Ka`ba and I would have lowered its gate to the level of the ground
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine Nabi se pucha kya (Ka'ba ke paas ki) golai wali deewar Ka'ba ka hissa hai. Nabi ne haan mein jawab diya. Maine phir pucha: "Unhe kya hua, unhone ise Ka'ba ki imaarat mein kyun shamil nahi kiya?" Aap ne kaha: "Kya tumhe nahi pata ke tumhari qaum (Quraish) ke paas paise kam pad gaye the (isliye woh Ka'ba ki imaarat mein shamil na kar sake)?" Maine pucha: "Aur iska darwaza itna ooncha kyun hai?" Aap ne jawab diya: "Tumhari qaum ne aisa isliye kiya taake woh jise chahen andar aane den aur jise chahen roken. Agar tumhari qaum abhi haal hi mein jahiliyat se na nikli hoti aur mujhe dar na hota ke unhe yeh napasand aayegi, to main zaroor deewar ko Ka'ba ki imaarat mein shamil kar deta aur darwaze ko zameen ke barabar tak neecha kar deta."

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me, "Were your people not close to the Pre-Islamic period of ignorance, I would have demolished the Ka`ba and would have rebuilt it on its original foundations laid by Abraham (for Quraish had curtailed its building), and I would have built a back door (too)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool ne mujhse kaha: "Agar tumhari qaum jahiliyat se abhi haal hi mein na nikli hoti, main Ka'ba girakar isse Ibrahim ki asli buniyaad par dobara banata (kyunke Quraish ne isse chhota kar diya tha), aur ek pichhla darwaza bhi banata."

e: Narrated Yazid bin Ruman from `Urwa:`Aisha said that the Prophet (ﷺ) said to her, "O Aisha! Were your nation not close to the Pre-Islamic Period of Ignorance, I would have had the Ka`ba demolished and would have included in it the portion which had been left, and would have made it at a level with the ground and would have made two doors for it, one towards the east and the other towards the west, and then by doing this it would have been built on the foundations laid by Abraham." That was what urged Ibn-Az-Zubair to demolish the Ka`ba. Yazid said, "I saw Ibn-Az-Zubair when he demolished and rebuilt the Ka`ba and included in it a portion of Al-Hijr (the unroofed portion of Ka`ba which is at present in the form of a compound towards the northwest of the Ka`ba). I saw the original foundations of Abraham which were of stones resembling the humps of camels." So Jarir asked Yazid, "Where was the place of those stones?" Yazid said, "I will just now show it to you." So Jarir accompanied Yazid and entered Al-Hijr, and Yazid pointed to a place and said, "Here it is." Jarir said, "It appeared to me about six cubits from Al-Hijr or so
hi: Yazid bin Ruman, Urwa ke hawale se: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha ke Nabi ne unse kaha: "Aye Ayesha! Agar tumhari qaum abhi haal hi mein jahiliyat se na nikli hoti, main Ka'ba girvata aur usme woh hissa shamil karta jo chhod diya gaya tha, aur isse zameen ke barabar kar deta, aur do darwaze banata, ek mashriq ki taraf ek magrib ki taraf, aur isi tarah yeh Ibrahim ki buniyaad par dobara banti." Yehi wajah thi jisne Ibn-Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko Ka'ba girvane par uksaaya. Yazid ne kaha: "Maine Ibn-Az-Zubair ko dekha jab unhone Ka'ba giraaya aur dobara banaya, aur usme Al-Hijr ka ek hissa shamil kiya (Ka'ba ka woh bina chhat wala hissa jo abhi Ka'ba ke shimal-magrib mein ek angaan ki tarah hai). Maine Ibrahim ki asli buniyaad dekhi jo unt ke ku bon jaise pattharon se bani thi." Jarir (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Yazid se pucha: "Woh patthar kahan the?" Yazid ne kaha: "Main abhi tumhe dikhataa hoon." To Jarir Yazid ke saath Al-Hijr mein gaye, aur Yazid ne ek jagah dikhate huye kaha: "Yahin hai." Jarir ne kaha: "Mujhe laga ke woh Al-Hijr se taqreeban chhe haath door tha."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:On the Day of the Conquest of Mecca, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah has made this town a sanctuary. Its thorny bushes should not be cut, its game should not be chased, and its fallen things should not be picked up except by one who would announce it publicly
