hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Fatah-e-Mecca ke din, Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Allah ne is shehar ko haram (muqaddas jagah) banaya hai. Iski kaante wali jhaadiyan na kaati jaayen, iske shikaar ka peechha na kiya jaaye, aur isme giri hui koi cheez sirf woh shaks uthaaye jo use elaan kare (public tor par)."

e: Narrated 'Usama bin Zaid:I asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Where will you stay in Mecca? Will you stay in your house in Mecca?" He replied, "Has `Aqil left any property or house?" `Aqil along with Talib had inherited the property of Abu Talib. Jafar and `Ali did not inherit anything as they were Muslims and the other two were non-believers. `Umar bin Al-Khattab used to say, "A believer cannot inherit (anything from an) infidel." Ibn Shihab, (a sub-narrator) said, "They (`Umar and others) derived the above verdict from Allah's Statement: "Verily! those who believed and Emigrated and strove with their life And property in Allah's Cause, And those who helped (the emigrants) And gave them their places to live in, These are (all) allies to one another
hi: Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Maine pucha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Aap Mecca mein kahan thehrenge? Kya aap Mecca mein apne ghar mein rukenge?" Aap ne jawab diya: "Kya Aqil ne koi maal ya ghar chhodaa hai?" Aqil ne Talib ke saath Abu Talib ki maal ki waraasat li thi. Jafar aur Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko kuch nahi mila kyunke woh Musalman the aur baaki do (Aqil, Talib) ghair-Musalman the. Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Khattab (رضی اللہ عنہ) kaha karte the: "Ek momin ek kaafir se waraasat nahi le sakta." Ibn Shihab ne kaha: "Unhone (Umar aur doosron ne) yeh faisla Allah ke farmaan se liya: 'Beshak, jo iman laaye aur hijrat ki aur Allah ki raah mein apni jaan-maal se koshish ki, aur jinhone (Muhajireen ko) panah di aur jagah di, yeh sab ek-doosre ke madadgar hain.'"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) intended to enter Mecca he said, "Our destination tomorrow, if Allah wished, will be Khaif Bani Kinana where (the pagans) had taken the oath of Kufr." (Against the Prophet (ﷺ) i.e. to be loyal to heathenism by boycotting Bani Hashim, the Prophet's folk) (See Hadith)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool Mecca mein daakhil hone ka iraada kiya, unhone farmaya: "Insha Allah, kal humari manzil Khaif Bani Kinana hogi jahan (mushrikon ne) kufr ki qasam khaayi thi." (Nabi ke khilaf, yaani Bani Hashim ka bahishkaar karke jahiliyat ke saath wafadaar rehne ki.)

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:On the Day of Nahr at Mina, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Tomorrow we shall stay at Khaif Bani Kinana where the pagans had taken the oath of Kufr (heathenism)." He meant (by that place) Al-Muhassab where the Quraish tribe and Bani Kinana concluded a contract against Bani Hashim and Bani `Abdul-Muttalib or Bani Al-Muttalib that they would not intermarry with them or deal with them in business until they handed over the Prophet (ﷺ) to them
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Yaum-un-Nahr ke din Mina mein, Nabi ne farmaya: "Kal hum Khaif Bani Kinana mein rukenge jahan mushrikon ne kufr ki qasam khaayi thi." Aap ka matlab tha Al-Muhassab, jahan Quraish aur Bani Kinana ne Bani Hashim aur Bani Abdul Muttalib ya Bani Al-Muttalib ke khilaf ek samjhauta kiya tha ke woh unse shaadi-byaah nahi karenge na tijarat karenge jab tak woh Nabi ko unke hawale na kar dein.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet;; said, "Dhus-Suwaiqa-tain (literally: One with two lean legs) from Ethiopia will demolish the Ka`ba
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Dhus-Suwaiqa-tain (yaani patli-patli taangon wala) Ethiopia se Ka'ba ko girvega."

e: Narrated `Aisha:The people used to fast on 'Ashura (the tenth day of the month of Muharram) before the fasting of Ramadan was made obligatory. And on that day the Ka`ba used to be covered with a cover. When Allah made the fasting of the month of Ramadan compulsory, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever wishes to fast (on the day of 'Ashura') may do so; and whoever wishes to leave it can do so
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Log Ashura (Muharram ki das taareekh) ka roza rakhte the isse pehle ke Ramadan ka roza farz kiya jaaye. Aur us din Ka'ba par gilaaf chadhaya jata tha. Jab Allah ne Ramadan ke roze farz kiye, Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jo (Ashura ka) roza rakhna chahe, rakh sakta hai; aur jo chhodna chahe, chhod sakta hai."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) said "The people will continue performing the Hajj and `Umra to the Ka`ba even after the appearance of Gog and Magog." Narrated Shu`ba extra: The Hour (Day of Judgment) will not be established till the Hajj (to the Ka`ba) is abandoned
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Log Ka'ba ka Hajj aur Umrah karte rahenge, chahe Yajuj-Majuj bhi zahir ho jaayen." Shu'ba ki izafa riwayat: Qiyamat tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak Hajj (Ka'ba tak) tark na kar diya jaaye.

e: Narrated Abu Wail:(One day) I sat along with Shaiba on the chair inside the Ka`ba. He (Shaiba) said, "No doubt, `Umar sat at this place and said, 'I intended not to leave any yellow (i.e. gold) or white (i.e. silver) (inside the Ka`ba) undistributed.' I said (to `Umar), 'But your two companions (i.e. The Prophet (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr) did not do so.' `Umar said, They are the two persons whom I always follow
hi: Abu Wail bataate hain: (Ek din) main Shaiba ke saath Ka'ba ke andar ek kursi par baitha tha. Unhone (Shaiba ne) kaha: "Beshak, Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) isi jagah baithe the aur kaha: 'Mera iraada tha ke Ka'ba ke andar koi peeli (sona) ya safed (chandi) cheez baant diye bina na chhodun.'" Maine (Umar se) kaha: "Magar aapke do sathiyon (Nabi aur Abu Bakr) ne aisa nahi kiya." Umar ne kaha: "Woh dono hi log hain jinki main hamesha pairvi karta hoon."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "As if I were looking at him, a black person with thin legs plucking the stones of the Ka`ba one after another
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Goya main abhi use dekh raha hoon, ek kaala shaks, patli taangon wala, Ka'ba ke patthar ek-ek karke ukhaad raha hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Dhus-Suwaiqatain (the thin legged man) from Ethiopia will demolish the Ka`ba
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Dhus-Suwaiqatain (patli taangon wala) Ethiopia se Ka'ba ko girvega."

e: Narrated `Abis bin Rabi`a:`Umar came near the Black Stone and kissed it and said "No doubt, I know that you are a stone and can neither benefit anyone nor harm anyone. Had I not seen Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) kissing you I would not have kissed you
hi: Abis bin Rabi'a bataate hain: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) Hajr-e-Aswad (Kaala Patthar) ke paas aaye, use bosa diya aur kaha: "Beshak, mujhe pata hai tum sirf ek patthar ho aur na kisi ko faida pahucha sakte ho na nuqsaan. Agar maine Allah ke Rasool ko tumhe bosa dete na dekha hota, main tumhe kabhi bosa na deta."

e: Narrated Salim that his father said:"Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), Usama bin Zaid, Bilal, and `Uthman bin abu Talha entered the Ka`ba and then closed its door. When they opened the door I was the first person to enter (the Ka`ba). I met Bilal and asked him, "Did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) offer a prayer inside (the Ka`ba)?" Bilal replied in the affirmative and said, "(The Prophet (ﷺ) offered the prayer) in between the two right pillars
hi: Salim, apne waalid ke hawale se: "Allah ke Rasool, Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ), Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ), aur Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) Ka'ba mein daakhil hue aur darwaza band kar diya. Jab unhone darwaza khola, main sabse pehle andar (Ka'ba mein) daakhil hua. Main Bilal se mila aur pucha: 'Kya Allah ke Rasool ne andar namaz padhi?' Bilal ne haan mein jawab diya aur kaha: '(Nabi ne namaz padhi) do dahine sutoon ke darmiyan.'"

e: Narrated Nafi`:Whenever Ibn `Umar entered the Ka`ba he used to walk straight keeping the door at his back on entering, and used to proceed on till about three cubits from the wall in front of him, and then he would offer the prayer there aiming at the place where Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prayed, as Bilal had told him. There is no harm for any person to offer the prayer at any place inside the Ka`ba
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Jab bhi Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) Ka'ba mein daakhil hote, seedhe chalte, darwaza peeche chhodte huye, aur saamne wali deewar se taqreeban teen haath door jate, phir wahin namaz padhte, us jagah ka nishaana lekar jahan Allah ke Rasool ne namaz padhi thi, jaisa Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne unhe bataya tha. Ka'ba ke andar kisi bhi jagah namaz padhne mein koi harj nahi.

e: Narrated Isma'il bin Abu Khalid:`Abdullah bin Abu `Aufa said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) performed the `Umra. He performed Tawaf of the Ka`ba and offered two rak`at behind the Maqam (Abraham's place) and was accompanied by those who were screening him from the people." Somebody asked `Abdullah, "Did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) enter the Ka`ba?" `Abdullah replied in the negative
hi: Ismail bin Abu Khalid bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abu Aufa ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool ne Umrah kiya. Aap ne Ka'ba ka Tawaf kiya aur Maqam (Ibrahim ki jagah) ke peechhe do rakat padhi, aur unke saath woh log the jo unhe logon se parda kar rahe the." Kisi ne Abdullah se pucha: "Kya Allah ke Rasool Ka'ba mein daakhil hue the?" Abdullah ne na mein jawab diya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to Mecca, he refused to enter the Ka`ba with idols in it. He ordered (idols to be taken out). So they were taken out. The people took out the pictures of Abraham and Ishmael holding Azlams in their hands. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "May Allah curse these people. By Allah, both Abraham and Ishmael never did the game of chance with Azlams." Then he entered the Ka`ba and said Takbir at its corners but did not offer the prayer in it
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool Mecca aaye, unhone Ka'ba mein daakhil hone se inkaar kiya kyunke usme buth the. Aap ne unhe bahar nikaalne ka hukum diya. To woh nikaale gaye. Logon ne Ibrahim aur Ismail ki tasveerein bhi nikaali jinke haathon mein Azlams (fal nikaalne ke teer) the. Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Allah ki laanat ho in logon par. Allah ki qasam, na Ibrahim ne na Ismail ne kabhi Azlams se fal nikaale." Phir Aap Ka'ba mein daakhil hue aur uske konon par Takbir kahi, magar usme namaz nahi padhi.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and his companions came to Mecca, the pagans circulated the news that a group of people were coming to them and they had been weakened by the Fever of Yathrib (Medina). So the Prophet ordered his companions to do Ramal in the first three rounds of Tawaf of the Ka`ba and to walk between the two corners (The Black Stone and Yemenite corner). The Prophet (ﷺ) did not order them to do Ramal in all the rounds of Tawaf out of pity for them
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool aur unke sahaba Mecca aaye, mushrikon ne yeh khabar phailaaee ke ek giroh unke paas aa raha hai jo Yathrib (Madina) ke bukhaar se kamzor ho chuka hai. Isliye Nabi ne apne sahaba ko Ka'ba ke Tawaf ki pehli teen chakkaron mein Ramal (tez chaal se lehrte huye chalna) karne aur do konon (Hajr-e-Aswad aur Yemeni kona) ke beech (aam raftar se) chalne ka hukum diya. Nabi ne unhe sab saat chakkaron mein Ramal karne ka hukum nahi diya, unpar reham karte huye.

e: Narrated Salim that his father said:I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) arriving at Mecca; he kissed the Black Stone Corner first while doing Tawaf and did ramal in the first three rounds of the seven rounds (of Tawaf)
hi: Salim, apne waalid ke hawale se: Maine Allah ke Rasool ko Mecca pahunchte dekha; unhone Tawaf shuru karte waqt sabse pehle Hajr-e-Aswad wale kone ko bosa diya, aur saat chakkaron mein se pehli teen mein Ramal kiya.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) did Ramal in (first) three rounds (of Tawaf), and walked in the remaining four, in Hajj and Umra
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne (pehli) teen chakkaron mein Ramal kiya aur baaki chaar mein aam chaal se chale, Hajj aur Umrah dono mein.

e: Narrated Zaid bin Aslam from his father who said:"`Umar bin Al-Khattab addressed the Corner (Black Stone) saying, 'By Allah! I know that you are a stone and can neither benefit nor harm. Had I not seen the Prophet (ﷺ) touching (and kissing) you, I would never have touched (and kissed) you.' Then he kissed it and said, 'There is no reason for us to do Ramal (in Tawaf) except that we wanted to show off before the pagans, and now Allah has destroyed them.' `Umar added, '(Nevertheless), the Prophet (ﷺ) did that and we do not want to leave it (i.e. Ramal)
hi: Zaid bin Aslam, apne waalid ke hawale se: "Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Khattab (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Kone (Hajr-e-Aswad) se khitaab karte huye kaha: 'Allah ki qasam! Mujhe pata hai tum sirf ek patthar ho aur na kisi ko faida pahucha sakte ho na nuqsaan. Agar maine Nabi ko tumhe chhoote (aur bosa dete) na dekha hota, main tumhe kabhi na chhodtaa.' Phir unhone use bosa diya aur kaha: 'Humein Ramal karne ki koi wajah nahi thi siwaye is ke ke hum mushrikon ke saamne apni taaqat dikhana chahte the, aur ab Allah ne unhe barbaad kar diya hai.' Umar ne joda: '(Iske bawajood), Nabi ne aisa kiya aur hum ise (Ramal) chhodna nahi chahte.'"

e: Narrated Nafi`:Ibn `Umar. said, "I have never missed the touching of these two stones of Ka`ba (the Black Stone and the Yemenite Corner) both in the presence and the absence of crowds, since I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) touching them." I asked Nafi`: "Did Ibn `Umar use to walk between the two Corners?" Nafi` replied, "He used to walk in order that it might be easy for him to touch it (the Corner Stone)
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Maine kabhi Ka'ba ke inhi do pattharon (Hajr-e-Aswad aur Yemeni kona) ko chhote se nahi chhoda, chahe bhirr ho ya na ho, jab se maine Nabi ko unhe chhote dekha." Maine Nafi se pucha: "Kya Ibn Umar donon konon ke beech chalte the?" Nafi ne jawab diya: "Woh isliye chalte the taake unhe chhona asaan ho."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas.:In his Last Hajj the Prophet (ﷺ) performed Tawaf of the Ka`ba riding a camel and pointed a bent-headed stick towards the Corner (Black Stone)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Apne aakhri Hajj mein, Nabi ne apni oontni par sawar hokar Ka'ba ka Tawaf kiya aur ek moded huye sir wali chhadi se Kone (Hajr-e-Aswad) ki taraf ishara kiya.

e: Abu Ash-Sha'tha said, "Who keeps away from some portion of the Ka'bah?" Mu'awiya used to touch the four corners of the Ka'bah, Ibn 'Abbas said to him, "These two corners (the one facing the Hijr) are not to be touched." Mu'awiya said, "Nothing is untouchable in the Ka'bah." And Ibn Az-Zubair used to touch all the corners of the Ka'bah
hi: Abu Ash-Sha'tha bataate hain: "Kaun Ka'ba ke kisi hisse se bachta hai?" Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) Ka'ba ke charon konon ko chhote the, Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne unse kaha: "Yeh do kone (jo Hijr ke saamne hain) chhote ke liye nahi hain." Muawiya ne kaha: "Ka'ba mein kuch bhi na-chhone layak nahi." Aur Ibn Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) sab konon ko chhote the.

e: Narrated Salim bin `Abdullah that his father said:"I have not seen the Prophet (ﷺ) touching except the two Yemenite Corners (i.e. the ones facing Yemen)
hi: Salim bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ), apne waalid ke hawale se: "Maine Nabi ko sirf do Yemeni konon (yaani jo Yemen ki taraf hain) ke ilawa kisi aur kone ko chhote nahi dekha."

e: Narrated Zaid bin Aslam that his father said:"I saw `Umar bin Al-Khattab kissing the Black Stone and he then said, (to it) 'Had I not seen Allah's Apostle kissing you, (stone) I would not have kissed you
hi: Zaid bin Aslam, apne waalid ke hawale se: "Maine Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Khattab (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko Hajr-e-Aswad chumte dekha aur unhone (usse) kaha: 'Agar maine Allah ke Rasool ko tumhe bosa dete na dekha hota, main tumhe kabhi bosa na deta.'"

e: Narrated Az-Zubair bin 'Arabi:A man asked Ibn `Umar about the touching of the Black Stone. Ibn `Umar said, "I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) touching and kissing it." The questioner said, "But if there were a throng (much rush) round the Ka`ba and the people overpowered me, (what would I do?)" He replied angrily, "Stay in Yemen (as that man was from Yemen). I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) touching and kissing it
hi: Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Arabi bataate hain: Ek shaks ne Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se Hajr-e-Aswad chhone ke baare mein pucha. Ibn Umar ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool ko ise chhote aur bosa dete dekha." Sawaal karne wale ne kaha: "Magar agar Ka'ba ke aas-paas bhirr ho aur log mujhe dhakkā de dein, (to main kya karoon)?" Woh gusse se jawab diya: "Yemen mein hi rah jaao (kyunke woh shaks Yemen se tha). Maine Allah ke Rasool ko ise chhote aur bosa dete dekha."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) performed Tawaf of the Ka`ba while riding a camel, and whenever he came in front of the Corner, he pointed towards it (with something)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne apni oontni par sawar hokar Ka'ba ka Tawaf kiya, aur jab bhi woh Kone ke saamne aaate, uski taraf ishara karte.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) performed Tawaf of the Ka`ba riding a camel, and every time he came in front of the Corner (having the Black Stone), he pointed towards it with something he had with him and said Takbir
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne apni oontni par sawar hokar Ka'ba ka Tawaf kiya, aur jab bhi woh Kone (Hajr-e-Aswad wale) ke saamne aaate, apne paas ki cheez se uski taraf ishara karte aur Takbir kahte.

e: Narrated `Urwa:`Aisha said, "The first thing the Prophet (ﷺ) did on reaching Mecca, was the ablution and then he performed Tawaf of the Ka`ba and that was not `Umra (alone), (but Hajj-al-Qiran). `Urwa added: Later Abu Bakr and `Umar did the same in their Hajj." And I performed the Hajj with my father Az-Zubair, and the first thing he did was Tawaf of the Ka`ba. Later I saw the Muhajirin (Emigrants) and the Ansar doing the same. My mother (Asma') told me that she, her sister (`Aisha), Az-Zubair and such and such persons assumed Ihram for `Umra, and after they passed their hands over the Black Stone Corner (of the Ka`ba) they finished the Ihram. (i.e. After doing Tawaf of the Ka`ba and Sa`i between Safa-Marwa)
hi: Urwa bataate hain: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha: "Mecca pahunchte hi sabse pehli cheez jo Nabi ne ki, woh wudu tha, phir unhone Ka'ba ka Tawaf kiya, aur yeh sirf Umrah nahi tha (balki Hajj-al-Qiran)." Urwa ne joda: "Baad mein Abu Bakr aur Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne bhi apne Hajj mein wahi kiya." "Aur maine apne waalid Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath Hajj kiya, aur unhone sabse pehle Ka'ba ka Tawaf kiya. Baad mein maine Muhajireen aur Ansaar ko bhi aisa hi karte dekha. Meri maa (Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا)) ne mujhe bataya ke unhone, unki behn (Ayesha), Az-Zubair aur falaan-falaan logon ne Umrah ka Ihram baandha, aur jab unhone Hajr-e-Aswad ke kone par apne haath phere, unhone Ihram khatam kar diya." (yaani Ka'ba ka Tawaf aur Safa-Marwa ka Sa'i karne ke baad)

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) performed Tawaf of the Ka`ba for Hajj or `Umra, he used to do Ramal during the first three rounds, and in the last four rounds he used to walk; then after the Tawaf he used to offer two rak`at and then performed Tawaf between Safa and Marwa
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool Hajj ya Umrah ke liye Ka'ba ka Tawaf karte, pehli teen chakkaron mein Ramal karte aur aakhri chaar mein aam chaal se chalte; phir Tawaf ke baad do rakat padhte aur phir Safa-Marwa ka Tawaf karte.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:When the Prophet (ﷺ) performed the Tawaf of the Ka`ba, he did Ramal during the first three rounds and in the last four rounds he used to walk and while doing Tawaf between Safa and Marwa, he used to run in the midst of the rain water passage
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Jab Nabi Ka'ba ka Tawaf karte, pehli teen chakkaron mein Ramal karte aur aakhri chaar mein aam chaal se chalte, aur Safa-Marwa ke beech Tawaf karte waqt baarish ke paani ki nehr ke beech mein daudte.

e: Ibn Juraij said, " `Ata informed us that when Ibn Hisham forbade women to perform Tawaf with men he said to him, 'How do you forbid them while the wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) used to perform Tawaf with the men?' I said, 'Was this before decreeing of the use of the veil or after it? `Ata took an oath and said, 'I saw it after the order of veil.' I said, 'How did they mix with the men?' `Ata said, 'The women never mixed with the men, and `A'ishah used to perform Tawaf separately and never mixed with men. Once it happened that `A'ishah was performing the Tawaf, and a woman said to her, 'O Mother of believers! Let us touch the Black stone.' `A'ishah said to her, 'Go yourself,' and she herself refused to do so. The wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) used to come out in night, in disguise and used to perform Tawaf with men. But whenever they intended to enter the Ka`bah, they would stay outside till the men had gone out. I and `Ubaid bin `Umair used to visit `A'ishah while she was residing at Jauf Thabir." I asked, "What was her veil?" `Ata said, "She was wearing an old Turkish veil, and that was the only thing (veil) which was screen between us and her. I saw a pink cover on her
hi: Ibn Juraij bataate hain: Ata ne humein bataya ke jab Ibn Hisham ne aurton ko mardon ke saath Tawaf karne se mana kiya, unhone (Ata ne) kaha: "Aap unhe kaise mana kar sakte hain jabke Nabi ki biwiyan mardon ke saath Tawaf karti thi?" Maine kaha: "Kya yeh parda ka hukum aane se pehle tha ya baad mein?" Ata ne qasam khakar kaha: "Maine ise parda ke hukum ke baad dekha." Maine kaha: "Woh mardon ke saath kaise ghulmil jaati thi?" Ata ne kaha: "Aurtein mardon ke saath ghulmil nahi hoti thi, aur Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) alag se Tawaf karti thi aur kabhi mardon se ghulmil nahi hoti thi. Ek baar Ayesha Tawaf kar rahi thi, aur ek aurat ne unse kaha: 'Aye Ummul-Momineen! Chaliye Hajr-e-Aswad ko chhue.' Ayesha ne kaha: 'Tum khud jaao,' aur khud aisa karne se inkaar kiya. Nabi ki biwiyan raat ko chhup kar bahar aati aur mardon ke saath Tawaf karti thi. Magar jab bhi woh Ka'ba mein daakhil hone ka iraada karti, woh bahar rukti jab tak mard chale na jaate." Main aur Ubaid bin Umair Ayesha se milne jate the jabke woh Jauf Thabir mein rehti thi. Maine pucha: "Unka parda kya tha?" Ata ne kaha: "Unhone ek purana Turki parda pehna hua tha, aur woh sirf woh (parda) tha jo humare aur unke darmiyan hijaab tha. Maine unpar ek gulaabi chadar dekhi."

e: Narrated Um Salama:(the wife of the Prophet) I informed Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that I was ill. So he said, "Perform the Tawaf while riding behind the people." I did so, and at that time the Prophet (ﷺ) was praying beside the Ka`ba and reciting Surat-at-Tur
hi: Um Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki biwi) bataati hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool ko bataya ke main bimar hoon. To Aap ne kaha: "Logon ke peechhe (sawari par) baithkar Tawaf karo." Maine aisa hi kiya, aur us waqt Nabi Ka'ba ke bagal mein namaz padh rahe the aur Surah At-Tur tilawat kar rahe the.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:While the Prophet (ﷺ) was performing Tawaf of the Ka`ba, he passed by a person who had tied his hands to another person with a rope or string or something like that. The Prophet (ﷺ) cut it with his own hands and said, "Lead him by the hand
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Jabke Nabi Ka'ba ka Tawaf kar rahe the, woh ek shaks ke paas se guzre jisne apne haath doosre shaks se ek rassi ya dhaage ya kisi aisi cheez se bandhe hue the. Nabi ne use apne haath se kaat diya aur kaha: "Use haath se pakd kar le jaao (usse rassi se mat baandho)."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) saw a man performing Tawaf of the Ka`ba tied with a string or something else. So the Prophet cut that string
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne ek shaks ko dekha Ka'ba ka Tawaf karte hue jabke woh dhaage ya kisi aur cheez se bandha hua tha. Isliye Nabi ne woh dhaaga kaat diya.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:In the year prior to the last Hajj of the Prophet (ﷺ) when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) made Abu Bakr the leader of the pilgrims, the latter (Abu Bakr) sent me in the company of a group of people to make a public announcement: 'No pagan is allowed to perform Hajj after this year, and no naked person is allowed to perform Tawaf of the Ka`ba.' (See Hadith No. 365 Vol)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ke aakhri Hajj se ek saal pehle, jab Allah ke Rasool ne Abu Bakr ko Hajjiyon ka Ameer (leader) banaya, unhone (Abu Bakr ne) mujhe kuch logon ke saath yeh public elaan karne bheja: "Is saal ke baad koi mushrik Hajj nahi kar sakta, aur koi nanga shaks Ka'ba ka Tawaf nahi kar sakta."

e: Narrated `Amr:We asked Ibn `Umar: "May a man have sexual relations with his wife during the Umra before performing Tawaf between Safa and Marwa?" He said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) arrived (in Mecca) and circumambulated the Ka`ba seven times, then offered two rak`at behind Maqam Ibrahim (the station of Abraham), then performed Tawaf between Safa and Marwa." Ibn `Umar added, "Verily! In Allah's Apostle you have a good example." And I asked Jabir bin `Abdullah (the same question), and he replied, "You should not go near your wives (have sexual relations) till you have finished Tawaf between Safa and Marwa
hi: Amr bataate hain: Humne Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha: "Kya koi shaks Umrah mein Safa-Marwa ke Tawaf se pehle apni biwi se humbistari kar sakta hai?" Unhone kaha: "Allah ke Rasool aaye (Mecca) aur Ka'ba ka saat baar Tawaf kiya, phir Maqam-e-Ibrahim ke peechhe do rakat padhi, phir Safa-Marwa ka Tawaf kiya." Ibn Umar ne joda: "Beshak, Allah ke Rasool mein tumhare liye behtareen namoona hai." Aur maine Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) se (yehi sawaal) pucha, unhone jawab diya: "Tumhe apni biwiyon ke qareeb nahi jaana chahiye jab tak tum Safa-Marwa ka Tawaf mukammal na kar lo."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) arrived at Mecca and performed Tawaf of the Ka`ba and Sa`i between Safa and Marwa, but he did not go near the Ka`ba after his Tawaf till he returned from `Arafat
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi Mecca pahunche aur Ka'ba ka Tawaf aur Safa-Marwa ka Sa'i kiya, magar Tawaf ke baad Ka'ba ke qareeb tab tak nahi gaye jab tak Arafat se wapas na aa gaye.

e: Narrated Um Salama:(the wife of the Prophet) I informed Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (about my illness). (Through other sub-narrators, Um Salama narrated that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was at Mecca and had just decided to leave (Mecca) while she had not yet done Tawaf of the Ka`ba (and after listening to her). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When the morning prayer is established, perform the Tawaf on your camel while the people are in prayer." So she did the same and did not offer the two rak`at of Tawaf until she came out of the Mosque
hi: Um Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool ko (apni bimari ke baare mein) bataya. (Doosre raawiyon ke zariye, Um Salama ne bataya ke jab Allah ke Rasool Mecca mein the aur (Mecca se) jane ka faisla kar chuke the, aur unhone (Um Salama ne) abhi tak Ka'ba ka Tawaf nahi kiya tha (aur unki baat sunkar), Nabi ne kaha: "Jab Fajr ki namaz shuru ho, apni sawari par Tawaf kar lo jabke log namaz mein hon." To unhone waisa hi kiya aur Tawaf ki do rakat namaz (masjid mein) nahi padhi jab tak woh masjid se bahar nahi aa gayi.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) reached Mecca, circumambulated the Ka`ba seven times and then offered a two rak`at prayer behind Maqam Ibrahim. Then he went towards the Safa. Allah has said, "Verily, in Allah's Apostle you have a good example
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi Mecca pahunche, Ka'ba ka saat baar Tawaf kiya, phir Maqam-e-Ibrahim ke peechhe do rakat padhi. Phir Safa ki taraf gaye. Allah ne farmaya hai: "Beshak, Allah ke Rasool mein tumhare liye behtareen namoona hai."

e: Narrated `Urwa from Aisha:Some people performed Tawaf (of the Ka`ba) after the morning prayer and then sat to listen to a preacher till sunrise, and then they stood up for the prayer. Then Aisha commented, "Those people kept on sitting till it was the time in which the prayer is disliked and after that they stood up for the prayer
hi: Urwa, Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke hawale se: Kuch logon ne Fajr ki namaz ke baad Ka'ba ka Tawaf kiya, phir baithkar waaz karne wale ka waaz suna suraj nikalne tak, phir namaz ke liye khade hue. Isspar Ayesha ne kaha: "Woh log us waqt tak baithe rahe jab tak namaz ke liye napasandidgi ka waqt aa gaya, aur uske baad woh namaz ke liye khade hue."

e: Narrated `Abdullah:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) forbidding the offering of prayers at the time of sunrise and sunset
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi ko suraj nikalne aur doobne ke waqt namaz padhne se mana karte suna.

e: Narrated Abida bin Humaid:`Abdul, `Aziz bin Rufa`i said, "I saw `Abdullah bin Az-Zubair performing Tawaf of the Ka`ba after the morning prayer then offering the two rak`at prayer." `Abdul `Aziz added, "I saw `Abdullah bin Az-Zubair offering a two rak`at prayer after the `Asr prayer." He informed me that Aisha told him that the Prophet (ﷺ) used to offer those two rak`at whenever he entered her house
hi: Abida bin Humaid bataate hain: Abdul Aziz bin Rufai ne kaha: "Maine Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko Fajr ki namaz ke baad Ka'ba ka Tawaf karte aur phir do rakat padhte dekha." Abdul Aziz ne joda: "Maine Abdullah bin Az-Zubair ko Asr ki namaz ke baad bhi do rakat padhte dekha." Unhone mujhe bataya ke Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne unhe bataya ke Nabi jab bhi unke ghar mein daakhil hote, yeh do rakat padhte.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) performed Tawaf (of the Ka`ba) riding a camel (at that time the Prophet (ﷺ) had a foot injury). Whenever he came to the Corner (having the Black Stone) he would point out towards it with a thing in his hand and say, "Allahu-Akbar
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne apni oontni par sawar hokar (Ka'ba ka) Tawaf kiya (us waqt Nabi ke paon mein zakhm tha). Jab bhi woh Kone (Hajr-e-Aswad wale) tak pahunchte, apne haath ki kisi cheez se uski taraf ishara karte aur "Allahu-Akbar" kehte.

e: Narrated Um Salama:I informed Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that I was sick. He said, "Perform Tawaf (of the Ka`ba) while riding behind the people." So, I performed the Tawaf while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was offering the prayer beside the Ka`ba and was reciting Surat-at-Tur
hi: Um Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool ko bataya ke main bimar hoon. Aap ne kaha: "Logon ke peechhe (sawari par) Tawaf karo." To maine (sawari par) Tawaf kiya jabke Allah ke Rasool Ka'ba ke bagal mein namaz padh rahe the aur Surah At-Tur tilawat kar rahe the.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Al `Abbas bin `Abdul-Muttalib asked the permission of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to let him stay in Mecca during the nights of Mina in order to provide the pilgrims with water to drink, so the Prophet (ﷺ) permitted him
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Al-Abbas bin Abdul-Muttalib ne Allah ke Rasool se Mina ki raaton mein Mecca mein rehne ki ijazat maangi taake woh Hajjiyon ko peene ka paani muhaiya karain, isliye Nabi ne unhe ijazat di.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to the drinking place and asked for water. Al-Abbas said, "O Fadl! Go to your mother and bring water from her for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Give me water to drink." Al-Abbas said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! The people put their hands in it." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) again said, 'Give me water to drink. So, he drank from that water and then went to the Zamzam (well) and there the people were offering water to the others and working at it (drawing water from the well). The Prophet (ﷺ) then said to them, "Carry on! You are doing a good deed." Then he said, "Were I not afraid that other people would compete with you (in drawing water from Zamzam), I would certainly take the rope and put it over this (i.e. his shoulder) (to draw water)." On saying that the Prophet (ﷺ) pointed to his shoulder
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool paani pilaane ki jagah (Zamzam) aaye aur paani maanga. Al-Abbas ne kaha: "Aye Fadl! Apni maa ke paas jaao aur unse Allah ke Rasool ke liye paani laao." Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: "Mujhe (yahi Zamzam) paani pilaa do." Al-Abbas ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Log isme apne haath daaalte hain." Allah ke Rasool ne dobara kaha: "Mujhe pani do." To Aap ne usi paani se piya, phir Zamzam kue ki taraf gaye jahan log doosron ko paani de rahe the aur kaam kar rahe the (paani nikaal rahe the). Nabi ne unse kaha: "Karte raho! Tum achha kaam kar rahe ho." Phir farmaya: "Agar mujhe dar na hota ke doosre log tum se (paani nikaalne mein) muqabla karenge, main zaroor rassi lekar isse (yaani apne shoulder par) rakhta (paani nikaalne ke liye)." Yeh kehte huye Nabi ne apne shoulder ki taraf ishara kiya.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik that Abu Dhar said:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The roof of my house was made open while I was at Makkah (on the night of Mi'raj) and Jibril descended. He opened up my chest and washed it with the water of Zamzam. Then he brought the golden tray full of Wisdom and Belief and poured it in my chest and then closed it. Then he took hold of my hand and ascended to the nearest heaven. Jibril told the gatekeeper of the nearest heaven to open the gate. The gatekeeper asked, "Who is it?" Jibril replied, "I am Jibril." (See Hadith No. 349 Vol)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke hawale se, Abu Dharr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Mecca mein hote hue, mere ghar ki chhat khol di gayi aur Jibreel utre. Unhone mera seena chaak kiya aur Zamzam ke paani se dhoya. Phir sone ki thaali laaye jo hikmat aur iman se bhari thi, ise mere seene mein daala aur seene ko band kar diya. Phir mera haath pakad kar mujhe qareebi aasman tak le gaye. Jibreel ne qareebi aasman ke darban se darwaza kholne ko kaha. Darban ne pucha: 'Kaun hai?' Jibreel ne jawab diya: 'Main Jibreel hoon.'"

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I gave Zamzam water to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he drank it while standing. `Asim (a sub-narrator) said that `Ikrima took the oath that on that day the Prophet (ﷺ) had not been standing but riding a camel
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool ko Zamzam ka paani diya aur Aap ne khade hokar piya. Asim (raawi) ne kaha ke Ikrima ne qasam khaakar kaha ke us din Nabi khade nahi the, balki oont par sawar the.

e: Narrated `Aisha:We set out with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the year of his Last Hajj and we intended (the Ihram) for `Umra. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever has a Hadi with him should assume Ihram for both Hajj and `Umra, and should not finish it till he performs both of them (Hajj and `Umra)." When we reached Mecca, I had my menses. When we had performed our Hajj, the Prophet (ﷺ) sent me with `Abdur-Rahman to Tan`im and I performed the `Umra. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "This is in lieu of your missed `Umra." Those who had assumed Ihram for `Umra performed Tawaf (between Safa and Marwa) and then finished their Ihram. And then they performed another Tawaf (between Safa and Marwa) after returning from Mina. And those who had assumed Ihram for Hajj and `Umra together ( Hajj-Qiran ) performed only one Tawaf (between Safa and Marwa)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Hum Allah ke Rasool ke saath unke aakhri Hajj mein nikle aur humne Umrah ki niyyat se Ihram baandha. Phir Nabi ne farmaya: "Jiske paas Hadi ho, use Hajj-Umrah dono ka Ihram baandhna chahiye, aur dono khatam kiye bina Ihram na khole." Jab hum Mecca pahunche, mujhe haiz aaya. Jab humne Hajj mukammal kiya, Nabi ne mujhe Abdur-Rahman ke saath Tan'im bheja aur maine Umrah kiya. Nabi ne farmaya: "Yeh tumhare chhoote hue Umrah ke badle mein hai." Jinhone Umrah ka Ihram baandha tha unhone Tawaf (Safa-Marwa) kiya aur apna Ihram khatam kar diya. Phir Mina se wapas aane ke baad unhone ek aur Tawaf (Safa-Marwa) kiya. Aur jinhone Hajj-Umrah dono ka Ihram ek saath baandha tha (Hajj-Qiran), unhone sirf ek Tawaf (Safa-Marwa) kiya.

e: Narrated Nafi`:`Abdullah bin `Abdullah bin `Umar and his riding animal entered the house of Ibn `Umar. He (the son of Ibn `Umar) said, "I fear that this year a battle might take place between the people and you might be prevented from going to the Ka`ba. I suggest that you should stay here." Ibn `Umar said, "Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) set out for the pilgrimage, and the pagans of Quraish intervened between him and the Ka`ba. So, if the people intervened between me and the Ka`ba, I would do the same as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had done . . . "Verily, in Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) you have a good example." Then he added, "I make you a witness that I have intended to perform Hajj along with `Umra." After arriving at Mecca, Ibn `Umar performed one Tawaf only (between Safa and Marwa)
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) apni sawari samet Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke ghar daakhil hue. Unhone (Ibn Umar ke bete ne) kaha: "Mujhe dar hai is saal logon aur aapke darmiyan jung ho sakti hai aur aapko Ka'ba jaane se roka jaa sakta hai. Mera mashwara hai aap yahin ruk jaayein." Ibn Umar ne kaha: "Ek baar Allah ke Rasool Hajj ke liye nikle, aur Quraish ke mushrikon ne unke aur Ka'ba ke darmiyan rukawat daali. Isliye agar log mere aur Ka'ba ke darmiyan rukawat daalen, main wahi karunga jo Allah ke Rasool ne kiya tha... Beshak, Allah ke Rasool mein tumhare liye behtareen namoona hai." Phir unhone joda: "Main tumhe gawah banata hoon ke maine Hajj-Umrah dono ki niyyat ki hai." Mecca pahunchne ke baad, Ibn Umar ne sirf ek Tawaf (Safa-Marwa) kiya.

e: Narrated Nafi`:Ibn `Umar intended to perform Hajj in the year when Al-Hajjaj attacked Ibn Az-Zubair. Somebody said to Ibn `Umar, "There is a danger of an impending war between them." Ibn `Umar said, "Verily, in Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) you have a good example. (And if it happened as you say) then I would do the same as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had done. I make you witness that I have decided to perform `Umra." Then he set out and when he reached Al-Baida', he said, "The ceremonies of both Hajj and `Umra are similar. I make you witness that I have made Hajj compulsory for me along with `Umra." He drove (to Mecca) a Hadi which he had bought from (a place called) Qudaid and did not do more than that. He did not slaughter the Hadi or finish his Ihram, or shave or cut short his hair till the day of slaughtering the sacrifices (10th Dhul-Hijja). Then he slaughtered his Hadi and shaved his head and considered the first Tawaf (of Safa and Marwa) as sufficient for Hajj and `Umra. Ibn `Umar said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did the same
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne us saal Hajj karne ka iraada kiya jab Al-Hajjaj ne Ibn Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) par hamla kiya. Kisi ne Ibn Umar se kaha: "Unke darmiyan jung hone ka khatra hai." Ibn Umar ne kaha: "Beshak, Allah ke Rasool mein tumhare liye behtareen namoona hai. (Aur agar aisa hota jaisa tum keh rahe ho) main wahi karunga jo Allah ke Rasool ne kiya tha. Main tumhe gawah banata hoon ke maine Umrah karne ka faisla kiya hai." Phir woh nikle, aur jab Al-Baida pahunche, kaha: "Hajj-Umrah dono ki rasmein ek jaisi hain. Main tumhe gawah banata hoon ke maine apne liye Hajj-Umrah dono farz kar liye hain." Unhone (Mecca ki taraf) ek Hadi le jaaayaa jo unhone Qudaid (ek jagah) se khareeda tha, aur usse zyada kuch nahi kiya. Unhone na apna Hadi zabah kiya na apna Ihram khatam kiya, na sar munavaayaa na baal chhote kiye jab tak Yaum-un-Nahr (qurbani ka din, 10 Zul-Hijja) na aa gaya. Phir unhone apna Hadi zabah kiya aur sar munavaayaa aur pehle Tawaf (Safa-Marwa) ko Hajj-Umrah dono ke liye kaafi samjha. Ibn Umar ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool ne bhi aisa hi kiya."

e: Narrated Muhammad bin `Abdur-Rahman bin Nawfal Al-Qurashi:I asked `Urwa bin Az-Zubair (regarding the Hajj of the Prophet (ﷺ) ). `Urwa replied, "Aisha narrated, 'When the Prophet (ﷺ) reached Mecca, the first thing he started with was the ablution, then he performed Tawaf of the Ka`ba and his intention was not `Umra alone (but Hajj and `Umra together).' " Later Abu Bakr performed the Hajj and the first thing he started with was Tawaf of the Ka`ba and it was not `Umra alone (but Hajj and `Umra together). And then `Umar did the same. Then `Uthman performed the Hajj and the first thing he started with was Tawaf of the Ka`ba and it was not `Umra alone. And then Muawiya and `Abdullah bin `Umar did the same. I performed Hajj with Ibn Az-Zubair and the first thing he started with was Tawaf of the Ka`ba and it was not `Umra alone, (but Hajj and `Umra together). Then I saw the Muhajirin (Emigrants) and Ansar doing the same and it was not `Umra alone. And the last person I saw doing the same was Ibn `Umar, and he did not do another `Umra after finishing the first. Now here is Ibn `Umar present amongst the people! They neither ask him nor anyone of the previous ones. And all these people, on entering Mecca, would not start with anything unless they had performed Tawaf of the Ka`ba, and would not finish their Ihram. And no doubt, I saw my mother and my aunt, on entering Mecca doing nothing before performing Tawaf of the Ka`ba, and they would not finish their Ihram. And my mother informed me that she, her sister, Az-Zubair and such and such persons had assumed Ihram for `Umra and after passing their hands over the Corner (the Black Stone) (i.e. finishing their Umra) they finished their Ihram
hi: Muhammad bin Abdur-Rahman bin Nawfal Al-Qurashi bataate hain: Maine Urwa bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) se (Nabi ke Hajj ke baare mein) pucha. Urwa ne jawab diya: "Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha: 'Jab Nabi Mecca pahunche, sabse pehle unhone wudu kiya, phir Ka'ba ka Tawaf kiya aur unka iraada sirf Umrah nahi tha (balki Hajj-Umrah dono).' " Baad mein Abu Bakr ne bhi Hajj kiya aur sabse pehle Ka'ba ka Tawaf kiya, aur yeh sirf Umrah nahi tha. Phir Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne bhi yehi kiya. Phir Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne bhi Hajj kiya aur sabse pehle Ka'ba ka Tawaf kiya, aur yeh sirf Umrah nahi tha. Phir Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne bhi yehi kiya. Maine Ibn Az-Zubair ke saath Hajj kiya aur sabse pehle unhone Ka'ba ka Tawaf kiya, aur yeh sirf Umrah nahi tha (balki Hajj-Umrah dono). Phir maine Muhajireen aur Ansaar ko bhi aisa hi karte dekha, aur yeh sirf Umrah nahi thi. Aur aakhri shaks jise maine aisa karte dekha woh Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) the, aur unhone pehle ke baad doosra Umrah nahi kiya. Ab Ibn Umar khud logon mein maujood hain! Na woh unse poochte hain na pehle ke logon se. Aur sab log, Mecca mein daakhil hote hue, sabse pehle Ka'ba ka Tawaf karte the, aur apna Ihram khatam nahi karte the. Aur beshak, maine apni maa aur khala ko Mecca mein daakhil hote hue Ka'ba ka Tawaf karne se pehle kuch aur na karte dekha, aur woh apna Ihram khatam nahi karti thi. Aur meri maa ne mujhe bataya ke unhone, unki behn, Az-Zubair, aur falaan-falaan logon ne Umrah ka Ihram baandha, aur Kone (Hajr-e-Aswad) par apne haath pherane ke baad (yaani apna Umrah khatam karne ke baad) unhone apna Ihram khatam kar diya.

e: Narrated `Urwa:I asked `Aisha : "How do you interpret the statement of Allah,. : Verily! (the mountains) As-Safa and Al-Marwa are among the symbols of Allah, and whoever performs the Hajj to the Ka`ba or performs `Umra, it is not harmful for him to perform Tawaf between them (Safa and Marwa.) (2.158). By Allah! (it is evident from this revelation) there is no harm if one does not perform Tawaf between Safa and Marwa." `Aisha said, "O, my nephew! Your interpretation is not true. Had this interpretation of yours been correct, the statement of Allah should have been, 'It is not harmful for him if he does not perform Tawaf between them.' But in fact, this divine inspiration was revealed concerning the Ansar who used to assume Ihram for worshipping an idol called "Manat" which they used to worship at a place called Al-Mushallal before they embraced Islam, and whoever assumed Ihram (for the idol), would consider it not right to perform Tawaf between Safa and Marwa. When they embraced Islam, they asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) regarding it, saying, "O Allah's Apostle! We used to refrain from Tawaf between Safa and Marwa." So Allah revealed: 'Verily; (the mountains) As-Safa and Al-Marwa are among the symbols of Allah.' " Aisha added, "Surely, Allah's Apostle set the tradition of Tawaf between Safa and Marwa, so nobody is allowed to omit the Tawaf between them." Later on I (`Urwa) told Abu Bakr bin `Abdur-Rahman (of `Aisha's narration) and he said, 'I have not heard of such information, but I heard learned men saying that all the people, except those whom `Aisha mentioned and who used to assume Ihram for the sake of Manat, used to perform Tawaf between Safa and Marwa. When Allah referred to the Tawaf of the Ka`ba and did not mention Safa and Marwa in the Qur'an, the people asked, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We used to perform Tawaf between Safa and Marwa and Allah has revealed (the verses concerning) Tawaf of the Ka`ba and has not mentioned Safa and Marwa. Is there any harm if we perform Tawaf between Safa and Marwa?' So Allah revealed: "Verily As-Safa and Al- Marwa are among the symbols of Allah." Abu Bakr said, "It seems that this verse was revealed concerning the two groups, those who used to refrain from Tawaf between Safa and Marwa in the Pre- Islamic Period of ignorance and those who used to perform the Tawaf then, and after embracing Islam they refrained from the Tawaf between them as Allah had enjoined Tawaf of the Ka`ba and did not mention Tawaf (of Safa and Marwa) till later after mentioning the Tawaf of the Ka`ba
hi: Urwa bataate hain: Maine Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se pucha: "Aap Allah ke is farmaan ka kya matlab samajhti hain: 'Beshak, (pahad) As-Safa aur Al-Marwa Allah ki nishaniyon mein se hain, aur jo bhi Ka'ba ka Hajj kare ya Umrah kare, uske liye unke beech Tawaf karna koi harj nahi' (2:158). Allah ki qasam! (Iss ayat se saaf zahir hai) ke agar koi Safa-Marwa ke beech Tawaf na kare to koi harj nahi." Ayesha ne kaha: "Aye mere bhatije! Tumhara matlab galat hai. Agar tumhara matlab sahi hota, to Allah ka farmaan yeh hota: 'Uske liye koi harj nahi agar woh unke beech Tawaf na kare.' Magar asal mein yeh wahi Ansaar ke baare mein nazil hui jo but 'Manat' ki ibadat ke liye Ihram baandhte the, jiski woh Al-Mushallal naam ki jagah par ibadat karte the Islam qubool karne se pehle, aur jo bhi (us but ke liye) Ihram baandhta, use Safa-Marwa ke beech Tawaf karna sahi nahi lagta tha. Jab woh Islam laaye, unhone Allah ke Rasool se iske baare mein pucha, kaha: 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Hum Safa-Marwa ke beech Tawaf karne se bachte.' To Allah ne yeh wahi nazil ki: 'Beshak, (pahad) As-Safa aur Al-Marwa Allah ki nishaniyon mein se hain.'" Ayesha ne joda: "Beshak, Allah ke Rasool ne Safa-Marwa ke beech Tawaf karne ka riwaaj muqarrar kiya, isliye kisi ko iske beech Tawaf chhodne ki ijazat nahi." Baad mein maine (Urwa ne) yeh Abu Bakr bin Abdur-Rahman ko bataya, unhone kaha: "Maine yeh khabar nahi suni, magar maine ilm wale logon ko yeh kehte suna ke sab log, siwaye un logon ke jinka Ayesha ne zikar kiya jo Manat ke liye Ihram baandhte the, Safa-Marwa ke beech Tawaf karte the. Jab Allah ne Ka'ba ke Tawaf ka zikar kiya aur Quran mein Safa-Marwa ka zikar na kiya, logon ne pucha: 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Hum Safa-Marwa ke beech Tawaf karte the aur Allah ne Ka'ba ke Tawaf ki ayaat nazil ki hain magar Safa-Marwa ka zikar nahi kiya. Kya koi harj hai agar hum Safa-Marwa ke beech Tawaf karen?' To Allah ne nazil ki: 'Beshak As-Safa aur Al-Marwa Allah ki nishaniyon mein se hain.'" Abu Bakr ne kaha: "Lagta hai yeh ayat un do giroh ke baare mein nazil hui — woh jo Jahiliyat ke zamane mein Safa-Marwa ke beech Tawaf karne se bachte the, aur woh jo tab Tawaf karte the aur Islam qubool karne ke baad Tawaf se bachne lage kyunke Allah ne Ka'ba ka Tawaf farz kiya tha aur Safa-Marwa ka zikar baad mein kiya, Ka'ba ke Tawaf ke zikar ke baad."

e: Narrated Nafi`:Ibn `Umar said, "When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) performed the first Tawaf he did Ramal in the first three rounds and then walked in the remaining four rounds (of Tawaf of the Ka`ba), where as in performing Tawaf between Safa and Marwa he used to run in the midst of the rainwater passage," I asked Nafi`, "Did `Abdullah (bin `Umar) use to walk steadily on reaching the Yemenite Corner?" He replied, "No, unless people were crowded at the Corner; otherwise he would not leave it without touching it
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Jab Allah ke Rasool ne pehla Tawaf kiya, pehli teen chakkaron mein Ramal kiya aur baaki chaar mein aam chaal se chale (Ka'ba ke Tawaf mein), jabke Safa-Marwa ke beech Tawaf karte waqt woh baarish ke paani ki nehr ke beech mein daudte." Maine Nafi se pucha: "Kya Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) (bin Umar) Yemeni Kone tak pahunchte huye aaram se chalte?" Unhone jawab diya: "Nahi, siwaye jab log Kone ke qareeb bhirr mein hote; warna woh use chhote bina nahi jate."

e: Narrated `Amr bin Dinar:We asked Ibn `Umar whether a man who, while performing `Umra, had performed Tawaf of the Ka`ba; and had not yet performed Tawaf between Safa and Marwa, could have sexual relation with his wife, Ibn `Umar replied "The Prophet (ﷺ) reached Mecca and performed the seven rounds (of Tawaf) of the Ka`ba and then offered a two-rak`at prayer behind Maqam Ibrahim and then performed the seven rounds (of Tawaf) between Safa and Marwa." He added, "Verily! In Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) you have a good example." We asked Jabir bin `Abdullah (the same question) and he said, "He (that man) should not come near (his wife) till he has completed Tawaf between Safa and Marwa
hi: Amr bin Dinar bataate hain: Humne Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha kya koi shaks, jisne Umrah mein Ka'ba ka Tawaf kiya ho aur abhi Safa-Marwa ka Tawaf na kiya ho, apni biwi se humbistari kar sakta hai. Ibn Umar ne jawab diya: "Nabi Mecca pahunche, Ka'ba ke saat chakkar (Tawaf) lagaae, phir Maqam-e-Ibrahim ke peechhe do rakat padhi, phir Safa-Marwa ke saat chakkar lagaae." Unhone joda: "Beshak, Allah ke Rasool mein tumhare liye behtareen namoona hai." Humne Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) se (yehi sawaal) pucha, unhone kaha: "Woh (shaks) apni biwi ke qareeb tab tak na jaaye jab tak Safa-Marwa ka Tawaf mukammal na kar le."

e: Narrated `Amr bin Dinar:I heard Ibn `Umar saying, "The Prophet (ﷺ) arrived at Mecca and performed Tawaf of the Ka`ba and then offered a two-rak`at prayer and then performed Tawaf between Safa and Marwa." Ibn `Umar then recited (the verse): "Verily! In Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) you have a good example
hi: Amr bin Dinar bataate hain: Maine Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko kehte suna: "Nabi Mecca pahunche aur Ka'ba ka Tawaf kiya, phir do rakat padhi, phir Safa-Marwa ke beech Tawaf kiya." Ibn Umar ne phir yeh ayat padhi: "Beshak, Allah ke Rasool mein tumhare liye behtareen namoona hai."

e: Narrated `Asim:I asked Anas bin Malik: "Did you use to dislike to perform Tawaf between Safa and Marwa?" He said, "Yes, as it was of the ceremonies of the days of the Pre-Islamic period of ignorance, till Allah revealed: 'Verily! (The two mountains) As-Safa and Al-Marwa are among the symbols of Allah. It is therefore no sin for him who performs the pilgrimage to the Ka`ba, or performs `Umra, to perform Tawaf between them
hi: Asim bataate hain: Maine Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha: "Kya aap Safa-Marwa ke beech Tawaf karne ko napasand karte the?" Unhone kaha: "Haan, kyunke yeh jahiliyat ke zamane ki rasmein thi, jab tak Allah ne nazil nahi kiya: 'Beshak, (do pahad) As-Safa aur Al-Marwa Allah ki nishaniyon mein se hain. Isliye jo Ka'ba ka Hajj ya Umrah kare, uske liye unke beech Tawaf karna gunah nahi.'"

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) performed Tawaf of the Ka`ba and the Sa`i of Safa and Marwa so as to show his strength to the pagans
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Ka'ba ka Tawaf aur Safa-Marwa ka Sa'i kiya taake mushrikon ko apni taaqat dikhaen.

e: Narrated `Aisha:I was menstruating when I reached Mecca. So, I neither performed Tawaf of the Ka`ba, nor the Tawaf between Safa and Marwa. Then I informed Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about it. He replied, "Perform all the ceremonies of Hajj like the other pilgrims, but do not perform Tawaf of the Ka`ba till you get clean (from your menses)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Mecca pahunchte hi mujhe haiz aa gaya. Isliye maine na Ka'ba ka Tawaf kiya na Safa-Marwa ka Tawaf. Phir maine Allah ke Rasool ko yeh bataya. Aap ne jawab diya: "Doosre Hajjiyon ki tarah Hajj ki sab rasmein poori karo, magar Ka'ba ka Tawaf tab tak mat karo jab tak (haiz se) paak na ho jao."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) and his companions assumed Ihram for Hajj and none except the Prophet (ﷺ) and Talha had the Hadi (sacrifice) with them. `Ali arrived from Yemen and had a Hadi with him. `Ali said, "I have assumed Ihram for what the Prophet (ﷺ) has done." The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered his companions to perform the `Umra with the Ihram which they had assumed, and after finishing Tawaf (of Ka`ba, Safa and Marwa) to cut short their hair, and to finish their Ihram except those who had Hadi with them. They (the people) said, "How can we proceed to Mina (for Hajj) after having sexual relations with our wives?" When that news reached the Prophet (ﷺ) he said, "If I had formerly known what I came to know lately, I would not have brought the Hadi with me. Had there been no Hadi with me, I would have finished the state of Ihram." `Aisha got her menses, so she performed all the ceremonies of Hajj except Tawaf of the Ka`ba, and when she got clean (from her menses), she performed Tawaf of the Ka`ba. She said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! (All of you) are returning with the Hajj and `Umra, but I am returning after performing Hajj only." So the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered `Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Bakr to accompany her to Tan`im and thus she performed the `Umra after the Hajj
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi aur unke sahaba ne Hajj ka Ihram baandha, aur Nabi aur Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke ilawa kisi ke paas Hadi (qurbani ka janwar) nahi tha. Ali (Alayhis Salam) Yemen se aaye aur unke paas bhi Hadi tha. Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: "Maine wahi niyyat ki jo Nabi ne ki." Nabi ne apne sahaba ko usi Ihram se Umrah karne ka hukum diya jo unhone baandha tha, aur Tawaf (Ka'ba, Safa-Marwa) khatam karke baal chhote karne aur Ihram khatam karne ka, siwaye un logon ke jinke paas Hadi tha. Unhone (logon ne) kaha: "Hum apni biwiyon se humbistari karke Mina (Hajj ke liye) kaise ja sakte hain?" Jab yeh baat Nabi tak pahunchi, unhone farmaya: "Agar mujhe pehle pata hota jo mujhe baad mein pata chala, main apna Hadi apne saath na laata. Agar mere paas Hadi na hota, main apna Ihram khatam kar deta." Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko haiz aaya, isliye unhone Ka'ba ke Tawaf ke ilawa Hajj ki sab rasmein poori ki, aur jab woh (haiz se) paak ho gayi, Ka'ba ka Tawaf kiya. Unhone kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! (Sab) Hajj-Umrah dono karke wapas ja rahe hain magar main sirf Hajj karke wapas ja rahi hoon." Isliye Nabi ne Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Bakr ko unke saath Tan'im jane ka hukum diya, aur isi tarah unhone Hajj ke baad Umrah kiya.

e: Narrated Hafsa:(On `Id) We used to forbid our virgins to go out (for `Id prayer). A lady came and stayed at the fortress of Bani Khalaf. She mentioned that her sister was married to one of the companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who participated in twelve Ghazawats along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and her sister was with him in six of them. She said, "We used to dress the wounded and look after the patients." She (her sister) asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) , "Is there any harm for a woman to stay at home if she doesn't have a veil?" He said, "She should cover herself with the veil of her companion and she should take part in the good deeds and in the religious gatherings of the believers." When Um 'Atiyya came, I asked her. "Did you hear anything about that?" Um 'Atiyya said, "Bi Abi" and she never mentioned the name of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) without saying "Bi Abi" (i.e. 'Let my father be sacrificed for you'). We asked her, "Have you heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying so and so (about women)?" She replied in the affirmative and said, "Let my father be sacrificed for him. He told us that unmarried mature virgins who stay often screened or unmarried young virgins and mature girls who stay often screened should come out and take part in the good deeds and in the religious gatherings of the believers. But the menstruating women should keep away from the Musalla (praying place)." I asked her, "The menstruating women?" She replied, "Don't they present themselves at `Arafat and at such and such places?
hi: Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: (Eid ke din) hum apni kunwari ladkiyon ko bahar jane se rokte the (Eid ki namaz ke liye). Ek aurat aayi aur Bani Khalaf ke qile mein rahi. Usne bataya ke uski behn Nabi ke ek sathi se shaadi-shuda thi jinhone Allah ke Rasool ke saath barah jungon mein hissa liya, aur uski behn chhe mein unke saath thi. Usne kaha: "Hum zakhmiyon ki dekhbhal karte aur bimaron ki khidmat karte the." Usne (uski behn ne) Allah ke Rasool se pucha: "Kya kisi aurat ke liye ghar mein rehna koi harj hai agar uske paas parda na ho?" Aap ne kaha: "Woh apni sathi ka parda odh le aur Musalmanon ki neik majlison mein shareek ho." Jab Um Atiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) aayin, maine unse pucha: "Kya aapne iske baare mein kuch suna hai?" Um Atiya ne kaha: "Bi Abi" (unhone Allah ke Rasool ka naam kabhi bina "Bi Abi" (mere baap unpar qurban ho) kahe nahi liya). Humne unse pucha: "Kya aapne Allah ke Rasool ko yeh (aurton ke baare mein) kehte suna?" Unhone haan mein jawab diya aur kaha: "Mere baap unpar qurban hon. Aap ne humein bataya ke jawan, kunwari, parda-nasheen ladkiyan ya jawan aur balig ladkiyan bahar aayen aur Musalmanon ki neik majlison mein shareek hon. Magar haiz wali aurtein Musalla se door rahen." Maine pucha: "Haiz wali bhi?" Unhone jawab diya: "Kya woh Arafat aur falaan-falaan jagahon par maujood nahi hoti?"

e: Narrated `Abdul `Aziz bin Rufai:I asked Anas bin Malik, "Tell me what you remember from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (regarding these questions): Where did he offer the Zuhr and `Asr prayers on the day of Tarwiya (8th day of Dhul-Hijja)?" He replied, "(He offered these prayers) at Mina." I asked, "Where did he offer the `Asr prayer on the day of Nafr (i.e. departure from Mina on the 12th or 13th of Dhul-Hijja)?" He replied, "At Al-Abtah," and then added, "You should do as your chiefs do
hi: Abdul Aziz bin Rufai bataate hain: Maine Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha: "Mujhe wahi bataiye jo aapko Allah ke Rasool se yaad hai (in sawaalon ke baare mein): Aap ne Tarwiya ke din (8 Zul-Hijja) Zuhr-Asr ki namaz kahan padhi?" Unhone jawab diya: "(Aap ne yeh namazein padhi) Mina mein." Maine pucha: "Aap ne Nafr ke din (yaani Mina se wapasi ke din, 12 ya 13 Zul-Hijja) Asr kahan padhi?" Unhone jawab diya: "Al-Abtah mein," aur joda: "Tumhe wahi karna chahiye jo tumhare sardar karte hain."

e: Narrated `Abdul `Aziz:I went out to Mina on the day of Tarwiya and met Anas going on a donkey. I asked him, "Where did the Prophet (ﷺ) offer the Zuhr prayer on this day?" Anas replied, "See where your chiefs pray and pray similarly
hi: Abdul Aziz bataate hain: Main Tarwiya ke din Mina gaya aur Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se mila, woh gadhe par sawar the. Maine unse pucha: "Nabi ne is din Zuhr kahan padhi?" Anas ne jawab diya: "Dekho tumhare sardar kahan namaz padhte hain, aur waisi hi padho."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) offered a two-rak`at prayer at Mina. Abu Bakr, `Umar and `Uthman, (during the early years of his caliphate) followed the same practice
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Mina mein do rakat namaz padhi. Abu Bakr, Umar aur Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) (unki khilafat ke shuru ke saalon mein) ne bhi yehi kiya.

e: Narrated Haritha bin Wahab Al-Khuza`i:The Prophet (ﷺ) led us in a two-rak`at prayer at Mina although our number was more than ever and we were in better security than ever
hi: Haritha bin Wahab Al-Khuza'i (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne humari Mina mein do rakat namaz ki imamat ki, jabke humari tadaad pehle se kabhi zyada nahi thi aur hum pehle se zyada mehfooz the.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Mas`ud:I offered (only a) two rak`at prayer with the Prophet (at Mina), and similarly with Abu Bakr and with `Umar, and then you differed in opinions. Wish that I would be lucky enough to have two of the four rak`at accepted (by Allah)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi (Mina mein) ke saath sirf do rakat namaz padhi, aur isi tarah Abu Bakr aur Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath, phir tum log ikhtilaaf mein pad gaye. Kaash mujhe (unki jagah chaar rakat mein se) do rakat qubool ho jaayein.

e: Narrated Um Al-Fadl:The people doubted whether the Prophet (ﷺ) was observing the fast on the Day of `Arafat, so I sent something for him to drink and he drank it
hi: Um Al-Fadl (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Logon ko shak tha kya Nabi Arafat ke din roza rakh rahe hain, isliye maine unke liye kuch peene ko bheja, aur Aap ne use piya.

e: Narrated Muhammad bin Abu Bakr Al-Thaqafi:I asked Anas bin Malik while we were proceeding from Mina to `Arafat, "What did you use to do on this day when you were with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ?" Anas said, "Some of us used to recite Talbiya and nobody objected to that, and others used to recite Takbir and nobody objected to that
hi: Muhammad bin Abu Bakr Al-Thaqafi bataate hain: Maine Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha jabke hum Mina se Arafat ja rahe the, "Us din aap Allah ke Rasool ke saath kya karte the?" Anas ne kaha: "Hum mein se kuch Talbiya kahte the aur koi rukta nahi tha, aur kuch Takbir kahte the aur koi rukta nahi tha."

e: Narrated Salim:`Abdul Malik wrote to Al-Hajjaj that he should not differ from Ibn `Umar during Hajj. On the Day of `Arafat, when the sun declined at midday, Ibn `Umar came along with me and shouted near Al- Hajjaj's cotton (cloth) tent. Al-Hajjaj came Out, wrapping himself with a waist-sheet dyed with safflower, and said, "O Abu `Abdur-Rahman! What is the matter?" He said, If you want to follow the Sunna (the tradition of the Prophet (ﷺ) ) then proceed (to `Arafat)." Al-Hajjaj asked, "At this very hour?" Ibn `Umar said, "Yes." He replied, "Please wait for me till I pour some water over my head (i.e. take a bath) and come out." Then Ibn `Umar dismounted and waited till Al-Hajjaj came out. So, he (Al-Hajjaj) walked in between me and my father (Ibn `Umar). I said to him, "If you want to follow the Sunna then deliver a brief sermon and hurry up for the stay at `Arafat." He started looking at `Abdullah (Ibn `Umar) (inquiringly), and when `Abdullah noticed that, he said that he had told the truth
hi: Salim bataate hain: Abdul Malik ne Al-Hajjaj ko likha ke woh Hajj mein Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se ikhtilaaf na kare. Arafat ke din, jab suraj dopahar se dhala, Ibn Umar mere saath aaye aur Al-Hajjaj ke cotton khaimay ke qareeb pukara. Al-Hajjaj bahar aaye, kesar se rangi hui chadar samete hue, aur kaha: "Aye Abu Abdur-Rahman! Kya baat hai?" Ibn Umar ne kaha: "Agar tum Sunnat ki pairvi karna chahte ho to (Arafat ke liye) chalo." Al-Hajjaj ne pucha: "Isi waqt?" Ibn Umar ne haan mein jawab diya. Unhone kaha: "Mera intezar karo jab tak main apne sar par paani daaal kar (ghusl karke) bahar aaun." Phir Ibn Umar utre aur Al-Hajjaj ke bahar aane tak intezar kiya. Phir woh (Al-Hajjaj) mere aur mere waalid (Ibn Umar) ke beech chale. Maine unse kaha: "Agar aap Sunnat ki pairvi karna chahte hain to chhoṭTa khutba dein aur Arafat mein thehrne ke liye jaldi karein." Woh Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) (Ibn Umar) ki taraf (poochte hue) dekhne lage, aur jab Abdullah ne yeh dekha, unhone kaha ke maine sach kaha hai.

e: Narrated Um Al-Fadl bint Al Harith:On the day of `Arafat, some people who were with me, differed about the fasting of the Prophet (ﷺ) some said that he was fasting while others said that he was not fasting. So I sent a bowl full of milk to him while he was riding his camel, and he drank that milk
hi: Um Al-Fadl bint Al-Harith bataati hain: Arafat ke din, kuch log jo mere paas the, Nabi ke roze ke baare mein ikhtilaaf ka shikaar hue; kuch ne kaha woh roza rakhe hue hain aur kuch ne kaha nahi. Isliye maine unke liye doodh se bhara pyaala bheja jabke woh apni oontni par sawar the, aur unhone woh doodh piya.

e: Ibn Shihab said:Salim said, "In the year when Al-Hajjaj bin Yusuf attacked Ibn Az-Zubair, the former asked 'Abdullah (Ibn 'Umar) what to do during the stay on the Day of 'Arafa (9th of Dhul-Hijjah). I said to him, "If you want to follow the Sunna (the legal way of the Prophet (ﷺ)) you should offer the Salat just after midday on the Day of the 'Arafa. 'Abdullah bin 'Umar said, 'He (Salim) has spoken the truth.' " They (the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ)) used to offer the Zuhr and Asr prayer together according to the Sunna, I asked Salim, "Did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) do that ?" Salim said, "And in doing that do you (people) follow anything else except his (ﷺ) Sunna?
hi: Ibn Shihab bataate hain: Salim ne kaha: "Jis saal Al-Hajjaj bin Yusuf ne Ibn Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) par hamla kiya, unhone Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) (Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ)) se pucha Arafat ke din ka thairna kaise karein. Maine unse kaha: 'Agar aap Sunnat ki pairvi karna chahte hain to Arafat ke din dopahar ke foran baad namaz padhein.' Abdullah bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: 'Usne sach kaha.'" (Nabi ke sahaba Zuhr-Asr Sunnat ke mutabiq ek saath padhte.) Maine Salim se pucha: "Kya Allah ke Rasool ne aisa kiya tha?" Salim ne kaha: "Aur aisa karke tum log unki Sunnat ke ilawa kis cheez ki pairvi kar rahe ho?"

e: Narrated Salim bin `Abdullah bin `Umar:`Abdul-Malik bin Marwan wrote to Al-Hajjaj that he should follow `Abdullah bin `Umar in all the ceremonies of Hajj. So when it was the Day of `Arafat (9th of Dhul-Hijja), and after the sun had deviated or had declined from the middle of the sky, I and Ibn `Umar came and he shouted near the cotton (cloth) tent of Al-Hajjaj, "Where is he?" Al-Hajjaj came out. Ibn `Umar said, "Let us proceed (to `Arafat)." Al-Hajjaj asked, "Just now?" Ibn `Umar replied, "Yes." Al-Hajjaj said, "Wait for me till I pour water on me (i.e. take a bath)." So, Ibn `Umar dismounted (and waited) till Al-Hajjaj came out. He was walking between me and my father. I informed Al-Hajjaj, "If you want to follow the Sunna today, then you should shorten the sermon and then hurry up for the stay (at `Arafat)." Ibn `Umar said, "He (Salim) has spoken the truth
hi: Salim bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abdul-Malik bin Marwan ne Al-Hajjaj ko likha ke woh Hajj ki sab rasmon mein Abdullah bin Umar ki pairvi kare. Isliye jab Arafat ka din aaya, aur suraj aasman ke beech se dhal chuka tha, main aur Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) aaye aur unhone Al-Hajjaj ke cotton khaimay ke qareeb pukara: "Kahan hai woh?" Al-Hajjaj bahar aaye. Ibn Umar ne kaha: "Let us proceed (Arafat ki taraf)." Al-Hajjaj ne pucha: "Abhi?" Ibn Umar ne haan mein jawab diya. Al-Hajjaj ne kaha: "Mera intezar karo jab tak main apne upar paani daaalu (ghusl karun)." Isliye Ibn Umar utre (aur intezar kiya) jab tak Al-Hajjaj bahar na aaye. Woh mere aur mere waalid ke beech chal rahe the. Maine Al-Hajjaj ko bataya: "Agar aap aaj Sunnat ki pairvi karna chahte hain, to khutba chhoṭTa karein aur Arafat mein thehrne ke liye jaldi karein." Ibn Umar ne kaha: "Usne sach kaha."

e: Narrated Muhammad bin Jubair bin Mut`im:My father said, "(Before Islam) I was looking for my camel .." The same narration is told by a different sub-narrator. Jubair bin Mut`im said, "My camel was lost and I went out in search of it on the day of `Arafat, and I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) standing in `Arafat. I said to myself: By Allah he is from the Hums (literally: strictly religious, Quraish were called so, as they used to say, 'We are the people of Allah we shall not go out of the sanctuary). What has brought him here?
hi: Muhammad bin Jubair bin Mut'im bataate hain: Mere waalid ne kaha: "(Islam se pehle) main apna oont dhoond raha tha.." Yehi riwayat ek doosre raawi ne bhi bayan ki. Jubair bin Mut'im ne kaha: "Mera oont gum ho gaya tha aur main Arafat ke din usse dhoondne nikla, aur maine Nabi ko Arafat mein khada dekha. Maine khud se socha: Allah ki qasam, yeh Hums (yaani Quraish, jo sakhti se deendar the aur kehte: hum Allah ke log hain, hum haram se bahar nahi jate) mein se hain. Inhe yahan kya laaya?"

e: Narrated `Urwa:During the Pre-Islamic period of Ignorance, the people used to perform Tawaf of the Ka`ba naked except the Hums; and the Hums were Quraish and their offspring. The Hums used to give clothes to the men who would perform the Tawaf wearing them; and women (of the Hums) used to give clothes to the women who would perform the Tawaf wearing them. Those to whom the Hums did not give clothes would perform Tawaf round the Ka`ba naked. Most of the people used to go away (disperse) directly from `Arafat but they (Hums) used to depart after staying at Al-Muzdalifa. `Urwa added, "My father narrated that `Aisha had said, 'The following verses were revealed about the Hums: Then depart from the place whence all the people depart--(2.199) `Urwa added, "They (the Hums) used to stay at Al-Muzdalifa and used to depart from there (to Mina) and so they were sent to `Arafat (by Allah's order)
hi: Urwa bataate hain: Jahiliyat ke zamane mein, log Ka'ba ka Tawaf nangee hokar karte the siwaye Hums ke; aur Hums Quraish aur unki aulad the. Hums mardon ko kapde dete the jinme woh Tawaf karte, aur (Hums) aurtein aurton ko kapde deti jinme woh Tawaf karti. Jinhe Hums ne kapde nahi diye woh nange hokar Tawaf karte. Zyada tar log seedhe Arafat se laudte, magar woh (Hums) Al-Muzdalifa mein rukne ke baad lauṭte. Urwa ne joda: "Mere waalid ne bataya ke Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha: 'Yeh ayaat Hums ke baare mein nazil hui: Phir wahin se lauṭo jahan se sab log lauṭte (2.199)'" Urwa ne joda: "Woh (Hums) Al-Muzdalifa mein rukte aur wahin se laute, isliye unhe Arafat bheja gaya (Allah ke hukum se)."

e: Narrated `Urwa:Usama was asked in my presence, "How was the speed of (the camel of) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while departing from `Arafat during the Hajjatul Wada`?" Usama replied, "The Prophet (ﷺ) proceeded on with a modest pace, and when there was enough space he would (make his camel) go very fast
hi: Urwa bataate hain: Mere saamne Usama se pucha gaya: "Hajjatul Wida ke waqt Arafat se laute hue Allah ke Rasool (ki oontni) ki raftar kaisi thi?" Usama ne jawab diya: "Nabi aasan raftaar se chal rahe the, aur jab jagah kaafi hoti, (oontni ko) tez chalaate."

e: Narrated Usama bin Zaid:As soon as the Prophet (ﷺ) departed from `Arafat, he went towards the mountain pass, and there he answered the call of nature. He was asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Will you offer the prayer here?" He replied, "(The place of) the prayer is ahead of you (i.e. at Al-Muzdalifa)
hi: Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Jaise hi Nabi Arafat se lauṭe, woh pahad ki ghati (raaste) ki taraf gaye aur wahan qaza-e-hajat ki. Poocha gaya: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Kya aap yahan namaz padhenge?" Aap ne jawab diya: "(Namaz ki jagah) tumhare aage hai (yaani Al-Muzdalifa mein)."

e: Narrated Nafi`:`Abdullah bin `Umar used to offer the Maghrib and `Isha' prayers together at Jam' (Al-Muzdalifa). But he used to pass by that mountain pass where Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went, and he would enter it and answer the call of nature and perform ablution, and would not offer any prayer till he had prayed at Jam
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) Maghrib-Isha ek saath Jam' (Al-Muzdalifa) mein padhte. Magar woh us pahad ki ghati se guzarte jahan Allah ke Rasool gaye the, aur usme daakhil hoke qaza-e-hajat aur wudu karte, aur koi namaz nahi padhte jab tak Jam' (Al-Muzdalifa) mein namaz na padh len.

e: Narrated Usama bin Zaid:I rode behind Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) from `Arafat and when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) reached the mountain pass on the left side which is before Al-Muzdalifa he made his camel kneel and then urinated, and then I poured water for his ablution. He performed light ablution and then I said to him: (Is it the time for) the prayer, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" He replied, "The (place of) prayer is ahead of you (i.e. at Al- Muzdalifa)." So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) rode till he reached Al-Muzdalifa and then he offered the prayer (there) . Then in the morning (10th Dhul-Hijja) Al-Faql (bin `Abbas) rode behind Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Kuraib, (a sub-narrator) said that `Abdullah bin `Abbas narrated from Al-Fadl, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) kept on reciting Talbiya (during the journey) till he reached the Jamra." (Jamrat-Al-`Aqaba)
hi: Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Main Allah ke Rasool ke peechhe sawar hokar Arafat se aaya, aur jab Allah ke Rasool baayi taraf wali pahad ki ghati tak pahunche jo Al-Muzdalifa se pehle hai, Aap ne apna oont bithaya aur peshab kiya, phir maine unke wudu ke liye paani daala. Aap ne halka wudu kiya aur maine pucha: "(Namaz ka waqt hai kya) Ya Allah ke Rasool!" Aap ne jawab diya: "(Namaz ki jagah) tumhare aage hai (yaani Al-Muzdalifa mein)." To Allah ke Rasool sawar hue yahan tak ke Al-Muzdalifa pahunche aur wahan namaz padhi. Phir subah (10 Zul-Hijja), Al-Faql (bin Abbas) Allah ke Rasool ke peechhe sawar hue. Kuraib, (doosre raawi) ne kaha ke Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Al-Fadl ke hawale se bataya: "Allah ke Rasool ke Rasool kept on reciting Talbiya (safar ke dauran) yahan tak ke Jamra tak pahunche." (Jamrat-Al-Aqaba)

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas.:I proceeded along with the Prophet (ﷺ) on the day of `Arafat (9th Dhul-Hijja). The Prophet (ﷺ) heard a great hue and cry and the beating of camels behind him. So he beckoned to the people with his lash, "O people! Be quiet. Hastening is not a sign of righteousness
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Main Arafat ke din Nabi ke saath tha. Nabi ne peechhe se bahut shor aur oonton ke maare jane ki awaaz suni. Isliye unhone apne chaabuk se logon ko ishara karke kaha: "Aye logon! Sukoon se raho. Jaldbaazi neki ki nishani nahi."

e: Narrated Usama bin Zaid:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) proceeded from `Arafat and dismounted at the mountainous pass and then urinated and performed a light ablution. I said to him, "(Shall we offer) the prayer?" He replied, "The prayer is ahead of you (i.e. at Al-Muzdalifa)." When he came to Al-Muzdalifa, he performed a perfect ablution. Then Iqama for the prayer was pronounced and he offered the Maghrib prayer and then every person made his camel kneel at his place; and then Iqama for the prayer was pronounced and he offered the (`Isha') prayer and he did not offer any prayer in between them (i.e. Maghrib and `Isha' prayers)
hi: Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool Arafat se aaye aur pahad ki ghati mein utre, aur peshab karke halka wudu kiya. Maine unse pucha: "(Shall we offer) namaz?" Aap ne jawab diya: "Namaz tumhare aage hai (yaani Al-Muzdalifa mein)." Jab woh Al-Muzdalifa aaye, unhone mukammal wudu kiya. Phir Iqama di gayi aur unhone Maghrib padhi, phir har shaks ne apna oont apni jagah bithaya; aur phir Iqama di gayi aur unhone (Isha ki) namaz padhi, aur donon (Maghrib-Isha) ke beech koi (aur) namaz nahi padhi.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) offered the Maghrib and `Isha' prayers together at Jam' (i.e. Al-Muzdalifa) with a separate Iqama for each of them and did not offer any optional prayer in between them or after each of them
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne Jam' (i.e. Al-Muzdalifa) mein Maghrib-Isha ek saath padhi, har ek ke liye alag Iqama, aur donon ke beech ya baad mein koi (aur) nafil namaz nahi padhi.

e: Narrated Abu Aiyub Al-Ansari:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) offered the Maghrib and `Isha' prayers together at Al-Muzdalifa
hi: Abu Aiyub Al-Ansari (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Al-Muzdalifa mein Maghrib-Isha ek saath padhi.

e: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin Yazid:`Abdullah;- performed the Hajj and we reached Al-Muzdalifa at or about the time of the `Isha' prayer. He ordered a man to pronounce the Adhan and Iqama and then he offered the Maghrib prayer and offered two rak`at after it. Then he asked for his supper and took it, and then, I think, he ordered a man to pronounce the Adhan and Iqama (for the `Isha' prayer). (`Amr, a sub-narrator said: The intervening statement 'I think', was said by the sub-narrator Zuhair) (i.e. not by `Abdur-Rahman). Then `Abdullah offered two rak`at of `Isha' prayer. When the day dawned, `Abdullah said, "The Prophet never offered any prayer at this hour except this prayer at this time and at this place and on this day." `Abdullah added, "These two prayers are shifted from their actual times -- the Maghrib prayer (is offered) when the people reached Al-Muzdalifa and the Fajr (morning) prayer at the early dawn." `Abdullah added, "I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) doing that
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Yazid bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ);- ne Hajj kiya aur hum Isha ke waqt ya uske aas-paas Al-Muzdalifa pahunche. Unhone ek shaks ko Adhan-Iqama kehne ka hukum diya, phir Maghrib padhi, aur uske baad do rakat padhi. Phir unhone apna khaana maanga aur khaya, phir, mujhe lagta hai, unhone ek shaks ko Adhan-Iqama kehne ka hukum diya (Isha ke liye). (Amr, doosre raawi ne kaha: "'Mujhe lagta hai' yeh baat doosre raawi Zuhair ne kahi thi, Abdur-Rahman ne nahi.") Phir Abdullah ne Isha ki do rakat padhi. Jab din nikla, Abdullah ne kaha: "Nabi ne kabhi kisi namaz ko uske muqarrar waqt se hatkar nahi padha siwaye do baar; unhone Maghrib-Isha ek saath padhi, aur Fajr apne aam waqt se pehle padhi." Abdullah ne joda: "Yeh dono namazein apni asli waqt se hatai gayi hain — pehli: Maghrib, jab log Al-Muzdalifa pahunchte hain; aur doosri: Fajr namaz jo bahut savere padhi jaati hai." Abdullah ne joda: "Maine Nabi ko yehi karte dekha."

e: Narrated Salim:`Abdullah bin `Umar used to send the weak among his family early to Mina. So they used to depart from Al-Mash'ar Al-Haram (that is Al-Muzdalifa) at night (when the moon had set) and invoke Allah as much as they could, and then they would return (to Mina) before the Imam had started from Al- Muzdalifa to Mina. So some of them would reach Mina at the time of the Fajr prayer and some of them would come later. When they reached Mina they would throw pebbles on the Jamra (Jamrat-Al- `Aqaba) Ibn `Umar used to say, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave the permission to them (weak people) to do so
hi: Salim bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) apne pariwara ke kamzor logon ko subah jaldi Mina bheja karte. Woh raat ko (chaand doobne ke baad) Al-Mash'ar-Al-Haram (yaani Al-Muzdalifa) se nikalte aur jitni Allah ki yaad kar sakte, karte, phir wapas (Mina) jate Imam ke Al-Muzdalifa se Mina rawana hone se pehle. Kuch Fajr ki namaz ke waqt Mina pahunchte aur kuch baad mein. Jab woh Mina pahunchte, woh Jamra (Jamrat-Al-Aqaba) par kanker phenkte. Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) kahte: "Allah ke Rasool ne unhe (kamzor logon ko) aisa karne ki ijazat di thi."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had sent me from Jam' (i.e. Al-Muzdalifa) at night
