hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne mujhe Jam' (yaani Al-Muzdalifa) se raat ko bheja tha.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I was among those whom the Prophet (ﷺ) sent on the night of Al-Muzdalifa early being among the weak members of his family
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Main unme se tha jinhe Nabi ne Al-Muzdalifa ki raat jaldi bheja, apne pariwara ke kamzor logon mein se hote hue.

e: Narrated `Abdullah:(the slave of Asma') During the night of Jam', Asma' got down at Al-Muzdalifa and stood up for (offering) the prayer and offered the prayer for some time and then asked, "O my son! Has the moon set?" I replied in the negative and she again prayed for another period and then asked, "Has the moon set?" I replied, "Yes." So she said that we should set out (for Mina), and we departed and went on till she threw pebbles at the Jamra (Jamrat-Al-`Aqaba) and then she returned to her dwelling place and offered the morning prayer. I asked her, "O you! I think we have come (to Mina) early in the night." She replied, "O my son! Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave permission to the women to do so
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) (Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke gulam) bataate hain: Jam' ki raat, Asma Al-Muzdalifa mein utrin aur namaz ke liye khadi hui aur kuch der padhi, phir pucha: "Aye mere bete! Kya chaand doob gaya hai?" Maine na mein jawab diya, aur unhone phir kuch der namaz padhi, phir pucha: "Kya chaand doob gaya?" Maine haan mein jawab diya. To unhone kaha ke hum nikalte hain (Mina ke liye), aur hum nikale aur chale yahan tak ke unhone Jamra (Jamrat-Al-Aqaba) par kanker maare, phir apni jagah wapas gayi aur Fajr ki namaz padhi. Maine unse pucha: "Aye aap! Mujhe lagta hai hum raat mein jald aa gaye hain." Unhone jawab diya: "Aye mere bete! Allah ke Rasool ne aurton ko aisa karne ki ijazat di thi."

e: Narrated `Aisha:Sauda asked the permission of the Prophet (ﷺ) to leave earlier at the night of Jam', and she was a fat and very slow woman. The Prophet (ﷺ) gave her permission
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Sauda (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne Nabi se Jam' ki raat jaldi jane ki ijazat maangi, aur woh moti aur bahut dheeli aurat thi. Nabi ne unhe ijazat di.

e: Narrated `Aisha:We got down at Al-Muzdalifa and Sauda asked the permission of the Prophet (ﷺ) to leave (early) before the rush of the people. She was a slow woman and he gave her permission, so she departed (from Al- Muzdalifa) before the rush of the people. We kept on staying at Al-Muzdalifa till dawn, and set out with the Prophet (ﷺ) but (I suffered so much that) I wished I had taken the permission of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as Sauda had done, and that would have been dearer to me than any other happiness
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Hum Al-Muzdalifa mein utre aur Sauda (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne Nabi se logon ki bhirr se pehle jane ki ijazat maangi. Woh dheeli aurat thi aur Aap ne unhe ijazat di, isliye woh bhirr se pehle (Al-Muzdalifa se) nikal gayi. Hum Al-Muzdalifa mein subah tak rukte rahe, aur Nabi ke saath nikle (magar mujhe itni takleef hui ke) main chahti thi kaash maine bhi Allah ke Rasool se woh ijazat li hoti jo Sauda ne li thi, aur yeh mujhe kisi bhi khushi se zyada pyara hota.

e: Narrated `Abdullah:I never saw the Prophet (ﷺ) offering any prayer not at its stated time except two; he prayed the Maghrib and the `Isha' together and he offered the morning prayer before its usual time
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi ko kisi namaz ko uske muqarrar waqt se hatkar nahi padhte dekha siwaye do baar; unhone Maghrib-Isha ek saath padhi, aur Fajr ki namaz apne aam waqt se pehle padhi.

e: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin Yazid:I went out with `Abdullah to Mecca and when we proceeded to Jam', he offered the two prayers (the Maghrib and the `Isha') together, making the Adhan and Iqama separately for each prayer. He took his supper in between the two prayers. He offered the Fajr prayer as soon as the day dawned. Some people said, "The day had dawned (at the time of the prayer)," and others said, "The day had not dawned." `Abdullah then said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'These two prayers have been shifted from their stated times at this place only (at Al-Muzdalifa); first: The Maghrib and the `Isha'. So the people should not arrive at Al-Muzdalifa till the time of the `Isha' prayer has become due. The second prayer is the morning prayer which is offered at this hour.' " Then `Abdullah stayed there till it became a bit brighter. He then said, "If the chief of the believers hastened onwards to Mina just now, then he had indeed followed the Sunna." I do not know which proceeded the other, his (`Abdullah's) statement or the departure of `Uthman . `Abdullah was reciting Talbiya till he threw pebbles at the Jamrat-Al- `Aqaba on the Day of Nahr (slaughtering) (that is the 10th of Dhul-Hijja)
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Yazid bataate hain: Main Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath Mecca gaya, aur jab hum Jam' pahunche, unhone donon namazein (Maghrib-Isha) ek saath padhi, har namaz ke liye alag Adhan-Iqama. Unhone donon namazon ke beech apna khaana khaya. Din nikalte hi unhone Fajr padhi. Kuch logon ne kaha: "Din nikal chuka hai," aur kuch ne kaha: "Din nahi nikla." Abdullah ne phir kaha: "Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: 'Yeh do namazein apne muqarrar waqt se sirf yahan (Al-Muzdalifa) mein hataai gayi hain; pehli: Maghrib-Isha. Isliye log Al-Muzdalifa mein tab tak na pahunchen jab tak Isha ka waqt zaroori na ho jaaye. Doosri namaz Fajr hai jo is (savere) waqt padhi jaati hai.'" Phir Abdullah wahin ruke jab tak thodi si roshni na ho gayi. Phir unhone kaha: "Agar Ameer-ul-Momineen abhi Mina ki taraf jaldi kar rahe hote, unhone Sunnat ki pairvi ki hoti." Mujhe nahi pata kaunsi baat pehle hui, Abdullah ki yeh baat ya Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ka nikalna. Abdullah Talbiya kahte rahe yahan tak ke unhone Yaum-un-Nahr (qurbani ke din, yaani 10 Zul-Hijja) Jamrat-Al-Aqaba par kanker maare.

e: Narrated `Amr bin Maimun:I saw `Umar, offering the Fajr (morning) prayer at Jam'; then he got up and said, "The pagans did not use to depart (from Jam') till the sun had risen, and they used to say, 'Let the sun shine on Thabir (a mountain).' But the Prophet (ﷺ) contradicted them and departed from Jam' before sunrise
hi: Amr bin Maimun bataate hain: Maine Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko Jam' mein Fajr ki namaz padhte dekha; phir woh uthe aur kaha: "Mushrik log tab tak (Jam' se) nahi nikalte the jab tak suraj na nikal aaye, aur woh kehte: 'Suraj Thabir (ek pahad) par chamke.' Magar Nabi ne unke khilaf jaakar suraj nikalne se pehle Jam' se nikal gaye."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) made Al-Fadl ride behind him, and Al-Fadl informed that he (the Prophet (ﷺ) ) kept on reciting Talbiya till he did the Rami of the Jamra. (Jamrat-Al-`Aqaba)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne Al-Fadl ko apne peechhe sawar karwayaa, aur Al-Fadl ne bataya ke (Nabi) Talbiya kahte rahe yahan tak ke unhone Jamra (Jamrat-Al-Aqaba) ka Rami (kanker maarna) kiya.

e: Narrated 'Ubaidullah bin `Abdullah:Ibn `Abbas said, "Usama bin Zaid rode behind the Prophet (ﷺ) from `Arafat to Al-Muzdalifa; and then from Al-Muzdalifa to Mina, Al-Fadl rode behind him." He added, "Both of them (Usama and Al-Fadl) said, 'The Prophet (ﷺ) was constantly reciting Talbiya till he did Rami of the Jamarat-Al-`Aqaba
hi: Ubaidullah bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) Allah ke Rasool ke peechhe sawar hokar Arafat se Al-Muzdalifa gaye; phir Al-Muzdalifa se Mina tak, Al-Fadl unke peechhe sawar hue." Unhone joda: "Donon (Usama aur Al-Fadl) ne kaha: 'Nabi musalsal Talbiya kahte rahe yahan tak ke unhone Jamrat-Al-Aqaba ka Rami kiya.'"

e: Narrated Abu Jamra:I asked Ibn `Abbas about Hajj-at-Tamattu`. He ordered me to perform it. I asked him about the Hadi (sacrifice). He said, "You have to slaughter a camel, a cow or a sheep, or you may share the Hadi with the others." It seemed that some people disliked it (Hajj-at-Tamattu`). I slept and dreamt as if a person was announcing: "Hajj Mabrur and accepted Mut'ah (Hajj-at-Tamattu`)" I went to Ibn `Abbas and narrated it to him. He said, "Allah is Greater. (That was) the tradition of Abu Al-Qasim (i.e. Prophet). Narrated Shu`ba that the call in the dream was. "An accepted `Umra and Hajj-Mabrur
hi: Abu Jamra bataate hain: Maine Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se Hajj-at-Tamattu ke baare mein pucha. Unhone mujhe use karne ka hukum diya. Maine unse Hadi ke baare mein pucha. Unhone kaha: "Tumhe ek oont, gaay ya bhed zabah karni hogi, ya tum Hadi mein doosron ke saath shareek ho sakte ho." Aisa lagta hai kuch log ise (Hajj-at-Tamattu) napasand karte the. Main soya aur khwab dekha ke koi elaan kar raha hai: "Hajj Mabroor aur qubool shuda Mut'ah (Hajj-at-Tamattu)." Main Ibn Abbas ke paas gaya aur unhe yeh bataya. Unhone kaha: "Allahu Akbar. (Yeh) Abul-Qasim (yaani Nabi) ki Sunnat hai." Shu'ba ne riwayat ki ke khwab mein awaaz thi: "Qubool shuda Umrah aur Hajj Mabroor."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira':Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw a man driving his Badana (sacrificial camel). He said, "Ride on it." The man said, "It is a Badana." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Ride on it." He (the man) said, "It is a Badana." The Prophet said, "Ride on it." And on the second or the third time he (the Prophet (ﷺ) ) added, "Woe to you
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne ek shaks ko apna Badana (qurbani ka oont) hankate dekha. Aap ne kaha: "Ispar sawar ho jao." Shaks ne kaha: "Yeh Badana hai." Nabi ne (phir) kaha: "Ispar sawar ho jao." Usne (phir) kaha: "Yeh Badana hai." Nabi ne kaha: "Ispar sawar ho jao," aur doosri ya teesri baar joda: "Tumhare liye afsos!"

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) saw a man driving a Badana. He said, "Ride on it." The man replied, "It is a Badana." The Prophet (ﷺ) said (again), "Ride on it." He (the man) said, "It is a Badana." The Prophet (ﷺ) said thrice, "Ride on it
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne ek shaks ko Badana hankate dekha. Aap ne kaha: "Ispar sawar ho jao." Shaks ne jawab diya: "Yeh Badana hai." Nabi ne (phir) kaha: "Ispar sawar ho jao." Usne (phir) kaha: "Yeh Badana hai." Nabi ne teen baar kaha: "Ispar sawar ho jao."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:During the last Hajj (Hajj-al-Wada`) of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) he performed `Umra and Hajj. He drove a Hadi along with him from Dhul-Hulaifa. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) started by assuming Ihram for `Umra and Hajj. And the people, too, performed the `Umra and Hajj along with the Prophet. Some of them brought the Hadi and drove it along with them, while the others did not. So, when the Prophet (ﷺ) arrived at Mecca. he said to the people, "Whoever among you has driven the Hadi, should not finish his Ihram till he completes his Hajj. And whoever among you has not (driven) the Hadi with him, should perform Tawaf of the Ka`ba and the Tawaf between Safa and Marwa, then cut short his hair and finish his Ihram, and should later assume Ihram for Hajj; but he must offer a Hadi (sacrifice); and if anyone cannot afford a Hadi, he should fast for three days during the Hajj and seven days when he returns home. The Prophet (ﷺ) performed Tawaf of the Ka`ba on his arrival (at Mecca); he touched the (Black Stone) corner first of all and then did Ramal (fast walking with moving of the shoulders) during the first three rounds round the Ka`ba, and during the last four rounds he walked. After finishing Tawaf of the Ka`ba, he offered a two rak`at prayer at Maqam Ibrahim, and after finishing the prayer he went to Safa and Marwa and performed seven rounds of Tawaf between them and did not do any deed forbidden because of Ihram, till he finished all the ceremonies of his Hajj and sacrificed his Hadi on the day of Nahr (10th day of Dhul-Hijja). He then hastened onwards (to Mecca) and performed Tawaf of the Ka`ba and then everything that was forbidden because of Ihram became permissible. Those who took and drove the Hadi with them did the same as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ke aakhri Hajj (Hajj-al-Wida) mein, unhone Umrah aur Hajj dono kiya. Unhone Dhul-Hulaifa se apne saath Hadi lekar chale. Allah ke Rasool ne pehle Umrah-Hajj (dono) ka Ihram baandha, aur log bhi Nabi ke saath Hajj-Umrah karte the. Kuch ne apna Hadi liya aur apne saath rakha, jabke doosron ne nahi liya. Isliye, jab Nabi Mecca pahunche, unhone logon se kaha: "Jinhone bhi apna Hadi liya hai, woh apna Hajj mukammal karne tak Ihram na khole. Aur jinke paas Hadi nahi hai, unhe Ka'ba ka Tawaf aur Safa-Marwa ka Tawaf karke, apne baal chhote karke, apna Ihram khatam kar dena chahiye, aur baad mein Hajj ka Ihram baandhna chahiye; magar unhe zaroor Hadi zabah karni chahiye; aur agar koi Hadi ka intezaam na kar sake, use Hajj ke teen din aur ghar wapas jaane ke baad saat din roza rakhna chahiye." Nabi ne pahunchte hi Ka'ba ka Tawaf kiya; unhone sabse pehle Kone (Hajr-e-Aswad) ko chhua aur pehli teen chakkaron mein Ramal kiya, aur aakhri chaar mein aam chaal se chale. Ka'ba ka Tawaf khatam karke, unhone Maqam-e-Ibrahim mein do rakat padhi, aur namaz khatam karke Safa-Marwa gaye aur unke saat chakkar (Tawaf) kiye, aur jab tak Hajj ki sab rasmein mukammal na kar li aur Yaum-un-Nahr (10 Zul-Hijja) apna Hadi zabah na kar liya, koi Ihram wali cheez haram nahi ki. Phir Aap jaldi (Mecca) laute aur Ka'ba ka Tawaf kiya, aur uske baad har cheez jaiz ho gayi jo Ihram ki wajah se haram thi. Jinhone Hadi apne saath liya aur laaya tha, unhone bhi Allah ke Rasool jaisa hi kiya.

e: Narrated 'Urwa:" 'Aishah informed me about the Hajj and 'Umra (together) of the Prophet (ﷺ) and so did the people who were with him (during the Hajj and 'Umra) and narration similar to the narration of the Ibn 'Umar (previous hadith)
hi: Urwa bataate hain: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne mujhe Nabi ke Hajj-Umrah (dono) ke baare mein bataya, aur unke saath jo log the unhone bhi yehi bataya, jaisa Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne bataya (pichhli hadith).

e: Narrated Nafi`:`Abdullah (bin `Abdullah) bin `Umar said to his father, "Stay here, for I am afraid that it (affliction between Ibn Az-Zubair and Al-Hajjaj) might prevent you from reaching the Ka`ba." Ibn `Umar said, "(In this case) I would do the same as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did, and Allah has said, 'Verily, in Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), you have a good example (to follow).' So, I make you, people, witness that I have made `Umra compulsory for me." So he assumed Ihram for `Umra. Then he went out and when he reached Al- Baida', he assumed Ihram for Hajj and `Umra (together) and said, "The conditions (requisites) of Hajj and `Umra are the same." He, then brought a Hadi from Qudaid. Then he arrived (at Mecca) and performed Tawaf (between Safa and Marwa) once for both Hajj and `Umra and did not finish the Ihram till he had finished both Hajj and `Umra
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) (bin Abdullah) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne apne waalid se kaha: "Yahin rukiye, kyunke mujhe dar hai ke (Ibn Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Al-Hajjaj ke darmiyan) fasaad aapko Ka'ba tak pahunchne se rok de." Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "(Iss surat mein) main wahi karunga jo Allah ke Rasool ne kiya, aur Allah ne farmaya hai: 'Beshak, Allah ke Rasool mein tumhare liye behtareen namoona hai.' Isliye main tum sab log ko gawah banata hoon ke maine Umrah farz kar liya hai." Isliye unhone Umrah ka Ihram baandha. Phir woh nikle aur jab Al-Baida pahunche, unhone Hajj-Umrah dono ka Ihram baandha aur kaha: "Hajj-Umrah ki sharten ek jaisi hain." Phir woh Qudaid se ek Hadi laaae. Phir woh (Mecca) pahunche aur ek hi Tawaf (Safa-Marwa) kiya Hajj-Umrah dono ke liye, aur Ihram tab tak khatam nahi kiya jab tak Hajj-Umrah dono mukammal nahi ho gaye.

e: Narrated Al-Miswar bin Makhrama and Marwan:The Prophet (ﷺ) set out from Medina with over one thousand of his companions (at the time of the Treaty of Hudaibiya) and when they reached Dhul-Hulaifa, the Prophet (ﷺ) garlanded his Hadi and marked it and assumed Ihram for `Umra
hi: Al-Miswar bin Makhrama (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Marwan bataate hain: Nabi Madina se ek hazaar se zyada sahaba ke saath nikle (Hudaibiya ke muahide ke waqt) aur jab woh Dhul-Hulaifa pahunche, Nabi ne apne Hadi ko maalayen pehnayi aur nishaan lagaayaa, aur Umrah ka Ihram baandha.

e: Narrated `Aisha:I twisted with my own hands the garlands for the Budn of the Prophet (ﷺ) who garlanded and marked them, and then made them proceed to Mecca; Yet no permissible thing was regarded as illegal for him then
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine apne haathon se Nabi ke Budn (qurbani ke oonton) ke liye maalayen buni, aur Aap ne unhe maalayen pehnayi aur nishaan lagaayaa, phir unhe Mecca ki taraf bheja; magar ussay koi jaiz cheez unke liye haram nahi hui (kyunke Nabi khud Ihram mein nahi the).

e: Narrated Hafsa:I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What is wrong with the people, they have finished their Ihram but you have not?" He said, "I matted my hair and I have garlanded my Hadi, so I will not finish my Ihram till I have finished my Hajj
hi: Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Logon ko kya hua, unhone apna Ihram khatam kar diya magar aapne nahi?" Aap ne kaha: "Maine apne baal jaṭ kiye hain aur apne Hadi ko maalayen pehnayi hain, isliye main apna Ihram tab tak khatam nahi karunga jab tak apna Hajj mukammal na kar loon."

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to send the Hadi from Medina and I used to twist the garlands for his Hadi and he did not keep away from any of these things which a Muhrim keeps away from
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool Madina se Hadi bhejte the aur main unke Hadi ke liye maalayen bunati thi, aur woh un sab cheezon se dur nahi rehte jinse ek Muhrim rehte hai (kyunke Nabi khud us waqt Ihram mein nahi hote).

e: Narrated `Aisha:I twisted the garlands for the Hadis of the Prophet (ﷺ) and then he marked and garlanded them (or I garlanded them) and then made them proceed to the Ka`ba but he remained in Medina and no permissible thing was regarded as illegal for him then
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine Nabi ke Hadi ke liye maalayen buni, phir unhone (ya maine) nishaan lagaayaa aur unhe maalayen pehnayi, phir unhe Ka'ba ki taraf bheja, magar Aap Madina mein hi rahe aur unke liye koi jaiz cheez haram nahi hui.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abu Bakr bin `Amr bin Hazm:That `Amra bint `Abdur-Rahman had told him, "Zaid bin Abu Sufyan wrote to `Aisha that `Abdullah bin `Abbas had stated, 'Whoever sends his Hadi (to the Ka`ba), all the things which are illegal for a (pilgrim) become illegal for that person till he slaughters it (i.e. till the 10th of Dhul-Hijja).' " `Amra added, `Aisha said, 'It is not like what Ibn `Abbas had said: I twisted the garlands of the Hadis of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with my own hands. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) put them round their necks with his own hands, sending them with my father; Yet nothing permitted by Allah was considered illegal for Allah's Apostle till he slaughtered the Hadis
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Bakr bin Amr bin Hazm bataate hain: Amra bint Abdur-Rahman ne unhe bataya: "Zaid bin Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko likha ke Abdullah bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: 'Jo bhi apna Hadi (Ka'ba ki taraf) bheje, uske liye sab woh cheezein haram ho jaati hain jo ek Muhrim (Hajji) ke liye haram hain, jab tak Hadi zabah na ho jaaye (yaani 10 Zul-Hijja tak).'" Amra ne joda ke Ayesha ne kaha: "Yeh Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki baat jaisa nahi hai. Maine apne haathon se Allah ke Rasool ke Hadi ke liye maalayen buni. Phir Allah ke Rasool ne apne haathon se unhe unki gardan mein daali, aur mere waalid ke zariye unhe (Mecca) bheja; magar Allah ki taraf se koi jaiz cheez Allah ke Rasool ke liye haram nahi hui jab tak Hadi zabah nahi hui."

e: Narrated `Aisha:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) sent sheep as Hadi
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ek baar Nabi ne bhedein Hadi ke tor par bheji.

e: Narrated `Aisha:I used to make the garlands for (the Hadis of) the Prophet (ﷺ) and he would garland the sheep (with them) and would stay with his family as a non-Muhrim
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Main Nabi (ke Hadi) ke liye maalayen bunati thi aur Aap unhe bhedon ko pehnate, aur apne pariwara ke saath ghair-Muhrim ki tarah rehte.

e: Narrated Aisha:I used to twist the garlands for the sheep of the Prophet (ﷺ) and he would send them (to the Ka`ba), and stay as a non-Muhrim
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Main Nabi ki bhedon ke liye maalayen bunati thi, aur woh unhe (Ka'ba ki taraf) bhejte, aur khud ghair-Muhrim ki tarah rehte.

e: Narrated `Aisha:I twisted (the garlands) for the Hadis of the Prophet (ﷺ) before he assumed Ihram
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine Nabi ke Hadi ke liye maalayen buni isse pehle ke unhone Ihram baandha.

e: Narrated `Aisha:I twisted the garlands of the Hadis from the wool which was with me
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine Hadi ke liye maalayen us oon se buni jo mere paas thi.

e: Narrated `Ikrima:Abu Huraira said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) saw a man driving a Badana (sacrificial camel). The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to him), 'Ride on it.' He replied, 'It is a Badana.' The Prophet (ﷺ) again said, 'Ride on it!' Abu Huraira added, 'Then I saw that man riding it, showing obedience to the Prophet (ﷺ), and a shoe was (hanging) from its neck.' " Narrated Abu Huraira: From the Prophet: (as above)
hi: Ikrima bataate hain: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Nabi ne ek shaks ko Badana hankate dekha. Nabi ne (usse) kaha: 'Ispar sawar ho jao.' Usne jawab diya: 'Yeh Badana hai.' Nabi ne dobara kaha: 'Ispar sawar ho jao!'" Abu Huraira ne joda: "Phir maine us shaks ko ispar sawar dekha, Nabi ki itaa'at karte hue, aur uski gardan se ek joota latak raha tha." Abu Huraira ne Nabi se yehi (upar wali) riwayat ki.

e: Narrated `Ali:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered me to give in charity the skin and the coverings of the Budn which I had slaughtered
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne mujhe hukum diya ke main Budn ke chamde aur kapde sadqa mein de dun jinhe maine zabah kiya tha.

e: Narrated Nafi`:Ibn `Umar intended to perform Hajj in the year of the Hajj of Al-Harawriya during the rule of Ibn Az-Zubair. Some people said to him, "It is very likely that there will be a fight among the people, and we are afraid that they might prevent you (from performing Hajj)." He replied, "Verily, in Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) there is a good example for you (to follow). In this case I would do the same as he had done. I make you witness that I have intended to perform `Umra." When he reached Al-Baida', he said, "The conditions for both Hajj and `Umra are the same. I make you witness that I have intended to perform Hajj along with `Umra." After that he took a garlanded Hadi (to Mecca) which he bought (on the way). When he reached (Mecca), he performed Tawaf of the Ka`ba and of Safa (and Marwa) and did not do more than that. He did not make legal for himself the things which were illegal for a Muhrim till it was the Day of Nahr (sacrifice), when he had his head shaved and slaughtered (the sacrifice) and considered sufficient his first Tawaf (between Safa and Marwa), as a (Sa`i) for his Hajj and `Umra both. He then said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) used to do like that
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne us saal Hajj karne ka iraada kiya jab Al-Harawriya ne Hajj kiya, Ibn Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke zamane mein. Kuch logon ne unse kaha: "Aisa lagta hai logon ke darmiyan jung hogi, aur humein dar hai woh aapko (Hajj se) rok denge." Unhone jawab diya: "Beshak, Allah ke Rasool mein tumhare liye behtareen namoona hai. Iss surat mein main wahi karunga jo unhone kiya. Main tumhe gawah banata hoon ke maine Umrah karne ka iraada kiya hai." Jab woh Al-Baida pahunche, unhone kaha: "Hajj-Umrah dono ki sharten ek jaisi hain. Main tumhe gawah banata hoon ke maine Hajj-Umrah dono ki niyyat ki hai." Iske baad woh ek maalayen wala Hadi le gaye jo unhone (raaste mein) khareeda. Jab woh pahunche, unhone Ka'ba ka aur Safa (Marwa) ka Tawaf kiya, aur isse zyada kuch nahi kiya. Unhone woh cheezein jaiz nahi banayi jo ek Muhrim ke liye haram hain jab tak Yaum-un-Nahr (qurbani ka din) na aa gaya, jab unhone apna sar munavaayaa aur (Hadi) zabah kiya, aur apne pehle Tawaf (Safa-Marwa) ko Hajj-Umrah dono ke liye kaafi samjha. Phir unhone kaha: "Nabi bhi aisa hi karte the."

e: Narrated `Amra bint `Abdur-Rahman:I heard `Aisha saying, "Five days before the end of Dhul-Qa'da we set out from Medina in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with the intention of performing Hajj only. When we approached Mecca, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered those who had no Hadi with them to finish their Ihram after performing Tawaf of the Ka`ba and (Sa`i) between Safa and Marwa." `Aisha added, "On the day of Nahr (slaughtering of sacrifice) beef was brought to us. I asked, 'What is this?' The reply was, 'Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) has slaughtered (sacrifices) on behalf of his wives
hi: Amra bint Abdur-Rahman bataati hain: Maine Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko kehte suna: "Zul-Qa'da khatam hone se paanch din pehle, hum Allah ke Rasool ke saath Madina se sirf Hajj ki niyyat se nikle. Jab hum Mecca ke qareeb pahunche, Allah ke Rasool ne un logon ko jinke paas Hadi nahi tha ke woh Ka'ba ka Tawaf aur Safa-Marwa ka (Sa'i) karke apna Ihram khatam kar den." Ayesha ne joda: "Yaum-un-Nahr (qurbani ke din), humein gaay ka gosht mila. Maine pucha: 'Yeh kya hai?' Jawab mila: 'Allah ke Rasool ne apni biwiyon ki taraf se qurbani ki hai.'"

e: Narrated Nafi`:`Abdullah (bin `Umar), used to slaughter (his sacrifice) at the Manhar. ('Ubaidullah, a sub-narrator said, "The Manhar of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) (bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ)) Manhar (qurbani karne ki jagah) par zabah karte the. (Ubaidullah, doosre raawi ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool ka Manhar.")

e: Narrated Nafi`:Ibn `Umar used to send his Hadi from Jam' (to Mina) in the last third of the night with the pilgrims amongst whom there were free men and slaves, till it was taken into the Manhar (slaughtering place) of the Prophet (ﷺ)
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) apna Hadi Jam' (Al-Muzdalifa) se (Mina) raat ke aakhri tihai hisse mein Hajjiyon ke saath bhejte, jinme azaad log aur gulaam donon shamil hote, yahan tak ke woh Nabi ke Manhar (qurbani ki jagah) mein le jaaayaa jata.

e: Narrated Sahl bin Bakkar:The narration of Anas abridged, saying, "The Prophet (ﷺ) slaughtered seven Budn (camels) while standing, with his own hands. On the day of `Id-ul-Adha he slaughtered (sacrificed) two horned rams, black and white in color
hi: Sahl bin Bakkar bataate hain: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki (choti) riwayat: "Nabi ne saat Budn (oont) khade hokar apne haathon se zabah kiye. Eid-ul-Adha ke din unhone do singon wale menghon ko, kaale-safed rang ke, zabah kiya."

e: Narrated Ziyad bin Jubair:I saw Ibn `Umar passing by a man who had made his Badana sit to slaughter it. Ibn `Umar said, "Slaughter it while it is standing with one leg tied up as is the tradition of Muhammad
hi: Ziyad bin Jubair bataate hain: Maine Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko dekha ek shaks ke paas se guzarte hue jisne apna Badana bithaya hua tha zabah karne ke liye. Ibn Umar ne kaha: "Ise khade hue zabah karo, ek taang baandh kar, jaisi Muhammad ki riwayat hai."

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) offered four rak`at of Zuhr prayer at Medina; and two rak`at of `Asr prayer at Dhil- Hulaifa and spent the night there and when (the day) dawned, he mounted his Mount and started saying, "None has the right to be worshipped but Allah, and Glorified be Allah." When he reached Al- Baida' he recited Talbiya for both Hajj and `Umra. And when he arrived at Mecca, he ordered them (his companions) to finish their Ihram. The Prophet (ﷺ) slaughtered seven Budn (camel) with his own hands while the camels were standing He also sacrificed two horned rams (black and white in color) at Medina
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Madina mein Zuhr ki chaar rakat padhi, aur Dhul-Hulaifa mein Asr ki do rakat, aur wahin raat guzari, aur jab (din) hua, unhone apni sawari par sawar hokar kehna shuru kiya: "Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahi, aur Allah paak hai." Jab woh Al-Baida pahunche, unhone Hajj-Umrah dono ke liye Talbiya kahi. Aur jab Mecca pahunche, unhe (apne sahaba ko) Ihram khatam karne ka hukum diya. Nabi ne apne haathon se saat Budn khade hue zabah kiye. Aap ne Madina mein bhi do singon wale menghon (kaale-safed) ki qurbani ki.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) offered four rak`at of Zuhr prayer at Medina and two rak`at of `Asr prayer at Dhul-Hulaifa. Narrated Aiyub: "A man said: Anas said, "Then he (the Prophet (ﷺ) passed the night there till dawn and then he offered the morning (Fajr) prayer, and mounted his Mount and when it arrived at Al-Baida' he assumed Ihram for both `Umra and Hajj
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Madina mein Zuhr ki chaar rakat padhi aur Dhul-Hulaifa mein Asr ki do rakat. Aiyub bataate hain: "Ek shaks ne kaha: Anas ne kaha: 'Phir woh (Nabi) wahin raat guzarte gaye subah tak aur Fajr ki namaz padhi, phir apni sawari par sawar hue aur jab woh Al-Baida pahunche, unhone Umrah-Hajj dono ka Ihram baandha.'"

e: Narrated `Ali:The Prophet (ﷺ) sent me to supervise the (slaughtering of) Budn (Hadi camels) and ordered me to distribute their meat, and then he ordered me to distribute their covering sheets and skins. 'Ali added, "The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered me to supervise the slaughtering (of the Budn) and not to give anything (of their bodies) to the butcher as wages for slaughtering
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Nabi ne mujhe Budn (Hadi oonton) ki dekhbhal ke liye bheja aur mujhe unka gosht taqseem karne ka hukum diya, phir unke kapde aur khaal taqseem karne ka hukum diya. Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne joda: "Nabi ne mujhe hukum diya ke main Budn ki dekhbhal karun aur zabah karne wale ko unke jism ka koi hissa mazdoori ke tor par na dun."

e: Narrated `Ali:The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered me to supervise the (slaughtering) of Budn (Hadi camel) and to distribute their meat, skins and covering sheets in charity and not to give anything (of their bodies) to the butcher as wages for slaughtering
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Nabi ne mujhe hukum diya ke main Budn (Hadi oont) ki dekhbhal karun aur unka gosht, khaal aur kapde sadqa mein taqseem karun, aur zabah karne wale ko unke jism ka koi hissa mazdoori ke tor par na dun.

e: Narrated `Ali:The Prophet (ﷺ) offered one hundred Budn as Hadi and ordered me to distribute their meat (in charity) and I did so. Then he ordered me to distribute their covering sheets in charity and I did so. Then he ordered me to distribute their skins in charity and I did so
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Nabi ne sau Budn Hadi ke tor par pesh kiye aur mujhe unka gosht taqseem karne ka hukum diya, aur maine aisa kiya. Phir unhone mujhe unke kapde sadqa mein taqseem karne ka hukum diya, aur maine aisa kiya. Phir unhone mujhe unke khaal sadqa mein taqseem karne ka hukum diya, aur maine aisa kiya.

e: Narrated Ibn Juraij:`Ata' said, "I heard Jabir bin `Abdullah saying, 'We never ate the meat of the Budn for more than three days of Mina. Later, the Prophet (ﷺ) gave us permission by saying: 'Eat and take (meat) with you. So we ate (some) and took (some) with us.' " I asked `Ata', "Did Jabir say (that they went on eating the meat) till they reached Medina?" `Ata' replied, "No
hi: Ibn Juraij bataate hain: Ata ne kaha: "Maine Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko kehte suna: 'Hum Mina ke teen dinon se zyada Budn ka gosht kabhi nahi khate the. Baad mein, Nabi ne humein ijazat di aur kaha: Khao aur (apne saath) le jao.' To humne khaya aur (apne saath) le liya." Maine Ata se pucha: "Kya Jabir ne kaha (ke woh khaate rahe) yahan tak ke Madina pahunche?" Ata ne kaha: "Nahi."

e: Narrated `Amra:I heard `Aisha saying, "We set out (from Medina) along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) five days before the end of Dhul-Qa'da with the intention of performing Hajj only. When we approached Mecca, Allah's Apostle ordered those who had no Hadi along with them to finish the Ihram after performing Tawaf of the Ka`ba, (Safa and Marwa). `Aisha added, "Beef was brought to us on the Day of Nahr and I said, 'What is this?' Somebody said, 'The Prophet (ﷺ) has slaughtered (cows) on behalf of his wives
hi: Amra bataati hain: Maine Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko kehte suna: "Hum (Madina se) Zul-Qa'da khatam hone se paanch din pehle Allah ke Rasool ke saath sirf Hajj ki niyyat se nikle. Jab hum Mecca ke qareeb pahunche, Allah ke Rasool ne un logon ko jinke paas Hadi nahi tha, Ka'ba ka Tawaf (Safa-Marwa) karke Ihram khatam karne ka hukum diya." Ayesha ne joda: "Yaum-un-Nahr ke din humein gaay ka gosht mila aur maine pucha: 'Yeh kya hai?' Kisi ne kaha: 'Nabi ne apni biwiyon ki taraf se qurbani ki hai.'"

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) was asked about a person who had his head shaved before slaughtering (his Hadi) (or other similar ceremonies of Hajj). He replied, "There is no harm, there is no harm
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi se ek shaks ke baare mein pucha gaya jisne apna sar zabah karne se pehle munavaaya (ya Hajj ki koi aur rasm ki). Aap ne jawab diya: "Koi harj nahi, koi harj nahi."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:A man said to the Prophet (ﷺ) "I performed the Tawaf-al-Ifada before the Rami (throwing pebbles at the Jamra)." The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "There is no harm." The man said, "I had my head shaved before slaughtering." The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "There is no harm." He said, "I have slaughtered the Hadi before the Rami." The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "There is no harm
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Ek shaks ne Nabi se kaha: "Maine Rami (kanker maarne) se pehle Tawaf-al-Ifada kiya." Nabi ne jawab diya: "Koi harj nahi." Shaks ne kaha: "Maine zabah se pehle apna sar munavaaya." Nabi ne jawab diya: "Koi harj nahi." Usne kaha: "Maine Rami se pehle Hadi zabah kiya." Nabi ne jawab diya: "Koi harj nahi."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) was asked by a man who said, "I have done the Rami in the evening." The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "There is no harm in it." Another man asked, "I had my head shaved before the slaughtering." The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "There is no harm in it
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Ek shaks ne Nabi se pucha aur kaha: "Maine shaam ko Rami kiya." Nabi ne jawab diya: "Koi harj nahi." Doosre shaks ne pucha: "Maine zabah se pehle apna sar munavaaya." Nabi ne jawab diya: "Koi harj nahi."

e: Narrated Abu Musa:I came upon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) when he was at Al-Batha. He asked me, "Have you intended to perform the Hajj?" I replied in the affirmative. He asked, "For what have you assumed Ihram?" I replied," I have assumed Ihram with the same intention as that of the Prophet (ﷺ) ." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You have done well! Go and perform Tawaf round the Ka`ba and between Safa and Marwa." Then I went to one of the women of Bani Qais and she took out lice from my head. Later, I assumed the Ihram for Hajj. So, I used to give this verdict to the people till the caliphate of `Umar. When I told him about it, he said, "If we take (follow) the Holy Book, then it orders us to complete Hajj and `Umra (Hajj-at- Tamattu`) and if we follow the tradition of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not finish his Ihram till the Hadi had reached its destination (had been slaughtered). (i.e. Hajj-al-Qiran). (See Hadith No)
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Allah ke Rasool ke paas aaya jab woh Al-Batha mein the. Aap ne pucha: "Kya tumne Hajj ki niyyat ki hai?" Maine haan mein jawab diya. Aap ne pucha: "Tumne kis niyyat se Ihram baandha?" Maine jawab diya: "Maine Nabi jaisi niyyat se Ihram baandha." Nabi ne kaha: "Tumne achha kiya! Jaao, Ka'ba ka aur Safa-Marwa ka Tawaf karo." Phir main Bani Qais ki ek aurat ke paas gaya aur usne mere sar se jooen nikaali. Baad mein maine Hajj ka Ihram baandha. Isliye main logon ko yehi fatwa deta raha Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki khilafat tak. Jab maine unhe iske baare mein bataya, unhone kaha: "Agar hum Allah ki Kitaab ki pairvi karen, to woh humein Hajj-Umrah mukammal karne ka hukum deti hai (Hajj-at-Tamattu); aur agar hum Allah ke Rasool ki Sunnat ki pairvi karen, to Allah ke Rasool ne apna Ihram tab tak khatam nahi kiya jab tak Hadi apni jagah na pahunch gayi (zabah na ho gayi). (yaani Hajj-al-Qiran.)"

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Hafsa said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What is wrong with the people; they finished their Ihram after performing `Umra, but you have not finished it after your `Umra?" He replied, "I matted my hair and have garlanded my Hadi. So, I cannot finish my Ihram till I slaughter (my Hadi)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Logon ko kya hua, unhone Umrah karne ke baad Ihram khatam kar diya, magar aapne apna Umrah ke baad khatam nahi kiya?" Aap ne jawab diya: "Maine apne baal jaaṭ kiye hain aur apne Hadi ko maalayen pehnayi hain. Isliye main apna Ihram tab tak khatam nahi karunga jab tak (apna Hadi) zabah na karun."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (got) his head shaved after performing his Hajj
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne apna Hajj mukammal karne ke baad apna sar munavaaya.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! Be merciful to those who have their head shaved." The people said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! And (invoke Allah for) those who get their hair cut short." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! Be merciful to those who have their head shaved." The people said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! And those who get their hair cut short." The Prophet (ﷺ) said (the third time), "And to those who get their hair cut short." Nafi` said that the Prophet (ﷺ) had said once or twice, "O Allah! Be merciful to those who get their head shaved," and on the fourth time he added, "And to those who have their hair cut short
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Aye Allah! Jinhone sar munavaaya unpar reham kar." Logon ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Aur jinhone (baal) chhote kiye?" Nabi ne farmaya: "Aye Allah! Jinhone sar munavaaya unpar reham kar." Logon ne phir kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Aur jinhone (baal) chhote kiye?" Nabi ne (teesri baar) farmaya: "Aur jinhone (baal) chhote kiye." Nafi ne kaha ke Nabi ne ek ya do baar kaha: "Aye Allah! Jinhone sar munavaaya unpar reham kar," aur chauthi baar joda: "Aur jinhone baal chhote kiye."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! Forgive those who get their heads shaved." The people asked. "Also those who get their hair cut short?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! Forgive those who have their heads shaved." The people said, "Also those who get their hair cut short?" The Prophet (invoke Allah for those who have their heads shaved and) at the third time said, "also (forgive) those who get their hair cut short
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Aye Allah! Jinhone sar munavaaya, unhe maaf kar." Logon ne pucha: "Aur jinhone baal chhote kiye?" Nabi ne kaha: "Aye Allah! Jinhone sar munavaaya, unhe maaf kar." Logon ne phir kaha: "Aur jinhone baal chhote kiye?" Teesri baar Nabi ne kaha: "Aur (maaf kar) jinhone baal chhote kiye."

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) and some of his companions got their heads shaved and some others got their hair cut short
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi aur unke kuch sahaba ne apne sar munavaae aur kuch ne baal chhote kiye.

e: Narrated Muawiya:I cut short the hair of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with a long blade
hi: Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool ke baal ek lambi chhuri se chhote kiye.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When the Prophet (ﷺ) came to Mecca, he ordered his Companions to perform Tawaf round the Ka`ba and between Safa and Marwa, to finish their Ihram and get their hair shaved off or cut short
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Jab Nabi Mecca aaye, unhone apne sahaba ko Ka'ba ka aur Safa-Marwa ka Tawaf karne, apna Ihram khatam karne, aur apne baal munavaane ya chhote karne ka hukum diya.

e: Narrated Nafi' that Ibn 'Umar (ra) performed only one Tawaf. He would take an afternoon nap and then return to Mina. That was on the day of Nahr (slaughtering)
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne sirf ek Tawaf kiya. Woh dopahar ki neend lete aur phir Mina wapas jate. Yeh Yaum-un-Nahr (qurbani ke din) hua.

e: Narrated `Aisha:We performed Hajj with the Prophet (ﷺ) and performed Tawaf-al-ifada on the Day of Nahr (slaughtering). Safiya got her menses and the Prophet desired from her what a husband desires from his wife. I said to him, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! She is having her menses." He said, "Is she going to detain us?" We informed him that she had performed Tawaf-al-Ifada on the Day of Nahr. He said, "(Then you can) depart
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Humne Nabi ke saath Hajj kiya aur Yaum-un-Nahr ke din Tawaf-al-Ifada kiya. Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko haiz aaya aur Nabi ne unse woh chaahte hue jo shohar biwi se chaahtaa hai (paas aana chaha). Maine unse kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Unhe haiz hai." Aap ne pucha: "Kya woh humein rok legi?" Humne unhe bataya ke unhone Yaum-un-Nahr ke din Tawaf-al-Ifada kar liya hai. Aap ne kaha: "(To tum) chal sakte ho."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) was asked about the slaughtering, shaving (of the head), and the doing of Rami before or after the due times. He said, "There is no harm in that
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi se zabah, sar munavaane, aur Rami ke waqt se pehle ya baad karne ke baare mein pucha gaya. Aap ne kaha: "Isme koi harj nahi."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) was asked (as regards the ceremonies of Hajj) at Mina on the Day of Nahr and he replied that there was no harm. Then a man said to him, "I got my head shaved before slaughtering." He replied, "Slaughter (now) and there is no harm in it." (Another) man said, "I did the Rami (of the Jimar) after midday." The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "There was no harm in it
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi se (Mina mein, Yaum-un-Nahr ke din, Hajj ki rasmon ke baare mein) pucha gaya, aur unhone jawab diya ke koi harj nahi. Phir ek shaks ne unse kaha: "Maine zabah se pehle apna sar munavaaya." Nabi ne jawab diya: "(Ab) zabah karo, koi harj nahi." (Doosre) shaks ne kaha: "Maine dopahar ke baad Rami kiya." Nabi ne jawab diya: "Koi harj nahi tha."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stopped (for a while near the Jimar at Mina) during his last Hajj and the people started asking him questions. A man said, "Ignorantly I got my head shaved before slaughtering." The Prophet replied, "Slaughter (now) and there is no harm in it." Another man said, "Unknowingly I slaughtered the Hadi before doing the Rami." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do Rami now and there is no harm in it." So, on that day, when the Prophet (ﷺ) was asked about anything (about the ceremonies of Hajj) done before or after (its stated time) his reply was, "Do it (now) and there is no harm
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool apne aakhri Hajj mein (Mina ke Jamaraat ke qareeb) thodi der ruke aur log unse sawaal karne lage. Ek shaks ne kaha: "Anjaane mein maine apna sar zabah se pehle munavaaya." Nabi ne jawab diya: "(Ab) zabah karo, koi harj nahi." Doosre shaks ne kaha: "Anjaane mein maine Rami se pehle Hadi zabah kiya." Nabi ne kaha: "Ab Rami karo, koi harj nahi." Isliye us din, jab bhi Nabi se kisi cheez ke baare mein (waqt se pehle ya baad hone ke baare mein) pucha gaya, Aap ka jawab hota: "(Ab) karo, koi harj nahi."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr bin Al-`As:I witnessed the Prophet (ﷺ) when he was delivering the sermon on the Day of Nahr. A man stood up and said, "I thought that such and such was to be done before such and such. I got my hair shaved before slaughtering." (Another said), "I slaughtered the Hadi before doing the Rami." So, the people asked about many similar things. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do it (now) and there is no harm in all these cases." Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) was asked about anything on that day, he replied, "Do it (now) and there is no harm in it
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Aas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Maine Nabi ko dekha Yaum-un-Nahr ke din khutba dete huye. Ek shaks khada hua aur kaha: "Maine socha falaan cheez falaan cheez se pehle karni chahiye. Maine apna sar zabah se pehle munavaaya." (Doosre ne kaha), "Maine Hadi Rami se pehle zabah ki." Isliye logon ne bahut si isi tarah ki cheezon ke baare mein pucha. Nabi ne kaha: "(Ab) karo, in sab surtoon mein koi harj nahi." Jab bhi Nabi se us din kisi cheez ke baare mein pucha gaya, Aap ka jawab tha: "(Ab) karo, koi harj nahi."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr bin Al-`As:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stopped while on his she-camel (the sub-narrator then narrated the Hadith as above, i.e)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Aas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool apni oontni par ruke (doosre raawi ne aage waisi hi riwayat ki jaisi upar).

e: Narrated `Ikrima:Ibn `Abbas said: "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) delivered a sermon on the Day of Nahr, and said, 'O people! (Tell me) what is the day today?' The people replied, 'It is the forbidden (sacred) day.' He asked again, 'What town is this?' They replied, 'It is the forbidden (Sacred) town.' He asked, 'Which month is this?' They replied, 'It is the forbidden (Sacred) month.' He said, 'No doubt! Your blood, your properties, and your honor are sacred to one another like the sanctity of this day of yours, in this (sacred) town (Mecca) of yours, in this month of yours.' The Prophet (ﷺ) repeated his statement again and again. After that he raised his head and said, 'O Allah! Haven't conveyed (Your Message) to them'. Haven't I conveyed Your Message to them?' " Ibn `Abbas added, "By Him in Whose Hand my soul is, the following was his will (Prophet's will) to his followers:--It is incumbent upon those who are present to convey this information to those who are absent Beware don't renegade (as) disbelievers (turn into infidels) after me, Striking the necks (cutting the throats) of one another
hi: Ikrima bataate hain: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool ne Yaum-un-Nahr ke din khutba diya aur kaha: 'Aye logon! (Batao) aaj kaunsa din hai?' Logon ne jawab diya: 'Yeh haram (muqaddas) din hai.' Aap ne phir pucha: 'Yeh kaunsa shehar hai?' Unhone jawab diya: 'Yeh haram shehar hai.' Aap ne pucha: 'Yeh kaunsa mahina hai?' Unhone jawab diya: 'Yeh haram mahina hai.' Aap ne farmaya: 'Beshak, tumhara khoon, tumhara maal, aur tumhari izzat ek-doosre ke liye utni hi muqaddas hai jitni is din ki, is shehar mein, is mahine mein.' Nabi ne yeh baat baar-baar dohrayi. Phir apna sar utha kar kaha: 'Aye Allah! Kya maine unhe (paighaam) pahuncha diya? Kya maine unhe pahuncha diya?'" Ibn Abbas ne joda: "Us zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, yehi Nabi ki apni ummat ke liye wasiyat thi: Jo maujood hain unhe woh baat un tak pahunchani chahiye jo maujood nahi. Khabardar! Mere baad kaafir na ban jaana ek-doosre ki gardanein kaatte hue."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) delivering a sermon at `Arafat
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Maine Nabi ko Arafat mein khutba dete suna.

e: Narrated Abu Bakra:The Prophet (ﷺ) delivered to us a sermon on the Day of Nahr. He said, "Do you know what is the day today?" We said, "Allah and His Apostle know better." He remained silent till we thought that he might give that day another name. He said, "Isn't it the Day of Nahr?" We said, "It is." He further asked, "Which month is this?" We said, "Allah and His Apostle know better." He remained silent till we thought that he might give it another name. He then said, "Isn't it the month of Dhul-Hijja?" We replied: "Yes! It is." He further asked, "What town is this?" We replied, "Allah and His Apostle know it better." He remained silent till we thought that he might give it another name. He then said, "Isn't it the forbidden (Sacred) town (of Mecca)?" We said, "Yes. It is." He said, "No doubt, your blood and your properties are sacred to one another like the sanctity of this day of yours, in this month of yours, in this town of yours, till the day you meet your Lord. No doubt! Haven't I conveyed Allah's message to you? They said, "Yes." He said, "O Allah! Be witness. So it is incumbent upon those who are present to convey it (this information) to those who are absent because the informed one might comprehend it (what I have said) better than the present audience, who will convey it to him. Beware! Do not renegade (as) disbelievers after me by striking the necks (cutting the throats) of one another
hi: Abu Bakra (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne humein Yaum-un-Nahr ke din khutba diya. Aap ne pucha: "Kya tumhe pata hai aaj kaunsa din hai?" Humne kaha: "Allah aur uske Rasool behtar jaante hain." Aap khamosh rahe yahan tak ke humein laga Aap iska koi doosra naam denge. Aap ne kaha: "Kya yeh Yaum-un-Nahr nahi?" Humne kaha: "Haan, yehi hai." Aap ne phir pucha: "Yeh kaunsa mahina hai?" Humne kaha: "Allah aur uske Rasool behtar jaante hain." Aap khamosh rahe yahan tak ke humein laga Aap iska koi doosra naam denge. Aap ne kaha: "Kya yeh Zul-Hijja ka mahina nahi?" Humne jawab diya: "Haan, yehi hai." Aap ne phir pucha: "Yeh kaunsa shehar hai?" Humne kaha: "Allah aur uske Rasool behtar jaante hain." Aap khamosh rahe yahan tak ke humein laga Aap iska koi doosra naam denge. Aap ne kaha: "Kya yeh haram shehar (Mecca) nahi?" Humne kaha: "Haan, yehi hai." Aap ne farmaya: "Beshak, tumhara khoon aur tumhara maal ek-doosre ke liye utna hi muqaddas hai jitna is din ki, is mahine mein, is shehar mein muqaddas hai, us din tak jab tak tum apne Rab se milo. Beshak! Kya maine Allah ka paighaam tum tak pahuncha diya?" Unhone kaha: "Haan." Aap ne kaha: "Aye Allah! Gawah reh." Isliye jo maujood hain unhe woh baat un tak pahunchani chahiye jo maujood nahi, kyunke jise woh baat pahunchai jaati hai woh use samajhta hai jaisa maujood sunne wale se zyada behtar, jo unhe aage pahunchate hain. Khabardar! Mere baad kaafir na ban jaana ek-doosre ki gardanein kaatte hue.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:At Mina, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do you know what is the day today?" The people replied, "Allah and His Apostle know it better." He said, "It is the forbidden (sacred) day. And do you know what town is this?" They replied, "Allah and His Apostle know it better." He said, "This is the forbidden (Sacred) town (Mecca). And do you know which month is this?" The people replied, "Allah and His Apostle know it better." He said, "This is the forbidden (sacred) month." The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "No doubt, Allah made your blood, your properties, and your honor sacred to one another like the sanctity of this day of yours in this month of yours in this town of yours." Narrated Ibn `Umar: On the Day of Nahr (10th of Dhul-Hijja), the Prophet (ﷺ) stood in between the Jamrat during his Hajj which he performed (as in the previous Hadith) and said, "This is the greatest Day (i.e. 10th of Dhul-Hijjah)." The Prophet (ﷺ) started saying repeatedly, "O Allah! Be Witness (I have conveyed Your Message)." He then bade the people farewell. The people said, "This is Hajjat-al-Wada
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Mina mein, Nabi ne kaha: "Kya tumhe pata hai aaj kaunsa din hai?" Logon ne jawab diya: "Allah aur uske Rasool behtar jaante hain." Aap ne kaha: "Yeh haram din hai. Aur kya tumhe pata hai yeh kaunsa shehar hai?" Unhone jawab diya: "Allah aur uske Rasool behtar jaante hain." Aap ne kaha: "Yeh haram shehar (Mecca) hai. Aur kya tumhe pata hai yeh kaunsa mahina hai?" Logon ne jawab diya: "Allah aur uske Rasool behtar jaante hain." Aap ne kaha: "Yeh haram mahina hai." Nabi ne joda: "Beshak, Allah ne tumhara khoon, tumhara maal, aur tumhari izzat ek-doosre ke liye utni hi muqaddas banayi hai jitni is din ki, is mahine mein, is shehar mein." Ibn Umar bataate hain: Yaum-un-Nahr (10 Zul-Hijja) ke din, apni Hajj ki rasmon ke dauran, Nabi Jamaraat ke beech khade hue aur kaha: "Yeh sabse azeem din hai (yaani 10 Zul-Hijja)." Nabi baar-baar kehte rahe: "Aye Allah! Gawah reh." Phir unhone logon se raksat li. Log kehne lage: "Yeh Hajjatul Wida hai."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) permitted the people who provided the pilgrims with water to stay at Mecca during the nights of Mina
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne un logon ko jo Hajjiyon ko paani muhaiya karate, Mina ki raaton mein Mecca mein rehne ki ijazat di.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:That the Prophet (ﷺ) allowed people who provided the pilgrims with water to stay at Mecca during the nights of Mina
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne un logon ko jo Hajjiyon ko paani dete, Mina ki raaton mein Mecca mein thehrne ki ijazat di.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Al-Abbas asked the permission from the Prophet (ﷺ) to stay at Mecca during the nights of Mina in order to provide water to the people, so the Prophet (ﷺ) allowed him
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Al-Abbas ne Nabi se Mina ki raaton mein Mecca mein logon ko paani muhaiya karne ke liye rehne ki ijazat maangi, isliye Nabi ne unhe ijazat di.

e: Narrated Wabra:I asked Ibn `Umar, "When should I do the Rami of the Jimar?" He replied, "When your leader does that." I asked him again the same question. He replied, "We used to wait till the sun declined and then we would do the Rami (i.e. on the 11th and 12th of Dhul-Hijja)
hi: Wabra bataate hain: Maine Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha: "Rami-e-Jimar kab karni chahiye?" Unhone jawab diya: "Jab tumhara sardar kare." Maine unse dobara wahi sawaal pucha. Unhone jawab diya: "Hum suraj dhalne tak intezar karte the, phir Rami karte the (yaani 11-12 Zul-Hijja ko)."

e: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin Yazid:`Abdullah, did the Rami from the middle of the valley. So, I said, "O, Abu `Abdur-Rahman! Some people do the Rami (of the Jamra) from above it (i.e. from the top of the valley)." He said, "By Him except whom none has the right to be worshipped, this is the place from where the one on whom Surat-al-Baqara was revealed (i.e. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)) did the Rami
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Yazid bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne wadi ke beech se Rami ki. Maine kaha: "Aye Abu Abdur-Rahman! Kuch log Jamra ki Rami uske oopar se karte hain (yaani wadi ki chotti se)." Unhone kaha: "Us zaat ki qasam jiske siwa koi mabood nahi, yehi woh jagah hai jahan se woh shaks jinpar Surah Al-Baqarah nazil hui (yaani Allah ke Rasool) ne Rami ki thi."

e: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin Yazid:When `Abdullah, reached the big Jamra (i.e. Jamrat-ul-Aqaba) he kept the Ka`ba on the left side and Mina on his right side and threw seven pebbles (at the Jamra) and said, "The one on whom Surat-al- Baqara was revealed (i.e. the Prophet) had done the Rami similarly
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Yazid bataate hain: Jab Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bade Jamra (yaani Jamrat-ul-Aqaba) tak pahunche, unhone Ka'ba ko apni baayi taraf aur Mina ko dahini taraf rakhkar saat kanker maare aur kaha: "Woh shaks jinpar Surah Al-Baqarah nazil hui (yaani Nabi), unhone isi tarah Rami ki thi."

e: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin Yazid:I performed Hajj with Ibn Mas`ud , and saw him doing Rami of the big Jamra (Jamrat-ul-Aqaba) with seven small pebbles, keeping the Ka`ba on his left side and Mina on his right. He then said, "This is the place where the one on whom Surat-al-Baqara was revealed (i.e. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ) stood
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Yazid bataate hain: Maine Ibn Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath Hajj kiya, aur unhe bade Jamra (Jamrat-ul-Aqaba) ki Rami saat chhoṭe kankaron se karte dekha, Ka'ba ko baayi taraf aur Mina ko dahini taraf rakhte hue. Phir unhone kaha: "Yeh woh jagah hai jahan woh shaks (yaani Allah ke Rasool), jinpar Surah Al-Baqarah nazil hui, khade the."

e: Narrated Al-A`mash:I heard Al-Hajjaj saying on the pulpit, "The Sura in which Al-Baqara (the cow) is mentioned and the Sura in which the family of `Imran is mentioned and the Sura in which the women (An-Nisa) is mentioned." I mentioned this to Ibrahim, and he said, `Abdur-Rahman bin Yazid told me, 'I was with Ibn Mas`ud, when he did the Rami of the Jamrat-ul-Aqaba. He went down the middle of the valley, and when he came near the tree (which was near the Jamra) he stood opposite to it and threw seven small pebbles and said: 'Allahu-Akbar' on throwing every pebble.' Then he said, 'By Him, except Whom none has the right to be worshipped, here (at this place) stood the one on whom Surat-al-Baqra was revealed (i.e. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
hi: Al-A'mash bataate hain: Maine Al-Hajjaj ko mimbar par kehte suna: "Woh Surah jisme Al-Baqara (gaay) ka zikar hai, aur woh Surah jisme Aal-e-Imran ka zikar hai, aur woh Surah jisme aurton (An-Nisa) ka zikar hai." Maine yeh Ibrahim ko bataya, aur unhone kaha: Abdur-Rahman bin Yazid ne mujhe bataya: "Main Ibn Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath tha jab unhone Jamrat-ul-Aqaba ki Rami ki. Woh wadi ke beech mein gaye, aur jab woh us darakht ke qareeb aaye (jo Jamra ke qareeb tha), woh uske saamne khade ho gaye aur saat chhoṭe kankar maare, aur har kanker maarte waqt 'Allahu-Akbar' kaha." Phir unhone kaha: "Us zaat ki qasam jiske siwa koi mabood nahi, yahan (is jagah) woh shaks khade the jinpar Surah Al-Baqarah nazil hui."

e: Narrated Salim:Ibn `Umar used to do Rami of the Jamrat-ud-Dunya (the Jamra near to the Khaif mosque) with seven small stones and used to recite Takbir on throwing every pebble. He then would go ahead till he reached the level ground where he would stand facing the Qibla for a long time to invoke (Allah) while raising his hands (while invoking). Then he would do Rami of the Jamrat-ul-Wusta (middle Jamra) and then he would go to the left towards the middle ground, where he would stand facing the Qibla. He would remain standing there for a long period to invoke (Allah) while raising his hands, and would stand there for a long period. Then he would do Rami of the Jamrat-ul-Aqaba from the middle of the valley, but he would not stay by it, and then he would leave and say, "I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) doing like this
hi: Salim bataate hain: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) Jamrat-ud-Dunya (Khaif masjid ke qareeb wali Jamra) ki Rami saat chhoṭe pattharon se karte aur har kanker maarte waqt Takbir kahte. Phir woh aage badhte yahan tak ke woh seedhi zameen tak pahunchte jahan woh der tak Qibla ki taraf mun karke haath uthakar dua karte. Phir woh Jamrat-ul-Wusta (darmiyani Jamra) ki Rami karte aur baayi taraf beech ki zameen ki taraf jate, jahan woh Qibla ki taraf mun karte. Woh wahan der tak khade hote, haath uthakar dua karte, aur wahin der tak khade rehte. Phir woh Jamrat-ul-Aqaba ki Rami wadi ke beech se karte, magar wahan rukate nahi, aur phir chale jate aur kahete: "Maine Nabi ko aisa hi karte dekha."

e: Narrated Salim bin `Abdullah:`Abdullah bin `Umar used to do Rami of the Jamrat-ud-Dunya with seven small pebbles and used to recite Takbir on throwing each stone. He, then, would proceed further till he reached the level ground, where he would stay for a long time, facing the Qibla to invoke (Allah) while raising his hands. Then he would do Rami of the Jamrat-ul-Wusta similarly and would go to the left towards the level ground, where he would stand for a long time facing the Qibla to invoke (Allah) while raising his hands. Then he would do Rami of the Jamrat-ul-Aqaba from the middle of the valley, but he would not stay by it. Ibn `Umar used to say, "I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) doing like that
hi: Salim bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abdullah bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) Jamrat-ud-Dunya ki Rami saat chhoṭe kankaron se karte aur har patthar maarte waqt Takbir kahte. Phir woh aage badhte yahan tak ke woh seedhi zameen tak pahunchte, jahan woh Qibla ki taraf mun karke der tak dua karte, haath uthate hue. Phir woh isi tarah Jamrat-ul-Wusta ki Rami karte aur baayi taraf seedhi zameen ki taraf jate, jahan woh der tak Qibla ki taraf mun karke haath uthakar dua karte. Phir woh Jamrat-ul-Aqaba ki Rami wadi ke beech se karte, magar wahan rukate nahi. Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) kahte: "Maine Allah ke Rasool ko aisa hi karte dekha."

e: Narrated Az-Zuhri:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stoned the Jamra near Mina Mosque, he would do Ramy of it with seven small pebbles and say Takbir on throwing each pebble. Then he would go ahead and stand facing the Qiblah with his hands raised, and invoke (Allah) and he used to stand for a long period. Then he would come to the second Jamra (Al-Wusta) and stone it will seven small stones, reciting Takbir on throwing each stone. Then he would stand facing the Qiblah with raised hands to invoke (Allah). Then he would come to the Jamra near the 'Aqaba (Jamrat-ul-'Aqaba) and do Ramy of it with seven small pebbles, reciting Takbir on throwing each stone. he then would leave and not stay by it. Narrated Az-Zuhri: I heard Salim bin 'Abdullah saying the same that his father said on the authority of the Prophet (ﷺ). And Ibn 'Umar used to do the same
hi: Az-Zuhri bataate hain: Jab bhi Allah ke Rasool Mina masjid ke qareeb wali Jamra ki Rami karte, saat chhoṭe kankaron se karte aur har kanker maarte waqt Takbir kahte. Phir woh aage badhte aur Qibla ki taraf mun karke haath uthakar dua karte, aur der tak khade rehte. Phir woh doosri Jamra (Al-Wusta) tak aate aur usse saat chhoṭe kankaron se Rami karte, har kanker maarte waqt Takbir kahte. Phir woh Qibla ki taraf mun karke haath uthakar dua karte. Phir woh Jamra Al-Aqaba tak aate aur usse saat chhoṭe kankaron se Rami karte, har kanker maarte waqt Takbir kahte, phir chale jate aur wahan rukate nahi. Az-Zuhri bataate hain: Maine Salim bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko yehi kehte suna jo unke waalid ne Nabi ke hawale se kaha tha. Aur Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bhi aisa hi karte the.

e: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin Al-Qasim:I heard my father who was the best man of his age, saying, "I heard `Aisha saying, 'I perfumed Allah's Apostle with my own hands before finishing his Ihram while yet he had not performed Tawaf-al- Ifada.' She spread her hands (while saying so)
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Al-Qasim bataate hain: Maine apne waalid ko, jo apne zamane ke behtareen shaks the, kehte suna: "Maine Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko kehte suna: 'Maine Allah ke Rasool ko apne haathon se khushbu lagai isse pehle ke unhone apna Ihram khatam kiya, isse pehle ke unhone Tawaf-al-Ifada kiya.'" Unhone apne haath phailaate hue yeh batayaa.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The people were ordered to perform the Tawaf of the Ka`ba (Tawaf-al-Wada`) as the lastly thing, before leaving (Mecca), except the menstruating women who were excused
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Logon ko Ka'ba ka Tawaf (Tawaf-al-Wada) sabse aakhri kaam karne ka hukum diya gaya (Mecca chhoṭne se pehle), siwaye haiz wali aurton ke, jinhe ijazat di gayi.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) offered the Zuhr, `Asr, Maghrib and the `Isha' prayers and slept for a while at a place called Al-Muhassab and then rode to the Ka`ba and performed Tawaf round it
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Zuhr, Asr, Maghrib aur Isha ki namazein padhi aur Al-Muhassab naam ki jagah thodi der aaram kiya, phir sawar hokar Ka'ba gaye aur uska Tawaf kiya.

e: Narrated `Aisha:Safiya bint Huyay, the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ) got her menses, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was informed of that. He said, "Would she delay us?" The people said, "She has already performed Tawaf-al-Ifada." He said, "Therefore she will not (delay us)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Huyai, Nabi ki biwi, ko haiz aaya, aur Allah ke Rasool ko yeh bataya gaya. Aap ne pucha: "Kya woh humein rok degi?" Logon ne kaha: "Unhone Tawaf-al-Ifada kar liya hai." Aap ne kaha: "Isliye woh (humein) nahi rokegi."

e: Narrated `Ikrima:The people of Medina asked Ibn `Abbas about a woman who got her menses after performing Tawafal- Ifada. He said, "She could depart (from Mecca)." They said, "We will not act on your verdict and ignore the verdict of Zaid." Ibn `Abbas said, "When you reach Medina, inquire about it." So, when they reached Medina they asked (about that). One of those whom they asked was Um Sulaim. She told them the narration of Safiya
hi: Ikrima bataate hain: Madina walon ne Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se ek aurat ke baare mein pucha jise Tawaf-al-Ifada karne ke baad haiz aa gaya. Unhone kaha: "Woh (Mecca se) ja sakti hai." Unhone kaha: "Hum aapka fatwa nahi maanenge aur Zaid ka fatwa chhoṭ denge." Ibn Abbas ne kaha: "Jab tum Madina pahunchoge, iske baare mein poochna." Isliye jab woh Madina pahunche, unhone (iske baare mein) pucha. Un logon mein se ek jinse unhone pucha, Um Sulaim thi. Unhone Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) ki riwayat bataayi.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:A menstruating woman was allowed to leave Mecca if she had done Tawaf-al-Ifada. Tawus (a subnarrator) said from his father, "I heard Ibn `Umar saying that she would not depart. Then later I heard him saying that the Prophet (ﷺ) had allowed them (menstruating women) to depart
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Ek haiz wali aurat ko, agar usne Tawaf-al-Ifada kar liya ho, Mecca chhoṭne ki ijazat di gayi. Tawus (raawi) apne waalid ke hawale se batate: "Maine Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko kehte suna ke woh nahi ja sakti. Baad mein maine unhe kehte suna ke Nabi ne unhe (haiz wali aurton ko) jane ki ijazat di thi."

e: Narrated `Aisha:We set out with the Prophet (ﷺ) with the intention of performing Hajj only. The Prophet (ﷺ) reached Mecca and performed Tawaf of the Ka`ba and between Safa and Marwa and did not finish the Ihram, because he had the Hadi with him. His companions and his wives performed Tawaf (of the Ka`ba and between Safa and Marwa), and those who had no Hadi with them finished their Ihram. I got the menses and performed all the ceremonies of Hajj. So, when the Night of Hasba (night of departure) came, I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! All your companions are returning with Hajj and `Umra except me." He asked me, "Didn't you perform Tawaf of the Ka`ba (Umra) when you reached Mecca?" I said, "No." He said, "Go to Tan`im with your brother `Abdur-Rahman, and assume Ihram for `Umra and I will wait for you at such and such a place." So I went with `Abdur-Rahman to Tan`im and assumed Ihram for `Umra. Then Safiya bint Huyay got menses. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, " 'Aqra Halqa! You will detain us! Didn't you perform Tawaf-al-Ifada on the Day of Nahr (slaughtering)?" She said, "Yes, I did." He said, "Then there is no harm, depart." So I met the Prophet (ﷺ) when he was ascending the heights towards Mecca and I was descending, or vice-versa
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Hum Nabi ke saath sirf Hajj ki niyyat se nikle. Nabi Mecca pahunche aur Ka'ba ka aur Safa-Marwa ka Tawaf kiya, aur apna Ihram khatam nahi kiya kyunke unke paas Hadi tha. Unke sahaba aur unki biwiyon ne (bhi) Tawaf kiya, aur jinke paas Hadi nahi tha unhone apna Ihram khatam kar diya. Mujhe haiz aaya aur maine Hajj ki sab rasmein poori ki. Isliye jab Hasba ki raat (jane ki raat) aayi, maine kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Aapke sab sahaba Hajj-Umrah dono karke wapas ja rahe hain siwaye mere." Aap ne pucha: "Kya tumne Mecca pahunchte hi Ka'ba ka Tawaf (Umrah) nahi kiya?" Maine kaha: "Nahi." Aap ne kaha: "Apne bhai Abdur-Rahman ke saath Tan'im jaao, Umrah ka Ihram baandho aur main falaan jagah tumhara intezar karunga." Isliye main Abdur-Rahman ke saath Tan'im gayi aur Umrah ka Ihram baandha. Phir Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Huyai ko haiz aaya. Nabi ne kaha: "Aqra Halqa! Tum humein rok logi! Kya tumne Yaum-un-Nahr ke din Tawaf-al-Ifada nahi kiya?" Unhone kaha: "Kiya tha." Aap ne kaha: "To koi harj nahi, chalo." Isliye main Nabi se mili jabke woh Mecca ki oonchaaiyoun ki taraf chadh rahe the aur main utar rahi thi, ya iske ulta.

e: Narrated `Abdul-Aziz bin Rufai:I asked Anas bin Malik, "Tell me something you have observed about the Prophet (ﷺ) concerning where he offered the Zuhr prayer on the Day of Tarwiya (8th Dhul-Hijja)." Anas replied, "He offered it at Mina." I said, "Where did he offer the `Asr prayer on the Day of Nafr (day of departure from Mina)?" He replied, "At Al-Abtah," and added, "You should do as your leaders do
hi: Abdul-Aziz bin Rufai bataate hain: Maine Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha: "Mujhe kuch bataiye jo aapne Nabi ke baare mein dekha, ke unhone Tarwiya ke din (8 Zul-Hijja) Zuhr kahan padhi?" Anas ne jawab diya: "Aap ne isse Mina mein padha." Maine pucha: "Aap ne Nafr ke din (Mina se wapasi ka din) Asr kahan padhi?" Unhone jawab diya: "Al-Abtah mein," aur joda: "Tumhe wahi karna chahiye jo tumhare sardar karte hain."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) offered the Zuhr, `Asr, Maghrib and `Isha' prayers and slept for a while at a place called Al-Mahassab and then he rode towards the Ka`ba and performed Tawaf (al-Wada)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Zuhr, Asr, Maghrib aur Isha ki namazein padhi aur Al-Muhassab naam ki jagah thodi der so gaye, phir Ka'ba ki taraf sawar hokar gaye aur uska Tawaf (Al-Wada) kiya.

e: Narrated `Aisha:It (i.e. Al-Abtah) was a place where the Prophet (ﷺ) used to camp so that it might be easier for him to depart
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Yeh (yaani Al-Abtah) woh jagah thi jahan Nabi apna khaimah lagaate taake unhe (Mecca se) jane mein asaani ho.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Staying at Al-Mahassab is not one of the ceremonies (of Hajj), but Al-Mahassab is a place where Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) camped (during his Hajjat-al-Wida)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Al-Mahassab mein thehrnaa Hajj ki rasmon mein se nahi, balki Al-Mahassab woh jagah hai jahan Allah ke Rasool ne khaimah lagaaya tha (unke Hajjatul Wida ke waqt).

e: Narrated Nafi`:Ibn `Umar used to spend the night at Dhi-Tuwa in between the two Thaniyas and then he would enter Mecca through the Thaniya which is at the higher region of Mecca, and whenever he came to Mecca for Hajj or `Umra, he never made his she camel kneel down except near the gate of the Masjid (Sacred Mosque) and then he would enter (it) and go to the Black (stone) Corner and start from there circumambulating the Ka`ba seven times: hastening in the first three rounds (Ramal) and walking in the last four. On finishing, he would offer two rak`at prayer and set out to perform Tawaf between Safa and Marwa before returning to his dwelling place. On returning (to Medina) from Hajj or `Umra, he used to make his camel kneel down at Al-Batha which is at Dhul-Hulaifa, the place where the Prophet used to make his camel kneel down
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) do Thaniyaon (raaston) ke beech Dhi-Tuwa mein raat guzarte, phir woh us Thaniya se Mecca daakhil hote jo Mecca ke oonche hisse mein hai, aur jab bhi woh Mecca Hajj ya Umrah ke liye aate, apni oontni ko sirf Masjid (Al-Haram) ke darwaze ke qareeb bithate, phir andar jate aur Hajr-e-Aswad ke kone tak jate, aur wahan se Ka'ba ke saat chakkar shuru karte: pehli teen chakkaron mein Ramal karte aur aakhri chaar mein aam chaal se chalte. Khatam karke, woh do rakat padhte aur Safa-Marwa ka Tawaf karne nikalte isse pehle ke woh apne rehne ki jagah wapas jate. Hajj ya Umrah se (Madina) wapasi par, woh apna oont Al-Batha (jo Dhul-Hulaifa mein hai) mein bithate, wahi jagah jahan Nabi apna oont bithate.

e: Narrated Khalid bin Al-Harith:'Ubaidullah was asked about Al Mahassab. 'Ubaidullah narrated: Nafi` said, 'Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), `Umar and Ibn `Umar camped there." Nafi` added, "Ibn `Umar used to offer the Zuhr and `Asr prayers at it (i.e. Al-Mahassab)." I think he mentioned the Maghrib prayer also. I said, "I don't doubt about `Isha' (i.e. he used to offer it there also), and he used to sleep there for a while. He used to say, 'The Prophet (ﷺ) used to do the same
hi: Khalid bin Al-Harith bataate hain: Ubaidullah se Al-Mahassab ke baare mein pucha gaya. Ubaidullah ne riwayat ki: Nafi ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool, Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne wahan (Al-Mahassab mein) khaimah lagaya." Nafi ne joda: "Ibn Umar Zuhr-Asr Al-Mahassab mein padhte." Mujhe lagta hai unhone Maghrib ka bhi zikar kiya. Maine kaha: "Mujhe Isha ke baare mein koi shak nahi (ke woh bhi wahan padhte), aur woh wahan thodi der sote the." Woh kahte: "Nabi bhi aisa hi karte the."

e: Narrated Nafi':Whenver Ibn 'Umar (ra) approached (Makkah) he used to pass the night at Dhi-Tuwa till dawn, and then he would enter Makkah. On his return, he used to pass by Dhi-Tuwa and pass the night there till dawn, and he used to say that the Prophet (ﷺ) used to do the same
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Jab bhi Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) (Mecca) ke qareeb aate, woh Dhi-Tuwa mein raat guzarte subah tak, phir Mecca daakhil hote. Wapasi par, woh Dhi-Tuwa se guzarte aur wahin raat guzarte subah tak, aur woh kahte ke Nabi bhi aisa hi karte the.

e: Narrated Ibn ' `Abbas:Dhul-Majaz and `Ukaz were the markets of the people during the Pre-Islamic period of ignorance. When the people embraced Islam, they disliked to do bargaining there till the following Holy Verses were revealed:-- There is no harm for you If you seek of the bounty Of your Lord (during Hajj by trading, etc)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Dhul-Majaz aur Ukaz jahiliyat ke zamane mein logon ke bazaar the. Jab log Islam laaye, unhone wahan tijarat karna napasand kiya, jab tak yeh paak ayaat nazil hui: "Isme koi harj nahi agar tum apne Rab ka fazl (Hajj ke dauran tijarat karke) talaash karo."

e: Narrated `Aisha:Safiya got her menses on the night of Nafr (departure from Hajj), and she said, "I see that I will detain you." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Aqra Halqa! Did she perform the Tawaf on the Day of Nahr (slaughtering)?" Somebody replied in the affirmative. He said, "Then depart." (Different narrators mentioned that) `Aisha said, "We set out with Allah's Apostle (from Medina) with the intention of performing Hajj only. When we reached Mecca, he ordered us to finish the Ihram. When it was the night of Nafr (departure), Safiya bint Huyay got her menses. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Halqa Aqra! I think that she will detain you," and added, "Did you perform the Tawaf (Al-Ifada) on the Day of Nahr (slaughtering)?" She replied, "Yes." He said, "Then depart." I said, "O Allah's Apostle! I have not (done the Umra)." He replied, "Perform `Umra from Tan`im." My brother went with me and we came across the Prophet (ﷺ) in the last part of the night. He said, "Wait at such and such a place
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko Nafr ki raat (Hajj se wapasi ki raat) haiz aa gaya, aur unhone kaha: "Mujhe lagta hai main tumhe rok lungi." Nabi ne kaha: "Aqra Halqa! Kya unhone Yaum-un-Nahr ke din Tawaf kiya?" Kisi ne haan mein jawab diya. Aap ne kaha: "To chalo." (Doosre raawiyon ne bataya:) Ayesha ne kaha: "Hum Allah ke Rasool ke saath (Madina se) sirf Hajj ki niyyat se nikle. Jab hum Mecca pahunche, Aap ne humein Ihram khatam karne ka hukum diya. Jab Nafr ki raat aayi, Safiya bint Huyai ko haiz aa gaya. Nabi ne kaha: 'Halqa Aqra! Mujhe lagta hai woh tumhe rok legi,' aur joda: 'Kya tumne Yaum-un-Nahr ke din Tawaf (Al-Ifada) kiya?' Unhone jawab diya: 'Haan.' Aap ne kaha: 'To chalo.' Maine kaha: 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Maine (Umrah) nahi kiya.' Aap ne jawab diya: 'Tan'im se Umrah karo.' Mera bhai mere saath gaya aur hum raat ke aakhri hisse mein Nabi se mile. Aap ne kaha: 'Falaan jagah intezar karo.'"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "(The performance of) `Umra is an expiation for the sins committed (between it and the previous one). And the reward of Hajj Mabrur (the one accepted by Allah) is nothing except Paradise
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Umrah (ka amal) do Umron ke darmiyan hue gunahon ka kaffara ban jaata hai. Aur Hajj-e-Mabroor (Allah ke haan qubool shuda Hajj) ka ajr sirf Jannat hai."

e: Narrated Ibn Juraij:`Ikrima bin Khalid asked Ibn `Umar about performing `Umra before Hajj. Ibn `Umar replied, "There is no harm in it." `Ikrima said, "Ibn `Umar also said, 'The Prophet (ﷺ) had performed `Umra before performing Hajj.'" Narrated `Ikrima bin Khalid: "I asked Ibn `Umar the same (as above)
hi: Ibn Juraij bataate hain: Ikrima bin Khalid ne Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha Hajj se pehle Umrah karne ke baare mein. Ibn Umar ne jawab diya: "Isme koi harj nahi." Ikrima ne kaha: "Ibn Umar ne yeh bhi kaha: 'Nabi ne Hajj karne se pehle Umrah kiya tha.'" Ikrima bin Khalid bataate hain: "Maine Ibn Umar se yehi (upar wali baat) pucha."

e: Narrated Mujahid:Urwa bin Az-Zubair and I entered the Mosque (of the Prophet) and saw `Abdullah bin `Umar sitting near the dwelling place of Aisha and some people were offering the Duha prayer. We asked him about their prayer and he replied that it was a heresy. He (Urwa) then asked him how many times the Prophet (ﷺ) had performed `Umra. He replied, 'Four times; one of them was in the month of Rajab." We disliked to contradict him. Then we heard `Aisha, the Mother of faithful believers cleaning her teeth with Siwak in the dwelling place. 'Urwa said, "O Mother! O Mother of the believers! Don't you hear what Abu `Abdur Rahman is saying?" She said, "What does he say?" 'Urwa said, "He says that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) performed four `Umra and one of them was in the month of Rajab." `Aisha said, "May Allah be merciful to Abu `Abdur Rahman! The Prophet (ﷺ) did not perform any `Umra except that he was with him, and he never performed any `Umra in Rajab
hi: Mujahid bataate hain: Main aur Urwa bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) (Nabi ki) masjid mein daakhil hue aur dekha Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke rehne ki jagah ke qareeb baithe hain, aur kuch log Duha ki namaz padh rahe the. Humne unse unki namaz ke baare mein pucha aur unhone jawab diya ke yeh bid'at (naya riwaaj) hai. Phir unhone (Urwa ne) unse pucha Nabi ne kitni baar Umrah kiya. Unhone jawab diya: "Chaar baar; ek Rajab ke mahine mein." Humein unse ikhtilaaf karna napasand aaya. Phir humne Ayesha, Ummul-Momineen, ko unke rehne ki jagah mein Siwak se daant saaf karte suna. Urwa ne kaha: "Aye Um! Aye Ummul-Momineen! Kya aap sun rahi hain Abu Abdur Rahman kya keh rahe hain?" Unhone pucha: "Woh kya kehte hain?" Urwa ne kaha: "Woh kehte hain ke Allah ke Rasool ne chaar Umrah kiye aur unme se ek Rajab ke mahine mein tha." Ayesha ne kaha: "Allah Abu Abdur Rahman par reham kare! Nabi ne koi Umrah nahi kiya siwaye us waqt jab woh khud unke saath the, aur Aap ne kabhi Rajab ke mahine mein Umrah nahi kiya."

e: Narrated 'Urwa bin Az-Zubair:I asked `Aisha (whether the Prophet (ﷺ) had performed `Umra in Rajab). She replied, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) never performed any `Umra in Rajab
hi: Urwa bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se pucha (kya Nabi ne Rajab mein Umrah kiya). Unhone jawab diya: "Allah ke Rasool ne kabhi Rajab mein Umrah nahi kiya."

e: Narrated Qatada:I asked Anas how many times the Prophet (ﷺ) had performed `Umra. He replied, "Four times. 1. `Umra of Hudaibiya in Dhil-Qa'da when the pagans hindered him; 2. `Umra in the following year in Dhil-Qa'da after the peace treaty with them (the pagans); 3. `Umra from Al-Ji'rana where he distributed the war booty." I think he meant the booty (of the battle) of Hunain. I asked, "How many times did he perform Hajj?" He (Anas) replied, "Once
