hi: Qatada bataate hain: Maine Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha Nabi ne kitni baar Umrah kiya. Unhone jawab diya: "Chaar baar. 1. Hudaibiya ka Umrah, Zul-Qa'da mein, jab mushrikon ne unhe rok liya; 2. Agle saal Zul-Qa'da mein Umrah, unke (mushrikon ke) saath sulah ke muahide ke baad; 3. Al-Ji'rana se Umrah jahan unhone maal-e-ghanimat taqseem kiya." Mujhe lagta hai unka matlab Hunain ki jung ke maal-e-ghanimat se tha. Maine pucha: "Aur Aap ne kitni baar Hajj kiya?" Unhone (Anas ne) jawab diya: "Ek baar."

e: Narrated Qatada:I asked Anas (about the Prophet's `Umra) and he replied, "The Prophet (ﷺ) performed `Umra when the pagans made him return, and Umra of al-Hudaibiya (the next year), and another `Umra in Dhi-l-Qa'da, and another `Umra in combination with his Hajj
hi: Qatada bataate hain: Maine Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se (Nabi ke Umrah ke baare mein) pucha aur unhone jawab diya: "Nabi ne Umrah kiya jab mushrikon ne unhe wapas jaane par majboor kiya, aur Al-Hudaibiya ka Umrah (agle saal), aur ek aur Umrah Zul-Qa'da mein, aur ek aur Umrah jo unke Hajj ke saath juda tha."

e: Narrated Hammam:The Prophet (ﷺ) performed four `Umra (three) in Dhi-l-Qa'da except the (one) `Umra which he performed with his Hajj: His `Umra from Al-hudaibiya, and the one of the following year, and the one from Al-Ji'rana where he distributed the booty (of the battle) of Hunain, and another `Umra with his Hajj
hi: Hammam bataate hain: Nabi ne chaar Umrah kiye (teen) Zul-Qa'da mein, siwaye us (ek) Umrah ke jo unhone apne Hajj ke saath kiya: Unka Al-Hudaibiya se Umrah, aur agle saal wala, aur Al-Ji'rana se wala jahan unhone Hunain ki jung ke maal-e-ghanimat taqseem kiye, aur ek doosra Umrah unke Hajj ke saath.

e: Narrated Abu 'Is-haq:I asked Masruq, `Ata' and Mujahid (about the `Umra of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)). They said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had performed `Umra in Dhi-l-Qa'da before he performed Hajj." I heard Al-Bara' bin `Azib saying, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had performed `Umra in Dhi-l-Qa'da twice before he performed Hajj
hi: Abu Ishaq bataate hain: Maine Masruq, Ata aur Mujahid se (Allah ke Rasool ke Umrah ke baare mein) pucha. Unhone kaha: "Allah ke Rasool ne Zul-Qa'da mein Umrah kiya isse pehle ke unhone Hajj kiya." Maine Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko kehte suna: "Allah ke Rasool ne Zul-Qa'da mein do baar Umrah kiya isse pehle ke unhone Hajj kiya."

e: Narrated Ata:I heard Ibn `Abbas saying, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked an Ansari woman (Ibn `Abbas named her but `Ata' forgot her name), 'What prevented you from performing Hajj with us?' She replied, 'We have a camel and the father of so-and-so and his son (i.e. her husband and her son) rode it and left one camel for us to use for irrigation.' He said (to her), 'Perform `Umra when Ramadan comes, for `Umra in Ramadan is equal to Hajj (in reward),' or said something similar
hi: Ata bataate hain: Maine Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko kehte suna: "Allah ke Rasool ne ek Ansari aurat se pucha (Ibn Abbas ne uska naam liya tha magar Ata bhool gaye), 'Tumhe kis cheez ne humare saath Hajj karne se roka?' Usne jawab diya: 'Humare paas ek oont tha aur falaan-falaan ke baap aur unke bete (yaani uske shohar aur uske bete) ispar sawar huye aur humare liye sinchai ke liye ek doosra oont chhod gaye.' Aap ne (usse) kaha: 'Ramadan aane par Umrah karo, kyunke Ramadan mein Umrah (ajr mein) Hajj ke barabar hai,' ya isi jaisi baat kahi."

e: Narrated Aisha:We set out along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) shortly before the appearance of the new moon (crescent) of the month of Dhi-l-Hijja and he said to us, "Whoever wants to assume Ihram for Hajj may do so; and whoever wants to assume Ihram for `Umra may do so. Hadn't I brought the Hadi (animal for sacrificing) (with me), I would have assumed Ihram for `Umra." (`Aisha added,): So some of us assumed Ihram for `Umra while the others for Hajj. I was amongst those who assumed Ihram for `Umra. The day of `Arafat approached and I was still menstruating. I complained to the Prophet (ﷺ) (about that) and he said, "Abandon your `Umra, undo and comb your hair, and assume Ihram for Hajj;." When it was the night of Hasba, he sent `Abdur Rahman with me to at-Tan`im and I assumed Ihram for `Umra (and performed it) in lieu of my missed `Umra
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Hum Allah ke Rasool ke saath Zul-Hijja ke naye chaand (crescent) ke zahir hone se thoda pehle nikle aur Aap ne humse kaha: "Jo Hajj ka Ihram baandhna chahe, baandh sakta hai; aur jo Umrah ka Ihram baandhna chahe, baandh sakta hai. Agar main apna Hadi (qurbani ka janwar) na laaya hota, main Umrah ka Ihram baandhta." (Ayesha ne joda:) Isliye humme se kuch ne Umrah ka Ihram baandha aur baaki ne Hajj ka. Main un logon mein thi jinhone Umrah ka Ihram baandha. Arafat ka din nazdeek aaya aur mujhe abhi bhi haiz tha. Maine Nabi se (iske baare mein) shikayat ki aur Aap ne kaha: "Apna Umrah chhod do, apne baal khol kar kanghi karo, aur Hajj ka Ihram baandho." Jab Hasba ki raat aayi, Aap ne Abdur Rahman ko mere saath Tan'im bheja, aur maine wahan apne chhoote hue Umrah ke badle mein Umrah ka Ihram baandha.

e: Narrated `Amr bin Aus:`Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Bakr told me that the Prophet (ﷺ) had ordered him to let `Aisha ride behind him and to make her perform `Umra from at-Tan`im
hi: Amr bin Aus bataate hain: Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Bakr ne mujhe bataya ke Nabi ne unhe hukum diya tha ke woh Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko apne peechhe sawar karwaaakar Tan'im se Umrah karwaen.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) and his companions assumed Ihram for Hajj and none except the Prophet (ﷺ) and Talha had the Hadi with them. `Ali had come from Yemen and he had the Hadi with him. He (`Ali) said, "I have assumed Ihram with an intention like that of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has assumed it." The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered his companions to intend the Ihram with which they had come for `Umra, to perform the Tawaf of the Ka`ba (and between Safa and Marwa), to get their hair cut short and then to finish their Ihram with the exception of those who had the Hadi with them. They asked, "Shall we go to Mina and the private organs of some of us are dribbling (if we finish Ihram and have sexual relations with our wives)?" The Prophet heard that and said, "Had I known what I know now, I would not have brought the Hadi. If I did not have the Hadi with me I would have finished my Ihram." `Aisha got her menses and performed all the ceremonies (of Hajj) except the Tawaf . So when she became clean from her menses, and she had performed the Tawaf of the Ka`ba, she said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! You (people) are returning with both Hajj and `Umra and I am returning only with Hajj!" So, he ordered `Abdur Rahman bin Abu Bakr to go with her to at-Tan`im. Thus she performed `Umra after the Hajj in the month of Dhi-l-Hijja. Suraqa bin Malik bin Ju'shum met the Prophet (ﷺ) at Al-`Aqaba (Jamrat-ul 'Aqaba) while the latter was stoning it and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Is this permissible only for you?" The Prophet replied, "No, it is for ever (i.e. it is permissible for all Muslims to perform `Umra before Hajj)
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi aur unke sahaba ne Hajj ka Ihram baandha aur sirf Nabi aur Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas Hadi tha. Ali (Alayhis Salam) Yemen se aaye the aur unke paas bhi Hadi tha. Unhone (Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne) kaha: "Maine wahi niyyat se Ihram baandha jaisi Allah ke Rasool ne baandhi." Nabi ne apne sahaba ko hukum diya ke woh jis Ihram se aaye the usse Umrah ki niyyat karein, Ka'ba ka Tawaf (aur Safa-Marwa ka) karein, apne baal chhote karain, aur Ihram khatam karein, siwaye un logon ke jinke paas Hadi tha. Unhone pucha: "Kya hum Mina jaayein jabke hum mein se kuch ke sharmgaah (Ihram khatam karke) tapak rahe hain?" Nabi ne yeh suna aur farmaya: "Agar mujhe pehle pata hota jo mujhe ab pata hai, main Hadi na laata. Agar mere paas Hadi na hota, main apna Ihram khatam kar deta." Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko haiz aaya aur unhone Tawaf ke ilawa Hajj ki sab rasmein poori ki. To jab woh (haiz se) paak ho gayi, aur unhone Ka'ba ka Tawaf kar liya, unhone kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Aap (log) Hajj-Umrah dono karke wapas ja rahe hain aur main sirf Hajj karke!" To Aap ne Abdur Rahman bin Abu Bakr ko unke saath Tan'im jaane ka hukum diya. Isi tarah unhone Hajj ke baad Zul-Hijja ke mahine mein Umrah kiya. Suraqa bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ju'shum Nabi se Al-Aqaba (Jamrat-ul-Aqaba) mein mile jabke Aap use pathrao kar rahe the, aur kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Kya yeh sirf aapke liye jaiz hai?" Nabi ne jawab diya: "Nahi, yeh hamesha ke liye hai (yaani sab Musalmanon ke liye Hajj se pehle Umrah karna jaiz hai)."

e: Narrated `Aisha:We set out with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) shortly before the appearance of the new moon of Dhi-l-Hijja and he said, "Whoever wants to assume Ihram for `Umra may do so, and whoever wants to assume Ihram for Hajj may do so. Had not I brought the Hadi with me, I would have assumed Ihram for `Umra." Some of the people assumed Ihram for `Umra while others for Hajj. I was amongst those who had assumed Ihram for `Umra. I got my menses before entering Mecca, and was menstruating till the day of `Arafat. I complained to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about it, he said, "Abandon your `Umra, undo and comb your hair, and assume Ihram for Hajj." So, I did that accordingly. When it was the night of Hasba (day of departure from Mina), the Prophet (ﷺ) sent `Abdur Rahman with me to at-Tan`im. The sub-narrator adds: He (`Abdur-Rahman) let her ride behind him. And she assumed Ihram for `Umra in lieu of the abandoned one. Aisha completed her Hajj and `Umra, and no Hadi, Sadaqa (charity), or fasting was obligatory for her
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Hum Allah ke Rasool ke saath Zul-Hijja ke naye chaand ke zahir hone se thoda pehle nikle aur Aap ne kaha: "Jo Umrah ka Ihram baandhna chahe, baandh sakta hai, aur jo Hajj ka Ihram baandhna chahe, baandh sakta hai. Agar main apna Hadi na laaya hota, main Umrah ka Ihram baandhta." Kuch logon ne Umrah ka Ihram baandha aur baaki ne Hajj ka. Main un logon mein thi jinhone Umrah ka Ihram baandha. Mujhe Mecca daakhil hone se pehle haiz aa gaya, aur Arafat ke din tak haiz mein thi. Maine Allah ke Rasool se iski shikayat ki, Aap ne kaha: "Apna Umrah chhod do, apne baal khol kar kanghi karo, aur Hajj ka Ihram baandho." To maine waisa hi kiya. Jab Hasba ki raat (Mina se jaane ka din) aayi, Nabi ne Abdur Rahman ko mere saath Tan'im bheja. Doosre raawi ne joda: "Unhone (Abdur-Rahman ne) unhe apne peechhe sawar karwaya." Aur unhone chhoote hue Umrah ke badle mein Umrah ka Ihram baandha. Ayesha ne apna Hajj-Umrah mukammal kiya, aur unpar koi Hadi, sadqa, ya roza farz nahi hua.

e: Narrated Al-Aswad:That `Aisha said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! The people are returning after performing the two Nusuks (i.e. Hajj and `Umra) but I am returning with one only?" He said, "Wait till you become clean from your menses and then go to at-Tan`im, assume Ihram (and after performing `Umra) join us at such-and-such a place. But it (i.e. the reward of `Umra) is according to your expenses or the hardship (which you will undergo while performing it)
hi: Al-Aswad bataate hain: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Log do Nusuk (yaani Hajj-Umrah) karke wapas ja rahe hain magar main sirf ek karke!" Aap ne kaha: "Intezar karo jab tak tum haiz se paak ho jao, phir Tan'im jaao, Ihram baandho (aur Umrah karne ke baad) humse falaan-falaan jagah milo. Magar iska (yaani Umrah ka) ajr tumhare kharche ya mehnat ke mutabiq hai (jo tum ise karte hue uṭhaogi)."

e: Narrated `Aisha:We set out assuming the Ihram for Hajj in the months of Hajj towards the sacred precincts of Hajj. We dismounted at Sarif and the Prophet (ﷺ) said to his companions, "Whoever has not got the Hadi with him and likes to make it as `Umra, he should do it, but he who has got the Hadi with him should not do it." The Prophet (ﷺ) and some of his wealthy companions had the Hadi with them, so they did not finish Ihram after performing the `Umra. The Prophet (ﷺ) came to me while I was weeping. He asked me the reason for it. I replied, "I have heard of what you have said to your companions and I cannot do the `Umra." He asked me, "What is the matter with you?" I replied, "I am not praying." He said, "There is no harm in it as you are one of the daughters of Adam and the same is written for you as for others. So, you should perform Hajj and I hope that Allah will enable you to perform the `Umra as well." So, I carried on till we departed from Mina and halted at Al-Mahassab. The Prophet (ﷺ) called `Abdur- Rahman and said, "Go out of the sanctuary with your sister and let her assume Ihram for `Umra, and after both of you have finished the Tawaf I will be waiting for you at this place." We came back at midnight and the Prophet (ﷺ) asked us, "Have you finished?" I replied in the affirmative. He announced the departure and the people set out for the journey and some of them had performed the Tawaf of the Ka`ba before the morning prayer, and after that the Prophet (ﷺ) set out for Medina
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Hum Hajj ke maheenon mein Hajj ki niyyat se Hajj ki muqaddas seemaon ki taraf nikle. Hum Sarif mein utre aur Nabi ne apne sahaba se kaha: "Jiske paas Hadi na ho aur woh ise Umrah banana chahe, kar sakta hai, magar jiske paas Hadi ho, use aisa nahi karna chahiye." Nabi aur unke kuch maldaar sahaba ke paas Hadi tha, isliye unhone Umrah karne ke baad Ihram khatam nahi kiya. Nabi mere paas aaye jabke main ro rahi thi. Unhone iski wajah poochhi. Maine jawab diya: "Maine wahi suna hai jo aapne apne sahaba se kaha, aur main Umrah nahi kar sakti." Unhone pucha: "Kya baat hai?" Maine jawab diya: "Main namaz nahi padh rahi (haiz mein hoon)." Aap ne kaha: "Isse koi harj nahi, kyunke tum bhi Adam ki betiyon mein se ho, aur tumhare liye wahi likha hai jo doosron ke liye. Isliye Hajj karo aur mujhe ummeed hai Allah tumhe Umrah bhi karne dega." Isliye main karti rahi yahan tak ke hum Mina se rawana hokar Al-Mahassab mein rukke. Nabi ne Abdur-Rahman ko bulaya aur kaha: "Apni behn ko haram (seema) se bahar le jaao aur unhe Umrah ka Ihram baandhne do, aur jab tum dono Tawaf khatam kar lo, main tumhara is jagah intezar karunga." Hum aadhi raat ko wapas aaye aur Nabi ne humse pucha: "Kya tumne khatam kar liya?" Maine haan mein jawab diya. Aap ne rawaanagi ka elaan kiya aur log safar ke liye nikle, aur kuch ne Fajr ki namaz se pehle hi Ka'ba ka Tawaf kar liya, aur uske baad Nabi Madina ke liye rawana hue.

e: Narrated Safwan bin Ya`la bin Umaiya from his father who said:"A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was at Ji'rana. The man was wearing a cloak which had traces of Khaluq or Sufra (a kind of perfume). The man asked (the Prophet (ﷺ) ), 'What do you order me to perform in my `Umra?' So, Allah inspired the Prophet (ﷺ) divinely and he was screened by a piece of cloth. I wished to see the Prophet (ﷺ) being divinely inspired. `Umar said to me, 'Come! Will you be pleased to look at the Prophet (ﷺ) while Allah is inspiring him?' I replied in the affirmative. `Umar lifted one corner of the cloth and I looked at the Prophet (ﷺ) who was snoring. (The sub-narrator thought that he said: The snoring was like that of a camel). When that state was over, the Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "Where is the questioner who asked about `Umra? Put off your cloak and wash away the traces of Khaluq from your body and clean the Sufra (yellow color) and perform in your Umra what you perform in your Hajj (i.e. the Tawaf round the Ka`ba and the Sa`i between Safa and Marwa)
hi: Safwan bin Ya'la bin Umaiya apne waalid ke hawale se: "Ek shaks Nabi ke paas aaya jabke Aap Ji'rana mein the. Shaks ne ek chogha pehna hua tha jisme Khaluq ya Sufra (ek qisam ki khushbu) ke nishaan the. Shaks ne (Nabi se) pucha: 'Aap mujhe apne Umrah mein kya karne ka hukum dete hain?' To Allah ne Nabi par khaas tor par wahi nazil ki aur Aap ek kapde se dhke gaye. Main dekhna chahta tha ke Nabi par kaise wahi utarti hai. Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne mujhse kaha: 'Aao! Kya tumhe pasand aayega Nabi ko dekhna jabke Allah unhe wahi de raha hai?' Maine haan mein jawab diya. Umar ne kapde ka ek konna uṭhaaaya aur maine Nabi ko dekha jo khurraati le rahe the. (Raawi ko laga usne kaha ke khurraati oont jaisi thi.) Jab woh halat khatam hui, Nabi ne pucha: 'Umrah ke baare mein pooche wala kahan hai? Apna chogha utaar do aur apne badan se Khaluq ke nishaan dho lo aur Sufra (peela rang) saaf karo, aur apne Umrah mein wahi karo jo tum apne Hajj mein karte ho (yaani Ka'ba ka Tawaf aur Safa-Marwa ka Sa'i).'"

e: Narrated Hisham Ibn `Urwa from his father who said:While I was a youngster, I asked `Aisha the wife of the Prophet. "What about the meaning of the Statement of Allah; "Verily! (the mountains) As-Safa and Al Marwa, are among the symbols of Allah. So, it is not harmful if those who perform Hajj or `Umra of the House (Ka`ba at Mecca) to perform the going (Tawaf) between them? (2.158) I understand (from that) that there is no harm if somebody does not perform the Tawaf between them." `Aisha replied, "No, for if it were as you are saying, then the recitation would have been like this: 'It is not harmful not to perform Tawaf between them.' This verse was revealed in connection with the Ansar who used to assume the Ihram for the idol Manat which was put beside a place called Qudaid and those people thought it not right to perform the Tawaf of As- Safa and Al-Marwa. When Islam came, they asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about that, and Allah revealed:-- "Verily! (the mountains) As-Safa and Al-Marwa Are among the symbols of Allah. So, it is not harmful of those who perform Hajj or `Umra of the House (Ka`ba at Mecca) to perform the going (Tawaf) between them." (2.158) Sufyan and Abu Muawiya added from Hisham (from `Aisha): "The Hajj or `Umra of the person who does not perform the going (Tawaf) between As-Safa and Al-Marwa is incomplete in Allah's sight
hi: Hisham Ibn Urwa apne waalid ke hawale se: "Jab main jawan tha, maine Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki biwi) se pucha: 'Allah ke farmaan ka kya matlab hai: Beshak (pahad) As-Safa aur Al-Marwa Allah ki nishaniyon mein se hain. Isliye koi harj nahi agar jo Ka'ba (Mecca) ka Hajj ya Umrah kare, unke beech Tawaf (Sa'i) kare (2:158)? Mujhe (isse) lagta hai koi harj nahi agar koi unke beech Tawaf na kare.' Ayesha ne jawab diya: 'Nahi, kyunke agar aisa hota jaisa tum keh rahe ho, to ayat aisi hoti: Unke beech Tawaf na karna koi harj nahi. Yeh ayat Ansaar ke baare mein nazil hui jo but Manat ke liye Ihram baandhte the jo Qudaid naam ki jagah ke paas rakha hua tha, aur woh log Safa-Marwa ke Tawaf ko sahi nahi samajhte the. Jab Islam aaya, unhone Allah ke Rasool se iske baare mein pucha, aur Allah ne nazil ki: Beshak (pahad) As-Safa aur Al-Marwa Allah ki nishaniyon mein se hain. Isliye koi harj nahi agar jo Ka'ba (Mecca) ka Hajj ya Umrah kare, unke beech Tawaf kare (2:158).'" Sufyan aur Abu Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Hisham se (Ayesha ke hawale se) izafa kiya: "Us shaks ka Hajj ya Umrah, jo Safa-Marwa ke beech Tawaf na kare, Allah ke nazdeek na-mukammal hai."

e: Narrated Isma`il:`Abdullah bin Abu `Aufa said: "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) performed `Umra and we too performed `Umra along with him. When he entered Mecca he performed the Tawaf (of Ka`ba) and we too performed it along with him, and then he came to the As-Safa and Al-Marwa (i.e. performed the Sai) and we also came to them along with him. We were shielding him from the people of Mecca lest they may hit him with an arrow." A friend of his asked him (i.e. `Abdullah bin `Aufa), "Did the Prophet (ﷺ) enter the Ka`ba (during that `Umra)?" He replied in the negative. Then he said, "What did he (the Prophet (ﷺ) ) say about Khadija?" He (Abdullah bin `Aufa) said, "(He said) 'Give Khadija the good tidings that she will have a palace made of Qasab in Paradise and there will be neither noise nor any trouble in it
hi: Ismail bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abu Aufa ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool ne Umrah kiya aur hum bhi unke saath Umrah kiya. Jab Aap Mecca mein daakhil hue, Aap ne (Ka'ba ka) Tawaf kiya aur hum bhi unke saath kiya, phir Aap As-Safa aur Al-Marwa gaye (yaani Sa'i kiya) aur hum bhi unke saath gaye. Hum unhe Mecca walon se bacha rahe the (unke aage khade hokar) taake koi unhe teer na maar de." Unke ek dost ne unse (yaani Abdullah bin Abu Aufa se) pucha: "Kya Nabi ne (us Umrah ke dauran) Ka'ba mein daakhil hokar namaz padhi?" Unhone na mein jawab diya. Phir unhone (dost ne) pucha: "Nabi ne Khadija (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke baare mein kya kaha?" Unhone (Abdullah bin Abu Aufa ne) kaha: "(Nabi ne kaha) 'Khadija ko khushkhabri do ke unke liye Jannat mein Qasab (moti) ka ek mahal hoga jisme na koi shor hoga na koi museebat.'"

e: Narrated `Amr bin Dinar:We asked Ibn `Umar whether a man who had performed the Tawaf of the Ka`ba but had not performed the Tawaf between As-Safa and Al-Marwa yet, was permitted to have sexual relation with his wife. He replied, "The Prophet (ﷺ) arrived (at Mecca) and circumambulated the Ka`ba seven times and then offered a two rak`at prayer behind Maqam-Ibrahim and then performed the going (Tawaf) between As-Safa and Al-Marwa (seven times) (and verily, in Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) you have a good example." And we asked Jabir bin `Abdullah (the same question) and he replied, "He should not go near her till he has finished the going (Tawaf) between As-Safa and Al-Marwa
hi: Amr bin Dinar bataate hain: Humne Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha kya ek shaks, jisne Ka'ba ka Tawaf kar liya ho magar abhi Safa-Marwa ka Tawaf na kiya ho, apni biwi se humbistari kar sakta hai. Unhone jawab diya: "Nabi (Mecca) aaye aur Ka'ba ke saat chakkar lagaae, phir Maqam-e-Ibrahim ke peechhe do rakat padhi, phir Safa-Marwa ke beech Tawaf kiya (saat baar), aur beshak, Allah ke Rasool mein tumhare liye behtareen namoona hai." Aur humne Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) se (yehi sawaal) pucha, unhone jawab diya: "Woh (shaks) unke qareeb tab tak na jaaye jab tak Safa-Marwa ka Tawaf mukammal na kar le."

e: Narrated Abu Musa Al-Ash`ari:I came to the Prophet (ﷺ) at Al-Batha' while his camel was kneeling down and he asked me, "Have you intended to perform the Hajj?" I replied in the affirmative. He asked me, 'With what intention have you assumed Ihram?" I replied, "I have assumed Ihram with the same intention as that of the Prophet. He said, "You have done well. Perform the Tawaf of the Ka`ba and (the Sai) between As-Safa and Al- Marwa and then finish the Ihram." So, I performed the Tawaf around the Ka`ba and the Sai) between As-Safa and Al-Marwa and then went to a woman of the tribe of Qais who cleaned my head from lice. Later I assumed the Ihram for Hajj. I used to give the verdict of doing the same till the caliphate of `Umar who said, "If you follow the Holy Book then it orders you to remain in the state of Ihram till you finish from Hajj, if you follow the Prophet (ﷺ) then he did not finish his Ihram till the Hadi (sacrifice) had reached its place of slaughtering (Hajj-al-Qiran)
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ash'ari bataate hain: Main Nabi ke paas Al-Batha mein aaya jabke unka oont bitha hua tha aur Aap ne mujhse pucha: "Kya tumne Hajj ki niyyat ki hai?" Maine haan mein jawab diya. Aap ne pucha: "Kis niyyat se Ihram baandha?" Maine jawab diya: "Maine Nabi jaisi niyyat se Ihram baandha." Aap ne kaha: "Tumne achha kiya. Ka'ba ka Tawaf aur Safa-Marwa ka Sa'i karo, phir Ihram khatam karo." To maine Ka'ba ka Tawaf aur Safa-Marwa ka Sa'i kiya, phir Qais qabile ki ek aurat ke paas gaya jisne mera sar jooen se saaf kiya. Baad mein maine Hajj ka Ihram baandha. Main yehi fatwa deta raha Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki khilafat tak, jinhone kaha: "Agar tum Kitaab-e-Paak ki pairvi karo to woh tumhe hukum deti hai Ihram mein rehne ka Hajj mukammal karne tak, aur agar tum Nabi ki pairvi karo, to Aap ne apna Ihram tab tak khatam nahi kiya jab tak Hadi apni jagah na pahunch gayi (Hajj-al-Qiran)."

e: Narrated Al-Aswad:`Abdullah the slave of Asma bint Abu Bakr, told me that he used to hear Asma', whenever she passed by Al-Hajun, saying, "May Allah bless His Apostle Muhammad. Once we dismounted here with him, and at that time we were traveling with light luggage; we had a few riding animals and a little food ration. I, my sister, `Aisha, Az-Zubair and such and such persons performed `Umra, and when we had passed our hands over the Ka`ba (i.e. performed Tawaf round the Ka`ba and between As-Safa and Al- Marwa) we finished our Ihram. Later on we assumed Ihram for Hajj the same evening
hi: Al-Aswad bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) (Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Abu Bakr (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke gulam) ne mujhe bataya ke woh Asma ko, jab bhi woh Al-Hajun se guzarti, yeh kehte suna: "Allah apne Rasool Muhammad par barkatein utaare. Ek baar hum yahan unke saath utre, aur us waqt hum halke saaman ke saath safar kar rahe the; humare paas kuch sawari ke janwar aur thoda khaana tha. Main, meri behn (Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا)), Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ), aur falaan-falaan logon ne Umrah kiya, aur jab humne Ka'ba par apne haath phere (yaani Ka'ba ka aur Safa-Marwa ka Tawaf kiya), humne apna Ihram khatam kar diya. Baad mein humne usi shaam Hajj ka Ihram baandha."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) returned from a Ghazwa, Hajj or `Umra, he used to say Takbir thrice at every elevation of the ground and then would say, "None has the right to be worshipped but Allah; He is One and has no partner. All the kingdom is for Him, and all the praises are for Him, and He is Omnipotent. We are returning with repentance, worshipping, prostrating, and praising our Lord. He has kept up His promise and made His slave victorious, and He Alone defeated all the clans of (nonbelievers)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Jab bhi Allah ke Rasool kisi Ghazwa, Hajj ya Umrah se wapas aaate, har oonchi zameen ki taraf teen baar Takbir kahte, phir kehte: "La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, wa huwa 'ala kulli shai'in Qadir. Ayibuna, ta'ibuna, 'abiduna, sajiduna, li rabbina hamiduna. Sadaqallahu wa'dahu, wa nasara 'abdahu, wa hazamal-ahzaba wahdahu" (Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahi, woh akela hai aur uska koi shareek nahi. Saari saltanat aur saari tareef usi ke liye hai, aur woh har cheez par qaadir hai. Hum tauba karte hue wapas aa rahe hain, ibadat karte hue, sajda karte hue, apne Rab ki hamd karte hue. Allah ne apna waada sach kiya, apne bande ki madad ki, aur akele hi sab (kaafir) qabilon ko shikast di).

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When the Prophet (ﷺ) arrived at Mecca, some boys of the tribe of Bani `Abdul Muttalib went to receive him, and the Prophet (ﷺ) made one of them ride in front of him and the other behind him
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Jab Nabi Mecca pahunche, Bani Abdul Muttalib ke kuch bacche unhe lene aaye, aur Nabi ne ek ko apne aage aur doosre ko apne peechhe sawar karwaya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) left for Mecca, he used to pray in the mosque of Ash-Shajra, and when he returned (to Medina), he used to pray in the middle of the valley of Dhul-Hulaifa and used to pass the night there till morning
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Jab bhi Allah ke Rasool Mecca ke liye nikalte, Ash-Shajra ki masjid mein namaz padhte, aur jab (Madina) wapas aaate, Dhul-Hulaifa ki wadi ke beech mein namaz padhte aur wahin subah tak raat guzarte.

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) never returned to his family from a journey at night. He used to return either in the morning or in the afternoon
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi kabhi raat ko safar se apne pariwara ke paas wapas nahi aate. Woh ya to subah ya dopahar mein wapas aate.

e: Narrated Jabir:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade going to one's family at night (on arrival from a journey)
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne raat ko (safar se aane par) apne pariwara ke paas jane se mana kiya.

e: Narrated Humaid:Anas said, "Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) returned from a journey, he, on seeing the high places of Medina, would make his she-camel proceed faster; and if it were another animal, even then he used to make it proceed faster." Narrated Humaid that the Prophet (ﷺ) used to make it proceed faster out of his love for Medina. Narrated Anas: As above, but mentioned "the walls of Medina" instead of "the high places of Medina." Al-Harith bin `Umar agrees with Anas
hi: Humaid bataate hain: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Jab bhi Allah ke Rasool safar se wapas aaate, Madina ki oonchi jagahein dekhte hi apni oontni ki raftar tez kar dete; aur agar koi doosra janwar hota, tab bhi woh usse tez chalaate." Humaid ne bataya ke Nabi aisa Madina se apni mohabbat ki wajah se karte. Anas ne yehi riwayat ki, magar "Madina ki oonchi jagahein" ke bajaye "Madina ki deewaren" kaha. Al-Harith bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bhi Anas se sehmat hain.

e: Narrated Abu 'Is-haq:I heard Al-Bara' saying, "The above Verse was revealed regarding us, for the Ansar on returning from Hajj never entered their houses through the proper doors but from behind. One of the Ansar came and entered through the door and he was taunted for it. Therefore, the following was revealed: -- "It is not righteousness That you enter the houses from the back, But the righteous man is He who fears Allah, Obeys His order and keeps away from What He has forbidden So, enter houses through the proper doors
hi: Abu Ishaq bataate hain: Maine Al-Bara ko kehte suna: "Yeh Aayat humare baare mein nazil hui, kyunke Ansaar Hajj se wapas aane par apne gharon mein sahi darwazon se nahi balki peechhe se daakhil hote the. Ek Ansari ne aakar (sahi) darwaze se pravesh kiya aur uski isliye ninda ki gayi. Isliye yeh nazil hui: 'Yeh neki nahi ke tum gharon mein peechhe se daakhil ho, balki neik shaks woh hai jo Allah se dare, uske hukum ki itaa'at kare aur jis cheez se usne mana kiya usse bache. Isliye gharon mein sahi darwazon se daakhil ho.'"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Traveling is a kind of torture as it prevents one from eating, drinking and sleeping properly. So, when one's needs are fulfilled, one should return quickly to one's family
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Safar ek qisam ki takleef hai kyunke yeh insaan ko sahi tarah khaane, peene aur sone se rokta hai. Isliye jab kisi ki zaroortein poori ho jaayein, use jaldi apne pariwara ke paas wapas jaana chahiye."

e: Narrated Zaid bin Aslam from his father:I was with Ibn `Umar on the way to Mecca, and he got the news that Safiya bint Abu Ubaid was seriously ill. So, he hastened his pace, and when the twilight disappeared, he dismounted and offered the Maghrib and `Isha' prayers together. Then he said, "I saw that whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) had to hasten when traveling, he would delay the Maghrib prayer and join them together (i.e. offer the Maghrib and the `Isha prayers together)
hi: Zaid bin Aslam, apne waalid ke hawale se: Main Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath Mecca ke raaste par tha, aur unhe khabar mili ke Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Abu Ubaid sakht bimar hain. Isliye unhone apni raftar tez ki, aur jab shaam ki roshni ghayab ho gayi, woh utre aur Maghrib-Isha ek saath padhi. Phir unhone kaha: "Maine dekha ke jab bhi Nabi ko safar mein jaldi karni hoti, Aap Maghrib ki namaz taal dete aur donon namazein (Maghrib-Isha) ek saath padhte."

e: Narrated Nafi`:When `Abdullah bin `Umar set out for Mecca intending to perform Umra, at the time of afflictions, he said, "If I should be prevented from reaching the Ka`ba, then I would do the same as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did, so I assume the Ihram for Umra as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) assumed the Ihram for Umra in the year of Hudaibiya
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Jab Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) Mecca ke liye Umrah ki niyyat se nikle, fitno ke waqt mein, unhone kaha: "Agar mujhe Ka'ba tak pahunchne se roka gaya, to main wahi karunga jo Allah ke Rasool ne kiya tha, isliye main Umrah ka Ihram baandhta hoon jaise Allah ke Rasool ne Hudaibiya ke saal Umrah ka Ihram baandha tha."

e: Narrated Nafi`:That Ubaidullah bin `Abdullah and Salim bin `Abdullah informed him that they told Ibn `Umar when Ibn Az-Zubair was attacked by the army, saying "There is no harm for you if you did not perform Hajj this year. We are afraid that you may be prevented from reaching the Ka`ba." Ibn `Umar said "We set out with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and the non-believers of Quraish prevented us from reaching the Ka`ba, and so the Prophet (ﷺ) slaughtered his Hadi and got his head shaved." Ibn `Umar added, "I make you witnesses that I have made `Umra obligatory for me. And, Allah willing, I will go and then if the way to Ka`ba is clear, I will perform the Tawaf, but if I am prevented from going to the Ka`ba then I will do the same as the Prophet (ﷺ) did while I was in his company." Ibn `Umar then assumed Ihram for Umra from Dhul-Hulaifa and proceeded for a while and said, "The conditions of `Umra and Hajj are similar and I make you witnesses that I have made `Umra and Hajj obligatory for myself." So, he did not finish the Ihram till the day of Nahr (slaughtering) came, and he slaughtered his Hadi. He used to say, "I will not finish the Ihram till I perform the Tawaf, one Tawaf on the day of entering Mecca (i.e. of Safa and Marwa for both `Umra and Hajj)
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Ubaidullah bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Salim bin Abdullah ne unhe bataya ke unhone Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kaha jab fauj ne Ibn Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) par hamla kiya: "Aapko is saal Hajj na karne mein koi harj nahi. Humein dar hai aapko Ka'ba tak pahunchne se roka jaayega." Ibn Umar ne kaha: "Hum Allah ke Rasool ke saath nikle aur Quraish ke kaafiron ne humein Ka'ba tak pahunchne se roka, isliye Nabi ne apna Hadi zabah kiya aur apna sar munavaaya." Ibn Umar ne joda: "Main tumhe gawah banata hoon ke maine Umrah apne liye farz kar liya hai. Aur, Insha Allah, main jaunga aur agar Ka'ba ka raasta khula hoga, main Tawaf karunga, magar agar mujhe Ka'ba jaane se roka gaya, to main wahi karunga jo Nabi ne kiya tha jabke main unke saath tha." Phir Ibn Umar ne Dhul-Hulaifa se Umrah ka Ihram baandha aur kuch der chalte rahe, phir kaha: "Umrah aur Hajj ki sharten ek jaisi hain aur main tumhe gawah banata hoon ke maine Umrah aur Hajj dono apne liye farz kar liye hain." To unhone Yaum-un-Nahr (qurbani ke din) tak Ihram khatam nahi kiya, aur apna Hadi zabah kiya. Woh kahte: "Main Tawaf karne tak Ihram khatam nahi karunga, ek Tawaf Mecca daakhil hote hi (yaani Safa-Marwa ka, Hajj-Umrah dono ke liye)."

e: Narrated Nafi`:Some of the sons of `Abdullah told him (i.e. `Abdullah) if he had stayed (and not performed Hajj that year)
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke kuch bete ne unse kaha agar woh (us saal Hajj na karke) ruk gaye hote (to behtar hota).

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was prevented from performing (`Umra) Therefore, he shaved his head and had sexual relations with his wives and slaughtered his Hadi and performed Umra in the following year
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ko (Umrah karne se) roka gaya. Isliye Aap ne apna sar munavaaya aur apni biwiyon se humbistari ki aur apna Hadi zabah kiya, aur agle saal Umrah kiya.

e: Narrated Salim:(Abdullah) bin `Umar used to say, "Is not (the following of) the tradition of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sufficient for you? If anyone of you is prevented from performing Hajj, he should perform the Tawaf of the Ka`ba and between As-Safa and Al-Marwa and then finish the Ihram and everything will become legal for him which was illegal for him (during the state of Ihram) and he can perform Hajj in a following year and he should slaughter a Hadi or fast in case he cannot afford the Hadi
hi: Salim bataate hain: (Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ)) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) kahte the: "Kya Allah ke Rasool ki Sunnat (ki pairvi) tumhare liye kaafi nahi? Agar tum mein se koi Hajj karne se rok diya jaaye, use Ka'ba ka aur Safa-Marwa ka Tawaf karke apna Ihram khatam kar dena chahiye, aur har cheez jo Ihram ki wajah se haram thi uske liye jaiz ho jaayegi, aur woh agle saal Hajj kar sakta hai, aur use ek Hadi zabah karni chahiye, ya agar woh Hadi na de sake, to roza rakhna chahiye."

e: Narrated Al-Miswar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) slaughtered (the Hadi) before he had his head shaved and then he ordered his Companions to do the same
hi: Al-Miswar bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne apna sar munavaane se pehle (Hadi) zabah ki, phir apne sahaba ko wahi karne ka hukum diya.

e: Narrated Nafi`:That `Abdullah and Salim said to `Abdullah bin `Umar, "(You should not go for Hajj this year)." `Abdullah bin `Umar replied, "We set out with the Prophet (to Mecca for performing `Umra) and the infidels of Quraish prevented us from reaching the Ka`ba. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) slaughtered his Budn (camels for sacrifice) and got his head shaved
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Salim ne Abdullah bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kaha: "(Aapko is saal Hajj ke liye nahi jaana chahiye)." Abdullah bin Umar ne jawab diya: "Hum Nabi ke saath (Mecca) nikle (Umrah karne ke liye) aur Quraish ke kaafiron ne humein Ka'ba tak pahunchne se roka. Allah ke Rasool ne apni Budn (qurbani ke oont) zabah kiye aur apna sar munavaaya."

e: Narrated Nafi`:When `Abdullah bin `Umar set out for Mecca with the intention of performing `Umra in the period of afflictions, he said, "If I should be prevented from reaching the Ka`ba, then I would do the same as we did while in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ." So, he assumed the Ihram for `Umra since the Prophet (ﷺ) had assumed the Ihram for `Umra in the year of Al-Hudaibiya. Then `Abdullah bin `Umar thought about it and said, "The conditions for both Hajj and `Umra are similar." He then turned towards his companions and said, "The conditions of both Hajj and `Umra are similar and I make you witnesses that I have made the performance of Hajj obligatory for myself along with `Umra." He then performed one Tawaf (between As-Safa and Al-Marwa) for both of them (i.e. Hajj and (`Umra) and considered that to be sufficient for him and offered a Hadi
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Jab Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) fitno ke waqt Umrah ki niyyat se Mecca ke liye nikle, unhone kaha: "Agar mujhe Ka'ba tak pahunchne se roka gaya, to main wahi karunga jo humne Allah ke Rasool ki sohbat mein kiya tha." Isliye unhone Umrah ka Ihram baandha kyunke Nabi ne Al-Hudaibiya ke saal Umrah ka Ihram baandha tha. Phir Abdullah bin Umar ne iske baare mein socha aur kaha: "Hajj-Umrah dono ki sharten ek jaisi hain." Phir woh apne sahaba ki taraf mud kar kaha: "Hajj-Umrah dono ki sharten ek jaisi hain aur main tumhe gawah banata hoon ke maine Hajj bhi Umrah ke saath apne liye farz kar liya hai." Phir unhone dono (Hajj-Umrah) ke liye ek Tawaf (Safa-Marwa ke beech) kiya aur ise apne liye kaafi samjha, aur ek Hadi pesh ki.

e: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Layla:Ka`b bin 'Ujra said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him (Ka`b), "Perhaps your lice have troubled you?" Ka`b replied, "Yes! O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Have your head shaved and then either fast three days or feed six poor persons or slaughter one sheep as a sacrifice
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Layla bataate hain: Ka'b bin Ujra ne kaha ke Allah ke Rasool ne unse (Ka'b se) kaha: "Shayad tumhari jooen tumhe pareshan kar rahi hain?" Ka'b ne jawab diya: "Haan! Ya Allah ke Rasool." Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: "Apna sar munavaao, phir teen din roza rakho ya chhe zaroorat-mand logon ko khana khilaao ya qurbani ke tor par ek bhed zabah karo."

e: Narrated Ka`b bin `Umra:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood beside me at Al-Hudaibiya and the lice were falling from my head in great number. He asked me, "Have your lice troubled you?" I replied in the affirmative. He ordered me to get my head shaved. Ka`b added, "This Holy Verse:--'And if any of you is ill, or has ailment in his scalp (2.196), etc. was revealed regarding me. "The Prophet (ﷺ) then ordered me either to fast three days, or to feed six poor persons with one Faraq (three Sas) (of dates), or to slaughter a sheep, etc. (sacrifice) whatever was available
hi: Ka'b bin Umra bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool Al-Hudaibiya mein mere bagal mein khade the aur mere sar se jooen bahut zyada gir rahi thi. Unhone mujhse pucha: "Kya tumhari jooen tumhe pareshan kar rahi hain?" Maine haan mein jawab diya. Aap ne mujhe apna sar munavaane ka hukum diya. Ka'b ne joda: "Yeh paak Aayat: 'Aur agar tum mein se koi bimaar ho, ya uske sar mein takleef ho (2:196), waghera' mere baare mein nazil hui." Nabi ne mujhe teen din roza rakhne, ya chhe zaroorat-mand logon ko ek Faraq (teen Sa) (khajoor) khilaane, ya ek bhed zabah karne, jo bhi mil sake, ka hukum diya.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Ma'qil:I sat with Ka`b bin 'Ujra and asked him about the Fidya. He replied, "This revelation was revealed concerning my case especially, but it is also for you in general. I was carried to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and the lice were falling in great number on my face. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I have never thought that your ailment (or struggle) has reached to such an extent as I see. Can you afford a sheep?" I replied in the negative. He then said, "Fast for three days, or feed six poor persons each with half a Sa of food." (1 Sa = 3 Kilograms approx)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ma'qil bataate hain: Main Ka'b bin Ujra ke saath baitha aur unse Fidya ke baare mein pucha. Unhone jawab diya: "Yeh wahi khaas tor par mere maamle mein nazil hui, magar yeh tum sabke liye bhi hai. Mujhe Allah ke Rasool ke paas laaya gaya aur meri jooen bahut zyada mere chehre par gir rahi thi. Nabi ne kaha: 'Maine kabhi nahi socha tha ke tumhari takleef itni badh chuki hai jitni main dekh raha hoon. Kya tum ek bhed de sakte ho?' Maine na mein jawab diya. Phir unhone kaha: 'Teen din roza rakho, ya chhe zaroorat-mand logon ko aadha Sa khaana pratyek ko khilaao.'" (1 Sa = taqreeban 3 kg)

e: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Layla:(Reporting the speech of Ka`b bin Ujra) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw him (i.e. Ka`b) while the lice were falling on his face. He asked (him), "Have your lice troubled you?" He replied in the affirmative. So, he ordered him to get his head shaved while he was at Al-Hudaibiya. At that time they were not permitted to finish their Ihram, and were still hoping to enter Mecca. So, Allah revealed the verses of Al-Fidya. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered him to feed six poor persons with one Faraq of food or to slaughter one sheep (as a sacrifice) or to fast for three days
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Layla bataate hain: (Ka'b bin Ujra ki baat bayan karte hue) Allah ke Rasool ne unhe (Ka'b ko) dekha jabke jooen unke chehre par gir rahi thi. Aap ne (unse) pucha: "Kya tumhari jooen tumhe pareshan kar rahi hain?" Unhone haan mein jawab diya. Isliye Aap ne unhe apna sar munavaane ka hukum diya jabke woh Al-Hudaibiya mein the. Us waqt unhe Ihram khatam karne ki ijazat nahi thi, aur woh Mecca daakhil hone ki ummeed rakhte the. Isliye Allah ne Fidya ki ayaat nazil ki. Allah ke Rasool ne unhe chhe zaroorat-mand logon ko ek Faraq khaana khilaane, ya ek bhed zabah karne, ya teen din roza rakhne ka hukum diya.

e: Narrated Ka'b bin 'Ujra (ra):Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw him (i.e. Ka'b) while the lice were falling on his face
hi: Ka'b bin Ujra (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne unhe (Ka'b ko) dekha jabke jooen unke chehre par gir rahi thi.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever performs Hajj to this House (Ka`ba) and does not approach his wife for sexual relations nor commits sins (while performing Hajj), he will come out as sinless as a newlyborn child. (Just delivered by his mother)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jo bhi is Ghar (Ka'ba) ka Hajj kare aur apni biwi se humbistari na kare aur na koi gunah kare (Hajj ke dauran), woh is tarah bahar aayega jaise woh naya paida hua ho (be-gunah, jaise abhi apni maa ne janam diya ho)."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever performs Hajj to this Ka`ba and does not approach his wife for sexual relations nor commit sins (while performing Hajj), he will come out as sinless as a newborn child, (just delivered by his mother)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jo bhi is Ka'ba ka Hajj kare aur apni biwi se humbistari na kare aur na koi gunah kare (Hajj ke dauran), woh is tarah bahar aayega jaise woh naya paida hua ho, (jaise abhi apni maa ne janam diya ho)."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abu Qatada:My father set out (for Mecca) in the year of Al-Hudaibiya, and his companions assumed Ihram, but he did not. At that time the Prophet (ﷺ) was informed that an enemy wanted to attack him, so the Prophet (ﷺ) proceeded onwards. While my father was among his companions, some of them laughed among themselves. (My father said), "I looked up and saw an onager. I attacked, stabbed and caught it. I then sought my companions' help but they refused to help me. (Later) we all ate its meat. We were afraid that we might be left behind (separated) from the Prophet (ﷺ) so I went in search of the Prophet (ﷺ) and made my horse to run at a galloping speed at times and let it go slow at an ordinary speed at other times till I met a man from the tribe of Bani Ghifar at midnight. I asked him, "Where did you leave the Prophet (ﷺ) ?" He replied, "I left him at Ta'hin and he had the intention of having the midday rest at As-Suqya. I followed the trace and joined the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Your people (companions) send you their compliments, and (ask for) Allah's Blessings upon you. They are afraid lest they may be left behind; so please wait for them.' I added, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I hunted an onager and some of its meat is with me. The Prophet (ﷺ) told the people to eat it though all of them were in the state of Ihram
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abu Qatada (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Mere waalid Al-Hudaibiya ke saal (Mecca) ke liye nikle, aur unke sahaba ne Ihram baandha magar unhone nahi. Us waqt Nabi ko khabar mili ke dushman unpar hamla karna chahta hai, isliye Nabi aage badhe. Mere waalid apne sahaba ke saath the, kuch aapas mein hansne lage. (Mere waalid ne kaha:) "Maine oopar dekha aur ek jangli gadha dekha. Maine hamla kiya, chhura mara aur usse pakad liya. Phir maine apne sahaba se madad maangi magar unhone madad karne se inkaar kiya (kyunke woh Ihram mein the). (Baad mein) hum sabne uska gosht khaya. Humein dar tha ke kahin hum Nabi se pichhad na jaayein, isliye main Nabi ko dhoondhne nikla, kabhi apne ghode ko sarpat daudaya aur kabhi aam raftaar se chalaya yahan tak ke aadhi raat ko Bani Ghifar qabile ke ek shaks se mila. Maine unse pucha: 'Aapne Nabi ko kahan chhoda?' Unhone jawab diya: 'Maine unhe Ta'hin mein chhoda aur unka iraada As-Suqya mein dopahar ki neend lene ka tha.' Maine unka pichha kiya aur Nabi se jaakar mila aur kaha: 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Aapke log (sahaba) aapko apne salaam aur Allah ki barkat bhejte hain. Unhe dar hai kahin woh pichhad na jaayein; isliye kripya unka intezar karein.' Maine joda: 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Maine ek jangli gadha shikaar kiya hai aur uska kuch gosht mere paas hai.' Nabi ne logon ko woh khane ko kaha, chahe sab log Ihram mein the."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abu Qatada:That his father said "We proceeded with the Prophet (ﷺ) in the year of Al-Hudaibiya and his companions assumed Ihram but I did not. We were informed that some enemies were at Ghaiqa and so we went on towards them. My companions saw an onager and some of them started laughing among themselves. I looked and saw it. I chased it with my horse and stabbed and caught it. I wanted some help from my companions but they refused. (I slaughtered it all alone). We all ate from it (i.e. its meat). Then I followed Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) lest we should be left behind. At times I urged my horse to run at a galloping speed and at other times at an ordinary slow speed. On the way I met a man from the tribe of Bani Ghifar at midnight. I asked him where he had left Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . The man replied that he had left the Prophet (ﷺ) at a place called Ta'hin and he had the intention of having the midday rest at As-Suqya. So, I followed Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) till I reached him and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have been sent by my companions who send you their greetings and compliments and ask for Allah's Mercy and Blessings upon you. They were afraid lest the enemy might intervene between you and them; so please wait for them." So he did. Then I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We have hunted an onager and have some of it (i.e. its meat) left over." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) told his companions to eat the meat although all of them were in a state of Ihram
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abu Qatada (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain, apne waalid ke hawale se: "Hum Al-Hudaibiya ke saal Nabi ke saath nikle aur unke sahaba ne Ihram baandha magar maine nahi. Humein khabar mili ke kuch dushman Ghaiqa mein hain, isliye hum unki taraf gaye. Mere sathiyon ne ek jangli gadha dekha aur kuch aapas mein hansne lage. Maine dekha aur usse dekh liya. Maine apne ghode se uska picha kiya, chhura mara aur usse pakad liya. Maine apne sathiyon se madad maangi magar unhone inkaar kiya. (Maine ise akela zabah kiya.) Hum sabne usse khaya. Phir maine Allah ke Rasool ka pichha kiya taake hum pichhad na jaayein. Kabhi apne ghode ko sarpat daudaya aur kabhi aam dheemi raftaar se. Raaste mein maine Bani Ghifar qabile ke ek shaks se aadhi raat ko mulaqat ki. Maine unse pucha kahan unhone Allah ke Rasool ko chhoda hai. Shaks ne jawab diya ke usne Nabi ko Ta'hin naam ki jagah chhoda hai aur unka iraada As-Suqya mein dopahar ki neend lene ka tha. Isliye maine Allah ke Rasool ka pichha kiya yahan tak ke unse mil gaya aur kaha: 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe mere sathiyon ne bheja hai jo aapko apna salaam aur Allah ki rehmat-barkat bhejte hain. Unhe dar hai kahin dushman aapke aur unke darmiyan aa na jaaye; isliye kripya unka intezar karein.' To Aap ne aisa hi kiya. Phir maine kaha: 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Humne ek jangli gadha shikaar kiya hai aur uska kuch gosht bacha hua hai.' Allah ke Rasool ne apne sahaba ko woh gosht khane ko kaha, chahe sab Ihram mein the."

e: Narrated Abu Qatada:We were in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) at a place called Al-Qaha (which is at a distance of three stages of journey from Medina). Abu Qatada narrated through another group of narrators: We were in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) at a place called Al-Qaha and some of us had assumed Ihram while the others had not. I noticed that some of my companions were watching something, so I looked up and saw an onager. (I rode my horse and took the spear and whip) but my whip fell down (and I asked them to pick it up for me) but they said, "We will not help you by any means as we are in a state of Ihram." So, I picked up the whip myself and attacked the onager from behind a hillock and slaughtered it and brought it to my companions. Some of them said, "Eat it." While some others said, "Do not eat it." So, I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) who was ahead of us and asked him about it, He replied, "Eat it as it is Halal (i.e. it is legal to eat it)
hi: Abu Qatada (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Nabi ke saath Al-Qaha naam ki jagah (Madina se teen manzil ki doori par) the. Abu Qatada ki ek doosri riwayat: Hum Nabi ke saath Al-Qaha mein the aur humme se kuch ne Ihram baandha tha aur baaki ne nahi. Maine dekha kuch sathi kuch dekh rahe hain, isliye maine oopar dekha aur ek jangli gadha dekha. (Maine apna ghoda aur neza-chaabuk liya) magar mera chaabuk gir gaya (aur maine unse uṭhaane ko kaha), magar unhone kaha: "Hum tumhari kisi bhi tarah madad nahi karenge kyunke hum Ihram mein hain." Isliye maine khud chaabuk uṭhaya aur ek tibbe ke peechhe se jangli gadhe par hamla kiya aur usse zabah kiya, aur apne sathiyon ke paas laaya. Kuch ne kaha: "Ise khao." Kuch ne kaha: "Ise mat khao." Isliye main Nabi ke paas gaya jo hamse aage the aur unse pucha, Aap ne jawab diya: "Ise khao, kyunke yeh halal hai (yaani ise khana jaiz hai)."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abu Qatada:That his father had told him that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) set out for Hajj and so did his companions. He sent a batch of his companions by another route and Abu Qatada was one of them. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to them, "Proceed along the seashore till we meet all together." So, they took the route of the seashore, and when they started all of them assumed Ihram except Abu Qatada. While they were proceeding on, his companions saw a group of onagers. Abu Qatada chased the onagers and attacked and wounded a sheonager. They got down and ate some of its meat and said to each other: "How do we eat the meat of the game while we are in a state of Ihram?" So, we (they) carried the rest of the she-onager's meat, and when they met Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) they asked, saying, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We assumed Ihram with the exception of Abu Qatada and we saw (a group) of onagers. Abu Qatada attacked them and wounded a she-onager from them. Then we got down and ate from its meat. Later, we said, (to each other), 'How do we eat the meat of the game and we are in a state of Ihram?' So, we carried the rest of its meat. The Prophet asked, "Did anyone of you order Abu Qatada to attack it or point at it?" They replied in the negative. He said, "Then eat what is left of its meat
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abu Qatada (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain, apne waalid ke hawale se: Allah ke Rasool Hajj ke liye nikle aur unke sahaba bhi. Aap ne apne kuch sahaba ko doosre raaste se bheja, aur Abu Qatada unme se ek the. Nabi ne unse kaha: "Samundar ke kinare-kinare chalna jab tak hum sab saath na mil jaayein." To woh samundar ke kinare wala raasta gaye, aur jab woh chale, sab ne Ihram baandha siwaye Abu Qatada ke. Jaise woh aage badh rahe the, unke sathiyon ne jangli gadhoon ka ek jhund dekha. Abu Qatada ne unka pichha kiya aur ek maada gadhe ko zakhmi kiya. Woh utre aur uska kuch gosht khaya aur ek-doosre se kaha: "Hum shikaar ka gosht kaise khaayein jabke hum Ihram mein hain?" To hum (unhone) maada gadhe ka baaki gosht le gaye, aur jab woh Allah ke Rasool se mile, unhone pucha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Humne Ihram baandha siwaye Abu Qatada ke aur humne (kuch) jangli gadhe dekhe. Abu Qatada ne unpar hamla kiya aur ek maada gadhe ko zakhmi kiya. Phir hum utre aur uska gosht khaya. Baad mein humne kaha: 'Hum shikaar ka gosht kaise khaayein jabke hum Ihram mein hain?' Isliye hum baaki gosht le aaye." Nabi ne pucha: "Kya tum mein se kisi ne Abu Qatada ko hamla karne ya ishara karne ko kaha tha?" Unhone na mein jawab diya. Aap ne kaha: "To baaki gosht khao."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abbas:From As-Sa'b bin Jath-thama Al-Laithi that the latter presented an onager to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while he was at Al-Abwa' or at Waddan, and he refused it. On noticing the signs of some unpleasant feeling of disappointment on his (As-Sab's) face, the Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "I have only returned it because I am Muhrim
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain, As-Sa'b bin Jath-thama Al-Laithi ke hawale se: Unhone (As-Sa'b ne) Allah ke Rasool ko ek jangli gadha tohfe mein diya jabke Aap Al-Abwa ya Waddan mein the, aur Aap ne ise wapas kar diya. Jab Nabi ne unke (As-Sa'b ke) chehre par naraazgi ke asaraat dekhe, Aap ne unse kaha: "Maine ise sirf isliye wapas kiya kyunke main Muhrim (Ihram mein) hoon."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "It is not sinful of a Muhrim to kill five kinds of animals
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Muhrim ke liye paanch qisam ke janwaron ko maarna gunah nahi."

e: One of the wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) narrated:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A Muhrim can kill (five kinds of animals)
hi: Nabi ki ek biwi bataati hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Muhrim (paanch qisam ke janwaron ko) maar sakta hai."

e: Narrated Hafsa:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "It is not sinful (of a Muhrim) to kill five kinds of animals, namely: the crow, the kite, the mouse, the scorpion and the rabid dog
hi: Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "(Muhrim ke liye) paanch qisam ke janwaron ko maarna gunah nahi, yaani: kauwa, cheel, chuha, bichhu, aur paagal kutta."

e: Narrated Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Five kinds of animals are harmful and could be killed in the Haram (Sanctuary). These are: the crow, the kite, the scorpion, the mouse and the rabid dog
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Paanch qisam ke janwar nuksaandeh hain aur unhe Haram (muqaddas ilaqe) mein bhi maara ja sakta hai. Yeh hain: kauwa, cheel, bichhu, chuha, aur paagal kutta."

e: Narrated `Abdullah:While we were in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) in a cave at Mina, when Surat-wal-Mursalat were revealed and he recited it and I heard it (directly) from his mouth as soon as he recited its revelation. Suddenly a snake sprang at us and the Prophet (ﷺ) said (ordered us): "Kill it." We ran to kill it but it escaped quickly. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It has escaped your evil and you too have escaped its evil
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Mina ki ek gufa mein Nabi ke saath the jab Surah Al-Mursalat nazil hui, aur Aap ne ise tilawat ki aur maine ise unke mun se seedhe suna jaise hi Aap ne iski wahi tilawat ki. Achanak ek saanp humpar jhpata, aur Nabi ne (humein) hukum diya: "Ise maaro." Hum ise maarne daude magar woh jaldi bhaag gaya. Nabi ne kaha: "Woh tumhari buraai se bach gaya aur tum bhi uski buraai se bach gaye."

e: Narrated `Aisha the wife of the Prophet:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) called the salamander a bad animal, but I did not hear him ordering it to be killed
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا), Nabi ki biwi, bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool ne salamander (chhipkali jaisa janwar) ko bura janwar kaha, magar maine unhe ise maarne ka hukum dete nahi suna.

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Abu Sa`id Al-Maqburi:Abu Shuraih, Al-`Adawi said that he had said to `Amr bin Sa`id when he was sending the troops to Mecca (to fight `Abdullah bin Az-Zubair), "O Chief! Allow me to tell you what Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said on the day following the Conquest of Mecca. My ears heard that and my heart understood it thoroughly and I saw with my own eyes the Prophet (ﷺ) when he, after Glorifying and Praising Allah, started saying, 'Allah, not the people, made Mecca a sanctuary, so anybody who has belief in Allah and the Last Day should neither shed blood in it, nor should he cut down its trees. If anybody tells (argues) that fighting in it is permissible on the basis that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did fight in Mecca, say to him, 'Allah allowed His Apostle and did not allow you.' "Allah allowed me only for a few hours on that day (of the conquest) and today its sanctity is valid as it was before. So, those who are present should inform those who are absent (concerning this fact." Abu Shuraih was asked, "What did `Amr reply?" He said, (`Amr said) 'O Abu Shuraih! I know better than you in this respect Mecca does not give protection to a sinner, a murderer or a thief
hi: Sa'id bin Abu Sa'id Al-Maqburi bataate hain: Abu Shuraih (رضی اللہ عنہ), Al-Adawi ne bataya ke unhone Amr bin Sa'id se kaha jab woh Mecca fauj bhej rahe the (Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) se jang karne ke liye): "Aye sardar! Mujhe wahi batane dijiye jo Allah ke Rasool ne Fatah-e-Mecca ke agle din farmaya. Mere kaanon ne woh suna aur mere dil ne use samjha, aur maine apni aankhon se Nabi ko dekha jab Aap ne Allah ki hamd-sana karke kaha: 'Allah ne, na ke logon ne, Mecca ko haram (muqaddas) banaya hai, isliye jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par iman rakhta hai, use na isme khoon bahaana chahiye, na iske darakht katane chahiye. Agar koi dawa kare (behas kare) ke usme jung karna jaiz hai kyunke Allah ke Rasool ne Mecca mein jung ki, to usse kaho: Allah ne apne Rasool ko ijazat di thi, tumhe nahi.' Allah ne mujhe us din (Fatah ke din) sirf kuch ghanton ke liye ijazat di thi, aur aaj iski muqaddasi waisi hi valid hai jaisi pehle thi. Isliye jo maujood hain unhe woh baat un tak pahunchani chahiye jo maujood nahi." Abu Shuraih se pucha gaya: "Amr ne kya jawab diya?" Unhone kaha: (Amr ne kaha) "Aye Abu Shuraih! Mujhe is baare mein tumse zyada pata hai. Mecca kisi gunahgaar, qatil ya chor ko panah nahi deta."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:"The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Allah has made Mecca, a sanctuary, so it was a sanctuary before me and will continue to be a sanctuary after me. It was made legal for me (i.e. I was allowed to fight in it) for a few hours of a day. It is not allowed to uproot its shrubs or to cut its trees, or to chase (or disturb) its game, or to pick up its luqata (fallen things) except by a person who would announce that (what he has found) publicly.' Al-`Abbas said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Except Al-Idhkhir (a kind of grass) (for it is used) by our goldsmiths and for our graves.' The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, 'Except Al-Idhkhir.' " `Ikrima said, 'Do you know what "chasing or disturbing" the game means? It means driving it out of the shade to occupy its place
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Allah ne Mecca ko haram banaya, isliye yeh mujhse pehle bhi haram tha aur mere baad bhi haram rahega. Yeh mere liye ek din ke kuch ghanton ke liye halal ki gayi (yaani mujhe usme jung karne ki ijazat mili). Isse kaante wali jhaadiyan ukhadna, darakht kaatna, iske shikaar ka picha karna, ya iski giri hui cheezein (luqata) uṭhaana jaiz nahi, siwaye us shaks ke jo isse aam elaan kare." Al-Abbas ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Siwaye Al-Idhkhir ke (kyunke woh humare sunaron aur humari qabron ke liye istemal hota hai)." Nabi ne phir kaha: "Siwaye Al-Idhkhir ke." Ikrima ne kaha: "Kya tumhe pata hai 'shikaar ka picha karna' ka kya matlab hai? Iska matlab hai use saaye se bahar nikaal kar uski jagah lena."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:On the day of the conquest of Mecca, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There is no more emigration (from Mecca) but Jihad and intentions, and whenever you are called for Jihad, you should go immediately. No doubt, Allah has made this place (Mecca) a sanctuary since the creation of the heavens and the earth and will remain a sanctuary till the Day of Resurrection as Allah has ordained its sanctity. Fighting was not permissible in it for anyone before me, and even for me it was allowed only for a portion of a day. So, it is a sanctuary with Allah's sanctity till the Day of Resurrection. Its thorns should not be uprooted and its game should not be chased; and its luqata (fallen things) should not be picked up except by one who would announce that publicly, and its vegetation (grass etc.) should not be cut." Al-`Abbas said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Except Al-Idhkhir, (for it is used by their blacksmiths and for their domestic purposes)." So, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Except Al-Idhkhir
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Fatah-e-Mecca ke din, Nabi ne kaha: "Ab hijrat (Mecca se) nahi hai balki sirf Jihad aur niyyat hai, aur jab bhi tumhe Jihad ke liye bulaya jaaye, foran jao. Beshak, Allah ne is jagah (Mecca) ko aasman-zameen ki paidaish se hi haram banaya hai aur yeh Qiyamat tak haram rahega jaisa Allah ne muqarrar kiya hai. Mujhse pehle kisi ke liye isme jung karna jaiz nahi tha, aur mere liye bhi sirf din ke ek hisse ke liye jaiz hua. Isliye yeh Allah ki muqaddasi ke saath Qiyamat tak haram rahega. Iski kaante wali jhaadiyan ukhadni nahi chahiye, iske shikaar ka picha nahi karna chahiye, aur iski giri hui cheezein (luqata) sirf woh shaks uṭhaye jo isse aam elaan kare, aur iski hariyali (ghaas waghera) na kaaati jaaye." Al-Abbas ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Siwaye Al-Idhkhir ke, (kyunke woh unke lohaaron aur unke ghareloo maqasid ke liye istemal hota hai)." Isliye Nabi ne kaha: "Siwaye Al-Idhkhir ke."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was cupped while he was in a state of Ihram
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Ihram ki halat mein cupping (Hijama, khoon nikalne ka ilaaj) karwaya.

e: Narrated Ibn Buhaina:The Prophet, while in the state of Ihram, was cupped at the middle of his head at Liha-Jamal
hi: Ibn Buhaina bataate hain: Nabi, Ihram ki halat mein, apne sar ke beech mein Liha-Jamal naam ki jagah cupping karwate.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) married Maimuna while he was in the state of Ihram, (only the ceremonies of marriage were held)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) se shaadi ki jabke Aap Ihram ki halat mein the (sirf shaadi ki rasmein hui).

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:A person stood up and asked, "O Allah's: Apostle! What clothes may be worn in the state of Ihram?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Do not wear a shirt or trousers, or any headgear (e.g. a turban), or a hooded cloak; but if somebody has no shoes he can wear leather stockings provided they are cut short off the ankles, and also, do not wear anything perfumed with Wars or saffron, and the Muhrima (a woman in the state of Ihram) should not cover her face, or wear gloves
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Ek shaks khada hokar pucha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Ihram ki halat mein kaunse kapde pehne jaayein?" Nabi ne jawab diya: "Qamees, pajama, koi topi (jaise pagdi), ya hooded chogha na pehno; magar agar kisi ke paas juti na ho, woh Khuff (chamde ke moze) pehen sakta hai bashart woh takhno se neeche kaate jaayein, aur Wars ya zafraan se khushbudaar kiya hua kuch na pehno, aur Muhrima (Ihram mein aurat) apna chehra na dhaake, ya dastane na pehne."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:A man was crushed to death by his she-camel and was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who said, "Give him a bath and shroud him, but do not cover his head, and do not bring any perfume near to him, as he will be resurrected reciting Talbiya
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Ek shaks apni oontni ke neeche dab kar mar gaya aur use Allah ke Rasool ke paas laaya gaya jinhone kaha: "Ise ghusl do aur kafan pehnaao, magar uska sar na dhaako, aur uske qareeb koi khushbu na laao, kyunke woh Talbiya kahte hue uthega."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Hunain:`Abdullah bin Al-Abbas and Al-Miswar bin Makhrama differed at Al-Abwa'; Ibn `Abbas said that a Muhrim could wash his head; while Al-Miswar maintained that he should not do so. `Abdullah bin `Abbas sent me to Abu Aiyub Al-Ansari and I found him bathing between the two wooden posts (of the well) and was screened with a sheet of cloth. I greeted him and he asked who I was. I replied, "I am `Abdullah bin Hunain and I have been sent to you by Ibn `Abbas to ask you how Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to wash his head while in the state of Ihram." Abu Aiyub Al-Ansari caught hold of the sheet of cloth and lowered it till his head appeared before me, and then told somebody to pour water on his head. He poured water on his head, and he (Abu Aiyub) rubbed his head with his hands by bringing them from back to front and from front to back and said, "I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) doing like this
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Hunain bataate hain: Abdullah bin Al-Abbas aur Al-Miswar bin Makhrama (رضی اللہ عنہ) ka Al-Abwa mein ikhtilaaf hua; Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha ke Muhrim apna sar dho sakta hai; jabke Al-Miswar ne kaha ke aisa nahi karna chahiye. Abdullah bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne mujhe Abu Aiyub Al-Ansari (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas bheja aur maine unhe do lakdi ke khambhon ke beech nahate paaya, ek chadar se parda kiye hue. Maine unhe salaam kiya aur unhone pucha main kaun hoon. Maine jawab diya: "Main Abdullah bin Hunain hoon aur mujhe Ibn Abbas ne aapse yeh poochne bheja hai ke Allah ke Rasool Ihram ki halat mein apna sar kaise dhote the." Abu Aiyub Al-Ansari ne chadar pakdi aur usse neeche kiya jab tak unka sar mere saamne aa gaya, phir kisi ko unke sar par paani daalne ko kaha. Usne paani daala aur unhone (Abu Aiyub ne) apne haathon se apna sar aage-peeche ragda aur kaha: "Maine Nabi ko aisa hi karte dekha."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) delivering a sermon at `Arafat saying, "If a Muhrim does not find slippers, he could wear Khuffs (socks made from thick fabric or leather, but he has to cut short the Khuffs below the ankles), and if he does not find an Izar (a waist sheet for wrapping the lower half of the body) he could wear trousers
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Maine Nabi ko Arafat mein khutba dete suna: "Agar Muhrim ko juti na mile, woh Khuff pehen sakta hai (magar takhno se neeche kaatna hoga), aur agar Izar (kamar lapetne ka kapda) na mile, woh pajama pehen sakta hai."

e: Narrated `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked what sort of clothes a Muhrim should wear. He replied, "He should not wear a shirt, turbans, trousers, a hooded cloak, or a dress perfumed with saffron or Wars; and if slippers are not available he can wear Khuffs (socks made from thick fabric or leather) but he should cut them so that they reach below the ankles
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool se pucha gaya Muhrim kaunse kapde pehne. Aap ne jawab diya: "Woh qamees, pagdi, pajama, hooded chogha, ya zafraan ya Wars se khushbudaar kiya hua libaas na pehne; aur agar juti na mile to Khuff pehen sakta hai magar unhe takhno se neeche kaatna hoga."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) delivered a sermon at `Arafat and said, "Whoever does not get an Izar can wear trousers, and whoever cannot get a pair of shoes can wear Khuffs (socks made from thick fabric or leather)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne Arafat mein khutba diya aur kaha: "Jise Izar na mile, woh pajama pehen sakta hai, aur jise juti na mile, woh Khuff pehen sakta hai."

e: Narrated Al-Bara:The Prophet (ﷺ) assumed Ihram for Umra in the month of Dhul-Qa'da but the (pagan) people of Mecca refused to admit him into Mecca till he agreed on the condition that he would not bring into Mecca any arms but sheathed
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Nabi ne Zul-Qa'da ke mahine mein Umrah ka Ihram baandha, magar Mecca ke (mushrik) logon ne unhe Mecca daakhil hone ki ijazat dene se inkaar kiya jab tak Aap iss shart par raazi nahi hue ke Aap Mecca mein koi hathiyaar bina myaan (nyaan) ke nahi laayenge.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) fixed Dhul-Hulaifa as the Miqat (the place for assuming Ihram) for the people of Medina, and Qaran-al-Manazil for the people of Najd, and Yalamlam for the people of Yemen. These Mawaqit are for those people and also for those who come through these Mawaqit (from places other than the above-mentioned) with the intention of (performing) Hajj and Umra. And those living inside these Mawaqit can assume Ihram from the place where they start; even the people of Mecca can assume Ihram from Mecca
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne Madina walon ke liye Dhul-Hulaifa, Najd walon ke liye Qarn-al-Manazil, aur Yemen walon ke liye Yalamlam ko Miqat (Ihram baandhne ki jagah) muqarrar kiya. Yeh Mawaqit un logon ke liye hain aur unke ilawa un logon ke liye bhi jo un raaston se guzarte hue Hajj-Umrah karne ka iraada rakhte hain. Aur jo in Mawaqit ke andar rehta hai, woh jahan se chalna shuru kare wahin se Ihram baandh sakta hai; Mecca wale bhi Mecca se Ihram baandh sakte hain.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered Mecca in the year of its Conquest wearing an Arabian helmet on his head and when the Prophet (ﷺ) took it off, a person came and said, "Ibn Khatal is holding the covering of the Ka`ba (taking refuge in the Ka`ba)." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Kill him
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool Fatah ke saal Mecca mein daakhil hue, apne sar par ek Arabi khod (helmet) pehne hue, aur jab Nabi ne ise utaara, ek shaks aaya aur kaha: "Ibn Khatal Ka'ba ke gilaaf ko pakde hue hai (panah maang raha hai)." Nabi ne kaha: "Use qatl karo."

e: Narrated Ya'li:While I was with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) there came to him a man wearing a cloak having a trace of yellowish perfume or a similar thing on it. `Umar used to say to me, "Would you like to see the Prophet (ﷺ) at the time when he is inspired divinely?" So, it happened that he was inspired (then) and when the inspiration was over the Prophet (ﷺ) said (to that man), "Do in your `Umra the same as you do in your Hajj
hi: Ya'la bataate hain: Jabke main Allah ke Rasool ke saath tha, ek shaks unke paas aaya ek chogha pehne hue jisme peele khushbu ya isi jaisi cheez ka nishaan tha. Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) mujhse kahte: "Kya tum Nabi ko us waqt dekhna chahoge jab unpar wahi utar rahi ho?" To aisa hua ke unpar wahi utri, aur jab wahi khatam hui, Nabi ne (us shaks se) kaha: "Apne Umrah mein wahi karo jo tum apne Hajj mein karte ho."

e: A man bit the hand of another man but in that process the latter broke one incisor tooth of the former, and the Prophet (ﷺ) forgave the latter
hi: Ek shaks ne doosre shaks ka haath kata, magar us process mein doosre shaks ki ek daant tut gayi, aur Nabi ne doosre shaks ko maaf kar diya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:While a man was standing with the Prophet (ﷺ) at `Arafat, he fell from his Mount and his neck was crushed by it. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Wash the deceased with water and Sidr and shroud him in two pieces of cloth, and neither perfume him nor cover his head, for Allah will resurrect him on the Day of Resurrection and he will be reciting Talbiya
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Jabke ek shaks Nabi ke saath Arafat mein khada tha, woh apni sawari se gir gaya aur uski gardan usse kuchali gayi. Nabi ne kaha: "Marhoom ko paani aur Sidr se dhoo lo, aur do kapdon mein kafan do, aur na khushbu lagaao na uska sar dhako, kyunke Allah use Qiyamat ke din uṭaega jabke woh Talbiya keh raha hoga."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:While a man was standing with the Prophet (ﷺ) at `Arafat, he fell from his Mount and his neck was crushed by it. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Wash the deceased with water and Sidr and shroud him in two pieces of cloth, and neither perfume him nor cover his head, for Allah will resurrect him on the Day of Resurrection and he will be reciting Talbiya
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: (yehi upar wali riwayat dobara).

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:A man was in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) and his she-camel crushed his neck while he was in a state of Ihram and he died Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Wash him with water and Sidr and shroud him in his two garments; neither perfume him nor cover his head, for he will be resurrected on the Day of Resurrection, reciting Talbiya
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Ek shaks Nabi ke sohbat mein tha aur uski oontni ne Ihram ki halat mein uski gardan kuchali aur woh mar gaya. Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: "Ise paani aur Sidr se dhoo lo aur uske do kapdon mein kafan do; na khushbu lagaao na uska sar dhako, kyunke woh Qiyamat ke din Talbiya kehte hue uthega."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:A woman from the tribe of Juhaina came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "My mother had vowed to perform Hajj but she died before performing it. May I perform Hajj on my mother's behalf?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Perform Hajj on her behalf. Had there been a debt on your mother, would you have paid it or not? So, pay Allah's debt as He has more right to be paid
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Juhaina qabile ki ek aurat Nabi ke paas aayi aur kaha: "Meri maa ne Hajj karne ki mannat maani thi magar woh use poora karne se pehle intiqal kar gayin. Kya main apni maa ki taraf se Hajj kar sakti hoon?" Nabi ne jawab diya: "Unki taraf se Hajj karo. Agar tumhari maa par qarz hota, kya tum use ada karti ya nahi? Isliye Allah ka qarz ada karo, kyunke woh ada karne ke sabse zyada haqdaar hai."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:A woman from the tribe of Khath'am came in the year (of ,Hajjat-al-Wada` of the Prophet (ﷺ) ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! My father has come under Allah's obligation of performing Hajj but he is a very old man and cannot sit properly on his Mount. Will the obligation be fulfilled if I perform Hajj on his behalf?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied in the affirmative
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Khath'am qabile ki ek aurat aayi (Nabi ke Hajjatul Wida ke saal) aur kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Mere waalid par Allah ka Hajj karne ka farz aa chuka hai, magar woh bahut budhe hain aur apni sawari par theek se baith nahi sakte. Kya unki taraf se Hajj karne se yeh farz poora hoga?" Nabi ne haan mein jawab diya.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abbas:Al-Fadl was riding behind the Prophet (ﷺ) and a woman from the tribe of Khath'am came up. Al-Fadl started looking at her and she looked at him. The Prophet (ﷺ) turned Al-Fadl's face to the other side. She said, "My father has come under Allah's obligation of performing Hajj but he is a very old man and cannot sit properly on his Mount. Shall I perform Hajj on his behalf? The Prophet (ﷺ) replied in the affirmative. That happened during Hajjat-al-Wada` of the Prophet (ﷺ)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Al-Fadl Nabi ke peechhe sawar the aur Khath'am qabile ki ek aurat aayi. Al-Fadl usse dekhne lage aur woh unhe. Nabi ne Al-Fadl ka chehra doosri taraf mod diya. Usne kaha: "Mere waalid par Allah ka Hajj karne ka farz aa chuka hai, magar woh bahut budhe hain aur apni sawari par theek se baith nahi sakte. Kya main unki taraf se Hajj kar sakti hoon?" Nabi ne haan mein jawab diya. Yeh Nabi ke Hajjatul Wida ke waqt hua.

e: Narrated 'Abdullah bin 'Abbas (ra):Al Fadl was riding behind the Prophet (ﷺ) and a woman from the tribe of Khath'am came up. Al Fadl started looking at her and she looked at him. The Prophet (ﷺ) turned Al-Fadl's face to the other side. She said, "My father has come under Allah's obligation of performing Hajj but he is very old man and cannot sit properly on his Rahila (mount). Shall I perform Hajj on his behalf?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied in the affirmative. That happened during Hajjat-ul-Wada' of the Prophet (ﷺ)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: (yehi upar wali riwayat dobara.)

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) sent me (to Mina) with the luggage from Jam' (i.e. Al-Muzdalifa) at night
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne mujhe (Mina) saaman ke saath Jam' (yaani Al-Muzdalifa) se raat ko bheja.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abbas:I came riding on my she-ass and had (just) then attained the age of puberty. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was praying at Mina. I passed in front of a part of the first row and then dismounted from it, and the animal started grazing. I aligned with the people behind Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (The sub-narrator added that happened in Mina during the Prophet's Hajjat-al-Wada)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Main apni gadhi par sawar hokar aaya, aur tab main balig hone ke qareeb tha. Allah ke Rasool Mina mein namaz padha rahe the. Main pehli saf ke ek hisse ke saamne se guzra aur phir gadhi se utar gaya, aur janwar charne laga. Main log ke saath Allah ke Rasool ke peechhe saf mein shamil ho gaya. (Rawi ne joda ke yeh Mina mein Nabi ke Hajjatul Wida ke waqt hua.)

e: Narrated As-Sa'ib bin Yazid:(While in the company of my parents) I was made to perform Hajj with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and I was a seven-year-old boy then. (Fath-ul-Bari, p.443, Vol)
hi: As-Saib bin Yazid bataate hain: (Apne maa-baap ki sohbat mein) mujhe Allah ke Rasool ke saath Hajj karwaya gaya jabke main saat saal ka ladka tha.

e: Narrated Al-Ju'aid bin `Abdur-Rahman:I heard `Umar bin `Abdul `Aziz telling about As-Sa'ib bin Yazid that he had performed Hajj (while carried) with the belongings of the Prophet
