hi: Al-Ju'aid bin Abdur-Rahman bataate hain: Maine Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdul Aziz ko As-Saib bin Yazid ke baare mein batate suna ke unhone Hajj kiya (Nabi ke saaman ke saath le jaate hue).

e: Narrated Ibrahim's grand-father that 'Umar(ra) in his last Hajj allowed the wives of the Prophet(ﷺ)to perform Hajj and he sent with them 'Uthman bin 'Affan(ra) and 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Auf(ra) as escorts
hi: Ibrahim ke dada ke hawale se: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne apne aakhri Hajj mein Nabi ki biwiyon ko Hajj karne ki ijazat di aur unke saath Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Affan aur Abdur-Rahman bin Auf ko unki rakshak (escort) ke tor par bheja.

e: Narrated Aisha (mother of the faithful believers):I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shouldn't we participate in Holy battles and Jihad along with you?" He replied, "The best and the most superior Jihad (for women) is Hajj which is accepted by Allah." `Aisha added: Ever since I heard that from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) I have determined not to miss Hajj
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Ummul-Momineen) bataati hain: Maine kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Kya humein aapke saath jung aur Jihad mein shamil nahi hona chahiye?" Aap ne jawab diya: "Behtareen aur sabse badaa Jihad (aurton ke liye) Hajj hai jise Allah qubool karta hai." Ayesha ne joda: Jab se maine yeh Allah ke Rasool se suna, maine yeh iraada kar liya ke Hajj kabhi nahi chhodungi.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A woman should not travel except with a Dhu-Mahram (her husband or a man with whom that woman cannot marry at all according to the Islamic Jurisprudence), and no man may visit her except in the presence of a Dhu-Mahram." A man got up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I intend to go to such and such an army and my wife wants to perform Hajj." The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to him), "Go along with her (to Hajj)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Aurat ko Dhi-Mahram (yaani woh shaks jisse woh Islami sharia ke mutabiq shaadi kabhi nahi kar sakti, jaise shohar ya wo rishtedaar) ke bina safar nahi karna chahiye, aur na koi mard uski taraf jaaye jab tak Dhi-Mahram maujood ho." Ek shaks khada hokar bola: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Main falaan-falaan fauj mein jaana chahta hoon aur meri biwi Hajj karna chahti hai." Nabi ne (usse) kaha: "Unke saath jaao (Hajj ke liye)."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When the Prophet (ﷺ) returned after performing his Hajj, he asked Um Sinan Al-Ansari, "What did forbid you to perform Hajj?" She replied, "Father of so-and-so (i.e. her husband) had two camels and he performed Hajj on one of them, and the second is used for the irrigation of our land." The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to her), "Perform `Umra in the month of Ramadan, (as it is equivalent to Hajj or Hajj with me (in reward)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Jab Nabi apna Hajj mukammal karke wapas aaye, unhone Um Sinan Al-Ansariya se pucha: "Tumhe Hajj karne se kis cheez ne roka?" Usne jawab diya: "Falaan (yaani uske shohar) ke paas do oont the aur unhone ek par Hajj kiya, aur doosra humari zameen ki sinchai ke liye istemal hota hai." Nabi ne (usse) kaha: "Ramadan ke mahine mein Umrah karo, (kyunke yeh ajr mein) Hajj ke barabar hai, ya Hajj karne ke barabar hai mere saath."

e: Narrated Qaza'a the slave of Ziyad:Abu Sa`id who participated in twelve Ghazawat with the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I heard four things from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (or I narrate them from the Prophet (ﷺ) ) which won my admiration and appreciation. They are: -1. "No lady should travel without her husband or without a Dhu-Mahram for a two-days' journey. -2. No fasting is permissible on two days of `Id-ul-Fitr, and `Id-al-Adha. -3. No prayer (may be offered) after two prayers: after the `Asr prayer till the sun set and after the morning prayer till the sun rises. -4. Not to travel (for visiting) except for three mosques: Masjid-al-Haram (in Mecca), my Mosque (in Medina), and Masjid-al-Aqsa (in Jerusalem)
hi: Qaza'a (Ziyad ke gulam) bataate hain: Abu Saeed, jinhone Nabi ke saath barah Ghazwe kiye, ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool se chaar baatein sunin (ya main Nabi se yeh riwayat karta hoon) jinse mujhe bahut khushi aur tasdeeq mili. Yeh hain: 1. Koi aurat apne shohar ya Dhi-Mahram ke bina do din ka safar na kare. 2. Eid-ul-Fitr aur Eid-ul-Adha ke do dinon mein roza jaiz nahi. 3. Do namazon ke baad koi (nafil) namaz nahi (Asr ke baad suraj doobne tak, aur Fajr ke baad suraj nikalne tak). 4. Sirf teen masjidon ke liye khaas safar karo: Al-Masjid-Al-Haram (Mecca), meri Masjid (Madina), aur Masjid-al-Aqsa (Jerusalem)."

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) saw an old man walking, supported by his two sons, and asked about him. The people informed him that he had vowed to go on foot (to the Ka`ba). He said, "Allah is not in need of this old man's torturing himself," and ordered him to ride
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne ek budhe shaks ko chalte dekha, apne do beto ka sahara lete huye, aur unke baare mein pucha. Logon ne bataya ke unhone paidal (Ka'ba tak) jaane ki mannat maani thi. Aap ne kaha: "Allah ko is budhe shaks ke khud ko takleef dene ki zaroorat nahi," aur unhe sawari par jaane ka hukum diya.

e: Narrated `Uqba bin 'Amir:My sister vowed to go on foot to the Ka`ba, and she asked me to take the verdict of the Prophet (ﷺ) about it. So, I did and the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "She should walk and also should ride." Narrated Abul-Khair from `Uqba as above.:
hi: Uqba bin Amir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Meri behn ne paidal Ka'ba tak jaane ki mannat maani, aur usne mujhse Nabi ki raay poochne ko kaha. Isliye maine pucha, aur Nabi ne kaha: "Woh paidal bhi chale aur sawari bhi kare." Abul-Khair ne Uqba se yehi riwayat ki hai.

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Medina is a sanctuary from that place to that. Its trees should not be cut and no heresy should be innovated nor any sin should be committed in it, and whoever innovates in it an heresy or commits sins (bad deeds), then he will incur the curse of Allah, the angels, and all the people." (See Hadith No. 409, Vol)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Madina haram (muqaddas panah) hai wahan se wahan tak. Iske darakht na kaate jaayein, aur na koi bid'at (naya riwaaj) isme laayi jaaye, na koi gunah kiya jaaye, aur jo koi bid'at laaye ya isme gunah kare, uspar Allah, farishton, aur sab logon ki laanat ho."

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) came to Medina and ordered a mosque to be built and said, "O Bani Najjar! Suggest to me the price (of your land)." They said, "We do not want its price except from Allah" (i.e. they wished for a reward from Allah for giving up their land freely). So, the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered the graves of the pagans to be dug out and the land to be leveled, and the date-palm trees to be cut down. The cut datepalms were fixed in the direction of the Qibla of the mosque
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi Madina aaye aur ek masjid banwane ka hukum diya aur kaha: "Aye Bani Najjar! Mujhe (apni zameen ki) qeemat batao." Unhone kaha: "Hum iski qeemat sirf Allah se maangte hain" (yaani apni zameen dete waqt Allah se ajr chahte the, bina paisa liye). To Nabi ne mushrikon ki qabrein khudwane, zameen barabar karne, aur khajoor ke darakht katwane ka hukum diya. Kate hue khajoor Qibla ki taraf masjid ki deewar ke tor par lagaye gaye.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I have made Medina a sanctuary between its two (Harrat) mountains." The Prophet (ﷺ) went to the tribe of Bani Haritha and said (to them), "I see that you have gone out of the sanctuary," but looking around, he added, "No, you are inside the sanctuary
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Maine Madina ko uske do (Harrat) pahaaadon ke beech haram banaya hai." Nabi Bani Haritha qabile ke paas gaye aur (unse) kaha: "Mujhe lagta hai tum haram se bahar nikal gaye ho," magar aas-paas dekh kar unhone joda: "Nahi, tum haram ke andar hi ho."

e: Narrated `Ali:We have nothing except the Book of Allah and this written paper from the Prophet (wherein is written:) Medina is a sanctuary from the 'Air Mountain to such and such a place, and whoever innovates in it an heresy or commits a sin, or gives shelter to such an innovator in it will incur the curse of Allah, the angels, and all the people, none of his compulsory or optional good deeds of worship will be accepted. And the asylum (of protection) granted by any Muslim is to be secured (respected) by all the other Muslims; and whoever betrays a Muslim in this respect incurs the curse of Allah, the angels, and all the people, and none of his compulsory or optional good deeds of worship will be accepted, and whoever (freed slave) befriends (take as masters) other than his manumitters without their permission incurs the curse of Allah, the angels, and all the people, and none of his compulsory or optional good deeds of worship will be accepted
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Humare paas Allah ki Kitaab aur Nabi ka yeh likha hua kaghaz ke siwa kuch nahi hai (jisme likha hai): Madina haram hai Air pahad se falaan-falaan jagah tak, aur jo isme bid'at laaye ya gunah kare, ya aise bid'at karne wale ko panah de, uspar Allah, farishton aur sab logon ki laanat hai, na uska koi farz na nafil neik amal qubool hoga. Aur jo Musalman kisi ko panah de, use sab doosre Musalmanon ko mehfooz rakhna chahiye; aur jo koi Musalman ko isme dhoka de, uspar Allah, farishton aur sab logon ki laanat hai, aur na uska koi farz na nafil neik amal qubool hoga. Aur jo (azaad kiya gulaam) apne azaad karne walon ki ijazat ke bina kisi doosre ko apna hami banaaye, uspar Allah, farishton aur sab logon ki laanat hai, aur na uska koi farz na nafil neik amal qubool hoga.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I was ordered to migrate to a town which will swallow (conquer) other towns and is called Yathrib and that is Medina, and it turns out (bad) persons as a furnace removes the impurities of iron
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Mujhe ek aise shehar mein hijrat karne ka hukum diya gaya jo doosre shehron ko nigal jaayega (fatah karega) aur use Yathrib kehte hain, aur yehi Madina hai, aur yeh (buri cheezein) is tarah bahar nikalta hai jaise bhaṭTi lohe ki gandi cheezein bahar nikaalti hai."

e: Narrated Abu Humaid:We came with the Prophet (ﷺ) from Tabuk, and when we reached near Medina, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "This is Tabah
hi: Abu Humaid bataate hain: Hum Nabi ke saath Tabuk se aaye, aur jab hum Madina ke qareeb pahunche, Nabi ne kaha: "Yeh Taba hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:If I saw deers grazing in Medina, I would not chase them, for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "(Medina) is a sanctuary between its two mountains
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Agar main Madina mein charte hue hiran dekhu, main unka picha nahi karunga, kyunke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "(Madina) uske do pahaaadon ke beech ek haram hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "The people will leave Medina in spite of the best state it will have, and none except the wild birds and the beasts of prey will live in it, and the last persons who will die will be two shepherds from the tribe of Muzaina, who will be driving their sheep towards Medina, but will find nobody in it, and when they reach the valley of Thaniyat-al-Wada`, they will fall down on their faces dead
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool ko farmate suna: "Log Madina chhod jayenge iski sabse achhi halat ke bawajood, aur usme sirf jangli parinde aur shikaari janwar hi rahenge, aur aakhri do log jo marenge, Muzaina qabile ke do charwahe honge jo apni bhedon ko Madina ki taraf hankaate hue, wahan koi na payenge, aur jab woh Thaniyat-al-Wada ki wadi tak pahunchenge, woh chehre ke bal gir kar mar jayenge."

e: Narrated Sufyan b. Abu Zuhair:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "Yemen will be conquered and some people will migrate (from Medina) and will urge their families, and those who will obey them to migrate (to Yemen) although Medina will be better for them; if they but knew. Sham will also be conquered and some people will migrate (from Medina) and will urge their families and those who will obey them, to migrate (to Sham) although Medina will be better for them; if they but knew. 'Iraq will be conquered and some people will migrate (from Medina) and will urge their families and those who will obey them to migrate (to 'Iraq) although Medina will be better for them; if they but knew
hi: Sufyan bin Abu Zuhair bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool ko farmate suna: "Yemen fatah hoga aur kuch log (Madina se) hijrat karenge aur apne pariwara ko aur unko jo unki baat maanenge, hijrat karne ko kahenge, halanke Madina unke liye behtar hoga, agar unhe pata hota. Sham bhi fatah hoga aur kuch log (Madina se) hijrat karenge aur apne pariwara aur unko jo unki baat maanenge, hijrat karne ko kahenge, halanke Madina unke liye behtar hoga, agar unhe pata hota. Iraq bhi fatah hoga aur kuch log (Madina se) hijrat karenge aur apne pariwara aur unko jo unki baat maanenge, hijrat karne ko kahenge, halanke Madina unke liye behtar hoga, agar unhe pata hota."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Verily, Belief returns and goes back to Medina as a snake returns and goes back to its hole (when in danger)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Beshak, Iman Madina ki taraf laut aata hai jaise saanp apne bill ki taraf lauṭa hai (jab khatra ho)."

e: Narrated Sa`d:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "None plots against the people of Medina but that he will be dissolved (destroyed) like the salt is dissolved in water
hi: Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi ko farmate suna: "Koi bhi Madina walon ke khilaf saazish nahi karta magar woh (usi tarah) ghulnashil ho jaayega jaise namak paani mein ghulta hai."

e: Narrated Usama:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) stood at the top of a (looked out from upon one) castle amongst the castles (or the high buildings) of Medina and said, "Do you see what I see? (No doubt) I see the spots where afflictions will take place among your houses (and these afflictions will be) as numerous as the spots where raindrops fall
hi: Usama (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Nabi Madina ke ek qile (ya oonchi imaarat) ki chotti par khade hue aur kaha: "Kya tumhe woh dikhta hai jo main dekh raha hoon? (Beshak) main un jagahon ko dekh raha hoon jahan tumhare gharon ke beech fitna hoga, jaisi baarish ki boondein giren."

e: Narrated Abu Bakra:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The terror caused by Al-Masih Ad-Dajjal will not enter Medina and at that time Medina will have seven gates and there will be two angels at each gate guarding them
hi: Abu Bakra (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Al-Masih Ad-Dajjal ka khauf Madina mein daakhil nahi hoga aur us waqt Madina ke saat darwaze honge aur har darwaze par do farishte pehra denge."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "There are angels guarding the entrances (or roads) of Medina, neither plague nor Ad-Dajjal will be able to enter it
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Farishte Madina ke raaston ki hifazat kar rahe hain, na taun (plague) na Ad-Dajjal isme daakhil ho sakenge."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There will be no town which Ad-Dajjal will not enter except Mecca and Medina, and there will be no entrance (road) (of both Mecca and Medina) but the angels will be standing in rows guarding it against him, and then Medina will shake with its inhabitants thrice (i.e. three earthquakes will take place) and Allah will expel all the non-believers and the hypocrites from it
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Koi shehar aisa nahi hoga jismein Ad-Dajjal daakhil na ho siwaye Mecca aur Madina ke, aur (dono ke) har raaste par farishte safon mein khade hokar usse (Dajjal se) hifazat karenge, phir Madina apne bashindon samet teen baar hilega (yaani teen zalzale honge) aur Allah sab kaafiron aur munafiqon ko usse nikaal dega."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) told us a long narrative about Ad-Dajjal, and among the many things he mentioned, was his saying, "Ad-Dajjal will come and it will be forbidden for him to pass through the entrances of Medina. He will land in some of the salty barren areas (outside) Medina; on that day the best man or one of the best men will come up to him and say, 'I testify that you are the same Dajjal whose description was given to us by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) .' Ad-Dajjal will say to the people, 'If I kill this man and bring him back to life again, will you doubt my claim?' They will say, 'No.' Then Ad-Dajjal will kill that man and bring him back to life. That man will say, 'Now I know your reality better than before.' Ad-Dajjal will say, 'I want to kill him but I cannot
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne humein Ad-Dajjal ke baare mein ek lambi kahani sunayi, aur unme se ek baat yeh thi: "Ad-Dajjal aayega aur usse Madina ke raaston se guzarne se roka jaayega. Woh Madina ke bahar kisi khaari-banjar zameen par utrega; us din, sabse behtareen shaks (ya sabse behtareen logon mein se ek) uske paas aayega aur kahega: 'Main gawahi deta hoon ke tum wahi Dajjal ho jiska bayaan humein Allah ke Rasool ne diya tha.' Ad-Dajjal logon se kahega: 'Agar main is shaks ko qatl karke phir zinda kar dun, kya tumhe mere dawe mein shak rahega?' Woh kahenge: 'Nahi.' Phir Dajjal us shaks ko qatl karega aur phir zinda karega. Woh shaks kahega: 'Ab mujhe tumhari asliyat pehle se behtar pata hai.' Dajjal kahega: 'Main use qatl karna chahta hoon magar main nahi kar sakta.'"

e: Narrated Jabir:A bedouin came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and gave a pledge of allegiance for embracing Islam. The next day he came with fever and said (to the Prophet (ﷺ) ), "Please cancel my pledge (of embracing Islam and of emigrating to Medina)." The Prophet (ﷺ) refused (that request) three times and said, "Medina is like a furnace, it expels out the impurities (bad persons) and selects the good ones and makes them perfect
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek dehati (Bedouin) Nabi ke paas aaya aur Islam qubool karne ki bai'at ki. Agle din woh bukhaar samet aaya aur kaha (Nabi se): "Kripya meri bai'at radd (mansookh) kar dijiye." Nabi ne (yeh guzarish) teen baar inkaar ki aur kaha: "Madina bhaTTi jaisa hai, yeh gandi cheezein (bure log) nikaal deta hai aur achhon ko chunkar unhe mukammal banaata hai."

e: Narrated Zaid bin Thabit:When the Prophet (ﷺ) went out for (the battle of) Uhud, some of his companions (hypocrites) returned (home). A party of the believers remarked that they would kill those (hypocrites) who had returned, but another party said that they would not kill them. So, this Divine Inspiration was revealed: "Then what is the matter with you that you are divided into two parties concerning the hypocrites." (4.88) The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Medina expels the bad persons from it, as fire expels the impurities of iron
hi: Zaid bin Thabit (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Nabi Uhud (ki jung) ke liye nikle, unke kuch sahaba (munafiq) wapas laut aaye. Momino ke ek giroh ne kaha ke woh (munafiqon) ko jinhone waapsi ki, qatl karenge, magar doosre giroh ne kaha ke woh unhe qatl nahi karenge. Isliye yeh wahi nazil hui: "Phir tumhe kya hua ke munafiqon ke baare mein tum do giroh mein baT gaye" (4:88). Nabi ne farmaya: "Madina bure logon ko isse nikaal deta hai jaise aag lohe ki gandi cheezein nikaal deti hai."

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! Bestow on Medina twice the blessings You bestowed on Mecca
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Aye Allah! Madina ko dogunI barkatein de jo tune Mecca ko di hain."

e: Narrated Anas:Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) returned from a journey and observed the walls of Medina, he would make his Mount go fast, and if he was on an animal (i.e. a horse), he would make it gallop because of his love for Medina
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab bhi Nabi safar se wapas aaate aur Madina ki deewaren dekhte, apni sawari ki raftaar tez kar dete, aur agar Aap kisi janwar (ghode) par hote, use tez daudaate, Madina se apni mohabbat ki wajah se.

e: Narrated Anas:(The people of) Bani Salama intended to shift near the mosque (of the Prophet) but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) disliked to see Medina vacated and said, "O the people of Bani Salama! Don't you think that you will be rewarded for your footsteps which you take towards the mosque?" So, they stayed at their old places
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: (Bani Salama ke log) masjid (Nabi ki masjid) ke qareeb shift hona chahte the, magar Allah ke Rasool ko Madina khaali dekhna napasand tha, isliye unhone kaha: "Aye Bani Salama ke log! Kya tumhe nahi lagta ke tumhe apne (masjid ki taraf) qadmon ka ajr milega?" To woh apni purani jagah par hi rahe.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There is a garden from the gardens of Paradise between my house and my pulpit, and my pulpit is on my Lake Fount (Al-Kauthar)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Mere ghar aur mere mimbar ke darmiyan Jannat ke baagon mein se ek baag hai, aur mera mimbar mere Haud (Al-Kauthar) par hai."

e: Narrated `Aisha:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) reached Medina, Abu Bakr and Bilal became ill. When Abu Bakr's fever got worse, he would recite (this poetic verse): "Everybody is staying alive with his People, yet Death is nearer to him than His shoe laces." And Bilal, when his fever deserted him, would recite: "Would that I could stay overnight in A valley wherein I would be Surrounded by Idhkhir and Jalil (kinds of goodsmelling grass). Would that one day I could Drink the water of the Majanna, and Would that (The two mountains) Shama and Tafil would appear to me!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! Curse Shaiba bin Rabi`a and `Utba bin Rabi`a and Umaiya bin Khalaf as they turned us out of our land to the land of epidemics." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then said, "O Allah! Make us love Medina as we love Mecca or even more than that. O Allah! Give blessings in our Sa and our Mudd (measures symbolizing food) and make the climate of Medina suitable for us, and divert its fever towards Al-juhfa." Aisha added: When we reached Medina, it was the most unhealthy of Allah's lands, and the valley of Buthan (the valley of Medina) used to flow with impure colored water
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool Madina pahunche, Abu Bakr aur Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) bimar ho gaye. Jab Abu Bakr ka bukhaar badha, woh yeh she'r padhte: "Har koi apne khandaan ke saath zinda hai, magar maut usse uske joote ke tasme se bhi qareeb hai." Aur Bilal, jab unka bukhaar utarta, yeh padhte: "Kaash main ek raat kisi wadi mein guzar sakta jahan Idhkhir aur Jalil (khushbudaar ghaas) mere aas-paas hoti. Kaash ek din main Majanna ka paani pee sakta, aur kaash (do pahad) Shama aur Tafil mujhe dikhaaee dete!" Nabi ne kaha: "Aye Allah! Shaiba bin Rabi'a, Utba bin Rabi'a, aur Umaiya bin Khalaf par laanat kar kyunke unhone humein humari zameen se bimari wali zameen ki taraf nikaala." Allah ke Rasool ne phir kaha: "Aye Allah! Humein Madina se utni hi mohabbat de jitni humein Mecca se hai, ya usse bhi zyada. Aye Allah! Humare Sa aur Mudd (naapne ki maqdarein khaane ki cheezon ke liye) mein barkat de, aur Madina ki aab-o-hawa humare liye munasib bana de, aur iska bukhaar Al-Juhfa ki taraf pher de." Ayesha ne joda: "Jab hum Madina pahunche, yeh Allah ki sabse ghair-swasthkar zameenon mein se thi, aur Buthan ki wadi (Madina ki wadi) mein ganda rangeen paani bahtaa tha."

e: Narrated Zaid bin Aslam from his father:`Umar said, O Allah! Grant me martyrdom in Your cause, and let my death be in the city of Your Apostle
hi: Zaid bin Aslam, apne waalid ke hawale se: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Aye Allah! Mujhe teri raah mein shahadat de, aur meri maut tere Rasool ke shehar (Madina) mein ho."

e: Narrated Talha bin 'Ubaidullah:A bedouin with unkempt hair came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Inform me what Allah has made compulsory for me as regards the prayers." He replied: "You have to offer perfectly the five compulsory prayers in a day and night (24 hours), unless you want to pray Nawafil." The bedouin further asked, "Inform me what Allah has made compulsory for me as regards fasting." He replied, "You have to fast during the whole month of Ramadan, unless you want to fast more as Nawafil." The bedouin further asked, "Tell me how much Zakat Allah has enjoined on me." Thus, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) informed him about all the rules (i.e. fundamentals) of Islam. The bedouin then said, "By Him Who has honored you, I will neither perform any Nawafil nor will I decrease what Allah has enjoined on me. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If he is saying the truth, he will succeed (or he will be granted Paradise)
hi: Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ubaidullah bataate hain: Ek dehati (Bedouin), uljhe baalon wala, Allah ke Rasool ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe bataiye Allah ne mujhpar namaz ke baare mein kya farz kiya hai." Aap ne jawab diya: "Din-raat (chaubees ghanton) mein paanch farz namazein mukammal padhna, siwaye jab tum nafil padhna chaho." Dehati ne phir pucha: "Mujhe bataiye Allah ne mujhpar roze ke baare mein kya farz kiya hai." Aap ne jawab diya: "Poore Ramadan mahine ka roza rakhna, siwaye jab tum nafil roze rakhna chaho." Dehati ne phir pucha: "Mujhe bataiye Allah ne mujhpar kitni Zakat farz ki hai." Isi tarah Allah ke Rasool ne unhe Islam ke sab bunyaadi usool bataye. Dehati ne kaha: "Us zaat ki qasam jisne aapko izzat di hai, main na koi nafil karunga na jo Allah ne mujhpar farz kiya hai usme kami karunga." Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: "Agar woh sach keh raha hai, to woh kamyaab hoga (ya use Jannat milegi)."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) observed the fast on the 10th of Muharram ('Ashura), and ordered (Muslims) to fast on that day, but when the fasting of the month of Ramadan was prescribed, the fasting of the 'Ashura' was abandoned. `Abdullah did not use to fast on that day unless it coincided with his routine fasting by chance
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne Muharram ki das taareekh (Ashura) ka roza rakha, aur (Musalmanon ko) uska roza rakhne ka hukum diya, magar jab Ramadan ke roze farz kiye gaye, Ashura ka roza chhod diya gaya. Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) is din roza nahi rakhte the siwaye jab yeh unki aam roze ki tareekh se milta.

e: Narrated `Aisha:(The tribe of) Quraish used to fast on the day of Ashura' in the Pre-Islamic period, and then Allah's Apostle ordered (Muslims) to fast on it till the fasting in the month of Ramadan was prescribed; whereupon the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who wants to fast (on 'Ashura') may fast, and he who does not want to fast may not fast
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: (Qabila) Quraish Ashura ka roza jahiliyat ke zamane mein rakhte the, aur phir Allah ke Rasool ne (Musalmanon ko) uska roza rakhne ka hukum diya jab tak Ramadan ke roze farz nahi hue; tab Nabi ne farmaya: "Jo (Ashura ka) roza rakhna chahe, rakh sakta hai, aur jo na rakhna chahe, na rakhe."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Fasting is a shield (or a screen or a shelter). So, the person observing fasting should avoid sexual relation with his wife and should not behave foolishly and impudently, and if somebody fights with him or abuses him, he should tell him twice, 'I am fasting." The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "By Him in Whose Hands my soul is, the smell coming out from the mouth of a fasting person is better in the sight of Allah than the smell of musk. (Allah says about the fasting person), 'He has left his food, drink and desires for My sake. The fast is for Me. So I will reward (the fasting person) for it and the reward of good deeds is multiplied ten times
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Roza ek dhaal (ya parda ya panah) hai. Isliye roza rakhne wale ko apni biwi se humbistari nahi karni chahiye aur bewaqoofana ya be-adabi wala suluk nahi karna chahiye, aur agar koi usse lade ya usse gaali de, use do baar kehna chahiye: 'Main roze se hoon.'" Nabi ne joda: "Us zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, roza rakhne wale ke mun se aane wali khushbu Allah ke nazdeek mushk ki khushbu se behtar hai. (Allah roza rakhne wale ke baare mein kehta hai): 'Usne apna khana, paani aur khwahishen mere liye chhod diya. Roza mere liye hai. Isliye main isse (roza rakhne wale ko) ajr dunga, aur neik amalon ka ajr das guna badhaya jaata hai.'"

e: Narrated Abu Wail from Hudhaifa:`Umar asked the people, "Who remembers the narration of the Prophet (ﷺ) about the affliction?" Hudhaifa said, "I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, 'The affliction of a person in his property, family and neighbors is expiated by his prayers, fasting, and giving in charity." `Umar said, "I do not ask about that, but I ask about those afflictions which will spread like the waves of the sea." Hudhaifa replied, "There is a closed gate in front of those afflictions." `Umar asked, "Will that gate be opened or broken?" He replied, "It will be broken." `Umar said, "Then the gate will not be closed again till the Day of Resurrection." We said to Masruq, "Would you ask Hudhaifa whether `Umar knew what that gate symbolized?" He asked him and he replied "He (`Umar) knew it as one knows that there will be night before tomorrow, morning
hi: Abu Wail, Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke hawale se: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne logon se pucha: "Fitno ke baare mein Nabi ki kahi baat kise yaad hai?" Hudhaifa ne kaha: "Maine Nabi ko farmate suna: 'Aadmi ki apni maal, pariwara aur padosi mein aazmaish uski namaz, roze, aur sadqa dene se maaf ho jaati hai.'" Umar ne kaha: "Main iske baare mein nahi poochta, balki main un fitno ke baare mein poochta hoon jo samundar ki lehron ki tarah phailenge." Hudhaifa ne jawab diya: "In fitno ke saamne ek band darwaza hai." Umar ne pucha: "Kya woh darwaza khola jaayega ya toda jaayega?" Unhone jawab diya: "Toda jaayega." Umar ne kaha: "Phir woh darwaza Qiyamat tak dobara band nahi hoga." Humne Masruq se kaha: "Kya aap Hudhaifa se poochenge kya Umar jaante the woh darwaza kya ishara karta hai?" Unhone poocha aur jawab diya "Woh (Umar) isse aise jaante the jaise koi jaanta hai ke kal se pehle raat aayegi, subah."

e: Narrated Sahl:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There is a gate in Paradise called Ar-Raiyan, and those who observe fasts will enter through it on the Day of Resurrection and none except them will enter through it. It will be said, 'Where are those who used to observe fasts?' They will get up, and none except them will enter through it. After their entry the gate will be closed and nobody will enter through it
hi: Sahl (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jannat mein Ar-Raiyan naam ka ek darwaza hai, aur woh log jo roza rakhte the Qiyamat ke din usi se daakhil honge, aur unke siwa koi doosra isse daakhil nahi hoga. Kaha jaayega: 'Roza rakhne wale kahan hain?' Woh khadi honge, aur unke siwa koi doosra isse daakhil nahi hoga. Unke daakhil hone ke baad darwaza band ho jaayega aur koi bhi ise se daakhil nahi hoga."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever gives two kinds (of things or property) in charity for Allah's Cause, will be called from the gates of Paradise and will be addressed, 'O slaves of Allah! Here is prosperity.' So, whoever was amongst the people who used to offer their prayers, will be called from the gate of the prayer; and whoever was amongst the people who used to participate in Jihad, will be called from the gate of Jihad; and whoever was amongst those who used to observe fasts, will be called from the gate of Ar-Raiyan; whoever was amongst those who used to give in charity, will be called from the gate of charity." Abu Bakr said, "Let my parents be sacrificed for you, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! No distress or need will befall him who will be called from those gates. Will there be any one who will be called from all these gates?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Yes, and I hope you will be one of them
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jo bhi Allah ki raah mein do qisam ki cheezein (ya maal) sadqa mein de, Jannat ke darwazon se pukara jaayega aur usse kaha jaayega: 'Aye Allah ke bande! Yahan khushhaali hai.' Isliye jo namaz padhne walon mein se hoga, use namaz ke darwaze se pukara jaayega; aur jo Jihad karne walon mein se hoga, use Jihad ke darwaze se; aur jo roza rakhne walon mein se hoga, use Ar-Raiyan ke darwaze se; jo sadqa dene walon mein se hoga, use sadqa ke darwaze se pukara jaayega." Abu Bakr ne kaha: "Mere maa-baap aap par qurban hon, Ya Allah ke Rasool! Jo in darwazon se pukara jaayega usse koi museebat ya zaroorat nahi hogi. Kya koi aisa hoga jise in sab darwazon se pukara jaaye?" Nabi ne jawab diya: "Haan, aur mujhe ummeed hai tum unme se hoge."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When Ramadan begins, the gates of Paradise are opened
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jab Ramadan shuru hota hai, Jannat ke darwaze khol diye jate hain."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When the month of Ramadan starts, the gates of the heaven are opened and the gates of Hell are closed and the devils are chained
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jab Ramadan mahina shuru hota hai, aasman ke darwaze khol diye jate hain aur Dozakh ke darwaze band kar diye jate hain, aur shayateen zanjeeron mein baandh diye jate hain."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "When you see the crescent (of the month of Ramadan), start fasting, and when you see the crescent (of the month of Shawwal), stop fasting; and if the sky is overcast (and you can't see it) then regard the month of Ramadan as of 30 days
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool ko farmate suna: "Jab tum naya chaand (Ramadan ka) dekho, roza shuru karo, aur jab tum naya chaand (Shawwal ka) dekho, roza band karo; aur agar aasman badalon se dhaka ho (aur tum dekh na sako), to Ramadan mahine ko 30 din ka maano."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever established prayers on the night of Qadr out of sincere faith and hoping for a reward from Allah, then all his previous sins will be forgiven; and whoever fasts in the month of Ramadan out of sincere faith, and hoping for a reward from Allah, then all his previous sins will be forgiven
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jo bhi Shab-e-Qadr ki raat namaz padhe sacche iman aur Allah se ajr ki ummeed rakhte hue, uske pichhle sab gunah maaf kar diye jaayenge; aur jo bhi Ramadan mahine mein roza rakhe sacche iman aur Allah se ajr ki ummeed rakhte hue, uske pichhle sab gunah maaf kar diye jaayenge."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) was the most generous amongst the people, and he used to be more so in the month of Ramadan when Gabriel visited him, and Gabriel used to meet him on every night of Ramadan till the end of the month. The Prophet (ﷺ) used to recite the Holy Qur'an to Gabriel, and when Gabriel met him, he used to be more generous than a fast wind (which causes rain and welfare)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi sabse zyada sakhi (dariyadil) the, aur Ramadan mahine mein zyada sakhi ho jate the jab Jibreel unse milne aaate, aur Jibreel har raat Ramadan mein unse milte the mahine ke aakhir tak. Nabi Jibreel ko paak Quran padh kar sunate, aur jab Jibreel unse milte, woh tez hawa se bhi zyada sakhi ho jate (jo baarish aur khushhaali laati hai).

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever does not give up forged speech and evil actions, Allah is not in need of his leaving his food and drink (i.e. Allah will not accept his fasting)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jo koi jhoothi baat aur bure amal chhodne se inkaar kare, Allah ko uske khana-paani chhodne ki koi zaroorat nahi (yaani Allah uska roza qubool nahi karega)."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah said, 'All the deeds of Adam's sons (people) are for them, except fasting which is for Me, and I will give the reward for it.' Fasting is a shield or protection from the fire and from committing sins. If one of you is fasting, he should avoid sexual relation with his wife and quarreling, and if somebody should fight or quarrel with him, he should say, 'I am fasting.' By Him in Whose Hands my soul is' The unpleasant smell coming out from the mouth of a fasting person is better in the sight of Allah than the smell of musk. There are two pleasures for the fasting person, one at the time of breaking his fast, and the other at the time when he will meet his Lord; then he will be pleased because of his fasting
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Allah ne kaha: 'Adam ke betoun (logon) ke sab amal unke liye hain, siwaye roze ke jo mere liye hai, aur main isi ka ajr dunga.' Roza ek dhaal ya panah hai aag se aur gunah karne se. Agar tum mein se koi roza rakhta hai, use apni biwi se humbistari aur jhagde se bachna chahiye, aur agar koi usse lade ya jhagda kare, use kehna chahiye: 'Main roze se hoon.' Us zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai! Roza rakhne wale ke mun se aane wali napasandida khushbu bhi Allah ke nazdeek mushk ki khushbu se behtar hai. Roza rakhne wale ke liye do khushiyan hain, ek uska roza kholte waqt, aur doosri jab woh apne Rab se milega; tab woh apne roze ki wajah se khush hoga."

e: Narrated 'Alqama:While I was walking with `Abdullah he said, "We were in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) and he said, 'He who can afford to marry should marry, because it will help him refrain from looking at other women, and save his private parts from committing illegal sexual relation; and he who cannot afford to marry is advised to fast, as fasting will diminish his sexual power
hi: Alqama bataate hain: Jabke main Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath chal raha tha, unhone kaha: "Hum Nabi ke saath the aur unhone kaha: 'Jo shaadi karne ki taakat rakhta hai, use shaadi karni chahiye, kyunke isse woh doosri aurton ki taraf dekhne se rukega, aur apni sharmgaah ko haram ta'alluq se bachaegaa; aur jo shaadi ki taakat nahi rakhta, use roza rakhna chahiye, kyunke roza uski shahavaani taakat ko kam karta hai.'"

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) mentioned Ramadan and said, "Do not fast unless you see the crescent (of Ramadan), and do not give up fasting till you see the crescent (of Shawwal), but if the sky is overcast (if you cannot see it), then act on estimation (i.e. count Sha'ban as 30 days)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Ramadan ka zikar kiya aur kaha: "Roza mat rakho jab tak tum naya chaand (Ramadan ka) na dekho, aur roza chona mat jab tak tum naya chaand (Shawwal ka) na dekho, magar agar aasman badalon se dhaka ho (agar tum ise dekh na sako), to andaza lagao (yaani Sha'ban ko 30 din maano)."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The month (can be) 29 nights (i.e. days), and do not fast till you see the moon, and if the sky is overcast, then complete Sha'ban as thirty days
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Mahina 29 raatein (yaani din) hota hai, aur chaand dekhe bina roza mat rakho, aur agar aasman badalon se dhaka ho, to Sha'ban ko poore teen din poore karo (30 din)."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The month is like this and this," (at the same time he showed the fingers of both his hands thrice) and left out one thumb on the third time
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Mahina aisa hota hai aur aisa," (yehi kehte huye Aap ne apne donon haathon ki ungliyan teen baar dikhaaee) aur teesri baar ek angoothaa chhod diya.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) or Abul-Qasim said, "Start fasting on seeing the crescent (of Ramadan), and give up fasting on seeing the crescent (of Shawwal), and if the sky is overcast (and you cannot see it), complete thirty days of Sha'ban
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ya Abul-Qasim ne kaha: "Naya chaand (Ramadan ka) dekhne par roza shuru karo, aur naya chaand (Shawwal ka) dekhne par roza band karo, aur agar aasman badalon se dhaka ho (aur tum dekh na sako), to Sha'ban ke teen din poore karo (30 din)."

e: Narrated Um Salama:The Prophet (ﷺ) vowed to keep aloof from his wives for a period of one month, and after the completion of 29 days he went either in the morning or in the afternoon to his wives. Someone said to him "You vowed that you would not go to your wives for one month." He replied, "The month is of 29 days
hi: Um Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi ne ek mahine ke liye apni biwiyon se door rehne ki mannat maani, aur 29 din poore hone ke baad, subah ya shaam ko apni biwiyon ke paas gaye. Kisi ne unse kaha: "Aapne ek mahine ke liye apni biwiyon ke paas na jaane ki mannat maani thi." Aap ne jawab diya: "Mahina 29 din ka bhi hota hai."

e: Narrated Anas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) vowed to keep aloof from his wives for one month, and he had dislocation of his leg. So, he stayed in a Mashruba for 29 nights and then came down. Some people said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! You vowed to stay aloof for one month," He replied, "The month is of 29 days
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne ek mahine ke liye apni biwiyon se door rehne ki mannat maani, aur unki taang mein taklif thi. Isliye woh ek Mashruba (khajoor ke tanon ki seedhi wala kamra) mein 29 raatein rahe, phir neeche aaye. Kuch logon ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Aapne ek mahine ke liye door rehne ki mannat maani thi." Aap ne jawab diya: "Mahina 29 din ka bhi hota hai."

e: Narrated Abu Bakra:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The two months of `Id i.e. Ramadan and Dhul-Hijja, do not decrease (in superiority)
hi: Abu Bakra (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Do Eid ke mahene, yaani Ramadan aur Zul-Hijja, apni fazeelat mein kam nahi hote (chahe unke din kam ho jaayein)."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "We are an illiterate nation; we neither write, nor know accounts. The month is like this and this, i.e. sometimes of 29 days and sometimes of thirty days
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Hum un-padh ummat hain; na hum likhte hain na hisaab-kitaab jaante hain. Mahina aisa hota hai aur aisa," (yaani kabhi 29 din ka aur kabhi 30 din ka).

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "None of you should fast a day or two before the month of Ramadan unless he has the habit of fasting (Nawafil) (and if his fasting coincides with that day) then he can fast that day
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Tum mein se koi Ramadan se ek-do din pehle roza na rakhe, siwaye jise (nafil) roza rakhne ki aadat ho (aur agar uska roza us din ke saath mil jaaye) to woh us din roza rakh sakta hai."

e: Narrated Al-Bara:It was the custom among the companions of Muhammad that if any of them was fasting and the food was presented (for breaking his fast), but he slept before eating, he would not eat that night and the following day till sunset. Qais bin Sirma-al-Ansari was fasting and came to his wife at the time of Iftar (breaking one's fast) and asked her whether she had anything to eat. She replied, "No, but I would go and bring some for you." He used to do hard work during the day, so he was overwhelmed by sleep and slept. When his wife came and saw him, she said, "Disappointment for you." When it was midday on the following day, he fainted and the Prophet (ﷺ) was informed about the whole matter and the following verses were revealed: "You are permitted To go to your wives (for sexual relation) At the night of fasting." So, they were overjoyed by it. And then Allah also revealed: "And eat and drink Until the white thread Of dawn appears to you Distinct from the black thread (of the night)
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Yeh riwaaj tha Muhammad ke sahaba mein ke agar koi roza rakh raha hota aur khana pesh kiya jata (roza kholne ke liye), magar khaane se pehle so jata, to woh us raat aur agle din suraj doobne tak kuch na khata. Qais bin Sirma-al-Ansari roza rakhe hue the aur Iftar ke waqt apni biwi ke paas aaye aur pucha kya unke paas khane ko kuch hai. Usne jawab diya: "Nahi, magar main jaakar tumhare liye kuch laaati hoon." Woh din bhar mehnat ka kaam karte the, isliye unhe neend ghera gayi aur woh so gaye. Jab unki biwi aayi aur unhe (soye hue) dekha, usne kaha: "Tumhare liye afsos." Agle din dopahar ko, woh behosh ho gaye aur Nabi ko poori baat batai gayi, aur yeh Aayat nazil hui: "Tumhe apni biwiyon ke paas (humbistari ke liye) jaane ki ijazat hai roze ki raat mein." Isse unhe bahut khushi hui. Aur phir Allah ne yeh bhi nazil kiya: "Aur khao-piyo jab tak subah ka safed dhaaga kaale dhaage se alag na ho jaaye."

e: Narrated `Adi bin Hatim:When the above verses were revealed: 'Until the white thread appears to you, distinct from the black thread,' I took two (hair) strings, one black and the other white, and kept them under my pillow and went on looking at them throughout the night but could not make anything out of it. So, the next morning I went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and told him the whole story. He explained to me, "That verse means the darkness of the night and the whiteness of the dawn
hi: Adi bin Hatim (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab upar wali ayaat nazil hui: "Jab tak tumhe safed dhaaga kaale dhaage se alag saaf dikhe," maine do (baalon ke) dhaage liye, ek kaala aur ek safed, aur unhe apne takiye ke neeche rakh liya aur poori raat unhe dekhta raha magar kuch samajh na paya. Agli subah main Allah ke Rasool ke paas gaya aur unhe poori baat batai. Unhone mujhe samjhaaya: "Iss ayat ka matlab hai raat ka andhera aur subah ki roshni."

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:When the following verses were revealed: 'Eat and drink until the white thread appears to you, distinct from the black thread' and of dawn was not revealed, some people who intended to fast, tied black and white threads to their legs and went on eating till they differentiated between the two. Allah then revealed the words, 'of dawn', and it became clear that meant night and day
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab yeh ayaat nazil hui: "Khao-piyo jab tak tumhe safed dhaaga kaale dhaage se saaf alag dikhe" aur 'subah ka' hissa nazil nahi hua tha, kuch log jo roza rakhna chahte the, apni taangon mein kaale-safed dhaage baandh lete aur khate rahte jab tak woh dono mein farq na kar lete. Allah ne phir "subah ka" alfaaz nazil kiye, aur saaf ho gaya ke iska matlab raat aur din tha.

e: Narrated `Aisha:Bilal used to pronounce the Adhan at night, so Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? said, "Carry on taking your meals (eat and drink) till Ibn Um Maktum pronounces the Adhan, for he does not pronounce it till it is dawn
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) raat ko Adhan dete the, isliye Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: "Khaana-peena jaari rakho jab tak Ibn Um Maktum Adhan de, kyunke woh subah hone tak Adhan nahi dete."

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:I used to take my Suhur meals with my family and then hurry up for presenting myself for the (Fajr) prayer with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main apne pariwara ke saath Sehri khata aur phir Allah ke Rasool ke saath (Fajr ki) namaz mein hazir hone ke liye jaldi karta.

e: Narrated Anas:Zaid bin Thabit said, "We took the Suhur with the Prophet (ﷺ) . Then he stood for the prayer." I asked, "What was the interval between the Suhur and the Adhan?" He replied, "The interval was sufficient to recite fifty verses of the Qur'an
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Zaid bin Thabit (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Humne Nabi ke saath Sehri khai. Phir Aap namaz ke liye khade hue." Maine pucha: "Sehri aur Adhan ke beech kitna waqfa tha?" Unhone jawab diya: "Itna waqfa jitne mein Quran ki pachaas ayaat tilawat ki ja sakein."

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) fasted for days continuously; the people also did the same but it was difficult for them. So, the Prophet (ﷺ) forbade them (to fast continuously for more than one day). They said, "But you fast without break (no food was taken in the evening or in the morning)." The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "I am not like you, for I am provided with food and drink (by Allah)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne lagataar kai din roza rakha; logon ne bhi wahi kiya magar unke liye yeh mushkil tha. Isliye Nabi ne unhe (aisa lagataar roza rakhne se) mana kiya. Unhone kaha: "Magar aap to bina roka roza rakhte hain (shaam-subah kuch nahi khate)." Nabi ne jawab diya: "Main tumhari tarah nahi hoon, kyunke mujhe (Allah ki taraf se) khana-paani diya jaata hai."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Take Suhur as there is a blessing in it
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Sehri khao, kyunke isme barkat hai."

e: Narrated Salama bin Al-Akwa`:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered a person on 'Ashura' (the tenth of Muharram) to announce, "Whoever has eaten, should not eat any more, but fast, and who has not eaten should not eat, but complete his fast (till the end of the day)
hi: Salama bin Al-Akwa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Nabi ne Ashura (Muharram ki das taareekh) ke din ek shaks ko elaan karne ka hukum diya: "Jisne khaya hai, woh aur na khaye, balki roza rakhe, aur jisne nahi khaya, woh na khaye, balki apna roza poora kare (din ke aakhir tak)."

e: Narrated `Aisha and Um Salama:At times Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to get up in the morning in the state of Janaba after having sexual relations with his wives. He would then take a bath and fast
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) aur Um Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Kabhi-kabhi Allah ke Rasool subah Janaba ki halat mein uṭte the apni biwiyon se humbistari karne ke baad. Phir Aap ghusl karte aur roza rakhte.

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to kiss and embrace (his wives) while he was fasting, and he had more power to control his desires than any of you. Said Jabir, "The person who gets discharge after casting a look (on his wife) should complete his fast
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi apni biwiyon ko bosa dete aur galale lagaate roze ki halat mein, aur unhe khud par tum sab se zyada qaboo tha (apni khwahishen kaboo karne par). Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Jo shaks (apni biwi ki taraf) dekh kar shehwat ka josh nikaale, use apna roza mukammal karna chahiye."

e: Narrated Hisham's father:Aisha said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to kiss some of his wives while he was fasting," and then she smiled
hi: Hisham ke waalid ke hawale se: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool apni kuch biwiyon ko roze ki halat mein bosa dete the," phir woh muskurain.

e: Narrated Zainab:(daughter of Um Salama) that her mother said, "While I was (lying) with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) underneath a woolen sheet, I got the menstruation, and then slipped away and put on the clothes (which I used to wear) in menses. He asked, "What is the matter? Did you get your menses?" I replied in the affirmative and then entered underneath that woolen sheet. I and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to take a bath from one water pot and he used to kiss me while he was fasting
hi: Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Um Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) ki beti) bataati hain, apni maa ke hawale se: "Ek baar jab main Allah ke Rasool ke saath oonI chadar ke neeche thi, mujhe haiz aa gaya, isliye main khisak gayi aur woh kapde pehne jo main haiz ke waqt pehnti thi. Aap ne pucha: 'Kya baat hai? Kya tumhe haiz aa gaya?' Maine haan mein jawab diya aur phir wapas usi oonI chadar ke neeche gayi. Main aur Allah ke Rasool ek hi bartan se ghusl karte the, aur Aap mujhe roze ki halat mein bosa dete."

e: Narrated `Aisha:(At times) in Ramadan the Prophet (ﷺ) used to take a bath in the morning not because of a wet dream and would continue his fast
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: (Kabhi-kabhi) Ramadan mein Nabi subah ghusl karte, na ke ehtelaam (khwaab mein humbistari) ki wajah se, aur apna roza jaari rakhte.

e: Narrated Abu Bakr bin `Abdur-Rahman:My father and I went to `Aisha and she said, "I testify that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) at times used to get up in the morning in a state of Janaba from sexual intercourse, not from a wet dream and then he would fast that day." Then he went to Um Salama and she also narrated a similar thing
hi: Abu Bakr bin Abdur-Rahman bataate hain: Main aur mere waalid Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas gaye aur unhone kaha: "Main gawahi deti hoon ke Allah ke Rasool kabhi-kabhi subah Janaba ki halat mein uṭte the humbistari ki wajah se, na ke ehtelaam ki wajah se, aur phir us din roza rakhte." Phir woh Um Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas gaye aur unhone bhi isi jaisi baat bayan ki.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If somebody eats or drinks forgetfully then he should complete his fast, for what he has eaten or drunk, has been given to him by Allah
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Agar koi bhoolkar khana ya paani piye, use apna roza poora karna chahiye, kyunke jo usne khaya-piya, woh Allah ne usse diya (koi qasoor nahi)."

e: Narrated Humran:I saw `Uthman performing ablution; he washed his hands thrice, rinsed his mouth and then washed his nose, by putting water in it and then blowing it out, and washed his face thrice, and then washed his right forearm up to the elbow thrice, and then the left-forearm up to the elbow thrice, then smeared his head with water, washed his right foot thrice, and then his left foot thrice and said, "I saw Allah's Apostle performing ablution similar to my present ablution, and then he said, 'Whoever performs ablution like my present ablution and then offers two rak`at in which he does not think of worldly things, all his previous sins will be forgiven
hi: Humran bataate hain: Maine Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko wudu karte dekha; unhone apne haath teen baar dhoye, kuLLI ki aur apni naak mein paani daal kar phoonka, phir apna chehra teen baar dhoya, phir apni dahini kohni tak baazu teen baar dhoi, phir baayi kohni tak teen baar, phir apne sar par paani phera, phir apna dahina paon teen baar dhoya, phir baaya paon teen baar dhoya, aur kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool ko isi tarah wudu karte dekha jaisa maine abhi kiya, aur phir unhone kaha: 'Jo koi mere is wudu jaisa wudu kare, phir do rakat padhe jisme woh duniyawi khayaalon mein na uljhe, uske pichhle sab gunah maaf ho jaayenge.'"

e: Narrated `Aisha:A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said that he had been burnt (ruined). The Prophet (ﷺ) asked him what was the matter. He replied, "I had sexual intercourse with my wife in Ramadan (while I was fasting)." Then a basket full of dates was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he asked, "Where is the burnt (ruined) man?" He replied, "I am present." The Prophet (ﷺ) told him to give that basket in charity (as expiation)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ek shaks Nabi ke paas aaya aur kaha ke woh jal (barbaad) gaya hai. Nabi ne pucha kya baat hai. Usne jawab diya: "Maine Ramadan mein apni biwi se humbistari ki (jabke main roze se tha)." Phir Nabi ke paas khajooron se bhari ek tokari laayi gayi aur Aap ne pucha: "Jala hua shaks kahan hai?" Usne jawab diya: "Main hazir hoon." Nabi ne use woh tokari sadqa mein dene ko kaha (kaffara ke tor par).

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:While we were sitting with the Prophet (ﷺ) a man came and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have been ruined." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked what was the matter with him. He replied "I had sexual intercourse with my wife while I was fasting." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked him, "Can you afford to manumit a slave?" He replied in the negative. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked him, "Can you fast for two successive months?" He replied in the negative. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked him, "Can you afford to feed sixty poor persons?" He replied in the negative. The Prophet (ﷺ) kept silent and while we were in that state, a big basket full of dates was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) . He asked, "Where is the questioner?" He replied, "I (am here)." The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to him), "Take this (basket of dates) and give it in charity." The man said, "Should I give it to a person poorer than I? By Allah; there is no family between its (i.e. Medina's) two mountains who are poorer than I." The Prophet (ﷺ) smiled till his premolar teeth became visible and then said, 'Feed your family with it
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jabke hum Nabi ke saath baithe the, ek shaks aaya aur kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Main barbaad ho gaya hoon." Allah ke Rasool ne pucha kya baat hai. Usne jawab diya: "Maine apni biwi se humbistari ki jabke main roze se tha." Allah ke Rasool ne pucha: "Kya tum ek gulaam azaad kar sakte ho?" Usne na mein jawab diya. Allah ke Rasool ne pucha: "Kya tum lagataar do maheene roza rakh sakte ho?" Usne na mein jawab diya. Nabi ne pucha: "Kya tum saath zaroorat-mand logon ko khana khila sakte ho?" Usne na mein jawab diya. Nabi khamosh rahe, aur jabke hum isi haalat mein the, Nabi ke paas khajooron se bhari ek badi tokari laayi gayi. Aap ne pucha: "Sawaal karne wala kahan hai?" Usne jawab diya: "Main (yahan hoon)." Nabi ne (usse) kaha: "Ise le lo aur sadqa mein de do." Shaks ne kaha: "Kya main isse mujhse zyada gareeb kisi ko dun? Allah ki qasam! Iske (yaani Madina ke) do pahaaadon ke beech mujhse zyada gareeb koi pariwara nahi." Nabi muskuraaye yahan tak ke unke daant zaahir ho gaye aur kaha: "Isse apne pariwara ko khilao."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "I had sexual intercourse with my wife on Ramadan (while fasting)." The Prophet (ﷺ) asked him, "Can you afford to manumit a slave?" He replied in the negative. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked him, "Can you fast for two successive months?" He replied in the negative. He asked him, "Can you afford to feed sixty poor persons?" He replied in the negative. (Abu Huraira added): Then a basket full of dates was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he said (to that man), "Feed (poor people) with this by way of atonement." He said, "(Should I feed it) to poorer people than we? There is no poorer house than ours between its (Medina's) mountains." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Then feed your family with it
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks Nabi ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Maine Ramadan mein (roze ki halat mein) apni biwi se humbistari ki." Nabi ne pucha: "Kya tum ek gulaam azaad kar sakte ho?" Usne na mein jawab diya. Nabi ne pucha: "Kya tum lagataar do maheene roza rakh sakte ho?" Usne na mein jawab diya. Aap ne pucha: "Kya tum saath zaroorat-mand logon ko khana khila sakte ho?" Usne na mein jawab diya. (Abu Huraira ne joda:) Phir Nabi ke paas khajooron se bhari ek tokari laayi gayi aur Aap ne (us shaks se) kaha: "Isse (gareebon ko) khana khilaao kaffara ke tor par." Usne kaha: "(Kya main isse) mujhse zyada gareeb logon ko dun? Iske (Madina ke) pahaaadon ke beech humse zyada gareeb ghar nahi hai." Nabi ne kaha: "To apne pariwara ko isse khilaao."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) was cupped while he was in the state of Ihram, and also while he was observing a fast
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne cupping (Hijama) karwaya jabke woh Ihram ki halat mein the aur roze se bhi the.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) was cupped while he was fasting
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne cupping karwaya jabke woh roze se the.

e: Narrated Thabit Al-Bunani:Anas bin Malik was asked whether they disliked the cupping for a fasting person. He replied in the negative and said, "Only if it causes weakness
hi: Thabit Al-Bunani bataate hain: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha gaya kya woh roza rakhne wale ke liye cupping ko napasand karte the. Unhone na mein jawab diya aur kaha: "Sirf agar isse kamzori ho."

e: Narrated Ibn Abi `Aufa:We were in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on a journey. He said to a man, "Get down and mix Sawiq (powdered barley) with water for me." The man said, "The sun (has not set yet), O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." The Prophet (ﷺ) again said to him, "Get down and mix Sawiq with water for me." The man again said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! The sun!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him (for the third time) "Get down and mix Sawiq with water for me." The man dismounted and mixed Sawiq with water for him. The Prophet (ﷺ) drank it and then beckoned with his hand (towards the East) and said, "When you see the night falling from this side, then a fasting person should break his fast
hi: Ibn Abi Aufa bataate hain: Hum Allah ke Rasool ke saath ek safar mein the. Aap ne ek shaks se kaha: "Utro aur mere liye Sawiq (piste hue jau) paani mein gholo." Shaks ne kaha: "Suraj (abhi doobi nahi), Ya Allah ke Rasool." Nabi ne phir kaha: "Utro aur mere liye Sawiq paani mein gholo." Shaks ne phir kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Suraj!" Nabi ne (teesri baar) kaha: "Utro aur mere liye Sawiq paani mein gholo." Shaks utra aur unke liye Sawiq ghola. Nabi ne use piya aur phir apne haath se (mashriq ki taraf) ishara kiya aur kaha: "Jab tum is taraf se raat girte dekho, roza rakhne wale ko apna roza kholna chahiye."

e: Narrated `Aisha:Hamza bin `Amr Al-Aslami said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I fast continuously
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Hamza bin Amr Al-Aslami ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Main lagataar roza rakhta hoon..."

e: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) Hamza bin `Amr Al-Aslami asked the Prophet, "Should I fast while traveling?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "You may fast if you wish, and you may not fast if you wish
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki biwi) bataati hain: Hamza bin Amr Al-Aslami ne Nabi se pucha: "Kya mujhe safar mein roza rakhna chahiye?" Nabi ne jawab diya: "Agar chaho to roza rakho, aur agar chaho to na rakho."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) set out for Mecca in Ramadan and he fasted, and when he reached Al-Kadid, he broke his fast and the people (with him) broke their fast too. (Abu `Abdullah said, "Al-Kadid is a land covered with water between Usfan and Qudaid)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool Ramadan mein Mecca ke liye nikle aur roza rakha, aur jab Aap Al-Kadid pahunche, apna roza tod diya aur (unke saath) log bhi apna roza tod diya. (Abu Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Al-Kadid Usfan aur Qudaid ke darmiyan ek paani se dhaki zameen hai.")

e: Narrated Abu Ad-Darda:We set out with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on one of his journeys on a very hot day, and it was so hot that one had to put his hand over his head because of the severity of heat. None of us was fasting except the Prophet and Ibn Rawaha
hi: Abu Ad-Darda bataate hain: Hum Allah ke Rasool ke saath ek safar mein nikle bahut garmi ke din, aur itni garmi thi ke garmi ki shiddat ki wajah se log apna haath sar par rakhte the. Humme se koi bhi roza nahi rakhe hue tha siwaye Nabi aur Ibn Rawaha ke.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was on a journey and saw a crowd of people, and a man was being shaded (by them). He asked, "What is the matter?" They said, "He (the man) is fasting." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It is not righteousness that you fast on a journey
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ek safar par the aur unhone logon ki ek bhirr dekhi, aur ek shaks ko saaya diya jaa raha tha. Aap ne pucha: "Kya baat hai?" Unhone kaha: "Woh (shaks) roze se hai." Nabi ne kaha: "Safar mein roza rakhna neki nahi."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:We used to travel with the Prophet (ﷺ) and neither did the fasting persons criticize those who were not fasting, nor did those who were not fasting criticize the fasting ones
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Nabi ke saath safar karte the, aur na roza rakhne wale un logon ki ninda karte jo roza nahi rakhte the, na roza na rakhne wale un logon ki ninda karte jo roza rakhte the.

e: Narrated Tawus:Ibn `Abbas said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) set out from Medina to Mecca and he fasted till he reached 'Usfan, where he asked for water and raised his hand to let the people see him, and then broke the fast, and did not fast after that till he reached Mecca, and that happened in Ramadan." Ibn `Abbas used to say, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (sometimes) fasted and (sometimes) did not fast during the journeys so whoever wished to fast could fast, and whoever wished not to fast, could do so
hi: Tawus bataate hain: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool Madina se Mecca ke liye nikle aur roza rakha yahan tak ke woh Usfan pahunche, jahan unhone paani maanga aur logon ko dikhaane ke liye apna haath uṭaaya, phir apna roza tod diya, aur uske baad roza nahi rakha jab tak Mecca na pahunch gaye, aur yeh Ramadan mein hua." Ibn Abbas kahte: "Allah ke Rasool (kabhi) roza rakhte aur (kabhi) na rakhte safar mein, isliye jo roza rakhna chahe, rakh sakta hai, aur jo na rakhna chahe, na rakhe."

e: Narrated Nafi`:Ibn `Umar recited the verse: "They had a choice either to fast or to feed a poor person for every day, and said that the order of this Verse was canceled
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne yeh ayat padhi: "Unke paas roza rakhne ya har din ke liye ek gareeb ko khana khilaane ka ikhtiyaar tha," aur kaha ke iss ayat ka hukum mansookh (radd) kar diya gaya.

e: Narrated `Aisha:Sometimes I missed some days of Ramadan, but could not fast in lieu of them except in the month of Sha'ban." Said Yahya, a sub-narrator, "She used to be busy serving the Prophet (ﷺ)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Kabhi-kabhi main Ramadan ke kuch din chhod deti thi, magar main unki jagah roza sirf Sha'ban mahine mein rakh pati thi. Yahya (doosre raawi) ne kaha: "Woh Nabi ki khidmat mein masroof rehti thi."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Isn't it true that a woman does not pray and does not fast on menstruating? And that is the defect (a loss) in her religion
hi: Abu Saeed (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Kya yeh sach nahi ke aurat haiz ke waqt namaz nahi padhti aur roza nahi rakhti? Aur yeh uske deen mein ek kami (nuqsaan) hai."

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever died and he ought to have fasted (the missed days of Ramadan) then his guardians must fast on his behalf
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jo koi is haalat mein mare ke usne (Ramadan ke chhoote hue) roze rakhne the, uske waaris (guardians) uski taraf se roza rakhein."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! My mother died and she ought to have fasted one month (for her missed Ramadan). Shall I fast on her behalf?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied in the affirmative and said, "Allah's debts have more right to be paid." In another narration a woman is reported to have said, "My sister died..." Narrated Ibn `Abbas: A woman said to the Prophet (ﷺ) "My mother died and she had vowed to fast but she didn't fast." In another narration Ibn `Abbas is reported to have said, "A woman said to the Prophet, "My mother died while she ought to have fasted for fifteen days
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Ek shaks Nabi ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Meri maa ka intiqal ho gaya aur unhe ek mahine ka roza rakhna tha (chhoote hue Ramadan ka). Kya main unki taraf se roza rakh sakta hoon?" Nabi ne haan mein jawab diya aur kaha: "Allah ka qarz ada karne ka sabse zyada haqq hai." Ek doosri riwayat mein ek aurat ne kaha: "Meri behn ka intiqal ho gaya..." Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai: Ek aurat ne Nabi se kaha: "Meri maa ka intiqal ho gaya aur unhone roza rakhne ki mannat maani thi magar rakh nahi payin." Ek doosri riwayat mein Ibn Abbas se hai: "Ek aurat ne Nabi se kaha: 'Meri maa ka intiqal ho gaya jabke unhe pandrah din roza rakhna tha.'"

e: Narrated `Umar bin Al-Khattab:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When night falls from this side and the day vanishes from this side and the sun sets, then the fasting person should break his fast
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Khattab (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jab is taraf se raat aati hai aur us taraf se din chala jaata hai aur suraj doob jaata hai, to roza rakhne wale ko apna roza khol dena chahiye."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abi `Aufa:We were in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) on a journey and he was fasting, and when the sun set, he addressed somebody, "O so-and-so, get up and mix Sawiq with water for us." He replied, "O Allah's Apostle! (Will you wait) till it is evening?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Get down and mix Sawiq with water for us." He replied, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! (If you wait) till it is evening." The Prophet (ﷺ) said again, "Get down and mix Sawiq with water for us." He replied, "It is still daytime."(1) The Prophet (ﷺ) said again, "Get down and mix Sawiq with water for us." He got down and mixed Sawiq for them. The Prophet (ﷺ) drank it and then said, "When you see night falling from this side, the fasting person should break his fast
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Aufa bataate hain: Hum Nabi ke saath ek safar mein the aur Aap roze se the, aur jab suraj dooba, Aap ne kisi ko sambodhit karke kaha: "Aye falaan! Uṭ kar humare liye Sawiq paani mein gholo." Usne jawab diya: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! (Kya intezar karenge) shaam tak?" Nabi ne kaha: "Utro aur humare liye Sawiq gholo." Usne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! (Agar intezar karein) shaam tak." Nabi ne phir kaha: "Utro aur humare liye Sawiq gholo." Usne kaha: "Abhi din hi hai." Nabi ne phir kaha: "Utro aur humare liye Sawiq gholo." Woh utra aur unke liye Sawiq ghola. Nabi ne use piya aur phir kaha: "Jab tum is taraf se raat girte dekho, roza rakhne wale ko apna roza kholna chahiye."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abi `Aufa:We were traveling with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he was fasting, and when the sun set, he said to (someone), "Get down and mix Sawiq with water for us." He replied, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! (Will you wait) till it is evening?" The Prophet (ﷺ) again said, "Get down and mix Sawiq with water for us." He replied, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! It is still daytime." The Prophet (ﷺ) said again, "Get down and mix Sawiq with water for us." So, he got down and carried out that order. The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "When you see night falling from this side, the fasting person should break his fast," and he beckoned with his finger towards the east
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Aufa bataate hain: Hum Allah ke Rasool ke saath safar kar rahe the aur Aap roze se the, aur jab suraj dooba, unhone (kisi se) kaha: "Utro aur humare liye Sawiq paani mein gholo." Usne jawab diya: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! (Intezar karenge) shaam tak?" Nabi ne phir kaha: "Utro aur humare liye Sawiq gholo." Usne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Abhi din hai." Nabi ne phir kaha: "Utro aur humare liye Sawiq gholo." To woh utra aur hukum poora kiya. Nabi ne phir kaha: "Jab tum is taraf se raat girte dekho, roza rakhne wale ko apna roza kholna chahiye," aur unhone mashriq ki taraf apni ungli se ishara kiya.

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The people will remain on the right path as long as they hasten the breaking of the fast
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Log seedhe raaste par rahenge jab tak woh roza kholne mein jaldi karte rahenge."

e: Narrated Ibn Abi `Aufa:I was with the Prophet (ﷺ) on a journey, and he observed the fast till evening. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to a man, "Get down and mix Sawiq with water for me." He replied, "Will you wait till it is evening?" The Prophet said, "Get down and mix Sawiq with water for me; when you see night falling from this side, the fasting person should break his fast
hi: Ibn Abi Aufa bataate hain: Main Nabi ke saath ek safar mein tha, aur Aap ne shaam tak roza rakha. Nabi ne ek shaks se kaha: "Utro aur mere liye Sawiq paani mein gholo." Usne jawab diya: "Kya intezar karenge shaam tak?" Nabi ne kaha: "Utro aur mere liye Sawiq gholo; jab tum is taraf se raat girte dekho, roza rakhne wale ko apna roza kholna chahiye."

e: Narrated Abu Usama from Hisham bin 'Urwa from Fatima:Asma bint Abi Bakr said, "We broke our fast during the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) on a cloudy day and then the sun appeared." Hisham was asked, "Were they ordered to fast in lieu of that day?" He replied, "It had to be made up for." Ma`mar said, "I heard Hisham saying, "I don't know whether they fasted in lieu of that day or not
hi: Abu Usama, Hisham bin Urwa ke hawale se, Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ke hawale se: Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Abi Bakr (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha: "Humne Nabi ke zamane mein apna roza tod diya ek badalon wale din, phir suraj zahir ho gaya." Hisham se pucha gaya: "Kya unhe us din ka roza dobara rakhne ka hukum diya gaya?" Unhone jawab diya: "Haan, isse pura karna hi tha." Ma'mar ne kaha: "Maine Hisham ko kehte suna: 'Mujhe nahi pata kya unhone us din ki jagah roza rakha ya nahi.'"

e: Narrated Ar-Rubai' bint Mu'awwidh:"The Prophet (ﷺ) sent a messenger to the village of the Ansar in the morning of the day of 'Ashura' (10th of Muharram) to announce: 'Whoever has eaten something should not eat but complete the fast, and whoever is observing the fast should complete it.' "She further said, "Since then we used to fast on that day regularly and also make our boys fast. We used to make toys of wool for the boys and if anyone of them cried for food, he was given those toys till it was the time of the breaking of the fast
hi: Ar-Rubai bint Mu'awwidh bataati hain: "Nabi ne Ashura (10 Muharram) ki subah Ansaar ke gaon mein ek qasid bheja yeh elaan karne: 'Jisne kuch khaya hai, woh aur na khaye balki apna roza poora kare, aur jo roze se hai woh apna roza poora kare.'" Woh aage joda: "Iske baad hum us din baqayda roza rakhte aur apne ladkon ko bhi roza rakhaate. Hum ladkon ke liye oon ke khilaune banate, aur agar unme se koi khaeane ke liye rone laga, hum use woh khilaune dete jab tak roza kholne ka waqt na aa jaaye."

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not practice Al-Wisal (fasting continuously without breaking one's fast in the evening or eating before the following dawn)." The people said to the Prophet, "But you practice Al- Wisal?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "I am not like any of you, for I am given food and drink (by Allah) during the night
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Al-Wisal (lagataar roza rakhna bina shaam ko khole ya agli subah tak kuch khaye) na karo." Logon ne Nabi se kaha: "Magar aap to Al-Wisal karte hain?" Nabi ne jawab diya: "Main tum mein se kisi jaisa nahi, kyunke mujhe raat mein khana-paani diya jaata hai (Allah ki taraf se)."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade Al-Wisal. The people said (to him), "But you practice it?" He said, "I am not like you, for I am given food and drink by Allah
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Al-Wisal se mana kiya. Logon ne (unse) kaha: "Magar aap ise karte hain?" Aap ne kaha: "Main tum jaisa nahi, kyunke Allah mujhe khana-paani deta hai."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id:That he had heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Do not fast continuously (practice Al-Wisal), and if you intend to lengthen your fast, then carry it on only till the Suhur (before the following dawn)." The people said to him, "But you practice (Al-Wisal), O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" He replied, "I am not similar to you, for during my sleep I have One Who makes me eat and drink
hi: Abu Saeed (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Unhone Nabi ko farmate suna: "Lagataar roza (Al-Wisal) mat rakho, aur agar tum apna roza lamba karna chaho, to sirf Sehri tak (agli subah tak) hi karo." Logon ne unse kaha: "Magar aap Al-Wisal karte hain, Ya Allah ke Rasool!" Aap ne jawab diya: "Main tum jaisa nahi hoon, kyunke apni neend mein mera koi hai jo mujhe khilata-pilata hai."

e: Narrated Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade Al-Wisal out of mercy to them. They said to him, "But you practice Al- Wisal?" He said, "I am not similar to you, for my Lord gives me food and drink
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool ne unke liye reham karte hue Al-Wisal se mana kiya. Unhone kaha: "Magar aap to Al-Wisal karte hain?" Aap ne kaha: "Main tum jaisa nahi, kyunke mera Rab mujhe khana-paani deta hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade Al-Wisal in fasting. So, one of the Muslims said to him, "But you practice Al- Wisal. O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Who amongst you is similar to me? I am given food and drink during my sleep by my Lord." So, when the people refused to stop Al-Wisal (fasting continuously), the Prophet (ﷺ) fasted day and night continuously along with them for a day and then another day and then they saw the crescent moon (of the month of Shawwal). The Prophet (ﷺ) said to them (angrily), "If It (the crescent) had not appeared, I would have made you fast for a longer period." That was as a punishment for them when they refused to stop (practicing Al-Wisal)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne roze mein Al-Wisal se mana kiya. Isliye ek Musalman ne unse kaha: "Magar aap Al-Wisal karte hain, Ya Allah ke Rasool!" Nabi ne jawab diya: "Tum mein se kaun mere jaisa hai? Mujhe apni neend mein mere Rab ki taraf se khana-paani milta hai." Isliye jab logon ne Al-Wisal (lagataar roza) chhodne se inkaar kiya, Nabi ne unke saath ek din aur din-raat lagataar roza rakha, phir ek aur din, phir unhone naya chaand (Shawwal ka) dekha. Nabi ne unse (gusse se) kaha: "Agar chaand na dikhta, main tumhe aur zyada roza rakhne deta." Yeh unke liye ek saza thi jab unhone (Al-Wisal) chhodne se inkaar kiya.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said twice, "(O you people) Be cautious! Do not practice Al-Wisal." The people said to him, "But you practice Al-Wisal?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "My Lord gives me food and drink during my sleep. Do that much of deeds which is within your ability
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne do baar kaha: "(Aye logon) Khabardar! Al-Wisal mat karo." Logon ne unse kaha: "Magar aap Al-Wisal karte hain?" Nabi ne jawab diya: "Mera Rab mujhe apni neend mein khana-paani deta hai. Utne hi amal karo jitni tumhari taaqat ho."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Do not fast continuously day and night (practice Al-Wisal) and if anyone of you intends to fast continuously day and night, he should continue till the Suhur time." They said, "But you practice Al-Wisal, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I am not similar to you;. during my sleep I have One Who makes me eat and drink
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Lagataar din-raat roza (Al-Wisal) mat rakho, aur agar tum mein se koi lagataar din-raat roza rakhna chahe, use Sehri tak jaari rakhna chahiye." Unhone kaha: "Magar aap Al-Wisal karte hain, Ya Allah ke Rasool!" Nabi ne kaha: "Main tum jaisa nahi; apni neend mein mera koi hai jo mujhe khilata-pilata hai."

e: Narrated Abu Juhaifa:The Prophet (ﷺ) made a bond of brotherhood between Salman and Abu Ad-Darda.' Salman paid a visit to Abu Ad-Darda' and found Um Ad-Darda' dressed in shabby clothes and asked her why she was in that state. She replied, "Your brother Abu Ad-Darda' is not interested in (the luxuries of) this world." In the meantime Abu Ad-Darda' came and prepared a meal for Salman. Salman requested Abu Ad- Darda' to eat (with him), but Abu Ad-Darda' said, "I am fasting." Salman said, "I am not going to eat unless you eat." So, Abu Ad-Darda' ate (with Salman).
