When it was night and (a part of the night passed), Abu Ad-Darda' got up (to offer the night prayer), but Salman told him to sleep and Abu Ad- Darda' slept. After sometime Abu Ad-Darda' again got up but Salman told him to sleep. When it was the last hours of the night, Salman told him to get up then, and both of them offered the prayer. Salman told Abu Ad-Darda', "Your Lord has a right on you, your soul has a right on you, and your family has a right on you; so you should give the rights of all those who has a right on you." Abu Ad- Darda' came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and narrated the whole story. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Salman has spoken the truth
hi: Abu Juhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Salman (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Abu Ad-Darda ke darmiyan bhaicharee ka rishta banaya. Salman Abu Ad-Darda se milne gaye aur unki biwi Um Ad-Darda ko purane kapdon mein dekha aur unse iski wajah poochhi. Unhone jawab diya: "Tumhare bhai Abu Ad-Darda ko iss duniya (ki aish) mein koi dilchaspi nahi." Isi dauran Abu Ad-Darda aaye aur Salman ke liye khana taiyaar kiya. Salman ne Abu Ad-Darda se (unke saath) khaane ko kaha, magar Abu Ad-Darda ne kaha: "Main roze se hoon." Salman ne kaha: "Main tab tak nahi khaunga jab tak tum na khao." To Abu Ad-Darda ne (Salman ke saath) khana khaya. Raat hone par (kuch waqt guzarne ke baad), Abu Ad-Darda (namaz padhne) uṭe, magar Salman ne unhe sone ko kaha aur Abu Ad-Darda so gaye. Thodi der baad Abu Ad-Darda phir uṭe magar Salman ne unhe sone ko kaha. Jab raat ka aakhri hissa aaya, Salman ne unhe uṭhne ko kaha, aur donon ne namaz padhi. Salman ne Abu Ad-Darda se kaha: "Tumhare Rab ka tumpar haqq hai, tumhari jaan ka tumpar haqq hai, aur tumhare pariwara ka tumpar haqq hai; isliye tumhe sab haqdaaron ka haqq ada karna chahiye." Abu Ad-Darda Nabi ke paas gaye aur poori kahani sunayi. Nabi ne kaha: "Salman ne sach kaha hai."

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to fast till one would say that he would never stop fasting, and he would abandon fasting till one would say that he would never fast. I never saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) fasting for a whole month except the month of Ramadan, and did not see him fasting in any month more than in the month of Sha'ban
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool itna roza rakhte ke koi kehta woh kabhi roza rakhna na chhodenge, aur woh itna roza chhodte ke koi kehta woh kabhi roza rakhna hi nahi karenge. Maine Allah ke Rasool ko kabhi poore mahine roza rakhte nahi dekha siwaye Ramadan ke, aur maine unhe kisi doosre mahine se zyada Sha'ban mein roza rakhte dekha.

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) never fasted in any month more than in the month of Sha'ban. He used to say, "Do those deeds which you can do easily, as Allah will not get tired (of giving rewards) till you get bored and tired (of performing religious deeds)." The most beloved prayer to the Prophet (ﷺ) was the one that was done regularly (throughout the life) even if it were little. And whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) offered a prayer he used to offer it regularly
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi ne kisi doosre mahine se zyada Sha'ban mein roza rakha. Woh kahte: "Woh amal karo jo tum aasani se kar sako, kyunke Allah kabhi thakta nahi (ajr dene mein) jab tak tum khud (nek amal karte-karte) oob aur thak na jaao." Nabi ko sabse pyari namaz woh thi jo musalsal (poori zindagi) padhi jaaye, chahe woh thodi ho. Aur jab bhi Nabi koi namaz padhte, use hamesha padhte.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) never fasted a full month except the month of Ramadan, and he used to fast till one could say, "By Allah, he will never stop fasting," and he would abandon fasting till one would say, "By Allah, he will never fast
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne kabhi poora mahina roza nahi rakha siwaye Ramadan ke, aur woh itna roza rakhte ke koi kehta: "Allah ki qasam, woh roza rakhna kabhi na chhodenge," aur woh itna roza chhodte ke koi kehta: "Allah ki qasam, woh kabhi roza rakhena hi nahi karenge."

e: Narrated Anas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to leave fasting in a certain month till we thought that he would not fast in that month, and he used to fast in another month till we thought he would not stop fasting at all in that month. And if one wanted to see him praying at night, one could see him (in that condition), and if one wanted to see him sleeping at night, one could see him (in that condition) too
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool kisi khaas mahine mein roza chhod dete yahan tak ke humein lagta woh us mahine mein bilkul roza nahi rakhenge, aur woh kisi doosre mahine mein itna roza rakhte ke humein lagta woh us mahine mein bilkul roza nahi chhodenge. Aur agar koi unhe raat ko namaz padhte dekhna chahta, dekh sakta tha, aur agar koi unhe raat ko sote dekhna chahta, dekh sakta tha.

e: Narrated Humaid:I asked Anas about the fasting of the Prophet. He said "Whenever I liked to see the Prophet (ﷺ) fasting in any month, I could see that, and whenever I liked to see him not fasting, I could see that too, and if I liked to see him praying in any night, I could see that, and if I liked to see him sleeping, I could see that, too." Anas further said, "I never touched silk or velvet softer than the hand of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and never smelled musk or perfumed smoke more pleasant than the smell of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
hi: Humaid bataate hain: Maine Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se Nabi ke roze ke baare mein pucha. Unhone kaha: "Jab bhi mujhe Nabi ko kisi mahine roza rakhte dekhna hota, main dekh sakta tha, aur jab bhi mujhe unhe roza na rakhte dekhna hota, main dekh sakta tha, aur agar mujhe unhe kisi raat namaz padhte dekhna hota, main dekh sakta tha, aur agar mujhe unhe sote dekhna hota, main dekh sakta tha." Anas ne aage kaha: "Maine kabhi resham ya makhmal ko Allah ke Rasool ke haath se zyada narm nahi mehsoos kiya, aur kabhi mushk ya khushbudaar dhuan Allah ke Rasool ki khushbu se zyada pyara nahi sunga."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr bin Al-`As:"Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to me," and then he narrated the whole narration, i.e. your guest has a right on you, and your wife has a right on you. I then asked about the fasting of David. The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Half of the year," (i.e. he used to fast on every alternate day)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Aas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: "Ek baar Allah ke Rasool mere paas aaye," phir unhone poori riwayat bayan ki, yaani tumhare mehmaan ka tumpar haqq hai, aur tumhari biwi ka tumpar haqq hai. Phir maine Dawud (علیہ السلام) ke roze ke baare mein pucha. Nabi ne jawab diya: "Aadha saal," (yaani woh har alternate din roza rakhte the).

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr bin Al-`As:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me, "O `Abdullah! Have I not been informed that you fast during the day and offer prayers all the night." `Abdullah replied, "Yes, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Don't do that; fast for few days and then give it up for few days, offer prayers and also sleep at night, as your body has a right on you, and your wife has a right on you, and your guest has a right on you. And it is sufficient for you to fast three days in a month, as the reward of a good deed is multiplied ten times, so it will be like fasting throughout the year." I insisted (on fasting) and so I was given a hard instruction. I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have power." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Fast like the fasting of the Prophet David (ﷺ) and do not fast more than that." I said, "How was the fasting of the Prophet of Allah, David (ﷺ)?" He said, "Half of the year," (i.e. he used to fast on every alternate day). Afterwards when `Abdullah became old, he used to say, "It would have been better for me if I had accepted the permission of the Prophet (which he gave me i.e. to fast only three days a month)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Aas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne mujhse kaha: "Aye Abdullah! Kya mujhe bataya nahi gaya ke tum din bhar roza rakhte ho aur poori raat namaz padhte ho?" Abdullah ne jawab diya: "Haan, Ya Allah ke Rasool!" Nabi ne kaha: "Aisa mat karo; kuch din roza rakho phir kuch din chhod do, namaz padho aur raat ko so bhi jao, kyunke tumhare jism ka bhi tumpar haqq hai, aur tumhari biwi ka bhi tumpar haqq hai, aur tumhare mehmaan ka bhi tumpar haqq hai. Aur mahine mein teen din roza rakhna tumhare liye kaafi hai, kyunke neik amal ka ajr das guna badhaya jaata hai, isliye yeh poore saal roza rakhne jaisa hoga." Maine (roza rakhne par) zid ki, isliye mujhe sakht hukum diya gaya. Maine kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Mujhme taaqat hai." Nabi ne kaha: "Nabi Dawud jaisa roza rakho aur usse zyada mat rakho." Maine pucha: "Allah ke Nabi Dawud ka roza kaisa tha?" Aap ne kaha: "Aadha saal," (yaani woh har alternate din roza rakhte the). Baad mein jab Abdullah budhe ho gaye, woh kahte: "Kaash maine Nabi ki di hui ijazat (mahine mein sirf teen din roza rakhne ki) qubool kar li hoti."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was informed that I had taken an oath to fast daily and to pray (every night) all the night throughout my life (so Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to me and asked whether it was correct): I replied, "Let my parents be sacrificed for you! I said so." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You can not do that. So, fast for few days and give it up for few days, offer Salat (prayer) and sleep. Fast three days a month as the reward of good deeds is multiplied ten times and that will be equal to one year of fasting." I replied, "I can do better than that." The Prophet (ﷺ) said to me, "Fast one day and give up fasting for two days." I replied, "I can do better than that." The Prophet (ﷺ) said to me, "Fast one day and give up fasting for a day and that is the fasting of Prophet David and that is the best fasting." I said, "I have the power to fast better (more) than that." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There is no better fasting than that
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ko yeh khabar mili ke maine har din roza rakhne aur poori zindagi (har raat) poori raat namaz padhne ki qasam khaayi hai (isliye Allah ke Rasool mere paas aaye aur pucha kya yeh sahi hai): Maine jawab diya: "Mere maa-baap aap par qurban hon! Maine aisa kaha." Nabi ne kaha: "Tum aisa nahi kar sakte. Isliye kuch din roza rakho aur kuch din chhod do, namaz padho aur so bhi jao. Mahine mein teen din roza rakho kyunke neik amal ka ajr das guna badhaya jaata hai aur yeh ek saal ke roze ke barabar hoga." Maine kaha: "Main isse zyada kar sakta hoon." Nabi ne mujhse kaha: "Ek din roza rakho aur do din chhod do." Maine kaha: "Main isse zyada kar sakta hoon." Nabi ne mujhse kaha: "Ek din roza rakho aur ek din chhod do, aur yehi Nabi Dawud ka roza hai aur yehi behtareen roza hai." Maine kaha: "Mujhme isse zyada roza rakhne ki taaqat hai." Nabi ne kaha: "Isse behtar koi roza nahi."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:The news of my daily fasting and praying every night throughout the night reached the Prophet. So he sent for me or I met him, and he said, "I have been informed that you fast everyday and pray every night (all the night). Fast (for some days) and give up fasting (for some days); pray and sleep, for your eyes have a right on you, and your body and your family (i.e. wife) have a right on you." I replied, "I have more power than that (fasting)." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Then fast like the fasts of (the Prophet) David". I said, "How?" He replied, "He used to fast on alternate days, and he used not to flee on meeting the enemy." I said, "From where can I get that chance?" (`Ata' said, "I do not know how the expression of fasting daily throughout the life occurred.") So, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, twice, "Whoever fasts daily throughout his life is just as the one who does not fast at all
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Meri har-roz roza aur har-raat poori raat namaz padhne ki khabar Nabi tak pahunchi. Isliye unhone mujhe bulaya ya main unse mila, aur unhone kaha: "Mujhe bataya gaya hai ke tum har din roza rakhte ho aur poori raat (har raat) namaz padhte ho. Roza rakho (kuch dinon ke liye) aur roza chhod do (kuch dinon ke liye); namaz padho aur so bhi jao, kyunke tumhari aankhon ka bhi tumpar haqq hai, aur tumhare jism aur tumhare pariwara (biwi) ka bhi tumpar haqq hai." Maine jawab diya: "Mujhme isse zyada taaqat hai." Nabi ne kaha: "To phir (Nabi) Dawud jaisa roza rakho." Maine pucha: "Kaise?" Unhone jawab diya: "Woh har alternate din roza rakhte the, aur dushman se milte waqt woh kabhi bhaagte nahi the." Maine kaha: "Mujhe yeh mauka kahan milega?" (Ata ne kaha: "Mujhe nahi pata poori zindagi har-roz roza rakhne ki baat kaise aayi.") To Nabi ne do baar kaha: "Jo bhi apni poori zindagi har-roz roza rakhta hai, woh us shaks jaisa hai jo bilkul roza nahi rakhta."

e: Narrated Mujahid from `Abdullah bin `Amr:The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to `Abdullah), "Fast three days a month." `Abdullah said, (to the Prophet) "I am able to fast more than that." They kept on arguing on this matter till the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Fast on alternate days, and recite the whole Qur'an once a month." `Abdullah said, "I can recite more (in a month)," and the argument went on till the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Recite the Qur'an once each three days." (i.e. you must not recite the whole Qur'an in less than three days)
hi: Mujahid, Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke hawale se: Nabi ne (Abdullah se) kaha: "Mahine mein teen din roza rakho." Abdullah ne (Nabi se) kaha: "Mujhme isse zyada roza rakhne ki taaqat hai." Woh iss maamle par baatcheet karte rahe yahan tak ke Nabi ne kaha: "Alternate din roza rakho, aur poore Quran ki ek baar mahine mein tilawat karo." Abdullah ne kaha: "Main isse zyada (ek mahine mein) tilawat kar sakta hoon," aur baatcheet jaari rahi yahan tak ke Nabi ne kaha: "Quran ki tilawat har teen din mein ek baar karo." (yaani poore Quran ki tilawat teen din se kam mein nahi karni chahiye.)

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr bin Al-`As:The Prophet (ﷺ) said to me, "You fast daily all the year and pray every night all the night?" I replied in the affirmative. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If you keep on doing this, your eyes will become weak and your body will get tired. He who fasts all the year is as he who did not fast at all. The fasting of three days (a month) will be equal to the fasting of the whole year." I replied, "I have the power for more than this." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Then fast like the fasting of David who used to fast on alternate days and would never flee from the battle field, on meeting the enemy
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Aas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne mujhse kaha: "Tum har-roz roza rakhte ho aur poori raat namaz padhte ho?" Maine haan mein jawab diya. Nabi ne kaha: "Agar tum aisa karte rahoge, tumhari aankhein kamzor ho jaayengi aur tumhara jism thak jaayega. Jo poori zindagi roza rakhta hai woh usi jaisa hai jo bilkul roza nahi rakhta. Teen din (mahine mein) ka roza poore saal ke roze ke barabar hoga." Maine jawab diya: "Mujhme isse zyada taaqat hai." Nabi ne kaha: "To Nabi Dawud jaisa roza rakho jo alternate din roza rakhte the aur dushman se milne par jung ke maidan se kabhi bhaagte nahi the."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was informed about my fasts, and he came to me and I spread for him a leather cushion stuffed with palm fibres, but he sat on the ground and the cushion remained between me and him, and then he said, "Isn't it sufficient for you to fast three days a month?" I replied, "O Allah's Apostle! (I can fast more)." He said, "Five?" I replied, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! (I can fast more)." He said, "Seven?" I replied, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! (I can fast more)." He said, "Nine (days per month)?" I replied, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! (I can fast more)" He said, "Eleven (days per month)?" And then the Prophet said, "There is no fast superior to that of the Prophet David (ﷺ) it was for half of the year. So, fast on alternate days
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ko mere roze ke baare mein bataya gaya, aur woh mere paas aaye, maine unke liye khajoor ke resse se bhara chamde ka takiya bichhaya, magar woh zameen par baithe aur takiya mere aur unke darmiyan reh gaya, phir unhone kaha: "Kya tumhare liye mahine mein teen din roza rakhna kaafi nahi?" Maine kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! (Main aur bhi rakh sakta hoon)." Unhone kaha: "Paanch?" Maine kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! (Main aur bhi rakh sakta hoon)." Unhone kaha: "Saat?" Maine kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! (Main aur bhi rakh sakta hoon)." Unhone kaha: "Nau (din mahine mein)?" Maine kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! (Main aur bhi rakh sakta hoon)." Unhone kaha: "Gyarah (din mahine mein)?" Aur phir Nabi ne kaha: "Nabi Dawud ke roze se behtar koi roza nahi hai; woh aadhe saal ke barabar tha. Isliye alternate din roza rakho."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:My friend (the Prophet (ﷺ) ) advised me to observe three things: (1) to fast three days a month; (2) to pray two rak`at of Duha prayer (forenoon prayer); and (3) to pray witr before sleeping
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Mere dost (Nabi) ne mujhe teen baaton ki naseehat di: (1) har mahine teen din roza rakhna; (2) Duha ki do rakat padhna; aur (3) sone se pehle Witr padhna.

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) paid a visit to Um-Sulaim and she placed before him dates and ghee. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Replace the ghee and dates in their respective containers for I am fasting." Then he stood somewhere in her house and offered an optional prayer and then he invoked good on Um-Sulaim and her family. Then Um-Sulaim said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have a special request (today)." He said, "What is it?" She replied, "(Please invoke for) your servant Anas." So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not leave anything good in the world or the Hereafter which he did not invoke (Allah to bestow) on me and said, "O Allah! Give him (i.e. Anas) property and children and bless him." Thus I am one of the richest among the Ansar and my daughter Umaina told me that when Al-Hajjaj came to Basra, more than 120 of my offspring had been buried
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi Um-Sulaim ke ghar gaye aur unhone unke saamne khajoor aur ghee rakha. Nabi ne kaha: "Ghee aur khajoor wapas apne bartanon mein rakh do, kyunke main roze se hoon." Phir Aap unke ghar mein kahin khade hue aur nafil namaz padhi, phir Um-Sulaim aur unke pariwara ke liye bhalai ki dua ki. Phir Um-Sulaim ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Meri ek khaas guzarish hai (aaj)." Aap ne pucha: "Kya hai?" Usne jawab diya: "(Kripya dua karein) aapke khadim Anas ke liye." To Allah ke Rasool ne is duniya ya Aakhirat mein koi bhalai nahi chhodi jiski unke liye (mere liye) dua na ki ho aur kaha: "Aye Allah! Ise (Anas ko) maal aur aulad de aur usme barkat de." Isi wajah se main Ansaar mein sabse zyada maldaaron mein se hoon, aur meri beti Umaina ne mujhe bataya ke jab Al-Hajjaj Basra aaye, mere 120 se zyada aulad-ausiyaal dafn ki ja chuki thi.

e: Narrated Mutarrif from `Imran Ibn Husain:That the Prophet (ﷺ) asked him (Imran) or asked a man and `Imran was listening, "O Abu so-and-so! Have you fasted the last days of this month?" (The narrator thought that he said, "the month of Ramadan"). The man replied, "No, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "When you finish your fasting (of Ramadan) fast two days (in Shawwal)." Through another series of narrators `Imran said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, '(Have you fasted) the last days of Sha'ban?
hi: Mutarrif, Imran Ibn Husain ke hawale se: Nabi ne unse (Imran se) pucha, ya kisi shaks se pucha jabke Imran sun rahe the, "Aye Abu falaan! Kya tumne is mahine ke aakhri din roza rakha?" (Raawi ko laga unhone kaha "Ramadan ke mahine ke"). Shaks ne jawab diya: "Nahi, Ya Allah ke Rasool!" Nabi ne unse kaha: "Jab tum apna roza (Ramadan ka) khatam kar lo, to (Shawwal mein) do din roza rakho." Ek doosri riwayat mein Imran ne kaha: "Nabi ne kaha: '(Kya tumne roza rakha) Sha'ban ke aakhri dinon mein?'"

e: Narrated Muhammad bin `Abbas:I asked Jabir "Did the Prophet (ﷺ) forbid fasting on Fridays?" He replied, "Yes." (Other narrators added, "If he intends to fast only that day)
hi: Muhammad bin Abbas bataate hain: Maine Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha: "Kya Nabi ne Jumme ko roza rakhne se mana kiya?" Unhone haan mein jawab diya. (Doosre raawiyon ne joda: "Agar woh sirf usi din roza rakhna chahe.")

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "None of you should fast on Friday unless he fasts a day before or after it
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi ko farmate suna: "Tum mein se koi Jumme ko roza na rakhe siwaye jab usse ek din pehle ya baad bhi roza rakhna ho."

e: Narrated Abu Aiyub from Juwairiya bint Al-Harith:The Prophet (ﷺ) visited her (Juwairiya) on a Friday and she was fasting. He asked her, "Did you fast yesterday?" She said, "No." He said, "Do you intend to fast tomorrow?" She said, "No." He said, "Then break your fast." Through another series of narrators, Abu Aiyub is reported to have said, "He ordered her and she broke her fast
hi: Abu Aiyub, Juwairiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Al-Harith ke hawale se: Nabi unse (Juwairiya se) Jumme ke din milne gaye aur woh roze se thi. Aap ne unse pucha: "Kya tumne kal roza rakha tha?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi." Aap ne pucha: "Kya kal roza rakhne ka iraada hai?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi." Aap ne kaha: "Phir apna roza tod do." Ek doosri riwayat mein Abu Aiyub ne kaha: "Unhone unhe hukum diya aur unhone apna roza tod diya."

e: Narrated Alqama:I asked `Aisha "Did Allah's Apostle, use to choose some special days (for fasting)?" She replied, "No, but he used to be regular (constant) (in his service of worshipping). Who amongst you can endure what Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to endure?
hi: Alqama bataate hain: Maine Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se pucha: "Kya Allah ke Rasool kuch khaas din (roze ke liye) chunte the?" Unhone jawab diya: "Nahi, magar woh musalsal (roze mein) pabandi se rahte the. Tum mein se kaun woh sehen kar sakta hai jo Allah ke Rasool sehen karte the?"

e: Narrated Um Al-Fadl bint Al-Harith:"While the people were with me on the day of `Arafat they differed as to whether the Prophet (ﷺ) was fasting or not; some said that he was fasting while others said that he was not fasting. So, I sent to him a bowl full of milk while he was riding over his camel and he drank it
hi: Um Al-Fadl bint Al-Harith bataati hain: "Jabke log mere paas Arafat ke din the, unme ikhtilaaf hua kya Nabi roze se hain ya nahi; kuch ne kaha woh roze se hain jabke doosron ne kaha woh roze se nahi hain. Isliye maine unhe doodh se bhara ek pyaala bheja jabke woh apni oont par sawar the aur unhone use piya."

e: Narrated Maimuna:The people doubted whether the Prophet (ﷺ) was fasting on the day of `Arafat or not, so I sent milk while he was standing at `Arafat, he drank it and the people were looking at him
hi: Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Logon ko shak tha kya Nabi Arafat ke din roze se hain ya nahi, isliye maine unhe doodh bheja jabke woh Arafat mein khade the, unhone use piya aur log unhe dekh rahe the.

e: Narrated Abu `Ubaid:(the slave of Ibn Azhar) I witnessed the `Id with `Umar bin Al-Khattab who said, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has forbidden people to fast on the day on which you break fasting (the fasts of Ramadan) and the day on which you eat the meat of your sacrifices (the first day of `Id ul Fitr and `Id ul-Adha)
hi: Abu Ubaid (Ibn Azhar ke gulam) bataate hain: Maine Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Khattab (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath Eid dekhi, unhone kaha: "Allah ke Rasool ne logon ko us din roza rakhne se mana kiya jis din tum apna roza kholte ho (Ramadan ke roze) aur us din jis din tum apni qurbani ka gosht khate ho (Eid-ul-Fitr aur Eid-ul-Adha ka pehla din)."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the fasting of `Id-ul-Fitr and `Id-ul-Adha (two feast days) and also the wearing of As-Samma' (a single garment covering the whole body), and sitting with one's leg drawn up while being wrapped in one garment. He also forbade the prayers after the Fajr (morning) and the `Asr (afternoon) prayers
hi: Abu Saeed (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Eid-ul-Fitr aur Eid-ul-Adha (do Eid ke din) roza rakhne se mana kiya, aur As-Samma (poore badan ko dhaakne wala ek hi kapda) pehnne se, aur ek kapde mein lipt kar apni taang samete baithne se. Aap ne Fajr aur Asr ki namaz ke baad namaz padhne se bhi mana kiya.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Two fasts and two kinds of sale are forbidden: fasting on the day of `Id ul Fitr and `Id-ul-Adha and the kinds of sale called Mulamasa and Munabadha. (These two kinds of sale used to be practiced in the days of Pre-Islamic period of ignorance; Mulamasa means when you touch something displayed for sale you have to buy it; Munabadha means when the seller throws something to you, you have to buy it)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Do roze aur do qisam ki bikri mana hai: Eid-ul-Fitr aur Eid-ul-Adha ke din roza rakhna, aur Mulamasa aur Munabadha naam ki bikri. (Yeh do qisam ki bikri jahiliyat ke zamane mein hoti thi; Mulamasa ka matlab hai jab tum kisi bikri ke liye rakhi cheez ko chhuo, tumhe use khareedna padta; Munabadha ka matlab hai jab bechne wala tumhari taraf koi cheez phenke, tumhe use khareedna padta.)

e: Narrated Ziyad bin Jubair:A man went to Ibn `Umar and said, "A man vowed to fast one day (the sub-narrator thinks that he said that the day was Monday), and that day happened to be `Id day." Ibn `Umar said, "Allah orders vows to be fulfilled and the Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the fasting on this day (i.e. Id)
hi: Ziyad bin Jubair bataate hain: Ek shaks Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas gaya aur kaha: "Ek shaks ne ek din roza rakhne ki mannat maani thi (raawi ko laga usne kaha Somvar), aur woh din Eid ka din ban gaya." Ibn Umar ne kaha: "Allah mannaton ko poora karne ka hukum deta hai, aur Nabi ne is din (Eid ke) roza rakhne se mana kiya."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:(who fought in twelve Ghazawat in the company of the Prophet). I heard four things from the Prophet (ﷺ) and they won my admiration. He said; -1. "No lady should travel on a journey of two days except with her husband or a Dhi-Mahram; -2. "No fasting is permissible on the two days of Id-ul-Fitr and `Id-ul-Adha; -3. "No prayer (may be offered) after the morning compulsory prayer until the sun rises; and no prayer after the `Asr prayer till the sun sets; -4. "One should travel only for visiting three Masjid (Mosques): Masjid-al-Haram (Mecca), Masjid-al- Aqsa (Jerusalem), and this (my) Mosque (at Medina)
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ), jinhone Nabi ke saath barah Ghazwe kiye, ne kaha: Maine Nabi se chaar baatein sunin jinse mujhe khushi aur tasdeeq mili. Aap ne farmaya: 1. "Koi aurat do din ke safar par apne shohar ya Dhi-Mahram ke bina na jaaye." 2. "Eid-ul-Fitr aur Eid-ul-Adha ke do dinon mein roza jaiz nahi." 3. "Fajr ki farz namaz ke baad koi namaz nahi jab tak suraj na nikle, aur Asr ki namaz ke baad koi namaz nahi jab tak suraj na doobe." 4. "Sirf teen masjidon ke liye safar karna chahiye: Al-Masjid-Al-Haram (Mecca), Masjid-al-Aqsa (Jerusalem), aur yeh (meri) Masjid (Madina)."

e: Narrated Yahya:Hisham said, "My father said that 'Aishah (ra) used to observe Saum (fast) on the days of Mina." His (i.e., Hisham's) father also used to observe Saum on those days
hi: Yahya bataate hain: Hisham ne kaha: "Mere waalid ne kaha ke Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) Mina ke dinon mein roza rakhti thi." Hisham ke waalid bhi un dinon roza rakhte the.

e: Narrated `Aisha and Ibn `Umar:Nobody was allowed to fast on the days of Tashriq except those who could not afford the Hadi (Sacrifice)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) aur Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Tashriq ke dinon (11-13 Zul-Hijja) mein kisi ko roza rakhne ki ijazat nahi thi siwaye un logon ke jo Hadi (qurbani ka janwar) na de sakte ho.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Fasting for those who perform ,Hajj-at-Tamattu` (in lieu of the Hadi which they cannot afford) may be performed up to the day of `Arafat. And if one does not get a Hadi and has not fasted (before the `Id) then one should fast of the days of Mina. (11th, 12th and 13th of Dhul Hijjah)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Jo Hajj-at-Tamattu karte hain (unke liye jinhone Hadi ka intezaam na kiya ho), unka roza Arafat ke din tak rakha ja sakta hai. Aur agar kisi ke paas Hadi nahi hai aur usne (Eid se pehle) roza nahi rakha, to use Mina ke dinon (11, 12, 13 Zul-Hijja) mein roza rakhna chahiye.

e: Narrated Salim's father:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever wishes may fast on the day of 'Ashura
hi: Salim ke waalid bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jo bhi Ashura ke din roza rakhna chahe, rakh sakta hai."

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered (the Muslims) to fast on the day of 'Ashura', and when fasting in the month of Ramadan was prescribed, it became optional for one to fast on that day ('Ashura') or not
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool ne (Musalmanon ko) Ashura ke din roza rakhne ka hukum diya, aur jab Ramadan ke roze farz kiye gaye, us din (Ashura) roza rakhna ikhtiyaari (optional) ho gaya, chahe koi rakhe ya na rakhe.

e: Narrated Aisha:Quraish used to fast on the day of 'Ashura' in the Pre-Islamic period, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) too, used to fast on that day. When he came to Medina, he fasted on that day and ordered others to fast, too. Later when the fasting of the month of Ramadan was prescribed, he gave up fasting on the day of 'Ashura' and it became optional for one to fast on it or not
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Quraish jahiliyat ke zamane mein Ashura ka roza rakhte the, aur Allah ke Rasool bhi us din roza rakhte the. Jab Aap Madina aaye, Aap ne us din roza rakha aur doosron ko bhi rakhne ka hukum diya. Baad mein jab Ramadan ke roze farz kiye gaye, Aap ne Ashura ka roza chhod diya, aur yeh ikhtiyaari ho gaya, chahe koi rakhe ya na rakhe.

e: Narrated Humaid bin `Abdur Rahman:That he heard Muawiya bin Abi Sufyan on the day of 'Ashura' during the year he performed the Hajj, saying on the pulpit, "O the people of Medina! Where are your Religious Scholars? I heard Allah's Apostle saying, 'This is the day of 'Ashura'. Allah has not enjoined its fasting on you but I am fasting it. You have the choice either to fast or not to fast (on this day)
hi: Humaid bin Abdur Rahman bataate hain: Unhone Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko Ashura ke din, jis saal unhone Hajj kiya, mimbar par kehte suna: "Aye Madina walon! Tumhare deen ke Ulema kahan hain? Maine Allah ke Rasool ko farmate suna: 'Yeh Ashura ka din hai. Allah ne tumpar iska roza farz nahi kiya, magar main isse roza rakhta hoon. Tumhe ikhtiyaar hai chaho roza rakho ya na rakho.'"

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) came to Medina and saw the Jews fasting on the day of Ashura. He asked them about that. They replied, "This is a good day, the day on which Allah rescued Bani Israel from their enemy. So, Moses fasted this day." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "We have more claim over Moses than you." So, the Prophet fasted on that day and ordered (the Muslims) to fast (on that day)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi Madina aaye aur Yahudiyon ko Ashura ke din roza rakhte dekha. Unhone unse iski wajah pucchi. Unhone jawab diya: "Yeh ek achha din hai, wahi din jis din Allah ne Bani Israel ko unke dushman se bachaya. Isliye Musa ne is din roza rakha." Nabi ne kaha: "Humara Musa par tumse zyada haqq hai." Isliye Nabi ne us din roza rakha aur (Musalmanon ko) roza rakhne ka hukum diya.

e: Narrated Abu Musa:The day of 'Ashura' was considered as `Id day by the Jews. So the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered, "I recommend you (Muslims) to fast on this day
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ashura ka din Yahudiyon ki Eid maana jata tha. Isliye Nabi ne hukum diya: "Main tumhe (Musalmanon ko) is din roza rakhne ki sifarish karta hoon."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I never saw the Prophet (ﷺ) seeking to fast on a day that he favored more than another except this day, the day of 'Ashura', and this month, meaning the month of Ramadan
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Maine kabhi Nabi ko kisi doosre din se zyada Ashura ke din roza rakhne ki kosish karte nahi dekha, siwaye is mahine ke, yaani Ramadan ke.

e: Narrated Salama bin Al-Akwa`:The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered a man from the tribe of Bani Aslam to announce amongst the people that whoever had eaten should fast the rest of the day, and whoever had not eaten should continue his fast, as that day was the day of 'Ashura
hi: Salama bin Al-Akwa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Bani Aslam qabile ke ek shaks ko logon mein yeh elaan karne ka hukum diya ke jisne khaya hai, woh baaki din ka roza rakhe, aur jisne nahi khaya, woh apna roza jaari rakhe, kyunke woh din Ashura ka din tha.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying regarding Ramadan, "Whoever prayed at night in it (the month of Ramadan) out of sincere Faith and hoping for a reward from Allah, then all his previous sins will be forgiven
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool ko Ramadan ke baare mein farmate suna: "Jo bhi is (Ramadan) mahine mein sacche iman aur Allah se ajr ki ummeed rakhte hue raat ki namaz padhe, uske pichhle sab gunah maaf kar diye jaayenge."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever prayed at night the whole month of Ramadan out of sincere Faith and hoping for a reward from Allah, then all his previous sins will be forgiven." Ibn Shihab (a sub-narrator) said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died and the people continued observing that (i.e. Nawafil offered individually, not in congregation), and it remained as it was during the Caliphate of Abu Bakr and in the early days of 'Umar's Caliphate
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jo bhi Ramadan ke poore mahine mein sacche iman aur Allah se ajr ki ummeed rakhte hue raat ki namaz padhe, uske pichhle sab gunah maaf kar diye jaayenge." Ibn Shihab (ek raawi) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool ka intiqal hua aur log yehi (Nawafil alag-alag padhna, jamaat mein nahi) karte rahe, aur yeh Abu Bakr ki khilafat mein aur Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki khilafat ke shuru ke dinon mein bhi waisa hi raha."

e: Abdur Rahman bin 'Abdul Qari said, "I went out in the company of 'Umar bin Al-Khattab one night in Ramadan to the mosque and found the people praying in different groups. A man praying alone or a man praying with a little group behind him. So, 'Umar said, 'In my opinion I would better collect these (people) under the leadership of one Qari (Reciter) (i.e. let them pray in congregation!)'. So, he made up his mind to congregate them behind Ubai bin Ka'b. Then on another night I went again in his company and the people were praying behind their reciter. On that, 'Umar remarked, 'What an excellent Bid'a (i.e. innovation in religion) this is; but the prayer which they do not perform, but sleep at its time is better than the one they are offering.' He meant the prayer in the last part of the night. (In those days) people used to pray in the early part of the night
hi: Abdur Rahman bin Abdul Qari bataate hain: "Main ek raat Ramadan mein Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Khattab (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath masjid mein gaya aur logon ko alag-alag jhundo mein namaz padhte dekha. Koi akela padh raha tha, koi kisi chhote se giroh ke saath. Isspar Umar ne kaha: 'Mere khayaal se behtar hoga agar main in sabko ek Qari (paathak) ki imamat mein jama kar dun (yaani unhe jamaat mein padhana chahiye).' Isliye unhone unhe Ubai bin Ka'b (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki imamat mein jama karne ka faisla kiya. Phir ek doosri raat main phir unke saath gaya aur log apne paathak ke peechhe padh rahe the. Isspar Umar ne kaha: 'Yeh kitni behtareen Bid'a (yaani deen mein naya riwaaj) hai; magar jo namaz woh nahi padhte balki uske waqt sote hain, woh us namaz se behtar hai jo woh padh rahe hain,' unka matlab raat ke aakhri hisse ki namaz se tha. (Un dinon) log raat ke shuru mein namaz padhte the."

e: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to pray (at night) in Ramadan
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki biwi) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool Ramadan mein (raat ko) namaz padhte the.

e: Narrated 'Urwa:That he was informed by `Aisha, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went out in the middle of the night and prayed in the mosque and some men prayed behind him. In the morning, the people spoke about it and then a large number of them gathered and prayed behind him (on the second night). In the next morning the people again talked about it and on the third night the mosque was full with a large number of people. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came out and the people prayed behind him. On the fourth night the Mosque was overwhelmed with people and could not accommodate them, but the Prophet (ﷺ) came out (only) for the morning prayer. When the morning prayer was finished he recited Tashah-hud and (addressing the people) said, "Amma ba'du, your presence was not hidden from me but I was afraid lest the night prayer (Qiyam) should be enjoined on you and you might not be able to carry it on." So, Allah's Apostle died and the situation remained like that (i.e. people prayed individually)
hi: Urwa bataate hain: Unhe Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne bataya: "Allah ke Rasool aadhi raat ko bahar gaye aur masjid mein namaz padhi aur kuch log unke peechhe padhe. Subah, logon ne iske baare mein baat ki aur bahut se log jama ho gaye aur unke peechhe padhe (doosri raat). Agli subah phir logon ne iske baare mein baat ki aur teesri raat masjid bahut se logon se bhar gayi. Allah ke Rasool bahar aaye aur log unke peechhe padhe. Chauthi raat masjid itni bhirr se bhar gayi ke usme sab log samaa nahi paaye, magar Nabi sirf Fajr ki namaz ke liye (Musalla ki taraf) bahar aaye. Fajr ki namaz khatam karke, unhone Tashahhud padha aur (logon se khitaab karke) kaha: 'Amma ba'du, mujhse tumhari maujoodgi chhupi nahi thi, magar mujhe dar tha kahin raat ki namaz (Qiyam) tumpar farz na ho jaaye aur tum use jaari na rakh sako.' To Allah ke Rasool ka intiqal ho gaya aur halaat waisi hi rahi (yaani log alag-alag namaz padhte rahe)."

e: Narrated Abu Salama bin `Abdur Rahman:that he asked `Aisha "How was the prayer of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in Ramadan?" She replied, "He did not pray more than eleven rak`at in Ramadan or in any other month. He used to pray four rak`at ---- let alone their beauty and length----and then he would pray four ----let alone their beauty and length ---- and then he would pray three rak`at (witr)." She added, "I asked, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Do you sleep before praying the witr?' He replied, 'O `Aisha! My eyes sleep but my heart does not sleep
hi: Abu Salama bin Abdur Rahman bataate hain: Unhone Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se pucha: "Ramadan mein Allah ke Rasool ki namaz kaisi thi?" Unhone jawab diya: "Aap Ramadan mein ya kisi bhi doosre mahine mein gyarah rakat se zyada nahi padhte the. Aap chaar rakat padhte — mujhse unki khoobsurati aur lambai ke baare mein na poochho — phir chaar rakat padhte — mujhse unki khoobsurati aur lambai ke baare mein na poochho — phir teen rakat (Witr) padhte." Unhone joda: "Maine pucha: 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Kya aap Witr padhne se pehle sote hain?' Aap ne jawab diya: 'Aye Ayesha! Meri aankhein sotin hain magar mera dil nahi sota.'"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever fasted the month of Ramadan out of sincere Faith (i.e. belief) and hoping for a reward from Allah, then all his past sins will be forgiven, and whoever stood for the prayers in the night of Qadr out of sincere Faith and hoping for a reward from Allah, then all his previous sins will be forgiven
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jo bhi Ramadan mahine mein sacche iman aur Allah se ajr ki ummeed rakhte hue roza rakhe, uske pichhle sab gunah maaf kar diye jaayenge, aur jo bhi Shab-e-Qadr ki raat namaz padhe sacche iman aur Allah se ajr ki ummeed rakhte hue, uske pichhle sab gunah maaf kar diye jaayenge."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Some men amongst the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) were shown in their dreams that the night of Qadr was in the last seven nights of Ramadan. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "It seems that all your dreams agree that (the Night of Qadr) is in the last seven nights, and whoever wants to search for it (i.e. the Night of Qadr) should search in the last seven (nights of Ramadan)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ke kuch sahaba ko apne khwabon mein dikhaya gaya ke Shab-e-Qadr Ramadan ki aakhri saat raaton mein hai. Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Aisa lagta hai tum sab ke khwab is baat par muttafiq hain ke yeh aakhri saat raaton mein hai, isliye jo isse dhoondna chahe, use aakhri saat (Ramadan ki raaton) mein dhoondna chahiye."

e: Narrated Abu Salama:I asked Abu Sa`id, and he was a friend of mine, (about the Night of Qadr) and he said, "We practiced I`tikaf (seclusion in the mosque) in the middle third of the month of Ramadan with the Prophet (ﷺ) . In the morning of the 20th of Ramadan, the Prophet (ﷺ) came and addressed us and said, 'I was informed of (the date of the Night of Qadr) but I was caused to forget it; so search for it in the odd nights of the last ten nights of the month of Ramadan. (In the dream) I saw myself prostrating in mud and water (as a sign). So, whoever was in I`tikaf with me should return to it with me (for another 10-day's period)', and we returned. At that time there was no sign of clouds in the sky but suddenly a cloud came and it rained till rainwater started leaking through the roof of the mosque which was made of date-palm leaf stalks. Then the prayer was established and I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prostrating in mud and water and I saw the traces of mud on his forehead
hi: Abu Salama bataate hain: Maine Abu Saeed se pucha, aur woh mere dost the, (Shab-e-Qadr ke baare mein), unhone kaha: "Hum Nabi ke saath Ramadan ke darmiyani das dinon mein I'tikaf (masjid mein rehna, ibadat ke liye) karte the. 20 Ramadan ki subah, Nabi aaye aur humse khitaab karte huye kaha: 'Mujhe (Shab-e-Qadr ki taareekh) bataai gayi thi magar mujhe bhulwa diya gaya; isliye ise Ramadan ke aakhri das dinon ke taaq (odd) raaton mein dhoondo. (Khwab mein) maine khud ko kichad aur paani mein sajda karte dekha (ek nishani ke tor par). Isliye jo bhi mere saath I'tikaf mein tha, use mere saath dobara aana chahiye (aur ek doosre 10-din ke arse ke liye).' Aur hum wapas laute. Us waqt aasman mein badalon ka koi nishaan nahi tha magar achanak ek baadal aaya aur itni baarish hui ke paani masjid ki chhat se (jo khajoor ke tanon se bani thi) TapaKna shuru ho gaya. Phir namaz shuru hui aur maine Allah ke Rasool ko kichad aur paani mein sajda karte dekha, aur unke maathe par kichad ke nishaan bhi dekhe."

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Search for the Night of Qadr in the odd nights of the last ten days of Ramadan
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Shab-e-Qadr ko Ramadan ke aakhri das dinon ke taaq raaton mein dhoondo."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to practice I`tikaf (in the mosque) in the middle third of Ramadan and after passing the twenty nights he used to go back to his house on the 21st, and the people who were in I`tikaf with him also used to go back to their houses. Once in Ramadan, in which he practiced I`tikaf, he established the night prayers at the night in which he used to return home, and then he addressed the people and ordered them whatever Allah wished him to order and said, "I used to practice I`tikaf for these ten days (i.e. the middle third but now I intend to stay in I`tikaf for the last ten days (of the month); so whoever was in I`tikaf with me should stay at his place of seclusion. I have verily been shown (the date of) this Night (of Qadr) but I have forgotten it. So search for it in the odd nights of the last ten days (of this month). I also saw myself (in the dream) prostrating in mud and water." On the night of the 21st, the sky was covered with clouds and it rained, and the rainwater started leaking through the roof of the mosque at the praying place of the Prophet (ﷺ) . I saw with my own eyes the Prophet at the completion of the morning prayer leaving with his face covered with mud and water
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool Ramadan ke darmiyani das dinon mein I'tikaf karte the aur bees raaton ke baad, woh 21 taareekh ko apne ghar wapas jaane the, aur unke saath I'tikaf karne wale log bhi apne gharon wapas jate the. Ek baar Ramadan mein, jab woh I'tikaf kar rahe the, unhone raat ki namaz us raat mein padhi jab woh (ghar) wapas jane wale the, phir logon se khitaab kiya aur unhe hukum diya jo Allah ne chaha, aur kaha: "Main in das dinon (yaani darmiyani das dinon) mein I'tikaf karta tha magar ab mera iraada hai ke main (mahine ke) aakhri das dinon mein I'tikaf karun; isliye jo bhi mere saath I'tikaf kar raha tha, use apni jagah par rukna chahiye. Mujhe zaroor is Raat (Shab-e-Qadr ki taareekh) dikhaee gayi thi magar main use bhool gaya hoon. Isliye ise (Ramadan ke) aakhri das dinon ke taaq raaton mein dhoondo. Maine khud ko (khwab mein) kichad-paani mein sajda karte bhi dekha." 21 taareekh ki raat, aasman badalon se dhaka hua tha aur baarish hui, aur paani masjid ki chhat se, Nabi ki namaz padhne ki jagah par, tapakna shuru ho gaya. Maine apni aankhon se dekha Nabi Fajr ki namaz mukammal hone ke baad kichad-paani se dhake chehre ke saath nikale.

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Look for (the Night of Qadr)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "(Shab-e-Qadr ko) dhoondo..."

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to practice I`tikaf in the last ten nights of Ramadan and used to say, "Look for the Night of Qadr in the last ten nights of the month of Ramadan
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool Ramadan ke aakhri das raaton mein I'tikaf karte the aur kahte: "Shab-e-Qadr ko Ramadan ke aakhri das raaton mein dhoondo."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Look for the Night of Qadr in the last ten nights of Ramadan ,' on the night when nine or seven or five nights remain out of the last ten nights of Ramadan (i.e. 21, 23, 25, respectively)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Shab-e-Qadr ko Ramadan ke aakhri das raaton mein dhoondo, us raat jab Ramadan ki aakhri das raaton mein se nau, saat ya paanch raaten baaki reh jaayein (yaani 21, 23, 25)."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The Night of Qadr is in the last ten nights of the month (Ramadan), either on the first nine or in the last (remaining) seven nights (of Ramadan)." Ibn `Abbas added, "Search for it on the twenty-fourth (of Ramadan)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Shab-e-Qadr Ramadan mahine ki aakhri das raaton mein hai, ya to pehli nau ya (Ramadan ki) aakhri (baaki bachi) saat raaton mein." Ibn Abbas ne joda: "Ise 24 taareekh ko dhoondo."

e: Narrated 'Ubada bin As-Samit:The Prophet (ﷺ) came out to inform us about the Night of Qadr but two Muslims were quarreling with each other. So, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I came out to inform you about the Night of Qadr but such-and-such persons were quarreling, so the news about it had been taken away; yet that might be for your own good, so search for it on the 29th, 27th and 25th (of Ramadan)
hi: Ubada bin As-Samit (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi bahar aaye humein Shab-e-Qadr ke baare mein batane, magar do Musalman aapas mein jhagd rahe the. Isliye Nabi ne farmaya: "Main tumhe Shab-e-Qadr ke baare mein batane nikla tha magar falaan-falaan log jhagd rahe the, isliye iska ilm meri taraf se le liya gaya (utha liya gaya); yeh shayad tumhare hi faide ke liye hai, isliye ise 29, 27, aur 25 taareekh ko dhoondo."

e: Narrated Aisha:With the start of the last ten days of Ramadan, the Prophet (ﷺ) used to tighten his waist belt (i.e. work hard) and used to pray all the night, and used to keep his family awake for the prayers
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ramadan ke aakhri das dinon ki shuruaat par, Nabi apni kamar ki patti kaste (yaani mehnat se ibadat karte), poori raat namaz padhte, aur apne pariwara ko bhi namaz ke liye jagaate.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to practice I`tikaf in the last ten days of the month of Ramadan
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool Ramadan ke aakhri das dinon mein I'tikaf karte the.

e: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) The Prophet (ﷺ) used to practice I`tikaf in the last ten days of Ramadan till he died and then his wives used to practice I`tikaf after him
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki biwi) bataati hain: Nabi Ramadan ke aakhri das dinon mein I'tikaf karte the yahan tak ke unka intiqal ho gaya, aur phir unke baad unki biwiyan I'tikaf karti thi.

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to practice I`tikaf in the middle ten days of Ramadan and once he stayed in I`tikaf till the night of the twenty-first and it was the night in the morning of which he used to come out of his I`tikaf. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever was in I`tikaf with me should stay in I`tikaf for the last ten days, for I was informed (of the date) of the Night (of Qadr) but I have been caused to forget it. (In the dream) I saw myself prostrating in mud and water in the morning of that night. So, look for it in the last ten nights and in the odd ones of them." It rained that night and the roof of the mosque dribbled as it was made of leaf stalks of date-palms. I saw with my own eyes the mark of mud and water on the forehead of the Prophet (i.e. in the morning of the twenty-first)
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool Ramadan ke darmiyani das dinon mein I'tikaf karte the aur ek baar woh 21 taareekh ki raat tak I'tikaf mein rahe, aur yehi woh raat thi jiski subah woh apna I'tikaf khatam karte the. Nabi ne farmaya: "Jo bhi mere saath I'tikaf mein tha, use aakhri das dinon mein I'tikaf mein rehnaa chahiye, kyunke mujhe (Shab-e-Qadr ki taareekh) bataai gayi thi magar mujhe bhulwa diya gaya. (Khwab mein) maine khud ko us raat ki subah kichad-paani mein sajda karte dekha. Isliye ise aakhri das raaton mein aur unme taaq (odd) raaton mein dhoondo." Us raat baarish hui aur masjid ki chhat se paani tapaknaa laga kyunke woh khajoor ke tanon se bani thi. Maine apni aankhon se Nabi ke maathe par kichad-paani ke nishaan dekhe (yaani 21 taareekh ki subah).

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to (put) bend his head (out) to me while he was in I`tikaf in the mosque during my monthly periods and I would comb and oil his hair
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi apna sar mere paas jhukate (masjid ke bahar) jabke woh masjid mein I'tikaf mein hote aur main haiz mein hoti, aur main unke baal kanghi karke tel lagati.

e: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to let his head in (the house) while he was in the mosque and I would comb and oil his hair. When in I`tikaf he used not to enter the house except for a need
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki biwi) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool apna sar (ghar mein) daakhil karte jabke woh masjid mein hote, aur main unke baal kanghi karke tel lagati. I'tikaf mein hote hue, Aap ghar mein daakhil nahi hote the siwaye kisi zaroorat ke.

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to embrace me during my menses. He also used to put his head out of the mosque while he was in I`tikaf, and I would wash it during my menses
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi mujhe apne aagosh mein lete the jabke main haiz mein hoti. Woh apna sar bhi masjid se bahar nikaalte jabke woh I'tikaf mein hote, aur main use haiz ki halat mein dhoti.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:`Umar asked the Prophet (ﷺ) "I vowed in the Pre-Islamic period of ignorance to stay in I`tikaf for one night in Al-Masjid al-Haram." The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "Fulfill your vow
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Umar ne Nabi se pucha: "Maine jahiliyat ke zamane mein Al-Masjid-Al-Haram mein ek raat I'tikaf karne ki mannat maani thi." Nabi ne unse kaha: "Apni mannat poori karo."

e: Narrated `Amra:Aisha said, "the Prophet (ﷺ) used to practice I`tikaf in the last ten days of Ramadan and I used to pitch a tent for him, and after offering the morning prayer, he used to enter the tent." Hafsa asked the permission of `Aisha to pitch a tent for her and she allowed her and she pitched her tent. When Zainab bint Jahsh saw it, she pitched another tent. In the morning the Prophet (ﷺ) noticed the tents. He said, 'What is this?" He was told of the whole situation. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do you think that they intended to do righteousness by doing this?" He therefore abandoned the I`tikaf in that month and practiced I`tikaf for ten days in the month of Shawwal
hi: Amra bataati hain: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha: "Nabi Ramadan ke aakhri das dinon mein I'tikaf karte the aur main unke liye khaimah lagati thi, aur Fajr ki namaz padhne ke baad, Aap khaimay mein daakhil hote." Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne Ayesha se ijazat maangi ke woh bhi apna khaimah lagaen, aur unhone ijazat di aur Hafsa ne apna khaimah lagaya. Jab Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Jahsh (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne yeh dekha, unhone bhi ek doosra khaimah lagaya. Subah, Nabi ne khaime dekhe. Aap ne kaha: "Yeh kya hai?" Unhe poori baat batayi gayi. Phir Nabi ne kaha: "Kya tumhe lagta hai unhone yeh neki ke iraade se kiya?" Isliye Aap ne us mahine (Ramadan mein) I'tikaf chhod diya aur Shawwal ke mahine mein das din I'tikaf kiya.

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) intended to practice I`tikaf and when he reached the place where he intended to perform I`tikaf, he saw some tents, the tents of `Aisha, Hafsa and Zainab. So, he said, "Do you consider that they intended to do righteousness by doing this?" And then he went away and did not perform I`tikaf (in Ramadan) but performed it in the month of Shawwal for ten days
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi ne I'tikaf karne ka iraada kiya aur jab woh jagah pahunche jahan I'tikaf karna tha, unhone kuch khaime dekhe, Ayesha, Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) aur Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke khaime. Isliye unhone kaha: "Kya tumhe lagta hai unhone yeh neki ke iraade se kiya?" Phir woh wapas chale gaye aur (us Ramadan mein) I'tikaf nahi kiya balki Shawwal ke mahine mein das din I'tikaf kiya.

e: Narrated `Ali bin Al-Husain:Safiya, the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ) told me that she went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to visit him in the mosque while he was in I`tikaf in the last ten days of Ramadan. She had a talk with him for a while, then she got up in order to return home. The Prophet (ﷺ) accompanied her. When they reached the gate of the mosque, opposite the door of Um-Salama, two Ansari men were passing by and they greeted Allah's Apostle . He told them: Do not run away! And said, "She is (my wife) Safiya bint Huyai." Both of them said, "Subhan Allah, (How dare we think of any evil) O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" And they felt it. The Prophet said (to them), "Satan reaches everywhere in the human body as blood reaches in it, (everywhere in one's body). I was afraid lest Satan might insert an evil thought in your minds
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bin Al-Husain bataate hain: Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا), Nabi ki biwi, ne mujhe bataya ke woh Allah ke Rasool se milne masjid gayi jabke woh Ramadan ke aakhri das dinon mein I'tikaf mein the. Unhone thodi der baat ki, phir woh apne ghar wapas jaane ke liye uṭtin. Nabi unke saath gaye. Jab woh masjid ke darwaze tak pahunche, Um Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke darwaze ke saamne, do Ansari mard guzar rahe the aur unhone Allah ke Rasool ko salaam kiya. Aap ne unse kaha: "Bhaago mat!" aur kaha: "Yeh (meri biwi) Safiya bint Huyai hain." Dono ne kaha: "Subhan Allah, (Hum aapke baare mein kaisi bhi bura khayaal kar sakte hain), Ya Allah ke Rasool!" Aur unhe bura laga. Nabi ne (unse) kaha: "Shaitan insaan ke jism mein har jagah pahunchta hai jaise khoon pahunchta hai (poore jism mein). Mujhe dar tha kahin shaitan tumhare dilon mein koi bura khayaal na daal de."

e: Narrated Abu Salama bin `Abdur-Rahman:I asked Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri, "Did you hear Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) talking about the Night of Qadr?" He replied in the affirmative and said, "Once we were in I`tikaf with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the middle ten days of (Ramadan) and we came out of it in the morning of the twentieth, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)delivered a sermon on the 20th (of Ramadan) and said, 'I was informed (of the date) of the Night of Qadr (in my dream) but had forgotten it. So, look for it in the odd nights of the last ten nights of the month of Ramadan. I saw myself prostrating in mud and water on that night (as a sign of the Night of Qadr). So, whoever had been in I`tikaf with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) should return for it.' The people returned to the mosque (for I`tikaf). There was no trace of clouds in the sky. But all of a sudden a cloud came and it rained. Then the prayer was established (they stood for the prayer) and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prostrated in mud and water and I saw mud over the forehead and the nose of the Prophet
hi: Abu Salama bin Abdur-Rahman bataate hain: Maine Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha: "Kya aapne Allah ke Rasool ko Shab-e-Qadr ke baare mein baat karte suna?" Unhone haan mein jawab diya aur kaha: "Ek baar hum Allah ke Rasool ke saath (Ramadan ke) darmiyani das dinon mein I'tikaf mein the aur hum 20 taareekh ki subah bahar aaye, aur Allah ke Rasool ne 20 Ramadan ko khutba diya aur kaha: 'Mujhe Shab-e-Qadr ki taareekh (khwab mein) bataai gayi thi magar main bhool gaya. Isliye ise Ramadan ke aakhri das raaton ke taaq raaton mein dhoondo. Maine khud ko us raat kichad-paani mein sajda karte dekha (Shab-e-Qadr ki nishani ke tor par). Isliye jo bhi Allah ke Rasool ke saath I'tikaf mein tha, use iske liye wapas aana chahiye.' Log masjid (I'tikaf ke liye) wapas laute. Aasman mein badalon ka koi nishaan nahi tha. Magar achanak ek baadal aaya aur baarish hui. Phir namaz shuru hui (log namaz ke liye khade hue) aur Allah ke Rasool ne kichad-paani mein sajda kiya aur maine Nabi ke maathe aur naak par kichad dekhi."

e: Narrated `Aisha:One of the wives of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) practiced I`tikaf with him while she had bleeding in between her periods and she would see red (blood) or yellowish traces, and sometimes we put a tray beneath her when she offered the prayer
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi ki ek biwi ne unke saath I'tikaf kiya jabke unhe apne mahine ke ilawa bhi khoon bahne ki takleef thi, aur woh laal ya peela rang ka khoon dekhti thi, aur kabhi hum unke neeche ek trai rakh dete the jab woh namaz padhti.

e: Narrated `Ali bin Al-Husain (from Safiya the Prophet's wife):The wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) were with him in the mosque (while he was in I`tikaf) and then they departed and the Prophet (ﷺ) said to Safiya bint Huyai, "Don't hurry up, for I shall accompany you," (and her dwelling was in the house of Usama). The Prophet (ﷺ) went out and in the meantime two Ansari men met him and they looked at the Prophet (ﷺ) and passed by. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to them, "Come here. She is (my wife) Safiya bint Huyai." They replied, "Subhan Allah, (How dare we think of evil) O Allah's Apostle! (we never expect anything bad from you)." The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Satan circulates in the human being as blood circulates in the body, and I was afraid lest Satan might insert an evil thought in your minds
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bin Al-Husain, Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki biwi) ke hawale se: Nabi ki biwiyan unke saath masjid mein thi (jab woh I'tikaf mein the), aur phir woh chal padi, aur Nabi ne Safiya bint Huyai se kaha: "Jaldi mat karo, main tumhare saath jaunga," (aur unka ghar Usama ke ghar mein tha). Nabi bahar gaye aur isi dauran do Ansari mard unse mile aur unhone Nabi ko dekha aur guzar gaye. Nabi ne unse kaha: "Idhar aao. Yeh (meri biwi) Safiya bint Huyai hain." Unhone jawab diya: "Subhan Allah, (Hum bura kaise soch sakte hain) Ya Allah ke Rasool! (Hum aapse kabhi bura ummeed nahi karte)." Nabi ne jawab diya: "Shaitan insaan mein aise ghumta hai jaise khoon jism mein ghumta hai, aur mujhe dar tha kahin shaitan tumhare dilon mein koi bura khayaal na daal de."

e: Narrated `Ali bin Al-Husain from Safiya:Safiya went to the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was in I`tikaf. When she returned, the Prophet (ﷺ) accompanied her walking. An Ansari man saw him. When the Prophet (ﷺ) noticed him, he called him and said, "Come here. She is Safiya. (Sufyan a sub-narrator perhaps said that the Prophet (ﷺ) had said, "This is Safiya"). And Satan circulates in the body of Adam's offspring as his blood circulates in it." (A sub-narrator asked Sufyan, "Did Safiya visit him at night?" He said, "Of course, at night)
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bin Al-Husain, Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke hawale se: Safiya Nabi ke paas gayi jabke woh I'tikaf mein the. Jab woh wapas gayi, Nabi paidal unke saath gaye. Ek Ansari shaks ne unhe dekha. Jab Nabi ne use dekha, Aap ne use bulaya aur kaha: "Idhar aao. Yeh Safiya hain." (Sufyan, ek raawi, shayad kaha ke Nabi ne kaha: "Yeh Safiya hain.") "Aur shaitan Adam ki aulad ke jism mein ghumta hai jaise unka khoon jism mein ghumta hai." (Ek raawi ne Sufyan se pucha: "Kya Safiya raat ko unse milne gayi thi?" Unhone jawab diya: "Bilkul, raat ko hi.")

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id:We practiced I`tikaf with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the middle ten days (of Ramadan). In the morning of the twentieth (of Ramadan) we shifted our baggage, but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to us and said, "Whoever was in I`tikaf should return to his place of I`tikaf, for I saw (i.e. was informed about the date of) this Night (of Qadr) and saw myself prostrating in mud and water." When I returned to my place the sky was overcast with clouds and it rained. By Him Who sent Muhammad with the Truth, the sky was covered with clouds from the end of that day, and the mosque which was roofed with leafstalks of date palm trees (leaked with rain) and I saw the trace of mud and water over the nose of the Prophet (ﷺ) and its tip
hi: Abu Saeed (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Allah ke Rasool ke saath (Ramadan ke) darmiyani das dinon mein I'tikaf kar rahe the. 20 taareekh ki subah, humne apna saaman shift kar liya, magar Allah ke Rasool humare paas aaye aur kaha: "Jo bhi I'tikaf mein tha, use apni I'tikaf ki jagah wapas jana chahiye, kyunke maine yeh Raat (Shab-e-Qadr) dekhi (yaani iski taareekh mujhe bataai gayi) aur khud ko kichad-paani mein sajda karte dekha." Jab main apni jagah wapas gaya, aasman badalon se dhaka hua tha aur baarish hui. Us zaat ki qasam jisne Muhammad ko haqq ke saath bheja, us din ke aakhir se aasman badalon se dhaka raha, aur masjid, jiski chhat khajoor ke tanon se bani thi, (baarish se tapaki) aur maine Nabi ki naak par aur uski nok par kichad-paani ka nishaan dekha.

e: Narrated `Amra bint `Abdur-Rahman from `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to practice I`tikaf every year in the month of Ramadan. And after offering the morning prayer, he used to enter the place of his I`tikaf. `Aisha asked his permission to let her practice I`tikaf and he allowed her, and so she pitched a tent in the mosque. When Hafsa heard of that, she also pitched a tent (for herself), and when Zainab heard of that, she too pitched another tent. When, in the morning, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had finished the morning prayer, he saw four tents and asked, "What is this?" He was informed about it. He then said, "What made them do this? Is it righteousness? Remove the tents, for I do not want to see them." So, the tents were removed. The Prophet (ﷺ) did not perform I`tikaf that year in the month of Ramadan, but did it in the last ten days of Shawwal
hi: Amra bint Abdur-Rahman, Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke hawale se: Allah ke Rasool har saal Ramadan ke mahine mein I'tikaf karte the. Aur Fajr ki namaz padhne ke baad, woh apni I'tikaf ki jagah mein daakhil hote. Ayesha ne unse ijazat maangi ke woh bhi I'tikaf karein aur unhone ijazat di, isliye unhone masjid mein khaimah lagaya. Jab Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko iska pata chala, unhone bhi khaimah lagaya (apne liye), aur jab Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko iska pata chala, unhone bhi ek doosra khaimah lagaya. Jab, subah ko, Allah ke Rasool Fajr ki namaz khatam kar chuke, unhone chaar khaime dekhe aur pucha: "Yeh kya hai?" Unhe iske baare mein bataaya gaya. Phir Aap ne kaha: "Unhe yeh karne par kis cheez ne uksaya? Kya yeh neki hai? Khaime hatao, main unhe dekhna nahi chahta." Isliye khaime hataaye gaye. Nabi ne us saal Ramadan mein I'tikaf nahi kiya, balki Shawwal ke aakhri das dinon mein kiya.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:`Umar bin Al-Khattab said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I vowed in the Pre-Islamic period to perform I`tikaf in Al-Masjid-al-Haram for one night." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Fulfill your vow." So, he performed I`tikaf for one night
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Umar bin Khattab (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Maine jahiliyat ke zamane mein Al-Masjid-Al-Haram mein ek raat I'tikaf karne ki mannat maani thi." Nabi ne kaha: "Apni mannat poori karo." To unhone ek raat I'tikaf kiya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:that `Umar had vowed in the Pre-Islamic period to perform I`tikaf in Al-Masjid-al-Haram. (A subnarrator thinks that `Umar vowed to perform I`tikaf for one night.) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to `Umar, "Fulfill your vow
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Umar ne jahiliyat ke zamane mein Al-Masjid-Al-Haram mein I'tikaf karne ki mannat maani thi. (Ek raawi ka khayaal hai Umar ne ek raat I'tikaf karne ki mannat maani thi.) Allah ke Rasool ne Umar se kaha: "Apni mannat poori karo."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to perform I`tikaf every year in the month of Ramadan for ten days, and when it was the year of his death, he stayed in I`tikaf for twenty days
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi har saal Ramadan mein das din I'tikaf karte the, aur jis saal unka intiqal hua, us saal woh bees din I'tikaf mein rahe.

e: Narrated `Amra bint `Abdur-Rahman from `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) mentioned that he would practice I`tikaf in the last ten days of Ramadan. `Aisha asked his permission to perform I`tikaf and he permitted her. Hafsa asked `Aisha to take his permission for her, and she did so. When Zainab bint Jahsh saw that, she ordered a tent to be pitched for her and it was pitched for her. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to proceed to his tent after the prayer. So, he saw the tents and asked, "What is this?" He was told that those were the tents of Aisha, Hafsa, and Zainab. Allah's Apostle said, "Is it righteousness which they intended by doing so? I am not going to perform I`tikaf." So he returned home. When the fasting month was over, he performed I`tikaf for ten days in the month of Shawwal
hi: Amra bint Abdur-Rahman, Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke hawale se: Allah ke Rasool ne zikar kiya ke woh Ramadan ke aakhri das dinon mein I'tikaf karenge. Ayesha ne unse I'tikaf ki ijazat maangi aur unhone ijazat di. Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne Ayesha se kaha ke woh unke liye bhi ijazat maangen, aur unhone aisa kiya. Jab Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Jahsh (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne yeh dekha, unhone bhi apna khaimah lagane ka hukum diya aur unke liye lagaya gaya. Allah ke Rasool namaz ke baad apne khaimay ki taraf jate the. Isliye unhone khaime dekhe aur pucha: "Yeh kya hai?" Unhe bataya gaya ke yeh Ayesha, Hafsa aur Zainab ke khaime hain. Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: "Kya isse woh neki (kamana) chahti hain? Main I'tikaf nahi karunga." Isliye Aap wapas ghar chale gaye. Jab roze ka mahina khatam hua, unhone Shawwal ke mahine mein das din I'tikaf kiya.

e: Narrated `Urwa:Aisha during her menses used to comb and oil the hair of the Prophet (ﷺ) while he used to be in I`tikaf in the mosque. He would stretch out his head towards her while she was in her chamber
hi: Urwa bataate hain: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) apne mahine (haiz) mein Nabi ke baal kanghi karke tel lagati jabke woh masjid mein I'tikaf mein hote. Aap apna sar unki taraf badhate jabke woh apne kamre mein hoti.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:You people say that Abu Huraira tells many narrations from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and you also wonder why the emigrants and Ansar do not narrate from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as Abu Huraira does. My emigrant brothers were busy in the market while I used to stick to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) content with what fills my stomach; so I used to be present when they were absent and I used to remember when they used to forget, and my Ansari brothers used to be busy with their properties and I was one of the poor men of Suffa. I used to remember the narrations when they used to forget. No doubt, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) once said, "Whoever spreads his garment till I have finished my present speech and then gathers it to himself, will remember whatever I will say." So, I spread my colored garment which I was wearing till Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had finished his saying, and then I gathered it to my chest. So, I did not forget any of that narrations
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Tum log kehte ho ke Abu Huraira Allah ke Rasool se bahut zyada hadithein riwayat karta hai, aur tumhe hairat hoti hai ke Muhajireen aur Ansaar Abu Huraira jitni hadithein kyun nahi riwayat karte. Mere Muhajir bhai bazaar mein masroof rehte the jabke main hamesha Allah ke Rasool ke saath rehta tha, sirf itne khaane par khush hote hue jo mera pet bhar de; isliye main tab maujood hota tha jab woh gair-maujood hote, aur mujhe woh yaad rehta jo woh bhool jate. Mere Ansaari bhai apni maal mein masroof rehte the aur main Suffa ke gareeb logon mein se ek tha. Mujhe hadithein yaad rehti thi jab woh bhool jate. Ek baar Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: "Jo bhi apna kapda phailaye jab tak main apni baat khatam na karun, phir usse apni taraf samet le, use woh sab yaad rahega jo main kahunga." Isliye maine apna rangeen kapda, jo main pehne hue tha, phailaya jab tak Allah ke Rasool apni baat khatam nahi kar liye, phir maine use apne seene se lagaya. Isliye mujhe un hadithon mein se koi nahi bhoola.

e: Narrated Ibrahim bin Sa`d from his father from his grandfather:`Abdur Rahman bin `Auf said, "When we came to Medina as emigrants, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) established a bond of brotherhood between me and Sa`d bin Ar-Rabi`. Sa`d bin Ar-Rabi` said (to me), 'I am the richest among the Ansar, so I will give you half of my wealth and you may look at my two wives and whichever of the two you may choose I will divorce her, and when she has completed the prescribed period (before marriage) you may marry her.' `Abdur-Rahman replied, "I am not in need of all that. Is there any marketplace where trade is practiced?' He replied, "The market of Qainuqa." `Abdur- Rahman went to that market the following day and brought some dried buttermilk (yogurt) and butter, and then he continued going there regularly. Few days later, `Abdur-Rahman came having traces of yellow (scent) on his body. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked him whether he had got married. He replied in the affirmative. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Whom have you married?' He replied, 'A woman from the Ansar.' Then the Prophet (ﷺ) asked, 'How much did you pay her?' He replied, '(I gave her) a gold piece equal in weigh to a date stone (or a date stone of gold)! The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Give a Walima (wedding banquet) even if with one sheep
hi: Ibrahim bin Sa'd, apne waalid ke hawale se, apne dada ke hawale se: Abdur Rahman bin Auf (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Jab hum Madina hijrat karke aaye, Allah ke Rasool ne mere aur Sa'd bin Ar-Rabi ke darmiyan bhaichare ka rishta banaya. Sa'd bin Ar-Rabi ne (mujhse) kaha: 'Main Ansaar mein sabse maldaar hoon, isliye main tumhe apni aadhi daulat de dunga aur tum meri do biwiyon mein se dekh sakte ho, jise bhi tum chuno, main use talaq de dunga, aur jab woh apni iddat (intezaar ki muddat) poori kar le, tum usse shaadi kar sakte ho.' Abdur-Rahman ne jawab diya: 'Mujhe iski koi zaroorat nahi. Kya koi bazaar hai jahan tijarat hoti ho?' Unhone jawab diya: 'Qainuqa ka bazaar.' Abdur-Rahman agle din us bazaar gaye aur kuch sookhi chhaach (yogurt) aur ghee laaye, phir wahan pabandi se jana shuru kiya. Kuch dinon baad, Abdur-Rahman peele khushbu (rang) ke nishaan samete aaye. Allah ke Rasool ne unse pucha kya unhone shaadi ki hai. Unhone haan mein jawab diya. Nabi ne pucha: 'Tumne kisse shaadi ki?' Unhone jawab diya: 'Ek Ansari aurat se.' Phir Nabi ne pucha: 'Tumne usse kitna mehar diya?' Unhone jawab diya: '(Maine use di) khajoor ke daane jitni sone ki ek dhaali (ya sone ki ek khajoor-daane ki dhaali)!' Nabi ne kaha: 'Walima (shaadi ki dawat) do, chahe ek hi bhed ke saath.'"

e: Narrated Anas:When `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf came to Medina, the Prophet (ﷺ) established a bond of brotherhood between him and Sa`d bin Ar-Rabi al-Ansari. Sa`d was a rich man, so he said to `Abdur-Rahman, "I will give you half of my property and will help you marry." `Abdur-Rahman said (to him), "May Allah bless you in your family and property. Show me the market." So `Abdur-Rahman did not return from the market) till he gained some dried buttermilk (yogurt) and butter (through trading). He brought that to his house-hold. We stayed for sometime (or as long as Allah wished), and then `Abdur-Rahman came, scented with yellowish perfume. The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to him) "What is this?" He replied, "I got married to an Ansari woman." The Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "What did you pay her?" He replied, "A gold stone or gold equal to the weight of a date stone." The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to him), "Give a wedding banquet even if with one sheep
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Abdur-Rahman bin Auf Madina aaye, Nabi ne unke aur Sa'd bin Ar-Rabi Al-Ansari ke darmiyan bhaichaaroe ka rishta banaya. Sa'd maldaar the, isliye unhone Abdur-Rahman se kaha: "Main tumhe apni aadhi maal dunga aur tumhari shaadi mein madad karunga." Abdur-Rahman ne (unse) kaha: "Allah tumhare pariwara aur maal mein barkat de. Mujhe bazaar dikhaao." Isliye Abdur-Rahman (bazaar se) tab tak wapas nahi aaye jab tak unhone (tijarat karke) kuch sookhi chhaach aur ghee na kama liya. Woh use apne ghar laaye. Hum thodi der ruke rahe (ya jitni Allah ne chaha), aur phir Abdur-Rahman peele khushbu se sugandhit hokar aaye. Nabi ne (unse) kaha: "Yeh kya hai?" Unhone jawab diya: "Maine ek Ansari aurat se shaadi ki hai." Nabi ne pucha: "Tumne usse kitna diya?" Unhone jawab diya: "Ek sone ka patthar, ya khajoor-daane jitna sona." Nabi ne (unse) kaha: "Shaadi ki dawat do, chahe ek hi bhed ke saath."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:`Ukaz, Majanna and Dhul-Majaz were marketplaces in the Pre-Islamic period of ignorance. When Islam came, Muslims felt that marketing there might be a sin. So, the Divine Inspiration came: "There is no harm for you to seek the bounty of your Lord (in the seasons of Hajj)." (2.198) Ibn `Abbas recited the Verse in this way
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Ukaz, Majanna aur Dhul-Majaz jahiliyat ke zamane mein logon ke bazaar the. Jab Islam aaya, Musalmanon ko laga ke wahan tijarat karna gunah ho sakta hai. Isliye yeh wahi nazil hui: "Isme koi harj nahi ke tum apne Rab ka fazl talaash karo (Hajj ke maheenon mein)" (2:198). Ibn Abbas ne is tarah ayat padhi.

e: Narrated An-Nu`man bin Bashir:The Prophet (ﷺ) said "Both legal and illegal things are obvious, and in between them are (suspicious) doubtful matters. So whoever forsakes those doubtful things lest he may commit a sin, will definitely avoid what is clearly illegal; and whoever indulges in these (suspicious) doubtful things bravely, is likely to commit what is clearly illegal. Sins are Allah's Hima (i.e. private pasture) and whoever pastures (his sheep) near it, is likely to get in it at any moment
hi: An-Nu'man bin Bashir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Halal aur haram dono saaf hain, aur unke darmiyan (shubhavaali) shakOK cheezein hain. Isliye jo bhi in shakOK cheezon se bachta hai (kahin uska gunah na ho jaaye), woh zaroor un cheezon se bhi bachega jo saaf haram hain; aur jo bhi bahaduri se in (shubhavaali) shakOK cheezon mein pad jaata hai, uske un cheezon mein pad jaane ka bhi khatra hai jo saaf haram hain. Gunah Allah ki Hima (yaani khaas charagaah) hai, aur jo bhi (apni bhedein) uske qareeb charata hai, woh kabhi bhi usme daakhil ho sakta hai."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abu Mulaika:`Uqba bin Al-Harith said that a black woman came and claimed that she had suckled both of them (i.e. `Uqba and his wife). So, he mentioned that to the Prophet (ﷺ) who turned his face from him and smiled and said, "How (can you keep your wife), and it was said (that both of you were suckled by the same woman)?" His wife was the daughter of Abu Ihab-al-Tamimi
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abu Mulaika bataate hain: Uqba bin Al-Harith ne kaha ke ek kaali aurat aayi aur dawa kiya ke usne dono (Uqba aur unki biwi) ko doodh pilaaya tha. Isliye unhone yeh Nabi ko bataya jinhone apna chehra unse moda aur muskuraye aur kaha: "Kaise (tum apni biwi ko rakh sakte ho), jabke yeh kaha gaya (ke tum dono ko usi aurat ne doodh pilaaya tha)?" Unki biwi Abu Ihab At-Tamimi ki beti thi.

e: Narrated Aisha:`Utba bin Abu Waqqas took a firm promise from his brother Sa`d bin Abu Waqqas to take the son of the slave-girl of Zam`a into his custody as he was his (i.e. `Utba's) son. In the year of the Conquest (of Mecca) Sa`d bin Abu Waqqas took him, and said that he was his brother's son, and his brother took a promise from him to that effect. 'Abu bin Zam`a got up and said, "He is my brother and the son of the slave-girl of my father and was born on my father's bed." Then they both went to the Prophet (ﷺ) Sa`d said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! He is the son of my brother and he has taken a promise from me that I will take him." 'Abu bin Zam`a said, "(He is) my brother and the son of my father's slave-girl and was born on my father's bed." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The boy is for you. O 'Abu bin Zam`a." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The son is for the bed (i.e. the man on whose bed he was born) and stones (disappointment and deprivation) for the one who has done illegal sexual intercourse." The Prophet (ﷺ) told his wife Sauda bint Zam`a to screen herself from that boy as he noticed a similarity between the boy and `Utba. So, the boy did not see her till he died
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Utba bin Abu Waqqas ne apne bhai Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas se ek pakka waada liya ke woh Zam'a ki launDi ke bete ko apni sarparasti mein le lein kyunke woh unka (yaani Utba ka) beta tha. Fatah-e-Mecca ke saal, Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas ne use liya aur kaha ke yeh unke bhai ka beta hai, aur unke bhai ne unse iske liye waada liya tha. Abu bin Zam'a khade hue aur kaha: "Yeh mera bhai hai, mere waalid ki launDi ka beta, aur mere waalid ke bistar par paida hua." Phir donon Nabi ke paas gaye. Sa'd ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Yeh mere bhai ka beta hai aur usne mujhse waada liya hai ke main use lunga." Abu bin Zam'a ne kaha: "(Yeh) mera bhai hai, mere waalid ki launDi ka beta, aur mere waalid ke bistar par paida hua." Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: "Yeh ladka tumhara hai, Aye Abu bin Zam'a." Phir Nabi ne kaha: "Beta bistar (yaani jiske bistar par paida hua use) mansoob hota hai, aur zina karne wale ke liye patthar (na-ummidi aur mehroomiyat)." Nabi ne apni biwi Sauda (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Zam'a ko us ladke se parda karne ko kaha kyunke unhone ladke aur Utba ke darmiyan ek samaanta dekhi thi. Isliye woh ladka unhe kabhi apni maut tak nahi dekh saka.

e: Narrated `Adi bin Hatim:I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about Al Mirad (i.e. a sharp-edged piece of wood or a piece of wood provided with a piece of iron used for hunting).
