He replied, "If the game is hit by its sharp edge, eat it, and if it is hit by its broad side, do not eat it, for it has been beaten to death." I asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I release my dog by the name of Allah and find with it at the game, another dog on which I have not mentioned the name of Allah, and I do not know which one of them caught the game." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said (to him), 'Don't eat it as you have mentioned the name of Allah on your dog and not on the other dog
hi: Adi bin Hatim (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool se Al-Mirad (yaani ek tez-dhaaar wala lakdi ka tukda, ya lohe ke tukde wali lakdi jo shikaar ke liye istemal hoti hai) ke baare mein pucha. Aap ne jawab diya: "Agar shikaar iski tez dhaaar se lage, use khao, aur agar iski chaudi taraf se lage, use na khao, kyunke yeh maar-maar kar mara gaya hoga." Maine pucha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Main apne kutte ko Allah ke naam par chhodataa hoon aur shikaar ke saath ek doosra kutta bhi paata hoon jispar maine Allah ka naam nahi liya, aur mujhe nahi pata unme se kisne shikaar pakda." Allah ke Rasool ne (unse) kaha: "Ise mat khao, kyunke tumne Allah ka naam apne kutte par liya hai, doosre kutte par nahi."

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) passed by a fallen date and said, "Were it not for my doubt that this might have been given in charity, I would have eaten it." And narrated Abu Huraira the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I found a datefruit fallen on my bed
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ek giri hui khajoor ke paas se guzre aur kaha: "Agar mujhe shak na hota ke yeh sadqe ki khajoor hai, main ise khata." Aur Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne riwayat ki ke Nabi ne kaha: "Maine apne bistar par ek giri hui khajoor paayi."

e: Narrated `Abbas bin Tamim:that his uncle said: "The Prophet (ﷺ) was asked: If a person feels something during his prayer; should one interrupt his prayer?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said: No! You should not give it up unless you hear a sound or smell something." Narrated Ibn Abi Hafsa: Az-Zuhri said, "There is no need of repeating ablution unless you detect a smell or hear a sound
hi: Abbas bin Tamim bataate hain, apne chacha ke hawale se: Nabi se pucha gaya: "Agar koi shaks apni namaz mein kuch mehsoos kare, kya use apni namaz rokani chahiye?" Nabi ne farmaya: "Nahi! Tumhe use nahi chhodna chahiye jab tak tumhe koi awaaz sunai na de ya koi badbu mehsoos na ho." Ibn Abi Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataate hain: Az-Zuhri ne kaha: "Wudu dobara karne ki koi zaroorat nahi jab tak koi badbu ya awaaz mehsoos na ho."

e: Narrated `Aisha:Some people said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Meat is brought to us by some people and we are not sure whether the name of Allah has been mentioned on it or not (at the time of slaughtering the animals)." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said (to them), "Mention the name of Allah and eat it
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Kuch logon ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Kuch log humare paas gosht late hain aur humein yaqeen nahi ke usme Allah ka naam liya gaya ya nahi (zabah karte waqt)." Allah ke Rasool ne (unse) kaha: "(Tum) Allah ka naam lo aur use khao."

e: Narrated Jabir:While we were offering the prayer with the Prophet (ﷺ) a caravan carrying food came from Sham. The people looked towards the caravan (and went to it) and only twelve persons remained with the Prophet. So, the Divine Inspiration came; "But when they see some bargain or some amusement, they disperse headlong to it
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jabke hum Nabi ke saath namaz padh rahe the, Sham se khaana lane wala ek qafila aaya. Log qafile ki taraf dekhne lage (aur uski taraf gaye) aur sirf barah log Nabi ke saath rah gaye. Isliye yeh wahi nazil hui: "Magar jab woh koi saudebaazi ya tamaasha dekhte hain, woh usi taraf bhaag jaate hain (namaz chhod kar)."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A time will come when one will not care how one gains one's money, legally or illegally
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Ek waqt aayega jab koi yeh nahi chinta karega ke usne paisa kaise kamaya, halal se ya haram se."

e: Narrated Abu Al-Minhal:I used to practice money exchange, and I asked Zaid bin 'Arqam about it, and he narrated what the Prophet said in the following: Abu Al-Minhal said, "I asked Al-Bara' bin `Azib and Zaid bin Arqam about practicing money exchange. They replied, 'We were traders in the time of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about money exchange. He replied, 'If it is from hand to hand, there is no harm in it; otherwise it is not permissible
hi: Abu Al-Minhal bataate hain: Main paise ki adla-badli (money exchange) ka kaam karta tha, aur maine Zaid bin Arqam (رضی اللہ عنہ) se iske baare mein pucha, aur unhone bataya jo Nabi ne kaha tha. Abu Al-Minhal ne kaha: "Maine Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Zaid bin Arqam se paise ki adla-badli ke baare mein pucha. Unhone jawab diya: 'Hum Allah ke Rasool ke zamane mein taajir the aur maine Allah ke Rasool se paise ki adla-badli ke baare mein pucha. Unhone jawab diya: Agar yeh haath se haath (yaani turant, ek hi jagah) ho, koi harj nahi; warna yeh jaiz nahi.'"

e: Narrated 'Ubaid bin `Umair:Abu Musa asked `Umar to admit him but he was not admitted as `Umar was busy, so Abu Musa went back. When `Umar finished his job he said, "Didn't I hear the voice of `Abdullah bin Qais? Let him come in." `Umar was told that he had left. So, he sent for him and on his arrival, he (Abu Musa) said, "We were ordered to do so (i.e. to leave if not admitted after asking permission thrice). `Umar told him, "Bring witness in proof of your statement." Abu Musa went to the Ansar's meeting places and asked them. They said, "None amongst us will give this witness except the youngest of us, Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri. Abu Musa then took Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri (to `Umar) and `Umar said, surprisingly, "Has this order of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) been hidden from me?" (Then he added), "I used to be busy trading in markets
hi: Ubaid bin Umair bataate hain: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se andar aane ki ijazat maangi magar unhe ijazat nahi mili kyunke Umar masroof the, isliye Abu Musa wapas chale gaye. Jab Umar apna kaam khatam kar chuke, unhone kaha: "Kya maine Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Qais ki aawaaz nahi suni? Use andar aane do." Umar ko bataya gaya ke woh chale gaye hain. Isliye unhone unhe bulwaya, aur (Abu Musa) aane par, unhone (Umar se) kaha: "Humein aisa karne ka hukum diya gaya hai (yaani teen baar ijazat maangne ke baad, agar andar aane ki ijazat na mile, to chale jaana)." Umar ne unse kaha: "Apni baat ke liye gawah laao." Abu Musa Ansaar ki majlison mein gaye aur unse pucha. Unhone kaha: "Hum mein se koi yeh gawahi nahi dega siwaye humare sabse jawan shaks, Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke." Abu Musa phir Abu Saeed Al-Khudri ko (Umar ke paas) le gaye, aur Umar ne hairat se kaha: "Kya Allah ke Rasool ka yeh hukum mujhse chhupa raha?" (Phir unhone joda) "Main bazaaron mein tijarat mein masroof rehta tha."

e: Abu Hurairah (ra) said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) mentioned a person from Bani Israel who travelled by sea and carried out his needs." Then he narrated the whole story. (See Hadith no)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool ne Bani Israel ke ek shaks ka zikar kiya jo samundar mein safar karta tha aur apni zaroortein poori karta tha." Phir unhone poori kahani sunayi.

e: Narrated Jabir:A caravan arrived (at Medina) while we were offering the Jumua prayer with the Prophet. The people left out for the caravan, with the exception of twelve persons. Then this Verse was revealed: 'But when they see some bargain or some amusement, they disperse headlong to it and leave you standing
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek qafila (Madina) pahuncha jabke hum Nabi ke saath Jumme ki namaz padh rahe the. Log qafile ki taraf nikal gaye, siwaye barah logon ke. Phir yeh ayaat nazil hui: "Magar jab woh koi saudebaazi ya tamaasha dekhte hain, woh usi taraf bhaag jaate hain aur tumhe khade chhod dete hain."

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If a woman gives in charity from her house meals without wasting (i.e. being extravagant), she will get the reward for her giving, and her husband will also get the reward for his earning and the storekeeper will also get a similar reward. The acquisition of the reward of none of them will reduce the reward of the others
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Agar koi aurat apne ghar ka khaana sadqa deti hai fizoolkharchi kiye bina, use uske dene ka ajr milega, aur uske shohar ko bhi uski kamaai ka ajr milega, aur bhandaari ko bhi utna hi ajr milega. Kisi ka bhi ajr doosre ka ajr kam nahi karega."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If a woman gives something (i.e. in charity) from her husband's earnings without his permission, she will get half his reward
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Agar koi aurat apne shohar ki kamaai se (sadqa mein) kuch deti hai uski ijazat ke bina, use uska aadha ajr milta hai."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "whoever desires an expansion in his sustenance and age, should keep good relations with his Kith and kin
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool ko farmate suna: "Jo bhi apni rozi aur umr mein izafa chahta hai, use apne rishtedaron se achha suluk rakhna chahiye."

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) purchased food grains from a Jew on credit and mortgaged his iron armor to him
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi ne ek Yahudi se qarz par anaaj khareeda aur apna lohe ka zire (armor) uske paas girvi rakha.

e: Narrated Qatada:Anas went to the Prophet (ﷺ) with barley bread having some dissolved fat on it. The Prophet (ﷺ) had mortgaged his armor to a Jew in Medina and took from him some barley for his family. Anas heard him saying, "The household of Muhammad did not possess even a single Sa of wheat or food grains for the evening meal, although he has nine wives to look after." (See Hadith No)
hi: Qatada bataate hain: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) Nabi ke paas jau ki roti lekar gaye jisme kuch ghee ghula hua tha. Nabi ne apna zire ek Madina ke Yahudi ke paas girvi rakha tha aur usse apne pariwara ke liye kuch jau liya tha. Anas ne unhe kehte suna: "Muhammad ke pariwara ke paas raat ka khana khaane ke liye ek Sa gehun ya anaaj bhi nahi tha, chahe unke sambhaalne ke liye nau biwiyan thi."

e: Narrated `Aisha:When Abu Bakr As-Siddiq was chosen Caliph, he said, "My people know that my profession was not incapable of providing substance to my family. And as I will be busy serving the Muslim nation, my family will eat from the National Treasury of Muslims, and I will practice the profession of serving the Muslims
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab Abu Bakr As-Siddiq khalifa chune gaye, unhone kaha: "Meri qaum jaanti hai ke mera peshaa mere pariwara ke liye rozi kamane mein na-kaabil nahi tha. Aur chunke main Musalman ummat ki khidmat mein masroof rahunga, mera pariwara Musalmanon ke Bait-ul-Maal (National Treasury) se khaana khaega, aur main Musalmanon ki khidmat ka peshaa apnaunga."

e: Narrated Aisha:The companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to practice manual labor, so their sweat used to smell, and they were advised to take a bath
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool ke sahaba mehnat ka kaam karte the, isliye unka paseena sungh ke aata, aur unhe ghusl karne ki salaah di jaati.

e: Narrated Al-Miqdam:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Nobody has ever eaten a better meal than that which one has earned by working with one's own hands. The Prophet of Allah, David (ﷺ) used to eat from the earnings of his manual labor
hi: Al-Miqdam bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Kisi ne bhi kabhi apne haathon ki kamaai se behtar khaana nahi khaya. Allah ke Nabi Dawud apne haathon ki mehnat ki kamaai se khate the."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The Prophet David (ﷺ) used not to eat except from the earnings of his manual labor
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Nabi Dawud sirf apne haathon ki mehnat ki kamaai se khate the."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "No doubt, it is better for any one of you to cut a bundle of wood and carry it over his back rather than to ask someone who may or may not give him
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Beshak, tum mein se kisi ke liye behtar hai ke woh lakdi ka gathar kaaat kar apni pusht par lekar jaaye, bajaye is ke ke woh kisi se maange jo use de ya na de."

e: Narrated Az-Zubair bin Al-Awwam:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "One would rather take a rope and cut wood and carry it than ask others
hi: Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Awwam (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Behtar hai ke koi rassi lekar lakdi kaate aur use apni pusht par le jaaye, bajaye is ke ke woh doosron se maange."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "May Allah's mercy be on him who is lenient in his buying, selling, and in demanding back his money
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Allah ki rehmat ho us shaks par jo khareedne, bechne, aur apna paisa wapas maangne mein narmi baratataa hai."

e: Narrated Hudhaifa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Before your time the angels received the soul of a man and asked him, 'Did you do any good deeds (in your life)?' He replied, 'I used to order my employees to grant time to the rich person to pay his debts at his convenience.' So Allah said to the angels; "Excuse him." Rabi said that (the dead man said), 'I used to be easy to the rich and grant time to the poor.' Or, in another narration, 'grant time to the well-off and forgive the needy,' or, 'accept from the well-off and forgive the needy
hi: Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Tumse pehle, farishton ne ek shaks ki jaan li aur usse pucha: 'Kya tumne koi neik amal kiya (apni zindagi mein)?' Usne jawab diya: 'Main apne mulaazimon ko maldaar shaks ko apna qarz aasani se wapas karne ka mauka dene ka hukum deta tha.' To Allah ne farishton se kaha: 'Ise maaf kar do.'" Rabi ne kaha ke (marne wale shaks ne kaha): "Main maldaar logon ke saath narmi baratata tha aur gareebon ko waqt deta tha," ya ek doosri riwayat mein, "khushhaal logon ko waqt deta aur zaroorat-mand ko maaf kar deta," ya, "khushhaal se leta aur zaroorat-mand ko maaf kar deta."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There was a merchant who used to lend the people, and whenever his debtor was in straitened circumstances, he would say to his employees, 'Forgive him so that Allah may forgive us.' So, Allah forgave him
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Ek vyapaari tha jo logon ko qarz deta, aur jab bhi uska qarzdaar mushkil mein hota, woh apne mulaazimon se kehta: 'Use maaf kar do taake Allah humein maaf kare.' Isliye Allah ne use maaf kar diya."

e: Narrated Hakim bin Hizam:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The seller and the buyer have the right to keep or return goods as long as they have not parted or till they part; and if both the parties spoke the truth and described the defects and qualities (of the goods), then they would be blessed in their transaction, and if they told lies or hid something, then the blessings of their transaction would be lost
hi: Hakim bin Hizam (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Bechne wale aur khareedne wale ko cheez rakhne ya wapas karne ka haqq hai jab tak woh alag na ho jaayen ya alag ho jaayen; aur agar donon party sach bolen aur (maal ke) aib aur khoobiyon ka zikar karen, to unki saudebaazi mein barkat hogi, aur agar woh jhoot bolein ya kuch chhupaen, to unki saudebaazi ki barkat khatam ho jayegi."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id:We used to be given mixed dates (from the booty) and used to sell (barter) two Sas of those dates) for one Sa (of good dates). The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to us), "No (bartering of) two Sas for one Sa nor two Dirhams for one Dirham is permissible", (as that is a kind of usury). (See Hadith No)
hi: Abu Saeed (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Humein (maal-e-ghanimat mein se) mila-jula khajoor diya jata tha aur hum do Sa (kharaab khajoor) ko ek Sa (achhi khajoor) ke liye bech (barter) dete the. Nabi ne (humse) kaha: "Nahi (do Sa ka ek Sa ke liye barter), na do Dirham ka ek Dirham ke liye jaiz hai" (kyunke yeh ek qisam ka sood hai).

e: Narrated Abu Mas`ud:An Ansari man, called Abu Shu'aib, came and told his butcher slave, "Prepare meals sufficient for five persons, for I want to invite the Prophet (ﷺ) along with four other persons as I saw signs of hunger on his face." Abu Shu'aib invited them and another person came along with them. The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to Abu Shu'aib), This man followed us, so if you allow him, he will join us, and if you want him to return, he will go back." Abu Shu'aib said, "No, I have allowed him (i.e. he, too, is welcomed to the meal)
hi: Abu Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek Ansari shaks, jise Abu Shu'aib kaha jata, aaya aur apne kasaai gulaam se kaha: "Paanch logon ke liye khaana taiyaar karo, kyunke main Nabi ko chaar aur logon ke saath dawat dena chahta hoon kyunke maine unke chehre par bhookh ke asaraat dekhe hain." Abu Shu'aib ne unhe bulaya aur ek aur shaks unke saath aa gaya. Nabi ne (Abu Shu'aib se) kaha: "Yeh shaks humare saath aaya, isliye agar tum ijazat do, woh humare saath shaamil hoga, aur agar tum chaho woh wapas jaaye, woh wapas jaayega." Abu Shu'aib ne kaha: "Nahi, maine unhe ijazat de di hai (yaani woh bhi khaane mein shaamil ho sakte hain)."

e: Narrated Hakim bin Hizam:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The buyer and the seller have the option to cancel or to confirm the deal, as long as they have not parted or till they part, and if they spoke the truth and told each other the defects of the things, then blessings would be in their deal, and if they hid something and told lies, the blessing of the deal would be lost
hi: Hakim bin Hizam (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Khareedne aur bechne wale ko saudebaazi radd karne ya poori karne ka ikhtiyaar hai jab tak woh alag na ho jaayen ya alag ho jaayen, aur agar unhone sach bola aur ek-doosre ko cheez ke aib bataye, to unki saudebaazi mein barkat hogi, aur agar unhone kuch chhupaya aur jhoot bola, to saudebaazi ki barkat khatam ho jaayegi."

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah (ra):The Prophet (ﷺ) said "Certainly a time will come when people will not bother to know from where they earned the money, by lawful means or unlawful means." (See Hadith no)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Zaroor ek waqt aayega jab log yeh parwaah nahi karenge ke unhone paisa kahan se kamaya, halal se ya haram se."

e: Narrated Aisha:When the last Verses of Surat al- Baqara were revealed, the Prophet (ﷺ) recited them in the mosque and proclaimed the trade of alcohol as illegal
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab Surah Al-Baqarah ki aakhri ayaat nazil hui, Nabi ne unhe masjid mein padha aur sharaab ki tijarat ko haram elaan kiya.

e: Narrated Samura bin Jundab:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "This night I dreamt that two men came and took me to a Holy land whence we proceeded on till we reached a river of blood, where a man was standing, and on its bank was standing another man with stones in his hands. The man in the middle of the river tried to come out, but the other threw a stone in his mouth and forced him to go back to his original place. So, whenever he tried to come out, the other man would throw a stone in his mouth and force him to go back to his former place. I asked, 'Who is this?' I was told, 'The person in the river was a Riba-eater
hi: Samura bin Jundub (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Aaj raat maine khwab dekha ke do log aaye aur mujhe ek muqaddas zameen le gaye jahan se hum aage badhe jab tak humne ek khoon ki nadi na paayi, jahan ek shaks khada tha, aur uske kinare doosra shaks pattharon ke saath khada tha. Nadi ke beech wala shaks bahar aana chahta, magar doosra uske mun mein patthar phenkta aur use apni asli jagah wapas jane par majboor karta. Isliye jab bhi woh bahar aana chahta, doosra shaks uske mun mein patthar daalta aur use wapas apni jagah bhej deta. Maine pucha: 'Yeh kaun hai?' Mujhe bataya gaya: 'Nadi mein woh shaks Riba (sood) khane wala tha.'"

e: Narrated `Aun bin Abu Juhaifa:My father bought a slave who practiced the profession of cupping. (My father broke the slave's instruments of cupping). I asked my father why he had done so. He replied, "The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the acceptance of the price of a dog or blood, and also forbade the profession of tattooing, getting tattooed and receiving or giving Riba, (usury), and cursed the picture-makers
hi: Aun bin Abu Juhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Mere waalid ne ek gulaam khareeda jo cupping (Hijama, khoon nikalne ka kaam) ka peshaa karta tha. (Mere waalid ne gulaam ke cupping ke aalaat tod diye.) Maine unse pucha kyun. Unhone jawab diya: "Nabi ne kutte ya khoon ki qeemat lene se mana kiya, aur gudna (tattoo) banane-banvane se bhi mana kiya, aur Riba (sood) lene-dene se bhi, aur tasveer banane walon par laanat ki."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "The swearing (by the seller) may persuade the buyer to purchase the goods but that will be deprived of Allah's blessing
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool ko farmate suna: "(Bechne wale ki) qasam khane se khareedaaar cheez khareedne par raazi ho sakta hai, magar isse Allah ki barkat khatam ho jaati hai."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abu `Aufa:A man displayed some goods in the market and swore by Allah that he had been offered so much for that, that which was not offered, and he said so, so as to cheat a Muslim. On that occasion the following Verse was revealed: "Verily! Those who purchase a small gain at the cost of Allah's covenant and their oaths (They shall have no portion in the Hereafter ..etc)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abu Aufa bataate hain: Ek shaks ne bazaar mein kuch saaman rakha aur Allah ki qasam khakar kaha ke usse itni bhaari qeemat pesh ki gayi thi jitni asal mein nahi pesh ki gayi thi, aur usne yeh isliye kaha taake woh ek Musalman ko dhoka de sake. Us waqt yeh ayat nazil hui: "Beshak! Woh log jo Allah ke waade aur apni qasmon ke badle mein thodi si duniyawi cheez khareedte hain (unke liye Aakhirat mein koi hissa nahi)."

e: Narrated `Ali:I got an old she-camel as my share from the booty, and the Prophet (ﷺ) had given me another from Al- Khumus. And when I intended to marry Fatima (daughter of the Prophet), I arranged that a goldsmith from the tribe of Bani Qainuqa' would accompany me in order to bring Idhkhir and then sell it to the goldsmiths and use its price for my marriage banquet
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Mujhe maal-e-ghanimat mein se apna hissa ek budhi oontni ke tor par mila, aur Nabi ne mujhe ek aur oontni Khumus (paanchwaan hissa) se di. Aur jab maine Fatima (Alayhas Salam) (Nabi ki beti) se shaadi karne ka iraada kiya, maine intezaam kiya ke Bani Qainuqa qabile ka ek sunaar mere saath jaaye Idhkhir (ek khaas jhaadi) laane ke liye aur phir use sunaron ko becha jaaye, aur uski qeemat mere shaadi ki dawat ke liye istemal ki jaaye.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah made Mecca a sanctuary and it was neither permitted for anyone before, nor will it be permitted for anyone after me (to fight in it). And fighting in it was made legal for me for a few hours of a day only. None is allowed to uproot its thorny shrubs or to cut down its trees or to chase its game or to pick up its Luqata (fallen things) except by a person who would announce it publicly." `Abbas bin `Abdul-Muttalib requested the Prophet, "Except Al-Idhkhir, for our goldsmiths and for the roofs of our houses." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Except Al-Idhkhir." `Ikrima said, "Do you know what is meant by chasing its game? It is to drive it out of the shade and sit in its place." Khalid said, "(`Abbas said: Al-Idhkhir) for our goldsmiths and our graves
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Allah ne Mecca ko haram (panah wali jagah) banaya, aur na mujhse pehle kisi ko, na mere baad kisi ko (isme jung karne ki) ijazat thi. Aur mere liye ise ek din ke kuch ghanton ke liye jaiz kiya gaya. Kisi ko isme kaante wali jhaadiyan ukhadane, darakht kaatne, iske shikaar ka picha karne, ya iski giri hui cheezein (Luqata) uthaane ki ijazat nahi, siwaye us shaks ke jo isse aam elaan kare." Abbas bin Abdul-Muttalib ne Nabi se guzarish ki: "Siwaye Al-Idhkhir ke, humare sunaron aur humare gharon ki chhaton ke liye." Nabi ne kaha: "Siwaye Al-Idhkhir ke." Ikrima ne kaha: "Kya tumhe pata hai shikaar ka picha karne ka kya matlab hai? Iska matlab hai use saaye se bahar nikaal kar uski jagah baith jaana." Khalid ne kaha: "(Abbas ne kaha: Al-Idhkhir) humare sunaron aur humari qabron ke liye."

e: Narrated Khabbab:I was a blacksmith in the Pre-Islamic period, and 'Asi bin Wail owed me some money, so I went to him to demand it. He said (to me), "I will not pay you unless you disbelieve Muhammad." I said, "I will not disbelieve till Allah kills you and then you get resurrected." He said, "Leave me till I die and get resurrected, then I will be given wealth and children and I will pay you your debt." On that occasion it was revealed to the Prophet: 'Have you seen him who disbelieved in Our signs and says: Surely I will be given wealth and children? Has he known the unseen, or has he taken a covenant from the Beneficent (Allah)?
hi: Khabbab (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main jahiliyat ke zamane mein ek lohar tha, aur Asi bin Wail par mera kuch paisa qarz tha, isliye main use maangne gaya. Usne (mujhse) kaha: "Main tumhe tab tak nahi dunga jab tak tum Muhammad ko na maano (kaafir na ho jaao)." Maine kaha: "Main kaafir nahi hounga jab tak Allah tumhe maar na de aur phir tumhe dobara zinda kar de." Usne kaha: "Mujhe (marne) do jab tak main mar na jaaun aur dobara zinda na ho jaaun, phir mujhe maal aur aulad di jaayegi aur main tumhara qarz ada karunga." Isi waqt Nabi par yeh nazil hui: "Kya tumne use dekha jisne humari nishaniyon ka inkaar kiya aur kaha: Zaroor mujhe maal aur aulad di jaayegi? Kya usse ghaib ka ilm hai, ya usne Rahman se koi ahad liya hai?"

e: Narrated 'Is-haq bin `Abdullah bin Abu Talha:I heard Anas bin Malik saying, "A tailor invited Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to a meal which he had prepared. " Anas bin Malik said, "I accompanied Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to that meal. He served the Prophet (ﷺ) with bread and soup made with gourd and dried meat. I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) taking the pieces of gourd from the dish." Anas added, "Since that day I have continued to like gourd
hi: Ishaq bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko kehte suna: "Ek darzi ne Allah ke Rasool ko khana khaane ki dawat di jo usne taiyaar kiya tha." Anas bin Malik ne kaha: "Main Allah ke Rasool ke saath us khaane mein gaya. Usne Nabi ko roti aur laukI (kaddu) aur sookhe gosht se bana shorba pesh kiya. Maine Nabi ko thaali se laukI ke tukde uthate dekha." Anas ne joda: "Us din se, mujhe laukI hamesha pasand aayi."

e: Narrated Abu Hazim:I heard Sahl bin Sa`d saying, "A woman brought a Burda (i.e. a square piece of cloth having edging). I asked, 'Do you know what a Burda is?' They replied in the affirmative and said, "It is a cloth sheet with woven margins." Sahl went on, "She addressed the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, 'I have woven it with my hands for you to wear.' The Prophet (ﷺ) took it as he was in need of it, and came to us wearing it as a waist sheet. One of us said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Give it to me to wear.' The Prophet (ﷺ) agreed to give it to him. The Prophet (ﷺ) sat with the people for a while and then returned (home), wrapped that waist sheet and sent it to him. The people said to that man, 'You haven't done well by asking him for it when you know that he never turns down anybody's request.' The man replied, 'By Allah, I have not asked him for it except to use it as my shroud when I die." Sahl added; "Later it (i.e. that sheet) was his shroud
hi: Abu Hazim bataate hain: Maine Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko kehte suna: "Ek aurat Nabi ke liye ek Burda (yaani kinaari wala chaukor kapda) laayi. (Maine unse pucha kya unhe pata hai Burda kya hoti hai, unhone haan mein jawab diya aur kaha ke yeh ek chadar hai jiske kinaare bune hue hote hain.)" Sahl ne aage kaha: "Usne Nabi se khitaab karte huye kaha: 'Maine ise apne haathon se aapke pehnne ke liye buna hai.' Nabi ne ise liya kyunke unhe iski zaroorat thi, aur woh use kamar ke kapde ke tor par pehnkar humare paas aaye. Humme se ek ne kaha: 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe ise pehnne ke liye de dijiye.' Nabi maan gaye. Nabi thodi der logon ke saath baithe, phir wapas (ghar) gaye, wahi kamar ka kapda lapetkar use us shaks ko bhej diya. Logon ne us shaks se kaha: 'Tumne achha nahi kiya isse maangkar, jabke tumhe pata hai Aap kabhi kisi ki darkhwast wapas nahi karte.' Shaks ne jawab diya: 'Allah ki qasam, maine ise maanga hi isliye tha taake main mare hue waqt isme kafan diya jaaun.'" Sahl ne joda: "Baad mein, yehi (chadar) uska kafan bani."

e: Narrated Abu Hazim:Some men came to Sahl bin Sa`d to ask him about the pulpit. He replied, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent for a woman (Sahl named her) (this message): 'Order your slave carpenter to make pieces of wood (i.e. a pulpit) for me so that I may sit on it while addressing the people.' So, she ordered him to make it from the tamarisk of the forest. He brought it to her and she sent it to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered it to be placed in the mosque: so, it was put and he sat on it
hi: Abu Hazim bataate hain: Kuch log Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas aaye aur unse mimbar ke baare mein pucha. Unhone jawab diya: "Allah ke Rasool ne ek aurat ko bulwaya (Sahl ne uska naam liya) yeh sandesh: 'Apne badhee gulaam ko lakdi ke tukde (yaani ek mimbar) banane ka hukum do taake main logon ko khitaab karte waqt usme baith sakoon.' Isliye usne use jungle ki jhaadi ki lakdi se banane ka hukum diya. Usne yeh laakar Allah ke Rasool ko bhej diya. Allah ke Rasool ne ise masjid mein rakhne ka hukum diya, isliye ise rakha gaya aur Aap usme baithe."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:An Ansari woman said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shall I make something for you to sit on, as I have a slave who is a carpenter?" He replied, "If you wish." So, she got a pulpit made for him. When it was Friday the Prophet (ﷺ) sat on that pulpit. The date-palm stem near which the Prophet (ﷺ) used to deliver his sermons cried so much so that it was about to burst. The Prophet (ﷺ) came down from the pulpit to the stem and embraced it and it started groaning like a child being persuaded to stop crying and then it stopped crying. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It has cried because of (missing) what it used to hear of the religious knowledge
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek Ansari aurat ne Allah ke Rasool se kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Kya main aapke baithne ke liye kuch banvvaoon, mere paas ek badhee gulaam hai?" Aap ne jawab diya: "Agar tum chaho." Isliye usne unke liye ek mimbar banvvayaa. Jumme ka din aaya to Nabi ise usi mimbar par baith gaye. Khajoor ka woh tana jiske paas Nabi khutba dete the, itna roya ke phatne wala tha. Nabi mimbar se utar kar us tane ke paas gaye aur use gale lagaya, aur woh us bachche ki tarah kraahna laga jise chup karaya ja raha ho, aur phir roka. Nabi ne kaha: "Yeh isliye roya kyunke usse (deeni ilm) sunanaa miss ho gaya."

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) bought food grains from a Jew on credit and mortgaged his armor to him
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool ne ek Yahudi se qarz par anaaj khareeda aur apna zire uske paas girvi rakha.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:I was with the Prophet (ﷺ) in a Ghazwa (Military Expedition) and my camel was slow and exhausted. The Prophet came up to me and said, "O Jabir." I replied, "Yes?" He said, "What is the matter with you?" I replied, "My camel is slow and tired, so I am left behind." So, he got down and poked the camel with his stick and then ordered me to ride. I rode the camel and it became so fast that I had to hold it from going ahead of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . He then asked me, have you got married?" I replied in the affirmative. He asked, "A virgin or a matron?" I replied, "I married a matron." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Why have you not married a virgin, so that you may play with her and she may play with you?" Jabir replied, "I have sisters (young in age) so I liked to marry a matron who could collect them all and comb their hair and look after them." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You will reach, so when you have arrived (at home), I advise you to associate with your wife (that you may have an intelligent son)." Then he asked me, "Would you like to sell your camel?" I replied in the affirmative and the Prophet (ﷺ) purchased it for one Uqiya of gold. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) reached before me and I reached in the morning, and when I went to the mosque, I found him at the door of the mosque. He asked me, "Have you arrived just now?" I replied in the affirmative. He said, "Leave your camel and come into (the mosque) and pray two rak`at." I entered and offered the prayer. He told Bilal to weigh and give me one Uqiya of gold. So Bilal weighed for me fairly and I went away. The Prophet (ﷺ) sent for me and I thought that he would return to me my camel which I hated more than anything else. But the Prophet (ﷺ) said to me, "Take your camel as well as its price
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Nabi ke saath ek Ghazwa mein tha aur mera oont dheema aur thaka hua tha. Nabi mere paas aaye aur kaha: "Aye Jabir!" Maine jawab diya: "Haan?" Aap ne pucha: "Kya baat hai?" Maine jawab diya: "Mera oont dheema aur thaka hua hai, isliye main peeche rah gaya hoon." Isliye woh utre, apni chhadi se oont ko chubhoya, phir mujhe uspar sawar hone ka hukum diya. Main sawar hua aur woh itna tez ho gaya ke mujhe use Allah ke Rasool se aage jaane se rokna pada. Phir Aap ne mujhse pucha: "Kya tumne shaadi ki hai?" Maine haan mein jawab diya. Aap ne pucha: "Kunwari ya biwah?" Maine jawab diya: "Maine ek biwah se shaadi ki." Nabi ne kaha: "Kunwari se shaadi kyun nahi ki, taake tum uske saath khel sakte aur woh tumhare saath?" Jabir ne jawab diya: "Meri (chhoti) behnein hain, isliye mujhe ek biwah pasand aayi jo unhe sambhal sake, unke baal kanghi kar sake, aur unki dekhbhal kar sake." Nabi ne kaha: "Tum pahunch jaoge, isliye jab tum (ghar) pahuncho, main tumhe apni biwi ke saath rehne ki naseehat karta hoon (taake tumhare achhe aulad ho)." Phir unhone mujhse pucha: "Kya tum apna oont bechna chahoge?" Maine haan mein jawab diya aur Nabi ne ise ek Uqiya sona dekr khareeda. Allah ke Rasool mujhse pehle pahunche aur main subah pahuncha, aur jab main masjid gaya, maine unhe masjid ke darwaze par paaya. Unhone mujhse pucha: "Kya tum abhi pahunche ho?" Maine haan mein jawab diya. Aap ne kaha: "Apna oont chhod do aur andar aakar do rakat padho." Main andar gaya aur namaz padhi. Aap ne Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) se mujhe ek Uqiya sona tolne aur dene ko kaha. Isliye Bilal ne mujhe imandaari se tola aur main chala gaya. Nabi ne mujhe bulwaya aur maine socha woh mujhe mera oont wapas karenge jise main sabse zyada napasand karta tha, magar Nabi ne mujhse kaha: "Apna oont bhi le lo aur uski qeemat bhi."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:`Ukaz, Majanna and Dhul-Majaz were markets in the Pre-Islamic period. When the people embraced Islam they considered it a sin to trade there. So, the following Holy Verse came:-- 'There is no harm for you if you seek of the bounty of your Lord (Allah) in the Hajj season." (2.198) Ibn `Abbas recited it like this
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Ukaz, Majanna aur Dhul-Majaz jahiliyat ke zamane mein bazaar the. Jab log Islam laaye, unhe laga wahan tijarat karna gunah hai. Isliye yeh Aayat nazil hui: "Isme koi harj nahi agar tum Hajj ke maheenon mein apne Rab (Allah) ka fazl talaash karo" (2:198). Ibn Abbas ne is tarah ayat padhi.

e: Narrated `Amr:Here (i.e. in Mecca) there was a man called Nawwas and he had camels suffering from the disease of excessive and unquenchable thirst. Ibn `Umar went to the partner of Nawwas and bought those camels. The man returned to Nawwas and told him that he had sold those camels. Nawwas asked him, "To whom have you sold them?" He replied, "To such and such Sheikh." Nawwas said, "Woe to you; By Allah, that Sheikh was Ibn `Umar." Nawwas then went to Ibn `Umar and said to him, "My partner sold you camels suffering from the disease of excessive thirst and he had not known you." Ibn `Umar told him to take them back. When Nawwas went to take them, Ibn `Umar said to him, "Leave them there as I am happy with the decision of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that there is no oppression
hi: Amr bataate hain: Yahan (yaani Mecca mein) Nawwas naam ka ek shaks tha aur uske paas kuch oont the jinhe zyada aur na bujhne wali pyaas ki bimari thi. Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) Nawwas ke saathi ke paas gaye aur woh oont khareed liye. Shaks Nawwas ke paas wapas gaya aur unhe bataya ke usne woh oont bech diye. Nawwas ne pucha: "Kisko becha?" Usne jawab diya: "Falaan-falaan Shaikh ko." Nawwas ne kaha: "Tumpar afsos; Allah ki qasam, woh Shaikh Ibn Umar the." Nawwas phir Ibn Umar ke paas gaye aur unse kaha: "Mere saathi ne aapko zyada pyaas ki bimari wale oont bech diye aur usse aapki pehchaan nahi thi." Ibn Umar ne unse unhe wapas lene ko kaha. Jab Nawwas unhe lene gaye, Ibn Umar ne unse kaha: "Unhe wahin rehne do, kyunke main Allah ke Rasool ke is faisle se khush hoon ke koi na-insaafi nahi (yaani main iski qeemat wapas nahi loonga, jaante hue unke aib)."

e: Narrated Abu Qatada:We set out with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the year of Hunain, (the Prophet (ﷺ) gave me an armor). I sold that armor and bought a garden in the region of the tribe of Bani Salama and that was the first property I got after embracing Islam
hi: Abu Qatada (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Allah ke Rasool ke saath Hunain ke saal (safar par) nikle, (Nabi ne mujhe ek zire diya). Maine woh zire becha aur Bani Salama qabile ke ilaqe mein ek baag khareeda, aur yeh Islam qubool karne ke baad meri pehli maal thi.

e: Narrated Abu Musa:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The example of a good companion (who sits with you) in comparison with a bad one, is like that of the musk seller and the blacksmith's bellows (or furnace); from the first you would either buy musk or enjoy its good smell while the bellows would either burn your clothes or your house, or you get a bad nasty smell thereof
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Ek achhe sathi (jo tumhare saath baithe) ki misaal ek bure sathi ke muqaable mein, mushk bechne wale aur lohar ki bhatti (ya angithi) jaisi hai; pehle se tum ya to mushk khareedoge ya iski achhi khushbu ka lutf uthaoge, jabke bhatti tumhare kapde ya ghar jala degi, ya usse tumhe bura badbudaar dhuan milega."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Abu Taiba cupped Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) so he ordered that he be paid one Sa of dates and ordered his masters to reduce his tax (as he was a slave and had to pay a tax to them)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Taiba ne Allah ke Rasool ka cupping (khoon nikaalna) kiya, isliye Aap ne hukum diya ke unhe ek Sa khajoor di jaaye aur unke maalikon ko unka tax kam karne ka hukum diya (kyunke woh ek gulaam the aur unhe unko tax dena padta tha).

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) got his blood out (medically) and paid that person who had done it. If it had been illegal, the Prophet (ﷺ) would not have paid him
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Ek baar Nabi ne apna khoon nikalvvayaa (dawa ke tor par) aur us shaks ko iski qeemat di jisne yeh kiya. Agar yeh haram hota, Nabi use paisa na dete.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) sent to `Umar a silken two-piece garment, and when he saw `Umar wearing it, he said to him, "I have not sent it to you to wear. It is worn by him who has no share in the Hereafter, and I have sent it to you so that you could benefit by it (i.e. sell it)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Ek baar Nabi ne Umar ko resham ke do-tukdon wala libaas bheja, aur jab unhone Umar ko ise pehne dekha, unhone unse kaha: "Maine ise tumhe pehnne ke liye nahi bheja tha. Ise woh pehnta hai jiska Aakhirat mein koi hissa nahi, aur maine ise tumhe isliye bheja tha taake tum ise (yaani bech kar) faida utha sako."

e: Narrated Aisha:(mother of the faithful believers) I bought a cushion with pictures on it. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw it, he kept standing at the door and did not enter the house. I noticed the sign of disgust on his face, so I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I repent to Allah and His Apostle . (Please let me know) what sin I have done." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "What about this cushion?" I replied, "I bought it for you to sit and recline on." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The painters (i.e. owners) of these pictures will be punished on the Day of Resurrection. It will be said to them, 'Put life in what you have created (i.e. painted).' " The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "The angels do not enter a house where there are pictures
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Ummul-Momineen) bataati hain: Maine ek takiya khareeda jisme tasveerein bani hui thi. Jab Allah ke Rasool ne ise dekha, woh darwaze par khade rahe aur ghar mein daakhil nahi hue. Maine unke chehre par napasandidgi ke asaraat dekhe, isliye maine kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Main Allah aur uske Rasool se tauba karti hoon. (Kripya mujhe bataiye) maine kya gunah kiya hai." Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: "Yeh takiya kya hai?" Maine jawab diya: "Maine ise aapke baithne aur takiya lagane ke liye khareeda." Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: "In tasveeron ke banane walon (yaani maalikon) ko Qiyamat ke din saza di jayegi. Unhe kaha jaayega: 'Jo tumne banaya hai usme jaan daalo (yaani tasveer banane ki cheez).'" Nabi ne joda: "Farishte us ghar mein daakhil nahi hote jahan tasveerein hoti hain."

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Bani Najjar! Suggest a price for your garden." Part of it was a ruin and it contained some date palms
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha: "Aye Bani Najjar! Apne baag ki qeemat batao." Uska ek hissa khandarat wala tha aur usme kuch khajoor ke darakht the.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The buyer and the seller have the option to cancel or confirm the bargain before they separate from each other or if the sale is optional." Nafi` said, "Ibn `Umar used to separate quickly from the seller if he had bought a thing which he liked
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Khareedne aur bechne wale ko ek-doosre se alag hone se pehle saudebaazi radd karne ya poori karne ka ikhtiyaar hai, ya agar bikri ikhtiyaari (optional) ho." Nafi ne kaha: "Ibn Umar jaldi se bechne wale se alag ho jate agar unhone koi cheez khareedi hoti jo unhe pasand aayi hoti."

e: Narrated Hakim bin Hizam":The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The buyer and the seller have the option of canceling or confirming the deal unless they separate
hi: Hakim bin Hizam (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Khareedne aur bechne wale ko saudebaazi radd ya poori karne ka ikhtiyaar hai jab tak woh alag na ho jaayen."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The seller and the buyer have the option of canceling or confirming the deal unless they separate, or one of them says to the other, 'Choose (i.e. decide to cancel or confirm the bargain now)." Perhaps he said, 'Or if it is an optional sale.' " Ibn `Umar, Shuraih, Ash-Shu`bi, Tawus, Ata, and Ibn Abu Mulaika agree upon this judgment
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Bechne aur khareedne wale ko saudebaazi radd ya poori karne ka ikhtiyaar hai jab tak woh alag na ho jaayen, ya ek doosre se kahe: 'Chuno' (yaani abhi faisla karo, saudebaazi radd karni hai ya poori)." Shayad unhone kaha: "Ya agar yeh ikhtiyaari bikri ho." Ibn Umar, Shuraih, Ash-Shu'bi, Tawus, Ata, aur Ibn Abu Mulaika is faisle par muttafiq hain.

e: Narrated Hakim bin Hizam:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The buyer and the seller have the option of canceling or confirming the bargain unless they separate, and if they spoke the truth and made clear the defects of the goods, then they would be blessed in their bargain, and if they told lies and hid some facts, their bargain would be deprived of Allah's blessings
hi: Hakim bin Hizam (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Khareedne aur bechne wale ko saudebaazi radd ya poori karne ka ikhtiyaar hai jab tak woh alag na ho jaayen, aur agar unhone sach bola aur maal ke aib saaf zaahir kiye, to unki saudebaazi mein barkat hogi, aur agar unhone jhoot bola aur kuch cheezein chhupaee, to unki saudebaazi Allah ki barkat se mehroom ho jaayegi."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Both the buyer and the seller have the option of canceling or confirming a bargain unless they separate, or the sale is optional." (See Hadith No)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Donon, khareedne aur bechne wale, ko saudebaazi radd ya poori karne ka ikhtiyaar hai jab tak woh alag na ho jaayen, ya bikri ikhtiyaari (optional) ho."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Both the buyer and the seller have the option of canceling or confirming the bargain, as long as they are still together; and unless they separate or one of them gives the other the option of keeping or returning the things and a decision is concluded then, in which case the bargain is considered final. If they separate after the bargain and none of them has rejected it, then the bargain is rendered final
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Donon, khareedne aur bechne wale, ko saudebaazi radd ya poori karne ka ikhtiyaar hai jab tak woh saath hain; aur jab tak woh alag na ho jaayen ya unme se ek doosre ko cheez rakhne ya wapas karne ka ikhtiyaar de aur usi waqt faisla ho jaaye, tab saudebaazi pakki maani jaaegi. Agar woh saudebaazi ke baad alag ho gaye aur kisi ne isse radd nahi kiya, to saudebaazi pakki ho jaayegi."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No deal is settled and finalized unless the buyer and the seller separate, except if the deal is optional (whereby the validity of the bargain depends on the stipulations agreed upon)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Koi saudebaazi tab tak pakki aur mukammal nahi hoti jab tak khareedaar aur bechne wala alag na ho jaayen, siwaye jab bikri ikhtiyaari ho (jisme saudebaazi ki sahihta muqarrar sharton par depend karti hai)."

e: Narrated Hakim bin Hizam:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Both the buyer and the seller have the option of canceling or confirming the bargain unless they separate." The sub-narrator, Hammam said, "I found this in my book: 'Both the buyer and the seller give the option of either confirming or canceling the bargain three times, and if they speak the truth and mention the defects, then their bargain will be blessed, and if they tell lies and conceal the defects, they might gain some financial gain but they will deprive their sale of (Allah's) blessings
hi: Hakim bin Hizam (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Donon, khareedne aur bechne wale, ko saudebaazi radd ya poori karne ka ikhtiyaar hai jab tak woh alag na ho jaayen." Doosre raawi Hammam ne kaha: "Maine apni kitaab mein yeh paaya: 'Donon, khareedne aur bechne wale, ko teen baar saudebaazi radd ya poori karne ka ikhtiyaar hai, aur agar unhone sach bola aur aib bataye, to unki saudebaazi mein barkat hogi, aur agar unhone jhoot bola aur aib chhupaaayaa, to unhe kuch maali faida to milega magar woh apni bikri ki barkat se mehroom rahenge.'"

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar (ra) :We were accompanying the Prophet (ﷺ) on a journey and I was riding an unmanageable camel belonging to 'Umar (ra), and I could not bring it under my control. So, it used to go ahead of the party and 'Umar would check it and force it to retreat, and again it went ahead and again 'Umar forced it to retreat. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked 'Umar to sell that camel to him. 'Umar replied, "It is for you O Allah's Messenger !" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) told 'Umar to sell that camel to him (not to give it as gift). So, 'Umar sold it to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said to 'Abdullah bin 'Umar "This camel is for you O 'Abdullah (as a present) and you could do with it whatever you like
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Hum Nabi ke saath ek safar mein the aur main Umar ke ek na-qaboo oont par sawar tha, aur main use kaboo mein nahi la pa raha tha. Isliye woh giroh se aage nikal jata aur Umar use rokne ke liye peeche karte, aur phir woh aage nikal jaata aur Umar phir use peeche karte. Nabi ne Umar se woh oont unhe bechne ko kaha. Umar ne jawab diya: "Yeh aapke liye hai, Ya Allah ke Rasool!" Allah ke Rasool ne Umar se ise unhe bechne ko kaha (dena nahi). Isliye Umar ne ise Allah ke Rasool ko becha. Phir Nabi ne Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kaha: "Yeh oont tumhare liye hai, Aye Abdullah (tohfe ke tor par) aur tum ispar jo chaho kar sakte ho."

e: Narrated 'Abdullah bin 'Umar (ra):I bartered my property in Khaibar to 'Uthman (chief of the faithful believers) for his property in Al-Wadi. When we finished the deal, I left immediately and got out of his house lest he should cancel the deal, for the tradition was that they buyer and the seller had the option of canceling the bargain unless they separated. When our deal was completed, I came to know that I have been unfair to 'Uthman, for by selling him my land I caused him to be in a land of Thamud, at a distance of three days journey from Al-Madina, while he made me nearer to Al-Madina, at a distance of three days journey from my former land
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Maine apni Khaibar ki maal Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath badalkar unki Al-Wadi ki maal li. Jab humne saudebaazi khatam ki, main foran chala gaya aur unke ghar se nikal gaya taake woh saudebaazi radd na kar sakein, kyunke rivaaj tha ke khareedaar aur bechne wale ko alag hone tak saudebaazi radd karne ka ikhtiyaar tha. Jab humari saudebaazi mukammal ho gayi, mujhe pata chala ke main Uthman ke saath na-insaafi kar chuka tha, kyunke apni zameen unhe bechkar maine unhe Thamud ki zameen mein daal diya, Madina se teen din ki doori par, jabke unhone mujhe Madina ke zyada qareeb kar diya, meri purani zameen se teen din ki doori par.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:A person came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and told him that he was always betrayed in purchasing. The Prophet (ﷺ) told him to say at the time of buying, "No cheating
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Ek shaks Nabi ke paas aaya aur unhe bataya ke woh khareedari mein hamesha dhoka khata hai. Nabi ne use kehne ko kaha jab woh khareedari kare: "Koi dhoka nahi (chahiye)."

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "An army will invade the Ka`ba and when the invaders reach Al-Baida', all the ground will sink and swallow the whole army." I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! How will they sink into the ground while amongst them will be their markets (the people who worked in business and not invaders) and the people not belonging to them?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "all of those people will sink but they will be resurrected and judged according to their intentions
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Ek fauj Ka'ba par hamla karegi, aur jab hamlaavar Al-Baida tak pahunchenge, saari zameen dhaans jaayegi aur poori fauj ko nigal legi." Maine pucha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Woh zameen mein kaise dhaans jayenge jabke unme unke bazaar (yaani vyapar karne wale log, hamlaavar nahi) hoenge, aur woh log jo unse ta'aluq nahi rakhte?" Nabi ne jawab diya: "Woh sab zameen mein dhaans jaayenge magar unhe dobara zinda kiya jaayega aur unki niyyat ke mutabiq unka faisla hoga."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The congregational prayer of anyone amongst you is more than twenty (five or twenty seven) times in reward than his prayer in the market or in his house, for if he performs ablution completely and then goes to the mosque with the sole intention of performing the prayer, and nothing urges him to proceed to the mosque except the prayer, then, on every step which he takes towards the mosque, he will be raised one degree or one of his sins will be forgiven. The angels will keep on asking Allah's forgiveness and blessings for everyone of you so long as he keeps sitting at his praying place. The angels will say, 'O Allah, bless him! O Allah, be merciful to him!' as long as he does not do Hadath or a thing which gives trouble to the other." The Prophet (ﷺ) further said, "One is regarded in prayer so long as one is waiting for the prayer
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Tum mein se kisi ki jamaat wali namaz uski bazaar ya ghar ki namaz se bees (paanch ya sattaees) guna zyada ajr wali hai, kyunke agar woh mukammal wudu kare aur sirf namaz padhne ki niyyat se masjid jaaye, aur namaz ke ilawa kuch aur usse masjid ki taraf na khinche, to masjid ki taraf har kadam par usse ek darja buland kiya jaayega ya uska ek gunah maaf kiya jaayega. Farishte tum mein se har ek ke liye Allah se maafi aur rehmat maangte rahenge jab tak woh apni namaz ki jagah par baitha rahega. Farishte kahenge: 'Aye Allah! Ise barkat de! Aye Allah! Isse reham kar!' jab tak woh na Hadath kare (wudu tod de) ya kisi ko takleef pahunchane wali koi baat kare." Nabi ne aage kaha: "Insaan namaz mein hi samjha jata hai jab tak woh namaz ka intezar kar raha hai."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:While the Prophet (ﷺ) was in the market, somebody, called, "O Abul-Qasim." The Prophet (ﷺ) turned to him. The man said, "I have called to this (i.e. another man)." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Name yourselves by my name but not by my Kunya (name)." (In Arabic world it is the custom to call the man as the father of his eldest son, e.g. Abul-Qasim.) (See Hadith No. 737, Vol)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jabke Nabi bazaar mein the, kisi ne pukaara: "Aye Abul-Qasim." Nabi unki taraf mude. Shaks ne kaha: "Maine (kisi doosre shaks ko) pukaara tha." Nabi ne kaha: "Apne naam mere naam par rakho magar meri Kunya (yaani Abul-Qasim jaisa naam) na rakho." (Arab duniya mein rivaaj hai ke shaks ko uske sabse bade bete ke baap ke tor par bulaya jaata hai, jaise Abul-Qasim.)

e: Narrated Anas:A man at Al-Baqi' called, "O Abul-Qasim!" The Prophet (ﷺ) turned to him and the man said (to the Prophet ), "I did not intend to call you." The prophet said, "Name yourselves by my name but not by my Kunya (name)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Al-Baqi mein ek shaks ne pukaara: "Aye Abul-Qasim!" Nabi unki taraf mude aur shaks ne (Nabi se) kaha: "Mera iraada aapko bulane ka nahi tha." Nabi ne kaha: "Apne naam mere naam par rakho magar meri Kunya na rakho."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira Ad-Dausi:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) went out during the day. Neither did he talk to me nor I to him till he reached the market of Bani Qainuqa and then he sat in the compound of Fatima's house and asked about the small boy (his grandson Al-Hasan) but Fatima kept the boy in for a while. I thought she was either changing his clothes or giving the boy a bath. After a while the boy came out running and the Prophet (ﷺ) embraced and kissed him and then said, 'O Allah! Love him, and love whoever loves him
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) Ad-Dausi (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Nabi din mein bahar gaye. Na Aap ne mujhse baat ki na maine unse, jab tak woh Bani Qainuqa ke bazaar nahi pahunche, aur phir Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ke ghar ke angaan mein baithe aur chhote ladke (apne pote Al-Hasan (Alayhis Salam)) ke baare mein pucha, magar Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ne bachche ko thodi der andar rok liya. Mujhe laga woh ya to uske kapde badal rahi hai ya use ghusl de rahi hai. Thodi der baad bachcha daudta hua bahar aaya aur Nabi ne use gale lagaya, bosa diya, aur phir kaha: "Aye Allah! Isse mohabbat kar, aur us shaks se mohabbat kar jo isse mohabbat kare."

e: Narrated Nafi`:Ibn `Umar told us that the people used to buy food from the caravans in the lifetime of the Prophet. The Prophet (ﷺ) used to forbid them to sell it at the very place where they had purchased it (but they were to wait) till they carried it to the market where foodstuff was sold. Ibn `Umar said, 'The Prophet (ﷺ) also forbade the reselling of foodstuff by somebody who had bought it unless he had received it with exact full measure
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne humein bataya ke log Nabi ke zamane mein qafilon se khaana khareedte the. Nabi unhe usi jagah bechne se rokte the jahan unhone khareeda tha (magar unhe intezar karna padta) jab tak woh use us bazaar tak nahi le jaate jahan khaane ki cheezein bechi jaati hain. Ibn Umar ne kaha: "Nabi ne khaane ki cheezein doosre ko bechne se bhi mana kiya jisne khareedi ho jab tak uski poori naap na le li ho."

e: Narrated Ata bin Yasar:I met `Abdullah bin `Amr bin Al-`As and asked him, "Tell me about the description of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) which is mentioned in Torah (i.e. Old Testament.") He replied, 'Yes. By Allah, he is described in Torah with some of the qualities attributed to him in the Qur'an as follows: "O Prophet ! We have sent you as a witness (for Allah's True religion) And a giver of glad tidings (to the faithful believers), And a warner (to the unbelievers) And guardian of the illiterates. You are My slave and My messenger (i.e. Apostle). I have named you "Al-Mutawakkil" (who depends upon Allah). You are neither discourteous, harsh Nor a noisemaker in the markets And you do not do evil to those Who do evil to you, but you deal With them with forgiveness and kindness. Allah will not let him (the Prophet) Die till he makes straight the crooked people by making them say: "None has the right to be worshipped but Allah," With which will be opened blind eyes And deaf ears and enveloped hearts
hi: Ata bin Yasar bataate hain: Main Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Aas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se mila aur unse pucha: "Mujhe bataiye Allah ke Rasool ki jo tasveer Torah (Old Testament) mein hai." Unhone jawab diya: "Haan. Allah ki qasam, unhe Torah mein kuch usi tarah ki sifaton se bataya gaya hai jaise Quran mein: 'Aye Nabi! Humne tumhe gawah (Allah ke sachche deen ke liye) aur khushkhabri dene wala (sacche momino ko) aur darane wala (kaafiron ko) aur un-padhon ka rakhwala banakr bheja hai. Tum mere banda aur mere Rasool ho. Maine tumhara naam "Al-Mutawakkil" (jo Allah par bharosa karta hai) rakha hai. Tum na be-adab ho, na sakht, na bazaaron mein shorgul karne wale, aur tum unse buraee nahi karte jo tumse buraee karte hain, balki unse maafi aur narmi se pesh aaate ho. Allah unhe (Nabi ko) tab tak maut nahi dega jab tak woh tedhe logon ko seedha na kar de, unse yeh kahalwvaukar: "Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahi," jisse andhi aankhein, bahare kaan, aur band dil khul jaayenge.'"

e: Narrated `Abdullah ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "He who buys foodstuff should not sell it till he is satisfied with the measure with which he has bought it
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jo khaane ki cheez khareedta hai, use tab tak nahi bechna chahiye jab tak woh naap se santusht na ho jaaye jise usne khareede waqt istemal kiya."

e: Narrated Jabir:`Abdullah bin `Amr bin Haram died and was in debt to others. I asked the Prophet (ﷺ) to intercede with his creditors for some reduction in the debts. The Prophet (ﷺ) requested them (to reduce the debts) but they refused. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to me, "Go and put your dates (In heaps) according to their different kinds. The Ajwa on one side, the cluster of Ibn Zaid on another side, etc.. Then call me." I did that and called the Prophet (ﷺ) He came and sat at the head or in the middle of the heaps and ordered me. Measure (the dates) for the people (creditors)." I measured for them till I paid all the debts. My dates remained as if nothing had been taken from them. In other narrations, Jabir said; The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He (i.e. `Abdullah) continued measuring for them till he paid all the debts." The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to `Abdullah), "Cut (clusters) for him (i.e. one of the creditors) and measure for him fully
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Haram ka intiqal hua aur unpar doosron ka qarz tha. Maine Nabi se guzarish ki ke woh unke qarzdaaar logon se kuch chhoot (kami) ke liye sifarish karein. Nabi ne unse guzarish ki magar unhone inkaar kiya. Nabi ne mujhse kaha: "Jaao aur apni khajooren (dher mein) unki alag-alag qisamon ke mutabiq rakho. Ajwa ek taraf, Ibn Zaid ka gucchha doosri taraf, waghera. Phir mujhe bulao." Maine aisa kiya aur Nabi ko bulwaya. Aap aaye aur dheron ke sar ya beech mein baithe aur mujhe hukum diya: "(Khajoor) logon (qarz-daaaron) ke liye naap." Maine unke liye naapa jab tak sab qarz ada nahi ho gaya. Meri khajooren waisi hi rahi jaise koi kami hi nahi hui. Doosri riwayaton mein, Jabir ne kaha: Nabi ne kaha: "Unhone (yaani Abdullah ne) unke liye tab tak naapa jab tak poora qarz ada nahi ho gaya." Nabi ne (Abdullah se) kaha: "Iske liye (yaani ek qarz-daaar ke liye) kaat do aur poori naap kar do."

e: Narrated Al-Miqdam bin Ma'diyakrib:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Measure your foodstuff and you will be blessed
hi: Al-Miqdam bin Ma'diyakrib bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Apni khaane ki cheezein naapkar bechna, isse tumhe barkat milegi."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Zaid:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The Prophet Abraham (ﷺ) made Mecca a sanctuary, and asked for Allah's blessing in it. I made Medina a sanctuary as Abraham made Mecca a sanctuary and I asked for Allah's Blessing in its measures the Mudd and the Sa as Abraham did for Mecca
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Nabi Ibrahim ne Mecca ko haram banaya, aur usme Allah ki barkat maangi. Maine Madina ko bhi haram banaya jaise Ibrahim ne Mecca ko banaya tha, aur maine Madina ke Mudd aur Sa (naapne ki khaas maqdaarein) mein barkat maangi jaise Ibrahim ne Mecca ke liye maangi."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O Allah bestow your blessings on their measures, bless their Mudd and Sa." The Prophet (ﷺ) meant the people of Medina
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Aye Allah! Unke naapne ki maqdaaron mein barkat de, unke Mudd aur Sa mein barkat de." Nabi ka matlab Madina ke logon se tha.

e: Narrated Salim:that his father said. "I saw those, who used to buy foodstuff without measuring or weighing in the life time of the Prophet (ﷺ) being punished if they sold it before carrying it to their own houses
hi: Salim bataate hain, apne waalid ke hawale se: "Maine dekha ke jinhone Nabi ke zamane mein bina naape ya tole khaane ki cheezein khareedi, unhe saza di jaati thi agar woh use apne gharon tak le jaane se pehle bech dete."

e: Narrated Tawus:Ibn `Abbas said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the selling of foodstuff before its measuring and transferring into one's possession." I asked Ibn `Abbas, "How is that?" Ibn `Abbas replied, "It will be just like selling money for money, as the foodstuff has not been handed over to the first purchaser who is the present seller
hi: Tawus bataate hain: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool ne khaane ki cheezon ko naap aur apne qabze mein lene se pehle bechne se mana kiya." Maine Ibn Abbas se pucha: "Yeh kaise?" Ibn Abbas ne jawab diya: "Yeh bilkul aise hoga jaise paise ke liye paise bechna, kyunke khaane ki cheez pehle khareedaar (jo ab bechne wala hai) ke haath mein nahi aayi."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who buys foodstuff should not sell it till he has received it
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jo khaane ki cheez khareedtaa hai, use tab tak nahi bechna chahiye jab tak woh use apne haath mein na le le."

e: Narrated Az-Zuhri from Malik bin Aus:That the latter said, "Who has change?" Talha said, "I (will have change) when our storekeeper comes from the forest." Malik bin Aus narrated from `Umar bin Al-Khattab: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The bartering of gold for gold is Riba (usury), except if it is from hand to hand and equal in amount, and wheat grain for wheat grain is usury except if it is from hand to hand and equal in amount, and dates for dates is usury except if it is from hand to hand and equal in amount, and barley for barley is usury except if it is from hand to hand and equal in amount
hi: Az-Zuhri, Malik bin Aus ke hawale se: Unhone (Malik bin Aus ne) kaha: "Kiske paas chhote sikke (chhutta) hain?" Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Mere paas honge jab humara khazanchi jungle se aayega." Malik bin Aus ne Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Khattab (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke hawale se riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Sone ka sone se badal karna Riba (sood) hai, siwaye jab yeh haath se haath ho aur maqdaar barabar ho, aur gehun ka gehun se badal karna sood hai siwaye jab yeh haath se haath ho aur maqdaar barabar ho, aur khajoor ka khajoor se badal karna sood hai siwaye jab yeh haath se haath ho aur maqdaar barabar ho, aur jau ka jau se badal karna sood hai siwaye jab yeh haath se haath ho aur maqdaar barabar ho."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the selling of foodstuff before receiving it. I consider that all types of sellings should be done similarly
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne khaane ki cheezon ko apne qabze mein lene se pehle bechne se mana kiya. Mera khayaal hai ke yehi hukum sab qisam ki bikri par lagu hota hai.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The buyer of foodstuff should not sell it before it has been measured for him." Isma`il narrated instead, "He should not sell it before receiving it
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Khaane ki cheez khareedne wale ko use tab tak nahi bechna chahiye jab tak uski naap na ho jaaye." Ismail (doosre raawi) ne is tarah kaha: "Use tab tak nahi bechna chahiye jab tak use qabze mein na le le."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:I saw the people buy foodstuff randomly (i.e. blindly without measuring it) in the lifetime of Allah's Apostle and they were punished (by beating), if they tried to sell it before carrying it to their own houses
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool ke zamane mein logon ko khaane ki cheezein bina naape (yaani andaza lagaakr) khareedte dekha, aur agar woh apne gharon tak le jaane se pehle bechne ki koshish karte, unhe saza (pitai) di jaati.

e: Narrated Aisha:Rarely did the Prophet (ﷺ) fail to visit Abu Bakr's house everyday, either in the morning or in the evening. When the permission for migration to Medina was granted, all of a sudden the Prophet (ﷺ) came to us at noon and Abu Bakr was informed, who said, "Certainly the Prophet (ﷺ) has come for some urgent matter." The Prophet (ﷺ) said to Abu Bakr, when the latter entered, "Let nobody stay in your home." Abu Bakr said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! There are only my two daughters (namely `Aisha and Asma') present." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I feel (am informed) that I have been granted the permission for migration." Abu Bakr said, "I will accompany you, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You will accompany me." Abu Bakr then said "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have two she-camels I have prepared specially for migration, so I offer you one of them. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I have accepted it on the condition that I will pay its price
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Bahut kam hi hota tha ke Nabi Abu Bakr ke ghar na jate, subah ya shaam mein. Jab Madina hijrat karne ki ijazat mili, achanak Nabi dopahar ko humare paas aaye aur Abu Bakr ko bataya gaya, unhone kaha: "Zaroor Nabi kisi zaroori kaam se aaye hain." Nabi ne Abu Bakr se, jab woh andar aaye, kaha: "Koi bhi tumhare ghar mein na rahe (baat karne ke liye)." Abu Bakr ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Sirf meri do betiyaan (Ayesha aur Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا)) hain." Nabi ne kaha: "Mujhe lagta hai (mujhe batayaa gaya hai) ke mujhe hijrat ki ijazat mil gayi hai." Abu Bakr ne kaha: "Main aapke saath jaunga, Ya Allah ke Rasool!" Nabi ne kaha: "Tum mere saath jaoge." Abu Bakr ne phir kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Mere paas do oontaniyaan hain jo maine khaas hijrat ke liye taiyaar ki hai, isliye main aapko unme se ek pesh karta hoon." Nabi ne kaha: "Maine ise is shart par qubool kiya ke main iski qeemat dunga."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Do not urge somebody to return what he has already bought (i.e. in optional sale) from another seller so as to sell him your own goods
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Kisi ko yeh mat kaho ke woh doosre bechne wale se khareedi hui cheez wapas kar de (yaani ikhtiyaari saudebaazi mein) taake tum use apna maal bech sako."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the selling of things by a town dweller on behalf of a desert dweller; and similarly Najsh was forbidden. And one should not urge somebody to return the goods to the seller so as to sell him his own goods; nor should one demand the hand of a girl who has already been engaged to someone else; and a woman should not try to cause some other woman to be divorced in order to take her place
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne shehar ke rehne wale ko dehati (Bedouin) ke liye cheez bechne se mana kiya; aur isi tarah Najsh (dikhaawe ki bikri, jisme kimat badhane ke liye jhoothi tez bolI lagaaee jaati hai) se bhi mana kiya. Aur kisi ko yeh nahi kehna chahiye ke woh cheez bechne wale ko wapas kare taake woh apni cheez bech sake; na kisi ladki ka rishta maangna chahiye jiski shaadi kisi doosre se pehle se tay ho chuki ho; aur na kisi aurat ko doosri aurat se talaq lene par uksana chahiye taake woh uski jagah le sake.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:A man decided that a slave of his would be manumitted after his death and later on he was in need of money, so the Prophet (ﷺ) took the slave and said, "Who will buy this slave from me?" Nu'aim bin `Abdullah bought him for such and such price and the Prophet (ﷺ) gave him the slave
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks ne apne gulaam ko apni maut ke baad azaad hone ka waada kiya, aur baad mein use paison ki zaroorat pad gayi, isliye Nabi ne woh gulaam liya aur kaha: "Kaun mujhse yeh gulaam khareedega?" Nu'aim bin Abdullah ne use falaan-falaan qeemat par khareeda aur Nabi ne unhe gulaam de diya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade Najsh
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Najsh se mana kiya.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the sale called 'Habal-al-Habala which was a kind of sale practiced in the Pre- Islamic Period of ignorance. One would pay the price of a she-camel which was not born yet would be born by the immediate offspring of an extant she-camel
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Habal-al-Habala naam ki bikri se mana kiya jo jahiliyat ke zamane mein hoti thi. Koi shaks ek oontani ki qeemat detaa jo abhi paida nahi hui hoti thi, jo maujooda oontani ke agle bachche se paida hogi.

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the selling by Munabadha, i.e. to sell one's garment by casting it to the buyer not allowing him to examine or see it. Similarly he forbade the selling by Mulamasa. Mulamasa is to buy a garment, for example, by merely touching it, not looking at it
hi: Abu Saeed (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Munabadha se bikri karne se mana kiya, yaani apna kapda khareedaar ki taraf phenkkar bechna, use dekhne ya jaanchne ki ijazat diye bina. Isi tarah Aap ne Mulamasa se bikri karne se bhi mana kiya. Mulamasa ka matlab hai ek kapda sirf usse chhue jaane se khareedna, use dekhe bina.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade two kinds of dressing; (one of them) is to sit with one's legs drawn up while wrapped in one garment. (The other) is to lift that garment on one's shoulders. And also forbade two kinds of sale: Al-Limais and An-Nibadh
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne do qisam ke pehnaave se mana kiya; (unme se ek) ek hi kapde mein lipt kar apni taangein samete baithnaa. (Doosra) us kapde ko apne shoulders par uthana. Aap ne do qisam ki bikri se bhi mana kiya: Al-Limais (Mulamasa) aur An-Nibadh (Munabadha).

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade selling by Mulamasa and Munabadha
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Mulamasa aur Munabadha se bikri karne se mana kiya.

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade two kinds of dresses and two kinds of sale, i.e., Mulamasa and Munabadha
hi: Abu Saeed (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne do qisam ke pehnaave aur do qisam ki bikri se mana kiya, yaani Mulamasa aur Munabadha.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Don't keep camels and sheep unmilked for a long time, for whoever buys such an animal has the option to milk it and then either to keep it or return it to the owner along with one Sa of dates." Some narrated from Ibn Seereen (that the Prophet (ﷺ) had said), "One Sa of wheat, and he has the option for three days." And some narrated from Ibn Seereen, " ... a Sa of dates," not mentioning the option for three days. But a Sa of dates is mentioned in most narrations
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "oont aur bhedon ko lambi der tak bina doodh nikale mat rakho, kyunke jo bhi aisa janwar khareedtaa hai, use doodh nikaalne ka ikhtiyaar hai aur phir ya to ise rakh sakta hai ya maalik ko wapas kar sakta hai ek Sa khajoor ke saath." Kuch riwayaton mein Ibn Seereen ke hawale se hai (ke Nabi ne kaha): "Ek Sa gehun, aur usse teen din ka ikhtiyaar hai." Aur kuch riwayaton mein Ibn Seereen se hai, "...ek Sa khajoor," teen din ke ikhtiyaar ka zikar kiye bina. Magar zyada tar riwayaton mein ek Sa khajoor ka zikar hai.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Mas`ud:Whoever buys a sheep which has not been milked for a long time, has the option of returning it along with one Sa of dates; and the Prophet (ﷺ) forbade going to meet the seller on the way (as he has no knowledge of the market price and he may sell his goods at a low price)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jo bhi ek lambi der se bina doodh nikale bhed khareede, usse yeh ikhtiyaar hai ke ek Sa khajoor ke saath ise wapas kare; aur Nabi ne bechne wale se raaste mein milne se mana kiya (kyunke usse bazaar ki qeemat ka pata nahi hota aur woh apna maal kam qeemat mein bech sakta hai).

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Do not go forward to meet the caravan (to buy from it on the way before it reaches the town). And do not urge buyers to cancel their purchases to sell them (your own goods) yourselves, and do not practice Najsh. A town dweller should not sell the goods for the desert dweller. Do not leave sheep unmilked for a long time, when they are on sale, and whoever buys such an animal has the option of returning it, after milking it, along with a Sa of dates or keeping it. it has been kept unmilked for a long period by the seller (to deceive others)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Qafile se milne ke liye aage mat jaao (taake usse shehar pahunchne se pehle raaste mein khareed lo). Aur khareedaaaron ko unki khareedari radd karne ke liye mat uksao taake tum unhe apna maal bech sako, aur Najsh mat karo. Ek shehar ka rehne wala dehati ke liye maal na beche. bhedon ko lambi der tak bina doodh nikale mat rakho jab woh bikri ke liye hon, aur jo bhi aisa janwar khareedta hai, use doodh nikaalne ke baad ise wapas karne ya rakhne ka ikhtiyaar hai ek Sa khajoor ke saath. Isse bechne wale ne (doosron ko dhoka dene ke liye) lambi der tak doodh nahi nikala hoga."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever buys a sheep which has been kept unmilked for a long period, and milks it, can keep it if he is satisfied, and if he is not satisfied, he can return it, but he should pay one Sa of dates for the milk
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jo bhi ek lambi der se bina doodh nikale bhed khareede aur uska doodh nikale, agar santusht ho to ise rakh sakta hai, aur agar santusht na ho, to ise wapas kar sakta hai, magar use doodh ke badle ek Sa khajoor deni hogi."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If a slave-girl commits illegal sexual intercourse and it is proved beyond doubt, then her owner should lash her and should not blame her after the legal punishment. And then if she repeats the illegal sexual intercourse he should lash her again and should not blame her after the legal punishment, and if she commits it a third time, then he should sell her even for a hair rope
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Agar koi launDi zina kare aur yeh bina shak sabit ho jaaye, to uske maalik ko use kode maarne chahiye aur qanooni saza ke baad usse zyada ninda nahi karni chahiye. Aur agar woh dobara zina kare, use phir kode maarne chahiye aur qanooni saza ke baad zyada ninda nahi karni chahiye, aur agar woh teesri baar aisa kare, to usse chahiye ke use bech de, chahe ek baal ki rassi ke badle mein hi kyun na ho."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira and Zaid bin Khalid:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked about the slave-girl, if she was a virgin and committed illegal sexual intercourse. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If she committed illegal sexual intercourse, lash her, and if she did it a second time, then lash her again, and if she repeated the third time, then sell her even for a hair rope." Ibn Shihab said, "I don't know whether to sell her after the third or fourth offense
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Zaid bin Khalid (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool se ek launDi ke baare mein pucha gaya, agar woh kunwari ho aur zina kare. Nabi ne kaha: "Agar usne zina kiya, use kode maaro, aur agar woh doosri baar kare, use phir kode maaro, aur agar woh teesri baar kare, to use bech do, chahe ek baal ki rassi ke badle mein hi ho." Ibn Shihab ne kaha: "Mujhe nahi pata teesri ya chauthi baar ke baad use bechna hai."

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to me and I told him about the slave-girl (Barirah) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Buy and manumit her, for the Wala is for the one who manumits." In the evening the Prophet (ﷺ) got up and glorified Allah as He deserved and then said, "Why do some people impose conditions which are not present in Allah's Book (Laws)? Whoever imposes such a condition as is not in Allah's Laws, then that condition is invalid even if he imposes one hundred conditions, for Allah's conditions are more binding and reliable
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool mere paas aaye aur maine unhe launDi (Barira (رضی اللہ عنہا)) ke baare mein bataya. Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: "Ise khareedkar azaad karo, kyunke Wala (waraasat ka rishta) azaad karne wale ka hota hai."
