Shaam ko Nabi khade hue aur jaisi Allah ki taareef karni chahiye waisi ki, phir kaha: "Kuch log Allah ki Kitaab mein maujood na hone wali sharten kyun rakhte hain? Jo bhi aisi shart lagata hai jo Allah ke qanoon mein nahi, woh shart baatil hai chahe woh sau sharten lagaye, kyunke Allah ki sharten zyada pukhta aur bharosemand hain."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Aisha wanted to buy Barirah and he (the Prophet) went out for the prayer. When he returned, she told him that they (her masters) refused to sell her except on the condition that her Wala' would go to them. The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, 'The Wala' would go to him who manumits.' " Hammam asked Nafi` whether her (Barirah's) husband was a free man or a slave. He replied that he did not know
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) Barira (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko khareednaa chahti thi aur woh (Nabi) namaz ke liye bahar gaye. Jab woh wapas aaye, unhone unhe bataya ke unke (Barira ke) maalikon ne use bechne se inkaar kiya siwaye is shart par ke uska Wala unhi ke paas rahega. Nabi ne jawab diya: "Wala usi ke paas jaaega jo azaad karega." Hammam ne Nafi se pucha kya Barira ka shohar azaad tha ya gulaam. Unhone jawab diya ke unhe pata nahi.

e: Narrated Jarir:I have given a pledge of allegiance to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for to testify that None has the right to be worshipped but Allah, and Muhammad is His Apostle, to offer prayers perfectly, to pay Zakat, to listen to and obey (Allah's and His Prophet's orders), and to give good advice to every Muslim
hi: Jarir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool se gawahi dene ki bai'at ki ke Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahi aur Muhammad uske Rasool hain, namazein mukammal padhne, Zakat dene, sunne aur maanne (Allah aur Nabi ke hukmon ki), aur har Musalman ko achhi naseehat dene ki.

e: Narrated Tawus:Ibn `Abbas said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Do not go to meet the caravans on the way (for buying their goods without letting them know the market price); a town dweller should not sell the goods of a desert dweller on behalf of the latter.' I asked Ibn `Abbas, 'What does he mean by not selling the goods of a desert dweller by a town dweller?' He said, 'He should not become his broker
hi: Tawus bataate hain: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: 'Qafilon se raaste mein milne mat jaao (unke saaman khareedne ke liye bina unhe bazaar ki qeemat bataye); shehar ka rehne wala dehati ke maal ko uski taraf se na beche.' Maine Ibn Abbas se pucha: 'Iska kya matlab hai ke shehar ka rehne wala dehati ke maal ko na beche?' Unhone jawab diya: 'Iska matlab hai use uska dalaal (broker) nahi banna chahiye.'"

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the selling of the goods of a desert dweller by a town person
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne shehar ke rehne wale ko dehati ke maal ko bechne se mana kiya.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "A buyer should not urge a seller to restore a purchase so as to buy it himself, and do not practice Najsh; and a town dweller should not sell goods of a desert dweller
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Khareedaar ko bechne wale se saudebaazi radd karne ke liye uksana nahi chahiye taake woh khud khareed sake, aur Najsh mat karo; aur shehar ka rehne wala dehati ke maal na beche."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:We were forbidden that a town dweller should sell goods of a desert dweller
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Humein rok diya gaya tha ke shehar ka rehne wala dehati ke maal ko na beche.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the meeting (of caravans) on the way and the selling of goods by an inhabitant of the town on behalf of a desert dweller
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne qafilon se raaste mein milne aur shehar ke rehne wale ke dehati ke maal ko uski taraf se bechne se mana kiya.

e: Narrated Tawus:I asked Ibn `Abbas, "What is the meaning of, 'No town dweller should sell (or buy) for a desert dweller'?" Ibn `Abbas said, "It means he should not become his broker
hi: Tawus bataate hain: Maine Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha: "'Koi shehar ka rehne wala dehati ke liye na beche (ya khareede)' ka kya matlab hai?" Ibn Abbas ne kaha: "Iska matlab hai use uska dalaal nahi banna chahiye."

e: Narrated `Abdullah:Whoever buys an animal which has been kept unmilked for a long time, could return it, but has to pay a Sa of dates along with it. And the Prophet (ﷺ) forbade meeting the owners of goods on the way away from the market
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jo bhi ek lambi der se bina doodh nikale janwar khareedta hai, use ise wapas karne ka ikhtiyaar hai, magar saath mein ek Sa khajoor deni hogi. Aur Nabi ne bazaar se door, raaste mein maal ke maalikon se milne se mana kiya.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "You should not try to cancel the purchases of one another (to get a benefit thereof), and do not go ahead to meet the caravan (for buying the goods) (but wait) till it reaches the market
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Ek-doosre ki khareedari ko radd karne ki koshish mat karo (isse faida uthane ke liye), aur qafile se milne ke liye aage mat jaao (saaman khareedne ke liye) jab tak woh bazaar tak na pahunch jaaye."

e: Narrated `Abdullah:We used to go ahead to meet the caravan and used to buy foodstuff from them. The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade us to sell it till it was carried to the market
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum qafile se milne aage jate the aur unse khaane ki cheezein khareedte the. Nabi ne humein unhe (bazaar mein) le jaane se pehle bechne se mana kiya.

e: Narrated `Abdullah:Some people used to buy foodstuff at the head of the market and used to sell it on the spot. Allah's Apostle forbade them to sell it till they brought it to (their) places
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Kuch log bazaar ke shuru mein khaane ki cheezein khareedte aur usi jagah bech dete. Allah ke Rasool ne unhe (apni) jagahon tak lane se pehle bechne se mana kiya.

e: Narrated `Urwa:Aisha said, "Barira came to me and said, 'I have agreed with my masters to pay them nine Uqiyas (of gold) (in installments) one Uqiya per year; please help me.' I said, 'I am ready to pay the whole amount now provided your masters agree that your Wala' will be for me.' So, Barira went to her masters and told them about that offer but they refused to accept it. She returned, and at that time, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was sitting (present). Barira said, 'I told them of the offer but they did not accept it and insisted on having the Wala'.' The Prophet (ﷺ) heard that." `Aisha narrated the whole story to the Prophet. He said to her, "Buy her and stipulate that her Wala' would be yours as the Wala' is for the manumitter." `Aisha did so. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up in front of the people, and after glorifying Allah he said, "Amma Ba`du (i.e. then after)! What about the people who impose conditions which are not in Allah's Book (Laws)? Any condition that is not in Allah's Book (Laws) is invalid even if they were one hundred conditions, for Allah's decisions are the right ones and His conditions are the strong ones (firmer) and the Wala' will be for the manumitter
hi: Urwa bataate hain: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha: "Barira (رضی اللہ عنہا) mere paas aayi aur kaha: 'Maine apne maalikon se sehmati ki hai ke main unhe nau Uqiya (sona) dunga (kisaaaton mein), ek Uqiya har saal; kripya meri madad karein.' Maine kaha: 'Main puri raqam abhi ada karne ko taiyaar hoon bashart tumhare maalik raazi hon ke tumhara Wala mera hoga.' Isliye Barira apne maalikon ke paas gayi aur unhe yeh pesh kash bataya magar unhone qubool karne se inkaar kiya. Woh wapas aayi, aur us waqt Allah ke Rasool (wahin) baithe hue the. Barira ne kaha: 'Maine unhe pesh kash batai magar unhone qubool nahi ki aur Wala rakhne par zid ki.' Nabi ne yeh suna." Ayesha ne poori kahani Nabi ko sunayi. Aap ne unse kaha: "Ise khareedo aur shart rakho ke uska Wala tumhara hoga, kyunke Wala azaad karne wale ka hota hai." Ayesha ne waisa hi kiya. Phir Allah ke Rasool logon ke saamne khade hue, aur Allah ki hamd-o-sana karke kaha: "Amma ba'du (yaani iske baad)! Un logon ka kya kahna jo Allah ki Kitaab mein na hone wali sharten lagate hain? Koi bhi shart jo Allah ki Kitaab mein na ho, baatil hai chahe woh sau sharten hon, kyunke Allah ke faisle sahi hain aur uski sharten pukhta (mazboot) hain, aur Wala azaad karne wale ka hoga."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Aisha, (mother of the faithful believers) wanted to buy a slave girl and manumit her, but her masters said that they would sell her only on the condition that her Wala' would be for them. `Aisha told Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) of that. He said, "What they stipulate should not hinder you from buying her, as the Wala' is for the manumitted
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Ummul-Momineen) ek launDi khareedna aur azaad karna chahti thi, magar uske maalikon ne kaha ke woh use sirf is shart par bechenge ke uska Wala unke paas rahega. Ayesha ne yeh Allah ke Rasool ko batayi. Aap ne kaha: "Unki lagaee hui shart tumhe use khareedne se na roke, kyunke Wala azaad karne wale ka hota hai."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The selling of wheat for wheat is Riba (usury) except if it is handed from hand to hand and equal in amount. Similarly the selling of barley for barley, is Riba except if it is from hand to hand and equal in amount, and dates for dates is usury except if it is from hand to hand and equal in amount. (See Riba-Fadl in the glossary)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Gehun ka gehun se badla lena Riba (sood) hai siwaye jab yeh haath se haath ho aur maqdaar barabar ho. Isi tarah jau ka jau se badla lena bhi Riba hai siwaye jab yeh haath se haath ho aur maqdaar barabar ho, aur khajoor ka khajoor se badla lena sood hai siwaye jab yeh haath se haath ho aur maqdaar barabar ho."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade Muzabana; and Muzabana is the selling of fresh dates for dried old dates by measure, and the selling of fresh grapes for dried grapes by measure
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Muzabana se mana kiya; aur Muzabana ka matlab hai taazi khajoor ko sookhi purani khajoor se naap se bechna, aur taazi angoor ko sookhi kishmish se naap se bechna.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade Muzabana; and Muzabana is the selling of fresh fruit (without measuring it) for something by measure on the basis that if that thing turns to be more than the fruit, the increase would be for the seller of the fruit, and if it turns to be less, that would be of his lot. Narrated Ibn `Umar from Zaid bin Thabit that the Prophet (ﷺ) allowed the selling of the fruits on the trees after estimation (when they are ripe)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne Muzabana se mana kiya; aur Muzabana ka matlab hai taaza phal (bina naaape) ko naap ki cheez se bechna is bunyaad par ke agar woh cheez phal se zyada nikle, izafa bechne wale ka hoga, aur agar kam nikle, woh nuqsaan bhi uska hoga. Zaid bin Thabit (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke hawale se: Nabi ne darakhton par phal andaza lagaakar (jab woh pak jaaen) bechne ki ijazat di.

e: Narrated Ibn Shihab:that Malik bin Aus said, "I was in need of change for one-hundred Dinars. Talha bin 'Ubaidullah called me and we discussed the matter, and he agreed to change (my Dinars). He took the gold pieces in his hands and fidgeted with them, and then said, "Wait till my storekeeper comes from the forest." `Umar was listening to that and said, "By Allah! You should not separate from Talha till you get the money from him, for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'The selling of gold for gold is Riba (usury) except if the exchange is from hand to hand and equal in amount, and similarly, the selling of wheat for wheat is Riba (usury) unless it is from hand to hand and equal in amount, and the selling of barley for barley is usury unless it is from hand to hand and equal in amount, and dates for dates, is usury unless it is from hand to hand and equal in amount
hi: Ibn Shihab bataate hain: Malik bin Aus ne kaha: "Mujhe sau Dinar ke liye chhutte (chhote sikke) chahiye the. Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ubaidullah ne mujhe bulaya aur humne iss baare mein baat ki, aur woh (mere Dinar) badalne ke liye raazi hue. Unhone sone ke tukde apne haathon mein liye aur unse khelte rahe, phir kaha: 'Intezar karo jab tak mera khazanchi jungle se aaye.' Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) yeh sun rahe the aur unhone kaha: 'Allah ki qasam! Tum Talha se tab tak alag mat ho jab tak tumhe paisa na mile, kyunke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: Sone ka sone se badal karna Riba hai siwaye jab yeh badla haath se haath ho aur maqdaar barabar ho, aur isi tarah gehun ka gehun se badal karna Riba hai jab tak yeh haath se haath ho aur maqdaar barabar ho, aur jau ka jau se badal karna Riba hai jab tak yeh haath se haath ho aur maqdaar barabar ho, aur khajoor ka khajoor se badal karna Riba hai jab tak yeh haath se haath ho aur maqdaar barabar ho.'"

e: Narrated Abu Bakra:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Don't sell gold for gold unless equal in weight, nor silver for silver unless equal in weight, but you could sell gold for silver or silver for gold as you like
hi: Abu Bakra (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Sona sone ke badle mat becho siwaye jab woh wazan mein barabar ho, na chandi chandi ke badle siwaye jab woh wazan mein barabar ho, magar tum sona chandi ke badle ya chandi sona ke badle jaisa chaho becho sakte ho."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id:(Concerning exchange) that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "Do not sell gold for gold unless equal in weight, and do not sell silver unless equal in weight
hi: Abu Saeed (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain (adla-badli ke baare mein): Maine Allah ke Rasool ko farmate suna: "Sona sone ke badle mat becho siwaye jab woh wazan mein barabar ho, aur chandi chandi ke badle mat becho siwaye jab woh wazan mein barabar ho."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Do not sell gold for gold unless equivalent in weight, and do not sell less amount for greater amount or vice versa; and do not sell silver for silver unless equivalent in weight, and do not sell less amount for greater amount or vice versa and do not sell gold or silver that is not present at the moment of exchange for gold or silver that is present
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Sona sone ke badle mat becho siwaye jab woh wazan mein barabar ho, aur kam maqdaar ko zyada maqdaar ke badle ya iske ulta mat becho; aur chandi chandi ke badle mat becho siwaye jab woh wazan mein barabar ho, aur kam maqdaar ko zyada maqdaar ke badle ya iske ulta mat becho, aur jo sona ya chandi maujood na ho use maujood sona ya chandi ke badle mat becho."

e: Narrated Abu Salih Az-Zaiyat:I heard Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri saying, "The selling of a Dinar for a Dinar, and a Dirham for a Dirham (is permissible)." I said to him, "Ibn `Abbas does not say the same." Abu Sa`id replied, "I asked Ibn `Abbas whether he had heard it from the Prophet (ﷺ) or seen it in the Holy Book. Ibn `Abbas replied, "I do not claim that, and you know Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) better than I, but Usama informed me that the Prophet had said, 'There is no Riba (in money exchange) except when it is not done from hand to hand (i.e. when there is delay in payment)
hi: Abu Salih Az-Zaiyat bataate hain: Maine Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko kehte suna: "Ek Dinar ka ek Dinar ke badle, aur ek Dirham ka ek Dirham ke badle bikri (jaiz hai)." Maine unse kaha: "Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) yehi nahi kehte." Abu Saeed ne jawab diya: "Maine Ibn Abbas se pucha kya unhone yeh Nabi se suna tha ya Kitaab-e-Paak mein dekha tha. Ibn Abbas ne jawab diya: 'Main yeh daawa nahi karta, aur tum Allah ke Rasool ke baare mein mujhse zyada jaante ho, magar Usama ne mujhe bataya ke Nabi ne kaha tha: Riba (paisa badalne mein) sirf tab hoti hai jab yeh haath se haath na ho (yaani jab payment mein deri ho).'"

e: Narrated Abu Al-Minhal:I asked Al-Bara' bin `Azib and Zaid bin Arqam about money exchanges. Each of them said, "This is better than I," and both of them said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the selling of silver for gold on credit
hi: Abu Al-Minhal bataate hain: Maine Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Zaid bin Arqam (رضی اللہ عنہ) se paise ki adla-badli ke baare mein pucha. Unme se har ek ne kaha: "Yeh (doosra) mujhse behtar hai," aur donon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool ne chandi ko sone ke badle udhaaar par bechne se mana kiya."

e: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Bakra:that his father said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the selling of gold for gold and silver for silver except if they are equivalent in weight, and allowed us to sell gold for silver and vice versa as we wished
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Bakra (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain, apne waalid ke hawale se: Nabi ne sone ka sone se aur chandi ka chandi se badla karne se mana kiya siwaye jab woh wazan mein barabar hon, aur humein sona chandi se ya chandi sona se jaisa chaho badla karne ki ijazat di.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Do not sell fruits of dates until they become free from all the dangers of being spoilt or blighted; and do not sell fresh dates for dry dates." Narrated Salim and `Abdullah from Zaid bin Thabit: "Later on Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) permitted the selling of ripe fruits on trees for fresh dates or dried dates in Bai'-al-'Araya, and did not allow it for any other kind of sale
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Khajoor ke phal tab tak mat becho jab tak woh kharab ya bimar hone ke sab khatron se mehfooz na ho jaayen; aur taazi khajoor ko sookhi khajoor ke badle mat becho." Salim aur Abdullah, Zaid bin Thabit (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke hawale se: "Baad mein Allah ke Rasool ne pake hue phalon ko taazi ya sookhi khajoor ke badle Bai-al-Araya mein bechne ki ijazat di, aur kisi doosri qisam ki bikri ke liye nahi."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade Muzabana; and Muzabana means the selling of fresh dates (on the trees) for dried dates by measure and also the selling of fresh grapes for dried grapes by measure
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Muzabana se mana kiya; aur Muzabana ka matlab hai taazi khajoor (darakhton par) ko sookhi khajoor se naap se bechna, aur taazi angoor ko sookhi kishmish se naap se bechna.

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade Muzabana and Muhaqala; and Muzabana means the selling of ripe dates for dates still on the trees
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Muzabana aur Muhaqala se mana kiya; aur Muzabana ka matlab hai pakki khajoor ko darakhton par lagi (kachchi) khajoor ke badle bechna.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade Muzabana and Muhaqala
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne Muzabana aur Muhaqala se mana kiya.

e: Narrated Zaid bin Thabit:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) allowed the owner of 'Araya to sell the fruits on the trees by means of estimation
hi: Zaid bin Thabit (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Araya ke maalik ko darakhton ke phal andaza lagaakar bechne ki ijazat di.

e: Narrated Jabir:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the selling of fruits unless they get ripe, and none of them should be sold except for Dinar or Dirham (i.e. money), except the 'Araya trees (the dates of which could be sold for dates)
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne phalon ko tab tak bechne se mana kiya jab tak woh pak na jaayen, aur unhe sirf Dinar ya Dirham (yaani paison) ke badle bechna chahiye, siwaye Araya darakhton ke (jinki khajoor khajoor ke badle bechi ja sakti hai).

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) allowed the sale of the dates of 'Araya provided they were about five Awsuq (singular: Wasaq which means sixty Sa's) or less (in amount)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Araya ki khajoor ki bikri ko taqreeban paanch Awsuq (ek Wasq matlab saath Sa) ya usse kam maqdaar mein ijazat di.

e: Narrated Sahl bin Abu Hathma:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the selling of fruits (fresh dates) for dried dates but allowed the sale of fruits on the 'Araya by estimation and their new owners might eat their dates fresh. Sufyan (in another narration) said, "I told Yahya (a sub-narrator) when I was a mere boy, 'Meccans say that the Prophet (ﷺ) allowed them the sale of the fruits on 'Araya by estimation.' Yahya asked, 'How do the Meccans know about it?' I replied, 'They narrated it (from the Prophet (ﷺ) ) through Jabir.' On that, Yahya kept quiet." Sufyan said, "I meant that Jabir belonged to Medina." Sufyan was asked whether in Jabir's narration there was any prohibition of selling fruits before their benefit is evident (i.e. no dangers of being spoilt or blighted). He replied that there was none
hi: Sahl bin Abu Hathma bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne phalon (taazi khajoor) ko sookhi khajoor ke badle bechne se mana kiya, magar Araya par phalon ko andaza lagaakar bechne ki ijazat di, aur unke naye maalik apni taazi khajoor kha sakte the. Sufyan ne (ek doosri riwayat mein) kaha: "Maine Yahya se kaha, jabke main abhi bachcha tha: 'Mecca wale kehte hain ke Nabi ne unhe Araya par phalon ko andaza lagaakar bechne ki ijazat di.' Yahya ne pucha: 'Mecca walon ko iska kaise pata chala?' Maine jawab diya: 'Unhone yeh (Nabi se) Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke zariye riwayat ki.'" Isspar Yahya khamosh ho gaye. Sufyan ne kaha: "Mera matlab tha ke Jabir Madina se the." Sufyan se pucha gaya kya Jabir ki riwayat mein phalon ko unki khoobi zaahir hone se pehle bechne ki mumaaniyat ka koi zikar hai. Unhone jawab diya ke aisa koi zikar nahi.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar from Zaid bin Thabit:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) allowed the sale of 'Araya by estimating the dates on them for measured amounts of dried dates. Musa bin `Uqba said, "Al- 'Araya were distinguished date palms; one could come and buy them (i.e. their fruits)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ), Zaid bin Thabit (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke hawale se: Allah ke Rasool ne Araya ko unpar ki khajoor andaza lagaakar, naapi hui sookhi khajoor ke badle bechne ki ijazat di. Musa bin Uqba ne kaha: "Al-Araya alag-alag khajoor ke darakht the; koi bhi aakar unhe (yaani unke phal) khareed sakta tha."

e: Zaid bin Thabit (ra) said, "In the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), the people used to trade with fruits. When they cut their date-fruits and the purchasers came to recieve their rights, the seller would say, 'My dates have got rotten, they are blighted with disease, they are afflicted with Qusham (a disease which causes the fruit to fall before ripening).' They would go on complaining of defects in their purchases. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Do not sell the fruits before their benefit is evident (i.e. free from all the dangers of being spoiled or blighted), by way of advice for they quarrelled too much." Kharija bin Zaid bin Thabit said that Zaid bin Thabit (ra) used not to sell the fruits of his land till Pleiades appeared and one could distinguish the yellow fruits from the red (ripe) ones
hi: Zaid bin Thabit (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ke zamane mein, log phalon ki tijarat karte the. Jab woh apni khajoor kaatte aur khareedaar apni cheez lene aaate, bechne wala kehta: "Meri khajoor sad chuki hai, unme bimari hai, unhe Qusham (ek bimari jisse phal pakne se pehle gir jaate hain) lag chuki hai." Woh apni khareedi hui cheez mein aib ki shikayat karte rehte. Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: "Phalon ko unki khoobi zaahir hone se pehle mat becho (yaani jab tak woh kharab ya bimar hone ke khatre se mehfooz na ho), naseehat ke tor par, kyunke woh bahut zyada jhagdte the." Kharija bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Thabit ne kaha ke Zaid bin Thabit apni zameen ke phal tab tak nahi bechte the jab tak Pleiades (sitare) zaahir na hote aur peele phal lal (pake) phalon se alag na dikhaaee dete.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the sale of fruits till their benefit is evident. He forbade both the seller and the buyer (such sale)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne phalon ko unki khoobi zaahir hone se pehle bechne se mana kiya. Aap ne bechne aur khareedne wale dono ko (aisi bikri se) mana kiya.

e: Narrated Anas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the sale of date fruits till they were ripe. Abu `Abdullah (Al-Bukhari) said, "That means till they were red (can be eaten)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne khajoor ke phalon ko pakne se pehle bechne se mana kiya. Abu Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) (Al-Bukhari) ne kaha: "Iska matlab hai jab tak woh lal (khane ke laayak) na ho jaayen."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the sale of (date) fruits till they were red or yellow and fit for eating
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne (khajoor) phalon ko tab tak bechne se mana kiya jab tak woh lal ya pele aur khane ke laayak na ho jaayen.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the sale of fruits till their benefit is evident; and the sale of date palms till the dates are almost ripe. He was asked what 'are almost ripe' meant. He replied, "Got red and yellow
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne phalon ko unki khoobi zaahir hone se pehle bechne se mana kiya; aur khajoor ke darakhton ko tab tak bechne se mana kiya jab tak khajoor taqreeban pak na jaaen. Aap se poocha gaya "taqreeban pak" ka matlab kya hai. Aap ne jawab diya: "Lal aur pele ho jaayen."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the sale of fruits till they are almost ripe. He was asked what is meant by 'are almost ripe.' He replied, "Till they become red." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) further said, "If Allah spoiled the fruits, what right would one have to take the money of one's brother (i.e. other people)?
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne phalon ko tab tak bechne se mana kiya jab tak woh taqreeban pak na jaayen. Aap se poocha gaya "taqreeban pak" ka matlab kya hai. Aap ne jawab diya: "Jab tak woh lal na ho jaayen." Allah ke Rasool ne aage kaha: "Agar Allah phalon ko barbaad kar de, to kisi ko apne bhai (yaani doosre logon) ka paisa lene ka kya haqq hoga?"

e: Narrated Ibn Shihab:If somebody bought fruits before their benefit is evident and then the fruits were spoiled with blights, the loss would be suffered by the owner (not the buyer). Narrated Salim bin 'Abdullah from Ibn Umar: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Do not sell or buy fruits before their benefit was evident and do not sell fresh fruits (dates) for dried dates
hi: Ibn Shihab bataate hain: Agar koi phal unki khoobi zaahir hone se pehle khareedtaa hai aur phir woh bimari se barbaad ho jaate hain, nuqsaan maalik (bechne wale) ka hoga (khareedar ka nahi). Salim bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ), Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke hawale se: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Phalon ko unki khoobi zaahir hone se pehle mat becho ya khareedo, aur taazi phal (khajoor) ko sookhi khajoor se mat becho."

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) bought some foodstuff from a Jew on credit and mortgaged his armor to him
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi ne ek Yahudi se qarz par kuch khaane ki cheezein khareedi aur apna zire uske paas girvi rakha.

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri and Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) appointed somebody as a governor of Khaibar. That governor brought to him an excellent kind of dates (from Khaibar). The Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "Are all the dates of Khaibar like this?" He replied, "By Allah, no, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! But we barter one Sa of this (type of dates) for two Sas of dates of ours and two Sas of it for three of ours." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Do not do so (as that is a kind of usury) but sell the mixed dates (of inferior quality) for money, and then buy good dates with that money
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Khaibar ka gawarnar muqarrar kiya. Us gawarnar ne unke paas ek behtareen qisam ki khajoor (Khaibar se) laayi. Nabi ne pucha: "Kya Khaibar ki sab khajoor aisi hi hain?" Usne jawab diya: "Allah ki qasam, nahi, Ya Allah ke Rasool! Magar hum ek Sa iski (yaani achhi khajoor ki) do Sa humari (kamzor khajoor) ke badle badalte hain, aur do Sa iski teen Sa humari ke badle." Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: "Aisa mat karo (kyunke yeh ek qisam ka Riba hai) balki mila-jula khajoor (kam quality wali) paise ke badle becho, phir usse achhi khajoor khareedo."

e: Narrated Nafi', the freed slave of Ibn 'Umar:If pollinated date-palms are sold and nothing is mentioned (in the contract) about their fruits, the fruits will go to the person who has pollinated them, and so will be the case with the slave and the cultivator. Nafi' mentioned those three things
hi: Nafi, Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke azaad kiye gulaam, bataate hain: Agar pollinated (nar-maada milaaee hui) khajoor ke darakht beche jaayein aur (samjhaute mein) unke phalon ka koi zikar na ho, phal usi shaks ko milenge jisne unme pollination karvaee thi, aur yehi hukum gulaam aur khetihar ke saath bhi hai. Nafi ne yeh teen cheezon ka zikar kiya.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If somebody sells pollinated date palms, the fruits will be for the seller unless the buyer stipulates that they will be for himself (and the seller agrees)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Agar koi pollinated khajoor ke darakht bechta hai, phal bechne wale ke honge siwaye jab khareedaar shart rakhe ke woh unke honge (aur bechne wala raazi ho)."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade Al-Muzabana, i.e. to sell ungathered dates of one's garden for measured dried dates or fresh ungathered grapes for measured dried grapes; or standing crops for measured quantity of foodstuff. He forbade all such bargains
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Al-Muzabana se mana kiya, yaani apne baag ki bina kati khajoor ko naapi hui sookhi khajoor ke badle bechna, ya bina kate taaza angoor ko naapi hui sookhi kishmish ke badle, ya khade fasal ko naapi hui maqdaar ke khaane ki cheez ke badle. Aap ne aise sab saudo se mana kiya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever pollinates date palms and then sells them, the fruits will belong to him unless the buyer stipulates that the fruits should belong to him (and the seller agrees)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jo bhi khajoor ke darakhton mein pollination karvata hai aur phir unhe becht hai, phal usi ke honge siwaye jab khareedaar shart rakhe ke woh phal uske honge (aur bechne wala raazi ho)."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade Muhaqala, Mukhadara, Mulamasa, Munabadha and Muzabana. (See glossary and previous Hadiths for the meanings of these terms)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Muhaqala, Mukhadara, Mulamasa, Munabadha, aur Muzabana se mana kiya.

e: Narrated Humaid:Anas said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the selling of dates till they were almost ripe." We asked Anas, "What does 'almost ripe' mean?" He replied, "They get red and yellow. The Prophet (ﷺ) added, 'If Allah destroyed the fruits present on the trees, what right would the seller have to take the money of his brother (somebody else)?
hi: Humaid bataate hain: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Nabi ne khajoor ko tab tak bechne se mana kiya jab tak woh taqreeban pak na jaayen." Humne Anas se pucha: "'Taqreeban pak' ka kya matlab hai?" Unhone jawab diya: "Woh lal aur pele ho jaate hain." Nabi ne joda: "Agar Allah darakhton par lagI khajoor ko barbaad kar de, to bechne wale ko apne bhai (yaani doosre shaks) ka paisa lene ka kya haqq hoga?"

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:I was with the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was eating fresh dates. He said, "From the trees there is a tree which resembles a faithful believer." I wanted to say that it was the date palm, but I was the youngest among them (so I kept quiet). He added, "It is the date palm
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Main Nabi ke saath tha jabke woh taazi khajoor kha rahe the. Aap ne kaha: "Darakhton mein se ek darakht hai jo ek sacche momin jaisa hai." Main kehna chahta tha ke yeh khajoor ka darakht hai, magar main unme sabse jawan tha (isliye chup raha). Aap ne joda: "Yeh khajoor ka darakht hai."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Abu Taiba cupped Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and so Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered that a Sa of dates be paid to him and ordered his masters (for he was a slave) to reduce his tax
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Taiba ne Allah ke Rasool ka cupping kiya, isliye Allah ke Rasool ne hukum diya ke unhe ek Sa khajoor di jaaye aur unke maalikon (jinke woh gulaam the) ko unka tax kam karne ka hukum diya.

e: Narrated `Aisha:Hind, the mother of Mu'awiya said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), "Abu Sufyan (her husband) is a miser. Am I allowed to take from his money secretly?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said to her, "You and your sons may take what is sufficient reasonably and fairly
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Hind, Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki maa, ne Allah ke Rasool se kaha: "Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ) (unke shohar) kanjoos hain. Kya main unke paise se chupke (kuch) le sakti hoon?" Nabi ne unse kaha: "Tum aur tumhare bete jitna munasib aur munasib hai utna le sakte ho."

e: Narrated Hisham bin `Urwa from his father:who heard Aisha saying, "The Holy Verse; 'Whoever amongst the guardians is rich, he should take no wages (from the property of the orphans) but If he is poor, let him have for himself what is just and reasonable (according to his labors)' (4.6) was revealed concerning the guardian of the orphans who looks after them and manages favorably their financial affairs; If the guardian Is poor, he could have from It what Is just and reasonable, (according to his labors)
hi: Hisham bin Urwa, apne waalid ke hawale se, jinhone Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko kehte suna: "Yeh paak Aayat: 'Jo bhi sarparast maldaar ho, use (yateemon ki maal se) koi mazdoori nahi leni chahiye, magar agar woh gareeb hai, use utna hi lena chahiye jo uske liye jaiz aur munasib ho (uski mehnat ke mutabiq)' (4:6) yateemon ke sarparast ke baare mein nazil hui jo unki dekhbhal karta hai aur unke maali maamle sambhalataa hai; agar sarparast gareeb hai, woh utna hi le sakta hai jo jaiz aur munasib ho (uski mehnat ke mutabiq)."

e: Narrated Jabir:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave preemption (to the partner) in every joint property, but if the boundaries of the property were demarcated or the ways and streets were fixed, then there was no pre-emption
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne har mushtarka (joint) maal mein pre-emption (Shuf'a — pehle khareedne ka haqq) ki ijazat di, magar agar maal ki seemaen tay ho chuki thi ya raaste-galiyaan muqarrar ho chuki thi, to Shuf'a nahi hota.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) decided the validity of preemption in every joint undivided property, but if the boundaries were well marked or the ways and streets were fixed, then there was no pre-emption
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne har mushtarka (bina baaanti hui) maal mein Shuf'a ki vaidta ka faisla kiya, magar agar seemaen achhi tarah tay thi ya raaste-galiyaan muqarrar thi, to Shuf'a nahi hota.

e: Narrated Mussaddad from `Abdul Wahid:the same as above but said, "... in every joint undivided thing..." Narrated Hisham from Ma`mar the same as above but said, " ... in every property
hi: Mussaddad, Abdul Wahid ke hawale se: yehi upar wali baat, magar kaha, "... har mushtarka (bina baaanti) cheez mein..." Hisham, Ma'mar ke hawale se: yehi upar wali baat, magar kaha, "... har maal mein."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "While three persons were walking, rain began to fall and they had to enter a cave in a mountain. A big rock rolled over and blocked the mouth of the cave. They said to each other, 'Invoke Allah with the best deed you have performed (so Allah might remove the rock)'. One of them said, 'O Allah! My parents were old and I used to go out for grazing (my animals). On my return I would milk (the animals) and take the milk in a vessel to my parents to drink. After they had drunk from it, I would give it to my children, family and wife. One day I was delayed and on my return I found my parents sleeping, and I disliked to wake them up. The children were crying at my feet (because of hunger). That state of affairs continued till it was dawn. O Allah! If You regard that I did it for Your sake, then please remove this rock so that we may see the sky.' So, the rock was moved a bit. The second said, 'O Allah! You know that I was in love with a cousin of mine, like the deepest love a man may have for a woman, and she told me that I would not get my desire fulfilled unless I paid her one-hundred Dinars (gold pieces). So, I struggled for it till I gathered the desired amount, and when I sat in between her legs, she told me to be afraid of Allah, and asked me not to deflower her except rightfully (by marriage). So, I got up and left her. O Allah! If You regard that I did it for Your sake, kindly remove this rock.' So, two-thirds of the rock was removed. Then the third man said, 'O Allah! No doubt You know that once I employed a worker for one Faraq (three Sa's) of millet, and when I wanted to pay him, he refused to take it, so I sowed it and from its yield I bought cows and a shepherd. After a time that man came and demanded his money. I said to him: Go to those cows and the shepherd and take them for they are for you. He asked me whether I was joking with him. I told him that I was not joking with him, and all that belonged to him. O Allah! If You regard that I did it sincerely for Your sake, then please remove the rock.' So, the rock was removed completely from the mouth of the cave
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jabke teen log chal rahe the, baarish shuru ho gayi aur unhe ek pahad ki gufa mein panah leni padi. Ek bada patthar ludkaa aur gufa ka mun band ho gaya. Unhone ek-doosre se kaha: 'Allah se apne behtareen amal ke wasile se dua karo (taake Allah patthar hataa de).' Unme se ek ne kaha: 'Aye Allah! Mere maa-baap budhe the aur main charaaee (apne janwaron ki) ke liye jata tha. Wapas aakar (unka doodh) nikaalta aur ek bartan mein apne maa-baap ke peene ke liye lata. Unke pi lene ke baad, main apne bachchon, pariwara aur biwi ko deta. Ek din mujhe der ho gayi aur wapas aakar maine apne maa-baap ko sote paaya, aur mujhe unhe jagaanaa napasand hua. Bachche mere paon ke paas rote rahe (bhookh se). Yeh haalat subah tak jaari rahi. Aye Allah! Agar tujhe pata hai maine yeh sirf tere liye kiya, to kripya yeh patthar hata de taake hum aasman dekh sakein.' To patthar thoda hila. Doosre ne kaha: 'Aye Allah! Tujhe pata hai ke main apni ek chachazaad bahan se mohabbat karta tha, jaisi sabse gehri mohabbat koi mard kisi aurat se kar sakta hai, aur usne mujhse kaha ke meri khwahish tab tak poori nahi hogi jab tak main use sau Dinar (sone ke sikke) na dun. Isliye maine bahut mehnat ki jab tak maine woh maqdaar jama nahi kar li, aur jab main uski taangong ke beech baitha, usne mujhse Allah se darne ko kaha, aur mujhe usse haqq (shaadi) ke bina uski izzat na loothne ko kaha. Isliye main utha aur use chhod diya. Aye Allah! Agar tujhe pata hai maine yeh sirf tere liye kiya, to kripya yeh patthar hata de.' To do-tihai patthar hat gaya. Phir teesre shaks ne kaha: 'Aye Allah! Beshak tujhe pata hai ke maine ek mazdoor ko ek Faraq (teen Sa) bajra ke liye kaam par rakha, aur jab maine use paisa dena chaha, usne lene se inkaar kiya, isliye maine usse boya aur uski paidawaar se maine gaayen aur ek charwaha khareeda. Kuch waqt baad woh shaks aaya aur apna paisa maangne laga. Maine usse kaha: Un gaayon aur charwahe ki taraf jaao aur unhe le lo, kyunke woh tumhare hain. Usne pucha kya main uska mazaaak uda raha hoon. Maine kaha nahi, main mazaaak nahi kar raha hoon, aur sab kuch uska tha. Aye Allah! Agar tujhe pata hai maine yeh sirf tere liye kiya, to kripya patthar hata de.' To patthar gufa ke mun se poori tarah hat gaya."

e: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Bakr:We were with the Prophet (ﷺ) when a tall pagan with long matted unkempt hair came driving his sheep. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked him, "Are those sheep for sale or for gifts?" The pagan replied, "They are for sale." The Prophet (ﷺ) bought one sheep from him
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Bakr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Nabi ke saath the jab ek lamba mushrik, lambe uljhe baalon wala, apni bhedon ko hankate hue aaya. Nabi ne unse pucha: "Kya yeh bhedein bikri ke liye hain ya tohfa?" Mushrik ne jawab diya: "Bikri ke liye hain." Nabi ne unse ek bhed khareedi.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The Prophet Abraham (ﷺ) emigrated with Sarah and entered a village where there was a king or a tyrant. (The king) was told that Abraham had entered (the village) accompanied by a woman who was one of the most charming women. So, the king sent for Abraham and asked, 'O Abraham! Who is this lady accompanying you?' Abraham replied, 'She is my sister (i.e. in religion).' Then Abraham returned to her and said, 'Do not contradict my statement, for I have informed them that you are my sister. By Allah, there are no true believers on this land except you and I.' Then Abraham sent her to the king. When the king got to her, she got up and performed ablution, prayed and said, 'O Allah! If I have believed in You and Your Apostle, and have saved my private parts from everybody except my husband, then please do not let this pagan overpower me.' On that the king fell in a mood of agitation and started moving his legs. Seeing the condition of the king, Sarah said, 'O Allah! If he should die, the people will say that I have killed him.' The king regained his power, and proceeded towards her but she got up again and performed ablution, prayed and said, 'O Allah! If I have believed in You and Your Apostle and have kept my private parts safe from all except my husband, then please do not let this pagan overpower me.' The king again fell in a mood of agitation and started moving his legs. On seeing that state of the king, Sarah said, 'O Allah! If he should die, the people will say that I have killed him.' The king got either two or three attacks, and after recovering from the last attack he said, 'By Allah! You have sent a satan to me. Take her to Abraham and give her Ajar.' So she came back to Abraham and said, 'Allah humiliated the pagan and gave us a slave-girl for service
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Nabi Ibrahim ne Sarah ke saath hijrat ki aur ek gaon mein daakhil hue jahan ek raja ya zaalim hukmaran tha. (Raja ko) bataya gaya ke Ibrahim ek aurat ke saath aaye hain jo sabse khoobsurat aurton mein se ek hai. Isliye raja ne Ibrahim ko bulaya aur pucha: 'Aye Ibrahim! Yeh aapke saath aayi hui khaatun kaun hain?' Ibrahim ne jawab diya: 'Yeh meri behn hain (yaani deen mein).' Phir Ibrahim unke paas gaye aur kaha: 'Meri baat na jhutlaanaa, kyunke maine unhe bataya hai ke tum meri behn ho. Allah ki qasam, is zameen par tumhare aur mere siwa koi sacha momin nahi.' Phir Ibrahim ne unhe raja ke paas bheja. Jab raja unke paas gaye, woh uth khadi hui, wudu kiya, namaz padhi aur kaha: 'Aye Allah! Agar maine tujh par aur tere Rasool par iman rakha hai, aur apni sharmgaah sirf apne shohar ke siwa sab se mehfooz rakhi hai, to kripya is mushrik ko mujh par ghalba na de.' Isspar raja begni ho gaya aur apni taangein hilane laga. Raja ka yeh haal dekh kar Sarah ne kaha: 'Aye Allah! Agar woh mar jaaye, log kahenge maine use maara.' Raja fir se theek ho gaya, aur unki taraf badha, magar woh phir uth khadi hui, wudu kiya, namaz padhi aur kaha: 'Aye Allah! Agar maine tujh par aur tere Rasool par iman rakha hai, aur apni sharmgaah sab se mehfooz rakhi hai siwaye apne shohar ke, to kripya is mushrik ko mujh par ghalba na de.' Raja phir begni ho gaya aur apni taangein hilane laga. Yeh dekh kar Sarah ne kaha: 'Aye Allah! Agar woh mar jaaye, log kahenge maine use maara.' Raja ko do ya teen baar aisa hua, aur aakhri baar theek hokar usne kaha: 'Allah ki qasam! Tumne mere paas ek shaitan bheja hai. Ise Ibrahim ke paas le jaao aur usse Ajar (laundi) do.' Isliye woh Ibrahim ke paas wapas aayi aur kaha: 'Allah ne mushrik ko zaleel kiya aur humein khidmatgar ke liye ek laundi di.'"

e: Narrated `Aisha:Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas and 'Abu bin Zam`a quarreled over a boy. Sa`d said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! This boy is the son of my brother (`Utba bin Abi Waqqas) who took a promise from me that I would take him as he was his (illegal) son. Look at him and see whom he resembles." 'Abu bin Zam`a said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! This is my brother and was born on my father's bed from his slave-girl." Allah's Apostle cast a look at the boy and found definite resemblance to `Utba and then said, "The boy is for you, O 'Abu bin Zam`a. The child goes to the owner of the bed and the adulterer gets nothing but the stones (despair, i.e. to be stoned to death). Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Sauda bint Zama! Screen yourself from this boy." So, Sauda never saw him again
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Abu bin Zam'a ek ladke ke baare mein jhagde. Sa'd ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Yeh ladka mere bhai (Utba bin Abi Waqqas) ka beta hai, jinhone mujhse waada liya tha ke main use lunga kyunke woh unka (haraam) beta tha. Ise dekhiye aur dekhiye woh kiske jaisa dikhta hai." Abu bin Zam'a ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Yeh mera bhai hai aur mere waalid ki laundi ka beta hai jo unke bistar par paida hua." Allah ke Rasool ne ladke ki taraf dekha aur usme Utba se saaf mel dekha, phir kaha: "Yeh ladka tumhara hai, Aye Abu bin Zam'a. Bachcha bistar wale ka hota hai (yaani jiske bistar par paida hua), aur zina karne wale ke liye sirf patthar (na-ummidi)." Phir Nabi ne kaha: "Aye Sauda (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Zama! Is ladke se parda karo." Isliye Sauda ne use phir kabhi nahi dekha.

e: Narrated Sa`d that his father said:`Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf said to Suhaib, 'Fear Allah and do not ascribe yourself to somebody other than your father.' Suhaib replied, 'I would not like to say it even if I were given large amounts of money, but I say I was kidnapped in my childhood
hi: Sa'd bataate hain, apne waalid ke hawale se: Abdur-Rahman bin Auf ne Suhaib (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kaha: "Allah se daro aur apni pehchaan apne waalid ke ilawa kisi aur se mat jodo." Suhaib ne jawab diya: "Main yeh kabhi nahi keh sakta chahe mujhe bahut sara paisa diya jaaye, magar main kehta hoon ke mujhe bachpan mein aghwa kiya gaya tha."

e: Narrated `Urwa bin Az-Zubair:Hakim bin Hizam said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I used to do good deeds in the Pre-Islamic period of Ignorance, e.g., keeping good relations with my Kith and kin, manumitting slaves and giving alms. Shall I receive a reward for all that?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, "You embraced Islam with all the good deeds which you did in the past
hi: Urwa bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hakim bin Hizam (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Main jahiliyat ke zamane mein neik amal karta tha, jaise rishtedaron se achha suluk rakhna, gulaam azaad karna, aur sadqa dena. Kya mujhe iska ajr milega?" Allah ke Rasool ne jawab diya: "Tum Islam laaye us sab neki ke amal ke saath jo tumne pehle kiya."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abbas:Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) passed by a dead sheep and said to the people, "Wouldn't you benefit by its skin?" The people replied that it was dead. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "But its eating only is illegal
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Ek baar Allah ke Rasool ek murda bhed ke paas se guzre aur logon se kaha: "Kya tum iski khaal se faida nahi uthaoge?" Logon ne jawab diya ke yeh murda hai. Nabi ne kaha: "Sirf ise khana haram hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "By Him in Whose Hands my soul is, son of Mary (Jesus) will shortly descend amongst you people (Muslims) as a just ruler and will break the Cross and kill the pig and abolish the Jizya (a tax taken from the non-Muslims, who are in the protection, of the Muslim government). Then there will be abundance of money and nobody will accept charitable gifts
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Us zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, Maryam ke bete (Isa) jald hi tum logon (Musalmanon) ke beech ek insaaf pasand hukmaran ke tor par utrenge aur Cross todenge, khinzeer ko qatl karenge, aur Jizya (ghair-Musalmanon se liya jaane wala tax) khatam kar denge. Phir bahut zyada dhan hoga aur koi bhi sadqa qubool nahi karega."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Once `Umar was informed that a certain man sold alcohol. `Umar said, "May Allah curse him! Doesn't he know that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'May Allah curse the Jews, for Allah had forbidden them to eat the fat of animals but they melted it and sold it
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko bataya gaya ke ek shaks sharaab bech raha hai. Umar ne kaha: "Allah use laant kare! Kya usse pata nahi ke Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: 'Allah Yahudiyon par laant kare, kyunke Allah ne unpar janwaron ki charbi haram ki thi magar unhone use pigla kar becha.'"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "May Allah curse the Jews, because Allah made fat illegal for them but they sold it and ate its price
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Allah Yahudiyon par laant kare, kyunke Allah ne unpar charbi haram ki thi magar unhone use becha aur uski qeemat khaee."

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Abu Al-Hasan:While I was with Ibn `Abbas a man came and said, "O father of `Abbas! My sustenance is from my manual profession and I make these pictures." Ibn `Abbas said, "I will tell you only what I heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . I heard him saying, 'Whoever makes a picture will be punished by Allah till he puts life in it, and he will never be able to put life in it.' " Hearing this, that man heaved a sigh and his face turned pale. Ibn `Abbas said to him, "What a pity! If you insist on making pictures I advise you to make pictures of trees and any other unanimated objects
hi: Sa'id bin Abu Al-Hasan bataate hain: Jabke main Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath tha, ek shaks aaya aur kaha: "Aye Abbas ke baap! Meri rozi mere haathon ke kaam se hai aur main yeh tasveerein banataa hoon." Ibn Abbas ne kaha: "Main tumhe sirf woh bataunga jo maine Allah ke Rasool se suna hai. Maine unhe kehte suna: 'Jo koi tasveer banata hai, Allah use tab tak saza dega jab tak woh usme jaan na daale, aur woh kabhi usme jaan nahi daal payega.'" Yeh sunkar shaks ne aah bhari aur uska chehra peela pad gayaa. Ibn Abbas ne unse kaha: "Kitna afsos! Agar tum tasveerein banana hi chahte ho, mera mashwara hai ke darakhton aur doosri be-jaan cheezon ki tasveerein banao."

e: Narrated `Aisha:When the last verses of Surat-al-Baqara were revealed, the Prophet (ﷺ) went out (of his house to the Mosque) and said, "The trade of alcohol has become illegal
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab Surah Al-Baqarah ki aakhri ayaat nazil hui, Nabi (ghar se masjid ki taraf) bahar gaye aur kaha: "Sharaab ki tijarat haram ho gayi hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah says, 'I will be against three persons on the Day of Resurrection: -1. One who makes a covenant in My Name, but he proves treacherous. -2. One who sells a free person (as a slave) and eats the price, -3. And one who employs a laborer and gets the full work done by him but does not pay him his wages
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Allah kehta hai: 'Main teen logon ke khilaf Qiyamat ke din hounga: 1. Woh shaks jo mere naam par ahad kare, phir dhoka de. 2. Woh shaks jo ek azaad insaan ko (gulaam ki tarah) bech de aur uski qeemat khaye. 3. Aur woh shaks jo mazdoor rakhe aur poora kaam use kavaaye magar uski mazdoori na de.'"

e: Narrated Anas:Amongst the captives was Safiya. First she was given to Dihya Al-Kalbi and then to the Prophet
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Qaidiyon mein Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) bhi thi. Pehle unhe Dihya Al-Kalbi ko diya gaya, phir Nabi ko.

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:that while he was sitting with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) he said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We get female captives as our share of booty, and we are interested in their prices, what is your opinion about coitus interruptus?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do you really do that? It is better for you not to do it. No soul that which Allah has destined to exist, but will surely come into existence
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jabke woh Allah ke Rasool ke saath baithe the, unhone kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Humein maal-e-ghanimat mein aurat qaidiyaan milti hain, aur humein unki qeemat ki fikr hai, Al-Azl (safar se bahar rehna, coitus interruptus) ke baare mein aapki kya raay hai?" Nabi ne kaha: "Kya tum sach mein aisa karte ho? Behtar hai tum aisa na karo. Koi bhi rooh jise Allah ne wujood mein aane ka faisla kiya hai, zaroor wujood mein aayegi."

e: Narrated Jabir:The Prophet (ﷺ) sold a Mudabbar (on behalf of his master who was still living and in need of money)
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne ek Mudabbar (gulaam jise maalik ki maut ke baad azaadi ka waada mila ho) becha (uske maalik ki taraf se, jo abhi zinda tha aur paise ki zaroorat mein tha).

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sold a Mudabbar
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne ek Mudabbar becha.

e: Narrated Zaid bin Khalid and Abu Huraira:that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked about an unmarried slave-girl who committed illegal sexual intercourse. They heard him saying, "Flog her, and if she commits illegal sexual intercourse after that, flog her again, and on the third (or the fourth) offense, sell her
hi: Zaid bin Khalid (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool se ek kunwari laundi ke baare mein pucha gaya jisne zina kiya. Unhone unhe kehte suna: "Use kode maaro, aur agar woh iske baad zina kare, phir use kode maaro, aur teesri (ya chauthi) baar, use bech do."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "If a slave-girl of yours commits illegal sexual intercourse and her illegal sexual intercourse is proved, she should be lashed, and after that nobody should blame her, and if she commits illegal sexual intercourse the second time, she should be lashed and nobody should blame her after that, and if she does the offense for the third time and her illegal sexual intercourse is proved, she should be sold even for a hair rope
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi ko farmate suna: "Agar tumhari laundi zina kare aur yeh sabit ho jaaye, use kode maaro, aur uske baad koi use ninda na kare, aur agar woh doosri baar zina kare, use kode maaro aur uske baad koi ninda na kare, aur agar woh teesri baar aisa kare aur yeh sabit ho jaaye, to use bech do, chahe ek baal ki rassi ke badle mein."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) came to Khaibar and when Allah made him victorious and he conquered the town by breaking the enemy's defense, the beauty of Safiya bint Huyai bin Akhtab was mentioned to him and her husband had been killed while she was a bride. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) selected her for himself and he set out in her company till he reached Sadd-ar-Rawha' where her menses were over and he married her. Then Hais (a kind of meal) was prepared and served on a small leather sheet (used for serving meals). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then said to me, "Inform those who are around you (about the wedding banquet)." So that was the marriage banquet given by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for (his marriage with) Safiya. After that we proceeded to Medina and I saw that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was covering her with a cloak while she was behind him. Then he would sit beside his camel and let Safiya put her feet on his knees to ride (the camel)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi Khaibar aaye, aur jab Allah ne unhe fatah di aur unhone dushman ki hifazat tod kar shehar fatah kiya, unhe Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Huyai bin Akhtab ki khoobsurati ke baare mein bataya gaya, jinke shohar ko qatl kiya gaya tha jabke woh nayi dulhan thi. Allah ke Rasool ne unhe apne liye chuna aur unke saath chal pade jab tak woh Sadd-ar-Rawha pahunche jahan unka mahina khatam hua aur unhone unse shaadi ki. Phir Hais (ek khaas khaana) taiyaar hua aur ek chamde ki chadar par pesh kiya gaya (khaana serve karne ke liye). Allah ke Rasool ne phir mujhse kaha: "Apne aas-paas ke logon ko batao (shaadi ki dawat ke baare mein)." To yehi Allah ke Rasool ki (Safiya ke saath shaadi ke liye) shaadi ki dawat thi. Uske baad hum Madina ke liye rawana hue, aur maine dekha Allah ke Rasool unhe chadar se dhak rahe the jabke woh unke peechhe (sawari par) thi. Phir woh apne oont ke bagal mein baithte aur Safiya ko apne ghutnon par apne paon rakhkar sawar hone dete.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), in the year of the Conquest of Mecca, saying, "Allah and His Apostle made illegal the trade of alcohol, dead animals, pigs and idols." The people asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What about the fat of dead animals, for it was used for greasing the boats and the hides; and people use it for lights?" He said, "No, it is illegal." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) further said, "May Allah curse the Jews, for Allah made the fat (of animals) illegal for them, yet they melted the fat and sold it and ate its price
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool ko, Fatah-e-Mecca ke saal, farmate suna: "Allah aur uske Rasool ne sharaab, murda janwar, khinzeer aur buton ki tijarat haram kar di hai." Logon ne pucha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Murda janwaron ki charbi ke baare mein kya, kyunke isse kishtiyon aur khaalon par lagaya jaata hai, aur log isse roshni ke liye istemal karte hain?" Aap ne kaha: "Nahi, yeh haram hai." Allah ke Rasool ne aage kaha: "Allah Yahudiyon par laanat kare, kyunke Allah ne unpar (janwaron ki) charbi haram ki, magar unhone use pigla kar becha aur uski qeemat khaee."

e: Narrated Abu Mas`ud Al-Ansari:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade taking the price of a dog, money earned by prostitution and the earnings of a soothsayer
hi: Abu Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ansari (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kutte ki qeemat lene, veshya-vritti se kamaya paisa, aur jyotish (soothsayer) ki kamaai lene se mana kiya.

e: Narrated `Aun bin Abu Juhaifa:I saw my father buying a slave whose profession was cupping, and ordered that his instruments (of cupping) be broken. I asked him the reason for doing so. He replied, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prohibited taking money for blood, the price of a dog, and the earnings of a slave-girl by prostitution; he cursed her who tattoos and her who gets tattooed, the eater of Riba (usury), and the maker of pictures
hi: Aun bin Abu Juhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine apne waalid ko ek gulaam khareedte dekha jiska peshaa cupping tha, aur unhone uske aalaat todane ka hukum diya. Maine unse iski wajah pucchi. Unhone jawab diya: "Allah ke Rasool ne khoon ki qeemat lene, kutte ki qeemat, aur laundi ki veshya-vritti se kamaai lene se mana kiya; unhone gudna banane walon aur gudnvvane walon par, Riba khane wale par, aur tasveer banane wale par laanat ki."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to Medina and the people used to pay in advance the price of fruits to be delivered within one or two years. (The sub-narrator is in doubt whether it was one to two years or two to three years.) The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever pays money in advance for dates (to be delivered later) should pay it for known specified weight and measure (of the dates)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool Madina aaye aur log phalon ki qeemat pehle se ada karte the jinhe ek ya do saal ke baad delivery honi hoti (raawi ko shak hai ke yeh ek-do saal tha ya do-teen saal). Nabi ne kaha: "Jo koi khajoor (baad mein delivery ke liye) ka paisa pehle deta hai, use jaani-pehchani, muqarrar naap aur wazan ke liye dena chahiye."

e: Narrated Ibn Abi Najih:as above, mentioning only specific measure
hi: Ibn Abi Najih bataate hain: (upar wali riwayat), sirf muqarrar naap ka zikar karte hue.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) came to Medina and the people used to pay in advance the price of dates to be delivered within two or three years. He said (to them), "Whoever pays in advance the price of a thing to be delivered later should pay it for a specified measure at specified weight for a specified period
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi Madina aaye aur log khajoor ki qeemat pehle se ada karte the jinhe do ya teen saal ke baad delivery honi hoti. Aap ne (unse) kaha: "Jo koi kisi cheez ki qeemat pehle deta hai jise baad mein delivery hona hai, use muqarrar naap, muqarrar wazan, aur muqarrar muddat ke liye dena chahiye."

e: Narrated Ibn Abi Najih:as above, saying, "He should pay the price in advance for a specified measure and for a specified period
hi: Ibn Abi Najih bataate hain: (upar wali riwayat), aur kaha, "Use muqarrar naap ke liye aur muqarrar muddat ke liye pehle qeemat deni chahiye."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) came (to Medina) and he told the people (regarding the payment of money in advance that they should pay it) for a known specified measure and a known specified weight and a known specified period
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi (Madina) aaye aur logon ko bataya (paisa pehle dene ke baare mein ke unhe) jaani-pehchaani muqarrar naap, jaani-pehchaani muqarrar wazan, aur jaani-pehchaani muqarrar muddat ke liye dena chahiye.

e: Narrated Shu`ba:Muhammad or `Abdullah bin Abu Al-Mujalid said, "Abdullah bin Shaddad and Abu Burda differed regarding As-Salam, so they sent me to Ibn Abi `Aufa and I asked him about it. He replied, 'In the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), Abu Bakr and `Umar, we used to pay in advance the prices of wheat, barley, dried grapes and dates to be delivered later. I also asked Ibn Abza and he, too, replied as above
hi: Shu'ba bataate hain: Muhammad ya Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abu Al-Mujalid ne kaha: "Abdullah bin Shaddad aur Abu Burda ka As-Salam ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hua, isliye unhone mujhe Ibn Abi Aufa ke paas bheja aur maine unse iske baare mein pucha. Unhone jawab diya: 'Allah ke Rasool, Abu Bakr aur Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke zamane mein, hum gehun, jau, sookhi angoor, aur khajoor ki qeemat pehle dete the jinhe baad mein delivery hona hota. Maine yehi Ibn Abza se bhi pucha aur unhone bhi wahi jawab diya.'"

e: Narrated Muhammad bin Al-Mujalid:`Abdullah bin Shaddad and Abu Burda sent me to `Abdullah bin Abi `Aufa and told me to ask `Abdullah whether the people in the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) used to pay in advance for wheat (to be delivered later). `Abdullah replied, "We used to pay in advance to the peasants of Sham for wheat, barley and olive oil of a known specified measure to be delivered in a specified period." I asked (him), "Was the price paid (in advance) to those who had the things to be delivered later?" `Abdullah bin `Aufa replied, "We did not use to ask them about that." Then they sent me to `Abdur Rahman bin Abza and I asked him. He replied, "The companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) used to practice Salam in the lifetime of the Prophet; and we did not use to ask them whether they had standing crops or not
hi: Muhammad bin Al-Mujalid bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Shaddad aur Abu Burda ne mujhe Abdullah bin Abi Aufa ke paas bheja aur mujhse kaha Abdullah se pucchun kya Nabi ke zamane mein log gehun ki qeemat pehle dete the (baad mein delivery ke liye). Abdullah ne jawab diya: "Hum Sham ke kisaanon ko jau, gehun, aur zaitoon ke tel ki qeemat pehle dete the, jaani-pehchaani muqarrar naap ke liye, muqarrar muddat mein delivery ke liye." Maine (unse) pucha: "Kya paisa un logon ko diya jaata jinke paas woh cheezein (delivery ke liye) hoti thi?" Abdullah bin Aufa ne jawab diya: "Hum unse yeh sawaal nahi karte the." Phir unhone mujhe Abdur-Rahman bin Abza ke paas bheja aur maine unse pucha. Unhone jawab diya: "Nabi ke sahaba Nabi ke zamane mein Salam ka amal karte the; aur hum unse yeh nahi puchte the ke unke paas khadi fasal hai ya nahi."

e: Narrated Muhammad bin Abi Al-Mujalid:as above (446) and said, "We used to pay them in advance for wheat and barley (to be delivered later). Narrated Ash-Shaibani--"And also for oil." Narrated Ash-Shaibani: who said "We used to pay in advance for wheat barley and dried grapes
hi: Muhammad bin Abi Al-Mujalid bataate hain: (yehi upar wali riwayat) aur kaha, "Hum unhe gehun aur jau ki qeemat pehle dete the (baad mein delivery ke liye)." Ash-Shaibani ke hawale se: "Aur tel ke liye bhi." Ash-Shaibani ke hawale se: "Hum gehun, jau aur sookhi angoor ki qeemat pehle dete the."

e: Narrated Abu Bakhtari at-Tai:I asked Ibn `Abbas about Salam for (the fruits of) date-palms. He replied "The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the sale of dates on the trees till they became fit for eating and could be weighed." A man asked what to be weighed (as the dates were still on the trees). Another man sitting beside Ibn `Abbas replied, "Till they are cut and stored." Narrated Abu Al-Bakhtari: I heard Ibn `Abbas (saying) that the Prophet (ﷺ) forbade ... etc. as above
hi: Abu Bakhtari At-Tai bataate hain: Maine Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se khajoor ke phalon ke Salam ke baare mein pucha. Unhone jawab diya: "Nabi ne khajoor darakhton par bechne se mana kiya tab tak jab tak woh khane ke laayak na ho jaayen aur unka wazan na kiya ja sake." Ek shaks ne pucha wazan kaise ho sakta hai (jabke khajoor darakhton par hi hai). Ibn Abbas ke bagal mein baithe ek doosre shaks ne jawab diya: "Jab tak woh kaati aur jama na ho jaaye." Abu Al-Bakhtari bataate hain: Maine Ibn Abbas ko kehte suna ke Nabi ne mana kiya... waghera jaisa upar hai.

e: Narrated Abu Al-Bakhtari:I asked Ibn `Umar about Salam (the fruits of) date-palms. He replied, "The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the sale of dates till their benefit becomes evident and fit for eating and also the sale of silver (for gold) on credit." I asked Ibn `Abbas about Salam for dates and he replied, "The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the sale of dates till they were fit for eating and could be estimated
hi: Abu Al-Bakhtari bataate hain: Maine Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se khajoor ke Salam ke baare mein pucha. Unhone jawab diya: "Nabi ne khajoor bechne se mana kiya jab tak unki khoobi zaahir na ho aur khane ke laayak na ho, aur chandi ko sone ke badle udhaar par bechne se bhi mana kiya." Maine Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se bhi khajoor ke Salam ke baare mein pucha aur unhone jawab diya: "Nabi ne khajoor bechne se mana kiya jab tak woh khane ke laayak aur andaza lagaee jaane laayak na ho jaaye."

e: Narrated Abu Al-Bakhtari:I asked Ibn `Umar about Salam for dates. Ibn `Umar replied, "The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the sale (of the fruits) of date-palms until they were fit for eating and also forbade the sale of silver for gold on credit." I also asked Ibn `Abbas about it. Ibn `Abbas replied, "The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the sale of dates till they were fit for eating, and could be weighed." I asked him, "What is to be weighed (as the dates are on the trees)?" A man sitting by Ibn `Abbas said, "It means till they are cut and stored
hi: Abu Al-Bakhtari bataate hain: Maine Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se khajoor ke Salam ke baare mein pucha. Ibn Umar ne jawab diya: "Nabi ne khajoor (phalon) ko bechne se mana kiya jab tak woh khane ke laayak na ho jaaye, aur chandi ko sone ke badle udhaar par bechne se bhi mana kiya." Maine Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se bhi iske baare mein pucha. Ibn Abbas ne jawab diya: "Nabi ne khajoor bechne se mana kiya jab tak woh khane ke laayak na ho aur unka wazan na kiya ja sake." Maine unse pucha: "Wazan kaise ho sakta hai (jabke woh darakhton par hai)?" Ibn Abbas ke bagal mein baithe ek shaks ne kaha: "Iska matlab hai jab tak woh kaati aur jama na ho jaaye."

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) bought some foodstuff (barley) from a Jew on credit and mortgaged his iron armor to him (the armor stands for a guarantor)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool ne ek Yahudi se udhaar par kuch khaane ki cheezein (jau) khareedi aur apna lohe ka zire uske paas girvi rakha (zire zamanat ke tor par hai).

e: Narrated Al-A`mash:We argued at Ibrahim's dwelling place about mortgaging in Salam. He said, "Aisha said, 'The Prophet (ﷺ) bought some foodstuff from a Jew on credit and the payment was to be made by a definite period, and he mortgaged his iron armor to him
hi: Al-A'mash bataate hain: Humne Ibrahim ki rehne ki jagah par Salam mein girvi rakhne par bahas ki. Unhone kaha: "Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha: 'Nabi ne ek Yahudi se kuch khaane ki cheezein udhaar par khareedi jinka paisa muqarrar muddat mein dena tha, aur unhone apna lohe ka zire uske paas girvi rakha.'"

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) came to Medina and the people used to pay in advance the prices of fruits to be delivered within two to three years. The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to them), "Buy fruits by paying their prices in advance on condition that the fruits are to be delivered to you according to a fixed specified measure within a fixed specified period." Ibn Najih said, " ... by specified measure and specified weight
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi Madina aaye aur log phalon ki qeemat pehle dete the jinhe do-teen saal mein delivery hona hota. Nabi ne (unse) kaha: "Phal khareedne ke liye pehle unki qeemat is shart par do ke phal tumhe muqarrar naap ke mutabiq muqarrar muddat mein delivery honge." Ibn Najih ne kaha: "... muqarrar naap aur muqarrar wazan ke saath."

e: Narrated Muhammad bin Abi Al-Mujalid:Abu Burda and `Abdullah bin Shaddad sent me to `Abdur Rahman bin Abza and `Abdullah bin Abi `Aufa to ask them about the Salaf (Salam). They said, "We used to get war booty while we were with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and when the peasants of Sham came to us we used to pay them in advance for wheat, barley, and oil to be delivered within a fixed period." I asked them, "Did the peasants own standing crops or not?" They replied, "We never asked them about it
hi: Muhammad bin Abi Al-Mujalid bataate hain: Abu Burda aur Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Shaddad ne mujhe Abdur-Rahman bin Abza aur Abdullah bin Abi Aufa ke paas Salaf (Salam) ke baare mein poochne bheja. Unhone kaha: "Hum Allah ke Rasool ke saath maal-e-ghanimat paate the aur jab Sham ke kisaan humare paas aate, hum unhe gehun, jau, aur tel ki qeemat pehle dete the jo muqarrar muddat mein delivery honi hoti." Maine unse pucha: "Kya kisaanon ke paas khadi fasal hoti thi ya nahi?" Unhone jawab diya: "Humne unse kabhi yeh nahi poocha."

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The people used to sell camels on the basis of Habal-al-Habala. The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade such sale. Nafi` explained Habal-al-Habala by saying. "The camel is to be delivered to the buyer after the she-camel gives birth
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Log Habal-al-Habala ki bunyaad par oont bechte the. Nabi ne aisi bikri se mana kiya. Nafi ne Habal-al-Habala ka matlab bataya: "Yeh matlab hai ke oont, oontni ke bachche janne ke baad khareedar ko diya jaayega."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave a verdict regarding Shuf'a in every undivided joint thing (property). But if the limits are defined (or demarcated) or the ways and streets are fixed, then there is no pre-emption
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne har bina baanti hui mushtarka (joint) maal mein Shuf'a ka faisla diya. Magar agar seemaen tay ho chuki hon ya raaste-galiyaan muqarrar ho chuki hon, to Shuf'a nahi hota.

e: Narrated `Amr bin Ash-Sharid:While I was standing with Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas, Al-Miswar bin Makhrama came and put his hand on my shoulder. Meanwhile Abu Rafi`, the freed slave of the Prophet (ﷺ) came and asked Sa`d to buy from him the (two) dwellings which were in his house. Sa`d said, "By Allah I will not buy them." Al- Miswar said, "By Allah, you shall buy them." Sa`d replied, "By Allah, I will not pay more than four thousand (Dirhams) by installments." Abu Rafi` said, "I have been offered five hundred Dinars (for it) and had I not heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, 'The neighbor has more right than anyone else because of his nearness, I would not give them to you for four-thousand (Dirhams) while I am offered five-hundred Dinars (one Dinar equals ten Dirhams) for them." So, he sold it to Sa`d
hi: Amr bin Ash-Sharid bataate hain: Jabke main Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath khada tha, Al-Miswar bin Makhrama (رضی اللہ عنہ) aaye aur unhone apna haath mere kandhe par rakha. Isi dauran Abu Rafi (رضی اللہ عنہ), Nabi ke azaad kiye gulaam, aaye aur Sa'd se guzarish ki ke woh unse (Abu Rafi se) do makaan khareed len jo unke (Sa'd ke) ghar mein the. Sa'd ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam main unhe nahi khareedunga." Al-Miswar ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, tumhein zaroor khareedne chahiye." Sa'd ne jawab diya: "Allah ki qasam, main kisaaon mein chaar hazaar (Dirham) se zyada nahi dunga." Abu Rafi ne kaha: "Mujhe (inke liye) paanch sau Dinar ki pesh kash mil chuki hai, aur agar maine Nabi ko yeh farmate na suna hota: 'Padosi ko doosron se zyada haqq hai apni nazdeekiyat ki wajah se,' to main unhe tumhe chaar hazaar (Dirham) mein na deta jabke mujhe unke liye paanch sau Dinar (ek Dinar dus Dirham ke barabar) ki pesh kash mil chuki hai." To unhone woh Sa'd ko bech diya.

e: Narrated Aisha:I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have two neighbors and would like to know to which of them I should give presents." He replied, "To the one whose door is nearer to you
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Mere do padosi hain aur main jaanna chahti hoon unme se kise tohfe dun." Aap ne jawab diya: "Jiska darwaza tumse zyada nazdeek ho."

e: Narrated Abu Musa Al-Ash`ari:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The honest treasurer who gives willingly what he is ordered to give, is one of the two charitable persons, (the second being the owner)
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ash'ari (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Imandaar bhandaari jo dil se woh cheez de jiska hukum diya jaaye, do sadqa dene walon mein se ek hai (doosra maalik hai)."

e: Narrated Abu Musa:I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) with two men from Ash`ari tribe. I said (to the Prophet), "I do not know that they want employment." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No, we do not appoint for our jobs anybody who demands it earnestly
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Nabi ke paas Ash'ari qabile ke do logon ke saath gaya. Maine (Nabi se) kaha: "Mujhe nahi pata ke woh naukri chahte hain." Nabi ne farmaya: "Nahi, hum apne kaamon par kisi ko muqarrar nahi karte jo isse sakhti se maange."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah did not send any prophet but shepherded sheep." His companions asked him, "Did you do the same?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Yes, I used to shepherd the sheep of the people of Mecca for some Qirats
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Allah ne har Nabi ko bheja, aur har Nabi ne bhedein charaee hain." Sahaba ne pucha: "Kya aap ne bhi aisa kiya?" Nabi ne jawab diya: "Haan, main Mecca walon ki bhedein kuch Qirat (ke badle) charata tha."

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr employed a (pagan) man from the tribe of Bani Ad-Dail and the tribe of Bani 'Abu bin `Adi as a guide. He was an expert guide and he broke the oath contract which he had to abide by with the tribe of Al-`Asi bin Wail and he was on the religion of Quraish pagans. The Prophet (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr had confidence in him and gave him their riding camels and told him to bring them to the Cave of Thaur after three days. So, he brought them their two riding camels after three days and both of them (The Prophet (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr) set out accompanied by 'Amir bin Fuhaira and the Dili guide who guided them below Mecca along the road leading to the sea-shore
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi aur Abu Bakr ne Bani Ad-Dail aur Bani Abu bin Adi qabile ke ek (mushrik) shaks ko raah-numa (guide) ke tor par naukar rakha. Woh mahir raah-numa tha aur usne Al-Asi bin Wail qabile ke saath apna qasm-nama tod diya tha, aur woh Quraish ke mushrikon ke deen par tha. Nabi aur Abu Bakr ne usme bharosa kiya aur unhe apne sawari ke oont diye aur usse teen din baad Ghar-e-Thaur (Thaur ki gufa) tak lane ko kaha. To woh teen din baad unhe unke do sawari oont laaya, aur donon (Nabi aur Abu Bakr) Amir bin Fuhaira aur usi Dili raah-numa ke saath chal pade jo unhe Mecca ke neeche se samundar ki taraf jaane wale raaste se le gaya.

e: Narrated Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr hired a man from the tribe of Bani-Ad-Dil as an expert guide who was a pagan (follower of the religion of the pagans of Quraish). The Prophet (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr gave him their two riding camels and took a promise from him to bring their riding camels in the morning of the third day to the Cave of Thaur
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki biwi) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool aur Abu Bakr ne Bani-Ad-Dil qabile ke ek shaks ko mahir raah-numa ke tor par naukar rakha jo ek mushrik tha (Quraish ke mushrikon ke deen ka pairokaar). Nabi aur Abu Bakr ne unhe apne do sawari oont diye aur unse waada liya ke woh teesre din ki subah unke sawari oont Ghar-e-Thaur laaega.

e: Narrated Ya`la bin Umaiya:I fought in Jaish-al-Usra (Ghazwa of Tabuk) along with the Prophet (ﷺ) and in my opinion that was the best of my deeds. Then I had an employee, who quarrel led with someone and one of the them bit and cut the other's finger and caused his own tooth to fall out. He then went to the Prophet (with a complaint) but the Prophet (ﷺ) canceled the suit and said to the complainant, "Did you expect him to let his finger in your mouth so that you might snap and cut it (as does a stallion camel)?" Narrated Ibn Juraij from `Abdullah bin Abu Mulaika from his grandfather a similar story: A man bit the hand of another man and caused his own tooth to fall out, but Abu Bakr judged that he had no right for compensation (for the broken tooth)
hi: Ya'la bin Umaiya bataate hain: Maine Jaish-al-Usra (Ghazwa-e-Tabuk) mein Nabi ke saath jung ki aur mere khayaal mein woh mera behtareen amal tha. Phir mera ek mulaazim tha jiska kisi se jhagda hua aur unme se ek ne doosre ki ungli kaaati aur usme se apna daant tod liya. Woh Nabi ke paas gaya (shikayat karne), magar Nabi ne muqadma khaarij kar diya aur shikayat karne wale se kaha: "Kya tumne yeh ummeed ki thi ke woh apni ungli tumhare mun mein chod dega taake tum use kaat lo (jaise oont karta hai)?" Ibn Juraij, Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abu Mulaika ke hawale se, apne dada ke hawale se, isi jaisi kahani: Ek shaks ne doosre shaks ka haath kaata aur usme apna daant tod liya, magar Abu Bakr ne faisla diya ke usse (tote daant ka) koi mua'wza nahi milega.

e: Narrated Ubai bin Ka`b:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Both of them (Moses and Al-Khadir) proceeded on till they reached a wall which was about to fall."
