Sa`d said [?? or Sa`id], "(Al-Khadir pointed) with his hands (towards the wall) and then raised his hands and the wall became straightened up." Ya`la said, "I think Sa`id [?? or Sa`d] said, 'He (Khadir) passed his hand over it and it was straightened up." (Moses said to him), "if you had wanted, you could have taken wages for it." Sa`id [?? or Sa`d] said, "Wages with which to buy food
hi: Ubai bin Ka'b (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Woh dono (Musa aur Al-Khadir) aage chalte gaye jab tak woh ek deewar tak pahunche jo girne hi wali thi." Sa'd (ya Sa'id, raawi ka naam shaki) ne kaha: "(Al-Khadir ne) apne haathon se (deewar ki taraf) ishara kiya aur phir apne haath uthaye aur deewar sidhi ho gayi." Ya'la ne kaha: "Mujhe lagta hai Sa'id (ya Sa'd) ne kaha: 'Unhone (Khadir ne) apna haath usse phera aur woh sidhi ho gayi.'" (Musa ne unse kaha), "Agar tum chahte, iske liye mazdoori le sakte the." Sa'id (ya Sa'd) ne kaha: "Mazdoori jisse khana khareeda ja sake."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Your example and the example of the people of the two Scriptures (i.e. Jews and Christians) is like the example of a man who employed some laborers and asked them, 'Who will work for me from morning till midday for one Qirat?' The Jews accepted and carried out the work. He then asked, Who will work for me from midday up to the `Asr prayer for one Qirat?' The Christians accepted and fulfilled the work. He then said, 'Who will work for me from the `Asr till sunset for two Qirats?' You, Muslims have accepted the offer. The Jews and the Christians got angry and said, 'Why should we work more and get lesser wages?' (Allah) said, 'Have I withheld part of your right?' They replied in the negative. He said, 'It is My Blessing, I bestow upon whomever I wish
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Tumhari (Musalmanon ki) misaal aur do Kitaabon walon (yaani Yahudi aur Isaaaion) ki misaal us shaks jaisi hai jisne kuch mazdoor rakhe aur unse pucha: 'Kaun mere liye subah se dopahar tak ek Qirat ke badle kaam karega?' Yahudi raazi hue aur unhone kaam poora kiya. Phir usne pucha: 'Kaun mere liye dopahar se Asr ki namaz tak ek Qirat ke liye kaam karega?' Isaaee raazi hue aur unhone kaam poora kiya. Phir usne kaha: 'Kaun mere liye Asr se suraj dhoobne tak do Qirat ke liye kaam karega?' Tum, Musalmanon, ne yeh pesh kash qubool ki. Yahudi aur Isaaee naraaj ho gaye aur kaha: 'Hum kyun zyada kaam karein aur kam paisa lein?' (Allah ne) kaha: 'Kya maine tumhare haqq mein se kuch rok li?' Unhone na mein jawab diya. Usne kaha: 'Yeh meri barkat hai, main jise chahta hoon deta hoon.'"

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar bin Al-Khattab:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Your example and the example of Jews and Christians is like the example of a man who employed some laborers to whom he said, 'Who will work for me up to midday for one Qirat each?' The Jews carried out the work for one Qirat each; and then the Christians carried out the work up to the `Asr prayer for one Qirat each; and now you Muslims are working from the `Asr prayer up to sunset for two Qirats each. The Jews and Christians got angry and said, 'We work more and are paid less.' The employer (Allah) asked them, 'Have I usurped some of your right?' They replied in the negative. He said, 'That is My Blessing, I bestow upon whomever I wish
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Tumhari (Musalmanon ki) misaal aur Yahudi-Isaaiiyon ki misaal us shaks jaisi hai jisne kuch mazdoor rakhe jinse usne kaha: 'Kaun mere liye dopahar tak ek Qirat ke liye kaam karega?' Yahudiyon ne ek-ek Qirat ke liye kaam poora kiya; aur phir Isaaiyon ne Asr ki namaz tak ek-ek Qirat ke liye kaam poora kiya; aur ab tum Musalman Asr ki namaz se suraj doobne tak do-do Qirat ke liye kaam kar rahe ho. Yahudi-Isaaee naraaj ho gaye aur kaha: 'Hum zyada kaam karte hain aur kam paate hain.' Malik (Allah) ne unse pucha: 'Kya maine tumhare haqq mein se kuch chheena hai?' Unhone na mein jawab diya. Usne kaha: 'Yeh meri barkat hai, main jise chahta hoon deta hoon.'"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah said, 'I will be an opponent to three types of people on the Day of Resurrection: -1. One who makes a covenant in My Name, but proves treacherous; -2. One who sells a free person and eats his price; and -3. One who employs a laborer and takes full work from him but does not pay him for his lab our
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Allah kehta hai: 'Main teen qisam ke logon ke khilaf Qiyamat ke din hounga: 1. Woh shaks jo mere naam par ahad kare, phir dhoka de. 2. Woh shaks jo ek azaad insaan ko bech de aur uski qeemat khaye. 3. Aur woh shaks jo mazdoor rakhe aur poora kaam use kavaye magar uski mazdoori na de.'"

e: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The example of Muslims, Jews and Christians is like the example of a man who employed laborers to work for him from morning till night for specific wages. They worked till midday and then said, 'We do not need your money which you have fixed for us and let whatever we have done be annulled.' The man said to them, 'Don't quit the work, but complete the rest of it and take your full wages.' But they refused and went away. The man employed another batch after them and said to them, 'Complete the rest of the day and yours will be the wages I had fixed for the first batch.' So, they worked till the time of `Asr prayer. Then they said, "Let what we have done be annulled and keep the wages you have promised us for yourself.' The man said to them, 'Complete the rest of the work, as only a little of the day remains,' but they refused. Thereafter he employed another batch to work for the rest of the day and they worked for the rest of the day till the sunset, and they received the wages of the two former batches. So, that was the example of those people (Muslims) and the example of this light (guidance) which they have accepted willingly
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Musalmanon, Yahudiyon aur Isaaiyon ki misaal us shaks jaisi hai jisne mazdoor rakhe subah se raat tak khaas mazdoori par kaam karne ke liye. Woh dopahar tak kaam karte rahe, phir kaha: 'Humein tumhari muqarrar ki hui mazdoori ki zaroorat nahi, aur jo hamne kiya use radd samjho.' Us shaks ne unse kaha: 'Kaam mat chhodo, balki baaki kaam mukammal karo aur apni poori mazdoori le lo.' Magar unhone inkaar kiya aur chale gaye. Us shaks ne unke baad doosre mazdoor rakhe aur unse kaha: 'Din ka baaki hissa mukammal karo aur tumhe woh mazdoori milegi jo maine pehli toli ke liye muqarrar ki thi.' Isliye woh Asr ki namaz tak kaam karte rahe. Phir unhone kaha: 'Jo humne kiya use radd samjho aur tumne humse jo waada kiya woh apne paas rakho.' Us shaks ne unse kaha: 'Baaki kaam mukammal karo, din ka bahut kam hissa bacha hai,' magar unhone inkaar kiya. Iske baad usne din ke baaki hisse ke liye aur mazdoor rakhe aur unhone din ke baaki hisse suraj doobne tak kaam kiya, aur unhe pehli do toliyon ki mazdoori mil gayi. To yehi (Musalmanon) logon ki aur is roshni (hidayat) ki misaal hai jise unhone dil se qubool kiya."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "Three men from among those who were before you, set out together till they reached a cave at night and entered it. A big rock rolled down the mountain and closed the mouth of the cave. They said (to each other), Nothing could save you from this rock but to invoke Allah by giving reference to the righteous deed which you have done (for Allah's sake only).' So, one of them said, 'O Allah! I had old parents and I never provided my family (wife, children etc.) with milk before them. One day, by chance I was delayed, and I came late (at night) while they had slept. I milked the sheep for them and took the milk to them, but I found them sleeping. I disliked to provide my family with the milk before them. I waited for them and the bowl of milk was in my hand and I kept on waiting for them to get up till the day dawned. Then they got up and drank the milk. O Allah! If I did that for Your Sake only, please relieve us from our critical situation caused by this rock.' So, the rock shifted a little but they could not get out." The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "The second man said, 'O Allah! I had a cousin who was the dearest of all people to me and I wanted to have sexual relations with her but she refused. Later she had a hard time in a famine year and she came to me and I gave her one-hundred-and-twenty Dinars on the condition that she would not resist my desire, and she agreed. When I was about to fulfill my desire, she said: It is illegal for you to outrage my chastity except by legitimate marriage. So, I thought it a sin to have sexual intercourse with her and left her though she was the dearest of all the people to me, and also I left the gold I had given her. O Allah! If I did that for Your Sake only, please relieve us from the present calamity.' So, the rock shifted a little more but still they could not get out from there." The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "Then the third man said, 'O Allah! I employed few laborers and I paid them their wages with the exception of one man who did not take his wages and went away. I invested his wages and I got much property thereby. (Then after some time) he came and said to me: O Allah's slave! Pay me my wages. I said to him: All the camels, cows, sheep and slaves you see, are yours. He said: O Allah's slave! Don't mock at me. I said: I am not mocking at you. So, he took all the herd and drove them away and left nothing. O Allah! If I did that for Your Sake only, please relieve us from the present suffering.' So, that rock shifted completely and they got out walking
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool ko farmate suna: "Tumse pehle teen log ek saath safar par nikle jab tak woh raat ko ek gufa tak pahunche aur usme daakhil hue. Ek bada patthar pahad se ludka aur gufa ka mun band kar diya. Unhone (ek-doosre se) kaha: 'Kuch bhi tumhe is patthar se nahi bacha sakta siwaye is ke ke tum Allah se apna woh neik amal batakar dua karo jo tumne (sirf Allah ke liye) kiya hai.' Isliye unme se ek ne kaha: 'Aye Allah! Mere maa-baap budhe the aur main apne pariwara ko (biwi, bachche waghera) doodh unse pehle kabhi nahi pilata tha. Ek din, itfaqan mujhe der ho gayi, aur main der se (raat ko) aaya jabke woh so chuke the. Maine unke liye (bhedon ka) doodh nikala aur unhe pesh kiya, magar unhe sota paaya. Mujhe apne pariwara ko unse pehle doodh dena napasand hua. Main unka intezar karta raha, doodh ka bartan mere haath mein tha, aur main unke uthne ka intezar karta raha jab tak subah nahi ho gayi. Phir woh uthe aur doodh piya. Aye Allah! Agar maine yeh sirf tere liye kiya, humein is museebat se, jo is patthar ki wajah se hai, azaad kar de.' To patthar thoda hila magar woh bahar nahi nikal sake." Nabi ne joda: "Doosre shaks ne kaha: 'Aye Allah! Meri ek chachazaad bahan thi jo mujhe sabse pyari thi, aur main uske saath humbistari karna chahta tha magar usne inkaar kiya. Baad mein akaal ke saal usse takleef hui aur woh mere paas aayi, aur maine use ek sau bees Dinar diye is shart par ke woh meri khwahish ko na thukraaye, aur woh raazi ho gayi. Jab main apni khwahish poori karne wala tha, usne kaha: Tumhare liye meri izzat (chastity) loothna haram hai siwaye jaiz shaadi ke. Isliye maine usse humbistari karna gunah samjha aur use chhod diya, chahe woh mujhe sabse pyari thi, aur maine woh sona bhi chod diya jo maine use diya tha. Aye Allah! Agar maine yeh sirf tere liye kiya, humein is museebat se azaad kar de.' To patthar aur thoda hila magar woh phir bhi bahar nahi nikal sake." Nabi ne joda: "Phir teesre shaks ne kaha: 'Aye Allah! Maine kuch mazdoor rakhe aur unki mazdoori de di siwaye ek shaks ke jisne apni mazdoori nahi li aur chala gaya. Maine uski mazdoori mein tijarat ki aur mujhe bahut maal mili. (Kuch waqt baad) woh aaya aur mujhse kaha: Aye Allah ke bande! Mujhe meri mazdoori do. Maine usse kaha: Yeh sab oont, gaayen, bhedein aur gulaam jo tum dekh rahe ho, sab tumhare hain. Usne kaha: Aye Allah ke bande! Mera mazaaak mat udao. Maine kaha: Main tumhara mazaaak nahi uda raha. Isliye usne sab kuch le liya aur hankaakar le gaya, kuch bhi na chhodaa. Aye Allah! Agar maine yeh sirf tere liye kiya, humein is takleef se azaad kar de.' To woh patthar poori tarah hat gaya aur woh chalte hue bahar nikal aaye."

e: Narrated Abu Mas'ud Al-Ansari:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered us to give in charity we would go to the market and work as porters to earn a Mudd (two handfuls) (of foodstuff) but now some of us have one-hundred thousand Dirhams or Dinars. (The sub-narrator) Shaqiq said, "I think Abu Mas`ud meant himself by saying (some of us)
hi: Abu Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ansari (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab bhi Allah ke Rasool humein sadqa dene ka hukum dete, hum bazaar jate aur boojh uthane ka kaam karte taake ek Mudd (do mutthi bhar khaane ki cheez) kamaa sakein, magar aaj hum mein se kuch ke paas ek lakh Dirham ya Dinar hain. (Shaqiq, raawi ne kaha:) Mujhe lagta hai Abu Mas'ud ka matlab khud unse tha jab unhone "hum mein se kuch" kaha.

e: Narrated Tawus:Ibn `Abbas said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the meeting of caravans (on the way) and ordained that no townsman is permitted to sell things on behalf of a bedouin." I asked Ibn `Abbas, "What is the meaning of his saying, 'No townsman is permitted to sell things on behalf of a bedouin.' " He replied, "He should not work as a broker for him
hi: Tawus bataate hain: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Nabi ne qafilon se raaste mein milne se mana kiya, aur hukum diya ke koi shehar ka rehne wala dehati ki taraf se cheezein na beche." Maine Ibn Abbas se pucha: "'Koi shehar ka rehne wala dehati ki taraf se na beche' ka kya matlab hai?" Unhone jawab diya: "Use uska dalaal nahi banna chahiye."

e: Narrated Khabbab:I was a blacksmith and did some work for Al-`As bin Wail. When he owed me some money for my work, I went to him to ask for that amount. He said, "I will not pay you unless you disbelieve in Muhammad." I said, "By Allah! I will never do that till you die and be resurrected." He said, "Will I be dead and then resurrected after my death?" I said, "Yes." He said, "There I will have property and offspring and then I will pay you your due." Then Allah revealed. 'Have you seen him who disbelieved in Our signs, and yet says: I will be given property and offspring?
hi: Khabbab (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main ek lohar tha aur Al-Asi bin Wail ke liye kaam karta tha. Jab unpar mere kaam ka kuch paisa qarz tha, main woh maangne unke paas gaya. Unhone kaha: "Main tumhe tab tak nahi dunga jab tak tum Muhammad ko na maano." Maine kaha: "Allah ki qasam! Main aisa kabhi nahi karunga jab tak tum mar na jaao aur dobara zinda na ho jaao." Unhone kaha: "Kya main marunga aur phir apni maut ke baad dobara zinda hounga?" Maine haan mein jawab diya. Unhone kaha: "Wahan mere paas maal aur aulad hogi aur phir main tumhara paisa ada karunga." Phir Allah ne yeh nazil ki: "Kya tumne use dekha jisne humari nishaniyon ka inkaar kiya, aur phir kaha: Mujhe zaroor maal aur aulad di jaayegi?"

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id:Some of the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) went on a journey till they reached some of the 'Arab tribes (at night). They asked the latter to treat them as their guests but they refused. The chief of that tribe was then bitten by a snake (or stung by a scorpion) and they tried their best to cure him but in vain. Some of them said (to the others), "Nothing has benefited him, will you go to the people who resided here at night, it may be that some of them might possess something (as treatment)," They went to the group of the companions (of the Prophet (ﷺ) ) and said, "Our chief has been bitten by a snake (or stung by a scorpion) and we have tried everything but he has not benefited. Have you got anything (useful)?" One of them replied, "Yes, by Allah! I can recite a Ruqya, but as you have refused to accept us as your guests, I will not recite the Ruqya for you unless you fix for us some wages for it." They agreed to pay them a flock of sheep. One of them then went and recited (Surat-ul-Fatiha): 'All the praises are for the Lord of the Worlds' and puffed over the chief who became all right as if he was released from a chain, and got up and started walking, showing no signs of sickness. They paid them what they agreed to pay. Some of them (i.e. the companions) then suggested to divide their earnings among themselves, but the one who performed the recitation said, "Do not divide them till we go to the Prophet (ﷺ) and narrate the whole story to him, and wait for his order." So, they went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and narrated the story. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked, "How did you come to know that Surat-ul-Fatiha was recited as Ruqya?" Then he added, "You have done the right thing. Divide (what you have earned) and assign a share for me as well." The Prophet (ﷺ) smiled thereupon
hi: Abu Saeed (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ke kuch sahaba ek safar par nikle jab tak woh (raat ko) kuch Arab qabilon tak pahunche. Unhone unse mehmannavazi ki guzarish ki magar unhone inkaar kiya. Uss qabile ke sardar ko phir saanp (ya bichhu) ne dasa liya aur unhone use theek karne ki poori koshish ki magar be-faida. Unme se kuch ne (doosron se) kaha: "Kuch faida nahi hua, kya tum un logon ke paas jaoge jo yahan raat ko ruke the, ho sakta hai unme se kisi ke paas kuch (dawa) ho." Woh Nabi ke sahaba ke giroh ke paas gaye aur kaha: "Humare sardar ko saanp ne dasa (ya bichhu ne kataa) hai aur humne sab kuch kiya magar usse faida nahi hua. Kya tumhare paas kuch hai?" Unme se ek ne jawab diya: "Haan, Allah ki qasam! Main Ruqya padh sakta hoon, magar chunke tumne humein mehmaan banane se inkaar kiya, main tumhare liye Ruqya tab tak nahi padhunga jab tak tum humare liye kuch mazdoori muqarrar na karo." Woh unhe bhedon ka ek jhund dene par raazi hue. Unme se ek ne jaakar (Surah Al-Fatiha) padhi: "Sab tareefein Rabb-ul-Aalameen ke liye hain" aur sardar par phoonka jo aise theek ho gaya jaise kisi zanjeer se azaad kiya gaya ho, aur woh uthkar chalne laga, bimari ka koi asar nahi tha. Unhone unhe wahi diya jo unhone waada kiya tha. Unme se kuch (yaani sahaba) ne apni kamaai ko aapas mein baantne ka mashwara diya, magar jisne Ruqya padhi thi, usne kaha: "Isse mat baanto jab tak hum Nabi ke paas na jaayen aur poori kahani unhe na sunaayen, aur unke hukum ka intezar karein." To woh Allah ke Rasool ke paas gaye aur kahani sunaee. Allah ke Rasool ne pucha: "Tumhe kaise pata chala ke Surah Al-Fatiha Ruqya ke tor par padhi jaati hai?" Phir Aap ne joda: "Tumne sahi kiya. Isse baanto aur mera bhi hissa muqarrar karo." Nabi iske baad muskuraaye.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:When Abu Taiba cupped the Prophet (ﷺ) and the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered that he be paid one or two Sas of foodstuff and he interceded with his masters to reduce his taxes
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Abu Taiba ne Nabi ka cupping (khoon nikalna) kiya, Nabi ne hukum diya ke unhe ek ya do Sa khaane ki cheez di jaaye, aur unke maalikon se unka tax kam karne ki sifarish ki.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When the Prophet (ﷺ) was cupped, he paid the man who cupped him his wages
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Jab Nabi ka cupping hua, unhone cupping karne wale ko uski mazdoori di.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When the Prophet (ﷺ) was cupped, he paid the man who cupped him his wages. If it had been undesirable he would not have paid him
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Jab Nabi ka cupping hua, unhone cupping karne wale ko uski mazdoori di. Agar yeh napasandida hota, Aap use na dete.

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to get cupped and would never withhold the wages of any person
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi cupping karwvvate the aur kabhi kisi ki mazdoori nahi rokte the.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) sent for a slave who had the profession of cupping, and he cupped him. The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered that he be paid one or two Sas, or one or two Mudds of foodstuff, and appealed to his masters to reduce his taxes:
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne ek gulaam ko bulwvayaa jiska peshaa cupping tha, aur usne unka cupping kiya. Nabi ne hukum diya ke usse ek ya do Sa, ya ek ya do Mudd khaane ki cheez di jaaye, aur unke maalikon se unka tax kam karne ki appeal ki.

e: Narrated Abu Mas`ud Al-Ansari:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) regarded illegal the price of a dog, the earnings of a prostitute, and the charges taken by a soothsayer
hi: Abu Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ansari (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kutte ki qeemat, veshya ki kamaai, aur jyotish (soothsayer) ki fees ko haram maana.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) prohibited the earnings of slave girls (through prostitution)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne launDiyon ki kamaai (veshya-vritti ke zariye) haram elaan ki.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade taking a price for animal copulation
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne janwaron ke sambhog (breeding) ke liye qeemat lene se mana kiya.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:"Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave the land of Khaibar to the Jews to work on and cultivate and take half of its yield. Ibn `Umar added, "The land used to be rented for a certain portion (of its yield)." Nafi` mentioned the amount of the portion but I forgot it. Rafi` bin Khadij said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade renting farms." Narrated 'Ubaidullah Nafi` said: Ibn `Umar said: (The contract of Khaibar continued) till `Umar evacuated the Jews (from Khaibar)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: "Allah ke Rasool ne Khaibar ki zameen Yahudiyon ko kaam karne aur kheti karne ke liye di, is shart par ke woh iski paidawaar ka aadha hissa lenge." Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne joda: "Zameen ek muqarrar hisse (paidawaar ke) ke badle kiraye par di jaati thi." Nafi ne us hisse ki maqdaar batayi magar main bhool gaya. Rafi bin Khadij (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Nabi ne kheton ko kiraye par dene se mana kiya." Ubaidullah, Nafi ke hawale se bataate hain: Ibn Umar ne kaha: (Khaibar ka muahida jaari raha) jab tak Umar ne Yahudiyon ko (Khaibar se) nikaal nahi diya.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Procrastination (delay) in paying debts by a wealthy man is injustice. So, if your debt is transferred from your debtor to a rich debtor, you should agree
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Maldaar shaks ka qarz chukane mein taalamatol karna zulm hai. Isliye agar tumhara qarz tumhare qarzdaar se kisi maldaar qarzdaar ki taraf transfer ho jaaye, tumhein raazi ho jaana chahiye."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Procrastination (delay) in paying debts by a wealthy person is injustice. So, if your debt is transferred from your debtor to a rich debtor, you should agree
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Maldaar shaks ka qarz chukane mein taalamatol karna zulm hai. Isliye agar tumhara qarz tumhare qarzdaar se kisi maldaar qarzdaar ki taraf transfer ho jaaye, tumhein raazi ho jaana chahiye."

e: Narrated Salama bin Al-Akwa: Once, while we were sitting in the company of Prophet, a dead man was brought. The Prophet (ﷺ) was requested to lead the funeral prayer for the deceased. He said, "Is he in debt?" The people replied in the negative. He said, "Has he left any wealth?" They said, "No." So, he led his funeral prayer. Another dead man was brought and the people said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Lead his funeral prayer." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Is he in debt?" They said, "Yes." He said, "Has he left any wealth?" They said, ''Three Dinars." So, he led the prayer. Then a third dead man was brought and the people said (to the Prophet (ﷺ) ), Please lead his funeral prayer." He said, "Has he left any wealth?" They said, "No." He asked, "Is he in debt?" They said, ("Yes! He has to pay) three Dinars.', He (refused to pray and) said, "Then pray for your (dead) companion." Abu Qatada said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Lead his funeral prayer, and I will pay his debt." So, he led the prayer
hi: Salama bin Al-Akwa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar, jabke hum Nabi ki sohbat mein baithe the, ek murda shaks laaya gaya. Nabi se guzarish ki gayi ke woh marhoom ki namaz-e-janaza padhaen. Aap ne pucha: "Kya uspar qarz tha?" Logon ne na mein jawab diya. Aap ne pucha: "Kya usne koi maal chhoda?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi." Isliye Aap ne unki namaz-e-janaza padhaee. Ek doosra murda laaya gaya aur logon ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Iski namaz-e-janaza padhaiye." Nabi ne pucha: "Kya uspar qarz tha?" Unhone haan mein jawab diya. Aap ne pucha: "Kya usne koi maal chhoda?" Unhone kaha: "Teen Dinar." Isliye Aap ne namaz padhaee. Phir ek teesra murda laaya gaya aur logon ne (Nabi se) kaha, "Kripya iski namaz-e-janaza padhaiye." Aap ne pucha: "Kya usne koi maal chhoda?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi." Aap ne pucha: "Kya uspar qarz tha?" Unhone kaha: ("Haan! Usne) teen Dinar (chukane hain).' Aap ne (namaz padhane se inkaar karke) kaha: "Phir apne (marhoom) sathi ki namaz khud padho." Abu Qatada (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Iski namaz-e-janaza padhaiye, aur main uska qarz ada karunga." Isliye Aap ne namaz padhaee.

e: Narrated Muhammad bin 'Amr Al-Aslami that his father Hamza said:'Umar (ra) sent him (i.e. Hamza) as a Sadaqa / Zakat collector. A man had committed illegal sexual intercourse with the slave girl of his wife. Hamza took (personal) sureties for the adulterer till they came to 'Umar. 'Umar had lashed the adulterer one hundred lashes. 'Umar confirmed their claim (that the adulterer had already been punished) and excused him because of being Ignorant. Jarir Al-Ash'ath said to Ibn Mas'ud regarding renegades (i.e., those who became infidels after embracing Islam), "Let them repent and take (personal) sureties for them." They repented and their relatives stood sureties for them. According to Hammad, if somebody stands surety for another person and that person dies, the person giving surety will be released from responsibility. According to Al-Hakam, his responsibilities continues
hi: Muhammad bin Amr Al-Aslami bataate hain, apne waalid Hamza ke hawale se: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne unhe (Hamza ko) Zakat jama karne wale ke tor par bheja. Ek shaks ne apni biwi ki launDi se zina kiya tha. Hamza ne zina karne wale ke liye kuch logon ki zamanat li jab tak woh Umar tak pahunche. Umar ne zina karne wale ko sau kode maare. Umar ne unke daawe (ke zina karne wale ko pehle hi saza mil chuki hai, is dawe) ki tasdeeq ki aur usse na-samajhi ki wajah se maaf kar diya. Jarir (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ash'ath ne murtad logon (jo Islam qubool karke phir kaafir ho gaye) ke baare mein Ibn Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kaha: "Unhe tauba karne dijiye aur unki (personal) zamanat li jaaye." Woh tauba kar liye aur unke rishtedaron ne unki zamanat li. Hammad ke mutabiq, agar koi kisi doosre shaks ki zamanat le aur woh shaks mar jaaye, zamanat lene wala apni zimmedaari se azaad ho jataa hai. Al-Hakam ke mutabiq, uski zimmedaari jaari rehti hai.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "An Israeli man asked another Israeli to lend him one thousand Dinars. The second man required witnesses. The former replied, 'Allah is sufficient as a witness.' The second said, 'I want a surety.' The former replied, 'Allah is sufficient as a surety.' The second said, 'You are right,' and lent him the money for a certain period. The debtor went across the sea. When he finished his job, he searched for a conveyance so that he might reach in time for the repayment of the debt, but he could not find any. So, he took a piece of wood and made a hole in it, inserted in it one thousand Dinars and a letter to the lender and then closed (i.e. sealed) the hole tightly. He took the piece of wood to the sea and said. 'O Allah! You know well that I took a loan of one thousand Dinars from so-and-so. He demanded a surety from me but I told him that Allah's Guarantee was sufficient and he accepted Your guarantee. He then asked for a witness and I told him that Allah was sufficient as a Witness, and he accepted You as a Witness. No doubt, I tried hard to find a conveyance so that I could pay his money but could not find, so I hand over this money to You.' Saying that, he threw the piece of wood into the sea till it went out far into it, and then he went away. Meanwhile he started searching for a conveyance in order to reach the creditor's country. One day the lender came out of his house to see whether a ship had arrived bringing his money, and all of a sudden he saw the piece of wood in which his money had been deposited. He took it home to use for fire. When he sawed it, he found his money and the letter inside it. Shortly after that, the debtor came bringing one thousand Dinars to him and said, 'By Allah, I had been trying hard to get a boat so that I could bring you your money, but failed to get one before the one I have come by.' The lender asked, 'Have you sent something to me?' The debtor replied, 'I have told you I could not get a boat other than the one I have come by.' The lender said, 'Allah has delivered on your behalf the money you sent in the piece of wood. So, you may keep your one thousand Dinars and depart guided on the right path
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Bani Israel ke ek shaks ne doosre Bani Israel se hazaar Dinar ka qarz maanga. Doosre shaks ne gawah maange. Pehle shaks ne jawab diya: 'Allah gawah ke liye kaafi hai.' Doosre ne kaha: 'Mujhe zamanat chahiye.' Pehle ne jawab diya: 'Allah zamanat ke liye kaafi hai.' Doosre ne kaha: 'Tumne sach kaha,' aur usse muqarrar muddat ke liye paisa diya. Qarzdaar samundar paar gaya. Jab usne apna kaam khatam kiya, usne (paisa lane ke liye) sawari dhoondi taake woh waqt par qarz wapas kar sake, magar usse koi nahi mili. Isliye usne ek lakdi ka tukda liya aur usme ek surakh banaya, usme hazaar Dinar aur qarz dene wale ke liye ek khat daala, phir surakh ko kaskar band kiya. Woh lakdi ka tukda samundar ke paas gaya aur kaha: 'Aye Allah! Tujhe pata hai maine falaan-falaan se hazaar Dinar ka qarz liya tha. Usne mujhse zamanat maangi thi magar maine usse kaha Allah ki zamanat kaafi hai aur usne teri zamanat qubool ki. Phir usne gawah maanga aur maine usse kaha Allah gawah ke liye kaafi hai, aur usne tujhe gawah maana. Beshak, maine bahut koshish ki koi sawari dhoondne ki taake main uska paisa ada kar sakoon magar mujhe nahi mili, isliye main yeh paisa tujhe sonpta hoon.' Yeh kehte huye, usne lakdi ka tukda samundar mein phenka jab tak woh door tak chala gaya, phir woh chala gaya. Isi dauran woh sawari dhoondte hue qarz dene wale ke shehar ki taraf jaane ka intezaam karta raha. Ek din qarz dene wala apne ghar se bahar nikla yeh dekhne ke koi kashti aayi hai jismein uska paisa laaya gaya ho, aur achanak usne lakdi ka tukda dekha jismein uska paisa rakha tha. Woh use jalane ke liye ghar le gaya. Jab usne use kaata, usme apna paisa aur khat paaya. Thodi der baad, qarzdaar hazaar Dinar lekar aaya aur kaha: 'Allah ki qasam, main tumhare liye kashti dhoondne ki koshish karta raha taake main tumhara paisa laakar de sakoon, magar mujhe isse pehle koi nahi mili jis par main aaya hoon.' Qarz dene wale ne pucha: 'Kya tumne mujhe kuch bheja tha?' Qarzdaar ne jawab diya: 'Maine tumhe bataya na, mujhe is se pehle koi kashti nahi mili jispar main aaya hoon.' Qarz dene wale ne kaha: 'Allah ne tumhari taraf se woh paisa pahuncha diya jo tumne lakdi ke tukde mein bheja tha. Isliye tum apne hazaar Dinar rakh lo aur seedhe raaste par chale jaao.'"

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:Ibn `Abbas said, "In the verse: To every one We have appointed ' (Muwaliya Muwaliya means one's) heirs (4.33).' (And regarding the verse) 'And those with whom your right hands have made a pledge.' Ibn `Abbas said, "When the emigrants came to the Prophet (ﷺ) in Medina, the emigrant would inherit the Ansari while the latter's relatives would not inherit him because of the bond of brotherhood which the Prophet established between them (i.e. the emigrants and the Ansar). When the verse: 'And to everyone We have appointed heirs' (4.33) was revealed, it canceled (the bond (the pledge) of brotherhood regarding inheritance)." Then he said, "The verse: To those also to whom your right hands have pledged, remained valid regarding cooperation and mutual advice, while the matter of inheritance was excluded and it became permissible to assign something in one's testament to the person who had the right of inheriting before
hi: Sa'id bin Jubair bataate hain: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Ayat mein: 'Har ek ke liye humne waaris muqarrar kiye hain' (Muwaliya ka matlab hai) waaris (4:33). (Aur ayat ke baare mein) 'Aur jinse tumhare dahine haathon ne ahad kiya hai.' Ibn Abbas ne kaha: 'Jab Muhajireen Nabi ke paas Madina aaye, Muhajir Ansaari se waraasat leta, jabke Ansaari ke rishtedaar unse waraasat nahi lete, us bhaichare ke rishte ki wajah se jo Nabi ne unke darmiyan banaya tha (yaani Muhajireen aur Ansaar ke beech). Jab ayat: 'Aur har ek ke liye humne waaris muqarrar kiye hain' (4:33) nazil hui, usne (bhaichare ke rishte ko waraasat ke maamle mein) radd kar diya.'" Phir unhone kaha: "Ayat: 'Aur unhe bhi jinse tumhare dahine haathon ne ahad kiya hai,' waraasat ke maamle mein badla, aisa hi rehta magar aapasi madad aur naseehat ke maamle mein valid rahta, jabke waraasat ka maamla ise se alag ho gaya aur jaiz ho gaya ke koi apni vasiyat mein kuch us shaks ke naam kare jise pehle waraasat ka haqq tha."

e: Narrated Anas:`Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf came to us and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) established a bond of brotherhood between him and Sa`d bin Rabi`a
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abdur-Rahman bin Auf humare paas aaye aur Allah ke Rasool ne unke aur Sa'd bin Rabi'a ke darmiyan bhaichare ka rishta banaya.

e: Narrated `Asim:I heard Anas bin Malik, "Have you ever heard that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'There is no alliance in Islam?' " He replied, "The Prophet (ﷺ) made alliance between Quraish and the Ansar in my house
hi: Asim bataate hain: Maine Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha: "Kya aapne kabhi suna hai Nabi ne kaha ho: 'Islam mein koi (jahiliyat wala) muahida nahi hai'?" Unhone jawab diya: "Nabi ne mere ghar mein Quraish aur Ansaar ke darmiyan muahida banaya."

e: Narrated Salama bin Al-Akwa`:A dead person was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) so that he might lead the funeral prayer for him. He asked, "Is he in debt?" When the people replied in the negative, he led the funeral prayer. Another dead person was brought and he asked, "Is he in debt?" They said, "Yes." He (refused to lead the prayer and) said, "Lead the prayer of your friend." Abu Qatada said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I undertake to pay his debt." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then led his funeral prayer
hi: Salama bin Al-Akwa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek murda shaks Nabi ke paas laaya gaya taake woh uski namaz-e-janaza padhaen. Aap ne pucha: "Kya uspar qarz tha?" Logon ne na mein jawab diya, isliye Aap ne uski namaz-e-janaza padhaee. Ek aur murda laaya gaya aur Aap ne pucha: "Kya uspar qarz tha?" Unhone haan mein jawab diya. Aap ne (namaz padhane se inkaar karke) kaha: "Apne sathi ki namaz khud padho." Abu Qatada (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Main uska qarz ada karunga." Allah ke Rasool ne phir uski namaz-e-janaza padhaee.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) said (to me), "If the money of Bahrain comes, I will give you a certain amount of it." The Prophet (ﷺ) had breathed his last before the money of Bahrain arrived. When the money of Bahrain reached, Abu Bakr announced, "Whoever was promised by the Prophet (ﷺ) should come to us." I went to Abu Bakr and said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) promised me so and so." Abu Bakr gave me a handful of coins and when I counted them, they were five-hundred in number. Abu Bakr then said, "Take twice the amount you have taken (besides)
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Nabi ne (mujhse) kaha: "Agar Bahrain se paisa aa jaaye, main tumhe usme se ek khaas maqdaar dunga." Nabi ka intiqal ho gaya Bahrain ka paisa pahunchne se pehle. Jab Bahrain ka paisa pahuncha, Abu Bakr ne elaan kiya: "Jise bhi Nabi ne kuch waada kiya ho, hamare paas aaye." Main Abu Bakr ke paas gaya aur kaha: "Nabi ne mujhse falaan-falaan waada kiya tha." Abu Bakr ne mujhe ek muttthi bhar sikke diye aur jab maine gine, woh paanch sau nikle. Abu Bakr ne phir kaha: "(Iske ilawa) itna aur le lo jitna tumne liya hai."

e: Narrated Aisha:(wife of the Prophet) Since I reached the age when I could remember things, I have seen my parents worshipping according to the right faith of Islam. Not a single day passed but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) visited us both in the morning and in the evening. When the Muslims were persecuted, Abu Bakr set out for Ethiopia as an emigrant. When he reached a place called Bark-al-Ghimad, he met Ibn Ad-Daghna, the chief of the Qara tribe, who asked Abu Bakr, "Where are you going?" Abu Bakr said, "My people have turned me out of the country and I would like to tour the world and worship my Lord." Ibn Ad- Daghna said, "A man like you will not go out, nor will he be turned out as you help the poor earn their living, keep good relation with your Kith and kin, help the disabled (or the dependents), provide guests with food and shelter, and help people during their troubles. I am your protector. So, go back and worship your Lord at your home." Ibn Ad-Daghna went along with Abu Bakr and took him to the chiefs of Quraish saying to them, "A man like Abu Bakr will not go out, nor will he be turned out. Do you turn out a man who helps the poor earn their living, keeps good relations with Kith and kin, helps the disabled, provides guests with food and shelter, and helps the people during their troubles?" So, Quraish allowed Ibn Ad-Daghna's guarantee of protection and told Abu Bakr that he was secure, and said to Ibn Ad-Daghna, "Advise Abu Bakr to worship his Lord in his house and to pray and read what he likes and not to hurt us and not to do these things publicly, for we fear that our sons and women may follow him." Ibn Ad-Daghna told Abu Bakr of all that, so Abu Bakr continued worshipping his Lord in his house and did not pray or recite Qur'an aloud except in his house. Later on Abu Bakr had an idea of building a mosque in the court yard of his house. He fulfilled that idea and started praying and reciting Qur'an there publicly. The women and the offspring of the pagans started gathering around him and looking at him astonishingly. Abu Bakr was a softhearted person and could not help weeping while reciting Qur'an. This horrified the pagan chiefs of Quraish. They sent for Ibn Ad-Daghna and when he came, they said, "We have given Abu Bakr protection on condition that he will worship his Lord in his house, but he has transgressed that condition and has built a mosque in the court yard of his house and offered his prayer and recited Qur'an in public. We are afraid lest he mislead our women and offspring. So, go to him and tell him that if he wishes he can worship his Lord in his house only, and if not, then tell him to return your pledge of protection as we do not like to betray you by revoking your pledge, nor can we tolerate Abu Bakr's public declaration of Islam (his worshipping). `Aisha added: Ibn Ad-Daghna came to Abu Bakr and said, "You know the conditions on which I gave you protection, so you should either abide by those conditions or revoke my protection, as I do not like to hear the 'Arabs saying that Ibn Ad-Daghna gave the pledge of protection to a person and his people did not respect it." Abu Bakr said, "I revoke your pledge of protection and am satisfied with Allah's protection." At that time Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was still in Mecca and he said to his companions, "Your place of emigration has been shown to me. I have seen salty land, planted with date-palms and situated between two mountains which are the two ,Harras." So, when the Prophet (ﷺ) told it, some of the companions migrated to Medina, and some of those who had migrated to Ethiopia returned to Medina. When Abu Bakr prepared for emigration, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him, "Wait, for I expect to be permitted to emigrate." Abu Bakr asked, "May my father be sacrificed for your sake, do you really expect that?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied in the affirmative. So, Abu Bakr postponed his departure in order to accompany Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and fed two camels which he had, with the leaves of Samor trees for four months
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab se main baaton ko samajhne ki umr mein aayi, maine apne maa-baap ko Islam ke sahih deen ke mutabiq ibadat karte dekha hai. Koi din aisa nahi guzra jab Allah ke Rasool humse subah-shaam milne na aaaye hon. Jab Musalmanon ko sataya gaya, Abu Bakr Ethiopia hijrat karne ke liye nikle. Jab woh Bark-al-Ghimad naam ki jagah pahunche, unki mulaqat Ibn Ad-Daghna se hui, jo Qara qabile ke sardar the, unhone Abu Bakr se pucha: "Aap kahan ja rahe hain?" Abu Bakr ne kaha: "Meri qaum ne mujhe desh se nikaal diya hai aur main duniya ghumkar apne Rab ki ibadat karna chahta hoon." Ibn Ad-Daghna ne kaha: "Aap jaise shaks ko na jaana chahiye na nikala jaana chahiye, kyunke aap gareebon ki rozi kamane mein madad karte hain, rishtedaron se achha suluk rakhte hain, be-sahaara logon ki madad karte hain, mehmaan ko khaana-rahne ki jagah dete hain, aur museebat mein logon ki madad karte hain. Main aapka rakhwala hoon. Isliye wapas jaiye aur apne ghar mein apne Rab ki ibadat kijiye." Ibn Ad-Daghna Abu Bakr ke saath gaye aur unhe Quraish ke sardaron ke paas le gaye aur unse kaha: "Abu Bakr jaise shaks ko na jaana chahiye na nikala jaana chahiye. Kya aap us shaks ko nikaaloge jo gareebon ki rozi mein madad karta hai, rishtedaron se achha suluk rakhta hai, be-sahaara logon ki madad karta hai, mehmaan ko khaana-rahne ki jagah deta hai, aur museebat mein logon ki madad karta hai?" Isliye Quraish ne Ibn Ad-Daghna ki panah ko qubool kiya aur Abu Bakr ko mehfooz ghoshit kiya, aur Ibn Ad-Daghna se kaha: "Abu Bakr ko naseehat kijiye ke woh apne Rab ki ibadat apne ghar mein karein aur jo chahen namaz padhen aur Quran padhen, magar humein takleef na dein aur yeh sab khule aam na karein, kyunke humein dar hai kahin humare bete-biwiyaan unki pairvi na kar len." Ibn Ad-Daghna ne yeh sab Abu Bakr ko bataya, isliye Abu Bakr apne ghar mein apne Rab ki ibadat karte rahe aur ghar ke ilawa kahin bhi namaz ya Quran zor se nahi padhte the. Baad mein Abu Bakr ne apne ghar ke angaan mein ek masjid banane ka khayaal kiya. Unhone yeh khayaal poora kiya aur wahan khule aam namaz aur Quran padhna shuru kiya. Mushrikon ki aurten aur bachche unke ird-gird jama hone lage aur unhe hairat se dekhte the. Abu Bakr narm-dil the aur Quran padhte huye ro dete the. Isse Quraish ke mushrik sardaar dara gaye. Unhone Ibn Ad-Daghna ko bulwaya aur jab woh aaye, unhone kaha: "Humne Abu Bakr ko is shart par panah di thi ke woh apni ibadat apne ghar mein karenge, magar unhone woh shart tori hai aur apne angaan mein ek masjid banaee hai aur khule aam namaz aur Quran padhte hain. Humein dar hai kahin woh humare bete-biwiyon ko galat raah par na le jaayein. Isliye unke paas jaiye aur unse kahiye ke agar woh chahen, apne Rab ki ibadat sirf apne ghar mein karein, aur agar na chahen, to aapki panah wapas kar dein, kyunke humein aapko dhoka dena pasand nahi, aur na hum Abu Bakr ki khuli ibadat sehen kar sakte hain." Ayesha ne joda: Ibn Ad-Daghna Abu Bakr ke paas gaye aur kaha: "Aapko pata hai maine kis shart par aapko panah di thi, isliye aap ya to un sharton ka paalan karein ya meri panah wapas karein, kyunke mujhe napasand hai ke Arab yeh kahen ke Ibn Ad-Daghna ne kisi ko panah di aur uski qaum ne uski izzat nahi ki." Abu Bakr ne kaha: "Main tumhari panah wapas karta hoon aur Allah ki panah se santusht hoon." Us waqt Allah ke Rasool abhi Mecca mein the aur unhone apne sahaba se kaha: "Mujhe humari hijrat ki jagah dikhaee gayi hai. Maine ek namkeen zameen dekhi hai, khajoor ke darakhton se lagI hui, do pahaadon ke beech jo do Harra hain." Isliye jab Nabi ne yeh bataya, kuch sahaba ne Madina hijrat kar li, aur kuch jo Ethiopia hijrat kar chuke the, Madina wapas aa gaye. Jab Abu Bakr hijrat ki taiyaari kar rahe the, Allah ke Rasool ne unse kaha: "Intezar karo, kyunke mujhe ummeed hai mujhe bhi hijrat ki ijazat mil jayegi." Abu Bakr ne pucha: "Mera baap aapke liye qurban ho, kya aap sach mein aisi ummeed rakhte hain?" Allah ke Rasool ne haan mein jawab diya. Isliye Abu Bakr ne apni rawaanagi taal di taake Allah ke Rasool ke saath ja sakein, aur apne do oonton ko Samor darakht ke patton se chaar mahine tak khilate rahe.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Whenever a dead man in debt was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) he would ask, "Has he left anything to repay his debt?" If he was informed that he had left something to repay his debts, he would offer his funeral prayer, otherwise he would tell the Muslims to offer their friend's funeral prayer. When Allah made the Prophet (ﷺ) wealthy through conquests, he said, "I am more rightful than other believers to be the guardian of the believers, so if a Muslim dies while in debt, I am responsible for the repayment of his debt, and whoever leaves wealth (after his death) it will belong to his heirs
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab bhi koi qarz-daar murda Allah ke Rasool ke paas laaya jata, woh pucchte: "Kya usne apna qarz ada karne ke liye kuch chhoda hai?" Agar unhe bataya jaata ke usne kuch chhoda hai jo qarz chukane ke liye kaafi hai, Aap uski namaz-e-janaza padhate, warna Musalmanon se kehte apne sathi ki namaz khud padh len. Jab Allah ne fathon ke zariye Nabi ko maldaar bana diya, unhone kaha: "Main momino ka doosre momino se zyada haqdaar hoon (unka sarparast banne ke liye), isliye agar koi Musalman qarz ke saath mar jaaye, main uska qarz chukane ke liye zimmedaar hoon, aur jo bhi maal chhod jaaye, woh uske waarison ka hoga."

e: Narrated `Ali:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered me to distribute the saddles and skins of the Budn which I had slaughtered
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne mujhe hukum diya ke main un Budn (qurbani ke oont) ke jinhe maine zabah kiya tha, saddle aur khaal taqseem kar dun.

e: Narrated `Uqba bin Amir:that the Prophet (ﷺ) had given him sheep to distribute among his companions and a male kid was left (after the distribution). When he informed the Prophet (ﷺ) of it, he said (to him), "Offer it as a sacrifice on your behalf
hi: Uqba bin Amir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne unhe bhedein di apne sahaba mein taqseem karne ke liye, aur (taqseem ke baad) ek nar bakri bach gayi. Jab unhone Nabi ko yeh bataya, Aap ne (unse) kaha: "Ise apni taraf se qurbani ke tor par zabah karo."

e: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf:I got an agreement written between me and Umaiya bin Khalaf that Umaiya would look after my property (or family) in Mecca and I would look after his in Medina. When I mentioned the word 'Ar-Rahman' in the documents, Umaiya said, "I do not know 'Ar-Rahman.' Write down to me your name, (with which you called yourself) in the Pre-Islamic Period of Ignorance." So, I wrote my name ' `Abdu `Amr'. On the day (of the battle) of Badr, when all the people went to sleep, I went up the hill to protect him. Bilal(1) saw him (i.e. Umaiya) and went to a gathering of Ansar and said, "(Here is) Umaiya bin Khalaf! Woe to me if he escapes!" So, a group of Ansar went out with Bilal to follow us (`Abdur-Rahman and Umaiya). Being afraid that they would catch us, I left Umaiya's son for them to keep them busy but the Ansar killed the son and insisted on following us. Umaiya was a fat man, and when they approached us, I told him to kneel down, and he knelt, and I laid myself on him to protect him, but the Ansar killed him by passing their swords underneath me, and one of them injured my foot with his sword. (The sub narrator said, " `Abdur-Rahman used to show us the trace of the wound on the back of his foot)
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Auf (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Umaiya bin Khalaf ke saath ek muahida likhwaya ke Umaiya Mecca mein mera maal (ya pariwara) ki dekhbhal karega aur main Madina mein uski. Jab maine dastavez mein 'Ar-Rahman' lafz likha, Umaiya ne kaha: "Mujhe 'Ar-Rahman' nahi pata. Mujhe apna naam likho jise tum jahiliyat ke zamane mein bulate the." Isliye maine apna naam 'Abdu Amr' likha. Badr ki jung ke din, jab sab log so gaye, main Umaiya ki hifazat ke liye pahad par gaya. Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne unhe (Umaiya ko) dekha aur Ansaar ki ek majlis mein gaya aur kaha: "(Yahan hai) Umaiya bin Khalaf! Afsos hoga agar woh bach jaaye!" Isliye Ansaar ka ek giroh Bilal ke saath humara (Abdur-Rahman aur Umaiya ka) picha karne nikla. Yeh dar tha ke woh humein pakd lenge, isliye maine Umaiya ke bete ko unke liye chhod diya taake woh masroof rahen, magar Ansaar ne bete ko qatl kar diya aur picha karna jaari rakha. Umaiya moti shaks the, aur jab woh humare qareeb aaye, maine unse ghutne tekne ko kaha, aur woh tek gaye, aur main unki hifazat karne ke liye unpar leta gaya, magar Ansaar ne unhe mere neeche se apni talwaren nikaal kar qatl kar diya, aur unme se ek ne apni talwar se mera paon zakhmi kar diya. (Raawi ne kaha: "Abdur-Rahman humein apne paon ke peeche ka zakhm dikhate the.")

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri and Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) employed someone as a governor at Khaibar. When the man came to Medina, he brought with him dates called Janib. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked him, "Are all the dates of Khaibar of this kind?" The man replied, "(No), we exchange two Sa's of bad dates for one Sa of this kind of dates (i.e. Janib), or exchange three Sa's for two." On that, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Don't do so, as it is a kind of usury (Riba) but sell the dates of inferior quality for money, and then buy Janib with the money". The Prophet said the same thing about dates sold by weight. (See Hadith No)
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Khaibar ka ek gawarnar muqarrar kiya. Jab woh shaks Madina aaya, woh apne saath Janib naam ki khajoor laaya. Nabi ne unse pucha: "Kya Khaibar ki sab khajoor aisi hain?" Shaks ne jawab diya: "(Nahi), hum kharaab khajoor ke do Sa badalkar is qisam (Janib) ki ek Sa lete hain, ya teen Sa (kharaab) badalkar do (achhi)." Isspar Nabi ne kaha: "Aisa mat karo, kyunke yeh sood (Riba) ka ek qisam hai balki kam quality wali khajoor ko paise ke badle becho, phir usse Janib khareeda karo." Nabi ne wazan se bechi jaane wali khajoor ke baare mein bhi yehi kaha.

e: Narrated Ibn Ka`b bin Malik from his father:We had some sheep which used to graze at Sala'. One of our slavegirls saw a sheep dying and she broke a stone and slaughtered the sheep with it. My father said to the people, "Don't eat it till I ask the Prophet about it (or till I send somebody to ask the Prophet)." So, he asked or sent somebody to ask the Prophet, and the Prophet (ﷺ) permitted him to eat it. 'Ubaidullah (a sub-narrator) said, "I admire that girl, for though she was a slave-girl, she dared to slaughter the sheep
hi: Ibn Ka'b bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain, apne waalid ke hawale se: Humaari kuch bhedein thi jo Sala naam ki jagah par charti thi. Humaari ek launDi ne dekha ke ek bhed marne wali hai, aur usne ek patthar todkar us patthar se bhed zabah kar di. Mere waalid ne logon se kaha: "Ise mat khao jab tak main Nabi se iske baare mein na poochun (ya jab tak main kisi ko Nabi se poochne na bhejun)." Isliye unhone khud pucha ya kisi ko poochne bheja, aur Nabi ne unhe ise khane ki ijazat di. Ubaidullah (doosre raawi) ne kaha: "Mujhe us ladki ki tarif karni hai, kyunke woh launDi hote hue bhi usne himmat karke bhed zabah ki."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) owed somebody a camel of a certain age. When he came to demand it back, the Prophet (ﷺ) said (to some people), "Give him (his due)." When the people searched for a camel of that age, they found none, but found a camel one year older. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Give (it to) him." On that, the man remarked, "You have given me my right in full. May Allah give you in full." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The best amongst you is the one who pays the rights of others generously
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi par kisi ka ek khaas umr ka oont qarz tha. Jab woh use wapas maangne aaya, Nabi ne (kuch logon se) kaha: "Use (uska haqq) do." Jab logon ne usi umr ka oont dhoonda, unhe nahi mila, magar unhe ek oont mila jo ek saal bada tha. Nabi ne kaha: "Use de do." Isspar shaks ne kaha: "Aapne mujhe mera poora haqq de diya. Allah aapko poora de." Nabi ne farmaya: "Tum mein sabse behtar woh hai jo doosron ka haqq khule dil se ada kare."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) demanding his debts and behaved rudely. The companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) intended to harm him, but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said (to them), "Leave him, for the creditor (i.e. owner of a right) has the right to speak." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then said, "Give him a camel of the same age as that of his." The people said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! There is only a camel that is older than his." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Give (it to) him, for the best amongst you is he who pays the rights of others handsomely
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks Nabi ke paas apna qarz maangne aaya aur be-adabi se pesh aaya. Nabi ke sahaba use nuqsaan pahunchana chahte the, magar Allah ke Rasool ne (unse) kaha: "Use chhod do, kyunke qarz-daata (yaani haqq wale) ko bolne ka haqq hai." Allah ke Rasool ne phir kaha: "Use usi umr ka ek oont do." Logon ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Sirf ek oont hai jo uski umr se bada hai." Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: "Use de do, kyunke tum mein sabse behtar woh hai jo doosron ka haqq khoobsoorati se ada kare."

e: Narrated Marwan bin Al-Hakam and Al-Miswar bin Makhrama:When the delegates of the tribe of Hawazin after embracing Islam, came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), he got up. They appealed to him to return their properties and their captives. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to them, "The most beloved statement to me is the true one. So, you have the option of restoring your properties or your captives, for I have delayed distributing them." The narrator added, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had been waiting for them for more than ten days on his return from Taif. When they realized that Allah's Apostle would return to them only one of two things, they said, "We choose our captives." So, Allah's Apostle got up in the gathering of the Muslims, praised Allah as He deserved, and said, "Then after! These brethren of yours have come to you with repentance and I see it proper to return their captives to them. So, whoever amongst you likes to do that as a favor, then he can do it, and whoever of you wants to stick to his share till we pay him from the very first booty which Allah will give us then he can do so." The people replied, "We agree to give up our shares willingly as a favor for Allah's Apostle." Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "We don't know who amongst you has agreed and who hasn't. Go back and your chiefs may tell us your opinion." So, all of them returned and their chiefs discussed the matter with them and then they (i.e. their chiefs) came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to tell him that they (i.e. the people) had given up their shares gladly and willingly
hi: Marwan bin Al-Hakam aur Al-Miswar bin Makhrama (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Hawazin qabile ka wafd, Islam qubool karne ke baad, Allah ke Rasool ke paas aaya, woh khade hue. Unhone unse apni maal aur qaidiyon ko wapas karne ki guzarish ki. Allah ke Rasool ne unse kaha: "Mujhe sabse pyari baat sachi baat hai. Isliye tumhe ikhtiyaar hai ke apni maal wapas lo ya apne qaidiyon ko, kyunke maine (taqseem) taal diya hai." Raawi ne joda, Allah ke Rasool unka das din se zyada intezar kar rahe the Taif se wapas aane ke baad. Jab unhe pata chala ke Allah ke Rasool inme se sirf ek cheez wapas karenge, unhone kaha: "Hum apne qaidiyon ko chunte hain." Isliye Allah ke Rasool Musalmanon ki majlis mein khade hue, Allah ki jaisi hamd karni chahiye vaisi ki, aur kaha: "Iske baad! Tumhare yeh bhai tauba karke aaye hain aur mujhe theek lagta hai unke qaidiyon ko wapas karna. Isliye jise bhi aisa karna pasand ho ek ehsaan ke tor par, kar sakta hai, aur jo apna hissa rakhna chahe jab tak hum use pehle maal-e-ghanimat se ada nahi karte, woh bhi kar sakta hai." Logon ne kaha: "Hum Allah ke Rasool ki khaatir apna hissa khushi se de dete hain." Phir Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: "Humein nahi pata tum mein se kis ne raazi hokar diya aur kisne nahi. Wapas jaao aur tumhare sardar humein tumhari raay bata sakte hain." Isliye sab wapas gaye aur unke sardaar ne unse baat ki, phir woh Allah ke Rasool ke paas aaye aur unhe bataya ke unhone (yaani logon ne) apna hissa khushi aur raazi hokar de diya.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:I was accompanying the Prophet (ﷺ) on a journey and was riding a slow camel that was lagging behind the others. The Prophet (ﷺ) passed by me and asked, "Who is this?" I replied, "Jabir bin `Abdullah." He asked, "What is the matter, (why are you late)?" I replied, "I am riding a slow camel." He asked, "Do you have a stick?" I replied in the affirmative. He said, "Give it to me." When I gave it to him, he beat the camel and rebuked it. Then that camel surpassed the others thenceforth. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Sell it to me." I replied, "It is (a gift) for you, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." He said, "Sell it to me. I have bought it for four Dinars (gold pieces) and you can keep on riding it till Medina." When we approached Medina, I started going (towards my house). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Where are you going?" I said, "I have married a widow." He said, "Why have you not married a virgin to fondle with each other?" I said, "My father died and left daughters, so I decided to marry a widow (an experienced woman) (to look after them)." He said, "Well done." When we reached Medina, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O Bilal, pay him (the price of the camel) and give him extra money." Bilal gave me four Dinars and one Qirat extra. (A sub-narrator said): Jabir added, "The extra Qirat of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) never parted from me." The Qirat was always in Jabir bin `Abdullah's purse
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main ek safar mein Nabi ke saath tha aur main ek dheeme oont par sawar tha jo doosron se peeche rah gaya tha. Nabi mere paas se guzre aur pucha: "Yeh kaun hai?" Maine jawab diya: "Jabir bin Abdullah." Aap ne pucha: "Kya baat hai (kyun der ho rahi hai)?" Maine jawab diya: "Main dheeme oont par sawar hoon." Aap ne pucha: "Kya tumhare paas chhadi hai?" Maine haan mein jawab diya. Aap ne kaha: "Mujhe do." Jab maine unhe di, unhone oont ko maara aur daanta. Phir woh oont tab se sab se aage nikalne laga. Nabi ne kaha: "Ise mujhe bech do." Maine jawab diya: "Yeh aapke liye hai, Ya Allah ke Rasool!" Aap ne kaha: "Ise mujhe becho. Maine ise chaar Dinar (sona) mein khareeda hai, aur tum ispar Madina tak sawar rah sakte ho." Jab hum Madina ke qareeb pahunche, main (apne ghar ki taraf) jaane laga. Nabi ne pucha: "Tum kahan ja rahe ho?" Maine kaha: "Maine ek biwah aurat se shaadi ki hai." Aap ne pucha: "Kunwari se shaadi kyun nahi ki, taake tum ek-doosre ke saath khel sakte?" Maine kaha: "Mere waalid ka intiqal ho gaya aur unhone betiyaan chhodi, isliye maine ek biwah (tajurbekaaar aurat) se shaadi karne ka faisla kiya (unki dekhbhal ke liye)." Aap ne kaha: "Achha kiya." Jab hum Madina pahunche, Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: "Aye Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ), ise (oont ki qeemat) do aur kuch izafa bhi." Bilal ne mujhe chaar Dinar aur ek Qirat izafi diye. (Doosre raawi ne kaha:) Jabir ne joda: "Allah ke Rasool ka izafi Qirat mujhse kabhi juda nahi hua." Woh Qirat hamesha Jabir bin Abdullah ke thaili mein rahta.

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sad: A woman came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I want to give up myself to you." A man said, "Marry her to me." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "We agree to marry her to you with what you know of the Qur'an by heart
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek aurat Allah ke Rasool ke paas aayi aur kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Main khud ko aapko sonpna chahti hoon." Ek shaks ne kaha: "Iski shaadi mujhse karwva dijiye." Nabi ne kaha: "Hum tumse iski shaadi is bunyaad par karte hain ke tum jo Quran hifz karte ho use isse sikhate raho."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) deputed me to keep Sadaqat (al-Fitr) of Ramadan. A comer came and started taking handfuls of the foodstuff (of the Sadaqa) (stealthily). I took hold of him and said, "By Allah, I will take you to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ." He said, "I am needy and have many dependents, and I am in great need." I released him, and in the morning Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked me, "What did your prisoner do yesterday?" I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! The person complained of being needy and of having many dependents, so, I pitied him and let him go." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Indeed, he told you a lie and he will be coming again." I believed that he would show up again as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had told me that he would return. So, I waited for him watchfully. When he (showed up and) started stealing handfuls of foodstuff, I caught hold of him again and said, "I will definitely take you to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He said, "Leave me, for I am very needy and have many dependents. I promise I will not come back again." I pitied him and let him go. In the morning Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked me, "What did your prisoner do." I replied, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! He complained of his great need and of too many dependents, so I took pity on him and set him free." Allah's Apostle said, "Verily, he told you a lie and he will return." I waited for him attentively for the third time, and when he (came and) started stealing handfuls of the foodstuff, I caught hold of him and said, "I will surely take you to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as it is the third time you promise not to return, yet you break your promise and come." He said, "(Forgive me and) I will teach you some words with which Allah will benefit you." I asked, "What are they?" He replied, "Whenever you go to bed, recite "Ayat-al-Kursi"-- 'Allahu la ilaha illa huwa-l-Haiy-ul Qaiyum' till you finish the whole verse. (If you do so), Allah will appoint a guard for you who will stay with you and no satan will come near you till morning. " So, I released him. In the morning, Allah's Apostle asked, "What did your prisoner do yesterday?" I replied, "He claimed that he would teach me some words by which Allah will benefit me, so I let him go." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked, "What are they?" I replied, "He said to me, 'Whenever you go to bed, recite Ayat-al-Kursi from the beginning to the end ---- Allahu la ilaha illa huwa-lHaiy-ul-Qaiyum----.' He further said to me, '(If you do so), Allah will appoint a guard for you who will stay with you, and no satan will come near you till morning.' (Abu Huraira or another sub-narrator) added that they (the companions) were very keen to do good deeds. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He really spoke the truth, although he is an absolute liar. Do you know whom you were talking to, these three nights, O Abu Huraira?" Abu Huraira said, "No." He said, "It was Satan
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne mujhe Ramadan ke Zakat-ul-Fitr ki dekhbhal ke liye muqarrar kiya. Koi aaya aur khaane ki cheez (Zakat ki) chupke se mutthiyon mein le jaane laga. Maine use pakd liya aur kaha: "Allah ki qasam, main tumhe Allah ke Rasool ke paas le jaunga." Usne kaha: "Main zaroorat-mand hoon aur mere bahut se aashrit hain, aur mujhe sakht zaroorat hai." Maine use chod diya, aur subah Allah ke Rasool ne mujhse pucha: "Kal raat tumhare qaidi ne kya kiya?" Maine kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Us shaks ne apni zaroorat aur bahut se aashriton ki shikayat ki, isliye mujhe uspar reham aaya aur maine use jaane diya." Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: "Beshak, usne tumse jhoot bola aur woh dobara aayega." Mujhe yaqeen tha woh dobara aayega kyunke Allah ke Rasool ne mujhe bataya tha ke woh aayega. Isliye main uska intezar karta raha. Jab usne (aakar) phir mutthiyaan churaana shuru kiya, maine use dobara pakd liya aur kaha: "Main tumhe zaroor Allah ke Rasool ke paas le jaunga." Usne kaha: "Mujhe chhod do, main bahut zaroorat-mand hoon aur mere bahut se aashrit hain. Wada karta hoon dobara nahi aunga." Mujhe uspar reham aaya aur maine use jaane diya. Subah Allah ke Rasool ne mujhse pucha: "Tumhare qaidi ne kya kiya?" Maine jawab diya: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Usne apni sakht zaroorat aur bahut zyada aashriton ki shikayat ki, isliye mujhe uspar reham aaya aur maine use azaad kar diya." Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: "Beshak, usne tumse jhoot bola aur woh phir aayega." Teesri baar main uska hushiyari se intezar karta raha, aur jab usne (aakar) phir mutthiyaan churana shuru kiya, maine use pakd liya aur kaha: "Main tumhe zaroor Allah ke Rasool ke paas le jaunga, kyunke yeh teesri baar hai jab tum wada karte ho na aane ka, phir bhi apna wada torkar aate ho." Usne kaha: "(Mujhe maaf karo aur) main tumhe kuch alfaaz sikhaunga jinse Allah tumhe faida dega." Maine pucha: "Woh kya hain?" Usne jawab diya: "Jab bhi tum sone jao, 'Ayat-al-Kursi' padho — 'Allahu la ilaha illa huwa-l-Haiy-ul-Qaiyum' poori ayat khatam hone tak. (Agar tum aisa karo), Allah tumhare liye ek rakhwala muqarrar karega jo tumhare saath rahega aur subah tak koi shaitan tumhare qareeb nahi aayega." Isliye maine use jaane diya. Subah Allah ke Rasool ne pucha: "Kal raat tumhare qaidi ne kya kiya?" Maine jawab diya: "Usne daawa kiya ke woh mujhe kuch alfaaz sikhaega jinse Allah mujhe faida dega, isliye maine use jaane diya." Allah ke Rasool ne pucha: "Woh kya hain?" Maine jawab diya: "Usne mujhse kaha: 'Jab bhi tum sone jaao, Ayat-al-Kursi shuru se aakhir tak padho — Allahu la ilaha illa huwa-lHaiy-ul-Qaiyum—.' Usne aage kaha: '(Agar tum aisa karo), Allah tumhare liye ek rakhwala muqarrar karega jo tumhare saath rahega, aur subah tak koi shaitan tumhare qareeb nahi aayega.'" (Abu Huraira ya kisi doosre raawi ne) joda ke woh (sahaba) neik amal karne mein bahut betaab the. Nabi ne kaha: "Usne sach kaha, chahe woh sarasar jhuta hai. Kya tumhe pata hai teen raaton tak tum kisse baat kar rahe the, Aye Abu Huraira?" Abu Huraira ne kaha: "Nahi." Nabi ne kaha: "Woh Shaitan tha."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id al-Khudri:Once Bilal brought Barni (i.e. a kind of dates) to the Prophet (ﷺ) and the Prophet (ﷺ) asked him, "From where have you brought these?" Bilal replied, "I had some inferior type of dates and exchanged two Sas of it for one Sa of Barni dates in order to give it to the Prophet; to eat." Thereupon the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Beware! Beware! This is definitely Riba (usury)! This is definitely Riba (Usury)! Don't do so, but if you want to buy (a superior kind of dates) sell the inferior dates for money and then buy the superior kind of dates with that money
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) Barni (ek khaas qisam ki khajoor) Nabi ke paas laaye, aur Nabi ne unse pucha: "Yeh kahan se laaye?" Bilal ne jawab diya: "Mere paas kam quality wali khajoor thi aur maine uski do Sa badalkar ek Sa Barni khajoor li taake main use Nabi ko khane ke liye de sakoon." Isspar Nabi ne kaha: "Khabardar! Khabardar! Yeh zaroor sood (Riba) hai! Yeh zaroor Riba hai! Aisa mat karo, magar agar tum (behtar quality) khareedna chahte ho, kam quality wali khajoor ko paisa ke badle becho, phir usse behtar khajoor khareed lo."

e: Narrated `Amr:Concerning the Waqf of `Umar: It was not sinful of the trustee (of the Waqf) to eat or provide his friends from it, provided the trustee had no intention of collecting fortune (for himself). Ibn `Umar was the manager of the trust of `Umar and he used to give presents from it to those with whom he used to stay at Mecca
hi: Amr bataate hain: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke Waqf (charity endowment) ke baare mein: Isme gunah nahi tha ke Waqf ka trustee usme se khaye ya apne doston ko khilaye, bashart ke trustee ka apne liye daulat jama karne ka koi iraada na ho. Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) Umar ke trust ke manager the aur unse mila-jula tohfa dete the un logon ko jinke saath woh Mecca mein rahte the.

e: Narrated Zaid bin Khalid and Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Unais! Go to the wife of this (man) and if she confesses (that she has committed illegal sexual intercourse), then stone her to death
hi: Zaid bin Khalid (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Aye Unais! Is (shaks) ki biwi ke paas jaao, aur agar woh (zina ka) iqrar kare, use sangsaar (pathrao) kar do."

e: Narrated `Uqba bin Al-Harith:When An-Nuaman or his son was brought in a state of drunkenness, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered all those who were present in the house to beat him. I was one of those who beat him. We beat him with shoes and palm-leaf stalks
hi: Uqba bin Al-Harith bataate hain: Jab An-Nu'man ya unke bete ko nashe ki halat mein laaya gaya, Allah ke Rasool ne ghar mein maujood sabko unhe maarne ka hukum diya. Main unme se ek tha jinhone unhe maara. Humne unhe jooton aur khajoor ke patton ki laathiyon se maara.

e: Narrated `Aisha:I twisted the garlands of the Hadis (i.e. animals for sacrifice) of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with my own hands. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) put them around their necks with his own hands, and sent them with my father (to Mecca). Nothing legal was regarded illegal for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) till the animals were slaughtered
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine apne haathon se Allah ke Rasool ke Hadi (qurbani ke janwaron) ki maalayen buni. Phir Allah ke Rasool ne apne haathon se unhe unki gardan mein daalim, aur unhe mere waalid ke saath (Mecca) bheja. Allah ke Rasool ke liye koi jaiz cheez haram nahi hui jab tak janwar zabah nahi ho gaye.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Abu Talha was the richest man in Medina amongst the Ansar and Beeruha' (garden) was the most beloved of his property, and it was situated opposite the mosque (of the Prophet.). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to enter it and drink from its sweet water. When the following Divine Verse was revealed: 'You will not attain righteousness till you spend in charity of the things you love' (3.92), Abu Talha got up in front of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Allah says in His Book, 'You will not attain righteousness unless you spend (in charity) that which you love,' and verily, the most beloved to me of my property is Beeruha (garden), so I give it in charity and hope for its reward from Allah. O Allah's Apostle! Spend it wherever you like." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) appreciated that and said, "That is perishable wealth, that is perishable wealth. I have heard what you have said; I suggest you to distribute it among your relatives." Abu Talha said, "I will do so, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." So, Abu Talha distributed it among his relatives and cousins. The sub-narrator (Malik) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: "That is a profitable wealth," instead of "perishable wealth
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) Ansaar mein Madina ke sabse maldaar shaks the, aur Beeruha (baag) unki sabse pyari maal thi, jo (Nabi ki) masjid ke saamne thi. Allah ke Rasool usme daakhil hote aur uska meetha paani pite. Jab yeh paak Aayat nazil hui: "Tum kabhi neki ko nahi paoge jab tak us cheez ko sadqa na do jo tumhe pyari ho" (3:92), Abu Talha Allah ke Rasool ke saamne khade hue aur kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Allah apni Kitaab mein farmata hai: 'Tum kabhi neki ko nahi paoge jab tak us cheez ko sadqa na do jo tumhe pyari ho,' aur beshak, mera maal mein mujhe sabse pyari Beeruha (baag) hai, isliye main ise sadqa deta hoon aur Allah se iska ajr chahta hoon. Ya Allah ke Rasool! Ise wahan kharch karein jahan aap munasib samjhen." Allah ke Rasool ne isse sarahte huye kaha: "Yeh mai-kharaab hone wali (fani) daulat hai, yeh fani daulat hai. Maine jo tumne kaha suna hai; mera mashwara hai ke tum ise apne rishtedaron mein taqseem karo." Abu Talha ne kaha: "Main aisa karunga, Ya Allah ke Rasool!" Isliye Abu Talha ne ise apne rishtedaron aur chachazaad bhaiyon mein taqseem kar diya. (Doosre raawi Malik ne kaha: Nabi ne kaha "yeh faidamand daulat hai" ki bajaye "fani daulat.")

e: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "An honest treasurer who gives what he is ordered to give fully, perfectly and willingly to the person to whom he is ordered to give, is regarded as one of the two charitable persons
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Imandaar bhandaari jo poora, mukammal aur khushi se woh cheez de jiska hukum diya jaaye us shaks ko jise dene ka hukum diya gaya, do sadqa dene walon mein se ek mana jataa hai."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "There is none amongst the Muslims who plants a tree or sows seeds, and then a bird, or a person or an animal eats from it, but is regarded as a charitable gift for him
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Koi bhi Musalman aisa nahi jo darakht lagaye ya beej boye, aur phir koi parinda, ya insaan, ya janwar usse khaye, magar yeh uske liye sadqe ka tohfa mana jata hai."

e: Narrated Abu Umama al-Bahili:I saw some agricultural equipment and said: "I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying: "There is no house in which these equipment enters except that Allah will cause humiliation to enter it
hi: Abu Umama (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Bahili bataate hain: Maine kuch kheti ke auzaar dekhe aur kaha: "Maine Nabi ko farmate suna: 'Koi bhi ghar aisa nahi jismein yeh auzaar daakhil hote hain magar Allah usme zillat daakhil kar deta hai.'"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever keeps a dog, one Qirat of the reward of his good deeds is deducted daily, unless the dog is used for guarding a farm or cattle." Abu Huraira (in another narration) said from the Prophet, "unless it is used for guarding sheep or farms, or for hunting." Narrated Abu Hazim from Abu Huraira: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A dog for guarding cattle or for hunting
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jo koi kutta paalta hai, uske neik amalon ke ajr mein se har din ek Qirat kam ho jata hai, siwaye jab kutta khet ya maweshi ki rakhwali ke liye ho." Abu Huraira ne (ek doosri riwayat mein) Nabi ke hawale se kaha: "...siwaye jab woh bhedon ya kheton ki rakhwali ke liye, ya shikaar ke liye ho." Abu Hazim, Abu Huraira ke hawale se: Nabi ne kaha: "Maweshi ki rakhwali ya shikaar ke liye kutta."

e: Narrated As-Sa'ib bin Yazid:Abu Sufyan bin Abu Zuhair, a man from Azd Shanu'a and one of the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, 'If one keeps a dog which is meant for guarding neither a farm nor cattle, one Qirat of the reward of his good deeds is deducted daily." I said, "Did you hear this from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" He said, "Yes, by the Lord of this Mosque
hi: As-Saib bin Yazid bataate hain: Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abu Zuhair, Azd Shanu'a qabile ke ek shaks aur Nabi ke sahaba mein se ek, ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool ko farmate suna: 'Agar koi kutta paalta hai jo na khet ki rakhwali ke liye ho na maweshi ki, uske neik amalon ke ajr mein se har din ek Qirat kam ho jata hai.'" Maine pucha: "Kya aapne yeh Allah ke Rasool se suna?" Unhone jawab diya: "Haan, is Masjid ke Rab ki qasam."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "While a man was riding a cow, it turned towards him and said, 'I have not been created for this purpose (i.e. carrying), I have been created for ploughing." The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "I, Abu Bakr and `Umar believe in the story." The Prophet (ﷺ) went on, "A wolf caught a sheep, and when the shepherd chased it, the wolf said, 'Who will be its guard on the day of wild beasts, when there will be no shepherd for it except me?' "After narrating it, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I, Abu Bakr and `Umar too believe it." Abu Salama (a sub-narrator) said, "Abu Bakr and `Umar were not present then
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jab ek shaks gaay par sawar tha, gaay ne unki taraf mudkar kaha: 'Mujhe is (yaani sawari ke) maqsad ke liye paida nahi kiya gaya, mujhe khet jotane ke liye paida kiya gaya hai.'" Nabi ne aage kaha: "Main, Abu Bakr aur Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) is kahani par iman rakhte hain." Nabi ne aage kaha: "Ek bhediye ne ek bhed pakdi, aur jab charwahe ne uska picha kiya, bhediye ne kaha: 'Jangli janwaron ke din uska rakhwala kaun hoga jab uska koi charwaha na hoga siwaye mere?'" Yeh sunane ke baad, Nabi ne kaha: "Main, Abu Bakr aur Umar bhi ispar iman rakhte hain." Abu Salama (raawi) ne kaha: "Abu Bakr aur Umar us waqt maujood nahi the."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Ansar said to the Prophet (ﷺ) "Distribute the date palm trees between us and our emigrant brothers." He replied, "No." The Ansar said (to the emigrants), "Look after the trees (water and watch them) and share the fruits with us." The emigrants said, "We listen and obey
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ansaar ne Nabi se kaha: "Khajoor ke darakht humare aur humare Muhajir bhaion ke darmiyan taqseem kar dijiye." Nabi ne jawab diya: "Nahi." Ansaar ne (Muhajireen se) kaha: "Darakhton ki dekhbhal karo (sinchi karo aur dekhbhal karo) aur phal humare saath baanto." Muhajireen ne kaha: "Hum sunte aur maante hain."

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) got the date palm trees of the tribe of Bani-An-Nadir burnt and the trees cut down at a place called Al-Buwaira . Hassan bin Thabit said in a poetic verse: "The chiefs of Bani Lu'ai found it easy to watch fire spreading at Al-Buwaira
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Bani An-Nadir qabile ke khajoor ke darakhton ko jalwaya aur katvaya Al-Buwaira naam ki jagah par. Hassan bin Thabit ne apne ek she'r mein kaha: "Bani Lu'ai ke sardaar ke liye Al-Buwaira mein aag ke phailne ko dekhna aasaan tha."

e: Narrated Rafi` bin Khadij:We worked on farms more than anybody else in Medina. We used to rent the land at the yield of specific delimited portion of it to be given to the landlord. Sometimes the vegetation of that portion was affected by blights etc., while the rest remained safe and vice versa, so the Prophet (ﷺ) forbade this practice. At that time gold or silver were not used (for renting the land). If they provided the seeds, they would get so-and-so much
hi: Rafi bin Khadij (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Madina mein sabse zyada kheti karte the. Hum zameen ko iss shart par kiraye par lete the ke uske ek khaas hisse ki paidawaar zameendaar ko dee jaayegi. Kabhi-kabhi us hisse ki paidawaar bimari waghera se kharaab ho jaati, jabke baaki zameen theek rehti, aur kabhi iske ulta hota, isliye Nabi ne is riwaj se mana kiya. Us waqt zameen kiraye par sona-chandi (paison) se nahi li jaati thi. Agar woh (kisaan) beej dete, unhe kuch (nishchit) maqdaar milti.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) concluded a contract with the people of Khaibar to utilize the land on the condition that half the products of fruits or vegetation would be their share. The Prophet (ﷺ) used to give his wives one hundred Wasqs each, eighty Wasqs of dates and twenty Wasqs of barley. (When `Umar became the Caliph) he gave the wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) the option of either having the land and water as their shares, or carrying on the previous practice. Some of them chose the land and some chose the Wasqs, and `Aisha chose the land
