hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne Khaibar walon ke saath ek muahida kiya ke woh zameen istemal karenge is shart par ke phalon ya paidawaar ka aadha hissa unka hoga. Nabi apni har biwi ko sau Wasq dete the, assi Wasq khajoor ke aur bees Wasq jau ke. (Jab Umar khalifa bane) unhone Nabi ki biwiyon ko ikhtiyaar diya ke ya to woh zameen aur paani apna hissa rakhein, ya pehli riwaj jaari rakhein. Unme se kuch ne zameen chuni aur kuch ne Wasq, aur Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne zameen chuni.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) made a deal with the people of Khaibar that they would have half the fruits and vegetation of the land they cultivated
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne Khaibar walon ke saath ek muahida kiya ke unhe apni kheti-baadi ki zameen ke phal aur paidawaar ka aadha hissa milega.

e: Narrated `Amr:I said to Tawus, "I wish you would give up Mukhabara (Sharecropping), for the people say that the Prophet forbade it." On that Tawus replied, "O `Amr! I give the land to sharecroppers and help them. No doubt; the most learned man, namely Ibn `Abbas told me that the Prophet (ﷺ) had not forbidden it but said, 'It is more beneficial for one to give his land free to one's brother than to charge him a fixed rental
hi: Amr bataate hain: Maine Tawus se kaha: "Kaash aap Mukhabara (bataee riwaaj) chhod dete, kyunke log kehte hain Nabi ne isse mana kiya tha." Isspar Tawus ne jawab diya: "Aye Amr! Main zameen bataeedaaro ko deta hoon aur unki madad karta hoon. Beshak, sabse jaankaar shaks, yaani Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ), ne mujhe bataya ke Nabi ne isse mana nahi kiya, balki kaha: 'Kisi ke liye apni zameen apne bhai ko muft dena, kisi khaas kiraye par dene se zyada faidamand hai.'"

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave the land of Khaibar to the Jew's on the condition that they work on it and cultivate it, and be given half of its yield
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Khaibar ki zameen Yahudiyon ko is shart par di ke woh isme kaam karenge aur kheti karenge, aur unhe iski paidawaar ka aadha hissa diya jaayega.

e: Narrated Rafi`:We worked on farms more than anybody else in Medina. We used to rent the land and say to the owner, "The yield of this portion is for us and the yield of that portion is for you (as the rent)." One of those portions might yield something and the other might not. So, the Prophet (ﷺ) forbade us to do so
hi: Rafi (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Madina mein sabse zyada kheti karte the. Hum zameen kiraye par lete the aur maalik se kehte the: "Iss hisse ki paidawaar humari hai aur us hisse ki (kiraye ke tor par) tumhari." Ek hissa kuch de sakta tha aur doosra kuch nahi. Isliye Nabi ne humein aisa karne se mana kiya.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "While three men were walking, It started raining and they took shelter (refuge) in a cave in a mountain. A big rock rolled down from the mountain and closed the mouth of the cave. They said to each other, "Think of good deeds which you did for Allah's sake only, and invoke Allah by giving reference to those deeds so that He may remove this rock from you." One of them said, 'O Allah! I had old parents and small children and I used to graze the sheep for them. On my return to them in the evening, I used to milk (the sheep) and start providing my parents first of all before my children. One day I was delayed and came late at night and found my parents sleeping. I milked (the sheep) as usual and stood by their heads. I hated to wake them up and disliked to give milk to my children before them, although my children were weeping (because of hunger) at my feet till the day dawned. O Allah! If I did this for Your sake only, kindly remove the rock so that we could see the sky through it.' So, Allah removed the rock a little and they saw the sky. The second man said, 'O Allah! I was in love with a cousin of mine like the deepest love a man may have for a woman. I wanted to outrage her chastity but she refused unless I gave her one hundred Dinars. So, I struggled to collect that amount. And when I sat between her legs, she said, 'O Allah's slave! Be afraid of Allah and do not deflower me except rightfully (by marriage).' So, I got up. O Allah! If I did it for Your sake only, please remove the rock.' The rock shifted a little more. Then the third man said, 'O Allah! I employed a laborer for a Faraq of rice and when he finished his job and demanded his right, I presented it to him, but he refused to take it. So, I sowed the rice many time till I gathered cows and their shepherd (from the yield). (Then after some time) He came and said to me, 'Fear Allah (and give me my right)." I said, 'Go and take those cows and the shepherd.' He said, 'Be afraid of Allah! Don't mock at me.' I said, 'I am not mocking at you. Take (all that).' So, he took all that. O Allah! If I did that for Your sake only, please remove the rest of the rock.' So, Allah removed the rock
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jabke teen log chal rahe the, baarish shuru ho gayi aur unhone ek pahad ki gufa mein panah li. Ek bada patthar pahad se ludka aur gufa ka mun band kar diya. Unhone (ek-doosre se) kaha: 'Un neik amalon ke baare mein socho jo tumne sirf Allah ke liye kiye the, aur unka waseela lekar Allah se dua karo taake woh yeh patthar tumse hataaa de.' Unme se ek ne kaha: 'Aye Allah! Mere maa-baap budhe the aur mere chhote bachche the, aur main unke liye bhedein charata tha. Shaam ko wapas aakar, main (bhedon ka) doodh nikalta aur pehle apne maa-baap ko dena shuru karta, apne bachchon se pehle. Ek din mujhe der ho gayi aur main raat ko der se aaya aur apne maa-baap ko sota paaya. Maine hamesha ki tarah doodh nikala aur unke sar ke paas khada raha. Mujhe unhe jagane se napasand hua aur apne bachchon ko unse pehle doodh dena bhi napasand hua, chahe mere bachche mere paon ke paas bhookh se ro rahe the jab tak subah nahi ho gayi. Aye Allah! Agar maine yeh sirf tere liye kiya, kripya patthar hata de taake hum aasman dekh saken.' To Allah ne patthar thoda hataya aur unhone aasman dekha. Doosre shaks ne kaha: 'Aye Allah! Main apni ek chachazaad bahan se aisi mohabbat karta tha jaisi sabse gehri mohabbat koi mard kisi aurat se kar sakta hai. Main uski izzat loothna chahta tha magar usne inkaar kiya jab tak main use sau Dinar na dun. Isliye maine bahut mehnat karke woh maqdaar jama ki. Aur jab main uski taangon ke beech baitha, usne kaha: Aye Allah ke bande! Allah se dar aur mujhe haqq (shaadi) ke bina mat chhoo. Isliye main uth gaya. Aye Allah! Agar maine yeh sirf tere liye kiya, kripya patthar hata de.' Patthar aur thoda hata. Phir teesre shaks ne kaha: 'Aye Allah! Maine ek mazdoor ko ek Faraq chawal ke liye rakha aur jab usne apna kaam khatam kiya aur apna haqq maanga, maine usse pesh kiya magar usne lene se inkaar kiya. Isliye maine woh chawal kaee baar boye jab tak maine ussi se gaayen aur unka charwaha jama kar liya. (Kuch waqt baad) woh aaya aur mujhse kaha: Allah se dar (aur mujhe mera haqq do). Maine kaha: Jaao aur woh gaayen aur charwaha le lo. Usne kaha: Allah se dar! Mera mazak mat udao. Maine kaha: Main tumhara mazak nahi uda raha. Isliye usne sab kuch le liya. Aye Allah! Agar maine yeh sirf tere liye kiya, kripya baaki patthar bhi hata de.' To Allah ne patthar poori tarah hataya diya."

e: Narrated Zaid bin Aslam from his father:`Umar said, "But for the future Muslim generations, I would have distributed the land of the villages I conquer among the soldiers as the Prophet (ﷺ) distributed the land of Khaibar
hi: Zaid bin Aslam bataate hain, apne waalid ke hawale se: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Agar aane wali Musalman naslon ka khayaal na hota, main un gaanvo ki zameen fauj mein taqseem kar deta jinhe main fatah karta, jaise Nabi ne Khaibar ki zameen taqseem ki thi."

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who cultivates land that does not belong to anybody is more rightful (to own it)." `Urwa said, "`Umar gave the same verdict in his Caliphate
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jo bhi aisi zameen aabad kare jo kisi ki nahi, woh iska maalik banne ka zyada haqdaar hai." Urwa ne kaha: "Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne apni khilafat mein bhi yehi faisla diya."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:While the Prophet (ﷺ) was passing the night at his place of rest in Dhul-Hulaifa in the bottom of the valley (of Aqiq), he saw a dream and it was said to him, "You are in a blessed valley." Musa said, "Salim let our camels kneel at the place where `Abdullah used to make his camel kneel, seeking the place where Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to take a rest, which is situated below the mosque which is in the bottom of the valley; it is midway between the mosque and the road
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Jabke Nabi Dhul-Hulaifa mein wadi (Aqiq) ke neeche apni aaram karne ki jagah par raat guzar rahe the, unhone ek khwab dekha aur unhe bataya gaya: "Tum ek mubarak wadi mein ho." Musa ne kaha: Salim humare uonton ko wahin bithate jahan Abdullah apna unt bitha kar rukte, us jagah ki talaash mein jahan Allah ke Rasool aaram karte the, jo masjid ke neeche wadi ke beech mein hai; yeh masjid aur raaste ke beech mein hai.

e: Narrated `Umar:While the Prophet (ﷺ) was in Al-`Aqiq he said, "Someone (meaning Gabriel) came to me from my Lord tonight (in my dream) and said, 'Offer the prayer in this blessed valley and say (I intend to perform) `Umra along with Hajj (together)
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Nabi Al-Aqiq mein the, unhone kaha: "Koi (Jibreel) aaj raat mere Rab ki taraf se mere paas aaya (khwab mein) aur kaha: 'Is mubarak wadi mein namaz padho aur kaho (main karta hoon) Umrah Hajj ke saath (Hajj-al-Qiran).'"

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:`Umar expelled the Jews and the Christians from Hijaz. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had conquered Khaibar, he wanted to expel the Jews from it as its land became the property of Allah, His Apostle, and the Muslims. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) intended to expel the Jews but they requested him to let them stay there on the condition that they would do the labor and get half of the fruits. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) told them, "We will let you stay on this condition, as long as we wish." So, they (i.e. Jews) kept on living there until `Umar forced them to go towards Taima' and Ariha
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Umar ne Yahudi aur Isaiyon ko Hijaz se nikal diya. Jab Allah ke Rasool ne Khaibar fatah kiya, unhone Yahudiyon ko wahan se nikalna chaha chunke uski zameen Allah, uske Rasool aur Musalmanon ki milkiyat ban chuki thi. Allah ke Rasool Yahudiyon ko nikalna chahte the magar unhone Nabi se guzarish ki ke woh unhe wahan rehne de is shart par ke woh mehnat karenge aur phalon ka aadha hissa lenge. Allah ke Rasool ne unse kaha: "Hum tumhe is shart par yahan rehne denge jab tak hum chahen." Isliye woh (Yahudi) wahan rehte rahe jab tak Umar ne unhe Taima aur Ariha ki taraf jaane par majboor nahi kiya.

e: Narrated Rafi` bin Khadij:My uncle Zuhair said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade us to do a thing which was a source of help to us." I said, "Whatever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said was right." He said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent for me and asked, 'What are you doing with your farms?' I replied, 'We give our farms on rent on the basis that we get the yield produced at the banks of the water streams (rivers) for the rent, or rent it for some Wasqs of barley and dates.' Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Do not do so, but cultivate (the land) yourselves or let it be cultivated by others gratis, or keep it uncultivated.' I said, 'We hear and obey
hi: Rafi bin Khadij (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Mere chacha Zuhair ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool ne humein us cheez se mana kiya jo humare liye faidamand thi." Maine kaha: "Allah ke Rasool ne jo bhi kaha, woh sahi hai." Unhone kaha: "Allah ke Rasool ne mujhe bulaya aur pucha: 'Tum apni zameen se kya karte ho?' Maine jawab diya: 'Hum apni zameen kiraye par dete hain is bunyaad par ke humein paani ke nalon (nadiyon) ke kinare ki paidawaar milegi, ya isse kuch Wasq jau aur khajoor ke badle kiraye par dete hain.' Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: 'Aisa mat karo, balki zameen khud kheti karo, ya doosron ko muft kheti karne do, ya use un-kheti hui chhod do.' Maine kaha: 'Hum sunte hain aur maante hain.'"

e: Narrated Jabir:The people used to rent their land for cultivation for one-third, one-fourth or half its yield. The Prophet said, "Whoever has land should cultivate it himself or give it to his (Muslim) brother gratis; otherwise keep it uncultivated." Narrated Abu Huraira: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever has land should cultivate it himself or give it to his (Muslim) brother gratis; otherwise he should keep it uncultivated
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Log apni zameen ek-tihai, ek-chauthai, ya aadhi paidawaar ke liye kiraye par dete the. Nabi ne kaha: "Jiske paas zameen ho, use khud kheti karni chahiye, ya apne (Musalman) bhai ko muft dena chahiye; warna use un-kheti hui chhodanaa chahiye." Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jiske paas zameen ho, use khud kheti karni chahiye, ya apne (Musalman) bhai ko muft dena chahiye; warna use un-kheti hui chhodanaa chahiye."

e: Narrated `Amr:When I mentioned it (i.e. the narration of Rafi` 'bin Khadij: no. 532) to Tawus, he said, "It is permissible to rent the land for cultivation, for Ibn `Abbas said, 'The Prophet (ﷺ) did not forbid that, but said: One had better give the land to one's brother gratis rather than charge a certain amount for it
hi: Amr bataate hain: Jab maine yeh (Rafi bin Khadij (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki riwayat) Tawus ko bataee, unhone kaha: "Zameen kheti ke liye kiraye par dena jaiz hai, kyunke Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: 'Nabi ne isse mana nahi kiya, balki kaha: Behtar hai apni zameen apne bhai ko muft dena, kisi khaas maqdaar ke badle kiraye par dene se.'"

e: Narrated Nafi`:Ibn `Umar used to rent his farms in the time of Abu Bakr, `Umar, `Uthman, and in the early days of Muawiya. Then he was told the narration of Rafi` 'bin Khadij that the Prophet (ﷺ) had forbidden the renting of farms. Ibn `Umar went to Rafi` and I accompanied him. He asked Rafi` who replied that the Prophet had forbidden the renting of farms. Ibn `Umar said, "You know that we used to rent our farms in the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for the yield of the banks of the water streams (rivers) and for certain amount of figs
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) apni zameen Abu Bakr, Umar, Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke zamane mein, aur Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke shuru ke dinon mein kiraye par dete the. Phir unhe Rafi bin Khadij (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki riwayat batayi gayi ke Nabi ne zameen kiraye par dene se mana kiya tha. Ibn Umar Rafi ke paas gaye aur main unke saath tha. Unhone Rafi se pucha, jinhone jawab diya ke Nabi ne zameen kiraye par dena mana kiya tha. Ibn Umar ne kaha: "Tumhe pata hai ke hum apni zameen Allah ke Rasool ke zamane mein paani ke nalon ke kinare ki paidawaar aur kuch anjeer ke badle kiraye par dete the."

e: Narrated Salim:`Abdullah bin `Umar said, "I knew that the land was rented for cultivation in the lifetime of Allah's Apostle ." Later on Ibn `Umar was afraid that the Prophet (ﷺ) had forbidden it, and he had no knowledge of it, so he gave up renting his land
hi: Salim bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Mujhe pata tha ke zameen Allah ke Rasool ke zamane mein kheti ke liye kiraye par di jaati thi." Baad mein Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko dar hua ke Nabi ne isse mana kiya ho aur unhe iska pata na ho, isliye unhone apni zameen kiraye par dena chhod diya.

e: Narrated Hanzala bin Qais:Rafi` bin Khadij said, "My two uncles told me that they (i.e. the companions of the Prophet) used to rent the land in the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) for the yield on the banks of water streams (rivers) or for a portion of the yield stipulated by the owner of the land. The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade it." I said to Rafi`, "What about renting the land for Dinars and Dirhams?" He replied, "There is no harm in renting for Dinars- Dirhams. Al-Laith said, "If those who have discernment for distinguishing what is legal from what is illegal looked into what has been forbidden concerning this matter they would not permit it, for it is surrounded with dangers
hi: Hanzala bin Qais bataate hain: Rafi bin Khadij (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Mere do chachaon ne mujhe bataya ke woh (Nabi ke sahaba) Nabi ke zamane mein zameen kiraye par dete the, paani ke nalon ke kinare ki paidawaar ke badle, ya zameendaar ke muqarrar kiye hue hisse ke badle. Nabi ne isse mana kiya." Maine Rafi se pucha: "Zameen Dinar-Dirham ke badle kiraye par dene ke baare mein kya?" Unhone jawab diya: "Dinar-Dirham ke badle kiraye par dene mein koi harj nahi." Al-Laith ne kaha: "Agar woh log jinhe halal-haram mein tamiz ki samajh hai, is baare mein mana kiye gaye cheez par ghaur karein, woh ise jaiz nahi karenge, kyunke yeh khatron se ghira hua hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) was narrating (a story), while a bedouin was sitting with him. "One of the inhabitants of Paradise will ask Allah to allow him to cultivate the land. Allah will ask him, 'Are you not living in the pleasures you like?' He will say, 'Yes, but I like to cultivate the land.' " The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "When the man (will be permitted he) will sow the seeds and the plants will grow up and get ripe, ready for reaping and so on till it will be as huge as mountains within a wink. Allah will then say to him, 'O son of Adam! Take here you are, gather (the yield); nothing satisfies you.' " On that, the bedouin said, "The man must be either from Quraish (i.e. an emigrant) or an Ansari, for they are farmers, whereas we are not farmers." The Prophet (ﷺ) smiled (at this)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Nabi (ek kahani) suna rahe the, jabke ek dehati unke saath baitha tha. "Jannat ke bashindon mein se ek Allah se zameen kheti karne ki ijazat maangega. Allah usse poochega: 'Kya tum jis khushi mein chahte ho usme nahi ho?' Woh kahega: 'Haan, magar main zameen kheti karna chahta hoon.'" Nabi ne joda: "Jab shaks (ijazat pakar) beej boyega, paudhe ugenge aur pak jaayenge, katne ke liye taiyaar honge, aur pahadon jitne bade ho jaayenge palak jhapakte hi. Allah phir usse kahega: 'Aye Adam ke bete! Lo, sab jama karo; kuch bhi tumhe santusht nahi karta.'" Isspar dehati ne kaha: "Woh shaks zaroor Quraish (yaani Muhajir) ya Ansaari hoga, kyunke woh kisaan hain, jabke hum kisaan nahi hain." Nabi is baat par muskuraye.

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:We used to be very happy on Friday as an old lady used to cut some roots of the Silq, which we used to plant on the banks of our small water streams, and cook them in a pot of her's, adding to them, some grains of barley. (Ya'qub, the sub-narrator said, "I think the narrator mentioned that the food did not contain fat or melted fat (taken from meat).") When we offered the Friday prayer we would go to her and she would serve us with the dish. So, we used to be happy on Fridays because of that. We used not to take our meals or the midday nap except after the Jumua prayer (i.e. Friday prayer)
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Jumme ko bahut khush hote the, kyunke ek budhi aurat Silq (ek sabzi) ki kuch jaden katti jinhe hum apne paani ke chhote nalon ke kinare bote the, aur unhe apne bartan mein pakati, thoda jau ke daane dalti. (Ya'qub, doosre raawi ne kaha: "Mujhe lagta hai raawi ne kaha khaane mein ghee ya gala hua ghee nahi tha.") Jab hum Jumme ki namaz padh le, hum uske paas jate aur woh humein khaana khilati. Isliye hum Jumme ko iski wajah se khush hote the. Hum apna khaana ya dopahar ki neend Jumme ki namaz ke baad hi lete the.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The people say that Abu Huraira narrates too many narrations. In fact Allah knows whether I say the truth or not. They also ask, "Why do the emigrants and the Ansar not narrate as he does?" In fact, my emigrant brethren were busy trading in the markets, and my Ansar brethren were busy with their properties. I was a poor man keeping the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and was satisfied with what filled my stomach. So, I used to be present while they (i.e. the emigrants and the Ansar) were absent, and I used to remember while they forgot (the Hadith). One day the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever spreads his sheet till I finish this statement of mine and then gathers it on his chest, will never forget anything of my statement." So, I spread my covering sheet which was the only garment I had, till the Prophet (ﷺ) finished his statement and then I gathered it over my chest. By Him Who had sent him (i.e. Allah's Apostle) with the truth, since then I did not forget even a single word of that statement of his, until this day of mine. By Allah, but for two verses in Allah's Book, I would never have related any narration (from the Prophet). (These two verses are): "Verily! Those who conceal the clear signs and the guidance which we have sent down .....(up to) the Merciful
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Log kehte hain Abu Huraira bahut zyada riwaayaten batataa hai. Allah jaanta hai main sach kehta hoon ya nahi. Woh yeh bhi puchte hain: "Muhajireen aur Ansaar kyun mere jitni riwaayaten nahi batate?" Asal mein, mere Muhajir bhai bazaar mein tijarat mein masroof rehte the, aur mere Ansaar bhai apni maal mein masroof. Main ek gareeb shaks tha jo Allah ke Rasool ki sohbat mein rehta tha, aur jitna pet bharta utne se santusht ho jata. Isliye main tab maujood hota jab woh (doosre) gair-maujood hote, aur mujhe hadith yaad rehti jab woh bhool jate. Ek din Nabi ne kaha: "Jo bhi apna kapda phailaye jab tak main apni baat khatam na karun, phir usse apni taraf samet le, use woh sab yaad rahega jo main kahunga." Isliye maine apna woh chadar (jo mera akela libaas tha) phailaya, jab tak Nabi ne apni baat khatam nahi ki, phir maine ise apne seene par samet liya. Us zaat ki qasam jisne unhe (Nabi ko) haqq ke saath bheja, tab se lekar aaj tak maine unki us baat ka ek lafz bhi nahi bhoola. Allah ki qasam, agar Allah ki Kitaab mein do ayaat na hoti, main kabhi Nabi ki koi riwayat na batata. (Yeh do ayaat hain): "Beshak! Woh log jo saaf nishaniyon aur hidayat ko chhupate hain jo humne nazil ki hai, ... (aakhir tak) ... Reham karne wala."

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:A tumbler (full of milk or water) was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) who drank from it, while on his right side there was sitting a boy who was the youngest of those who were present and on his left side there were old men. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "O boy, will you allow me to give it (i.e. the rest of the drink) to the old men?" The boy said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I will not give preference to anyone over me to drink the rest of it from which you have drunk." So, the Prophet (ﷺ) gave it to him
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ke paas ek pyala (doodh ya paani se bhara) laaya gaya, jise unhone piya, jabke unke dahine taraf ek ladka baitha tha jo maujood logon mein sabse chhota tha, aur baayi taraf budhe log the. Nabi ne pucha: "Aye ladke! Kya tum mujhe ijazat doge ke main baaki (peene ki cheez) budhe logon ko de dun?" Ladke ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Main kisi ko bhi apni baari se pehle (yeh peene ki cheez pina) nahi dunga, jo aapne piya hai usme se." Isliye Nabi ne woh usi ko de di.

e: Narrated Az-Zuhri:Anas bin Malik said, that once a domestic sheep was milked for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while he was in the house of Anas bin Malik. The milk was mixed with water drawn from the well in Anas's house. A tumbler of it was presented to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who drank from it. Then Abu Bakr was sitting on his left side and a bedouin on his right side. When the Prophet (ﷺ) removed the tumbler from his mouth, `Umar was afraid that the Prophet (ﷺ) might give it to the bedouin, so he said. "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Give it to Abu Bakr who is sitting by your side." But the Prophet (ﷺ) gave it to the bedouin, who was to his right and said, "You should start with the one on your right side
hi: Az-Zuhri bataate hain: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha ke ek baar Allah ke Rasool ke liye ek gharelu bhed ka doodh nikala gaya jabke Aap Anas bin Malik ke ghar mein the. Doodh Anas ke ghar ke kue se nikale gaye paani mein milaya gaya. Ek pyala Allah ke Rasool ko pesh kiya gaya jisme se unhone piya. Phir Abu Bakr unki baayi taraf baithe the aur ek dehati (Bedouin) unki dahini taraf. Jab Nabi ne pyala apne mun se hataya, Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko dar tha ke Nabi use dehati ko de denge, isliye unhone kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Ise Abu Bakr ko dijiye jo aapke bagal mein baithe hain." Magar Nabi ne ise dehati ko de diya, jo unki dahini taraf tha, aur kaha: "Tumhe apni dahini taraf se shuru karna chahiye."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Do not withhold the superfluous water, for that will prevent people from grazing their cattle
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Faaltu paani mat roko, kyunke isse log apni maweshi charane se roke jaayenge."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Do not withhold the superfluous water in order to withhold the superfluous grass
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Faaltu paani na roko taake tum faaltu ghaas rok sako."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "No bloodmoney will be charged if somebody dies in a mine or in a well or is killed by an animal; and if somebody finds a treasure in his land he has to give one-fifth of it to the Government
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Koi khoon-baha (diyat) nahi lagu hoga agar koi khaan mein ya kue mein mar jaaye, ya kisi janwar se maara jaaye; aur agar koi apni zameen mein khazana paaye, use uska paanchvaan hissa Sarkaar (Zakat) ko dena hoga."

e: Narrated `Abdullah (bin Mas`ud):The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever takes a false oath to deprive somebody of his property will meet Allah while He will be angry with him." Allah revealed: 'Verily those who purchase a little gain at the cost of Allah's covenant, and their oaths.' ........(3.77) Al-Ashath came (to the place where `Abdullah was narrating) and said, "What has Abu `Abdur- Rahman (i.e. `Abdullah) been telling you? This verse was revealed concerning me. I had a well in the land of a cousin of mine. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked me to bring witnesses (to confirm my claim). I said, 'I don't have witnesses.' He said, 'Let the defendant take an oath then.' I said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! He will take a (false) oath immediately.' Then the Prophet (ﷺ) mentioned the above narration and Allah revealed the verse to confirm what he had said." (See Hadith No)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) (bin Mas'ud) (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jo koi kisi doosre shaks se uska maal chheenne ke liye jhuti qasam khata hai, woh Allah se aisi haalat mein milega ke woh usse naraaj hoga." Allah ne nazil ki: "Beshak, woh log jo Allah ke ahad aur apni qasmon ke badle mein thoda faaida khareedte hain..." (3:77). Al-Ashath (jahan Abdullah riwaayat suna rahe the wahan) aaye aur kaha: "Abu Abdur-Rahman (yaani Abdullah) tumhe kya bata rahe hain? Yeh ayat mere baare mein nazil hui thi. Mere chachazaad bhai ki zameen mein mera ek kua tha. Nabi ne mujhse gawah laane ko kaha. Maine kaha: 'Mere paas gawah nahi hain.' Aap ne kaha: 'Phir mudda alaih (jispar daawa hai) qasam le.' Maine kaha: 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Woh foran (jhuti) qasam le lega.' Phir Nabi ne yeh upar wali riwaayat batayi aur Allah ne unki baat ki tasdeeq karte huye yeh ayat nazil ki."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "There are three persons whom Allah will not look at on the Day of Resurrection, nor will he purify them and theirs shall be a severe punishment. They are: -1. A man who possessed superfluous water on a way and he withheld it from travelers. -2. A man who gave a pledge of allegiance to a ruler and he gave it only for worldly benefits. If the ruler gives him something he gets satisfied, and if the ruler withholds something from him, he gets dissatisfied. -3. And a man who displayed his goods for sale after the `Asr prayer and he said, 'By Allah, except Whom None has the right to be worshipped, I have been given so much for my goods,' and somebody believes him (and buys them). The Prophet (ﷺ) then recited: "Verily! Those who purchase a little gain at the cost of Allah's Covenant and their oaths
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Teen aise log hain jinki taraf Allah Qiyamat ke din nahi dekhega, na unhe paak karega, aur unke liye sakht saza hai: 1. Woh shaks jiske paas faaltu paani ho aur woh use musafiron se roke. 2. Woh shaks jo kisi hukmaran se bai'at kare sirf duniyawi faayde ke liye. Agar hukmaran usse kuch de, woh santusht ho jataa hai, aur agar hukmaran kuch na de, woh na-khush ho jata hai. 3. Aur woh shaks jo Asr ki namaz ke baad apna maal bikri ke liye pesh kare aur kahe: 'Allah ki qasam jiske siwa koi mabood nahi, mujhe apne maal ke liye itni qeemat mil rahi hai,' aur koi usse vishwas karke (khareed le)." Nabi ne phir yeh padha: "Beshak! Woh log jo Allah ke Ahad aur apni qasmon ke badle mein thoda faaida khareedte hain..."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Az-Zubair:An Ansari man quarreled with Az-Zubair in the presence of the Prophet (ﷺ) about the Harra Canals which were used for irrigating the date-palms. The Ansari man said to Az-Zubair, "Let the water pass' but Az-Zubair refused to do so. So, the case was brought before the Prophet (ﷺ) who said to Az-Zubair, "O Zubair! Irrigate (your land) and then let the water pass to your neighbor." On that the Ansari got angry and said to the Prophet, "Is it because he (i.e. Zubair) is your aunt's son?" On that the color of the face of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) changed (because of anger) and he said, "O Zubair! Irrigate (your land) and then withhold the water till it reaches the walls between the pits round the trees." Zubair said, "By Allah, I think that the following verse was revealed on this occasion": "But no, by your Lord They can have No faith Until they make you judge In all disputes between them
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Ek Ansari shaks ka Az-Zubair se Nabi ke saamne Harra ki nehron ke baare mein jhagda hua jinse khajoor ke darakht sinche jate the. Ansari shaks ne Az-Zubair se kaha: "Paani jaane do," magar Az-Zubair ne inkaar kiya. Isliye maamla Nabi ke paas laaya gaya jinhone Az-Zubair se kaha: "Aye Zubair! (Apni zameen) sincho, phir paani apne padosi ki taraf jaane do." Isspar Ansari naraaj ho gaye aur Nabi se kaha: "Kya isliye ke woh (Zubair) aapki khaala (mausi) ka beta hai?" Isspar Allah ke Rasool ka chehra (gusse se) badal gaya aur unhone kaha: "Aye Zubair! (Apni zameen) sincho, phir paani roko jab tak yeh darakhton ke aas-paas ke gaddhon ki deevaron tak na pahunch jaaye." Zubair ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, mujhe lagta hai yeh ayat isi mouke par nazil hui": "Magar nahi, tumhare Rab ki qasam! Woh momin nahi ho sakte jab tak woh tumhe apne aapasi jhagdon mein faisla karne wala na maanen."

e: Narrated `Urwa:When a man from the Ansar quarreled with Az-Zubair, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Zubair! Irrigate (your land) first and then let the water flow (to the land of the others)." "On that the Ansari said, (to the Prophet), "It is because he is your aunt's son." On that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Zubair! Irrigate till the water reaches the walls between the pits around the trees and then stop (i.e. let the water go to the other's land)." I think the following verse was revealed concerning this event: "But no, by your Lord They can have No faith Until they make you judge In all disputes between them
hi: Urwa bataate hain: Jab ek Ansari shaks ka Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) se jhagda hua, Nabi ne kaha: "Aye Zubair! Pehle (apni zameen) sincho, phir paani (doosron ki zameen ki taraf) jaane do." Isspar Ansari ne (Nabi se) kaha: "Yeh isliye ke woh aapki khaala ka beta hai." Isspar Nabi ne kaha: "Aye Zubair! Sincho jab tak paani darakhton ke aas-paas ke gaddhon ki deewaron tak na pahunch jaaye, phir roko (yaani paani doosre ki zameen mein jaane do)." Mujhe lagta hai yeh ayat isi ghatna ke baare mein nazil hui: "Magar nahi, tumhare Rab ki qasam! Woh momin nahi ho sakte jab tak woh tumhe apne aapasi jhagdon mein faisla karne wala na maanen."

e: Narrated `Urwa bin Az-Zubair:An Ansari man quarreled with Az-Zubair about a canal in the Harra which was used for irrigating date-palms. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), ordering Zubair to be moderate, said, "O Zubair! Irrigate (your land) first and then leave the water for your neighbor." The Ansari said, "Is it because he is your aunt's son?" On that the color of the face of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) changed and he said, "O Zubair! Irrigate (your land) and withhold the water till it reaches the walls that are between the pits around the trees." So, Allah's Apostle gave Zubair his full right. Zubair said, "By Allah, the following verse was revealed in that connection": "But no, by your Lord They can have No faith Until they make you judge In all disputes between them." (4.65) (The sub-narrator,) Ibn Shihab said to Juraij (another sub-narrator), "The Ansar and the other people interpreted the saying of the Prophet, 'Irrigate (your land) and withhold the water till it reaches the walls between the pits around the trees,' as meaning up to the ankles
hi: Urwa bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek Ansari shaks ka Az-Zubair se Harra mein ek nehar ke baare mein jhagda hua jisse khajoor ke darakht sinche jate the. Allah ke Rasool ne, Zubair ko narmi ka hukum dete huye, kaha: "Aye Zubair! Pehle (apni zameen) sincho, phir paani apne padosi ke liye chhod do." Ansari ne kaha: "Yeh isliye ke woh aapki khaala ka beta hai?" Isspar Allah ke Rasool ka chehra badal gaya aur unhone kaha: "Aye Zubair! Sincho aur paani roko jab tak yeh darakhton ke aas-paas ke gaddhon ki deewaron tak na pahunch jaaye." Isliye Allah ke Rasool ne Zubair ko unka poora haqq diya. Zubair ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, yeh ayat isi silsile mein nazil hui": "Magar nahi, tumhare Rab ki qasam! Woh momin nahi ho sakte jab tak woh tumhe apne aapasi jhagdon mein faisla karne wala na maanen" (4:65). Ibn Shihab ne Juraij se kaha: "Ansaar aur doosre logon ne Nabi ki baat 'sincho aur paani roko jab tak yeh darakhton ke aas-paas ke gaddhon ki deewaron tak na pahunch jaaye' ka matlab liya takhno tak."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "While a man was walking he felt thirsty and went down a well and drank water from it. On coming out of it, he saw a dog panting and eating mud because of excessive thirst. The man said, 'This (dog) is suffering from the same problem as that of mine. So he (went down the well), filled his shoe with water, caught hold of it with his teeth and climbed up and watered the dog. Allah thanked him for his (good) deed and forgave him." The people asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Is there a reward for us in serving (the) animals?" He replied, "Yes, there is a reward for serving any animate
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jabke ek shaks chal raha tha, use pyaas lagi aur woh ek kue mein utara aur usme se paani piya. Bahar aakar, usne ek kutta dekha jo haafte hue mitti kha raha tha bahut zyada pyaas ki wajah se. Shaks ne kaha: 'Yeh (kutta) usi museebat mein hai jismein main tha.' Isliye woh (kue mein wapas gaya), apni juti mein paani bhara, use daanton mein pakadkar chadha, aur kutte ko paani pilaya. Allah ne uske is (neik) amal ke liye uska shukriya ada kiya aur use maaf kar diya." Logon ne pucha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Kya janwaron ki khidmat karne ka humein bhi ajr milta hai?" Aap ne jawab diya: "Haan, kisi bhi zinda mahluk ki khidmat karne ka ajr milta hai."

e: Narrated Asma' bint Abi Bakr:The Prophet (ﷺ) prayed the eclipse prayer, and then said, "Hell was displayed so close that I said, 'O my Lord ! Am I going to be one of its inhabitants?"' Suddenly he saw a woman. I think he said, who was being scratched by a cat. He said, "What is wrong with her?" He was told, "She had imprisoned it (i.e. the cat) till it died of hunger
hi: Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Abi Bakr (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi ne suraj grahan ki namaz padhi, phir kaha: "Dozakh mujhe itni qareeb dikhaee gayi ke maine kaha, 'Aye mere Rab! Kya main iske bashindon mein se ek hounga?'" Achanak Aap ne ek aurat dekhi. Mujhe lagta hai unhone kaha, use ek billi nochne (kharaash karne) wali thi. Aap ne pucha: "Iska kya haal hai?" Unhe bataya gaya: "Isne (billi ko) qaid kiya jab tak woh bhookh se mar nahi gayi."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "A woman was tortured and was put in Hell because of a cat which she had kept locked till it died of hunger." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) further said, (Allah knows better) Allah said (to the woman), 'You neither fed it nor watered when you locked it up, nor did you set it free to eat the vermin of the earth
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Ek aurat ko yaatna di gayi aur usse Dozakh mein daala gaya, ek billi ki wajah se jise usne band karke rakha jab tak woh bhookh se mar nahi gayi." Allah ke Rasool ne aage kaha: (Allah behtar jaanta hai) Allah ne (us aurat se) kaha: "Tumne na ise khana diya na paani jab tumne ise band kiya, na hi tumne ise azaad kiya ke woh zameen ke keede-makode kha sake."

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:Once a tumbler (full of milk or water) was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who drank from it, while on his right side there was sitting a boy who was the youngest of those who were present, and on his left side there were old men. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "O boy ! Do you allow me to give (the drink) to the elder people (first)?" The boy said, "I will not prefer anybody to have my share from you, O Allah's Apostle!" So, he gave it to the boy
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Allah ke Rasool ke paas ek pyala (doodh ya paani se bhara) laaya gaya jise unhone piya, jabke unke dahine taraf ek ladka baitha tha jo maujood logon mein sabse chhota tha, aur baayi taraf budhe log the. Nabi ne pucha: "Aye ladke! Kya tum mujhe ijazat doge ke main (peene ki cheez) budhe logon ko (pehle) dun?" Ladke ne kaha: "Main kisi ko bhi apni baari se pehle nahi dunga, Ya Allah ke Rasool!" Isliye Aap ne woh ladke ko de di.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "By Him in Whose Hands my soul is, I will drive some people out from my (sacred) Fount on the Day of Resurrection as strange camels are expelled from a private trough
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Us zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, main Qiyamat ke din kuch logon ko apne (muqaddas) Haud se hankakar nikal dunga jaise ajnabi unt kisi private hod se nikale jate hain."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "May Allah be merciful to the mother of Ishmael! If she had left the water of Zamzam (fountain) as it was, (without constructing a basin for keeping the water), (or said, "If she had not taken handfuls of its water"), it would have been a flowing stream. Jurhum (an Arab tribe) came and asked her, 'May we settle at your dwelling?' She said, 'Yes, but you have no right to possess the water.' They agreed
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Allah Ismail ki maa (Hajra) par reham kare! Agar unhone Zamzam ka paani apni asli haalat mein (bina paani rokne ki koshish kiye) chhod diya hota, (ya kaha: "Agar unhone iska paani mutthiyon mein na liya hota"), yeh ek behta hua sarita ban gaya hota. Jurhum qabile ne unke paas aakar pucha: 'Kya hum aapke rehne ki jagah par bas saken?' Unhone kaha: 'Haan, magar tumhe paani par koi haqq nahi hoga.' Woh raazi ho gaye."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There are three types of people whom Allah will neither talk to, nor look at, on the Day of Resurrection. (They are): -1. A man who takes an oath falsely that he has been offered for his goods so much more than what he is given, -2. a man who takes a false oath after the `Asr prayer in order to grab a Muslim's property, and -3. a man who withholds his superfluous water. Allah will say to him, "Today I will withhold My Grace from you as you withheld the superfluity of what you had not created
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Teen qisam ke log hain jinse Allah Qiyamat ke din na baat karega, na unki taraf dekhega. (Woh hain): 1. Woh shaks jo jhuti qasam khata hai ke usse apne maal ke liye jitna diya gaya usse zyada pesh kiya gaya. 2. Woh shaks jo Asr ki namaz ke baad kisi Musalman ki maal hasil karne ke liye jhuti qasam khata hai. 3. Aur woh shaks jo apna faaltu paani rokta hai. Allah usse kahega: 'Aaj main tumse apni rahmat rokunga jaise tumne woh faaltu cheez roki jise tumne paida nahi kiya tha.'"

e: Narrated As-Sab bin Jath-thama:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, No Hima except for Allah and His Apostle. We have been told that Allah's Apostle made a place called An-Naqi' as Hima, and `Umar made As-Saraf and Ar-Rabadha Hima (for grazing the animals of Zakat)
hi: As-Sab bin Jath-thama (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Koi Hima (khaas charagaah, jahan kisi ki bhi bhedon ko charne ki mumaniat ho) nahi siwaye Allah aur uske Rasool ke liye." Humein bataya gaya ke Allah ke Rasool ne An-Naqi naam ki jagah ko Hima banaya, aur Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne As-Saraf aur Ar-Rabadha ko Hima banaya (Zakat ke janwaron ko charane ke liye).

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Keeping horses may be a source of reward to some (man), a shelter to another (i.e. means of earning one's living), or a burden to a third. He to whom the horse will be a source of reward is the one who keeps it in Allah's Cause (prepare it for holy battles) and ties it by a long rope in a pasture (or a garden). He will get a reward equal to what its long rope allows it to eat in the pasture or the garden, and if that horse breaks its rope and crosses one or two hills, then all its footsteps and its dung will be counted as good deeds for its owner; and if it passes by a river and drinks from it, then that will also be regarded as a good deed for its owner even if he has had no intention of watering it then. Horses are a shelter from poverty to the second person who keeps horses for earning his living so as not to ask others, and at the same time he gives Allah's right (i.e. Zak`at) (from the wealth he earns through using them in trading etc.,) and does not overburden them. He who keeps horses just out of pride and for showing off and as a means of harming the Muslims, his horses will be a source of sins to him." When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked about donkeys, he replied, "Nothing particular was revealed to me regarding them except the general unique verse which is applicable to everything: "Whoever does goodness equal to the weight of an atom (or small ant) shall see it (its reward) on the Day of Resurrection
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Ghode paalna kisi ke liye ajr ka zariya ho sakta hai, kisi doosre ke liye rozi ka zariya, aur teesre ke liye ek bojh. Woh shaks jiske liye ghoda ajr ka zariya hoga, woh hai jo use Allah ki raah mein palta hai (Jihad ke liye taiyaar karta hai) aur ek lambi rassi se ek charagaah (ya baag) mein baandhta hai. Use woh utna ajr milega jitna uski rassi ki lambaee se woh charagaah ya baag mein kha sakta hai, aur agar woh ghoda apni rassi todkar ek ya do tibbe paar kar jaaye, to uske sab kadam aur uski lad uske maalik ke liye neik amal mane jaayenge; aur agar woh kisi nadi ke paas se guzre aur usme se pi le, to yeh bhi maalik ke liye ek neik amal maana jaayega chahe use us waqt use paani pilane ki niyyat na thi. Ghode gareebi se panah hain doosre shaks ke liye jo apni rozi kamane ke liye ghode rakhta hai taake use doosron se maangna na pade, aur usi waqt Allah ka haqq (yaani Zakat) (us daulat se jo woh unse tijarat waghera mein kamata hai) ada karta hai aur unpar zyada bojh nahi daalta. Woh shaks jo ghode sirf ghamand aur dikhaave ke liye rakhta hai aur Musalmanon ko nuqsaan pahunchane ke liye, uske ghode uske liye gunah ka zariya honge." Jab Allah ke Rasool se gadhon ke baare mein pucha gaya, unhone jawab diya: "Mujh par unke baare mein khaas kuch nazil nahi hua siwaye us aam, benazir ayat ke jo har cheez par lagu hoti hai: 'Jo bhi zare-baraabar neki karega, use (uska ajr) Qiyamat ke din dikhaee dega.'"

e: Narrated Zaid bin Khalid:A man came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and asked about Al-Luqata (a fallen thing). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Recognize its container and its tying material and then make a public announcement about it for one year and if its owner shows up, give it to him; otherwise use it as you like." The man said, "What about a lost sheep?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It is for you, your brother or the wolf." The man said "What about a lost camel?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Why should you take it as it has got its water-container (its stomach) and its hooves and it can reach the places of water and can eat the trees till its owner finds it?
hi: Zaid bin Khalid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks Allah ke Rasool ke paas aaya aur unse Al-Luqata (giri hui cheez) ke baare mein pucha. Nabi ne kaha: "Uske bartan aur uski baandhne wali cheez ko pehchaan lo, phir ek saal tak isse public elaan karo, aur agar uska maalik zaahir ho jaaye, use de do; warna use apni marzi se istemal karo." Shaks ne pucha: "Ek gum-shuda bhed ke baare mein kya?" Nabi ne kaha: "Yeh tumhare liye hai, tumhare bhai ke liye, ya bhediye ke liye." Shaks ne pucha: "Ek gum-shuda unt ke baare mein kya?" Nabi ne kaha: "Ise kyun loge jabke iske paas apna paani ka bartaan (yaani uska pet) hai, aur iske khur hain, aur yeh paani ki jagahon tak pahunch sakta hai aur darakht kha sakta hai jab tak iska maalik ise na paa le?"

e: Narrated Az-Zubair bin Al 'Awwam:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No doubt, one had better take a rope (and cut) and tie a bundle of wood and sell it whereby Allah will keep his face away (from Hell-fire) rather than ask others who may give him or not
hi: Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Awwam (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Beshak, kisi ke liye behtar hai ke woh ek rassi le (aur kaat kar) lakdi ka gathar baandhe aur bech de, jisse Allah uska chehra (Dozakh se) bacha lega, bajaye is ke ke woh doosron se maange jo use de ya na de."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "No doubt, you had better gather a bundle of wood and carry it on your back (and earn your living thereby) rather than ask somebody who may give you or not
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Beshak, tumhare liye behtar hai ke tum lakdi ka gathar jama karo aur ise apni pusht par le jaao (aur ise bech kar apni rozi kamao), bajaye is ke ke tum kisi se maango jo tumhe de ya na de."

e: Narrated Husain bin `Ali:`Ali bin Abi Talib said: "I got a she-camel as my share of the war booty on the day (of the battle) of Badr, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave me another she-camel. I let both of them kneel at the door of one of the Ansar, intending to carry Idhkhir on them to sell it and use its price for my wedding banquet on marrying Fatima. A goldsmith from Bani Qainqa' was with me. Hamza bin `Abdul-Muttalib was in that house drinking wine and a lady singer was reciting: "O Hamza! (Kill) the (two) fat old she camels (and serve them to your guests). So Hamza took his sword and went towards the two she-camels and cut off their humps and opened their flanks and took a part of their livers." (I said to Ibn Shihab, "Did he take part of the humps?" He replied, "He cut off their humps and carried them away.") `Ali further said, "When I saw that dreadful sight, I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and told him the news. The Prophet (ﷺ) came out in the company of Zaid bin Haritha who was with him then, and I too went with them. He went to Hamza and spoke harshly to him. Hamza looked up and said, 'Aren't you only the slaves of my forefathers?' The Prophet (ﷺ) retreated and went out. This incident happened before the prohibition of drinking
hi: Husain bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: "Badr ki jung ke din, maal-e-ghanimat mein se mera hissa ek untni thi, aur Allah ke Rasool ne mujhe ek aur untni di. Maine donon ko Ansaar ke ek ghar ke darwaze par bithaya, iraada karte huye ke unpar Idhkhir (jhaadi) ladkar bechunga aur uski qeemat se Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ke saath meri shaadi ki dawat ka intezaam karunga. Bani Qainuqa qabile ka ek sunaar mere saath tha. Hamza bin Abdul-Muttalib usi ghar mein sharaab pi rahe the, aur ek gaane wali aurat gaa rahi thi: 'Aye Hamza! (Qatl karo) moti budhi untniyon ko (aur unhe apne mehmaanon ko pesh karo).' Isliye Hamza ne apni talwar li aur donon untniyon ki taraf gaye aur unke kohaano (hump) kaat diye aur unke pehluon ko chirkar unke jigar ka kuch hissa nikal liya." (Maine Ibn Shihab se pucha: "Kya unhone kohaano ka hissa liya?" Unhone jawab diya: "Unhone kohaano ko kaata aur le gaye.") Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne aage kaha: "Jab maine yeh khaufnaak manzar dekha, main Nabi ke paas gaya aur unhe yeh khabar batai. Nabi Zaid bin Haritha ke saath bahar aaye, jo us waqt unke saath the, aur main bhi unke saath gaya. Woh Hamza ke paas gaye aur unse sakhti se baat ki. Hamza ne oopar dekha aur kaha: 'Kya tum sab mere pura-khon ke gulaam nahi ho?' Nabi peeche hat gaye aur bahar chale gaye. Yeh waqia sharaab ke haraam hone se pehle hua tha."

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) decided to grant a portion of (the uncultivated land of) Bahrain to the Ansar. The Ansar said, "(We will not accept it) till you give a similar portion to our emigrant brothers (from Quraish)." He said, "(O Ansar!) You will soon see people giving preference to others, so remain patient till you meet me (on the Day of Resurrection)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Bahrain ki (na-abaad) zameen ka ek hissa Ansaar ko dene ka faisla kiya. Ansaar ne kaha: "(Hum ise qubool nahi karenge) jab tak aap humare Muhajir bhaion (Quraish se) ko bhi utna hi hissa na dein." Nabi ne kaha: "(Aye Ansaar!) Tum jald hi dekhoge ke log doosron ko tarjih dete hain, isliye Sabr karo jab tak tum mujhse (Qiyamat ke din) na milo."

e: Narrated Anas (ra):The Prophet (ﷺ) called the Ansar so as to grant them a portion of (the land of) Bahrain. They said, "O Allah's Messenger ! If you grant this to us, write a similar document on our Quraish (emigrant) brothers." But the Prophet (ﷺ) did not have enough grants and he said: "After me you will see the people giving preference (to others), so be patient till you meet me
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Ansaar ko bulaya taake unhe Bahrain (ki zameen) ka ek hissa den. Unhone kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Agar aap yeh humein den, humare Quraish (Muhajir) bhaion ke liye bhi isi jaisi dastavez likhiye." Magar Nabi ke paas dene ke liye kaafi nahi tha aur unhone kaha: "Mere baad tum dekhoge ke log doosron ko tarjih denge, isliye sabr karo jab tak tum mujhse (Qiyamat ke din) na milo."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "One of the rights of a she camel is that it should be milked at a place of water
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Untni ke haqqon mein se ek yeh hai ke uska doodh paani ki jagah par nikala jaaye."

e: Narrated 'Abdullah (ra): I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say, "If somebody buys date-palms after they have been pollinated, the fruits will belong to the seller unless the buyer stipulates the contrary. If somebody buys a slave having some property, the property will belong to the seller unless the buyer stipulate that it should belong to him
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool ko farmate suna: "Agar koi khajoor ke darakht unke pollinated hone ke baad khareedta hai, phal bechne wale ke honge siwaye jab khareedar iske ulta shart rakhe. Agar koi maal wala gulaam khareedta hai, maal bechne wale ka hoga siwaye jab khareedar shart rakhe ke woh uska hoga."

e: Narrated Zaid bin Thabit:The Prophet (ﷺ) permitted selling the dates of the 'Araya for ready dates by estimating the amount of the former (as they are still on the trees)
hi: Zaid bin Thabit (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Araya ki khajoor ko naapi hui khajoor ke badle andaza lagakar bechne ki ijazat di (jabke woh abhi darakhton par hain).

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the sales called Al-Mukhabara, Al-Muhaqala and Al-Muzabana and the selling of fruits till they are free from blights. He forbade the selling of the fruits except for money, except the 'Araya
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Al-Mukhabara, Al-Muhaqala, aur Al-Muzabana ki bikri se mana kiya, aur phalon ko bechne se mana kiya jab tak woh bimari se mehfooz na ho jaaye. Aap ne phalon ko sirf paisa (Dinar-Dirham) ke ilawa kisi cheez se bechne se mana kiya, siwaye Araya ke.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) allowed the sale of the dates of the 'Araya for ready dates by estimating the former which should be estimated as less than five Awsuq or five Awsuq. (Dawud, the sub-narrator is not sure as to the right amount)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Araya ki khajoor ko naapi hui khajoor ke badle andaza lagakar bechne ki ijazat di, magar sirf paanch Awsuq se kam ya paanch Awsuq ke barabar maqdaar tak. (Dawud, doosre raawi ko theek maqdaar par yaqeen nahi.)

e: Narrated Rafi` 'bin Khadij and Sahl bin Abi Hathma:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the sale of Muzabana, i.e. selling of fruits for fruits, except in the case of 'Araya; he allowed the owners of 'Araya such kind of sale
hi: Rafi bin Khadij (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Sahl bin Abi Hathma bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Muzabana ki bikri se mana kiya, yaani phal ko phal ke badle bechna, siwaye Araya ke maamle mein; unhone Araya ke maalikon ko yeh bikri karne ki ijazat di.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:While I was in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) in one of his Ghazawat, he asked, "What is wrong with your camel? Will you sell it?" I replied in the affirmative and sold it to him. When he reached Medina, I took the camel to him in the morning and he paid me its price
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jabke main Nabi ke saath unke ek Ghazwa mein tha, unhone pucha: "Tumhare unt ko kya hua? Kya tum ise bechoge?" Maine haan mein jawab diya aur ise unhe becha. Jab woh Madina pahunche, main subah unt unke paas laaya aur unhone mujhe uski qeemat ada ki.

e: Narrated Al-A`mash:When we were with Ibrahim, we talked about mortgaging in deals of Salam. Ibrahim narrated from Aswad that `Aisha had said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) bought some foodstuff on credit from a Jew and mortgaged an iron armor to him
hi: Al-A'mash bataate hain: Jab hum Ibrahim ke saath the, humne Salam ke saudo mein girvi rakhne ke baare mein baat ki. Ibrahim ne Aswad se riwaayat ki ke Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha: "Nabi ne ek Yahudi se udhaar par kuch khaane ki cheez khareedi aur apna lohe ka zire uske paas girvi rakha."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever takes the money of the people with the intention of repaying it, Allah will repay it on his behalf, and whoever takes it in order to spoil it, then Allah will spoil him
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jo koi logon ka paisa isi niyyat se leta hai ke woh use wapas karega, Allah uski taraf se ada kar dega, aur jo isse barbaad karne ki niyyat se leta hai, Allah use barbaad kar dega."

e: Narrated Abu Dhar:Once, while I was in the company of the Prophet, he saw the mountain of Uhud and said, "I would not like to have this mountain turned into gold for me unless nothing of it, not even a single Dinar remains of it with me for more than three days (i.e. I will spend all of it in Allah's Cause), except that Dinar which I will keep for repaying debts." Then he said, "Those who are rich in this world would have little reward in the Hereafter except those who spend their money here and there (in Allah's Cause), and they are few in number." Then he ordered me to stay at my place and went not far away. I heard a voice and intended to go to him but I remembered his order, "Stay at your place till I return." On his return I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! (What was) that noise which I heard?" He said, "Did you hear anything?" I said, "Yes." He said, "Gabriel came and said to me, 'Whoever amongst your followers dies, worshipping none along with Allah, will enter Paradise.' " I said, "Even if he did such-and-such things (i.e. even if he stole or committed illegal sexual intercourse)" He said, "Yes
hi: Abu Dharr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar, jabke main Nabi ki sohbat mein tha, unhone Uhud pahad dekha aur kaha: "Mujhe pasand nahi ke yeh pahad mere liye sone mein badal jaaye siwaye is ke ke usme se ek Dinar bhi teen din se zyada mere paas na rahe (yaani main sab Allah ki raah mein kharch kar dun), siwaye us Dinar ke jo main qarz ada karne ke liye rakhunga." Phir unhone kaha: "Jo is duniya mein maldaar hain unhe Aakhirat mein bahut kam ajr milega, siwaye un logon ke jo apna paisa yahan-wahan (Allah ki raah mein) kharch karte hain, aur woh (log) kam hain." Phir unhone mujhe apni jagah rukne ka hukum diya aur zyada door nahi gaye. Maine ek aawaaz suni aur unke paas jaane ka iraada kiya magar mujhe unka hukum yaad aaya: "Apni jagah rukna jab tak main wapas na aaun." Unki wapasi par maine kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! (Kya thi) woh awaaz jo maine suni?" Unhone kaha: "Kya tumne kuch suna?" Maine haan mein jawab diya. Unhone kaha: "Jibreel aaye aur mujhse kaha: 'Jo bhi tumhare pairokaron mein se mare, Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek kiye bina, woh Jannat mein daakhil hoga.'" Maine kaha: "Chahe usne aisa-aisa (bura) kiya ho (yaani chori ya zina)?" Unhone kaha: "Haan."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If I had gold equal to the mountain of Uhud, it would not please me that it should remain with me for more than three days, except an amount which I would keep for repaying debts
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Agar mere paas Uhud pahad jitna sona hota, mujhe pasand nahi ke woh teen din se zyada mere paas rahe, siwaye us maqdaar ke jo main qarz ada karne ke liye rakhunga."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:A man demanded his debts from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in such a rude manner that the companions of the Prophet intended to harm him, but the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Leave him, no doubt, for he (the creditor) has the right to demand it (harshly). Buy a camel and give it to him." They said, "The camel that is available is older than the camel he demands. "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Buy it and give it to him, for the best among you are those who repay their debts handsomely
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks ne Allah ke Rasool se apna qarz itne be-adabi se maanga ke Nabi ke sahaba use nuqsaan pahunchana chahte the, magar Nabi ne kaha: "Use chhod do, beshak usse (qarz-data se) haqq hai isse (sakhti se) maangne ka. Ek unt khareedo aur use de do." Unhone kaha: "Jo unt maujood hai woh uski maangi gayi umr se bada hai." Nabi ne kaha: "Ise khareedo aur de do, kyunke tum mein sabse behtar woh hai jo apna qarz behtareen tareeke se chukate hain."

e: Narrated Hudhaifa:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Once a man died and was asked, 'What did you use to say (or do) (in your life time)?' He replied, 'I was a businessman and used to give time to the rich to repay his debt and (used to) deduct part of the debt of the poor.' So he was forgiven (his sins.)" Abu Mas`ud said, "I heard the same (Hadith) from the Prophet
hi: Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi ko farmate suna: "Ek baar ek shaks mar gaya aur usse pucha gaya: 'Tum kya kehte (ya karte) the (apni zindagi mein)?' Usne jawab diya: 'Main ek vyapaari tha aur maldaar ko apna qarz chukane ke liye waqt deta tha, aur gareeb ke qarz ka kuch hissa maaf kar deta tha.' Isliye usse maaf kar diya gaya (uske gunah)." Abu Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Maine yehi (hadith) Nabi se suni."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and demanded a camel (the Prophet (ﷺ) owed him). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) told his companions to give him (a camel). They said, "We do not find except an older camel (than what he demands). (The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered them to give him that camel). The man said, "You have paid me in full and may Allah also pay you in full." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Give him, for the best amongst the people is he who repays his debts in the most handsome manner
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks Nabi ke paas aaya aur ek unt maanga (jo Nabi par qarz tha). Allah ke Rasool ne apne sahaba se ise (unt) dene ko kaha. Unhone kaha: "Humein sirf ek bada unt milta hai (jo isse bada hai jo usne maanga)." (Nabi ne unhe woh unt dene ka hukum diya.) Shaks ne kaha: "Aapne mujhe poora ada kiya, aur Allah aapko bhi poora ada kare." Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: "Ise do, kyunke logon mein sabse behtar woh hai jo apna qarz sabse behtareen tareeke se chukata hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) owed a camel of a certain age to a man who came to demand it back. The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered his companions to give him. They looked for a camel of the same age but found nothing but a camel one year older. The Prophet (ﷺ) told them to give it to him. The man said, "You have paid me in full, and may Allah pay you in full." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The best amongst you is he who pays his debts in the most handsome manner
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi par kisi ka ek khaas umr ka unt qarz tha, jo use wapas maangne aaya. Nabi ne apne sahaba ko ise dene ka hukum diya. Unhone usi umr ka unt dhoonda magar unhe koi nahi mila siwaye ek unt ke jo ek saal bada tha. Nabi ne unhe use de dene ko kaha. Shaks ne kaha: "Aapne mujhe poora ada kiya, aur Allah aapko poora ada kare." Nabi ne kaha: "Tum mein sabse behtar woh hai jo apna qarz sabse behtareen tareeke se chukata hai."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was in the Mosque. (Mis`ar thinks that Jabir went in the forenoon.) After the Prophet (ﷺ) told me to pray two rak`at, he repaid me the debt he owed me and gave me an extra amount
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Nabi ke paas gaya jabke woh masjid mein the. (Misar ko lagta hai Jabir dopahar se pehle gaye.) Nabi ne mujhe do rakat padhne ko kaha, phir unhone mujhe jo qarz dena tha woh ada kiya aur kuch izafa bhi diya.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:My father was martyred on the day (of the battle) of Uhud, and he was in debt. His creditors demanded their rights persistently. I went to the Prophet (and informed him about it). He told them to take the fruits of my garden and exempt my father from the debts but they refused to do so. So, the Prophet did not give them my garden and told me that he would come to me the next morning. He came to us early in the morning and wandered among the date-palms and invoked Allah to bless their fruits. I then plucked the dates and paid the creditors, and there remained some of the dates for us
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Mere waalid Uhud ki jung ke din shaheed hue aur unpar qarz tha. Unke qarz-daaon ne apna haqq sakhti se maanga. Main Nabi ke paas gaya (aur unhe iske baare mein bataya). Unhone unhe (qarz-daaon ko) mere baag ke phal lene aur mere waalid ko qarz se azaad karne ko kaha, magar unhone aisa karne se inkaar kiya. Isliye Nabi ne mera baag unhe nahi diya aur mujhe bataya ke woh agli subah mere paas aayenge. Woh savere aaye aur khajoor ke darakhton mein ghume aur unke phalon ke liye Allah se barkat maangi. Phir maine khajoor kati aur qarz-daaon ko ada kiya, aur kuch khajoor humare paas bhi bacha reh gayi.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:When my father died he owed a Jew thirty Awsuq (of dates). I requested him to give me respite for repaying but he refused. I requested Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to intercede with the Jew. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went to the Jew and asked him to accept the fruits of my trees in place of the debt but the Jew refused. Allah's Apostle entered the garden of the date-palms, wandering among the trees and ordered me (saying), "Pluck (the fruits) and give him his due." So, I plucked the fruits for him after the departure of Allah's Apostle and gave his thirty Awsuq, and still had seventeen Awsuq extra for myself. Jabir said: I went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to inform of what had happened, but found him praying the `Asr prayer. After the prayer I told him about the extra fruits which remained. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) told me to inform (`Umar) Ibn Al-Khattab about it. When I went to `Umar and told him about it, `Umar said, "When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) walked in your garden, I was sure that Allah would definitely bless it
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab mere waalid ka intiqal hua, unpar ek Yahudi ka teen Wasq (khajoor) ka qarz tha. Maine usse mohlat maangi qarz chukane ke liye magar usne inkaar kiya. Maine Allah ke Rasool se guzarish ki ke woh Yahudi se sifarish karein. Allah ke Rasool Yahudi ke paas gaye aur unse guzarish ki ke woh qarz ke badle mere darakhton ke phal qubool kare magar Yahudi ne inkaar kiya. Allah ke Rasool khajoor ke baag mein daakhil hue, darakhton mein ghume, aur mujhe hukum diya (kehte huye), "Phal kaato aur usse uska haqq ada karo." Isliye maine Allah ke Rasool ke jaane ke baad uske liye phal kate aur uska teen Wasq ada kiya, aur mere paas apne liye satrah Wasq bhi bach gaye. Jabir ne kaha: Main Allah ke Rasool ke paas gaya taake unhe yeh khabar dun, magar unhe Asr ki namaz padhte paaya. Namaz ke baad maine unhe bacha hua phal ke baare mein bataya. Allah ke Rasool ne mujhse kaha ke main (Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ)) Ibn Al-Khattab ko iske baare mein bataun. Jab main Umar ke paas gaya aur unhe bataya, Umar ne kaha: "Jab Allah ke Rasool tumhare baag mein chale, mujhe yaqeen tha Allah zaroor isme barkat dega."

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to invoke Allah in the prayer saying, "O Allah, I seek refuge with you from all sins, and from being in debt." Someone said, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! (I see) very often you seek refuge with Allah from being in debt. He replied, "If a person is in debt, he tells lies when he speaks, and breaks his promises when he promises
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool namaz mein Allah se dua karte the: "Aye Allah! Main tujhse sab gunahon se aur qarzdaar hone se panah maangta hoon." Kisi ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! (Main dekhta hoon) aap aksar qarzdaar hone se Allah ki panah maangte hain." Aap ne jawab diya: "Agar koi qarzdaar hai, woh baat karte waqt jhoot bolta hai, aur waada karke todta hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If someone leaves some property, it will be for the inheritors, and if he leaves some weak offspring, it will be for us to support them
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Agar koi kuch maal chhod jaaye, woh waarison ke liye hogi, aur agar koi kamzor aulad chhod jaaye, unhe sambhalna humara zimma hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I am closer to the believers than their selves in this world and in the Hereafter, and if you like, you can read Allah's Statement: "The Prophet (ﷺ) is closer to the believers than their own selves." (33.6) So, if a true believer dies and leaves behind some property, it will be for his inheritors (from the father's side), and if he leaves behind some debt to be paid or needy offspring, then they should come to me as I am the guardian of the deceased
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Main momino ke sabse zyada nazdeek hoon unke apne aap se, is duniya mein aur Aakhirat mein, aur agar tum chaho, Allah ka farmaan padh sakte ho: 'Nabi momino ke apne aap se zyada nazdeek hain' (33:6). Isliye agar koi sacha momin mar jaaye aur kuch maal chhod jaaye, woh uske waarison (baap ki taraf se) ke liye hogi, aur agar woh koi qarz chhod jaaye jo chukana hai ya zaroorat-mand aulad chhod jaaye, to unhe mere paas aana chahiye, kyunke main marhoom ka sarparast hoon."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Procrastination (delay) in repaying debts by a wealthy person is injustice
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Maldaar shaks ka qarz chukane mein taalamatol karna zulm hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and demanded his debts and used harsh words. The companions of the Prophet wanted to harm him, but the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Leave him, as the creditor (owner of the right) has the right to speak
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks Nabi ke paas aaya aur apna qarz maanga aur be-adabi se pesh aaya. Nabi ke sahaba use nuqsaan pahunchana chahte the, magar Nabi ne kaha: "Use chhod do, kyunke qarz-data (yaani haqq wale) ko bolne ka haqq hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If a man finds his very things with a bankrupt, he has more right to take them back than anyone else
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Agar koi apni asal cheez kisi divaal (bankrupt) shaks ke paas paata hai, use use wapas lene ka haqq doosron se zyada hai."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:A man pledged that his slave would be manumitted after his death. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "Who will buy the slave from me?" Nu'aim bin `Abdullah bought the slave and the Prophet (ﷺ) took its price and gave it to the owner
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks ne apne gulaam ko apni maut ke baad azaad hone ka waada kiya. Nabi ne pucha: "Kaun mujhse yeh gulaam khareedega?" Nu'aim bin Abdullah ne gulaam khareeda aur Nabi ne uski qeemat lekar maalik ko de di.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah (ra):Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) mentioned an Israeli man who asked another Israeli to lend him money, and the latter gave it to him for a fixed period. (Abu Hurairah mentioned the rest of narration) [See chapter: Kafala in loans and debts. Hadith]
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne ek Bani Israel ke shaks ka zikar kiya jisne doosre se paisa maanga, aur usne muqarrar muddat ke liye diya. (Abu Huraira ne baaki riwaayat batayi jaisa Kafalah adhyaay mein aa chuka hai.)

e: Narrated Jabir:When `Abdullah (my father) died, he left behind children and debts. I asked the lenders to put down some of his debt, but they refused, so I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) to intercede with them, yet they refused. The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to me), "Classify your dates into their different kinds: 'Adha bin Zaid, Lean and 'Ajwa, each kind alone and call all the creditors and wait till I come to you." I did so and the Prophet (ﷺ) came and sat beside the dates and started measuring to each his due till he paid them fully, and the amount of dates remained as it was before, as if he had not touched them. (On another occasion) I took part in one of Ghazawat along with the Prophet (ﷺ) and I was riding one of our camels. The camel got tired and was lagging behind the others. The Prophet (ﷺ) hit it on its back. He said, "Sell it to me, and you have the right to ride it till Medina.'' When we approached Medina, I took the permission from the Prophet (ﷺ) to go to my house, saying, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have newly married." The Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "Have you married a virgin or a matron (a widow or divorcee)?" I said, "I have married a matron, as `Abdullah (my father) died and left behind daughters small in their ages, so I married a matron who may teach them and bring them up with good manners." The Prophet (ﷺ) then said (to me), "Go to your family." When I went there and told my maternal uncle about the selling of the camel, he admonished me for it. On that I told him about its slowness and exhaustion and about what the Prophet (ﷺ) had done to the camel and his hitting it. When the Prophet (ﷺ) arrived, I went to him with the camel in the morning and he gave me its price, the camel itself, and my share from the war booty as he gave the other people
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) (mere waalid) ka intiqal hua, unhone bachche aur qarz chhod diya. Maine qarz dene walon se kuch kami karne ki guzarish ki magar unhone inkaar kiya, isliye main Nabi ke paas gaya ke woh unse sifarish karen, magar unhone phir bhi inkaar kiya. Nabi ne kaha: "Apni khajoor ko unki alag-alag qismon mein taqseem karo: 'Adha bin Zaid, patli aur Ajwa, har qisam alag, aur sab qarz-daaon ko bulao aur mera intezar karo jab tak main na aaun." Maine aisa kiya aur Nabi aaye aur khajoor ke bagal mein baithe aur har ek ka haqq naap na shuru kiya jab tak unhe poora ada nahi kiya, aur khajoor ki maqdaar waisi hi rahi jaise pehle thi, jaise unhone use chhoa hi nahi. (Ek doosre mouke par) main Nabi ke saath ek Ghazwa mein gaya aur main humare unton mein se ek par sawar tha. Unt thak gaya aur doosron se peeche rah gaya. Nabi ne uski pusht par maara. Unhone kaha: "Ise mujhe becho, aur tumhe Madina tak ispar sawar rahne ka haqq hoga." Jab hum Madina ke qareeb pahunche, maine Nabi se apne ghar jaane ki ijazat maangi, yeh kehte huye: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Meri nayi shaadi hui hai." Nabi ne pucha: "Kya tumne kunwari se shaadi ki ya biwah se?" Maine kaha: "Maine ek biwah se shaadi ki, kyunke Abdullah (mere waalid) ka intiqal ho gaya aur unhone chhoti betiyaan chhodi, isliye maine ek biwah se shaadi ki jo unhe sikha sake aur achhe adab ke saath badha sake." Nabi ne (mujhse) kaha: "Apne pariwara ke paas jaao." Jab main wahan gaya aur apne maama ko unt bechne ke baare mein bataya, unhone mujhe danta. Isspar maine unhe uski dheemi raftaar aur thakaavat ke baare mein bataya, aur Nabi ne unt ke saath kya kiya aur unke maarne ke baare mein bhi. Jab Nabi aaye, main subah unt lekar unke paas gaya aur unhone mujhe uski qeemat, khud unt, aur maal-e-ghanimat mein se mera hissa diya, jaisa unhone doosron ko diya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "I am often betrayed in bargaining." The Prophet (ﷺ) advised him, "When you buy something, say (to the seller), 'No deception." The man used to say so afterwards
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Ek shaks Nabi ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Main aksar saudebaazi mein dhoka khata hoon." Nabi ne unhe naseehat di: "Jab tum kuch khareedo, (bechne wale se) kaho: 'Koi dhoka nahi.'" Shaks baad mein aisa kehta reha.

e: Narrated Al-Mughira bin Shu`ba:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah has forbidden for you, (1) to be undutiful to your mothers, (2) to bury your daughters alive, (3) to not to pay the rights of the others (e.g. charity, etc.) and (4) to beg of men (begging). And Allah has hated for you (1) vain, useless talk, or that you talk too much about others, (2) to ask too many questions, (in disputed religious matters) and (3) to waste the wealth (by extravagance)
hi: Al-Mughira bin Shu'ba (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Allah ne tumpar haram kiya hai: (1) apni maaon ki na-farmani karna, (2) apni betiyon ko zinda dafn karna, (3) doosron ke haqq (jaise sadqa waghera) ada na karna, aur (4) logon se bheek maangna. Aur Allah ne tumhare liye napasand ki hai: (1) fazool, faaltu baatein, ya doosron ke baare mein zyada baatein karna, (2) bahut zyada sawaal poochna (deeni jhagdon mein), aur (3) daulat barbaad karna (fizoolkharchi se)."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "Everyone of you is a guardian, and responsible for what is in his custody. The ruler is a guardian of his subjects and responsible for them; a husband is a guardian of his family and is responsible for it; a lady is a guardian of her husband's house and is responsible for it, and a servant is a guardian of his master's property and is responsible for it." I heard that from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and I think that the Prophet (ﷺ) also said, "A man is a guardian of his father's property and is responsible for it, so all of you are guardians and responsible for your wards and things under your care
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool ko farmate suna: "Tum mein har ek rakhwala hai, aur apni zimmedaari mein jo hai uska zimmedaar hai. Hukmaran apni raaya ka rakhwala hai aur unke liye zimmedaar hai; shohar apne pariwara ka rakhwala hai aur uske liye zimmedaar hai; aurat apne shohar ke ghar ki rakhwali hai aur uske liye zimmedaar hai; aur khaadim apne maalik ki maal ka rakhwala hai aur uske liye zimmedaar hai." Maine yeh Allah ke Rasool se suna aur mujhe lagta hai Nabi ne yeh bhi kaha: "Mard apne baap ki maal ka rakhwala hai aur uske liye zimmedaar hai, isliye tum sab rakhwale ho aur apni zimmedaariyon aur apne under aayi cheezon ke liye zimmedaar ho."

e: Narrated `Abdullah:I heard a man reciting a verse (of the Holy Qur'an) but I had heard the Prophet (ﷺ) reciting it differently. So, I caught hold of the man by the hand and took him to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who said, "Both of you are right." Shu`ba, the sub-narrator said, "I think he said to them, "Don't differ, for the nations before you differed and perished (because of their differences)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine ek shaks ko Quran ki ek ayat padhte suna magar maine Nabi ko usi ayat ko doosre tareeke se padhte suna tha. Isliye maine us shaks ka haath pakada aur use Allah ke Rasool ke paas laaya jinhone kaha: "Tum dono sahi ho." Shu'ba (raawi) ne kaha: "Mujhe lagta hai Nabi ne unse kaha: 'Ikhtilaaf mat karo, kyunke tumse pehli ummaton ne ikhtilaaf kiya aur barbaad ho gayi.'"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Two persons, a Muslim and a Jew, quarreled. The Muslim said, "By Him Who gave Muhammad superiority over all the people! The Jew said, "By Him Who gave Moses superiority over all the people!" At that the Muslim raised his hand and slapped the Jew on the face. The Jew went to the Prophet and informed him of what had happened between him and the Muslim. The Prophet (ﷺ) sent for the Muslim and asked him about it. The Muslim informed him of the event. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not give me superiority over Moses, for on the Day of Resurrection all the people will fall unconscious and I will be one of them, but I will. be the first to gain consciousness, and will see Moses standing and holding the side of the Throne (of Allah). I will not know whether (Moses) has also fallen unconscious and got up before me, or Allah has exempted him from that stroke
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Do log, ek Musalman aur ek Yahudi, ka jhagda hua. Musalman ne kaha: "Us zaat ki qasam jisne Muhammad ko sab logon par fazilat di!" Yahudi ne kaha: "Us zaat ki qasam jisne Musa ko sab logon par fazilat di!" Isspar Musalman ne apna haath uthaya aur Yahudi ke mun par thappad maara. Yahudi Nabi ke paas gaya aur unhe uske aur Musalman ke darmiyan jo hua bataya. Nabi ne Musalman ko bulwaya aur uske baare mein pucha. Musalman ne unhe waqia bataya. Nabi ne kaha: "Mujhe Musa par fazilat mat do, kyunke Qiyamat ke din sab log behosh ho jaayenge aur main unme se ek hounga, magar main sabse pehle hosh mein aunga, aur dekhunga Musa khade hokar Arsh (Allah ke takht) ka kona pakde hue. Mujhe nahi pata woh bhi behosh hue the aur mujhse pehle hosh mein aaye, ya Allah ne unhe is behoshi se mafi di."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:While Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was sitting, a Jew came and said, "O Abul Qasim! One of your companions has slapped me on my face." The Prophet (ﷺ) asked who that was.
