He replied that he was one of the Ansar. The Prophet (ﷺ) sent for him, and on his arrival, he asked him whether he had beaten the Jew. He (replied in the affirmative and) said, "I heard him taking an oath in the market saying, 'By Him Who gave Moses superiority over all the human beings.' I said, 'O wicked man! (Has Allah given Moses superiority) even over Muhammad I became furious and slapped him over his face." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not give a prophet superiority over another, for on the Day of Resurrection all the people will fall unconscious and I will be the first to emerge from the earth, and will see Moses standing and holding one of the legs of the Throne. I will not know whether Moses has fallen unconscious or the first unconsciousness was sufficient for him
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jabke Allah ke Rasool baithe hue the, ek Yahudi aaya aur kaha: "Aye Abul Qasim! Aapke kisi sahabi ne mere mun par thappad maara hai." Nabi ne pucha kaun tha. Usne jawab diya ke woh Ansaar mein se tha. Nabi ne use bulwaya, aur uske aane par, unse pucha kya usne Yahudi ko maara tha. Usne (haan mein jawab diya aur) kaha: "Maine use bazaar mein qasam khate suna: 'Us zaat ki qasam jisne Musa ko sab insaanon par fazilat di.' Maine kaha: 'Aye zaalim shaks! (Kya Allah ne Musa ko fazilat di) Muhammad par bhi?' Mujhe gussa aaya aur maine uske mun par thappad maara." Nabi ne kaha: "Ek Nabi ko doosre par fazilat mat do, kyunke Qiyamat ke din sab log behosh ho jaayenge aur main sabse pehle zameen se niklunga, aur Musa ko khade dekhunga, Arsh ki ek taang pakde hue. Mujhe nahi pata Musa bhi behosh hue the ya pehli behoshi hi unke liye kaafi thi (Toor pahad par)."

e: Narrated Anas:A Jew crushed the head of a girl between two stones. The girl was asked who had crushed her head, and some names were mentioned before her, and when the name of the Jew was mentioned, she nodded agreeing. The Jew was captured and when he confessed, the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered that his head be crushed between two stones
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek Yahudi ne ek ladki ka sar do pattharon ke beech kuchla. Ladki se pucha gaya kisne uska sar kuchla, aur usse kuch naam bataye gaye, aur jab Yahudi ka naam liya gaya, usne ishare se maan liya. Yahudi ko pakada gaya aur jab usne iqrar kiya, Nabi ne hukum diya ke uska sar bhi do pattharon ke beech kuchla jaaye.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:A man was often cheated in buying. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "When you buy something, say (to the seller), No cheating." The man used to say so thenceforward
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Ek shaks khareedari mein aksar dhoka khata tha. Nabi ne usse kaha: "Jab tum kuch khareedo, (bechne wale se) kaho, 'Koi dhoka nahi.'" Shaks baad mein aisa hi kehta reha.

e: Narrated Jabir:A man manumitted a slave and he had no other property than that, so the Prophet (ﷺ) canceled the manumission (and sold the slave for him). Nu'aim bin Al-Nahham bought the slave from him
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks ne ek gulaam azaad kiya aur uske paas iske ilawa koi doosri maal nahi thi, isliye Nabi ne azaadi ko radd kiya (aur uske liye gulaam becha). Nu'aim bin Al-Nahham ne unse gulaam khareeda.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Mas`ud:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever takes a false oath so as to take the property of a Muslim (illegally) will meet Allah while He will be angry with him." Al-Ash'ath said: By Allah, that saying concerned me. I had common land with a Jew, and the Jew later on denied my ownership, so I took him to the Prophet who asked me whether I had a proof of my ownership. When I replied in the negative, the Prophet asked the Jew to take an oath. I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! He will take an oath and deprive me of my property." So, Allah revealed the following verse: "Verily! Those who purchase a little gain at the cost of Allah's covenant and their oaths
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jo koi ek Musalman ki maal (ghair-qanooni tareeke se) hasil karne ke liye jhuti qasam khata hai, woh Allah se aisi haalat mein milega ke woh usse naraaj hoga." Al-Ash'ath ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, yeh baat mere baare mein thi. Meri aur ek Yahudi ki saanjhi zameen thi, aur baad mein Yahudi ne meri milkiyat se inkaar kiya, isliye main use Nabi ke paas le gaya jinhone pucha kya mere paas milkiyat ka koi saboot hai. Jab maine na mein jawab diya, Nabi ne Yahudi se qasam lene ko kaha. Maine kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Woh qasam le lega aur mujhse mera maal chheen lega." Isliye Allah ne yeh ayat nazil ki: "Beshak! Woh log jo Allah ke ahad aur apni qasmon ke badle mein thoda faaida khareedte hain..."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Ka`b bin Malik:Ka`b demanded his debt back from Ibn Abi Hadrad in the Mosque and their voices grew louder till Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) heard them while he was in his house. He came out to them raising the curtain of his room and addressed Ka`b, "O Ka`b!" Ka`b replied, "Labaik, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." (He said to him), "Reduce your debt to one half," gesturing with his hand. Ka`b said, "I have done so, O Allah's Apostle!" On that the Prophet (ﷺ) said to Ibn Abi Hadrad, "Get up and repay the debt, to him
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ka'b bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ka'b ne masjid mein Ibn Abi Hadrad se apna qarz maanga aur unki aawazein bahut zyada oonchi ho gayi, jab tak Allah ke Rasool ne unhe apne ghar mein suna. Aap bahar aaye, apne kamre ka parda uthate huye, aur Ka'b ko sambodhit karte huye kaha: "Aye Ka'b!" Ka'b ne jawab diya: "Labbaik, Ya Allah ke Rasool." (Nabi ne unse kaha), "Apna qarz aadhi karo," apne haath se ishara karte huye. Ka'b ne kaha: "Maine aisa kiya, Ya Allah ke Rasool!" Isspar Nabi ne Ibn Abi Hadrad se kaha: "Utho aur usse qarz chukao."

e: Narrated `Umar bin Al-Khattab:I heard Hisham bin Hakim bin Hizam reciting Surat-al-Furqan in a way different to that of mine. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had taught it to me (in a different way). So, I was about to quarrel with him (during the prayer) but I waited till he finished, then I tied his garment round his neck and seized him by it and brought him to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "I have heard him reciting Surat-al-Furqan in a way different to the way you taught it to me." The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered me to release him and asked Hisham to recite it. When he recited it, Allah's Apostle said, "It was revealed in this way." He then asked me to recite it. When I recited it, he said, "It was revealed in this way. The Qur'an has been revealed in seven different ways, so recite it in the way that is easier for you
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Khattab (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Hisham bin Hakim bin Hizam (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko Surah Al-Furqan mera padhne se alag tareeke se padhte suna. Allah ke Rasool ne mujhe (ek alag tareeke se) sikhaee thi. Isliye main unse jhagda karna chahta tha (namaz ke dauran) magar unke khatam hone ka intezar kiya, phir maine unke kapde ko unki gardan ke gird lapetkar unhe pakda aur Allah ke Rasool ke paas le gaya aur kaha: "Maine unhe Surah Al-Furqan aapke sikhaye tareeke se alag padhte suna hai." Nabi ne mujhe unhe chhodne ka hukum diya aur Hisham se ise padhne ko kaha. Jab unhone ise padha, Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: "Yeh isi tarah nazil hui thi." Phir unhone mujhse ise padhne ko kaha. Jab maine ise padha, unhone kaha: "Yeh bhi isi tarah nazil hui thi. Quran saat alag-alag tareeqon mein nazil hui hai, isliye jis tareeke se tumhe aasaan lage usme ise padho."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No doubt, I intended to order somebody to pronounce the Iqama of the (compulsory congregational) prayer and then I would go to the houses of those who do not attend the prayer and burn their houses over them
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Beshak, mera iraada tha ke main kisi ko namaz (farz jamaat namaz) ki Iqama kehne ka hukum dun aur phir un logon ke gharon ki taraf jaoon jo namaz mein hazir nahi hote aur unpar unke ghar jala dun."

e: Narrated Aisha:Abu bin Zam`a and Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas carried the case of their claim of the (ownership) of the son of a slave-girl of Zam`a before the Prophet. Sa`d said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! My brother, before his death, told me that when I would return (to Mecca), I should search for the son of the slave-girl of Zam`a and take him into my custody as he was his son." 'Abu bin Zam`a said, 'He is my brother and the son of the slave-girl of my father, and was born on my father's bed." The Prophet (ﷺ) noticed a resemblance between `Utba and the boy but he said, "O 'Abu bin Zam`a! You will get this boy, as the son goes to the owner of the bed. You, Sauda, screen yourself from the boy
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Abu bin Zam'a aur Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Nabi ke saamne Zam'a ki launDi ke bete ki milkiyat ka daaava pesh kiya. Sa'd ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Mere bhai ne apni maut se pehle mujhse kaha tha ke jab main (Mecca) wapas jaoon, mujhe Zam'a ki launDi ke bete ko dhoondna chahiye aur apni sarparasti mein lena chahiye kyunke woh unka beta tha." Abu bin Zam'a ne kaha: "Yeh mera bhai hai aur mere waalid ki launDi ka beta, aur mere waalid ke bistar par paida hua." Nabi ne ladke aur Utba ke darmiyan ek samaanta dekhi magar unhone kaha: "Aye Abu bin Zam'a! Tumhe yeh ladka milega, kyunke bacha bistar wale ko jata hai. Aur, Sauda (رضی اللہ عنہا), ladke se parda karo."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent horsemen to Najd and they arrested and brought a man called Thumama bin Uthal, the chief of Yamama, and they fastened him to one of the pillars of the Mosque. When Allah's Apostle came up to him; he asked, "What have you to say, O Thumama?" He replied, "I have good news, O Muhammad!" Abu Huraira narrated the whole narration which ended with the order of the Prophet "Release him
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Najd ki taraf ghudsawaar bheje aur unhone Thumama bin Uthal naam ke ek shaks ko, jo Yamama ka sardaar tha, pakada aur laaye, aur use masjid ke ek sutoon se baandh diya. Jab Allah ke Rasool unke paas gaye, unhone pucha: "Tumhe kya kehna hai, Aye Thumama?" Usne jawab diya: "Mere paas achhi khabar hai, Aye Muhammad!" Abu Huraira ne poori riwaayat batayi jo Nabi ke hukum "Ise azaad kar do" par khatam hui.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) sent some horsemen to Najd and they arrested and brought a man called Thumama bin Uthal from the tribe of Bani Hanifa, and they fastened him to one of the pillars of the Mosque
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Najd ki taraf kuch ghudsawaar bheje aur unhone Bani Hanifa qabile ke Thumama bin Uthal naam ke ek shaks ko pakada aur laaye, aur use masjid ke ek sutoon se baandh diya.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Ka`b bin Malik Al-Ansari from Ka`b bin Malik:That `Abdullah bin Abi Hadrad Al-Aslami owed him some debt. Ka`b met him and caught hold of him and they started talking and their voices grew loudest. The Prophet (ﷺ) passed by them and addressed Ka`b, pointing out to him to reduce the debt to one half. So, Ka`b got one half of the debt and exempted the debtor from the other half
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ka'b bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ansari, Ka'b bin Malik ke hawale se: Abdullah bin Abi Hadrad Al-Aslami unpar kuch qarz karte the. Ka'b unse mile aur unhe pakada aur woh baat karne lage aur unki aawazein bahut zyada oonchi ho gayi. Nabi unke paas se guzre aur Ka'b ko sambodhit karke ishara kiya ke qarz aadhi kar do. Isliye Ka'b ne aadha qarz liya aur qarz-daar ko baaki aadhe se maaf kar diya.

e: Narrated Khabbab:I was a blacksmith In the Pre-Islamic period of ignorance, and 'Asi bin Wail owed me some money. I went to him to demand it, but he said to me, "I will not pay you unless you reject faith in Muhammad." I replied, "By Allah, I will never disbelieve Muhammad till Allah lets you die and then resurrects you." He said, "Then wait till I die and come to life again, for then I will be given property and offspring and will pay your right." So, thus revelation came: "Have you seen him who disbelieved in Our signs and yet says, 'I will be given property and offspring?
hi: Khabbab (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main jahiliyat ke zamane mein ek lohar tha, aur Asi bin Wail par mera kuch paisa qarz tha. Main use maangne gaya, magar unhone mujhse kaha: "Main tumhe tab tak nahi dunga jab tak tum Muhammad par apna iman radd na karo." Maine jawab diya: "Allah ki qasam, main kabhi Muhammad ka inkaar nahi karunga jab tak Allah tumhe maar na de aur phir tumhe dobara zinda kar de." Unhone kaha: "Phir intezar karo jab tak main mar na jaoon aur dobara zinda na ho jaoon, kyunke tab mujhe maal aur aulad di jaayegi aur main tumhara haqq ada karunga." Isliye yeh wahi nazil hui: "Kya tumne use dekha jisne humari nishaniyon ka inkaar kiya, aur phir kaha: 'Mujhe zaroor maal aur aulad di jaayegi?'"

e: Narrated Ubai bin Ka`b:I found a purse containing one hundred Diners. So I went to the Prophet (and informed him about it), he said, "Make public announcement about it for one year" I did so, but nobody turned up to claim it, so I again went to the Prophet (ﷺ) who said, "Make public announcement for another year." I did, but none turned up to claim it. I went to him for the third time and he said, "Keep the container and the string which is used for its tying and count the money it contains and if its owner comes, give it to him; otherwise, utilize it." The sub-narrator Salama said, "I met him (Suwaid, another sub-narrator) in Mecca and he said, 'I don't know whether Ubai made the announcement for three years or just one year
hi: Ubai bin Ka'b (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Mujhe ek thaali (bag) mili jisme sau Dinar the. Isliye main Nabi ke paas gaya (aur unhe bataya), unhone kaha: "Iska ek saal tak public elaan karo." Maine aisa kiya, magar koi ise lene nahi aaya, isliye main phir Nabi ke paas gaya jinhone kaha: "Ek aur saal ke liye public elaan karo." Maine kiya, magar koi ise lene nahi aaya. Main teesri baar unke paas gaya aur unhone kaha: "Bartan aur uski baandhne wali dhage ki gaanth yaad rakho aur usme rakhi raqam gino, aur agar uska maalik aaye, use de do; warna use istemal karo." Salama (raawi) ne kaha: "Maine unhe (Suwaid ko) Mecca mein mila aur unhone kaha: 'Mujhe nahi pata Ubai ne teen saal elaan kiya ya sirf ek saal.'"

e: Narrated Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani:A bedouin went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and asked him about picking up a lost thing. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Make public announcement about it for one year. Remember the description of its container and the string with which it is tied; and if somebody comes and claims it and describes it correctly, (give it to him); otherwise, utilize it." He said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What about a lost sheep?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It is for you, for your brother (i.e. its owner), or for the wolf." He further asked, "What about a lost camel?" On that the face of the Prophet (ﷺ) became red (with anger) and said, "You have nothing to do with it, as it has its feet, its water reserve and can reach places of water and drink, and eat trees
hi: Zaid bin Khalid (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Juhani (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek dehati Nabi ke paas gaya aur unse giri hui cheez uthane ke baare mein pucha. Nabi ne kaha: "Iska ek saal tak public elaan karo. Uske bartan aur uski baandhne wali dhage ka bayaan yaad rakho; aur agar koi aakar isko sahi tareeke se bayaan kare, (use de do); warna use istemal karo." Usne pucha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Ek gum-shuda bhed ke baare mein kya?" Nabi ne kaha: "Woh tumhare liye hai, tumhare bhai (yaani uske maalik) ke liye, ya bhediye ke liye." Usne aage pucha: "Ek gum-shuda unt ke baare mein kya?" Isspar Nabi ka chehra laal ho gaya (gusse se) aur unhone kaha: "Tumhara isse koi ta'aluq nahi, kyunke uske paas apne paon hain, apna paani ka bharosa hai aur woh paani ki jagahon tak pahunch sakta hai aur paani pi sakta hai, aur darakht kha sakta hai."

e: Narrated Sulaiman bin Bilal from Yahya:Yazid Maula Al-Munba'ith heard Zaid bin Khalid al-Juhani saying, "The Prophet (ﷺ) was asked about Luqata. He said, 'Remember the description of its container and the string it is tied with, and announce it publicly for one year.' " Yazid added, "If nobody claims then the person who has found it can spend it, and it is regarded as a trust entrusted to him." Yahya said, "I do not know whether the last sentences were said by the Prophet (ﷺ) or by Yazid." Zaid further said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) was asked, 'What about a lost sheep?' The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Take it, for it is for you or for your brother (i.e. its owner) or for the wolf." Yazid added that it should also be announced publicly. The man then asked the Prophet (ﷺ) about a lost camel. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Leave it, as it has its feet, water container (reservoir), and it will reach a place of water and eat trees till its owner finds it
hi: Sulaiman bin Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ), Yahya ke hawale se: Yazid Maula Al-Munba'ith ne Zaid bin Khalid (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Juhani (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko kehte suna: "Nabi se Luqata ke baare mein pucha gaya. Unhone kaha: 'Iske bartan aur uski baandhne wali dhage ka bayaan yaad rakho, aur ek saal tak iskaa public elaan karo.'" Yazid ne joda: "Agar koi daava na kare to jisne ise paaya woh ise kharch kar sakta hai, aur yeh use ek amanat ke tor par sonpi gayi maani jaayegi." Yahya ne kaha: "Mujhe nahi pata aakhri jumla Nabi ne kaha ya Yazid ne." Zaid ne aage kaha: "Nabi se pucha gaya: 'Ek gum-shuda bhed ke baare mein kya?' Nabi ne kaha: 'Ise le lo, kyunke woh tumhare liye hai ya tumhare bhai (yaani uske maalik) ke liye, ya bhediye ke liye.'" Yazid ne joda ke iska bhi public elaan karna chahiye. Shaks ne phir Nabi se ek gum-shuda unt ke baare mein pucha. Nabi ne kaha: "Ise chhod do, kyunke uske paas apna paani ka bharosa (pet) aur apne paon hain, aur woh paani ki jagah tak pahunch jaayega aur paani pi lega, aur darakht kha lega jab tak uska maalik use na paa le."

e: Narrated Zaid bin Khalid:A man came and asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about picking a lost thing. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Remember the description of its container and the string it is tied with, and make public announcement about it for one year. If the owner shows up, give it to him; otherwise, do whatever you like with it." He then asked, "What about a lost sheep?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It is for you, for your brother (i.e. its owner), or for the wolf." He further asked, "What about a lost camel?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It is none of your concern. It has its water-container (reservoir) and its feet, and it will reach water and drink it and eat the trees till its owner finds it
hi: Zaid bin Khalid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks aaya aur Allah ke Rasool se giri hui cheez uthane ke baare mein pucha. Nabi ne kaha: "Uske bartan aur uski baandhne wali dhage ka bayaan yaad rakho, aur ek saal tak iskaa public elaan karo. Agar maalik zaahir ho jaaye, use de do; warna apni marzi se jo chaho karo." Phir usne pucha: "Ek gum-shuda bhed ke baare mein kya?" Nabi ne kaha: "Woh tumhare liye hai, tumhare bhai (uske maalik) ke liye, ya bhediye ke liye." Usne aage pucha: "Ek gum-shuda unt ke baare mein kya?" Nabi ne kaha: "Yeh tumhare liye chinta ki baat nahi. Uske paas apna paani ka bharosa (reservoir) aur apne paon hain, aur woh paani tak pahunch kar pi lega aur darakht kha lega jab tak uska maalik use na paa le."

e: Narrated 'Abdur-Rahman bin Hurmuz:Abu Hurairah (ra) said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) mentioned an Israeli man." Abu Hurairah then told the whole narration). (At the end of the narration it was mentioned that the creditor) went out to the sea, hoping that a boat might have brought his money. Suddenly he saw a piece of wood and he took it to his house to use as firewood. When he sawed it, he found his money and a letter in it. [See hadith No. 2291 for details]
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Hurmuz bataate hain: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool ne Bani Israel ke ek shaks ka zikar kiya." (Abu Huraira ne phir poori riwaayat batayi.) (Riwaayat ke aakhir mein bataya gaya ke qarz-data) samundar ki taraf gaya, is ummeed mein ke koi kashti uska paisa laaee ho. Achanak usne ek lakdi ka tukda dekha aur use apne ghar jalane ke liye le gaya. Jab usne use kata, usme apna paisa aur ek khat paaya.

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) passed a date fallen on the way and said, "Were I not afraid that it may be from a Sadaqa (charitable gifts), I would have eaten it
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ek raaste par giri hui khajoor ke paas se guzre aur kaha: "Agar mujhe dar na hota ke yeh sadqe ki cheez hai, main ise khata."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Sometimes when I return home and find a date fallen on my bed, I pick it up in order to eat it, but I fear that it might be from a Sadaqa, so I throw it
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Kabhi-kabhi jab main ghar wapas aata hoon aur apne bistar par ek giri hui khajoor paata hoon, main use khane ke liye uthata hoon, magar mujhe dar hota hai ke yeh sadqe ki ho sakti hai, isliye main use phenk deta hoon."

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas (ra):Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) also said, "It (i.e., Makkah's) thorny bushes should not be uprooted and its game should not be chased, and picking up its fallen things is illegal except by him who makes public announcement about it, and its grass should not be cut." 'Abbas said, "O Allah's Messenger ! Except Idhkhir (a kind of grass)." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Except Idhkhir
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne yeh bhi kaha: "(Mecca ki) kaante wali jhaadiyan ukhadni nahi chahiye, iske shikaar ka picha nahi karna chahiye, aur iski giri hui cheezein uthana haram hai siwaye us shaks ke jo iskaa public elaan kare, aur iski ghaas nahi katni chahiye." Abbas ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Siwaye Idhkhir ke (ek qisam ki ghaas)." Nabi ne kaha: "Siwaye Idhkhir ke."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:When Allah gave victory to His Apostle over the people of Mecca, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up among the people and after glorifying Allah, said, "Allah has prohibited fighting in Mecca and has given authority to His Apostle and the believers over it, so fighting was illegal for anyone before me, and was made legal for me for a part of a day, and it will not be legal for anyone after me. Its game should not be chased, its thorny bushes should not be uprooted, and picking up its fallen things is not allowed except for one who makes public announcement for it, and he whose relative is murdered has the option either to accept a compensation for it or to retaliate." Al-`Abbas said, "Except Al-Idhkhir, for we use it in our graves and houses." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Except Al-Idhkhir." Abu Shah, a Yemenite, stood up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Get it written for me." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Write it for Abu Shah." (The sub-narrator asked Al-Auza'i): What did he mean by saying, "Get it written, O Allah's Apostle?" He replied, "The speech which he had heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Allah ne apne Rasool ko Mecca walon par fatah di, Allah ke Rasool logon ke beech khade hue aur Allah ki hamd-sana ke baad kaha: "Allah ne Mecca mein jung ko haram kiya hai aur apne Rasool aur momino ko usme ikhtiyaar diya hai, isliye mujhse pehle kisi ke liye isme jung karna jaiz nahi tha, aur mere liye ek din ke kuch hisse ke liye jaiz kiya gaya, aur mere baad kisi ke liye jaiz nahi hoga. Iske shikaar ka picha nahi karna chahiye, iski kaante wali jhaadiyan nahi ukhadni chahiye, aur iski giri hui cheezein uthana jaiz nahi siwaye us shaks ke jo iskaa public elaan kare, aur jiske rishtedaar ka qatl ho jaaye, use ikhtiyaar hai ya to khoon-baha qubool kare ya badla le." Al-Abbas ne kaha: "Siwaye Al-Idhkhir ke, kyunke hum ise apni qabron aur gharon mein istemal karte hain." Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: "Siwaye Al-Idhkhir ke." Abu Shah, ek Yemeni, khade hue aur kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Mere liye ise likhwa dijiye." Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: "Abu Shah ke liye likh do." (Doosre raawi ne Al-Auza'i se pucha: "'Ise likhwa dijiye, Ya Allah ke Rasool' ka kya matlab tha?" Unhone jawab diya: "Woh khutba jo usne Allah ke Rasool se suna.")

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "An animal should not be milked without the permission of its owner. Does any of you like that somebody comes to his store and breaks his container and takes away his food? The udders of the animals are the stores of their owners where their provision is kept, so nobody should milk the animals of somebody else, without the permission of its owner
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Kisi janwar ka doodh uske maalik ki ijazat ke bina na nikala jaaye. Kya tum mein se koi pasand karega ke koi uske godaam mein aaye, uska bartan tode aur uska khana le jaaye? Janwaron ke than unke maalikon ke godaam hain jahan unka khaana rakha hota hai, isliye kisi ko bhi doosre ke janwar ka doodh uske maalik ki ijazat ke bina nahi nikaalna chahiye."

e: Narrated Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani:A man asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about the Luqata. He said, "Make public announcement of it for one year, then remember the description of its container and the string it is tied with, utilize the money, and if its owner comes back after that, give it to him." The people asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What about a lost sheep?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Take it, for it is for you, for your brother, or for the wolf." The man asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What about a lost camel?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got angry and his cheeks or face became red, and said, "You have no concern with it as it has its feet, and its watercontainer, till its owner finds it
hi: Zaid bin Khalid (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Juhani (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks ne Allah ke Rasool se Luqata ke baare mein pucha. Unhone kaha: "Iska ek saal tak public elaan karo, phir uske bartan aur uski baandhne wali dhage ka bayaan yaad rakho, paisa istemal karo, aur agar uska maalik baad mein aaye, use de do." Logon ne pucha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Ek gum-shuda bhed ke baare mein kya?" Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: "Ise le lo, kyunke woh tumhare liye hai, tumhare bhai ke liye, ya bhediye ke liye." Shaks ne pucha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Ek gum-shuda unt ke baare mein kya?" Allah ke Rasool ko gussa aaya aur unke gaal ya chehra laal ho gaya, aur unhone kaha: "Tumhara isse koi ta'aluq nahi kyunke uske paas apne paon hain, aur apna paani ka bharosa hai, jab tak uska maalik use na paa le."

e: Narrated Suwaid bin Ghafala:While I was in the company of Salman bin Rabi`a and Suhan, in one of the holy battles, I found a whip. One of them told me to drop it but I refused to do so and said that I would give it to its owner if I found him, otherwise I would utilize it. On our return we performed Hajj and on passing by Medina, I asked Ubai bin Ka`b about it. He said, "I found a bag containing a hundred Dinars in the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) and took it to the Prophet (ﷺ) who said to me, 'Make public announcement about it for one year.' So, I announced it for one year and went to the Prophet (ﷺ) who said, 'Announce it publicly for another year.' So, I announced it for another year. I went to him again and he said, "Announce for another year." So I announced for still another year. I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) for the fourth time, and he said, 'Remember the amount of money, the description of its container and the string it is tied with, and if the owner comes, give it to him; otherwise, utilize it
hi: Suwaid bin Ghafala bataate hain: Jabke main Salman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Rabi'a aur Suhan ki sohbat mein tha, ek muqaddas jung mein, mujhe ek chaabuk mila. Unme se ek ne mujhse ise gira dene ko kaha magar maine inkaar kiya aur kaha ke agar mujhe iska maalik mila to main use de dunga, warna isse istemal karunga. Wapasi par, humne Hajj kiya aur Madina se guzarte huye, maine Ubai bin Ka'b (رضی اللہ عنہ) se iske baare mein pucha. Unhone kaha: "Mujhe Nabi ke zamane mein ek bag mila jisme sau Dinar the, aur main use Nabi ke paas le gaya jinhone mujhse kaha: 'Iska ek saal tak public elaan karo.' Isliye maine ek saal elaan kiya aur Nabi ke paas gaya jinhone kaha: 'Iskaa doosre saal bhi public elaan karo.' Isliye maine doosre saal ke liye elaan kiya. Main phir unke paas gaya aur unhone kaha: 'Ek aur saal elaan karo.' Isliye maine phir ek aur saal ke liye elaan kiya. Main chauthi baar Nabi ke paas gaya, aur unhone kaha: 'Paisa ki maqdaar, uske bartan ka bayaan, aur uski baandhne wali dhage ka bayaan yaad rakho, aur agar maalik aaye, use de do; warna use istemal karo.'"

e: Narrated Salama:the above narration (Hadith 616) from Ubai bin Ka`b: adding, "I met the sub-narrator at Mecca later on, but he did not remember whether Ka`b had announced what he had found one year or three years
hi: Salama bataate hain: (upar wali riwaayat 616) Ubai bin Ka'b (رضی اللہ عنہ) se, aur joda: "Baad mein maine (doosre raawi ko) Mecca mein mila, magar unhe yaad nahi tha ke Ka'b ne apni mili hui cheez ka ek saal elaan kiya tha ya teen saal."

e: Narrated Zaid bin Khalid:A bedouin asked the Prophet (ﷺ) about the Luqata. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Make public announcement about it for one year and if then somebody comes and describes the container of the Luqata and the string it was tied with, (give it to him); otherwise, spend it." He then asked the Prophet (ﷺ) about a lost camel. The face of the Prophet (ﷺ) became red and he said, "You have no concern with it as it has its water reservoir and feet and it will reach water and drink and eat trees. Leave it till its owner finds it." He then asked the Prophet (ﷺ) about a lost sheep. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It is for you, for your brother, or for the wolf
hi: Zaid bin Khalid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek dehati ne Nabi se Luqata ke baare mein pucha. Nabi ne kaha: "Iska ek saal tak public elaan karo aur agar koi aakar Luqata ke bartan aur uski baandhne wali dhage ka bayaan sahi kare, (use de do); warna use kharch karo." Phir usne Nabi se ek gum-shuda unt ke baare mein pucha. Nabi ka chehra laal ho gaya aur unhone kaha: "Tumhara isse koi ta'aluq nahi kyunke uske paas apna paani ka bharosa aur apne paon hain, aur woh paani tak pahunch kar pi lega aur darakht kha lega. Ise chhod do jab tak uska maalik use na paa le." Phir usne Nabi se ek gum-shuda bhed ke baare mein pucha. Nabi ne kaha: "Woh tumhare liye hai, tumhare bhai ke liye, ya bhediye ke liye."

e: Narrated Abu Bakr:While I was on my way, all of a sudden I saw a shepherd driving his sheep, I asked him whose servant he was. He replied that he was the servant of a man from Quraish, and then he mentioned his name and I recognized him. I asked, "Do your sheep have some milk?" He replied in the affirmative. I said, "Are you going to milk for me?" He replied in the affirmative. I ordered him and he tied the legs of one of the sheep. Then I told him to clean the udder (teats) of dust and to remove dust off his hands. He removed the dust off his hands by clapping his hands. He then milked a little milk. I put the milk for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in a pot and closed its mouth with a piece of cloth and poured water over it till it became cold. I took it to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "Drink, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" He drank it till I was pleased
hi: Abu Bakr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jabke main apne raaste par tha, achanak maine ek charwaha apni bhedein hankate dekha. Maine unse pucha woh kiske khaadim hain. Unhone jawab diya woh Quraish ke ek shaks ke khaadim hain, phir unka naam bataya aur maine unhe pehchaan liya. Maine pucha: "Kya tumhari bhedon mein doodh hai?" Unhone haan mein jawab diya. Maine kaha: "Kya tum mere liye doodh nikaal loge?" Unhone haan mein jawab diya. Maine unhe hukum diya aur unhone ek bhed ki taangein baandh di. Phir maine unse thanon ki dhool saaf karne aur haathon se dhool hatane ko kaha. Unhone apne haathon ki dhool taali bajakar hataee. Phir unhone thoda doodh nikala. Maine woh doodh Allah ke Rasool ke liye ek bartan mein daala aur uska mun ek kapde se band kiya aur usme paani daala jab tak woh thanda ho gaya. Main use Nabi ke paas le gaya aur kaha: "Piye, Ya Allah ke Rasool!" Unhone piya jab tak main santusht ho gaya.

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When the believers pass safely over (the bridge across) Hell, they will be stopped at a bridge in between Hell and Paradise where they will retaliate upon each other for the injustices done among them in the world, and when they get purified of all their sins, they will be admitted into Paradise. By Him in Whose Hands the life of Muhammad is everybody will recognize his dwelling in Paradise better than he recognizes his dwelling in this world
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jab momin Dozakh ke pul se safar karke par ho jaate hain, unhe Dozakh aur Jannat ke darmiyan ek doosre pul par roka jaayega jahan woh duniyawi zulm ke badle ek-doosre se badla lenge, aur jab woh sab gunahon se paak ho jaayenge, unhe Jannat mein daakhil kiya jaayega. Us zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein Muhammad ki zindagi hai, har koi apna Jannat ka ghar duniyawi ghar se zyada pehchaanega."

e: Narrated Safwan bin Muhriz Al-Mazini:While I was walking with Ibn `Umar holding his hand, a man came in front of us and asked, "What have you heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about An-Najwa?" Ibn `Umar said, "I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, 'Allah will bring a believer near Him and shelter him with His Screen and ask him: Did you commit such-and-such sins? He will say: Yes, my Lord. Allah will keep on asking him till he will confess all his sins and will think that he is ruined. Allah will say: 'I did screen your sins in the world and I forgive them for you today', and then he will be given the book of his good deeds. Regarding infidels and hypocrites (their evil acts will be exposed publicly) and the witnesses will say: These are the people who lied against their Lord. Behold! The Curse of Allah is upon the wrongdoers
hi: Safwan bin Muhriz Al-Mazini bataate hain: Jabke main Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath unka haath pakade chal raha tha, ek shaks samne aaya aur pucha: "Aapne Allah ke Rasool se An-Najwa (Qiyamat ke din Allah ka bandon se khaas mulaqaat) ke baare mein kya suna?" Ibn Umar ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool ko farmate suna: 'Allah ek momin ko apne qareeb laayega aur use apne Parde se dhaakega aur uspoochega: Kya tumne aisa-aisa gunah kiya? Woh kahega: Haan, mere Rab. Allah usse tab tak poochta rahega jab tak woh apne sab gunahon ka iqrar na kare aur soche ke woh tabaah ho gaya hai. Allah kahega: Maine duniya mein tumhare gunah chhupaye aur aaj main tumhe unhe maaf karta hoon,' aur phir usse uski neik amalon ki kitaab di jaayegi. Jahan tak kaafiron aur munafikon ka ta'aluq hai (unke bure amal khule aam zaahir ho jaayenge) aur gawaah kahenge: 'Yehi log hain jinhone apne Rab par jhoot bola. Khabardar! Allah ki laanat zaalimon par hai.'"

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "A Muslim is a brother of another Muslim, so he should not oppress him, nor should he hand him over to an oppressor. Whoever fulfilled the needs of his brother, Allah will fulfill his needs; whoever brought his (Muslim) brother out of a discomfort, Allah will bring him out of the discomforts of the Day of Resurrection, and whoever screened a Muslim, Allah will screen him on the Day of Resurrection
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Ek Musalman doosre Musalman ka bhai hai, isliye use na uspar zulm karna chahiye, na use kisi zaalim ke haath sonpna chahiye. Jo koi apne bhai ki zaroorten poori kare, Allah uski zaroorten poori karega; jo koi apne (Musalman) bhai ko kisi museebat se nikaale, Allah use Qiyamat ke din museebaton se nikaalega, aur jo koi kisi Musalman (ki galti) ko chhupaataa hai, Allah use Qiyamat ke din chhupaayega."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Help your brother, whether he is an oppressor or he is an oppressed one
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Apne bhai ki madad karo, chahe woh zaalim ho ya mazloom."

e: Narrated Anas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Help your brother, whether he is an oppressor or he is an oppressed one. People asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! It is all right to help him if he is oppressed, but how should we help him if he is an oppressor?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "By preventing him from oppressing others
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Apne bhai ki madad karo, chahe woh zaalim ho ya mazloom." Logon ne pucha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Agar woh mazloom ho to madad karna theek hai, magar agar woh zaalim ho to hum kaise madad karen?" Nabi ne kaha: "Use doosron par zulm karne se rokkar."

e: Narrated Muawiya bin Suwaid:I heard Al-Bara' bin `Azib saying, "The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered us to do seven things and prohibited us from doing seven other things." Then Al-Bara' mentioned the following:-- (1) To pay a visit to the sick (inquiring about his health), (2) to follow funeral processions, (3) to say to a sneezer, "May Allah be merciful to you" (if he says, "Praise be to Allah!"), (4) to return greetings, (5) to help the oppressed, (6) to accept invitations, (7) to help others to fulfill their oaths. (See Hadith No. 753, Vol)
hi: Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Suwaid bataate hain: Maine Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko kehte suna: "Nabi ne humein saat cheezon ka hukum diya aur saat doosri cheezon se mana kiya." Phir Al-Bara ne yeh bataya: (1) bimar ki iyaadat karna (uski sehat ke baare mein poochna), (2) janaza mein shaamil hona, (3) chheenkne wale ko kehna, "Allah tumpar reham kare" (agar woh "Alhamdulillah" kahe), (4) salaam ka jawab dena, (5) mazloom ki madad karna, (6) dawat qubool karna, (7) doosron ko unki qasmen poori karne mein madad karna.

e: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A believer to another believer is like a building whose different parts enforce each other." The Prophet (ﷺ) then clasped his hands with the fingers interlaced (while saying that)
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Ek momin doosre momin ke liye ek imaarat ki tarah hai jiske alag-alag hisse ek-doosre ko mazboot karte hain." Nabi ne phir yeh kehte huye apne haath ke ungliyaan aapas mein jodi.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Oppression will be a darkness on the Day of Resurrection
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Zulm Qiyamat ke din andhera hoga."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) sent Mu`adh to Yemen and said, "Be afraid, from the curse of the oppressed as there is no screen between his invocation and Allah
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne Mu'adh ko Yemen bheja aur kaha: "Mazloom ki bad-dua se darona, kyunke uski dua aur Allah ke darmiyan koi parda nahi."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever has oppressed another person concerning his reputation or anything else, he should beg him to forgive him before the Day of Resurrection when there will be no money (to compensate for wrong deeds), but if he has good deeds, those good deeds will be taken from him according to his oppression which he has done, and if he has no good deeds, the sins of the oppressed person will be loaded on him
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jo koi kisi doosre par zulm kare uski izzat ya kisi aur cheez ke maamle mein, use Qiyamat ke din se pehle usse maafi mangle leni chahiye jab paisa (galti sudharne ke liye) nahi hoga, magar agar uske paas neik amal hain, woh neik amal uske zulm ke mutabiq usse le liye jaayenge, aur agar uske paas neik amal nahi hain, to mazloom shaks ke gunah uspar daal diye jaayenge."

e: Narrated Aisha:Regarding the explanation of the following verse:-- "If a wife fears Cruelty or desertion On her husband's part." (4.128) A man may dislike his wife and intends to divorce her, so she says to him, "I give up my rights, so do not divorce me." The above verse was revealed concerning such a case
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Iss ayat ki tafseer ke baare mein: "Agar ek biwi apne shohar se zulm ya be-parwaahi ka khadsha rakhti hai" (4:128). Ek mard apni biwi ko napasand kar sakta hai aur use talaq dena chahta hai, isliye woh usse kehti hai: "Main apna haqq chhodti hoon, isliye mujhe talaq mat dijiye." Yeh upar wali ayat aisi hi ek soorat mein nazil hui.

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d As-Sa`idi:A drink (milk mixed with water) was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who drank some of it. A boy was sitting to his right, and some old men to his left. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to the boy, "Do you allow me to give the rest of the drink to these people?" The boy said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I will not give preference to anyone over me to drink the rest of it from which you have drunk." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then handed the bowl (of drink) to the boy. (See Hadith No)
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) As-Sa'idi (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ke paas ek peene ki cheez (doodh paani se mila hua) laaee gayi jise unhone piya. Ek ladka unki dahini taraf baitha tha, aur kuch budhe log unki baayi taraf. Allah ke Rasool ne ladke se kaha: "Kya tum mujhe ijazat doge ke main baaki (peene ki cheez) in logon ko dun?" Ladke ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Main kisi ko bhi apni baari se pehle nahi dunga, jo aapne piya hai usme se." Allah ke Rasool ne phir woh pyala usi ladke ko de diya.

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Zaid:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever usurps the land of somebody unjustly, his neck will be encircled with it down the seven earths (on the Day of Resurrection)
hi: Sa'id bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jo koi kisi ki zameen na-haqq hasil karta hai, uski gardan usse (zameen se) saat zameenon tak lipeti jaayegi (Qiyamat ke din)."

e: Narrated Abu Salama:That there was a dispute between him and some people (about a piece of land). When he told `Aisha about it, she said, "O Abu Salama! Avoid taking the land unjustly, for the Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Whoever usurps even one span of the land of somebody, his neck will be encircled with it down the seven earths
hi: Abu Salama bataate hain: Unka aur kuch logon ka (ek zameen ke tukde ke baare mein) jhagda hua. Jab unhone Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko iske baare mein bataya, unhone kaha: "Aye Abu Salama! Zameen na-haqq lene se bacho, kyunke Nabi ne kaha: 'Jo koi kisi ki zameen ka ek bhi baalish (span) na-haqq leta hai, uski gardan usse saat zameenon tak lipeti jaayegi.'"

e: Narrated Salim's father (i.e. `Abdullah):The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever takes a piece of the land of others unjustly, he will sink down the seven earths on the Day of Resurrection
hi: Salim ke waalid (yaani Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ)) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jo koi doosron ki zameen ka ek tukda na-haqq leta hai, woh Qiyamat ke din saat zameenon mein dhaans jaayega."

e: Narrated Jabala:"We were in Medina with some of the Iraqi people, and we were struck with famine and Ibn Az-Zubair used to give us dates. Ibn `Umar used to pass by and say, "The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade us to eat two dates at a time, unless one takes the permission of one's companions
hi: Jabala bataate hain: "Hum Madina mein kuch Iraqi logon ke saath the, aur akaal se pareshaan the, aur Ibn Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) humein khajoor dete the. Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) guzarte the aur kehte the: 'Nabi ne humein ek saath do khajoor khaane se mana kiya tha, jab tak koi apne saathiyon se ijazat na le.'"

e: Narrated Abu Mas`ud:There was an Ansari man called Abu Shu'aib who had a slave butcher. Abu Shu'aib said to him, "Prepare a meal sufficient for five persons so that I might invite the Prophet (ﷺ) besides other four persons." Abu Shu'aib had seen the signs of hunger on the face of the Prophet (ﷺ) and so he invited him. Another man who was not invited, followed the Prophet. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to Abu Shu'aib, "This man has followed us. Do you allow him to share the meal?" Abu Shu'aib said, "Yes
hi: Abu Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek Ansari shaks tha jise Abu Shu'aib kaha jata, uske paas ek kasaaaee gulaam tha. Abu Shu'aib ne unse kaha: "Paanch logon ke liye khaana taiyaar karo taake main Nabi ko aur unke saath chaar aur logon ko dawat dun." Abu Shu'aib ne Nabi ke chehre par bhookh ke asaraat dekhe the, isliye unhone unhe dawat di. Ek doosra shaks jise dawat nahi di gayi thi, Nabi ke saath chala gaya. Nabi ne Abu Shu'aib se kaha: "Yeh shaks humare saath aaya hai. Kya tum ijazat dete ho ke woh khaane mein shaamil ho?" Abu Shu'aib ne kaha: "Haan."

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The most hated person in the sight of Allah is the most quarrelsome person
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Allah ke nazdeek sabse napasandida shaks woh hai jo sabse zyada jhagdaloo hai."

e: Narrated Um Salama:(the wife of the Prophet) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) heard some people quarreling at the door of his dwelling. He came out and said, "I am only a human being, and opponents come to me (to settle their problems); maybe someone amongst you can present his case more eloquently than the other, whereby I may consider him true and give a verdict in his favor. So, If I give the right of a Muslim to another by mistake, then it is really a portion of (Hell) Fire, he has the option to take or give up (before the Day of Resurrection)
hi: Um Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki biwi) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kuch logon ko apne ghar ke darwaze par jhagdte suna. Aap bahar aaye aur kaha: "Main sirf ek insaan hoon, aur mere paas maamle suljhane ke liye do party aati hain; ho sakta hai unme se koi apna maamla doosre se zyada khoobsoorti se pesh kare, jisse main use sach samajh kar uske haqq mein faisla dun. Isliye agar main galti se kisi Musalman ka haqq doosre ko de dun, to yeh (Dozakh ki) aag ka ek hissa hai, jo woh chaahe le sakta hai ya (Qiyamat ke din) chhod sakta hai."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever has (the following) four characters will be a hypocrite, and whoever has one of the following four characteristics will have one characteristic of hypocrisy until he gives it up. These are: (1 ) Whenever he talks, he tells a lie; (2) whenever he makes a promise, he breaks it; (3) whenever he makes a covenant he proves treacherous; (4) and whenever he quarrels, he behaves impudently in an evil insulting manner." (See Hadith No. 33 Vol)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jiske paas yeh chaar khasiyaten hain, woh munafik hai, aur jiske paas in chaaron mein se koi ek ho, uske paas munafiqat ki ek khasiyat hai jab tak woh usse chhod na de. Yeh hain: (1) Jab woh baat kare, jhoot bole; (2) jab wada kare, tore; (3) jab ahad kare, dhoka de; (4) aur jab jhagda kare, be-adabi se, bure aur gaali-gluch bhare tareeke se pesh aaye."

e: Narrated Aisha:Hind bint `Utba (Abu Sufyan's wife) came and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Abu Sufyan is a miser. Is there any harm if I spend something from his property for our children?" He said, there is no harm for you if you feed them from it justly and reasonably (with no extravagance)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Hind bint Utba (Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki biwi) aayi aur kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Abu Sufyan kanjoos hain. Kya koi harj hai agar main unka maal se apne bachchon ke liye kuch kharch karun?" Aap ne kaha: "Koi harj nahi agar tum unhe usse insaaf aur munasib tareeke se (bina fizoolkharchi ke) khilaao."

e: Narrated `Uqba bin 'Amir:We said to the Prophet, "You send us out and it happens that we have to stay with people who do not entertain us. What do you think about it? He said to us, "If you stay with some people and they entertain you as they should for a guest, accept their hospitality, but if they don't, take the right of the guest from them
hi: Uqba bin Amir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Humne Nabi se kaha: "Aap humein bhejte hain aur humein aisi jagahon par rukna padta hai jahan log humari mehmannavazi nahi karte. Iske baare mein aapki kya raay hai?" Aap ne humse kaha: "Agar tumhe kisi jagah rukna pade aur woh log tumhari mehmannavazi karen jaisi mehmaan ki honi chahiye, unka mehmaan-nawazi qubool karo, magar agar woh na karen, unse mehmaan ka haqq le lo."

e: Narrated `Umar:When Allah took away the soul of His Prophet at his death, the Ansar assembled In the shed of Bani Sa`ida. I said to Abu Bakr, "Let us go." So, we came to them (i.e. to Ansar) at the shed of Bani Sa`ida. (See Hadith No. 19, Vol. 5 for details)
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Allah ne apne Nabi ki rooh unki maut par le li, Ansaar Bani Sa'ida ke chhappar (shed) mein jama hue. Maine Abu Bakr se kaha: "Chaliye chalte hain." Isliye hum unke (Ansaar ke) paas Bani Sa'ida ke chhappar mein gaye.

e: Narrated Al-Araj:Abu Huraira said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'No one should prevent his neighbor from fixing a wooden peg in his wall." Abu Huraira said (to his companions), "Why do I find you averse to it? By Allah, I certainly will narrate it to you
hi: Al-Araj bataate hain: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: 'Koi bhi apne padosi ko apni deewar mein ek lakdi ki keel lagane se na roke.'" Abu Huraira ne (apne sathiyon se) kaha: "Mujhe kyun lagta hai tum isse napasand karte ho? Allah ki qasam, main zaroor tumhe yeh bataunga."

e: Narrated Anas:I was the butler of the people in the house of Abu Talha, and in those days drinks were prepared from dates. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered somebody to announce that alcoholic drinks had been prohibited. Abu Talha ordered me to go out and spill the wine. I went out and spilled it, and it flowed in the streets of Medina. Some people said, "Some people were killed and wine was still in their stomachs." On that the Divine revelation came:-- "On those who believe And do good deeds There is no blame For what they ate (in the past)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke ghar mein logon ka bhandaari tha, aur un dinon khajoor se sharaab banaee jaati thi. Allah ke Rasool ne kisi ko elaan karne ka hukum diya ke sharaab haram kar di gayi hai. Abu Talha ne mujhe bahar jaane aur sharaab bahane ka hukum diya. Main bahar gaya aur ise bahaya, aur yeh Madina ki galiyon mein behne laga. Kuch logon ne kaha: "Kuch log qatl huye jabke sharaab abhi unke pet mein thi." Isspar Allahi wahi nazil hui: "Woh log jo iman laaye aur neik amal kiye, unpar koi gunah nahi jo unhone (pehle) khaya-piya..."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Beware! Avoid sitting on the roads (ways)." The people said, "There is no way out of it as these are our sitting places where we have talks." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If you must sit there, then observe the rights of the way." They asked, "What are the rights of the way?" He said, "They are the lowering of your gazes (on seeing what is illegal to look at), refraining from harming people, returning greetings, advocating good and forbidding evil
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Khabardar! Raaston par baithne se bacho." Logon ne kaha: "Iska koi ilaaj nahi kyunke yeh humari baithne ki jagahein hain jahan hum baatchit karte hain." Nabi ne kaha: "Agar tumhe wahan baitha hi hai, to raaste ke haqq ka khayaal rakho." Unhone pucha: "Raaste ke haqq kya hain?" Aap ne kaha: "Apni nigaahen neeche rakhna (jo dekhna haram hai use dekhne se bachna), logon ko takleef na dena, salaam ka jawab dena, achhi baat ka hukum dena aur buri baat se rokna."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A man felt very thirsty while he was on the way, there he came across a well. He went down the well, quenched his thirst and came out. Meanwhile he saw a dog panting and licking mud because of excessive thirst. He said to himself, "This dog is suffering from thirst as I did." So, he went down the well again and filled his shoe with water and watered it. Allah thanked him for that deed and forgave him. The people said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Is there a reward for us in serving the animals?" He replied: "Yes, there is a reward for serving any animate (living being)." (See Hadith No)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Ek shaks ko safar mein bahut zyada pyaas lagi, aur usne ek kua paaya. Woh kue mein utar kar apni pyaas bujhai aur bahar aaya. Isi dauran usne ek kutta dekha jo haafte hue mitti chaat raha tha bahut zyada pyaas ki wajah se. Usne khud se kaha: 'Yeh kutta wahi museebat mein hai jismein main tha.' Isliye woh phir kue mein utara aur apni juti mein paani bhara aur use paani pilaya. Allah ne uski is neki ka shukriya ada kiya aur use maaf kar diya." Logon ne pucha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Kya janwaron ki khidmat karne ka humein bhi ajr milta hai?" Aap ne jawab diya: "Haan, kisi bhi zinda mahluk ki khidmat karne ka ajr milta hai."

e: Narrated Usama bin Zaid:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) stood at the top of one of the castles (or higher buildings) of Medina and said, "Do you see what I see? No doubt I am seeing the spots of afflictions amongst your houses as numerous as the spots where raindrops fall (during a heavy rain). (See Hadith No)
hi: Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Ek baar Nabi Madina ke ek qile (ya oonchi imaarat) ki chotti par khade hue aur kaha: "Kya tumhe woh dikhta hai jo main dekh raha hoon? Beshak, main tumhare gharon ke beech fitnon ki jagahein utni hi zyada dekh raha hoon jitni jagahein baarish ki boondon ke girne ki."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abbas:I had been eager to ask `Umar about the two ladies from among the wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) regarding whom Allah said (in the Qur'an saying): If you two (wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) namely Aisha and Hafsa) turn in repentance to Allah your hearts are indeed so inclined (to oppose what the Prophet (ﷺ) likes) (66.4), till performed the Hajj along with `Umar (and on our way back from Hajj) he went aside (to answer the call of nature) and I also went aside along with him carrying a tumbler of water. When he had answered the call of nature and returned. I poured water on his hands from the tumbler and he performed ablution. I said, "O Chief of the believers! ' Who were the two ladies from among the wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) to whom Allah said: 'If you two return in repentance (66.4)? He said, "I am astonished at your question, O Ibn `Abbas. They were Aisha and Hafsa." Then `Umar went on relating the narration and said. "I and an Ansari neighbor of mine from Bani Umaiya bin Zaid who used to live in `Awali Al-Medina, used to visit the Prophet (ﷺ) in turns. He used to go one day, and I another day. When I went I would bring him the news of what had happened that day regarding the instructions and orders and when he went, he used to do the same for me. We, the people of Quraish, used to have authority over women, but when we came to live with the Ansar, we noticed that the Ansari women had the upper hand over their men, so our women started acquiring the habits of the Ansari women. Once I shouted at my wife and she paid me back in my coin and I disliked that she should answer me back. She said, 'Why do you take it ill that I retort upon you? By Allah, the wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) retort upon him, and some of them may not speak with him for the whole day till night.' What she said scared me and I said to her, 'Whoever amongst them does so, will be a great loser.' Then I dressed myself and went to Hafsa and asked her, 'Does any of you keep Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) angry all the day long till night?' She replied in the affirmative. I said, 'She is a ruined losing person (and will never have success)! Doesn't she fear that Allah may get angry for the anger of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and thus she will be ruined? Don't ask Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) too many things, and don't retort upon him in any case, and don't desert him. Demand from me whatever you like, and don't be tempted to imitate your neighbor (i.e. `Aisha) in her behavior towards the Prophet), for she (i.e. Aisha) is more beautiful than you, and more beloved to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). In those days it was rumored that Ghassan, (a tribe living in Sham) was getting prepared their horses to invade us. My companion went (to the Prophet (ﷺ) on the day of his turn, went and returned to us at night and knocked at my door violently, asking whether I was sleeping. I was scared (by the hard knocking) and came out to him. He said that a great thing had happened. I asked him: What is it? Have Ghassan come? He replied that it was worse and more serious than that, and added that Allah's Apostle had divorced all his wives. I said, Hafsa is a ruined loser! I expected that would happen some day.' So I dressed myself and offered the Fajr prayer with the Prophet. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) entered an upper room and stayed there alone. I went to Hafsa and found her weeping. I asked her, 'Why are you weeping? Didn't I warn you? Has Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) divorced you all?' She replied, 'I don't know. He is there in the upper room.' I then went out and came to the pulpit and found a group of people around it and some of them were weeping. Then I sat with them for some time, but could not endure the situation. So I went to the upper room where the Prophet (ﷺ) was and requested to a black slave of his: "Will you get the permission of (Allah's Apostle) for `Umar (to enter)? The slave went in, talked to the Prophet (ﷺ) about it and came out saying, 'I mentioned you to him but he did not reply.' So, I went and sat with the people who were sitting by the pulpit, but I could not bear the situation, so I went to the slave again and said: "Will you get he permission for `Umar? He went in and brought the same reply as before. When I was leaving, behold, the slave called me saying, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has granted you permission." So, I entered upon the Prophet and saw him lying on a mat without bedding on it, and the mat had left its mark on the body of the Prophet, and he was leaning on a leather pillow stuffed with palm fibres. I greeted him and while still standing, I said: "Have you divorced your wives?' He raised his eyes to me and replied in the negative. And then while still standing, I said chatting: "Will you heed what I say, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We, the people of Quraish used to have the upper hand over our women (wives), and when we came to the people whose women had the upper hand over them..." `Umar told the whole story (about his wife). "On that the Prophet (ﷺ) smiled." `Umar further said, "I then said, 'I went to Hafsa and said to her: Do not be tempted to imitate your companion (`Aisha) for she is more beautiful than you and more beloved to the Prophet.' The Prophet (ﷺ) smiled again. When I saw him smiling, I sat down and cast a glance at the room, and by Allah, I couldn't see anything of importance but three hides. I said (to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)) "Invoke Allah to make your followers prosperous for the Persians and the Byzantines have been made prosperous and given worldly luxuries, though they do not worship Allah?' The Prophet (ﷺ) was leaning then (and on hearing my speech he sat straight) and said, 'O Ibn Al-Khattab! Do you have any doubt (that the Hereafter is better than this world)? These people have been given rewards of their good deeds in this world only.' I asked the Prophet (ﷺ) . 'Please ask Allah's forgiveness for me. The Prophet (ﷺ) did not go to his wives because of the secret which Hafsa had disclosed to `Aisha, and he said that he would not go to his wives for one month as he was angry with them when Allah admonished him (for his oath that he would not approach Maria). When twenty-nine days had passed, the Prophet (ﷺ) went to Aisha first of all. She said to him, 'You took an oath that you would not come to us for one month, and today only twenty-nine days have passed, as I have been counting them day by day.' The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'The month is also of twenty-nine days.' That month consisted of twenty-nine days. `Aisha said, 'When the Divine revelation of Choice was revealed, the Prophet (ﷺ) started with me, saying to me, 'I am telling you something, but you need not hurry to give the reply till you can consult your parents." `Aisha knew that her parents would not advise her to part with the Prophet (ﷺ) . The Prophet (ﷺ) said that Allah had said: 'O Prophet! Say To your wives; If you desire The life of this world And its glitter, ... then come! I will make a provision for you and set you free In a handsome manner. But if you seek Allah And His Apostle, and The Home of the Hereafter, then Verily, Allah has prepared For the good-doers amongst you A great reward.' (33.28) `Aisha said, 'Am I to consult my parents about this? I indeed prefer Allah, His Apostle, and the Home of the Hereafter.' After that the Prophet (ﷺ) gave the choice to his other wives and they also gave the same reply as `Aisha did
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Main Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se un do khawatin ke baare mein poochne ke liye betaab tha, Nabi ki biwiyon mein se, jinke baare mein Allah ne (Quran mein) kaha: "Agar tum dono (Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) aur Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا)) tauba karo Allah ki taraf, tumhare dil zaroor jhuk chuke hain (Nabi ki napasand cheez ke khilaf)" (66:4), jab tak maine Umar ke saath Hajj kiya (aur wapasi mein) woh ek taraf gaye (qaza-e-hajat ke liye) aur main bhi unke saath ek paani ka bartan lekar gaya. Jab woh khatam karke wapas aaye, maine unke haathon par paani daala aur unhone wudu kiya. Maine pucha: "Aye Momino ke Ameer! (Bataiye) woh do khawatin kaun thi jinke baare mein Allah ne kaha: 'Agar tum dono tauba karo...' (66:4)?" Unhone kaha: "Mujhe tumhare sawaal par hairat hai, Aye Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ). Woh Ayesha aur Hafsa thi." Phir Umar ne poori kahani sunaee aur kaha: "Main aur mera ek Ansari padosi, Bani Umaiya bin Zaid se, jo Awali Al-Madina mein rehte the, hum baari-baari Nabi se milne jaate the. Woh ek din jate aur main doosre din. Jab main jata, main use us din ki khabar lata deeni hukmon aur farmaanon ke baare mein, aur jab woh jate, woh mere liye wahi karte. Hum Quraish log auraton par hukumat rakhte the, magar jab hum Ansaar ke saath rehne aaye, humne dekha ke Ansaari auraton ka apne mardon par khaas haath tha, isliye humari aurten bhi Ansaari auraton ki aadten apnane lagi. Ek baar maine apni biwi par chillaya aur usne mujhe usi tarah jawab diya, aur mujhe napasand aaya ke woh mujhe waapas jawab de. Usne kaha: 'Tum kyun bura maante ho ke main tumhe jawab deti hoon? Allah ki qasam, Nabi ki biwiyaan unhe jawab deti hain, aur kuch to poore din-raat unse baat tak nahi karti.' Uski baat ne mujhe daraya aur maine usse kaha: 'Unme se jo bhi aisa kare, woh bahut nuqsaan uthaegi.' Phir maine kapde pehne aur Hafsa ke paas gaya aur pucha: 'Kya tum mein se koi Allah ke Rasool ko poore din-raat naraaj rakhti hai?' Unhone haan mein jawab diya. Maine kaha: 'Woh barbaad aur nuqsaan uthane wali hai! Kya usse dar nahi ke Allah, Allah ke Rasool ke gusse ki wajah se naraaj ho jaaye aur woh barbaad ho jaaye? Allah ke Rasool se zyada sawaal mat poocho, aur kisi bhi surat mein unhe jawab mat dena, aur unhe chhodna mat. Mujhse jo chaho maango, aur apni padosin (Ayesha) ki tarah Nabi ke saath suluk karne ke lalach mein mat aana, kyunke woh (Ayesha) tumse zyada khoobsurat hain, aur Allah ke Rasool ko tumse zyada aziz hain.'" Un dinon yeh afvaah thi ke Ghassan (Sham mein rehne wala ek qabila) humpar hamla karne ke liye apne ghode taiyaar kar raha hai. Mera sathi Nabi ke paas apni baari ke din gaya, aur raat ko wapas aaya aur mere darwaze par zor se dastak di, poochte huye kya main so raha tha. Main daar gaya (zordaar dastak se) aur unke paas bahar gaya. Unhone kaha ke ek badi baat hui hai. Maine pucha: "Kya baat hai? Kya Ghassan aa gaye?" Unhone jawab diya ke yeh usse bhi bada aur zyada sanjeeda hai, aur joda ke Allah ke Rasool ne apni sab biwiyon ko talaq de di hai. Maine kaha: "Hafsa barbaad aur nuqsaan uthane wali hai! Mujhe pata tha yeh kabhi na kabhi hoga." Isliye maine kapde pehne aur Nabi ke saath Fajr ki namaz padhi. Phir Nabi ek oonche kamre mein daakhil hue aur akele wahan rahe. Main Hafsa ke paas gaya aur unhe rote paaya. Maine pucha: "Tum kyun ro rahi ho? Kya maine tumhe pehle nahi bataya tha? Kya Allah ke Rasool ne tum sab ko talaq de di?" Unhone jawab diya: "Mujhe nahi pata. Woh wahan oonche kamre mein hain." Phir main bahar gaya aur mimbar ke paas aaya aur logon ka ek giroh uske aas-paas paaya, aur unme se kuch ro rahe the. Phir main kuch der unke saath baitha, magar yeh halaat sehen nahi kar saka. Isliye main us oonche kamre ke paas gaya jahan Nabi the aur unke kaale gulaam se kaha: "Kya tum Umar ke liye (andar aane ki) ijazat lo ge?" Gulaam andar gaya, Nabi se baat ki aur bahar aakar kaha: "Maine aapka zikar kiya magar unhone jawab nahi diya." Isliye main gaya aur mimbar ke paas baithe logon ke saath baitha, magar main halaat sehen nahi kar saka, isliye main phir gulaam ke paas gaya aur kaha: "Kya tum Umar ke liye ijazat loge?" Woh andar gaya aur pehle jaisa hi jawab lekar aaya. Jab main jaane laga, achanak gulaam ne mujhe bulaya aur kaha: "Allah ke Rasool ne tumhe ijazat de di hai." Isliye main Nabi ke paas daakhil hua aur unhe ek chataee par leta dekha bina bistar ke, aur chataee ne Nabi ke jism par nishaan chhod diye the, aur woh khajoor ke resse se bhare chamde ke takiye par teke hue the. Maine unhe salaam kiya aur khade rehte huye kaha: "Kya aapne apni biwiyon ko talaq de di?" Unhone apni aankhein mere taraf uthaee aur na mein jawab diya. Phir khade rehte huye baatchit karte huye maine kaha: "Kya aap woh sunenge jo main kehna chahta hoon, Ya Allah ke Rasool! Hum Quraish log apni auraton (biwiyon) par khaas haath rakhte the, aur jab hum un logon ke paas aaye jinki auraton ka unpar khaas haath tha..." Umar ne poori kahani sunaee (apni biwi ke baare mein). "Isspar Nabi muskuraye." Umar ne aage kaha: "Maine phir kaha, 'Main Hafsa ke paas gaya aur unse kaha: apni sathi (Ayesha) ki tarah suluk karne ke lalach mein mat aana kyunke woh tumse zyada khoobsurat hain aur Nabi ko tumse zyada aziz hain.' Nabi phir muskuraye. Jab maine unhe muskurate dekha, main baith gaya aur kamre par nazar daali, aur Allah ki qasam, mujhe koi ahamiyat wali cheez nazar nahi aayi siwaye teen khalon (hides) ke. Maine (Allah ke Rasool se) kaha: 'Allah se dua kijiye ke woh aapke pairokaron ko khushhaal kare, kyunke Farsiyon aur Rumiyon ko khushhaal kiya gaya hai aur unhe duniyawi aish-o-aaram diya gaya hai, chahe woh Allah ki ibadat nahi karte.' Nabi tab tek rahe the (aur mera baat sunkar seedhe baithe) aur kaha: 'Aye Ibn Al-Khattab! Kya tumhe koi shak hai (ke Aakhirat is duniya se behtar hai)? In logon ko unke neik amalon ka ajr sirf is duniya mein de diya gaya hai.' Maine Nabi se pucha: 'Kripya mere liye Allah se maafi maangiye.' Nabi apni biwiyon ke paas is raaz ki wajah se nahi gaye jo Hafsa ne Ayesha ko bataya tha, aur unhone kaha ke woh ek mahine tak apni biwiyon ke paas nahi jaayenge kyunke woh unse naraaj the jab Allah ne unhe (unki qasam ke baare mein, ke woh Maria ke paas nahi jaayenge) tanbih ki. Jab unnatis (29) din guzar gaye, Nabi sabse pehle Ayesha ke paas gaye. Unhone unse kaha: 'Aapne qasam khai thi ke aap humare paas ek mahine tak nahi aayenge, aur aaj sirf unnatis din guzre hain, kyunke maine unhe din-ba-din gina hai.' Nabi ne kaha: 'Mahina unnatis din ka bhi hota hai.' Woh mahina unnatis din ka tha." Ayesha ne kaha: "Jab ikhtiyaar (Choice) ki wahi nazil hui, Nabi mere se shuru hue, mujhse kehte huye: 'Main tumhe kuch batana chahta hoon, magar tumhe jawab dene mein jaldi nahi karni chahiye jab tak tum apne maa-baap se salaah na le lo.'" Ayesha ko pata tha ke uske maa-baap use kabhi Nabi se alag hone ki salaah nahi denge. Nabi ne kaha ke Allah ne farmaya: "Aye Nabi! Apni biwiyon se kaho: 'Agar tum is duniya ki zindagi aur uski chamak-dhamak chahti ho, ... aao! Main tumhe kuch dunga aur tumhe khoobsurati se azaad kar dunga. Magar agar tum Allah, uske Rasool, aur Aakhirat ke ghar ko chahti ho, to Allah ne tum mein se neik logon ke liye bada ajr taiyaar kiya hai'" (33:28). Ayesha ne kaha: "Kya iske baare mein main apne maa-baap se salaah loon? Main zaroor Allah, uske Rasool aur Aakhirat ke ghar ko tarjih deti hoon." Iske baad, Nabi ne apni doosri biwiyon ko bhi ikhtiyaar diya aur unhone bhi Ayesha jaisa hi jawab diya.

e: Narrated Anas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took an oath that he would not go to his wives for one month as his foot had been sprained. He stayed in an upper room when `Umar went to him and said, "Have you divorced your wives?" He said, "No, but I have taken an oath that I would not go to them for one month." The Prophet stayed there for twenty-nine days, and then came down and went to his wives
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne qasam khaee ke woh ek mahine tak apni biwiyon ke paas nahi jaayenge kyunke unke paon mein moch aayi thi. Woh ek oonche kamre mein rahe jab Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) unke paas gaye aur pucha: "Kya aapne apni biwiyon ko talaq de di?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi, magar maine qasam khaee hai ke main unke paas ek mahine tak nahi jaunga." Nabi wahan unnatis din tak rahe, phir neeche aaye aur apni biwiyon ke paas gaye.

e: Narrated Jabir:The Prophet (ﷺ) entered the Mosque, and I too went there after tying the camel at the pavement of the Mosque. I said (to the Prophet (ﷺ) ), "This is your camel." He came out and started examining the camel and said, "Both the camel and its price are for you
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi masjid mein daakhil hue, aur main bhi wahan gaya apni untni ko masjid ke ferie (chabutre) par baandhkar. Maine (Nabi se) kaha: "Yeh aapki untni hai." Aap bahar aaye aur untni ki jaanch karne lage aur kaha: "Dono, untni aur uski qeemat, tumhare liye hain."

e: Narrated Hudhaifa:I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) coming (or the Prophet (ﷺ) came) to the dumps of some people and urinated there while standing
hi: Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool ko dekha (ya Nabi aaye) kuch logon ke koude-karkat (dump) ki taraf jate huye aur wahan khade hokar peshab kiya.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "While a man was on the way, he found a thorny branch of a tree there on the way and removed it. Allah thanked him for that deed and forgave him
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jabke ek shaks raaste par tha, usne wahan ek darakht ki kaantedaar shaakha paayi aur use hataya. Allah ne uske is amal ke liye uska shukriya ada kiya aur use maaf kar diya."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) judged that seven cubits should be left as a public way when there was a dispute about the land
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne faisla diya ke saat haath (cubits) public raaste ke liye chhodne chahiye jab zameen ke baare mein jhagda ho.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Yazid Al-Ansari:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade robbery (taking away what belongs to others without their permission), and also forbade mutilation (or maiming) of bodies
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Yazid Al-Ansari (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne dakaiti (doosron ki cheez unki ijazat ke bina lena) se mana kiya, aur laashon ko vikrit karne se bhi mana kiya.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When an adulterer commits illegal sexual intercourse, then he is not a believer at the time, he is doing it, and when a drinker of an alcoholic liquor drinks it, then he is not a believer at the time of drinking it, and when a thief steals, then he is not a believer at the time of stealing, and when a robber robs, and the people look at him, then he is not a believer at the time of doing robbery
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jab zaani zina karta hai, us waqt woh momin nahi hota; aur jab sharaabi sharaab pita hai, us waqt woh momin nahi hota; aur jab chor chori karta hai, us waqt woh momin nahi hota; aur jab dakait dakaiti karta hai aur log use dekhte hain, us waqt woh momin nahi hota."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The Hour will not be established until the son of Mary (i.e. Jesus) descends amongst you as a just ruler, he will break the cross, kill the pigs, and abolish the Jizya tax. Money will be in abundance so that nobody will accept it (as charitable gifts)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Qiyamat tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak Maryam ke bete (Isa) tum logon ke beech ek insaaf pasand hukmaran ke tor par nahi utarte, woh Cross todenge, khinzeer qatl karenge, aur Jizya khatam kar denge. Paisa itna bahut zyada hoga ke koi bhi (Zakat) qubool nahi karega."

e: Narrated Salama bin Al-Akwa`:On the day of Khaibar the Prophet (ﷺ) saw fires being lighted. He asked, "Why are these fires being lighted?" The people replied that they were cooking the meat of donkeys. He said, "Break the pots and throw away their contents." The people said, "Shall we throw away their contents and wash the pots (rather than break them)?" He said, "Wash them
hi: Salama bin Al-Akwa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Khaibar ke din, Nabi ne aag jalte dekhe. Aap ne pucha: "Yeh aag kyun jal rahi hai?" Logon ne jawab diya ke woh gadhon ka gosht paka rahe hain. Aap ne kaha: "Bartan tod do aur unka saaman phenk do." Logon ne pucha: "Kya hum saaman phenk kar bartan dho len (bajaye todne ke)?" Aap ne kaha: "Unhe dho lo."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Mas`ud:The Prophet (ﷺ) entered Mecca and (at that time) there were three hundred-and-sixty idols around the Ka`ba. He started stabbing the idols with a stick he had in his hand and reciting: "Truth (Islam) has come and Falsehood (disbelief) has vanished
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi Mecca mein daakhil hue aur (us waqt) Ka'ba ke aas-paas teen sau saath but the. Unhone apne haath ki chhadi se buton ko chubhona shuru kiya aur padha: "Haqq (Islam) aa gaya aur baatil (kufr) mit gaya."

e: Narrated Al-Qasim:Aisha said that she hung a curtain decorated with pictures (of animals) on a cupboard. The Prophet (ﷺ) tore that curtain and she turned it into two cushions which remained in the house for the Prophet (ﷺ) to sit on
hi: Al-Qasim bataate hain: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha ke unhone (tasveeron wali) ek chadar apni almari par lataee. Nabi ne woh chadar phad di aur unhone use do takion mein badal diya jo ghar mein Nabi ke baithne ke liye reh gaye.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr bin Al-`As:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Whoever is killed while protecting his property then he is a martyr
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Aas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Maine Nabi ko farmate suna: "Jo koi apni maal ki hifazat karte huye qatl kiya jaaye, woh shaheed hai."

e: Narrated Anas:While the Prophet (ﷺ) was with one of his wives, one of the mothers of the believers (i.e. one of his wives) sent a wooden bowl containing food with a servant. The wife (in whose house he was sitting) stroke the bowl with her hand and broke it. The Prophet (ﷺ) collected the shattered pieces and put the food back in it and said, "Eat." He kept the servant and the bowl till he had eaten the food. Then the Prophet gave another unbroken. bowl to the servant and kept the broken one
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jabke Nabi apni ek biwi ke paas the, momino ki maaon mein se ek (yaani unki ek doosri biwi) ne khaana se bhara ek lakdi ka bartan ek khaadim ke saath bheja. Biwi (jinke ghar Nabi baithe the) ne bartan par apna haath maara aur ise tod diya. Nabi ne bikhare hue tukde jama kiye aur khaana wapas usme rakha aur kaha: "Khao." Aap ne khaadim aur bartan ko apne paas rakha jab tak Aap ne khaana khatam nahi kiya. Phir Nabi ne khaadim ko doosra saboot bartan diya aur tote hue bartan ko rakh liya.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "There was an Israeli man called Juraij, while he was praying, his mother came and called him, but he did not respond to her call. He said (to himself) whether he should continue the prayer or reply to his mother. She came to him the second time and called him and said, "O Allah! Do not let him die until he sees the faces of prostitutes." Juraij used to live in a hermitage. A woman said that she would entice Juraij, so she went to him and presented herself (for an evil act) but he refused. She then went to a shepherd and allowed him to commit an illegal sexual intercourse with her and later she gave birth to a boy. She alleged that the baby was from Juraij. The people went to Juraij and broke down his hermitage, pulled him out of it and abused him. He performed ablution and offered the prayer, then he went to the male (baby) and asked him; "O boy! Who is your father?" The baby replied that his father was the shepherd. The people said that they would build for him a hermitage of gold but Juraij asked them to make it of mud only
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Bani Israel mein Juraij naam ka ek shaks tha. Jabke woh namaz padh raha tha, uski maa aayi aur use bulaya, magar usne unki pukaar ka jawab nahi diya. Usne (khud se) socha ke kya use namaz jaari rakhni chahiye ya apni maa ko jawab dena chahiye. Woh doosri baar aaye aur use bulaya aur kaha: 'Aye Allah! Ise tab tak mat maar jab tak yeh veshyaon ke chehre na dekh le.' Juraij ek kutya (hermitage) mein rehta tha. Ek aurat ne kaha ke woh Juraij ko behka legi, isliye woh uske paas gayi aur khud ko (bure kaam ke liye) pesh kiya magar usne inkaar kiya. Phir woh ek charwahe ke paas gayi aur use apne saath zina karne ki ijazat di aur baad mein usne ek ladka janam diya. Usne dawa kiya ke bachcha Juraij ka hai. Log Juraij ke paas gaye aur uski kutiya tod di, use bahar khinch liya aur uska apman kiya. Usne wudu kiya aur namaz padhi, phir woh us ladke ke paas gaya aur usse pucha: 'Aye ladke! Tera baap kaun hai?' Bachche ne jawab diya ki uska baap charwaha hai. Logon ne kaha ke woh uske liye sone ki kutiya banaenge magar Juraij ne unse mitti ki hi banane ko kaha."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:"Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent an army towards the east coast and appointed Abu 'Ubaida bin Al-Jarrah as their chief, and the army consisted of three-hundred men including myself. We marched on till we reached a place where our food was about to finish. Abu- 'Ubaida ordered us to collect all the journey food and it was collected. My (our) journey food was dates. Abu 'Ubaida kept on giving us our daily ration in small amounts from it, till it was exhausted. The share of everyone of us used to be one date only." I said, "How could one date benefit you?" Jabir replied, "We came to know its value when even that too finished." Jabir added, "When we reached the sea-shore, we saw a huge fish which was like a small mountain. The army ate from it for eighteen days. Then Abu 'Ubaida ordered that two of its ribs be fixed and they were fixed in the ground. Then he ordered that a she-camel be ridden and it passed under the two ribs (forming an arch) without touching them
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Allah ke Rasool ne mashriqi taat ki taraf ek fauj bheji aur Abu Ubaida bin Al-Jarrah ko unka sardaar muqarrar kiya, aur fauj mein teen sau log the, main bhi unme se ek tha. Hum chalte rahe jab tak humara raashan khatam hone laga. Abu Ubaida ne humein humara sab safar ka khaana jama karne ka hukum diya, aur ise jama kiya gaya. Humara (mera) safar ka khaana khajoor tha. Abu Ubaida humein rozana thodi thodi maqdaar dete rahe, jab tak woh khatam ho gaya. Har ek ko sirf ek hi khajoor milti thi." Maine kaha: "Ek khajoor tumhe kya faida degi?"
