Jabir ne jawab diya: "Humein iski qeemat ka pata tab chala jab woh bhi khatam ho gayi." Jabir ne joda: "Jab hum samundar ke kinare pahunche, humne ek badi machhli dekhi jo ek chhote pahad jaisi thi. Fauj ne athaarah din tak ise khaya. Phir Abu Ubaida ne uski do paslion ko khada karvaya aur unhe zameen mein gada diya. Phir unhone ek untni ko sawar karvaya jo un donon paslion ke neeche se (jinse ek dhanush-jaisa aakaar banta tha) bina chhuye guzar gayi."

e: Narrated Salama:Once (on a journey) our provisions diminished and the people were reduced to poverty. They went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and asked his permission to slaughter their camels, and he agreed. `Umar met them and they told him about it, and he said, "How would you survive after slaughtering your camels?" Then he went to the Prophet and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! How would they survive after slaughtering their camels?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered `Umar, "Call upon the people to bring what has remained of their food." A leather sheet was spread and all the food was collected and heaped over it. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up and invoked Allah to bless it, and then directed all the people to come with their utensils, and they started taking from it till all of them got what was sufficient for them. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then said, "I testify that None has the right to be worshipped but Allah, and I am His Messenger
hi: Salama (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar (safar mein) humara raashan kam ho gaya aur log gareebi mein aa gaye. Woh Nabi ke paas gaye aur apne unton ko zabah karne ki ijazat maangi, aur unhone maan liya. Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) unse mile aur unhone use bataya, aur unhone kaha: "Apne unton ko zabah karne ke baad tum kaise zinda rahoge?" Phir woh Nabi ke paas gaye aur kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Apne unton ko zabah karne ke baad woh kaise zinda rahenge?" Allah ke Rasool ne Umar ko hukum diya: "Logon ko bulao ke woh apna bacha hua khaana laayen." Ek chamde ki chadar bichhaee gayi aur sab khaana jama karke uspar dher kiya gaya. Allah ke Rasool khade hue aur isme barkat ke liye Allah se dua ki, phir sab logon ko apne bartan lekar aane ka hukum diya, aur woh usse lene lage jab tak sabko unki zaroorat ke mutabiq mil gaya. Allah ke Rasool ne phir kaha: "Main gawahi deta hoon ke Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahi, aur main uska Rasool hoon."

e: Narrated Rafi` bin Khadij:We used to offer the `Asr prayer with the Prophet (ﷺ) and slaughter a camel, the meat of which would be divided in ten parts. We would eat the cooked meat before sunset
hi: Rafi bin Khadij (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Nabi ke saath Asr ki namaz padhte the aur ek unt zabah karte the, jiska gosht das hisson mein baanta jata. Hum suraj doobne se pehle pakka hua gosht kha lete the.

e: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When the people of Ash`ari tribe ran short of food during the holy battles, or the food of their families in Medina ran short, they would collect all their remaining food in one sheet and then distribute it among themselves equally by measuring it with a bowl. So, these people are from me, and I am from them
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jab Ash'ari qabile ke log muqaddas jungon mein apna khaana khatam kar dete, ya Madina mein unke pariwara ka khaana khatam ho jata, woh apna baacha khaana ek chadar mein jama karte aur phir use ek katore se naapkar aapas mein barabar taqseem karte. Isliye yeh log mere hain aur main inka hoon."

e: Narrated Anas:that Abu Bakr As-Siddiq wrote to him the law of Zakat which was made obligatory by Allah's Apostle. He wrote: 'Partners possessing joint property (sheep) have to pay its Zakat equally
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Bakr As-Siddiq ne unhe Zakat ka woh qanoon likha jise Allah ke Rasool ne farz kiya tha. Unhone likha: "Saanjhi maal (bhedon) ke maalikon ko iska Zakat barabar ada karna hai."

e: Narrated 'Abaya bin Rifa'a bin Rafi' bin Khadij:My grandfather said, "We were in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) at Dhul-Hulaifa. The people felt hungry and captured some camels and sheep (as booty). The Prophet (ﷺ) was behind the people. They hurried and slaughtered the animals and put their meat in pots and started cooking it. (When the Prophet came) he ordered the pots to be upset and then he distributed the animals (of the booty), regarding ten sheep as equal to one camel. One of the camels fled and the people ran after it till they were exhausted. At that time there were few horses. A man threw an arrow at the camel, and Allah stopped the camel with it. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Some of these animals are like wild animals, so if you lose control over one of these animals, treat it in this way (i.e. shoot it with an arrow)." Before distributing them among the soldiers my grandfather said, "We may meet the enemies in the future and have no knives; can we slaughter the animals with reeds?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Use whatever causes blood to flow, and eat the animals if the name of Allah has been mentioned on slaughtering them. Do not slaughter with teeth or fingernails and I will tell you why: It is because teeth are bones (i.e. cannot cut properly) and fingernails are the tools used by the Ethiopians (whom we should not imitate for they are infidels)
hi: Abaya bin Rifa'a bin Rafi bin Khadij (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Mere dada ne kaha: "Hum Nabi ke saath Dhul-Hulaifa mein the. Logon ko bhookh lagi aur unhone kuch unt aur bheden (maal-e-ghanimat mein) pakade. Nabi logon se peeche the. Woh jaldi mein zabah karke unka gosht bartanon mein daal kar pakana shuru kar diye. (Jab Nabi aaye) unhone bartanon ko ulat dene ka hukum diya aur phir maal-e-ghanimat taqseem kiya, das bhedon ko ek unt ke barabar samajhte huye. Ek unt bhaag gaya aur log uske peeche daude jab tak woh thak gaye. Us waqt kam ghode the. Ek shaks ne unt par teer maara aur Allah ne teer se unt ko roka. Nabi ne kaha: 'Inme se kuch janwar jangli janwaron jaise hain, isliye agar tum inme se kisi par kaboo kho dete ho, isi tarah karo (yaani teer maaro).'" Sipahiyon mein taqseem karne se pehle, mere dada ne kaha: "Ho sakta hai humari dushman se mulaqaat ho aur humare paas chaku na ho; kya hum janwar ko narkal se zabah kar sakte hain?" Nabi ne kaha: "Jisse bhi khoon nikle, use istemal karo, aur janwar khao agar unhe zabah karte waqt Allah ka naam liya gaya ho. Daanton ya naakhunon se zabah mat karo aur main tumhe batata hoon kyun: Kyunke daant hadiyan hain (theek se kaat nahi sakte) aur naakhun Ethiopiyon ke istemal ke auzaar hain (jinki hum nakal nahi karte, kyunke woh kaafir hain)."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) decreed that one should not eat two dates together at a time unless he gets the permission from his companions (sharing the meal with him)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne faisla diya ke koi ek saath do khajoor na khaye jab tak apne sathiyon (jinke saath khaana share kar raha hai) se ijazat na le.

e: Narrated Jabala:"While at Medina we were struck with famine. Ibn Az-Zubair used to provide us with dates as our food. Ibn `Umar used to pass by us and say, "Don't eat two dates together at a time as the Prophet (ﷺ) has forbidden eating two dates together at a time (in a gathering) unless one takes the permission of one's companion brother
hi: Jabala bataate hain: "Madina mein rehte huye humein akaal ne pareshaan kiya. Ibn Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) humein khaane ke liye khajoor dete. Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) humare paas se guzarte aur kehte: 'Ek saath do khajoor mat khao kyunke Nabi ne ek saath do khajoor khaane se mana kiya hai (ek jamaat mein), jab tak koi apne sathi bhai se ijazat na le.'"

e: Narrated Nafi`:Ibn `Umar said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'If one manumits his share of a jointly possessed slave, and can afford the price of the other shares according to the adequate price of the slave, the slave will be completely manumitted; otherwise he will be partially manumitted.' " (Aiyub, a sub-narrator is not sure whether the saying " ... otherwise he will be partially manumitted" was said by Nafi` or the Prophet)
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: 'Agar koi saanjhi milkiyat wale gulaam mein apna hissa azaad karta hai, aur woh baaki hisson ki qeemat gulaam ki munasib qeemat ke mutabiq de sakta hai, gulaam poori tarah azaad ho jaayega; warna woh sirf ansik tor par azaad hoga.'" (Aiyub, doosre raawi ko yaqeen nahi ke "...warna woh sirf ansik tor par azaad hoga" yeh baat Nafi ne kahi ya Nabi ne.)

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever manumits his share of a jointly possessed slave, it is imperative for him to get that slave manumitted completely by paying the remaining price, and if he does not have sufficient money to manumit him, then the price of the slave should be estimated justly, and he is to be allowed to work and earn the amount that will manumit him (without overburdening him)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jo koi saanjhi milkiyat wale gulaam mein apna hissa azaad karta hai, uske liye zaroori hai ke baaki qeemat dekar gulaam ko poori tarah azaad karvaye, aur agar uske paas iske liye kaafi paisa nahi hai, to gulaam ki qeemat sahi tarah lagaee jaani chahiye, aur usse kaam karke woh maqdaar kamane ki ijazat honi chahiye jo use azaad kar de (uspar zyada bojh dale bina)."

e: Narrated An-Nu`man bin Bashir:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The example of the person abiding by Allah's order and restrictions in comparison to those who violate them is like the example of those persons who drew lots for their seats in a boat. Some of them got seats in the upper part, and the others in the lower. When the latter needed water, they had to go up to bring water (and that troubled the others), so they said, 'Let us make a hole in our share of the ship (and get water) saving those who are above us from troubling them. So, if the people in the upper part left the others do what they had suggested, all the people of the ship would be destroyed, but if they prevented them, both parties would be safe
hi: An-Nu'man bin Bashir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jo Allah ke hukmon aur seemaon ka paalan karta hai unki misaal, un logon ke muqaable jo unka ullanghan karte hain, un logon jaisi hai jinhone ek kashti mein apni jagahon ke liye chithi daali. Kuch ko oopar wali jagahein mili aur kuch ko neeche wali. Jab neeche walon ko paani ki zaroorat padti, unhe (upar jaane ka) safar karna padta (aur isse doosre pareshaan hote), isliye unhone kaha: 'Chalo hum apne hisse ki kashti mein ek surakh banate hain (aur paani le lete hain), taake hum upar walo ko pareshaan na karen.' Isliye, agar upar wale unhe woh karne den jo unhone sujhaya, sab log kashti mein tabaah ho jaate, magar agar unhone unhe rok diya, dono taraf mehfooz rahenge."

e: Narrated `Urwa bin Az-Zubair:That he had asked `Aisha about the meaning of the Statement of Allah: "If you fear that you shall not Be able to deal justly With the orphan girls, then Marry (Other) women of your choice Two or three or four." (4.3) She said, "O my nephew! This is about the orphan girl who lives with her guardian and shares his property. Her wealth and beauty may tempt him to marry her without giving her an adequate Mahr (bridal-money) which might have been given by another suitor. So, such guardians were forbidden to marry such orphan girls unless they treated them justly and gave them the most suitable Mahr; otherwise they were ordered to marry any other woman." `Aisha further said, "After that verse the people again asked the Prophet (about the marriage with orphan 'girls), so Allah revealed the following verses:-- 'They ask your instruction Concerning the women. Say: Allah Instructs you about them And about what is Recited unto you In the Book, concerning The orphan girls to whom You give not the prescribed portions and yet whom you Desire to marry..." (4.127) What is meant by Allah's Saying:-- 'And about what is Recited unto you is the former verse which goes:-- 'If you fear that you shall not Be able to deal justly With the orphan girls, then Marry (other) women of your choice.' (4.3) `Aisha said, "Allah's saying in the other verse:--'Yet whom you desire to marry' (4.127) means the desire of the guardian to marry an orphan girl under his supervision when she has not much property or beauty (in which case he should treat her justly). The guardians were forbidden to marry their orphan girls possessing property and beauty without being just to them, as they generally refrain from marrying them (when they are neither beautiful nor wealthy)
hi: Urwa bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Unhone Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se Allah ke is farmaan ka matlab pucha: "Agar tumhe dar hai ke tum yateem ladkiyon ke saath insaaf nahi kar paoge, to (doosri) auraton se shaadi karo jo tumhe pasand hon, do, teen, ya chaar" (4:3). Unhone kaha: "Aye mere bhatije! Yeh un yateem ladkiyon ke baare mein hai jo apne sarparast ke saath rehti hain aur uska maal mein hissedaar hoti hain. Uski daulat aur khoobsurati use lalach de sakti hai ke woh usse bina munasib mehar diye shaadi kare jo koi doosra suitor deta. Isliye aise sarparaston ko aisi yateem ladkiyon se shaadi karne se mana kiya gaya jab tak woh unke saath insaaf na karen aur unhe behtareen mehar na den; warna unhe kisi doosri aurat se shaadi karne ka hukum diya gaya." Ayesha ne aage kaha: "Us ayat ke baad, logon ne Nabi se phir pucha (yateem ladkiyon se shaadi ke baare mein), isliye Allah ne yeh ayaat nazil ki: 'Woh tumse aurton ke baare mein hidayat maangte hain. Kaho: Allah tumhe unke baare mein aur Kitaab mein tumhe padhi jaane wali baaton ke baare mein hidayat deta hai, un yateem ladkiyon ke baare mein jinhe tum unka muqarrar hissa nahi dete phir bhi unse shaadi karne ki khwahish rakhte ho...' (4:127)." Allah ke farmaan "aur Kitaab mein tumhe padhi jaane wali baaton ke baare mein" ka matlab pehli ayat hai jo yeh hai: "Agar tumhe dar hai ke tum yateem ladkiyon ke saath insaaf nahi kar paoge, to (doosri) auraton se shaadi karo jo tumhe pasand hon" (4:3). Ayesha ne kaha: "Allah ka doosri ayat mein farmaan 'phir bhi unse shaadi karne ki khwahish rakhte ho' (4:127) ka matlab hai us sarparast ki khwahish jo apni dekhbhal mein wali yateem ladki se shaadi karna chahta hai jab uski koi khaas maal ya khoobsurati na ho (aisi surat mein use uske saath insaaf karna chahiye). Sarparaston ko apni yateem ladkiyon se, jinke paas maal aur khoobsurati thi, bina unse insaaf kiye shaadi karne se mana kiya gaya, kyunke woh unhe (jab woh na khoobsurat na maldaar hoti) hi bindar shaadi karne se bachte."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) established the right of Shu'fa (i.e. Preemption) in joint properties; but when the land is divided and the ways are demarcated, then there is no pre-emption
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne saanjhi maal mein Shuf'a (pehle khareedne ka haqq) ka haqq muqarrar kiya; magar jab zameen taqseem ho jaaye aur raaste muqarrar ho jaayen, to koi Shuf'a nahi hota.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The right of preemption is valid in every joint property, but when the land is divided and the way is demarcated, then there is no right of pre-emption
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Shuf'a ka haqq har saanjhi maal mein valid hai, magar jab zameen taqseem ho jaaye aur raaste muqarrar ho jaayen, to koi Shuf'a ka haqq nahi hota."

e: Narrated Sulaiman bin Abu Muslim:I asked Abu Minhal about money exchange from hand to hand. He said, "I and a partner of mine bought something partly in cash and partly on credit." Al-Bara' bin `Azib passed by us and we asked about it. He replied, "I and my partner Zaid bin Al-Arqam did the same and then went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and asked him about it. He said, 'Take what was from hand to hand and leave what was on credit
hi: Sulaiman bin Abu Muslim bataate hain: Maine Abu Minhal se haath-se-haath paise ki adla-badli ke baare mein pucha. Unhone kaha: "Main aur mera sajhedaaar ne kuch khareeda tha, kuch nagad aur kuch udhaar par." Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) humare paas se guzre aur humne unse iske baare mein pucha. Unhone jawab diya: "Main aur mera sajhedaaar Zaid bin Al-Arqam ne bhi yehi kiya tha aur phir Nabi ke paas gaye aur unse iske baare mein pucha. Unhone kaha: 'Jo haath se haath hua use lo aur jo udhaar par hua use chhod do.'"

e: Narrated `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) rented the land of Khaibar to the Jews on the condition that they would work on it and cultivate it and take half of its yield
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Khaibar ki zameen Yahudiyon ko is shart par kiraye par di ke woh isme kaam aur kheti karenge, aur iski paidawaar ka aadha hissa lenge.

e: Narrated `Uqba bin 'Amir:that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave him some sheep to distribute among his companions in order to sacrifice them and a kid was left. He told the Prophet (ﷺ) about it and the Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "Sacrifice it on your behalf
hi: Uqba bin Amir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne unhe kuch bhedein di apne sahaba mein qurbani ke liye taqseem karne ko, aur ek bacha (bakri ka) reh gaya. Unhone Nabi ko iske baare mein bataya aur Nabi ne unse kaha: "Ise apni taraf se qurbani ke tor par zabah karo."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Hisham:that his mother Zainab bint Humaid took him to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Take the pledge of allegiance from him." But he said, "He is still too young for the pledge," and passed his hand on his (i.e. `Abdullah's) head and invoked for Allah's blessing for him. Zuhra bin Ma`bad stated that he used to go with his grandfather, `Abdullah bin Hisham, to the market to buy foodstuff. Ibn `Umar and Ibn Az-Zubair would meet him and say to him, "Be our partner, as the Prophet (ﷺ) invoked Allah to bless you." So, he would be their partner, and very often he would win a camel's load and send it home
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Hisham (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Unki maa Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Humaid unhe Nabi ke paas le gaee aur kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Isse bai'at kar leeye." Magar Aap ne kaha: "Woh bai'at ke liye abhi bahut chhota hai," aur unke (Abdullah ke) sar par apna haath phera aur unke liye Allah se dua ki. Zuhra bin Ma'bad ne bataya ke woh apne dada, Abdullah bin Hisham, ke saath bazaar jate khaane ki cheezein khareedne. Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Ibn Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) unse milte aur kehte: "Humare sajhedaaar bano, kyunke Nabi ne aapke liye Allah se barkat ki dua ki hai." Isliye woh unke sajhedaaar ban jate, aur aksar unhe ek unt bhar jitna faida hota aur woh ise apne ghar bhej dete.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever manumits his share of a jointly possessed slave, it is imperative on him to manumit the slave completely if he has sufficient money to pay the rest of its price which is to be estimated justly. He should pay his partners their shares and release him (the freed one)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jo koi saanjhi milkiyat wale gulaam mein apna hissa azaad karta hai, uske liye zaroori hai ke gulaam ko poori tarah azaad karvaye agar uske paas baaki qeemat ada karne ke liye kaafi paisa hai, jise munasib tareeke se lagaya jaana chahiye. Use apne sajhedaaron ko unka hissa dena chahiye aur use (azaad kiye gulaam ko) chhod dena chahiye."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever manumits his share of a jointly possessed slave, it is essential for him to manumit the slave completely if he has sufficient money. Otherwise he should look for some work for the slave (to earn what would enable him to emancipate himself), without overburdening him with work
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jo koi saanjhi milkiyat wale gulaam mein apna hissa azaad karta hai, uske liye zaroori hai ke gulaam ko poori tarah azaad karvaye agar uske paas kaafi paisa hai. Warna use gulaam ke liye koi kaam dhoondna chahiye (taake woh apni azaadi ke liye kaafi paisa kama sake), uspar zyada bojh daale bina."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (along with his companions) reached Mecca in the morning of the fourth of Dhul-Hijja assuming Ihram for Hajj only. So when we arrived at Mecca, the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered us to change our intentions of the Ihram for `Umra and that we could finish our Ihram after performing the `Umra and could go to our wives (for sexual intercourse). The people began talking about that. Jabir said surprisingly, "Shall we go to Mina while semen is dribbling from our male organs?" Jabir moved his hand while saying so. When this news reached the Prophet (ﷺ) he delivered a sermon and said, "I have been informed that some peoples were saying so and so; By Allah I fear Allah more than you do, and am more obedient to Him than you. If I had known what I know now, I would not have brought the Hadi (sacrifice) with me and had the Hadi not been with me, I would have finished the Ihram." At that Suraqa bin Malik stood up and asked "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Is this permission for us only or is it forever?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "It is forever." In the meantime `Ali bin Abu Talib came from Yemen and was saying Labbaik for what the Prophet (ﷺ) has intended. (According to another man, `Ali was saying Labbaik for Hajj similar to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)). The Prophet (ﷺ) told him to keep on the Ihram and let him share the Hadi with him
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi (apne sahaba ke saath) 4 Zul-Hijja ki subah Mecca pahunche, sirf Hajj ka Ihram baandhe hue. Isliye jab hum Mecca pahunche, Nabi ne humein apni Ihram ki niyyat Umrah mein badalne ka hukum diya aur kaha ke hum Umrah karne ke baad apna Ihram khatam kar sakte hain aur apni biwiyon ke paas (humbistari ke liye) ja sakte hain. Log iske baare mein baat karne lage. Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne hairat se kaha: "Kya hum Mina jaayein jabke humare mard ke ang se veerya (semen) tap raha ho?" Jabir ne yeh kehte huye apna haath hilaya. Jab yeh baat Nabi tak pahunchi, unhone khutba diya aur kaha: "Mujhe bataya gaya hai ke kuch log aisa-aisa keh rahe hain; Allah ki qasam, main tumse zyada Allah se darta hoon, aur main tumse zyada uski itaa'at karta hoon. Agar mujhe woh pata hota jo mujhe ab pata hai, main apne saath Hadi (qurbani ka janwar) na lataa aur agar mere saath Hadi na hota, main apna Ihram khatam kar deta." Isspar Suraqa bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) khade hue aur pucha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Kya yeh ijazat sirf humare liye hai ya hamesha ke liye?" Nabi ne jawab diya: "Yeh hamesha ke liye hai." Isi dauran Ali (Alayhis Salam) bin Abu Talib Yemen se aaye aur Talbiya kah rahe the usi niyyat se jo Nabi ne rakhi thi. (Ek doosri riwaayat ke mutabiq, Ali (Alayhis Salam) Allah ke Rasool jaisi hi Hajj ki niyyat se Talbiya kah rahe the.) Nabi ne unse Ihram jaari rakhne ko kaha aur unhe apna Hadi unke saath baantne diya.

e: Narrated Abaya bin Rifaa:My grandfather, Rafi` bin Khadij said, "We were in the valley of Dhul-Hulaifa of Tihama in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) and had some camels and sheep (of the booty). The people hurried (in slaughtering the animals) and put their meat in the pots and started cooking. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came and ordered them to upset the pots, and distributed the booty considering one camel as equal to ten sheep. One of the camels fled and the people had only a few horses, so they got worried. (The camel was chased and) a man stopped the camel by throwing an arrow at it. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Some of these animals are untamed like wild animals, so if anyone of them went out of your control, then you should treat it as you have done now.' " My grandfather said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We fear that we may meet our enemy tomorrow and we have no knives, could we slaughter the animals with reeds?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Yes, or you can use what would make blood flow (slaughter) and you can eat what is slaughtered and the Name of Allah is mentioned at the time of slaughtering. But don't use teeth or fingernails (in slaughtering). I will tell you why, as for teeth, they are bones, and fingernails are used by Ethiopians for slaughtering. (See Hadith)
hi: Abaya bin Rifaa bataate hain: Mere dada, Rafi bin Khadij (رضی اللہ عنہ), ne kaha: "Hum Tihama ke Dhul-Hulaifa wadi mein Nabi ke saath the aur (maal-e-ghanimat mein) kuch unt aur bhedein thi. Logon ne jaldi ki (janwar zabah karne mein) aur unka gosht bartanon mein daalkar pakana shuru kiya. Allah ke Rasool aaye aur unhe bartanon ko ulat dene ka hukum diya, aur maal-e-ghanimat taqseem kiya, ek unt ko das bhedon ke barabar samajhte huye. Ek unt bhaag gaya aur logon ke paas sirf kuch ghode the, isliye woh pareshaan ho gaye. (Unt ka picha kiya gaya aur) ek shaks ne teer maarkar unt ko rok diya. Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: 'Inme se kuch janwar jangli janwaron jaise hain, isliye agar inme se koi tumhare kaboo se bahar chala jaaye, to isi tarah karo jaise abhi kiya.'" Mere dada ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Humein dar hai kal humari mulaqaat dushman se ho sakti hai aur humare paas chaku nahi honge, kya hum narkal se janwar zabah kar sakte hain?" Nabi ne kaha: "Haan, ya woh cheez istemal karo jisse khoon bahe (zabah), aur jo zabah kiya jaaye use khao agar zabah karte waqt Allah ka naam liya gaya ho. Magar daanton ya naakhunon se zabah mat karo. Main tumhe batata hoon kyun: daant hadiyan hain, aur naakhun Ethiopiyon dwaara zabah karne mein istemal hote hain."

e: Narrated Anas:No doubt, the Prophet (ﷺ) mortgaged his armor for barley grains. Once I took barley bread with some dissolved fat on it to the Prophet (ﷺ) and I heard him saying, "The household of Muhammad did not possess except a Sa (of food grain, barley, etc.) for both the morning and the evening meals although they were nine houses
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Beshak, Nabi ne apna zire jau ke daanon ke badle girvi rakha. Ek baar main jau ki roti Nabi ke paas ghula hua ghee ke saath lekar gaya, aur maine unhe kehte suna: "Muhammad ke pariwara ke paas kabhi subah aur shaam ke khaane ke liye ek Sa (khaane ki cheez, jau, waghera) se zyada nahi hota, chahe woh nau ghar the."

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) bought some foodstuff on credit for a limited period and mortgaged his armor for it
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi ne kuch khaane ki cheez udhaar par khareedi ek muqarrar muddat ke liye, aur uske liye apna zire girvi rakha.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Who would kill Ka`b bin Al-Ashraf as he has harmed Allah and His Apostle ?" Muhammad bin Maslama (got up and) said, "I will kill him." So, Muhammad bin Maslama went to Ka`b and said, "I want a loan of one or two Wasqs of food grains." Ka`b said, "Mortgage your women to me." Muhammad bin Maslama said, "How can we mortgage our women, and you are the most handsome among the Arabs?" He said, "Then mortgage your sons to me." Muhammad said, "How can we mortgage our sons, as the people will abuse them for being mortgaged for one or two Wasqs of food grains? It is shameful for us. But we will mortgage our arms to you." So, Muhammad bin Maslama promised him that he would come to him next time. They (Muhammad bin Maslama and his companions came to him as promised and murdered him. Then they went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and told him about it
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Kaun Ka'b bin Al-Ashraf ko qatl karega kyunke usne Allah aur uske Rasool ko nuqsaan pahunchaya hai?" Muhammad bin Maslama ne (uthkar) kaha: "Main use qatl karunga." Isliye Muhammad bin Maslama Ka'b ke paas gaye aur kaha: "Mujhe ek ya do Wasq khaane ki cheezon ka qarz chahiye." Ka'b ne kaha: "Apni aurton ko mere paas girvi rakho." Muhammad bin Maslama ne kaha: "Hum apni aurton ko kaise girvi rakh sakte hain, jabke tum Arbon mein sabse khoobsurat ho?" Usne kaha: "Phir apne beton ko mere paas girvi rakho." Muhammad ne kaha: "Hum apne beton ko kaise girvi rakh sakte hain, kyunke log unhe taane marenge ke unhe ek ya do Wasq khaane ki cheez ke liye girvi rakha gaya hai? Yeh humare liye sharam ki baat hai. Magar hum apne hathiyaar tumhare paas girvi rakh sakte hain." Isliye Muhammad bin Maslama ne usse waada kiya ke woh agli baar unke paas aayenge. (Muhammad bin Maslama aur unke sathi waade ke mutabiq unke paas aaye aur unhe qatl kar diya. Phir woh Nabi ke paas gaye aur unhe iske baare mein bataya.)

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "One can ride the mortgaged animal because of what one spends on it, and one can drink the milk of a milch animal as long as it is mortgaged
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Girvi rakhe janwar par woh khareedaari ki wajah se sawar ho sakta hai jo woh uspar kharch karta hai, aur doodh dene wale janwar ka doodh utni der pi sakta hai jitni der woh girvi rahe."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The mortgaged animal can be used for riding as long as it is fed and the milk of the milch animal can be drunk according to what one spends on it. The one who rides the animal or drinks its milk should provide the expenditures
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Girvi rakha gaya janwar sawari ke kaam aa sakta hai jab tak use khilaya jaaye, aur doodh dene wale janwar ka doodh us hisab se piya ja sakta hai jitna koi uspar kharch karta hai. Jo bhi janwar par sawar ho ya uska doodh piye, use uska kharch dena chahiye."

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) bought some foodstuff from a Jew and mortgaged his armor to him
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool ne ek Yahudi se kuch khaane ki cheez khareedi aur unhe apna zire uske paas girvi rakha.

e: Narrated Ibn Abu Mulaika:I wrote a letter to Ibn `Abbas and he wrote to me that the Prophet (ﷺ) had given the verdict that the defendant had to take an oath
hi: Ibn Abu Mulaika bataate hain: Maine Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko ek khat likha aur unhone jawab diya ke Nabi ne yeh faisla diya tha ke mudda alaih (jispar daava hai) qasam le (agar khareedaar ke paas gawah na ho).

e: Narrated Abu Wail: Abdullah (bin Mas'ud) said, "Whoever took a false oath in order to grab somebody's property will meet Allah while Allah will be angry with him." Allah revealed the following verse to confirm that:--"Verily! Those who purchase a small gain at the cost of Allah's covenant And their oaths...a painful torment." (3.77) Al-Ash'ath bin Qais came to us and asked as to what Abu Abdur-Rehman (i.e. Ibn Mas'ud) was telling you." We related the story to him. On that he said, "He has told the truth. This verse was revealed about me. I had some dispute with another man regarding a well and we took the case before Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said (to me), "Produce two witnesses (to support your claim); otherwise the defendant has the right to take an oath (to refute your claim).' I said, 'The defendant would not mind to take a false oath." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then said, 'Whoever took a false oath in order to grab someone else's property will meet Allah, Allah will be angry with him.' Allah then revealed what Confirmed it." Al-Ash'ath then recited the following Verse:--"Verily! Those who purchase a small gain at the cost of Allah's covenant, And their oaths . . . (to) . . . they shall have a painful torment!' (3.77) (See Hadith No)
hi: Abu Wail bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) (bin Mas'ud) ne kaha: "Jo koi jhuti qasam khata hai kisi ki maal hasil karne ke liye, woh Allah se aisi haalat mein milega ke Allah usse naraaj hoga." Allah ne yeh tasdeeq karne ke liye ayat nazil ki: "Beshak! Woh log jo Allah ke ahad aur apni qasmon ke badle mein thoda faaida khareedte hain..." (3:77). Al-Ash'ath bin Qais humare paas aaye aur pucha ke Abu Abdur-Rahman (yaani Ibn Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ)) unhe kya bata rahe hain. Humne unhe poori kahani sunaee. Isspar unhone kaha: "Unhone sach kaha. Yeh ayat mere baare mein nazil hui thi. Mera ek shaks se ek kue ke baare mein jhagda hua aur hum apna maamla Allah ke Rasool ke paas le gaye. Allah ke Rasool ne (mujhse) kaha: 'Do gawah pesh karo (apne daave ki tasdeeq ke liye); warna mudda alaih ko qasam lene ka haqq hai (tumhare daave ko radd karne ke liye).' Maine kaha: 'Mudda alaih jhuti qasam khane se nahi hichkichaega.' Allah ke Rasool ne phir kaha: 'Jo koi jhuti qasam khata hai kisi doosre ki maal hasil karne ke liye, woh Allah se milega aur Allah usse naraaj hoga.' Phir Allah ne is tasdeeq mein wahi nazil ki." Al-Ash'ath ne phir yeh ayat padhi: "Beshak! Woh log jo Allah ke ahad aur apni qasmon ke badle mein thoda faaida khareedte hain... (aakhir tak) ... unke liye dardnaak saza hogi!" (3:77)

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever frees a Muslim slave, Allah will save all the parts of his body from the (Hell) Fire as he has freed the body-parts of the slave." Sa`id bin Marjana said that he narrated that Hadith to `Ali bin Al-Husain and he freed his slave for whom `Abdullah bin Ja`far had offered him ten thousand Dirhams or one-thousand Dinars
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jo koi ek Musalman gulaam azaad karta hai, Allah uske jism ke sab hisso ko (Dozakh ki) aag se bachaega, jaise usne gulaam ke jism ke hisse azaad kiye." Sa'id bin Marjana ne kaha ke unhone yeh Hadith Ali (Alayhis Salam) bin Al-Husain ko sunaee aur unhone apna gulaam azaad kiya jiske liye Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ja'far ne unhe das hazaar Dirham ya ek hazaar Dinar ki pesh kash di thi.

e: Narrated Abu Dhar:I asked the Prophet, "What is the best deed?" He replied, "To believe in Allah and to fight for His Cause." I then asked, "What is the best kind of manumission (of slaves)?" He replied, "The manumission of the most expensive slave and the most beloved by his master." I said, "If I cannot afford to do that?" He said, "Help the weak or do good for a person who cannot work for himself." I said, "If I cannot do that?" He said, "Refrain from harming others for this will be regarded as a charitable deed for your own good
hi: Abu Dharr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi se pucha: "Sabse behtareen amal kya hai?" Aap ne jawab diya: "Allah par iman rakhna aur uski raah mein jung karna." Maine phir pucha: "Sabse behtareen qisam ki azaadi (gulaamon ki) kaunsi hai?" Aap ne jawab diya: "Sabse mehanga gulaam ko azaad karna aur us gulaam ko jo uske maalik ko sabse aziz ho." Maine kaha: "Agar main aisa na kar sakoon?" Aap ne kaha: "Kamzor ki madad karo ya us shaks ke liye kuch achha karo jo khud kaam nahi kar sakta." Maine kaha: "Agar main woh bhi na kar sakoon?" Aap ne kaha: "Doosron ko takleef pahunchane se bacho, kyunke yeh tumhare apne bhale ke liye ek sadqe ka amal maana jaayega."

e: Narrated Asma' bint Abu Bakr:The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered us to free slaves at the time of solar eclipses
hi: Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Abu Bakr (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi ne humein suraj grahan ke waqt gulaam azaad karne ka hukum diya.

e: Narrated Asma' bint Abu Bakr:We were ordered to free slaves at the time of lunar eclipses
hi: Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Abu Bakr (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Humein chaand grahan ke waqt gulaam azaad karne ka hukum diya gaya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever manumits a slave owned by two masters, should manumit him completely (not partially) if he is rich after having its price evaluated
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jo koi do maalikon ke saanjhi gulaam ko azaad karta hai, use use poori tarah (ansik nahi) azaad karna chahiye agar woh maldaar hai, uski qeemat lagane ke baad."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever frees his share of a common slave and he has sufficient money to free him completely, should let its price be estimated by a just man and give his partners the price of their shares and manumit the slave; otherwise (i.e. if he has not sufficient money) he manumits the slave partially
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jo koi saanjhi gulaam mein apna hissa azaad karta hai aur uske paas use poori tarah azaad karne ke liye kaafi paisa hai, to use kisi insaaf pasand shaks se uski qeemat lagvani chahiye aur apne sazedaron ko unke hisse ka paisa dekar gulaam azaad karna chahiye; warna (yaani agar uske paas kaafi paisa nahi) woh gulaam ko ansik tor par azaad karta hai."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever manumits his share of a slave, then it is essential for him to get that slave manumitted' completely as long as he has the money to do so. If he has not sufficient money to pay the price of the other shares (after the price of the slave is evaluated justly), the manumitted manumits the slave partially in proportion to his share. `Ubaidullah narrated as above in brief
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jo koi apna hissa gulaam mein azaad karta hai, uske liye zaroori hai ke gulaam ko poori tarah azaad karvaye jab tak uske paas iske liye paisa hai. Agar uske paas baaki hisso ki qeemat (jo insaaf se lagaee gayi ho) dene ke liye kaafi paisa nahi hai, to azaad karne wala apne hisse ke mutabiq gulaam ko ansik azaad karta hai." Ubaidullah ne yeh riwaayat sankshep mein sunaee.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who manumits his share of a slave and has money sufficient to free the remaining portion of that slave's price (justly estimated) then he should manumit him (by giving the rest of his price to the other co-owners)." Nafi` added, "Otherwise the slave is partially free." Aiyub is not sure whether the last statement was said by Nafi` or it was a part of the Hadith
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jo apna hissa gulaam mein azaad karta hai aur uske paas gulaam ki baaki qeemat (insaaf se lagaee gayi) dene ke liye kaafi paisa ho, to use gulaam ko azaad karna chahiye (baaki qeemat doosre sajhedaron ko dekar)." Nafi ne joda: "Warna gulaam ansik azaad hota hai." Aiyub ko yaqeen nahi ke aakhri baat Nafi ne kahi ya yeh Hadith ka hissa thi.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:That he used to give his verdict regarding the male or female slaves owned by more than one master, one of whom may manumit his share of the slave. Ibn `Umar used to say in such a case, "The manumitted should manumit the slave completely if he has sufficient money to pay the rest of the price of that slave (which is to be justly estimated) and the other shareholders are to take the price of their shares and the slave is freed (released from slavery)." Ibn `Umar narrated this verdict from the Prophet
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Woh do ya zyada maalikon ke saanjhi mard ya aurat gulaamon ke baare mein faisla dete the, jinme se koi ek apna hissa azaad kar sakta tha. Aisi soorat mein Ibn Umar kehte: "Azaad karne wale ko gulaam ko poori tarah azaad karna chahiye agar uske paas baaki qeemat (jo insaaf se lagaee gayi ho) dene ke liye paisa hai, aur baaki sazedaar apne hisse ki qeemat len aur gulaam azaad ho jaaye (gulaami se mukt)." Ibn Umar ne yeh faisla Nabi se riwaayat kiya.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:That the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever frees his portion of a (common) slave
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha: "Jo koi saanjhi gulaam mein apna hissa azaad karta hai..." (baaki jaisa upar hai).

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever frees his portion of a common slave should free the slave completely by paying the rest of his price from his money if he has enough money; otherwise the price of the slave is to be estimated and the slave is to be helped to work without hardship till he pays the rest of his price
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jo koi saanjhi gulaam mein apna hissa azaad karta hai, use gulaam ko poori tarah azaad karna chahiye baaki qeemat apne paise se dekar agar uske paas kaafi paisa hai; warna gulaam ki qeemat lagaee jaani chahiye, aur gulaam ko madad ki jaani chahiye ke woh bina takleef ke kaam karke baaki qeemat ada kar sake."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah has accepted my invocation to forgive what whispers in the hearts of my followers, unless they put it to action or utter it." (See Hadith No. 657 Vol)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Allah ne meri dua qubool ki hai ke woh us cheez ko maaf kare jo mere pairokaron ke dilon mein khyaal ke tor par aati hai, jab tak woh ise amal mein na laayen ya bolen nahi."

e: Narrated `Umar bin Al-Khattab:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The (reward of) deeds depend on intentions, and every person will get the reward according to what he intends. So, whoever migrated for Allah and His Apostle, then his migration will be for Allah and His Apostle, and whoever migrated for worldly benefits or for marrying a woman, then his migration will be for what he migrated for." (See Hadith No. 1, Vol)
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Khattab (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Amalon ka daromadaar niyyaton par hai, aur har insaan ko wahi milega jiski usne niyyat ki. Isliye jo koi Allah aur uske Rasool ke liye hijrat kare, uski hijrat Allah aur uske Rasool ke liye hogi, aur jo koi duniyawi faayde ke liye ya kisi aurat se shaadi karne ke liye hijrat kare, uski hijrat usi ke liye hogi jiske liye usne hijrat ki."

e: Narrated Qais:When Abu Huraira accompanied by his slave set out intending to embrace Islam they lost each other on the way. The slave then came while Abu Huraira was sitting with the Prophet. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Abu Huraira! Your slave has come back." Abu Huraira said, "Indeed, I would like you to witness that I have manumitted him." That happened at the time when Abu Huraira recited (the following poetic verse):-- 'What a long tedious tiresome night! Nevertheless, it has delivered us From the land of Kufr (disbelief)
hi: Qais bataate hain: Jab Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) apne gulaam ke saath Islam qubool karne nikle, raaste mein woh ek-doosre se alag ho gaye. Gulaam baad mein aaya jabke Abu Huraira Nabi ke saath baithe the. Nabi ne kaha: "Aye Abu Huraira! Tumhara gulaam wapas aa gaya hai." Abu Huraira ne kaha: "Beshak, main chahta hoon aap gawaah rahen ke maine use azaad kar diya hai." Yeh us waqt hua jab Abu Huraira yeh she'r padh rahe the: "Kitni lambi, thakaanewali, museebat bhari raat thi! Phir bhi, isne humein kufr ki zameen se azaad kiya."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:On my way to the Prophet (ﷺ) I was reciting:-- 'What a long tedious tiresome night! Nevertheless, it has saved us From the land of Kufr (disbelief).' I had a slave who ran away from me on the way. When I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and gave the pledge of allegiance for embracing Islam, the slave showed up while I was still with the Prophet (ﷺ) who remarked, "O Abu Huraira! Here is your slave!" I said, "I manumit him for Allah's Sake," and so I freed him
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ke paas jate huye main padh raha tha: "Kitni lambi, thakaanewali, museebat bhari raat thi! Phir bhi, isne humein kufr ki zameen se bachaya." Mera ek gulaam tha jo raaste mein mujhse bhaag gaya. Jab main Nabi ke paas gaya aur Islam qubool karne ki bai'at ki, gulaam wahan aa gaya jabke main abhi bhi Nabi ke saath tha. Nabi ne kaha: "Aye Abu Huraira! Yeh raha tumhara gulaam!" Maine kaha: "Main ise Allah ke liye azaad karta hoon," aur isliye maine use azaad kar diya.

e: Narrated Qais:When Abu Huraira accompanied by his slave came intending to embrace Islam, they lost each other on the way. (When the slave showed up) Abu Huraira said (to the Prophet), "I make you witness that the slave is free for Allah's Cause
hi: Qais bataate hain: Jab Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) apne gulaam ke saath Islam qubool karne aaye, raaste mein woh ek-doosre se alag ho gaye. (Jab gulaam wapas aaya) Abu Huraira ne (Nabi se) kaha: "Main aapko gawaah banata hoon ke yeh gulaam Allah ke liye azaad hai."

e: Narrated `Aisha:`Utba bin Abi Waqqas authorized his brother Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas to take the son of the slave-girl of Zam`a into his custody, telling him that the boy was his own (illegal) son. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went (to Mecca) at the time of the Conquest, Sa`d took the son of the slave-girl of Zam`a to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and also brought 'Abu bin Zam`a with him and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! This is the son of my brother `Utba who authorized me to take him into my custody." 'Abu bin Zam`a said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! He is my brother, the son of Zam`a's slave-girl and he was born on his bed." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) looked at the son of the slave-girl of Zam`a and noticed much resemblance (to `Utba). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "It is for you, O 'Abu bin Zam`a as he was born on the bed of your father." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then told Sauda bint Zam`a to observe veil in the presence of the boy as he noticed the boy's resemblance to `Utba and Sauda was the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Utba bin Abi Waqqas ne apne bhai Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko ikhtiyaar diya ke woh Zam'a ki launDi ke bete ko apni sarparasti mein le lein, unhe batate huye ke woh ladka unka (na-jaiz) beta tha. Jab Allah ke Rasool Fatah ke waqt (Mecca) gaye, Sa'd Zam'a ki launDi ke bete ko Allah ke Rasool ke paas le gaye aur Abu bin Zam'a ko bhi apne saath laaye aur kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Yeh mere bhai Utba ka beta hai jinhone mujhe ise apni sarparasti mein lene ka ikhtiyaar diya tha." Abu bin Zam'a ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Yeh mera bhai hai, Zam'a ki launDi ka beta hai aur woh unke bistar par paida hua." Allah ke Rasool ne Zam'a ki launDi ke bete ki taraf dekha aur unme bahut zyada samaanta (Utba se) dekhi. Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: "Yeh tumhara hai, Aye Abu bin Zam'a, kyunke woh tumhare waalid ke bistar par paida hua." Allah ke Rasool ne phir Sauda (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Zam'a se kaha ke woh ladke ke saamne parda karen kyunke unhone ladke mein Utba se samaanta dekhi thi, aur Sauda Nabi ki biwi thi.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:A man amongst us declared that his slave would be freed after his death. The Prophet (ﷺ) called for that slave and sold him. The slave died the same year
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Humare mein se ek shaks ne elaan kiya ke uska gulaam uski maut ke baad azaad hoga. Nabi ne us gulaam ko bulaya aur use becha diya. Gulaam usi saal mar gaya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the selling or donating the Wala' of a freed slave
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne azaad kiye gulaam ka Wala (waraasat ka rishta) bechne ya daan karne se mana kiya.

e: Narrated `Aisha:I bought Barirah but her masters put the condition that her Wala' would be for them. I told the Prophet (ﷺ) about it. He said (to me), "Manumit (free) her as her Wala' will be for the one who pays the price." So, I manumitted (freed) her. The Prophet (ﷺ) called Barirah and gave her the option of either staying with her husband or leaving him. She said, "Even if he gave me so much money, I would not stay with him," and so she preferred her freedom to her husband
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine Barira (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko khareeda magar uske maalikon ne shart rakhi ke uska Wala unhi ke paas rahega. Maine yeh Nabi ko bataya. Unhone (mujhse) kaha: "Ise azaad karo, kyunke Wala usi ke paas jaayega jo qeemat ada karega." Isliye maine use azaad kar diya. Nabi ne Barira ko bulwaya aur unhe ikhtiyaar diya ya to apne shohar ke saath rahen ya unhe chhod den. Unhone kaha: "Chahe woh mujhe kitna bhi paisa de, main uske saath nahi rahungi," aur isliye unhone apni azaadi ko apne shohar par tarjih di.

e: Narrated Anas:Some men of the Ansar asked for the permission of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "Allow us to give up the ransom from our nephew Al-`Abbas. The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to them), "Do not leave (even) a Dirham (of his ransom)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Kuch Ansaar ne Allah ke Rasool se ijazat maangi aur kaha: "Humein humare chachazaad bhatije Al-Abbas ki fidya (ransom) maaf karne di jaaye." Nabi ne (unse) kaha: "Ek Dirham bhi (uski fidya mein se) mat chodo."

e: Narrated Hisham:My father told me that Hakim bin Hizam manumitted one-hundred slaves in the Pre-Islamic period of ignorance and slaughtered one-hundred camels (and distributed them in charity). When he embraced Islam he again slaughtered one-hundred camels and manumitted one-hundred slaves. Hakim said, "I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What do you think about some good deeds I used to practice in the Pre-Islamic period of ignorance regarding them as deeds of righteousness?' Allah's Apostle said, "You have embraced Islam along with all those good deeds you did
hi: Hisham bataate hain: Mere waalid ne mujhe bataya ke Hakim bin Hizam (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne jahiliyat ke zamane mein sau gulaam azaad kiye aur sau unt zabah kiye (aur sadqa mein baante). Jab woh Musalman hue, unhone phir sau unt zabah kiye aur sau gulaam azaad kiye. Hakim ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool se pucha: 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Jahiliyat ke zamane mein maine kuch neik amal kiye jinhe main neik samajhta tha, unke baare mein aapki kya raay hai?' Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: 'Tum Islam mein daakhil hue us sab neki ke saath jo tumne pehle ki.'"

e: Narrated Marwan and Al-Miswar bin Makhrama:When the delegates of the tribe of Hawazin came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and they requested him to return their properties and captives. The Prophet (ﷺ) stood up and said to them, "I have other people with me in this matter (as you see) and the most beloved statement to me is the true one; you may choose either the properties or the prisoners as I have delayed their distribution." The Prophet (ﷺ) had waited for them for more than ten days since his arrival from Ta'if. So, when it became evident to them that the Prophet (ﷺ) was not going to return them except one of the two, they said, "We choose our prisoners." The Prophet got up amongst the people and glorified and praised Allah as He deserved and said, "Then after, these brethren of yours have come to us with repentance, and I see it logical to return them the captives. So, whoever amongst you likes to do that as a favor, then he can do it, and whoever of you likes to stick to his share till we recompense him from the very first war booty which Allah will give us, then he can do so (i.e. give up the present captives)." The people unanimously said, "We do that (return the captives) willingly." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "We do not know which of you has agreed to it and which have not, so go back and let your leaders forward us your decision." So, all the people then went back and discussed the matter with their leaders who returned and informed the Prophet (ﷺ) that all the people had willingly given their consent to return the captives. This is what has reached us about the captives of Hawazin. Narrated Anas that `Abbas said to the Prophet, "I paid for my ransom and `Aqil's ransom
hi: Marwan aur Al-Miswar bin Makhrama (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Hawazin qabile ka wafd Nabi ke paas aaya aur unse apni maal aur qaidiyon ko wapas karne ki guzarish ki. Nabi khade hue aur unse kaha: "Mere saath is maamle mein doosre log bhi hain (jaisa tumhe pata hai), aur mujhe sabse aziz baat sachi baat hai; tumhe ikhtiyaar hai maal ya qaidiyon mein se ek chuno, kyunke maine taqseem taal di hai." Nabi ne unka das din se zyada intezar kiya tha Taif se wapas aane ke baad. Isliye jab unhe saaf ho gaya ke Nabi unhe do mein se sirf ek hi wapas karenge, unhone kaha: "Hum apne qaidiyon ko chunte hain." Nabi logon ke beech khade hue, Allah ki jaisi hamd honi chahiye vaisi ki, aur kaha: "Iske baad! Tumhare yeh bhai tauba karke humare paas aaye hain, aur main theek samajhta hoon ke unhe qaidi wapas kar dun. Isliye jo bhi tum mein se ise ehsaan ke tor par karna chahe, kar sakta hai, aur jo apna hissa rakhna chahe jab tak humein pehli maal-e-ghanimat mile jise Allah humein dega, woh bhi kar sakta hai (yaani maujooda qaidiyon ko chodh sakta hai)." Logon ne muttafik tor par kaha: "Hum aisa (qaidiyon ko wapas) khushi se karte hain." Nabi ne kaha: "Humein nahi pata tum mein se kisne raazi hokar diya aur kisne nahi, isliye wapas jaao aur apne sardaron ko humein apna faisla batane do." Isliye sab log wapas gaye aur apne sardaron se baat ki, jo laute aur Nabi ko bataya ke sab logon ne apni raazandi se qaidi wapas karne ki sehmati de di hai. Yehi humein Hawazin ke qaidiyon ke baare mein pata hai. Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne bataya ke Abbas ne Nabi se kaha: "Maine apni aur Aqil ki fidya ada ki hai."

e: Narrated Ibn `Aun:I wrote a letter to Nafi` and Nafi` wrote in reply to my letter that the Prophet (ﷺ) had suddenly attacked Bani Mustaliq without warning while they were heedless and their cattle were being watered at the places of water. Their fighting men were killed and their women and children were taken as captives; the Prophet (ﷺ) got Juwairiya on that day. Nafi` said that Ibn `Umar had told him the above narration and that Ibn `Umar was in that army
hi: Ibn Aun bataate hain: Maine Nafi ko ek khat likha aur Nafi ne jawab diya ke Nabi ne Bani Mustaliq par achanak hamla kiya jabke woh be-khabar the aur unke maweshi paani ki jagahon par pilaye ja rahe the. Unke ladne wale mardon ko qatl kiya gaya aur unki aurton aur bachchon ko qaidi banaya gaya; Nabi ne us din Juwairiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko liya. Nafi ne kaha ke Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne unhe yeh riwaayat batayi thi, aur Ibn Umar khud us fauj mein the.

e: Narrated Ibn Muhairiz:I saw Abu Sa`id and asked him about coitus interruptus. Abu Sa`id said, "We went with Allah's Apostle, in the Ghazwa of Bani Al-Mustaliq and we captured some of the 'Arabs as captives, and the long separation from our wives was pressing us hard and we wanted to practice coitus interruptus. We asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (whether it was permissible). He said, "It is better for you not to do so. No soul, (that which Allah has) destined to exist, up to the Day of Resurrection, but will definitely come, into existence
hi: Ibn Muhairiz bataate hain: Maine Abu Saeed ko dekha aur unse Al-Azl (safar se bahar rehna, coitus interruptus) ke baare mein pucha. Abu Saeed ne kaha: "Hum Allah ke Rasool ke saath Bani Al-Mustaliq ki Ghazwa mein gaye aur humne kuch Arbon ko qaidi banaya, aur apni biwiyon se lambi juadaee humpar bhaari padi thi aur hum Al-Azl karna chahte the. Humne Allah ke Rasool se pucha (kya yeh jaiz hai). Unhone kaha: 'Behtar hai tum aisa na karo. Koi bhi rooh, jise Allah ne Qiyamat tak wujood mein aane ka faisla kiya hai, zaroor wujood mein aayegi.'"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I have loved the people of the tribe of Bani Tamim ever since I heard, three things, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said about them. I heard him saying, These people (of the tribe of Bani Tamim) would stand firm against Ad-Dajjal." When the Sadaqat (gifts of charity) from that tribe came, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "These are the Sadaqat (i.e. charitable gifts) of our folk." `Aisha had a slave-girl from that tribe, and the Prophet (ﷺ) said to `Aisha, "Manumit her as she is a descendant of Ishmael (the Prophet)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Bani Tamim qabile ke logon se mohabbat ki jab se maine teen baaten suni jo Allah ke Rasool ne unke baare mein kahi. Maine unhe kehte suna: "Yeh log (Bani Tamim qabile ke) Dajjal ke khilaf mazbooti se khade honge." Jab is qabile se sadqe (charity gifts) aaye, Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: "Yeh humare logon ka sadqa hai." Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas is qabile ki ek launDi thi, aur Nabi ne Ayesha se kaha: "Ise azaad karo kyunke woh Ismail (Nabi) ki aulad mein se hai."

e: Narrated Abu Musa:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "He who has a slave-girl and educates and treats her nicely and then manumits and marries her, will get a double reward
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jiske paas ek launDi ho aur woh use taalim de aur achha suluk kare, phir use azaad karke usse shaadi kare, use dohra ajr milega."

e: Narrated Al-Ma'rur bin Suwaid:I saw Abu Dhar Al-Ghifari wearing a cloak, and his slave, too, was wearing a cloak. We asked him about that (i.e. how both were wearing similar cloaks). He replied, "Once I abused a man and he complained of me to the Prophet (ﷺ) . The Prophet (ﷺ) asked me, 'Did you abuse him by slighting his mother?' He added, 'Your slaves are your brethren upon whom Allah has given you authority. So, if one has one's brethren under one's control, one should feed them with the like of what one eats and clothe them with the like of what one wears. You should not overburden them with what they cannot bear, and if you do so, help them (in their hard job)
hi: Al-Ma'rur bin Suwaid bataate hain: Maine Abu Dharr (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ghifari ko ek chogha pehne dekha, aur unka gulaam bhi ek chogha pehne hue tha. Humne unse iske baare mein pucha (yaani dono ek jaise chogha kyun pehne hue the). Unhone jawab diya: "Ek baar maine ek shaks ko gaali di aur usne meri shikayat Nabi se ki. Nabi ne mujhse pucha: 'Kya tumne uski maa ko lekar usse be-adabi ki?'" Unhone joda: "Tumhare gulaam tumhare bhai hain jinpar Allah ne tumhe ikhtiyaar diya hai. Isliye agar kisi ke apne bhai apne ikhtiyaar mein hon, use unhe wahi khilana chahiye jo woh khud khaata hai, aur wahi pehnana chahiye jo woh khud pehanta hai. Unpar aisa bojh na daalo jo woh na sehen kar saken, aur agar aisa karo, unki madad karo (unke mushkil kaam mein)."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If a slave is honest and faithful to his master and worships his Lord (Allah) in a perfect manner, he will get a double reward
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Agar ek gulaam imaandaar aur wafadaar hai apne maalik ke prati, aur apne Rab (Allah) ki ibadat achhi tarah karta hai, use dohra ajr milega."

e: Narrated Abu Musa Al-Ash`ari:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who has a slave-girl and teaches her good manners and improves her education and then manumits and marries her, will get a double reward; and any slave who observes Allah's right and his master's right will get a double reward
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ash'ari (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jiske paas ek launDi ho aur usse achhe adab sikhaye aur uski taalim behtar kare, phir use azaad karke usse shaadi kare, use dohra ajr milega; aur jo bhi gulaam Allah ka haqq aur apne maalik ka haqq ada karta hai, use dohra ajr milega."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "A pious slave gets a double reward." Abu Huraira added: By Him in Whose Hands my soul is but for Jihad (i.e. holy battles), Hajj, and my duty to serve my mother, I would have loved to die as a slave
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Ek neik gulaam ko dohra ajr milta hai." Abu Huraira ne joda: "Us zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, agar Jihad, Hajj, aur apni maa ki khidmat ka farz na hota, mujhe pasand hota ke main gulaam ke tor par mar jaoon."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Goodness and comfort are for him who worships his Lord in a perfect manner and serves his master sincerely
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Bhalaee aur aaram uske liye hai jo apne Rab ki ibadat achhi tarah kare aur apne maalik ki khidmat imaandaari se kare."

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If a slave serves his Saiyid (i.e. master) sincerely and worships his Lord (Allah) perfectly, he will get a double reward
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Agar koi gulaam apne Sayyid (maalik) ki khidmat imaandaari se kare aur apne Rab (Allah) ki ibadat mukammal tor par kare, use dohra ajr milega."

e: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The Mamluk (slave) who worships his Lord in a perfect manner, and is dutiful, sincere and obedient to his Saiyid (master), will get a double reward
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Mamluk (gulaam) jo apne Rab ki ibadat mukammal tor par kare, aur apne Sayyid (maalik) ka farzshinaas, imaandaar aur itaa'atgaar ho, use dohra ajr milega."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You should not say, 'Feed your lord (Rabbaka), help your lord in performing ablution, or give water to your lord, but should say, 'my master (e.g. Feed your master instead of lord etc.) (Saiyidi), or my guardian (Maulai), and one should not say, my slave (Abdi), or my girl-slave (Amati), but should say, my lad (Fatai), my lass (Fatati), and 'my boy (Ghulami)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Tumhe yeh nahi kehna chahiye, 'Apne Rab (Rabbaka) ko khilao, apne Rab ko wudu mein madad karo, ya apne Rab ko paani do,' balki kehna chahiye, 'Mere maalik (Saiyidi)' ya 'mere rakhwale (Maulai),' aur kisi ko yeh nahi kehna chahiye, 'mera gulaam (Abdi),' ya 'meri launDi (Amati),' balki kehna chahiye, 'mera jawan (Fatai),' 'meri jawan launDi (Fatati),' aur 'mera ladka (Ghulami).'"

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If one manumits his share of a common slave (Abd), and he has money sufficient to free the remaining portion of the price of the slave (justly estimated), then he should free the slave completely by paying the rest of his price; otherwise the slave is freed partly
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Agar koi saanjhi gulaam (Abd) mein apna hissa azaad karta hai, aur uske paas baaki qeemat (insaaf se lagaee gayi) dene ke liye kaafi paisa hai, to use gulaam ko poori tarah azaad karna chahiye baaki qeemat dekar; warna gulaam ansik azaad hota hai."

e: Narrated `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Everyone of you is a guardian and is responsible for his charges. The ruler who has authority over people, is a guardian and is responsible for them, a man is a guardian of his family and is responsible for them; a woman is a guardian of her husband's house and children and is responsible for them; a slave ('Abu) is a guardian of his master's property and is responsible for it; so all of you are guardians and are responsible for your charges
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Tum mein har ek rakhwala hai aur apni zimmedaari mein jo hai uska zimmedaar hai. Hukmaran jo logon par ikhtiyaar rakhta hai, rakhwala hai aur unke liye zimmedaar hai; ek mard apne pariwara ka rakhwala hai aur unke liye zimmedaar hai; ek aurat apne shohar ke ghar aur bachchon ki rakhwali hai aur unke liye zimmedaar hai; ek gulaam apne maalik ki maal ka rakhwala hai aur uske liye zimmedaar hai; isliye tum sab rakhwale ho aur apni zimmedaariyon ke liye zimmedaar ho."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira and Zaid bin Khalid:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If a slave-girl (Ama) commits illegal sexual intercourse, scourge her; if she does it again, scourge her again; if she repeats it, scourge her again." The narrator added that on the third or the fourth offense, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Sell her even for a hair rope
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Zaid bin Khalid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Agar ek launDi (Ama) zina kare, use kode maaro; agar woh dobara kare, use phir kode maaro; agar woh phir kare, use phir kode maaro." Raawi ne joda ke teesri ya chauthi baar, Nabi ne kaha: "Use bech do, chahe ek baal ki rassi ke badle mein hi ho."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When your servant brings your meals to you then if he does not let him sit and share the meals, then he should at least give him a mouthful or two mouthfuls of that meal or a meal or two meals, as he has prepared it
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jab tumhara khaadim tumhare liye khaana laaye, agar use saath baithne aur khaane mein shaamil hone ki ijazat na do, to kam se kam use ek ya do nivala khaane ka de do, kyunke usne ise taiyaar kiya hai."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:That he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "Everyone of you is a guardian and is responsible for his charge; the ruler is a guardian and is responsible for his subjects; the man is a guardian in his family and responsible for his charges; a woman is a guardian of her husband's house and responsible for her charges; and the servant is a guardian of his master's property and is responsible for his charge." I definitely heard the above from the Prophet (ﷺ) and think that the Prophet (ﷺ) also said, "A man is a guardian of his father's property and responsible for his charges; so everyone of you is a guardian and responsible for his charges
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Unhone Allah ke Rasool ko farmate suna: "Tum mein har ek rakhwala hai aur apni zimmedaari mein jo hai uska zimmedaar hai; hukmaran rakhwala hai aur apni raaya ke liye zimmedaar hai; mard apne pariwara ka rakhwala hai aur apni zimmedaari mein jo hai uska zimmedaar hai; aurat apne shohar ke ghar ki rakhwali hai aur apni zimmedaari mein jo hai uska zimmedaar hai; aur khaadim apne maalik ki maal ka rakhwala hai aur apni zimmedaari mein jo hai uska zimmedaar hai." Maine yeh zaroor Nabi se suna aur mujhe lagta hai Nabi ne yeh bhi kaha: "Mard apne baap ki maal ka rakhwala hai aur apni zimmedaari mein jo hai uska zimmedaar hai, isliye tum sab rakhwale ho aur apni zimmedaariyon ke liye zimmedaar ho."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If somebody fights (or beats somebody) then he should avoid the face
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Agar koi (kisi se) lade ya (kisi ko) maare, use chehre se bacna chahiye."

e: Narrated 'Aishah (ra) that Barira came to seek her help in writing of emancipation and she had to pay five Uqiya (of gold) by five yearly installments. 'Aishah said to her, "Do you think that if I pay the whole sum at once, your masters will sell you to me, and I will free you and your Wala' will be for me." Barira went to her masters and told them about that offer. They said that they would not agree to it unless her Wala' would be for them. 'Aishah further said, "I went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and told him about it." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to her, "Buy Barira and manumit her and the Wala' will be for the liberator." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then got up and said, "What about those people who stipulate conditions that are not present in Allah's Laws? If anybody stipulates a condition which is not in Allah's Laws, then what he stipulates is invalid. Allah's Condition (Laws) are the truth and are more solid
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Barira (رضی اللہ عنہا) unse madad maangne aayi apni azaadi ke muahide (mukatiba) ke liye jismein use paanch Uqiya (sona) paanch saalana kiston mein ada karni thi. Ayesha ne unse kaha: "Kya tumhe lagta hai agar main poori raqam ek saath ada kar dun, tumhare maalik tumhe mujhe bech denge, aur main tumhe azaad kar dungi, aur tumhara Wala mera hoga?" Barira apne maalikon ke paas gayi aur unhe yeh pesh kash bataee. Unhone kaha ke woh isse raazi nahi honge jab tak unka Wala unhi ke paas rahe. Ayesha ne aage kaha: "Main Allah ke Rasool ke paas gayi aur unhe iske baare mein bataya." Allah ke Rasool ne unse kaha: "Barira ko khareedo aur azaad karo, aur Wala azaad karne wale ka hoga." Phir Allah ke Rasool khade hue aur kaha: "Un logon ka kya kahna jo aisi sharten lagate hain jo Allah ke qanoon mein maujood nahi? Agar koi aisi shart lagata hai jo Allah ke qanoon mein nahi, to uski shart batil hai. Allah ki sharten (qanoon) haqq hain aur zyada mazboot hain."

e: Narrated `Urwa:That `Aisha told him that Barirah came to seek her help in her writing of emancipation (for a certain sum) and that time she had not paid anything of it. `Aisha said to her, "Go back to your masters, and if they agree that I will pay the amount of your writing of emancipation and get your Wala', I will do so." Barirah informed her masters of that but they refused and said, "If she (i.e. `Aisha) is seeking Allah's reward, then she can do so, but your Wala' will be for us." `Aisha mentioned that to Allah's Apostle who said to her, "Buy and manumit (free) her, as the Wala' is for the liberator." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then got up and said, "What about the people who stipulate conditions which are not present in Allah's Laws? Whoever imposes conditions which are not present in Allah's Laws, then those conditions will be invalid, even if he imposed these conditions a hundred times. Allah's conditions (Laws) are the truth and are more solid
hi: Urwa bataate hain: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne unhe bataya ke Barira (رضی اللہ عنہا) unse madad maangne aayi apni azaadi ke muahide ke liye (ek khaas raqam ke liye) aur us waqt unhone usme se kuch bhi ada nahi kiya tha. Ayesha ne unse kaha: "Apne maalikon ke paas wapas jaao, aur agar woh raazi hon ke main tumhari azaadi ki raqam ada karke tumhara Wala loon, main aisa karungi." Barira ne yeh apne maalikon ko bataya magar unhone inkaar kiya aur kaha: "Agar woh (yaani Ayesha) Allah ka ajr chahti hai, to woh aisa kar sakti hai, magar tumhara Wala humara hoga." Ayesha ne yeh Allah ke Rasool ko bataya jinhone unse kaha: "Ise khareeda aur azaad karo, kyunke Wala azaad karne wale ka hota hai." Allah ke Rasool phir khade hue aur kaha: "Un logon ka kya kahna jo aisi sharten lagate hain jo Allah ke qanoon mein maujood nahi? Jo bhi aisi sharten lagta hai jo Allah ke qanoon mein nahi, to woh sharten batil hongi, chahe woh sau baar lagae. Allah ki sharten (qanoon) haqq hain aur zyada mazboot hain."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Aisha wanted to buy a slave-girl in order to manumit her. The girl's masters stipulated that her Wala' would be for them. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said (to `Aisha), "What they stipulate should not stop you, for the Wala' is for the liberator
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ek launDi khareedna chahti thi taake use azaad kar sakein. Ladki ke maalikon ne shart rakhi ke uska Wala unhi ke paas rahega. Allah ke Rasool ne (Ayesha se) kaha: "Unki lagaee hui shart tumhe roke nahi, kyunke Wala azaad karne wale ka hota hai."

e: Narrated Aisha:Barirah came (to `Aisha) and said, "I have made a contract of emancipation with my masters for nine Uqiyas (of gold) to be paid in yearly installments. Therefore, I seek your help." `Aisha said, "If your masters agree, I will pay them the sum at once and free you on condition that your Wala' will be for me." Barirah went to her masters but they refused that offer. She (came back) and said, "I presented to them the offer but they refused, unless the Wala' was for them." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) heard of that and asked me about it, and I told him about it. On that he said, "Buy and manumit her and stipulate that the Wala' should be for you, as Wala' is for the liberator." `Aisha added, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then got up amongst the people, Glorified and Praised Allah, and said, 'Then after: What about some people who impose conditions which are not present in Allah's Laws? So, any condition which is not present in Allah's Laws is invalid even if they were one-hundred conditions. Allah's ordinance is the truth, and Allah's condition is stronger and more solid. Why do some men from you say, O so-and-so! manumit the slave but the Wala will be for me? Verily, the Wala is for the liberator
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Barira (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Ayesha ke paas) aayi aur kaha: "Maine apne maalikon se ek muahida kiya hai apni azaadi ke liye nau Uqiya (sona) ke badle, jo saalana kiston mein ada karni hai. Isliye main aapki madad chahti hoon." Ayesha ne kaha: "Agar tumhare maalik raazi hon, main unhe poori raqam ek saath ada karke tumhe azaad kar dungi is shart par ke tumhara Wala mera hoga." Barira apne maalikon ke paas gayi magar unhone yeh pesh kash radd kar di. Woh (wapas aakar) kaha: "Maine unhe yeh pesh kash batai magar unhone inkaar kiya, jab tak Wala unke paas rahe." Allah ke Rasool ne yeh suna aur mujhse iske baare mein pucha, aur maine unhe bataya. Isspar unhone kaha: "Ise khareedo aur azaad karo aur shart rakho ke Wala tumhara hoga, kyunke Wala azaad karne wale ka hota hai." Ayesha ne joda: "Allah ke Rasool phir logon ke beech khade hue, Allah ki hamd-sana ki aur kaha: 'Iske baad: Un logon ka kya kahna jo aisi sharten lagate hain jo Allah ke qanoon mein maujood nahi? Isliye jo bhi shart Allah ke qanoon mein nahi, woh batil hai chahe woh sau sharten hon. Allah ka faisla haqq hai, aur Allah ki shart zyada mazboot aur pukhta hai. Tum mein se kuch mard kyun kahte hain, "Aye falaan! Gulaam ko azaad karo magar Wala mera hoga?" Beshak, Wala azaad karne wale ka hota hai.'"

e: Narrated `Amra bint `Abdur-Rahman:Barirah went to Aisha, the mother of the faithful believers to seek her help in her emancipation Aisha said to her, "If your masters agree, I will pay them your price in a lump sum and manumit (free) you." Barirah mentioned that offer to her masters but they refused to sell her unless the Wala' was for them. `Aisha told Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about it. He said, "Buy and manumit her as the Wala' is for the liberator
hi: Amra bint Abdur-Rahman bataati hain: Barira (رضی اللہ عنہا) Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا), momino ki maa, ke paas gayi apni azaadi ke liye madad maangne. Ayesha ne unse kaha: "Agar tumhare maalik raazi hon, main unhe tumhari poori qeemat ek saath ada karke tumhe azaad kar dungi." Barira ne yeh pesh kash apne maalikon ko bataee magar unhone use bechne se inkaar kiya jab tak Wala unke paas rahe. Ayesha ne yeh Allah ke Rasool ko bataya. Unhone kaha: "Ise khareedo aur azaad karo, kyunke Wala azaad karne wale ka hota hai."

e: Narrated `Abdul Wahid bin Aiman:I went to `Aisha and said, "I was the slave of `Utba bin Abu Lahab. "Utba died and his sons became my masters who sold me to Ibn Abu `Amr who manumitted me. The sons of `Utba stipulated that my Wala' should be for them." `Aisha said, "Barirah came to me and she was given the writing of emancipation by her masters and she asked me to buy and manumit her. I agreed to it, but Barirah told me that her masters would not sell her unless her Wala' was for them." `Aisha said, "I am not in need of that." When the Prophet (ﷺ) heard that, or he was told about it, he asked `Aisha about it. `Aisha mentioned what Barirah had told her. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Buy and manumit (free) her and let them stipulate whatever they like." So, `Aisha bought and manumitted her and her masters stipulated that her Wala' should be for them." The Prophet;, said, "The Wala' will be for the liberator even if they stipulated a hundred conditions
hi: Abdul Wahid bin Aiman bataate hain: Main Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas gaya aur kaha: "Main Utba bin Abu Lahab ka gulaam tha. Utba ka intiqal hua aur unke bete mere maalik ban gaye jinhone mujhe Ibn Abu Amr ko bech diya jinhone mujhe azaad kar diya. Utba ke beto ne shart rakhi ke mera Wala unhi ke paas rahega." Ayesha ne kaha: "Barira (رضی اللہ عنہا) mere paas aayi aur uske maalikon ne unhe azaadi ka muahida diya tha aur usne mujhse unhe khareedne aur azaad karne ki guzarish ki. Maine iske liye raazi ho gayi, magar Barira ne mujhe bataya ke uske maalik use tab tak nahi bechenge jab tak uska Wala unhi ke paas rahe." Ayesha ne kaha: "Mujhe isse koi zaroorat nahi thi." Jab Nabi ne yeh suna, ya unhe iske baare mein bataya gaya, unhone Ayesha se iske baare mein pucha. Ayesha ne unhe woh bataya jo Barira ne unse kaha tha. Nabi ne kaha: "Ise khareedo aur azaad karo, aur unhe jo bhi shart chahiye lagane do." Isliye Ayesha ne unhe khareeda aur azaad kiya aur unke maalikon ne shart rakhi ke Wala unhi ke paas rahega. Nabi ne kaha: "Wala azaad karne wale ka hoga chahe woh sau sharten lagaen."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Muslim women! None of you should look down upon the gift sent by her female neighbor even if it were the trotters of the sheep (fleshless part of legs)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Aye Musalman auratein! Tum mein se koi apni padosin ke bheje hue tohfe ko chhota na samjhe, chahe woh bhed ke paaon (bina gosht wala hissa) hi kyun na ho."

e: Narrated `Urwa:Aisha said to me, "O my nephew! We used to see the crescent, and then the crescent and then the crescent in this way we saw three crescents in two months and no fire (for cooking) used to be made in the houses of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). I said, "O my aunt! Then what use to sustain you?" `Aisha said, "The two black things: dates and water, our neighbors from Ansar had some Manaih and they used to present Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) some of their milk and he used to make us drink
hi: Urwa bataate hain: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne unse kaha: "Aye mere bhatije! Hum chaand dekhte, phir doosra chaand, phir teesra chaand — is tarah do maheenon mein teen chaand dekh lete, aur Allah ke Rasool ke gharon mein khana pakane ke liye aag nahi jalti thi." Maine pucha: "Aye meri khala! Phir aap kya khakar guzara karte the?" Ayesha ne kaha: "Do kaali cheezein: khajoor aur paani. Humare Ansari padosiyon ke paas kuch Manaih (doodh dene wale janwar udhaar diye jaate the) the aur woh Allah ke Rasool ko unka doodh bhejte the, jo woh humein pilate the."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I shall accept the invitation even if I were invited to a meal of a sheep's trotter, and I shall accept the gift even if it were an arm or a trotter of a sheep
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Main dawat qubool karunga chahe mujhe bhed ke paaon (khaane) ki dawat di jaaye, aur main tohfa qubool karunga chahe woh bhed ka baazu ya paaon hi kyun na ho."

e: Narrated Sahl:The Prophet (ﷺ) sent for a woman from the emigrants and she had a slave who was a carpenter. The Prophet said to her "Order your slave to prepare the wood (pieces) for the pulpit." So, she ordered her slave who went and cut the wood from the tamarisk and prepared the pulpit, for the Prophet. When he finished the pulpit, the woman informed the Prophet (ﷺ) that it had been finished. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked her to send that pulpit to him, so they brought it. The Prophet (ﷺ) lifted it and placed it at the place in which you see now
hi: Sahl (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Muhajir auraton mein se ek ke paas bhejwaya, jiske paas ek badhai gulaam tha. Nabi ne usse kaha: "Apne gulaam ko mimbar ke liye lakdi taiyaar karne ka hukum do." Isliye usne apne gulaam ko hukum diya jo jhaadi ki lakdi kaat kar laaya aur Nabi ke liye mimbar taiyaar kiya. Jab woh mukammal hua, aurat ne Nabi ko bataya. Nabi ne mimbar unke paas bhejne ko kaha, isliye woh laaye. Nabi ne ise uthaya aur us jagah rakha jahan tum ise abhi dekhte ho.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abu Qatada Al-Aslami:That his father said, "One day I was sitting with some of the Prophet's companions on the way to Mecca. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was ahead of us. All of my companions were in the state of Ihram while I was a non-Muhrim. They saw an onager while I was busy repairing my shoes, so they did not tell me about it but they wished I had seen it. By chance I looked up and saw it. So, I turned to the horse, saddled it and rode on it, forgetting to take the spear and the whip. I asked them if they could hand over to me the whip and the spear but they said, 'No, by Allah, we shall not help you in that in any way.' I became angry and got down from the horse, picked up both the things and rode the horse again. I attacked the onager and slaughtered it, and brought it (after it had been dead). They took it (cooked some of it) and started eating it, but they doubted whether it was allowed for them to eat it or not, as they were in the state of Ihram. So, we proceeded and I hid with me one of its fore-legs. When we met Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and asked him about the case, he asked, 'Do you have a portion of it with you?'
