I replied in the affirmative and gave him that fleshy foreleg which he ate completely while he was in the state of Ihram
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abu Qatada (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Aslami bataate hain, apne waalid ke hawale se: Ek din main Nabi ke kuch sahaba ke saath Mecca ke raaste par baitha tha. Allah ke Rasool humse aage the. Mere sab sathi Ihram mein the jabke main Ihram mein nahi tha. Unhone ek jangli gadha dekha jabke main apni juti theek kar raha tha, isliye unhone mujhe iske baare mein nahi bataya magar chahte the ke maine bhi dekha ho. Itfaqan maine oopar dekha aur use dekh liya. Isliye main apne ghode ki taraf gaya, use sadal kiya aur uspar sawar hua, apna neza aur chaabuk lena bhool gaya. Maine unse chaabuk aur neza dene ko kaha magar unhone kaha: "Nahi, Allah ki qasam, hum tumhari isme kisi bhi tarah madad nahi karenge." Mujhe gussa aaya aur main ghode se utra, dono cheezein utha li aur phir sawar hua. Maine jangli gadhe par hamla kiya aur use zabah kiya, aur usse (mar jaane ke baad) laaya. Unhone use liya (kuch pakaya) aur khana shuru kiya, magar unhe shak tha kya yeh unke liye jaiz hai khana kyunke woh Ihram mein the. Isliye hum aage badhe aur maine uski ek agli taang chhupa li. Jab hum Allah ke Rasool se mile aur unse iske baare mein pucha, unhone poocha: "Kya tumhare paas iska koi hissa hai?" Maine haan mein jawab diya aur unhe woh gosht wali taang di jise unhone poori tarah khaya jabke woh Ihram mein the.

e: Narrated Anas:Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) visited us in this house of ours and asked for something to drink. We milked one of our sheep and mixed it with water from this well of ours and gave it to him. Abu Bakr was sitting on his left side and `Umar in front of him and a bedouin on his right side. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) finished, `Umar said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) "Here is Abu Bakr." But Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave the remaining milk to the bedouin and said twice, "The (persons on the) right side! So, start from the right side." Anas added, "It is a Sunna (the Prophet's traditions)" and repeated it thrice
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Allah ke Rasool humare is ghar mein aaye aur kuch peene ko maanga. Humne apni ek bhed ka doodh nikala aur humare is kue ke paani se milaya aur unhe diya. Abu Bakr unki baayi taraf baithe the aur Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) unke saamne, aur ek dehati unki dahini taraf. Jab Allah ke Rasool pikar khatam kar chuke, Umar ne unse kaha: "Yeh Abu Bakr hain." Magar Allah ke Rasool ne baacha hua doodh dehati ko diya aur do baar kaha: "(Jo) dahini taraf (ho)! Isliye dahini taraf se shuru karo." Anas ne joda: "Yeh ek Sunnat hai," aur teen baar dohraya.

e: Narrated Anas:We chased a rabbit at Mar-al-Zahran and the people ran after it but were exhausted. I overpowered and caught it, and gave it to Abu Talha who slaughtered it and sent its hip or two thighs to Allah's Apostle. (The narrator confirms that he sent two thighs). The Prophet (ﷺ) accepted that. (The sub-narrator asked Anas, "Did the Prophet; eat from it?" Anas replied, "He ate from it)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Humne Mar-al-Zahran mein ek khargosh ka picha kiya aur log uske peechhe daude magar thak gaye. Maine use pakad liya aur Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko diya jinhone use zabah kiya aur uski ek taang ya donon jaanghein Allah ke Rasool ko bheji. (Raawi tasdeeq karta hai ke unhone donon jaanghein bheji.) Nabi ne use qubool kiya. (Doosre raawi ne Anas se pucha: "Kya Nabi ne usme se khaya?" Anas ne jawab diya: "Haan, unhone khaya.")

e: Narrated As-Sa'b bin Jath-thama:An onager was presented to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) at the place called Al-Abwa' or Waddan, but Allah's Apostle rejected it. When the Prophet (ﷺ) noticed the signs of sorrow on the giver's face he said, "We have not rejected your gift, but we are in the state of Ihram." (i.e. if we were not in a state of Ihram we would have accepted your gift, Fath-ul-Bari page 130, Vol)
hi: As-Sa'b bin Jath-thama bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ko Al-Abwa ya Waddan naam ki jagah par ek jangli gadha pesh kiya gaya, magar Allah ke Rasool ne use radd kar diya. Jab Nabi ne dene wale ke chehre par gam ke asaraat dekhe, unhone kaha: "Humne tumhara tohfa radd nahi kiya, magar hum Ihram mein hain." (Yaani agar hum Ihram mein na hote, hum tumhara tohfa qubool karte.)

e: Narrated Aisha:The people used to look forward for the days of my (`Aisha's) turn to send gifts to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in order to please him
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Log Ayesha ki baari ke dinon ka intezaar karte the taake Allah ke Rasool ko khush karne ke liye tohfe bhejein.

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:Ibn `Abbas said: Um Hufaid, Ibn `Abbas's aunt sent some dried yogurt (butter free), ghee (butter) and a mastigar to the Prophet (ﷺ) as a gift. The Prophet (ﷺ) ate the dried yogurt and butter but left the mastigar because he disliked it. Ibn `Abbas said, "The mastigar was eaten at the table of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and if it had been illegal to eat, it could not have been eaten at the table of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
hi: Sa'id bin Jubair bataate hain: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: Um Hufaid, Ibn Abbas ki khala, ne Nabi ko sookha dahi (bina makhan wala), ghee (makhan), aur ek mastigar tohfe mein bheja. Nabi ne sookha dahi aur ghee khaya magar mastigar chhod diya kyunke unhe woh napasand tha. Ibn Abbas ne kaha: "Mastigar Allah ke Rasool ki mez par khaya jaata tha, aur agar yeh khana haram hota, to Allah ke Rasool ki mez par na khaya jaata."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Whenever a meal was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), he would ask whether it was a gift or Sadaqa (something given in charity). If he was told that it was Sadaqa, he would tell his companions to eat it, but if it was a gift, he would hurry to share it with them
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab bhi Allah ke Rasool ke paas khana laaya jaata, woh puchte kya yeh tohfa hai ya Sadaqa (charity mein diya gaya). Agar unhe bataya jaata ke yeh Sadaqa hai, woh apne sahaba se ise khane ko kahte, magar agar yeh tohfa hota, woh jaldi se unke saath baantte.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Some meat was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) and it was said that the meat had been given in charity to Barirah. He said, "It was Sadaqa for Barirah but a gift for us
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ke paas kuch gosht laaya gaya aur kaha gaya ke yeh gosht Barira (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko sadqe mein diya gaya tha. Nabi ne kaha: "Yeh Barira ke liye Sadaqa tha magar humare liye tohfa hai."

e: Narrated `Aisha:I intended to buy Barirah but her masters stipulated that her Wala should be for them. When the Prophet was told about it, he said to me, "Buy and manumit her, as the Wala' is for the liberator." Once Barirah was given some meat, and the Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "What is this?" I said, "It has been given to Barirah in charity." He said, "It is sadaqa for her but a gift for us." Barirah was given the option (to stay with her husband or to part with him). `Abdur-Rahman (a sub-narrator) wondered, "Was her husband a slave or a free man?" Shu`ba (another sub-narrator) said, "I asked `Abdur-Rahman whether her husband was a slave or a free man. He replied that he did not know whether he was a slave or a free man
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine Barira (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko khareedna chaha magar uske maalikon ne shart rakhi ke uska Wala unke paas rahega. Jab Nabi ko iske baare mein bataya gaya, unhone mujhse kaha: "Ise khareedo aur azaad karo, kyunke Wala azaad karne wale ka hota hai." Ek baar Barira ko kuch gosht diya gaya, aur Nabi ne pucha: "Yeh kya hai?" Maine kaha: "Yeh Barira ko sadqe mein diya gaya hai." Unhone kaha: "Yeh uske liye Sadaqa hai magar humare liye tohfa." Barira ko ikhtiyaar diya gaya (apne shohar ke saath rahne ya alag hone ka). Abdur-Rahman (doosre raawi) ne hairat se pucha: "Kya uska shohar gulaam tha ya azaad?" Shu'ba (ek aur raawi) ne kaha: "Maine Abdur-Rahman se pucha kya uska shohar gulaam tha ya azaad. Unhone jawab diya ke unhe nahi pata woh gulaam tha ya azaad."

e: Narrated Um 'Atiyya:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) went to `Aisha and asked her whether she had something (to eat). She said that she had nothing except the mutton which Um 'Atiyya had sent to (Barirah) in charity. The Prophet (ﷺ) said that it had reached its destination (i.e. it is no longer an object of charity)
hi: Um Atiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ek baar Nabi Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas gaye aur pucha kya unke paas (khaane ko) kuch hai. Unhone kaha ke unke paas kuch nahi siwaye us bhed ke gosht ke jo Um Atiya ne (Barira (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko) sadqe mein bheja tha. Nabi ne kaha ke yeh apni manzil tak pahunch chuka hai (yaani ab yeh sadqe ki cheez nahi rahi).

e: Narrated `Aisha:The people used to send gifts to the Prophet (ﷺ) on the day of my turn. Um Salama said: "My companions (the wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) Other than Aisha) gathered and they complained about it. So I informed the Prophet about it on their behalf, but he remained silent
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Log Nabi ki baari wale din unhe tohfe bhejte the. Um Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha: "Meri sathiyon (Ayesha ke ilawa Nabi ki doosri biwiyan) ne ikattha hokar iski shikayat ki. Isliye maine unki taraf se Nabi ko iske baare mein bataya, magar woh khaamosh rahe."

e: Narrated `Urwa from `Aisha:The wives of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) were in two groups. One group consisted of `Aisha, Hafsa, Safiyya and Sauda; and the other group consisted of Um Salama and the other wives of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). The Muslims knew that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) loved `Aisha, so if any of them had a gift and wished to give to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), he would delay it, till Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had come to `Aisha's home and then he would send his gift to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in her home. The group of Um Salama discussed the matter together and decided that Um Salama should request Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to tell the people to send their gifts to him in whatever wife's house he was. Um Salama told Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) of what they had said, but he did not reply. Then they (those wives) asked Um Salama about it. She said, "He did not say anything to me." They asked her to talk to him again. She talked to him again when she met him on her day, but he gave no reply. When they asked her, she replied that he had given no reply. They said to her, "Talk to him till he gives you a reply." When it was her turn, she talked to him again. He then said to her, "Do not hurt me regarding Aisha, as the Divine Inspirations do not come to me on any of the beds except that of Aisha." On that Um Salama said, "I repent to Allah for hurting you." Then the group of Um Salama called Fatima, the daughter of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and sent her to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to say to him, "Your wives request to treat them and the daughter of Abu Bakr on equal terms." Then Fatima conveyed the message to him. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O my daughter! Don't you love whom I love?" She replied in the affirmative and returned and told them of the situation. They requested her to go to him again but she refused. They then sent Zainab bint Jahsh who went to him and used harsh words saying, "Your wives request you to treat them and the daughter of Ibn Abu Quhafa on equal terms." On that she raised her voice and abused `Aisha to her face so much so that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) looked at `Aisha to see whether she would retort. `Aisha started replying to Zainab till she silenced her. The Prophet (ﷺ) then looked at `Aisha and said, "She is really the daughter of Abu Bakr
hi: Urwa, Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke hawale se: Allah ke Rasool ki biwiyan do giroh mein thi. Ek giroh mein Ayesha, Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا), Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) aur Sauda (رضی اللہ عنہا) thi; aur doosre giroh mein Um Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) aur Allah ke Rasool ki baaki biwiyan. Musalmanon ko pata tha ke Allah ke Rasool Ayesha se mohabbat karte hain, isliye agar unme se kisi ke paas tohfa hota aur woh Allah ke Rasool ko dena chahta, woh taal deta jab tak Allah ke Rasool Ayesha ke ghar na aa jaate, phir apna tohfa Allah ke Rasool ko unke ghar mein bhejta. Um Salama ke giroh ne aapas mein baat ki aur faisla kiya ke Um Salama Allah ke Rasool se guzarish karein ke woh logon ko unke tohfe jahan bhi woh (Nabi) us waqt hon, wahan bhejne ko kahein. Um Salama ne Allah ke Rasool ko woh baat batayi jo unhone kahi thi, magar unhone koi jawab nahi diya. Phir unhone (un biwiyon ne) Um Salama se iske baare mein pucha. Unhone kaha: "Unhone mujhe kuch nahi kaha." Unhone unse dobara baat karne ko kaha. Unhone dobara baat ki jab woh unse apni baari mein mile, magar unhone koi jawab nahi diya. Jab unhone pucha, unhone jawab diya ke unhe koi jawab nahi mila. Unhone unse kaha: "Unse baat karo jab tak woh tumhe jawab na de." Jab unki baari aayi, unhone phir baat ki. Phir unhone (Nabi ne) unse kaha: "Ayesha ke maamle mein mujhe takleef mat do, kyunke Ilhaam Ayesha ke bistar ke ilawa kisi aur bistar par mere paas nahi aata." Isspar Um Salama ne kaha: "Main aapko takleef dene ke liye Allah se tauba karti hoon." Phir Um Salama ke giroh ne Fatima (Alayhas Salam), Allah ke Rasool ki beti, ko bulaya aur unhe Allah ke Rasool ke paas bheja yeh kehne: "Aapki biwiyan chahti hain ke aap unke saath aur Abu Bakr ki beti (Ayesha) ke saath barabar ka suluk karein." Phir Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ne yeh sandesh unhe diya. Nabi ne kaha: "Aye meri beti! Kya tum usse mohabbat nahi karti jisse main mohabbat karta hoon?" Unhone haan mein jawab diya aur wapas jaakar unhe halaat batayi. Unhone unse phir jaane ko kaha magar unhone inkaar kiya. Phir unhone Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Jahsh (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko bheja jo unke paas gayi aur sakht alfaaz mein kaha: "Aapki biwiyan chahti hain ke aap unke saath aur Ibn Abu Quhafa (Abu Bakr) ki beti ke saath barabar ka suluk karein." Isspar unhone apni aawaaz oonchi ki aur Ayesha ko unke saamne bura-bhala kaha itna ke Allah ke Rasool ne Ayesha ki taraf dekha yeh dekhne ke kya woh jawab degi. Ayesha ne Zainab ko jawab dena shuru kiya jab tak unhe khaamosh nahi kar diya. Nabi ne phir Ayesha ki taraf dekha aur kaha: "Woh waaqai Abu Bakr ki beti hai."

e: Narrated 'Azra bin Thabit Al-Ansari:When I went to Thumama bin `Abdullah, he gave me some perfume and said that Anas would not reject the gifts of perfume. Anas said: The Prophet (ﷺ) used not to reject the gifts of perfume
hi: Azra bin Thabit Al-Ansari bataate hain: Jab main Thumama bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas gaya, unhone mujhe kuch khushbu di aur kaha ke Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) khushbu ka tohfa kabhi radd nahi karte the. Anas ne kaha: Nabi khushbu ka tohfa kabhi radd nahi karte the.

e: Narrated Al-Miswar bin Makhrama and Marwan:When the delegates of the tribe of Hawazin came to the Prophet (ﷺ) he stood up amongst the people, Glorified and Praised Allah as He deserved, and said, "Then after: Your brethren have come to you with repentance and I see it logical to return to them their captives; so whoever amongst you likes to do that as a favor, then he can do it, and whoever of you like to stick to his share till we give him his right from the very first Fai (war booty) (1) which Allah will bestow on us, then (he can do so)." The people replied, "We do that (to return the captives) willingly as a favor for your sake
hi: Al-Miswar bin Makhrama (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Marwan bataate hain: Jab Hawazin qabile ka wafd Nabi ke paas aaya, woh logon ke beech khade hue, Allah ki jaisi hamd honi chahiye vaisi ki, aur kaha: "Iske baad: Tumhare bhai tauba karke tumhare paas aaye hain aur main theek samajhta hoon ke unke qaidiyon ko wapas karun; isliye jo bhi tum mein se ise ehsaan ke tor par karna chahe, kar sakta hai, aur jo apna hissa rakhna chahe jab tak humein pehli maal-e-ghanimat mile jise Allah humein dega, (woh bhi kar sakta hai)." Logon ne jawab diya: "Hum aisa (qaidiyon ko wapas karna) khushi se aapki khaatir karte hain."

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to accept gifts and used to give something in return
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool tohfe qubool karte the aur badle mein kuch dete the.

e: Narrated An-Nu`man bin Bashir:that his father took him to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "I have given this son of mine a slave." The Prophet asked, "Have you given all your sons the like?" He replied in the negative. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Take back your gift then
hi: An-Nu'man bin Bashir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain, apne waalid ke hawale se: Unke waalid unhe Allah ke Rasool ke paas le gaye aur kaha: "Maine apne is bete ko ek gulaam diya hai." Nabi ne pucha: "Kya tumne apne sab beton ko isi jaisa diya hai?" Unhone na mein jawab diya. Nabi ne kaha: "Phir apna tohfa wapas le lo."

e: Narrated 'Amir:I heard An-Nu`man bin Bashir on the pulpit saying, "My father gave me a gift but `Amra bint Rawaha (my mother) said that she would not agree to it unless he made Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as a witness to it. So, my father went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, 'I have given a gift to my son from `Amra bint Rawaha, but she ordered me to make you as a witness to it, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!' Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked, 'Have you given (the like of it) to everyone of your sons?' He replied in the negative. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Be afraid of Allah, and be just to your children.' My father then returned and took back his gift
hi: Aamir bataate hain: Maine An-Nu'man bin Bashir (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko mimbar par kehte suna: "Mere waalid ne mujhe ek tohfa diya magar Amra bint Rawaha (meri maa) ne kaha ke woh isse raazi nahi hongi jab tak woh Allah ke Rasool ko iska gawaah na banaye. Isliye mere waalid Allah ke Rasool ke paas gaye aur kaha: 'Maine Amra bint Rawaha ke bete ko ek tohfa diya hai, magar unhone mujhse aapko iska gawaah banane ko kaha, Aye Allah ke Rasool!' Allah ke Rasool ne pucha: 'Kya tumne apne sab beton ko (isi jaisa) diya hai?' Unhone na mein jawab diya. Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: 'Allah se daro, aur apne bachchon ke saath insaaf karo.' Mere waalid phir wapas gaye aur apna tohfa wapas le liya."

e: Narrated Az-Zuhri:Ubaidullah bin `Abdullah told me that `Aisha had said, "When the Prophet (ﷺ) became sick and his condition became serious, he requested his wives to allow him to be treated in my house, and they allowed him. He came out leaning on two men while his feet were dragging on the ground. He was walking between Al-`Abbas and another man." 'Ubaidullah said, "When I informed Ibn `Abbas of what `Aisha had said, he asked me whether I knew who was the second man whom `Aisha had not named. I replied in the negative. He said, 'He was `Ali bin Abi Talib
hi: Az-Zuhri bataate hain: Ubaidullah bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne mujhe bataya ke Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha: "Jab Nabi bimar hue aur unki halat sanjeeda ho gayi, unhone apni biwiyon se guzarish ki ke unhe mere ghar mein ilaaj karne diya jaaye, aur unhone ijazat di. Woh do mardon par tekkar bahar aaye jabke unke paon zameen par ghisat rahe the. Woh Al-Abbas aur ek doosre shaks ke beech chal rahe the." Ubaidullah ne kaha: "Jab maine Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko yeh Ayesha ki baat batayi, unhone mujhse pucha kya mujhe pata hai kaun doosra shaks tha jiska naam Ayesha ne nahi liya. Maine na mein jawab diya. Unhone kaha: 'Woh Ali (Alayhis Salam) bin Abi Talib the.'"

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "One who takes back his gift (which he has already given) is like a dog that swallows its vomit
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jo apna diya hua tohfa wapas leta hai, woh us kutte jaisa hai jo apni ulti khud khaata hai."

e: Narrated Asma:Once I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have no property except what has been given to me by Az-Zubair (i.e. her husband). May I give in charity?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Give in charity and do not withhold it; otherwise Allah will withhold it back from you
hi: Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ek baar maine kaha: "Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mere paas koi maal nahi siwaye us maal ke jo Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) (unke shohar) ne mujhe di hai. Kya main sadqa de sakti hoon?" Nabi ne kaha: "Sadqa do aur ise mat roko; warna Allah ise tumse rok lega."

e: Narrated Asma:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Give (in charity) and do not give reluctantly lest Allah should give you in a limited amount; and do not withhold your money lest Allah should withhold it from you
hi: Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Sadqa do aur bemann se mat do, kahin Allah tumhe seemit maqdaar mein de; aur apna paisa mat roko, kahin Allah use tumse rok le."

e: Narrated Kuraib:the freed slave of Ibn `Abbas, that Maimuna bint Al-Harith told him that she manumitted a slave-girl without taking the permission of the Prophet. On the day when it was her turn to be with the Prophet, she said, "Do you know, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), that I have manumitted my slave-girl?" He said, "Have you really?" She replied in the affirmative. He said, "You would have got more reward if you had given her (i.e. the slave-girl) to one of your maternal uncles
hi: Kuraib, Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke azaad kiye gulaam, bataate hain: Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Al-Harith ne unhe bataya ke unhone Nabi ki ijazat liye bina ek launDi azaad ki. Jis din unki baari thi Nabi ke saath, unhone kaha: "Kya aapko pata hai, Aye Allah ke Rasool, maine apni launDi azaad kar di hai?" Unhone pucha: "Kya waaqai?" Unhone haan mein jawab diya. Unhone kaha: "Tumhe zyada ajr milta agar tumne use apne maama mein se kisi ko diya hota."

e: Narrated Aisha:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) wanted to go on a journey, he would draw lots as to which of his wives would accompany him. He would take her whose name came out. He used to fix for each of them a day and a night. But Sauda bint Zam`a gave up her (turn) day and night to `Aisha, the wife of the Prophet in order to seek the pleasure of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (by that action)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab bhi Allah ke Rasool safar par jaane ka iraada karte, woh chitthi daalte kis biwi ko unke saath jaana hai. Woh jiska naam nikalta use le jaate. Woh har ek ke liye ek din-raat muqarrar karte the. Magar Sauda (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Zam'a ne apna din-raat Ayesha ko de diya taake Allah ke Rasool ki khushi haasil kar sakein.

e: Narrated Maimuna, the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ) that she manumitted her slave-girl and the Prophet (ﷺ) said to her, "You would have got more reward if you had given the slave-girl to one of your maternal uncles
hi: Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا), Nabi ki biwi, bataati hain: Unhone apni launDi azaad ki aur Nabi ne unse kaha: "Tumhe zyada ajr milta agar tumne launDi apne maama mein se kisi ko di hoti."

e: Narrated Aisha:I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have two neighbors; which of them should I give a gift to?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "(Give) to the one whose door is nearer to you
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine kaha: "Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mere do padosi hain; unme se kise main tohfa dun?" Nabi ne kaha: "(Do) jiska darwaza tumse zyada nazdeek ho."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abbas:That he heard As-Sa'b bin Jath-thama Al-Laithi, who was one of the companions of the Prophet, saying that he gave the meat of an onager to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while he was at a place called Al-Abwa' or Waddan, and was in a state of Ihram. The Prophet (ﷺ) did not accept it. When the Prophet (ﷺ) saw the signs of sorrow on As-Sa'b's face because of not accepting his present, he said (to him), "We are not returning your present, but we are in the state of Ihram." (See Hadith No)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Unhone As-Sa'b bin Jath-thama Al-Laithi, jo Nabi ke sahaba mein se ek the, se suna ke unhone Allah ke Rasool ko ek jangli gadhe ka gosht diya jabke woh Al-Abwa ya Waddan naam ki jagah par the aur Ihram mein the. Nabi ne use qubool nahi kiya. Jab Nabi ne As-Sa'b ke chehre par unka tohfa qubool na karne ki wajah se gam ke asaraat dekhe, unhone (unse) kaha: "Hum tumhara tohfa wapas nahi kar rahe, magar hum Ihram mein hain."

e: Narrated Abu Humaid Al-Sa`idi:The Prophet (ﷺ) appointed a man from the tribe of Al-Azd, called Ibn 'Utbiyya for collecting the Zakat. When he returned he said, "This (i.e. the Zakat) is for you and this has been given to me as a present." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Why hadn't he stayed in his father's or mother's house to see whether he would be given presents or not? By Him in Whose Hands my life is, whoever takes something from the resources of the Zakat (unlawfully) will be carrying it on his neck on the Day of Resurrection; if it be a camel, it will be grunting; if a cow, it will be mooing; and if a sheep, it will be bleating." The Prophet then raised his hands till we saw the whiteness of his armpits, and he said thrice, "O Allah! Haven't I conveyed Your Message (to them)?
hi: Abu Humaid Al-Sa'idi bataate hain: Nabi ne Al-Azd qabile ke ek shaks ko, jise Ibn Utbiyya kaha jaata tha, Zakat jama karne ke liye muqarrar kiya. Jab woh wapas aaye, unhone kaha: "Yeh (Zakat) aapke liye hai aur yeh mujhe tohfe mein diya gaya hai." Nabi ne kaha: "Woh apne waalid ya apni maa ke ghar kyun nahi ruke yeh dekhne ke unhe tohfe milte ya nahi? Us zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, jo bhi Zakat ke maal se (ghair-qanooni tareeke se) kuch leta hai, woh use Qiyamat ke din apni gardan par lekar aayega; agar woh oont hoga, woh garajta hoga; agar gaay hogi, woh boonken maar rahi hogi; aur agar bhed hogi, woh mimiya rahi hogi." Nabi ne phir apne haath uthaye jab tak humne unki baghal ki safedi dekhi, aur teen baar kaha: "Aye Allah! Kya maine tera paighaam (unhe) pahuncha diya?"

e: Narrated Jabir:The Prophet (ﷺ) said to me, "I will give you so much (the Prophet (ﷺ) pointed thrice with his hands) when funds of Bahrain will come to me." But the Prophet (ﷺ) died before the money reached him. (When it came) Abu Bakr ordered an announcer to announce that whoever had a money claim on the Prophet (ﷺ) or was promised to be given something, should come to Abu Bakr. I went to Abu Bakr and told him that the Prophet (ﷺ) had promised to give me so much. On that Abu Bakr gave me three handfuls (of money)
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne mujhse kaha: "Main tumhe itna dunga (Nabi ne apne haathon se teen baar ishara kiya) jab Bahrain ka paisa mere paas aayega." Magar Nabi ka intiqal ho gaya paisa pahunchne se pehle. (Jab woh aaya) Abu Bakr ne ek elaan karne wale ko hukum diya ke elaan kare ke jiska bhi Nabi par koi paisa ka daawa hai, ya jise kuch dene ka waada kiya gaya tha, Abu Bakr ke paas aaye. Main Abu Bakr ke paas gaya aur unhe bataya ke Nabi ne mujhse itna dene ka waada kiya tha. Isspar Abu Bakr ne mujhe teen mutthiyan (paisa ki) di.

e: Narrated Al-Miswar bin Makhrama:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) distributed some cloaks but did not give anything thereof to Makhrama. Makhrama said (to me), "O son! accompany me to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." When I went with him, he said, "Call him to me." I called him (i.e. the Prophet (ﷺ) ) for my father. He came out wearing one of those cloaks and said, "We kept this (cloak) for you, (Makhrama)." Makhrama looked at the cloak and said, "Makhrama is pleased," (or the Prophet (ﷺ) said), "Is Makhrama pleased?
hi: Al-Miswar bin Makhrama (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kuch chogha taqseem kiye magar Makhrama ko usme se kuch nahi diya. Makhrama ne (mujhse) kaha: "Aye bete! Mere saath Allah ke Rasool ke paas chalo." Jab main unke saath gaya, unhone kaha: "Unhe mere paas bulao." Maine unhe (Nabi ko) apne waalid ke liye bulaya. Woh un chogho mein se ek pehnkar bahar aaye aur kaha: "Humne yeh (chogha) tumhare liye rakha tha, (Makhrama)." Makhrama ne chogha dekha aur kaha: "Makhrama khush hai," (ya Nabi ne kaha), "Kya Makhrama khush hai?"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:A man came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "I am ruined." The Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "What do you mean?" He said, "I had a sexual intercourse with my wife during Ramadan (while fasting)." The Prophet (ﷺ) asked him, "Can you manumit a slave?" He replied in the negative. He then asked him, "Can you fast for two successive months continuously" He replied in the negative. The Prophet (ﷺ) then asked him, "Can you feed sixty poor persons?" He replied in the negative. In the meantime an Ansari came with a basket full of dates. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to the man, "Take it and give it in charity (as an expiation of your sin)." The man said "Should I give it to some people who are poorer than we O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? By Him Who has sent you with the Truth, there is no family between Medina's two mountains poorer than we." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) told him to take it and provide his family with it
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks Allah ke Rasool ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Main barbaad ho gaya hoon." Nabi ne pucha: "Kya matlab?" Usne kaha: "Maine Ramadan mein (roze ki halat mein) apni biwi se humbistari ki." Nabi ne unse pucha: "Kya tum ek gulaam azaad kar sakte ho?" Usne na mein jawab diya. Phir unhone pucha: "Kya tum lagataar do maheene roza rakh sakte ho?" Usne na mein jawab diya. Nabi ne phir pucha: "Kya tum saath zaroorat-mand logon ko khana khila sakte ho?" Usne na mein jawab diya. Isi dauran ek Ansari khajooron se bhari ek tokri lekar aaya. Nabi ne shaks se kaha: "Ise lo aur sadqa mein de do (apne gunah ke kaffare ke tor par)." Shaks ne kaha: "Kya main isse hum se zyada gareeb logon ko dun, Aye Allah ke Rasool? Us zaat ki qasam jisne aapko haqq ke saath bheja, Madina ke do pahadon ke beech humse zyada gareeb koi pariwara nahi." Allah ke Rasool ne use apne pariwara ko khilane ko kaha.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:My father was martyred on the day (of the battle) of Uhud and his creditors demanded the debt back in a harsh manner. So I went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and informed him of that, he asked them to accept the fruits of my garden and excuse my father, but they refused. So, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not give them the fruits, nor did he cut them and distribute them among them, but said, "I will come to you tomorrow morning." So, he came to us the next morning and walked about in between the date-palms and invoked Allah to bless their fruits. I plucked the fruits and gave back all the rights of the creditors in full, and a lot of fruits were left for us. Then I went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), who was sitting, and informed him about what happened. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) told `Umar, who was sitting there, to listen to the story. `Umar said, "Don't we know that you are Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? By Allah! you are Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Mere waalid Uhud ki jung ke din shaheed hue aur unke qarz-daaron ne sakht tareeke se qarz maanga. Isliye main Allah ke Rasool ke paas gaya aur unhe iske baare mein bataya, unhone unse (qarz-daaron se) mere baag ke phal lekar mere waalid ko maaf karne ko kaha, magar unhone inkaar kiya. Isliye Allah ke Rasool ne unhe phal nahi diye, na hi unhe kaatkar unme taqseem kiya, balki kaha: "Main kal subah tumhare paas aunga." Isliye woh agli subah humare paas aaye aur khajoor ke darakhton ke beech ghume aur unke phalon ke liye Allah se barkat maangi. Maine phal tode aur qarz-daaron ka poora haqq ada kiya, aur humare liye bahut sara phal bach gaya. Phir main Allah ke Rasool ke paas gaya, jo baithe hue the, aur unhe jo hua woh bataya. Allah ke Rasool ne Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se, jo wahan baithe the, kaha ke kahani sunein. Umar ne kaha: "Kya humein nahi pata aap Allah ke Rasool hain? Allah ki qasam, aap Allah ke Rasool hain."

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:A drink (milk mixed with water) was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) who drank some of it while a boy was sitting on his right and old men on his left. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to the boy, "If you permit me, I'll give (the rest of the drink to) these old men first." The boy said, "I will not give preference to any one over me as regards my share from you, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" The Prophet (ﷺ) then put that container in the boy's hand. (See Hadith No)
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ke paas ek peene ki cheez (doodh paani mein milaya hua) laayi gayi jise unhone piya, jabke ek ladka unki dahini taraf baitha tha aur budhe log unki baayi taraf. Nabi ne ladke se kaha: "Agar tum mujhe ijazat do, main pehle in budhe logon ko (baaki cheez) de dun." Ladke ne kaha: "Main kisi ko bhi apni baari se pehle nahi dunga, Aye Allah ke Rasool!" Phir Nabi ne woh bartan ladke ke haath mein rakh diya.

e: Jabir (ra) said, "I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) in the mosque and he paid me my right and gave me more than he owed me
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main masjid mein Nabi ke paas gaya aur unhone mera haqq ada kiya aur jitna unpar qarz tha usse zyada diya.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:I sold a camel to the Prophet (ﷺ) on one of the journeys. When we reached Medina, he ordered me to go to the Mosque and offer two rak`at. Then he weighed for me (the price of the camel in gold) and gave an extra amount over it. A part of it remained with me till it was taken by the army of Sham on the day of Harra
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine ek safar mein Nabi ko ek oont becha. Jab hum Madina pahunche, unhone mujhe masjid jaakar do rakat padhne ka hukum diya. Phir unhone mere liye (oont ki qeemat sone mein) tola aur isse zyada diya. Uska ek hissa mere paas tha jab tak Harra ke din Sham ki fauj ne mujhse le liya.

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:A drink (of milk and water) was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while a boy was sitting on his right side and old men were sitting on his left side. He asked the boy, "Will you allow me to give it to these (people)?" The boy said, "No, by Allah, I will not allow anyone to take my right from you." Then the Prophet put the bowl in the boy's hand
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ke paas ek peene ki cheez (doodh-paani) laayi gayi jabke ek ladka unki dahini taraf baitha tha aur budhe log unki baayi taraf. Unhone ladke se pucha: "Kya tum mujhe ijazat doge ke main ise in (logon) ko de dun?" Ladke ne kaha: "Nahi, Allah ki qasam, main kisi ko bhi mera haqq aapse lene ki ijazat nahi dunga." Phir Nabi ne woh bartan ladke ke haath mein rakh diya.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) owed a man some debt (and that man demanded it very harshly). The companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) wanted to harm him, but the Prophet (ﷺ) said to them, "Leave him, as the creditor has the right to speak harshly." He then added, "Buy (a camel) of the same age and give it to him." They said, "We cannot get except a camel of an older age than that of his." He said, "Buy it and give it to him, as the best amongst you is he who pays back his debt in the most handsome way
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool par kisi ka kuch qarz tha (aur woh shaks sakhti se maang raha tha). Nabi ke sahaba use nuqsaan pahunchana chahte the, magar Nabi ne unse kaha: "Use chhod do, kyunke qarz-daata ko sakhti se bolne ka haqq hai." Phir unhone joda: "Usi umr ka (oont) khareedo aur use de do." Unhone kaha: "Humein sirf usse bada (oont) milta hai." Nabi ne kaha: "Ise khareedo aur de do, kyunke tum mein sabse behtar woh hai jo apna qarz sabse behtareen tareeke se chukata hai."

e: Narrated Marwan bin Al-Hakam and Al-Miswar bin Makhrama:When the delegates of the tribe of Hawazin came to the Prophet (ﷺ) they requested him to return their property and their captives. He said to them, "This concerns also other people along with me as you see, and the best statement to me is the true one, so you may choose one of two alternatives; either the captives or the property and (I have not distributed the booty for) I have been waiting for you." When the Prophet (ﷺ) had returned from Ta'if, he waited for them for more than ten nights. When they came to know that the Prophet (ﷺ) would not return except one of the two, they chose their captives. The Prophet then stood up amongst the Muslims, Glorified and Praised Allah as He deserved, and then said, "Then after: These brothers of yours have come to you with repentance and I see it proper to return their captives, so whoever amongst you likes to do that as a favor, then he can do it, and whoever of you wants to stick to his share till we pay him from the very first Fai (i.e. war booty) which Allah will give us, then he can do so." The people said, "We return (the captives) to them willingly as a favor, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I do not know who of you has given his consent and who has not; so go back and your leaders may present your decision to me." The people went away, and their leaders discussed the matter with them, and then came to the Prophet (ﷺ) to tell him that all of them had given their consent (to return the captives) willingly. (Az-Zuhri, the sub-narrator said, "This is what we know about the captives of Hawazin)
hi: Marwan bin Al-Hakam aur Al-Miswar bin Makhrama (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Hawazin qabile ka wafd Nabi ke paas aaya, unhone unse apni maal aur apne qaidiyon ko wapas karne ki guzarish ki. Nabi ne unse kaha: "Isme mere saath doosre log bhi hain jaisa tumhe pata hai, aur mujhe sabse aziz baat sachi baat hai; isliye tumhe do cheezon mein se ek chunne ka ikhtiyaar hai — ya to qaidi ya maal — (aur maine taqseem nahi ki hai) kyunke maine tumhara intezaar kiya." Jab Nabi Taif se wapas aaye, unhone unka das raaton se zyada intezaar kiya. Jab unhe pata chala ke Nabi in do cheezon mein se sirf ek hi wapas karenge, unhone apne qaidi chune. Nabi phir Musalmanon ke beech khade hue, Allah ki jaisi hamd honi chahiye vaisi ki, aur kaha: "Iske baad: Tumhare yeh bhai tauba karke tumhare paas aaye hain aur main theek samajhta hoon ke unke qaidi wapas karun, isliye jo bhi tum mein se ise ehsaan ke tor par karna chahe, kar sakta hai, aur jo apna hissa rakhna chahe jab tak humein pehli maal-e-ghanimat (yaani jung ka maal) mile jo Allah humein dega, woh bhi kar sakta hai." Logon ne kaha: "Hum unhe (qaidiyon ko) khushi se ehsaan ke tor par wapas karte hain, Aye Allah ke Rasool!" Nabi ne kaha: "Mujhe nahi pata tum mein se kisne raazi hokar diya aur kisne nahi; isliye wapas jaao aur tumhare sardaar mujhe tumhara faisla bata sakte hain." Log wapas gaye aur unke sardaaron ne unse baat ki, phir Nabi ke paas aakar bataya ke sabne khushi se raazandi de di hai (qaidi wapas karne ki). (Az-Zuhri, doosre raawi ne kaha: "Yehi humein Hawazin ke qaidiyon ke baare mein maloom hai.")

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) took a camel of special age from somebody on credit. Its owner came and demanded it back (harshly). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No doubt, he who has a right, can demand it." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) gave him an older camel than his camel and said, "The best amongst you is he who repays his debts in the most handsome way
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kisi se udhaar mein ek khaas umr ka oont liya. Uska maalik aaya aur ise sakhti se wapas maanga. Nabi ne kaha: "Beshak, jiska haqq ho, use maangne ka haqq hai." Phir Nabi ne use uske oont se bada oont diya aur kaha: "Tum mein sabse behtar woh hai jo apna qarz sabse behtareen tareeke se chukata hai."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:That he was in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) on a journey, riding a troublesome camel belonging to `Umar. The camel used to go ahead of the Prophet, so Ibn `Umar's father would say, "O `Abdullah! No one should go ahead of the Prophet." The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "Sell it to me." `Umar said to the Prophet "It is for you." So, he bought it and said, "O `Abdullah! It is for you, and you can do with it what you like
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Woh ek safar mein Nabi ki sohbat mein the, Umar ke ek na-qaboo oont par sawar. Yeh oont Nabi se aage nikal jaata, isliye Ibn Umar ke waalid kahte: "Aye Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ)! Koi bhi Nabi se aage na nikle." Nabi ne unse (Umar se) kaha: "Ise mujhe becho." Umar ne Nabi se kaha: "Yeh aapke liye hai." Isliye unhone use khareeda aur kaha: "Aye Abdullah! Yeh tumhare liye hai, aur tum ispar jo chaho kar sakte ho."

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar (ra):We were in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) on a journey, and I was riding a troublesome camel. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked 'Umar to sell that camel to him. So, 'Umar sold it to him. The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "O 'Abdullah! The camel is for you
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Hum ek safar mein Nabi ki sohbat mein the, aur main ek na-qaboo oont par sawar tha. Nabi ne Umar se woh oont unhe bechne ko kaha. Isliye Umar ne ise unhe becha. Nabi ne phir kaha: "Aye Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ)! Yeh oont tumhare liye hai."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:`Umar bin Al-Khattab saw a silken dress (cloak) being sold at the gate of the Mosque and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Would that you buy it and wear it on Fridays and when the delegates come to you!" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "This is worn by the one who will have no share in the Hereafter." Later on some silk dresses were brought and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent one of them to `Umar. `Umar said, "How do you give me this to wear while you said what you said about the dress of 'Utarid?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I have not given it to you to wear." So, `Umar gave it to a pagan brother of his in Mecca
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Umar bin Khattab (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne masjid ke darwaze par ek resham ka libaas (chogha) bikte dekha aur kaha: "Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kaash aap ise khareed lete aur Jumme ke din aur jab wafd aapke paas aaye tab pehante." Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: "Ise woh pehanta hai jiska Aakhirat mein koi hissa nahi." Baad mein kuch resham ke libaas laaye gaye aur Allah ke Rasool ne unme se ek Umar ko bheja. Umar ne kaha: "Aap mujhe yeh pehnne ko kaise dete hain jabke aapne Utarid ke libaas ke baare mein woh kaha jo kaha?" Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: "Maine tumhe ise pehnne ke liye nahi diya." Isliye Umar ne ise Mecca mein apne mushrik bhai ko de diya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) went to the house of Fatima but did not enter it. `Ali came and she told him about that. When 'Ali asked the Prophet (ﷺ) about it, he said, "I saw a (multicolored) decorated curtain on her door. I am not interested in worldly things." `Ali went to Fatima and told her about it. Fatima said, "I am ready to dispense with it in the way he suggests." The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered her to send it to such-andsuch needy people
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Ek baar Nabi Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ke ghar gaye magar andar nahi gaye. Ali (Alayhis Salam) aaye aur usne unhe iske baare mein bataya. Jab Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne Nabi se iske baare mein pucha, unhone kaha: "Maine unke darwaze par ek (rangeen) sajaawati parda dekha. Mujhe duniyawi cheezon mein dilchaspi nahi." Ali (Alayhis Salam) Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ke paas gaye aur unhe iske baare mein bataya. Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ne kaha: "Main isse jaisi bhi unki khwahish ho, chhod dene ko taiyaar hoon." Nabi ne unhe hukum diya ke woh ise falaan-falaan zaroorat-mand logon ko bhej den.

e: Narrated `Ali:The Prophet (ﷺ) gave me a silken dress as a gift and I wore it. When I saw the signs of anger on his face, I cut it into pieces and distributed it among my wives
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Nabi ne mujhe resham ka libaas tohfe mein diya aur maine ise pehna. Jab maine unke chehre par gusse ke asaraat dekhe, maine ise tukdon mein kaat diya aur apni biwiyon mein taqseem kar diya.

e: Narrated Anas:A Jubba (i.e. cloak) made of thick silken cloth was presented to the Prophet. The Prophet (ﷺ) used to forbid people to wear silk. So, the people were pleased to see it. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "By Him in Whose Hands Muhammad's soul is, the handkerchiefs of Sa`d bin Mu`adh in Paradise are better than this." Anas added, "The present was sent to the Prophet (ﷺ) by Ukaidir (a Christian) from Dauma
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ko moti resham ke kapde se bana ek Jubba (chogha) pesh kiya gaya. Nabi log resham pehanne se mana karte the. Isliye log ise dekhkar khush hue. Nabi ne kaha: "Us zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein Muhammad ki jaan hai, Jannat mein Sa'd bin Mu'adh ke rumaal is (resham) se behtar hain." Anas ne joda: "Yeh tohfa Nabi ko Ukaidir (ek Isaai) ne Dauma se bheja tha."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:A Jewess brought a poisoned (cooked) sheep for the Prophet (ﷺ) who ate from it. She was brought to the Prophet and he was asked, "Shall we kill her?" He said, "No." I continued to see the effect of the poison on the palate of the mouth of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek Yahudi aurat Nabi ke liye zeher milai hui (pakai) bhed laayi jise unhone khaya. Use Nabi ke paas laaya gaya aur unse pucha gaya: "Kya hum use qatl kar dein?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi." Main lagataar zeher ka asar Allah ke Rasool ke mun ke taalu par dekhta raha.

e: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Bakr:We were one-hundred and thirty persons accompanying the Prophet (ﷺ) who asked us whether anyone of us had food. There was a man who had about a Sa of wheat which was mixed with water then. A very tall pagan came driving sheep. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked him, "Will you sell us (a sheep) or give it as a present?" He said, "I will sell you (a sheep)." The Prophet (ﷺ) bought a sheep and it was slaughtered. The Prophet ordered that its liver and other Abdominal organs be roasted. By Allah, the Prophet (ﷺ) gave every person of the one-hundred-and-thirty a piece of that; he gave all those of them who were present; and kept the shares of those who were absent. The Prophet (ﷺ) then put its meat in two huge basins and all of them ate to their fill, and even then more food was left in the two basins which were carried on the camel (or said something like it)
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Bakr bataate hain: Hum ek sau tees log Nabi ki sohbat mein the jinhone humse pucha kya humme se kisi ke paas khana hai. Ek shaks tha jiske paas taqreeban ek Sa gehun tha jo paani mein milaya gaya tha. Ek bahut lamba mushrik apni bhedein hankata hua aaya. Nabi ne unse pucha: "Kya tum humein (ek bhed) bechoge ya tohfe mein doge?" Usne kaha: "Main aapko bechunga." Nabi ne ek bhed khareedi aur use zabah kiya gaya. Nabi ne hukum diya ke uska jigar aur doosre pet ke ang bhoone jaaen. Allah ki qasam, Nabi ne un ek sau tees logon mein se har ek ko usme se ek tukda diya; jo maujood the unhe diya, aur jo maujood nahi the unke hisse rakh liye. Nabi ne phir uska gosht do bade katoron mein rakha aur sab logon ne pet bhar kar khaya, aur phir bhi katoron mein khana bacha jise oont par lekar jaaya gaya (ya isi jaisa kuch kaha).

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:`Umar saw a silken cloak over a man for sale and requested the Prophet (ﷺ) to buy it in order to wear it on Fridays and while meeting delegates. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "This is worn by the one who will have no share in the Hereafter." Later on Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got some silken cloaks similar to that one, and he sent one to `Umar. `Umar said to the Prophet (ﷺ) "How can I wear it, while you said about it what you said?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I have not given it to you to wear, but to sell or to give to someone else." So, `Umar sent it to his brother at Mecca before he embraced Islam
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Umar ne ek shaks par resham ka chogha bikte dekha aur Nabi se guzarish ki ke woh use khareed lein taake Jumme ke din aur wafd se milte waqt pehen sakein. Nabi ne kaha: "Ise woh pehanta hai jiska Aakhirat mein koi hissa nahi." Baad mein Allah ke Rasool ko usi jaise kuch resham ke chogha mile, aur unhone ek Umar ko bheja. Umar ne Nabi se kaha: "Main ise kaise pehnun jabke aapne iske baare mein woh kaha jo kaha?" Nabi ne kaha: "Maine ise tumhe pehnne ke liye nahi diya, balki bechne ya kisi aur ko dene ke liye." Isliye Umar ne ise Mecca mein apne bhai ko bheja isse pehle ke woh Islam qubool kare.

e: Narrated Asma' bint Abu Bakr:My mother came to me during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and she was a pagan. I said to Allah's Apostle (seeking his verdict), "My mother has come to me and she desires to receive a reward from me, shall I keep good relations with her?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Yes, keep good relation with her
hi: Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Abu Bakr (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Meri maa Allah ke Rasool ke zamane mein mere paas aayi jabke woh mushrik thi. Maine Allah ke Rasool se (unki raay lene ke liye) pucha: "Meri maa mere paas aayi hai aur woh mujhse kuch chahti hai; kya main unse achha suluk rakhun?" Nabi ne kaha: "Haan, unse achha suluk rakho."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who takes back his present is like him who swallows his vomit
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jo apna diya hua tohfa wapas leta hai, woh us shaks jaisa hai jo apni ulti khud nigal jaata hai."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The bad example is not for us. He who takes back his present is like a dog that swallows back its vomit
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Bura misaal humare liye nahi hai. Jo apna diya hua tohfa wapas leta hai, woh us kutte jaisa hai jo apni ulti khud nigal jaata hai."

e: Narrated `Umar bin Al-Khattab:I gave a horse in Allah's Cause. The person to whom it was given, did not look after it. I intended to buy it from him, thinking that he would sell it cheap. When I asked the Prophet (ﷺ) he said, "Don't buy it, even if he gives it to you for one Dirham, as the person who takes back what he has given in charity, is like a dog that swallows back its vomit
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Khattab (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ki raah mein ek ghoda diya. Jise woh diya gaya tha, usne uski dekhbhal nahi ki. Maine iraada kiya ke usse khareed lun, yeh sochkar ke woh use sasta bechega. Jab maine Nabi se pucha, unhone kaha: "Ise mat khareedo, chahe woh tumhe ek Dirham mein de de, kyunke jo shaks apna diya hua sadqa wapas leta hai, woh us kutte jaisa hai jo apni ulti khud nigal jaata hai."

e: Narrated Asma' bint Abu Bakr (ra):My mother came to me during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and she was a Mushrikah (polytheist, idolatress, pagan). I said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (seeking his verdict), "My mother has come to and she desires to recieve a reward from me, shall I keep good relations with her ?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Yes, keep good relation with her
hi: Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Abu Bakr (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Meri maa Allah ke Rasool ke zamane mein mere paas aayi jabke woh Mushrika (but-parast) thi. Maine Allah ke Rasool se (unki raay lene ke liye) pucha: "Meri maa mere paas aayi hai aur woh mujhse kuch chahti hai; kya main unse achha suluk rakhun?" Nabi ne kaha: "Haan, unse achha suluk rakho."

e: Narrated Jabir:The Prophet (ﷺ) gave the verdict that `Umra is for the one to whom it is presented
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne faisla diya ke Umra (jeevanbhar ke liye di gayi maal) usi ka hai jise woh di gayi hai.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Umra is permissible." Ata said, "Jabir narrated the same to me from the Prophet
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha: "Umra jaiz hai." Ata ne kaha: "Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne mujhe yehi Nabi se riwaayat ki."

e: Narrated Anas:Once the people of Medina were frightened, so the Prophet (ﷺ) borrowed a horse from Abu Talha called Al-Mandub, and rode it. When he came back he said, "We have not seen anything (to be afraid of), but the horse was very fast (having an energy as inexhaustible as the water of the sea)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Madina walon ko dar laga, isliye Nabi ne Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) se ek ghoda liya jise Al-Mandub kaha jaata tha, aur uspar sawar hue. Jab woh wapas aaye, unhone kaha: "Humein (darne wali) koi cheez nahi mili, magar yeh ghoda bahut tez tha (samundar ke paani jaisi na-khatam hone wali taaqat wala)."

e: Narrated Aiman:I went to `Aisha and she was wearing a coarse dress costing five Dirhams. `Aisha said, "Look up and see my slave-girl who refuses to wear it in the house though during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) I had a similar dress which no woman desiring to appear elegant (before her husband) failed to borrow from me
hi: Aiman bataate hain: Main Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas gaya aur woh ek mota (saada) kapda pehne hue thi jiski qeemat paanch Dirham thi. Ayesha ne kaha: "Dekho meri launDi ki taraf jo ise ghar mein pehanne se inkaar karti hai, jabke Allah ke Rasool ke zamane mein mere paas isi jaisa kapda tha jise koi bhi aurat jo (apne shohar ke saamne) sundar dikhna chahti thi, mujhse maangne se nahi chukti thi."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "What a good Maniha (the she-camel which has recently given birth and which gives profuse milk) is, and (what a good Maniha) (the sheep which gives profuse milk, a bowl in the morning and another in the evening) is!" Narrated Malik: Maniha is a good deed of charity
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Kitna achha hai Maniha (woh oontni jisne abhi bachcha diya ho aur bahut zyada doodh deti ho), aur (kitni achhi hai) woh bhed jo bahut doodh deti ho, ek subah ka pyaala aur ek shaam ka!" Malik (doosre raawi) ne kaha: Maniha sadqe ka ek neik amal hai.

e: Narrated Ibn Shihab Az-Zuhri:Anas bin Malik said, "When the emigrants came to Medina, they had nothing whereas the Ansar had land and property. The Ansar gave them their land on condition that the emigrants would give them half the yearly yield and work on the land and provide the necessaries for cultivation." His (i.e. Anas's mother who was also the mother of `Abdullah bin Abu Talha, gave some date-palms to Allah's Apostle who gave them to his freed slave-girl (Um Aiman) who was also the mother of Usama bin Zaid. When the Prophet (ﷺ) finished from the fighting against the people of Khaibar and returned to Medina, the emigrants returned to the Ansar the fruit gifts which the Ansar had given them. The Prophet (ﷺ) also returned to Anas's mother the date-palms. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave Um Aiman other trees from his garden in lieu of the old gift
hi: Ibn Shihab Az-Zuhri bataate hain: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Jab Muhajir Madina aaye, unke paas kuch nahi tha jabke Ansaar ke paas zameen aur maal thi. Ansaar ne unhe apni zameen is shart par di ke Muhajir unhe saal ki paidawaar ka aadha hissa denge aur zameen par kaam karenge aur kheti ke saaman ka intezaam karenge." Anas ki maa, jo Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki bhi maa thi, ne kuch khajoor ke darakht Allah ke Rasool ko diye jinhone unhe apni azaad ki hui launDi (Um Aiman) ko diya, jo Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki bhi maa thi. Jab Nabi ne Khaibar walon ke khilaf jung khatam ki aur Madina wapas aaye, Muhajireen ne Ansaar ko woh phal ke tohfe wapas kiye jo Ansaar ne unhe diye the. Nabi ne bhi Anas ki maa ko khajoor ke darakht wapas kiye. Allah ke Rasool ne Um Aiman ko apne baag se doosre darakht diye us purane tohfe ke badle mein.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:That Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "There are forty virtuous deeds and the best of them is the Maniha of a she-goat, and anyone who does one of these virtuous deeds hoping for Allah's reward with firm confidence that he will get it, then Allah will make him enter Paradise because of it. Hassan (a subnarrator) said, "We tried to count those good deeds below the Maniha; we mentioned replying to the sneezer, removing harmful things from the road, etc., but we failed to count even fifteen
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Chalis neik amal hain, aur unme sabse behtareen ek bakri ka Maniha hai, aur jo bhi in neik amalon mein se koi karta hai Allah ke ajr ki ummeed rakhte hue aur pukhta yaqeen ke saath ke use woh milega, Allah use isi wajah se Jannat mein daakhil karega." Hassan (doosre raawi) ne kaha: "Humne Maniha se neeche in neik amalon ko ginne ki koshish ki; humne chheenkne wale ko jawab dena, raaste se nuqsaandeh cheezein hataana, waghera ka zikar kiya, magar hum pandrah bhi na gin sake."

e: Narrated Jabir:Some men had superfluous land and they said that they would give it to others to cultivate on the condition that they would get one-third or one-fourth or one half of its yield. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever has land should cultivate it himself or give it to his brother or keep it uncultivated
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Kuch logon ke paas zyada zameen thi aur unhone kaha ke woh doosron ko zameen denge kheti karne ke liye is shart par ke unhe paidawaar ka ek-tihai, ek-chauthai, ya aadha milega. Nabi ne kaha: "Jiske paas zameen ho, use khud kheti karni chahiye ya apne bhai ko de deni chahiye, ya use un-kheti hui chhod dena chahiye."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id:A bedouin came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and asked him about emigration. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "May Allah be merciful to you. The matter of emigration is difficult. Have you got some camels?" He replied in the affirmative. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked him, "Do you pay their Zakat?" He replied in the affirmative. He asked, "Do you lend them so that their milk may be utilized by others?" The bedouin said, "Yes." The Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "Do you milk them on the day of watering them?" He replied, "Yes." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do good deeds beyond the merchants (or the sea) and Allah will never disregard any of your deeds." (See Hadith No. 260, Vol)
hi: Abu Saeed (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek dehati Nabi ke paas aaya aur unse hijrat ke baare mein pucha. Nabi ne unse kaha: "Allah tumpar reham kare. Hijrat ka maamla mushkil hai. Kya tumhare paas kuch oont hain?" Usne haan mein jawab diya. Nabi ne pucha: "Kya tum unka Zakat dete ho?" Usne haan mein jawab diya. Unhone pucha: "Kya tum unhe udhaar dete ho taake doosre unka doodh istemal kar sakein?" Dehati ne kaha: "Haan." Nabi ne pucha: "Kya tum unhe paani pilane ke din doodh nikaalte ho?" Usne jawab diya: "Haan." Nabi ne kaha: "Vyapaariyon (ya samundar) se pare neik amal karo aur Allah tumhare kisi bhi amal ko kabhi nazarandaaz nahi karega."

e: Narrated Tawus:That he was told by the most learned one amongst them (i.e. Ibn `Abbas) that the Prophet (ﷺ) went towards some land which was flourishing with vegetation and asked to whom it belonged. He was told that such and such a person took it on rent. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It would have been better (for the owner) if he had given it to him gratis rather than charging him a fixed rent
hi: Tawus bataate hain: Sabse jaankaar shaks (yaani Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ)) ne unhe bataya ke Nabi ek aisi zameen ki taraf gaye jo hariyali se bhari thi aur pucha yeh kiski hai. Unhe bataya gaya ke falaan-falaan shaks ne ise kiraaye par liya hai. Nabi ne kaha: "(Maalik ke liye) behtar hota agar usne ise muft de diya hota, kisi tay shuda kiraaye ke badle lene se."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The Prophet Abraham (ﷺ) migrated with Sarah. The people (of the town where they migrated) gave her Ajar (i.e. Hajar). Sarah returned and said to Abraham, "Do you know that Allah has humiliated that pagan and he has given a slave-girl for my service?
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Nabi Ibrahim ne Sarah ke saath hijrat ki. (Us jagah ke) logon ne unhe Ajar (yaani Hajar, ek launDi) di. Sarah wapas aayi aur Ibrahim se kaha: 'Kya aapko pata hai Allah ne us mushrik ko zaleel kiya hai aur usne meri khidmat ke liye ek launDi di hai?'"

e: Narrated `Umar bin Al-Khattab:Once I gave a horse (for riding) in Allah's Cause. Later I saw it being sold. I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (whether I could buy it). He said, "Don't buy it, for you should not get back what you have given in charity
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Khattab (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar maine Allah ki raah mein (sawari ke liye) ek ghoda diya. Baad mein maine dekha ke woh bik raha hai. Maine Allah ke Rasool se pucha (kya main use khareed sakta hoon). Unhone kaha: "Ise mat khareedo, kyunke tumhe woh cheez wapas nahi leni chahiye jo tumne sadqe mein di."

e: Narrated `Urwa bin Al-Musaiyab Alqama bin Waqqas and Ubaidullah bin `Abdullah:About the story of `Aisha and their narrations were similar attesting each other, when the liars said what they invented about `Aisha, and the Divine Inspiration was delayed, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent for `Ali and Usama to consult them in divorcing his wife (i.e. `Aisha). Usama said, "Keep your wife, as we know nothing about her except good." Barirah said, "I cannot accuse her of any defect except that she is still a young girl who sleeps, neglecting her family's dough which the domestic goats come to eat (i.e. she was too simple-minded to deceive her husband)." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Who can help me to take revenge over the man who has harmed me by defaming the reputation of my family? By Allah, I have not known about my family anything except good, and they mentioned (i.e. accused) a man about whom I did not know anything except good
hi: Urwa bin Al-Musaiyab, Alqama bin Waqqas aur Ubaidullah bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain, Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke qisse ke baare mein, aur unki riwaayaten ek-doosre ki tasdeeq karti hain: Jab jhoot bolne walon ne Ayesha ke baare mein jhoothi baatein ghadi, aur wahi mein deri hui, Allah ke Rasool ne Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Usama ko bulaya taake unse salaah len apni biwi (Ayesha) ko talaq dene ke baare mein. Usama ne kaha: "Apni biwi ko rakhiye, kyunke humein unke baare mein achhi baaton ke siwa kuch nahi pata." Barira (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha: "Main unme koi bhi aib nahi paati siwaye is ke ke woh abhi ek jawan ladki hain jo soti hain, apne pariwara ke aate ko chhod kar jise bakriyaan aakar kha jaati hain (yaani woh itni saada thi ke apne shohar ko dhoka nahi de sakti thi)." Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: "Kaun mujhe us shaks se badla lene mein madad karega jisne mere pariwara ki izzat par ilzaam lagakar mujhe takleef pahunchaee hai? Allah ki qasam, maine apne pariwara ke baare mein achhi baaton ke siwa kuch nahi jaana, aur unhone jis shaks (Safwan) par ilzaam lagaya, uske baare mein bhi maine achha hi jaana hai."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Ubai bin Ka`b Al-Ansari went to the garden where Ibn Saiyad used to live. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered (the garden), he (i.e. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ) started hiding himself behind the date-palms as he wanted to hear secretly the talk of Ibn Saiyad before the latter saw him. Ibn Saiyad wrapped with a soft decorated sheet was lying on his bed murmuring. Ibn Saiyad's mother saw the Prophet hiding behind the stems of the date-palms. She addressed Ibn Saiyad saying, "O Saf, this is Muhammad." Hearing that Ibn Saiyad stopped murmuring (or got cautious), the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If she had left him undisturbed, he would have revealed his reality." (See Hadith No. 290, Vol 4 for details)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool aur Ubai bin Ka'b (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ansari us baag mein gaye jahan Ibn Saiyad rehta tha. Jab Allah ke Rasool andar daakhil hue, unhone khajoor ke darakhton ke peechhe chhupna shuru kiya taake Ibn Saiyad ke dekhne se pehle uski baatein chupkar sun sakein. Ibn Saiyad ek narm sajaawati chadar mein lipta apne bistar par leta bud-buda raha tha. Ibn Saiyad ki maa ne Nabi ko khajoor ke tano ke peechhe chhupte dekha. Usne Ibn Saiyad se kaha: "Aye Saf, yeh Muhammad hain." Yeh sunkar Ibn Saiyad ruk gaya (ya hoshiyaar ho gaya), Nabi ne kaha: "Agar usne use pareshan na kiya hota, woh apni asliyat zaahir kar deta."

e: Narrated Aisha:The wife of Rifa`a Al-Qurazi came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "I was Rifa`a's wife, but he divorced me and it was a final irrevocable divorce. Then I married `Abdur-Rahman bin Az-Zubair but he is impotent." The Prophet (ﷺ) asked her 'Do you want to remarry Rifa`a? You cannot unless you had a complete sexual relation with your present husband." Abu Bakr was sitting with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Khalid bin Sa`id bin Al-`As was at the door waiting to be admitted. He said, "O Abu Bakr! Do you hear what this (woman) is revealing frankly before the Prophet (ﷺ) ?
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Rifa'a Al-Qurazi ki biwi Nabi ke paas aayi aur kaha: "Main Rifa'a ki biwi thi, magar unhone mujhe talaq de di aur yeh aakhri, mansookh na hone wali talaq thi. Phir maine Abdur-Rahman bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) se shaadi ki magar woh napunsak hain." Nabi ne unse pucha: "Kya tum Rifa'a se dobara shaadi karna chahti ho? Tum aisa tab tak nahi kar sakti jab tak apne maujooda shohar ke saath mukammal jismani rishta na ho." Abu Bakr Allah ke Rasool ke saath baithe the aur Khalid bin Sa'id bin Al-As darwaze par andar aane ka intezaar kar rahe the. Unhone kaha: "Aye Abu Bakr! Kya aap sun rahe hain yeh (aurat) Nabi ke saamne khule aam kya keh rahi hai?"

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abu Mulaika from `Uqba bin Al-Harith:`Uqba married the daughter of Abu Ihab bin `Aziz, and then a woman came and said, "I suckled `Uqba and his wife." `Uqba said to her, "I do not know that you have suckled me, and you did not inform me." He then sent someone to the house of Abu Ihab to inquire about that but they did not know that she had suckled their daughter. Then `Uqba went to the Prophet (ﷺ) in Medina and asked him about it. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "How (can you keep your wife) after it has been said (that both of you were suckled by the same woman)?" So, he divorced her and she was married to another (husband)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abu Mulaika, Uqba bin Al-Harith ke hawale se: Uqba ne Abu Ihab bin Aziz ki beti se shaadi ki, phir ek aurat aayi aur kaha: "Maine Uqba aur unki biwi dono ko doodh pilaya tha." Uqba ne usse kaha: "Mujhe nahi pata tumne mujhe doodh pilaya, aur tumne mujhe pehle nahi bataya." Unhone Abu Ihab ke ghar kisi ko poochne bheja magar unhe nahi pata tha ke usne unki beti ko doodh pilaya. Phir Uqba Madina mein Nabi ke paas gaye aur unse iske baare mein pucha. Nabi ne unse kaha: "(Tum apni biwi ko kaise rakh sakte ho) jabke yeh keh diya gaya hai (ke tum dono ko usi aurat ne doodh pilaya)?" Isliye unhone use talaq de di aur usne kisi doosre se shaadi kar li.

e: Narrated `Umar bin Al-Khattab:People were (sometimes) judged by the revealing of a Divine Inspiration during the lifetime of Allah's Apostle but now there is no longer any more (new revelation). Now we judge you by the deeds you practice publicly, so we will trust and favor the one who does good deeds in front of us, and we will not call him to account about what he is really doing in secret, for Allah will judge him for that; but we will not trust or believe the one who presents to us with an evil deed even if he claims that his intentions were good
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Khattab (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ke zamane mein logon ka faisla (kabhi-kabhi) wahi ke zariye hota tha, magar ab (Nabi ke baad) koi nayi wahi nahi hai. Ab hum tumhara faisla tumhare khule aam kiye gaye amal se karenge; isliye jo koi humare saamne neik amal kare, hum uspar bharosa karenge aur use tarjih denge, aur hum usse yeh hisaab nahi lenge ke woh chupke se kya kar raha hai, kyunke Allah uska hisaab lega; magar hum us shaks par bharosa ya yaqeen nahi karenge jo humare saamne bura amal pesh kare, chahe woh dawa kare ke uski niyyat achhi thi.

e: Narrated Anas:A funeral procession passed in front of the Prophet (ﷺ) and the people praised the deceased. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It has been affirmed (Paradise)." Then another funeral procession passed by and the people talked badly of the deceased. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It has been affirmed (Hell)." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! You said it has been affirmed for both?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The testimony of the people (is accepted), (for) the believers are Allah's witnesses on the earth
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek janaza Nabi ke saamne se guzra aur logon ne marhoom ki taareef ki. Nabi ne kaha: "Yeh tasdeeq ho gaya (Jannat)." Phir ek doosra janaza guzra aur logon ne marhoom ke baare mein bura kaha. Nabi ne kaha: "Yeh tasdeeq ho gaya (Dozakh)." Allah ke Rasool se pucha gaya: "Aye Allah ke Rasool! Aapne kaha yeh dono ke liye tasdeeq ho gaya?" Nabi ne kaha: "Logon ki gawahi (qubool hai); momin zameen par Allah ke gawaah hain."

e: Narrated Abu Al-Aswad:Once I went to Medina where there was an outbreak of disease and the people were dying rapidly. I was sitting with `Umar and a funeral procession passed by. The people praised the deceased. `Umar said, "It has been affirmed" (Paradise). Then another funeral procession passed by. The people praised the deceased. `Umar said, "It has been affirmed." (Paradise). Then another funeral procession passed by. The people praised the deceased. `Umar said, "It has been affirmed (Paradise)." Then a third funeral procession passed by and the people talked badly of the deceased. `Umar said, "It has been affirmed (Hell)." I asked `Umar, "O chief of the believers! What has been affirmed?" He said, "I have said what the Prophet (ﷺ) said. He said, 'Allah will admit into paradise any Muslim whose good character is attested by four persons.' We asked the Prophet, 'If there were three witnesses only?' He said, 'Even three.' We asked, 'If there were two only?' He said, 'Even two.' But we did not ask him about one witness
hi: Abu Al-Aswad bataate hain: Ek baar main Madina gaya jahan ek bimari phaili hui thi aur log tezi se mar rahe the. Main Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath baitha tha aur ek janaza guzra. Logon ne marhoom ki taareef ki. Umar ne kaha: "Yeh tasdeeq ho gaya" (Jannat). Phir ek doosra janaza guzra. Logon ne marhoom ki taareef ki. Umar ne kaha: "Yeh tasdeeq ho gaya." (Jannat). Phir ek aur janaza guzra. Logon ne marhoom ki taareef ki. Umar ne kaha: "Yeh tasdeeq ho gaya" (Jannat). Phir ek teesra janaza guzra aur logon ne marhoom ke baare mein bura kaha. Umar ne kaha: "Yeh tasdeeq ho gaya" (Dozakh). Maine Umar se pucha: "Aye Momino ke Ameer! Kya cheez tasdeeq ho gayi?" Unhone kaha: "Maine wahi kaha jo Nabi ne kaha. Unhone kaha: 'Allah kisi bhi Musalman ko Jannat mein daakhil karega jiski achhi seerat ki tasdeeq chaar log karein.' Humne Nabi se pucha: 'Agar sirf teen gawaah hon?' Unhone kaha: 'Teen bhi kaafi hain.' Humne pucha: 'Agar sirf do hon?' Unhone kaha: 'Do bhi kaafi hain.' Magar humne unse ek gawaah ke baare mein nahi pucha."

e: Narrated Aisha:Aflah asked the permission to visit me but I did not allow him. He said, "Do you veil yourself before me although I am your uncle?" `Aisha said, "How is that?" Aflah replied, "You were suckled by my brother's wife with my brother's milk." I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about it, and he said, "Aflah is right, so permit him to visit you
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Aflah ne mujhse milne ki ijazat maangi magar maine unhe ijazat nahi di. Unhone kaha: "Kya tum mujhse parda karti ho jabke main tumhara chacha hoon?" Ayesha ne pucha: "Woh kaise?" Aflah ne jawab diya: "Tumhe mere bhai ki biwi ne mere bhai ke doodh se doodh pilaya tha." Maine Allah ke Rasool se iske baare mein pucha aur unhone kaha: "Aflah sahi keh rahe hain, isliye unhe apne paas aane ki ijazat do."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said about Hamza's daughter, "I am not legally permitted to marry her, as foster relations are treated like blood relations (in marital affairs). She is the daughter of my foster brother
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہما) bataate hain: Nabi ne Hamza ki beti ke baare mein kaha: "Mujhe unse shaadi karne ki qanooni ijazat nahi, kyunke doodh-rishte khoon ke rishton jaise hi mane jaate hain (shaadi ke maamlon mein). Woh mere doodh-bhai ki beti hain."

e: Narrated `Amra bint `Abdur-Rahman:That `Aisha the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ) told her uncle that once, while the Prophet (ﷺ) was in her house, she heard a man asking Hafsa's permission to enter her house. `Aisha said, "I said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I think the man is Hafsa's foster uncle.' " `Aisha added, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! There is a man asking the permission to enter your house." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, "I think the man is Hafsa's foster uncle." `Aisha said, "If so-and-so were living (i.e. her foster uncle) would he be allowed to visit me?" Allah's Apostle said, "Yes, he would, as the foster relations are treated like blood relations (in marital affairs)
hi: Amra bint Abdur-Rahman bataati hain: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا), Nabi ki biwi, ne apne chacha ko bataya ke ek baar, jabke Nabi unke ghar mein the, unhone ek shaks ko Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke ghar mein aane ki ijazat maangte suna. Ayesha ne kaha: "Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe lagta hai woh shaks Hafsa ka doodh-chacha hai.'" Ayesha ne joda: "Aye Allah ke Rasool! Ek shaks aapke ghar mein aane ki ijazat maang raha hai." Allah ke Rasool ne jawab diya: "Mujhe lagta hai woh Hafsa ka doodh-chacha hai." Ayesha ne kaha: "Agar falaan-falaan (unka doodh-chacha) zinda hote, kya unhe mere paas aane ki ijazat hoti?" Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: "Haan, hoti, kyunke doodh-rishte khoon ke rishton jaise hi maane jaate hain (shaadi ke maamlon mein)."

e: Narrated Aisha:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) came to me while a man was in my house. He said, "O `Aisha! Who is this (man)?" I replied, "My foster brothers" He said, "O `Aisha! Be sure about your foster brothers, as fostership is only valid if it takes place in the suckling period (before two years of age)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ek baar Nabi mere paas aaye jabke mere ghar mein ek shaks tha. Unhone pucha: "Aye Ayesha! Yeh (shaks) kaun hai?" Maine kaha: "Mera doodh-bhai." Unhone kaha: "Aye Ayesha! Apne doodh-bhaiyon ke baare mein sunishchit raho, kyunke doodh ka rishta sirf tab valid hota hai jab yeh doodh pilane ki umr mein hua ho (do saal se pehle)."

e: Narrated `Urwa bin Az-Zubair:A woman committed theft in the Ghazwa of the Conquest (of Mecca) and she was taken to the Prophet who ordered her hand to be cut off. `Aisha said, "Her repentance was perfect and she was married (later) and used to come to me (after that) and I would present her needs to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
hi: Urwa bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Fatah-e-Mecca ki jung mein ek aurat ne chori ki aur usse Nabi ke paas laaya gaya jinhone uska haath kaatne ka hukum diya. Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha: "Uski tauba mukammal thi aur usne (baad mein) shaadi kar li aur mere paas aati thi aur main uski zaroortein Allah ke Rasool tak pahunchati thi."

e: Narrated Zaid bin Khalid:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered that an unmarried man who committed illegal sexual intercourse be scourged one hundred lashes and sent into exile for one year
hi: Zaid bin Khalid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne hukum diya ke ek shaadishuda na hone wale mard ne agar ghair-qanooni jismani rishta banaya, use sau kode maare jaayein aur ek saal ke liye jila-watan (nikaal) diya jaaye.

e: Narrated An-Nu`man bin Bashir:My mother asked my father to present me a gift from his property; and he gave it to me after some hesitation. My mother said that she would not be satisfied unless the Prophet (ﷺ) was made a witness to it. I being a young boy, my father held me by the hand and took me to the Prophet (ﷺ) . He said to the Prophet, "His mother, bint Rawaha, requested me to give this boy a gift." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do you have other sons besides him?" He said, "Yes." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not make me a witness for injustice." Narrated Ash-Shu`bi that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I will not become a witness for injustice
hi: An-Nu'man bin Bashir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Meri maa ne mere waalid se apni maal se mujhe ek tohfa dene ki guzarish ki; aur unhone kuch hichkichaahat ke baad mujhe woh diya. Meri maa ne kaha ke woh santusht nahi hongi jab tak Nabi ko iska gawaah na banaya jaaye. Main ek jawan ladka tha, mere waalid mera haath pakadkar mujhe Nabi ke paas le gaye. Unhone Nabi se kaha: "Iski maa, bint Rawaha, ne mujhse guzarish ki ke main is ladke ko yeh tohfa dun." Nabi ne pucha: "Kya iske ilawa tumhare aur bete hain?" Unhone kaha: "Haan." Nabi ne kaha: "Mujhe na-insaafi ka gawaah mat banao." Ash-Sha'bi ke hawale se ke Nabi ne kaha: "Main na-insaafi ka gawaah nahi banunga."

e: Narrated Zahdam bin Mudarrib:I heard `Imran bin Husain saying, "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'The best people are those living in my generation, then those coming after them, and then those coming after (the second generation)." `Imran said "I do not know whether the Prophet (ﷺ) mentioned two or three generations after your present generation. The Prophet (ﷺ) added, 'There will be some people after you, who will be dishonest and will not be trustworthy and will give witness (evidences) without being asked to give witness, and will vow but will not fulfill their vows, and obesity will appear among them
hi: Zahdam bin Mudarrib bataate hain: Maine Imran bin Husain (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko kehte suna: "Nabi ne kaha: 'Sabse behtareen log mere zamane ke hain, phir woh jo unke baad aayenge, phir woh jo unke baad aayenge (teesri nasl).'" Imran ne kaha: "Mujhe nahi pata Nabi ne apni zaboon ke baad do ya teen naslon ka zikar kiya. Nabi ne joda: 'Tumhare baad kuch log aayenge jo be-imaan honge aur bharosemand nahi honge, aur bina poochhe gawahi denge, aur mannat maanenge magar apni mannaten poori nahi karenge, aur unme motaapa aam ho jaayega.'"

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The people of my generation are the best, then those who follow them, and then those who follow the latter. After that there will come some people whose witness will go ahead of their oaths, and their oaths will go ahead of their witness." Ibrahim (a sub-narrator) said, "We used to be beaten for taking oaths by saying, 'I bear witness by the Name of Allah or by the Covenant of Allah
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Mere zamane ke log sabse behtareen hain, phir woh jo unki pairvi karte hain, phir woh jo unke baad unki pairvi karte hain. Uske baad kuch aise log aayenge jinki gawahi unki qasmon se aage aayegi, aur unki qasmen unki gawahi se aage aayengi." Ibrahim (doosre raawi) ne kaha: "Humein qasam khane par maara jata agar hum kehte, 'Main Allah ke naam ki, ya Allah ke ahad ki qasam khata hoon.'"

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) was asked about the great sins He said, "They are:-- (1 ) To join others in worship with Allah, (2) To be undutiful to one's parents. (3) To kill a person (which Allah has forbidden to kill) (i.e. to commit the crime of murdering). (4) And to give a false witness
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi se bade gunahon ke baare mein pucha gaya. Unhone kaha: "Yeh hain: (1) Allah ke saath doosron ko shareek karna, (2) apne maa-baap ki na-farmani karna, (3) kisi ko qatl karna (jise Allah ne qatl karne se mana kiya hai), aur (4) jhuti gawahi dena."

e: Narrated Abu Bakra:The Prophet (ﷺ) said thrice, "Should I inform you about the greatest of the great sins?" They said, "Yes, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" He said, "To join others in worship with Allah and to be undutiful to one's parents." The Prophet (ﷺ) then sat up after he had been reclining (on a pillow) and said, "And I warn you against giving a false witness, and he kept on saying that warning till we thought he would not stop. (See Hadith No. 7, Vol)
hi: Abu Bakra (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne teen baar kaha: "Kya main tumhe sabse bade gunahon ke baare mein bataun?" Unhone kaha: "Haan, Aye Allah ke Rasool!" Aap ne kaha: "Allah ke saath doosron ko shareek karna aur apne maa-baap ki na-farmani karna." Nabi phir tekan lagaye hue se seedhe baithe aur kaha: "Aur main tumhe jhuti gawahi dene se aagah karta hoon," aur woh yeh baar-baar kahte rahe jab tak humein laga woh rukenge nahi.
