I suggested that his creditors take the fruits (i.e. dates) of my garden in lieu of the debt of my father, but they refused the offer, as they thought that it would not cover the full debt. So, I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and told him about it. He said (to me), "When you pluck the dates and collect them in the Mirbad (i.e. a place where dates are dried), call me (Allah's Messenger (ﷺ))." Finally he came accompanied by Abu Bakr and `Umar and sat on the dates and invoked Allah to bless them. Then he said, "Call your creditors and give them their full rights." So, I paid all my father's creditors in full and yet thirteen extra Wasqs of dates remained, seven of which were 'Ajwa and six were Laun or six of which were Ajwa and seven were Laun. I met Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) at sunset and informed him about it. On that he smiled and said, "Go to Abu Bakr and `Umar and tell them about it." They said, "We perceived that was going to happen, as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did what he did
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Mere waalid ka intiqal hua aur unpar qarz tha. Maine sujhaav diya ke unke qarz-daar mere baag ke phal (khajoor) qarz ke badle le len, magar unhone yeh pesh kash radd kar di, yeh sochkar ke isse poora qarz na chukega. Isliye main Nabi ke paas gaya aur unhe iske baare mein bataya. Unhone (mujhse) kaha: "Jab tum khajoor katke jama kar lo Mirbad (jahan khajoor sukhaee jaati hai) mein, mujhe bulao." Aakhirkaar woh Abu Bakr aur Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath aaye aur khajooron par baithe aur unme barkat ke liye dua ki. Phir unhone kaha: "Apne qarz-daaron ko bulao aur unka poora haqq de do." Isliye maine apne waalid ke sab qarz-daaron ko poora chukaya aur phir bhi terah extra Wasq khajoor bach gayi, saat Ajwa aur chhe Laun, ya chhe Ajwa aur saat Laun. Main suraj doobte waqt Allah ke Rasool se mila aur unhe iske baare mein bataya. Isspar woh muskuraye aur kaha: "Abu Bakr aur Umar ke paas jaao aur unhe iske baare mein batao." Unhone kaha: "Humein pata tha aisa hoga, kyunke Allah ke Rasool ne jo kiya woh kiya."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Ka`b:That Ka`b bin Malik told him that in the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) he demanded his debt from Ibn Abu Hadrad in the Mosque. Their voices grew louder till Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) heard them while he was in his house. So he lifted the curtain of his room and called Ka`b bin Malik saying, "O Ka`b!" He replied, "Labbaik! O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" He beckoned to him with his hand suggesting that he deduct half the debt. Ka`b said, "I agree, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then said (to Ibn Abu Hadrad), "Get up and pay him the rest
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ka'b bataate hain: Ka'b bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne unhe bataya ke Allah ke Rasool ke zamane mein unhone Ibn Abu Hadrad se masjid mein apna qarz maanga. Unki awazein itni oonchi ho gayi ke Allah ke Rasool ne unhe apne ghar se suna. Isliye unhone apne kamre ka parda uthaya aur Ka'b bin Malik ko bulaya, "Aye Ka'b!" Unhone jawab diya: "Labbaik! Aye Allah ke Rasool!" Unhone apne haath se ishara kiya jaise keh rahe hon ke aadha qarz kam kar do. Ka'b ne kaha: "Main raazi hoon, Aye Allah ke Rasool!" Allah ke Rasool ne phir (Ibn Abu Hadrad se) kaha: "Utho aur unhe baaki ada karo."

e: Narrated Marwan and al-Miswar bin Makhrama:(from the companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)) When Suhail bin `Amr agreed to the Treaty (of Hudaibiya), one of the things he stipulated then, was that the Prophet (ﷺ) should return to them (i.e. the pagans) anyone coming to him from their side, even if he was a Muslim; and would not interfere between them and that person. The Muslims did not like this condition and got disgusted with it. Suhail did not agree except with that condition. So, the Prophet (ﷺ) agreed to that condition and returned Abu Jandal to his father Suhail bin `Amr. Thenceforward the Prophet (ﷺ) returned everyone in that period (of truce) even if he was a Muslim. During that period some believing women emigrants including Um Kulthum bint `Uqba bin Abu Muait who came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and she was a young lady then. Her relative came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and asked him to return her, but the Prophet (ﷺ) did not return her to them for Allah had revealed the following Verse regarding women: "O you who believe! When the believing women come to you as emigrants. Examine them, Allah knows best as to their belief, then if you know them for true believers, Send them not back to the unbelievers, (for) they are not lawful (wives) for the disbelievers, Nor are the unbelievers lawful (husbands) for them
hi: Marwan aur Al-Miswar bin Makhrama (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Suhail bin Amr Hudaibiya ke Muahide par raazi hue, unhone ek shart rakhi ke Nabi kisi bhi shaks ko wapas karenge jo unki (mushrikon ki) taraf se Nabi ke paas aaye, chahe woh Musalman hi kyun na ho, aur Nabi unke aur us shaks ke beech dakhal nahi denge. Musalmanon ko yeh shart bahut napasand aayi, magar Suhail sirf isi shart par raazi the. Isliye Nabi ne yeh shart maan li aur Abu Jandal ko unke waalid Suhail bin Amr ko wapas kar diya. Us muddat mein Nabi har shaks ko wapas karte rahe, chahe woh Musalman hi ho. Us dauran kuch imandaar aurton ne hijrat ki, jinme Um Kulthum bint Uqba bin Abu Mu'ait bhi thi jo us waqt jawan thi. Uske rishtedaar Nabi ke paas aaye aur unse use wapas karne ki maang ki, magar Nabi ne use wapas nahi kiya kyunke Allah ne aurton ke baare mein yeh ayat nazil ki thi: "Aye imandaar logo! Jab imandaar aurtein hijrat karke tumhare paas aayen, unki jaanch karo. Allah unke iman ko behtar jaanta hai. Agar tumhe unka sacha iman pata chale, unhe kaafiron ki taraf wapas mat bhejo, kyunke na woh (aurtein) kaafiron ke liye jaiz hain, na kaafir unke liye jaiz hain."

e: Narrated `Urwa: Aisha told me, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to examine them according to this Verse: "O you who believe! When the believing women come to you, as emigrants test them . . . for Allah is Oft- Forgiving, Most Merciful." (60.10-12) Aisha said, "When any of them agreed to that condition Allah's Apostle would say to her, 'I have accepted your pledge of allegiance.' He would only say that, but, by Allah he never touched the hand of any women (i.e. never shook hands with them) while taking the pledge of allegiance and he never took their pledge of allegiance except by his words (only)
hi: Urwa bataate hain: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne mujhe bataya, "Allah ke Rasool is ayat ke mutabiq unki jaanch karte the: 'Aye imandaar logo! Jab imandaar aurtein hijrat karke tumhare paas aayen, unhe aazmaao...' (60:10-12)." Ayesha ne kaha: "Jab unme se koi is shart par raazi hoti, Allah ke Rasool usse kehte, 'Maine tumhari bai'at qubool ki.' Woh sirf yehi kahte the, magar Allah ki qasam, unhone kabhi kisi aurat ka haath nahi chuya (yaani haath milane ki tarah bai'at karte waqt) — Aap sirf apne alfaaz se bai'at lete the."

e: Narrated Jarir:When I gave the pledge of allegiance to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he stipulated that I should give good advice to every Muslim
hi: Jarir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab maine Allah ke Rasool se bai'at ki, unhone shart rakhi ke main har Musalman ko achhi naseehat dunga.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:I gave the pledge of allegiance to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for offering the prayers perfectly paying the Zakat and giving good advice to every Muslim
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool se bai'at ki ke main namaz mukammal padhunga, Zakat dunga, aur har Musalman ko achhi naseehat dunga.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If someone sells pollinated date-palms, their fruits will be for the seller, unless the buyer stipulates the contrary
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Agar koi pollinated khajoor ke darakht bechta hai, unke phal bechne wale ke honge, siwaye jab khareedar iske ulta shart rakhe."

e: Narrated `Urwa:Aisha told me that Barirah came to seek her help in writing for emancipation and at that time she had not paid any part of her price. `Aisha said to her, "Go to your masters and if they agree that I will pay your price (and free you) on condition that your Wala' will be for me, I will pay the money." Barirah told her masters about that, but they refused, and said, "If `Aisha wants to do a favor she could, but your Wala will be for us." Aisha informed Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) of that and he said to her, "Buy and manumit Barirah as the Wala' will go to the manumitted
hi: Urwa bataate hain: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne unhe bataya ke Barira (رضی اللہ عنہا) unse apni azaadi ke muahide mein madad maangne aayi, aur us waqt unhone uski qeemat ka koi hissa ada nahi kiya tha. Ayesha ne usse kaha: "Apne maalikon ke paas jaao, aur agar woh raazi hon ke main tumhari qeemat ada karke (tumhe azaad karke) tumhara Wala mera ho, main paisa dungi." Barira ne yeh apne maalikon ko bataya magar unhone inkaar kar diya aur kaha: "Agar Ayesha koi ehsaan karna chahti hain, kar sakti hain, magar Wala humara hi rahega." Ayesha ne yeh Allah ke Rasool ko bataya. Unhone kaha: "Barira ko khareedo aur azaad karo, kyunke Wala azaad karne wale ka hota hai."

e: Narrated Jabir:While I was riding a (slow) and tired camel, the Prophet (ﷺ) passed by and beat it and prayed for Allah's Blessings for it. The camel became so fast as it had never been before. The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "Sell it to me for one Uqiyya (of gold)." I said, "No." He again said, "Sell it to me for one Uqiyya (of gold)." I sold it and stipulated that I should ride it to my house. When we reached (Medina) I took that camel to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he gave me its price. I returned home but he sent for me (and when I went to him) he said, "I will not take your camel. Take your camel as a gift for you." (Various narrations are mentioned here with slight variations in expressions relating the condition that Jabir had the right to ride the sold camel up to Medina)
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jabke main ek dheeme aur thake hue unt par sawar tha, Nabi guzre aur usme maara aur uske liye Allah se barkat ki dua ki. Unt itna tez ho gaya jitna woh pehle kabhi nahi tha. Nabi ne phir kaha: "Ise mujhe ek Uqiya (sona) mein becho." Maine kaha: "Nahi." Aap ne phir kaha: "Ise mujhe ek Uqiya mein becho." Maine ise becha aur shart rakhi ke main ise apne ghar tak sawar rahunga. Jab hum (Madina) pahunche, main unt Nabi ke paas laaya aur unhone mujhe uski qeemat di. Main ghar wapas gaya magar Aap ne mujhe bulwaya (aur jab main gaya) unhone kaha: "Main tumhara unt nahi lunga. Apna unt tohfe ke tor par le lo." (Iske baare mein alag-alag riwaayaton mein thodi bahut fark hai, khaaskar Jabir ke beche hue unt ko Madina tak sawar rahne ke haqq ke baare mein.)

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Ansar said to the Prophet, "Divide our date-palms between us and our emigrant brothers." The Prophet said, "No." The Ansar said to the emigrants, "You may do the labor (in our gardens) and we will share the fruits with you." The emigrants said, "We hear and obey
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ansaar ne Nabi se kaha: "Humare khajoor ke darakht humare aur humare Muhajir bhaion ke beech taqseem kar dijiye." Nabi ne kaha: "Nahi." Ansaar ne Muhajireen se kaha: "Tum (baagon mein) mehnat karo aur hum tumhare saath phal baantenge." Muhajireen ne kaha: "Hum sunte hain aur maante hain."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave the land of Khaibar to the Jews on the condition that they would work on it and cultivate it and they would get half of its yield
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Khaibar ki zameen Yahudiyon ko is shart par di ke woh isme kaam aur kheti karenge, aur unhe iski paidawaar ka aadha hissa milega.

e: Narrated `Uqba bin Amir:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "From among all the conditions which you have to fulfill, the conditions which make it legal for you to have sexual relations (i.e. the marriage contract) have the greatest right to be fulfilled
hi: Uqba bin Amir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Un sab sharton mein jo tumhe poori karni chahiye, jo sharten shaadi ke muahide (aur usse jaiz hone wale humbistari) ko jaiz banati hain, unhe poora karne ka sabse zyada haqq hai."

e: Narrated Rafi` bin Khadij:We used to work on the fields more than the other Ansar, and we used to rent the land (for the yield of a specific portion of it). But sometimes that portion or the rest of the land did not give any yield, so we were forbidden (by the Prophet (ﷺ) ) to follow such a system, but we were allowed to rent the land for money
hi: Rafi bin Khadij (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum doosre Ansaar se zyada zameen mein kaam karte the, aur hum zameen ko iss tarah kiraye par lete the ke ek khaas hisse ki paidawaar humein milegi. Magar kabhi-kabhi woh hissa ya baaki zameen bekaar reh jaati, isliye humein aisa karne se mana kiya gaya, magar humein zameen ko paison ke badle kiraye par dene ki ijazat mili.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No town-dweller should sell for a bedouin. Do not practice Najsh (i.e. Do not offer a high price for a thing which you do not want to buy, in order to deceive the people). No Muslim should offer more for a thing already bought by his Muslim brother, nor should he demand the hand of a girl already engaged to another Muslim. A Muslim woman shall not try to bring about The divorce of her sister (i.e. another Muslim woman) in order to take her place herself
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Koi shehar ka rehne wala dehati ke liye maal na beche. Najsh mat karo (yaani jhuti tez boli mat lagao, jise khareedne ka iraada na ho, sirf doosron ko dhoka dene ke liye). Koi Musalman apne Musalman bhai ki khareedi hui cheez ke liye zyada qeemat na pesh kare, na kisi aisi ladki ka rishta maange jiski shaadi kisi doosre Musalman se pehle se tay ho chuki ho. Koi Musalman aurat doosri Musalman aurat ki talaq na chaahe taake khud uski jagah le sake."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira and Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani:A bedouin came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's apostle! I ask you by Allah to judge My case according to Allah's Laws." His opponent, who was more learned than he, said, "Yes, judge between us according to Allah's Laws, and allow me to speak." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Speak." He (i .e. the bedouin or the other man) said, "My son was working as a laborer for this (man) and he committed illegal sexual intercourse with his wife. The people told me that it was obligatory that my son should be stoned to death, so in lieu of that I ransomed my son by paying one hundred sheep and a slave girl. Then I asked the religious scholars about it, and they informed me that my son must be lashed one hundred lashes, and be exiled for one year, and the wife of this (man) must be stoned to death." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "By Him in Whose Hands my soul is, I will judge between you according to Allah's Laws. The slave-girl and the sheep are to be returned to you, your son is to receive a hundred lashes and be exiled for one year. You, Unais, go to the wife of this (man) and if she confesses her guilt, stone her to death." Unais went to that woman next morning and she confessed. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered that she be stoned to death
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Zaid bin Khalid (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Juhani (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek dehati Allah ke Rasool ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Main Allah ki qasam dekar guzarish karta hoon ke aap Allah ke qanoon ke mutabiq mere maamle ka faisla karen." Uske muqaable wala, jo usse zyada ilm wala tha, ne kaha: "Haan, humare beech Allah ke qanoon ke mutabiq faisla kijiye, aur mujhe baat karne dijiye." Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: "Bolo." Usne kaha: "Mera beta is (shaks) ka mazdoor tha aur usne iski biwi se zina kar liya. Logon ne mujhe bataya ke mere bete ko sangsaar kiya jaana chahiye, isliye maine iske badle sau bhedein aur ek launDi dekar apna fidya ada kiya. Phir maine ulema se pucha aur unhone bataya ke mere bete ko sau kode aur ek saal ke liye jila-vatan (exile) kiya jaaye, aur is (shaks) ki biwi ko sangsaar kiya jaaye." Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: "Us zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, main tumhare beech Allah ke qanoon ke mutabiq faisla karunga. LaunDi aur bhedein tumhe wapas ki jaayengi, tumhare bete ko sau kode aur ek saal ki jila-vatani milegi. Aye Unais! Iski biwi ke paas jaao aur agar woh (zina ka) iqrar kare, use sangsaar kar do." Unais agli subah us aurat ke paas gaye aur usne iqrar kiya. Allah ke Rasool ne hukum diya ke use sangsaar kiya jaaye.

e: Narrated Aiman Al-Makki:When I visited Aisha she said, "Barirah who had a written contract for her emancipation for a certain amount came to me and said, "O mother of the believers! Buy me and manumit me, as my masters will sell me." Aisha agreed to it. Barirah said, 'My masters will sell me on the condition that my Wala will go to them." Aisha said to her, 'Then I am not in need of you.' The Prophet (ﷺ) heard of that or was told about it and so he asked Aisha, 'What is the problem of Barirah?' He said, 'Buy her and manumit her, no matter what they stipulate.' Aisha added, 'I bought and manumitted her, though her masters had stipulated that her Wala would be for them.' The Prophet (ﷺ) said, The Wala is for the liberator, even if the other stipulated a hundred conditions
hi: Aiman Al-Makki bataate hain: Jab main Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se milne gaya, unhone kaha: "Barira (رضی اللہ عنہا), jinka apni azaadi ke liye ek khaas raqam ka muahida likha gaya tha, mere paas aayi aur kaha: 'Aye Momino ki maa! Mujhe khareedo aur azaad karo, kyunke mere maalik mujhe bech dete.' Ayesha iske liye raazi ho gayin." Barira ne kaha: "Mere maalik mujhe is shart par bechenge ke mera Wala unhi ke paas rahega." Ayesha ne unse kaha: "Phir mujhe tumhari zaroorat nahi." Nabi ne yeh suna ya unhe bataya gaya, isliye unhone Ayesha se pucha: "Barira ka kya masla hai?" Aap ne kaha: "Ise khareedo aur azaad karo, chahe woh jo bhi shart rakhen." Ayesha ne kaha: "Maine ise khareeda aur azaad kiya, chahe uske maalikon ne shart rakhi thi ke Wala unhi ke paas rahega." Nabi ne kaha: "Wala azaad karne wale ka hota hai, chahe doosra sau sharten hi kyun na lagaye."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade (1) the meeting of the caravan (of goods) on the way, (2) and that a residing person buys for a bedouin, (3) and that a woman stipulates the divorce of the wife of the would-be husband, (4) and that a man tries to cause the cancellation of a bargain concluded by another. He also forbade An-Najsh (see Hadith 824) and that one withholds the milk in the udder of the animal so that he may deceive people on selling it
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne mana kiya: (1) qafile se raaste mein milne se, (2) shehar ke rehne wale ko dehati ke liye khareedne se, (3) koi aurat kisi doosre shohar ki biwi ki talaq ki khwahish rakhe, (4) koi shaks doosre ki tay hui saudebaazi radd karvane ki koshish kare. Aap ne Najsh se bhi mana kiya, aur is baat se bhi ke koi doodh dene wale janwar ka doodh (bechne se pehle) rokkar rakhe taake khareedar ko dhoka de sake.

e: Narrated Ubai bin Ka`b:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Moses the Messenger of Allah," and then he narrated the whole story about him. Al-Khadir said to Moses, "Did not I tell you that you can have no patience with me." (18.72). Moses then violated the agreement for the first time because of forgetfulness, then Moses promised that if he asked Al-Khadir about anything, the latter would have the right to desert him. Moses abided by that condition and on the third occasion he intentionally asked Al-Khadir and caused that condition to be applied. The three occasions referred to above are referred to by the following Verses: "Call me not to account for forgetting And be not hard upon me." (18.73) "Then they met a boy and Khadir killed him." (18.74) "Then they proceeded and found a wall which was on the verge of falling and Khadir set it up straight
hi: Ubai bin Ka'b (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: "Musa, Allah ke Rasool," aur phir unki poori kahani sunaee. Al-Khadir ne Musa se kaha: "Kya maine tumse nahi kaha tha ke tum mere saath sabr nahi rakh paoge?" (18:72). Musa ne pehli baar bhoolkar apni shart tori, phir Musa ne waada kiya ke agar unhone Khadir se kuch pucha, to Khadir ko unhe chhodne ka haqq hoga. Musa ne pehli do baar is shart ka paalan kiya, magar teesri baar unhone jaanbujhkar Al-Khadir se sawaal kiya aur woh shart amal mein aa gayi. Yeh teen mouke in ayaat mein bataye gaye hain: "Mujhe iske liye jawabdeh mat karo ke main bhool gaya, aur mujh par sakhti mat karo" (18:73), "Phir woh ek ladke se mile aur Khadir ne use qatl kar diya" (18:74), "Phir woh aage badhe aur ek aisi deewar dekhi jo girne hi wali thi aur Khadir ne use seedha kar diya."

e: Narrated `Urwa:Aisha said, "Barirah came to me and said, 'My people (masters) have written the contract for my emancipation for nine Awaq ) of gold) to be paid in yearly installments, one Uqiyya per year; so help me." Aisha said (to her), "If your masters agree, I will pay them the whole sum provided the Wala will be for me." Barirah went to her masters and told them about it, but they refused the offer and she returned from them while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was sitting. She said, "I presented the offer to them, but they refused unless the Wala' would be for them." When the Prophet (ﷺ) heard that and `Aisha told him about It, he said to her, "Buy Barirah and let them stipulate that her Wala' will be for them, as the Wala' is for the manumitted." `Aisha did so. After that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got up amidst the people, Glorified and Praised Allah and said, "What is wrong with some people who stipulate things which are not in Allah's Laws? Any condition which is not in Allah's Laws is invalid even if there were a hundred such conditions. Allah's Rules are the most valid and Allah's Conditions are the most solid. The Wala is for the manumitted
hi: Urwa bataate hain: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha: "Barira (رضی اللہ عنہا) mere paas aayi aur kaha: 'Mere log (maalikon) ne meri azaadi ke muahide mein nau Uqiya (sona) likhi hai, jo saalana kiston mein ada karni hai, ek Uqiya har saal; isliye meri madad kijiye.' Ayesha ne (usse) kaha: 'Agar tumhare maalik raazi hon, main unhe poori raqam de dungi bashart ke Wala mera ho.' Barira apne maalikon ke paas gayi aur unhe yeh bataya, magar unhone yeh pesh kash radd kar di, aur woh wapas aayi jabke Allah ke Rasool baithe the. Usne kaha: 'Maine unhe pesh kash batai, magar unhone inkaar kiya jab tak Wala unke paas rahe.' Jab Nabi ne yeh suna aur Ayesha ne unhe bataya, Aap ne unse kaha: 'Barira ko khareedo aur unhe Wala apne paas rakhne do, kyunke Wala azaad karne wale ka hota hai.' Ayesha ne aisa hi kiya. Iske baad Allah ke Rasool logon ke beech khade hue, Allah ki hamd-sana ki aur kaha: 'Kuch logon ka kya masla hai jo aisi sharten lagate hain jo Allah ke qanoon mein nahi? Jo bhi shart Allah ke qanoon mein nahi, woh batil hai chahe sau sharten hon. Allah ke faisle sabse mazboot hain, aur Allah ki sharten sabse pukhta hain. Wala azaad karne wale ka hota hai.'"

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:When the people of Khaibar dislocated `Abdullah bin `Umar's hands and feet, `Umar got up delivering a sermon saying, "No doubt, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) made a contract with the Jews concerning their properties, and said to them, 'We allow you (to stand in your land) as long as Allah allows you.' Now `Abdullah bin `Umar went to his land and was attacked at night, and his hands and feet were dislocated, and as we have no enemies there except those Jews, they are our enemies and the only people whom we suspect, I have made up my mind to exile them." When `Umar decided to carry out his decision, a son of Abu Al-Huqaiq's came and addressed `Umar, "O chief of the believers, will you exile us although Muhammad allowed us to stay at our places, and made a contract with us about our properties, and accepted the condition of our residence in our land?" `Umar said, "Do you think that I have forgotten the statement of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), i.e.: What will your condition be when you are expelled from Khaibar and your camel will be carrying you night after night?" The Jew replied, "That was a joke from Abul-Qasim." `Umar said, "O the enemy of Allah! You are telling a lie." `Umar then drove them out and paid them the price of their properties in the form of fruits, money, camel saddles and ropes, etc
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Khaibar walon ne Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke haath-paon tode, Umar khade hue aur khutba dete huye kaha: "Beshak, Allah ke Rasool ne Yahudiyon ke saath unka maal ke baare mein ek muahida kiya tha, aur unse kaha: 'Hum tumhe (apni zameen mein) tab tak rehne denge jab tak Allah tumhe rehne de.' Ab Abdullah bin Umar apni zameen gaye aur raat ko hamla hua, aur unke haath-paon tode gaye, aur wahan Yahudiyon ke siwa humara koi dushman nahi, isliye woh humare dushman hain aur humein unpar hi shak hai. Maine faisla kar liya hai ke main unhe jila-vatan kar dunga." Jab Umar ne apna faisla amal mein laana chaha, Abu Al-Huqaiq ka ek beta aaya aur Umar se kaha: "Aye Momino ke Ameer! Kya aap humein jila-vatan karenge jabke Muhammad ne humein apni jagahon par rehne diya aur humari maal ke baare mein muahida kiya, aur humare zameen mein rehne ki shart qubool ki?" Umar ne kaha: "Kya tumhe lagta hai maine Allah ke Rasool ki baat bhula di hai: 'Tumhara haal kya hoga jab tumhe Khaibar se nikala jaayega aur tumhare unt tumhe raat-ba-raat le jaayenge?'" Yahudi ne jawab diya: "Yeh to Abul-Qasim (Nabi) ka mazak tha." Umar ne kaha: "Aye Allah ke dushman! Tum jhoot bol rahe ho." Phir Umar ne unhe nikal diya aur unka maal ki qeemat unhe phal, paisa, unt ke saddle aur rassiyon ke tor par de di.

e: Narrated Al-Miswar bin Makhrama and Marwan:(whose narrations attest each other) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) set out at the time of Al-Hudaibiya (treaty), and when they proceeded for a distance, he said, "Khalid bin Al-Walid leading the cavalry of Quraish constituting the front of the army, is at a place called Al-Ghamim, so take the way on the right." By Allah, Khalid did not perceive the arrival of the Muslims till the dust arising from the march of the Muslim army reached him, and then he turned back hurriedly to inform Quraish. The Prophet (ﷺ) went on advancing till he reached the Thaniya (i.e. a mountainous way) through which one would go to them (i.e. people of Quraish). The she-camel of the Prophet (ﷺ) sat down. The people tried their best to cause the she-camel to get up but in vain, so they said, "Al-Qaswa' (i.e. the she-camel's name) has become stubborn! Al-Qaswa' has become stubborn!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Al-Qaswa' has not become stubborn, for stubbornness is not her habit, but she was stopped by Him Who stopped the elephant." Then he said, "By the Name of Him in Whose Hands my soul is, if they (i.e. the Quraish infidels) ask me anything which will respect the ordinances of Allah, I will grant it to them." The Prophet (ﷺ) then rebuked the she-camel and she got up. The Prophet (ﷺ) changed his way till he dismounted at the farthest end of Al-Hudaibiya at a pit (i.e. well) containing a little water which the people used in small amounts, and in a short while the people used up all its water and complained to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ); of thirst. The Prophet (ﷺ) took an arrow out of his arrow-case and ordered them to put the arrow in that pit. By Allah, the water started and continued sprouting out till all the people quenched their thirst and returned with satisfaction. While they were still in that state, Budail bin Warqa-al-Khuza`i came with some persons from his tribe Khuza`a and they were the advisers of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who would keep no secret from him and were from the people of Tihama. Budail said, "I left Ka`b bin Luai and 'Amir bin Luai residing at the profuse water of Al-Hudaibiya and they had milch camels (or their women and children) with them, and will wage war against you, and will prevent you from visiting the Ka`ba." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "We have not come to fight anyone, but to perform the `Umra. No doubt, the war has weakened Quraish and they have suffered great losses, so if they wish, I will conclude a truce with them, during which they should refrain from interfering between me and the people (i.e. the 'Arab infidels other than Quraish), and if I have victory over those infidels, Quraish will have the option to embrace Islam as the other people do, if they wish; they will at least get strong enough to fight. But if they do not accept the truce, by Allah in Whose Hands my life is, I will fight with them defending my Cause till I get killed, but (I am sure) Allah will definitely make His Cause victorious." Budail said, "I will inform them of what you have said." So, he set off till he reached Quraish and said, "We have come from that man (i.e. Muhammad) whom we heard saying something which we will disclose to you if you should like." Some of the fools among Quraish shouted that they were not in need of this information, but the wiser among them said, "Relate what you heard him saying." Budail said, "I heard him saying so-and-so," relating what the Prophet (ﷺ) had told him. `Urwa bin Mas`ud got up and said, "O people! Aren't you the sons? They said, "Yes." He added, "Am I not the father?" They said, "Yes." He said, "Do you mistrust me?" They said, "No." He said, "Don't you know that I invited the people of `Ukaz for your help, and when they refused I brought my relatives and children and those who obeyed me (to help you)?" They said, "Yes." He said, "Well, this man (i.e. the Prophet) has offered you a reasonable proposal, you'd better accept it and allow me to meet him." They said, "You may meet him." So, he went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and started talking to him. The Prophet (ﷺ) told him almost the same as he had told Budail. Then `Urwa said, "O Muhammad! Won't you feel any scruple in extirpating your relations? Have you ever heard of anyone amongst the Arabs extirpating his relatives before you? On the other hand, if the reverse should happen, (nobody will aid you, for) by Allah, I do not see (with you) dignified people, but people from various tribes who would run away leaving you alone." Hearing that, Abu Bakr abused him and said, "Do you say we would run and leave the Prophet (ﷺ) alone?" `Urwa said, "Who is that man?" They said, "He is Abu Bakr." `Urwa said to Abu Bakr, "By Him in Whose Hands my life is, were it not for the favor which you did to me and which I did not compensate, I would retort on you." `Urwa kept on talking to the Prophet (ﷺ) and seizing the Prophet's beard as he was talking while Al-Mughira bin Shu`ba was standing near the head of the Prophet, holding a sword and wearing a helmet. Whenever `Urwa stretched his hand towards the beard of the Prophet, Al-Mughira would hit his hand with the handle of the sword and say (to `Urwa), "Remove your hand from the beard of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." `Urwa raised his head and asked, "Who is that?" The people said, "He is Al-Mughira bin Shu`ba." `Urwa said, "O treacherous! Am I not doing my best to prevent evil consequences of your treachery?" Before embracing Islam Al-Mughira was in the company of some people. He killed them and took their property and came (to Medina) to embrace Islam. The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to him, "As regards your Islam, I accept it, but as for the property I do not take anything of it. (As it was taken through treason). `Urwa then started looking at the Companions of the Prophet. By Allah, whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) spat, the spittle would fall in the hand of one of them (i.e. the Prophet's companions) who would rub it on his face and skin; if he ordered them they would carry his orders immediately; if he performed ablution, they would struggle to take the remaining water; and when they spoke to him, they would lower their voices and would not look at his face constantly out of respect. `Urwa returned to his people and said, "O people! By Allah, I have been to the kings and to Caesar, Khosrau and An- Najashi, yet I have never seen any of them respected by his courtiers as much as Muhammad is respected by his companions. By Allah, if he spat, the spittle would fall in the hand of one of them (i.e. the Prophet's companions) who would rub it on his face and skin; if he ordered them, they would carry out his order immediately; if he performed ablution, they would struggle to take the remaining water; and when they spoke, they would lower their voices and would not look at his face constantly out of respect." `Urwa added, "No doubt, he has presented to you a good reasonable offer, so please accept it." A man from the tribe of Bani Kinana said, "Allow me to go to him," and they allowed him, and when he approached the Prophet and his companions, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "He is so-and-so who belongs to the tribe that respects the Budn (i.e. camels of the sacrifice). So, bring the Budn in front of him." So, the Budn were brought before him and the people received him while they were reciting Talbiya. When he saw that scene, he said, "Glorified be Allah! It is not fair to prevent these people from visiting the Ka`ba." When he returned to his people, he said, 'I saw the Budn garlanded (with colored knotted ropes) and marked (with stabs on their backs). I do not think it is advisable to prevent them from visiting the Ka`ba." Another person called Mikraz bin Hafs got up and sought their permission to go to Muhammad, and they allowed him, too. When he approached the Muslims, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Here is Mikraz and he is a vicious man." Mikraz started talking to the Prophet and as he was talking, Suhail bin `Amr came. When Suhail bin `Amr came, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Now the matter has become easy." Suhail said to the Prophet "Please conclude a peace treaty with us." So, the Prophet (ﷺ) called the clerk and said to him, "Write: By the Name of Allah, the most Beneficent, the most Merciful." Suhail said, "As for 'Beneficent,' by Allah, I do not know what it means. So write: By Your Name O Allah, as you used to write previously." The Muslims said, "By Allah, we will not write except: By the Name of Allah, the most Beneficent, the most Merciful." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Write: By Your Name O Allah." Then he dictated, "This is the peace treaty which Muhammad, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has concluded." Suhail said, "By Allah, if we knew that you are Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) we would not prevent you from visiting the Ka`ba, and would not fight with you. So, write: "Muhammad bin `Abdullah." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "By Allah! I am the Apostle of Allah even if you people do not believe me. Write: Muhammad bin `Abdullah." (Az-Zuhri said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) accepted all those things, as he had already said that he would accept everything they would demand if it respects the ordinance of Allah, (i.e. by letting him and his companions perform `Umra.)") The Prophet (ﷺ) said to Suhail, "On the condition that you allow us to visit the House (i.e. Ka`ba) so that we may perform Tawaf around it." Suhail said, "By Allah, we will not (allow you this year) so as not to give chance to the 'Arabs to say that we have yielded to you, but we will allow you next year." So, the Prophet (ﷺ) got that written. Then Suhail said, "We also stipulate that you should return to us whoever comes to you from us, even if he embraced your religion." The Muslims said, "Glorified be Allah! How will such a person be returned to the pagans after he has become a Muslim? While they were in this state Abu Jandal bin Suhail bin `Amr came from the valley of Mecca staggering with his fetters and fell down amongst the Muslims. Suhail said, "O Muhammad! This is the very first term with which we make peace with you, i.e. you shall return Abu Jandal to me." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The peace treaty has not been written yet." Suhail said, "I will never allow you to keep him." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Yes, do." He said, "I won't do.: Mikraz said, "We allow you (to keep him)." Abu Jandal said, "O Muslims! Will I be returned to the pagans though I have come as a Muslim? Don't you see how much I have suffered?" Abu Jandal had been tortured severely for the Cause of Allah. `Umar bin Al-Khattab said, "I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, 'Aren't you truly the Messenger of Allah?' The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Yes, indeed.' I said, 'Isn't our Cause just and the cause of the enemy unjust?' He said, 'Yes.' I said, 'Then why should we be humble in our religion?' He said, 'I am Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and I do not disobey Him, and He will make me victorious.' I said, 'Didn't you tell us that we would go to the Ka`ba and perform Tawaf around it?' He said, 'Yes, but did I tell you that we would visit the Ka`ba this year?' I said, 'No.' He said, 'So you will visit it and perform Tawaf around it.' " `Umar further said, "I went to Abu Bakr and said, 'O Abu Bakr! Isn't he truly Allah's Prophet?' He replied, 'Yes.' I said, 'Then why should we be humble in our religion?' He said, 'Indeed, he is Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he does not disobey his Lord, and He will make him victorious. Adhere to him as, by Allah, he is on the right.' I said, 'Was he not telling us that we would go to the Ka`ba and perform Tawaf around it?' He said, 'Yes, but did he tell you that you would go to the Ka`ba this year?' I said, 'No.' He said, "You will go to Ka`ba and perform Tawaf around it." (Az-Zuhri said, " `Umar said, 'I performed many good deeds as expiation for the improper questions I asked them.' ") When the writing of the peace treaty was concluded, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to his companions, "Get up and' slaughter your sacrifices and get your head shaved." By Allah none of them got up, and the Prophet repeated his order thrice. When none of them got up, he left them and went to Um Salama and told her of the people's attitudes towards him. Um Salama said, "O the Prophet of Allah (ﷺ)! Do you want your order to be carried out? Go out and don't say a word to anybody till you have slaughtered your sacrifice and call your barber to shave your head." So, the Prophet (ﷺ) went out and did not talk to anyone of them till he did that, i.e. slaughtered the sacrifice and called his barber who shaved his head. Seeing that, the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) got up, slaughtered their sacrifices, and started shaving the heads of one another, and there was so much rush that there was a danger of killing each other. Then some believing women came (to the Prophet (ﷺ) ); and Allah revealed the following Divine Verses:-- "O you who believe, when the believing women come to you as emigrants examine them . . ." (60.10) `Umar then divorced two wives of his who were infidels. Later on Muawiya bin Abu Sufyan married one of them, and Safwan bin Umaiya married the other. When the Prophet (ﷺ) returned to Medina, Abu Basir, a new Muslim convert from Quraish came to him. The Infidels sent in his pursuit two men who said (to the Prophet (ﷺ) ), "Abide by the promise you gave us." So, the Prophet (ﷺ) handed him over to them. They took him out (of the City) till they reached Dhul-Hulaifa where they dismounted to eat some dates they had with them. Abu Basir said to one of them, "By Allah, O so-and-so, I see you have a fine sword." The other drew it out (of the scabbard) and said, "By Allah, it is very fine and I have tried it many times." Abu Basir said, "Let me have a look at it." When the other gave it to him, he hit him with it till he died, and his companion ran away till he came to Medina and entered the Mosque running. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw him he said, "This man appears to have been frightened." When he reached the Prophet (ﷺ) he said, "My companion has been murdered and I would have been murdered too." Abu Basir came and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), by Allah, Allah has made you fulfill your obligations by your returning me to them (i.e. the Infidels), but Allah has saved me from them." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Woe to his mother! what excellent war kindler he would be, should he only have supporters." When Abu Basir heard that he understood that the Prophet (ﷺ) would return him to them again, so he set off till he reached the seashore. Abu Jandal bin Suhail got himself released from them (i.e. infidels) and joined Abu Basir. So, whenever a man from Quraish embraced Islam he would follow Abu Basir till they formed a strong group. By Allah, whenever they heard about a caravan of Quraish heading towards Sham, they stopped it and attacked and killed them (i.e. infidels) and took their properties. The people of Quraish sent a message to the Prophet (ﷺ) requesting him for the Sake of Allah and Kith and kin to send for (i.e. Abu Basir and his companions) promising that whoever (amongst them) came to the Prophet (ﷺ) would be secure. So the Prophet (ﷺ) sent for them (i.e. Abu Basir's companions) and Allah revealed the following Divine Verses: "And it is He Who Has withheld their hands from you and your hands From them in the midst of Mecca, After He made you the victorious over them. ... the unbelievers had pride and haughtiness, in their hearts ... the pride and haughtiness of the time of ignorance." (48.24-26) And their pride and haughtiness was that they did not confess (write in the treaty) that he (i.e. Muhammad) was the Prophet of Allah and refused to write: "In the Name of Allah, the most Beneficent, the Most Merciful," and they (the mushriks) prevented them (the Muslims) from visiting the House (the Ka`bah)
hi: Al-Miswar bin Makhrama (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Marwan bataate hain (jinki riwaayaten ek-doosre ki tasdeeq karti hain): Allah ke Rasool Hudaibiya ke waqt (Mecca ki taraf) nikle, aur jab kuch aage badhe, Aap ne kaha: "Khalid bin Al-Walid, Quraish ki ghudsawaar fauj ki agwaee karte huye, Al-Ghamim naam ki jagah par hai, isliye dahini taraf ka raasta lo." Allah ki qasam, Khalid ko Musalmanon ke aane ka pata tab tak nahi chala jab tak fauj ki dhool unhe nahi mili, aur woh jaldi se Quraish ko khabar dene wapas gaye. Nabi aage badhte rahe jab tak Thaniya (pahaadi raasta) tak pahunche jahan se Quraish ke paas jaaya jaata tha. Nabi ki untni baith gaee. Logon ne use uthane ki poori koshish ki magar be-faida, isliye unhone kaha: "Al-Qaswa (untni ka naam) ziddi ho gayi hai! Al-Qaswa ziddi ho gayi hai!" Nabi ne kaha: "Al-Qaswa ziddi nahi hui, kyunke yeh uski aadat nahi, balki usi ne use roka hai jisne haathi ko roka tha." Phir Aap ne kaha: "Us zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, agar Quraish mujhse koi aisi cheez maangenge jo Allah ke ahkaam ka ehteraam karti ho, main unhe woh de dunga." Nabi ne phir untni ko daata aur woh uth khadi hui. Nabi ne apna raasta badla jab tak woh Hudaibiya ke aakhri sire par ek gadde (kue) ke paas ruke jismein thoda paani tha. Thodi der mein logon ne sab paani khatam kar diya aur Allah ke Rasool se pyaas ki shikayat ki. Nabi ne apne teer-daan se ek teer nikala aur unhe usse us gadde mein daalne ka hukum diya. Allah ki qasam, paani behne laga jab tak sab logon ki pyaas bujh gayi. Isi dauran Budail bin Warqa Al-Khuza'i apne qabile Khuza'a ke kuch logon ke saath aaye, jo Allah ke Rasool ke mushavir the aur unse koi raaz nahi rakhte the, aur Tihama ke logon mein se the. Budail ne kaha: "Maine Ka'b bin Lu'ai aur Amir bin Lu'ai ko Hudaibiya ke bahaav wale paani ke paas dekha, unke paas doodh dene wale unt (ya unki aurten-bachche) the, aur woh tumse jung karenge aur tumhe Ka'ba jaane se rokenge." Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: "Hum kisi se jung karne nahi aaye, balki Umrah karne aaye hain. Jung ne Quraish ko kamzor kar diya hai aur unhe bahut nuqsaan hua hai, isliye agar woh chahen, main unse ek muddat ke liye sulah kar sakta hoon jismein woh mere aur (doosre Arab) logon ke beech dakhal na den, aur agar main unpar fatah paa loon, Quraish ke paas Islam qubool karne ka mauka hoga jaisa doosre logon ko mila, agar woh chahen; ya kam se kam woh jung ke liye kaafi mazboot ho jaayenge. Magar agar woh sulah qubool na karen, us zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, main apne maqsad ki hifazat mein jung karunga jab tak mujhe qatl na kar diya jaaye, magar (mujhe yaqeen hai) Allah zaroor apna maqsad poora karega." Budail ne kaha: "Main unhe yeh baat pahunchaunga." Woh Quraish ke paas gaye aur kaha: "Hum us shaks (Muhammad) se aaye hain jinhe humne kuch kehte suna hai jo hum tumhe bataenge agar tum chaho." Quraish ke kuch bevakoofon ne kaha ke unhe iski koi zaroorat nahi, magar aqalmandon ne kaha: "Jo tumne usse suna woh humein batao." Budail ne kaha: "Maine unhe aisa-aisa kehte suna," aur Nabi ki poori baat unhe bataee. Urwa bin Mas'ud khade hue aur kaha: "Aye log! Kya tum mere bete nahi ho?" Unhone haan kaha. Unhone joda: "Kya main tumhara baap nahi?" Unhone haan kaha. Unhone pucha: "Kya tumhe mujhpar shak hai?" Unhone na kaha. Unhone kaha: "Kya tumhe yaad nahi ke maine Ukaz walon ko tumhari madad ke liye bulaya, aur jab unhone inkaar kiya, main apne rishtedaar aur bachche laaya jinhone meri baat maani (tumhari madad ke liye)?" Unhone haan kaha. Unhone kaha: "Is shaks (Nabi) ne tumhe ek munasib pesh kash di hai, ise qubool karo aur mujhe unse milne do." Unhone kaha: "Tum ja sakte ho." Isliye woh Nabi ke paas gaye aur unse baat ki. Nabi ne unse bhi lagbhag wahi kaha jo Budail se kaha tha. Phir Urwa ne kaha: "Aye Muhammad! Kya aapko apne rishtedaron ko barbaad karte huye koi hichkichahat nahi? Kya aapne kabhi kisi Arab ko apne rishtedaron ko aapse pehle barbaad karte suna hai? Doosri taraf, agar iska ulta hota (yaani Quraish jeette), aap dekhte ke aapke saath koi izzatdaar log nahi, balki alag-alag qabilon ke log hain jo aapko akela chhod kar bhaag jaate." Yeh sunkar, Abu Bakr ne unhe daanta aur kaha: "Kya tum kehte ho hum Nabi ko akela chhod kar bhaagenge?" Urwa ne pucha: "Yeh kaun hai?" Unhone kaha: "Yeh Abu Bakr hain." Urwa ne Abu Bakr se kaha: "Us zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, agar tumne mujhpar ek ehsaan na kiya hota jiska maine badla nahi diya, main tumhe jawab deta." Urwa Nabi se baat karte rahe aur baar-baar Nabi ki daadhi pakadte, jabke Al-Mughira bin Shu'ba (رضی اللہ عنہ) Nabi ke sar ke paas khade the, apne haath mein talwar aur sar par khod (helmet) pehne hue. Jab bhi Urwa apna haath Nabi ki daadhi ki taraf badhate, Al-Mughira talwar ki musth se unke haath par maarte aur kehte: "Allah ke Rasool ki daadhi se apna haath hatao." Urwa ne apna sar uthaya aur pucha: "Yeh kaun hai?" Logon ne kaha: "Yeh Al-Mughira bin Shu'ba hain." Urwa ne kaha: "Aye dagabaaz! Kya main tumhari dagabaazi ke bure natijon se bachane ki koshish nahi kar raha?" (Islam qubool karne se pehle, Al-Mughira kuch logon ke saath the. Unhone unhe qatl kiya aur unka maal le liya aur (Madina) aaye Islam qubool karne. Nabi ne (unse) kaha: "Jahan tak aapke Islam ka ta'aluq hai, main use qubool karta hoon, magar jahan tak maal ka sawaal hai, main usme se kuch nahi lunga (kyunke yeh dagabaazi se hasil kiya gaya).") Urwa Nabi ke sahaba ko dekhte rahe. Allah ki qasam, jab bhi Allah ke Rasool thookte, thook unme se kisi ke haath mein girta jise woh apne chehre aur jism par ragadte; agar Aap koi hukum dete, woh foran uska paalan karte; agar Aap wudu karte, woh bacha hua paani lene ke liye jhagadte; aur jab woh (Nabi se) baat karte, apni aawaz neechi rakhte aur ehteram ki wajah se Nabi ke chehre ki taraf lagatar nahi dekhte. Urwa apne logon ke paas wapas gaye aur kaha: "Aye log! Allah ki qasam, main raajaon ke paas gaya hoon, Caesar, Khosrau, aur An-Najashi ke darbaar mein, magar maine kabhi kisi ko apne darbariyon dwaara itna sammaanit hote nahi dekha jitna Muhammad ko unke sahaba dwaara. Allah ki qasam, agar Aap thookte, thook unme se kisi ke haath mein girta jise woh apne chehre aur jism par ragadte; agar Aap hukum dete, woh foran paalan karte; agar Aap wudu karte, woh bacha hua paani lene ke liye jhagadte; aur jab woh baat karte, apni aawaz neechi rakhte aur ehteram ki wajah se lagatar unke chehre ki taraf nahi dekhte." Urwa ne joda: "Beshak, unhone tumhe ek achhi munasib pesh kash di hai, isliye ise qubool karo." Bani Kinana qabile ke ek shaks ne kaha: "Mujhe unke paas jaane do," aur unhe ijazat mili, aur jab woh Nabi aur unke sahaba ke qareeb pahunche, Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: "Yeh falaan-falaan hai, jo us qabile se hai jo Budn (qurbani ke unt) ka sammaan karta hai. Isliye Budn ko unke saamne laao." Budn unke saamne laaye gaye aur log Talbiya padhte huye unka istikbaal karte hue aaye. Yeh dekhkar, usne kaha: "Subhanallah! In logon ko Ka'ba jaane se rokna munasib nahi." Jab woh apne logon ke paas wapas gaye, unhone kaha: "Maine Budn ko maalaon se saja hua (rangeen resson se) aur nishaanzada dekha hai. Mujhe nahi lagta inhe Ka'ba jaane se rokna theek hoga." Mikraz bin Hafs naam ka ek doosra shaks khade hue aur unhe milne ki ijazat maangi, aur unhe bhi ijazat di gayi. Jab woh Musalmanon ke qareeb pahunche, Nabi ne kaha: "Yeh Mikraz hai aur woh ek bura shaks hai." Mikraz ne Nabi se baat ki, aur jabke woh baat kar rahe the, Suhail bin Amr aaye. Jab Suhail bin Amr aaye, Nabi ne kaha: "Ab maamla aasaan ho gaya hai." Suhail ne Nabi se kaha: "Kripya humare saath sulha ka muahida karein." Isliye Nabi ne likhne wale ko bulaya aur usse kaha: "Likho: Allah ke naam se jo bahut zyada meharbaan, nihaayat reham karne wala hai." Suhail ne kaha: "'Meharbaan' ka Allah ki qasam mujhe pata nahi kya matlab hai. Isliye likho: Tere naam se, Aye Allah, jaisa tum pehle likhte the." Musalmanon ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, hum sirf yehi likhenge: Allah ke naam se jo bahut zyada meharbaan, nihaayat reham karne wala hai." Nabi ne kaha: "Likho: Tere naam se, Aye Allah." Phir Aap ne bataya: "Yeh woh sulha muahida hai jo Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool, ne kiya hai." Suhail ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, agar humein pata hota ke aap Allah ke Rasool hain, hum aapko Ka'ba jaane se na rokte, aur aapse jung na karte. Isliye likho: Muhammad bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ)." Nabi ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam! Main Allah ka Rasool hoon chahe tum log mujhpar iman na laao. Likho: Muhammad bin Abdullah." (Az-Zuhri ne kaha: "Nabi ne yeh sab qubool kiya, kyunke unhone pehle hi kaha tha ke woh har cheez qubool karenge jo Allah ke ahkaam ka ehteram karti ho, yaani unhe aur unke sahaba ko Umrah karne diyaa jaaye.") Nabi ne Suhail se kaha: "Is shart par ke tum humein Ghar (Ka'ba) mein aane do taake hum uska Tawaf kar saken." Suhail ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, hum (is saal aisa nahi karne denge) taake Arab log yeh na kahen ke humne tumhare aage jhuk gaye, magar hum tumhe agle saal aane denge." Isliye Nabi ne yeh likhwa diya. Phir Suhail ne kaha: "Hum yeh bhi shart rakhte hain ke tum humein wapas karoge jo bhi humari taraf se tumhare paas aaye, chahe usne tumhara deen qubool kiya ho." Musalmanon ne kaha: "Subhanallah! Aisa shaks kaise mushrikon ko wapas kiya jaayega jabke woh Musalman ban chuka hai?" Isi haal mein, Abu Jandal bin Suhail bin Amr Mecca ki wadi se apni bediyon mein ladkhadate huye aaye aur Musalmanon ke beech gir pade. Suhail ne kaha: "Aye Muhammad! Yeh humari sulha ki sabse pehli shart hai, yaani aap Abu Jandal ko mujhe wapas karenge." Nabi ne kaha: "Sulha ka muahida abhi likha nahi gaya." Suhail ne kaha: "Main tumhe use rakhne nahi dunga." Nabi ne kaha: "Haan, karo." Usne kaha: "Main nahi karunga." Mikraz ne kaha: "Hum tumhe (use rakhne) dete hain." Abu Jandal ne kaha: "Aye Musalmano! Kya mujhe mushrikon ko wapas kar diya jaayega jabke main Musalman hokar aaya hoon? Kya tum nahi dekhte main kitna sataya gaya hoon?" Abu Jandal ko Allah ki raah mein sakht sataya gaya tha. Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab ne kaha: "Main Nabi ke paas gaya aur kaha: 'Kya aap sach mein Allah ke Rasool nahi hain?' Nabi ne kaha: 'Haan, zaroor.' Maine kaha: 'Kya humara maqsad haqq nahi aur dushman ka maqsad nahaq nahi?' Aap ne kaha: 'Haan.' Maine kaha: 'Phir humein apne deen mein kyun jhukna chahiye?' Aap ne kaha: 'Main Allah ka Rasool hoon aur main uski na-farmani nahi karta, aur woh mujhe fatah dega.' Maine kaha: 'Kya aapne humein nahi bataya tha ke hum Ka'ba jaakar uska Tawaf karenge?' Aap ne kaha: 'Haan, magar kya maine tumhe bataya tha ke hum isi saal Ka'ba jaayenge?' Maine kaha: 'Nahi.' Aap ne kaha: 'To tum zaroor wahan jaakar uska Tawaf karoge.'" Umar ne aage kaha: "Main Abu Bakr ke paas gaya aur kaha: 'Aye Abu Bakr! Kya woh sach mein Allah ke Nabi nahi hain?' Unhone kaha: 'Haan.' Maine kaha: 'Phir humein apne deen mein kyun jhukna chahiye?' Unhone kaha: 'Beshak, woh Allah ke Rasool hain aur woh apne Rab ki na-farmani nahi karte, aur woh unhe fatah denge. Unse jude raho, kyunke Allah ki qasam, woh haqq par hain.' Maine kaha: 'Kya unhone humein nahi bataya tha ke hum Ka'ba jaayenge aur uska Tawaf karenge?' Unhone kaha: 'Haan, magar kya unhone tumhe bataya tha ke tum isi saal Ka'ba jaoge?' Maine kaha: 'Nahi.' Unhone kaha: 'To tum Ka'ba jaakar uska Tawaf karoge.'" (Az-Zuhri ne kaha: "Umar ne kaha: 'Maine (baad mein) apne is galat sawaal ka kaffara dene ke liye bahut neik amal kiye.'") Jab sulha likhi ja chuki, Allah ke Rasool ne apne sahaba se kaha: "Utho aur apni qurbaniyaan zabah karo aur apne sar munDao." Allah ki qasam, koi nahi utha, aur Nabi ne teen baar apna hukum dohrata. Jab koi nahi utha, Aap unhe chhodkar Um Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas gaye aur unhe logon ke rawaiye ke baare mein bataya. Um Salama ne kaha: "Aye Allah ke Nabi! Kya aap chahte hain aapka hukum poora ho? Bahar jaiye aur kisi se ek lafz bhi mat boliye jab tak aap apni qurbaani zabah na kar den aur apne barbar ko bulwaakar sar munDwa na len." Isliye Nabi bahar gaye aur kisi se baat nahi ki jab tak Aap ne aisa nahi kiya, yaani qurbaani zabah ki aur apna barbar bulwaya jisne unka sar munDwa diya. Yeh dekhkar, Nabi ke sahaba uthe, apni qurbaniyaan zabah kin, aur ek-doosre ke sar munDane lage, aur itni bheed ho gayi ke ek-doosre ko chot lagne ka khatra tha. Phir kuch imandaar aurtein aaeen, aur Allah ne yeh Divine ayaat nazil ki: "Aye imandaar logo! Jab imandaar aurtein hijrat karke tumhare paas aayen, unki jaanch karo..." (60:10). Umar ne phir apni do biwiyon ko talaq de di jo kaafir thi. Baad mein Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne unme se ek se shaadi ki, aur Safwan bin Umaiya ne doosri se. Jab Nabi Madina wapas aaye, Abu Basir, ek naya Musalman, Quraish se unke paas aaya. Kaafiron ne unka picha karne do log bheje jinhone (Nabi se) kaha: "Aapne humse jo waada kiya use poora karein." Isliye Nabi ne use unhe sonp diya. Woh use bahar le gaye jab tak woh Dhul-Hulaifa pahunche jahan woh khajoor khaane ke liye ruke. Abu Basir ne unme se ek se kaha: "Allah ki qasam, aye falaan, maine dekha tumhari talwar bahut khoob hai." Usne use nikala aur kaha: "Allah ki qasam, yeh bahut acchi hai aur maine ise kaee baar aazmaya hai." Abu Basir ne kaha: "Mujhe ise dekhne do." Jab usne di, Abu Basir ne usse usse itna maara ke woh mar gaya, aur uska saathi bhaag kar Madina pahuncha aur masjid mein daudte huye daakhil hua. Jab Allah ke Rasool ne use dekha, kaha: "Yeh shaks dara hua lagta hai." Jab woh Nabi ke paas pahuncha, usne kaha: "Mera saathi maara gaya hai aur main bhi maara jata." Abu Basir aaye aur kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Allah ki qasam, Allah ne aapko apni zimmedaari poori karvaee, aapne mujhe unhe wapas kiya, magar Allah ne mujhe unse bachaya." Nabi ne kaha: "Uski maa ko afsos! Kaash uske saath madad karne wale hote, kitna behtareen jung ka mashaal jalane wala hota!" Jab Abu Basir ne yeh suna, unhe samajh aaya ke Nabi unhe phir wapas kar denge, isliye woh chal pade jab tak samundar ke kinare pahunche. Abu Jandal bin Suhail bhi khud ko azaad karvakar Abu Basir ke saath jud gaye. Isliye jab bhi koi Quraish shaks Islam qubool karta, woh Abu Basir se jud jata jab tak unki ek mazboot toli ban gayi. Allah ki qasam, jab bhi unhe Quraish ke Sham jaane wale qafile ke baare mein pata chalta, woh use rokte aur hamla karte aur unhe qatl karte aur unka maal le lete. Quraish ne Nabi ko Allah aur rishtedari ki khaatir Abu Basir aur unke saathiyon ko bulane ki guzarish ki, yeh waada karte huye ke jo bhi (unme se) Nabi ke paas aaye, mehfooz rahega. Isliye Nabi ne unhe bulwa liya, aur Allah ne yeh Divine ayaat nazil ki: "Aur wahi hai jisne unke haath tumse aur tumhare haath unse Mecca ke beech mein roke, unke tumpar fatah pane ke baad. ... kaafiron ke dilon mein ghamand aur zid thi, ... jahiliyat ke zamane wali ghamand aur zid" (48:24-26). Unki ghamand aur zid yeh thi ke unhone Nabi ke Nabi hone ka iqrar nahi kiya (muahide mein likhne se) aur "Allah ke naam se jo bahut zyada meharbaan, nihaayat reham karne wala hai" likhne se inkaar kiya, aur unhone Musalmanon ko Ghar (Ka'ba) jaane se roka.

e: Narrated Az-Zuhri:`Urwa said, "Aisha told me that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to examine the women emigrants. We have been told also that when Allah revealed the order that the Muslims should return to the pagans what they had spent on their wives who emigrated (after embracing Islam) and that the Muslims should not keep unbelieving women as their wives, `Umar divorced two of his wives, Qariba, the daughter of Abu Umayyah and the daughter of Jarwal Al-Khuza`i. Later on Mu`awiya married Qariba and Abu Jahm married the other." When the pagans refused to pay what the Muslims had spent on their wives, Allah revealed: "And if any of your wives have gone from you to the unbelievers and you have an accession (by the coming over of a woman from the other side) (then pay to those whose wives have gone) the equivalent of what they had spent (on their Mahr)." (60.11) So, Allah ordered that the Muslim whose wife has gone, should be given, as a compensation of the Mahr he had given to his wife, from the Mahr of the wives of the pagans who had emigrated deserting their husbands. We do not know any of the women emigrants who deserted Islam after embracing it. We have also been told that Abu Basir bin Asid Ath-Thaqafi came to the Prophet (ﷺ) as a Muslim emigrant during the truce. Al-Akhnas bin Shariq wrote to the Prophet (ﷺ) requesting him to return Abu Basir
hi: Az-Zuhri bataate hain: Urwa ne kaha, "Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne mujhe bataya ke Allah ke Rasool imandaar aurat hijraton ki jaanch karte the." Humein yeh bhi bataya gaya ke jab Allah ne yeh hukum nazil kiya ke Musalman kaafiron ko unka woh kharch wapas karen jo unhone apni biwiyon par kiya tha jo (Islam qubool karke) hijrat kar chuki thi, aur Musalmanon ko kaafir aurton ko biwi ke tor par na rakhna chahiye, Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne apni do biwiyon ko talaq de di, Qariba (Abu Umayya ki beti) aur Jarwal Al-Khuza'i ki beti. Baad mein Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Qariba se shaadi ki aur Abu Jahm ne doosri se. Jab kaafiron ne Musalmanon ka apni biwiyon par kiya hua kharch dene se inkaar kiya, Allah ne yeh nazil ki: "Aur agar tumhari kisi biwi ne tumhe chhodkar kaafiron ki taraf jaane ka faisla kiya ho aur tumhe (badle mein aane wali) mile (yaani doosri taraf se koi aurat aaye), to unhe unka mehar wapas do jo unhone (Mahr par) kharch kiya tha" (60:11). Isliye Allah ne hukum diya ke jis Musalman ki biwi chali gayi ho, use uske Mahr ke badle mua'wza diya jaaye us Mahr se jo kaafir aurton ka tha jo apne shohar chhodkar hijrat kar chuki thi. Humein aisi koi Musalman aurat nahi maalum jisne Islam qubool karne ke baad hijrat chhod di ho. Humein yeh bhi bataya gaya ke Abu Basir bin Asid Ath-Thaqafi ek Musalman hijrat karke Nabi ke paas sulha ke dauran aaye. Al-Akhnas bin Shariq ne Nabi ko khat likha aur Abu Basir ko wapas karne ki guzarish ki.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) mentioned a person who asked an Israeli man to lend him one-thousand Dinars, and the Israeli lent him the sum for a certain fixed period
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne ek shaks ka zikar kiya jisne Bani Israel ke ek shaks se hazaar Dinar ka qarz maanga, aur us Bani Israel shaks ne muqarrar muddat ke liye woh raqam dee.

e: Narrated `Amra:Aisha said that Barirah came to seek her help in the writing of her emancipation. `Aisha said to her, "If you wish, I will pay your masters (your price) and the wala' will be for me." When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came, she told him about it. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to her, "Buy her (i.e. Barirah) and manumit (free) her, for the Wala is for the one who manumits." Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ascended the pulpit and said, "What about those people who stipulate conditions which are not in Allah's Laws? Whoever stipulates such conditions as are not in Allah's Laws, then those conditions are invalid even if he stipulated a hundred such conditions
hi: Amra bataati hain: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha ke Barira (رضی اللہ عنہا) apni azaadi ke muahide mein madad maangne aayi. Ayesha ne unse kaha: "Agar tum chaho, main tumhare maalikon ko qeemat ada karunga aur Wala mera hoga." Jab Allah ke Rasool aaye, unhone unhe iske baare mein bataya. Nabi ne unse kaha: "Ise (yaani Barira ko) khareedo aur azaad karo, kyunke Wala usi ke paas jata hai jo azaad karta hai." Phir Allah ke Rasool mimbar par chadhe aur kaha: "Un logon ka kya masla hai jo aisi sharten lagate hain jo Allah ke qanoon mein nahi? Jo bhi aisi sharten lagta hai jo Allah ke qanoon mein nahi, woh sharten batil hain chahe woh sau aisi sharten lagaye."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah has ninety-nine names, i.e. one-hundred minus one, and whoever knows them will go to Paradise." (Please see Hadith No. 419 Vol)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Allah ke ninyanve naam hain, yaani ek sau kam ek, aur jo bhi inhe yaad rakhta hai, woh Jannat mein jaayega."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Umar bin Al-Khattab got some land in Khaibar and he went to the Prophet (ﷺ) to consult him about it saying, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) I got some land in Khaibar better than which I have never had, what do you suggest that I do with it?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If you like you can give the land as endowment and give its fruits in charity." So `Umar gave it in charity as an endowment on the condition that it would not be sold nor given to anybody as a present and not to be inherited, but its yield would be given in charity to the poor people, to the Kith and kin, for freeing slaves, for Allah's Cause, to the travelers and guests; and that there would be no harm if the guardian of the endowment ate from it according to his need with good intention, and fed others without storing it for the future
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Umar bin Al-Khattab ko Khaibar mein kuch zameen mili aur woh Nabi ke paas iske baare mein mashwara lene gaye aur kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe Khaibar mein aisi zameen mili hai jaisi mujhe kabhi nahi mili, aap iske baare mein kya salaah dete hain?" Nabi ne kaha: "Agar tum chaho, zameen waqf kar sakte ho aur uski paidawaar sadqa mein de sakte ho." Isliye Umar ne ise sadqa mein diya is shart par ke ise na becha jaaye, na kisi ko tohfe mein diya jaaye, na waraasat mein di jaaye, magar iski paidawaar gareebon, rishtedaron, gulaamon ko azaad karne, Allah ki raah mein, musafiron aur mehmaanon ko sadqa mein di jaaye; aur waqf ke rakhwali ko koi harj nahi agar woh imandaari se apni zaroorat ke mutabiq isme se khaye, aur doosron ko khilaye bina isse jama karne ka iraada rakhe.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "It is not permissible for any Muslim who has something to will to stay for two nights without having his last will and testament written and kept ready with him
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Kisi bhi Musalman ke liye jaiz nahi jiske paas vasiyat karne ke liye kuch ho, ke woh do raat bhi bina apni vasiyat likhkar taiyaar rakhe guzaare."

e: Narrated `Amr bin Al-Harith:(The brother of the wife of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), Juwairiya bint Al-Harith) When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died, he did not leave any Dirham or Dinar (i.e. money), a slave or a slave woman or anything else except his white mule, his arms and a piece of land which he had given in charity
hi: Amr bin Al-Harith (Allah ke Rasool ki biwi Juwairiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Al-Harith ke bhai) bataate hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool ka intiqal hua, unhone koi Dirham ya Dinar (yaani paisa), koi gulaam ya launDi, ya koi cheez nahi chhodi siwaye apni safed khachchar (mule), apne hathiyaar, aur zameen ka ek tukda jo unhone sadqa mein de diya tha.

e: Narrated Talha bin Musarrif:I asked `Abdullah bin Abu `Aufa "Did the Prophet (ﷺ) make a will?" He replied, "No," I asked him, "How is it then that the making of a will has been enjoined on people, (or that they are ordered to make a will)?" He replied, "The Prophet (ﷺ) bequeathed Allah's Book (i.e. Qur'an)
hi: Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Musarrif bataate hain: Maine Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abu Aufa se pucha: "Kya Nabi ne vasiyat ki thi?" Unhone jawab diya: "Nahi." Maine unse pucha: "Phir logon ko vasiyat karne ka hukum kyun diya gaya (ya hukum kiya gaya)?" Unhone jawab diya: "Nabi ne Allah ki Kitaab (Quran) ki vasiyat ki."

e: Narrated Al-Aswad:In the presence of `Aisha some people mentioned that the Prophet (ﷺ) had appointed `Ali by will as his successor. `Aisha said, "When did he appoint him by will? Verily when he died he was resting against my chest (or said: in my lap) and he asked for a wash-basin and then collapsed while in that state, and I could not even perceive that he had died, so when did he appoint him by will?
hi: Al-Aswad bataate hain: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke saamne kuch logon ne zikar kiya ke Nabi ne apni vasiyat mein Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko apna jaanshin muqarrar kiya tha. Ayesha ne kaha: "Unhone kab unhe muqarrar kiya? Unke intiqal ke waqt, woh mere seene se (ya kaha: meri god mein) teke hue the aur unhone ek bartan maanga, phir usi haalat mein behosh ho gaye, aur mujhe pata bhi nahi chala ke unka intiqal ho gaya hai, to woh kab yeh vasiyat kar sakte the?"

e: Narrated Sa`d bin Abu Waqqas:The Prophet (ﷺ) came visiting me while I was (sick) in Mecca, ('Amir the sub-narrator said, and he disliked to die in the land, whence he had already migrated). He (i.e. the Prophet) said, "May Allah bestow His Mercy on Ibn Afra (Sa`d bin Khaula)." I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! May I will all my property (in charity)?" He said, "No." I said, "Then may I will half of it?" He said, "No". I said, "One third?" He said: "Yes, one third, yet even one third is too much. It is better for you to leave your inheritors wealthy than to leave them poor begging others, and whatever you spend for Allah's sake will be considered as a charitable deed even the handful of food you put in your wife's mouth. Allah may lengthen your age so that some people may benefit by you, and some others be harmed by you." At that time Sa`d had only one daughter
hi: Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas bataate hain: Nabi mujhse milne aaye jabke main Mecca mein (bimar) tha. (Amir, doosre raawi ne kaha: aur Sa'd ko us zameen mein marna napasand tha jahan se woh pehle hijrat kar chuke the.) Nabi ne kaha: "Allah Ibn Afra (Sa'd bin Khaula) par reham kare." Maine kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Kya main apni saara maal vasiyat mein de sakta hoon (sadqa mein)?" Aap ne kaha: "Nahi." Maine kaha: "Phir aadha?" Aap ne kaha: "Nahi." Maine kaha: "Ek-tihai?" Aap ne kaha: "Haan, ek-tihai, chahe ek-tihai bhi bahut zyada hai. Behtar hai ke tum apne waarison ko maldaar chhodo bajaye is ke ke unhe gareebi mein logon se bheek maangne de do, aur jo bhi tum Allah ki raah mein kharch karoge, use sadqe ka amal mana jaayega, chahe woh ek mutthi khaana ho jo tum apni biwi ke mun mein daalo. Allah tumhari umr lambi kar sakta hai taake kuch log tumse faida uthayen aur kuch nuqsaan." Us waqt Sa'd ki sirf ek beti thi.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I recommend that people reduce the proportion of what they bequeath by will to the fourth (of the whole legacy), for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "One-third, yet even one third is too much
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main logon ko sifarish karta hoon ke woh apni vasiyat mein diye jaane wale hisse ko chauthai (poore maal ka) tak kam karen, kyunke Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: "Ek-tihai, chahe ek-tihai bhi bahut zyada hai."

e: Narrated Sa`d:I fell sick and the Prophet (ﷺ) paid me a visit. I said to him, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I invoke Allah that He may not let me expire in the land whence I migrated (i.e. Mecca)." He said, "May Allah give you health and let the people benefit by you." I said, "I want to will my property, and I have only one daughter and I want to will half of my property (to be given in charity)." He said," Half is too much." I said, "Then I will one third." He said, "One-third, yet even one-third is too much." (The narrator added, "So the people started to will one third of their property and that was Permitted for them)
hi: Sa'd bataate hain: Main bimar pad gaya aur Nabi mujhse milne aaye. Maine unse kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Main Allah se dua karta hoon ke woh mujhe us zameen mein na marne de jahan se maine hijrat ki (yaani Mecca)." Aap ne kaha: "Allah tumhe sehat de aur logon ko tumse faida pahunchne de." Maine kaha: "Main apni maal ki vasiyat karna chahta hoon, aur meri sirf ek beti hai, aur main apni aadhi maal (sadqa mein) dena chahta hoon." Aap ne kaha: "Aadha bahut zyada hai." Maine kaha: "Phir ek-tihai." Aap ne kaha: "Ek-tihai, chahe ek-tihai bhi bahut zyada hai." (Raawi ne joda, "Isliye log apni maal ka ek-tihai vasiyat karna shuru kiya aur unhe yeh ijazat mil gayi.")

e: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) `Utba bin Abi Waqqas entrusted (his son) to his brother Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas saying, "The son of the slave-girl of Zam`a is my (illegal) son, take him into your custody." So during the year of the Conquest (of Mecca) Sa`d took the boy and said, "This is my brother's son whom my brother entrusted to me." 'Abu bin Zam'a got up and said, "He is my brother and the son of the slave girl of my father and was born on my father's bed." Then both of them came to Allah's Apostle and Sa`d said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! This is my brother's son whom my brother entrusted to me." Then 'Abu bin Zam`a got up and said, "This is my brother and the son of the slave-girl of my father." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O Abu bin Zam`a! This boy is for you as the boy belongs to the bed (where he was born), and for the adulterer is the stone (i.e. deprivation)." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said to his wife Sauda bint Zam`a, "Screen yourself from this boy," when he saw the boy's resemblance to `Utba. Since then the boy did not see Sauda till he died
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki biwi) bataati hain: Utba bin Abi Waqqas ne apne bhai Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko (apne bete ki) zimmedaari sonpi aur kaha: "Zam'a ki launDi ka beta mera (na-jaiz) beta hai, ise apni sarparasti mein le lo." Isliye Fatah-e-Mecca ke saal, Sa'd ne ladke ko liya aur kaha: "Yeh mere bhai ka beta hai jise mere bhai ne mujhe sonpa tha." Abu bin Zam'a khade hue aur kaha: "Yeh mera bhai hai aur mere waalid ki launDi ka beta, aur mere waalid ke bistar par paida hua." Phir donon Allah ke Rasool ke paas gaye aur Sa'd ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Yeh mere bhai ka beta hai jise mere bhai ne mujhe sonpa tha." Phir Abu bin Zam'a khade hue aur kaha: "Yeh mera bhai hai aur mere waalid ki launDi ka beta." Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: "Aye Abu bin Zam'a! Yeh ladka tumhara hai kyunke bacha bistar wale ka hota hai (jiske bistar par paida hua), aur zina karne wale ke liye sirf patthar (mehroomiyat)." Phir Nabi ne apni biwi Sauda (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Zam'a se kaha: "Is ladke se parda karo," jab unhone ladke aur Utba ke beech samaanta dekhi. Uske baad, ladke ne Sauda ko kabhi apni maut tak nahi dekha.

e: Narrated Anas:A Jew crushed the head of a girl between two stones. She was asked, "Who has done so to you, so-and-so? So-and-so?" Till the name of the Jew was mentioned, whereupon she nodded (in agreement). So the Jew was brought and was questioned till he confessed. The Prophet (ﷺ) then ordered that his head be crushed with stones
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek Yahudi ne ek ladki ka sar do pattharon ke beech kuchla. Usse pucha gaya: "Yeh kisne kiya, falaan? falaan?" jab tak Yahudi ka naam liya gaya, aur usne ishare se maan liya. Isliye Yahudi ko laaya gaya aur pucha gaya jab tak usne iqrar kiya. Nabi ne phir hukum diya ke uska sar bhi pattharon se kuchla jaaye.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The custom (in old days) was that the property of the deceased would be inherited by his offspring; as for the parents (of the deceased), they would inherit by the will of the deceased. Then Allah cancelled from that custom whatever He wished and fixed for the male double the amount inherited by the female, and for each parent a sixth (of the whole legacy) and for the wife an eighth or a fourth and for the husband a half or a fourth
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: (Purane zamane mein) riwaj tha ke marhoom ki maal uski aulad ko milti thi; jahan tak maa-baap ka sawaal hai, unhe marhoom ki vasiyat ke zariye milta tha. Phir Allah ne is riwaj mein se jo chaha radd kiya aur mard ke liye aurat se doguna hissa muqarrar kiya, aur har maa-baap ke liye ek-chhatthaee (poori maal ka), biwi ke liye aathvaan ya chauthai, aur shohar ke liye aadha ya chauthai.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:A man asked the Prophet, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What kind of charity is the best?" He replied. "To give in charity when you are healthy and greedy hoping to be wealthy and afraid of becoming poor. Don't delay giving in charity till the time when you are on the death bed when you say, 'Give so much to so-and-so and so much to so-and-so,' and at that time the property is not yours but it belongs to so-and-so (i.e. your inheritors)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks ne Nabi se pucha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Sabse behtareen sadqa kaunsa hai?" Aap ne jawab diya: "Woh jo tum tab do jab tum sehatmand ho, lalchi ho maldaar banne ki khwahish rakhte hue, aur gareeb hone se darte hue. Sadqa dena tab tak taal mat jab tak maut ke bistar par ho aur kaho, 'itna falaan ko do, itna falaan ko,' aur us waqt maal tumhari nahi hoti balki falaan (yaani tumhare waarison) ki hoti hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The signs of a hypocrite are three: Whenever he speaks he tells a lie; whenever he is entrusted he proves dishonest; whenever he promises he breaks his promise
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Munafik ki teen nishaniyaan hain: Jab woh baat kare, jhoot bole; jab usse amanat sonpi jaaye, khyaanat kare; aur jab woh waada kare, waada tore."

e: Narrated `Urwa bin Az-Zubair:Hakim bin Hizam said, "I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for something, and he gave me, and I asked him again and he gave me and said, 'O Hakim! This wealth is green and sweet (i.e. as tempting as fruits), and whoever takes it without greed then he is blessed in it, and whoever takes it with greediness, he is not blessed in it and he is like one who eats and never gets satisfied. The upper (i.e. giving) hand is better than the lower (i.e. taking) hand." Hakim added, "I said, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! By Him Who has sent you with the Truth I will never demand anything from anybody after you till I die." Afterwards Abu Bakr used to call Hakim to give him something but he refused to accept anything from him. Then `Umar called him to give him (something) but he refused. Then `Umar said, "O Muslims! I offered to him (i.e. Hakim) his share which Allah has ordained for him from this booty and he refuses to take it." Thus Hakim did not ask anybody for anything after the Prophet, till he died--may Allah bestow His mercy upon him
hi: Urwa bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hakim bin Hizam (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool se kuch maanga, aur unhone mujhe diya, aur maine phir maanga aur unhone phir diya aur kaha: 'Aye Hakim! Yeh maal hariaa aur meetha hai (yaani lalchawane waala jaise phal), aur jo bhi ise bina lalach ke leta hai, usme uski barkat hoti hai, aur jo bhi ise lalach se leta hai, usme uski barkat nahi hoti aur woh us shaks jaisa hai jo khata hai magar kabhi santusht nahi hota. Oopar wala (dena wala) haath neeche wale (lene wale) haath se behtar hai.'" Hakim ne joda: "Maine kaha, 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Us zaat ki qasam jisne aapko haqq ke saath bheja hai, main aapke baad kisi se bhi kuch nahi maangunga jab tak main mar na jaoon.'" Baad mein Abu Bakr Hakim ko kuch dene ke liye bulate magar unhone lene se inkaar kar diya. Phir Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne unhe bulaya (dene ke liye) magar unhone inkaar kar diya. Umar ne kaha: "Aye Musalmano! Maine unhe (Hakim ko) unka woh hissa dena chaha jo Allah ne is maal-e-ghanimat mein unke liye muqarrar kiya hai, magar woh lene se inkaar karte hain." Isliye Hakim ne Nabi ke baad kisi se kuch nahi maanga jab tak unka intiqal na ho gaya — Allah unpar reham kare.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "All of you are guardians and responsible for your charges: the Ruler (i.e. Imam) is a guardian and responsible for his subjects; and a man is a guardian of his family and is responsible for his charges; and a lady is a guardian in the house of her husband and is responsible for her charge; and a servant is a guardian of the property of his master and is responsible for his charge." I think he also said, "And a man is a guardian of the property of his father
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool ko kehte suna: "Tum sab rakhwale ho aur apni zimmedaariyon ke liye zimmedaar ho: hukmaran (Imam) ek rakhwala hai aur apni raaya ke liye zimmedaar hai; mard apne pariwara ka rakhwala hai aur uski zimmedaari mein jo hai uska zimmedaar hai; aurat apne shohar ke ghar ki rakhwali hai aur apni zimmedaari ke liye zimmedaar hai; aur khaadim apne maalik ki maal ka rakhwala hai aur apni zimmedaari ke liye zimmedaar hai." Mujhe lagta hai unhone yeh bhi kaha: "Mard apne baap ki maal ka bhi rakhwala hai."

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said to Abu Talha, "I recommend that you divide (this garden) amongst your relatives." Abu Talha said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I will do the same." So Abu Talha divided it among his relatives and cousins. Ibn 'Abbas said, "When the Qur'anic Verse: "Warn your nearest kinsmen." (26.214) Was revealed, the Prophet (ﷺ) started calling the various big families of Quraish, "O Bani Fihr! O Bani Adi!". Abu Huraira said, "When the Verse: "Warn your nearest kinsmen" was revealed, the Prophet (ﷺ) said (in a loud voice), "O people of Quraish
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kaha: "Mera mashwara hai ke tum (yeh baag) apne rishtedaron mein taqseem karo." Abu Talha ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Main aisa hi karunga." Isliye Abu Talha ne ise apne rishtedaron aur chachazaad bhaiyon mein taqseem kar diya. Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Jab Quranic Ayat: 'Apne sabse qareebi rishtedaron ko darao' (26:214) nazil hui, Nabi ne Quraish ke bade khaandanon ko bulana shuru kiya, 'Aye Bani Fihr! Aye Bani Adi!'" Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Jab Ayat: 'Apne sabse qareebi rishtedaron ko darao' nazil hui, Nabi ne (zor se) kaha: 'Aye Quraish ke logo!'"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:When Allah revealed the Verse: "Warn your nearest kinsmen," Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got up and said, "O people of Quraish (or said similar words)! Buy (i.e. save) yourselves (from the Hellfire) as I cannot save you from Allah's Punishment; O Bani `Abd Manaf! I cannot save you from Allah's Punishment, O Safiya, the Aunt of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I cannot save you from Allah's Punishment; O Fatima bint Muhammad! Ask me anything from my wealth, but I cannot save you from Allah's Punishment
