hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Allah ne Ayat nazil ki: "Apne sabse qareebi rishtedaron ko darao," Allah ke Rasool khade hue aur kaha: "Aye Quraish ke logo (ya kuch aisa hi kaha)! Apne aap ko (Dozakh ki aag se) khareedo (bachao), kyunke main tumhe Allah ki saza se nahi bacha sakta; Aye Bani Abd Manaf! Main tumhe Allah ki saza se nahi bacha sakta; Aye Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا), Allah ke Rasool ki phufi! Main tumhe Allah ki saza se nahi bacha sakta; Aye Fatima (Alayhas Salam) bint Muhammad! Mujhse mere maal se jo chaho maango, magar main tumhe Allah ki saza se nahi bacha sakta."

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) saw a man driving a Badana (i.e. camel for sacrifice) and said to him, "Ride on it." The man said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! It is a Badana." (The Prophet (ﷺ) repeated his order) and on the third or fourth time he said, "Ride it, (woe to you" or said: "May Allah be merciful to you)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne ek shaks ko Badana (qurbani ka unt) hankate dekha aur kaha: "Ispar sawar ho jaao." Shaks ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Yeh Badana hai." (Nabi ne apna hukum dohraya) aur teesri ya chauthi baar unhone kaha: "Ispar sawar ho jaao, (afsos tumpar)" ya kaha, "Allah tumpar reham kare."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw a man driving a Badana and said to him, "Ride on it," and on the second or the third time he added, "Woe to you
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne ek shaks ko Badana hankate dekha aur kaha: "Ispar sawar ho jaao," aur doosri ya teesri baar unhone joda: "Afsos tumpar."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The mother of Sa`d bin 'Ubada died in his absence. He said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! My mother died in my absence; will it be of any benefit for her if I give Sadaqa on her behalf?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Yes," Sa`d said, "I make you a witness that I gave my garden called Al Makhraf in charity on her behalf
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Sa'd bin Ubada (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki maa unki gair-maujoodgi mein guzar gayi. Unhone kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Meri maa meri gair-maujoodgi mein guzar gayi; kya use koi faida hoga agar main uski taraf se sadqa dun?" Nabi ne kaha: "Haan." Sa'd ne kaha: "Main aapko gawaah banata hoon ke maine apna Al-Makhraf naam ka baag uski taraf se sadqa mein de diya hai."

e: Narrated Ka`b bin Malik:I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! For the acceptance of my repentance I wish to give all my property in charity for Allah's sake through His Apostle ." He said, "It is better for you to keep some of the property for yourself." I said, "Then I will keep my share in Khaibar
hi: Ka'b bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Meri tauba ki qubooliyat ke liye main apni saara maal Allah ki raah mein aur unke Rasool ke zariye sadqa dena chahta hoon." Aap ne kaha: "Behtar hai tum apni maal ka kuch hissa apne liye rakho." Maine kaha: "To main Khaibar mein apna hissa rakhta hoon."

e: Narrated Anas (ra):When the Holy Verse: 'By no means shall you attain Al-Birr (piety, righteousness, it means here Allah's Reward i.e., Paradise), unless you spend of that which you love..', (V 3:92) was revealed, Abu Talha went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger ! Allah, the Blessed, the Superior stated in His book: 'By no means shall you attain Birr, unless you spend of that which you love....' (V 3:92) and the most beloved property to me is Bairuha' (which was a garden where Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to go to sit in its shade and drink from its water). I give it to Allah and His Messenger (ﷺ) hoping for Allah's Reward in the Hereafter. So, O Allah's Messenger! Use it as Allah orders you to use it." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Bravo! O Abu Talha, it is fruitful property. We have accepted it from you and now we return it to you. Distribute it amongst your relatives." So, Abu Talha distributed it amongst his relatives, amongst whom were Ubai and Hassan. When Hassan sold his share of that garden to Mu'awiyya, he was asked, "How do you sell Abu Talha's Sadaqa?" He replied, "Why should not I sell a Sa' of date for Sa' of money?" The garden was situated on the courtyard of the palace of Bani Hudailah built by Mu'awiya
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab paak Ayat nazil hui: "Tum kabhi Al-Birr (neki, Jannat) nahi paoge jab tak us cheez ko sadqa na do jo tumhe aziz ho" (3:92), Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) Allah ke Rasool ke paas gaye aur kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Allah, jo Barakaton wala aur Buland hai, apni Kitaab mein farmata hai: 'Tum kabhi Al-Birr nahi paoge jab tak us cheez ko sadqa na do jo tumhe aziz ho' (3:92), aur meri sabse aziz maal Bairuha hai (ek baag jahan Allah ke Rasool jaakar chhaon mein baithte aur uska paani pite the). Main ise Allah aur uske Rasool ko dena chahta hoon, Aakhirat mein Allah ke ajr ki ummeed rakhte huye. Isliye, Ya Allah ke Rasool! Ise wahan istemal kijiye jahan Allah aapko hukum de." Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: "Wah! Aye Abu Talha, yeh faidamand maal hai. Humne yeh tumse qubool kar li hai aur ab hum ise tumhe wapas karte hain. Ise apne rishtedaron mein taqseem karo." Isliye Abu Talha ne ise apne rishtedaron mein taqseem kiya, jinme Ubai aur Hassan bhi the. Jab Hassan ne baag mein apna hissa Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko becha, unse pucha gaya: "Tum Abu Talha ka sadqa kyun bechte ho?" Unhone jawab diya: "Kyun na main khajoor ka Sa paisa ke Sa ke badle bechun?" Baag Bani Hudaila ke mahal ke aangaan mein tha jo Muawiya ne banwaya tha.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Some people claim that the order in the above Verse is cancelled, by Allah, it is not cancelled, but the people have stopped acting on it. There are two kinds of guardians (who are in charge of the inheritance): One is that who inherits; such a person should give (of what he inherits to the relatives, the orphans and the needy, etc.), the other is that who does not inherit (e.g. the guardian of the orphans): such a person should speak kindly and say (to those who are present at the time of distribution), "I can not give it to you (as the wealth belongs to the orphans)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Kuch log kehte hain ke upar wali ayat mansookh (radd) ho gayi hai. Allah ki qasam, yeh mansookh nahi hui, magar logon ne ispar amal karna chhod diya hai. Do qisam ke sarparast hain (jo waraasat ke maamle mein zimmedaar hote hain): Ek woh jo waaris hai; aise shaks ko chahiye ke woh (apni waraasat mein se rishtedaron, yateemon, aur zaroorat-mandon ko) kuch de. Doosra woh jo waaris nahi (jaise yateem ka sarparast): aise shaks ko narmi se baat karni chahiye aur (taqseem ke waqt maujood logon se) kehna chahiye, "Main tumhe (yeh) nahi de sakta (kyunke maal yateemon ki hai)."

e: Narrated `Aisha:A man said to the Prophet, "My mother died suddenly, and I think that if she could speak, she would have given in charity. May I give in charity on her behalf?" He said, "Yes! Give in charity on her behalf
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ek shaks ne Nabi se kaha: "Meri maa achanak guzar gayi, aur mujhe lagta hai agar woh bol pati, woh sadqa deti. Kya main uski taraf se sadqa de sakta hoon?" Nabi ne kaha: "Haan! Uski taraf se sadqa do."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Sa`d bin Ubada consulted Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "My mother died and she had an unfulfilled vow." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Fulfill it on her behalf
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Sa'd bin Ubada (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Allah ke Rasool se salaah li aur kaha: "Meri maa guzar gaee aur unka ek nadra (mannat) adhoora reh gaya." Nabi ne kaha: "Uski taraf se woh poora karo."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:That the mother of Sa`d bin Ubada the brother of Bani Saida died in Sa`d's absence, so he came to the Prophet saying, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! My mother died in my absence, will it benefit her if I give in charity on her behalf?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Yes." Sa`d said, "I take you as my witness that I give my garden Al-Makhraf in charity on her behalf
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Sa'd bin Ubada (رضی اللہ عنہ) (Bani Sa'ida ke bhai) ki maa unki gair-maujoodgi mein guzar gayi, isliye woh Nabi ke paas gaye aur kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Meri maa meri gair-maujoodgi mein guzar gayi, kya use faida hoga agar main uski taraf se sadqa dun?" Nabi ne kaha: "Haan." Sa'd ne kaha: "Main aapko gawaah banata hoon ke maine apna Al-Makhraf baag uski taraf se sadqa mein diya."

e: Narrated Az-Zuhri:`Urwa bin Az-Zubair said that he asked `Aisha about the meaning of the Qur'anic Verse:-- "And if you fear that you will not deal fairly with the orphan girls then marry (other) women of your choice." (4.2-3) Aisha said, "It is about a female orphan under the guardianship of her guardian who is inclined towards her because of her beauty and wealth, and likes to marry her with a Mahr less than what is given to women of her standard. So they (i.e. guardians) were forbidden to marry the orphans unless they paid them a full appropriate Mahr (otherwise) they were ordered to marry other women instead of them. Later on the people asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about it. So Allah revealed the following Verse:-- "They ask your instruction (O Muhammad!) regarding women. Say: Allah instructs you regarding them..." (4.127) and in this Verse Allah indicated that if the orphan girl was beautiful and wealthy, her guardian would have the desire to marry her without giving her an appropriate Mahr equal to what her peers could get, but if she was undesirable for lack of beauty or wealth, then he would not marry her, but seek to marry some other woman instead of her. So, since he did not marry her when he had no inclination towards her, he had not the right to marry her when he had an interest in her, unless he treated her justly by giving her a full Mahr and securing all her rights
hi: Az-Zuhri bataate hain: Urwa bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha ke unhone Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se Quranic Ayat ka matlab pucha: "Agar tumhe dar hai ke tum yateem ladkiyon ke saath insaaf nahi kar paoge, to (doosri) auraton se shaadi karo jo tumhe pasand hon" (4:2-3). Ayesha ne kaha: "Yeh un yateem ladkiyon ke baare mein hai jo apne sarparast ke ikhtiyaar mein hoti hain jo unki khoobsurati aur daulat ki wajah se unse akarshit hote hain, aur unhe unke standard se kam Mahr dekar shaadi karna chahte hain. Isliye unhe (sarparaston ko) yateem ladkiyon se shaadi karne se mana kiya gaya jab tak woh unhe poora munasib Mahr na den (warna), unhe unki jagah doosri auraton se shaadi karne ka hukum diya gaya. Baad mein logon ne Allah ke Rasool se iske baare mein pucha, isliye Allah ne yeh Ayat nazil ki: 'Woh tumse aurton ke baare mein hidayat maangte hain (Aye Muhammad!). Kaho: Allah tumhe unke baare mein hidayat deta hai...' (4:127) aur is Ayat mein Allah ne ishara kiya ke agar yateem ladki khoobsurat aur daulatmand ho, uska sarparast usse bina munasib Mahr diye shaadi karna chahega, aur agar woh khoobsurat na ho ya daulatmand na ho, to woh usse shaadi nahi karega, balki uski jagah kisi doosri se shaadi karega. Isliye, chunke usne use tab shaadi nahi ki jab usme koi khichaav na tha, use tab bhi shaadi karne ka haqq nahi jab uski khaatir ho, jab tak woh use poora Mahr dekar aur uske sab haqq mehfooz rakhkar insaaf na kare."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:In the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) , `Umar gave in charity some of his property, a garden of date-palms called Thamgh. `Umar said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have some property which I prize highly and I want to give it in charity." The Prophet; said, "Give it in charity (i.e. as an endowment) with its land and trees on the condition that the land and trees will neither be sold nor given as a present, nor bequeathed, but the fruits are to be spent in charity." So `Umar gave it in charity, and it was for Allah's Cause, the emancipation of slaves, for the poor, for guests, for travelers, and for kinsmen. The person acting as its administrator could eat from it reasonably and fairly, and could let a friend of his eat from it provided he had no intention of becoming wealthy by its means
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ke zamane mein, Umar ne apni maal ka kuch hissa sadqa mein diya, ek khajoor ka baag jise Thamgh kaha jata tha. Umar ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Meri kuch maal hai jise main bahut qeemti samajhta hoon aur main ise sadqa mein dena chahta hoon." Nabi ne kaha: "Ise sadqa (waqf) mein do, iski zameen aur darakhton samet, is shart par ke zameen aur darakht na beche jaayenge, na tohfe mein diye jaayenge, na waraasat mein diye jaayenge, magar iski paidawaar sadqa mein kharch ki jaayegi." Isliye Umar ne ise sadqa diya, aur yeh Allah ki raah mein, gulaamon ko azaad karne mein, gareebon ke liye, mehmaanon ke liye, musafiron ke liye, aur rishtedaron ke liye tha. Iske prabandhak imandaari aur munasib tareeke se isme se kha sakta tha, aur apne doston ko bhi khila sakta tha, bashart ke uska iraada isse maldaar banne ka na ho.

e: Narrated `Aisha:The following Verse:-- "If a guardian is well-off, let him claim no remuneration (i.e. wages), but if he is poor, let him have for himself what is just and reasonable." (4.6) was revealed in connection with the guardian of an orphan, and it means that if he is poor he can have for himself (from the orphan's wealth) what is just and reasonable according to the orphan's share of the inheritance
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Yeh Ayat: "Agar sarparast maldaar hai, use koi mazdoori na leni chahiye, magar agar woh gareeb hai, use utna hi lena chahiye jo munasib ho" (4:6) yateem ke sarparast ke baare mein nazil hui, aur iska matlab hai ke agar woh gareeb hai, woh apne liye (yateem ki daulat se) utna hi le sakta hai jo munasib ho, yateem ki waraasat ke mutabiq.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Avoid the seven great destructive sins." The people enquired, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What are they?" He said, "To join others in worship along with Allah, to practice sorcery, to kill the life which Allah has forbidden except for a just cause, (according to Islamic law), to eat up Riba (usury), to eat up an orphan's wealth, to give back to the enemy and fleeing from the battlefield at the time of fighting, and to accuse, chaste women, who never even think of anything touching chastity and are good believers
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Saat bade tabaahikaari gunahon se bacho." Logon ne pucha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Woh kya hain?" Aap ne kaha: "Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek karna, jaadu karna, uss jaan ko qatl karna jise Allah ne haram kiya hai siwaye jaiz wajah ke, sood (Riba) khaana, yateem ka maal khaana, jung ke maidan se bhaagna jung ke waqt, aur pak-baaz Musalman auraton par jhute ilzaam lagana jinhe kabhi bad-chaal ka khyaal tak nahi aata aur woh achhi momin hain."

e: Nafi' said:"Ibn 'Umar never refused to be appointed as guardian." The most beloved thing to Ibn Sirin concerning an orphan's wealth was that the orphan's advisor and guardians would assemble to decide what is best for him. When Tawus was asked about something concerning an orphan's affairs, he would recite: '...And Allah knows him who means mischief from him who means good...' (V 2:220). 'Ata said concerning some orphans, "The guardian is to provide for the young and the old orphans according to their needs from their shares
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kabhi bhi sarparast banne se inkaar nahi kiya. Ibn Sirin ko yateem ki daulat ke baare mein sabse zyada pasand yeh tha ke yateem ka mashwara denewala aur sarparast milkar yeh tay karen ke uske liye kya behtar hai. Jab Tawus se yateem ke maamlon ke baare mein kuch pucha jata, woh yeh padhte: "...aur Allah jaanta hai fasad karne wale ko neki karne wale se..." (2:220). Ata ne kuch yateemon ke baare mein kaha: "Sarparast ko chhote aur bade yateemon ki zaroorat ke mutabiq unke hisse se unki dekhbhal karni chahiye."

e: Narrated Anas:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to Medina; he did not have any servant. Abu Talha (Anas' step-father) took me to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Anas is a wise boy, so let him serve you." So, I served him at home and on journeys. If I did anything, he never asked me why I did it, and if I refrained from doing anything, he never asked me why I refrained from doing it
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool Madina aaye, unke paas koi khadim nahi tha. Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) (Anas ke sautele waalid) mujhe Allah ke Rasool ke paas laaye aur kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Anas ek aqlmand ladka hai, isliye ise aapki khidmat karne dijiye." Isliye maine ghar aur safar mein unki khidmat ki. Agar maine kuch kiya, unhone kabhi nahi pucha maine woh kyun kiya, aur agar maine kuch nahi kiya, unhone kabhi nahi pucha maine woh kyun nahi kiya.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Abu Talha had the greatest wealth of date-palms amongst the Ansar in Medina, and he prized above all his wealth (his garden) Bairuha', which was situated opposite the Mosque (of the Prophet (ﷺ) ). The Prophet used to enter It and drink from its fresh water. When the following Divine Verse came:-- "By no means shall you attain piety until you spend of what you love," (3.92) Abu Talha got up saying. "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Allah says, 'You will not attain piety until you spend of what you love,' and I prize above all my wealth, Bairuha' which I want to give in charity for Allah's Sake, hoping for its reward from Allah. So you can use it as Allah directs you." On that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Bravo! It is a profitable (or perishable) property. (Ibn Maslama is not sure as to which word is right, i.e. profitable or perishable.) I have heard what you have said, and I recommend that you distribute this amongst your relatives." On that Abu Talha said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I will do (as you have suggested)." So, Abu Talha distributed that garden amongst his relatives and cousins
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) Ansaar mein Madina ke sabse maldaar khajoor ke baag ke maalik the, aur unhe sabse aziz maal Bairuha thi, jo (Nabi ki) masjid ke saamne thi. Nabi usme daakhil hote aur uska taaza paani pite. Jab yeh paak Ayat nazil hui: "Tum kabhi neki nahi paoge jab tak us cheez ko sadqa na do jo tumhe aziz ho" (3:92), Abu Talha khade hue aur kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Allah farmata hai, 'Tum neki nahi paoge jab tak us cheez ko sadqa na do jo tumhe aziz ho,' aur meri sabse aziz maal Bairuha hai jise main Allah ki raah mein sadqa mein dena chahta hoon, Allah se iska ajr chahte huye. Isliye aap ise wahan istemal karen jahan Allah aapko hukum de." Isspar Nabi ne kaha: "Wah! Yeh faidamand (ya fani) maal hai." (Ibn Maslama ko yaqeen nahi konsa lafz sahi hai, faidamand ya fani.) "Maine tumhari baat sun li hai, aur mera mashwara hai ke tum ise apne rishtedaron mein taqseem karo." Isspar Abu Talha ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Main aisa hi karunga." Isliye Abu Talha ne woh baag apne rishtedaron aur chachazaad bhaiyon mein taqseem kar diya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:A man said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) , "My mother died, will it benefit her if I give in charity on her behalf?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied in the affirmative. The man said, "I have a garden and I make you a witness that I give it in charity on her behalf
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks ne Allah ke Rasool se kaha: "Meri maa guzar gayi, kya use faida hoga agar main uski taraf se sadqa dun?" Nabi ne haan mein jawab diya. Shaks ne kaha: "Mere paas ek baag hai aur main aapko gawaah banata hoon ke main use uski taraf se sadqa mein deta hoon."

e: Narrated Anas:When the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered that the mosque be built, he said, "O Bani An-Najjar! Suggest to me a price for this garden of yours." They replied, "By Allah! We will demand its price from none but Allah
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Nabi ne masjid banane ka hukum diya, unhone kaha: "Aye Bani Najjar! Mujhe apne is baag ki qeemat batao." Unhone jawab diya: "Allah ki qasam! Hum iski qeemat sirf Allah se maangenge."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:When `Umar got a piece of land in Khaibar, he came to the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "I have got a piece of land, better than which I have never got. So what do you advise me regarding it?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If you wish you can keep it as an endowment to be used for charitable purposes." So, `Umar gave the land in charity (i.e. as an endowment) on the condition that the land would neither be sold nor given as a present, nor bequeathed, (and its yield) would be used for the poor, the kinsmen, the emancipation of slaves, Jihad, and for guests and travelers; and its administrator could eat in a reasonable just manner, and he also could feed his friends without intending to be wealthy by its means
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Umar ko Khaibar mein ek zameen ka tukda mila, woh Nabi ke paas gaye aur kaha: "Mujhe ek zameen ka tukda mila hai, jaisi mujhe kabhi nahi mila. Iske baare mein aapki kya salaah hai?" Nabi ne kaha: "Agar tum chaho, ise sadqe (waqf) ke tor par rakh sakte ho jiski paidawaar charity mein istemal ho." Isliye Umar ne zameen sadqa mein di is shart par ke woh na bechi jaayegi, na tohfe mein di jaayegi, na waraasat mein di jaayegi, (aur iski paidawaar) gareebon, rishtedaron, gulaamon ko azaad karne, Jihad, mehmaanon aur musafiron ke liye istemal hogi; aur iska prabandhak munasib tareeke se isme se kha sakta hai, aur apne doston ko bhi khila sakta hai bina isse maldaar banne ka iraada rakhe.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:`Umar got some property in Khaibar and he came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and informed him about it. The Prophet said to him, "If you wish you can give it in charity." So `Umar gave it in charity (i.e. as an endowment) the yield of which was to be used for the good of the poor, the needy, the kinsmen and the guests
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Umar ko Khaibar mein kuch maal mili aur woh Nabi ke paas iske baare mein batane gaye. Nabi ne unse kaha: "Agar tum chaho, ise sadqa mein de sakte ho." Isliye Umar ne ise sadqa mein diya jiski paidawaar gareebon, zaroorat-mandon, rishtedaron, aur mehmaanon ke bhale ke liye istemal hoti.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to Medina, he ordered that a mosque be built. He said, "O Bani An- Najjar! Suggest me a price for the garden of yours." They replied, "By Allah, we will not ask its price except from Allah
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool Madina aaye, unhone masjid banane ka hukum diya. Unhone kaha: "Aye Bani An-Najjar! Mujhe apne baag ki qeemat batao." Unhone jawab diya: "Allah ki qasam, hum iski qeemat sirf Allah se maangenge."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Once `Umar gave a horse in charity to be used in holy fighting. It had been given to him by Allah's Apostle . `Umar gave it to another man to ride. Then `Umar was informed that the man put the horse for sale, so he asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) whether he could buy it. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, "You should not buy it, for you should not take back what you have given in charity
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Umar ne ek ghoda jihad ke liye sadqa mein diya jo unhe khud Allah ke Rasool ne diya tha. Umar ne use ek doosre shaks ko sawari ke liye diya. Phir Umar ko pata chala ke woh shaks ghoda bikri ke liye rakh raha hai, isliye unhone Allah ke Rasool se pucha kya woh use khareed sakte hain. Allah ke Rasool ne jawab diya: "Ise mat khareedo, kyunke tumhe woh cheez wapas nahi leni chahiye jo tumne sadqa mein di ho."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "My heirs will not inherit a Dinar or a Dirham (i.e. money), for whatever I leave (excluding the adequate support of my wives and the wages of my employees) is given in charity
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Mere waaris ek Dinar ya Dirham (yaani paisa) waraasat mein nahi paayenge, kyunke jo bhi main chhodta hoon (apni biwiyon ki munasib khidmat aur apne mulazimon ki mazdoori ke ilawa) sadqa mein di jaati hai."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:When `Umar founded an endowment he stipulated that its administrator could eat from it and also feed his friend on the condition that he would not store anything for himself from it
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Umar ne ek waqf sthaapit kiya, unhone shart rakhi ke uska prabandhak isse kha sakta hai aur apne dost ko bhi khila sakta hai is shart par ke woh apne liye kuch jama karke na rakhe.

e: Abu 'Abdur-Rahman narrated:When 'Uthman (ra) was circled (by the rebels), he looked upon them from above and said, "I ask you by Allah, I ask nobody but the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ), don't you know that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Whoever will (buy and) dig the well of Ruma will be granted Paradise,' and I (bought and) dug it? Don't you know that he said. 'Whoever equip the army of 'Usra (i.e., Tabuk's Ghazwa) will be granted Paradise,' and I equipped it ?" They attested whatever he said. When 'Umar founded his endowment he said, "Its administrator can eat from it." The management of the endowment can be taken over by the founder himself or any other person, for both cases are permissible
hi: Abu Abdur-Rahman bataate hain: Jab Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko (baagiyon dwaara) ghera gaya, unhone unhe oopar se dekha aur kaha: "Main tumhe Allah ki qasam dekar poochta hoon, main sirf Nabi ke sahaba se poochta hoon, kya tumhe nahi pata ke Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, 'Jo koi Ruma ka kua khareedkar khodega use Jannat ka waada hai,' aur maine use khareeda aur khodwa? Kya tumhe nahi pata ke unhone kaha, 'Jo koi Al-Usra ki fauj (yaani Ghazwa-e-Tabuk) ko saaz-o-saaman de, use Jannat ka waada hai,' aur maine use saaz-o-saaman diya?" Unhone unki har baat ki tasdeeq ki. Jab Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne apna waqf sthaapit kiya, unhone kaha: "Iska prabandhak isse kha sakta hai." Waqf ka intezam khud sthaapik ya koi doosra shaks kar sakta hai, kyunke donon jaiz hain.

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said (at the time of building the Mosque), "O Bani An-Najjar! Suggest to me a price for your garden." They replied, "We do not ask its price except from Allah
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne (masjid banwate waqt) kaha: "Aye Bani An-Najjar! Mujhe apne baag ki qeemat batao." Unhone jawab diya: "Hum iski qeemat sirf Allah se maangenge."

e: Ibn 'Abbas (ra) said, "A man from the tribe of Bani Sahm went out in the company of Tamim Ad-Dari and 'Adi bin Badda'. The man of Bani Sahm died in a land where there was no Muslim. When Tamim and 'Adi returned conveying the property of the deceased, they claimed that they had lost a silver bowl with gold engraving. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) made them take an oath (to confirm their claim), and then the bowl was found in Makkah with some people who claimed that they had bought it from Tamim and 'Adi. Then two witnesses from the relatives of the deceased got up and swore that their witnesses were more valid than the witnesses of 'Adi and Tamim, and that the bowl belonged to their deceased fellow. So, this verse was revealed in connection with this case: 'O you who believe! When death approached any of you ...'," (V 5:)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Bani Sahm qabile ka ek shaks Tamim Ad-Dari aur Adi bin Badda ke saath nikla. Bani Sahm ka shaks ek aisi zameen mein guzar gaya jahan koi Musalman nahi tha. Jab Tamim aur Adi marhoom ki maal lekar wapas aaye, unhone daava kiya ke unhone sona jatit ek chandi ka bartan khoya diya hai. Allah ke Rasool ne unse qasam likhwaee (unke daave ki tasdeeq ke liye), aur phir woh bartan Mecca mein kuch logon ke paas mila jinhone daava kiya ke unhone use Tamim aur Adi se khareeda tha. Phir marhoom ke rishtedaron mein se do gawaah khade hue aur qasam khaee ke unki gawahi Adi aur Tamim ki gawahi se zyada sahi hai, aur ke bartan unke marhoom rishtedaar ka tha. Isliye yeh ayat isi maamle ke baare mein nazil hui: "Aye imandaar logo! Jab maut tum mein se kisi ke qareeb aaye..." (5:106).

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah Al-Ansari:My father was martyred on the day (of the Ghazwa) of Uhud and left six daughters and some debts to be paid. When the time of plucking the date-fruits came, I went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Apostle! you know that my father was martyred on Uhud's day and owed much debt, and I wish that the creditors would see you." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Go and collect the various kinds of dates and place them separately in heaps"' I did accordingly and called him. On seeing him, the creditors started claiming their rights pressingly at that time. When the Prophet (ﷺ) saw how they behaved, he went round the biggest heap for three times and sat over it and said, "Call your companions (i.e. the creditors)." Then he kept on measuring and giving them, till Allah cleared all my father's debts. By Allah, it would have pleased me that Allah would clear the debts of my father even though I had not taken a single date to my sisters. But by Allah, all the heaps were complete, (as they were) and I looked at the heap where Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was sitting and noticed as if not a single date had been taken thereof
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ansari bataate hain: Mere waalid Uhud ki jung ke din shaheed hue aur unhone chhah betiyaan aur kuch qarz chhoda. Jab khajoor katne ka waqt aaya, main Allah ke Rasool ke paas gaya aur kaha: "Ya Allah ke Apostle! Aapko pata hai mere waalid Uhud ki jung mein shaheed hue aur unpar bahut zyada qarz tha, aur main chahta hoon ke qarz-daaron ki aap se mulaqaat ho." Nabi ne kaha: "Jaao aur alag-alag qismon ki khajoor jama karke unhe alag-alag dheri mein rakho." Maine aisa kiya aur unhe bulwaya. Unhe dekhkar, qarz-daaron ne us waqt zor se apna haqq maangna shuru kiya. Jab Nabi ne unka yeh rawaiya dekha, woh sabse bade dher ke gird teen baar ghume aur uske oopar baith gaye aur kaha: "Apne saathiyon (yaani qarz-daaron) ko bulwao." Phir Aap naapte aur unhe dete rahe jab tak Allah ne mere waalid ke sab qarz ada kar diye. Allah ki qasam, mujhe khushi hoti agar Allah mere waalid ke qarz ada kar deta chahe main apni behnon ke liye ek bhi khajoor na leta. Magar Allah ki qasam, sab dher poore reh gaye (jaisa woh the), aur maine jahan Allah ke Rasool baithe the woh dher dekha, aur lagta tha jaise usme se ek bhi khajoor nahi li gayi thi.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Masud:I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What is the best deed?" He replied, "To offer the prayers at their early stated fixed times." I asked, "What is next in goodness?" He replied, "To be good and dutiful to your parents." I further asked, what is next in goodness?" He replied, "To participate in Jihad in Allah's Cause." I did not ask Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) anymore and if I had asked him more, he would have told me more
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Masud bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool se pucha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Sabse behtareen amal kya hai?" Aap ne jawab diya: "Namaz apne muqarrar waqt par padhna." Maine pucha: "Iske baad kaunsa neik amal hai?" Aap ne jawab diya: "Apne maa-baap se achha suluk rakhna." Maine phir pucha: "Iske baad kaunsa neik amal hai?" Aap ne jawab diya: "Allah ki raah mein Jihad karna." Maine Allah ke Rasool se aur nahi pucha, aur agar main aur puchta, woh mujhe aur batate.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "There is no Hijra (i.e. migration) (from Mecca to Medina) after the Conquest (of Mecca), but Jihad and good intention remain; and if you are called (by the Muslim ruler) for fighting, go forth immediately
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Fatah (Mecca) ke baad koi Hijra (yaani Mecca se Madina hijrat) nahi rahi, magar Jihad aur achhi niyyat baaaki hai; aur agar tumhe (Musalman hukmaran dwaara) jung ke liye bulaya jaaye, foran nikal pado."

e: Narrated `Aisha:(That she said), "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We consider Jihad as the best deed. Should we not fight in Allah's Cause?" He said, "The best Jihad (for women) is Hajj-Mabrur (i.e. Hajj which is done according to the Prophet's tradition and is accepted by Allah)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Hum Jihad ko sabse behtareen amal samajhte hain. Kya humein Allah ki raah mein jung nahi karni chahiye?" Aap ne kaha: "(Auraton ke liye) sabse behtareen Jihad Hajj-e-Mabrur hai (yaani Hajj jo Nabi ki sunnat ke mutabiq kiya jaaye aur jise Allah qubool kar le)."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:A man came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "Instruct me as to such a deed as equals Jihad (in reward)." He replied, "I do not find such a deed." Then he added, "Can you, while the Muslim fighter is in the battle-field, enter your mosque to perform prayers without cease and fast and never break your fast?" The man said, "But who can do that?" Abu Huraira added, "The Mujahid (i.e. Muslim fighter) is rewarded even for the footsteps of his horse while it wanders about (for grazing) tied in a long rope
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks Allah ke Rasool ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Mujhe koi aisa amal bataiye jo Jihad ke barabar (ajr mein) ho." Aap ne jawab diya: "Mujhe aisa koi amal nahi miltaa." Phir Aap ne joda: "Kya tum, jabke Musalman fauji maidan-e-jung mein hai, apni masjid mein daakhil hokar bina ruke namaz padh sakte ho aur roza rakh sakte ho bina kabhi tore?" Shaks ne kaha: "Yeh kaun kar sakta hai?" Abu Huraira ne joda: "Mujahid (yaani Musalman fauji) ko uske ghode ke un kadmon ka bhi ajr milta hai jo woh ek lambi rassi se baandhe hue ghumte huye (charte huye) leta hai."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Somebody asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Who is the best among the people?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied "A believer who strives his utmost in Allah's Cause with his life and property." They asked, "Who is next?" He replied, "A believer who stays in one of the mountain paths worshipping Allah and leaving the people secure from his mischief
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Kisi ne pucha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Logon mein sabse behtareen kaun hai?" Allah ke Rasool ne jawab diya: "Woh momin jo apni jaan aur maal se Allah ki raah mein poori mehnat karta hai." Unhone pucha: "Iske baad kaun?" Aap ne jawab diya: "Woh momin jo kisi pahad ki wadi mein rehte huye Allah ki ibadat karta hai aur logon ko apni buraee se mehfooz rakhtaa hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "The example of a Mujahid in Allah's Cause-- and Allah knows better who really strives in His Cause----is like a person who fasts and prays continuously. Allah guarantees that He will admit the Mujahid in His Cause into Paradise if he is killed, otherwise He will return him to his home safely with rewards and war booty
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool ko kehte suna: "Allah ki raah mein Mujahid ki misaal — aur Allah behtar jaanta hai kaun sach mein uski raah mein koshish karta hai — us shaks jaisi hai jo lagatar roza rakhta aur namaz padhta hai. Allah ki zimmedaari hai ke woh Mujahid ko, agar woh maara jaaye, Jannat mein daakhil kare, warna use ajr aur maal-e-ghanimat ke saath apne ghar mahfooz wapas bhej de."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to visit Umm Haram bint Milhan, who would offer him meals. Umm Haram was the wife of Ubada bin As-Samit. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), once visited her and she provided him with food and started looking for lice in his head. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) slept, and afterwards woke up smiling. Umm Haram asked, "What causes you to smile, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" He said. "Some of my followers who (in a dream) were presented before me as fighters in Allah's cause (on board a ship) amidst this sea caused me to smile; they were as kings on the thrones (or like kings on the thrones)." (Ishaq, a sub-narrator is not sure as to which expression the Prophet (ﷺ) used.) Umm Haram said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Invoke Allah that he makes me one of them. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) invoked Allah for her and slept again and woke up smiling. Once again Umm Haram asked, "What makes you smile, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" He replied, "Some of my followers were presented to me as fighters in Allah's Cause," repeating the same dream. Umm Haram said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Invoke Allah that He makes me one of them." He said, "You are amongst the first ones." It happened that she sailed on the sea during the Caliphate of Mu'awiya bin Abi Sufyan, and after she disembarked, she fell down from her riding animal and died
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool Um Haram bint Milhaan ke paas jate the, jo unhe khaana khilaati. Um Haram Ubada bin As-Samit ki biwi thi. Ek baar Allah ke Rasool unke paas gaye aur usne unhe khaana diya aur unke sar mein jooen dhoondne lagi. Phir Allah ke Rasool sote gaye aur baad mein muskurate huye jaage. Um Haram ne pucha: "Aapko kis baat par muskuraahat aayi, Ya Allah ke Rasool?" Aap ne kaha: "Mere kuch pairokaar, jinhe khwab mein mujhe Allah ki raah mein fauji ke tor par (ek kashti mein) is samundar mein pesh kiya gaya, unhone mujhe muskuraaya; woh raajaon jaise takht par baithe the (ya raajaon jaise)." (Ishaq, doosre raawi ko yaqeen nahi Nabi ne kaunsa alfaaz istemal kiya.) Um Haram ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Allah se dua kijiye ke woh mujhe unme se ek banaye." Allah ke Rasool ne unke liye Allah se dua ki aur phir se soye aur muskurate huye jaage. Um Haram ne phir pucha: "Aapko kis baat par muskuraahat aayi, Ya Allah ke Rasool?" Aap ne jawab diya: "Mere kuch pairokaar mujhe Allah ki raah mein fauji ke tor par pesh kiye gaye," wahi khwab doharate huye. Um Haram ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Allah se dua kijiye ke woh mujhe unme se ek banaye." Aap ne kaha: "Tum pehle logon mein se ho." Baad mein aisa hua ke woh Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki khilafat ke dauran samundar mein safar par nikli, aur jab woh utrti, apni sawari se gir gaee aur intiqal ho gaya.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever believes in Allah and His Apostle, offers prayer perfectly and fasts the month of Ramadan, will rightfully be granted Paradise by Allah, no matter whether he fights in Allah's Cause or remains in the land where he is born." The people said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ! Shall we acquaint the people with this good news?" He said, "Paradise has one-hundred grades which Allah has reserved for the Mujahidin who fight in His Cause, and the distance between each of two grades is like the distance between the Heaven and the Earth. So, when you ask Allah (for something), ask for Al-firdaus which is the best and highest part of Paradise." (The sub-narrator added, "I think the Prophet also said, 'Above it (i.e. Al-Firdaus) is the Throne of Beneficent (i.e. Allah), and from it originate the rivers of Paradise
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jo bhi Allah aur uske Rasool par iman rakhe, namaz mukammal padhe, aur Ramadan ke roze rakhe, Allah use haqq se Jannat dega, chahe woh Allah ki raah mein jung kare ya apni janamsthaan (paidaish ki jagah) mein hi rahe." Logon ne pucha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Kya hum logon ko yeh khushkhabri bataye?" Aap ne kaha: "Jannat mein sau darje hain jo Allah ne Mujahideen ke liye taiyaar kiye hain jo uski raah mein jung karte hain, aur do darjon ke beech ki doori aasman aur zameen ke beech ki doori jaisi hai. Isliye jab tum Allah se kuch maango, Al-Firdaus maango jo Jannat ka sabse behtareen aur oonchaa hissa hai." (Doosre raawi ne joda: "Mujhe lagta hai Nabi ne yeh bhi kaha, 'Uske oopar Rahman (Allah) ka Arsh hai, aur usse Jannat ki nadiyaan nikalti hain.'")

e: Narrated Samura:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Last night two men came to me (in a dream) and made me ascend a tree and then admitted me into a better and superior house, better of which I have never seen. One of them said, 'This house is the house of martyrs
hi: Samura bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha: "Kal raat do log mere paas aaye (khwab mein) aur mujhe ek darakht par chadhaaya aur phir mujhe ek behtareen aur behtareen ghar mein daakhil kiya, jaisa maine kabhi nahi dekha. Unme se ek ne kaha, 'Yeh shuhado ka ghar hai.'"

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A single endeavor (of fighting) in Allah's Cause in the forenoon or in the afternoon is better than the world and whatever is in it
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Allah ki raah mein subah ya shaam ki ek koshish (jung ki) duniya aur usme jo kuch hai usse behtar hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A place in Paradise as small as a bow is better than all that on which the sun rises and sets (i.e. all the world)." He also said, "A single endeavor in Allah's Cause in the afternoon or in the forenoon is better than all that on which the sun rises and sets
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jannat mein ek dhanush jitni jagah bhi us saari duniya se behtar hai jispar suraj ugta aur doobta hai (yaani poori duniya)." Aap ne yeh bhi kaha: "Allah ki raah mein shaam ya subah ki ek koshish (jung ki) poori duniya se behtar hai jispar suraj ugta aur doobta hai."

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A single endeavor in Allah's Cause in the afternoon and in the forenoon is better than the world and whatever is in it
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Allah ki raah mein shaam aur subah ki ek koshish (jung ki) duniya aur usme jo kuch hai usse behtar hai."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Nobody who dies and finds good from Allah (in the Hereafter) would wish to come back to this world even if he were given the whole world and whatever is in it, except the martyr who, on seeing the superiority of martyrdom, would like to come back to the world and get killed again (in Allah's Cause)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Koi bhi shaks jo mar jaaye aur Allah ke paas achhaee paae (Aakhirat mein), duniya mein wapas aana pasand nahi karega chahe use poori duniya aur usme jo kuch hai de diya jaaye, siwaye shaheed ke, jo shahaadat ki behtareen fazIlat dekhkar duniya mein wapas aana chahega aur (Allah ki raah mein) dobara maara jaana chahega."

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A single endeavor (of fighting) in Allah's Cause in the afternoon or in the forenoon is better than all the world and whatever is in it. A place in Paradise as small as the bow or lash of one of you is better than all the world and whatever is in it. And if a houri from Paradise appeared to the people of the earth, she would fill the space between Heaven and the Earth with light and pleasant scent and her head cover is better than the world and whatever is in it
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Allah ki raah mein shaam ya subah ki ek koshish (jung ki) poori duniya aur usme jo kuch hai usse behtar hai. Jannat mein tum mein se kisi ke dhanush ya chaabuk jitni jagah bhi poori duniya aur usme jo kuch hai usse behtar hai. Aur agar Jannat ki ek hoor (khoobsurat aurat) duniya walon ke saamne zaahir ho jaaye, woh aasman aur zameen ke darmiyan ki jagah ko roshni aur khushbu se bhar degi, aur uska sar-dhakan poori duniya aur usme jo kuch hai usse behtar hoga."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "By Him in Whose Hands my life is! Were it not for some men amongst the believers who dislike to be left behind me and whom I cannot provide with means of conveyance, I would certainly never remain behind any Sariya' (army-unit) setting out in Allah's Cause. By Him in Whose Hands my life is! I would love to be martyred in Allah's Cause and then get resurrected and then get martyred, and then get resurrected again and then get martyred and then get resurrected again and then get martyred
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Us zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri zindagi hai! Agar kuch momin aise na hote jinhe mere peeche na jaane ka bura lagta aur jinhe main sawari ka saaz-o-saaman nahi de sakta, main kabhi kisi Sariya (fauji daste) ke peeche nahi rehta jo Allah ki raah mein nikle. Us zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri zindagi hai! Mujhe pasand hoga ke main Allah ki raah mein shaheed ho jaoon, phir zinda kiya jaoon, phir shaheed ho jaoon, phir zinda kiya jaoon, phir shaheed ho jaoon."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) delivered a sermon and said, "Zaid took the flag and was martyred, and then Ja`far took the flag and was martyred, and then `Abdullah bin Rawaha took the flag and was martyred too, and then Khalid bin Al-Walid took the flag though he was not appointed as a commander and Allah made him victorious." The Prophet (ﷺ) further added, "It would not please us to have them with us." Aiyub, a sub-narrator, added, "Or the Prophet, shedding tears, said, 'It would not please them to be with us
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne khutba diya aur kaha: "Zaid ne jhandaa liya aur shaheed hue, phir Ja'far ne jhanda liya aur shaheed hue, phir Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Rawaha ne jhanda liya aur woh bhi shaheed hue, phir Khalid bin Al-Walid ne jhanda liya chahe unhe sardaaar muqarrar nahi kiya gaya tha, aur Allah ne unhe fatah di." Nabi ne aage kaha: "Humein achha nahi lagega agar woh humare saath (is duniya mein) hote." Aiyub, doosre raawi, ne joda: "Ya Nabi ne, aansu bahate huye, kaha: 'Unhe humare saath rehna pasand nahi aata.'"

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Um Haram said, "Once the Prophet (ﷺ) slept in my house near to me and got up smiling. I said, 'What makes you smile?' He replied, 'Some of my followers who (i.e. in a dream) were presented to me sailing on this green sea like kings on thrones.' I said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Invoke Allah to make me one of them." So the Prophet (ﷺ) invoked Allah for her and went to sleep again. He did the same (i.e. got up and told his dream) and Um Haram repeated her question and he gave the same reply. She said, "Invoke Allah to make me one of them." He said, "You are among the first batch." Later on it happened that she went out in the company of her husband 'Ubada bin As-Samit who went for Jihad and it was the first time the Muslims undertook a naval expedition led by Mu'awiya. When the expedition came to an end and they were returning to Sham, a riding animal was presented to her to ride, but the animal let her fall and thus she died
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Um Haram ne kaha: "Ek baar Nabi mere ghar mein mere qareeb soye aur muskurate huye uthe. Maine pucha, 'Aapko kis baat par muskuraahat aayi?' Aap ne jawab diya, 'Mere kuch pairokaaar jinhe (khwab mein) mujhe pesh kiya gaya, is hare samundar mein jahaaaj par safar karte huye, raajaon jaise takht par baithe.' Maine kaha, 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Allah se dua kijiye ke woh mujhe unme se ek banaye.'" Isliye Nabi ne unke liye Allah se dua ki aur phir se soye. Unhone wahi kiya (yaani jaage aur apna khwab bataya) aur Um Haram ne apna sawaal doharaya aur unhone wahi jawab diya. Unhone kaha, "Allah se dua kijiye ke woh mujhe unme se ek banaye." Aap ne kaha, "Tum pehli toli mein se ho." Baad mein aisa hua ke woh apne shohar Ubada bin As-Samit ke saath nikli jo Jihad ke liye gaye, aur yeh Musalmanon ki pahli samundari jung thi jiski agwaee Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) kar rahe the. Jab yeh jung khatam hui aur woh Sham wapas ja rahe the, unhe sawari ke liye ek janwar diya gaya, magar janwar ne unhe gira diya aur unka intiqal ho gaya.

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) sent seventy men from the tribe of Bani Sulaim to the tribe of Bani Amir. When they reached there, my maternal uncle said to them, "I will go ahead of you, and if they allow me to convey the message of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (it will be all right); otherwise you will remain close to me." So he went ahead of them and the pagans granted him security But while he was reporting the message of the Prophet (ﷺ) , they beckoned to one of their men who stabbed him to death. My maternal uncle said, "Allah is Greater! By the Lord of the Ka`ba, I am successful." After that they attacked the rest of the party and killed them all except a lame man who went up to the top of the mountain. (Hammam, a sub-narrator said, "I think another man was saved along with him)." Gabriel informed the Prophet (ﷺ) that they (i.e the martyrs) met their Lord, and He was pleased with them and made them pleased. We used to recite, "Inform our people that we have met our Lord, He is pleased with us and He has made us pleased " Later on this Qur'anic Verse was cancelled. The Prophet (ﷺ) invoked Allah for forty days to curse the murderers from the tribe of Ral, Dhakwan, Bani Lihyan and Bani Usaiya who disobeyed Allah and his Apostle
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Bani Sulaim qabile se sattar log Bani Amir qabile ke paas bheje. Jab woh wahan pahunche, mere mama ke bhai ne unse kaha: "Main tumse aage jata hoon, aur agar woh mujhe Allah ke Rasool ka sandesh pahunchane denge (to theek hai); warna tum mere qareeb raho." Isliye woh unse aage gaye aur mushrikon ne unhe mahfooz hone ka waada diya. Magar jabke woh Nabi ka sandesh de rahe the, unhone apne ek shaks ko ishara se bulaya jisne unhe chupkar maar diya. Mere mama ke bhai ne kaha: "Allah sabse bada hai! Ka'ba ke Rab ki qasam, main kaamyaab ho gaya." Iske baad unhone baaki logon par hamla kiya aur ek langde shaks ke siwaa sab qatl kar diye jo pahad ki chotti par chadh gaya. (Hammam, doosre raawi ne kaha: "Mujhe lagta hai ek aur shaks bhi unke saath bach gaya tha.") Jibreel ne Nabi ko bataya ke woh (yaani shuhada) apne Rab se mile, aur Allah unse khush tha aur usne unhe khush kiya. Hum yeh padhte the: "Humari qaum ko batao ke hum apne Rab se mil chuke hain, woh humse khush hai aur usne humein khush kiya hai." Baad mein yeh Quranic Ayat mansookh ho gayi. Nabi ne chaalis din tak Allah se dua ki ke woh Ral, Dhakwan, Bani Lihyan aur Bani Usaiya qabilon ke qaatilon par laanat bheje jinhone Allah aur uske Rasool ki na-farmani ki thi.

e: Narrated Jundab bin Sufyan:In one of the holy Battles a finger of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (got wounded and) bled. He said, "You are just a finger that bled, and what you got is in Allah's Cause
hi: Jundab bin Sufyan bataate hain: Ek muqaddas jung mein, Allah ke Rasool ki ek ungli (zakhmi hokar) khoon bahane lagi. Aap ne kaha: "Tum sirf ek ungli ho jo khoon bahati hai, aur jo tumhe hua woh Allah ki raah mein hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "By Him in Whose Hands my soul is! Whoever is wounded in Allah's Cause....and Allah knows well who gets wounded in His Cause....will come on the Day of Resurrection with his wound having the color of blood but the scent of musk
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Us zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri rooh hai! Jo koi Allah ki raah mein zakhmi hota hai — aur Allah behtar jaanta hai kaun uski raah mein zakhmi hota hai — woh Qiyamat ke din is haal mein aayega ke uska zakhm khoon ke rang ka hoga magar kastoori ki khushbu wala."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abbas:That Abu Sufyan told him that Heraclius said to him, "I asked you about the outcome of your battles with him (i.e. the Prophet (ﷺ) ) and you told me that you fought each other with alternate success. So the Apostles are tested in this way but the ultimate victory is always theirs
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne unhe bataya ke Heraclius ne unse kaha: "Maine tumse tumhari (Nabi ke saath) jungon ke natijon ke baare mein pucha aur tumne mujhe bataya ke tum baari-baari jeete aur haare. Isi tarah Rasoolo (Nabi log) aazmaaaye jate hain magar aakhri fatah hamesha unhi ki hoti hai."

e: Narrated Anas:My uncle Anas bin An-Nadr was absent from the Battle of Badr. He said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I was absent from the first battle you fought against the pagans. (By Allah) if Allah gives me a chance to fight the pagans, no doubt. Allah will see how (bravely) I will fight." On the day of Uhud when the Muslims turned their backs and fled, he said, "O Allah! I apologize to You for what these (i.e. his companions) have done, and I denounce what these (i.e. the pagans) have done." Then he advanced and Sa`d bin Mu`adh met him. He said "O Sa`d bin Mu`adh ! By the Lord of An-Nadr, Paradise! I am smelling its aroma coming from before (the mountain of) Uhud," Later on Sa`d said, "O Allah's Apostle! I cannot achieve or do what he (i.e. Anas bin An-Nadr) did. We found more than eighty wounds by swords and arrows on his body. We found him dead and his body was mutilated so badly that none except his sister could recognize him by his fingers." We used to think that the following Verse was revealed concerning him and other men of his sort: "Among the believers are men who have been true to their covenant with Allah.........." (33.23) His sister Ar-Rubbaya' broke a front tooth of a woman and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered for retaliation. On that Anas (bin An-Nadr) said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! By Him Who has sent you with the Truth, my sister's tooth shall not be broken." Then the opponents of Anas's sister accepted the compensation and gave up the claim of retaliation. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "There are some people amongst Allah's slaves whose oaths are fulfilled by Allah when they take them
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Mere chacha Anas bin An-Nadr Badr ki jung mein maujood nahi the. Unhone kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Main us pehli jung mein maujood nahi tha jo aapne mushrikon ke khilaf ladi. (Allah ki qasam) agar Allah mujhe mushrikon se jung karne ka mauka de, Allah zaroor dekhega main kitni bahaduri se jung karta hoon." Uhud ki jung ke din, jab Musalman peeche hatne lage, unhone kaha: "Aye Allah! Main tujhse un logon (yaani apne saathiyon) ke kiye ka maafinaama maangta hoon, aur main un logon (yaani mushrikon) ke kiye se khud ko alag karta hoon." Phir woh aage badhe aur Sa'd bin Mu'adh unse mile. Unhone kaha: "Aye Sa'd bin Mu'adh! An-Nadr ke Rab ki qasam, Jannat! Main iski khushbu Uhud (pahad) ke saamne se mahsoos kar raha hoon." Baad mein Sa'd ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Main woh nahi kar sakta jo unhone (Anas bin An-Nadr) kiya." Humein unke jism par talwaron aur teeron ke assi se zyada zakhm mile. Hum unhe murda paaye aur unka jism itna vikrit tha ke sirf unki behn hi unhe unki ungliyon se pehchaan sakin. Hum sochte the ke yeh ayat unke aur unke jaise doosre logon ke baare mein nazil hui: "Momino mein aise log hain jinhone Allah se kiya apna ahad sach kiya hai..." (33:23). Unki behn Ar-Rubbaya ne ek aurat ka agla daant tod diya tha aur Allah ke Rasool ne badla lene ka hukum diya. Isspar Anas (bin An-Nadr) ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Us zaat ki qasam jisne aapko haqq ke saath bheja, meri behn ka daant nahi toda jaayega." Phir Anas ki behn ke muqabil logon ne mua'wza qubool kiya aur badla lene ka daava chhod diya. Isliye Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: "Allah ke kuch bande aise hain jinki qasmen Allah poori kar deta hai jab woh unhe lete hain."

e: Narrated Kharija bin Zaid:Zaid bin Thabit said, "When the Qur'an was compiled from various written manuscripts, one of the Verses of Surat Al-Ahzab was missing which I used to hear Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) reciting. I could not find it except with Khuza`ima bin Thabit Al-Ansari, whose witness Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) regarded as equal to the witness of two men. And the Verse was:-- "Among the believers are men who have been true to what they covenanted with Allah
hi: Kharija bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Zaid bin Thabit (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Jab Quran ko alag-alag likhe hue hastlikhon se jama kiya jata tha, Surah Al-Ahzab ki ek Ayat kho gayi thi jise main Allah ke Rasool ko padhte suna karta tha. Mujhe woh sirf Khuzaima bin Thabit Al-Ansari ke paas mili, jinki gawahi Allah ke Rasool do logon ki gawahi ke barabar maante the. Aur woh Ayat yeh thi: 'Momino mein aise log hain jinhone Allah se kiya apna ahad sach kiya hai...'"

e: Narrated Al-Bara:A man whose face was covered with an iron mask (i.e. clad in armor) came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shall I fight or embrace Islam first? "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Embrace Islam first and then fight." So he embraced Islam, and was martyred. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, A Little work, but a great reward. "(He did very little (after embracing Islam), but he will be rewarded in abundance
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Ek shaks jiska chehra lohe ke naqab (yaani zire) se dhaka hua tha, Nabi ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Kya pehle main jung karun ya Islam qubool karun?" Nabi ne kaha: "Pehle Islam qubool karo, phir jung karo." Isliye usne Islam qubool kiya aur shaheed ho gaya. Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: "Thoda kaam, magar bada ajr." (Usne bahut kam kiya, magar use bahut zyada ajr milega.)

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Um Ar-Rubai' bint Al-Bara', the mother of Haritha bin Suraqa came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Prophet! Will you tell me about Haritha?" Haritha had been killed (i.e. martyred) on the day of Badr with an arrow thrown by an unidentified person. She added, "If he is in Paradise, I will be patient; otherwise, I will weep bitterly for him." He said, "O mother of Haritha! There are Gardens in Paradise and your son got the Firdaus al-ala (i.e. the best place in Paradise)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Um Ar-Rubai bint Al-Bara, Haritha bin Suraqa ki maa, Nabi ke paas aaeen aur kaha: "Aye Allah ke Nabi! Kya aap mujhe Haritha ke baare mein bataenge?" Haritha Badr ki jung ke din shaheed hue the, ek anjaan teer se. Unhone joda: "Agar woh Jannat mein hain, main sabr karungi; warna, main unke liye zor se roungi." Nabi ne kaha: "Aye Haritha ki maa! Jannat mein bahut sare baag hain aur tumhare bete ne Firdaus-al-A'la (Jannat ki sabse behtareen jagah) paee hai."

e: Narrated Abu Musa:A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and asked, "A man fights for war booty; another fights for fame and a third fights for showing off; which of them fights in Allah's Cause?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who fights that Allah's Word (i.e. Islam) should be superior, fights in Allah's Cause
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks Nabi ke paas aaya aur pucha: "Ek shaks maal-e-ghanimat ke liye jung karta hai; doosra naam ke liye; teesra dikhaave ke liye; inme se kaun Allah ki raah mein jung karta hai?" Nabi ne kaha: "Jo bhi is niyyat se jung kare ke Allah ka kalima buland ho (yaani Islam ki fatah), woh Allah ki raah mein jung karta hai."

e: Narrated Abu `Abs:(who is `Abdur-Rahman bin Jabir) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said," Anyone whose both feet get covered with dust in Allah's Cause will not be touched by the (Hell) fire
hi: Abu Abs (Abdur-Rahman bin Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ)) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: "Jiske donon paon Allah ki raah mein dhool se dhake ho jaayen, use Dozakh ki aag nahi chhuegi."

e: Narrated `Ikrima:that Ibn `Abbas told him and `Ali bin `Abdullah to go to Abu Sa`id and listen to some of his narrations; So they both went (and saw) Abu Sa`id and his brother irrigating a garden belonging to them. When he saw them, he came up to them and sat down with his legs drawn up and wrapped in his garment and said, "(During the construction of the mosque of the Prophet) we carried the adobe of the mosque, one brick at a time while `Ammar used to carry two at a time. The Prophet (ﷺ) passed by `Ammar and removed the dust off his head and said, "May Allah be merciful to `Ammar. He will be killed by a rebellious aggressive group. `Ammar will invite them to (obey) Allah and they will invite him to the (Hell) fire
hi: Ikrima bataate hain: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne unhe aur Ali (Alayhis Salam) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko Abu Saeed ke paas jaane aur unki kuch riwaayaten sunne ko kaha. Isliye donon Abu Saeed ke paas gaye (aur dekha) unhe aur unke bhai ko apne baag ki sinchaee karte huye. Jab unhone unhe dekha, woh unke paas aaye aur apni taangen samete aur apne kapde mein lipetkar baith gaye, aur kaha: "(Nabi ki masjid banate waqt) hum masjid ke liye mitti ki eenten ek-ek karke dhote the jabke Ammar (رضی اللہ عنہ) do-do dhote the. Nabi Ammar ke paas se guzre aur unke sar se dhool hataee aur kaha: 'Allah Ammar par reham kare. Use ek baagi aur aakramak giroh maar dega. Ammar unhe Allah (ki itaaat) ki taraf bulaega, aur woh use Dozakh ki taraf bulaenge.'"

e: Narrated `Aisha:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) returned on the day (of the battle) of Al-Khandaq (i.e. Trench), he put down his arms and took a bath. Then Gabriel whose head was covered with dust, came to him saying, "You have put down your arms! By Allah, I have not put down my arms yet." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Where (to go now)?" Gabriel said, "This way," pointing towards the tribe of Bani Quraiza. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went out towards them
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool Al-Khandaq (Khandaq) ki jung ke din wapas aaye, unhone apne hathiyaar rakhe aur ghusl kiya. Phir Jibreel, jinka sar dhool se dhaka hua tha, unke paas aaye aur kaha: "Aapne apne hathiyaar rakh diye! Allah ki qasam, maine abhi tak apne hathiyaar nahi rakhe." Allah ke Rasool ne pucha: "Kahan (ab janaa hai)?" Jibreel ne kaha: "Is taraf," Bani Quraiza qabile ki taraf ishara karte huye. Isliye Allah ke Rasool unki taraf nikle.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:For thirty days Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) invoked Allah to curse those who had killed the companions of Bir- Mauna; he invoked evil upon the tribes of Ral, Dhakwan, and Usaiya who disobeyed Allah and His Apostle. There was revealed about those who were killed at Bir-Mauna a Qur'anic Verse we used to recite, but it was cancelled later on. The Verse was: "Inform our people that we have met our Lord. He is pleased with us and He has made us pleased
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Teen din tak, Allah ke Rasool ne Allah se dua ki ke woh un logon par laanat bheje jinhone Bir-Mauna ke sahaba ko qatl kiya tha; unhone Ral, Dhakwan, aur Usaiya qabilon par bad-dua ki jinhone Allah aur uske Rasool ki na-farmani ki thi. Bir-Mauna mein shaheed hue logon ke baare mein ek Quranic Ayat nazil hui jise hum padhte the, magar baad mein woh mansookh ho gayi. Woh Ayat thi: "Humari qaum ko batao ke hum apne Rab se mil chuke hain, woh humse khush hai aur usne humein khush kiya hai."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:"Some people drank alcohol in the morning of the day (of the battle) of Uhud and were martyred (on the same day)." Sufyan was asked, "(Were they martyred) in the last part of the day?)" He replied, "Such information does not occur in the narration
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Kuch logon ne Uhud ki jung ke din subah sharaab pi aur usi din shaheed hue." Sufyan se pucha gaya: "(Kya woh shaheed hue) din ke aakhri hisse mein?" Unhone jawab diya: "Riwaayat mein aisi koi jaankaari nahi."

e: Narrated Jabir:My father's mutilated body was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) and was placed in front of him. I went to uncover his face but my companions forbade me. Then mourning cries of a lady were heard, and it was said that she was either the daughter or the sister of `Amr. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Why is she crying?" Or said, "Do not cry, for the angels are still shading him with their wings." (Al-Bukhari asked Sadaqa, a sub-narrator, "Does the narration include the expression: 'Till he was lifted?' " The latter replied, "Jabir may have said it)
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Mere waalid ka vikrit shariir Nabi ke paas laaya gaya aur unke saamne rakha gaya. Main unka chehra kholne gaya magar mere saathiyon ne mujhe roka. Phir ek aurat ki rone ki aawaaz sunaee dee, aur bataya gaya ke woh Amr ki beti ya behn thi. Nabi ne kaha: "Woh kyun ro rahi hai?" Ya kaha: "Mat roo, kyunke farishte abhi bhi unhe apne paron se chhaaya de rahe hain." (Al-Bukhari ne Sadaqa, doosre raawi se pucha: "Kya riwaayat mein yeh alfaaz hain: 'Jab tak unhe uthaya nahi gaya?'" Unhone jawab diya: "Jabir ne shayad aisa kaha ho.")

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Nobody who enters Paradise likes to go back to the world even if he got everything on the earth, except a Mujahid who wishes to return to the world so that he may be martyred ten times because of the dignity he receives (from Allah)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jannat mein daakhil hone wala koi bhi shaks duniya mein wapas jaana pasand nahi karta, chahe use zameen ki har cheez de di jaaye, siwaye Mujahid ke jo duniya mein wapas jaana chahega taake woh das baar shaheed ho sake, us izzat ki wajah se jo use (Allah se) milti hai."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abi `Aufa:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Know that Paradise is under the shades of swords
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abu Aufa bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jaan lo ke Jannat talwaron ke saaye ke neeche hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Once Solomon, son of David said, '(By Allah) Tonight I will have sexual intercourse with one hundred (or ninety-nine) women each of whom will give birth to a knight who will fight in Allah's Cause.' On that, a companion (angel) said to him, "(Say) Allah willing", but he did not say, "Allah willing." Therefore only one of those women conceived and gave birth to a half-man. By Him in Whose Hands Muhammad's life is, if he had said, "Allah willing', (he would have begotten sons) all of whom would have been knights striving in Allah's Cause
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Ek baar Sulaiman, Dawud ke bete, ne kaha, '(Allah ki qasam) Aaj raat main sau (ya ninyaanve) auraton ke saath humbistari karunga, aur unme se har ek ek ghudsawaar ko janam degi jo Allah ki raah mein jung karega.' Isspar ek saathi (farishte) ne unse kaha, '(Kaho) Insha Allah,' magar unhone 'Insha Allah' nahi kaha. Isliye unme se sirf ek aurat ne garbh dhaaran kiya aur ek adhoore mard ko janam diya. Us zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein Muhammad ki zindagi hai, agar unhone 'Insha Allah' kaha hota, (unke sab bete) ghudsawaar hote jo Allah ki raah mein koshish karte."

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) was the best, the bravest and the most generous of all the people. Once when the people of Medina got frightened, the Prophet (ﷺ) rode a horse and went ahead of them and said, "We found this horse very fast
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi sab logon mein sabse behtar, sabse bahadur, aur sabse zyada daani the. Ek baar jab Madina ke log dar gaye, Nabi ne ek ghoda par sawar hokar unse aage nikle aur kaha: "Humne yeh ghoda bahut tez paya."

e: Narrated Muhammad bin Jubair:Jubair bin Mut`im told me that while he was in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with the people returning from Hunain, some people (bedouins) caught hold of the Prophet (ﷺ) and started begging of him so much so that he had to stand under a (kind of thorny tree (i.e. Samurah) and his cloak was snatched away. The Prophet (ﷺ) stopped and said, "Give me my cloak. If I had as many camels as these thorny trees, I would have distributed them amongst you and you will not find me a miser or a liar or a coward
hi: Muhammad bin Jubair bataate hain: Jubair bin Mut'im ne mujhe bataya ke jabke woh Allah ke Rasool ke saath the aur log Hunain se wapas ja rahe the, kuch (dehati) logon ne Nabi ko pakadkar itni bheek maangi ke unhe ek kaantedaar darakht (Samurah) ke neeche khade hone ke liye majboor hona pada aur unka chogha chin liya gaya. Nabi ruke aur kaha: "Mujhe mera chogha do. Agar mere paas itne unt hote jitne yeh kaantedaar darakht hain, main unhe tum mein taqseem kar deta, aur tum mujhe kanjoos, jhootha, ya kayar nahi paate."

e: Narrated `Amr bin Maimun Al-Audi:Sa`d used to teach his sons the following words as a teacher teaches his students the skill of writing and used to say that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to seek Refuge with Allah from them (i.e. the evils) at the end of every prayer. The words are: 'O Allah! I seek refuge with You from cowardice, and seek refuge with You from being brought back to a bad stage of old life and seek refuge with You from the afflictions of the world, and seek refuge with You from the punishments in the grave
hi: Amr bin Maimun Al-Audi bataate hain: Sa'd apne beton ko yeh alfaaz sikhate the jaise koi ustaad apne shagirdon ko likhne ki kala sikhata hai, aur woh kehte the ke Allah ke Rasool har namaz ke aakhir mein in (buraee) se Allah ki panah maangte the. Alfaaz yeh hain: "Aye Allah! Main tujhse kaayarta se panah maangta hoon, aur budape ki bad-haalat mein wapas jaane se panah maangta hoon, aur duniya ke fitnon se panah maangta hoon, aur qabar ki azaab se panah maangta hoon."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to say, "O Allah! I seek refuge with You from helplessness, laziness, cowardice and feeble old age; I seek refuge with You from afflictions of life and death and seek refuge with You from the punishment in the grave
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi kehte the: "Aye Allah! Main tujhse be-basi, aalasya, kaayarta aur kamzor budape se panah maangta hoon; main tujhse zindagi aur maut ke fitnon se panah maangta hoon, aur qabar ki azaab se panah maangta hoon."

e: Narrated As-Sa'-ib bin Yazid:I was in the company of Talha bin 'Ubaidullah, Sa`d, Al-Miqdad bin Al-Aswad and `Abdur Rahman bin `Auf and I heard none of them narrating anything from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) but Talha was talking about the day (of the battle) of Uhud
hi: As-Sa'ib bin Yazid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ubaidullah, Sa'd, Al-Miqdad (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Aswad aur Abdur-Rahman bin Auf ki sohbat mein tha, aur maine unme se kisi ko Allah ke Rasool se koi Hadith riwaayat karte nahi suna, magar Talha Uhud ki jung ke din ke baare mein baat kar rahe the.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:On the day of the Conquest (of Mecca) the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There is no emigration after the Conquest but Jihad and intentions. When you are called (by the Muslim ruler) for fighting, go forth immediately." (See Hadith No)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Fatah (Mecca) ke din, Nabi ne kaha: "Fatah ke baad koi hijrat nahi, magar Jihad aur (achhi) niyyaten (baaki hain). Jab tumhe (Musalman hukmaran dwaara) jung ke liye bulaya jaaye, foran nikal pado." (Hadith No. 2783 dekhen.)

e: Narrated Abu Huraira: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah welcomes two men with a smile; one of whom kills the other and both of them enter Paradise. One fights in Allah's Cause and gets killed. Later on Allah forgives the killer who also gets martyred (in Allah's Cause)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Allah do logon ka muskurate huye istikbaal karta hai; unme se ek doosre ko qatl karta hai aur donon Jannat mein daakhil hote hain. Ek Allah ki raah mein jung karta hai aur maara jata hai. Baad mein Allah qaatil ko maaf kar deta hai jo phir khud bhi (Allah ki raah mein) shaheed ho jata hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira: I went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while he was at Khaibar after it had fallen in the Muslims' hands. I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Give me a share (from the land of Khaibar)." One of the sons of Sa'id bin Al-'As said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Do not give him a share." I said, "This is the murderer of Ibn Qauqal." The son of Sa`id bin Al-As said, "Strange! A Wabr (i.e. guinea pig) who has come down to us from the mountain of Qadum (i.e. grazing place of sheep) blames me for killing a Muslim who was given superiority by Allah because of me, and Allah did not disgrace me at his hands (i.e. was not killed as an infidel)." (The sub-narrator said "I do not know whether the Prophet (ﷺ) gave him a share or not
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Allah ke Rasool ke paas gaya jabke woh Khaibar mein the, Musalmanon ke haath aane ke baad. Maine kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe (Khaibar ki zameen se) hissa dijiye." Sa'id bin Al-As ke beton mein se ek ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Ise hissa mat dijiye." Maine kaha: "Yeh Ibn Qauqal ka qaatil hai." Sa'id bin Al-As ke bete ne kaha: "Ajeeb baat hai! Ek Wabr (guinea pig) jo Qadum pahad se (yaani charaee ki jagah se) humare paas aaya hai, mujhpar ek Musalman ke qatl ka ilzaam lagata hai jise Allah ne mere zariye izzat di, aur Allah ne mujhe uske haathon se rusva nahi kiya (yaani woh kaafir ke tor par maara nahi gaya)." (Doosre raawi ne kaha: "Mujhe nahi pata Nabi ne unhe hissa diya ya nahi.")

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:In the life-time of the Prophet, Abu Talha did not fast because of the Jihad, but after the Prophet (ﷺ) died I never saw him without fasting except on `Id-ul-Fitr and `Id-ul-Adha
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ki zindagi mein, Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) Jihad ki wajah se roza nahi rakhte the, magar Nabi ke intiqal ke baad maine unhe kabhi bina roze ke nahi dekha siwaye Eid-ul-Fitr aur Eid-ul-Adha ke.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Five are regarded as martyrs: They are those who die because of plague, Abdominal disease, drowning or a falling building etc., and the martyrs in Allah's Cause
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Paanch tarah ke log shaheed mane jate hain: woh jo talaee ki bimari se marte hain, pet ki bimari se, doobne se, imaarat ke girne se, aur Allah ki raah mein shaheed hone wale."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Plague is the cause of martyrdom of every Muslim (who dies because of it)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Talaee (plague) har Musalman ke liye shahaadat ka zariya hai (jo iski wajah se marta hai)."

e: Narrated Al-Bara:When the Divine Inspiration: "Those of the believers who sit (at home), was revealed the Prophet (ﷺ) sent for Zaid (bin Thabit) who came with a shoulder-blade and wrote on it. Ibn Um-Maktum complained about his blindness and on that the following revelation came: "Not equal are those believers who sit (at home) except those who are disabled (by injury, or are blind or lame etc.) and those who strive hard and fight in the Way of Allah with their wealth and lives
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Jab Divine Ayat nazil hui: "Woh momin jo (ghar par) baithe rehte hain..." Nabi ne Zaid (bin Thabit) ko bulwaya jo ek kandhe ki haddi laaye aur uspar likha. Ibn Um-Maktum ne apni andhaapan ki shikayat ki, aur isspar yeh wahi nazil hui: "Barabar nahi hain woh momin jo (ghar par) baithe rehte hain, siwaye un ke jo asakt hain (chot ki wajah se, ya andhe ya langde hain) aur woh jo Allah ki raah mein apni jaan-maal se koshish karte hain."

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d As-Sa`idi:I saw Marwan bin Al-Hakam sitting in the Mosque. So I came forward and sat by his side. He told us that Zaid bin Thabit had told him that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had dictated to him the Divine Verse: "Not equal are those believers who sit (at home) and those who strive hard and fight in the Cause of Allah with their wealth and lives.' (4.95) Zaid said, "Ibn Um-Maktum came to the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was dictating to me that very Verse. On that Ibn Um Maktum said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! If I had power, I would surely take part in Jihad." He was a blind man. So Allah sent down revelation to His Apostle while his thigh was on mine and it became so heavy for me that I feared that my thigh would be broken. Then that state of the Prophet (ﷺ) was over after Allah revealed "...except those who are disabled (by injury or are blind or lame etc)
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) As-Sa'idi bataate hain: Maine Marwan bin Al-Hakam ko masjid mein baithe dekha. Isliye main aage aaya aur unke bagal mein baith gaya. Unhone humein bataya ke Zaid bin Thabit (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne unse kaha tha ke Allah ke Rasool ne unhe yeh Divine Ayat bolkar likhwaee: "Barabar nahi hain woh momin jo (ghar par) baithe rehte hain aur woh jo Allah ki raah mein apni jaan-maal se koshish karte hain" (4:95). Zaid ne kaha: "Ibn Um-Maktum Nabi ke paas aaye jabke woh yehi Ayat mujhe bolkar likhwa rahe the. Isspar Ibn Um Maktum ne kaha, 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Agar mujhme taakat hoti, main zaroor Jihad mein shaamil hota.' Woh ek andhe shaks the. Isliye Allah ne apne Rasool par wahi nazil ki jabke unki raan meri raan par thi, aur yeh mere liye itni bhaari ho gayi ke mujhe dar tha meri raan tut jaaegi. Phir Nabi ki yeh haalat khatam hui jab Allah ne yeh nazil ki: '...siwaye un ke jo asakt hain (chot ki wajah se, ya andhe ya langde hain).'"

e: Narrated Salim Abu-An-Nadr:`Abdullah bin Abi `Aufa wrote and I read what he wrote that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When you face them ( i.e. your enemy) then be patient
hi: Salim Abu-An-Nadr bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abu Aufa ne likha aur maine unka likha padha ke Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: "Jab tum unse (yaani apne dushman se) saamna karo, sabr rakho."

e: Narrated Anas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went towards the Khandaq (i.e. Trench) and saw the Emigrants and the Ansar digging in a very cold morning as they did not have slaves to do that for them. When he noticed their fatigue and hunger he said, "O Allah! The real life is that of the Here-after, (so please) forgive the Ansar and the Emigrants." In its reply the Emigrants and the Ansar said, "We are those who have given a pledge of allegiance to Muhammad that we will carry on Jihad as long as we live
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool Al-Khandaq (Trench, khaee) ki taraf gaye aur Muhajireen aur Ansaar ko dekha ek bahut thande subah mein khodte huye, kyunke unke paas iske liye koi gulaam nahi the. Jab unhone unki thakan aur bhookh dekhi, unhone kaha: "Aye Allah! Asli zindagi to Aakhirat ki hai, (isliye kripya) Ansaar aur Muhajireen ko maaf kar de." Iske jawab mein Muhajireen aur Ansaar ne kaha: "Hum woh log hain jinhone Muhammad se bai'at ki hai ke hum jab tak zinda hain Jihad karte rahenge."

e: Narrated Anas:The Emigrants and the Ansar started digging the trench around Medina carrying the earth on their backs and saying, "We are those who have given a pledge of allegiance to Muhammad that we will carry on Jihad as long as we live." The Prophet (ﷺ) kept on replying, "O Allah, there is no good except the good of the Hereafter; so confer Your Blessings on the Ansar and the Emigrants
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Muhajireen aur Ansaar Madina ke gird khaee khodne lage, mitti apni pushton par lekar, aur kehte huye: "Hum woh log hain jinhone Muhammad se bai'at ki hai ke hum jab tak zinda hain Jihad karte rahenge." Nabi baar-baar jawab dete rahe: "Aye Allah, Aakhirat ki bhalaee ke siwa koi bhalaee nahi; isliye Ansaar aur Muhajireen par apni barkat naazil kar."

e: Narrated Al-Bara:The Prophet (ﷺ) went on carrying (i.e. the earth) and saying, "Without You (O Allah!) we would have got no guidance
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Nabi (mitti) uthate rahe aur kehte rahe: "Tere bina (Aye Allah!) humein koi hidayat na milti."

e: Narrated Al-Bara:On the day (of the battle) of Al-Ahzab (i.e. clans) I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) carrying earth, and the earth was covering the whiteness of his `Abdomen. And he was saying, "Without You (O Allah!) we would have got no guidance, nor given in charity, nor prayed. So please bless us with tranquility and make firm our feet when we meet our enemies. Indeed (these) people have rebelled against (oppressed) us but never shall we yield if they try to bring affliction upon us
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Al-Ahzab (qabilon) ki jung ke din, maine Nabi ko mitti uthate dekha, aur mitti unke pet ki safedi chhupaa rahi thi. Aur woh keh rahe the: "Tere bina (Aye Allah!) humein koi hidayat na milti, na hum sadqa dete, na namaz padhte. Isliye humein sukoon de aur jab hum dushman se milen tab humare kadam mazboot kar.
