Beshak (yeh) log humpar zulm karte hain (humpar zaadti karte hain), magar hum kabhi jhukenge nahi agar woh humein museebat mein daalna chahen."

e: Narrated Anas:We returned from the Ghazwa of Tabuk along with the Prophet. (See Hadith No. 92 below)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Ghazwa-e-Tabuk se Nabi ke saath wapas aaye. (Hadith No. 92 dekhen.)

e: Narrated Anas:While the Prophet (ﷺ) was in a Ghazwa he said, "Some people have remained behind us in Medina and we never crossed a mountain path or a valley, but they were with us (i.e. sharing the reward with us), as they have been held back by a (legal) excuse
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jabke Nabi ek Ghazwa mein the, unhone kaha: "Kuch log humare peeche Madina mein reh gaye hain, aur hum koi pahaadi raasta ya wadi paar nahi karte, magar woh humare saath hote hain (yaani humare saath ajr baantte hain), kyunke unhe kisi (jaiz) uzr ne roka hai."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Indeed, anyone who fasts for one day for Allah's Pleasure, Allah will keep his face away from the (Hell) fire for (a distance covered by a journey of) seventy years
hi: Abu Saeed bataate hain: Maine Nabi ko farmate suna: "Jo koi Allah ki khushi ke liye ek din roza rakhta hai, Allah uska chehra Dozakh ki aag se sattar saal (ki doori) tak door rakhega."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever spends two things in Allah's Cause, will be called by all the gate-keepers of Paradise who will be saying, 'O so-and-so! Come here.' " Abu Bakr said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Such persons will never be destroyed." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I hope you will be one of them
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Jo koi Allah ki raah mein do cheezen kharch karta hai, Jannat ke sab darbaan usse pukarenge, 'Aye falaan! Idhar aao.'" Abu Bakr ne kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Aise log kabhi tabaah nahi honge." Nabi ne kaha: "Mujhe ummeed hai tum bhi unme se ek hoge."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ascended the pulpit and said, "Nothing worries me as to what will happen to you after me, except the temptation of worldly blessings which will be conferred on you." Then he mentioned the worldly pleasures. He started with the one (i.e. the blessings) and took up the other (i.e. the pleasures). A man got up saying, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Can the good bring about evil?" The Prophet (ﷺ) remained silent and we thought that he was being inspired divinely, so all the people kept silent with awe. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) wiped the sweat off his face and asked, "Where is the present questioner?" "Do you think wealth is good?" he repeated thrice, adding, "No doubt, good produces nothing but good. Indeed it is like what grows on the banks of a stream which either kills or nearly kills the grazing animals because of gluttony except the vegetation-eating animal which eats till both its flanks are full (i.e. till it gets satisfied) and then stands in the sun and defecates and urinates and again starts grazing. This worldly property is sweet vegetation. How excellent the wealth of the Muslim is, if it is collected through legal means and is spent in Allah's Cause and on orphans, poor people and travelers. But he who does not take it legally is like an eater who is never satisfied and his wealth will be a witness against him on the Day of Resurrection
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool mimbar par chadhe aur kaha: "Mujhe iski koi fikar nahi ke mere baad tumhare saath kya hoga, siwaye duniyawi barkaton ki azmaish ke jo tumhe di jaayengi." Phir unhone duniyawi khushiyon ka zikar kiya. Ek shaks ne khade hokar kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Kya bhalaee buraee la sakti hai?" Nabi khaamosh rahe aur humein laga unpar wahi naazil ho rahi hai, isliye sab log ehteram se khaamosh ho gaye. Phir Nabi ne apne chehre ka paseena ponchha aur pucha: "Sawaal poochhne wala kahan hai?" (unhone joda) "Kya tumhe lagta hai daulat achhi hai?" Unhone yeh teen baar dohraaya, aur joda: "Beshak, bhalaee sirf bhalaee paida karti hai. Yeh usi tarah hai jaise nadi ke kinare uganevali hariyali, jo lalach ki wajah se charne wale janwaron ko maar deti hai ya lagbhag maar deti hai, siwaye us janwar ke jo ghaas khata hai jab tak uske donon pahlu bhar nahi jate (yaani santusht ho jata hai) aur phir suraj mein khade hokar mal-mootra karta hai aur phir se charna shuru karta hai. Yeh duniyawi daulat meethi hariyali jaisi hai. Musalman ka maal kitna behtareen hai agar woh jaiz tareeke se jama kiya jaaye aur Allah ki raah mein, yateemon, gareebon aur musafiron par kharch kiya jaaye. Magar jo ise jaiz tareeke se hasil nahi karta, woh us khaane wale jaisa hai jo kabhi santusht nahi hota, aur uski daulat Qiyamat ke din uske khilaf gawahi degi."

e: Narrated Zaid bin Khalid:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "He who prepares a Ghazi going in Allah's Cause is given a reward equal to that of) a Ghazi; and he who looks after properly the dependents of a Ghazi going in Allah's Cause is (given a reward equal to that of) a Ghazi
hi: Zaid bin Khalid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jo koi Allah ki raah mein jaane wale Ghazi (fauji) ki taiyaari mein madad kare, use bhi Ghazi jitna ajr milta hai; aur jo koi Allah ki raah mein jaane wale Ghazi ke pariwara ki achhi dekhbhal karta hai, use bhi Ghazi jitna ajr milta hai."

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) used not to enter any house in Medina except the house of Um Sulaim besides those of his wives when he was asked why, he said, "I take pity on her as her brother was killed in my company
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi Madina mein apni biwiyon ke ilawa kisi doosre ghar mein daakhil nahi hote the siwaye Um Sulaim ke ghar ke. Jab unse pucha gaya kyun, unhone kaha: "Mujhe unpar reham aata hai, kyunke unka bhai mere saath (jung mein) qatl ho gaya tha."

e: Narrated Ibn `Aun:Once Musa bin Anas while describing the battle of Yamama, said, "Anas bin Malik went to Thabit bin Qais, who had lifted his clothes from his thighs and was applying Hunut to his body. Anas asked, 'O Uncle! What is holding you back (from the battle)?' He replied, 'O my nephew! I am coming just now,' and went on perfuming himself with Hunut, then he came and sat (in the row). Anas then mentioned that the people fled from the battle-field. On that Thabit said, 'Clear the way for me to fight the enemy. We would never do so (i.e. flee) in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). How bad the habits you have acquired from your enemies
hi: Ibn Aun bataate hain: Ek baar Musa bin Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Yamama ki jung ka zikar karte huye kaha: "Anas bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) Thabit bin Qais ke paas gaye, jinhone apne kapde apni raanon se uthaye hue the aur apne jism par Hunut (khushbudaar cheez) lagaa rahe the. Anas ne pucha, 'Aye chacha! Aapko kya rok raha hai (jung mein jaane se)?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Aye mere bhatije! Main abhi aata hoon,' aur Hunut lagate rahe, phir aakar (safon mein) baith gaye. Anas ne phir bataya ke log jung ke maidan se bhaag gaye. Isspar Thabit ne kaha, 'Mujhe raasta do dushman se jung karne ke liye. Hum Allah ke Rasool ki sohbat mein kabhi aisa (yaani bhaagna) nahi karte the. Kitni buri aadaten tumne apne dushmanon se seekhi hain.'"

e: Narrated Jabir:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Who will bring me the information about the enemy on the day (of the battle) of Al-Ahzab (i.e. Clans)?" Az-Zubair said, "I will." The Prophet (ﷺ) said again, "Who will bring me the information about the enemy?" Az-Zubair said again, "I will." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Every prophet had a disciple and my disciple is Az-Zubair
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha: "Kaun mujhe Al-Ahzab (qabilon) ki jung ke din dushman ki khabar lakar dega?" Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Main launga." Nabi ne phir kaha: "Kaun mujhe dushman ki khabar laaega?" Az-Zubair ne phir kaha: "Main launga." Nabi ne kaha: "Har Nabi ka ek shagird hota hai, aur mera shagird Az-Zubair hai."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:When the Prophet (ﷺ) called the people (Sadaqa, a sub-narrator, said, 'Most likely that happened on the day of Al-Khandaq) Az-Zubair responded to the call (i.e. to act as a scout). The Prophet) called the people again and Az-Zubair responded to the call. The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "Every prophet had a disciple and my disciple is Zubair bin Al-`Awwam
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Nabi ne logon ko bulaya (Sadaqa, doosre raawi ne kaha, 'Yeh Al-Khandaq ke din hua hoga'), Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne pukaar ka jawab diya (yaani jaasoosi karne ke liye). Nabi ne phir logon ko bulaya aur Az-Zubair ne phir jawab diya. Nabi ne phir kaha: "Har Nabi ka ek shagird hota hai, aur mera shagird Zubair bin Al-Awwam hai."

e: Narrated Malik bin Al-Huwairith:On my departure from the Prophet (ﷺ) he said to me and to a friend of mine, "You two, pronounce the Adhan and the Iqama for the prayer and let the elder of you lead the prayer
hi: Malik bin Al-Huwairith bataate hain: Nabi se vidaee lete waqt, unhone mujhse aur mere ek dost se kaha: "Tum donon, Adhan aur Iqama namaz ke liye kaho, aur tum mein se jo bada ho, woh namaz padhwaye."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Good will remain (as a permanent quality) in the foreheads of horses till the Day of Resurrection
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Ghodon ke mathe par (yaani unke bariq gunon mein) hamesha (Qiyamat tak) bhalaee rahegi."

e: Narrated Urwa bin Ja'd:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Good will remain (as a permanent quality) in the foreheads of horses till the Day of Resurrection
hi: Urwa bin Ja'd bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Ghodon ke mathe par hamesha (Qiyamat tak) bhalaee rahegi."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "There is a blessing in the fore-heads of horses
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Ghodon ke mathe par barkat hoti hai."

e: Narrated `Urwa Al-Bariqi:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Good will remain (as a permanent quality) in the foreheads of horses (for Jihad) till the Day of Resurrection, for they bring about either a reward (in the Hereafter) or (war) booty (in this world)
hi: Urwa Al-Bariqi bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Ghodon ke mathe par hamesha (Jihad ke liye) bhalaee rahegi Qiyamat tak, kyunke woh ya to ajr (Aakhirat mein) late hain ya maal-e-ghanimat (is duniya mein)."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If somebody keeps a horse in Allah's Cause motivated by his faith in Allah and his belief in His Promise, then he will be rewarded on the Day of Resurrection for what the horse has eaten or drunk and for its dung and urine
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Agar koi shaks Allah ki raah mein ghoda palta hai, Allah par apne iman aur uske waade par vishwas se prerit hokar, to use Qiyamat ke din uska ajr milega jo ghode ne khaya-piya ho aur uski lad aur mootra ke liye bhi."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abi Qatada:(from his father) Abu Qatada went out (on a journey) with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) but he was left behind with some of his companions who were in the state of Ihram. He himself was not in the state of Ihram. They saw an onager before he could see it. When they saw the onager, they did not speak anything till Abu Qatada saw it. So, he rode over his horse called Al-Jarada and requested them to give him his lash, but they refused. So, he himself took it and then attacked the onager and slaughtered it. He ate of its meat and his companions ate, too, but they regretted their eating. When they met the Prophet (they asked him about it) and he asked, "Have you some of its meat (left) with you?" Abu Qatada replied, "Yes, we have its leg with us." So, the Prophet (ﷺ) took and ate it
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abu Qatada (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain (apne waalid ke hawale se): Abu Qatada Allah ke Rasool ke saath (safar par) nikle magar unhe kuch saathiyon ke saath peeche chhod diya gaya jo Ihram mein the. Woh khud Ihram mein nahi the. Unhone (saathiyon ne) ek jangli gadha dekha isse pehle ke Abu Qatada dekhte, aur jab unhone use dekha, unhone (Abu Qatada ko) kuch nahi kaha jab tak Abu Qatada khud usse dekh na liya. Isliye woh apne ghode par sawar hue jise Al-Jarada kaha jata tha aur unhe apna chaabuk dene ki guzarish ki, magar unhone inkaar kiya. Isliye unhone khud use liya aur gadhe par hamla karke use zabah kiya. Unhone uska gosht khaya aur unke saathiyon ne bhi khaya, magar baad mein unhe apne khaane par afsos hua. Jab woh Nabi se mile (aur unse iske baare mein pucha), Aap ne pucha: "Kya tumhare paas uska kuch gosht bacha hai?" Abu Qatada ne jawab diya: "Haan, humare paas uski taang hai." Isliye Nabi ne use liya aur khaya.

e: Narrated Sahl:In our garden there was a horse belonging to the Prophet (ﷺ) called Al-Luhaif or Al-Lukhaif
hi: Sahl bataate hain: Humare baag mein Nabi ka ek ghoda tha jise Al-Luhaif ya Al-Lukhaif kaha jata tha.

e: Narrated Mu`adh:I was a companion rider of the Prophet (ﷺ) on a donkey called 'Ufair. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "O Mu`adh! Do you know what Allah's right on His slaves is, and what the right of His slaves on Him is?" I replied, "Allah and His Apostle know better." He said, "Allah's right on His slaves is that they should worship Him (Alone) and should not worship any besides Him. And slave's right on Allah is that He should not punish him who worships none besides Him." I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Should I not inform the people of this good news?" He said, "Do not inform them of it, lest they should depend on it (absolutely)
hi: Mu'adh bataate hain: Main Nabi ke saath ek gadhe par sawar tha jise 'Ufair kaha jata tha. Nabi ne pucha: "Aye Mu'adh! Kya tumhe pata hai Allah ka apne bandon par kya haqq hai, aur bandon ka Allah par kya haqq hai?" Maine jawab diya: "Allah aur uske Rasool behtar jaante hain." Aap ne kaha: "Allah ka apne bandon par haqq yeh hai ke woh sirf uski (akele) ibadat karen aur uske siwa kisi doosre ki ibadat na karen. Aur bande ka Allah par haqq yeh hai ke woh us shaks ko saza na de jo uske siwa kisi doosre ki ibadat nahi karta." Maine kaha: "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Kya main logon ko yeh khushkhabri na dun?" Aap ne kaha: "Unhe mat batao, warna woh ispar (poori tarah) bharosa kar baithenge."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Once there was a feeling of fright in Medina, so the Prophet (ﷺ) borrowed a horse belonging to us called Mandub (and he rode away on it). (When the Prophet (ﷺ) returned) he said, "I have not seen anything of fright and I found it (i.e. this horse) very fast
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Madina mein khatare ka ehsaas hua, isliye Nabi ne humara ek ghoda udhaar liya jise Mandub kaha jata tha (aur uspar sawar hokar gaye). (Jab Nabi wapas aaye) unhone kaha: "Maine koi khatara nahi dekha, aur mujhe yeh (ghoda) bahut tez laga."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying. "Evil omen is in three things: The horse, the woman and the house
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi ko kehte suna: "Bad-shaguni teen cheezon mein hoti hai: Ghoda, aurat, aur ghar."

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d As-Saidi:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If there is any evil omen in anything, then it is in the woman, the horse and the house
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) As-Saidi bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Agar kisi cheez mein bad-shaguni ho sakti hai, to woh aurat, ghoda, aur ghar mein hoti hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, " Horses are kept for one of three purposes; for some people they are a source of reward, for some others they are a means of shelter and for some others they are a source of sins. The one for whom they are a source of reward, is he who keeps a horse for Allah's Cause (i.e. Jihad) tying it with a long tether on a meadow or in a garden with the result that whatever it eats from the area of the meadow or the garden where it is tied will be counted as good deeds for his benefit, and if it should break its rope and jump over one or two hillocks then all its dung and its foot marks will be written as good deeds for him; and if it passes by a river and drinks water from it even though he had no intention of watering it, even then he will get the reward for its drinking. As for the man for whom horses are a source of sins, he is the one who keeps a horse for the sake of pride and pretense and showing enmity for Muslims: such a horse will be a source of sins for him. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked about donkeys, he replied, "Nothing has been revealed to me about them except this unique, comprehensive Verse: "Then anyone who does an atom's (or a small ant's) weight of good shall see it; And anyone who does an atom's (or a small ant's) weight of evil, shall see it
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Ghode teen maqsad ke liye rakhe jate hain: kuch logon ke liye woh ajr ka zariya hain, kuch doosron ke liye panah ka zariya hain, aur kuch aur logon ke liye gunah ka zariya. Jiske liye woh ajr ka zariya hain, woh hai jo apna ghoda Allah ki raah mein rakhta hai (yaani Jihad ke liye), use ek lambi rassi se ek maidan ya baag mein baandhkar; agar woh ghaas khata hai us maidan ya baag ki jagahon se jahan usko baandha gaya hai, use ajr milega, aur agar rassi todkar ek ya do pahadiyan paar kar jaaye, iske sab gobar aur paon ke nishaan uske liye neik amal likhe jaayenge; aur agar woh kisi nadi ke paas se guzre aur usme se paani piye chahe uski niyyat na thi paani pilane ki, usse bhi paani piyane ka ajr milega. Jiske liye ghode gunah ka zariya hain, woh hai jo apna ghoda ghamand, dikhaave aur Musalmanon se dushmani ke liye rakhta hai: aisa ghoda uske liye gunah ka zariya hoga." Jab Allah ke Rasool se gadhon ke baare mein pucha gaya, unhone jawab diya: "Mujhpar unke baare mein khaas kuch nazil nahi hua siwaye is benazir, aam Ayat ke: 'Jo bhi zare-barabar neki karega, use dekhega; aur jo bhi zare-barabar buraee karega, use dekhega.'"

e: Narrated Muslim from Abu `Aqil from Abu Al-Mutawakkil An-Naji:I called on Jabir bin `Abdullah Al-Ansari and said to him, "Relate to me what you have heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ." He said, "I accompanied him on one of the journeys." (Abu `Aqil said, "I do not know whether that journey was for the purpose of Jihad or `Umra.") "When we were returning," Jabir continued, "the Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Whoever wants to return earlier to his family, should hurry up.' We set off and I was on a black red tainted camel having no defect, and the people were behind me. While I was in that state the camel stopped suddenly (because of exhaustion). On that the Prophet (ﷺ) said to me, 'O Jabir, wait!' Then he hit it once with his lash and it started moving on a fast pace. He then said, 'Will you sell the camel?' I replied in the affirmative when we reached Medina, and the Prophet (ﷺ) went to the Mosque along with his companions. I, too, went to him after tying the camel on the pavement at the Mosque gate. Then I said to him, 'This is your camel.' He came out and started examining the camel and saying, 'The camel is ours.' Then the Prophet (ﷺ) sent some Awaq (i.e. an amount) of gold saying, 'Give it to Jabir.' Then he asked, 'Have you taken the full price (of the camel)?' I replied in the affirmative. He said, 'Both the price and the camel are for you
hi: Muslim, Abu Aqil se, Abu Al-Mutawakkil An-Naji se: Main Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ansari se milne gaya aur unse kaha, "Mujhe woh bataiye jo aapne Allah ke Rasool se suna." Unhone kaha, "Main unke saath ek safar par tha." (Abu Aqil ne kaha, "Mujhe nahi pata woh safar Jihad ke liye tha ya Umrah ke liye.") "Jab hum wapas ja rahe the," Jabir ne aage kaha, "Nabi ne kaha, 'Jo bhi apne pariwara ke paas jaldi wapas jana chahta hai, use jaldi karni chahiye.' Hum chal pade aur main ek kale-lal rang ke unt par tha jisme koi kami nahi thi, aur log mere peeche the. Isi haal mein achanak unt ruka (thakan ki wajah se). Isspar Nabi ne mujhse kaha, 'Aye Jabir! Ruko!' Phir unhone use ek baar apne chaabuk se maara aur woh tez raftaar se chalna laga. Phir unhone pucha, 'Kya tum unt bechoge?' Maine haan mein jawab diya jab hum Madina pahunche, aur Nabi apne sahaba ke saath masjid gaye. Main bhi unt ko masjid ke darwaze ki chabutre par baandhkar unke paas gaya. Phir maine unse kaha, 'Yeh aapka unt hai.' Woh bahar aaye aur unt ki jaanch karne lage, kehte huye, 'Unt humara hai.' Phir Nabi ne kuch Awaq (yaani ek maqdaar) sona bheja, kehte huye, 'Ise Jabir ko do.' Phir unhone pucha, 'Kya tumne poori qeemat le li hai (unt ki)?' Maine haan mein jawab diya. Unhone kaha, 'Qeemat aur unt dono tumhare hain.'"

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:There was a feeling of fright in Medina, so the Prophet (ﷺ) borrowed a horse called Mandub belonging 'to Abu Talha and mounted it. (On his return), he said, "I did not see anything of fright and I found this horse very fast
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Madina mein khatare ka ehsaas hua, isliye Nabi ne Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) ka ek ghoda udhaar liya jise Mandub kaha jata tha aur uspar sawar hue. (Wapasi par), unhone kaha, "Maine koi khatara nahi dekha aur mujhe yeh ghoda bahut tez laga."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) fixed two shares for the horse and one share for its rider (from the war booty)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne ghode ke liye do hisse aur uske sawar ke liye ek hissa muqarrar kiya (maal-e-ghanimat se).

e: Narrated Abu 'Is-haq:Somebody asked Al-Bar-a bin `Azib, "Did you flee deserting Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) during the battle of Hunain?" Al-Bara replied, "But Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not flee. The people of the Tribe of Hawazin were good archers. When we met them, we attacked them, and they fled. When the Muslims started collecting the war booty, the pagans faced us with arrows, but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not flee. No doubt, I saw him on his white mule and Abu Sufyan was holding its reins and the Prophet (ﷺ) was saying, 'I am the Prophet (ﷺ) in truth: I am the son of `Abdul Muttalib
hi: Abu Ishaq bataate hain: Kisi ne Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha, "Kya aap Hunain ki jung mein Allah ke Rasool ko chhodkar bhaage the?" Al-Bara ne jawab diya, "Magar Allah ke Rasool nahi bhaage. Hawazin qabile ke log achhe tirandaaz the. Jab hum unse mile, humne unpar hamla kiya, aur woh bhaag gaye. Jab Musalman maal-e-ghanimat jama karne lage, mushrikon ne humpar teer chalaye, magar Allah ke Rasool nahi bhaage. Beshak, maine unhe apne safed khachchar par dekha aur Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ) uski lagaam pakde hue the, aur Nabi keh rahe the, 'Main sach mein Nabi hoon: Main Abdul Muttalib ka beta hoon.'"

e: Narrated Ibn'`Umar:When the Prophet (ﷺ) put his feet in the stirrup and the she-camel got up carrying him he would start reciting Talbiya at the mosque of Dhul-Hulaifa
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Nabi apne paon rikaab mein rakhte aur untni unhe lekar khadi hoti, woh Dhul-Hulaifa ki masjid mein Talbiya padhna shuru karte.

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) met them (i.e. the people) while he was riding an unsaddled horse with his sword slung over his shoulder
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi unse (yaani logon se) mile jabke woh bina jin (saddle) ke ghode par sawar the, apni talwar kandhe par latkaye hue.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Once the people of Medina were frightened, so the Prophet (ﷺ) rode a horse belonging to Abu Talha and it ran slowly, or was of narrow paces. When he returned, he said, "I found your (i.e. Abu Talha's) horse very fast. After that the horse could not be surpassed in running
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Madina ke log dar gaye, isliye Nabi Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) ka ghoda par sawar hue aur woh dheeme ya sankirin kadam se chala. Jab woh wapas aaye, unhone kaha, "Mujhe tumhara (yaani Abu Talha ka) ghoda bahut tez laga." Uske baad, ghoda daudne mein kisi se paar nahi hua.

e: Narrated (`Abdullah) bin `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) arranged for a horse race amongst the horses that had been made lean to take place between Al-Hafya'' and Thaniyat Al-Wada` (i.e. names of two places) and the horses which had not been made lean from Ath-Thaniyat to the mosque of Bani Zuraiq. I was also amongst those who took part in that horse race. Sufyan, a sub-narrator, said, "The distance between Al-Hafya and Thaniya Al- Wada` is five or six miles; and between Thaniya and the mosque of Bani Zuraiq is one mile
hi: (Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ)) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne un ghodon ki daud ka intezaam kiya jinhe patla kiya gaya tha, Al-Hafya aur Thaniyat Al-Wada (do jagahon ke naam) ke beech, aur jin ghodon ko patla nahi kiya gaya tha, Ath-Thaniya se Bani Zuraiq ki masjid tak. Main bhi us ghoda-daud mein shaamil tha. Sufyan, doosre raawi ne kaha, "Al-Hafya aur Thaniya Al-Wada ke beech ki doori paanch ya chhah meel hai; aur Thaniya aur Bani Zuraiq ki masjid ke beech ek meel hai."

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) arranged for a horse race of the horses which had not been made lean; the area of the race was from Ath-Thaniya to the mosque of Bani Zuraiq. (The sub-narrator said, "`Abdullah bin `Umar was amongst those who participated in that horse race)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne un ghodon ki daud ka intezaam kiya jinhe patla nahi kiya gaya tha; daud ka ilaka Ath-Thaniya se Bani Zuraiq ki masjid tak tha. (Doosre raawi ne kaha, "Abdullah bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bhi us ghoda-daud mein shaamil the.")

e: Narrated Abu 'Is-haq from Musa bin `Uqba from Nafi` from Ibn `Umar who said:"Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) arranged a horse race amongst the horses that had been made lean, letting them start from Al-Hafya' and their limit (distance of running) was up to Thaniyat-al-Wada`. I asked Musa, 'What was the distance between the two places?' Musa replied, 'Six or seven miles. He arranged a race of the horses which had not been made lean sending them from Thaniyat-al-Wada`, and their limit was up to the mosque of Bani Zuraiq.' I asked, 'What was the distance between those two places?' He replied 'One mile or so.' Ibn `Umar was amongst those who participated in that horse race
hi: Abu Ishaq, Musa bin Uqba se, Nafi se, Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se: "Allah ke Rasool ne un ghodon ki daud ka intezaam kiya jinhe patla kiya gaya tha, unhe Al-Hafya se chalwate huye, aur unki seema (daudne ki doori) Thaniyat-al-Wada tak thi." Maine Musa se pucha, "Un do jagahon ke beech ki doori kya thi?" Musa ne jawab diya, "Chhah ya saat meel." Unhone un ghodon ki bhi daud ka intezaam kiya jinhe patla nahi kiya gaya tha, unhe Thaniyat-al-Wada se bhejte huye, aur unki seema Bani Zuraiq ki masjid tak thi. Maine pucha, "Un do jagahon ke beech ki doori kya thi?" Unhone jawab diya, "Ek meel ya usse kuch zyada." Ibn Umar bhi us ghoda-daud mein shaamil the.

e: Narrated Anas:The she camel of the Prophet (ﷺ) was called Al-Adba
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ki untni ka naam Al-Adba tha.

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) had a she camel called Al-Adba which could not be excelled in a race. (Humaid, a subnarrator said, "Or could hardly be excelled.") Once a bedouin came riding a camel below six years of age which surpassed it (i.e. Al-`Adba') in the race. The Muslims felt it so much that the Prophet (ﷺ) noticed their distress. He then said, "It is Allah's Law that He brings down whatever rises high in the world
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ke paas ek untni thi jise Al-Adba kaha jata tha jise daud mein kabhi paar nahi kiya ja sakta tha. (Humaid, doosre raawi ne kaha, "Ya mushkil se paar kiya ja sakta tha.") Ek baar ek dehati chhah saal se kam umr ke unt par sawar hokar aaya jisne usse (yaani Al-Adba ko) daud mein paar kar diya. Musalmanon ko yeh bahut bura laga aur Nabi ne unki pareshaani mahsoos ki. Phir unhone kaha, "Yeh Allah ka qanoon hai ke jo bhi duniya mein oonchaa uthta hai, use woh neeche lata hai."

e: Narrated `Amr bin Al-Harith:The Prophet (ﷺ) did not leave anything behind him after his death except a white mule, his arms and a piece of land which he left to be given in charity
hi: Amr bin Al-Harith bataate hain: Nabi ne apni maut ke baad apne peeche kuch nahi chhoda siwaye ek safed khachchar, apne hathiyaar, aur zameen ka ek tukda jise unhone sadqe mein dene ke liye chhoda tha.

e: Narrated Al-Bara:that a man asked him. "O Abu '`Umara! Did you flee on the day (of the battle) of Hunain?" He replied, "No, by Allah, the Prophet (ﷺ) did not flee but the hasty people fled and the people of the Tribe of Hawazin attacked them with arrows, while the Prophet (ﷺ) was riding his white mule and Abu Sufyan bin Al-Harith was holding its reins, and the Prophet (ﷺ) was saying, 'I am the Prophet (ﷺ) in truth, I am the son of `Abdul Muttalib
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Ek shaks ne unse pucha, "Aye Abu Umara! Kya aap Hunain ke din (jung mein) bhaage the?" Unhone jawab diya, "Nahi, Allah ki qasam, Nabi nahi bhaage magar jaldbaaz log bhaage, aur Hawazin qabile ke logon ne unpar teer chalaye, jabke Nabi apne safed khachchar par sawar the aur Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Harith uski lagaam pakde hue the, aur Nabi keh rahe the, 'Main sach mein Nabi hoon, Main Abdul Muttalib ka beta hoon.'"

e: Narrated `Aisha:the mother of the faithful believers, I requested the Prophet (ﷺ) to permit me to participate in Jihad, but he said, "Your Jihad is the performance of Hajj
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا), mominon ki maa, bataati hain: Maine Nabi se guzarish ki ke woh mujhe Jihad mein shaamil hone ki ijazat den, magar unhone kaha, "Tumhara Jihad Hajj karna hai."

e: Narrated `Aisha:the mother of the faithful believers: The Prophet (ﷺ) was asked by his wives about Jihad and he replied, "The best Jihad (for you) is (the performance of) Hajj
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا), mominon ki maa, bataati hain: Nabi se unki biwiyon ne Jihad ke baare mein pucha aur unhone jawab diya, "(Tumhare liye) sabse behtareen Jihad Hajj karna hai."

e: Narrated Anas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went to the daughter of Milhan and reclined there (and slept) and then (woke up) smiling. She asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What makes you smile?" He replied, (I dreamt that) some people amongst my followers were sailing on the green sea in Allah's Cause, resembling kings on thrones." She said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Invoke Allah to make me one of them." He said, "O Allah! Let her be one of them." Then he (slept again and woke up and) smiled. She asked him the same question and he gave the same reply. She said, "Invoke Allah to make me one of them." He replied, ''You will be amongst the first group of them; you will not be amongst the last." Later on she married 'Ubada bin As-Samit and then she sailed on the sea with bint Qaraza, Mu'awiya's wife (for Jihad). On her return, she mounted her riding animal, which threw her down breaking her neck, and she died on falling down
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool Milhaan ki beti (Um Haram) ke paas gaye aur wahan leta gaye (aur soye), phir (uthkar) muskurate huye. Usne pucha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Aapko kis baat par muskurahat aayi?" Aap ne jawab diya, "(Maine khwab mein dekha ke) mere pairokaron mein se kuch log hare samundar mein Allah ki raah mein safar kar rahe the, jaise raajaon jaisi takhto par baithe hon." Usne kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Allah se dua kijiye ke woh mujhe unme se ek banaye." Aap ne kaha, "Aye Allah! Isse unme se ek bana." Phir Aap (dobara soye aur uthkar) muskurate. Usne wahi sawaal dohraaya aur unhone wahi jawab diya. Usne kaha, "Allah se dua kijiye ke woh mujhe unme se ek banaye." Aap ne jawab diya, "Tum unki pahli toli mein hogi; aakhri mein nahi." Baad mein usne Ubada bin As-Samit se shaadi ki aur phir samundar mein safar kiya bint Qaraza ke saath, Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki biwi (Jihad ke liye). Wapasi par, woh apne sawari ke janwar par sawar hui jisne use gira aur uski gardan tut gaee, aur woh girkar mar gayi.

e: Narrated `Aisha:Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) intended to proceed on a journey, he used to draw lots amongst his wives and would take the one upon whom the lot fell. Once, before setting out for Jihad, he drew lots amongst us and the lot came to me; so I went with the Prophet; and that happened after the revelation of the Verse of Hijab (i.e. veiling)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab bhi Nabi safar par jana chahte, woh apni biwiyon ke beech chithi daalte the aur jispar chithi padti, use apne saath le jate. Ek baar, Jihad par jaane se pehle, unhone humare beech chithi daali aur meri chithi aayi; isliye main Nabi ke saath gayi; aur yeh Hijab (yaani parde) ki Ayat nazil hone ke baad hua tha.

e: Narrated Anas:On the day (of the battle) of Uhud when (some) people retreated and left the Prophet, I saw `Aisha bint Abu Bakr and Um Sulaim, with their robes tucked up so that the bangles around their ankles were visible hurrying with their water skins (in another narration it is said, "carrying the water skins on their backs"). Then they would pour the water in the mouths of the people, and return to fill the water skins again and come back again to pour water in the mouths of the people
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Uhud ki jung ke din jab kuch log peeche hate aur Nabi ko chhod diya, maine Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Abu Bakr aur Um Sulaim ko dekha, unke kapde samete hue taake unki taangon ke kangan dikh rahe hon, apni mashken lekar daudte huye (ek doosri riwaayat mein hai, "mashken apni pushton par uthate huye"). Phir woh logon ke mun mein paani daalti aur wapas jaakar mashken bharne ke liye jati aur phir wapas aakar logon ke mun mein paani daalti.

e: Narrated Tha`laba bin Abi Malik:`Umar bin Al-Khattab distributed some garments amongst the women of Medina. One good garment remained, and one of those present with him said, "O chief of the believers! Give this garment to your wife, the (grand) daughter of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." They meant Um Kulthum, the daughter of `Ali. `Umar said, Um Salit has more right (to have it)." Um Salit was amongst those Ansari women who had given the pledge of allegiance to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).' `Umar said, "She (i.e. Um Salit) used to carry the water skins for us on the day of Uhud
hi: Tha'laba bin Abi Malik bataate hain: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab ne Madina ki auraton mein kuch kapde taqseem kiye. Ek achha kapda bach gaya, aur wahan maujood ek shaks ne kaha, "Aye Momino ke Ameer! Yeh kapda apni biwi ko dijiye, jo Allah ke Rasool ki (pote ki) beti hain." Unka matlab Um Kulthum, Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki beti, se tha. Umar ne kaha, "Um Salit ko iska zyada haqq hai." Um Salit un Ansaar auraton mein se thi jinhone Allah ke Rasool se bai'at ki thi. Umar ne kaha, "Woh (yaani Um Salit) Uhud ke din humare liye mashken uthati thi."

e: Narrated Ar-Rubayyi 'bint Mu'auwidh:We were in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) providing the wounded with water and treating them and bringing the killed to Medina (from the battle field)
hi: Ar-Rubayyi bint Mu'auwidh bataati hain: Hum Nabi ki sohbat mein the, zakhmiyon ko paani pilate aur unka ilaaj karte, aur maidan-e-jung se murdon ko Madina late.

e: Narrated Ar-Rubai' bint Mu'auwidh:We used to take part in holy battles with the Prophet (ﷺ) by providing the people with water and serving them and bringing the killed and the wounded back to Medina
hi: Ar-Rubai bint Mu'auwidh bataati hain: Hum Nabi ke saath muqaddas jungon mein hissa lete the, logon ko paani pilakar aur unki khidmat karke, aur murdon aur zakhmiyon ko Madina wapas lakar.

e: Narrated Abu Musa:Abu 'Amir was hit with an arrow in his knee, so I went to him and he asked me to remove the arrow. When I removed it, the water started dribbling from it. Then I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and told him about it. He said, "O Allah! Forgive `Ubaid Abu 'Amir
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Amir ko unke ghutne mein teer laga, isliye main unke paas gaya aur unhone mujhe teer nikalne ko kaha. Jab maine use nikala, usmein se paani tapakne laga. Phir main Nabi ke paas gaya aur unhe iske baare mein bataya. Aap ne kaha, "Aye Allah! Ubaid Abu Amir ko maaf kar."

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) was vigilant one night and when he reached Medina, he said, "Would that a pious man from my companions guard me tonight!" Suddenly we heard the clatter of arms. He said, "Who is that? " He (The new comer) replied, " I am Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas and have come to guard you." So, the Prophet (ﷺ) slept (that night)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi ek raat saavdhaan (chaukanne) the aur jab woh Madina pahunche, unhone kaha, "Kaash mere sahaba mein se koi neik shaks aaj raat meri rakhwali kare!" Achanak humne hathiyaron ki khadkhadahat suni. Aap ne pucha, "Kaun hai?" Usne (naye aane wale ne) jawab diya, "Main Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (رضی اللہ عنہ) hoon aur aapki rakhwali karne aaya hoon." Isliye Nabi (us raat) so gaye.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Let the slave of Dinar and Dirham, and of Qatifah and Khamisa (i.e. money and luxurious clothes) perish for he is pleased if these things are given to him, and if not, he is displeased
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Dinar aur Dirham ke gulaam ko, aur Qatifah aur Khamisa (yaani paisa aur aish-o-aaram wale kapde) ke gulaam ko barbaad ho, kyunke woh khush hota hai agar yeh cheezein use di jaen, aur agar nahi, to woh naraaj hota hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, " Let the slave of Dinar and Dirham, of Qatifah and Khamisa perish as he is pleased if these things are given to him, and if not, he is displeased. Let such a person perish and relapse, and if he is pierced with a thorn, let him not find anyone to take it out for him. Paradise is for him who holds the reins of his horse to strive in Allah's Cause, with his hair unkempt and feet covered with dust: if he is appointed in the vanguard, he is perfectly satisfied with his post of guarding, and if he is appointed in the rearward, he accepts his post with satisfaction; (he is so simple and unambiguous that) if he asks for permission he is not permitted, and if he intercedes, his intercession is not accepted
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Dinar aur Dirham ke gulaam ko, Qatifah aur Khamisa ke gulaam ko barbaad ho, kyunke woh khush hota hai agar yeh cheezein use di jaen, aur agar nahi, to woh naraaj hota hai. Aisa shaks barbaad ho aur gire, aur agar usme kaanta chubhe, koi na mile jo use nikale. Jannat us shaks ke liye hai jo apne ghode ki lagaam pakadkar Allah ki raah mein koshish karta hai, uske baal bikhre hue aur paon dhool se dhake hue: agar use agli safon mein tainaat kiya jaaye, woh apni rakhwali ki zimmedaari se poori tarah santusht hai, aur agar use peechli safon mein tainaat kiya jaaye, woh apna kaam raazi hokar qubool karta hai; (woh itna saada aur seedha hai ke) agar woh ijazat maange, use ijazat nahi milti, aur agar woh sifarish kare, uski sifarish qubool nahi hoti."

e: Narrated Anas:I was in the company of Jabir bin `Abdullah on a journey and he used to serve me though he was older than I. Jarir said, "I saw the Ansar doing a thing (i.e. showing great reverence to the Prophet (ﷺ) ) for which I have vowed that whenever I meet any of them, I will serve him
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki sohbat mein ek safar par tha aur woh meri khidmat karte the chahe woh mujhse bade the. Jarir (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Maine Ansaar ko ek aisi cheez karte dekha (yaani Nabi ke prati bahut zyada ehteram dikhate hue) ke maine kasam khaee hai ke jab bhi main unme se kisi se milunga, main uski khidmat karunga."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:I went along with the Prophet (ﷺ) to Khaibar so as to serve him. (Later on) when the Prophet (ﷺ) returned he, on seeing the Uhud mountain, said, "This is a mountain that loves us and is loved by us." Then he pointed to Medina with his hand saying, "O Allah! I make the area which is in between Medina's two mountains a sanctuary, as Abraham made Mecca a sanctuary. O Allah! Bless us in our Sa` and Mudd (i.e. units of measuring)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Nabi ke saath Khaibar gaya taake unki khidmat kar sakoon. (Baad mein) jab Nabi wapas aaye aur Uhud pahad dekha, unhone kaha, "Yeh ek pahad hai jo humse mohabbat karta hai aur jisse hum mohabbat karte hain." Phir unhone apne haath se Madina ki taraf ishara kiya aur kaha, "Aye Allah! Main Madina ke do pahadon ke beech ki jagah ko Hima (mahfooz jagah) banata hoon, jaise Ibrahim ne Mecca ko Hima banaya. Aye Allah! Humare Sa aur Mudd (naapne ki maapak) mein barkat de."

e: Narrated Anas:We were with the Prophet (on a journey) and the only shade one could have was the shade made by one's own garment. Those who fasted did not do any work and those who did not fast served the camels and brought the water on them and treated the sick and (wounded). So, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Today, those who were not fasting took (all) the reward
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Nabi ke saath the (ek safar par) aur sirf apne kapde ka saaya hi mil sakta tha. Jinhone roza rakha tha unhone koi kaam nahi kiya, aur jinhone roza nahi rakha tha unhone unton ki khidmat ki aur unpar paani laaye aur bimaron (aur zakhmiyon) ka ilaaj kiya. Isspar Nabi ne kaha, "Aaj, jinhone roza nahi rakha, unhone poora ajr le liya."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Charity is obligatory everyday on every joint of a human being. If one helps a person in matters concerning his riding animal by helping him to ride it or by lifting his luggage on to it, all this will be regarded as charity. A good word, and every step one takes to offer the compulsory Congregational prayer, is regarded as charity; and guiding somebody on the road is regarded as charity
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Har din, insaan ke har jod ke liye sadqa farz hai. Agar koi kisi ki sawari ke janwar mein madad kare use sawar hone mein madad karke ya uska saaman uspar chadhakar, yeh sab sadqa mana jaayega. Achhi baat, aur farz jamaat namaz padhne ke liye uthaya gaya har kadam bhi sadqa mana jata hai; aur kisi ko raaste par raah dikhana bhi sadqa mana jata hai."

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d As-Sa'idi:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "To guard Muslims from infidels in Allah's Cause for one day is better than the world and whatever is on its surface, and a place in Paradise as small as that occupied by the whip of one of you is better than the world and whatever is on its surface; and a morning's or an evening's journey which a slave (person) travels in Allah's Cause is better than the world and whatever is on its surface
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) As-Sa'idi bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Musalmanon ko kaafiron se ek din bachana Allah ki raah mein, poori duniya aur usme jo kuch hai usse behtar hai, aur Jannat mein ek jagah jitni chhoti ho tumhare chaabuk jitni, poori duniya aur usme jo kuch hai usse behtar hai; aur ek subah ya shaam ka safar jo koi banda Allah ki raah mein kare, poori duniya aur usme jo kuch hai usse behtar hai."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said to Abu Talha, "Choose one of your boy servants to serve me in my expedition to Khaibar." So, Abu Talha took me letting me ride behind him while I was a boy nearing the age of puberty. I used to serve Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) when he stopped to rest. I heard him saying repeatedly, "O Allah! I seek refuge with You from distress and sorrow, from helplessness and laziness, from miserliness and cowardice, from being heavily in debt and from being overcome by men." Then we reached Khaibar; and when Allah enabled him to conquer the Fort (of Khaibar), the beauty of Safiya bint Huyai bin Akhtab was described to him. Her husband had been killed while she was a bride. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) selected her for himself and took her along with him till we reached a place called Sa`d-As-Sahba,' where her menses were over and he took her for his wife. Hais (a kind of dish) was served on a small leather sheet. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) told me to call those who were around me. So, that was the marriage banquet of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Safiya. Then we left for Medina. I saw Allah's Apostle folding a cloak round the hump of the camel so as to make a wide space for Safiya (to sit on behind him) He sat beside his camel letting his knees for Safiya to put her feet on so as to mount the camel. Then, we proceeded till we approached Medina; he looked at Uhud (mountain) and said, "This is a mountain which loves us and is loved by us." Then he looked at Medina and said, "O Allah! I make the area between its (i.e. Medina's) two mountains a sanctuary as Abraham made Mecca a sanctuary. O Allah! Bless them (i.e. the people of Medina) in their Mudd and Sa (i.e. measures)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kaha, "Apne ladke gulaamon mein se ek chuno jo mera Khaibar ki muhim mein khidmat kare." Isliye Abu Talha ne mujhe liya aur apne peeche sawar kiya jabke main baalig hone ke qareeb ek ladka tha. Main Allah ke Rasool ki khidmat karta jab woh aaram karne ke liye rukte. Maine unhe baar-baar kehte suna, "Aye Allah! Main tujhse pareshaani aur gam se, kamzori aur aalasya se, kanjoosi aur kaayarta se, bahut zyada qarzdaar hone se aur logon par kaabu na paane se panah maangta hoon." Phir hum Khaibar pahunche; aur jab Allah ne unhe Qila (Khaibar ka) fatah karna naseeb kiya, unhe Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Huyai bin Akhtab ki khoobsurati ke baare mein bataya gaya. Uske shohar ko qatl kiya gaya tha jabke woh nayi dulhan thi. Isliye Allah ke Rasool ne unhe apne liye chuna aur unhe apne saath le gaye jab tak hum ek jagah pahunche jise Sa'd-As-Sahba kaha jata tha, jahan unka mahina khatam hua aur unhone unse shaadi ki. Hais (ek qisam ka khaana) ek chhote chamde ki chadar par pesh kiya gaya. Phir Allah ke Rasool ne mujhse mere aas-paas ke logon ko bulane ko kaha. To yehi Allah ke Rasool aur Safiya ki shaadi ki dawat thi. Phir hum Madina ke liye rawana hue. Maine Allah ke Rasool ko ek chadar unt ke kohaan (hump) ke gird lapette dekha taake Safiya (unke peeche baithne) ke liye jagah bane. Woh apne unt ke bagal mein baithte aur Safiya ko apne ghutnon par apne paon rakhne dete taake woh unt par sawar ho sake. Phir hum aage badhte gaye jab tak Madina ke qareeb pahunche; unhone Uhud (pahad) ki taraf dekha aur kaha, "Yeh ek pahad hai jo humse mohabbat karta hai aur jisse hum mohabbat karte hain." Phir unhone Madina ki taraf dekha aur kaha, "Aye Allah! Main iske (yaani Madina ke) do pahadon ke beech ki jagah ko Hima banata hoon, jaise Ibrahim ne Mecca ko Hima banaya. Aye Allah! Unhe (yaani Madina ke logon ko) unke Mudd aur Sa (naapne ki maapak) mein barkat de."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Um Haram told me that the Prophet (ﷺ) one day took a midday nap in her house. Then he woke up smiling. Um Haram asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What makes you smile?" He replied "I was astonished to see (in my dream) some people amongst my followers on a sea-voyage looking like kings on the thrones." She said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Invoke Allah to make me one of them." He replied, "You are amongst them." He slept again and then woke up smiling and said the same as before twice or thrice. And she said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Invoke Allah to make me one of them." And he said, "You are amongst the first batch." 'Ubada bin As-Samit married her (i.e. Um Haram) and then he took her for Jihad. When she returned, an animal was presented to her to ride, but she fell down and her neck was broken
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Um Haram ne mujhe bataya ke Nabi ek din unke ghar mein dopahar ki neend le rahe the. Phir woh muskurate huye uthe. Um Haram ne pucha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Aapko kis baat par muskurahat aayi?" Aap ne jawab diya, "Mujhe hairat hui yeh dekhkar (khwab mein) ke mere pairokaron mein se kuch log samundar ke safar par the, raajaon jaise takht par baithe hue." Usne kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Allah se dua kijiye ke woh mujhe unme se ek banaye." Aap ne jawab diya, "Tum unme se ek ho." Woh phir soye aur muskurate huye uthe aur pehle jaisa hi do ya teen baar kaha. Aur usne kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Allah se dua kijiye ke woh mujhe unme se ek banaye." Aur Aap ne kaha, "Tum pahli toli mein ho." Ubada bin As-Samit ne unse (yaani Um Haram se) shaadi ki aur phir unhe Jihad ke liye le gaye. Jab woh wapas aayi, ek janwar unke sawari ke liye pesh kiya gaya, magar woh giri aur uski gardan tut gaee.

e: Narrated Mus`ab bin Sa`d:Once Sa`d (bin Abi Waqqas) thought that he was superior to those who were below him in rank. On that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You gain no victory or livelihood except through (the blessings and invocations of) the poor amongst you
hi: Mus'ab bin Sa'd bataate hain: Ek baar Sa'd (bin Abi Waqqas) ne socha ke woh un logon se behtar hain jo darje mein unse neeche hain. Isspar Nabi ne kaha, "Tumhe koi fatah ya rozi (Allah ki taraf se) sirf apne beech ke gareebon (ki barkat aur dua) ki wajah se milti hai."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A time will come when groups of people will go for Jihad and it will be asked, 'Is there anyone amongst you who has enjoyed the company of the Prophet?' The answer will be, 'Yes.' Then they will be given victory (by Allah) (because of him). Then a time will come when it will be asked. 'Is there anyone amongst you who has enjoyed the company of the companions of the Prophet?' It will be said, 'Yes,' and they will be given victory (by Allah). Then a time will come when it will be said. 'Is there anyone amongst you who has enjoyed the company of the companions of the companions of the Prophet?' It will be said, 'Yes,' and they will be given victory (by Allah)
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Ek waqt aayega jab logon ke giroh Jihad ke liye jaayenge aur pucha jaayega, 'Kya tum mein koi hai jisne Nabi ki sohbat ka maza liya?' Jawab hoga, 'Haan.' Phir unhe (Allah dwaara) fatah di jaayegi (uski wajah se). Phir ek waqt aayega jab pucha jaayega, 'Kya tum mein koi hai jisne Nabi ke sahaba ki sohbat ka maza liya?' Kaha jaayega, 'Haan,' aur unhe (Allah dwaara) fatah di jaayegi. Phir ek waqt aayega jab kaha jaayega, 'Kya tum mein koi hai jisne Nabi ke sahaba ke sathiyon ki sohbat ka maza liya?' Kaha jaayega, 'Haan,' aur unhe (Allah dwaara) fatah di jaayegi."

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d As-Sa`idi:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and the pagans faced each other and started fighting. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) returned to his camp and when the pagans returned to their camp, somebody talked about a man amongst the companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who would follow and kill with his sword any pagan going alone. He said, "Nobody did his job (i.e. fighting) so properly today as that man." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Indeed, he is amongst the people of the (Hell) Fire." A man amongst the people said, "I shall accompany him (to watch what he does)" Thus he accompanied him, and wherever he stood, he would stand with him, and wherever he ran, he would run with him. Then the (brave) man got wounded seriously and he decided to bring about his death quickly. He planted the blade of the sword in the ground directing its sharp end towards his chest between his two breasts. Then he leaned on the sword and killed himself. The other man came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "I testify that you are Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." The Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "What has happened?" He replied, "(It is about) the man whom you had described as one of the people of the (Hell) Fire. The people were greatly surprised at what you said, and I said, 'I will find out his reality for you.' So, I came out seeking him. He got severely wounded, and hastened to die by slanting the blade of his sword in the ground directing its sharp end towards his chest between his two breasts. Then he eased on his sword and killed himself." Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "A man may seem to the people as if he were practising the deeds of the people of Paradise while in fact he is from the people of the Hell) Fire, another may seem to the people as if he were practicing the deeds of the people of Hell (Fire), while in fact he is from the people of Paradise
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) As-Sa'idi bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool aur mushrik ek-doosre ke saamne aaye aur jung shuru ki. Jab Allah ke Rasool apne khaime ki taraf wapas gaye aur mushrik apne khaime ki taraf wapas gaye, kisi ne Allah ke Rasool ke sahaba mein se ek shaks ke baare mein baat ki jo akele jate hue kisi bhi mushrik ka picha karke apni talwar se qatl kar deta. Usne kaha, "Aaj kisi ne apna kaam (yaani jung) itna acchhi tarah nahi kiya jitna us shaks ne." Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Beshak, woh Dozakh walon mein se hai." Logon mein se ek shaks ne kaha, "Main uske saath jaunga (dekhne ke liye woh kya karta hai)." Isliye woh uske saath gaya, aur jahan bhi woh khada hota, woh bhi khade hote, aur jahan bhi woh daudta, woh bhi daudte. Phir woh (bahadur) shaks sakht zakhmi ho gaya aur usne jaldi apni maut laane ka faisla kiya. Usne talwar ki blade zameen mein gadi, uski tez dhaar apne seene ki taraf, apni donon chhatiyon ke beech. Phir woh talwar par jhuka aur khud ko qatl kar liya. Doosra shaks Allah ke Rasool ke paas aaya aur kaha, "Main gawahi deta hoon ke aap Allah ke Rasool hain." Nabi ne pucha, "Kya hua hai?" Usne jawab diya, "(Yeh) us shaks ke baare mein hai jise aapne Dozakh walon mein se ek bataya tha. Log aapki baat se bahut hairaan hue, aur maine kaha, 'Main tumhare liye uski asaliyat pata karunga.' Isliye main use dhoondne nikla. Woh sakht zakhmi hua, aur apni maut ki jaldi ki apni talwar ki blade zameen mein trichhi gadkar, uski tez dhaar apne seene ki taraf, apni donon chhatiyon ke beech. Phir woh apni talwar par jhuka aur khud ko qatl kar liya." Phir Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Ek shaks logon ko aisa lag sakta hai jaise woh Jannat walon jaise amal kar raha ho, jabke asal mein woh Dozakh walon mein se hai, aur doosra logon ko Dozakh walon jaise amal karte hue lag sakta hai, jabke woh asal mein Jannat walon mein se hai."

e: Narrated Salama bin Al-Akwa`:The Prophet (ﷺ) passed by some people of the tribe of Bani Aslam who were practicing archery. The Prophet said, "O Bani Isma`il ! Practice archery as your father Isma`il was a great archer. Keep on throwing arrows and I am with Bani so-and-so." So one of the parties ceased throwing. Allah's Apostle said, "Why do you not throw?" They replied, "How should we throw while you are with them (i.e. on their side)?" On that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Throw, and I am with all of you
hi: Salama bin Al-Akwa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi Bani Aslam qabile ke kuch logon ke paas se guzre jo tirandaazi kar rahe the. Nabi ne kaha, "Aye Bani Ismail! Tirandaazi ka amal jaari rakho jaise tumhare baap Ismail ek behtareen tirandaaz the. Teer chalate raho, main Bani falaan ke saath hoon." Isspar ek giroh ne teer chalana band kar diya. Allah ke Rasool ne pucha, "Tum log kyun nahi chalat rahe?" Unhone jawab diya, "Hum kaise chalaen jabke aap unke saath hain (yaani unki taraf)?" Isspar Nabi ne kaha, "Chalate raho, main tum sab ke saath hoon."

e: Narrated Abu Usaid:On the day (of the battle) of Badr when we stood in rows against (the army of) Quraish and they stood in rows against us, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When they do come near you, throw arrows at them
hi: Abu Usaid bataate hain: Badr ki jung ke din jab hum Quraish ke muqaable safon mein khade the aur woh humare muqaable, Nabi ne kaha, "Jab woh tumhare qareeb aa jaen, unpar teer chalao."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:While some Ethiopians were playing in the presence of the Prophet, `Umar came in, picked up a stone and hit them with it. On that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O `Umar! Allow them (to play)." Ma`mar (the subnarrator) added that they were playing in the Mosque
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jabke kuch Ethiopiyon log Nabi ki maujoodgi mein khel rahe the, Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) aaye, ek patthar uthaya aur unhe usse maara. Isspar Nabi ne kaha, "Aye Umar! Unhe (khelne do)." Ma'mar, doosre raawi ne joda ke woh masjid mein khel rahe the.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Abu Talha and the Prophet (ﷺ) used to shield themselves with one shield. Abu Talha was a good archer, and when he threw (his arrows) the Prophet (ﷺ) would look at the target of his arrows
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Nabi ek dhaal se khud ko bachate the. Abu Talha ek achhe tirandaaz the, aur jab woh teer chalate, Nabi unke teer ke nishaane ki taraf dekhte.

e: Narrated Sahl:When the helmet of the Prophet (ﷺ) was smashed on his head and blood covered his face and one of his front teeth got broken, `Ali brought the water in his shield and Fatima the Prophet's daughter) washed him. But when she saw that the bleeding increased more by the water, she took a mat, burnt it, and placed the ashes on the wound of the Prophet (ﷺ) and so the blood stopped oozing out
hi: Sahl bataate hain: Jab Nabi ka khod (helmet) unke sar par tut gaya aur khoon se unka chehra dhak gaya aur unka ek agla daant tut gaya, Ali (Alayhis Salam) apni dhaal mein paani laaye aur Fatima (Alayhas Salam) (Nabi ki beti) ne unhe dhoya. Magar jab unhone dekha ke khoon paani se aur zyada behne laga, unhone ek chataee li, use jalaya, aur uski raakh Nabi ke zakhm par lagaee, aur isse khoon behna band ho gaya.

e: Narrated `Umar:The properties of Bani An-Nadir which Allah had transferred to His Apostle as Fai Booty were not gained by the Muslims with their horses and camels. The properties therefore, belonged especially to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who used to give his family their yearly expenditure and spend what remained thereof on arms and horses to be used in Allah's Cause
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Bani An-Nadir ki maal jo Allah ne apne Rasool ko Fai maal-e-ghanimat ke tor par di, unhe Musalmanon ne apne ghodon aur unton se hasil nahi kiya. Isliye woh maal khaas Allah ke Rasool ki thi, jo apne pariwara ko saalana kharch dete aur baaki apne paas rakhe hathiyaar aur ghodon par kharch karte the jo Allah ki raah mein istemal hote.

e: Narrated `Ali:I never saw the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Let my parents sacrifice their lives for you," to any man after Sa`d. I heard him saying (to him), "Throw (the arrows)! Let my parents sacrifice their lives for you
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Maine kabhi Nabi ko kisi doosre shaks ke liye "Mere maa-baap tumpar qurbaan ho" kehte nahi suna siwaye Sa'd ke. Maine unhe (Sa'd se) kehte suna, "Teer chalao! Mere maa-baap tumpar qurbaan ho."

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to my house while two girls were singing beside me the songs of Bu'ath (a story about the war between the two tribes of the Ansar, i.e. Khazraj and Aus, before Islam.) The Prophet (ﷺ) reclined on the bed and turned his face to the other side. Abu Bakr came and scolded me and said protestingly, "Instrument of Satan in the presence of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) turned his face towards him and said, "Leave them." When Abu Bakr became inattentive, I waved the two girls to go away and they left. It was the day of `Id when negroes used to play with leather shields and spears. Either I requested Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) or he himself asked me whether I would like to see the display. I replied in the affirmative. Then he let me stand behind him and my cheek was touching his cheek and he was saying, "Carry on, O Bani Arfida (i.e. negroes)!" When I got tired, he asked me if that was enough. I replied in the affirmative and he told me to leave
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool mere ghar aaye jabke do ladkiyaan mere paas Bu'ath ke geet gaa rahi thi (Ansaar ke do qabilon, Khazraj aur Aus, ke beech Islam se pehle ki jung ki kahani). Nabi bistar par lete aur apna chehra doosri taraf mod liya. Abu Bakr aaye aur mujhe daanta aur ehtiraaz karte huye kaha, "Shaitaan ka saaz Allah ke Rasool ki maujoodgi mein?" Allah ke Rasool ne apna chehra unki taraf mod kar kaha, "Unhe chhod do." Jab Abu Bakr ka dhyaan hat gaya, maine do ladkiyon ko ishare se jaane ko kaha aur woh chali gaee. Yeh Eid ka din tha jab kaale log chamde ki dhalon aur bharcho ke saath khelte the. Ya to maine Allah ke Rasool se guzarish ki ya unhone khud mujhse pucha kya main yeh tamaasha dekhna chahungi. Maine haan mein jawab diya. Phir unhone mujhe apne peeche khade hone diya aur mera gaal unke gaal se chhu raha tha aur woh keh rahe the, "Jaari rakho, Aye Bani Arfida (yaani kaale log)!" Jab main thak gayi, unhone pucha kya itna kaafi hai. Maine haan mein jawab diya aur unhone mujhe jaane ko kaha.

e: Narrated Anas:The 'Prophet was the best and the bravest amongst the people. Once the people of Medina got terrified at night, so they went in the direction of the noise (that terrified them). The Prophet (ﷺ) met them (on his way back) after he had found out the truth. He was riding an unsaddled horse belonging to Abu Talha and a sword was hanging by his neck, and he was saying, "Don't be afraid! Don't be afraid!" He further said, "I found it (i.e. the horse) very fast," or said, "This horse is very fast." (Qastala-ni)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi sab logon mein sabse behtar aur sabse bahadur the. Ek baar Madina ke log raat ko dar gaye, isliye woh us aawaaz ki taraf gaye (jisne unhe daraya). Nabi unse (wapas aate hue) mile, sach jaankar. Woh Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) ka bina jin (saddle) wala ghoda par sawar the aur unki gardan mein talwar latki hui thi, aur woh keh rahe the, "Mat daro! Mat daro!" Unhone aage kaha, "Mujhe yeh (yaani ghoda) bahut tez laga," ya kaha, "Yeh ghoda bahut tez hai."

e: Narrated Abu Umama:Some people conquered many countries and their swords were decorated neither with gold nor silver, but they were decorated with leather, lead and iron
hi: Abu Umama (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Kuch logon ne bahut se desh fatah kiye aur unki talwaren na sone se sajaee hui thi na chandi se, balki chamde, seesa aur lohe se.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:That he proceeded in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) towards Najd to participate in a Ghazwa. (Holybattle) When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) returned, he too returned with him. Midday came upon them while they were in a valley having many thorny trees. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and the people dismounted and dispersed to rest in the shade of the trees. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) rested under a tree and hung his sword on it. We all took a nap and suddenly we heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) calling us. (We woke up) to see a bedouin with him. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "This bedouin took out my sword while I was sleeping and when I woke up, I found the unsheathed sword in his hand and he challenged me saying, 'Who will save you from me?' I said thrice, 'Allah.' The Prophet (ﷺ) did not punish him but sat down
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Woh Allah ke Rasool ke saath Najd ki taraf ek Ghazwa mein gaye. Jab Allah ke Rasool wapas aaye, woh bhi unke saath wapas aaye. Dopahar hui jabke woh ek waadi mein the jahan bahut se kaante darakht the. Allah ke Rasool aur log utre aur darakhton ke saaye mein aaram ke liye bikhar gaye. Allah ke Rasool ek darakht ke neeche aaram karne gaye aur uspar apni talwar taang di. Hum sab so gaye, aur achanak humne Allah ke Rasool ko humein bulate suna. (Hum uthe) aur dekha ek dehati unke saath tha. Nabi ne kaha, "Is dehati ne meri talwar nikal li jab main so raha tha aur jab main jaga, maine khuli talwar uske haath mein paee aur usne mujhe chunauti dete hue kaha, 'Kaun tumhe mujhse bachaega?' Maine teen baar kaha, 'Allah.'" Nabi ne use saza nahi di balki baith gaye.

e: Narrated Sahl:That he was asked about the wound of the Prophet (ﷺ) on the day (of the battle) of Uhud. He said, "The face of the Prophet (ﷺ) was wounded and one of his front teeth was broken and the helmet over his head was smashed. Fatima washed off the blood while `Ali held water. When she saw that the bleeding was increasing continuously, she burnt a mat (of date-palm leaves) till it turned into ashes which she put over the wound and thus the bleeding ceased
hi: Sahl bataate hain: Unse Uhud ki jung ke din Nabi ke zakhm ke baare mein pucha gaya. Unhone kaha, "Nabi ka chehra zakhmi hua aur unka ek agla daant tut gaya aur unke sar ka khod tut gaya. Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ne khoon dhoya jabke Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne paani rakha. Jab unhone dekha ke khoon lagatar badh raha hai, unhone ek chataee (khajoor ke patton ki) jalaee jab tak woh raakh ban gayi, jise unhone zakhm par rakha aur isse khoon behna ruk gaya."

e: Narrated `Amr bin Al-Harith:The Prophet (ﷺ) did not leave behind him after his death, anything except his arms, his white mule, and a piece of land at Khaibar which he left to be given in charity
hi: Amr bin Al-Harith bataate hain: Nabi ne apni maut ke baad apne peeche kuch nahi chhoda siwaye apne hathiyaar, apne safed khachchar, aur Khaibar mein zameen ka ek tukda jise unhone sadqe mein dene ke liye chhoda tha.

e: Narrated Jabir:as above (Hadith No. 158). Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah: That he participated in a Ghazwa (Holy-Battle) in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Midday came upon them while they were in a valley having many thorny trees. The people dispersed to rest in the shade of the trees. The Prophet (ﷺ) rested under a tree, hung his sword on it, and then slept. Then he woke up to find near to him, a man whose presence he had not noticed before. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "This (man) took my sword (out of its scabbard) and said, 'Who will save you from me.' I replied, 'Allah.' So, he put the sword back into its scabbard, and you see him sitting here." Anyhow, the Prophet (ﷺ) did not punish him. (See Hadith No)
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: (jaisa upar hai — Hadith No. 158). Jabir bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Woh Allah ke Rasool ke saath ek Ghazwa mein shaamil the. Dopahar hui jabke woh ek waadi mein the jahan bahut se kaante darakht the. Log darakhton ke saaye mein aaram ke liye bikhar gaye. Nabi ek darakht ke neeche aaram karne gaye, uspar apni talwar taang di, phir soye. Phir woh jaage aur dekha unke qareeb ek shaks hai jiski maujoodgi unhone pehle mahsoos nahi ki thi. Nabi ne kaha, "Is (shaks) ne meri talwar (uske miaan se) nikali aur kaha, 'Kaun tumhe mujhse bachaega.' Maine jawab diya, 'Allah.' Isliye usne talwar wapas uske miaan mein rakh di, aur tum use yahan baite dekh rahe ho." Beshak, Nabi ne use saza nahi di.

e: Narrated Abu Qatada:That he was in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and when they had covered a portion of the road to Mecca, he and some of the companions lagged behind. The latter were in a state of Ihram, while he was not. He saw an onager and rode his horse and requested his companions to give him his lash but they refused. Then he asked them to give him his spear but they refused, so he took it himself, attacked the onager, and killed it. Some of the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) ate of it while some others refused to eat. When they caught up with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) they asked him about that, and he said, "That was a meal Allah fed you with." (It is also said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked, "Have you got something of its meat?
hi: Abu Qatada (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Woh Allah ke Rasool ke saath the aur jab unhone Mecca ke raaste ka kuch hissa tay kar liya, woh aur kuch sahaba peeche reh gaye. Woh (peeche wale) Ihram mein the, jabke woh (Abu Qatada) nahi the. Unhone ek jangli gadha dekha aur apne ghode par sawar hue aur apne sathiyon se apna chaabuk maanga magar unhone inkaar kar diya. Phir unhone apni bhala maangi magar unhone inkaar kiya, isliye unhone khud le li, jangli gadhe par hamla kiya, aur use zabah kiya. Nabi ke kuch sahaba ne usme se khaya jabke doosron ne khane se inkaar kiya. Jab woh Allah ke Rasool se mile, unhone iske baare mein pucha, aur unhone kaha, "Yeh ek khaana tha jo Allah ne tumhe khilaya." (Yeh bhi kaha jata hai ke Allah ke Rasool ne pucha, "Kya tumhare paas iska kuch gosht hai?")

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) , while in a tent (on the day of the battle of Badr) said, "O Allah! I ask you the fulfillment of Your Covenant and Promise. O Allah! If You wish (to destroy the believers) You will never be worshipped after today." Abu Bakr caught him by the hand and said, "This is sufficient, O Allah's Apostle! You have asked Allah pressingly." The Prophet (ﷺ) was clad in his armor at that time. He went out, saying to me: "Their multitude will be put to flight and they will show their backs. Nay, but the Hour is their appointed time (for their full recompense) and that Hour will be more grievous and more bitter (than their worldly failure)." (54.45-46) Khalid said that was on the day of the battle of Badr
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne, ek khaime mein (Badr ki jung ke din), kaha, "Aye Allah! Main tujhse Tere ahad aur waade ki poorti maangta hoon. Aye Allah! Agar tu chahe (imandaron ko barbaad karna), tujhe aaj ke baad kabhi ibadat nahi ki jaayegi." Abu Bakr ne unka haath pakada aur kaha, "Yeh kaafi hai, Aye Allah ke Rasool! Aapne Allah se bade zor se maanga hai." Nabi us waqt apna zire pehne hue the. Woh bahar gaye, mujhse kehte huye: "Unki bheed harigi aur woh peeth dikhaenge. Balki, Qiyamat unke liye muqarrar waqt hai (poori saza ke liye), aur woh waqt zyada dukhad aur karva hoga (unki duniyawi haar se)" (54:45-46). Khalid ne kaha yeh Badr ki jung ke din hua.

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died while his (iron) armor was mortgaged to a Jew for thirty Sas of barley
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool ka intiqal hua jabke unka (lohe ka) zire ek Yahudi ke paas teen Sa jau ke badle girvi tha.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The example of a miser and the one who gives in charity, is like the example of two men wearing iron cloaks so tightly that their arms are raised forcibly towards their collar-bones. So, whenever a charitable person wants to give in charity, his cloak spreads over his body so much so that it wipes out his traces, but whenever the miser wants to give in charity, the rings (of the iron cloak) come closer to each other and press over his body, and his hands get connected to his collarbones. Abu Huraira heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying. "The miser then tries to widen it but in vain
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Kanjoos aur sadqa dekar wale ki misaal do logon jaisi hai jinhone lohe ke choge pehne hue hain, itne tang ke unke haath zabardasti unke gale ki haddiyon ki taraf uthe hue hain. Isliye jab bhi sadqa dekar shaks sadqa dena chahta hai, uska choga uske jism par is tarah phailta hai ke uske nishaan tak mit jate hain, magar jab bhi kanjoos sadqa dena chahta hai, (lohe ke choge ki) kadiyan ek-doosre ke qareeb aa jati hain aur uske jism par dabaav daalti hain, aur uske haath uske gale ki haddiyon se judd jate hain." Abu Huraira ne Nabi ko kehte suna, "Kanjoos phir ise phailane ki koshish karta hai magar be-faida."

e: Narrated Al-Mughira bin Shu`ba:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went out to answer the call of nature and on his return I brought some water to him. He performed the ablution while he was wearing a Sha'mi cloak. He rinsed his mouth and washed his nose by putting water in it and then blowing it out, and washed his face. Then he tried to take out his hands through his sleeves but they were tight, so he took them out from underneath, washed them and passed wet hands over his head and over his leather socks
hi: Al-Mughira bin Shu'ba (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool qaza-e-hajat ke liye bahar gaye aur wapasi par main unke liye kuch paani laaya. Unhone wudu kiya jabke woh ek Shaami choga pehne hue the. Unhone kulla kiya aur naak mein paani daalkar use phoonk kar saaf kiya, phir chehra dhoya. Phir unhone apne haath aastinon se bahar nikalne ki koshish ki magar woh tang the, isliye unhone unhe neeche se nikala, dhoya, aur gile haath apne sar aur apne chamde ke mojon par phere.

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) allowed `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf and Az-Zubair to wear silken shirts because they had a skin disease causing itching
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Abdur-Rahman bin Auf aur Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko resham ki qameejen pehnne ki ijazat di kyunke unhe khaal ki bimari thi jisse khujli hoti thi.

e: Narrated Anas:As above. Narrated Anas: `Abdur Rahman bin `Auf and Az-Zubair complained to the Prophet, i.e. about the lice (that caused itching) so he allowed them to wear silken clothes. I saw them wearing such clothes in a holy battle
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: (jaisa upar hai). Anas bataate hain: Abdur-Rahman bin Auf aur Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Nabi se shikayat ki, yaani juon (lice, jisse khujli hoti hai) ke baare mein, isliye unhone unhe resham ke kapde pehnne ki ijazat di. Maine unhe ek muqaddas jung mein aise kapde pehne dekha.

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) allowed `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf and Az-Zubair bin Al-`Awwam to wear silk
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Abdur-Rahman bin Auf aur Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Awwam ko resham pehnne ki ijazat di.

e: Narrated Anas:(Wearing of silk) was allowed to them (i.e. `AbdurRahman and Az-Zubair) because of the itching they suffered from
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: (Resham pehnna) unhe (yaani Abdur-Rahman aur Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko) khujli ki wajah se jo unhe hoti thi, ijazat di gayi thi.

e: Narrated Umaiya Ad-Damri:I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) eating of a shoulder (of a sheep) by cutting from it and then he was called to prayer and he prayed without repeating his ablution. Narrated Az-Zuhri: as above (Hadith No. 173...) and added that the Prophet (ﷺ) put the knife down
hi: Umaiya Ad-Damri bataate hain: Maine Nabi ko ek bhed ke shoulder ka gosht katte huye khate dekha, phir unhe namaz ke liye bulaya gaya aur unhone bina wudu dohrae namaz padhi. Az-Zuhri bataate hain: (jaisa upar hai — Hadith No. 173...) aur joda ke Nabi ne chaaku neeche rakh diya.

e: Narrated Khalid bin Madan:That 'Umair bin Al-Aswad Al-Ansi told him that he went to 'Ubada bin As-Samit while he was staying in his house at the sea-shore of Hims with (his wife) Um Haram. 'Umair said. Um Haram informed us that she heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Paradise is granted to the first batch of my followers who will undertake a naval expedition." Um Haram added, I said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Will I be amongst them?' He replied, 'You are amongst them.' The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, 'The first army amongst' my followers who will invade Caesar's City will be forgiven their sins.' I asked, 'Will I be one of them, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?' He replied in the negative
hi: Khalid bin Madan bataate hain: Umair bin Al-Aswad Al-Ansi ne unhe bataya ke woh Ubada bin As-Samit ke paas gaye jab woh Hims ke samundri kinare apne ghar mein (apni biwi) Um Haram ke saath rah rahe the. Umair ne kaha, "Um Haram ne humein bataya ke unhone Nabi ko kehte suna, 'Jannat mere pairokaron ki pahli toli ko di jaayegi jo samundari muhim mein jaayegi.'" Um Haram ne joda, "Maine kaha, 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Kya main unme se hoongi?' Aap ne jawab diya, 'Tum unme se ho.'" Nabi ne phir kaha, "Mere pairokaron ki pahli fauj jo Caesar ke shehar par hamla karegi, unke gunah maaf kiye jaayenge." Maine pucha, "Kya main unme se ek hoongi, Ya Allah ke Rasool?" Aap ne na mein jawab diya.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "You (i.e. Muslims) will fight with the Jews until some of them will hide behind stones. The stones will (betray them) saying, 'O `Abdullah (i.e. slave of Allah)! There is a Jew hiding behind me; so kill him
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Tum (yaani Musalman) Yahudiyon se jung karoge jab tak unme se kuch pattharon ke peeche chhupne lagenge. Patthar (unhe dhoka dekar) kahenge, 'Aye Abdullah (yaani Allah ke bande)! Ek Yahudi mere peeche chhupa hai; use qatl karo.'"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The Hour will not be established until you fight with the Jews, and the stone behind which a Jew will be hiding will say. "O Muslim! There is a Jew hiding behind me, so kill him
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Qiyamat tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak tum Yahudiyon se jung na karo, aur jis patthar ke peeche ek Yahudi chhupa hoga, woh kahega, 'Aye Musalman! Ek Yahudi mere peeche chhupa hai, use qatl karo.'"

e: Narrated `Amr bin Taghlib:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "One of the portents of the Hour is that you will fight with people wearing shoes made of hair; and one of the portents of the Hour is that you will fight with broad-faced people whose faces will look like shields coated with leather
hi: Amr bin Taghlib (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Qiyamat ki ek nishaani yeh hai ke tum baal se bane joote pehne logon se jung karoge; aur Qiyamat ki ek nishaani yeh hai ke tum chaude chehre wale logon se jung karoge jinke chehre chamde se dhake dhalon jaise dikhenge."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The Hour will not be established until you fight with the Turks; people with small eyes, red faces, and flat noses. Their faces will look like shields coated with leather. The Hour will not be established till you fight with people whose shoes are made of hair
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Qiyamat tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak tum Turkon se jung na karo; chhoti aankhon, laal chehron, aur chapti naak wale log. Unke chehre chamde se dhake dhalon jaise dikhenge. Qiyamat tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak tum baal se bane joote pehne logon se jung na karo."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The Hour will not be established till you fight with people wearing shoes made of hair. And the Hour will not be established till you fight with people whose faces look like shields coated with leather. " (Abu Huraira added, "They will be) small-eyed, flat nosed, and their faces will look like shields coated with leather
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Qiyamat tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak tum baal se bane joote pehne logon se jung na karo. Aur Qiyamat tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak tum un logon se jung na karo jinke chehre chamde se dhake dhalon jaise dikhte hon." (Abu Huraira ne joda, "Woh) chhoti aankhon, chapti naak wale honge, aur unke chehre chamde se dhake dhalon jaise dikhenge."

e: Narrated Abu 'Is-haq:A man asked Al-Bara', "O Abu '`Umara! Did you all flee on the day (of the battle) of Hunain?" He replied, "No, by Allah! Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not flee, but his young unarmed companions passed by the archers of the tribe of Hawazin and Bani Nasr whose arrows hardly missed a target, and they threw arrows at them hardly missing a shot. So the Muslims retreated towards the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was riding his white mule which was being led by his cousin Abu Sufyan bin Al-Harith bin `Abdul Muttalib. The Prophet (ﷺ) dismounted and invoked Allah for victory; then he said, 'I am the Prophet, without a lie; I am the son of `Abdul Muttalib, and then he arranged his companions in rows
hi: Abu Ishaq bataate hain: Ek shaks ne Al-Bara se pucha, "Aye Abu Umara! Kya tum sab Hunain ke din bhaage the?" Unhone jawab diya, "Nahi, Allah ki qasam! Allah ke Rasool nahi bhaage, magar unke jawan bina hathiyaar wale sahaba Hawazin aur Bani Nasr qabile ke tirandaazon ke paas se guzre jinke teer shaayad hi apna nishaan chukte, aur unhone unpar teer chalaye jo shaayad hi apna nishaan chukte.
