Isliye Musalman Nabi ki taraf peeche hate jabke woh apne safed khachchar par sawar the jise unke chachazaad bhai Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Harith bin Abdul Muttalib le ja rahe the. Nabi utre aur fatah ke liye Allah se dua ki; phir unhone kaha, 'Main Nabi hoon, bina jhoot ke; Main Abdul Muttalib ka beta hoon,' aur phir unhone apne sahaba ko safon mein khada kiya."

e: Narrated `Ali:When it was the day of the battle of Al-Ahzab (i.e. the clans), Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! Fill their (i.e. the infidels') houses and graves with fire as they busied us so much that we did not perform the prayer (i.e. `Asr) till the sun set
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Jab Al-Ahzab (qabilon) ki jung ka din tha, Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Aye Allah! Unke (yaani kaafiron ke) gharon aur qabron ko aag se bhar de kyunke unhone humein itna masroof rakha ke humne Asr ki namaz suraj doobne tak nahi padhi."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to recite the following invocations during Qunut: "O Allah! Save Salama bin Hisham. O Allah! Save Al-Walid bin Al-Walid. O Allah! Save `Aiyash bin Rabi`a O Allah ! Save the weak Muslims. O Allah! Be very hard on Mudar tribe. O Allah! Afflict them with years (of famine) similar to the (famine) years of the time of Prophet Joseph
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi Qunut ke dauran yeh dua padhte the: "Aye Allah! Salama bin Hisham ko bachaa. Aye Allah! Al-Walid bin Al-Walid ko bachaa. Aye Allah! Aiyash bin Rabi'a ko bachaa. Aye Allah! Kamzor Musalmanon ko bachaa. Aye Allah! Mudar qabile par sakhti kar. Aye Allah! Unhe Nabi Yusuf ke zamane jaisa akaal ke saal bhugatne de."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abi `Aufa:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) invoked evil upon the pagans on the ay (of the battle) of Al-Ahzab, saying, "O Allah! The Revealer of the Holy Book, the Swift-Taker of Accounts, O Allah, defeat Al-Ahzab (i.e. the clans), O Allah, defeat them and shake them
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Aufa bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Al-Ahzab ki jung ke din mushrikon ke khilaf bad-dua ki, kehte huye, "Aye Allah! Paak Kitaab ke Naazil karne wale, Tez Hisaab lene wale, Aye Allah, Al-Ahzab (qabilon) ko haar de, Aye Allah, unhe haar de aur unhe jhinjhod de."

e: Narrated `Abdullah:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) was offering the prayer in the shade of the Ka`ba. Abu Jahl and some Quraishi men sent somebody to bring the Abdominal contents of a she-camel which had been slaughtered somewhere in Mecca, and when he brought them, they put them over the Prophet (ﷺ) Then Fatima (i.e. the Prophet's daughter) came and threw them away from him, and he said, "O Allah! Destroy (the pagans of) Quraish; O Allah! Destroy Quraish; O Allah Destroy Quraish," naming especially Abu Jahl bin Hisham, `Utba bin Rabi`a, Shaiba bin Rabi`a, Al Walid bin `Utba, Ubai bin Khalaf and `Uqba bin Abi Muait. (The narrator, `Abdullah added, "I saw them all killed and thrown in the Badr well)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Nabi Ka'ba ke saaye mein namaz padh rahe the. Abu Jahl aur kuch Quraish logon ne kisi ko bheja ke woh ek zabah ki hui untni ke pet ke andaruni hisse laaye jo Mecca mein kahin zabah ki gayi thi, aur jab woh unhe laaya, unhone unhe Nabi par daal diya. Phir Fatima (Alayhas Salam) (Nabi ki beti) aai aur unhe unse hataya, aur Nabi ne kaha, "Aye Allah! Quraish ko (mushrikon ko) barbaad kar; Aye Allah! Quraish ko barbaad kar; Aye Allah! Quraish ko barbaad kar," khaas tor par Abu Jahl bin Hisham, Utba bin Rabi'a, Shaiba bin Rabi'a, Al-Walid bin Utba, Ubai bin Khalaf aur Uqba bin Abi Muait ka naam lekar. (Raawi, Abdullah ne joda, "Maine unhe sab qatl hote aur Badr ke kue mein pheke jate dekha.")

e: Narrated `Aisha:Once the Jews came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "Death be upon you." So I cursed them. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "What is the matter?" I said, "Have you not heard what they said?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Have you not heard what I replied (to them)? (I said), ('The same is upon you)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ek baar Yahudi Nabi ke paas aaye aur kaha, "Tumpar maut ho." Isliye maine unhe bad-dua di. Nabi ne kaha, "Kya baat hai?" Maine kaha, "Kya aapne nahi suna unhone kya kaha?" Nabi ne kaha, "Kya tumne nahi suna maine unhe kya jawab diya? (Maine kaha), 'Yehi tumpar bhi ho.'"

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) wrote a letter to Caesar saying, "If you reject Islam, you will be responsible for the sins of the tillers (i.e. your people)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Caesar ko ek khat likha, "Agar tum Islam qubool karne se inkaar karte ho, to tum apni raaya (kisaanon) ke gunahon ke zimmedaar hoge."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Tufail bin `Amr Ad-Dausi and his companions came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! The people of the tribe of Daus disobeyed and refused to follow you; so invoke Allah against them." The people said, "The tribe of Daus is ruined." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! Give guidance to the people of Daus, and let them embrace Islam
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Tufail bin Amr Ad-Dausi aur unke sathi Nabi ke paas aaye aur kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Daus qabile ke log na-farmani karte hain aur aapki baat manne se inkaar karte hain; isliye unke khilaf Allah se dua kijiye." Logon ne kaha, "Daus qabila barbaad ho gaya." Nabi ne kaha, "Aye Allah! Daus qabile ko hidayat de aur unhe Islam qubool karne de."

e: Narrated Anas:When the Prophet (ﷺ) intended to write a letter to the ruler of the Byzantines, he was told that those people did not read any letter unless it was stamped with a seal. So, the Prophet (ﷺ) got a silver ring-- as if I were just looking at its white glitter on his hand ---- and stamped on it the expression "Muhammad, Apostle of Allah
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Nabi ne Byzantines ke hukmaran ko khat likhna chaha, unhe bataya gaya ke woh log koi bhi khat nahi padhte jab tak uspar koi muhar na ho. Isliye Nabi ne ek chandi ki angoothi banwaee — jaise main abhi bhi uski safed chamak unke haath par dekh raha hoon — aur uspar "Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool" ke alfaaz khudwaye.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent his letter to Khusrau and ordered his messenger to hand it over to the Governor of Bahrain who was to hand it over to Khusrau. So, when Khusrau read the letter he tore it. Sa`id bin Al- Musaiyab said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) then invoked Allah to disperse them with full dispersion, (destroy them (i.e. Khusrau and his followers) severely
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne apna khat Khusrau ko bheja aur apne khaddam ko hukum diya ke woh Bahrain ke gawarnar ko de jo use aage Khusrau ko dena tha. Jab Khusrau ne khat padha, usne use phaad diya. Sa'id bin Al-Musaiyab ne kaha, "Nabi ne phir Allah se dua ki ke woh unhe (Khusrau aur uske pairokaron ko) bikher de, poori tarah bikher de, unhe sakhti se barbaad kar de."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) wrote to Caesar and invited him to Islam and sent him his letter with Dihya Al-Kalbi whom Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered to hand it over to the Governor of Busra who would forward it to Caesar. Caesar as a sign of gratitude to Allah, had walked from Hims to Ilya (i.e. Jerusalem) when Allah had granted Him victory over the Persian forces. So, when the letter of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) reached Caesar, he said after reading it, 'Seek for me any one of his people! (Arabs of Quraish tribe) if present here, in order to ask him about Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). At that time Abu Sufyan bin Harb was in Sham with some men from Quraish who had come (to Sham) as merchants during the truce that had been concluded between Allah's Messenger (ﷺ); and the infidels of Quraish. Abu Sufyan said, Caesar's messenger found us somewhere in Sham so he took me and my companions to Ilya and we were admitted into Caesar's court to find him sitting in his royal court wearing a crown and surrounded by the senior dignitaries of the Byzantine. He said to his translator. 'Ask them who amongst them is a close relation to the man who claims to be a prophet." Abu Sufyan added, "I replied, 'I am the nearest relative to him.' He asked, 'What degree of relationship do you have with him?' I replied, 'He is my cousin,' and there was none of Bani Abu Manaf in the caravan except myself. Caesar said, 'Let him come nearer.' He then ordered that my companions stand behind me near my shoulder and said to his translator, 'Tell his companions that I am going to ask this man about the man who claims to be a prophet. If he tells a lie, they should contradict him immediately." Abu Sufyan added, "By Allah! Had it not been shameful that my companions label me a liar, I would not have spoken the truth about him when he asked me. But I considered it shameful to be called a liar by my companions. So I told the truth. He then said to his translator, 'Ask him what kind of family does he belong to.' I replied, 'He belongs to a noble family amongst us.' He said, 'Has anybody else amongst you ever claimed the same before him? 'I replied, 'No.' He said, 'Had you ever blamed him for telling lies before he claimed what he claimed? ' I replied, 'No.' He said, 'Was anybody amongst his ancestors a king?' I replied, 'No.' He said, "Do the noble or the poor follow him?' I replied, 'It is the poor who follow him.' He said, 'Are they increasing or decreasing (day by day)?' I replied,' They are increasing.' He said, 'Does anybody amongst those who embrace his (the Prophet's) Religion become displeased and then discard his Religion?'. I replied, 'No. ' He said, 'Does he break his promises? I replied, 'No, but we are now at truce with him and we are afraid that he may betray us." Abu Sufyan added, "Other than the last sentence, I could not say anything against him. Caesar then asked, 'Have you ever had a war with him?' I replied, 'Yes.' He said, 'What was the outcome of your battles with him?' I replied, 'The result was unstable; sometimes he was victorious and sometimes we.' He said, 'What does he order you to do?' I said, 'He tells us to worship Allah alone, and not to worship others along with Him, and to leave all that our fore-fathers used to worship. He orders us to pray, give in charity, be chaste, keep promises and return what is entrusted to us.' When I had said that, Caesar said to his translator, 'Say to him: I asked you about his lineage and your reply was that he belonged to a noble family. In fact, all the apostles came from the noblest lineage of their nations. Then I questioned you whether anybody else amongst you had claimed such a thing, and your reply was in the negative. If the answer had been in the affirmative, I would have thought that this man was following a claim that had been said before him. When I asked you whether he was ever blamed for telling lies, your reply was in the negative, so I took it for granted that a person who did not tell a lie about (others) the people could never tell a lie about Allah. Then I asked you whether any of his ancestors was a king. Your reply was in the negative, and if it had been in the affirmative, I would have thought that this man wanted to take back his ancestral kingdom. When I asked you whether the rich or the poor people followed him, you replied that it was the poor who followed him. In fact, such are the followers of the apostles. Then I asked you whether his followers were increasing or decreasing. You replied that they were increasing. In fact, this is the result of true faith till it is complete (in all respects). I asked you whether there was anybody who, after embracing his religion, became displeased and discarded his religion; your reply was in the negative. In fact, this is the sign of true faith, for when its cheerfulness enters and mixes in the hearts completely, nobody will be displeased with it. I asked you whether he had ever broken his promise. You replied in the negative. And such are the apostles; they never break their promises. When I asked you whether you fought with him and he fought with you, you replied that he did, and that sometimes he was victorious and sometimes you. Indeed, such are the apostles; they are put to trials and the final victory is always theirs. Then I asked you what he ordered you. You replied that he ordered you to worship Allah alone and not to worship others along with Him, to leave all that your fore-fathers used to worship, to offer prayers, to speak the truth, to be chaste, to keep promises, and to return what is entrusted to you. These are really the qualities of a prophet who, I knew (from the previous Scriptures) would appear, but I did not know that he would be from amongst you. If what you say should be true, he will very soon occupy the earth under my feet, and if I knew that I would reach him definitely, I would go immediately to meet Him; and were I with him, then I would certainly wash his feet.' " Abu Sufyan added, "Caesar then asked for the letter of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and it was read. Its contents were: "In the name of Allah, the most Beneficent, the most Merciful (This letter is) from Muhammad, the slave of Allah, and His Apostle, to Heraclius, the Ruler of the Byzantine. Peace be upon the followers of guidance. Now then, I invite you to Islam (i.e. surrender to Allah), embrace Islam and you will be safe; embrace Islam and Allah will bestow on you a double reward. But if you reject this invitation of Islam, you shall be responsible for misguiding the tillers (i.e. your nation). O people of the Scriptures! Come to a word common to you and us and you, that we worship none but Allah, and that we associate nothing in worship with Him; and that none of us shall take others as Lords besides Allah. Then if they turn away, say: Bear witness that we are (they who have surrendered (unto Him)..(3.64) Abu Sufyan added, "When Heraclius had finished his speech, there was a great hue and cry caused by the Byzantine Royalties surrounding him, and there was so much noise that I did not understand what they said. So, we were turned out of the court. When I went out with my companions and we were alone, I said to them, 'Verily, Ibn Abi Kabsha's (i.e. the Prophet's) affair has gained power. This is the King of Bani Al-Asfar fearing him." Abu Sufyan added, "By Allah, I remained low and was sure that his religion would be victorious till Allah converted me to Islam, though I disliked it
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Caesar ko khat likha aur unhe Islam ki taraf bulaya, aur apna khat Dihya Al-Kalbi ke saath bheja jisse Allah ke Rasool ne hukum diya ke woh use Busra ke gawarnar ko de jo aage Caesar tak pahunchaata. Caesar ne, Allah ka shukriya ada karte huye, Hims se Ilya (yaani Jerusalem) tak paidal chala tha jab Allah ne unhe Farsiyon par fatah di thi. Isliye jab Allah ke Rasool ka khat Caesar tak pahuncha, usne padhne ke baad kaha, "Dhoondo koi bhi shaks uski qaum se (Quraish qabile ke Arab), agar yahan maujood ho, taake main unse Allah ke Rasool ke baare mein pucch sakoon." Us waqt Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Harb Sham mein the kuch Quraish logon ke saath jo (Sham mein) taajir ke tor par aaye the us sulha ke dauran jo Allah ke Rasool aur Quraish ke mushrikon ke beech ho chuki thi. Abu Sufyan ne kaha, "Caesar ke khaddamon ne humein Sham mein kahin paaya, isliye woh mujhe aur mere sathiyon ko Ilya le gaye aur humein Caesar ke darbaar mein daakhil kiya, jahan hamne unhe apne shahi darbaar mein taj pehne, aur Byzantine ke bade adhikariyon se ghire hue baithe paaya. Unhone apne anuvaadak se kaha, 'Unse pucho unme se koi is shaks ka nazdeeki rishtedaar hai kya jo Nabi hone ka dawa karta hai.'" Abu Sufyan ne joda, "Maine jawab diya, 'Main uska sabse nazdeeki rishtedaar hoon.' Usne pucha, 'Tumhara usse kya rishta hai?' Maine jawab diya, 'Woh mera chachazaad bhai hai,' aur us qafile mein Bani Abu Manaf ke siwa koi aur nahi tha. Caesar ne kaha, 'Use qareeb aane do.' Phir usne hukum diya ke mere sathi mere kandhon ke qareeb mere peeche khade hon aur apne anuvaadak se kaha, 'Unke sathiyon se kaho ke main is shaks se un shakhs ke baare mein pucchunga jo Nabi hone ka dawa karta hai. Agar woh jhoot bole, unhe foran uska khandan karna chahiye.'" Abu Sufyan ne joda, "Allah ki qasam! Agar yeh sharam ki baat na hoti ke mere sathi mujhe jhuta kahen, main unke baare mein sach nahi bolta jab usne mujhse pucha. Magar maine ise sharam ki baat samjha ke mere sathi mujhe jhuta kahen. Isliye maine sach bola. Phir usne apne anuvaadak se kaha, 'Unse pucho woh kaunse khaandaan se ta'alluq rakhte hain.' Maine jawab diya, 'Woh humare beech ke ek izzatdaar khaandaan se hain.' Usne kaha, 'Kya kisi doosre ne bhi tum mein pehle aisa daava kiya hai?' Maine jawab diya, 'Nahi.' Usne kaha, 'Kya tumne kabhi unhe unke daave se pehle jhoot bolne ka ilzaam lagaya tha?' Maine jawab diya, 'Nahi.' Usne kaha, 'Kya unke pura-khon mein koi raja tha?' Maine jawab diya, 'Nahi.' Usne kaha, "Kya izzatdaar log ya gareeb log unki pairvi karte hain?' Maine jawab diya, 'Gareeb log unki pairvi karte hain.' Usne kaha, 'Kya woh badh rahe hain ya kam ho rahe hain (din-ba-din)?' Maine jawab diya, 'Woh badh rahe hain.' Usne kaha, 'Kya unke deen ko apnane wale koi naraaj hokar apna deen chhodta hai?' Maine jawab diya, 'Nahi.' Usne kaha, 'Kya woh apne waade todte hain?' Maine jawab diya, 'Nahi, magar hum abhi unke saath sulha mein hain aur humein dar hai woh humse dagabaazi karenge.'" Abu Sufyan ne joda, "Iske ilawa, mujhe unke khilaf kuch aur kehne ka mauka nahi mila. Caesar ne phir pucha, 'Kya tumne kabhi unse jung ki hai?' Maine jawab diya, 'Haan.' Usne kaha, 'Tumhari jungon ka natija kya raha?' Maine jawab diya, 'Natija badalta raha; kabhi woh jeete, kabhi hum.' Usne kaha, 'Woh tumhe kya karne ka hukum dete hain?' Maine kaha, 'Woh humein sirf Allah ki ibadat karne ka hukum dete hain, aur uske saath kisi aur ki ibadat na karne ka, aur woh sab kuch chhodne ka jo humare pura-khan parastish karte the. Woh humein namaz padhne, sadqa dene, pakbaaz rehne, waade poore karne aur amanat wapas karne ka hukum dete hain.' Jab maine yeh kaha, Caesar ne apne anuvaadak se kaha, 'Unse kaho: Maine tumse unke khaandaan ke baare mein pucha aur tumne jawab diya ke woh ek izzatdaar khaandaan se hain. Asal mein, sab Rasool apni qaum ke sabse izzatdaar khaandaanon se aate hain. Phir maine tumse pucha kya tum mein kisi aur ne aisa daava kiya tha, aur tumhara jawab na tha. Agar jawab haan hota, main sochta yeh shaks pehle ke kisi daave ki pairvi kar raha hai. Jab maine tumse pucha kya unpar kabhi jhoot bolne ka ilzaam laga, tumhara jawab na tha, isliye maine samajh liya ke jo shaks doosron ke baare mein jhoot nahi bolta, woh Allah ke baare mein kabhi jhoot nahi bol sakta. Phir maine tumse pucha kya unke kisi pura-khe mein koi raja tha. Tumhara jawab na tha, aur agar haan hota, main sochta yeh shaks apni pura-khon ki badshaahat wapas lena chahta hai. Jab maine tumse pucha kya maldaar ya gareeb log unki pairvi karte hain, tumne jawab diya gareeb log. Asal mein, aise hi log Rasoolon ke pairokaar hote hain. Phir maine tumse pucha kya unke pairokaar badh rahe hain ya kam ho rahe hain. Tumne jawab diya woh badh rahe hain. Asal mein, yeh sacche iman ka natija hai jab tak woh (sab prakaar se) mukammal na ho jaaye. Maine tumse pucha kya koi shaks jo unka deen apnane ke baad naraaj hokar apna deen chhodta hai; tumhara jawab na tha. Asal mein, yeh sacche iman ki nishaani hai, kyunke jab uski khushi dil mein poori tarah ghul jati hai, koi usse naraaj nahi hota. Maine tumse pucha kya unhone kabhi apna waada toda. Tumne na mein jawab diya. Aur aise hi Rasool hote hain; woh kabhi apne waade nahi todte. Jab maine tumse pucha kya tum unse lade aur woh tumse lade, tumne jawab diya haan, aur kabhi woh jeete kabhi tum. Beshak, aise hi Rasool hote hain; unhe azmaishon mein daala jaata hai magar aakhri fatah hamesha unhi ki hoti hai. Phir maine tumse pucha unhone tumhe kya hukum diya. Tumne jawab diya woh tumhe sirf Allah ki ibadat karne aur uske saath kisi aur ki ibadat na karne, sab kuch jo tumhare pura-khe parastish karte the woh chhodne, namaz padhne, sach bolne, pakbaaz rehne, waade poore karne, aur amanat wapas karne ka hukum dete hain. Yeh sach mein ek Nabi ki khaasiyaten hain jise (purani Kitaabon se) main jaanta tha ke aayega, magar mujhe nahi pata tha ke woh tum mein se hoga. Agar tumhari baat sach hai, woh jald hi mere paon ke neeche ki zameen par bhi kaboo kar lega, aur agar mujhe yaqeen hota ke main zaroor unhe pahunch sakunga, main foran unse milne jata; aur agar main unke saath hota, to main zaroor unke paon dhota.'" Abu Sufyan ne joda, "Caesar ne phir Allah ke Rasool ka khat maanga aur woh padha gaya. Iske alfaaz the: 'Allah ke naam se jo bahut zyada meharbaan, nihaayat reham karne wala hai. (Yeh khat) Muhammad, Allah ke bande aur uske Rasool ki taraf se, Heraclius, Byzantine ke hukmaran ko. Salaam ho hidayat ke pairokaron par. Iske baad, main tumhe Islam ki taraf bulata hoon (yaani Allah ke aage samarpit ho jaao), Islam qubool karo aur tum mahfooz rahoge; Islam qubool karo aur Allah tumhe dohra ajr dega. Magar agar tum Islam ki yeh dawat radd karte ho, tum apni raaya (yaani apni qaum) ko galat raah dikhane ke zimmedaar hoge. Aye Kitaab walon! Aao ek aisi baat par jo hum sab mein saanjhi hai, ke hum sirf Allah ki ibadat karen, aur uske saath kisi ko na joden; aur hum mein se koi Allah ke siwa doosron ko Rab na maane. Phir agar woh mun mode, kaho: Gawaahi do ke hum (Allah ke aage) samarpit hain' (3:64)." Abu Sufyan ne joda, "Jab Heraclius ne apni baat khatam ki, uske aas-paas ke Byzantine shaahi logon ne bahut zyada hangama macha diya, aur itni shorgul thi ke maine samajha nahi woh kya keh rahe the. Isliye humein darbaar se bahar nikal diya gaya. Jab main apne sathiyon ke saath bahar gaya aur hum akele the, maine unse kaha, 'Beshak, Ibn Abi Kabsha (yaani Nabi) ka maamla taakatvar ho gaya hai. Yeh dekho Bani Al-Asfar (Byzantine) ka Raja bhi unse darta hai.'" Abu Sufyan ne joda, "Allah ki qasam, main hamesha yaqeen rakhta raha ke unka deen zaroor kaamyaab hoga jab tak Allah ne mujhe Islam ki taraf moda, chahe mujhe napasand tha."

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:That he heard the Prophet (ﷺ) on the day (of the battle) of Khaibar saying, "I will give the flag to a person at whose hands Allah will grant victory." So, the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) got up, wishing eagerly to see to whom the flag will be given, and everyone of them wished to be given the flag. But the Prophet asked for `Ali. Someone informed him that he was suffering from eye-trouble. So, he ordered them to bring `Ali in front of him. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) spat in his eyes and his eyes were cured immediately as if he had never any eye-trouble. `Ali said, "We will fight with them (i.e. infidels) till they become like us (i.e. Muslims)." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Be patient, till you face them and invite them to Islam and inform them of what Allah has enjoined upon them. By Allah! If a single person embraces Islam at your hands (i.e. through you), that will be better for you than the red camels
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Unhone Nabi ko Khaibar ki jung ke din kehte suna, "Main jhanda us shaks ko dunga jiske haath fatah dega Allah." Isliye Nabi ke sahaba uthe, betaab hote huye ke jhanda kise diya jaayega, aur har ek chahta tha ke use jhanda mile. Magar Nabi ne Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko bulwaya. Kisi ne unhe bataya ke Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki aankhon mein takleef hai. Isliye unhone unhe Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko apne saamne laane ka hukum diya. Phir Nabi ne unki aankhon mein thooka aur unki aankhen foran theek ho gayi jaise unhe kabhi koi takleef na thi. Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha, "Hum unse (yaani kaafiron se) tab tak ladenge jab tak woh humare jaise (yaani Musalman) na ban jaen." Nabi ne kaha, "Sabr karo, jab tak tum unke saamne na jaao aur unhe Islam ki dawat na do aur unhe woh na batao jo Allah ne unpar farz kiya hai. Allah ki qasam! Agar ek shaks bhi tumhare zariye Islam qubool kare, yeh tumhare liye laal unton se bhi behtar hai."

e: Narrated Anas:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) attacked some people, he would never attack them till it was dawn. If he heard the Adhan (i.e. call for prayer) he would delay the fight, and if he did not hear the Adhan, he would attack them immediately after dawn. We reached Khaibar at night
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab bhi Allah ke Rasool kisi qaum par hamla karte, woh subah ki roshni hone se pehle kabhi hamla nahi karte the. Agar woh Adhan (namaz ki azaan) sunte, jung talte, aur agar Adhan na sunte, foran subah hote hi hamla karte the. Hum raat ko Khaibar pahunche.

e: Narrated Anas:as Hadith No. 193 above
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: (jaisa upar hai — Hadith No. 193).

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) set out for Khaibar and reached it at night. He used not to attack if he reached the people at night, till the day broke. So, when the day dawned, the Jews came out with their bags and spades. When they saw the Prophet; they said, "Muhammad and his army!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, Allahu--Akbar! (Allah is Greater) and Khaibar is ruined, for whenever we approach a nation (i.e. enemy to fight) then it will be a miserable morning for those who have been warned
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi Khaibar ki taraf nikle aur raat ko wahan pahunche. Agar woh raat ko kisi qaum tak pahunchte, hamla nahi karte the jab tak subah na ho jaaye. Isliye jab subah hui, Yahudi apne thaile aur phaavde lekar bahar aaye. Jab unhone Nabi ko dekha, unhone kaha, "Muhammad aur uski fauj!" Nabi ne kaha, "Allahu Akbar! Aur Khaibar barbaad ho gaya, kyunke jab bhi hum kisi qaum (yaani dushman se ladne) ke qareeb jate hain, un logon ke liye jinhe pehle chetaavni di gayi thi, subah bahut buri hoti hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Apostle said, " I have been ordered to fight with the people till they say, 'None has the right to be worshipped but Allah,' and whoever says, 'None has the right to be worshipped but Allah,' his life and property will be saved by me except for Islamic law, and his accounts will be with Allah, (either to punish him or to forgive him)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Mujhe hukum diya gaya hai ke main logon se jung karun jab tak woh na kahen, 'Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahi,' aur jo bhi kahe, 'Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahi,' uski jaan aur maal mere zariye mahfooz honge siwaye Islami qanoon ke tehat, aur uska hisaab Allah ke paas hoga, (ya to use saza dene ke liye ya maaf karne ke liye)."

e: Narrated Ka`b bin Malik:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) intended to lead a Ghazwa, he would use an equivocation from which one would understand that he was going to a different destination
hi: Ka'b bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab bhi Allah ke Rasool ek Ghazwa ki agwaee karna chahte, woh koi indirect ishara istemal karte jisse log samajhte ke woh kisi doosri jagah jaane wale hain.

e: Narrated Ka`b bin Malik:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) intended to carry out a Ghazwa, he would use an equivocation to conceal his real destination till it was the Ghazwa of Tabuk which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) carried out in very hot weather. As he was going to face a very long journey through a wasteland and was to meet and attack a large number of enemies. So, he made the situation clear to the Muslims so that they might prepare themselves accordingly and get ready to conquer their enemy. The Prophet (ﷺ) informed them of the destination he was heading for
hi: Ka'b bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab bhi Allah ke Rasool ek Ghazwa ki taiyaari karte, woh apni asli manzil chhupane ke liye koi indirect ishara istemal karte, jab tak Ghazwa-e-Tabuk ka waqt aaya jise Allah ke Rasool ne bahut garmi wale mausam mein anjaam diya. Chunke unhe ek lambi wadi ke raaste bahut lambi safar karni thi aur ek bahut badi fauj se milna aur hamla karna tha, isliye unhone Musalmanon ko haalat saaf bataee taake woh khud ko munasib tareeke se taiyaar kar saken aur apne dushman ko fatah karne ke liye taiyaar ho saken. Nabi ne unhe manzil batayi jahaan woh ja rahe the.

e: Ka`b bin Malik used to say:"Scarcely did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) set out for a journey on a day other than Thursday
hi: Ka'b bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) kaha karte the: "Bahut kam hi hota tha ke Allah ke Rasool Guruwaar ke ilawa kisi aur din safar par nikalte."

e: Narrated Ka`b bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) set out on Thursday for the Ghazwa of Tabuk and he used to prefer to set out (i.e. travel) on Thursdays
hi: Ka'b bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi Guruwaar ke din Ghazwa-e-Tabuk ke liye nikle aur woh Guruwaar ke din safar par nikalne ko tarjih dete the.

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) offered a four-rak`at Zuhr prayer at Medina and then offered a two rak`at `Asr prayer at Dhul-Hulaifa and I heard the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) reciting Talbiya aloud (for Hajj and `Umra) altogether
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Madina mein chaar rakat ki Zuhr namaz padhi aur phir Dhul-Hulaifa mein do rakat Asr ki namaz padhi, aur maine Nabi ke sahaba ko sab ek saath zor se Talbiya (Hajj aur Umrah ke liye) padhte suna.

e: Narrated `Aisha:We set out in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) five days before the end of Dhul Qa'da intending to perform Hajj only. When we approached Mecca Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered those who did not have the Hadi (i.e. an animal for sacrifice) with them, to perform the Tawaf around the Ka`ba, and between Safa and Marwa and then finish their Ihram. Beef was brought to us on the day of Nahr (i.e. the days of slaughtering) and I asked, "What is this?" Somebody said, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has slaughtered (a cow) on behalf of his wives
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Hum Allah ke Rasool ke saath Dhul Qa'da khatam hone se paanch din pehle nikle, sirf Hajj karne ki niyyat se. Jab hum Mecca ke qareeb pahunche, Allah ke Rasool ne un logon ko jinke paas Hadi (qurbani ka janwar) nahi tha, Ka'ba ka Tawaf karne aur Safa-Marwa ke beech saee karne aur phir apna Ihram khatam karne ka hukum diya. Nahr ke din (yaani zabah ke dinon) humare paas gaay ka gosht laaya gaya aur maine pucha, "Yeh kya hai?" Kisi ne kaha, Allah ke Rasool ne apni biwiyon ki taraf se (ek gaay) zabah ki hai.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) set out in the month of Ramadan. He observed fasting till he reached a place called Kadid where he broke his fast
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Nabi Ramadan ke mahine mein safar par nikle. Unhone Kadid naam ki jagah tak roza rakha, jahan unhone apna roza tod diya.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah (ra):Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent us on a military expedition telling us, "If you find such and such persons (he named two men from Quraish), burn them with fire." Then we came to bid him farewell, when we wanted to set out, he said: "Previously I ordered you to burn so-and-so and so-and-so with fire, but as punishment with fire is done by none except Allah, if you capture them, kill them, (instead)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne humein ek fauji muhim par bheja aur kaha, "Agar tum falaan-falaan logon (unhone Quraish ke do log naam liye) ko paao, unhe aag se jalakar maar do." Phir jab hum unse vidaee lene aaye, aur jaane ke liye taiyaar hue, unhone kaha, "Pehle maine tumhe falaan-falaan ko aag se jalane ka hukum diya tha, magar chunke aag se saza sirf Allah deta hai, isliye agar tum unhe pakdo, unhe (iske bajaye) qatl kar dena."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet said, "It is obligatory for one to listen to and obey (the ruler's orders) unless these orders involve one of disobedience (to Allah); but if an act of disobedience (to Allah) is imposed, he should not listen to or obey it
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Hukmaran ke hukum sunna aur manna farz hai, jab tak woh hukum kisi na-farmani (Allah ki) ke baare mein na ho; magar agar aisa hukum diya jaaye jo na-farmani wala ho, use na sunna chahiye na manna chahiye."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:That he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "We are the last but will be the foremost to enter Paradise)." The Prophet added, "He who obeys me, obeys Allah, and he who disobeys me, disobeys Allah. He who obeys the chief, obeys me, and he who disobeys the chief, disobeys me. The Imam is like a shelter for whose safety the Muslims should fight and where they should seek protection. If the Imam orders people with righteousness and rules justly, then he will be rewarded for that, and if he does the opposite, he will be responsible for that
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Unhone Allah ke Rasool ko kehte suna, "Hum sabse aakhri hain magar Jannat mein daakhil hone mein sabse aage honge." Nabi ne joda, "Jo mujhe maanta hai, woh Allah ko maanta hai, aur jo meri na-farmani karta hai, woh Allah ki na-farmani karta hai. Jo sardaar ko maanta hai, woh mujhe maanta hai, aur jo sardaar ki na-farmani karta hai, woh meri na-farmani karta hai. Imam ek panah jaisa hai jiski hifaazat ke liye Musalmanon ko jung karni chahiye aur jahan unhe hifaazat dhoondni chahiye. Agar Imam neki ka hukum de aur insaaf se hukumat kare, use uska ajr milega, aur agar woh iska ulta kare, woh iske liye zimmedaar hoga."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:When we reached (Hudaibiya) in the next year (of the treaty of Hudaibiya), not even two men amongst us agreed unanimously as to which was the tree under which we had given the pledge of allegiance, and that was out of Allah's Mercy. (The sub narrator asked Naf'i, "For what did the Prophet (ﷺ) take their pledge of allegiance, was it for death?" Naf'i replied "No, but he took their pledge of allegiance for patience
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab hum agle saal (Hudaibiya ke muahide ke) pahunche, humme se do log bhi sahmat nahi the ke woh kaunsa darakht tha jiske neeche humne bai'at ki thi, aur yeh Allah ki rehmat thi. (Doosre raawi ne Nafi se pucha, "Nabi ne unse kis cheez ke liye bai'at li, kya woh maut ke liye thi?" Nafi ne jawab diya, "Nahi, unhone sabr ke liye bai'at li.")

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Zaid:that in the time (of the battle) of Al-Harra a person came to him and said, "Ibn Hanzala is taking the pledge of allegiance from the people for death." He said, "I will never give a pledge of allegiance for such a thing to anyone after Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Al-Harra ke waqt ek shaks unke paas aaya aur kaha, "Ibn Hanzala logon se maut ke liye bai'at le raha hai." Unhone kaha, "Main Allah ke Rasool ke baad aisi cheez ke liye kisi ko bai'at kabhi nahi dunga."

e: Narrated Yazid bin Ubaid:Salama said, "I gave the Pledge of allegiance (Al-Ridwan) to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and then I moved to the shade of a tree. When the number of people around the Prophet (ﷺ) diminished, he said, 'O Ibn Al-Akwa` ! Will you not give to me the pledge of Allegiance?' I replied, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have already given to you the pledge of Allegiance.' He said, 'Do it again.' So I gave the pledge of allegiance for the second time." I asked 'O Abu Muslim! For what did you give he pledge of Allegiance on that day?" He replied, "We gave the pledge of Allegiance for death
hi: Yazid bin Ubaid bataate hain: Salama ne kaha, "Maine Allah ke Rasool se Al-Ridwan ki bai'at ki aur phir ek darakht ki chhaaye mein chala gaya. Jab Nabi ke aas-paas logon ki taadaad kam hui, unhone kaha, 'Aye Ibn Al-Akwa! Kya tum mujhe bai'at nahi doge?' Maine jawab diya, 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Maine aapko bai'at pehle hi de di hai.' Unhone kaha, 'Phir se karo.' Isliye maine doosri baar bai'at ki." (Doosre raawi ne pucha) "Aye Abu Muslim! Us din tumne kis cheez ke liye bai'at ki?" Unhone jawab diya, "Humne maut ke liye bai'at ki."

e: Narrated Anas:On the day (of the battle) of the Trench, the Ansar were saying, "We are those who have sworn allegiance to Muhammad for Jihad (for ever) as long as we live." The Prophet (ﷺ) replied to them, "O Allah! There is no life except the life of the Hereafter. So honor the Ansar and emigrants with Your Generosity
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Khandaq ki jung ke din, Ansaar keh rahe the, "Hum woh log hain jinhone Muhammad se Jihad (hamesha ke liye) ki bai'at ki hai jab tak hum zinda hain." Nabi ne unhe jawab diya, "Aye Allah! Aakhirat ki zindagi ke siwa koi zindagi nahi. Isliye Ansaar aur Muhajireen ko apni faragdil (bakhshish) se sammaanit kar."

e: Narrated Mujashi:My brother and I came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and I requested him to take the pledge of allegiance from us for migration. He said, "Migration has passed away with its people." I asked, "For what will you take the pledge of allegiance from us then?" He said, "I will take (the pledge) for Islam and Jihad
hi: Mujashi bataate hain: Main aur mera bhai Nabi ke paas aaye aur maine unse guzarish ki ke woh humse hijrat ki bai'at len. Unhone kaha, "Hijrat apne logon ke saath guzar chuki hai." Maine pucha, "Phir aap humse kis cheez ki bai'at lenge?" Unhone kaha, "Main Islam aur Jihad ke liye bai'at lunga."

e: Narrated `Abdullah:Today a man came to me and asked me a question which I did not know how to answer. He said, "Tell me, if a wealthy active man, well-equipped with arms, goes out on military expeditions with our chiefs, and orders us to do such things as we cannot do (should we obey him?)" I replied, "By Allah, I do not know what to reply to you, except that we, were in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) and he used to order us to do a thing once only till we finished it. And no doubt, everyone among you will remain in a good state as long as he obeys Allah. If one is in doubt as to the legality of something, he should ask somebody who would satisfy him, but soon will come a time when you will not find such a man. By Him, except Whom none has the right to be worshipped. I see that the example of what has passed of this life (to what remains thereof) is like a pond whose fresh water has been used up and nothing remains but muddy water
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Aaj ek shaks mere paas aaya aur mujhse ek sawaal pucha jiska jawab mujhe nahi pata tha kaise dun. Usne kaha, "Mujhe bataiye, agar ek maldaar, fauri, achhe hathiyaar se lais shaks humare sardaron ke saath fauji muhim par jata hai aur humein aisi cheezon ka hukum deta hai jo hum nahi kar sakte (kya humein uski itaaat karni chahiye?)" Maine jawab diya, "Allah ki qasam, mujhe nahi pata tumhe kya jawab dun, siwaye is ke ke hum Nabi ki sohbat mein the aur woh humein ek kaam ka hukum sirf ek baar dete the jab tak hum use poora na kar len. Aur beshak, tum mein se har ek achhi haalat mein rahega jab tak woh Allah ki itaaat karta hai. Agar koi kisi cheez ki jaizta ke baare mein shak mein ho, use kisi se puchna chahiye jo use santusht kare, magar jald hi aisa waqt aayega jab tumhe aisa shaks nahi milega. Us zaat ki qasam jiske siwa koi mabood nahi hai, mujhe lagta hai baki bache is zindagi ki misaal ek talaab jaisi hai jiska taaza paani khatam ho chuka hai aur sirf ganda paani bacha hai."

e: Narrated Salim Abu An-Nadr:The freed slave of `Umar bin 'Ubaidullah who was `Umar's clerk: `Abdullah bin Abi `Aufa wrote him (i.e. `Umar) a letter that contained the following:-- "Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (during a holy battle), waited till the sun had declined and then he got up among the people and said, "O people! Do not wish to face the enemy (in a battle) and ask Allah to save you (from calamities) but if you should face the enemy, then be patient and let it be known to you that Paradise is under the shades of swords." He then said,, "O Allah! The Revealer of the (Holy) Book, the Mover of the clouds, and Defeater of Al-Ahzab (i.e. the clans of infidels), defeat them infidels and bestow victory upon us
hi: Salim Abu An-Nadr bataate hain: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ubaidullah ka azaad kiya gulaam, jo Umar ka lipik tha: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Aufa ne unhe (yaani Umar ko) ek khat likha jismein yeh tha: "Ek baar Allah ke Rasool ne (ek muqaddas jung ke dauran) intezaar kiya jab tak suraj dhal gaya, phir woh logon ke beech khade hue aur kaha, 'Aye logo! Dushman se saamna karne ki khwahish mat karo aur Allah se apni hifaazat maango, magar agar tumhe dushman ka saamna karna pade, to sabr karo aur jaan lo ke Jannat talwaron ke saaye ke neeche hai.' Phir unhone kaha, 'Aye Allah! Paak Kitaab ke naazil karne wale, baadlon ke chalane wale, aur Al-Ahzab (yaani kaafir qabilon) ko haar dene wale, unhe (kaafiron ko) haar de aur humein fatah de.'"

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:I participated in a Ghazwa along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) The Prophet (ﷺ) met me (on the way) while I was riding a camel of ours used for irrigation and it had got so tired that it could hardly walk. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked me, "What is wrong with the camel?" I replied, "It has got tired." So. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came from behind it and rebuked it and prayed for it so it started surpassing the other camels and going ahead of them. Then he asked me, "How do you find your camel (now)?" I replied, "I find it quite well, now as it has received your blessings." He said, "Will you sell it to me?" I felt shy (to refuse his offer) though it was the only camel for irrigation we had. So, I said, "Yes." He said, "Sell it to me then." I sold it to him on the condition that I should keep on riding it till I reached Medina. Then I said, "O Allah's Apostle! I am a bridegroom," and requested him to allow me to go home. He allowed me, and I set out for Medina before the people till I reached Medina, where I met my uncle, who asked me about the camel and I informed him all about it and he blamed me for that. When I took the permission of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) he asked me whether I had married a virgin or a matron and I replied that I had married a matron. He said, "Why hadn't you married a virgin who would have played with you, and you would have played with her?" I replied, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! My father died (or was martyred) and I have some young sisters, so I felt it not proper that I should marry a young girl like them who would neither teach them manners nor serve them. So, I have married a matron so that she may serve them and teach them manners." When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) arrived in Medina, I took the camel to him the next morning and he gave me its price and gave me the camel itself as well
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Allah ke Rasool ke saath ek Ghazwa mein shaamil tha. Nabi mujhse (raaste mein) mile jabke main humare sinchaee wale unt par sawar tha jo itna thaka hua tha ke woh mushkil se chal pa raha tha. Nabi ne pucha, "Unt ko kya hua hai?" Maine jawab diya, "Yeh thak gaya hai." Isliye Allah ke Rasool uske peeche se aaye aur use daanta aur uske liye dua ki, isliye woh doosre unton se aage nikalne laga. Phir unhone pucha, "Ab apna unt kaisa lag raha hai?" Maine jawab diya, "Ab bilkul theek lag raha hai, kyunke usne aapki barkat paee hai." Unhone kaha, "Kya tum ise mujhe bechoge?" Mujhe (unke pesh kash radd karne mein) sharam mahsoos hui chahe yeh humara ekmaatra sinchaee wala unt tha. Isliye maine kaha, "Haan." Unhone kaha, "Phir mujhe becho." Maine ise unhe becha is shart par ke main Madina pahunchne tak ispar sawar rahunga. Phir maine kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Main dulha hoon," aur unse ghar jaane ki ijazat maangi. Unhone mujhe ijazat di, aur main logon se pehle Madina ke liye rawana hua jab tak Madina pahuncha, jahan meri mulaqaat mere chacha se hui, jinhone mujhse unt ke baare mein pucha aur maine unhe sab kuch bataya aur unhone mujhe iske liye daanta. Jab maine Allah ke Rasool se ijazat li, unhone mujhse pucha kya maine kunwari se shaadi ki ya biwah se, aur maine jawab diya ke maine biwah se shaadi ki. Unhone kaha, "Tumne kunwari se shaadi kyun nahi ki jo tumhare saath khelti aur tum uske saath khelte?" Maine jawab diya, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Mere waalid ka intiqal ho gaya (ya shaheed hue) aur meri kuch chhoti behnen hain, isliye mujhe theek nahi laga ke main unhi jaisi ek jawan ladki se shaadi karun jo na unhe adab sikha sake na unki khidmat kar sake. Isliye maine ek biwah se shaadi ki taake woh unki khidmat kare aur unhe adab sikhaye." Jab Allah ke Rasool Madina pahunche, main agli subah unhe unt dekhaane le gaya aur unhone mujhe uski qeemat di, aur unt bhi mujhe wapas de diya.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Once there was a feeling of fright at Medina, so Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) rode a horse belonging to Abu Talha and (on his return) he said, "We have not seen anything (fearful), but we found this horse very fast
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Madina mein khatare ka ehsaas hua, isliye Allah ke Rasool Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke ghode par sawar hue aur (wapasi par) unhone kaha, "Humne kuch (khataranak) nahi dekha, magar humein yeh ghoda bahut tez laga."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Once the people got frightened, so Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) rode a slow horse belonging to Abu Talha, and he set out all alone, making the horse gallop. Then the people rode, making their horses gallop after him. On his return he said, "Don't be afraid (there is nothing to be afraid of) (and I have found) this horse a very fast one." That horse was never excelled in running hence forward. (Qastalani Vol)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar log dar gaye, isliye Allah ke Rasool Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke ek dheeme ghode par sawar hue, aur woh akele nikle, ghode ko tez daudate huye. Phir log bhi apne ghodon ko tez daudate huye unke peeche gaye. Wapasi par unhone kaha, "Daro mat (darne ki koi baat nahi) (aur maine paaya ke) yeh ghoda bahut tez hai." Us ghode ko iske baad daud mein kabhi paar nahi kiya gaya.

e: Narrated `Umar bin Al-Khattab:I gave a horse to be used in Allah's Cause, but later on I saw it being sold. I asked the Prophet (ﷺ) whether I could buy it. He said, "Don't buy it and don't take back your gift of charity
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab bataate hain: Maine Allah ki raah mein istemal hone ke liye ek ghoda diya, magar baad mein maine dekha ke woh becha jaane wala hai. Maine Nabi se pucha kya main use khareed sakta hoon. Unhone kaha, "Ise mat khareedo aur apna sadqe ka tohfa wapas mat lo."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:`Umar gave a horse to be used in Allah's Cause, but later on he found it being sold. So, he intended to buy it and asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who said, "Don't buy it and don't take back your gift of charity
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Umar ne Allah ki raah mein istemal hone ke liye ek ghoda diya, magar baad mein unhone dekha ke woh becha jaane wala hai. Isliye unhone ise khareedne ka iraada kiya aur Allah ke Rasool se pucha jinhone kaha, "Ise mat khareedo aur apna sadqe ka tohfa wapas mat lo."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Were it not for the fear that it would be difficult for my followers, I would not have remained behind any Sariya, (army-unit) but I don't have riding camels and have no other means of conveyance to carry them on, and it is hard for me that my companions should remain behind me. No doubt I wish I could fight in Allah's Cause and be martyred and come to life again to be martyred and come to life once more
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Agar mujhe dar na hota ke yeh mere pairokaron ke liye mushkil ho jaayega, main kabhi kisi fauji daste (Sariya) se peeche nahi rehta, magar mere paas na sawari ke unt hain na koi doosra saadan unhe le jaane ke liye, aur mujhe yeh bura lagta hai ke mere sahaba mujhse peeche rahen. Beshak, mujhe pasand hoga ke main Allah ki raah mein jung karun aur shaheed ho jaoon, phir zinda kiya jaoon aur shaheed ho jaoon, phir zinda kiya jaoon."

e: Narrated Yali:I participated in the Ghazwa of Tabuk along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and I gave a young camel to be ridden in Jihad and that was, to me, one of my best deeds. Then I employed a laborer who quarrelled with another person. One of them bit the hand of the other and the latter drew his hand from the mouth of the former pulling out his front tooth. Then the former instituted a suit against the latter before the Prophet who rejected that suit saying, "Do you expect him to put out his hand for you to snap as a male camel snaps (vegetation)?
hi: Ya'la bataate hain: Main Allah ke Rasool ke saath Ghazwa-e-Tabuk mein shaamil tha aur maine Jihad ke liye sawari ke liye ek jawan unt diya, aur yeh mere liye mere sabse behtareen amalon mein se ek tha. Phir maine ek mazdoor rakha jiska kisi doosre shaks se jhagda hua. Unme se ek ne doosre ka haath kaata aur doosre ne apna haath uske mun se khinch liya, jisse uski agli daant nikal gaee. Phir pahle wale ne doosre ke khilaf Nabi ke saamne daava daayar kiya, jinhone woh daava yeh kehte huye radd kar diya, "Kya tum ummeed karte ho ke woh apna haath tumhare liye phaila de taake tum use kaato jaise nar unt (paude-kapde) kaatta hai?"

e: Narrated Tha`laba bin Abi Malik Al-Qurazi:When Qais bin Sa`d Al-Ansari, who used to carry the flag of the Prophet, intended to perform Hajj, he combed his hair
hi: Tha'laba bin Abi Malik Al-Qurazi bataate hain: Jab Qais bin Sa'd Al-Ansari, jo Nabi ka jhanda le jate the, Hajj karne ka iraada kiya, unhone apne baal saante.

e: Narrated Salama bin Al-Akwa: Ali remained behind the Prophet (ﷺ) during the battle of Khaibar as he was suffering from some eye trouble but then he said, "How should I stay behind Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" So, he set out till he joined the Prophet. On the eve of the day of the conquest of Khaibar, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "(No doubt) I will give the flag or, tomorrow, a man whom Allah and His Apostle love or who loves Allah and His apostle will take the flag. Allah will bestow victory upon him." Suddenly 'Ali joined us though we were not expecting him. The people said, "Here is 'Ali. "So, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave the flag to him and Allah bestowed victory upon him
hi: Salama bin Al-Akwa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ali (Alayhis Salam) Khaibar ki jung ke dauran Nabi ke peeche reh gaye kyunke unhe aankhon ki kuch takleef thi, magar phir unhone kaha, "Main Allah ke Rasool se peeche kaise rah sakta hoon?" Isliye woh nikle jab tak Nabi se judd gaye. Khaibar ki fatah wali raat, Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "(Beshak) main jhanda dunga," ya, "kal, ek shaks jise Allah aur uska Rasool muhabbat karte hain ya jo Allah aur uske Rasool se muhabbat karta hai, jhanda lega. Allah use fatah dega." Achanak Ali (Alayhis Salam) humare paas aa gaye chahe hum unki ummeed nahi karte the. Logon ne kaha, "Yahaan Ali (Alayhis Salam) hain." Isliye Allah ke Rasool ne unhe jhanda diya aur Allah ne unhe fatah di.

e: Narrated Nafi bin Jubair: I heard Al Abbas telling Az-Zubair, "The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered you to fix the flag here
hi: Nafi bin Jubair bataate hain: Maine Al-Abbas ko Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kehte suna, "Nabi ne aapko yahan jhanda gaadne ka hukum diya."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I have been sent with the shortest expressions bearing the widest meanings, and I have been made victorious with awe (cast in the hearts of the enemy), and while I was sleeping, the keys of the treasures of the world were brought to me and put in my hand." Abu Huraira added: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has left the world and now you, people, are bringing out those treasures (i.e. the Prophet (ﷺ) did not benefit by them
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Mujhe sabse chhote alfaazon ke saath sabse gahre matlab lekar bheja gaya hai, aur mujhe dushman ke dilon mein khauf daalkar fatah di gayi hai, aur jab main so raha tha, duniya ke khazanon ki chaabiyaan mere paas laee gaee aur mere haath mein rakhi gaee." Abu Huraira ne joda: Allah ke Rasool duniya se chale gaye hain aur ab tum log un khazanon ko nikaal rahe ho (yaani Nabi ne khud unse koi faida nahi liya).

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Abu Sufyan said, "Heraclius sent for me when I was in 'Ilya' (i.e. Jerusalem). Then he asked for the letter of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and when he had finished its reading there was a great hue and cry around him and the voices grew louder and we were asked to quit the place. When we were turned out, I said to my companions, 'The cause of Ibn Abi Kabsha has become conspicuous as the King of Bani Al- Asfar is afraid of him
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Heraclius ne mujhe bulwaya jabke main Ilya (yaani Jerusalem) mein tha. Phir usne Allah ke Rasool ka khat maanga aur jab usne padhna khatam kiya, uske aas-paas bahut zyada shorgul mach gaya aur aawazen oonchi hoti gaee aur humein wahaan se jaane ko kaha gaya. Jab humein bahar nikala gaya, maine apne sathiyon se kaha, 'Ibn Abi Kabsha (yaani Nabi) ka masla bahut mashhur ho gaya hai, kyunke Bani Al-Asfar ka Raja bhi unse darta hai.'"

e: Narrated Asma:I prepared the journey-food for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in Abu Bakr's house when he intended to emigrate to Medina. I could not find anything to tie the food-container and the water skin with. So, I said to Abu Bakr, "By Allah, I do not find anything to tie (these things) with except my waist belt." He said, "Cut it into two pieces and tie the water-skin with one piece and the food-container with the other (The subnarrator added, "She did accordingly and that was the reason for calling her Dhatun-Nitaqain (i.e. two-belted woman)
hi: Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool ke liye safar ka khaana taiyaar kiya Abu Bakr ke ghar mein jab woh Madina hijrat karna chahte the. Mujhe khaana ke bartan aur mashk baandhne ke liye kuch nahi mila. Isliye maine Abu Bakr se kaha, "Allah ki qasam, mujhe (inhe) baandhne ke liye kuch nahi mil raha siwaye meri kamar ki belt ke." Unhone kaha, "Ise do tukdon mein kaato aur ek tukde se mashk baandho aur doosre se khaane ka bartan." (Doosre raawi ne joda, "Usne aisa hi kiya, aur isi wajah se unhe Dhatun-Nitaqain — yaani do-belton wali aurat — kaha jane laga.")

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:During the life-time of the Prophet (ﷺ) we used to take the meat of sacrificed animals (as journey food) to Medina. (See Hadith No. 474 Vol)
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ki zindagi mein, hum qurbani ke janwaron ka gosht (safar ke khaane ke tor par) Madina le jate the.

e: Narrated Suwaid bin An-Nu`man:That he went out in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) during the year of Khaibar (campaign) till they reached a place called As-Sahba', the lower part of Khaibar. They offered the `Asr prayer (there) and the Prophet asked for the food. Nothing but Sawiq was brought to the Prophet. So, they chewed it and ate it and drank water. After that the Prophet (ﷺ) got up, washed his mouth, and they too washed their mouths and then offered the prayer
hi: Suwaid bin An-Nu'man (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Woh Nabi ke saath Khaibar ke saal (ki muhim mein) nikle jab tak woh As-Sahba naam ki jagah pahunche, jo Khaibar ka neeche wala hissa hai. Unhone (wahan) Asr ki namaz padhi aur Nabi ne khaana maanga. Nabi ke paas sirf Sawiq (bhune jau ka aata) laaya gaya. Isliye unhone use chabaya aur khaya aur paani piya. Iske baad Nabi uthe, apna mun dhoya, aur unhone (sahaba ne) bhi apna mun dhoya aur phir namaz padhi.

e: Narrated Salama:Once the journey-food of the people ran short and they were in great need. So, they came to the Prophet to take his permission for slaughtering their camels, and he permitted them. Then `Umar met them and they informed him about it. He said, "What will sustain you after your camels (are finished)?" Then `Umar went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What will sustain them after their camels (are finished)?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Make an announcement amongst the people that they should bring all their remaining food (to me)." (They brought it and) the Prophet (ﷺ) invoked Allah and asked for His Blessings for it. Then he asked them to bring their food utensils and the people started filling their food utensils with their hands till they were satisfied. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then said, "I testify that None has the right to be worshipped but Allah, and I am His Apostle
hi: Salama bataate hain: Ek baar logon ka safar ka khaana kam ho gaya aur unhe sakht zaroorat thi. Isliye woh Nabi ke paas gaye apne unton ko zabah karne ki ijazat lene ke liye, aur unhone ijazat de di. Phir Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) unse mile aur unhone unhe iske baare mein bataya. Unhone kaha, "Tumhare unton (khatam hone) ke baad tumhe kya sahaara dega?" Phir Umar Nabi ke paas gaye aur kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Unke unt (khatam hone) ke baad unhe kya sahaara dega?" Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Logon mein elaan karo ke woh apna bacha khaana (mere paas) laen." (Unhone laaya aur) Nabi ne iske liye Allah se dua aur barkat maangi. Phir unhone unse apne khaane ke bartan lane ko kaha, aur log apne bartan apne haathon se bharte lage jab tak woh santusht ho gaye. Allah ke Rasool ne phir kaha, "Main gawahi deta hoon ke Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahi, aur main uska Rasool hoon."

e: Narrated Wahb bin Kaisan:Jabir bin `Abdullah said, "We set out, and we were three-hundred men carrying our journey-food on our shoulders. Then we began to eat a single date each per day." A man asked (Jabir), "O Abu `Abdullah! How could a person be satisfied with a single date?" Jabir replied, "We realized the value of that one date when we could not even have that much till we reached the sea-shore, when all of a sudden we saw a huge fish cast by the sea. So, we ate of it as much as we wished for eighteen days
hi: Wahb bin Kaisan bataate hain: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Hum nikle, aur hum teen sau log the apne kandhon par apna safar ka khaana lekar. Phir humne har din ek-ek khajoor khana shuru kiya." Ek shaks ne (Jabir se) pucha, "Aye Abu Abdullah! Ek khajoor se koi kaise santusht ho sakta hai?" Jabir ne jawab diya, "Humein us ek khajoor ki qadr tab pata chali jab humare paas woh bhi nahi bacha jab tak hum samundar ke kinare pahunche, jab achanak humne ek badi machhli dekhi jise samundar ne fenka tha. Isliye humne usme se athaarah din tak jitna chaha khaya."

e: Narrated Aisha:That she said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Your companions are returning with the reward of both Hajj and `Umra, while I am returning with (the reward of) Hajj only." He said to her, "Go, and let `Abdur- Rahman (i.e. your brother) make you sit behind him (on the animal)." So, he ordered `AbdurRahman to let her perform `Umra from Al-Tan`im. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) waited for her at the higher region of Mecca till she returned
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Unhone kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Aapke sahaba Hajj aur Umrah dono ka ajr lekar wapas ja rahe hain, jabke main sirf Hajj (ka ajr) lekar wapas ja rahi hoon." Aap ne unse kaha, "Jaao, aur Abdur-Rahman (yaani tumhare bhai) ko apne peeche (janwar par) baithane do." Isliye unhone Abdur-Rahman ko hukum diya ke woh unhe Al-Tan'im se Umrah karvane de jaen. Phir Nabi ne unka intezaar kiya Mecca ke oonche hisse mein jab tak woh wapas aayi.

e: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Bakr As-Siddiq:The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered me to let `Aisha sit behind me (on the animal) and to let her perform `Umra from at-Tan`im
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Bakr As-Siddiq bataate hain: Nabi ne mujhe hukum diya ke main Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko apne peeche (janwar par) baithaun aur unhe At-Tan'im se Umrah karvane le jaoon.

e: Narrated Anas:I was riding behind Abu Talha (on the same) riding animal and (the Prophet's companions) were reciting Talbiya aloud for both Hajj and `Umra
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke peeche (usi janwar par) sawar tha aur (Nabi ke sahaba) Hajj aur Umrah dono ke liye zor se Talbiya padh rahe the.

e: Narrated `Urwa from Usama bin Zaid:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) rode a donkey on which there was a saddle covered by a velvet sheet and let Usama ride behind him (on the donkey)
hi: Urwa, Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) se: Allah ke Rasool ek gadhe par sawar hue jispar ek jin (saddle) tha jise malmal ke kapde se dhaka gaya tha, aur unhone Usama ko apne peeche (usi gadhe par) bithaya.

e: Narrated Nafi` from `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to Mecca through its higher region on the day of the Conquest (of Mecca) riding his she-camel on which Usama was riding behind him. Bilal and `Uthman bin Talha, one of the servants of the Ka`ba, were also accompanying him till he made his camel kneel in the mosque and ordered the latter to bring the key of the Ka`ba. He opened the door of the Ka`ba and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered in the company of Usama, Bilal and `Uthman, and stayed in it for a long period. When he came out, the people rushed to it, and `Abdullah bin `Umar was the first to enter it and found Bilal standing behind the door. He asked Bilal, "Where did the Prophet (ﷺ) offer his prayer?" He pointed to the place where he had offered his prayer. `Abdullah said, "I forgot to ask him how many rak`at he had performed
hi: Nafi, Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) se: Allah ke Rasool Fatah-e-Mecca ke din Mecca ke oonche hisse se aaye, apni untni par sawar the, jispar Usama unke peeche baithe the. Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ), Ka'ba ke sevakon mein se ek, bhi unke saath the jab tak unhone apni untni ko masjid mein baithne diya aur Uthman ko Ka'ba ki chaabi lane ka hukum diya. Unhone Ka'ba ka darwaza khola aur Allah ke Rasool Usama, Bilal aur Uthman ke saath andar gaye, aur wahan lambi der tak ruke. Jab woh bahar aaye, log wahan daude, aur Abdullah bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) sabse pehle andar gaye aur Bilal ko darwaze ke peeche khade paaya. Unhone Bilal se pucha, "Nabi ne kahan namaz padhi?" Unhone us jagah ki taraf ishara kiya jahan unhone namaz padhi thi. Abdullah ne kaha, "Main unse poochna bhool gaya kitni rakaten unhone padhi."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "There is a (compulsory) Sadaqa (charity) to be given for every joint of the human body (as a sign of gratitude to Allah) everyday the sun rises. To judge justly between two persons is regarded as Sadaqa, and to help a man concerning his riding animal by helping him to ride it or by lifting his luggage on to it, is also regarded as Sadaqa, and (saying) a good word is also Sadaqa, and every step taken on one's way to offer the compulsory prayer (in the mosque) is also Sadaqa and to remove a harmful thing from the way is also Sadaqa
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Insaan ke jism ke har jod ke liye ek (farz) sadqa hai jo suraj ugne par har din dena hai (Allah ke shukriye ke tor par). Do logon ke beech insaaf se faisla karna sadqa mana jata hai, aur kisi ki sawari ke janwar mein madad karna, use sawar hone mein madad karke ya uska saaman uspar chadhakar, yeh bhi sadqa mana jata hai, aur (kehna) ek achhi baat bhi sadqa hai, aur farz namaz padhne (masjid mein) jaane ke raaste mein uthaya gaya har kadam bhi sadqa hai aur raaste se koi nuksaandeh cheez hatana bhi sadqa hai."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the people to travel to a hostile country carrying (copies of) the Qur'an
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne logon ko Quran (ki kapiyaan) lekar dushman ke desh mein safar karne se mana kiya.

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) reached Khaibar in the morning, while the people were coming out carrying their spades over their shoulders. When they saw him they said, "This is Muhammad and his army! Muhammad and his army!" So, they took refuge in the fort. The Prophet (ﷺ) raised both his hands and said, "Allahu Akbar, Khaibar is ruined, for when we approach a nation (i.e. enemy to fight) then miserable is the morning of the warned ones." Then we found some donkeys which we (killed and) cooked: The announcer of the Prophet (ﷺ) announced: "Allah and His Apostle forbid you to eat donkey's meat." So, all the pots including their contents were turned upside down
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi subah Khaibar pahunche, jabke log apne kandhon par phaavde lekar bahar aa rahe the. Jab unhone use dekha, unhone kaha, "Yeh Muhammad aur uski fauj hai! Muhammad aur uski fauj!" Isliye woh qile mein panah lene bhaage. Nabi ne donon haath uthaye aur kaha, "Allahu Akbar, Khaibar barbaad ho gaya, kyunke jab hum kisi qaum (yaani dushman se ladne) ke qareeb jate hain, chetaavni paane walo ki subah bahut buri hoti hai." Phir humein kuch gadhe mile jinhe humne (zabah karke) pakaya. Nabi ke elaan karne wale ne elaan kiya: "Allah aur uske Rasool tumhe gadhe ka gosht khaane se mana karte hain." Isliye sab handiyaan, unme jo kuch bhi tha samet, ulat di gayi.

e: Narrated Abu Musa Al-Ash`ari:We were in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (during Hajj). Whenever we went up a high place we used to say: "None has the right to be worshipped but Allah, and Allah is Greater," and our voices used to rise, so the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O people! Be merciful to yourselves (i.e. don't raise your voice), for you are not calling a deaf or an absent one, but One Who is with you, no doubt He is All-Hearer, ever Near (to all things)
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ash'ari bataate hain: Hum Allah ke Rasool ki sohbat mein the (Hajj ke dauran). Jab bhi hum kisi oonchi jagah par jate, hum kehte: "Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahi, aur Allah sabse bada hai," aur humari aawazen oonchi ho jati thi, isliye Nabi ne kaha, "Aye logo! Apne aap par reham karo (yaani apni aawaz oonchi mat karo), kyunke tum kisi bahre ya gair-maujood shaks ko nahi bula rahe, balki us Zaat ko jo tumhare saath hai, beshak woh sab kuch sunta hai, hamesha (sab cheezon ke) qareeb hai."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:Whenever we went up a place we would say, "Allahu--Akbar (i.e. Allah is Greater)", and whenever we went down a place we would say, "Subhan Allah
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab bhi hum kisi oonchi jagah jate, hum kehte, "Allahu Akbar (yaani Allah sabse bada hai)," aur jab bhi hum kisi neeche jagah jate, hum kehte, "Subhan Allah."

e: Narrated Jabir:Whenever we went up a place we would say Takbir, and whenever we went down we would say, "Subhan Allah
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab bhi hum kisi oonchi jagah jate, hum Takbir kehte, aur jab bhi hum neeche jate, hum kehte, "Subhan Allah."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) returned from the Hajj or the `Umra or a Ghazwa, he would say Takbir thrice. Whenever he came upon a mountain path or wasteland, then he would say, "None has the right to be worshipped but Allah Alone Who has no partner. All the Kingdom belongs to Him and all the praises are for Him and He is Omnipotent. We are returning with repentance, worshipping, prostrating ourselves and praising our Lord. Allah fulfilled His Promise, granted victory to His slave and He Alone defeated all the clans
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab bhi Nabi Hajj, Umrah, ya kisi Ghazwa se wapas aate, woh teen baar Takbir kehte. Jab bhi woh kisi pahadi raaste ya ban-jar zameen se guzarte, woh kahte, "Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahi, akela, jiska koi shareek nahi. Poori badshahat usi ki hai, aur sab tareefein usi ke liye hain aur woh sab par Qaadir hai. Hum tauba karte huye, ibadat karte huye, sajda karte huye, aur apne Rab ki tareef karte huye wapas aa rahe hain. Allah ne apna waada poora kiya, apne bande ko fatah di, aur usne akele hi sab qabilon ko haar di."

e: Narrated Ibrahim Abu Isma`il As-Saksaki:I heard Abu Burda who accompanied Yazid bin Abi Kabsha on a journey. Yazid used to observe fasting on journeys. Abu Burda said to him, "I heard Abu Musa several times saying that Allah's Apostle said, 'When a slave falls ill or travels, then he will get reward similar to that he gets for good deeds practiced at home when in good health
hi: Ibrahim Abu Ismail As-Saksaki bataate hain: Maine Abu Burda ko suna jo Yazid bin Abi Kabsha ke saath ek safar mein the. Yazid safar mein roza rakhte the. Abu Burda ne unse kaha, "Maine Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko kaee baar kehte suna ke Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, 'Jab koi banda bimar hota hai ya safar karta hai, use waisa hi ajr milta hai jaisa woh apne ghar mein sehatmand hote hue neik amal karke paata.'"

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:On the day of the battle of the Trench, the Prophet (ﷺ) wanted somebody from amongst the people to volunteer to be a reconnoitre. Az-Zubair volunteered. He demanded the same again and Az-Zubair volunteered again. Then he repeated the same demand (thrice) and Az-Zubair volunteered once more. The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, " Every prophet has a disciple and my disciple is Az-Zubair
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Khandaq ki jung ke din, Nabi chahte the ke koi logon mein se jaasoosi ke liye aage aaye. Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne aage aakar khud ko pesh kiya. Unhone yehi maang dobara ki aur Az-Zubair phir aage aaye. Phir unhone teesri baar wahi maang dohraee aur Az-Zubair ek baar phir aage aaye. Isspar Nabi ne kaha, "Har Nabi ka ek shagird hota hai, aur mera shagird Az-Zubair hai."

e: Narrated Ibn' `Umar:from the Prophet (ﷺ) the following Hadith (No. 242). Narrated Ibn `Umar: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If the people knew what I know about traveling alone, then nobody would travel alone at night
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi se (jaisi hadith No. 242 hai). Ibn Umar bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Agar logon ko pata hota jo mujhe akele safar karne ke baare mein pata hai, koi bhi raat ko akele safar na karta."

e: Narrated Hisham's father:Usama bin Zaid was asked at what pace the Prophet (ﷺ) rode during Hajjat-ul-Wada`. He said, "He rode at a medium pace, but when he came upon an open way he would go at full pace
hi: Hisham ke waalid bataate hain: Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha gaya Nabi Hajjat-ul-Wada ke dauran kis raftaar se sawar the. Unhone kaha, "Woh darmiyaani raftaar se sawar the, magar jab woh koi khuli raah pate, woh poori raftaar se chalte."

e: Narrated Aslam:While I was in the company of `Abdullah bin `Umar on the way to Mecca, he received the news of the severe illness of Safiya bint Abi Ubaid (i.e. his wife), so he proceeded at greater speed, and when the twilight disappeared, he dismounted and offered the Maghrib and `Isha 'prayers together and said, " I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) delaying the Maghrib prayer to offer it along with the `Isha' when he was in a hurry on a journey
hi: Aslam bataate hain: Jabke main Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki sohbat mein Mecca ke raaste par tha, unhe Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Abi Ubaid (yaani unki biwi) ki sakht bimari ki khabar mili, isliye woh zyada tezi se chalne lage, aur jab shaam ki roshni khatam ho gaee, woh utre aur Maghrib aur Isha ki namazein ek saath padhi aur kaha, "Maine Nabi ko dekha Maghrib ki namaz taalte huye taake use Isha ke saath padha jaye jab woh safar mein jaldi mein hote."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Journey is a piece of torture, for it disturbs one's sleep, eating and drinking. So, when you fulfill your job, you should hurry up to your family
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Safar ek qisam ki takleef hai, kyunke yeh kisi ki neend, khaane aur peene mein khalal daalta hai. Isliye jab tum apna kaam poora kar lo, tumhe apne pariwara ke paas jaldi wapas jaana chahiye."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:`Umar bin Al-Khattab gave a horse to be ridden in Allah's Cause and then he found it being sold. He intended to purchase it. So, he consulted Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who said, "Don't buy it and don't take back your gift of charity
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Umar bin Al-Khattab ne ek ghoda Allah ki raah mein istemal hone ke liye diya aur phir dekha ke woh becha jaane wala hai. Unhone use khareedne ka iraada kiya. Isliye unhone Allah ke Rasool se salaah li, jinhone kaha, "Ise mat khareedo aur apna sadqe ka tohfa wapas mat lo."

e: Narrated Aslam:I heard `Umar bin Al-Khattab saying, "I gave a horse to be ridden in Allah's Cause and the person who got it intended to sell it or neglected it. So, I wanted to buy it as I thought he would sell it cheap. I consulted the Prophet (ﷺ) who said, "Do not buy it even if for one Dirham, because he who takes back his gift is like a dog swallowing its vomit
hi: Aslam bataate hain: Maine Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab ko kehte suna, "Maine ek ghoda Allah ki raah mein istemal hone ke liye diya aur us shaks ne, jise woh mila, use bechne ka iraada kiya ya use la-parwaahi se rakha. Isliye maine use khareedne ki khwahish ki kyunke mujhe laga ke woh use saste mein bech dega. Maine Nabi se salaah li jinhone kaha, 'Ise mat khareedo chahe ek Dirham mein hi kyun na ho, kyunke jo apna sadqe ka tohfa wapas leta hai woh us kutte jaisa hai jo apni ulti khud khata hai.'"

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) asking his permission to take part in Jihad. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked him, "Are your parents alive?" He replied in the affirmative. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "Then exert yourself in their service
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks Nabi ke paas aaya aur Jihad mein shaamil hone ki ijazat maangi. Nabi ne unse pucha, "Kya tumhare maa-baap zinda hain?" Usne haan mein jawab diya. Nabi ne unse kaha, "Phir unki khidmat mein poori mehnat karo."

e: Narrated Abu Bashir Al-Ansari:That he was in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on some of his journeys. (The sub-narrator `Abdullah adds, "I think that Abu Bashir also said, 'And the people were at their sleeping places.") Allah's Apostle sent a messenger ordering: "There shall not remain any necklace of string or any other kind of necklace round the necks of camels except it is cut off
hi: Abu Bashir Al-Ansari bataate hain: Woh Allah ke Rasool ke saath kuch safaron mein the. (Doosre raawi Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne joda, "Mujhe lagta hai Abu Bashir ne yeh bhi kaha, 'Aur log apni sone ki jagahon par the.'") Allah ke Rasool ne ek khaddam bheja yeh hukum dekar: "Koi bhi haar ya kisi doosri qisam ki maala unton ki gardan mein na rahe siwaye is ke ke use kaat diya jaaye."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:That he heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "It is not permissible for a man to be alone with a woman, and no lady should travel except with a Mahram (i.e. her husband or a person whom she cannot marry in any case for ever; e.g. her father, brother, etc.)." Then a man got up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have enlisted in the army for such-and-such Ghazwa and my wife is proceeding for Hajj." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Go, and perform the Hajj with your wife
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Unhone Nabi ko kehte suna, "Kisi mard ke liye jaiz nahi ke woh akele kisi aurat ke saath ho, aur koi aurat bina Mahram (yaani apne shohar ya us shaks ke jisse woh kabhi shaadi nahi kar sakti, jaise uska waalid, bhai, waghera) ke safar na kare." Phir ek shaks khada hua aur kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Main falaana-falaana Ghazwa ke liye fauj mein bharti ho gaya hoon aur meri biwi Hajj ke liye ja rahi hai." Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Jaao, aur apni biwi ke saath Hajj karo."

e: Narrated 'Ubaidullah bin Abi Rafi`:I heard `Ali saying, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent me, Az-Zubair and Al-Miqdad somewhere saying, 'Proceed till you reach Rawdat Khakh. There you will find a lady with a letter. Take the letter from her.' " So, we set out and our horses ran at full pace till we got at Ar-Rawda where we found the lady and said (to her). "Take out the letter." She replied, "I have no letter with me." We said, "Either you take out the letter or else we will take off your clothes." So, she took it out of her braid. We brought the letter to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and it contained a statement from Hatib bin Abi Balta'a to some of the Meccan pagans informing them of some of the intentions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O Hatib! What is this?" Hatib replied, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Don't hasten to give your judgment about me. I was a man closely connected with the Quraish, but I did not belong to this tribe, while the other emigrants with you, had their relatives in Mecca who would protect their dependents and property . So, I wanted to recompense for my lacking blood relation to them by doing them a favor so that they might protect my dependents. I did this neither because of disbelief nor apostasy nor out of preferring Kufr (disbelief) to Islam." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), said, "Hatib has told you the truth." `Umar said, O Allah's Apostle! Allow me to chop off the head of this hypocrite." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Hatib participated in the battle of Badr, and who knows, perhaps Allah has already looked at the Badr warriors and said, 'Do whatever you like, for I have forgiven you
hi: Ubaidullah bin Abi Rafi bataate hain: Maine Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko kehte suna, "Allah ke Rasool ne mujhe, Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Al-Miqdad (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko kahin bheja aur kaha, 'Chalte raho jab tak Rawdat Khakh na pahunch jaao. Wahan tumhe ek aurat khat lekar milegi. Usse khat le lena.' Isliye hum nikle aur humare ghode poori raftaar se daude jab tak hum Ar-Rawda pahunche, jahan humne us aurat ko paaya aur (usse) kaha, 'Khat nikaalo.' Usne jawab diya, 'Mere paas koi khat nahi hai.' Humne kaha, 'Ya to tum khat nikaalo ya hum tumhare kapde utaar denge.' Isliye usne use apni choti mein se nikala. Hum khat Allah ke Rasool ke paas laaye aur usme Hatib bin Abi Balta'a ka Mecca ke kuch mushrikon ko likha hua ek bayaan tha jismein woh unhe Allah ke Rasool ke kuch iraadon ki khabar de rahe the. Isspar Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, 'Aye Hatib! Yeh kya hai?' Hatib ne jawab diya, 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Mere baare mein foran apna faisla mat dijiye. Main Quraish se qareebi taur par juda hua tha, magar main is qabile se ta'alluq nahi rakhta tha, jabke aapke saath doosre Muhajireen ke Mecca mein rishtedaar the jo unke aashriton aur maal ki hifaazat karte. Isliye mujhe unse khoon ka rishta na hone ki kami poori karne ke liye maine unpar ek ehsaan karna chaha taake woh mere aashriton ki hifaazat karen. Maine yeh na kufr ki wajah se kiya na deen se firne ki wajah se, na Islam se zyada Kufr ko tarjih dekar.' Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, 'Hatib ne tumse sach kaha hai.' Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe ijazat dijiye ke main is munafik ka sar kaat dun.' Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, 'Hatib Badr ki jung mein shaamil the, aur kise pata, shaayad Allah ne Badr ke jungjuon ki taraf dekhkar kaha ho, \"Jo chaho karo, kyunke maine tumhe maaf kar diya hai.\"'"

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:When it was the day (of the battle) of Badr, prisoners of war were brought including Al-Abbas who was undressed. The Prophet (ﷺ) looked for a shirt for him. It was found that the shirt of `Abdullah bin Ubai would do, so the Prophet (ﷺ) let him wear it. That was the reason why the Prophet (ﷺ) took off and gave his own shirt to `Abdullah. (The narrator adds, "He had done the Prophet (ﷺ) some favor for which the Prophet liked to reward him
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Badr ki jung ka din tha, jang ke qaidi laaye gaye, jinme Al-Abbas bhi the jo bina kapde ke the. Nabi ne unke liye ek qameej dhoondi. Unhe Abdullah bin Ubai ki qameej theek lagi, isliye Nabi ne unhe woh pehnaee. Yehi wajah thi ke Nabi ne apni khud ki qameej utaarkar Abdullah ko di. (Raawi ne joda, "Unhone Nabi ke liye kuch ehsaan kiya tha jiske badle Nabi unhe kuch dena chahte the.")
