e: Narrated Sahl:On the day (of the battle) of Khaibar the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Tomorrow I will give the flag to somebody who will be given victory (by Allah) and who loves Allah and His Apostle and is loved by Allah and His Apostle." So, the people wondered all that night as to who would receive the flag and in the morning everyone hoped that he would be that person. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked, "Where is `Ali?" He was told that `Ali was suffering from eye-trouble, so he applied saliva to his eyes and invoked Allah to cure him. He at once got cured as if he had no ailment. The Prophet (ﷺ) gave him the flag. `Ali said, "Should I fight them till they become like us (i.e. Muslim)?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Go to them patiently and calmly till you enter the land. Then, invite them to Islam, and inform them what is enjoined upon them, for, by Allah, if Allah gives guidance to somebody through you, it is better for you than possessing red camels
hi: Sahl bataate hain: Khaibar ki jung ke din Nabi ne kaha, "Kal main jhanda us shaks ko dunga jise (Allah se) fatah di jaayegi aur jo Allah aur uske Rasool se muhabbat karta hai aur jise Allah aur uske Rasool muhabbat karte hain." Isliye log poori raat sochte rahe kaun jhanda paaega, aur subah har ek ummeed karte tha ke woh hi wahi shaks hoga. Allah ke Rasool ne pucha, "Ali (Alayhis Salam) kahaan hain?" Unhe bataya gaya ke Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki aankhon mein takleef hai, isliye unhone apni thook unki aankhon par lagaee aur unke shifa ke liye Allah se dua ki. Woh foran theek ho gaye jaise unhe kabhi koi bimari na thi. Nabi ne unhe jhanda diya. Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne pucha, "Kya main unse tab tak jung karun jab tak woh humare jaise (yaani Musalman) na ban jaen?" Nabi ne kaha, "Sabr aur shaanti se unke paas jaao jab tak tum unki zameen mein daakhil ho jaao. Phir unhe Islam ki dawat do, aur unhe woh batao jo unpar farz hai, kyunke, Allah ki qasam, agar Allah tumhare zariye kisi ko hidayat de, yeh tumhare liye laal unton ke maalik hone se zyada behtar hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah wonders at those people who will enter Paradise in chains
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Allah unn logon par taajjub karta hai jo zanjiron mein jakade huye Jannat mein daakhil honge."

e: Narrated Abu Burda's father:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Three persons will get their reward twice. (One is) a person who has a slave girl and he educates her properly and teaches her good manners properly (without violence) and then manumits and marries her. Such a person will get a double reward. (Another is) a believer from the people of the scriptures who has been a true believer and then he believes in the Prophet (ﷺ) (Muhammad). Such a person will get a double reward. (The third is) a slave who observes Allah's Rights and Obligations and is sincere to his master
hi: Abu Burda ke waalid bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Teen logon ko unka ajr do baar milega. (Ek hai) woh shaks jiske paas ek launDi ho aur woh use theek tarah se taalim de aur achhe adab sikhaye (bina zyadti ke) aur phir use azaad karke usse shaadi kare. Aise shaks ko dohra ajr milega. (Doosra hai) Kitaab walon mein se ek momin jo sacha momin raha ho aur phir Nabi (Muhammad) par iman laaya ho. Aise shaks ko dohra ajr milega. (Teesra hai) woh gulaam jo Allah ke haqqon aur zimmedariyon ka paalan karta hai aur apne maalik ke prati imandaar hai."

e: Narrated As-Sab bin Jaththama:The Prophet (ﷺ) passed by me at a place called Al-Abwa or Waddan, and was asked whether it was permissible to attack the pagan warriors at night with the probability of exposing their women and children to danger. The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "They (i.e. women and children) are from them (i.e. pagans)." I also heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "The institution of Hima is invalid except for Allah and His Apostle
hi: As-Sab bin Jaththama bataate hain: Nabi mere paas se guzre ek jagah jise Al-Abwa ya Waddan kaha jata hai, aur unse pucha gaya kya raat ko mushrik jungjuon par hamla karna jaiz hai jabke unki aurton aur bachchon ko khatre mein daalne ki sambhavna ho. Nabi ne jawab diya, "Woh (yaani aurten aur bachche) unhi (yaani mushrikon) mein se hain." Maine Nabi ko yeh bhi kehte suna, "Hima (khaas charagaah ka riwaj) sirf Allah aur uske Rasool ke liye jaiz hai."

e: As above (hadith)
hi: (jaisa upar hai).

e: Narrated `Abdullah:During some of the Ghazawat of the Prophet (ﷺ) a woman was found killed. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) disapproved the killing of women and children
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ke kuch Ghazawaat ke dauran ek aurat murda mili. Allah ke Rasool ne auraton aur bachchon ke qatl ko napasand kiya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:During some of the Ghazawat of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) a woman was found killed, so Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the killing of women and children
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ke kuch Ghazawaat ke dauran ek aurat murda mili, isliye Allah ke Rasool ne auraton aur bachchon ko qatl karne se mana kiya.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent us in a mission (i.e., an army-unit) and said, "If you find so-and-so and so-and-so, burn both of them with fire." When we intended to depart, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I have ordered you to burn so-and-so and so-and-so, and it is none but Allah Who punishes with fire, so, if you find them, kill them (i.e., don't burn them)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne humein ek muhim (yaani fauji daste) mein bheja aur kaha, "Agar tum falaana-falaana ko paao, unhe donon ko aag se jalakar maar do." Jab humne jaane ka iraada kiya, Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Maine tumhe falaana-falaana ko aag se jalane ka hukum diya tha, magar aag se saza sirf Allah deta hai, isliye agar tum unhe paao, unhe qatl kar dena (yaani jalane ke bajaye)."

e: Narrated `Ikrima:`Ali burnt some people and this news reached Ibn `Abbas, who said, "Had I been in his place I would not have burnt them, as the Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Don't punish (anybody) with Allah's Punishment.' No doubt, I would have killed them, for the Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'If somebody (a Muslim) discards his religion, kill him
hi: Ikrima bataate hain: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kuch logon ko jala diya aur yeh khabar Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) tak pahunchi, jinhone kaha, "Agar main unki jagah hota, main unhe kabhi na jalata, kyunke Nabi ne kaha, 'Allah ki tarah saza mat do (yaani aag se saza mat do).' Beshak, main unhe qatl karta, kyunke Nabi ne kaha, 'Agar koi (Musalman) apna deen chhod de, use qatl kar do.'"

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:A group of eight men from the tribe of 'Ukl came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and then they found the climate of Medina unsuitable for them. So, they said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Provide us with some milk." Allah's Apostle said, "I recommend that you should join the herd of camels." So they went and drank the urine and the milk of the camels (as a medicine) till they became healthy and fat. Then they killed the shepherd and drove away the camels, and they became unbelievers after they were Muslims. When the Prophet (ﷺ) was informed by a shouter for help, he sent some men in their pursuit, and before the sun rose high, they were brought, and he had their hands and feet cut off. Then he ordered for nails which were heated and passed over their eyes, and they were left in the Harra (i.e. rocky land in Medina). They asked for water, and nobody provided them with water till they died (Abu Qilaba, a sub-narrator said, "They committed murder and theft and fought against Allah and His Apostle, and spread evil in the land)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ukl qabile ke aath logon ka ek giroh Nabi ke paas aaya aur unhe Madina ka mausam apne liye munasib nahi laga. Isliye unhone kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Humein kuch doodh dijiye." Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Mera mashwara hai ke tum unton ke jhund mein shaamil ho jaao." Isliye woh gaye aur (dawa ke tor par) unton ka mootra aur doodh piya jab tak woh sehatmand aur mota-taaza ho gaye. Phir unhone charwahe ko qatl kiya aur unton ko hankalane, aur woh Musalman hote hue kaafir ban gaye. Jab Nabi ko ek chillane wale ne madad ke liye bataya, unhone kuch logon ko unka picha karne bheja, aur suraj oonch uthne se pehle unhe pakadkar laaya gaya, aur unhone unke haath-paon katwaye. Phir unhone garam kili hui kilein unki aankhon par pheraane ka hukum diya, aur unhe Harra (yaani Madina ki pathareeli zameen) mein chhod diya gaya. Unhone paani maanga magar kisi ne unhe paani nahi diya jab tak woh mar gaye. (Abu Qilaba, doosre raawi ne kaha, "Unhone qatl aur chori ki thi aur Allah aur uske Rasool ke khilaf jung ki thi, aur zameen mein buraee failaee thi.")

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah (ra):I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "An ant bit a Prophet amongst the Prophets, and he ordered that the place of the ants be burnt. So, Allah inspired to him, 'It is because one ant bit you that you burnt a nation amongst the nations that glorify Allah?
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool ko kehte suna, "Ek chunti ne Nabiyon mein se ek Nabi ko kaata, aur unhone hukum diya ke chuntiyon ki jagah jalaee jaaye. Isliye Allah ne unhe wahi bheji, 'Kya sirf isliye ke ek chunti ne tumhe kaata, tumne un qaumon mein se ek qaum ko jala diya jo Allah ki tasbeeh karti hai?'"

e: Narrated Jarir:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me, "Will you relieve me from Dhul-Khalasa? Dhul-Khalasa was a house (of an idol) belonging to the tribe of Khath'am called Al-Ka`ba Al-Yama-niya. So, I proceeded with one hundred and fifty cavalry men from the tribe of Ahmas, who were excellent knights. It happened that I could not sit firm on horses, so the Prophet (ﷺ) , stroke me over my chest till I saw his finger-marks over my chest, he said, 'O Allah! Make him firm and make him a guiding and rightly guided man.' " Jarir proceeded towards that house, and dismantled and burnt it. Then he sent a messenger to Allah's Apostle informing him of that. Jarir's messenger said, "By Him Who has sent you with the Truth, I did not come to you till I had left it like an emancipated or gabby camel (i.e. completely marred and spoilt)." Jarir added, "The Prophet (ﷺ) asked for Allah's Blessings for the horses and the men of Ahmas five times
hi: Jarir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne mujhse kaha, "Kya tum mujhe Dhul-Khalasa se aaraam do?" Dhul-Khalasa Khath'am qabile ka ek ghar (but ka) tha jise Al-Ka'ba Al-Yamaania kaha jata tha. Isliye main Ahmas qabile ke sau pachaas ghudsawaron ke saath chal pada, jo bahut behtareen sawaar the. Aisa hua ke main ghode par mazbooti se nahi baith sakta tha, isliye Nabi ne mere seene par apni hatheli maari jab tak maine unki ungliyon ke nishaan apne seene par dekhe, unhone kaha, "Aye Allah! Ise mazboot bana aur ise ek raah-numa aur sahi raah paane wala shaks bana." Jarir us ghar ki taraf gaye, use bikher diya aur jala diya. Phir unhone ek khaddam bheja Allah ke Rasool ko yeh batane. Jarir ke khaddam ne kaha, "Us Zaat ki qasam jisne aapko haqq ke saath bheja hai, main aapke paas tab tak nahi aaya jab tak maine use ek zakhmi ya bekaar unt ki tarah nahi chhoda diya (yaani poori tarah barbaad kar diya)." Jarir ne joda, "Nabi ne Ahmas qabile ke ghodon aur logon ke liye paanch baar Allah se barkat maangi."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) burnt the date-palms of Bani An-Nadir
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Bani An-Nadir qabile ke khajoor ke darakhton ko jala diya.

e: Narrated Al-Bara bin Azib:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent a group of Ansari men to kill Abu-Rafi`. One of them set out and entered their (i.e. the enemies) fort. That man said, "I hid myself in a stable for their animals. They closed the fort gate. Later they lost a donkey of theirs, so they went out in its search. I, too, went out along with them, pretending to look for it. They found the donkey and entered their fort. And I, too, entered along with them. They closed the gate of the fort at night, and kept its keys in a small window where I could see them. When those people slept, I took the keys and opened the gate of the fort and came upon Abu Rafi` and said, 'O Abu Rafi`. When he to replied me, I proceeded towards the voice and hit him. He shouted and I came out to come back, pretending to be a helper. I said, 'O Abu Rafi`,' changing the tone of my voice. He asked me, 'What do you want; woe to your mother?' I asked him, 'What has happened to you?' He said, 'I don't know who came to me and hit me.' Then I drove my sword into his belly and pushed it forcibly till it touched the bone. Then I came out, filled with puzzlement and went towards a ladder of theirs in order to get down but I fell down and sprained my foot. I came to my companions and said, 'I will not leave till I hear the wailing of the women.' So, I did not leave till I heard the women bewailing Abu Rafi`, the merchant of Hijaz. Then I got up, feeling no ailment, (and we proceeded) till we came upon the Prophet (ﷺ) and informed him
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Ansaar ke kuch logon ko Abu Rafi (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko qatl karne ke liye bheja. Unme se ek nikla aur unke (yaani dushmanon ke) qile mein daakhil hua. Us shaks ne kaha, "Maine khud ko unke janwaron ke tabele mein chhupaya. Unhone qile ka darwaza band kar diya. Baad mein unka ek gadha kho gaya, isliye woh use dhoondne nikle. Main bhi unke saath nikla, yeh dikhaane ke maine bhi use dhoondne nikla hoon. Unhe gadha mil gaya aur woh apne qile mein daakhil hue, aur main bhi unke saath daakhil hua. Unhone raat ko qile ka darwaza band kar diya aur uski chaabiyaan ek chhoti khidki mein rakhi jahaan se main unhe dekh sakta tha. Jab woh log so gaye, maine chaabiyaan lekar qile ka darwaza khola aur Abu Rafi ke paas pahuncha aur kaha, 'Aye Abu Rafi.' Jab unhone mujhe jawab diya, main aawaaz ki taraf gaya aur unhe maara. Woh chillae aur main bahar nikla, phir madad karne wale ka natak karte huye wapas aaya. Maine kaha, 'Aye Abu Rafi,' apni aawaaz badalte huye. Unhone mujhse pucha, 'Kya chahiye tujhe; tere maa ko afsos ho?' Maine unse pucha, 'Kya hua hai aapko?' Unhone kaha, 'Mujhe nahi pata kaun mere paas aaya aur mujhe maara.' Phir maine apni talwar unke pet mein ghusaee aur usse jor se dhakela jab tak woh haddi tak pahunch gaee. Phir main bahar nikla, hairaan hote huye, aur unke ek seedhi ki taraf gaya taake main neeche jaoon, magar main gir gaya aur mera paon mochki gaya. Main apne sathiyon ke paas gaya aur kaha, 'Main tab tak nahi chhodunga jab tak main auraton ka rona na suno.' Isliye maine tab tak jagah nahi chhodi jab tak maine auraton ko Abu Rafi, Hijaz ke vyapaari, ka maatam karte suna. Phir main utha, koi taklif mahsoos na karte huye, (aur hum aage badhe) jab tak hum Nabi ke paas pahunche aur unhe bataya."

e: Narrated Al-Bara bin Azib:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent a group of the Ansar to Abu Rafi`. `Abdullah bin Atik entered his house at night and killed him while he was sleeping
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Ansaar ke kuch logon ko Abu Rafi (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas bheja. Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Atik raat ko unke ghar mein daakhil hue aur unhe sote waqt qatl kar diya.

e: Narrated Salim Abu An-Nadr: (the freed slave of 'Umar bin 'Ubaidullah) I was Umar's clerk. Once Abdullah bin Abi Aufa wrote a letter to 'Umar when he proceeded to Al-Haruriya. I read in it that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in one of his military expeditions against the enemy, waited till the sun declined and then he got up amongst the people saying, "O people! Do not wish to meet the enemy, and ask Allah for safety, but when you face the enemy, be patient, and remember that Paradise is under the shades of swords." Then he said, "O Allah, the Revealer of the Holy Book, and the Mover of the clouds and the Defeater of the clans, defeat them, and grant us victory over them
hi: Salim Abu An-Nadr (Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ubaidullah ka azaad kiya gulaam) bataate hain: Main Umar ka lipik tha. Ek baar Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Aufa ne Umar ko ek khat likha jab woh Al-Haruriya ki taraf ja rahe the. Maine usme padha ke Allah ke Rasool ne ek fauji muhim ke dauran dushman ke khilaf, intezaar kiya jab tak suraj dhal gaya aur phir woh logon ke beech khade hue aur kaha, "Aye logo! Dushman se milne ki khwahish mat karo, aur Allah se apni hifaazat maango, magar jab tumhe dushman ka saamna karna pade, sabr karo, aur yaad rakho ke Jannat talwaron ke saaye ke neeche hai." Phir unhone kaha, "Aye Allah! Paak Kitaab ke naazil karne wale, baadlon ke chalane wale, aur qabilon ko haar dene wale, unhe haar de, aur humein unpar fatah de."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Do not wish to meet the enemy, but when you meet face) the enemy, be patient
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha: "Dushman se milne ki khwahish mat karo, magar jab tum dushman ka saamna karo, sabr karo."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Khosrau will be ruined, and there will be no Khosrau after him, and Caesar will surely be ruined and there will be no Caesar after him, and you will spend their treasures in Allah's Cause." He called, "War is deceit
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Khusrau barbaad ho jaayega, aur uske baad koi Khusrau nahi hoga, aur Caesar zaroor barbaad ho jaayega aur uske baad koi Caesar nahi hoga, aur tum unke khazanon ko Allah ki raah mein kharch karoge." Unhone yeh bhi kaha, "Jung dhoka hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) called,: "War is deceit
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: "Jung dhoka hai."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "War is deceit
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Jung dhoka hai."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Who is ready to kill Ka`b bin Al-Ashraf who has really hurt Allah and His Apostle?" Muhammad bin Maslama said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Do you like me to kill him?" He replied in the affirmative. So, Muhammad bin Maslama went to him (i.e. Ka`b) and said, "This person (i.e. the Prophet) has put us to task and asked us for charity." Ka`b replied, "By Allah, you will get tired of him." Muhammad said to him, "We have followed him, so we dislike to leave him till we see the end of his affair." Muhammad bin Maslama went on talking to him in this way till he got the chance to kill him
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Kaun Ka'b bin Al-Ashraf ko qatl karega jisne sach mein Allah aur uske Rasool ko dukh pahunchaaya hai?" Muhammad bin Maslama ne kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Kya aap chahte hain main use qatl karun?" Unhone haan mein jawab diya. Isliye Muhammad bin Maslama unke paas gaya aur kaha, "Is shaks (yaani Nabi) ne humein museebat mein daala hai aur humse sadqa maanga hai." Ka'b ne jawab diya, "Allah ki qasam, tum unse thak jaoge." Muhammad ne unse kaha, "Humne unki pairvi ki hai, isliye humein unhe chhodna napasand hai jab tak hum unke masle ka anjaam na dekh len." Muhammad bin Maslama unse isi tarah baat karte rahe jab tak unhe unhe qatl karne ka mauka mil gaya.

e: Narrated Jabir:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Who is ready to kill Ka`b bin Ashraf (i.e. a Jew)." Muhammad bin Maslama replied, "Do you like me to kill him?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied in the affirmative. Muhammad bin Maslama said, "Then allow me to say what I like." The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "I do (i.e. allow you)
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Kaun Ka'b bin Ashraf (yaani ek Yahudi) ko qatl karne ke liye taiyaar hai." Muhammad bin Maslama ne jawab diya, "Kya aap chahte hain main use qatl karun?" Nabi ne haan mein jawab diya. Muhammad bin Maslama ne kaha, "Phir mujhe jo main chahun woh kehne ki ijazat dijiye." Nabi ne jawab diya, "Main deta hoon (yaani ijazat)."

e: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (ra):Once, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) accompanied by Ubai bin Ka'b set out to Ibn Saiyyad. He was informed that Ibn Saiyyad was in a garden of date palms. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered the garden of date-palms, he started hiding himself behind the trunks of the palms while Ibn Saiyyad was covered with a velvet sheet with murmurs emanating from under it. Ibn Saiyyad's mother saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Saf! This is Muhammad." So Ibn Saiyyad got up. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If she had left him (in his state), the truth would have been clear
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar, Allah ke Rasool Ubai bin Ka'b (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath Ibn Saiyyad ke paas gaye. Unhe bataya gaya ke Ibn Saiyyad khajoor ke darakhton ke ek baag mein hai. Jab Allah ke Rasool baag mein daakhil hue, woh khajoor ke darakhton ke tanon ke peeche chhup gaye jabke Ibn Saiyyad ek malmal ki chadar mein lipeta hua tha jiske neeche se budbudahat aa rahi thi. Ibn Saiyyad ki maa ne Allah ke Rasool ko dekha aur kaha, "Aye Saf! Yeh Muhammad hain." Isliye Ibn Saiyyad uth khada hua. Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Agar usne use (uski haalat mein hi) chhod diya hota, sach saaf ho jaata."

e: Narrated Al-Bara:I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the day (of the battle) of the Trench carrying earth till the hair of his chest were covered with dust and he was a hairy man. He was reciting the following verses of `Abdullah (bin Rawaha): "O Allah, were it not for You, We would not have been guided, Nor would we have given in charity, nor prayed. So, bestow on us calmness, and when we meet the enemy. Then make our feet firm, for indeed, Yet if they want to put us in affliction, (i.e. want to fight against us) we would not (flee but withstand them)." The Prophet (ﷺ) used to raise his voice while reciting these verses. (See Hadith No. 432, Vol)
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool ko Khandaq ki jung ke din mitti uthate dekha jab tak unke seene ke baal dhool se dhak gaye, aur woh ek baalon wale shaks the. Woh Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Rawaha ke yeh she'r padh rahe the: "Aye Allah, tere bina, Hum hidayat na paate, Na hum sadqa dete, na namaz padhte. Isliye humein sukoon de, aur jab hum dushman se milen Phir humare kadam mazboot kar de, kyunke beshak, Agar woh humein museebat mein daalna chahen (yaani humse jung karna chahen), Hum (bhagenge nahi balki unka saamna karenge)." Nabi in she'ron ko padhte waqt apni aawaz oonchi karte the. (Dekhen Hadith No. 432, Vol.)

e: Narrated Jarir:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not screen himself from me since my embracing Islam, and whenever he saw me he would receive me with a smile. Once I told him that I could not sit firm on horses. He stroke me on the chest with his hand and said, "O Allah! Make him firm and make him a guiding and a rightly guided man
hi: Jarir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab se maine Islam qubool kiya, Allah ke Rasool ne kabhi mujhse parda nahi kiya, aur jab bhi woh mujhe dekhte, muskurate huye mera istikbaal karte. Ek baar maine unse kaha ke main ghode par mazboot se nahi baith sakta. Unhone apne haath se mere seene par maara aur kaha, "Aye Allah! Ise mazboot bana aur ise ek raah-numa aur sahi raah paane wala shaks bana."

e: Narrated Abu Hazim:The people asked Sahl bin Sa`d As-Sa' idi "With what thing (medicine) was the wound of Allah's Apostle treated?" He replied, "There is none left (living) amongst the people who knows it better than me. `Ali used to bring water in his shield and Fatima (i.e. the Prophet's daughter) used to wash the blood off his face. Then a mat (of palm leaves) was burnt and its ash was inserted in the wound of Allah's Apostle
hi: Abu Hazim bataate hain: Logon ne Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) As-Sa'idi se pucha, "Allah ke Rasool ke zakhm ka ilaaj kis cheez (dawa) se kiya gaya?" Unhone jawab diya, "Logon mein koi bhi bacha nahi jo mujhse zyada ise jaanta ho. Ali (Alayhis Salam) apni dhaal mein paani laate aur Fatima (Alayhas Salam) (yaani Nabi ki beti) unke chehre se khoon dhoti. Phir ek chataee (khajoor ke patton ki) jalaee gaee aur uski raakh Allah ke Rasool ke zakhm mein daali gaee."

e: Narrated Abu Burda:That his father said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) sent Mu`adh and Abu Musa to Yemen telling them. 'Treat the people with ease and don't be hard on them; give them glad tidings and don't fill them with aversion; and love each other, and don't differ
hi: Abu Burda bataate hain apne waalid ke hawale se: Nabi ne Mu'adh aur Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko Yemen bheja aur unse kaha, "Logon ke saath narmi se pesh aao aur unpar sakhti mat karo; unhe khushkhabri do aur unhe nafrat mat dilao; aur ek-doosre se mohabbat karo, aur ikhtilaf mat karo."

e: Narrated Al-Bara bin Azib:The Prophet (ﷺ) appointed `Abdullah bin Jubair as the commander of the infantry men (archers) who were fifty on the day (of the battle) of Uhud. He instructed them, "Stick to your place, and don't leave it even if you see birds snatching us, till I send for you; and if you see that we have defeated the infidels and made them flee, even then you should not leave your place till I send for you." Then the infidels were defeated. By Allah, I saw the women fleeing lifting up their clothes revealing their leg-bangles and their legs. So, the companions of `Abdullah bin Jubair said, "The booty! O people, the booty ! Your companions have become victorious, what are you waiting for now?" `Abdullah bin Jubair said, "Have you forgotten what Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to you?" They replied, "By Allah! We will go to the people (i.e. the enemy) and collect our share from the war booty." But when they went to them, they were forced to turn back defeated. At that time Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in their rear was calling them back. Only twelve men remained with the Prophet (ﷺ) and the infidels martyred seventy men from us. On the day (of the battle) of Badr, the Prophet (ﷺ) and his companions had caused the 'Pagans to lose 140 men, seventy of whom were captured and seventy were killed. Then Abu Sufyan asked thrice, "Is Muhammad present amongst these people?" The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered his companions not to answer him. Then he asked thrice, "Is the son of Abu Quhafa present amongst these people?" He asked again thrice, "Is the son of Al-Khattab present amongst these people?" He then returned to his companions and said, "As for these (men), they have been killed." `Umar could not control himself and said (to Abu Sufyan), "You told a lie, by Allah! O enemy of Allah! All those you have mentioned are alive, and the thing which will make you unhappy is still there." Abu Sufyan said, "Our victory today is a counterbalance to yours in the battle of Badr, and in war (the victory) is always undecided and is shared in turns by the belligerents, and you will find some of your (killed) men mutilated, but I did not urge my men to do so, yet I do not feel sorry for their deed" After that he started reciting cheerfully, "O Hubal, be high! (1) On that the Prophet (ﷺ) said (to his companions), "Why don't you answer him back?" They said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) What shall we say?" He said, "Say, Allah is Higher and more Sublime." (Then) Abu Sufyan said, "We have the (idol) Al `Uzza, and you have no `Uzza." The Prophet said (to his companions), "Why don't you answer him back?" They asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What shall we say?" He said, "Say Allah is our Helper and you have no helper
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Jubair ko Uhud ki jung ke din paidal fauj (tirandaajon) ka sardaar muqarrar kiya jinki taadaad pachaas thi. Unhone unhe hukum diya, "Apni jagah par date raho, aur ise mat chhodo chahe tum dekho ke parinde humein noch rahe hain, jab tak main tumhe bulane ke liye kisi ko na bheju; aur agar tum dekho ke humne kaafiron ko haar di hai aur unhe bhagane par majboor kiya hai, tab bhi apni jagah mat chhodna jab tak main tumhe bulane ke liye kisi ko na bheju." Phir kaafir hare. Allah ki qasam, maine auraton ko apne kapde uthakar bhaagte dekha, unki taangon ke kangan aur taangen dikh rahi thi. Isliye Abdullah bin Jubair ke sathiyon ne kaha, "Maal-e-ghanimat! Aye logo, maal-e-ghanimat! Tumhare sathi jeet gaye hain, ab tum kis baat ka intezar kar rahe ho?" Abdullah bin Jubair ne kaha, "Kya tum Allah ke Rasool ki baat bhool gaye?" Unhone jawab diya, "Allah ki qasam! Hum un logon (yaani dushman) ke paas jaenge aur maal-e-ghanimat mein apna hissa lenge." Magar jab woh unke paas gaye, unhe haar kar wapas mudna pada. Us waqt Allah ke Rasool unke peeche the, unhe wapas bula rahe the. Sirf baarah log Nabi ke saath reh gaye aur kaafiron ne humare sattar log shaheed kar diye. Badr ki jung ke din, Nabi aur unke sahaba ne mushrikon ke ek sau chaalis log haaraaye the, unme se sattar pakade gaye aur sattar mare gaye. Phir Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne teen baar pucha, "Kya Muhammad in logon mein maujood hain?" Nabi ne apne sahaba ko unhe jawab na dene ka hukum diya. Phir usne teen baar pucha, "Kya Abu Quhafa ka beta in logon mein maujood hai?" Usne phir teen baar pucha, "Kya Al-Khattab ka beta in logon mein maujood hai?" Phir woh apne sathiyon ki taraf muda aur kaha, "Jahaan tak in (logon) ka sawaal hai, woh qatl kiye ja chuke hain." Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) apne aap ko rok na sake aur (Abu Sufyan se) kaha, "Tumne jhoot bola, Allah ki qasam! Aye Allah ke dushman! Tumne jinka zikar kiya, sab zinda hain, aur woh cheez jo tumhe naraaj karegi, abhi bhi baqi hai." Abu Sufyan ne kaha, "Aaj hamari fatah Badr ki jung mein tumhari fatah ke barabar hai, aur jung mein (fatah) hamesha adalbadli hoti hai aur baari-baari milti hai, aur tum apne mure hue logon mein se kuchon ko vikrit (ang-bhang) paoge, magar maine apne logon ko aisa karne ka hukum nahi diya, magar mujhe unke kaam ka afsos bhi nahi." Iske baad, usne khush hote huye padhna shuru kiya, "Aye Hubal, buland ho!" Isspar Nabi ne (apne sahaba se) kaha, "Tum use jawab kyun nahi dete?" Unhone kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Hum kya kahen?" Unhone kaha, "Kaho, Allah buland aur mahaan hai." (Phir) Abu Sufyan ne kaha, "Humare paas (but) Al-Uzza hai, aur tumhare paas koi Uzza nahi." Nabi ne (apne sahaba se) kaha, "Tum use jawab kyun nahi dete?" Unhone pucha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Hum kya kahen?" Unhone kaha, "Kaho, Allah humara madadgaar hai aur tumhara koi madadgaar nahi."

e: Narrated Anas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was the (most handsome), most generous and the bravest of all the people. Once the people of Medina got frightened having heard an uproar at night. So, the Prophet (ﷺ) met the people while he was riding an unsaddled horse belonging to Abu Talha and carrying his sword (slung over his shoulder). He said (to them), "Don't get scared, don't get scared." Then he added, "I found it (i.e the horse) very fast
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool sabse (khoobsurat), sabse zyada daani, aur sabse bahadur the sab logon mein. Ek baar Madina ke log raat ko ek shorgul sunkar dar gaye. Isliye Nabi logon se mile jabke woh Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) ka bina jin (saddle) wala ghoda par sawar the aur apni talwar (kandhe par) latkaye hue the. Unhone (unse) kaha, "Mat daro, mat daro." Phir unhone joda, "Mujhe yeh (yaani ghoda) bahut tez laga."

e: Narrated Salama:I went out of Medina towards Al-Ghaba. When I reached the mountain path of Al-Ghaba, a slave of `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf met me. I said to him, "Woe to you! What brought you here?" He replied, "The she-camels of the Prophet (ﷺ) have been taken away." I said, "Who took them?" He said, "Ghatafan and Fazara." So, I sent three cries, "O Sabaha-h ! O Sabahah !" so loudly that made the people in between its (i.e. Medina's) two mountains hear me. Then I rushed till I met them after they had taken the camels away. I started throwing arrows at them saying, "I am the son of Al-Akwa`"; and today perish the mean people!" So, I saved the she-camels from them before they (i.e. the robbers) could drink water. When I returned driving the camels, the Prophet (ﷺ) met me, I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) Those people are thirsty and I have prevented them from drinking water, so send some people to chase them." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O son of Al-Akwa`, you have gained power (over your enemy), so forgive (them). (Besides) those people are now being entertained by their folk
hi: Salama bataate hain: Main Madina se Al-Ghaba ki taraf nikla. Jab main Al-Ghaba ke pahadi raaste par pahuncha, Abdur-Rahman bin Auf ka ek gulaam mujhse mila. Maine usse kaha, "Tujhpar afsos! Tu yahan kya lekar aaya?" Usne jawab diya, "Nabi ki untniyaan le jaee gaee hain." Maine pucha, "Kisne unhe liya?" Usne kaha, "Ghatafan aur Fazara ne." Isliye maine teen baar pukara, "Aye Sabaha-h! Aye Sabaha-h!" itni zor se ke (Madina ke) do pahadon ke beech ke log mujhe sun sake. Phir main dauda jab tak main unse mila unke unt le jaane ke baad. Maine unpar teer chalane shuru kiye, kehte huye, "Main Al-Akwa ka beta hoon"; "aur aaj kamine log barbaad hon!" Isliye maine untniyaan unse bachaa li isse pehle ke woh (yaani choron) paani pi sakte. Jab main unt hankalkar wapas laya, Nabi mujhse mile, maine kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Woh log pyaase hain aur maine unhe paani pine se roka hai, isliye kuch logon ko unka picha karne bhejiye." Nabi ne kaha, "Aye Al-Akwa ke bete, tumhe (apne dushman par) taakat mil gayi hai, isliye (unhe) maaf kar do. (Iske ilawa) woh log ab apne qabile ke logon dwaara khilaaye-pilaye ja rahe hain."

e: Narrated Abu 'Is-haq:A man asked Al-Bara "O Abu '`Umara! Did you flee on the day (of the battle) of Hunain?" Al-Bara replied while I was listening, "As for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) he did not flee on that day. Abu Sufyan bin Al- Harith was holding the reins of his mule and when the pagans attacked him, he dismounted and started saying, 'I am the Prophet, and there is no lie about it; I am the son of `Abdul Muttalib.' On that day nobody was seen braver than the Prophet
hi: Abu Ishaq bataate hain: Ek shaks ne Al-Bara se pucha, "Aye Abu Umara! Kya aap Hunain ke din bhaage the?" Al-Bara ne jawab diya jabke main sun raha tha, "Jahaan tak Allah ke Rasool ki baat hai, woh us din nahi bhaage. Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Harith unke khachchar ki lagaam thaame hue the aur jab mushrikon ne unpar hamla kiya, woh utare aur kehne lage, 'Main Nabi hoon, aur isme koi jhoot nahi; Main Abdul Muttalib ka beta hoon.' Us din koi bhi Nabi se zyada bahadur nahi dekha gaya."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:When the tribe of Bani Quraiza was ready to accept Sa`d's judgment, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent for Sa`d who was near to him. Sa`d came, riding a donkey and when he came near, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said (to the Ansar), "Stand up for your leader." Then Sa`d came and sat beside Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who said to him. "These people are ready to accept your judgment." Sa`d said, "I give the judgment that their warriors should be killed and their children and women should be taken as prisoners." The Prophet (ﷺ) then remarked, "O Sa`d! You have judged amongst them with (or similar to) the judgment of the King Allah
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Bani Quraiza qabila Sa'd ke faisle ko maane ke liye taiyaar hua, Allah ke Rasool ne Sa'd ko bulaya jo unke qareeb hi the. Sa'd ek gadhe par sawar hokar aaye, aur jab woh qareeb aaye, Allah ke Rasool ne (Ansaar se) kaha, "Apne sardaar ke liye khade ho jaao." Phir Sa'd aaye aur Allah ke Rasool ke bagal mein baith gaye, jinhone unse kaha, "Yeh log tumhara faisla maane ke liye taiyaar hain." Sa'd ne kaha, "Mera faisla hai ke unke fauji qatl kiye jaayen aur unke bachche aur aurten qaidi banaee jaen." Nabi ne phir kaha, "Aye Sa'd! Tumne unke beech Allah Raja ke faisle (ke barabar ya jaisa) faisla diya hai."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik (ra):Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered (Makkah) in the year of the Conquest (of Makkah) wearing a helmet over his head. After he took it off, a man came and said, "Ibn Khatal is clinging to the curtains of the Ka'bah." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Kill him
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool Fatah-e-Mecca ke saal (Mecca mein) daakhil hue apne sar par ek khod (helmet) pehne hue. Jab unhone use utaara, ek shaks aaya aur kaha, "Ibn Khatal Ka'ba ke pardon se chipka hua hai." Nabi ne kaha, "Use qatl kar do."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent a Sariya of ten men as spies under the leadership of `Asim bin Thabit al-Ansari, the grandfather of `Asim bin `Umar bin Al-Khattab. They proceeded till they reached Hadaa, a place between 'Usfan, and Mecca, and their news reached a branch of the tribe of Hudhail called Bani Lihyan. About two-hundred men, who were all archers, hurried to follow their tracks till they found the place where they had eaten dates they had brought with them from Medina. They said, "These are the dates of Yathrib (i.e. Medina), "and continued following their tracks When `Asim and his companions saw their pursuers, they went up a high place and the infidels circled them. The infidels said to them, "Come down and surrender, and we promise and guarantee you that we will not kill any one of you" `Asim bin Thabit; the leader of the Sariya said, "By Allah! I will not come down to be under the protection of infidels. O Allah! Convey our news to Your Prophet. Then the infidels threw arrows at them till they martyred `Asim along with six other men, and three men came down accepting their promise and convention, and they were Khubaib-al-Ansari and Ibn Dathina and another man So, when the infidels captured them, they undid the strings of their bows and tied them. Then the third (of the captives) said, "This is the first betrayal. By Allah! I will not go with you. No doubt these, namely the martyred, have set a good example to us." So, they dragged him and tried to compel him to accompany them, but as he refused, they killed him. They took Khubaid and Ibn Dathina with them and sold them (as slaves) in Mecca (and all that took place) after the battle of Badr. Khubaib was bought by the sons of Al-Harith bin 'Amir bin Naufal bin `Abd Manaf. It was Khubaib who had killed Al-Harith bin 'Amir on the day (of the battle of) Badr. So, Khubaib remained a prisoner with those people. Narrated Az-Zuhri: 'Ubaidullah bin 'Iyyad said that the daughter of Al-Harith had told him, "When those people gathered (to kill Khubaib) he borrowed a razor from me to shave his pubes and I gave it to him. Then he took a son of mine while I was unaware when he came upon him. I saw him placing my son on his thigh and the razor was in his hand. I got scared so much that Khubaib noticed the agitation on my face and said, 'Are you afraid that I will kill him? No, I will never do so.' By Allah, I never saw a prisoner better than Khubaib. By Allah, one day I saw him eating of a bunch of grapes in his hand while he was chained in irons, and there was no fruit at that time in Mecca." The daughter of Al-Harith used to say, "It was a boon Allah bestowed upon Khubaib." When they took him out of the Sanctuary (of Mecca) to kill him outside its boundaries, Khubaib requested them to let him offer two rak`at (prayer). They allowed him and he offered Two rak`at and then said, "Hadn't I been afraid that you would think that I was afraid (of being killed), I would have prolonged the prayer. O Allah, kill them all with no exception." (He then recited the poetic verse):-- "I being martyred as a Muslim, Do not mind how I am killed in Allah's Cause, For my killing is for Allah's Sake, And if Allah wishes, He will bless the amputated parts of a torn body" Then the son of Al Harith killed him. So, it was Khubaib who set the tradition for any Muslim sentenced to death in captivity, to offer a two-rak`at prayer (before being killed). Allah fulfilled the invocation of `Asim bin Thabit on that very day on which he was martyred. The Prophet (ﷺ) informed his companions of their news and what had happened to them. Later on when some infidels from Quraish were informed that `Asim had been killed, they sent some people to fetch a part of his body (i.e. his head) by which he would be recognized. (That was because) `Asim had killed one of their chiefs on the day (of the battle) of Badr. So, a swarm of wasps, resembling a shady cloud, were sent to hover over `Asim and protect him from their messenger and thus they could not cut off anything from his flesh
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne das logon ka ek fauji dasta jaasoos ke tor par bheja jiski agwaee Asim bin Thabit Al-Ansari kar rahe the, jo Asim bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab ke dada the. Woh chalte gaye jab tak Hadaa naam ki jagah pahunche, jo Usfan aur Mecca ke beech hai, aur unki khabar Hudhail qabile ki ek shaakha, Bani Lihyan, tak pahunchi. Taqreeban do sau log, jo sab tirandaaz the, unka picha karne daude jab tak unhe woh jagah mili jahan unhone Madina se laee khajooren khaee thi. Unhone kaha, "Yeh Yathrib (yaani Madina) ki khajoor hain," aur unka picha jaari rakha. Jab Asim aur unke sathiyon ne apne picha karne walon ko dekha, woh ek oonchi jagah par chadh gaye aur kaafiron ne unhe gher liya. Kaafiron ne unse kaha, "Neeche aao aur samarpit ho jaao, aur hum waada aur zamanat dete hain ke hum tum mein se kisi ko qatl nahi karenge." Asim bin Thabit, fauji daste ke sardaar, ne kaha, "Allah ki qasam! Main neeche kaafiron ki panah mein aane ke liye nahi aaunga. Aye Allah! Humari khabar apne Nabi tak pahuncha de." Phir kaafiron ne unpar teer chalaye jab tak unhone Asim ko chhah aur logon ke saath shaheed kar diya, aur teen log unka waada aur ahad maante huye neeche aaye, aur woh the Khubaib-al-Ansari, Ibn Dathina, aur ek doosra shaks. Jab kaafiron ne unhe pakada, unhone unke dhanush ki dooriyaan khol di aur unhe baandha. Phir teesre (qaidi) ne kaha, "Yeh pahli dagabaazi hai. Allah ki qasam! Main tumhare saath nahi jaunga. Beshak in (shaheedon) ne humare liye ek achhi misaal qaayam ki hai." Isliye unhone use khincha aur uska saath dene ke liye majboor karne ki koshish ki, magar jab usne inkaar kiya, unhone use qatl kar diya. Woh Khubaib aur Ibn Dathina ko apne saath le gaye aur Mecca mein unhe (gulaam ke tor par) becha (yeh sab Badr ki jung ke baad hua). Khubaib ko Al-Harith bin Amir bin Naufal bin Abd Manaf ke beton ne khareeda. Yehi Khubaib the jinhone Badr ki jung ke din Al-Harith bin Amir ko qatl kiya tha. Isliye Khubaib un logon ke qaidi reh gaye. Az-Zuhri bataate hain: Ubaidullah bin Iyyad ne kaha ke Al-Harith ki beti ne unhe bataya, "Jab woh log (Khubaib ko qatl karne ke liye) jama hue, unhone mujhse apni sharm gaah ke baal mundne ke liye ek ustura maanga aur maine unhe de diya. Phir unhone mere ek bete ko le liya jabke mujhe pata nahi tha jab woh uske paas aaye. Maine dekha unhone mere bete ko apni raan par baithaya hua tha aur ustura unke haath mein tha. Mujhe itna dar laga ke Khubaib ne mere chehre par ghabrahat dekh li aur kaha, 'Kya tumhe dar hai ke main use qatl karunga? Nahi, main aisa kabhi nahi karunga.' Allah ki qasam, maine kabhi Khubaib se behtar qaidi nahi dekha. Allah ki qasam, ek din maine unhe apne haath mein angoor ka gucchha khate dekha jabke woh lohe ki zanjeeron mein jakade the, aur us waqt Mecca mein koi phal maujood nahi tha." Al-Harith ki beti kehti thi, "Yeh Allah ki taraf se Khubaib ko di gaee ek barkat thi." Jab woh unhe Haram (Mecca ki pavitra seema) se bahar unhe qatl karne le gaye, Khubaib ne unse do rakat namaz padhne ki guzarish ki. Unhone ijazat di aur unhone do rakat padhi, phir kaha, "Agar mujhe dar na hota ke tum sochoge main dar raha hoon (qatl hone se), main namaz lambi kar deta. Aye Allah! Inhe sabko bina kisi ko chhode qatl kar de." (Phir unhone yeh she'r padha): "Main Musalman ke tor par shaheed ho raha hoon, Mujhe iski koi parwah nahi ke main Allah ki raah mein kaise maara jaoon, Kyunke mera qatl Allah ke liye hai, Aur agar Allah chahe, woh (mere) kate hue jism ke tukdon ko barkat dega." Phir Al-Harith ke bete ne unhe qatl kiya. Isliye Khubaib ne hi yeh riwaj qaayam ki ke qaid mein maut ki saza pane wale kisi bhi Musalman ko (qatl hone se pehle) do rakat namaz padhni chahiye. Allah ne Asim bin Thabit ki dua usi din poori ki jis din woh shaheed hue. Nabi ne apne sahaba ko unki khabar aur unke saath jo hua woh bataya. Baad mein jab Quraish ke kuch kaafiron ko pata chala ke Asim qatl ho chuke hain, unhone kuch logon ko unke jism ka ek hissa (yaani unka sar) laane ke liye bheja jisse unhe pehchana ja sake, (kyunke) Asim ne Badr ki jung ke din unke ek sardaar ko qatl kiya tha. Isliye baraton (wasps) ka ek jhund, jo ek chhayadaar baadal jaisa dikh raha tha, Asim ke oopar mandrane ke liye bheja gaya taake woh unhe unke khaddam se bacha sake, aur isliye woh unke gosht mein se kuch bhi nahi kaat sake.

e: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Free the captives, feed the hungry and pay a visit to the sick
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Qaidiyon ko azaad karo, bhookon ko khilao, aur bimaron ki iyaadat karo."

e: Narrated Abu Juhaifa:I asked `Ali, "Do you have the knowledge of any Divine Inspiration besides what is in Allah's Book?" `Ali replied, "No, by Him Who splits the grain of corn and creates the soul. I don't think we have such knowledge, but we have the ability of understanding which Allah may endow a person with, so that he may understand the Qur'an, and we have what is written in this paper as well." I asked, "What is written in this paper?" He replied, "(The regulations of) blood-money, the freeing of captives, and the judgment that no Muslim should be killed for killing an infidel
hi: Abu Juhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Ali (Alayhis Salam) se pucha, "Kya aapke paas Allah ki Kitaab ke ilawa kisi Divine Ilham ka ilm hai?" Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne jawab diya, "Nahi, us Zaat ki qasam jo daane ko phaadta hai aur rooh banata hai. Mujhe nahi lagta humare paas aisa koi ilm hai, magar humare paas samajh ki woh salaahiyat hai jo Allah kisi shaks ko de sakta hai, taake woh Quran ko samajh sake, aur humare paas jo is kaagaz mein likha hai woh bhi hai." Maine pucha, "Is kaagaz mein kya likha hai?" Unhone jawab diya, "(Qawaanin) khoon-baha, qaidiyon ki azaadi, aur yeh faisla ke koi Musalman kisi kaafir ko qatl karne ke badle qatl nahi kiya jaayega."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Some Ansari men asked permission from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Allow us not to take the ransom of our nephew Al `Abbas. The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Do not leave a single Dirham thereof
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Kuch Ansaar logon ne Allah ke Rasool se ijazat maangi yeh kehte huye, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Humein humare bhatije Al-Abbas ka fidya na lene dijiye." Nabi ne jawab diya, "Isme se ek bhi Dirham mat chhodo."

e: (In another narration) Anas said:"Some wealth was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) from Bahrain. Al `Abbas came to him and said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Give me (some of it), as I have paid my and `Aqil's ransom.' The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Take,' and gave him in his garment
hi: (Ek doosri riwaayat mein) Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Nabi ke paas Bahrain se kuch daulat laee gaee. Al-Abbas unke paas aaye aur kaha, 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe (isme se kuch) dijiye, kyunke maine apna aur Aqil ka fidya ada kiya hai.' Nabi ne kaha, 'Lo,' aur unhe unke kapde mein bharkar diya."

e: Narrated Jubair:(who was among the captives of the Battle of Badr) I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) reciting 'Surat-at-Tur' in the Maghrib prayer
hi: Jubair bataate hain (jo Badr ki jung ke qaidiyon mein se ek the): Maine Nabi ko Maghrib ki namaz mein Surah At-Tur padhte suna.

e: Narrated Salama bin Al-Akwa`:"An infidel spy came to the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was on a journey. The spy sat with the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) and started talking and then went away. The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to his companions), 'Chase and kill him.' So, I killed him." The Prophet (ﷺ) then gave him the belongings of the killed spy (in addition to his share of the war booty)
hi: Salama bin Al-Akwa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Ek kaafir jaasoos Nabi ke paas aaya jabke woh safar mein the. Jaasoos Nabi ke sahaba ke saath baitha aur baat karta raha, phir chala gaya. Nabi ne (apne sahaba se) kaha, 'Uska picha karo aur use qatl karo.' Isliye maine use qatl kar diya." Phir Nabi ne unhe qatl kiye gaye jaasoos ka saaman diya (maal-e-ghanimat mein apne hisse ke ilawa).

e: Narrated `Amr bin Maimun:`Umar (after he was stabbed), instructed (his would-be-successor) saying, "I urge him (i.e. the new Caliph) to take care of those non-Muslims who are under the protection of Allah and His Apostle in that he should observe the convention agreed upon with them, and fight on their behalf (to secure their safety) and he should not over-tax them beyond their capability
hi: Amr bin Maimun bataate hain: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne (chhura maare jaane ke baad) hukum diya, "Main unhe (yaani naye Khalifa ko) mashwara deta hoon ke woh un gair-Musalmanon ka khayaal rakhen jo Allah aur uske Rasool ki panah mein hain, aur unke saath kiye gaye ahad ka paalan karen, aur unki taraf se jung karen (unki hifaazat ke liye), aur unpar unki taakat se zyada tax na lagaen."

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:Ibn `Abbas said, "Thursday! What (great thing) took place on Thursday!" Then he started weeping till his tears wetted the gravels of the ground . Then he said, "On Thursday the illness of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was aggravated and he said, "Fetch me writing materials so that I may have something written to you after which you will never go astray." The people (present there) differed in this matter and people should not differ before a prophet. They said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) is seriously sick.' The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Let me alone, as the state in which I am now, is better than what you are calling me for." The Prophet (ﷺ) on his death-bed, gave three orders saying, "Expel the pagans from the Arabian Peninsula, respect and give gifts to the foreign delegates as you have seen me dealing with them." I forgot the third (order)" (Ya'qub bin Muhammad said, "I asked Al-Mughira bin `Abdur-Rahman about the Arabian Peninsula and he said, 'It comprises Mecca, Medina, Al-Yama-ma and Yemen." Ya'qub added, "And Al-Arj, the beginning of Tihama)
hi: Sa'id bin Jubair bataate hain: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Guruwaar! Kya (badi) baat hui Guruwaar ke din!" Phir woh rone lage jab tak unke aansoo zameen ke pattharon ko gila kar diye. Phir unhone kaha, "Guruwaar ke din, Allah ke Rasool ki bimari badh gayi aur unhone kaha, 'Mujhe likhne ka saaman lekar aao taake main tumhare liye kuch likh dun jiske baad tum kabhi bhatke nahi.' Wahaan maujood log is baare mein ikhtilaf karne lage, aur logon ko ek Nabi ke saamne ikhtilaf nahi karna chahiye. Unhone kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool sakht bimar hain.' Nabi ne kaha, 'Mujhe akela chhod do, kyunke jis haalat mein main abhi hoon woh usse behtar hai jiske liye tum mujhe bula rahe ho.'" Nabi ne apni maut ke bistar par teen hukum diye, "Mushrikon ko Arab ki sarzameen se nikal do, videshi wafdon ko izzat aur tohfe do jaisa tumne mujhe unke saath pesh aate dekha hai." "Maine teesra hukum bhool gaya." (Ya'qub bin Muhammad ne kaha, "Maine Al-Mughira bin Abdur-Rahman se Arab ki sarzameen ke baare mein pucha aur unhone kaha, 'Isme Mecca, Madina, Al-Yamama, aur Yemen shaamil hain.'" Ya'qub ne joda, "Aur Al-Arj, Tihama ki shuruaat.")

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:`Umar saw a silken cloak being sold in the market and he brought it to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Buy this cloak and adorn yourself with it on the `Id festivals and on meeting the delegations." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, "This is the dress for the one who will have no share in the Hereafter (or, this is worn by one who will have no share in the Hereafter)." After sometime had passed, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent a silken cloak to `Umar. `Umar took it and brought it to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! You have said that this is the dress of that who will have no share in the Hereafter (or, this is worn by one who will have no share in the Hereafter), yet you have sent me this!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said," I have sent it) so that you may sell it or fulfill with it some of your needs
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Umar ne bazaar mein resham ka ek choga bikte dekha aur use Allah ke Rasool ke paas laaye aur kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Yeh choga khareediye aur ise Eid ke tyoharon par aur wafdon se milte waqt pehniye." Allah ke Rasool ne jawab diya, "Yeh us shaks ka libaas hai jiska Aakhirat mein koi hissa nahi hoga (ya, yeh usi shaks ke pahnne ke liye hai jiska Aakhirat mein koi hissa nahi hoga)." Kuch waqt baad, Allah ke Rasool ne Umar ko resham ka ek choga bheja. Umar ne use liya aur Allah ke Rasool ke paas laaye aur kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Aapne kaha tha ke yeh us shaks ka libaas hai jiska Aakhirat mein koi hissa nahi hoga (ya, yeh usi shaks ke pahnne ke liye hai jiska Aakhirat mein koi hissa nahi hoga), phir bhi aapne yeh mujhe bheja!" Nabi ne kaha, "(Maine ise isliye bheja hai) taake tum ise bech sako ya iske zariye apni kuch zaroorten poori kar sako."

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar: Umar and a group of the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) set out with the Prophet to Ibn Saiyad. He found him playing with some boys near the hillocks of Bani Maghala. Ibn Saiyad at that time was nearing his puberty. He did not notice (the Prophet's presence) till the Prophet (ﷺ) stroked him on the back with his hand and said, "Ibn Saiyad! Do you testify that I am Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" Ibn Saiyad looked at him and said, "I testify that you are the Apostle of the illiterates." Then Ibn Saiyad asked the Prophet. "Do you testify that I am the apostle of Allah?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "I believe in Allah and His Apostles." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said (to Ibn Saiyad). "What do you see?" Ibn Saiyad replied, "True people and false ones visit me." The Prophet said, "Your mind is confused as to this matter." The Prophet (ﷺ) added, " I have kept something (in my mind) for you." Ibn Saiyad said, "It is Ad-Dukh." The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to him), "Shame be on you! You cannot cross your limits." On that 'Umar said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Allow me to chop his head off." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If he should be him (i.e. Ad-Dajjal) then you cannot overpower him, and should he not be him, then you are not going to benefit by murdering him
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Umar aur Nabi ke sahaba ke ek giroh Nabi ke saath Ibn Saiyad ke paas gaye. Unhone use Bani Maghala ki chhoti pahadiyon ke qareeb kuch ladkon ke saath khelte paaya. Ibn Saiyad us waqt baalig hone ke qareeb tha. Usne (Nabi ki maujoodgi) mahsoos nahi ki jab tak Nabi ne apne haath se uski peeth par thapthapaee, aur kaha, "Ibn Saiyad! Kya tum gawahi dete ho ke main Allah ka Rasool hoon?" Ibn Saiyad ne unki taraf dekha aur kaha, "Main gawahi deta hoon ke aap un-padhon ke Rasool hain." Phir Ibn Saiyad ne Nabi se pucha, "Kya aap gawahi dete hain ke main Allah ka Rasool hoon?" Nabi ne unse kaha, "Main Allah aur uske Rasoolon par iman rakhta hoon." Phir Nabi ne (Ibn Saiyad se) pucha, "Tum kya dekhte ho?" Ibn Saiyad ne jawab diya, "Sacche aur jhute log mere paas aate hain." Nabi ne kaha, "Tumhaara dimaag is maamle mein uljha hua hai." Nabi ne joda, "Maine (apne dimaag mein) tumhare liye kuch rakha hai." Ibn Saiyad ne kaha, "Yeh Ad-Dukh hai." Nabi ne (usse) kaha, "Sharam ho tujhpar! Tum apni seema se aage nahi jaa sakte." Isspar Umar ne kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe ijazat dijiye ke main iska sar kaat dun." Nabi ne kaha, "Agar yeh wahi (yaani Dajjal) hai, tum ise haar nahi de sakoge, aur agar yeh wahi nahi hai, isse qatl karne ka koi faayda nahi."

e: Narrated Ibn Umar: (Later on) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (once again) went along with Ubai bin Ka'b to the garden of date-palms where Ibn Saiyad was staying. When the Prophet entered the garden, he started hiding himself behind the trunks of the date-palms as he wanted to hear something from Ibn Saiyad before the latter could see him. Ibn Saiyad was lying in his bed, covered with a velvet sheet from where his murmurs were heard. Ibn Saiyad's mother saw the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was hiding himself behind the trunks of the date-palms. She addressed Ibn Saiyad, "O Saf!" (And this was his name). Ibn Saiyad got up. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Had this woman let him to himself, he would have revealed the reality of his case." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) got up amongst the people, glorifying Allah as He deserves, he mentioned Ad-Dajjal, saying, "I warn you about him (i.e. Ad-Dajjal) and there is no prophet who did not warn his nation about him, and Noah warned his nation about him, but I tell you a statement which no prophet informed his nation of. You should understand that he is a one-eyed man and Allah is not one-eyed
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: (Baad mein) Allah ke Rasool (ek baar phir) Ubai bin Ka'b (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath khajoor ke baag mein gaye jahan Ibn Saiyad tha. Jab Nabi baag mein daakhil hue, woh khajoor ke tanon ke peeche chhupne lage kyunke woh Ibn Saiyad ko dekhne se pehle usse kuch sunna chahte the. Ibn Saiyad apne bistar par leta hua tha, ek malmal ki chadar se dhaka hua, jahan se uski budbudahat sunaee de rahi thi. Ibn Saiyad ki maa ne Nabi ko dekha jabke woh khajoor ke tanon ke peeche chhupe hue the. Usne Ibn Saiyad ko sambodhit kiya, "Aye Saf!" (yehi unka naam tha). Ibn Saiyad uth khada hua. Nabi ne kaha, "Agar us aurat ne use akela chhod diya hota, uski asaliyat saaf ho jaati." Phir Nabi logon ke beech khade hue, Allah ki jaisi hamd honi chahiye vaisi ki, unhone Dajjal ka zikar kiya, kehte huye, "Main tumhe uske (yaani Dajjal ke) baare mein chetaavni deta hoon, aur koi Nabi aisa nahi jisne apni ummat ko uske baare mein chetaavni na di ho, aur Nooh ne bhi apni ummat ko uske baare mein chetaavni di, magar main tumhe ek aisi baat batataa hoon jo kisi Nabi ne apni ummat ko nahi bataee. Tumhe samajhna chahiye ke woh ek aankh wala shaks hoga, aur Allah ek aankh wala nahi hai."

e: Narrated Usama bin Zaid:I asked the Prophet (ﷺ) during his Hajj, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Where will you stay tomorrow?" He said, "Has `Aqil left for us any house?" He then added, "Tomorrow we will stay at Khaif Bani Kinana, i.e. Al-Muhassab, where (the Pagans of) Quraish took an oath of Kufr (i.e. to be loyal to heathenism) in that Bani Kinana got allied with Quraish against Bani Hashim on the terms that they would not deal with the members of this tribe or give them shelter." (Az-Zuhri said, "Khaif means valley.") (See Hadith No. 659, Vol)
hi: Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi se unke Hajj ke dauran pucha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Aap kal kahaan rukenge?" Unhone kaha, "Kya Aqil ne humare liye koi ghar chhoda hai?" Phir unhone joda, "Kal hum Khaif Bani Kinana mein rukenge, yaani Al-Muhassab, jahaan (Quraish ke mushrikon ne) Kufr ki qasam khaee thi (yaani but-parasti se wafadaar rehne ki), jismein Bani Kinana Quraish ke saath jude the Bani Hashim ke khilaf is shart par ke woh is qabile ke logon se koi len-den ya panah nahi denge." (Az-Zuhri ne kaha, "Khaif ka matlab hai wadi.") (Dekhen Hadith No. 659, Vol.)

e: Narrated Aslam:`Umar bin Al-Khattab appointed a freed slave of his, called Hunai, manager of the Hima (i.e. a pasture devoted for grazing the animals of the Zakat or other specified animals). He said to him, "O Hunai! Don't oppress the Muslims and ward off their curse (invocations against you) for the invocation of the oppressed is responded to (by Allah); and allow the shepherd having a few camels and those having a few sheep (to graze their animals), and take care not to allow the livestock of `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf and the livestock of (`Uthman) bin `Affan, for if their livestock should perish, then they have their farms and gardens, while those who own a few camels and those who own a few sheep, if their livestock should perish, would bring their dependents to me and appeal for help saying, 'O chief of the believers! O chief of the believers!' Would I then neglect them? (No, of course not). So, I find it easier to let them have water and grass rather than to give them gold and silver (from the Muslims' treasury). By Allah, these people think that I have been unjust to them. This is their land, and during the pre-Islamic period, they fought for it and they embraced Islam (willingly) while it was in their possession. By Him in Whose Hand my life is! Were it not for the animals (in my custody) which I give to be ridden for striving in Allah's Cause, I would not have turned even a span of their land into a Hima
hi: Aslam bataate hain: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab ne apne ek azaad kiye gulaam, Hunai, ko Hima (yaani Zakat ke ya doosre khaas janwaron ki charaee ke liye alag rakhi gaee zameen) ka prabandhak muqarrar kiya. Unhone usse kaha, "Aye Hunai! Musalmanon par zulm mat karo aur unki bad-dua se bacho, kyunke mazloom ki dua (Allah dwaara) qubool ki jaati hai; aur un charwahon ko jaane do jinke paas kam unt hain aur unhe bhi jinke paas kam bhedein hain, magar khayaal rakho ke Abdur-Rahman bin Auf ke maweshi aur (Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ)) bin Affan ke maweshi ko na aane dena, kyunke agar unke maweshi mar bhi jaayen, unke paas apne khet aur baag hain, jabke un logon ke paas jinke kam unt ya bhedein hain, agar unke maweshi mar jaen, woh apne aashriton ko mere paas lakar madad maangenge, kehte huye, 'Aye Momino ke Ameer! Aye Momino ke Ameer!' Kya main phir bhi unhe napasand karta? (Nahi, beshak nahi.) Isliye mujhe unhe paani aur ghaas dena aasaan lagta hai bajaye is ke ke main unhe (Musalmanon ke khazaane se) sona-chandi dun. Allah ki qasam, yeh log sochte hain maine unke saath na-insaafi ki hai. Yeh unki zameen hai, aur jahiliyat ke zamane mein unhone iske liye jung ki thi aur woh Islam mein daakhil hue jabke yeh unke kabze mein thi. Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri zindagi hai! Agar mere paas woh janwar na hote jinhe main Allah ki raah mein Jihad ke liye deta hoon, main unki zameen ka ek bhi tukda Hima nahi banata."

e: Narrated Hudhaifa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to us), " List the names of those people who have announced that they are Muslims." So, we listed one thousand and five hundred men. Then we wondered, "Should we be afraid (of infidels) although we are one thousand and five hundred in number?" No doubt, we witnessed ourselves being afflicted with such bad trials that one would have to offer the prayer alone in fear. Narrated Al-A`mash: "We (listed the Muslims and) found them five hundred." And Abu Muawiya said, "Between six hundred to seven hundred
hi: Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne (humse) kaha, "Un logon ke naam likho jinhone elaan kiya hai ke woh Musalman hain." Isliye humne ek hazaar paanch sau logon ki soochi banaee. Phir humein hairat hui, "Kya humein (kaafiron se) darna chahiye jabke hum ek hazaar paanch sau ki taadaad mein hain?" Beshak, humne khud ko aisi buri azmaishon mein paaya ke koi shaks dar ke maare namaz akele padhne ko majboor ho jata. Al-A'mash bataate hain: "Humne (Musalmanon ki soochi banaee aur) unhe paanch sau paaya." Aur Abu Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Chhah sau se saat sau ke beech."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have enlisted in the army for such-andsuch Ghazwa, and my wife is leaving for Hajj." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Go back and perform Hajj with your wife
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks Nabi ke paas aaya aur kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Main falaana-falaana Ghazwa ke liye fauj mein bharti ho gaya hoon, aur meri biwi Hajj ke liye ja rahi hai." Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Wapas jaao aur apni biwi ke saath Hajj karo."

e: Narrated Az-Zuhri:as follows in Hadith 297. Narrated Abu Huraira: We were in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in a Ghazwa, and he remarked about a man who claimed to be a Muslim, saying, "This (man) is from the people of the (Hell) Fire." When the battle started, the man fought violently till he got wounded. Somebody said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! The man whom you described as being from the people of the (Hell) Fire fought violently today and died." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He will go to the (Hell) Fire." Some people were on the point of doubting (the truth of what the Prophet had said) while they were in this state, suddenly someone said that he was still alive but severely wounded. When night fell, he lost patience and committed suicide. The Prophet (ﷺ) was informed of that, and he said, "Allah is Greater! I testify that I am Allah's Slave and His Apostle." Then he ordered Bilal to announce amongst the people: 'None will enter Paradise but a Muslim, and Allah may support this religion (i.e. Islam) even with a disobedient man
hi: Az-Zuhri bataate hain: jaisa Hadith 297 mein hai. Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum ek Ghazwa mein Allah ke Rasool ki sohbat mein the, aur unhone ek shaks ke baare mein kaha jo Musalman hone ka dawa karta tha, "Yeh (shaks) Dozakh walon mein se hai." Jab jung shuru hui, us shaks ne sakhti se jung ki jab tak woh zakhmi hua. Kisi ne kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Jis shaks ko aapne Dozakh walon mein se bataya tha, usne aaj sakhti se jung ki aur mar gaya." Nabi ne kaha, "Woh Dozakh mein jaayega." Kuch log shak karne ke kagaar par the (Nabi ki baat ke sach hone par), jabke achanak kisi ne kaha ke woh abhi zinda hai magar sakht zakhmi hai. Jab raat hui, usne sabr khokar khud ko qatl kar liya. Nabi ko iski khabar di gayi aur unhone kaha, "Allahu Akbar! Main gawahi deta hoon ke main Allah ka banda aur uska Rasool hoon." Phir unhone Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko hukum diya ke woh logon mein elaan kare: 'Jannat mein sirf Musalman daakhil hoga, aur Allah is deen (yaani Islam) ki madad ek na-farmani karne wale shaks ke zariye bhi kar sakta hai.'"

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) delivered a sermon and said, "Zaid received the flag and was martyred, then Ja`far took it and was martyred, then `Abdullah bin Rawaha took it and was martyred, and then Khalid bin Al-Walid took it without being appointed, and Allah gave him victory." The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "I am not pleased (or they will not be pleased) that they should remain (alive) with us," while his eyes were shedding tears
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne khutba diya aur kaha, "Zaid ne jhanda liya aur shaheed hue, phir Ja'far ne use liya aur shaheed hue, phir Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Rawaha ne use liya aur shaheed hue, aur phir Khalid bin Al-Walid ne bina muqarrar kiye jaane ke jhanda liya, aur Allah ne unhe fatah di." Nabi ne joda, "Mujhe khush nahi hoga (ya, unhe khush nahi hoga) ke woh humare saath (is duniya mein) rahen," jabke unki aankhon se aansoo bah rahe the.

e: Narrated Anas: The people of the tribes of Ril, Dhakwan, 'Usaiya and Bani Lihyan came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and claimed that they had embraced Islam, and they requested him to support them with some men to fight their own people. The Prophet (ﷺ) supported them with seventy men from the Ansar whom we used to call Al-Qurra'(i.e. Scholars) who (out of piety) used to cut wood during the day and pray all the night. So, those people took the (seventy) men till they reached a place called Bi'r-Ma'una where they betrayed and martyred them. So, the Prophet (ﷺ) invoked evil on the tribe of Ril, Dhakwan and Bani Lihyan for one month in the prayer. Narrated Qatada: Anas told us that they (i.e. Muslims) used to recite a Quranic Verse concerning those martyrs which was:-- "O Allah! Let our people be informed on our behalf that we have met our Lord Who has got pleased with us and made us pleased." Then the Verse was cancelled
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ril, Dhakwan, Usaiya aur Bani Lihyan qabilon ke log Nabi ke paas aaye aur dawa kiya ke unhone Islam qubool kar liya hai, aur unse apne hi logon se jung karne ke liye kuch fauji madad maangi. Nabi ne unhe Ansaar mein se sattar log dekar madad ki jinhe hum Al-Qurra (yaani Ilm wale) kaha karte the jo (ibadat-guzari ki wajah se) din mein lakdi kaatte the aur poori raat namaz padhte the. Isliye woh log un (sattar) logon ko lekar Bi'r-Ma'una naam ki jagah pahunche jahan unhone dagabaazi karke unhe shaheed kar diya. Isliye Nabi ne Ril, Dhakwan aur Bani Lihyan qabilon par ek mahine tak namaz mein bad-dua ki. Qatada bataate hain: Anas ne humein bataya ke woh (yaani Musalman) un shuhada ke baare mein ek Quranic Ayat padhte the jo yeh thi: "Aye Allah! Humari qaum ko humari taraf se batao ke hum apne Rab se mile hain jo humse khush hai aur usne humein khush kiya hai." Phir yeh Ayat mansookh ho gayi.

e: Narrated Abu Talha:Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) conquered some people, he would stay in their town for three days
hi: Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab bhi Nabi kisi qaum ko fatah karte, woh unke shehar mein teen din rukte.

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) performed `Umra, setting out from Al-Ji'rana where he distributed the war booty of Hunain
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Umrah kiya, Al-Ji'rana se rawana hokar, jahan unhone Hunain ke maal-e-ghanimat ko taqseem kiya tha.

e: Narrated Nafi' (ra):A horse of Ibn 'Umar fled and the enemy took it. Then the Muslims conquered the enemy and the horse was returned to him during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). And also, once a slave of Ibn 'Umar (ra) fled and joined the Byzantines, and when the Muslims conquered them, Khalid bin Al-Walid returned the slave to him after the death of the Prophet (ﷺ)
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ka ek ghoda bhaag gaya aur dushman ne use pakad liya. Phir Musalmanon ne dushman ko haar di aur ghoda unhe wapas mil gaya Allah ke Rasool ki zindagi mein hi. Aur ek baar, Ibn Umar ka ek gulaam bhaag gaya aur Byzantines se ja mila, aur jab Musalmanon ne unhe haar di, Khalid bin Al-Walid ne gulaam ko unhe wapas kiya Nabi ki maut ke baad.

e: Narrated Nafi`:Once a slave of Ibn `Umar fled and joined the Byzantine. Khalid bin Al-Walid got him back and returned him to `Abdullah (bin `Umar). Once a horse of Ibn `Umar also ran away and followed the Byzantines, and he (i.e. Khalid) got it back and returned it to `Abdullah
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Ek baar Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ka ek gulaam bhaag gaya aur Byzantine se ja mila. Khalid bin Al-Walid ne use wapas paaya aur Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) (bin Umar) ko de diya. Ek baar Ibn Umar ka ek ghoda bhi bhaag gaya aur Byzantines ki taraf gaya, aur unhone (yaani Khalid ne) use wapas paaya aur Abdullah ko de diya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:That he was riding a horse on the day, the Muslims fought (against the Byzantines), and the commander of the Muslim army was Khalid bin Al-Walid who had been appointed by Abu Bakr. The enemy took the horse away, and when the enemy was defeated, Khalid returned the horse to him
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Woh ek ghode par sawar the us din jab Musalmanon ne (Byzantines ke khilaf) jung ki, aur Musalman fauj ke sardaar Khalid bin Al-Walid the jinhe Abu Bakr ne muqarrar kiya tha. Dushman ne ghoda le liya, aur jab dushman ko haar di gaee, Khalid ne ghoda unhe wapas kar diya.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We have slaughtered a young sheep of ours and have ground one Sa of barley. So, I invite you along with some persons." So, the Prophet (ﷺ) said in a loud voice, "O the people of the Trench! Jabir has prepared "Sur" so come along
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Humne apni ek jawan bhed zabah ki hai aur ek Sa jau pisa hai. Isliye main aapko aur kuch logon ko dawat deta hoon." Isliye Nabi ne oonchi aawaz mein kaha, "Aye Khandaq ke logo! Jabir ne 'Sur' (khaana) taiyaar kiya hai, isliye chalo."

e: Narrated Um Khalid:(the daughter of Khalid bin Sa`id) I went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with my father and I was wearing a yellow shirt. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Sanah, Sanah!" (`Abdullah, the narrator, said that 'Sanah' meant 'good' in the Ethiopian language). I then started playing with the seal of Prophethood (in between the Prophet's shoulders) and my father rebuked me harshly for that. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Leave her," and then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (invoked Allah to grant me a long life) by saying (thrice), "Wear this dress till it is worn out and then wear it till it is worn out, and then wear it till it is worn out." (The narrator adds, "It is said that she lived for a long period, wearing that (yellow) dress till its color became dark because of long wear
hi: Um Khalid (Khalid bin Sa'id ki beti) bataati hain: Main apne waalid ke saath Allah ke Rasool ke paas gayi aur maine ek peeli qameej pehni hui thi. Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Sanah, Sanah!" (Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ), raawi ne kaha ke 'Sanah' Ethiopiyaee bhaasha mein 'achha' ke liye tha.) Phir main Nabuvvat ki muhar (Nabi ke kandhon ke beech) se khelne lagi aur mere waalid ne mujhe iske liye sakhti se daanta. Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Ise chhod do," aur phir Allah ke Rasool ne (mere liye lambi umr ki dua ki) yeh kehte huye (teen baar), "Ise pehno jab tak yeh phat na jaaye, phir ise pehno jab tak yeh phat na jaaye, phir ise pehno jab tak yeh phat na jaaye." (Raawi ne joda, "Kaha jata hai ke woh lambi umr tak jinda rahi, us (peeli) libaas ko pahnte huye jab tak lambe istemal se uska rang gahra ho gaya.")

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Al-Hasan bin 'Ali took a date from the dates of the Sadaqa and put it in his mouth. The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to him) in Persian, "Kakh, kakh! (i.e. Don't you know that we do not eat the Sadaqa (i.e. what is given in charity) (charity is the dirt of the people)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Al-Hasan bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne Sadaqa ki khajooron mein se ek khajoor li aur apne mun mein daal li. Nabi ne (unse) Faarsi mein kaha, "Kakh, kakh! (yaani kya tumhe nahi pata hum Sadaqa nahi khate) (Sadaqa logon ki gandagi hai)."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) got up amongst us and mentioned Al Ghulul, emphasized its magnitude and declared that it was a great sin saying, "Don't commit Ghulul for I should not like to see anyone amongst you on the Day of Resurrection, carrying over his neck a sheep that will be bleating, or carrying over his neck a horse that will be neighing. Such a man will be saying: 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Intercede with Allah for me,' and I will reply, 'I can't help you, for I have conveyed Allah's Message to you Nor should I like to see a man carrying over his neck, a camel that will be grunting. Such a man will say, 'O Allah's Apostle! Intercede with Allah for me, and I will say, 'I can't help you for I have conveyed Allah's Message to you,' or one carrying over his neck gold and silver and saying, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Intercede with Allah for me,' and I will say, 'I can't help you for I have conveyed Allah's Message to you,' or one carrying clothes that will be fluttering, and the man will say, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Intercede with Allah for me.' And I will say, 'I can't help you, for I have conveyed Allah's Message to you
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi humare beech khade hue aur Al-Ghulul (yaani maal-e-ghanimat mein se chori) ka zikar kiya, iski sanginta par zor dekar aur ise ek bada gunah batate huye kaha, "Ghulul mat karo, kyunke mujhe pasand nahi ke Qiyamat ke din tum mein se koi apni gardan par ek bhed lekar aaye jo mimmiya rahi ho, ya ek ghoda lekar aaye jo hinhinataa rahi ho. Aisa shaks kahega, 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Mere liye Allah se sifarish keejiye,' aur main jawab dunga, 'Main tumhari madad nahi kar sakta, kyunke maine tumhe Allah ka paighaam pahuncha diya hai.' Na hi mujhe pasand hoga ke koi apni gardan par ek unt lekar aaye jo bolta ho. Aisa shaks kahega, 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Mere liye Allah se sifarish keejiye,' aur main kahunga, 'Main tumhari madad nahi kar sakta kyunke maine tumhe Allah ka paighaam pahuncha diya hai,' ya koi apni gardan par sona-chandi lekar aaye aur kahe, 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Mere liye Allah se sifarish keejiye,' aur main kahunga, 'Main tumhari madad nahi kar sakta kyunke maine tumhe Allah ka paighaam pahuncha diya hai,' ya koi kapde lekar aaye jo lahra rahe hon, aur shaks kahega, 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Mere liye Allah se sifarish keejiye.' Aur main kahunga, 'Main tumhari madad nahi kar sakta, kyunke maine tumhe Allah ka paighaam pahuncha diya hai.'"

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:There was a man who looked after the family and the belongings of the Prophet (ﷺ) and he was called Karkara. The man died and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "He is in the '(Hell) Fire." The people then went to look at him and found in his place, a cloak he had stolen from the war booty
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks tha jo Nabi ke pariwara aur saaman ki dekhbhal karta tha, aur use Karkara kaha jata tha. Woh shaks guzar gaya aur Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Woh (Dozakh ki) aag mein hai." Log phir use dekhne gaye aur unki jagah ek choga paaya jo unhone maal-e-ghanimat se churaya tha.

e: Narrated Abaya bin Rifaa:My grandfather, Rafi` said, "We were in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) at DhulHulaifa, and the people suffered from hunger. We got some camels and sheep (as booty) and the Prophet (ﷺ) was still behind the people. They hurried and put the cooking pots on the fire. (When he came) he ordered that the cooking pots should be upset and then he distributed the booty (amongst the people) regarding ten sheep as equal to one camel. Then a camel fled and the people chased it till they got tired, as they had a few horses (for chasing it). So a man threw an arrow at it and caused it to stop (with Allah's Permission). On that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Some of these animals behave like wild beasts, so, if any animal flees from you, deal with it in the same way." My grandfather asked (the Prophet (ﷺ) ), "We hope (or are afraid) that we may meet the enemy tomorrow and we have no knives. Can we slaughter our animals with canes?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, "If the instrument used for killing causes the animal to bleed profusely and if Allah's Name is mentioned on killing it, then eat its meat (i.e. it is lawful) but don't use a tooth or a nail and I am telling you the reason: A tooth is a bone (and slaughtering with a bone is forbidden ), and a nail is the slaughtering instrument of the Ethiopians
hi: Abaya bin Rifaa bataate hain: Mere dada, Rafi ne kaha, "Hum Dhul-Hulaifa mein Nabi ke saath the, aur logon ko bhookh ne pareshaan kiya. Humein kuch unt aur bhedein mili (maal-e-ghanimat mein), aur Nabi logon se peeche the. Unhone jaldi ki aur khaane ke bartan aag par rakh diye. (Jab Nabi aaye) unhone hukum diya ke bartan ulat diye jaayen aur phir unhone maal-e-ghanimat taqseem kiya, das bhedon ko ek unt ke barabar samajhte huye. Phir ek unt bhaag gaya aur log uska picha karte thak gaye, kyunke unke paas kam ghode the. Isliye ek shaks ne uspar teer maara aur (Allah ki ijazat se) use rok diya. Isspar Nabi ne kaha, 'Inme se kuch janwar jangli janwaron jaise hote hain, isliye agar koi janwar tumse bhaag jaaye, isi tarah karo.'" Mere dada ne (Nabi se) pucha, "Humein ummeed hai (ya dar hai) ke kal humari dushman se mulaqaat hogi aur humare paas chaaku nahi hain. Kya hum apne janwaron ko narkal se zabah kar sakte hain?" Allah ke Rasool ne jawab diya, "Agar zabah karne wala auzaar khoon jyada nikale aur zabah karte waqt Allah ka naam liya jaaye, to uska gosht khaao (yaani yeh jaiz hai) magar daant ya naakhun ka istemal mat karo aur main tumhe iski wajah batataa hoon: daant ek haddi hai (aur haddi se zabah karna mana hai), aur naakhun Ethiopiyon ka zabah karne ka auzaar hai."

e: Narrated Qais:Jarir bin `Abdullah said to me, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me, 'Won't you relieve me from Dhul- Khalasa?' Dhul-Khalasa was a house where the tribe of Khatham used to stay, and it used to be called Ka`bat-ul Yamaniya. So I proceeded with one hundred-and-fifty (men) from the tribe of Ahmas who were good cavalry.
