I informed the Prophet (ﷺ) that I could not sit firm on horses, so he stroke me on the chest with his hand and I noticed his finger marks on my chest. He invoked, 'O Allah! Make him firm and a guiding and rightly-guided man." Jarir set out towards that place, dismantled and burnt it, and then sent the good news to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . The messenger of Jarir said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). "O Allah's Apostle! By Him Who has sent you with the Truth, I did not come to you till it (i.e. the house) had been turned (black) like a scabby camel (covered with tar)." So the Prophet (ﷺ) invoked Allah to Bless the horses of the men of Ahmas five times
hi: Qais bataate hain: Jarir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne mujhse kaha, "Allah ke Rasool ne mujhse kaha, 'Kya tum mujhe Dhul-Khalasa se aaram nahi doge?' Dhul-Khalasa ek ghar tha jahan Khatham qabile ke log rehte the, aur ise Ka'bat-ul Yamaniya kaha jata tha. Isliye main Ahmas qabile ke sau paanch pachaas (logon) ke saath chal pada jo behtareen ghudsawaar the. Maine Nabi ko bataya ke main ghode par mazbooti se nahi baith sakta, isliye unhone mere seene par apne haath se maara aur maine unki ungliyon ke nishaan apne seene par dekhe. Unhone dua ki, 'Aye Allah! Ise mazboot bana aur ise ek raah-numa aur sahi raah paane wala shaks bana.'" Jarir us jagah gaye, use bikher diya aur jala diya, phir Allah ke Rasool ko achhi khabar bheji. Jarir ke khaddam ne Allah ke Rasool se kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Us Zaat ki qasam jisne aapko haqq ke saath bheja hai, main aapke paas tab tak nahi aaya jab tak woh (yaani ghar) ek zakhmi unt jaisa (kaala, taar se dhaka hua) na ho gaya." Isliye Nabi ne Ahmas qabile ke logon ke ghodon ke liye paanch baar Allah se barkat maangi.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, on the day of the Conquest of Mecca, "There is no migration (after the Conquest), but Jihad and good intentions, and when you are called for Jihad, you should immediately respond to the call
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Fatah-e-Mecca ke din kaha, "(Fatah ke baad) koi hijrat nahi, magar Jihad aur achhi niyyaten hain, aur jab tumhe Jihad ke liye bulaya jaaye, tumhe foran bulaave ka jawab dena chahiye."

e: Narrated Abu `Uthman An-Nahdi:Mujashi (bin Mas`ud) took his brother Mujalid bin Mas`ud to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "This is Mujalid and he will give a pledge of allegiance to you for migration." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There is no migration after the Conquest of Mecca, but I will take his pledge of allegiance for Islam
hi: Abu Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) An-Nahdi bataate hain: Mujashi (bin Mas'ud) apne bhai Mujalid bin Mas'ud ko Nabi ke paas laaye aur kaha, "Yeh Mujalid hain aur woh hijrat ke liye aapse bai'at lenge." Nabi ne kaha, "Fatah-e-Mecca ke baad koi hijrat nahi, magar main unse Islam ke liye bai'at lunga."

e: Narrated `Ata':I and 'Ubai bin `Umar went to `Aisha while she was staying near Thabir (i.e. a mountain). She said, "There is no Migration after Allah gave His Prophet victory over Mecca
hi: Ata bataate hain: Main aur Ubai bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas gaye jabke woh Thabir (yaani ek pahad) ke qareeb rah rahi thi. Unhone kaha, "Koi hijrat nahi ab jab Allah ne apne Nabi ko Mecca par fatah di hai."

e: Narrated Sa`d bin 'Ubaida:Abu `Abdur-Rahman who was one of the supporters of `Uthman said to Abu Talha who was one of the supporters of `Ali, "I perfectly know what encouraged your leader (i.e. `Ali) to shed blood. I heard him saying: Once the Prophet (ﷺ) sent me and Az-Zubair saying, 'Proceed to such-and-such Ar-Roudah (place) where you will find a lady whom Hatib has given a letter. So when we arrived at Ar-Roudah, we requested the lady to hand over the letter to us. She said, 'Hatib has not given me any letter.' We said to her. 'Take out the letter or else we will strip off your clothes.' So she took it out of her braid. So the Prophet (ﷺ) sent for Hatib, (who came) and said, 'Don't hurry in judging me, for, by Allah, I have not become a disbeliever, and my love to Islam is increasing. (The reason for writing this letter was) that there is none of your companions but has relatives in Mecca who look after their families and property, while I have nobody there, so I wanted to do them some favor (so that they might look after my family and property).' The Prophet (ﷺ) believed him. `Umar said, 'Allow me to chop off his (i.e. Hatib's) neck as he has done hypocrisy.' The Prophet (ﷺ) said, (to `Umar), 'Who knows, perhaps Allah has looked at the warriors of Badr and said (to them), 'Do whatever you like, for I have forgiven you.' " Abu `Abdur-Rahman added, "So this is what encouraged him (i.e. `Ali)
hi: Sa'd bin Ubaida bataate hain: Abu Abdur-Rahman, jo Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke samarthakon mein se ek the, ne Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) se, jo Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke samarthakon mein se ek the, kaha, "Mujhe achhi tarah pata hai ke tumhare neta (yaani Ali (Alayhis Salam)) ko khoon bahane ke liye kya taakat mili. Maine unhe kehte suna: 'Ek baar Nabi ne mujhe aur Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko bheja aur kaha, Falaana-falaana Ar-Roudah (jagah) jaao jahan tumhe ek aurat milegi jise Hatib ne ek khat diya hai. Isliye jab hum Ar-Roudah pahunche, humne us aurat se khat humein dene ko kaha. Usne kaha, Hatib ne mujhe koi khat nahi diya. Humne usse kaha, Khat nikaalo ya hum tumhare kapde utaar denge. Isliye usne use apni choti mein se nikala. Phir Nabi ne Hatib ko bulwaya, (jo aaye) aur kaha, Mere baare mein jaldi faisla mat kijiye, kyunke, Allah ki qasam, main kaafir nahi bana hoon, aur Islam ke prati meri mohabbat badh rahi hai. (Yeh khat likhne ki wajah yeh thi ke) aapke sathiyon mein se koi bhi aisa nahi jiske Mecca mein rishtedaar na hon jo unke pariwara aur maal ki dekhbhal karen, jabke mere wahan koi nahi hai, isliye maine unpar ek ehsaan karna chaha (taake woh mere pariwara aur maal ki dekhbhal karen).' Nabi ne unpar vishwas kiya. Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, Mujhe ijazat dijiye ke main iski (yaani Hatib ki) gardan kaat dun kyunke usne munafiqat ki hai. Nabi ne (Umar se) kaha, Kise pata, shaayad Allah ne Badr ke jungjuon ki taraf dekhkar unse kaha ho, Jo chaho karo, kyunke maine tumhe maaf kar diya hai.'" Abu Abdur-Rahman ne joda, "To yehi wajah thi jisne unhe (yaani Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko) taakat di."

e: Narrated Ibn Abi Mulaika:Ibn Az-Zubair said to Ibn Ja`far "Do you remember when I, you and Ibn `Abbas went out to receive Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" Ibn Ja`far replied in the affirmative. Ibn Az-Zubair added, "And Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) made us (i.e. I and Ibn `Abbas) ride along with him and left you
hi: Ibn Abi Mulaika bataate hain: Ibn Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Ibn Ja'far se kaha, "Kya tumhe yaad hai jab main, tum aur Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) Allah ke Rasool ka istikbaal karne gaye the?" Ibn Ja'far ne haan mein jawab diya. Ibn Az-Zubair ne joda, "Aur Allah ke Rasool ne humein (yaani mujhe aur Ibn Abbas ko) apne saath sawar hone diya aur tumhe chhod diya."

e: Narrated As-Sa'ib bin Yazid:I along with some boys went out to receive Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) at Thaniyatal-Wada
hi: As-Saib bin Yazid bataate hain: Main kuch ladkon ke saath Allah ke Rasool ka istikbaal karne Thaniyat-al-Wada gaya.

e: Narrated `Abdullah:When the Prophet (ﷺ) returned (from Jihad), he would say Takbir thrice and add, "We are returning, if Allah wishes, with repentance and worshipping and praising (our Lord) and prostrating ourselves before our Lord. Allah fulfilled His Promise and helped His Slave, and He Alone defeated the (infidel) clans
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Nabi (Jihad se) wapas aate, woh teen baar Takbir kahte aur jodte, "Hum wapas aa rahe hain, Insha Allah, tauba karte huye, ibadat karte huye, aur (apne Rab ki) hamd aur sajda karte huye. Allah ne apna waada poora kiya, aur apne bande ki madad ki, aur usne akele hi (kaafir) qabilon ko haar di."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:We were in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) while returning from 'Usfan, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was riding his she-camel keeping Safiya bint Huyay riding behind him. His she-camel slipped and both of them fell down. Abu Talha jumped from his camel and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! May Allah sacrifice me for you." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Take care of the lady." So, Abu Talha covered his face with a garment and went to Safiya and covered her with it, and then he set right the condition of their she-camel so that both of them rode, and we were encircling Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) like a cover. When we approached Medina, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "We are returning with repentance and worshipping and praising our Lord." He kept on saying this till he entered Medina
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Nabi ki sohbat mein the, Usfan se wapas ate huye, aur Allah ke Rasool apni untni par sawar the, Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Huyai unke peeche sawar thi. Unki untni phisal gayi aur donon gir gaye. Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) apne unt se koodkar utre aur kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Allah mujhe aapke liye qurban kare." Nabi ne kaha, "Un khaatun ka khayaal rakho." Isliye Abu Talha ne apna chehra ek kapde se dhaka aur Safiya ke paas gaye aur unhe usse dhaka, phir unki untni ki haalat theek ki taake donon uspar sawar ho saken, aur hum Allah ke Rasool ko ek parde jaisi tarah gher lete the. Jab hum Madina ke qareeb pahunche, Nabi ne kaha, "Hum wapas aa rahe hain, tauba karte huye, ibadat karte huye, aur apne Rab ki hamd karte huye." Woh yeh kehte rahe jab tak Madina daakhil hue.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:That he and Abu Talha came in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) and Safiya was accompanying the Prophet, who let her ride behind him on his she-camel. During the journey, the she-camel slipped and both the Prophet (ﷺ) and (his) wife fell down. Abu Talha (the sub-narrator thinks that Anas said that Abu Talha jumped from his camel quickly) said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! May Allah sacrifice me for your sake! Did you get hurt?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied,"No, but take care of the lady." Abu Talha covered his face with his garment and proceeded towards her and covered her with his garment, and she got up. He then set right the condition of their she-camel and both of them (i.e. the Prophet (ﷺ) and his wife) rode and proceeded till they approached Medina. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "We are returning with repentance and worshipping and praising our Lord." The Prophet (ﷺ) kept on saying this statement till he entered Medina
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Woh aur Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) Nabi ki sohbat mein aaye aur Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) Nabi ke saath thi, jinhone unhe apni untni par apne peeche sawar hone diya. Safar ke dauran, untni phisal gayi aur Nabi aur (unki) biwi donon gir gaye. Abu Talha (raawi ko lagta hai Anas ne kaha ke Abu Talha apne unt se jaldi se koode) ne kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Allah mujhe aapke liye qurban kare! Kya aapko chot lagi?" Nabi ne jawab diya, "Nahi, magar un khaatun ka khayaal rakho." Abu Talha ne apna chehra apne kapde se dhaka aur unki taraf badhe aur unhe apne kapde se dhaka, aur woh uth khadi hui. Phir unhone untni ki haalat theek ki aur donon (yaani Nabi aur unki biwi) sawar hue aur aage badhe jab tak Madina ke qareeb pahunche. Nabi ne kaha, "Hum wapas aa rahe hain, tauba karte huye, ibadat karte huye, aur apne Rab ki hamd karte huye." Nabi yeh baat kehte rahe jab tak Madina daakhil hue.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:I was on a journey in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) and when we reached Medina, he said to me, "Enter the Mosque and offer two rak`at
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Nabi ki sohbat mein ek safar par tha aur jab hum Madina pahunche, unhone mujhse kaha, "Masjid mein daakhil ho jaao aur do rakat namaz padho."

e: Narrated Ka`b:Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) returned from a journey in the forenoon, he would enter the Mosque and offer two rak`at before sitting
hi: Ka'b bataate hain: Jab bhi Nabi safar se subah wapas aate, woh masjid mein daakhil hokar baithne se pehle do rakat namaz padhte the.

e: Narrated Muharib bin Dithar:Jabir bin `Abdullah said, "When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) arrived at Medina, he slaughtered a camel or a cow." Jabir added, "The Prophet (ﷺ) bought a camel from me for two Uqiyas (of gold) and one or two Dirhams. When he reached Sirar, he ordered that a cow be slaughtered and they ate its meat. When he arrived at Medina, he ordered me to go to the Mosque and offer two rak`at, and weighed (and gave) me the price of the camel
hi: Muharib bin Dithar bataate hain: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Jab Allah ke Rasool Madina pahunche, unhone ek unt ya ek gaay zabah ki." Jabir ne joda, "Nabi ne mujhse ek unt do Uqiya (sona) aur ek ya do Dirham mein khareeda. Jab woh Sirar pahunche, unhone hukum diya ke ek gaay zabah ki jaaye aur unhone uska gosht khaya. Jab woh Madina pahunche, unhone mujhe masjid jaane aur do rakat namaz padhne ka hukum diya, aur unhone unt ki qeemat toolkar mujhe di."

e: Narrated Jabir:Once I returned from a journey and the Prophet (ﷺ) said (to me) "Offer two rak`at." (Sirar is a place near Medina)
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar main safar se wapas aaya aur Nabi ne (mujhse) kaha "Do rakat padho." (Sirar Madina ke qareeb ek jagah hai.)

e: Narrated `Ali:I got a she-camel in my share of the war booty on the day (of the battle) of Badr, and the Prophet (ﷺ) had given me a she-camel from the Khumus. When I intended to marry Fatima, the daughter of Allah's Apostle, I had an appointment with a goldsmith from the tribe of Bani Qainuqa' to go with me to bring Idhkhir (i.e. grass of pleasant smell) and sell it to the goldsmiths and spend its price on my wedding party. I was collecting for my she-camels equipment of saddles, sacks and ropes while my two shecamels were kneeling down beside the room of an Ansari man. I returned after collecting whatever I collected, to see the humps of my two she-camels cut off and their flanks cut open and some portion of their livers was taken out. When I saw that state of my two she-camels, I could not help weeping. I asked, "Who has done this?" The people replied, "Hamza bin `Abdul Muttalib who is staying with some Ansari drunks in this house." I went away till I reached the Prophet (ﷺ) and Zaid bin Haritha was with him. The Prophet (ﷺ) noticed on my face the effect of what I had suffered, so the Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "What is wrong with you?" I replied, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have never seen such a day as today. Hamza attacked my two she-camels, cut off their humps, and ripped open their flanks, and he is sitting there in a house in the company of some drunks." The Prophet (ﷺ) then asked for his covering sheet, put it on, and set out walking followed by me and Zaid bin Haritha till he came to the house where Hamza was. He asked permission to enter, and they allowed him, and they were drunk. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) started rebuking Hamza for what he had done, but Hamza was drunk and his eyes were red. Hamza looked at Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and then he raised his eyes, looking at his knees, then he raised up his eyes looking at his umbilicus, and again he raised up his eyes looking at his face. Hamza then said, "Aren't you but the slaves of my father?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) realized that he was drunk, so Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) retreated, and we went out with him
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Badr ki jung ke din maal-e-ghanimat mein mujhe ek untni mili, aur Nabi ne mujhe ek doosri untni Khumus (paanchvaan hissa) se di. Jab maine Fatima (Alayhas Salam), Allah ke Rasool ki beti, se shaadi ka iraada kiya, maine Bani Qainuqa qabile ke ek sunaar ke saath Idhkhir (khushbudaar ghaas) lane aur use sunaron ko bechne ka waada kiya, taake main uski qeemat apni shaadi ki dawat par kharch kar sakoon. Main apni do untniyon ke liye jin (saddle), thaile aur rassiyaan jama kar raha tha jabke woh donon untniyaan ek Ansari shaks ke kamre ke bagal mein baithi hui thi. Main jama karke wapas aaya to dekha meri donon untniyon ke kohaan (hump) kate hue the aur unke pehlu chire hue the aur unka kuch jigar nikala liya gaya tha. Yeh dekhkar main apne aap ko rone se rok nahi paya. Maine pucha, "Yeh kisne kiya?" Logon ne jawab diya, "Hamza bin Abdul Muttalib, jo is ghar mein kuch Ansaari sharaabiyon ke saath hain." Main Nabi ke paas gaya, jinke saath Zaid bin Haritha the. Nabi ne mere chehre par takleef ke asaraat dekhe, isliye unhone pucha, "Kya baat hai?" Maine jawab diya, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Maine aaj jaisa din kabhi nahi dekha. Hamza ne meri donon untniyon par hamla kiya, unke kohaan kate, unke pehlu chire, aur woh ab wahaan sharaabiyon ke saath baithe hain." Nabi ne apna kapda maangwaya, use pehna, aur chal pade, main aur Zaid bin Haritha unke peeche the, jab tak woh us ghar pahunche jahaan Hamza the. Unhone andar aane ki ijazat maangi aur unhe ijazat mil gayi, aur woh log sharaabi the. Allah ke Rasool Hamza ko unke kiye par daantne lage, magar Hamza sharaabi the aur unki aankhen laal thi. Hamza ne Nabi ki taraf dekha, phir apni nazar oopar uthakar unke ghutnon ko dekha, phir unke naabhi ko dekha, phir unke chehre ko dekha. Hamza ne kaha, "Kya tum mere waalid ke gulaam nahi ho?" Allah ke Rasool ko samajh aa gaya ke woh sharaabi hai, isliye Allah ke Rasool peeche hate, aur hum unke saath bahar aaye.

e: Narrated `Aisha:(mother of the believers) After the death of Allah's Apostle Fatima the daughter of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked Abu Bakr As-Siddiq to give her, her share of inheritance from what Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had left of the Fai (i.e. booty gained without fighting) which Allah had given him. Abu Bakr said to her, "Allah's Apostle said, 'Our property will not be inherited, whatever we (i.e. prophets) leave is Sadaqa (to be used for charity)." Fatima, the daughter of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got angry and stopped speaking to Abu Bakr, and continued assuming that attitude till she died. Fatima remained alive for six months after the death of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). She used to ask Abu Bakr for her share from the property of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) which he left at Khaibar, and Fadak, and his property at Medina (devoted for charity). Abu Bakr refused to give her that property and said, "I will not leave anything Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to do, because I am afraid that if I left something from the Prophet's tradition, then I would go astray." (Later on) `Umar gave the Prophet's property (of Sadaqa) at Medina to `Ali and `Abbas, but he withheld the properties of Khaibar and Fadak in his custody and said, "These two properties are the Sadaqa which Allah's Apostle used to use for his expenditures and urgent needs. Now their management is to be entrusted to the ruler." (Az-Zuhri said, "They have been managed in this way till today)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (momino ki maa) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool ki wafat ke baad, unki beti Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ne Abu Bakr As-Siddiq se apna waraasat ka hissa maanga us Fai (yaani jung ke bina hasil hui maal-e-ghanimat) mein se jo Allah ke Rasool ne chhodi thi aur jo Allah ne unhe di thi. Abu Bakr ne unse kaha, "Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, 'Humari (yaani Nabiyon ki) maal ki waraasat nahi hoti, jo bhi hum chhodte hain woh Sadaqa hai (charity ke liye).'" Fatima (Alayhas Salam) naraaj ho gaee aur Abu Bakr se baat karna band kar diya, aur apni wafat tak yehi rawaiya rakha. Fatima (Alayhas Salam) Allah ke Rasool ki wafat ke chhah mahine baad tak zinda rahi. Woh Abu Bakr se apna hissa maangti rahi us maal se jo Allah ke Rasool ne Khaibar, Fadak, aur Madina mein chhodi thi (charity ke liye vaqf). Abu Bakr ne woh maal dene se inkaar kiya aur kaha, "Main woh koi bhi kaam nahi chhodunga jo Allah ke Rasool karte the, kyunke mujhe dar hai ke agar maine Nabi ki koi baat chhodi, main bhatak jaunga." (Baad mein) Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Madina mein Nabi ki Sadaqa ki maal Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Abbas ko de di, magar Khaibar aur Fadak ki maal apne paas rakhi aur kaha, "Yeh do maal woh Sadaqa hain jinhe Allah ke Rasool apni zaroorton aur kharche ke liye istemal karte the. Ab inka intezam hukmaran ke haath mein rahega." (Az-Zuhri ne kaha, "Aur yeh isi tarah prabandhit ho rahi hain aaj tak.")

e: Narrated Malik bin Aus:While I was at home, the sun rose high and it got hot. Suddenly the messenger of `Umar bin Al-Khattab came to me and said, "The chief of the believers has sent for you." So, I went along with him till I entered the place where `Umar was sitting on a bedstead made of date-palm leaves and covered with no mattress, and he was leaning over a leather pillow. I greeted him and sat down. He said, "O Mali! Some persons of your people who have families came to me and I have ordered that a gift should be given to them, so take it and distribute it among them." I said, "O chief of the believers! I wish that you order someone else to do it." He said, "O man! Take it." While I was sitting there with him, his doorman Yarfa' came saying, "`Uthman, `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf, Az-Zubair and Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas are asking your permission (to see you); may I admit them?" `Umar said, "Yes", So they were admitted and they came in, greeted him, and sat down. After a while Yarfa' came again and said, "May I admit `Ali and `Abbas?" `Umar said, "yes." So, they were admitted and they came in and greeted (him) and sat down. Then `Abbas said, "O chief of the believers! Judge between me and this (i.e. `Ali)." They had a dispute regarding the property of Bani An-Nadir which Allah had given to His Apostle as Fai. The group (i.e. `Uthman and his companions) said, "O chief of the believers! Judge between them and relieve both of them from each other." `Umar said, "Be patient! I beseech you by Allah by Whose Permission the Heaven and the Earth exist, do you know that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Our (i.e. prophets') property will not be inherited, and whatever we leave, is Sadaqa (to be used for charity),' and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) meant himself (by saying "we'')?" The group said, "He said so." `Umar then turned to `Ali and `Abbas and said, "I beseech you by Allah, do you know that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said so?" They replied, " He said so." `Umar then said, "So, I will talk to you about this matter. Allah bestowed on His Apostle with a special favor of something of this Fai (booty) which he gave to nobody else." `Umar then recited the Holy Verses: "What Allah bestowed as (Fai) Booty on his Apostle (Muhammad) from them --- for this you made no expedition with either cavalry or camelry: But Allah gives power to His Apostles over whomever He will 'And Allah is able to do all things." 9:6) `Umar added "So this property was especially given to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), but, by Allah, neither did he take possession of it and leave you, nor did he favor himself with it to your exclusion, but he gave it to all of you and distributed it amongst you till this property remained out of it. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to spend the yearly expenses of his family out of this property and used to keep the rest of its revenue to be spent on Allah's Cause. Allah's Apostle kept on doing this during all his lifetime. I ask you by Allah do you know this?" They replied in the affirmative. `Umar then said to `Ali and `Abbas. "I ask you by Allah, do you know this?" `Umar added, "When Allah had taken His Prophet unto Him, 'Abu Bakr said, 'I am the successor of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) so, Abu Bakr took over that property and managed it in the same way as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to do, and Allah knows that he was true, pious and rightly-guided, and he was a follower of what was right. Then Allah took Abu Bakr unto Him and I became Abu Bakr's successor, and I kept that property in my possession for the first two years of my Caliphate, managing it in the same way as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to do and as Abu Bakr used to do, and Allah knows that I have been true, pious, rightly guided, and a follower of what is right. Now you both (i.e. 'Ali and `Abbas) came to talk to me, bearing the same claim and presenting the same case; you, `Abbas, came to me asking for your share from your nephew's property, and this man, i.e. `Ali, came to me asking for his wife's share from her father's property. I told you both that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Our (prophets') properties are not to be inherited, but what we leave is Sadaqa (to be used for charity).' When I thought it right that I should hand over this property to you, I said to you, 'I am ready to hand over this property to you if you wish, on the condition that you would take Allah's Pledge and Covenant that you would manage it in the same way as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to, and as Abu Bakr used to do, and as I have done since I was in charge of it.' So, both of you said (to me), 'Hand it over to us,' and on that condition I handed it over to you. So, I ask you by Allah, did I hand it over to them on this condition?" The group said, "Yes." Then `Umar faced `Ali and `Abbas saying, "I ask you by Allah, did I hand it over to you on this condition?" They said, "Yes. " He said, " Do you want now to give a different decision? By Allah, by Whose Leave both the Heaven and the Earth exist, I will never give any decision other than that (I have already given). And if you are unable to manage it, then return it to me, and I will do the job on your behalf
hi: Malik bin Aus bataate hain: Jabke main ghar par tha, suraj oonch utha aur garmi ho gaee. Achanak Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab ka khaddam mere paas aaya aur kaha, "Momino ke Ameer ne aapko bulaya hai." Isliye main uske saath gaya jab tak main us jagah pahuncha jahan Umar khajoor ke patton se bane ek chaarpaee par baithe the, bina gaddi ke, aur ek chamde ke takiye par teke hue the. Maine unhe salaam kiya aur baith gaya. Unhone kaha, "Aye Mali! Tumhare logon mein se kuch, jinke pariwara hain, mere paas aaye, aur maine unhe kuch tohfa dene ka hukum diya hai, isliye ise lo aur unme baant do." Maine kaha, "Aye Momino ke Ameer! Kaash aap kisi aur ko yeh karne ka hukum dete." Unhone kaha, "Aye shaks! Ise lo." Jabke main unke saath baitha tha, unka darwaza banda, Yarfa, aaya aur kaha, "Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ), Abdur-Rahman bin Auf, Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ), aur Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (رضی اللہ عنہ) aapse milne ki ijazat maangte hain; kya main unhe andar aane dun?" Umar ne kaha, "Haan," isliye unhe andar aane diya gaya aur woh aaye, salaam kiya, aur baith gaye. Thodi der baad Yarfa phir aaya aur kaha, "Kya main Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Abbas ko andar aane dun?" Umar ne kaha, "Haan." Isliye unhe andar aane diya gaya aur woh aaye, salaam kiya, aur baith gaye. Phir Abbas ne kaha, "Aye Momino ke Ameer! Mere aur inke (yaani Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke) beech faisla keejiye." Unka Bani An-Nadir ki maal ke baare mein jhagda tha jo Allah ne apne Rasool ko Fai ke tor par di thi. Giroh (yaani Uthman aur unke sathi) ne kaha, "Aye Momino ke Ameer! Unke beech faisla keejiye aur unhe ek-doosre se rahat dijiye." Umar ne kaha, "Sabr karo! Main tumhe Allah ki qasam dekar poochta hoon, jiski ijazat se aasman aur zameen qaayam hain, kya tumhe pata hai Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, 'Humari (yaani Nabiyon ki) maal ki waraasat nahi hoti, aur jo hum chhodte hain woh Sadaqa hai,' aur Allah ke Rasool ka matlab khud unse tha (jab unhone 'hum' kaha)?" Giroh ne kaha, "Unhone yeh kaha." Umar phir Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Abbas ki taraf mude aur kaha, "Main tumhe Allah ki qasam dekar poochta hoon, kya tumhe pata hai Allah ke Rasool ne yeh kaha?" Unhone jawab diya, "Unhone yeh kaha." Umar ne phir kaha, "Isliye main is maamle ke baare mein tumse baat karunga. Allah ne apne Rasool ko is Fai (maal-e-ghanimat) mein se ek khaas ehsaan diya jo usne kisi aur ko nahi diya." Umar ne phir yeh paak Ayaat padhi: "Jo bhi Allah ne apne Rasool (Muhammad) ko unse Fai (booty) ke tor par diya — iske liye tumne na ghodon se na unton se koi safar kiya; magar Allah apne Rasoolon ko jispar chahe Qaadir bana deta hai. Aur Allah har cheez par Qaadir hai" (59:6). Umar ne joda, "Isliye yeh maal khaas Allah ke Rasool ko di gaee, magar Allah ki qasam, na unhone use apne liye rakha aur tumhe chhoda, na unhone ise sirf apne liye khaas rakha tumhein us se vanchit karke, balki unhone yeh tum sabko di aur tum sabme baant di jab tak yeh maal us hisse tak rah gaee (jise unhone rakha). Allah ke Rasool apne pariwara ke saalana kharche isi maal se dete the, aur baaki aamdani Allah ki raah mein kharch karne ke liye rakhte the. Allah ke Rasool ne apni poori zindagi aisa hi kiya. Main tumhe Allah ki qasam dekar poochta hoon, kya tumhe yeh pata hai?" Unhone haan mein jawab diya. Umar ne phir Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Abbas se kaha, "Main tumhe Allah ki qasam dekar poochta hoon, kya tumhe yeh pata hai?" Umar ne joda, "Jab Allah ne apne Nabi ko apni taraf bula liya, Abu Bakr ne kaha, 'Main Allah ke Rasool ka janshin hoon,' isliye Abu Bakr ne woh maal sambhali aur uska intezam usi tarah kiya jaisa Allah ke Rasool karte the, aur Allah jaanta hai ke woh sachche, pakbaaz, aur sahi raah par chalne wale the, aur woh sahi cheez ki pairvi karte the. Phir Allah ne Abu Bakr ko apni taraf bula liya aur main Abu Bakr ka janshin bana, aur maine woh maal apni khilafat ke pahle do saal apne kabze mein rakhi, isi tarah intezam karte huye jaise Allah ke Rasool aur Abu Bakr karte the, aur Allah jaanta hai ke main sachcha, pakbaaz, sahi raah par chalne wala hoon, aur main sahi cheez ki pairvi karta hoon. Ab tum donon (yaani Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Abbas) mujhse baat karne aaye ho, ek hi daava aur ek hi maamla pesh karte huye; tum, Abbas, mere paas apne bhatije ki maal se apna hissa maangne aaye, aur yeh shaks, yaani Ali (Alayhis Salam), apni biwi ka hissa unke waalid ki maal se maangne aaya. Maine tum dono ko bataya ke Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, 'Humari (Nabiyon ki) maal ki waraasat nahi hoti, magar jo hum chhodte hain woh Sadaqa hai.' Jab maine socha ke mujhe yeh maal tumhe sonp deni chahiye, maine tumse kaha, 'Main yeh maal tumhe sonpne ke liye taiyaar hoon agar tum chaho, is shart par ke tum Allah ka ahad aur waada loge ke tum ise usi tarah prabandhit karoge jaise Allah ke Rasool karte the, aur jaise Abu Bakr karte the, aur jaise maine (jab se main iska prabandhak hoon) kiya hai.' Isliye tum dono ne (mujhse) kaha, 'Ise humein sonp do,' aur us shart par maine tumhe yeh sonp diya. Isliye main tumhe Allah ki qasam dekar poochta hoon, kya maine unhe yeh isi shart par sonpi thi?" Giroh ne kaha, "Haan." Phir Umar Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Abbas ki taraf mude aur kaha, "Main tumhe Allah ki qasam dekar poochta hoon, kya maine tumhe yeh isi shart par sonpi thi?" Unhone kaha, "Haan." Unhone kaha, "Kya tum ab koi doosra faisla chahte ho? Allah ki qasam, jiske ijazat se aasman aur zameen qaayam hain, main is (faisle) ke ilawa koi doosra faisla kabhi nahi dunga. Aur agar tum ise sambhal nahi pate, to ise mujhe wapas kar do, aur main tumhaari taraf se yeh kaam karunga."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The delegates of the tribe of `Abdul-Qais came and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We are from the tribe of Rabi`a, and there is the infidels of the tribe of Mudar intervening between you and us, so we cannot come to you except in the Sacred Months. So please order us some instructions that we may apply it to ourselves and also invite our people whom we left behind us to observe as well." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I order you (to do) four (things) and forbid you (to do) four: I order you to believe in Allah, that is, to testify that None has the right to be worshipped but Allah (the Prophet (ﷺ) pointed with his hand); to offer prayers perfectly; to pay Zakat; to fast the month of Ramadan, and to pay the Khumus (i.e. one-fifth) of the war booty to Allah and I forbid you to use Ad-dubba', An-Naqir, Al-Hantam and Al-Muzaffat (i.e. utensils used for preparing alcoholic drinks)." (See Hadith No. 50, Vol)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abdul-Qais qabile ke wafd aaye aur kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Hum Rabi'a qabile se hain, aur humare aur aapke beech Mudar qabile ke kaafir bache hue hain, isliye hum aapke paas sirf muqaddas mahinon mein aa sakte hain. Isliye humein kuch hidayaat dijiye jinpar hum khud amal karen aur jinhe hum apne peeche chhode logon ko bhi bulane ke liye istemal karen." Nabi ne kaha, "Main tumhe chaar cheezon ka hukum deta hoon aur chaar cheezon se mana karta hoon: Main tumhe Allah par iman rakhne ka hukum deta hoon, yaani gawahi dena ke Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahi (Nabi ne apne haath se ishara kiya); namaz mukammal padhne; Zakat dene; Ramadan ke roze rakhne; aur maal-e-ghanimat ka Khumus (yaani ek-paanchvaan hissa) Allah ko dene ka. Aur main tumhe Ad-dubba, An-Naqir, Al-Hantam, aur Al-Muzaffat (yaani sharaab banane ke bartan) istemal karne se mana karta hoon." (Dekhen Hadith No. 50, Vol.)

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "My heirs should not take even a single Dinar (i.e. anything from my property), and whatever I leave, excluding the expenditure of my wives and my laborers, will be Sadaqa (i.e. be used for charity)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Mere waaris ek bhi Dinar (yaani mera maal se kuch) na len, aur jo bhi main chhodta hoon, apni biwiyon aur mulazimon ke kharche ke ilawa, woh Sadaqa (yaani charity ke liye) hoga."

e: Narrated Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died, and there was nothing in my house that a living being could eat, except some barley Lying on a shelf. So, I ate of it for a long period and measured it, and (after a short period) it was consumed
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool ka intiqal hua, aur mere ghar mein koi bhi cheez nahi thi jo koi zinda mahluk kha sake, siwaye kuch jau ke jo ek taak par pade the. Isliye maine unhe lambe waqt tak khaya aur naapa, aur (thode waqt baad) woh khatam ho gaye.

e: Narrated `Amr bin Al-Harith:The Prophet (ﷺ) did not leave anything (after his death) except his arms, a white mule, and a (piece of) land which he had given as Sadaqa
hi: Amr bin Al-Harith bataate hain: Nabi ne apni maut ke baad kuch nahi chhoda siwaye apne hathiyaar, ek safed khachchar, aur zameen ka ek tukda jise unhone Sadaqa mein diya tha.

e: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) When the sickness of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got aggravated, he asked the permission of his wives that he should be treated in my house, and they permitted him
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool ki bimari badh gaee, unhone apni biwiyon se ijazat maangi ke unka ilaaj mere ghar mein ho, aur unhone ijazat de di.

e: Narrated Ibn Abu Mulaika:`Aisha said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) died in my house on the day of my turn while he was leaning on my chest closer to my neck, and Allah made my saliva mix with his Saliva." `Aisha added, "`AbdurRahman came with a Siwak and the Prophet (ﷺ) was too weak to use it so I took it, chewed it and then (gave it to him and he) cleaned his teeth with it
hi: Ibn Abu Mulaika bataate hain: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha, "Nabi ka intiqal mere ghar mein hua mere baari ke din, jabke woh mere seene par, gale ke qareeb, teke hue the, aur Allah ne mera laar unke laar se mila diya." Ayesha ne joda, "Abdur-Rahman Siwaak (dant saaf karne ki lakdi) lekar aaye aur Nabi bahut kamzor the use istemal karne ke liye, isliye maine woh liya, chabaya, aur (unhe di aur unhone) usse apne daant saaf kiye."

e: Narrated Safiya:(the wife of the Prophet) That she came to visit Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while he was in I`tikaf (i.e. seclusion in the Mosque during the last ten days of Ramadan). When she got up to return, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got up with her and accompanied her, and when he reached near the gate of the Mosque close to the door (of the house) of Um Salama, the wife of the Prophet, two Ansari men passed by them and greeted Allah's Apostle and then went away. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) addressed them saying, "Don't hurry! (She is my wife)," They said, "Glorified be Allah! O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (You are far away from any suspicion)," and his saying was hard on them. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Satan circulates in the mind of a person as blood does (in his body). I was afraid that Satan might put some (evil) thoughts in your minds
hi: Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki biwi) bataati hain: Woh Allah ke Rasool se milne gaee jabke woh I'tikaf mein the (yaani Ramadan ke aakhri das dinon mein masjid mein ekaant). Jab woh wapas jane ke liye uthi, Allah ke Rasool bhi unke saath uthe aur unhe chhodne gaye, aur jab woh masjid ke darwaze ke qareeb pahunche, Um Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki biwi) ke ghar ke darwaze ke qareeb, do Ansaari log wahaan se guzre aur Allah ke Rasool ko salaam kiya aur chale gaye. Allah ke Rasool ne unse kaha, "Jaldi mat karo! (Yeh meri biwi hai)." Unhone kaha, "Subhanallah! Ya Allah ke Rasool! (Aap kisi shak se bahut door hain)," aur unki yeh baat unke liye mushkil thi. Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Shaitaan insaan ke dimaag mein khoon ki tarah gahar jata hai. Mujhe dar tha ke Shaitaan tumhare dimaag mein koi (bura) khyaal daal de."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Once I went upstairs in Hafsa's house and saw the Prophet (ﷺ) answering the call of nature with his back towards the Qibla and facing Sham
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar main Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke ghar oopar gaya aur maine Nabi ko dekha qaza-e-hajat karte huye, unki peeth Qibla ki taraf aur unka chehra Sham ki taraf.

e: Narrated Aisha:That Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to offer the `Asr prayer while the sun was still shining in her Hujra (i.e. her dwelling place)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool Asr ki namaz un ke Hujra (yaani unke rehne ki jagah) mein suraj ki roshni abhi bhi maujood rehte huye padhte the.

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) stood up and delivered a sermon, and pointing to `Aisha's house (i.e. eastwards), he said thrice, "Affliction (will appear from) here," and, "from where the side of the Satan's head comes out (i.e. from the East)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi khade hue aur khutba diya, aur Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke ghar ki taraf (yaani mashrik/purab ki taraf) ishara karte huye, unhone teen baar kaha, "Fitna yahan se (aayegi)," aur, "jahan se Shaitaan ke sar ka hissa nikalta hai (yaani mashrik se)."

e: Narrated `Amra bint `Abdur-Rahman:`Aisha, the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ) told her that once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was with her and she heard somebody asking permission to enter Hafsa's house. She said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! This man is asking permission to enter your house." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, "I think he is so-and-so (meaning the foster uncle of Hafsa). What is rendered illegal because of blood relations, is also rendered illegal because of the corresponding foster-relations
hi: Amra bint Abdur-Rahman bataati hain: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا), Nabi ki biwi, ne unhe bataya ke ek baar Allah ke Rasool unke saath the aur unhone kisi ko Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke ghar mein aane ki ijazat maangte suna. Unhone kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Yeh shaks aapke ghar mein aane ki ijazat maangte hai." Allah ke Rasool ne jawab diya, "Mujhe lagta hai woh falaan-falaan hain (yaani Hafsa ke doodh-rishte ke chacha ka matlab tha). Jo khoon ke rishton ki wajah se haram hai, woh doodh-rishton ki wajah se bhi haram ho jata hai."

e: Narrated Anas:That when Abu Bakr became the Caliph, he sent him to Bahrain and wrote this letter for him, and stamped it with the Ring of the Prophet. Three lines were engraved on the Ring, (the word) 'Muhammad' was in a line, 'Apostle' was in another line, and 'Allah' in a third
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Abu Bakr Khalifa bane, unhone unhe (yaani Anas ko) Bahrain bheja aur unke liye yeh khat likha aur ise Nabi ki angoothi se muhar lagaee. Angoothi par teen laainen khudi hui thi, ek laain mein 'Muhammad,' doosri mein 'Rasool,' aur teesri mein 'Allah.'

e: Narrated `Isa bin Tahman:Anas brought out to us two worn out leather shoes without hair and with pieces of leather straps. Later on Thabit Al-Bunani told me that Anas said that they were the shoes of the Prophet
hi: Isa bin Tahman bataate hain: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) humare paas do purane, baalon rahit chamde ke joote laaye, jinme chamde ki pattiyaan thi. Baad mein Thabit Al-Bunani ne mujhe bataya ke Anas ne kaha ke yeh Nabi ke joote the.

e: Narrated Abu Burda:`Aisha brought out to us a patched woollen garment, and she said, "(It chanced that) the soul of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was taken away while he was wearing this." Abu-Burda added, "Aisha brought out to us a thick waist sheet like the ones made by the Yemenites, and also a garment of the type called Al-Mulabbada
hi: Abu Burda bataate hain: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) humare paas ek chithadi lagi hui ooni kapda laee, aur unhone kaha, "(Aisa hua ke) Allah ke Rasool ki rooh nikli jabke woh yeh pehne hue the." Abu Burda ne joda, "Ayesha humare paas ek moti kamar ki chaadar bhi laee jaisi Yemeni banate hain, aur ek Al-Mulabbada naam ka kapda bhi."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:When the cup of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got broken, he fixed it with a silver wire at the crack. (The subnarrator, `Asim said, "I saw the cup and drank (water) in it
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool ka pyala tut gaya, unhone ise chandi ke taar se darar par theek kiya. (Doosre raawi, Asim ne kaha, "Maine woh pyala dekha aur usme (paani) piya.")

e: Narrated `Ali bin Al-Husain:That when they reached Medina after returning from Yazid bin Mu'awiya after the martyrdom of Husain bin `Ali (may Allah bestow His Mercy upon him), Al-Miswar bin Makhrama met him and said to him, "Do you have any need you may order me to satisfy?" `Ali said, "No." Al-Miswar said, Will you give me the sword of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for I am afraid that people may take it from you by force? By Allah, if you give it to me, they will never be able to take it till I die." When `Ali bin Abu Talib demanded the hand of the daughter of Abi Jahal to be his wife besides Fatima, I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on his pulpit delivering a sermon in this connection before the people, and I had then attained my age of puberty. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Fatima is from me, and I am afraid she will be subjected to trials in her religion (because of jealousy)." The Prophet (ﷺ) then mentioned one of his son-in-law who was from the tribe of 'Abdi Shams, and he praised him as a good son-in-law, saying, "Whatever he said was the truth, and he promised me and fulfilled his promise. I do not make a legal thing illegal, nor do I make an illegal thing legal, but by Allah, the daughter of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and the daughter of the enemy of Allah, (i.e. Abu Jahl) can never get together (as the wives of one man) (See Hadith No. 76, Vo)
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bin Al-Husain bataate hain: Jab woh Yazid bin Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) se wapas aakar Madina pahunche Husain bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) (Allah unpar reham kare) ki shahaadat ke baad, Al-Miswar bin Makhrama (رضی اللہ عنہ) unse mile aur unse kaha, "Kya aapko koi zaroorat hai jo main aapke liye poori kar sakoon?" Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha, "Nahi." Al-Miswar ne kaha, "Kya aap mujhe Allah ke Rasool ki talwar denge, kyunke mujhe dar hai log ise aapse zabardasti le lenge? Allah ki qasam, agar aap ise mujhe denge, woh ise kabhi nahi le sakenge jab tak main mar na jaoon." Jab Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ne Abu Jahl ki beti ka haath maanga apni biwi banane ke liye Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ke saath, maine Allah ke Rasool ko unke mimbar par is silsile mein logon ke saamne khutba dete suna, aur us waqt main baalig hone ki umr ko pahunch chuka tha. Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Fatima (Alayhas Salam) mujhse hai, aur mujhe dar hai ke woh apne deen mein azmaishon ka shikaar hogi (jalan ki wajah se)." Nabi ne phir apne ek daamaad ka zikar kiya jo Abdi Shams qabile se the, aur unki taarif ki ek achhe daamaad ke tor par, kehte huye, "Woh jo bhi kehte, sach hota, aur unhone mujhse waada kiya aur use poora kiya. Main kisi jaiz cheez ko na-jaiz nahi banata, na hi kisi na-jaiz cheez ko jaiz banata, magar Allah ki qasam, Allah ke Rasool ki beti aur Allah ke dushman (yaani Abu Jahl) ki beti kabhi ek saath (ek shohar ki biwiyon ke tor par) nahi ho sakti." (Dekhen Hadith No. 76, Vol.)

e: Narrated Ibn Al-Hanafiya:If `Ali had spoken anything bad about `Uthman then he would have mentioned the day when some persons came to him and complained about the Zakat officials of `Uthman. `Ali then said to me, "Go to `Uthman and say to him, 'This document contains the regulations of spending the Sadaqa of Allah's Apostle so order your Zakat officials to act accordingly." I took the document to `Uthman. `Uthman said, "Take it away, for we are not in need of it." I returned to `Ali with it and informed him of that. He said, "Put it whence you took it
hi: Ibn Al-Hanafiya bataate hain: Agar Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke baare mein kuch bura kaha hota, to woh us din ka zikar karte jab kuch log unke paas aaye aur Uthman ke Zakat adhikariyon ki shikayat ki. Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne phir mujhse kaha, "Uthman ke paas jaao aur unse kaho, 'Yeh dastavez Allah ke Rasool ke Sadaqa kharch karne ke qawaanin rakhti hai, isliye apne Zakat adhikariyon ko iske mutabiq amal karne ka hukum den.'" Main woh dastavez Uthman ke paas le gaya. Uthman ne kaha, "Ise le jaao, kyunke humein iski zaroorat nahi." Main use lekar Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke paas wapas aaya aur unhe iske baare mein bataya. Unhone kaha, "Ise wahaan rakh do jahaan se tumne liya tha."

e: Muhammad bin Suqa:I heard Mundhir at-Tawri reporting Ibn Hanafiya who said, "My father sent me saying, 'Take this letter to `Uthman for it contains the orders of the Prophet (ﷺ) concerning the Sadaqa
hi: Muhammad bin Suqa bataate hain: Maine Mundhir at-Tawri ko Ibn Hanafiya se riwaayat karte suna jinhone kaha, "Mere waalid ne mujhe yeh kehte hue bheja, 'Yeh khat Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas le jaao kyunke isme Nabi ke Sadaqa ke baare mein hukum hain.'"

e: Narrated `Ali:Fatima complained of what she suffered from the hand mill and from grinding, when she got the news that some slave girls of the booty had been brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). She went to him to ask for a maid-servant, but she could not find him, and told `Aisha of her need. When the Prophet (ﷺ) came, Aisha informed him of that. The Prophet (ﷺ) came to our house when we had gone to our beds. (On seeing the Prophet) we were going to get up, but he said, 'Keep at your places,' I felt the coolness of the Prophet's feet on my chest. Then he said, "Shall I tell you a thing which is better than what you asked me for? When you go to your beds, say: 'Allahu Akbar (i.e. Allah is Greater)' for 34 times, and 'Al hamdu Li llah (i.e. all the praises are for Allah)' for 33 times, and Subhan Allah (i.e. Glorified be Allah) for 33 times. This is better for you than what you have requested
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ne haath ki chaki aur pisne se hone wali takleef ki shikayat ki, jab unhe khabar mili ke maal-e-ghanimat ki kuch launDiyaan Allah ke Rasool ke paas laee gaee hain. Woh unse ek khaadima maangne gaee magar unhe wahaan na paaya, aur Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko apni zaroorat bataee. Jab Nabi aaye, Ayesha ne unhe iske baare mein bataya. Nabi humare ghar aaye jabke hum apne bistaron par ja chuke the. (Nabi ko dekh kar) hum uthne wale the, magar unhone kaha, "Apni jagah par raho," maine Nabi ke paanv ki thandak apne seene par mahsoos ki. Phir unhone kaha, "Kya main tumhe woh bataoon jo tumne mujhse maanga tha usse behtar hai? Jab tum apne bistar par jaao, kaho: 'Allahu Akbar (yaani Allah sabse bada hai)' 34 baar, aur 'Al hamdu Lillah (yaani sab tareefein Allah ke liye hain)' 33 baar, aur 'Subhan Allah' (yaani Allah paak hai) 33 baar. Yeh tumhare liye behtar hai us cheez se jo tumne maangi thi."

e: Narrated Jabir bin 'Abdullah (ra):A boy was born to one of our men, the Ansar, and he wanted to name him Muhammad. The Ansari man said, "I took the boy to the Prophet (ﷺ). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Name your child by my name, but do not name (them) by my Kunya, for I have been made Qasim (i.e., a distributor) to distribute (the booty etc.) amongst you." The narrator, Husain said that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I have been sent as a Qasim (i.e., distributor) to distribute (things) amongst you." [The Sub narrator Salim said that he heard Jabir saying that the man wanted to name the boy Al-Qasim, but the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Call (your sons) by my name, but do not name (them) by my Kunya
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Humare ek Ansaar shaks ke ek beta hua aur woh use Muhammad naam dena chahta tha. Ansaar shaks ne kaha, "Main ladke ko Nabi ke paas le gaya. Nabi ne kaha, 'Apne bachche ka naam mere naam par rakho, magar meri Kunya (naam) mat rakho, kyunke mujhe Qasim (yaani baantne wala) banaya gaya hai taake main tum mein (maal-e-ghanimat waghera) baant sakoon.'" Raawi, Husain ne kaha ke Nabi ne kaha, "Mujhe Qasim (yaani baantne wala) ke tor par bheja gaya hai taake main tum mein cheezein baant sakoon." [Doosre raawi Salim ne kaha ke unhone Jabir ko kehte suna ke shaks apne bete ka naam Al-Qasim rakhna chahta tha, magar Nabi ne kaha, "(Apne beton ka naam) mere naam par rakho, magar meri Kunya mat rakho."]

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah Al-Ansari:A man amongst us begot a boy whom he named Al-Qasim. On that the Ansar said, (to the man), "We will never call you Abu-al-Qasim and will never please you with this blessed title." So, he went to the Prophet and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have begotten a boy whom I named Al-Qasim and the Ansar said, 'We will never call you Abu-al-Qasim, nor will we please you with this title.' " The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The Ansar have done well. Name by my name, but do not name by my Kunya, for I am Qasim
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ansari bataate hain: Humare beech ek shaks ke ek beta hua jise usne Al-Qasim naam diya. Isspar Ansaar ne (us shaks se) kaha, "Hum tumhe kabhi Abu-al-Qasim nahi bulaenge aur tumhe is mubaarak upaadhi se khush nahi karenge." Isliye woh Nabi ke paas gaya aur kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Mere ek beta hua hai jise maine Al-Qasim naam diya aur Ansaar ne kaha, 'Hum tumhe kabhi Abu-al-Qasim nahi bulaenge, na is upaadhi se tumhe khush karenge.'" Nabi ne kaha, "Ansaar ne acha kiya. Mere naam par naam rakho, magar meri Kunya par mat rakho, kyunke main Qasim hoon."

e: Narrated Muawiya:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If Allah wants to do good for somebody, he makes him comprehend the Religion (i.e. Islam), and Allah is the Giver and I am Al-Qasim (i.e. the distributor), and this (Muslim) nation will remain victorious over their opponents, till Allah's Order comes and they will still be victorious
hi: Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Agar Allah kisi ke liye bhalaee chahta hai, woh use deen (yaani Islam) ki samajh deta hai, aur Allah dene wala hai aur main Al-Qasim (yaani baantne wala) hoon, aur yeh (Musalman) ummat apne muqablon par fatah paati rahegi jab tak Allah ka hukum na aa jaaye, aur tab bhi woh fatah paane wali hi rahegi."

e: Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Neither do I give you (anything) nor withhold (anything) from you, but I am just a distributor (i.e. Qasim), and I give as I am ordered
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Na main tumhe (kuch) deta hoon, na tumse (kuch) rokta hoon, balki main sirf ek baantne wala (yaani Qasim) hoon, aur main jaisa hukum diya jaata hai waisa deta hoon."

e: Narrated Khaula Al-Ansariya:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "Some people spend Allah's Wealth (i.e. Muslim's wealth) in an unjust manner; such people will be put in the (Hell) Fire on the Day of Resurrection
hi: Khaula Al-Ansariya bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool ko kehte suna, "Kuch log Allah ki daulat (yaani Musalmanon ki daulat) na-insaafi se kharch karte hain; aise log Qiyamat ke din (Dozakh ki) aag mein daale jaayenge."

e: Narrated `Urwa-al-Bariqi:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Horses are always the source of good, namely, rewards (in the Hereafter) and booty, till the Day of Resurrection
hi: Urwa-al-Bariqi bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Ghode hamesha bhalaee ka zariya rahte hain, yaani ajr (Aakhirat mein) aur maal-e-ghanimat (is duniya mein), Qiyamat tak."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When Khosrau is ruined, there will be no Khosrau after him; and when Caesar is ruined, there will be no Caesar after him. By Him in Whose Hands my life is, you will spend their treasures in Allah's Cause
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jab Khusrau barbaad hoga, uske baad koi Khusrau nahi hoga; aur jab Caesar barbaad hoga, uske baad koi Caesar nahi hoga. Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri zindagi hai, tum unke khazanon ko Allah ki raah mein kharch karoge."

e: Narrated Jabir bin Samura:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When Khosrau is ruined, there will be no Khosrau after him; and when Caesar is ruined, their will be no Caesar after him. By Him in Whose Hands my life is, you will spend their treasures in Allah's Cause
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Samura bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jab Khusrau barbaad hoga, uske baad koi Khusrau nahi hoga; aur jab Caesar barbaad hoga, uske baad koi Caesar nahi hoga. Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri zindagi hai, tum unke khazanon ko Allah ki raah mein kharch karoge."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Booty has been made legal for me
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Maal-e-ghanimat mere liye jaiz ki gayi hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah guarantees him who strives in His Cause and whose motivation for going out is nothing but Jihad in His Cause and belief in His Word, that He will admit him into Paradise (if martyred) or bring him back to his dwelling place, whence he has come out, with what he gains of reward and booty
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Allah zamanat deta hai us shaks ko jo uski raah mein koshish karta hai aur jiska ghar se nikalne ka maqsad sirf uski raah mein Jihad aur uske alfaaz par iman hai, ke woh use Jannat mein daakhil karega (agar shaheed ho jaaye) ya use uske ghar wapas la dega, jahaan se woh nikla tha, uski jitni bhi ajr aur maal-e-ghanimat use mile."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A prophet amongst the prophets carried out a holy military expedition, so he said to his followers, 'Anyone who has married a woman and wants to consummate the marriage, and has not done so yet, should not accompany me; nor should a man who has built a house but has not completed its roof; nor a man who has sheep or shecamels and is waiting for the birth of their young ones.' So, the prophet carried out the expedition and when he reached that town at the time or nearly at the time of the `Asr prayer, he said to the sun, 'O sun! You are under Allah's Order and I am under Allah's Order O Allah! Stop it (i.e. the sun) from setting.' It was stopped till Allah made him victorious. Then he collected the booty and the fire came to burn it, but it did not burn it. He said (to his men), 'Some of you have stolen something from the booty. So one man from every tribe should give me a pledge of allegiance by shaking hands with me.' (They did so and) the hand of a man got stuck over the hand of their prophet. Then that prophet said (to the man), 'The theft has been committed by your people. So all the persons of your tribe should give me the pledge of allegiance by shaking hands with me.' The hands of two or three men got stuck over the hand of their prophet and he said, "You have committed the theft.' Then they brought a head of gold like the head of a cow and put it there, and the fire came and consumed the booty. The Prophet (ﷺ) added: Then Allah saw our weakness and disability, so he made booty legal for us
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne farmaya: "Nabiyon mein se ek Nabi ne ek muqaddas fauji muhim par jane ka faisla kiya, isliye unhone apne pairokaron se kaha, 'Jisne kisi aurat se shaadi ki hai aur usse milna chahta hai, magar abhi tak nahi mila, woh mere saath na aaye; na hi woh mard jisne ghar banaya hai magar iski chhat poori nahi ki; na hi woh mard jiske paas bhedein ya untniyaan hain aur woh unke bachchon ke janam ka intezar kar raha hai.' Isliye Nabi ne muhim shuru ki aur jab woh us shehar tak pahunche, Asr ki namaz ke waqt ya uske qareeb, unhone suraj se kaha, 'Aye suraj! Tu Allah ke hukum ke maatahat hai aur main bhi Allah ke hukum ke maatahat hoon. Aye Allah! Ise (yaani suraj ko) doobne se roko.' Woh (suraj) ruka reha jab tak Allah ne unhe fatah di. Phir unhone maal-e-ghanimat jama kiya, aur aag use jalane aee, magar aag ne use nahi jalaya. Unhone kaha (apne logon se), 'Tum mein se kisi ne maal-e-ghanimat mein se kuch churaya hai. Isliye har qabile ka ek shaks mujhse haath milakar bai'at kare.' (Unhone aisa kiya aur) ek shaks ka haath unke Nabi ke haath se chipak gaya. Phir us Nabi ne (us shaks se) kaha, 'Yeh chori tumhare qabile ne ki hai. Isliye tumhare poore qabile ke sab log mujhse haath milakar bai'at karen.' Do ya teen logon ke haath unke Nabi ke haath se chipak gaye, aur unhone kaha, 'Tumne chori ki hai.' Phir woh gaay ke sar jitni sona ki ek murti laaye aur use wahaan rakha, aur aag aee aur maal-e-ghanimat ko jala diya." Nabi ne joda: "Phir Allah ne humari kamzori aur asamarthata dekhi, isliye usne humare liye maal-e-ghanimat jaiz kar diya."

e: Narrated Aslam:`Umar said, "Were it not for those Muslims who have not come to existence yet, I would have distributed (the land of) every town I conquer among the fighters as the Prophet (ﷺ) distributed the land of Khaibar
hi: Aslam bataate hain: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Agar un Musalmanon ka khyaal na hota jo abhi paida nahi hue, main har shehar ki (jise main fatah karun) zameen jungjuon mein taqseem kar deta jaisa Nabi ne Khaibar ki zameen taqseem ki thi."

e: Narrated Abu Musa Al-Ash`ari:A bedouin asked the Prophet, "A man may fight for the sake of booty, and another may fight so that he may be mentioned by the people, and a third may fight to show his position (i.e. bravery); which of these is regarded as fighting in Allah's Cause?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who fights so that Allah's Word (i.e. Islam) should be superior, fights for Allah's Cause
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ash'ari bataate hain: Ek dehati ne Nabi se pucha, "Ek shaks maal-e-ghanimat ke liye jung karta hai, doosra taake log uskaa zikar karen, aur teesra apni himmat dikhane ke liye (yaani bahaduri); inme se kaun Allah ki raah mein jung karta hai?" Nabi ne kaha, "Jo koi is niyyat se jung kare ke Allah ka kalima buland ho (yaani Islam ki fatah), woh Allah ki raah mein jung karta hai."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abu Mulaika:Some silken cloaks with golden buttons were presented to the Prophet. He distributed them amongst his companions and kept one for Makhrama, bin Naufal. Later on Makhrama came along with his son Al-Miswar bin Makhrama, and stood up at the gate and said (to his son). "Call him (i.e. the Prophet) to me." The Prophet (ﷺ) heard his voice, took a silken cloak and brought it to him, placing those golden buttons in front of him saying, "O Abu-al-Miswar! I have kept this aside for you! O Abu-al Miswar! I have kept this aside for you!" Makhrama was a bad-tempered man
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abu Mulaika bataate hain: Nabi ke paas kuch resham ke choge pesh kiye gaye jinme sone ke batan the. Unhone unhe apne sahaba mein taqseem kar diya aur ek Makhrama bin Naufal ke liye rakha. Baad mein Makhrama apne bete Al-Miswar bin Makhrama (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath aaye aur darwaze par khade hokar (apne bete se) kaha, "Unhe (yaani Nabi ko) mere paas bulao." Nabi ne unki aawaz suni, ek resham ka choga liya aur unke paas laaye, sone ke batan unke saamne rakhte huye kehte huye, "Aye Abu-al-Miswar! Maine ise tumhare liye alag rakha tha! Aye Abu-al-Miswar! Maine ise tumhare liye alag rakha tha!" Makhrama sakht gussaaavali tabiyat wale shaks the.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:People used to give some of their datepalms to the Prophet (as a gift), till he conquered Bani Quraiza and Bani An-Nadir, whereupon he started returning their favors
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Log Nabi ko apni khajoor ke darakhton mein se kuch (tohfe ke tor par) dete the, jab tak unhone Bani Quraiza aur Bani An-Nadir ko fatah kiya, jiske baad unhone unka ehsaan wapas karna shuru kiya.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Az-Zubair:When Az-Zubair got up during the battle of Al-Jamal, he called me and I stood up beside him, and he said to me, "O my son! Today one will be killed either as an oppressor or as an oppressed one. I see that I will be killed as an oppressed one. My biggest worry is my debts. Do you think, if we pay the debts, there will be something left for us from our money?" Az-Zubair added, "O my son! Sell our property and pay my debts." Az-Zubair then willed one-third of his property and willed one-third of that portion to his sons; namely, `Abdullah's sons. He said, "One-third of the one third. If any property is left after the payment of the debts, one-third (of the one-third of what is left) is to be given to your sons." (Hisham, a sub-narrator added, "Some of the sons of `Abdullah were equal in age to the sons of Az-Zubair e.g. Khubaib and `Abbas. `Abdullah had nine sons and nine daughters at that time." (The narrator `Abdullah added:) My father (Az-Zubair) went on drawing my attention to his debts saying, "If you should fail to pay part of the debts, appeal to my Master to help you." By Allah! I could not understand what he meant till I asked, "O father! Who is your Master?" He replied, "Allah (is my Master)." By Allah, whenever I had any difficulty regarding his debts, I would say, "Master of Az-Zubair! Pay his debts on his behalf ." and Allah would (help me to) pay it. Az-Zubair was martyred leaving no Dinar or Dirham but two pieces of land, one of which was (called) Al-Ghaba, and eleven houses in Medina, two in Basra, one in Kufa and one in Egypt. In fact, the source of the debt which he owed was, that if somebody brought some money to deposit with him. Az-Zubair would say, "No, (i won't keep it as a trust), but I take it as a debt, for I am afraid it might be lost." Az-Zubair was never appointed governor or collector of the tax of Kharaj or any other similar thing, but he collected his wealth (from the war booty he gained) during the holy battles he took part in, in the company of the Prophet, Abu Bakr, `Umar, and `Uthman. (`Abdullah bin Az-Zubair added:) When I counted his debt, it turned to be two million and two hundred thousand. (The sub-narrator added:) Hakim bin Hizam met `Abdullah bin Zubair and asked, "O my nephew! How much is the debt of my brother?" `Abdullah kept it as a secret and said, "One hundred thousand," Hakim said, "By Allah! I don't think your property will cover it." On that `Abdullah said to him, "What if it is two million and two hundred thousand?" Hakim said, "I don't think you can pay it; so if you are unable to pay all of it, I will help you." Az-Zubair had already bought Al-Ghaba for one hundred and seventy thousand. `Abdullah sold it for one million and six hundred thousand. Then he called the people saying, "Any person who has any money claim on Az-Zubair should come to us in Al-Ghaba." There came to him `Abdullah bin Ja`far whom Az-Zubair owed four hundred thousand. He said to `Abdullah bin Az-Zubair, "If you wish I will forgive you the debt." `Abdullah (bin Az-Zubair) said, "No." Then Ibn Ja`far said, "If you wish you can defer the payment if you should defer the payment of any debt." Ibn Az-Zubair said, "No." `Abdullah bin Ja`far said, "Give me a piece of the land." `Abdullah bin Az-Zubair said (to him), "Yours is the land extending from this place to this place." So, `Abdullah bin Az-Zubair sold some of the property (including the houses) and paid his debt perfectly, retaining four and a half shares from the land (i.e. Al-Ghaba). He then went to Mu'awiya while `Amr bin `Uthman, Al-Mundhir bin Az-Zubair and Ibn Zam`a were sitting with him. Mu'awiya asked, "At what price have you appraised Al-Ghaba?" He said, "One hundred thousand for each share," Muawiya asked, "How many shares have been left?" `Abdullah replied, "Four and a half shares." Al-Mundhir bin Az-Zubair said, "I would like to buy one share for one hundred thousand." `Amr bin `Uthman said, "I would like to buy one share for one hundred thousand." Ibn Zam`a said, "I would like to buy one share for one hundred thousand." Muawiya said, "How much is left now?" `Abdullah replied, "One share and a half." Muawiya said, "I would like to buy it for one hundred and fifty thousand." `Abdullah also sold his part to Muawiya for six hundred thousand. When Ibn Az-Zubair had paid all the debts. Az-Zubair's sons said to him, "Distribute our inheritance among us." He said, "No, by Allah, I will not distribute it among you till I announce in four successive Hajj seasons, 'Would those who have money claims on Az-Zubair come so that we may pay them their debt." So, he started to announce that in public in every Hajj season, and when four years had elapsed, he distributed the inheritance among the inheritors. Az-Zubair had four wives, and after the one-third of his property was excluded (according to the will), each of his wives received one million and two hundred thousand. So the total amount of his property was fifty million and two hundred thousand
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Az-Zubair Al-Jamal ki jung ke din uthe, unhone mujhe bulaya aur main unke bagal mein khada hua, aur unhone mujhse kaha, "Aye mere bete! Aaj koi ya to zaalim ke tor par ya mazloom ke tor par qatl hoga. Mujhe lagta hai main mazloom ke tor par qatl hounga. Meri sabse badi fikar mera qarz hai. Kya tumhe lagta hai, agar hum qarz chuka den, humare paas apne paise mein se kuch bacha rahega?" Az-Zubair ne joda, "Aye mere bete! Humari maal becho aur mera qarz chukao." Az-Zubair ne phir apni maal ka ek-tihai vasiyat mein diya, aur us ek-tihai mein se ek-tihai apne beton ko, yaani Abdullah ke beton ko diya. Unhone kaha, "Ek-tihai ka ek-tihai. Agar qarz chukane ke baad kuch maal bachi, uska ek-tihai (bache hue ka ek-tihai) tumhare beton ko diya jaaye." (Hisham, doosre raawi ne joda, "Abdullah ke kuch bete umr mein Az-Zubair ke beton ke barabar the, jaise Khubaib aur Abbas. Abdullah ke us waqt nau bete aur nau betiyaan thi.") (Raawi Abdullah ne joda:) Mere waalid (Az-Zubair) mujhe unke qarz ki yaad dilate rahe, kehte huye, "Agar tum qarz ka kuch hissa ada karne mein na-kaam raho, mere Maalik se madad maango." Allah ki qasam! Mujhe samajh nahi aaya unka matlab kya tha jab tak maine pucha, "Aye waalid! Aapka Maalik kaun hai?" Unhone jawab diya, "Allah (mera Maalik hai)." Allah ki qasam, jab bhi mujhe unke qarz ke baare mein koi mushkil hoti, main kehta, "Az-Zubair ke Maalik! Unki taraf se unka qarz chukao." Aur Allah (meri madad karke) use chuka dete. Az-Zubair shaheed hue bina koi Dinar ya Dirham chhode, magar do zameen ke tukde, jinme se ek Al-Ghaba thi, aur gyarah ghar Madina mein, do Basra mein, ek Kufa mein, aur ek Egypt mein. Asal mein, unke qarz ki wajah yeh thi ke agar koi unke paas apna paisa amanat ke tor par rakhna chahta, Az-Zubair kahte, "Nahi, (main ise amanat nahi rakhunga), magar main ise qarz ke tor par lunga, kyunke mujhe dar hai kahin yeh kho na jaaye." Az-Zubair ko kabhi gawarnar ya Kharaj tax jama karne wala muqarrar nahi kiya gaya, magar unhone apni daulat (jung ke maal-e-ghanimat se) jama ki jab woh Nabi, Abu Bakr, Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ), aur Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath muqaddas jungon mein shaamil the. (Abdullah bin Az-Zubair ne joda:) Jab maine unka qarz gina, woh do miliyan do lakh nikla. (Doosre raawi ne joda:) Hakim bin Hizam (رضی اللہ عنہ) Abdullah bin Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) se mile aur pucha, "Aye mere bhatije! Mere bhai ka qarz kitna hai?" Abdullah ne ise raaz rakha aur kaha, "Ek lakh." Hakim ne kaha, "Allah ki qasam! Mujhe nahi lagta tumhari maal ise poora kar payegi." Isspar Abdullah ne unse kaha, "Agar yeh do miliyan do lakh ho to?" Hakim ne kaha, "Mujhe nahi lagta tum ise ada kar paoge; isliye agar tum poora ada nahi kar pate, main tumhari madad karunga." Az-Zubair ne pahle Al-Ghaba ek lakh sattar hazaar mein khareeda tha. Abdullah ne ise ek miliyan chhah lakh mein becha. Phir unhone logon ko bulaya aur kaha, "Jis kisi ka bhi Az-Zubair par koi paisa baaki hai, woh humare paas Al-Ghaba mein aaye." Abdullah bin Ja'far unke paas aaye, jinke Az-Zubair par chaar lakh baaki the. Unhone Abdullah bin Az-Zubair se kaha, "Agar tum chaho, main tumhara qarz maaf kar dunga." Abdullah (bin Az-Zubair) ne kaha, "Nahi." Ibn Ja'far ne phir kaha, "Agar tum chaho, tum bhugtaan ko taal sakte ho." Ibn Az-Zubair ne kaha, "Nahi." Abdullah bin Ja'far ne kaha, "Mujhe zameen ka ek tukda do." Abdullah bin Az-Zubair ne (unse) kaha, "Tumhari zameen yahaan se yahaan tak hai." Isliye Abdullah bin Az-Zubair ne apni kuch maal (gharon samet) bech di aur apna qarz poori tarah chuka diya, saadhe chaar hisse zameen (yaani Al-Ghaba) mein rakhte huye. Phir woh Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas gaye jabke Amr bin Uthman, Al-Mundhir bin Az-Zubair, aur Ibn Zam'a unke saath baithe the. Muawiya ne pucha, "Tumne Al-Ghaba ki kitni qeemat lagaee?" Unhone kaha, "Ek lakh har hisse ke liye." Muawiya ne pucha, "Kitne hisse bache hain?" Abdullah ne jawab diya, "Saadhe chaar hisse." Al-Mundhir bin Az-Zubair ne kaha, "Main ek hissa ek lakh mein khareedna chahta hoon." Amr bin Uthman ne kaha, "Main ek hissa ek lakh mein khareedna chahta hoon." Ibn Zam'a ne kaha, "Main ek hissa ek lakh mein khareedna chahta hoon." Muawiya ne pucha, "Ab kitna bacha hai?" Abdullah ne jawab diya, "Dedh hissa." Muawiya ne kaha, "Main ise ek lakh pachaas hazaar mein khareedna chahta hoon." Abdullah ne apna hissa bhi Muawiya ko chhah lakh mein becha. Jab Ibn Az-Zubair ne sab qarz chuka diya, Az-Zubair ke beton ne unse kaha, "Humari waraasat humare beech taqseem karo." Unhone kaha, "Nahi, Allah ki qasam, main ise tumhare beech tab tak taqseem nahi karunga jab tak main chaar Hajj ke mausamon mein elaan na kar dun, 'Jis kisi ka bhi Az-Zubair par koi paisa baaki hai, woh aaye taake hum unhe unka qarz ada karen.'" Isliye unhone har Hajj ke mausam mein yeh elaan karna shuru kiya, aur jab chaar saal guzar gaye, unhone waraasat waarison mein taqseem kar di. Az-Zubair ki chaar biwiyaan thi, aur ek-tihai maal ko alag rakhne ke baad (vasiyat ke mutabiq), har biwi ko ek miliyan do lakh mile. Isliye unki poori maal pachaas miliyan do lakh thi.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:`Uthman did not join the Badr battle because he was married to one of the daughters of Allah's Apostle and she was ill. So, the Prophet (ﷺ) said to him. "You will get a reward and a share (from the war booty) similar to the reward and the share of one who has taken part in the Badr battle
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) Badr ki jung mein shaamil nahi hue kyunke unki shaadi Allah ke Rasool ki ek beti se hui thi aur woh bimar thi. Isliye Nabi ne unse kaha, "Tumhe ajr aur hissa (maal-e-ghanimat se) milega jaisa Badr ki jung mein shaamil hone wale shaks ko milta."

e: Narrated Marwan bin Al-Hakam and Miswar bin Makhrama:When the Hawazin delegation came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) after they had embraced Islam and requested him to return their properties and war prisoners to them, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "To me the best talk is the truest, so you may choose either of two things; the war prisoners or the wealth, for I have delayed their distribution." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had waited for them for over ten days when he returned from Ta'if. So, when those people came to know that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was not going to return to them except one of the two things the said, "We choose our war Prisoners 'Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up amongst the Muslims, and after glorifying Allah as He deserved, he said, "Now then, these brothers of yours have come to us with repentance, and I see it logical that I should return their captives to them, so whoever of you likes to do that as a favor then he can do it, and whoever amongst you likes to stick to his share, let him give up his prisoners and we will compensate him from the very first Fai' (i.e. war booty received without fight) which Allah will give us." On that, all the people said. 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) We have agreed willingly to do so (return the captives)" Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to them "I do not know who amongst you has agreed to this and who has not. You should return and let your leaders inform me of your agreement." The people returned and their leaders spoke to them, and then came to Allah's Apostle and said, "All the people have agreed willingly to do so and have given the permission to return the war prisoners (without Compensation)" (Az-Zuhri, the sub-narrator states) This is what has been related to us about the captives of Hawazin
hi: Marwan bin Al-Hakam aur Miswar bin Makhrama (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Hawazin qabile ka wafd Islam qubool karne ke baad Allah ke Rasool ke paas aaya aur unse apni maal aur qaidiyon ko wapas karne ki guzarish ki, Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Mujhe sabse achhi baat sabse sachi baat lagti hai, isliye tumhe do cheezon mein se ek chunne ka ikhtiyaar hai; qaidi ya daulat, kyunke maine unki taqseem taal di hai." Allah ke Rasool ne Taif se wapas aane ke baad das din se zyada unka intezaar kiya tha. Jab un logon ko pata chala ke Allah ke Rasool do cheezon mein se sirf ek hi wapas karenge, unhone kaha, "Hum apne qaidiyon ko chunte hain." Allah ke Rasool Musalmanon ke beech khade hue, aur Allah ki jaisi hamd honi chahiye vaisi ki, unhone kaha, "Iske baad, tumhare yeh bhai tauba karke humare paas aaye hain, aur mujhe theek lagta hai ke main unke qaidiyon ko unhe wapas karun, isliye jo bhi tum mein se aisa karna chahe ek ehsaan ke tor par, kar sakta hai, aur jo bhi apna hissa rakhna chahe, use apne qaidi chhodne honge aur hum use pahle Fai (yaani bina jung ke mile maal-e-ghanimat) se mua'wza denge jo Allah humein dega." Isspar sab logon ne kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Hum khushi se aisa (qaidiyon ko wapas) karne ke liye raazi hain." Phir Allah ke Rasool ne unse kaha, "Mujhe nahi pata tum mein se kisne raazi hokar diya aur kisne nahi. Isliye tum wapas jaao aur apne sardaron ko mujhe apni raazandi batane do." Log wapas gaye aur unke sardaron ne unse baat ki, phir Allah ke Rasool ke paas aaye aur kaha, "Sab logon ne khushi se raazi hokar (qaidiyon ko wapas karne ki) ijazat de di hai." (Az-Zuhri, doosre raawi ne kaha) Yeh humein Hawazin ke qaidiyon ke baare mein bataya gaya hai.

e: Narrated Zahdam:Once we were in the house of Abu Musa who presented a meal containing cooked chicken. A man from the tribe of Bani Taim Allah with red complexion as if he were from the Byzantine war prisoners, was present. Abu Musa invited him to share the meal but he (apologised) saying. "I saw chickens eating dirty things and so I have had a strong aversion to eating them, and have taken an oath that I will not eat chickens." Abu Musa said, "Come along, I will tell you about this matter (i.e. how to cancel one's oath). I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) in the company of a group of Al-Ashariyin, asked him to provide us with means of conveyance. He said, 'By Allah, I will not provide you with any means of conveyance and I have nothing to make you ride on.' Then some camels as booty were brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he asked for us saying. 'Where are the group of Al-Ash`ariyun?' Then he ordered that we should be given five camels with white humps. When we set out we said, 'What have we done? We will never be blessed (with what we have been given).' So, we returned to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, 'We asked you to provide us with means of conveyance, but you took an oath that you would not provide us with any means of conveyance. Did you forget (your oath when you gave us the camels)? He replied. 'I have not provided you with means of conveyance, but Allah has provided you with it, and by Allah, Allah willing, if ever I take an oath to do something, and later on I find that it is more beneficial to do something different, I will do the thing which is better, and give expiation for my oath
hi: Zahdam bataate hain: Ek baar hum Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke ghar mein the jinhone khaane mein pakka huaa murga pesh kiya. Bani Taim Allah qabile ka ek shaks, laal rang wala, mano Byzantine ke qaidiyon mein se ho, wahaan maujood tha. Abu Musa ne use khaane mein shaamil hone ki dawat di magar usne (maafi maangte huye) kaha, "Maine murgon ko gandagi khate dekha hai, isliye mujhe murga khaane se sakht nafrat ho gaee hai, aur maine qasam khaee hai ke main murga nahi khaunga." Abu Musa ne kaha, "Aao, main tumhe is baare mein (yaani apni qasam radd karne ke baare mein) batataa hoon. Main Al-Ashariyin ke ek giroh ke saath Nabi ke paas gaya aur unse humein sawari ka saadhan dene ki guzarish ki. Unhone kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, main tumhe koi sawari ka saadhan nahi dunga aur mere paas tumhe sawar karane ke liye kuch nahi.' Phir Allah ke Rasool ke paas maal-e-ghanimat mein kuch unt laaye gaye, aur unhone humare baare mein pucha, kehte huye, 'Al-Ashariyin ka giroh kahaan hai?' Phir unhone hukum diya ke humein safed kohanon wale paanch unt diye jaaen. Jab hum nikle, humne kaha, 'Humne yeh kya kiya? (Humein dar hai) ke humein iski barkat nahi milegi.' Isliye hum Nabi ke paas wapas gaye aur kaha, 'Humne aapse sawari ka saadhan maanga tha, magar aapne qasam khaee thi ke aap humein koi saadhan nahi denge. Kya aap bhool gaye (apni qasam)?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Maine tumhe koi sawari ka saadhan nahi diya, balki Allah ne tumhe diya, aur Allah ki qasam, Insha Allah, agar main kabhi kuch karne ki qasam khata hoon aur baad mein pata hoon ke kuch aur karna behtar hai, main woh cheez karunga jo behtar hai, aur apni qasam ka kaffara dunga.'"

e: Narrated Nafi` from Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent a Sariya towards Najd, and `Abdullah bin `Umar was in the Sariya. They gained a great number of camels as war booty. The share of each one of them was twelve or eleven camels, and they were given an extra camel each
hi: Nafi bataate hain, Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se: Allah ke Rasool ne Najd ki taraf ek Sariya (fauji dasta) bheja, aur Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) us Sariya mein the. Unhe maal-e-ghanimat mein bahut se unt mile. Har ek ka hissa baarah ya gyarah unt tha, aur unhe har ek ko ek izafi unt bhi diya gaya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to give extra share to some of the members of the Sariya he used to send, in addition to the shares they shared with the army in general
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool jis Sariya (fauji daste) ko bhejte, uske kuch sadasyon ko izafi hissa dete, un hisson ke ilawa jo poori fauj ke saath saanjhe hote.

e: Narrated Abu Musa:We got the news of the migration of the Prophet (ﷺ) while we were in Yemen, so we set out migrating to him. We were, I and my two brothers, I being the youngest, and one of my brothers was Abu Burda and the other was Abu Ruhm. We were over fifty (or fifty-three or fifty two) men from our people. We got on board a ship which took us to An-Najashi in Ethiopia, and there we found Ja`far bin Abu Talib and his companions with An-Najashi. Ja`far said (to us), "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has sent us here and ordered us to stay here, so you too, stay with us." We stayed with him till we all left (Ethiopia) and met the Prophet (ﷺ) at the time when he had conquered Khaibar. He gave us a share from its booty (or gave us from its booty).
