He gave only to those who had taken part in the Ghazwa with him. but he did not give any share to any person who had not participated in Khaibar's conquest except the people of our ship, besides Ja`far and his companions, whom he gave a share as he did them (i.e. the people of the ship)
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Humein Nabi ki hijrat ki khabar mili jabke hum Yemen mein the, isliye hum unke paas hijrat karne nikle. Hum, main aur mere do bhai, main sabse chhota tha, aur mere ek bhai Abu Burda the aur doosre Abu Ruhm. Hum apne logon mein se pachaas (ya pachaas se teen ya do zyada) log the. Hum ek kashti par sawar hue jo humein An-Najashi ke paas Ethiopia le gaee, aur wahaan humne Ja'far bin Abu Talib aur unke sathiyon ko An-Najashi ke saath paaya. Ja'far ne (humse) kaha, "Allah ke Rasool ne humein yahaan bheja hai aur hukum diya hai ke hum yahaan rukein, isliye tum bhi humare saath ruko." Hum unke saath ruke jab tak hum sab (Ethiopia se) chale, aur Nabi se mile jab unhone Khaibar fatah kar liya tha. Unhone humein iske maal-e-ghanimat se hissa diya. Unhone sirf unhe hissa diya jinhone unke saath Ghazwa mein hissa liya tha, magar unhone Khaibar ki fatah mein shaamil na hone wale kisi ko hissa nahi diya, siwaye humari kashti ke logon ke, Ja'far aur unke sathiyon ke ilawa, jinhe unhone hissa diya jaisa unhone (kashti ke logon ko) diya.

e: Narrated Jabir:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said (to me), "If the property of Bahrain had come to us, I would have given you so much and so much." But the Bahrain property did not come till the Prophet (ﷺ) had died. When the Bahrain property came. Abu Bakr ordered somebody to announce, "Any person who has money claim on Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) or whom Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had promised something, should come to us." So, I went to him and said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had promised to give me so much an so much." Abu Bakr scooped up money with both hands thrice for me." (The sub-narrator Sufyan illustrated this action by scooping up with both hands and said, "Ibn Munkadir, another sub-narrator, used to illustrate it in this way.") Narrated Jabir: Once I went to Abu Bakr and asked for the money but he did not give me, and I went to him again, but he did not give me, so I went to him for the third time and said, "I asked you, but you did not give me; then I asked you (for the second time) and you did not give me; then I asked you (for the third time) but you did not give me. You should either give me or allow yourself to be considered a miser regarding my case." Abu Bakr said, "You tell me that I am a miser with regard to you. But really, whenever I rejected your request, I had the inclination to give you." (In another narration Jabir added:) So, Abu Bakr scooped up money with both hands for me and asked me to count it. I found out that It was five hundred. Abu Bakr told me to take twice that amount
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne (mujhse) kaha, "Agar Bahrain ki maal humare paas aa jaaye, main tumhe itna aur itna dunga." Magar Bahrain ki maal tab tak nahi aee jab tak Nabi ka intiqal nahi ho gaya. Jab Bahrain ki maal aee, Abu Bakr ne kisi ko elaan karne ka hukum diya, "Jis kisi ka bhi Allah ke Rasool par koi haqq hai ya jise Allah ke Rasool ne kuch waada kiya tha, woh humare paas aaye." Isliye main unke paas gaya aur kaha, "Allah ke Rasool ne mujhse itna aur itna dene ka waada kiya tha." Abu Bakr ne teen baar apne donon haathon se mere liye paisa nikala." (Doosre raawi Sufyan ne yeh amal apne donon haathon se dikhate huye samjhaya, aur kaha, "Ibn Munkadir, doosre raawi, isi tarah dikhate the.") Jabir bataate hain: Ek baar main Abu Bakr ke paas gaya aur paisa maanga magar unhone nahi diya, aur main phir gaya, magar unhone nahi diya, isliye main teesri baar gaya aur kaha, "Maine aapse maanga, magar aapne nahi diya; phir maine (doosri baar) maanga aur aapne nahi diya; phir maine (teesri baar) maanga magar aapne nahi diya. Aapko ya to mujhe dena chahiye ya khud ko kanjoos maan lena chahiye mere maamle mein." Abu Bakr ne kaha, "Tum mujhse kehte ho ke main tumhare saath kanjoos hoon. Magar asal mein, jab bhi maine tumhari guzarish radd ki, mera dil tumhe dene ka tha." (Ek doosri riwaayat mein, Jabir ne joda:) Isliye Abu Bakr ne mere liye apne donon haathon se paisa nikala aur mujhse use ginne ko kaha. Maine paaya ke woh paanch sau tha. Abu Bakr ne mujhse kaha ke main isse doguna le lun.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:While Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was distributing the booty at Al-Ji'rana, somebody said to him "Be just (in your distribution)." The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Verily I would be miserable if I did not act justly
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jabke Allah ke Rasool Al-Ji'rana mein maal-e-ghanimat taqseem kar rahe the, kisi ne unse kaha "Insaaf se taqseem keejiye." Nabi ne jawab diya, "Beshak main dukhi hounga agar main insaaf se amal na karun."

e: Narrated Jubair bin Mut`im:The Prophet (ﷺ) talked about war prisoners of Badr saying, "Had Al-Mut`im bin Adi been alive and interceded with me for these mean people, I would have freed them for his sake
hi: Jubair bin Mut'im bataate hain: Nabi ne Badr ke qaidiyon ke baare mein kaha, "Agar Al-Mut'im bin Adi zinda hote aur mujhse in be-sahaara logon ke liye sifarish karte, main unke liye unhe azaad kar deta."

e: Narrated Jubair bin Mut`im:I and `Uthman bin `Affan went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! You have given to Bani Al-Muttalib and left us although they and we are of the same kinship to you." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Bani Muttalib and Bani Hashim are one and the same." The Prophet (ﷺ) did not give a share to Bani `Abd Shams and Bani Naufal. (Ibn 'Is-haq said, "Abd Shams and Hashim and Al-Muttalib were maternal brothers and their mother was 'Atika bint Murra and Naufal was their paternal brother)
hi: Jubair bin Mut'im bataate hain: Main aur Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Affan Allah ke Rasool ke paas gaye aur kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Aapne Bani Al-Muttalib ko diya aur humein chhod diya chahe woh aur hum aapse ek jaise rishte ke hain." Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Bani Muttalib aur Bani Hashim ek hi hain." Nabi ne Bani Abd Shams aur Bani Naufal ko koi hissa nahi diya. (Ibn Ishaq ne kaha, "Abd Shams, Hashim, aur Al-Muttalib maami bhai the aur unki maa Atika bint Murra thi, aur Naufal unka waalidi bhai tha.")

e: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf:While I was standing in the row on the day (of the battle) of Badr, I looked to my right and my left and saw two young Ansari boys, and I wished I had been stronger than they. One of them called my attention saying, "O Uncle! Do you know Abu Jahl?" I said, "Yes, What do you want from him, O my nephew?" He said, "I have been informed that he abuses Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). By Him in Whose Hands my life is, if I should see him, then my body will not leave his body till either of us meet his fate." I was astonished at that talk. Then the other boy called my attention saying the same as the other had said. After a while I saw Abu Jahl walking amongst the people. I said (to the boys), "Look! This is the man you asked me about." So, both of them attacked him with their swords and struck him to death and returned to Allah'S Apostle to inform him of that. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked, "Which of you has killed him?" Each of them said, "I Have killed him." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked, "Have you cleaned your swords?" They said, "No. " He then looked at their swords and said, "No doubt, you both have killed him and the spoils of the deceased will be given to Mu`adh bin `Amr bin Al-Jamuh." The two boys were Mu`adh bin 'Afra and Mu`adh bin `Amr bin Al-Jamuh
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Auf bataate hain: Jabke main Badr ki jung ke din safon mein khada tha, maine apni dahini aur baaee taraf dekha aur do jawan Ansaari ladke dekhe, aur mujhe khwahish hui ke kaash main unse zyada mazboot hota. Unme se ek ne mera dhyaan aakarshit kiya, "Aye chacha! Kya aap Abu Jahl ko jaante hain?" Maine kaha, "Haan. Tumhe unse kya kaam hai, mere bhatije?" Usne kaha, "Mujhe bataya gaya hai ke woh Allah ke Rasool ko gaali deta hai. Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haathon mein meri jaan hai, agar main use dekhta hoon, mera jism uske jism se tab tak nahi hatega jab tak humme se koi apni maut na paaye." Main is baat par hairan hua. Phir doosre ladke ne bhi mera dhyaan aakarshit kiya aur wahi kaha jo pahle ne kaha tha. Thodi der baad maine Abu Jahl ko logon ke beech chalte dekha. Maine (ladkon se) kaha, "Dekho! Yeh hai woh shaks jiske baare mein tumne mujhse pucha." Isliye donon ne apni talwaron se uspar hamla kiya aur use maar dala aur Allah ke Rasool ke paas wapas gaye unhe iski khabar dene. Allah ke Rasool ne pucha, "Tum mein se kisne use qatl kiya?" Har ek ne kaha, "Maine use qatl kiya." Allah ke Rasool ne pucha, "Kya tumne apni talwaren saaf ki hain?" Unhone kaha, "Nahi." Phir unhone unki talwaron ki taraf dekha aur kaha, "Koi shak nahi, tum donon ne use qatl kiya hai, aur murda ka saaman Mu'adh bin Amr bin Al-Jamuh ko diya jaayega." Woh do ladke Mu'adh bin Afra aur Mu'adh bin Amr bin Al-Jamuh the.

e: Narrated Abu Qatada:We set out in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the day (of the battle) of Hunain. When we faced the enemy, the Muslims retreated and I saw a pagan throwing himself over a Muslim. I turned around and came upon him from behind and hit him on the shoulder with the sword He (i.e. the pagan) came towards me and seized me so violently that I felt as if it were death itself, but death overtook him and he released me. I followed `Umar bin Al Khattab and asked (him), "What is wrong with the people (fleeing)?" He replied, "This is the Will of Allah," After the people returned, the Prophet (ﷺ) sat and said, "Anyone who has killed an enemy and has a proof of that, will possess his spoils." I got up and said, "Who will be a witness for me?" and then sat down. The Prophet (ﷺ) again said, "Anyone who has killed an enemy and has proof of that, will possess his spoils." I (again) got up and said, "Who will be a witness for me?" and sat down. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said the same for the third time. I again got up, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O Abu Qatada! What is your story?" Then I narrated the whole story to him. A man (got up and) said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! He is speaking the truth, and the spoils of the killed man are with me. So please compensate him on my behalf." On that Abu Bakr As-Siddiq said, "No, by Allah, he (i.e. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ) will not agree to give you the spoils gained by one of Allah's Lions who fights on the behalf of Allah and His Apostle." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Abu Bakr has spoken the truth." So, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave the spoils to me. I sold that armor (i.e. the spoils) and with its price I bought a garden at Bani Salima, and this was my first property which I gained after my conversion to Islam
hi: Abu Qatada (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Allah ke Rasool ke saath Hunain ki jung ke din nikle. Jab humari dushman se mulaqaat hui, Musalman peeche hate aur maine ek mushrik ko ek Musalman par khud ko daalte dekha. Main muda aur uske peeche se aaya aur uske kandhe par talwar se maara. Woh (yaani mushrik) mere paas aaya aur mujhe itni sakhti se pakada ke mujhe laga yeh maut hi hai, magar maut ne pahle use apni chapet mein le liya aur usne mujhe chhod diya. Main Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab ke peeche gaya aur pucha, "Logon (yaani bhaagte hue) ko kya hua?" Unhone jawab diya, "Yeh Allah ki marzi hai." Jab log wapas aaye, Nabi baithe aur kaha, "Jisne bhi kisi dushman ko qatl kiya hai aur uska saboot hai, uska saaman use milega." Main uth aur kaha, "Mere liye gawaah kaun hoga?" aur baith gaya. Nabi ne phir kaha, "Jisne bhi kisi dushman ko qatl kiya hai aur uska saboot hai, uska saaman use milega." Main (phir) uth aur kaha, "Mere liye gawaah kaun hoga?" aur baith gaya. Phir Nabi ne yehi teesri baar kaha. Main phir utha, aur Allah ke Rasool ne pucha, "Aye Abu Qatada! Tumhari kahani kya hai?" Phir maine unhe poori kahani sunaee. Ek shaks ne (uthkar) kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Woh sach kah rahe hain, aur murda shaks ka saaman mere paas hai, isliye kripya mujhe uski taraf se mua'wza dijiye." Isspar Abu Bakr As-Siddiq ne kaha, "Nahi, Allah ki qasam, woh (yaani Allah ke Rasool) tumhe woh saaman dene ke liye raazi nahi honge jo Allah ke Sheron mein se ek ne jeeta hai, jo Allah aur uske Rasool ki taraf se jung karta hai." Nabi ne kaha, "Abu Bakr ne sach kaha." Isliye Allah ke Rasool ne saaman mujhe diya. Maine woh zire (yaani saaman) becha aur uski qeemat se Bani Salima mein ek baag khareeda, aur yeh Islam qubool karne ke baad meri pahli maal thi.

e: Narrated `Urwa bin Az-Zubair:Hakim bin Hizam said, "I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for something, and he gave me. I asked him again, and he gave me, and said to me. 'O Hakim! This wealth is like green sweet (i.e. fruit), and if one takes it without greed, then one is blessed in it, and if one takes it with greediness, then one is not blessed in it, and will be like the one who eats without satisfaction. And an upper (i.e. giving) hand is better than a lower (i.e. taking) hand,' I said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! By Him Who has sent you with the Truth. I will not ask anyone for anything after you till I leave this world." So, when Abu Bakr during his Caliphate, called Hakim to give him (some money), Hakim refused to accept anything from him. Once `Umar called him (during his Caliphate) in order to give him something, but Hakim refused to accept it, whereupon `Umar said, "O Muslims! I give him (i.e. Hakim) his right which Allah has assigned to him) from this Fai '(booty), but he refuses to take it." So Hakim never took anything from anybody after the Prophet (ﷺ) till he died
hi: Urwa bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hakim bin Hizam (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Maine Allah ke Rasool se kuch maanga, aur unhone mujhe diya. Maine phir maanga, aur unhone phir diya, aur mujhse kaha, 'Aye Hakim! Yeh daulat meethe hari phal jaisi hai, aur agar koi ise bina lalach ke leta hai, use isme barkat milti hai, aur agar koi ise lalach se leta hai, use isme barkat nahi milti, aur woh us shaks jaisa hoga jo khata hai magar kabhi santusht nahi hota. Aur ek oopar wala (yaani dena wala) haath ek neeche wale (yaani lene wale) haath se behtar hai.' Maine kaha, 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Us Zaat ki qasam jisne aapko haqq ke saath bheja hai, main aapke baad kisi se kuch nahi maangunga jab tak main is duniya se chala na jaoon.'" Isliye jab Abu Bakr, apni khilafat ke dauran, Hakim ko bulwate (kuch dene ke liye), Hakim unse kuch lene se inkaar kar dete. Ek baar Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne (apni khilafat ke dauran) unhe bulwaya kuch dene ke liye, magar Hakim ne lene se inkaar kiya, isspar Umar ne kaha, "Aye Musalmano! Main use (yaani Hakim ko) uska haqq deta hoon jo Allah ne is Fai (maal-e-ghanimat) mein se unke liye muqarrar kiya hai, magar woh lene se inkaar karte hain." Isliye Hakim ne Nabi ke baad kisi se kuch nahi liya jab tak unka intiqal nahi ho gaya.

e: Narrated Nafi`:`Umar bin Al-Khattab said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I vowed to observe I`tikaf for one day during the pre-Islamic period." The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered him to fulfill his vow. `Umar gained two lady captives from the war prisoners of Hunain and he left them in some of the houses at Mecca. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) freed the captives of Hunain without ransom, they came out walking in the streets. `Umar said (to his son), "O `Abdullah! See what is the matter." `Abdullah replied, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has freed the captives without ransom." He said (to him), "Go and set free those two slave girls." (Nafi` added:) Allah's Apostle did not perform the `Umra from Al-Ji'rana, and if he had performed the `Umra, it would not have been hidden from `Abdullah
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab ne kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Maine jahiliyat ke zamane mein ek din I'tikaf karne ki mannat maangi thi." Nabi ne unhe apni mannat poori karne ka hukum diya. Umar ko Hunain ke jung ke qaidiyon mein se do launDiyaan maal-e-ghanimat mein mili aur unhone unhe Mecca ke kuch gharon mein rakha. Jab Allah ke Rasool ne Hunain ke qaidiyon ko bina fidya liye azaad kiya, woh galiyon mein chalte hue bahar aaye. Umar ne (apne bete se) kaha, "Aye Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ)! Dekho kya maamla hai." Abdullah ne jawab diya, "Allah ke Rasool ne qaidiyon ko bina fidya azaad kiya hai." Unhone (unse) kaha, "Jaao aur un do launDiyon ko bhi azaad kar do." (Nafi ne joda:) Allah ke Rasool ne Al-Ji'rana se Umrah nahi kiya, aur agar unhone Umrah kiya hota, yeh Abdullah se chhupa na reha hota.

e: Narrated `Amr bin Taghlib:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave (gifts) to some people to the exclusion of some others. The latter seemed to be displeased by that. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I give to some people, lest they should deviate from True Faith or lose patience, while I refer other people to the goodness and contentment which Allah has put in their hearts, and `Amr bin Taghlib is amongst them." `Amr bin Taghlib said, "The statement of Allah's Apostle is dearer to me than red camels." Narrated Al-Hasan: `Amr bin Taghlib told us that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got some property or some war prisoners and he distributed them in the above way (i.e. giving to some people to the exclusion of others)
hi: Amr bin Taghlib (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kuch logon ko tohfe diye aur kuch doosron ko nahi diye. Doosre naraaj lage. Nabi ne kaha, "Main kuch logon ko deta hoon taake woh sacche iman se na bhatke ya sabr na kho den, jabke main kuch doosre logon ko us achhaee aur santushti ke bharose chhodta hoon jo Allah ne unke dilon mein rakhi hai, aur Amr bin Taghlib un mein se hain." Amr bin Taghlib ne kaha, "Allah ke Rasool ki yeh baat mujhe laal unton se zyada aziz hai." Al-Hasan bataate hain: Amr bin Taghlib ne humein bataya ke Allah ke Rasool ko kuch maal ya qaidi mile aur unhone unhe upar diye tarike se taqseem kiya.

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I give to Quraish people in order to let them adhere to Islam, for they are near to their life of Ignorance (i.e. they have newly embraced Islam and it is still not strong in their hearts)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Main Quraish ke logon ko deta hoon taake woh Islam se jude rahen, kyunke woh abhi apni jahiliyat ki zindagi ke qareeb hain (yaani unhone haal hi mein Islam qubool kiya hai aur yeh unke dilon mein abhi mazboot nahi hua)."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:When Allah favored His Apostle with the properties of Hawazin tribe as Fai (booty), he started giving to some Quraishi men even up to one-hundred camels each, whereupon some Ansari men said about Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), "May Allah forgive His Apostle! He is giving to (men of) Quraish and leaves us, in spite of the fact that our swords are still dropping blood (of the infidels)" When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was informed of what they had said, he called the Ansar and gathered them in a leather tent and did not call anybody else along, with them. When they gathered, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to them and said, "What is the statement which, I have been informed, and that which you have said?" The learned ones among them replied," O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! The wise ones amongst us did not say anything, but the youngsters amongst us said, 'May Allah forgive His Apostle; he gives the Quraish and leaves the Ansar, in spite of the fact that our swords are still dribbling (wet) with the blood of the infidels.' " Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, I give to such people as are still close to the period of Infidelity (i.e. they have recently embraced Islam and Faith is still weak in their hearts). Won't you be pleased to see people go with fortune, while you return with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to your houses? By Allah, what you will return with, is better than what they are returning with." The Ansar replied, "Yes, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), we are satisfied' Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said to them." You will find after me, others being preferred to you. Then be patient till you meet Allah and meet His Apostle at Al-Kauthar (i.e. a fount in Paradise)." (Anas added:) But we did not remain patient
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Allah ne apne Rasool ko Hawazin qabile ki maal Fai (maal-e-ghanimat) ke tor par nawaza, unhone kuch Quraishi logon ko sau unt tak dene shuru kiye, isspar kuch Ansaari logon ne Allah ke Rasool ke baare mein kaha, "Allah apne Rasool ko maaf kare! Woh Quraish ko de rahe hain aur humein chhod rahe hain, jabke humari talwaren abhi bhi (kaafiron ke) khoon se tapak rahi hain." Jab Allah ke Rasool ko yeh khabar mili jo unhone kaha, unhone Ansaar ko bulaya aur unhe ek chamde ke tambu mein jama kiya, aur unke saath kisi doosre ko nahi bulaya. Jab woh jama ho gaye, Allah ke Rasool unke paas aaye aur kaha, "Yeh kya baat hai jo mujhe bataee gaee hai, aur jo tumne kaha?" Unme se aqlmand logon ne jawab diya, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Humare aqlmand logon ne kuch nahi kaha, magar humare naujawaanon ne kaha, 'Allah apne Rasool ko maaf kare; woh Quraish ko dete hain aur Ansaar ko chhodte hain, jabke humari talwaren abhi bhi (kaafiron ke) khoon se tapak rahi hain.'" Allah ke Rasool ne jawab diya, "Main un logon ko deta hoon jo abhi kufr ke daur ke qareeb hain (yaani unhone haal hi mein Islam qubool kiya hai aur unka iman abhi kamzor hai). Kya tumhe khushi nahi hogi ke dekho log daulat lekar ja rahe hain, jabke tum Allah ke Rasool ke saath apne ghar wapas ja rahe ho? Allah ki qasam, jo tum lekar wapas ja rahe ho woh usse behtar hai jo woh lekar ja rahe hain." Ansaar ne jawab diya, "Haan, Ya Allah ke Rasool, hum santusht hain." Phir Nabi ne unse kaha, "Tum mere baad paoge ke doosron ko tumse zyada tarjih di jaayegi. Isliye sabr karo jab tak tum Allah se mile aur Al-Kauthar (yaani Jannat ka ek talab) par uske Rasool se mile." (Anas ne joda:) Magar hum sabr nahi kar sake.

e: Narrated Jubair bin Mut`im:That while he was with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who was accompanied by the people on their way back from Hunain, the bedouins started begging things of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) so much so that they forced him to go under a Samura tree where his loose outer garment was snatched away. On that, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up and said to them, "Return my garment to me. If I had as many camels as these trees, I would have distributed them amongst you; and you will not find me a miser or a liar or a coward
hi: Jubair bin Mut'im bataate hain: Jabke woh Allah ke Rasool ke saath the jo Hunain se wapas jate huye logon ke saath the, dehatiyon ne Allah ke Rasool se itni cheezon ki bheek maangni shuru ki ke unhone unhe ek Samurah darakht ke neeche jane par majboor kar diya jahaan unka bahar ka libaas chheena liya gaya. Isspar Allah ke Rasool khade hue aur unse kaha, "Mera kapda mujhe wapas do. Agar mere paas itne unt hote jitne yeh darakht hain, main unhe tum mein taqseem kar deta; aur tum mujhe kanjoos, jhootha, ya kayar nahi paoge."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:While I was walking with the Prophet (ﷺ) who was wearing a Najrani outer garment with a thick hem, a bedouin came upon the Prophet (ﷺ) and pulled his garment so violently that I could recognize the impress of the hem of the garment on his shoulder, caused by the violence of his pull. Then the bedouin said, "Order for me something from Allah's Fortune which you have." The Prophet (ﷺ) turned to him and smiled, and ordered that a gift be given to him
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jabke main Nabi ke saath chal raha tha, jinhone ek Najrani bahar ka libaas pahna hua tha jiska kinaara mota tha, ek dehati Nabi ke paas aaya aur unka libaas itni sakhti se khincha ke main unke kandhe par kinaare ka nishaan dekh sakta tha, jo uske jor se khinchne ki wajah se bana tha. Phir dehati ne kaha, "Allah ki daulat mein se jo aapke paas hai, mere liye kuch dene ka hukum dijiye." Nabi unki taraf mude aur muskurate huye unhe kuch dene ka hukum diya.

e: Narrated `Abdullah:On the day (of the battle) of Hunain, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) favored some people in the distribution of the booty (to the exclusion of others); he gave Al-Aqra' bin H`Abis one-hundred camels and he gave 'Uyaina the same amount, and also gave to some of the eminent Arabs, giving them preference in this regard. Then a person came and said, "By Allah, in this distribution justice has not been observed, nor has Allah's Pleasure been aimed at." I said (to him), "By Allah, I will inform the Prophet (of what you have said), "I went and informed him, and he said, "If Allah and His Apostle did not act justly, who else would act justly. May Allah be merciful to Moses, for he was harmed with more than this, yet he kept patient
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hunain ki jung ke din, Allah ke Rasool ne maal-e-ghanimat ki taqseem mein kuch logon ko tarjih di; unhone Al-Aqra bin Habis ko sau unt diye aur Uyaina ko bhi utne hi diye, aur kuch pramukh Arab logon ko bhi tarjih dekar diya. Phir ek shaks aaya aur kaha, "Allah ki qasam, is taqseem mein insaaf nahi kiya gaya, na hi Allah ki khushi ka lakshya rakha gaya." Maine (usse) kaha, "Allah ki qasam, main Nabi ko bataunga (jo tumne kaha)." Main gaya aur unhe bataya, aur unhone kaha, "Agar Allah aur uske Rasool ne insaaf se kaam nahi kiya, to aur kaun karega? Allah Musa par reham kare, unhe isse zyada dukh diya gaya, phir bhi woh sabr se rahe."

e: Narrated Asma bint Abu Bakr:I used to carry the date stones on my head from the land of Az-Zubair which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had given to him, and it was at a distance of 2/3 of a Farsakh from my house. Narrated Hisham's father: The Prophet (ﷺ) gave Az-Zubair a piece of land from the property of Bani An- Nadir (gained as war booty)
hi: Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Abu Bakr (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Main khajoor ke daanon ko apne sar par lekar le jati thi Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki us zameen se jo Allah ke Rasool ne unhe di thi, aur woh meri ghar se do-tihai Farsakh doori par thi. Hisham ke waalid bataate hain: Nabi ne Az-Zubair ko Bani An-Nadir ki maal (maal-e-ghanimat mein hasil ki hui) mein se zameen ka ek tukda diya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:`Umar bin Al-Khattab expelled all the Jews and Christians from the land of Hijaz. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) after conquering Khaibar, thought of expelling the Jews from the land which, after he conquered it belonged to Allah, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and the Muslims. But the Jews requested Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to leave them there on the condition that they would do the labor and get half of the fruits (the land would yield). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "We shall keep you on these terms as long as we wish." Thus they stayed till the time of `Umar's Caliphate when he expelled them to Taima and Ariha
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Umar bin Al-Khattab ne sab Yahudi aur Isaee logon ko Hijaz ki sarzameen se nikal diya. Allah ke Rasool ne, Khaibar fatah karne ke baad, Yahudiyon ko us zameen se nikalne ka iraada kiya jo, unke fatah karne ke baad, Allah, Allah ke Rasool, aur Musalmanon ki ho gaee thi. Magar Yahudiyon ne Allah ke Rasool se guzarish ki ke woh unhe wahaan is shart par rehne den ke woh mehnat karenge aur phalon ka aadha hissa lenge. Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Hum tumhe in sharton par tab tak rehne denge jab tak hum chahen." Isliye woh wahaan rahe jab tak Umar ki khilafat ke dauran unhe Taima aur Ariha ki taraf jaane par majboor nahi kiya gaya.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Mughaffal:While we were besieging the fort of Khaibar, a person threw a leather container containing fat, and I ran to take it, but when I turned I saw the Prophet (standing behind), so I felt embarrassed in front of him
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Mughaffal bataate hain: Jabke hum Khaibar ke qile ka gherav kar rahe the, kisi ne charbi se bhara ek chamde ka thaila fenka, aur main use lene ke liye dauda, magar jab main muda to dekha Nabi (peeche khade the), isliye mujhe unke saamne sharam mahsoos hui.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:In our holy battles, we used to get honey and grapes, as war booty which we would eat and would not store
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Humare muqaddas jungon mein, humein maal-e-ghanimat mein shahad aur angoor milte the jinhe hum khate the aur jama karke nahi rakhte the.

e: Narrated Ibn Abi `Aufa:We were afflicted with hunger during the besiege of Khaibar, and when it was the day of (the battle of) Khaibar, we slaughtered the donkeys and when the pots got boiling (with their meat). Allah's Apostle made an announcement that all the pots should be upset and that nobody should eat anything of the meat of the donkeys. We thought that the Prophet (ﷺ) prohibited that because the Khumus had not been taken out of the booty (i.e. donkeys); other people said, "He prohibited eating them for ever." The sub-narrator added, "I asked Sa`id bin Jubair who said, 'He has made the eating of donkeys' meat illegal for ever
hi: Ibn Abi Aufa bataate hain: Khaibar ke gherav ke dauran humein bhookh ne pareshaan kiya, aur jab Khaibar ki jung ka din aaya, humne gadhon ko zabah kiya, aur jab handiyaan ubalne lagi (unke gosht se), Allah ke Rasool ne elaan kiya ke sab handiyaan ulat di jaaen aur koi bhi gadhe ka gosht na khaaye. Humne socha ke Nabi ne isliye mana kiya kyunke maal-e-ghanimat (yaani gadhon) se Khumus nahi liya gaya tha; doosre logon ne kaha, "Unhone hamesha ke liye unhe khaane se mana kiya." Raawi ne joda, "Maine Sa'id bin Jubair se pucha jinhone kaha, 'Unhone gadhon ka gosht khaane ko hamesha ke liye haram kar diya.'"

e: Narrated `Amr bin Dinar:I was sitting with Jabir bin Zaid and `Amr bin Aus, and Bajala was narrating to them in 70 A.H. the year when Mus`ab bin Az-Zubair was the leader of the pilgrims of Basra. We were sitting at the steps of Zamzam well and Bajala said, "I was the clerk of Juz bin Muawiya, Al-Ahnaf's paternal uncle. A letter came from `Umar bin Al-Khattab one year before his death; and it was read:-- "Cancel every marriage contracted among the Magians between relatives of close kinship (marriages that are regarded illegal in Islam: a relative of this sort being called Dhu-Mahram.)" `Umar did not take the Jizya from the Magian infidels till `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf testified that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had taken the Jizya from the Magians of Hajar
hi: Amr bin Dinar bataate hain: Main Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Zaid aur Amr bin Aus ke saath baitha tha, aur Bajala unhe 70 A.H. mein bata rahe the, us saal jab Mus'ab bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) Basra ke Hajiyon ke sardaar the. Hum Zamzam kue ki seedhiyon par baithe the aur Bajala ne kaha, "Main Juz bin Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ), Al-Ahnaf ke chacha, ka lipik tha. Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab se ek khat aaya unki maut se ek saal pahle, aur woh padha gaya: 'Magianon (Zoroastrianon) mein kareebi rishton (jinhe Islam mein na-jaiz maana jata hai, aise rishton ko Dhu-Mahram kaha jata hai) ke beech kiye gaye har shaadi ko radd karo.' Umar ne Magian kaafiron se Jizya nahi liya jab tak Abdur-Rahman bin Auf ne gawahi nahi di ke Allah ke Rasool ne Hajar ke Magianon se Jizya liya tha."

e: Narrated `Amr bin `Auf Al-Ansari:(who was an ally of Bani `Amr bin Lu'ai and one of those who had taken part in (the Ghazwa of) Badr): Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent Abu 'Ubaida bin Al-Jarreh to Bahrain to collect the Jizya. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had established peace with the people of Bahrain and appointed Al-`Ala' bin Al-Hadrami as their governor. When Abu 'Ubaida came from Bahrain with the money, the Ansar heard of Abu 'Ubaida's arrival which coincided with the time of the morning prayer with the Prophet. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) led them in the morning prayer and finished, the Ansar approached him, and he looked at them and smiled on seeing them and said, "I feel that you have heard that Abu. 'Ubaida has brought something?" They said, "Yes, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)' He said, "Rejoice and hope for what will please you! By Allah, I am not afraid of your poverty but I am afraid that you will lead a life of luxury as past nations did, whereupon you will compete with each other for it, as they competed for it, and it will destroy you as it destroyed them
hi: Amr bin Auf Al-Ansari bataate hain (jo Bani Amr bin Lu'ai ke saathi the aur Badr ki jung mein shaamil the): Allah ke Rasool ne Abu Ubaida bin Al-Jarrah ko Bahrain Jizya jama karne bheja. Allah ke Rasool ne Bahrain ke logon se sulha ki thi aur Al-Ala bin Al-Hadrami ko unka gawarnar muqarrar kiya tha. Jab Abu Ubaida Bahrain se paisa lekar aaye, Ansaar ko Abu Ubaida ke aane ki khabar mili jo subah ki namaz ke waqt hui, jabke woh Nabi ke saath the. Jab Allah ke Rasool subah ki namaz khatam karke uthe, Ansaar unke paas aaye, aur unhone unhe dekhkar muskurate huye kaha, "Mujhe lagta hai tumne suna hai ke Abu Ubaida kuch laaye hain?" Unhone kaha, "Haan, Ya Allah ke Rasool!" Aap ne kaha, "Khush ho jao aur us cheez ki ummeed karo jo tumhe pasand aaegi! Allah ki qasam, mujhe tumhari gareebi se dar nahi lagta, magar mujhe dar hai ke tum usi tarah aish-o-aaram ki zindagi jioge jaisi pichli ummaten ne jiee, aur phir tum uske liye ek-doosre se muqaabla karoge, jaisa unhonne kiya, aur yeh tumhe barbaad kar dega jaisa usne unhe barbaad kiya."

e: Narrated Jubair bin Haiya:`Umar sent the Muslims to the great countries to fight the pagans. When Al-Hurmuzan embraced Islam, `Umar said to him. "I would like to consult you regarding these countries which I intend to invade." Al-Hurmuzan said, "Yes, the example of these countries and their inhabitants who are the enemies. of the Muslims, is like a bird with a head, two wings and two legs; If one of its wings got broken, it would get up over its two legs, with one wing and the head; and if the other wing got broken, it would get up with two legs and a head, but if its head got destroyed, then the two legs, two wings and the head would become useless. The head stands for Khosrau, and one wing stands for Caesar and the other wing stands for Faris. So, order the Muslims to go towards Khosrau." So, `Umar sent us (to Khosrau) appointing An-Nu`man bin Muqrin as our commander. When we reached the land of the enemy, the representative of Khosrau came out with forty-thousand warriors, and an interpreter got up saying, "Let one of you talk to me!" Al-Mughira replied, "Ask whatever you wish." The other asked, "Who are you?" Al-Mughira replied, "We are some people from the Arabs; we led a hard, miserable, disastrous life: we used to suck the hides and the date stones from hunger; we used to wear clothes made up of fur of camels and hair of goats, and to worship trees and stones. While we were in this state, the Lord of the Heavens and the Earths, Elevated is His Remembrance and Majestic is His Highness, sent to us from among ourselves a Prophet whose father and mother are known to us. Our Prophet, the Messenger of our Lord, has ordered us to fight you till you worship Allah Alone or give Jizya (i.e. tribute); and our Prophet has informed us that our Lord says:-- "Whoever amongst us is killed (i.e. martyred), shall go to Paradise to lead such a luxurious life as he has never seen, and whoever amongst us remains alive, shall become your master." (Al-Mughira, then blamed An-Nu`man for delaying the attack and) An-Nu' man said to Al-Mughira, "If you had participated in a similar battle, in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) he would not have blamed you for waiting, nor would he have disgraced you. But I accompanied Allah's Apostle in many battles and it was his custom that if he did not fight early by daytime, he would wait till the wind had started blowing and the time for the prayer was due (i.e. after midday)
hi: Jubair bin Haiya bataate hain: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Musalmanon ko bade desho mein mushrikon se jung karne bheja. Jab Al-Hurmuzan ne Islam qubool kiya, Umar ne unse kaha, "Main un desho ke baare mein tumse mashwara chahta hoon jinhe main fatah karna chahta hoon." Al-Hurmuzan ne kaha, "Haan, in deshon aur unke rehne wale jo Musalmanon ke dushman hain, unki misal ek parinde jaisi hai jiska ek sar, do pankh, aur do paanv hain. Agar uska ek pankh tut jaaye, woh apne do paanv, ek pankh, aur sar ke sahaare uthega; aur agar doosra pankh bhi tut jaaye, woh do paanv aur sar ke sahaare uthega, magar agar uska sar barbaad ho jaaye, phir do paanv, do pankh, aur sar sab bekaar ho jaayenge. Sar Khusrau ke liye hai, aur ek pankh Caesar ke liye, aur doosra pankh Faris ke liye. Isliye Musalmanon ko Khusrau ki taraf jane ka hukum do." Isliye Umar ne humein (Khusrau ki taraf) bheja, An-Nu'man bin Muqrin ko humara sardaar muqarrar karte huye. Jab hum dushman ki zameen tak pahunche, Khusrau ke pratinidhi chaalis hazaar sipahiyon ke saath bahar aaye, aur ek anuvaadak khade hokar bola, "Tum mein se koi mujhse baat kare!" Al-Mughira ne jawab diya, "Jo chaho pucho." Doosre ne pucha, "Tum kaun ho?" Al-Mughira ne jawab diya, "Hum Arbon mein se kuch log hain; hum bahut sakht, dukhad, aur museebat bhari zindagi jite the: hum bhookh se chamde aur khajoor ke daanon ko chuste the; hum unton ke chamde aur bakriyon ke baal se bane kapde pehnte the, aur darakhton aur pattharon ki parastish karte the. Jabke hum is haalat mein the, aasmanon aur zameenon ke Rab ne, jiska naam buland hai aur jiski shaan azeem hai, humare hi beech se ek Nabi bheja jinka baap aur maa humein maalum hain. Humare Nabi, humare Rab ke Rasool, ne humein tumse jung karne ka hukum diya hai jab tak tum akele Allah ki ibadat na karo ya Jizya (yaani tax) na do; aur humare Nabi ne humein bataya hai ke humara Rab kehta hai: 'Humme se jo bhi qatl kiya jaaye (yaani shaheed ho), woh Jannat mein aisa aish-o-aaram bhara jeevan jiega jaisa usne kabhi nahi dekha, aur jo bhi zinda rahe, woh tumhara sardaar ban jaayega.'" (Al-Mughira ne phir An-Nu'man ko hamle mein deri karne par ilzaam lagaya, aur) An-Nu'man ne Al-Mughira se kaha, "Agar tum Allah ke Rasool ki sohbat mein aisi hi ek jung mein shaamil hote, woh tumhare intezaar karne par tumhe ilzaam nahi dete, na hi apmaanit karte. Magar main Allah ke Rasool ke saath kaee jungon mein shaamil raha aur unki aadat thi ke agar woh din ki shuruaat mein jung na karte, to woh tab tak intezaar karte jab tak hawa chalna shuru hoti aur namaz ka waqt aa jata (yaani dopahar ke baad)."

e: Narrated Abu Humaid As-Saidi:We accompanied the Prophet (ﷺ) in the Ghazwa of Tabuk and the king of 'Aila presented a white mule and a cloak as a gift to the Prophet. And the Prophet (ﷺ) wrote to him a peace treaty allowing him to keep authority over his country
hi: Abu Humaid As-Saidi bataate hain: Hum Nabi ke saath Ghazwa-e-Tabuk mein shaamil the, aur Aila ke raja ne Nabi ko ek safed khachchar aur ek libaas tohfe mein diya. Nabi ne unhe ek sulha ka khat likha jismein unhe apni sarzameen par apna adhikar banaye rakhne ki ijazat di gaee.

e: Narrated Juwairiya bin Qudama at-Tamimi:We said to `Umar bin Al-Khattab, "O Chief of the believers! Advise us." He said, "I advise you to fulfill Allah's Covenant (made with the Dhimmis) as it is the convention of your Prophet and the source of the livelihood of your dependents (i.e. the taxes from the Dhimmis)
hi: Juwairiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) bin Qudama at-Tamimi bataate hain: Humne Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab se kaha, "Aye Momino ke Ameer! Humein naseehat dijiye." Unhone kaha, "Main tumhe Allah ke Ahad (jo Dhimmiyon yaani gair-Musalman praja se kiya gaya hai) ka paalan karne ki naseehat deta hoon, kyunke yeh tumhare Nabi ki riwaj hai aur tumhare aashriton ki rozi ka zariya hai (yaani Dhimmiyon se aane wala tax)."

e: Narrated Yahya bin Sa`id:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) called the Ansar in order to grant them part of the land of Bahrain. On that they said, "No! By Allah, we will not accept it unless you grant a similar thing to our Quraishi brothers as well." He said, "That will be their's if Allah wishes." But when the Ansar persisted in their request, he said, "After me you will see others given preference over you in this respect (in which case) you should be patient till you meet me at the Tank (of Al-Kauthar)
hi: Yahya bin Sa'id bataate hain: Ek baar Nabi ne Ansaar ko bulaya taake unhe Bahrain ki zameen ka ek hissa den. Isspar unhone kaha, "Nahi! Allah ki qasam, hum ise qubool nahi karenge jab tak aap humare Quraishi bhaiyon ko bhi isi tarah kuch na den." Unhone kaha, "Insha Allah, woh unhe milega." Magar jab Ansaar apni maang par date rahe, unhone kaha, "Mere baad tum doosron ko is baare mein khud se zyada tarjih dete dekhoge (isliye) tumhe sabr karna chahiye jab tak tum mujhse (Jannat mein) Al-Kauthar ke talab par mile."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) once said to me, "If the revenue of Bahrain came, I would give you this much and this much." When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had died, the revenue of Bahrain came, and Abu Bakr announced, " Let whoever was promised something by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) come to me." So, I went to Abu Bakr and said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me, 'If the revenue of Bahrain came, I would give you this much and this. much." On that Abu Bakr said to me, "Scoop (money) with both your hands." I scooped money with both my hands and Abu Bakr asked me to count it. I counted it and it was five-hundred (gold pieces). The total amount he gave me was one thousand and five hundred (gold pieces.) Narrated Anas: Money from Bahrain was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) . He said, "Spread it in the Mosque." It was the biggest amount that had ever been brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . In the meantime Al-`Abbas came to him and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Give me, for I gave the ransom of myself and `Aqil." The Prophet said (to him), "Take." He scooped money with both hands and poured it in his garment and tried to lift it, but he could not and appealed to the Prophet, "Will you order someone to help me in lifting it?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No." Then Al-`Abbas said, "Then will you yourself help me carry it?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No." Then Al `Abbas threw away some of the money, but even then he was not able to lift it, and so he again requested the Prophet (ﷺ) "Will you order someone to help me carry it?" The Prophet said, "No." Then Al-`Abbas said, "Then will you yourself yelp me carry it?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'No." So, Al-`Abbas threw away some more money and lifted it on his shoulder and went away. The Prophet (ﷺ) kept on looking at him with astonishment at his greediness till he went out of our sight. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not get up from there till not a single Dirham remained from that money
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne ek baar mujhse kaha, "Agar Bahrain ki aamdani aee, main tumhe itna aur itna dunga." Jab Allah ke Rasool ka intiqal ho gaya, Bahrain ki aamdani aee, aur Abu Bakr ne elaan kiya, "Jise bhi Allah ke Rasool ne kuch waada kiya ho, woh mere paas aaye." Isliye main Abu Bakr ke paas gaya aur kaha, "Allah ke Rasool ne mujhse kaha tha, 'Agar Bahrain ki aamdani aee, main tumhe itna aur itna dunga.'" Isspar Abu Bakr ne mujhse kaha, "Apne donon haathon se (paisa) nikal lo." Maine apne donon haathon se paisa nikala aur Abu Bakr ne mujhse use ginane ko kaha. Maine gina aur woh paanch sau (sone ke sikke) nikla. Kul jitna unhonne mujhe diya woh ek hazaar paanch sau (sone ke sikke) tha. Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Bahrain se paisa Nabi ke paas laaya gaya. Unhone kaha, "Ise masjid mein failaa do." Yeh sabse badi rakam thi jo kabhi Allah ke Rasool ke paas laee gaee thi. Isi dauran Al-Abbas unke paas aaye aur kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe dijiye, kyunke maine apna aur Aqil ka fidya ada kiya hai." Nabi ne (unse) kaha, "Le lo." Unhone apne donon haathon se paisa nikala aur apne kapde mein daalkar use uthane ki koshish ki, magar woh na utha sake aur Nabi se guzarish ki, "Kya aap kisi ko mujhe ise uthane mein madad karne ka hukum denge?" Nabi ne kaha, "Nahi." Phir Al-Abbas ne kaha, "Phir kya aap khud mujhe ise le jane mein madad karenge?" Nabi ne kaha, "Nahi." Phir Al-Abbas ne kuch paisa gira diya, magar phir bhi woh use na utha sake, aur unhonne phir Nabi se guzarish ki, "Kya aap kisi ko mujhe ise le jane mein madad karne ka hukum denge?" Nabi ne kaha, "Nahi." Phir Al-Abbas ne kaha, "Phir kya aap khud mujhe ise le jane mein madad karenge?" Nabi ne kaha, "Nahi." Isliye Al-Abbas ne aur kuch paisa gira diya aur use apne kandhe par uthakar chale gaye. Nabi unhe hairat se dekhte rahe unki lalach par jab tak woh humari nazron se ojhal ho gaye. Allah ke Rasool wahaan se tab tak nahi uthe jab tak us paise mein se ek bhi Dirham nahi bacha.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever killed a person having a treaty with the Muslims, shall not smell the smell of Paradise though its smell is perceived from a distance of forty years
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Jisne bhi kisi Musalmanon ke saath sandhi (muahida) wale shaks ko qatl kiya, woh Jannat ki khushbu bhi nahi soonghega, chahe uski khushbu chaalis saal ki doori se mahsoos ki jaati ho."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:While we were in the Mosque, the Prophet (ﷺ) came out and said, "Let us go to the Jews" We went out till we reached Bait-ul-Midras. He said to them, "If you embrace Islam, you will be safe. You should know that the earth belongs to Allah and His Apostle, and I want to expel you from this land. So, if anyone amongst you owns some property, he is permitted to sell it, otherwise you should know that the Earth belongs to Allah and His Apostle
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jabke hum masjid mein the, Nabi bahar aaye aur kaha, "Chalo Yahudiyon ke paas chalte hain." Hum bahar gaye jab tak Bait-ul-Midras pahunche. Unhone unse kaha, "Agar tum Islam qubool karo, tum mahfooz rahoge. Tumhe pata hona chahiye ke zameen Allah aur uske Rasool ki hai, aur main tumhe is zameen se nikalna chahta hoon. Isliye agar tum mein se koi kuch maal rakhta hai, use bechne ki ijazat hai, warna tumhe pata hona chahiye ke zameen Allah aur uske Rasool ki hai."

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:that he heard Ibn `Abbas saying, "Thursday! And you know not what Thursday is? After that Ibn `Abbas wept till the stones on the ground were soaked with his tears. On that I asked Ibn `Abbas, "What is (about) Thursday?" He said, "When the condition (i.e. health) of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) deteriorated, he said, 'Bring me a bone of scapula, so that I may write something for you after which you will never go astray.'The people differed in their opinions although it was improper to differ in front of a prophet, They said, 'What is wrong with him? Do you think he is delirious? Ask him (to understand). The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, 'Leave me as I am in a better state than what you are asking me to do.' Then the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered them to do three things saying, 'Turn out all the pagans from the Arabian Peninsula, show respect to all foreign delegates by giving them gifts as I used to do.' " The sub-narrator added, "The third order was something beneficial which either Ibn `Abbas did not mention or he mentioned but I forgot
hi: Sa'id bin Jubair bataate hain: Unhone Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko kehte suna, "Guruwaar! Aur tumhe nahi pata guruwaar kya hai?" Iske baad Ibn Abbas rone lage jab tak zameen ke patthar unke aansuon se bhig gaye. Isspar maine Ibn Abbas se pucha, "Guruwaar ke baare mein kya baat hai?" Unhone kaha, "Jab Allah ke Rasool ki haalat (yaani sehat) badhi, unhone kaha, 'Mere liye kandhe ki ek haddi lao taake main tumhare liye kuch likh dun jiske baad tum kabhi bhatke nahi.' Logon mein ikhtilaf ho gaya chahe Nabi ke saamne ikhtilaf karna munasib nahi tha. Unhone kaha, 'Unhe kya hua hai? Kya tumhe lagta hai woh behosh hain? Unse (samjhane ke liye) poocho.' Nabi ne jawab diya, 'Mujhe chhod do jaisa main hoon, meri yeh haalat usse behtar hai jiske liye tum mujhse maang rahe ho.'" Phir Nabi ne unhe teen cheezon ka hukum diya, kehte huye, "Sab mushrikon ko Arab ki sarzameen se nikal do, videshi wafdon ko izzat deno aur tohfe deno jaisa maine unke saath kiya." (Doosre raawi ne joda:) "Teesra hukum ek achhi baat thi jise ya to Ibn Abbas ne nahi bataya ya unhonne bataya magar main bhool gaya."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:When Khaibar was conquered, a roasted poisoned sheep was presented to the Prophet (ﷺ) as a gift (by the Jews). The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered, "Let all the Jews who have been here, be assembled before me." The Jews were collected and the Prophet (ﷺ) said (to them), "I am going to ask you a question. Will you tell the truth?" They said, "Yes." The Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "Who is your father?" They replied, "So-and-so." He said, "You have told a lie; your father is so-and-so." They said, "You are right." He said, "Will you now tell me the truth, if I ask you about something?" They replied, "Yes, O Abu Al-Qasim; and if we should tell a lie, you can realize our lie as you have done regarding our father." On that he asked, "Who are the people of the (Hell) Fire?" They said, "We shall remain in the (Hell) Fire for a short period, and after that you will replace us." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You may be cursed and humiliated in it! By Allah, we shall never replace you in it." Then he asked, "Will you now tell me the truth if I ask you a question?" They said, "Yes, O Abu Al-Qasim." He asked, "Have you poisoned this sheep?" They said, "Yes." He asked, "What made you do so?" They said, "We wanted to know if you were a liar in which case we would get rid of you, and if you are a prophet then the poison would not harm you
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Khaibar fatah hui, ek bhuna hua zahrila bhed Nabi ko tohfe ke tor par pesh kiya gaya (Yahudiyon dwaara). Nabi ne hukum diya, "Sab Yahudi jo yahaan rahe hain, unhe mere saamne jama karo." Yahudi jama kiye gaye aur Nabi ne (unse) kaha, "Main tumse ek sawaal puchunga. Kya tum sach bataoge?" Unhone kaha, "Haan." Nabi ne pucha, "Tumhara baap kaun hai?" Unhone jawab diya, "Falaan-falaan." Unhone kaha, "Tumne jhoot bola; tumhara baap falaan-falaan hai." Unhone kaha, "Aap sahi hain." Unhone kaha, "Kya ab tum mujhe sach bataoge agar main tumse kuch poochun?" Unhone jawab diya, "Haan, Aye Abul-Qasim; aur agar hum jhoot bolen, aap humara jhoot pahchaan lenge jaisa aapne humare baap ke baare mein kiya." Isspar unhone pucha, "Dozakh wale kaun hain?" Unhone kaha, "Hum kuch waqt Dozakh mein rahenge, aur uske baad tum humari jagah loge." Nabi ne kaha, "Tum usme laanat aur zaleel hokar raho! Allah ki qasam, hum kabhi tumhari jagah nahi loge usme." Phir unhone pucha, "Ab kya tum sach bataoge agar main tumse kuch poochun?" Unhone kaha, "Haan, Aye Abul-Qasim." Unhone pucha, "Kya tumne is bhed ko zahar diya?" Unhone kaha, "Haan." Unhone pucha, "Tumne aisa kyun kiya?" Unhone kaha, "Hum jaanna chahte the kya aap jhute hain, jispar hum aapse chhutkaara paa lenge, aur agar aap Nabi hain, to zahar aapko nuksaan nahi pahunchaega."

e: Narrated `Asim:I asked Anas about the Qunut (i.e. invocation in the prayer). Anas said, "It should be recited before bowing." I said, "So-and-so claims that you say that it should be recited after bowing." He replied, "He is mistaken." Then Anas narrated to us that the Prophet (ﷺ) invoked evil on the tribe of Bani-Sulaim for one month after bowing. ' Anas Further said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) had sent 40 or 70 Qaris (i.e. men well versed in the knowledge of the Qur'an) to some pagans, but the latter struggled with them and martyred them, although there was a peace pact between them and the Prophet (ﷺ) I had never seen the Prophet so sorry and worried about anybody as he was about them (i.e. the Qaris)
hi: Asim bataate hain: Maine Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se Qunut (yaani namaz mein dua) ke baare mein pucha. Anas ne kaha, "Ise ruku se pahle padhna chahiye." Maine kaha, "Falaan-falaan daava karte hain ke aap kehte hain ise ruku ke baad padhna chahiye." Unhone jawab diya, "Woh galat hain." Phir Anas ne humein bataya ke Nabi ne Bani Sulaim qabile ke khilaf ek mahine tak ruku ke baad bad-dua ki. Anas ne aage kaha, "Nabi ne chaalis ya sattar Qariyon (yaani Quran ke gyan rakhne wale) ko kuch mushrikon ke paas bheja tha, magar unhone unse jhagda kiya aur unhe shaheed kar diya, chahe unke aur Nabi ke beech sulha ka muahida tha. Maine Nabi ko kabhi kisi ke baare mein itna dukhi aur pareshaan nahi dekha jitna unke (yaani Qariyon ke) baare mein."

e: Narrated Um Hani:the daughter of Abu Talib: I went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the day of the conquest of Mecca and found him taking a bath, and his daughter Fatima was screening him. I greeted him and he asked, "Who is that?" I said, "I, Um Hani bint Abi Talib." He said, "Welcome, O Um Hani." When he had finished his bath, he stood up and offered eight rak`at while dressed in one garment. I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! My brother `Ali has declared that he will kill a man to whom I have granted asylum. The man is so and-so bin Hubaira." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O Um Hani! We will grant asylum to the one whom you have granted asylum." (Um Hani said, "That (visit) took place in the Duha (i.e. forenoon)
hi: Um Hani, Abu Talib ki beti, bataati hain: Main Allah ke Rasool ke paas gaee Fatah-e-Mecca ke din aur unhe ghusal karte paaya, aur unki beti Fatima (Alayhas Salam) unhe parda se chhupa rahi thi. Maine unhe salaam kiya aur unhone pucha, "Yeh kaun hai?" Maine kaha, "Main, Um Hani bint Abi Talib." Unhone kaha, "Khush aamdad, Aye Um Hani." Jab unhone ghusal khatam kiya, woh khade hue aur ek hi kapde mein aath rakat namaz padhi. Maine kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Mere bhai Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne elaan kiya hai ke woh us shaks ko qatl karenge jise maine panah di hai. Woh shaks falaan-falaan bin Hubaira hai." Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Aye Um Hani! Hum use bhi panah denge jise tumne panah di hai." (Um Hani ne kaha, "Yeh (mulaqaat) Duha (yaani subah ke poorwaar-bhaag) mein hui thi.")

e: Narrated Ibrahim at-Tamimi's father:`Ali delivered a sermon saying, "We have no book to read except the Book of Allah and what is written in this paper which contains verdicts regarding (retaliation for) wounds, the ages of the camels (given as Zakat or as blood money) and the fact that Medina is a sanctuary in between Air mountain to so-and-so (mountain). So, whoever innovates in it an heresy or commits a sin or gives shelter in it, to such an innovator will incur the Curse of Allah, the angels and all the people, and none of his compulsory or optional good deeds of worship will be accepted. And whoever (freed slave) takes as his master (i.e. befriends) other than his real masters will incur the same (Curse). And the asylum granted by any Muslim is to be secured by all the other Muslims, and whoever betrays a Muslim in this respect will incur the same (Curse)
hi: Ibrahim At-Taimi ke waalid bataate hain: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne khutba diya aur kaha, "Humare paas Allah ki Kitaab ke ilawa koi doosri Kitaab padhne ke liye nahi hai, aur is kaagaz mein jo likha hai (uske ilawa) jismein zakhmon ke badle (khoon-baha) ke faisle, unton ki umr (jo Zakat ya khoon-baha ke tor par diye jate hain), aur yeh haqiqat ke Madina Air pahad se falaan-falaan (pahad) tak ek panah wali jagah hai. Isliye jo bhi isme koi nayi bidat likhale ya gunah kare ya kisi aise nayi bidat karne wale ko panah de, use Allah, farishton aur sab logon ki laanat milegi, aur uska koi farz ya nafil ibadat qubool nahi hoga. Aur jo bhi (azaad kiya gulaam) apne asli maalikon ke ilawa kisi doosre ko apna sarparast (yaani dost) banata hai, use bhi wahi (laanat) milegi. Aur kisi bhi Musalman dwaara di gaee panah sab Musalmanon dwaara mahfooz ki jaani chahiye, aur jo bhi is baare mein kisi Musalman se dagabaazi kare, use bhi wahi (laanat) milegi."

e: Narrated Sahl bin Abi Hathma:`Abdullah bin Sahl and Muhaiyisa bin Mas`ud bin Zaid set out to Khaibar, the inhabitants of which had a peace treaty with the Muslims at that time. They parted and later on Muhaiyisa came upon `Abdullah bin Sahl and found him murdered agitating in his blood. He buried him and returned to Medina. `Abdur Rahman bin Sahl, Muhaiyisa and Huwaiyisa, the sons of Mas`ud came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and `Abdur Rahman intended to talk, but the Prophet (ﷺ) said (to him), "Let the eldest of you speak." as `Abdur-Rahman was the youngest:. `Abdur-Rahman kept silent and the other two spoke. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If you swear as to who has committed the murder, you will have the right to take your right from the murderer." They said, "How should we swear if we did not witness the murder or see the murderer?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Then the Jews can clear themselves from the charge by taking Alaska (an oath taken by men that it was not they who committed the murder)." The!y said, "How should we believe in the oaths of infidels?" So, the Prophet (ﷺ) himself paid the blood money (of `Abdullah). (See Hadith No. 36 Vol)
hi: Sahl bin Abi Hathma bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Sahl aur Muhaiyisa bin Mas'ud bin Zaid Khaibar ki taraf nikle, jiske rehane wale us waqt Musalmanon ke saath sulha ke muahide mein the. Woh alag ho gaye, aur baad mein Muhaiyisa Abdullah bin Sahl ke paas aaye aur unhe apne khoon mein tadapta hua murda paaya. Unhone unhe dafanaya aur Madina wapas aaye. Abdur Rahman bin Sahl, Muhaiyisa, aur Huwaiyisa, Mas'ud ke bete, Nabi ke paas aaye, aur Abdur-Rahman baat karna chahte the, magar Nabi ne (unse) kaha, "Tum mein se sabse bade ko bolne do," kyunke Abdur-Rahman sabse chhote the. Abdur-Rahman khaamosh rahe aur doosre do ne baat ki. Nabi ne kaha, "Agar tum qasam khakar batao kisne qatl kiya, tumhe qaatil se apna haqq lene ka adhikar hoga." Unhone kaha, "Hum kaise qasam khaenge jabke humne na qatl dekha na qaatil?" Nabi ne kaha, "Phir Yahudi khud ko is ilzaam se qasam lekar saaf kar sakte hain (yaani Alaska, ek qasam jo mard lete the ke unhone qatl nahi kiya)." Unhone kaha, "Hum kaafiron ki qasmon par kaise vishwas karen?" Isliye Nabi ne khud (Abdullah ke) khoon-baha ada kiya. (Dekhen Hadith No. 36, Vol.)

e: Narrated ' `Abdullah bin `Abbas:That Abu Sufyan bin Harb Informed him that Heraclius called him and the members of a caravan from Quraish who had gone to Sham as traders, during the truce which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had concluded with Abu Sufyan and the Quraish infidels
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Harb ne unhe bataya ke Heraclius ne unhe aur Quraish ke ek qafile ke logon ko bulaya jo taajir ke tor par Sham gaye the, us sulha ke dauran jo Allah ke Rasool ne Abu Sufyan aur Quraish ke kaafiron ke saath ki thi.

e: Narrated Aisha:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) was bewitched so that he began to imagine that he had done a thing which in fact he had not done
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ek baar Nabi par jaadu kiya gaya tha, jiski wajah se unhe lagta ke unhonne koi kaam kiya hai jo asal mein unhonne nahi kiya tha.

e: Narrated `Auf bin Malik:I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) during the Ghazwa of Tabuk while he was sitting in a leather tent. He said, "Count six signs that indicate the approach of the Hour: my death, the conquest of Jerusalem, a plague that will afflict you (and kill you in great numbers) as the plague that afflicts sheep, the increase of wealth to such an extent that even if one is given one hundred Dinars, he will not be satisfied; then an affliction which no Arab house will escape, and then a truce between you and Bani Al-Asfar (i.e. the Byzantines) who will betray you and attack you under eighty flags. Under each flag will be twelve thousand soldiers
hi: Auf bin Malik bataate hain: Main Ghazwa-e-Tabuk ke dauran Nabi ke paas gaya jabke woh ek chamde ke tambu mein baithe the. Unhone kaha, "Qiyamat ke aane se pahle chhah nishaaniyaan gino: meri maut, Jerusalem ki fatah, ek talaee (plague) jo tumhe isi tarah takleef degi jaisa bhedon ko lagti hai (aur bahut se logon ko maar degi), daulat ka itna badhna ke agar kisi ko sau Dinar bhi diye jaen, woh santusht nahi hoga; phir ek museebat jisse koi Arab ghar nahi bachega, aur phir tumhare aur Bani Al-Asfar (yaani Byzantine) ke beech ek sulha hogi jo woh dagabaazi karke todenge aur assi jhandon ke tehat tum par hamla karenge. Har jhande ke neeche baarah hazaar sipahi honge."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Abu Bakr, on the day of Nahr (i.e. slaughtering of animals for sacrifice), sent me in the company of others to make this announcement: "After this year, no pagan will be allowed to perform the Hajj, and none will be allowed to perform the Tawaf of the Ka`ba undressed." And the day of Al-Hajj-ul-Akbar is the day of Nahr, and its called Al-Akbar because the people call the `Umra Al-Hajj-ul-Asghar (i.e. the minor Hajj). Abu Bakr threw back the pagans' covenant that year, and therefore, no pagan performed the Hajj in the year of Hajj-ul-Wada` of the Prophets
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nahr ke din (yaani qurbani zabah karne ka din), Abu Bakr ne mujhe doosron ke saath elaan karne bheja: "Is saal ke baad, koi mushrik Hajj nahi kar sakega, aur koi bhi Ka'ba ka Tawaf nange hokar nahi kar sakega." Aur Al-Hajj-ul-Akbar ka din Nahr ka din hai, aur ise Al-Akbar isliye kaha jata hai kyunke log Umrah ko Al-Hajj-ul-Asghar (yaani chhota Hajj) kehte hain. Abu Bakr ne us saal mushrikon ka ahad radd kar diya, aur isliye, Nabi ke Hajjat-ul-Wada ke saal koi mushrik Hajj nahi kar saka.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever has (the following) four characteristics will be a pure hypocrite: "If he speaks, he tells a lie; if he gives a promise, he breaks it, if he makes a covenant he proves treacherous; and if he quarrels, he behaves in a very imprudent evil insulting manner (unjust). And whoever has one of these characteristics, has one characteristic of a hypocrite, unless he gives it up
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Jiske paas (yeh) chaar khasiyaten hon, woh saad-e-munafik (poora munafik) hoga: agar woh baat kare, jhoot bole; agar woh waada kare, use tore; agar woh ahad kare, dagabaazi kare; aur agar woh jhagda kare, bahut bura aur be-adab tareeke se pesh aaye (na-insaafi se). Aur jiske paas inme se koi ek khasiyat ho, uske paas munafik ki ek khasiyat hai, jab tak woh ise chhod na de."

e: Narrated `Ali:We did not, write anything from the Prophet (ﷺ) except the Qur'an and what is written in this paper, (wherein) the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Medina is a sanctuary from (the mountain of) Air to so and-so, therefore, whoever innovates (in it) an heresy or commits a sin, or gives shelter to such an innovator, will incur the Curse of Allah. the angels and all the people; and none of his compulsory or optional good deeds of worship will be accepted And the asylum granted by any Muslim Is to be secured by all the Muslims even if it is granted by one of the lowest social status among them. And whoever betrays a Muslim in this respect will incur the Curse of Allah, the angels and all the people, and his compulsory and optional good deeds of worship will not be accepted. And any freed slave who will take as masters (befriends) people other than his own real masters who freed him without taking the permission of the latter, will incur the Curse of Allah, the angels and all the people, and his compulsory and optional good deeds of worship will not be accepted
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Humne Nabi se kuch nahi likha siwaye Quran ke aur jo is kaagaz mein likha hai, (jismein) Nabi ne kaha, "Madina Air (pahad) se falaan-falaan tak ek panah wali jagah hai, isliye jo bhi isme koi nayi bidat likhale ya gunah kare, ya kisi aise nayi bidat karne wale ko panah de, use Allah, farishton aur sab logon ki laanat milegi; aur uska koi farz ya nafil ibadat qubool nahi hoga. Aur kisi bhi Musalman dwaara di gaee panah sab Musalmanon dwaara mahfooz ki jaani chahiye, chahe woh unke sabse neeche darje ke shaks dwaara di gaee ho. Aur jo bhi is baare mein kisi Musalman se dagabaazi kare, use Allah, farishton aur sab logon ki laanat milegi, aur uska farz ya nafil ibadat qubool nahi hoga. Aur jo bhi azaad kiya gulaam apne asli maalikon ki ijazat ke bina kisi doosre ko apna sarparast (yaani dost) banata hai, use bhi Allah, farishton aur sab logon ki laanat milegi, aur uska farz ya nafil ibadat qubool nahi hoga."

e: Narrated Sa`id:Abu Huraira once said (to the people), "What will your state be when you can get no Dinar or Dirham (i.e. taxes from the Dhimmis)?" on that someone asked him, "What makes you know that this state will take place, O Abu Huraira?" He said, "By Him in Whose Hands Abu Huraira's life is, I know it through the statement of the true and truly inspired one (i.e. the Prophet)." The people asked, "What does the Statement say?" He replied, "Allah and His Apostle's asylum granted to Dhimmis, i.e. non-Muslims living in a Muslim territory) will be outraged, and so Allah will make the hearts of these Dhimmis so daring that they will refuse to pay the Jizya they will be supposed to pay
hi: Sa'id bataate hain: Ek baar Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne (logon se) kaha, "Tumhari kya haalat hogi jab tumhe koi Dinar ya Dirham (yaani Dhimmiyon se tax) nahi milega?" Isspar kisi ne unse pucha, "Aapko kaise pata chalega ke aisa hoga, Aye Abu Huraira?" Unhone kaha, "Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haathon mein Abu Huraira ki jaan hai, mujhe yeh sachche aur wahi paane wale (yaani Nabi) ke bayaan se pata hai." Logon ne pucha, "Bayaan mein kya kaha gaya hai?" Unhone jawab diya, "Allah aur uske Rasool dwaara Dhimmiyon (yaani Musalman ilake mein rehne wale gair-Musalman) ko di gaee panah ka apman kiya jaayega, aur isliye Allah unke dilon ko itna himmati bana dega ke woh Jizya dene se inkaar kar denge jise dene ke liye woh zimmedaar hain."

e: Narrated Al-A`mash:I asked Abu Wail, "Did you take part in the battle of Siffin?" He said, 'Yes, and I heard Sahl bin Hunaif (when he was blamed for lack of zeal for fighting) saying, "You'd better blame your wrong opinions. I wish you had seen me on the day of Abu Jandal. If I had the courage to disobey the Prophet's orders, I would have done so. We had kept out swords on our necks and shoulders, for a thing which frightened us. And we did so, we found it easier for us, except in the case of the above battle (of ours)
hi: Al-A'mash bataate hain: Maine Abu Wail se pucha, "Kya aap Siffin ki jung mein shaamil the?" Unhone kaha, "Haan, aur maine Sahl bin Hunaif ko (jab unhe jung mein utsaah ki kami ke liye doshi thahraaya gaya) yeh kehte suna, 'Behtar hai tum apne galat khyalon ko doshi thahrao. Kaash tumne mujhe Abu Jandal ke din dekha hota. Agar mujhme Nabi ke hukmon ki na-farmani karne ki himmat hoti, main aisa karta. Humne apni talwaren apni gardanon aur kandhon par rakhi thi kisi cheez ki wajah se jo humein daraee. Aur humne aisa kiya, humein yeh humare liye aasaan laga, siwaye is (Siffin ki) jung ke maamle mein.'"

e: Narrated Abu Wail:We were in Siffin and Sahl bin Hunaif got up and said, "O people! Blame yourselves! We were with the Prophet (ﷺ) on the day of Hudaibiya, and if we had been called to fight, we would have fought. But `Umar bin Al-Khattab came and said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Aren't we in the right and our opponents in the wrong?' Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Yes.' `Umar said, 'Aren't our killed persons in Paradise and their's in Hell?' He said, 'Yes.' `Umar said, 'Then why should we accept hard terms in matters concerning our religion? Shall we return before Allah judges between us and them?' Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'O Ibn Al- Khattab! I am the Messenger of Allah and Allah will never degrade me. Then `Umar went to Abu Bakr and told him the same as he had told the Prophet. On that Abu Bakr said (to `Umar). 'He is the Messenger of Allah and Allah will never degrade him.' Then Surat-al-Fath (i.e. Victory) was revealed and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) recited it to the end in front of `Umar. On that `Umar asked, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Was it (i.e. the Hudaibiya Treaty) a victory?' Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Yes
hi: Abu Wail bataate hain: Hum Siffin mein the aur Sahl bin Hunaif uthe aur kaha, "Aye logo! Apne aap ko doshi do! Hum Hudaibiya ke din Nabi ke saath the, aur agar humein jung karne ke liye bulaya jata, hum jung karte. Magar Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab aaye aur kaha, 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Kya hum sahi nahi hain aur humare virodhi galat nahi hain?' Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, 'Haan.' Umar ne kaha, 'Kya humare mare gaye log Jannat mein nahi aur unke Dozakh mein nahi?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan.' Umar ne kaha, 'Phir hum apne deen ke maamle mein sakht sharten kyun sweekaar karen? Kya hum wapas jaen isse pahle ke Allah humare aur unke beech faisla kare?' Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, 'Aye Ibn Al-Khattab! Main Allah ka Rasool hoon aur Allah mujhe kabhi zaleel nahi karega.' Phir Umar Abu Bakr ke paas gaye aur unhe wahi bataya jo unhonne Nabi ko bataya tha. Isspar Abu Bakr ne (Umar se) kaha, 'Woh Allah ke Rasool hain aur Allah unhe kabhi zaleel nahi karega.' Phir Surah Al-Fath (yaani Fatah) nazil hui aur Allah ke Rasool ne ise aakhir tak Umar ke saamne padha. Isspar Umar ne pucha, 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Kya yeh (yaani Hudaibiya ka Muahida) fatah thi?' Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, 'Haan.'"

e: Narrated Asma 'bint Abi Bakr:During the period of the peace treaty of Quraish with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), my mother, accompanied by her father, came to visit me, and she was a pagan. I consulted Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! My mother has come to me and she desires to receive a reward from me, shall I keep good relation with her?" He said, "Yes, keep good relation with her
hi: Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Abu Bakr (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Quraish ki Allah ke Rasool ke saath sulha ke dauran, meri maa, apne waalid ke saath, mujhse milne aee, aur woh mushrik thi. Maine Allah ke Rasool se salaah li, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Meri maa mujhse milne aee hain aur woh mujhse kuch ehsaan chahti hain, kya main unse achha suluk rakhun?" Aap ne kaha, "Haan, unse achha suluk rakho."

e: Narrated Al-Bara:When the Prophet (ﷺ) intended to perform the `Umra he sent a person to the people of Mecca asking their permission to enter Mecca. They stipulated that he would not stay for more than three days and would not enter it except with sheathed arms and would not preach (Islam) to any of them. So `Ali bin Abi- Talib started writing the treaty between them. He wrote, "This is what Muhammad, Apostle of Allah has agreed to." The (Meccans) said, "If we knew that you (Muhammad) are the Messenger of Allah, then we would not have prevented you and would have followed you. But write, 'This is what Muhammad bin `Abdullah has agreed to..' " On that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "By Allah, I am Muhammad bin `Abdullah, and, by Allah, I am Apostle of 'Allah." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used not to write; so he asked `Ali to erase the expression of Apostle of Allah. On that `Ali said, "By Allah I will never erase it." Allah's Apostle said (to `Ali), "Let me see the paper." When `Ali showed him the paper, the Prophet (ﷺ) erased the expression with his own hand. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had entered Mecca and three days had elapsed, the Meccans came to `Ali and said, "Let your friend (i.e. the Prophet) quit Mecca." `Ali informed Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about it and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Yes," and then he departed
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Jab Nabi ne Umrah karne ka iraada kiya, unhone Mecca ke logon ko yeh puchne ke liye ek shaks bheja ke woh unhe Mecca mein daakhil hone ki ijazat den. Unhone shart rakhi ke Nabi teen din se zyada na ruken aur sirf ghire hue hathiyaar ke saath daakhil hon aur wahaan kisi ko (Islam ka) upadesh na den. Isliye Ali (Alayhis Salam) bin Abi Talib donon ke beech muahida likhna shuru kiya. Unhone likha, "Yeh woh hai jispar Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool, raazi hue hain." (Mecca walon ne) kaha, "Agar humein pata hota ke tum (Muhammad) Allah ke Rasool ho, hum tumhe na rokte aur tumhari pairvi karte. Magar likho, 'Yeh woh hai jispar Muhammad bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) raazi hue hain..'" Isspar Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Allah ki qasam, main Muhammad bin Abdullah hoon, aur Allah ki qasam, main Allah ka Rasool hoon." Allah ke Rasool likhna nahi jaante the, isliye unhone Ali (Alayhis Salam) se "Allah ke Rasool" ka lafz mitane ko kaha. Isspar Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha, "Allah ki qasam main ise kabhi nahi mitaunga." Allah ke Rasool ne (Ali (Alayhis Salam) se) kaha, "Mujhe kaagaz dikhao." Jab Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne unhe kaagaz dikhaya, Nabi ne khud apne haathon se woh lafz mita diya. Jab Allah ke Rasool Mecca mein daakhil ho gaye aur teen din guzar gaye, Mecca ke log Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke paas aaye aur kaha, "Apne dost (yaani Nabi) se kaho Mecca chhod den." Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne yeh Allah ke Rasool ko bataya aur Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Haan," aur phir woh chale gaye.

e: Narrated `Abdullah:While the Prophet (ﷺ) was in the state of prostration, surrounded by a group of people from Quraish pagans. `Uqba bin Abi Mu'ait came and brought the intestines of a camel and threw them on the back of the Prophet (ﷺ) . The Prophet (ﷺ) did not raise his head from prostration till Fatima (i.e. his daughter) came and removed those intestines from his back, and invoked evil on whoever had done (the evil deed). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! Destroy the chiefs of Quraish, O Allah! Destroy Abu Jahl bin Hisham, `Utba bin Rabi`a, Shaiba bin Rabi`a, `Uqba bin Abi Mu'ait, Umaiya bin Khalaf (or Ubai bin Khalaf)." Later on I saw all of them killed during the battle of Badr and their bodies were thrown into a well except the body of Umaiya or Ubai, because he was a fat person, and when he was pulled, the parts of his body got separated before he was thrown into the well
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jabke Nabi sajde ki haalat mein the, Quraish ke mushrikon ke ek giroh ne unhe ghera. Uqba bin Abi Mu'ait aaye aur ek untni ki aanton (intestines) laaye aur unhe Nabi ki peeth par phenk diya. Nabi ne apna sar sajde se tab tak nahi uthaya jab tak Fatima (Alayhas Salam) (yaani unki beti) na aee aur unki peeth se woh aanten hataee, aur jisne bhi yeh (bura kaam) kiya use bad-dua di. Nabi ne kaha, "Aye Allah! Quraish ke sardaron ko barbaad kar. Aye Allah! Abu Jahl bin Hisham, Utba bin Rabi'a, Shaiba bin Rabi'a, Uqba bin Abi Mu'ait, Umaiya bin Khalaf (ya Ubai bin Khalaf) ko barbaad kar." Baad mein maine unhe sabko Badr ki jung mein qatl hote dekha aur unke jism ek kue mein phenke gaye siwaye Umaiya ya Ubai ke jism ke, kyunke woh mote the, aur jab unhe khincha gaya, unke jism ke tukde alag ho gaye kue mein phenke jane se pahle.

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, ''Every betrayer will have a flag on the Day of Resurrection" One of the two subnarrators said that the flag would be fixed, and the other said that it would be shown on the Day of Resurrection, so that the betrayer might be recognized by it
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Har dagabaaz ke paas Qiyamat ke din ek jhanda hoga." Doosre raawi mein se ek ne kaha ke jhanda gada jaayega, aur doosre ne kaha ke Qiyamat ke din use dikhaya jaayega, taake dagabaaz ko usse pahchana jaa sake.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Every betrayer will have a flag which will be fixed on the Day of Resurrection, and the flag's prominence will be made in order to show the betrayal he committed
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Har dagabaaz ke paas ek jhanda hoga jo Qiyamat ke din gaada jaayega, aur jhande ki oonchaee uski dagabaazi dikhane ke liye badhaee jaayegi."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said on the day of the conquest of Mecca, "There is no migration now, but there is Jihad (i.e.. holy battle) and good intentions. And when you are called for Jihad, you should come out at once" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) also said, on the day of the conquest of Mecca, "Allah has made this town a sanctuary since the day He created the Heavens and the Earth. So, it is a sanctuary by Allah's Decree till the Day of Resurrection. Fighting in it was not legal for anyone before me, and it was made legal for me only for an hour by daytime. So, it (i.e. Mecca) is a sanctuary by Allah's Decree till the Day of Resurrection. Its thorny bushes should not be cut, and its game should not be chased, its fallen property (i.e. Luqata) should not be picked up except by one who will announce it publicly; and its grass should not be uprooted," On that Al-`Abbas said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Except the Idhkhir, because it is used by the goldsmiths and by the people for their houses." On that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Except the Idhkhir
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Fatah-e-Mecca ke din kaha, "Ab koi hijrat nahi, magar Jihad aur achhi niyyaten hain. Aur jab tumhe Jihad ke liye bulaya jaaye, tumhe foran nikal padna chahiye." Allah ke Rasool ne Fatah-e-Mecca ke din yeh bhi kaha, "Allah ne is shehar ko ek panah wali jagah banaya hai us din se jab usne aasmanon aur zameen ko banaya. Isliye yeh Allah ke hukum se Qiyamat tak ek panah wali jagah hai. Isme jung karna mujhse pahle kisi ke liye jaiz nahi tha, aur mere liye bhi sirf din ke ek ghante ke liye jaiz kiya gaya. Isliye yeh (yaani Mecca) Allah ke hukum se Qiyamat tak panah wali jagah hai. Iski kaantedaar jhadiyaan nahi katni chahiye, iske shikaar ka picha nahi karna chahiye, iski giri hui cheezein (yaani Luqata) uthane ki ijazat nahi siwaye us shaks ke jo iskaa saarvajanik elaan kare; aur iski ghaas nahi ukhadni chahiye." Isspar Al-Abbas ne kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Siwaye Al-Idhkhir ke, kyunke ise sunaron aur logon ke apne gharon ke liye istemal kiya jata hai." Isspar Nabi ne kaha, "Siwaye Al-Idhkhir ke."

e: Narrated `Imran bin Husain:Some people of Bani Tamim came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he said (to them), "O Bani Tamim! rejoice with glad tidings." They said, "You have given us glad tidings, now give us something." On hearing that the color of his face changed then the people of Yemen came to him and he said, "O people of Yemen ! Accept the good tidings, as Bani Tamim has refused them." The Yemenites said, "We accept them. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) started taking about the beginning of creation and about Allah's Throne. In the mean time a man came saying, "O `Imran! Your she-camel has run away!'' (I got up and went away), but I wish I had not left that place (for I missed what Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said
hi: Imran bin Husain (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Bani Tamim qabile ke kuch log Nabi ke paas aaye aur unhonne (unse) kaha, "Aye Bani Tamim! Achhi khabar se khush ho jao." Unhonne kaha, "Aapne humein achhi khabar di hai, ab humein kuch dijiye." Yeh sunkar unke chehre ka rang badal gaya, phir Yemen ke log unke paas aaye aur unhonne kaha, "Aye Yemen ke logo! Achhi khabar qubool karo, kyunke Bani Tamim ne use radd kiya hai." Yemen walon ne kaha, "Hum ise qubool karte hain." Phir Nabi ne takhleeq ki shuruaat aur Allah ke Arsh ke baare mein baat karna shuru kiya. Isi dauran ek shaks aaya aur kaha, "Aye Imran! Tumhari untni bhaag gaee hai!" (Main uthkar chala gaya), magar kaash main woh jagah na chhodta (kyunke maine woh miss kar diya jo Allah ke Rasool ne kaha).

e: Narrated Imran bin Husain: I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and tied my she-camel at the gate. The people of Bani Tamim came to the Prophet (ﷺ) who said "O Bani Tamim! Accept the good tidings." They said twice, 'You have given us the good tidings, now give us something" Then some Yemenites came to him and he said, "Accept the good tidings, O people of Yemen, for Bani Tamim refused them." They said, "We accept it, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We have come to ask you about this matter (i.e. the start of creations)." He said, "First of all, there was nothing but Allah, and (then He created His Throne). His throne was over the water, and He wrote everything in the Book (in the Heaven) and created the Heavens and the Earth." Then a man shouted, "O Ibn Husain! Your she-camel has gone away!"
