So, I went away and could not see the she-camel because of the mirage. By Allah, I wished I had left that she-camel (but not that gathering)
hi: Imran bin Husain (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Nabi ke paas gaya aur apni untni darwaze par baandhi. Bani Tamim qabile ke log Nabi ke paas aaye jinhone kaha "Aye Bani Tamim! Achhi khabar qubool karo." Unhone do baar kaha, "Aapne humein achhi khabar di hai, ab humein kuch dijiye." Phir kuch Yemen ke log unke paas aaye aur unhone kaha, "Achhi khabar qubool karo, Aye Yemen ke logo, kyunke Bani Tamim ne use radd kiya." Unhone kaha, "Hum ise qubool karte hain, Ya Allah ke Rasool! Hum aapse is baat ke baare mein pucchne aaye hain (yaani takhleeq ki shuruaat)." Unhone kaha, "Sabse pahle, Allah ke siwa kuch nahi tha, (phir usne apna Arsh banaya). Uska Arsh paani ke oopar tha, aur usne har cheez ek Kitaab (yaani aasman mein) mein likh di aur aasmanon aur zameen ko banaya." Phir ek shaks chillaya, "Aye Ibn Husain! Tumhari untni chali gaee hai!" Isliye main chala gaya aur mirage (dhundli hui hawa) ki wajah se untni na dekh saka. Allah ki qasam, kaash maine woh untni chhod diya hota (magar us jama'at ko nahi).

e: Narrated 'Umar:One day the Prophet (ﷺ) stood up amongst us for a long period and informed us about the beginning of creation (and talked about everything in detail) till he mentioned how the people of Paradise will enter their places and the people of Hell will enter their places. Some remembered what he had said, and some forgot it
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek din Nabi humare beech lambe waqt tak khade rahe aur humein takhleeq ki shuruaat ke baare mein bataya (aur har cheez tafseel se bataee) jab tak unhone bataya kaise Jannat wale apni jagahon mein daakhil honge aur Dozakh wale apni jagahon mein. Kuch logon ne yaad rakha jo unhone kaha, aur kuch bhool gaye.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah the Most Superior said, "The son of Adam slights Me, and he should not slight Me, and he disbelieves in Me, and he ought not to do so. As for his slighting Me, it is that he says that I have a son; and his disbelief in Me is his statement that I shall not recreate him as I have created (him) before
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Allah, jo sabse buland hai, ne kaha, 'Aadam ka beta Mujhe apman karta hai, jabke use aisa nahi karna chahiye, aur woh Mujhpar vishwas nahi karta, jabke use aisa nahi karna chahiye. Uska mera apman karna yeh hai ke woh kehta hai mera ek beta hai; aur uska Mujhpar avishvaas yeh hai ke woh kehta hai main use dobara paida nahi karunga jaisa maine pahle kiya.'"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When Allah completed the creation, He wrote in His Book which is with Him on His Throne, "My Mercy overpowers My Anger
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Jab Allah ne takhleeq poori kar li, usne apni Kitaab mein, jo uske Arsh ke paas hai, likha, 'Meri Rehmat meri Gusse par bhari padti hai.'"

e: Narrated Muhammad bin Ibrahim bin Al-Harith:from Abu Salama bin `Abdur-Rahman who had a dispute with some people on a piece of land, and so he went to `Aisha and told her about it. She said, "O Abu Salama, avoid the land, for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Any person who takes even a span of land unjustly, his neck shall be encircled with it down seven earths
hi: Muhammad bin Ibrahim bin Al-Harith bataate hain: Abu Salama bin Abdur-Rahman ka kuch logon se zameen ke ek tukde ke baare mein jhagda hua, isliye woh Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas gaye aur unhe iske baare mein bataya. Unhone kaha, "Aye Abu Salama, us zameen se bacho, kyunke Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, 'Jo bhi na-haqq zameen ka ek bhi span leta hai, uski gardan usse saat zameenon tak lipeti jaayegi.'"

e: Narrated Salim's father:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Any person who takes a piece of land unjustly will sink down the seven earths on the Day of Resurrection
hi: Salim ke waalid bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Jo bhi na-haqq zameen ka ek tukda leta hai, woh Qiyamat ke din saat zameenon mein dhaans jaayega."

e: Narrated Abu Bakra:The Prophet (ﷺ) said. "(The division of time has turned to its original form which was current when Allah created the Heavens and the Earths. The year is of twelve months, out of which four months are sacred: Three are in succession Dhul-Qa' da, Dhul-Hijja and Muharram, and (the fourth is) Rajab of (the tribe of) Mudar which comes between Jumada-ath-Thaniyah and Sha`ban
hi: Abu Bakra (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "(Waqt ka baantvara apni asli shakal mein wapas aa gaya hai jaisa jab Allah ne aasmanon aur zameenon ko banaya tha. Saal baarah mahinon ka hota hai, jinme se chaar mahine muqaddas hain: teen lagatar hain—Dhul-Qa'da, Dhul-Hijja, aur Muharram—aur (chautha hai) Rajab (Bani) Mudar ka, jo Jumada-ath-Thaniyah aur Sha'ban ke beech aata hai."

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Zaid bin `Amr bin Nufail:That Arwa sued him before Marwan for a right, which she claimed, he had deprived her of. On that Sa`id said, "How should I deprive her of her right? I testify that I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, 'If anyone takes a span of land unjustly, his neck will be encircled with it down seven earths on the Day of Resurrection
hi: Sa'id bin Zaid bin Amr bin Nufail bataate hain: Arwa ne unke khilaf Marwan ke saamne ek haqq ka daava kiya jise unhonne (yaani Sa'id ne) usse chheena tha, aisa dawa kiya. Isspar Sa'id ne kaha, "Main uska haqq kaise chheenun? Main gawahi deta hoon ke maine Allah ke Rasool ko kehte suna, 'Agar koi na-haqq zameen ka ek span leta hai, uski gardan usse saat zameenon tak Qiyamat ke din lipeti jaayegi.'"

e: Narrated Abu Dhar:The Prophet (ﷺ) asked me at sunset, "Do you know where the sun goes (at the time of sunset)?" I replied, "Allah and His Apostle know better." He said, "It goes (i.e. travels) till it prostrates Itself underneath the Throne and takes the permission to rise again, and it is permitted and then (a time will come when) it will be about to prostrate itself but its prostration will not be accepted, and it will ask permission to go on its course but it will not be permitted, but it will be ordered to return whence it has come and so it will rise in the west. And that is the interpretation of the Statement of Allah: "And the sun Runs its fixed course For a term (decreed). that is The Decree of (Allah) The Exalted in Might, The All- Knowing
hi: Abu Dharr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne suraj doobne ke waqt mujhse pucha, "Kya tumhe pata hai suraj kahaan jata hai (jab woh doobta hai)?" Maine jawab diya, "Allah aur uske Rasool behtar jaante hain." Unhone kaha, "Yeh (yaani jata hai) jab tak yeh Arsh ke neeche sajda karta hai aur dobara ugne ki ijazat maangta hai, aur ise ijazat di jaati hai, phir (ek waqt aayega jab) yeh sajda karne wala hoga magar uska sajda qubool nahi kiya jaayega, aur yeh apni raah par jane ki ijazat maangega magar ise ijazat nahi di jaayegi, balki ise wapas jane ka hukum milega jahaan se yeh aaya tha, aur isliye yeh mashrik ki bajaye magrib se ugega. Aur yehi Allah ke is farmaan ki vyaakhya hai: 'Aur suraj apni muqarrar raah par chalta hai ek muddat tak (yaani nirdharit). Yeh us Sarvashaktimaan, Sarvagya (Allah) ka faisla hai.'"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The sun and the moon will be folded up (deprived of their light) on the Day of Resurrection
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Suraj aur chaand Qiyamat ke din lapete jaayenge (yaani apni roshni se vanchit kiye jaayenge)."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The sun and the moon do not eclipse because of someone's death or life (i.e. birth), but they are two signs amongst the Signs of Allah. So, if you see them (i.e. eclipse) offer the (eclipse) prayer
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Suraj aur chaand kisi ki maut ya zindagi (yaani janam) ki wajah se grahan nahi hote, balki woh Allah ki Nishaaniyon mein se do Nishaaniyaan hain. Isliye agar tum unhe (yaani grahan) dekho, grahan ki namaz padho."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The sun and the moon are two signs amongst the Signs of Allah. They do not eclipse because of someone's death or life. So, if you see them (i.e. eclipse), celebrate the Praises of Allah (i.e. pray)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Suraj aur chaand Allah ki Nishaaniyon mein se do Nishaaniyaan hain. Woh kisi ki maut ya zindagi ki wajah se grahan nahi hote. Isliye agar tum unhe (yaani grahan) dekho, Allah ki hamd karo (yaani namaz padho)."

e: Narrated `Aisha:On the day of a solar eclipse, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up (to offer the eclipse prayer). He recited Takbir, recited a long recitation (of Holy Verses), bowed a long bowing, and then he raised his head saying, "Allah hears him who sends his praises to Him." Then he stayed standing, recited a long recitation again, but shorter than the former, bowed a long bowing, but shorter than the first, performed a long prostration and then performed the second rak`a in the same way as he had done the first. By the time he had finished his prayer with Taslim, the solar eclipse had been over. Then he addressed the people referring to the solar and lunar eclipses saying, "These are two signs amongst the Signs of Allah, and they do not eclipse because of anyone's death or life. So, if you see them, hasten for the Prayer
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Suraj grahan ke din, Allah ke Rasool khade hue (grahan ki namaz padhne ke liye). Unhone Takbir kahi, ek lamba paath (paak Ayaton ka) padha, ek lamba ruku kiya, phir apna sar uthaya aur kaha, "Allah use sunta hai jo uski taarif karta hai." Phir woh khade rahe, phir se ek lamba paath padha, magar pahle se chhota, ek lamba ruku kiya, magar pahle se chhota, ek lamba sajda kiya, aur phir dusri rakat pahli jaisa hi ki. Jab tak unhone Taslim ke saath apni namaz khatam ki, suraj grahan khatam ho chuka tha. Phir unhone suraj aur chaand grahan ke baare mein logon ko sambodhit kiya, "Yeh Allah ki Nishaaniyon mein se do Nishaaniyaan hain, aur woh kisi ki maut ya zindagi ki wajah se grahan nahi hote. Isliye agar tum unhe dekho, namaz ke liye jaldi karo."

e: Narrated Abu Mas`ud:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "the sun and the moon do not eclipse because of the death or life of someone, but they are two signs amongst the Signs of Allah. So, if you see them, offer the Prayer (of eclipse)
hi: Abu Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Suraj aur chaand kisi ki maut ya zindagi ki wajah se grahan nahi hote, balki woh Allah ki Nishaaniyon mein se do Nishaaniyaan hain. Isliye agar tum unhe dekho, (grahan ki) namaz padho."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I have been made victorious with the Saba (i.e. easterly wind) and the people of 'Ad were destroyed with the Dabur (i.e. westerly wind)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Mujhe Saba (yaani purvi hawa) ke zariye fatah di gaee hai, aur Aad qabile ke log Dabur (yaani pashchimi hawa) ke zariye barbaad kiye gaye."

e: Narrated Ata:`Aisha said If the Prophet (ﷺ) saw a cloud In the sky, he would walk to and fro in agitation, go out and come in, and the color of his face would change, and if it rained, he would feel relaxed." So `Aisha knew that state of his. So the Prophet (ﷺ) said, I don't know (am afraid), it may be similar to what happened to some people referred to in the Holy Qur'an in the following Verse: -- "Then when they saw it as a dense cloud coming towards their valleys, they said, 'This is a cloud bringing us rain!' Nay, but, it is that (torment) which you were asking to be hastened a wind wherein is severe torment
hi: Ata bataate hain: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha ke jab Nabi aasman mein baadal dekhte, woh chintit hokar idhar-udhar chalte, bahar-andar jate, aur unke chehre ka rang badal jata, aur agar barish hoti, unhe aaram milta. Isliye Ayesha unki yeh haalat pahchaanti thi. (Ek baar) Nabi ne kaha, "Mujhe nahi pata (mujhe dar hai) ke yeh usi jaisa na ho jaisa kuch logon ke saath hua jinka zikar Quran mein hai, is ayat mein: 'Phir jab unhone ise ek gahre baadal ki tarah apni waadiyon ki taraf aate dekha, unhone kaha, \"Yeh ek baadal hai jo humein barish dega!\" Nahi, balki yeh woh (azaab) hai jise tumne jaldi maanga tha—ek hawa jismein sakht azaab hai.'"

e: Narrated Malik bin Sasaa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "While I was at the House in a state midway between sleep and wakefulness, (an angel recognized me) as the man lying between two men. A golden tray full of wisdom and belief was brought to me and my body was cut open from the throat to the lower part of the `Abdomen and then my `Abdomen was washed with Zamzam water and (my heart was) filled with wisdom and belief. Al- Buraq, a white animal, smaller than a mule and bigger than a donkey was brought to me and I set out with Gabriel. When I reached the nearest heaven. Gabriel said to the heaven's gate-keeper, 'Open the gate.' The gatekeeper asked, 'Who is it?' He said, 'Gabriel.' The gate-keeper asked,' Who is accompanying you?' Gabriel said, 'Muhammad.' The gate-keeper said, 'Has he been called?' Gabriel said, 'Yes.' Then it was said, 'He is welcomed. What a wonderful visit his is!' Then I met Adam and greeted him and he said, 'You are welcomed O son and a Prophet.' Then we ascended to the second heaven. It was asked, 'Who is it?' Gabriel said, 'Gabriel.' It was said, 'Who is with you?' He said, 'Muhammad.' It was asked, 'Has he been sent for?' He said, 'Yes.' It was said, 'He is welcomed. What a wonderful visit his is!" Then I met Jesus and Yahya (John) who said, 'You are welcomed, O brother and a Prophet.' Then we ascended to the third heaven. It was asked, 'Who is it?' Gabriel said, 'Gabriel.' It was asked, 'Who is with you? Gabriel said, 'Muhammad.' It was asked, 'Has he been sent for?' 'Yes,' said Gabriel. It was said, 'He is welcomed. What a wonderful visit his is!' (The Prophet (ﷺ) added:) There I met Joseph and greeted him, and he replied, 'You are welcomed, O brother and a Prophet!' Then we ascended to the 4th heaven and again the same questions and answers were exchanged as in the previous heavens. There I met Idris and greeted him. He said, 'You are welcomed O brother and Prophet.' Then we ascended to the 5th heaven and again the same questions and answers were exchanged as in previous heavens. there I met and greeted Aaron who said, 'You are welcomed O brother and a Prophet". Then we ascended to the 6th heaven and again the same questions and answers were exchanged as in the previous heavens. There I met and greeted Moses who said, 'You are welcomed O brother and. a Prophet.' When I proceeded on, he started weeping and on being asked why he was weeping, he said, 'O Lord! Followers of this youth who was sent after me will enter Paradise in greater number than my followers.' Then we ascended to the seventh heaven and again the same questions and answers were exchanged as in the previous heavens. There I met and greeted Abraham who said, 'You are welcomed O son and a Prophet.' Then I was shown Al-Bait-al-Ma'mur (i.e. Allah's House). I asked Gabriel about it and he said, This is Al Bait-ul-Ma'mur where 70,000 angels perform prayers daily and when they leave they never return to it (but always a fresh batch comes into it daily).' Then I was shown Sidrat-ul-Muntaha (i.e. a tree in the seventh heaven) and I saw its Nabk fruits which resembled the clay jugs of Hajr (i.e. a town in Arabia), and its leaves were like the ears of elephants, and four rivers originated at its root, two of them were apparent and two were hidden. I asked Gabriel about those rivers and he said, 'The two hidden rivers are in Paradise, and the apparent ones are the Nile and the Euphrates.' Then fifty prayers were enjoined on me. I descended till I met Moses who asked me, 'What have you done?' I said, 'Fifty prayers have been enjoined on me.' He said, 'I know the people better than you, because I had the hardest experience to bring Bani Israel to obedience. Your followers cannot put up with such obligation. So, return to your Lord and request Him (to reduce the number of prayers.' I returned and requested Allah (for reduction) and He made it forty. I returned and (met Moses) and had a similar discussion, and then returned again to Allah for reduction and He made it thirty, then twenty, then ten, and then I came to Moses who repeated the same advice. Ultimately Allah reduced it to five. When I came to Moses again, he said, 'What have you done?' I said, 'Allah has made it five only.' He repeated the same advice but I said that I surrendered (to Allah's Final Order)'" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was addressed by Allah, "I have decreed My Obligation and have reduced the burden on My slaves, and I shall reward a single good deed as if it were ten good deeds
hi: Malik bin Sasaa bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Jabke main Ghar (Ka'ba) ke paas neend aur jagrat ke beech ki haalat mein tha, (ek farishte ne mujhe pahchaan liya) do logon ke beech leta hua. Ek sone ki tashtri hikmat aur iman se bhari hui mere paas laee gaee, aur mera jism gale se pet tak khol diya gaya, phir mere pet ko Zamzam ke paani se dhoya gaya, aur (mera dil) hikmat aur iman se bhar diya gaya. Al-Buraq, ek safed janwar, khachchar se chhota aur gadhe se bada, mere paas laaya gaya aur main Jibreel ke saath nikla. Jab main sabse qareebi aasman tak pahuncha, Jibreel ne aasman ke darbaan se kaha, 'Darwaza kholo.' Darbaan ne pucha, 'Kaun hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Jibreel.' Darbaan ne pucha, 'Aapke saath kaun hai?' Jibreel ne kaha, 'Muhammad.' Darbaan ne pucha, 'Kya unhe bulaya gaya hai?' Jibreel ne kaha, 'Haan.' Phir kaha gaya, 'Unka swagat hai. Kitna behtareen unka aagman hai!' Phir main Aadam se mila aur unhe salaam kiya aur unhone kaha, 'Tumhara swagat hai, Aye beta aur Nabi.' Phir hum doosre aasman tak pahunche. Pucha gaya, 'Kaun hai?' Jibreel ne kaha, 'Jibreel.' Pucha gaya, 'Aapke saath kaun hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Muhammad.' Pucha gaya, 'Kya unhe bulaya gaya hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan.' Kaha gaya, 'Unka swagat hai. Kitna behtareen unka aagman hai!' Phir main Isa aur Yahya se mila jinhone kaha, 'Tumhara swagat hai, Aye bhai aur Nabi.' Phir hum teesre aasman tak pahunche. Pucha gaya, 'Kaun hai?' Jibreel ne kaha, 'Jibreel.' Pucha gaya, 'Aapke saath kaun hai?' Jibreel ne kaha, 'Muhammad.' Pucha gaya, 'Kya unhe bulaya gaya hai?' 'Haan,' Jibreel ne kaha. Kaha gaya, 'Unka swagat hai. Kitna behtareen unka aagman hai!' (Nabi ne joda:) Wahaan main Yusuf se mila aur unhe salaam kiya, aur unhone jawab diya, 'Tumhara swagat hai, Aye bhai aur Nabi!' Phir hum chauthe aasman tak pahunche aur phir wahi sawal-jawab hue jaisa pichle aasmanon mein. Wahaan main Idris se mila aur unhe salaam kiya. Unhone kaha, 'Tumhara swagat hai, Aye bhai aur Nabi.' Phir hum paanchvaan aasman tak pahunche aur phir wahi sawal-jawab hue jaisa pichle aasmanon mein. Wahaan main Haroon se mila aur unhe salaam kiya, jinhone kaha, 'Tumhara swagat hai, Aye bhai aur Nabi.' Phir hum chhathe aasman tak pahunche aur phir wahi sawal-jawab hue jaisa pichle aasmanon mein. Wahaan main Musa se mila aur unhe salaam kiya, jinhone kaha, 'Tumhara swagat hai, Aye bhai aur Nabi.' Jab main aage badha, woh rone lage aur jab unse pucha gaya woh kyun ro rahe hain, unhone kaha, 'Aye Rab! Is jawan (Nabi) ke pairokar, jo mere baad bheje gaye, mere pairokaron se zyada taadaad mein Jannat mein daakhil honge.' Phir hum saatvaan aasman tak pahunche aur phir wahi sawal-jawab hue jaisa pichle aasmanon mein. Wahaan main Ibrahim se mila aur unhe salaam kiya, jinhone kaha, 'Tumhara swagat hai, Aye beta aur Nabi.' Phir mujhe Al-Bait-al-Ma'mur (yaani Allah ka Ghar) dikhaya gaya. Maine Jibreel se iske baare mein pucha aur unhone kaha, 'Yeh Al-Bait-ul-Ma'mur hai jahaan sattar hazaar farishte rozana namaz padhte hain, aur jab woh chale jate hain, woh kabhi wapas nahi aate (balki har roz ek naya samuh aata hai).' Phir mujhe Sidrat-ul-Muntaha (yaani saatven aasman ka ek darakht) dikhaya gaya aur maine iske Nabk phal dekhe jo Hajr (yaani Arabia ka ek shehar) ke mitti ke ghados jaise the, aur iske patte hathi ke kaanon jaise the, aur char nadiyaan iski jadon se nikalti thi, do zaahir aur do chhupi hui. Maine Jibreel se un nadiyon ke baare mein pucha aur unhone kaha, 'Do chhupi hui nadiyaan Jannat mein hain, aur zaahir wali Nile aur Euphrates hain.' Phir mujhpar pachaas namazen farz ki gaee. Main neeche utra jab tak Musa se mila jinhone mujhse pucha, 'Tumne kya kiya?' Maine kaha, 'Pachaas namazen farz ki gaee hain.' Unhone kaha, 'Main logon ko tumse behtar jaanta hoon, kyunke maine Bani Israel ko itaaat karvane mein sabse sakht tajruba kiya. Tumhare pairokaar is farz ka bojh nahi uthaa sakenge. Isliye apne Rab ke paas wapas jao aur unse (namazon ki tadaad kam karne ki) guzarish karo.' Main wapas gaya aur Allah se (kami ki) guzarish ki aur usne ise chaalis kar diya. Main phir wapas gaya (aur Musa se mila) aur waisi hi baat hui, aur phir main phir Allah ke paas kami ke liye gaya aur usne ise tees kar diya, phir bees, phir das, aur phir main Musa ke paas aaya jinhone wahi mashwara dohraya. Aakhirkar Allah ne ise paanch tak kam kar diya. Jab main phir Musa ke paas aaya, unhone kaha, 'Tumne kya kiya?' Maine kaha, 'Allah ne ise sirf paanch kiya hai.' Unhone wahi mashwara dohraya magar maine kaha ke main (Allah ke aakhri faisle ke aage) samarpit ho chuka hoon.'" Allah ke Rasool se Allah ne kaha, "Maine apna hukum tay kar diya hai aur apne bandon par se bojh kam kar diya hai, aur main ek achhe amal ka ajr das achhe amalon jitna dunga."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Mas'ud:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), the true and truly inspired said, "(The matter of the Creation of) a human being is put together in the womb of the mother in forty days, and then he becomes a clot of thick blood for a similar period, and then a piece of flesh for a similar period. Then Allah sends an angel who is ordered to write four things. He is ordered to write down his (i.e. the new creature's) deeds, his livelihood, his (date of) death, and whether he will be blessed or wretched (in religion). Then the soul is breathed into him. So, a man amongst you may do (good deeds till there is only a cubit between him and Paradise and then what has been written for him decides his behavior and he starts doing (evil) deeds characteristic of the people of the (Hell) Fire. And similarly a man amongst you may do (evil) deeds till there is only a cubit between him and the (Hell) Fire, and then what has been written for him decides his behavior, and he starts doing deeds characteristic of the people of Paradise
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool, jo sachche aur sacha ilham paane wale hain, ne kaha, "(takhleeq ka maamla) ek insaan ko maa ke garbh mein chaalis din tak joda jata hai, phir woh utne hi waqt ke liye gandha khoon ka thakka ban jata hai, phir utne hi waqt ke liye gosht ka ek tukda. Phir Allah ek farishta bhejta hai jise chaar cheezen likhne ka hukum diya jata hai. Use uski (yaani naee takhleeq ki) taqdir (amal), rozi, uski maut (ki tarikh), aur woh Jannat wale honge ya Dozakh wale, yeh likhne ka hukum diya jata hai. Phir usmein rooh phunki jaati hai. Isliye tum mein se koi (neik) amal karta reh sakta hai jab tak uske aur Jannat ke beech sirf ek haath ki doori na rah jaaye, aur phir jo uske liye likha gaya hai woh amal mein aa jata hai, aur woh Dozakh walon jaisa (bura) amal karna shuru kar deta hai. Aur isi tarah tum mein se koi (bura) amal karta reh sakta hai jab tak uske aur Dozakh (ki aag) ke beech sirf ek haath ki doori na rah jaaye, aur phir jo uske liye likha gaya hai woh amal mein aa jata hai, aur woh Jannat walon jaisa amal karna shuru kar deta hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If Allah loves a person, He calls Gabriel saying, 'Allah loves so and-so; O Gabriel! Love him.' Gabriel would love him and make an announcement amongst the inhabitants of the Heaven. 'Allah loves so-and-so, therefore you should love him also,' and so all the inhabitants of the Heaven would love him, and then he is granted the pleasure of the people on the earth
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Agar Allah kisi shaks se mohabbat karta hai, woh Jibreel ko bulata hai aur kehta hai, 'Allah falaan-falaan se mohabbat karta hai; Aye Jibreel! Usse mohabbat karo.' Jibreel usse mohabbat karega aur aasman walon ke beech elaan karega, 'Allah falaan-falaan se mohabbat karta hai, isliye tumhe bhi usse mohabbat karni chahiye,' aur isliye sab aasman wale usse mohabbat karenge, aur phir use zameen walon ki khushi bhi milegi."

e: Narrated `Aisha:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "The angels descend to the clouds and mention this or that matter decreed in the Heaven. The devils listen stealthily to such a matter, come down to inspire the soothsayers with it, and the latter would add to it one-hundred lies of their own
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool ko kehte suna, "Farishte baadlon ki taraf utarte hain aur aasman mein tay kiya gaya falaana-falaana maamla ka zikar karte hain. Shaitan chupke se yeh sunte hain aur neeche aakar jyotishon (soothsayer) ko yeh baat sunaate hain, aur woh log usme apni sau jhooti baaten mila dete hain."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "On every Friday the angels take their stand at every gate of the mosque to write the names of the people chronologically (i.e. according to the time of their arrival for the Friday prayer) and when the Imam sits (on the pulpit) they fold up their scrolls and get ready to listen to the sermon
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Har Jumme ko farishte masjid ke har darwaze par khade hote hain logon ke naam waqt ke hisab se likhne ke liye (yaani unke Jumme ki namaz ke liye aane ke waqt ke hisab se), aur jab Imam (mimbar par) baitha hai, woh apne suchi-patra baandhkar khutba sunne ke liye taiyaar ho jate hain."

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Al-Musaiyab:`Umar came to the Mosque while Hassan was reciting a poem. (`Umar disapproved of that). On that Hassan said, "I used to recite poetry in this very Mosque in the presence of one (i.e. the Prophet (ﷺ) ) who was better than you." Then he turned towards Abu Huraira and said (to him), "I ask you by Allah, did you hear Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying (to me), "Retort on my behalf. O Allah! Support him (i.e. Hassan) with the Holy Spirit?" Abu Huraira said, "Yes
hi: Sa'id bin Al-Musaiyab bataate hain: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) masjid mein aaye jabke Hassan ek kavita padh rahe the. (Umar ko yeh napasand aaya). Isspar Hassan ne kaha, "Main isi masjid mein kavita padhta tha ek aise shaks (yaani Nabi) ki maujoodgi mein jo aapse behtar the." Phir woh Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki taraf mude aur (unse) kaha, "Main aapko Allah ki qasam dekar poochta hoon, kya aapne Allah ke Rasool ko (mujhse) kehte suna, 'Mere taraf se jawab do. Aye Allah! Ise (yaani Hassan ko) Ruh-ul-Qudus (yaani Paak Rooh, Jibreel) se madad de'?" Abu Huraira ne kaha, "Haan."

e: Narrated Al Bara:The Prophet (ﷺ) said to Hassan, "Lampoon them (i.e. the pagans) and Gabriel is with you
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Nabi ne Hassan se kaha, "Unhe (yaani mushrikon ko) taana maar (kavita se), aur Jibreel tumhare saath hai."

e: Narrated Jarir:as below. Narrated Humaid bin Hilal: Anas bin Malik said, "As if I see a cloud of dust swirling up in the lane of Bani Ghanim." Musa added, "That was caused by the procession of Gabriel
hi: Jarir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: (jaisa neeche hai). Humaid bin Hilal bataate hain: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Mano main dhool ka ek baadal dekh raha hoon jo Bani Ghanim ki gali mein uth raha hai." Musa ne joda, "Yeh Jibreel ke jaane se hua tha."

e: Narrated Aisha:Al Harith bin Hisham asked the Prophet, "How does the divine inspiration come to you?" He replied, "In all these ways: The Angel sometimes comes to me with a voice which resembles the sound of a ringing bell, and when this state abandons me, I remember what the Angel has said, and this type of Divine Inspiration is the hardest on me; and sometimes the Angel comes to me in the shape of a man and talks to me, and I understand and remember what he says
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Al-Harith bin Hisham ne Nabi se pucha, "Divine ilham aapke paas kaise aata hai?" Unhone jawab diya, "Sab in tareekon se: Kabhi Farishte mere paas ek aawaz ke saath aate hain jo ghanti ki aawaz jaisi lagti hai, aur jab yeh haalat khatam hoti hai, mujhe yaad rahta hai jo Farishte ne kaha tha, aur yeh Divine ilham ki qisam mere liye sabse mushkil hoti hai; aur kabhi Farishta mere paas ek insaan ki shakal mein aata hai aur mujhse baat karta hai, aur mujhe samajh aata hai aur yaad rahta hai jo woh kahte hain."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Who ever spends a couple (of objects) in Allah's cause, will be called by the Gatekeepers of Paradise who will say, "O so-and-so, come on!" Abu Bakr said, "Such a person will never perish or be miserable' The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I hope you will be among such person
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi ko kehte suna, "Jo bhi Allah ki raah mein do (cheezon ki) jode kharch karta hai, use Jannat ke darbaan bulaenge aur kahenge, 'Aye falaan! Idhar ao!'" Abu Bakr ne kaha, "Aisa shaks kabhi barbaad ya dukhi nahi hoga." Nabi ne kaha, "Mujhe ummeed hai tum bhi aise logon mein se hoge."

e: Narrated Abu Salama:`Aisha said that the Prophet (ﷺ) said to her "O `Aisha' This is Gabriel and he sends his (greetings) salutations to you." `Aisha said, "Salutations (Greetings) to him, and Allah's Mercy and Blessings be on him," and addressing the Prophet (ﷺ) she said, "You see what I don't see
hi: Abu Salama bataate hain: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha ke Nabi ne unse kaha, "Aye Ayesha! Yeh Jibreel hain aur woh aapko apna salaam bhejte hain." Ayesha ne kaha, "Unhe bhi salaam ho, aur Allah ki Rehmat aur Barkaten unpar hon," aur Nabi se mukhatib hote huye kaha, "Aap woh dekhte hain jo main nahi dekhti."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked Gabriel, "Why don't you visit us more often than you do?" Then the following Holy Verse was revealed (in this respect):-- "And we (angels) descend not but by the order of your Lord. To Him belongs what is before us and what is behind us, and what is between those two and your Lord was never forgetful
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Jibreel se pucha, "Aap humse jitni baar milne aate hain usse zyada baar kyun nahi aate?" Isspar yeh paak Ayat nazil hui: "Aur hum (Farishte) sirf tumhare Rab ke hukum se utarte hain. Jo hamare saamne hai, jo hamare peeche hai, aur jo un donon ke beech hai sab uski hi milkiyat hai, aur tumhara Rab kabhi bhulane wala nahi."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Gabriel read the Qur'an to me in one way (i.e. dialect) and I continued asking him to read it in different ways till he read it in seven different ways
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Jibreel ne mujhe Quran ek tareeke se padhaya, aur main unse alag-alag tareekon mein padhane ki guzarish karta raha jab tak unhone mujhe saat alag tareekon mein padhaya."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was the most generous of all the people, and he used to be more generous in the month of Ramadan when Gabriel used to meet him. Gabriel used to meet him every night in Ramadan to study the Holy Qur'an carefully together. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to become more generous than the fast wind when he met Gabriel
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool sab logon mein sabse daani the, aur woh Ramadan ke mahine mein aur zyada daani ho jate the jab Jibreel unse milte the. Jibreel Ramadan mein har raat unse milte the taake Quran ka aapas mein saath-saath motabika (revision) kar sake. Allah ke Rasool tez hawa se bhi zyada daani ho jate jab woh Jibreel se milte.

e: Narrated Ibn Shihab:Once `Umar bin `Abdul `Aziz delayed the `Asr prayer a little. `Urwa said to him, "Gabriel descended and led the prayer in front of the Prophet (ﷺ) " On that `Umar said, "O `Urwa! Be sure of what you say." "Urwa said, "I heard Bashir bin Abi Masud narrating from Ibn Masud who heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, 'Gabriel descended and led me in prayer; and then prayed with him again, and then prayed with him again, and then prayed with him again, and then prayed with him again, counting with his fingers five prayers
hi: Ibn Shihab bataate hain: Ek baar Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdul Aziz ne Asr ki namaz mein thodi deri ki. Urwa ne unse kaha, "Jibreel neeche aaye aur Nabi ke saamne namaz padhaee." Isspar Umar ne kaha, "Aye Urwa! Jo kaho, uski pukhta taasdik karo." Urwa ne kaha, "Maine Bashir bin Abi Mas'ud ko Ibn Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwaayat karte suna jinhone Allah ke Rasool ko kehte suna, 'Jibreel neeche aaye aur meri namaz padhaee; aur phir unke saath namaz padhi, aur phir unke saath namaz padhi, aur phir unke saath namaz padhi, aur phir unke saath namaz padhi,' apni ungliyon par paanch namazon ki ginti karte huye."

e: Narrated Abu Dhar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Gabriel said to me, 'Whoever amongst your followers dies without having worshipped others besides Allah, will enter Paradise (or will not enter the (Hell) Fire)." The Prophet (ﷺ) asked. "Even if he has committed illegal sexual intercourse or theft?" He replied, "Even then
hi: Abu Dharr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Jibreel ne mujhse kaha, 'Tumhare pairokaron mein se jo bhi bina kisi doosre ki ibadat kiye (Allah ke siwa) mar jata hai, woh Jannat mein daakhil hoga (ya Dozakh ki aag mein daakhil nahi hoga).'" Nabi ne pucha, "Chahe usne zina ya chori ki ho?" Unhone jawab diya, "Chahe woh bhi ho."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Angels keep on descending from and ascending to the Heaven in turn, some at night and some by daytime, and all of them assemble together at the time of the Fajr and `Asr prayers. Then those who have stayed with you over-night, ascend unto Allah Who asks them, and He knows the answer better than they, "How have you left My slaves?" They reply, "We have left them praying as we found them praying." If anyone of you says "Amin" (during the Prayer at the end of the recitation of Surat-al-Fatiha), and the angels in Heaven say the same, and the two sayings coincide, all his past sins will be forgiven
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Farishte baari-baari aasman se utarte aur aasman ki taraf chadhte rahte hain, kuch raat ko aur kuch din mein, aur woh sab Fajr aur Asr ki namaz ke waqt ek saath jama hote hain. Phir woh jinhone tumhare saath raat guzari, Allah ki taraf chadhte hain jo unse pucchta hai (aur woh iska jawab unse zyada jaanta hai), 'Tumne mere bandon ko kis haalat mein chhoda?' Woh jawab dete hain, 'Humne unhe namaz padhte hue chhoda jaisa humne unhe namaz padhte hue paaya.'" Agar tum mein se koi "Ameen" kehta hai (Surah Al-Fatiha padhte waqt), aur aasman ke farishte bhi wahi kehte hain, aur donon ke kehne ka waqt mil jata hai, uske sab pichle gunah maaf kiye jaayenge.

e: Narrated `Aisha:I stuffed for the Prophet (ﷺ) a pillow decorated with pictures (of animals) which looked like a Namruqa (i.e. a small cushion). He came and stood between the two doors and his face began to change. I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What did we do wrong?" He said, "What is this pillow?" I said, "I have prepared this pillow for you, so that you may recline on it." He said, "Don't you know that angels do not enter a house wherein there are pictures; and whoever makes a picture will be punished on the Day of Resurrection and will be asked to give life to (what he has created)?
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine Nabi ke liye ek takiya bhara jispar tasveerein (janwaron ki) bani hui thi jo Namruqa (yaani ek chhota cushion) jaisa dikhta tha. Woh aaye aur do darwazon ke beech khade ho gaye aur unka chehra badalna shuru hua. Maine kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Humne kya galat kiya hai?" Unhone kaha, "Yeh takiya kya hai?" Maine kaha, "Maine yeh takiya aapke liye taiyaar kiya hai taake aap ispar tek sakein." Unhone kaha, "Kya tumhe nahi pata ke farishte aise ghar mein daakhil nahi hote jahaan tasveeren hoti hain; aur jo bhi tasveer banata hai, use Qiyamat ke din saza di jaayegi aur usse kaha jaaega ke woh (apni banaee cheez) mein jaan dele?"

e: Narrated Abu Talha:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying; "Angels (of Mercy) do not enter a house wherein there is a dog or a picture of a living creature (a human being or an animal)
hi: Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool ko kehte suna, "(Rehmat ke) Farishte us ghar mein daakhil nahi hote jahaan kutta ya kisi zinda mahluk (insaan ya janwar) ki tasveer ho."

e: Narrated Busr bin Sa`id:That Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani narrated to him something in the presence of Sa`id bin 'Ubaidullah Al- Khaulani who was brought up in the house of Maimuna the wife of the Prophet. Zaid narrated to them that Abu Talha said that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The Angels (of Mercy) do not enter a house wherein there is a picture." Busr said, "Later on Zaid bin Khalid fell ill and we called on him. To our surprise we saw a curtain decorated with pictures in his house. I said to Ubaidullah Al-Khaulani, "Didn't he (i.e. Zaid) tell us about the (prohibition of) pictures?" He said, "But he excepted the embroidery on garments. Didn't you hear him?" I said, "No." He said, "Yes, he did
hi: Busr bin Sa'id bataate hain: Zaid bin Khalid (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Juhani (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne unhe kuch bataya Sa'id bin Ubaidullah Al-Khaulani ki maujoodgi mein, jo Nabi ki biwi Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke ghar mein pala-bada the. Zaid ne unhe bataya ke Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha ke Nabi ne kaha, "(Rehmat ke) Farishte us ghar mein daakhil nahi hote jahaan tasveer ho." Busr ne kaha, "Baad mein Zaid bin Khalid bimar pade aur hum unse milne gaye. Humein hairat hui ke unke ghar mein tasveeron wala ek parda dekha. Maine Ubaidullah Al-Khaulani se kaha, 'Kya unhone (yaani Zaid ne) humein tasveeron ke baare mein nahi bataya tha?' Unhone kaha, 'Magar unhone kapdon par ki hui kadhaee ko chhod diya tha. Kya tumne unhe nahi suna?' Maine kaha, 'Nahi.' Unhone kaha, 'Haan, unhone aisa kaha tha.'"

e: Narrated Salim's father:Once Gabriel promised the Prophet (that he would visit him, but Gabriel did not come) and later on he said, "We, angels, do not enter a house which contains a picture or a dog
hi: Salim ke waalid bataate hain: Ek baar Jibreel ne Nabi se waada kiya (ke woh unse milne aaenge, magar Jibreel nahi aaye), aur baad mein unhone kaha, "Hum, farishte, aise ghar mein daakhil nahi hote jismein tasveer ya kutta ho."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When the Imam, during the prayer, says, "Allah hears him who praises Him', say: 'O Allah! Our Lord! All the praises are for You/, for if the saying of anyone of you coincides with the saying of the angels, his past sins will be forgiven
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Jab Imam, namaz ke dauran, 'Allah use sunta hai jo uski taarif karta hai' kahe, tum kaho: 'Aye Allah! Hamare Rab! Sab taarifen Tere liye hain,' kyunke agar tum mein se kisi ka kehna Farishton ke kehne se milat khata hai, uske sab pichle gunah maaf kiye jaayenge."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "As long as any-one of you is waiting for the prayer, he is considered to be praying actually, and the angels say, 'O Allah! Be merciful to him and forgive him', (and go on saying so) unless he leaves his place of praying or passes wind (i.e. breaks his ablution)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Jab tak tum mein se koi namaz ka intezaar kar raha hai, use as-manvit kiya jata hai ke woh amal mein namaz padh raha hai, aur farishte kehte hain, 'Aye Allah! Uspar reham kar aur use maaf kar,' (aur yehi kahte rehte hain) jab tak woh apni namaz ki jagah na chhode ya (wudu na tode)."

e: Narrated Yali:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) reciting the following Verse on the pulpit: "They will call: O Malik...' and Sufyan said that `Abdullah recited it: 'They will call: O Mali
hi: Ya'la bataate hain: Maine Nabi ko mimbar par yeh Ayat padhte suna: "Woh pukarenge: Aye Malik..." aur Sufyan ne kaha ke Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne ise "Aye Mali" padha (bina "k" ke, ek chhota soorat).

e: Narrated `Aisha:That she asked the Prophet (ﷺ) , 'Have you encountered a day harder than the day of the battle) of Uhud?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Your tribes have troubled me a lot, and the worse trouble was the trouble on the day of 'Aqaba when I presented myself to Ibn `Abd-Yalail bin `Abd-Kulal and he did not respond to my demand. So I departed, overwhelmed with excessive sorrow, and proceeded on, and could not relax till I found myself at Qarnath-Tha-alib where I lifted my head towards the sky to see a cloud shading me unexpectedly. I looked up and saw Gabriel in it. He called me saying, 'Allah has heard your people's saying to you, and what they have replied back to you, Allah has sent the Angel of the Mountains to you so that you may order him to do whatever you wish to these people.' The Angel of the Mountains called and greeted me, and then said, "O Muhammad! Order what you wish. If you like, I will let Al-Akh-Shabain (i.e. two mountains) fall on them." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No but I hope that Allah will let them beget children who will worship Allah Alone, and will worship None besides Him
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Unhone Nabi se pucha, "Kya aapne Uhud ki jung ke din se bhi sakht din dekha hai?" Nabi ne jawab diya, "Tumhare logon ne mujhe bahut takleef di hai, aur sabse bura din Aqaba ka din tha jab maine khud ko Ibn Abd-Yalail bin Abd-Kulal ke saamne pesh kiya aur usne meri maang ka koi jawab nahi diya. Isliye main bahut zyada dukhi hokar nikla, aur mujhe tab tak aaram nahi mila jab tak main khud ko Qarn-Tha'alib mein na paaya jahaan maine apna sar aasman ki taraf uthaya aur ek baadal achanak mujhe chhaya de raha tha. Maine oopar dekha aur usme Jibreel ko dekha. Unhone mujhe pukara aur kaha, 'Allah ne tumhari qaum ki tumhe kahi hui baat sun li hai, aur unhone tumhe jo jawab diya woh bhi. Allah ne tumhare paas pahadon ke Farishte ko bheja hai taake tum unhe hukum de sako jo bhi tum in logon ke saath karna chahte ho.' Pahadon ke Farishte ne pukara aur mujhe salaam kiya, phir kaha, 'Aye Muhammad! Jo chaho hukum kariye. Agar aap chahte ho, main Al-Akh-Shabain (yaani do pahad) unpar gira dunga.'" Nabi ne kaha, "Nahi, magar mujhe ummeed hai Allah unse aise bachche paida karvaega jo akele Allah ki ibadat karenge, aur uske siwa kisi aur ki ibadat nahi karenge."

e: Narrated Abu 'Is-haq-Ash-Shaibani:I asked Zir bin Hubaish regarding the Statement of Allah: "And was at a distance Of but two bowlengths Or (even) nearer; So did (Allah) convey The Inspiration to His slave (Gabriel) and then he (Gabriel) Conveyed (that to Muhammad). (53.9-10) On that, Zir said, "Ibn Mas`ud informed us that the Prophet (ﷺ) had seen Gabriel having 600 wings
hi: Abu Ishaq Ash-Shaibani bataate hain: Maine Zir bin Hubaish se Allah ke is farmaan ke baare mein pucha: "Aur woh do dhanush ki lambaee ki doori par tha, ya usse bhi zyada nazdeek; isliye (Allah ne) apne bande (Jibreel) ko wahi (paighaam) pahunchaya, aur unhone (Jibreel ne) use (Muhammad tak) pahunchaya" (53:9-10). Isspar, Zir ne kaha, "Ibn Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne humein bataya ke Nabi ne Jibreel ko dekha tha jinke chhah sau pankh the."

e: Narrated `Abdullah:Regarding the Verse: "Indeed he (Muhammad) did see. Of the Signs of his Lord, The Greatest!" (53.18) That the Prophet (ﷺ) had seen a green carpet spread all over the horizon of the sky
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Is Ayat ke baare mein: "Beshak unhone (yaani Muhammad ne) apne Rab ki sabse badi Nishaaniyon mein se ek dekhi!" (53:18): Nabi ne ek hari-bhari chataee dekhi thi jo poore aasman ke kshitij mein phaili hui thi.

e: Narrated Aisha:Whoever claimed that (the Prophet) Muhammad saw his Lord, is committing a great fault, for he only saw Gabriel in his genuine shape in which he was created covering the whole horizon
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jisne bhi daava kiya ke (Nabi) Muhammad ne apne Rab ko dekha, woh ek badi galati kar raha hai, kyunke unhone sirf Jibreel ko unki asli shakal mein dekha tha jismein unhe banaya gaya tha, jo poore kshitij ko dhak rahe the.

e: Narrated Masruq:I asked Aisha "What about His Statement:-- "Then he (Gabriel) approached And came closer, And was at a distance Of but two bow-lengths Or (even) nearer?" (53.8-9) She replied, "It was Gabriel who used to come to the Prophet (ﷺ) in the figure of a man, but on that occasion, he came in his actual and real figure and (he was so huge) that he covered the whole horizon
hi: Masruq bataate hain: Maine Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se pucha, "Iske baare mein kya (matlab hai): 'Phir woh (Jibreel) nazdeek aaye aur aur nazdeek, aur do dhanush ki lambaee ki doori par tha, ya usse bhi zyada nazdeek?'" (53:8-9) Unhone jawab diya, "Yeh Jibreel the jo Nabi ke paas ek insaan ki shakal mein aate the, magar us mouke par, woh apni asli aur haqiqi shakal mein aaye aur (woh itne bade the ke) unhone poora kshitij dhak liya."

e: Narrated Samura:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Last night I saw (in a dream) two men coming to me. One of them said, "The person who kindles the fire is Malik, the gate-keeper of the (Hell) Fire, and I am Gabriel, and this is Michael
hi: Samura bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Kal raat maine (khwab mein) do log dekhe mere paas aate huye. Unme se ek ne kaha, 'Jo shaks aag jalane wala hai, woh Malik hai, Dozakh ka darbaan, aur main Jibreel hoon, aur yeh Mikaeel hai.'"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If a husband calls his wife to his bed (i.e. to have sexual relation) and she refuses and causes him to sleep in anger, the angels will curse her till morning
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Agar koi shohar apni biwi ko apne bistar par bulata hai (yaani hambister hone ke liye) aur woh inkaar kar deti hai aur use gusse mein sone par majboor karti hai, farishte subah tak use bad-dua denge."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:that he heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "The Divine Inspiration was delayed for a short period but suddenly, as I was walking. I heard a voice in the sky, and when I looked up towards the sky, to my surprise, I saw the angel who had come to me in the Hira Cave, and he was sitting on a chair in between the sky and the earth. I was so frightened by him that I fell on the ground and came to my family and said (to them), 'Cover me! (with a blanket), cover me!' Then Allah sent the Revelation: "O, You wrapped up (In a blanket)! (Arise and warn! And your Lord magnify And keep pure your garments, And desert the idols)
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Unhone Nabi ko yeh kehte suna, "Divine ilham kuch waqt ke liye ruka raha, magar achanak, jabke main chal raha tha, maine aasman mein ek aawaz suni, aur jab maine upar dekha, hairat se, maine woh Farishta dekha jo mujhe Hira ki gufa mein mile the, aur woh aasman aur zameen ke beech ek kursi par baithe hue the. Main unse itna dar gaya ke main zameen par gir gaya aur apne pariwara ke paas aaya aur (unse) kaha, 'Mujhe dhaak do (kambal se), mujhe dhaak do!' Phir Allah ne yeh wahi bheji: 'Aye tum jo (kambal mein) lipete huye ho! (utho aur chetaao, aur apne Rab ki barhaee karo, aur apne kapde paak rakho, aur buton se door raho).'"

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "On the night of my Ascent to the Heaven, I saw Moses who was a tall brown curlyhaired man as if he was one of the men of Shan'awa tribe, and I saw Jesus, a man of medium height and moderate complexion inclined to the red and white colors and of lank hair. I also saw Malik, the gate-keeper of the (Hell) Fire and Ad-Dajjal amongst the signs which Allah showed me." (The Prophet then recited the Holy Verse): "So be not you in doubt of meeting him' when you met Moses during the night of Mi'raj over the heavens" (32.23) Narrated Anas and Abu Bakra: "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The angels will guard Medina from Ad-Dajjal (who will not be able to enter the city of Medina)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Meri aasman ki chadhaee ki raat, maine Musa ko dekha jo ek lambe, bhure, ghungrale baal wale shaks the, mano woh Shan'awa qabile ke logon mein se ek hon, aur maine Isa ko dekha, darmiyana qad aur darmiyana rang wale shaks jo laal aur safed rang ki taraf jhukaa hua tha aur seedhe baal wale the. Maine Malik ko bhi dekha, Dozakh ka darbaan, aur Dajjal, un Nishaaniyon mein jo Allah ne mujhe dikhaee." (Nabi ne phir yeh paak Ayat padhi): "Isliye tum use (yaani Musa se) milne mein shak mat karo" jab tum Musa se Mi'raj ki raat aasmanon mein mile. (32:23) Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Abu Bakra (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: "Nabi ne kaha, 'Farishte Madina ki Dajjal se hifaazat karenge (jo Madina shehar mein daakhil nahi ho payega).'"

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When anyone of you dies, he will be shown his destination both in the morning and in the evening, and if he belongs to the people of Paradise, he will be shown his place in Paradise, and if he is from the people of Hell, he will be shown his place in Hell
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Jab tum mein se koi mar jata hai, use uska thikaana subah-shaam dikhaya jata hai, aur agar woh Jannat walon mein se hai, use Jannat mein uski jagah dikhaee jaaegi, aur agar woh Dozakh walon mein se hai, use Dozakh mein uski jagah dikhaee jaaegi."

e: Narrated `Imran bin Husain:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I looked at Paradise and found poor people forming the majority of its inhabitants; and I looked at Hell and saw that the majority of its inhabitants were women
hi: Imran bin Husain (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Maine Jannat ki taraf dekha aur paaya ke gareeb log iske zyadatar nivaasi hain; aur maine Dozakh ki taraf dekha aur dekha ke iske zyadatar nivaasi aurten thi."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:While we were in the company of the Prophet, he said, "While I was asleep, I saw myself in Paradise and there I beheld a woman making ablution beside a palace, I asked, To whom does this palace belong? 'They said, To `Umar bin Al-Khattab.' Then I remembered `Umar's Ghaira (concerning women), and so I quickly went away from that palace." (When `Umar heard this from the Prophet), he wept and said, "Do you think it is likely that I feel Ghaira because of you, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jabke hum Nabi ki sohbat mein the, unhone kaha, "Jab main soya hua tha, maine khud ko Jannat mein dekha, aur wahaan maine ek aurat ko ek mahal ke qareeb wudu karte dekha. Maine pucha, 'Yeh mahal kiska hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Umar bin Al-Khattab ka.' Phir mujhe Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki (auraton ke maamle mein) gahri jalan aur ghairat yaad aee, isliye main jaldi se us mahal se door chala gaya." (Jab Umar ne yeh Nabi se suna), woh rone lage aur kaha, "Kya aap sochte hain main aapke baare mein ghairat karunga, Ya Allah ke Rasool?"

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Qais Al-Ash`ari:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A tent (in Paradise) is like a hollow pearl which is thirty miles in height and on every corner of the tent the believer will have a family that cannot be seen by the others." (Narrated Abu `Imran in another narration, "The tent is sixty miles in height)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Qais Al-Ash'ari bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Ek khaima (Jannat mein) ek khokhla moti jaisa hoga jo tees meel ooncha hoga, aur khaime ke har kone mein momin ka ek pariwara hoga jise doosre log nahi dekh sakenge." (Abu Imran, doosre raawi ne ek doosri riwaayat mein kaha, "Khaima saath meel ooncha hai.")

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah said, "I have prepared for My Pious slaves things which have never been seen by an eye, or heard by an ear, or imagined by a human being." If you wish, you can recite this Verse from the Holy Qur'an:--"No soul knows what is kept hidden for them, of joy as a reward for what they used to do
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Allah ne kaha, 'Maine apne neik bandon ke liye woh cheezein taiyaar ki hain jo na kisi aankh ne dekhi, na kisi kaan ne suni, na kisi insaan ne kalpna ki.' Agar tum chaho, tum Quran ki yeh Ayat padh sakte ho: 'Koi rooh nahi jaanti kya unke liye chhupakar rakha gaya hai, unke amalon ke ajr ke soorat mein, khushi ke tor par (jo woh karte the).'"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The first group (of people) who will enter Paradise will be (glittering) like the moon when it is full. They will not spit or blow their noses or relieve nature. Their utensils will be of gold and their combs of gold and silver; in their centers the aloe wood will be used, and their sweat will smell like musk. Everyone of them will have two wives; the marrow of the bones of the wives' legs will be seen through the flesh out of excessive beauty. They ( i.e. the people of Paradise) will neither have differences nor hatred amongst themselves; their hearts will be as if one heart and they will be glorifying Allah in the morning and in the evening
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Sabse pahle giroh (jo logon ka) Jannat mein daakhil hoga, woh purnima ke chaand ki tarah (chamakte hue) hoga. Woh na thookenge, na naak saaf karenge, na hi qaza-e-hajat karenge. Unke bartan sone ke honge, aur unki kanghiyaan sone-chandi ki, unke kendron mein loban (agarbatti) ka istemal hoga, aur unka paseena kasturi jaisa sungega. Har ek ke do biwiyaan hongi; unki biwiyon ki taangon ki haddiyon ka guda itna khoobsurat hoga ke woh gosht se dikhna chahiye. Woh (yaani Jannat wale) na kabhi ikhtilaf karenge na nafrat, unke dil mano ek dil ki tarah honge, aur woh subah-shaam Allah ki tasbeeh karte rahenge."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The first batch (of people) who will enter Paradise will be (glittering) like a full moon; and those who will enter next will be (glittering) like the brightest star. Their hearts will be as if the heart of a single man, for they will have no enmity amongst themselves, and everyone of them shall have two wives, each of whom will be so beautiful, pure and transparent that the marrow of the bones of their legs will be seen through the flesh. They will be glorifying Allah in the morning and evening, and will never fall ill, and they will neither blow their noses, nor spit. Their utensils will be of gold and silver, and their combs will be of gold, and the fuel used in their centers will be the aloeswood, and their sweat will smell like musk
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Sabse pahli toli jo Jannat mein daakhil hogi, purnima ke chaand ki tarah (chamakegi); aur jo agli baar daakhil honge, sabse chamakdar sitare ki tarah honge. Unke dil mano ek insaan ka dil hoga, kyunke unke beech koi dushmani nahi hogi, aur har ek ki do biwiyaan hongi, har ek itni khoobsurat, paak, aur paardarshi ke unki taangon ki haddiyon ka guda gosht se dikhna chahiye. Woh subah-shaam Allah ki tasbeeh karenge, aur kabhi bimar nahi padenge, na naak saaf karenge na thookenge. Unke bartan sona-chandi ke honge, aur unki kanghiyaan sona ki hongi, aur unke kendron mein jalane wala eendhan loban hoga, aur unka paseena kasturi jaisa sungega."

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Verily! 70,000 or 700,000 of my followers will enter Paradise altogether; so that the first and the last amongst them will enter at the same time, and their faces will be glittering like the bright full moon
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Beshak! Mere pairokaron mein se sattar hazaar ya saat laakh log ek saath Jannat mein daakhil honge; isliye unme se sabse pahle aur sabse aakhri log ek hi waqt daakhil honge, aur unke chehre chaudhvin ke chaand ki tarah chamakte honge."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:A silken cloak was presented to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he used to forbid the usage of silk (by men). When the people were fascinated by the cloak. he said, "By Allah in Whose Hands the life of Muhammad is, the handkerchiefs of Sa`d bin Mu`adh in Paradise are better than this
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ke paas resham ka ek choga pesh kiya gaya aur woh (mardon ke liye) resham ke istemal se mana karte the. Jab log us choge se aakarshit hue, unhone kaha, "Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haathon mein Muhammad ki zindagi hai, Jannat mein Sa'd bin Mu'adh ke rumaal is (choge) se behtar hain."

e: Narrated Al-Bara bin Azib:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was given a silken garment, and its beauty and delicacy astonished the people. On that, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "No doubt, the handkerchiefs of Sa`d bin Mu`adh in Paradise are better than this
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ko resham ka ek libaas diya gaya, aur uski khoobsurati aur nazukta logon ko hairat mein daal diya. Isspar Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Beshak, Jannat mein Sa'd bin Mu'adh ke rumaal is (choge) se behtar hain."

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d Al-Saidi:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "A place in Paradise equal to the size of a lash is better than the whole world and whatever is in it
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) As-Saidi bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Jannat mein ek chaabuk jitni jagah bhi poori duniya aur usme jo kuch hai usse behtar hai."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There is a tree in Paradise (which is so big and huge that) if a rider travels in its shade for one hundred years, he would not be able to cross it
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Jannat mein ek darakht hai (jo itna bada aur vishaal hai ke) agar koi sawar uski chhaaye mein sau saal safar kare, woh use paar nahi kar payega."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said "There is a tree in Paradise (which is so big and huge that) a rider could travel in its shade for a hundred years. And if you wish, you can recite:--'In shade long extended..' (56. 30) and a place in Paradise equal to an arrow bow of one of you, is better than (the whole earth) on which the sun rises and sets
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Jannat mein ek darakht hai (jo itna bada aur vishaal hai ke) ek sawar uski chhaaye mein sau saal safar kar sakta hai. Aur agar tum chaho, tum yeh padh sakte ho: 'Lambe faile hue saaye mein...' (56:30) aur Jannat mein tumhare dhanush jitni ek jagah bhi (poori zameen) se behtar hai jispar suraj ugta aur doobta hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The first batch (of people) who will enter Paradise will be (glittering) like the full moon, and the batch next to them will be (glittering) like the most brilliant star in the sky. Their hearts will be as if the heart of a single man, for they will have neither enmity nor jealousy amongst themselves; everyone will have two wives from the houris, (who will be so beautiful, pure and transparent that) the marrow of the bones of their legs will be seen through the bones and the flesh
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Sabse pahli toli jo Jannat mein daakhil hogi, purnima ke chaand ki tarah (chamakegi), aur unke baad wali toli aasman mein sabse chamakdar sitare ki tarah hogi. Unke dil mano ek insaan ka dil hoga, kyunke unke beech na dushmani hogi na jalan; har ek ke do biwiyaan hongi hooron mein se, (jo itna khoobsurat, paak, aur paardarshi hongi ke) unki taangon ki haddiyon ka guda haddiyon aur gosht se dikhna chahiye."

e: Narrated Al-Bara (bin Azib):The Prophet, after the death of his son Ibrahim, said, "There is a wet-nurse for him (i.e. Ibrahim) in Paradise
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne, apne bete Ibrahim ki maut ke baad, kaha, "Unke (yaani Ibrahim ke) liye Jannat mein ek doodh pilane wali maa (dai) hai."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The people of Paradise will look at the dwellers of the lofty mansions (i.e. a superior place in Paradise) in the same way as one looks at a brilliant star far away in the East or in the West on the horizon; all that is because of their superiority over one another (in rewards)." On that the people said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Are these lofty mansions for the prophets which nobody else can reach? The Prophet (ﷺ) replied," No! "By Allah in whose Hands my life is, these are for the men who believed in Allah and also believed in the Apostles
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Jannat wale oonche mahalon (yaani Jannat ki ek oonchi jagah) ke nivaasiyon ko usi tarah dekhenge jaise koi ek chamakdar sitare ko door purab ya pashchim mein kshitij par dekhta hai; yeh sab isliye kyunke unme se ek-doosre par ajr mein superiority (barhta) hogi." Isspar logon ne kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Kya yeh oonche mahal sirf Nabiyon ke liye hain jinke paas koi aur nahi pahunch sakta?" Nabi ne jawab diya, "Nahi! Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haathon mein meri zindagi hai, yeh un logon ke liye hain jo Allah par iman laaye aur Rasoolon par bhi iman laaye."

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Paradise has eight gates, and one of them is called Ar-Raiyan through which none will enter but those who observe fasting
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Jannat ke aath darwaze hain, aur unme se ek Ar-Raiyan kehlata hai jismein sirf woh log daakhil honge jo roza rakhte hain."

e: Narrated Abu Dhar:While the Prophet (ﷺ) was on a journey, he said (regarding the performance of the Zuhr prayer), "Wait till it (i.e. the weather) gets cooler." He said the same again till the shade of the hillocks extended. Then he said, "Delay the (Zuhr) Prayer till it gets cooler, for the severity of heat is from the increase in heat of Hell (fire)
hi: Abu Dharr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jabke Nabi ek safar par the, unhone (Zuhr ki namaz ke baare mein) kaha, "Intezaar karo jab tak (yaani mausam) thanda ho jaaye." Unhone yehi baat dohraee jab tak pahadiyon ki chhaya failne lagi. Phir unhone kaha, "(Zuhr ki) namaz taalo jab tak thanda ho jaaye, kyunke garmi ki sakhti Dozakh (ki aag) ki badh rahi garmi ki wajah se hoti hai."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Delay the (Zuhr) Prayer till it gets cooler, for the severity of heat is from the increase in the heat of Hell (fire)
hi: Abu Saeed bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "(Zuhr ki) namaz taalo jab tak thanda ho jaaye, kyunke garmi ki sakhti Dozakh (ki aag) ki badh rahi garmi ki wajah se hoti hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The (Hell) Fire complained to its Lord saying, 'O my Lord! My different parts eat up each other.' So, He allowed it to take two breaths, one in the winter and the other in summer, and this is the reason for the severe heat and the bitter cold you find (in weather)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Dozakh (ki aag) ne apne Rab se shikaayat ki, kehte huye, 'Aye mere Rab! Mere alag hisse ek-doosre ko khate hain.' Isliye usne use do saans lene ki ijazat di, ek sardi mein aur doosri garmi mein, aur yehi tumhe mausam mein milne wali sakht garmi aur teekhi thand ki wajah hai."

e: Narrated Abu Jamra Ad-Dabi:I used to sit with Ibn `Abbas in Mecca. Once I had a fever and he said (to me), "Cool your fever with Zamzam water, for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: 'It, (the Fever) is from the heat of the (Hell) Fire; so, cool it with water (or Zamzam water)
hi: Abu Jamra Ad-Dabi bataate hain: Main Mecca mein Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath baitha tha. Ek baar mujhe bukhaar aaya aur unhone (mujhse) kaha, "Apne bukhaar ko Zamzam ke paani se thanda karo, kyunke Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: 'Yeh (bukhaar) Dozakh (ki aag) ki garmi se hota hai; isliye ise paani se (ya Zamzam ke paani se) thanda karo.'"

e: Narrated Rafi` bin Khadij:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Fever is from the heat of the (Hell) Fire; so cool it with water
hi: Rafi bin Khadij (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi ko kehte suna, "Bukhaar Dozakh (ki aag) ki garmi se hota hai; isliye ise paani se thanda karo."

e: Narrated Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Fever is from the heat of the (Hell) Fire, so cool it with water
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Bukhaar Dozakh (ki aag) ki garmi se hota hai, isliye ise paani se thanda karo."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Fever is from the heat of the (Hell) Fire; so abate fever with water
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Bukhaar Dozakh (ki aag) ki garmi se hota hai; isliye bukhaar ko paani se kam karo."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Your (ordinary) fire is one of 70 parts of the (Hell) Fire." Someone asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) This (ordinary) fire would have been sufficient (to torture the unbelievers)," Allah's Apostle said, "The (Hell) Fire has 69 parts more than the ordinary (worldly) fire, each part is as hot as this (worldly) fire
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Tumhari (aam duniyavi) aag Dozakh ki aag ke sattar hisso mein se ek hissa hai." Kisi ne pucha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Yeh (duniyavi) aag hi kaafi hoti (kaafiron ko saza dene ke liye)." Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Dozakh ki aag mein duniyavi aag se unsath (69) hisse zyada hain, har hissa isi (duniyavi) aag jitna garam hai."

e: Narrated Yali:That he heard the Prophet (ﷺ) on the pulpit reciting:-- "They will cry: "O Malik!' (43.77) (Malik is the gate-keeper (angel) of the (Hell) Fire
hi: Ya'la bataate hain: Unhone Nabi ko mimbar par yeh padhte suna: "Woh pukarenge: 'Aye Malik!'" (43:77) (Malik Dozakh ka darbaan Farishta hai.)

e: Narrated Abu Wail:Somebody said to Usama, "Will you go to so-and-so (i.e. `Uthman) and talk to him (i.e. advise him regarding ruling the country)?" He said, "You see that I don't talk to him. Really I talk to (advise) him secretly without opening a gate (of affliction), for neither do I want to be the first to open it (i.e. rebellion), nor will I say to a man who is my ruler that he is the best of all the people after I have heard something from Allah's Apostle ." They said, What have you heard him saying? He said, "I have heard him saying, "A man will be brought on the Day of Resurrection and thrown in the (Hell) Fire, so that his intestines will come out, and he will go around like a donkey goes around a millstone. The people of (Hell) Fire will gather around him and say: O so-and-so! What is wrong with you? Didn't you use to order us to do good deeds and forbid us to do bad deeds? He will reply: Yes, I used to order you to do good deeds, but I did not do them myself, and I used to forbid you to do bad deeds, yet I used to do them myself
hi: Abu Wail bataate hain: Kisi ne Usama se kaha, "Kya aap falaan-falaan (yaani Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ)) ke paas jaakar unse baat karenge (yaani unhe desh chalane ke baare mein mashwara denge)?" Unhone kaha, "Tum sochte ho main unse baat nahi karta. Asal mein main unse chupke se baat karta hoon bina koi darwaza (fitne ka) khole, kyunke na main aisa pahla shaks banna chahta hoon jo ise khole (yaani baghavat), na hi main us shaks ko, jo mera hukmaran hai, yeh kahunga ke woh sab logon mein sabse behtar hai jab maine Allah ke Rasool se kuch suna hai." Unhone pucha, "Aapne unhe kya kehte suna hai?" Unhone kaha, "Maine unhe kehte suna, 'Qiyamat ke din ek shaks laaya jaayega aur Dozakh mein daalkar phenka jaayega, taake uski aanten bahar aa jaengi, aur woh chakki ke gird ghumne wale gadhe ki tarah ghumega. Dozakh wale uske aas-paas jama honge aur puchenge: Aye falaan! Tumhe kya hua? Kya tum humein neik amal karne ka hukum aur bure amal se rokne ka hukum nahi dete the? Woh jawab dega: Haan, main tumhe neik amal karne ka hukum deta tha, magar khud woh nahi karta tha, aur main tumhe bure amal se rokta tha, phir bhi khud woh karta tha.'"

e: Narrated `Aisha:Magic was worked on the Prophet (ﷺ) so that he began to fancy that he was doing a thing which he was not actually doing. One day he invoked (Allah) for a long period and then said, "I feel that Allah has inspired me as how to cure myself. Two persons came to me (in my dream) and sat, one by my head and the other by my feet. One of them asked the other, "What is the ailment of this man?" The other replied, 'He has been bewitched" The first asked, 'Who has bewitched him?' The other replied, 'Labid bin Al-A'sam.' The first one asked, 'What material has he used?' The other replied, 'A comb, the hair gathered on it, and the outer skin of the pollen of the male date-palm.' The first asked, 'Where is that?' The other replied, 'It is in the well of Dharwan.' " So, the Prophet (ﷺ) went out towards the well and then returned and said to me on his return, "Its date-palms (the date-palms near the well) are like the heads of the devils." I asked, "Did you take out those things with which the magic was worked?" He said, "No, for I have been cured by Allah and I am afraid that this action may spread evil amongst the people." Later on the well was filled up with earth
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi par jaadu kiya gaya, jiski wajah se unhe lagta ke unhonne koi kaam kiya hai jo asal mein unhonne nahi kiya tha. Ek din unhone lambe waqt tak (Allah se) dua ki aur phir kaha, "Mujhe lagta hai Allah ne mujhe ilham diya hai ke main khud ko kaise theek karun. Do log mere paas aaye (khwab mein) aur baithe, ek mere sar ke paas aur doosra mere paanv ke paas. Unme se ek ne doosre se pucha, 'Is shaks ki bimari kya hai?' Doosre ne jawab diya, 'Ispar jaadu kiya gaya hai.' Pahle ne pucha, 'Kisne ispar jaadu kiya?' Doosre ne jawab diya, 'Labid bin Al-A'sam ne.' Pahle ne pucha, 'Kaunsi cheez istemal ki gaee?' Doosre ne jawab diya, 'Ek kaanghi, usmein bhare hue baal, aur nar khajoor ke phool ka bahar wala chilka.' Pahle ne pucha, 'Yeh kahaan hai?' Doosre ne jawab diya, 'Dharwan ke kue mein.'" Isliye Nabi us kue ki taraf gaye aur phir wapas aaye aur wapasi par mujhse kaha, "Iske khajoor ke darakht shaitanon ke sar jaise dikhte hain." Maine pucha, "Kya aapne woh cheezein nikali jinse jaadu kiya gaya tha?" Unhone kaha, "Nahi, kyunke Allah ne mujhe theek kar diya hai aur mujhe dar hai ke isse logon ke beech buraee faila sakti hai." Baad mein us kue ko mitti se bhar diya gaya.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "During your sleep, Satan knots three knots at the back of the head of each of you, and he breathes the following words at each knot, 'The night is, long, so keep on sleeping,' If that person wakes up and celebrates the praises of Allah, then one knot is undone, and when he performs ablution the second knot is undone, and when he prays, all the knots are undone, and he gets up in the morning lively and in good spirits, otherwise he gets up in low spirits and lethargic
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Tumhari neend ke dauran, Shaitan tum mein se har ek ke sar ke peeche teen gaanthein baandhta hai, aur har gaanth par yeh alfaaz phoonkta hai, 'Raat lambi hai, isliye sote raho.' Agar woh shaks uthe aur Allah ki tasbeeh kare, to ek gaanth khul jaati hai, aur jab woh wudu karta hai, doosri gaanth khul jaati hai, aur jab woh namaz padhta hai, sab gaanthein khul jaati hain, aur woh subah taazgi aur achhe mood mein uthta hai, warna woh sust aur be-man se uthta hai."

e: Narrated `Abdullah:It was mentioned before the Prophet (ﷺ) that there was a man who slept the night till morning (after sunrise). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He is a man in whose ears (or ear) Satan had urinated
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ke saamne zikar hua ke ek shaks tha jo poori raat sota reha, subah tak (suraj nikalne tak). Nabi ne kaha, "Woh aisa shaks hai jiske kaanon mein (ya kaan mein) Shaitan ne peshaab kiya hai."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If anyone of you, when having sexual relation with his wife, say: 'In the name of Allah. O Allah! Protect us from Satan and prevent Satan from approaching our offspring you are going to give us,' and if he begets a child (as a result of that relation) Satan will not harm it
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Agar koi tum mein se, apni biwi ke saath hambister hote waqt, kahe: 'Allah ke naam se. Aye Allah! Humein Shaitan se bachaa aur Shaitan ko humari aane wali aulad se door rakh,' aur agar (uski wajah se) koi bacha paida hota hai (us hambister se), Shaitan use nuksaan nahi pahunchaega."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When the (upper) edge of the sun appears (in the morning), don't perform a prayer till the sun appears in full, and when the lower edge of the sun sets, don't perform a prayer till it sets completely. And you should not seek to pray at sunrise or sunset for the sun rises between two sides of the head of the devil (or Satan)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Jab suraj ka (oopar wala) kinara dikhna shuru ho (subah), namaz mat padho jab tak suraj poora nikal na jaaye, aur jab suraj ka neeche wala kinara doobna shuru ho, namaz mat padho jab tak woh poora doob na jaaye. Aur tumhe suraj ke ugne ya doobne ke waqt namaz padhne ki koshish nahi karni chahiye, kyunke suraj Shaitan ke sar ke do hison ke beech ugta hai."

e: Narrated Abu Said Al-Khudri: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If while you are praying, somebody intends to pass in front of you, prevent him; and should he insist, prevent him again; and if he insists again, fight with him (i.e. prevent him violently e.g. pushing him violently), because such a person is (like) a devil
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Agar tum namaz padh rahe ho aur koi tumhare saamne se guzarna chahta hai, use roko; aur agar woh zid kare, use phir roko; aur agar woh phir zid kare, usse jhagdo (yaani use zor se roko, jaise use dhakka dekar), kyunke aisa shaks Shaitan jaisa hota hai."

e: Narrated Muhammad bin Sirin:Abu Huraira said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) put me in charge of the Zakat of Ramadan (i.e. Zakat-ul-Fitr). Someone came to me and started scooping some of the foodstuff of (Zakat) with both hands. I caught him and told him that I would take him to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." Then Abu Huraira told the whole narration and added "He (i.e. the thief) said, 'Whenever you go to your bed, recite the Verse of "Al-Kursi" (2.255) for then a guardian from Allah will be guarding you, and Satan will not approach you till dawn.' " On that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He told you the truth, though he is a liar, and he (the thief) himself was the Satan
hi: Muhammad bin Sirin bataate hain: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Allah ke Rasool ne mujhe Ramadan ka Zakat (yaani Zakat-ul-Fitr) sambhaale ki zimmedaari di. Koi mere paas aaya aur donon haathon se kuch anaaj khokhalne laga. Maine use pakad liya aur use bataya ke main use Allah ke Rasool ke paas le jaunga." Phir Abu Huraira ne poori kahani sunaee aur joda "Usne (yaani chor ne) kaha, 'Jab bhi tum apne bistar mein jaao, Al-Kursi ki Ayat (2:255) padho, isse Allah ki taraf se ek rakhwala tumhari rakhwali karega, aur Shaitan subah tak tumhare qareeb nahi aaega.'" Isspar Nabi ne kaha, "Usne tumse sach kaha, chahe woh khud jhoota hai, aur woh (yaani chor) khud Shaitan tha."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Satan comes to one of you and says, 'Who created so-and-so? 'till he says, 'Who has created your Lord?' So, when he inspires such a question, one should seek refuge with Allah and give up such thoughts
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Shaitan tum mein se kisi ke paas aata hai aur kehta hai, 'Falaan-falaan ko kisne banaya?' jab tak woh kahe, 'Tumhare Rab ko kisne banaya?' Isliye jab woh aisa sawal khyaal mein daalta hai, use Allah ki panah maangni chahiye aur aise khyalon ko chhod dena chahiye."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When the month of Ramadan comes, the gates of Paradise are opened and the gates of the (Hell) Fire are closed, and the devils are chained
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Jab Ramadan ka mahina aata hai, Jannat ke darwaze khole jate hain aur Dozakh (ki aag) ke darwaze band kiye jate hain, aur Shaitanon ko zanjeeron mein jakad diya jaata hai."

e: Narrated Ubai bin Ka`b:That he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "(The prophet) Moses said to his attendant, "Bring us our early meal' (18.62). The latter said, 'Did you remember when we betook ourselves to the rock? I indeed forgot the fish and none but Satan made me forget to remember it." (18.63) Moses did not feel tired till he had crossed the place which Allah ordered him to go to
hi: Ubai bin Ka'b (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Unhone Allah ke Rasool ko kehte suna, "(Nabi) Musa ne apne saathi se kaha, 'Humara subah ka khaana lao' (18:62). Doosre ne jawab diya, 'Kya aapko yaad hai jab hum us chattan ke paas gaye the? Main sach mein machhli bhool gaya tha aur sirf Shaitan hi mujhe ise yaad rakhne se rok sakta tha.' (18:63) Musa jab tak us jagah ko paar nahi kar liya jahaan Allah ne unhe jane ka hukum diya tha, thake nahi."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) pointing towards the east saying, "Lo! Afflictions will verily emerge hence; afflictions will verily emerge hence where the (side of the head of) Satan appears
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool ko purab ki taraf ishara karte huye dekha, kehte huye, "Sun lo! Fitne zaroor yahaan se uthenge, fitne zaroor yahaan se uthenge, jahaan Shaitan ke sar ka hissa dikhna shuru hota hai."

e: Narrated Jabir:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When night falls, then keep your children close to you, for the devils spread out then. An hour later you can let them free; and close the gates of your house (at night), and mention Allah's Name thereupon, and cover your utensils, and mention Allah's Name thereupon, (and if you don't have something to cover your utensil) you may put across it something (e.g. a piece of wood etc)
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Jab raat hoti hai, apne bachchon ko apne paas rakho, kyunke Shaitan us waqt phailte hain. Ek ghante baad tum unhe aazad chhod sakte ho; aur (raat ko) apne ghar ke darwaze band karo, aur uske saath Allah ka naam lo, aur apne bartan dhaako, aur uske saath Allah ka naam lo, (aur agar tumhare paas bartan dhaakne ke liye kuch nahi hai) tum uspar kuch (jaise lakdi ka tukda) rakh sakte ho."

e: Narrated Safiya bint Huyay:While Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was in I`tikaf, I called on him at night and having had a talk with him, I got up to depart. He got up also to accompany me to my dwelling place, which was then in the house of Usama bin Zaid. Two Ansari men passed by, and when they saw the Prophet (ﷺ) they hastened away. The Prophet said (to them). "Don't hurry! It is Safiya, the daughter of Huyay (i.e. my wife)." They said, "Glorified be Allah! O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! (How dare we suspect you?)" He said, "Satan circulates in the human mind as blood circulates in it, and I was afraid that Satan might throw an evil thought (or something) into your hearts
hi: Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Huyay bataati hain: Jabke Allah ke Rasool I'tikaf mein the, main raat ko unse milne gaee aur unse baat karke, main jane ke liye uthi. Woh bhi mujhe mere rehne ki jagah tak chhodne ke liye uthe, jo us waqt Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke ghar mein thi. Do Ansaari log wahaan se guzre, aur jab unhone Nabi ko dekha, woh jaldi se chale gaye. Nabi ne (unse) kaha, "Jaldi mat karo! Yeh Safiya hain, Huyay ki beti (yaani meri biwi)."
