Unhone kaha, "Subhanallah! Ya Allah ke Rasool! (Hum aappar shak kaise kar sakte hain?)" Unhone kaha, "Shaitan insaan ke dimaag mein isi tarah ghumta hai jaise khoon unme ghumta hai, aur mujhe dar tha ke Shaitan tumhare dilon mein koi bura khyaal (ya kuch) daal de."

e: Narrated Sulaiman bin Surad:While I was sitting in the company of the Prophet, two men abused each other and the face of one of them became red with anger, and his jugular veins swelled (i.e. he became furious). On that the Prophet said, "I know a word, the saying of which will cause him to relax, if he does say it. If he says: 'I seek Refuge with Allah from Satan.' then all his anger will go away." Somebody said to him, "The Prophet has said, 'Seek refuge with Allah from Satan."' The angry man said, "Am I mad?
hi: Sulaiman bin Surad bataate hain: Jabke main Nabi ki sohbat mein baitha tha, do log ek-doosre ko gaali de rahe the aur unme se ek ka chehra gusse se laal ho gaya aur uski gale ki nasen phul gaee (yaani woh bahut gusse mein tha). Isspar Nabi ne kaha, "Main ek aisa lafz jaanta hoon ke agar use kaha jaaye, uska gusa khatam ho jaayega. Agar woh kahe: 'Main Shaitan se Allah ki panah maangta hoon,' to uska sara gusa door ho jaayega." Kisi ne us gusse wale shaks se kaha, "Nabi ne kaha hai, 'Shaitan se Allah ki panah maango.'" Gusse wale shaks ne kaha, "Kya main pagal hoon?"

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If anyone of you, on having sexual relation with his wife, says: 'O Allah! Protect me from Satan, and prevent Satan from approaching the offspring you are going to give me,' and if it happens that the lady conceives a child, Satan will neither harm it nor be given power over it
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Agar koi tum mein se, apni biwi ke saath hambister hote waqt, kahe: 'Aye Allah! Mujhe Shaitan se bachaa, aur Shaitan ko us aulad se door rakh jo tu mujhe dene wala hai,' aur agar us aurat ko garbh ho jaata hai, Shaitan na ise nuksaan pahunchaega na uspar koi taakat paayega."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) offered a prayer, and (after finishing) he said, "Satan came in front of me trying persistently to divert my attention from the prayer, but Allah gave me the strength to over-power him
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne ek namaz padhi, aur (khatam karne ke baad) unhone kaha, "Shaitan mere saamne aaya, mera dhyaan namaz se hatane ki lagatar koshish karte huye, magar Allah ne mujhe uspar kaboo paane ki taakat di."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When the call for the prayer is pronounced, Satan takes to his heels, passing wind with noise, When the call for the prayer is finished, he comes back. And when the Iqama is pronounced, he again takes to his heels, and after its completion, he returns again to interfere between the (praying) person and his heart, saying to him. 'Remember this or that thing.' till the person forgets whether he has offered three or four rak`at: so if one forgets whether he has prayed three or four rak`at, he should perform two prostrations of Sahu (i.e. forgetfulness)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Jab Adhan (namaz ki azaan) ki jaati hai, Shaitan gaas nikalte huye bhaag jata hai. Jab Adhan khatam hoti hai, woh wapas aata hai. Aur jab Iqamat kahi jaati hai, woh phir bhaag jata hai, aur uske khatam hone ke baad, woh phir namaz padhne wale aur uske dil ke beech dakhal dene wapas aata hai, usse kehta hai, 'Yeh ya woh baat yaad karo,' jab tak woh (namaz padhne wala) bhool jata hai kya usne teen ya chaar rakat padhi hai; isliye agar koi bhool jata hai kya usne teen ya chaar rakat padhi hai, use Sahu ke do sajde karne chahiye (yaani bhool ki bharpaee ke sajde)."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When any human being is born. Satan touches him at both sides of the body with his two fingers, except Jesus, the son of Mary, whom Satan tried to touch but failed, for he touched the placenta-cover instead
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Jab bhi koi insaan paida hota hai, Shaitan use apni do ungliyon se jism ke donon taraf chhuta hai, siwaye Isa, Maryam ke bete ke, jinhe Shaitan chhune ki koshish karta magar na-kaamyab raha, kyunke usne (Isa ki jagah) placenta ke aavaran ko chhuya."

e: Narrated Alqama:I went to Sham (and asked. "Who is here?"), The people said, "Abu Ad-Darda." Abu Darda said, "Is the person whom Allah has protected against Satan, (as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said) amongst you". The subnarrator, Mughira said that the person who was given Allah's Refuge through the tongue of the Prophet was `Ammar (bin Yasir)
hi: Alqama bataate hain: Main Sham gaya (aur pucha, "Yahaan kaun hai?"). Logon ne kaha, "Abu Ad-Darda." Abu Darda ne pucha, "Kya woh shaks jise Allah ne Shaitan se mahfooz kiya hai, (jaisa Allah ke Rasool ne kaha), tum mein hai?" Doosre raawi, Al-Mughira ne kaha ke woh shaks jise Nabi ki zubaan se Allah ki panah di gaee thi, woh Ammar (رضی اللہ عنہ) (bin Yasir) the.

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "While the angels talk amidst the clouds about things that are going to happen on earth, the devils hear a word of what they say and pour it in the ears of a soothsayer as one pours something in a bottle, and they add one hundred lies to that (one word)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Farishte baadlon ke beech un baaton ke baare mein baat karte hain jo zameen par hone wali hain, aur Shaitan unke kahe hue lafz mein se ek lafz sunte hain aur use jyotish (soothsayer) ke kaanon mein isi tarah daalte hain jaise koi kisi botal mein kuch daalta hai, aur woh usme sau jhoot mila dete hain."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Yawning is from Satan and if anyone of you yawns, he should check his yawning as much as possible, for if anyone of you (during the act of yawning) should say: 'Ha', Satan will laugh at him
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Jamhaee (yawning) Shaitan ki taraf se hoti hai, aur agar tum mein se koi jamhaee le, use jitna ho sake use rokna chahiye, kyunke agar tum mein se koi (jamhaee lete waqt) 'Ha' kehta hai, Shaitan uspar hasega."

e: Narrated `Aisha:On the day (of the battle) of Uhud when the pagans were defeated, Satan shouted, "O slaves of Allah! Beware of the forces at your back," and on that the Muslims of the front files fought with the Muslims of the back files (thinking they were pagans). Hudhaifa looked back to see his father "Al-Yaman," (being attacked by the Muslims). He shouted, "O Allah's Slaves! My father! My father!" By Allah, they did not stop till they killed him. Hudhaifa said, "May Allah forgive you." `Urwa said that Hudhaifa continued to do good (invoking Allah to forgive the killer of his father till he met Allah (i.e. died)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Uhud ki jung ke din jab mushrik hare, Shaitan chilla, "Aye Allah ke bando! Apni peeth ke pichhe fauj se saavdhaan raho," aur isspar agli safon ke Musalmanon ne pichli safon ke Musalmanon se jung kar di (unhe mushrik samajhkar). Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne mudkar apne waalid "Al-Yaman" ko dekha (Musalmanon dwaara hamla hote hue). Woh chille, "Aye Allah ke bando! Mere waalid! Mere waalid!" Allah ki qasam, woh tab tak nahi ruke jab tak unhone unhe qatl na kar diya. Hudhaifa ne kaha, "Allah tumhe maaf kare." Urwa ne kaha ke Hudhaifa apni maut tak Allah se apne waalid ke qaatil ko maaf karne ki dua karte rahe.

e: Narrated `Aisha:I asked the Prophet (ﷺ) about one's looking here and there during the prayer. He replied, "It is what Satan steals from the prayer of any one of you
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine Nabi se namaz ke dauran idhar-udhar dekhne ke baare mein pucha. Unhone jawab diya, "Yeh woh hai jo Shaitan tum mein se kisi ki namaz se churata hai."

e: Narrated Abu Qatada:as below. Narrated Abu Qatada: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A good dream is from Allah, and a bad or evil dream is from Satan; so if anyone of you has a bad dream of which he gets afraid, he should spit on his left side and should seek Refuge with Allah from its evil, for then it will not harm him
hi: Abu Qatada (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain (jaisa neeche hai). Abu Qatada bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Achha khwab Allah ki taraf se hota hai, aur bura ya bad khwab Shaitan ki taraf se. Isliye agar tum mein se koi bura khwab dekhe jisse use dar lage, use apni baaee taraf thookna chahiye aur uski buraee se Allah ki panah maangni chahiye, phir yeh use nuksaan nahi pahunchaega."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If one says one-hundred times in one day: "None has the right to be worshipped but Allah, the Alone Who has no partners, to Him belongs Dominion and to Him belong all the Praises, and He has power over all things (i.e. Omnipotent)", one will get the reward of manumitting ten slaves, and one-hundred good deeds will be written in his account, and one-hundred bad deeds will be wiped off or erased from his account, and on that day he will be protected from the morning till evening from Satan, and nobody will be superior to him except one who has done more than that which he has done
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Agar koi din mein sau baar kahe: 'Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahi, akela, jiska koi shareek nahi, saari badshahat usi ki hai, aur sab taarifen usi ke liye hain, aur woh har cheez par Qaadir hai,' use das gulamon ko azaad karne jitna ajr milega, aur sau neik amal uske khate mein likhe jaayenge, aur sau bure amal uske khate se hatae ya mitae jaayenge, aur us din woh subah se shaam tak Shaitan se mahfooz rahega, aur koi bhi usse zyada behtar nahi hoga siwaye jisne usse zyada aisa kiya ho."

e: Narrated Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas:Once `Umar asked the leave to see Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in whose company there were some Quraishi women who were talking to him and asking him for more financial support raising their voices. When `Umar asked permission to enter the women got up (quickly) hurrying to screen themselves. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) admitted `Umar, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was smiling, `Umar asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! May Allah keep you in happiness always." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I am astonished at these women who were with me. As soon as they heard your voice, they hastened to screen themselves." `Umar said, "O Allah's Apostle! You have more right to be feared by them." Then he addressed (those women) saying, "O enemies of your own souls! Do you fear me and not Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ?" They replied. "Yes, for you are a fearful and fierce man as compared with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." On that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said (to `Umar), "By Him in Whose Hands my life is, whenever Satan sees you taking a path, he follows a path other than yours
hi: Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Allah ke Rasool se milne ki ijazat maangi, jinki sohbat mein kuch Quraishi aurten unse baat kar rahi thi aur zyada aarthik madad maangti huee apni aawaaz oonchi kar rahi thi. Jab Umar ne andar aane ki ijazat maangi, aurten jaldi se uthkar parde ke peeche chhup gaee. Jab Allah ke Rasool ne Umar ko andar aane diya, Allah ke Rasool muskurate huye baithe the. Umar ne pucha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Allah aapko hamesha khush rakhe." Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Mujhe in auraton par hairat ho rahi hai jo mere paas thi. Jaise hi unhone tumhari aawaaz suni, woh jaldi se parde ke peeche chhup gaee." Umar ne kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Aap unke liye Allah ke Rasool se zyada dar ka paatra hain." Phir unhone (un auraton se) kaha, "Aye apni hi rooh ke dushmano! Kya tum mujhse darti ho aur Allah ke Rasool se nahi?" Unhone jawab diya, "Haan, kyunke aap Allah ke Rasool ke muqaable mein sakht aur karva swabhaav wale insaan hain." Isspar Allah ke Rasool ne (Umar se) kaha, "Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haathon mein meri zindagi hai, jab bhi Shaitan tumhe koi raasta lete dekhta hai, woh tumhare raaste ke ilawa koi doosra raasta apnata hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If anyone of you rouses from sleep and performs the ablution, he should wash his nose by putting water in it and then blowing it out thrice, because Satan has stayed in the upper part of his nose all the night
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Agar koi tum mein se neend se uthkar wudu karta hai, use apni naak mein paani daalkar ise teen baar phoonkar saaf karna chahiye, kyunke Shaitan poori raat uski naak ke oopar wale hisse mein rahta hai."

e: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin `Abdullah bin `Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Sasaa Ansari:That Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri said to his father. "I see you are fond of sheep and the desert, so when you want to pronounce the Adhan, raise your voice with it for whoever will hear the Adhan whether a human being, or a Jinn, or anything else, will bear witness, in favor on the Day of Resurrection." Abu Sa`id added, "I have heard this from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Sasaa Ansari bataate hain: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne apne waalid se kaha, "Main dekhta hoon aapko bhedon aur bayaban (registaan) se lagav hai, isliye jab bhi aap Adhan kahna chahen, apni aawaaz oonchi rakhiye, kyunke jo bhi Adhan sunta hai, chahe woh insaan ho, jinn, ya koi aur mahluk, sab Qiyamat ke din uske haqq mein gawahi denge." Abu Saeed ne joda, "Maine yeh Allah ke Rasool se suna hai."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:That he heard the Prophet (ﷺ) delivering a sermon on the pulpit saying, "Kill snakes and kill Dhu-at- Tufyatain (i.e. a snake with two white lines on its back) and Al-Abtar (i.e. a snake with short or mutilated tail) for they destroy the sight of one's eyes and bring about abortion." (`Abdullah bin `Umar further added): Once while I was chasing a snake in order, to kill it, Abu Lubaba called me saying: "Don't kill it," I said. "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered us to kill snakes." He said, "But later on he prohibited the killing of snakes living in the houses." (Az-Zuhri said. "Such snakes are called Al-Awamir)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Unhone Nabi ko mimbar par khutba dete huye kehte suna, "Saanpon ko qatl karo aur Dhu-at-Tufyatain (yaani ek saanp jiski peeth par do safed lakiraan hoti hain) aur Al-Abtar (yaani choti ya kati hui poonch wala saanp) ko qatl karo, kyunke woh aankhon ki roshni chheen sakte hain aur garbhpaat karva sakte hain." (Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne aage kaha:) Ek baar jab main ek saanp ka picha kar raha tha use qatl karne ke liye, Abu Lubaba ne mujhe bulaya aur kaha, "Ise mat maaro." Maine kaha, "Allah ke Rasool ne humein saanp qatl karne ka hukum diya hai." Unhone kaha, "Magar baad mein unhone gharon mein rehne wale saanpon ko qatl karne se mana kiya." (Az-Zuhri ne kaha, "Aise saanpon ko Al-Awamir kaha jata hai.")

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar (ra):Abu Lubaba and Zaid bin Khattab saw me
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Lubaba aur Zaid bin Khattab ne mujhe dekha.

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id al-Khudri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "There will come a time when the best property of a man will be sheep which he will graze on the tops of mountains and the places where rain falls (i.e. pastures) escaping to protect his religion from afflictions
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Ek waqt aayega jab kisi shaks ki sabse behtareen daulat bhedein hongi jinhe woh pahadon ki chotiyon aur barish ki jagahon (yaani charaagahon) mein charaaga le jaayega, apne deen ko fitnon se bachane ke liye."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The main source of disbelief is in the east. Pride and arrogance are characteristics of the owners of horses and camels, and those bedouins who are busy with their camels and pay no attention to Religion; while modesty and gentleness are the characteristics of the owners of sheep
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Kufr (avishwas) ka mukhya srot purab mein hai. Ghamand aur ghaman ghodon aur unton ke maalikon ke gun hain, aur un dehati logon ke bhi jo apne unton mein masroof rehte hain aur deen par koi dhyaan nahi dete; jabke namrata aur narmi bhed-bakri walon ke gun hain."

e: Narrated `Uqba bin `Umar and Abu Mas`ud:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) pointed with his hand towards Yemen and said, "(True) Belief is Yemenite, towards here (i.e. the Yemenites had True Belief and embraced Islam readily). Certainly sternness and mercilessness are the qualities of those who are loud and at the base of the tails of camels, where the two horns of Satan will appear. Such qualities belong to the tribes of Rabi`a and Mudar
hi: Uqba bin Amir (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Abu Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne apne haath se Yemen ki taraf ishara karte huye kaha, "(Sacha) iman Yemen ki taraf se hai, is taraf (yaani Yemen walon ne aasaani se sacha iman qubool kiya aur Islam apnaya). Beshak, sakhti aur be-rehmi un logon ki khasiyat hain jo unton ki dumon ke qareeb zor se aawaz karte hain, jahaan Shaitan ke do sing dikhte hain. Aisi khasiyat Rabi'a aur Mudar qabilon ki hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When you hear the crowing of roosters, ask for Allah's Blessings for (their crowing indicates that) they have seen an angel. And when you hear the braying of donkeys, seek Refuge with Allah from Satan for (their braying indicates) that they have seen a Satan
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Jab tum murgon ki baang suno, Allah se barkat maango (kyunke unki baang dikhaati hai ke) unhone ek farishta dekha hai. Aur jab tum gadhon ki dahaad suno, Shaitan se Allah ki panah maango (kyunke unki dahaad dikhaati hai) ke unhone ek Shaitan dekha hai."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When night falls (or it is evening), keep your children close to you for the devils spread out at that time. But when an hour of the night elapses, you can let them free. Close the doors and mention the Name of Allah, for Satan does not open a closed door
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Jab raat hoti hai (ya shaam hoti hai), apne bachchon ko apne paas rakho kyunke Shaitan us waqt phailte hain. Magar jab raat ka ek ghanta guzar jaata hai, tum unhe aazad chhod sakte ho. Darwaaze band karo aur Allah ka naam lo, kyunke Shaitan band darwaaza nahi kholta."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A group of Israelites were lost. Nobody knows what they did. But I do not see them except that they were cursed and changed into rats, for if you put the milk of a she-camel in front of a rat, it will not drink it, but if the milk of a sheep is put in front of it, it will drink it." I told this to Ka`b who asked me, "Did you hear it from the Prophet (ﷺ) ?" I said, "Yes." Ka`b asked me the same question several times.; I said to Ka`b. "Do I read the Torah? (i.e. I tell you this from the Prophet)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Bani Israel ka ek giroh kho gaya. Kisi ko nahi pata unka kya hua. Magar mujhe lagta hai unhe laanat mili aur woh chuhon mein badal diye gaye, kyunke agar tum ek chuhe ke saamne untni ka doodh rakho, woh nahi piyega, magar agar bhed ka doodh rakho, woh piyega." Maine yeh baat Ka'b ko bataee, jinhone mujhse pucha, "Kya aapne yeh Nabi se suna?" Maine kaha, "Haan." Ka'b ne mujhse yehi sawal kaee baar pucha. Maine Ka'b se kaha, "Kya main Torah padhta hoon? (yaani main aapko yeh Nabi ki taraf se bata raha hoon)."

e: Narrated Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) called the Salamander, a mischief-doer. I have not heard him ordering that it should be killed. Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas claims that the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered that it should be killed
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi ne chhipkali (salamander) ko fasaad phaila hone wala kaha. Maine unhe kabhi use qatl karne ka hukum dete nahi suna. Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ka daava hai ke Nabi ne use qatl karne ka hukum diya.

e: Narrated Um Sharik:That the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered her to kill Salamanders
hi: Um Sharik bataati hain: Nabi ne unhe chhipkali qatl karne ka hukum diya.

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Kill the snake with two white lines on its back, for it blinds the on-looker and causes abortion
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Us saanp ko qatl karo jiski peeth par do safed lakiraan hoti hain, kyunke woh dekhne wale ko andha kar deta hai aur garbhpaat karva sakta hai."

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered that a short-tailed or mutilated-tailed snake (i.e. Abtar) should be killed, for it blinds the on-looker and causes abortion
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi ne hukum diya ke chhoti ya kati hui poonch wale saanp (yaani Abtar) ko qatl kiya jaaye, kyunke woh dekhne wale ko andha kar deta hai aur garbhpaat karva sakta hai.

e: Narrated Abu Mulaika:Ibn `Umar used to kill snakes, but afterwards he forbade their killing and said, "Once the Prophet (ﷺ) pulled down a wall and saw a cast-off skin of a snake in it. He said, 'Look for the snake. 'They found it and the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Kill it." For this reason I used to kill snakes. Later on I met Abu Lubaba who told me the Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Do not kill snakes except the short-tailed or mutilated-tailed snake with two white lines on its back, for it causes abortion and makes one blind. So kill it
hi: Abu Mulaika bataate hain: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) saanp qatl karte the, magar baad mein unhone inhe qatl karna mana kar diya aur kaha, "Ek baar Nabi ne ek deewaar giraee aur usmein ek saanp ki chhodi hui khaal dekhi. Unhone kaha, 'Saanp ko dhoondo.' Unhone use paaya aur Nabi ne kaha, 'Ise qatl karo.' Isi wajah se main saanp qatl karta tha. Baad mein main Abu Lubaba se mila jinhone mujhe bataya ke Nabi ne kaha, 'Saanp mat qatl karo siwaye choti ya kati hui poonch wale saanp (yaani Abtar) ke jiski peeth par do safed lakiraan hoti hain, kyunke woh garbhpaat karva sakta hai aur andha bhi kar sakta hai. Isliye ise qatl karo.'"

e: Narrated Nafi`:Ibn `Umar used to kill snakes but when Abu Lubaba informed him that the Prophet (ﷺ) had forbidden the killing of snakes living in houses, he gave up killing them
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) saanp qatl karte the magar jab Abu Lubaba ne unhe bataya ke Nabi ne gharon mein rehne wale saanpon ko qatl karne se mana kiya tha, unhone unhe qatl karna chhod diya.

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Five kinds of animals are mischief-doers and can be killed even in the Sanctuary: They are the rat the scorpion, the kite (a type of predatory bird), the crow and the rabid dog
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Paanch tarah ke janwar fasaad phaila dete hain aur unhe Haram (Mecca ki mahfooz jagah) mein bhi qatl kiya ja sakta hai: chuha, bichchu, chil (ek qisam ka shikari pakshi), koa, aur paagal kutta."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "It is not sinful of a person in the state of Ihram to kill any of these five animals: The scorpion, the rat, the rabid dog, the crow and the kite
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Ihram ki haalat mein in paanch janwaron mein se kisi ko qatl karne mein koi gunah nahi hai: bichchu, chuha, paagal kutta, koa, aur chil."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Cover your utensils and tie your water skins, and close your doors and keep your children close to you at night, as the Jinns spread out at such time and snatch things away. When you go to bed, put out your lights, for the mischief-doer (i.e. the rat) may drag away the wick of the candle and burn the dwellers of the house." Ata said, "The devils." (instead of the Jinns)
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Apne bartan dhaako aur apni mashken baandho, aur apne darwaaze band karo aur raat ko apne bachchon ko apne paas rakho, kyunke jin us waqt phailte hain aur cheezein churaa lete hain. Jab tum sote ho, apni roshni bujha do, kyunke fasaad phaila hone wala (yaani chuha) mombatti ki baati khinch sakta hai aur ghar walon ko jala sakta hai." Ata ne kaha, "(Jin ke bajaye) Shaitan."

e: Narrated `Abdullah:Once we were in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in a cave. Surat-al-Mursalat (77) was revealed there, and we were learning it from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . Suddenly a snake came out of its hole and we rushed towards it to kill it, but it hastened and entered its hole before we were able to catch it. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said," It has been saved from your evil and you have been saved from its evil
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar hum Allah ke Rasool ki sohbat mein ek gufa mein the. Surah Al-Mursalat (77) wahaan nazil hui, aur hum use Allah ke Rasool se seekh rahe the. Achanak ek saanp apni bil se nikla aur hum uski taraf daude use qatl karne ke liye, magar woh jaldi se apni bil mein ghus gaya isse pahle ke hum use pakad sakte. Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Yeh tumhari buraee se bach gaya aur tum iski buraee se bach gaye."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A woman entered the (Hell) Fire because of a cat which she had tied, neither giving it food nor setting it free to eat from the vermin of the earth
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Ek aurat Dozakh mein daakhil hui ek billi ki wajah se jise usne baandha hua tha, na use khaana diya na use aazad chhoda zameen ke keechide khaane ke liye."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Once while a prophet amongst the prophets was taking a rest underneath a tree, an ant bit him. He, therefore, ordered that his luggage be taken away from underneath that tree and then ordered that the dwelling place of the ants should be set on fire. Allah sent him a revelation:-- "Wouldn't it have been sufficient to burn a single ant? (that bit you): (See Page 162, chapter No)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Ek baar Nabiyon mein se ek Nabi ek darakht ke neeche aaraam kar rahe the, jab ek chunti ne unhe kaata. Unhone hukum diya ke unka saaman us darakht ke neeche se hata liya jaaye aur phir hukum diya ke chuntiyon ki jagah jalaee jaaye. Allah ne unhe yeh wahi bheji: 'Kya ek akeli chunti ko jalana kaafi na hota? (jisne tumhe kaata).'"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said "If a house fly falls in the drink of anyone of you, he should dip it (in the drink) and take it out, for one of its wings has a disease and the other has the cure for the disease
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Agar makkhi tumhare paani ya khaane mein gir jaaye, use pura doobo do aur phir nikal lo, kyunke uske ek pankh mein bimari hoti hai aur doosre mein uska ilaaj."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "A prostitute was forgiven by Allah, because, passing by a panting dog near a well and seeing that the dog was about to die of thirst, she took off her shoe, and tying it with her head-cover she drew out some water for it. So, Allah forgave her because of that
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Ek beshva aurat ko Allah ne maaf kar diya kyunke woh ek kue ke qareeb se guzari jahaan ek kutta haanfte hue pyaas se maar raha tha. Usne apna joota utaara aur apne sar ke chunre se baandhkar usse kue se paani nikala (aur kutte ko pilaya). Isliye Allah ne use maaf kar diya."

e: Narrated Abu Talha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Angels do not enter a house that has either a dog or a picture in it
hi: Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Farishte us ghar mein daakhil nahi hote jismein kutta ya tasveer ho."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered that the dogs should be killed
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne hukum diya ke kutte qatl kiye jaaen.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If somebody keeps a dog, he loses one Qirat (of the reward) of his good deeds everyday, except if he keeps it for the purpose of agriculture or for the protection of livestock
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Agar koi kutta paalta hai, use har din apne neik amalon ke ajr mein se ek Qirat (yaani hissa) kam hota hai, siwaye jab woh use kheti ke kaam ke liye ya maweshi ki rakhwali ke liye paalta ho."

e: Narrated Sufyan bin Abi Zuhair Ash-Shanai:That he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "If somebody keeps a dog that is neither used for farm work nor for guarding the livestock, he will lose one Qirat (of the reward) of his good deeds everyday
hi: Sufyan bin Abi Zuhair Ash-Shanai bataate hain: Unhone Allah ke Rasool ko kehte suna, "Agar koi kutta paalta hai jo na kheti ke kaam ke liye hai na maweshi ki rakhwali ke liye, use har din apne neik amalon ke ajr mein se ek Qirat kam hota hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah created Adam, making him 60 cubits tall. When He created him, He said to him, "Go and greet that group of angels, and listen to their reply, for it will be your greeting (salutation) and the greeting (salutations of your offspring." So, Adam said (to the angels), As-Salamu Alaikum (i.e. Peace be upon you). The angels said, "As-salamu Alaika wa Rahmatu-l-lahi" (i.e. Peace and Allah's Mercy be upon you). Thus the angels added to Adam's salutation the expression, 'Wa Rahmatu-l-lahi,' Any person who will enter Paradise will resemble Adam (in appearance and figure). People have been decreasing in stature since Adam's creation
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Allah ne Aadam ko banaya, unhe saath hath (cubits) lamba banate huye. Jab usne unhe banaya, usne (unse) kaha, 'Jaao aur us farishton ke giroh ko salaam karo, aur unka jawab suno, kyunke woh tumhari aur tumhari aulad ki salaami hogi.' Isliye Aadam ne (farishton se) kaha, 'As-Salamu Alaikum.' Farishton ne jawab diya, 'As-salamu Alaika wa Rahmatu-l-lahi.' Isi tarah farishton ne Aadam ki salaami mein 'Wa Rahmatu-l-lahi' joda. Koi bhi shaks jo Jannat mein daakhil hoga, Aadam jaisa (aakar mein) hoga. Aadam ke banaye jane ke baad se log kad mein kam hote gaye hain."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The first group of people who will enter Paradise, will be glittering like the full moon and those who will follow them, will glitter like the most brilliant star in the sky. They will not urinate, relieve nature, spit, or have any nasal secretions. Their combs will be of gold, and their sweat will smell like musk. The aloes-wood will be used in their centers. Their wives will be houris. All of them will look alike and will resemble their father Adam (in stature), sixty cubits tall
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Sabse pahli logon ki toli jo Jannat mein daakhil hogi, purnima ke chaand ki tarah (chamakegi) aur unke baad wale log, aasman ke sabse chamakdar sitare ki tarah chamakenge. Woh na peshaab karenge, na qaza-e-hajat, na thookenge, na inke naak se koi sraav hoga. Unki kanghiyaan sona ki hongi, aur unka paseena kasturi jaisa sungega. Loban unke kendron mein istemal hoga. Unki biwiyaan hooren hongi. Sab log ek jaise dikhenge aur apne baap Aadam se milte-julte honge (kad mein), saath hath ooncha."

e: Narrated Zainab bint Abi Salama:Um Salama said, "Um Sulaim said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Allah does not refrain from saying the truth! Is it obligatory for a woman to take a bath after she gets nocturnal discharge?' He said, 'Yes, if she notices the water (i.e. discharge).' Um Salama smiled and said, 'Does a woman get discharge?' Allah's Apostle said. 'Then why does a child resemble (its mother)?
hi: Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Abi Salama bataati hain: Um Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha, "Um Sulaim ne kaha, 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Allah sach kehne se pichhe nahi hatta! Kya aurat ko farz snaan (ghusal) karna chahiye agar use raat mein swapna dosh ho?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan, agar woh paani (yaani daag) dekhe.' Um Salama muskuraee aur kaha, 'Kya aurat ko bhi swapna dosh ho sakta hai?' Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, 'Phir bacha (apni maa se) kyun milta-julta hai?'"

e: Narrated Anas:When `Abdullah bin Salam heard the arrival of the Prophet (ﷺ) at Medina, he came to him and said, "I am going to ask you about three things which nobody knows except a prophet: What is the first portent of the Hour? What will be the first meal taken by the people of Paradise? Why does a child resemble its father, and why does it resemble its maternal uncle" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Gabriel has just now told me of their answers." `Abdullah said, "He (i.e. Gabriel), from amongst all the angels, is the enemy of the Jews." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The first portent of the Hour will be a fire that will bring together the people from the east to the west; the first meal of the people of Paradise will be Extra-lobe (caudate lobe) of fish-liver. As for the resemblance of the child to its parents: If a man has sexual intercourse with his wife and gets discharge first, the child will resemble the father, and if the woman gets discharge first, the child will resemble her." On that `Abdullah bin Salam said, "I testify that you are the Messenger of Allah." `Abdullah bin Salam further said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! The Jews are liars, and if they should come to know about my conversion to Islam before you ask them (about me), they would tell a lie about me." The Jews came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and `Abdullah went inside the house. Allah's Apostle asked (the Jews), "What kind of man is `Abdullah bin Salam amongst you?" They replied, "He is the most learned person amongst us, and the best amongst us, and the son of the best amongst us." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "What do you think if he embraces Islam (will you do as he does)?" The Jews said, "May Allah save him from it." Then `Abdullah bin Salam came out in front of them saying, "I testify that None has the right to be worshipped but Allah and that Muhammad is the Apostle of Allah." Thereupon they said, "He is the evilest among us, and the son of the evilest amongst us," and continued talking badly of him
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Salam (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne suna ke Nabi Madina pahunche hain, woh unke paas aaye aur kaha, "Main aapse teen cheezon ke baare mein puchunga jo koi Nabi ke siwa nahi jaanta: Qiyamat ki sabse pahli nishaani kya hai? Jannat walon ka pahla khaana kya hoga? Bacha apne baap se kyun milta-julta hai, aur maama ke bhai se kyun milta-julta hai?" Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Jibreel ne abhi mujhe inke jawab bataye hain." Abdullah ne kaha, "Woh (yaani Jibreel), sab farishton mein se, Yahudiyon ka dushman hai." Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Qiyamat ki sabse pahli nishaani ek aag hogi jo logon ko purab se pashchim tak jama karegi; Jannat wale ka pahla khaana machhli ke jigar ka ek khaas hissa (Extra-lobe) hoga. Jahaan tak bacche ka apne maa-baap se milte-julte hone ka sawal hai: agar mard apni biwi se hambister hota hai aur uska sraav pahle nikalta hai, bacha baap se milta-julta hoga, aur agar aurat ka sraav pahle nikalta hai, bacha usse milta-julta hoga." Isspar Abdullah bin Salam ne kaha, "Main gawahi deta hoon ke aap Allah ke Rasool hain." Abdullah bin Salam ne joda, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Yahudi jhoote hain, aur agar unhe mere Islam qubool karne ki khabar aapke unse (mere baare mein) puchne se pahle mil gaee, woh mere baare mein jhoot bolenge." Yahudi Allah ke Rasool ke paas aaye aur Abdullah ghar ke andar chala gaya. Allah ke Rasool ne (Yahudiyon se) pucha, "Abdullah bin Salam tum logon mein kaisa shaks hai?" Unhone jawab diya, "Woh humare beech sabse ilm wala hai, aur humare beech sabse behtar hai, aur humare beech sabse behtar ka beta hai." Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Tumhara kya khyaal hai agar woh Islam qubool kar le (kya tum bhi waisa hi karoge)?" Yahudiyon ne kaha, "Allah use isse bachaye." Isspar Abdullah bin Salam unke saamne bahar aaye aur kaha, "Main gawahi deta hoon ke Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahi aur Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain." Isspar unhone kaha, "Woh humare beech sabse bura hai, aur humare beech sabse bure ka beta hai," aur uske baare mein buri baaten kehte rahe.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "But for the Israelis, meat would not decay and but for Eve, wives would never betray their husbands
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Agar Bani Israel na hote, gosht kabhi sadta nahi; aur agar Hawwa (Eve) na hoti, koi biwi apne shohar se kabhi dagabaazi nahi karti."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Apostle said, "Treat women nicely, for a woman is created from a rib, and the most curved portion of the rib is its upper portion, so, if you should try to straighten it, it will break, but if you leave it as it is, it will remain crooked. So treat women nicely
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Aurton ke saath achha suluk karo, kyunke aurat ek pasli se banaee gaee hai, aur pasli ka sabse tirchha hissa uska oopar wala hissa hota hai, isliye agar tum use seedha karne ki koshish karoge, woh tut jaayegi, magar agar tum use usi haalat mein chhod do, woh tirchhi hi rahegi. Isliye aurton ke saath achha suluk karo."

e: Narrated `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), the true and truly inspired said, "(as regards your creation), every one of you is collected in the womb of his mother for the first forty days, and then he becomes a clot for another forty days, and then a piece of flesh for another forty days. Then Allah sends an angel to write four items: He writes his deeds, time of his death, means of his livelihood, and whether he will be wretched or blessed (in religion). Then the soul is breathed into his body. So a man may do deeds characteristic of the people of the (Hell) Fire, so much so that there is only the distance of a cubit between him and it, and then what has been written (by the angel) surpasses, and so he starts doing deeds characteristic of the people of Paradise and enters Paradise. Similarly, a person may do deeds characteristic of the people of Paradise, so much so that there is only the distance of a cubit between him and it, and then what has been written (by the angel) surpasses, and he starts doing deeds of the people of the (Hell) Fire and enters the (Hell) Fire
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool, jo sachche aur sacha ilham paane wale hain, ne kaha, "(Tumhari takhleeq ke baare mein), tum mein se har ek ko apni maa ke garbh mein chaalis din tak joda jata hai, phir woh utne hi waqt ke liye khoon ka thakka ban jata hai, phir utne hi waqt ke liye gosht ka ek tukda. Phir Allah ek farishta bhejta hai jise chaar cheezen likhne ka hukum diya jata hai: woh uske amal, uski maut ka waqt, uski rozi, aur woh Jannat wale honge ya Dozakh wale, yeh likhta hai. Phir usmein rooh phunki jaati hai. Isliye insaan Dozakh walon jaisa amal karta reh sakta hai jab tak uske aur Dozakh ke beech sirf ek haath ki doori na rah jaaye, aur phir jo likha gaya hai woh amal mein aa jata hai, aur woh Jannat walon jaisa amal karna shuru kar deta hai aur Jannat mein daakhil hota hai. Isi tarah, insaan Jannat walon jaisa amal karta reh sakta hai jab tak uske aur Jannat ke beech sirf ek haath ki doori na rah jaaye, aur phir jo likha gaya hai woh amal mein aa jata hai, aur woh Dozakh walon jaisa amal karna shuru kar deta hai aur Dozakh mein daakhil hota hai."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah has appointed an angel in the womb, and the angel says, 'O Lord! A drop of discharge (i.e. of semen), O Lord! a clot, O Lord! a piece of flesh.' And then, if Allah wishes to complete the child's creation, the angel will say. 'O Lord! A male or a female? O Lord! wretched or blessed (in religion)? What will his livelihood be? What will his age be?' The angel writes all this while the child is in the womb of its mother
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Allah ne garbh mein ek farishta muqarrar kiya hai, aur farishta kehta hai, 'Aye Rab! Ek boond (yaani veerya). Aye Rab! Ek thakka. Aye Rab! Gosht ka ek tukda.' Aur phir, agar Allah bacche ki takhleeq poori karna chahta hai, farishta kahega, 'Aye Rab! Ladka ya ladki? Aye Rab! Barbaad ya bakhtavaar? Uski rozi kya hogi? Uski umr kya hogi?' Farishta yeh sab likhta hai jabke bacha apni maa ke garbh mein hota hai."

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah will say to that person of the (Hell) Fire who will receive the least punishment, 'If you had everything on the earth, would you give it as a ransom to free yourself (i.e. save yourself from this Fire)?' He will say, 'Yes.' Then Allah will say, 'While you were in the backbone of Adam, I asked you much less than this, i.e. not to worship others besides Me, but you insisted on worshipping others besides me
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Allah Dozakh wale us shaks se kahega jise sabse kam saza milegi, 'Agar tumhare paas zameen ki har cheez hoti, kya tum use apni azaadi ke fidya ke tor par de dete (yaani is aag se khud ko bachane ke liye)?' Woh kahega, 'Haan.' Phir Allah kahega, 'Jabke tum Aadam ki peeth mein the, maine tumse isse bhi kam maanga tha, yaani mere siwa kisi aur ki ibadat na karna, magar tumne zid ki aur mere siwa doosron ki ibadat ki.'"

e: Narrated `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whenever a person is murdered unjustly, there is a share from the burden of the crime on the first son of Adam for he was the first to start the tradition of murdering
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Jab bhi kisi ko na-haqq qatl kiya jata hai, Aadam ke pahle bete par is gunah ka ek hissa hota hai, kyunke woh sabse pahle shaks the jinhone qatl karne ki riwaj shuru ki."

e: Narrated Aishah (ra):I heard the Prophet (ﷺ), "Souls are like recruited troops: Those who are like qualities are inclined to each other, but those who have dissimilar qualities, differ
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine Nabi ko kehte suna, "Roohaan bharti ki gaee faujon ki tarah hain: Jinme milte-julte gun hain, unmein aakarshan hota hai, magar jinme alag gun hote hain, unme ikhtilaf hota hai."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood amongst the people, glorified and praised Allah as He deserved and then mentioned the Dajjal saying, "I warn you against him (i.e. the Dajjal) and there was no prophet but warned his nation against him. No doubt, Noah warned his nation against him but I tell you about him something of which no prophet told his nation before me. You should know that he is one-eyed, and Allah is not one-eyed
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Allah ke Rasool logon ke beech khade hue, Allah ki jaisi tarif honi chahiye vaisi ki, aur phir Dajjal ka zikar kiya, kehte huye, "Main tumhe usse (yaani Dajjal se) chetata hoon, aur koi bhi Nabi aisa nahi hua jisne apni ummat ko usse chetaaya na ho. Beshak, Nooh ne bhi apni ummat ko usse chetaaya, magar main tumhe ek aisi baat batataa hoon jo kisi Nabi ne apni ummat ko nahi bataee. Tumhe jaanna chahiye ke woh ek aankh wala hai, aur Allah ek aankh wala nahi hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Shall I not tell you about the Dajjal a story of which no prophet told his nation? The Dajjall is one-eyed and will bring with him what will resemble Hell and Paradise, and what he will call Paradise will be actually Hell; so I warn you (against him) as Noah warned his nation against him
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Kya main tumhe Dajjal ke baare mein aisi kahani na sunaun jo kisi Nabi ne apni ummat ko nahi sunaee? Dajjal ek aankh wala hoga aur apne saath Jannat aur Dozakh jaisi cheezein laega, aur jise woh Jannat kahega woh asal mein Dozakh hogi; isliye main tumhe usse chetata hoon jaisa Nooh ne apni ummat ko chetaaya."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Noah and his nation will come (on the Day of Resurrection and Allah will ask (Noah), "Did you convey (the Message)?' He will reply, 'Yes, O my Lord!' Then Allah will ask Noah's nation, 'Did Noah convey My Message to you?' They will reply, 'No, no prophet came to us.' Then Allah will ask Noah, 'Who will stand a witness for you?' He will reply, 'Muhammad and his followers (will stand witness for me).' So, I and my followers will stand as witnesses for him (that he conveyed Allah's Message)." That is, (the interpretation) of the Statement of Allah: "Thus we have made you a just and the best nation that you might be witnesses Over mankind
hi: Abu Saeed bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Nooh aur unki ummat aayenge (Qiyamat ke din) aur Allah (Nooh se) puchega, 'Kya tumne (paighaam) pahunchaya?' Woh jawab denge, 'Haan, Aye mere Rab!' Phir Allah Nooh ki ummat se puchega, 'Kya Nooh ne mera paighaam tumhe pahunchaya?' Woh kahenge, 'Nahi, koi Nabi hamare paas nahi aaya.' Phir Allah Nooh se puchega, 'Tumhare liye kaun gawaah banega?' Woh jawab denge, 'Muhammad aur unke pairokaar (mere liye gawahi denge).' Isliye main aur mere pairokaar unke liye gawahi denge (ke unhone Allah ka paighaam pahunchaya)." Yehi Allah ke is farmaan ki vyaakhya hai: "Isi tarah humne tumhe ek nishpaksh aur behtareen ummat banaya taake tum manav-jaati ke liye gawaah ban sako."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:We were in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) at a banquet and a cooked (mutton) forearm was set before him, and he used to like it. He ate a morsel of it and said, "I will be the chief of all the people on the Day of Resurrection. Do you know how Allah will gather all the first and the last (people) in one level place where an observer will be able to see (all) of them and they will be able to hear the announcer, and the sun will come near to them. Some People will say: Don't you see, in what condition you are and the state to which you have reached? Why don't you look for a person who can intercede for you with your Lord? Some people will say: Appeal to your father, Adam.' They will go to him and say: 'O Adam! You are the father of all mankind, and Allah created you with His Own Hands, and ordered the angels to prostrate for you, and made you live in Paradise. Will you not intercede for us with your Lord? Don't you see in what (miserable) state we are, and to what condition we have reached?' On that Adam will reply, 'My Lord is so angry as He has never been before and will never be in the future; (besides), He forbade me (to eat from) the tree, but I disobeyed (Him), (I am worried about) myself! Myself! Go to somebody else; go to Noah.' They will go to Noah and say; 'O Noah! You are the first amongst the messengers of Allah to the people of the earth, and Allah named you a thankful slave. Don't you see in what a (miserable) state we are and to what condition we have reached? Will you not intercede for us with your Lord? Noah will reply: 'Today my Lord has become so angry as He had never been before and will never be in the future. Myself! Myself! Go to the Prophet (Muhammad). The people will come to me, and I will prostrate myself underneath Allah's Throne. Then I will be addressed: 'O Muhammad! Raise your head; intercede, for your intercession will be accepted, and ask (for anything) for you will be given
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Nabi ki sohbat mein ek dawat mein the aur unke saamne pakka hua (bhed ka) agla paanv rakha gaya, jo unhe pasand tha. Unhone uska ek graas khaya aur kaha, "Qiyamat ke din main sab logon ka sardaar hoonga. Kya tumhe pata hai Allah kaise sab pahle aur baad ke logon ko ek hi maidaan mein jama karega jahaan koi bhi dekhne wala unhe dekh sakega aur koi bhi aawaaz lagane wala unke dwara suna jaayega, aur suraj unke qareeb aa jaayega? Kuch log kahenge: Kya tum nahi dekhte tumhari kya haalat hai aur tum kis haalat mein pahunch gaye ho? Kyun na tum kisi aise shaks ko dhoondo jo tumhare Rab se tumhari sifarish kare? Kuch log kahenge: Apne baap Aadam se guzarish karo.' Woh unke paas jaaenge aur kahenge: 'Aye Aadam! Aap sab insaanon ke baap hain, aur Allah ne aapko apne haathon se banaya, aur farishton ko aapko sajda karne ka hukum diya, aur aapko Jannat mein basaya. Kya aap humare liye apne Rab se sifarish nahi karenge? Kya aap nahi dekhte hum kaisi (dukhi) haalat mein hain, aur hum kis haalat mein pahunch gaye hain?' Isspar Aadam jawab denge, 'Mera Rab aaj itna gusse mein hai jitna woh pahle kabhi nahi tha aur aage kabhi nahi hoga; (iske alaava), usne mujhe darakht (ka phal khaane) se mana kiya tha, magar maine uski na-farmani ki. (Mujhe fikar hai) khud apne baare mein! Khud apne baare mein! Kisi aur ke paas jaao; Nooh ke paas jaao.' Woh Nooh ke paas jaaenge aur kahenge: 'Aye Nooh! Aap zameen ke logon ke liye Allah ke sabse pahle Rasool hain, aur Allah ne aapko 'shukrguzaar banda' kaha. Kya aap nahi dekhte hum kaisi (dukhi) haalat mein hain, aur hum kis haalat mein pahunch gaye hain? Kya aap humare liye apne Rab se sifarish nahi karenge?' Nooh jawab denge, 'Aaj mera Rab itna gusse mein hai jitna woh pahle kabhi nahi tha aur aage kabhi nahi hoga. Khud apne baare mein! Khud apne baare mein! Nabi (Muhammad) ke paas jaao.' Log mere paas aaenge, aur main Allah ke Arsh ke neeche sajda mein gir jaunga. Phir mujhe kaha jaayega: 'Aye Muhammad! Apna sar uthao; sifarish karo, kyunke tumhari sifarish qubool ki jaayegi, aur maango (kuch bhi), kyunke tumhe diya jaayega.'"

e: Narrated `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) recited the following Verse) in the usual tone: 'Fahal-Min-Muddalkir
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne (yeh Ayat) apne aam andaaz mein padhi: "Fahal-Min-Muddakir."

e: Narrated Anas (ra):Abu Dhar (ra) used to say that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "While I was at Makkah, the roof of my house was opened and Jibril descended, opened my chest, and washed it with Zamzam water. Then he brought a golden tray full of wisdom and faith, and having poured its contents into my chest, he closed it. Then he took my hand and ascended with me to the heaven. When Jibril reached the nearest heaven, he said to the gatekeeper of the heaven, 'Open (the gate).' The gatekeeper asked, 'who is it?' Jibril answered, 'Jibril'. He asked, 'Is there anyone with you?' Jibril replied, 'Muhammad (ﷺ) is with me.' He asked, 'Has he been called?', Jibril said, 'Yes'. So, the gate was opened and we went over the nearest heaven, and there we saw a man sitting with Aswida (a large number of people) on his right and Aswida on his left. When he looked towards his right, he laughed and when he looked towards his left he wept. He said (to me), 'Welcome, O pious Prophet and pious son'. I said, 'Who is this man O Jibril?' Jibril replied, 'He is Adam, and the people on his right and left are the souls of his offspring. Those on the right are the people of Paradise, and those on the left are the people of the (Hell) Fire. So, when he looks to the right, he laughs, and when he looks to the left he weeps.' Then Jibril ascended with me till he reached the second heaven and said to the gatekeeper, 'Open (the gate).' The gatekeeper said to him the same as the gatekeeper of the first heaven had said, and he opened the gate." Anas added: Abu Dhar mentioned that the Prophet (ﷺ) met Idris, Musa (Moses), 'Isa (Jesus) and Ibrahim (Abraham) over the heavens, but he did not specify their places (i.e., on which heavens each of them was), but he mentioned that he (the Prophet (ﷺ)) had met Adam on the nearest heaven, and Ibrahim on the sixth. Anas said, "When Jibril and the Prophet (ﷺ) passed by Idris, the latter said, 'Welcome, O pious Prophet and pious brother!' the Prophet (ﷺ) asked, 'Who is he?' Jibril said, 'He is Idris.' " The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "Then I passed by Musa who said, 'Welcome, O pious Prophet and pious brother!' I said, 'Who is he?' Jibril said, 'He is Musa.' Then I passed by 'Isa who said, 'Welcome, O pious Prophet and pious brother!' I said, 'Who is he?' He replied, 'He is 'Isa.' Then I passed by the Prophet (ﷺ) Ibrahim who said, 'Welcome, O pious Prophet and pious son!' I said, 'Who is he?' Jibril replied, 'He is Ibrahim'." Narrated Ibn 'Abbas and Abu Haiyya Al-Ansari: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Then Jibril ascended with me to a place where I heard the creaking of pens." Ibn Hazm and Anas bin Malik state that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah enjoined fifty Salat (prayers) on me. When I returned with this order of Allah, I passed by Musa who asked me, 'What has Allah enjoined on your followers?' I replied, 'He has enjoined fifty Salat (prayers) on them.' On that Musa said to me, 'Go back to your Lord (and appeal for reduction), for your followers will not be able to bear it.' So, I returned to my Lord and asked for some reduction, and He reduced it to half. When I passed by Musa again and informed him about it, he once more said to me, 'Go back to your Lord, for your followers will not be able to bear it.' So, I returned to my Lord similarly as before, and half of it was reduced. I again passed by Musa and he said to me, 'Go back to your Lord, for your followers will not be able to bear it.' I again returned to my Lord and He said, 'These are five (Salat-prayers) and they are all (equal to) fifty (in reward), for My Word does not change.' I returned to Musa, he again told me to return to my Lord (for further reduction) but I said to him 'I feel shy of asking my Lord now.' Then Jibril took me till we reached Sidrat-ul-Muntaha (i.e., lote tree of utmost boundary) which was shrouded in colors indescribable. Then I was admitted into Paradise where I found small tents (made) of pearls and its earth was musk (a kind of perfume)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Dharr (رضی اللہ عنہ) kaha karte the ke Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Jabke main Mecca mein tha, mere ghar ki chhat khuli aur Jibreel neeche aaye, mera seena khola, aur use Zamzam ke paani se dhoya. Phir woh ek sone ki tashtri laaye jo hikmat aur iman se bhari thi, aur uski cheez mere seene mein daalkar, unhone use band kar diya. Phir unhone mera haath pakada aur mujhe lekar aasman ki taraf chadhe. Jab Jibreel sabse qareebi aasman tak pahunche, unhone aasman ke darbaan se kaha, 'Kholo (darwaza).' Darbaan ne pucha, 'Kaun hai?' Jibreel ne jawab diya, 'Jibreel.' Usne pucha, 'Kya koi aapke saath hai?' Jibreel ne kaha, 'Muhammad mere saath hain.' Usne pucha, 'Kya unhe bulaya gaya hai?', Jibreel ne kaha, 'Haan.' Isliye darwaza khola gaya, aur hum sabse qareebi aasman par gaye, aur wahaan humne ek shaks ko baithe dekha, jinke dahine taraf aswida (yaani bahut sare log) the aur baaee taraf bhi aswida. Jab woh apne dahine taraf dekhte, muskurate, aur jab baaee taraf dekhte, rote. Unhone (mujhse) kaha, 'Khush aamdad, Aye neik Nabi aur neik beta.' Maine pucha, 'Yeh kaun hai, Aye Jibreel?' Jibreel ne jawab diya, 'Yeh Aadam hain, aur unke dahine-baaee ke log unki aulad ki roohen hain. Dahine wale Jannat wale hain, aur baaee wale Dozakh wale. Isliye jab woh dahine dekhte hain, muskurate hain, aur jab baaee dekhte hain, rote hain.' Phir Jibreel mujhe lekar doosre aasman tak chadhe aur darbaan se kaha, 'Kholo (darwaza).' Darbaan ne wahi kaha jo pahle aasman ke darbaan ne kaha tha, aur usne darwaza khola." Anas ne joda: Abu Dharr ne bataya ke Nabi ki mulaqaat Idris, Musa, Isa, aur Ibrahim se aasmanon mein huee, magar unhone unke jagahon ki tafseel nahi di (yaani kaunse aasman par kaun the), magar unhone bataya ke Aadam se unki mulaqaat sabse qareebi aasman par hui thi, aur Ibrahim se chhathe par. Anas ne kaha, "Jab Jibreel aur Nabi Idris ke paas se guzre, unhone kaha, 'Khush aamdad, Aye neik Nabi aur neik bhai!' Nabi ne pucha, 'Yeh kaun hain?' Jibreel ne kaha, 'Yeh Idris hain.' " Nabi ne joda, "Phir main Musa ke paas se guzra jinhone kaha, 'Khush aamdad, Aye neik Nabi aur neik bhai!' Maine kaha, 'Yeh kaun hain?' Jibreel ne kaha, 'Yeh Musa hain.' Phir main Isa ke paas se guzra jinhone kaha, 'Khush aamdad, Aye neik Nabi aur neik bhai!' Maine kaha, 'Yeh kaun hain?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Yeh Isa hain.' Phir main Ibrahim ke paas se guzra jinhone kaha, 'Khush aamdad, Aye neik Nabi aur neik beta!' Maine kaha, 'Yeh kaun hain?' Jibreel ne jawab diya, 'Yeh Ibrahim hain.'" Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Abu Haiyya Al-Ansari bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Phir Jibreel mujhe lekar ek aisi jagah gaye jahaan maine kalamon ki khadkhadahat suni." Ibn Hazm aur Anas bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Nabi ne kaha, "Allah ne mujhpar pachaas namazen farz ki. Jab main Allah ke is hukum ke saath wapas aaya, main Musa ke paas se guzra jinhone mujhse pucha, 'Allah ne tumhare pairokaron par kya farz kiya hai?' Maine jawab diya, 'Unpar pachaas namazen farz ki hain.' Isspar Musa ne mujhse kaha, 'Apne Rab ke paas wapas jaao (aur kam karne ki guzarish karo), kyunke tumhare pairokaar iska bojh nahi uthaa sakenge.' Isliye main apne Rab ke paas wapas gaya aur kuch kami maangi, aur usne ise aadha kar diya. Jab main phir Musa ke paas se guzra aur unhe iske baare mein bataya, unhone phir kaha, 'Apne Rab ke paas wapas jaao, kyunke tumhare pairokaar iska bojh nahi uthaa sakenge.' Isliye main apne Rab ke paas wapas gaya jaisa pahle, aur uska aadha aur kam kar diya gaya. Main phir Musa ke paas se guzra aur unhone mujhse kaha, 'Apne Rab ke paas wapas jaao, kyunke tumhare pairokaar iska bojh nahi uthaa sakenge.' Main phir apne Rab ke paas gaya aur usne kaha, 'Yeh paanch (namazen) hain aur woh sab (ajr mein) pachaas ke barabar hain, kyunke mera farmaan nahi badalta.' Main Musa ke paas wapas gaya, unhone phir mujhe wapas jane ko kaha (kami ke liye) magar maine unse kaha 'Ab main apne Rab se maangne mein sharam mahsoos karta hoon.' Phir Jibreel mujhe lekar Sidrat-ul-Muntaha (yaani aakhri seema ka darakht) tak pahunche jo aise rangon mein lipeta hua tha jinhe bayaan nahi kiya ja sakta. Phir mujhe Jannat mein daakhil kiya gaya jahaan maine motiyon ke chhote khaime dekhe aur uski zameen kasturi (ek qisam ki khushbu) ki thi."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I have been made victorious with As-Saba (i.e. an easterly wind) and the people of 'Ad were destroyed by Ad-Dabur (i.e. a westerly wind)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Mujhe As-Saba (yaani purvi hawa) ke zariye fatah di gaee hai, aur Aad qabile ke log Ad-Dabur (yaani pashchimi hawa) ke zariye barbaad kiye gaye."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id:`Ali sent a piece of gold to the Prophet (ﷺ) who distributed it among four persons: Al-Aqra' bin H`Abis Al-Hanzali from the tribe of Mujashi, 'Uyaina bin Badr Al-Fazari, Zaid at-Ta'i who belonged to (the tribe of) Bani Nabhan, and 'Alqama bin Ulatha Al-`Amiri who belonged to (the tribe of) Bani Kilab. So the Quraish and the Ansar became angry and said, "He (i.e. the Prophet, ) gives the chief of Najd and does not give us." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I give them) so as to attract their hearts (to Islam)." Then a man with sunken eyes, prominent cheeks, a raised forehead, a thick beard and a shaven head, came (in front of the Prophet (ﷺ) ) and said, "Be afraid of Allah, O Muhammad!" The Prophet (ﷺ) ' said "Who would obey Allah if I disobeyed Him? (Is it fair that) Allah has trusted all the people of the earth to me while, you do not trust me?" Somebody who, I think was Khalid bin Al-Walid, requested the Prophet (ﷺ) to let him chop that man's head off, but he prevented him. When the man left, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Among the off-spring of this man will be some who will recite the Qur'an but the Qur'an will not reach beyond their throats (i.e. they will recite like parrots and will not understand it nor act on it), and they will renegade from the religion as an arrow goes through the game's body. They will kill the Muslims but will not disturb the idolaters. If I should live up to their time' I will kill them as the people of 'Ad were killed (i.e. I will kill all of them)
hi: Abu Saeed bataate hain: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne Nabi ke paas sona ka ek tukda bheja jise unhone chaar logon mein taqseem kiya: Al-Aqra bin Habis Al-Hanzali (Mujashi qabile se), Uyaina bin Badr Al-Fazari, Zaid at-Ta'i (Bani Nabhan se), aur Alqama bin Ulatha Al-Amiri (Bani Kilab se). Isspar Quraish aur Ansaar naraaj ho gaye aur kaha, "Woh (yaani Nabi) Najd ke sardaron ko dete hain aur humein nahi dete." Nabi ne kaha, "(Main unhe isliye deta hoon) taake unke dil (Islam ki taraf) aakarshit hon." Phir ek shaks aaya, dhaansi aankhon, ubhre hue galon, uthe hue mathe, moti daadhi, aur munde hue sar wala, aur (Nabi se) kaha, "Allah se daro, Aye Muhammad!" Nabi ne kaha, "Agar main uski na-farmani karun, to Allah ki itaaat kaun karega? (Kya yeh sahi hai ke) Allah ne poori duniya ke logon ki zimmedaari mujhpar daali hai, magar tum mujhpar bharosa nahi karte?" Kisi ne, mujhe lagta hai woh Khalid bin Al-Walid the, Nabi se guzarish ki ke unhe us shaks ka sar kaatne diya jaaye, magar unhone unhe roka. Jab woh shaks chala gaya, Nabi ne kaha, "Is shaks ki aulad mein aise log honge jo Quran padhenge magar Quran unke gale se aage nahi jaayega (yaani woh tote ki tarah padhenge bina samajhe ya amal kiye), aur woh deen se aisa nikal jaayenge jaise teer shikaar ke jism se aar-paar nikal jata hai. Woh Musalmanon ko qatl karenge magar mushrikon ko nahi chhedenge. Agar main unke zamane tak zinda raha, main unhe aisa qatl karunga jaise Aad qabile ke log qatl kiye gaye the (yaani main unhe poori tarah barbaad karunga)."

e: Narrated `Abdullah:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) reciting: "Fahal Min Muddakir." (See Hadith No)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi ko yeh padhte suna: "Fahal Min Muddakir." (Dekhen Hadith No.)

e: Narrated Zainab bint Jahsh:That the Prophet (ﷺ) once came to her in a state of fear and said, "None has the right to be worshipped but Allah. Woe unto the Arabs from a danger that has come near. An opening has been made in the wall of Gog and Magog like this," making a circle with his thumb and index finger. Zainab bint Jahsh said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shall we be destroyed even though there are pious persons among us?" He said, "Yes, when the evil persons will increase
hi: Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Jahsh (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ek baar Nabi dar ki haalat mein unke paas aaye aur kaha, "Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahi. Arbon par afsos ho us khatre se jo qareeb aa gaya hai. Yajooj aur Majooj ki deewaar mein ek chhed ho gaya hai, isse jaisa," apni ungli aur angoothe se ek gola banate huye. Zainab bint Jahsh ne kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Kya hum barbaad ho jaayenge chahe humare beech neik log ho?" Unhone kaha, "Haan, jab buraee badh jaaye."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah has made an opening in the wall of the Gog and Magog (people) like this, and he made with his hand (with the help of his fingers)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Allah ne Yajooj aur Majooj (logon) ki deewaar mein aisa chhed kiya hai," aur unhone apne haath se (apni ungliyon ki madad se) yeh dikhaya.

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah will say (on the Day of Resurrection), 'O Adam.' Adam will reply, 'Labbaik wa Sa`daik', and all the good is in Your Hand.' Allah will say: 'Bring out the people of the fire.' Adam will say: 'O Allah! How many are the people of the Fire?' Allah will reply: 'From every one thousand, take out nine-hundred-and ninety-nine.' At that time children will become hoary headed, every pregnant female will have a miscarriage, and one will see mankind as drunken, yet they will not be drunken, but dreadful will be the Wrath of Allah." The companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "O Allah's Apostle! Who is that (excepted) one?" He said, "Rejoice with glad tidings; one person will be from you and one-thousand will be from Gog and Magog." The Prophet (ﷺ) further said, "By Him in Whose Hands my life is, I hope that you will be one-fourth of the people of Paradise." We shouted, "Allahu Akbar!" He added, "I hope that you will be one-third of the people of Paradise." We shouted, "Allahu Akbar!" He said, "I hope that you will be half of the people of Paradise." We shouted, "Allahu Akbar!" He further said, "You (Muslims) (compared with non Muslims) are like a black hair in the skin of a white ox or like a white hair in the skin of a black ox (i.e. your number is very small as compared with theirs)
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Allah kahega (Qiyamat ke din), 'Aye Aadam.' Aadam jawab denge, 'Labbaik wa Sa'daik, aur sab bhalaee Tere haath mein hai.' Allah kahega: 'Dozakh ke logon ko bahar nikalo.' Aadam puchenge: 'Aye Allah! Dozakh ke log kitne hain?' Allah jawab dega: 'Har hazaar mein se, naau sau ninanve nikalo.' Us waqt bachche budhe ho jaenge, har garbhavati aurat ka garbh gir jaayega, aur log nashe mein dikhenge, phir bhi nashe mein nahi honge, magar Allah ka gusa itna bhayaanak hoga." Nabi ke sahaba ne pucha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Woh ek (baki bacha) kaun hoga?" Unhone kaha, "Khush khabar se khush ho jaao; ek shaks tum mein se hoga aur ek hazaar Yajooj aur Majooj mein se." Nabi ne aage kaha, "Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haathon mein meri zindagi hai, mujhe ummeed hai tum Jannat ke logon ka ek-chauthaee hissa hoge." Hum sab ne \"Allahu Akbar!\" chilla. Unhone joda, "Mujhe ummeed hai tum Jannat ke logon ka ek-tihai hissa hoge." Humne phir \"Allahu Akbar!\" chilla. Unhone kaha, "Mujhe ummeed hai tum Jannat ke logon ka aadha hissa hoge." Hum phir \"Allahu Akbar!\" chilla. Unhone aage kaha, "Tum (Musalman) (gair-Musalmanon ki tulna mein) ek safed bail ke jism mein kale baal ki tarah ho, ya ek kale bail ke jism mein safed baal ki tarah (yaani tumhari tadaad unse bahut kam hai)."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You will be gathered (on the Day of Judgment), bare-footed, naked and not circumcised." He then recited:--'As We began the first creation, We, shall repeat it: A Promise We have undertaken: Truly We shall do it.' (21.104) He added, "The first to be dressed on the Day of Resurrection, will be Abraham, and some of my companions will be taken towards the left side (i.e. to the (Hell) Fire), and I will say: 'My companions! My companions!' It will be said: 'They renegade from Islam after you left them.' Then I will say as the Pious slave of Allah (i.e. Jesus) said. 'And I was a witness Over them while I dwelt amongst them. When You took me up You were the Watcher over them, And You are a witness to all things. If You punish them. They are Your slaves And if You forgive them, Verily you, only You are the All-Mighty, the All-Wise
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Tumhe (Qiyamat ke din) nange paanv, nange badan, aur khatna na hue jama kiya jaayega." Phir unhone (yeh Ayat) padhi: "Jaisa humne pahli takhleeq shuru ki, waisa hi hum ise dohraenge: Ek waada jo humne liya hai; sach mein hum aisa karenge." (21:104) Unhone joda, "Qiyamat ke din sabse pahle kapde pahnane wale Ibrahim honge, aur mere kuch sathiyon ko baaee taraf le jaya jaayega (yaani Dozakh ki aag ki taraf), aur main kahunga: 'Mere sathi! Mere sathi!' Kaha jaaega: 'Woh aapke jane ke baad Islam se firte gaye.' Phir main wahi kahunga jo Allah ke neik bande (yaani Isa) ne kaha: 'Aur main unpar gawaah tha jab tak main unke beech tha. Jab tum ne mujhe upar uthaya, tum hi unpar nigaraan the, aur tum har cheez ke gawaah ho. Agar tum unhe saza do, woh tumhare bande hain, aur agar tum unhe maaf kardo, beshak tum hi, sirf tum, Sarvashaktimaan, Sarvagya ho.'"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "On the Day of Resurrection Abraham will meet his father Azar whose face will be dark and covered with dust.(The Prophet Abraham (ﷺ) will say to him): 'Didn't I tell you not to disobey me?' His father will reply: 'Today I will not disobey you.' 'Abraham will say: 'O Lord! You promised me not to disgrace me on the Day of Resurrection; and what will be more disgraceful to me than cursing and dishonoring my father?' Then Allah will say (to him):' 'I have forbidden Paradise for the disbelievers." Then he will be addressed, 'O Abraham! Look! What is underneath your feet?' He will look and there he will see a Dhabh (an animal,) blood-stained, which will be caught by the legs and thrown in the (Hell) Fire
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Qiyamat ke din Ibrahim apne baap Azar se milenge jinka chehra kaala aur dhool se dhaka hoga. (Nabi Ibrahim unse kahega:) 'Kya maine tumse mera kehna na maanne ko nahi kaha tha?' Unke baap jawab denge: 'Aaj main tumhari baat nahi taalunga.' Ibrahim kahenge: 'Aye Rab! Tune mujhse waada kiya tha ke tu mujhe Qiyamat ke din rusva nahi karega; aur mere liye us se zyada rusva karna wali baat kya hogi jab main apne baap ko laanat deta hoon aur unka apman karta hoon?' Phir Allah kahega (unse): 'Maine kaafiron ke liye Jannat haram kar di hai.' Phir unse kaha jaaega, 'Aye Ibrahim! Dekho! Tumhare paanv ke neeche kya hai?' Woh dekhenge aur wahaan ek Dhabh (janwar) dekhenge, khoon se sana hua, jise uske paanv se pakadkar Dozakh mein phenk diya jaayega."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) entered the Ka`ba and found in it the pictures of (Prophet) Abraham and Mary. On that he said' "What is the matter with them ( i.e. Quraish)? They have already heard that angels do not enter a house in which there are pictures; yet this is the picture of Abraham. And why is he depicted as practicing divination by arrows?
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Ka'ba mein daakhil hokar usmein Ibrahim aur Maryam ki tasveeren paaee. Isspar unhone kaha, "Inhe (yaani Quraish ko) kya hua hai? Unhone suna hai ke farishte us ghar mein daakhil nahi hote jismein tasveeren hoti hain; phir bhi yeh Ibrahim ki tasveer hai. Aur unhe teer se qismat dekhne wale (bhaag batane wale) ke soorat mein kyun dikhaya gaya hai?"

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When the Prophet (ﷺ) saw pictures in the Ka`ba, he did not enter it till he ordered them to be erased. When he saw (the pictures of Abraham and Ishmael carrying the arrows of divination, he said, "May Allah curse them (i.e. the Quraish)! By Allah, neither Abraham nor Ishmael practiced divination by arrows
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Nabi ne Ka'ba mein tasveeren dekhi, woh us waqt tak andar daakhil nahi hue jab tak unhone unhe mitane ka hukum na diya. Jab unhone (Ibrahim aur Ismail ki tasveeren) qismat ke teer thame hue dekhi, unhone kaha, "Allah unhe (yaani Quraish ko) laanat kare! Allah ki qasam, na Ibrahim ne na Ismail ne kabhi teer se qismat dekhne ka amal kiya."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The people said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Who is the most honorable amongst the people (in Allah's Sight)?" He said, "The most righteous amongst them." They said, "We do not ask you, about this. " He said, "Then Joseph, Allah's Prophet, the son of Allah's Prophet, The son of Allah's Prophet the son of Allah's Khalil (i.e. Abraham)." They said, "We do not want to ask about this," He said' "Then you want to ask about the descent of the Arabs. Those who were the best in the pre-Islamic period of ignorance will be the best in Islam provided they comprehend the religious knowledge
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Logon ne pucha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Sab logon mein sabse izzatdaar kaun hai (Allah ki nazar mein)?" Unhone kaha, "Unme sabse pakbaz." Unhone kaha, "Hum aapse yeh nahi puchna chahte." Unhone kaha, "Phir Yusuf, Allah ke Nabi, Allah ke Nabi ke bete, jo khud Allah ke Nabi ke bete the, jo khud Allah ke dost (Ibrahim) ke bete the." Unhone kaha, "Hum aapse yeh bhi nahi puchna chahte." Unhone kaha, "Phir tum Arbon ke vansh ke baare mein puchna chahte ho. Jo log Jahiliyat ke daur mein sabse behtar the, woh Islam mein bhi sabse behtar honge, bashart ke unhe deen ka ilm ho jaaye."

e: Narrated Samura:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Two persons came to me at night (in dream) (and took me along with them). We passed by a tall man who was so tall that I was not able to see his head and that person was Abraham
hi: Samura bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Do log raat ko mere paas aaye (khwab mein) (aur mujhe apne saath le gaye). Hum ek lambe shaks ke paas se guzre jo itne lambe the ke main unka sar nahi dekh pa raha tha, aur woh shaks Ibrahim the."

e: Narrated Mujahid:That when the people mentioned before Ibn `Abbas that the Dajjal would have the word Kafir, (i.e. unbeliever) or the letters Kafir (the root of the Arabic verb 'disbelieve') written on his forehead, I heard Ibn `Abbas saying, "I did not hear this, but the Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'If you want to see Abraham, then look at your companion (i.e. the Prophet) but Moses was a curly-haired, brown man (who used to ride) a red camel, the reins of which was made of fibres of date-palms. As if I were now looking down a valley
hi: Mujahid bataate hain: Jab logon ne Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saamne zikar kiya ke Dajjal ke mathe par \"Kafir\" (yaani avishwasi) lafz likha hoga, maine Ibn Abbas ko kehte suna, "Maine yeh nahi suna, magar Nabi ne kaha, 'Agar tum Ibrahim ko dekhna chahte ho, apne sathi (yaani Nabi) ko dekho, magar Musa ek ghungrale baal wale, bhure rang wale shaks the (jo sawari karte the) ek laal unt par jiski lagaam khajoor ke reson se bani thi. Mano abhi bhi main ek waadi ki taraf neeche dekh raha hoon (unhe dekhte huye).'"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Abraham did his circumcision with an adze* at the age of eighty." Narrated Abu Az-Zinad: (as above) With an adze*. * a type of curved blade axe
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Ibrahim ne aathvar saal ki umr mein apna khatna ek kulhadi jaise auzaar se kiya." Abu Az-Zinad bataate hain (jaisa upar hai): ek kulhadi jaise auzaar se.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Abraham did not tell a lie except on three occasions
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Ibrahim ne sirf teen mauqon par jhoot bola."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Abraham did not tell a lie except on three occasion. Twice for the Sake of Allah when he said, "I am sick," and he said, "(I have not done this but) the big idol has done it." The (third was) that while Abraham and Sarah (his wife) were going (on a journey) they passed by (the territory of) a tyrant. Someone said to the tyrant, "This man (i.e. Abraham) is accompanied by a very charming lady." So, he sent for Abraham and asked him about Sarah saying, "Who is this lady?" Abraham said, "She is my sister." Abraham went to Sarah and said, "O Sarah! There are no believers on the surface of the earth except you and I. This man asked me about you and I have told him that you are my sister, so don't contradict my statement." The tyrant then called Sarah and when she went to him, he tried to take hold of her with his hand, but (his hand got stiff and) he was confounded. He asked Sarah. "Pray to Allah for me, and I shall not harm you." So Sarah asked Allah to cure him and he got cured. He tried to take hold of her for the second time, but (his hand got as stiff as or stiffer than before and) was more confounded. He again requested Sarah, "Pray to Allah for me, and I will not harm you." Sarah asked Allah again and he became alright. He then called one of his guards (who had brought her) and said, "You have not brought me a human being but have brought me a devil." The tyrant then gave Hajar as a girl-servant to Sarah. Sarah came back (to Abraham) while he was praying. Abraham, gesturing with his hand, asked, "What has happened?" She replied, "Allah has spoiled the evil plot of the infidel (or immoral person) and gave me Hajar for service." (Abu Huraira then addressed his listeners saying, "That (Hajar) was your mother, O Bani Ma-is-Sama (i.e. the Arabs, the descendants of Ishmael, Hajar's son)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ibrahim ne sirf teen mauqon par jhoot bola. Do baar Allah ki khaatir jab unhone kaha, "Main bimar hoon," aur unhone kaha, "(Maine yeh nahi kiya, balki) bada but ne kiya." (Teesra) yeh tha ke jab Ibrahim aur Sarah (unki biwi) safar kar rahe the, woh ek zaalim hukmaran ke ilake se guzre. Kisi ne zaalim se kaha, "Is shaks (yaani Ibrahim) ke saath ek bahut khoobsurat khaatun hai." Isliye usne Ibrahim ko bulaya aur Sarah ke baare mein pucha, "Yeh khaatun kaun hai?" Ibrahim ne kaha, "Yeh meri behn hai." Ibrahim Sarah ke paas gaye aur kaha, "Aye Sarah! Is zameen par tumhare aur mere siwa koi momin nahi. Is shaks ne mujhse tumhare baare mein pucha aur maine use bataya ke tum meri behn ho, isliye mera bayaan mat todna." Zaalim ne phir Sarah ko bulaya, aur jab woh uske paas gaee, usne apne haath se unhe pakadne ki koshish ki, magar (uska haath jaam ho gaya aur) woh hairat mein pad gaya. Usne Sarah se kaha, "Mere liye Allah se dua karo, aur main tumhe nuksaan nahi pahunchaunga." Isliye Sarah ne unke liye Allah se dua ki aur woh theek ho gaye. Usne doosri baar unhe pakadne ki koshish ki, magar (unka haath pahle se bhi zyada jaam ho gaya aur) woh aur zyada hairat mein pad gaya. Usne phir Sarah se woh guzarish dohraee, "Mere liye Allah se dua karo, aur main tumhe nuksaan nahi pahunchaunga." Sarah ne phir Allah se dua ki aur woh theek ho gaya. Phir usne apne ek pahredaar (jo unhe laaya tha) ko bulaya aur kaha, "Tum meri paas koi insaan nahi laaye, balki ek Shaitan laaye ho." Phir zaalim ne Hajar ko Sarah ki khidmat ke liye di. Sarah wapas aee (Ibrahim ke paas) jabke woh namaz padh rahe the. Ibrahim ne apne haath se ishara karte huye pucha, "Kya hua?" Usne jawab diya, "Allah ne us kaafir (ya be-imaan) shaks ki bad-niyyati ko nakaam kar diya, aur mujhe khidmatgaari ke liye Hajar di." (Abu Huraira ne phir apne srotaon se kaha, "Woh (yaani Hajar) tumhari maa thi, Aye Bani Ma-is-Sama (yaani Arab, Ismail, Hajar ke bete, ki aulad).")

e: Narrated Um Sharik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered that the salamander should be killed and said, "It (i.e. the salamander) blew (the fire) on Abraham
hi: Um Sharik bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool ne hukum diya ke chhipkali ko qatl kiya jaaye aur kaha, "Isne (yaani chhipkali ne) Ibrahim par (aag) phoonki thi."

e: Narrated `Abdullah:When the Verse:--"It is those who believe and do not confuse their belief with wrong ( i.e. joining others in worship with Allah" (6.83) was revealed, we said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Who is there amongst us who has not done wrong to himself?" He replied, "It is not as you say, for 'wrong' in the Verse and 'do not confuse their belief, with wrong means 'SHIRK' (i.e. joining others in worship with Allah). Haven't you heard Luqman's saying to his son, 'O my son! Join not others in worship with Allah, verily joining others in worship with Allah is a great wrong indeed
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab yeh Ayat nazil hui: "Woh log jo iman laaye aur apne iman ko galat na-insaafi (yaani Allah ke saath shareek karne) se milate nahi..." (6:83), humne kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Humme se kaun aisa hai jisne khud par koi na-insaafi nahi ki?" Unhone jawab diya, "Yeh waisa nahi hai jaisa tum kehte ho, kyunke is Ayat mein 'na-insaafi' aur 'apne iman ko na-insaafi se milate nahi' ka matlab Shirk hai (yaani Allah ke saath kisi aur ki ibadat mein shareek karna). Kya tumne Luqman ke apne bete se kahe hue lafz nahi sune hain, 'Aye mere bete! Allah ke saath kisi ko na jodo, kyunke Allah ke saath shareek karna beshak ek badi na-insaafi hai.'"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:One day some meat was given to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he said, "On the Day of Resurrection Allah will gather all the first and the last (people) in one plain, and the voice of the announcer will reach all of them, and one will be able to see them all, and the sun will come closer to them." (The narrator then mentioned the narration of intercession): "The people will go to Abraham and say: 'You are Allah's Prophet and His Khalil on the earth. Will you intercede for us with your Lord?' Abraham will then remember his lies and say: 'Myself! Myself! Go to Moses
