hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek din Nabi ko kuch gosht diya gaya aur unhone kaha, "Qiyamat ke din, Allah sab pahle aur baad ke logon ko ek hi maidaan mein jama karega, aur elaan karne wale ki aawaaz sabtak pahunchegi, aur koi bhi dekhne wala sabko dekh sakega, aur suraj unke qareeb aa jaayega." (Raawi ne phir sifarish ki riwaayat ka zikar kiya): "Log Ibrahim ke paas jaayenge aur kahenge: 'Aap Allah ke Nabi hain aur zameen par uske Khalil. Kya aap humare liye apne Rab se sifarish nahi karenge?' Ibrahim phir apne jhooth yaad karenge aur kahega: 'Khud apne baare mein! Khud apne baare mein! Musa ke paas jaao.'"

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "May Allah bestow His Mercy on the mother of Ishmael! Had she not hastened (to fill her water-skin with water from the Zamzam well). Zamzam would have been a stream flowing on the surface of the earth." Ibn `Abbas further added, "(The Prophet) Abraham brought Ishmael and his mother (to Mecca) and she was suckling Ishmael and she had a water-skin with her
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Allah Ismail ki maa par reham kare! Agar usne jaldbaazi na dikhaee hoti (Zamzam ke kue ka paani apni mashk mein bharne ke liye), Zamzam zameen ki satah mein behta hua ek jaraa hota." Ibn Abbas ne joda, "(Nabi) Ibrahim Ismail aur unki maa ko (Mecca) laaye, aur woh Ismail ko doodh pila rahi thi, aur unke paas ek mashk paani thi."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The first lady to use a girdle was the mother of Ishmael. She used a girdle so that she might hide her tracks from Sarah. Abraham brought her and her son Ishmael while she was suckling him, to a place near the Ka`ba under a tree on the spot of Zamzam, at the highest place in the mosque. During those days there was nobody in Mecca, nor was there any water So he made them sit over there and placed near them a leather bag containing some dates, and a small water-skin containing some water, and set out homeward. Ishmael's mother followed him saying, "O Abraham! Where are you going, leaving us in this valley where there is no person whose company we may enjoy, nor is there anything (to enjoy)?" She repeated that to him many times, but he did not look back at her Then she asked him, "Has Allah ordered you to do so?" He said, "Yes." She said, "Then He will not neglect us," and returned while Abraham proceeded onwards, and on reaching the Thaniya where they could not see him, he faced the Ka`ba, and raising both hands, invoked Allah saying the following prayers: 'O our Lord! I have made some of my offspring dwell in a valley without cultivation, by Your Sacred House (Ka`ba at Mecca) in order, O our Lord, that they may offer prayer perfectly. So fill some hearts among men with love towards them, and (O Allah) provide them with fruits, so that they may give thanks.' (14.37) Ishmael's mother went on suckling Ishmael and drinking from the water (she had). When the water in the water-skin had all been used up, she became thirsty and her child also became thirsty. She started looking at him (i.e. Ishmael) tossing in agony; She left him, for she could not endure looking at him, and found that the mountain of Safa was the nearest mountain to her on that land. She stood on it and started looking at the valley keenly so that she might see somebody, but she could not see anybody. Then she descended from Safa and when she reached the valley, she tucked up her robe and ran in the valley like a person in distress and trouble, till she crossed the valley and reached the Marwa mountain where she stood and started looking, expecting to see somebody, but she could not see anybody. She repeated that (running between Safa and Marwa) seven times." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "This is the source of the tradition of the walking of people between them (i.e. Safa and Marwa). When she reached the Marwa (for the last time) she heard a voice and she asked herself to be quiet and listened attentively. She heard the voice again and said, 'O, (whoever you may be)! You have made me hear your voice; have you got something to help me?" And behold! She saw an angel at the place of Zamzam, digging the earth with his heel (or his wing), till water flowed from that place. She started to make something like a basin around it, using her hand in this way, and started filling her water-skin with water with her hands, and the water was flowing out after she had scooped some of it." The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "May Allah bestow Mercy on Ishmael's mother! Had she let the Zamzam (flow without trying to control it) (or had she not scooped from that water) (to fill her water-skin), Zamzam would have been a stream flowing on the surface of the earth." The Prophet (ﷺ) further added, "Then she drank (water) and suckled her child. The angel said to her, 'Don't be afraid of being neglected, for this is the House of Allah which will be built by this boy and his father, and Allah never neglects His people.' The House (i.e. Ka`ba) at that time was on a high place resembling a hillock, and when torrents came, they flowed to its right and left. She lived in that way till some people from the tribe of Jurhum or a family from Jurhum passed by her and her child, as they (i.e. the Jurhum people) were coming through the way of Kada'. They landed in the lower part of Mecca where they saw a bird that had the habit of flying around water and not leaving it. They said, 'This bird must be flying around water, though we know that there is no water in this valley.' They sent one or two messengers who discovered the source of water, and returned to inform them of the water. So, they all came (towards the water)." The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "Ishmael's mother was sitting near the water. They asked her, 'Do you allow us to stay with you?" She replied, 'Yes, but you will have no right to possess the water.' They agreed to that." The Prophet (ﷺ) further said, "Ishmael's mother was pleased with the whole situation as she used to love to enjoy the company of the people. So, they settled there, and later on they sent for their families who came and settled with them so that some families became permanent residents there. The child (i.e. Ishmael) grew up and learnt Arabic from them and (his virtues) caused them to love and admire him as he grew up, and when he reached the age of puberty they made him marry a woman from amongst them. After Ishmael's mother had died, Abraham came after Ishmael's marriage in order to see his family that he had left before, but he did not find Ishmael there. When he asked Ishmael's wife about him, she replied, 'He has gone in search of our livelihood.' Then he asked her about their way of living and their condition, and she replied, 'We are living in misery; we are living in hardship and destitution,' complaining to him. He said, 'When your husband returns, convey my salutation to him and tell him to change the threshold of the gate (of his house).' When Ishmael came, he seemed to have felt something unusual, so he asked his wife, 'Has anyone visited you?' She replied, 'Yes, an old man of so-and-so description came and asked me about you and I informed him, and he asked about our state of living, and I told him that we were living in hardship and poverty.' On that Ishmael said, 'Did he advise you anything?' She replied, 'Yes, he told me to convey his salutation to you and to tell you to change the threshold of your gate.' Ishmael said, 'It was my father, and he has ordered me to divorce you. Go back to your family.' So, Ishmael divorced her and married another woman from amongst them (i.e. Jurhum). Then Abraham stayed away from them for a period as long as Allah wished and called on them again but did not find Ishmael. So he came to Ishmael's wife and asked her about Ishmael. She said, 'He has gone in search of our livelihood.' Abraham asked her, 'How are you getting on?' asking her about their sustenance and living. She replied, 'We are prosperous and well-off (i.e. we have everything in abundance).' Then she thanked Allah' Abraham said, 'What kind of food do you eat?' She said, 'Meat.' He said, 'What do you drink?' She said, 'Water." He said, "O Allah! Bless their meat and water." The Prophet added, "At that time they did not have grain, and if they had grain, he would have also invoked Allah to bless it." The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "If somebody has only these two things as his sustenance, his health and disposition will be badly affected, unless he lives in Mecca." The Prophet (ﷺ) added," Then Abraham said to Ishmael's wife, "When your husband comes, give my regards to him and tell him that he should keep firm the threshold of his gate.' When Ishmael came back, he asked his wife, 'Did anyone call on you?' She replied, 'Yes, a good-looking old man came to me,' so she praised him and added, 'He asked about you, and I informed him, and he asked about our livelihood and I told him that we were in a good condition.' Ishmael asked her, 'Did he give you any piece of advice?' She said, 'Yes, he told me to give his regards to you and ordered that you should keep firm the threshold of your gate.' On that Ishmael said, 'It was my father, and you are the threshold (of the gate). He has ordered me to keep you with me.' Then Abraham stayed away from them for a period as long as Allah wished, and called on them afterwards. He saw Ishmael under a tree near Zamzam, sharpening his arrows. When he saw Abraham, he rose up to welcome him (and they greeted each other as a father does with his son or a son does with his father). Abraham said, 'O Ishmael! Allah has given me an order.' Ishmael said, 'Do what your Lord has ordered you to do.' Abraham asked, 'Will you help me?' Ishmael said, 'I will help you.' Abraham said, Allah has ordered me to build a house here,' pointing to a hillock higher than the land surrounding it." The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "Then they raised the foundations of the House (i.e. the Ka`ba). Ishmael brought the stones and Abraham was building, and when the walls became high, Ishmael brought this stone and put it for Abraham who stood over it and carried on building, while Ishmael was handing him the stones, and both of them were saying, 'O our Lord! Accept (this service) from us, Verily, You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.' The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "Then both of them went on building and going round the Ka`ba saying: O our Lord ! Accept (this service) from us, Verily, You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ismail ki maa sabse pahli aurat thi jinhone kamar-belt istemal kiya. Unhone iska istemal apne paanv ke nishaan Sarah se chhupane ke liye kiya. Ibrahim unhe aur unke bete Ismail ko, jab woh use doodh pila rahi thi, Ka'ba ke qareeb ek darakht ke neeche, Zamzam ki jagah par, masjid ke sabse oonche hisse mein laaye. Us waqt Mecca mein na koi rehta tha na wahaan koi paani tha. Isliye unhone unhe wahaan baithaya, unke paas khajooron se bhara ek chamde ka thaila aur thoda paani wali ek mashk rakha, aur ghar wapas jane lage. Ismail ki maa unke peeche gaee aur kaha, "Aye Ibrahim! Aap humein kahaan chhodkar ja rahe hain, is waadi mein jahaan na koi insaan hai jiski sohbat hum le saken, na koi doosri cheez (yaani zaroorat ki cheez)?" Usne yeh baat kaee baar dohraee, magar woh peeche mudhe bina aage badhte rahe. Phir usne unse pucha, "Kya Allah ne aapko aisa karne ka hukum diya?" Unhone kaha, "Haan." Usne kaha, "Phir woh humein akela nahi chhodega," aur wapas chali gaee jabke Ibrahim aage badhte rahe, aur jab woh Thaniyah pahunche jahaan se woh unhe dekh nahi sakte the, unhone Ka'ba ki taraf mudhkar, apne donon haathon ko uthaakar, Allah se yeh dua ki: "Aye humare Rab! Maine apni kuch aulad ko ek bina kheti baadi wali waadi mein basaya hai, tere pavitra ghar (Ka'ba, Mecca mein) ke paas, taake, Aye humare Rab, woh namaz mukammal padhen. Isliye kuch dilon ko unki taraf mohabbat se bhar de, aur (Aye Allah) unhe phal dekar rozi de, taake woh shukriya ada karen." (14:37) Ismail ki maa Ismail ko doodh pilati rahi aur paani piti rahi (jo unke paas thi). Jab mashk ka paani khatam ho gaya, use pyaas lagi aur uske bachche ko bhi pyaas lagi. Woh use tadapte huye dekhne lagi; woh use chhodkar door hui, kyunke woh use tadapta hua dekh nahi paee, aur usne paaya ke Safa pahad us zameen par sabse qareebi pahad tha. Woh uspar khadi hui aur waadi ko gahraee se dekhne lagi taake koi use dikhe, magar koi nahi dikha. Phir woh Safa se utri, aur jab woh waadi mein pahunchi, usne apna libaas uthaya aur waadi mein aisi tarah daudi jaisa koi museebat mein daudta hai, jab tak usne waadi paar ki aur Marwa pahad pahunchi jahaan woh khadi hui aur dekhne lagi, kisi ke dikhne ki ummeed karte huye, magar koi nahi dikha. Usne yeh (Safa aur Marwa ke beech daudna) saat baar dohraya. Nabi ne kaha, "Yehi wajah hai ke log inke beech chalte hain (yaani Safa-Marwa saee). Jab woh Marwa pahunchi (aakhri baar), usne ek aawaaz suni, aur usne khud se chup rehne ko kaha aur dhyan se suna. Usne phir woh aawaaz suni aur usne (us anjaan aawaaz se) kaha, "Aye (jo bhi tum ho)! Tumne mujhe apni aawaaz sunaee; kya tumhare paas koi madad hai?" Aur dekho! Usne Zamzam ki jagah par ek farishta dekha, apni eedi (ya pankh) se zameen khodte huye, jab tak usme se paani behne laga. Woh hairat mein pad gaee aur uske aas-paas kuaan khodne lagi, apne haath se, aur apne haathon se mashk mein paani bharna shuru kiya, aur paani uske kuch nikalne ke baad bhi behta raha. Nabi ne joda, "Allah Ismail ki maa par reham kare! Agar usne Zamzam (ko svabhavik tareeke se behne diya hota) (ya us paani se kuch na nikala hota apni mashk bharne ke liye), Zamzam zameen ki satah mein behta hua ek jaraa hota." Nabi ne aage kaha, "Phir usne (paani) piya aur apne bachche ko doodh pilaya. Farishte ne unse kaha, 'Akele chhode jane se mat daro, kyunke yeh Allah ka ghar hai jise yeh ladka aur uska waalid banaenge, aur Allah apni praja ko kabhi akela nahi chhodta.'" Us waqt Ghar (yaani Ka'ba) ek oonchi jagah par tha jaisi ek tile jaisi, aur jab seelaab aata, woh uske daahine aur baaee taraf behta. Woh isi tarah rahi jab tak Jurhum qabile ke kuch log ya Jurhum ka ek pariwara unke aur unke bachche ke paas se guzre, kyunke woh (Jurhum ke log) Kada ke raaste se aa rahe the. Woh Mecca ke neeche wale hisse mein utre jahaan unhone ek pankhi dekha jiski aadat paani ke aas-paas ghumne aur use na chhodne ki thi. Unhone kaha, "Yeh pankhi paani ke aas-paas hi ghumta hoga, chahe humein pata hai is waadi mein koi paani nahi." Unhone ek ya do khaddam bheje jinhone paani ka srot dhoonda, aur wapas aake unhe paani ke baare mein bataya. Isliye woh sab (paani ki taraf) aaye. Nabi ne joda, "Ismail ki maa paani ke qareeb baithi thi. Unhone usse pucha, 'Kya aap humein apne saath rehne ki ijazat dengi?' Usne jawab diya, 'Haan, magar tumhe paani par koi haqq nahi hoga.' Woh iske liye raazi ho gaye." Nabi ne aage kaha, "Ismail ki maa is poori haalat se khush thi kyunke woh logon ki sohbat ka aanand lena chahti thi. Isliye woh wahaan base, aur baad mein unhone apne pariwaron ke liye khaddam bheje jo aakar unke saath base, jab tak kuch pariwaar wahaan permanent rehne wale ban gaye. Bacha (yaani Ismail) bada hua aur unse Arabi seekhi aur (uski achhaiyon ki wajah se) unhe usse mohabbat aur prashansa hui jab woh bada ho raha tha, aur jab woh baalig umr tak pahuncha, unhone unme se ek aurat se uski shaadi karvaee. Ismail ki maa ke guzarne ke baad, Ibrahim, Ismail ki shaadi ke baad, apne pariwara ko dekhne aaye jise unhone pahle chhoda tha, magar unhe Ismail wahaan nahi mila. Jab unhone Ismail ki biwi se unke baare mein pucha, usne jawab diya, 'Woh humari rozi (kamane) ki khoj mein gaye hain.' Phir unhone unse unke rehne-sehne aur haalat ke baare mein pucha, aur usne jawab diya, 'Hum museebat mein rehte hain; hum mushkil aur gareebi mein rehte hain,' unse shikaayat karte huye. Unhone kaha, 'Jab tumhara shohar aaye, mera salaam unhe pahunchao aur unse kaho apne darwaaze ki choukhat badal den.' Jab Ismail aaye, unhe kuch anokha mahsoos hua, isliye unhone apni biwi se pucha, 'Kya koi tumse milne aaya?' Usne jawab diya, 'Haan, falaan-falaan hulye ka ek buddha shaks aaya aur aapke baare mein pucha, aur maine unhe bataya, aur unhone humare rehne-sehne ke baare mein pucha, aur maine unhe bataya ke hum mushkil aur gareebi mein rahte hain.' Isspar Ismail ne kaha, 'Kya unhone aapko koi salaah di?' Usne jawab diya, 'Haan, unhone mujhe aapko unka salaam pahunchane aur aapse apne darwaaze ki choukhat badalne ko kaha.' Ismail ne kaha, 'Woh mere waalid the, aur unhonne mujhe tumhe talaq dene ka hukum diya hai. Apne pariwara ke paas wapas jaao.' Isliye Ismail ne use talaq de di aur unme se doosri (yaani Jurhum se) shaadi ki. Phir Ibrahim jitne waqt tak Allah ne chaaha, unse door rahe, aur unse phir milne aaye magar unhe Ismail nahi mile. Isliye woh Ismail ki biwi ke paas gaye aur Ismail ke baare mein pucha. Usne kaha, 'Woh humari rozi ki khoj mein gaye hain.' Ibrahim ne unse pucha, 'Tum kaise guzaraa kar rahe ho?' unse unki rozi aur rehne-sehne ke baare mein puchte huye. Usne jawab diya, 'Hum khush-haal hain aur humare paas sab kuch bahutaat mein hai.' Phir usne Allah ka shukriya ada kiya. Ibrahim ne pucha, 'Tum kaisa khaana khate ho?' Usne kaha, 'Gosht.' Unhone pucha, 'Tum kya pite ho?' Usne kaha, 'Paani.' Unhone kaha, 'Aye Allah! Unke gosht aur paani mein barkat de.'" Nabi ne joda, "Us waqt unke paas anaaj nahi tha, aur agar hota, woh (Ibrahim) iske liye bhi barkat ki dua karte." Nabi ne aage kaha, "Agar kisi ke paas sirf yehi do cheezein rozi ke tor par hon, uski sehat aur svabhaav par bura asar padega, siwaye agar woh Mecca mein rehta ho." Nabi ne joda, "Phir Ibrahim ne Ismail ki biwi se kaha, 'Jab tumhara shohar aaye, mera salaam unhe pahunchao aur unse kaho apne darwaaze ki choukhat mazboot rakhen.' Jab Ismail wapas aaye, unhone apni biwi se pucha, 'Kya koi tumse milne aaya?' Usne jawab diya, 'Haan, ek achhe dikhne wale buddhe shaks mere paas aaye,' aur unki prashansa ki aur joda, 'Unhone aapke baare mein pucha, aur maine unhe bataya, aur unhone humari rozi ke baare mein pucha aur maine unhe bataya ke hum achhi haalat mein hain.' Ismail ne unse pucha, 'Kya unhone koi salaah di?' Usne kaha, 'Haan, unhone mujhe aapko unka salaam pahunchane ko kaha aur hukum diya ke aap apne darwaaze ki choukhat mazboot rakhen.' Isspar Ismail ne kaha, 'Woh mere waalid the, aur tum (yeh biwi) choukhat ho. Unhone mujhe tumhe apne saath rakhne ka hukum diya hai.' Phir Ibrahim jitne waqt tak Allah ne chaaha, unse door rahe, aur baad mein unse milne aaye. Unhone Ismail ko Zamzam ke qareeb ek darakht ke neeche, apne teer tez karte hue dekha. Jab unhone Ibrahim ko dekha, woh unka istikbaal karne ke liye uthe (aur donon ne ek-doosre ko waisi hi khushi se istikbaal kiya jaisa koi baap-beta karte hain). Ibrahim ne kaha, 'Aye Ismail! Allah ne mujhe ek hukum diya hai.' Ismail ne kaha, 'Aap Apne Rab ke hukum ko poora karen.' Ibrahim ne pucha, 'Kya tum meri madad karoge?' Ismail ne kaha, 'Main aapki madad karunga.' Ibrahim ne kaha, 'Allah ne mujhe hukum diya hai ke main yahaan ek ghar banaoon,' ek us tile ki taraf ishara karte huye jo aas-paas ki zameen se ooncha tha." Nabi ne joda, "Phir unhone Ghar (yaani Ka'ba) ki neenven uthaeen. Ismail patthar laate aur Ibrahim banate, aur jab deewaren oonchi ho gaeen, Ismail yeh patthar laaye aur Ibrahim ke liye rakha jo uspar chadhkar banane lage, jabke Ismail unhe patthar dete rahe, aur donon kehte rahe, 'Aye humare Rab! Humse (yeh sewa) qubool kar, Beshak, Tu Sab Sunne wala, Sab Jaanne wala hai.'" Nabi ne joda, "Phir donon ne Ghar (Ka'ba) banana aur uski parikrama karna jaari rakha, kehte huye: Aye humare Rab! Humse (yeh sewa) qubool kar, Beshak, Tu Sab Sunne wala, Sab Jaanne wala hai."

e: (Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When Abraham had differences with his wife), (because of her jealousy of Hajar, Ishmael's mother), he took Ishmael and his mother and went away. They had a water-skin with them containing some water, Ishmael's mother used to drink water from the water-skin so that her milk would increase for her child. When Abraham reached Mecca, he made her sit under a tree and afterwards returned home. Ishmael's mother followed him, and when they reached Kada', she called him from behind, 'O Abraham! To whom are you leaving us?' He replied, '(I am leaving you) to Allah's (Care).' She said, 'I am satisfied to be with Allah.' She returned to her place and started drinking water from the water-skin, and her milk increased for her child. When the water had all been used up, she said to herself, 'I'd better go and look so that I may see somebody.' She ascended the Safa mountain and looked, hoping to see somebody, but in vain. When she came down to the valley, she ran till she reached the Marwa mountain. She ran to and fro (between the two mountains) many times. Then she said to herself, 'I'd better go and see the state of the child,' she went and found it in a state of one on the point of dying. She could not endure to watch it dying and said (to herself), 'If I go and look, I may find somebody.' She went and ascended the Safa mountain and looked for a long while but could not find anybody. Thus she completed seven rounds (of running) between Safa and Marwa. Again she said (to herself), 'I'd better go back and see the state of the child.' But suddenly she heard a voice, and she said to that strange voice, 'Help us if you can offer any help.' Lo! It was Gabriel (who had made the voice). Gabriel hit the earth with his heel like this (Ibn `Abbas hit the earth with his heel to Illustrate it), and so the water gushed out. Ishmael's mother was astonished and started digging. (Abu Al-Qasim) (i.e. the Prophet) said, "If she had left the water, (flow naturally without her intervention), it would have been flowing on the surface of the earth.") Ishmael's mother started drinking from the water and her milk increased for her child . Afterwards some people of the tribe of Jurhum, while passing through the bottom of the valley, saw some birds, and that astonished them, and they said, 'Birds can only be found at a place where there is water.' They sent a messenger who searched the place and found the water, and returned to inform them about it. Then they all went to her and said, 'O Ishmael's mother! Will you allow us to be with you (or dwell with you)?' (And thus they stayed there.) Later on her boy reached the age of puberty and married a lady from them. Then an idea occurred to Abraham which he disclosed to his wife (Sarah), 'I want to call on my dependents I left (at Mecca).' When he went there, he greeted (Ishmael's wife) and said, 'Where is Ishmael?' She replied, 'He has gone out hunting.' Abraham said (to her), 'When he comes, tell him to change the threshold of his gate.' When he came, she told him the same whereupon Ishmael said to her, 'You are the threshold, so go to your family (i.e. you are divorced).' Again Abraham thought of visiting his dependents whom he had left (at Mecca), and he told his wife (Sarah) of his intentions. Abraham came to Ishmael's house and asked, "Where is Ishmael?" Ishmael's wife replied, "He has gone out hunting," and added, "Will you stay (for some time) and have something to eat and drink?' Abraham asked, 'What is your food and what is your drink?' She replied, 'Our food is meat and our drink is water.' He said, 'O Allah! Bless their meals and their drink." Abu Al-Qa-sim (i.e. Prophet) said, "Because of Abraham's invocation there are blessings (in Mecca)." Once more Abraham thought of visiting his family he had left (at Mecca), so he told his wife (Sarah) of his decision. He went and found Ishmael behind the Zamzam well, mending his arrows. He said, "O Ishmael, Your Lord has ordered me to build a house for Him." Ishmael said, "Obey (the order of) your Lord." Abraham said, "Allah has also ordered me that you should help me therein." Ishmael said, "Then I will do." So, both of them rose and Abraham started building (the Ka`ba) while Ishmael went on handing him the stones, and both of them were saying, "O our Lord ! Accept (this service) from us, Verily, You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing." (2.127). When the building became high and the old man (i.e. Abraham) could no longer lift the stones (to such a high position), he stood over the stone of Al- Maqam and Ishmael carried on handing him the stones, and both of them were saying, 'O our Lord! Accept (this service) from us, Verily You are All-Hearing, All-Knowing
hi: (Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Ibrahim aur unki biwi ke beech ikhtilaf hua), (Hajar, Ismail ki maa se unki jalan ki wajah se), woh Ismail aur unki maa ko lekar chal pade. Unke paas ek mashk paani thi, aur Ismail ki maa mashk se paani piti rahti taake apne bachche ke liye doodh badh sake. Jab Ibrahim Mecca pahunche, unhone unhe ek darakht ke neeche baithaya aur baad mein ghar wapas laute. Ismail ki maa unke peeche gaee, aur jab woh Kada tak pahunche, usne unhe peeche se pukara, "Aye Ibrahim! Aap humein kiske sahaare chhodkar jaa rahe hain?" Unhone jawab diya, "(Main tumhe) Allah ke (bharose) chhodkar." Usne kaha, "Main Allah ke saath rehne se santusht hoon." Woh apni jagah wapas gaee aur mashk se paani pine lagi, aur uska doodh apne bachche ke liye badhne laga. Jab paani khatam ho gaya, usne apne aap se kaha, "Mujhe jaakar dekhna chahiye taake koi mujhe dikhe." Woh Safa pahad par chadhi aur dekha, kisi ke dikhne ki ummeed karte huye, magar be-faida. Jab woh waadi mein utri, woh daudi jab tak Marwa pahad tak pahunchi. Woh (donon pahadon ke beech) kaee baar daudi. Phir usne apne aap se kaha, "Mujhe jaakar bachche ki haalat dekhna chahiye," woh gaee aur use (bachche ko) maut ke qareeb (haalat mein) paaya. Woh use marte hue dekhne ki taab na la saki aur (khud se) kaha, "Agar main jaakar dekhungi, mujhe koi mil sakta hai." Woh gaee aur Safa pahad par chadhi aur lambe waqt tak dekhti rahi magar kisi ko na paaya. Isi tarah usne Safa aur Marwa ke beech saat phere poore kiye. Phir usne (khud se) kaha, "Mujhe jaakar bachche ki haalat dekhna chahiye." Magar achanak usne ek aawaaz suni, aur usne us anjaan aawaaz se kaha, "Madad karo agar tumhare paas koi madad hai." Aur dekho! Woh Jibreel the (jinhone woh aawaaz nikali). Jibreel ne apni eedi se zameen ko is tarah maara, (Ibn Abbas ne apni eedi se zameen maarke yeh dikhaya), aur paani behne laga. Ismail ki maa hairat mein pad gaee aur khodne lagi. (Abul-Qasim, yaani Nabi ne) kaha, "Agar usne paani ko (svabhavik soorat se behne diya hota), yeh zameen ki satah mein behta hua ek jaraa hota." Ismail ki maa paani se pine lagi aur uska doodh apne bachche ke liye badhne laga. Baad mein Jurhum qabile ke kuch log, waadi ke neeche wale hisse se guzarte huye, kuch pankhi dekhe, aur unhe hairat hui, aur unhone kaha, "Pankhi sirf wahin mil sakte hain jahaan paani ho." Unhone ek khaddam bheja jisne jagah dhoondi aur paani paaya, aur wapas aakar unhe iske baare mein bataya. Phir sab unke paas gaye aur kaha, "Aye Ismail ki maa! Kya aap humein apne saath rehne (ya basne) ki ijazat dengi?" (Aur isi tarah woh wahaan base.) Baad mein unka ladka baalig umr tak pahuncha aur unme se ek khaatun se shaadi ki. Phir Ibrahim ke dimaag mein ek khyaal aaya jise unhone apni biwi (Sarah) ko bataya, "Main apne aashriton se milna chahta hoon jinhe maine (Mecca mein) chhoda tha." Jab woh wahaan gaye, unhone (Ismail ki biwi ko) salaam kiya aur kaha, "Ismail kahaan hain?" Usne jawab diya, "Woh shikaar ke liye gaye hain." Ibrahim ne (usse) kaha, "Jab woh aaen, unse kahna apne darwaaze ki choukhat badal den." Jab woh aaye, usne unhe wahi bataya, isspar Ismail ne unse kaha, "Tum hi choukhat ho, isliye apne pariwara ke paas jaao (yaani tumhe talaq)." Phir Ibrahim ko phir apne chhode hue aashriton se milne ka khyaal aaya, aur unhone apni biwi (Sarah) ko apna iraada bataya. Ibrahim Ismail ke ghar aaye aur pucha, "Ismail kahaan hain?" Ismail ki biwi ne jawab diya, "Woh shikaar ke liye gaye hain," aur joda, "Kya aap rukenge aur kuch khaane-pine ki cheez lenge?" Ibrahim ne pucha, "Tumhara khaana aur peena kya hai?" Usne jawab diya, "Humara khaana gosht hai aur humara peena paani." Unhone kaha, "Aye Allah! Unke khaane aur peene mein barkat de." Abul-Qasim (yaani Nabi) ne kaha, "Ibrahim ki dua ki wajah se hi (Mecca mein) barkaten hain." Phir Ibrahim ko phir apne chhode hue pariwara se milne ka khyaal aaya, isliye unhone apni biwi (Sarah) ko apne faisle se bataya. Woh gaye aur Ismail ko Zamzam ke kue ke peeche, apne teer theek karte hue paaya. Unhone kaha, "Aye Ismail, Tumhare Rab ne mujhe hukum diya hai ke main unke liye ek ghar banaoon." Ismail ne kaha, "Apne Rab ke hukum ka paalan karen." Ibrahim ne kaha, "Allah ne mujhe yeh bhi hukum diya hai ke tum ismein meri madad karo." Ismail ne kaha, "Phir main karunga." Isliye donon uthe aur Ibrahim ne (Ka'ba) banana shuru kiya jabke Ismail unhe patthar dete rahe, aur donon kehte rahe, "Aye humare Rab! Humse (yeh sewa) qubool kar, Beshak, Tu Sab Sunne wala, Sab Jaanne wala hai." (2:127) Jab nirmaan ooncha hua aur buddhe shaks (yaani Ibrahim) itni oonchaee par patthar nahi utha sakte the, woh Al-Maqam ke patthar par khade hue aur Ismail patthar dete rahe, aur donon kehte rahe, "Aye humare Rab! Humse (yeh sewa) qubool kar, Beshak, Tu Sab Sunne wala, Sab Jaanne wala hai."

e: Narrated Abu Dhar:I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Which mosque was first built on the surface of the earth?" He said, "Al-Masjid-ul-Haram (in Mecca)." I said, "Which was built next?" He replied, "The mosque of Al-Aqsa (in Jerusalem) ." I said, "What was the period of construction between the two?" He said, "Forty years." He added, "Wherever (you may be, and) the prayer time becomes due, perform the prayer there, for the best thing is to do so (i.e. to offer the prayers in time)
hi: Abu Dharr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine pucha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Zameen par sabse pahle kaunsi masjid banaee gaee?" Unhone kaha, "Al-Masjid-ul-Haram (Mecca mein)." Maine pucha, "Uske baad kaunsi?" Unhone jawab diya, "Al-Aqsa ki masjid (Jerusalem mein)." Maine pucha, "In donon ke beech nirmaan mein kitna waqt tha?" Unhone kaha, "Chaalis saal." Unhone joda, "Jahaan kahin (bhi tum ho, aur) namaz ka waqt aa jaaye, wahaan namaz padho, kyunke sabse behtareen baat yehi hai (yaani waqt par namaz padhna)."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:When the mountain of Uhud came in the sight of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) he said. "This is a mountain that loves us and is loved by us. O Allah! Abraham made Mecca a sanctuary, and I make (the area) in between these two mountains (of Medina) a sanctuary
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Uhud pahad Allah ke Rasool ki nazron ke saamne aaya, unhone kaha, "Yeh ek pahad hai jo humse mohabbat karta hai aur jisse hum mohabbat karte hain. Aye Allah! Ibrahim ne Mecca ko ek panah wali jagah banaya, aur main in do (Madina ke) pahadon ke beech ki jagah ko ek panah wali jagah banata hoon."

e: Narrated `Aisha:(The wife of the Prophet) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said (to her). "Don't you see that when your folk built the Ka`ba, they did not build it on all the foundations built by Abraham?" I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Why don't we rebuild it on the foundations of Abraham?" He said. "But for the fact that your folk have recently given up infidelity (I would have done so). Narrated Ibn `Umar: Aisha must have heard this from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for I see that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used not to touch the two corners facing Al-Hijr only because the House had not been built on the foundations of Abraham
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool ne (unse) kaha, "Kya tum nahi dekhti ke jab tumhare logon ne Ka'ba banaya, unhone ise Ibrahim ki dwara banaee gaee sab neenvon par nahi banaya?" Maine kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Hum ise Ibrahim ki neenvon par phir se kyun nahi banate?" Unhone kaha, "Agar yeh baat na hoti ke tumhare log haal hi mein kufr chhode hain (main aisa kar deta)." Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ayesha ne yeh Allah ke Rasool se zaroor suna hoga, kyunke main dekhta hoon ke Allah ke Rasool Al-Hijr ki taraf wale do konon ko nahi chhute the sirf isliye kyunke Ghar Ibrahim ki neenvon par nahi banaya gaya tha.

e: Narrated Abu Humaid As-Sa`idi:The people asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! How shall we (ask Allah to) send blessings on you?" Allah's Apostle replied, "Say: O Allah! Send Your Mercy on Muhammad and on his wives and on his offspring, as You sent Your Mercy on Abraham's family; and send Your Blessings on Muhammad and on his offspring, as You sent Your Blessings on Abraham's family, for You are the Most Praiseworthy, the Most Glorious
hi: Abu Humaid As-Saidi bataate hain: Logon ne pucha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Hum aap par kaise darood bhejen?" Allah ke Rasool ne jawab diya, "Kaho: Aye Allah! Muhammad par, unki biwiyon par, aur unki aulad par apni Rehmat naazil kar, jaise Tune Ibrahim ke pariwara par apni Rehmat naazil ki thi; aur Muhammad par aur unki aulad par apni Barkat naazil kar, jaise Tune Ibrahim ke pariwara par apni Barkat naazil ki thi, kyunke Tu hi sabse zyada tarif ke laayak, sabse mahaan hai."

e: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Laila:Ka`b bin Ujrah met me and said, "Shall I not give you a present I got from the Prophet?" `Abdur- Rahman said, "Yes, give it to me." I said, "We asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! How should one (ask Allah to) send blessings on you, the members of the family, for Allah has taught us how to salute you (in the prayer)?' He said, 'Say: O Allah! Send Your Mercy on Muhammad and on the family of Muhammad, as You sent Your Mercy on Abraham and on the family of Abraham, for You are the Most Praise-worthy, the Most Glorious. O Allah! Send Your Blessings on Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You sent your Blessings on Abraham and on the family of Abraham, for You are the Most Praise-worthy, the Most Glorious
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Laila bataate hain: Ka'b bin Ujrah unse mile aur kaha, "Kya main tumhe ek tohfa na dun jo mujhe Nabi se mila?" Abdur-Rahman ne kaha, "Haan, mujhe dijiye." Maine kaha, "Humne Allah ke Rasool se pucha, 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Hum pariwara ke logon par kaise darood bhejen, kyunke Allah ne humein (namaz mein) aapko salaam karna sikha diya hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Kaho: Aye Allah! Muhammad aur Muhammad ke pariwara par apni Rehmat naazil kar, jaise Tune Ibrahim aur Ibrahim ke pariwara par apni Rehmat naazil ki, kyunke Tu hi sabse zyada tarif ke laayak, sabse mahaan hai. Aye Allah! Muhammad aur Muhammad ke pariwara par apni Barkat naazil kar, jaise Tune Ibrahim aur Ibrahim ke pariwara par apni Barkat naazil ki, kyunke Tu hi sabse zyada tarif ke laayak, sabse mahaan hai.'"

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to seek Refuge with Allah for Al-Hasan and Al-Husain and say: "Your forefather (i.e. Abraham) used to seek Refuge with Allah for Ishmael and Isaac by reciting the following: 'O Allah! I seek Refuge with Your Perfect Words from every devil and from poisonous pests and from every evil, harmful, envious eye
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi Al-Hasan (Alayhis Salam) aur Al-Husain (Alayhis Salam) (apne pote-potiyon) ke liye Allah ki panah maangte aur kehte, "Tumhare pura-khe (yaani Ibrahim) Ismail aur Ishaaq ke liye Allah ki panah in alfaazon se maangte the: 'Aye Allah! Main Tere mukammal alfaazon ke zariye har Shaitan se, aur zeher wale keedon se, aur har buri, nuksaandeh, jalan karne wali nazar se panah maangta hoon.'"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "We are more liable to be in doubt than Abraham when he said, 'My Lord! Show me how You give life to the dead." . He (i.e. Allah) said: 'Don't you believe then?' He (i.e. Abraham) said: "Yes, but (I ask) in order to be stronger in Faith." (2.260) And may Allah send His Mercy on Lot! He wished to have a powerful support. If I were to stay in prison for such a long time as Joseph did I would have accepted the offer (of freedom without insisting on having my guiltlessness declared)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Hum shak karne mein Ibrahim se bhi zyada haqdaar hain jab unhone kaha, 'Mere Rab! Mujhe dikha tu murdon ko kaise jinda karta hai.' Allah ne kaha: 'Kya tumhe iman nahi?' Ibrahim ne kaha: 'Haan, magar (main puchta hoon) taake mera iman aur mazboot ho.' (2:260) Aur Allah Lut par apni rehmat naazil kare! Unhe ek taakatvaar sahaara chahiye tha. Agar main utne lambe waqt tak jail mein rahta jitne Yusuf rahe, main (bina bequsuri qubool kiye rihaee ke) prastaav qubool kar leta."

e: Narrated Salama bin Al-Akwa`:The Prophet (ﷺ) passed by some persons of the tribe of Aslam practicing archery (i.e. the throwing of arrows) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O offspring of Ishmael! Practice archery (i.e. arrow throwing) as your father was a great archer (i.e. arrow-thrower). I am with (on the side of) the son of so-and-so-." Hearing that, one of the two teams stopped throwing. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked them, ' Why are you not throwing?" They replied, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! How shall we throw when you are with the opposite team?" He said, "Throw, for I am with you all
hi: Salama bin Al-Akwa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi Aslam qabile ke kuch logon ke paas se guzre jo tirandaazi kar rahe the. Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Aye Ismail ki aulad! Tirandaazi karte raho kyunke tumhare baap ek behtareen tirandaaz the. Main falaan ke bete ke saath hoon (yaani ek team ke saamne)." Yeh sunkar, do teamon mein se ek ne teer chalana band kar diya. Allah ke Rasool ne unse pucha, "Tum kyun nahi chalat rahe?" Unhone jawab diya, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Hum kaise chalaen jabke aap muqaable wali team ke saath hain?" Unhone kaha, "Chalate raho, main tum sabko ke saath hoon."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Some people asked the Prophet: "Who is the most honorable amongst the people?" He replied, "The most honorable among them is the one who is the most Allah-fearing." They said, "O Allah's Prophet! We do not ask about this." He said, "Then the most honorable person is Joseph, Allah's Prophet, the son of Allah's Prophet, the son of Allah's Prophet, the son of Allah's Khalil." They said, "We do not ask about this." He said, "Then you want to ask me about the Arabs' descent?" They said, "Yes." He said, "Those who were best in the pre-Islamic period, are the best in Islam, if they comprehend (the religious knowledge)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Kuch logon ne Nabi se pucha: "Sab logon mein sabse izzatdaar kaun hai?" Unhone jawab diya, "Unme sabse pakbaz." Unhone kaha, "Ya Allah ke Nabi! Hum yeh nahi puchna chahte." Unhone kaha, "Phir sabse izzatdaar shaks Yusuf hain, Allah ke Nabi, Allah ke Nabi ke bete, jo khud Allah ke Nabi ke bete the, jo khud Allah ke dost (Ibrahim) ke bete the." Unhone kaha, "Hum yeh bhi nahi puchna chahte." Unhone kaha, "Phir tum Arbon ke vansh ke baare mein puchna chahte ho?" Unhone kaha, "Haan." Unhone kaha, "Jo log Jahiliyat ke daur mein sabse behtar the, woh Islam mein bhi sabse behtar honge, bashart ke unhe (deen ka) ilm ho jaaye."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "May Allah forgive Lot: He wanted to have a powerful support
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Allah Lut ko maaf kare: Woh ek taakatvaar sahaara chahte the."

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) recited:-- 'Hal-min-Muddakir' (54.15) (Is there any that will remember) (and avoid evil)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne padha: "Hal-min-Muddakir" (54:15) (yaani "Kya koi hai jo naseehat le?" — aur buraee se bache).

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Zam`a:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) while referring to the person who had cut the legs of the she-camel (of the Prophet Salih (ﷺ)), saying, "The man who was appointed for doing this job, was a man of honor and power in his nation like Abu Zam`a
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Zam'a bataate hain: Maine Nabi ko us shaks ke baare mein kehte suna jisne (Nabi Salih ki) untni ke paanv kate the, "Woh shaks jise yeh kaam karne ke liye chuna gaya, apni qaum mein Abu Zam'a jaisa ek izzatdaar aur takatvaar shaks tha."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) landed at Al-Hijr during the Ghazwa of Tabuk, he ordered his companions not to drink water from its well or reserve water from it. They said, "We have already kneaded the dough with its water. and also filled our bags with its water.'' On that, the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered them to throw away the dough and pour out the water
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool Ghazwa-e-Tabuk ke dauran Al-Hijr mein utre, unhone apne sathiyon ko wahaan ke kue se paani na pine ya jama na karne ka hukum diya. Unhone kaha, "Hum pahle hi uske paani se aata gundh chuke hain, aur humne apne matke bhi uske paani se bhar liye hain." Isspar Nabi ne unhe aata phenkne aur paani baahar daalne ka hukum diya.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The people landed at the land of Thamud called Al-Hijr along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and they took water from its well for drinking and kneading the dough with it as well. (When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) heard about it) he ordered them to pour out the water they had taken from its wells and feed the camels with the dough, and ordered them to take water from the well whence the she-camel (of Prophet Salih) used to drink
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Log Thamud ki zameen, jise Al-Hijr kaha jata hai, mein Allah ke Rasool ke saath utre aur unhone uske kue se pine aur aata gundhne ke liye paani liya. (Jab Allah ke Rasool ne yeh suna) unhone unhe uske kue se liya hua paani baahar daalne aur unton ko woh aata khilane ka hukum diya, aur unhe us kue se paani lene ka hukum diya jahaan se (Nabi Salih ki) untni piti thi.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:When the Prophet (ﷺ) passed by (a place called) Al Hijr, he said, "Do not enter the houses of those who were unjust to themselves, unless (you enter) weeping, lest you should suffer the same punishment as was inflicted upon them." After that he covered his face with his sheet cloth while he was on the camel-saddle
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Nabi Al-Hijr se guzre, unhone kaha, "Un logon ke gharon mein daakhil mat ho jo apne aap par zulm kiye the, jab tak (tum) rote hue na daakhil ho, kahin tum bhi unhi jaisi saza na pao jo unpar aee." Iske baad unhone apna chehra apni chaadar se dhak liya jabke woh unt ki jin (saddle) par sawar the.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Do not enter the ruined dwellings of those who were unjust to themselves unless (you enter) weeping, lest you should suffer the same punishment as was inflicted upon them
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Un logon ke barbaad gharon mein daakhil mat ho jo apne aap par zulm kiye the, jab tak (tum) rote hue na daakhil ho, kahin tum bhi unhi jaisi saza na pao jo unpar aee."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The honorable is the son of the honorable, the son the honorable, the son the honorable, i.e. Joseph, the son of Jacob, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Izzatdaar (shaks) izzatdaar ka beta hai, izzatdaar ka beta, izzatdaar ka beta, yaani Yusuf, Yaqub ke bete, Ishaq ke bete, Ibrahim ke bete."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked, "Who is the most honorable amongst the people?" He replied, "The most Allah fearing." The people said, "We do not want to ask you about this." He said, "The most honorable person is Joseph, Allah's Prophet, the son of Allah's Prophet, the son of Allah's Prophet, the son of Allah's Khalil" The people said, 'We do not want to ask you about this." He said," Then you want to ask me about the origins of the Arabs? People are of various origins. The best in the pre-Islamic period are the best in Islam, provided they comprehend (the religious knowledge)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool se pucha gaya, "Sab logon mein sabse izzatdaar kaun hai?" Unhone jawab diya, "Sabse zyada Allah se darne wala." Logon ne kaha, "Hum aapse yeh nahi puchna chahte." Unhone kaha, "Sabse izzatdaar shaks Yusuf hain, Allah ke Nabi, Allah ke Nabi ke bete, jo khud Allah ke Nabi ke bete the, jo khud Allah ke dost ke bete the." Logon ne kaha, "Hum aapse yeh bhi nahi puchna chahte." Unhone kaha, "Phir tum mujhse Arbon ki asal ke baare mein puchna chahte ho? Log alag-alag mool se hain. Jo Jahiliyat ke daur mein sabse behtar the, woh Islam mein bhi sabse behtar honge, bashart ke unhe (deen ka) ilm ho jaaye."

e: Narrated `Aisha:That the Prophet (ﷺ) said (to her). "Order Abu Bakr to lead the people in prayer." She replied," Abu Bakr is a soft-hearted person and when he stands at your place, he will weep (so he will not be able to lead the prayer)." The Prophet (ﷺ) repeated the same order and she gave the same reply. The narrator, Shuba said that the Prophet (ﷺ) said on the third or fourth time. "You are (like) the female companions of Joseph. Order Abu Bakr to lead the prayer
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi ne (unse) kaha, "Abu Bakr ko logon ki imaamat karne (namaz padhane) ka hukum do." Unhone jawab diya, "Abu Bakr ek narm dil wale insaan hain, aur jab woh aapki jagah khade honge, woh rone lagenge (isliye woh namaz nahi padha payenge)." Nabi ne yehi hukum dohraya aur unhone wahi jawab diya. Raawi Shuba ne kaha ke teesri ya chauthi baar Nabi ne kaha, "Tum log Yusuf ki saheliyon jaisi ho. Abu Bakr ko namaz padhane ka hukum do."

e: Narrated Abu Musa:When the Prophet (ﷺ) fell ill, he said, "Order Abu Bakr to lead the people in prayer." `Aisha said, "Abu Bakr is a soft-hearted person. The Prophet (ﷺ) gave the same order again and she again gave the same reply. He again said, "Order Abu Bakr (to lead the prayer)! You are (like) the female companions of Joseph." Consequently Abu Bakr led the people in prayer in the life-time of the Prophet
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Nabi bimar pad gaye, unhone kaha, "Abu Bakr ko logon ki imaamat karne ka hukum do." Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha, "Abu Bakr ek narm dil wale insaan hain." Nabi ne wahi hukum phir diya aur unhone phir wahi jawab diya. Unhone phir kaha, "Abu Bakr ko hukum do (namaz padhane ka)! Tum log Yusuf ki saheliyon jaisi ho." Isliye Abu Bakr ne Nabi ki zindagi mein hi logon ki imaamat ki.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! Save `Aiyyash bin Abi Rabi`a (from the unjust treatment of the infidels). O Allah! Save Salama bin Hisham. O Allah! Send your Punishment on (the tribe of) Mudar. O Allah! Let them suffer from years (of drought) similar to that inflicted during the life-time of Joseph
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Aye Allah! Aiyash bin Abi Rabi'a ko bacha (kaafiron ke na-insaafi se). Aye Allah! Salama bin Hisham ko bacha. Aye Allah! Mudar (qabile) par apni saza bhej. Aye Allah! Unhe Yusuf ke zamane jaise akal ke saal bhugatne de."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "May Allah bestow His Mercy on Lot. He wanted to have a powerful support. If I were to stay in prison (for a period equal to) the stay of Joseph (in prison) and then the offer of freedom came to me, then I would have accepted it." (See Hadith No)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Allah Lut par apni rehmat naazil kare. Unhe ek taakatvaar sahaara chahiye tha. Agar main utne waqt tak jail mein rahta jitna Yusuf rahe, aur phir azaadi ka prastaav milta, main use qubool kar leta." (Dekhen Hadith No.)

e: Narrated Masruq:I asked Um Ruman, `Aisha's mother about the accusation forged against `Aisha. She said, "While I was sitting with `Aisha, an Ansari woman came to us and said, 'Let Allah condemn such-and-such person.' I asked her, 'Why do you say so?' She replied, 'For he has spread the (slanderous) story.' `Aisha said, 'What story?' The woman then told her the story. `Aisha asked, 'Have Abu Bakr and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) heard about it ?' She said, 'Yes.' `Aisha fell down senseless (on hearing that), and when she came to her senses, she got fever and shaking of the body. The Prophet (ﷺ) came and asked, 'What is wrong with her?' I said, 'She has got fever because of a story which has been rumored.' `Aisha got up and said, 'By Allah! Even if I took an oath, you would not believe me, and if I put forward an excuse, You would not excuse me. My example and your example is just like that example of Jacob and his sons. Against that which you assert, it is Allah (Alone) Whose Help can be sought.' (12.18) The Prophet (ﷺ) left and then Allah revealed the Verses (concerning the matter), and on that `Aisha said, 'Thanks to Allah (only) and not to anybody else
hi: Masruq bataate hain: Maine Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ki maa Um Ruman se, Ayesha par lagaaye gaye ilzaam ke baare mein pucha. Unhone kaha, "Jabke main Ayesha ke saath baithi thi, ek Ansaar aurat humare paas aee aur kaha, 'Allah falaan-falaan shaks ko barbaad kare.' Maine unse pucha, 'Aap yeh kyun keh rahi hain?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Kyunke usne yeh kahani phaila diya.' Ayesha ne pucha, 'Kaunsi kahani?' Us aurat ne unhe poori kahani sunaee. Ayesha ne pucha, 'Kya Abu Bakr aur Allah ke Rasool ne iske baare mein suna hai?' Usne kaha, 'Haan.' Ayesha behosh ho gaee (yeh sunkar), aur jab woh hosh mein aee, unhe bukhaar chadha aur unka jism kaanpne laga. Nabi aaye aur pucha, 'Ise kya hua hai?' Maine kaha, 'Use ek phaili hui kahani ki wajah se bukhaar hai.' Ayesha uthi aur kaha, 'Allah ki qasam! Chahe main qasam khaun, tum mera vishwas nahi karoge, aur agar main koi safaee dun, tum mujhe maaf nahi karoge. Mera aur tumhara masla Yaqub aur unke beton jaisa hai. Jo tum kehte ho, uske khilaf, Allah (akela) hi hai jiski madad mangi jaa sakti hai.' (12:18) Nabi wahaan se chale gaye aur phir Allah ne (is baare mein) Ayaten nazil ki, aur isspar Ayesha ne kaha, 'Shukriya sirf Allah ka, kisi aur ka nahi.'"

e: Narrated `Urwa:I asked `Aisha the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ) about the meaning of the following Verse: -- "(Respite will be granted) 'Until when the apostles give up hope (of their people) and thought that they were denied (by their people)..............."(12.110) `Aisha replied, "Really, their nations did not believe them." I said, "By Allah! They were definite that their nations treated them as liars and it was not a matter of suspecting." `Aisha said, "O 'Uraiya (i.e. `Urwa)! No doubt, they were quite sure about it." I said, "May the Verse be read in such a way as to mean that the apostles thought that Allah did not help them?" Aisha said, "Allah forbid! (Impossible) The Apostles did not suspect their Lord of such a thing. But this Verse is concerned with the Apostles' followers who had faith in their Lord and believed in their apostles and their period of trials was long and Allah's Help was delayed till the apostles gave up hope for the conversion of the disbelievers amongst their nation and suspected that even their followers were shaken in their belief, Allah's Help then came to them
hi: Urwa bataate hain: Maine Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا), Nabi ki biwi, se is Ayat ka matlab pucha: "(Muhlat di jaayegi) Jab tak Rasool ummeed chhod den (apni qaum se) aur samjhen ke unse jhoot bola gaya (unki hi qaum dwaara)..." (12:110) Ayesha ne jawab diya, "Sach mein, unki qaumen unhe jhuta samajhti thi." Maine kaha, "Allah ki qasam! Unhe poora yaqeen tha ke unki qaumen unhe jhuta maanti thi, aur yeh koi shak ki baat nahi thi." Ayesha ne kaha, "Aye Urwa (Uraiya)! Beshak, unhe iska yaqeen tha." Maine pucha, "Kya is Ayat ko yeh maan kar padha jaaye ke Rasool sochte the ke Allah ne unki madad nahi ki?" Ayesha ne kaha, "Allah na kare! Yeh mumkin nahi! Rasoolon ne apne Rab par kabhi aisa shak nahi kiya. Magar yeh Ayat un Rasoolon ke pairokaron ke baare mein hai jinka apne Rab par vishwas tha aur apne Rasoolon par bhi iman tha, aur unki azmaishon ki avadhi lambi thi aur Allah ki madad tab tak taali gaee jab tak Rasool apni qaum mein na manne walon ki hidayat ki ummeed chhod nahi dete aur sochte ke unke apne pairokar bhi apne vishwas mein dagmagane lage hain, phir Allah ki madad unke paas aee."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The honorable, the son of the honorable, the son of the honorable, the son of the honorable, (was) Joseph, the son of Jacob, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Izzatdaar, izzatdaar ka beta, izzatdaar ka beta, izzatdaar ka beta, (yaani) Yusuf, Yaqub ke bete, Ishaq ke bete, Ibrahim ke bete."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "While Job was naked, taking a bath, a swarm of gold locusts fell on him and he started collecting them in his garment. His Lord called him, 'O Job! Have I not made you rich enough to need what you see? He said, 'Yes, O Lord! But I cannot dispense with your Blessing
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Jabke Ayyub nange hokar naha raha tha, sone ki tiddiyon ka ek jhund unpar gira aur woh unhe apne kapde mein jama karne lage. Unke Rab ne unhe pukara, 'Aye Ayyub! Kya maine tumhe itna daulatmand nahi banaya ke tumhe yeh chahiye jo tum dekh rahe ho?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Haan, Aye Rab! Magar mujhe teri barkat ke bina nahi rah sakta.'"

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) returned to Khadija while his heart was beating rapidly. She took him to Waraqa bin Naufal who was a Christian convert and used to read the Gospels in Arabic Waraqa asked (the Prophet), "What do you see?" When he told him, Waraqa said, "That is the same angel whom Allah sent to the Prophet) Moses. Should I live till you receive the Divine Message, I will support you strongly
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi Khadija (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas wapas aaye jabke unka dil zor se dhadak raha tha. Unhone unhe Waraqa bin Naufal ke paas le gaee jo Isaee ban chuke the aur Arbi mein Injeel padhte the. Waraqa ne (Nabi se) pucha, "Aapko kya dikhaee diya?" Jab unhone unhe bataya, Waraqa ne kaha, "Yeh wahi farishta hai jise Allah ne Musa ke paas bheja tha. Kaash main us waqt tak zinda rahun jab tak aapko Divine paighaam mile, main aapka pura saath dunga."

e: Narrated Malik bin Sasaa:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) talked to his companions about his Night Journey to the Heavens. When he reached the fifth Heaven, he met Aaron. (Gabriel said to the Prophet), "This is Aaron." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Gabriel greeted and so did I, and he returned the greeting saying, 'Welcome, O Pious Brother and Pious Prophet
hi: Malik bin Sasaa bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne apne sahaba se apni aasman ki chadhaee ke baare mein baat ki. Jab woh paanchvaan aasman tak pahunche, unki mulaqaat Haroon se hui. (Jibreel ne Nabi se kaha), "Yeh Haroon hain." Nabi ne kaha, "Jibreel ne salaam kiya aur maine bhi, aur unhone jawab diya, kehte huye, 'Khush aamdad, Aye neik bhai aur neik Nabi.'"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "On the night of my Ascension to Heaven, I saw (the prophet) Moses who was a thin person with lank hair, looking like one of the men of the tribe of Shanua; and I saw Jesus who was of average height with red face as if he had just come out of a bathroom. And I resemble prophet Abraham more than any of his offspring does. Then I was given two cups, one containing milk and the other wine. Gabriel said, 'Drink whichever you like.' I took the milk and drank it. Gabriel said, 'You have accepted what is natural, (True Religion i.e. Islam) and if you had taken the wine, your followers would have gone astray
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Meri aasman ki chadhaee ki raat, maine Musa ko dekha jo ek patle, seedhe baal wale shaks the, mano woh Shanua qabile ke logon mein se ek hon; aur maine Isa ko dekha, darmiyana qad aur laal chehre wale, mano woh gusal se abhi bahar aaye hon. Aur main Ibrahim ki aulad mein sabse zyada unse milta-julta hoon. Phir mujhe do pyale diye gaye, ek doodh se bhara aur doosra sharab se. Jibreel ne kaha, 'Jo pasand ho piyo.' Maine doodh liya aur piya. Jibreel ne kaha, 'Tumne fitrat ke anuroop (yaani sacha deen, Islam) qubool kiya, aur agar tum sharab lete, tumhare pairokaar bhatak jate.'"

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "One should not say that I am better than Jonah (i.e. Yunus) bin Matta." So, he mentioned his father Matta. The Prophet (ﷺ) mentioned the night of his Ascension and said, "The prophet Moses was brown, a tall person as if from the people of the tribe of Shanu'a. Jesus was a curly-haired man of moderate height." He also mentioned Malik, the gate-keeper of the (Hell) Fire, and Ad-Dajjal
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Kisi ko yeh nahi kehna chahiye ke main Yunus bin Matta se behtar hoon." Isliye unhone unke waalid Matta ka naam liya. Nabi ne apni aasman ki chadhaee ki raat ka zikar kiya aur kaha, "Nabi Musa bhure rang wale, lambe shaks the, mano woh Shanua qabile ke logon mein se hon. Isa ghungrale baal wale, darmiyana qad ke shaks the." Unhone Malik ka bhi zikar kiya, Dozakh ka darbaan, aur Dajjal ka bhi.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When the Prophet (ﷺ) came to Medina, he found (the Jews) fasting on the day of 'Ashura' (i.e. 10th of Muharram). They used to say: "This is a great day on which Allah saved Moses and drowned the folk of Pharaoh. Moses observed the fast on this day, as a sign of gratitude to Allah." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I am closer to Moses than they." So, he observed the fast (on that day) and ordered the Muslims to fast on it
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Nabi Madina aaye, unhone (Yahudiyon ko) Ashura ke din (yaani Muharram ki daswin taarikh) roza rakhte paaya. Woh kahte the: "Yeh ek bada din hai jispar Allah ne Musa ko bachaya aur Firaun ki qaum ko dubaya. Musa ne is din ka roza Allah ke shukriye ke tor par rakha." Nabi ne kaha, "Main Musa se unse zyada nazdeek hoon." Isliye unhone (us din) roza rakha aur Musalmanon ko bhi is din roza rakhne ka hukum diya.

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'People will be struck unconscious on the Day of Resurrection and I will be the first to regain consciousness, and behold! There I will see Moses holding one of the pillars of Allah's Throne. I will wonder whether he has become conscious before me, or if he has been exempted because of his unconsciousness at the Tur (mountain) which he received (on the earth)
hi: Abu Saeed bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Qiyamat ke din log behosh ho jaayenge, aur main sabse pahle hosh mein aunga, aur dekhunga! Musa Allah ke Arsh ke ek khambe ko pakade hue honge. Mujhe hairat hogi kya woh mujhse pahle hosh mein aaye, ya use Tur (pahad) par behosh hone se mukti mili jo unhe (duniya mein) mila tha."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Were it not for Bani Israel, meat would not decay; and were it not for Eve, no woman would ever betray her husband
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Agar Bani Israel na hote, gosht kabhi sadta nahi; aur agar Hawwa na hoti, koi bhi aurat kabhi apne shohar se dagabaazi nahi karti."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:That he differed with Al-Hur bin Qais Al-Fazari regarding the companion of Moses. Ibn `Abbas said that he was Al-Khadir. Meanwhile Ubai bin Ka`b passed by them and Ibn `Abbas called him saying, "My friend and I have differed regarding Moses' companion whom Moses asked the way to meet. Have you heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) mentioning something about him?" He said, "Yes, I heard Allah's Apostle saying, 'While Moses was sitting in the company of some Israelites, a man came and asked (him), 'Do you know anyone who is more learned than you?' Moses replied, 'No.' So, Allah sent the Divine Inspiration to Moses: 'Yes, Our slave, Khadir (is more learned than you).' Moses asked how to meet him (i.e. Khadir). So, the fish, was made, as a sign for him, and he was told that when the fish was lost, he should return and there he would meet him. So, Moses went on looking for the sign of the fish in the sea. The servant boy of Moses said to him, 'Do you know that when we were sitting by the side of the rock, I forgot the fish, and it was only Satan who made me forget to tell (you) about it.' Moses said, That was what we were seeking after,' and both of them returned, following their footmarks and found Khadir; and what happened further to them, is mentioned in Allah's Book
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Unka Al-Hur bin Qais Al-Fazari se Musa ke sathi ke baare mein ikhtilaf hua. Ibn Abbas ne kaha ke woh Al-Khadir the. Isi dauran Ubai bin Ka'b (رضی اللہ عنہ) wahaan se guzre aur Ibn Abbas ne unhe bulaya aur kaha, "Meri aur mere dost ki Musa ke us sathi ke baare mein baat ho rahi thi jinse Musa ne raasta puchne ke liye mulaqaat ki. Kya aapne Allah ke Rasool ko unke baare mein kuch kehte suna hai?" Unhone jawab diya, "Haan, maine Allah ke Rasool ko yeh kehte suna, 'Ek baar Musa kuch Israeliyon ke saath baithe the, jab ek shaks aaya aur pucha, "Kya aap kisi aise shaks ko jaante hain jo aapse zyada ilm wala hai?" Musa ne jawab diya, "Nahi." Isliye Allah ne Musa ko Divine ilham bheji: "Haan, Hamara banda, Khadir (aapse zyada ilm wale hain)." Musa ne pucha unse kaise mulaqaat karen. Isliye ek machhli unke liye ek nishaani banaee gaee, aur unhe bataya gaya ke jab machhli kho jaaye, unhe wapas jana chahiye, aur wahaan unki mulaqaat hogi. Isliye Musa samundar mein machhli ki nishaani dhoondte gaye. Musa ke naujawaan khaddam ne unse kaha, "Kya aapko yaad hai jab hum us chattan ke qareeb baithe the, main machhli bhool gaya, aur sirf Shaitan hi mujhe ise (aapko) batane se roka." Musa ne kaha, "Yehi to hum dhoondh rahe the," aur donon apne kadmon ke nishaanon ki pairvi karte huye wapas gaye aur Khadir ko paaya; aur unke saath aage jo hua, Allah ki Kitaab mein bataya gaya hai.'"

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:I said to Ibn `Abbas, "Nauf Al-Bakali claims that Moses, the companion of Al-Khadir was not Moses (the prophet) of the children of Israel, but some other Moses." Ibn `Abbas said, "Allah's enemy (i.e. Nauf) has told a lie. Ubai bin Ka`b told us that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Once Moses stood up and addressed Bani Israel. He was asked who was the most learned man amongst the people. He said, 'I.' Allah admonished him as he did not attribute absolute knowledge to Him (Allah). So, Allah said to him, 'Yes, at the junction of the two seas there is a Slave of Mine who is more learned than you.' Moses said, 'O my Lord! How can I meet him?' Allah said, 'Take a fish and put it in a large basket and you will find him at the place where you will lose the fish.' Moses took a fish and put it in a basket and proceeded along with his (servant) boy, Yusha` bin Noon, till they reached the rock where they laid their heads (i.e. lay down). Moses slept, and the fish, moving out of the basket, fell into the sea. It took its way into the sea (straight) as in a tunnel. Allah stopped the flow of water over the fish and it became like an arch (the Prophet (ﷺ) pointed out this arch with his hands). They travelled the rest of the night, and the next day Moses said to his boy (servant), 'Give us our food, for indeed, we have suffered much fatigue in this journey of ours.' Moses did not feel tired till he crossed that place which Allah had ordered him to seek after. His boy (servant) said to him, 'Do you know that when we were sitting near that rock, I forgot the fish, and none but Satan caused me to forget to tell (you) about it, and it took its course into the sea in an amazing way?.' So there was a path for the fish and that astonished them. Moses said, 'That was what we were seeking after.' So, both of them retraced their footsteps till they reached the rock. There they saw a man Lying covered with a garment. Moses greeted him and he replied saying, 'How do people greet each other in your land?' Moses said, 'I am Moses.' The man asked, 'Moses of Bani Israel?' Moses said, 'Yes, I have come to you so that you may teach me from those things which Allah has taught you.' He said, 'O Moses! I have some of the Knowledge of Allah which Allah has taught me, and which you do not know, while you have some of the Knowledge of Allah which Allah has taught you and which I do not know.' Moses asked, 'May I follow you?' He said, 'But you will not be able to remain patient with me for how can you be patient about things which you will not be able to understand?' (Moses said, 'You will find me, if Allah so will, truly patient, and I will not disobey you in aught.') So, both of them set out walking along the sea-shore, a boat passed by them and they asked the crew of the boat to take them on board. The crew recognized Al-Khadir and so they took them on board without fare. When they were on board the boat, a sparrow came and stood on the edge of the boat and dipped its beak once or twice into the sea. Al-Khadir said to Moses, 'O Moses! My knowledge and your knowledge have not decreased Allah's Knowledge except as much as this sparrow has decreased the water of the sea with its beak.' Then suddenly Al-Khadir took an adze and plucked a plank, and Moses did not notice it till he had plucked a plank with the adze. Moses said to him, 'What have you done? They took us on board charging us nothing; yet you have intentionally made a hole in their boat so as to drown its passengers. Verily, you have done a dreadful thing.' Al-Khadir replied, 'Did I not tell you that you would not be able to remain patient with me?' Moses replied, 'Do not blame me for what I have forgotten, and do not be hard upon me for my fault.' So the first excuse of Moses was that he had forgotten. When they had left the sea, they passed by a boy playing with other boys. Al-Khadir took hold of the boys head and plucked it with his hand like this. (Sufyan, the sub narrator pointed with his fingertips as if he was plucking some fruit.) Moses said to him, "Have you killed an innocent person who has not killed any person? You have really done a horrible thing." Al-Khadir said, "Did I not tell you that you could not remain patient with me?' Moses said "If I ask you about anything after this, don't accompany me. You have received an excuse from me.' Then both of them went on till they came to some people of a village, and they asked its inhabitants for food but they refused to entertain them as guests. Then they saw therein a wall which was just going to collapse (and Al Khadir repaired it just by touching it with his hands). (Sufyan, the sub-narrator, pointed with his hands, illustrating how Al-Khadir passed his hands over the wall upwards.) Moses said, "These are the people whom we have called on, but they neither gave us food, nor entertained us as guests, yet you have repaired their wall. If you had wished, you could have taken wages for it." Al-Khadir said, "This is the parting between you and me, and I shall tell you the explanation of those things on which you could not remain patient." The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "We wished that Moses could have remained patient by virtue of which Allah might have told us more about their story. (Sufyan the sub-narrator said that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "May Allah bestow His Mercy on Moses! If he had remained patient, we would have been told further about their case
hi: Sa'id bin Jubair bataate hain: Maine Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kaha, "Nauf Al-Bakali ka daava hai ke Al-Khadir ke sathi Musa, Bani Israel wale Musa (Nabi) nahi the, balki koi doosre Musa the." Ibn Abbas ne kaha, "Allah ke dushman (yaani Nauf) ne jhoot bola. Ubai bin Ka'b (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne humein bataya ke Nabi ne kaha, 'Ek baar Musa khade hue aur Bani Israel ko sambodhit kiya. Unse pucha gaya sab logon mein sabse zyada ilm wala kaun hai. Unhone kaha, "Main." Allah ne unhe daanta kyunke unhone sampoorna ilm ka Allah ko hi haq nahi diya. Isliye Allah ne unse kaha, "Haan, do samundaron ke sangam par mera ek banda hai jo tumse zyada ilm wala hai." Musa ne pucha, "Aye mere Rab! Main unse kaise milun?" Allah ne kaha, "Ek machhli lo aur use ek badi tokri mein rakho aur tumhe woh jagah milegi jahaan tum machhli kho doge." Musa ne machhli li, use tokri mein rakha, aur apne naujawaan khaddam, Yusha bin Noon ke saath nikle, jab tak woh chattan tak pahunche jahaan unhone apne sar rakhe (yaani let gaye). Musa so gaye, aur machhli, tokri se nikalkar, samundar mein gir gaee. Yeh samundar mein ek surang jaisa raasta banate huye chali. Allah ne machhli ke oopar paani ka bahav roka diya aur woh ek mehraab jaisa ban gaya (Nabi ne apne haathon se yeh mehraab dikhaya). Woh raat ke baaki hisse mein safar karte rahe, aur agli subah Musa ne apne khaddam se kaha, "Humara khaana lao, kyunke humne apne is safar mein bahut thakan mahsoos ki hai." Musa tab tak thake nahi jab tak unhone woh jagah paar nahi kar li jahaan Allah ne unhe jane ka hukum diya tha. Unke khaddam ne unse kaha, "Kya aapko yaad hai jab hum us chattan ke qareeb baithe the, main machhli bhool gaya, aur sirf Shaitan hi mujhe ise (aapko) batane se roka, aur woh samundar mein ajeeb tarike se apna raasta bana gaee." Isliye machhli ke liye ek raasta tha aur yeh unhe hairat mein daal diya. Musa ne kaha, "Yehi to hum dhoondh rahe the." Isliye donon apne kadmon ke nishaanon ki pairvi karte huye wapas gaye jab tak woh chattan tak pahunche. Wahaan unhone ek shaks dekha jo ek kapde mein lipeta leta hua tha. Musa ne unhe salaam kiya aur unhone jawab diya, "Tumhare desh mein log ek-doosre ko kaise salaam karte hain?" Musa ne kaha, "Main Musa hoon." Us shaks ne pucha, "Bani Israel wale Musa?" Musa ne kaha, "Haan, main tumhare paas isliye aaya hoon taake tum mujhe woh sikhaao jo Allah ne tumhe sikhaya hai." Usne kaha, "Aye Musa! Mere paas Allah ka kuch aisa ilm hai jo Allah ne mujhe sikhaya hai aur jo tumhe nahi pata, jabke tumhare paas Allah ka kuch aisa ilm hai jo Allah ne tumhe sikhaya hai aur jo mujhe nahi pata." Musa ne pucha, "Kya main aapki pairvi kar sakta hoon?" Usne kaha, "Magar tum mere saath sabr nahi rakh paoge, kyunke tum aisi cheezon ke baare mein kaise sabr rakh paoge jinhe tum samajh nahi paoge?" (Musa ne kaha, "Aap mujhe, Insha Allah, sacha sabr rakhte paenge, aur main aapki kisi baat mein na-farmani nahi karunga.") Isliye donon samundar ke kinare-kinare chal pade, ek naav unke paas se guzri aur unhone naav walon se unhe savaar karane ki guzarish ki. Naav walon ne Al-Khadir ko pahchaan liya aur unhe bina kiraye ke savaar kar liya. Jab woh naav par the, ek chidiya aee aur naav ke kinare par baithi aur apni chonch ek ya do baar samundar mein daali. Al-Khadir ne Musa se kaha, "Aye Musa! Mera ilm aur tumhara ilm Allah ke ilm mein utni bhi kami nahi laaya jitni is chidiya ne apni chonch se samundar ke paani mein kami laee hai." Phir achanak Al-Khadir ne ek auzaar liya aur naav ka ek takhta nikal diya, aur Musa ko iska pata bhi tab chala jab woh takhta nikal chuka tha. Musa ne unse kaha, "Aapne yeh kya kiya? Unhone humein bina kiraye savaar kiya, phir bhi aapne jaanboojhkar unki naav mein chhed kar diya taake uske sawaron ko dubaya ja sake. Beshak, aapne ek bahut bura kaam kiya hai." Al-Khadir ne kaha, "Kya maine tumse nahi kaha tha ke tum mere saath sabr nahi rakh paoge?" Musa ne kaha, "Mujhe iske liye jawabdeh mat karo ke main bhool gaya, aur mujhpar sakhti mat karo." Isliye Musa ka pahla uzr bhoolna tha. Jab woh samundar chhod chuke the, woh ek ladke ke paas se guzre jo doosre ladkon ke saath khel raha tha. Al-Khadir ne ladke ka sar pakada aur ise apne haath se aise nikal diya." (Sufyan, doosre raawi ne apni ungliyon ke konon se ishara kiya, mano woh koi phal tod rahe hon.) Musa ne unse kaha, "Kya aapne ek maasoom jaan ko qatl kiya jisne kisi ko qatl nahi kiya? Aapne sach mein ek bahut bura kaam kiya hai." Al-Khadir ne kaha, "Kya maine tumse nahi kaha tha ke tum mere saath sabr nahi rakh paoge?" Musa ne kaha, "Agar iske baad main aapse kisi cheez ke baare mein poochun, mujhe apne saath mat rakhna. Aapko mujhse uzr mil chuka hai." Phir donon chalte rahe jab tak woh ek gaanv ke logon ke paas pahunche, aur unhone wahaan ke logon se khaana maanga magar unhone unhe mehmaan banane se inkaar kiya. Phir unhone wahaan ek deewaar dekhi jo girne hi wali thi (aur Al-Khadir ne use sirf apne haathon se chhookar seedha kar diya). (Sufyan, doosre raawi ne apne haathon se dikhaya kaise Al-Khadir ne apna haath deewaar par oopar ki taraf phera.) Musa ne kaha, "Yeh woh log hain jinse humne madad maangi, magar unhone na humein khaana diya na mehmaan banaya, phir bhi aapne unki deewaar seedha kar di. Agar aap chahte, aap iske liye mazdoori le sakte the." Al-Khadir ne kaha, "Yahaan se hum alag hote hain, aur main tumhe un cheezon ki vyaakhya batataa hoon jinme tum sabr nahi rakh paye." Nabi ne aage kaha, "Humni chahti thi ke kaash Musa sabr rakh pate taake Allah unke baare mein humein aur bataata.'" Sufyan, doosre raawi ne kaha ke Nabi ne kaha, "Allah Musa par apni rehmat naazil kare! Agar woh sabr rakh pate, humein unke maamle ke baare mein aur bataya jata."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Al-Khadir was named so because he sat over a barren white land, it turned green with plantation after (his sitting over it)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Al-Khadir ka naam isliye rakha gaya kyunke woh ek badin (safed, banjar) zameen par baithe the, jo unke baith jane ke baad hariyali se hari-bhari ho gaee."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "It was said to Bani Israel, Enter the gate (of the town) with humility (prostrating yourselves) and saying: "Repentance", but they changed the word and entered the town crawling on their buttocks and saying: "A wheat grain in the hair
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Bani Israel se kaha gaya, 'Shehar ke darwaze mein vinamrata se daakhil ho (yaani jhukkar) aur kaho: \"Tauba,\" magar unhone lafz badal diya aur apne peeche ke bal rengkte hue shehar mein daakhil hue, kehte huye: \"Ek gehun ka daana baal mein.\"'"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "(The Prophet) Moses was a shy person and used to cover his body completely because of his extensive shyness. One of the children of Israel hurt him by saying, 'He covers his body in this way only because of some defect in his skin, either leprosy or scrotal hernia, or he has some other defect.' Allah wished to clear Moses of what they said about him, so one day while Moses was in seclusion, he took off his clothes and put them on a stone and started taking a bath. When he had finished the bath, he moved towards his clothes so as to take them, but the stone took his clothes and fled; Moses picked up his stick and ran after the stone saying, 'O stone! Give me my garment!' Till he reached a group of Bani Israel who saw him naked then, and found him the best of what Allah had created, and Allah cleared him of what they had accused him of. The stone stopped there and Moses took and put his garment on and started hitting the stone with his stick. By Allah, the stone still has some traces of the hitting, three, four or five marks. This was what Allah refers to in His Saying:-- "O you who believe! Be you not like those Who annoyed Moses, But Allah proved his innocence of that which they alleged, And he was honorable In Allah's Sight
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "(Nabi) Musa bahut sharmila shaks the aur apni sharam ki wajah se apna poora badan dhakte the. Bani Israel mein se ek shaks ne unhe dukh pahunchaya yeh kehte huye, 'Woh apna jism sirf isliye dhakte hain kyunke unke chamde mein koi kami hai, ya to kodh ya kisi doosri bimari ki wajah se, ya unme koi doosri kami hai.' Allah ne Musa ko iske ilzaam se saaf karna chaha, isliye ek din jab Musa akele the, unhone apne kapde utare aur ek patthar par rakhkar nahane lage. Jab woh nahana khatam kar chuke, woh apne kapdon ki taraf mude unhe lene ke liye, magar patthar unke kapde lekar bhaag gaya; Musa ne apna danda uthaya aur patthar ke peeche daude, kehte huye, 'Aye patthar! Mera libaas mujhe wapas de!' Jab tak woh Bani Israel ke ek giroh tak nahi pahunche jinhone unhe tabhi nanga dekha, aur unhe dekha ke Allah ne unhe behtareen jism diya hai, aur Allah ne unhe us ilzaam se saaf kar diya jo unpar lagaya gaya tha. Patthar wahaan ruka aur Musa ne apna libaas liya aur pahina aur patthar ko apne dande se maar-maar kar peete rahe. Allah ki qasam, patthar mein abhi bhi maar ke nishaan hain, teen, chaar, ya paanch daage. Yehi hai jiska zikar Allah ne is farmaan mein kiya: 'Aye tum jo iman late ho! Un logon jaise mat bano jinhone Musa ko dukh pahunchaya, magar Allah ne unke ilzaam se unki begunahi saabit ki, aur woh Allah ki nazar mein izzatdaar the.'"

e: Narrated `Abdullah:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) distributed something (among his followers. A man said, "This distribution has not been done (with justice) seeking Allah's Countenance." I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and told him (of that). He became so angry that I saw the signs of anger on his face. Then he said, "May Allah bestow His Mercy on Moses, for he was harmed more (in a worse manner) than this; yet he endured patiently
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Nabi ne (apne pairokaron ke beech) kuch cheez taqseem ki. Ek shaks ne kaha, "Yeh taqseem Allah ki khushi ke lakshya se nahi ki gaee." Main Nabi ke paas gaya aur unhe iske baare mein bataya. Woh itna naraaj hue ke maine unke chehre par gusse ke asaraat dekhe. Phir unhone kaha, "Allah Musa par apni rehmat naazil kare, kyunke unhe issse bhi zyada takleef di gaee; phir bhi unhone sabr rakha."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:We were with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) picking the fruits of the 'Arak trees, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Pick the black fruit, for it is the best." The companions asked, "Were you a shepherd?" He replied, "There was no prophet who was not a shepherd
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Allah ke Rasool ke saath Arak darakhton ke phal chunne gaye, aur Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Kale phal chuno, kyunke woh sabse behtar hote hain." Sahaba ne pucha, "Kya aap ek charwaha the?" Unhone jawab diya, "Koi bhi Nabi nahi hua jo charwaha na raha ho."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Angel of Death was sent to Moses when he came to Moses, Moses slapped him on the eye. The angel returned to his Lord and said, "You have sent me to a Slave who does not want to die." Allah said, "Return to him and tell him to put his hand on the back of an ox and for every hair that will come under it, he will be granted one year of life." Moses said, "O Lord! What will happen after that?" Allah replied, "Then death." Moses said, "Let it come now." Moses then requested Allah to let him die close to the Sacred Land so much so that he would be at a distance of a stone's throw from it." Abu Huraira added, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'If I were there, I would show you his grave below the red sand hill on the side of the road
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maut ka Farishta Musa ke paas bheja gaya, aur jab woh Musa ke paas aaye, Musa ne unki aankh par thapad maara. Farishta apne Rab ke paas wapas gaye aur kaha, "Aapne mujhe ek aise bande ke paas bheja jo marna nahi chahta." Allah ne kaha, "Unke paas wapas jaao aur unse kaho ke woh apna haath ek bail ki peeth par rakhe, aur jitne baal uske haath ke neeche aaenge, unhe utne hi saal ki zindagi diya jaayega." Musa ne pucha, "Aye Rab! Uske baad kya hoga?" Allah ne jawab diya, "Phir maut." Musa ne kaha, "To abhi aane do." Musa ne phir Allah se guzarish ki ke unki maut Pavitra Bhoomi ke qareeb ho, itna qareeb ke ek pathar phenkne ki doori tak." Abu Huraira ne joda, "Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, 'Agar main wahaan hota, main tumhe unki qabar dikhata, laal ret ki pahadi ke neeche, raaste ke bagal mein.'"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:A Muslim and a Jew quarreled. The Muslim taking an oath, said, "By Him Who has preferred Muhammad over all people...!"
