The Jew said, "By Him Who has preferred Moses, over all people." The Muslim raised his hand and slapped the Jew who came to the Prophet (ﷺ) to tell him what had happened between him and the Muslim. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Don't give me superiority over Moses, for the people will become unconscious (on the Day of Resurrection) and I will be the first to gain consciousness to see Moses standing and holding a side of Allah's Throne. I will not know if he has been among those people who have become unconscious; and that he has gained consciousness before me, or he has been amongst those whom Allah has exempted
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek Musalman aur ek Yahudi mein jhagda hua. Musalman ne qasam khakar kaha, "Us Zaat ki qasam jisne Muhammad ko sab logon par superiority di...!" Yahudi ne kaha, "Us Zaat ki qasam jisne Musa ko sab logon par superiority di." Musalman ne apna haath uthaya aur Yahudi ko thapad maara. Yahudi Nabi ke paas gaya unhe batane jo unke aur Musalman ke beech hua. Nabi ne kaha, "Mujhe Musa se superiority mat do, kyunke log behosh ho jaayenge (Qiyamat ke din) aur main sabse pahle hosh mein aunga taake dekhun Musa khade hue Allah ke Arsh ke ek kone ko pakde hue. Mujhe nahi pata kya woh un logon mein the jo behosh hue the; aur kya unhe mujhse pahle hosh aee, ya woh un logon mein the jinhe Allah ne mukt kar diya."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Adam and Moses argued with each other. Moses said to Adam. 'You are Adam whose mistake expelled you from Paradise.' Adam said to him, 'You are Moses whom Allah selected as His Messenger and as the one to whom He spoke directly; yet you blame me for a thing which had already been written in my fate before my creation?"' Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said twice, "So, Adam overpowered Moses
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Aadam aur Musa ne ek-doosre se bahas ki. Musa ne Aadam se kaha, 'Aap woh Aadam hain jinki galti ne aapko Jannat se nikal diya.' Aadam ne unse kaha, 'Aap woh Musa hain jinhe Allah ne apna Rasool aur seedhe baat karne wala chuna; phir bhi aap mujhe ek aisi cheez ke liye doshi dete hain jo pahle se hi meri taqdir mein likhi thi, mere paida hone se pahle?'" Allah ke Rasool ne do baar kaha, "Isliye Aadam ne Musa par jeet paee."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) once came to us and said, "All the nations were displayed in front of me, and I saw a large multitude of people covering the horizon. Somebody said, 'This is Moses and his followers
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Nabi humare paas aaye aur kaha, "Sab qaumen mere saamne pesh ki gaee, aur maine logon ki ek badi bheed dekhi jo poora kshitij dhak rahi thi. Kisi ne kaha, 'Yeh Musa aur unke pairokaar hain.'"

e: Narrated Abu Musa:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Many amongst men reached (the level of) perfection but none amongst the women reached this level except Asia, Pharaoh's wife, and Mary, the daughter of `Imran. And no doubt, the superiority of `Aisha to other women is like the superiority of Tharid (i.e. a meat and bread dish) to other meals
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Bahut se mard purnata tak pahunche, magar koi aurat nahi pahunchi siwaye Asiya, Firaun ki biwi, aur Maryam, Imran ki beti ke. Aur, beshak, Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ki doosri aurton par superiority aisi hai jaisa Tharid (yaani gosht aur roti se bana khaana) doosre khaanon par."

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "None of you should say that I am better than Yunus (i.e. Jonah)." Musadded added, "Jonah bin Matta
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Tum mein se koi yeh na kahe ke main Yunus se behtar hoon." Musadded, doosre raawi ne joda, "Yunus bin Matta."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No slave (of Allah) should say that I am better than Yunus bin Matta." So the Prophet mentioned his father's name with his name
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Koi (Allah ka) banda yeh na kahe ke main Yunus bin Matta se behtar hoon." Isliye Nabi ne unke naam ke saath unke waalid ka naam bhi joda.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Once while a Jew was selling something, he was offered a price that he was not pleased with. So, he said, "No, by Him Who gave Moses superiority over all human beings!" Hearing him, an Ansari man got up and slapped him on the face and said, "You say: By Him Who Gave Moses superiority over all human beings although the Prophet (Muhammad) is present amongst us!" The Jew went to the Prophet and said, "O Abu-l-Qasim! I am under the assurance and contract of security, so what right does so-and-so have to slap me?" The Prophet (ﷺ) asked the other, "Why have you slapped". He told him the whole story. The Prophet (ﷺ) became angry, till anger appeared on his face, and said, "Don't give superiority to any prophet amongst Allah's Prophets, for when the trumpet will be blown, everyone on the earth and in the heavens will become unconscious except those whom Allah will exempt. The trumpet will be blown for the second time and I will be the first to be resurrected to see Moses holding Allah's Throne. I will not know whether the unconsciousness which Moses received on the Day of Tur has been sufficient for him, or has he got up before me. And I do not say that there is anybody who is better than Yunus bin Matta
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar jab ek Yahudi kuch bech raha tha, use ek aisi qeemat pesh ki gaee jisse woh khush nahi tha. Isliye unhone kaha, "Nahi, us Zaat ki qasam jisne Musa ko sab insaanon par superiority di!" Yeh sunkar, ek Ansaar shaks utha aur unhe thapad maara aur kaha, "Tum kehte ho: Us Zaat ki qasam jisne Musa ko sab insaanon par superiority di, jabke Nabi (Muhammad) hamare beech maujood hain!" Yahudi Nabi ke paas gaya aur kaha, "Aye Abul-Qasim! Main aapki panah mein hoon aur amaan-samjhaute ke tehat hoon, isliye falaan ko mujhe thapad marne ka kya haqq hai?" Nabi ne doosre shaks se pucha, "Tumne use thapad kyun maara?" Usne unhe poori kahani sunaee. Nabi naraaj ho gaye, jab tak unke chehre par gusse ke asaraat dikhne lage, aur kaha, "Allah ke Nabiyon mein se kisi ko doosre se superiority mat do, kyunke jab pahli baar singa phoonka jaayega, zameen aur aasman ke sab log behosh ho jaayenge siwaye un logon ke jinhe Allah bachaega. Phir doosri baar singa phoonka jaayega aur main sabse pahle hosh mein aunga Musa ko dekhne, Allah ke Arsh ko pakde hue. Mujhe nahi pata kya Musa ko mila hua behoshi Tur (pahad) wala kaafi tha (isliye woh Qiyamat ki behoshi se bach gaye), ya woh mujhse pahle hosh mein aae. Aur main nahi kehta ke koi bhi Yunus bin Matta se behtar hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "None should say that I am better than Yunus bin Matta
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Koi yeh na kahe ke main Yunus bin Matta se behtar hoon."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The reciting of the Zabur (i.e. Psalms) was made easy for David. He used to order that his riding animals be saddled, and would finish reciting the Zabur before they were saddled. And he would never eat except from the earnings of his manual work
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Dawood ke liye Zabur (yaani Psalms) padhna aasaan kar diya gaya tha. Woh apne sawari ke janwaron par jin kasne ka hukum dete aur unke tayar hone se pahle Zabur padhna khatam kar dete. Aur woh sirf apni haathon ki mehnat ki kamaee se hi khate the."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was informed that I have said: "By Allah, I will fast all the days and pray all the nights as long as I live." On that, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked me, "Are you the one who says: 'I will fast all the days and pray all the nights as long as I live?' " I said, "Yes, I have said it." He said, "You cannot do that. So fast (sometimes) and do not fast (sometimes). Pray and sleep. Fast for three days a month, for the reward of a good deed is multiplied by ten times, and so the fasting of three days a month equals the fasting of a year." I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I can do (fast) more than this." He said, "Fast on every third day. I said: I can do (fast) more than that, He said: "Fast on alternate days and this was the fasting of David which is the most moderate sort of fasting." I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I can do (fast) more than that." He said, "There is nothing better than that
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ko bataya gaya ke maine kaha hai, "Allah ki qasam, main apni poori zindagi roza rakhunga aur poori raat namaz padhunga." Isspar, Allah ke Rasool ne mujhse pucha, "Kya tum hi ho jo kehta hai: 'Main apni poori zindagi roza rakhunga aur poori raat namaz padhunga?'" Maine kaha, "Haan, maine yeh kaha." Unhone kaha, "Tum aisa nahi kar sakte. Isliye (kabhi) roza rakho aur (kabhi) roza mat rakho. Namaz padho aur so bhi. Har mahine mein teen din roza rakho, kyunke ek neik amal ka ajr das guna diya jata hai, isliye mahine mein teen din ka roza ek saal ke roze ke barabar ho jata hai." Maine kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Main isse zyada (roza) rakh sakta hoon." Unhone kaha, "Har teesre din roza rakho." Maine kaha, "Main isse bhi zyada rakh sakta hoon," Unhone kaha: "Ek din chhodkar roza rakho, aur yehi Dawood ka roza tha jo sabse santulit qisam ka roza hai." Maine kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Main isse zyada rakh sakta hoon." Unhone kaha, "Isse behtar kuch nahi hai."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr bin Al-As:The Prophet (ﷺ) said to me, "I have been informed that you pray all the nights and observe fast all the days; is this true?" I replied, "Yes." He said, "If you do so, your eyes will become weak and you will get bored. So fast three days a month, for this will be the fasting of a whole year, or equal to the fasting of a whole year." I said, "I find myself able to fast more." He said, "Then fast like the fasting of (the Prophet) David who used to fast on alternate days and would not flee on facing the enemy
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-As bataate hain: Nabi ne mujhse kaha, "Mujhe bataya gaya hai ke tum poori raat namaz padhte ho aur poore din roza rakhte ho; kya yeh sach hai?" Maine jawab diya, "Haan." Unhone kaha, "Agar tum aisa karte ho, tumhari aankhen kamzor ho jaayengi aur tum thak jaoge. Isliye mahine mein teen din roza rakho, kyunke yeh poore saal ke roze ke barabar hoga, ya poore saal ke roze ke barabar." Maine kaha, "Main isse zyada roza rakh sakta hoon." Unhone kaha, "Phir Dawood ke roze jaisa roza rakho jo ek din chhodkar roza rakhte the aur dushman ka saamna hote waqt kabhi bhaagte nahi the."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me, "The most beloved fasting to Allah was the fasting of (the Prophet) David who used to fast on alternate days. And the most beloved prayer to Allah was the prayer of David who used to sleep for (the first) half of the night and pray for 1/3 of it and (again) sleep for a sixth of it
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne mujhse kaha, "Allah ke liye sabse pyara roza Dawood ka roza tha jo ek din chhodkar roza rakhte the. Aur Allah ke liye sabse pyari namaz Dawood ki namaz thi, jo raat ka pahla aadha hissa sote the, ek-tihai hissa namaz padhte the, aur phir chhathaee hissa phir sote the."

e: Narrated Mujahid:I asked Ibn `Abbas, "Should we perform a prostration on reciting Surat-Sa`d?" He recited (the Sura) including: 'And among his progeny, David, Solomon..(up to)...so follow their guidance (6.84-91) And then he said, "Your Prophet is amongst those people who have been ordered to follow them (i.e. the preceding apostles)
hi: Mujahid bataate hain: Maine Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha, "Kya humein Surah Sad padhte waqt sajda karna chahiye?" Unhone (Surah) padhi, jismein tha: "Aur unki aulad mein, Dawood, Sulaiman... jab tak... isliye unki hidayat ki pairvi karo" (6:84-91) aur phir unhone kaha, "Tumhare Nabi bhi un logon mein se hain jinhe in (pichle Rasoolon) ki pairvi karne ka hukum diya gaya hai."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The prostration in Sura-Sa`d is not amongst the compulsory prostrations, though I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) prostrating on reciting it
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Surah Sad ka sajda farz sajdon mein se nahi hai, chahe maine Nabi ko ise padhte waqt sajda karte dekha hai.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A strong demon from the Jinns came to me yesterday suddenly, so as to spoil my prayer, but Allah enabled me to overpower him, and so I caught him and intended to tie him to one of the pillars of the Mosque so that all of you might see him, but I remembered the invocation of my brother Solomon: 'And grant me a kingdom such as shall not belong to any other after me.' (38.35) so I let him go cursed
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Kal ek taakatvaar jin mujhpar achanak hamla karne aaya taake meri namaz kharab kar sake, magar Allah ne mujhe uspar kaboo paane ki taakat di, aur maine use pakad liya aur socha ke use masjid ke ek khambe se baandhun taake tum sab use dekh sako, magar mujhe apne bhai Sulaiman ki dua yaad aee: 'Aur mujhe ek aisi badshahat de jo mere baad kisi aur ko na mile' (38:35) isliye maine use laanit karke chhod diya."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Solomon (the son of) David said, 'Tonight I will sleep with seventy ladies each of whom will conceive a child who will be a knight fighting for "Allah's Cause.' His companion said, 'If Allah will.' But Solomon did not say so; therefore none of those women got pregnant except one who gave birth to a half child." The Prophet (ﷺ) further said, "If the Prophet Solomon (ﷺ) had said it (i.e. 'If Allah will') he would have begotten children who would have fought in Allah's Cause." Shuaib and Ibn Abi Az-Zinad said, "Ninety (women) is more correct (than seventy)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Sulaiman, Dawood ke bete ne kaha, 'Aaj raat main sattar aurton ke saath hambister hounga, aur har ek unme se ek bacha paida karegi jo Allah ki raah mein jung karega.' Unke saathi ne kaha, 'Agar Allah chaahe.' Magar Sulaiman ne yeh nahi kaha; isliye un aurton mein se ek ke siwa koi bhi garbhvati nahi hui, aur usne ek adhoore bachche ko paidaish diya." Nabi ne aage kaha, "Agar Nabi Sulaiman ne yeh kaha hota ('Agar Allah chahe'), unke bachche Allah ki raah mein jung karte." Shuaib aur Ibn Abi Az-Zinad ne kaha, "'Nabbe' (yaani 90) zyada sahi hai (sattar ke bajaye)."

e: Narrated Abu Dharr:I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Which mosque was built first?" He replied, "Al-Masjid-ul-Haram." I asked, "Which (was built) next?" He replied, "Al-Masjid-ul-Aqsa (i.e. Jerusalem)." I asked, "What was the period in between them?" He replied, "Forty (years)." He then added, "Wherever the time for the prayer comes upon you, perform the prayer, for all the earth is a place of worshipping for you
hi: Abu Dharr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine pucha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Sabse pahle kaunsi masjid banaee gaee?" Unhone jawab diya, "Al-Masjid-ul-Haram." Maine pucha, "Uske baad kaunsi?" Unhone jawab diya, "Al-Masjid-ul-Aqsa (yaani Jerusalem)." Maine pucha, "Un donon ke beech kitne waqt ka faasla tha?" Unhone jawab diya, "Chaalis (saal)." Phir unhone joda, "Jahaan bhi namaz ka waqt tumpar aaye, namaz padh lo, kyunke poori zameen tumhare liye ibaadat ki jagah hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "My example and the example of the people is like that of a person who lit a fire and let the moths, butterflies and these insects fall in it." He also said, "There were two women, each of whom had a child with her. A wolf came and took away the child of one of them, whereupon the other said, 'It has taken your child.' The first said, 'But it has taken your child.' So they both carried the case before David who judged that the living child be given to the elder lady. So both of them went to Solomon bin David and informed him (of the case). He said, 'Bring me a knife so as to cut the child into two pieces and distribute it between them.' The younger lady said, 'May Allah be merciful to you! Don't do that, for it is her (i.e. the other lady's) child.' So he gave the child to the younger lady
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Meri aur logon ki misaal us shaks jaisi hai jisne aag jalaee aur patange, titliyaan, aur aise keede usme girne diye." Unhone yeh bhi kaha, "Do aurten thi, har ek ke paas ek bacha tha. Ek bhediya aaya aur ek ka bacha le gaya, isspar doosri ne kaha, 'Yeh tumhara bacha le gaya.' Pahli ne kaha, 'Nahi, yeh tumhara bacha le gaya.' Isliye dono Dawood ke paas gaee apna maamla pesh karne, jinhone faisla diya ke zinda bacha bade waali aurat ko diya jaaye. Isliye donon Sulaiman bin Dawood ke paas gaee aur unhe (maamle ke baare mein) bataya. Unhone kaha, 'Mujhe ek chaaku lakar do taake main bacche ke do tukde karke unmein baant dun.' Chhoti aurat ne kaha, 'Allah aappar reham kare! Aisa mat kariye, kyunke yeh uska (yaani doosri aurat ka) bacha hai.' Isliye unhone bacha chhoti aurat ko de diya."

e: Narrated `Abdullah:When the Verse:-- 'Those who believe and mix not their belief with wrong." was revealed, the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Who amongst us has not mixed his belief with wrong?" Then Allah revealed: "Join none in worship with Allah, Verily joining others in worship with Allah is a great wrong indeed
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab yeh Ayat nazil hui: "Woh log jo iman late hain aur apne iman ko zulm se mila nahi rakhte..." Nabi ke sahaba ne kaha, "Hum mein se kisne apne iman ko zulm se mila na rakha ho?" Phir Allah ne yeh nazil kiya: "Allah ke saath kisi ko na jodo, kyunke Allah ke saath kisi ko jodna beshak ek bada zulm hai."

e: Narrated `Abdullah:When the Verse:-- 'Those who believe and mix not their belief with wrong.' was revealed, the Muslims felt it very hard on them and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Who amongst us does not do wrong to himself?" He replied, "The Verse does not mean this. But that (wrong) means to associate others in worship to Allah: Don't you listen to what Luqman said to his son when he was advising him," O my son! Join not others in worship with Allah. Verily joining others in worship with Allah is a great wrong indeed
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab yeh Ayat nazil hui: "Woh log jo iman late hain aur apne iman ko zulm se mila nahi rakhte," Musalmanon ko yeh bahut mushkil lagi aur unhone kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Hum mein se kaun khud par zulm nahi karta?" Unhone jawab diya, "Is Ayat ka yeh matlab nahi hai. Balki, (zulm ka) matlab hai Allah ke saath kisi ko jodna: Kya tumne Luqman ne apne bete se jo naseehat di thi woh nahi suna, 'Aye mere bete! Allah ke saath kisi ko na jodo. Beshak, Allah ke saath kisi ko jodna ek bada zulm hai.'"

e: Narrated Malik bin Sasaa:That the Prophet (ﷺ) talked to them about the night of his Ascension to the Heavens. He said, "(Then Gabriel took me) and ascended up till he reached the second heaven where he asked for the gate to be opened, but it was asked, 'Who is it?' Gabriel replied, 'I am Gabriel.' It was asked, 'Who is accompanying you?' He replied, 'Muhammad.' It was asked, 'Has he been called?' He said, 'Yes.' When we reached over the second heaven, I saw Yahya (i.e. John) and Jesus who were cousins. Gabriel said, 'These are John (Yahya) and Jesus, so greet them.' I greeted them and they returned the greeting saying, 'Welcome, O Pious Brother and Pious Prophet!;
hi: Malik bin Sasaa bataate hain: Nabi ne apni sahaba se aasman ki chadhaee ki raat ke baare mein baat ki. Unhone kaha, "(Phir Jibreel mujhe lekar) doosre aasman tak chadhe jahaan unhone darwaza kholne ki maang ki, magar pucha gaya, 'Kaun hai?' Jibreel ne jawab diya, 'Main Jibreel hoon.' Pucha gaya, 'Aapke saath kaun hai?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Muhammad.' Pucha gaya, 'Kya unhe bulaya gaya hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan.' Jab hum doosre aasman par pahunche, maine Yahya (yaani Yohan) aur Isa ko dekha, jo mama-jaee bhai the. Jibreel ne kaha, 'Yeh Yahya aur Isa hain, isliye unhe salaam karo.' Maine unhe salaam kiya aur unhone jawab diya, kehte huye, 'Khush aamdad, Aye neik bhai aur neik Nabi!'"

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Al-Musaiyab:Abu Huraira said, "I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, 'There is none born among the off-spring of Adam, but Satan touches it. A child therefore, cries loudly at the time of birth because of the touch of Satan, except Mary and her child." Then Abu Huraira recited: "And I seek refuge with You for her and for her offspring from the outcast Satan
hi: Sa'id bin Al-Musaiyab bataate hain: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Maine Allah ke Rasool ko kehte suna, 'Aadam ki aulad mein koi bhi paida nahi hota jise Shaitan chhue na ho. Isliye bacha paidaish ke waqt zor se rota hai Shaitan ke chhune ki wajah se, siwaye Maryam aur unke bachche ke.'" Phir Abu Huraira ne padha: "Aur main Teri panah mangta hoon uske liye aur uski aulad ke liye phitkare hue Shaitan se."

e: Narrated `Ali:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Mary, the daughter of `Imran, was the best among the women (of the world of her time) and Khadija is the best amongst the women. (of this nation)
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Maine Nabi ko kehte suna, "Maryam, Imran ki beti, apne zamane ki aurton mein sabse behtar thi, aur Khadija (رضی اللہ عنہا) is ummat ki aurton mein sabse behtar hain."

e: Narrated Abu Musa Al-Ash`ari:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The superiority of `Aisha to other ladies is like the superiority of Tharid (i.e. meat and bread dish) to other meals. Many men reached the level of perfection, but no woman reached such a level except Mary, the daughter of `Imran and Asia, the wife of Pharaoh
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ash'ari bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ki doosri aurton par superiority aisi hai jaisa Tharid (yaani gosht aur roti se bana khaana) doosre khaanon par. Bahut se mard purnata tak pahunche, magar koi aurat nahi pahunchi siwaye Maryam, Imran ki beti, aur Asiya, Firaun ki biwi ke."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "Amongst all those women who ride camels (i.e. Arabs), the ladies of Quraish are the best. They are merciful and kind to their off-spring and the best guardians of their husbands' properties.' Abu Huraira added, "Mary the daughter of `Imran never rode a camel
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool ko kehte suna, "Un sab aurton mein jo unt par sawar hoti hain (yaani Arab aurten), Quraish ki aurten sabse behtar hain. Woh apni aulad ke prati sabse dayaloo aur narm hoti hain, aur apne shohar ki maal ki sabse behtar dekhbhal karne wali hoti hain." Abu Huraira ne joda, "Maryam, Imran ki beti, ne kabhi unt ki sawari nahi ki."

e: Narrated 'Ubada:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If anyone testifies that None has the right to be worshipped but Allah Alone Who has no partners, and that Muhammad is His Slave and His Apostle, and that Jesus is Allah's Slave and His Apostle and His Word which He bestowed on Mary and a Spirit created by Him, and that Paradise is true, and Hell is true, Allah will admit him into Paradise with the deeds which he had done even if those deeds were few." (Junada, the sub-narrator said, " 'Ubada added, 'Such a person can enter Paradise through any of its eight gates he likes)
hi: Ubada bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Agar koi gawahi de ke Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahi, akela, jiska koi shareek nahi, aur Muhammad uske bande aur Rasool hain, aur Isa (bhi) Allah ke bande aur Rasool hain aur unka kalima jise usne Maryam ko diya, aur uska ek rooh jise usne paida kiya, aur ke Jannat sach hai aur Dozakh sach hai, Allah use apne kiye hue amalon ke saath Jannat mein daakhil karega chahe woh amal kam hi kyun na hon." (Junada, doosre raawi ne kaha, "Ubada ne joda, 'Aisa shaks Jannat ke aathon darwazon mein se jise chaahe usse daakhil ho sakta hai.'")

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "None spoke in cradle but three: (The first was) Jesus, (the second was), there was a man from Bani Israel called Juraij. While he was offering his prayers, his mother came and called him. He said (to himself), 'Shall I answer her or keep on praying?" (He went on praying) and did not answer her. His mother said, "O Allah! Do not let him die till he sees the faces of prostitutes." So while he was in his hermitage, a lady came and sought to seduce him, but he refused. So she went to a shepherd and presented herself to him to commit illegal sexual intercourse with her and then later she gave birth to a child and claimed that it belonged to Juraij. The people, therefore, came to him and dismantled his hermitage and expelled him out of it and abused him. Juraij performed the ablution and offered prayer, and then came to the child and said, 'O child! Who is your father?' The child replied, 'The shepherd.' (After hearing this) the people said, 'We shall rebuild your hermitage of gold,' but he said, 'No, of nothing but mud.'(The third was the hero of the following story) A lady from Bani Israel was nursing her child at her breast when a handsome rider passed by her. She said, 'O Allah ! Make my child like him.' On that the child left her breast, and facing the rider said, 'O Allah! Do not make me like him.' The child then started to suck her breast again. (Abu Huraira further said, "As if I were now looking at the Prophet (ﷺ) sucking his finger (in way of demonstration.") After a while the people passed by, with a lady slave and she (i.e. the child's mother) said, 'O Allah! Do not make my child like this (slave girl)!, On that the child left her breast and said, 'O Allah! Make me like her.' When she asked why, the child replied, 'The rider is one of the tyrants while this slave girl is falsely accused of theft and illegal sexual intercourse
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Kisi ne palne mein baat nahi ki siwaye teen ke: (Pahle) Isa; (doosre), Bani Israel mein ek shaks tha jise Juraij kaha jata tha. Jabke woh namaz padh rahe the, unki maa aee aur unhe pukara. Unhone (apne aap se) socha, 'Kya main unhe jawab dun ya namaz padhta rahoon?' (Woh namaz padhte rahe) aur jawab nahi diya. Unki maa ne kaha, 'Aye Allah! Ise tab tak mat marne de jab tak yeh beshva aurton ke chehre na dekh le.' Isliye jabke woh apni kuti mein the, ek aurat aee aur unhe bhatkane ki koshish ki, magar unhone inkaar kiya. Isliye woh ek charwahe ke paas gaee aur usse na-jaiz ta'alluq banaya, aur baad mein ek bachche ko paidaish diya aur daava kiya ke woh Juraij ka hai. Log unke paas aaye, unki kuti gira di aur unhe wahaan se nikal diya aur unhe gaaliyaan diya. Juraij ne wudu kiya aur namaz padhi, aur phir bachche ke paas aaye aur pucha, 'Aye bachche! Tumhara baap kaun hai?' Bachche ne jawab diya, 'Charwaha.' (Yeh sunkar) logon ne kaha, 'Hum tumhari kuti sona se banaenge,' magar unhone kaha, 'Nahi, mitti ke siwa kuch nahi.'" (Teesra kissa yeh hai:) Bani Israel ki ek aurat apne bachche ko doodh pila rahi thi jab ek khoobsurat ghudsawaar unke paas se guzra. Usne kaha, 'Aye Allah! Mere bachche ko unke jaisa bana.' Isspar bachche ne doodh chhod diya, aur ghudsawaar ki taraf mudkar kaha, 'Aye Allah! Mujhe unke jaisa mat bana.' Bachche ne phir doodh peena shuru kiya. (Abu Huraira ne aage kaha, "Mano abhi bhi main Nabi ko apni ungli chuste dekh raha hoon (yeh dikhane ke liye).") Thoda der baad log ek daasi ke saath guzre aur usne (yaani bachche ki maa ne) kaha, 'Aye Allah! Mere bachche ko is (daasi) jaisa mat bana!' Isspar bachche ne doodh chhod diya aur kaha, 'Aye Allah! Mujhe uske jaisa bana.' Jab usne pucha kyun, bachche ne jawab diya, 'Ghudsawaar zaalimon mein se ek tha jabke yeh daasi ke oopar chori aur galat ta'alluq ka jhuta ilzaam hai.'"

e: Narrated Hisham:From Ma`mar as below. Narrated Abu Huraira: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I met Moses on the night of my Ascension to heaven." The Prophet (ﷺ) then described him saying, as I think, "He was a tall person with lank hair as if he belonged to the people of the tribe of Shanuah.' The Prophet (ﷺ) further said, "I met Jesus." The Prophet (ﷺ) described him saying, "He was one of moderate height and was red-faced as if he had just come out of a bathroom. I saw Abraham whom I resembled more than any of his children did." The Prophet (ﷺ) further said, "(That night) I was given two cups; one full of milk and the other full of wine. I was asked to take either of them which I liked, and I took the milk and drank it. On that it was said to me, 'You have taken the right path (religion). If you had taken the wine, your (Muslim) nation would have gone astray
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Meri aasman ki chadhaee ki raat mujhe Musa se mulaqaat hui." Nabi ne phir unhe varnan karte huye kaha, mujhe lagta hai, "Woh ek lambe, seedhe baal wale shaks the, mano woh Shanua qabile ke logon mein se the." Nabi ne aage kaha, "Meri mulaqaat Isa se bhi hui." Nabi ne unhe varnan karte huye kaha, "Woh darmiyana qad aur laal chehre wale the, mano woh gusal se abhi bahar aaye hon. Maine Ibrahim ko dekha jinse main unki apni aulad se zyada milta-julta hoon." Nabi ne aage kaha, "(Us raat) mujhe do pyale diye gaye; ek doodh se bhara aur doosra sharab se bhara. Mujhe jo pasand ho lene ko kaha gaya, aur maine doodh liya aur piya. Isspar mujhse kaha gaya, 'Tumne sahi raasta (deen) chuna. Agar tum sharab lete, tumhari (Musalman) ummat bhatak jaati.'"

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I saw Moses, Jesus and Abraham (on the night of my Ascension to the heavens). Jesus was of red complexion, curly hair and a broad chest. Moses was of brown complexion, straight hair and tall stature as if he was from the people of Az-Zutt
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Maine Musa, Isa, aur Ibrahim ko dekha (meri aasman ki chadhaee ki raat). Isa laal rang, ghungrale baal, aur chaudi chhati wale the. Musa bhure rang, seedhe baal, aur lambe kad ke the, mano woh Az-Zutt qabile ke logon mein se hon."

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) mentioned the Masih Ad-Dajjal in front of the people saying, Allah is not one-eyed while Masih Ad-Dajjal is blind in the right eye and his eye looks like a bulging out grape. While sleeping near the Ka`ba last night, I saw in my dream a man of brown color the best one can see amongst brown color and his hair was long that it fell between his shoulders. His hair was lank and water was dribbling from his head and he was placing his hands on the shoulders of two men while circumambulating the Ka`ba. I asked, 'Who is this?' They replied, 'This is Jesus, son of Mary.' Behind him I saw a man who had very curly hair and was blind in the right eye, resembling Ibn Qatan (i.e. an infidel) in appearance. He was placing his hands on the shoulders of a person while performing Tawaf around the Ka`ba. I asked, 'Who is this? 'They replied, 'The Masih, Ad-Dajjal
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne logon ke saamne Al-Masih Ad-Dajjal ka zikar kiya, kehte huye, "Allah ek aankh wala nahi hai jabke Al-Masih Ad-Dajjal ki dahini aankh andhi hai aur uski aankh ubri hui angoor jaisi dikhti hai. Kal raat Ka'ba ke qareeb sote huye, maine khwab mein ek bhure rang ke shaks ko dekha, jitna behtareen bhura rang dekha ja sakta hai, aur unke baal itne lambe the ke woh unke kandhon ke beech gir rahe the. Unke baal seedhe the aur unke sar se paani tapak raha tha, aur woh apne haath do logon ke kandhon par rakhkar Ka'ba ka Tawaf kar rahe the. Maine pucha, 'Yeh kaun hain?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Yeh Isa, Maryam ke bete hain.' Unke peeche maine ek shaks dekha jinke baal bahut ghungrale the aur unki dahini aankh andhi thi, dikhne mein Ibn Qatan (yaani ek kaafir) jaise. Woh bhi apne haath ek shaks ke kandhon par rakhkar Ka'ba ka Tawaf kar rahe the. Maine pucha, 'Yeh kaun hain?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Al-Masih, Ad-Dajjal.'"

e: Narrated Salim from his father:No, By Allah, the Prophet (ﷺ) did not tell that Jesus was of red complexion but said, "While I was asleep circumambulating the Ka`ba (in my dream), suddenly I saw a man of brown complexion and lank hair walking between two men, and water was dropping from his head. I asked, 'Who is this?' The people said, 'He is the son of Mary.' Then I looked behind and I saw a red-complexioned, fat, curly-haired man, blind in the right eye which looked like a bulging out grape. I asked, 'Who is this?' They replied, 'He is Ad-Dajjal.' The one who resembled to him among the people was Ibn Qatan." (Az-Zuhri said, "He (i.e. Ibn Qatan) was a man from the tribe Khuza`a who died in the pre-Islamic period
hi: Salim, apne waalid ke hawale se, bataate hain: Nahi, Allah ki qasam, Nabi ne yeh nahi kaha ke Isa laal rang wale the, balki unhone kaha, "Jabke main sote hue Ka'ba ka Tawaf kar raha tha (apne khwab mein), achanak maine ek bhure rang ke, seedhe baal wale shaks ko do logon ke beech chalte dekha, aur unke sar se paani tapak raha tha. Maine pucha, 'Yeh kaun hain?' Logon ne kaha, 'Yeh Maryam ke bete hain.' Phir maine peeche dekha aur ek laal rang, mote, ghungrale baal wale shaks ko dekha, jinki dahini aankh andhi thi jo ubri hui angoor jaisi dikhti thi. Maine pucha, 'Yeh kaun hain?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Yeh Ad-Dajjal hain.' Logon mein unse sabse zyada milte-julte Ibn Qatan the." (Az-Zuhri ne kaha, "Woh (yaani Ibn Qatan) Khuza'a qabile ke ek shaks the jo Islam se pahle guzar gaye the.")

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "I am the nearest of all the people to the son of Mary, and all the prophets are paternal brothers, and there has been no prophet between me and him (i.e. Jesus)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool ko kehte suna, "Main sab logon mein Maryam ke bete se sabse nazdeek hoon, aur sab Nabi mama ki taraf se bhai hain, aur mere aur unke (yaani Isa ke) beech koi Nabi nahi aaya."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Both in this world and in the Hereafter, I am the nearest of all the people to Jesus, the son of Mary. The prophets are paternal brothers; their mothers are different, but their religion is one
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Duniya aur Aakhirat donon mein, main sab logon mein Isa, Maryam ke bete, se sabse nazdeek hoon. Nabi mama ki taraf se bhai hain; unki maata alag hain, magar unka deen ek hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Jesus, seeing a man stealing, asked him, 'Did you steal?, He said, 'No, by Allah, besides Whom there is none who has the right to be worshipped' Jesus said, 'I believe in Allah and suspect my eyes
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Isa ne ek shaks ko chori karte dekhkar unse pucha, 'Kya tumne chori ki?' Usne kaha, 'Nahi, us Zaat ki qasam jiske siwa koi mabood nahi.' Isa ne kaha, 'Main Allah par iman rakhta hoon, aur apni aankhon par shak karta hoon.'"

e: Narrated `Umar:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Do not exaggerate in praising me as the Christians praised the son of Mary, for I am only a Slave. So, call me the Slave of Allah and His Apostle
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi ko kehte suna, "Meri taarif mein zyadti mat karo jaisa Isaeeyon ne Maryam ke bete ki taarif ki, kyunke main sirf ek banda hoon. Isliye mujhe Allah ka banda aur uska Rasool kaho."

e: Narrated Abu Musa Al-Ash`ari:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If a person teaches his slave girl good manners properly, educates her properly, and then manumits and marries her, he will get a double reward. And if a man believes in Jesus and then believes in me, he will get a double reward. And if a slave fears his Lord (i.e. Allah) and obeys his masters, he too will get a double reward
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ash'ari bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Agar koi apni launDi ko achhi tarah adab sikhata hai, use theek se taalim deta hai, aur phir use azaad karke usse shaadi karta hai, use dohra ajr milega. Aur agar koi Isa par iman lata hai aur phir mujhpar (bhi) iman lata hai, use dohra ajr milega. Aur agar koi gulaam apne Rab se darta hai aur apne maalikon ki itaaat karta hai, use bhi dohra ajr milega."

e: Narrted Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "You will be resurrected (and assembled) bare-footed, naked and uncircumcised." The Prophet (ﷺ) then recited the Divine Verse:-- "As We began the first creation, We shall repeat it: A promise We have undertaken. Truly We shall do it." (21.104) He added, "The first to be dressed will be Abraham. Then some of my companions will take to the right and to the left. I will say: 'My companions! 'It will be said, 'They had been renegades since you left them.' I will then say what the Pious Slave Jesus, the son of Mary said: 'And I was a witness over them while I dwelt amongst them; when You did take me up, You were the Watcher over them, and You are a Witness to all things. If You punish them, they are Your slaves, and if You forgive them, You, only You are the All-Mighty the All-Wise.' " (5.117-118) Narrated Qabisah, "Those were the apostates who renegade from Islam during the Caliphate of Abu Bakr who fought them
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Tumhe (Qiyamat ke din) nange paanv, nange badan, aur khatna na hue jama kiya jaayega." Phir Nabi ne yeh Divine Ayat padhi: "Jaisa humne pahli takhleeq shuru ki, waisa hi hum ise dohraenge: Ek waada jo humne liya hai; sach mein hum aisa karenge." (21:104) Unhone joda, "Sabse pahle kapde pahnane wale Ibrahim honge. Phir mere kuch sathi dahine aur baaee taraf le jaye jayenge. Main kahunga: 'Mere sathi!' Kaha jaayega, 'Woh aapke jane ke baad se Islam se firte gaye.' Phir main wahi kahunga jo Allah ke neik bande Isa, Maryam ke bete, ne kaha: 'Aur main unpar gawaah tha jab tak main unke beech tha; jab tum ne mujhe upar uthaya, tum hi unpar nigraan the, aur tum har cheez ke gawaah ho. Agar tum unhe saza do, woh tumhare bande hain, aur agar tum unhe maaf kar do, tum hi, sirf tum, Sarvashaktimaan, Sarvagya ho.'" (5:117-118) Qabisa bataate hain, "Yeh woh log the jo Abu Bakr ki khilafat ke dauran Islam se firte gaye the aur jinse Abu Bakr ne jung ki."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "By Him in Whose Hands my soul is, surely (Jesus,) the son of Mary will soon descend amongst you and will judge mankind justly (as a Just Ruler); he will break the Cross and kill the pigs and there will be no Jizya (i.e. taxation taken from non Muslims). Money will be in abundance so that nobody will accept it, and a single prostration to Allah (in prayer) will be better than the whole world and whatever is in it." Abu Huraira added "If you wish, you can recite (this verse of the Holy Book): -- 'And there is none Of the people of the Scriptures (Jews and Christians) But must believe in him (i.e Jesus as an Apostle of Allah and a human being) Before his death. And on the Day of Judgment He will be a witness Against them." (4.159) (See Fath-ul-Bari, Page 302 Vol)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haathon mein meri jaan hai, jald hi Maryam ke bete (yaani Isa) tum mein utrenge aur (ek nishpaksh hukmaran ke tor par) logon ka insaaf se faisla karenge; woh cross todenge aur suaron ko qatl karenge, aur Jizya nahi liya jaayega (yaani gair-Musalmanon se tax). Paisa itna hoga ke koi ise lene se inkaar karega, aur ek Allah ke saamne sajda is duniya aur usme jo kuch hai usse behtar hoga." Abu Huraira ne joda, "Agar tum chaho, tum (Quran ki) yeh Ayat padh sakte ho: 'Aur Kitaab wale (Yahudi aur Isaee) koi bhi nahi jo unki (yaani Isa, Allah ke Rasool ke tor par aur ek insaan ke tor par) maut se pahle unpar iman na laae. Aur Qiyamat ke din woh unke khilaf gawaah honge.'" (4:159)

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said "How will you be when the son of Mary (i.e. Jesus) descends amongst you and your imam is among you
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Kaisi hogi tumhari haalat jab Maryam ke bete (yaani Isa) tum mein utrenge aur tumhara apna imam tum mein maujood hoga?"

e: Narrated Rabi bin Hirash:`Uqba bin `Amr said to Hudhaifa, "Won't you relate to us of what you have heard from Allah's Apostle ?" He said, "I heard him saying, "When Al-Dajjal appears, he will have fire and water along with him. What the people will consider as cold water, will be fire that will burn (things). So, if anyone of you comes across this, he should fall in the thing which will appear to him as fire, for in reality, it will be fresh cold water." Hudhaifa added, "I also heard him saying, 'From among the people preceding your generation, there was a man whom the angel of death visited to capture his soul. (So his soul was captured) and he was asked if he had done any good deed.' He replied, 'I don't remember any good deed.' He was asked to think it over. He said, 'I do not remember, except that I used to trade with the people in the world and I used to give a respite to the rich and forgive the poor (among my debtors). So Allah made him enter Paradise." Hudhaifa further said, "I also heard him saying, 'Once there was a man on his death-bed, who, losing every hope of surviving said to his family: When I die, gather for me a large heap of wood and make a fire (to burn me). When the fire eats my meat and reaches my bones, and when the bones burn, take and crush them into powder and wait for a windy day to throw it (i.e. the powder) over the sea. They did so, but Allah collected his particles and asked him: Why did you do so? He replied: For fear of You. So Allah forgave him." `Uqba bin `Amr said, "I heard him saying that the Israeli used to dig the grave of the dead (to steal their shrouds)
hi: Rabi bin Hirash bataate hain: Uqba bin Amr ne Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kaha, "Kya aap humein woh nahi sunaoge jo aapne Allah ke Rasool se suna hai?" Unhone kaha, "Maine unhe kehte suna, 'Jab Al-Dajjal aayega, uske saath aag aur paani hoga. Jise log thanda paani samajhenge, woh asal mein aag hogi jo (cheezein) jalaegi. Isliye agar tum mein se koi is (Dajjal) ka saamna kare, use us cheez mein girna chahiye jo use aag jaisi lagti hai, kyunke asal mein woh taaza thanda paani hoga.'" Hudhaifa ne joda, "Maine unhe yeh bhi kehte suna, 'Tumhare pahle ke logon mein se ek shaks tha jise Maut ka Farishta uski jaan lene aaya. (Isliye uski jaan li gaee) aur usse pucha gaya kya usne koi neik amal kiya hai. Usne jawab diya, \"Mujhe koi neik amal yaad nahi.\" Usse phir sochne ko kaha gaya. Usne kaha, \"Mujhe kuch yaad nahi, siwaye iske ke main duniya mein logon se vyaapaar karta tha aur ameeron ko muhlat deta tha aur gareebon (yaani apne karzdaron mein se) ko maaf kar deta tha.\" Isliye Allah ne use Jannat mein daakhil kiya.'" Hudhaifa ne aage kaha, "Maine unhe yeh bhi kehte suna, 'Ek baar ek shaks apni maut ke bistar par tha, aur zinda rehne ki har ummeed khokar apne pariwara se kaha: Jab main mar jaoon, mere liye lakdi ka ek bada dher jama karo aur aag jalao (mujhe jalane ke liye). Jab aag mera gosht khaa jaaye aur meri haddiyon tak pahunch jaaye, aur jab haddiyaan jal jaen, unhe lekar chur chura (bareek) kar do aur ek tez hawa wale din ka intezaar karo taake use samundar mein phenka ja sake. Unhone aisa hi kiya, magar Allah ne uske ansh (particles) jama kiye aur usse pucha: Tumne aisa kyun kiya? Usne jawab diya: Tere dar se. Isliye Allah ne use maaf kar diya.'" Uqba bin Amr ne kaha, "Maine unhe yeh bhi kehte suna ke Israeliyon ki aadat thi ke woh murde ki qabar khodte the (unka kafan churane ke liye)."

e: Narrated `Aisha and Ibn `Abbas:On his death-bed Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) put a sheet over his-face and when he felt hot, he would remove it from his face. When in that state (of putting and removing the sheet) he said, "May Allah's Curse be on the Jews and the Christians for they build places of worship at the graves of their prophets." (By that) he intended to warn (the Muslim) from what they (i.e. Jews and Christians) had done
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) aur Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Apni maut ke bistar par, Allah ke Rasool ne apne chehre par ek chaadar rakhi, aur jab unhe garmi mahsoos hoti, woh use apne chehre se hatate. Jab woh is haalat mein the (chaadar rakhte aur hatate huye), unhone kaha, "Allah ki laanat ho Yahudiyon aur Isaeeyon par, kyunke unhone apne Nabiyon ki qabron par ibadat ki jagahen banaee." (Isse) unka maqsad (Musalmanon ko) uske baare mein chetana tha jo unhone kiya.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The Israelis used to be ruled and guided by prophets: Whenever a prophet died, another would take over his place. There will be no prophet after me, but there will be Caliphs who will increase in number." The people asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What do you order us (to do)?" He said, "Obey the one who will be given the pledge of allegiance first. Fulfil their (i.e. the Caliphs) rights, for Allah will ask them about (any shortcoming) in ruling those Allah has put under their guardianship
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Israeliyon par Nabi hukmarani aur maargdarshan karte the: Jab bhi ek Nabi guzar jaate, doosra unki jagah leta. Mere baad koi Nabi nahi hoga, magar Khalifaen hongi jinki tadaad badhti jaayegi." Logon ne pucha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Aap humein kya hukum dete hain?" Unhone kaha, "Us shaks ki itaaat karo jise sabse pahle bai'at di jaaye. Unke (yaani Khalifon ke) haqq poore karo, kyunke Allah unse puchega unki hukumat mein jinke woh zimmedaar the, unke baare mein."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You will follow the wrong ways, of your predecessors so completely and literally that if they should go into the hole of a mastigure, you too will go there." We said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Do you mean the Jews and the Christians?" He replied, "Whom else?" (Meaning, of course, the Jews and the Christians)
hi: Abu Saeed bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Tum apne pichle logon ke galat raaston ko itni tarah aur haramamah se pairvi karoge ke agar woh kisi chhipkali ki bil mein bhi ghuse, tum bhi wahaan jaoge." Humne pucha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Kya aapka matlab Yahudi aur Isaee hain?" Unhone jawab diya, "Aur kaun?" (Yaani Yahudi aur Isaee hi tha)

e: Narrated Anas:The people mentioned the fire and the bell (as means proposed for announcing the time of prayer) and by such a suggestion they referred to the Jews and the Christians. But Bilal was ordered, "Pronounce the words of the Adhan (i.e. call for the prayer) twice and the Iqama once only
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Logon ne aag aur ghanti ka zikar kiya (namaz ka waqt batane ke tarike ke tor par), aur aisa sujhaa dekar unka ishara Yahudiyon aur Isaeeyon ki taraf tha. Magar Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko hukum diya gaya, "Adhan ke alfaaz do baar kaho aur Iqamat sirf ek baar."

e: Narrated `Aisha:That she used to hate that one should keep his hands on his flanks while praying. She said that the Jews used to do so
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Unhe napasand tha ke koi namaz padhte waqt apne haathon ko apni kamar ke bagal mein rakhe. Unhone kaha ke Yahudi aisa karte the.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Your period (i.e. the Muslims' period) in comparison to the periods of the previous nations, is like the period between the `Asr prayer and sunset. And your example in comparison to the Jews and the Christians is like the example of a person who employed some laborers and asked them, 'Who will work for me till midday for one Qirat each?' The Jews worked for half a day for one Qirat each. The person asked, 'Who will do the work for me from midday to the time of the `Asr (prayer) for one Qirat each?' The Christians worked from midday till the `Asr prayer for one Qirat. Then the person asked, 'Who will do the work for me from the `Asr till sunset for two Qirats each?' " The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "It is you (i.e. Muslims) who are doing the work from the `Asr till sunset, so you will have a double reward. The Jews and the Christians got angry and said, 'We have done more work but got less wages.' Allah said, 'Have I been unjust to you as regards your rights?' They said, 'No.' So Allah said, 'Then it is My Blessing which I bestow on whomever I like
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Tumhari (yaani Musalmanon ki) avadhi, pichli ummaton ki avadhiyon ke muqaable mein, Asr ki namaz aur suraj doobne ke beech ki avadhi jaisi hai. Aur Yahudiyon aur Isaeeyon ke muqaable mein tumhari misaal us shaks jaisi hai jisne kuch mazdoor rakhe aur unse pucha, 'Kaun dopahar tak mere liye kaam karega ek-ek Qirat ke liye?' Yahudiyon ne aadha din kaam kiya ek-ek Qirat ke liye. Us shaks ne pucha, 'Kaun mere liye dopahar se Asr ki namaz tak kaam karega ek-ek Qirat ke liye?' Isaeeyon ne dopahar se Asr tak kaam kiya ek-ek Qirat ke liye. Phir us shaks ne pucha, 'Kaun mere liye Asr se suraj doobne tak kaam karega do-do Qirat ke liye?'" Nabi ne joda, "Yeh tum ho (yaani Musalman) jo Asr se suraj doobne tak kaam karte ho, isliye tumhen dohra ajr milega. Yahudi aur Isaee naraaj ho gaye aur kaha, 'Humne zyada kaam kiya magar kam mazduri paee.' Allah ne kaha, 'Kya maine tumhare haqq ke saath na-insaafi ki?' Unhone kaha, 'Nahi.' Isliye Allah ne kaha, 'Phir yeh meri barkat hai jise main jise chaahun deta hoon.'"

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I heard `Umar saying, "May Allah Curse so-and-so! Doesn't he know that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'May Allah curse the Jews for, though they were forbidden (to eat) fat, they liquefied it and sold it
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko kehte suna, "Allah falaan-falaan ko laanit kare! Kya unhe nahi pata ke Nabi ne kaha, 'Allah Yahudiyon ko laanit kare, kyunke unhe charbi khaane se mana kiya gaya tha, magar unhone use pigalakar bech diya.'"

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Convey (my teachings) to the people even if it were a single sentence, and tell others the stories of Bani Israel (which have been taught to you), for it is not sinful to do so. And whoever tells a lie on me intentionally, will surely take his place in the (Hell) Fire
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "(Meri sikhaee) logon tak pahunchao chahe woh sirf ek jumla hi ho, aur logon ko Bani Israel ki kahaniyaan sunao (jo tumhe sikhaee gaee hain), kyunke isme koi gunah nahi. Aur jo bhi jaanboojhkar mujhpar jhoot bolta hai, use zaroor Dozakh mein apni jagah leni hogi."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The Jews and the Christians do not dye (their grey hair), so you shall do the opposite of what they do (i.e. dye your grey hair and beards)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Yahudi aur Isaee apne (safed) baal rangte nahi hain, isliye tum unse ulta karo (yaani apne safed baal aur daadhi ko rango)."

e: Narrated Jundub:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Amongst the nations before you there was a man who got a wound, and growing impatient (with its pain), he took a knife and cut his hand with it and the blood did not stop till he died. Allah said, 'My Slave hurried to bring death upon himself so I have forbidden him (to enter) Paradise
hi: Jundab bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Tumse pahle logon mein se ek shaks tha jise chot lagi, aur (dard se) besabri ho jane par, usne ek chaaku liya aur apne haath ko kaata, aur khoon tab tak nahi ruka jab tak woh mar gaya. Allah ne kaha, 'Mera banda jaldbaazi se apni khud ki maut laaya, isliye maine use Jannat (mein daakhil hone) se mana kar diya hai.'"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "Allah willed to test three Israelis who were a Leper, a blind man and a bald-headed man. So, he sent them an angel who came to the leper and said, 'What thing do you like most?' He replied, 'Good color and good skin, for the people have a strong aversion to me.' The angel touched him and his illness was cured, and he was given a good color and beautiful skin. The angel asked him, 'What kind of property do you like best?' He replied, 'Camels (or cows).' (The narrator is in doubt, for either the leper or the bald-headed man demanded camels and the other demanded cows). So he (i.e. the leper) was given a pregnant she-camel, and the angel said (to him), 'May Allah bless you in it.' The angel then went to the bald-headed man and said, 'What thing do you like most?' He said, 'I like good hair and wish to be cured of this disease, for the people feel repulsion for me.' The angel touched him and his illness was cured, and he was given good hair. The angel asked (him), 'What kind of property do you like best?' He replied, 'Cows,' The angel gave him a pregnant cow and said, 'May Allah bless you in it.' The angel went to the blind man and asked, 'What thing do you like best?' He said, '(I like) that Allah may restore my eye-sight to me so that I may see the people.' The angel touched his eyes and Allah gave him back his eye-sight. The angel asked him, 'What kind of property do you like best?' He replied, 'Sheep.' The angel gave him a pregnant sheep. Afterwards, all the three pregnant animals gave birth to young ones, and multiplied and brought forth so much that one of the (three) men had a herd of camels filling a valley, and one had a herd of cows filling a valley, and one had a flock of sheep filling a valley. Then the angel, disguised in the shape and appearance of a leper, went to the leper and said, I am a poor man, who has lost all means of livelihood while on a journey. So none will satisfy my need except Allah and then you. In the Name of Him Who has given you such nice color and beautiful skin, and so much property, I ask you to give me a camel so that I may reach my destination. The man replied, 'I have many obligations (so I cannot give you).' The angel said, 'I think I know you; were you not a leper to whom the people had a strong aversion? Weren't you a poor man, and then Allah gave you (all this property).' He replied, '(This is all wrong), I got this property through inheritance from my fore-fathers.' The angel said, 'If you are telling a lie, then let Allah make you as you were before. ' Then the angel, disguised in the shape and appearance of a bald man, went to the bald man and said to him the same as he told the first one, and he too answered the same as the first one did. The angel said, 'If you are telling a lie, then let Allah make you as you were before.' The angel, disguised in the shape of a blind man, went to the blind man and said, 'I am a poor man and a traveler, whose means of livelihood have been exhausted while on a journey. I have nobody to help me except Allah, and after Him, you yourself. I ask you in the Name of Him Who has given you back your eye-sight to give me a sheep, so that with its help, I may complete my journey.' The man said, 'No doubt, I was blind and Allah gave me back my eye-sight; I was poor and Allah made me rich; so take anything you wish from my property. By Allah, I will not stop you for taking anything (you need) of my property which you may take for Allah's sake.' The angel replied, 'Keep your property with you. You (i.e the three men) have been tested, and Allah is pleased with you and is angry with your two companions
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Unhone Allah ke Rasool ko kehte suna, "Allah ne teen Israeliyon ko aazmane ka faisla kiya jo ek kodhi, ek andha, aur ek ganja the. Isliye usne unke paas ek farishta bheja jo kodhi ke paas aakar pucha, 'Tumhe sabse zyada kya pasand hai?' Usne jawab diya, 'Achha rang aur achha chamda, kyunke log mujhse sakht nafrat karte hain.' Farishte ne unhe chhuya aur unki bimari theek ho gaee, aur unhe achha rang aur khoobsurat chamda diya gaya. Farishte ne unse pucha, 'Kaunsi qisam ki maal tumhe sabse zyada pasand hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Unt (ya gaaye).' (Raawi ko shak hai, ya to kodhi ne unt maange ya ganje ne aur doosre ne gaaye maangi.) Isliye unhe ek garbhvati untni di gaee aur farishte ne kaha (unse), 'Allah ise tumhare liye barkatvaar kare.' Farishta phir ganje ke paas gaya aur pucha, 'Tumhe sabse zyada kya pasand hai?' Usne kaha, 'Achhe baal pasand hain aur main is bimari se theek hona chahta hoon, kyunke log mujhse nafrat karte hain.' Farishte ne unhe chhuya aur unki bimari theek ho gaee, aur unhe achhe baal diye gaye. Farishte ne (unse) pucha, 'Kaunsi qisam ki maal tumhe sabse zyada pasand hai?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Gaaye,' Farishte ne unhe ek garbhvati gaay di aur kaha, 'Allah ise tumhare liye barkatvaar kare.' Farishta andhe ke paas gaya aur pucha, 'Tumhe sabse zyada kya pasand hai?' Usne kaha, '(Mujhe pasand hai ke) Allah meri nazar wapas de de taake main logon ko dekh sakoon.' Farishte ne unki aankhon ko chhuya aur Allah ne unhe unki nazar wapas de di. Farishte ne unse pucha, 'Kaunsi qisam ki maal tumhe sabse zyada pasand hai?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Bhedein.' Farishte ne unhe ek garbhvati bhed di. Baad mein, teen garbhvati janwaron ne bachche paidaish diye, aur itne badhe aur badhe ke ek shaks ke paas unton ka jhund tha jo ek poori wadi bhar deta, ek doosre ke paas gaayon ka jhund tha jo ek wadi bhar deta, aur teesre ke paas bhedon ka rewad tha jo ek wadi bhar deta. Phir farishta, kodhi jaisa soorat aur chehra dhaaran karke, kodhi ke paas gaya aur kaha, 'Main ek gareeb shaks hoon jisne apna rozi-roti ka zariya safar mein kho diya hai. Aaj koi mujhe santusht nahi kar sakta siwaye Allah ke aur phir tumhare. Us Zaat ke naam par jisne tumhe itna achha rang aur khoobsurat chamda diya, aur itni maal, main tumse guzarish karta hoon ke mujhe ek unt do taake main apni manzil tak pahunch sakoon.' Us shaks ne jawab diya, 'Mere upar kaee zimmedariyaan hain (isliye main nahi de sakta).' Farishta ne kaha, 'Mujhe lagta hai main tumhe pahchanta hoon; kya tum ek kodhi nahi the jinse log sakht nafrat karte the? Kya tum gareeb nahi the, aur phir Allah ne tumhe (yeh sab maal) di?' Usne jawab diya, '(Yeh sab galat hai), mujhe yeh maal apne pura-khon se waraasat mein mili hai.' Farishte ne kaha, 'Agar tum jhoot bol rahe ho, to Allah tumhe wapas usi haalat mein kar de jaisa tum pahle the.' Phir farishta, ek ganje shaks jaisa soorat dhaaran karke, ganje ke paas gaya aur unse wahi kaha jo pahle shaks se kaha tha, aur unhone bhi wahi jawab diya jo pahle shaks ne diya tha. Farishte ne kaha, 'Agar tum jhoot bol rahe ho, to Allah tumhe wapas usi haalat mein kar de jaisa tum pahle the.' Farishta, ek andhe shaks ka soorat dhaaran karke, andhe ke paas gaya aur kaha, 'Main ek gareeb aur musafir shaks hoon, jiska rozi-roti ka zariya safar mein khatam ho gaya hai. Mera koi madadgar nahi siwaye Allah ke aur uske baad, khud tum. Main tumse Us Zaat ke naam par guzarish karta hoon jisne tumhen tumhari nazar wapas di, mujhe ek bhed do, taake iski madad se main apna safar poora kar sakun.' Us shaks ne kaha, 'Beshak, main andha tha aur Allah ne mujhe meri nazar wapas di; main gareeb tha aur Allah ne mujhe ameer banaya; isliye mere maal se jo chaho le lo. Allah ki qasam, main tumhe tumhare maal se lene se nahi rokunga jo tum Allah ke liye lete ho.' Farishte ne jawab diya, 'Apni maal apne paas hi rakho. Tum (yaani teen shaks) aazmaye gaye ho, aur Allah tumse khush hai aur tumhare doosre saathiyon se naraaj hai.'"

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Once three persons (from the previous nations) were traveling, and suddenly it started raining and they took shelter in a cave. The entrance of the cave got closed while they were inside. They said to each other, 'O you! Nothing can save you except the truth, so each of you should ask Allah's Help by referring to such a deed as he thinks he did sincerely (i.e. just for gaining Allah's Pleasure).' So one of them said, 'O Allah! You know that I had a laborer who worked for me for one Faraq (i.e. three Sas) of rice, but he departed, leaving it (i.e. his wages). I sowed that Faraq of rice and with its yield I bought cows (for him). Later on when he came to me asking for his wages, I said (to him), 'Go to those cows and drive them away.' He said to me, 'But you have to pay me only a Faraq of rice,' I said to him, 'Go to those cows and take them, for they are the product of that Faraq (of rice).' So he drove them. O Allah! If you consider that I did that for fear of You, then please remove the rock.' The rock shifted a bit from the mouth of the cave. The second one said, 'O Allah, You know that I had old parents whom I used to provide with the milk of my sheep every night. One night I was delayed and when I came, they had slept, while my wife and children were crying with hunger. I used not to let them (i.e. my family) drink unless my parents had drunk first. So I disliked to wake them up and also disliked that they should sleep without drinking it, I kept on waiting (for them to wake) till it dawned. O Allah! If You consider that I did that for fear of You, then please remove the rock.' So the rock shifted and they could see the sky through it. The (third) one said, 'O Allah! You know that I had a cousin (i.e. my paternal uncle's daughter) who was most beloved to me and I sought to seduce her, but she refused, unless I paid her one-hundred Dinars (i.e. gold pieces). So I collected the amount and brought it to her, and she allowed me to sleep with her. But when I sat between her legs, she said, 'Be afraid of Allah, and do not deflower me but legally. 'I got up and left the hundred Dinars (for her). O Allah! If You consider that I did that for fear of You then please remove the rock. So Allah saved them and they came out (of the cave)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Ek baar teen log (pichle ummaton mein se) safar kar rahe the, aur achanak barish shuru ho gaee aur unhone ek gufa mein panah li. Gufa ka darwaza band ho gaya jabke woh andar the. Unhone ek-doosre se kaha, 'Aye tum sab! Sirf sach hi tumhe bacha sakta hai, isliye har ek ko apne aise kisi neik amal ka hawala dekar Allah se madad maangni chahiye jise usne sachche dil se kiya hai (yaani sirf Allah ki khushi ke liye).' Isliye unme se ek ne kaha, 'Aye Allah! Tujhe pata hai mere paas ek mazdoor tha jo mere liye ek Faraq (yaani teen Sa) chaawal ke liye kaam karta tha, magar woh apni mazdoori chhodkar chala gaya. Maine woh Faraq chaawal bo di aur uski paidawaar se (uske liye) gaaye khareedi. Baad mein jab woh mere paas apni mazdoori maangne aaya, maine (usse) kaha, \"Un gaayon ke paas jaao aur unhe le jaao.\" Usne mujhse kaha, \"Aapko to bas ek Faraq chaawal dena hai,\" maine unse kaha, \"Un gaayon ke paas jaao aur unhe le lo, kyunke woh us Faraq (chaawal) ki hi paidawaar hain.\" Isliye woh unhe le gaya. Aye Allah! Agar tune socha ke maine yeh Tere dar se kiya, to kripya patthar hataa de.' Patthar Gufa ke dahaane se thoda hat gaya. Doosre ne kaha, 'Aye Allah, Tujhe pata hai mere budhe maa-baap the jinhe main har raat apni bhedon ka doodh pilata tha. Ek raat mujhe der ho gaee aur jab main aaya, woh so chuke the, jabke meri biwi aur bachche bhookh se ro rahe the. Main unhe (yaani apne pariwara ko) doodh pilane nahi deta tha jab tak mere maa-baap pahle na pi len. Isliye mujhe unhe jagana napasand tha aur unhe bina pilaye sone dena bhi napasand tha, isliye main (unke jagne ka) intezaar karta raha jab tak subah ho gaee. Aye Allah! Agar tune socha ke maine yeh Tere dar se kiya, to kripya patthar hataa de.' Isliye patthar hat gaya aur woh aasman dekh sakte the. (Teesre ne) kaha, 'Aye Allah! Tujhe pata hai mere ek chachajaad behn thi jise main sabse zyada muhabbat karta tha aur maine unhe bhatkane ki koshish ki, magar unhone inkaar kiya jab tak main unhe sau Dinar (yaani sona ke sikke) na dun. Isliye maine woh raqam jama ki aur unhe dee, aur unhone mujhe apne saath sone diya. Magar jab main unke donon taangon ke beech baitha, unhone kaha, \"Allah se daro, aur mujhe jaiz tareeke ke bina apni kanya-shukrata se vaanchit mat karo.\" Main utha aur woh sau Dinar unhe chhod diya. Aye Allah! Agar tune socha ke maine yeh Tere dar se kiya, to kripya patthar hataa de.'" Isliye Allah ne unhe bachaya aur woh (gufa se) bahar aa gaye.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:That he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "While a lady was nursing her child, a rider passed by and she said, 'O Allah! Don't let my child die till he becomes like this (rider).' The child said, 'O Allah! Don't make me like him,' and then returned to her breast (sucking it). (After a while) they passed by a lady who was being pulled and teased (by the people). The child's mother said, 'O Allah! Do not make my child like her.' The child said, 'O Allah! Make me like her.' Then he said, 'As for the rider, he is an infidel, while the lady is accused of illegal sexual intercourse (falsely) and she says: Allah is sufficient for me (He knows the truth)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Unhone Allah ke Rasool ko kehte suna, "Jabke ek aurat apne bachche ko doodh pila rahi thi, ek ghudsawaar guzra aur usne kaha, 'Aye Allah! Mere bachche ko tab tak mat maar jab tak yeh iske (ghudsawaar ke) jaisa na ban jaaye.' Bachche ne kaha, 'Aye Allah! Mujhe unke jaisa mat bana,' aur phir doodh peena shuru kiya (dobara). (Thoda der baad) woh ek aurat ke paas se guzre jise (log) khinch rahe the aur pareshaan kar rahe the. Bachche ki maa ne kaha, 'Aye Allah! Mere bachche ko is (aurat) jaisa mat bana.' Bachche ne kaha, 'Aye Allah! Mujhe uske jaisa bana.' Phir usne kaha, 'Ghudsawaar ek kaafir tha, jabke aurat par (jhuta) zina ka ilzaam laga hai aur woh kahti hai: Allah mere liye kaafi hai (woh sach jaanta hai).'"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "While a dog was going round a well and was about to die of thirst, an Israeli prostitute saw it and took off her shoe and watered it. So Allah forgave her because of that good deed
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Jabke ek kutta ek kue ke gird ghoom raha tha aur pyaas se marne hi wala tha, ek Israeli beshva aurat ne use dekha aur apna joota utaara aur use paani pilaya. Isliye Allah ne is neik amal ki wajah se use maaf kar diya."

e: Narrated Humaid bin `Abdur-Rahman:That he heard Muawiya bin Abi Sufyan (talking) on the pulpit in the year when he performed the Hajj. He took a tuft of hair that was in the hand of an orderly and said, "O people of Medina! Where are your learned men? I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) forbidding such a thing as this (i.e. false hair) and he used to say, 'The Israelis were destroyed when their ladies practiced this habit (of using false hair to lengthen their locks)
hi: Humaid bin Abdur-Rahman bataate hain: Unhone Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko mimbar par (baat karte) suna, us saal jab unhone Hajj kiya. Unhone baal ka ek guchha liya jo ek khaddam ke haath mein tha aur kaha, "Aye Madina walo! Tumhare ilm wale kahaan hain? Maine Nabi ko aisi cheez (yaani jhoote baal) se mana karte suna, aur woh kahte the, 'Israeli barbaad ho gaye jab unki aurten yeh riwaj (jhoote baal istemal karke baal lambe karna) apnane lagi.'"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Amongst the people preceding you there used to be 'Muhaddithun' (i.e. persons who can guess things that come true later on, as if those persons have been inspired by a divine power), and if there are any such persons amongst my followers, it is `Umar bin Al-Khattab
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Tumse pahle logon mein 'Muhaddithun' (yaani woh log jo Divine ilham ki tarah cheezon ka andaaza laga sakte hain jo baad mein sach saabit hoti hain) hote the, aur agar mere pairokaron mein aise koi log hain, to woh Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab hain."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Amongst the men of Bani Israel there was a man who had murdered ninety-nine persons. Then he set out asking (whether his repentance could be accepted or not). He came upon a monk and asked him if his repentance could be accepted. The monk replied in the negative and so the man killed him. He kept on asking till a man advised to go to such and such village. (So he left for it) but death overtook him on the way. While dying, he turned his chest towards that village (where he had hoped his repentance would be accepted), and so the angels of mercy and the angels of punishment quarrelled amongst themselves regarding him. Allah ordered the village (towards which he was going) to come closer to him, and ordered the village (whence he had come), to go far away, and then He ordered the angels to measure the distances between his body and the two villages. So he was found to be one span closer to the village (he was going to). So he was forgiven
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Bani Israel ke logon mein ek shaks tha jisne ninyaanve logon ko qatl kiya tha. Phir woh yeh puchne nikla ke kya uski tauba qubool ho sakti hai. Woh ek sadhu ke paas pahunche aur pucha kya unki tauba qubool ho sakti hai. Sadhu ne \"nahi\" mein jawab diya, isliye us shaks ne unhe bhi qatl kar diya. Woh puchta raha jab tak ek shaks ne unhe falaan-falaan gaanv jane ki salaah di. (Isliye woh wahaan ke liye chala) magar raaste mein hi unki maut ho gaee. Marte waqt, unhone apna seena us gaanv ki taraf muda diya (jahaan unhe tauba qubool hone ki ummeed thi), isliye rehmat ke farishton aur azaab ke farishton ke beech unhe lekar jhagda hua. Allah ne us gaanv (jahaan woh ja rahe the) ko unke qareeb aane ka hukum diya, aur us gaanv (jahaan se woh aae the) ko door jane ka hukum diya, aur phir farishton ko unke jism aur donon gaanvon ke beech ki doori naapne ka hukum diya. Isliye woh us gaanv (jahaan ja rahe the) ke ek span zyada qareeb paaye gaye. Isliye unhe maaf kar diya gaya."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ); offered the morning prayer and then faced the people and said, "While a man was driving a cow, he suddenly rode over it and beat it. The cow said, "We have not been created for this, but we have been created for ploughing." On that the people said astonishingly, "Glorified be Allah! A cow speaks!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I believe this, and Abu Bakr and `Umar too, believe it, although neither of them was present there. While a person was amongst his sheep, a wolf attacked and took one of the sheep. The man chased the wolf till he saved it from the wolf, where upon the wolf said, 'You have saved it from me; but who will guard it on the day of the wild beasts when there will be no shepherd to guard them except me (because of riots and afflictions)? ' " The people said surprisingly, "Glorified be Allah! A wolf speaks!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "But I believe this, and Abu Bakr and `Umar too, believe this, although neither of them was present there." (See the Foot-note of page No. 10 Vol)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Allah ke Rasool ne subah ki namaz padhi aur logon ki taraf mude aur kaha, "Jabke ek shaks apni gaay hankata raha tha, achanak woh uspar sawar hua aur use maara. Gaay ne kaha, 'Humein iske liye nahi banaya gaya, balki hum kheti jotne ke liye banaye gaye hain.' Isspar log hairat se bole, 'Subhanallah! Ek gaay baat kar rahi hai!' Nabi ne kaha, \"Main ispar vishwas karta hoon, aur Abu Bakr aur Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bhi ispar vishwas karte hain, chahe woh donon wahaan maujood nahi the. Jabke ek shaks apni bheron ke saath tha, ek bhediya hamla karke ek bhed le gaya. Us shaks ne bhediye ka picha kiya jab tak usne use bhed se chheen liya, isspar bhediye ne kaha, 'Tumne ise mujhse bacha liya; magar us din kaun iski rakhwali karega jab jangli janwaron ka din hoga aur koi charwaha nahi hoga siwaye mere (yaani fitnon ke dauran)?'\" Log hairat se bole, \"Subhanallah! Ek bhediya baat kar raha hai!\" Nabi ne kaha, \"Main ispar vishwas karta hoon, aur Abu Bakr aur Umar bhi ispar vishwas karte hain, chahe woh donon wahaan maujood nahi the.\"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "A man bought a piece of land from another man, and the buyer found an earthenware jar filled with gold in the land. The buyer said to the seller. 'Take your gold, as I have bought only the land from you, but I have not bought the gold from you.' The (former) owner of the land said, "I have sold you the land with everything in it.' So both of them took their case before a man who asked, 'Do you have children?' One of them said, "I have a boy.' The other said, "I have a girl.' The man said, 'Marry the girl to the boy and spend the money on both of them and give the rest of it in charity
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Ek shaks ne doosre se zameen ka ek tukda khareeda, aur khareedar ko us zameen mein sona bhara ek matka mila. Khareedar ne bechne wale se kaha, 'Apna sona lo, kyunke maine tumse sirf zameen khareedi thi, sona nahi khareeda.' Zameen ke (pahle) maalik ne kaha, 'Maine tumhe zameen uske andar ki har cheez samet bech di hai.' Isliye donon apna maamla ek shaks ke saamne le gaye jisne pucha, 'Kya tumhare koi bachche hain?' Unme se ek ne kaha, 'Mera ek ladka hai.' Doosre ne kaha, 'Meri ek ladki hai.' Us shaks ne kaha, 'Ladki ki shaadi ladke se kar do aur sona un donon par kharch karo, aur baaki charitable kaamon mein dan karo.'"

e: Narrated Usama bin Zaid:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Plague was a means of torture sent on a group of Israelis (or on some people before you). So if you hear of its spread in a land, don't approach it, and if a plague should appear in a land where you are present, then don't leave that land in order to run away from it (i.e. plague)
hi: Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Talaee ek qisam ki saza thi jo kuch Israeliyon par (ya tumse pahle kuch logon par) bheji gaee thi. Isliye agar tum suno ke yeh kisi zameen mein phaila hai, wahaan mat jaao, aur agar yeh us zameen mein phel jaaye jahaan tum ho, wahaan se bhaagne ke liye us zameen ko mat chhodo."

e: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about the plague. He told me that it was a Punishment sent by Allah on whom He wished, and Allah made it a source of mercy for the believers, for if one in the time of an epidemic plague stays in his country patiently hoping for Allah's Reward and believing that nothing will befall him except what Allah has written for him, he will get the reward of a martyr
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool se talaee ke baare mein pucha. Unhone bataya ke yeh Allah ki taraf se ek saza thi jo usne jispar chaahe bhejta hai, aur Allah ne ise mominon ke liye ek rehmat ka zariya banaya, kyunke agar koi mahamari ke dauran apni zameen mein sabr se, Allah ke ajr ki ummeed rakhte huye, aur yeh vishwas rakhte huye ke uske saath sirf wahi hoga jo Allah ne uske liye likha hai, rehta hai, use ek shaheed jitna ajr milega.

e: Narrated `Aisha:The people of Quraish worried about the lady from Bani Makhzum who had committed theft. They asked, "Who will intercede for her with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" Some said, "No one dare to do so except Usama bin Zaid the beloved one to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ." When Usama spoke about that to Allah's Apostle Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, (to him), "Do you try to intercede for somebody in a case connected with Allah's Prescribed Punishments?" Then he got up and delivered a sermon saying, "What destroyed the nations preceding you, was that if a noble amongst them stole, they would forgive him, and if a poor person amongst them stole, they would inflict Allah's Legal punishment on him. By Allah, if Fatima, the daughter of Muhammad stole, I would cut off her hand
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Quraish qabile ke log Bani Makhzum ki us aurat ko lekar pareshaan the jisne chori ki thi. Unhone pucha, "Allah ke Rasool ke saamne uske liye kaun sifarish karega?" Kuchon ne kaha, "Iski himmat koi nahi karega siwaye Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke, jo Allah ke Rasool ke sabse pyare hain." Jab Usama ne Allah ke Rasool se is baare mein baat ki, Allah ke Rasool ne (unse) kaha, "Kya tum Allah ke muqarrar kiye hue dandon mein se ek ke maamle mein sifarish karte ho?" Phir woh khade hue aur khutba diya, kehte huye, "Jinhone tumse pahle ki ummaton ko barbaad kiya, woh yeh tha ke agar unme se koi izzatdaar shaks chori karta, woh use maaf kar dete, magar agar koi gareeb shaks chori karta, woh uspar Allah ka qanooni dand lagate. Allah ki qasam, agar Muhammad ki beti Fatima (Alayhas Salam) bhi chori karti, main uska haath kaat deta."

e: Narrated Ibn Mas`ud:I heard a person reciting a (Qur'anic) Verse in a certain way, and I had heard the Prophet (ﷺ) reciting the same Verse in a different way. So I took him to the Prophet (ﷺ) and informed him of that but I noticed the sign of disapproval on his face, and then he said, "Both of you are correct, so don't differ, for the nations before you differed, so they were destroyed
hi: Ibn Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine ek shaks ko ek Quranic Ayat ek tarike se padhte suna, aur maine Nabi ko wahi Ayat ek doosre tarike se padhte suna tha. Isliye main use Nabi ke paas le gaya aur unhe iske baare mein bataya, magar maine unke chehre par napasandgi ke asaraat dekhe, aur phir unhone kaha, "Tum donon sahi ho, isliye ikhtilaf mat karo, kyunke tumse pahle ki ummaten ikhtilaf ki wajah se barbaad hui thi."

e: Narrated `Abdullah:As if I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) talking about one of the prophets whose nation had beaten him and caused him to bleed, while he was cleaning the blood off his face and saying, "O Allah! Forgive my nation, for they have no knowledge
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Mano main abhi bhi Nabi ko ek Nabi (pichle ummaton ke) ke baare mein baat karte dekh raha hoon jise unki qaum ne maara tha aur khoon bahana diya tha, jabke woh apne chehre se khoon ponchhte huye keh rahe the, "Aye Allah! Meri qaum ko maaf kar de, kyunke unhe ilm nahi hai."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Amongst the people preceding your age, there was a man whom Allah had given a lot of money. While he was in his death-bed, he called his sons and said, 'What type of father have I been to you? They replied, 'You have been a good father.' He said, 'I have never done a single good deed; so when I die, burn me, crush my body, and scatter the resulting ashes on a windy day.' His sons did accordingly, but Allah gathered his particles and asked (him), 'What made you do so?' He replied, 'Fear of You.' So Allah bestowed His Mercy upon him (forgave him)
hi: Abu Saeed bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Tumse pahle ke daur mein, ek shaks tha jise Allah ne bahut zyada daulat di thi. Jabke woh maut ke bistar par the, unhone apne beton ko bulaya aur kaha, 'Main tumhare liye kaisa baap raha hoon?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Aap ek achha baap rahe hain.' Unhone kaha, 'Maine kabhi ek bhi neik amal nahi kiya; isliye jab main mar jaun, mujhe jala do, mera jism chur karo, aur raakh ko ek tez hawa wale din bikher dena.' Unke beton ne aisa hi kiya, magar Allah ne unke ansh (particles) jama kiye aur unse pucha, 'Tumne aisa kyun kiya?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Tere dar se.' Isliye Allah ne unpar apni rehmat naazil ki (unhe maaf kiya)."

e: Narrated Rabi` bin Hirash:`Uqba said to Hudhaifa, "Won't you narrate to us what you heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ?" Hudhaifa said, "I heard him saying, 'Death approached a man and when he had no hope of surviving, he said to his family, 'When I die, gather for me much wood and build a fire (to burn me),. When the fire has eaten my flesh and reached my bones, take the bones and grind them and scatter the resulting powder in the sea on a hot (or windy) day.' (That was done.) But Allah collected his particles and asked (him), 'Why did you do so?' He replied, 'For fear of You.' So Allah forgave him." Narrated `Abdul Malik: As above, saying, "On a windy day
hi: Rabi bin Hirash bataate hain: Uqba ne Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kaha, "Kya aap humein woh nahi sunaoge jo aapne Allah ke Rasool se suna hai?"
