Hudhaifa ne kaha, "Maine unhe kehte suna, 'Ek shaks ki maut qareeb aee, aur jab unhe zinda rehne ki koi ummeed nahi rahi, unhone apne pariwara se kaha, \"Jab main mar jaun, mere liye bahut sara lakdi jama karo aur aag jalana (mujhe jalane ke liye). Jab aag mera gosht khaa le aur meri haddiyon tak pahunch jaaye, haddiyon ko lekar piso aur raakh ko samundar mein ek garam (ya tez hawa wale) din bikher dena.\" (Aisa hi kiya gaya.) Magar Allah ne unke ansh jama kiye aur unse pucha, \"Tumne aisa kyun kiya?\" Unhone jawab diya, \"Tere dar se.\" Isliye Allah ne unhe maaf kar diya.'" Abdul Malik ne isi tarah bataya, kehte huye, "Tez hawa wale din."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "A man used to give loans to the people and used to say to his servant, 'If the debtor is poor, forgive him, so that Allah may forgive us.' So when he met Allah (after his death), Allah forgave him
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Ek shaks logon ko qarz deta tha aur apne khaddam se kehta tha, 'Agar qarzdaar gareeb hai, use maaf kar do, taake Allah humein bhi maaf kare.' Isliye jab woh Allah se mile (apni maut ke baad), Allah ne unhe maaf kar diya."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A man used to do sinful deeds, and when death came to him, he said to his sons, 'After my death, burn me and then crush me, and scatter the powder in the air, for by Allah, if Allah has control over me, He will give me such a punishment as He has never given to anyone else.' When he died, his sons did accordingly. Allah ordered the earth saying, 'Collect what you hold of his particles.' It did so, and behold! There he was (the man) standing. Allah asked (him), 'What made you do what you did?' He replied, 'O my Lord! I was afraid of You.' So Allah forgave him. " Another narrator said "The man said, Fear of You, O Lord
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Ek shaks gunahon bhare kaam karta tha, aur jab unki maut aee, unhone apne beton se kaha, 'Mere maut ke baad, mujhe jala dena aur phir mujhe chur karna, aur raakh ko hawa mein bikher dena, kyunke, Allah ki qasam, agar Allah ka mujhpar kaboo raha, woh mujhe aisi saza dega jaisi usne kisi ko nahi di.' Jab unka intiqal hua, unke beton ne aisa hi kiya. Allah ne zameen ko hukum diya, 'Jo bhi tumhare paas uske ansh hain, unhe jama karo.' Zameen ne aisa hi kiya, aur dekho! Woh shaks wahaan khade the. Allah ne (unse) pucha, 'Tumne aisa kyun kiya?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Aye mere Rab! Mujhe Tera dar tha.' Isliye Allah ne unhe maaf kar diya." (Doosre raawi ne kaha ke shaks ne kaha "Tere dar se, Aye Rab.")

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "A lady was punished because of a cat which she had imprisoned till it died. She entered the (Hell) Fire because of it, for she neither gave it food nor water as she had imprisoned it, nor set it free to eat from the vermin of the earth
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Ek aurat ko ek billi ki wajah se saza di gaee jise usne qaid mein rakha jab tak woh mar gaee. Woh iske liye Dozakh ki aag mein daakhil hui, kyunke usne na to use khaana diya na paani, jabke use qaid mein rakha tha, na hi use aazad chhoda taake woh zameen ke keede-makode kha sake."

e: Narrated Abu Masud: `Uqba said:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "One of the sayings of the prophets which the people have got is, 'If you do not feel ashamed, then do whatever you like
hi: Abu Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Uqba ne kaha, Nabi ne kaha, "Nabiyon ki baaton mein se jo logon ko mila hai woh yeh hai: 'Agar tumhe sharam nahi aati, to jo chaho karo.'"

e: Narrated Abu Mas'ud:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "One of the sayings of the prophets which the people have got is, 'If you do not feel ashamed, then do whatever you like
hi: Abu Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Nabiyon ki baaton mein se jo logon ko mila hai woh yeh hai: 'Agar tumhe sharam nahi aati, to jo chaho karo.'"

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "While a man was walking, dragging his dress with pride, he was caused to be swallowed by the earth and will go on sinking in it till the Day of Resurrection
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Jabke ek shaks ghamand se apna libaas ghaseetta hua chal raha tha, unhe zameen mein nigal liya gaya, aur woh Qiyamat tak usme dhaanste rahenge."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "We are the last (to come) but we will be the foremost on the Day of Resurrection, nations were given the Book (i.e. Scripture) before us, and we were given the Holy Book after them. This (i.e. Friday) is the day about which they differed. So the next day (i.e. Saturday) was prescribed for the Jews and the day after it (i.e. Sunday) for the Christians. It is incumbent on every Muslim to wash his head and body on a Day (i.e. Friday) (at least) in every seven days
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Hum (Musalman) sabse aakhri (aane wale) hain, magar Qiyamat ke din sabse aage honge. Doosri ummaton ko humse pahle Kitaab di gaee thi, aur humein unke baad Paak Kitaab di gaee. Yeh (yaani Jumme ka din) woh din hai jispar unmein ikhtilaf hua. Isliye agla din (yaani Shanivaar) Yahudiyon ke liye muqarrar kiya gaya, aur uske baad wala (yaani Ravivaar) Isaeeyon ke liye. Har Musalman ke liye zaroori hai ke woh har saat din mein ek din (yaani Jumme ko) apna sar aur badan dhoye (yaani ghusal kare)."

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Al-Musaiyab:When Muawiya bin Abu Sufyan came to Medina for the last time, he delivered a sermon before us. He took out a tuft of hair and said, "I never thought that someone other than the Jews would do such a thing (i.e. use false hair). The Prophet (ﷺ) named such a practice, 'Az-Zur' (i.e. falsehood)," meaning the use of false hair
hi: Sa'id bin Al-Musaiyab bataate hain: Jab Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ) aakhri baar Madina aaye, unhone humare saamne ek khutba diya. Unhone baal ka ek guchha nikala aur kaha, "Maine kabhi nahi socha ke Yahudiyon ke ilawa koi doosra aisa kaam (yaani jhoote baal ka istemal) karega." Nabi ne aisi riwaj ko 'Az-Zur' (yaani jhoot, dhoka) ka naam diya, matlab jhoote baal ka istemal.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Regarding the Verse: 'And (We) made you into Shu'ub and Qabail-- (49.13) that Shu'ub means the big Qabail (i.e. nations) while the Qabail (i.e. tribes) means the branch tribes
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Is Ayat ke baare mein: "Aur (humne) tumhe Shu'ub aur Qabaail banaya..." (49:13) — Shu'ub ka matlab hai bade Qabaail (yaani rashtriya samuh), jabke Qabaail ka matlab hai unki shaakhaee qabile.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked, "Who is the most honorable amongst the people?" He said, "The most righteous (i.e. Allah-fearing) amongst you." They said, "We do not ask you about this." He said, "Then Joseph, the prophet of Allah
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Allah ke Rasool se pucha gaya, "Sab logon mein sabse izzatdaar kaun hai?" Unhone kaha, "Tum mein sabse zyada pakbaz (Allah se darne wala)." Unhone kaha, "Hum aapse yeh nahi puchna chahte." Unhone kaha, "Phir Yusuf, Allah ke Nabi."

e: Narrated Kulaib bin Wail:I asked Zainab bint Abi Salama (i.e. daughter of the wife of the Prophet, "Tell me about the Prophet (ﷺ) . Did he belong to the tribe of Mudar?" She replied, "Yes, he belonged to the tribe of Mudar and was from the offspring of An-Nadr bin Kinana
hi: Kulaib bin Wail bataate hain: Maine Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Abi Salama (yaani Nabi ki biwi ki beti) se pucha, "Mujhe Nabi ke baare mein bataiye. Kya woh Mudar qabile se the?" Unhone jawab diya, "Haan, woh Mudar qabile se the aur An-Nadr bin Kinana ki aulad the."

e: Narrated Kulaib:I was told by the Rabiba (i.e. daughter of the wife of the Prophet) who, I think, was Zainab, that the Prophet (forbade the utensils (of wine called) Ad-Dubba, Al-Hantam, Al-Muqaiyar and Al-Muzaffat. I said to her, 'Tell me as to which tribe the Prophet (ﷺ) belonged; was he from the tribe of Mudar?'' She replied, "He belonged to the tribe of Mudar and was from the offspring of An-Nadr bin Kinana
hi: Kulaib bataate hain: Mujhe Rabiba (yaani Nabi ki biwi ki beti) ne bataya, jinke baare mein mujhe lagta hai woh Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) thi, ke Nabi ne Ad-Dubba, Al-Hantam, Al-Muqaiyar, aur Al-Muzaffat (yaani sharaab banane ke bartan) istemal karne se mana kiya. Maine unse pucha, "Mujhe bataiye Nabi kaunse qabile se the; kya woh Mudar qabile se the?" Unhone jawab diya, "Woh Mudar qabile se the aur An-Nadr bin Kinana ki aulad the."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "You see that the people are of different natures. Those who were the best in the pre-Islamic period, are also the best in Islam if they comprehend religious knowledge. You see that the best amongst the people in this respect (i.e. ambition of ruling) are those who hate it most. And you see that the worst among people is the double faced (person) who appears to these with one face and to the others with another face (i.e a hypocrite)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Tum dekhte ho ke log alag-alag fitrat ke hote hain. Jo jahiliyat ke daur mein sabse behtar the, woh Islam mein bhi sabse behtar hain, agar unhe deeni ilm ho jaaye. Tum dekhte ho ke sab logon mein is (hukmarani ki cheshta) mein sabse behtar woh hain jo isse sabse zyada nafrat karte hain. Aur tum dekhte ho ke sab logon mein sabse bura do-chehre wala shaks hota hai jo ek ko ek chehra dikhata hai aur doosre ko doosra chehra (yaani munafik)."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The tribe of Quraish has precedence over the people in this connection (i.e the right of ruling). The Muslims follow the Muslims amongst them, and the infidels follow the infidels amongst them. People are of different natures: The best amongst them in the pre-Islamic period are the best in Islam provided they comprehend the religious knowledge. You will find that the best amongst the people in this respect (i.e. of ruling) is he who hates it (i.e. the idea of ruling) most, till he is given the pledge of allegiance
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Quraish qabile ko is maamle (yaani hukmarani ke haqq) mein logon par pahle haqq hai. Musalman unme se Musalmanon ki pairvi karte hain, aur kaafir unme se kaafiron ki. Log alag-alag fitrat ke hote hain: Jahiliyat ke daur mein sabse behtar, Islam mein bhi sabse behtar hain, bashart ke unhe deeni ilm ho jaaye. Tum paoge ke ismein (yaani hukmarani mein) sabse behtar woh hai jo ise sabse zyada napasand karta hai, jab tak use bai'at nahi di jaati."

e: Narrated Tawus:Ibn `Abbas recited the Qur'anic Verse:--'Except to be kind to me for my kin-ship to you--" (42.23) Sa`id bin Jubair said, "(The Verse implies) the kinship of Muhammad." Ibn `Abbas said, "There was not a single house (i.e. sub-tribe) of Quraish but had a kinship to the Prophet (ﷺ) and so the above Verse was revealed in this connection, and its interpretation is: 'O Quraish! You should keep good relation between me (i.e. Muhammad) and you
hi: Tawus bataate hain: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne yeh Quranic Ayat padhi: "Siwaaye is ke ke mere rishte ke prati narmi rakho..." (42:23) Sa'id bin Jubair ne kaha, "(Is Ayat ka matlab hai) Muhammad ke saath rishta." Ibn Abbas ne kaha, "Quraish ka koi bhi ghar (yaani upa-qabila) aisa nahi tha jiska Nabi se koi rishta na ho, aur isliye yeh Ayat isi silsile mein nazil hui, aur iska matlab hai: 'Aye Quraish! Tumhe mere (yaani Muhammad ke) aur apne beech achhe ta'alluq rakhne chahiye.'"

e: Narrated Abi Mas`ud:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "From this side from the east, afflictions will appear. Rudeness and lack of mercy are characteristics of the rural bedouins who are busy with their camels and cows (and pay no attention to religion). Such are the tribes of Rabi`a and Mudar
hi: Abu Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Is taraf se, purab se, fitnen prakat hongi. Berahmi aur rehm ki kami dehati beduinon ki khasiyat hain jo apne unton aur gayon mein masroof rahte hain (aur deen par dhyaan nahi dete). Aise hain Rabi'a aur Mudar qabile."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "Pride and arrogance are characteristics of the rural bedouins while calmness is found among the owners of sheep. Belief is Yemenite, and wisdom is also Yemenite i.e. the Yemenites are well-known for their true belief and wisdom)." Abu `Abdullah (Al-Bukhari) said, "Yemen was called so because it is situated to the right of the Ka`ba, and Sham was called so because it is situated to the left of the Ka`ba
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool ko kehte suna, "Ghamand aur ghaman dehati beduinon ki khasiyat hain, jabke shaanti bhed-bakriyon ke maalikon mein paee jaati hai. Iman Yemen se hai, aur hikmat bhi Yemen se hai (yaani Yemen ke log apne sachche iman aur hikmat ke liye jaane jate hain)." Abu Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) (Al-Bukhari) ne kaha, "Yemen ka naam isliye pada kyunke woh Ka'ba ki dahini taraf hai, aur Sham ka naam isliye pada kyunke woh Ka'ba ki baaee taraf hai."

e: Narrated Muhammad bin Jubair bin Mut`im:That while he was with a delegation from Quraish to Muawiya, the latter heard the news that `Abdullah bin `Amr bin Al-`As said that there would be a king from the tribe of Qahtan. On that Muawiya became angry, got up and then praised Allah as He deserved, and said, "Now then, I have heard that some men amongst you narrate things which are neither in the Holy Book, nor have been told by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Those men are the ignorant amongst you. Beware of such hopes as make the people go astray, for I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, 'Authority of ruling will remain with Quraish, and whoever bears hostility to them, Allah will destroy him as long as they abide by the laws of the religion
hi: Muhammad bin Jubair bin Mut'im bataate hain: Jabke woh Quraish ke ek wafd ke saath Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas the, Muawiya ko yeh khabar mili ke Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-As ne kaha hai ke Qahtan qabile se ek raja aayega. Isspar Muawiya naraaj ho gaye, khade hue aur Allah ki jaisi hamd honi chahiye vaisi ki, aur kaha, "Ab, maine suna hai ke tum mein se kuch log aisi baaten kehte hain jo na Paak Kitaab mein hain, na Allah ke Rasool ne kahi hain. Woh log tum mein se najaan hain. Aisi ummeedon se bacho jo logon ko bhatkati hain, kyunke maine Allah ke Rasool ko kehte suna, 'Hukumat ka ikhtiyar Quraish ke paas rahega, aur jo bhi unse dushmani rakhega, Allah use barbaad karega jab tak woh deen ke qawaanin ka paalan karte hain.'"

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Authority of ruling will remain with Quraish, even if only two of them remained
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Hukumat ka ikhtiyar Quraish ke paas rahega, chahe unme se sirf do hi bache hon."

e: Narrated Jubair bin Mut`im:`Uthman bin `Affan went (to the Prophet) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! You gave property to Bani Al-Muttalib and did not give us, although we and they are of the same degree of relationship to you." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Only Bani Hashim and Bani Al Muttalib are one thing (as regards family status)
hi: Jubair bin Mut'im bataate hain: Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Affan (Nabi ke paas) gaye aur kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Aapne Bani Al-Muttalib ko maal di, magar humein nahi di, chahe hum aur woh aapse ek jaise rishte ke hain." Nabi ne kaha, "Sirf Bani Hashim aur Bani Al-Muttalib ek hi cheez hain (khaandaan ke darja ke hisaab se)."

e: Narrated `Urwa bin Az-Zubair: `Abdullah bin Az-Zubair went with some women of the tribe of Bani Zuhra to `Aisha who used to treat them nicely because of their relation to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
hi: Urwa bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Az-Zubair Bani Zuhra qabile ki kuch aurton ke saath Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas gaye, jo unse achha suluk rakhti thi kyunke unka Allah ke Rasool se rishta tha.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The tribe of Quraish, the Ansar, the (people of the tribe of) Julhaina, Muzaina, Aslam, Ashja', and Ghifar are my disciples and have no protectors except Allah and His Apostle
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Quraish qabile, Ansaar, aur (Juhaina, Muzaina, Aslam, Ashja, aur Ghifar qabile ke) log mere pairokaar hain aur unka Allah aur uske Rasool ke siwa koi doosra sarparast nahi hai."

e: Narrated `Urwa bin Az-Zubair:`Abdullah bin Az-Zubair was the most beloved person to `Aisha excluding the Prophet (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr, and he in his turn, was the most devoted to her, `Aisha used not to withhold the money given to her by Allah, but she used to spend it in charity. (`Abdullah) bin Az-Zubair said, " `Aisha should be stopped from doing so." (When `Aisha heard this), she said protestingly, "Shall I be stopped from doing so? I vow that I will never talk to `Abdullah bin Az-Zubair." On that, Ibn Az-Zubair asked some people from Quraish and particularly the two uncles of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to intercede with her, but she refused (to talk to him). Az-Zuhriyun, the uncles of the Prophet, including `Abdur-Rahman bin Al-Aswad bin `Abd Yaghuth and Al-Miswar bin Makhrama said to him, "When we ask for the permission to visit her, enter her house along with us (without taking her leave)." He did accordingly (and she accepted their intercession). He sent her ten slaves whom she manumitted as an expiation for (not keeping) her vow. `Aisha manumitted more slaves for the same purpose till she manumitted forty slaves. She said, "I wish I had specified what I would have done in case of not fulfilling my vow when I made the vow, so that I might have done it easily
hi: Urwa bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Az-Zubair, Nabi aur Abu Bakr ke ilawa, Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke sabse pyare the, aur woh (yaani Abdullah) bhi unke sabse samarpit the. Ayesha jo paisa unhe milta, use chhupakar nahi rakhti thi, balki charity mein kharch kar deti thi. Abdullah bin Az-Zubair ne kaha, "Ayesha ko aisa karne se roka jaana chahiye." (Jab Ayesha ne yeh suna), unhone apmaanit hokar kaha, "Kya mujhe aisa karne se roka jaayega? Main qasam khati hoon ke main kabhi Abdullah bin Az-Zubair se baat nahi karungi." Isspar, Ibn Az-Zubair ne Quraish ke kuch logon se, khaaskar Allah ke Rasool ke do chachon se, unse sifarish karne ko kaha, magar unhone (unse baat karne se) inkaar kiya. Az-Zuhriyun, Nabi ke chache, jinme Abdur-Rahman bin Al-Aswad bin Abd Yaghuth aur Al-Miswar bin Makhrama (رضی اللہ عنہ) shaamil the, unhone unse (Abdullah se) kaha, "Jab hum unse milne ki ijazat maangenge, tum humare saath unke ghar daakhil ho jaana (bina unse ijazat lere)." Unhone aisa hi kiya (aur Ayesha ne unki sifarish qubool ki). Unhone (Abdullah ne) unhe das gulaam bheje jinhe unhone apni qasam (na todne) ke kaffara ke tor par azaad kar diya. Ayesha ne isi maksad ke liye aur bhi gulaam azaad kiye jab tak unhone chaalis gulaam azaad kar diye. Unhone kaha, "Kaash maine apni qasam lete waqt yeh nishchit kar liya hota ke agar main use poora nahi kar paee to kya karungi, taake main use aasaani se poora kar paati."

e: Narrated Anas:`Uthman called Zaid bin Thabit, `Abdullah bin Az-Zubair, Sa`id bin Al-`As and `AbdurRahman bin Al-Harith bin Hisham, and then they wrote the manuscripts of the Holy Qur'an in the form of book in several copies. `Uthman said to the three Quraishi persons, "If you differ with Zaid bin Thabit on any point of the Qur'an, then write it in the language of Quraish, as the Qur'an was revealed in their language." So they acted accordingly. (Zaid bin Thabit was an Ansari and not from Quraish)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Zaid bin Thabit (رضی اللہ عنہ), Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ), Sa'id bin Al-As, aur Abdur-Rahman bin Al-Harith bin Hisham ko bulaya, aur unhone Paak Quran ki likhi hui kapiyaan kaee hison mein taiyaar ki. Uthman ne teen Quraishi logon se kaha, "Agar tumhari Zaid bin Thabit se Quran ki kisi baat par asahamti ho, use Quraish ki bhaasha mein likho, kyunke Quran unki bhaasha mein nazil hua tha." Isliye unhone aisa hi kiya. (Zaid bin Thabit ek Ansari the, Quraish se nahi.)

e: Narrated Salama:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) passed by some people from the tribe of Aslam practicing archery. He said, "O children of Ishmael! Throw (arrows), for your father was an archer. I am on the side of Bani so-and-so," meaning one of the two teams. The other team stopped throwing, whereupon the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "What has happened to them?" They replied, "How shall we throw while you are with Bani so-and-so?" He said, "Throw for I am with all of you
hi: Salama bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool Aslam qabile ke kuch logon ke paas se guzre jo tirandaazi kar rahe the. Unhone kaha, "Aye Ismail ki aulad! Teer chalao, kyunke tumhare baap ek tirandaaz the. Main falaan-falaan ke saath hoon," ek team ki taraf ishara karte huye. Doosri team ne teer chalana band kar diya, isspar Nabi ne pucha, "Unhe kya hua hai?" Unhone jawab diya, "Hum kaise chalaen jabke aap falaan-falaan ke saath hain?" Unhone kaha, "Chalate raho, main tum sabko ke saath hoon."

e: Narrated Abu Dhar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If somebody claims to be the son of any other than his real father knowingly, he but disbelieves in Allah, and if somebody claims to belong to some folk to whom he does not belong, let such a person take his place in the (Hell) Fire
hi: Abu Dharr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Agar koi jaanboojhkar apne asli baap ke siwa kisi aur ka beta hone ka daava kare, usne Allah ka inkaar kiya hai, aur agar koi apne aap ko kisi aise qabile ka batata hai jiska woh nahi hai, use apni jagah Dozakh mein leni chahiye."

e: Narrated Wathila bin Al-Asqa:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Verily, one of the worst lies is to claim falsely to be the son of someone other than one's real father, or to claim to have had a dream one has not had, or to attribute to me what I have not said
hi: Wathila bin Al-Asqa bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Sach mein, sabse bure jhooton mein se ek hai apne asli baap ke siwa kisi aur ka beta hone ka jhuta daava karna, ya aisa khwab dekhne ka daava karna jo dekha na ho, ya mere naam se woh kehna jo maine nahi kaha."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The delegates of `Abd-ul-Qais came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We are from the tribe of Rabi`a and the infidels of Mudar tribe stand between us and you, so that we cannot come to you except in the Sacred Months. Therefore we would like you to give us some instructions which we may follow and convey to our people staying behind us." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I order you to observe four things and forbid you (to do) four things: (I order you) to believe in Allah testifying that None has the right to be worshipped except Allah; to offer the prayer perfectly; to pay the Zakat; and to give one-fifth of the war booty to Allah. And I forbid you to use Ad-Dubba, Al-Hantam, An-Naqir and Al- Muzaffat." (These are names of utensils in which alcoholic drinks were served)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abdul-Qais qabile ke wafd Allah ke Rasool ke paas aaye aur kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Hum Rabi'a qabile se hain aur Mudar qabile ke kaafir humare aur aapke beech hain, isliye hum aapke paas sirf muqaddas mahinon mein aa sakte hain. Isliye humein kuch hidayaat dijiye jinhe hum khud amal karen aur apne peeche chhode logon ko bhi batayen." Nabi ne kaha, "Main tumhe chaar cheezon ka hukum deta hoon aur chaar cheezon se mana karta hoon: (Hukum deta hoon) ke tum Allah par iman rakho, gawahi dekar ke Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahi; namaz mukammal padho; Zakat do; aur maal-e-ghanimat ka paanchvaan hissa Allah ko do. Aur main tumhe Ad-Dubba, Al-Hantam, An-Naqir, aur Al-Muzaffat (yaani sharab banane ke bartan) se mana karta hoon."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the pulpit saying, "Verily, afflictions (will start) from here," pointing towards the east, "whence the side of the head of Satan comes out
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool ko mimbar par kehte suna, "Sach mein, fitnen (yahaan se aaengi)," purab ki taraf ishara karte huye, "jahaan se Shaitan ke sar ka hissa nikalta hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The tribes of Quraish, Al-Ansar, Juhaina, Muzaina, Aslam, Ghifar and Ashja' are my helpers, and they have no protector (i.e. Master) except Allah and His Apostle
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Quraish, Al-Ansaar, Juhaina, Muzaina, Aslam, Ghifar, aur Ashja qabile mere madadgar hain, aur unka Allah aur uske Rasool ke siwa koi doosra sarparast nahi hai."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:While Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was on the pulpit, he said, "May Allah forgive the tribe of Ghifar! And may Allah save the tribe of Aslam! The tribe of `Usaiya have disobeyed Allah and His Apostle
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jabke Allah ke Rasool mimbar par the, unhone kaha, "Allah Ghifar qabile ko maaf kare! Aur Allah Aslam qabile ko bacha rakhe! Usaiya qabile ne Allah aur uske Rasool ki na-farmani ki hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "May Allah save the tribe of Aslam, and may Allah forgive the tribe of Ghifar
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Allah Aslam qabile ko bacha rakhe, aur Allah Ghifar qabile ko maaf kare."

e: Narrated Abu Bakra:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do you think that the tribes of Juhaina, Muzaina, Aslam and Ghifar are better than the tribes of Bani Tamim, Bani Asad, Bani `Abdullah bin Ghatafan and Bani Amir bin Sasaa?" A man said, "They were unsuccessful and losers." The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "(Yes), they are better than the tribes of Bani Tamim, Bani Asad, Bani `Abdullah bin Ghatafan and Bani Amir bin Sasaa
hi: Abu Bakra (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Kya tum sochte ho ke Juhaina, Muzaina, Aslam, aur Ghifar qabile Bani Tamim, Bani Asad, Bani Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ghatafan, aur Bani Amir bin Sasaa qabilon se behtar hain?" Ek shaks ne kaha, "Woh na-kaamyaab aur hare hue log the." Nabi ne joda, "(Haan), woh Bani Tamim, Bani Asad, Bani Abdullah bin Ghatafan, aur Bani Amir bin Sasaa qabilon se behtar hain."

e: Narrated Abu Bakra:Al-Aqra' bin Habis said to the Prophet (ﷺ) "Nobody gave you the pledge of allegiance but the robbers of the pilgrims (i.e. those who used to rob the pilgrims) from the tribes of Aslam, Ghifar, Muzaina." (Ibn Abi Ya'qub is in doubt whether Al-Aqra' added. 'And Juhaina.') The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Don't you think that the tribes of Aslam, Ghifar, Muzaina (and also perhaps) Juhaina are better than the tribes of Bani Tamim, Bani Amir, Asad, and Ghatafan?" Somebody said, "They were unsuccessful and losers!" The Prophet said, "Yes, by Him in Whose Hands my life is, they (i.e. the former) are better than they (i.e. the latter)
hi: Abu Bakra (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Al-Aqra bin Habis ne Nabi se kaha, "Aapko sirf Aslam, Ghifar, Muzaina qabilon ke Hajiyon ko lootne walon ne bai'at di hai." (Ibn Abi Ya'qub, doosre raawi ko shak hai kya Al-Aqra ne \"aur Juhaina\" joda tha.) Nabi ne kaha, "Kya tumhe nahi lagta ke Aslam, Ghifar, Muzaina (aur shaayad) Juhaina qabile Bani Tamim, Bani Amir, Asad, aur Ghatafan qabilon se behtar hain?" Kisi ne kaha, "Woh na-kaamyaab aur hare hue the!" Nabi ne kaha, "Haan, us Zaat ki qasam jiske haathon mein meri zindagi hai, woh (yaani pahle wale) un (yaani baad walon) se behtar hain."

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah (ra):The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The hour will not be established unless a man from the tribe of Qahtan appears, driving the people with his stick (ruling them with violence and oppression)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Qiyamat tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak Qahtan qabile ka ek shaks prakat na ho, jo apni lathi se logon ko haankta hai (unpar zulm aur zabardasti se hukumat karta hai)."

e: Narrated Jabir:We were in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) in a Ghazwa. A large number of emigrants joined him and among the emigrants there was a person who used to play jokes (or play with spears); so he (jokingly) stroked an Ansari man on the hip. The Ansari got so angry that both of them called their people. The Ansari said, "Help, O Ansar!" And the emigrant said "Help, O emigrants!" The Prophet (ﷺ) came out and said, "What is wrong with the people (as they are calling) this call of the period of Ignorance? "Then he said, "What is the matter with them?" So he was told about the stroke of the emigrant to the Ansari. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Stop this (i.e. appeal for help) for it is an evil call. "Abdullah bin Ubai bin Salul (a hypocrite) said, "The emigrants have called and (gathered against us); so when we return to Medina, surely, the more honorable people will expel therefrom the meaner," Upon that `Umar said, "O Allah's Prophet! Shall we not kill this evil person (i.e. `Abdullah bin Ubai bin Salul) ?" The Prophet) said, "(No), lest the people should say that Muhammad used to kill his companions
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Nabi ki sohbat mein ek Ghazwa mein the. Bahut se Muhajir unse jud gaye, aur unme se ek shaks tha jo mazak karta tha (ya bhaale se khelta tha); isliye usne (mazak mein) ek Ansaar shaks ki kamar par thapad maara. Ansaari itna naraaj hue ke donon ne apni-apni qaum ko pukara. Ansaari ne kaha, "Madad karo, Aye Ansaar!" aur Muhajir ne kaha "Madad karo, Aye Muhajireen!" Nabi bahar aaye aur kaha, "Yeh kya hai, log jahiliyat ke daur ki pukar pukar rahe hain?" Phir unhone pucha, "Unhe kya hua hai?" Isliye unhe bataya gaya Muhajir ne Ansaari ko maara tha. Nabi ne kaha, "Ise (yaani aisi pukar ko) roko, kyunke yeh ek buri pukar hai." Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ubai bin Salul (ek munafik) ne kaha, "Muhajireen ne pukar li hai (aur humare khilaf ekjut ho gaye hain); isliye jab hum Madina wapas jaenge, izzatdaar log zaroor wahaan se kamzor logon ko nikal denge." Isspar Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Aye Allah ke Nabi! Kya hum is bure shaks (yaani Abdullah bin Ubai bin Salul) ko qatl na kar den?" Nabi ne kaha, "(Nahi), kahin log yeh na kahen ke Muhammad apne hi sathiyon ko qatl karte the."

e: Narrated `Abdullah (bin Mas`ud):The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Who-ever slaps his face or tears the bosom of his dress, or calls the calls of the Period of Ignorance, is not from us
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) (bin Mas'ud) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Jo bhi apna chehra thapadata hai ya apna gala chaakta hai, ya jahiliyat ke daur ki pukaren lagata hai, woh humein se nahi hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "`Amr bin Luhai bin Qam'a bin Khindif was the father of Khuza`a
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Amr bin Luhai bin Qam'a bin Khindif Khuza'a qabile ke pita the."

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Al-Musaiyab:Al-Bahira was an animal whose milk was spared for the idols and other deities, and so nobody was allowed to milk it. As-Saiba was an animal which they (i.e. infidels) used to set free in the names of their gods so that it would not be used for carrying anything. Abu Huraira said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'I saw `Amr bin 'Amir bin Luhai Al-Khuza`i dragging his intestines in the (Hell) Fire, for he was the first man who started the custom of releasing animals (for the sake of false gods)
hi: Sa'id bin Al-Musaiyab bataate hain: Al-Bahira ek janwar tha jiska doodh buton aur doosre buton ke liye alag rakha jata tha, isliye koi bhi use dohne ki ijazat nahi rakhta tha. As-Saiba ek janwar tha jise woh (yaani kaafiron ne) apne buton ke naam par aazad chhod dete the taake use kisi bojh dhone ke kaam mein na laaya jaaye. Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Nabi ne kaha, 'Maine Amr bin Amir bin Luhai Al-Khuza'i ko Dozakh (ki aag) mein apni aanten ghaseette hue dekha, kyunke woh sabse pahle shaks the jinhone janwaron ko (jhute buton ke naam par) aazad chhodne ki riwaj shuru ki.'"

e: Narrated Abu Jamra:Ibn `Abbas said to us, "Shall I tell you the story of Abu Dhar's conversion to Islam?" We said, "Yes." He said, "Abu Dhar said: I was a man from the tribe of Ghifar. We heard that a man had appeared in Mecca, claiming to be a Prophet. I said to my brother, 'Go to that man and talk to him and bring me his news.' He set out, met him and returned. I asked him, 'What is the news with you?' He said, 'By Allah, I saw a man enjoining what is good and forbidding what is evil.' I said to him, 'You have not satisfied me with this little information.' So, I took a waterskin and a stick and proceeded towards Mecca. Neither did I know him (i.e. the Prophet (ﷺ) ), nor did I like to ask anyone about him. I Kept on drinking Zam zam water and staying in the Mosque. Then `Ali passed by me and said, 'It seems you are a stranger?' I said, 'Yes.' He proceeded to his house and I accompanied him. Neither did he ask me anything, nor did I tell him anything. Next morning I went to the Mosque to ask about the Prophet but no-one told me anything about him. `Ali passed by me again and asked, 'Hasn't the man recognized his dwelling place yet' I said, 'No.' He said, 'Come along with me.' He asked me, 'What is your business? What has brought you to this town?' I said to him, 'If you keep my secret, I will tell you.' He said, 'I will do.' I said to him, 'We have heard that a person has appeared here, claiming to be a Prophet. I sent my brother to speak to him and when he returned, he did not bring a satisfactory report; so I thought of meeting him personally.' `Ali said (to Abu Dhar), 'You have reached your goal; I am going to him just now, so follow me, and wherever I enter, enter after me. If I should see someone who may cause you trouble, I will stand near a wall pretending to mend my shoes (as a warning), and you should go away then.' `Ali proceeded and I accompanied him till he entered a place, and I entered with him to the Prophet (ﷺ) to whom I said, 'Present (the principles of) Islam to me.' When he did, I embraced Islam 'immediately. He said to me, 'O Abu Dhar! Keep your conversion as a secret and return to your town; and when you hear of our victory, return to us. ' I said, 'By Him Who has sent you with the Truth, I will announce my conversion to Islam publicly amongst them (i.e. the infidels),' Abu Dhar went to the Mosque, where some people from Quraish were present, and said, 'O folk of Quraish ! I testify that None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, and I (also) testify that Muhammad is Allah's Slave and His Apostle.' (Hearing that) the Quraishi men said, 'Get at this Sabi (i.e. Muslim) !' They got up and beat me nearly to death. Al `Abbas saw me and threw himself over me to protect me. He then faced them and said, 'Woe to you! You want to kill a man from the tribe of Ghifar, although your trade and your communications are through the territory of Ghifar?' They therefore left me. The next morning I returned (to the Mosque) and said the same as I had said on the previous day. They again said, 'Get at this Sabi!' I was treated in the same way as on the previous day, and again Al-Abbas found me and threw himself over me to protect me and told them the same as he had said the day before.' So, that was the conversion of Abu Dhar (may Allah be Merciful to him) to Islam
hi: Abu Jamra bataate hain: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne humse kaha, "Kya main tumhe Abu Dharr (رضی اللہ عنہ) ka Islam qubool karne ka kissa sunaun?" Humne kaha, "Haan." Unhone kaha, "Abu Dharr ne kaha: Main Ghifar qabile ka ek shaks tha. Humne suna ke Mecca mein ek shaks paida hua hai jo Nabi hone ka daava karta hai. Maine apne bhai se kaha, 'Us shaks ke paas jaao aur unse baat karo aur mujhe unki khabar lekar aao.' Woh gaye, unse mile, aur wapas aaye. Maine unse pucha, 'Tumhare paas kya khabar hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, maine ek aise shaks ko dekha jo achhaee ka hukum deta hai aur buraee se rokta hai.' Maine unse kaha, 'Tumne itni thodi jaankari se mujhe santusht nahi kiya.' Isliye maine ek paani ki mashk aur ek laathi liya aur Mecca ki taraf chal pada. Na main unhe (yaani Nabi ko) jaanta tha, na hi mujhe kisi se unke baare mein puchna achha laga. Main Zamzam ka paani pita raha aur masjid mein ruka raha. Phir Ali (Alayhis Salam) mere paas se guzre aur kaha, 'Lagta hai tum ek pardeshi ho?' Maine kaha, 'Haan.' Woh apne ghar chale gaye aur main unke saath gaya. Na unhone mujhse kuch pucha, na maine unhe kuch bataya. Agli subah main masjid gaya Nabi ke baare mein puchne, magar kisi ne mujhe unke baare mein kuch nahi bataya. Ali (Alayhis Salam) phir mere paas se guzre aur pucha, 'Kya us shaks ne abhi tak apna rehne ka thikana nahi paaya?' Maine kaha, 'Nahi.' Unhone kaha, 'Mere saath chalo.' Unhone mujhse pucha, 'Tumhara kya kaam hai? Tumhe is shehar mein kya laaya?' Maine unse kaha, 'Agar tum mera raaz rakhoge, main tumhe bataunga.' Unhone kaha, 'Main aisa hi karunga.' Maine unse kaha, 'Humne suna hai ke yahaan koi shaks aayi hai jo Nabi hone ka daava karta hai. Maine apne bhai ko unse baat karne bheja, aur jab woh wapas aaye, unka jawab santoshjanak nahi tha; isliye maine socha khud unse milna chahiye.' Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne (Abu Dharr se) kaha, 'Tum apni manzil tak pahunch gaye ho; main abhi unke paas ja raha hoon, isliye mere peeche chalo, aur jahaan bhi main daakhil hoon, tum bhi mere baad daakhil ho jaana. Agar mujhe koi aisa shaks dikhta hai jo tumhe pareshaan kar sakta hai, main deewaar ke paas khade hokar apna joota theek karne ka natak karunga (chetaaavni ke tor par), aur tumhe wahaan se chale jaana chahiye.' Ali (Alayhis Salam) chal pade aur main unke saath gaya jab tak woh ek jagah daakhil hue, aur main bhi unke saath Nabi ke paas gaya jinse maine kaha, 'Mujhe Islam (ke usulon) ka parichay dijiye.' Jab unhone diya, main foran Islam mein daakhil ho gaya. Unhone mujhse kaha, 'Aye Abu Dharr! Apne Islam qubool karne ko raaz rakho aur apne shehar wapas jaao; aur jab tum humari fatah ki khabar suno, wapas aa jaana.' Maine kaha, 'Us Zaat ki qasam jisne aapko Haqq ke saath bheja hai, main isse (yaani apne Islam qubool karne ko) khule-aam unke (yaani kaafiron ke) beech elaan karunga.' Abu Dharr masjid gaye, jahaan kuch Quraish log maujood the, aur kaha, 'Aye Quraish walo! Main gawahi deta hoon ke Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahi, aur main (bhi) gawahi deta hoon ke Muhammad Allah ke bande aur uske Rasool hain.' (Yeh sunkar) Quraishi logon ne kaha, 'Is Sabi (yaani Musalman) ko pakdo!' Woh khade hue aur mujhe maar-maar kar maut ke qareeb kar diya. Al-Abbas ne mujhe dekha aur mujhe bachane ke liye khud ko mujhpar daal diya. Phir woh unki taraf mude aur kaha, 'Afsos tum par! Tum Ghifar qabile ke ek shaks ko qatl karna chahte ho, jabke tumhara vyaapaar aur aane-jane ka raasta Ghifar ki sarzameen se hi hokar guzata hai?' Isliye unhone mujhe chhod diya. Agli subah main wapas gaya aur wahi kaha jo maine pichhle din kaha tha. Woh phir bole, 'Is Sabi ko pakdo!' Mere saath wahi suluk hua jo pichhle din hua tha, aur Al-Abbas ne phir mujhe dekha aur mujhe bachane ke liye khud ko mujhpar daal diya aur unhe wahi bataya jo unhone pichhle din kaha tha." Yehi Abu Dharr (Allah unpar reham kare) ka Islam qubool karna tha.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah (ra):The Prophet (ﷺ) said, (The people of) Aslam, Ghifar and some people of Muzaina and Juhaina or said (some people of Juhaina or Muzaina) are better with Allah or said (on the Day of resurrection) than the tribe of Asad, Tamim, Hawazin and Ghatafan
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "(Aslam, Ghifar, aur kuch Muzaina ya Juhaina qabile ke log) Allah ke nazdik behtar hain (ya Qiyamat ke din) Asad, Tamim, Hawazin, aur Ghatafan qabilon se."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:If you wish to know about the ignorance of the Arabs, refer to Surat-al-Anam after Verse No. 130:-- Indeed lost are those who have killed their children From folly without knowledge and have forbidden that which Allah has provided for them, inventing a lie against Allah. They have indeed gone astray and were not guided
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Agar tum Arbon ki jahiliyat ke baare mein jaanna chahte ho, Surah Al-An'am ki Ayat 130 ke baad dekho: "Sach mein, na-kaamyaab hain woh jinhone apne bachchon ko boodha samajhki, bina ilm ke, aur jise Allah ne unhe rozi diya use haram thahraya, Allah par jhoot gadhkar. Woh bhatak gaye hain aur unhe hidayat nahi mili."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When the Verse:-- 'And warn your tribe of near kindred.' (26.214) was revealed, the Prophet (ﷺ) started calling (the 'Arab tribes), "O Bani Fihr, O Bani `Adi" mentioning first the various branch tribes of Quraish
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab yeh Ayat nazil hui: "Aur apne najdeeki rishtedaron ko chetaao" (26:214), Nabi ne (Arab qabilon ko) pukar-pukar kar bulana shuru kiya, "Aye Bani Fihr, Aye Bani Adi," Quraish ki alag-alag shaakhaee qabilon ke naam le-lekar.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas: When the Verse:-- 'And warn your tribe of near kindred' (26.214). was revealed, the Prophet (ﷺ) started calling every tribe by its name
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab yeh Ayat nazil hui: "Aur apne najdeeki rishtedaron ko chetaao" (26:214), Nabi ne har qabile ko uske naam se pukarna shuru kiya.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Bani `Abd Manaf! Buy yourselves from Allah; O Bani `Abdul-Muttalib! Buy yourselves from Allah; O mother of Az-Zubair bin Al-Awwam, the aunt of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and O Fatima bint Muhammad! Buy yourselves from Allah, for I cannot defend you before Allah. You (both) can ask me from my property as much as you like
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Aye Bani Abd Manaf! Apne aap ko Allah se khareed lo (bachao). Aye Bani Abdul-Muttalib! Apne aap ko Allah se khareed lo. Aye Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Awwam ki maa, Allah ke Rasool ki phuphi, aur Aye Fatima (Alayhas Salam) bint Muhammad! Apne aap ko Allah se khareed lo, kyunke main tumhe Allah ke saamne nahi bacha sakta. Tum donon mujhse mere maal mein se jitna chaho maang sakte ho."

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) sent for the Ansar (and when they came), he asked, 'Is there any stranger amongst you?" They said, "No except the son of our sister." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The son of the sister of some people belongs to them
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Ansaar ko bulaya (aur jab woh aaye), unhone pucha, "Kya tum mein koi pardeshi hai?" Unhone kaha, "Nahi, siwaye humari behn ke bete ke." Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Kisi qaum ki behn ka beta unhi mein se mana jata hai."

e: Narrated `Aisha:That during the Mina days, Abu Bakr came to her, while there were two girls with her, beating drums, and the Prophet (ﷺ) was (lying) covering himself with his garment. Abu Bakr rebuked the two girls, but the Prophet (ﷺ) uncovered his face and said, "O Abu Bakr! Leave them, for these are the days of Id (festival)." Those days were the days of Mina-. `Aisha added, "I was being screened by the Prophet (ﷺ) while I was watching the Ethiopians playing in the Mosque. `Umar rebuked them, but the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Leave them, O Bani Arfida! Play. (for) you are safe
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Mina ke dinon mein, Abu Bakr unse milne aaye jabke unke paas do ladkiyaan thi jo dhol baja rahi thi, aur Nabi apna kapda odhe lete hue the. Abu Bakr ne un do ladkiyon ko daanta, magar Nabi ne apna chehra khola aur kaha, "Aye Abu Bakr! Unhe rehne do, kyunke yeh Eid (yaani tyohaar) ke din hain." Woh din Mina ke din the. Ayesha ne joda, "Main Nabi ke aad mein chhupi thi jabke main Ethiopiyon ko masjid mein khelte dekh rahi thi. Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne unhe daanta, magar Nabi ne kaha, 'Unhe khelne do, Aye Bani Arfida! Khelo, (kyunke) tum mahfooz ho.'"

e: Narrated `Aisha:Once Hassan bin Thabit asked the permission of the Prophet (ﷺ) to lampoon (i.e. compose satirical poetry defaming) the infidels. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "What about the fact that I have common descent with them?" Hassan replied, "I shall take you out of them as a hair is taken out of dough." Narrated `Urwa: I started abusing Hassan in front of `Aisha, whereupon she said. "Don't abuse him, for he used to defend the Prophet (with his poetry)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ek baar Hassan bin Thabit ne Nabi se kaafiron ke khilaf taana (vyangatmak kavita) likhne ki ijazat maangi. Nabi ne kaha, "Iska kya jawab dena hai ke mera unse saanjha vansh hai?" Hassan ne jawab diya, "Main aapko unme se aise nikaalunga jaise aate se ek baal nikala jata hai." Urwa bataate hain: Main Ayesha ke saamne Hassan ki buraee karna shuru kiya, isspar unhone kaha, "Unki buraee mat karo, kyunke woh Nabi ki (apni kavita se) hifaazat karte the."

e: Narrated Jubair bin Mut`im:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I have five names: I am Muhammad and Ahmad; I am Al-Mahi through whom Allah will eliminate infidelity; I am Al-Hashir who will be the first to be resurrected, the people being resurrected thereafter; and I am also Al-`Aqib (i.e. There will be no prophet after me)
hi: Jubair bin Mut'im bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Mere paanch naam hain: Main Muhammad hoon aur Ahmad; main Al-Mahi hoon jiske zariye Allah kufr ko mitaega; main Al-Hashir hoon jo sabse pahle (Qiyamat ke din) zinda kiya jaayega, iske baad hi doosre log zinda kiye jaenge; aur main Al-Aqib bhi hoon (yaani mere baad koi Nabi nahi hoga)."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Doesn't it astonish you how Allah protects me from the Quraish's abusing and cursing? They abuse Mudhammam and curse Mudhammam while I am Muhammad (and not Mudhammam)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Kya tumhe hairat nahi hoti Allah mujhe Quraish ki gaaliyon aur laanton se kaise bachata hai? Woh 'Mudhammam' ko gaaliyaan dete aur laanten dete hain, jabke main Muhammad hoon (Mudhammam nahi)."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "My similitude in comparison with the other prophets is that of a man who has built a house completely and excellently except for a place of one brick. When the people enter the house, they admire its beauty and say: 'But for the place of this brick (how splendid the house will be)
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Doosre Nabiyon ke muqaable mein meri misaal us shaks jaisi hai jisne ek ghar poori tarah aur khoobsurati se banaya, siwaye ek eent ki jagah ke. Jab log ghar mein daakhil hote hain, uski khoobsurati ki taarif karte hain aur kahte hain: 'Kaash yeh eent ki jagah bhar di jaati (kaisa shaandaar ghar hota).'"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "My similitude in comparison with the other prophets before me, is that of a man who has built a house nicely and beautifully, except for a place of one brick in a corner. The people go about it and wonder at its beauty, but say: 'Would that this brick be put in its place!' So I am that brick, and I am the last of the Prophets
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Mujhse pahle ke Nabiyon ke muqaable mein meri misaal us shaks jaisi hai jisne ek ghar khoobsurati se aur behtareen tarike se banaya, siwaye ek kone mein ek eent ki jagah ke. Log uske aas-paas ghoomte hain aur uski khoobsurati par hairat hote hain, magar kahte hain: 'Kaash yeh eent apni jagah par lag jaaati!' Isliye main woh eent hoon, aur main sab Nabiyon mein sabse aakhri hoon."

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) died when he was sixty three years old
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi ka intiqal hua jab woh trisath (63) saal ke the.

e: Narrated Anas:While the Prophet (ﷺ) was in the market, a man called (somebody), "O Abu-l-Qasim!' The Prophet (ﷺ) turned to him and said "Name yourselves after me but do not call yourselves by my Kuniya
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jabke Nabi bazaar mein the, ek shaks ne pukara, "Aye Abul-Qasim!" Nabi unki taraf mude aur kaha, "Apne aap ko mere naam par rakho, magar apne aap ko meri Kuniya (upnaam) se mat pukaro."

e: Narrated Jabir:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Name yourselves after me, but do not call yourselves by my Kuniya
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Apne aap ko mere naam par rakho, magar apne aap ko meri Kuniya se mat pukaro."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Abu-l-Qasim said, "Name yourselves after me, but do not call yourselves by my Kuniya
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abul-Qasim ne kaha, "Apne aap ko mere naam par rakho, magar apne aap ko meri Kuniya se mat pukaro."

e: Narrated Al-Ju'aid bin `Abdur Rahman:I saw As-Sa'ib bin Yazid when he was ninety-four years old, quite strong and of straight figure. He said, "I know that I enjoyed my hearing and seeing powers only because of the invocation of Allah's Apostle . My aunt took me to him and said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! My nephew is sick; will you invoke Allah for him?' So he invoked (Allah) for me
hi: Al-Ju'aid bin Abdur Rahman bataate hain: Maine As-Sa'ib bin Yazid (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko dekha jab woh chauraanve saal ke the, bahut mazboot aur seedhe kad ke. Unhone kaha, "Mujhe pata hai ke meri sunne aur dekhne ki taakat sirf isliye achhi rahi kyunke Allah ke Rasool ne mere liye dua ki thi. Meri phuphi mujhe unke paas le gaee aur kaha, 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Mera bhatija bimar hai; kya aap uske liye dua karenge?' Isliye unhone mere liye Allah se dua ki."

e: Narrated As-Sa'ib bin Yazid:My aunt took me to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! My nephew is sick."' The Prophet (ﷺ) passed his hands over my head and blessed me. Then he performed ablution and I drank the remaining water, and standing behind him, I saw the seal in between his shoulders
hi: As-Sa'ib bin Yazid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Meri phuphi mujhe Allah ke Rasool ke paas le gaee aur kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Mera bhatija bimar hai." Nabi ne apne haath mere sar par phere aur mujhe barkat di. Phir unhone wudu kiya aur maine bacha hua paani piya, aur unke peeche khade hokar, maine unke donon kandhon ke beech Nabuvvat ki muhar dekhi.

e: Narrated `Uqba bin Al-Harith:(Once) Abu Bakr offered the `Asr prayer and then went out walking and saw Al-Hasan playing with the boys. He lifted him on to his shoulders and said, " Let my parents be sacrificed for your sake! (You) resemble the Prophet (ﷺ) and not `Ali," while `Ali was smiling
hi: Uqba bin Al-Harith bataate hain: (Ek baar) Abu Bakr ne Asr ki namaz padhi aur phir bahar chalte hue Al-Hasan (Alayhis Salam) ko ladkon ke saath khelte dekha. Unhone unhe apne kandhe par uthaya aur kaha, "Mere maa-baap tumhare liye qurbaan hon! Tum Nabi jaise dikhte ho, Ali (Alayhis Salam) jaise nahi," jabke Ali (Alayhis Salam) muskurate huye khade the.

e: Narrated Abu Juhaifa:I saw the Prophet, and Al-Hasan resembled him
hi: Abu Juhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi ko dekha, aur Al-Hasan (Alayhis Salam) unse milte-julte the.

e: Narrated Isma`il bin Abi Khalid:I heard Abu Juhaifa saying, "I saw the Prophet, and Al-Hasan bin `Ali resembled him." I said to Abu- Juhaifa, "Describe him for me." He said, "He was white and his beard was black with some white hair. He promised to give us 13 young she-camels, but he expired before we could get them
hi: Ismail bin Abi Khalid bataate hain: Maine Abu Juhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko kehte suna, "Maine Nabi ko dekha, aur Al-Hasan bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) unse milte-julte the." Maine Abu Juhaifa se kaha, "Unka varnan keejiye." Unhone kaha, "Woh gore rang ke the aur unki daadhi kaali thi, kuch safed baal ke saath. Unhone humein terah jawan untniyaan dene ka waada kiya, magar hum unhe paane se pahle unka intiqal ho gaya."

e: Narrated Wahb Abu Juhaifa As-Suwai:I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) and saw some white hair below his lower lip above the chin
hi: Wahb Abu Juhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) As-Suwai bataate hain: Maine Nabi ko dekha aur unke neeche wale honth ke neeche, kaanchi ke oopar, kuch safed baal dekhe.

e: Narrated Hariz bin `Uthman:That he asked `Abdullah bin Busr (i.e. the companion of the Prophet), "Did you see the Prophet (ﷺ) when he was old?" He said, "He had a few white hairs between the lower lip and the chin
hi: Hariz bin Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Unhone Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Busr (yaani Nabi ke sahaabi) se pucha, "Kya aapne Nabi ko unki budhaape mein dekha tha?" Unhone kaha, "Unke neeche wale honth aur kaanchi ke beech kuch safed baal the."

e: Narrated Rabi`a bin Abi `Abdur-Rahman:I heard Anas bin Malik describing the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "He was of medium height amongst the people, neither tall nor short; he had a rosy color, neither absolutely white nor deep brown; his hair was neither completely curly nor quite lank. Divine Inspiration was revealed to him when he was forty years old. He stayed ten years in Mecca receiving the Divine Inspiration, and stayed in Medina for ten more years. When he expired, he had scarcely twenty white hairs in his head and beard." Rabi`a said, "I saw some of his hairs and it was red. When I asked about that, I was told that it turned red because of scent
hi: Rabi'a bin Abi Abdur-Rahman bataate hain: Maine Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko Nabi ka varnan karte suna, "Woh logon mein darmiyana qad ke the, na lambe na chhote; unka rang gulaabi tha, na bilkul safed na gahra bhura; unke baal na poori tarah ghungrale the na bilkul seedhe. Divine Ilham unhe tab mila jab woh chaalis saal ke the. Woh Mecca mein das saal tak Divine Ilham pate rahe, aur Madina mein das saal aur rahe. Jab unka intiqal hua, unke sar aur daadhi mein mushkil se bees safed baal the." Rabi'a ne kaha, "Maine unke kuch baal dekhe the aur woh laal the. Jab maine iske baare mein pucha, mujhe bataya gaya ke khushbu ki wajah se woh laal ho gaye the."

e: Narrated Anas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was neither very tall nor short, neither absolutely white nor deep brown. His hair was neither curly nor lank. Allah sent him (as an Apostle) when he was forty years old. Afterwards he resided in Mecca for ten years and in Medina for ten more years. When Allah took him unto Him, there were scarcely twenty white hairs in his head and beard
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool na bahut lambe the na chhote, na bilkul safed na gahra bhura. Unke baal na ghungrale the na seedhe. Allah ne unhe Nabuvvat di jab woh chaalis saal ke the. Iske baad woh Mecca mein das saal rahe aur Madina mein das saal aur. Jab Allah ne unhe apni taraf bula liya, unke sar aur daadhi mein mushkil se bees safed baal the.

e: Narrated Al-Bara:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was the handsomest of all the people, and had the best appearance. He was neither very tall nor short
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool sab logon mein sabse khoobsurat the, aur unka soorat sabse behtar tha. Woh na bahut lambe the na chhote.

e: Narrated Qatada:I asked Anas, "Did the Prophet (ﷺ) use to dye (his) hair?" He said, "No, for there were only a few white hairs on his temples
hi: Qatada bataate hain: Maine Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha, "Kya Nabi apne baal rangte the?" Unhone kaha, "Nahi, kyunke unki kanpaton par sirf kuch safed baal the."

e: Narrated Al-Bara:The Prophet (ﷺ) was of moderate height having broad shoulders (long) hair reaching his ear-lobes. Once I saw him in a red cloak and I had never seen a more handsome man than him
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Nabi darmiyana qad ke the, chaude kandhon wale, aur unke baal unke kaan ki lau tak pahunchte the. Ek baar maine unhe ek laal choge mein dekha, aur maine unse behtar khoobsurat insaan kabhi nahi dekha.

e: Narrated Abu 'Is-haq:Al-Bara' was asked, "Was the face of the Prophet (as bright) as a sword?" He said, "No, but (as bright) as a moon
hi: Abu Ishaq bataate hain: Al-Bara se pucha gaya, "Kya Nabi ka chehra talwar jaisa (chamakla) tha?" Unhone kaha, "Nahi, balki chaand jaisa."

e: Narrated Abu Juhaifa:Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went to Al-Batha' at noon, performed the ablution and offered' a two rak`at Zuhr prayer and a two-rak`at `Asr prayer while a spearheaded stick was planted before him and the passersby were passing in front of it. (After the prayer), the people got up and held the hands of the Prophet and passed them on their faces. I also took his hand and kept it on my face and noticed that it was colder than ice, and its smell was nicer than musk
hi: Abu Juhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Allah ke Rasool dopahar ko Al-Batha gaye, wudu kiya, aur do rakat Zuhr aur do rakat Asr ki namaz padhi jabke unke saamne ek bhale (spear) jaisi lakdi gaadi hui thi, aur raahgeer uske saamne se guzarte the. (Namaz ke baad), log uthe aur Nabi ke haathon ko pakada aur apne chehron par phera. Maine bhi unka haath liya aur apne chehre par rakha aur mahsoos kiya ke woh baraf se bhi zyada thanda tha, aur uski khushbu kasturi se bhi zyada acchhi thi.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) was the most generous of all the people, and he used to become more generous in Ramadan when Gabriel met him. Gabriel used to meet him every night during Ramadan to revise the Qur'an with him. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then used to be more generous than the fast wind
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi sab logon mein sabse daani the, aur woh Ramadan mein aur zyada daani ho jate jab Jibreel unse milte. Jibreel Ramadan ki har raat unse milte the taake unke saath Quran ka motabika (revision) kar sake. Allah ke Rasool tez hawa se bhi zyada daani ho jaate jab woh Jibreel se milte.

e: Narrated `Aisha:That Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to her in a happy mood with his features glittering with joy, and said, "Have you not heard what the Qaif has said about Zaid and Us-ama? He saw their feet and remarked. These belong to each other." (i.e. They are father and son)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool unke paas khush mood mein aaye, unka chehra khushi se chamak raha tha, aur unhone kaha, "Kya tumne nahi suna Qaif (yaani paon ke nishaanon se rishta pahchanne wala maahir) ne Zaid aur Usama ke baare mein kya kaha? Unhone unke paanv dekhe aur kaha, 'Yeh donon ek-doosre ke hain.' (yaani woh baap-beta hain.)"

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Ka`b:I heard Ka`b bin Malik talking after his failure to join (the Ghazwa of) Tabuk. He said, "When I greeted Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) whose face was glittering with happiness, for whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was happy, his face used to glitter, as if it was a piece of the moon, and we used to recognize it (i.e. his happiness) from his face
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ka'b bataate hain: Maine Ka'b bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko Tabuk ke Ghazwa mein shaamil na hone ki apni asamarthata ke baad baat karte suna. Unhone kaha, "Jab maine Allah ke Rasool ko salaam kiya, unka chehra khushi se chamak raha tha, kyunke jab bhi Allah ke Rasool khush hote, unka chehra chaand ke ek tukde ki tarah chamakta tha, aur hum unke chehre se hi (unki khushi) pahchante the."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I have been sent (as an Apostle) in the best of all the generations of Adam's offspring since their Creation
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Mujhe Aadam ki aulad ki peedhiyon mein se sabse behtar peedhi mein bheja gaya hai, unki takhleeq se lekar ab tak."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to let his hair hang down while the infidels used to part their hair. The people of the Scriptures were used to letting their hair hang down and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) liked to follow the people of the Scriptures in the matters about which he was not instructed otherwise. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) parted his hair
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool apne baal khule hue rakhte the, jabke kaafir apne baal beech se baantte the. Kitaab wale (yaani Yahudi aur Isaee) apne baal khule chhodte the, aur Allah ke Rasool Kitaab walon ki pairvi karna pasand karte the un maamlon mein jinke baare mein unhe khaas hidayat nahi mili thi. Baad mein Allah ke Rasool ne apne baal baantne shuru kiye.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:The Prophet (ﷺ) never used bad language neither a "Fahish nor a Mutafahish. He used to say "The best amongst you are those who have the best manners and character." (See Hadith No. 56 (B) Vol
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi kabhi buri ya gaali wali bhaasha istemal nahi karte the, na Fahish (aslil baaten) na Mutafahish (jaanboojhkar aslil baaten). Woh kahte the, "Tum mein sabse behtar woh hain jinke adab aur charitra sabse behtar hain."

e: Narrated `Aisha:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was given the choice of one of two matters, he would choose the easier of the two, as long as it was not sinful to do so, but if it was sinful to do so, he would not approach it. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) never took revenge (over anybody) for his own sake but (he did) only when Allah's Legal Bindings were outraged in which case he would take revenge for Allah's Sake
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab bhi Allah ke Rasool ko do maamlon mein se ek chunne ka mauka milta, woh unme se aasaan wala chunte, jab tak woh gunah na ho, magar agar woh gunah hota, woh usse door rahte. Allah ke Rasool ne kabhi apne liye badla nahi liya, magar jab Allah ke qanoonon ka ullanghan hota, tab woh Allah ki khaatir badla lete.

e: Narrated Anas:I have never touched silk or Dibaj (i.e. thick silk) softer than the palm of the Prophet (ﷺ) nor have I smelt a perfume nicer than the sweat of the Prophet
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine kabhi Nabi ki hatheli se zyada narm resham ya Dibaj (mota resham) nahi chhuya hai, na hi maine Nabi ke paseene se zyada acchhi khushbu kabhi mahsoos ki hai.

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) was shier than a veiled virgin girl
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ek parde wali kuari ladki se bhi zyada sharam wale the.

e: Narrated Shuba:A similar Hadith (i e. No. 762) with this addition: And if he (i.e. the Prophet) disliked something, the sign of aversion would appear on his face
hi: Shuba bataate hain: Isi hadith jaisa (yaani No. 762), is izafe ke saath: Aur agar unhe (yaani Nabi ko) koi cheez napasand aati, unke chehre par napasandgi ke asaraat dikh jate.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) never criticized any food (presented to him), but he would eat it if he liked it; otherwise, he would leave it (without expressing his dislike)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kabhi kisi khaane (jo unhe pesh kiya gaya) ki buraee nahi ki, balki agar woh unhe pasand aata, woh use khate; warna, woh use chhod dete (bina apni napasandgi zaahir kiye).

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Malik bin Buhaina Al-Asdi:When the Prophet (ﷺ) prostrated, he used to keep his arms so widely apart that we used to see his armpits. (The sub-narrator, Ibn Bukair said, "The whiteness of his armpits)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik bin Buhaina Al-Asdi bataate hain: Jab Nabi sajda karte, woh apni baanhen itni doori par rakhte ke hum unki baaghlen dekh sakte the. (Doosre raawi, Ibn Bukair ne kaha, "Unki baaghlon ki safedi.")

e: Narrated Anas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not use to raise his hands in his invocations except in the Istisqa (i.e. invoking Allah for the rain) in which he used to raise his hands so high that one could see the whiteness of his armpits. (Note: It may be that Anas did not see the Prophet (ﷺ) raising his hands but it has been narrated that the Prophet (ﷺ) used to raise his hands for invocations other than Istisqa. See Hadith No. 612 Vol. 5. and Hadith No. 807 & 808 Vol
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool apni duaon mein apne haath nahi uthate the siwaye Istisqa (yaani barish ke liye dua) mein, jismein woh apne haath itne ooncha uthate ke unki baaghlon ki safedi dikh jaati. (Tippani: Ho sakta hai Anas ne Nabi ko haath uthate hue na dekha ho, magar yeh riwaayat hai ke Nabi Istisqa ke ilawa doosri duaon mein bhi apne haath uthate the.)

e: Narrated Abu Juhaifa:By chance I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) at noon while he was at Al-Abtah (resting) in a tent. Bilal came out (of the tent) and pronounced the Adhan for the prayer, and entering again, he brought out the water which was left after Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had performed the ablution. The people rushed to take some of the water. Bilal again went in and brought out a spear-headed stick, and then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came out. As if I were now looking at the whiteness of his leg. Bilal fixed the stick and the Prophet (ﷺ) offered a two-rak`at Zuhr prayer and a two-rak`at `Asr prayer, while women and donkeys were passing in front of the Prophet (beyond the stick)
hi: Abu Juhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar main dopahar ko Nabi ke paas gaya jabke woh Al-Abtah mein ek tambu mein (aaram kar rahe) the. Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) (tambu se) bahar aaye aur namaz ke liye Adhan diya, aur phir andar jaakar woh paani lekar aaye jo Allah ke Rasool ke wudu ke baad bacha tha. Log us paani mein se kuch lene daude. Bilal phir andar gaye aur ek bhale jaisi lakdi laaye, aur phir Allah ke Rasool bahar aaye. Mano abhi bhi main unki taang ki safedi dekh raha hoon. Bilal ne lakdi gaadi aur Nabi ne do rakat Zuhr aur do rakat Asr ki namaz padhi, jabke aurten aur gadhe Nabi ke saamne (lakdi se aage) se guzar rahe the.

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to talk so clearly that if somebody wanted to count the number of his words, he could do so. Narrated `Urwa bin Az-Zubair: `Aisha said (to me), "Don't you wonder at Abu so-and-so who came and sat by my dwelling and started relating the traditions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) intending to let me hear that, while I was performing an optional prayer. He left before I finished my optional prayer. Had I found him still there. I would have said to him, 'Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) never talked so quickly and vaguely as you do
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi itni saaf aur spasht baat karte the ke agar koi unke alfaazon ko ginna chahe, gin sakta tha. Urwa bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ayesha ne (mujhse) kaha, "Kya tumhe falaan-falaan par hairat nahi hoti jo aaye aur mere ghar ke bagal mein baithke Allah ke Rasool ki riwaayaten sunane lage, jabke main nafil namaz padh rahi thi. Woh mere namaz khatam karne se pahle hi chale gaye. Agar main unhe wahaan paati, main unse kahti, 'Allah ke Rasool kabhi tumhari tarah itni jaldbaazi aur aspashtata se baat nahi karte the.'"

e: Narrated Abu Salama bin `Abdur-Rahman:That he asked `Aisha "How was the prayer of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the month of Ramadan?" She replied, "He used not to pray more than eleven rak`at whether in Ramadan or in any other month. He used to offer four rak`at, let alone their beauty and length, and then four rak`at, let alone their beauty and length. Afterwards he would offer three rak`at. I said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Do you go to bed before offering the witr prayer?' He said, 'My eyes sleep, but my heart does not sleep
hi: Abu Salama bin Abdur-Rahman bataate hain: Unhone Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se pucha, "Ramadan ke mahine mein Allah ke Rasool ki namaz kaisi hoti thi?" Unhone jawab diya, "Woh Ramadan mein ya kisi doosre mahine mein gyarah rakat se zyada namaz nahi padhte the. Woh chaar rakat padhte, aur unki khoobsurati aur lambaee ke baare mein mat pucho; phir chaar rakat aur padhte, aur unki khoobsurati aur lambaee ke baare mein mat pucho. Phir woh teen rakat padhte. Maine kaha, 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Kya aap Witr padhne se pahle sone chale jate hain?' Unhone kaha, 'Meri aankhen soti hain, magar mera dil nahi sota.'"

e: Narrated Sharik bin `Abdullah bin Abi Namir:I heard Anas bin Malik telling us about the night when the Prophet (ﷺ) was made to travel from the Ka`ba Mosque. Three persons (i.e. angels) came to the Prophet (ﷺ) before he was divinely inspired was an Apostle), while he was sleeping in Al-Masjid-ul-Haram. The first (of the three angels) said, "Which of them is he?" The second said, "He is the best of them." That was all that happened then, and he did not see them till they came at another night and he perceived their presence with his heart, for the eyes of the Prophet (ﷺ) were closed when he was asleep, but his heart was not asleep (not unconscious). This is characteristic of all the prophets: Their eyes sleep but their hearts do not sleep. Then Gabriel took charge of the Prophet (ﷺ) and ascended along with him to the Heaven
hi: Sharik bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Namir bataate hain: Maine Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko us raat ke baare mein batate suna jab Nabi ko Ka'ba masjid se safar karna pada. Teen shaks (yaani farishte) Nabi ke paas aaye isse pahle ke unhe Divine ilham mila (yaani woh Nabi bane), jabke woh Al-Masjid-ul-Haram mein sote hue the. Pahle (in teen farishton mein se) ne kaha, "Unme se kaun hai?" Doosre ne kaha, "Yeh unmein sabse behtar hain." Yeh sab tha jo us waqt hua, aur unhone unhe (farishton ko) dobara nahi dekha jab tak woh doosri raat aaye aur unhone apne dil se unki maujoodgi mahsoos ki, kyunke Nabi ki aankhen sote waqt band hoti thi, magar unka dil nahi sota tha. Yeh sab Nabiyon ki khasiyat hai: unki aankhen soti hain magar unka dil nahi sota. Phir Jibreel ne Nabi ki zimmedaari li aur unke saath aasman ki taraf chadhe.

e: Narrated `Imran bin Husain:That they were with the Prophet (ﷺ) on a journey. They travelled the whole night, and when dawn approached, they took a rest and sleep overwhelmed them till the sun rose high in the sky. The first to get up was Abu Bakr. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used not to be awakened from his sleep, but he would wake up by himself. `Umar woke up and then Abu Bakr sat by the side of the Prophet's head and started saying: Allahu-Akbar raising his voice till the Prophet (ﷺ) woke up, (and after traveling for a while) he dismounted and led us in the morning prayer. A man amongst the people failed to join us in the prayer. When the Prophet (ﷺ) had finished the prayer, he asked (the man), "O so-and-so! What prevented you from offering the prayer with us?" He replied, "I am Junub." Allah's Apostle ordered him to perform Tayammam with clean earth. The man then offered the prayer. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered me and a few others to go ahead of him. We had become very thirsty. While we were on our way (looking for water), we came across a lady (riding an animal), hanging her legs between two water-skins. We asked her, "Where can we get water?" She replied, "Oh ! There is no water." We asked, "how far is your house from the water?" She replied, "A distance of a day and a night travel." We said, "Come on to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." She asked, "What is Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" So we brought her to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) against her will, and she told him what she had told us before and added that she was the mother of orphans. So the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered that her two water-skins be brought and he rubbed the mouths of the water-skins. As we were thirsty, we drank till we quenched our thirst and we were forty men. We also filled all our waterskins and other utensils with water, but we did not water the camels. The waterskin was so full that it was almost about to burst. The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "Bring what (foodstuff) you have." So some dates and pieces of bread were collected for the lady, and when she went to her people, she said, "I have met either the greatest magician or a prophet as the people claim." So Allah guided the people of that village through that lady. She embraced Islam and they all embraced Islam
hi: Imran bin Husain (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Woh Nabi ke saath ek safar par the. Woh poori raat safar karte rahe, aur jab subah hone lagi, unhone aaram kiya aur neend ne unhe dabocha liya jab tak suraj aasman mein ooncha chadh gaya. Sabse pahle uthne wale Abu Bakr the. Allah ke Rasool ko kabhi jagaya nahi jata tha, balki woh khud jag jate the. Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) jage aur phir Abu Bakr Nabi ke sar ke bagal mein baithkar "Allahu Akbar" buland aawaaz mein kahne lage jab tak Nabi jag gaye, (aur kuch der safar karne ke baad) unhone (apni untni se) utarkar humari subah ki namaz padhaee. Ek shaks humari namaz mein shaamil nahi ho paya. Jab Nabi ne namaz khatam ki, unhone (us shaks se) pucha, "Aye falaan! Humare saath namaz padhne se tumhe kisne roka?" Usne jawab diya, "Main Junub hoon (yaani mujhe ghusal ki zaroorat hai)." Nabi ne unhe paak mitti se Tayammam karne ka hukum diya. Us shaks ne phir namaz padhi. Allah ke Rasool ne mujhe aur kuch aur logon ko apne aage jane ka hukum diya. Humein bahut zyada pyaas lagi. Jabke hum apne raaste par the (paani dhoondte hue), humein ek aurat mili (ek janwar par sawar), apni taangen do mashkon ke beech latkate huye. Humne unse pucha, "Humein paani kahaan milega?" Unhone jawab diya, "Oh! Yahaan koi paani nahi." Humne pucha, "Tumhara ghar paani se kitni doori par hai?" Unhone jawab diya, "Ek din aur ek raat ki doori." Humne kaha, "Allah ke Rasool ke paas chalo." Unhone pucha, "Allah ke Rasool kya hai?" Isliye hum unhe Allah ke Rasool ke paas laaye, unki marzi ke khilaf, aur unhone unhe wahi bataya jo unhone humein bataya tha, aur joda ke woh yatimon ki maa hai. Isliye Nabi ne hukum diya ke unki do mashken laee jaen aur unhone mashkon ke munhon ko chuya. Chunke hum pyaase the, humne piya jab tak humari pyaas bujh gaee, aur hum chaalis log the. Humne apni sab mashken aur bartan bhi paani se bhar diye, magar humne unton ko paani nahi diya. Mashk itna bhara tha ke lagta tha phat jaayega. Nabi ne phir kaha, "Jo bhi (khaane ka saaman) tumhare paas hai, lakar aao." Isliye us aurat ke liye kuch khajooren aur roti ke tukde jama kiye gaye, aur jab woh apne logon ke paas gaee, unhone kaha, "Main ya to sabse bade jaadugaar ya ek Nabi se mili, jaisa log daava karte hain." Isliye Allah ne us gaanv ke logon ko us aurat ke zariye hidayat di. Usne Islam qubool kiya aur unhone sab logon ne bhi Islam qubool kiya.

e: Narrated Anas:A bowl of water was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was at Az-Zawra. He placed his hand in it and the water started flowing among his fingers. All the people performed ablution (with that water). Qatada asked Anas, "How many people were you?" Anas replied, "Three hundred or nearly three hundred
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek paani ka bartan Nabi ke paas laaya gaya jabke woh Az-Zawra mein the. Unhone apna haath usmein rakha aur paani unki ungliyon ke beech se behne laga. Sab logon ne (usi paani se) wudu kiya. Qatada ne Anas se pucha, "Tum log kitne the?" Anas ne jawab diya, "Teen sau ya taquriban teen sau."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) at the 'time when the `Asr prayer was due. Then the people were searching for water for ablution but they could not find any. Then some water was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he placed his hand in the pot and ordered the people to perform the ablution with the water. I saw water flowing from underneath his fingers and the people started performing the ablution till all of them did it
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool ko Asr ki namaz ke waqt dekha. Log wudu ke liye paani dhoondne lage magar unhe koi nahi mila. Phir kuch paani Allah ke Rasool ke paas laaya gaya aur unhone apna haath bartan mein rakha aur logon ko usi paani se wudu karne ka hukum diya. Maine unki ungliyon ke neeche se paani behte dekha aur log wudu karne lage jab tak sab ne kar liya.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) went out on one of his journeys with some of his companions. They went on walking till the time of the prayer became due. They could not find water to perform the ablution. One of them went away and brought a little amount of water in a pot. The Prophet (ﷺ) took it and performed the ablution, and then stretched his four fingers on to the pot and said (to the people), "Get up to perform the ablution." They started performing the ablution till all of them did it, and they were seventy or so persons
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi apne kuch sahaba ke saath ek safar par gaye. Woh chalte rahe jab tak namaz ka waqt aa gaya. Unhe wudu karne ke liye paani nahi mila. Unme se ek shaks gaya aur ek bartan mein thoda paani lekar aaya. Nabi ne use liya aur wudu kiya, aur phir apni chaar ungliyaan bartan mein phailaee aur (logon se) kaha, "Wudu karne ke liye utho." Woh wudu karne lage jab tak sab ne kar liya, aur woh sattar ya uske aas-paas log the.

e: Narrated Humaid:Anas bin Malik said, "Once the time of the prayer became due and the people whose houses were close to the Mosque went to their houses to perform ablution, while the others remained (sitting there). A stone pot containing water was brought to the Prophet, who wanted to put his hand in it, but It was too small for him to spread his hand in it, and so he had to bring his fingers together before putting his hand in the pot. Then all the people performed the ablution (with that water)." I asked Anas, "How many persons were they." He replied, "There were eighty men
hi: Humaid bataate hain: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Ek baar namaz ka waqt aa gaya aur jinke ghar masjid ke qareeb the woh wudu karne apne ghar chale gaye, jabke doosre log wahaan ruke rahe. Ek pathar ka bartan paani bhari laaya gaya, aur Nabi apna haath usmein rakhna chahte the, magar woh unke haath phailane ke liye bahut chhota tha, isliye unhe apni ungliyaan ek saath karke bartan mein rakhna pada. Phir sab logon ne (usi paani se) wudu kiya." Maine Anas se pucha, "Woh kitne log the?" Unhone jawab diya, "Assi log the."

e: Narrated Salim bin Abi Aj-Jad:Jabir bin `Abdullah said, "The people became very thirsty on the day of Al-Hudaibiya (Treaty). A small pot containing some water was in front of the Prophet (ﷺ) and when he had finished the ablution, the people rushed towards him. He asked, 'What is wrong with you?' They replied, 'We have no water either for performing ablution or for drinking except what is present in front of you.' So he placed his hand in that pot and the water started flowing among his fingers like springs. We all drank and performed ablution (from it)." I asked Jabir, "How many were you?" he replied, "Even if we had been one-hundred-thousand, it would have been sufficient for us, but we were fifteen-hundred
hi: Salim bin Abi Aj-Jad bataate hain: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Log Al-Hudaibiya ke din bahut pyaase ho gaye. Ek chhota bartan jismein kuch paani tha, Nabi ke saamne tha, aur jab unhone wudu khatam kiya, log unki taraf daude. Unhone pucha, 'Kya baat hai?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Humare paas na wudu ke liye na pine ke liye koi paani hai siwaye jo aapke saamne hai.' Isliye unhone apna haath us bartan mein rakha aur paani unki ungliyon ke beech se sroton ki tarah behne laga. Hum sabne (usi se) piya aur wudu kiya." Maine Jabir se pucha, "Tum log kitne the?" Unhone jawab diya, "Chahe hum ek lakh hote, yeh humare liye kaafi hota, magar hum paanch sau pandra sau the."

e: Narrated Al-Bara:We were one-thousand-and-four-hundred persons on the day of Al-Hudaibiya (Treaty), and (at) Al- Hudaibiya (there) was a well. We drew out its water not leaving even a single drop. The Prophet (ﷺ) sat at the edge of the well and asked for some water with which he rinsed his mouth and then he threw it out into the well. We stayed for a short while and then drew water from the well and quenched our thirst, and even our riding animals drank water to their satisfaction
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Hum Al-Hudaibiya ke din ek hazaar chaar sau log the, aur (wahaan) Al-Hudaibiya mein ek kuaan tha. Humne uska paani nikala jab tak ek bhi bund na bacha. Nabi kue ke kinare baithe aur kuch paani maanga jisse unhone kulla kiya aur phir use kue mein phenka. Hum thoda intezaar karte rahe aur phir kue se paani nikala aur apni pyaas bujhaee, aur humare sawari ke janwaron ne bhi santusht hokar paani piya.
