e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Abu Talha said to Um Sulaim, "I have noticed feebleness in the voice of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) which I think, is caused by hunger. Have you got any food?" She said, "Yes." She brought out some loaves of barley and took out a veil belonging to her, and wrapped the bread in part of it and put it under my arm and wrapped part of the veil round me and sent me to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). I went carrying it and found Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the Mosque sitting with some people. When I stood there, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked, "Has Abu Talha sent you?" I said, "Yes". He asked, "With some food? I said, "Yes" Allah's Apostle then said to the men around him, "Get up!" He set out (accompanied by them) and I went ahead of them till I reached Abu Talha and told him (of the Prophet's visit). Abu Talha said, "O Um Sulaim! Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) is coming with the people and we have no food to feed them." She said, "Allah and His Apostle know better." So Abu Talha went out to receive Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Allah's Apostle came along with Abu Talha. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O Um Sulaim! Bring whatever you have." She brought the bread which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered to be broken into pieces. Um Sulaim poured on them some butter from an oilskin. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) recited what Allah wished him to recite, and then said, "Let ten persons come (to share the meal)." Ten persons were admitted, ate their fill and went out. Then he again said, "Let another ten do the same." They were admitted, ate their fill and went out. Then he again said, '"'Let another ten persons (do the same.)" They were admitted, ate their fill and went out. Then he said, "Let another ten persons come." In short, all of them ate their fill, and they were seventy or eighty men
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Um Sulaim se kaha, "Maine Allah ke Rasool ki aawaaz mein kamzori mahsoos ki hai jiski wajah, mujhe lagta hai, bhookh hai. Kya tumhare paas koi khaana hai?" Unhone kaha, "Haan." Unhone kuch jau ki rotiyaan nikali aur apna ek chunra liya, roti ka kuch hissa usme lapet kar mere baanh ke neeche rakha, aur mujhe Allah ke Rasool ke paas bheja. Main use lekar gaya aur Allah ke Rasool ko masjid mein kuch logon ke saath baithe paaya. Jab main wahaan khada hua, Allah ke Rasool ne pucha, "Kya Abu Talha ne tumhe bheja hai?" Maine kaha, "Haan." Unhone pucha, "Kuch khaane ke saath?" Maine kaha, "Haan." Allah ke Rasool ne apne aas-paas ke logon se kaha, "Utho!" Woh (unke saath) nikle aur main unse aage chala jab tak Abu Talha tak pahuncha aur unhe (Nabi ke aane ki) khabar di. Abu Talha ne kaha, "Aye Um Sulaim! Allah ke Rasool log lekar aa rahe hain aur humare paas unhe khilane ke liye koi khaana nahi hai." Unhone kaha, "Allah aur uske Rasool behtar jaante hain." Isliye Abu Talha Allah ke Rasool ka istikbaal karne bahar gaye. Allah ke Rasool Abu Talha ke saath aaye. Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Aye Um Sulaim! Jo bhi tumhare paas hai laao." Unhone roti laee jise Allah ke Rasool ne tukde karne ka hukum diya. Um Sulaim ne uspar ek chamde ke thaile se ghi daala. Phir Allah ke Rasool ne woh padha jo Allah chahta tha unhe padhna, aur kaha, "Das logon ko aane do (khaana baantne ke liye)." Das log andar aaye, pet bharkar khaya aur bahar chale gaye. Phir unhonne phir kaha, "Aur das ko bulao." Woh andar aaye, pet bharkar khaya, aur chale gaye. Phir unhonne kaha, "Aur das logon ko." (Sankshep mein), sab logon ne pet bharkar khaya, aur woh sattar ya assi log the.

e: Narrated `Abdullah:We used to consider miracles as Allah's Blessings, but you people consider them to be a warning. Once we were with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on a journey, and we ran short of water. He said, "Bring the water remaining with you." The people brought a utensil containing a little water. He placed his hand in it and said, "Come to the blessed water, and the Blessing is from Allah." I saw the water flowing from among the fingers of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) , and no doubt, we heard the meal glorifying Allah, when it was being eaten (by him)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum chamatkaron ko Allah ki barkaten maante the, magar tum log unhe ek chetaavni maante ho. Ek baar hum Allah ke Rasool ke saath ek safar par the, aur humare paas paani kam ho gaya. Unhone kaha, "Jo bhi paani tumhare paas bacha hai, lakar aao." Log ek bartan laaye jismein thoda paani tha. Unhone apna haath usme rakha aur kaha, "Is barkatvaar paani ki taraf aao, aur yeh barkat Allah ki taraf se hai." Maine dekha paani Allah ke Rasool ki ungliyon ke beech se behta hua, aur beshak, humne khaane ko (unke dwara khaaaye jane ke waqt) Allah ki tasbeeh karte suna.

e: Narrated Jabir:My father had died in debt. So I came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "My father (died) leaving unpaid debts, and I have nothing except the yield of his date palms; and their yield for many years will not cover his debts. So please come with me, so that the creditors may not misbehave with me." The Prophet (ﷺ) went round one of the heaps of dates and invoked (Allah), and then did the same with another heap and sat on it and said, "Measure (for them)." He paid them their rights and what remained was as much as had been paid to them
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Mere waalid ka intiqal qarz chhodkar hua. Isliye main Nabi ke paas gaya aur kaha, "Mere waalid ne (intiqal karte waqt) qarz chhoda hai, aur mere paas unke khajoor ke darakhton ki paidawaar ke siwa kuch nahi hai; aur kaee saal ki paidawaar bhi unka qarz poora nahi karegi. Isliye kripya mere saath chaliye, taake qarzdaar mere saath bura suluk na karen." Nabi khajoor ke ek dher ke chaaron taraf ghume aur dua ki, phir doosre dher ke saath bhi wahi kiya aur uspar baith gaye aur kaha, "(Unke liye) naapo." Unhone unka poora haqq ada kiya, aur jo bacha woh utna hi tha jitna unhe diya gaya tha.

e: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Bakr:The companions of Suffa were poor people. The Prophet (ﷺ) once said, "Whoever has food enough for two persons, should take a third one (from among them), and whoever has food enough for four persons, should take a fifth or a sixth (or said something similar)." Abu Bakr brought three persons while the Prophet (ﷺ) took ten. And Abu Bakr with his three family members (who were I, my father and my mother) (the sub-narrator is in doubt whether `Abdur-Rahman said, "My wife and my servant who was common for both my house and Abu Bakr's house.") Abu Bakr took his supper with the Prophet (ﷺ) and stayed there till he offered the `Isha' prayers. He returned and stayed till Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took his supper. After a part of the night had passed, he returned to his house. His wife said to him, "What has detained you from your guests?" He said, "Have you served supper to them?" She said, "They refused to take supper until you come. They (i.e. some members of the household) presented the meal to them but they refused (to eat)" I went to hide myself and he said, "O Ghunthar!" He invoked Allah to cause my ears to be cut and he rebuked me. He then said (to them): Please eat!" and added, I will never eat the meal." By Allah, whenever we took a handful of the meal, the meal grew from underneath more than that handful till everybody ate to his satisfaction; yet the remaining food was more than the original meal. Abu Bakr saw that the food was as much or more than the original amount. He called his wife, "O sister of Bani Firas!" She said, "O pleasure of my eyes. The food has been tripled in quantity." Abu Bakr then started eating thereof and said, "It (i.e. my oath not to eat) was because of Satan." He took a handful from it, and carried the rest to the Prophet. So that food was with the Prophet (ﷺ). There was a treaty between us and some people, and when the period of that treaty had elapsed, he divided us into twelve groups, each being headed by a man. Allah knows how many men were under the command of each leader. Anyhow, the Prophet (ﷺ) surely sent a leader with each group. Then all of them ate of that meal
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Bakr bataate hain: Suffa ke saathi gareeb log the. Ek baar Nabi ne kaha, "Jiske paas do logon ke liye khaana kaafi ho, use ek teesre ko (unmein se) le lena chahiye, aur jiske paas chaar logon ke liye ho, use paanchvaan ya chhatha le lena chahiye," ya kuch aisa hi kaha. Abu Bakr teen log lekar aaye jabke Nabi das log le gaye. Aur Abu Bakr apne teen pariwaar ke sadasyon ke saath (jo main, mere waalid, aur meri maa the) — (doosre raawi ko shak hai kya Abdur-Rahman ne kaha, "Meri biwi aur mera naukar jo mere aur Abu Bakr ke ghar donon ke liye saanjha tha.") Abu Bakr ne Nabi ke saath raat ka khaana khaya aur wahaan tab tak ruke jab tak unhone Isha ki namaz padhi. Woh wapas aaye aur wahaan ruke jab tak Allah ke Rasool ne apna raat ka khaana khaya. Raat ka kuch hissa guzarne ke baad, woh apne ghar wapas gaye. Unki biwi ne unse kaha, "Aapke mehmaanon ne aapko kya roka?" Unhone kaha, "Kya tumne unhe raat ka khaana diya?" Unhone kaha, "Unhonne aapke aane tak khaana lene se inkaar kiya. (Doosre pariwaar ke sadasyon ne) unhe khaana pesh kiya magar unhonne (khaane se) inkaar kiya." Main chhupne gaya aur unhone kaha, "Aye Ghunthar!" Unhone Allah se dua ki ke mere kaan kate jaen aur mujhe daanta. Phir unhone (mehmaanon se) kaha: "Kripya khaiye!" aur joda, "Main kabhi yeh khaana nahi khaunga." Allah ki qasam, jab bhi hum khaane ka mutthi bhar nikalte, khaana neeche se us mutthi se zyada badh jata jab tak har koi santusht hokar khata, phir bhi bacha hua khaana asal khaane se zyada tha. Abu Bakr ne dekha ke khaana utna hi ya usse zyada tha jitna woh pahle tha. Unhone apni biwi ko bulaya, "Aye Bani Firas ki behn!" Unhone kaha, "Aye meri aankhon ki thandak! Khaana teen guna ho gaya hai." Abu Bakr ne phir usmein se khaana shuru kiya aur kaha, "(Meri qasam) Shaitan ki wajah se thi." Unhone usmein se ek mutthi liya aur baaki Nabi ke paas le gaye. Isliye woh khaana Nabi ke paas tha. Humare aur kuch logon ke beech ek muahida tha, aur jab uski avadhi khatam huee, unhone humein baarah giroh mein baant diya, har giroh ka ek sardaar. Allah jaanta hai har sardaar ke tehat kitne log the. Beshak, Nabi ne har giroh ke saath ek sardaar bheja. Phir un sabne us khaane se khaya.

e: Narrated Anas:Once during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), the people of Medina suffered from drought. So while the Prophet was delivering a sermon on a Friday a man got up saying, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! The horses and sheep have perished. Will you invoke Allah to bless us with rain?" The Prophet (ﷺ) lifted both his hands and invoked. The sky at that time was as clear as glass. Suddenly a wind blew, raising clouds that gathered together, and it started raining heavily. We came out (of the Mosque) wading through the flowing water till we reached our homes. It went on raining till the next Friday, when the same man or some other man stood up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! The houses have collapsed; please invoke Allah to withhold the rain." On that the Prophet (ﷺ) smiled and said, "O Allah, (let it rain) around us and not on us." I then looked at the clouds to see them separating forming a sort of a crown round Medina
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Allah ke Rasool ki zindagi mein, Madina ke log sukhe se pareshaan the. Isliye Jumme ke din jabke Nabi khutba de rahe the, ek shaks utha aur bola, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Ghode aur bhedein marne lage hain. Kya aap barish ke liye dua karenge?" Nabi ne apne donon haath uthae aur dua ki. Aasman us waqt sheeshe jaisa saaf tha. Achanak hawa chali, baadal jama hue, aur tez barish shuru ho gaee. Hum (masjid se) behte hue paani mein chalte huye apne ghar tak pahunche. Barish agle Jumme tak jaari rahi, jab wahi shaks ya koi doosra shaks khade hokar bola, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Ghar gir rahe hain; kripya barish rokne ke liye dua kijiye." Isspar Nabi muskurae aur kaha, "Aye Allah! (Barish ho) humare aas-paas, humpar nahi." Phir maine baadlon ko dekha alag hote hue, Madina ke gird ek taj jaisa banate huye.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to deliver his sermons while standing beside a trunk of a datepalm. When he had the pulpit made, he used it instead. The trunk started crying and the Prophet (ﷺ) went to it, rubbing his hand over it (to stop its crying)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi khutba diya karte the ek khajoor ke tane ke bagal khade hokar. Jab unke liye mimbar banaya gaya, unhone uska istemal shuru kiya. Woh tana rone laga, aur Nabi uske paas gaye, apna haath uspar phere hue (usko rone se rokne ke liye).

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to stand by a tree or a date-palm on Friday. Then an Ansari woman or man said. "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shall we make a pulpit for you?" He replied, "If you wish." So they made a pulpit for him and when it was Friday, he proceeded towards the pulpit (for delivering the sermon). The datepalm cried like a child! The Prophet (ﷺ) descended (the pulpit) and embraced it while it continued moaning like a child being quietened. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It was crying for (missing) what it used to hear of religious knowledge given near to it
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi Jumme ke din ek darakht ya khajoor ke tane ke bagal khade hote the. Phir ek Ansaari aurat ya mard ne kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Kya hum aapke liye ek mimbar banaye?" Unhone jawab diya, "Agar tum chaho." Isliye unhone unke liye ek mimbar banaya, aur jab Jumma aaya, woh mimbar ki taraf (khutba dene) badhe. Khajoor ka tana bachche ki tarah rone laga! Nabi (mimbar se) utarkar use gale lagaya jabke woh bachche ko chup karane jaisa aawaaz karta raha. Nabi ne kaha, "Woh isliye ro raha tha kyunke usse (jo woh) apne paas se deeni ilm sunta tha, woh chhut gaya."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:That he heard Jabir bin `Abdullah saying, "The roof of the Mosque was built over trunks of datepalms working as pillars. When the Prophet (ﷺ) delivered a sermon, he used to stand by one of those trunks till the pulpit was made for him, and he used it instead. Then we heard the trunk sending a sound like of a pregnant she-camel till the Prophet (ﷺ) came to it, and put his hand over it, then it became quiet
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Unhone Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko kehte suna, "Masjid ki chhat khajoor ke tanon par banaee gaee thi jo khambon ka kaam karte the. Jab Nabi khutba dete, woh un tanon mein se ek ke bagal khade hote the jab tak unke liye mimbar banaya gaya, aur unhone uska istemal shuru kiya. Phir humne tane ko ek garbhvati untni jaisa aawaaz karte suna jab tak Nabi uske paas aaye aur apna haath uspar rakha, phir woh shaant ho gaya."

e: Narrated Hudhaifa:Once `Umar bin Al-Khattab said, "Who amongst you remembers the statement of Allah's Apostle regarding the afflictions?" Hudhaifa replied, "I remember what he said exactly." `Umar said, "Tell (us), you are really a daring man!" Hudhaifa said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'A man's afflictions (i.e. wrong deeds) concerning his relation to his family, his property and his neighbors are expiated by his prayers, giving in charity and enjoining what is good and forbidding what is evil.' " `Umar said, "I don't mean these afflictions but the afflictions that will be heaving up and down like waves of the sea." Hudhaifa replied, "O chief of the believers! You need not fear those (afflictions) as there is a closed door between you and them." `Umar asked, "Will that door be opened or broken?" Hudhaifa replied, "No, it will be broken." `Umar said, "Then it is very likely that the door will not be closed again." Later on the people asked Hudhaifa, "Did `Umar know what that door meant?" He said, "Yes, `Umar knew it as everyone knows that there will be night before the tomorrow morning. I narrated to `Umar an authentic narration, not lies." We dared not ask Hudhaifa; therefore we requested Masruq who asked him, "What does the door stand for?" He said, "`Umar
hi: Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab ne kaha, "Tum mein se kis ko Allah ke Rasool ka fitnon ke baare mein bataana yaad hai?" Hudhaifa ne jawab diya, "Mujhe woh yaad hai jo unhone kaha, bilkul sahi." Umar ne kaha, "Batao, tum sach mein bahadur insaan ho!" Hudhaifa ne kaha, "Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, 'Kisi shaks ke apne pariwara, apni maal, aur apne padoson ke prati (gunahon bhare) kaam uske namaz, sadqe, aur achhaee ka hukum dekar buraee se rokne se maaf ho jate hain.'" Umar ne kaha, "Mera matlab yeh fitne nahi, balki woh fitne jo samundar ki lahron jaise uthegi aur giregi." Hudhaifa ne jawab diya, "Aye Mominon ke Ameer! Tumhe un (fitnon) se darne ki zaroorat nahi kyunke tumhare aur unke beech ek band darwaza hai." Umar ne pucha, "Kya woh darwaza khola jaaega ya toda jaayega?" Hudhaifa ne jawab diya, "Nahi, woh toda jaayega." Umar ne kaha, "Phir yeh bahut sambhav hai ke darwaza dobara band nahi hoga." Baad mein logon ne Hudhaifa se pucha, "Kya Umar ko pata tha us darwaze ka matlab kya tha?" Unhone kaha, "Haan, Umar ko utna hi pata tha jitna har koi jaanta hai ke subah se pahle raat hoti hai. Maine Umar ko ek sachchi riwaayat sunaee, koi jhoot nahi." Humme Hudhaifa se aage sawal karne ki himmat nahi thi; isliye humne Masruq se guzarish ki jinhone unse pucha, "Woh darwaza kiske liye hai?" Unhone kaha, "Umar."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The Hour will not be established till you fight a nation wearing hairy shoes, and till you fight the Turks, who will have small eyes, red faces and flat noses; and their faces will be like flat shields. And you will find that the best people are those who hate responsibility of ruling most of all till they are chosen to be the rulers. And the people are of different natures: The best in the pre-Islamic period are the best in Islam. A time will come when any of you will love to see me rather than to have his family and property doubled
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Qiyamat tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak tum baal wale jooton pehne ek qaum se jung na karo, aur Turkon se jung na karo, jinki aankhen chhoti hoti hain, chehre laal hote hain, aur naak chapti hoti hai; aur unke chehre chapti dhalon jaise dikhte hain. Aur tum paoge ke sabse behtar log woh hain jo hukmarani ki zimmedaari se sabse zyada nafrat karte hain jab tak unhe hukmaran nahi chuna jaata. Aur log alag-alag fitrat ke hote hain: jahiliyat ke daur mein sabse behtar, Islam mein bhi sabse behtar. Ek waqt aayega jab tum mein se koi mujhe dekhna apne pariwara aur maal ke dogune se zyada aziz samjhega."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The Hour will not be established till you fight with the Khudh and the Kirman from among the non-Arabs. They will be of red faces, flat noses and small eyes; their faces will look like flat shields, and their shoes will be of hair
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Qiyamat tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak tum gair-Arab Khudh aur Kirman qabile se jung na karo. Woh laal chehre, chapti naak, aur chhoti aankhon wale honge; unke chehre chapti dhalon jaise dikhenge, aur unke joote baal ke bane honge."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I enjoyed the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for three years, and during the other years of my life, never was I so anxious to understand the (Prophet's) traditions as I was during those three years. I heard him saying, beckoning with his hand in this way, "Before the Hour you will fight with people who will have hairy shoes and live in Al-Bariz." (Sufyan, the sub-narrator once said, "And they are the people of Al-Bazar)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main teen saal Allah ke Rasool ki sohbat mein raha, aur apni zindagi ke doosre saalon mein, main kabhi unki riwaayaton ko samajhne ke liye itna betaab nahi tha jitna un teen saalon mein tha. Maine unhe apne haath se ishara karte huye kehte suna, "Qiyamat se pahle tum aise logon se jung karoge jinke joote baal ke bane honge aur jo Al-Bariz mein rahte honge." (Sufyan, doosre raawi ne ek baar kaha, "Aur woh Al-Bazar ke log hain.")

e: Narrated `Umar bin Taghlib:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "Near the Hour you will fight with people who will wear hairy shoes; and you will also fight people with flat faces like shields
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Taghlib bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool ko kehte suna, "Qiyamat ke qareeb tum un logon se jung karoge jinke joote baal ke bane honge; aur tum un logon se bhi jung karoge jinke chehre dhalon jaise chapte honge."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "The Jews will fight with you, and you will be given victory over them so that a stone will say, 'O Muslim! There is a Jew behind me; kill him
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool ko kehte suna, "Yahudi tumse jung karenge, aur tumhe unpar fatah di jaayegi jab tak ek patthar bhi kahega, 'Aye Musalman! Mere peeche ek Yahudi hai; use qatl karo.'"

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A time will come when the people will wage holy war, and it will be asked, 'Is there any amongst you who has enjoyed the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?' They will say: 'Yes.' And then victory will be bestowed upon them. They will wage holy war again, and it will be asked: 'Is there any among you who has enjoyed the company of the companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ?' They will say: 'Yes.' And then victory will be bestowed on them
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Ek waqt aayega jab log Jihad karenge, aur pucha jaayega, 'Kya tum mein koi hai jisne Allah ke Rasool ki sohbat ka anubhav liya ho?' Woh kahenge: 'Haan.' Aur phir unhe fatah di jaayegi. Woh phir Jihad karenge, aur pucha jaayega: 'Kya tum mein koi hai jisne Allah ke Rasool ke sahaba ki sohbat ka anubhav liya ho?' Woh kahenge: 'Haan.' Aur phir unhe fatah di jaayegi."

e: Narrated `Adi bin Hatim:While I was in the city of the Prophet, a man came and complained to him (the Prophet, ) of destitution and poverty. Then another man came and complained of robbery (by highwaymen). The Prophet said, "Adi! Have you been to Al-Hira?" I said, "I haven't been to it, but I was informed about it." He said, "If you should live for a long time, you will certainly see that a lady in a Howdah traveling from Al-Hira will (safely reach Mecca and) perform the Tawaf of the Ka`ba, fearing none but Allah." I said to myself, "What will happen to the robbers of the tribe of Tai who have spread evil throughout the country?" The Prophet (ﷺ) further said, "If you should live long, the treasures of Khosrau will be opened (and taken as spoils)." I asked, "You mean Khosrau, son of Hurmuz?" He said, "Khosrau, son of Hurmuz. And if you should live long, you will see that one will carry a handful of gold or silver and go out looking for a person to accept it from him, but will find none to accept it from him. And any of you, when meeting Allah, will meet Him without needing an interpreter between him and Allah to interpret for him, and Allah will say to him: 'Didn't I send a messenger to teach you?' He will say: 'Yes.' Allah will say: 'Didn't I give you wealth and do you favors?' He will say: 'Yes.' Then he will look to his right and see nothing but Hell, and look to his left and see nothing but Hell." `Adi further said: I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Save yourself from the (Hell) Fire even with half a date (to be given in charity) and if you do not find a half date, then with a good pleasant word." `Adi added: (later on) I saw a lady in a Howdah traveling from Al-Hira till she performed the Tawaf of the Ka`ba, fearing none but Allah. And I was one of those who opened (conquered) the treasures of Khosrau, son of Hurmuz. If you should live long, you will see what the Prophet (ﷺ) Abu-l-Qasim had said: 'A person will come out with a handful of gold...etc
hi: Adi bin Hatim (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jabke main Nabi ke shehar mein tha, ek shaks aaya aur unse (yaani Nabi se) gareebi ki shikaayat ki. Phir ek doosra shaks aaya aur luteron (raaste par lootne walon) ki shikaayat ki. Nabi ne kaha, "Adi! Kya tum Al-Hira gaye ho?" Maine kaha, "Main wahaan nahi gaya, magar mujhe uske baare mein bataya gaya hai." Unhone kaha, "Agar tum lambe waqt tak zinda rahe, tum zaroor dekhoge ke Howdah (yaani sawari ke jin ke saath baandha hua takht) mein baithi ek mahila Al-Hira se safar karegi (aur mahfooz Mecca pahunchegi) aur Ka'ba ka Tawaf karegi, Allah ke siwa kisi se na darte hue." Maine khud se socha, "Tayy qabile ke luteron ka kya hoga jinhone poore desh mein buraee phaila di hai?" Nabi ne aage kaha, "Agar tum lambe waqt tak zinda rahe, Khusrau ke khazanon ke darwaze khole jaenge (aur maal-e-ghanimat ke tor par liye jaenge)." Maine pucha, "Aapka matlab Khusrau, Hurmuz ke bete se hai?" Unhone kaha, "Khusrau, Hurmuz ke bete se. Aur agar tum lambe waqt tak zinda rahe, tum dekhoge ke koi mutthi bhar sona ya chandi lekar niklega yeh dhoondte hue ke koi ise usse le le, magar koi nahi milega jo ise le. Aur tum mein se koi bhi, jab woh Allah se milega, bina kisi anuvaadak ke milega jo unke beech tarjuma kare, aur Allah unse kahega: 'Kya maine tumhare paas ek Rasool nahi bheja tumhe sikhane ke liye?' Woh kahega: 'Haan.' Allah kahega: 'Kya maine tumhe daulat nahi di aur tumpar ehsaan nahi kiye?' Woh kahega: 'Haan.' Phir woh apni dahini taraf dekhega aur Dozakh ke siwa kuch nahi paaega, aur apni baaee taraf dekhega aur Dozakh ke siwa kuch nahi paaega." Adi ne aage kaha: Maine Nabi ko kehte suna, "Apne aap ko Dozakh (ki aag) se bachao, chahe aadhi khajoor (sadqe mein dekar) se hi ho, aur agar aadhi khajoor bhi na mile, to ek achhi aur khushnuma baat se." Adi ne joda: (baad mein) maine ek mahila ko Howdah mein Al-Hira se safar karte dekha jab tak unhone Ka'ba ka Tawaf kiya, Allah ke siwa kisi se na darte hue. Aur main un logon mein se tha jinhone Khusrau, Hurmuz ke bete, ke khazanon ko khola (fatah kiya). Agar tum lambe waqt tak zinda rahe, tum wahi dekhoge jo Nabi Abul-Qasim ne kaha tha: 'Ek shaks mutthi bhar sona lekar nikle...' aadi.

e: Narrated `Adi:as above (i.e. Hadith No)
hi: Adi bataate hain: (jaisa upar hai, yaani Hadith No.)

e: Narrated `Uqba bin `Amr:The Prophet (ﷺ) once came out and offered the funeral prayer for the martyrs of Uhud, and proceeded to the pulpit and said, "I shall be your predecessor and a witness on you, and I am really looking at my sacred Fount now, and no doubt, I have been given the keys of the treasures of the world. By Allah, I am not afraid that you will worship others along with Allah, but I am afraid that you will envy and fight one another for worldly fortunes
hi: Uqba bin Amr bataate hain: Ek baar Nabi bahar aaye aur Uhud ke shaheedon ke liye janaza namaz padhi, phir mimbar par gaye aur kaha, "Main tumhara pehle jaane wala aur tumpar gawaah honewala hoonga, aur beshak, main abhi apna muqaddas talab dekh raha hoon, aur beshak, mujhe duniya ke khazanon ki chaabiyaan di gaee hain. Allah ki qasam, mujhe dar nahi ke tum Allah ke saath doosron ko jodoge, magar mujhe dar hai ke tum duniyavi daulat ke liye eershya aur jhagda karoge."

e: Narrated Usama:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) stood on one of the high buildings (of Medina) and said, "Do you see what I see? I see affliction pouring among your houses like raindrops
hi: Usama bataate hain: Ek baar Nabi Madina ki ek oonchi imaarat par khade hue aur kaha, "Kya tum woh dekhte ho jo main dekh raha hoon? Main tumhare gharon ke beech barish ki boondon jaise fitne utarte dekh raha hoon."

e: Narrated Zainab bint Jahsh:That the Prophet (ﷺ) came to her in a state of fear saying, "None has the right to be worshiped but Allah! Woe to the Arabs because of evil that has come near. Today a hole has been made in the wall of Gog and Magog as large as this." pointing with two of his fingers making a circle. Zainab said, "I said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shall we be destroyed though amongst us there are pious people? ' He said, 'Yes, if evil increases
hi: Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Jahsh (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi dari hui haalat mein unke paas aaye aur kaha, "Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahi! Arbon par afsos ho us buraee ki wajah se jo qareeb aa gaee hai. Aaj Yajooj aur Majooj ki deewaar mein itna bada chhed ho gaya hai," apni do ungliyon se ek gola banate huye. Zainab ne kaha, "Maine kaha, 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Kya hum barbaad ho jaayenge chahe humare beech neik log ho?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan, jab buraee badh jaaye.'"

e: Um Salama said:The Prophet (ﷺ) woke up and said, "Glorified be Allah: What great (how many) treasures have been sent down, and what great (how many ) afflictions have been sent down
hi: Um Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi jaag gaye aur kaha, "Subhanallah! Kitne khazane naazil kiye gaye hain, aur kitne fitne naazil kiye gaye hain."

e: Narrated Sasaa:Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri said to me, "I notice that you like sheep and you keep them; so take care of them and their food, for I have heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, 'A time will come upon the people when the best of a Muslim's property will be sheep, which he will take to the tops of mountains and to the places of rain-falls to run away with his religion in order to save it from afflictions
hi: Sasaa bataate hain: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne mujhse kaha, "Maine dekha hai tumhe bhedein pasand hain aur tum unhe paalte ho; isliye unka aur unke khaane ka khyaal rakho, kyunke maine Allah ke Rasool ko kehte suna, 'Ek waqt aayega jab logon ke liye ek Musalman ki sabse behtar maal bhedein hongi, jinhe woh pahadon ki chotiyon aur barish wali jagahon par le jaayega apne deen ko fitnon se bachane ke liye.'"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "There will be afflictions (and at the time) the sitting person will be better than the standing one, and the standing one will be better than the walking, and the walking will be better than the running. And whoever will look towards those afflictions, they will overtake him, and whoever will find a refuge or a shelter, should take refuge in it." The same narration is reported by Abu Bakr, with the addition, "(The Prophet (ﷺ) said), 'Among the prayers there is a prayer the missing of which will be to one like losing one's family and property
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Fitne honge (us waqt) baithne wala khade hue se behtar hoga, aur khade hue wala chalte hue se behtar hoga, aur chalte hue wala daudte hue se behtar hoga. Aur jo bhi un fitnon ki taraf dekhega, woh use apni chapet mein le legi, aur jise koi panah ya sahaara mile, use us panah mein chala jaana chahiye." Yehi riwaayat Abu Bakr ne bhi bataee hai, is izafe ke saath, "(Nabi ne kaha), 'Namazon mein ek aisi namaz hai jiska chhutna aisa hoga jaisa apne pariwara aur maal ko khona.'"

e: Narrated Ibn Mas`ud:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Soon others will be preferred to you, and there will be things which you will not like." The companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What do you order us to do (in this case)? " He said, "(I order you) to give the rights that are on you and to ask your rights from Allah
hi: Ibn Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Jald hi tumhare badle doosron ko tarjih di jaayegi, aur aisi cheezein hongi jo tumhe pasand nahi aayengi." Nabi ke sahaba ne pucha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Aap humein (aisi haalat mein) kya karne ka hukum dete hain?" Unhone kaha, "(Main tumhe hukum deta hoon ke) tum apne oopar ke haqq poore karo aur apne haqq Allah se maango."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "This branch from Quraish will ruin the people." The companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "What do you order us to do (then)?" He said, "I would suggest that the people keep away from them
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Quraish ki yeh shaakha logon ko barbaad karegi." Nabi ke sahaba ne pucha, "Aap humein (phir) kya karne ka hukum dete hain?" Unhone kaha, "Main sujhaav dunga ke log unse door rahen."

e: Narrated Sa`id Al-Umawi:I was with Marwan and Abu Huraira and heard Abu Huraira saying, "I heard the trustworthy, truly inspired one (i.e. the Prophet (ﷺ) ) saying, 'The destruction of my followers will be brought about by the hands of some youngsters from Quraish." Marwan asked, "Youngsters?" Abu Huraira said, "If you wish, I would name them: They are the children of so-and-so and the children of so-and-so
hi: Sa'id Al-Umawi bataate hain: Main Marwan aur Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath tha aur maine Abu Huraira ko kehte suna, "Maine wafadaar, sachche ilham paane wale (yaani Nabi) ko kehte suna, 'Mere pairokaron ka tabaahi Quraish ke kuch jawan logon ke haathon hoga.'" Marwan ne pucha, "Jawan?" Abu Huraira ne kaha, "Agar tum chaho, main unke naam batata hoon: Woh falaan-falaan ke bachche hain aur falaan-falaan ke bachche hain."

e: Narrated Hudhaifa bin Al-Yaman:The people used to ask Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about good, but I used to ask him about evil for fear that it might overtake me. Once I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We were in ignorance and in evil and Allah has bestowed upon us the present good; will there be any evil after this good?" He said, "Yes." I asked, "Will there be good after that evil?" He said, "Yes, but it would be tained with Dakhan (i.e. Little evil)." I asked, "What will its Dakhan be?" He said, "There will be some people who will lead (people) according to principles other than my tradition. You will see their actions and disapprove of them." I said, "Will there be any evil after that good?" He said, "Yes, there will be some people who will invite others to the doors of Hell, and whoever accepts their invitation to it will be thrown in it (by them)." I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Describe those people to us." He said, "They will belong to us and speak our language" I asked, "What do you order me to do if such a thing should take place in my life?" He said, "Adhere to the group of Muslims and their Chief." I asked, "If there is neither a group (of Muslims) nor a chief (what shall I do)?" He said, "Keep away from all those different sects, even if you had to bite (i.e. eat) the root of a tree, till you meet Allah while you are still in that state
hi: Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Yaman bataate hain: Log Allah ke Rasool se achhaee ke baare mein puchte the, magar main unse buraee ke baare mein puchta tha, is dar se ke woh mujhe apni chapet mein le le. Ek baar maine kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Hum jahiliyat aur buraee mein the, aur Allah ne humein abhi ki achhaee di hai; kya is achhaee ke baad koi buraee hogi?" Unhone kaha, "Haan." Maine pucha, "Kya us buraee ke baad koi achhaee hogi?" Unhone kaha, "Haan, magar usmein Dakhan (yaani thoda bura) mila hoga." Maine pucha, "Uska Dakhan kya hoga?" Unhone kaha, "Kuch log honge jo (logon ki) agwaee meri sunnat ke ilawa doosri siddhanton ke aadhar par karenge. Tum unke amal dekhoge aur unhe napasand karoge." Maine kaha, "Kya us achhaee ke baad koi buraee hogi?" Unhone kaha, "Haan, kuch log honge jo doosron ko Dozakh ke darwazon ki taraf bulaenge, aur jo bhi unka nimantran qubool karega, use usme phenka jaayega." Maine kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Humein un logon ka varnan bataiye." Unhone kaha, "Woh humari hi qaum se honge aur humari hi bhaasha bolenge." Maine pucha, "Aap mujhe kya hukum dete hain agar aisa kuch mere jeevankal mein ho jaaye?" Unhone kaha, "Musalmanon ki jamaat aur unke Ameer ke saath jude raho." Maine pucha, "Agar (Musalmanon ki) koi jamaat na ho aur na koi Ameer (to kya karun)?" Unhone kaha, "Un sab alag-alag firqon se door raho, chahe tumhe ped ki jadon ko chuba-chubakar khaana pade, jab tak tum usi haalat mein Allah se milo."

e: Narrated Hudhaifa:My companions learned (something about) good (through asking the Prophet) while I learned (something about) evil
hi: Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Mere sathiyon ne Nabi se achhaee ke baare mein pucha, jabke maine buraee ke baare mein pucha.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The Day of (Judgment) will not be established till there is a war between two groups whose claims (or religion) will be the same
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Qiyamat tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak do giroh ke beech jung na ho jinke daave (ya deen) ek jaise honge."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The Hour will not be established till there is a war between two groups among whom there will be a great number of casualties, though the claims (or religion) of both of them will be one and the same. And the Hour will not be established till there appear about thirty liars, all of whom will be claiming to be the messengers of Allah
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Qiyamat tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak do giroh ke beech ek aisi jung na ho jinmein bahut zyada logon ki jaanen jaayengi, chahe donon ke daave (ya deen) ek hi hon. Aur Qiyamat tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak taquriban tees jhute log prakat na ho jaayen, sab Allah ke Rasool hone ka daava karte hue."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:While we were with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who was distributing (i.e. some property), there came Dhu-l- Khuwaisira, a man from the tribe of Bani Tamim and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Do Justice." The Prophet said, "Woe to you! Who could do justice if I did not? I would be a desperate loser if I did not do justice." `Umar said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Allow me to chop his head off." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Leave him, for he has companions who pray and fast in such a way that you will consider your fasting negligible in comparison to theirs. They recite Qur'an but it does not go beyond their throats (i.e. they do not act on it) and they will desert Islam as an arrow goes through a victim's body, so that the hunter, on looking at the arrow's blade, would see nothing on it; he would look at its Risaf and see nothing: he would look at its Nadi and see nothing, and he would look at its Qudhadh ( 1 ) and see nothing (neither meat nor blood), for the arrow has been too fast even for the blood and excretions to smear. The sign by which they will be recognized is that among them there will be a black man, one of whose arms will resemble a woman's breast or a lump of meat moving loosely. Those people will appear when there will be differences amongst the people." I testify that I heard this narration from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and I testify that `Ali bin Abi Talib fought with such people, and I was in his company. He ordered that the man (described by the Prophet (ﷺ) ) should be looked for. The man was brought and I looked at him and noticed that he looked exactly as the Prophet (ﷺ) had described him
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jabke hum Allah ke Rasool ke saath the jo (kuch maal) taqseem kar rahe the, Dhu-l-Khuwaisira, Bani Tamim qabile ka ek shaks aaya aur kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Insaf keejiye." Nabi ne kaha, "Afsos tujhpar! Kaun insaf karega agar main na karun? Main bahut zyada hara hua shaks hoonga agar main insaf na karun." Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe ijazat dijiye ke main iska sar kaat dun." Nabi ne kaha, "Ise chhod do, kyunke uske aise sathi hain ke jab tum unki namaz aur roze dekhoge, apni namaz aur roze ko unke saamne chhoti cheez samjhoge. Woh Quran padhte hain magar yeh unke gale se aage nahi jata (yaani woh ispar amal nahi karte), aur woh Islam se aise niklenge jaisa teer shikaar ke jism se aar-paar nikla jata hai, isliye shikari, teer ke phal ko dekhte huye, uspar kuch nahi paaega; woh uski Risaf dekhega aur kuch nahi paaega; woh uski Nadi dekhega aur kuch nahi paaega, aur woh uski Qudhadh dekhega aur kuch nahi paaega (na gosht na khoon), kyunke teer itna tez tha ke khoon ya gaandagi usse chipki hi nahi. Unhe pahchane ki nishaani yeh hai ke unme ek kaala shaks hoga, jiski ek baanh aurat ki chhaati jaisi ya gosht ke dheele tukde jaisi hogi. Yeh log tab prakat honge jab logon mein ikhtilaf hoga." (Raawi ne joda:) Main gawahi deta hoon ke maine yeh riwaayat Allah ke Rasool se suni, aur main gawahi deta hoon ke Ali (Alayhis Salam) bin Abi Talib ne aise logon se jung ki, aur main unki sohbat mein tha. Unhone hukum diya ke us shaks (jiska Nabi ne varnan kiya tha) ko dhoonda jaaye. Us shaks ko laaya gaya aur maine use dekha aur paaya ke woh bilkul waisa hi dikhta tha jaisa Nabi ne bataya tha.

e: Narrated `Ali:I relate the traditions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to you for I would rather fall from the sky than attribute something to him falsely. But when I tell you a thing which is between you and me, then no doubt, war is guile. I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "In the last days of this world there will appear some young foolish people who will use (in their claim) the best speech of all people (i.e. the Qur'an) and they will abandon Islam as an arrow going through the game. Their belief will not go beyond their throats (i.e. they will have practically no belief), so wherever you meet them, kill them, for he who kills them shall get a reward on the Day of Resurrection
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Main tumse Allah ke Rasool ki riwaayaten isliye batata hoon kyunke main aasman se girna pasand karunga bajaye iske ke main unse jhuta kuch jodun. Magar jab main tumhe kuch aisa batata hoon jo sirf tumhare aur mere beech ki baat hai, to beshak, jung dhoka hai. Maine Allah ke Rasool ko kehte suna, "Is duniya ke aakhri dinon mein kuch jawan aur bevkuf log prakat honge jo sab logon ke behtareen bolne (yaani Quran) ka istemal karenge, aur woh Islam se aise nikal jaenge jaise teer shikaar ke jism se aar-paar niklega. Unka iman unke gale se aage nahi jaayega, isliye jahaan bhi tum unse milo, unhe qatl karo, kyunke jo unhe qatl karega, use Qiyamat ke din ajr milega."

e: Narrated Khabbab bin Al-Arat:We complained to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (of the persecution inflicted on us by the infidels) while he was sitting in the shade of the Ka`ba, leaning over his Burd (i.e. covering sheet). We said to him, "Would you seek help for us? Would you pray to Allah for us?" He said, "Among the nations before you a (believing) man would be put in a ditch that was dug for him, and a saw would be put over his head and he would be cut into two pieces; yet that (torture) would not make him give up his religion. His body would be combed with iron combs that would remove his flesh from the bones and nerves, yet that would not make him abandon his religion. By Allah, this religion (i.e. Islam) will prevail till a traveler from Sana (in Yemen) to Hadrarmaut will fear none but Allah, or a wolf as regards his sheep, but you (people) are hasty
hi: Khabbab (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Arat bataate hain: Humne Allah ke Rasool se (kaafiron dwaara ki gaee zulm ki) shikaayat ki jabke woh Ka'ba ki chhaye mein apne Burd (yaani odhne wale kapde) par teke baithe the. Humne unse kaha, "Kya aap humare liye madad maangenge? Kya aap humare liye Allah se dua karenge?" Unhone kaha, "Tumse pahle ummaton mein, ek (imandaar) shaks ko ek gaddhe mein daalkar unke liye khode gaye gaddhe mein rakha jata, aur unke sar par ek aara rakha jata aur unhe do tukdon mein kaata jata; phir bhi yeh (yaatana) unhe apna deen chhodne par majboor nahi karti. Unke jism ko lohe ki kanghiyon se khurcha jata jo gosht ko haddiyon aur naeson se alag kar deta, phir bhi yeh unhe apna deen chhodne par majboor nahi karti. Allah ki qasam, yeh deen (yaani Islam) fatah paega jab tak Sana (Yemen) se Hadramaut tak ek musafir Allah ke siwa kisi se na dare, ya apni bhedon ke baare mein bhediye se na dare, magar tum log jaldbaazi kar rahe ho."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) noticed the absence of Thabit bin Qais. A man said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I shall bring you his news." So he went to him and saw him sitting in his house drooping his head (sadly). He asked Thabit, "What's the matter?" Thabit replied, "An evil situation: A man used to raise his voice over the voice of the Prophet (ﷺ) and so all his good deeds have been annulled and he is from the people of Hell." The man went back and told the Prophet (ﷺ) that Thabit had said so-and-so. (The sub-narrator, Musa bin Anas said, "The man went to Thabit again with glad tidings)." The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "Go and say to Thabit: 'You are not from the people of Fire, but from the people of Paradise
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Thabit bin Qais ki gair-maujoodgi ko mahsoos kiya. Ek shaks ne kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Main aapko unki khabar lakar dunga." Isliye woh unke paas gaye aur unhe apne ghar mein baithe apna sar jhukate dekha (dukhi hokar). Unhone Thabit se pucha, "Kya baat hai?" Thabit ne jawab diya, "Ek buri haalat: Ek shaks apni aawaaz Nabi ki aawaaz se oonchi kiya karta tha, isliye uske sab neik amal radd ho gaye hain aur woh Dozakh walon mein se hai." Woh shaks wapas gaya aur Nabi ko bataya ke Thabit ne aisa-aisa kaha hai. (Doosre raawi, Musa bin Anas ne kaha, "Woh shaks Thabit ke paas achhi khabar lekar wapas gaya.") Nabi ne unse (yaani us shaks se) kaha, "Jaao aur Thabit se kaho: 'Tum Dozakh walon mein se nahi ho, balki Jannat walon mein se ho.'"

e: Narrated Al-Bara' bin `Azib:A man recited Surat-al-Kahf (in his prayer) and in the house there was a (riding) animal which got frightened and started jumping. The man finished his prayer with Taslim, but behold! A mist or a cloud hovered over him. He informed the Prophet (ﷺ) of that and the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O so-and-so! Recite, for this (mist or cloud) was a sign of peace descending for the recitation of Qur'an
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks ne (apni namaz mein) Surah Al-Kahf padhi, aur ghar mein ek (sawari ka) janwar tha jo darkar koodne laga. Us shaks ne Taslim ke saath apni namaz khatam ki, magar dekho! Uske oopar ek dhundli ya baadal chhaya hua tha. Unhone Nabi ko iske baare mein bataya, aur Nabi ne kaha, "Aye falaan! Padhte raho, kyunke yeh (dhundli ya baadal) Quran ki tilaawat par utarne wali shaanti ki nishaani thi."

e: Narrated Al-Bara' bin `Azib:Abu Bakr came to my father who was at home and purchased a saddle from him. He said to `Azib, "Tell your son to carry it with me." So I carried it with him and my father followed us so as to take the price (of the saddle). My father said, "O Abu Bakr! Tell me what happened to you on your night journey with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (during Migration)." He said, "Yes, we travelled the whole night and also the next day till midday. when nobody could be seen on the way ( because of the severe heat) . Then there appeared a long rock having shade beneath it, and the sunshine had not come to it yet. So we dismounted there and I levelled a place and covered it with an animal hide or dry grass for the Prophet (ﷺ) to sleep on (for a while). I then said, 'Sleep, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and I will guard you.' So he slept and I went out to guard him. Suddenly I saw a shepherd coming with his sheep to that rock with the same intention we had when we came to it. I asked (him), 'To whom do you belong, O boy?' He replied, 'I belong to a man from Medina or Mecca.' I said, 'Do your sheep have milk?' He said, 'Yes.' I said, 'Will you milk for us?' He said, 'Yes.' He caught hold of a sheep and I asked him to clean its teat from dust, hairs and dirt. (The sub-narrator said that he saw Al-Bara' striking one of his hands with the other, demonstrating how the shepherd removed the dust.) The shepherd milked a little milk in a wooden container and I had a leather container which I carried for the Prophet (ﷺ) to drink and perform the ablution from. I went to the Prophet, hating to wake him up, but when I reached there, the Prophet (ﷺ) had already awakened; so I poured water over the middle part of the milk container, till the milk was cold. Then I said, 'Drink, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!' He drank till I was pleased. Then he asked, 'Has the time for our departure come?' I said, 'Yes.' So we departed after midday. Suraqa bin Malik followed us and I said, 'We have been discovered, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!' He said, Don't grieve for Allah is with us.' The Prophet (ﷺ) invoked evil on him (i.e. Suraqa) and so the legs of his horse sank into the earth up to its belly. (The subnarrator, Zuhair is not sure whether Abu Bakr said, "(It sank) into solid earth.") Suraqa said, 'I see that you have invoked evil on me. Please invoke good on me, and by Allah, I will cause those who are seeking after you to return.' The Prophet (ﷺ) invoked good on him and he was saved. Then, whenever he met somebody on the way, he would say, 'I have looked for him here in vain.' So he caused whomever he met to return. Thus Suraqa fulfilled his promise
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Bakr mere waalid ke paas aaye jo ghar par the aur unse ek jin (saddle) khareeda. Unhone Azib se kaha, "Apne bete ko mere saath ise le jane ko kaho." Isliye maine unke saath use uthaya, aur mere waalid unke peeche gaye qeemat lene ke liye. Mere waalid ne kaha, "Aye Abu Bakr! Mujhe bataiye aapko Allah ke Rasool ke saath apni raat ki (hijrat ki) safar mein kya hua." Unhone kaha, "Haan, hum poori raat aur agli din bhi dopahar tak safar karte rahe, jab (sakht garmi ki wajah se) raaste par koi dikh nahi raha tha. Phir ek lambi chattan dikhi jiske neeche chhaya thi, aur suraj abhi uspar nahi aaya tha. Isliye hum wahaan utre aur maine ek jagah samaan ki aur use janwar ki khaal ya sookhi ghaas se dhaka Nabi ke sone ke liye (kuch der ke liye). Phir maine kaha, 'Soiye, Ya Allah ke Rasool, main aapki rakhwali karunga.' Isliye woh soye aur main unki rakhwali karne bahar gaya. Achanak maine ek charwahe ko apni bheron ke saath us chattan ki taraf aate dekha, wahi irada lekar jo humara tha jab hum yahaan aaye. Maine (unse) pucha, 'Tum kiske ho, Aye ladke?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Main Madina ya Mecca ke ek shaks ka hoon.' Maine kaha, 'Kya tumhari bheron mein doodh hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan.' Maine kaha, 'Kya tum humare liye dohoge?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan.' Unhone ek bhed pakdi aur maine unse uski stan ko dhool, baal, aur gaandagi se saaf karne ko kaha. (Doosre raawi ne kaha unhone Al-Bara ko apne ek haath ko doosre se maar kar dikhate dekha, yeh dikhate hue ke charwaha dhool kaise hatataa tha.) Charwahe ne ek lakdi ke bartan mein thoda doodh doha aur mere paas ek chamde ka bartan tha jise main Nabi ke pine aur wudu karne ke liye laaya tha. Main Nabi ke paas gaya, unhe jagane se hichkichate hue, magar jab main wahaan pahuncha, Nabi pahle se hi jaag chuke the; isliye maine paani doodh ke bartan ke beech wale hisse par daala jab tak doodh thanda ho gaya. Phir maine kaha, 'Piyiye, Ya Allah ke Rasool!' Unhone piya jab tak main santusht ho gaya. Phir unhone pucha, 'Kya humare chalne ka waqt aa gaya hai?' Maine kaha, 'Haan.' Isliye hum dopahar ke baad chal pade. Suraqa bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) humara picha karne laga aur maine kaha, 'Humein dhundh liya gaya hai, Ya Allah ke Rasool!' Unhone kaha, 'Dukhi mat ho, Allah humare saath hai.' Nabi ne unpar (yaani Suraqa par) bad-dua ki aur unke ghode ke paanv zameen mein pet tak dhaanse gaye. (Doosre raawi, Zuhair ko yaqeen nahi kya Abu Bakr ne kaha, '(Woh dhaanse gaye) taani zameen mein.') Suraqa ne kaha, 'Maine dekha aapne mujhpar bad-dua ki hai. Kripya mujhpar achhi dua kijiye, aur Allah ki qasam, main aapko dhoondne walon ko wapas bhejunga.' Nabi ne unpar achhi dua ki aur woh bach gaye. Phir, jab bhi woh raaste par kisi se milte, woh kahte, 'Maine yahaan unhe be-faide dhoonda hai.' Isliye unhone jisse bhi mulaqaat ki, use wapas bheja. Isliye Suraqa ne apna waada poora kiya."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) paid a visit to a sick bedouin. The Prophet (ﷺ) when visiting a patient used to say, "No harm will befall you! May Allah cure you! May Allah cure you!" So the Prophet (ﷺ) said to the bedouin. "No harm will befall you. May Allah cure you!" The bedouin said, "You say, may Allah cure me? No, for it is a fever which boils in (the body of) an old man, and will lead him to the grave." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Yes, then may it be as you say
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ek beemar dehati se milne gaye. Jab bhi Nabi kisi mareez se milte, woh kahte, "Koi nuksaan nahi hoga! Allah tumhe theek kare! Allah tumhe theek kare!" Isliye Nabi ne dehati se kaha, "Koi nuksaan nahi hoga. Allah tumhe theek kare!" Dehati ne kaha, "Aap kahte hain Allah mujhe theek kare? Nahi, kyunke yeh ek bukhaar hai jo (ek budhe ke jism mein) ubaal raha hai, aur use qabar tak le jaayega." Nabi ne kaha, "Haan, phir aisa hi ho jaisa tum kehte ho."

e: Narrated Anas:There was a Christian who embraced Islam and read Surat-al-Baqara and Al-`Imran, and he used to write (the revelations) for the Prophet. Later on he returned to Christianity again and he used to say: "Muhammad knows nothing but what I have written for him." Then Allah caused him to die, and the people buried him, but in the morning they saw that the earth had thrown his body out. They said, "This is the act of Muhammad and his companions. They dug the grave of our companion and took his body out of it because he had run away from them." They again dug the grave deeply for him, but in the morning they again saw that the earth had thrown his body out. They said, "This is an act of Muhammad and his companions. They dug the grave of our companion and threw his body outside it, for he had run away from them." They dug the grave for him as deep as they could, but in the morning they again saw that the earth had thrown his body out. So they believed that what had befallen him was not done by human beings and had to leave him thrown (on the ground)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek Isaee tha jisne Islam qubool kiya aur Surah Al-Baqara aur Al-Imran padhi, aur woh Nabi ke liye (wahi) likhta tha. Baad mein woh phir Isaee ban gaya aur kehta tha, "Muhammad ko kuch nahi pata siwaye jo maine unke liye likha." Phir Allah ne unhe maar diya, aur logon ne unhe dafanaya, magar subah unhone dekha ke zameen ne unka jism bahar phenk diya tha. Unhone kaha, "Yeh Muhammad aur unke sathiyon ka kaam hai. Unhone humare sathi ki qabar khod di aur unka jism nikal liya kyunke woh unse bhaag gaya tha." Unhone unke liye phir gahra gaddha khoda, magar subah unhone phir dekha zameen ne unka jism bahar phenk diya tha. Unhone kaha, "Yeh Muhammad aur unke sathiyon ka kaam hai. Unhone humare sathi ki qabar khoda aur unka jism baahar phenk diya, kyunke woh unse bhaag gaya tha." Unhone unke liye jitni gahri ho sake khoda, magar subah unhone phir dekha zameen ne unka jism bahar phenk diya tha. Isliye unhone vishwas kiya ke jo unke saath hua woh insaanon ka kaam nahi tha aur unhe pheka hua chhodna pada.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When Khosrau perishes, there will be no (more) Khosrau after him, and when Caesar perishes, there will be no more Caesar after him. By Him in Whose Hands Muhammad's life is, you will spend the treasures of both of them in Allah's Cause
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Jab Khusrau khatam ho jaayega, uske baad koi (aur) Khusrau nahi hoga, aur jab Caesar khatam ho jaayega, uske baad koi (aur) Caesar nahi hoga. Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haathon mein Muhammad ki zindagi hai, tum unke donon ke khazane Allah ki raah mein kharch karoge."

e: Narrated Jabir bin Samura:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When Khosrau perishes, there will be no more Khosrau after him, and when Caesar perishes, there will be no more Caesar after him." The Prophet (ﷺ) also said, "You will spend the treasures of both of them in Allah's Cause
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Samura bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Jab Khusrau khatam ho jaayega, uske baad koi (aur) Khusrau nahi hoga, aur jab Caesar khatam ho jaayega, uske baad koi (aur) Caesar nahi hoga." Nabi ne yeh bhi kaha, "Tum unke donon ke khazane Allah ki raah mein kharch karoge."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Musailama-al-Kadhdhab (i.e. the liar) came in the life-time of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with many of his people (to Medina) and said, "If Muhammad makes me his successor, I will follow him." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went up to him with Thabit bin Qais bin Shams; and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was carrying a piece of a datepalm leaf in his hand. He stood before Musailama (and his companions) and said, "If you asked me even this piece (of a leaf), I would not give it to you. You cannot avoid the fate you are destined to, by Allah. If you reject Islam, Allah will destroy you. I think that you are most probably the same person whom I have seen in the dream." Abu Huraira told me that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ); said, "While I was sleeping, I saw (in a dream) two gold bracelets round my arm, and that worried me too much. Then I was instructed divinely in my dream, to blow them off and so I blew them off, and they flew away. I interpreted the two bracelets as symbols of two liars who would appear after me. And so one of them was Al-Ansi and the other was Musailama Al-Kadhdhab from Al-Yamama
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Musailama-Al-Kadhdhab (yaani jhoota) Allah ke Rasool ki zindagi mein apne bahut se logon ke saath (Madina) aaya aur kaha, "Agar Muhammad mujhe apna jaanshin banate hain, main unki pairvi karunga." Allah ke Rasool Thabit bin Qais bin Shams ke saath unke paas gaye; aur Allah ke Rasool ne apne haath mein khajoor ke patte ka ek tukda pakada hua tha. Woh Musailama (aur unke sathiyon) ke saamne khade hue aur kaha, "Agar tum mujhse yeh (ek patte ka tukda) bhi maango, main tumhe nahi dunga. Tum apni taqdir se bach nahi sakte, Allah ki qasam. Agar tum Islam radd karte ho, Allah tumhe barbaad karega. Mujhe lagta hai tum sambhavatya wahi ho jise maine khwab mein dekha tha." Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne mujhe bataya ke Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Jabke main so raha tha, maine (ek khwab mein) apni baanh ke gird sone ki do kanghiyaan dekhi, aur isne mujhe bahut pareshaan kiya. Phir mujhe Divine soorat se hidayat mili ke main unhe phoonk maar dun, isliye maine phoonka aur woh uda gaee. Maine un do kanghiyon ko do jhuton ka pratik samjha jo mere baad prakat honge. Isliye unme se ek Al-Ansi tha aur doosra Musailama Al-Kadhdhab, Al-Yamama se."

e: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "In a dream I saw myself migrating from Mecca to a place having plenty of date trees. I thought that it was Al-Yamama or Hajar, but it came to be Medina i.e. Yathrib. In the same dream I saw myself moving a sword and its blade got broken. It came to symbolize the defeat which the Muslims suffered from, on the Day of Uhud. I moved the sword again, and it became normal as before, and that was the symbol of the victory Allah bestowed upon Muslims and their gathering together. I saw cows in my dream, and by Allah, that was a blessing, and they symbolized the believers on the Day of Uhud. And the blessing was the good Allah bestowed upon us and the reward of true belief which Allah gave us after the day of Badr
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Ek khwab mein maine khud ko Mecca se ek aisi jagah hijrat karte dekha jahaan bahut khajoor ke darakht the. Maine socha yeh Al-Yamama ya Hajar hai, magar woh Madina, yaani Yathrib nikla. Usi khwab mein maine khud ko ek talwar chalate dekha aur uska phal tut gaya. Yeh us haar ka pratik bana jo Musalmanon ne Uhud ke din jhela. Maine talwar phir chalaee, aur woh pahle jaisi theek ho gaee, aur yeh us fatah ka pratik tha jo Allah ne Musalmanon ko di aur unhein ek saath jama kiya. Maine khwab mein gaayon ko dekha, aur Allah ki qasam, yeh ek barkat thi, aur woh Uhud ke din ke mominon ka pratik thi. Aur barkat woh achhaee thi jo Allah ne humein di, aur woh ajr jo Allah ne humein sachche iman ke liye diya Badr ke din ke baad."

e: Narrated `Aisha:Once Fatima came walking and her gait resembled the gait of the Prophet (ﷺ) . The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Welcome, O my daughter!" Then he made her sit on his right or on his left side, and then he told her a secret and she started weeping. I asked her, "Why are you weeping?" He again told her a secret and she started laughing. I said, "I never saw happiness so near to sadness as I saw today." I asked her what the Prophet (ﷺ) had told her. She said, "I would never disclose the secret of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." When the Prophet (ﷺ) died, I asked her about it. She replied. "The Prophet (ﷺ) said: 'Every year Gabriel used to revise the Qur'an with me once only, but this year he has done so twice. I think this portends my death, and you will be the first of my family to follow me.' So I started weeping. Then he said. 'Don't you like to be the chief of all the ladies of Paradise or the chief of the believing women? So I laughed for that
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ek baar Fatima (Alayhas Salam) chalte hue aee aur unka chalne ka andaaz Nabi ki chaal jaisa tha. Nabi ne kaha, "Khush aamdad, Aye meri beti!" Phir unhone unhe apni dahini ya baaee taraf baithaya, aur unhe ek raaz bataya aur woh rone lagi. Maine unse pucha, "Tum kyun ro rahi ho?" Unhone phir unhe ek raaz bataya aur woh haansne lagi. Maine kaha, "Maine kabhi khushi ko dukh se itna qareeb nahi dekha jitna aaj dekha." Maine unse pucha Nabi ne unhe kya bataya tha. Unhone kaha, "Main Allah ke Rasool ka raaz kabhi zaahir nahi karungi." Jab Nabi ka intiqal hua, maine unse phir pucha. Unhone jawab diya, "Nabi ne kaha: 'Har saal Jibreel mere saath Quran ka motabika (revision) sirf ek baar karte the, magar is saal unhone do baar kiya. Mujhe lagta hai yeh meri maut ka ishara hai, aur tum mere pariwara mein mujhse sabse pahle milne wali hogi.' Isliye main rone lagi. Phir unhone kaha, 'Kya tumhe khushi nahi hogi ke tum Jannat ki sab aurton ki sardaar bano ya sachche mominon aurton ki sardaar?' Isliye main haansi."

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) in his fatal illness, called his daughter Fatima and told her a secret because of which she started weeping. Then he called her and told her another secret, and she started laughing. When I asked her about that, she replied, The Prophet (ﷺ) told me that he would die in his fatal illness, and so I wept, but then he secretly told me that from amongst his family, I would be the first to join him, and so I laughed
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi ne apni aakhri bimari ke dauran apni beti Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ko bulaya aur unhe ek raaz bataya jiski wajah se woh rone lagi. Phir unhone unhe bulaya aur ek doosra raaz bataya, aur woh haansi. Jab maine unse iske baare mein pucha, unhone jawab diya, "Nabi ne mujhe bataya ke woh apni is aakhri bimari mein intiqal kar jaenge, isliye main roee, magar phir unhone raaz mein mujhe bataya ke apne pariwara mein se, main sabse pahle unse milungi, isliye main haansi."

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:About Ibn `Abbas: `Umar bin Al-Khattab used to treat Ibn `Abbas very favorably `Abdur Rahman bin `Auf said to him. "We also have sons that are equal to him (but you are partial to him.)" `Umar said, "It is because of his knowledge." Then `Umar asked Ibn `Abbas about the interpretation of the Verse:- 'When come the Help of Allah and the conquest (of Mecca) (110.1) Ibn `Abbas said. "It portended the death of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), which Allah had informed him of." `Umar said, "I do not know from this Verse but what you know
hi: Sa'id bin Jubair bataate hain: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke baare mein: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab unke saath bahut achha suluk karte the. Abdur Rahman bin Auf (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne unse kaha, "Humare bhi bete hain jo unke barabar hain (magar aap unke prati pakshpaat karte hain)." Umar ne kaha, "Yeh unke ilm ki wajah se hai." Phir Umar ne Ibn Abbas se is Ayat ki vyaakhya pucha: "Jab Allah ki madad aur fatah (Mecca ki) aaye..." (110:1) Ibn Abbas ne kaha, "Yeh Allah ke Rasool ki wafat ka ishara tha, jiski Allah ne unhe khabar di thi." Umar ne kaha, "Mujhe is Ayat se sirf wahi pata hai jo tumhe pata hai."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in his fatal illness came out, wrapped with a sheet, and his head was wrapped with an oiled bandage. He sat on the pulpit, and praising and glorifying Allah, he said, "Now then, people will increase but the Ansar will decrease in number, so much so that they, compared with the people, will be just like the salt in the meals. So, if any of you should take over the authority by which he can either benefit some people or harm some others, he should accept the goodness of their good people (i.e. Ansar) and excuse the faults of their wrong-doers." That was the last gathering which the Prophet (ﷺ) attended
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool apni aakhri bimari mein bahar aaye, ek chaadar mein lipete hue, aur unka sar ek tel lagi patti se baandha hua tha. Woh mimbar par baithe, aur Allah ki hamd aur uski taarif karke, unhone kaha, "Ab, log badhenge magar Ansaar sankhaya mein kam ho jaenge, itne ke woh, logon ke muqaable mein, khaane mein namak jaisi hongi. Isliye agar tum mein se koi hukumat sambhale jismein woh kuch logon ko faida ya kuch logon ko nuksaan pahuncha sake, use unke achhe logon (yaani Ansaar) ki achhaee qubool karni chahiye aur unke ghalat logon ki galtiyon ko maaf karna chahiye." Yehi aakhri sabha thi jismein Nabi shaamil hue.

e: Narrated Abu Bakra:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) brought out Al-Hasan and took him up the pulpit along with him and said, "This son of mine is a Saiyid (i.e. chief) and I hope that Allah will help him bring about reconciliation between two Muslim groups
hi: Abu Bakra (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Nabi Al-Hasan (Alayhis Salam) ko baahar laaye aur unhe apne saath mimbar par le gaye aur kaha, "Yeh mera beta Saiyid (yaani sardaar) hai, aur mujhe ummeed hai Allah unke zariye do Musalman girohon ke beech sulha karvaega."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) had informed us of the death of Ja`far and Zaid before the news of their death reached us, and his eyes were shedding tears
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne humein Ja'far aur Zaid ki maut ki khabar unki maut ki khabar humtak pahunchne se pahle di thi, aur unki aankhon se aansu beh rahe the.

e: Narrated Jabir:(Once) the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Have you got carpets?" I replied, "Whence can we get carpets?" He said, "But you shall soon have carpets." I used to say to my wife, "Remove your carpets from my sight," but she would say, "Didn't the Prophet (ﷺ) tell you that you would soon have carpets?" So I would give up my request
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: (Ek baar) Nabi ne kaha, "Kya tumhare paas qaalinen hain?" Maine jawab diya, "Humein qaalinen kahaan se milengi?" Unhone kaha, "Magar jald hi tumhare paas qaalinen hongi." Main apni biwi se kaha karta tha, "Apni qaalinen meri nazron se hataa do," magar woh kahti, "Kya Nabi ne aapko nahi bataya tha ke jald hi aapke paas qaalinen hongi?" Isliye main apni maang chhod deta.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Mas`ud:Sa`d bin Mu`adh came to Mecca with the intention of performing `Umra, and stayed at the house of Umaiya bin Khalaf Abi Safwan, for Umaiya himself used to stay at Sa`d's house when he passed by Medina on his way to Sham. Umaiya said to Sa`d, "Will you wait till midday when the people are (at their homes), then you may go and perform the Tawaf round the Ka`ba?" So, while Sa`d was going around the Ka`ba, Abu Jahl came and asked, "Who is that who is performing Tawaf?" Sa`d replied, "I am Sa`d." Abu Jahl said, "Are you circumambulating the Ka`ba safely although you have given refuge to Muhammad and his companions?" Sa`d said, "Yes," and they started quarreling. Umaiya said to Sa`d, "Don't shout at Abi-l-Hakam (i.e. Abu Jahl), for he is chief of the valley (of Mecca)." Sa`d then said (to Abu Jahl). 'By Allah, if you prevent me from performing the Tawaf of the Ka`ba, I will spoil your trade with Sham." Umaiya kept on saying to Sa`d, "Don't raise your voice." and kept on taking hold of him. Sa`d became furious and said, (to Umaiya), "Be away from me, for I have heard Muhammad saying that he will kill you." Umaiya said, "Will he kill me?" Sa`d said, "Yes,." Umaiya said, "By Allah! When Muhammad says a thing, he never tells a lie." Umaiya went to his wife and said to her, "Do you know what my brother from Yathrib (i.e. Medina) has said to me?" She said, "What has he said?" He said, "He claims that he has heard Muhammad claiming that he will kill me." She said, By Allah! Muhammad never tells a lie." So when the infidels started to proceed for Badr (Battle) and declared war (against the Muslims), his wife said to him, "Don't you remember what your brother from Yathrib told you?" Umaiya decided not to go but Abu Jahl said to him, "You are from the nobles of the valley (of Mecca), so you should accompany us for a day or two." He went with them and thus Allah got him killed
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Sa'd bin Mu'adh Mecca gaye Umrah karne ke irade se, aur Umaiya bin Khalaf Abi Safwan ke ghar mein ruke, kyunke Umaiya khud Sa'd ke ghar mein rukte the jab woh Madina se guzarte hue Sham jate the. Umaiya ne Sa'd se kaha, "Dopahar tak intezaar karoge jab log (apne gharon mein) honge, phir tum jaakar Ka'ba ka Tawaf kar sakte ho?" Isliye jabke Sa'd Ka'ba ka Tawaf kar rahe the, Abu Jahl aaya aur pucha, "Yeh Tawaf kaun kar raha hai?" Sa'd ne jawab diya, "Main Sa'd hoon." Abu Jahl ne kaha, "Kya tum mahfooz hokar Ka'ba ka Tawaf kar rahe ho jabke tumne Muhammad aur unke sathiyon ko panah di hai?" Sa'd ne kaha, "Haan," aur woh jhagadne lage. Umaiya ne Sa'd se kaha, "Abi-l-Hakam (yaani Abu Jahl) par mat chilla, kyunke woh wadi (Mecca) ke sardaar hain." Sa'd ne phir (Abu Jahl se) kaha, "Allah ki qasam, agar tumne mujhe Ka'ba ka Tawaf karne se roka, main tumhara Sham ka vyaapaar barbaad kar dunga." Umaiya baar-baar Sa'd se kaha karte, "Apni aawaaz oonchi mat karo," aur unhe thaamte rahe. Sa'd bahut gusse mein aa gaye aur (Umaiya se) kaha, "Mujhse door ho, kyunke maine Muhammad ko kehte suna hai ke woh tumhe qatl karega." Umaiya ne kaha, "Kya woh mujhe qatl karega?" Sa'd ne kaha, "Haan." Umaiya ne kaha, "Allah ki qasam! Jab Muhammad kuch kahte hain, woh kabhi jhoot nahi bolte." Umaiya apni biwi ke paas gaye aur unse kaha, "Kya tumhe pata hai mere Yathrib (yaani Madina) ke bhai ne mujhse kya kaha?" Unhone pucha, "Kya kaha?" Unhone kaha, "Woh daava karte hain ke unhone Muhammad ko daava karte suna hai ke woh mujhe qatl karenge." Unhone kaha, "Allah ki qasam! Muhammad kabhi jhoot nahi bolte." Isliye jab kaafir Badr (ki jung) ke liye rawana hue aur jung ka elaan kiya, unki biwi ne unse kaha, "Kya tumhe yaad nahi tumhare Yathrib ke bhai ne tumse kya kaha tha?" Umaiya ne na jane ka faisla kiya, magar Abu Jahl ne unse kaha, "Tum wadi (Mecca) ke izzatdaar logon mein se ho, isliye tumhe ek-do din ke liye humare saath chalna chahiye." Woh unke saath gaye aur isi tarah Allah ne unhe (yuddha mein) maar dilwaya.

e: Narrated `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I saw (in a dream) the people assembled in a gathering, and then Abu Bakr got up and drew one or two buckets of water (from a well) but there was weakness in his drawing. May Allah forgive him. Then `Umar took the bucket and in his hands it turned into a very large bucket. I had never seen anyone amongst: the people who could draw the water as strongly as `Umar till all the people drank their fill and watered their camels that knelt down there
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Maine (ek khwab mein) dekha ke log ek jama'at mein ikattthe hain, aur phir Abu Bakr uthe aur ek ya do baalti paani (kue se) nikali magar unke nikalne mein kamzori thi. Allah unhe maaf kare. Phir Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne baalti li aur unke haathon mein woh ek bahut badi baalti ban gaee. Maine kabhi kisi ko itni taakat se paani nikalte nahi dekha jitni Umar ne nikala jab tak sab logon ne apni pyaas bujhaee aur apne baithe hue unton ko bhi paani pilaya."

e: Narrated Abu `Uthman:I got the news that Gabriel came to the Prophet (ﷺ) while Um Salama was present. Gabriel started talking (to the Prophet (ﷺ) and then left. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to Um Salama, "(Do you know) who it was?" (or a similar question). She said, "It was Dihya (a handsome person amongst the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) )." Later on Um Salama said, "By Allah! I thought he was none but Dihya, till I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) talking about Gabriel in his sermon." (The Sub-narrator asked Abu `Uthman, "From where have you heard this narration?" He replied, "From Usama bin Zaid)
hi: Abu Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Mujhe khabar mili ke Jibreel Nabi ke paas aaye jabke Um Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) maujood thi. Jibreel ne (Nabi se) baat ki aur phir chale gaye. Nabi ne Um Salama se pucha, "(Kya tumhe pata hai) yeh kaun tha?" (ya isse milta-julta sawal). Unhone kaha, "Yeh Dihya the (Nabi ke sahaba mein se ek khoobsurat shaks)." Baad mein Um Salama ne kaha, "Allah ki qasam! Maine socha yeh Dihya hi hain, jab tak maine Nabi ko apne khutbe mein Jibreel ke baare mein baat karte suna."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The Jews came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and told him that a man and a woman from amongst them had committed illegal sexual intercourse. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to them, "What do you find in the Torah (old Testament) about the legal punishment of Ar-Rajm (stoning)?" They replied, (But) we announce their crime and lash them." `Abdullah bin Salam said, "You are telling a lie; Torah contains the order of Rajm." They brought and opened the Torah and one of them placed his hand on the Verse of Rajm and read the verses preceding and following it. `Abdullah bin Salam said to him, "Lift your hand." When he lifted his hand, the Verse of Rajm was written there. They said, "Muhammad has told the truth; the Torah has the Verse of Rajm. The Prophet (ﷺ) then gave the order that both of them should be stoned to death. (`Abdullah bin `Umar said, "I saw the man leaning over the woman to shelter her from the stones)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Yahudi Allah ke Rasool ke paas aaye aur unhe bataya ke unme se ek mard aur ek aurat ne na-jaiz ta'alluq banaya hai. Allah ke Rasool ne unse pucha, "Torah mein Ar-Rajm (yaani patharon se maarne ki saza) ke baare mein kya hukum hai?" Unhone jawab diya, "(Magar) hum unka gunah elaan karte hain aur unhe kode maarte hain." Abdullah bin Salam (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Tum jhoot bol rahe ho; Torah mein Rajm ka hukum hai." Woh Torah laaye aur kholi, aur unme se ek ne apna haath Rajm ki Ayat par rakha aur uske pahle aur baad ki Ayaten padhi. Abdullah bin Salam ne unse kaha, "Apna haath uthao." Jab unhone uthaya, wahaan Rajm ki Ayat likhi hui thi. Unhone kaha, "Muhammad ne sach kaha; Torah mein Rajm ki Ayat hai." Nabi ne phir hukum diya ke donon ko partharon se maar diya jaaye. (Abdullah bin Umar ne kaha, "Maine dekha woh mard aurat ke oopar jhuka hua tha use partharon se bachane ke liye.")

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Masud:During the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) the moon was split into two parts and on that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Bear witness (to this)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ki zindagi mein chaand do tukdon mein baant gaya, aur isspar Nabi ne kaha, "(Iski) gawahi do."

e: Narrated Anas:That the Meccan people requested Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to show them a miracle, and so he showed them the splitting of the moon
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Mecca walon ne Allah ke Rasool se ek chamatkar dikhane ki guzarish ki, isliye unhone unhe chaand ka do tukdon mein baanta hua dikhaya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The moon was split into two parts during the lifetime of the Prophet
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Chaand Nabi ki zindagi mein do tukdon mein baanta gaya.

e: Narrated Anas:Once two men from the companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went out of the house of the Prophet (ﷺ) on a very dark night. They were accompanied by two things that resembled two lamps lighting the way in front of them, and when they parted, each of them was accompanied by one of those two things (lamps) till they reached their homes
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Allah ke Rasool ke do sahaba Nabi ke ghar se ek bahut andheri raat mein nikle. Unke saath do cheezein thi jo do laiton jaisi thi jo unke aage raasta roshan kar rahi thi, aur jab woh alag hue, har ek ke saath un donon cheezon mein se ek thi jab tak woh apne ghar pahunche.

e: Narrated Al-Mughira bin Shu`ba:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Some of my followers will remain victorious (and on the right path) till the Last Day comes, and they will still be victorious
hi: Al-Mughira bin Shu'ba (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Mere pairokaron mein se kuch log Qiyamat tak fatah pate rahenge (aur seedhe raaste par rahenge), aur woh phir bhi fatah pate rahenge."

e: Narrated Muawiya:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "A group of people amongst my followers will remain obedient to Allah's orders and they will not be harmed by anyone who will not help them or who will oppose them, till Allah's Order (the Last Day) comes upon them while they are still on the right path
hi: Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi ko kehte suna, "Mere pairokaron mein ek giroh Allah ke ahkaam ki itaaat karta rahega, aur unhe koi nuksaan nahi pahunchaega jo unki madad na kare ya unke khilaf ho, jab tak Allah ka hukum (Qiyamat) unpar na aa jaaye jabke woh abhi bhi seedhe raaste par honge."

e: Narrated `Urwa:That the Prophet (ﷺ) gave him one Dinar so as to buy a sheep for him. `Urwa bought two sheep for him with the money. Then he sold one of the sheep for one Dinar, and brought one Dinar and a sheep to the Prophet. On that, the Prophet (ﷺ) invoked Allah to bless him in his deals. So `Urwa used to gain (from any deal) even if he bought dust. (In another narration) `Urwa said, "I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "There is always goodness in horses till the Day of Resurrection." (The subnarrator added, "I saw 70 horses in `Urwa's house.') (Sufyan said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) asked `Urwa to buy a sheep for him as a sacrifice
hi: Urwa bataate hain: Nabi ne unhe ek Dinar diya taake woh unke liye ek bhed khareed saken. Urwa ne us paise se do bhedein khareedi. Phir unhone ek bhed ek Dinar mein bech di, aur ek Dinar aur ek bhed Nabi ke paas laaye. Isspar, Nabi ne unke vyapaar mein barkat ke liye Allah se dua ki. Isliye Urwa (kisi bhi soude se) faayda pate the chahe woh dhool hi khareeden. (Ek doosri riwaayat mein) Urwa ne kaha, "Maine Allah ke Rasool ko kehte suna, 'Ghodon mein hamesha Qiyamat tak achhaee rahegi.'" (Doosre raawi ne joda, "Maine Urwa ke ghar mein sattar ghode dekhe.") (Sufyan ne kaha, "Nabi ne Urwa se unke liye qurbani ke liye ek bhed khareedne ko kaha.")

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "There is always goodness in horses till the Day of Resurrection
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Ghodon mein hamesha Qiyamat tak achhaee rahegi."

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There is always goodness in horses
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Ghodon mein hamesha achhaee rahegi."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A horse may be kept for one of three purposes: for a man it may be a source of reward; for another it may be a means of living; and for a third it may be a burden (a source of committing sins). As for the one for whom it is a source of reward, he is the one who keeps his horse for the sake of Jihad in Allah's Cause; he ties it with a long rope on a pasture or in a garden. So whatever its rope allows it to eat, will be regarded as good rewardable deeds (for its owner). And if it breaks off its rope and jumps over one or two hillocks, even its dung will be considered amongst his good deeds.
