And if it passes by a river and drinks water from it, that will be considered as good deeds for his benefit) even if he has had no intention of watering it. A horse is a shelter for the one who keeps it so that he may earn his living honestly and takes it as a refuge to keep him from following illegal ways (of gaining money), and does not forget the rights of Allah (i.e. paying the Zakat and allowing others to use it for Allah's Sake). But a horse is a burden (and a source of committing sins for him who keeps it out of pride and pretense and with the intention of harming the Muslims." The Prophet (ﷺ) was asked about donkeys. He replied, "Nothing has been revealed to me concerning them except this comprehensive Verse (which covers everything) :--'Then whosoever has done good equal to the weight of an atom (or a small ant), Shall see it (its reward) And whosoever has done evil equal to the weight of an atom (or a small ) ant), Shall see it (Its punishment)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Ghoda teen maqsad ke liye rakha ja sakta hai: kisi ke liye woh ajr ka zariya hoga; kisi doosre ke liye woh rozi kamane ka zariya hoga; aur kisi teesre ke liye woh bojh (yaani gunah karne ka zariya) hoga. Jiske liye woh ajr ka zariya hai, woh hai jo apna ghoda Allah ki raah mein Jihad ke liye rakhta hai; woh ise ek lambi rassi se ek charaagah ya baag mein baandhta hai. Isliye ghoda jitna bhi apni rassi ki lambaee mein khata hai, use achhe, ajr wale amalon mein gina jaayega. Aur agar woh apni rassi todkar ek ya do tilon ko paar karta hai, uska mal bhi uske neik amalon mein gina jaayega. Aur agar woh kisi nadi ke paas se guzarta hai aur usmein se paani pita hai, ise bhi uske faayde mein achha amal gina jaayega, chahe uska paani pilane ka irada na ho. Ghoda us shaks ke liye ek panah hai jo ise apni imandaar rozi kamane ke liye rakhta hai aur najaiz raaston se paisa kamane se bachne ke liye ise ek sahaara samajhta hai, aur Allah ke haqq (yaani Zakat dena aur doosron ko Allah ke liye istemal karne dena) nahi bhoolta. Magar ghoda bojh (aur gunah ka zariya) hai us shaks ke liye jo ise ghamand, dikhaave, aur Musalmanon ko nuksaan pahunchane ki niyyat se rakhta hai." Nabi se gadhon ke baare mein pucha gaya. Unhone jawab diya, "Mujhpar unke baare mein khaas kuch nazil nahi hua siwaye is sarva-samaveshi Ayat ke: 'Jo bhi zarra-barabar neki karega, use dekhega, aur jo bhi zarra-barabar buraee karega, use dekhega.'"

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) reached Khaibar in the early morning and the people of Khaibar came out with their spades, and when they saw the Prophet (ﷺ) they said, "Muhammad and his army!" and returned hurriedly to take refuge in the fort. The Prophet (ﷺ) raised his hands and said, "Allah is Greater! Khaibar is ruined ! If we approach a nation, then miserable is the morning of those who are warned
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool subah-subah Khaibar pahunche, aur Khaibar ke log apne phaavdon lekar bahar aaye, aur jab unhone Nabi ko dekha, unhone kaha, "Muhammad aur unki fauj!" aur jaldi se qile mein panah lene bhaag gaye. Nabi ne apne haath uthaye aur kaha, "Allahu Akbar! Khaibar barbaad hua! Jab hum kisi qaum ke qareeb aate hain, chetaavni paane walon ki subah bahut buri hoti hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I hear many narrations from you but I forget them." He said, "Spread your covering sheet." I spread my sheet and he moved both his hands as if scooping something and emptied them in the sheet and said, "Wrap it." I wrapped it round my body, and since then I have never forgotten
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Main aapse bahut riwaayaten sunta hoon magar unhe bhool jata hoon." Unhone kaha, "Apna odhne wala kapda phailao." Maine apna kapda phailaya aur unhone apne donon haathon se aisa ishara kiya jaise kuch sameetkar (mere kapde mein) khali kar rahe hon aur kaha, "Ise lapet lo." Maine ise apne jism ke gird lapeta, aur tab se main kabhi kuch bhoola nahi.

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:"Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "A time will come upon the people, when a group of people will wage a holy war and it will be said, 'Is there amongst you anyone who has accompanied Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?' They will say, 'Yes.' And so victory will be bestowed on them. Then a time will come upon the people when a group of people will wage a holy war, and it will be said, "Is there amongst you anyone who has accompanied the companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?' They will say, 'Yes.' And so victory will be bestowed on them. Then a time will come upon the people when a group of people will wage a holy war, and it will be said, "Is there amongst you anyone who has been in the company of the companions of the companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ?' They will say, 'Yes.' And victory will be bestowed on them
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Ek waqt aayega jab log Jihad karenge, aur pucha jaayega, 'Kya tum mein koi hai jisne Allah ke Rasool ki sohbat ka anubhav liya ho?' Woh kahenge: 'Haan.' Aur unhe fatah di jaayegi. Phir ek waqt aayega jab log Jihad karenge, aur pucha jaayega, 'Kya tum mein koi hai jisne Allah ke Rasool ke sahaba ki sohbat ka anubhav liya ho?' Woh kahenge: 'Haan.' Aur unhe fatah di jaayegi. Phir ek waqt aayega jab log Jihad karenge, aur pucha jaayega, 'Kya tum mein koi hai jisne Allah ke Rasool ke sahaba ke sathiyon ki sohbat ka anubhav liya ho?' Woh kahenge: 'Haan.' Aur unhe fatah di jaayegi."

e: Narrated `Imran bin Husain:"Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'The best of my followers are those living in my generation (i.e. my contemporaries). and then those who will follow the latter" `Imran added, "I do not remember whether he mentioned two or three generations after his generation, then the Prophet (ﷺ) added, 'There will come after you, people who will bear witness without being asked to do so, and will be treacherous and untrustworthy, and they will vow and never fulfill their vows, and fatness will appear among them
hi: Imran bin Husain (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Mere pairokaron mein sabse behtar meri peedhi ke log hain, phir unke baad walon ki peedhi." Imran ne joda, "Mujhe yaad nahi kya unhone do ya teen peedhiyon ka zikar kiya apni peedhi ke baad, phir Nabi ne joda, 'Tumhare baad aise log aaenge jo bina puche gawahi denge, aur woh dagabaaz aur bharose ke laayak nahi honge, aur woh mannat mangenge aur kabhi apni mannat poori nahi karenge, aur unme motaee dikhne lagegi.'"

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The best people are those living in my generation, and then those who will follow them, and then those who will follow the latter. Then there will come some people who will bear witness before taking oaths, and take oaths before bearing witness." (Ibrahim, a sub-narrator said, "They used to beat us for witnesses and covenants when we were still children)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Sab logon mein sabse behtar meri peedhi ke log hain, phir unke baad wale, phir unke baad wale. Phir aise log aaenge jo qasam khane se pahle gawahi denge, aur gawahi dene se pahle qasam khaenge." (Ibrahim, doosre raawi ne kaha, "Woh humein gawahi aur muahidon ke liye maarte the jab hum bachche the.")

e: Narrated Al-Bara':Abu Bakr bought a (camel) saddle from `Azib for thirteen Dirhams. Abu Bakr said to `Azib, "Tell Al- Bara' to carry the saddle for me." `Azib said, "No, unless you relate to me what happened to you and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) when you left Mecca while the pagans were in search of you." Abu Bakr said, "We left Mecca and we traveled continuously for that night and the following day till it was midday. I looked (around) searching for shade to take as shelter, and suddenly I came across a rock, and found a little shade there. So I cleaned the place and spread a bed for the Prophet (ﷺ) in the shade and said to him, 'Lie down, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).' So the Prophet (ﷺ) lay down and I went out, looking around to see if there was any person pursuing us. Suddenly I saw a shepherd driving his sheep towards the rock, seeking what we had already sought from it. I asked him, 'To whom do you belong, O boy?' He said, 'I belong to a man from Quraish.' He named the man and I recognized him. I asked him, 'Is there any milk with your sheep?' He said, 'Yes.' I said, 'Will you then milk (some) for us?' He said, 'Yes.' Then I asked him to tie the legs of one of the sheep and clean its udder, and then ordered him to clean his hands from dust. Then the shepherd cleaned his hands by striking his hands against one another. After doing so, he milked a small amount of milk. I used to keep for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) a leather water-container, the mouth of which was covered with a piece of cloth. I poured water on the milk container till its lower part was cold. Then I took the milk to the Prophet (ﷺ) whom I found awake. I said to him, 'Drink, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).' So he drank till I became pleased. Then I said, 'It is time for us to move, O Allah's Apostle!' He said, 'Yes.' So we set out while the people (i.e. Quraish pagans) were searching for us, but none found us except Suraqah bin Malik bin Ju`shum who was riding his horse. I said, 'These are our pursuers who have found us. O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!' He said, 'Do not grieve, for Allah is with us
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Abu Bakr ne Azib se terah Dirham mein ek (unt ki) jin khareedi. Abu Bakr ne Azib se kaha, "Al-Bara se kaho jin mere saath le jaayen." Azib ne kaha, "Nahi, jab tak aap mujhe na bataiye ke jab aap Mecca chhodkar nikle the aur mushrik aapko dhoondh rahe the, aapko aur Allah ke Rasool ko kya hua." Abu Bakr ne kaha, "Hum Mecca se nikle aur poori raat aur agli din bhi dopahar tak safar karte rahe. Maine (aas-paas) chhaya dhoondhta rahe, aur achanak maine ek chattan paee aur wahaan thodi chhaya paee. Isliye maine jagah saaf ki aur Nabi ke liye chhaye mein ek bistar bichhaya aur unse kaha, 'Leti jaiye, Ya Allah ke Rasool.' Isliye Nabi lete gaye aur main bahar gaya, dekhte hue koi humara picha to nahi kar raha. Achanak maine ek charwaaha apni bheron ko us chattan ki taraf le jate dekha, wahi cheez chahte hue jo humne pahle wahaan se chahi thi. Maine (unse) pucha, 'Tum kiske ho, Aye ladke?' Unhone kaha, 'Main Quraish ke ek shaks ka hoon.' Unhone shaks ka naam liya aur maine unhe pahchana. Maine unse pucha, 'Kya tumhari bheron mein doodh hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan.' Maine kaha, 'Phir kya tum humare liye dohoge?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan.' Phir maine unse ek bhed ke paanv baandhne aur uski stan saaf karne ko kaha, aur phir unhe apne haath dhool se saaf karne ka hukum diya. Iske baad, charwaha ne apne haathon ko ek-doosre par maar kar saaf kiya. Aisa karne ke baad, unhone thoda doodh doha. Main Allah ke Rasool ke liye ek chamde ka paani ka bartan rakhta tha, jiska munh kapde se dhaka hua tha. Maine paani doodh ke bartan par daala jab tak uska neeche wala hissa thanda ho gaya. Phir main doodh Nabi ke paas laaya jinhe maine jagte hue paaya. Maine unse kaha, 'Piyiye, Ya Allah ke Rasool.' Isliye unhone piya jab tak main santusht ho gaya. Phir maine kaha, 'Humare chalne ka waqt aa gaya hai, Ya Allah ke Rasool!' Unhone kaha, 'Haan.' Isliye hum nikle jabke log (yaani Quraish ke mushrik) humein dhoondh rahe the, magar Suraqa bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ju'shum ke siwa koi na mila jo apne ghode par sawar the. Maine kaha, 'Yeh humare picha karne wale hain jinhone humein paa liya hai, Ya Allah ke Rasool!' Unhone kaha, 'Dukhi mat ho, Allah humare saath hai.'"

e: Narrated Abu Bakr:I said to the Prophet (ﷺ) while I was in the Cave. "If any of them should look under his feet, he would see us." He said, "O Abu Bakr! What do you think of two (persons) the third of whom is Allah?
hi: Abu Bakr bataate hain: Maine Nabi se kaha jabke main gufa mein tha, "Agar unme se koi apne paanv ke neeche dekhe, woh humein dekh lega." Unhone kaha, "Aye Abu Bakr! Do logon ke baare mein tumhara kya khyaal hai jinke teesre Allah hain?"

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) addressed the people saying, "Allah has given option to a slave to choose this world or what is with Him. The slave has chosen what is with Allah." Abu Bakr wept, and we were astonished at his weeping caused by what the Prophet (ﷺ) mentioned as to a Slave ( of Allah) who had been offered a choice, (we learned later on) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) himself was the person who was given the choice, and that Abu Bakr knew best of all of us. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) added, "The person who has favored me most of all both with his company and wealth, is Abu Bakr. If I were to take a Khalil other than my Lord, I would have taken Abu Bakr as such, but (what relates us) is the Islamic brotherhood and friendliness. All the gates of the Mosque should be closed except the gate of Abu Bakr
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne logon ko sambodhit karte huye kaha, "Allah ne ek bande ko ikhtiyar diya hai ke woh duniya chune ya woh jo uske paas hai. Us bande ne jo Allah ke paas hai use chuna." Abu Bakr ro pade, aur hum unke rone se hairat mein pade, kyunke Nabi ne bataya tha ke ek bande ko ikhtiyar diya gaya (aur humein baad mein pata chala ke Allah ke Rasool khud woh shaks the jinko ikhtiyar diya gaya, aur Abu Bakr sab se zyada jaante the). Allah ke Rasool ne joda, "Jis shaks ne apni sohbat aur apni daulat se mujhpar sabse zyada ehsaan kiya hai, woh Abu Bakr hain. Agar main apne Rab ke siwa kisi ko Khalil (khaas dost) banata, main Abu Bakr ko banata, magar (humein jodne wali cheez) Islami bhaeechara aur dosti hai. Masjid ke sab darwaze band kiye jaenge siwaye Abu Bakr ke darwaze ke."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:We used to compare the people as to who was better during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . We used to regard Abu Bakr as the best, then `Umar, and then `Uthman
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Allah ke Rasool ki zindagi mein logon ki tulna karte the ke kaun behtar hai. Hum Abu Bakr ko sabse behtar maante the, phir Umar, phir Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ).

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If I were to take a Khalil, I would have taken Abu Bakr, but he is my brother and my companion (in Islam)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Agar main ek Khalil banata, main Abu Bakr ko banata, magar woh mera bhai aur mera sathi hain (Islam mein)."

e: Narrated Aiyub:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If I were to take a Khalil, I would have taken him (i.e. Abu Bakr) as a Khalil, but the Islamic brotherhood is better
hi: Aiyub bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Agar main ek Khalil banata, main unhe (yaani Abu Bakr ko) Khalil banata, magar Islami bhaeechara behtar hai."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abi Mulaika:The people of Kufa sent a letter to Ibn Az-Zubair, asking about (the inheritance of) (paternal) grandfather. He replied that the right of the inheritance of (paternal) grandfather is the same as that of father if the father is dead) and added, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, ' If I were to take a Khalil from this nation, I would have taken him (i.e. Abu Bakr)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Mulaika bataate hain: Kufa ke logon ne Ibn Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko ek khat bheja, daade ke (waraasat ke) baare mein puchte hue. Unhone jawab diya ke daade ki waraasat ka haqq waisa hi hai jaisa baap ka (agar baap ka intiqal ho chuka ho) aur joda, "Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, 'Agar main is ummat mein se ek Khalil banata, main unhe (yaani Abu Bakr ko) banata.'"

e: Narrated Jubair bin Mut`im:A woman came to the Prophet (ﷺ) who ordered her to return to him again. She said, "What if I came and did not find you?" as if she wanted to say, "If I found you dead?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If you should not find me, go to Abu Bakr
hi: Jubair bin Mut'im bataate hain: Ek aurat Nabi ke paas aee, jinhone unhe dobara aane ka hukum diya. Unhone kaha, "Agar main aaun aur aapko na paaun (to)?" mano woh puchna chahti thi, "Agar main aapko maut-praapt paaun?" Nabi ne kaha, "Agar tum mujhe na pao, Abu Bakr ke paas jaana."

e: Narrated `Ammar:I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and there was none with him but five slaves, two women and Abu Bakr (i.e. those were the only converts to Islam then)
hi: Ammar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool ko dekha aur unke saath sirf paanch gulaam, do aurten, aur Abu Bakr the (yaani us waqt sirf yehi Islam qubool kar chuke the).

e: Narrated Abu Ad-Darda:While I was sitting with the Prophet, Abu Bakr came, lifting up one corner of his garment uncovering his knee. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Your companion has had a quarrel." Abu Bakr greeted (the Prophet (ﷺ) ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! There was something (i.e. quarrel) between me and the Son of Al-Khattab. I talked to him harshly and then regretted that, and requested him to forgive me, but he refused. This is why I have come to you." The Prophet (ﷺ) said thrice, "O Abu Bakr! May Allah forgive you." In the meanwhile, `Umar regretted (his refusal of Abu Bakr's excuse) and went to Abu Bakr's house and asked if Abu Bakr was there. They replied in the negative. So he came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and greeted him, but signs of displeasure appeared on the face of the Prophet (ﷺ) till Abu Bakr pitied (`Umar), so he knelt and said twice, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! By Allah! I was more unjust to him (than he to me)." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah sent me (as a Prophet) to you (people) but you said (to me), 'You are telling a lie,' while Abu Bakr said, 'He has said the truth,' and consoled me with himself and his money." He then said twice, "Won't you then give up harming my companion?" After that nobody harmed Abu Bakr
hi: Abu Ad-Darda bataate hain: Jabke main Nabi ke saath baitha tha, Abu Bakr aaye, apne kapde ka ek kona uthate huye jisse unki ghutna dikh rahi thi. Nabi ne kaha, "Tumhare sathi ka jhagda hua hai." Abu Bakr ne salaam kiya (Nabi ko) aur kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Mere aur Al-Khattab ke bete ke beech kuch (yaani jhagda) hua. Maine unse sakhti se baat ki aur phir pachhtaya aur unse mujhe maaf karne ki guzarish ki, magar unhone inkaar kiya. Isliye main aapke paas aaya hoon." Nabi ne teen baar kaha, "Aye Abu Bakr! Allah tumhe maaf kare." Isi dauran, Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko afsos hua (Abu Bakr ki maafi radd karne ka) aur woh Abu Bakr ke ghar gaye aur pucha kya Abu Bakr wahaan hain. Unhone na mein jawab diya. Isliye woh Nabi ke paas aaye aur unhe salaam kiya, magar Nabi ke chehre par naraajagi ke asaraat dikhne lage jab tak Abu Bakr ko (Umar par) taras aaya, isliye woh ghutne take khade hue aur do baar kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Allah ki qasam! Main unke saath unse zyada na-insaafi tha (unki tulna mein)." Nabi ne kaha, "Allah ne mujhe (Nabi ke tor par) tumhare paas bheja tha, magar tumne (mujhse) kaha, 'Tum jhoot bol rahe ho,' jabke Abu Bakr ne kaha, 'Unhone sach kaha hai,' aur apne aap aur apni daulat se mera saath diya." Phir unhone do baar kaha, "Kya tum mere sathi ko takleef dena chhod doge?" Uske baad, kisi ne bhi Abu Bakr ko takleef nahi di.

e: Narrated `Amr bin Al-As:The Prophet (ﷺ) deputed me to lead the Army of Dhat-as-Salasil. I came to him and said, "Who is the most beloved person to you?" He said, "`Aisha." I asked, "Among the men?" He said, "Her father." I said, "Who then?" He said, "Then `Umar bin Al-Khattab." He then named other men
hi: Amr bin Al-As (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne mujhe Dhat-as-Salasil ki fauj ki agwaee karne ke liye chuna. Main unke paas gaya aur kaha, "Aapko sabse zyada pyara kaun hai?" Unhone kaha, "Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا)." Maine pucha, "Mardon mein?" Unhone kaha, "Unke waalid." Maine pucha, "Phir kaun?" Unhone kaha, "Phir Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab." Phir unhone doosre logon ke naam liye.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "While a shepherd was amongst his sheep, a wolf attacked them and took away one sheep. When the shepherd chased the wolf, the wolf turned towards him and said, 'Who will be its guard on the day of wild animals when nobody except I will be its shepherd?' And while a man was driving a cow with a load on it, it turned towards him and spoke to him saying, 'I have not been created for this purpose, but for ploughing." The people said, "Glorified be Allah." The Prophet said, "But I believe in it and so do Abu Bakr and `Umar
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool ko kehte suna, "Jabke ek charwaha apni bhedon mein tha, ek bhediya unpar hamla kiya aur ek bhed le gaya. Jab charwaha ne bhediye ka picha kiya, bhediya unki taraf mudkar bola, 'Jangli janwaron ke din iski rakhwali kaun karega jab mere siwa koi charwaha na hoga?' Aur jabke ek shaks apni gaay ko bojh lade hue hanka raha tha, gaay unki taraf mudkar baat kiya, kehte huye, 'Mujhe iske liye nahi banaya gaya, balki khet jotne ke liye.'" Logon ne kaha, "Subhanallah!" Nabi ne kaha, "Magar main ispar vishwas karta hoon, aur Abu Bakr aur Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bhi."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "While I was sleeping, I saw myself standing at a well, on it there was a bucket. I drew water from the well as much as Allah wished. Then Ibn Abi Quhafa (i.e. Abu Bakr) took the bucket from me and brought out one or two buckets (of water) and there was weakness in his drawing the water. May Allah forgive his weakness for him. Then the bucket turned into a very big one and Ibn Al-Khattab took it over and I had never seen such a mighty person amongst the people as him in performing such hard work, till the people drank to their satisfaction and watered their camels that knelt down there
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool ko kehte suna, "Jabke main so raha tha, maine khud ko ek kue ke paas khade dekha, jispar ek baalti thi. Maine kue se paani nikala jitna Allah ne chaha. Phir Ibn Abi Quhafa (yaani Abu Bakr) ne mujhse baalti li aur ek ya do baaltiyaan (paani ki) nikali aur unke nikalne mein kuch kamzori thi. Allah unhe (is kamzori ke liye) maaf kare. Phir baalti ek bahut badi baalti ban gaee aur Ibn Al-Khattab ne use sambhala, aur maine logon mein unse zyada takatvaar kisi ko itna mushkil kaam karte nahi dekha, jab tak log santusht hokar piye aur apne baithe hue unton ko bhi paani pilaya."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:That Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah will not look on the Day of Judgment at him who drags his robe (behind him) out of pride." Abu Bakr said "One side of my robe slacks down unless I get very cautious about it." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "But you do not do that with pride
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Allah Qiyamat ke din us shaks ki taraf nahi dekhega jo apna choga ghamand se (peeche) ghaseetta hai." Abu Bakr ne kaha, "Mere choge ka ek taraf apne aap latak jata hai jab tak main ispar khaas dhyaan na dun." Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Magar tum aisa ghamand se nahi karte."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "Anybody who spends a pair of something in Allah's Cause will be called from all the gates of Paradise, "O Allah's slave! This is good.' He who is amongst those who pray will be called from the gate of the prayer (in Paradise) and he who is from the people of Jihad will be called from the gate of Jihad, and he who is from those' who give in charity (i.e. Zakat) will be called from the gate of charity, and he who is amongst those who observe fast will be called from the gate of fasting, the gate of Raiyan." Abu Bakr said, "He who is called from all those gates will need nothing," He added, "Will anyone be called from all those gates, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" He said, "Yes, and I hope you will be among those, O Abu Bakr
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool ko kehte suna, "Jo koi bhi Allah ki raah mein kisi cheez ke do jode kharch karta hai, use Jannat ke sab darwazon se bulaya jaayega, 'Aye Allah ke bande! Yeh achha hai.' Jo namaz padhne walon mein se hai, use namaz ke darwaze se bulaya jaayega; aur jo Jihad karnewalon mein se hai, use Jihad ke darwaze se; aur jo sadqa (yaani Zakat) dene walon mein se hai, use sadqe ke darwaze se; aur jo roza rakhne walon mein se hai, use roze ke darwaze se, yaani Ar-Raiyan darwaze se." Abu Bakr ne kaha, "Jise in sab darwazon se bulaya jaayega, use kisi cheez ki zaroorat nahi hogi." Unhone joda, "Kya kisi ko in sab darwazon se bulaya jaayega, Ya Allah ke Rasool?" Unhone kaha, "Haan, aur mujhe ummeed hai tum bhi unmein se hoge, Aye Abu Bakr."

e: Narrated 'Aisha: (the wife of the Prophet) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died while Abu Bakr was at a place called As-Sunah (Al-'Aliya) 'Umar stood up and said, "By Allah! Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) is not dead!" 'Umar (later on) said, "By Allah! Nothing occurred to my mind except that." He said, "Verily! Allah will resurrect him and he will cut the hands and legs of some men." Then Abu Bakr came and uncovered the face of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), kissed him and said, "Let my mother and father be sacrificed for you, (O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)), you are good in life and in death. By Allah in Whose Hands my life is, Allah will never make you taste death twice." Then he went out and said, "O oath-taker! Don't be hasty." When Abu Bakr spoke, 'Umar sat down. Abu Bakr praised and glorified Allah and said, No doubt! Whoever worshipped Muhammad, then Muhammad is dead, but whoever worshipped Allah, then Allah is Alive and shall never die." Then he recited Allah's Statement.:-- "(O Muhammad) Verily you will die, and they also will die." (39.30) He also recited:-- "Muhammad is no more than an Apostle; and indeed many Apostles have passed away, before him, If he dies Or is killed, will you then Turn back on your heels? And he who turns back On his heels, not the least Harm will he do to Allah And Allah will give reward to those Who are grateful." (3.144) The people wept loudly, and the Ansar were assembled with Sad bin 'Ubada in the shed of Bani Saida. They said (to the emigrants). "There should be one 'Amir from us and one from you." Then Abu Bakr, Umar bin Al-Khattab and Abu 'baida bin Al-Jarrah went to them. 'Umar wanted to speak but Abu Bakr stopped him. 'Umar later on used to say, "By Allah, I intended only to say something that appealed to me and I was afraid that Abu Bakr would not speak so well. Then Abu Bakr spoke and his speech was very eloquent. He said in his statement, "We are the rulers and you (Ansars) are the ministers (i.e. advisers)," Hubab bin Al-Mundhir said, "No, by Allah we won't accept this. But there must be a ruler from us and a ruler from you." Abu Bakr said, "No, we will be the rulers and you will be the ministers, for they (i.e. Quraish) are the best family amongst the 'Arabs and of best origin. So you should elect either 'Umar or Abu 'Ubaida bin Al-Jarrah as your ruler." 'Umar said (to Abu Bakr), "No but we elect you, for you are our chief and the best amongst us and the most beloved of all of us to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." So 'Umar took Abu Bakr's hand and gave the pledge of allegiance and the people too gave the pledge of allegiance to Abu Bakr. Someone said, "You have killed Sad bin Ubada." 'Umar said, "Allah has killed him
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain (Nabi ki biwi): Allah ke Rasool ka intiqal hua jabke Abu Bakr As-Sunah (Al-Aliya) naam ki jagah par the. Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) khade hue aur kaha, "Allah ki qasam! Allah ke Rasool ka intiqal nahi hua hai!" (Baad mein) Umar ne kaha, "Allah ki qasam! Mere zehen mein sirf yehi baat aee." Unhone kaha, "Yaqinan! Allah unhe dobara zinda karega aur woh kuch logon ke haath-paanv katenge (jo unke intiqal ki baat karte hain)." Phir Abu Bakr aaye aur Allah ke Rasool ka chehra khola, unhe chooma aur kaha, "Mere maa-baap tumhare liye qurbaan hon, (Aye Allah ke Rasool), tum zindagi aur maut donon mein achhe ho. Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haathon mein meri zindagi hai, Allah tumhe kabhi do baar maut nahi dilwaega." Phir woh bahar gaye aur kaha, "Aye qasam khane wale! Jaldbaazi mat karo." Jab Abu Bakr ne baat ki, Umar baith gaye. Abu Bakr ne Allah ki hamd aur uski taarif ki aur kaha, "Koi shak nahi! Jisne bhi Muhammad ki ibadat ki, Muhammad ka intiqal ho chuka hai, magar jisne Allah ki ibadat ki, Allah zinda hai aur kabhi maut-prapt nahi hoga." Phir unhone Allah ka yeh farmaan padha: "(Aye Muhammad) Beshak tum maroge, aur woh bhi marenge." (39:30) Unhone yeh bhi padha: "Muhammad sirf ek Rasool hain; aur unse pahle bhi bahut se Rasool guzre hain. Agar woh mar jate ya qatl kar diye jate, kya tum apne pairon par phir wapas mud jaoge? Aur jo apne paanv par wapas mudta hai, use Allah ka koi nuksaan nahi hoga, aur Allah shukrguzaar logon ko ajr dega." (3:144) Log zor se rone lage, aur Ansaar, Sa'd bin Ubada (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath, Bani Sa'ida ke shed mein jama hue. Unhone (muhajiron se) kaha, "Ek Amir humare beech se ho aur ek tumhare beech se." Phir Abu Bakr, Umar bin Al-Khattab, aur Abu Ubaida bin Al-Jarrah unke paas gaye. Umar baat karna chahte the magar Abu Bakr ne unhe roka. Umar baad mein kaha karte the, "Allah ki qasam, mera irada sirf kuch aisa kehne ka tha jo mujhe achha laga, aur mujhe dar tha ke Abu Bakr utna achha nahi bol paenge." Phir Abu Bakr ne baat ki aur unka bhaashan bahut prabhaavshaali tha. Unhone apni baat mein kaha, "Hum hukmaran hain aur tum (Ansaar) mantri (yaani salaahkaar) ho." Hubab bin Al-Mundhir ne kaha, "Nahi, Allah ki qasam hum yeh qubool nahi karenge. Balki ek hukmaran humare beech se ho aur ek tumhare beech se." Abu Bakr ne kaha, "Nahi, hum hukmaran honge aur tum mantri, kyunke woh (yaani Quraish) Arbon mein sabse behtar khaandaan aur sabse achhe vansh ke hain. Isliye tumhe ya to Umar ya Abu Ubaida bin Al-Jarrah ko apna hukmaran chunna chahiye." Umar ne (Abu Bakr se) kaha, "Nahi, hum tumhe chunte hain, kyunke tum humare sardaar ho aur humare beech sabse behtar ho, aur Allah ke Rasool ko humare beech sabse zyada pyare ho." Isliye Umar ne Abu Bakr ka haath pakada aur bai'at di, aur logon ne bhi Abu Bakr ko bai'at di. Kisi ne kaha, "Tumne Sa'd bin Ubada ko qatl kar diya hai." Umar ne kaha, "Allah ne unhe maar diya."

e: Aisha said (in another narration), ("When the Prophet (ﷺ) was on his death-bed) he looked up and said thrice, (Amongst) the Highest Companion (See Qur'an 4.69)' Aisha said, Allah benefited the people by their two speeches. 'Umar frightened the people some of whom were hypocrites whom Allah caused to abandon Islam because of 'Umar's speech. Then Abu Bakr led the people to True Guidance and acquainted them with the right path they were to follow so that they went out reciting:-- "Muhammad is no more than an Apostle and indeed many Apostles have passed away before him
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain (ek doosri riwaayat mein): (Jab Nabi apni maut ke bistar par the) unhone oopar dekha aur teen baar kaha, "(Sabse) Buland Sathi (dekhen Quran 4:69)." Ayesha ne kaha, "Allah ne logon ko unke do bhaashanon se faayda pahunchaya. Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne logon ko daraya, jinmein se kuch munafik the jinhe Allah ne Umar ke bhaashan ki wajah se Islam chhodne par majboor kiya. Phir Abu Bakr ne logon ko sahi hidayat ki taraf le gaye aur unhe sahi raasta samjhaya jispar unhe chalna tha, isliye woh yeh padhte hue nikle: 'Muhammad sirf ek Rasool hain aur unse pahle bhi bahut se Rasool guzre hain.'"

e: Narrated Muhammad bin Al-Hanafiya:I asked my father (`Ali bin Abi Talib), "Who are the best people after Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ?" He said, "Abu Bakr." I asked, "Who then?" He said, "Then `Umar. " I was afraid he would say "Uthman, so I said, "Then you?" He said, "I am only an ordinary person
hi: Muhammad bin Al-Hanafiya bataate hain: Maine apne waalid (Ali (Alayhis Salam) bin Abi Talib) se pucha, "Allah ke Rasool ke baad sab logon mein sabse behtar kaun hai?" Unhone kaha, "Abu Bakr." Maine pucha, "Phir kaun?" Unhone kaha, "Phir Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ)." Mujhe dar tha woh Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) kahenge, isliye maine kaha, "Phir aap?" Unhone kaha, "Main sirf ek aam shaks hoon."

e: Narrated `Aisha:We went out with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on one of his journeys till we reached Al-Baida or Dhatul-Jaish where my necklace got broken (and lost). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stopped to search for it and the people too stopped with him. There was no water at that place and they had no water with them. So they went to Abu Bakr and said, "Don't you see what `Aisha has done? She has made Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and the people stop where there is no water and they have no water with them. Abu Bakr came while Allah's Apostle was sleeping with his head on my thigh and said, "You detained Allah's Apostle and the people where there is no water and they have no water." He then admonished me and said what Allah wished and pinched me at my flanks with his hands, but I did not move because the head of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was on my thigh . Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) kept on sleeping till he got up in the morning and found no water. Then Allah revealed the Divine Verse of Tayammum, and the people performed Tayammum. Usaid bin Al-Hudair said. "O family of Abu Bakr! This is not the first blessing of yours." We urged the camel on which I was sitting to get up from its place and the necklace was found under it
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Hum Allah ke Rasool ke saath ek unke safaron mein se ek par nikle jab tak hum Al-Baida ya Dhatul-Jaish pahunche jahaan mera haar toot gaya (aur kho gaya). Allah ke Rasool use dhoondhne ke liye ruke aur log bhi unke saath ruke. Us jagah paani nahi tha aur unke paas paani nahi tha. Isliye woh Abu Bakr ke paas gaye aur kaha, "Kya aap dekh nahi rahe Ayesha ne kya kiya hai? Usne Allah ke Rasool aur logon ko wahaan roka hai jahaan paani nahi hai aur unke paas paani nahi hai." Abu Bakr aaye jabke Allah ke Rasool apna sar meri raan par rakhkar so rahe the aur kaha, "Tumne Allah ke Rasool aur logon ko wahaan roka jahaan paani nahi hai aur unke paas paani nahi hai." Phir unhone mujhe daanta aur woh kaha jo Allah chahta tha, aur apne haathon se mere pahluon mein chukone lage, magar main hili nahi kyunke Allah ke Rasool ka sar meri raan par tha. Allah ke Rasool sote rahe jab tak subah uthe aur paani nahi mila. Phir Allah ne Tayammum ki Divine Ayat naazil ki, aur logon ne Tayammum kiya. Usaid bin Al-Hudair ne kaha, "Aye Abu Bakr ke pariwara! Yeh tumhari pahli barkat nahi hai." Humne us unt ko jispar main baithi thi uthne ko utsaahit kiya jahaan se woh khada tha, aur haar uske neeche mila.

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not abuse my companions for if any one of you spent gold equal to Uhud (in Allah's Cause) it would not be equal to a Mud or even a half Mud spent by one of them
hi: Abu Saeed bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Mere sathiyon ki buraee mat karo, kyunke agar tum mein se koi Uhud (pahad) ke barabar sona bhi (Allah ki raah mein) kharch kare, yeh unke dwaara kharch kiya gaya ek Mud ya uska aadha bhi barabar nahi hoga."

e: Narrated Abu Musa Al-Ash`ari:I performed ablution in my house and then went out and said, "Today I shall stick to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and stay with him all this day of mine (in his service)." I went to the Mosque and asked about the Prophet . They said, "He had gone in this direction." So I followed his way, asking about him till he entered a place called Bir Aris. I sat at its gate that was made of date-palm leaves till the Prophet (ﷺ) finished answering the call of nature and performed ablution. Then I went up to him to see him sitting at the well of Aris at the middle of its edge with his legs uncovered, hanging in the well. I greeted him and went back and sat at the gate. I said, "Today I will be the gatekeeper of the Prophet." Abu Bakr came and pushed the gate. I asked, "Who is it?" He said, "Abu Bakr." I told him to wait, went in and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Abu Bakr asks for permission to enter." He said, "Admit him and give him the glad tidings that he will be in Paradise." So I went out and said to Abu Bakr, "Come in, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gives you the glad tidings that you will be in Paradise" Abu Bakr entered and sat on the right side of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the built edge of the well and hung his legs n the well as the Prophet (ﷺ) did and uncovered his legs. I then returned and sat (at the gate). I had left my brother performing ablution and he intended to follow me. So I said (to myself). "If Allah wants good for so-and-so (i.e. my brother) He will bring him here." Suddenly somebody moved the door. I asked, "Who is it?" He said, "`Umar bin Al-Khattab." I asked him to wait, went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), greeted him and said, `Umar bin Al-Khattab asks the permission to enter." He said, "Admit him, and give him the glad tidings that he will be in Paradise." I went to "`Umar and said "Come in, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), gives you the glad tidings that you will be in Paradise." So he entered and sat beside Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the built edge of the well on the left side and hung his legs in the well. I returned and sat (at the gate) and said, (to myself), "If Allah wants good for so-and-so, He will bring him here." Somebody came and moved the door. I asked "Who is it?" He replied, "Uthman bin `Affan." I asked him to wait and went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and informed him. He said, "Admit him, and give him the glad tidings of entering Paradise, after a calamity that will befall him." So I went up to him and said to him, "Come in; Allah's Apostle gives you the glad tidings of entering Paradise after a calamity that will befall you. "Uthman then came in and found that the built edge of the well was occupied, so he sat opposite to the Prophet (ﷺ) on the other side. Sa`id bin Al-Musaiyab said, "I interpret this (narration) in terms of their graves
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ash'ari bataate hain: Maine apne ghar mein wudu kiya aur phir bahar nikla aur kaha, "Aaj main Allah ke Rasool ke saath rahunga aur unke is poore din mein unki sewa mein saath dunga." Main masjid gaya aur Nabi ke baare mein pucha. Unhone kaha, "Woh is taraf gaye hain." Isliye main unke raaste par unke baare mein puchte huye chala, jab tak woh ek jagah pahunche jise Bir Aris kaha jata tha. Main uske darwaze par baitha jo khajoor ke patton se bana tha, jab tak Nabi qaza-e-hajat khatam karke wudu kar chuke. Phir main unke paas gaya unhe kue Aris ke kinare ke beech mein baithe dekha, apne paanv khule, kue mein latakte hue. Maine unhe salaam kiya aur wapas gaya aur darwaze par baith gaya. Maine kaha, "Aaj main Nabi ka darbaan banunga." Abu Bakr aaye aur darwaza dhakela. Maine pucha, "Kaun hai?" Unhone kaha, "Abu Bakr." Maine unhe intezaar karne ko kaha, andar gaya aur kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Abu Bakr andar aane ki ijazat maangte hain." Unhone kaha, "Unhe aane do aur unhe khushkhabri do ke woh Jannat mein honge." Isliye main bahar gaya aur Abu Bakr se kaha, "Andar aaiye, aur Allah ke Rasool aapko khushkhabri dete hain ke aap Jannat mein honge." Abu Bakr andar aaye aur Allah ke Rasool ke dahine taraf kue ki banaee hui kinaar par baithe aur apne paanv kue mein latkaye jaisa Nabi ne kiya tha aur apne paanv khole. Main phir wapas gaya aur baith gaya (darwaze par). Maine apne bhai ko wudu karte chhoda tha aur woh mera peecha karne wale the. Isliye maine (khud se) kaha, "Agar Allah falaan-falaan (yaani mere bhai) ke liye achhaee chahta hai, Woh unhe yahaan laega." Achanak kisi ne darwaza hilaya. Maine pucha, "Kaun hai?" Unhone kaha, "Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab." Maine unhe intezaar karne ko kaha, Allah ke Rasool ke paas gaya, unhe salaam kiya aur kaha, "Umar bin Al-Khattab andar aane ki ijazat maangte hain." Unhone kaha, "Unhe aane do, aur unhe khushkhabri do ke woh Jannat mein honge." Main Umar ke paas gaya aur kaha "Andar aaiye, aur Allah ke Rasool, aapko khushkhabri dete hain ke aap Jannat mein honge." Isliye woh andar aaye aur Allah ke Rasool ke bagal mein kue ki banaee hui kinaar par baaee taraf baithe aur apne paanv kue mein latkaye. Main wapas gaya aur baith gaya (darwaze par) aur kaha, (khud se), "Agar Allah falaan-falaan ke liye achhaee chahta hai, Woh unhe yahaan laega." Koi aaya aur darwaza hilaya. Maine pucha "Kaun hai?" Usne jawab diya, "Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Affan." Maine unhe intezaar karne ko kaha aur Nabi ke paas gaya aur unhe bataya. Unhone kaha, "Unhe aane do, aur unhe Jannat mein daakhil hone ki khushkhabri do, ek museebat ke baad jo unpar aayegi." Isliye main unke paas gaya aur unse kaha, "Andar aaiye; Allah ke Rasool aapko Jannat mein daakhil hone ki khushkhabri dete hain, ek museebat ke baad jo aappar aayegi." Uthman phir andar aaye aur dekha ke kue ki banaee hui kinaar bhari hui thi, isliye woh Nabi ke saamne doosri taraf baithe. Sa'id bin Al-Musaiyab ne kaha, "Main is (riwaayat) ki vyaakhya unki qabron ke silsile mein karta hoon."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) once climbed the mountain of Uhud with Abu Bakr, `Umar and `Uthman. The mountain shook with them. The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to the mountain), "Be firm, O Uhud! For on you there are no more than a Prophet, a Siddiq and two martyrs
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Nabi Uhud pahad par chadhe Abu Bakr, Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ), aur Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath. Pahad unke saath hilne laga. Nabi ne (pahad se) kaha, "Sthir raho, Aye Uhud! Kyunke tumpar ek Nabi, ek Siddiq, aur do shahid ke siwa koi aur nahi hai."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said. "While (in a dream), I was standing by a well, drawing water from it. Abu Bakr and `Umar came to me. Abu Bakr took the bucket (from me) and drew one or two buckets of water, and there was some weakness in his drawing. May Allah forgive him. Then Ibn Al-Khattab took the bucket from Abu Bakr, and the bucket turned into a very large one in his hands. I had never seen such a mighty person amongst the people as him in performing such hard work. He drew so much water that the people drank to their satisfaction and watered their camels." (Wahab, a sub-narrator said, "till their camels drank and knelt down)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Jabke (ek khwab mein), main ek kue ke paas khade hokar usse paani nikal raha tha. Abu Bakr aur Umar mere paas aaye. Abu Bakr ne baalti li (mujhse) aur ek ya do baaltiyaan paani nikali, aur unke nikalne mein kuch kamzori thi. Allah unhe maaf kare. Phir Ibn Al-Khattab ne Abu Bakr se baalti li, aur baalti unke haathon mein ek bahut badi baalti ban gaee. Maine logon mein unse zyada takatvaar kisi ko itna mushkil kaam karte nahi dekha. Unhone itna paani nikala ke log santusht hokar piye aur apne unton ko bhi pilaya." (Wahb, doosre raawi ne kaha, "jab tak unke unt piye aur baith gaye.")

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:While I was standing amongst the people who were invoking Allah for `Umar bin Al-Khattab who was lying (dead) on his bed, a man behind me rested his elbows on my shoulder and said, "(O `Umar!) May Allah bestow His Mercy on you. I always hoped that Allah will keep you with your two companions, for I often heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "I, Abu Bakr and `Umar were (somewhere). I, Abu Bakr and `Umar did (something). I, Abu Bakr and `Umar set out.' So I hoped that Allah will keep you with both of them." I turned back to see that the speaker was `Ali bin Abi Talib
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jabke main un logon mein khada tha jo Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab ke liye dua kar rahe the jo apne bistar par (murda) lete the, ek shaks mere peeche mere kandhe par apni kohni tekte huye bola, "(Aye Umar!) Allah tumpar apni rehmat naazil kare. Mujhe hamesha ummeed rahi ke Allah tumhe apne do sathiyon ke saath rakhega, kyunke maine aksar Allah ke Rasool ko kehte suna, 'Main, Abu Bakr aur Umar (kahin the). Main, Abu Bakr aur Umar ne (kuch) kiya. Main, Abu Bakr aur Umar nikle.' Isliye mujhe ummeed thi Allah tumhe unke donon ke saath rakhega." Main mudkar dekha ke baat karne wale Ali (Alayhis Salam) bin Abi Talib the.

e: Narrated `Urwa bin Az-Zubair:I asked `Abdullah bin `Amr, "What was the worst thing the pagans did to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" He said, "I saw `Uqba bin Abi Mu'ait coming to the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was praying.' `Uqba put his sheet round the Prophet's neck and squeezed it very severely. Abu Bakr came and pulled `Uqba away from the Prophet and said, "Do you intend to kill a man just because he says: 'My Lord is Allah, and he has brought forth to you the Evident Signs from your Lord?
hi: Urwa bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha, "Mushrikon ne Allah ke Rasool ke saath sabse bura kaam kya kiya?" Unhone kaha, "Maine Uqba bin Abi Mu'ait ko Nabi ke paas aate dekha jabke woh namaz padh rahe the. Uqba ne apni chaadar Nabi ki gale ke gird lapet di aur use bahut sakhti se kasa. Abu Bakr aaye aur Uqba ko Nabi se khincha aur kaha, 'Kya tum ek aise shaks ko qatl karna chahte ho sirf isliye kyunke woh kehta hai: \"Mera Rab Allah hai,\" aur woh tumhare paas tumhare Rab ki taraf se saaf Nishaaniyaan lekar aaya hai?'"

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I saw myself (in a dream) entering Paradise, and behold! I saw Ar-Rumaisa', Abu Talha's wife. I heard footsteps. I asked, Who is it? Somebody said, 'It is Bilal ' Then I saw a palace and a lady sitting in its courtyard. I asked, 'For whom is this palace?' Somebody replied, 'It is for `Umar.' I intended to enter it and see it, but I thought of your (`Umar's) Ghira (and gave up the attempt)." `Umar said, "Let my parents be sacrificed for you, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! How dare I think of my Ghira (self-respect) being offended by you?
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Maine khud ko (ek khwab mein) Jannat mein daakhil hote dekha, aur dekho! Maine Ar-Rumaisa ko dekha, Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki biwi. Maine kadmon ki aawaaz suni. Maine pucha, 'Yeh kaun hai?' Kisi ne kaha, 'Yeh Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) hai.' Phir maine ek mahal dekha aur ek khaatun uske aangan mein baithi thi. Maine pucha, 'Yeh mahal kiska hai?' Kisi ne jawab diya, 'Yeh Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ka hai.' Maine ismein daakhil hokar dekhna chaha, magar maine tumhari (Umar ki) ghairat (yaani izzat aur svabhimaan) ke baare mein sochkar aisa nahi kiya." Umar ne kaha, "Mere maa-baap aapke liye qurbaan hon, Ya Allah ke Rasool! Main kaise soch sakta hoon ke meri ghairat aapse (kisi cheez mein) apmaanit ho sakti hai?"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:While we were with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) he said, "While I was sleeping, I saw myself in Paradise, and suddenly I saw a woman performing ablution beside a palace. I asked, 'For whom is this palace?' They replied, 'It is for `Umar.' Then I remembered `Umar's Ghira (self-respect) and went away quickly." `Umar wept and said, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! How dare I think of my ghira (self-respect) being offended by you?
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jabke hum Allah ke Rasool ke saath the, unhone kaha, "Jabke main so raha tha, maine khud ko Jannat mein dekha, aur achanak maine ek aurat ko ek mahal ke bagal mein wudu karte dekha. Maine pucha, 'Yeh mahal kiska hai?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Yeh Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ka hai.' Phir mujhe Umar ki ghairat yaad aee aur main jaldi se chala gaya." Umar ro pade aur kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Main kaise soch sakta hoon ke meri ghairat aapse apmaanit ho sakti hai?"

e: Narrated Hamza's father:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "While I was sleeping, I saw myself drinking (i.e. milk), and I was so contented that I saw the milk flowing through my nails. Then I gave (the milk) to `Umar." They (i.e. the companions of the Prophet) asked, "What do you interpret it?" He said, "Knowledge
hi: Hamza ke waalid bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Jabke main so raha tha, maine khud ko (doodh) pite dekha, aur main itna santusht tha ke maine doodh apni ungliyon ke naakhunon se bahte dekha. Phir maine (yeh doodh) Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko diya." Unhone (yaani Nabi ke sahaba ne) pucha, "Aap iska kya matlab nikalte hain?" Unhone kaha, "Ilm."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "In a dream I saw myself drawing water from a well with a bucket. Abu Bakr came and drew a bucket or two weakly. May Allah forgive him. Then `Umar bin Al-Khattab came and the bucket turned into a very large one in his hands. I had never seen such a mighty person as he in doing such hard work till all the people drank to their satisfaction and watered their camels that knelt down there
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Ek khwab mein maine khud ko ek kue se paani ek baalti se nikalte dekha. Abu Bakr aaye aur ek ya do baaltiyaan kamzori se nikali. Allah unhe maaf kare. Phir Umar bin Al-Khattab aaye aur baalti unke haathon mein ek bahut badi baalti ban gaee. Maine kabhi kisi ko itna takatvaar nahi dekha jitna woh itna mushkil kaam karte huye the, jab tak sab logon ne santusht hokar piya aur apne baithe hue unton ko bhi paani pilaya."

e: Narrated Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas:`Umar bin Al-Khattab asked the permission of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to see him while some Quraishi women were sitting with him, talking to him and asking him for more expenses, raising their voices above the voice of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). When `Umar asked for the permission to enter, the women quickly put on their veils. Allah'sf Apostle allowed him to enter and `Umar came in while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was smiling, `Umar said "O Allah's Apostle! May Allah always keep you smiling." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "These women who have been here, roused my wonder, for as soon as they heard your voice, they quickly put on their veils. "`Umar said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! You have more right to be feared by them than I." Then `Umar addressed the women saying, "O enemies of yourselves! You fear me more than you do Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ?" They said, "Yes, for you are harsher and sterner than Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O Ibn Al-Khattab! By Him in Whose Hands my life is! Never does Satan find you going on a way, but he takes another way other than yours
hi: Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab ne Allah ke Rasool se unse milne ki ijazat maangi jabke kuch Quraishi aurten unke saath baithi thi, unse baat kar rahi thi aur zyada kharche ke liye maang rahi thi, apni aawaaz Allah ke Rasool ki aawaaz se oonchi karte huye. Jab Umar ne andar aane ki ijazat maangi, aurten jaldi se apna parda phailane lagi. Allah ke Rasool ne unhe andar aane diya aur Umar andar aaye jabke Allah ke Rasool muskura rahe the. Umar ne kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Allah aapko hamesha muskurate rakhe." Nabi ne kaha, "Yeh aurten jo yahaan thi, unhone mujhe hairat mein daal diya, kyunke jaise hi unhone tumhari aawaaz suni, unhone jaldi apna parda phaila liya." Umar ne kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Aap unke liye mujhse zyada Allah ke muqaable mein darte jane ke haqdaar hain." Phir Umar ne aurton ko sambodhit karte huye kaha, "Aye apni hi rooh ke dushmano! Kya tum Allah ke Rasool se zyada mujhse darti ho?" Unhone kaha, "Haan, kyunke tum Allah ke Rasool se zyada sakht aur karva swabhaav wale ho." Isspar Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Aye Ibn Al-Khattab! Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haathon mein meri zindagi hai! Shaitan tumhe kabhi kisi raaste par jate huye nahi paata, magar woh tumhare raaste ke ilawa doosra raasta apnata hai."

e: Narrated `Abdullah:We have been powerful since `Umar embraced Islam
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum taaqatwar ho gaye jab se Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Islam qubool kiya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When (the dead body of) `Umar was put on his deathbed, the people gathered around him and invoked (Allah) and prayed for him before the body was taken away, and I was amongst them. Suddenly I felt somebody taking hold of my shoulder and found out that he was `Ali bin Abi Talib. `Ali invoked Allah's Mercy for `Umar and said, "O `Umar! You have not left behind you a person whose deeds I like to imitate and meet Allah with more than I like your deeds. By Allah! I always thought that Allah would keep you with your two companions, for very often I used to hear the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, 'I, Abu Bakr and `Umar went (somewhere); I, Abu Bakr and `Umar entered (somewhere); and I, Abu Bakr and `Umar went out
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab (Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ka murda jism) unke maut ke bistar par rakha gaya, log unke aas-paas jama hue aur unke liye dua ki aur jism le jane se pahle dua ki, aur main unmein tha. Achanak maine mahsoos kiya koi mera kandha pakada hua hai aur paaya ke woh Ali (Alayhis Salam) bin Abi Talib the. Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne Umar ke liye Allah ki rehmat ki dua ki aur kaha, "Aye Umar! Tumne apne peeche koi aisa shaks nahi chhoda jiske amal ki nakal karte huye Allah se milna mujhe tumhare amal se zyada pasand ho. Allah ki qasam! Mujhe hamesha lagta tha Allah tumhe apne do sathiyon ke saath rakhega, kyunke maine Nabi ko bahut baar kehte suna, 'Main, Abu Bakr aur Umar (kahin) gaye; main, Abu Bakr aur Umar (kahin) daakhil hue; aur main, Abu Bakr aur Umar (kahin se) nikle.'"

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) ascended the mountain of Uhud and he was accompanied by Abu Bakr, `Umar and `Uthman. The mountain shook beneath them. The Prophet (ﷺ) hit it with his foot and said, "O Uhud ! Be firm, for on you there is none but a Prophet, a Siddiq and a martyr (i.e. and two martyrs)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi Uhud pahad par chadhe aur unke saath Abu Bakr, Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ), aur Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) the. Pahad unke neeche hila. Nabi ne apne paanv se ise maara aur kaha, "Aye Uhud! Sthir raho, kyunke tumpar ek Nabi, ek Siddiq, aur ek shahid (yaani do shahid) ke siwa koi aur nahi hai."

e: Narrated Aslam:Ibn `Umar asked me about some matters concerning `Umar. He said, "Since Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died. I have never seen anybody more serious, hard working and generous than `Umar bin Al-Khattab (till the end of his life)
hi: Aslam bataate hain: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne mujhse Umar ke baare mein kuch baaten pucha. Unhone kaha, "Jab se Allah ke Rasool ka intiqal hua hai, maine kabhi kisi ko Umar bin Al-Khattab se zyada sangin, mehnati, aur daani nahi dekha (unki poori zindagi tak)."

e: Narrated Anas:A man asked the Prophet (ﷺ) about the Hour (i.e. Day of Judgment) saying, "When will the Hour be?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "What have you prepared for it?" The man said, "Nothing, except that I love Allah and His Apostle." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You will be with those whom you love." We had never been so glad as we were on hearing that saying of the Prophet (i.e., "You will be with those whom you love.") Therefore, I love the Prophet, Abu Bakr and `Umar, and I hope that I will be with them because of my love for them though my deeds are not similar to theirs
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks ne Nabi se Qiyamat ke baare mein pucha, kehte huye, "Qiyamat kab hogi?" Nabi ne kaha, "Tumne iske liye kya taiyaari ki hai?" Us shaks ne kaha, "Kuch nahi, siwaye is ke ke main Allah aur uske Rasool se mohabbat karta hoon." Nabi ne kaha, "Tum unke saath hoge jinse tum mohabbat karte ho." Hum kabhi itne khush nahi hue jitna Nabi ki is baat par (yaani, \"Tum unke saath hoge jinse tum mohabbat karte ho.\") hue. Isliye main Nabi, Abu Bakr, aur Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se mohabbat karta hoon, aur mujhe ummeed hai unse meri mohabbat ki wajah se main unke saath hoonga, chahe mere amal unke jaise nahi.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Among the nations before you there used to be people who were inspired (though they were not prophets). And if there is any of such persons amongst my followers, it is 'Umar." Narrated Abu Huraira: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Among the nation of Bani Israel who lived before you, there were men who used to be inspired with guidance though they were not prophets, and if there is any of such persons amongst my followers, it is 'Umar
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Tumse pahle ki ummaton mein aise log the jinhe Divine ilham milta tha (chahe woh Nabi nahi the). Aur agar mere pairokaron mein aise koi log hain, to woh Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) hain." Abu Huraira bataate hain (doosri riwaayat): Nabi ne kaha, "Tumse pahle Bani Israel ki ummat mein aise log the jinhe hidaayat ka Divine ilham milta tha chahe woh Nabi nahi the, aur agar mere pairokaron mein aise koi log hain, to woh Umar hain."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whilst a shepherd was amongst his sheep, a wolf attacked them and took away a sheep. The shepherd chased it and got that sheep freed from the wolf. The wolf turned towards the shepherd and said, 'Who will guard the sheep on the day of wild animals when it will have no shepherd except myself?" The people said, "Glorified be Allah." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "But I believe in it and so do Abu Bakr and `Umar although Abu Bakr and `Umar were not present there (at the place of the event)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Jabke ek charwaha apni bhedon ke beech tha, ek bhediya hamla kiya aur ek bhed le gaya. Charwaha ne uska picha kiya aur bhed ko bhediye se chhudwa liya. Bhediya charwahe ki taraf mudkar bola, 'Jangli janwaron ke din bhedon ki rakhwali kaun karega jab uska koi charwaha nahi hoga siwaye mere?'" Logon ne kaha, "Subhanallah!" Nabi ne kaha, "Magar main ispar vishwas karta hoon, aur Abu Bakr aur Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bhi, chahe woh wahaan (us ghatna ki jagah par) maujood nahi the."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "While I was sleeping, the people were presented to me (in a dream). They were wearing shirts, some of which were merely covering their (chests). and some were a bit longer. `Umar was presented before me and his shirt was so long that he was dragging it." They asked, "How have you interpreted it, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" He said, "Religion
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool ko kehte suna, "Jabke main so raha tha, log (ek khwab mein) mere saamne pesh kiye gaye. Woh qameejen pahne the, kuch sirf unke (seene) tak the, aur kuch thoda lambi thi. Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) mere saamne pesh kiye gaye aur unki qameej itni lambi thi ke woh use ghaseette the." Unhone pucha, "Aapne iska kya matlab nikala, Ya Allah ke Rasool?" Unhone kaha, "Deen."

e: Narrated Al-Miswar bin Makhrama:When `Umar was stabbed, he showed signs of agony. Ibn `Abbas, as if intending to encourage `Umar, said to him, "O Chief of the believers! Never mind what has happened to you, for you have been in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and you kept good relations with him and you parted with him while he was pleased with you. Then you were in the company of Abu Bakr and kept good relations with him and you parted with him (i.e. he died) while he was pleased with you. Then you were in the company of the Muslims, and you kept good relations with them, and if you leave them, you will leave them while they are pleased with you." `Umar said, (to Ibn "Abbas), "As for what you have said about the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and his being pleased with me, it is a favor, Allah did to me; and as for what you have said about the company of Abu Bakr and his being pleased with me, it is a favor Allah did to me; and concerning my impatience which you see, is because of you and your companions. By Allah! If (at all) I had gold equal to the earth, I would have ransomed myself with it from the Punishment of Allah before I meet Him
hi: Al-Miswar bin Makhrama (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko chaaku maara gaya, unhone dard ke asaraat dikhaye. Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ), mano Umar ko utsaahit karne ki koshish karte huye, unse kaha, "Aye Mominon ke Ameer! Aapke saath jo hua uski parwah mat karo, kyunke aap Allah ke Rasool ki sohbat mein rahe aur unke saath achhe ta'alluq rakhe aur unse alag hue jabke woh aapse khush the. Phir aap Abu Bakr ki sohbat mein rahe aur unke saath achhe ta'alluq rakhe aur unse alag hue (yaani unka intiqal hua) jabke woh aapse khush the. Phir aap Musalmanon ki sohbat mein rahe, aur unke saath achhe ta'alluq rakhe, aur agar aap unhe chhodkar jate hain, aap unhe is haalat mein chhodenge ke woh aapse khush hain." Umar ne (Ibn Abbas se) kaha, "Jahaan tak tumne Allah ke Rasool ki sohbat aur unke mujhse khush hone ke baare mein kaha, yeh Allah ka mujhpar ek ehsaan hai; aur jahaan tak tumne Abu Bakr ki sohbat aur unke mujhse khush hone ke baare mein kaha, yeh bhi Allah ka mujhpar ek ehsaan hai; aur jo bechaini main dikha raha hoon, uski wajah tum aur tumhare sathi ho. Allah ki qasam! Agar mere paas zameen ke barabar sona hota, main use Allah ke azaab se bachne ke liye fidya mein de deta isse pahle ke main use (Allah ko) milun."

e: Narrated Abu Musa:While I was with the Prophet (ﷺ) in one of the gardens of Medina, a man came and asked me to open the gate. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to me, "Open the gate for him and give him the glad tidings that he will enter Paradise." I opened (the gate) for him, and behold! It was Abu Bakr. I informed him of the glad tidings the Prophet (ﷺ) had said, and he praised Allah. Then another man came and asked me to open the gate. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to me "Open (the gate) and give him the glad tidings of entering Paradise." I opened (the gate) for him, and behold! It was `Umar. I informed him of what the Prophet (ﷺ) had said, and he praised Allah. Then another man came and asked me to open the gate. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to me. "Open (the gate) for him and inform him of the glad tidings, of entering Paradise with a calamity which will befall him. " Behold ! It was `Uthman, I informed him of what Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said. He praised Allah and said, "I seek Allah's Aid
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jabke main Nabi ke saath Madina ke ek baag mein tha, ek shaks aaya aur mujhse darwaza kholne ko kaha. Nabi ne mujhse kaha, "Unke liye darwaza kholo aur unhe Jannat mein daakhil hone ki khushkhabri do." Maine (darwaza) unke liye khola, aur dekho! Woh Abu Bakr the. Maine unhe Nabi ki di hui khushkhabri bataee, aur unhone Allah ki taarif ki. Phir ek doosra shaks aaya aur mujhse darwaza kholne ko kaha. Nabi ne mujhse kaha, "(Darwaza) kholo aur unhe Jannat mein daakhil hone ki khushkhabri do." Maine unke liye khola, aur dekho! Woh Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) the. Maine unhe Nabi ki di hui baat bataee, aur unhone Allah ki taarif ki. Phir ek doosra shaks aaya aur mujhse darwaza kholne ko kaha. Nabi ne mujhse kaha, "Unke liye (darwaza) kholo aur unhe Jannat mein daakhil hone ki khushkhabri do, ek museebat ke saath jo unpar aayegi." Dekho! Woh Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) the. Maine unhe Allah ke Rasool ki kahi hui baat bataee. Unhone Allah ki taarif ki aur kaha, "Main Allah se madad maangta hoon."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Hisham:We were with the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was holding `Umar bin Al-Khattab by the hand
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Hisham (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Nabi ke saath the jabke woh Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab ka haath pakde hue the.

e: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) entered a garden and ordered me to guard its gate. A man came and asked permission to enter. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Admit him and give him the glad tidings of entering Paradise." Behold! It was Abu Bakr. Another man came and asked the permission to enter. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Admit him and give him the glad tidings of entering Paradise." Behold! It was `Umar. Then another man came, asking the permission to enter. The Prophet (ﷺ) kept silent for a short while and then said, "Admit him and give him the glad tidings of entering Paradise with a calamity which will befall him." Behold! It was `Uthman bin `Affan. `Asim, in another narration, said that the Prophet (ﷺ) was sitting in a place where there was water, and he was uncovering both his knees or his knee, and when `Uthman entered, he covered them (or it)
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ek baag mein daakhil hue aur mujhe uske darwaze ki rakhwali karne ka hukum diya. Ek shaks aaya aur andar aane ki ijazat maangi. Nabi ne kaha, "Use andar aane do aur use Jannat mein daakhil hone ki khushkhabri do." Dekho! Woh Abu Bakr the. Ek doosra shaks aaya, andar aane ki ijazat maangte huye. Nabi ne kaha, "Use andar aane do aur use Jannat mein daakhil hone ki khushkhabri do." Dekho! Woh Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) the. Phir ek doosra shaks aaya, andar aane ki ijazat maangte huye. Nabi kuch der khaamosh rahe aur phir kaha, "Use andar aane do aur use Jannat mein daakhil hone ki khushkhabri do, ek museebat ke saath jo unpar aayegi." Dekho! Woh Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Affan the. Asim, ek doosri riwaayat mein, ne kaha ke Nabi ek jagah baithe the jahaan paani tha, aur unhone apni donon ghutnen ya ek ghutna kholi hui thi, aur jab Uthman andar aaye, unhone unhe dhak liya.

e: Narrated 'Ubaidullah bin `Adi bin Al-Khiyar:Al-Miswar bin Makhrama and `Abdur-Rahman bin Al-Aswad bin 'Abd Yaghuth said (to me), "What forbids you to talk to `Uthman about his brother Al-Walid because people have talked much about him?" So I went to `Uthman and when he went out for prayer I said (to him), "I have something to say to you and it is a piece of advice for you " `Uthman said, "O man, from you." (Ma`mar said: I see that he said, "I seek Refuge with Allah from you.") So I left him and went to them. Then the messenger of `Uthman came and I went to him (i.e. `Uthman), `Uthman asked, "What is your advice?" I replied, "Allah sent Muhammad with the Truth, and revealed the Divine Book (i.e. Qur'an) to him; and you were amongst those who followed Allah and His Apostle, and you participated in the two migrations (to Ethiopia and to Medina) and enjoyed the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and saw his way. No doubt, the people are talking much about Al-Walid." `Uthman said, "Did you receive your knowledge directly from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ?" I said, "No, but his knowledge did reach me and it reached (even) to a virgin in her seclusion." `Uthman said, "And then Allah sent Muhammad with the Truth and I was amongst those who followed Allah and His Apostle and I believed in what ever he (i.e. the Prophet) was sent with, and participated in two migrations, as you have said, and I enjoyed the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and gave the pledge of allegiance to him. By Allah! I never disobeyed him, nor did I cheat him till Allah took him unto Him. Then I treated Abu Bakr and then `Umar similarly and then I was made Caliph. So, don't I have rights similar to theirs?" I said, "Yes." He said, "Then what are these talks reaching me from you people? Now, concerning what you mentioned about the question of Al-Walid, Allah willing, I shall deal with him according to what is right." Then he called `Ali and ordered him to flog him, and `Ali flogged him (i.e. Al-Walid) eighty lashes
hi: Ubaidullah bin Adi bin Al-Khiyar bataate hain: Al-Miswar bin Makhrama (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Abdur-Rahman bin Al-Aswad bin Abd Yaghuth ne (mujhse) kaha, "Aapko Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) se unke bhai Al-Walid ke baare mein baat karne se kya rokta hai, kyunke log unke baare mein bahut baaten kar rahe hain?" Isliye main Uthman ke paas gaya aur jab woh namaz ke liye bahar nikle, maine (unse) kaha, "Mujhe aapse kuch kehna hai aur yeh aapke liye ek naseehat hai." Uthman ne kaha, "Aye shaks, tumse (main Allah ki panah mangta hoon)." (Ma'mar ne kaha: "Mujhe lagta hai unhone kaha, 'Main tumse Allah ki panah mangta hoon.'") Isliye main unhe chhodkar un donon ke paas gaya. Phir Uthman ka bheja hua shaks aaya aur main unke paas gaya (yaani Uthman ke). Uthman ne pucha, "Tumhari naseehat kya hai?" Maine jawab diya, "Allah ne Muhammad ko Haqq ke saath bheja, aur unpar Paak Kitaab (yaani Quran) nazil ki; aur aap unmein se the jinhone Allah aur uske Rasool ki pairvi ki, aur aapne do hijraton (Ethiopia aur Madina) mein hissa liya aur Allah ke Rasool ki sohbat ka anubhav liya aur unka tariqa dekha. Beshak, log Al-Walid ke baare mein bahut baaten kar rahe hain." Uthman ne kaha, "Kya tumhe apna ilm seedhe Allah ke Rasool se mila?" Maine kaha, "Nahi, magar unka ilm mujhtak pahuncha, aur ek kuari tak bhi jo apni ekaant mein thi." Uthman ne kaha, "Aur phir Allah ne Muhammad ko Haqq ke saath bheja aur main unmein tha jinhone Allah aur uske Rasool ki pairvi ki aur unpar jo bhi (yaani Nabi ko) diya gaya uspar iman laaya, aur do hijraton mein hissa liya, jaisa tumne kaha, aur Allah ke Rasool ki sohbat ka anubhav liya aur unhe bai'at di. Allah ki qasam! Maine kabhi unki na-farmani nahi ki, na hi unke saath dhoka kiya jab tak Allah ne unhe apni taraf bula liya. Phir maine Abu Bakr ke saath aur phir Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath waisa hi kiya, aur phir mujhe Khalifa banaya gaya. To kya mera bhi unke jaisa haqq nahi hai?" Maine kaha, "Haan." Unhone kaha, "Phir yeh baaten jo mujhtak tum logon se pahunch rahi hain, kya hain? Ab, Al-Walid ke maamle ke baare mein jo tumne kaha, Insha Allah, main unke saath sahi tarike se pesh aunga." Phir unhone Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko bulaya aur unhe hukum diya unhe kode maarne ka, aur Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne unhe (yaani Al-Walid ko) assi kode maare.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:During the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) we considered Abu Bakr as peerless and then `Umar and then `Uthman (coming next to him in superiority) and then we used not to differentiate between the companions of the Prophet
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ki zindagi mein, hum Abu Bakr ko sabse behtar maante the, phir Umar, phir Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) (unse behtar hone mein agle), aur phir hum Nabi ke sahaba ke beech koi bhed nahi karte the.

e: Narrated `Uthman:(the son of Mawhab) An Egyptian who came and performed the Hajj to the Ka`ba saw some people sitting. He enquired, "Who are these people?" Somebody said, "They are the tribe of Quraish." He said, "Who is the old man sitting amongst them?" The people replied, "He is `Abdullah bin `Umar." He said, "O Ibn `Umar! I want to ask you about something; please tell me about it. Do you know that `Uthman fled away on the day (of the battle) of Uhud?" Ibn `Umar said, "Yes." The (Egyptian) man said, "Do you know that `Uthman was absent on the day (of the battle) of Badr and did not join it?" Ibn `Umar said, "Yes." The man said, "Do you know that he failed to attend the Ar Ridwan pledge and did not witness it (i.e. Hudaibiya pledge of allegiance)?" Ibn `Umar said, "Yes." The man said, "Allahu Akbar!" Ibn `Umar said, "Let me explain to you (all these three things). As for his flight on the day of Uhud, I testify that Allah has excused him and forgiven him; and as for his absence from the battle of Badr, it was due to the fact that the daughter of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was his wife and she was sick then. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him, "You will receive the same reward and share (of the booty) as anyone of those who participated in the battle of Badr (if you stay with her).' As for his absence from the Ar-Ridwan pledge of allegiance, had there been any person in Mecca more respectable than `Uthman (to be sent as a representative). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) would have sent him instead of him. No doubt, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had sent him, and the incident of the Ar-Ridwan pledge of Allegiance happened after `Uthman had gone to Mecca. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) held out his right hand saying, 'This is `Uthman's hand.' He stroke his (other) hand with it saying, 'This (pledge of allegiance) is on the behalf of `Uthman.' Then Ibn `Umar said to the man, 'Bear (these) excuses in mind with you
hi: Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) (Mawhab ke bete) bataate hain: Ek Misri jo Hajj karne aaya, kuch logon ko baithe dekha. Usne pucha, "Yeh log kaun hain?" Kisi ne kaha, "Yeh Quraish qabile ke log hain." Usne pucha, "Unmein baitha boodha shaks kaun hai?" Logon ne jawab diya, "Woh Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) hain." Usne kaha, "Aye Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ)! Mujhe kuch puchna hai; kripya mujhe bataiye. Kya aap jaante hain ke Uthman Uhud ki jung ke din bhaag gaye the?" Ibn Umar ne kaha, "Haan." (Misri) shaks ne kaha, "Kya aap jaante hain ke Uthman Badr ki jung ke din maujood nahi the aur ismein shaamil nahi hue?" Ibn Umar ne kaha, "Haan." Shaks ne kaha, "Kya aap jaante hain ke woh Ar-Ridwan bai'at mein maujood nahi the aur ise dekh nahi paye (yaani Hudaibiya ki bai'at)?" Ibn Umar ne kaha, "Haan." Shaks ne kaha, "Allahu Akbar!" Ibn Umar ne kaha, "Mujhe (in teen baaton ko) samjhane do. Jahaan tak Uhud ke din unke bhaagne ka sawal hai, main gawahi deta hoon ke Allah ne unhe maaf kiya aur unhe kshama di; aur jahaan tak Badr ki jung se unke gair-haajir hone ka sawal hai, yeh isliye tha kyunke Allah ke Rasool ki beti unki biwi thi aur woh us waqt bimar thi. Allah ke Rasool ne unse kaha, 'Tumhe wahi ajr aur hissa (maal-e-ghanimat mein) milega jaisa Badr ki jung mein shaamil hone wale kisi ko milta' (agar tum unke saath raho). Aur jahaan tak Ar-Ridwan bai'at se unke gair-haajir hone ka sawal hai, agar Mecca mein Uthman se zyada izzatdaar koi shaks hota (pratinidhi ke tor par bhejne ke liye), Allah ke Rasool unhe unke bajaye bhejte. Beshak, Allah ke Rasool ne unhe bheja tha, aur Ar-Ridwan bai'at ki ghatna Uthman ke Mecca jane ke baad huee. Allah ke Rasool ne apna dahina haath badhkar kaha, 'Yeh Uthman ka haath hai.' Unhone apne (doosre) haath se ispar thapthapaya aur kaha, 'Yeh (bai'at) Uthman ki taraf se hai.'" Phir Ibn Umar ne us shaks se kaha, "Ab in uzron ko apne saath rakho."

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) ascended the mountain of Uhud and Abu Bakr, `Umar and `Uthman were accompanying him. The mountain gave a shake (i.e. trembled underneath them) . The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Uhud ! Be calm." I think that the Prophet (ﷺ) hit it with his foot, adding, "For upon you there are none but a Prophet, a Siddiq and two martyrs
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi Uhud pahad par chadhe aur Abu Bakr, Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ), aur Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) unke saath the. Pahad hila. Nabi ne kaha, "Aye Uhud! Sthir raho." Mujhe lagta hai Nabi ne ise apne paanv se maara, joda, "Kyunke tumpar ek Nabi, ek Siddiq, aur do shahid ke siwa koi aur nahi hai."

e: Narrated `Amr bin Maimun:I saw `Umar bin Al-Khattab a few days before he was stabbed in Medina. He was standing with Hudhaifa bin Al-Yaman and `Uthman bin Hunaif to whom he said, "What have you done? Do you think that you have imposed more taxation on the land (of As-Swad i.e. 'Iraq) than it can bear?" They replied, "We have imposed on it what it can bear because of its great yield." `Umar again said, "Check whether you have imposed on the land what it can not bear." They said, "No, (we haven't)." `Umar added, "If Allah should keep me alive I will let the widows of Iraq need no men to support them after me." But only four days had elapsed when he was stabbed (to death ). The day he was stabbed, I was standing and there was nobody between me and him (i.e. `Umar) except `Abdullah bin `Abbas. Whenever `Umar passed between the two rows, he would say, "Stand in straight lines." When he saw no defect (in the rows), he would go forward and start the prayer with Takbir. He would recite Surat Yusuf or An-Nahl or the like in the first rak`a so that the people may have the time to Join the prayer. As soon as he said Takbir, I heard him saying, "The dog has killed or eaten me," at the time he (i.e. the murderer) stabbed him. A non-Arab infidel proceeded on carrying a double-edged knife and stabbing all the persons he passed by on the right and left (till) he stabbed thirteen persons out of whom seven died. When one of the Muslims saw that, he threw a cloak on him. Realizing that he had been captured, the non-Arab infidel killed himself, `Umar held the hand of `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf and let him lead the prayer. Those who were standing by the side of `Umar saw what I saw, but the people who were in the other parts of the Mosque did not see anything, but they lost the voice of `Umar and they were saying, "Subhan Allah! Subhan Allah! (i.e. Glorified be Allah)." `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf led the people a short prayer. When they finished the prayer, `Umar said, "O Ibn `Abbas! Find out who attacked me." Ibn `Abbas kept on looking here and there for a short time and came to say. "The slave of Al Mughira." On that `Umar said, "The craftsman?" Ibn `Abbas said, "Yes." `Umar said, "May Allah curse him. I did not treat him unjustly. All the Praises are for Allah Who has not caused me to die at the hand of a man who claims himself to be a Muslim. No doubt, you and your father (Abbas) used to love to have more non-Arab infidels in Medina." Al-Abbas had the greatest number of slaves. Ibn `Abbas said to `Umar. "If you wish, we will do." He meant, "If you wish we will kill them." `Umar said, "You are mistaken (for you can't kill them) after they have spoken your language, prayed towards your Qibla, and performed Hajj like yours." Then `Umar was carried to his house, and we went along with him, and the people were as if they had never suffered a calamity before. Some said, "Do not worry (he will be Alright soon)." Some said, "We are afraid (that he will die)." Then an infusion of dates was brought to him and he drank it but it came out (of the wound) of his belly. Then milk was brought to him and he drank it, and it also came out of his belly. The people realized that he would die. We went to him, and the people came, praising him. A young man came saying, "O chief of the believers! Receive the glad tidings from Allah to you due to your company with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and your superiority in Islam which you know. Then you became the ruler (i.e. Caliph) and you ruled with justice and finally you have been martyred." `Umar said, "I wish that all these privileges will counterbalance (my shortcomings) so that I will neither lose nor gain anything." When the young man turned back to leave, his clothes seemed to be touching the ground. `Umar said, "Call the young man back to me." (When he came back) `Umar said, "O son of my brother! Lift your clothes, for this will keep your clothes clean and save you from the Punishment of your Lord." `Umar further said, "O `Abdullah bin `Umar! See how much I am in debt to others." When the debt was checked, it amounted to approximately eighty-six thousand. `Umar said, "If the property of `Umar's family covers the debt, then pay the debt thereof; otherwise request it from Bani `Adi bin Ka`b, and if that too is not sufficient, ask for it from Quraish tribe, and do not ask for it from any one else, and pay this debt on my behalf." `Umar then said (to `Abdullah), "Go to `Aisha (the mother of the believers) and say: "`Umar is paying his salutation to you. But don't say: 'The chief of the believers,' because today I am not the chief of the believers. And say: "`Umar bin Al-Khattab asks the permission to be buried with his two companions (i.e. the Prophet, and Abu Bakr)." `Abdullah greeted `Aisha and asked for the permission for entering, and then entered to her and found her sitting and weeping. He said to her, "`Umar bin Al-Khattab is paying his salutations to you, and asks the permission to be buried with his two companions." She said, "I had the idea of having this place for myself, but today I prefer `Umar to myself." When he returned it was said (to `Umar), "`Abdullah bin `Umar has come." `Umar said, "Make me sit up." Somebody supported him against his body and `Umar asked (`Abdullah), "What news do you have?" He said, "O chief of the believers! It is as you wish. She has given the permission." `Umar said, "Praise be to Allah, there was nothing more important to me than this.
