So when I die, take me, and greet `Aisha and say: "`Umar bin Al-Khattab asks the permission (to be buried with the Prophet (ﷺ) ), and if she gives the permission, bury me there, and if she refuses, then take me to the grave-yard of the Muslims." Then Hafsa (the mother of the believers) came with many other women walking with her. When we saw her, we went away. She went in (to `Umar) and wept there for sometime. When the men asked for permission to enter, she went into another place, and we heard her weeping inside. The people said (to `Umar), "O chief of the believers! Appoint a successor." `Umar said, "I do not find anyone more suitable for the job than the following persons or group whom Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had been pleased with before he died." Then `Umar mentioned `Ali, `Uthman, Az-Zubair, Talha, Sa`d and `Abdur-Rahman (bin `Auf) and said, "Abdullah bin `Umar will be a witness to you, but he will have no share in the rule. His being a witness will compensate him for not sharing the right of ruling. If Sa`d becomes the ruler, it will be alright: otherwise, whoever becomes the ruler should seek his help, as I have not dismissed him because of disability or dishonesty." `Umar added, "I recommend that my successor takes care of the early emigrants; to know their rights and protect their honor and sacred things. I also recommend that he be kind to the Ansar who had lived in Medina before the emigrants and Belief had entered their hearts before them. I recommend that the (ruler) should accept the good of the righteous among them and excuse their wrong-doers, and I recommend that he should do good to all the people of the towns (Al-Ansar), as they are the protectors of Islam and the source of wealth and the source of annoyance to the enemy. I also recommend that nothing be taken from them except from their surplus with their consent. I also recommend that he do good to the 'Arab bedouin, as they are the origin of the 'Arabs and the material of Islam. He should take from what is inferior, amongst their properties and distribute that to the poor amongst them. I also recommend him concerning Allah's and His Apostle's protectees (i.e. Dhimmis) to fulfill their contracts and to fight for them and not to overburden them with what is beyond their ability." So when `Umar expired, we carried him out and set out walking. `Abdullah bin `Umar greeted (`Aisha) and said, "`Umar bin Al-Khattab asks for the permission." `Aisha said, "Bring him in." He was brought in and buried beside his two companions. When he was buried, the group (recommended by `Umar) held a meeting. Then `Abdur-Rahman said, " Reduce the candidates for rulership to three of you." Az-Zubair said, "I give up my right to `Ali." Talha said, "I give up my right to `Uthman." Sa`d said, 'I give up my right to `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf." `Abdur-Rahman then said (to `Uthman and `Ali), "Now which of you is willing to give up his right of candidacy so that he may choose the better of the (remaining) two, bearing in mind that Allah and Islam will be his witnesses." So both the sheiks (i.e. `Uthman and `Ali) kept silent. `Abdur-Rahman said, "Will you both leave this matter to me, and I take Allah as my Witness that I will not choose but the better of you?" They said, "Yes." So `Abdur-Rahman took the hand of one of them (i.e. `Ali) and said, "You are related to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and one of the earliest Muslims as you know well. So I ask you by Allah to promise that if I select you as a ruler you will do justice, and if I select `Uthman as a ruler you will listen to him and obey him." Then he took the other (i.e. `Uthman) aside and said the same to him. When `Abdur-Rahman secured (their agreement to) this covenant, he said, "O `Uthman! Raise your hand." So he (i.e. `Abdur-Rahman) gave him (i.e. `Uthman) the solemn pledge, and then `Ali gave him the pledge of allegiance and then all the (Medina) people gave him the pledge of allegiance
hi: Amr bin Maimun bataate hain: Maine Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab ko Madina mein unpar chaaku maare jaane se kuch din pahle dekha. Woh Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Yaman aur Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Hunaif ke saath khade the, jinse unhone kaha, "Tumne kya kiya hai? Kya tumhe lagta hai tumne As-Swad (yaani Iraq) ki zameen par uski takat se zyada tax laga diya hai?" Unhone jawab diya, "Humne ispar utna hi tax lagaya hai jitna yeh uski achhi paidawaar ki wajah se sambhaal sakti hai." Umar ne phir kaha, "Check karo kya tumne zameen par uski takat se zyada tax laga diya hai." Unhone kaha, "Nahi, (humne aisa nahi kiya)." Umar ne joda, "Agar Allah mujhe zinda rakhe, main Iraq ki vidhavaon ko mere baad kisi aur mard ke sahaare ki zaroorat nahi padne dunga." Magar sirf chaar din guzre the jab unpar chaaku maara gaya. Jis din unpar chaaku maara gaya, main khada tha aur mere aur unke beech koi nahi tha siwaye Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke. Jab bhi Umar donon safon ke beech se guzarte, woh kahte, "Seedhi lainon mein khade ho." Jab unhe safon mein koi kami nahi dikhti, woh aage badhte aur Takbir ke saath namaz shuru karte. Woh pahli rakat mein Surah Yusuf ya An-Nahl ya isI tarah ki koee Surah padhte the taake logon ko namaz mein shaamil hone ka waqt mil sake. Jaise hi unhone Takbir kahi, maine unhe kehte suna, "Kutte ne mujhe maar diya hai ya khaa liya hai," jis waqt (yaani hatyaare ne) unhe chaaku maara. Ek gair-Arab kaafir ek do-dhaari chaaku lekar aage badha aur jis bhi shaks ke paas se guzarta, dahine aur baaye chaaku maarta jata (jab tak) usne terah logon ko chaaku maara jinme se saat mar gaye. Jab ek Musalman ne yeh dekha, usne uske oopar ek chaadar phenki. Yeh mahsoos karke ke woh pakda gaya hai, gair-Arab kaafir ne khud ko qatl kar liya. Umar ne Abdur-Rahman bin Auf ka haath pakda aur unhe namaz padhaane diya. Jo log Umar ke bagal mein khade the unhone woh dekha jo maine dekha, magar jo log masjid ke doosre hisson mein the unhone kuch nahi dekha, magar unhone Umar ki aawaaz khoi hui paee aur woh kah rahe the, "Subhan Allah! Subhan Allah!" Abdur-Rahman bin Auf ne logon ko ek chhoti namaz padhaee. Jab unhone namaz khatam ki, Umar ne kaha, "Aye Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ)! Pata karo kisne mujhpar hamla kiya." Ibn Abbas thodi der idhar-udhar dekhte rahe aur aakar kaha, "Al Mughira ke gulaam ne." Isspar Umar ne kaha, "Woh karigar?" Ibn Abbas ne kaha, "Haan." Umar ne kaha, "Allah use laanat kare. Maine unke saath na-insaafi nahi ki. Sab tarifen Allah ke liye hain Jisne mujhe aise shaks ke haathon marne nahi diya jo khud ko Musalman kehta hai. Beshak, tum aur tumhare waalid (Abbas) zyada gair-Arab kaafiron ko Madina mein rakhna pasand karte the." Al-Abbas ke paas sabse zyada gulaam the. Ibn Abbas ne Umar se kaha, "Agar aap chahen, hum aisa karenge." Unka matlab tha, "Agar aap chahen, hum unhe qatl kar denge." Umar ne kaha, "Tum galat samajh rahe ho (kyunke tum unhe qatl nahi kar sakte) baad mein jab unhone tumhari bhaasha bol li hai, tumhare Qibla ki taraf namaz padhi hai, aur tumhari tarah Hajj kiya hai." Phir Umar ko unke ghar le jaaya gaya, aur hum unke saath gaye, aur log aise the mano unhone pahle kabhi koi museebat nahi jheli thi. Kuch ne kaha, "Fikar mat kariye (woh theek ho jaenge jald hi)." Kuch ne kaha, "Humein dar hai (ke woh mar jaenge)." Phir khajooron ka ek ghol unhe diya gaya aur unhone use piya magar yeh unke pet (ke ghaav) se bahar nikal aaya. Phir unhe doodh diya gaya, aur unhone use bhi piya, aur yeh bhi unke pet se bahar nikal aaya. Logon ko samajh aa gaya ke woh mar jaenge. Hum unke paas gaye, aur log unki taarif karte hue aaye. Ek jawan shaks aakar bola, "Aye Mominon ke Ameer! Allah ki taraf se aapko khushkhabri ho, aapki Allah ke Rasool ke saath sohbat ki wajah se aur Islam mein aapki superiority ki wajah se jo aap jaante hain. Phir aap hukmaran (yaani Khalifa) bane aur aapne insaaf se hukumat ki aur aakhirkaar aap shaheed hue." Umar ne kaha, "Kaash yeh sab ehsaan (mere kamiyon ke) barabar ho jaen, taake na mujhe kuch faayda ho na nuksaan." Jab jawan shaks pichhe murkar jaane laga, uske kapde zameen ko chhoote hue lag rahe the. Umar ne kaha, "Jawan shaks ko mere paas wapas bulao." (Jab woh wapas aaya) Umar ne kaha, "Aye mere bhai ke bete! Apne kapde uthao, kyunke isse tumhare kapde saaf rahenge aur tumhe apne Rab ki saza se bachaenge." Umar ne aage kaha, "Aye Abdullah bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ)! Dekho main kitna qarzdaar hoon (doosron ka)." Jab qarz check kiya gaya, woh takriban chhiyasi hazaar tha. Umar ne kaha, "Agar Umar ke pariwara ki maal qarz poora kar de, to usse qarz chuka do; warna Bani Adi bin Ka'b se guzarish karo, aur agar yeh bhi kaafi na ho, Quraish qabile se maango, aur kisi aur se mat maango, aur mere taraf se yeh qarz ada karo." Umar ne phir (Abdullah se) kaha, "Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (mominon ki maa) ke paas jaao aur kaho: Umar aapko salaam kehta hai. Magar 'mominon ke Ameer' mat kaho, kyunke aaj main mominon ka Ameer nahi hoon. Aur kaho: Umar bin Al-Khattab apne do sathiyon (yaani Nabi aur Abu Bakr) ke saath dafan hone ki ijazat maangta hai." Abdullah ne Ayesha ko salaam kiya aur andar aane ki ijazat maangi, aur phir unke paas daakhil hue aur unhe baithe rote paaya. Unhone unse kaha, "Umar bin Al-Khattab aapko salaam kehte hain, aur apne do sathiyon ke saath dafan hone ki ijazat maangte hain." Unhone kaha, "Maine yeh jagah apne liye rakhi thi, magar aaj main Umar ko khud se zyada tarjih deti hoon." Jab woh wapas aaye, kaha gaya (Umar se), "Abdullah bin Umar aa gaye hain." Umar ne kaha, "Mujhe baithao." Kisi ne unke jism ko sahaara diya aur Umar ne (Abdullah se) pucha, "Kya khabar hai tumhare paas?" Unhone kaha, "Aye Mominon ke Ameer! Jaisa aap chahte the. Unhone ijazat de di hai." Umar ne kaha, "Allah ki taarif ho, mere liye ismein se zyada zaroori kuch nahi tha. Isliye jab main mar jaun, mujhe le jaana, aur Ayesha ko salaam karna aur kehna: Umar bin Al-Khattab ijazat maangta hai (yaani Nabi ke saath dafan hone ki), aur agar woh ijazat de, mujhe wahaan dafan karna, aur agar woh inkaar kare, mujhe Musalmanon ke qabristaan mein le jaana." Phir Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) (mominon ki maa) bahut si aurton ke saath aee jo unke saath chal rahi thi. Jab humne unhe dekha, hum chale gaye. Woh andar gee (Umar ke paas) aur kuch der roee. Jab mardon ne andar aane ki ijazat maangi, woh doosri jagah chali gaee, aur humne unhe andar rote hue suna. Logon ne (Umar se) kaha, "Aye Mominon ke Ameer! Apna uttaradhikaari muqarrar keejiye." Umar ne kaha, "Mujhe in logon se ya is giroh se behtar koi shaks is kaam ke liye nahi milta jinke saath Allah ke Rasool apni wafat se pahle khush the." Phir Umar ne Ali (Alayhis Salam), Uthman, Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ), Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ), Sa'd, aur Abdur-Rahman (bin Auf) ka naam liya aur kaha, "Abdullah bin Umar tumhaare liye gawaah hoga, magar use hukumat mein koee hissa nahi milega. Unka gawaah hona hukumat na milne ki bharpaee karega. Agar Sa'd hukmaran bante hain, theek hai; warna, jo bhi hukmaran bane use unki madad leni chahiye, kyunke maine unhe asamarthata ya be-imaani ki wajah se nahi hataya." Umar ne joda, "Main sujhaav deta hoon ke mera uttaradhikaari purane muhajiron ka khayaal rakhe; unke haqq jaane aur unki izzat aur pavitr cheezon ki hifaazat kare. Main yeh bhi sujhaav deta hoon ke woh Ansaar ke saath narmi se pesh aaye jo muhajiron se pahle Madina mein rahte the aur jinke dilon mein iman unse pahle daakhil hua. Main sujhaav deta hoon ke (hukmaran) unmein se dhaarmik logon ki achhaee qubool kare aur unke galat karne walon ko maaf kare, aur main sujhaav deta hoon ke woh shehron ke sab logon (Al-Ansaar) ke saath achha suluk kare, kyunke woh Islam ki hifaazat karne wale aur daulat ke srot hain aur dushman ke liye pareshaani ka srot hain. Main yeh bhi sujhaav deta hoon ke unse kuch na liya jaaye siwaye unke atirikt se, unki apni razaamandi se. Main yeh bhi sujhaav deta hoon ke woh Arab dehatiyon ke saath achha suluk kare, kyunke woh Arabon ke mool hain aur Islam ki saamagri hain. Use unka maal mein se woh cheez leni chahiye jo kam mahatvapurna ho aur use unmein se gareebon mein baant deni chahiye. Main use Allah aur uske Rasool ke Dhimmi (yaani gair-Musalman praja) ke baare mein bhi sujhaav deta hoon ke unke muahide poore kare aur unke liye jung kare aur unpar unki kshamata se zyada bojh na daale." Isliye jab Umar guzar gaye, hum unhe uthakar chal pade. Abdullah bin Umar ne salaam kiya (Ayesha ko) aur kaha, "Umar bin Al-Khattab ijazat maangte hain." Ayesha ne kaha, "Unhe andar lao." Unhe andar laaya gaya aur unke donon sathiyon ke bagal mein dafan kiya gaya. Jab unhe dafan kiya gaya, giroh (jinka Umar ne naam liya tha) ne ek baithak ki. Phir Abdur-Rahman ne kaha, "Apne mein se hukumat ke ummeedwaron ko teen tak kam karo." Az-Zubair ne kaha, "Main apna haqq Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko detaa hoon." Talha ne kaha, "Main apna haqq Uthman ko detaa hoon." Sa'd ne kaha, "Main apna haqq Abdur-Rahman bin Auf ko detaa hoon." Abdur-Rahman ne phir kaha (Uthman aur Ali (Alayhis Salam) se), "Ab tum donon mein se kaun apne ummeedwaari ka haqq chhodne ke liye tayyar hai taake woh (baaki) donon mein se behtar chun sake, is baat ko dhyaan mein rakhte huye ke Allah aur Islam uske gawaah honge?" Isliye donon buzurg (yaani Uthman aur Ali (Alayhis Salam)) khaamosh rahe. Abdur-Rahman ne kaha, "Kya tum donon yeh maamla mujhpar chhodoge, aur main Allah ko apna gawaah banata hoon ke main tum donon mein se behtar hi chununga?" Unhone kaha, "Haan." Isliye Abdur-Rahman ne unmein se ek (yaani Ali (Alayhis Salam)) ka haath pakda aur kaha, "Aapka Allah ke Rasool se rishta hai aur aap Musalmanon mein se sabse pahle ke ek hain, jaisa aap achhi tarah jaante hain. Isliye main aapko Allah ki qasam deta hoon ke waada karo agar main aapko hukmaran chunta hoon aap insaaf karenge, aur agar main Uthman ko hukmaran chunta hoon aap unki baat sunenge aur unki itaaat karenge." Phir usne doosre (yaani Uthman) ko alag lekar wahi kaha. Jab Abdur-Rahman ne unkaa (samjhauta) sunishchit kar liya, unhone kaha, "Aye Uthman! Apna haath uthao." Isliye usne (yaani Abdur-Rahman ne) unhe (yaani Uthman ko) solemn pledge di, aur phir Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne unhe bai'at di aur phir sab (Madina ke) logon ne unhe bai'at di.

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Tomorrow I will give the flag to a man with whose leadership Allah will grant (the Muslims) victory." So the people kept on thinking the whole night as to who would be given the flag. The next morning the people went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and every one of them hoped that he would be given the flag. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Where is `Ali bin Abi Talib?" The people replied, "He is suffering from eye trouble, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." He said, "Send for him and bring him to me." So when `Ali came, the Prophet (ﷺ) spat in his eyes and invoked good on him, and he became alright as if he had no ailment. The Prophet (ﷺ) then gave him the flag. `Ali said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shall I fight them (i.e. enemy) till they become like us?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Proceed to them steadily till you approach near to them and then invite them to Islam and inform them of their duties towards Allah which Islam prescribes for them, for by Allah, if one man is guided on the right path (i.e. converted to Islam) through you, it would be better for you than (a great number of) red camels
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Kal main jhanda us shaks ko dunga jiski agwaee se Allah (Musalmanon ko) fatah dega." Isliye log poori raat sochte rahe kise jhanda diya jaayega. Agli subah log Allah ke Rasool ke paas gaye aur har ek ummeed karta tha use jhanda milega. Nabi ne pucha, "Ali (Alayhis Salam) bin Abi Talib kahaan hain?" Logon ne jawab diya, "Unhe aankh ki takleef hai, Ya Allah ke Rasool." Unhone kaha, "Unhe bulaao aur mere paas laao." Jab Ali (Alayhis Salam) aaye, Nabi ne unki aankhon mein thooka aur unpar achhi dua ki, aur woh theek ho gaye mano unhe koi takleef thi hi nahi. Nabi ne phir unhe jhanda diya. Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Kya main unse (yaani dushman se) jung karun jab tak woh humare jaise ban jaen?" Nabi ne kaha, "Sthirta se unke paas jaao jab tak tum unke qareeb pahunche, phir unhe Islam ki dawat do aur unhe Allah ke prati unke kartavyon ke baare mein batao jo Islam unpar farz karta hai, kyunke, Allah ki qasam, agar ek shaks bhi tumhare zariye sahi raste par aa jaaye, yeh tumhare liye (bahut sare) laal unton se behtar hoga."

e: Narrated Salama:`Ali happened to stay behind the Prophet (ﷺ) and (did not join him) during the battle of Khaibar for he was having eye trouble. Then he said, "How could I remain behind Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" So `Ali set out following the Prophet (ﷺ) , When it was the eve of the day in the morning of which Allah helped (the Muslims) to conquer it, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I will give the flag (to a man), or tomorrow a man whom Allah and His Apostle love will take the flag," or said, "A man who loves Allah and His Apostle; and Allah will grant victory under his leadership." Suddenly came `Ali whom we did not expect. The people said, "This is `Ali." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave him the flag and Allah granted victory under his leadership
hi: Salama bataate hain: Ali (Alayhis Salam) Khaibar ki jung ke din Nabi se peeche rah gaye kyunke unhe aankh ki takleef thi. Phir unhone kaha, "Main Allah ke Rasool se peeche kaise rah sakta hoon?" Isliye Ali (Alayhis Salam) Nabi ka picha karte hue nikle. Jab woh raat aee jiski subah Allah ne (Musalmanon ki) fatah ki, Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Main jhanda (ek shaks ko) dunga," ya "Kal ek shaks jhanda lega jise Allah aur uske Rasool muhabbat karte hain," ya kaha, "Jo Allah aur uske Rasool se muhabbat karta hai; aur Allah unki agwaee mein fatah dega." Achanak Ali (Alayhis Salam) aaye jinke aane ki humein ummeed nahi thi. Logon ne kaha, "Yeh Ali (Alayhis Salam) hain." Allah ke Rasool ne unhe jhanda diya aur Allah ne unki agwaee mein fatah di.

e: Narrated Abu Hazim:A man came to Sahl bin Sa`d and said, "This is so-and-so," meaning the Governor of Medina, "He is calling `Ali bad names near the pulpit." Sahl asked, "What is he saying?" He (i.e. the man) replied, "He calls him (i.e. `Ali) Abu Turab." Sahl laughed and said, "By Allah, none but the Prophet (ﷺ) called him by this name and no name was dearer to `Ali than this." So I asked Sahl to tell me more, saying, "O Abu `Abbas! How (was this name given to `Ali)?" Sahl said, "`Ali went to Fatima and then came out and slept in the Mosque. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked Fatima, "Where is your cousin?" She said, "In the Mosque." The Prophet (ﷺ) went to him and found that his (i.e. `Ali's) covering sheet had slipped off his back and dust had soiled his back. The Prophet (ﷺ) started wiping the dust off his back and said twice, "Get up! O Abu Turab (i.e. O. man with the dust)
hi: Abu Hazim bataate hain: Ek shaks Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas aaya aur kaha, "Yeh falaan hai," Madina ke gawarnar ka zikar karte huye, "woh mimbar ke qareeb Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko buri baaten kah rahe hain." Sahl ne pucha, "Woh kya kah rahe hain?" Usne jawab diya, "Woh unhe Abu Turab kahte hain." Sahl haanse aur kaha, "Allah ki qasam, sirf Nabi ne unhe is naam se pukara, aur Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko is se pyara koi naam nahi tha." Isliye maine Sahl se aur batane ko kaha, "Aye Abu Abbas! Kaise (yeh naam Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko mila)?" Sahl ne kaha, "Ali (Alayhis Salam) Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ke paas gaye aur phir bahar aakar masjid mein so gaye. Nabi ne Fatima (Alayhas Salam) se pucha, 'Tumhare chachere bhai kahaan hain?' Unhone kaha, 'Masjid mein.' Nabi unke paas gaye aur paaya ke unki odhne wali chaadar unki peeth se sarak gaee thi aur dhool unki peeth par lagi thi. Nabi unki peeth se dhool ponchhne lage aur do baar kaha, 'Utho! Aye Abu Turab (yaani dhool wale shaks)!'"

e: Narrated Sa`d bin 'Ubaida:A man came to Ibn `Umar and asked about `Uthman and Ibn `Umar mentioned his good deeds and said to the questioner. "Perhaps these facts annoy you?" The other said, "Yes." Ibn `Umar said, "May Allah stick your nose in the dust (i.e. degrade you)!' Then the man asked him about `Ali. Ibn `Umar mentioned his good deeds and said, "It is all true, and that is his house in the midst of the houses of the Prophet. Perhaps these facts have hurt you?" The questioner said, "Yes." Ibn `Umar said, "May Allah stick your nose in the dust (i.e. degrade you or make you do things which you hate) ! Go away and do whatever you can against me
hi: Sa'd bin Ubaida bataate hain: Ek shaks Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas aaya aur unse Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke baare mein pucha, aur Ibn Umar ne unke neik amal bataye aur puchne wale se kaha, "Shaayad yeh baaten tumhe naraaj karti hain?" Doosre ne kaha, "Haan." Ibn Umar ne kaha, "Allah tumhari naak ko mitti mein sane (yaani tumhe apman kare)!" Phir us shaks ne Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke baare mein pucha. Ibn Umar ne unke neik amal bataye aur kaha, "Yeh sab sach hai, aur yeh raha unka ghar Nabi ke gharon ke beech mein. Shaayad in baaton ne tumhe dukhi kiya hai?" Puchne wale ne kaha, "Haan." Ibn Umar ne kaha, "Allah tumhari naak ko mitti mein sane (yaani tumhe apman kare ya tumhe aisa kaam karvaye jo tumhe napasand ho)! Jaao aur mere khilaf jo bhi kar sakte ho karo."

e: Narrated `Ali:Fatima complained of the suffering caused to her by the hand mill. Some Captives were brought to the Prophet, so she came to him but did not find him at home. `Aisha was present there to whom she told (of her desire for a servant). When the Prophet (ﷺ) came, Aisha informed him about Fatima's visit. `Ali added "So the Prophet (ﷺ) came to us, while we had gone to our bed. I wanted to get up but the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Remain at your place". Then he sat down between us till I found the coolness of his feet on my chest. Then he said, "Shall I teach you a thing which is better than what you have asked me? When you go to bed, say, 'Allahu-Akbar' thirty-four times, and 'Subhan Allah thirty-three times, and 'Al hamdu-li l-lah thirty-three times for that is better for you both than a servant
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ne haath ki chakki (aata pisne ke) se hone wali takleef ki shikaayat ki. Kuch qaidi Nabi ke paas laaye gaye, isliye woh unke paas gaee magar unhe ghar par na paaya. Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) wahaan maujood thi jinko unhone (apni khaahish ek naukar ki) bataee. Jab Nabi aaye, Ayesha ne unhe Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ki mulaqaat ke baare mein bataya. Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne joda "Isliye Nabi humare paas aaye, jabke hum apne bistar mein ja chuke the. Main uthna chaahta tha magar Nabi ne kaha, 'Apni jagah raho.' Phir woh humare beech baithe jab tak maine unke paanv ki thandak apni chhaati par mahsoos ki. Phir unhone kaha, 'Kya main tumhe ek aisi cheez sikhaun jo usse behtar hai jo tumne mujhse maangi hai? Jab tum bistar mein jaao, \"Allahu Akbar\" chauتis (34) baar kaho, aur \"Subhanallah\" taintis (33) baar, aur \"Al-hamdu-lillah\" taintis (33) baar, kyunke yeh tum donon ke liye ek naukar se behtar hai.'"

e: And narrated Sad that the Prophet (ﷺ) said to 'Ali, "Will you not be pleased from this that you are to me like Aaron was to Moses?
hi: Sa'd bataate hain: Nabi ne Ali (Alayhis Salam) se kaha, "Kya tumhe khushi nahi hogi ke tum mere liye waise ho jaise Haroon Musa ke liye the?"

e: Narrated Ubaida: Ali said (to the people of 'Iraq), "Judge as you used to judge, for I hate differences (and I do my best ) till the people unite as one group, or I die as my companions have died
hi: Ubaida bataate hain: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne (Iraq ke logon se) kaha, "Waise hi faisla karo jaisa tum karte the, kyunke mujhe ikhtilaf se nafrat hai (aur main puri koshish karta hoon) jab tak log ek jamaat ke soorat mein ekjut ho jaen, ya main mar jaun jaise mere sathi mare."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The people used to say, "Abu Huraira narrates too many narrations." In fact I used to keep close to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and was satisfied with what filled my stomach. I ate no leavened bread and dressed no decorated striped clothes, and never did a man or a woman serve me, and I often used to press my belly against gravel because of hunger, and I used to ask a man to recite a Qur'anic Verse to me although I knew it, so that he would take me to his home and feed me. And the most generous of all the people to the poor was Ja`far bin Abi Talib. He used to take us to his home and offer us what was available therein. He would even offer us an empty folded leather container (of butter) which we would split and lick whatever was in it
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Log kahte the, "Abu Huraira bahut zyada riwaayaten sunate hain." Asal mein main Allah ke Rasool ke qareeb rahta tha aur santusht tha jo mera pet bhar deta. Maine na khameeri roti khaee, na chitrit dhaaridaar kapde pahne, na kisi mard ya aurat ne meri sewa ki, aur main aksar bhookh ki wajah se apna pet kankaron par dabata tha, aur main kisi shaks se ek Quranic Ayat sunane ko kehta tha chahe mujhe woh pahle se pata ho, taake woh mujhe apne ghar le jaye aur khilaye. Aur sab logon mein gareebon ke prati sabse daani Ja'far bin Abi Talib the. Woh humein apne ghar le jate aur jo bhi wahaan hota humein dete. Woh humein ek khali, lapete hue chamde ke bartan (ghi ka) bhi dete jise hum chirkar usmein jo bhi hota chaate the.

e: Narrated Ash-Shu`bi:Whenever Ibn `Umar greeted Ibn Jafar, he used to say: "As-salamu-'Alaika (i.e. Peace be on you) O son of Dhu-l-Janahain (son of the two-winged person)
hi: Ash-Shu'bi bataate hain: Jab bhi Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) Ibn Ja'far ko salaam karte, woh kahte, "As-Salamu-Alaika (yaani tumpar shaanti ho), Aye Dhu-l-Janahain ke bete (yaani do-pankhon wale shaks ke bete)."

e: Narrated Anas:Whenever there was drought, `Umar bin Al-Khattab used to ask Allah for rain through Al-`Abbas bin `Abdul Muttalib, saying, "O Allah! We used to request our Prophet to ask You for rain, and You would give us. Now we request the uncle of our Prophet to ask You for rain, so give us rain." And they would be given rain
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab bhi sookha padta, Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab Al-Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib ke zariye Allah se barish maangte, kehte huye, "Aye Allah! Hum apne Nabi se guzarish karte the ke woh humare liye Tujhse barish maange, aur Tu humein deta tha. Ab hum apne Nabi ke chache se guzarish karte hain ke woh humare liye Tujhse barish maange, isliye humein barish de." Aur unhe barish di jaati.

e: Narrated 'Aisha: Fatima sent somebody to Abu Bakr asking him to give her her inheritance from the Prophet (ﷺ) from what Allah had given to His Apostle through Fai (i.e. booty gained without fighting). She asked for the Sadaqa (i.e. wealth assigned for charitable purposes) of the Prophet (ﷺ) at Medina, and Fadak, and what remained of the Khumus (i.e., one-fifth) of the Khaibar booty. Abu Bakr said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'We (Prophets), our property is not inherited, and whatever we leave is Sadaqa, but Muhammad's Family can eat from this property, i.e. Allah's property, but they have no right to take more than the food they need.' By Allah! I will not bring any change in dealing with the Sadaqa of the Prophet (and will keep them) as they used to be observed in his (i.e. the Prophet's) life-time, and I will dispose with it as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to do," Then 'Ali said, "I testify that None has the right to be worshipped but Allah, and that Muhammad is His Apostle," and added, "O Abu Bakr! We acknowledge your superiority." Then he (i.e. 'Ali) mentioned their own relationship to Allah's Apostle and their right. Abu Bakr then spoke saying, "By Allah in Whose Hands my life is. I love to do good to the relatives of Allah's Apostle rather than to my own relatives
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ne Abu Bakr ke paas kisi ko bheja unse apni waraasat maangne ke liye, jo unhe Allah ke Rasool se milna thi us Fai (yaani bina jung ke hasil hui daulat) se jo Allah ne apne Rasool ko di thi. Unhone Nabi ki Madina ki Sadaqa (yaani charity ke liye maal), Fadak, aur Khaibar ke maal-e-ghanimat ke Khumus (yaani ek-paanchvaan hissa) mein se jo bach gaya tha, uski maangi. Abu Bakr ne kaha, "Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, 'Humare (Nabiyon ke) maal ki waraasat nahi hoti, aur jo hum chhodte hain woh Sadaqa hai, magar Muhammad ka pariwara is maal se, yaani Allah ki maal se, kha sakta hai, magar unhe apni zaroorat se zyada khaane ka koi haqq nahi.' Allah ki qasam! Main Nabi ki Sadaqa ke maamle mein koi badlaav nahi laoonga aur (unhe usi tarah rakhunga) jaisa unki zindagi mein tha, aur main ise usi tarah istemal karunga jaisa Allah ke Rasool karte the." Phir Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha, "Main gawahi deta hoon ke Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahi, aur Muhammad uske Rasool hain," aur joda, "Aye Abu Bakr! Hum aapki superiority ko maante hain." Phir unhone (yaani Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne) Allah ke Rasool se apne rishte ka aur apne haqq ka zikar kiya. Abu Bakr ne phir kaha, "Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haathon mein meri zindagi hai, main Allah ke Rasool ke rishtedaron ke saath achha suluk karna apne khud ke rishtedaron se zyada pasand karunga."

e: Abu Bakr said: Look at Muhammad through his family (i.e. if you are no good to his family you are not good to him)
hi: Abu Bakr ne kaha: Muhammad ko unke pariwara ke zariye dekho (yaani agar tum unke pariwara ke saath achha nahi ho, tum unke prati bhi achhe nahi ho).

e: Narrated Al-Miswar bin Makhrama:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Fatima is a part of me, and he who makes her angry, makes me angry
hi: Al-Miswar bin Makhrama (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Fatima (Alayhas Salam) mera ek hissa hai, aur jo unhe naraaj karta hai, mujhe naraaj karta hai."

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) called his daughter Fatima during his illness in which he died, and told her a secret whereupon she wept. Then he called her again and told her a secret whereupon she laughed. When I asked her about that, she replied, "The Prophet (ﷺ) spoke to me in secret and informed me that he would die in the course of the illness during which he died, so I wept. He again spoke to me in secret and informed me that I would be the first of his family to follow him (after his death) and on that I laughed
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi ne apni beti Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ko apni aakhri bimari ke dauran, jismein unka intiqal hua, bulaya aur unhe ek raaz bataya jispar woh rone lagi. Phir unhone unhe phir bulaya aur ek raaz bataya jispar woh haansi. Jab maine unse iske baare mein pucha, unhone jawab diya, "Nabi ne mujhse raaz mein baat ki aur mujhe bataya ke unka intiqal usi bimari mein hoga jismein unka intiqal hua, isliye main roee. Unhone phir mujhse raaz mein baat ki aur mujhe bataya ke apne pariwara mein se, main sabse pahle unke peeche jaaungi (unki maut ke baad), aur ispar main haansi."

e: Narrated Marwan bin Al-Hakam:`Uthman bin `Affan was afflicted with severe nose-bleeding in the year when such illness was prevelant and that prevented him from performing Hajj, and (because of it) he made his will. A man from Quraish came to him and said, "Appoint your successor." `Uthman asked, "Did the people name him? (i.e. the successor) the man said, "Yes." `Uthman asked, "Who is that?" The man remained silent. Another man came to `Uthman and I think it was Al-Harith. He also said, "Appoint your successor." `Uthman asked, "Did the people name him?" The man replied "Yes." `Uthman said, "Who is that?" The man remained silent. `Uthman said, "Perhaps they have mentioned Az-Zubair?" The man said, "Yes." `Uthman said, "By Him in Whose Hands my life is, he is the best of them as I know, and the dearest of them to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
hi: Marwan bin Al-Hakam bataate hain: Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Affan ko us saal sakht naak se khoon bahne ki bimari hui jab yeh bimari phaila hui thi, aur iske wajah se woh Hajj nahi kar sake, aur (iske wajah se) unhone apni vasiyat likhi. Quraish ka ek shaks unke paas aaya aur kaha, "Apna jaanshin muqarrar keejiye." Uthman ne pucha, "Kya logon ne kisi ka naam liya hai? (yaani jaanshin)" Shaks ne kaha, "Haan." Uthman ne pucha, "Kaun hai?" Shaks khaamosh ho gaya. Ek doosra shaks Uthman ke paas aaya, mujhe lagta hai woh Al-Harith the. Unhone bhi kaha, "Apna jaanshin muqarrar keejiye." Uthman ne pucha, "Kya logon ne kisi ka naam liya hai?" Shaks ne jawab diya, "Haan." Uthman ne kaha, "Kaun hai?" Shaks khaamosh ho gaya. Uthman ne kaha, "Shaayad unhone Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ka naam liya hai?" Shaks ne kaha, "Haan." Uthman ne kaha, "Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haathon mein meri zindagi hai, woh unmein sabse behtar hain jitna mujhe pata hai, aur Allah ke Rasool ke sabse pyare."

e: Narrated Marwan bin Al-Hakam:While I was with `Uthman, a man came to him and said, "Appoint your successor." `Uthman said, "Has such successor been named?" He replied, "Yes, Az-Zubair." `Uthman said, thrice, "By Allah! Indeed you know that he is the best of you
hi: Marwan bin Al-Hakam bataate hain: Jabke main Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath tha, ek shaks unke paas aaya aur kaha, "Apna jaanshin muqarrar keejiye." Uthman ne kaha, "Kya aisa koi jaanshin naam liya gaya hai?" Usne jawab diya, "Haan, Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ)." Uthman ne teen baar kaha, "Allah ki qasam! Tumhe pata hai woh tum sabmein behtar hain."

e: Narrated Jabir:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Every prophet used to have a Hawari (i.e. disciple), and my Hawari is Az-Zubair bin Al-`Awwam
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Har Nabi ka ek Hawaari (yaani khaas shaagird) hota tha, aur mera Hawaari Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Awwam hain."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Az-Zubair:During the battle of Al-Ahzab, I and `Umar bin Abi-Salama were kept behind with the women. Behold! I saw (my father) Az-Zubair riding his horse, going to and coming from Bani Quraiza twice or thrice. So when I came back I said, "O my father! I saw you going to and coming from Bani Quraiza?" He said, "Did you really see me, O my son?" I said, "Yes." He said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Who will go to Bani Quraiza and bring me their news?' So I went, and when I came back, Allah's Apostle mentioned for me both his parents saying, "Let my father and mother be sacrificed for you
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Al-Ahzab ki jung ke dauran, main aur Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi-Salama aurton ke saath peeche rakhe gaye the. Dekho! Maine (apne waalid) Az-Zubair ko apne ghode par sawar, Bani Quraiza ki taraf do-teen baar aate-jate dekha. Isliye jab main wapas aaya, maine kaha, "Aye mere waalid! Maine aapko Bani Quraiza ki taraf jate-aate dekha?" Unhone kaha, "Kya tumne sach mein mujhe dekha, aye mere bete?" Maine kaha, "Haan." Unhone kaha, "Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, 'Kaun Bani Quraiza ki taraf jaayega aur mujhe unki khabar laega?' Isliye main gaya, aur jab main wapas aaya, Allah ke Rasool ne mere liye apne donon maa-baap ka zikar kiya, kehte huye, 'Mere maa-baap tumhare liye qurbaan hon.'"

e: Narrated `Urwa:On the day of the battle of Al-Yarmuk, the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) said to Az-Zubair, "Will you attack the enemy vigorously so that we may attack them along with you?" So Az-Zubair attacked them, and they inflicted two wounds over his shoulder, and in between these two wounds there was an old scar he had received on the day of the battle of Badr When I was a child, I used to insert my fingers into those scars in play
hi: Urwa bataate hain: Al-Yarmuk ki jung ke din, Nabi ke sahaba ne Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kaha, "Kya aap dushman par sakhti se hamla karenge taake hum bhi aapke saath hamla kar saken?" Isliye Az-Zubair ne unpar hamla kiya, aur unhone unke kandhe par do zakhm kiye, aur in donon zakhmon ke beech ek purana nishaan tha jo unhe Badr ki jung ke din mila tha. Jab main bachcha tha, main mazak-mazak mein un nishaanon mein apni ungliyaan daalkar khelta tha.

e: Narrated Abu `Uthman:During one of the Ghazawat in which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was fighting, none remained with the Prophet (ﷺ) but Talha and Sa`d
hi: Abu Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek Ghazwe ke dauran jismein Allah ke Rasool jung kar rahe the, koi bhi Nabi ke saath nahi bacha siwaye Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Sa'd ke.

e: Narrated Qais bin Abi Hazim:I saw Talha's paralyzed hand with which he had protected the Prophet (from an arrow)
hi: Qais bin Abi Hazim bataate hain: Maine Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke lakve (yaani padaghaat) hue haath ko dekha jisse unhone Nabi ki (ek teer se) hifaazat ki thi.

e: Narrated Sa`d:On the day of the battle of Uhud the Prophet (ﷺ) mentioned for me both his parents (i.e. saying, "Let my parents be sacrificed for you)
hi: Sa'd bataate hain: Uhud ki jung ke din Nabi ne mere liye apne donon maa-baap ka zikar kiya (yaani kaha, "Mere maa-baap tumhare liye qurbaan hon").

e: Narrated Sa`d:No doubt, (for some time) I stood for one-third of the Muslims
hi: Sa'd bataate hain: Koi shak nahi, (kuch waqt ke liye) main Musalmanon ke ek-tihaee ke barabar khada raha.

e: Narrated Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas:No man embraced Islam before the day on which I embraced Islam, and no doubt, I remained for seven days as one third of the then extant Muslims
hi: Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Koi shaks Islam nahi laaya us din se pahle jispar main Islam laaya, aur koi shak nahi, main saat din tak us waqt ke Musalmanon ke ek-tihaee ke barabar raha.

e: Narrated Qais:I heard Sa`d saying, "I was the first amongst the 'Arabs who shot an arrow for Allah's Cause. We used to fight along with the Prophet, while we had nothing to eat except the leaves of trees so that one's excrete would look like the excrete balls of camel or a sheep, containing nothing to mix them together. Today Banu Asad tribe blame me for not having understood Islam. I would be a loser if my deeds were in vain." Those people complained about Sa`d to `Umar, claiming that he did not offer his prayers perfectly
hi: Qais bataate hain: Maine Sa'd ko kehte suna, "Main sab Arbon mein sabse pahle tha jinhone Allah ki raah mein teer chalaya. Hum Nabi ke saath jung karte the jabke humare paas khaane ke liye siwaye darakhton ke patton ke kuch nahi hota tha, itna ke koi bhi apna mal unt ya bhed ke mal ke chhote gole jaisa dekhta, jisme kuch bhi mila nahi hota tha (unhe jodne ke liye). Aaj Banu Asad qabile ke log mujhpar ilzaam lagate hain ke maine Islam ko sahi tarike se nahi samjha. Main na-kaamyaab hoonga agar mere amal barbaad ho jaen." Un logon ne Sa'd ki Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se shikaayat ki, daava karte huye ke woh apni namaz sahi tarike se nahi padhte.

e: Narrated Al-Miswar bin Makhrama:`Ali demanded the hand of the daughter of Abu Jahl. Fatima heard of this and went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "Your people think that you do not become angry for the sake of your daughters as `Ali is now going to marry the daughter of Abu Jahl. "On that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got up and after his recitation of Tashah-hud. I heard him saying, "Then after! I married one of my daughters to Abu Al-`As bin Al- Rabi` (the husband of Zainab, the daughter of the Prophet (ﷺ) ) before Islam and he proved truthful in whatever he said to me. No doubt, Fatima is a part of me, I hate to see her being troubled. By Allah, the daughter of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and the daughter of Allah's Enemy cannot be the wives of one man." So `Ali gave up that engagement. 'Al-Miswar further said: I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) talking and he mentioned a son-in-law of his belonging to the tribe of Bani `Abd-Shams. He highly praised him concerning that relationship and said (whenever) he spoke to me, he spoke the truth, and whenever he promised me, he fulfilled his promise
hi: Al-Miswar bin Makhrama (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne Abu Jahl ki beti se shaadi ka prastaav rakha. Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ne yeh suna aur Allah ke Rasool ke paas gaee aur kaha, "Aapki qaum sochti hai ke aap apni betiyon ke liye naraaj nahi hote, kyunke Ali (Alayhis Salam) ab Abu Jahl ki beti se shaadi karna chahte hain." Isspar Allah ke Rasool khade hue aur apna Tashah-hud padhne ke baad, maine unhe kehte suna, "Iske baad! Maine apni ek beti ki shaadi Abu Al-As bin Ar-Rabi (yaani Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا), Nabi ki beti ke shohar) se ki thi Islam se pahle, aur woh mujhse jo bhi kahte the usme sachche nikle. Koi shak nahi, Fatima (Alayhas Salam) mera ek hissa hai, mujhe napasand hai use pareshaan hote dekhna. Allah ki qasam, Allah ke Rasool ki beti aur Allah ke dushman ki beti ek shaks ki biwiyaan nahi ban sakti." Isliye Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne woh mangni chhod di. Al-Miswar ne aage kaha: Maine Nabi ko baat karte suna aur unhone apne ek daamad ka zikar kiya jo Bani Abd-Shams qabile se the. Unhone unke baare mein bahut taarif ki us rishte mein, kehte huye, "(Jab bhi) unhone mujhse baat ki, unhone sach kaha, aur jab bhi unhone mujhse waada kiya, unhone apna waada poora kiya."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) sent an army under the command of Usama bin Zaid. When some people criticized his leadership, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If you are criticizing Usama's leadership, you used to criticize his father's leadership before. By Allah! He was worthy of leadership and was one of the dearest persons to me, and (now) this (i.e. Usama) is one of the dearest to me after him (i.e. Zaid)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne ek fauj Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke netritva mein bheji. Jab kuch logon ne unki agwaee par ilzaam lagaya, Nabi ne kaha, "Agar tum Usama ki agwaee par ilzaam lagate ho, tumne unke waalid ki agwaee par bhi pahle ilzaam lagaya tha. Allah ki qasam! Woh agwaee ke laayak the aur mere sabse pyare logon mein se ek the, aur (ab) yeh (yaani Usama) unke baad mere sabse pyare logon mein se ek hai."

e: Narrated `Urwa:Aisha said, "A Qaif (i.e. one skilled in recognizing the lineage of a person through Physiognomy and through examining the body parts of an infant) came to me while the Prophet (ﷺ) was present, and Usama bin Zaid and Zaid bin Haritha were Lying asleep. The Qa'if said. These feet (of Usama and his father) are of persons belonging to the same lineage.' " The Prophet (ﷺ) was pleased with that saying which won his admiration, and he told `Aisha of it
hi: Urwa bataate hain: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha, "Ek Qaif (yaani ek maahir jo shaariirik lakshanon se rishta pahchante hain) mere paas aaya jabke Nabi wahaan maujood the, aur Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Zaid bin Haritha sote hue the. Qaif ne kaha, 'Yeh (Usama aur unke waalid ke) paanv ek hi vansh ke logon ke hain.'" Nabi is baat se khush hue jisne unka dil jeeta, aur unhone Ayesha ko bhi iske baare mein bataya.

e: Narrated 'Aisha: The people of the Quraish tribe were worried about the Makhzumiya woman. They said. "Nobody dare speak to him (i.e. the Prophet (ﷺ) ) except Usama bin Zaid as he is the most beloved to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Quraish qabile ke log Makhzumiya aurat ke maamle se pareshaan the. Unhone kaha, "Koi bhi unse (yaani Nabi se) baat karne ki himmat nahi karega siwaye Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke, kyunke woh Allah ke Rasool ko sabse pyare hain."

e: Aisha said, "A woman from Bani Makhzumiya committed a theft and the people said, 'Who can intercede with the Prophet (ﷺ) for her?' So nobody dared speak to him (i.e. the Prophet) but Usama bin Zaid spoke to him. The Prophet said, 'If a reputable man amongst the children of Bani Israel committed a theft, they used to forgive him, but if a poor man committed a theft, they would cut his hand. But I would cut even the hand of Fatima (i.e. the daughter of the Prophet) if she committed a theft
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Bani Makhzumiya qabile ki ek aurat ne chori ki, aur logon ne kaha, "Kaun Nabi ke saamne uske liye sifarish kar sakta hai?" Isliye kisi ne unse (yaani Nabi se) baat karne ki himmat nahi ki siwaye Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke. Nabi ne kaha, "Agar Bani Israel mein koi izzatdaar shaks chori karta, woh use maaf kar dete, magar agar koi gareeb shaks chori karta, woh uska haath kaat dete. Magar main Fatima (Alayhas Salam) (yaani Nabi ki beti) ka bhi haath kaatunga agar woh chori kare."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Dinar:One day Ibn `Umar, while in the Mosque, looked at a man who was dragging his clothes while walking in one of the corners of the Mosque He said, "See who is that. I wish he was near to me." Somebody then said (to Ibn `Umar), "Don't you know him, O Abu `Abdur-Rahman? He is Muhammad bin Usama." On that Ibn `Umar bowed his head and dug the earth with his hands and then, said, "If Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw him, he would have loved him
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Dinar bataate hain: Ek din Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne masjid mein ek shaks ko dekha jo masjid ke ek kone mein apne kapde ghaseette hue chal raha tha. Unhone kaha, "Dekho yeh kaun hai. Kaash woh mere qareeb hote." Kisi ne (Ibn Umar se) kaha, "Kya aap unhe nahi jaante, Aye Abu Abdur-Rahman? Woh Muhammad bin Usama hain." Isspar Ibn Umar ne apna sar jhukaya aur apne haathon se zameen khoda aur kaha, "Agar Allah ke Rasool unhe dekhte, woh unse pyar karte."

e: Narrated Usama bin Zaid: That the Prophet (ﷺ) used to take him (i.e. Usama) and Al-Hasan (in his lap) and say: "O Allah! Love them, as I love them
hi: Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi unhe (yaani Usama ko) aur Al-Hasan (Alayhis Salam) ko (apni god mein) uthate the aur kahte, "Aye Allah! Inse pyar kar, jaisa main unse pyar karta hoon."

e: The freed slave of Usama bin Zaid said, "Al-Hajjaj bin Aiman bin Um Aiman and Aiman Ibn Um Aiman was Usama's brother from the maternal side, and he was one of the Ansar. He was seen by Ibn 'Umar not performing his bowing and prostrations in a perfect manner. So Ibn 'Umar told him to repeat his prayer
hi: Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke azaad kiye gulaam bataate hain: Al-Hajjaj bin Aiman bin Um Aiman, aur Aiman ibn Um Aiman Usama ke mama-jaee bhai the, aur woh Ansaar mein se the. Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne unhe dekha ke woh apna ruku aur sajda sahi tarike se nahi kar rahe the. Isliye Ibn Umar ne unhe namaz doharane ko kaha.

e: Harmala, the freed slave of Usama bin Zaid said that while he was in the company of 'Abdullah bin 'Umar, Al-Hajjaj bin Aiman came in and (while praying) he did not perform his bowing and prostrations properly. So Ibn 'Umar told him to repeat his prayer. When he went away, Ibn 'Umar asked me, "Who is he?" I said, "Al-Hajjaj bin Um Aiman." Ibn 'Umar said, "If Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw him, he would have loved him." Then Ibn 'Umar mentioned the love of the Prophet (ﷺ) for the children of Um Aiman. Sulaiman said that Um Aiman was one of the nurses of the Prophet
hi: Harmala, Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke azaad kiye gulaam, bataate hain: Jabke woh Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki sohbat mein the, Al-Hajjaj bin Aiman aaye aur (namaz padhte waqt) unhone apna ruku aur sajda sahi tarike se nahi kiya. Isliye Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne unhe namaz doharane ko kaha. Jab woh chale gaye, Ibn Umar ne mujhse pucha, "Woh kaun hain?" Maine kaha, "Al-Hajjaj bin Um Aiman." Ibn Umar ne kaha, "Agar Allah ke Rasool unhe dekhte, woh unse pyar karte." Phir Ibn Umar ne Nabi ki Um Aiman ke bachchon ke prati mohabbat ka zikar kiya. Sulaiman ne kaha ke Um Aiman Nabi ki daiyon mein se ek thi.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:If a man saw a dream during the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) he would narrate it to the Prophet. Once I wished to see a dream and narrate it to the Prophet (ﷺ) I was young, unmarried, and used to sleep in the Mosque during the lifetime of the Prophet. I dreamt that two angels took me and went away with me towards the (Hell) Fire which looked like a well with the inside walls built up, and had two side-walls like those of a well. There I saw some people in it whom I knew. I started saying, "I seek Refuge with Allah from the (Hell) Fire, I seek Refuge with Allah from the (Hell) Fire." Then another angel met the other two and said to me, "Do not be afraid." I narrated my dream to Hafsa who, in her turn, narrated it to the Prophet. He said, "What an excellent man `Abdullah is if he only observes the night prayer." (Salim, a sub-narrator said, "Abdullah used not to sleep at night but very little hence forward)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Agar koi shaks Nabi ki zindagi mein koi khwab dekhta, woh use Nabi ko sunata. Ek baar main bhi chahta tha ke main koi khwab dekhun aur Nabi ko sunaun. Main jawan tha, ashaadi-shuda, aur Nabi ki zindagi mein masjid mein sota tha. Maine khwab mein dekha ke do farishte mujhe pakadkar (Dozakh ki) aag ki taraf le gaye jo ek kue jaisa dikhta tha, andar se deewaron se bana hua, aur uske do kinare the jaise ek kue ke. Wahaan maine kuch logon ko dekha jinhe main jaanta tha. Main kehne laga, "Main Allah ki panah maangta hoon (Dozakh ki) aag se, main Allah ki panah maangta hoon (Dozakh ki) aag se." Phir ek doosra farishta un donon se mila aur mujhe kaha, "Daro mat." Maine apna khwab Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko bataya, jinhone ise Nabi ko bataya. Unhone kaha, "Kaisa behtareen shaks hai Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ), agar woh raat ki namaz (nafil) padha kare." (Salim, doosre raawi ne kaha, "Abdullah tab se raat ko bahut kam sote the.")

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar from Hafsa his sister:That the Prophet (ﷺ) had said to her, "`Abdullah is a pious man
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) apni behn Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) se bataate hain: Nabi ne unse kaha tha, "Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ek pakbaz shaks hai."

e: Narrated 'Alqama:I went to Sham and offered a two-rak`at prayer and then said, "O Allah! Bless me with a good pious companion." So I went to some people and sat with them. An old man came and sat by my side. I asked, "Who is he?" They replied, "(He is) Abu-Ad-Darda.' I said (to him), "I prayed to Allah to bless me with a pious companion and He sent you to me." He asked me, "From where are you?" I replied, "From the people of Al-Kufa." He said, "Isn't there amongst you Ibn Um `Abd, the one who used to carry the shoes, the cushion(or pillow) and the water for ablution? Is there amongst you the one whom Allah gave Refuge from Satan through the request of His Prophet. Is there amongst you the one who keeps the secrets of the Prophet (ﷺ) which nobody knows except him?" Abu Darda further asked, "How does `Abdullah (bin Mas`ud) recite the Sura starting with, 'By the Night as it conceals (the light)." (92.1) Then I recited before him: 'By the Night as it envelops: And by the Day as it appears in brightness; And by male and female.' (91.1-3) On this Abu Ad-Darda' said, "By Allah, the Prophet (ﷺ) made me recite the Sura in this way while I was listening to him (reciting it)
hi: Alqama bataate hain: Main Sham gaya aur do rakat namaz padhi aur phir kaha, "Aye Allah! Mujhe ek achhe, pakbaz sathi se nawaza." Isliye main kuch logon ke paas gaya aur unke saath baith gaya. Ek budha shaks aaya aur mere paas baith gaya. Maine pucha, "Yeh kaun hain?" Unhone jawab diya, "(Yeh) Abu-Ad-Darda hain." Maine (unse) kaha, "Maine Allah se dua ki thi ke mujhe ek pakbaz sathi de, aur usne aapko mere paas bheja." Unhone mujhse pucha, "Tum kahaan se ho?" Maine jawab diya, "Al-Kufa ke logon mein se." Unhone kaha, "Kya tum mein Ibn Um Abd nahi hain, woh jo joote, taakia (yaani gaddi), aur wudu ka paani uthate the? Kya tum mein woh hain jinhe Allah ne Shaitan se panah di apne Nabi ki guzarish par? Kya tum mein woh hain jo Nabi ke raaz rakhte hain jo unke ilawa kisi ko nahi pata?" Abu Darda ne aage pucha, "Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) (bin Mas'ud) us Surah ko kaise padhte hain jo shuru hoti hai, 'Raat ki qasam jab woh (roshni) chhupati hai.' (92:1)" Phir maine unke saamne padha: "Raat ki qasam jab woh chhaa jaati hai; Aur din ki qasam jab woh roshan hoti hai; Aur (uski qasam) jisne nar aur maada banaaye." (91:1-3) Isspar Abu Ad-Darda ne kaha, "Allah ki qasam, Nabi ne mujhe isi tarah yeh Surah padhwaee jabke main unse (Quran) sun raha tha."

e: Narrated Ibrahim:'Alqama went to Sham and when he entered the mosque, he said, "O Allah ! Bless me with a pious companion." So he sat with Abu Ad-Darda. Abu Ad-Darda' asked him, "Where are you from?" 'Alqama replied, "From the people of Kufa." Abu Ad-Darda said, "Isn't there amongst you the Keeper of the secret which nobody else knows i.e. Hudhaifa?" Al-qama said, "Yes." Then Abu Ad-Darda further said, "Isn't there amongst you the person whom Allah gave Refuge from Satan through the invocation of His Prophet namely `Ammar?" Alqama replied in the affirmative Abu Ad-Darda said, "Isn't there amongst you the person who carries the Siwak (or the Secret) (i.e. of the Prophet (ﷺ) namely `Abdullah bin Mas'ud)?" Alqama said, "Yes." Then Abu Ad-Darda asked, "How (Abdullah bin Masud) used to recite the Sura starting with: "By the night as it envelopes; By the day as it appears in brightness?" (92.1-2). Alqama said "And by male and female." Abu Ad-Darda then said, "These people (of Sham) tried hard to make me accept something other than what I had heard from the Prophet
hi: Ibrahim bataate hain: Alqama Sham gaye aur jab woh masjid mein daakhil hue, unhone kaha, "Aye Allah! Mujhe ek pakbaz sathi de." Isliye woh Abu Ad-Darda ke saath baith gaye. Abu Ad-Darda ne unse pucha, "Tum kahaan se ho?" Alqama ne jawab diya, "Kufa ke logon mein se." Abu Ad-Darda ne kaha, "Kya tum mein woh raaz rakhne wala nahi hai jise koi aur nahi jaanta, yaani Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ)?" Alqama ne kaha, "Haan." Phir Abu Ad-Darda ne aage kaha, "Kya tum mein woh shaks nahi hai jise Allah ne Shaitan se panah di apne Nabi ki dua se, yaani Ammar (رضی اللہ عنہ)?" Alqama ne haan mein jawab diya. Abu Ad-Darda ne kaha, "Kya tum mein woh shaks nahi hai jo Siwaak (ya raaz) uthata hai (yaani Nabi ka), yaani Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ)?" Alqama ne kaha, "Haan." Phir Abu Ad-Darda ne pucha, "(Abdullah bin Masud) kaise padhte the yeh Surah jo shuru hoti hai: 'Raat ki qasam jab woh chhaa jaati hai; Din ki qasam jab woh roshan hoti hai?'" (92:1-2) Alqama ne kaha, "'Aur (uski qasam) jisne nar aur maada banaaye.'" Abu Ad-Darda ne phir kaha, "Yeh log (Sham ke) mujhe kisi aur cheez ko qubool karane ki koshish karte rahe jo maine Nabi se suna tha uske ilawa."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, " Every nation has an extremely trustworthy man, and the trustworthy man of this (i.e. Muslim) nation is Abu 'Ubaida bin Al-Jarrah
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Har ummat ka ek bahut bharosemand shaks hota hai, aur is (Musalman) ummat ka bharosemand shaks Abu Ubaida bin Al-Jarrah hain."

e: Narrated Hudhaifa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said to the people of Najran, "I will send you the most trustworthy man." (Every one of) the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) was looking forward (to be that person). He then sent Abu 'Ubaida
hi: Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Najran ke logon se kaha, "Main tumhare paas sabse zyada bharosemand shaks bhejunga." (Har ek) Nabi ke sahaba ummeed lagaye hue the (ke woh chune jaaenge). Phir unhone Abu Ubaida ko bheja.

e: Narrated Abu Bakra:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) talking at the pulpit while Al-Hasan was sitting beside him, and he (i.e. the Prophet ) was once looking at the people and at another time Al-Hasan, and saying, "This son of mine is a Saiyid (i.e. chief) and perhaps Allah will bring about an agreement between two sects of the Muslims through him
hi: Abu Bakra (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi ko mimbar par baat karte suna jabke Al-Hasan (Alayhis Salam) unke bagal mein baithe the, aur woh (yaani Nabi) kabhi logon ki taraf dekhte aur kabhi Al-Hasan (Alayhis Salam) ki taraf, aur kehte, "Yeh mera beta ek Saiyid (yaani sardaar) hai, aur shaayad Allah unke zariye do Musalman girohon ke beech sulha karvaaae."

e: Narrated Usama bin Zaid:That the Prophet (ﷺ) used to take him and Al-Hasan, and used to say, "O Allah! I love them, so please love them," or said something similar
hi: Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi unhe aur Al-Hasan (Alayhis Salam) ko uthate the aur kahte, "Aye Allah! Main inse mohabbat karta hoon, isliye kripya inse mohabbat kar," ya isi se milta-julta kuch kahte.

e: Narrated Muhammad:Anas bin Malik said, "The head of Al-Husain was brought to 'Ubaidullah bin Ziyad and was put in a tray, and then Ibn Ziyad started playing with a stick at the nose and mouth of Al-Husain's head and saying something about his handsome features." Anas then said (to him), "Al-Husain resembled the Prophet more than the others did." Anas added, "His (i.e. Al-Husain's) hair was dyed with Wasma (i.e. a kind of plant used as a dye)
hi: Muhammad bataate hain: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Al-Husain (Alayhis Salam) ka sar Ubaidullah bin Ziyad ke paas laaya gaya aur ek tray mein rakha gaya, aur phir Ibn Ziyad Al-Husain (Alayhis Salam) ke sar ki naak aur munh ke paas ek lakdi se khelna laga aur unke khoobsurat lakshanon ke baare mein kuch kah raha tha." Anas ne phir (unse) kaha, "Al-Husain (Alayhis Salam) Nabi se doosron ki tulna mein zyada milte-julte the." Anas ne joda, "Unke (yaani Al-Husain (Alayhis Salam) ke) baal Wasma (yaani ek qisam ke paudhe se bana rang) se range hue the."

e: Narrated Al-Bara:I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) carrying Al-Hasan on his shoulder an saying, "O Allah! I love him, so please love him
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Maine Nabi ko Al-Hasan (Alayhis Salam) ko apne kandhe par uthate aur kahte dekha, "Aye Allah! Main inse mohabbat karta hoon, isliye kripya inse mohabbat kar."

e: Narrated `Uqba bin Al-Harith:I saw Abu Bakr carrying Al-Hasan and saying, "Let my father be sacrificed for you; you resemble the Prophet and not `Ali," while `Ali was laughing at this
hi: Uqba bin Al-Harith bataate hain: Maine Abu Bakr ko Al-Hasan (Alayhis Salam) ko uthate aur kahte dekha, "Mere waalid tumhare liye qurbaan hon; tum Nabi se milte-julte ho, Ali (Alayhis Salam) se nahi," jabke Ali (Alayhis Salam) ispar haanste the.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Abu Bakr used to say, "Look after Muhammad (ﷺ) in (looking after) his family
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Bakr kaha karte the, "Muhammad ka unke pariwara ke maamle mein khyaal rakho."

e: Narrated Anas:None resembled the Prophet (ﷺ) more than Al-Hasan bin `Ali did
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Koi bhi Nabi se Al-Hasan bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) se zyada milta-julta nahi tha.

e: Narrated Ibn Abi Nu'm:A person asked `Abdullah bin `Umar whether a Muslim could kill flies. I heard him saying (in reply). "The people of Iraq are asking about the killing of flies while they themselves murdered the son of the daughter of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . The Prophet (ﷺ) said, They (i.e. Hasan and Husain) are my two sweet basils in this world
hi: Ibn Abi Nu'm bataate hain: Ek shaks ne Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha kya ek Musalman makkhiyaan maar sakta hai. Maine unhe jawab dete suna, "Iraq ke log makkhiyon ko maarne ke baare mein puchte hain jabke unhonne khud Allah ke Rasool ki beti ke bete ko qatl kiya. Nabi ne kaha, 'Woh (yaani Hasan (Alayhis Salam) aur Husain (Alayhis Salam)) is duniya mein mere do khushboodaar phool hain (yaani chhote basil paudhe).'"

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:`Umar used to say, "Abu Bakr is our chief, and he manumitted our chief," meaning Bilal
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) kaha karte the, "Abu Bakr humare sardaar hain, aur unhonne humare sardaar ko azaad kiya," Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ka zikar karte huye.

e: Narrated Qais:Bilal said to Abu Bakr, "If you have bought me for yourself then keep me (for yourself), but if you have bought me for Allah's Sake, then leave me for Allah's Work
hi: Qais bataate hain: Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Abu Bakr se kaha, "Agar aapne mujhe apne liye khareeda hai, mujhe (apne liye) rakhiye, magar agar aapne mujhe Allah ke liye khareeda hai, mujhe Allah ke kaam ke liye chhod dijiye."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) embraced me (pressed me to his chest) and said, "O Allah, teach him wisdom (i.e. the understanding of the knowledge of Qur'an)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Nabi ne mujhe gale lagaya (apne seene se lagaya) aur kaha, "Aye Allah, ise hikmat sikha (yaani Quran ke gyan ki samajh)."

e: Narrated 'Abdul Warith: The same but said, "O Allah, teach him (Ibn Abbas) the Book (i.e. the understanding of the knowledge of Qur'an)." Narrated Khalid: As above
hi: Abdul Warith bataate hain: (Wahi riwaayat) magar kaha, "Aye Allah, ise (yaani Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko) Kitaab sikha (yaani Quran ke gyan ki samajh)." Khalid bataate hain: (Upar jaisa hi)

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) had informed the people about the death of Zaid, Ja`far and Ibn Rawaha before the news of their death reached them. He said with his eyes flowing with tears, "Zaid took the flag and was martyred; then Ja`far took the flag and was martyred, and then Ibn Rawaha took the flag and was martyred. Finally the flag was taken by one of Allah's Swords (i.e. Khalid bin Al-Walid) and Allah gave them (i.e. the Muslims) victory
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne logon ko Zaid, Ja'far, aur Ibn Rawaha ki maut ki khabar unki maut ki khabar untak pahunchne se pahle di thi. Unhonne apni aankhon se aansu bahate huye kaha, "Zaid ne jhanda liya aur shaheed hue; phir Ja'far ne jhanda liya aur shaheed hue, aur phir Ibn Rawaha ne jhanda liya aur shaheed hue. Aakhirkar jhanda Allah ki ek Talwaron mein se ek (yaani Khalid bin Al-Walid) ne uthaya aur Allah ne unhe (yaani Musalmanon ko) fatah di."

e: Narrated Masruq:`Abdullah (bin Mas`ud) was mentioned before `Abdullah bin `Amr. The latter said, "That is a man I continue to love because I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, ' Learn the recitation of the Qur'an from (any of these) four persons: `Abdullah bin Masud, Salim the freed slave of Abu Hudhaifa, Ubai bin Ka`b, and Mu`adh bin Jabal." I do not remember whether he mentioned Ubai first or Mu`adh
hi: Masruq bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) (bin Mas'ud) ka zikar Abdullah bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saamne hua. Unhone kaha, "Yeh woh shaks hai jinse main hamesha mohabbat karta hoon kyunke maine Allah ke Rasool ko kehte suna, 'In chaar logon mein se (kisi bhi ek se) Quran padhna seekho: Abdullah bin Masud, Salim (Abu Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke azaad kiye gulaam), Ubai bin Ka'b (رضی اللہ عنہ), aur Mu'adh bin Jabal (رضی اللہ عنہ).'" Mujhe yaad nahi kya unhonne pahle Ubai ka naam liya ya Mu'adh ka.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) neither talked in an insulting manner nor did he ever speak evil intentionally. He used to say, "The most beloved to me amongst you is the one who has the best character and manners." He added, " Learn the Qur'an from (any of these) four persons. `Abdullah bin Mas`ud, Salim the freed slave of Abu Hudhaifa, Ubai bin Ka`b, and Mu`adh bin Jabal
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool na to apmaanjanak tarike se baat karte the na hi jaanboojhkar buri baat kahte the. Woh kaha karte the, "Tum mein mujhe sabse zyada pyara woh hai jinke adab aur charitra sabse behtar hain." Unhone joda, "Quran chaar logon mein se (kisi ek se) sikho: Abdullah bin Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ), Salim (Abu Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke azaad kiye gulaam), Ubai bin Ka'b (رضی اللہ عنہ), aur Mu'adh bin Jabal (رضی اللہ عنہ)."

e: Narrated Alqama:I went to Sham and was offering a two-rak`at prayer; I said, "O Allah! Bless me with a (pious) companion." Then I saw an old man coming towards me, and when he came near I said, (to myself), "I hope Allah has given me my request." The man asked (me), "Where are you from?" I replied, "I am from the people of Kufa." He said, "Weren't there amongst you the Carrier of the (Prophet's) shoes, Siwak and the ablution water container? Weren't there amongst you the man who was given Allah's Refuge from the Satan? And weren't there amongst you the man who used to keep the (Prophet's) secrets which nobody else knew? How did Ibn Um `Abd (i.e. `Abdullah bin Mas`ud) use to recite Surat-al-lail (the Night:92)?" I recited:-- "By the Night as it envelops By the Day as it appears in brightness. And by male and female." (92.1- 3) On that, Abu Darda said, "By Allah, the Prophet (ﷺ) made me read the Verse in this way after listening to him, but these people (of Sham) tried their best to let me say something different
hi: Alqama bataate hain: Main Sham gaya aur do rakat namaz padh raha tha; maine kaha, "Aye Allah! Mujhe ek (pakbaz) sathi se nawaza." Phir maine ek budha shaks mere paas aate dekha, aur jab woh qareeb aaye maine (khud se) kaha, "Mujhe ummeed hai Allah ne meri guzarish qubool kar li." Us shaks ne (mujhse) pucha, "Tum kahaan se ho?" Maine jawab diya, "Main Kufa ke logon mein se hoon." Unhone kaha, "Kya tum mein woh (Nabi ke) joote, Siwaak, aur wudu ke paani ka bartan uthane wale nahi the? Kya tum mein woh shaks nahi tha jise Allah ki panah di gaee thi Shaitan se? Aur kya tum mein woh shaks nahi tha jo (Nabi ke) raaz rakhta tha jo koi aur nahi jaanta tha? Ibn Um Abd (yaani Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ)) Surat-al-Lail (yaani Raat, 92) kaise padhte the?" Maine padha: "Raat ki qasam jab woh chhaa jaati hai, Din ki qasam jab woh roshan hoti hai, Aur (uski qasam) jisne nar aur maada banaaye." (92:1-3) Isspar, Abu Darda ne kaha, "Allah ki qasam, Nabi ne mujhe isi tarah yeh Ayat padhwaee, unhe sunne ke baad, magar yeh log (Sham ke) meri poori koshish ki mujhe kuch aur kahne ke liye majboor karne ki."

e: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin Yazid:We asked Hudhaifa to tell us of a person resembling (to some extent) the Prophet (ﷺ) in good appearance and straight forward behavior so that we may learn from him (good manners and acceptable conduct). Hudhaifa replied, "I do not know anybody resembling the Prophet (to some extent) in appearance and conduct more than Ibn Um `Abd
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Yazid bataate hain: Humne Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kaha ke woh humein aise kisi shaks ke baare mein bataen jo (kuch had tak) Nabi jaise achhe soorat aur seedhi soch mein milte-julte hon, taake hum unse (achhe adab aur qubool karne laayak vyavhaar) seekh saken. Hudhaifa ne jawab diya, "Mujhe koi bhi shaks Nabi jaise soorat aur vyavhaar mein Ibn Um Abd se zyada milta-julta nahi lagta."

e: Narrated Abu Musa Al-Ash`ari:My brother and I came from Yemen, and for some time we continued to consider `Abdullah bin Mas`ud as one of the members of the family of the Prophet (ﷺ) because we used to see him and his mother going in the house of the Prophet (ﷺ) very often
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ash'ari bataate hain: Mera bhai aur main Yemen se aaye, aur kuch waqt tak hum Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko Nabi ke pariwara ka ek sadasya samajhte rahe kyunke hum unhe aur unki maa ko Nabi ke ghar bahut baar jate dekhte the.

e: Narrated Ibn Abu Mulaika:Muawiya offered one rak`a witr prayer after the `Isha prayer, and at that time a freed slave of Ibn `Abbas was present. He (i.e. the slave) went to Ibn `Abbas (and told him that Muawiya offered one rak`a witr prayer). Ibn `Abbas said, "Leave him, for he was in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
hi: Ibn Abu Mulaika bataate hain: Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Isha ki namaz ke baad ek rakat Witr padhi, aur us waqt Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ka ek azaad kiya gulaam wahaan maujood tha. Woh (yaani gulaam) Ibn Abbas ke paas gaya (aur unhe bataya ke Muawiya ne ek rakat Witr padhi). Ibn Abbas ne kaha, "Unhe chhod do, kyunke woh Allah ke Rasool ki sohbat mein rahe hain."

e: Narrated Ibn Abi Mulaika:Somebody said to Ibn `Abbas, "Can you speak to the chief of the believers Mu`awiyah, as he does not pray except one rak`a as witr?" Ibn `Abbas replied, "He is a Faqih (i.e. a learned man who can give religious verdicts)
hi: Ibn Abu Mulaika bataate hain: Kisi ne Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kaha, "Kya aap mominon ke Ameer Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) se baat kar sakte hain, kyunke woh sirf ek rakat Witr padhte hain?" Ibn Abbas ne jawab diya, "Woh ek Faqih hain (yaani ek ilm waala shaks jo deeni faisle de sakte hain)."

e: Narrated Humran bin Aban:Muawiya said (to the people), "You offer a prayer which we, who were the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) never saw the Prophet (ﷺ) offering, and he forbade its offering," i.e. the two rak`at after the compulsory `Asr prayer
hi: Humran bin Aban bataate hain: Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne (logon se) kaha, "Tum ek namaz padhte ho jo hum, jo Nabi ke sahaba the, kabhi Nabi ko padhte nahi dekha, aur unhone ise padhna mana kiya," yaani Farz Asr ki namaz ke baad ki do rakat.

e: Narrated Al-Miswar bin Makhrama:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Fatima is a part of me, and whoever makes her angry, makes me angry
hi: Al-Miswar bin Makhrama (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Fatima (Alayhas Salam) mera ek hissa hai, aur jo bhi unhe naraaj karta hai, mujhe naraaj karta hai."

e: Narrated Abu Salama:`Aisha said, "Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said (to me), 'O Aish (`Aisha)! This is Gabriel greeting you.' I said, 'Peace and Allah's Mercy and Blessings be on him, you see what I don't see' " She was addressing Allah's Apostle
hi: Abu Salama bataate hain: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha, "Ek baar Allah ke Rasool ne (mujhse) kaha, 'Aye Aish (Ayesha)! Yeh Jibreel hain jo tumhe salaam kah rahe hain.' Maine kaha, 'Unpar shaanti aur Allah ki rehmat aur barkaten hon; aap woh dekhte hain jo main nahi dekhti.'" Woh Allah ke Rasool se mukhatib ho rahi thi.

e: Narrated Abu Musa Al-Ash`ari:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Many amongst men attained perfection but amongst women none attained the perfection except Mary, the daughter of `Imran and Asiya, the wife of Pharaoh. And the superiority of `Aisha to other women is like the superiority of Tharid (i.e. an Arabic dish) to other meals
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ash'ari bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Bahut se mard purnata tak pahunche, magar aurton mein koi bhi purnata tak nahi pahunchi siwaye Maryam, Imran ki beti, aur Asiya, Firaun ki biwi ke. Aur Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ki doosri aurton par superiority aisi hai jaisa Tharid (yaani ek Arbi vyanjan) doosre khaanon par."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The superiority of `Aisha over other women is like the superiority of Tharid to other meals
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ki doosri aurton par superiority aisi hai jaisa Tharid ki doosre khaanon par."

e: Narrated Al-Qasim bin Muhammad:Once `Aisha became sick and Ibn `Abbas went to see her and said, "O mother of the believers! You are leaving for truthful fore-runners i.e. for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr
hi: Al-Qasim bin Muhammad bataate hain: Ek baar Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bimar pada aur Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) unse milne gaye aur kaha, "Aye mominon ki maa! Aap sachche pathpradarshkon ke paas ja rahi hain, yaani Allah ke Rasool aur Abu Bakr ke paas."

e: Narrated Abu Wail:When `Ali sent `Ammar and Al-Hasan to (the people of) Kufa to urge them to fight, `Ammar addressed them saying, "I know that she (i.e. `Aisha) is the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ) in this world and in the Hereafter (world to come), but Allah has put you to test, whether you will follow Him (i.e. Allah) or her
hi: Abu Wail bataate hain: Jab Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne Ammar (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Al-Hasan (Alayhis Salam) ko Kufa ke logon ke paas bheja unhe jung ke liye taiyaar karne, Ammar ne unse khitaab karte huye kaha, "Mujhe pata hai ke woh (yaani Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا)) is duniya aur Aakhirat mein Nabi ki biwi hain, magar Allah ne tumhein aazmane ke liye rakha hai, kya tum Us (yaani Allah) ki pairvi karoge ya unki."

e: Narrated `Aisha:That she borrowed a necklace from Asma' and it was lost. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent some of his companions to look for it. During their journey the time of prayer was due and they prayed without ablution. When they returned to the Prophet (ﷺ) they complained about it. So the Divine Verse of Tayammum was revealed. Usaid bin Hudair said (to `Aisha), "May Allah reward you handsomely. By Allah, whenever you have a difficulty, Allah took you out of it and brought with it, a Blessing for the Muslims
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Unhone Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) se ek haar udhaar liya jo kho gaya. Allah ke Rasool ne apne kuch sahaba ko use dhoondne bheja. Unki safar ke dauran, namaz ka waqt aa gaya aur unhonne bina wudu ke namaz padhi. Jab woh Nabi ke paas wapas aaye, unhonne iski shikaayat ki. Isliye Tayammum ki Divine Ayat naazil hui. Usaid bin Hudair ne (Ayesha se) kaha, "Allah aapko behtareen ajr de. Allah ki qasam, jab bhi aapko koi mushkil hoti hai, Allah aapko usse nikal deta hai aur uske saath, Musalmanon ke liye ek barkat lata hai."

e: Narrated Hisham's father:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was in his fatal illness, he started visiting his wives and saying, "Where will I be tomorrow?" He was anxious to be in `Aisha's home. `Aisha said, "So when it was my day, the Prophet became silent (no longer asked the question)
hi: Hisham ke waalid bataate hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool apni aakhri bimari mein the, woh apni biwiyon se milne jate aur puchte, "Kal main kahaan hoonga?" Woh Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke ghar mein hone ke liye betaab the. Ayesha ne kaha, "Isliye jab mera din aaya, Nabi khaamosh ho gaye (aur unhone phir yeh sawal nahi pucha)."

e: Narrated Hisham's father:The people used to send presents to the Prophet (ﷺ) on the day of `Aisha's turn. `Aisha said, "My companions (i.e. the other wives of the Prophet) gathered in the house of Um Salama and said, "O Um Salama! By Allah, the people choose to send presents on the day of `Aisha's turn and we too, love the good (i.e. presents etc.) as `Aisha does. You should tell Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to tell the people to send their presents to him wherever he may be, or wherever his turn may be." Um Salama said that to the Prophet and he turned away from her, and when the Prophet (ﷺ) returned to her (i.e. Um Salama), she repeated the same, and the Prophet (ﷺ) again turned away, and when she told him the same for the third time, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Um Salama! Don't trouble me by harming `Aisha, for by Allah, the Divine Inspiration never came to me while I was under the blanket of any woman amongst you except her
hi: Hisham ke waalid bataate hain: Log Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ki baari ke din Nabi ko tohfe bhejte the. Ayesha ne kaha, "Meri sathiyaan (yaani Nabi ki doosri biwiyaan) Um Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke ghar mein jama hui aur kaha, 'Aye Um Salama! Allah ki qasam, log Ayesha ki baari ke din tohfe bhejna chunte hain, aur hum bhi achhi cheezen (yaani tohfe) pasand karte hain jaise Ayesha karti hain. Aapko Allah ke Rasool ko yeh kehna chahiye ke woh logon ko bataen apne tohfe unhe bhejne chahiye chahe woh kahin bhi hon, ya unki jo bhi baari ho.'" Um Salama ne yeh Nabi ko bataya aur woh unse mude, aur jab Nabi unke (yaani Um Salama ke) paas wapas aaye, unhonne phir wahi kaha, aur Nabi phir mude, aur jab unhonne teesri baar unse yeh kaha, Nabi ne kaha, "Aye Um Salama! Mujhe Ayesha ko dukh dekar pareshaan mat karo, kyunke Allah ki qasam, Divine Ilham mujhe kabhi nahi mila jabke main tum mein se kisi ke bhi kambal ke neeche tha siwaye unke (yaani Ayesha ke)."

e: Narrated Ghailan bin Jarir:I asked Anas, "Tell me about the name 'Al-Ansar.; Did you call yourselves by it or did Allah call you by it?" He said, "Allah called us by it." We used to visit Anas (at Basra) and he used to narrate to us the virtues and deeds of the Ansar, and he used to address me or a person from the tribe of Al-Azd and say, "Your tribe did so-and-so on such-and-such a day
hi: Ghailan bin Jarir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha, "Mujhe bataiye 'Al-Ansaar' naam ke baare mein. Kya tumne khud ko yeh naam diya ya Allah ne tumhe is naam se pukara?" Unhone kaha, "Allah ne humein is naam se pukara." Hum Anas (Basra mein) se milne jate the aur woh humein Ansaar ke neik amal aur khoobiyon ki riwaayaten sunate the, aur woh mujhe ya Al-Azd qabile ke kisi shaks ko sambodhit karte huye kahte, "Tumhari qaum ne falaan-falaan din aisa-aisa kiya."

e: Narrated `Aisha:The day of Bu'ath (i.e. Day of fighting between the two tribes of the Ansar, the Aus and Khazraj) was brought about by Allah for the good of His Apostle so that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) reached (Medina), the tribes of Medina had already divided and their chiefs had been killed and wounded. So Allah had brought about the battle for the good of H is Apostle in order that they (i.e. the Ansar) might embrace Islam
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Bu'ath ka din (yaani Ansaar ke do qabilon, Aus aur Khazraj, ke beech jung ka din) Allah ne apne Rasool ki bhalaee ke liye laaya, taake jab Allah ke Rasool (Madina) pahunche, Madina ke qabile pahle se hi baante hue the aur unke sardaar mare ya zakhmi ho chuke the. Isliye Allah ne apne Rasool ki bhalaee ke liye us jung ko laaya taake woh (yaani Ansaar) Islam qubool kar saken.

e: Narrated Anas:On the day of the Conquest of Mecca, when the Prophet (ﷺ) had given (from the booty) to the Quraish, the Ansar said, "By Allah, this is indeed very strange: While our swords are still dribbling with the blood of Quraish, our war booty is distributed amongst them." When this news reached the Prophet (ﷺ) he called the Ansar and said, "What is this news that has reached me from you?" They used not to tell lies, so they replied, "What has reached you is true." He said, "Doesn't it please you that the people take the booty to their homes and you take Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to your homes? If the Ansar took their way through a valley or a mountain pass, I would take the Ansar's valley or a mountain pass
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Fatah-e-Mecca ke din, jab Nabi ne (maal-e-ghanimat mein se) Quraish ko diya, Ansaar ne kaha, "Allah ki qasam, yeh sach mein bahut ajeeb hai: Jabke humari talwaren abhi bhi Quraish ke khoon se tapak rahi hain, humara jung ka maal unmein baanta ja raha hai." Jab yeh khabar Nabi tak pahunchi, unhone Ansaar ko bulaya aur kaha, "Yeh kya khabar hai jo mujhtak tumse pahunchi hai?" Woh jhoot nahi bolte the, isliye unhone jawab diya, "Jo aaptak pahunchi hai woh sach hai." Unhone kaha, "Kya tumhe khushi nahi hoti ke log apna maal-e-ghanimat apne gharon le jaen aur tum Allah ke Rasool ko apne gharon le jaao? Agar Ansaar kisi waadi ya pahadi raaste se guzarte, main Ansaar ki waadi ya pahadi raaste se guzarta."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) or Abul-Qasim said, "If the Ansar took their way through a valley or a mountain pass, I would take Ansar's valley. And but for the migration, I would have been one of the Ansar." Abu Huraira used to say, "The Prophet (ﷺ) is not unjust (by saying so). May my parents be sacrificed for him, for the Ansar sheltered and helped him," or said a similar sentence
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ya Abul-Qasim ne kaha, "Agar Ansaar kisi waadi ya pahadi raaste se guzarte, main Ansaar ki waadi se guzarta. Aur agar hijrat na hoti, main Ansaar mein se ek hota." Abu Huraira kahte the, "Nabi na-insaafi nahi kar rahe the (yeh kahne mein). Mere maa-baap unke liye qurbaan hon, kyunke Ansaar ne unhe panah di aur unki madad ki," ya isi se milta-julta kuch kahte.

e: Narrated Sa`d's father:When the emigrants reached Medina. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) established the bond of fraternity between `Abdur-Rahman and Sa`d bin Ar-Rabi. Sa`d said to `Abdur-Rahman, "I am the richest of all the Ansar, so I want to divide my property (between us), and I have two wives, so see which of the two you like and tell me, so that I may divorce her, and when she finishes her prescribed period (i.e. 'Idda) of divorce, then marry her." `Abdur-Rahman said, "May Allah bless your family and property for you; where is your market?"
