So they showed him the Qainuqa' market. (He went there and) returned with a profit in the form of dried yogurt and butter. He continued going (to the market) till one day he came, bearing the traces of yellow scent. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "What is this (scent)?" He replied, "I got married." The Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "How much Mahr did you give her?" He replied, "I gave her a datestone of gold or a gold piece equal to the weight of a date-stone." (The narrator, Ibrahim, is in doubt as to which is correct)
hi: Sa'd ke waalid bataate hain: Jab hijrat karne wale (yaani Muhajir) Madina pahunche, Allah ke Rasool ne Abdur-Rahman aur Sa'd bin Ar-Rabi ke beech bhaeechaara ka bandhan banaya. Sa'd ne Abdur-Rahman se kaha, "Main sab Ansaar mein sabse ameer hoon, isliye main apni maal taqseem karna chahta hoon (humare beech), aur meri do biwiyaan hain, isliye dekho tumhe in donon mein se kaunsi pasand hai aur mujhe batao, taake main use talaq de dun, aur jab woh apni Iddat (yaani talaq ki muddat) poori kar le, phir usse shaadi kar lena." Abdur-Rahman ne kaha, "Allah tumhare pariwara aur maal ko barkat de; tumhara bazaar kahaan hai?" Isliye unhone use Qainuqa bazaar dikhaya. (Woh wahaan gaye aur) munafe ke saath wapas aaye, dahi aur ghi ke soorat mein. Woh (bazaar) jate rahe jab tak ek din woh peele rang ki khushbu ke asaraat ke saath aaye. Nabi ne pucha, "Yeh (khushbu) kya hai?" Unhone jawab diya, "Meri shaadi hui hai." Nabi ne pucha, "Tumne unhe kitna Mahr diya?" Unhone jawab diya, "Maine unhe sona ki ek khajoor ki gutli jitni maatra di ya khajoor ki gutli ke wazan jitna sona diya." (Raawi Ibrahim ko shak hai kaunsa sahi hai.)

e: Narrated Anas:When `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf came to us, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) made a bond of fraternity between him and Sa`d bin Ar-Rabi` who was a rich man, Sa`d said, "The Ansar know that I am the richest of all of them, so I will divide my property into two parts between me and you, and I have two wives; see which of the two you like so that I may divorce her and you can marry her after she becomes lawful to you by her passing the prescribed period (i.e. 'Idda) of divorce. `Abdur Rahman said, "May Allah bless you your family (i.e. wives) for you." (But `Abdur-Rahman went to the market) and did not return on that day except with some gain of dried yogurt and butter. He went on trading just a few days till he came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) bearing the traces of yellow scent over his clothes. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked him, "What is this scent?" He replied, "I have married a woman from the Ansar." Allah's Apostle asked, "How much Mahr have you given?" He said, "A date-stone weight of gold or a golden date-stone." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Arrange a marriage banquet even with a sheep
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Abdur-Rahman bin Auf humare paas aaye, Allah ke Rasool ne unke aur Sa'd bin Ar-Rabi, jo ek ameer shaks the, ke beech bhaeechaara ka bandhan banaya. Sa'd ne kaha, "Ansaar jaante hain ke main unmein sabse ameer hoon, isliye main apni maal ko donon mein baantunga, tumhare aur mere beech, aur meri do biwiyaan hain; dekho tumhe in donon mein se kaunsi pasand hai taake main use talaq de dun aur tum usse shaadi kar sako jab woh apni Iddat poori karke tumhare liye jaiz ho jaaye." Abdur-Rahman ne kaha, "Allah tumhe tumhare pariwara (yaani biwiyon) ke liye barkat de." (Magar Abdur-Rahman bazaar gaye) aur us din wapas nahi aaye siwaye kuch dahi aur ghi ke munafe ke saath. Woh kuch dinon tak vyaapaar karte rahe jab tak woh Allah ke Rasool ke paas peele rang ki khushbu ke asaraat apne kapdon par lekar aaye. Allah ke Rasool ne unse pucha, "Yeh khushbu kya hai?" Unhone jawab diya, "Maine Ansaar ki ek aurat se shaadi ki hai." Allah ke Rasool ne pucha, "Tumne kitna Mahr diya hai?" Unhone kaha, "Sona ki ek khajoor-gutli ke wazan ka sona ya sone ki khajoor-gutli." Nabi ne kaha, "Ek shaadi ki dawat do, chahe ek bhed se hi ho."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Ansar said (to the Prophet (ﷺ) ), "Please divide the date-palm trees between us and them (i.e. emigrants)." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No." The Ansar said, "Let them (i.e. the emigrants) do the labor for us in the gardens and share the date-fruits with us." The emigrants said, "We accepted this
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ansaar ne (Nabi se) kaha, "Kripya khajoor ke darakhton ko humare aur unke (yaani Muhajir ke) beech baant dijiye." Nabi ne kaha, "Nahi." Ansaar ne kaha, "Unhe (yaani Muhajir ko) humare liye baagon mein mehnat karne do aur khajoor ke phal humare saath baanten." Muhajir ne kaha, "Humne ise qubool kiya."

e: Narrated Al-Bara:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying (or the Prophet (ﷺ) said), "None loves the Ansar but a believer, and none hates them but a hypocrite. So Allah will love him who loves them, and He will hate him who hates them
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Maine Nabi ko kehte suna (ya Nabi ne kaha), "Sirf ek momin hi Ansaar se mohabbat karta hai, aur sirf ek munafik hi unse nafrat karta hai. Isliye Allah unse mohabbat karega jo unse mohabbat karta hai, aur Allah unse nafrat karega jo unse nafrat karta hai."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The sign of Belief is to love the Ansar, and the sign of hypocrisy is to hate the Ansar
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Iman ki nishaani Ansaar se mohabbat karna hai, aur munafiqat ki nishaani Ansaar se nafrat karna hai."

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) saw the women and children (of the Ansar) coming forward. (The sub-narrator said, "I think that Anas said, 'They were returning from a wedding party.") The Prophet (ﷺ) stood up and said thrice, "By Allah! You are from the most beloved people to me
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne (Ansaar ki) aurton aur bachchon ko (unki taraf) aate dekha. (Doosre raawi ne kaha, "Mujhe lagta hai Anas ne kaha, 'Woh ek shaadi ki dawat se wapas aa rahe the.'") Nabi khade hue aur teen baar kaha, "Allah ki qasam! Tum mere liye sabse pyare logon mein se ho."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Once an Ansari woman, accompanied by a son of hers, came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) spoke to her and said twice, "By Him in Whose Hand my life is, you are the most beloved people to me
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar ek Ansaari aurat, apne bete ke saath, Allah ke Rasool ke paas aee. Allah ke Rasool ne unse baat ki aur do baar kaha, "Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haathon mein meri zindagi hai, tum mere liye sabse pyare log ho."

e: Narrated Zaid bin Al-Arqam:The Ansar said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Every prophet has his own followers and we have followed you. So will you invoke Allah to let our followers be considered from us (as Ansar too)?" So he invoked Allah accordingly
hi: Zaid bin Al-Arqam bataate hain: Ansaar ne kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Har Nabi ke apne pairokaar hote hain, aur humne aapki pairvi ki hai. Isliye kya aap Allah se dua karenge ke humare pairokaar bhi humein se maane jaen (yaani Ansaar ki tarah)?" Isliye unhone aisi dua ki.

e: Narrated Abu Hamza:(A man from the Ansar) The Ansar said, "Every nation has followers and (O Prophet) we have followed you, so invoke Allah to let our followers be considered from us (as Ansar like ourselves)." So the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! Let their followers be considered as Ansar like themselves
hi: Abu Hamza bataate hain (ek Ansaari shaks): Ansaar ne kaha, "Har ummat ke apne pairokaar hote hain, aur (Aye Nabi) humne aapki pairvi ki hai, isliye Allah se dua kariye ke humare pairokaar bhi humein se maane jaen (yaani Ansaar ki tarah)." Isliye Nabi ne kaha, "Aye Allah! Unke pairokaar ko unke jaisa Ansaar maana jaaye."

e: Narrated Abu Usaid:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The best of the Ansar's families (homes) are those of Banu An-Najjar and then (those of) Banu `Abdul Ash-hal, then (those of) Banu Al-Harith bin Al-Khazraj and then (those of) Banu Sa`ida; nevertheless, there is good in all the families (houses) of the Ansar." On this, Sa`d (bin Ubada) said, "I see that the Prophet (ﷺ) has preferred some people to us." Somebody said (to him), "No, but he has given you superiority to many." (Hadith similar to above with a different chain)
hi: Abu Usaid bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Ansaar ke sabse behtar pariwara (gharon) Banu An-Najjar hain, phir Banu Abdul Ash-hal, phir Banu Al-Harith bin Al-Khazraj, phir Banu Sa'ida; magar phir bhi, Ansaar ke sab pariwaron mein achhaee hai." Isspar Sa'd (bin Ubada) ne kaha, "Mujhe lagta hai Nabi ne kuch logon ko humari tulna mein tarjih di hai." Kisi ne (unse) kaha, "Nahi, balki unhone aapko bahut se doosron par superiority di hai." (Isi tarah ki riwaayat ek doosri chain ke saath)

e: Narrated Abu Usaid:That he heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "The best of the Ansar, or the best of the Ansar families (homes) are Banu An-Najjar, Bani `Abdul Ash-hal, Banu Al-Harith and Banu Sai'da
hi: Abu Usaid bataate hain: Unhone Nabi ko kehte suna, "Ansaar mein sabse behtar, ya Ansaar ke pariwaron mein sabse behtar, Banu An-Najjar, Banu Abdul Ash-hal, Banu Al-Harith, aur Banu Sa'ida hain."

e: Narrated Abu Humaid:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The best of the Ansar families (homes) are the families (homes) of Banu An- Najjar, and then that of Banu `Abdul Ash-hal, and then that of Banu Al-Harith, and then that of Banu Saida; and there is good in all the families (homes) of the Ansar." Sa`d bin 'Ubada followed us and said, "O Abu Usaid ! Don't you see that the Prophet (ﷺ) compared the Ansar and made us the last of them in superiority? Then Sa`d met the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! In comparing the Ansar's families (homes) as to the degree of superiority, you have made us the last of them." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, "Isn't it sufficient that you are regarded amongst the best?
hi: Abu Humaid bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Ansaar ke sabse behtar pariwara Banu An-Najjar hain, phir Banu Abdul Ash-hal, phir Banu Al-Harith, phir Banu Sa'ida; magar Ansaar ke sab pariwaron mein achhaee hai." Sa'd bin Ubada (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne humari baat sun li aur kaha, "Aye Abu Usaid! Kya aap dekh nahi rahe ke Nabi ne Ansaar ki tulna ki aur humein unmein superiority ke maamle mein aakhri rakha?" Phir Sa'd Nabi se mile aur kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Ansaar ke pariwaron ki tulna superiority ke darje se karte huye, aapne humein sabse aakhri rakha." Allah ke Rasool ne jawab diya, "Kya yeh kaafi nahi ke tum sab mein behtareen samjhe jate ho?"

e: Narrated Usaid bin Hudair:A man from the Ansar said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Will you appoint me as you have appointed so-and-so?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "After me you will see others given preference to you; so be patient till you meet me at the Tank (i.e. Lake of Kauthar). (on the Day of Resurrection)
hi: Usaid bin Hudair bataate hain: Ek Ansaari shaks ne kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Kya aap mujhe bhi (kisi jagah ka) muqarrar karenge jaisa aapne falaan-falaan ko kiya?" Nabi ne kaha, "Mere baad tum dekhoge ke doosron ko tumse zyada tarjih di jaayegi; isliye sabr karo jab tak tum mujhse (Jannat mein) Al-Kauthar ke talab par mile." (yaani Qiyamat ke din)

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said to the Ansar, "After me you will see others given preference to you; so be patient till you meet me, and your promised place (of meeting) will be the Tank (i.e. Lake of Kauthar)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Ansaar se kaha, "Mere baad tum dekhoge ke doosron ko tumse zyada tarjih di jaayegi; isliye sabr karo jab tak tum mujhse milo, aur tumhari waada ki jagah Al-Kauthar ka talab hoga."

e: Narrated Yahya bin Sa`id:That he heard Anas bin Malik when he went with him to Al-Walid, saying, "Once the Prophet (ﷺ) called the Ansar in order to give them the territory of Bahrain they said, 'No, unless you give to our emigrant brethren a similar share.' On that he said 'If you do not agree to it, then be patient till you meet me, for after me others will be given preference to you
hi: Yahya bin Sa'id bataate hain: Unhone Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko, jab woh unke saath Al-Walid ke paas gaye the, yeh kehte suna: "Ek baar Nabi ne Ansaar ko bulaya taake unhe Bahrain ki zameen den. Unhone kaha, 'Nahi, jab tak aap humare Muhajir bhaiyon ko bhi utna hi hissa na den.' Isspar unhone kaha, 'Agar tum ispar raazi nahi hote, phir sabr karo jab tak tum mujhse milo, kyunke mere baad doosron ko tumse zyada tarjih di jaayegi.'"

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "There is no life except the life of the Hereafter; so, O Allah! Improve the state of the Ansar and the Muhajirun." And Anas added that the Prophet (ﷺ) also said, "O Allah! Forgive the Ansar
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Sirf Aakhirat ki zindagi hi asli zindagi hai; isliye, Aye Allah! Ansaar aur Muhajir ki haalat behtar kar de." Aur Anas ne joda ke Nabi ne yeh bhi kaha, "Aye Allah! Ansaar ko maaf kar."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:On the day of the battle of the Trench (i.e. Ghazwat-ul-Khandaq) the Ansar used to say, "We are those who have given the pledge of allegiance to Muhammad for Jihad (i.e. holy fighting) as long as we live." The Prophet (ﷺ) , replied to them, "O Allah! There is no life except the life of the Hereafter; so please honor the Ansar and the Emigrants
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Al-Khandaq (yaani khaee) ki jung ke din, Ansaar kahte the, "Hum woh log hain jinhone Muhammad ko Jihad ke liye bai'at di hai jab tak hum zinda hain." Nabi ne unse jawab diya, "Aye Allah! Sirf Aakhirat ki zindagi hi asli zindagi hai; isliye kripya Ansaar aur Muhajir ko izzat dijiye."

e: Narrated Sahl:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to us while we were digging the trench and carrying out the earth on our backs. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then said, "O Allah ! There is no life except the life of the Hereafter, so please forgive the Emigrants and the Ansar
hi: Sahl bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool humare paas aaye jabke hum khaee khodh rahe the aur mitti apni peeth par le ja rahe the. Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Aye Allah! Sirf Aakhirat ki zindagi hi asli zindagi hai, isliye kripya Muhajir aur Ansaar ko maaf kariye."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:A man came to the Prophet. The Prophet (ﷺ) sent a messenger to his wives (to bring something for that man to eat) but they said that they had nothing except water. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Who will take this (person) or entertain him as a guest?" An Ansar man said, "I." So he took him to his wife and said to her, "Entertain generously the guest of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) " She said, "We have got nothing except the meals of my children." He said, "Prepare your meal, light your lamp and let your children sleep if they ask for supper." So she prepared her meal, lighted her lamp and made her children sleep, and then stood up pretending to mend her lamp, but she put it off. Then both of them pretended to be eating, but they really went to bed hungry. In the morning the Ansari went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who said, "Tonight Allah laughed or wondered at your action." Then Allah revealed: "But give them (emigrants) preference over themselves even though they were in need of that And whosoever is saved from the covetousness Such are they who will be successful
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks Nabi ke paas aaya. Nabi ne apni biwiyon ke paas ek paigaam bheja (use khilane ke liye kuch lane ke liye), magar unhonne kaha unke paas paani ke ilawa kuch nahi hai. Isspar Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Kaun ise (yaani is shaks ko) le jaayega ya mehmaan banaega?" Ek Ansaar shaks ne kaha, "Main." Isliye woh use apni biwi ke paas le gaye aur unse kaha, "Allah ke Rasool ke mehmaan ki bahut achhi sewa karo." Unhone kaha, "Humare paas mere bachchon ke khaane ke ilawa kuch nahi hai." Unhone kaha, "Apna khaana taiyaar karo, apni diyaan jalao, aur apne bachchon ko sula do agar woh raat ka khaana maangte hain." Isliye unhone apna khaana taiyaar kiya, diya jalaee, aur apne bachchon ko sulaya, aur phir uthkar apni diya theek karne ka natak kiya magar use bujha diya. Phir donon khate hone ka natak karte rahe, magar asal mein woh bhookhe soye. Subah, Ansaari Allah ke Rasool ke paas gaya jinhone kaha, "Aaj raat Allah ne tumhare amal par muskuraya ya hairat hui." Phir Allah ne yeh nazil kiya: "Magar unhe (yaani Muhajir ko) khud se zyada tarjih do chahe unhe khud zaroorat ho, Aur jo koi apne lalach se bacha liya jata hai, wahi log kaamyaab honge." (59:9)

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Abu Bakr and Al-`Abbas passed by one of the gatherings of the Ansar who were weeping then. He (i.e. Abu Bakr or Al-`Abbas) asked, "Why are you weeping?" They replied, "We are weeping because we remember the gathering of the Prophet (ﷺ) with us." So Abu Bakr went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and told him of that. The Prophet (ﷺ) came out, tying his head with a piece of the hem of a sheet. He ascended the pulpit which he never ascended after that day. He glorified and praised Allah and then said, "I request you to take care of the Ansar as they are my near companions to whom I confided my private secrets. They have fulfilled their obligations and rights which were enjoined on them but there remains what is for them. So, accept the good of the good-doers amongst them and excuse the wrongdoers amongst them
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Bakr aur Al-Abbas Ansaar ki ek majlis se guzre jahaan woh us waqt ro rahe the. Unhone (yaani Abu Bakr ya Al-Abbas ne) pucha, "Tum kyun ro rahe ho?" Unhone jawab diya, "Hum isliye ro rahe hain kyunke humein Nabi ki humare saath majlis yaad aee." Isliye Abu Bakr Nabi ke paas gaye aur unhe yeh bataya. Nabi bahar aaye, apna sar ek chaadar ke kinare se baandhte hue. Woh mimbar par chadhe jispar woh us din ke baad kabhi nahi chadhe. Unhone Allah ki hamd aur uski taarif ki aur phir kaha, "Main tumse Ansaar ka khyaal rakhne ki guzarish karta hoon, kyunke woh mere qareebi sathi hain jinhe maine apne khaas raaz batae. Unhone apni zimmedaariyaan aur haqq poore kiye jo unpar farz kiye gaye the, magar abhi bhi kuch unke liye baaki hai. Isliye, unmein se neik logon ki achhaee qubool karo, aur unke galat amal walon ko maaf karo."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (in his fatal illness) came out wrapped in a sheet covering his shoulders and his head was tied with an oily tape of cloth till he sat on the pulpit, and after praising and glorifying Allah, he said, "Then-after, O people! The people will go on increasing, but the Ansar will go on decreasing till they become just like salt in a meal. So whoever amongst you will be the ruler and has the power to harm or benefit others, should accept the good of the good-doers amongst them and excuse the wrongdoers amongst them
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (apni aakhri bimari mein) ek chaadar mein lipete hue bahar aaye, apne kandhon ko dhaankte huye, aur unka sar ek tel lagi patti se baandha hua tha, jab tak woh mimbar par baithe. Allah ki hamd aur uski taarif karke, unhone kaha, "Iske baad, Aye logo! Log badhte rahenge, magar Ansaar kam hote jaenge jab tak woh khaane mein namak jaise ban jaen. Isliye tum mein se koi bhi jo hukmaran bane aur logon ko faayda ya nuksaan pahunchane ki taakat rakhe, use unke neik logon ki achhaee qubool karni chahiye aur unke galat amal walon ko maaf karna chahiye."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The Ansar are my near companions to whom I confided my private secrets, People will go on increasing but the Ansar will go on decreasing; so accept the good of the good-doers amongst them and excuse the wrong-doers amongst them
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Ansaar mere qareebi sathi hain jinhe maine apne khaas raaz batae. Log badhte rahenge magar Ansaar kam hote jaenge; isliye unmein se neik logon ki achhaee qubool karo aur unke galat amal walon ko maaf karo."

e: Narrated Al-Bara:A silken cloth was given as a present to the Prophet (ﷺ) . His companions started touching it and admiring its softness. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Are you admiring its softness? The handkerchiefs of Sa`d bin Mu`adh (in Paradise) are better and softer than it
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Nabi ko ek resham ka kapda tohfe mein diya gaya. Unke sahaba use chhune lage aur uski narmi ki taarif karne lage. Nabi ne kaha, "Kya tum iski narmi ki taarif kar rahe ho? Sa'd bin Mu'adh ke rumaal (Jannat mein) isse behtar aur narm hain."

e: Narrated Jabir:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "The Throne (of Allah) shook at the death of Sa`d bin Mu`adh." Through another group of narrators, Jabir added, "I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) : saying, 'The Throne of the Beneficent shook because of the death of Sa`d bin Mu`adh
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi ko kehte suna, "Allah ka Arsh hila Sa'd bin Mu'adh ki maut par." Ek doosri riwaayat mein, Jabir ne joda, "Maine Nabi ko kehte suna: 'Sarvashaktimaan ka Arsh Sa'd bin Mu'adh ki maut ki wajah se hila.'"

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Some people (i.e. the Jews of Bani Quraiza) agreed to accept the verdict of Sa`d bin Mu`adh so the Prophet (ﷺ) sent for him (i.e. Sa`d bin Mu`adh). He came riding a donkey, and when he approached the Mosque, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Get up for the best amongst you." or said, "Get up for your chief." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Sa`d! These people have agreed to accept your verdict." Sa`d said, "I judge that their warriors should be killed and their children and women should be taken as captives." The Prophet said, "You have given a judgment similar to Allah's Judgment (or the King's judgment)
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Kuch log (yaani Bani Quraiza ke Yahudi) Sa'd bin Mu'adh ka faisla qubool karne ke liye raazi hue, isliye Nabi ne unke (yaani Sa'd ke) liye bheja. Woh ek gadhe par sawar hokar aaye, aur jab woh masjid ke qareeb pahunche, Nabi ne kaha, "Apne sabse behtareen shaks ke liye khade ho jaao," ya "Apne sardaar ke liye khade ho jaao." Phir Nabi ne kaha, "Aye Sa'd! In logon ne aapkaa faisla qubool karne ki sahmati di hai." Sa'd ne kaha, "Main faisla deta hoon ke unke mujahidon ko qatl kiya jaaye aur unke bachchon aur aurton ko qaidi banaya jaaye." Nabi ne kaha, "Tumne Allah ke faisle (ya Baadshaah ke faisle) jaisa hi faisla diya hai."

e: Narrated Anas:Two men left the Prophet (ﷺ) on a very dark night. Suddenly a light came in front of them, and when they separated, the light also separated along with them
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Do log Nabi ke paas se ek bahut andheri raat mein nikle. Achanak unke saamne ek roshni aee, aur jab woh alag hue, roshni bhi unke saath alag ho gaee.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Learn the recitation of Qur'an from four persons: Ibn Mas`ud, Salim, the freed slave of Abu Hudhaifa, Ubai and Mu`adh bin Jabal
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi ko kehte suna, "Quran chaar logon se sikho: Ibn Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ), Salim (Abu Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke azaad kiye gulaam), Ubai, aur Mu'adh bin Jabal (رضی اللہ عنہ)."

e: Narrated Abu Usaid:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The best of the Ansar's houses are those of Bani An-Najjar, then those of Bani `Abdul Ash-hal, then those of Bani Al-Harith bin Al-Khazraj, then those of Bani Saida; but there is goodness in all the houses of the Ansar." Sa`d bin Ubada who was one of those who embraced Islam early, said, "I see that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) is giving others superiority above us." Some people said to him, "But he has given you superiority above many other people
hi: Abu Usaid bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Ansaar ke sabse behtar ghar Banu An-Najjar ke hain, phir Banu Abdul Ash-hal ke, phir Banu Al-Harith bin Al-Khazraj ke, phir Banu Sa'ida ke; magar Ansaar ke sab gharon mein achhaee hai." Sa'd bin Ubada (رضی اللہ عنہ), jo un logon mein se the jinhone shuru mein Islam qubool kiya tha, ne kaha, "Mujhe lagta hai Allah ke Rasool doosron ko humare oopar superiority de rahe hain." Kisi ne unse kaha, "Magar unhone aapko bahut se doosron par superiority di hai."

e: Narrated Masruq:`Abdullah bin Masud was mentioned before `Abdullah bin `Amr who said, "That is a man I still love, as I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying 'Learn the recitation of Qur'an from four from `Abdullah bin Mas`ud -- he started with him--Salim, the freed slave of Abu Hudaifa, Mu`adh bin Jabal and Ubai bin Ka`b
hi: Masruq bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) ka zikar Abdullah bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saamne hua jinhone kaha, "Yeh woh shaks hai jinse main abhi bhi mohabbat karta hoon, kyunke maine Allah ke Rasool ko kehte suna, 'Quran chaar logon se sikho, Abdullah bin Mas'ud se — unhone unke naam se shuruaat ki — Salim, Abu Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke azaad kiye gulaam, Mu'adh bin Jabal (رضی اللہ عنہ), aur Ubai bin Ka'b (رضی اللہ عنہ).'"

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said to Ubai, "Allah has ordered me to recite to you: 'Those who disbelieve (Surat-al- Bayina 98).' " Ubai said, "Has He mentioned my name?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Yes." On hearing this, Ubai started weeping
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Ubai se kaha, "Allah ne mujhe hukum diya hai ke main tumhe padhkar sunaun: 'Woh log jinhone kufr kiya (Surah Al-Bayina, 98).'" Ubai ne pucha, "Kya usne mera naam liya hai?" Nabi ne kaha, "Haan." Yeh sunkar, Ubai rone lage.

e: Narrated Qatada:Anas said, "The Qur'an was collected in the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) by four (men), all of whom were from the Ansar: Ubai, Mu`adh bin Jabal, Abu Zaid and Zaid bin Thabit." I asked Anas, "Who is Abu Zaid?" He said, "One of my uncles
hi: Qatada bataate hain: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Quran Nabi ki zindagi mein chaar logon dwaara jama kiya gaya tha, sab Ansaar se: Ubai, Mu'adh bin Jabal (رضی اللہ عنہ), Abu Zaid, aur Zaid bin Thabit (رضی اللہ عنہ)." Maine Anas se pucha, "Abu Zaid kaun hain?" Unhone kaha, "Mere ek chacha."

e: Narrated Anas:On the day of the battle of Uhud, the people ran away, leaving the Prophet (ﷺ) , but Abu- Talha was shielding the Prophet (ﷺ) with his shield in front of him. Abu Talha was a strong, experienced archer who used to keep his arrow bow strong and well stretched. On that day he broke two or three arrow bows. If any man passed by carrying a quiver full of arrows, the Prophet (ﷺ) would say to him, "Empty it in front of Abu Talha." When the Prophet (ﷺ) started looking at the enemy by raising his head, Abu Talha said, "O Allah's Prophet! Let my parents be sacrificed for your sake! Please don't raise your head and make it visible, lest an arrow of the enemy should hit you. Let my neck and chest be wounded instead of yours." (On that day) I saw `Aisha, the daughter of Abu Bakr and Um Sulaim both lifting their dresses up so that I was able to see the ornaments of their legs, and they were carrying the water skins on their arms to pour the water into the mouths of the thirsty people and then go back and fill them and come to pour the water into the mouths of the people again. (On that day) Abu Talha's sword fell from his hand twice or thrice
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Uhud ki jung ke din, log Nabi ko chhodkar bhaag gaye, magar Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) Nabi ki hifaazat kar rahe the apni dhaal se, unke aage khade hokar. Abu Talha ek takatvaar, anubhavi tirandaaz the jo apna dhanush mazboot aur poori tarah khincha rakhte the. Us din unhone do ya teen dhanush tode. Agar koi shaks teeron se bhara koila lekar guzarta, Nabi kahte, "Ise Abu Talha ke saamne khali karo." Jab Nabi apna sar uthakar dushman ki taraf dekhte, Abu Talha kahte, "Ya Allah ke Nabi! Mere maa-baap aapke liye qurbaan hon! Kripya apna sar mat uthaiye aur use saaf dikhne mat dijiye, kahin dushman ka koi teer aapko na lage. Mera gala aur seena aapke badle zakhmi ho jaaye." (Us din) maine Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا), Abu Bakr ki beti, aur Um Sulaim ko dekha, donon apne kapde oopar uthate huye, taake main unki taangon ke gehne dekh sakon, aur woh donon apni baanhon par paani ki mashken ladkar pyase logon ke munhon mein paani daalte, phir wapas jate aur unhe bharkar phir logon ke munhon mein paani daalte. (Us din) Abu Talha ki talwaar unke haath se do ya teen baar gir gaee.

e: Narrated Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas:I have never heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying about anybody walking on the earth that he is from the people of Paradise except `Abdullah bin Salam. The following Verse was revealed concerning him: "And a witness from the children of Israel testifies that this Qur'an is true
hi: Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine kabhi Nabi ko zameen par chalne wale kisi shaks ke baare mein yeh kahte nahi suna ke woh Jannat walon mein se hai siwaye Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Salam (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke. Unke baare mein yeh Ayat nazil hui: "Aur Bani Israel mein se ek gawaah gawahi deta hai ke yeh Quran sach hai."

e: Narrated Qais bin Ubad:While I was sitting in the Mosque of Medina, there entered a man (Abdullah bin Salam) with signs of solemnity over his face. The people said, "He is one of the people of Paradise." He prayed two light rak`at and then left. I followed him and said, "When you entered the Mosque, the people said, 'He is one of the people of Paradise.' " He said, "By Allah, one ought not say what he does not know; and I will tell you why. In the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) I had a dream which I narrated to him. I saw as if I were in a garden." He then described its extension and greenery. He added: In its center there was an iron pillar whose lower end was fixed in the earth and the upper end was in the sky, and at its upper end there was a (ring-shaped) hand-hold. I was told to climb it. I said, "I can't." "Then a servant came to me and lifted my clothes from behind and I climbed till I reached the top (of the pillar). Then I got hold of the hand-hold, and I was told to hold it tightly, then I woke up and (the effect of) the handhold was in my hand. I narrated all that to the Prophet (ﷺ) who said, 'The garden is Islam, and the handhold is the Most Truth-worthy Hand-Hold. So you will remain as a Muslim till you die." The narrator added: "The man was `Abdullah bin Salam
hi: Qais bin Ubad bataate hain: Jabke main Madina ki masjid mein baitha tha, ek shaks (Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Salam (رضی اللہ عنہ)) aaya jinke chehre par sanjidgi ke asaraat the. Logon ne kaha, "Woh Jannat walon mein se hain." Unhone do halki rakaten padhi aur phir chale gaye. Main unke peeche gaya aur kaha, "Jab aap masjid mein daakhil hue, logon ne kaha, 'Woh Jannat walon mein se hain.'" Unhone kaha, "Allah ki qasam, kisi ko woh nahi kehna chahiye jo use pata nahi; aur main tumhe bataunga kyun. Nabi ki zindagi mein maine ek khwab dekha jise maine unhe sunaya. Maine khud ko ek baag mein dekha." Phir unhone uski vistriti aur hariyali ka varnan kiya. Unhone joda: Uske beech mein lohe ka ek khamba tha, jiska neeche wala hissa zameen mein gada hua tha aur oopar wala hissa aasman mein tha, aur uske oopar wale sire par ek (choodi jaisa) haath pakadne wala kunda tha. Mujhe uspar chadhne ko kaha gaya. Maine kaha, "Main nahi kar sakta." Phir ek naukar mere paas aaya aur mere kapde peeche se uthaye aur main chadha jab tak main khambe ke shikher tak pahuncha. Phir maine woh haath-pakadne wala hissa pakada, aur mujhe kaha gaya use mazbooti se pakadne ko, phir main jaag gaya aur (woh haath-pakadne wala hissa) mere haath mein tha. Maine yeh sab Nabi ko sunaya jinhone kaha, "Baag Islam hai, aur haath-pakadne wala hissa Sabse Bharosemand Sahaara hai. Isliye tum Musalman rahoge apni maut tak." Raawi ne joda: "Woh shaks Abdullah bin Salam the."

e: Narrated Abu Burda:When I came to Medina. I met `Abdullah bin Salam. He said, "Will you come to me so that I may serve you with Sawiq (i.e. powdered barley) and dates, and let you enter a (blessed) house that in which the Prophet (ﷺ) entered?" Then he added, "You are In a country where the practice of Riba (i.e. usury) is prevalent; so if somebody owes you something and he sends you a present of a load of chopped straw or a load of barley or a load of provender then do not take it, as it is Riba
hi: Abu Burda bataate hain: Jab main Madina aaya, main Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Salam (رضی اللہ عنہ) se mila. Unhone kaha, "Kya aap mere ghar aayenge taake main aapko Sawiq (yaani pise hue jau) aur khajooren khila sakun, aur aapko us ghar mein daakhil hone dun jismein Nabi daakhil hue the?" Phir unhone joda, "Aap ek aise desh mein hain jahaan Riba (yaani sood) phaila hua hai; isliye agar koi aapka qarzdaar hai aur woh aapko tohfe ke tor par bhoosa, jau, ya chaara ka ek bojh bhejta hai, to use mat lena, kyunke yeh Riba hai."

e: Narrated `Ali:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying (as below) Narrated `Ali: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The best of the world's women is Mary (at her lifetime), and the best of the world's women is Khadija (at her lifetime)
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool ko kehte suna: Nabi ne kaha, "Duniya ki sabse behtar aurat Maryam thi (apni zindagi mein), aur duniya ki sabse behtar aurat Khadija (رضی اللہ عنہا) thi (apni zindagi mein)."

e: Narrated `Aisha:I did not feel jealous of any of the wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) as much as I did of Khadija (although) she died before he married me, for I often heard him mentioning her, and Allah had told him to give her the good tidings that she would have a palace of Qasab (i.e. pipes of precious stones and pearls in Paradise), and whenever he slaughtered a sheep, he would send her women-friends a good share of it
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine Nabi ki kisi doosri biwi se itni eershya (jalan) mahsoos nahi ki jitni Khadija (رضی اللہ عنہا) se ki, chahe unka intiqal ho chuka tha isse pahle ke unse meri shaadi hui, kyunke main aksar unhe Khadija ka zikar karte hue sunti thi, aur Allah ne unse kaha tha ke unhe khushkhabri den ke unke liye Jannat mein Qasab (yaani kimati pattharon aur motiyon se bane pipe jaisa) ka ek mahal hai, aur jab bhi woh ek bhed zabah karte, woh Khadija ki saheliyon ko uska ek achha hissa bhejte.

e: Narrated `Aisha:I did not feel jealous of any woman as much as I did of Khadija because Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to mention her very often. He married me after three years of her death, and his Lord (or Gabriel) ordered him to give her the good news of having a palace of Qasab in Paradise
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine kisi doosri aurat se itni eershya mahsoos nahi ki jitni Khadija (رضی اللہ عنہا) se, kyunke Allah ke Rasool unka zikar bahut baar karte the. Unhone mujhse unki maut ke teen saal baad shaadi ki, aur unke Rab (ya Jibreel) ne unhe hukum diya ke woh unhe Jannat mein Qasab ka mahal milne ki khushkhabri den.

e: Narrated `Aisha:I did not feel jealous of any of the wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) as much as I did of Khadija though I did not see her, but the Prophet (ﷺ) used to mention her very often, and when ever he slaughtered a sheep, he would cut its parts and send them to the women friends of Khadija. When I sometimes said to him, "(You treat Khadija in such a way) as if there is no woman on earth except Khadija," he would say, "Khadija was such-and-such, and from her I had children
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine Nabi ki kisi doosri biwi se itni eershya mahsoos nahi ki jitni Khadija (رضی اللہ عنہا) se, chahe maine unhe kabhi nahi dekha, magar Nabi unka zikar bahut baar karte the, aur jab bhi woh ek bhed zabah karte, woh uske tukde karke Khadija ki saheliyon ko bhejte. Jab kabhi maine unse kaha, "(Aap Khadija ke saath aisa suluk karte hain) mano zameen par Khadija ke siwa koi aurat nahi," woh kahte, "Khadija aisi-aisi thi, aur unse mere bachche hue."

e: Narrated Isma`il:I asked `Abdullah bin Abi `Aufa, "Did the Prophet (ﷺ) give glad tidings to Khadija?" He said, "Yes, of a palace of Qasab (in Paradise) where there will be neither any noise nor any fatigue
hi: Ismail bataate hain: Maine Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Aufa se pucha, "Kya Nabi ne Khadija (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko khushkhabri di thi?" Unhone kaha, "Haan, ek Qasab mahal ki (Jannat mein) jahaan na koi shor hoga na koi thakan."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira: Gabriel came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! This is Khadija coming to you with a dish having meat soup (or some food or drink). When she reaches you, greet her on behalf of her Lord (i.e. Allah) and on my behalf, and give her the glad tidings of having a Qasab palace in Paradise wherein there will be neither any noise nor any fatigue (trouble)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jibreel Nabi ke paas aaye aur kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Yeh Khadija (رضی اللہ عنہا) hain, aapke paas ek bartan lekar aate hue jismein gosht ka shorba (ya kuch khaana ya pine ki cheez) hai. Jab woh aaptak pahunche, unhe unke Rab (yaani Allah) ki taraf se aur mere taraf se salaam kariye, aur unhe Jannat mein ek Qasab mahal milne ki khushkhabri dijiye jahaan na shor hoga na koi thakan (museebat)."

e: Narrated 'Aisha:Once Hala bint Khuwailid, Khadija's sister, asked the permission of the Prophet (ﷺ) to enter. On that, the Prophet (ﷺ) remembered the way Khadija used to ask permission, and that upset him. He said, "O Allah! Hala!" So I became jealous and said, "What makes you remember an old woman amongst the old women of Quraish an old woman (with a teethless mouth) of red gums who died long ago, and in whose place Allah has given you somebody better than her?
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ek baar Hala bint Khuwailid, Khadija (رضی اللہ عنہا) ki behn, ne Nabi se milne ki ijazat maangi. Isspar Nabi ko Khadija ke ijazat maangne ka andaaz yaad aaya, aur yeh unhe dukhi kiya. Unhone kaha, "Aye Allah! Hala!" Isliye mujhe eershya hui aur maine kaha, "Aapko kya yaad dilata hai ek budhi aurat ko Quraish ki budhi aurton mein se, ek budhi aurat (jiske daanton wale munh mein) laal masoode hain, jo bahut pahle mar chuki hai, aur jiski jagah Allah ne aapko unse behtar koi diya hai?"

e: Narrated Jarir bin 'Abdullah: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has never refused to admit me since I embraced Islam, and whenever he saw me, he would smile
hi: Jarir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kabhi mujhe andar aane se mana nahi kiya jab se maine Islam qubool kiya, aur jab bhi unhone mujhe dekha, woh muskurate.

e: Jarir bin 'Abdullah narrated:There was a house called Dhul-Khalasa in the Pre-Islamic Period and it was also called Al-Ka'ba Al-Yamaniya or Al-Ka'ba Ash-Shamiya. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me, "Will you relieve me from Dhul-Khalasa?" So I left for it with 150 cavalrymen from the tribe of Ahmas and then we destroyed it and killed whoever we found there. Then we came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and informed him about it. He invoked good upon us and upon the tribe of Ahmas
hi: Jarir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jahiliyat ke daur mein ek ghar Dhul-Khalasa naam ka tha, aur use Al-Ka'ba Al-Yamaniya ya Al-Ka'ba Ash-Shamiya bhi kaha jata tha. Allah ke Rasool ne mujhse kaha, "Kya tum mujhe Dhul-Khalasa se aaram doge?" Isliye main Ahmas qabile ke dedh sau ghudsawaar logon ke saath wahaan gaya aur humne use toda aur jo bhi wahaan mila use qatl kiya. Phir hum Nabi ke paas wapas aaye aur unhe iski khabar di. Unhone humare aur Ahmas qabile ke logon ke liye achhi dua ki.

e: Narrated `Aisha:On the day of the battle of Uhud the pagans were defeated completely. Then Satan shouted loudly, "O Allah's slaves! Beware the ones behind you!" So the front files attacked the back ones. Then Hudhaifa looked and saw his father, and said loudly, "O Allah's slaves! My father! My father!" By Allah, they did not stop till they killed him (i.e. Hudaifa's father). Hudhaifa said, "May Allah forgive you!" The sub-narrator said, "By Allah, because of what Hudhaifa said, he remained in a good state till he met Allah (i.e. died)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Uhud ki jung ke din, kaafir poori tarah haar gaye. Phir Shaitan zor se chilla, "Aye Allah ke bando! Apni peeth ke pichhe fauj se saavdhaan raho!" Isliye agli safon ne pichhli safon par hamla kiya. Phir Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne mudkar apne waalid ko dekha aur zor se chilla, "Aye Allah ke bando! Mere waalid! Mere waalid!" Allah ki qasam, woh tab tak nahi ruke jab tak unhonne unhe (yaani Hudhaifa ke waalid ko) qatl na kar diya. Hudhaifa ne kaha, "Allah tumhe maaf kare!" Raawi ne joda, "Allah ki qasam, jo kuch Hudhaifa ne kaha uski wajah se, woh apni maut tak ek achhi haalat mein rahe (yaani Allah se milne tak)."

e: Narrated 'Aishah (ra):Hind bint 'Utba came and said, "O Allah's Messenger! (Before I embraced Islam) there was no family on the surface of the earth I wished to see in degradation more than I did your family, but today there is no family on the surface of the earth I wish to see honored more than I did yours." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I thought similarly, by Him in whose Hand my soul is!" She further said, "O Allah's Messenger ! Abu Sufyan is a miser, so, is it sinful of me to feed my children from his property ?" He said, "I do not allow it unless you take for your needs what is just and reasonable
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Hind bint Utba aee aur kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! (Islam qubool karne se pahle) zameen par koi bhi pariwara aisa nahi tha jinki apmaan hote dekhna main utna chahti jitna aapke pariwara ki chahti thi, magar aaj zameen par koi bhi pariwara aisa nahi jiski izzat hote dekhna main utna chahti jitna aapke pariwara ki chahti hoon." Nabi ne kaha, "Usi Zaat ki qasam jiske haathon mein meri jaan hai, mera bhi yehi khyaal tha!" Unhone aage kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ) ek kanjoos shaks hai, isliye kya mujhe gunah hoga agar main unka maal se apne bachchon ko khilaun?" Unhone kaha, "Main iski ijazat nahi deta siwaye iske ke tum apni zaroorton ke liye jaayaz aur munasib maatra le sako."

e: Narrated 'Abdullah bin 'Umar: The Prophet (ﷺ) met Zaid bin 'Amr bin Nufail in the bottom of (the valley of) Baldah before any Divine Inspiration came to the Prophet. A meal was presented to the Prophet (ﷺ) but he refused to eat from it. (Then it was presented to Zaid) who said, "I do not eat anything which you slaughter in the name of your stone idols. I eat none but those things on which Allah's Name has been mentioned at the time of slaughtering." Zaid bin 'Amr used to criticize the way Quraish used to slaughter their animals, and used to say, "Allah has created the sheep and He has sent the water for it from the sky, and He has grown the grass for it from the earth; yet you slaughter it in other than the Name of Allah. He used to say so, for he rejected that practice and considered it as something abominable
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi Zaid bin Amr bin Nufail se ek waadi ke naichle hisse mein mile isse pahle ke unpar Divine ilham naazil hua. Ek khaana Nabi ke saamne pesh kiya gaya magar unhone use khane se inkaar kiya. (Phir woh Zaid ke saamne pesh kiya gaya) jinhonne kaha, "Main koi bhi cheez nahi khata jise tum apne partharon ke buton ke naam par zabah karte ho. Main sirf woh cheez khata hoon jispar zabah karte waqt Allah ka naam liya gaya ho." Zaid bin Amr Quraish ke zabah karne ke tarike ki alochna karte the aur kahte, "Allah ne bhed banaee aur uske liye aasman se paani bheja, aur zameen se ghaas ugaee; phir bhi tum use Allah ke naam ke ilawa kisi doosre naam se zabah karte ho." Woh aisa isliye kahte the kyunke woh us riwaj ko radd karte the aur use ghinaaavna samajhte the.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar:Zaid bin 'Amr bin Nufail went to Sham, inquiring about a true religion to follow. He met a Jewish religious scholar and asked him about their religion. He said, "I intend to embrace your religion, so tell me something about it." The Jew said, "You will not embrace our religion unless you receive your share of Allah's Anger." Zaid said, "'I do not run except from Allah's Anger, and I will never bear a bit of it if I have the power to avoid it. Can you tell me of some other religion?" He said, "I do not know any other religion except the Hanif." Zaid enquired, "What is Hanif?" He said, "Hanif is the religion of (the prophet) Abraham who was neither a Jew nor a Christian, and he used to worship None but Allah (Alone)" Then Zaid went out and met a Christian religious scholar and told him the same as before. The Christian said, "You will not embrace our religion unless you get a share of Allah's Curse." Zaid replied, "I do not run except from Allah's Curse, and I will never bear any of Allah's Curse and His Anger if I have the power to avoid them. Will you tell me of some other religion?" He replied, "I do not know any other religion except Hanif." Zaid enquired, "What is Hanif?" He replied, Hanif is the religion of (the prophet) Abraham who was neither a Jew nor a Christian and he used to worship None but Allah (Alone)" When Zaid heard their Statement about (the religion of) Abraham, he left that place, and when he came out, he raised both his hands and said, "O Allah! I make You my Witness that I am on the religion of Abraham
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Zaid bin Amr bin Nufail Sham gaye, ek sachche deen ke baare mein poochte hue jiski woh pairvi kar saken. Unki mulaqaat ek Yahudi deeni ilm waala se hui aur unse unke deen ke baare mein pucha. Unhone kaha, "Main tumhara deen apnana chahta hoon, isliye mujhe iske baare mein kuch bataiye." Yahudi ne kaha, "Tum humara deen tab tak nahi apna sakte jab tak tum Allah ke gusse ka hissa na le lo." Zaid ne kaha, "Main sirf Allah ke gusse se hi bhaagta hoon, aur main kabhi uska ek ansh bhi nahi bardaasht karunga agar main ise taalne ki taakat rakhta hoon. Kya aap mujhe kisi aur deen ke baare mein bata sakte hain?" Unhone kaha, "Main Hanif ke ilawa koi doosra deen nahi jaanta." Zaid ne pucha, "Hanif kya hai?" Unhone kaha, "Hanif Ibrahim ka deen hai, jo na Yahudi the na Isaee, aur woh sirf Allah (akele) ki ibadat karte the." Phir Zaid nikle aur ek Isaee deeni ilm waala se mile aur unse wahi bataya jo pahle kaha tha. Isaee ne kaha, "Tum humara deen tab tak nahi apna sakte jab tak tum Allah ki laanat ka hissa na le lo." Zaid ne jawab diya, "Main sirf Allah ki laanat se bhaagta hoon, aur main kabhi Allah ki laanat aur uske gusse ka koi hissa bardaasht nahi karunga agar main ise taalne ki taakat rakhta hoon. Kya aap mujhe kisi aur deen ke baare mein bataenge?" Unhone jawab diya, "Main Hanif ke ilawa koi doosra deen nahi jaanta." Zaid ne pucha, "Hanif kya hai?" Unhone jawab diya, "Hanif Ibrahim ka deen hai, jo na Yahudi the na Isaee aur sirf Allah (akele) ki ibadat karte the." Jab Zaid ne unke (Ibrahim ke deen ke baare mein) bayaan suna, woh wahaan se chale gaye, aur jab woh bahar aaye, unhone apne donon haath uthaye aur kaha, "Aye Allah! Main tujhe gawaah banata hoon ke main Ibrahim ke deen par hoon."

e: Narrated Asma bint Abi Bakr:I saw Zaid bin Amr bin Nufail standing with his back against the Ka'ba and saying, "O people of Quraish! By Allah, none amongst you is on the religion of Abraham except me." He used to preserve the lives of little girls: If somebody wanted to kill his daughter he would say to him, "Do not kill her for I will feed her on your behalf." So he would take her, and when she grew up nicely, he would say to her father, "Now if you want her, I will give her to you, and if you wish, I will feed her on your behalf
hi: Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Abi Bakr (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine Zaid bin Amr bin Nufail ko Ka'ba ki peeth ke bagal khade dekha, aur woh kah rahe the, "Aye Quraish ke logo! Allah ki qasam, tum mein se koi bhi Ibrahim ke deen par nahi hai siwaye mere." Woh chhoti ladkiyon ki jaan bachane ka kaam karte the: Agar koi apni beti ko qatl karna chahta, woh usse kahte, "Ise mat maarao, kyunke main tumhare badle use khilaunga." Isliye woh use le lete, aur jab woh achhi tarah badi ho jaati, woh uske baap se kahte, "Ab agar tum use chaahte ho, main use tumhe deta hoon, aur agar tum chaho, main tumhare badle use khilata rahunga."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:When the Ka`ba was rebuilt, the Prophet (ﷺ) and `Abbas went to carry stones. `Abbas said to the Prophet (ﷺ) "(Take off and) put your waist sheet over your neck so that the stones may not hurt you." (But as soon as he took off his waist sheet) he fell unconscious on the ground with both his eyes towards the sky. When he came to his senses, he said, "My waist sheet! My waist sheet!" Then he tied his waist sheet (round his waist)
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Ka'ba dobara banaee ja rahi thi, Nabi aur Al-Abbas patthar lane gaye. Al-Abbas ne Nabi se kaha, "(Utariye aur) apna kamar bandh apne gale ke gird lapet lijiye taake pattharon se aapko chot na lage." (Magar jaise hi unhone apna kamar bandh utaara) woh behosh hokar zameen par gir gaye, unki donon aankhen aasman ki taraf. Jab hosh mein aaye, unhone kaha, "Mera kamar bandh! Mera kamar bandh!" Phir unhone apna kamar bandh (apni kamar ke gird) baandha.

e: Narrated `Amr bin Dinar and 'Ubaidullah bin Abi Yazid:In the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) there was no wall around the Ka`ba and the people used to pray around the Ka`ba till `Umar became the Caliph and he built the wall around it. 'Ubaidullah further said, "Its wall was low, so Ibn Az-Zubair built it
hi: Amr bin Dinar aur Ubaidullah bin Abi Yazid bataate hain: Nabi ki zindagi mein Ka'ba ke chaaron taraf koi deewaar nahi thi, aur log Ka'ba ke chaaron taraf namaz padhte the jab tak Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) Khalifa bane aur unhonne uske chaaron taraf deewaar banaee. Ubaidullah ne aage kaha, "Uski deewaar neechi thi, isliye Ibn Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne ise (aur ooncha) banaya."

e: Narrated `Aisha:'Ashura' (i.e. the tenth of Muharram) was a day on which the tribe of Quraish used to fast in the pre-Islamic period of ignorance. The Prophet (ﷺ) also used to fast on this day. So when he migrated to Medina, he fasted on it and ordered (the Muslims) to fast on it. When the fasting of Ramadan was enjoined, it became optional for the people to fast or not to fast on the day of Ashura
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ashura (yaani Muharram ki daswin taarikh) ek din tha jispar Quraish qabile ke log jahiliyat ke daur mein roza rakhte the. Nabi bhi is din roza rakhte the. Isliye jab woh Madina hijrat kar aaye, unhone is din roza rakha aur (Musalmanon ko) is din roza rakhne ka hukum diya. Jab Ramadan ke roze farz kiye gaye, Ashura ke din roza rakhna ya na rakhna logon ki marzi par chhod diya gaya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The people used to consider the performance of `Umra in the months of Hajj an evil deed on the earth, and they used to call the month of Muharram as Safar and used to say, "When (the wounds over) the backs (of the camels) have healed and the foot-marks (of the camels) have vanished (after coming from Hajj), then `Umra becomes legal for the one who wants to perform `Umra." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and his companions reached Mecca assuming Ihram for Hajj on the fourth of Dhul-Hijja. The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered his companions to perform `Umra (with that Ihram instead of Hajj). They asked, "O Allah's Apostle! What kind of finishing of Ihram?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Finish the Ihram completely
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Log Hajj ke mahinon mein Umrah karne ko ek bura kaam samajhte the, aur woh Muharram mahine ko Safar bulaate the aur kahte, "Jab unton ki (safar se hui) chots theek ho jaen aur unke paanv ke nishaan (Hajj se lautne ke baad) mit jaen, phir Umrah karna jaiz hoga uske liye jo Umrah karna chahta hai." Allah ke Rasool aur unke sathi Mecca dhaee Dhul-Hijja ko Hajj ke liye Ihram pahinkar pahunche. Nabi ne apne sathiyon ko hukum diya ke woh Umrah karen (us Ihram se, Hajj ke bajaye). Unhone pucha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Ihram khatam karne ka kaunsa tareeka?" Nabi ne kaha, "Ihram poori tarah khatam karo."

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Al-Musaiyab's grand-father:In the pre-Islamic period of ignorance a flood of rain came and filled the valley in between the two mountains (around the Ka`ba)
hi: Sa'id bin Al-Musaiyab ke daade bataate hain: Jahiliyat ke daur mein ek barish ki baadh aee aur do pahadon ke beech ki waadi (Ka'ba ke aas-paas) bhar di.

e: Narrated Qais bin Abi Hazim:Abu Bakr went to a lady from the Ahmas tribe called Zainab bint Al-Muhajir and found that she refused to speak. He asked, "Why does she not speak." The people said, "She has intended to perform Hajj without speaking." He said to her, "Speak, for it is illegal not to speak, as it is an action of the pre-islamic period of ignorance. So she spoke and said, "Who are you?" He said, "A man from the Emigrants." She asked, "Which Emigrants?" He replied, "From Quraish." She asked, "From what branch of Quraish are you?" He said, "You ask too many questions; I am Abu Bakr." She said, "How long shall we enjoy this good order (i.e. Islamic religion) which Allah has brought after the period of ignorance?" He said, "You will enjoy it as long as your Imams keep on abiding by its rules and regulations." She asked, "What are the Imams?" He said, "Were there not heads and chiefs of your nation who used to order the people and they used to obey them?" She said, "Yes." He said, "So they (i.e. the Imams) are those whom I meant
hi: Qais bin Abi Hazim bataate hain: Abu Bakr Ahmas qabile ki ek mahila, Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Al-Muhajir, ke paas gaye aur paaya ke woh baat karne se inkaar kar rahi thi. Unhone pucha, "Woh kyun baat nahi kar rahi?" Logon ne kaha, "Unhone bina baat kiye Hajj karne ka irada kiya hai." Unhone unse kaha, "Baat karo, kyunke baat na karna jaiz nahi hai, kyunke yeh jahiliyat ke daur ka amal hai." Isliye woh boli aur kaha, "Aap kaun hain?" Unhone kaha, "Muhajir logon mein se ek shaks." Unhone pucha, "Kaunse Muhajir?" Unhone jawab diya, "Quraish se." Unhone pucha, "Aap Quraish ki kaunsi shaakha se hain?" Unhone kaha, "Tum bahut zyada sawal poochti ho; main Abu Bakr hoon." Unhone pucha, "Hum is achhe nizaam (yaani Islami deen) ka kitne der tak aanand lenge jise Allah jahiliyat ke daur ke baad laaya hai?" Unhone kaha, "Tum ise tab tak aanand loge jab tak tumhare Imam iske qawaanin ka paalan karte hain." Unhone pucha, "Imam kya hote hain?" Unhone kaha, "Kya tumhare desh ke sardaar aur mukhiya nahi the jo logon ko hukum dete the aur log unki itaaat karte the?" Unhone kaha, "Haan." Unhone kaha, "To wohi (yaani Imam) mera matlab tha."

e: Narrated `Aisha:A black lady slave of some of the 'Arabs embraced Islam and she had a hut in the mosque. She used to visit us and talk to us, and when she finished her talk, she used to say: "The day of the scarf was one of our Lord's wonders: Verily! He has delivered me from the land of Kufr." When she said the above verse many times, I (i.e. `Aisha) asked her, "What was the day of the scarf?" She replied, "Once the daughter of some of my masters went out and she was wearing a leather scarf (round her neck) and the leather scarf fell from her and a kite descended and picked it up, mistaking it for a piece of meat. They (i.e. my masters) accused me of stealing it and they tortured me to such an extent that they even looked for it in my private parts. So, while they all were around me, and I was in my great distress, suddenly the kite came over our heads and threw the scarf, and they took it. I said to them 'This is what you accused me of stealing, though I was innocent
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Kuchh Arab qabile ki ek kaali launDi ne Islam qubool kiya, aur unki masjid mein ek kuti thi. Woh humare paas aati aur humare saath baat karti, aur jab woh apni baat khatam karti, woh kahti: "Chunre ka din humare Rab ke chamatkaron mein se ek tha: Beshak, usne mujhe kufr ki bhoomi se nikala." Jab unhone yeh baat bahut baar kahi, maine (yaani Ayesha ne) unse pucha, "Chunre ka din kya tha?" Unhone jawab diya, "Ek baar mere kuchh maalikon ki beti bahar gaee, ek chamde ki chunre (apne gale mein) pahne hue, aur woh chunri gir gaee aur ek cheel ne use girte dekha aur use gosht ka tukda samajhkar utha liya. Unhone (yaani mere maalikon ne) mujhpar chori ka ilzaam lagaya, aur mujhe itna pareshaan kiya ke unhone meri sharmgaah mein bhi (chunri) dhoondi. Isliye jabke woh sab mere aas-paas the, aur main sakht museebat mein thi, achanak woh cheel humare saron ke oopar aee aur chunri phenk di, aur unhone use utha liya. Maine unse kaha, 'Yehi woh cheez hai jiski chori ka aapne mujhpar ilzaam lagaya, jabke main begunah thi.'"

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If anybody has to take an oath, he should swear only by Allah." The people of Quraish used to swear by their fathers, but the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not swear by your fathers
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Agar kisi ko qasam khaani hai, use sirf Allah ki qasam khaani chahiye." Quraish qabile ke log apne baap ki qasam khate the, magar Nabi ne kaha, "Apne baap ki qasam mat khaao."

e: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin Al-Qasim:Al-Qasim used to walk in front of the funeral procession. He used not to get up for the funeral procession (in case it passed by him). And he narrated from `Aisha that she said, "The people of the pre-Islamic period of ignorance used to stand up for the funeral procession. When they saw it they used to say twice: 'You were noble in your family. What are you now?
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Al-Qasim bataate hain: Al-Qasim janaza jaloos ke aage chala karte the. Woh janaza jaloos ke liye khade nahi hote (agar woh unke paas se guzarta). Aur unhone Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se riwaayat ki ke unhone kaha, "Jahiliyat ke daur ke log janaza jaloos ke liye khade hote the. Jab woh ise dekhte, do baar kahte: 'Tum apne pariwara mein izzatdaar the. Ab tum kya ho?'"

e: Narrated `Umar:The pagans used not to leave Jam' (i.e. Muzdalifa) till the sun had risen on Thabir mountain. The Prophet contradicted them by leaving (Muzdalifa) before the sun rose
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Kaafir log Jam (yaani Muzdalifa) ko tab tak nahi chhodte the jab tak suraj Thabir pahad par na chadh jaaye. Nabi ne unke khilaf (Muzdalifa ko) suraj chadhne se pahle chhodkar inkaar kiya (yaani unse ulta kaam kiya).

e: Narrated Husain:That `Ikrima said, "Kasan Dihaqa means glass full (of something) followed successively with other full glasses
hi: Husain bataate hain: Ikrima ne kaha, "Kasan Dihaqa ka matlab hai kaanch ka pyaala bhara hua (kisi cheez se), lagataar doosre bhare hue pyaalon ke saath."

e: Ibn `Abbas said:"In the pre-Islamic period of ignorance I heard my father saying, "Provide us with Kasan Dihaqa
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jahiliyat ke daur mein, maine apne waalid ko yeh kehte suna, "Humein Kasan Dihaqa do."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The most true words said by a poet was the words of Labid." He said, Verily, Everything except Allah is perishable and Umaiya bin As-Salt was about to be a Muslim (but he did not embrace Islam)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Ek kavi dwaara kahi gaee sabse sachi baat Labid ki baat thi." Unhone kaha, Sach mein, Allah ke siwa har cheez nashvat hai (mit jane wali), aur Umaiya bin As-Salt Musalman banne ke qareeb the (magar unhone Islam qubool nahi kiya).

e: Narrated `Aisha:Abu Bakr had a slave who used to give him some of his earnings. Abu Bakr used to eat from it. One day he brought something and Abu Bakr ate from it. The slave said to him, "Do you know what this is?" Abu Bakr then enquired, "What is it?" The slave said, "Once, in the pre-Islamic period of ignorance I foretold somebody's future though I did not know this knowledge of foretelling but I, cheated him, and when he met me, he gave me something for that service, and that is what you have eaten from." Then Abu Bakr put his hand in his mouth and vomited whatever was present in his stomach
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Abu Bakr ka ek gulaam tha jo unhe apni kamaee ka kuch hissa deta tha, aur Abu Bakr usmein se khate the. Ek din woh kuch lekar aaye aur Abu Bakr ne usme se khaya. Gulaam ne unse kaha, "Kya aapko pata hai yeh kya hai?" Abu Bakr ne pucha, "Yeh kya hai?" Gulaam ne kaha, "Ek baar, jahiliyat ke daur mein, maine kisi ke mustaqbil ka andaaza lagaya, chahe mujhe yeh ilm nahi tha, magar maine unhe dhoka diya, aur jab woh mujhse mile, unhone mujhe iske liye kuch diya, aur wahi hai jo aapne khaya hai." Isspar Abu Bakr ne apna haath apne munh mein daala aur jo bhi unke pet mein tha use ugal diya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:In the pre-Islamic period of ignorance the people used to bargain with the meat of camels on the principle of Habal-al-Habala which meant the sale of a she-camel that would be born by a she-camel that had not yet been born. The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade them such a transaction
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jahiliyat ke daur mein, log unton ke gosht ka vyaapaar Habal-al-Habala ke usool par karte the, jiska matlab hai ek untni ka bechna jo ek doosri untni se paida hogi jo abhi khud paida nahi huee. Nabi ne unhe aisa lene-dene karne se mana kiya.

e: Narrated Ghailan bin Jarir:We used to visit Anas bin Malik and he used to talk to us about the Ansar, and used to say to me: "Your people did so-and-so on such-and-such a day, and your people did so-and-so on such-and-such a day
hi: Ghailan bin Jarir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se milne jate the aur woh humse Ansaar ke baare mein baat karte, aur mujhse kahte the: "Tumhari qaum ne falaan-falaan din aisa-aisa kiya, aur tumhari qaum ne falaan-falaan din aisa-aisa kiya."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The first event of Qasama in the pre-Islamic period of ignorance was practiced by us (i.e. Banu Hashim). A man from Banu Hashim was employed by a Quraishi man from another branch-family. The (Hashimi) laborer set out with the Quraishi driving his camels. There passed by him another man from Banu Hashim. The leather rope of the latter's bag had broken so he said to the laborer, "Will you help me by giving me a rope in order to tie the handle of my bag lest the camels should run away from me?" The laborer gave him a rope and the latter tied his bag with it. When the caravan halted, all the camels' legs were tied with their fetters except one camel. The employer asked the laborer, "Why, from among all the camels has this camel not been fettered?" He replied, "There is no fetter for it." The Quraishi asked, "Where is its fetter?" and hit the laborer with a stick that caused his death (later on Just before his death) a man from Yemen passed by him. The laborer asked (him), "Will you go for the pilgrimage?" He replied, "I do not think I will attend it, but perhaps I will attend it." The (Hashimi) laborer said, "Will you please convey a message for me once in your life?" The other man said, "yes." The laborer wrote: 'When you attend the pilgrimage, call the family of Quraish, and if they respond to you, call the family of Banu Hashim, and if they respond to you, ask about Abu Talib and tell him that so-and-so has killed me for a fetter." Then the laborer expired. When the employer reached (Mecca), Abu Talib visited him and asked, "What has happened to our companion?" He said, "He became ill and I looked after him nicely (but he died) and I buried him." Then Abu Talib said, "The deceased deserved this from you." After some time, the messenger whom the laborer had asked to convey the message, reached during the pilgrimage season. He called, "O the family of Quraish!" The people replied, "This is Quraish." Then he called, "O the family of Banu Hashim!" Again the people replied, "This is Banu Hashim." He asked, "Who is Abu Talib?" The people replied, "This is Abu Talib." He said, "'So-and-so has asked me to convey a message to you that so-and-so has killed him for a fetter (of a camel)." Then Abu Talib went to the (Quraishi) killer and said to him, "Choose one of three alternatives: (i) If you wish, give us one-hundred camels because you have murdered our companion, (ii) or if you wish, fifty of your men should take an oath that you have not murdered our companion, and if you do not accept this, (iii) we will kill you in Qisas." The killer went to his people and they said, "We will take an oath." Then a woman from Banu Hashim who was married to one of them (i.e.the Quraishis) and had given birth to a child from him, came to Abu Talib and said, "O Abu Talib! I wish that my son from among the fifty men, should be excused from this oath, and that he should not take the oath where the oathtaking is carried on." Abu Talib excused him. Then another man from them came (to Abu Talib) and said, "O Abu Talib! You want fifty persons to take an oath instead of giving a hundred camels, and that means each man has to give two camels (in case he does not take an oath). So there are two camels I would like you to accept from me and excuse me from taking an oath when the oaths are taken. Abu Talib accepted them from him. Then 48 men came and took the oath. Ibn `Abbas further said: By Him in Whose Hand my life is, before the end of that year, none of those 48 persons remained alive
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Qasama (yaani ek qasam-aadharit nyaya-prakriya) ki pahli ghatna jahiliyat ke daur mein humare (yaani Banu Hashim ke) dwaara ki gaee thi. Banu Hashim ke ek shaks ko Quraish ki ek doosri shaakha ke ek shaks ne mazdoori par rakha. (Hashimi) mazdoor Quraishi ke saath unke unton ko hankate huye nikla. Wahaan se Banu Hashim ka ek doosra shaks guzra. Uski thaili ki chamde ki rassi toot gaee thi, isliye usne mazdoor se kaha, "Kya tum mujhe ek rassi dekar madad karoge taake main apni thaili ka handle baandh sakun, kahin unt mujhse bhaag na jaen?" Mazdoor ne unhe ek rassi di aur usne apni thaili usse baandhi. Jab caravan ruka, sab unton ke paanv unke bandhan se baandhe gaye siwaye ek unt ke. Malik ne mazdoor se pucha, "Sab unton mein se yeh unt kyun nahi baandha gaya?" Usne jawab diya, "Iske liye koi bandhan nahi hai." Quraishi ne pucha, "Iska bandhan kahaan hai?" aur mazdoor ko ek lakdi se maara jisse uski maut ho gaee (baad mein, maut se pahle) Yemen ka ek shaks unke paas se guzra. Mazdoor ne (unse) pucha, "Kya aap Hajj karne jaenge?" Usne jawab diya, "Mujhe nahi lagta main us mein shaamil hounga, magar shaayad main shaamil ho jaaun." (Hashimi) mazdoor ne kaha, "Kya aap kripya apni zindagi mein ek baar mera ek paighaam pahunchaenge?" Doosre shaks ne kaha, "Haan." Mazdoor ne likha: 'Jab aap Hajj mein shaamil hon, Quraish ke pariwara ko bulaiye, aur agar woh aapko jawab den, Banu Hashim ke pariwara ko bulaiye, aur agar woh aapko jawab den, Abu Talib ke baare mein puchiye aur unhe bataiye ke falaan-falaan ne mujhe ek bandhan ke liye qatl kiya hai." Phir mazdoor ka intiqal ho gaya. Jab malik (Mecca) pahuncha, Abu Talib unse milne gaye aur pucha, "Humare sathi ko kya hua?" Usne kaha, "Woh bimar pad gaye aur maine unki achhi dekhbhaal ki (magar unka intiqal ho gaya) aur maine unhe dafanaya." Phir Abu Talib ne kaha, "Marne wale ko yeh tumse milna hi tha." Kuch waqt baad, jis sandeshvaahak se mazdoor ne apna paighaam pahunchane ko kaha tha, woh Hajj ke mausam ke dauran pahuncha. Usne pukara, "Aye Quraish ke pariwara!" Logon ne jawab diya, "Yeh Quraish hai." Phir usne pukara, "Aye Banu Hashim ke pariwara!" Phir logon ne jawab diya, "Yeh Banu Hashim hai." Usne pucha, "Abu Talib kaun hain?" Logon ne jawab diya, "Yeh Abu Talib hain." Usne kaha, "Falaan-falaan ne mujhe aapko ek paighaam pahunchane ko kaha hai ke falaan-falaan ne unhe ek (unt ke) bandhan ke liye qatl kiya hai." Phir Abu Talib (Quraishi) qaatil ke paas gaye aur unse kaha, "Teen ikhtiyaaron mein se ek chuniye: (i) Agar aap chahen, humein sau unt dijiye kyunke aapne humare sathi ko qatl kiya hai, (ii) ya agar aap chahen, aapke pachaas log qasam khaen ke aapne humare sathi ko qatl nahi kiya, aur agar aap yeh qubool nahi karte, (iii) hum aapko Qisas mein qatl kar denge." Qaatil apni qaum ke paas gaya aur unhone kaha, "Hum qasam lenge." Phir Banu Hashim ki ek aurat jiski shaadi unmein se ek (yaani Quraishi) se hui thi aur uska ek bachcha bhi tha, Abu Talib ke paas aee aur kaha, "Aye Abu Talib! Main chahti hoon ke mera beta un pachaas logon mein se is qasam se bacha liya jaaye, aur woh us jagah qasam na le jahaan qasam li ja rahi hai." Abu Talib ne unhe chhoot di. Phir unmein se ek doosra shaks (Abu Talib ke paas) aaya aur kaha, "Aye Abu Talib! Aap chahte hain pachaas log qasam len sau unt dene ki jagah, iska matlab hai har shaks ko do unt dene honge (agar woh qasam nahi leta). Isliye mere paas do unt hain jo main chahta hoon aap mujhse qubool karen aur mujhe qasam lene se chhoot den jab qasam li jaaye." Abu Talib ne unhe unse qubool kiya. Phir 48 log aaye aur qasam li. Ibn Abbas ne aage kaha: Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri zindagi hai, us saal ke khatam hone se pahle, un 48 logon mein se koi bhi zinda nahi bacha.

e: Narrated 'Aisha: Allah caused the day of Buath to take place before Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was sent (as an Apostle) so that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) reached Medina, those people had already divided (in different groups) and their chiefs had been killed or wounded. So Allah made that day precede Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) so that they (i.e. the Ansar) might embrace Islam
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ne Bu'ath ka din Allah ke Rasool ke bheje jane se pahle hone diya taake jab Allah ke Rasool Madina pahunche, woh log (yaani Ansaar) pahle se hi (alag-alag girohon mein) baante hue the aur unke sardaar mare ya zakhmi ho chuke the. Isliye Allah ne us din ko Allah ke Rasool se pahle isliye laaya taake woh (yaani Ansaar) Islam qubool kar saken.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas:To run along the valley between two green pillars of Safa and Marwa (mountains) was not Sunna, but the people in the pre-islamic period of ignorance used to run along it, and used to say: "We do not cross this rain stream except running strongly
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Safa aur Marwa (pahad) ke do hare khambon ke beech waadi mein daudna Sunnat nahi thi, magar jahiliyat ke daur ke log uske saath daudte the aur kahte the, "Hum is barish ki dhara ko paar nahi karte siwaye zordaar daudkar."

e: Narrated Abu As-Safar:I heard Ibn `Abbas saying, "O people! Listen to what I say to you, and let me hear whatever you say, and don't go (without understanding), and start saying, 'Ibn `Abbas said so-and-so, Ibn `Abbas said so-and-so, Ibn `Abbas said so-and-so.' He who wants to perform the Tawaf around the Ka`ba should go behind Al-Hijr (i.e. a portion of the Ka`ba left out unroofed) and do not call it Al-Hatim, for in the pre-Islamic period of ignorance if any man took an oath, he used to throw his whip, shoes or bow in it
hi: Abu As-Safar bataate hain: Maine Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko yeh kehte suna, "Aye logo! Suno jo main tumse kahta hoon, aur mujhe jo bhi tum kahte ho woh sunne do, aur bina samjhe mat jaao, aur yeh kahna shuru mat karo, 'Ibn Abbas ne aisa-aisa kaha, Ibn Abbas ne aisa-aisa kaha, Ibn Abbas ne aisa-aisa kaha.' Jo koi Ka'ba ka Tawaf karna chahta hai, use Al-Hijr (yaani Ka'ba ka woh hissa jo bina chhat ke chhoda gaya hai) ke peeche se jana chahiye, aur ise Al-Hatim mat kaho, kyunke jahiliyat ke daur mein agar koi shaks qasam khata, woh apni chaabuk, joote, ya dhanush ismein phenkta."

e: Narrated `Amr bin Maimun:During the pre-Islamic period of ignorance I saw a she-monkey surrounded by a number of monkeys. They were all stoning it, because it had committed illegal sexual intercourse. I too, stoned it along with them
hi: Amr bin Maimun bataate hain: Jahiliyat ke daur mein, maine ek maada baandar dekhi jise bahut se baandaron ne gher rakha tha. Woh sab use pathar se maar rahe the, kyunke usne gair-jaayaz ta'alluq banaya tha. Main bhi unke saath use pathar se maar raha tha.

e: Narrated Sufyan:'Ubaidullah said: "I heard Ibn `Abbas saying, "Following are some traits of the people of the pre- Islamic period of ignorance (i) to defame the ancestry of other families, (ii) and to wail over the dead." 'Ubaidullah forgot the third trait. Sufyan said, "They say it (i.e. the third trait) was to believe that rain was caused by the influence of stars (i.e. if a special star appears it will rain)
hi: Ubaidullah bataate hain: Maine Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko kehte suna, "Yeh kuchh lakshan hain jahiliyat ke daur ke logon ke: (i) doosre pariwaron ke vansh ki ninda karna, (ii) aur murdon par matam (yaani zor se rona aur maatam manaana)." Ubaidullah teesra lakshan bhool gaye. Sufyan ne kaha, "Woh kahte hain (teesra lakshan) yeh maanna tha ke barish sitaron ke prabhaav se hoti hai (yaani agar ek khaas sitara dikhaee de, barish hogi)."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was inspired Divinely at the age of forty. Then he stayed in Mecca for thirteen years, and then was ordered to migrate, and he migrated to Medina and stayed there for ten years and then died
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ko chaalis saal ki umr mein Divine ilham mila. Phir woh terah saal Mecca mein rahe, aur phir hijrat karne ka hukum diya gaya, aur woh Madina hijrat karke aaye, jahaan woh das saal rahe, aur phir unka intiqal hua.

e: Narrated Khabbab:I came to the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was leaning against his sheet cloak in the shade of the Ka`ba. We were suffering greatly from the pagans in those days. I said (to him), "Will you invoke Allah (to help us)?" He sat down with a red face and said, "(A believer among) those who were before you used to be combed with iron combs so that nothing of his flesh or nerves would remain on his bones; yet that would never make him desert his religion. A saw might be put over the parting of his head which would be split into two parts, yet all that would never make him abandon his religion. Allah will surely complete this religion (i.e. Islam) so that a traveler from Sana to Hadra-maut will not be afraid of anybody except Allah." (The sub-narrator, Bayan added, "Or the wolf, lest it should harm his sheep)
hi: Khabbab (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Nabi ke paas gaya jabke woh Ka'ba ki chhaye mein apni chaadar par teke baithe the. Us zamane mein hum kaafiron ki taraf se bahut zulm sah rahe the. Maine (unse) kaha, "Kya aap Allah se dua karenge (humari madad ke liye)?" Woh laal chehre ke saath baith gaye aur kaha, "(Ek momin) tumse pahle ke logon mein se, lohe ki kanghiyon se khurcha jata tha jab tak unke gosht ya naeson mein se kuch bhi unki haddiyon par na bache, phir bhi yeh unhe apna deen chhodne par kabhi majboor nahi karta. Ek aara unke sar ke jode par rakha jata, jisse woh do hisson mein baant jata, phir bhi yeh unhe apna deen chhodne par kabhi majboor nahi karta. Allah zaroor is deen (yaani Islam) ko poora karega taake Sana se Hadramaut tak ek musafir kisi se na dare siwaye Allah ke." (Doosre raawi, Bayan ne joda, "Ya bhediye se, kahin uski bhedon ko nuksaan na pahunchae.")

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) recited Surat An-Najm and prostrated, and there was nobody who did not prostrate then except a man whom I saw taking a handful of pebbles, lifting it, and prostrating on it. He then said, "This is sufficient for me." No doubt I saw him killed as a disbeliever afterwards
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Surah An-Najm padhi aur sajda ki, aur koi bhi wahaan aisa nahi tha jisne sajda na ki ho siwaye ek shaks ke jise maine kuch kankad uthate, unhe apne haath mein uthate, aur unpar sajda karte dekha. Usne kaha, "Yeh mere liye kaafi hai." Koi shak nahi, maine baad mein unhe ek kaafir ke soorat mein qatl hote dekha.

e: Narrated `Abdullah:While the Prophet (ﷺ) was prostrating, surrounded by some of Quraish, `Uqba bin Abi Mu'ait brought the intestines (i.e. Abdominal contents) of a camel and put them over the back of the Prophet. The Prophet (ﷺ) did not raise his head, (till) Fatima, came and took it off his back and cursed the one who had done the harm. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! Destroy the chiefs of Quraish, Abu Jahl bin Hisham, `Utba bin Rabi`a, Shaiba bin Rabi`a, Umaiya bin Khalaf or Ubai bin Khalaf." (The sub-narrator Shu`ba, is not sure of the last name.) I saw these people killed on the day of Badr battle and thrown in the well except Umaiya or Ubai whose body parts were mutilated but he was not thrown in the well
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jabke Nabi sajda mein the, kuch Quraish ke log unke aas-paas the, Uqba bin Abi Mu'ait ek unt ki aanten (yaani pet ke andar ki cheezein) laaya aur unhe Nabi ki peeth par rakh diya. Nabi ne apna sar nahi uthaya, jab tak Fatima (Alayhas Salam) na aee aur use unki peeth se hataya, aur jisne bhi yeh takleef dee use bad-dua di. Nabi ne kaha, "Aye Allah! Quraish ke sardaron ko barbaad kar, Abu Jahl bin Hisham, Utba bin Rabi'a, Shaiba bin Rabi'a, Umaiya bin Khalaf ya Ubai bin Khalaf." (Doosre raawi, Shu'ba ko aakhri naam ka yaqeen nahi hai.) Maine in logon ko Badr ki jung ke din qatl hote aur kue mein phenke jate dekha siwaye Umaiya ya Ubai ke, jinke jism ke hisse alag ho gaye magar unhe kue mein nahi phenka gaya.

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:`AbdurRahman bin Abza said, "Ask Ibn `Abbas about these two Qur'anic Verses: 'Nor kill such life as Allah has made sacred, Except for just cause.' (25.168) "And whoever kills a believer intentionally, his recompense is Hell. (4.93) So I asked Ibn `Abbas who said, "When the Verse that is in Sura-al-Furqan was revealed, the pagans of Mecca said, 'But we have slain such life as Allah has made sacred, and we have invoked other gods along with Allah, and we have also committed fornication.' So Allah revealed:-- 'Except those who repent, believe, and do good-- (25.70) So this Verse was concerned with those people. As for the Verse in Surat-an-Nisa (4-93), it means that if a man, after understanding Islam and its laws and obligations, murders somebody, then his punishment is to dwell in the (Hell) Fire forever." Then I mentioned this to Mujahid who said, "Except the one who regrets (one's crime)
hi: Sa'id bin Jubair bataate hain: Abdur-Rahman bin Abza ne kaha, "Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se in do Quranic Ayaton ke baare mein puchho: 'Aur us jaan ko qatl mat karo jise Allah ne pavitr banaya hai, siwaye munasib kaaranon ke.' (25:68) 'Aur jo koi jaanboojhkar kisi momin ko qatl karta hai, uska badla Dozakh hai.' (4:93)" Isliye maine Ibn Abbas se pucha jinhone kaha, "Jab Surah-al-Furqan wali Ayat naazil hui, Mecca ke kaafiron ne kaha, 'Magar humne aisi jaan qatl ki hai jise Allah ne pavitr banaya hai, aur humne Allah ke saath doosre buton ko pukara hai, aur humne zina bhi kiya hai.' Isliye Allah ne naazil kiya: 'Siwaye un logon ke jo tauba karte hain, iman late hain, aur neik amal karte hain...' (25:70) Isliye yeh Ayat un logon ke silsile mein thi. Jahaan tak Surat-an-Nisa ki Ayat (4:93) ka sawal hai, iska matlab hai ke agar koi shaks, Islam aur uske qawaanin aur zimmedaariyon ko samjhne ke baad, kisi ko qatl karta hai, to uski saza hai ke woh (Dozakh ki) aag mein hamesha ke liye rahe." Phir maine yeh Mujahid ko bataya jinhone kaha, "Siwaye us shaks ke jo pachhtata hai (apne gunah par)."

e: Narrated `Urwa bin Az-Zubair:I asked Ibn `Amr bin Al-As, "Tell me of the worst thing which the pagans did to the Prophet." He said, "While the Prophet (ﷺ) was praying in the Hijr of the Ka`ba; `Uqba bin Abi Mu'ait came and put his garment around the Prophet's neck and throttled him violently. Abu Bakr came and caught him by his shoulder and pushed him away from the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "Do you want to kill a man just because he says, 'My Lord is Allah?
hi: Urwa bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Ibn Amr bin Al-As (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha, "Mujhe bataiye woh sabse bura kaam jo kaafiron ne Nabi ke saath kiya." Unhone kaha, "Jabke Nabi Ka'ba ke Hijr mein namaz padh rahe the, Uqba bin Abi Mu'ait aaya aur apna kapda Nabi ki gale ke gird ghumaya aur use sakhti se ghonta.
