Abu Bakr aaye aur unke kandhe se pakada aur unhe Nabi se hataya aur kaha, 'Kya tum ek shaks ko sirf isliye qatl karna chahte ho kyunke woh kahta hai, \"Mera Rab Allah hai\"?'"

e: Narrated `Ammar bin Yasir:I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) , and the only converts (to Islam) with him, were five slaves, two women and Abu Bakr
hi: Ammar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Yasir bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool ko dekha, aur unke saath sirf paanch gulaam, do aurten, aur Abu Bakr ne hi Islam qubool kiya tha.

e: Narrated Abu 'Is-haq: Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas said: None embraced Islam, except on the day I embraced it. And for seven days I was one of the three persons who were Muslims (one-third of Islam)
hi: Abu Ishaq bataate hain: Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Koi bhi us din se pahle Islam mein daakhil nahi hua jis din maine daakhil kiya. Aur saat din tak main teen logon mein se ek tha jo Musalman the (yaani Islam ka ek-tihaee)."

e: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman:"I asked Masruq, 'Who informed the Prophet (ﷺ) about the Jinns at the night when they heard the Qur'an?' He said, 'Your father `Abdullah informed me that a tree informed the Prophet (ﷺ) about them
hi: Abdur-Rahman bataate hain: Maine Masruq se pucha, "Kisne Nabi ko us raat ke baare mein bataya jab Jinnon ne Quran suna?" Unhone kaha, "Tumhare waalid Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne mujhe bataya ke ek darakht ne Nabi ko unke baare mein bataya."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:That once he was in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) carrying a water pot for his ablution and for cleaning his private parts. While he was following him carrying it (i.e. the pot), the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Who is this?" He said, "I am Abu Huraira." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Bring me stones in order to clean my private parts, and do not bring any bones or animal dung." Abu Huraira went on narrating: So I brought some stones, carrying them in the corner of my robe till I put them by his side and went away. When he finished, I walked with him and asked, "What about the bone and the animal dung?" He said, "They are of the food of Jinns. The delegate of Jinns of (the city of) Nasibin came to me--and how nice those Jinns were--and asked me for the remains of the human food. I invoked Allah for them that they would never pass by a bone or animal dung but find food on them
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar woh Nabi ki sohbat mein the, unke liye wudu aur apni sharma-sthanon ki safaee ke liye paani ka bartan le jate hue. Jabke woh unke peeche use lekar chal rahe the, Nabi ne pucha, "Yeh kaun hai?" Unhone kaha, "Main Abu Huraira hoon." Nabi ne kaha, "Mere liye pathar lao mere sharma-sthanon ki safaee ke liye, aur koi haddi ya janwar ki laid mat laana." Abu Huraira ne aage bataya: Isliye main kuch pathar laaya, apne kapde ke kone mein rakhkar, jab tak maine unhe unke bagal mein rakha aur chala gaya. Jab woh khatam hue, main unke saath chala aur pucha, "Haddi aur janwar ki laid ke baare mein kya?" Unhone kaha, "Woh Jinnon ka khaana hai. Nasibin shehar ke Jinnon ka ek wafd mere paas aaya — aur woh kaise achhe Jinn the! — aur unhone mujhse insaanon ke khaane ke bache hue hisson ke baare mein pucha. Maine unke liye Allah se dua ki taaki jab bhi unhe koee haddi ya janwar ki laid mile, unhe uspar khaana mile."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When Abu Dhar received the news of the Advent of the Prophet (ﷺ) he said to his brother, "Ride to this valley (of Mecca) and try to find out the truth of the person who claims to be a prophet who is informed of the news of Heaven. Listen to what he says and come back to me." So his brother set out and came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and listened to some of his talks, and returned to Abu Dhar and said to him. "I have seen him enjoining virtuous behavior and saying something that is not poetry." Abu Dhar said, "You have not satisfied me as to what I wanted." He then took his journey-food and carried a waterskin of his, containing some water till he reached Mecca. He went to the Mosque and searched for the Prophet and though he did not know him, he hated to ask anybody about him. When a part of the night had passed away, `Ali saw him and knew that he was a stranger. So when Abu Dhar saw `Ali, he followed him, and none of them asked his companion about anything, and when it was dawn, Abu Dhar took his journey food and his water-skin to the Mosque and stayed there all the day long without being perceived by the Prophet, and when it was evening, he came back to his retiring place. `Ali passed by him and said, "Has the man not known his dwelling place yet?" So `Ali awakened him and took him with him and none of them spoke to the other about anything. When it was the third day. `Ali did the same and Abu Dhar stayed with him. Then `Ali said "Will you tell me what has brought you here?" Abu Dhar said, "If you give me a firm promise that you will guide me, then I will tell you." `Ali promised him, and he informed `Ali about the matter. `Ali said, "It is true, and he is the Messenger of Allah. Next morning when you get up, accompany me, and if I see any danger for you, I will stop as if to pass water, but if I go on, follow me and enter the place which I will enter." Abu Dhar did so, and followed `Ali till he entered the place of the Prophet, and Abu Dhar went in with him, Abu Dhar listened to some of the Prophet's talks and embraced Islam on the spot. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "Go back to your people and inform them (about it) till you receive my order." Abu Dhar said, "By Him in Whose Hand my life is, I will proclaim my conversion loudly amongst them (i.e. the pagans)." So he went out, and when he reached the Mosque, he said as loudly as possible, "I bear witness that None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, and Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah." The People got up and beat him painfully. Then Al-Abbas came and knelt over him ((to protect him) and said (to the people), "Woe to you! Don't you know that this man belongs to the tribe of Ghifar and your trade to Sha'm is through their way?" So he rescued him from them. Abu Dhar again did the same the next day. They beat him and took vengeance on him and again Al-Abbas knelt over him (to protect him)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Abu Dharr (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko Nabi ke aagman ki khabar mili, unhone apne bhai se kaha, "Is (Mecca ki) waadi mein jaao aur us shaks ki sachaee jaanne ki koshish karo jo Nabi hone ka daava karta hai aur jise aasman ki khabron ka ilm hai. Woh jo kahte hain woh suno aur mere paas wapas aao." Isliye unke bhai nikle aur Nabi ke paas aaye aur unki kuch baaten suni, aur Abu Dharr ke paas wapas aakar kaha, "Maine unhe achhe charitra ka hukum dete aur kuch aisa kahte dekha jo kavita nahi hai." Abu Dharr ne kaha, "Tumne mujhe santusht nahi kiya jo main jaanna chahta tha." Phir unhone apni safar ka khaana liya aur apni paani ki mashk, kuch paani ke saath, uthaee jab tak woh Mecca pahunche. Woh masjid gaye aur Nabi ko dhoondha aur chahe unhe unki pahchan nahi thi, unhe kisi se puchne mein sharm aee. Jab raat ka kuch hissa guzar gaya, Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne unhe dekha aur pahchana ke woh ek pardeshi hain. Isliye jab Abu Dharr ne Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko dekha, unhone unka picha kiya, aur na kisi ne doosre se kisi baat ke baare mein pucha, aur jab subah huee, Abu Dharr apna safar ka khaana aur mashk masjid le gaye aur poore din wahaan rahe bina Nabi dwaara dekhe jaane ke, aur jab shaam huee, woh apni rahne ki jagah wapas aaye. Ali (Alayhis Salam) unke paas se guzre aur kaha, "Kya us shaks ko abhi tak apna rehne ka thikaana nahi mila?" Isliye Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne unhe jagaya aur apne saath le gaye, aur na kisi ne doosre se kisi baat ke baare mein baat ki. Jab teesra din aaya, Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne wahi kiya aur Abu Dharr unke saath ruke. Phir Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha "Kya tum mujhe bataoge kya tumhe yahaan laaya?" Abu Dharr ne kaha, "Agar tum mujhe pukhta waada do ke tum meri rahnumaee karoge, phir main tumhe bataunga." Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne waada kiya, aur unhone Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko maamle ke baare mein bataya. Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha, "Yeh sach hai, aur woh Allah ke Rasool hain. Kal subah jab tum utho, mere saath chalna, aur agar mujhe tumhare liye koee khatra dikhta hai, main peshaab karne ka natak karke ruk jaunga, magar agar main chalta rahun, mera picha karo aur us jagah daakhil ho jahaan main daakhil hounga." Abu Dharr ne aisa hi kiya, Ali (Alayhis Salam) ka picha karte hue jab tak woh Nabi ki jagah daakhil hue, aur Abu Dharr bhi unke saath daakhil hue. Abu Dharr ne Nabi ki kuch baaten suni aur wahin Islam qubool kiya. Nabi ne unse kaha, "Apni qaum ke paas wapas jao aur unhe (iske baare mein) batao jab tak tumhe mera hukum na mile." Abu Dharr ne kaha, "Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haathon mein meri zindagi hai, main iska (yaani apne Islam qubool karne ka) elaan unke (yaani kaafiron ke) beech khulle-aam karunga." Isliye woh bahar gaye, aur jab woh masjid pahunche, unhone jitne oonchi aawaaz mein mumkin ho saka kaha, "Main gawahi deta hoon ke Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahi, aur Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain." Log uthe aur unhe dard bhare tarike se maara. Phir Al-Abbas aaye aur unke oopar jhuke (unhe bachane ke liye) aur (logon se) kaha, "Afsos tum par! Kya tumhe nahi pata yeh shaks Ghifar qabile ka hai aur Sham ke tumhare vyaapaar ka raasta unki sarzameen se hi hokar gujarta hai?" Isliye unhone unhe bacha liya. Abu Dharr ne agle din phir wahi kiya. Unhone unhe maara aur badla liya, aur phir Al-Abbas ne unke oopar jhukkar (unhe bachaya).

e: Narrated Qais:I heard Sa`id bin Zaid bin `Amr bin Nufail saying in the mosque of Al-Kufa. "By Allah, I have seen myself tied and forced by `Umar to leave Islam before `Umar himself embraced Islam. And if the mountain of Uhud could move from its place for the evil which you people have done to `Uthman, then it would have the right to move from its place
hi: Qais bataate hain: Maine Sa'd bin Zaid bin Amr bin Nufail ko Al-Kufa ki masjid mein kehte suna, "Allah ki qasam, maine khud ko baandhe hue aur Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) dwaara Islam chhodne par majboor kiya jate dekha hai, isse pahle ke Umar ne khud Islam qubool kiya. Aur agar Uhud pahad apni jagah se hila hota us buraee ke liye jo tum logon ne Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath ki hai, use apni jagah se hilne ka haqq hota."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Mas'ud:We have been powerful since `Umar embraced Islam
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum taaqatwar hote gaye jab se Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Islam qubool kiya.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:While `Umar was at home in a state of fear, there came Al-`As bin Wail As-Sahmi Abu `Amr, wearing an embroidered cloak and a shirt having silk hems. He was from the tribe of Bani Sahm who were our allies during the pre-Islamic period of ignorance. Al-`As said to `Umar "What is wrong with you?" He said, "Your people claim that they would kill me if I become a Muslim." Al-`As said, "Nobody will harm you after I have given protection to you." So Al-`As went out and met the people streaming in the whole valley. He said, "Where are you going?" They said, "We want Ibn Al-Khattab who has embraced Islam." Al-`As said, "There is no way for anybody to touch him." So the people retreated
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jabke Umar apne ghar mein darate hue haalat mein the, Al-As bin Wail As-Sahmi Abu Amr aaye, ek kadhaee kiya hua choga aur resham ki hemgon wali qameej pahne hue. Woh Bani Sahm qabile ke the jo jahiliyat ke daur mein humare sathi the. Al-As ne Umar se kaha, "Aapko kya hua hai?" Unhone kaha, "Tumhari qaum daava karti hai ke agar main Musalman ban jaun, woh mujhe qatl kar denge." Al-As ne kaha, "Koi bhi tumhe nuksaan nahi pahunchaega jab tak maine tumhe panah di hai." Isliye Al-As bahar gaye aur logon se mile jo poori waadi mein baadh ki tarah aa rahe the. Unhone pucha, "Tum kahaan ja rahe ho?" Unhone kaha, "Hum Ibn Al-Khattab ko chahte hain jinhone Islam qubool kiya hai." Al-As ne kaha, "Koi bhi unhe chhoo nahi sakta." Isliye log wapas chale gaye.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:When `Umar embraced Islam, all The (disbelieving) people gathered around his home and said, "`Umar has embraced Islam." At that time I was still a boy and was on the roof of my house. There came a man wearing a cloak of Dibaj (i.e. a kind of silk), and said, "`Umar has embraced Islam. Nobody can harm him for I am his protector." I then saw the people going away from `Umar and asked who the man was, and they said, "Al-`As bin Wail
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Umar ne Islam qubool kiya, sab (kaafir) log unke ghar ke aas-paas jama hue aur kaha, "Umar ne Islam qubool kiya hai." Us waqt main abhi ek ladka tha aur apne ghar ki chhat par tha. Ek shaks aaya, Dibaj (yaani ek qisam ke resham) ka choga pahne hue, aur kaha, "Umar ne Islam qubool kiya hai. Koi bhi unhe nuksaan nahi pahuncha sakta kyunke main unka rakshak hoon." Phir maine dekha log Umar se door ja rahe the, aur maine pucha yeh shaks kaun tha, aur unhone kaha, "Al-As bin Wail."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:I never heard `Umar saying about something that he thought it would be so-and-so, but he was quite right. Once, while `Umar was sitting, a handsome man passed by him, `Umar said, "If I am not wrong, this person is still on his religion of the pre-Islamic period of ignorance or he was their foreteller. Call the man to me." When the man was called to him, he told him of his thought. The man said, "I have never seen such a day on which a Muslim is faced with such an accusation." `Umar said, "I am determined that you should tell me the truth." He said, "I was a foreteller in the pre-Islamic period of ignorance." Then `Umar said, "Tell me the most astonishing thing your female Jinn has told you of." He said, "One-day while I was in the market, she came to me scared and said, 'Haven't you seen the Jinns and their despair and they were overthrown after their defeat (and prevented from listening to the news of the heaven) so that they (stopped going to the sky and) kept following camel-riders (i.e. 'Arabs)?" `Umar said, "He is right." and added, "One day while I was near their idols, there came a man with a calf and slaughtered it as a sacrifice (for the idols). An (unseen) creature shouted at him, and I have never heard harsher than his voice. He was crying, 'O you bold evil-doer! A matter of success! An eloquent man is saying: None has the right to be worshipped except you (O Allah).' On that the people fled, but I said, 'I shall not go away till I know what is behind this.' Then the cry came again: 'O you bold evil-doer! A matter of success! An eloquent man is saying: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah.' I then went away and a few days later it was said, "A prophet has appeared
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine kabhi Umar ko kisi cheez ke baare mein yeh kehte nahi suna ke unhe lagta hai yeh aisa-aisa hoga, magar woh bilkul sahi nikle. Ek baar, jabke Umar baithe the, ek khoobsurat shaks unke paas se guzra. Umar ne kaha, "Agar main galat nahi hoon, yeh shaks abhi bhi apne jahiliyat ke daur ke deen par hai, ya woh unka ghaib ki khabar dene wala tha. Ise mere paas bulao." Jab shaks ko bulaya gaya, Umar ne unhe apna khyaal bataya. Shaks ne kaha, "Maine kabhi aisa din nahi dekha jispar ek Musalman ko aise ilzaam ka saamna karna pade." Umar ne kaha, "Main eershya se poochta hoon ke tum mujhe sach batao." Usne kaha, "Main jahiliyat ke daur mein ek ghaib ki khabar dene wala tha." Phir Umar ne kaha, "Mujhe woh sabse aashcharyajanak baat batao jo tumhari maada jin ne tumhe bataee hai." Usne kaha, "Ek din jabke main bazaar mein tha, woh darte hue mere paas aee aur kaha, 'Kya tumne Jinnon aur unki nirasha nahi dekhi aur unki haar ke baad unhe ulta diya gaya (aur unhe aasman ki khabron sunne se roka gaya) taake woh (aasman jane se rukkar) unton par sawar logon (yaani Arbon) ka picha karte rahe?'" Umar ne kaha, "Woh sahi hai," aur joda, "Ek din jabke main unke buton ke paas tha, ek shaks ek bachchada gaay lekar aaya aur use qurbani ke tor par zabah kiya. Ek (ghaib) mahluk ne unpar chilla, aur maine kabhi unki aawaaz se zyada karki aawaaz nahi suni. Woh chilla raha tha, 'Aye tum, sahsi burakaar! Kaamyaabi ki baat hai! Ek vakpatu insaan kah raha hai: Tere siwa koi mabood nahi (Aye Allah).'" Isspar log bhaag gaye, magar maine kaha, "Main tab tak nahi jaunga jab tak mujhe pata na chale iske pichhe kya hai." Phir cheekh dobara aee: "Aye tum, sahsi burakaar! Kaamyaabi ki baat hai! Ek vakpatu insaan kah raha hai: Tere siwa koi mabood nahi." Main phir chala gaya aur kuch dinon baad kaha gaya, "Ek Nabi prakat hue hain."

e: Narrated Qais:I heard Sa`id bin Zaid saying to the people, "If you but saw me and `Umar's sister tied and forced by `Umar to leave Islam while he was not yet a Muslim. And if the mountain of Uhud could move from its place for the evil which you people have done to `Uthman, it would have the right to do that
hi: Qais bataate hain: Maine Sa'd bin Zaid ko logon se kehte suna, "Agar tumne mujhe aur Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki behn ko dekha hota, jinhe Umar ne baandha tha aur Islam chhodne par majboor kiya tha jabke woh khud abhi Musalman nahi bane the. Aur agar Uhud pahad apni jagah se hila hota us buraee ke liye jo tum logon ne Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath ki hai, use apni jagah se hilne ka haqq hota."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The people of Mecca asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to show them a miracle. So he showed them the moon split in two halves between which they saw the Hira' mountain
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Mecca ke logon ne Allah ke Rasool se ek chamatkar dikhane ko kaha. Isliye unhone unhe chaand ko do tukdon mein baantte dikhaya, jinke beech unhone Hira pahad dekha.

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The moon was split ( into two pieces ) while we were with the Prophet (ﷺ) in Mina. He said, "Be witnesses." Then a Piece of the moon went towards the mountain
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Chaand do tukdon mein baant gaya jabke hum Nabi ke saath Mina mein the. Unhone kaha, "Gawaah raho." Phir chaand ka ek tukda pahad ki taraf gaya.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abbas:During the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) the moon was split (into two pieces)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ki zindagi mein chaand do tukdon mein baant gaya.

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The moon was split (into two pieces)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Chaand do tukdon mein baant gaya.

e: Narrated 'Ubaidullah bin `Adi bin Al-Khiyar:That Al-Miswar bin Makhrama and `Abdur-Rahman bin Al-Aswad bin 'Abd Yaghuth had said to him, "What prevents you from speaking to your uncle `Uthman regarding his brother Al-Walid bin `Uqba?" The people were speaking against the latter for what he had done. 'Ubaidullah said, "So I kept waiting for `Uthman, and when he went out for the prayer, I said to him, 'I have got something to say to you as a piece of advice.' `Uthman said, 'O man! I seek Refuge with Allah from you. So I went away. When I finished my prayer, I sat with Al-Miswar and Ibn 'Abd Yaghuth and talked to both of them of what I had said to `Uthman and what he had said to me. They said, 'You have done your duty.' So while I was sitting with them. `Uthman's Messenger came to me. They said, 'Allah has put you to trial." I set out and when I reached `Uthman, he said, 'What is your advice which you mentioned a while ago?' I recited Tashahhud and added, 'Allah has sent Muhammad and has revealed the Holy Book (i.e. Qur'an) to him. You (O `Uthman!) were amongst those who responded to the call of Allah and His Apostle and had faith in him. And you took part in the first two migrations (to Ethiopia and to Medina), and you enjoyed the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and learned his traditions and advice. Now the people are talking much about Al-Walid bin `Uqba and so it is your duty to impose on him the legal punishment.' `Uthman then said to me, 'O my nephew! Did you ever meet Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ?' I said, 'No, but his knowledge has reached me as it has reached the virgin in her seclusion.' `Uthman then recited Tashahhud and said, 'No doubt, Allah has sent Muhammad with the Truth and has revealed to him His Holy Book (i.e. Qur'an) and I was amongst those who responded to the call of Allah and His Apostle and I had faith in Muhammad's Mission, and I had performed the first two migrations as you have said, and I enjoyed the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and gave the pledge of allegiance to him. By Allah, I never disobeyed him and never cheated him till Allah caused him to die. Then Allah made Abu Bakr Caliph, and by Allah, I was never disobedient to him, nor did I cheat him. Then `Umar became Caliph, and by Allah, I was never disobedient to him, nor did I cheat him. Then I became Caliph. Have I not then the same rights over you as they had over me?' I replied in the affirmative. `Uthman further said, 'Then what are these talks which are reaching me from you? As for what you have mentioned about Al-Walid bin 'Uqba, Allah willing, I shall give him the legal punishment justly.' Then `Uthman ordered that Al-Walid be flogged forty lashes. He ordered `Ali to flog him and he himself flogged him as well
hi: Ubaidullah bin Adi bin Al-Khiyar bataate hain: Al-Miswar bin Makhrama (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Abdur-Rahman bin Al-Aswad bin Abd Yaghuth ne unse kaha tha, "Aapko apne chacha Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) se unke bhai Al-Walid bin Uqba ke baare mein baat karne se kya rokta hai?" Log unke (yaani Al-Walid ke) kiye hue kaam ke khilaf bahut kuch kah rahe the. Ubaidullah ne kaha, "Isliye main Uthman ka intezaar karte rahe, aur jab woh namaz ke liye bahar gaye, maine unse kaha, 'Mujhe aapse kuch kehna hai, ek naseehat ke tor par.' Uthman ne kaha, 'Aye shaks! Main tumse Allah ki panah maangta hoon.' Isliye main chala gaya. Jab maine apni namaz khatam ki, main Al-Miswar aur Ibn Abd Yaghuth ke saath baitha aur unhe bataya jo maine Uthman se kaha tha aur jo unhone mujhse kaha tha. Unhone kaha, 'Aapne apna farz nibhaya hai.' Isliye jabke main unke saath baitha tha, Uthman ka bheja hua shaks mere paas aaya. Unhone kaha, 'Allah ne aapko aazmaya hai.'" Main chal pada aur jab main Uthman tak pahuncha, unhone kaha, "Woh naseehat kya thi jo tumne thoda der pahle di?" Maine Tashah-hud padha aur joda, "Allah ne Muhammad ko bheja aur unpar Paak Kitaab (yaani Quran) nazil ki. Aap (Aye Uthman!) un logon mein the jinhone Allah aur uske Rasool ki pukar ka jawab diya aur unpar iman laaye. Aur aapne do hijraton mein hissa liya (Ethiopia aur Madina), aur Allah ke Rasool ki sohbat ka anubhav liya aur unki riwaajen aur naseehat seekhi. Ab log Al-Walid bin Uqba ke baare mein bahut kuch kah rahe hain, isliye yeh aapka farz hai ke unpar qanooni saza lagayen." Uthman ne phir mujhse kaha, "Aye mere bhatije! Kya tumne kabhi Allah ke Rasool se mulaqaat ki?" Maine kaha, "Nahi, magar unka ilm mujhtak pahuncha hai jaise woh apni ekaant mein baithi kuari tak pahunchta hai." Uthman ne phir Tashah-hud padha aur kaha, "Koi shak nahi, Allah ne Muhammad ko Haqq ke saath bheja aur unpar Paak Kitaab nazil ki, aur main unmein tha jinhone Allah aur uske Rasool ki pukar ka jawab diya aur Muhammad ke mission par iman laaya, aur maine do hijraten ki jaisa tumne kaha, aur maine Allah ke Rasool ki sohbat ka anubhav liya aur unhe bai'at di. Allah ki qasam, maine kabhi unki na-farmani nahi ki, na hi unke saath dhoka kiya jab tak Allah ne unhe intiqal karwaya. Phir Allah ne Abu Bakr ko Khalifa banaya, aur Allah ki qasam, maine kabhi unki na-farmani nahi ki, na hi unke saath dhoka kiya. Phir Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) Khalifa bane, aur Allah ki qasam, maine kabhi unki na-farmani nahi ki, na hi unke saath dhoka kiya. Phir main Khalifa bana. To kya mera bhi tumpar wahi haqq nahi hai jo unka tumpar tha?" Maine haan mein jawab diya. Uthman ne aage kaha, "Phir yeh kya baaten hain jo mujhtak tumse pahunch rahi hain? Jahaan tak Al-Walid bin Uqba ke baare mein tumne kaha, Insha Allah, main unhe insaaf se qanooni saza dunga." Phir Uthman ne hukum diya ke Al-Walid ko chaalis kode maare jaen. Unhone Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko hukum diya unhe kode maarne ka, aur unhone khud bhi unhe maara.

e: Narrated `Aisha:Um Habiba and Um Salama mentioned a church they had seen in Ethiopia and in the church there were pictures. When they told the Prophet (ﷺ) of this, he said, "Those people are such that if a pious man amongst them died, they build a place of worship over his grave and paint these pictures in it. Those people will be Allah's worst creatures on the Day of Resurrection
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Um Habiba aur Um Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne ek girja (yaani Isaee ibadat sthal) ka zikar kiya jo unhone Ethiopia mein dekha tha aur usmein tasveeren thi. Jab unhone Nabi ko yeh bataya, unhone kaha, "Woh log aise hain ke agar unmein se koi pakbaz shaks intiqal kar jata, woh unki qabar par ek ibadat ki jagah banate aur usmein yeh tasveeren banate. Woh log Qiyamat ke din Allah ki sabse buri takhleeq honge."

e: Narrated Um Khalid bint Khalid:When I came from Ethiopia (to Medina), I was a young girl. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) made me wear a sheet having marks on it. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was rubbing those marks with his hands saying, "Sanah! Sanah!" (i.e. good, good)
hi: Um Khalid bint Khalid bataati hain: Jab main Ethiopia se (Madina) aee, main ek chhoti ladki thi. Allah ke Rasool ne mujhe daagon wala ek kapda pehnwaya. Allah ke Rasool un daagon ko apne haathon se ragadte hue kahte the, "Sanah! Sanah!" (yaani achha, achha).

e: Narrated `Abdullah:We used to greet the Prophet (ﷺ) while he used to be in prayers, and he used to reply to our greetings. But when we came back from Najashi (the King of Ethiopia) we greeted him (while he was praying) and he did not reply to us. We said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We used to greet you in the past and you used to reply to us." He said, "Verily The Mind is occupied and busy with more important matter during the prayer." (So one cannot return One's greetings)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Nabi ko namaz ke dauran salaam karte the aur woh humare salaam ka jawab dete the. Magar jab hum An-Najashi (yaani Ethiopia ke raja) se wapas aaye, humne unhe (namaz padhte huye) salaam kiya aur unhone humein jawab nahi diya. Humne kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Hum aapko pahle salaam karte the aur aap humein jawab dete the." Unhone kaha, "Beshak, dimaag namaz ke dauran zyada mahatvapurna maamlon mein masroof aur vyast ho jata hai," (isliye insaan apna salaam ka jawab nahi de sakta).

e: Narrated Abu Musa:We received the news of the departure of the Prophet (to Medina) while we were in Yemen. So we went on board a ship but our ship took us away to An-Najashi (the Negus) in Ethiopia. There we met Ja`far bin Abi Talib and stayed with him till we came (to Medina) by the time when the Prophet (ﷺ) had conquered Khaibar. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O you people of the ship! You will have (the reward of) two migrations
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Humein Nabi ke (Madina) prasthaan ki khabar mili jabke hum Yemen mein the. Isliye hum ek jahaaz par sawar hue magar humare jahaaz ne humein An-Najashi (yaani Negus) ke paas Ethiopia le gaya. Wahaan humari mulaqaat Ja'far bin Abi Talib se hui aur hum unke saath ruke jab tak hum (Madina) aaye us waqt jab Nabi ne Khaibar fatah kar liya tha. Nabi ne kaha, "Aye jahaaz ke logo! Tumhe do hijraton ka (ajr) milega."

e: Narrated Jabir:When Negus died, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Today a pious man has died. So get up and offer the funeral prayer for your brother Ashama
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Negus ka intiqal hua, Nabi ne kaha, "Aaj ek pakbaz shaks ka intiqal hua hai. Isliye utho aur apne bhai Ashama ki janaza namaz padho."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah Al-Ansari:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) led the funeral prayer for the Negus and made us stand in rows behind him and I was in the second or third row
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ansari bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Negus ki janaza namaz padhaee aur humein apne peeche safon mein khada kiya, aur main doosri ya teesri saf mein tha.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) offered the funeral prayer for Ashama, the Negus, with four Takbir
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Ashama, Negus ki janaza namaz padhi, chaar Takbir ke saath.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) informed them (i.e. his companions) of the death of Negus, the king of Ethiopia, on the very day on which the latter died, and said, "Ask Allah's Forgiveness for your brother
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne unhe (yaani apne sahaba ko) Negus, Ethiopia ke raja, ki maut ki khabar usi din di jis din unka intiqal hua tha, aur kaha, "Apne bhai ke liye Allah se maafi maango."

e: Abu Huraira further said: "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) made them (i.e. the Muslims) stand in rows at the Musalla (i.e. praying place) and led the funeral prayer for the Negus and said four Takbir
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne aage kaha: "Allah ke Rasool ne unhe (yaani Musalmanon ko) Musalla (yaani namaz ki jagah) mein safon mein khada kiya aur Negus ki janaza namaz padhaee, chaar Takbir ke saath."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), while going out for the battle of Hunain, said, "Tomorrow Allah willing, we will encamp at Khaif Bani Kinana where the pagans(of Quraish) took the oath of Kufr (against the Prophet (ﷺ) i.e. to be loyal to heathenism, by boycotting Banu Hashim, the Prophet's folk. (See Hadith)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne, Hunain ki jung ke liye jate huye, kaha, "Kal, Insha Allah, hum Khaif Bani Kinana mein padaav daalenge, jahaan mushrikon (yaani Quraish ke) ne Kufr ki qasam khaee thi (yaani Nabi ke khilaf) —yaani but-parasti ke prati wafadaar rehne ki, Banu Hashim ka bahishkaar karte hue, jo Nabi ka khaandaan tha."

e: Narrated Al-Abbas bin `Abdul Muttalib:That he said to the Prophet (ﷺ) "You have not been of any avail to your uncle (Abu Talib) (though) by Allah, he used to protect you and used to become angry on your behalf." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He is in a shallow fire, and had It not been for me, he would have been in the bottom of the (Hell) Fire
hi: Al-Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib bataate hain: Unhone Nabi se kaha, "Aap apne chache (Abu Talib) ke kisi kaam nahi aaye, chahe, Allah ki qasam, woh aapko mahfooz rakhte the aur aapke liye gussa karte the." Nabi ne kaha, "Woh (Dozakh ki) haalki aag mein hain, aur agar main na hota, woh (Dozakh ki) aag ki tah mein hote."

e: Narrated Al-Musaiyab:When Abu Talib was in his death bed, the Prophet (ﷺ) went to him while Abu Jahl was sitting beside him. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O my uncle! Say: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, an expression I will defend your case with, before Allah." Abu Jahl and `Abdullah bin Umaiya said, "O Abu Talib! Will you leave the religion of `Abdul Muttalib?" So they kept on saying this to him so that the last statement he said to them (before he died) was: "I am on the religion of `Abdul Muttalib." Then the Prophet said, " I will keep on asking for Allah's Forgiveness for you unless I am forbidden to do so." Then the following Verse was revealed:-- "It is not fitting for the Prophet (ﷺ) and the believers to ask Allah's Forgiveness for the pagans, even if they were their near relatives, after it has become clear to them that they are the dwellers of the (Hell) Fire." (9.113) The other Verse was also revealed:-- "(O Prophet!) Verily, you guide not whom you like, but Allah guides whom He will
hi: Al-Musaiyab bataate hain: Jab Abu Talib maut ke bistar par the, Nabi unke paas gaye jabke Abu Jahl unke bagal mein baithe the. Nabi ne kaha, "Aye mere chache! Kahiye: Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahi, ek aisi baat jiske saath main aapka paksh Allah ke saamne rakhunga." Abu Jahl aur Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umaiya ne kaha, "Aye Abu Talib! Kya aap Abdul Muttalib ke deen ko chhodenge?" Isliye woh yeh baar-baar kahte rahe jab tak unki aakhri baat unse yeh thi: "Main Abdul Muttalib ke deen par hoon." Phir Nabi ne kaha, "Main aapke liye Allah se maafi maangta rahunga jab tak mujhe mana na kiya jaaye." Phir yeh Ayat naazil hui: "Yeh Nabi aur mominon ke laayak nahi ke woh mushrikon ke liye Allah se maafi maangen, chahe woh unke qareebi rishtedaar hi kyun na hon, jab unpar yeh saaf ho gaya ho ke woh (Dozakh ki) aag walon mein se hain." (9:113) Ek doosri Ayat bhi naazil huee: "(Aye Nabi!) Aap jise chahte hain use hidaayat nahi de sakte, magar Allah jise chahta hai hidaayat deta hai." (28:56)

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:That he heard the Prophet (ﷺ) when somebody mentioned his uncle (i.e. Abu Talib), saying, "Perhaps my intercession will be helpful to him on the Day of Resurrection so that he may be put in a shallow fire reaching only up to his ankles. His brain will boil from it." Narrated Yazid: (as above, Hadith 224) using the words: "will make his brain boil
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Unhone Nabi ko, jab kisi ne unke chache (yaani Abu Talib) ka zikar kiya, kehte suna, "Shaayad meri sifarish Qiyamat ke din unke kaam aaye taaki unhe thoda si aag mein rakha jaaye jo sirf unke takhnon tak pahunche. Unka dimaag ise kholega." (Doosre raawi ne yehi baat "unka dimaag kholega" ke alfaazon mein bataee.)

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:That he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "When the people of Quraish did not believe me (i.e. the story of my Night Journey), I stood up in Al-Hijr and Allah displayed Jerusalem in front of me, and I began describing it to them while I was looking at it
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Unhone Allah ke Rasool ko kehte suna, "Jab Quraish ke logon ne mujhpar vishwas nahi kiya (yaani meri raat ki safar ki kahani), main Al-Hijr mein khada hua aur Allah ne mere saamne Jerusalem dikhaya, aur main uska varnan karna shuru kiya jabke main use dekh raha tha."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Malik bin Sasaa said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) described to them his Night Journey saying, "While I was lying in Al-Hatim or Al-Hijr, suddenly someone came to me and cut my body open from here to here." I asked Al-Jarud who was by my side, "What does he mean?" He said, "It means from his throat to his pubic area," or said, "From the top of the chest." The Prophet (ﷺ) further said, "He then took out my heart. Then a gold tray of Belief was brought to me and my heart was washed and was filled (with Belief) and then returned to its original place. Then a white animal which was smaller than a mule and bigger than a donkey was brought to me." (On this Al-Jarud asked, "Was it the Buraq, O Abu Hamza?" I (i.e. Anas) replied in the affirmative). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The animal's step (was so wide that it) reached the farthest point within the reach of the animal's sight. I was carried on it, and Gabriel set out with me till we reached the nearest heaven. When he asked for the gate to be opened, it was asked, 'Who is it?' Gabriel answered, 'Gabriel.' It was asked, 'Who is accompanying you?' Gabriel replied, 'Muhammad.' It was asked, 'Has Muhammad been called?' Gabriel replied in the affirmative. Then it was said, 'He is welcomed. What an excellent visit his is!' The gate was opened, and when I went over the first heaven, I saw Adam there. Gabriel said (to me). 'This is your father, Adam; pay him your greetings.' So I greeted him and he returned the greeting to me and said, 'You are welcomed, O pious son and pious Prophet.' Then Gabriel ascended with me till we reached the second heaven. Gabriel asked for the gate to be opened. It was asked, 'Who is it?' Gabriel answered, 'Gabriel.' It was asked, 'Who is accompanying you?' Gabriel replied, 'Muhammad.' It was asked, 'Has he been called?' Gabriel answered in the affirmative. Then it was said, 'He is welcomed. What an excellent visit his is!' The gate was opened. When I went over the second heaven, there I saw Yahya (i.e. John) and `Isa (i.e. Jesus) who were cousins of each other. Gabriel said (to me), 'These are John and Jesus; pay them your greetings.' So I greeted them and both of them returned my greetings to me and said, 'You are welcomed, O pious brother and pious Prophet.' Then Gabriel ascended with me to the third heaven and asked for its gate to be opened. It was asked, 'Who is it?' Gabriel replied, 'Gabriel.' It was asked, 'Who is accompanying you?' Gabriel replied, 'Muhammad.' It was asked, 'Has he been called?' Gabriel replied in the affirmative. Then it was said, 'He is welcomed, what an excellent visit his is!' The gate was opened, and when I went over the third heaven there I saw Joseph. Gabriel said (to me), 'This is Joseph; pay him your greetings.' So I greeted him and he returned the greeting to me and said, 'You are welcomed, O pious brother and pious Prophet.' Then Gabriel ascended with me to the fourth heaven and asked for its gate to be opened. It was asked, 'Who is it?' Gabriel replied, 'Gabriel' It was asked, 'Who is accompanying you?' Gabriel replied, 'Muhammad.' It was asked, 'Has he been called?' Gabriel replied in the affirmative. Then it was said, 'He is welcomed, what an excel lent visit his is!' The gate was opened, and when I went over the fourth heaven, there I saw Idris. Gabriel said (to me), 'This is Idris; pay him your greetings.' So I greeted him and he returned the greeting to me and said, 'You are welcomed, O pious brother and pious Prophet.' Then Gabriel ascended with me to the fifth heaven and asked for its gate to be opened. It was asked, 'Who is it?' Gabriel replied, 'Gabriel.' It was asked. 'Who is accompanying you?' Gabriel replied, 'Muhammad.' It was asked, 'Has he been called?' Gabriel replied in the affirmative. Then it was said He is welcomed, what an excellent visit his is! So when I went over the fifth heaven, there I saw Harun (i.e. Aaron), Gabriel said, (to me). This is Aaron; pay him your greetings.' I greeted him and he returned the greeting to me and said, 'You are welcomed, O pious brother and pious Prophet.' Then Gabriel ascended with me to the sixth heaven and asked for its gate to be opened. It was asked. 'Who is it?' Gabriel replied, 'Gabriel.' It was asked, 'Who is accompanying you?' Gabriel replied, 'Muhammad.' It was asked, 'Has he been called?' Gabriel replied in the affirmative. It was said, 'He is welcomed. What an excellent visit his is!' When I went (over the sixth heaven), there I saw Moses. Gabriel said (to me),' This is Moses; pay him your greetings. So I greeted him and he returned the greetings to me and said, 'You are welcomed, O pious brother and pious Prophet.' When I left him (i.e. Moses) he wept. Someone asked him, 'What makes you weep?' Moses said, 'I weep because after me there has been sent (as Prophet) a young man whose followers will enter Paradise in greater numbers than my followers.' Then Gabriel ascended with me to the seventh heaven and asked for its gate to be opened. It was asked, 'Who is it?' Gabriel replied, 'Gabriel.' It was asked,' Who is accompanying you?' Gabriel replied, 'Muhammad.' It was asked, 'Has he been called?' Gabriel replied in the affirmative. Then it was said, 'He is welcomed. What an excellent visit his is!' So when I went (over the seventh heaven), there I saw Abraham. Gabriel said (to me), 'This is your father; pay your greetings to him.' So I greeted him and he returned the greetings to me and said, 'You are welcomed, O pious son and pious Prophet.' Then I was made to ascend to Sidrat-ul-Muntaha (i.e. the Lote Tree of the utmost boundary) Behold! Its fruits were like the jars of Hajr (i.e. a place near Medina) and its leaves were as big as the ears of elephants. Gabriel said, 'This is the Lote Tree of the utmost boundary) . Behold ! There ran four rivers, two were hidden and two were visible, I asked, 'What are these two kinds of rivers, O Gabriel?' He replied,' As for the hidden rivers, they are two rivers in Paradise and the visible rivers are the Nile and the Euphrates.' Then Al-Bait-ul-Ma'mur (i.e. the Sacred House) was shown to me and a container full of wine and another full of milk and a third full of honey were brought to me. I took the milk. Gabriel remarked, 'This is the Islamic religion which you and your followers are following.' Then the prayers were enjoined on me: They were fifty prayers a day. When I returned, I passed by Moses who asked (me), 'What have you been ordered to do?' I replied, 'I have been ordered to offer fifty prayers a day.' Moses said, 'Your followers cannot bear fifty prayers a day, and by Allah, I have tested people before you, and I have tried my level best with Bani Israel (in vain). Go back to your Lord and ask for reduction to lessen your followers' burden.' So I went back, and Allah reduced ten prayers for me. Then again I came to Moses, but he repeated the same as he had said before. Then again I went back to Allah and He reduced ten more prayers. When I came back to Moses he said the same, I went back to Allah and He ordered me to observe ten prayers a day. When I came back to Moses, he repeated the same advice, so I went back to Allah and was ordered to observe five prayers a day. When I came back to Moses, he said, 'What have you been ordered?' I replied, 'I have been ordered to observe five prayers a day.' He said, 'Your followers cannot bear five prayers a day, and no doubt, I have got an experience of the people before you, and I have tried my level best with Bani Israel, so go back to your Lord and ask for reduction to lessen your follower's burden.' I said, 'I have requested so much of my Lord that I feel ashamed, but I am satisfied now and surrender to Allah's Order.' When I left, I heard a voice saying, 'I have passed My Order and have lessened the burden of My Worshipers
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Malik bin Sasaa ne kaha ke Allah ke Rasool ne unhe apni raat ki safar ka varnan kiya, "Jabke main Al-Hatim ya Al-Hijr mein leta hua tha, achanak koi mere paas aaya aur mera jism yahan se yahan tak khol diya." Maine Al-Jarud se, jo mere bagal mein the, pucha, "Iska kya matlab hai?" Unhone kaha, "Iska matlab hai gale se naabhi tak," ya kaha, "Seene ke oopar se." Nabi ne aage kaha, "Phir unhone mera dil nikala. Phir Iman se bhari sone ki ek tashtri laee gaee aur mera dil dhoya gaya aur (Iman se) bhar diya gaya aur phir apni asli jagah wapas rakh diya gaya. Phir ek safed janwar laaya gaya jo khachchar se chhota aur gadhe se bada tha." (Isspar Al-Jarud ne pucha, "Kya woh Buraq tha, Aye Abu Hamza?" Maine (yaani Anas ne) haan mein jawab diya.) Nabi ne kaha, "Janwar ka kadam (itna lamba tha ke) uski nazar ki seema tak pahunchta tha. Mujhe uspar sawar kiya gaya, aur Jibreel mere saath nikle jab tak hum sabse qareebi aasman tak pahunche. Jab unhone darwaza kholne ki maang ki, pucha gaya, 'Kaun hai?' Jibreel ne jawab diya, 'Jibreel.' Pucha gaya, 'Aapke saath kaun hai?' Jibreel ne jawab diya, 'Muhammad.' Pucha gaya, 'Kya Muhammad ko bulaya gaya hai?' Jibreel ne haan mein jawab diya. Phir kaha gaya, 'Unka swagat hai. Kitna behtareen unka aagman hai!' Darwaza khola gaya, aur jab main pahle aasman se guzra, maine wahaan Aadam ko dekha. Jibreel ne (mujhse) kaha, 'Yeh aapke waalid, Aadam hain; unhe salaam kariye.' Isliye maine unhe salaam kiya aur unhone mujhe salaam ka jawab diya aur kaha, 'Tumhara swagat hai, Aye neik beta aur neik Nabi.' Phir Jibreel mujhe lekar doosre aasman tak chadhe. Jibreel ne darwaza kholne ki maang ki. Pucha gaya, 'Kaun hai?' Jibreel ne jawab diya, 'Jibreel.' Pucha gaya, 'Aapke saath kaun hai?' Jibreel ne jawab diya, 'Muhammad.' Pucha gaya, 'Kya unhe bulaya gaya hai?' Jibreel ne haan mein jawab diya. Phir kaha gaya, 'Unka swagat hai. Kitna behtareen unka aagman hai!' Darwaza khola gaya, aur jab main doosre aasman se guzra, wahaan maine Yahya (yaani Yohan) aur Isa ko dekha, jo mama-jaee bhai the. Jibreel ne (mujhse) kaha, 'Yeh Yahya aur Isa hain; unhe salaam kariye.' Isliye maine unhe salaam kiya aur donon ne mujhe salaam ka jawab diya aur kaha, 'Tumhara swagat hai, Aye neik bhai aur neik Nabi.' Phir Jibreel mujhe lekar teesre aasman tak chadhe aur uska darwaza kholne ki maang ki. Pucha gaya, 'Kaun hai?' Jibreel ne jawab diya, 'Jibreel.' Pucha gaya, 'Aapke saath kaun hai?' Jibreel ne jawab diya, 'Muhammad.' Pucha gaya, 'Kya unhe bulaya gaya hai?' Jibreel ne haan mein jawab diya. Phir kaha gaya, 'Unka swagat hai, kitna behtareen unka aagman hai!' Darwaza khola gaya, aur jab main teesre aasman se guzra, wahaan maine Yusuf ko dekha. Jibreel ne (mujhse) kaha, 'Yeh Yusuf hain; unhe salaam kariye.' Isliye maine unhe salaam kiya aur unhone mujhe salaam ka jawab diya aur kaha, 'Tumhara swagat hai, Aye neik bhai aur neik Nabi.' Phir Jibreel mujhe lekar chauthe aasman tak chadhe aur uska darwaza kholne ki maang ki. Pucha gaya, 'Kaun hai?' Jibreel ne jawab diya, 'Jibreel.' Pucha gaya, 'Aapke saath kaun hai?' Jibreel ne jawab diya, 'Muhammad.' Pucha gaya, 'Kya unhe bulaya gaya hai?' Jibreel ne haan mein jawab diya. Phir kaha gaya, 'Unka swagat hai, kitna behtareen unka aagman hai!' Darwaza khola gaya, aur jab main chauthe aasman se guzra, wahaan maine Idris ko dekha. Jibreel ne (mujhse) kaha, 'Yeh Idris hain; unhe salaam kariye.' Isliye maine unhe salaam kiya aur unhone mujhe salaam ka jawab diya aur kaha, 'Tumhara swagat hai, Aye neik bhai aur neik Nabi.' Phir Jibreel mujhe lekar paanchve aasman tak chadhe aur uska darwaza kholne ki maang ki. Pucha gaya, 'Kaun hai?' Jibreel ne jawab diya, 'Jibreel.' Pucha gaya. 'Aapke saath kaun hai?' Jibreel ne jawab diya, 'Muhammad.' Pucha gaya, 'Kya unhe bulaya gaya hai?' Jibreel ne haan mein jawab diya. Phir kaha gaya 'Unka swagat hai, kitna behtareen unka aagman hai!' Isliye jab main paanchve aasman se guzra, wahaan maine Haroon (yaani Aaron) ko dekha, Jibreel ne (mujhse) kaha, 'Yeh Haroon hain; unhe salaam kariye.' Maine unhe salaam kiya aur unhone mujhe salaam ka jawab diya aur kaha, 'Tumhara swagat hai, Aye neik bhai aur neik Nabi.' Phir Jibreel mujhe lekar chhathe aasman tak chadhe aur uska darwaza kholne ki maang ki. Pucha gaya. 'Kaun hai?' Jibreel ne jawab diya, 'Jibreel.' Pucha gaya, 'Aapke saath kaun hai?' Jibreel ne jawab diya, 'Muhammad.' Pucha gaya, 'Kya unhe bulaya gaya hai?' Jibreel ne haan mein jawab diya. Kaha gaya, 'Unka swagat hai. Kitna behtareen unka aagman hai!' Jab main (chhathe aasman se) guzra, wahaan maine Musa ko dekha. Jibreel ne (mujhse) kaha, 'Yeh Musa hain; unhe salaam kariye.' Isliye maine unhe salaam kiya aur unhone mujhe salaam ka jawab diya aur kaha, 'Tumhara swagat hai, Aye neik bhai aur neik Nabi.' Jab main unhe (yaani Musa ko) chhodkar aage badha, woh rone lage. Kisi ne unse pucha, 'Aapko kis cheez ne rulaya?' Musa ne kaha, 'Main isliye ro raha hoon kyunke mere baad ek jawan shaks (Nabi ke tor par) bheja gaya hai jinke pairokaar Jannat mein mere pairokaron se zyada tadaad mein daakhil honge.' Phir Jibreel mujhe lekar saatve aasman tak chadhe aur uska darwaza kholne ki maang ki. Pucha gaya, 'Kaun hai?' Jibreel ne jawab diya, 'Jibreel.' Pucha gaya, 'Aapke saath kaun hai?' Jibreel ne jawab diya, 'Muhammad.' Pucha gaya, 'Kya unhe bulaya gaya hai?' Jibreel ne haan mein jawab diya. Phir kaha gaya, 'Unka swagat hai. Kitna behtareen unka aagman hai!' Isliye jab main (saatve aasman se) guzra, wahaan maine Ibrahim ko dekha. Jibreel ne (mujhse) kaha, 'Yeh aapke waalid hain; unhe apna salaam dijiye.' Isliye maine unhe salaam kiya aur unhone mujhe salaam ka jawab diya aur kaha, 'Tumhara swagat hai, Aye neik beta aur neik Nabi.' Phir mujhe Sidrat-ul-Muntaha (yaani aakhri seema ka darakht) tak chadhaya gaya. Dekho! Uske phal Hajr (yaani Madina ke qareeb ek jagah) ke matke jaise the aur uske patte hathi ke kaanon jitne bade the. Jibreel ne kaha, 'Yeh Sidrat-ul-Muntaha hai.' Dekho! Wahaan chaar nadiyaan beh rahi thi, do chhupi hui aur do zaahir. Maine pucha, 'Yeh do tarah ki nadiyaan kya hain, Aye Jibreel?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Jahaan tak chhupi hui nadiyon ka sawal hai, woh Jannat mein do nadiyaan hain aur zaahir nadiyaan Nile aur Euphrates hain.' Phir mujhe Al-Bait-ul-Ma'mur (yaani pavitr Ghar) dikhaya gaya, aur ek bartan sharab se bhara aur doosra doodh se bhara aur teesra shahad se bhara mere paas laaya gaya. Maine doodh liya. Jibreel ne kaha, 'Yeh Islami deen hai jiski aap aur aapke pairokaar pairvi kar rahe hain.' Phir namazen mujhpar farz ki gaee: din mein pachaas namazen. Jab main wapas gaya, main Musa ke paas se guzra jinhone (mujhse) pucha, 'Aapko kya hukum diya gaya hai?' Maine jawab diya, 'Mujhe din mein pachaas namazen padhne ka hukum diya gaya hai.' Musa ne kaha, 'Aapke pairokaar din mein pachaas namazen nahi jhel sakte, aur Allah ki qasam, maine aapse pahle logon ko aazmaya hai, aur maine Bani Israel ke saath (be-faayde) apni poori koshish ki hai. Apne Rab ke paas wapas jaiye aur kami maangiye taake aapke pairokaron ka bojh kam ho.' Isliye main wapas gaya, aur Allah ne mere liye das namazen kam kar di. Phir main phir Musa ke paas gaya, magar unhone wahi kaha jo pahle kaha tha. Phir main phir Allah ke paas wapas gaya aur usne das aur kam ki. Jab main Musa ke paas wapas aaya, unhone wahi kaha, main Allah ke paas gaya aur usne hukum diya ke din mein das namazen padhi jaen. Jab main Musa ke paas wapas aaya, unhone wahi salaah dohraee, isliye main Allah ke paas wapas gaya aur mujhe din mein paanch namazen padhne ka hukum mila. Jab main Musa ke paas wapas aaya, unhone kaha, 'Aapko kya hukum diya gaya hai?' Maine jawab diya, 'Mujhe din mein paanch namazen padhne ka hukum diya gaya hai.' Unhone kaha, 'Aapke pairokaar din mein paanch namazen nahi jhel sakte, aur beshak, mujhe aapse pahle logon ka anubhav hai, aur maine Bani Israel ke saath poori koshish ki hai, isliye apne Rab ke paas wapas jaiye aur kami maangiye taake aapke pairokaron ka bojh kam ho.' Maine kaha, 'Maine apne Rab se itni guzarish ki hai ke mujhe sharm mahsoos ho rahi hai, magar ab main santusht hoon aur Allah ke hukum ke aage samarpit hoon.' Jab main wahaan se nikla, maine ek aawaaz suni jo keh rahi thi, 'Maine apna hukum tay kar diya hai aur apne bandon ka bojh kam kar diya hai.'"

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Regarding the Statement of Allah" "And We granted the vision (Ascension to the heavens) which We made you see (as an actual eye witness) was only made as a trial for the people." (17.60) Ibn `Abbas added: The sights which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was shown on the Night Journey when he was taken to Bait-ulMaqdis (i.e. Jerusalem) were actual sights, (not dreams). And the Cursed Tree (mentioned) in the Qur'an is the tree of Zaqqum (itself)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke is farmaan ke baare mein: "Aur Humne woh drishya (yaani aasman ki chadhaee) dikhaee jo Humne aapko dikhaee (ek asli aankhon-dekhi gawah ke tor par), sirf logon ke liye ek azmaish ke tor par." (17:60) Ibn Abbas ne joda: Allah ke Rasool ko raat ki safar mein jo drishya dikhaee gaye, jab unhe Bait-ul-Maqdis (yaani Jerusalem) le jaya gaya, woh haqiqi drishya the (khwab nahi). Aur Quran mein varnit Shaapit Vriksh Zaqqum ka hi vriksh hai.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Ka`b:Who was Ka`b's guide when Ka`b turned blind: I heard Ka`b bin Malik narrating: When he remained behind (i.e. did not Join) the Prophet (ﷺ) in the Ghazwa of Tabuk. Ibn Bukair, in his narration stated that Ka`b said, " I witnessed the Al-`Aqaba pledge of allegiance at night with the Prophet (ﷺ) when we jointly agreed to support Islam with all our efforts I would not like to have attended the Badr battle instead of that 'Aqaba pledge although Badr is more well-known than it, amongst the people
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ka'b bataate hain (jo Ka'b ke andhe hone par unke rahnumaa the): Maine Ka'b bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko yeh riwaayat karte suna jab woh Tabuk ke Ghazwe mein Nabi ke saath shaamil nahi hue the. (Ibn Bukair, apni riwaayat mein, ne kaha ke Ka'b ne kaha,) "Maine raat ko Al-Aqaba ki bai'at mein Nabi ke saath maujoodgi di jab humne saamuhik soorat se poori taakat se Islam ka saath dene ka waada kiya. Mujhe Al-Aqaba ki bai'at ki jagah Badr ki jung mein shaamil hona pasand na hota, chahe Badr logon mein isse zyada mashhur hai."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:I was present with my two maternal uncles at Al-`Aqaba (where the pledge of allegiance was given). (Ibn 'Uyaina said, "One of the two was Al-Bara' bin Marur)
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main apne do mama ke bhaiyon ke saath Al-Aqaba mein maujood tha (jahaan bai'at di gaee). (Ibn Uyaina ne kaha, "Un donon mein se ek Al-Bara bin Marur the.")

e: Narrated Jabir:My father, my two maternal uncles and I were among those who took part in the 'Aqaba Pledge
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Mere waalid, mere do mama ke bhai, aur main, sab un logon mein the jinhone Al-Aqaba ki bai'at mein hissa liya.

e: Narrated 'Ubada bin As-Samit:Who had taken part in the battle of Badr with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and had been amongst his companions on the night of Al-`Aqaba Pledge: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), surrounded by a group of his companions said, "Come along and give me the pledge of allegiance that you will not worship anything besides Allah, will not steal, will not commit illegal sexual intercourse will not kill your children, will not utter; slander, invented by yourself, and will not disobey me if I order you to do something good. Whoever among you will respect and fulfill this pledge, will be rewarded by Allah. And if one of you commits any of these sins and is punished in this world then that will be his expiation for it, and if one of you commits any of these sins and Allah screens his sin, then his matter, will rest with Allah: If He will, He will punish him and if He will,. He will excuse him." So I gave the pledge of allegiance to him for these conditions
hi: Ubada bin As-Samit bataate hain (jinhone Badr ki jung mein Allah ke Rasool ke saath hissa liya tha aur Al-Aqaba ki bai'at ki raat unke sahaba mein se the): Allah ke Rasool ne, apne kuch sahaba se ghere hue, kaha, "Aao aur mujhe bai'at do ke tum Allah ke siwa kisi ki ibadat nahi karoge, chori nahi karoge, na-jaiz ta'alluq nahi banaoge, apne bachchon ko qatl nahi karoge, khud gadhi hui buraee ki baat nahi kahoge, aur agar main tumhe kuch achha karne ka hukum dun, meri na-farmani nahi karoge. Tum mein se jo bhi is bai'at ka aadar karega aur use poora karega, use Allah ajr dega. Aur agar tum mein se koi in gunahon mein se koee gunah karta hai aur isi duniya mein use saza milti hai, phir yehi uska kaffara hoga; aur agar tum mein se koi in gunahon mein se koee gunah karta hai aur Allah uske gunah ko chhupa deta hai, phir uska maamla Allah ke haath mein hoga: agar woh chahe, use saza dega, aur agar woh chahe, use maaf kar dega." Isliye maine unhe in sharton ke liye bai'at di.

e: Narrated 'Ubada bin As Samit:I was one of the Naqibs who gave the ('Aqaba) Pledge of Allegiance to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). We gave the pledge of allegiance to him that we would not worship anything other than Allah, would not steal, would not commit illegal sexual intercourse, would not kill a person whose killing Allah has made illegal except rightfully, would not rob each other, and we would not be promised Paradise if we did the above sins, then if we committed one of the above sins, Allah will give His Judgment concerning it
hi: Ubada bin As-Samit bataate hain: Main un Naqib (yaani sardaron) mein se ek tha jinhone Allah ke Rasool ko (Al-Aqaba ki) bai'at di. Humne unhe bai'at di ke hum Allah ke siwa kisi ki ibadat nahi karenge, chori nahi karenge, na-jaiz ta'alluq nahi banaenge, kisi aisi jaan ko qatl nahi karenge jise Allah ne haram kiya hai siwaye munasib kaaranon ke, ek-doosre ko lootenge nahi, aur agar hum in gunahon ko karte hain to humein Jannat ka waada nahi kiya jaayega; phir agar humne un gunahon mein se koee gunah kiya, Allah is baare mein apna faisla dega.

e: Narrated Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) engaged me when I was a girl of six (years). We went to Medina and stayed at the home of Bani-al-Harith bin Khazraj. Then I got ill and my hair fell down. Later on my hair grew (again) and my mother, Um Ruman, came to me while I was playing in a swing with some of my girl friends. She called me, and I went to her, not knowing what she wanted to do to me. She caught me by the hand and made me stand at the door of the house. I was breathless then, and when my breathing became alright, she took some water and rubbed my face and head with it. Then she took me into the house. There in the house I saw some Ansari women who said, "Best wishes and Allah's Blessing and a good luck." Then she entrusted me to them and they prepared me (for the marriage). Unexpectedly Allah's Apostle came to me in the forenoon and my mother handed me over to him, and at that time I was a girl of nine years of age
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi ne mujhse mangni ki jab main chhah saal ki ladki thi. Hum Madina aaye aur Banu Al-Harith bin Khazraj ke ghar mein ruke. Phir main bimar padi aur mere baal jhad gaye. Baad mein mere baal phir badhe, aur meri maa, Um Ruman, mere paas aee jabke main kuch saheliyon ke saath jhule par khel rahi thi. Unhone mujhe pukara, aur main unke paas gaee, bina yeh jaane ke woh mere saath kya karna chahti hain. Unhone mera haath pakada aur mujhe ghar ke darwaze par khada kiya. Us waqt mera saans phoola hua tha, aur jab meri saansen theek huee, unhone kuch paani liya aur mere chehre aur sar par mala. Phir woh mujhe ghar ke andar le gaee. Wahaan ghar mein maine kuch Ansaar aurton ko dekha jinhone kaha, "Shubh kaamnaen aur Allah ki barkat aur achhi kismat." Phir unhone mujhe unke haath mein sonp diya aur unhone mujhe (shaadi ke liye) taiyaar kiya. Achanak Allah ke Rasool dopahar ke waqt mere paas aaye aur meri maa ne mujhe unhe sonp diya, aur us waqt main nau saal ki ladki thi.

e: Narrated `Aisha:That the Prophet (ﷺ) said to her, "You have been shown to me twice in my dream. I saw you pictured on a piece of silk and some-one said (to me). 'This is your wife.' When I uncovered the picture, I saw that it was yours. I said, 'If this is from Allah, it will be done
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi ne unse kaha, "Tumhe mujhe khwab mein do baar dikhaya gaya. Maine tumhe resham ke ek tukde mein tasveer ke soorat mein dekha aur kisi ne (mujhse) kaha (mera matlab, farishte ne), 'Yeh tumhari biwi hai.' Jab maine tasveer ka kapda khola, maine dekha ke yeh tumhi thi. Maine (khud se) kaha, 'Agar yeh Allah ki taraf se hai, yeh poora hoga.'"

e: Narrated Hisham's father:Khadija died three years before the Prophet (ﷺ) departed to Medina. He stayed there for two years or so and then he married `Aisha when she was a girl of six years of age, and he consummated that marriage when she was nine years old
hi: Hisham ke waalid bataate hain: Khadija (رضی اللہ عنہا) ka intiqal Nabi ke Madina hijrat se teen saal pahle hua. Woh do saal ke aas-paas wahaan rahe aur phir Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se shaadi ki jabke woh chhah saal ki ladki thi, aur unhone shaadi tab poori ki jab woh nau saal ki ho gaee.

e: Narrated Abu Wail:We visited Khabbab who said, "We migrated with the Prophet (ﷺ) for Allah's Sake, so our reward became due and sure with Allah. Some of us passed away without taking anything of their rewards (in this world) and one of them was Mus`ab bin `Umair who was martyred on the day (of the battle) of Uhud leaving a striped woolen cloak. When we covered his head with it, his feet became naked, and when we covered his feet, his head became naked. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered us to cover his head and put some Idhkhir (i.e. a special kind of grass) on his feet. (On the other hand) some of us have had their fruits ripened (in this world) and they are collecting them
hi: Abu Wail bataate hain: Hum Khabbab (رضی اللہ عنہ) se milne gaye jinhone kaha, "Humne Allah ki khaatir Nabi ke saath hijrat ki, isliye humara ajr Allah ke paas nishchit hai. Humme se kuch is duniya se chale gaye bina apna ajr paye, aur unmein se ek Mus'ab bin Umair the jo Uhud ki jung ke din shaheed hue, ek dhaaridaar ooni chaadar chhodkar. Jab humne unke sar ise dhaka, unke paanv khule rahe, aur jab humne unke paanv dhake, unka sar khula rah gaya. Isliye Allah ke Rasool ne humein hukum diya unke sar ko dhaankne aur unke paanvon par kuch Idhkhir (yaani ek khaas qisam ki ghaas) rakhne ka. (Doosri taraf) humme se kuch ne apne phal pak jate dekhe (is duniya mein) aur woh unhe jama kar rahe hain."

e: Narrated `Umar:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "The reward of deeds depends on the intentions, so whoever emigrated for the worldly benefits or to marry a woman, his emigration was for that for which he emigrated, but whoever emigrated for the Sake of Allah and His Apostle, his emigration is for Allah and His Apostle
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi ko kehte suna, "Amalon ka ajr niyyat par nirbhar karta hai, isliye jisne bhi duniyavi faayde ke liye ya kisi aurat se shaadi karne ke liye hijrat ki, uski hijrat usi cheez ke liye thi jiske liye usne hijrat ki; magar jisne Allah aur uske Rasool ke liye hijrat ki, uski hijrat Allah aur uske Rasool ke liye hai."

e: Narrated Mujahid bin Jabir Al-Makki:`Abdullah bin `Umar used to say, "There is no more Hijrah (i.e. migration) after the Conquest of Mecca
hi: Mujahid bin Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Makki bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) kaha karte the, "Fatah-e-Mecca ke baad koi aur Hijrat nahi hai."

e: Narrated 'Ata bin Abi Rabah:`Ubaid bin `Umar Al-Laithi and I visited Aisha and asked her about the Hijra (i.e. migration), and she said, "Today there is no (Hijrah) emigration. A believer used to run away with his religion to Allah and His Apostle lest he should be put to trial because of his religion. Today Allah has made Islam triumphant, and today a believer can worship his Lord wherever he likes. But the deeds that are still rewardable (in place of emigration) are Jihad and good intentions." (See Hadith No. 42 Vol)
hi: Ata bin Abi Rabah bataate hain: Ubaid bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Laithi aur main Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se mile aur unse Hijrat ke baare mein pucha. Unhone kaha, "Aaj koi Hijrat nahi hai. Ek momin apne deen ke saath Allah aur uske Rasool ki taraf bhaagta tha, kahin unse apne deen ki wajah se aazmaish na jhelni pade. Aaj Allah ne Islam ko fatah dilaee hai, aur aaj ek momin jahaan chahe apne Rab ki ibadat kar sakta hai. Magar jo amal abhi bhi ajr wale hain (Hijrat ke bajaye) woh Jihad aur achhi niyyaten hain."

e: Narrated Aisha:Sa`d said, "O Allah! You know that there is none against whom I am eager to fight more willingly for Your Cause than those people who disbelieved Your Apostle and drove him out (of his city). O Allah! I think that You have ended the fight between us and them
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Sa'd ne kaha, "Aye Allah! Tu jaanta hai ke koi bhi mujhe utna khushi se jung na karana jitna un logon ke khilaf jo Teri qaum ke saath hue jinhone Tere Rasool ko jhutlaya aur unhe (unke shehar se) nikal diya. Aye Allah! Mujhe lagta hai Tune humare aur unke beech ki jung ko khatam kar diya hai."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) started receiving the Divine Inspiration at the age of forty. Then he stayed in Mecca for thirteen years, receiving the Divine Revelation. Then he was ordered to migrate and he lived as an Emigrant for ten years and then died at the age of sixty-three (years)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ko chalis saal ki umr mein Divine ilham milna shuru hua. Phir woh terah saal Mecca mein rahe, Divine ilham pate hue. Phir unhe hijrat karne ka hukum diya gaya, aur woh das saal Muhajir ke soorat mein rahe, aur phir tirepan (63) saal ki umr mein unka intiqal hua.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stayed in Mecca for thirteen years (after receiving the first Divine Inspiration) and died at the age of sixty-three
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool Mecca mein terah saal rahe (pahli Divine ilham milne ke baad) aur tirepan saal ki umr mein unka intiqal hua.

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sat on the pulpit and said, "Allah has given one of His Slaves the choice of receiving the splendor and luxury of the worldly life whatever he likes or to accept the good (of the Hereafter) which is with Allah. So he has chosen that good which is with Allah." On that Abu Bakr wept and said, "Our fathers and mothers be sacrificed for you." We became astonished at this. The people said, "Look at this old man! Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) talks about a Slave of Allah to whom He has given the option to choose either the splendor of this worldly life or the good which is with Him, while he says. 'our fathers and mothers be sacrificed for you." But it was Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who had been given the option, and Abu Bakr knew it better than we. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) added, "No doubt, I am indebted to Abu Bakr more than to anybody else regarding both his companionship and his wealth. And if I had to take a Khalil from my followers, I would certainly have taken Abu Bakr, but the fraternity of Islam is. sufficient. Let no door (i.e. Khoukha) of the Mosque remain open, except the door of Abu Bakr
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool mimbar par baithe aur kaha, "Allah ne apne ek bande ko ikhtiyaar diya hai ke woh is duniyavi zindagi ki shaano-shaukat ya jo achhaee use pasand ho use chune, ya Allah ke paas jo achhaee hai use qubool kare. Isliye usne woh achhaee chuni jo Allah ke paas hai." Isspar Abu Bakr ro pade aur kaha, "Humare maa-baap aapke liye qurbaan hon." Hum ispar hairat mein pade. Logon ne kaha, "Is boodhe shaks ko dekho! Allah ke Rasool Allah ke ek bande ke baare mein baat kar rahe hain jise usne is duniyavi zindagi ki shaano-shaukat ya uske paas jo achhaee hai use chune ka ikhtiyaar diya, jabke yeh (Abu Bakr) kahte hain, 'Humare maa-baap aapke liye qurbaan hon.'" Magar asal mein Allah ke Rasool hi woh the jinhe ikhtiyaar diya gaya tha, aur Abu Bakr yeh humare muqaable mein zyada achhi tarah jaante the. Allah ke Rasool ne joda, "Koi shak nahi, main sabse zyada Abu Bakr ka aabhaari hoon unki sohbat aur unki daulat donon ke liye. Aur agar main apne pairokaron mein se koi Khalil banata, main zaroor Abu Bakr ko banata, magar Islami bhaeechara kaafi hai. Masjid ke koee bhi darwaza khula mat rehne do siwaye Abu Bakr ke darwaze ke."

e: Narrated 'Aisha: (the wife of the Prophet) I never remembered my parents believing in any religion other than the true religion (i.e. Islam), and (I don't remember) a single day passing without our being visited by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the morning and in the evening. When the Muslims were put to test (i.e. troubled by the pagans), Abu Bakr set out migrating to the land of Ethiopia, and when he reached Bark-al-Ghimad, Ibn Ad-Daghina, the chief of the tribe of Qara, met him and said, "O Abu Bakr! Where are you going?" Abu Bakr replied, "My people have turned me out (of my country), so I want to wander on the earth and worship my Lord." Ibn Ad-Daghina said, "O Abu Bakr! A man like you should not leave his home-land, nor should he be driven out, because you help the destitute earn their livings, and you keep good relations with your Kith and kin, help the weak and poor, entertain guests generously, and help the calamity-stricken persons. Therefore I am your protector. Go back and worship your Lord in your town." So Abu Bakr returned and Ibn Ad-Daghina accompanied him. In the evening Ibn Ad-Daghina visited the nobles of Quraish and said to them. "A man like Abu Bakr should not leave his homeland, nor should he be driven out. Do you (i.e. Quraish) drive out a man who helps the destitute earn their living, keeps good relations with his Kith and kin, helps the weak and poor, entertains guests generously and helps the calamity-stricken persons?" So the people of Quraish could not refuse Ibn Ad-Daghina's protection, and they said to Ibn Ad-Daghina, "Let Abu Bakr worship his Lord in his house. He can pray and recite there whatever he likes, but he should not hurt us with it, and should not do it publicly, because we are afraid that he may affect our women and children." Ibn Ad-Daghina told Abu Bakr of all that. Abu Bakr stayed in that state, worshipping his Lord in his house. He did not pray publicly, nor did he recite Quran outside his house. Then a thought occurred to Abu Bakr to build a mosque in front of his house, and there he used to pray and recite the Quran. The women and children of the pagans began to gather around him in great number. They used to wonder at him and look at him. Abu Bakr was a man who used to weep too much, and he could not help weeping on reciting the Quran. That situation scared the nobles of the pagans of Quraish, so they sent for Ibn Ad-Daghina. When he came to them, they said, "We accepted your protection of Abu Bakr on condition that he should worship his Lord in his house, but he has violated the conditions and he has built a mosque in front of his house where he prays and recites the Quran publicly. We are now afraid that he may affect our women and children unfavorably. So, prevent him from that. If he likes to confine the worship of his Lord to his house, he may do so, but if he insists on doing that openly, ask him to release you from your obligation to protect him, for we dislike to break our pact with you, but we deny Abu Bakr the right to announce his act publicly." Ibn Ad-Daghina went to Abu- Bakr and said, ("O Abu Bakr!) You know well what contract I have made on your behalf; now, you are either to abide by it, or else release me from my obligation of protecting you, because I do not want the 'Arabs hear that my people have dishonored a contract I have made on behalf of another man." Abu Bakr replied, "I release you from your pact to protect me, and am pleased with the protection from Allah." At that time the Prophet (ﷺ) was in Mecca, and he said to the Muslims, "In a dream I have been shown your migration place, a land of date palm trees, between two mountains, the two stony tracts." So, some people migrated to Medina, and most of those people who had previously migrated to the land of Ethiopia, returned to Medina. Abu Bakr also prepared to leave for Medina, but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him, "Wait for a while, because I hope that I will be allowed to migrate also." Abu Bakr said, "Do you indeed expect this? Let my father be sacrificed for you!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Yes." So Abu Bakr did not migrate for the sake of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in order to accompany him. He fed two she-camels he possessed with the leaves of As-Samur tree that fell on being struck by a stick for four months. One day, while we were sitting in Abu Bakr's house at noon, someone said to Abu Bakr, "This is Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with his head covered coming at a time at which he never used to visit us before." Abu Bakr said, "May my parents be sacrificed for him. By Allah, he has not come at this hour except for a great necessity." So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came and asked permission to enter, and he was allowed to enter. When he entered, he said to Abu Bakr. "Tell everyone who is present with you to go away." Abu Bakr replied, "There are none but your family. May my father be sacrificed for you, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I have been given permission to migrate." Abu Bakr said, "Shall I accompany you? May my father be sacrificed for you, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Yes." Abu Bakr said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! May my father be sacrificed for you, take one of these two she-camels of mine." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, "(I will accept it) with payment." So we prepared the baggage quickly and put some journey food in a leather bag for them. Asma, Abu Bakr's daughter, cut a piece from her waist belt and tied the mouth of the leather bag with it, and for that reason she was named Dhat-un-Nitaqain (i.e. the owner of two belts). Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr reached a cave on the mountain of Thaur and stayed there for three nights. 'Abdullah bin Abi Bakr who was intelligent and a sagacious youth, used to stay (with them) overnight. He used to leave them before day break so that in the morning he would be with Quraish as if he had spent the night in Mecca. He would keep in mind any plot made against them, and when it became dark he would (go and) inform them of it. 'Amir bin Fuhaira, the freed slave of Abu Bakr, used to bring the milch sheep (of his master, Abu Bakr) to them a little while after nightfall in order to rest the sheep there. So they always had fresh milk at night, the milk of their sheep, and the milk which they warmed by throwing heated stones in it. 'Amir bin Fuhaira would then call the herd away when it was still dark (before daybreak). He did the same in each of those three nights. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr had hired a man from the tribe of Bani Ad-Dail from the family of Bani Abd bin Adi as an expert guide, and he was in alliance with the family of Al-'As bin Wail As-Sahmi and he was on the religion of the infidels of Quraish. The Prophet (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr trusted him and gave him their two she-camels and took his promise to bring their two she camels to the cave of the mountain of Thaur in the morning after three nights later. And (when they set out), 'Amir bin Fuhaira and the guide went along with them and the guide led them along the sea-shore
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain (Nabi ki biwi): Mujhe kabhi yaad nahi ke mere maa-baap ne kabhi kisi aur deen ki ibadat ki ho siwaye sachche deen (yaani Islam) ke, aur (mujhe yaad nahi) ek bhi din aisa guzra jismein Allah ke Rasool humare paas subah-shaam na aaye hon. Jab Musalmanon ko aazmaish mein daala gaya (yaani kaafiron ne unhe sataya), Abu Bakr Ethiopia ki taraf hijrat ke liye nikle, aur jab woh Bark-al-Ghimad pahunche, Ibn Ad-Daghina, Qara qabile ke sardaar, unse mile aur pucha, "Aye Abu Bakr! Aap kahaan ja rahe hain?" Abu Bakr ne jawab diya, "Meri qaum ne mujhe nikal diya hai, isliye main zameen par ghoomna aur apne Rab ki ibadat karna chahta hoon." Ibn Ad-Daghina ne kaha, "Aye Abu Bakr! Aap jaise shaks ko na apna gaanv chhodna chahiye na hi unhe nikala jaana chahiye, kyunke aap gareebon ki kamaee mein madad karte hain, apne rishtedaron ke saath achhe ta'alluq rakhte hain, kamzoron aur gareebon ki madad karte hain, mehmaanon ki achhi izzat karte hain, aur museebat mein pade logon ki madad karte hain. Isliye main aapka rakshak hoon. Wapas jaiye aur apne shehar mein apne Rab ki ibadat kariye." Isliye Abu Bakr wapas gaye aur Ibn Ad-Daghina unke saath the. Shaam ko Ibn Ad-Daghina Quraish ke izzatdaar logon se mile aur unse kaha, "Abu Bakr jaisa shaks ko na apna gaanv chhodna chahiye na unhe nikala jaana chahiye. Kya tum (yaani Quraish) aise shaks ko nikaloge jo gareebon ki kamaee mein madad karta hai, apne rishtedaron ke saath achha suluk rakhta hai, kamzoron aur gareebon ki madad karta hai, mehmaanon ki bahut achhi izzat karta hai, aur museebat mein pade logon ki madad karta hai?" Isliye Quraish ke log Ibn Ad-Daghina ki panah ko radd nahi kar sake, aur unhone Ibn Ad-Daghina se kaha, "Abu Bakr ko apne ghar mein apne Rab ki ibadat karne do. Woh wahaan namaz padh sakte hain aur jo bhi chahen padh sakte hain, magar unhe isse takleef nahi deni chahiye, aur na khule-aam karna chahiye, kyunke humein dar hai woh humari aurton aur bachchon ko prabhavit na kar den." Ibn Ad-Daghina ne yeh sab Abu Bakr ko bataya. Abu Bakr isi haalat mein rahe, apne ghar mein apne Rab ki ibadat karte hue. Woh khule-aam namaz nahi padhte the, na apne ghar ke bahar Quran padhte the. Phir Abu Bakr ke man mein khyaal aaya ke woh apne ghar ke saamne ek masjid banaen, aur wahaan woh namaz padhte aur Quran padhte. Kaafiron ki aurten aur bachche unke aas-paas bhaari tadaad mein jama hone lage. Woh unpar hairat hote aur unhe dekhte. Abu Bakr ek aisa shaks the jo bahut zyada rote the, aur Quran padhte waqt woh apni rone ki bhaavna ko rok nahi sakte the. Yeh haalat Quraish ke izzatdaar kaafiron ko darane lagi, isliye unhone Ibn Ad-Daghina ko bulaya. Jab woh unke paas aaye, unhone kaha, "Humne Abu Bakr ki tumhari panah isliye qubool ki thi ke woh apne ghar mein apne Rab ki ibadat karenge, magar unhone sharton ka ullanghan kiya hai aur apne ghar ke saamne ek masjid banaee jahaan woh khule-aam namaz padhte aur Quran padhte hain. Ab humein dar hai ke woh humari aurton aur bachchon ko prabhavit kar sakte hain. Isliye unhe isse roka jaaye. Agar woh apne Rab ki ibadat sirf apne ghar tak seemit rakhna chahen, woh aisa kar sakte hain, magar agar woh ise khule-aam karne par zid karte hain, unse kahiye tumhe apni panah ki zimmedaari se azaad kar den, kyunke humein apne muahide ko tumhare saath todna pasand nahi, magar hum Abu Bakr ko apna amal khule-aam karne ka haqq nahi dete." Ibn Ad-Daghina Abu Bakr ke paas gaye aur kaha, "(Aye Abu Bakr!) Aap achhi tarah jaante hain maine aapke liye kya muahida kiya hai; ab, aapko ya to iska paalan karna hoga, ya mujhe aapki hifaazat ki zimmedaari se azaad karna hoga, kyunke main nahi chahta Arb yeh sunen ke meri qaum ne kisi doosre shaks ki taraf se kiye gaye ek muahide ka apman kiya hai." Abu Bakr ne jawab diya, "Main aapko meri hifaazat ki zimmedaari se azaad karta hoon, aur main Allah ki panah se khush hoon." Us waqt Nabi Mecca mein the, aur unhone Musalmanon se kaha, "Ek khwab mein mujhe tumhari hijrat ki jagah dikhaee gaee hai, khajoor ke darakhton wali ek zameen, do pahadon ke beech, do patharile ilakon mein." Isliye kuch log Madina hijrat ke liye gaye, aur zyada tar woh log jo pahle Ethiopia gaye the, Madina wapas aaye. Abu Bakr ne bhi Madina jane ki taiyaari ki, magar Allah ke Rasool ne unse kaha, "Thoda intezaar kariye, kyunke mujhe ummeed hai mujhe bhi hijrat ki ijazat milegi." Abu Bakr ne kaha, "Kya aap sach mein aisi ummeed rakhte hain? Mera baap aapke liye qurbaan ho!" Nabi ne kaha, "Haan." Isliye Abu Bakr Allah ke Rasool ki khaatir hijrat nahi ki taaki unke saath ja saken. Unhone apni do untniyon ko As-Samur darakht ke patte khilaye, chaar mahine tak, jinhe ek laathi se maar kar giraya jata tha. Ek din, jabke hum dopahar ko Abu Bakr ke ghar mein baithe the, kisi ne Abu Bakr se kaha, "Yeh Allah ke Rasool hain, apna sar dhaanke hue, aise waqt aa rahe hain jispar woh pahle kabhi humare paas nahi aaye." Abu Bakr ne kaha, "Mere maa-baap unke liye qurbaan hon. Allah ki qasam, woh is waqt sirf kisi bade zaroorat ke liye hi aate hain." Isliye Allah ke Rasool aaye aur andar aane ki ijazat maangi, aur unhe ijazat mil gaee. Jab woh andar aaye, unhone Abu Bakr se kaha, "Jo bhi tumhare saath maujood hain unhe jane ko kaho." Abu Bakr ne jawab diya, "Yahaan koee aur nahi siwaye aapke pariwara ke. Mera baap aapke liye qurbaan ho, Ya Allah ke Rasool!" Nabi ne kaha, "Mujhe hijrat ki ijazat mil gaee hai." Abu Bakr ne pucha, "Kya main aapke saath aaun? Mera baap aapke liye qurbaan ho, Ya Allah ke Rasool!" Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Haan." Abu Bakr ne kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Mera baap aapke liye qurbaan ho, in do untniyon mein se ek lijiye." Allah ke Rasool ne jawab diya, "(Main ise qubool karunga) qeemat ke saath." Isliye humne jaldi se saaman baandh liya aur unke liye kuch safar ka khaana ek chamde ke thaile mein rakha. Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا), Abu Bakr ki beti, ne apni komar ki patti ka ek hissa kaata aur usse thaile ka munh baandha, aur isi wajah se unse Dhat-un-Nitaqain (yaani do pattiyon wali) kaha jata hai. Phir Allah ke Rasool aur Abu Bakr Thaur pahad ki ek gufa tak pahunche aur teen raaten wahaan ruke. Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Bakr, jo ek buddhiman aur aqlmand jawan the, unke saath raat bitate the.
