Woh subah hone se pahle nikal jate taaki subah tak woh Quraish ke saath aise dikhen mano woh Mecca mein hi soye the. Woh unke khilaf koee bhi saazish dhyaan mein rakhte aur andhera hote hi unhe khabar dete. Amir bin Fuhaira, Abu Bakr ke azaad kiye gulaam, apni bhed-bakriyaan unke paas raat hote hi lekar aate taaki bhedein wahaan aaraam kar saken. Isliye unke paas raat ko taaza doodh milta, unki bhedon ka, aur woh doodh jo woh garam partharon ko usmein daalkar garam karte. Amir bin Fuhaira phir andhere mein hi (subah hone se pahle) apna rewad le jata. Aisa hi unhone teenon raaton mein kiya. Allah ke Rasool aur Abu Bakr ne Bani Ad-Dail qabile ke Bani Abd bin Adi pariwara se ek shaks ko ek maahir raah-dikhane wale ke tor par kiraye par liya tha, aur woh Al-As bin Wail As-Sahmi ke pariwara ke saath muahide mein tha aur Quraish ke kaafiron ke deen par tha. Nabi aur Abu Bakr ne unpar bharosa kiya aur unhe apni do untniyaan di aur unse teen raaton baad Thaur pahad ki gufa mein subah unke saath milne ka waada liya. Amir bin Fuhaira aur guide unke saath gaye aur guide unhe samundar ke kinare se raste par le gaya.

e: The nephew of Suraqa bin Ju'shum said that his father informed him that he heard Suraqa bin Ju'shum saying, "The messengers of the heathens of Quraish came to us declaring that they had assigned for the persons who would kill or arrest Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr, a reward equal to their bloodmoney. While I was sitting in one of the gatherings of my tribe, Bani Mudlij, a man from them came to us and stood up while we were sitting, and said, "O Suraqa! No doubt, I have just seen some people far away on the seashore, and I think they are Muhammad and his companions." Suraqa added, "I too realized that it must have been they. But I said 'No, it is not they, but you have seen so-and-so, and so-and-so whom we saw set out.' I stayed in the gathering for a while and then got up and left for my home and ordered my slave-girl to get my horse which was behind a hillock, and keep it ready for me. Then I took my spear and left by the back door of my house dragging the lower end of the spear on the ground and keeping it low. Then I reached my horse, mounted it and made it gallop. When I approached them (i.e. Muhammad and Abu Bakr), my horse stumbled and I fell down from it, Then I stood up, got hold of my quiver and took out the divining arrows and drew lots as to whether I should harm them (i.e. the Prophet (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr) or not, and the lot which I disliked came out. But I remounted my horse and let it gallop, giving no importance to the divining arrows. When I heard the recitation of the Quran by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who did not look hither and thither while Abu Bakr was doing it often, suddenly the forelegs of my horse sank into the ground up to the knees, and I fell down from it. Then I rebuked it and it got up but could hardly take out its forelegs from the ground, and when it stood up straight again, its fore-legs caused dust to rise up in the sky like smoke. Then again I drew lots with the divining arrows, and the lot which I disliked, came out. So I called upon them to feel secure. They stopped, and I remounted my horse and went to them. When I saw how I had been hampered from harming them, it came to my mind that the cause of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (i.e. Islam) will become victorious. So I said to him, "Your people have assigned a reward equal to the bloodmoney for your head." Then I told them all the plans the people of Mecca had made concerning them. Then I offered them some journey food and goods but they refused to take anything and did not ask for anything, but the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not tell others about us." Then I requested him to write for me a statement of security and peace. He ordered 'Amr bin Fuhaira who wrote it for me on a parchment, and then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) proceeded on his way. Narrated 'Urwa bin Az-Zubair:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) met Az-Zubair in a caravan of Muslim merchants who were returning from Sham. Az-Zubair provided Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr with white clothes to wear. When the Muslims of Medina heard the news of the departure of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) from Mecca (towards Medina), they started going to the Harra every morning . They would wait for him till the heat of the noon forced them to return. One day, after waiting for a long while, they returned home, and when they went into their houses, a Jew climbed up the roof of one of the forts of his people to look for something, and he saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and his companions dressed in white clothes, emerging out of the desert mirage. The Jew could not help shouting at the top of his voice, "O you 'Arabs! Here is your great man whom you have been waiting for!" So all the Muslims rushed to their arms and received Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the summit of Harra. The Prophet (ﷺ) turned with them to the right and alighted at the quarters of Bani 'Amr bin 'Auf, and this was on Monday in the month of Rabi-ul-Awal. Abu Bakr stood up, receiving the people while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sat down and kept silent. Some of the Ansar who came and had not seen Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) before, began greeting Abu Bakr, but when the sunshine fell on Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr came forward and shaded him with his sheet only then the people came to know Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stayed with Bani 'Amr bin 'Auf for ten nights and established the mosque (mosque of Quba) which was founded on piety. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prayed in it and then mounted his she-camel and proceeded on, accompanied by the people till his she-camel knelt down at (the place of) the Mosque of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) at Medina. Some Muslims used to pray there in those days, and that place was a yard for drying dates belonging to Suhail and Sahl, the orphan boys who were under the guardianship of 'Asad bin Zurara. When his she-camel knelt down, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "This place, Allah willing, will be our abiding place." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then called the two boys and told them to suggest a price for that yard so that he might take it as a mosque. The two boys said, "No, but we will give it as a gift, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then built a mosque there. The Prophet (ﷺ) himself started carrying unburnt bricks for its building and while doing so, he was saying "This load is better than the load of Khaibar, for it is more pious in the Sight of Allah and purer and better rewardable." He was also saying, "O Allah! The actual reward is the reward in the Hereafter, so bestow Your Mercy on the Ansar and the Emigrants." Thus the Prophet (ﷺ) recited (by way of proverb) the poem of some Muslim poet whose name is unknown to me. (Ibn Shihab said, "In the Hadiths it does not occur that Allah's Apostle recited a complete poetic verse other than this one)
hi: Suraqa bin Ju'shum ke bhatije bataate hain: Unke waalid ne unhe bataya ke unhone Suraqa bin Ju'shum ko kehte suna, "Quraish ke kaafiron ke sandesh-vahak humare paas aaye, elaan karte hue ke unhone Allah ke Rasool aur Abu Bakr ko qatl ya giraftaar karne wale ke liye unke khoon-baha ke barabar ajr rakha hai. Jabke main apni qaum, Banu Mudlij ki ek sabha mein baitha tha, unmein se ek shaks aaya aur khade hote huye, jabke hum baithe the, kaha, 'Aye Suraqa! Maine samundar ke kinare kuch log dekhe hain, mujhe lagta hai woh Muhammad aur unke sathi hain.' Suraqa ne joda, 'Mujhe bhi lagta tha woh wahi honge. Magar maine kaha, Nahi, yeh woh nahi hain, tumne falaan-falaan ko dekha hoga jo nikle the.' Main sabha mein kuch der ruka aur phir uthkar apne ghar chala gaya aur apni launDi se kaha mera ghoda jo ek pahadi ke peeche tha, laane ko. Phir maine apna bhaala liya aur ghar ke pichhle darwaze se nikla, bhaale ke neeche wale sire ko zameen par ghaseette hue aur use neeche rakhte hue. Phir main apne ghode tak pahuncha, uspar sawar hua aur use daudaya. Jab main unke qareeb pahuncha, mera ghoda khokla aur main usse gir gaya. Phir main utha, apna teer-tarkash pakada aur mustaqbil batane wale teer nikale aur qura ki ki mujhe unhe (yaani Nabi aur Abu Bakr ko) nuksaan pahunchana chahiye ya nahi, aur jo qura napasand tha woh nikla. Magar main phir bhi apne ghode par sawar hua aur use daudaya, mustaqbil batane wale teeron ki parwaah na karte hue. Jab maine Allah ke Rasool ki Quran tilaawat suni, jo idhar-udhar nahi dekh rahe the jabke Abu Bakr aksar dekhte the, achanak mere ghode ke agle paanv zameen mein ghutnon tak dhaans gaye, aur main gir gaya. Phir maine use daanta aur woh utha magar apne agle paanvon ko zameen se nikal nahi paaya, aur jab woh phir seedha khada hua, uske agle paanvon ne aasman mein dhool ka dhuaan jaisa uthaya. Phir maine mustaqbil batane wale teeron se dobara qura kiya, aur jo qura napasand tha woh nikla. Isliye maine unhe (nirdhaya) mahfooz hone ka aashvasan diya. Woh ruke, aur main apne ghode par sawar hokar unke paas gaya. Jab maine dekha kaise mujhe unhe nuksaan pahunchane se roka gaya, mere man mein aaya ke Allah ke Rasool ka uddeshya (yaani Islam) fatah paega. Isliye maine unse kaha, 'Aapki qaum ne aapke sar ke liye khoon-baha ke barabar ajr rakha hai.' Phir maine unhe Mecca ke logon ke sab plaan bataye jo unke baare mein bane the. Phir maine unhe kuch safar ka khaana aur saaman pesh kiya magar unhone kuch lene se inkaar kiya aur kuch maanga nahi, magar Nabi ne kaha, 'Humare baare mein doosron ko mat batana.' Phir maine unse mere liye ek hifaazat aur shaanti ka farmaan likhne ki guzarish ki. Unhone Amr bin Fuhaira ko hukum diya jinhone use mere liye ek chamde par likha, aur phir Allah ke Rasool apne raste par chal pade. Urwa bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ki mulaqaat Az-Zubair se ek Musalman vyaapariyon ke caravan mein huee jo Sham se wapas aa rahe the. Az-Zubair ne Allah ke Rasool aur Abu Bakr ko pahnne ke liye safed kapde diye. Jab Madina ke Musalmanon ne Allah ke Rasool ke Mecca se prasthan (Madina ki taraf) ki khabar suni, woh har subah Al-Harra jane lage. Woh unkaa intezaar karte jab tak dopahar ki garmi unhe wapas jane par majboor karti. Ek din, lambe intezaar ke baad, woh apne gharon mein wapas gaye, aur jab woh apne gharon mein gaye, ek Yahudi apni qaum ke ek qile ki chhat par chadha kuch dekhne ke liye, aur usne Allah ke Rasool aur unke sathiyon ko safed kapde pahne, registaan ke dhundle drishya se nikalte dekha. Yahudi apni sabse tez aawaaz mein chillane se khud ko rok nahi paya, "Aye tum Arabo! Yahaan hai tumhara mahaan shakhs jiska tumne intezaar kiya hai!" Isliye sab Musalman apne hathiyaron ki taraf daude aur Allah ke Rasool ka Al-Harra ki chotti par swagat kiya. Nabi unke saath dahini taraf mude aur Banu Amr bin Auf ke ilake mein utre, aur yeh Rabi-ul-Awal mahine ke somvaar ke din tha. Abu Bakr khade hue, logon ka swagat karte hue jabke Allah ke Rasool baithe rahe aur khaamosh rahe. Ansaar mein se kuch jo aaye the aur pahle Allah ke Rasool ko nahi dekha tha, Abu Bakr ko salaam karne lage, magar jab suraj ki roshni Allah ke Rasool par padi aur Abu Bakr aage badhe aur apni chaadar se unhe chhaaya di, tabhi logon ko Allah ke Rasool ka pata chala. Allah ke Rasool Banu Amr bin Auf ke saath das raaten rahe aur masjid (Quba ki masjid) sthapit ki jiski buniyaad taqwa par rakhi gaee thi. Allah ke Rasool ne usmein namaz padhi aur phir apni untni par sawar hue aur logon ke saath aage badhe jab tak unki untni Madina mein Allah ke Rasool ki masjid ki jagah baith gaee. Kuch Musalman us waqt wahaan namaz padhte the, aur woh jagah Suhail aur Sahl, do anaath ladkon ki khajoor sukhane ki jagah thi jo Asad bin Zurara ke sarparasti mein the. Jab unki untni baith gaee, Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Yeh jagah, Insha Allah, humari rehne ki jagah hogi." Allah ke Rasool ne phir un do ladkon ko bulaya aur unse us jagah ki qeemat batane ko kaha taaki woh ise masjid ke tor par le sakein. Do ladkon ne kaha, "Nahi, hum ise tohfe ke tor par denge, Ya Allah ke Rasool!" Allah ke Rasool ne phir wahaan ek masjid banaee. Nabi ne khud iski nirmaan ke liye kachchi eenten uthaani shuru ki aur aisa karte huye, woh keh rahe the "Yeh bojh Khaibar ke bojh se behtar hai, kyunke yeh Allah ki nazar mein zyada pavitr aur zyada shuddh aur behtar ajr dene wala hai." Woh yeh bhi keh rahe the, "Aye Allah! Asli ajr Aakhirat ka ajr hai, isliye Ansaar aur Muhajir par apni Rehmat naazil kar." Isliye Nabi ne ek Musalman kavi ki kavita ka ek uddharan diya (jiska naam mujhe pata nahi). (Ibn Shihab ne kaha, "Hadithon mein aisa nahi milta ke Allah ke Rasool ne is ek ke ilawa koee poori kavita ki panktiyaan padhi hon.")

e: Narrated Asma:I prepared the journey food for the Prophet (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr when they wanted (to migrate to) Medina. I said to my father (Abu Bakr), "I do not have anything to tie the container of the journey food with except my waist belt." He said, "Divide it lengthwise into two." I did so, and for this reason I was named 'Dhat-un-Nitaqain' (i.e. the owner of two belts). (Ibn `Abbas said, "Asma', Dhat-un-Nitaq)
hi: Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine Nabi aur Abu Bakr ke liye safar ka khaana taiyaar kiya jab woh Madina (hijrat karna) chahte the. Maine apne waalid (Abu Bakr) se kaha, "Mere paas khaane ke thaile ko baandhne ke liye kuch nahi hai siwaye apni komar ki patti ke." Unhone kaha, "Ise lambaee mein do hisson mein kaato." Maine aisa hi kiya, aur isi wajah se mujhe 'Dhat-un-Nitaqain' (yaani do pattiyon wali) kaha jata hai. (Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Asma, Dhat-un-Nitaq")

e: Narrated Al-Bara:When the Prophet (ﷺ) migrated to Medina, Suraqa bin Malik bin Ju'shum pursued him. The Prophet (ﷺ) invoked evil on him, therefore the forelegs of his horse sank into the ground. Suraqa said (to the Prophet ), "Invoke Allah to rescue me, and I will not harm you. "The Prophet (ﷺ) invoked Allah for him. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) felt thirsty and he passed by a shepherd. Abu Bakr said, "I took a bowl and milked a little milk in it and brought it to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he drank till I was pleased
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Jab Nabi Madina hijrat ke liye nikle, Suraqa bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ju'shum ne unka picha kiya. Nabi ne unpar bad-dua ki, isliye unke ghode ke agle paanv zameen mein dhaanse gaye. Suraqa ne (Nabi se) kaha, "Allah se dua kariye mujhe bachane ke liye, aur main aapko nuksaan nahi pahunchaunga." Nabi ne unke liye Allah se dua ki. Phir Allah ke Rasool ko pyaas lagi aur woh ek charwahe ke paas se guzre. Abu Bakr ne kaha, "Maine ek pyaala liya aur usmein thoda doodh nikala aur Nabi ke paas laaya, aur unhone piya jab tak main santusht ho gaya."

e: Narrated Asma:That she conceived `Abdullah bin Az-Zubair. She added, "I migrated to Medina while I was at full term of pregnancy and alighted at Quba where I gave birth to him. Then I brought him to the Prophet (ﷺ) and put him in his lap. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked for a date, chewed it, and put some of its juice in the child's mouth. So, the first thing that entered the child's stomach was the saliva of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Then the Prophet rubbed the child's palate with a date and invoked for Allah's Blessings on him, and he was the first child born amongst the Emigrants in the Islamic Land (i.e. Medina)
hi: Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Woh Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) se garbhvati thi. Unhone joda, "Main Madina hijrat karke aee jabke main garbhavastha ke aakhri charan mein thi, aur Quba mein utri jahaan maine unhe paidaish diya. Phir main unhe Nabi ke paas laee aur unhe unki god mein rakha. Nabi ne ek khajoor maangi, use chabaya, aur uska kuch ras bachche ke munh mein rakha. Isliye sabse pahli cheez jo bachche ke pet mein gaee, woh Allah ke Rasool ka laar tha. Phir Nabi ne bachche ki taalu ko khajoor se ragada aur uske liye Allah ki barkat ki dua ki, aur woh Islami zameen (yaani Madina) mein Muhajiron ke beech paida hone wala pahla bachcha tha."

e: Narrated Aisha:The first child who was born in the Islamic Land (i.e. Medina) amongst the Emigrants, was `Abdullah bin Az-Zubair. They brought him to the Prophet. The Prophet (ﷺ) took a date, and after chewing it, put its juice in his mouth. So the first thing that went into the child's stomach, was the saliva of the Prophet
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Islami zameen (yaani Madina) mein Muhajiron ke beech paida hone wala pahla bachcha Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) tha. Woh unhe Nabi ke paas laaye. Nabi ne ek khajoor li, aur use chabane ke baad, uska ras unke munh mein daala. Isliye sabse pahli cheez jo bachche ke pet mein gaee, woh Nabi ka laar tha.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) arrived at Medina with Abu Bakr, riding behind him on the same camel. Abu Bakr was an elderly man known to the people, while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was a youth that was unknown. Thus, if a man met Abu Bakr, he would say, "O Abu Bakr! Who is this man in front of you?" Abu Bakr would say, "This man shows me the Way," One would think that Abu Bakr meant the road, while in fact, Abu Bakr meant the way of virtue and good. Then Abu Bakr looked behind and saw a horse-rider pursuing them. He said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! This is a horse-rider pursuing us." The Prophet (ﷺ) looked behind and said, "O Allah! Cause him to fall down." So the horse threw him down and got up neighing. After that the rider, Suraqa said, "O Allah's Prophet! Order me whatever you want." The Prophet said, "Stay where you are and do not allow anybody to reach us." So, in the first part of the day Suraqa was an enemy of Allah's Prophet and in the last part of it, he was a protector. Then Allah's Apostle alighted by the side of the Al-Harra and sent a message to the Ansar, and they came to Allah's Prophet and Abu Bakr, and having greeted them, they said, "Ride (your she-camels) safe and obeyed." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr rode and the Ansar, carrying their arms, surrounded them. The news that Allah's Prophet had come circulated in Medina. The people came out and were eagerly looking and saying "Allah's Prophet has come! Allah's Prophet has come! So the Prophet (ﷺ) went on till he alighted near the house of Abu Ayub. While the Prophet (ﷺ) was speaking with the family members of Abu Ayub, `Abdullah bin Salam heard the news of his arrival while he himself was picking the dates for his family from his family garden. He hurried to the Prophet (ﷺ) carrying the dates which he had collected for his family from the garden. He listened to Allah's Prophet and then went home. Then Allah's Prophet said, "Which is the nearest of the houses of our kith and kin?" Abu Ayub replied, "Mine, O Allah's Prophet! This is my house and this is my gate." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Go and prepare a place for our midday rest." Abu Ayub said, "Get up (both of you) with Allah's Blessings." So when Allah's Prophet went into the house, `Abdullah bin Salam came and said "I testify that you (i.e. Muhammad) are Apostle of Allah and that you have come with the Truth. The Jews know well that I am their chief and the son of their chief and the most learned amongst them and the son of the most learned amongst them. So send for them (i.e. Jews) and ask them about me before they know that I have embraced Islam, for if they know that they will say about me things which are not correct." So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent for them, and they came and entered. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to them, "O (the group of) Jews! Woe to you: be afraid of Allah. By Allah except Whom none has the right to be worshipped, you people know for certain, that I am Apostle of Allah and that I have come to you with the Truth, so embrace Islam." The Jews replied, "We do not know this." So they said this to the Prophet and he repeated it thrice. Then he said, "What sort of a man is `Abdullah bin Salam amongst you?" They said, "He is our chief and the son of our chief and the most learned man, and the son of the most learned amongst us." He said, "What would you think if he should embrace Islam?" They said, "Allah forbid! He can not embrace Islam." He said, " What would you think if he should embrace Islam?" They said, "Allah forbid! He can not embrace Islam." He said, "What would you think if he should embrace Islam?" They said, "Allah forbid! He can not embrace Islam." He said, "O Ibn Salam! Come out to them." He came out and said, "O (the group of) Jews! Be afraid of Allah except Whom none has the right to be worshipped. You know for certain that he is Apostle of Allah and that he has brought a True Religion!' They said, "You tell a lie." On that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) turned them out
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool Madina pahunche Abu Bakr ke saath, usi unt par unke peeche baithe hue. Abu Bakr ek boodhe, jaane-mane shaks the, jabke Allah ke Rasool ek jawan the jinhe log nahi jaante the. Isliye agar koee Abu Bakr se milta, woh kahta, "Aye Abu Bakr! Yeh shaks aapke aage kaun hai?" Abu Bakr kahte, "Yeh shaks mujhe raasta dikhata hai." Koee soch sakta tha Abu Bakr ka matlab raasta tha, jabke asal mein Abu Bakr ka matlab achhaee aur neki ka raasta tha. Phir Abu Bakr ne peeche dekha aur unka picha karte hue ek ghudsawaar dekha. Unhone kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Yeh ek ghudsawaar hai jo humara picha kar raha hai." Nabi ne peeche dekha aur kaha, "Aye Allah! Ise girada de." Isliye ghoda unhe giraya aur hinhinate huye utha. Phir woh ghudsawaar, Suraqa, ne kaha, "Aye Allah ke Nabi! Jo bhi aap chahen mujhe hukum den." Nabi ne kaha, "Yahaan ruko aur kisi ko humtak pahunchne mat do." Isliye din ke pahle hisse mein Suraqa Allah ke Nabi ka dushman tha, aur din ke aakhri hisse mein woh ek rakshak ban gaya. Phir Allah ke Rasool Al-Harra ke kinare utre aur Ansaar ke paas ek paighaam bheja, aur woh Allah ke Nabi aur Abu Bakr ke paas aaye, aur salaam karte hue, unhone kaha, "Sawar hojiye, mahfooz aur maanya." Allah ke Rasool aur Abu Bakr sawar hue aur Ansaar, apne hathiyaron ke saath, unke chaaron taraf gher ke chale. Yeh khabar Madina mein phaila gaee ke Allah ke Nabi aa gaye hain. Log bahar aaye aur betaab hokar dekh rahe the aur kah rahe the, "Allah ke Nabi aa gaye hain! Allah ke Nabi aa gaye hain!" Isliye Nabi chalte rahe jab tak Abu Ayub ke ghar ke qareeb utre. Jabke Nabi Abu Ayub ke pariwara ke saath baat kar rahe the, Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Salam (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne unke aagman ki khabar suni jabke woh khud apne pariwara ke liye apne baag se khajoor chun rahe the. Woh Nabi ke paas jaldi se gaye, un khajooron ko lekar jo unhone apne pariwara ke liye chune the. Unhone Allah ke Nabi ki baat suni aur phir ghar chale gaye. Phir Allah ke Nabi ne kaha, "Humare rishtedaron ka sabse qareebi ghar kaunsa hai?" Abu Ayub ne jawab diya, "Mera, Ya Allah ke Nabi! Yeh mera ghar hai aur yeh mera darwaza hai." Nabi ne kaha, "Jaao aur humare dopahar ke aaraam ke liye ek jagah taiyaar karo." Abu Ayub ne kaha, "Uthiye (donon) Allah ki barkaton ke saath." Isliye jab Allah ke Nabi ghar mein daakhil hue, Abdullah bin Salam aaye aur kaha, "Main gawahi deta hoon ke aap (yaani Muhammad) Allah ke Rasool hain aur aap Haqq ke saath aaye hain. Yahudi achhi tarah jaante hain ke main unka sardaar hoon aur unke sardaar ka beta hoon, aur unmein sabse ilm wala hoon aur unke sabse ilm wale ka beta hoon. Isliye unke liye bhejiye aur unse mere baare mein puchiye isse pahle ke unhe pata chale ke maine Islam qubool kiya hai, kyunke agar unhe pata chala, woh mere baare mein aisi baaten kahenge jo sahi nahi hongi." Isliye Allah ke Rasool ne unke liye bheja, aur woh aaye aur andar gaye. Allah ke Rasool ne unse kaha, "Aye Yahudi ke giroh! Afsos tum par: Allah se daro. Allah ki qasam jiske siwa koee mabood nahi, tum log nishchit soorat se jaante ho, ke main Allah ka Rasool hoon aur main tumhare paas Haqq lekar aaya hoon, isliye Islam qubool karo." Yahudiyon ne jawab diya, "Humein yeh nahi pata." Isliye unhone yeh Nabi se kaha, aur unhone ise teen baar dohraya. Phir unhone pucha, "Abdullah bin Salam tum logon mein kaisa shaks hai?" Unhone kaha, "Woh humara sardaar hai aur humare sardaar ka beta, aur sabse ilm wala shaks, aur humare sabse ilm wale ka beta." Unhone pucha, "Tumhara kya khyaal hoga agar woh Islam qubool kar len?" Unhone kaha, "Allah aisa hone se bache! Woh Islam qubool nahi kar sakte." Unhone yehi teen baar pucha aur unhone har baar yehi jawab diya. Phir unhone kaha, "Aye Ibn Salam! Unke saamne aaiye." Woh bahar aaye aur kaha, "Aye Yahudi ke giroh! Allah se daro jiske siwa koee mabood nahi. Tum log nishchit soorat se jaante ho ke woh Allah ke Rasool hain aur woh sachche deen lekar aaye hain!" Unhone kaha, "Tum jhoot bol rahe ho." Isspar Allah ke Rasool ne unhe nikal diya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:`Umar bin Al-Khattab fixed a grant of 4000 (Dirhams) for every Early Emigrant (i.e. Muhajir) and fixed a grant of 3500 (Dirhams) only for Ibn `Umar. Somebody said to `Umar, "Ibn `Umar is also one of the Early Emigrants; why do you give him less than four-thousand?" `Umar replied, "His parents took him with them when they migrated, so he was not like the one who had migrated by himself
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Umar bin Al-Khattab ne har pahle Muhajir ke liye 4000 (Dirham) ka anudaan tay kiya aur Ibn Umar ke liye sirf 3500 (Dirham) ka anudaan tay kiya. Kisi ne Umar se kaha, "Ibn Umar bhi ek pahle Muhajir hain; aap unhe chaar hazaar se kam kyun dete hain?" Umar ne jawab diya, "Unke maa-baap unhe apne saath le gaye the hijrat karte waqt, isliye woh us shaks jaisa nahi tha jisne khud hijrat ki."

e: Narrated Khabbab:We migrated with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (See Hadith No. 253 below)
hi: Khabbab (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Humne Allah ke Rasool ke saath hijrat ki (dekhen Hadith No. 253 neeche).

e: Narrated Khabbab:We migrated with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) seeking Allah's Countenance, so our rewards became due and sure with Allah. Some of us passed away without eating anything of their rewards in this world. One of these was Mus`ab bin `Umair who was martyred on the day of the battle of Uhud. We did not find anything to shroud his body with except a striped cloak. When we covered his head with it, his feet remained uncovered, and when we covered his feet with it, his head remained uncovered. So Allah's Apostle ordered us to cover his head with it and put some Idhkhir (i.e. a kind of grass) over his feet. And there are some amongst us whose fruits have ripened and they are collecting them (i.e. they have received their rewards in this world)
hi: Khabbab (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Humne Allah ke Rasool ke saath Allah ki khushi ke liye hijrat ki, isliye humara ajr Allah ke paas nishchit hai. Humme se kuch is duniya se chale gaye bina apna ajr paye. Unmein se ek Mus'ab bin Umair the jo Uhud ki jung ke din shaheed hue. Humein unke jism ko dhaankne ke liye ek dhaaridaar chaadar ke siwa kuch nahi mila. Jab humne unke sar ise dhaka, unke paanv khule rahe, aur jab humne unke paanv dhake, unka sar khula rah gaya. Isliye Allah ke Rasool ne humein hukum diya unke sar ko dhaankne aur unke paanvon par kuch Idhkhir (yaani ek khaas qisam ki ghaas) rakhne ka. Aur kuch hum mein se aise hain jinke phal pak gaye hain (is duniya mein) aur woh unhe jama kar rahe hain (yaani unka ajr unhe milna shuru ho gaya hai).

e: Narrated Abu Burda Bin Abi Musa Al-Ash`ari:`Abdullah bin `Umar said to me, "Do you know what my father said to your father once?" I said, "No." He said, "My father said to your father, 'O Abu Musa, will it please you that we will be rewarded for our conversion to Islam with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and our migration with him, and our Jihad with him and all our good deeds which we did, with him, and that all the deeds we did after his death will be disregarded whether good or bad?' Your father (i.e. Abu Musa) said, 'No, by Allah, we took part in Jihad after Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) , prayed and did plenty of good deeds, and many people have embraced Islam at our hands, and no doubt, we expect rewards from Allah for these good deeds.' On that my father (i.e. `Umar) said, 'As for myself, By Him in Whose Hand `Umar's soul is, I wish that the deeds done by us at the time of the Prophet (ﷺ) remain rewardable while whatsoever we did after the death of the Prophet (ﷺ) be enough to save us from Punishment in that the good deeds compensate for the bad ones.' " On that I said (to Ibn `Umar), "By Allah, your father was better than my father
hi: Abu Burda bin Abi Musa Al-Ash'ari bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne mujhse kaha, "Kya aapko pata hai mere waalid ne ek baar aapke waalid se kya kaha tha?" Maine kaha, "Nahi." Unhone kaha, "Mere waalid ne aapke waalid se kaha, 'Aye Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ), kya aapko yeh khushi hogi ke humein Allah ke Rasool ke saath Islam qubool karne ka, unke saath hijrat karne ka, unke saath Jihad karne ka, aur humne jo bhi neik amal kiye unke saath, ajr milega, aur unki maut ke baad humne jo bhi kiya, achha ya bura, use nazarandaaz kiya jaayega?' Aapke waalid (yaani Abu Musa) ne kaha, 'Nahi, Allah ki qasam, humne Allah ke Rasool ke baad bhi Jihad kiya, namaz padhi, aur bahut se neik amal kiye, aur bahut se log humare haathon Islam qubool kar chuke hain, aur koee shak nahi, hum in neik amalon ke liye Allah se ajr ki ummeed karte hain.' Ispar mere waalid (yaani Umar) ne kaha, 'Jahaan tak mera sawal hai, us Zaat ki qasam jiske haathon mein Umar ki jaan hai, main chahta hoon ke Nabi ke zamane mein humne jo amal kiye woh ajr wale rahe, jabke unke intiqal ke baad humne jo bhi kiya woh sirf itna ho ke hum Allah ke azaab se bach saken, ismein neik amal bure amalon ki bharpaee kar den.'" Ispar maine (Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se) kaha, "Allah ki qasam, aapke waalid mere waalid se behtar the."

e: Narrated Abu `Uthman:I heard that Ibn `Umar used to become angry if someone mentioned that he had migrated before his father (`Umar), and he used to say, " `Umar and I came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and found him having his midday rest, so we returned home. Then `Umar sent me again (to the Prophet (ﷺ) ) and said, 'Go and see whether he is awake.' I went to him and entered his place and gave him the pledge of allegiance. Then I went back to `Umar and informed him that the Prophet (ﷺ) was awake. So we both went, running slowly, and when `Umar entered his place, he gave him the pledge of allegiance and thereafter I too gave him the pledge of allegiance
hi: Abu Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine suna ke Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) naraaj ho jate the agar koee yeh kahta ke woh apne waalid (Umar) se pahle hijrat kar gaye the, aur woh kahte, "Umar aur main Allah ke Rasool ke paas aaye aur unhe dopahar ke aaraam mein paaya, isliye hum ghar wapas chale gaye. Phir Umar ne mujhe phir bheja aur kaha, 'Jaao aur dekho kya woh jag rahe hain.' Main unke paas gaya aur unke paas gaya aur unhe bai'at di. Phir main Umar ke paas wapas gaya aur unhe bataya ke Nabi jag rahe hain. Isliye hum donon dheeme-dheeme daudte hue gaye, aur jab Umar unke paas pahunche, unhone unhe bai'at di aur uske baad maine bhi unhe bai'at di."

e: Narrated Al-Bara:Abu Bakr bought a (camel's) saddle from `Azib, and I carried it for him. `Azib (i.e. my father) asked Abu Bakr regarding the journey of the migration of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Abu Bakr said, "Close observers were appointed by our enemies to watch us. So we went out at night and travelled throughout the night and the following day till it was noon, then we perceived a rock and went towards it, and there was some shade under it. I spread a cloak I had with me for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and then the Prophet (ﷺ) layed on it. I went out to guard him and all of a sudden I saw a shepherd coming with his sheep looking for the same, the shade of the rock as we did, I asked him, 'O boy, to whom do you belong?' He replied, 'I belong to so-and-so.' I asked him, 'Is there some milk in your sheep?' He replied in the affirmative. I asked him, 'Will you milk?' He replied in the affirmative. Then he got hold of one of his sheep. I said to him, 'Remove the dust from its udder.' Then he milked a little milk. I had a water-skin with me which was tied with a piece of cloth. I had prepared the water-skin for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . So I poured some water over the milk (container) till its bottom became cold. Then I brought the milk to the Prophet and said, 'Drink, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).' Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) drank till I became pleased. Then we departed and the pursuers were following us
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Abu Bakr ne Azib se ek (unt ki) jin khareedi, aur maine use unke liye uthaya. Azib (yaani mere waalid) ne Abu Bakr se Allah ke Rasool ki hijrat ki safar ke baare mein pucha. Abu Bakr ne kaha, "Humare dushmanon ne humein dekhne ke liye khaas nigraan rakhe the. Isliye hum raat ko nikle aur poori raat aur agli din bhi dopahar tak safar kiya, phir humne ek chattan dekhi aur uski taraf gaye, aur uske neeche kuch chhaya thi. Maine apna kapda jo mere paas tha Allah ke Rasool ke liye phailaya aur Nabi uspar let gaye. Main unki rakhwali karne bahar gaya aur achanak maine ek charwaha apni bheron ke saath usi chattan ki chhaya dhoondhte huye aate dekha jaisa humne ki thi. Maine (unse) pucha, 'Aye ladke, tum kiske ho?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Main falaan-falaan ka hoon.' Maine pucha, 'Kya tumhari bhedon mein doodh hai?' Unhone haan mein jawab diya. Maine pucha, 'Kya tum doohoge?' Unhone haan mein jawab diya. Phir unhone apni ek bhed pakdi. Maine unse kaha, 'Uski stan se dhool hata do.' Phir unhone thoda doodh doha. Mere paas ek paani ka thaila tha jo ek kapde se baandha hua tha. Maine ise Allah ke Rasool ke liye taiyaar kiya tha. Isliye maine (doodh ke bartan par) thoda paani daala jab tak uska neeche wala hissa thanda ho gaya. Phir main doodh Nabi ke paas laaya aur kaha, 'Piyiye, Ya Allah ke Rasool.' Allah ke Rasool ne piya jab tak main santusht ho gaya. Phir hum nikle, aur humara picha karne wale abhi bhi humara picha kar rahe the."

e: Al-Bara added:I then went with Abu Bakr into his home (carrying that saddle) and there I saw his daughter `Aisha Lying in a bed because of heavy fever and I saw her father Abu Bakr kissing her cheek and saying, "How are you, little daughter?
hi: Al-Bara ne joda: Phir main Abu Bakr ke saath unke ghar gaya (woh jin lekar), aur wahaan maine unki beti Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko tez bukhaar ki wajah se bistar mein lete dekha, aur maine unke waalid Abu Bakr ko unke gaal ko choomte aur kahte dekha, "Kaisi ho, meri chhoti beti?"

e: Narrated Anas:(the servant of the Prophet) When the Prophet (ﷺ) arrived (at Medina), there was not a single companion of the Prophet (ﷺ) who had grey and black hair except Abu Bakr, and he dyed his hair with Henna' and Katam (i.e. plants used for dying hair)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain (Nabi ke khaddam): Jab Nabi (Madina) pahunche, Nabi ke sahaba mein koee bhi safed-kale baal wala nahi tha siwaye Abu Bakr ke, aur unhone apne baal Henna aur Katam (yaani baal rangane wale paudhon) se range.

e: Through another group of narrators, Anas bin Malik said: "When the Prophet (ﷺ) arrived at Medina, the eldest amongst his companions was Abu Bakr. He dyed his hair with Hinna and Katam till it became of dark red color
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne ek doosre raawion ke giroh ke zariye bataya: "Jab Nabi Madina pahunche, unke sahaba mein sabse boodha Abu Bakr the. Unhone apne baal Henna aur Katam se range jab tak woh gahre laal rang ke ho gaye."

e: Narrate Aisha:Abu Bakr married a woman from the tribe of Bani Kalb, called Um Bakr. When Abu Bakr migrated to Medina, he divorced her and she was married by her cousin, the poet who said the following poem lamenting the infidels of Quraish: "What is there kept in the well, The well of Badr, (The owners of) the trays of Roasted camel humps? What is there kept in the well, The well of Badr, (The owners of) lady singers And friends of the honorable companions; who used to drink (wine) together, Um Bakr greets us With the greeting of peace, But can I find peace After my people have gone? The Apostle tells us that We shall live again, But what sort of life will owls and skulls live?:
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Abu Bakr ne Bani Kalb qabile ki ek aurat se shaadi ki, jise Um Bakr kaha jata tha. Jab Abu Bakr Madina hijrat karke aaye, unhone unhe talaq de di, aur unki shaadi unke chachere bhai se hui jo ek kavi the aur jinhone Quraish ke kaafiron ke liye ek shokgeet likha jismein Badr ke kue ke aas-paas mare gaye logon ka maatam manaya gaya aur Musalmanon ki taraf apni kadwahat zaahir ki gaee.

e: Narrated Abu Bakr:I was with the Prophet (ﷺ) in the Cave. When I raised my head, I saw the feet of the people. I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! If some of them should look down, they will see us." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Abu Bakr, be quiet! (For we are) two and Allah is the Third of us
hi: Abu Bakr bataate hain: Main Nabi ke saath gufa mein tha. Jab maine apna sar uthaya, maine (kaafir peecha karne walon ke) paanv dekhe. Maine kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Agar unmein se koee neeche dekhe, woh humein dekh lega." Nabi ne kaha, "Aye Abu Bakr! Chup raho! (Kyunke hum) do hain aur Allah humara teesra hai."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id:Once a bedouin came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and asked him about the migration. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Mercy of Allah be on you! The migration is a quite difficult matter. Have you got some camels?" He replied in the affirmative. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do you give their Zakat?" He replied in the affirmative. The Prophet said, "Do you let others benefit by their milk gratis?" He replied in the affirmative. Then the Prophet asked, "Do you milk them on their watering days and give their milk to the poor and needy?" He replied in the affirmative. The Prophet, said, "Go on doing like this from beyond the seas, and there is no doubt that Allah will not overlook any of your good deeds
hi: Abu Saeed bataate hain: Ek baar ek dehati Nabi ke paas aaya aur unse hijrat ke baare mein pucha. Nabi ne kaha, "Allah ki rehmat tumpar ho! Hijrat ek bahut mushkil maamla hai. Kya tumhare paas kuch unt hain?" Unhone haan mein jawab diya. Phir Nabi ne pucha, "Kya tum unki Zakat dete ho?" Unhone haan mein jawab diya. Nabi ne pucha, "Kya tum doosron ko bina qeemat liye unka doodh pine dete ho?" Unhone haan mein jawab diya. Phir Nabi ne pucha, "Kya tum unhe paani pilane ke dinon par doohte ho aur unka doodh gareebon aur zaroortmandon ko dete ho?" Unhone haan mein jawab diya. Nabi ne kaha, "Isi tarah karte raho, samundaron ke paar se bhi, aur koee shak nahi, Allah tumhare kisi bhi neik amal ko nazarandaaz nahi karega."

e: Narrated Al-Bara:The first people who came to us (in Medina) were Mus`ab bin `Umair and Ibn Um Maktum. Then came to us `Ammar bin Yasir and Bilal
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Sabse pahle log jo humare paas (Madina) aaye woh Mus'ab bin Umair aur Ibn Um Maktum the. Phir Ammar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Yasir aur Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) humare paas aaye.

e: Narrated Al-Bara bin Azib:The first people who came to us (in Medina) were Mus`ab bin `Umair and Ibn Um Maktum who were teaching Qur'an to the people. Then there came Bilal, Sa`d and `Ammar bin Yasir. After that `Umar bin Al-Khattab came along with twenty other companions of the Prophet. Later on the Prophet (ﷺ) himself came (to Medina) and I had never seen the people of Medina so joyful as they were on the arrival of Allah's Apostle, for even the slave girls were saying, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has arrived!" And before his arrival I had read the Sura starting with:-- "Glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most High" (87.1) together with other Suras of Al-Mufassal
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Sabse pahle log jo humare paas (Madina) aaye woh Mus'ab bin Umair aur Ibn Um Maktum the jo logon ko Quran sikha rahe the. Phir Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ), Sa'd, aur Ammar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Yasir aaye. Uske baad Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab bees doosre Nabi ke sahaba ke saath aaye. Baad mein Nabi khud (Madina) aaye, aur maine Madina ke logon ko kabhi itna khush nahi dekha jitna Allah ke Rasool ke aagman par, itna ke launDiyaan bhi kah rahi thi, "Allah ke Rasool aa gaye hain!" Aur unke aagman se pahle, maine yeh Surah padhi thi jo isse shuru hoti hai: "Apne Rab ke naam ki mahima karo, jo sabse buland hai" (87:1), doosri Al-Mufassal Surahon ke saath.

e: Narrated `Aisha:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to Medina, Abu Bakr and Bilal got fever, and I went to both of them and said, "O my father, how do you feel? O Bilal, how do you feel?" Whenever Abu Bakr's fever got worse, he would say, "Every man will meet his death once in one morning while he will be among his family, for death is really nearer to him than his leather shoe laces (to his feet)." And whenever fever deserted Bilal, he would say aloud, "Would that I know whether I shall spend a night in the valley (of Mecca) with Idhkhir and Jalil (i.e. kinds of grass) around me, and whether I shall drink one day the water of Majannah, and whether I shall see once again the hills of Shamah and Tafil?" Then I went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and told him of that. He said, "O Allah, make us love Medina as much as or more than we used to love Mecca, O Allah, make it healthy and bless its Sa' and Mud (i.e. measures), and take away its fever to Al-Juhfa
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool Madina aaye, Abu Bakr aur Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko bukhaar chadha, aur main donon ke paas gaee aur kaha, "Aye mere waalid, aapko kaisa lagta hai? Aye Bilal, aapko kaisa lagta hai?" Jab bhi Abu Bakr ka bukhaar badhta, woh kahte, "Har insaan apni maut se subah-subah milega, apne pariwara ke beech rehte hue, kyunke maut sach mein use uski chamde ki jooton ki lases se bhi zyada nazdeek hai." Aur jab bhi Bilal ka bukhaar utarta, woh zor se kahte, "Kaash mujhe pata hota kya main (Mecca ki) waadi mein Idhkhir aur Jalil (yaani ghaas ki qismon) ke aas-paas ek raat bitaunga, aur kya main kabhi Majannah ka paani piunga, aur kya main phir kabhi Shamah aur Tafil ki pahadiyon ko dekhunga?" Phir main Allah ke Rasool ke paas gaee aur unhe yeh bataya. Unhone kaha, "Aye Allah! Humein Madina se utni hi ya usse zyada mohabbat karvaa jitni humein Mecca se thi. Aye Allah! Ise sehatmand banaa aur iske Sa aur Mud (yaani naapon) mein barkat de, aur iska bukhaar Al-Juhfa le ja."

e: Narrated 'Ubaidullah bin Adi bin Khiyar:I went to `Uthman. After reciting Tashah-hud, he said,. "Then after no doubt, Allah sent Muhammad with the Truth, and I was amongst those who responded to the Call of Allah and His Prophet and believed in the message of Muhammad. Then I took part in the two migrations. I became the son-in-law of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and gave the pledge of allegiance to him By Allah, I never disobeyed him, nor did I deceive him till Allah took him unto Him
hi: Ubaidullah bin Adi bin Khiyar bataate hain: Main Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas gaya. Tashah-hud padhne ke baad, unhone kaha, "Iske baad koi shak nahi, Allah ne Muhammad ko Haqq ke saath bheja, aur main unmein tha jinhone Allah aur uske Rasool ki pukar ka jawab diya aur Muhammad ke paighaam par iman laaya. Phir maine do hijraton mein hissa liya. Main Allah ke Rasool ka daamad bana aur unhe bai'at di. Allah ki qasam, maine kabhi unki na-farmani nahi ki, na hi unke saath dhoka kiya jab tak Allah ne unhe intiqal karwaya."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:During the last Hajj led by `Umar, `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf returned to his family at Mina and met me there. `AbdurRahman said (to `Umar), "O chief of the believers! The season of Hajj is the season when there comes the scum of the people (besides the good amongst them), so I recommend that you should wait till you go back to Medina, for it is the place of Migration and Sunna (i.e. the Prophet's tradition), and there you will be able to refer the matter to the religious scholars and the nobles and the people of wise opinions." `Umar said, "I will speak of it in Medina on my very first sermon I will deliver there
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke aakhri Hajj ke dauran, Abdur-Rahman bin Auf Mina mein apne pariwara ke paas wapas aaye aur wahaan mujhe mile. Abdur-Rahman ne (Umar se) kaha, "Aye Mominon ke Ameer! Hajj ka mausam woh mausam hai jab logon mein har tarah ke log (achhe-bure) aate hain, isliye main sujhaav deta hoon ke aap tab tak intezaar karein jab tak aap Madina wapas na jaaen, kyunke woh Hijrat aur Sunnat ki jagah hai, aur wahaan aap deeni vidwanon, izzatdaron, aur aqlmand logon se maamle ka zikar kar sakenge." Umar ne kaha, "Main iske baare mein Madina mein apne pahle khutbe mein baat karunga."

e: Narrated 'Um Al-`Ala:An Ansari woman who gave the pledge of allegiance to the Prophet (ﷺ) that the Ansar drew lots concerning the dwelling of the Emigrants. `Uthman bin Maz'un was decided to dwell with them (i.e. Um Al-`Ala's family), `Uthman fell ill and I nursed him till he died, and we covered him with his clothes. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) came to us and I (addressing the dead body) said, "O Abu As-Sa'ib, may Allah's Mercy be on you! I bear witness that Allah has honored you." On that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "How do you know that Allah has honored him?" I replied, "I do not know. May my father and my mother be sacrificed for you, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! But who else is worthy of it (if not `Uthman)?" He said, "As to him, by Allah, death has overtaken him, and I hope the best for him. By Allah, though I am the Apostle of Allah, yet I do not know what Allah will do to me," By Allah, I will never assert the piety of anyone after him. That made me sad, and when I slept I saw in a dream a flowing stream for `Uthman bin Maz'un. I went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and told him of it. He remarked, "That symbolizes his (good) deeds
hi: Um Al-Ala bataati hain (ek Ansaari aurat jinhone Nabi ko bai'at di thi): Ansaar ne qura kiya Muhajir ke rehne ki jagahon ke baare mein. Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Maz'un unke (yaani Um Al-Ala ke pariwara ke) saath rehne ke liye tay hue. Uthman bimar pade aur maine unki sewa ki jab tak unka intiqal hua, aur humne unhe unke kapdon mein lapet diya. Phir Nabi humare paas aaye aur main (murda jism se mukhatib hote huye) ne kaha, "Aye Abu As-Sa'ib, Allah ki rehmat aappar ho! Main gawahi deti hoon ke Allah ne aapko izzat di hai." Isspar Nabi ne kaha, "Tumhe kaise pata Allah ne unhe izzat di hai?" Maine jawab diya, "Mujhe nahi pata. Mere maa-baap aapke liye qurbaan hon, Ya Allah ke Rasool! Magar aur kaun iske laayak hai (agar Uthman nahi)?" Unhone kaha, "Jahaan tak unka sawal hai, Allah ki qasam, maut unhe aa chuki hai, aur mujhe unke liye behtareen ki ummeed hai. Allah ki qasam, chahe main Allah ka Rasool hoon, phir bhi mujhe nahi pata Allah mere saath kya karega." Allah ki qasam, main iske baad kabhi kisi ki pakbaazi ka daava nahi karungi. Yeh baat mujhe dukhi kar gaee, aur jab main soee, maine khwab mein Uthman bin Maz'un ke liye ek behti nadi dekhi. Main Allah ke Rasool ke paas gaee aur unhe yeh bataya. Unhone kaha, "Yeh unke (achhe) amalon ka pratik hai."

e: Narrated `Aisha:The day of Bu'ath was a day (i.e. battle) which Allah caused to take place just before the mission of His Apostle so that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to Medina, they (the tribes) had divided (into hostile groups) and their nobles had been killed; and all that facilitated their conversion to Islam
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Bu'ath ka din (yaani jung ka din) woh din tha jise Allah ne apne Rasool ke bheje jane se pahle hone diya taaki jab Allah ke Rasool Madina aaye, woh (qabile) baante hue the (alag-alag girohon mein) aur unke sardaar mare ja chuke the; aur is sab ne unke Islam qubool karne mein madad ki.

e: Narrated Aisha:That once Abu Bakr came to her on the day of `Id-ul-Fitr or `Id ul Adha while the Prophet (ﷺ) was with her and there were two girl singers with her, singing songs of the Ansar about the day of Buath. Abu Bakr said twice. "Musical instrument of Satan!" But the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Leave them Abu Bakr, for every nation has an `Id (i.e. festival) and this day is our `Id
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ek baar Abu Bakr unke paas Eid-ul-Fitr ya Eid-ul-Adha ke din aaye jabke Nabi unke saath the aur do gaane wali ladkiyaan unke paas thi, Bu'ath ke din ke baare mein Ansaar ke geet gate hue. Abu Bakr ne do baar kaha, "Shaitan ka vaadya yantra!" Magar Nabi ne kaha, "Unhe rehne do, Abu Bakr, kyunke har qaum ki apni Eid (yaani tyohaar) hoti hai, aur yeh din humari Eid hai."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) arrived at Medina, he alighted at the upper part of Medina among the people called Bani `Amr bin `Auf and he stayed with them for fourteen nights. Then he sent for the chiefs of Bani An-Najjar, and they came, carrying their swords. As if I am just now looking at Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on his she-camel with Abu Bakr riding behind him (on the same camel) and the chiefs of Bani An- Najjar around him till he dismounted in the courtyard of Abu Aiyub's home. The Prophet (ﷺ) used to offer the prayer wherever the prayer was due, and he would pray even in sheepfolds. Then he ordered that the mosque be built. He sent for the chiefs of Banu An-Najjar, and when they came, he said, "O Banu An-Najjar! Suggest to me the price of this garden of yours." They replied "No! By Allah, we do not demand its price except from Allah." In that garden there were the (following) things that I will tell you: Graves of pagans, unleveled land with holes and pits etc., and date-palm trees. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered that the graves of the pagans be dug up and, the unleveled land be leveled and the date-palm trees be cut down. The trunks of the trees were arranged so as to form the wall facing the Qibla. The Stone pillars were built at the sides of its gate. The companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) were carrying the stones and reciting some lyrics, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . . was with them and they were saying, "O Allah! There is no good except the good of the Hereafter, so bestow victory on the Ansar and the Emigrants
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool Madina pahunche, woh Madina ke oonche hisse mein Banu Amr bin Auf ke logon ke beech ruke aur unke saath chaudah raaten rahe. Phir unhone Banu An-Najjar ke sardaron ko bulaya, aur woh apni talwaren lekar aaye. Mano abhi bhi main Allah ke Rasool ko apni untni par Abu Bakr ke saath (usi untni par) peeche baithe dekh raha hoon, aur Banu An-Najjar ke sardaar unke aas-paas, jab tak woh Abu Aiyub ke ghar ke aangan mein utre. Nabi jahaan bhi namaz ka waqt hota, namaz padh lete, aur bhed-bakriyon ke baade mein bhi namaz padhte the. Phir unhone masjid banane ka hukum diya. Unhone Banu An-Najjar ke sardaron ko bulaya, aur jab woh aaye, unhone kaha, "Aye Banu An-Najjar! Mujhe apne is baag ki qeemat batao." Unhone kaha, "Nahi! Allah ki qasam, hum iski qeemat sirf Allah se maangte hain." Us baag mein yeh cheezein thi jo main tumhe bataunga: mushrikon ki qabren, ubad-khabad zameen gaddhon aur khaadon ke saath, aur khajoor ke darakht. Allah ke Rasool ne hukum diya ke mushrikon ki qabren khodi jaen, ubad-khabad zameen ko sman kiya jaaye, aur khajoor ke darakhton ko kata jaaye. Darakhton ke tane ek deewaar banane ke liye Qibla ki taraf istemal kiye gaye. Iske darwaze ke kinaron par pathar ke khambe banaye gaye. Nabi ke sahaba pathar laate aur kuch geet padhte, aur Allah ke Rasool bhi unke saath the, aur woh kah rahe the, "Aye Allah! Aakhirat ki bhalaee ke siwa koee bhalaee nahi, isliye Ansaar aur Muhajir ko fatah de."

e: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin Humaid Az-Zuhri:I heard `Umar bin `Abdul-Aziz asking As-Sa'ib, the nephew of An-Namir, "What have you heard about residing in Mecca?" The other said, "I heard Al-Ala bin Al-Hadrami saying, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: An Emigrant is allowed to stay in Mecca for three days after departing from Mina (i.e. after performing all the ceremonies of Hajj)
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Humaid Az-Zuhri bataate hain: Maine Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdul Aziz ko As-Saib se, jo An-Namir ke bhatije the, puchte suna, "Aapne Mecca mein rehne ke baare mein kya suna hai?" Doosre ne kaha, "Maine Al-Ala bin Al-Hadrami ko kehte suna, 'Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: Ek Muhajir ko Mecca mein teen din tak Mina se lautne ke baad (yaani Hajj ki sab riwajen poori karne ke baad) rehne ki ijazat hai.'"

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:The Prophet's companions did not take as a starting date for the Muslim calendar, the day, the Prophet (ﷺ) had been sent as an Apostle or the day of his death, but the day of his arrival at Medina
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ke sahaba ne Musalman calendar (yaani hijri sanvat) ki shuruaat ki taarikh ke tor par woh din nahi chuna jab Nabi ko Rasool banaya gaya tha ya unki wafat ka din, balki unke Madina aagman ka din.

e: Narrated `Aisha:Originally, two rak`at were prescribed in every prayer. When the Prophet (ﷺ) migrated (to Medina) four rak`at were enjoined, while the journey prayer remained unchanged(i.e. two rak`at)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Shuru mein, har namaz mein do rakat farz thi. Jab Nabi ne hijrat ki (Madina), chaar rakaten farz ki gaee, jabke safar ki namaz do rakat hi rahi.

e: Narrated Sa`d bin Malik:In the year of Hajjat-ul-Wada` the Prophet (ﷺ) visited me when I fell ill and was about to die because of that illness. I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I am very ill as you see, and I am a rich man and have no heir except my only daughter. Shall I give 2/3 of my property in charity?" He said, "No." I said, "Shall I then give one half of it in charity?" He said, "O Sa`d! Give 1/3 (in charity) and even 1/3 is too much. No doubt, it is better to leave your children rich than to leave them poor, reduced to begging from others. And Allah will reward you for whatever you spend with the intention of gaining Allah's Pleasure even if it were a mouthful of food you put into your wives mouth." I said, "O Allah's Apostle! Am I to be left behind (in Mecca) after my companions have gone?" He said, "If you should be left behind, you will be upgraded and elevated for every deed you will do with a desire to achieve Allah's Pleasure. I hope that you will live long so that some people will benefit by you while others will be harmed. O Allah! Please fulfill the migration of my companions and do not make them turn back on their heels. But (we feel sorry for) the unlucky Sa`d bin Khaulah." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) lamented his death in Mecca
hi: Sa'd bin Malik bataate hain: Hajjat-ul-Wada ke saal, Nabi mujhse milne aaye jab main bimar pad gaya tha aur us bimari ki wajah se maut ke qareeb tha. Maine kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Main bahut bimar hoon jaisa aap dekh rahe hain, aur main ek daulatmand shaks hoon aur mera koee waaris nahi siwaye meri ek beti ke. Kya main apni maal ka do-tihaee charity mein dun?" Unhone kaha, "Nahi." Maine kaha, "Phir kya main aadha dun?" Unhone kaha, "Aye Sa'd! Ek-tihaee do, aur ek-tihaee bhi bahut zyada hai. Koee shak nahi, apne bachchon ko daulatmand chhodna unhe gareeb chhodne se, doosron se bhiksha maangne ki haalat mein, behtar hai. Aur Allah tumhe uske ajr dega jo bhi tum Allah ki khushi paane ki niyyat se kharch karte ho, chahe woh ek gras khaana hi ho jo tum apni biwi ke munh mein daalte ho." Maine kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Kya mujhe (Mecca mein) chhod diya jaayega mere sathiyon ke jane ke baad?" Unhone kaha, "Agar tumhe chhod diya jaata hai, tumhe har amal ke liye ajr milega jo tum Allah ki khushi paane ki khaatir karoge. Mujhe ummeed hai tum lambe waqt tak zinda rahoge taaki kuch log tumse faayda uthaen aur kuch nuksaan. Aye Allah! Mere sathiyon ki hijrat poori kar aur unhe peeche mat mudne de. Magar (humen afsos hai) bad-kismat Sa'd bin Khaula par." Allah ke Rasool ne unki maut Mecca mein hone par afsos zaahir kiya.

e: Narrated Anas:When `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf came to Medina and the Prophet (ﷺ) established the bond of brotherhood between him and Sa`d bin Ar-Rabi-al-Ansari, Sa`d suggested that `Abdur-Rahman should accept half of his property and family. `Abdur Rahman said, "May Allah bless you in your family and property; guide me to the market." So `Abdur-Rahman (while doing business in the market) made some profit of some condensed dry yoghurt and butter. After a few days the Prophet (ﷺ) saw him wearing clothes stained with yellow perfume. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "What is this, O `Abdur-Rahman?" He said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have married an Ansar' woman." The Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "What have you given her as Mahr?" He (i.e. `Abdur-Rahman) said, "A piece of gold, about the weight of a date stone." Then the Prophet said, Give a banquet, even though of a sheep
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Abdur-Rahman bin Auf Madina aaye aur Nabi ne unke aur Sa'd bin Ar-Rabi Al-Ansaari ke beech bhaeechaara ka bandhan banaya, Sa'd ne sujhaav diya ke Abdur-Rahman unka maal aur pariwara ka aadha qubool kar len. Abdur-Rahman ne kaha, "Allah tumhare pariwara aur maal mein barkat de; mujhe bazaar dikha do." Isliye Abdur-Rahman ne (bazaar mein vyaapaar karte hue) kuch dahi aur ghi ka munafa kamaya. Kuch dinon baad Nabi ne unhe peele rang ki khushbu wale kapde pahne dekha. Nabi ne pucha, "Yeh kya hai, Aye Abdur-Rahman?" Unhone kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Maine ek Ansaari aurat se shaadi ki hai." Nabi ne pucha, "Tumne unhe Mahr mein kya diya?" Unhone (yaani Abdur-Rahman ne) kaha, "Ek khajoor-gutli ke barabar wazan ka sona." Phir Nabi ne kaha, "Ek shaadi ki dawat do, chahe ek bhed se hi ho."

e: Narrated Anas:When the news of the arrival of the Prophet (ﷺ) at Medina reached `Abdullah bin Salam, he went to him to ask him about certain things, He said, "I am going to ask you about three things which only a Prophet can answer: What is the first sign of The Hour? What is the first food which the people of Paradise will eat? Why does a child attract the similarity to his father or to his mother?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Gabriel has just now informed me of that." Ibn Salam said, "He (i.e. Gabriel) is the enemy of the Jews amongst the angels. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "As for the first sign of The Hour, it will be a fire that will collect the people from the East to the West. As for the first meal which the people of Paradise will eat, it will be the caudate (extra) lobe of the fish-liver. As for the child, if the man's discharge proceeds the woman's discharge, the child attracts the similarity to the man, and if the woman's discharge proceeds the man's, then the child attracts the similarity to the woman." On this, `Abdullah bin Salam said, "I testify that None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, and that you are the Messenger of Allah." and added, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Jews invent such lies as make one astonished, so please ask them about me before they know about my conversion to Islam. " The Jews came, and the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "What kind of man is `Abdullah bin Salam among you?" They replied, "The best of us and the son of the best of us and the most superior among us, and the son of the most superior among us. "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "What would you think if `Abdullah bin Salam should embrace Islam?" They said, "May Allah protect him from that." The Prophet (ﷺ) repeated his question and they gave the same answer. Then `Abdullah came out to them and said, "I testify that None has the right to be worshipped except Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah!" On this, the Jews said, "He is the most wicked among us and the son of the most wicked among us." So they degraded him. On this, he (i.e. `Abdullah bin Salam) said, "It is this that I was afraid of, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Nabi ke Madina aagman ki khabar Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Salam (رضی اللہ عنہ) tak pahunchi, woh unke paas kuch cheezon ke baare mein puchne gaye. Unhone kaha, "Main aapse teen aisi cheezon ke baare mein puchunga jinke baare mein sirf ek Nabi hi jawab de sakta hai: Qiyamat ki sabse pahli nishaani kya hai? Jannat wale sabse pahle kya khaenge? Bachcha apne baap ya apni maa se kyun milta-julta hai?" Nabi ne jawab diya, "Jibreel ne abhi mujhe yeh bataya hai." Ibn Salam ne kaha, "Woh (yaani Jibreel), farishton mein se, Yahudiyon ka dushman hai." Nabi ne kaha, "Jahaan tak Qiyamat ki sabse pahli nishaani ka sawal hai, yeh ek aag hogi jo logon ko purab se pashchim tak jama karegi. Jahaan tak Jannat wale sabse pahle kya khaenge iska sawal hai, woh machhli ke jigar ka extra hissa hoga. Jahaan tak bachche ka sawal hai, agar mard ka sraav aurat ke sraav se pahle nikle, bachcha mard se milta-julta hoga, aur agar aurat ka sraav pahle nikle, bachcha aurat se milta-julta hoga." Isspar, Abdullah bin Salam ne kaha, "Main gawahi deta hoon ke Allah ke siwa koee mabood nahi, aur aap Allah ke Rasool hain." Aur unhone joda, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Yahudi aise jhoot gadhte hain ke insaan hairat mein pad jaata hai, isliye kripya mere baare mein unse puchiye isse pahle ke unhe mere Islam qubool karne ka pata chale." Yahudi aaye, aur Nabi ne pucha, "Abdullah bin Salam tum mein kaisa shaks hai?" Unhone jawab diya, "Humare beech sabse behtar, aur humare beech sabse behtar ka beta, aur humare beech sabse izzatdaar." Nabi ne pucha, "Tumhara kya khyaal hoga agar Abdullah bin Salam Islam qubool kar le?" Unhone kaha, "Allah use isse bacha rakhe." Nabi ne apna sawal dohraya aur unhone wahi jawab diya. Phir Abdullah unke saamne bahar aaye aur kaha, "Main gawahi deta hoon ke Allah ke siwa koee mabood nahi aur Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain!" Isspar, Yahudiyon ne kaha, "Woh humare beech sabse bura hai, aur humare beech sabse bure ka beta." Isliye unhone unhe apmaanit kiya. Isspar, unhone (yaani Abdullah bin Salam ne) kaha, "Isi baat ka mujhe dar tha, Ya Allah ke Rasool."

e: Narrated Abu Al-Minhal `AbdurRahman bin Mut`im:A partner of mine sold some Dirhams on credit in the market. I said, "Glorified be Allah! Is this legal?" He replied, "Glorified be Allah! By Allah, when I sold them in the market, nobody objected to it." Then I asked Al-Bara' bin `Azib (about it) he said, "We used to make such a transaction when the Prophet came to Medina. So he said, 'There is no harm in it if it is done from hand to hand, but it is not allowed on credit.' Go to Zaid bin Al- Arqam and ask him about it for he was the greatest trader of all of us." So I asked Zaid bin Al-Arqam., and he said the same (as Al-Bara) did
hi: Abu Al-Minhal Abdur-Rahman bin Mut'im bataate hain: Mere ek saathi ne bazaar mein kuch Dirham udhaar par beche. Maine kaha, "Subhanallah! Kya yeh jaiz hai?" Unhone jawab diya, "Subhanallah! Allah ki qasam, jab maine unhe bazaar mein becha, kisi ne koI aapatti nahi ki." Phir maine Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) se (iske baare mein) pucha, jinhone kaha, "Hum aisa len-den karte the jab Nabi Madina aaye. Ispar unhone kaha, 'Ismein koee harz nahi agar yeh haathon-haath ho, magar udhaar par jaiz nahi hai.' Zaid bin Al-Arqam ke paas jao aur unse iske baare mein puchho, kyunke woh hum sab mein sabse bada vyaapari tha.'" Isliye maine Zaid bin Al-Arqam se pucha, aur unhone wahi kaha (jo Al-Bara ne kaha).

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Had only ten Jews (amongst their chiefs) believed me, all the Jews would definitely have believed me
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Agar sirf das Yahudi (unke sardaron mein se) mujhpar vishwas karte, sab Yahudi zaroor mujhpar vishwas karte."

e: Narrated Abu Musa:When the Prophet (ﷺ) arrived at Medina, he noticed that some people among the Jews used to respect Ashura' (i.e. 10th of Muharram) and fast on it. The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "We have more right to observe fast on this day." and ordered that fasting should be observed on it
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Nabi Madina pahunche, unhone dekha kuch Yahudi Ashura (yaani Muharram ki daswin) ka aadar karte the aur uspar roza rakhte the. Nabi ne phir kaha, "Humein is din roza rakhne ka isse zyada haqq hai." aur ispar roza rakhne ka hukum diya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When the Prophet (ﷺ) arrived at Medina he found that the Jews observed fast on the day of 'Ashura'. They were asked the reason for the fast. They replied, "This is the day when Allah caused Moses and the children of Israel to have victory over Pharaoh, so we fast on this day as a sign of glorifying it." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "We are closer to Moses than you." Then he ordered that fasting on this day should be observed
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Nabi Madina pahunche, unhone paaya ke Yahudi Ashura ke din roza rakhte the. Unse iski wajah puchi gaee. Unhone jawab diya, "Yeh woh din hai jab Allah ne Musa aur Bani Israel ko Firaun par fatah dilaee, isliye hum is din ko izzat dene ke liye roza rakhte hain." Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Hum tumse Musa ke zyada qareeb hain." Phir unhone is din roza rakhne ka hukum diya.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to keep his hair falling loose while the pagans used to part their hair, and the People of the Scriptures used to keep their hair falling loose, and the Prophet (ﷺ) liked to follow the People of the Scriptures in matters about which he had not been instructed differently, but later on the Prophet (ﷺ) started parting his hair
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi apne baal khule hue rakhte the jabke kaafir apne baal baantte the. Kitaab wale bhi apne baal khule rakhte the, aur Nabi Kitaab walon ki pairvi karna pasand karte the un maamlon mein jinke baare mein unhe khaas hidaayat nahi mili thi, magar baad mein Nabi ne apne baal baantne shuru kiye.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:They, the people of the Scriptures, divided this Scripture into parts, believing in some portions of it and disbelieving the others. (See 15:)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Unhone (yaani Kitaab walon ne) is Kitaab ko hisson mein baant diya, uske kuch hisson par iman laate hue aur kuch ko na maante hue. (Dekhen 15:)

e: Narrated Salman Al-Farisi:That he was sold (as a slave) by one master to another for more than ten times (i.e. between 13 and)
hi: Salman (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Farisi bataate hain: Unhe ek maalik ne doosre ko das bar se zyada becha (yaani terah aur chaar bar ke beech).

e: Narrated Salman:I am from Ram-Hurmuz (i.e. a Persian town)
hi: Salman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Ram-Hurmuz (yaani ek Farsi shehar) se hoon.

e: Narrated Salman:The interval between Jesus and Muhammad was six hundred years
hi: Salman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Isa aur Muhammad ke beech chhah sau saal ka faasla tha.

e: Narrated Abu 'Is-haq:Once, while I was sitting beside Zaid bin Al-Arqam, he was asked, "How many Ghazwat did the Prophet undertake?" Zaid replied, "Nineteen." They said, "In how many Ghazwat did you join him?" He replied, "Seventeen." I asked, "Which of these was the first?" He replied, "Al-`Ashira or Al- `Ashiru
hi: Abu Ishaq bataate hain: Ek baar, jabke main Zaid bin Al-Arqam ke bagal mein baitha tha, unse pucha gaya, "Nabi ne kitni Ghazwaaten ki?" Zaid ne jawab diya, "Unnis (19)." Unhone pucha, "Aap kitnon mein unke saath the?" Unhone jawab diya, "Satrah (17)." Maine pucha, "In mein se pahli kaunsi thi?" Unhone jawab diya, "Al-Ashira ya Al-Ashiru."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Mas`ud:From Sa`d bin Mu`adh: Sa`d bin Mu`adh was an intimate friend of Umaiya bin Khalaf and whenever Umaiya passed through Medina, he used to stay with Sa`d, and whenever Sa`d went to Mecca, he used to stay with Umaiya. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) arrived at Medina, Sa`d went to perform `Umra and stayed at Umaiya's home in Mecca. He said to Umaiya, "Tell me of a time when (the Mosque) is empty so that I may be able to perform Tawaf around the Ka`ba." So Umaiya went with him about midday. Abu Jahl met them and said, "O Abu Safwan! Who is this man accompanying you?" He said, "He is Sa`d." Abu Jahl addressed Sa`d saying, "I see you wandering about safely in Mecca inspite of the fact that you have given shelter to the people who have changed their religion (i.e. became Muslims) and have claimed that you will help them and support them. By Allah, if you were not in the company of Abu Safwan, you would not be able to go to your family safely." Sa`d, raising his voice, said to him, "By Allah, if you should stop me from doing this (i.e. performing Tawaf) I would certainly prevent you from something which is more valuable for you, that is, your passage through Medina." On this, Umaiya said to him, "O Sa`d do not raise your voice before Abu-l-Hakam, the chief of the people of the Valley (of Mecca)." Sa`d said, "O Umaiya, stop that! By Allah, I have heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) predicting that the Muslims will kill you." Umaiya asked, "In Mecca?" Sa`d said, "I do not know." Umaiya was greatly scared by that news. When Umaiya returned to his family, he said to his wife, "O Um Safwan! Don't you know what Sa`d told me? "She said, "What has he told you?" He replied, "He claims that Muhammad has informed them (i.e. companions that they will kill me. I asked him, 'In Mecca?' He replied, 'I do not know." Then Umaiya added, "By Allah, I will never go out of Mecca." But when the day of (the Ghazwa of) Badr came, Abu Jahl called the people to war, saying, "Go and protect your caravan." But Umaiya disliked to go out (of Mecca). Abu Jahl came to him and said, "O Abu Safwan! If the people see you staying behind though you are the chief of the people of the Valley, then they will remain behind with you." Abu Jahl kept on urging him to go until he (i.e. Umaiya) said, "As you have forced me to change my mind, by Allah, I will buy the best camel in Mecca. Then Umaiya said (to his wife). "O Um Safwan, prepare what I need (for the journey)." She said to him, "O Abu Safwan! Have you forgotten what your Yathribi brother told you?" He said, "No, but I do not want to go with them but for a short distance." So when Umaiya went out, he used to tie his camel wherever he camped. He kept on doing that till Allah caused him to be killed at Badr
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain (Sa'd bin Mu'adh se): Sa'd bin Mu'adh Umaiya bin Khalaf ke ghanishtha mitra the, aur jab bhi Umaiya Madina se guzarte, woh Sa'd ke saath rukte, aur jab bhi Sa'd Mecca jate, woh Umaiya ke saath rukte. Jab Allah ke Rasool Madina pahunche, Sa'd Umrah karne gaye aur Mecca mein Umaiya ke ghar ruke. Unhone Umaiya se kaha, "Mujhe aisa waqt bataiye jab (masjid) khali ho taaki main Ka'ba ka Tawaf kar sakoon." Isliye Umaiya unke saath dopahar ke aas-paas gaye. Abu Jahl unse mila aur pucha, "Aye Abu Safwan! Yeh aapke saath kaun hai?" Unhone kaha, "Yeh Sa'd hain." Abu Jahl ne Sa'd se kaha, "Main dekh raha hoon aap Mecca mein mahfooz ghoom rahe hain jabke aapne un logon ko panah di hai jinhone apna deen badal liya hai (yaani Musalman ban gaye hain) aur daava kiya hai ke aap unki madad aur himaayat karenge. Allah ki qasam, agar aap Abu Safwan ki sohbat mein nahi hote, aap mahfooz apne pariwara tak nahi pahunch pate." Sa'd ne, apni aawaaz buland karte huye, unse kaha, "Allah ki qasam, agar aap mujhe isse (yaani Tawaf se) rokte hain, main aapko ek aisi cheez se rok dunga jo aapke liye zyada mahatvapurna hai, yaani Madina se aapka safar." Ispar Umaiya ne unse kaha, "Aye Sa'd, ise roko! Abul-Hakam ke saamne apni aawaaz mat buland karo, jo (Mecca ki) wadi ke logon ke sardaar hain." Sa'd ne kaha, "Aye Umaiya, ise roko! Allah ki qasam, maine Allah ke Rasool ko yeh kehte suna hai ke Musalman aapko qatl karenge." Umaiya ne pucha, "Mecca mein?" Sa'd ne kaha, "Mujhe nahi pata." Umaiya isse bahut dar gaya. Jab Umaiya apne pariwara ke paas wapas gaye, unhone apni biwi se kaha, "Aye Um Safwan! Kya tumhe pata hai Sa'd ne mujhe kya bataya?" Unhone pucha, "Unhone aapko kya bataya?" Unhone jawab diya, "Woh daava karte hain Muhammad ne unhe (yaani sahaba ko) bataya hai ke woh mujhe qatl karenge. Maine unse pucha, 'Mecca mein?' Unhone kaha, 'Mujhe nahi pata.'" Phir Umaiya ne joda, "Allah ki qasam, main kabhi Mecca se bahar nahi jaunga." Magar jab Badr ki jung ka din aaya, Abu Jahl ne logon ko jung ke liye bulaya, kehte huye, "Jao aur apna caravan bachao." Magar Umaiya nikalna nahi chahte the. Abu Jahl unke paas aaye aur kaha, "Aye Abu Safwan! Agar log dekhen aap peeche rah gaye chahe aap wadi ke logon ke sardaar hain, phir woh bhi aapke saath peeche reh jaenge." Abu Jahl unhe jane par utsaahit karte rahe jab tak unhone (yaani Umaiya ne) kaha, "Chunke tumne mujhe apna khyaal badalne par majboor kiya hai, Allah ki qasam, main Mecca ka sabse behtareen unt khareedunga." Phir Umaiya ne (apni biwi se) kaha, "Aye Um Safwan, mujhe jo chahiye woh taiyaar karo (safar ke liye)." Unhone unse kaha, "Aye Abu Safwan! Kya aap apne Yathribi (yaani Madina ke) bhaee ki baat bhool gaye?" Unhone kaha, "Nahi, magar main unke saath sirf thoda door tak jana chahta hoon." Isliye jab Umaiya nikle, woh jahaan bhi padaav daalte, apna unt baandhte. Woh aisa karte rahe jab tak Allah ne unhe Badr mein qatl karvaa diya.

e: Narrated Ka`b bin Malik:I never failed to join Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in any of his Ghazawat except in the Ghazwa of Tabuk. However, I did not take part in the Ghazwa of Badr, but none who failed to take part in it, was blamed, for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had gone out to meet the caravans of (Quraish, but Allah caused them (i.e. Muslims) to meet their enemy unexpectedly (with no previous intention)
hi: Ka'b bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main kabhi Allah ke Rasool ki kisi Ghazwe mein shaamil hone se chhoota nahi siwaye Tabuk ke Ghazwe ke. Magar main Badr ki jung mein shaamil nahi hua tha, chahe jo koee ismein shaamil nahi hue, unhe iske liye kabhi doshi thahraya gaya, kyunke Allah ke Rasool (Quraish ke) caravanon se milne gaye the, magar Allah ne unhe (yaani Musalmanon ko) unke dushman se achanak milwaya (bina koee pahle se irada ke).

e: Narrated Ibn Masud:I witnessed Al-Miqdad bin Al-Aswad in a scene which would have been dearer to me than anything had I been the hero of that scene. He (i.e. Al-Miqdad) came to the Prophet (ﷺ) while the Prophet (ﷺ) was urging the Muslims to fight with the pagans. Al-Miqdad said, "We will not say as the People of Moses said: Go you and your Lord and fight you two. (5.27). But we shall fight on your right and on your left and in front of you and behind you." I saw the face of the Prophet (ﷺ) getting bright with happiness, for that saying delighted him
hi: Ibn Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Al-Miqdad (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Aswad ko ek aise drishya mein dekha jo mujhe kisi aur cheez se zyada pyara hota agar main us drishya ka hero hota. Woh (yaani Al-Miqdad) Nabi ke paas aaye jabke Nabi Musalmanon ko kaafiron se jung karne ke liye utsaahit kar rahe the. Al-Miqdad ne kaha, "Hum woh nahi kahenge jo Musa ki qaum ne kaha tha: 'Jaao aap aur aapka Rab aur donon jung kariye.' (5:27) Magar hum aapke dahine, aapke baaeen, aapke aage, aur aapke peeche se jung karenge." Maine Nabi ke chehre par khushi se chamakte dekha, kyunke is baat se unhe bahut khushi mili.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:On the day of the battle of Badr, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! I appeal to You (to fulfill) Your Covenant and Promise. O Allah! If Your Will is that none should worship You (then give victory to the pagans)." Then Abu Bakr took hold of him by the hand and said, "This is sufficient for you." The Prophet came out saying, "Their multitude will be put to flight and they will show their backs
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Badr ki jung ke din, Nabi ne kaha, "Aye Allah! Main teri barit aur waade ki apeal karta hoon. Aye Allah! Agar Teri marzi hai ke koee Teri ibadat na kare (to mushrikon ko fatah de)." Phir Abu Bakr ne unka haath pakada aur kaha, "Yeh aapke liye kaafi hai." Nabi bahar aaye, kehte huye, "Unki bhed jald hi bhaagegi aur woh peeth dikhaenge."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The believers who failed to join the Ghazwa of Badr and those who took part in it are not equal (in reward)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Woh momin jo Badr ki jung mein shaamil nahi hue aur jo shaamil hue, ajr mein barabar nahi hain.

e: Narrated Al-Bara:I and Ibn `Umar were considered too young to take part in the battle of Badr
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Main aur Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) Badr ki jung mein shaamil hone ke liye bahut chhote samjhe gaye the.

e: Narrated Al-Bara:I and Ibn `Umar were considered too young (to take part) in the battle of Badr, and the number of the Emigrant warriors were over sixty (men) and the Ansar were over
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Main aur Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) Badr ki jung mein shaamil hone ke liye bahut chhote samjhe gaye the, aur Muhajir mujahidon ki tadaad saath se zyada thi aur Ansaar saath se zyada.

e: Narrated Al-Bara:The companions of (the Prophet) Muhammad who took part in Badr, told me that their number was that of Saul's (i.e. Talut's) companions who crossed the river (of Jordan) with him and they were over three-hundred-and-ten men. By Allah, none crossed the river with him but a believer. (See Qur'an 2:)
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Muhammad ke sathiyon ne, jo Badr mein shaamil hue, mujhe bataya ke unki tadaad Saul (yaani Talut) ke sathiyon jitni thi jinhone unke saath nadi (Jordan) paar ki, aur woh teen sau das se zyada the. Allah ki qasam, koee bhi unke saath nadi paar nahi kiya siwaye ek sachche momin ke. (Dekhen Quran 2:)

e: Narrated Al-Bara:We, the Companions of Muhammad used to say that the number of the warriors of Badr was the same as the number of Saul's companions who crossed the river (of Jordan) with him, and none crossed the river with him but a believer, and they were over three-hundred-and-ten men
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Hum, Muhammad ke sahaba, kahte the ke Badr ke mujahidon ki tadaad Saul ke sathiyon jitni thi jinhone unke saath nadi paar ki, aur koee bhi unke saath nadi paar nahi kiya siwaye ek sachche momin ke, aur woh teen sau das se zyada the.

e: Narrated Al-Bara:We used to say that the warriors of Badr were over three-hundred-and-ten, as many as the Companions of Saul who crossed the river with him; and none crossed the river with him but a believer
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Hum kahte the ke Badr ke mujahid teen sau das se zyada the, jitne Saul ke sathi jinhone unke saath nadi paar ki; aur koee bhi unke saath nadi paar nahi kiya siwaye ek sachche momin ke.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Mas`ud:The Prophet (ﷺ) faced the Ka`ba and invoked evil on some people of Quraish, on Shaiba bin Rabi`a, `Utba bin Rabi`a, Al-Walid bin `Utba and Abu Jahl bin Hisham. I bear witness, by Allah, that I saw them all dead, putrefied by the sun as that day was a very hot day
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Ka'ba ki taraf munh karke kuch Quraish logon par bad-dua ki, Shaiba bin Rabi'a, Utba bin Rabi'a, Al-Walid bin Utba, aur Abu Jahl bin Hisham par. Main gawahi deta hoon, Allah ki qasam, maine unhen sab murda dekha, suraj se sadhe hue, kyunke woh din bahut garam tha.

e: Narrated `Abdullah That he came across Abu Jahl while he was on the point of death on the day of Badr. Abu Jahl said, "You should not be proud that you have killed me nor I am ashamed of being killed by my own folk
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Woh Abu Jahl ke paas se guzre jabke woh maut ke qareeb the, Badr ki jung ke din. Abu Jahl ne kaha, "Tumhe ispar gaurav nahi karna chahiye ke tumne mujhe qatl kiya hai, na hi mujhe apni hi qaum ke haathon qatl hone par sharm hai."

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Who will go and see what has happened to Abu Jahl?" Ibn Mas`ud went and found that the two sons of 'Afra had struck him fatally (and he was in his last breaths). `Abdullah bin Mas`ud said, "Are you Abu Jahl?" And took him by the beard. Abu Jahl said, "Can there be a man superior to one you have killed or one whom his own folk have killed?
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Kaun jaakar dekhega Abu Jahl ka kya hua?"
