Ibn Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) gaye aur paaya ke Afra ke do beton ne unhe maar-maar kar maut ke qareeb la diya tha (aur woh aakhri saansen le rahe the). Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Kya aap Abu Jahl hain?" aur unki daadhi pakad li. Abu Jahl ne kaha, "Kya koee shaks aise shaks se zyada izzatdaar ho sakta hai jise tumne qatl kiya hai ya jise uski apni qaum ne qatl kiya hai?"

e: Narrated Anas:On the day of Badr, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Who will go and see what has happened to Abu Jahl?" Ibn Mas`ud went and found that the two sons of 'Afra had struck him fatally. `Abdullah bin Mas`ud got hold of his beard and said, "'Are you Abu Jahl?" He replied, "Can there be a man more superior to one whom his own folk have killed (or you have killed)?
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Badr ki jung ke din, Nabi ne kaha, "Kaun jaakar dekhega Abu Jahl ka kya hua?" Ibn Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) gaye aur paaya ke Afra ke do beton ne unhe maar-maar kar maut ke qareeb la diya tha. Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne unki daadhi pakad li aur kaha, "Kya aap Abu Jahl hain?" Unhone jawab diya, "Kya koee shaks isse zyada izzatdaar ho sakta hai jise (tumne) qatl kiya hai ya jise uski apni qaum ne qatl kiya hai?"

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:(as above Hadith)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: (upar jaisa hi, yaani Hadith No. 3963 ki tarah).

e: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf:(the grandfather of Salih bin Ibrahim) the story of Badr, namely, the narration regarding the sons of 'Afra
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Auf bataate hain (Salih bin Ibrahim ke daade se): Badr ki kahani, khaaskar Afra ke beton ke baare mein riwaayat.

e: Narrated Abu Mijlaz:From Qais bin Ubad: `Ali bin Abi Talib said, "I shall be the first man to kneel down before (Allah), the Beneficent to receive His judgment on the day of Resurrection (in my favor)." Qais bin Ubad also said, "The following Verse was revealed in their connection:-- "These two opponents believers and disbelievers) Dispute with each other About their Lord." (22.19) Qais said that they were those who fought on the day of Badr, namely, Hamza, `Ali, 'Ubaida or Abu 'Ubaida bin Al-Harith, Shaiba bin Rabi`a, `Utba and Al-Walid bin `Utba
hi: Abu Mijlaz bataate hain (Qais bin Ubad se): Ali (Alayhis Salam) bin Abi Talib ne kaha, "Main sabse pahle shaks hoonga jo Qiyamat ke din Rehman (yaani Allah) ke saamne aakhri faisla sunne ke liye ghutne teke." Qais bin Ubad ne yeh bhi kaha, "Yeh Ayat unke silsile mein nazil hui: 'Yeh do virodhi paksh (momin aur kaafir) apne Rab ke baare mein ek-doosre se jhagadte hain.' (22:19)" Qais ne kaha ke yeh woh log the jinhone Badr ki jung ke din jung ki, yaani Hamza, Ali (Alayhis Salam), Ubaida ya Abu Ubaida bin Al-Harith, Shaiba bin Rabi'a, Utba, aur Al-Walid bin Utba.

e: Narrated Abu Dhar:The following Holy Verse:-- "These two opponents (believers & disbelievers) dispute with each other about their Lord," (22.19) was revealed concerning six men from Quraish, namely, `Ali, Hamza, 'Ubaida bin Al-Harith; Shaiba bin Rabi`a, `Utba bin Rabi`a and Al-Walid bin `Utba
hi: Abu Dharr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Yeh paak Ayat: "Yeh do virodhi paksh (momin aur kaafir) apne Rab ke baare mein ek-doosre se jhagadte hain," (22:19) chhah Quraish logon ke baare mein nazil huee, yaani Ali (Alayhis Salam), Hamza, Ubaida bin Al-Harith, Shaiba bin Rabi'a, Utba bin Rabi'a, aur Al-Walid bin Utba.

e: Narrated `Ali:The following Holy Verse:-- "These two opponents (believers and disbelievers) dispute with each other about their Lord." (22.19) was revealed concerning us
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Yeh paak Ayat: "Yeh do virodhi paksh (momin aur kaafir) apne Rab ke baare mein ek-doosre se jhagadte hain" (22:19) humare silsile mein naazil huee.

e: Narrated Qais bin Ubad:I heard Abu Dhar swearing that these Holy Verses were revealed in connection with those six persons on the day of Badr
hi: Qais bin Ubad bataate hain: Maine Abu Dharr (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko qasam khate suna ke yeh paak Ayaten un chhah logon ke silsile mein Badr ki jung ke din naazil huee.

e: Narrated Qais:I heard Abu Dhar swearing that the following Holy verse:-- "These two opponents (believers and disbelievers) disputing with each other about their Lord," (22.19) was revealed concerning those men who fought on the day of Badr, namely, Hamza, `Ali, Ubaida bin Al-Harith, `Utba and Shaiba----the two sons of Rabi`a-- and Al-Walid bin `Utba
hi: Qais bataate hain: Maine Abu Dharr (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko qasam khate suna ke yeh paak Ayat: "Yeh do virodhi paksh (momin aur kaafir) apne Rab ke baare mein ek-doosre se jhagadte hain" (22:19) un logon ke silsile mein naazil huee jinhone Badr ki jung ke din jung ki, yaani Hamza, Ali (Alayhis Salam), Ubaida bin Al-Harith, Utba aur Shaiba — Rabi'a ke do bete — aur Al-Walid bin Utba.

e: Narrated Abu 'Is-haq:A man asked Al-Bara' and I was listening, "Did `Ali take part in (the battle of) Badr?" Al-Bara' said, "(Yes). he even met (his enemies) in a duel and was clad in two armors (one over the other)
hi: Abu Ishaq bataate hain: Ek shaks ne Al-Bara se pucha jabke main sun raha tha, "Kya Ali (Alayhis Salam) Badr ki jung mein shaamil hue the?" Al-Bara ne kaha, "(Haan). Woh yahaan tak ke dwandva-yuddh (duel) mein bhi shaamil hue aur do kavach (ek doosre ke oopar) pahne hue the."

e: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf:"I had an agreement with Umaiya bin Khalaf (that he would look after my relatives and property in Mecca, and I would look after his relatives and property in Medina)." `Abdur-Rahman then mentioned the killing of Umaiya and his son on the day of Badr, and Bilal said, "Woe to me if Umaiya remains safe (i.e. alive)
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Auf bataate hain: "Mera Umaiya bin Khalaf ke saath ek muahida tha (ke woh Mecca mein mere rishtedaron aur maal ka khyaal rakhega, aur main Madina mein unke rishtedaron aur maal ka khyaal rakhunga)." Abdur-Rahman ne phir Umaiya aur unke bete ki Badr ki jung ke din hone waali maut ka zikar kiya, aur Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Mujhe afsos hoga agar Umaiya mahfooz (yaani zinda) rah gaya."

e: Narrated 'Abdullah: The Prophet (ﷺ) recited Surat-an-Najm and then prostrated himself, and all who were with him prostrated too. But an old man took a handful of dust and touched his forehead with it saying, "This is sufficient for me." Later on I saw him killed as an infidel
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Surat-an-Najm padhi aur phir sajda ki, aur sab jo unke saath the unhone bhi sajda ki. Magar ek budha shaks ne mutthi bhar mitti li aur usse apna maatha chhuya aur kaha, "Yeh mere liye kaafi hai." Baad mein maine unhe ek kaafir ke soorat mein qatl hote dekha.

e: Narrated 'Urwa (the son of Az-Zubair): Az-Zubair had three scars caused by the sword, one of which was over his shoulder and I used to insert my fingers in it. He received two of those wounds on the day of Badr and one on the day of Al-Yarmuk. When 'Abdullah bin Zubair was killed, 'Abdul-Malik bin Marwan said to me, "O 'Urwa, do you recognize the sword of Az-Zubair?" I said, "Yes." He said, "What marks does it have?" I replied, "It has a dent in its sharp edge which was caused in it on the day of Badr." 'Abdul- Malik said, "You are right! (i.e. their swords) have dents because of clashing with the regiments of the enemies Then 'Abdul-Malik returned that sword to me (i.e. Urwa). (Hisham, 'Urwa's son said, "We estimated the price of the sword as three-thousand (Dinars) and after that it was taken by one of us (i.e. the inheritors) and I wish I could have had it
hi: Urwa (Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke bete) bataate hain: Az-Zubair ko talwar se teen zakhm mile the, jinme se ek unke kandhe par tha aur main apni ungliyaan usmein daalta tha. Unhone do zakhm Badr ki jung ke din paye aur ek Al-Yarmuk ki jung ke din. Jab Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) qatl hue, Abdul-Malik bin Marwan ne mujhse kaha, "Aye Urwa, kya aap Az-Zubair ki talwaar ko pahchante hain?" Maine kaha, "Haan." Unhone pucha, "Ismein kaunse nishaan hain?" Maine jawab diya, "Iske teekhe kinare mein ek daant hai jo Badr ki jung ke din bana." Abdul-Malik ne kaha, "Aap sahi hain! (Yaani unki talwaron mein) daant dushman ki fauj se takraane ki wajah se hote hain." Phir Abdul-Malik ne woh talwaar mujhe (yaani Urwa ko) wapas kar di. (Hisham, Urwa ke bete ne kaha, "Humne us talwaar ki qeemat teen hazaar (Dinar) lagaee, aur uske baad use humme se ek ne (yaani waaris ne) le liya, aur kaash woh mere paas hoti.")

e: Narrated Hisham:That his father said, "The sword of Az-Zubair was decorated with silver." Hisham added, "The sword of `Urwa was (also) decorated with silver
hi: Hisham bataate hain (apne waalid se): Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki talwaar chandi se sajaee gaee thi. Hisham ne joda, "Urwa ki talwaar bhi chandi se sajaee gaee thi."

e: Narrated `Urwa:On the day of (the battle) of Al-Yarmuk, the companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to Az-Zubair, "Will you attack the enemy so that we shall attack them with you?" Az-Zubair replied, "If I attack them, you people would not support me." They said, "No, we will support you." So Az-Zubair attacked them (i.e. Byzantines) and pierced through their lines, and went beyond them and none of his companions was with him. Then he returned and the enemy got hold of the bridle of his (horse) and struck him two blows (with the sword) on his shoulder. Between these two wounds there was a scar caused by a blow, he had received on the day of Badr (battle). When I was a child I used to play with those scars by putting my fingers in them. On that day (my brother) "Abdullah bin Az-Zubair was also with him and he was ten years old. Az-Zubair had carried him on a horse and left him to the care of some men
hi: Urwa bataate hain: Al-Yarmuk ki jung ke din, Allah ke Rasool ke sahaba ne Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kaha, "Kya aap dushman par hamla karenge taaki hum bhi aapke saath hamla karen?" Az-Zubair ne jawab diya, "Agar main unpar hamla karta hoon, tum log mera saath nahi doge." Unhone kaha, "Nahi, hum aapka saath denge." Isliye Az-Zubair ne unpar (yaani Byzantines par) hamla kiya aur unki safon ko cheerte hue nikal gaye, aur unke saathiyon mein se koee bhi unke saath nahi tha. Phir woh wapas aaye aur dushman ne unke (ghode ki) lagaam pakad li aur unke kandhe par talwaar se do baar maara. In do zakhmon ke beech ek nishaan tha jo unhe Badr ki jung ke din ek maar se mila tha. Jab main bachcha tha, main un nishaanon mein apni ungliyaan daalkar khelta tha. Us din (yaani Al-Yarmuk ki jung ke din) (mera bhai) Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Az-Zubair bhi unke saath tha aur woh das saal ke the. Az-Zubair unhe ek ghode par uthaye hue the aur unhe kuch logon ki dekhbhaal mein chhod diya.

e: Narrated Abu Talha:On the day of Badr, the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered that the corpses of twenty four leaders of Quraish should be thrown into one of the dirty dry wells of Badr. (It was a habit of the Prophet (ﷺ) that whenever he conquered some people, he used to stay at the battle-field for three nights. So, on the third day of the battle of Badr, he ordered that his she-camel be saddled, then he set out, and his companions followed him saying among themselves." "Definitely he (i.e. the Prophet) is proceeding for some great purpose." When he halted at the edge of the well, he addressed the corpses of the Quraish infidels by their names and their fathers' names, "O so-and-so, son of so-and-so and O so-and-so, son of so-and-so! Would it have pleased you if you had obeyed Allah and His Apostle? We have found true what our Lord promised us. Have you too found true what your Lord promised you? "`Umar said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! You are speaking to bodies that have no souls!" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "By Him in Whose Hand Muhammad's soul is, you do not hear, what I say better than they do." (Qatada said, "Allah brought them to life (again) to let them hear him, to reprimand them and slight them and take revenge over them and caused them to feel remorseful and regretful
hi: Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Badr ki jung ke din, Nabi ne hukum diya ke Quraish ke chaubees sardaron ki laashen Badr ke ek gande sookhe kue mein phenk di jaen. (Yeh Nabi ki aadat thi ke jab bhi unhone kisi qaum ko fatah kiya, woh yuddh-kshetra mein teen raaten rukte.) Isliye Badr ki jung ke teesre din, unhone hukum diya ke unki untni par jin dala jaaye, phir woh nikle, aur unke sahaba unki pairvi karte huye, aapas mein kahte huye, "Nishchit soorat se, woh (yaani Nabi) kisi bade uddeshya ke liye ja rahe hain." Jab woh kue ke kinare ruke, unhone Quraish ke kaafiron ki laashon ko unke naamon aur unke waalidon ke naamon se sambodhit kiya, "Aye falaan, falaan ke bete, aur aye falaan, falaan ke bete! Kya tumhe khushi hoti agar tumne Allah aur uske Rasool ki itaaat ki hoti? Humne paaya ke jo humare Rab ne humse waada kiya woh sach tha. Kya tumne bhi paaya jo tumhare Rab ne tumse waada kiya, woh sach tha?" Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Aap un jismon se baat kar rahe hain jinmein koee rooh nahi hai!" Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haathon mein Muhammad ki rooh hai, tum jo main kah raha hoon use unse behtar nahi sun sakte." (Qatada ne kaha, "Allah ne unhe (dobara) zinda kiya taaki woh use sune, unhe daanta de aur zaleel kare aur unse badla le aur unhe pachhtava aur afsos mahsoos karvaye.")

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:regarding the Statement of Allah:--"Those who have changed Allah's Blessings for disbelief..." (14.28) The people meant here by Allah, are the infidels of Quraish. (`Amr, a sub-narrator said, "Those are (the infidels of) Quraish and Muhammad is Allah's Blessing. Regarding Allah's Statement:"..and have led their people Into the house of destruction? (14.29) Ibn `Abbas said, "It means the Fire they will suffer from (after their death) on the day of Badr
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke is farmaan ke baare mein: "Jinhone Allah ki niyaamaton ko kufr se badal diya..." (14:28) Yahaan jinka zikar hai woh Quraish ke kaafir hain. (Amr, doosre raawi ne kaha, "Woh Quraish ke kaafir hain aur Muhammad Allah ki niyaamat hain.") Allah ke is farmaan ke baare mein: "...aur apni qaum ko tabaahi ke ghar mein le gaye?" (14:29) Ibn Abbas ne kaha, "Iska matlab hai woh aag jo unhe (unki maut ke baad) Badr ki jung ke din jhelni hai."

e: Narrated Hisham's father:It was mentioned before `Aisha that Ibn `Umar attributed the following statement to the Prophet (ﷺ) "The dead person is punished in the grave because of the crying and lamentation Of his family." On that, `Aisha said, "But Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'The dead person is punished for his crimes and sins while his family cry over him then." She added, "And this is similar to the statement of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) when he stood by the (edge of the) well which contained the corpses of the pagans killed at Badr, 'They hear what I say.' She added, "But he said now they know very well what I used to tell them was the truth." `Aisha then recited: 'You cannot make the dead hear.' (30.52) and 'You cannot make those who are in their Graves, hear you.' (35.22) that is, when they had taken their places in the (Hell) Fire
hi: Hisham ke waalid bataate hain: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke saamne zikar hua ke Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) Nabi ki taraf yeh baat mansoob karte hain: "Murda apne pariwara ke rone aur maatam par qabar mein saza pata hai." Ispar, Ayesha ne kaha, "Magar Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, 'Murda apne gunahon aur paapon ki wajah se saza pata hai jabke uska pariwara us waqt uske liye rota hai.'" Unhone joda, "Aur yeh Allah ke Rasool ke us farmaan jaisa hai jab woh Badr ke kue ke (kinare) khade hue jismein mushrikon ki laashen thi, 'Woh jo main kahta hoon sunte hain.'" Unhone joda, "Magar unhone kaha ke ab unhe achhi tarah pata hai ke maine unse jo kaha woh sach tha." Phir Ayesha ne padha: "Aap murdon ko suna nahi sakte." (30:52) aur "Aap unhe jo apni qabron mein hain, suna nahi sakte." (35:22) yaani jab woh (Dozakh ki) aag mein apni jagahen le chuke the.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) stood at the well of Badr (which contained the corpses of the pagans) and said, "Have you found true what your lord promised you?" Then he further said, "They now hear what I say." This was mentioned before `Aisha and she said, "But the Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Now they know very well that what I used to tell them was the truth.' Then she recited (the Holy Verse):-- "You cannot make the dead hear... ...till the end of Verse
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi Badr ke kue (jismein mushrikon ki laashen thi) ke paas khade hue aur kaha, "Kya tumne paaya jo tumhare Rab ne tumse waada kiya, sach tha?" Phir unhone aage kaha, "Ab woh jo main kah raha hoon woh sunte hain." Yeh Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke saamne zikar hua aur unhone kaha, "Magar Nabi ne kaha, 'Ab unhe achhi tarah pata hai ke maine unse jo kaha woh sach tha.'" Phir unhone (paak Ayat) padha: "Aap murdon ko suna nahi sakte..." (aage tak)

e: Narrated Anas:Haritha was martyred on the day (of the battle) of Badr, and he was a young boy then. His mother came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! You know how dear Haritha is to me. If he is in Paradise, I shall remain patient, and hope for reward from Allah, but if it is not so, then you shall see what I do?" He said, "May Allah be merciful to you! Have you lost your senses? Do you think there is only one Paradise? There are many Paradises and your son is in the (most superior) Paradise of Al- Firdaus
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Haritha Badr ki jung ke din shaheed hue, aur woh us waqt ek jawan ladka the. Unki maa Nabi ke paas aee aur kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Aapko pata hai Haritha mujhe kitna pyara hai. Agar woh Jannat mein hai, main sabr karungi aur Allah se ajr ki ummeed rakhungi, magar agar aisa nahi hai, phir aap dekhenge main kya karungi?" Unhone kaha, "Allah tumpar reham kare! Kya tum apni samajh kho baithi ho? Kya tumhe lagta hai sirf ek hi Jannat hai? Bahut sari Jannaten hain, aur tumhara beta sabse behtareen Jannat, yaani Al-Firdaus, mein hai."

e: Narrated `Ali:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent me, Abu Marthad and Az-Zubair, and all of us were riding horses, and said, "Go till you reach Raudat-Khakh where there is a pagan woman carrying a letter from Hatib bin Abi Balta'a to the pagans of Mecca." So we found her riding her camel at the place which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had mentioned. We said (to her),"(Give us) the letter." She said, "I have no letter." Then we made her camel kneel down and we searched her, but we found no letter. Then we said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had not told us a lie, certainly. Take out the letter, otherwise we will strip you naked." When she saw that we were determined, she put her hand below her waist belt, for she had tied her cloak round her waist, and she took out the letter, and we brought her to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) Then `Umar said, "O Allah's Apostle! (This Hatib) has betrayed Allah, His Apostle and the believers! Let me cut off his neck!" The Prophet asked Hatib, "What made you do this?" Hatib said, "By Allah, I did not intend to give up my belief in Allah and His Apostle but I wanted to have some influence among the (Mecca) people so that through it, Allah might protect my family and property. There is none of your companions but has some of his relatives there through whom Allah protects his family and property." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He has spoken the truth; do not say to him but good." `Umar said, "He has betrayed Allah, His Apostle and the faithful believers. Let me cut off his neck!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Is he not one of the Badr warriors? May be Allah looked at the Badr warriors and said, 'Do whatever you like, as I have granted Paradise to you, or said, 'I have forgiven you."' On this, tears came out of `Umar's eyes, and he said, "Allah and His Apostle know better
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne mujhe, Abu Marthad, aur Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko bheja, aur hum sab ghodon par sawar the, aur kaha, "Jaao jab tak tum Raudat-Khakh na pahunch jao jahaan ek mushrik aurat hai jo Hatib bin Abi Balta'a ka ek khat Mecca ke mushrikon tak le ja rahi hai." Isliye humne unhe Allah ke Rasool ke bataye hue jagah par apne unt par sawar paaya. Humne unse kaha, "(Hamein do) khat." Unhone kaha, "Mere paas koee khat nahi hai." Phir humne unke unt ko bithaya aur unki talaashi li, magar humein koee khat nahi mila. Phir humne kaha, "Allah ke Rasool ne nishchit soorat se humein jhoot nahi kaha. Khat nikalo, warna hum tumhe nanga kar denge." Jab unhone dekha ke hum dradh hain, unhone apna haath apni kamar ki patti ke neeche daala, kyunke unhone apni chaadar apni kamar ke gird baandhi hui thi, aur unhone khat nikala, aur humne unhe Allah ke Rasool ke paas laaya. Phir Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! (Is Hatib ne) Allah, uske Rasool, aur mominon ke saath dhoka kiya hai! Mujhe unki gardan kaatne dijiye!" Nabi ne Hatib se pucha, "Tumne yeh kyun kiya?" Hatib ne kaha, "Allah ki qasam, mera irada Allah aur uske Rasool par apna iman chhodne ka nahi tha, magar main Mecca ke logon mein kuch prabhaav rakhna chahta tha taaki uske zariye Allah mere pariwara aur maal ki hifaazat kare. Aapke sathiyon mein se koee bhi nahi hai jinke wahaan kuch rishtedaar na hon jinke zariye Allah unke pariwara aur maal ki hifaazat karta hai." Nabi ne kaha, "Unhone sach kaha; unse achhi baaten ke ilawa kuch mat kaho." Umar ne kaha, "Unhone Allah, uske Rasool, aur sachche mominon ke saath dhoka kiya hai! Mujhe unki gardan kaatne dijiye!" Nabi ne kaha, "Kya woh Badr ke mujahidon mein se nahi hain? Shaayad Allah ne Badr ke mujahidon ki taraf dekhkar kaha ho, 'Jo chaho karo, kyunke maine tumhe Jannat di hai,' ya kaha, 'Maine tumhe maaf kar diya hai.'" Ispar, Umar ki aankhon se aansu nikle, aur unhone kaha, "Allah aur uske Rasool behtar jaante hain."

e: Narrated Usaid:On the day of Badr, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to us, "When the enemy comes near to you, shoot at them but use your arrows sparingly (so that your arrows should not be wasted)
hi: Usaid bataate hain: Badr ki jung ke din, Allah ke Rasool ne humse kaha, "Jab dushman tumhare qareeb aaye, unpar teer chalao magar apne teeron ka istemal sochkar karo (taaki teer barbaad na hon)."

e: Narrated Abu Usaid:On the day of (the battle of) Badr, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to us, "When your enemy comes near to you (i.e. overcomes you by sheer number), shoot at them but use your arrows sparingly
hi: Abu Usaid bataate hain: Badr ki jung ke din, Allah ke Rasool ne humse kaha, "Jab tumhara dushman tumhare qareeb aaye (yaani tadaad mein tumpar haavi ho jaaye), unpar teer chalao magar apne teeron ka istemal sochkar karo."

e: Narrated Al-Bara' bin `Azib:On the day of Uhud the Prophet (ﷺ) appointed `Abdullah bin Jubair as chief of the archers, and seventy among us were injured and martyred. On the day (of the battle) of Badr, the Prophet (ﷺ) and his companions had inflicted 140 casualties on the pagans, 70 were taken prisoners, and 70 were killed. Abu Sufyan said, "This is a day of (revenge) for the day of Badr and the issue of war is undecided
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Uhud ki jung ke din, Nabi ne Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Jubair ko tirandazon ka sardaar muqarrar kiya, aur hum mein se sattar log zakhmi aur shaheed hue. Badr ki jung ke din, Nabi aur unke sahaba ne mushrikon ko ek sau chaalis nuksaan pahunchaya tha, sattar ko qaidi banaya gaya, aur sattar qatl kiye gaye. Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Yeh Badr ke din ka (badla) din hai, aur jung ka mudda abhi tak tay nahi hua."

e: Narrated Abu Musa:That the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The good is what Allah gave us later on (after Uhud), and the reward of truthfulness is what Allah gave us after the day (of the battle) of Badr
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Achhaee woh hai jo Allah ne humein baad mein di (Uhud ke baad), aur sachaee ka ajr woh hai jo Allah ne humein Badr ki jung ke din ke baad diya."

e: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf:While I was fighting in the front file on the day (of the battle) of Badr, suddenly I looked behind and saw on my right and left two young boys and did not feel safe by standing between them. Then one of them asked me secretly so that his companion may not hear, "O Uncle! Show me Abu Jahl." I said, "O nephew! What will you do to him?" He said, "I have promised Allah that if I see him (i.e. Abu Jahl), I will either kill him or be killed before I kill him." Then the other said the same to me secretly so that his companion should not hear. I would not have been pleased to be in between two other men instead of them. Then I pointed him (i.e. Abu Jahl) out to them. Both of them attacked him like two hawks till they knocked him down. Those two boys were the sons of 'Afra' (i.e. an Ansari woman)
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Auf bataate hain: Jabke main Badr ki jung ke din agli saf mein jung kar raha tha, achanak maine peeche mudkar dekha aur apni dahini aur baaeen taraf do jawan ladke dekhe, aur do jawan ladkon ke beech khade hone mein main mahfooz mahsoos nahi kar raha tha. Phir unmein se ek ne mujhse dheere se pucha taaki unka sathi na sune, "Aye chacha! Mujhe Abu Jahl dikhaiye." Maine kaha, "Aye bhatije! Tum unke saath kya karoge?" Usne kaha, "Maine Allah se waada kiya hai ke agar main unhe (yaani Abu Jahl ko) dekhta hoon, main ya to unhe qatl karunga ya khud qatl ho jaunga isse pahle ke main unhe qatl karoon." Phir doosre ne bhi mujhse wahi baat dheere se kahi taaki unka sathi na sune. Main donon ke beech ke bajaye kisi aur ke saath khade hone se khush nahi hota. Phir maine unhe (yaani Abu Jahl ko) unhe dikhaya. Donon ne unpar do baazon ki tarah hamla kiya jab tak unhone unhe gira diya. Woh do ladke Afra (yaani ek Ansaari aurat) ke bete the.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent out ten spies under the command of `Asim bin Thabit Al-Ansari, the grand-father of `Asim bin `Umar Al-Khattab. When they reached (a place called) Al-Hadah between 'Usfan and Mecca, their presence was made known to a sub-tribe of Hudhail called Banu Lihyan. So they sent about one hundred archers after them. The archers traced the footsteps (of the Muslims) till they found the traces of dates which they had eaten at one of their camping places. The archers said, "These dates are of Yathrib (i.e. Medina)," and went on tracing the Muslims' footsteps. When `Asim and his companions became aware of them, they took refuge in a (high) place. But the enemy encircled them and said, "Come down and surrender. We give you a solemn promise and covenant that we will not kill anyone of you." `Asim bin Thabit said, "O people! As for myself, I will never get down to be under the protection of an infidel. O Allah! Inform your Prophet about us." So the archers threw their arrows at them and martyred `Asim. Three of them came down and surrendered to them, accepting their promise and covenant and they were Khubaib, Zaid bin Ad-Dathina and another man. When the archers got hold of them, they untied the strings of the arrow bows and tied their captives with them. The third man said, "This is the first proof of treachery! By Allah, I will not go with you for I follow the example of these." He meant the martyred companions. The archers dragged him and struggled with him (till they martyred him). Then Khubaib and Zaid bin Ad-Dathina were taken away by them and later on they sold them as slaves in Mecca after the event of the Badr battle. The sons of Al-Harith bin `Amr bin Naufal bought Khubaib for he was a person who had killed (their father) Al-Harith bin `Amr on the day (of the battle) of Badr. Khubaib remained imprisoned by them till they decided unanimously to kill him. One day Khubaib borrowed from a daughter of Al-Harith, a razor for shaving his pubic hair, and she lent it to him. By chance, while she was inattentive, a little son of hers went to him (i.e. Khubaib) and she saw that Khubaib had seated him on his thigh while the razor was in his hand. She was so much terrified that Khubaib noticed her fear and said, "Are you afraid that I will kill him? Never would I do such a thing." Later on (while narrating the story) she said, "By Allah, I had never seen a better captive than Khubaib. By Allah, one day I saw him eating from a bunch of grapes in his hand while he was fettered with iron chains and (at that time) there was no fruit in Mecca." She used to say," It was food Allah had provided Khubaib with." When they took him to Al-Hil out of Mecca sanctuary to martyr him, Khubaib requested them. "Allow me to offer a two-rak`at prayer." They allowed him and he prayed two rak`at and then said, "By Allah! Had I not been afraid that you would think I was worried, I would have prayed more." Then he (invoked evil upon them) saying, "O Allah! Count them and kill them one by one, and do not leave anyone of them"' Then he recited: "As I am martyred as a Muslim, I do not care in what way I receive my death for Allah's Sake, for this is for the Cause of Allah. If He wishes, He will bless the cut limbs of my body." Then Abu Sirwa', 'Uqba bin Al-Harith went up to him and killed him. It was Khubaib who set the tradition of praying for any Muslim to be martyred in captivity (before he is executed). The Prophet (ﷺ) told his companions of what had happened (to those ten spies) on the same day they were martyred. Some Quraish people, being informed of `Asim bin Thabit's death, sent some messengers to bring a part of his body so that his death might be known for certain, for he had previously killed one of their leaders (in the battle of Badr). But Allah sent a swarm of wasps to protect the dead body of `Asim, and they shielded him from the messengers who could not cut anything from his body
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne das jaasoson ko Asim bin Thabit Al-Ansari, jo Asim bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Khattab ke dada the, ki kamaand mein bheja. Jab woh Al-Hadah pahunche, jo Usfan aur Mecca ke beech tha, unki maujoodgi Hudhail ki ek shaakha, Banu Lihyan, ko pata chal gaee. Isliye unhone unke peeche taquriban ek sau tirandaajon ko bheja. Tirandaajon ne unke paanv ke nishaanon ka picha kiya jab tak unhone khajoor ke daanon ke nishaan paaye jo Musalmanon ne apne ek padaav par khaae the. Tirandaajon ne kaha, "Yeh khajoor Yathrib (yaani Madina) ke hain," aur Musalmanon ke nishaanon ka picha karte rahe. Jab Asim aur unke sathi ko unka pata chala, woh ek (oonchi) jagah par panah lekar chale gaye. Magar dushman ne unhe gher liya aur kaha, "Neeche ao aur surrender kar do. Hum tumhe pukhta waada aur muahida dete hain ke hum tum mein se kisi ko qatl nahi karenge." Asim bin Thabit ne kaha, "Aye logo! Jahaan tak mera sawal hai, main kabhi ek kaafir ki panah mein neeche nahi jaunga. Aye Allah! Apne Nabi ko humare baare mein bataa." Isliye tirandaajon ne unpar teer chalaae aur Asim ko shaheed kar diya. Unmein se teen neeche aaye aur unse surrender kiya, unka waada aur muahida qubool karte huye, aur woh Khubaib, Zaid bin Ad-Dathina, aur ek aur shaks the. Jab tirandaajon ne unhe pakad liya, unhone apne teer-kamaanon ki doriyaan kholi aur apne qaidiyon ko unse baandha. Teesre shaks ne kaha, "Yeh dhoke ka pahla saboot hai! Allah ki qasam, main tumhare saath nahi jaunga, kyunke main un logon ki misaal ka anusaran karta hoon," unka ishara un shahid hue sathiyon ki taraf tha. Tirandaajon ne unhe ghaseeta aur unse jhagda kiya (jab tak unhone unhe shaheed kar diya). Phir Khubaib aur Zaid bin Ad-Dathina ko woh le gaye aur baad mein unhe Mecca mein Badr ki jung ki ghatna ke baad gulaam ke tor par bech diya. Al-Harith bin Amr bin Naufal ke beton ne Khubaib ko khareeda kyunke woh us shaks ne (unke waalid) Al-Harith bin Amr ko Badr ki jung ke din qatl kiya tha. Khubaib unke paas qaid mein rahe jab tak unhone unhe qatl karne ka ekmat se faisla kiya. Ek din, Khubaib ne Al-Harith ki ek beti se apne sharma-jagah ke baal sadaane ke liye ek ustra udhaar maanga, aur unhone use de diya. Achanak, jabke woh be-dhyaan thi, unka ek chhota beta unke (yaani Khubaib ke) paas gaya aur unhone dekha Khubaib ne use apni raan par bithaya hua tha jabke ustra unke haath mein tha. Woh itna ghabraee ke Khubaib ne unka dar mahsoos kiya aur kaha, "Kya aapko dar hai main ise qatl karunga? Main aisa kabhi nahi karunga." Baad mein (kahani sunate huye) unhone kaha, "Allah ki qasam, maine kabhi Khubaib se behtar koee qaidi nahi dekha. Allah ki qasam, ek din maine unhe apne haath mein angoor ke ek guchhe se khate dekha jabke woh lohe ki zanjeeron mein jakde hue the, aur (us waqt) Mecca mein koee phal nahi tha." Woh kaha karti thi, "Yeh khaana tha jo Allah ne Khubaib ko diya." Jab woh unhe Al-Hil le gaye, Mecca ki mahafooz seema se bahar, unhe shaheed karne ke liye, Khubaib ne unse guzarish ki, "Mujhe do rakat namaz padhne dijiye." Unhone unhe ijazat di aur unhone do rakat padhi aur phir kaha, "Allah ki qasam! Agar mujhe dar na hota ke tum sochte ke main betaab hoon, main aur namaz padhta." Phir unhone (unpar bad-dua ki) kehte huye, "Aye Allah! Unhe ginna aur unhe ek-ek karke qatl karna, aur koee na chhodna." Phir unhone padha: "Chunke main ek Musalman ke tor par shaheed ho raha hoon, mujhe parwaah nahi kis tarike se meri maut hoti hai, Allah ki khaatir, kyunke yeh Allah ki raah mein hai. Agar Woh chaahe, Woh mere jism ke kate hue angon ko barkat dega." Phir Abu Sirwa, Uqba bin Al-Harith, unke paas gaye aur unhe qatl kiya. Khubaib hi the jinhone yeh riwaj shuru ki ke jo bhi Musalman qaid mein shaheed hone wala ho, use (fansi se pahle) namaz padhni chahiye. Nabi ne apne sahaba ko usi din bataya jo (un das jaasoson ke saath) hua tha, usi din jab woh shaheed hue. Kuch Quraish log, Asim bin Thabit ki maut ki khabar milne par, unke jism ka ek hissa lane ke liye kuch aadmi bheje taaki unki maut nishchit soorat se jaani ja sake, kyunke unhone pahle unke ek sardaar ko qatl kiya tha (Badr ki jung mein). Magar Allah ne bhadon (yaani wasps) ka ek jhund bheja Asim ki laash ki hifaazat ke liye, aur unhone unhe un sandesh-vahakon se bacha liya jo unke jism se kuch bhi kaatne mein asamarth rahe.

e: Narrated Nafi: Ibn 'Umar was once told that Said bin Zaid bin 'Amr bin Nufail, one of the Badr warriors, had fallen ill on a Friday. Ibn 'Umar rode to him late in the forenoon. The time of the Friday prayer approached and Ibn 'Umar did not take part in the Friday prayer
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko ek baar bataya gaya ke Sa'id bin Zaid bin Amr bin Nufail, Badr ke mujahidon mein se ek, Jumme ke din bimar pad gaye. Ibn Umar dopahar ke baad unse milne gaye. Jumme ki namaz ka waqt aaya aur Ibn Umar Jumme ki namaz mein shaamil nahi hue.

e: Narrated Subaia bint Al-Harith: That she was married to Sa`d bin Khaula who was from the tribe of Bani 'Amr bin Luai, and was one of those who fought the Badr battle. He died while she was pregnant during Hajjat-ul-Wada.' Soon after his death, she gave birth to a child. When she completed the term of delivery (i.e. became clean), she prepared herself for suitors. Abu As-Sanabil bin Ba'kak, a man from the tribe of Bani Abd-ud-Dar called on her and said to her, "What! I see you dressed up for the people to ask you in marriage. Do you want to marry By Allah, you are not allowed to marry unless four months and ten days have elapsed (after your husband's death)." Subai'a in her narration said, "When he (i.e. Abu As-Sanabil) said this to me, I put on my dress in the evening and went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and asked him about this problem. He gave the verdict that I was free to marry as I had already given birth to my child and ordered me to marry if I wished
hi: Subaia bint Al-Harith bataati hain: Unki shaadi Sa'd bin Khaula se huee thi jo Bani Amr bin Luai qabile se the, aur woh Badr ki jung mein ladne walon mein se ek the. Unka intiqal hua jabke woh garbhvati thi, Hajjat-ul-Wada ke dauran. Unke intiqal ke thoda der baad, unhone ek bachche ko paidaish diya. Jab unki prasav (yaani nifaas) ki muddat poori huee (yaani woh paak ho gaee), unhone apne aap ko sujhaav dene walon (rishte ke prastavon) ke liye taiyaar kiya. Abu As-Sanabil bin Ba'kak, Bani Abd-ud-Dar qabile ke ek shaks, unse milne aaye aur kaha, "Kya! Main dekh raha hoon aap logon se aapko shaadi ke liye puchne ke liye taiyaar hokar baithi hain. Kya aap shaadi karna chahti hain? Allah ki qasam, aapko shaadi ki ijazat nahi hai jab tak chaar mahine das din (aapke shohar ki maut ke baad) na guzar jaen." Subaia ne apni kahani mein kaha, "Jab unhone (yaani Abu As-Sanabil ne) mujhse yeh kaha, maine shaam ko apna kapda pehna aur Allah ke Rasool ke paas gaee aur unse is samasya ke baare mein pucha. Unhone faisla diya ke main shaadi karne ke liye azad hoon kyunke maine pahle hi apna bachcha paida kare diya tha, aur unhone mujhe shaadi karne ka hukum diya agar main chahun."

e: Narrated Rifaa:(who was one of the Badr warriors) Gabriel came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "How do you look upon the warriors of Badr among yourselves?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "As the best of the Muslims." or said a similar statement. On that, Gabriel said, "And so are the Angels who participated in the Badr (battle)
hi: Rifaa bataate hain (jo Badr ke mujahidon mein se ek the): Jibreel Nabi ke paas aaye aur kaha, "Aap apne beech Badr ke mujahidon ko kaise dekhte hain?" Nabi ne kaha, "Musalmanon mein sabse behtar," ya isi se milta-julta kuch kaha. Ispar, Jibreel ne kaha, "Aur waise hi hain woh farishte jinhone Badr ki jung mein hissa liya."

e: Narrated Mu`adh bin Rifa`a bin Rafi`:Rifa`a was one of the warriors of Badr while (his father) Rafi` was one of the people of Al-`Aqaba (i.e. those who gave the pledge of allegiance at Al-`Aqaba). Rafi` used to say to his son, "I would not have been happier if I had taken part in the Badr battle instead of taking part in the 'Aqaba pledge
hi: Mu'adh bin Rifa'a bin Rafi bataate hain: Rifa'a Badr ke mujahidon mein se ek the jabke (unke waalid) Rafi Al-Aqaba ke logon mein se ek the (yaani jinhone Al-Aqaba mein bai'at di). Rafi apne bete se kaha karte the, "Main utna khush nahi hota agar maine Badr ki jung mein hissa liya hota bajaye Al-Aqaba ki bai'at mein hissa lene ke."

e: Narrated Mu`adh:The one who asked (the Prophet) was Gabriel (refer to Hadith)
hi: Mu'adh bataate hain: Jinhone (Nabi se) sawal kiya woh Jibreel the (dekhen Hadith).

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said on the day (of the battle) of Badr, "This is Gabriel holding the head of his horse and equipped with arms for the battle
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Badr ki jung ke din kaha, "Yeh Jibreel hain, apne ghode ke sar ko pakde hue aur jung ke liye hathiyaron se saje hue."

e: Narrated Anas:Abu Zaid died and did not leave any offspring, and he was one of the Badr warriors
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Zaid ka intiqal hua aur unhone koee aulad nahi chhodi, aur woh Badr ke mujahidon mein se ek the.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Abu Sa`id bin Malik Al-Khudri returned from a journey and his family offered him some meat of sacrifices offered at `Id ul Adha. On that he said, "I will not eat it before asking (whether it is allowed)." He went to his maternal brother, Qatada bin Nu'man, who was one of the Badr warriors, and asked him about it. Qatada said, "After your departure, an order was issued by the Prophet (ﷺ) cancelling the prohibition of eating sacrifices after three days
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Saeed bin Malik Al-Khudri ek safar se wapas aaye aur unke pariwara ne unhe Eid-ul-Adha ki qurbaniyon ka kuch gosht diya. Ispar unhone kaha, "Main ise khaane se pahle (yeh) puchunga (kya yeh jaiz hai)." Woh apne mama ke bhai, Qatada bin Nu'man, jo Badr ke mujahidon mein se ek the, ke paas gaye aur unse iske baare mein pucha. Qatada ne kaha, "Aapke jane ke baad, Nabi ne ek hukum jaari kiya jismein teen din ke baad qurbani ka gosht khaane ki paband hataee gaee thi."

e: Narrated `Urwa:Az-Zubair said, "I met Ubaida bin Sa`id bin Al-As on the day (of the battle) of Badr and he was covered with armor; so much that only his eyes were visible. He was surnamed Abu Dhat-al-Karish. He said (proudly), 'I am Abu Dhat-al-Karish.' I attacked him with the spear and pierced his eye and he died. I put my foot over his body to pull (that spear) out, but even then I had to use a great force to take it out as its both ends were bent." `Urwa said, "Later on Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked Az-Zubair for the spear and he gave it to him. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died, Az-Zubair took it back. After that Abu Bakr demanded it and he gave it to him, and when Abu Bakr died, Az-Zubair took it back. `Umar then demanded it from him and he gave it to him. When `Umar died, Az-Zubair took it back, and then `Uthman demanded it from him and he gave it to him. When `Uthman was martyred, the spear remained with `Ali's offspring. Then `Abdullah bin Az-Zubair demanded it back, and it remained with him till he was martyred
hi: Urwa bataate hain: Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Maine Badr ki jung ke din Ubaida bin Sa'id bin Al-As se mulaqaat ki aur woh kavach mein itna dhake hue the ke sirf unki aankhen dikhti thi. Unka upnaam Abu Dhat-al-Karish tha. Unhone (gaurav se) kaha, 'Main Abu Dhat-al-Karish hoon.' Maine unpar bhaale se hamla kiya aur unki aankh mein bhaala ghusa diya aur unka intiqal ho gaya. Maine bhaale ko nikalne ke liye unke jism par apna paanv rakha, magar phir bhi mujhe ise nikalne ke liye bahut zor lagana pada kyunke iske donon sire mode hue the." Urwa ne kaha, "Baad mein Allah ke Rasool ne Az-Zubair se woh bhaala maanga aur unhone unhe de diya. Jab Allah ke Rasool ka intiqal hua, Az-Zubair ne use wapas le liya. Uske baad Abu Bakr ne use maanga aur unhone unhe de diya, aur jab Abu Bakr ka intiqal hua, Az-Zubair ne ise wapas le liya. Phir Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne unse ise maanga aur unhone unhe de diya. Jab Umar ka intiqal hua, Az-Zubair ne ise wapas le liya, aur phir Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne unse ise maanga aur unhone unhe de diya. Jab Uthman shaheed hue, bhaala Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki aulad ke paas raha. Phir Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Az-Zubair ne ise wapas maanga, aur woh unke paas raha jab tak woh khud shaheed hue."

e: Narrated 'Ubada bin As-Samit:(who was one of the Badr warriors) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Give me the pledge of allegiance
hi: Ubada bin As-Samit bataate hain (jo Badr ke mujahidon mein se ek the): Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Mujhe bai'at do."

e: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) Abu Hudhaifa, one of those who fought the battle of Badr, with Allah's Apostle adopted Salim as his son and married his niece Hind bint Al-Walid bin `Utba to him and Salim was a freed slave of an Ansari woman. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) also adopted Zaid as his son. In the pre-Islamic period of ignorance the custom was that, if one adopted a son, the people would call him by the name of the adopted-father whom he would inherit as well, till Allah revealed: "Call them (adopted sons) By (the names of) their fathers
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain (Nabi ki biwi): Abu Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ), jo Allah ke Rasool ke saath Badr ki jung mein lade the, ne Salim ko apna beta banaya aur unki bhatiji Hind bint Al-Walid bin Utba ki shaadi unse karvaee, aur Salim ek Ansaari aurat ka azaad kiya gulaam tha. Allah ke Rasool ne bhi Zaid ko apna beta banaya. Jahiliyat ke daur mein, riwaj yeh thi ke agar koee apne bete ko apnata, log unhe god lene wale baap ke naam se pukarte jinke woh waaris bhi bante, jab tak Allah ne naazil kiya: "Unhe (yaani god lie hue beton ko) unke (asli) baapon ke naam se pukaro."

e: Narrated Ar-Rubai bint Muauwidh:The Prophet (ﷺ) came to me the night my marriage was consummated and sat down on my bed as you (the sub-narrator) are sitting now, and small girls were beating the tambourine and singing in lamentation of my father who had been killed on the day of the battle of Badr. Then one of the girls said, "There is a Prophet amongst us who knows what will happen tomorrow." The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to her)," Do not say this, but go on saying what you have spoken before
hi: Ar-Rubai bint Muauwidh bataati hain: Nabi mere paas aaye us raat jab meri shaadi poori huee aur mere bistar par baithe jaise aap (subordinate raawi) abhi baithe hain, aur chhoti ladkiyaan daf baja rahi thi aur mere waalid ki taarif mein geet gaa rahi thi jo Badr ki jung ke din shaheed hue the. Phir unmein se ek ladki ne kaha, "Humare beech ek Nabi hain jo jaante hain kal kya hoga." Nabi ne (unse) kaha, "Yeh mat kaho, magar woh kahte raho jo tumne pahle kaha tha."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Abu Talha, a companion of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and one of those who fought at Badr together with Allah's Apostle told me that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said. "Angels do not enter a house in which there is a dog or a picture" He meant the images of creatures that have souls
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ), Allah ke Rasool ke ek sathi aur Badr ki jung mein Allah ke Rasool ke saath ladne walon mein se ek, ne mujhe bataya ke Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Farishte us ghar mein daakhil nahi hote jismein kutta ya tasveer ho." Unka ishara un jeevit praniyon ki chhaviyon ki taraf tha.

e: Narrated `Ali:I had a she-camel which I got in my share from the booty of the battle of Badr, and the Prophet (ﷺ) had given me another she camel from the Khumus which Allah had bestowed on him that day. And when I intended to celebrate my marriage to Fatima, the daughter of the Prophet, I made an arrangement with a goldsmith from Bani Qainuqa 'that he should go with me to bring Idhkhir (i.e. a kind of grass used by gold-smiths) which I intended to sell to gold-smiths in order to spend its price on the marriage banquet. While I was collecting ropes and sacks of pack saddles for my two she-camels which were kneeling down beside an Ansari's dwelling and after collecting what I needed, I suddenly found that the humps of the two she-camels had been cut off and their flanks had been cut open and portions of their livers had been taken out. On seeing that, I could not help weeping. I asked, "Who has done that?" They (i.e. the people) said, "Hamza bin `Abdul Muttalib has done it. He is present in this house with some Ansari drinkers, a girl singer, and his friends. The singer said in her song, "O Hamza, get at the fat she-camels!" On hearing this, Hamza rushed to his sword and cut off the camels' humps and cut their flanks open and took out portions from their livers." Then I came to the Prophet, with whom Zaid bin Haritha was present. The Prophet (ﷺ) noticed my state and asked, "What is the matter?" I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), I have never experienced such a day as today! Hamza attacked my two she-camels, cut off their humps and cut their flanks open, and he is still present in a house along with some drinkers." The Prophet (ﷺ) asked for his cloak, put it on, and proceeded, followed by Zaid bin Haritha and myself, till he reached the house where Hamza was. He asked the permission to enter, and he was permitted. The Prophet (ﷺ) started blaming Hamza for what he had done. Hamza was drunk and his eyes were red. He looked at the Prophet (ﷺ) then raised his eyes to look at his knees and raised his eyes more to look at his face and then said, "You are not but my father's slaves." When the Prophet (ﷺ) understood that Hamza was drunk, he retreated, walking backwards went out and we left with him
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Mere paas ek untni thi jo mujhe Badr ki jung ke maal-e-ghanimat mein apne hisse ke soorat mein mili, aur Nabi ne mujhe Khumus (yaani paanchvaan hissa) mein se ek aur untni di jo Allah ne unhe us din diya. Aur jab maine Nabi ki beti Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ke saath apni shaadi manane ka irada kiya, maine Bani Qainuqa ke ek sunaar ke saath ek waada kiya ke woh mere saath jaega Idhkhir (yaani ek qisam ki ghaas jise sunaar istemal karte the) lane, jise main sunaron ko bechkar chahta tha taaki iski qeemat ko shaadi ki dawat par kharch kar sakoon. Jabke main apni do untniyon ke liye rassiyaan aur baag-on ke thaile jama kar raha tha jo ek Ansaari ke ghar ke bagal mein baithi hui thi, jama karne ke baad jo mujhe chahiye tha, main achanak paaya ke un donon untniyon ke kohaan kate hue the aur unke pehlu kate hue the aur unke jigar ka kuch hissa nikala liya gaya tha. Yeh dekhkar, main apne aap ko rone se nahi rok paaya. Maine pucha, "Yeh kisne kiya?" Woh (yaani logon ne) kaha, "Hamza bin Abdul Muttalib ne yeh kiya hai. Woh is ghar mein kuch Ansaari sharaabiyon ke saath maujood hain, ek gaane wali ladki, aur unke doston ke saath." Gaane wali ne apne geet mein kaha, "Aye Hamza, moti untniyon ko pakdo!" Yeh sunkar, Hamza apni talwaar ki taraf daude aur untniyon ke kohaan kate aur unke pehlu kate aur unke jigar ka kuch hissa nikala liya. Phir main Nabi ke paas gaya, jinke saath Zaid bin Haritha maujood the. Nabi ne meri haalat dekhi aur pucha, "Kya baat hai?" Maine kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Maine aisa din kabhi nahi jhela jaisa aaj jhela hai! Hamza ne meri do untniyon par hamla kiya, unke kohaan kate aur unke pehlu kate, aur woh abhi bhi sharaabiyon ke saath ek ghar mein maujood hain." Nabi ne apna kapda maanga, use pehna, aur nikle, Zaid bin Haritha aur main unke peeche the, jab tak woh us ghar tak pahunche jahaan Hamza the. Unhone andar aane ki ijazat maangi, aur unhe ijazat mil gaee. Nabi ne Hamza ko unke kiye par daantna shuru kiya. Hamza sharaabi the aur unki aankhen laal thi. Unhone Nabi ki taraf dekha, phir apni aankhen uthakar unke ghutnon ko dekha, phir apni aankhen aur oonchi uthakar unke chehre ko dekha aur phir kaha, "Tum sirf mere waalid ke gulaam ho." Jab Nabi ko samajh aa gaya ke Hamza sharaabi hain, woh peeche hat gaye, chalte huye peeche jate hue bahar chale gaye, aur hum unke saath chale gaye.

e: Narrated Ibn Ma`qil:`Ali led the funeral prayer of Sahl bin Hunaif and said, "He was one of the warriors of Badr
hi: Ibn Ma'qil bataate hain: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne Sahl bin Hunaif ki janaza namaz padhaee aur kaha, "Woh Badr ke mujahidon mein se ek the."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:`Umar bin Al-Khattab said, "When (my daughter) Hafsa bint `Umar lost her husband Khunais bin Hudhaifa As-Sahrni who was one of the companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and had fought in the battle of Badr and had died in Medina, I met `Uthman bin `Affan and suggested that he should marry Hafsa saying, "If you wish, I will marry Hafsa bint `Umar to you,' on that, he said, 'I will think it over.' I waited for a few days and then he said to me. 'I am of the opinion that I shall not marry at present.' Then I met Abu Bakr and said, 'if you wish, I will marry you, Hafsa bint `Umar.' He kept quiet and did not give me any reply and I became more angry with him than I was with `Uthman . Some days later, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) demanded her hand in marriage and I married her to him. Later on Abu Bakr met me and said, "Perhaps you were angry with me when you offered me Hafsa for marriage and I gave no reply to you?' I said, 'Yes.' Abu Bakr said, 'Nothing prevented me from accepting your offer except that I learnt that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had referred to the issue of Hafsa and I did not want to disclose the secret of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) , but had he (i.e. the Prophet) given her up I would surely have accepted her
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Umar bin Al-Khattab ne kaha, "Jab (meri beti) Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Umar ne apne shohar Khunais bin Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) As-Sahmi, jo Allah ke Rasool ke sahaba mein se ek the aur Badr ki jung mein lade the aur Madina mein unka intiqal hua tha, ko kho diya, main Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Affan se mila aur sujhav diya ke woh Hafsa se shaadi karen, kehte huye, 'Agar aap chahen, main Hafsa bint Umar ki shaadi aapse kar dunga.' Ispar, unhone kaha, 'Main ispar vichaar karunga.' Maine kuch dinon tak intezaar kiya aur phir unhone mujhse kaha, 'Meri raay hai ke abhi main shaadi nahi karunga.' Phir main Abu Bakr se mila aur kaha, 'Agar aap chahen, main Hafsa bint Umar ki shaadi aapse kar dunga.' Woh khaamosh rahe aur mujhe koee jawab nahi diya, aur main unse Uthman se zyada naraaj hua. Kuch dinon baad, Allah ke Rasool ne unki shaadi ka prastav rakha aur maine unki shaadi unse kar di. Baad mein Abu Bakr mujhse mile aur kaha, 'Shaayad aap mujhse naraaj hue jab maine aapko koee jawab nahi diya jab aapne Hafsa ki shaadi ka prastav rakha?' Maine kaha, 'Haan.' Abu Bakr ne kaha, 'Mujhe aapke prastav ko qubool karne se sirf isliye roka kyunke mujhe pata chala ke Allah ke Rasool ne Hafsa ka zikar kiya tha, aur main Allah ke Rasool ka raaz zaahir nahi karna chahta tha, magar agar unhone (yaani Nabi ne) use chhod diya hota, main zaroor use qubool kar leta.'"

e: Narrated Abu Masud Al-Badri:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A man's spending on his family is a deed of charity
hi: Abu Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Badri bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Ek shaks ka apne pariwara par kharch karna ek charitable amal hai."

e: Narrated Az-Zuhri:I heard `Urwa bin Az-Zubair talking to `Umar bin `Abdul `Aziz during the latter's Governorship (at Medina), he said, "Al-Mughira bin Shu`ba delayed the `Asr prayer when he was the ruler of Al-Kufa. On that, Abu Mas`ud. `Uqba bin `Amr Al-Ansari, the grand-father of Zaid bin Hasan, who was one of the Badr warriors, came in and said, (to Al-Mughira), 'You know that Gabriel came down and offered the prayer and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prayed five prescribed prayers, and Gabriel said (to the Prophet (ﷺ) ), "I have been ordered to do so (i.e. offer these five prayers at these fixed stated hours of the day)
hi: Az-Zuhri bataate hain: Maine Urwa bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdul Aziz ke saath, unki Madina ki gawarnori ke dauran, baat karte suna. Unhone kaha, "Al-Mughira bin Shu'ba (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Asr ki namaz mein deri ki jab woh Kufa ke gawarnar the. Ispar, Abu Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ), Uqba bin Amr Al-Ansari, jo Zaid bin Hasan ke dada the aur jo Badr ke mujahidon mein se ek the, andar aaye aur kaha (Al-Mughira se), 'Aapko pata hai Jibreel neeche aaye aur namaz padhi, aur Allah ke Rasool ne paanch nirdharit namazen padhi, aur Jibreel ne (Nabi se) kaha, \"Mujhe aisa karne ka hukum diya gaya hai (yaani in paanch namazon ko din ke in nishchit samayon par padhne ka).\"'"

e: Narrated Abu Masud Al-Badri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "It is sufficient for one to recite the last two Verses of Surat-al-Baqara at night
hi: Abu Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Badri bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Raat mein Surat-al-Baqara ki aakhri do Ayaten padhna kaafi hai."

e: Narrated Mahmud bin Ar-Rabi:That `Itban bin Malik who was one of the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) and one of the warriors of Badr, came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
hi: Mahmud bin Ar-Rabi (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Itban bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ), jo Nabi ke sahaba mein se ek the aur Badr ke mujahidon mein se ek, Allah ke Rasool ke paas aaye.

e: Narrated Ibn Shihab:I asked Al-Husain bin Muhammad who was one of the sons of Salim and one of the nobles amongst them, about the narration of Mahmud bin Ar-Rabi 'from `Itban bin Malik, and he confirmed it
hi: Ibn Shihab bataate hain: Maine Al-Husain bin Muhammad se pucha, jo Salim ke beton mein se ek the aur unmein sabse izzatdaar the, Mahmud bin Ar-Rabi (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki Itban bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwaayat ke baare mein, aur unhone ispar muhar lagaee.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr bin Rabi`a:who was one of the leaders of Bani `Adi and his father participated in the battle of Badr in the company of the Prophet. `Umar appointed Qudama bin Maz'un as ruler of Bahrain, Qudama was one of the warriors of the battle of Badr and was the maternal uncle of `Abdullah bin `Umar and Hafsa
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Rabi'a bataate hain (jo Bani Adi ke sardaron mein se ek the aur jinke waalid ne Nabi ke saath Badr ki jung mein hissa liya tha): Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Qudama bin Maz'un ko Bahrain ka gawarnar muqarrar kiya. Qudama Badr ki jung ke mujahidon mein se ek the aur Abdullah bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke mama ke chacha the.

e: Narrated Az-Zuhri:Salim bin `Abdullah told me that Rafi` bin Khadij told `Abdullah bin `Umar that his two paternal uncles who had fought in the battle of Badr informed him that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the renting of fields. I said to Salim, "Do you rent your land?" He said, "Yes, for Rafi` is mistaken
hi: Az-Zuhri bataate hain: Salim bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne mujhe bataya ke Rafi bin Khadij (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Abdullah bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko bataya ke unke do chachere chacha, jinhone Badr ki jung mein ladaee ladi thi, unhe khabar di thi ke Allah ke Rasool ne kheton ko kiraye par dene se mana kiya. Maine Salim se kaha, "Kya aap apni zameen kiraye par dete hain?" Unhone kaha, "Haan, kyunke Rafi galat hain."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Shaddad bin Al-Had Al-Laithi:I saw Rifa`a bin Rafi` Al-Ansari who was a Badr warrior
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Shaddad bin Al-Had Al-Laithi bataate hain: Maine Rifa'a bin Rafi Al-Ansari ko dekha jo Badr ke mujahidon mein se ek the.

e: Narrated Al-Miswar bin Makhrama:That `Amr bin `Auf, who was an ally of Bani 'Amir bin Luai and one of those who fought at Badr in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) , said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent Abu 'Ubaida bin Al-Jarrah to Bahrain to bring the Jizya taxation from its people, for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had made a peace treaty with the people of Bahrain and appointed Al-`Ala' bin Al-Hadrami as their ruler. So, Abu 'Ubaida arrived with the money from Bahrain. When the Ansar heard of the arrival of Abu 'Ubaida (on the next day) they offered the morning prayer with the Prophet (ﷺ) and when the morning prayer had finished, they presented themselves before him. On seeing the Ansar, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) smiled and said, "I think you have heard that Abu 'Ubaida has brought something?" They replied, "Indeed, it is so, O Allah's Apostle!" He said, "Be happy, and hope for what will please you. By Allah, I am not afraid that you will be poor, but I fear that worldly wealth will be bestowed upon you as it was bestowed upon those who lived before you. So you will compete amongst yourselves for it, as they competed for it and it will destroy you as it did them
hi: Al-Miswar bin Makhrama (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Amr bin Auf, jo Bani Amir bin Luai qabile ke muahid the aur Nabi ke saath Badr ki jung mein ladne walon mein se ek the, ne kaha, "Allah ke Rasool ne Abu Ubaida bin Al-Jarrah ko Bahrain se Jizya (yaani tax) lane bheja, kyunke Allah ke Rasool ne Bahrain ke logon se sulha ki thi aur Al-Ala bin Al-Hadrami ko unka gawarnar muqarrar kiya tha. Isliye Abu Ubaida Bahrain se paisa lekar aaye. Jab Ansaar ko Abu Ubaida ke aane ki khabar mili, unhone (agli subah) Nabi ke saath subah ki namaz padhi, aur jab subah ki namaz khatam huee, woh unke saamne aaye. Ansaar ko dekhkar, Allah ke Rasool muskurae aur kaha, \"Mujhe lagta hai tumne suna hai ke Abu Ubaida kuch laaye hain?\" Unhone jawab diya, \"Sach mein, yeh aisa hi hai, Ya Allah ke Nabi!\" Unhone kaha, \"Khush ho jao aur us cheez ki ummeed karo jo tumhe khush karegi. Allah ki qasam, mujhe dar nahi ke tum gareeb ho jaoge, magar mujhe dar hai ke duniyavi daulat tumhe utni hi milegi jitna tumse pahle ke logon ko mili thi. Isliye tum ismein ek-doosre se muqabla karoge, jaisa unhone kiya, aur yeh tumhe barbaad karega jaisa usne unhe barbaad kiya.\""

e: Narrated Nafi`:Ibn `Umar used to kill all kinds of snakes until Abu Lubaba Al-Badri told him that the Prophet (ﷺ) had forbidden the killing of harmless snakes living in houses and called Jinnan. So Ibn `Umar gave up killing them
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) sab qisamon ke saanp qatl karte the jab tak Abu Lubaba Al-Badri ne unhe bataya ke Nabi ne gharon mein rehne wale nirdosh saanpon ko qatl karne se mana kiya tha, jinhe Jinnaan kaha jata hai. Isliye Ibn Umar ne unhe qatl karna chhod diya.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Some men of the Ansar requested Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to allow them to see him, they said, "Allow us to forgive the ransom of our sister's son, `Abbas." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "By Allah, you will not leave a single Dirham of it
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Kuch Ansaar logon ne Allah ke Rasool se unse milne ki ijazat maangi. Unhone kaha, "Humein apni behn ke bete, Abbas, ke fidya ko maaf karne dijiye." Nabi ne kaha, "Allah ki qasam, tum ismein se ek bhi Dirham nahi chhodoge."

e: Narrated 'Ubaidullah bin `Adi bin Al-Khiyar:That Al-Miqdad bin `Amr Al-Kindi, who was an ally of Bani Zuhra and one of those who fought the battle of Badr together with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) told him that he said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), "Suppose I met one of the infidels and we fought, and he struck one of my hands with his sword and cut it off and then took refuge in a tree and said, "I surrender to Allah (i.e. I have become a Muslim),' could I kill him, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), after he had said this?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "You should not kill him." Al- Miqdad said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! But he had cut off one of my two hands, and then he had uttered those words?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, "You should not kill him, for if you kill him, he would be in your position where you had been before killing him, and you would be in his position where he had been before uttering those words
hi: Ubaidullah bin Adi bin Al-Khiyar bataate hain: Al-Miqdad (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr Al-Kindi, jo Bani Zuhra ke muahid the aur Allah ke Rasool ke saath Badr ki jung mein ladne walon mein se ek, ne unhe bataya ke unhone Allah ke Rasool se kaha, "Maan lijiye maine ek kaafir se mulaqaat ki aur hum jung karte hain, aur usne apni talwaar se mera ek haath maara aur kaat diya, phir woh ek darakht mein panah leta hai aur kahta hai, 'Main Allah ke aage samarpit hoon (yaani main Musalman ban gaya hoon),' kya main unhe qatl kar sakta hoon, Ya Allah ke Rasool, yeh kahne ke baad?" Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Tumhe unhe qatl nahi karna chahiye." Al-Miqdad ne kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Magar unhone mere do haathon mein se ek kaat diya tha, aur phir unhone yeh alfaaz kahe?" Allah ke Rasool ne jawab diya, "Tumhe unhe qatl nahi karna chahiye, kyunke agar tum unhe qatl karte ho, woh tumhari (pahle wali) haalat mein honge jahaan tum unke qatl se pahle the, aur tum unki (pahle wali) haalat mein hoge jahaan woh un alfaazon ke kahne se pahle the."

e: Narrated Anas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said on the day of Badr, "Who will go and see what has happened to Abu Jahl?" Ibn Mas`ud went and saw him struck by the two sons of 'Afra and was on the point of death . Ibn Mas`ud said, "Are you Abu Jahl?" Abu Jahl replied, "Can there be a man more superior to the one whom you have killed (or as Sulaiman said, or his own folk have killed.)?" Abu Jahl added, "Would that I had been killed by other than a mere farmer
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Badr ki jung ke din kaha, "Kaun jaakar dekhega Abu Jahl ka kya hua?" Ibn Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) gaye aur unhe dekha, Afra ke do beton dwaara mara gaya aur maut ke qareeb tha. Ibn Mas'ud ne kaha, "Kya aap Abu Jahl hain?" Abu Jahl ne jawab diya, "Kya koee shaks isse zyada izzatdaar ho sakta hai jinhe tumne qatl kiya hai (ya jaisa Sulaiman ne kaha, ya jinke khud unki apni qaum ne qatl kiya)?" Abu Jahl ne joda, "Kaash mujhe kisi aur ne qatl kiya hota siwaye ek kisan (yaani ek nichle darje ke shaks) ke."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:`Umar said, "When the Prophet (ﷺ) died I said to Abu Bakr, 'Let us go to our Ansari brethren.' We met two pious men from them, who had fought in the battle of Badr." When I mentioned this to `Urwa bin Az-Zubair, he said, "Those two pious men were 'Uwaim bin Sa`ida and Ma`n bin Adi
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Jab Nabi ka intiqal hua, maine Abu Bakr se kaha, 'Chalo humare Ansaari bhaiyon ke paas chale.' Humari mulaqaat unmein se do pakbaz logon se huee, jinhone Badr ki jung mein ladaee ladi thi." Jab maine yeh Urwa bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kaha, unhone kaha, "Woh do pakbaz log Uwaim bin Sa'ida aur Ma'n bin Adi the."

e: Narrated Qais:The Badr warriors were given five thousand (Dirhams) each, yearly. `Umar said, "I will surely give them more than what I will give to others
hi: Qais bataate hain: Badr ke mujahidon ko har saal paanch hazaar (Dirham) diye jate the. Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Main zaroor unhe doosron ki tulna mein zyada dunga."

e: Narrated Jubair bin Mut'im: I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) reciting Surat-at-Tur in Maghrib prayer, and that was at a time when belief was first planted in my heart. The Prophet (ﷺ) while speaking about the war prisoners of Badr, said, "Were Al-Mutim bin Adi alive and interceded with me for these filthy people, I would definitely forgive them for his sake
hi: Jubair bin Mut'im bataate hain: Maine Nabi ko Maghrib ki namaz mein Surat-at-Tur padhte suna, aur yeh us waqt tha jab meri dil mein pahli baar iman utra tha. Nabi ne, Badr ke qaidiyon ke baare mein baat karte huye, kaha, "Kaash Al-Mut'im bin Adi zinda hote aur in gande logon ke liye mere saamne sifarish karte, main unke liye unhe zaroor maaf kar deta."

e: Narrated Said bin Al-Musaiyab: When the first civil strife (in Islam) took place because of the murder of 'Uthman, it left none of the Badr warriors alive. When the second civil strife, that is the battle of Al-Harra, took place, it left none of the Hudaibiya treaty companions alive. Then the third civil strife took place and it did not subside till it had exhausted all the strength of the people
hi: Sa'id bin Al-Musaiyab bataate hain: Jab Islam mein pahli naagarik ashaanti (yaani fitna) huee, Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki hatya ki wajah se, isne Badr ke mujahidon mein se kisi ko zinda nahi chhoda. Jab doosri naagarik ashaanti huee, yaani Al-Harra ki jung, isne Hudaibiya ke muahide ke sathiyon mein se kisi ko zinda nahi chhoda. Phir teesri ashaanti huee aur yeh tab tak khatam nahi huee jab tak isne logon ki poori taakat khatam nahi kar di.

e: Narrated Yunus bin Yazid:I heard Az-Zuhri saying, "I heard `Urwa bin Az-Zubair. Sa`id bin Al-Musaiyab, 'Alqama bin Waqqas and 'Ubaidullah bin `Abdullah each narrating part of the narrative concerning `Aisha the wife of the Prophet. `Aisha said: When I and Um Mistah were returning, Um Mistah stumbled by treading on the end of her robe, and on that she said, 'May Mistah be ruined.' I said, 'You have said a bad thing, you curse a man who took part in the battle of Badr!." Az-Zuhri then narrated the narration of the Lie (forged against `Aisha)
hi: Yunus bin Yazid bataate hain: Maine Az-Zuhri ko kehte suna, "Maine Urwa bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ), Sa'id bin Al-Musaiyab, Alqama bin Waqqas, aur Ubaidullah bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ), har ek ko Nabi ki biwi Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se mutaliq kahani ka ek hissa riwaayat karte suna. Ayesha ne kaha: Jab main aur Um Mistah wapas aa rahi thi, Um Mistah apni chaadar ke kinare par thokar khakar girne lagi, aur ispar unhone kaha, 'Mistah barbaad ho.' Maine kaha, 'Aapne ek buri baat kahi hai, aap ek aise shaks ko bad-dua deti hain jinhone Badr ki jung mein hissa liya!'" Az-Zuhri ne phir jhoote ilzaam (Ayesha ke khilaf gadha gaya) ki poori kahani riwaayat ki.

e: Narrated Ibn Shihab:These were the battles of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (which he fought), and while mentioning (the Badr battle) he said, "While the corpses of the pagans were being thrown into the well, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said (to them), 'Have you found what your Lord promised true?" `Abdullah said, "Some of the Prophet's companions said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! You are addressing dead people.' Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, 'You do not hear what I am saying, better than they.' The total number of Muslim fighters from Quraish who fought in the battle of Badr and were given their share of the booty, were 81 men." Az-Zubair said, "When their shares were distributed, their number was 101 men. But Allah knows it better
hi: Ibn Shihab bataate hain: Yeh Allah ke Rasool ki jungen thi (jo unhone ladi), aur (Badr ki jung ka) zikar karte huye unhone kaha, "Jabke mushrikon ki laashen kue mein phenki ja rahi thi, Allah ke Rasool ne (unse) kaha, 'Kya tumne paaya jo tumhare Rab ne waada kiya sach tha?'" Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Nabi ke kuch sahaba ne kaha, 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Aap murda logon se mukhatib ho rahe hain.' Allah ke Rasool ne jawab diya, 'Tum jo main kah raha hoon woh unse behtar nahi sun sakte.'" Quraish se woh Musalman mujahid jinhone Badr ki jung mein hissa liya aur maal-e-ghanimat mein apna hissa mila, kul churaasi (81) log the. Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Jab unke hisse taqseem kiye gaye, unki tadaad ek sau ek (101) thi. Magar Allah behtar jaanta hai."

e: Narrated Az-Zubair:On the day of Badr, (Quraishi) Emigrants received 100 shares of the war booty
hi: Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Badr ki jung ke din, (Quraishi) Muhajir logon ko sau hisse mile the maal-e-ghanimat mein se.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Bani An-Nadir and Bani Quraiza fought (against the Prophet (ﷺ) violating their peace treaty), so the Prophet exiled Bani An-Nadir and allowed Bani Quraiza to remain at their places (in Medina) taking nothing from them till they fought against the Prophet (ﷺ) again) . He then killed their men and distributed their women, children and property among the Muslims, but some of them came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he granted them safety, and they embraced Islam. He exiled all the Jews from Medina. They were the Jews of Bani Qainuqa', the tribe of `Abdullah bin Salam and the Jews of Bani Haritha and all the other Jews of Medina
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Banu An-Nadir aur Banu Quraiza ne (Nabi ke khilaf) jung ki (apna sulha muahida todte huye), isliye Nabi ne Banu An-Nadir ko nikal diya aur Banu Quraiza ko Madina mein hi rehne diya, unse kuch na lekar jab tak unhone phir Nabi ke khilaf jung nahi ki. Phir unhone unke mardon ko qatl kiya aur unki aurton, bachchon, aur maal ko Musalmanon mein baant diya, magar unmein se kuch Nabi ke paas aaye aur unhe hifaazat di, aur unhone Islam qubool kiya. Nabi ne Madina se sab Yahudiyon ko nikal diya. Yeh the Banu Qainuqa ke Yahudi, Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Salam (رضی اللہ عنہ) ka qabila, aur Banu Haritha ke Yahudi, aur Madina ke sab doosre Yahudi.

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:I mentioned to Ibn `Abbas Surat-Hashr. He said, "Call it Surat-an-Nadir
hi: Sa'id bin Jubair bataate hain: Maine Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se Surat-Al-Hashr ka zikar kiya. Unhone kaha, "Ise Surat-An-Nadir kaho."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Some people used to allot some date palm trees to the Prophet (ﷺ) as gift till he conquered Banu Quraiza and Bani An-Nadir, where upon he started returning their date palms to them
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Kuch log Nabi ko kuch khajoor ke darakht tohfe mein dete the jab tak unhone Banu Quraiza aur Banu An-Nadir ko fatah kiya, jiske baad unhone unke khajoor ke darakht unhe wapas karna shuru kiya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had the date-palm trees of Bani Al-Nadir burnt and cut down at a place called Al- Buwaira. Allah then revealed: "What you cut down of the date-palm trees (of the enemy) Or you left them standing on their stems. It was by Allah's Permission
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Banu An-Nadir ke khajoor ke darakhton ko Al-Buwaira naam ki jagah par jalana aur kaatna shuru kiya. Ispar, Allah ne yeh nazil kiya: "Jo tumne khajoor ke darakhton ko kata (dushman ke), ya unhe unke tanon par khade chhoda, yeh Allah ki ijazat se tha." (59:5)

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) burnt the date-palm trees of Bani An-Nadir. Hassan bin Thabit said the following poetic Verses about this event:-- "the terrible burning of Al-Buwaira Has been received indifferently By the nobles of Bani Luai (The masters and nobles of Quraish)." Abu Sufyan bin Al-Harith (i.e. the Prophet's cousin who was still a disbeliever then) replied to Hassan, saying in poetic verses:-- "May Allah bless that burning And set all its (i.e. Medina's) Parts on burning fire. You will see who is far from it (i.e. Al-Buwaira) And which of our lands will be Harmed by it (i.e. the burning of Al- Buwaira)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Banu An-Nadir ke khajoor ke darakhton ko jala diya. Hassan bin Thabit ne is ghatna ke baare mein yeh kavita likhi: "Al-Buwaira ki bhayaanak aag Bani Luai ke izzatdaron (Quraish ke sardaron aur izzatdaron) dwaara udaseenta se qubool ki gaee." Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Harith (yaani Nabi ke chachere bhai, jo us waqt tak kaafir the) ne Hassan ko yeh jawab diya: "Allah us jalaee ko barkat de aur uske sab hisson ko jal jane de. Tum dekhoge kaun isse door hai, aur humari zameen mein se kaunsi isse nuksaan paega."

e: Narrated Malik bin Aus Al-Hadathan An-Nasri:That once `Umar bin Al-Khattab called him and while he was sitting with him, his gatekeeper, Yarfa came and said, "Will you admit `Uthman, `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf, Az-Zubair and Sa`d (bin Abi Waqqas) who are waiting for your permission?" `Umar said, "Yes, let them come in." After a while, Yarfa- came again and said, "Will you admit `Ali and `Abbas who are asking your permission?" `Umar said, "Yes." So, when the two entered, `Abbas said, "O chief of the believers! Judge between me and this (i.e. `Ali). "Both of them had a dispute regarding the property of Bani An-Nadir which Allah had given to His Apostle as Fai (i.e. booty gained without fighting), `Ali and `Abbas started reproaching each other. The (present) people (i.e. `Uthman and his companions) said, "O chief of the believers! Give your verdict in their case and relieve each from) the other." `Umar said, "Wait I beseech you, by Allah, by Whose Permission both the heaven and the earth stand fast! Do you know that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'We (Prophets) our properties are not to be inherited, and whatever we leave, is to be spent in charity,' and he said it about himself?" They (i.e. `Uthman and his company) said, "He did say it. "`Umar then turned towards `Ali and `Abbas and said, "I beseech you both, by Allah! Do you know that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said this?" They replied in the affirmative. He said, "Now I am talking to you about this matter. Allah the Glorified favored His Apostle with something of this Fai (i.e. booty won without fighting) which He did not give to anybody else. Allah said:-- "And what Allah gave to His Apostle ("Fai"" Booty) from them--For which you made no expedition With either Calvary or camelry. But Allah gives power to His Apostles Over whomsoever He will And Allah is able to do all things." (59.6) So this property was especially granted to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . But by Allah, the Prophet (ﷺ) neither took it all for himself only, nor deprived you of it, but he gave it to all of you and distributed it amongst you till only this remained out of it. And from this Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to spend the yearly maintenance for his family, and whatever used to remain, he used to spend it where Allah's Property is spent (i.e. in charity), Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) kept on acting like that during all his life, Then he died, and Abu Bakr said, 'I am the successor of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).' So he (i.e. Abu Bakr) took charge of this property and disposed of it in the same manner as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to do, and all of you (at that time) knew all about it." Then `Umar turned towards `Ali and `Abbas and said, "You both remember that Abu Bakr disposed of it in the way you have described and Allah knows that, in that matter, he was sincere, pious, rightly guided and the follower of the right. Then Allah caused Abu Bakr to die and I said, 'I am the successor of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr.' So I kept this property in my possession for the first two years of my rule (i.e. Caliphate and I used to dispose of it in the same wa as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr used to do; and Allah knows that I have been sincere, pious, rightly guided an the follower of the right (in this matter). Later on both of you (i.e. `Ali and `Abbas) came to me, and the claim of you both was one and the same, O `Abbas! You also came to me. So I told you both that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Our property is not inherited, but whatever we leave is to be given in charity.' Then when I thought that I should better hand over this property to you both on the condition that you will promise and pledge before Allah that you will dispose it off in the same way as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr did and as I have done since the beginning of my caliphate or else you should not speak to me (about it).' So, both of you said to me, 'Hand it over to us on this condition.' And on this condition I handed it over to you. Do you want me now to give a decision other than that (decision)? By Allah, with Whose Permission both the sky and the earth stand fast, I will never give any decision other than that (decision) till the Last Hour is established. But if you are unable to manage it (i.e. that property), then return it to me, and I will manage on your behalf." The sub-narrator said, "I told `Urwa bin Az-Zubair of this Hadith and he said, 'Malik bin Aus has told the truth" I heard `Aisha, the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, 'The wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) sent `Uthman to Abu Bakr demanding from him their 1/8 of the Fai which Allah had granted to his Apostle. But I used to oppose them and say to them: Will you not fear Allah? Don't you know that the Prophet used to say: Our property is not inherited, but whatever we leave is to be given in charity? The Prophet (ﷺ) mentioned that regarding himself. He added: 'The family of Muhammad can take their sustenance from this property. So the wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) stopped demanding it when I told them of that.' So, this property (of Sadaqa) was in the hands of `Ali who withheld it from `Abbas and overpowered him. Then it came in the hands of Hasan bin `Ali, then in the hands of Husain bin `Ali, and then in the hands of `Ali bin Husain and Hasan bin Hasan, and each of the last two used to manage it in turn, then it came in the hands of Zaid bin Hasan, and it was truly the Sadaqa of Allah's Apostle
hi: Malik bin Aus Al-Hadathan An-Nasri bataate hain: Ek baar Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab ne unhe bulaya, aur jabke woh unke saath baithe the, unke darwaza-baan, Yarfa, aaye aur kaha, "Kya aap Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ), Abdur-Rahman bin Auf, Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ), aur Sa'd (bin Abi Waqqas) ko andar aane denge jo aapki ijazat ka intezaar kar rahe hain?" Umar ne kaha, "Haan, unhe andar aane do." Thoda der baad, Yarfa phir aaye aur kaha, "Kya aap Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Abbas ko andar aane denge jo aapse ijazat maangte hain?" Umar ne kaha, "Haan." Isliye jab donon andar gaye, Abbas ne kaha, "Aye Mominon ke Ameer! Mere aur is (yaani Ali (Alayhis Salam)) ke beech faisla kariye." Donon ka Banu An-Nadir ki maal ke baare mein jhagda tha jo Allah ne apne Rasool ko Fai (yaani jung ke bina hasil hui maal-e-ghanimat) ke tor par di thi. Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Abbas ek-doosre ko dosh dene lage. Log (yaani Uthman aur unke sathi) ne kaha, "Aye Mominon ke Ameer! Unke maamle mein faisla kariye aur unhe ek-doosre se aaraam dijiye." Umar ne kaha, "Sabr karo! Main tumhe Allah ki qasam dekar puchta hoon, jiski ijazat se aasman aur zameen sthir hain! Kya tumhe pata hai Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, 'Hum (Nabiyon) ki maal ki waraasat nahi hoti, aur jo hum chhodte hain woh Sadaqa hai,' aur unhone yeh khud apne baare mein kaha?" Unhone (yaani Uthman aur unke sathi) kaha, "Unhone aisa kaha." Umar phir Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Abbas ki taraf mude aur kaha, "Main tumhe Allah ki qasam dekar puchta hoon, kya tumhe pata hai Allah ke Rasool ne yeh kaha?" Unhone haan mein jawab diya.
