Umar ne kaha, "Isliye ab main is maamle ke baare mein tumse baat karunga. Allah ne apne Rasool ko is Fai (maal-e-ghanimat) mein se ek khaas meherbani di jo usne kisi aur ko nahi di. Allah ne kaha: 'Aur jo bhi Allah ne apne Rasool (Muhammad) ko unse Fai (booty) ke tor par diya — iske liye tumne na ghodon se na unton se koee safar ki; magar Allah apne Rasoolon ko jispar chaahe Qaadir bana deta hai. Aur Allah har cheez par Qaadir hai.' (59:6) Isliye yeh maal khaas Allah ke Rasool ko di gaee. Magar Allah ki qasam, na unhone use apne liye rakha aur tumhe chhoda, na unhone ise sirf apne liye khaas rakha tumhein usse vanchit karke, balki unhone yeh tum sabko di aur tum sabme baant di jab tak yeh maal us hisse tak rah gaee (jise unhone rakha). Allah ke Rasool apne pariwara ke saalana kharche isi maal se dete the, aur baaki aamdani Allah ki raah mein kharch karne ke liye rakhte the. Allah ke Rasool ne apni poori zindagi aisa hi kiya. Main tumhe Allah ki qasam dekar puchta hoon, kya tumhe yeh pata hai?" Unhone haan mein jawab diya. Umar ne phir Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Abbas se kaha, "Main tumhe Allah ki qasam dekar puchta hoon, kya tumhe yeh pata hai?" Umar ne joda, "Jab Allah ne apne Nabi ko apni taraf bula liya, Abu Bakr ne kaha, 'Main Allah ke Rasool ka janshin hoon,' isliye Abu Bakr ne woh maal sambhali aur uska intezam usi tarah kiya jaisa Allah ke Rasool karte the, aur Allah jaanta hai ke woh sachche, pakbaaz, aur sahi raah par chalne wale the, aur woh sahi cheez ki pairvi karte the. Phir Allah ne Abu Bakr ko apni taraf bula liya aur main Abu Bakr ka janshin bana, aur maine woh maal apni khilafat ke pahle do saal apne kabze mein rakhi, isi tarah intezam karte huye jaise Allah ke Rasool aur Abu Bakr karte the, aur Allah jaanta hai ke main sachcha, pakbaaz, aur sahi raah par chalne wala hoon, aur main sahi cheez ki pairvi karta hoon. Ab tum donon (yaani Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Abbas) mujhse baat karne aaye ho, ek hi daava aur ek hi maamla pesh karte huye; tum, Abbas, mere paas apne bhatije ki maal se apna hissa maangne aaye, aur yeh shaks, yaani Ali (Alayhis Salam), apni biwi ka hissa unke waalid ki maal se maangne aaya. Maine tum donon ko bataya ke Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, 'Hum (Nabiyon) ki maal ki waraasat nahi hoti, magar jo hum chhodte hain woh Sadaqa hai.' Jab maine socha ke mujhe yeh maal tumhe sonp deni chahiye, maine tumse kaha, 'Main yeh maal tumhe sonpne ke liye taiyaar hoon agar tum chaho, is shart par ke tum Allah ka ahad aur waada loge ke tum ise usi tarah prabandhit karoge jaise Allah ke Rasool karte the, aur jaise Abu Bakr karte the, aur jaise maine (jab se main iska prabandhak hoon) kiya hai.' Isliye tum donon ne (mujhse) kaha, 'Ise humein sonp do,' aur us shart par maine tumhe yeh sonp diya. Isliye main tumhe Allah ki qasam dekar puchta hoon, kya maine unhe yeh isi shart par sonpi thi?" Unhone kaha, "Haan." Phir Umar Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Abbas ki taraf mude aur kaha, "Main tumhe Allah ki qasam dekar puchta hoon, kya maine tumhe yeh isi shart par sonpi thi?" Unhone kaha, "Haan." Unhone kaha, "Kya tum ab koee doosra faisla chahte ho? Allah ki qasam, jiski ijazat se aasman aur zameen sthir hain, main is (faisle) ke ilawa koee doosra faisla kabhi nahi dunga. Aur agar tum ise sambhal nahi pate, to ise mujhe wapas kar do, aur main tumhari taraf se yeh kaam karunga." Malik bin Aus ne yeh riwaayat Urwa bin Az-Zubair ko sunaee, jinhone kaha, "Malik bin Aus ne sach kaha." Maine Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا), Nabi ki biwi, ko yeh kehte suna, "Nabi ki biwiyaan Uthman ko Abu Bakr ke paas apna aathvaan hissa maangne bhejti thi Fai mein se jo Allah ne unke Rasool ko diya, magar main unhe rokti karti aur kahti: Kya tum Allah se nahi darti? Kya tumhe nahi pata Allah ke Rasool kahte the: Humari maal ki waraasat nahi hoti, magar jo hum chhodte hain woh Sadaqa hai? Nabi ne yeh khud apne baare mein kaha. Unhone joda: Muhammad ka pariwara is maal se apni jeevika le sakta hai. Isliye Nabi ki biwiyon ne maangna chhod diya jab maine unhe yeh bataya." Isliye yeh (Sadaqa ki) maal Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke haathon mein thi jinhone ise Abbas se roka aur unpar haavi rahe. Phir yeh Hasan bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke haathon mein aee, phir Husain bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke haathon mein, aur phir Ali bin Husain aur Hasan bin Hasan ke haathon mein, jinmein se donon baari-baari iskaa intezam karte, phir yeh Zaid bin Hasan ke haathon mein aee, aur yeh sachche tor par Allah ke Rasool ki Sadaqa thi.

e: Narrated `Aisha:Fatima and Al-`Abbas came to Abu Bakr, claiming their inheritance of the Prophet's land of Fadak and his share from Khaibar. Abu Bakr said, "I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, 'Our property is not inherited, and whatever we leave is to be given in charity. But the family of Muhammad can take their sustenance from this property.' By Allah, I would love to do good to the Kith and kin of Allah's Apostle rather than to my own Kith and kin
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Fatima (Alayhas Salam) aur Al-Abbas Abu Bakr ke paas aaye, apni waraasat maangte huye, Nabi ki Fadak ki zameen aur Khaibar mein unke hisse ke soorat mein. Abu Bakr ne kaha, "Maine Nabi ko kehte suna, 'Humari maal ki waraasat nahi hoti, aur jo hum chhodte hain woh Sadaqa hai. Magar Muhammad ka pariwara is maal se apni jeevika le sakta hai.' Allah ki qasam, main Allah ke Rasool ke rishtedaron ke saath achha suluk karna apne khud ke rishtedaron se zyada pasand karunga."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Who is willing to kill Ka`b bin Al-Ashraf who has hurt Allah and His Apostle?" Thereupon Muhammad bin Maslama got up saying, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Would you like that I kill him?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Yes," Muhammad bin Maslama said, "Then allow me to say a (false) thing (i.e. to deceive Ka`b). "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You may say it." Then Muhammad bin Maslama went to Ka`b and said, "That man (i.e. Muhammad demands Sadaqa (i.e. Zakat) from us, and he has troubled us, and I have come to borrow something from you." On that, Ka`b said, "By Allah, you will get tired of him!" Muhammad bin Maslama said, "Now as we have followed him, we do not want to leave him unless and until we see how his end is going to be. Now we want you to lend us a camel load or two of food." (Some difference between narrators about a camel load or two.) Ka`b said, "Yes, (I will lend you), but you should mortgage something to me." Muhammad bin Mas-lama and his companion said, "What do you want?" Ka`b replied, "Mortgage your women to me." They said, "How can we mortgage our women to you and you are the most handsome of the 'Arabs?" Ka`b said, "Then mortgage your sons to me." They said, "How can we mortgage our sons to you? Later they would be abused by the people's saying that so-and-so has been mortgaged for a camel load of food. That would cause us great disgrace, but we will mortgage our arms to you." Muhammad bin Maslama and his companion promised Ka`b that Muhammad would return to him. He came to Ka`b at night along with Ka`b's foster brother, Abu Na'ila. Ka`b invited them to come into his fort, and then he went down to them. His wife asked him, "Where are you going at this time?" Ka`b replied, "None but Muhammad bin Maslama and my (foster) brother Abu Na'ila have come." His wife said, "I hear a voice as if dropping blood is from him, Ka`b said, "They are none but my brother Muhammad bin Maslama and my foster brother Abu Naila. A generous man should respond to a call at night even if invited to be killed." Muhammad bin Maslama went with two men. (Some narrators mention the men as 'Abu bin Jabr. Al Harith bin Aus and `Abbad bin Bishr). So Muhammad bin Maslama went in together with two men, and said to them, "When Ka`b comes, I will touch his hair and smell it, and when you see that I have got hold of his head, strike him. I will let you smell his head." Ka`b bin Al-Ashraf came down to them wrapped in his clothes, and diffusing perfume. Muhammad bin Maslama said, "I have never smelt a better scent than this." Ka`b replied, "I have got the best 'Arab women who know how to use the high class of perfume." Muhammad bin Maslama requested Ka`b "Will you allow me to smell your head?" Ka`b said, "Yes." Muhammad smelt it and made his companions smell it as well. Then he requested Ka`b again, "Will you let me (smell your head)?" Ka`b said, "Yes." When Muhammad got a strong hold of him, he said (to his companions), "Get at him!" So they killed him and went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and informed him. (Abu Rafi`) was killed after Ka`b bin Al-Ashraf
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Kaun Ka'b bin Al-Ashraf ko qatl karne ke liye taiyaar hai jinhonne Allah aur uske Rasool ko dukh diya hai?" Ispar Muhammad bin Maslama khade hue aur kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Kya aap chahenge main unhe qatl karun?" Nabi ne kaha, "Haan." Muhammad bin Maslama ne kaha, "Phir mujhe ijazat dijiye ke main (unse dhoka dene ke liye) kuch (jhuti) baat kahun." Nabi ne kaha, "Tum yeh keh sakte ho." Phir Muhammad bin Maslama Ka'b ke paas gaye aur kaha, "Woh shaks (yaani Muhammad) humse Sadaqa (yaani Zakat) maangta hai, aur usne humein bahut takleef di hai, aur main aapse kuch udhaar lene aaya hoon." Ispar, Ka'b ne kaha, "Allah ki qasam, tum unse thak jaoge!" Muhammad bin Maslama ne kaha, "Ab jabke hum unki pairvi kar chuke hain, hum unhe chhodna nahi chahte jab tak hum dekhen unka anjaam kya hota hai. Ab hum chahte hain aap humein ek ya do unton ke bojh jitni anaaj udhaar den." (Kuch raawi ko ek unt ka bojh yaad hai, doosron ko do.) Ka'b ne kaha, "Haan (main tumhe dunga), magar tumhe kuch girwi rakhna hoga." Muhammad bin Maslama aur unke sathi ne pucha, "Aap kya chahte hain?" Ka'b ne jawab diya, "Apni aurten mere paas girwi rakho." Unhone kaha, "Hum apni aurten aapke paas kaise girwi rakhen, jabke aap Arbon mein sabse khoobsurat hain?" Ka'b ne kaha, "Phir apne beton ko mere paas girwi rakho." Unhone kaha, "Hum apne beton ko kaise girwi rakhen? Baad mein unhe apman jhelna padega, log kahenge ke falaan-falaan ek unt ke anaaj-bojh ke liye girwi rakha gaya tha. Yeh humein apmaanit karega, magar hum apne hathiyaar aapke paas girwi rakhenge." Muhammad bin Maslama aur unke sathi ne Ka'b se waada kiya ke Muhammad unke paas wapas aaenge. Woh raat ko Ka'b ke paas gaye, unke saath Ka'b ke doodh-rishte ke bhai, Abu Na'ila. Ka'b ne unhe apne qile mein aane ki dawat di, aur phir woh unke paas neeche aaye. Unki biwi ne unse pucha, "Aap is waqt kahaan ja rahe hain?" Ka'b ne jawab diya, "Koee aur nahi siwaye Muhammad bin Maslama aur mere (doodh-rishte ke) bhai Abu Na'ila ke." Unki biwi ne kaha, "Mujhe lagta hai maine unki aawaaz mein khoon tapakte suna hai." Ka'b ne kaha, "Yeh koee aur nahi siwaye mere bhai Muhammad bin Maslama aur mere doodh-rishte ke bhai Abu Na'ila ke. Ek sakhi shaks ko chahiye ke woh raat mein bhi bulawe ka jawab de chahe use qatl karne ke liye bulaya jaaye." Muhammad bin Maslama do logon ke saath gaye (kuch raawi unke naam Abu bin Jabr, Al-Harith bin Aus, aur Abbad bin Bishr batate hain). Isliye Muhammad bin Maslama do logon ke saath andar gaye aur unse kaha, "Jab Ka'b aaye, main unke baal pakadunga aur unhe sungunga, aur jab tum dekho ke maine unka sar pakad liya hai, unpar hamla karo. Main tumhe unka sar sungne dunga." Ka'b bin Al-Ashraf apne kapdon mein lipete neeche aaye, khushbu mehakte hue. Muhammad bin Maslama ne kaha, "Maine kabhi isse behtar khushbu nahi soonghi." Ka'b ne jawab diya, "Mere paas Arbon ki sabse behtareen aurten hain jo behtareen khushbu ka istemal karna jaanti hain." Muhammad bin Maslama ne Ka'b se guzarish ki, "Kya aap mujhe aapka sar soonghne denge?" Ka'b ne kaha, "Haan." Muhammad ne use soongha aur apne sathiyon ko bhi soonghwaya. Phir unhone Ka'b se phir guzarish ki, "Kya aap mujhe (dobara) denge?" Ka'b ne kaha, "Haan." Jab Muhammad ne unhe mazbooti se pakad liya, unhone (apne sathiyon se) kaha, "Unpar hamla karo!" Isliye unhone unhe qatl kiya aur Nabi ke paas gaye aur unhe khabar di. (Abu Rafi (رضی اللہ عنہ) Ka'b bin Al-Ashraf ke baad qatl kiye gaye.)

e: Narrated Al-Bara bin Azib:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent a group of persons to Abu Rafi`. `Abdullah bin Atik entered his house at night, while he was sleeping, and killed him
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kuch logon ke ek giroh ko Abu Rafi (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas bheja. Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Atik unke ghar raat mein daakhil hue jabke woh sote hue the, aur unhe qatl kiya.

e: Narrated Al-Bara bin Azib:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent some men from the Ansar to ((kill) Abu Rafi`, the Jew, and appointed `Abdullah bin Atik as their leader. Abu Rafi` used to hurt Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and help his enemies against him. He lived in his castle in the land of Hijaz. When those men approached (the castle) after the sun had set and the people had brought back their livestock to their homes. `Abdullah (bin Atik) said to his companions, "Sit down at your places. I am going, and I will try to play a trick on the gate-keeper so that I may enter (the castle)." So `Abdullah proceeded towards the castle, and when he approached the gate, he covered himself with his clothes, pretending to answer the call of nature. The people had gone in, and the gate-keeper (considered `Abdullah as one of the castle's servants) addressing him saying, "O Allah's Servant! Enter if you wish, for I want to close the gate." `Abdullah added in his story, "So I went in (the castle) and hid myself. When the people got inside, the gate-keeper closed the gate and hung the keys on a fixed wooden peg. I got up and took the keys and opened the gate. Some people were staying late at night with Abu Rafi` for a pleasant night chat in a room of his. When his companions of nightly entertainment went away, I ascended to him, and whenever I opened a door, I closed it from inside. I said to myself, 'Should these people discover my presence, they will not be able to catch me till I have killed him.' So I reached him and found him sleeping in a dark house amidst his family, I could not recognize his location in the house. So I shouted, 'O Abu Rafi`!' Abu Rafi` said, 'Who is it?' I proceeded towards the source of the voice and hit him with the sword, and because of my perplexity, I could not kill him. He cried loudly, and I came out of the house and waited for a while, and then went to him again and said, 'What is this voice, O Abu Rafi`?' He said, 'Woe to your mother! A man in my house has hit me with a sword! I again hit him severely but I did not kill him. Then I drove the point of the sword into his belly (and pressed it through) till it touched his back, and I realized that I have killed him. I then opened the doors one by one till I reached the staircase, and thinking that I had reached the ground, I stepped out and fell down and got my leg broken in a moonlit night. I tied my leg with a turban and proceeded on till I sat at the gate, and said, 'I will not go out tonight till I know that I have killed him.' So, when (early in the morning) the cock crowed, the announcer of the casualty stood on the wall saying, 'I announce the death of Abu Rafi`, the merchant of Hijaz. Thereupon I went to my companions and said, 'Let us save ourselves, for Allah has killed Abu Rafi`,' So I (along with my companions proceeded and) went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and described the whole story to him. "He said, 'Stretch out your (broken) leg. I stretched it out and he rubbed it and it became All right as if I had never had any ailment whatsoever
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Ansaar ke kuch logon ko (Abu Rafi (رضی اللہ عنہ), ek Yahudi, ko qatl karne ke liye) bheja aur Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Atik ko unka sardaar muqarrar kiya. Abu Rafi Allah ke Rasool ko dukh dete the aur unke khilaf unke dushmanon ki madad karte the. Woh Hijaz ki zameen mein apne qile mein rahte the. Jab woh log (qile ke) qareeb pahunche, suraj doobne ke baad aur log apne maweshi apne gharon le ja chuke the, Abdullah (bin Atik) ne apne sathiyon se kaha, "Apni jagah baithe raho. Main ja raha hoon aur darwaza-baan ko dhoka dene ki koshish karunga taaki main (qile mein) daakhil ho sakoon." Isliye Abdullah qile ki taraf badhe, aur jab woh darwaze ke qareeb pahunche, unhone apne aap ko apne kapdon se dhaka, mano woh qaza-e-hajat kar rahe hon. Log andar ja chuke the, aur darwaza-baan (Abdullah ko qile ka koee naukar samajhkar) ne unse kaha, "Aye Allah ke bande! Agar chaaho andar aa jao, kyunke main darwaza band karna chahta hoon." Abdullah ne apni kahani mein joda, "Isliye main andar gaya aur chhup gaya. Jab log andar aa gaye, darwaza-baan ne darwaza band kiya aur chaabiyaan ek lakdi ki khoonti par latka di. Main utha, chaabiyaan lekar darwaza khola. Kuch log raat mein der tak Abu Rafi ke saath ek kamre mein khushgwaar gappen maarne baithe rahe. Jab unke sathi chale gaye, main unke paas gaya, aur jab bhi main koee darwaza kholta, main use andar se band kar deta. Maine socha, agar in logon ko meri maujoodgi ka pata chala, woh mujhe qatl karne se pahle nahi pakad sakenge. Isliye main unke paas pahuncha aur unhe paaya sote hue apne pariwara ke beech andhere ghar mein, aur main unki haalat nahi jaan saka. Isliye maine pukara, 'Aye Abu Rafi!' Abu Rafi ne kaha, 'Yeh kaun hai?' Main aawaaz ki taraf badha aur unpar talwaar se hamla kiya, aur apni bachani ki wajah se main unhe qatl na kar saka. Woh zor se chille, aur main ghar se bahar aaya aur thodi der intezaar kiya, phir unke paas phir gaya aur kaha, 'Yeh aawaaz kya hai, Aye Abu Rafi?' Unhone kaha, 'Tumhari maa ka bura ho! Mere ghar mein ek shaks ne mujhe talwaar se maara hai!' Maine phir unpar zordaar hamla kiya magar unhe qatl na kar saka. Phir maine talwaar ki nok unke pet mein daali jab tak yeh unki peeth tak pahunchi, aur mujhe mahsoos hua ke maine unhe qatl kar diya hai. Phir maine ek-ek karke sab darwaze khole jab tak main seedhi tak pahuncha, aur yeh sochkar ke main zameen par pahuncha gaya hoon, main bahar nikla aur gir gaya aur meri taang tut gaee ek chaandni raat mein. Maine apni taang apne pagdi se baandhi aur aage badha jab tak main darwaze par baith gaya, aur maine kaha, 'Main aaj raat yahaan se tab tak nahi jaunga jab tak mujhe pata na chale ke maine unhe qatl kiya hai.' Isliye jab (subah) murge ne baang di, maut ka elaan karne wala deewaar par khada hua aur bola, 'Main tumhe Abu Rafi ki maut ki khabar deta hoon, Hijaz ke vyaapaari.' Ispar main apne sathiyon ke paas gaya aur kaha, 'Aao khud ko bachae, kyunke Allah ne Abu Rafi ko qatl kar diya hai.' Isliye main (apne sathiyon ke saath) Nabi ke paas gaya aur unhe poori kahani sunaee. Unhone kaha, 'Apni (tooti) taang phaila.' Maine ise phaila diya aur unhone ise sahla aur woh bilkul theek ho gaee mano mujhe kabhi koee takleef hi nahi thi."

e: Narrated Al-Bara:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent `Abdullah bin 'Atik and `Abdullah bin `Utba with a group of men to Abu Rafi` (to kill him). They proceeded till they approached his castle, whereupon `Abdullah bin Atik said to them, "Wait (here), and in the meantime I will go and see." `Abdullah said later on, "I played a trick in order to enter the castle. By chance, they lost a donkey of theirs and came out carrying a flaming light to search for it. I was afraid that they would recognize me, so I covered my head and legs and pretended to answer the call to nature. The gatekeeper called, 'Whoever wants to come in, should come in before I close the gate.' So I went in and hid myself in a stall of a donkey near the gate of the castle. They took their supper with Abu Rafi` and had a chat till late at night. Then they went back to their homes. When the voices vanished and I no longer detected any movement, I came out. I had seen where the gate-keeper had kept the key of the castle in a hole in the wall. I took it and unlocked the gate of the castle, saying to myself, 'If these people should notice me, I will run away easily.' Then I locked all the doors of their houses from outside while they were inside, and ascended to Abu Rafi` by a staircase. I saw the house in complete darkness with its light off, and I could not know where the man was. So I called, 'O Abu Rafi`!' He replied, 'Who is it?' I proceeded towards the voice and hit him. He cried loudly but my blow was futile. Then I came to him, pretending to help him, saying with a different tone of my voice, ' What is wrong with you, O Abu Rafi`?' He said, 'Are you not surprised? Woe on your mother! A man has come to me and hit me with a sword!' So again I aimed at him and hit him, but the blow proved futile again, and on that Abu Rafi` cried loudly and his wife got up. I came again and changed my voice as if I were a helper, and found Abu Rafi` lying straight on his back, so I drove the sword into his belly and bent on it till I heard the sound of a bone break. Then I came out, filled with astonishment and went to the staircase to descend, but I fell down from it and got my leg dislocated. I bandaged it and went to my companions limping. I said (to them), 'Go and tell Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) of this good news, but I will not leave (this place) till I hear the news of his (i.e. Abu Rafi`'s) death.' When dawn broke, an announcer of death got over the wall and announced, 'I convey to you the news of Abu Rafi`'s death.' I got up and proceeded without feeling any pain till I caught up with my companions before they reached the Prophet (ﷺ) to whom I conveyed the good news
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Atik aur Abdullah bin Utba ko kuch logon ke giroh ke saath Abu Rafi (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko qatl karne ke liye bheja. Woh chal pade jab tak unke qile ke qareeb pahunche, ispar Abdullah bin Atik ne unse kaha, "Intezaar karo (yahaan), main jaunga aur dekhunga." Abdullah ne baad mein kaha, "Maine qile mein daakhil hone ke liye ek trick istemal kiya. Sanyog se, unka ek gadha kho gaya aur woh jalti roshni lekar use dhoondne nikle. Mujhe dar tha ke woh mujhe pahchan lenge, isliye maine apna sar aur taangen dhankan liya aur qaza-e-hajat karne ka natak kiya. Darwaza-baan ne pukara, 'Jo bhi andar aana chahta hai, mere darwaza band karne se pahle andar aa jaaye.' Isliye main andar gaya aur qile ke darwaze ke qareeb ek gadhe ke tabele mein chhup gaya. Unhone Abu Rafi ke saath raat ka khaana khaya aur der raat tak baaten ki. Phir woh apne gharon wapas chale gaye. Jab aawaazen khatam huee aur mujhe koee harakat mahsoos nahi huee, main bahar aaya. Maine dekha tha darwaza-baan ne qile ki chaabi kahaan deewaar ke ek chhed mein rakhi thi. Maine use liya aur qile ka darwaza khola, apne aap se kehte huye, 'Agar in logon ko mera pata chala, main aasaani se bhaag sakta hoon.' Phir maine unke sab gharon ke darwaze bahar se band kar diye jabke woh andar the, aur main ek seedhi se Abu Rafi ki taraf chadha. Maine ghar bilkul andhere mein paaya, uski roshni bujha di gaee thi, aur main jaan nahi paya woh shaks kahaan tha. Isliye maine pukara, 'Aye Abu Rafi!' Unhone jawab diya, 'Kaun hai?' Main aawaaz ki taraf badha aur unpar hamla kiya. Woh zor se chille magar mera vaar be-asar raha. Phir main unke paas madad karne ka natak karta hua aaya, apni aawaaz ka sur badalkar kehte huye, 'Kya baat hai, Aye Abu Rafi?' Unhone kaha, 'Kya tumhe hairat nahi hoti? Tumhari maa ka bura ho! Ek shaks mere paas aaya aur mujhe talwaar se maara!' Isliye maine phir unpar nishaana sadha aur unpar hamla kiya, magar phir mera vaar be-asar raha, aur ispar Abu Rafi zor se chille aur unki biwi uth gaee. Main phir aaya aur apni aawaaz badal li mano main madad karne wala hoon, aur maine Abu Rafi ko apni peeth ke bal seedha leta dekha, isliye maine talwaar unke pet mein ghusaee aur use jhukata raha jab tak maine ek haddi tootne ki aawaaz suni. Phir main bahar aaya, hairat se bhara, aur seedhi ki taraf gaya ise utarne ke liye, magar main isse gir gaya aur meri taang khisak gaee. Maine ise patti se baandha aur langda huya apne sathiyon ke paas gaya. Maine (unse) kaha, 'Jaao aur Allah ke Rasool ko yeh achhi khabar do, magar main (yahaan se) tab tak nahi jaunga jab tak main unki (yaani Abu Rafi ki) maut ki khabar na sunun.' Jab subah huee, maut ka elaan karne wala deewaar par chadha aur elaan kiya, 'Main tumhe Abu Rafi ki maut ki khabar deta hoon.' Main utha aur bina koee dard mahsoos kiye chal pada jab tak main apne sathiyon se mil gaya isse pahle ke woh Nabi tak pahunchte, jinhe main achhi khabar sunaee."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:On the day of Uhud. the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "This is Gabriel holding the head of his horse and equipped with war material
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Uhud ki jung ke din, Nabi ne kaha, "Yeh Jibreel hain, apne ghode ke sar ko pakde hue aur jung ke saaman se saje hue."

e: Narrated `Uqba bin Amir:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) offered the funeral prayers of the martyrs of Uhud eight years after (their death), as if bidding farewell to the living and the dead, then he ascended the pulpit and said, "I am your predecessor before you, and I am a witness on you, and your promised place to meet me will be Al- Haud (i.e. the Tank) (on the Day of Resurrection), and I am (now) looking at it from this place of mine. I am not afraid that you will worship others besides Allah, but I am afraid that worldly life will tempt you and cause you to compete with each other for it." That was the last look which I cast on Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
hi: Uqba bin Amir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Uhud ke shahidon ki janaza namaz aath saal baad padhi (unki maut ke), mano zinda aur murda donon se vida lete huye. Phir woh mimbar par chadhe aur kaha, "Main tumhara aage jane wala hoonga, aur main tumhare liye ek gawah hoonga, aur tumhara mujhse milne ka waada kiya hua jagah Al-Haud (yaani talab) hoga (Qiyamat ke din), aur main ise abhi apni is jagah se dekh raha hoon. Mujhe dar nahi ke tum Allah ke saath doosron ki ibadat karoge, magar mujhe dar hai ke duniyavi zindagi tumhe lalach degi aur ek-doosre se muqabla karvaegi." Yeh aakhri drishya tha jo maine Allah ke Rasool ka dekha.

e: Narrated Al-Bara:We faced the pagans on that day (of the battle of Uhud) and the Prophet (ﷺ) placed a batch of archers (at a special place) and appointed `Abdullah (bin Jubair) as their commander and said, "Do not leave this place; if you should see us conquering the enemy, do not leave this place, and if you should see them conquering us, do not (come to) help us," So, when we faced the enemy, they took to their heels till I saw their women running towards the mountain, lifting up their clothes from their legs, revealing their leg-bangles. The Muslims started saying, "The booty, the booty!" `Abdullah bin Jubair said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) had taken a firm promise from me not to leave this place." But his companions refused (to stay). So when they refused (to stay there), (Allah) confused them so that they could not know where to go, and they suffered seventy casualties. Abu Sufyan ascended a high place and said, "Is Muhammad present amongst the people?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not answer him." Abu Sufyan said, "Is the son of Abu Quhafa present among the people?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not answer him." `Abu Sufyan said, "Is the son of Al-Khattab amongst the people?" He then added, "All these people have been killed, for, were they alive, they would have replied." On that, `Umar could not help saying, "You are a liar, O enemy of Allah! Allah has kept what will make you unhappy." Abu Sufyan said, "Superior may be Hubal!" On that the Prophet said (to his companions), "Reply to him." They asked, "What may we say?" He said, "Say: Allah is More Elevated and More Majestic!" Abu Sufyan said, "We have (the idol) Al-`Uzza, whereas you have no `Uzza!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to his companions), "Reply to him." They said, "What may we say?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Say: Allah is our Helper and you have no helper." Abu Sufyan said, "(This) day compensates for our loss at Badr and (in) the battle (the victory) is always undecided and shared in turns by the belligerents. You will see some of your dead men mutilated, but neither did I urge this action, nor am I sorry for it." Narrated Jabir: Some people took wine in the morning of the day of Uhud and were then killed as martyrs
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Hum us din (yaani Uhud ki jung) mushrikon ka saamna karte the, aur Nabi ne tirandaajon ke ek giroh ko ek khaas jagah par muqarrar kiya aur Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) (bin Jubair) ko unka kamander muqarrar kiya aur kaha, "Yeh jagah mat chhodna; agar tum humein dushman ko haar dete dekho, phir bhi yeh jagah mat chhodna, aur agar tum unhe humein haar dete dekho, humari madad ke liye mat aana." Isliye jab hum dushman ka saamna kiye, woh peeth dikhakar bhaagne lage jab tak maine unki aurton ko pahad ki taraf bhaagte dekha, apne kapde apni taangon se uthate hue, jismein unke paayal dikh rahe the. Musalman kehne lage, "Maal-e-ghanimat, maal-e-ghanimat!" Abdullah bin Jubair ne kaha, "Nabi ne mujhse pukhta waada liya tha ke main yeh jagah na chhodun." Magar unke sathiyon ne (rukne se) inkaar kiya. Jab unhone inkaar kiya, (Allah) ne unhe aisa uljha diya ke unhe pata na chala kahaan jaen, aur unki sattar jaanen gaee. Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ) ek oonchi jagah par chadhe aur pucha, "Kya Muhammad logon mein maujood hain?" Nabi ne kaha, "Unhe jawab mat do." Usne phir pucha, "Kya Abu Quhafa ka beta (yaani Abu Bakr) logon mein maujood hai?" Nabi ne kaha, "Unhe jawab mat do." Usne phir pucha, "Kya Al-Khattab ka beta logon mein maujood hai?" Phir usne joda, "Yeh sab log qatl kiye ja chuke hain, kyunke agar woh zinda hote, woh zaroor jawab dete." Ispar, Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) khud ko roka nahi paye aur kaha, "Tum jhoote ho, Aye Allah ke dushman! Allah ne woh sab bacha rakha hai jo tumhe dukhi karega." Abu Sufyan ne kaha, "Hubal ki jai ho (yaani sarvashreshtha ho)!" Ispar, Nabi ne (apne sahaba se) kaha, "Unhe jawab do." Unhone pucha, "Hum kya kahen?" Unhone kaha, "Kaho: Allah sabse buland aur mahaan hai!" Abu Sufyan ne kaha, "Humare paas (but) Al-Uzza hai, jabke tumhare paas Al-Uzza nahi hai!" Nabi ne (apne sahaba se) kaha, "Unhe jawab do." Unhone pucha, "Hum kya kahen?" Nabi ne kaha, "Kaho: Allah humara madadgar hai aur tumhara koee madadgar nahi." Abu Sufyan ne kaha, "(Yeh) din Badr ke humare nuksaan ka badla hai, aur jung mein (fatah) hamesha badalne wala rahti hai aur donon mujahidon ke beech baari-baari se milti hai. Tum apne kuch murda logon ko vikrit paoge, magar maine na to iska hukum diya na hi mujhe iskaa afsos hai." Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Kuch log Uhud ki jung ke din subah sharab piye aur phir shaheed hue.

e: Narrated Sa`d bin Ibrahim:A meal was brought to `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf while he was fasting. He said, "Mus`ab bin `Umair was martyred, and he was better than I, yet he was shrouded in a Burda (i.e. a sheet) so that, if his head was covered, his feet became naked, and if his feet were covered, his head became naked." `Abdur-Rahman added, "Hamza was martyred and he was better than I. Then worldly wealth was bestowed upon us and we were given thereof too much. We are afraid that the reward of our deeds has been given to us in this life." `Abdur-Rahman then started weeping so much that he left the food
hi: Sa'd bin Ibrahim bataate hain: Ek khaana Abdur-Rahman bin Auf ke paas laaya gaya jabke woh roza rakhe hue the. Unhone kaha, "Mus'ab bin Umair shaheed hue, aur woh mujhse behtar the, phir bhi unhe ek Burda (yaani ek chaadar) mein kafna diya gaya isi tarah ke agar unka sar dhaka jata, unke paanv khule reh jaate, aur agar unke paanv dhake jate, unka sar khula reh jata." Abdur-Rahman ne joda, "Hamza shaheed hue aur woh mujhse behtar the. Phir humein duniyavi daulat mili aur humein usmein se bahut zyada di gaee. Humein dar hai ke humare amalon ka ajr abhi is jeevan mein hi de diya gaya hai." Phir Abdur-Rahman itna rone lage ke unhone khaana chhod diya.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:On the day of the battle of Uhud, a man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "Can you tell me where I will be if I should get martyred?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "In Paradise." The man threw away some dates he was carrying in his hand, and fought till he was martyred
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Uhud ki jung ke din, ek shaks Nabi ke paas aaya aur kaha, "Kya aap mujhe bata sakte hain main kahaan hoonga agar main shaheed ho jaoon?" Nabi ne jawab diya, "Jannat mein." Us shaks ne apne haath mein pakdi kuch khajooren phenk di aur jung karte rahe jab tak woh shaheed hue.

e: Narrated Khabbab bin Al-Art: We migrated in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), seeking Allah's Pleasure. So our reward became due and sure with Allah. Some of us have been dead without enjoying anything of their rewards (here), and one of them was Mus'ab bin 'Umar who was martyred on the day of the battle of Uhud, and did not leave anything except a Namira (i.e. a sheet in which he was shrouded). If we covered his head with it, his feet became naked, and if we covered his feet with it, his head became naked. So the Prophet (ﷺ) said to us, "Cover his head with it and put some Idhkhir (i.e. a kind of grass) over his feet or throw Idhkhir over his feet." But some amongst us have got the fruits of their labor ripened, and they are collecting them
hi: Khabbab (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Art bataate hain: Humne Allah ke Rasool ki sohbat mein hijrat ki, Allah ki khushi ki khaatir, isliye humara ajr Allah ke paas nishchit aur sunishchit ho gaya. Humme se kuch is duniya se guzar gaye bina apne ajr ka koee faayda uthae, aur unmein se ek Mus'ab bin Umair the jo Uhud ki jung ke din shaheed hue, aur unhonne ek Namira (yaani ek chaadar jismein unhe kafna diya gaya) ke ilawa kuch nahi chhoda. Agar humne unka sar isse dhaka, unke paanv khule rah jate, aur agar humne unke paanv dhaae, unka sar khula rah jata. Isliye Nabi ne humse kaha, "Unka sar isse dhaako aur unke paanvon par kuch Idhkhir (yaani ek qisam ki ghaas) rakho," ya "unke paanvon par Idhkhir daalo." Magar humme se kuch ne apne phal pak jate dekhe (is duniya mein) aur woh unhe jama kar rahe hain.

e: Narrated Anas: His uncle (Anas bin An-Nadr) was absent from the battle of Badr and he said, "I was absent from the first battle of the Prophet (i.e. Badr battle), and if Allah should let me participate in (a battle) with the Prophet, Allah will see how strongly I will fight." So he encountered the day of Uhud battle. The Muslims fled and he said, "O Allah ! I appeal to You to excuse me for what these people (i.e. the Muslims) have done, and I am clear from what the pagans have done." Then he went forward with his sword and met Sad bin Mu'adh (fleeing), and asked him, "Where are you going, O Sad? I detect a smell of Paradise before Uhud." Then he proceeded on and was martyred. No-body was able to recognize him till his sister recognized him by a mole on his body or by the tips of his fingers. He had over 80 wounds caused by stabbing, striking or shooting with arrows
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Unke chacha (Anas bin An-Nadr) Badr ki jung mein maujood nahi the aur unhone kaha, "Main Nabi ki pahli jung (yaani Badr) mein maujood nahi tha, aur agar Allah mujhe Nabi ke saath (kisi jung) mein shaamil hone diya, Allah dekhega main kitna zordaar jung karunga." Isliye woh Uhud ki jung ke din unse ru-b-ru hue. Musalman bhaag gaye aur unhone kaha, "Aye Allah! Main tujhse guzarish karta hoon ke jo in logon (yaani Musalmanon) ne kiya uske liye mujhe maaf kar de, aur main jo kaafiron ne kiya usse khud ko alag karta hoon." Phir woh apni talwaar lekar aage badhe aur Sa'd bin Mu'adh se mile (jo bhaag rahe the), aur pucha, "Tum kahaan ja rahe ho, Aye Sa'd? Mujhe Uhud ke saamne Jannat ki khushbu aa rahi hai." Phir woh aage badhe aur shaheed hue. Koee bhi unhe pahchan nahi paya jab tak unki behn ne unke jism par ek til se ya unki ungliyon ke agle hisson se unhe pahchana. Unke jism par assi se zyada zakhm the, chaaku, talwaar, ya teer ki wajah se.

e: Narrated Zaid bin Thabit:When we wrote the Holy Qur'an, I missed one of the Verses of Surat-al-Ahzab which I used to hear Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) reciting. Then we searched for it and found it with Khuza`ima bin Thabit Al-Ansari. The Verse was:-- 'Among the Believers are men Who have been true to Their Covenant with Allah, Of them, some have fulfilled Their obligations to Allah (i.e. they have been Killed in Allah's Cause), And some of them are (still) waiting" (33.23) So we wrote this in its place in the Qur'an
hi: Zaid bin Thabit (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab humne Paak Quran likha, maine Surat-al-Ahzab ki ek Ayat kho diya jise maine Allah ke Rasool ko padhte suna tha. Isliye humne use dhoondha aur use Khuzaima bin Thabit Al-Ansari ke paas paaya. Ayat yeh thi: "Mominon mein aise log hain jo Allah se apne ahad ke prati sachche rahe. Unmein se kuch ne apni zimmedaariyaan poori ki hain (yaani Allah ki raah mein shaheed hue), aur unmein se kuch abhi bhi (iska) intezaar kar rahe hain." (33:23) Isliye humne ise Quran mein iski jagah par likha.

e: Narrated Zaid bin Thabit:When the Prophet (ﷺ) set out for (the battle of) Uhud, some of those who had gone out with him, returned. The companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) were divided into two groups. One group said, "We will fight them (i.e. the enemy)," and the other group said, "We will not fight them." So there came the Divine Revelation:-- '(O Muslims!) Then what is the matter within you that you are divided into two parties about the hypocrites? Allah has cast them back (to disbelief) Because of what they have earned.' (4.88) On that, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "That is Taiba (i.e. the city of Medina) which clears one from one's sins as the fire expels the impurities of silver
hi: Zaid bin Thabit (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Nabi Uhud ki jung ke liye nikle, unmein se kuch jo unke saath nikle the wapas aa gaye. Nabi ke sahaba do girohon mein baant gaye. Ek giroh ne kaha, "Hum unse (yaani dushman se) jung karenge," aur doosre ne kaha, "Hum unse jung nahi karenge." Ispar Divine Ayat naazil huee: "(Aye Musalmano!) Tumhe kya hua hai ke tum munafikon ke maamle mein do girohon mein baant gaye ho? Allah ne unhe (kufr ki taraf) waapas dhakel diya hai unki kamaee ki wajah se." (4:88) Ispar, Nabi ne kaha, "Yeh Taiba hai (yaani Madina shehar), jo insaan ko gunahon se saaf karta hai jaisa aag chaandi ki gandagi ko baahar nikalti hai."

e: Narrated Jabir:This Verse: "When two of your parties almost Decided to fall away..." was revealed in our connection, i.e. Bani Salama and Bani Haritha and I would not have liked that, if it was not revealed, for Allah said:-- But Allah was their Protector
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Yeh Ayat: "Jab tumhare do giroh lagbhag (himmat) khone wale the..." humare silsile mein naazil huee, yaani Bani Salama aur Bani Haritha ke silsile mein, aur main isse khush nahi hota agar yeh naazil na huee hoti, kyunke Allah ne kaha: "Magar Allah unka rakshak tha."

e: Narrated Jabir:"Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me, "Have you got married O Jabir?" I replied, "Yes." He asked "What, a virgin or a matron?" I replied, "Not a virgin but a matron." He said, "Why did you not marry a young girl who would have fondled with you?" I replied, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! My father was martyred on the day of Uhud and left nine (orphan) daughters who are my nine sisters; so I disliked to have another young girl of their age, but (I sought) an (elderly) woman who could comb their hair and look after them." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You have done the right thing
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne mujhse kaha, "Kya tumne shaadi kar li hai, Aye Jabir?" Maine jawab diya, "Haan." Unhone pucha, "Kya, ek kuari ya ek biyaahi huee aurat?" Maine jawab diya, "Kuari nahi, balki ek biyaahi huee aurat." Unhone kaha, "Tumne ek jawan ladki se shaadi kyun nahi ki jo tumhare saath khela karti?" Maine jawab diya, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Mere waalid Uhud ki jung ke din shaheed hue aur nau (yaani anaath) betiyaan chhod gaye jo meri nau behnen hain; isliye mujhe unki hi umr ki ek doosri jawan ladki se shaadi karna pasand nahi tha, balki (mujhe chahiye tha) ek (badi umr ki) aurat jo unke baal sanvaare aur unki dekhbhaal kare." Nabi ne kaha, "Tumne sahi kaam kiya hai."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:That his father was martyred on the day of the battle of Uhud and was in debt and left six (orphan) daughters. Jabir, added, "When the season of plucking the dates came, I went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "You know that my father was martyred on the day of Uhud, and he was heavily in debt, and I would like that the creditors should see you." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Go and pile every kind of dates apart." I did so and called him (i.e. the Prophet (ﷺ) ). When the creditors saw him, they started claiming their debts from me then in such a harsh manner (as they had never done before). So when he saw their attitude, he went round the biggest heap of dates thrice, and then sat over it and said, 'O Jabir), call your companions (i.e. the creditors).' Then he kept on measuring (and giving) to the creditors (their due) till Allah paid all the debt of my father. I would have been satisfied to retain nothing of those dates for my sisters after Allah had paid the debts of my father. But Allah saved all the heaps (of dates), so that when I looked at the heap where the Prophet (ﷺ) had been sitting, it seemed as if a single date had not been taken away thereof
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Unke waalid Uhud ki jung ke din shaheed hue aur qarzdaar the, chhah (anaath) betiyaan chhodkar. Jabir ne joda, "Jab khajoor todne ka mausam aaya, main Allah ke Rasool ke paas gaya aur kaha, 'Aapko pata hai mere waalid Uhud mein shaheed hue, aur woh bahut zyada qarze mein the, aur main chahta hoon ke qarzdaar aapko dekhen (mera saath dene ke liye).'" Nabi ne kaha, "Jaao aur har qisam ki khajoor ko alag dher mein rakho." Maine aisa hi kiya aur unhe (yaani Nabi ko) bulaya. Jab qarzdaron ne unhe dekha, unhone mujhse itni sakhti se apna qarza maangna shuru kiya (jaisa pahle kabhi nahi kiya tha). Isliye jab Nabi ne unka vyavhaar dekha, woh sabse bade dher ke chaaron taraf teen baar ghoome, aur phir uske oopar baith gaye aur kaha, "(Aye Jabir), apne sathiyon (yaani qarzdaron) ko bulao." Phir woh qarzdaron ko unka haqq naapkar dena shuru kiya jab tak Allah ne mere waalid ka poora qarza chuka diya. Main santusht hota agar apni behnon ke liye kuch bhi khajoor na bache, Allah dwaara mere waalid ka qarza chuka dene ke baad. Magar Allah ne sab dher bacha liye, aisa ke jab maine us dher ki taraf dekha jahaan Nabi baithe the, aisa lagta tha mano ek bhi khajoor usmein se nahi li gaee.

e: Narrated Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas:I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the day of the battle of Uhud accompanied by two men fighting on his behalf. They were dressed in white and were fighting as bravely as possible. I had never seen them before, nor did I see them later on
hi: Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool ko Uhud ki jung ke din dekha, unke saath do log the jo unki taraf se jung kar rahe the. Woh safed kapde pahne hue the aur jitna mumkin ho utni bahaduri se jung kar rahe the. Maine unhe na pahle kabhi dekha tha na baad mein.

e: Narrated Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas:The Prophet (ﷺ) took out a quiver (of arrows) for me on the day of Uhud and said, "Throw (arrows); let my father and mother be sacrificed for you
hi: Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Uhud ke din mere liye ek teer-tarkash nikala aur kaha, "Chalao (teer); mere maa-baap tumhare liye qurbaan hon."

e: Narrated Sa`d:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) mentioned both his father and mother for me on the day of the battle of Uhud
hi: Sa'd bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Uhud ki jung ke din mere liye apne donon maa-baap ka zikar kiya.

e: Narrated Ibn Al Musaiyab:Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) mentioned both his father and mother for me on the day of the battle of Uhud." He meant when the Prophet (ﷺ) said (to Sa`d) while the latter was fighting. "Let my father and mother be sacrificed for you
hi: Ibn Al-Musaiyab bataate hain: Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Allah ke Rasool ne Uhud ki jung ke din mere liye apne donon maa-baap ka zikar kiya." Unka matlab tha jab Nabi ne (Sa'd se) kaha jabke woh jung kar rahe the, "Mere maa-baap tumhare liye qurbaan hon."

e: Narrated `Ali:I have never heard the Prophet (ﷺ) mentioning both his father and mother for anybody other than Sa`d
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Maine Nabi ko kabhi apne donon maa-baap ka zikar kisi aur ke liye karte nahi suna siwaye Sa'd ke.

e: Narrated `Ali:I have never heard the Prophet (ﷺ) mentioning his father and mother for anybody other than Sa`d bin Malik. I heard him saying on the day of Uhud, "O Sa`d throw (arrows)! Let my father and mother be sacrificed for you
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Maine Nabi ko kabhi apne maa-baap ka zikar kisi aur ke liye karte nahi suna siwaye Sa'd bin Malik ke. Maine unhe Uhud ki jung ke din kehte suna, "Aye Sa'd, teer chalao! Mere maa-baap tumhare liye qurbaan hon."

e: Narrated Mu'tamir's father:`Uthman said that on the day of the battle of Uhud, none remained with the Prophet (ﷺ) but Talha and Sa`d
hi: Mu'tamir ke waalid bataate hain: Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha ke Uhud ki jung ke din, koee bhi Nabi ke saath nahi bacha siwaye Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Sa'd ke.

e: Narrated As-Saib bin Yazid:I have been in the company of `AbdurRahman bin `Auf, Talha bin 'Ubaidullah, Al-Miqdad and Sa`d, and I heard none of them narrating anything from the Prophet (ﷺ) excepting the fact that I heard Talha narrating about the day of Uhud (battle)
hi: As-Saib bin Yazid bataate hain: Main Abdur-Rahman bin Auf, Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ubaidullah, Al-Miqdad (رضی اللہ عنہ), aur Sa'd ki sohbat mein raha, aur maine unmein se kisi ko bhi Nabi se koee riwaayat karte nahi suna siwaye iske ke maine Talha ko Uhud ki jung ke din ke baare mein baat karte suna.

e: Narrated Qais:I saw Talha's paralyzed hand with which he had protected the Prophet (ﷺ) on the day of Uhud
hi: Qais bataate hain: Maine Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) ka lakva hua haath dekha jisse unhone Uhud ki jung ke din Nabi ki hifaazat ki thi.

e: Narrated Anas:When it was the day of Uhud, the people left the Prophet (ﷺ) while Abu Talha was in front of the Prophet (ﷺ) shielding him with his leather shield. Abu Talha was a skillful archer who used to shoot violently. He broke two or three arrow bows on that day. If a man carrying a quiver full of arrows passed by, the Prophet would say (to him), put (scatter) its contents for Abu Talha." The Prophet (ﷺ) would raise his head to look at the enemy, whereupon Abu Talha would say, "Let my father and mother be sacrificed for you ! Do not raise your head, lest an arrow of the enemy should hit you. (Let) my neck (be struck) rather than your neck." I saw `Aisha, the daughter of Abu Bakr, and Um Sulaim rolling up their dresses so that I saw their leg-bangles while they were carrying water skins on their backs and emptying them in the mouths of the (wounded) people. They would return to refill them and again empty them in the mouths of the (wounded) people. The sword fell from Abu Talha's hand twice or thrice (on that day)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Uhud ki jung ke din, log Nabi ko chhodkar chale gaye jabke Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) Nabi ke aage the, unhe apni chamde ki dhaal se bachate hue. Abu Talha ek mahaar tirandaaz the jo zordaar teer chalate the. Unhone us din do ya teen dhanush tode. Agar koee shaks teeron se bhara koyla lekar guzarta, Nabi kahte, "Iske andar ki cheezen Abu Talha ke liye rakho." Nabi apna sar uthakar dushman ki taraf dekhte, ispar Abu Talha kahte, "Mere maa-baap tumhare liye qurbaan hon! Apna sar mat uthaiye, kahin dushman ka koee teer aapko na lag jaaye. Mera gala (kat jaaye) tumhare gale ki bajaaye." Maine Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا), Abu Bakr ki beti, aur Um Sulaim ko dekha, apna kapda uthate huye taaki main unki paayal dekh sakon, aur woh donon apni peeth par paani ki mashken laati aur ghaayal logon ke munhon mein daalti. Phir woh wapas jati aur unhe bharti aur phir ghaayal logon ke munhon mein daalti. Abu Talha ki talwaar unke haath se do ya teen baar gir gaee.

e: Narrated `Aisha:When it was the day of Uhud, the pagans were defeated. Then Satan, Allah's Curse be upon him, cried loudly, "O Allah's Worshippers, beware of what is behind!" On that, the front files of the (Muslim) forces turned their backs and started fighting with the back files. Hudhaifa looked, and on seeing his father Al-Yaman, he shouted, "O Allah's Worshippers, my father, my father!" But by Allah, they did not stop till they killed him. Hudhaifa said, "May Allah forgive you." (The sub-narrator, `Urwa, said, "By Allah, Hudhaifa continued asking Allah's Forgiveness for the killers of his father till he departed to Allah (i.e. died)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Uhud ki jung ke din, mushrik haar gaye. Phir Shaitan, Allah ki laanat use, zor se chilla, "Aye Allah ke bando! (Fauj ke) peeche se saavdhaan raho!" Ispar, agli safon ne pichhli safon par hamla kar diya. Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne dekha, aur apne waalid Al-Yaman ko dekhkar, chille, "Aye Allah ke bando! Mere waalid! Mere waalid!" Magar Allah ki qasam, unhone (unpar hamla) tab tak nahi ruka jab tak unke waalid qatl nahi hue. Hudhaifa ne kaha, "Allah tumhe maaf kare." (Doosre raawi, Urwa ne kaha, "Allah ki qasam, Hudhaifa apne waalid ke qaatilon ke liye Allah se maafi maangte rahe jab tak unka intiqal hua.")

e: Narrated `Uthman bin Mauhab:A man came to perform the Hajj to (Allah's) House. Seeing some people sitting, he said, "Who are these sitting people?" Somebody said, "They are the people of Quraish." He said, "Who is the old man?" They said, "Ibn `Umar." He went to him and said, "I want to ask you about something; will you tell me about it? I ask you with the respect due to the sanctity of this (Sacred) House, do you know that `Uthman bin `Affan fled on the day of Uhud?" Ibn `Umar said, "Yes." He said, "Do you know that he (i.e. `Uthman) was absent from the Badr (battle) and did not join it?" Ibn `Umar said, "Yes." He said, "Do you know that he failed to be present at the Ridwan Pledge of allegiance (i.e. Pledge of allegiance at Hudaibiya) and did not witness it?" Ibn `Umar replied, "Yes," He then said, "Allahu- Akbar!" Ibn `Umar said, "Come along; I will inform you and explain to you what you have asked. As for the flight (of `Uthman) on the day of Uhud, I testify that Allah forgave him. As regards his absence from the Badr (battle), he was married to the daughter of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and she was ill, so the Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, 'You will have such reward as a man who has fought the Badr battle will get, and will also have the same share of the booty.' As for his absence from the Ridwan Pledge of allegiance if there had been anybody more respected by the Meccans than `Uthman bin `Affan, the Prophet would surely have sent that man instead of `Uthman. So the Prophet (ﷺ) sent him (i.e. `Uthman to Mecca) and the Ridwan Pledge of allegiance took place after `Uthman had gone to Mecca. The Prophet raised his right hand saying. 'This is the hand of `Uthman,' and clapped it over his other hand and said, "This is for `Uthman.'" Ibn `Umar then said (to the man), "Go now, after taking this information
hi: Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Mauhab bataate hain: Ek shaks Hajj karne aaya (Allah ke Ghar par). Kuch logon ko baithe dekhkar, unhone pucha, "Yeh baithe log kaun hain?" Kisi ne kaha, "Yeh Quraish ke log hain." Unhone pucha, "Woh boodha shaks kaun hai?" Unhone kaha, "Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ)." Woh unke paas gaye aur kaha, "Main aapse kuch puchna chahta hoon; kya aap mujhe iske baare mein bataenge? Main aapko is (pavitra) Ghar ki pavitrata ki qasam dekar puchta hoon, kya aapko pata hai ke Uthman bin Affan Uhud ki jung ke din bhaag gaye the?" Ibn Umar ne kaha, "Haan." Unhone pucha, "Kya aapko pata hai ke woh Badr (ki jung) mein gair-haajir the aur usmein shaamil nahi hue?" Ibn Umar ne kaha, "Haan." Unhone pucha, "Kya aapko pata hai ke woh Ar-Ridwan bai'at mein gair-haajir the (yaani Hudaibiya ki bai'at) aur ise dekh nahi paye?" Ibn Umar ne jawab diya, "Haan." Phir usne kaha, "Allahu Akbar!" Ibn Umar ne kaha, "Aao, main tumhe batataa hoon aur samjhata hoon jo tumne pucha. Jahaan tak Uhud ke din unke bhaagne ka sawal hai, main gawahi deta hoon ke Allah ne unhe maaf kiya. Jahaan tak Badr (ki jung) se unke gair-haajir hone ka sawal hai, unki shaadi Allah ke Rasool ki beti se hui thi aur woh bimar thi, isliye Nabi ne unse kaha, 'Tumhe wahi ajr aur hissa milega jaisa Badr ki jung mein shaamil hone wale kisi ko milta.' Jahaan tak Ar-Ridwan bai'at se unke gair-haajir hone ka sawal hai, agar Mecca mein Uthman bin Affan se zyada izzatdaar koee shaks hota, Nabi zaroor unke bajaaye us shaks ko bhejte. Isliye Nabi ne unhe (Mecca) bheja, aur Ar-Ridwan bai'at Uthman ke Mecca jane ke baad huee. Nabi ne apna dahina haath uthaakar kaha, 'Yeh Uthman ka haath hai,' aur use apne doosre haath par thapthapaya aur kaha, 'Yeh Uthman ke liye hai.'" Phir Ibn Umar ne (us shaks se) kaha, "Ab jaao, yeh jaankaari lekar."

e: Narrated Al-Bara' bin `Azib:The Prophet (ﷺ) appointed `Abdullah bin Jubair as the commander of the cavalry archers on the day of the battle of Uhud. Then they returned defeated, and that is what is referred to by Allah's Statement:-- "And the Apostle (Muhammad) was in your rear calling you back
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Jubair ko Uhud ki jung ke din ghodswaar tirandaajon ka sardaar muqarrar kiya. Phir woh haar kar wapas aaye, aur yehi hai jiska zikar Allah ke is farmaan mein hai: "Aur Rasool (Muhammad) tumhe peeche se bula rahe the." (3:153)

e: Abu Talha (ra) said:I was amongst those who were overtaken by slumber until my sword fell from my hand on several occasions. The sword fell and I picked it up, and it fell again, and I picked it up
hi: Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main un logon mein tha jinhe neend ne apni chapet mein le liya tha (Uhud ki jung ke din), isi tarah ke meri talwaar kaee baar mere haath se gir gaee. Talwaar girti aur main use uthata, aur woh phir girti aur main phir use uthata.

e: Narrated Salim's father:That he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), when raising his head from bowing of the first rak`a of the morning prayer, saying, "O Allah! Curse so-and-so and so-and-so" after he had said, "Allah hears him who sends his praises to Him. Our Lord, all the Praises are for you!" So Allah revealed:-- "Not for you (O Muhammad! )......(till the end of Verse) they are indeed wrong-doers
hi: Salim ke waalid bataate hain: Unhone Allah ke Rasool ko, subah ki namaz ki pahli rakat ke ruku se apna sar uthate waqt, yeh kahte suna, "Aye Allah! Falaan-falaan par laanaat bhej," yeh kehne ke baad, "Allah use sunta hai jo uski taarif karta hai. Humare Rab! Sab taarifen tere liye hain." Ispar Allah ne naazil kiya: "Yeh maamla aapke haath mein nahi hai (Aye Muhammad!)...." (aakhri tak) "...beshak, woh zaalim hain." (3:128)

e: Salim bin `Abdullah said' "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to invoke evil upon Safwan bin Umaiya, Suhail bin `Amr and Al-Harith bin Hisham. So the Verse was revealed:-- "Not for you (O Muhammad!)......(till the end of Verse) For they are indeed wrong-doers
hi: Salim bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool Safwan bin Umaiya, Suhail bin Amr, aur Al-Harith bin Hisham ke khilaf bad-dua kiya karte the. Ispar Ayat naazil huee: "Yeh maamla aapke haath mein nahi hai (Aye Muhammad!)...." (aakhri tak) "...beshak, woh zaalim hain."

e: Narrated Tha`laba bin Abi Malik:`Umar bin Al-Khattab distributed woolen clothes amongst some women of Medina, and a nice woolen garment remained. Some of those who were sitting with him, said, "O chief of the believers! Give it to the daughter of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who is with you," and by that, they meant Um Kulthum, the daughter of `Ali. `Umar said, "Um Salit has got more right than she." Um Salit was amongst those Ansari women who had given the pledge of allegiance to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . `Umar added, "She (i.e. Um Salit) used to carry the filled water skins for us on the day of the battle of Uhud
hi: Tha'laba bin Abi Malik bataate hain: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab ne Madina ki kuch aurton mein ooni kapde taqseem kiye, aur ek achha ooni kapda bach gaya. Unmein se kuch jo unke saath baithe the ne kaha, "Aye Mominon ke Ameer! Ise Allah ke Rasool ki beti ko dijiye jo aapke saath hai," unka ishara Um Kulthum, Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki beti, ki taraf tha. Umar ne kaha, "Um Salit iski zyada haqdaar hain." Um Salit un Ansaari aurton mein se thi jinhone Allah ke Rasool ko bai'at di thi. Umar ne joda, "Woh (yaani Um Salit) Uhud ki jung ke din humare liye bhari paani ki mashken uthaati thi."

e: Narrated Jafar bin `Amr bin Umaiya:I went out with 'Ubaidullah bin `Adi Al-Khaiyar. When we reached Hims (i.e. a town in Syria), 'Ubaidullah bin `Adi said (to me), "Would you like to see Wahshi so that we may ask him about the killing of Hamza?" I replied, "Yes." Wahshi used to live in Hims. We enquired about him and somebody said to us, "He is that in the shade of his palace, as if he were a full water skin." So we went up to him, and when we were at a short distance from him, we greeted him and he greeted us in return. 'Ubaidullah was wearing his turban and Wahshi could not see except his eyes and feet. 'Ubaidullah said, "O Wahshi! Do you know me?" Wahshi looked at him and then said, "No, by Allah! But I know that `Adi bin Al-Khiyar married a woman called Um Qital, the daughter of Abu Al-Is, and she delivered a boy for him at Mecca, and I looked for a wet nurse for that child. (Once) I carried that child along with his mother and then I handed him over to her, and your feet resemble that child's feet." Then 'Ubaidullah uncovered his face and said (to Wahshi), "Will you tell us (the story of) the killing of Hamza?" Wahshi replied "Yes, Hamza killed Tuaima bin `Adi bin Al-Khiyar at Badr (battle) so my master, Jubair bin Mut`im said to me, 'If you kill Hamza in revenge for my uncle, then you will be set free." When the people set out (for the battle of Uhud) in the year of 'Ainain ..'Ainain is a mountain near the mountain of Uhud, and between it and Uhud there is a valley.. I went out with the people for the battle. When the army aligned for the fight, Siba' came out and said, 'Is there any (Muslim) to accept my challenge to a duel?' Hamza bin `Abdul Muttalib came out and said, 'O Siba'. O Ibn Um Anmar, the one who circumcises other ladies! Do you challenge Allah and His Apostle?' Then Hamza attacked and killed him, causing him to be non-extant like the bygone yesterday. I hid myself under a rock, and when he (i.e. Hamza) came near me, I threw my spear at him, driving it into his umbilicus so that it came out through his buttocks, causing him to die. When all the people returned to Mecca, I too returned with them. I stayed in (Mecca) till Islam spread in it (i.e. Mecca). Then I left for Taif, and when the people (of Taif) sent their messengers to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), I was told that the Prophet (ﷺ) did not harm the messengers; So I too went out with them till I reached Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). When he saw me, he said, 'Are you Wahshi?' I said, 'Yes.' He said, 'Was it you who killed Hamza?' I replied, 'What happened is what you have been told of.' He said, 'Can you hide your face from me?' So I went out when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died, and Musailamah Al-Kadhdhab appeared (claiming to be a prophet). I said, 'I will go out to Musailamah so that I may kill him, and make amends for killing Hamza. So I went out with the people (to fight Musailamah and his followers) and then famous events took place concerning that battle. Suddenly I saw a man (i.e. Musailamah) standing near a gap in a wall. He looked like an ash-colored camel and his hair was dishevelled. So I threw my spear at him, driving it into his chest in between his breasts till it passed out through his shoulders, and then an Ansari man attacked him and struck him on the head with a sword. `Abdullah bin `Umar said, 'A slave girl on the roof of a house said: Alas! The chief of the believers (i.e. Musailamah) has been killed by a black slave
hi: Ja'far bin Amr bin Umaiya bataate hain: Main Ubaidullah bin Adi Al-Khaiyar ke saath nikla. Jab hum Hims (yaani Sham ka ek shehar) pahunche, Ubaidullah bin Adi ne (mujhse) kaha, "Kya tum Wahshi ko dekhna chahoge taaki hum unse Hamza ki hatya ke baare mein puchen?" Maine jawab diya, "Haan." Wahshi Hims mein rahte the. Humne unke baare mein pucha aur kisi ne humse kaha, "Woh apne mahal ki chhaye mein hain, mano ek bhari hui paani ki mashk ho." Isliye hum unke paas gaye, aur jab hum unse thoda door the, humne unhe salaam kiya aur unhone humein jawab diya. Ubaidullah apni pagdi pahne hue the aur Wahshi sirf unki aankhen aur paanv dekh pate the. Ubaidullah ne kaha, "Aye Wahshi! Kya tum mujhe pahchante ho?" Wahshi ne unki taraf dekha aur kaha, "Nahi, Allah ki qasam! Magar mujhe pata hai ke Adi bin Al-Khiyar ne Um Qital naam ki ek aurat se shaadi ki, Abu Al-As ki beti, aur usne Mecca mein unke liye ek beta paidaish diya, aur maine us bachche ke liye ek daaee dhoondi. (Ek baar) main woh baccha aur unki maa ko lekar gaya aur phir use (yaani bachche ko) unse saunp diya, aur tumhare paanv us bachche ke paanvon jaise dikhte hain." Phir Ubaidullah ne apna chehra khola aur kaha (Wahshi se), "Kya tum humein Hamza ki hatya (ke baare mein) bataoge?" Wahshi ne jawab diya, "Haan, Hamza ne Tuaima bin Adi bin Al-Khiyar ko Badr (ki jung) mein qatl kiya tha, isliye mere maalik, Jubair bin Mut'im, ne mujhse kaha, 'Agar tum mere chacha ke badle mein Hamza ko qatl karte ho, tum azad ho jaoge.' Jab log (Uhud ki jung ke liye) nikle Ainain ke saal (Ainain, Uhud pahad ke qareeb ek pahad hai, aur uske aur Uhud ke beech ek waadi hai), main bhi logon ke saath jung ke liye nikla. Jab fauj jung ke liye taiyaar huee, Siba bahar aaye aur kaha, 'Kya koee (Musalman) mera duel challenge qubool karega?' Hamza bin Abdul Muttalib bahar aaye aur kaha, 'Aye Siba, Aye Ibn Um Anmar, doosri aurton ka khatna karne wale! Kya tum Allah aur uske Rasool ko challenge dete ho?' Phir Hamza ne hamla kiya aur unhe qatl kiya, unhe bite hue kal ki tarah samapt kar diya. Main ek chattan ke neeche chhup gaya, aur jab woh (yaani Hamza) mere qareeb aaye, maine unpar apna bhaala phenka, use unki naabhi mein ghusate huye taaki woh unke peeth se bahar nikle, jisse unki maut ho gaee. Jab sab log Mecca wapas gaye, main bhi unke saath wapas gaya. Main (Mecca mein) raha jab tak wahaan Islam phaila (Mecca mein), phir main Taif chala gaya, aur jab (Taif ke) log apne sandesh-vahak Allah ke Rasool ke paas bhejte the, mujhe bataya gaya ke Nabi sandesh-vahakon ko nuksaan nahi pahunchate; isliye main bhi unke saath nikla jab tak main Allah ke Rasool tak pahuncha. Jab unhone mujhe dekha, unhone kaha, 'Kya tum Wahshi ho?' Maine kaha, 'Haan.' Unhone kaha, 'Kya tumne hi Hamza ko qatl kiya?' Maine jawab diya, 'Jo aapko bataya gaya hai wahi hua.' Unhone kaha, 'Kya tum apna chehra mujhse chhupa sakte ho?' Isliye main chala gaya jab tak Allah ke Rasool ka intiqal hua, aur Musailamah Al-Kadhdhab prakat hue (Nabi hone ka daava karte huye). Maine kaha, 'Main Musailamah ki taraf jaunga taaki main unhe qatl kar sakoon, aur Hamza ki hatya ka prayaschit kar sakoon.' Isliye main logon ke saath nikla (Musailamah aur unke anuyaayiyon se jung karne ke liye) aur phir us jung ke prasidh ghatnaen huee. Achanak maine ek shaks (yaani Musailamah) ko ek deewaar ke chhed ke paas khade dekha. Woh ek raakhi rang ke unt jaisa dikhta tha aur unke baal bikhre hue the. Isliye maine unpar apna bhaala phenka, use unke seene mein ghusate huye taaki woh unke kandhon se bahar nikle, aur phir ek Ansaari shaks ne unpar hamla kiya aur talwaar se unke sar par vaar kiya." Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Ek ghar ki chhat par ek launDi ne kaha: Afsos! Mominon ke sardaar (yaani Musailamah) ko ek kale gulaam ne qatl kar diya."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (pointing to his broken canine tooth) said, "Allah's Wrath has become severe on the people who harmed His Prophet. Allah's Wrath has become severe on the man who is killed by the Apostle of Allah in Allah's Cause
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne (apne toote hue daadha ke daant ki taraf ishara karte huye) kaha, "Allah ka gussa un logon par sakht ho gaya jinhone unke Nabi ko dukh diya. Allah ka gussa us shaks par sakht ho gaya jise Allah ke Rasool ne Allah ki raah mein qatl kiya."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Wrath became severe on him whom the Prophet (ﷺ) had killed in Allah's Cause. Allah's Wrath became severe on the people who caused the face of Allah's Prophet to bleed
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ka gussa sakht ho gaya us shaks par jise Nabi ne Allah ki raah mein qatl kiya. Allah ka gussa sakht ho gaya un logon par jinhone Allah ke Nabi ke chehre se khoon bahaya.

e: Narrated Abu Hazim:That he heard Sahl bin Sa`d being asked about the wounds of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "By Allah, I know who washed the wounds of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and who poured water (for washing them), and with what he was treated." Sahl added, "Fatima, the daughter of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to wash the wounds, and `Ali bin Abi Talib used to pour water from a shield. When Fatima saw that the water aggravated the bleeding, she took a piece of a mat, burnt it, and inserted its ashes into the wound so that the blood was congealed (and bleeding stopped). His canine tooth got broken on that day, and his face was wounded, and his helmet was broken on his head
hi: Abu Hazim bataate hain: Unhone Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) se Allah ke Rasool ke zakhmon ke baare mein puchte suna, aur unhone jawab diya, "Allah ki qasam, mujhe pata hai kisne Allah ke Rasool ke zakhm dhoae, aur kisne paani daala (unhe dhone ke liye), aur unka ilaaj kis cheez se kiya gaya." Sahl ne joda, "Nabi ki beti Fatima (Alayhas Salam) unke zakhm dhoya karti thi, aur Ali (Alayhis Salam) bin Abi Talib ek dhaal se paani daalte the. Jab Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ne dekha ke paani khoon ki maatra badha raha hai, unhone ek chataee ka ek tukda liya, use jala diya, aur uski raakh zakhm mein daal di taaki khoon jam jaaye (aur bahna ruk jaye). Unka daadh ka daant us din toot gaya tha, aur unka chehra zakhmi ho gaya tha, aur unka khod tut gaya tha unke sar par."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Wrath gets severe on a person killed by a prophet, and Allah's Wrath became severe on him who had caused the face of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to bleed
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ka gussa sakht ho jata hai us shaks par jise ek Nabi ne qatl kiya ho, aur Allah ka gussa sakht ho gaya un logon par jinhone Allah ke Rasool ke chehre se khoon bahaya.

e: Narrated `Aisha:Regarding the Holy Verse: "Those who responded (To the call) of Allah And the Apostle (Muhammad), After being wounded, For those of them Who did good deeds And refrained from wrong, there is a great reward." (3.172) She said to `Urwa, "O my nephew! Your father, Az-Zubair and Abu Bakr were amongst them (i.e. those who responded to the call of Allah and the Apostle on the day (of the battle of Uhud). When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), suffered what he suffered on the day of Uhud and the pagans left, the Prophet (ﷺ) was afraid that they might return. So he said, 'Who will go on their (i.e. pagans') track?' He then selected seventy men from amongst them (for this purpose)." (The sub-narrator added, "Abu Bakr and Az-Zubair were amongst them)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Is paak Ayat ke baare mein: "Woh log jinhone Allah aur uske Rasool ki pukar ka jawab diya, zakhmi hone ke baad, un logon ke liye jinhone neik amal kiye aur bachte rahe (buraee se), bahut bada ajr hai." (3:172) Unhone Urwa se kaha, "Aye mere bhatije! Aapke waalid, Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ), aur Abu Bakr un logon mein the (jinhone Allah aur Rasool ki pukar ka jawab diya Uhud ki jung ke din). Jab Allah ke Rasool ne jo kuch Uhud ki jung ke din jhela aur mushrik chale gaye, Nabi ko dar tha ke woh wapas aa sakte hain. Isliye unhone kaha, 'Kaun unke (yaani mushrikon ke) picha karega?' Unhone phir unmein se sattar logon ko is maksad ke liye chuna." (Doosre raawi ne joda, "Abu Bakr aur Az-Zubair unmein se the.")

e: Narrated Qatada:We do not know of any tribe amongst the 'Arab tribes who lost more martyrs than Al-Ansar, and they will have superiority on the Day of Resurrection. Anas bin Malik told us that seventy from the Ansar were martyred on the day of Uhud, and seventy on the day (of the battle of) Bir Ma'una, and seventy on the day of Al-Yamama. Anas added, "The battle of Bir Ma'una took place during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and the battle of Al-Yamama, during the caliphate of Abu Bakr, and it was the day when Musailamah Al-Kadhdhab was killed
hi: Qatada bataate hain: Hum Arab qabilon mein se kisi aise qabile ko nahi jaante jinke Ansaar se zyada shahid hue hon, aur unhe Qiyamat ke din superiority milegi. Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne humein bataya ke Uhud ki jung ke din sattar Ansaar shaheed hue, aur Bir Ma'una ki jung ke din sattar, aur Al-Yamama ki jung ke din sattar. Anas ne joda, "Bir Ma'una ki jung Allah ke Rasool ki zindagi mein huee thi, aur Al-Yamama ki jung Abu Bakr ki khilafat ke dauran, aur usi din Musailamah Al-Kadhdhab qatl hue."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to shroud two martyrs of Uhud in one sheet and then say, "Which of them knew Qur'an more?" When one of the two was pointed out, he would put him first in the grave. Then he said, "I will be a witness for them on the Day of Resurrection." He ordered them to be buried with their blood (on their bodies). Neither was the funeral prayer offered for them, nor were they washed. Jabir added, "When my father was martyred, I started weeping and uncovering his face. The companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) stopped me from doing so but the Prophet (ﷺ) did not stop me. Then the Prophet said, '(O Jabir.) don't weep over him, for the angels kept on covering him with their wings till his body was carried away (for burial)
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool Uhud ke do shahidon ko ek hi chaadar mein kafna dete the aur phir puchte, "Unmein se kaun Quran zyada jaanta tha?" Jab ek ki taraf ishara kiya jata, woh unhe qabar mein pahle rakhte. Phir unhone kaha, "Main Qiyamat ke din unke liye ek gawah hoonga." Unhone hukum diya ke unhe unke khoon samet dafna diya jaaye. Na unki janaza namaz padhi gaee na unhe ghusal diya gaya. Jabir ne joda, "Jab mere waalid shaheed hue, main rone aur unka chehra kholne laga. Nabi ke sahaba ne mujhe aisa karne se roka magar Nabi ne mujhe nahi roka. Phir Nabi ne kaha, '(Aye Jabir), unke liye mat ro, kyunke farishte unhe apne pankhon se dhaankte rahe jab tak unka jism (dafan ke liye) le jaya gaya.'"

e: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I saw in a dream that I moved a sword and its blade got broken, and that symbolized the casualties which the believers suffered on the day of Uhud. Then I moved it again, and it became as perfect as it had been, and that symbolized the Conquest (of Mecca) which Allah helped us to achieve, and the union of all the believers. I (also) saw cows in the dream, and what Allah does is always beneficial. Those cows appeared to symbolize the faithful believers (who were martyred) on the day of Uhud
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Maine ek khwab mein dekha ke main ek talwaar hilata hoon aur uska phal toot jata hai, aur yeh Uhud ki jung ke din mominon ke jhele hue nuksaan ka pratik tha. Phir maine use phir hilaya, aur woh phir waisi hi ho gaee jaisi woh pahle thi, aur yeh (Mecca ki) Fatah ka pratik tha jise haasil karne mein Allah ne humari madad ki, aur sab mominon ki ekta ka bhi. Maine khwab mein gayen bhi dekhi, aur Allah jo bhi karta hai woh hamesha faaydamand hota hai. Woh gayen Uhud ki jung ke din shaheed hue sachche mominon ka pratik lagti thi."

e: Narrated Khabbab:We migrated with the Prophet (ﷺ) for Allah's Cause, so our reward became due with Allah. Some of us passed away (i.e. died) without enjoying anything from their reward, and one of them was Mus`ab bin `Umair who was killed (i.e. martyred) on the day of Uhud. He did not leave behind except a sheet of striped woolen cloth. If we covered his head with it, his feet became naked, and if we covered his feet with it, his head became naked. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to us, "Cover his head with it and put Idhkhir (i.e. a kind of grass) over his feet," or said, "Put some Idhkhir over his feet." But some of us have got their fruits ripened, and they are collecting them
hi: Khabbab (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Humne Nabi ke saath Allah ki khaatir hijrat ki, isliye humara ajr Allah ke paas due ho gaya. Humme se kuch is duniya se guzar gaye (yaani intiqal ho gaya) bina apne ajr se koee faayda uthae, aur unmein se ek Mus'ab bin Umair the jo Uhud ki jung ke din shaheed hue (yaani qatl kiye gaye). Unhone ek dhaaridaar ooni chaadar ke ilawa kuch nahi chhoda. Agar humne unka sar isse dhaka, unke paanv khule rah jate, aur agar humne unke paanv dhaae, unka sar khula rah jata. Nabi ne humse kaha, "Isse unka sar dhaako aur unke paanvon par kuch Idhkhir (yaani ek qisam ki ghaas) rakho," ya kaha, "unke paanvon par kuch Idhkhir daalo." Magar humme se kuch ne apne phal pak jate dekhe (is duniya mein) aur woh unhe jama kar rahe hain.

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "This is a mountain that loves us and is loved by us
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Yeh (Uhud) ek aisa pahad hai jo humse muhabbat karta hai aur jise hum muhabbat karte hain."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:When the mountain of Uhud appeared before Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) he said, "This IS a mountain that loves us and is loved by us. O, Allah! Abraham made Mecca a Sanctuary, and I have made Medina (i.e. the area between its two mountains) a Sanctuary as well
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Uhud pahad Allah ke Rasool ke saamne prakat hua, unhone kaha, "Yeh ek aisa pahad hai jo humse muhabbat karta hai aur jise hum muhabbat karte hain. Aye Allah! Ibrahim ne Mecca ko ek panah wali jagah banaya, aur maine bhi Madina (yaani uske do pahadon ke beech ka ilaka) ko panah wali jagah banaya hai."

e: Narrated `Uqba:One day the Prophet (ﷺ) went out and offered the (funeral) prayer for the people (i.e. martyrs) of Uhud as he used to offer a funeral prayer for any dead person, and then (after returning) he ascended the pulpit and said, "I am your predecessor before you, and I am a witness upon you, and I am looking at my Tank just now, and I have been given the keys of the treasures of the world (or the keys of the world). By Allah, I am not afraid that you will worship others besides Allah after me, but I am afraid that you will compete with each other for (the pleasures of) this world
hi: Uqba bataate hain: Ek din Nabi bahar gaye aur Uhud ke shahidon ki janaza namaz padhi jaisa woh kisi bhi murda shaks ki janaza namaz padhte the, aur phir (wapas aakar) mimbar par chadhe aur kaha, "Main tumhare liye pahle jane wala hoonga, aur main tumhare khilaf gawah hoonga, aur main abhi apna talab (yaani Al-Kauthar) dekh raha hoon, aur mujhe duniya ke khazanon ki (ya duniya ki) chaabiyaan di gaee hain. Allah ki qasam, mujhe dar nahi ke mere baad tum Allah ke saath doosron ki ibadat karoge, magar mujhe dar hai ke tum duniyavi cheezon ke liye ek-doosre se muqabla karoge."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) sent a Sariya of spies and appointed `Asim bin Thabit, the grandfather of `Asim bin `Umar bin Al-Khattab, as their leader. So they set out, and when they reached (a place) between 'Usfan and Mecca, they were mentioned to one of the branch tribes of Bani Hudhail called Lihyan. So, about one-hundred archers followed their traces till they (i.e. the archers) came to a journey station where they (i.e. `Asim and his companions) had encamped and found stones of dates they had brought as journey food from Medina. The archers said, "These are the dates of Medina," and followed their traces till they took them over. When `Asim and his companions were not able to go ahead, they went up a high place, and their pursuers encircled them and said, "You have a covenant and a promise that if you come down to us, we will not kill anyone of you." `Asim said, "As for me, I will never come down on the security of an infidel. O Allah! Inform Your Prophet about us." So they fought with them till they killed `Asim along with seven of his companions with arrows, and there remained Khubaib, Zaid and another man to whom they gave a promise and a covenant. So when the infidels gave them the covenant and promise, they came down. When they captured them, they opened the strings of their arrow bows and tied them with it. The third man who was with them said, "This is the first breach in the covenant," and refused to accompany them. They dragged him and tried to make him accompany them, but he refused, and they killed him. Then they proceeded on taking Khubaib and Zaid till they sold them in Mecca. The sons of Al-Harith bin `Amr bin Naufal bought Khubaib. It was Khubaib who had killed Al-Harith bin `Amr on the day of Badr. Khubaib stayed with them for a while as a captive till they decided unanimously to kill him. (At that time) Khubaib borrowed a razor from one of the daughters of Al- Harith to shave his pubic hair. She gave it to him. She said later on, "I was heedless of a little baby of mine, who moved towards Khubaib, and when it reached him, he put it on his thigh. When I saw it, I got scared so much that Khubaib noticed my distress while he was carrying the razor in his hand. He said 'Are you afraid that I will kill it? Allah willing, I will never do that,' " Later on she used to say, "I have never seen a captive better than Khubaib Once I saw him eating from a bunch of grapes although at that time no fruits were available at Mecca, and he was fettered with iron chains, and in fact, it was nothing but food bestowed upon him by Allah." So they took him out of the Sanctuary (of Mecca) to kill him. He said, "Allow me to offer a two-rak`at prayer." Then he went to them and said, "Had I not been afraid that you would think I was afraid of death, I would have prayed for a longer time." So it was Khubaib who first set the tradition of praying two rak`at before being executed. He then said, "O Allah! Count them one by one," and added, 'When I am being martyred as a Muslim, I do not care in what way I receive my death for Allah's Sake, because this death is in Allah's Cause. If He wishes, He will bless the cut limbs." Then `Uqba bin Al-Harith got up and martyred him. The narrator added: The Quraish (infidels) sent some people to `Asim in order to bring a part of his body so that his death might be known for certain, for `Asim had killed one of their chiefs on the day of Badr. But Allah sent a cloud of wasps which protected his body from their messengers who could not harm his body consequently
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne jaasoson ka ek dasta bheja aur Asim bin Thabit, Asim bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab ke dada, ko unka sardaar muqarrar kiya. Isliye woh chal pade, aur jab woh Usfan aur Mecca ke beech pahunche, unka zikar Hudhail qabile ki ek shaakha, Banu Lihyan, ke saamne hua. Isliye taquriban ek sau tirandaajon ne unka picha kiya jab tak woh (yaani tirandaaj) us jagah pahunche jahaan unhone (yaani Asim aur unke sathiyon ne) padaav daala tha aur wahaan unke khajoor ke gutliyaan paee jo woh Madina se khaane ke tor par laaye the.
