Tirandaajon ne kaha, "Yeh Madina ki khajoor hain," aur unka picha kiya jab tak woh unse aage nikal gaye. Jab Asim aur unke sathi aage nahi badh paye, woh ek oonchi jagah par chadhe, aur unka picha karne walon ne unhe gher liya aur kaha, "Tumhare paas ahad aur waada hai ke agar tum humare paas neeche aate ho, hum tum mein se kisi ko qatl nahi karenge." Asim ne kaha, "Jahaan tak mera sawal hai, main kabhi ek kaafir ki hifaazat mein neeche nahi aunga. Aye Allah! Apne Nabi ko humare baare mein soochit kar." Isliye unhone unse jung ki jab tak unhone Asim ko aur unke saat sathiyon ko teer se qatl kar diya, aur Khubaib, Zaid, aur ek aur shaks bache jinse unhone ahad aur waada kiya. Isliye jab kaafiron ne unhe waada aur ahad diya, woh neeche aae. Jab unhone unhe pakad liya, unhone apne teer-kamanon ki doriyaan kholi aur unse unhe baandha. Teesra shaks jo unke saath tha, ne kaha, "Yeh ahad todne ka pahla nishaan hai," aur unke saath jane se inkaar kiya. Unhone unhe ghaseeta aur unse jane ka aagrah kiya, magar usne inkaar kiya, aur unhone unhe qatl kar diya. Phir woh Khubaib aur Zaid ko lekar gaye jab tak unhone unhe Mecca mein bech diya. Al-Harith bin Amr bin Naufal ke beton ne Khubaib ko khareeda. Yeh Khubaib the jinhone Al-Harith bin Amr ko Badr ki jung ke din qatl kiya tha. Khubaib kuch waqt unke paas ek qaidi ke soorat mein raha jab tak unhone unhe qatl karne ka ekmat se faisla kiya. (Us waqt) Khubaib ne Al-Harith ki betiyon mein se ek se apne sharma-jagah ke baal sadaane ke liye ek ustra udhaar maanga. Unhone unhe woh de diya. Woh baad mein kahti thi, "Main apne ek chhote bachche ki taraf be-dhyaan thi jo Khubaib ki taraf badha, aur jab woh unke paas pahuncha, unhone use apni raan par bithaya. Jab maine yeh dekha, main itna daraee ke Khubaib ne mera dar mahsoos kiya jabke woh apne haath mein ustra pakde hue the. Unhone kaha, 'Kya tumhe dar hai main ise qatl kar dunga? Insha Allah, main aisa kabhi nahi karunga.'" Baad mein woh kahti thi, "Maine kabhi Khubaib se behtar koee qaidi nahi dekha. Ek baar maine unhe angoor ke ek guchhe se khate dekha, chahe us waqt Mecca mein koee phal maujood nahi tha, aur woh lohe ki zanjeeron mein jakde the, aur asal mein, yeh koee aur nahi balki khaana tha jo Allah ne unhe diya." Isliye woh unhe (yaani Mecca ki) mahafooz seema se bahar le gaye unhe qatl karne ke liye. Unhone kaha, "Mujhe do rakat namaz padhne dijiye." Phir woh unke paas gaye aur kaha, "Agar mujhe dar na hota ke tum sochte ke main betaab hoon, main aur namaz padhta." Isliye Khubaib hi the jinhone do rakat padhne ki riwaj shuru ki isse pahle ke unhe fasi di jaye. Unhone phir kaha, "Aye Allah! Unhe ek-ek karke gino," aur joda, "Chunke main ek Musalman ke soorat mein shaheed ho raha hoon, mujhe parwaah nahi kis tarike se meri maut hoti hai, Allah ki khaatir, kyunke yeh Allah ki raah mein hai. Agar Woh chaahe, Woh mere kate hue jism ke angon ko barkat dega." Phir Uqba bin Al-Harith uthe aur unhe shaheed kar diya. Raawi ne joda: Quraish ne kuch logon ko Asim ke paas unke jism ka ek hissa lane ke liye bheja taaki unki maut nishchit soorat se jaani ja sake, kyunke Asim ne Badr ki jung ke din unke ek sardaar ko qatl kiya tha. Magar Allah ne bhadon (yaani wasps) ka ek jhund bheja jinhone unke jism ki hifaazat ki unke sandesh-vahakon se, jo unke jism ko koee bhi nuksaan pahunchane mein asamartha rahe.

e: Narrated Jabir:The person who killed Khubaib was Abu Sirwa' (i.e. `Uqba bin Al-Harith)
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jinhone Khubaib ko qatl kiya woh Abu Sirwa (yaani Uqba bin Al-Harith) the.

e: Narrated `Abdul `Aziz:Anas said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) sent seventy men, called Al-Qurra 'for some purpose. The two groups of Bani Sulaim called Ri'l and Dhakwan, appeared to them near a well called Bir Ma'una. The people (i.e. Al- Qurra) said, 'By Allah, we have not come to harm you, but we are passing by you on our way to do something for the Prophet.' But (the infidels) killed them. The Prophet (ﷺ) therefore invoked evil upon them for a month during the morning prayer. That was the beginning of Al Qunut and we used not to say Qunut before that." A man asked Anas about Al-Qunut, "Is it to be said after the Bowing (in the prayer) or after finishing the Recitation (i.e. before Bowing)?" Anas replied, "No, but (it is to be said) after finishing the Recitation
hi: Abdul-Aziz bataate hain: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Nabi ne sattar logon ko bheja, jinhe Al-Qurra kaha jata tha, kisi khaas maksad ke liye. Bani Sulaim ke do giroh, Ril aur Dhakwan, unse Bir Ma'una naam ke ek kue ke paas mile. Logon (yaani Al-Qurra) ne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, hum tumhe nuksaan pahunchane nahi aae hain, balki hum Nabi ke liye kuch karne ja rahe hain, aur tumhare yahaan se guzar rahe hain.' Magar (kaafiron) ne unhe qatl kar diya. Isliye Nabi ne ek mahine tak subah ki namaz mein unke khilaf bad-dua ki. Yehi Al-Qunut ki shuruvaat thi, aur usse pahle hum Qunut nahi kahte the." Ek shaks ne Anas se Al-Qunut ke baare mein pucha, "Kya yeh ruku ke baad kaha jata hai ya tilaawat khatm karne ke baad (yaani ruku se pahle)?" Anas ne jawab diya, "Nahi, balki (yeh) tilaawat khatm karne ke baad (kaha jata hai)."

e: Narrated Anas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said Al-Qunut for one month after the posture of Bowing, invoking evil upon some 'Arab tribes
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne ek mahine tak ruku ke baad Al-Qunut kaha, kuch Arab qabilon ke khilaf bad-dua karte huye.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:(The tribes of) Ril, Dhakwan, 'Usaiya and Bani Lihyan asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to provide them with some men to support them against their enemy. He therefore provided them with seventy men from the Ansar whom we used to call Al-Qurra' in their lifetime. They used to collect wood by daytime and pray at night. When they were at the well of Ma'una, the infidels killed them by betraying them. When this news reached the Prophet (ﷺ) , he said Al-Qunut for one month In the morning prayer, invoking evil upon some of the 'Arab tribes, upon Ril, Dhakwan, 'Usaiya and Bani Lihyan. We used to read a verse of the Qur'an revealed in their connection, but later the verse was cancelled. It was: "convey to our people on our behalf the information that we have met our Lord, and He is pleased with us, and has made us pleased." (Anas bin Malik added:) Allah's Prophet said Qunut for one month in the morning prayer, invoking evil upon some of the 'Arab tribes (namely), Ril, Dhakwan, Usaiya, and Bani Lihyan. (Anas added:) Those seventy Ansari men were killed at the well of Mauna
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: (Qabile) Ril, Dhakwan, Usaiya, aur Bani Lihyan ne Allah ke Rasool se apne dushman ke khilaf kuch logon ki madad maangi. Isliye unhone unhe Ansaar mein se sattar log diye jinhe hum unki zindagi mein Al-Qurra kahte the. Woh din mein lakdi jama karte aur raat ko namaz padhte. Jab woh Ma'una ke kue ke paas pahunche, kaafiron ne dhoka dekar unhe qatl kiya. Jab yeh khabar Nabi tak pahunchi, unhone ek mahine tak subah ki namaz mein Al-Qunut kaha, kuch Arab qabilon ke khilaf bad-dua karte huye, Ril, Dhakwan, Usaiya, aur Bani Lihyan ke khilaf. Hum Quran ki ek Ayat padhte the jo unke silsile mein nazil huee thi, magar baad mein yeh Ayat radd kar di gaee. Yeh yeh thi: "Humare logon tak humari taraf se pahunchao ke humein apne Rab se mile aur woh humse khush hai aur usne humein khush kiya hai." (Anas bin Malik ne joda:) Allah ke Nabi ne ek mahine tak subah ki namaz mein Qunut kaha, kuch Arab qabilon ke khilaf bad-dua karte huye, yaani Ril, Dhakwan, Usaiya, aur Bani Lihyan. (Anas ne joda:) Woh sattar Ansaari log Ma'una ke kue ke paas qatl kiye gaye.

e: Narrated Anas:That the Prophet (ﷺ) sent his uncle, the brother of Um Sulaim at the head of seventy riders. The chief of the pagans, 'Amir bin at-Tufail proposed three suggestions (to the Prophet (ﷺ) ) saying, "Choose one of three alternatives: (1) that the bedouins will be under your command and the townspeople will be under my command; (2) or that I will be your successor, (3) or otherwise I will attack you with two thousand from Bani Ghatafan." But 'Amir was infected with plague in the House of Um so-and-so. He said, "Shall I stay in the house of a lady from the family of so-and-so after having a (swelled) gland like that she-camel? Get me my horse." So he died on the back of his horse. Then Haram, the brother of Um Sulaim and a lame man along with another man from so-and-so (tribe) went towards the pagans (i.e. the tribe of 'Amir). Haram said (to his companions), "Stay near to me, for I will go to them. If they (i.e. infidels) should give me protection, you will be near to me, and if they should kill me, then you should go back to your companions. Then Haram went to them and said, "Will you give me protection so as to convey the message of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ?" So, he started talking to them' but they signalled to a man (to kill him) and he went behind him and stabbed him (with a spear). He (i.e. Haram) said, "Allahu Akbar! I have succeeded, by the Lord of the Ka`ba!" The companion of Haram was pursued by the infidels, and then they (i.e. Haram's companions) were all killed except the lame man who was at the top of a mountain. Then Allah revealed to us a verse that was among the cancelled ones later on. It was: 'We have met our Lord and He is pleased with us and has made us pleased.' (After this event) the Prophet (ﷺ) invoked evil on the infidels every morning for 30 days. He invoked evil upon the (tribes of) Ril, Dhakwan, Bani Lihyan and Usaiya who disobeyed Allah and His Apostle
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne apne chacha, Um Sulaim ke bhai, ko sattar sawaron ke saath bheja. Mushrikon ke sardaar, Amir bin At-Tufail, ne teen sujhaav diye (Nabi se kehte huye): "Teen sujhaavon mein se ek chuniye: (1) dehati log aapke adhin honge aur shehari log mere adhin; (2) ya main aapka jaanshin banunga; (3) warna main aappar Banu Ghatafan se do hazaar logon ke saath hamla karunga." Magar Amir ko talaee ho gaee Um falaan-falaan ke ghar mein. Unhone kaha, "Kya main falaan pariwara ki ek mahilla ke ghar mein rahoon aisi (soojee hui) granthi ke saath jaise us untni ki hoti hai? Mera ghoda lao." Isliye unka intiqal apne ghode ki peeth par hi ho gaya. Phir Haram, Um Sulaim ke bhai, ek langde shaks ke saath, aur ek aur shaks (falaan qabile se), mushrikon (yaani Amir ki qaum) ki taraf gaye. Haram ne (apne sathiyon se) kaha, "Mere qareeb raho, kyunke main unke paas jaunga. Agar woh mujhe panah dete hain, tum mere qareeb hoge, aur agar woh mujhe qatl karte hain, phir tumhe apne sathiyon ke paas wapas jana chahiye." Phir Haram unke paas gaye aur kaha, "Kya aap mujhe panah denge taaki main Allah ke Rasool ka paighaam pahunchan sakoon?" Isliye woh unse baat karne lage, magar unhone ek shaks ko ishara kiya (unhe qatl karne ke liye) aur woh unke peeche gaya aur unhe (ek bhaale se) chubhaya. Unhone (yaani Haram ne) kaha, "Allahu Akbar! Ka'ba ke Rab ki qasam, main kaamyaab hua!" Haram ke sathi ka picha kaafiron ne kiya, aur phir woh (yaani Haram ke sathi) sab qatl kiye gaye siwaye us langde shaks ke jo ek pahad ki choti par tha. Phir Allah ne humare liye ek Ayat naazil ki jo baad mein radd kar di gaee. Yeh thi: 'Hum apne Rab se mile hain aur woh humse khush hai aur usne humein khush kiya hai.' (Is ghatna ke baad) Nabi ne tees din tak har subah kaafiron ke khilaf bad-dua ki. Unhone (qabile) Ril, Dhakwan, Bani Lihyan, aur Usaiya ke khilaf bad-dua ki, jinhone Allah aur uske Rasool ki na-farmani ki.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:That when Haram bin Milhan, his uncle was stabbed on the day of Bir Ma'una he sprinkled his blood over his face and his head this way and then said, "I have succeeded, by the Lord of the Ka`ba
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab unke chacha, Haram bin Milhan, Bir Ma'una ke din chubhaye gaye (bhaale se), unhone apna khoon apne chehre aur sar par isi tarah chhidkaya aur kaha, "Ka'ba ke Rab ki qasam, main kaamyaab hua!"

e: Narrated `Aisha:Abu Bakr asked the Prophet (ﷺ) to allow him to go out (of Mecca) when he was greatly annoyed (by the infidels). But the Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, ''Wait." Abu Bakr said, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Do you hope that you will be allowed (to migrate)?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, "I hope so." So Abu Bakr waited for him till one day Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came at noon time and addressed him saying "Let whoever is present with you, now leave you." Abu Bakr said, "None is present but my two daughters." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Have you noticed that I have been allowed to go out (to migrate)?" Abu Bakr said, "O Allah's Apostle, I would like to accompany you." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You will accompany me." Abu Bakr said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have got two she-camels which I had prepared and kept ready for (our) going out." So he gave one of the two (she-camels) to the Prophet (ﷺ) and it was Al-Jad`a . They both rode and proceeded till they reached the Cave at the mountain of Thaur where they hid themselves. Amir bin Fuhaira was the slave of `Abdullah bin at-Tufail bin Sakhbara `Aisha's brother from her mother's side. Abu Bakr had a milch she-camel. Amir used to go with it (i.e. the milch she-camel) in the afternoon and come back to them before noon by setting out towards them in the early morning when it was still dark and then he would take it to the pasture so that none of the shepherds would be aware of his job. When the Prophet (and Abu Bakr) went away (from the Cave), he (i.e. 'Amir) too went along with them and they both used to make him ride at the back of their camels in turns till they reached Medina. 'Amir bin Fuhaira was martyred on the day of Bir Ma'una. Narrated `Urwa: When those (Muslims) at Bir Ma'una were martyred and `Amr bin Umaiya Ad- Damri was taken prisoner, 'Amir bin at-Tufail, pointing at a killed person, asked `Amr, "Who is this?" `Amr bin Umaiya said to him, "He is 'Amir bin Fuhaira." 'Amir bin at-Tufail said, "I saw him lifted to the sky after he was killed till I saw the sky between him and the earth, and then he was brought down upon the earth. Then the news of the killed Muslims reached the Prophet (ﷺ) and he announced the news of their death saying, "Your companions (of Bir Ma'una) have been killed, and they have asked their Lord saying, 'O our Lord! Inform our brothers about us as we are pleased with You and You are pleased with us." So Allah informed them (i.e. the Prophet (ﷺ) and his companions) about them (i.e. martyrs of Bir Mauna). On that day, `Urwa bin Asma bin As-Salt who was one of them, was killed, and `Urwa (bin Az-Zubair) was named after `Urwa bin Asma and Mundhir (bin Az-Zubair) was named after Mundhir bin `Amr (who had also been martyred on that day)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Abu Bakr ne Nabi se (Mecca se) bahar jane ki ijazat maangi jab unhe (yaani Nabi ko) kaafiron dwaara bahut zyada dukh diya ja raha tha. Magar Nabi ne unse kaha, "Intezaar karo." Abu Bakr ne kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Kya aap ummeed karte hain ke aapko ijazat milegi (hijrat ki)?" Allah ke Rasool ne jawab diya, "Mujhe aisi ummeed hai." Isliye Abu Bakr unke liye intezaar karte rahe jab tak ek din Allah ke Rasool dopahar ke waqt aaye aur unse kaha, "Jo bhi is waqt tumhare saath hai, unhe jane do." Abu Bakr ne kaha, "Koee maujood nahi siwaye meri do betiyon ke." Nabi ne kaha, "Kya tumne gaur kiya ke mujhe (hijrat ke liye) bahar jane ki ijazat mil gaee hai?" Abu Bakr ne kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Main aapke saath ana chahta hoon." Nabi ne kaha, "Tum mere saath jaoge." Abu Bakr ne kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Mere paas do untniyaan hain jo maine taiyaar karke is (safar) ke liye rakhi hain." Isliye unhonne unmein se ek Nabi ko di, aur woh Al-Jad'a ka naam thi. Donon sawar hue aur chal pade jab tak woh Thaur pahad ki gufa tak pahunche jahaan woh chhup gaye. Amir bin Fuhaira, Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin at-Tufail bin Sakhbara ka gulaam the, jo Ayesha ke mama ki taraf ke bhai the. Abu Bakr ke paas ek doodh dene wali untni thi. Amir use dopahar mein le jate aur unke paas subah se pahle wapas aa jate, subah aane ke liye andhere mein hi nikalkar, phir use charaagah mein le jate taaki koee bhi charwaha unki gatividhi se avgat na ho. Jab Nabi (aur Abu Bakr) chale gaye (gufa se), woh (yaani Amir) bhi unke saath gaye, aur woh unhe baari-baari apni unton par sawar karate jab tak woh Madina pahunche. Amir bin Fuhaira Bir Ma'una ki jung ke din shaheed hue. Urwa bataate hain: Jab (Musalman) Bir Ma'una mein shaheed hue aur Amr bin Umaiya Ad-Damri ko qaidi banaya gaya, Amir bin at-Tufail ne ek qatl kiye hue shaks ki taraf ishara karte huye Amr se pucha, "Yeh kaun hai?" Amr bin Umaiya ne unse kaha, "Yeh Amir bin Fuhaira hain." Amir bin at-Tufail ne kaha, "Maine unhe qatl kiye jane ke baad aasman ki taraf uthte dekha jab tak maine aasman aur zameen ke beech aasman dekha, aur phir woh zameen par wapas laaye gaye." Phir qatl kiye gaye Musalmanon ki khabar Nabi tak pahunchi aur unhone unki maut ki khabar sunaee, kehte huye, "Tumhare sathi (yaani Bir Ma'una ke) qatl kiye ja chuke hain, aur unhone apne Rab se guzarish ki hai, 'Aye humare Rab! Humare bhaiyon ko humare baare mein bata, kyunke hum Tujhse khush hain aur Tu humse khush hai.'" Isliye Allah ne unhe (yaani Nabi aur unke sahaba ko) unke baare mein bataya. Us din, Urwa bin Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) bin As-Salt, jo unmein se ek the, qatl hue, aur Urwa (bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ)) ka naam Urwa bin Asma ke naam par rakha gaya, aur Mundhir (bin Az-Zubair) ka naam Mundhir bin Amr ke naam par (jo us din bhi shaheed hue the).

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said Al-Qunut after Bowing (i.e. Ar-Ruku') for one month, invoking evil upon (the tribes of) Ril and Dhakwan. He used to say, "Usaiya disobeyed Allah and His Apostle
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne ek mahine tak ruku ke baad Al-Qunut kaha, (qabile) Ril aur Dhakwan ke khilaf bad-dua karte huye. Woh kahte the, "Usaiya ne Allah aur uske Rasool ki na-farmani ki."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) invoked evil upon those (people) who killed his companions at Bir Mauna for 30 days (in the morning prayer). He invoked evil upon (tribes of) Ril, Lihyan and Usaiya who disobeyed Allah and His Apostle. Allah revealed a Qur'anic Verse to His Prophet regarding those who had been killed, i.e. the Muslims killed at Bir Ma'una, and we recited the Verse till later it was cancelled. (The Verse was:) 'Inform our people that we have met our Lord, and He is pleased with us, and we are pleased with Him
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne unke liye jinhone unke sathiyon ko Bir Ma'una mein qatl kiya, tees din (subah ki namaz mein) bad-dua ki. Unhone Ril, Lihyan, aur Usaiya (qabilon) ke khilaf bad-dua ki jinhone Allah aur uske Rasool ki na-farmani ki. Allah ne apne Nabi ko un logon ke baare mein ek Quranic Ayat naazil ki jo qatl kiye gaye the, yaani Bir Ma'una mein qatl kiye gaye Musalman, aur hum us Ayat ko padhte rahe jab tak baad mein ise radd kar diya gaya. (Ayat yeh thi:) "Humare logon ko batao ke hum apne Rab se mile hain, aur woh humse khush hai, aur hum usse khush hain."

e: Narrated `Asim Al-Ahwal:I asked Anas bin Malik regarding Al-Qunut during the prayer. Anas replied, "Yes (Al-Qunut was said by the Prophet (ﷺ) in the prayer)." I said, "Is it before Bowing or after Bowing?" Anas replied, "(It was said) before (Bowing)." I said, "So-and-so informed me that you told him that it was said after Bowing." Anas replied, "He was mistaken, for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said Al-Qunut after Bowing for one month. The Prophet (ﷺ) had sent some people called Al-Qurra who were seventy in number, to some pagan people who had concluded a peace treaty with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . But those who had concluded the treaty with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) violated the treaty (and martyred all the seventy men). So Allah's Apostle said Al-Qunut after Bowing (in the prayer) for one month, invoking evil upon them
hi: Asim Al-Ahwal bataate hain: Maine Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se Al-Qunut ke baare mein namaz mein pucha. Anas ne jawab diya, "Haan (Al-Qunut Nabi dwaara namaz mein kaha jata tha)." Maine pucha, "Kya yeh ruku se pahle hai ya ruku ke baad?" Anas ne jawab diya, "(Yeh) pahle (ruku se) kaha jata tha." Maine kaha, "Falaan-falaan ne mujhe bataya ke aapne unse kaha ke yeh ruku ke baad kaha jata hai." Anas ne jawab diya, "Woh galat hain, kyunke Allah ke Rasool ne ek mahine tak ruku ke baad Al-Qunut kaha. Nabi ne kuch logon ko, jinhe Al-Qurra kaha jata tha, sattar ki tadaad mein, kuch mushrik logon ke paas bheja tha jinhone Allah ke Rasool ke saath sulha ka muahida kiya tha. Magar jinhone Allah ke Rasool ke saath muahida kiya tha unhone muahida tod diya (aur sattar logon ko shaheed kar diya). Isliye Allah ke Rasool ne unke khilaf ek mahine tak (namaz mein) ruku ke baad Al-Qunut kaha."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:That the Prophet (ﷺ) inspected him on the day of Uhud while he was fourteen years old, and the Prophet (ﷺ) did not allow him to take part in the battle. He was inspected again by the Prophet (ﷺ) on the day of Al- Khandaq (i.e. battle of the Trench) while he was fifteen years old, and the Prophet (ﷺ) allowed him to take Part in the battle
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne unhe Uhud ki jung ke din unke umr ki jaanch ki jabke woh chaudah saal ke the, aur Nabi ne unhe jung mein shaamil hone ki ijazat nahi di. Unhe phir Nabi ne Al-Khandaq (yaani khaee ki jung) ke din phir jaancha jabke woh pandrah saal ke the, aur Nabi ne unhe jung mein shaamil hone ki ijazat di.

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:We were with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the Trench, and some were digging the trench while we were carrying the earth on our shoulders. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'O Allah! There is no life except the life of the Hereafter, so please forgive the Emigrants and the Ansar
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Allah ke Rasool ke saath Al-Khandaq (khaee) mein the, aur kuch log khaee khod rahe the jabke hum apni kandhon par mitti le ja rahe the. Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Aye Allah! Sirf Aakhirat ki zindagi hi asli zindagi hai, isliye kripya Muhajir aur Ansaar ko maaf kariye."

e: Narrated Anas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went out towards the Khandaq (i.e. Trench) and saw the Emigrants and the Ansar digging the trench in the cold morning. They had no slaves to do that (work) for them. When the Prophet saw their hardship and hunger, he said, 'O Allah! The real life is the life of the Hereafter, so please forgive Ansar and the Emigrants." They said in reply to him, "We are those who have given the Pledge of allegiance to Muhammad for to observe Jihad as long as we live
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool Al-Khandaq (khaee) ki taraf gaye aur dekha Muhajir aur Ansaar thandi wali subah mein khaee khod rahe the. Unke paas is kaam ke liye koee gulaam nahi the (ise unke liye karne ke liye). Jab Nabi ne unki mushkil aur bhookh dekhi, unhone kaha, "Aye Allah! Asli zindagi Aakhirat ki zindagi hai, isliye kripya Ansaar aur Muhajir ko maaf kariye." Unhone unki baat ke jawab mein kaha, "Hum woh log hain jinhone Muhammad ko Jihad ke liye bai'at di hai jab tak hum zinda hain."

e: Narrated Anas:Al-Muhajirun (i.e. the Emigrants) and the Ansar were digging the trench around Medina and were carrying the earth on their backs while saying, "We are those who have given the pledge of allegiance to Muhammad for Islam as long as we live." The Prophet (ﷺ) said in reply to their saying, "O Allah! There is no goodness except the goodness of the Hereafter; so please grant Your Blessing to the Ansar and the Emigrants." The people used to bring a handful of barley, and a meal used to be prepared thereof by cooking it with a cooking material (i.e. oil, fat and butter having a change in color and smell) and it used to be presented to the people (i.e. workers) who were hungry, and it used to stick to their throats and had a nasty smell
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Muhajir aur Ansaar Madina ke aas-paas khaee khod rahe the aur mitti apni peeth par lekar ja rahe the, yeh kahte huye, "Hum woh log hain jinhone Muhammad ko Islam ke liye bai'at di hai jab tak hum zinda hain." Nabi ne unki baat ke jawab mein kaha, "Aye Allah! Aakhirat ki achhaee ke siwa koee achhaee nahi hai; isliye kripya Ansaar aur Muhajir ko apni barkat dijiye." Log mutthi bhar jau laate, aur usse ek khaana taiyaar kiya jata, kuch pakane ki cheez (yaani ghi, tail) milakar jismein rang aur khushbu badal jati, aur ise bhooke logon (yaani mazdoor) ko pesh kiya jata, aur yeh unke gale mein chipakta aur usmein ek badboodaar khushbu hoti.

e: Narrated Jabir:We were digging (the trench) on the day of (Al-Khandaq ( i.e. Trench )) and we came across a big solid rock. We went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "Here is a rock appearing across the trench." He said, "I am coming down." Then he got up, and a stone was tied to his belly for we had not eaten anything for three days. So the Prophet (ﷺ) took the spade and struck the big solid rock and it became like sand. I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Allow me to go home." (When the Prophet (ﷺ) allowed me) I said to my wife, "I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) in a state that I cannot treat lightly. Have you got something (for him to eat?" She replied, "I have barley and a she goat." So I slaughtered the she-kid and she ground the barley; then we put the meat in the earthenware cooking pot. Then I came to the Prophet (ﷺ) when the dough had become soft and fermented and (the meat in) the pot over the stone trivet had nearly been well-cooked, and said, "I have got a little food prepared, so get up O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), you and one or two men along with you (for the food)." The Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "How much is that food?" I told him about it. He said, "It is abundant and good. Tell your wife not to remove the earthenware pot from the fire and not to take out any bread from the oven till I reach there." Then he said (to all his companions), "Get up." So the Muhajirin (i.e. Emigrants) and the Ansar got up. When I came to my wife, I said, "Allah's Mercy be upon you! The Prophet came along with the Muhajirin and the Ansar and those who were present with them." She said, "Did the Prophet (ﷺ) ask you (how much food you had)?" I replied, "Yes." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Enter and do not throng." The Prophet (ﷺ) started cutting the bread (into pieces) and put the cooked meat over it. He covered the earthenware pot and the oven whenever he took something out of them. He would give the food to his companions and take the meat out of the pot. He went on cutting the bread and scooping the meat (for his companions) till they all ate their fill, and even then, some food remained. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said (to my wife), "Eat and present to others as the people are struck with hunger
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum khod rahe the (khaee) Al-Khandaq ke din, aur humein ek bada thos patthar mila. Hum Nabi ke paas gaye aur kaha, "Yahaan khaee ke aar-paar ek patthar dikh raha hai." Unhone kaha, "Main neeche aa raha hoon." Phir woh uthe, aur ek pathar unke pet se baandha hua tha kyunke humne teen din se kuch nahi khaya tha. Isliye Nabi ne ek phaavda liya aur us bade thos pathar par vaar kiya, aur woh ret jaisa ban gaya. Maine kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe ghar jane ki ijazat dijiye." (Jab Nabi ne mujhe ijazat di) maine apni biwi se kaha, "Maine Nabi ko aisi haalat mein dekha hai jise main haalka nahi le sakta. Kya tumhare paas kuch (unke liye khaane ke liye) hai?" Unhone jawab diya, "Mere paas jau aur ek bakri hai." Isliye maine bakri ko zabah kiya aur unhone jau pisi; phir humne gosht ek mitti ke bartan mein daala. Phir main Nabi ke paas aaya jab aata khameera ho chuka tha aur bartan ke gosht (partharon ke chulhe par) taquriban pak chuka tha, aur kaha, "Mere paas kuch khaana taiyaar hai, isliye utheeye, Ya Allah ke Rasool, aap aur ek ya do log aapke saath (khaane ke liye)." Nabi ne pucha, "Kitna khaana hai?" Maine unhe bataya. Unhone kaha, "Yeh bahut aur achha hai. Apni biwi ko kaho mitti ka bartan aag se na utaare aur tandoor se roti bahar na nikale jab tak main wahaan pahunchta hoon." Phir unhone kaha (apne sab sahaba se), "Utho." Isliye Muhajir aur Ansaar uthe. Jab main apni biwi ke paas gaya, maine kaha, "Allah ki rehmat tumpar ho! Nabi Muhajir aur Ansaar ke saath aa rahe hain, aur jo unke saath maujood the." Unhone pucha, "Kya Nabi ne tumse pucha (kitna khaana hai)?" Maine jawab diya, "Haan." Phir Nabi ne kaha, "Andar jao aur bheed mat karo." Nabi roti kaatna (tukdon mein) shuru kiya aur paka hua gosht uske oopar rakha. Woh mitti ka bartan aur tandoor dhaankte the jab bhi woh unse kuch nikalte, aur sahaba ko khaana dete aur bartan se gosht nikalte. Woh roti kaatte aur gosht nikalte rahe (apne sahaba ke liye) jab tak sab ne pet bharkar khaya, aur phir bhi kuch khaana bacha raha. Phir Nabi ne (meri biwi se) kaha, "Ab khud khaao aur doosron ko do, kyunke log bhookh se pareshaan hain."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:When the Trench was dug, I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) in the state of severe hunger. So I returned to my wife and said, "Have you got anything (to eat), for I have seen Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in a state of severe hunger." She brought out for me, a bag containing one Sa of barley, and we had a domestic she animal (i.e. a kid) which I slaughtered then, and my wife ground the barley and she finished at the time I finished my job (i.e. slaughtering the kid). Then I cut the meat into pieces and put it in an earthenware (cooking) pot, and returned to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . My wife said, "Do not disgrace me in front of Allah's Apostle and those who are with him." So I went to him and said to him secretly, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have slaughtered a she-animal (i.e. kid) of ours, and we have ground a Sa of barley which was with us. So please come, you and another person along with you." The Prophet (ﷺ) raised his voice and said, "O people of Trench ! Jabir has prepared a meal so let us go." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me, "Don't put down your earthenware meat pot (from the fireplace) or bake your dough till I come." So I came (to my house) and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) too, came, proceeding before the people. When I came to my wife, she said, "May Allah do so-and-so to you." I said, "I have told the Prophet (ﷺ) of what you said." Then she brought out to him (i.e. the Prophet (ﷺ) the dough, and he spat in it and invoked for Allah's Blessings in it. Then he proceeded towards our earthenware meat-pot and spat in it and invoked for Allah's Blessings in it. Then he said (to my wife). Call a lady-baker to bake along with you and keep on taking out scoops from your earthenware meat-pot, and do not put it down from its fireplace." They were onethousand (who took their meals), and by Allah they all ate, and when they left the food and went away, our earthenware pot was still bubbling (full of meat) as if it had not decreased, and our dough was still being baked as if nothing had been taken from it
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Khaee khodi ja rahi thi, maine Nabi ko sakht bhookh ki haalat mein dekha. Isliye main apni biwi ke paas wapas gaya aur kaha, "Kya tumhare paas kuch (khaane ke liye) hai, kyunke maine Allah ke Rasool ko sakht bhookh ki haalat mein dekha hai." Unhone ek Sa jau bhara hua ek thaila nikala, aur humare paas ek paaltu janwar tha (yaani ek bakri) jise maine tab zabah kiya, aur meri biwi ne jau pisi aur unhone usi waqt khatm ki jab maine apna kaam (yaani zabah karna) khatm kiya. Phir maine gosht ke tukde kate aur unhe ek mitti ke (khaana pakane ke) bartan mein daale, aur Allah ke Rasool ke paas wapas gaya. Meri biwi ne kaha, "Mujhe Allah ke Rasool aur unke saath ke logon ke saamne apman mat karo." Isliye main unke paas gaya aur unse aahiste se kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Maine apni ek paaltu janwar (yaani bakri) zabah ki hai, aur humare paas jau ka jo ek Sa tha use bhi hamne pisa hai. Isliye kripya aiye, aap aur ek doosra shaks aapke saath." Nabi ne apni aawaaz buland ki aur kaha, "Aye khaee ke logo! Jabir ne khaana taiyaar kiya hai, isliye chalo." Allah ke Rasool ne mujhse kaha, "Apna mitti ka gosht ka bartan (chulhe se) neeche mat rakhna ya apni roti tandoor mein mat pakaana jab tak main wahaan na pahunch jaaunga." Isliye main (apne ghar) aaya, aur Allah ke Rasool bhi aaye, logon se pahle chalte hue. Jab main apni biwi ke paas pahuncha, unhone kaha, "Allah tumse aisa-aisa kare (yaani daanta)." Maine kaha, "Maine Nabi ko jo tumne kaha woh bata diya." Phir unhonne unke (yaani Nabi ke) saamne aata pesh kiya, aur Nabi ne usmein thooka aur usmein barkat ke liye Allah se dua ki. Phir woh humare mitti ke gosht wale bartan ki taraf gaye aur usmein bhi thooka aur usmein barkat ke liye Allah se dua ki. Phir unhone kaha (meri biwi se), "Ek roti banane wali aurat ko bulao jo tumhare saath roti banane mein madad kare, aur apne mitti ke bartan se scoop nikalte raho, ise (chulhe se) neeche mat rakhna." Woh (khaane wale) ek hazaar the, aur Allah ki qasam, sab ne khaya, aur jab woh khaana chhodkar chale gaye, humara mitti ka bartan abhi bhi ubal raha tha mano usmein kuch kam nahi hua, aur humari roti abhi bhi banaee ja rahi thi mano usmein se kuch liya hi nahi gaya.

e: Narrated `Aisha:As regards the following Qur'anic Verse:-- "When they came on you from above and from below you (from east and west of the valley) and when the eyes grew wild and the hearts reached up to the throats....." (33.10) That happened on the day of Al-Khandaq (i.e. Trench)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Is Quranic Ayat ke baare mein: "Jab woh tum par oopar aur neeche se aaye (yaani waadi ke purab aur pashchim se), aur jab aankhen hairat se phailne lagi aur dil gale tak pahunch gaye..." (33:10) Yeh Al-Khandaq (khaee) ki jung ke din hua tha.

e: Narrated Al-Bara:The Prophet (ﷺ) was carrying earth on the day of Al-Khandaq till his `Abdomen was fully covered with dust, and he was saying, "By Allah, without Allah we would not have been guided, neither would we have given in charity, nor would we have prayed. So (O Allah), please send Sakina (i.e. calmness) upon us, and make our feet firm if we meet the enemy as the enemy have rebelled against us, and if they intend affliction, (i.e. want to frighten us and fight against us then we would not flee but withstand them)." The Prophet (ﷺ) used to raise his voice saying, "Abaina! Abaina! (i.e. would not, we would not)
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Nabi Al-Khandaq ke din mitti le ja rahe the jab tak unka pet dhool se poora dhaank gaya, aur woh kah rahe the, "Allah ki qasam, Allah ke bina humein hidaayat nahi milti, na humne daan diya hota na namaz padhi hoti. Isliye (Aye Allah), kripya humpar Sakina (yaani shaanti) bhej, aur agar hum dushman se milen to humare paanv mazboot kar, kyunke dushman ne humare khilaf baghaawat ki hai, aur agar woh takleef pahunchana chahte hain (yaani humein daraana aur humse jung karna chahte hain, to hum bhaagenge nahi balki unka saamna karenge)." Nabi apni aawaaz buland karte huye kahte, "Abaina! Abaina! (yaani hum nahi bhaagenge, hum nahi bhaagenge!)"

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I have been made victorious by As-Saba (i.e. an easterly wind) and the Ad nation was destroyed by Ad-Dabur (i.e. a westerly wind)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Mujhe As-Saba (yaani ek purvi hawa) ke zariye fatah di gaee hai, aur Aad qaum ko Ad-Dabur (yaani ek pashchimi hawa) ne barbaad kiya."

e: Narrated Al-Bara:When it was the day of Al-Ahzab (i.e. the clans) and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) dug the trench, I saw him carrying earth out of the trench till dust made the skin of his `Abdomen out of my sight and he was a hairy man. I heard him reciting the poetic verses composed by Ibn Rawaha while he was carrying the earth, "O Allah! Without You we would not have been guided, nor would we have given in charity, nor would we have prayed. So, (O Allah), please send Sakina (i.e. calmness) upon us and make our feet firm if we meet the enemy, as they have rebelled against us. And if they intend affliction (i.e. want to frighten us, and fight against us) then we would not (flee but withstand them)." The Prophet (ﷺ) would then prolong his voice at the last words
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Jab Al-Ahzab (yaani (mushrikon ke) giroh) ka din aaya aur Allah ke Rasool ne khaee khodi, maine unhe khaee se mitti nikalte dekha jab tak dhool ne unke pet ki chamda mujhse chhupa di, aur woh baal wale shaks the. Maine unhe Ibn Rawaha dwaara likhi kavita padhte suna jabke woh mitti le ja rahe the, "Aye Allah! Tere bina humein hidaayat nahi milti, na humne daan diya hota, na namaz padhi hoti. Isliye (Aye Allah), kripya humpar Sakina (yaani shaanti) bhej aur humare paanv mazboot kar agar hum dushman se milen, kyunke unhone humare khilaf baghaavat ki hai. Aur agar woh takleef pahunchana chahte hain (yaani humein daraana aur humse jung karna chahte hain to hum) nahi (bhaagenge, balki unka saamna karenge)." Nabi phir aakhri alfaaz par apni aawaaz lambi karte the.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The first day (i.e. Ghazwa) I participated in, was the day of Al-Khandaq (i.e. Trench)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Pahli Ghazwa jismein maine hissa liya, woh Al-Khandaq (khaee) ka din tha.

e: Narrated `Ikrima bin Khalid:Ibn `Umar said, "I went to Hafsa while water was dribbling from her twined braids. I said, 'The condition of the people is as you see, and no authority has been given to me.' Hafsa said, (to me), 'Go to them, and as they (i.e. the people) are waiting for you, and I am afraid your absence from them will produce division amongst them.' " So Hafsa did not leave Ibn `Umar till we went to them. When the people differed. Muawiya addressed the people saying, "'If anybody wants to say anything in this matter of the Caliphate, he should show up and not conceal himself, for we are more rightful to be a Caliph than he and his father." On that, Habib bin Masalama said (to Ibn `Umar), "Why don't you reply to him (i.e. Muawiya)?" `Abdullah bin `Umar said, "I untied my garment that was going round my back and legs while I was sitting and was about to say, 'He who fought against you and against your father for the sake of Islam, is more rightful to be a Caliph,' but I was afraid that my statement might produce differences amongst the people and cause bloodshed, and my statement might be interpreted not as I intended. (So I kept quiet) remembering what Allah has prepared in the Gardens of Paradise (for those who are patient and prefer the Hereafter to this worldly life)." Habib said, "You did what kept you safe and secure (i.e. you were wise in doing so)
hi: Ikrima bin Khalid bataate hain: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Main Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas gaya jabke unki gundhi hui chotiyon se paani tapak raha tha. Maine kaha, 'Logon ki haalat waisi hi hai jaisi aap dekh rahi hain, aur mujhe koi ikhtiyar nahi diya gaya hai.' Hafsa ne kaha, 'Unke paas jao, kyunke woh (yaani log) aapka intezaar kar rahe hain, aur mujhe dar hai ke aapki unse gair-hazari unke beech phoot daal degi.'" Isliye Hafsa ne Ibn Umar ko tab tak nahi chhoda jab tak hum unke paas nahi gaye. Jab logon mein mataferq huee, Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne logon ko sambodhit karte huye kaha, "Agar koee is Khilafat ke maamle mein kuch kehna chahta hai, use saamne anaa chahiye, chhupna nahi chahiye, kyunke hum unse aur unke waalid se zyada Khalifa banne ke haqdaar hain." Ispar, Habib bin Masalama ne (Ibn Umar se) kaha, "Aap unhe (yaani Muawiya ko) jawab kyun nahi dete?" Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Maine apna kapda khola jo mere peeth aur taangon ke gird lipeta hua tha jabke main baitha tha, aur maine kehne hi wala tha, 'Jisne Islam ki khaatir aapke aur aapke waalid ke khilaf jung ki, woh Khalifa banne ka zyada haqdaar hai,' magar mujhe dar tha ke meri baat logon ke beech mataferq paida kar degi aur khoonkharaba ka kaaran banegi, aur meri baat galat tarike se samjhi ja sakti hai (jaisa maine nahi socha). (Isliye main chup raha) yaad karte huye jo Allah ne Jannat ke baagon mein rakha hai (unke liye jo sabr karte hain aur is duniyavi zindagi se Aakhirat ko tarjih dete hain)." Habib ne kaha, "Aapne woh kiya jisse aap mahfooz aur bache rahe (yaani aapne bahut hikmat se kaam liya)."

e: Narrated Sulaiman bin Surad:On the day of Al-Ahzab (i.e. clans) the Prophet (ﷺ) said, (After this battle) we will go to attack them(i.e. the infidels) and they will not come to attack us
hi: Sulaiman bin Surad bataate hain: Al-Ahzab (yaani giroh) ke din, Nabi ne kaha, "(Is jung ke baad) hum unpar (yaani kaafiron par) hamla karne jaenge, aur woh humpar hamla karne nahi aenge."

e: Narrated Sulaiman bin Surad:When the clans were driven away, I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "From now onwards we will go to attack them (i.e. the infidels) and they will not come to attack us, but we will go to them
hi: Sulaiman bin Surad bataate hain: Jab giroh (yaani mushrik fauj) bhagaee gaye, maine Nabi ko kehte suna, "Ab se hum unpar (yaani kaafiron par) hamla karne jaenge, aur woh humpar hamla karne nahi aenge, balki hum unke paas jaenge."

e: Narrated `Ali:On the day of Al-Khandaq (i.e. Trench), the Prophet (ﷺ) said '(Let) Allah fill their (i.e. the infidels') houses and graves with fire just as they have prevented us from offering the Middle Prayer (i.e. `Asr prayer) till the sun had set
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Al-Khandaq (khaee) ke din, Nabi ne kaha, "(Aye Allah!) Allah unke (yaani kaafiron ke) gharon aur qabron ko aag se bhar de jaisa unhone humein darmiyan Namaz (yaani Asr ki namaz) padhne se roka jab tak suraj dooba gaya."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:`Umar bin Al-Khattab came on the day of Al-Khandaq after the sun had set and he was abusing the infidels of Quraish saying, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I was unable to offer the (`Asr) prayer till the sun was about to set." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "By Allah, I have not offered this (i.e. `Asr) prayer." So we came down along with the Prophet (ﷺ) to Buthan where he performed ablution for the prayer and then we performed the ablution for it. Then he offered the `Asr prayer after the sun had set, and after it he offered the Maghrib prayer
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab Al-Khandaq ke din suraj doobne ke baad aaye aur Quraish ke kaafiron ko koste huye kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Main (Asr ki) namaz nahi padh saka jab tak suraj doobne hi wala tha." Nabi ne kaha, "Allah ki qasam, maine bhi yeh (yaani Asr ki) namaz nahi padhi hai." Isliye hum Nabi ke saath Buthan gaye jahaan unhone namaz ke liye wudu kiya aur phir humne bhi wudu kiya. Phir unhone Asr ki namaz suraj doobne ke baad padhi, aur uske baad Maghrib ki namaz padhi.

e: Narrated Jabir:On the day of Al-Ahzab (i.e. clans), Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Who will bring us the news of the people (i.e. the clans of Quraish infidels)?" Az-Zubair said, "I." The Prophet (ﷺ) again said, "Who will bring us the news of the people?" Az-Zubair said, "I." The Prophet (ﷺ) again said, "Who will bring us the news of the people?" Az-Zubair said, "I." The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "Every prophet has his Hawari (i.e. disciple - special helper); my disciple is Az-Zubair
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Al-Ahzab (yaani giroh) ke din, Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Kaun humein logon (yaani Quraish kaafiron ke girohon) ki khabar laega?" Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Main." Nabi ne phir kaha, "Kaun humein logon ki khabar laega?" Az-Zubair ne kaha, "Main." Nabi ne phir kaha, "Kaun humein logon ki khabar laega?" Az-Zubair ne kaha, "Main." Nabi ne phir kaha, "Har Nabi ka apna Hawaari (yaani khaas shaagird) hota hai, aur mera Hawaari Az-Zubair hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to say, "None has the right to be worshipped except Allah Alone (Who) honored His Warriors and made His Slave victorious, and He (Alone) defeated the (infidel) clans; so there is nothing after Him
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool kaha karte the, "Allah ke siwa koee mabood nahi jisne apne mujahidon ko izzat di aur apne bande ko fatah di, aur usne akele (kaafir) girohon ko haar di; isliye Uske baad kuch nahi bacha."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abi `Aufa:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) invoked evil upon the clans saying, "Allah, the Revealer of the Holy Book (i.e. the Qur'an), the Quick Taker of the accounts! Please defeat the clans. O Allah! Defeat them and shake them
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Aufa bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaafir girohon ke khilaf bad-dua ki, kahte huye, "Allah, Paak Kitaab (yaani Quran) ka prakashak, jo tez hisaab lene wala hai! Kripya (in) girohon ko haar do. Aye Allah! Unhe haaro aur unhe hila de."

e: Narrated `Abdullah:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) returned from a Ghazwa, Hajj or `Umra, he used to start (saying), "Allahu- Akbar," thrice and then he would say, "None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone Who has no partners. To Him belongs the Kingdom, all praises are for Him, and He is able to do all things (i.e. Omnipotent). We are returning with repentance (to Allah) worshipping, prostrating, and praising our Lord. Allah has fulfilled His Promise, made His Slave victorious, and He (Alone) defeated the clans (of infidels)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab bhi Allah ke Rasool kisi Ghazwe, Hajj, ya Umrah se wapas aate, woh "Allahu Akbar" teen baar kahte, aur phir kahte, "Allah ke siwa koee mabood nahi jiska koee saajidaar nahi. Baadshahat uski hai, sab taarifen uske liye hain, aur woh sab par Qaadir hai (yaani Sarvashaktimaan). Hum tauba karte huye (Allah ki taraf) laut rahe hain, ibadat karte hue, sajda karte hue, aur apne Rab ki taarif karte hue. Allah ne apna waada poora kiya, apne bande ko fatah di, aur usne akele (kaafir) girohon ko haara diya."

e: Narrated `Aisha:When the Prophet (ﷺ) returned from Al-Khandaq (i.e. Trench) and laid down his arms and took a bath, Gabriel came and said (to the Prophet (ﷺ) ), You have laid down your arms? By Allah, we angels have not laid them down yet. So set out for them." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Where to go?" Gabriel said, "Towards this side," pointing towards Banu Quraiza. So the Prophet (ﷺ) went out towards them
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab Nabi Al-Khandaq (yaani khaee) se wapas aaye aur apne hathiyaar rakh diye aur ghusal kiya, Jibreel aaye aur (Nabi se) kaha, "Aapne apne hathiyaar rakh diye? Allah ki qasam, hum farishton ne unhe abhi tak nahi rakha. Isliye unke khilaf nikliye." Nabi ne pucha, "Kahaan jaun?" Jibreel ne kaha, "Is taraf," Banu Quraiza ki taraf ishara karte huye. Isliye Nabi unke khilaf nikle.

e: Narrated Anas:As if I am just now looking at the dust rising in the street of Banu Ghanm (in Medina) because of the marching of Gabriel's regiment when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) set out to Banu Quraiza (to attack them)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Mano abhi bhi main Banu Ghanm ke gali mein dhool udte dekh raha hoon, Jibreel ki tukdi ke kooch karne ki wajah se, jab Allah ke Rasool Banu Quraiza ki taraf (unpar hamla karne) nikle.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:On the day of Al-Ahzab (i.e. Clans) the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "None of you Muslims) should offer the `Asr prayer but at Banu Quraiza's place." The `Asr prayer became due for some of them on the way. Some of those said, "We will not offer it till we reach it, the place of Banu Quraiza," while some others said, "No, we will pray at this spot, for the Prophet (ﷺ) did not mean that for us." Later on It was mentioned to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he did not berate any of the two groups
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Al-Ahzab (yaani giroh) ke din, Nabi ne kaha, "Tumme se koee bhi (Musalman) Asr ki namaz Banu Quraiza ke jagah ke ilawa kahin aur na padhe." Kuch logon ke liye Asr ki namaz raste mein hi (waqt par) aa gaee. Unmein se kuch ne kaha, "Hum ise tab tak nahi padhenge jab tak hum wahaan, yaani Banu Quraiza ki jagah tak, na pahunch jaen," jabke doosron ne kaha, "Nahi, hum ise yahin padhenge, kyunke Nabi ka yeh matlab humare liye nahi tha." Baad mein iska zikar Nabi se hua aur unhone in donon girohon mein se kisi ko bhi galat nahi thahraya.

e: Narrated Anas:Some (of the Ansar) used to present date palm trees to the Prophet (ﷺ) till Banu Quraiza and Banu An- Nadir were conquered (then he returned to the people their date palms). My people ordered me to ask the Prophet (ﷺ) to return some or all the date palms they had given to him, but the Prophet (ﷺ) had given those trees to Um Aiman. On that, Um Aiman came and put the garment around my neck and said, "No, by Him except Whom none has the right to be worshipped, he will not return those trees to you as he (i.e. the Prophet (ﷺ) ) has given them to me." The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to her), "Return those trees and I will give you so much (instead of them)." But she kept on refusing, saying, "No, by Allah," till he gave her ten times the number of her date palms
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Kuch (Ansaar) log Nabi ko khajoor ke darakht tohfe mein dete the jab tak Banu Quraiza aur Banu An-Nadir ko fatah kiya gaya (phir unhone unke khajoor ke darakht unhe wapas lekar de diye). Mere pariwara ne mujhe hukum diya ke main Nabi se kuch ya sab khajoor ke darakhton ko wapas maangun jo unhone unhe diye the, magar Nabi ne woh darakht Um Aiman ko de diye the. Ispar, Um Aiman aee aur mere gale ke gird kapda daal diya aur kaha, "Nahi, us Zaat ki qasam jiske siwa koee mabood nahi, woh (yaani Nabi) tumhe woh darakht wapas nahi denge kyunke unhone unhe mujhe de diya hai." Nabi ne (unse) kaha, "Woh darakht wapas kar do aur main tumhe utna hi (badle mein) dunga." Magar unhone inkaar karte rahe, kahte huye, "Nahi, Allah ki qasam," jab tak Nabi ne unhe unki khajoor ke darakhton ki tadaad se das guna zyada diye.

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The people of (Banu) Quraiza agreed to accept the verdict of Sa`d bin Mu`adh. So the Prophet (ﷺ) sent for Sa`d, and the latter came (riding) a donkey and when he approached the Mosque, the Prophet (ﷺ) said to the Ansar, "Get up for your chief or for the best among you." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said (to Sa`d)." These (i.e. Banu Quraiza) have agreed to accept your verdict." Sa`d said, "Kill their (men) warriors and take their offspring as captives, "On that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You have judged according to Allah's Judgment," or said, "according to the King's judgment
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Banu Quraiza ke log Sa'd bin Mu'adh ka faisla qubool karne ke liye raazi hue. Isliye Nabi ne Sa'd ke liye bheja, aur woh (ek) gadhe par sawar aakar, jab woh masjid ke qareeb pahunche, Nabi ne Ansaar se kaha, "Apne sardaar ke liye ya apne sabse behtar shaks ke liye khade ho jaao." Phir Nabi ne (Sa'd se) kaha, "In logon (yaani Banu Quraiza) ne aapka faisla qubool karne ki sahmati di hai." Sa'd ne kaha, "Main faisla deta hoon ke unke mujahidon ko qatl kiya jaaye aur unke bachchon aur aurton ko qaidi banaya jaaye." Ispar, Nabi ne kaha, "Aapne Allah ke faisle jaisa hi faisla diya hai," ya kaha, "Baadshah ke faisle jaisa."

e: Narrated `Aisha:Sa`d was wounded on the day of Khandaq (i.e. Trench) when a man from Quraish, called Hibban bin Al-`Araqa hit him (with an arrow). The man was Hibban bin Qais from (the tribe of) Bani Mais bin 'Amir bin Lu'ai who shot an arrow at Sa`d's medial arm vein (or main artery of the arm). The Prophet (ﷺ) pitched a tent (for Sa`d) in the Mosque so that he might be near to the Prophet (ﷺ) to visit. When the Prophet returned from the (battle) of Al-Khandaq (i.e. Trench) and laid down his arms and took a bath Gabriel came to him while he (i.e. Gabriel) was shaking the dust off his head, and said, "You have laid down the arms?" By Allah, I have not laid them down. Go out to them (to attack them)." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Where?" Gabriel pointed towards Bani Quraiza. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went to them (i.e. Banu Quraiza) (i.e. besieged them). They then surrendered to the Prophet's judgment but he directed them to Sa`d to give his verdict concerning them. Sa`d said, "I give my judgment that their warriors should be killed, their women and children should be taken as captives, and their properties distributed." Narrated Hisham: My father informed me that `Aisha said, "Sa`d said, "O Allah! You know that there is nothing more beloved to me than to fight in Your Cause against those who disbelieved Your Apostle and turned him out (of Mecca). O Allah! I think you have put to an end the fight between us and them (i.e. Quraish infidels). And if there still remains any fight with the Quraish (infidels), then keep me alive till I fight against them for Your Sake. But if you have brought the war to an end, then let this wound burst and cause my death thereby.' So blood gushed from the wound. There was a tent in the Mosque belonging to Banu Ghifar who were surprised by the blood flowing towards them . They said, 'O people of the tent! What is this thing which is coming to us from your side?' Behold! Blood was flowing profusely out of Sa`d's wound. Sa`d then died because of that
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Sa'd Al-Khandaq (khaee) ke din zakhmi hue jab Quraish ke ek shaks, Hibban bin Al-Araqa, ne unhe (teer se) maara. Woh shaks Hibban bin Qais the, Bani Mais bin Amir bin Luai qabile se, jinhone Sa'd ki baanh ki nas (ya mukhya dhamani) mein teer maara. Nabi ne unke liye (Sa'd ke liye) masjid mein ek tambu lagvaya taaki woh unke qareeb rahen aur unse milte rahen. Jab Nabi Al-Khandaq se wapas aaye aur apne hathiyaar rakh diye aur ghusal kiya, Jibreel unke paas aaye, apne sar se dhool jhaadkar, aur kaha, "Aapne hathiyaar rakh diye? Allah ki qasam, maine unhe abhi tak nahi rakha. Unke khilaf nikliye (aur unpar hamla kariye)." Nabi ne pucha, "Kahaan?" Jibreel ne Banu Quraiza ki taraf ishara kiya. Isliye Allah ke Rasool unke paas gaye (yaani Banu Quraiza ko gher liya). Phir unhone Nabi ke faisle ke aage samarpit ho diya, magar Nabi ne unke maamle ka faisla Sa'd ke haathon chhod diya. Sa'd ne kaha, "Main faisla deta hoon ke unke mujahidon ko qatl kiya jaaye, unki aurton aur bachchon ko qaidi banaya jaaye, aur unka maal taqseem ki jaaye." Hisham bataate hain (apne waalid se): Ayesha ne kaha, "Sa'd ne kaha, 'Aye Allah! Tujhe pata hai mujhe kisi cheez se zyada pyara kuch nahi hai jitna Teri raah mein un logon se jung karna jinhone Tere Rasool ko jhutlaya aur unhe (Mecca se) nikala. Aye Allah! Mujhe lagta hai Tune humare aur unke beech ki jung ko khatm kar diya hai. Aur agar abhi bhi Quraish (kaafiron) ke saath koee jung baaki hai, phir mujhe zinda rakh jab tak main Teri khaatir unse jung karun. Magar agar Tune jung khatm kar di hai, phir kripya is zakhm ko phat jane de aur mujhe isse maut de de.' Ispar, khoon unke zakhm se bahne laga. Masjid mein ek tambu tha jo Banu Ghifar ka tha, aur woh khoon ko unki taraf behta dekhkar hairat mein pade. Unhone kaha, 'Aye tambu ke logo! Yeh kya cheez hai jo tumhari taraf se aa rahi hai?' Dekho! Khoon Sa'd ke zakhm se bahut zyada beh raha tha. Phir Sa'd usi wajah se intiqal kar gaye."

e: Narrated Al-Bara:The Prophet (ﷺ) said to Hassan, "Abuse them (with your poems), and Gabriel is with you (i.e, supports you)." (Through another group of sub narrators) Al-Bara bin Azib said, "On the day of Quraiza's (besiege), Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to Hassan bin Thabit, 'Abuse them (with your poems), and Gabriel is with you (i.e. supports you)
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Nabi ne Hassan se kaha, "Unki (apni kavita se) buraee karo, aur Jibreel tumhare saath hai." (Ek doosri riwaayat mein) Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Quraiza ke ghersne ke din, Allah ke Rasool ne Hassan bin Thabit se kaha, 'Unki buraee karo (apni kavita se), aur Jibreel tumhare saath hai.'"

e: Al-Bara' bin `Azib said (through another chain of sub-narrators):"On the day of Quraiza's (siege), Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to Hassan bin Thabit, 'Abuse them (with your poems), and Jibril is with you
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha (ek doosri chain ke saath): "Quraiza ke ghersne ke din, Allah ke Rasool ne Hassan bin Thabit se kaha, 'Unki buraee karo (apni kavita se), aur Jibreel tumhare saath hai.'"

e: Narrated Jabir bin Abdullah (ra):The Prophet (ﷺ) led his Companions in the Fear Prayer in the seventh Ghazwa i.e. the Ghazwa of Dhat-ur-Riqa. Ibn Abbas said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) offered the Fear Prayer at a place called Dhi-Qarad
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne apne sahaba ko Salat-al-Khauf (yaani dar ke waqt ki namaz) padhaee saatvin Ghazwe mein, yaani Ghazwa Dhat-ur-Riqa. Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Nabi ne Salat-al-Khauf Dhi-Qarad naam ki jagah par padhi."

e: Jabir said that the Prophet (ﷺ) led the people in the Fear Prayer on the day of Muharib and Tha'laba (i.e. the day of the battle of Dhat-ur-Riqa)
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne logon ko Salat-al-Khauf padhaee Muharib aur Tha'laba ke din (yaani Ghazwa Dhat-ur-Riqa ke din).

e: Jabir added:"The Prophet (ﷺ) set out for the battle of Dhat-ur-Riqa' at a place called Nakhl and he met a group of people from Ghatafan, but there was no clash (between them); the people were afraid of each other and the Prophet (ﷺ) offered the two raka'at of the Fear prayer." Narrated Salama: "I fought in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) on the day of al-Qarad
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne joda: Nabi Ghazwa Dhat-ur-Riqa ke liye Nakhl naam ki jagah se nikle aur unki mulaqaat Ghatafan qabile ke kuch logon se huee, magar koee takraav nahi hua (unke beech); log ek-doosre se darte the, aur Nabi ne Salat-al-Khauf ki do rakaten padhi. Salama bataate hain: "Main Al-Qarad ke din Nabi ki sohbat mein jung mein tha."

e: Narrated Abu Burda:Abu Musa said, "We went out in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) for a Ghazwa and we were six persons having one camel which we rode in rotation. So, (due to excessive walking) our feet became thin and my feet became thin and my nail dropped, and we used to wrap our feet with the pieces of cloth, and for this reason, the Ghazwa was named Dhat-ur-Riqa as we wrapped our feet with rags." When Abu- Musa narrated this (Hadith), he felt regretful to do so and said, as if he disliked to have disclosed a good deed of his
hi: Abu Burda bataate hain: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Hum Nabi ke saath ek Ghazwe ke liye nikle aur hum chhah log the aur humare paas ek hi unt thi jispar hum baari-baari sawar hote the. Isliye (bahut zyada paidal chalne ki wajah se) humare paanv patle ho gaye aur mere paanv patle ho gaye aur mera naakhun gir gaya, aur hum apne paanvon ko kapde ke tukdon se lapette the, aur isi wajah se is Ghazwa ka naam Dhat-ur-Riqa (yaani chithdon wala) pada, kyunke humne apne paanvon ko chithdon se lapeta tha." Jab Abu Musa ne yeh (Hadith) riwaayat ki, unhe ise karne ka afsos hua aur unhone aisa mahsoos kiya mano unhe apni ek neik amal ko zaahir karna napasand tha.

e: Narrated Salih bin Khawwat:Concerning those who witnessed the Fear Prayer that was performed in the battle of Dhat-ur-Riqa' in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ); One batch lined up behind him while another batch (lined up) facing the enemy. The Prophet (ﷺ) led the batch that was with him in one rak`a, and he stayed in the standing posture while that batch completed their (two rak`at) prayer by themselves and went away, lining in the face of the enemy, while the other batch came and he (i.e. the Prophet) offered his remaining rak`a with them, and then, kept on sitting till they completed their prayer by themselves, and he then finished his prayer with Taslim along with them
hi: Salih bin Khawwat bataate hain: Un logon ke baare mein jinhone Salat-al-Khauf dekha jo Ghazwa Dhat-ur-Riqa mein Allah ke Rasool ke saath padhi gaee: Ek giroh unke peeche saf mein khada hua jabke doosra giroh dushman ka saamna karte huye khada hua. Nabi ne apne saath wale giroh ko ek rakat padhaee, aur phir woh khade hi rahe jab tak us giroh ne apni (do rakat) namaz khud khatm kar li aur chale gaye, dushman ke saamne khade ho jane ke liye, jabke doosra giroh aaya aur Nabi ne unke saath apni baaki rakat padhi, aur phir baithe rahe jab tak unhone apni namaz khud khatm ki, aur phir unhone apni namaz Taslim ke saath unke saath khatm ki.

e: Narrated Ibn Az-Zubair:Jabir said, "We were with the Prophet (ﷺ) at Nakhl," and then he mentioned the Fear prayer. Narrated Al-Qasim bin Muhammad: The Prophet (ﷺ) offered the Fear prayer in the Ghazwa of Banu Anmar
hi: Ibn Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Hum Nabi ke saath Nakhl mein the," aur phir unhone Salat-al-Khauf ka zikar kiya. Al-Qasim bin Muhammad bataate hain: Nabi ne Salat-al-Khauf Ghazwa Banu Anmar mein padhi.

e: Narrated Sahl bin Abi Hathma:(describing the Fear prayer): The Imam stands up facing the Qibla and one batch of them (i.e. the army) (out of the two) prays along with him and the other batch faces the enemy. The Imam offers one rak`a with the first batch, then they themselves stand up alone and offer one bowing and two prostrations while they are still in their place, and then go away to relieve the second batch, and the second batch comes (and takes the place of the first batch in the prayer behind the Imam) and he offers the second rak`a with them. So he completes his two-rak`at and then the second batch bows and prostrates two prostrations (i.e. complete their second rak`a and thus all complete their prayer). (This hadith has also been narrated through two other chains by Sahl b. Abi Hathma)
hi: Sahl bin Abi Hathma bataate hain (Salat-al-Khauf ka varnan karte huye): Imam Qibla ki taraf munh karke khada hota hai aur ek giroh (yaani fauj ka ek hissa) unke saath namaz padhta hai jabke doosra giroh dushman ka saamna karta hai. Imam pahle giroh ke saath ek rakat padhta hai, phir woh khud khade hote hain aur ek ruku aur do sajde karte hain, apni hi jagah par khade rahte huye, aur phir chale jate hain doosre giroh ko rahat dene ke liye, aur doosra giroh aata hai (aur Imam ke peeche namaz mein unki jagah leta hai) aur woh unke saath doosri rakat padhta hai. Isliye woh apni do rakaten poori karta hai, aur phir doosra giroh ruku karta hai aur do sajde karta hai (yaani apni doosri rakat poori karke, isi tarah sab apni namaz poori karte hain).

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:I took part in a Ghazwa towards Najd along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and we clashed with the enemy, and we lined up for them
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Najd ki taraf ek Ghazwe mein hissa liya Allah ke Rasool ke saath, aur hum dushman se mile aur unke muqaable mein safon mein khade hue.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) led the Fear-prayer with one of the two batches of the army while the other (batch) faced the enemy. Then the first batch went away and took places of their companions (i.e. second batch) and the second batch came and he led his second rak`a with them. Then he (i.e. the Prophet: finished his prayer with Taslim and then each of the two batches got up and completed their remaining one rak`a)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne fauj ke do girohon mein se ek ke saath Salat-al-Khauf padhaee jabke doosra (giroh) dushman ka saamna kar raha tha. Phir pahla giroh chala gaya aur apne sathiyon (yaani doosre giroh) ki jagah le li, aur doosra giroh aaya aur Nabi ne unke saath apni doosri rakat padhi. Phir unhone (yaani Nabi ne) apni namaz Taslim ke saath khatm ki, aur phir donon girohon mein se har ek uthe aur apni baaki ek rakat khud poori ki.

e: Narrated Sinan and Abu Salama:Jabir mentioned that he had participated in a Ghazwa towards Najd in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
hi: Sinan aur Abu Salama bataate hain: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne zikar kiya ke unhone Najd ki taraf ek Ghazwe mein Allah ke Rasool ke saath hissa liya.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:That he fought in a Ghazwa towards Najd along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) returned, he too, returned along with him. The time of the afternoon nap overtook them when they were in a valley full of thorny trees. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) dismounted and the people dispersed amongst the thorny trees, seeking the shade of the trees. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took shelter under a Samura tree and hung his sword on it. We slept for a while when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) suddenly called us, and we went to him, to find a bedouin sitting with him. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "This (bedouin) took my sword out of its sheath while I was asleep. When I woke up, the naked sword was in his hand and he said to me, 'Who can save you from me?, I replied, 'Allah.' Now here he is sitting." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not punish him (for that)
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Woh Najd ki taraf ek Ghazwe mein Allah ke Rasool ke saath lade, aur jab Allah ke Rasool wapas aaye, woh bhi unke saath wapas aaye. Dopahar ki neend ka waqt unhe aa gaya jabke woh kaantedaar paudon se bhari ek waadi mein the. Allah ke Rasool utre aur log kaantedaar paudon ke beech baant gaye, darakhton ki chhaye khojte hue. Allah ke Rasool ne ek Samura darakht ke neeche panah li aur apni talwaar usmein latka di. Hum kuch der soye jab tak Allah ke Rasool ne achanak humein bulaya, aur hum unke paas gaye aur paaya ek dehati shaks unke saath baitha hai. Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Is (dehati) ne meri talwaar uske myaan se nikal li jabke main so raha tha. Jab main jaga, khuli talwaar unke haath mein thi, aur usne mujhse kaha, 'Kaun tumhe mujhse bacha sakta hai?' Maine jawab diya, 'Allah.' Ab woh yahaan baitha hai." Allah ke Rasool ne unhe (is kaam ke liye) koee saza nahi di.

e: (through another group of narrators) Jabir said:"We were in the company of the Prophet (during the battle of) Dhat-ur-Riqa', and we came across a shady tree and we left it for the Prophet (to take rest under its shade). A man from the pagans came while the Prophet's sword was hanging on the tree. He took it out of its sheath secretly and said (to the Prophet (ﷺ) ), 'Are you afraid of me?' The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'No.' He said, 'Who can save you from me?' The Prophet (ﷺ) said, Allah.' The companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) threatened him, then the Iqama for the prayer was announced and the Prophet (ﷺ) offered a two rak`at Fear prayer with one of the two batches, and that batch went aside and he offered two rak`a-t with the other batch. So the Prophet (ﷺ) offered four rak`at but the people offered two rak`at only." (The subnarrator) Abu Bishr added, "The man was Ghaurath bin Al-Harith and the battle was waged against Muharib Khasafa
hi: (ek doosre giroh ke narawiyon se) Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Hum Nabi ke saath (Ghazwa) Dhat-ur-Riqa (mein) the, aur humari mulaqaat ek chhayedaar darakht se huee aur humne use Nabi ke liye chhod diya (aaram karne ke liye unki chhaye mein). Ek butparaston mein se ek shaks aaya jabke Nabi ki talwaar darakht par latki hui thi. Usne use gup-chup unke myaan se nikala aur (Nabi se) kaha, 'Kya tum mujhse darte ho?' Nabi ne kaha, 'Nahi.' Usne kaha, 'Kaun tumhe mujhse bacha sakta hai?' Nabi ne kaha, 'Allah.' Nabi ke sahaba ne unhe daantne ki koshish ki, phir namaz ke liye Iqama di gaee, aur Nabi ne do rakat ki Salat-al-Khauf ek giroh ke saath padhi, aur woh giroh alag hokar (jagah) le liya aur unhone doosre giroh ke saath do rakat aur padhi. Isliye Nabi ne chaar rakaten padhi magar logon ne sirf do rakaten padhi." (Doosre raawi, Abu Bishr ne joda, "Woh shaks Ghaurath bin Al-Harith tha, aur jung Muharib Khasafa ke khilaf thi.")

e: Jabir added, "We were with the Prophet (ﷺ) at Nakhl and he offered the Fear prayer." Abu Huraira said, "I offered the Fear prayer with the Prophet (ﷺ) during the Ghazwa (i.e. the battle) of Najd." Abu Huraira came to the Prophet (ﷺ) during the day of Khaibar
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne joda, "Hum Nabi ke saath Nakhl mein the aur unhone Salat-al-Khauf padhi." Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Maine Nabi ke saath Salat-al-Khauf padhi Ghazwa Najd ke dauran." Abu Huraira Khaibar ke din Nabi ke paas aaye.

e: Narrated Ibn Muhairiz:I entered the Mosque and saw Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri and sat beside him and asked him about Al-Azl (i.e. coitus interruptus). Abu Sa`id said, "We went out with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for the Ghazwa of Banu Al-Mustaliq and we received captives from among the Arab captives and we desired women and celibacy became hard on us and we loved to do coitus interruptus. So when we intended to do coitus interruptus, we said, 'How can we do coitus interruptus before asking Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who is present among us?" We asked (him) about it and he said, 'It is better for you not to do so, for if any soul (till the Day of Resurrection) is predestined to exist, it will exist
hi: Ibn Muhairiz bataate hain: Main masjid mein daakhil hua aur Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko dekha aur unke paas baith gaya aur unse Al-Azl (yaani sambhog ke dauran beech mein nikal jane ki riwaj) ke baare mein pucha. Abu Saeed ne kaha, "Hum Allah ke Rasool ke saath Ghazwa Banu Al-Mustaliq ke liye nikle aur humein Arab qaidiyon mein se kuch qaidi mile aur humein aurton ki iccha huee aur brahmacharya humare liye mushkil ho gaya aur humein Al-Azl karna achha lagne laga. Isliye jab humne Al-Azl karne ka irada kiya, humne kaha, 'Hum Al-Azl kaise kar sakte hain isse pahle ke hum Allah ke Rasool se puchen jo humare beech maujood hain?' Humne unse iske baare mein pucha aur unhone kaha, 'Tumhare liye behtar hai ke tum aisa na karo, kyunke agar koee bhi jaan (Qiyamat ke din tak) astitva mein aane ke liye niyat hai, woh astitva mein aayegi hi.'"

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:We took part in the Ghazwa of Najd along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and when the time for the afternoon rest approached while he was in a valley with plenty of thorny trees, he dismounted under a tree and rested in its shade and hung his sword (on it). The people dispersed amongst the trees in order to have shade. While we were in this state, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) called us and we came and found a bedouin sitting in front of him. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "This (Bedouin) came to me while I was asleep, and he took my sword stealthily. I woke up while he was standing by my head, holding my sword without its sheath. He said, 'Who will save you from me?' I replied, 'Allah.' So he sheathed it (i.e. the sword) and sat down, and here he is." But Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not punish him
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Najd ki taraf Allah ke Rasool ke saath Ghazwe mein gaye, aur jab dopahar ki aaraam ka waqt qareeb aaya jabke woh ek kaantedaar darakhton se bhari ek waadi mein the, woh ek darakht ke neeche utre aur uski chhaye mein aaraam kiya aur apni talwaar (usmein) latka di. Log darakhton mein baant gaye chhaye lene ke liye. Isi haalat mein, Allah ke Rasool ne humein bulaya aur hum aaye aur unke saamne ek dehati shaks baitha paaya. Nabi ne kaha, "Yeh (dehati) mere paas aaya jabke main so raha tha, aur usne chup-chup ke meri talwaar le li. Main jaga jabke woh mere sar ke bagal khade the, meri khuli talwaar apne haath mein pakde, bina uske myaan ke. Usne kaha, 'Kaun tumhe mujhse bacha sakta hai?' Maine jawab diya, 'Allah.' Isliye usne use myaan mein daal diya aur baith gaya, aur woh yahaan hai." Magar Allah ke Rasool ne unhe koee saza nahi di.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah Al-Ansari:I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) offering his Nawafil prayer on his Mount facing the East during the Ghazwa of Anmar
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ansari bataate hain: Maine Nabi ko apni Nawafil namaz apne sawari ke janwar par purab ki taraf munh karke padhte dekha Ghazwa Anmar ke dauran.

e: Narrated `Aisha:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) intended to go on a journey, he used to draw lots amongst his wives, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to take with him the one on whom lot fell. He drew lots amongst us during one of the Ghazwat which he fought. The lot fell on me and so I proceeded with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) after Allah's order of veiling (the women) had been revealed. I was carried (on the back of a camel) in my howdah and carried down while still in it (when we came to a halt). So we went on till Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had finished from that Ghazwa of his and returned. When we approached the city of Medina he announced at night that it was time for departure. So when they announced the news of departure, I got up and went away from the army camps, and after finishing from the call of nature, I came back to my riding animal. I touched my chest to find that my necklace which was made of Zifar beads (i.e. Yemenite beads partly black and partly white) was missing. So I returned to look for my necklace and my search for it detained me. (In the meanwhile) the people who used to carry me on my camel, came and took my howdah and put it on the back of my camel on which I used to ride, as they considered that I was in it. In those days women were light in weight for they did not get fat, and flesh did not cover their bodies in abundance as they used to eat only a little food. Those people therefore, disregarded the lightness of the howdah while lifting and carrying it; and at that time I was still a young girl. They made the camel rise and all of them left (along with it). I found my necklace after the army had gone. Then I came to their camping place to find no call maker of them, nor one who would respond to the call. So I intended to go to the place where I used to stay, thinking that they would miss me and come back to me (in my search). While I was sitting in my resting place, I was overwhelmed by sleep and slept. Safwan bin Al-Muattal As-Sulami Adh-Dhakwani was behind the army. When he reached my place in the morning, he saw the figure of a sleeping person and he recognized me on seeing me as he had seen me before the order of compulsory veiling (was prescribed). So I woke up when he recited Istirja' (i.e. "Inna li l-lahi wa inna llaihi raji'un") as soon as he recognized me. I veiled my face with my head cover at once, and by Allah, we did not speak a single word, and I did not hear him saying any word besides his Istirja'. He dismounted from his camel and made it kneel down, putting his leg on its front legs and then I got up and rode on it. Then he set out leading the camel that was carrying me till we overtook the army in the extreme heat of midday while they were at a halt (taking a rest). (Because of the event) some people brought destruction upon themselves and the one who spread the Ifk (i.e. slander) more, was `Abdullah bin Ubai Ibn Salul." (Urwa said, "The people propagated the slander and talked about it in his (i.e. `Abdullah's) presence and he confirmed it and listened to it and asked about it to let it prevail." `Urwa also added, "None was mentioned as members of the slanderous group besides (`Abdullah) except Hassan bin Thabit and Mistah bin Uthatha and Hamna bint Jahsh along with others about whom I have no knowledge, but they were a group as Allah said. It is said that the one who carried most of the slander was `Abdullah bin Ubai bin Salul." `Urwa added, "`Aisha disliked to have Hassan abused in her presence and she used to say, 'It was he who said: My father and his (i.e. my father's) father and my honor are all for the protection of Muhammad's honor from you."). `Aisha added, "After we returned to Medina, I became ill for a month. The people were propagating the forged statements of the slanderers while I was unaware of anything of all that, but I felt that in my present ailment, I was not receiving the same kindness from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as I used to receive when I got sick. (But now) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) would only come, greet me and say,' How is that (lady)?' and leave. That roused my doubts, but I did not discover the evil (i.e. slander) till I went out after my convalescence, I went out with Um Mistah to Al-Manasi' where we used to answer the call of nature and we used not to go out (to answer the call of nature) except at night, and that was before we had latrines near our houses. And this habit of our concerning evacuating the bowels, was similar to the habits of the old 'Arabs living in the deserts, for it would be troublesome for us to take latrines near our houses. So I and Um Mistah who was the daughter of Abu Ruhm bin Al-Muttalib bin `Abd Manaf, whose mother was the daughter of Sakhr bin 'Amir and the aunt of Abu Bakr As-Siddiq and whose son was Mistah bin Uthatha bin `Abbas bin Al-Muttalib, went out. I and Um Mistah returned to my house after we finished answering the call of nature. Um Mistah stumbled by getting her foot entangled in her covering sheet and on that she said, 'Let Mistah be ruined!' I said, 'What a hard word you have said. Do you abuse a man who took part in the battle of Badr?' On that she said, 'O you Hantah! Didn't you hear what he (i.e. Mistah) said? 'I said, 'What did he say?' Then she told me the slander of the people of Ifk. So my ailment was aggravated, and when I reached my home, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to me, and after greeting me, said, 'How is that (lady)?' I said, 'Will you allow me to go to my parents?' as I wanted to be sure about the news through them. Allah's Apostle allowed me (and I went to my parents) and asked my mother, 'O mother! What are the people talking about?' She said, 'O my daughter! Don't worry, for scarcely is there a charming woman who is loved by her husband and whose husband has other wives besides herself that they (i.e. women) would find faults with her.' I said, 'Subhan-Allah! (I testify the uniqueness of Allah). Are the people really talking in this way?' I kept on weeping that night till dawn I could neither stop weeping nor sleep then in the morning again, I kept on weeping. When the Divine Inspiration was delayed. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) called `Ali bin Abi Talib and Usama bin Zaid to ask and consult them about divorcing me. Usama bin Zaid said what he knew of my innocence, and the respect he preserved in himself for me. Usama said, '(O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!) She is your wife and we do not know anything except good about her.' `Ali bin Abi Talib said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Allah does not put you in difficulty and there are plenty of women other than she, yet, ask the maid-servant who will tell you the truth.' On that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) called Barira (i.e. the maid-servant) and said, 'O Barira! Did you ever see anything which aroused your suspicion?' Barira said to him, 'By Him Who has sent you with the Truth. I have never seen anything in her (i.e. Aisha) which I would conceal, except that she is a young girl who sleeps leaving the dough of her family exposed so that the domestic goats come and eat it.' So, on that day, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got up on the pulpit and complained about `Abdullah bin Ubai (bin Salul) before his companions, saying, 'O you Muslims! Who will relieve me from that man who has hurt me with his evil statement about my family? By Allah, I know nothing except good about my family and they have blamed a man about whom I know nothing except good and he used never to enter my home except with me.' Sa`d bin Mu`adh the brother of Banu `Abd Al-Ashhal got up and said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I will relieve you from him; if he is from the tribe of Al-Aus, then I will chop his head off, and if he is from our brothers, i.e. Al-Khazraj, then order us, and we will fulfill your order.' On that, a man from Al-Khazraj got up. Um Hassan, his cousin, was from his branch tribe, and he was Sa`d bin Ubada, chief of Al-Khazraj. Before this incident, he was a pious man, but his love for his tribe goaded him into saying to Sa`d (bin Mu`adh). 'By Allah, you have told a lie; you shall not and cannot kill him.
