If he belonged to your people, you would not wish him to be killed.' On that, Usaid bin Hudair who was the cousin of Sa`d (bin Mu`adh) got up and said to Sa`d bin 'Ubada, 'By Allah! You are a liar! We will surely kill him, and you are a hypocrite arguing on the behalf of hypocrites.' On this, the two tribes of Al-Aus and Al Khazraj got so much excited that they were about to fight while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was standing on the pulpit. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) kept on quietening them till they became silent and so did he. All that day I kept on weeping with my tears never ceasing, and I could never sleep. In the morning my parents were with me and I wept for two nights and a day with my tears never ceasing and I could never sleep till I thought that my liver would burst from weeping. So, while my parents were sitting with me and I was weeping, an Ansari woman asked me to grant her admittance. I allowed her to come in, and when she came in, she sat down and started weeping with me. While we were in this state, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came, greeted us and sat down. He had never sat with me since that day of the slander. A month had elapsed and no Divine Inspiration came to him about my case. Allah's Apostle then recited Tashah-hud and then said, 'Amma Badu, O `Aisha! I have been informed so-and-so about you; if you are innocent, then soon Allah will reveal your innocence, and if you have committed a sin, then repent to Allah and ask Him for forgiveness for when a slave confesses his sins and asks Allah for forgiveness, Allah accepts his repentance.' When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) finished his speech, my tears ceased flowing completely that I no longer felt a single drop of tear flowing. I said to my father, 'Reply to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on my behalf concerning what he has said.' My father said, 'By Allah, I do not know what to say to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) .' Then I said to my mother, 'Reply to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on my behalf concerning what he has said.' She said, 'By Allah, I do not know what to say to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).' In spite of the fact that I was a young girl and had a little knowledge of Qur'an, I said, 'By Allah, no doubt I know that you heard this (slanderous) speech so that it has been planted in your hearts (i.e. minds) and you have taken it as a truth. Now if I tell you that I am innocent, you will not believe me, and if I confess to you about it, and Allah knows that I am innocent, you will surely believe me. By Allah, I find no similitude for me and you except that of Joseph's father when he said, '(For me) patience is the most fitting against that which you assert; it is Allah (Alone) Whose Help can be sought.' Then I turned to the other side and lay on my bed; and Allah knew then that I was innocent and hoped that Allah would reveal my innocence. But, by Allah, I never thought that Allah would reveal about my case, Divine Inspiration, that would be recited (forever) as I considered myself too unworthy to be talked of by Allah with something of my concern, but I hoped that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) might have a dream in which Allah would prove my innocence. But, by Allah, before Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) left his seat and before any of the household left, the Divine inspiration came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). So there overtook him the same hard condition which used to overtake him, (when he used to be inspired Divinely). The sweat was dropping from his body like pearls though it was a wintry day and that was because of the weighty statement which was being revealed to him. When that state of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was over, he got up smiling, and the first word he said was, 'O `Aisha! Allah has declared your innocence!' Then my Mother said to me, 'Get up and go to him (i.e. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)). I replied, 'By Allah, I will not go to him, and I praise none but Allah. So Allah revealed the ten Verses:- - "Verily! They who spread the slander Are a gang, among you............." (24.11-20) Allah revealed those Qur'anic Verses to declare my innocence. Abu Bakr As-Siddiq who used to disburse money for Mistah bin Uthatha because of his relationship to him and his poverty, said, 'By Allah, I will never give to Mistah bin Uthatha anything after what he has said about Aisha.' Then Allah revealed:-- "And let not those among you who are good and wealthy swear not to give (any sort of help) to their kinsmen, those in need, and those who have left their homes for Allah's cause, let them pardon and forgive. Do you not love that Allah should forgive you? And Allah is Oft-Forgiving Most Merciful." (24.22) Abu Bakr As-Siddiq said, 'Yes, by Allah, I would like that Allah forgive me.' and went on giving Mistah the money he used to give him before. He also added, 'By Allah, I will never deprive him of it at all.' Aisha further said:." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) also asked Zainab bint Jahsh (i.e. his wife) about my case. He said to Zainab, 'What do you know and what did you see?" She replied, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I refrain from claiming falsely that I have heard or seen anything. By Allah, I know nothing except good (about `Aisha).' From amongst the wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) Zainab was my peer (in beauty and in the love she received from the Prophet) but Allah saved her from that evil because of her piety. Her sister Hamna, started struggling on her behalf and she was destroyed along with those who were destroyed. The man who was blamed said, 'Subhan-Allah! By Him in Whose Hand my soul is, I have never uncovered the cover (i.e. veil) of any female.' Later on the man was martyred in Allah's Cause
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab bhi Allah ke Rasool ka koee safar karne ka irada hota, woh apni biwiyon ke beech qura karte, aur Allah ke Rasool apne saath use le jate jiska naam qura mein nikal aata. Unhone ek Ghazwe ke dauran humare beech qura kiya jo unhone lada. Qura mera naam nikla, isliye main Allah ke Rasool ke saath gaee uske baad jab parda (yaani hijab) ka hukum naazil ho chuka tha. Mujhe (unt par) mere Howdah mein le jaya jata aur usi mein neeche utaara jata (jab hum rukte). Isliye hum chalte rahe jab tak Allah ke Rasool apne is Ghazwe se faaragh hokar wapas aaye. Jab hum Madina ke qareeb pahunche, unhone raat ko elaan kiya ke chalne ka waqt aa gaya hai. Isliye jab unhone prasthaan ki khabar di, main uthi aur fauj ke padaavon se door chali gaee, aur qaza-e-hajat se faaragh hone ke baad, main apne sawari ke janwar ke paas wapas aee. Maine apna seena chhuya to paaya ke mera haar, jo Zifar motiyon (yaani Yemeni motiyon jo kuch kaale aur kuch safed the) ka bana tha, gaayab tha. Isliye main apna haar dhoondne wapas gaee, aur uski talaash ne mujhe roka rakha. (Isi beech) woh log jo mujhe mere unt par le jate the, aaye aur mera Howdah uthaya aur use mere unt ki peeth par rakh diya, yeh sochkar ke main usmein hoon. Un dinon aurten wazan mein halki hoti thi kyunke woh moti nahi hoti thi, aur gosht unke shareer mein bhaari matra mein nahi hota tha kyunke woh bahut kam khaana khati thi. Isliye un logon ne Howdah uthate waqt uski halki chhodkar dhyaan nahi diya; aur us waqt main abhi ek jawan ladki thi. Unhone unt ko uthaya aur sab chale gaye. Maine apna haar fauj ke jane ke baad paaya. Phir main unke padaav mein aee taaki wahaan koee pukarne wala na paee aur na koee jawab dene wala. Isliye maine wahaan jane ka irada kiya jahaan main pahle rehti thi, yeh sochte huye ke woh mujhe miss karenge aur (meri talaash mein) wapas aenge. Jabke main apni jagah baithi thi, neend ne mujhe apni chapet mein le liya aur main so gaee. Safwan bin Al-Muattal As-Sulami Adh-Dhakwani fauj ke peeche the. Jab woh subah mere paas pahunche, unhone ek sote hue insaan ka soorat dekha aur mujhe pahchan liya jab unhone mujhe dekha, kyunke unhone mujhe parda ke hukum se pahle bhi dekha tha. Isliye main jag gaee jab unhone Istirja (yaani "Inna li l-lahi wa inna llaihi raji'un") padha jaise hi unhone mujhe pahchana. Maine apna chehra apne sar ke odhne wale kapde se turant dhaank liya, aur Allah ki qasam, humne ek bhi shabd nahi bola, aur maine unhe unke Istirja ke ilawa kuch kahte nahi suna. Woh apni unt se utre aur use bithaya, apna paanv uske agle paanvon par rakhkar, phir main uthi aur uspar sawar huee. Phir woh nikle, unt ko le jate hue jo mujhe le ja rahi thi, jab tak humne fauj ko sakht dopahar ki garmi mein pakad liya jabke woh ek padaav par ruke hue the. (Is ghatna ki wajah se) kuch logon ne khud par barbaadi laee, aur Ifk (yaani jhoote ilzaam) ko sabse zyada phailane wale Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ubai Ibn Salul the. (Urwa ne kaha, "Log jhoote ilzaam phaila rahe the aur uske (yaani Abdullah ke) saamne iska zikar karte the aur usne ise sahi maan liya aur use suna aur puchha taaki woh phaile.") Urwa ne yeh bhi joda, "Kisi aur ka naam is jhoote giroh ke sadasyon mein nahi liya gaya siwaye (Abdullah ke) Hassan bin Thabit, Mistah bin Uthatha, aur Hamna bint Jahsh ke, aur doosron ke saath jinke baare mein mujhe ilm nahi hai, magar woh ek giroh the jaisa Allah ne kaha. Yeh kaha jata hai ke jisne sabse zyada jhoota ilzaam phailaya woh Abdullah bin Ubai bin Salul the." Urwa ne joda, "Ayesha ko Hassan ki unki maujoodgi mein buraee karna napasand tha, aur woh kahti thi, 'Yeh woh the jinhone kaha: Mere waalid aur unke (yaani mere waalid ke) waalid aur meri izzat sab Muhammad ki izzat ki tumse hifaazat ke liye hain.'" Ayesha ne joda, "Jab hum Madina wapas aaye, main ek mahine tak bimar padi. Log jhoote ilzaamon ka prasaar kar rahe the jabke mujhe iske baare mein kuch pata nahi tha, magar mujhe mahsoos hua ke mujhe apni is bimari mein Allah ke Rasool se wahi dayaaluta nahi mil rahi thi jo pahle kisi aur bimari mein milti thi. (Ab) Allah ke Rasool sirf aate, salaam kahte aur puchhte, 'Kaisi ho?' aur chale jate. Isi ne mere man mein shak paida kiya, magar mujhe us buraee ka pata nahi chala jab tak main apni recovery ke baad bahar nikli, main Um Mistah ke saath Al-Manasi gaee jahaan hum qaza-e-hajat karte the aur hum sirf raat mein hi bahar jate the, aur yeh unse pahle tha jab humare gharon ke qareeb latrine (yaani sochalay) nahi the. Aur yeh humare pet saaf karne ki aadat purane Arbon jaisi thi jo registaan mein rahte the, kyunke gharon ke qareeb latrine banana humare liye takleefdeh hota. Isliye main aur Um Mistah, jo Abu Ruhm bin Al-Muttalib bin Abd Manaf ki beti thi, jinki maa Sakhr bin Amir ki beti aur Abu Bakr As-Siddiq ki phuphi thi aur jinke bete Mistah bin Uthatha bin Abbas bin Al-Muttalib the, bahar gaye. Main aur Um Mistah apni qaza-e-hajat se faaragh hone ke baad mere ghar wapas aaye. Um Mistah apni chaadar mein apna paanv uljhne se thokar khakar girne lagi, aur ispar unhone kaha, 'Mistah barbaad ho!' Maine kaha, 'Aapne ek bahut sakht baat kahi hai. Kya aap ek aise shaks ki buraee karti hain jinhone Badr ki jung mein hissa liya?' Ispar unhone kaha, 'Aye tum Hantah! Kya aapne nahi suna jo unhone (yaani Mistah ne) kaha?' Maine kaha, 'Unhone kya kaha?' Phir unhone mujhe logon ke jhoote ilzaam ki poori kahani sunaee. Isliye meri bimari aur badh gaee, aur jab main apne ghar pahunchi, Allah ke Rasool mere paas aaye aur salaam karke puchha, 'Kaisi ho?' Maine kaha, 'Kya aap mujhe mere maa-baap ke paas jane denge?' kyunke main unke zariye is khabar ki pushti karna chahti thi. Allah ke Rasool ne mujhe ijazat di (aur main apne maa-baap ke paas gaee) aur meri maa se pucha, 'Aye Maa! Log kya baat kar rahe hain?' Unhone kaha, 'Aye meri beti! Chinta mat karo, kyunke mushkil se koee khoobsurat aurat hoti hai jise uska shohar muhabbat karta ho aur uske shohar ki uske alawa doosri biwiyaan hon, jinke baare mein woh (yaani woh doosri aurten) kamiyaan na nikalen.' Maine kaha, 'Subhan-Allah! (Main Allah ki apeksik ekta ki gawahi deti hoon). Kya log sach mein aisi baat kar rahe hain?' Main us raat subah tak roti rahi, na main rona rokna sakti thi na so pati, phir subah main phir roti rahi. Jab Divine Ilham der se aee, Allah ke Rasool ne Ali (Alayhis Salam) bin Abi Talib aur Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko bulaya taaki unse mera talaq dene ke maamle mein raay len. Usama bin Zaid ne jo unhone meri begunahi ke baare mein jaante the aur mere prati apna samman zaahir kiya. Usama ne kaha, '(Ya Allah ke Rasool!) Woh aapki biwi hain aur hum unke baare mein achhe ke siwa kuch nahi jaante.' Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha, 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Allah aapko mushkil mein nahi daalega aur aapke liye unke ilawa bahut sari aurten hain, phir bhi launDi se puchiye jo aapko sach bataegi.' Ispar Allah ke Rasool ne Barira (رضی اللہ عنہا) (yaani launDi) ko bulaya aur kaha, 'Aye Barira! Kya tumne kabhi koee aisi cheez dekhi jisse tumhe shak hua?' Barira ne unse kaha, 'Us Zaat ki qasam jisne aapko Haqq ke saath bheja hai, maine kabhi unmein (yaani Ayesha mein) aisi koee baat nahi dekhi jise main chhupana chahoon, siwaye iske ke woh ek jawan ladki hain jo apne pariwara ka aata khula chhodkar soti hain isliye ghareloo bakriyaan aakar use kha jati hain.' Isliye, us din, Allah ke Rasool mimbar par chadhe aur apne sahaba ke saamne Abdullah bin Ubai (bin Salul) ki shikaayat karte huye kaha, 'Aye Musalmano! Kaun mujhe us shaks se rahat dega jisne apni buri baat se mere pariwara ko dukh diya hai? Allah ki qasam, main apne pariwara ke baare mein achhe ke siwa kuch nahi jaanta, aur unhone ek aise shaks par ilzaam lagaya hai jinke baare mein main achhe ke siwa kuch nahi jaanta, aur woh (yaani woh shaks) kabhi mere ghar mein daakhil nahi hue siwaye mere saath ke.' Sa'd bin Mu'adh, jo Banu Abd Al-Ashhal ke bhai the, uthe aur kaha, 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Main aapko usse rahat dunga; agar woh Al-Aus qabile se hain, phir main unka sar kaat dunga, aur agar woh humare bhaiyon mein se hain, yaani Al-Khazraj, phir humein hukum dijiye, aur hum aapka hukum poora karenge.' Ispar, Al-Khazraj se ek shaks uthe. Um Hassan, unki chachere behn, unki hi shaakha se thi, aur woh Sa'd bin Ubada (رضی اللہ عنہ) the, Al-Khazraj ke sardaar. Is ghatna se pahle, woh ek pakbaz shaks the, magar apne qabile ke prati unki mohabbat ne unhe Sa'd (bin Mu'adh) se yeh kahne par majboor kiya, 'Allah ki qasam, tumne jhoot kaha hai; tum unhe qatl nahi kar sakoge aur na hi karoge. Agar woh tumhare logon mein se hote, tum unki maut nahi chahte.' Ispar, Usaid bin Hudair, jo Sa'd (bin Mu'adh) ke chachere bhai the, uthe aur Sa'd bin Ubada se kaha, 'Allah ki qasam! Tum jhoote ho! Hum unhe zaroor qatl karenge, aur tum ek munafik ho jo munafikon ki taraf se baat kar rahe ho.' Ispar, Al-Aus aur Al-Khazraj qabile itne uttejit ho gaye ke woh jung karne hi wale the jabke Allah ke Rasool mimbar par khade the. Allah ke Rasool unhe shaant karte rahe jab tak woh khaamosh ho gaye, aur woh bhi khaamosh ho gaye. Us poore din main roti rahi, mere aansu kabhi na rukte, aur main kabhi so na saki. Subah mere maa-baap mere saath the, aur main do raaten aur ek din roti rahi, mere aansu kabhi na rukte, jab tak mujhe laga mera jigar rone se phat jaega. Isliye, jabke mere maa-baap mere saath baithe the aur main ro rahi thi, ek Ansaari aurat ne mujhse andar aane ki ijazat maangi. Maine unhe andar ane diya, aur jab woh andar aee, woh baith gaee aur mere saath rone lagi. Isi haalat mein, Allah ke Rasool aaye, humein salaam kiya, aur baith gaye. Woh us jhoote ilzaam ke din se mere saath kabhi nahi baithe the. Ek mahina guzar chuka tha aur unpar mere maamle ke baare mein koee Divine Ilham naazil nahi hua tha. Allah ke Rasool ne phir Tashah-hud padha aur kaha, 'Amma Ba'du, Aye Ayesha! Mujhe aapke baare mein aisa-aisa bataya gaya hai; agar aap begunah hain, phir jald hi Allah aapki begunahi zaahir karega, aur agar aapne koee gunah kiya hai, phir Allah se tauba kariye aur usse maafi maangiye, kyunke jab ek banda apne gunahon ka iqraar karta hai aur Allah se maafi maangta hai, Allah uski tauba qubool karta hai.' Jab Allah ke Rasool ne apni baat khatm ki, mere aansu poori tarah behna band ho gaye, itna ke mujhe ek bhi bund tapakte mahsoos nahi huee. Maine apne waalid se kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool ko mere taraf se jawab dijiye jo unhone kaha hai.' Mere waalid ne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, mujhe nahi pata Allah ke Rasool ko kya kahun.' Phir maine apni maa se kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool ko mere taraf se jawab dijiye jo unhone kaha hai.' Unhone kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, mujhe nahi pata Allah ke Rasool ko kya kahun.' Chahe main ek jawan ladki thi aur mujhe Quran ka thoda hi ilm tha, maine kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, mujhe pata hai aapne yeh (buraee bhara) baat sun li hai isi tarah ke woh aapke dilon (yaani manon) mein bas gaee hai aur aapne use sach maan liya hai. Ab agar main aapko bataun ke main begunah hoon, aap mujhpar vishwas nahi karenge, aur agar main aapke saamne iska iqraar karun, aur Allah jaanta hai main begunah hoon, aap zaroor mujhpar vishwas karenge. Allah ki qasam, mujhe apne aur aapke liye Yusuf ke waalid ke ilawa koee misaal nahi milti jab unhone kaha, "(Mere liye) sabr karna hi behtar hai us cheez ke khilaf jo tum daava karte ho; sirf Allah (akele) hai jiski Madad maangi ja sakti hai."' Phir main doosri taraf mudi aur apni bistar par let gaee; aur Allah ko pata tha main begunah hoon, aur mujhe ummeed thi ke Allah meri begunahi zaahir karega. Magar, Allah ki qasam, maine kabhi nahi socha ke Allah mere maamle ke baare mein aisa Divine Ilham bhejega jo (hamesha) padha jaayega, kyunke main khud ko itna gair-mahatvapurna maanti thi ke Allah mere baare mein kuch kahega, magar mujhe ummeed thi ke Allah ke Rasool ko ek khwab aayega jismein Allah meri begunahi saabit karega. Magar, Allah ki qasam, Allah ke Rasool ke apni jagah chhodne se pahle aur pariwara ke kisi sadasya ke jane se pahle, Divine Ilham Allah ke Rasool tak pahunch gaya. Isliye unhe wahi difficult haalat aee jo unhe Divine Ilham ane ke waqt aati thi. Unke shareer se paseena tapakne laga motiyon ki tarah chahe woh sardi ka din tha, aur yeh usse mahatvapurna baat ki wajah se tha jo unpar naazil ho rahi thi. Jab Allah ke Rasool ki yeh haalat khatm huee, woh muskurate hue uthe, aur unka pahla shabd tha, 'Aye Ayesha! Allah ne aapki begunahi ka elaan kiya hai!' Phir meri maa ne mujhse kaha, 'Utho aur unke (yaani Allah ke Rasool ke) paas jao.' Maine jawab diya, 'Allah ki qasam, main unke paas nahi jaunga, aur main sirf Allah ki taarif karta hoon.' Isliye Allah ne das Ayaten naazil ki: 'Sach mein, jinhone yeh jhoota ilzaam phailaya hai, ve tum hi mein se ek giroh hain...' (24:11-20) Allah ne yeh Quranic Ayaten meri begunahi zaahir karne ke liye naazil ki. Abu Bakr As-Siddiq jo Mistah bin Uthatha ke liye paisa kharch karte the unke rishte aur gareebi ki wajah se, ne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, main Mistah bin Uthatha ko kabhi kuch nahi dunga uske jo kuch unhone Ayesha ke baare mein kaha uske baad.' Phir Allah ne naazil kiya: 'Aur tum mein se jo samarth aur daulatmand hain unhe qasam nahi khaani chahiye (kisi madad na dene ki) apne rishtedaron, gareebon, aur unke jinhone Allah ki khaatir apne ghar chhode hain, unhe maaf karna aur kshama karna chahiye. Kya aap yeh pasand nahi karte ke Allah aapko maaf kare? Aur Allah bahut zyada Kshamashil, Rehmaan hai.' (24:22) Abu Bakr As-Siddiq ne kaha, 'Haan, Allah ki qasam, mujhe achha lagega agar Allah mujhe maaf kare.' aur unhone phir Mistah ko woh paisa dena shuru kiya jo woh pahle dete the. Unhone yeh bhi joda, 'Allah ki qasam, main unhe kabhi isse vanchit nahi karunga.' Ayesha ne aage kaha: Allah ke Rasool ne Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Jahsh (رضی اللہ عنہا) (yaani apni biwi) se bhi mere maamle ke baare mein pucha. Unhone Zainab se kaha, 'Aapko kya pata hai aur aapne kya dekha?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Main jhoote daave se bachti hoon ke maine kuch suna ya dekha hai. Allah ki qasam, main achhe ke siwa kuch nahi jaanti (Ayesha ke baare mein).' Nabi ki biwiyon mein se, Zainab meri barabar thi (khoobsurati mein aur unko milne wali mohabbat mein), magar Allah ne unhe us buraee se apni pakbaazi ki wajah se bacha liya. Unki behn, Hamna, unke liye jhagda karne lagi, aur woh barbaad hue logon ke saath barbaad hue. Jinke baare mein ilzaam lagaya gaya tha, unhone kaha, 'Subhan-Allah! Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haathon mein meri jaan hai, maine kabhi kisi aurat ka parda nahi khola.' Baad mein woh shaks Allah ki raah mein shaheed hue.

e: Narrated Az-Zuhri:Al-Walid bin `Abdul Malik said to me, "Have you heard that `Ali' was one of those who slandered `Aisha?" I replied, "No, but two men from your people (named) Abu Salama bin `Abdur-Rahman and Abu Bakr bin `Abdur-Rahman bin Al-Harith have informed me that Aisha told them that `Ali remained silent about her case
hi: Az-Zuhri bataate hain: Al-Walid bin Abdul Malik ne mujhse kaha, "Kya tumne suna hai ke Ali (Alayhis Salam) (bin Abi Talib) unmein the jinhone Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) par ilzaam lagaya?" Maine jawab diya, "Nahi, magar aapke logon mein se do log, Abu Salama bin Abdur-Rahman aur Abu Bakr bin Abdur-Rahman bin Al-Harith, ne mujhe bataya ke Ayesha ne unse kaha ke Ali (Alayhis Salam) unke maamle mein khaamosh rahe."

e: Narrated Masruq bin Al-Ajda:Um Ruman, the mother of `Aisha said that while `Aisha and she were sitting, an Ansari woman came and said, "May Allah harm such and-such a person!" Um Ruman said to her, What is the matter?" She replied, "My son was amongst those who talked of the story (of the Slander)." Um Ruman said, "What is that?" She said, "So-and-so..." and narrated the whole story. On that `Aisha said, "Did Allah's Apostle hear about that?" She replied, "Yes." `Aisha further said, "And Abu Bakr too?" She replied, "Yes." On that, `Aisha fell down fainting, and when she came to her senses, she had got fever with rigors. I put her clothes over her and covered her. The Prophet (ﷺ) came and asked, "What is wrong with this (lady)?" Um Ruman replied, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! She (i.e. `Aisha) has got temperature with rigors." He said, "Perhaps it is because of the story that has been talked about?" She said, "Yes." `Aisha sat up and said, "By Allah, if I took an oath (that I am innocent), you would not believe me, and if I said (that I am not innocent), you would not excuse me. My and your example is like that of Jacob and his sons (as Jacob said ): 'It is Allah (Alone) Whose Help can be sought against that you assert.' Um Ruman said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) then went out saying nothing. Then Allah declared her innocence. On that, `Aisha said (to the Prophet), "I thank Allah only; thank neither anybody else nor you
hi: Masruq bin Al-Ajda bataate hain: Um Ruman, Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ki maa, ne kaha ke jabke Ayesha aur woh baithi thi, ek Ansaari aurat aee aur boli, "Allah aise-aise shaks ko nuksaan pahunchae!" Um Ruman ne unse kaha, "Kya baat hai?" Unhone jawab diya, "Mera beta un logon mein tha jinhone us kahani (yaani jhoote ilzaam) ke baare mein baat ki." Um Ruman ne pucha, "Woh kya hai?" Unhone kaha, "Falaan-falaan..." aur poori kahani sunaee. Ispar Ayesha ne kaha, "Kya Allah ke Rasool ne iske baare mein suna?" Unhone jawab diya, "Haan." Ayesha ne phir pucha, "Aur Abu Bakr bhi?" Unhone jawab diya, "Haan." Ispar, Ayesha behosh hokar gir gaee, aur jab unhe hosh aaya, unhe thand wale bukhaar ke saath bukhaar aa gaya. Maine unke kapde unke oopar daale aur unhe dhaanka. Nabi aaye aur pucha, "Ise (yaani Ayesha ko) kya hua hai?" Um Ruman ne jawab diya, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Unhe (yaani Ayesha ko) thand wale bukhaar ke saath bukhaar aa gaya hai." Unhone kaha, "Shaayad yeh us kahani ki wajah se hai jo baat ki ja rahi hai?" Unhone kaha, "Haan." Ayesha uth baithi aur kaha, "Allah ki qasam, agar main qasam khaun (ke main begunah hoon), aap mujhpar vishwas nahi karenge, aur agar main (kahun ke main begunah nahi hoon), aap mujhe maaf nahi karenge. Meri aur aapki misaal Yaqoob aur unke beton jaisi hai (jaisa Yaqoob ne kaha): 'Sirf Allah (akele) hai jiski Madad maangi ja sakti hai us cheez ke khilaf jo tum daava karte ho.'" Um Ruman ne kaha, "Nabi phir kuch kahe bina bahar gaye. Phir Allah ne unki begunahi ka elaan kiya." Ispar, Ayesha ne (Nabi se) kaha, "Main sirf Allah ka shukriya ada karti hoon; na kisi aur ka na aapka."

e: Narrated Ibn Abi Mulaika:`Aisha used to recite this Verse:-- 'Ida taliqunahu bi-alsinatikum' (24.15) "(As you tell lie with your tongues.)" and used to say "Al-Walaq" means "telling of a lie. "She knew this Verse more than anybody else as it was revealed about her
hi: Ibn Abi Mulaika bataate hain: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) yeh Ayat padha karti thi: "Ida taliqunahu bi-alsinatikum" (24:15) (yaani jab tum apni zubanon se jhoot bolte ho), aur woh kahti thi ke "Al-Walaq" ka matlab hai "jhoot bolna." Woh is Ayat ko kisi se zyada achhi tarah jaanti thi kyunke yeh unke baare mein naazil huee thi.

e: Narrated Hisham's father:I started abusing Hassan in front of `Aisha. She said, "Do not abuse him as he used to defend Allah's Apostle (against the infidels). `Aisha added, "Once Hassan took the permission from the Prophet (ﷺ) to say poetic verses against the infidels. On that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'How will you exclude my forefathers (from that)? Hassan replied, 'I will take you out of them as one takes a hair out of the dough." Hisham's father added, "I abused Hassan as he was one of those who spoke against `Aisha
hi: Hisham ke waalid bataate hain: Main Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke saamne Hassan ki buraee karna shuru kiya. Unhone kaha, "Unki buraee mat karo, kyunke woh Allah ke Rasool ki (kaafiron ke khilaf) hifaazat karte the." Ayesha ne joda, "Ek baar Hassan ne Nabi se kaafiron ke khilaf kavita likhne ki ijazat maangi. Ispar Nabi ne kaha, 'Tum mere purvajon ko kaise bahar rakhoge (is kavita se)?' Hassan ne jawab diya, 'Main aapko unme se aise nikaalunga jaise aate se ek baal nikala jata hai.'" Hisham ke waalid ne joda, "Maine Hassan ki buraee ki kyunke woh un logon mein se the jinhone Ayesha ke khilaf baat ki thi."

e: Narrated Masruq:We went to `Aisha while Hassan bin Thabit was with her reciting poetry to her from some of his poetic verses, saying "A chaste wise lady about whom nobody can have suspicion. She gets up with an empty stomach because she never eats the flesh of indiscreet (ladies)." `Aisha said to him, "But you are not like that." I said to her, "Why do you grant him admittance, though Allah said:-- "and as for him among them, who had the greater share therein, his will be a severe torment." (24.11) On that, `Aisha said, "And what punishment is more than blinding?" She, added, "Hassan used to defend or say poetry on behalf of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (against the infidels)
hi: Masruq bataate hain: Hum Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas gaye jabke Hassan bin Thabit unke saath the, unhein apni kuch kavitaon mein se ek sunate hue, kahte huye, "Ek pakbaz, ilm waala mahila jinke baare mein koee bhi shak nahi kar sakta. Woh khali pet uthti hai kyunke woh aparadhsheel aurton ka gosht kabhi nahi khati." Ayesha ne unse kaha, "Magar aap aise nahi hain." Maine unse kaha, "Aap unhe (andar aane ki) ijazat kyun deti hain, jabke Allah ne kaha: 'Aur unmein se jiska hissa ismein (yaani ilzaam phailane mein) sabse zyada tha, uske liye sakht saza hai'? (24:11)" Ispar, Ayesha ne kaha, "Aur andhe ho jane se badtar koee saza kya hai?" Unhone joda, "Hassan Allah ke Rasool ki (kaafiron ke khilaf) hifaazat karte the ya unke liye kavita likhte the."

e: Narrated Zaid bin Khalid:We went out with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the year of Al-Hudaibiya. One night it rained and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) led us in the Fajr prayer and (after finishing it), turned to us and said, "Do you know what your Lord has said?" We replied, "Allah and His Apostle know it better." He said, "Allah said:-- "(Some of) My slaves got up believing in Me, And (some of them) disbelieving in Me. The one who said: We have been given Rain through Allah's Mercy and Allah's Blessing and Allah's Bounty, then he is a believer in Me, and is a disbeliever in the star. And whoever said: We have been given rain because of such and- such star, then he is a believer in the star, and is a disbeliever in Me
hi: Zaid bin Khalid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Allah ke Rasool ke saath Al-Hudaibiya ke saal nikle. Ek raat barish huee aur Allah ke Rasool ne humein Fajr ki namaz padhaee, aur (namaz khatam karke) humari taraf mude aur kaha, "Kya tumhe pata hai tumhare Rab ne kya kaha hai?" Humne jawab diya, "Allah aur uske Rasool behtar jaante hain." Unhone kaha, "Allah ne kaha: '(Kuch) mere bande mujhpar iman rakhte hue jage, aur (kuch) mujhpar avishvaas karte hue. Jisne kaha: Humein Allah ki rehmat, Allah ki barkat, aur Allah ke daan se barish di gaee hai, phir woh mujhpar iman rakhta hai aur sitare ka avishvaas karta hai. Aur jisne kaha: Humein falaan-falaan sitare ki wajah se barish di gaee hai, phir woh sitare par iman rakhta hai aur mera avishvaas karta hai.'"

e: Narrated Anas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) performed four `Umras, all in the month of Dhul-Qa'da, except the one which he performed with his Hajj (i.e. in Dhul-Hijja). He performed one `Umra from Al-Hudaibiya in Dhul- Qa'da, another `Umra in the following year in Dhul Qa'da a third from Al-Jirana where he distributed the war booty of Hunain, in Dhul Qa'da, and the fourth `Umra he performed was with his Hajj
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne chaar Umrah kiye, sab Dhul-Qa'da mahine mein, siwaye us ek ke jo unhone apne Hajj ke saath kiya (yaani Dhul-Hijja mein). Unhone ek Umrah Al-Hudaibiya se Dhul-Qa'da mein kiya, ek doosra Umrah agle saal Dhul-Qa'da mein, teesra Al-Jirana se jahaan unhone Hunain ke maal-e-ghanimat ko baanta, Dhul-Qa'da mein, aur chautha Umrah unhone apne Hajj ke saath kiya.

e: Narrated Abu Qatada:We set out with the Prophet (ﷺ) in the year of Al-Hudaibiya, and all his companions assumed the state of Ihram but I did not
hi: Abu Qatada (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Nabi ke saath Al-Hudaibiya ke saal nikle, aur unke sab sahaba ne Ihram ki haalat dhaaran ki magar maine nahi ki.

e: Narrated Al-Bara:Do you (people) consider the conquest of Mecca, the Victory (referred to in the Qur'an 48:1). Was the conquest of Mecca a victory? We really consider that the actual Victory was the Ar-Ridwan Pledge of allegiance which we gave on the day of Al-Hudaibiya (to the Prophet) . On the day of Al-Hudaibiya we were fourteen hundred men along with the Prophet (ﷺ) Al-Hudaibiya was a well, the water of which we used up leaving not a single drop of water in it. When the Prophet (ﷺ) was informed of that, he came and sat on its edge. Then he asked for a utensil of water, performed ablution from it, rinsed (his mouth), invoked (Allah), and poured the remaining water into the well. We stayed there for a while and then the well brought forth what we required of water for ourselves and our riding animals
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Kya tum log Mecca ki fatah ko woh Fatah (yaani Vijay, jiska zikar Quran 48:1 mein hai) mante ho? Kya Mecca ki fatah ek Vijay thi? Hum sach mein mante hain ke asli Vijay Ar-Ridwan bai'at thi jo humne Al-Hudaibiya ke din di thi (Nabi ko). Al-Hudaibiya ke din, hum ek hazaar chaar sau log the Nabi ke saath. Al-Hudaibiya ek kuaan tha, jiska paani humne istemal kiya jab tak ismein ek bund bhi paani nahi bacha. Jab Nabi ko iski khabar mili, woh aaye aur uske kinare par baith gaye. Phir unhone paani ka ek bartan maanga, usse wudu kiya, kulla kiya, dua ki, aur baaki paani kue mein daal diya. Hum wahaan kuch der ruke aur phir kue ne humare liye aur humare sawari ke janwaron ke liye jaroorat jitna paani diya.

e: Narrated Al-Bara bin Azib:That they were in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the day of Al-Hudaibiya and their number was 1400 or more. They camped at a well and drew its water till it was dried. When they informed Allah's Apostle of that, he came and sat over its edge and said, "Bring me a bucket of its water." When it was brought, he spat and invoked (Allah) and said, "Leave it for a while." Then they quenched their thirst and watered their riding animals (from that well) till they departed
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Woh Allah ke Rasool ke saath Al-Hudaibiya ke din the aur unki tadaad ek hazaar chaar sau ya usse zyada thi. Woh ek kue ke paas padaav daale the aur uska paani nikala jab tak yeh sookh gaya. Jab unhone Allah ke Rasool ko iski khabar di, woh aaye aur uske kinare baith gaye aur kaha, "Iska ek baalti paani mere liye lao." Jab woh laaya gaya, unhone usmein thooka aur dua ki aur kaha, "Ise thoda der ke liye chhod do." Phir unhone apni pyaas bujhaee aur apne sawari ke janwaron ko paani pilaya jab tak woh wahaan se chal pade.

e: Narrated Salim:Jabir said "On the day of Al-Hudaibiya, the people felt thirsty and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had a utensil containing water. He performed ablution from it and then the people came towards him. Allah's Apostle said, 'What is wrong with you?' The people said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We haven't got any water to perform ablution with or to drink, except what you have in your utensil.' So the Prophet (ﷺ) put his hand in the utensil and the water started spouting out between his fingers like springs. So we drank and performed ablution." I said to Jabir, "What was your number on that day?" He replied, "Even if we had been one hundred thousand, that water would have been sufficient for us. Anyhow, we were
hi: Salim bataate hain: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Al-Hudaibiya ke din, log pyase ho gaye aur Allah ke Rasool ke paas paani se bhara ek bartan tha. Unhone usse wudu kiya aur phir log unki taraf badhe. Allah ke Rasool ne pucha, 'Tumhe kya hua hai?' Logon ne kaha, 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Humare paas wudu ya pine ke liye koee paani nahi hai siwaye jo aapke bartan mein hai.' Isliye Nabi ne apna haath bartan mein daala aur paani unki ungliyon ke beech se sroton jaisa nikalne laga. Isliye humne piya aur wudu kiya." Maine Jabir se pucha, "Us din tum kitne the?" Unhone jawab diya, "Chahe hum ek lakh hote, woh paani humare liye kaafi hota, phir bhi hum..."

e: Narrated Qatada:I said to Sa`id bin Al-Musaiyab, "I have been informed that Jabir bin `Abdullah said that the number (of Al-Hudaibiya Muslim warriors) was 1400." Sa`id said to me, "Jabir narrated to me that they were 1500 who gave the Pledge of allegiance to the Prophet (ﷺ) on the day of Al-Hudaibiya
hi: Qatada bataate hain: Maine Sa'id bin Al-Musaiyab se kaha, "Mujhe bataya gaya hai ke Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha ke (Al-Hudaibiya ke Musalman mujahidon ki) tadaad ek hazaar chaar sau thi." Sa'id ne mujhse kaha, "Jabir ne mujhse riwaayat ki ke woh ek hazaar paanch sau the jinhone Al-Hudaibiya ke din Nabi ko bai'at di."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:On the day of Al-Hudaibiya, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to us' "You are the best people on the earth!" We were 1400 then. If I could see now, I would have shown you the place of the Tree (beneath which we gave the Pledge of Allegiance)." Salim said, "Our number was
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Al-Hudaibiya ke din, Allah ke Rasool ne humse kaha, "Tum zameen par sabse behtareen log ho!" Hum us waqt ek hazaar chaar sau the. Agar main abhi dekh pata, main tumhe darakht ki jagah dikhata (jiske neeche humne Bai'at di). Salim ne kaha, "Humari tadaad..."

e: Abdullah bin Abi `Aufa said, "The people (who gave the Pledge of allegiance) under the Tree numbered 1300 and the number of Bani Aslam was 1/8 of the Emigrants
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Aufa bataate hain: Darakht ke neeche (bai'at dene wale) log ek hazaar teen sau the, aur Banu Aslam ki tadaad Muhajir ki tadaad ka ek-aathvaan hissa thi.

e: Narrated Mirdas Al-Aslami:Who was among those (who had given the Pledge of allegiance) under the Tree: Pious people will die in succession, and there will remain the dregs of society who will be like the useless residues of dates and barley and Allah will pay no attention to them
hi: Mirdas Al-Aslami bataate hain (jo darakht ke neeche bai'at dene walon mein se the): Pakbaz log ek-ek karke intiqal kar jaenge, aur samaj ke tale ke log baaki rah jaenge, jo khajoor aur jau ke bekaar chhilkon jaise honge, aur Allah unhe koee mahatva nahi dega.

e: Narrated Marwan and Al-Miswar bin Makhrama:The Prophet (ﷺ) went out in the company of 1300 to 1500 of his companions in the year of Al-Hudaibiya, and when they reached Dhul-Hulaifa, he garlanded and marked his Hadi and assumed the state of Ihram
hi: Marwan aur Al-Miswar bin Makhrama (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ek hazaar teen sau se paanchon sau ke beech apne sathiyon ke saath Al-Hudaibiya ke saal nikle, aur jab woh Dhul-Hulaifa pahunche, unhone apni Hadi (yaani qurbani ke janwar) par malaen daali aur use nishaanit kiya aur Ihram ki haalat dhaaran ki.

e: Narrated Ka`b bin Ujra:That Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw him with the lice falling (from his head) on his face. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Are your lice troubling you? Ka`b said, "Yes." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) thus ordered him to shave his head while he was at Al-Hudaibiya. Up to then there was no indication that all of them would finish their state of Ihram and they hoped that they would enter Mecca. Then the order of Al-Fidya was revealed, so Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered Ka`b to feed six poor persons with one Faraq of food or slaughter a sheep or fast for three days
hi: Ka'b bin Ujra bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne unhe dekha jinke sar se joonen (yaani joon) unke chehre par gir rahi thi. Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Kya joonen tumhe pareshaan kar rahi hain?" Ka'b ne kaha, "Haan." Isliye Allah ke Rasool ne unhe apna sar munwane ka hukum diya jabke woh Al-Hudaibiya mein the. Us waqt tak koee ishara nahi tha ke woh sab Ihram khatm karenge aur unhe ummeed thi ke woh Mecca daakhil honge. Phir Al-Fidya (yaani prayaschit) ka hukum naazil hua, isliye Allah ke Rasool ne Ka'b ko chhah gareebon ko khilane ka hukum diya ek Faraq (naap) khaane se, ya ek bhed zabah karne ka, ya teen din roza rakhne ka.

e: (Narrated Aslam:Once I went with `Umar bin Al-Khattab to the market. A young woman followed `Umar and said, "O chief of the believers! My husband has died, leaving little children. By Allah, they have not even a sheep's trotter to cook; they have no farms or animals. I am afraid that they may die because of hunger, and I am the daughter of Khufaf bin Ima Al-Ghafari, and my father witnessed the Pledge of allegiance) of Al-Hudaibiya with the Prophet.' `Umar stopped and did not proceed, and said, "I welcome my near relative." Then he went towards a strong camel which was tied in the house, and carried on to it, two sacks he had loaded with food grains and put between them money and clothes and gave her its rope to hold and said, "Lead it, and this provision will not finish till Allah gives you a good supply." A man said, "O chief of the believers! You have given her too much." "`Umar said disapprovingly. "May your mother be bereaved of you! By Allah, I have seen her father and brother besieging a fort for a long time and conquering it, and then we were discussing what their shares they would have from that war booty
hi: Aslam bataate hain: Ek baar main Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab ke saath bazaar gaya. Ek jawan aurat Umar ke peeche aee aur kaha, "Aye Mominon ke Ameer! Mere shohar ka intiqal ho gaya hai, chhote bachche chhodkar. Allah ki qasam, unke paas pakane ke liye ek bhed ki taang bhi nahi hai; unke paas na khet hain na janwar. Mujhe dar hai ke woh bhookh se mar na jaen, aur main Khufaf bin Ima Al-Ghafari ki beti hoon, aur mere waalid ne Nabi ke saath Al-Hudaibiya ki bai'at dekhi thi." Umar ruke aur aage nahi badhe, aur kaha, "Main apne qareebi rishtedaar ka swagat karta hoon." Phir woh ek takatvaar unt ki taraf gaye jo ghar mein baandha hua tha, aur uspar unhone do bore laade jinmein unhone anaaj bhara tha, aur beech mein paisa aur kapde rakhe, aur uski rassi unhe pakadne ko di aur kaha, "Ise le jao, aur yeh saamaan tab tak khatm nahi hoga jab tak Allah tumhe achhi zeevika na de." Ek shaks ne kaha, "Aye Mominon ke Ameer! Aapne unhe bahut zyada de diya hai." Umar ne napasand karte huye kaha, "Teri maa tumhe khoe! Allah ki qasam, maine unke waalid aur bhai ko ek qile ka lamba ghera daalte aur use fatah karte dekha hai, aur phir hum charcha kar rahe the ke us jung mein unke kya hisse honge."

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Al-Musaiyab:That his father said, "I saw the Tree (of the Ar-Ridwan Pledge of allegiance) and when I returned to it later, I was not able to recognize it. (The sub--narrator Mahmud said, Al-Musaiyab said, 'Then I forgot it (i.e., the Tree)
hi: Sa'id bin Al-Musaiyab bataate hain (apne waalid se): "Maine woh darakht dekha (jiske neeche Ar-Ridwan ki bai'at di gaee) aur jab main baad mein wapas aaya, main use pahchan nahi paya." (Subordinate raawi Mahmud ne kaha, Al-Musaiyab ne kaha, "Phir main ise (yaani darakht ko) bhool gaya.")

e: Narrated Tariq bin `Abdur-Rahman:When I set out for Hajj, I passed by some people offering a prayer, I asked, "What is this mosque?" They said, "This is the Tree where Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took the Ar-Ridwan Pledge of allegiance. Then I went to Sa`id bin Musaiyab and informed him about it. Sa`id said, "My father said that he was amongst those who had given the Pledge of allegiance to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) beneath the Tree. He (i.e. my father) said, "When we set out the following year, we forgot the Tree and were unable to recognize it. "Then Sa`id said (perhaps ironically) "The companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) could not recognize it; nevertheless, you do recognize it; therefore you have a better knowledge
hi: Tariq bin Abdur-Rahman bataate hain: Jab main Hajj ke liye nikla, main kuch logon ke paas se guzra jo namaz padh rahe the. Maine pucha, "Yeh kaunsi masjid hai?" Unhone kaha, "Yeh woh darakht hai jahaan Allah ke Rasool ne Ar-Ridwan bai'at li thi." Phir main Sa'id bin Musaiyab ke paas gaya aur unhe iske baare mein bataya. Sa'id ne kaha, "Mere waalid ne kaha ke woh un logon mein the jinhone Allah ke Rasool ko us darakht ke neeche bai'at di thi. Unhone (yaani mere waalid ne) kaha, 'Jab humne agle saal prasthaan kiya, hum darakht ko bhool gaye aur use pahchaanne mein asamartha rahe.'" Phir Sa'id ne kaha (shaayad vyangatmak tor par), "Nabi ke sahaba use pahchan nahi paye; phir bhi tum ise pahchante ho; isliye tumhe behtar ilm hai."

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Al-Musaiyab:That his father was amongst those who had given the Pledge of allegiance (to the Prophet (ﷺ) ) beneath the Tree, and the next year when they went towards the Tree, they were not able to recognize it
hi: Sa'id bin Al-Musaiyab bataate hain (apne waalid se): Woh un logon mein the jinhone darakht ke neeche (Nabi ko) bai'at di thi, aur agle saal jab woh darakht ki taraf gaye, woh use pahchaanne mein asamartha rahe.

e: Narrated Tariq:(The tree where the Ridwan Pledge of allegiance was taken by the Prophet) was mentioned before Sa`id bin Al-Musaiyab. On that he smiled and said, "My father informed me (about it) and he had witnessed it (i.e. the Pledge)
hi: Tariq bataate hain: (Woh darakht jahaan Ridwan bai'at Nabi dwaara li gaee thi) Sa'id bin Al-Musaiyab ke saamne iska zikar hua. Ispar woh muskurae aur kaha, "Mere waalid ne mujhe (iske baare mein) bataya aur unhone ise dekha tha (yaani us bai'at ko)."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abi `Aufa:(Who was one of those who had given the Pledge of allegiance to the Prophet (ﷺ) beneath the Tree) When the people brought Sadaqa (i.e. Zakat) to the Prophet (ﷺ) he used to say, "O Allah! Bless them with your Mercy." Once my father came with his Sadaqa to him whereupon he (i.e. the Prophet) said. "O Allah! Bless the family of Abu `Aufa
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Aufa bataate hain (jo un logon mein se the jinhone darakht ke neeche Nabi ko bai'at di thi): Jab log Nabi ke paas Sadaqa (yaani Zakat) laate, woh kahte, "Aye Allah! Inhe apni Rehmat se barkat de." Ek baar mere waalid apni Sadaqa lekar unke paas aaye, ispar unhone (yaani Nabi ne) kaha, "Aye Allah! Abu Aufa ke pariwara ko barkat de."

e: Narrated `Abbas bin Tamim:When it was the day (of the battle) of Al-Harra the people were giving Pledge of allegiance to `Abdullah bin Hanzala. Ibn Zaid said, "For what are the people giving Pledge of allegiance to `Abdullah bin Hanzala?" It was said to him, "For death." Ibn Zaid said, "I will never give the Pledge of allegiance for that to anybody else after Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ." Ibn Zaid was one of those who had witnessed the day of Al-Hudaibiya with the Prophet
hi: Abbas bin Tamim bataate hain: Jab Al-Harra ki jung ka din tha, log Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Hanzala ko Bai'at de rahe the. Ibn Zaid ne pucha, "Log Abdullah bin Hanzala ko kis cheez ke liye Bai'at de rahe hain?" Unse kaha gaya, "Maut ke liye." Ibn Zaid ne kaha, "Main iske liye Allah ke Rasool ke baad kabhi kisi aur ko Bai'at nahi dunga." Ibn Zaid un logon mein se ek the jinhone Al-Hudaibiya ka din Nabi ke saath dekha tha.

e: Narrated Iyas bin Salama bin Al-Akwa`:My father who was amongst those who had given the Pledge of allegiance to the Prophet (ﷺ) beneath the Tree, said to me, "We used to offer the Jumua prayer with the Prophet (ﷺ) and then depart at a time when the walls had no shade for us to take shelter in
hi: Iyas bin Salama bin Al-Akwa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Mere waalid, jo un logon mein the jinhone darakht ke neeche Nabi ko bai'at di tha, ne mujhse kaha, "Hum Jumme ki namaz Nabi ke saath padhte the aur phir aise waqt chale jate jab deewaron ki koee chhaye nahi hoti thi jahaan hum panah le saken."

e: Narrated Yazid bin Abi Ubaid:I said to Salama bin Al-Akwa`, "For what did you give the Pledge of allegiance to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the day of Al-Hudaibiya?" He replied, "For death (in the Cause of Islam)
hi: Yazid bin Abi Ubaid bataate hain: Maine Salama bin Al-Akwa (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha, "Aapne Al-Hudaibiya ke din Allah ke Rasool ko kis cheez ke liye Bai'at di?" Unhone jawab diya, "Maut ke liye (Islam ki khaatir)."

e: Narrated Al-Musaiyab:I met Al-Bara bin `Azib and said (to him). "May you live prosperously! You enjoyed the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) and gave him the Pledge of allegiance (of Al-Hudaibiya) under the Tree." On that, Al- Bara' said, "O my nephew! You do not know what we have done after him (i.e. his death)
hi: Al-Musaiyab bataate hain: Main Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) se mila aur (unse) kaha, "Aap samriddh zindagi jiye! Aapne Nabi ki sohbat paee aur unhe (Al-Hudaibiya ki) Bai'at di darakht ke neeche." Ispar Al-Bara ne kaha, "Aye mere bhatije! Aapko nahi pata hum unke baad kya kar chuke hain (yaani unki maut ke baad)."

e: Narrated Abu Qilaba:that Thabit bin Ad-Dahhak had informed him that he was one of those who had given the Pledge of allegiance (of Al-Hudaibiya) beneath the Tree
hi: Abu Qilaba bataate hain: Thabit bin Ad-Dahhak ne unhe bataya ke woh un logon mein the jinhone darakht ke neeche (Al-Hudaibiya ki) Bai'at di thi.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:regarding Allah's Statement: "Verily! We have granted you (O, Muhammad) Manifest victory." (48.1) It refers to the Al-Hudaibiya Pledge. And the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) said (to the Prophet), "Congratulations and happiness for you; but what reward shall we get?" So Allah revealed:-- "That He may admit the believing men and women to gardens beneath which rivers flow
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain (Allah ke is farmaan ke baare mein): "Beshak, Humne aapko (Aye Muhammad) ek saaf Vijay diya hai." (48:1) Yeh Al-Hudaibiya ki Bai'at ka ishara hai. Aur Nabi ke sahaba ne (unse) kaha, "Aapko mubaarak ho aur khushi ho; magar humein kya ajr milega?" Ispar Allah ne naazil kiya: "Taaki woh momin mardon aur aurton ko baagon mein daakhil kare jinke neeche nadiyaan behti hain..."

e: Narrated Zahir Al-Aslami:(who was one of those who had witnessed (the Pledge of allegiance beneath) the Tree) While I was making fire beneath the cooking pots containing donkey's meat, the announcer of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) announced, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbids you to eat donkey's meat
hi: Zahir Al-Aslami bataate hain (jo un logon mein se the jinhone darakht ke neeche (Bai'at) dekhi thi): Jabke main gadhe ke gosht wale bartan ke neeche aag jala raha tha, Allah ke Rasool ke elaan karne wale ne elaan kiya, "Allah ke Rasool tumhe gadhe ka gosht khaane se mana karte hain."

e: The same narration was told by Majzaa from a man called Uhban bin Aus who was one of those who had witnessed (the Pledge of allegiance beneath) the Tree., and who had some trouble in his knee so that while doing prostrations, he used to put a pillow underneath his knee
hi: (yehi riwaayat Majzaa ne ek shaks se sunaee jinka naam Uhban bin Aus tha, jo un logon mein se ek the jinhone darakht ke neeche (Bai'at) dekhi thi, aur jinke ghutne mein kuch takleef thi, isliye sajda karte waqt, woh apne ghutne ke neeche ek takiya rakhte the.)

e: Narrated Suwaid bin An-Nu`man:who was one of those who witnessed (the Pledge of allegiance beneath) the Tree: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and his companions were given Sawiq and they chewed it
hi: Suwaid bin An-Nu'man (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain (jo un logon mein se the jinhone darakht ke neeche (Bai'at) dekhi thi): Allah ke Rasool aur unke sahaba ko Sawiq (yaani pisa hua jau) diya gaya aur unhone use chabaya.

e: Narrated Abu Jamra:I asked Aidh bin `Amr, who was one of the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) one of those (who gave the allegiance to the Prophet (ﷺ) under the Tree): "Can the witr prayer be repeated (in one night)?" He said, "If you have offered it in the first part of the night, you should not repeat it in the last part of the night." (See Fath-ul-Bari page 458 Vol 8th)
hi: Abu Jamra bataate hain: Maine Aidh bin Amr se pucha, jo Nabi ke sahaba mein se the aur un logon mein se the jinhone darakht ke neeche Nabi ko Bai'at di thi, "Kya Witr ki namaz (ek raat mein) doharaee ja sakti hai?" Unhone kaha, "Agar aapne ise raat ke pahle hisse mein padha hai, aapko ise raat ke aakhri hisse mein doharana nahi chahiye."

e: Narrated Zaid bin Aslam:My father said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was proceeding at night on one of his journeys and `Umar bin Al- Khattab was going along with him. `Umar bin Al-Khattab asked him (about something) but Allah's Apostle did not answer him. `Umar asked him again, but he did not answer him. He asked him again (for the third time) but he did not answer him. On that `Umar bin Al-Khattab addressed himself saying, "May your mother be bereaved of you, O `Umar, for you have asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) thrice, yet he has not answered you." `Umar said, "Then I made my camel run fast and took it in front of the other Muslims, and I was afraid that something might be revealed in my connection. I had hardly waited for a moment when I heard somebody calling me. I said, 'I was afraid that something might have been revealed about me.' Then I came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and greeted him. He (i.e. the Prophet) said, 'Tonight there has been revealed to me, a Sura which is dearer to me than (all the world) on which the sun rises,' and then he recited: 'Verily! We have granted you (O Muhammad) A manifest victory
hi: Zaid bin Aslam bataate hain (apne waalid se): Allah ke Rasool apne ek safar ki raat mein aage badh rahe the aur Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab unke saath ja rahe the. Umar bin Al-Khattab ne unse (kuch) pucha, magar Allah ke Rasool ne unhe jawab nahi diya. Umar ne phir pucha, magar unhone phir jawab nahi diya. Unhone phir pucha (teesri baar), magar unhone phir jawab nahi diya. Ispar Umar bin Al-Khattab ne khud se kaha, "Teri maa tumhe khoe, Aye Umar, kyunke tumne Allah ke Rasool se teen baar pucha, phir bhi unhone tumhe jawab nahi diya." Umar ne kaha, "Phir maine apne unt ko tezi se daudaya aur use doosre Musalmanon se aage le liya, aur mujhe dar tha ke mere silsile mein kuch naazil ho sakta hai. Main mushkil se ek pal ruka tha jab maine kisi ko mujhe bulate suna. Maine kaha, 'Mujhe dar tha mere baare mein kuch naazil hua hoga.' Phir main Allah ke Rasool ke paas aaya aur unhe salaam kiya. Unhone (yaani Nabi ne) kaha, 'Aaj raat mujhpar ek Surah naazil huee hai jo mujhe (saari duniya) se, jispar suraj chadhta hai, zyada pyari hai,' aur phir unhone padha: 'Beshak, Humne aapko (Aye Muhammad) ek saaf Vijay diya hai...'"

e: Narrated Al-Miswar bin Makhrama and Marwan bin Al-Hakam:(one of them said more than his friend): The Prophet (ﷺ) set out in the company of more than onethousand of his companions in the year of Al-Hudaibiya, and when he reached Dhul-Hulaifa, he garlanded his Hadi (i.e. sacrificing animal), assumed the state of Ihram for `Umra from that place and sent a spy of his from Khuzi'a (tribe). The Prophet (ﷺ) proceeded on till he reached (a village called) Ghadir-al-Ashtat. There his spy came and said, "The Quraish (infidels) have collected a great number of people against you, and they have collected against you the Ethiopians, and they will fight with you, and will stop you from entering the Ka`ba and prevent you." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O people! Give me your opinion. Do you recommend that I should destroy the families and offspring of those who want to stop us from the Ka`ba? If they should come to us (for peace) then Allah will destroy a spy from the pagans, or otherwise we will leave them in a miserable state." On that Abu Bakr said, "O Allah's Apostle! You have come with the intention of visiting this House (i.e. Ka`ba) and you do not want to kill or fight anybody. So proceed to it, and whoever should stop us from it, we will fight him." On that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Proceed on, in the Name of Allah
hi: Al-Miswar bin Makhrama (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Marwan bin Al-Hakam bataate hain (unmein se ek ne doosre se zyada bataya): Nabi apne ek hazaar se zyada sathiyon ke saath Al-Hudaibiya ke saal nikle, aur jab woh Dhul-Hulaifa pahunche, unhone apni Hadi (yaani qurbani ke janwar) par malaen daali, Umrah ke liye us jagah se Ihram ki haalat dhaaran ki, aur Khuza'a qabile se apni ek jaasoos bheji. Nabi aage badhe jab tak woh Ghadir-al-Ashtat (naam ki jagah) pahunche. Wahaan unki jaasoos aee aur kaha, "Quraish (kaafiron) ne aapke khilaf bahut sare log jama kiye hain, aur unhone Ethiopiyon ko bhi aapke khilaf jama kiya hai, aur woh aapse jung karenge, aur aapko Ka'ba mein daakhil hone se rokenge aur aapko rok denge." Nabi ne kaha, "Aye logo! Mujhe apni raay do. Kya tum sujhaav dete ho ke main un logon ke pariwaron aur santanon ko barbaad kar dun jo humein Ka'ba se rokna chahte hain? Agar woh (sulha ke liye) humare paas aate hain, phir Allah kaafiron ki ek jaasoos ko barbaad karega, warna hum unhe ek buri haalat mein chhod denge." Ispar Abu Bakr ne kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Aap is Ghar (yaani Ka'ba) ki ziyarat ke irade se aaye hain aur aap kisi ko qatl ya usse jung karna nahi chahte. Isliye ispar aage badhen, aur jo bhi humein isse rokne ki koshish kare, hum unse jung karenge." Ispar Nabi ne kaha, "Aage badho, Allah ke naam par."

e: Narrated `Urwa bin Az-Zubair:That he heard Marwan bin Al-Hakam and Al-Miswar bin Makhrama relating one of the events that happened to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the `Umra of Al-Hudaibiya. They said, "When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) concluded the truce with Suhail bin `Amr on the day of Al-Hudaibiya, one of the conditions which Suhail bin `Amr stipulated, was his saying (to the Prophet), "If anyone from us (i.e. infidels) ever comes to you, though he has embraced your religion, you should return him to us, and should not interfere between us and him." Suhail refused to conclude the truce with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) except on this condition. The believers disliked this condition and got disgusted with it and argued about it. But when Suhail refused to conclude the truce with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) except on that condition, Allah's Apostle concluded it. Accordingly, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then returned Abu Jandal bin Suhail to his father, Suhail bin `Amr, and returned every man coming to him from them during that period even if he was a Muslim. The believing women Emigrants came (to Medina) and Um Kulthum, the daughter of `Uqba bin Abi Mu'ait was one of those who came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and she was an adult at that time. Her relatives came, asking Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to return her to them, and in this connection, Allah revealed the Verses dealing with the believing (women)
hi: Urwa bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Unhone Marwan bin Al-Hakam aur Al-Miswar bin Makhrama (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko ek ghatna ka zikar karte suna jo Allah ke Rasool ke saath Al-Hudaibiya ke Umrah mein huee thi. Unhone kaha, "Jab Allah ke Rasool ne Suhail bin Amr ke saath Al-Hudaibiya ke din sulha ki, ek shart jo Suhail bin Amr ne rakhi, woh yeh kahte huye thi (Nabi se), 'Agar humme se koee bhi (yaani kaafiron mein se) kabhi aapke paas aata hai, chahe usne aapka deen qubool kar liya ho, aapko unhe humein wapas karna hoga, aur humare aur unke beech dakhal na dena hoga.' Suhail ne Allah ke Rasool ke saath sulha karne se inkaar kiya siwaye is shart par. Momin ko yeh shart napasand thi aur unhe isse ghini huee aur unhone iske baare mein baat ki. Magar jab Suhail ne Allah ke Rasool se sulha karne se inkaar kiya siwaye is shart ke, Allah ke Rasool ne use qubool kiya. Iske anusaar, Allah ke Rasool ne phir Abu Jandal bin Suhail ko unke waalid, Suhail bin Amr, ko wapas kar diya, aur us dauran unke paas aane wale har shaks ko wapas kiya, chahe woh Musalman hi kyun na ho. Momin Muhajir aurten (Madina) aee aur Um Kulthum, Uqba bin Abi Mu'ait ki beti, un logon mein se ek thi jo Allah ke Rasool ke paas aee, aur woh us waqt baalig thi. Unke rishtedaar aaye, Allah ke Rasool se unhe wapas karne ki guzarish karte huye, aur is silsile mein, Allah ne momin (aurton) se mutaliq Ayaten naazil ki."

e: Aisha said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to test all the believing women who migrated to him, with the following Verse:-- "O Prophet! When the believing Women come to you, to give the pledge of allegiance to you." (60.12) `Urwa's uncle said, "We were informed when Allah ordered His Apostle to return to the pagans what they had given to their wives who lately migrated (to Medina) and we were informed that Abu Basir..." relating the whole narration
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool har us momin aurat ki azmaish karte the jo unke paas hijrat karke aee, is Ayat ke zariye: "Aye Nabi! Jab momin aurten aapke paas Bai'at dene aien..." (60:12) Urwa ke chacha ne kaha, "Humein bataya gaya jab Allah ne apne Rasool ko hukum diya ke woh mushrikon ko woh wapas kar den jo unhone apni patni (yaani biwiyon) ko diya tha jo abhi haal hi mein hijrat karke aee thi, aur humein bataya gaya ke Abu Basir..." poori riwaayat sunate hue.

e: Narrated Nafi`:`Abdullah bin `Umar set out for Umra during the period of afflictions, and he said, "If I should be stopped from visiting the Ka`ba, I will do what we did when we were with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." He assumed Ihram for `Umra in the year of Al-Hudaibiya
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) Umrah ke liye nikle fitnon ke dauran, aur unhone kaha, "Agar mujhe Ka'ba ki ziyarat se roka jata hai, main woh karunga jo humne kiya jab hum Allah ke Rasool ke saath the." Unhone Umrah ke liye Ihram Al-Hudaibiya ke saal dhaaran kiya.

e: Narrated Nafi`:Ibn `Umar assumed Ihram and said, "If something should intervene between me and the Ka`ba, then I will do what the Prophet (ﷺ) did when the Quraish infidels intervened between him and (the Ka`ba). Then Ibn `Umar recited: "You have indeed in Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) A good example to follow
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Ihram dhaaran kiya aur kaha, "Agar kuch mere aur Ka'ba ke beech dakhal deta hai, phir main woh karunga jo Nabi ne kiya jab Quraish ke kaafiron ne unke aur (Ka'ba) ke beech dakhal diya." Phir Ibn Umar ne padha: "Aapke liye Allah ke Rasool mein ek achha udaaharan hai jiski pairvi ki ja sakti hai."

e: Narrated Nafi`:One of `Abdullah's sons said to `Abdullah (bin `Umar) "I wish you would stay this year (and not perform Hajj) as I am afraid that you will not be able to reach the Ka`ba." On that he (i.e. `Abdullah bin `Umar) said, "We went out with the Prophet (for `Umra), and when the Quraish infidels intervened between us and the Ka`ba, the Prophet (ﷺ) slaughtered his Hadi and shaved (his head), and his companions cut short their hair." Then `Abdullah bin `Umar said, "I make you witness that I have intended to perform `Umra and if I am allowed to reach the Ka`ba, I will perform the Tawaf, and if something (i.e. obstacles) intervene between me and the Ka`ba, then I will do what Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did." Then after going for a while, he said, "I consider the ceremonies (of both `Umra and Hajj as one and the same, so I would like you to witness that I have intended to perform Hajj along with my `Umra." So he performed only one Tawaf and one Sai (between Safa and Marwa) and finished the Ihram of both Umra and Hajj
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke beton mein se ek ne Abdullah (bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ)) se kaha, "Mujhe ummeed hoti ke aap is saal rukte (aur Hajj nahi karte) kyunke mujhe dar hai aap Ka'ba tak nahi pahunch payenge." Ispar unhone (yaani Abdullah bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne) kaha, "Hum Nabi (Umrah ke liye) ke saath nikle the, aur jab Quraish ke kaafiron ne humare aur Ka'ba ke beech dakhal diya, Nabi ne apni Hadi zabah ki aur apna sar munwaya, aur unke sahaba ne apne baal chhote kate." Phir Abdullah bin Umar ne kaha, "Main tumhe gawah banata hoon ke maine Umrah karne ka irada kiya hai aur agar mujhe Ka'ba tak pahunchne di jaati hai, main Tawaf karunga, aur agar kuch mere aur Ka'ba ke beech dakhal deta hai, phir main woh karunga jo Allah ke Rasool ne kiya." Phir kuch der chalne ke baad, unhone kaha, "Main donon (yaani Umrah aur Hajj) ki riwajon ko ek hi samajhta hoon, isliye main chahta hoon tum gawah bano ke maine Hajj bhi apni Umrah ke saath karne ka irada kiya hai." Isliye unhone sirf ek Tawaf aur ek Sai (Safa aur Marwa ke beech) kiya, aur donon Umrah aur Hajj ka Ihram khatm kiya.

e: Narrated Nafi`:The people used to say that Ibn `Umar had embraced Islam before `Umar. This is not true. What happened is that `Umar sent `Abdullah to bring his horse from an Ansari man so as to fight on it. At that time the people were giving the Pledge of allegiance to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) near the Tree, and `Umar was not aware of that. So `Abdullah (bin `Umar) gave the Pledge of Allegiance (to the Prophet) and went to take the horse and brought it to `Umar. While `Umar was putting on the armor to get ready for fighting, `Abdullah informed him that the people were giving the Pledge of allegiance to Allah's Apostle beneath the Tree. So `Umar set out and `Abdullah accompanied him till he gave the Pledge of allegiance to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and it was this event that made people say that Ibn `Umar had embraced Islam before `Umar
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Log kaha karte the ke Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Umar se pahle Islam qubool kiya tha. Yeh sach nahi hai. Jo hua woh yeh tha ke Umar ne Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko unka ghoda ek Ansaari shaks se lane bheja taaki woh uspar jung kar saken. Us waqt log darakht ke qareeb Allah ke Rasool ko Bai'at de rahe the, aur Umar ko iski khabar nahi thi. Isliye Abdullah (bin Umar) ne Bai'at di aur ghoda lene gaya aur use Umar ke paas laaya. Jabke Umar jung ke liye kavach pahne rahe the, Abdullah ne unhe bataya ke log darakht ke neeche Allah ke Rasool ko Bai'at de rahe hain. Isliye Umar nikle aur Abdullah unke saath the jab tak unhone (yaani Umar ne) Allah ke Rasool ko Bai'at di, aur yehi ghatna thi jisne logon ko kahne par majboor kiya ke Ibn Umar ne Umar se pahle Islam qubool kiya.

e: Abdullah bin `Umar added:"The people were along with the Prophet (ﷺ) on the day of Al-Hudaibiya spreading in the shade of the trees. Suddenly the people surrounded the Prophet (ﷺ) and started looking at him." `Umar said, "O `Abdullah! Go and see why the people are encircling Allah's Apostle and looking at him." `Abdullah bin `Umar then saw the people giving the Pledge of allegiance to the Prophet. So he also gave the Pledge of allegiance and returned to `Umar who went out in his turn and gave the Pledge of allegiance to the Prophet
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne joda: Log Al-Hudaibiya ke din Nabi ke saath darakhton ki chhaye mein phaile hue the. Achanak log Nabi ko gher liye aur unhe dekhne lage. Umar ne kaha, "Aye Abdullah! Jao aur dekho log Allah ke Rasool ko kyun gher rahe hain aur unhe dekh rahe hain." Abdullah bin Umar ne phir dekha log Nabi ko Bai'at de rahe hain. Isliye unhone bhi Bai'at di aur Umar ke paas wapas gaye jo phir bahar gaye aur Nabi ko Bai'at di.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abi `Aufa:We were in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) when he performed the `Umra. He performed the Tawaf and we did the same; he offered the prayer and we also offered the prayer with him. Then he performed the Sai between Safa and Marwa and we were guarding him against the people of Mecca so that nobody should harm him
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Aufa bataate hain: Hum Nabi ki sohbat mein the jab unhone Umrah kiya. Unhone Tawaf kiya aur humne bhi waisa hi kiya; unhone namaz padhi aur humne bhi unke saath namaz padhi. Phir unhone Safa aur Marwa ke beech Sai kiya, aur hum unki Mecca ke logon se hifaazat kar rahe the taaki koee bhi unhe nuksaan na pahuncha sake.

e: Narrated Abu Wail:When Sahl bin Hunaif returned from (the battle of) Siffin, we went to ask him (as to why he had come back). He replied, "(You should not consider me a coward) but blame your opinions. I saw myself on the day of Abu Jandal (inclined to fight), and if I had the power of refusing the order of Allah's Apostle then, I would have refused it (and fought the infidels bravely). Allah and His Apostle know (what is convenient) better. Whenever we put our swords on our shoulders for any matter that terrified us, our swords led us to an easy agreeable solution before the present situation (of disagreement and dispute between the Muslims). When we mend the breach in one side, it opened in another, and we do not know what to do about it
hi: Abu Wail bataate hain: Jab Sahl bin Hunaif (jung) Siffin se wapas aaye, hum unse (kyun woh wapas aaye) puchne gaye. Unhone jawab diya, "(Mujhe kaayar mat samjho, magar) apni hi rayon ko dosh do. Maine khud ko Abu Jandal ke din (jung karne ke liye jhukaav) dekha, aur agar us waqt mere paas Allah ke Rasool ke hukum ko radd karne ki taakat hoti, main use radd kar deta (aur kaafiron se bahaduri se jung karta). Allah aur uske Rasool behtar jaante hain (kya sahi hai). Jab bhi humne apni talwaren apne kandhon par rakhi kisi aisi cheez ke liye jo humein darati thi, humari talwaren humein aasaan, manya hal ki taraf le gaee isse pahle is aajkal ki (asahmati aur ikhtilaaf ki) haalat se. Jab hum ek taraf ka chhed bharte hain, doosri taraf khul jata hai, aur humein nahi pata iske baare mein kya karna hai."

e: Narrated Ka`b bin Ujra:The Prophet (ﷺ) came to me at the time of Al-Hudaibiya Pledge while lice were falling on my face. He said, "Are the lice of your head troubling you?" I said, "Yes." He said, "Shave your head and fast for three days, or feed six poor persons, or slaughter a sheep as sacrifice." (The sub-narrator, Aiyub said, "I do not know with which of these three options he started)
hi: Ka'b bin Ujra bataate hain: Nabi Al-Hudaibiya Bai'at ke waqt mere paas aaye jabke joonen (yaani joon) mere chehre par gir rahi thi. Unhone pucha, "Kya tumhare sar ki joonen tumhe pareshaan kar rahi hain?" Maine kaha, "Haan." Unhone kaha, "Apna sar munwa do aur teen din roza rakho, ya chhah gareebon ko khilao, ya ek bhed qurbani ke tor par zabah karo." (Subordinate raawi Aiyub ne kaha, "Mujhe nahi pata kaunse teen ikhtiyaaron se unhone shuruaat ki.")

e: Narrated Ka`b bin Ujra:We were in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) at Al-Hudaibiya in the state of Ihram and the pagans did not allow us to proceed (to the Ka`ba). I had thick hair and lice started falling on my face. The Prophet (ﷺ) passed by me and said, "Are the lice of your head troubling you?" I replied, Yes." (The sub-narrator added, "Then the following Divine Verse was revealed:-- "And if anyone of you is ill or has an ailment in his scalp, (necessitating shaving) must pay a ransom (Fidya) of either fasting or feeding the poor, Or offering a sacrifice
hi: Ka'b bin Ujra bataate hain: Hum Allah ke Rasool ki sohbat mein Al-Hudaibiya mein Ihram ki haalat mein the aur mushrikon ne humein aage badhne nahi diya (Ka'ba tak). Mere baal mote the aur joonen mere chehre par girne lagi. Nabi mere paas se guzre aur kaha, "Kya tumhare sar ki joonen tumhe pareshaan kar rahi hain?" Maine jawab diya, "Haan." (Subordinate raawi ne joda, "Phir yeh Divine Ayat naazil huee: 'Aur agar tummein se koee bimar hai ya uske sar mein koee takleef hai (jiske liye baal munwane ki zaroorat pade), use fidya (yaani prayaschit) dena chahiye ya to roza rakhkar ya gareebon ko khilaakar ya ek qurbani dekar.'")

e: Narrated Anas:Some people of the tribe of `Ukl and `Uraina arrived at Medina to meet the Prophet (ﷺ) and embraced Islam and said, "O Allah's Prophet! We are the owners of milch livestock (i.e. bedouins) and not farmers (i.e. countrymen)." They found the climate of Medina unsuitable for them. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered that they should be provided with some milch camels and a shepherd and ordered them to go out of Medina and to drink the camels' milk and urine (as medicine) So they set out and when they reached Al-Harra, they reverted to Heathenism after embracing Islam, and killed the shepherd of the Prophet and drove away the camels. When this news reached the Prophet, he sent some people in pursuit of them. (So they were caught and brought back to the Prophet (ﷺ) ). The Prophet (ﷺ) gave his orders in their concern. So their eyes were branded with pieces of iron and their hands and legs were cut off and they were left away in Harra till they died in that state of theirs. (See Hadith 234 Vol)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ukl aur Uraina qabile ke kuch log Madina aaye Nabi se milne aur Islam qubool kiya aur kaha, "Aye Allah ke Nabi! Hum doodh dene wale janwaron ke maalik hain (yaani dehati log) aur khetihaar nahi (yaani shehari log)." Unhe Madina ka mausam apne liye asuvidhajanak laga. Isliye Allah ke Rasool ne hukum diya ke unhe kuch doodh dene wale unt aur ek charwaha diya jaaye aur unhe Madina se bahar jane aur unton ka doodh aur peshab (dawaee ke tor par) pine ka hukum diya. Isliye woh nikle, aur jab woh Al-Harra pahunche, woh Islam qubool karne ke baad phir se but-parasti ki taraf laut gaye, aur Nabi ke charwahe ko qatl kiya aur unton ko le gaye. Jab yeh khabar Nabi tak pahunchi, unhone kuch logon ko unka picha karne bheja. (Isliye unhe pakad liya gaya aur Nabi ke paas wapas laaya gaya.) Nabi ne unke baare mein apna hukum diya. Isliye unki aankhon ko lohe ke tukdon se daga gaya aur unke haath aur paanv kate gaye aur unhe Al-Harra mein chhod diya gaya jab tak woh usi haalat mein mar gaye.

e: Narrated Abu Raja:The freed slave of Abu Qilaba, who was with Abu Qilaba in Sham: `Umar bin `Abdul `Aziz consulted the people saying, "What do you think of Qasama." They said, "'It is a right (judgment) which Allah's Apostle and the Caliphs before you acted on." Abu Qilaba was behind `Umar's bed. 'Anbasa bin Sa`id said, But what about the narration concerning the people of `Uraina?" Abu Qilaba said, "Anas bin Malik narrated it to me," and then narrated the whole story
hi: Abu Raja bataate hain (Abu Qilaba ke azaad kiye gulaam, jo Abu Qilaba ke saath Sham mein the): Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdul Aziz ne logon se raay li aur kaha, "Qasama ke baare mein tumhari kya raay hai?" Unhone kaha, "Yeh ek sahi (nyayvyavastha) hai jispar Allah ke Rasool aur aapse pahle ke Khalifon ne amal kiya." Abu Qilaba Umar ke bistar ke peeche baithe the. Anbasa bin Sa'id ne pucha, "Magar Uraina qabile ke logon ke baare mein riwaayat kya hai?" Abu Qilaba ne kaha, "Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne mujhe yeh riwaayat sunaee," aur phir poori kahani sunaee.

e: Narrated Salama bin Al-Akwa`:Once I went (from Medina) towards (Al-Ghaba) before the first Adhan of the Fajr Prayer. The shecamels of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to graze at a place called Dhi-Qarad. A slave of `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf met me (on the way) and said, "The she-camels of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had been taken away by force." I asked, "Who had taken them?" He replied "(The people of) Ghatafan." I made three loud cries (to the people of Medina) saying, "O Sabahah!" I made the people between the two mountains of Medina hear me. Then I rushed onward and caught up with the robbers while they were watering the camels. I started throwing arrows at them as I was a good archer and I was saying, "I am the son of Al-Akwa`, and today will perish the wicked people." I kept on saying like that till I restored the shecamels (of the Prophet), I also snatched thirty Burda (i.e. garments) from them. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) and the other people came there, and I said, "O Allah's Prophet! I have stopped the people (of Ghatafan) from taking water and they are thirsty now. So send (some people) after them now." On that the Prophet said, "O the son of Al-Akwa`! You have over-powered them, so forgive them." Then we all came back and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) seated me behind him on his she-camel till we entered Medina
hi: Salama bin Al-Akwa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar main Al-Ghaba ki taraf gaya Fajr ki namaz ki pahli Azaan se pahle. Allah ke Rasool ki untniyaan Dhi-Qarad naam ki jagah par charti thi. Abdur-Rahman bin Auf ke ek gulaam mujhse mile (raste mein) aur kaha, "Allah ke Rasool ki untniyaan zordaar se le li gaee hain." Maine pucha, "Kisne liya?" Unhone jawab diya, "(Ghatafan ke log)." Maine teen zordaar cheekhen mari (Madina ke logon ko bulane ke liye), kahte huye, "Aye Sabahah!" Maine Madina ke do pahadon ke beech ke sab logon ko mujhe sunwaya. Phir main aage badha aur luteron ko unke kue par paani pilate huye pakad liya. Maine unpar teer chalane shuru kiye kyunke main ek achha tirandaaz tha, aur main kah raha tha, "Main Al-Akwa ka beta hoon, aur aaj bure log barbaad honge." Main aisa kahta raha jab tak maine (Nabi ki) untniyaan wapas paee. Maine unse tees Burda (yaani kapde) bhi le liye. Phir Nabi aur doosre log wahaan aaye, aur maine kaha, "Aye Allah ke Nabi! Maine (Ghatafan ke) logon ko paani lene se roka hai aur woh ab pyase hain. Isliye unke peeche (kuch log) bhejiye abhi." Ispar Nabi ne kaha, "Aye Al-Akwa ke bete! Tumne unhe haara diya hai, isliye unhe maaf kar do." Phir hum sab wapas aaye, aur Allah ke Rasool ne mujhe apni untni par apne peeche baithaya jab tak hum Madina daakhil hue.

e: Narrated Suwaid bin An-Nu`man:I went out in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) in the year of Khaibar, and when we reached As Sahba' which is the lower part of Khaibar, the Prophet (ﷺ) offered the `Asr prayer and then asked the people to collect the journey food. Nothing was brought but Sawiq which the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered to be moistened with water, and then he ate it and we also ate it. Then he got up to offer the Maghrib prayer. He washed his mouth, and we too washed our mouths, and then he offered the prayer without repeating his abulution
hi: Suwaid bin An-Nu'man (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Nabi ki sohbat mein Khaibar ke saal nikla, aur jab hum As-Sahba pahunche, jo Khaibar ka neecha hissa hai, Nabi ne Asr ki namaz padhi aur phir logon ko safar ka khaana jama karne ko kaha. Kuch bhi nahi laaya gaya siwaye Sawiq (yaani pisa hua jau) ke jise Nabi ne paani mein bhigone ka hukum diya, aur phir unhone use khaya aur humne bhi khaya. Phir woh Maghrib ki namaz ke liye uthe. Unhone apna munh dhoya aur humne bhi apne munh dhoye, aur phir unhone bina wudu doharae namaz padhi.

e: Narrated Salama bin Al-Akwa`:We went out to Khaibar in the company of the Prophet. While we were proceeding at night, a man from the group said to 'Amir, "O 'Amir! Won't you let us hear your poetry?" 'Amir was a poet, so he got down and started reciting for the people poetry that kept pace with the camels' footsteps, saying:-- "O Allah! Without You we Would not have been guided On the right path Neither would be have given In charity, nor would We have prayed. So please forgive us, what we have committed (i.e. our defects); let all of us Be sacrificed for Your Cause And send Sakina (i.e. calmness) Upon us to make our feet firm When we meet our enemy, and If they will call us towards An unjust thing, We will refuse. The infidels have made a hue and Cry to ask others' help Against us." The Prophet (ﷺ) on that, asked, "Who is that (camel) driver (reciting poetry)?" The people said, "He is 'Amir bin Al-Akwa`." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "May Allah bestow His Mercy on him." A man amongst the people said, "O Allah's Prophet! has (martyrdom) been granted to him. Would that you let us enjoy his company longer." Then we reached and besieged Khaibar till we were afflicted with severe hunger. Then Allah helped the Muslims conquer it (i.e. Khaibar). In the evening of the day of the conquest of the city, the Muslims made huge fires. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "What are these fires? For cooking what, are you making the fire?" The people replied, "(For cooking) meat." He asked, "What kind of meat?" They (i.e. people) said, "The meat of donkeys." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Throw away the meat and break the pots!" Some man said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shall we throw away the meat and wash the pots instead?" He said, "(Yes, you can do) that too." So when the army files were arranged in rows (for the clash), 'Amir's sword was short and he aimed at the leg of a Jew to strike it, but the sharp blade of the sword returned to him and injured his own knee, and that caused him to die. When they returned from the battle, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw me (in a sad mood). He took my hand and said, "What is bothering you?" I replied, "Let my father and mother be sacrificed for you! The people say that the deeds of 'Amir are lost." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever says so, is mistaken, for 'Amir has got a double reward." The Prophet raised two fingers and added, "He (i.e. Amir) was a persevering struggler in the Cause of Allah and there are few 'Arabs who achieved the like of (good deeds) 'Amir had done
hi: Salama bin Al-Akwa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Nabi ki sohbat mein Khaibar ki taraf nikle. Jabke hum raat mein aage badh rahe the, giroh mein se ek shaks ne Amir se kaha, "Aye Amir! Kya tum humein apni kavita sunaoge?" Amir ek kavi the, isliye woh utre aur logon ke liye kavita padhne lage, unton ke qadmon ke saath taal mel khate huye, kahte huye, "Aye Allah! Tere bina hum sahi raste par na hote, na hum daan dete, na hum namaz padhte. Isliye humein maaf kar, jo bhi humne (galat) kiya hai; humare sab log Teri raah mein qurbaan hon, aur humpar Sakina (yaani shaanti) bhej humare paanvon ko dradh karne ke liye jab hum apne dushman se milen, aur agar woh humein kisi na-jaiz cheez ki taraf bulaenge, hum inkaar karenge. Kaafiron ne humare khilaf doosron se madad maangne ke liye bahut shor machaya hai." Ispar, Nabi ne pucha, "Yeh (unt) chalane wala kaun hai (kavita padhte hue)?" Logon ne kaha, "Yeh Amir bin Al-Akwa hain." Ispar Nabi ne kaha, "Allah unpar apni rehmat naazil kare." Logon mein se ek shaks ne kaha, "Aye Allah ke Nabi! Kya (shahadat) unke liye nishchit ho gaee hai? Kaash aap humein unki sohbat aur zyada enjoy karne dete." Phir hum Khaibar pahunche aur use gher liya jab tak humein sakht bhookh ka saamna karna pada. Phir Allah ne Musalmanon ki ise fatah karne mein madad ki. Us shehar ki fatah wale din shaam ko, Musalmanon ne bade-bade aag jalaye. Nabi ne pucha, "Yeh kaisi aagen hain? Kis cheez ko pakane ke liye tum aag jala rahe ho?" Logon ne jawab diya, "(Pakane ke liye) gosht." Unhone pucha, "Kaisa gosht?" Unhone (yaani logon ne) kaha, "Gadhon ka gosht." Nabi ne kaha, "Gosht phenko aur bartan tod do!" Kisi shaks ne kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Kya hum gosht phenk den aur uske bajaaye bartan dho len?" Unhone kaha, "(Haan, tum aisa bhi kar sakte ho)."
