Isliye jab fauj ki paanktiyaan jung ke liye taiyaar ki gaee (samana karne ke liye), Amir ki talwaar chhoti thi aur unhone ek Yahudi ki taang par vaar karne ka nishaana banaya, magar talwaar ki teekhi dhaar unki taraf wapas mud gaee aur unki hi ghutne ko zakhmi kar diya, jiski wajah se unki maut ho gaee. Jab woh jung se wapas aaye, Allah ke Rasool ne mujhe dekha (udaas mood mein). Unhone mera haath pakada aur pucha, "Tumhe kya pareshaan kar raha hai?" Maine jawab diya, "Mere maa-baap aapke liye qurbaan hon! Log kahte hain Amir ke amal barbaad ho gaye hain." Nabi ne kaha, "Jo bhi aisa kahta hai, woh galat hai, kyunke Amir ko dooguna ajr milega." Nabi ne do ungliyaan uthaee aur joda, "Woh (yaani Amir) Allah ki raah mein ek dradh saahsi mujahid the, aur bahut kam Arb log Amir jitne achhe amal karte hain."

e: Narrated Anas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) reached Khaibar at night and it was his habit that, whenever he reached the enemy at night, he will not attack them till it was morning. When it was morning, the Jews came out with their spades and baskets, and when they saw him(i.e. the Prophet (ﷺ) ), they said, "Muhammad! By Allah! Muhammad and his army!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Khaibar is destroyed, for whenever we approach a (hostile) nation (to fight), then evil will be the morning for those who have been warned
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool raat ko Khaibar pahunche, aur unki yeh aadat thi ke jab bhi woh dushman tak raat ko pahunchte, woh unpar hamla nahi karte jab tak subah na ho jaye. Jab subah huee, Yahudi apne phaavdon aur tokariyon ke saath bahar aaye, aur jab unhone unhe (yaani Nabi ko) dekha, unhone kaha, "Muhammad! Allah ki qasam! Muhammad aur unki fauj!" Nabi ne kaha, "Khaibar barbaad hua, kyunke jab bhi hum kisi (dushman) qaum ke qareeb aate hain (jung ke liye), jinke saamne chetaavni di gaee thi unki subah bahut buri hoti hai."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:We reached Khaibar early in the morning and the inhabitants of Khaibar came out carrying their spades, and when they saw the Prophet (ﷺ) they said, "Muhammad! By Allah! Muhammad and his army!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allahu-Akbar! Khaibar is destroyed, for whenever we approach a (hostile) nation (to fight) then evil will be the morning for those who have been warned." We then got the meat of donkeys (and intended to eat it), but an announcement was made by the announcer of the Prophet, "Allah and His Apostle forbid you to eat the meat of donkeys as it is an impure thing
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum subah-subah Khaibar pahunche aur wahaan ke log apne phaavdon lekar bahar aaye, aur jab unhone Nabi ko dekha, unhone kaha, "Muhammad! Allah ki qasam! Muhammad aur unki fauj!" Nabi ne kaha, "Allahu-Akbar! Khaibar barbaad hua, kyunke jab bhi hum kisi (dushman) qaum ke qareeb aate hain (jung ke liye), jinke saamne chetaavni di gaee thi unki subah bahut buri hoti hai." Humne phir gadhon ka gosht paaya (aur use khaane ka irada kiya), magar Nabi ke elaan karne wale ne elaan kiya, "Allah aur uske Rasool tumhe gadhon ka gosht khaane se mana karte hain kyunke yeh apavitra cheez hai."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Someone came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "The donkeys have been eaten (by the Muslims)." The Prophet kept quiet. Then the man came again and said, "The donkeys have been eaten." The Prophet (ﷺ) kept quiet. The man came to him the third time and said, "The donkeys have been consumed." On that the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered an announcer to announce to the people, "Allah and His Apostle forbid you to eat the meat of donkeys." Then the cooking pots were upset while the meat was still boiling in them
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Koee Allah ke Rasool ke paas aaya aur kaha, "Gadhe khaae ja chuke hain (Musalmanon dwaara)." Nabi khaamosh rahe. Phir shaks phir aaya aur kaha, "Gadhe khaae ja chuke hain." Nabi phir khaamosh rahe. Shaks teesri baar unke paas aaya aur kaha, "Gadhe khatam kiye ja chuke hain." Ispar Nabi ne ek elaan karne wale ko hukum diya logon ko elaan karne ke liye, "Allah aur uske Rasool tumhe gadhon ka gosht khaane se mana karte hain." Phir khaane ke bartan ulte kar diye gaye jabke gosht abhi bhi unmein ubal raha tha.

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) offered the Fajr Prayer near Khaibar when it was still dark and then said, "Allahu-Akbar! Khaibar is destroyed, for whenever we approach a (hostile) nation (to fight), then evil will be the morning for those who have been warned." Then the inhabitants of Khaibar came out running on the roads. The Prophet (ﷺ) had their warriors killed, their offspring and women taken as captives. Safiya was amongst the captives, She first came in the share of Dihya Al-Kalbi but later on she belonged to the Prophet . The Prophet (ﷺ) made her manumission as her 'Mahr
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Fajr ki namaz Khaibar ke qareeb padhi jab abhi andhera tha aur phir kaha, "Allahu-Akbar! Khaibar barbaad hua, kyunke jab bhi hum kisi (dushman) qaum ke qareeb aate hain (jung ke liye), jinke saamne chetaavni di gaee thi unki subah bahut buri hoti hai." Phir Khaibar ke log raston par daudte hue bahar aaye. Nabi ne unke mujahidon ko qatl karwaya aur unki santanon aur aurton ko qaidi banaya. Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) un qaidiyon mein se thi. Woh pahle Dihya Al-Kalbi ke hisse mein aee, magar baad mein woh Nabi ki ho gaee. Nabi ne unki azaadi hi ko unka Mahr banaya.

e: Narrated `Abdul `Aziz bin Suhaib:Anas bin Malik said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) took Safiya as a captive. He manumitted her and married her." Thabit asked Anas, "What did he give her as Mahr (i.e. marriage gift)?" Anas replied. "Her Mahr was herself, for he manumitted her
hi: Abdul Aziz bin Suhaib (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Nabi ne Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko qaidi ke tor par liya. Unhone unhe azaad kiya aur unse shaadi ki." Thabit ne Anas se pucha, "Unhone unhe Mahr mein kya diya?" Anas ne jawab diya, "Unka Mahr unki azaadi hi tha, kyunke unhone unhe azaad kiya."

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d As Saidi:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (and his army) encountered the pagans and the two armies.,, fought and then Allah's Apostle returned to his army camps and the others (i.e. the enemy) returned to their army camps. Amongst the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) there was a man who could not help pursuing any single isolated pagan to strike him with his sword. Somebody said, "None has benefited the Muslims today more than so-and-so." On that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "He is from the people of the Hell-Fire certainly." A man amongst the people (i.e. Muslims) said, "I will accompany him (to know the fact)." So he went along with him, and whenever he stopped he stopped with him, and whenever he hastened, he hastened with him. The (brave) man then got wounded severely, and seeking to die at once, he planted his sword into the ground and put its point against his chest in between his breasts, and then threw himself on it and committed suicide. On that the person (who was accompanying the deceased all the time) came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "I testify that you are the Messenger of Allah." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Why is that (what makes you say so)?" He said "It is concerning the man whom you have already mentioned as one of the dwellers of the Hell-Fire. The people were surprised by your statement, and I said to them, "I will try to find out the truth about him for you." So I went out after him and he was then inflicted with a severe wound and because of that, he hurried to bring death upon himself by planting the handle of his sword into the ground and directing its tip towards his chest between his breasts, and then he threw himself over it and committed suicide." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then said, "A man may do what seem to the people as the deeds of the dwellers of Paradise but he is from the dwellers of the Hell-Fire and another may do what seem to the people as the deeds of the dwellers of the Hell- Fire, but he is from the dwellers of Paradise
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) As Saidi bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (aur unki fauj) ki mushrikon se mulaqaat huee aur do faujen jung kiya aur phir Allah ke Rasool apne padaav par wapas aaye aur doosre (yaani dushman) bhi apne padaav par wapas gaye. Nabi ke sahaba mein ek shaks tha jo khud ko rok nahi pata kisi akele mushrik ka picha karna talwaar se hamla karne ke liye. Kisi ne kaha, "Aaj kisi ne Musalmanon ko utna faayda nahi pahunchaya jitna falaan-falaan ne." Ispar Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Woh Dozakh walon mein se hain, yaqinan." Logon mein se ek shaks ne kaha, "Main unke saath jaunga (yeh dekhne)." Isliye woh unke saath gaye, aur jab bhi woh (yaani woh shaks) ruka, woh unke saath ruka, aur jab bhi woh jaldi karta, woh bhi jaldi karta. (Bahadur) shaks phir sakht zakhmi ho gaya, aur foran maut chahte huye, unhone apni talwaar zameen mein gaad di aur uski nok apni chhaati mein rakhi apni donon palkon ke beech, aur phir khud ko uspar daal diya aur aatmahatya kar li. Ispar woh shaks (jo mrit shaks ke saath tha) Allah ke Rasool ke paas aaya aur kaha, "Main gawahi deta hoon aap Allah ke Rasool hain." Nabi ne pucha, "Yeh kyun (kah rahe ho)?" Unhone kaha, "Yeh us shaks ke baare mein hai jinke baare mein aapne pahle hi kaha tha ke woh Dozakh walon mein se hain. Log aapke farmaan se hairat mein pade, aur maine unse kaha, 'Main aapke liye unke baare mein sach jaankar dunga.' Isliye main unke peeche gaya aur unhe tab sakht zakhm laga, aur uski wajah se, unhone apni talwaar ki muthh zameen mein gaad di aur uski nok apni chhaati ke beech rakhi, aur phir khud ko uspar daal diya aur aatmahatya kar li." Allah ke Rasool ne phir kaha, "Ek shaks aise amal kar sakta hai jo logon ko Jannat walon jaise lagte hain, magar woh Dozakh walon mein se hai, aur doosra aise amal kar sakta hai jo logon ko Dozakh walon jaise lagte hain, magar woh Jannat walon mein se hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:We witnessed (the battle of) Khaibar. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said about one of those who were with him and who claimed to be a Muslim. "This (man) is from the dwellers of the Hell-Fire." When the battle started, that fellow fought so violently and bravely that he received plenty of wounds. Some of the people were about to doubt (the Prophet's statement), but the man, feeling the pain of his wounds, put his hand into his quiver and took out of it, some arrows with which he slaughtered himself (i.e. committed suicide). Then some men amongst the Muslims came hurriedly and said, "O Allah's Apostle! Allah has made your statement true so-and-so has committed suicide. "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O so-and-so! Get up and make an announcement that none but a believer will enter Paradise and that Allah may support the religion with an unchaste (evil) wicked man
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Khaibar (ki jung) ke gawah the. Allah ke Rasool ne unmein se ek ke baare mein, jo unke saath tha aur khud ko Musalman kahta tha, kaha, "Yeh (shaks) Dozakh walon mein se hai." Jab jung shuru huee, us shaks ne itni zordaar aur bahaduri se jung ki ke unhe bahut sare zakhm mile. Kuch log Nabi ke farmaan par shak karne lage, magar shaks, apne zakhmon ka dard mahsoos karte huye, apna haath apne teer-tarkash mein daalkar kuch teer nikale jinse unhone khud ko qatl kar liya (yaani aatmahatya kar li). Phir kuch Musalman jaldi se aaye aur kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Allah ne aapke farmaan ko sach saabit kiya hai; falaan-falaan ne aatmahatya kar li hai." Nabi ne kaha, "Aye falaan! Utho aur elaan karo ke sirf ek momin hi Jannat mein daakhil hoga aur ke Allah shaayad deen ko ek gair-pakbaaz, bure shaks ke zariye bhi majboot kar de."

e: narration about the chain of narrators
hi: (yeh riwaayaton ki chain ke baare mein hai)

e: Narrated Abu Musa Al-Ash`ari:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) fought the battle of Khaibar, or when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went towards it, (whenever) the people, (passed over a high place overlooking a valley, they raised their voices saying, "Allahu-Akbar! Allahu-Akbar! None has the right to be worshipped except Allah." On that Allah's Apostle said (to them), "Lower your voices, for you are not calling a deaf or an absent one, but you are calling a Hearer Who is near and is with you." I was behind the riding animal of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he heard me saying. "There Is neither might, nor power but with Allah," On that he said to me, "O `Abdullah bin Qais!" I said, "Labbaik. O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" He said, "Shall I tell you a sentence which is one of the treasures of Paradise" I said, "Yes, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Let my father and mother be sacrificed for your sake." He said, "It is: There is neither might nor power but with Allah
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ash'ari bataate hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool ne Khaibar ki jung kiya, ya jab Allah ke Rasool uski taraf gaye, (jab bhi) log, ek oonchi jagah se ek waadi ko dekhkar, apni aawaazen buland karke kahte, "Allahu Akbar! Allahu Akbar! Allah ke siwa koee mabood nahi." Ispar Nabi ne (unse) kaha, "Apni aawaazen neechi karo, kyunke tum kisi badhir ya gair-maujood shaks ko nahi pukar rahe, balki tum ek Sunne wale ko pukar rahe ho Jo tumhare qareeb hai aur tumhare saath hai." Main Allah ke Rasool ke sawari janwar ke peeche tha aur unhone mujhe kehte suna, "Allah ke siwa koee taakat ya bala (taaqat) nahi hai." Ispar unhone mujhse kaha, "Aye Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Qais!" Maine kaha, "Labbaik. Aye Allah ke Rasool!" Unhone kaha, "Kya main tumhe ek aisa shabd bataun jo Jannat ke khazanon mein se ek hai?" Maine kaha, "Haan, Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mere maa-baap aapke liye qurbaan hon." Unhone kaha, "Woh hai: Allah ke siwa koee taakat ya bala nahi hai."

e: Narrated Yazid bin Abi Ubaid:I saw the trace of a wound in Salama's leg. I said to him, "O Abu Muslim! What is this wound?" He said, "This was inflicted on me on the day of Khaibar and the people said, 'Salama has been wounded.' Then I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he puffed his saliva in it (i.e. the wound) thrice., and since then I have not had any pain in it till this hour
hi: Yazid bin Abi Ubaid bataate hain: Maine Salama ki taang par ek zakhm ka nishaan dekha. Maine unse kaha, "Aye Abu Muslim! Yeh kaisa zakhm hai?" Unhone kaha, "Yeh mujhe Khaibar ke din laga aur logon ne kaha, 'Salama zakhmi ho gaye hain.' Phir main Nabi ke paas gaya aur unhone usmein teen baar apna laar phoonka, aur tab se ab tak mujhe ismein koee dard mahsoos nahi hua."

e: Narrated Sahl:During one of his Ghazawat, the Prophet (ﷺ) encountered the pagans, and the two armies fought, and then each of them returned to their army camps. Amongst the (army of the) Muslims there was a man who would follow every pagan separated from the army and strike him with his sword. It was said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! None has fought so satisfactorily as so-and-so (namely, that brave Muslim). "The Prophet said, "He is from the dwellers of the Hell-Fire." The people said, "Who amongst us will be of the dwellers of Paradise if this (man) is from the dwellers of the Hell-Fire?" Then a man from amongst the people said, "I will follow him and accompany him in his fast and slow movements." The (brave) man got wounded, and wanting to die at once, he put the handle of his sword on the ground and its tip in between his breasts, and then threw himself over it, committing suicide. Then the man (who had watched the deceased) returned to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "I testify that you are Apostle of Allah." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "What is this?" The man told him the whole story. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A man may do what may seem to the people as the deeds of the dwellers of Paradise, but he is of the dwellers of the Hell-Fire and a man may do what may seem to the people as the deeds of the dwellers of the Hell-Fire, but he is from the dwellers of Paradise
hi: Sahl bataate hain: Ek Ghazwe ke dauran, Nabi ki mushrikon se mulaqaat huee, aur do faujen ladi, aur phir har ek apne padaav par wapas gaee. Musalmanon (ki fauj) mein ek shaks tha jo har mushrik ka, jo fauj se alag ho jata, picha karta aur use talwaar se maara. Kaha gaya, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Kisi ne itni santushtijanak jung nahi ki jitni falaan-falaan ne (yaani us bahadur Musalman ne)." Nabi ne kaha, "Woh Dozakh walon mein se hai." Logon ne kaha, "Humme se kaun Jannat walon mein hoga agar yeh (shaks) Dozakh walon mein se hai?" Phir logon mein se ek shaks ne kaha, "Main unka picha karunga aur unke saath (unki sust aur tez chalon mein) saath rahunga." (Bahadur) shaks zakhmi hue, aur foran maut chahte huye, unhone apni talwaar ki muth zameen par rakhi aur uski nok apni chhaati ke beech, aur phir khud ko uspar daal diya, aatmahatya karte huye. Phir shaks (jinhone mrit shaks ko dekha tha) Nabi ke paas wapas aaye aur kaha, "Main gawahi deta hoon aap Allah ke Rasool hain." Nabi ne pucha, "Yeh kya hai?" Shaks ne unhe poori kahani sunaee. Nabi ne kaha, "Ek shaks aise amal kar sakta hai jo logon ko Jannat walon jaise lagte hain, magar woh Dozakh walon mein se hai, aur ek shaks aise amal kar sakta hai jo logon ko Dozakh walon jaise lagte hain, magar woh Jannat walon mein se hai."

e: Narrated Abu `Imran:Anas looked at the people wearing Tailsans (i.e. a special kind of head covering worn by Jews in old days). On that Anas said, "At this moment they (i.e. those people) look like the Jews of Khaibar
hi: Abu Imran bataate hain: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne un logon ko dekha jo Tailsan (yaani purane zamane mein Yahudiyon dwaara pahna jane wala ek khaas sar ka kapda) pahne hue the. Ispar Anas ne kaha, "Is waqt woh (yaani woh log) Khaibar ke Yahudiyon jaise dikh rahe hain."

e: Narrated Salama:`Ali remained behind the Prophet (ﷺ) during the Ghazwa of Khaibar as he was suffering from eye trouble. He then said, "(How can) I remain behind the Prophet (ﷺ) ," and followed him. So when he slept on the night of the conquest of Khaibar, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I will give the flag tomorrow, or tomorrow the flag will be taken by a man who is loved by Allah and His Apostle , and (Khaibar) will be conquered through him, (with Allah's help)" While every one of us was hopeful to have the flag, it was said, "Here is `Ali" and the Prophet (ﷺ) gave him the flag and Khaibar was conquered through him (with Allah's Help)
hi: Salama bataate hain: Ali (Alayhis Salam) Khaibar ki jung ke din Nabi se peeche rah gaye kyunke unhe aankh ki takleef thi. Phir unhone kaha, "Main Nabi se peeche kaise rah sakta hoon?" aur unka picha kiya. Isliye jab Khaibar ki fatah ki raat soye, Nabi ne kaha, "Main kal jhanda dunga," ya "Kal jhanda ek aise shaks ke haathon lena jaayega jinse Allah aur uske Rasool muhabbat karte hain, aur (Khaibar) unke zariye fatah paaega (Allah ki madad se)." Jabke har koee jhanda paane ki ummeed rakh raha tha, kaha gaya, "Yahaan Ali (Alayhis Salam) hain," aur Nabi ne unhe jhanda diya aur Khaibar unke zariye fatah huee (Allah ki madad se).

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:On the day of Khaibar, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Tomorrow I will give this flag to a man through whose hands Allah will give us victory. He loves Allah and His Apostle, and he is loved by Allah and His Apostle." The people remained that night, wondering as to who would be given it. In the morning the people went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and everyone of them was hopeful to receive it (i.e. the flag). The Prophet said, "Where is `Ali bin Abi Talib?" It was said, "He is suffering from eye trouble O Allah's Apostle." He said, "Send for him." `Ali was brought and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) spat in his eye and invoked good upon him. So `Ali was cured as if he never had any trouble. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) gave him the flag. `Ali said "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I will fight with them till they become like us." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Proceed and do not hurry. When you enter their territory, call them to embrace Islam and inform them of Allah's Rights which they should observe, for by Allah, even if a single man is led on the right path (of Islam) by Allah through you, then that will be better for you than the nice red camels
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Khaibar ke din, Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Kal main yeh jhanda ek aise shaks ko dunga jinke haathon Allah humein fatah dega. Woh Allah aur uske Rasool se muhabbat karta hai, aur woh Allah aur uske Rasool ke pyare hain." Log us raat yeh sochte rahe ke kise jhanda diya jaayega. Subah log Allah ke Rasool ke paas gaye aur har koee ummeed karta tha ke use yeh milega. Nabi ne pucha, "Ali (Alayhis Salam) bin Abi Talib kahaan hain?" Unse kaha gaya, "Unhe aankh ki takleef hai, Aye Allah ke Nabi." Unhone kaha, "Unke liye bhejo." Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko laaya gaya aur Allah ke Rasool ne unki aankh mein thooka aur unke liye achhi dua ki. Isliye Ali (Alayhis Salam) theek ho gaye mano unhe kabhi koee takleef hi nahi thi. Phir Nabi ne unhe jhanda diya. Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Main unse (dushman se) jung karunga jab tak woh humare jaise ban jaen." Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Aage badho aur jaldbaazi mat karo. Jab tum unki zameen mein daakhil ho, unhe Islam qubool karne ki dawat do aur unhe Allah ke haqq batao jo unpar farz hain, kyunke, Allah ki qasam, agar ek shaks bhi tumhare zariye sahi raste par Allah dwaara le jaya jata hai, yeh tumhare liye khoobsurat laal unton se behtar hoga."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:We arrived at Khaibar, and when Allah helped His Apostle to open the fort, the beauty of Safiya bint Huyai bin Akhtaq whose husband had been killed while she was a bride, was mentioned to Allah's Apostle. The Prophet (ﷺ) selected her for himself, and set out with her, and when we reached a place called Sidd-as-Sahba,' Safiya became clean from her menses. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) married her. Hais (i.e. an 'Arabian dish) was prepared on a small leather mat. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said to me, "Invite the people around you." So that was the marriage banquet of the Prophet (ﷺ) and Safiya. Then we proceeded towards Medina, and I saw the Prophet, making for her a kind of cushion with his cloak behind him (on his camel). He then sat beside his camel and put his knee for Safiya to put her foot on, in order to ride (on the camel)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Khaibar pahunche, aur jab Allah ne apne Rasool ki qile fatah karne mein madad ki, Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Huyai bin Akhtaq ki khoobsurati ka zikar Allah ke Rasool ke saamne hua, jinke shohar ka intiqal (jung mein) hua tha jabke woh nauveli dulhan thi. Nabi ne unhe apne liye chuna, aur unke saath rawana hue, aur jab hum Sidd-as-Sahba naam ki jagah pahunche, Safiya apni maasik dhaarav se paak ho gaee. Phir Allah ke Rasool ne unse shaadi ki. Hais (yaani ek Arabi vyanjan) ek chhoti chamde ki chatai par taiyaar kiya gaya. Phir Nabi ne mujhse kaha, "Apne aas-paas ke logon ko bulao." Isliye yehi Nabi aur Safiya ki shaadi ki dawat thi. Phir hum Madina ki taraf badhe, aur maine dekha Nabi apni chaadar se unke liye ek gadde jaisa cushion bana rahe the apni peeth ke peeche (apne unt par). Phir woh apni ghutna baithe aur apni ghutna rakhi taaki Safiya apna paanv uspar rakhkar (unt par) sawar ho saken.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) stayed with Safiya bint Huyai for three days on the way of Khaibar where he consummated his marriage with her. Safiya was amongst those who were ordered to use a veil
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi Khaibar ke raste mein Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Huyai ke saath teen din ruke jahaan unhone unse apni shaadi poori ki. Safiya un logon mein se thi jinhe parda pahnne ka hukum diya gaya tha.

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) stayed for three nights between Khaibar and Medina and was married to Safiya. I invited the Muslim to his marriage banquet and there waa neither meat nor bread in that banquet but the Prophet ordered Bilal to spread the leather mats on which dates, dried yogurt and butter were put. The Muslims said amongst themselves, "Will she (i.e. Safiya) be one of the mothers of the believers, (i.e. one of the wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) ) or just (a lady captive) of what his right-hand possesses" Some of them said, "If the Prophet (ﷺ) makes her observe the veil, then she will be one of the mothers of the believers (i.e. one of the Prophet's wives), and if he does not make her observe the veil, then she will be his lady slave." So when he departed, he made a place for her behind him (on his camel and made her observe the veil)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi Khaibar aur Madina ke beech teen raaten ruke aur unki Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) se shaadi huee. Maine Musalmanon ko unki shaadi ki dawat ke liye bulaya, aur us dawat mein na gosht tha na roti, magar Nabi ne Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko chamde ki chataiyaan bichhane ka hukum diya jinpar khajoor, sookhi dahi, aur ghi rakhe gaye. Musalman aapas mein kahne lage, "Kya woh (yaani Safiya) mominon ki maaton mein se ek hogi (yaani Nabi ki biwiyon mein se ek), ya sirf (ek qaidi aurat) jo unke haathon mein hai?" Unmein se kuch ne kaha, "Agar Nabi unhe parda pahnate hain, phir woh mominon ki maaton mein se ek hongi (yaani Nabi ki biwiyon mein se ek), aur agar woh unhe parda nahi pahnwate, phir woh unki launDi hogi." Isliye jab woh rawana hue, unhone unke liye apne peeche ek jagah banaee (apne unt par) aur unhe parda pahnwaya.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Mughaffal:While we were besieging Khaibar, a person threw a leather container containing some fat and I ran to take it. Suddenly I looked behind, and behold! The Prophet (ﷺ) was there. So I felt shy (to take it then)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Mughaffal bataate hain: Jabke hum Khaibar ko gher rahe the, ek shaks ne ghi se bhara ek chamde ka bartan phenka, aur main use lene ke liye dauda. Achanak maine peeche mudkar dekha, aur dekho! Nabi wahaan the. Isliye main sharminda ho gaya (use us waqt lene se).

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:On the day of Khaiber, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the eating of garlic and the meat of donkeys
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Khaibar ke din, Allah ke Rasool ne lassun aur gadhon ka gosht khaane se mana kiya.

e: Narrated `Ali bin Abi Talib:On the day of Khaibar, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the Mut'a (i.e. temporary marriage) and the eating of donkey-meat
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bin Abi Talib bataate hain: Khaibar ke din, Allah ke Rasool ne Mut'a (yaani asthai shaadi) aur gadhon ka gosht khaane se mana kiya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:On the day of Khaibar, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the eating of donkey meat
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Khaibar ke din, Allah ke Rasool ne gadhon ka gosht khaane se mana kiya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the eating of donkey-meat
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne gadhon ka gosht khaane se mana kiya.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:On the day of Khaibar, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the eating of donkey meat and allowed the eating of horse meat
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Khaibar ke din, Allah ke Rasool ne gadhon ka gosht khaane se mana kiya aur ghode ka gosht khaane ki ijazat di.

e: Narrated Ibn Abi `Aufa:We where afflicted with severe hunger on the day of Khaibar. While the cooking pots were boiling and some of the food was well-cooked, the announcer of the Prophet (ﷺ) came to say, "Do not eat anything of the donkey-meat and upset the cooking pots." We then thought that the Prophet (ﷺ) had prohibited such food because the Khumus had not been taken out of it. Some others said, "He prohibited the meat of donkeys from the point of view of principle, because donkeys used to eat dirty things
hi: Ibn Abi Aufa bataate hain: Khaibar ke din humein sakht bhookh ka saamna karna pada. Jabke khaane ke bartan ubal rahe the aur kuch khaana achhi tarah pak chuka tha, Nabi ke elaan karne wale aaye aur kaha, "Gadhon ka gosht mat khao aur bartan khali kar do." Ispar humne socha Nabi ne aisa khaana isliye mana kiya kyunke usmein se Khumus (yaani paanchvaan hissa) nahi liya gaya tha. Kuch doosron ne kaha, "Unhone gadhon ka gosht siddhant ke tor par mana kiya, kyunke gadhe gaandi cheezein khate the."

e: Narrated Al-Bara and `Abdullah bin Abi `Aufa:That when they were in the company of the Prophet, they got some donkeys which they (slaughtered and) cooked. Then the announcer of the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Turn the cooking pots upside down (i.e. throw out the meat)
hi: Al-Bara aur Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Aufa bataate hain: Jab woh Nabi ki sohbat mein the, unhe kuch gadhe mile jinhe unhone (zabah karke) paka liya. Phir Nabi ke elaan karne wale ne kaha, "Khaane ke bartan ulte karo (yaani gosht bahar phenko)."

e: Narrated Al-Bara' and Ibn Abi `Aufa:On the day of Khaibar when the cooking pots were put on the fire, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Turn the cooking pots upside down
hi: Al-Bara aur Ibn Abi Aufa bataate hain: Khaibar ke din jab khaane ke bartan aag par rakhe gaye, Nabi ne kaha, "Bartan ulte karo."

e: Narrated Al-Bara:We took part in a Ghazwa with the Prophet (same as Hadith No)
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Hum ek Ghazwe mein Nabi ke saath the (usi Hadith jaisa jaisa pahle bataya gaya).

e: Narrated Al-Bara Bin Azib:During the Ghazwa of Khaibar, the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered us to throw away the meat of the donkeys whether it was still raw or cooked. He did not allow us to eat it later on
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ghazwa Khaibar ke dauran, Nabi ne humein gadhon ka gosht phenkne ka hukum diya, chahe woh kachcha ho ya paka hua. Unhone humein baad mein use khaane ki ijazat nahi di.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I do not know whether the Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the eating of donkey-meat (temporarily) because they were the beasts of burden for the people, and he disliked that their means of transportation should be lost, or he forbade it on the day of Khaibar permanently
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Mujhe nahi pata kya Nabi ne gadhon ka gosht khaane se (asthai soorat se) isliye mana kiya kyunke woh log logon ke saamaan dhone wale janwar the, aur unhe napasand tha ke unke safar karne ke saadhan kho jaen, ya unhone ise Khaibar ke din hamesha ke liye mana kiya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:On the day of Khaibar, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) divided (the war booty of Khaibar) with the ratio of two shares for the horse and one-share for the foot soldier. (The sub-narrator, Nafi` explained this, saying, "If a man had a horse, he was given three shares and if he had no horse, then he was given one share)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Khaibar ke din, Allah ke Rasool ne (yuddha ke maal-e-ghanimat ko) do hisse ghode ke liye aur ek hissa paidal soldier ke liye ke anupaat mein baanta. (Subordinate raawi, Nafi ne iski vyaakhya karte huye kaha, "Agar ek shaks ke paas ghoda tha, use teen hisse diye jate the, aur agar unke paas ghoda nahi tha, phir unhe ek hissa diya jata tha.")

e: Narrated Jubair bin Mut`im:`Uthman bin `Affan and I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "You had given Banu Al-Muttalib from the Khumus of Khaibar's booty and left us in spite of the fact that we and Banu Al-Muttalib are similarly related to you." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Banu Hashim and Banu Al-Muttalib only are one and the same." So the Prophet (ﷺ) did not give anything to Banu `Abd Shams and Banu Nawfal
hi: Jubair bin Mut'im bataate hain: Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Affan aur main Nabi ke paas gaye aur kaha, "Aapne Banu Al-Muttalib ko Khaibar ke maal-e-ghanimat ke Khumus mein se diya aur humein chhod diya, jabke hum aur Banu Al-Muttalib donon aapse barabar rishta rakhte hain." Nabi ne kaha, "Banu Hashim aur Banu Al-Muttalib sirf ek hi hain (ek hi pariwaar)." Isliye Nabi ne Banu Abd Shams aur Banu Naufal ko kuch nahi diya.

e: Narrated Abu Musa:The news of the migration of the Prophet (from Mecca to Medina) reached us while we were in Yemen. So we set out as emigrants towards him. We were (three) I and my two brothers. I was the youngest of them, and one of the two was Abu Burda, and the other, Abu Ruhm, and our total number was either 53 or 52 men from my people. We got on board a boat and our boat took us to Negus in Ethiopia. There we met Ja`far bin Abi Talib and stayed with him. Then we all came (to Medina) and met the Prophet (ﷺ) at the time of the conquest of Khaibar. Some of the people used to say to us, namely the people of the ship, "We have migrated before you." Asma' bint 'Umais who was one of those who had come with us, came as a visitor to Hafsa, the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ). She had migrated along with those other Muslims who migrated to Negus. `Umar came to Hafsa while Asma' bint 'Umais was with her. `Umar, on seeing Asma,' said, "Who is this?" She said, "Asma' bint 'Umais," `Umar said, "Is she the Ethiopian? Is she the sea-faring lady?" Asma' replied, "Yes." `Umar said, "We have migrated before you (people of the boat), so we have got more right than you over Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) " On that Asma' became angry and said, "No, by Allah, while you were with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who was feeding the hungry ones amongst you, and advised the ignorant ones amongst you, we were in the far-off hated land of Ethiopia, and all that was for the sake of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . By Allah, I will neither eat any food nor drink anything till I inform Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) of all that you have said. There we were harmed and frightened. I will mention this to the Prophet (ﷺ) and will not tell a lie or curtail your saying or add something to it
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ki (Mecca se Madina) hijrat ki khabar humtak pahunchi jabke hum Yemen mein the. Isliye hum unki taraf Muhajir ke soorat mein nikle. Hum (teen) the — main aur mere do bhai. Main unmein sabse chhota tha, aur unmein se ek Abu Burda the aur doosre Abu Ruhm, aur humari kul tadaad terpan ya baawan (52 ya 53) log the meri qaum se. Hum ek jahaaz mein sawar hue aur humara jahaaz humein Ethiopia mein Negus tak le gaya. Wahaan humein Ja'far bin Abi Talib mile aur hum unke saath ruke. Phir hum sab (Madina) aaye aur Nabi se Khaibar ki fatah ke waqt mile. Kuch log humse kahte, yaani jahaaz ke log, "Humne tumse pahle hijrat ki." Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Umais, jo hamare saath aee thi unmein se ek thi, Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) se milne gaee, jo Nabi ki biwi thi. Woh un doosre Musalmanon ke saath hijrat karke aee thi jinhone Negus ki taraf hijrat ki thi. Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) Hafsa ke paas aaye jabke Asma bint Umais unke saath thi. Umar ne, Asma ko dekhkar, kaha, "Yeh kaun hai?" Unhone kaha, "Asma bint Umais." Umar ne kaha, "Kya woh wahi Ethiopian hai? Kya woh wahi samundri safar karne wali mahila hai?" Asma ne jawab diya, "Haan." Umar ne kaha, "Humne tumse (aye jahaaz ke logo) pahle hijrat ki, isliye humara Allah ke Rasool par tumse zyada haqq hai." Ispar Asma naraj ho gaee aur kaha, "Nahi, Allah ki qasam, jabke tum Allah ke Rasool ke saath the jo tummein se bhooke logon ko khilate the aur naadanon ko naseehat dete the, hum door-daraz Ethiopia ki napasand ki huee zameen mein the, aur woh sab Allah ke Rasool ki khaatir thi. Allah ki qasam, na main koee khaana khaungi na koee cheez piungi jab tak main Allah ke Rasool ko yeh sab jo tumne kaha nahi bata deti. Wahaan humein takleef aur dar mila. Main yeh Nabi ko bataungi aur na jhoot bolungi na tumhari baat kam karungi na kuch jodungi."

e: So when the Prophet (ﷺ) came, she said, "O Allah's Prophet `Umar has said so-and-so." He said (to Asma'), "What did you say to him?" Asma' said, "I told him so-and-so." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He (i.e. `Umar) has not got more right than you people over me, as he and his companions have (the reward of) only one migration, and you, the people of the boat, have (the reward of) two migrations." Asma' later on said, "I saw Abu Musa and the other people of the boat coming to me in successive groups, asking me about this narration, and to them nothing in the world was more cheerful and greater than what the Prophet (ﷺ) had said about them." Narrated Abu Burda:Asma' said, "I saw Abu Musa requesting me to repeat this narration again and again
hi: (aage kaha:) Isliye jab Nabi aaye, unhone kaha, "Aye Allah ke Nabi! Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne falaan-falaan kaha." Unhone (yaani Nabi ne Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) se) pucha, "Tumne unse kya kaha?" Asma ne kaha, "Maine unse falaan-falaan kaha." Nabi ne kaha, "Unka (yaani Umar ka) tum logon par mujhpar koee zyada haqq nahi hai, kyunke unke aur unke sathiyon ke paas sirf ek hijrat (ka ajr) hai, jabke tum, jahaaz ke log, do hijraton (ka ajr) rakhte ho." Asma ne baad mein kaha, "Maine Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur jahaaz ke doosre logon ko baari-baari mere paas aate dekha, ismein se is riwaayat ke baare mein puchte huye, aur unke liye duniya mein isse zyada khushi aur mahatva wali koee cheez nahi thi jitna Nabi ne unke baare mein jo kaha tha." Abu Burda bataate hain: Asma ne kaha, "Maine dekha Abu Musa mujhse is riwaayat ko baar-baar doharane ki guzarish kar rahe the."

e: Narrated Abu Burda:Abu Musa said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I recognize the voice of the group of Al- Ashariyun, when they recite the Qur'an, when they enter their homes at night, and I recognize their houses by (listening) to their voices when they are reciting the Qur'an at night although I have not seen their houses when they came to them during the day time. Amongst them is Hakim who, on meeting the cavalry or the enemy, used to say to them (i.e. the enemy). My companions order you to wait for them
hi: Abu Burda bataate hain: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Nabi ne kaha, 'Main Al-Ashariyun (qabile) ke giroh ki aawaaz pahchanta hoon jab woh Quran padhte hain, jab woh raat ko apne gharon mein daakhil hote hain, aur main unke gharon ko unki aawaaz se pahchanta hoon jab woh raat ko Quran padhte hain, chahe maine unke ghar din mein dekhe na hon jab woh unmein aaye. Unmein Hakim hain jo, ghodswaron ya dushman se mulaqaat hone par, unse (yaani dushman se) kahte, Mere sathi tumhe unka intezaar karne ka hukum dete hain.'"

e: Narrated Abu Musa:We came upon the Prophet (ﷺ) after he had conquered Khaibar. He then gave us a share (from the booty), but apart from us he did not give to anybody else who did not attend the Conquest
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Nabi ke paas aaye Khaibar ki fatah ke baad. Unhone humein ek hissa diya (maal-e-ghanimat se), magar humare ilawa unhone kisi aur ko nahi diya jo fatah ke waqt maujood nahi tha.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:When we conquered Khaibar, we gained neither gold nor silver as booty, but we gained cows, camels, goods and gardens. Then we departed with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to the valley of Al-Qura, and at that time Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had a slave called Mid`am who had been presented to him by one of Banu Ad-Dibbab. While the slave was dismounting the saddle of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) an arrow the thrower of which was unknown, came and hit him. The people said, "Congratulations to him for the martyrdom." Allah's Apostle said, "No, by Him in Whose Hand my soul is, the sheet (of cloth) which he had taken (illegally) on the day of Khaibar from the booty before the distribution of the booty, has become a flame of Fire burning him." On hearing that, a man brought one or two leather straps of shoes to the Prophet and said, "These are things I took (illegally)." On that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "This is a strap, or these are two straps of Fire
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab humne Khaibar fatah kiya, humein na sona mila na chandi maal-e-ghanimat mein, balki humein gaay, unt, saamaan, aur baag mile. Phir hum Allah ke Rasool ke saath Al-Qura ki waadi ki taraf badhe, aur us waqt Allah ke Rasool ke paas ek gulaam tha jinka naam Mid'am tha jinhe Banu Ad-Dibbab mein se ek shaks ne unhe tohfe mein diya tha. Jabke gulaam Allah ke Rasool ki saddle utar raha tha, ek teer, jiska chalane wala anjaan tha, aaya aur unhe lag gaya. Logon ne kaha, "Unse shahadat mubarak ho." Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Nahi, us Zaat ki qasam jiske haathon mein meri jaan hai, woh chaadar jo unhone (na-jaiz soorat se) Khaibar ke din maal-e-ghanimat se taqseem hone se pahle li thi, ab unpar aag ki lapat ban gaee hai jo unhe jala rahi hai." Yeh sunkar, ek shaks Nabi ke paas ek ya do chamde ki jootiyon ki pattiyaan laaya aur kaha, "Yeh cheezein hain jo maine li hain (na-jaiz soorat se)." Ispar Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Yeh ek patti hai, ya yeh do (Dozakh ki) aag ki pattiyaan hain."

e: Narrated `Umar bin Al-Khattab:By Him in Whose Hand my soul is, were I not afraid that the other Muslims might be left in poverty, I would divide (the land of) whatever village I may conquer (among the fighters), as the Prophet (ﷺ) divided the land of Khaibar. But I prefer to leave it as a (source of) a common treasury for them to distribute its revenue amongst themselves
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab bataate hain: Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haathon mein meri jaan hai, agar mujhe dar na hota ke doosre Musalman gareebi mein rah jaaenge, main (zameen) taqseem kar deta jis bhi gaanv ko main fatah karta (mujahidon ke beech), jaise Nabi ne Khaibar ki zameen taqseem ki. Magar main ise ek saamanya kosh ke tor par chhodna pasand karta hoon taaki (log) uski aamdani aapas mein baant saken.

e: Narrated `Umar:But for the other Muslims (i.e. coming generations) I would divide (the land of) whatever villages the Muslims might conquer (among the fighters), as the Prophet (ﷺ) divided (the land of) Khaibar
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Magar aane wali peedhiyon ke Musalmanon ke liye, main woh gaanv taqseem kar deta jise Musalman fatah karenge (mujahidon ke beech), jaise Nabi ne Khaibar ki zameen taqseem ki.

e: Narrated 'Anbasa bin Sa`id:Abu Huraira came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and asked him (for a share from the Khaibar booty). On that, one of the sons of Sa`id bin Al-`As said to him, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Do not give him." Abu Huraira then said (to the Prophet (ﷺ) ) "This is the murderer of Ibn Qauqal." Sa`id's son said, "How strange! A guinea pig coming from Qadum Ad-Dan
hi: Anbasa bin Sa'id bataate hain: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) Nabi ke paas gaye aur unse (Khaibar ke maal-e-ghanimat mein se) hissa maanga. Ispar, Sa'id bin Al-As ke beton mein se ek ne unse kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Unhe mat dijiye." Abu Huraira ne phir kaha (Nabi se), "Yeh Ibn Qauqal ka hatyara hai." Sa'id ke bete ne kaha, "Kitni ajeeb baat hai! Qadum Ad-Dan se aee ek ginni pig!"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent Aban from Medina to Najd as the commander of a Sariya. Aban and his companions came to the Prophet (ﷺ) at Khaibar after the Prophet (ﷺ) had conquered it, and the reins of their horses were made of the fire of date palm trees. I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Do not give them a share of the booty." On that, Aban said (to me), "Strange! You suggest such a thing though you are what you are, O guinea pig coming down from the top of Ad-Da'n (a lotus tree)!" On that the Prophet said, "O Aban, sit down!" and did not give them any share
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Madina se Aban ko Najd ki taraf ek Sariya (yaani chhote daste) ka kamander bankar bheja. Aban aur unke sathi Nabi ke paas Khaibar mein aaye Nabi ke ise fatah karne ke baad, aur unke ghodon ki lagamen khajoor ke darakhton ki daaliyon se bani huee thi. Maine kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Unhe maal-e-ghanimat mein hissa mat dijiye." Ispar, Aban ne (mujhse) kaha, "Kitni ajeeb baat hai! Aap aisi baat sujhaav dete hain chahe aap jo bhi hain, Aye Ad-Da'n ki choti se aee ginni pig!" Ispar Nabi ne kaha, "Aye Aban, baith jao!" aur unhe koee hissa nahi diya.

e: Narrated Sa`id:Aban bin Sa`id came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and greeted him. Abu Huraira said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! This (Aban) is the murderer of Ibn Qauqal." (On hearing that), Aban said to Abu Huraira, "How strange your saying is! You, a guinea pig, descending from Qadum Dan, blaming me for (killing) a person whom Allah favored (with martyrdom) with my hand, and whom He forbade to degrade me with his hand
hi: Sa'id bataate hain: Aban bin Sa'id Nabi ke paas aaye aur unhe salaam kiya. Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Yeh (Aban) Ibn Qauqal ka hatyara hai." (Yeh sunkar), Aban ne Abu Huraira se kaha, "Aapki baat kitni ajeeb hai! Aap, ek ginni pig, Qadum Dan se aakar, mujhpar us shaks ki (hatya) ka ilzaam lagate hain jise Allah ne mere haathon se shahaadat se nawaza, aur jise usne mera apman karne se roka uske haathon se?"

e: Narrated `Aisha:Fatima the daughter of the Prophet (ﷺ) sent someone to Abu Bakr (when he was a caliph), asking for her inheritance of what Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had left of the property bestowed on him by Allah from the Fai (i.e. booty gained without fighting) in Medina, and Fadak, and what remained of the Khumus of the Khaibar booty. On that, Abu Bakr said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Our property is not inherited. Whatever we leave, is Sadaqa, but the family of (the Prophet) Muhammad can eat of this property.' By Allah, I will not make any change in the state of the Sadaqa of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and will leave it as it was during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and will dispose of it as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to do." So Abu Bakr refused to give anything of that to Fatima. So she became angry with Abu Bakr and kept away from him, and did not task to him till she died. She remained alive for six months after the death of the Prophet. When she died, her husband `Ali, buried her at night without informing Abu Bakr and he said the funeral prayer by himself. When Fatima was alive, the people used to respect `Ali much, but after her death, `Ali noticed a change in the people's attitude towards him. So `Ali sought reconciliation with Abu Bakr and gave him an oath of allegiance. `Ali had not given the oath of allegiance during those months (i.e. the period between the Prophet's death and Fatima's death). `Ali sent someone to Abu Bakr saying, "Come to us, but let nobody come with you," as he disliked that `Umar should come, `Umar said (to Abu Bakr), "No, by Allah, you shall not enter upon them alone " Abu Bakr said, "What do you think they will do to me? By Allah, I will go to them' So Abu Bakr entered upon them, and then `Ali uttered Tashah-hud and said (to Abu Bakr), "We know well your superiority and what Allah has given you, and we are not jealous of the good what Allah has bestowed upon you, but you did not consult us in the question of the rule and we thought that we have got a right in it because of our near relationship to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ." Thereupon Abu Bakr's eyes flowed with tears. And when Abu Bakr spoke, he said, "By Him in Whose Hand my soul is to keep good relations with the relatives of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) is dearer to me than to keep good relations with my own relatives. But as for the trouble which arose between me and you about his property, I will do my best to spend it according to what is good, and will not leave any rule or regulation which I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) following, in disposing of it, but I will follow." On that `Ali said to Abu Bakr, "I promise to give you the oath of allegiance in this after noon." So when Abu Bakr had offered the Zuhr prayer, he ascended the pulpit and uttered the Tashah-hud and then mentioned the story of `Ali and his failure to give the oath of allegiance, and excused him, accepting what excuses he had offered; Then `Ali (got up) and praying (to Allah) for forgiveness, he uttered Tashah-hud, praised Abu Bakr's right, and said, that he had not done what he had done because of jealousy of Abu Bakr or as a protest of that Allah had favored him with. `Ali added, "But we used to consider that we too had some right in this affair (of rulership) and that he (i.e. Abu Bakr) did not consult us in this matter, and therefore caused us to feel sorry." On that all the Muslims became happy and said, "You have done the right thing." The Muslims then became friendly with `Ali as he returned to what the people had done (i.e. giving the oath of allegiance to Abu Bakr)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Fatima (Alayhas Salam), Nabi ki beti, ne Abu Bakr ke paas (jab woh Khalifa the) kisi ko bheja, apni waraasat maangte huye jo Allah ke Rasool ne chhodi thi us maal se jo Allah ne unhe Fai (yaani bina jung ke hasil hui maal-e-ghanimat) ke soorat mein di thi Madina mein, aur Fadak mein, aur jo bacha tha Khaibar ke maal-e-ghanimat ke Khumus mein se. Ispar, Abu Bakr ne kaha, "Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, 'Humari maal ki waraasat nahi hoti, aur jo hum chhodte hain woh Sadaqa hai, magar Muhammad ka pariwara is maal se kha sakta hai.' Allah ki qasam, main Allah ke Rasool ki Sadaqa ki haalat mein koee badlaav nahi karunga aur use usi tarah chhodunga jaisi woh Allah ke Rasool ki zindagi mein thi, aur use usi tarah istemal karunga jaisa Allah ke Rasool karte the." Isliye Abu Bakr ne Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ko usmein se kuch dene se inkaar kiya. Isliye woh Abu Bakr se naraaj ho gaee aur unse door rehne lagi, aur unse baat nahi ki jab tak unka intiqal nahi hua. Woh Nabi ki maut ke chhah mahine baad tak zinda rahi. Jab unka intiqal hua, unke shohar Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne unhe raat ko dafna diya bina Abu Bakr ko bataye aur khud unki janaza namaz padhi. Jabke Fatima (Alayhas Salam) zinda thi, log Ali (Alayhis Salam) ka bahut samman karte the, magar unki maut ke baad, Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne logon ke ravaiye mein badlaav mahsoos kiya. Isliye Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne Abu Bakr se sulha ki koshish ki aur unhe bai'at di. Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne un mahinon mein bai'at nahi di thi (yaani Nabi ki maut aur Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ki maut ke beech ki muddat). Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne Abu Bakr ko kaha bheja, "Humare paas aiye, magar koee aapke saath na aye," kyunke unhe Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ka ana napasand tha. Umar ne (Abu Bakr se) kaha, "Nahi, Allah ki qasam, aap akele unke paas nahi jaenge." Abu Bakr ne kaha, "Tumhe kya lagta hai woh mere saath kya karenge? Allah ki qasam, main unke paas jaunga." Isliye Abu Bakr unke paas gaye, aur phir Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne Tashah-hud padha aur (Abu Bakr se) kaha, "Humein achhi tarah pata hai aapki superiority aur jo Allah ne aapko diya hai, aur humein usse jalan nahi hai jo Allah ne aapko diya hai, magar aapne humein hukumat ke sawal mein raay nahi li, aur humein laga humara bhi ismein haqq hai Allah ke Rasool se humare qareebi rishte ki wajah se." Ispar Abu Bakr ki aankhon se aansu behne lage. Aur jab Abu Bakr ne baat ki, unhone kaha, "Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haathon mein meri jaan hai, Allah ke Rasool ke rishtedaron ke saath achhe ta'alluq rakhna mujhe apne khud ke rishtedaron se achhe ta'alluq rakhne se zyada pyara hai. Magar jahaan tak takraav ka sawal hai jo mere aur aapke beech unka maal ke baare mein hua, main ise achhe tarike se kharch karne ki poori koshish karunga, aur koi qaida ya zaabta nahi chhodunga jise maine Allah ke Rasool ko uska intezam karte dekha, main uski pairvi karunga." Ispar Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne Abu Bakr se kaha, "Main aapko aaj dopahar bai'at dene ka waada karta hoon." Isliye jab Abu Bakr ne Zuhr ki namaz padhi, woh mimbar par chadhe aur Tashah-hud padha aur phir Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki kahani aur unki bai'at na dene ki baat ka zikar kiya, aur unhe maaf kiya, jo bhi unke uzr the unhe qubool karte huye. Phir Ali (Alayhis Salam) (uthe) aur maafi maangte huye, Tashah-hud padha, Abu Bakr ke haqq ki taarif ki, aur kaha ke unhone jo kiya woh Abu Bakr se jalan ya Allah ne jo unhe diya tha uska virodh karne ki wajah se nahi kiya tha. Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne joda, "Magar hum yeh maante the ke humara bhi is (hukumat ke) maamle mein kuch haqq hai, aur unhone (yaani Abu Bakr ne) hummein ismein raay nahi li, isliye humein dukh hua." Ispar sab Musalman khush ho gaye aur kaha, "Aapne sahi kiya hai." Iske baad Musalman phir Ali (Alayhis Salam) se dostana ho gaye jaise woh us kaam (yaani Abu Bakr ko bai'at dena) ki taraf laut aaye jo doosre logon ne kiya tha.

e: Narrated `Aisha:When Khaibar was conquered, we said, "Now we will eat our fill of dates
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab Khaibar fatah hua, humne kaha, "Ab hum apna pet khajoor se bharkap khaenge."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:We did not eat our fill except after we had conquered Khaibar
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Humne apna pet bharkar nahi khaya jab tak humne Khaibar fatah nahi kiya.

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri and Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) appointed a man as the ruler of Khaibar who later brought some Janib (i.e. dates of good quality) to the Prophet. On that, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said (to him). "Are all the dates of Khaibar like this?" He said, "No, by Allah, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! But we take one Sa of these (dates of good quality) for two or three Sa's of other dates (of inferior quality)." On that, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Do not do so, but first sell the inferior quality dates for money and then with that money, buy Janib
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne ek shaks ko Khaibar ka gawarnar muqarrar kiya jo baad mein Janib (yaani achhi qisam ki khajoor) Nabi ke paas laaya. Ispar, Allah ke Rasool ne (unse) kaha, "Kya Khaibar ki sab khajoor aisi hi hain?" Unhone kaha, "Nahi, Allah ki qasam, Aye Allah ke Rasool! Magar hum in (achhi khajoor) ka ek Sa lete hain doosri (nichli qisam ki) khajoor ke do ya teen Sa ke badle mein." Ispar, Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Aisa mat karo, balki pahle nichli qisam ki khajoor ko paison mein bech do aur phir usi paise se, Janib khareedo."

e: Abu Sa`id and Abu Huraira said:"The Prophet (ﷺ) made the brother of Bani Adi from the Ansar as the ruler of Khaibar
hi: Abu Saeed aur Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Banu Adi ke ek Ansaari bhai ko Khaibar ka gawarnar muqarrar kiya.

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) gave (the land of) Khaibar to the Jews (of Khaibar) on condition that they would work on it and cultivate it and they would have half of its yield
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Khaibar (ki zameen) Yahudiyon ko di is shart par ke woh uspar mehnat karenge aur use kheti ke liye istemal karenge aur unhe iski paidawaar ka aadha hissa milega.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:When Khaibar was conquered, a (cooked) sheep containing poison, was given as a present to Allah's Apostle
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Khaibar fatah hua, Allah ke Rasool ko tohfe mein ek (paka hua) bhed diya gaya jismein zahar mila hua tha.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) appointed Usama bin Zaid as the commander of some people. Those people criticized his leadership. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If you speak ill of his leadership, you have already spoken ill of his father's leadership before. By Allah, he deserved to be a Commander, and he was one of the most beloved persons to me and now this (i.e. Usama) is one of the most beloved persons to me after him
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko kuch logon ka sardaar muqarrar kiya. Un logon ne unki agwaee ki aalochana ki. Nabi ne kaha, "Agar tum unki agwaee ki buraee kar rahe ho, tumne pahle bhi unke waalid ki agwaee ki buraee ki thi. Allah ki qasam, woh sardaar banne ke laayak the, aur woh mere sabse pyare logon mein se the, aur ab yeh (yaani Usama) unke baad mere sabse pyare logon mein se hain."

e: Narrated Al-Bara:When the Prophet (ﷺ) went out for the `Umra in the month of Dhul-Qa'da, the people of Mecca did not allow him to enter Mecca till he agreed to conclude a peace treaty with them by virtue of which he would stay in Mecca for three days only (in the following year). When the agreement was being written, the Muslims wrote: "This is the peace treaty, which Muhammad, Apostle of Allah has concluded." The infidels said (to the Prophet), "We do not agree with you on this, for if we knew that you are Apostle of Allah we would not have prevented you for anything (i.e. entering Mecca, etc.), but you are Muhammad, the son of `Abdullah." Then he said to `Ali, "Erase (the name of) 'Apostle of Allah'." `Ali said, "No, by Allah, I will never erase you (i.e. your name)." Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took the writing sheet...and he did not know a better writing..and he wrote or got it the following written! "This is the peace treaty which Muhammad, the son of `Abdullah, has concluded: "Muhammad should not bring arms into Mecca except sheathed swords, and should not take with him any person of the people of Mecca even if such a person wanted to follow him, and if any of his companions wants to stay in Mecca, he should not forbid him." (In the next year) when the Prophet (ﷺ) entered Mecca and the allowed period of stay elapsed, the infidels came to `Ali and said "Tell your companion (Muhammad) to go out, as the allowed period of his stay has finished." So the Prophet (ﷺ) departed (from Mecca) and the daughter of Hamza followed him shouting "O Uncle, O Uncle!" `Ali took her by the hand and said to Fatima, "Take the daughter of your uncle." So she made her ride (on her horse). (When they reached Medina) `Ali, Zaid and Ja`far quarreled about her. `Ali said, "I took her for she is the daughter of my uncle." Ja`far said, "She is the daughter of my uncle and her aunt is my wife." Zaid said, "She is the daughter of my brother." On that, the Prophet (ﷺ) gave her to her aunt and said, "The aunt is of the same status as the mother." He then said to `Ali, "You are from me, and I am from you," and said to Ja`far, "You resemble me in appearance and character," and said to Zaid, "You are our brother and our freed slave." `Ali said to the Prophet 'Won't you marry the daughter of Hamza?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "She is the daughter of my foster brother
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Jab Nabi Dhul-Qa'da mahine mein Umrah ke liye nikle, Mecca ke logon ne unhe Mecca daakhil hone nahi diya jab tak woh unke saath ek sulha karar par raazi nahi hue jiske anusaar woh (agle saal) sirf teen din Mecca mein rukte. Jab muahida likha ja raha tha, Musalmanon ne likha, "Yeh woh sulha karar hai jo Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool, ne kiya hai." Kaafiron ne (Nabi se) kaha, "Hum ismein aapse sahmat nahi hain, kyunke agar humein pata hota aap Allah ke Rasool hain hum aapko kisi cheez se nahi rokte, magar aap Muhammad, Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke bete, hain." Phir unhone Ali (Alayhis Salam) se kaha, "'Allah ke Rasool' ko mitado." Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha, "Nahi, Allah ki qasam, main aapko (yaani aapka naam) kabhi nahi mitaunga." Phir Allah ke Rasool ne kaagaz liya...aur unhe isse achha likhaee nahi aati thi...aur unhone likha ya likhwaya yeh: "Yeh sulha karar hai jo Muhammad, Abdullah ke bete, ne kiya hai: Muhammad Mecca mein koee hathiyaar nahi laega siwaye myaan mein rakhi talwaron ke, aur woh Mecca ke logon mein se kisi ko apne saath nahi le jaayega chahe woh unki pairvi karna chahta ho, aur agar unke kisi sathi ko Mecca mein rukna hai, woh unhe mana nahi karenge." (Agle saal) jab Nabi Mecca daakhil hue aur ijazat mili muddat khatm ho gaee, kaafiron ne Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke paas aakar kaha, "Apne sathi (Muhammad) ko kaho ke woh chale jaen, kyunke unki rehne ki ijazat ki muddat khatm ho chuki hai." Isliye Nabi (Mecca se) rawana hue aur Hamza ki beti unke peeche daudi, chillate huye, "Aye chacha, Aye chacha!" Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne unka haath pakada aur Fatima (Alayhas Salam) se kaha, "Apni chachere behn ko lo." Isliye unhone unhe (apni untni par) bithaya. (Jab woh Madina pahunche) Ali (Alayhis Salam), Zaid, aur Ja'far unke baare mein jhagadne lage. Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha, "Maine unhe liya kyunke woh meri chachere behn hain." Ja'far ne kaha, "Woh meri chachere behn hain aur unki bua meri biwi hain." Zaid ne kaha, "Woh meri bhaee ki beti hain." Ispar, Nabi ne unhe unki bua ko diya aur kaha, "Bua maa ki hi haalat mein hoti hai." Phir Nabi ne Ali (Alayhis Salam) se kaha, "Tum mujhse ho, aur main tumse hoon," aur Ja'far se kaha, "Tum soorat aur charitra mein mujhse milte-julte ho," aur Zaid se kaha, "Tum humare bhai aur humare azaad kiye gulaam ho." Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne Nabi se kaha, "Kya aap Hamza ki beti se shaadi nahi karenge?" Nabi ne kaha, "Woh mere doodh-bhai ki beti hain."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) set out with the intention of performing `Umra, but the infidels of Quraish intervened between him and the Ka`ba, so the Prophet (ﷺ) slaughtered his Hadi (i.e. sacrificing animals and shaved his head at Al-Hudaibiya and concluded a peace treaty with them (i.e. the infidels) on condition that he would perform the `Umra the next year and that he would not carry arms against them except swords, and would not stay (in Mecca) more than what they would allow. So the Prophet (ﷺ) performed the `Umra in the following year and according to the peace treaty, he entered Mecca, and when he had stayed there for three days, the infidels ordered him to leave, and he left
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool Umrah karne ke irade se nikle, magar Quraish ke kaafiron ne unke aur Ka'ba ke beech dakhal diya, isliye Nabi ne apni Hadi zabah ki aur apna sar munwaya Al-Hudaibiya mein aur unke (yaani kaafiron ke) saath ek sulha karar kiya is shart par ke woh agle saal Umrah karenge aur woh unke khilaf koee hathiyaar nahi laenge siwaye talwaron ke, aur woh (Mecca mein) usse zyada nahi rukenge jitna unhe ijazat milegi. Isliye Nabi ne agle saal Umrah kiya aur sulha karar ke anusaar, unhone Mecca mein pravesh kiya, aur jab woh teen din ruke, kaafiron ne unhe jane ka hukum diya, aur woh chale gaye.

e: Narrated Mujahid:`Urwa and I entered the Mosque and found `Abdullah bin `Umar sitting beside the dwelling place of `Aisha. `Urwa asked (Ibn `Umar), "How many `Umras did the Prophet (ﷺ) perform?" Ibn `Umar replied, "Four, one of which was in Rajab." Then we heard `Aisha brushing her teeth whereupon `Urwa said, "O mother of the believers! Don't you hear what Abu `Abdur-Rahman is saying? He is saying that the Prophet performed four `Umra, one of which was in Rajab." `Aisha said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) did not perform any `Umra but he (i.e. Ibn `Umar) witnessed it. And he (the Prophet (ﷺ) ) never did any `Umra in (the month of) Rajab
hi: Mujahid bataate hain: Urwa aur main masjid mein daakhil hue aur Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke rehne ki jagah ke bagal baithe paaya. Urwa ne (Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se) pucha, "Nabi ne kitne Umrah kiye?" Ibn Umar ne jawab diya, "Chaar, jinmein se ek Rajab mein tha." Phir humne Ayesha ko apne daant safaee karte suna, ispar Urwa ne kaha, "Aye mominon ki maa! Kya aap sun rahi hain Abu Abdur-Rahman kya kah rahe hain? Woh keh rahe hain Nabi ne chaar Umrah kiye, jinmein se ek Rajab mein tha." Ayesha ne kaha, "Nabi ne koee bhi Umrah nahi kiya jiske woh (yaani Ibn Umar) gawah nahi the. Aur unhone kabhi Rajab (mahine) mein Umrah nahi kiya."

e: Narrated Ibn Abi `Aufa:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) performed the `Umra (which he performed in the year following the treaty of Al-Hudaibiya) we were screening Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) from the infidels and their boys lest they should harm him
hi: Ibn Abi Aufa bataate hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool ne Umrah kiya (jo unhone Al-Hudaibiya ke muahide ke agle saal kiya), hum Allah ke Rasool ko kaafiron aur unke bachchon se parda karte the taaki unhe koee nuksaan na pahunch sake.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and his companions arrived (at Mecca), the pagans said, "There have come to you a group of people who have been weakened by the fever of Yathrib (i.e. Medina)." So the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered his companions to do Ramal (i.e. fast walking) in the first three rounds of Tawaf around the Ka`ba and to walk in between the two corners (i.e. the black stone and the Yemenite corner). The only cause which prevented the Prophet (ﷺ) from ordering them to do Ramal in all the rounds of Tawaf, was that he pitied them
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool aur unke sathi (Mecca) pahunche, mushrikon ne kaha, "Tumhare paas aise log aaye hain jinhen Yathrib (yaani Madina) ke bukhaar ne kamzor kar diya hai." Isliye Nabi ne apne sahaba ko hukum diya ke woh Ka'ba ke Tawaf ke pahle teen chakron mein Ramal (yaani tez chalna) karen aur do konon (yaani kale pathar aur Yemeni kona) ke beech chalen. Nabi ne unhe poore Tawaf mein Ramal karne ka hukum isliye nahi diya kyunke unhe unpar rehm aee.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) hastened in going around the Ka`ba and between the Safa and Marwa in order to show the pagans his strength. Ibn `Abbas added, "When the Prophet (ﷺ) arrived (at Mecca) in the year of peace (following that of Al-Hudaibiya treaty with the pagans of Mecca), he (ordered his companions) to do Ramal in order to show their strength to the pagans and the pagans were watching (the Muslims) from (the hill of) Quaiqan
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Ka'ba ke gird aur Safa aur Marwa ke beech jaldi ki taaki woh mushrikon ko apni taakat dikha saken. Ibn Abbas ne joda, "Jab Nabi Fatah ke saal (yaani Al-Hudaibiya ke muahide ke baad) (Mecca) pahunche, unhone (apne sahaba ko hukum diya) Ramal karne ka taaki woh mushrikon ko apni taakat dikha saken, aur mushrik unhe Quaiqan (pahad) se dekh rahe the."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) married Maimuna while he was in the state of Ihram but he consummated that marriage after finishing that state. Maimuna died at Sarif (i.e. a place near Mecca)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) se shaadi ki jabke woh Ihram ki haalat mein the, magar unhone apni shaadi Ihram poora hone ke baad poori ki. Maimuna ka intiqal Sarif (yaani Mecca ke qareeb ek jagah) mein hua.

e: Ibn `Abbas added:The Prophet married Maimuna during the `Umrat-al-Qada' (i.e. the `Umra performed in lieu of the `Umra which the Prophet (ﷺ) could not perform because the pagans, prevented him to perform that `Umra
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne joda: Nabi ne Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) se shaadi Umrat-al-Qada ke dauran ki (yaani woh Umrah jo Nabi ne poora nahi kar paye the kyunke mushrikon ne unhe us Umrah se roka tha).

e: Narrated Nafi`:Ibn `Umar informed me that on the day (of Mu'tah) he stood beside Ja`far who was dead (i.e. killed in the battle), and he counted fifty wounds in his body, caused by stabs or strokes, and none of those wounds was in his back
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne mujhe bataya ke us din (yaani Mu'tah ki jung ke din) woh Ja'far ke bagal khade the jo maar diye gaye the (yaani jung mein qatl kiye gaye), aur unhone unke jism par pachaas zakhm gine, chaaku ya vaar ki wajah se, aur inmein se koee bhi zakhm unki peeth par nahi tha.

e: Abdullah bin `Umar said:"Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) appointed Zaid bin Haritha as the commander of the army during the Ghazwa of Mu'tah and said, "If Zaid is martyred, Ja`far should take over his position, and if Ja`far is martyred, `Abdullah bin Rawaha should take over his position.' " `Abdullah bin `Umar further said, "I was present amongst them in that battle and we searched for Ja`far bin Abi Talib and found his body amongst the bodies of the martyred ones, and found over ninety wounds over his body, caused by stabs or shots (of arrows)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Zaid bin Haritha ko Mu'tah ki jung ke dauran fauj ka kamandar muqarrar kiya aur kaha, "Agar Zaid shaheed ho jaen, Ja'far unki jagah sambhale, aur agar Ja'far shaheed ho jaen, Abdullah bin Rawaha unki jagah sambhale." Abdullah bin Umar ne aage kaha, "Main us jung mein unke saath maujood tha aur humne Ja'far bin Abi Talib ko dhoondha aur unka jism shaheed logon ke jismon ke beech paaya, aur unke jism par nabbe se zyada zakhm paaye, chaaku ya teeron ki wajah se."

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) had informed the people of the martyrdom of Zaid, Ja`far and Ibn Rawaha before the news of their death reached. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Zaid took the flag (as the commander of the army) and was martyred, then Ja`far took it and was martyred, and then Ibn Rawaha took it and was martyred." At that time the Prophet's eyes were shedding tears. He added, "Then the flag was taken by a Sword amongst the Swords of Allah (i.e. Khalid) and Allah made them (i.e. the Muslims) victorious
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne logon ko Zaid, Ja'far, aur Ibn Rawaha ki shahadat ki khabar unki maut ki khabar untak pahunchne se pahle di thi. Nabi ne kaha, "Zaid ne jhanda liya aur shaheed hue, phir Ja'far ne liya aur shaheed hue, aur phir Ibn Rawaha ne liya aur shaheed hue." Us waqt Nabi ki aankhon se aansu behne lage. Unhone joda, "Phir jhanda Allah ki ek Talwaron mein se ek (yaani Khalid) ne liya, aur Allah ne unhe (yaani Musalmanon ko) fatah di."

e: Narrated `Amra:I heard `Aisha saying, "When the news of the martyrdom of Ibn Haritha, Ja`far bin Abi Talib and `Abdullah bin Rawaha reached, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sat with sorrow explicit on his face." `Aisha added, "I was then peeping through a chink in the door. A man came to him and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! The women of Ja`far are crying.' Thereupon the Prophet (ﷺ) told him to forbid them to do so. So the man went away and returned saying, "I forbade them but they did not listen to me." The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered him again to go (and forbid them). He went again and came saying, 'By Allah, they overpowered me (i.e. did not listen to me)." `Aisha said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said (to him), "Go and throw dust into their mouths." Aisha added, "I said, May Allah put your nose in the dust! By Allah, neither have you done what you have been ordered, nor have you relieved Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) from trouble
hi: Amra bataate hain: Maine Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko kehte suna, "Jab Ibn Haritha, Ja'far bin Abi Talib, aur Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Rawaha ki shahadat ki khabar pahunchi, Allah ke Rasool udaasi ke saath baith gaye, jo unke chehre par saaf dikh raha tha." Ayesha ne joda, "Main us waqt darwaze ke ek chhed se jhaank rahi thi. Ek shaks unke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Ja'far ki aurten ro rahi hain.' Ispar Nabi ne unhe unhe aisa karne se rokne ka hukum diya. Isliye shaks chala gaya aur wapas aakar kaha, 'Maine unhe roka magar unhone meri baat nahi maani.' Nabi ne unhe phir jane ka hukum diya. Woh phir gaye aur wapas aakar kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, unhone mujhe haavi kar diya (yaani meri baat nahi suni).'" Ayesha ne kaha ke Allah ke Rasool ne (unse) kaha, "Jao aur unke munhon mein mitti daalo." Ayesha ne joda, "Maine kaha, 'Allah tumhari naak ko mitti mein sane!' Allah ki qasam, na tumne woh kiya jiska tumhe hukum diya gaya, na tumne Allah ke Rasool ko takleef se rahat di."

e: Narrated 'Amir:Whenever Ibn `Umar greeted the son of Ja`far, he used to say (to him), "Assalam 'Alaika (i.e. peace be on you) O the son of two-winged person
hi: Amir bataate hain: Jab bhi Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) Ja'far ke bete ko salaam karte, woh (unse) kahte, "As-Salamu Alaika (yaani tumpar shaanti ho), Aye do-pankhon wale shaks ke bete!"

e: Narrated Khalid bin Al-Walid:On the day (of the battle of) Mu'tah, nine swords were broken in my hand, and nothing was left in my hand except a Yemenite sword of mine
hi: Khalid bin Al-Walid bataate hain: Mu'tah ke din (jung mein), mere haath mein nau talwaren toot gaee, aur mere haath mein sirf meri ek Yemeni talwaar baaki bachi.

e: Narrated Khalid bin Al-Walid:On the day of Mu'tah, nine swords were broken in my hand and only a Yemenite sword of mine remained in my hand
hi: Khalid bin Al-Walid bataate hain: Mu'tah ke din, mere haath mein nau talwaren toot gaee aur sirf meri ek Yemeni talwaar hi baaki bachi mere haath mein.

e: Narrated An-Nu`man bin Bashir:`Abdullah bin Rawaha fell down unconscious and his sister `Amra started crying and was saying loudly, "O Jabala! Oh so-and-so! Oh so-and-so! and went on calling him by his (good ) qualities one by one). When he came to his senses, he said (to his sister), "When-ever you said something, I was asked, 'Are you really so (i.e. as she says)?
hi: An-Nu'man bin Bashir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Rawaha behosh hokar gir gaye aur unki behn Amra rone lagi aur zor se kahne lagi, "Aye Jabala! Oh falaan-falaan! Oh falaan-falaan!" aur unke achhe gunon ka ek-ek karke naam lekar unhe pukaar rahi thi. Jab unhe hosh aaya, unhone (apni behn se) kaha, "Jab bhi tumne kuch kaha, mujhse pucha gaya, 'Kya tum sach mein aise ho (jaisi woh kah rahi hai)?'"

e: Narrated Ash Shabi:An Nu`man bin Bashir said, "Abdullah bin Rawaha fell down unconscious.." (and mentioned the above Hadith adding, "Thereupon, when he died she (i.e. his sister) did not weep over him
hi: Ash Shabi bataate hain: An Nu'man bin Bashir (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Rawaha behosh hokar gir gaye..." (aur upar wali Hadith joda, "Iske baad, jab unka intiqal hua, unki behn ne unke liye rona nahi kiya.")

e: Narrated Usama bin Zaid:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent us towards Al-Huraqa, and in the morning we attacked them and defeated them. I and an Ansari man followed a man from among them and when we took him over, he said, "La ilaha illal-Lah." On hearing that, the Ansari man stopped, but I killed him by stabbing him with my spear. When we returned, the Prophet (ﷺ) came to know about that and he said, "O Usama! Did you kill him after he had said "La ilaha ilal-Lah?" I said, "But he said so only to save himself." The Prophet (ﷺ) kept on repeating that so often that I wished I had not embraced Islam before that day
hi: Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne humein Al-Huraqa ki taraf bheja, aur subah humne unpar hamla kiya aur unhe haara diya. Main aur ek Ansaari shaks ne unmein se ek shaks ka picha kiya, aur jab humne unhe pakad liya, unhone kaha, "La ilaha illal-Lah." Yeh sunkar, Ansaari shaks ruka, magar maine unhe apne bhaale se maarkar qatl kar diya. Jab hum wapas aaye, Nabi ko is baat ki khabar mili aur unhone kaha, "Aye Usama! Kya tumne unhe qatl kiya unke 'La ilaha ilal-Lah' kahne ke baad?" Maine kaha, "Magar unhone woh sirf khud ko bachane ke liye kaha." Nabi yeh baat itni baar doharate rahe ke maine chaaha kaash maine us din se pahle Islam qubool na kiya hota.

e: Narrated Salama bin Al-Akwa`:I fought in seven Ghazwat (i.e. battles) along with the Prophet (ﷺ) and fought in nine battles, fought by armies dispatched by the Prophet. Once Abu Bakr was our commander and at another time, Usama was our commander
hi: Salama bin Al-Akwa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine saat Ghazwaton (yaani jungon) mein Nabi ke saath jung ki, aur nau jungon mein Nabi dwaara bheje gaye dason ke saath jung ki. Ek baar Abu Bakr humare kamandar the, aur ek doosri baar Usama humare kamandar the.

e: Narrated Salama (in another narration):I fought seven Ghazwat (i.e. battles) along with the Prophet (ﷺ) and also fought in nine battles, fought by armies sent by the Prophet (ﷺ) . Once Abu Bakr was our commander and another time, Usama was (our commander)
hi: Salama bataate hain (ek doosri riwaayat mein): Maine saat Ghazwaton mein Nabi ke saath jung ki, aur nau jungon mein bhi jung ki jo Nabi dwaara bheje gaye daston ne ladi. Ek baar Abu Bakr humare kamandar the, aur ek doosri baar Usama (humare kamandar the).

e: Narrated Salama bin Al-Akwa`:I fought in nine Ghazwa-t along with the Prophet, I also fought along with Ibn Haritha when the Prophet made him our commander
hi: Salama bin Al-Akwa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine nau Ghazwaat mein Nabi ke saath jung ki. Maine Ibn Haritha ke saath bhi jung ki jab Nabi ne unhe humare kamandar banaya.

e: Narrated Yazid bin Abi Ubaid:Salama bin Al-Akwa` said, "I fought in seven Ghazwat along with the Prophet." He then mentioned Khaibar, Al-Hudaibiya, the day (i.e. battle) of Hunain and the day of Al-Qarad. I forgot the names of the other Ghazwat
hi: Yazid bin Abi Ubaid bataate hain: Salama bin Al-Akwa (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Maine saat Ghazwaat mein Nabi ke saath jung ki." Phir unhone Khaibar, Al-Hudaibiya, Hunain ke din, aur Al-Qarad ke din ka zikar kiya. Main baaki Ghazwaton ke naam bhool gaya.

e: Narrated `Ali:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent me, Az-Zubair and Al-Miqdad saying, "Proceed till you reach Rawdat Khakh where there is a lady carrying a letter, and take that (letter) from her." So we proceeded on our way with our horses galloping till we reached the Rawda, and there we found the lady and said to her, "Take out the letter." She said, "I have no letter." We said, "Take out the letter, or else we will take off your clothes." So she took it out of her braid, and we brought the letter to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . The letter was addressed from Hatib, bin Abi Balta'a to some pagans of Mecca, telling them about what Allah's Apostle intended to do. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O Hatib! What is this?" Hatib replied, "O Allah's Apostle! Do not make a hasty decision about me. I was a person not belonging to Quraish but I was an ally to them from outside and had no blood relation with them, and all the Emigrants who were with you, have got their kinsmen (in Mecca) who can protect their families and properties. So I liked to do them a favor so that they might protect my relatives as I have no blood relation with them. I did not do this to renegade from my religion (i.e. Islam) nor did I do it to choose Heathenism after Islam." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to his companions." As regards him, he (i.e. Hatib) has told you the truth." `Umar said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Allow me to chop off the head of this hypocrite!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He (i.e. Hatib) has witnessed the Badr battle (i.e. fought in it) and what could tell you, perhaps Allah looked at those who witnessed Badr and said, "O the people of Badr (i.e. Badr Muslim warriors), do what you like, for I have forgiven you. "Then Allah revealed the Sura:-- "O you who believe! Take not my enemies And your enemies as friends offering them (Your) love even though they have disbelieved in that Truth (i.e. Allah, Prophet Muhammad and this Qur'an) which has come to you ....(to the end of Verse)....(And whosoever of you (Muslims) does that, then indeed he has gone (far) astray (away) from the Straight Path
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne mujhe, Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ), aur Al-Miqdad (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko bheja, kehte huye, "Jaao jab tak tum Rawdat Khakh na pahunch jao jahaan ek aurat khat lekar ja rahi hai, aur use (yaani khat) unse le lo." Isliye hum apne ghodon ko daudate huye badhe jab tak hum Rawda pahunche, aur wahaan humne woh aurat paee aur unse kaha, "Khat nikalo." Unhone kaha, "Mere paas koee khat nahi hai." Humne kaha, "Khat nikalo, warna hum tumhe nanga kar denge." Isliye unhone use apni choti mein se nikala, aur humne woh khat Allah ke Rasool ke paas laaya. Yeh khat Hatib bin Abi Balta'a se Mecca ke kuch mushrikon ke naam tha, unhe batate huye Allah ke Rasool ka irada kya tha. Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Aye Hatib! Yeh kya hai?" Hatib ne jawab diya, "Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mere baare mein jaldbaazi mat kariye. Main Quraish se mutaliq nahi tha, magar unke saath ek baahri muahid tha, aur unse mera koee khoon ka rishta nahi tha, aur sab Muhajir jo aapke saath the, unke (Mecca mein) rishtedaar hain jo unke pariwaron aur maal ki hifaazat kar sakte hain. Isliye maine socha unpar ek ehsaan karun taaki woh mere rishtedaron ki hifaazat karenge kyunke mera unse koee khoon ka rishta nahi hai. Maine yeh apne deen (yaani Islam) se peeth pherne ke liye nahi kiya, na hi maine Islam ke baad phir se but-parasti chunne ke liye kiya." Allah ke Rasool ne apne sahaba se kaha, "Jahaan tak unka (yaani Hatib ka) sawal hai, unhone aapko sach kaha." Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe is munafik ka sar kaatne dijiye!"
