Nabi ne kaha, "Woh (yaani Hatib) Badr ki jung ke gawah hain (yaani unmein ladne wale the), aur tumhe kya pata, shaayad Allah ne Badr ke gawahon ki taraf dekhkar kaha ho, 'Aye Badr ke log (yaani Badr ke Musalman mujahid), jo chaho karo, kyunke maine tumhe maaf kar diya hai.'" Phir Allah ne yeh Surah naazil ki: "Aye mominon! Mere dushmanon aur tumhare dushmanon ko dost mat banao, unhe mohabbat pesh karte huye chahe unhone us Sach (yaani Allah, Nabi Muhammad, aur is Quran) ka inkaar kiya ho jo tumhare paas aaya hai...." (aakhri tak)...."Aur tummein se jo bhi (Musalman) aisa karta hai, woh (door) Seedhe Raste se bhata gaya hai."

e: Narrated Ubaidullah bin `Abdullah bin `Utba:Ibn `Abbas said, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) fought the Ghazwa (i.e. battles of Al-Fath during Ramadan." Narrated Az-Zuhri: Ibn Al-Musaiyab (also) said the same. Ibn `Abbas added, "The Prophet (ﷺ) fasted and when he reached Al-Kadid, a place where there is water between Qudaid and 'Usfan, he broke his fast and did not fast afterwards till the whole month had passed away
hi: Ubaidullah bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Utba bataate hain: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, Allah ke Rasool ne Ghazwa Al-Fath Ramadan mein lada." Az-Zuhri bataate hain: Ibn Al-Musaiyab ne bhi yehi kaha. Ibn Abbas ne joda, "Nabi ne roza rakha aur jab woh Al-Kadid pahunche, ek jagah jahaan Qudaid aur Usfan ke beech paani hai, unhone apna roza tod diya aur baad mein poore mahine ke guzarne tak roza nahi rakha."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) left Medina (for Mecca) in the company of ten-thousand (Muslim warriors) in (the month of) Ramadan, and that was eight and a half years after his migration to Medina. He and the Muslims who were with him, proceeded on their way to Mecca. He was fasting and they were fasting, but when they reached a place called Al-Kadid which was a place of water between 'Usfan and Qudaid, he broke his fast and so did they. (Az-Zuhri said, "One should take the last action of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and leave his early action (while taking a verdict)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Madina chhoda (Mecca ke liye) das hazaar (Musalman mujahidon) ki sohbat mein Ramadan mein, aur yeh unki Madina hijrat ke aadhe saal baad thi. Woh aur unke saath ke Musalman Mecca ki taraf badhe. Woh roza rakhe hue the aur woh (Musalman) bhi rakhe hue the, magar jab woh Al-Kadid naam ki jagah pahunche jo Usfan aur Qudaid ke beech ek paani wali jagah thi, unhone apna roza tod diya aur unhone bhi (usi tarah kiya). (Az-Zuhri ne kaha, "Insaan ko Allah ke Rasool ka aakhri amal lena chahiye aur unka pahla amal chhodna chahiye (faisla lete waqt).")

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) set out towards Hunain in the month of Ramadan and some of the people were fasting while some others were not fasting, and when the Prophet (ﷺ) mounted his she-camel, he asked for a tumbler of milk or water and put it on the palm of his hand or on his she-camel and then the people looked at him; and those who were not fasting told those who were fasting, to break their fast (i.e. as the Prophet (ﷺ) had done so
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool Hunain ki taraf Ramadan mein nikle aur kuch log roza rakhe hue the jabke kuch nahi. Jab Nabi apni untni par chadhe, unhone doodh ya paani ka ek pyala maanga aur use apni hatheli ya apni untni par rakha, aur phir logon ne unhe dekha, aur jinhone roza nahi rakha tha unhone un logon se, jinhone roza rakha tha, apna roza todne ko kaha (yaani jaise Nabi ne kiya tha).

e: Ibn `Abbas added:"The Prophet (ﷺ) went (to Hunain) in the year of the Conquest (of Mecca)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne joda: Nabi (Hunain) gaye Fatah-e-Mecca ke saal.

e: Narrated Tawus:Ibn `Abbas said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) travelled in the month of Ramadan and he fasted till he reached (a place called) 'Usfan, then he asked for a tumbler of water and drank it by the daytime so that the people might see him. He broke his fast till he reached Mecca." Ibn `Abbas used to say, "Allah's Apostle fasted and sometimes did not fast while traveling, so one may fast or may not (on journeys)
hi: Tawus bataate hain: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Allah ke Rasool ne Ramadan ke mahine mein safar ki aur unhone roza rakha jab tak woh (ek jagah jise) Usfan pahunche, phir unhone paani ka ek pyala maanga aur use din mein piya taaki log unhe dekhen. Unhone Mecca pahunchne tak apna roza tod diya." Ibn Abbas kaha karte the, "Allah ke Rasool ne safar karte waqt kabhi roza rakha aur kabhi nahi rakha, isliye koee bhi (safar ke dauran) roza rakh sakta hai ya nahi rakh sakta."

e: Narrated Hisham's father:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) set out (towards Mecca) during the year of the Conquest (of Mecca) and this news reached (the infidels of Quraish), Abu Sufyan, Hakim bin Hizam and Budail bin Warqa came out to gather information about Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) , They proceeded on their way till they reached a place called Marr-az-Zahran (which is near Mecca). Behold! There they saw many fires as if they were the fires of `Arafat. Abu Sufyan said, "What is this? It looked like the fires of `Arafat." Budail bin Warqa' said, "Banu `Amr are less in number than that." Some of the guards of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw them and took them over, caught them and brought them to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Abu Sufyan embraced Islam. When the Prophet (ﷺ) proceeded, he said to Al-Abbas, "Keep Abu Sufyan standing at the top of the mountain so that he would look at the Muslims. So Al-`Abbas kept him standing (at that place) and the tribes with the Prophet (ﷺ) started passing in front of Abu Sufyan in military batches. A batch passed and Abu Sufyan said, "O `Abbas Who are these?" `Abbas said, "They are (Banu) Ghifar." Abu Sufyan said, I have got nothing to do with Ghifar." Then (a batch of the tribe of) Juhaina passed by and he said similarly as above. Then (a batch of the tribe of) Sa`d bin Huzaim passed by and he said similarly as above. then (Banu) Sulaim passed by and he said similarly as above. Then came a batch, the like of which Abu Sufyan had not seen. He said, "Who are these?" `Abbas said, "They are the Ansar headed by Sa`d bin Ubada, the one holding the flag." Sa`d bin Ubada said, "O Abu Sufyan! Today is the day of a great battle and today (what is prohibited in) the Ka`ba will be permissible." Abu Sufyan said., "O `Abbas! How excellent the day of destruction is! "Then came another batch (of warriors) which was the smallest of all the batches, and in it there was Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and his companions and the flag of the Prophet (ﷺ) was carried by Az-Zubair bin Al Awwam. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) passed by Abu Sufyan, the latter said, (to the Prophet), "Do you know what Sa`d bin 'Ubada said?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "What did he say?" Abu Sufyan said, "He said so-and-so." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Sa`d told a lie, but today Allah will give superiority to the Ka`ba and today the Ka`ba will be covered with a (cloth) covering." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered that his flag be fixed at Al-Hajun. Narrated `Urwa: Nafi` bin Jubair bin Mut`im said, "I heard Al-Abbas saying to Az-Zubair bin Al-`Awwam, 'O Abu `Abdullah! Did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) order you to fix the flag here?' " Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered Khalid bin Al-Walid to enter Mecca from its upper part from Ka'da while the Prophet (ﷺ) himself entered from Kuda. Two men from the cavalry of Khalid bin Al-Walid named Hubaish bin Al-Ash'ar and Kurz bin Jabir Al-Fihri were martyred on that day
hi: Hisham ke waalid bataate hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool (Mecca ki taraf) nikle Fatah ke saal aur yeh khabar (Quraish ke kaafiron tak) pahunchi, Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ), Hakim bin Hizam (رضی اللہ عنہ), aur Budail bin Warqa Allah ke Rasool ke baare mein jaankari lene nikle. Woh apne raste par badhe jab tak woh Marr-az-Zahran (yaani Mecca ke qareeb ek jagah) pahunche. Dekho! Wahaan unhone bahut sari aagen dekhi mano Arafat ki aagen hon. Abu Sufyan ne kaha, "Yeh kya hai? Yeh Arafat ki aagon jaisa dikhta hai." Budail bin Warqa ne kaha, "Banu Amr isse kam hain tadaad mein." Allah ke Rasool ke kuch paharedaron ne unhe dekha aur unhe pakad liya, unhe giraftaar kiya, aur Allah ke Rasool ke paas laaye. Abu Sufyan ne Islam qubool kiya. Jab Nabi aage badhe, unhone Al-Abbas se kaha, "Abu Sufyan ko pahad ki choti par khade rakho taaki woh Musalmanon ko dekh saken." Isliye Al-Abbas ne unhe wahaan khade rakha aur Nabi ke saath ke qabile Abu Sufyan ke saamne paltanon mein guzarne lage. Ek paltan guzari aur Abu Sufyan ne kaha, "Aye Abbas! Yeh kaun hain?" Abbas ne kaha, "Yeh (Banu) Ghifar hain." Abu Sufyan ne kaha, "Mera Ghifar se koee matlab nahi." Phir (Juhaina qabile ki ek paltan) guzari aur unhone usi tarah kaha jaisa upar tha. Phir (Sa'd bin Huzaim qabile ki ek paltan) guzari aur unhone usi tarah kaha. Phir (Banu) Sulaim guzre aur unhone usi tarah kaha. Phir ek paltan aee jaisi Abu Sufyan ne pahle kabhi nahi dekhi thi. Unhone pucha, "Yeh kaun hain?" Abbas ne kaha, "Yeh Ansaar hain, Sa'd bin Ubada (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke netritva mein, jo jhanda thaame hue hain." Sa'd bin Ubada ne kaha, "Aye Abu Sufyan! Aaj ek bade jung ka din hai aur aaj Ka'ba mein jo mana hai woh jaayaz ho jaayega." Abu Sufyan ne kaha, "Aye Abbas! Barbaadi ka din kitna behtareen hai!" Phir ek doosri paltan aee jo sab paltnon se sabse chhoti thi, aur usmein Allah ke Rasool aur unke sathi the, aur Nabi ka jhanda Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Awwam thaam rahe the. Jab Allah ke Rasool Abu Sufyan ke paas se guzre, unhone (Nabi se) kaha, "Kya aapko pata hai Sa'd bin Ubada ne kya kaha?" Nabi ne pucha, "Unhone kya kaha?" Abu Sufyan ne kaha, "Unhone falaan-falaan kaha." Nabi ne kaha, "Sa'd ne jhoot kaha, magar aaj Allah Ka'ba ko superiority dega aur aaj Ka'ba ek (kapde se) dhaanka jaayega." Allah ke Rasool ne hukum diya ke unka jhanda Al-Hajun mein gaada jaaye. Urwa bataate hain: Nafi bin Jubair bin Mut'im ne kaha, "Maine Al-Abbas ko Az-Zubair bin Al-Awwam se kehte suna, 'Aye Abu Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ)! Kya Allah ke Rasool ne aapko hukum diya jhanda yahaan gaadne ka?'" Allah ke Rasool ne Khalid bin Al-Walid ko hukum diya ke woh Mecca ke oonche hisse se, Kada se, daakhil hon, jabke Nabi khud Kuda se daakhil hue. Khalid bin Al-Walid ke ghodswaron mein se do log, Hubaish bin Al-Ash'ar aur Kurz bin Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Fihri, us din shaheed hue.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Mughaffal:I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the day of the Conquest of Mecca over his she-camel, reciting Surat-al-Fath in a vibrant quivering tone. (The sub-narrator, Mu'awiya added, "Were I not afraid that the people may gather around me, I would recite in vibrant quivering tone as he (i.e. `Abdullah bin Mughaffal) did, imitating Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Mughaffal bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool ko Fatah-e-Mecca ke din apni untni par dekha, Surat-al-Fath ek kaanpti huee aawaaz mein padhte hue. (Subordinate raawi, Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne joda, "Agar mujhe dar na hota ke log mere aas-paas jama ho jaenge, main bhi Surat-al-Fath usi kaanpti huee aawaaz mein padhta jaisa unhone (yaani Abdullah bin Mughaffal ne) padha tha, Allah ke Rasool ki nakal karte huye.")

e: Narrated `Amr bin `Uthman:Usama bin Zaid said during the Conquest (of Mecca), "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Where will we encamp tomorrow?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "But has `Aqil left for us any house to lodge in?" He then added, "No believer will inherit an infidel's property, and no infidel will inherit the property of a believer." Az- Zuhri was asked, "Who inherited Abu Talib?" Az-Zuhri replied, "Aqil and Talib inherited him
hi: Amr bin Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Fatah (Mecca) ke dauran kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Hum kal kahaan padaav dalenge?" Nabi ne kaha, "Kya Aqil ne humare liye koee ghar chhoda hai jahaan hum rah saken?" Unhone aage kaha, "Koee bhi momin kaafir ki maal ki waraasat nahi karega, aur koee bhi kaafir momin ki maal ki waraasat nahi karega." Az-Zuhri se pucha gaya, "Abu Talib ka waaris kaun tha?" Az-Zuhri ne jawab diya, "Aqil aur Talib ne unki waraasat li."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If Allah makes us victorious, our encamping place will be Al-Khaif, the place where the infidels took an oath to be loyal to Heathenism (by boycotting Banu Hashim, the Prophet's folk)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Agar Allah humein fatah deta hai, humara padaav Al-Khaif hoga, jahaan kaafiron ne jhoote buton (yaani but-parasti) ke prati wafadaar rehne ki qasam khaee thi (Banu Hashim, Nabi ke khaandaan ka bahishkaar karte huye)."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) intended to carry on the Ghazwa of Hunain, he said, "Tomorrow, if Allah wished, our encamping) plaice will be Khaif Bani Kinana where (the infidels) took an oath to be loyal to Heathenism
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool ne Hunain ke Ghazwe ke liye jane ka irada kiya, unhone kaha, "Kal, Insha Allah, humara padaav Khaif Bani Kinana hoga jahaan (kaafiron ne) jhoote buton (yaani but-parasti) ke prati wafadaar rehne ki qasam khaee thi."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:On the day of the Conquest, the Prophet (ﷺ) entered Mecca, wearing a helmet on his head. When he took it off, a man came and said, "Ibn Khatal is clinging to the curtain of the Ka`ba." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Kill him." (Malik a sub-narrator said, "On that day the Prophet (ﷺ) was not in a state of Ihram as it appeared to us, and Allah knows better
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Fatah ke din, Nabi ne Mecca mein pravesh kiya, apne sar par ek khod pahne hue. Jab unhone ise utaara, ek shaks aaya aur kaha, "Ibn Khatal Ka'ba ke parde se chipka hua hai." Nabi ne kaha, "Unhe qatl karo." (Subordinate raawi, Malik ne kaha, "Us din Nabi Ihram ki haalat mein nahi the jaisa humein lagta hai, aur Allah behtar jaanta hai.")

e: Narrated `Abdullah:When the Prophet (ﷺ) entered Mecca on the day of the Conquest, there were 360 idols around the Ka`ba. The Prophet (ﷺ) started striking them with a stick he had in his hand and was saying, "Truth has come and Falsehood will neither start nor will it reappear
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Nabi Fatah ke din Mecca mein daakhil hue, Ka'ba ke aas-paas teen saath (360) but the. Nabi ne apne haath mein pakdi ek laathi se unhe maarna shuru kiya aur kah rahe the, "Sach aa gaya hai, aur jhoot na uthega na phir prakat hoga."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) arrived in Mecca, he refused to enter the Ka`ba while there were idols in it. So he ordered that they be taken out. The pictures of the (Prophets) Abraham and Ishmael, holding arrows of divination in their hands, were carried out. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "May Allah ruin them (i.e. the infidels) for they knew very well that they (i.e. Abraham and Ishmael) never drew lots by these (divination arrows). Then the Prophet (ﷺ) entered the Ka`ba and said. "Allahu Akbar" in all its directions and came out and did not offer any prayer therein
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool Mecca pahunche, unhone Ka'ba mein daakhil hone se inkaar kiya jab tak usmein but the. Isliye unhone unhe bahar nikalne ka hukum diya. Ibrahim aur Ismail (Nabiyon) ki chitren, jinke haathon mein peshangoi ke teer the, bahar nikali gaee. Nabi ne kaha, "Allah unhe (yaani kaafiron ko) barbaad kare, kyunke unhe achhi tarah pata tha ke unhone (yaani Ibrahim aur Ismail ne) kabhi in (peshangoi ke) teer se qura nahi kiya." Phir Nabi ne Ka'ba mein pravesh kiya aur uski har taraf mein "Allahu Akbar" kaha aur bahar aaye aur wahaan koee namaz nahi padhi.

e: Narrated 'Abdullãh bin 'Umar (ra):Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered Makkah through its upper part and he was riding his she-camel. Usãma bin Zaid was his Companion-rider behind him (on the same she-camel). In his company were Bilãl and 'Uthmãn bin Talha, who was one of the Al-Hajabah (who keep the key of the gate of the Ka'bah). When he made his she-camel kneel down in the Mosque (i.e., Al-Masjid al-Haram), he ordered him (i.e., 'Uthman) to bring the key of the Ka'bah. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered the Ka'bah along with 'Usãma bin Zaid, Bilãl and 'Uthmãn bin Talha, and he stayed in it for a long period and then came out. The people rushed (to get in) and `Abdullãh bin 'Umar was the first to enter and he found Bilãl standing behind the door. Ibn `Umar asked Bilãl, "Where did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) offer the Salat (prayer)?" Bilãl showed him the place where he (ﷺ) had offered Salat (prayer). `Abdullah later on said, "I forgot to ask Bilãl how many prostrations (i.e., Rak'a) the Prophet offered
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Mecca mein uske oonche hisse se pravesh kiya, apni untni par sawar hokar. Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) unke saath ek hi untni par peeche baithe the. Unke saath Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) the, jo Al-Hajabah mein se ek the (jo Ka'ba ke darwaze ki chaabi rakhte hain). Jab unhone apni untni masjid mein bithaee (yaani Al-Masjid-ul-Haram mein), unhone unhe (yaani Uthman ko) Ka'ba ki chaabi lane ka hukum diya. Phir Allah ke Rasool ne Usama bin Zaid, Bilal, aur Uthman bin Talha ke saath Ka'ba mein pravesh kiya, aur woh ismein ek lambe waqt tak ruke aur phir bahar aaye. Log andar jane ke liye daude, aur Abdullah bin Umar sabse pahle daakhil hue aur unhone Bilal ko darwaze ke peeche khade paaya. Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Bilal se pucha, "Allah ke Rasool ne namaz kahaan padhi?" Bilal ne unhe woh jagah dikhaee jahaan unhone namaz padhi thi. Abdullah ne baad mein kaha, "Main Bilal se puchna bhool gaya ki Nabi ne kitni rakaten padhi thi."

e: Narrated `Aisha:During the year of the Conquest (of Mecca), the Prophet (ﷺ) entered Mecca through Kada which was at the upper part of Mecca
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Fatah ke saal, Nabi Mecca mein Kada se daakhil hue, jo Mecca ke oonche hisse mein tha.

e: Narrated Hisham's father:During the year of the Conquest (of Mecca), the Prophet (ﷺ) entered Mecca through its upper part through Kada
hi: Hisham ke waalid bataate hain: Fatah ke saal, Nabi Mecca mein uske oonche hisse se Kada se daakhil hue.

e: Narrated Ibn Abi Laila:None informed us that he saw the Prophet (ﷺ) offering the Duha (i.e. forenoon) prayer, except Um Hani who mentioned that the Prophet (ﷺ) took a bath in her house on the day of the Conquest (of Mecca) and then offered an eight rak`at prayer. She added, "I never saw the Prophet (ﷺ) offering a lighter prayer than that prayer, but he was performing perfect bowing and prostrations
hi: Ibn Abi Laila bataate hain: Humein kisi ne bhi yeh nahi bataya ke unhone Nabi ko Duha (yaani dopahar se pahle ki) namaz padhte dekha, siwaye Um Hani ke jinhone zikar kiya ke Nabi ne unke ghar mein Fatah ke din ghusal kiya aur phir aath rakaton ki namaz padhi. Unhone joda, "Maine Nabi ko us namaz se halki koee namaz kabhi nahi padhte dekha, magar woh poori tarah ruku aur sajda kar rahe the."

e: Narrated 'Aishah (ra):The Prophet (ﷺ) used to say in his bowings and prostrations, "Subhanaka Allahumma Rabbanã wa bihamdika, Allãhumma ighfirli" (Glorified be You, O Allah, our Lord! All the praises are for You. O Allah, forgive me)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi apne ruku aur sajdon mein kaha karte the, "Subhanaka Allahumma Rabbana wa bihamdika, Allahumma ighfirli" (yaani Aapki pavitrata ho, Aye Allah, humare Rab! Sab taarifen tere liye hain. Aye Allah, mujhe maaf kar).

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:`Umar used to admit me (into his house) along with the old men who had fought in the Badr battle. Some of them said (to `Umar), "Why do you allow this young man to enter with us, while we have sons of his own age? " `Umar said, "You know what person he is." One day `Umar called them and called me along with them, I had thought he called me on that day to show them something about me (i.e. my knowledge). `Umar asked them, "What do you say about (the Sura): "When comes the help of Allah and the Conquest (of Mecca) And you see mankind entering the Religion of Allah (i.e. Islam) in crowds. 'So celebrate the Praises Of your Lord and ask for His forgiveness, Truly, He is the One Who accepts repentance and forgives." (110.1-3) Some of them replied, "We are ordered to praise Allah and repent to Him if we are helped and granted victory." Some said, "We do not know." Others kept quiet. `Umar then said to me, "Do you say similarly?" I said, "No." `Umar said "What do you say then?" I said, "This Verse indicates the approaching of the death of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) of which Allah informed him. When comes the help of Allah and the Conquest, i.e. the Conquest of Mecca, that will be the sign of your Prophet's) approaching death, so testify the uniqueness of your Lord (i.e. Allah) and praise Him and repent to Him as He is ready to forgive." On that, `Umar said, "I do not know about it anything other than what you know
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) mujhe (apne ghar mein) un boodhe logon ke saath daakhil hone dete the jinhone Badr ki jung mein hissa liya tha. Unmein se kuch ne (Umar se) kaha, "Aap is jawan shaks ko humare saath aane kyun dete hain, jabke humare khud ke bete bhi unki hi umr ke hain?" Umar ne kaha, "Tumhe pata hai woh kaisa shaks hain." Ek din Umar ne unhe bulaya aur mujhe bhi unke saath bulaya, aur maine socha unhone mujhe us din is liye bulaya taaki woh (unke saamne) mera kuch dikha sakon (yaani mera ilm). Umar ne unse pucha, "Aap in (Surah) ke baare mein kya kahte hain: 'Jab Allah ki madad aati hai aur Vijay (yaani Mecca ki fatah), aur aap dekhte hain log dal ke dal Allah ke deen (yaani Islam) mein daakhil ho rahe hain, isliye apne Rab ki taarif gaiye aur usse kshama maangiye. Wahi hai jo tauba qubool karta hai aur maaf karta hai.'" (110:1-3) Unmein se kuch ne jawab diya, "Humein hukum diya gaya hai ke agar humein madad aur fatah di jaaye, hum Allah ki taarif karen aur usse tauba karen." Kuch ne kaha, "Humein nahi pata." Doosre khaamosh rahe. Umar ne phir mujhse kaha, "Kya tum bhi yehi kahte ho?" Maine kaha, "Nahi." Umar ne pucha, "Phir tum kya kahte ho?" Maine kaha, "Yeh Ayat Allah ke Rasool ki nikat wafat ka ishara karti hai jiski Allah ne unhe khabar di thi. 'Jab Allah ki madad aur Vijay aae,' yaani Mecca ki fatah, yehi aapke Nabi ki nikat maut ka nishaan hoga, isliye apne Rab ki ekta ki gawahi dijiye aur uski taarif kijiye aur usse tauba kijiye kyunke woh maaf karne ke liye taiyaar hai." Ispar, Umar ne kaha, "Mujhe iske baare mein wahi pata hai jo tumhe pata hai."

e: Narrated Abu Shuraih:Al-Adawi that he said to `Amr bin Sa`id while the latter was sending troops in batches to Mecca, "O chief! Allow me to tell you a statement which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said on the second day of the Conquest of Mecca. My two ears heard it and my heart remembered it and my two eyes saw him when he said it. He (i.e. the Prophet) praised Allah and then said, 'Mecca has been made a sanctuary by Allah and not by the people, so it is not lawful for a person, who believes in Allah and the Last Day to shed blood in it, or to cut its trees and if someone asks the permission to fight in Mecca because Allah's Apostle was allowed to fight in it, say to him; Allah permitted His Apostle and did not allow you, and even he (i.e. the Apostle) was allowed for a short period of the day, and today its (Mecca's sanctity has become the same as it was before (of old) so those who are present should inform those who are absent (this Hadith)." Then Abu Shuraih, was asked, "What did `Amr say to you? Abu Shuraih said, "He said, "I knew that better than you, O Abu Shuraih! The Haram (i.e. Mecca) does not give refuge to a sinner or a fleeing murderer or a person running away after causing destruction
hi: Abu Shuraih (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Al-Adawi ne Amr bin Sa'id se kaha jabke woh Mecca ki taraf dale-dale sainikon ko bhej rahe the, "Aye sardaar! Mujhe aapko ek baat batane dijiye jo Allah ke Rasool ne Mecca ki Fatah ke doosre din kahi thi. Mere donon kaan ne ise suna aur mere dil ne ise yaad rakha aur meri donon aankhon ne unhe dekha jab unhone ise kaha. Unhone (yaani Nabi ne) Allah ki taarif ki aur phir kaha, 'Mecca ko Allah ne pavitra banaya hai, na ke logon ne, isliye yeh kisi aise shaks ke liye jaayaz nahi hai jo Allah aur Akhirat ke din par iman rakhta ho ke woh yahaan khoon bahaye, ya iske darakhton ko kate; aur agar koee yeh kahne ki ijazat maangta hai ke woh Mecca mein jung kar sakta hai kyunke Allah ke Rasool ko ismein jung karne ki ijazat mili thi, unse kaho; Allah ne apne Rasool ko ijazat di aur tumhe nahi, aur unhe bhi din ke ek chhote hisse ke liye hi ijazat mili thi, aur aaj iski pavitrata phir waisi hi ho gaee hai jaisi woh pahle thi, isliye jo yahaan hain unhe jinke yahaan nahi hain unhe iski khabar deni chahiye (yeh Hadith).'" Phir Abu Shuraih se pucha gaya, "Amr ne aapko kya kaha?" Abu Shuraih ne kaha, "Unhone kaha, 'Mujhe yeh tumse behtar pata hai, Aye Abu Shuraih! Al-Haram (yaani Mecca) kisi gunahgaar ko, ya bhaagte hue qaatil ko, ya tabaahi phailane ke baad bhaagte hue kisi insaan ko panah nahi deta.'"

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:That he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying in the year of the Conquest (of Mecca) while he was in Mecca, "Allah and His Apostle have made the selling of wine (i.e. alcoholic drinks) unlawful
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Unhone Allah ke Rasool ko Fatah ke saal, jabke woh Mecca mein the, yeh kahte huye suna, "Allah aur uske Rasool ne sharab (yaani nashile pey padaarthon) ka vyaapaar haram kar diya hai."

e: Narrated Anas:We stayed (in Mecca) for ten days along with the Prophet (ﷺ) and used to offer shortened prayers (i.e. journey prayers)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum (Mecca mein) das din tak Nabi ke saath ruke aur usmein hum choti (yaani safar ki) namazen padhte rahe.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) stayed in Mecca for 19 days during which he prayed 2 rak`at in each prayer
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi Mecca mein unnees din ruke jinke dauran unhone har namaz mein do rakaten padhi.

e: Narrated `Ikrima:Ibn `Abbas said, "We stayed for 19 days with the Prophet on a journey during which we used to offer shortened prayers." Ibn `Abbas added, "We offer the Qasr prayer (i.e. shortened prayer) If we stay up to 19 days as travelers, But if we stay longer, we offer complete prayers
hi: Ikrima bataate hain: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Hum ek safar ke dauran Nabi ke saath unnees din ruke jinke dauran hum choti (yaani safar ki) namazen padhte the." Ibn Abbas ne joda, "Hum Qasr (yaani choti) namaz padhte hain agar hum yaatriyon ke tor par unnees din tak rukte hain, magar agar hum isse zyada rukte hain, hum poori namaz padhte hain."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Tha`laba bin Su`air whose face was rubbed by the Prophet during the year of the Conquest (of Makkah)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Tha'laba bin Su'air bataate hain, jinke chehre ko Nabi ne Fatah ke saal (apne haathon se muhabbat se) chhuya tha.

e: Narrated Az-Zuhri:While we were in the company of Ibn Al-Musaiyab, Sunain Abi Jamila informed us (a Hadith), Abu Jamila said that he lived during the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) and that he had accompanied him ( to Mecca) during the year of the Conquest (of Mecca)
hi: Az-Zuhri bataate hain: Jabke hum Ibn Al-Musaiyab ki sohbat mein the, Sunain Abi Jamila ne humein ek Hadith sunaee. Abu Jamila ne kaha ke woh Nabi ki zindagi mein rahte the aur unhone Fatah ke saal unke saath (Mecca) jane ka saath diya tha.

e: Narrated `Amr bin Salama:We were at a place which was a thoroughfare for the people, and the caravans used to pass by us and we would ask them, "What is wrong with the people? What is wrong with the people? Who is that man?. They would say, "That man claims that Allah has sent him (as an Apostle), that he has been divinely inspired, that Allah has revealed to him such-and-such." I used to memorize that (Divine) Talk, and feel as if it was inculcated in my chest (i.e. mind) And the 'Arabs (other than Quraish) delayed their conversion to Islam till the Conquest (of Mecca). They used to say." "Leave him (i.e. Muhammad) and his people Quraish: if he overpowers them then he is a true Prophet. So, when Mecca was conquered, then every tribe rushed to embrace Islam, and my father hurried to embrace Islam before (the other members of) my tribe. When my father returned (from the Prophet) to his tribe, he said, "By Allah, I have come to you from the Prophet (ﷺ) for sure!" The Prophet (ﷺ) afterwards said to them, 'Offer such-and-such prayer at such-and-such time, and when the time for the prayer becomes due, then one of you should pronounce the Adhan (for the prayer), and let the one amongst you who knows Qur'an most should, lead the prayer." So they looked for such a person and found none who knew more Qur'an than I because of the Qur'anic material which I used to learn from the caravans. They therefore made me their Imam ((to lead the prayer) and at that time I was a boy of six or seven years, wearing a Burda (i.e. a black square garment) proved to be very short for me (and my body became partly naked). A lady from the tribe said, "Won't you cover the anus of your reciter for us?" So they bought (a piece of cloth) and made a shirt for me. I had never been so happy with anything before as I was with that shirt
hi: Amr bin Salama bataate hain: Hum ek aisi jagah par the jo logon ka aane-jane ka raasta thi, aur caravan humare paas se guzarte the aur hum unse puchte, "Logon ko kya hua hai? Logon ko kya hua hai? Woh shaks kaun hai?" Woh kahte, "Woh shaks daava karta hai ke Allah ne unhe (Nabi ke tor par) bheja hai, ke unhe Divine ilham mila hai, ke Allah ne unpar falaan-falaan nazil kiya hai." Main us (Divine) baat ko yaad rakhta tha aur mahsoos karta tha mano yeh mere seene (yaani manasika) mein ghusa hua ho. Aur (doosre) Arb log (Quraish ke ilawa) apni Islam qubool karne ki taarikh ko Fatah tak deri karte rahe. Woh kahte, "Leave unhe (yaani Muhammad ko) aur unki qaum Quraish ko chhod do: agar woh unpar haavi ho jate hain, phir woh ek sachcha Nabi hain." Isliye jab Mecca fatah huee, har qabile ne Islam qubool karne ke liye daud lagaee, aur mere waalid ne apni qaum se pahle Islam qubool karne ki jaldbaazi ki. Jab mere waalid (Nabi se milne ke baad) apni qaum ke paas wapas aaye, unhone kaha, "Allah ki qasam, main sach mein Nabi ki taraf se tumhare paas aaya hoon!" Nabi ne baad mein unse kaha, "Falaan-falaan namaz falaan-falaan waqt par padho, aur jab namaz ka waqt aa jaye, tummein se koee ek Adhan de, aur tummein se jo Quran sabse zyada jaanta ho use Imam banaya jaaye." Isliye unhone aise shaks ko dhoondha aur mujhse behtar koee nahi mila kyunke maine caravan se jitna Quranic saamagri seekhi thi. Isliye unhone mujhe apna Imam bana diya, aur us waqt main chhah ya saat saal ka bachcha tha, ek Burda (yaani ek kaala vaiga kapda) pahne hue jo mere liye bahut chhota saabit hua (aur mera shareer thoda nanga ho gaya). Qabile ki ek mahilla ne kaha, "Kya aap humare liye humare padhne wale (yaani mujhe) ki peeth ko dhaank nahi sakte?" Isliye unhone (kapde ka ek tukda) khareeda aur mere liye ek qameej banaee. Maine kabhi kisi cheez se itni khushi mahsoos nahi ki jitni us qameej se ki.

e: Narrated `Aisha:`Utba bin Abi Waqqas authorized his brother Sa`d to take the son of the slave-girl of Zam`a into his custody. `Utba said (to him). "He is my son." When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) arrived in Mecca during the Conquest (of Mecca), Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas took the son of the slave-girl of Zam`a and took him to the Prophet (ﷺ) `Abd bin Zam`a too came along with him. Sa`d said. "This is the son of my brother and the latter has informed me that he is his son." `Abd bin Zam`a said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! This is my brother who is the son of the slave-girl of Zam`a and was born on his (i.e. Zam'as) bed.' Allah's Apostle looked at the son of the slave-girl of Zam`a and noticed that he, of all the people had the greatest resemblance to `Utba bin Abi Waqqas. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then said (to `Abd), " He is yours; he is your brother, O `Abd bin Zam`a, he was born on the bed (of your father)." (At the same time) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said (to his wife Sauda), "Veil yourself before him (i.e. the son of the slave-girl) O Sauda," because of the resemblance he noticed between him and `Utba bin Abi Waqqas. Allah's Apostle added, "The boy is for the bed (i.e. for the owner of the bed where he was born), and stone is for the adulterer." (Ibn Shihab said, "Abu Huraira used to say that (i.e. the last statement of the Prophet in the above Hadith 596, publicly)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Utba bin Abi Waqqas ne apne bhai Sa'd ko Zam'a ki launDi ke bete ko apni hifaazat mein lene ka ikhtiyar diya. Utba ne (unse) kaha, "Woh mera beta hai." Jab Allah ke Rasool Fatah ke dauran Mecca pahunche, Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Zam'a ki launDi ke bete ko liya aur use Nabi ke paas le gaye. Abd bin Zam'a bhi unke saath aaye. Sa'd ne kaha, "Yeh mere bhai ka beta hai aur unhone mujhe bataya ke woh unka beta hai." Abd bin Zam'a ne kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Yeh mera bhai hai, jo Zam'a ki launDi ka beta hai aur unke (yaani Zam'a ke) bistar par paida hua tha." Allah ke Rasool ne Zam'a ki launDi ke bete ki taraf dekha aur mahsoos kiya ke woh, sab logon mein se, Utba bin Abi Waqqas se sabse zyada milta-julta tha. Allah ke Rasool ne phir (Abd se) kaha, "Woh tumhara hai; woh tumhara bhai hai, Aye Abd bin Zam'a, woh (tumhare waalid ke) bistar par paida hua tha." (usi waqt) Allah ke Rasool ne (apni biwi Sauda (رضی اللہ عنہا) se) kaha, "Unke saamne parda karo (yaani launDi ke bete ke), Aye Sauda," us milte-julte soorat ki wajah se jo unhone Utba bin Abi Waqqas ke saath dekha tha. Allah ke Rasool ne joda, "Bachcha uski hai jinke bistar par woh paida hua (yaani jiska woh bistar hai), aur zina karne wale ke liye pathar (yaani saza)." (Ibn Shihab ne kaha, "Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) kaha karte the ke [yeh aakhri farmaan upar wali Hadith 596 mein] khule-aam kaha gaya tha.")

e: Narrated `Urwa bin Az-Zubair:A lady committed theft during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the Ghazwa of Al-Fath, ((i.e. Conquest of Mecca). Her folk went to Usama bin Zaid to intercede for her (with the Prophet). When Usama interceded for her with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), the color of the face of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) changed and he said, "Do you intercede with me in a matter involving one of the legal punishments prescribed by Allah?" Usama said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Ask Allah's Forgiveness for me." So in the afternoon, Allah's Apostle got up and addressed the people. He praised Allah as He deserved and then said, "Amma ba'du ! The nations prior to you were destroyed because if a noble amongst them stole, they used to excuse him, and if a poor person amongst them stole, they would apply (Allah's) Legal Punishment to him. By Him in Whose Hand Muhammad's soul is, if Fatima, the daughter of Muhammad stole, I would cut her hand." Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave his order in the case of that woman and her hand was cut off. Afterwards her repentance proved sincere and she got married. `Aisha said, "That lady used to visit me and I used to convey her demands to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
hi: Urwa bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek mahilla ne Allah ke Rasool ki zindagi mein Ghazwa Al-Fath (yaani Mecca ki Fatah) ke dauran chori ki. Unke log Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas gaye taaki woh unke liye (Nabi se) sifarish karen. Jab Usama ne Allah ke Rasool se unke liye sifarish ki, Allah ke Rasool ke chehre ka rang badal gaya aur unhone kaha, "Kya tum mujhse ek aise maamle mein sifarish kar rahe ho jismein Allah ke nirdharit qanooni sazaon mein se ek shaamil hai?" Usama ne kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Mere liye Allah se maafi maangiye." Isliye dopahar ko, Allah ke Rasool uthe aur logon ko sambodhit kiya. Unhone Allah ki taarif ki jaisa woh deserve karte hain, aur phir kaha, "Amma Ba'du! Tumse pahle ki qaumen isliye barbaad huee kyunke agar unmein se koee izzatdaar shaks chori karta, woh unhe maaf kar dete, magar agar koee gareeb shaks chori karta, woh unpar (Allah ka) qanooni saza laagu karte. Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haathon mein Muhammad ki jaan hai, agar Fatima (Alayhas Salam), Muhammad ki beti, chori karti, main unka haath kaatta." Phir Allah ke Rasool ne us aurat ke maamle mein apna hukum diya aur unka haath kaata gaya. Baad mein unki tauba sachchi saabit huee aur unki shaadi ho gaee. Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha, "Woh mahilla mujhse milne aati thi aur main unki guzaarishen Allah ke Rasool tak pahunchati thi."

e: Narrated Mujashi:I took my brother to the Prophet (ﷺ) after the Conquest (of Mecca) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have come to you with my brother so that you may take a pledge of allegiance from him for migration." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, The people of migration (i.e. those who migrated to Medina before the Conquest) enjoyed the privileges of migration (i.e. there is no need for migration anymore)." I said to the Prophet, "For what will you take his pledge of allegiance?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I will take his pledge of allegiance for Islam, Belief, and for Jihad (i.e. fighting in Allah's Cause)
hi: Mujashi bataate hain: Main apne bhai ko Fatah ke baad Nabi ke paas lekar gaya aur kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Main aapke paas apne bhai ke saath aaya hoon taaki aap hijrat ke liye unse bai'at len." Nabi ne kaha, "Hijrat karne walon (yaani jinhone Fatah se pahle Madina hijrat ki thi) ne hijrat ke sab labh utha liye (isliye ab hijrat ki zaroorat nahi hai)." Maine Nabi se kaha, "Phir aap unse kis cheez ke liye bai'at lenge?" Nabi ne kaha, "Main unse Islam, Iman, aur Jihad (yaani Allah ki raah mein jung) ke liye bai'at lunga."

e: Narrated Mujashi bin Masud:I took Abu Mabad to the Prophet (ﷺ) in order that he might give him the pledge of allegiance for migration. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Migration has gone to its people, but I take the pledge from him (i.e. Abu Mabad) for Islam and Jihad
hi: Mujashi bin Masud bataate hain: Main Abu Mabad ko Nabi ke paas lekar gaya taaki woh unhe hijrat ke liye bai'at den. Nabi ne kaha, "Hijrat unke logon ke paas ja chuki hai, magar main unse (yaani Abu Mabad se) Islam aur Jihad ke liye bai'at lunga."

e: Narrated Mujahid:I said to Ibn `Umar, "I want to migrate to Sham." He said, "There is no migration, but Jihad (for Allah's Cause). Go and offer yourself for Jihad, and if you find an opportunity for Jihad (stay there) otherwise, come back
hi: Mujahid bataate hain: Maine Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kaha, "Main Sham hijrat karna chahta hoon." Unhone kaha, "Ab koee hijrat nahi hai, magar Jihad (Allah ki raah mein) hai. Jaao aur Jihad ke liye khud ko pesh karo, aur agar tumhe Jihad ka koee mauka milta hai (wahaan ruko) warna, wapas aa jao."

e: (In another narration) Ibn `Umar said:"There is no migration today or after Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." (and completed his statement as above)
hi: (ek doosri riwaayat mein) Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Aaj ya Allah ke Rasool ke baad koee hijrat nahi hai." (aur upar jaisa hi apni baat poori ki)

e: Narrated Mujahid bin Jabr:`Abdullah bin `Umar used to say, "There is no migration after the Conquest (of Mecca)
hi: Mujahid bin Jabr bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) kaha karte the, "Fatah (Mecca) ke baad koee hijrat nahi hai."

e: Narrated `Ata' bin Abi Rabah:`Ubaid bin `Umar and I visited `Aisha, and he asked her about the migration. She said, "There is no migration today. A believer used to flee with his religion to Allah and His Prophet for fear that he might be put to trial as regards his religion. Today Allah has rendered Islam victorious; therefore a believing one can worship one's Lord wherever one wishes. But there is Jihad (for Allah's Cause) and intentions." (See Hadith 42, in the 4th Vol. for its Explanation)
hi: Ata bin Abi Rabah bataate hain: Ubaid bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur main Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se mile, aur unhone unse hijrat ke baare mein pucha. Unhone kaha, "Aaj koee hijrat nahi hai. Ek momin apne deen ke saath Allah aur uske Nabi ki taraf bhaagta tha is dar se ke use apne deen ke baare mein aazmaish na jhelni pade. Aaj Allah ne Islam ko fatah dilaee hai; isliye ek momin jahaan chahe apne Rab ki ibadat kar sakta hai. Magar Jihad aur (achhi) niyyaten (abhi bhi ajr wale hain)."

e: Narrated Mujahid:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got up on the day of the Conquest of Mecca and said, "Allah has made Mecca a sanctuary since the day He created the Heavens and the Earth, and it will remain a sanctuary by virtue of the sanctity Allah has bestowed on it till the Day of Resurrection. It (i.e. fighting in it) was not made lawful to anyone before me, nor will it be made lawful to anyone after me, and it was not made lawful for me except for a short period of time. Its game should not be chased, nor should its trees be cut, nor its vegetation or grass uprooted, nor its Luqata (i.e. Most things) picked up except by one who makes a public announcement about it." Al-Abbas bin `Abdul Muttalib said, "Except the Idhkhir, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), as it is indispensable for blacksmiths and houses." On that, the Prophet (ﷺ) kept quiet and then said, "Except the Idhkhir as it is lawful to cut
hi: Mujahid bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool Fatah-e-Mecca ke din uthe aur kaha, "Allah ne Mecca ko us din se pavitra banaya hai jab usne aasman aur zameen banaee thi, aur yeh us pavitrata ki wajah se pavitra hi rahega jo Allah ne ise diya hai Qiyamat ke din tak. Yeh (yaani ismein jung karna) mujhse pahle kisi ke liye jaayaz nahi tha, na hi yeh mere baad kisi ke liye jaayaz hoga, aur yeh mere liye bhi sirf ek chhote waqt ke liye jaayaz tha. Iske shikaar janwaron ka picha nahi karna chahiye, na iske darakhton ko kaatna chahiye, na iski ghaas ya vanaspati ko ukhaadna chahiye, na iski Luqata (yaani khoee huee cheezen) uthana chahiye siwaye us shaks ke jo iske baare mein saarvajanik elaan kare." Al-Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib ne kaha, "Siwaye Idhkhir (yaani ek qisam ki ghaas) ke, Aye Allah ke Rasool, kyunke yeh lohaaron aur gharon ke liye zaroori hai." Ispar, Nabi khaamosh rahe aur phir kaha, "Siwaye Idhkhir ke, kyunke ise kaatna jaayaz hai."

e: Narrated Isma`il:I saw (a healed scar of) blow over the hand of Ibn Abi `Aufa who said, "I received that blow in the battle of Hunain in the company of the Prophet." I said, "Did you take part in the battle of Hunain?" He replied, "Yes (and in other battles) before it
hi: Ismail bataate hain: Maine Ibn Abi Aufa ke haath par ek (bhara hua) zakhm ka nishaan dekha jinhone kaha, "Mujhe woh zakhm Hunain ki jung mein mila, Nabi ki sohbat mein." Maine pucha, "Kya aapne Hunain ki jung mein hissa liya?" Unhone jawab diya, "Haan (aur isse pahle bhi doosri jungon mein)."

e: Narrated Abu 'Is-haq:I heard Al-Bara' narrating when a man came and said to him, "O Abu '`Umara! Did you flee on the day (of the battle) of Hunain?" Al-Bara' replied, "I testify that the Prophet (ﷺ) did not flee, but the hasty people hurried away and the people of Hawazin threw arrows at them. At that time, Abu Sufyan bin Al-Harith was holding the white mule of the Prophet (ﷺ) by the head, and the Prophet (ﷺ) was saying, "I am the Prophet (ﷺ) undoubtedly: I am the son of `Abdul-Muttalib
hi: Abu Ishaq bataate hain: Maine Al-Bara ko suna jab ek shaks ne unse pucha, "Aye Abu Umara! Kya aap Hunain ke din bhaag gaye the?" Al-Bara ne jawab diya, "Main gawahi deta hoon ke Nabi nahi bhage, magar jaldbaaz log jaldi se chale gaye aur Hawazin ke log unpar teer chalane lage. Us waqt, Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Harith Nabi ke safed khachchar ka sar pakde huye the, aur Nabi kah rahe the, 'Main bilkul Nabi hoon: main Abdul-Muttalib ka beta hoon.'"

e: Narrated Abu 'Is-haq:Al-Bara' was asked while I was listening, "Did you flee (before the enemy) along with the Prophet (ﷺ) on the day of (the battle of) Hunain?" He replied, "As for the Prophet, he did not (flee). The enemy were good archers and the Prophet (ﷺ) was saying, "I am the Prophet (ﷺ) undoubtedly; I am the son of `Abdul Muttalib
hi: Abu Ishaq bataate hain: Al-Bara se puchha gaya jabke main sun raha tha, "Kya aap Nabi ke saath Hunain ke din bhage the?" Unhone jawab diya, "Jahaan tak Nabi ka sawal hai, woh nahi bhage. Dushman achhe tirandaaz the aur Nabi kah rahe the, 'Main bilkul Nabi hoon; main Abdul Muttalib ka beta hoon.'"

e: Narrated Abu 'Is-haq:That he heard Al-Bara narrating when a man from Qais (tribe) asked him "Did you flee leaving Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the day (of the battle) of Hunain?" Al-Bara' replied, "But Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not flee. The people of Hawazin were good archers, and when we attacked them, they fled. But rushing towards the booty, we were confronted by the arrows (of the enemy). I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) riding his white mule while Abu Sufyan was holding its reins, and the Prophet (ﷺ) was saying "I am the Prophet (ﷺ) undoubtedly." (Israil and Zuhair said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) dismounted from his Mule
hi: Abu Ishaq bataate hain: Unhone Al-Bara se suna jab Qais qabile ke ek shaks ne unse pucha, "Kya aap Allah ke Rasool ko chhodkar Hunain ke din bhage?" Al-Bara ne jawab diya, "Magar Allah ke Rasool nahi bhage. Hawazin ke log achhe tirandaaz the, aur jab humne unpar hamla kiya, woh bhage. Magar maal-e-ghanimat ki taraf daudte hue, hum (dushman ke) teeron ka saamna karne lage. Maine Nabi ko apne safed khachchar par sawar dekha jabke Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ) uski lagaam thaame huye the, aur Nabi kah rahe the, 'Main bilkul Nabi hoon.'" (Israil aur Zuhair ne kaha, "Nabi apne khachchar se utre.")

e: Narrated Marwan and Al-Miswar bin Makhrama:When the delegate of Hawazin came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) declaring their conversion to Islam and asked him to return their properties and captives, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got up and said to them, "There Is involved in this matter, the people whom you see with me, and the most beloved talk to me, is the true one. So choose one of two alternatives: Either the captives or the properties. I have been waiting for you (i.e. have not distributed the booty)." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had delayed the distribution of their booty over ten nights after his return from Ta'if. So when they came to know that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was not going to return to them but one of the two, they said, "We prefer to have our captives." So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got up amongst the Muslims, and praising Allah as He deserved, said, "To proceed! Your brothers have come to you with repentance and I see (it logical) to return their captives. So, whoever of you likes to do that as a favor then he can do it. And whoever of you likes to stick to his share till we give him from the very first booty which Allah will give us, then he can do so." The people said, "We do that (i.e. return the captives) willingly as a favor, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "We do not know which of you have agreed to it and which have not; so go back and let your chiefs forward us your decision." They went back and their chief's spoke to them, and they (i.e. the chiefs) returned to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and informed him that all of them had agreed (to give up their captives) with pleasure, and had given their permission (i.e. that the captives be returned to their people). (The sub-narrator said, "That is what has reached me about the captives of Hawazin tribe)
hi: Marwan aur Al-Miswar bin Makhrama (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Hawazin ka pratinidhimandal Allah ke Rasool ke paas aaya, Islam qubool karne ka elaan karte huye aur apni maal aur qaidiyon ko wapas maangte huye, Allah ke Rasool uthe aur unse kaha, "Is maamle mein log shaamil hain jinhe tum mere saath dekh rahe ho, aur mere liye sabse pyari baat woh hai jo sachchi ho. Isliye do ikhtiyaaron mein se ek chuniye: ya to qaidi ya maal. Main tumhara intezaar kar raha hoon (yaani maine maal-e-ghanimat abhi taqseem nahi ki)." Allah ke Rasool ne Taif se wapasi ke baad das raaton tak unki maal-e-ghanimat ki taqseem ko deri se rakha tha. Isliye jab unhe pata chala ke Allah ke Rasool unhe donon nahi, balki sirf ek denge, unhone kaha, "Hum apne qaidiyon ko tarjih dete hain." Isliye Allah ke Rasool Musalmanon ke beech uthe, aur Allah ki taarif jitni woh laayak hai karke, kaha, "Iske baad! Tumhare bhaee tauba ke saath tumhare paas aaye hain aur mujhe (yeh) lagta hai ke main unke qaidi unhe wapas dese lautaun. Isliye tum mein se jo koee ise ek ehsaan ke tor par karna chahta hai, woh aisa kar sakta hai. Aur jo koee apna hissa tab tak rakhna chahta hai jab tak hum unhe pahli hi maal-e-ghanimat mein se de nahi dete jo Allah humein dega, phir woh aisa kar sakta hai." Logon ne kaha, "Hum aisa (yaani qaidiyon ko wapas karna) khushi se karte hain, Aye Allah ke Rasool!" Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Humein nahi pata tummein se kaun isse sahmat hai aur kaun nahi; isliye wapas jao aur apne sardaron ko humare paas humara faisla bhejne do." Woh wapas gaye aur unke sardaron ne unse baat ki, aur woh (yaani sardaar) Allah ke Rasool ke paas wapas aaye aur unhe bataya ke sab ne khushi se sahmati di thi (qaidiyon ko chhodne ki), aur ijazat di thi. (Subordinate raawi ne kaha, "Yehi mujhtak pahuncha hai Hawazin qabile ke qaidiyon ke baare mein.")

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:When we returned from (the battle of) Hunain, `Umar asked the Prophet (ﷺ) about a vow which he had made during the Pre-Islamic period of Ignorance that he would perform I`tikaf. The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered him to fulfill his vow
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab hum Hunain se wapas aaye, Umar ne Nabi se ek mannat ke baare mein pucha jo unhone jahiliyat ke dauran li thi ke woh I'tikaf karenge. Nabi ne unhe apni mannat poori karne ka hukum diya.

e: Narrated Abu Qatada:We set out along with the Prophet (ﷺ) during the year of (the battle of) Hunain, and when we faced the enemy, the Muslims (with the exception of the Prophet (ﷺ) and some of his companions) retreated (before the enemy). I saw one of the pagans over-powering one of the Muslims, so I struck the pagan from behind his neck causing his armor to be cut off. The pagan headed towards me and pressed me so forcibly that I felt as if I was dying. Then death took him over and he released me. Afterwards I followed `Umar and said to him, "What is wrong with the people?" He said, "It is the Order of Allah." Then the Muslims returned (to the battle after the flight) and (after overcoming the enemy) the Prophet sat and said, "Whoever had killed an Infidel and has an evidence to this issue, will have the Salb (i.e. the belonging of the deceased e.g. clothes, arms, horse, etc)." I (stood up) and said, "Who will be my witness?" and then sat down. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) repeated his question. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said the same (for the third time). I got up and said, "Who will be my witness?" and then sat down. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked his former question again. So I got up. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, What is the matter, O Abu Qatada?" So I narrated the whole story; A man said, "Abu Qatada has spoken the truth, and the Salb of the deceased is with me, so please compensate Abu Qatada on my behalf." Abu Bakr said, "No! By Allah, it will never happen that the Prophet (ﷺ) will leave a Lion of Allah who fights for the Sake of Allah and His Apostle and give his spoils to you." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Abu Bakr has spoken the truth. Give it (the spoils) back to him (O man)!" So he gave it to me and I bought a garden in (the land of) Banu Salama with it (i.e. the spoils) and that was the first property I got after embracing Islam
hi: Abu Qatada (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Nabi ke saath nikle Hunain ke saal, aur jab humari mulaqaat dushman se huee, Musalman (siwaye Nabi aur unke kuch sahaba ke) peeche hat gaye. Maine ek mushrik ko ek Musalman par haavi dekha, isliye maine mushrik ki gale ke peeche se unpar hamla kiya jisse unki kavach kat gaee. Woh mushrik meri taraf mudkar mujhse itni zordaar dabaya ke mujhe laga main mar jaunga. Phir maut ne unhe pakad liya aur unhone mujhe chhod diya. Baad mein maine Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ka picha kiya aur unse pucha, "Logon ko kya hua hai?" Unhone kaha, "Yeh Allah ka hukum hai." Phir Musalman (bhaagne ke baad jung mein) wapas aaye, aur (dushman par jeet haasil karne ke baad) Nabi baith gaye aur kaha, "Jisne kisi kaafir ko qatl kiya hai aur uska gawah hai, use Salb (yaani mrit shaks ki cheezen jaise kapde, hathiyaar, ghoda, aadi) milega." Main (utha aur) kaha, "Mera gawah kaun hoga?" aur phir baith gaya. Phir Nabi ne apna sawal doharaya. Phir Nabi ne usi baat ko phir kaha (teesri baar). Main utha aur kaha, "Mera gawah kaun hoga?" aur phir baith gaya. Nabi ne apna pahle wala sawal phir pucha. Isliye main utha. Nabi ne kaha, "Kya baat hai, Aye Abu Qatada?" Isliye maine poori kahani sunaee; ek shaks ne kaha, "Abu Qatada ne sach kaha hai, aur mrit shaks ka Salb mere paas hai, isliye Abu Qatada ko mere taraf se badle mein de dijiye." Abu Bakr ne kaha, "Nahi! Allah ki qasam, aisa kabhi nahi hoga ke Nabi Allah ke ek shera ko, jo Allah aur uske Rasool ki khaatir jung karta hai, chhodkar unka maal-e-ghanimat tumhe de den." Nabi ne kaha, "Abu Bakr ne sach kaha hai. Ise (yaani maal-e-ghanimat) unhe (yaani us shaks ko) wapas de do!" Isliye unhone woh mujhe de diya aur maine usse Banu Salama (ki zameen) mein ek baag khareeda, aur yeh pahli maal thi jo maine Islam qubool karne ke baad hasil ki.

e: Narrated Abu Qatada:When it was the day of (the battle of) Hunain, I saw a Muslim man fighting with one of the pagans and another pagan was hiding himself behind the Muslim in order to kill him. So I hurried towards the pagan who was hiding behind the Muslim to kill him, and he raised his hand to hit me but I hit his hand and cut it off. That man got hold of me and pressed me so hard that I was afraid (that I would die), then he knelt down and his grip became loose and I pushed him and killed him. The Muslims (excepting the Prophet (ﷺ) and some of his companions) started fleeing and I too, fled with them. Suddenly I met `Umar bin Al-Khattab amongst the people and I asked him, "What is wrong with the people?" He said, "It is the order of Allah" Then the people returned to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (after defeating the enemy). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever produces a proof that he has killed an infidel, will have the spoils of the killed man." So I got up to look for an evidence to prove that I had killed an infidel, but I could not find anyone to bear witness for me, so I sat down. Then it came to my mind (that I should speak of it) and I mentioned the case to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). A man from the persons who were sitting with him (i.e. the Prophet), said, "The arms of the deceased one whom he ( i.e. Abu Qatada) has mentioned, are with me, so please compensate him for it (i.e. the spoils)," Abu Bakr said, "No, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) will not give it (i.e. the spoils) to a weak humble person from Quraish and leave one of Allah's Lions who fights on behalf of Allah and His Apostle." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then got up and gave that (spoils) to me, and I bought with it, a garden which was the first property I got after embracing Islam
hi: Abu Qatada (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Hunain ka din tha, maine ek Musalman shaks ko ek mushrik ke saath jung karte dekha, aur ek doosra mushrik us Musalman ke peeche chhup raha tha unhe qatl karne ke liye. Isliye main us mushrik ki taraf jaldi se gaya jo Musalman ke peeche chhup raha tha use qatl karne ke liye, aur usne mujhe maarne ke liye apna haath uthaya magar maine unke haath par vaar kiya aur use kaat diya. Us shaks ne mujhe pakad liya aur mujhe itna zordaar dabaya ke main darne laga (ke main mar jaunga), phir woh ghutnon ke bal baithe aur unki pakad dhili pad gaee, aur maine unhe dhkel diya aur qatl kar diya. Musalman (Nabi aur unke kuch sahaba ke siwaye) bhaagne lage, aur main bhi unke saath bhaaga. Achanak main logon ke beech Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab se mila aur maine unse pucha, "Logon ko kya hua hai?" Unhone kaha, "Yeh Allah ka hukum hai." Phir log Allah ke Rasool ke paas wapas aaye (dushman ko haarane ke baad). Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Jo koee yeh saabit kar sakta hai ke usne ek kaafir ko qatl kiya hai, use mrit shaks ka maal-e-ghanimat milega." Isliye main saboot dhoondhne ke liye utha yeh saabit karne ke liye ke maine ek kaafir ko qatl kiya hai, magar mujhe koee nahi mila jo mere liye gawah bane, isliye main baith gaya. Phir mujhe khyaal aaya (ke mujhe iske baare mein baat karni chahiye) aur maine yeh maamla Allah ke Rasool ko bataya. Unke saath baithe logon mein se ek shaks ne kaha, "Us mrit shaks ke hathiyaar jinka unhone (yaani Abu Qatada ne) zikar kiya, mere paas hain, isliye kripya iske badle mein unhe (badla) de dijiye." Abu Bakr ne kaha, "Nahi, Allah ke Rasool ise (yaani maal-e-ghanimat) Quraish ke ek kamzor, vinamr shaks ko nahi denge aur Allah ke sheron mein se ek, jo Allah aur uske Rasool ki taraf se jung karta hai, chhod denge." Allah ke Rasool phir uthe aur woh (maal-e-ghanimat) mujhe de diya, aur maine usse ek baag khareeda jo pahli maal thi jo maine Islam qubool karne ke baad hasil ki.

e: Narrated Abu Musa:When the Prophet (ﷺ) had finished from the battle of Hunain, he sent Abu Amir at the head of an army to Autas He (i.e. Abu Amir) met Duraid bin As-Simma and Duraid was killed and Allah defeated his companions. The Prophet (ﷺ) sent me with Abu 'Amir. Abu Amir was shot at his knee with an arrow which a man from Jushm had shot and fixed into his knee. I went to him and said, "O Uncle! Who shot you?" He pointed me out (his killer) saying, "That is my killer who shot me (with an arrow)." So I headed towards him and overtook him, and when he saw me, he fled, and I followed him and started saying to him, "Won't you be ashamed? Won't you stop?" So that person stopped, and we exchanged two hits with the swords and I killed him. Then I said to Abu 'Amir. "Allah has killed your killer." He said, "Take out this arrow" So I removed it, and water oozed out of the wound. He then said, "O son of my brother! Convey my compliments to the Prophet (ﷺ) and request him to ask Allah's Forgiveness for me." Abu Amir made me his successor in commanding the people (i.e. troops). He survived for a short while and then died. (Later) I returned and entered upon the Prophet (ﷺ) at his house, and found him lying in a bed made of stalks of date-palm leaves knitted with ropes, and on it there was bedding. The strings of the bed had their traces over his back and sides. Then I told the Prophet (ﷺ) about our and Abu Amir's news and how he had said "Tell him to ask for Allah's Forgiveness for me." The Prophet (ﷺ) asked for water, performed ablution and then raised hands, saying, "O Allah, Forgive `Ubaid, Abu Amir." At that time I saw the whiteness of the Prophet's armpits. The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "O Allah, make him (i.e. Abu Amir) on the Day of Resurrection, superior to many of Your human creatures." I said, "Will you ask Allah's Forgiveness for me?" (On that) the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Allah, forgive the sins of `Abdullah bin Qais and admit him to a nice entrance (i.e. paradise) on the Day of Resurrection." Abu Burda said, "One of the prayers was for Abu 'Amir and the other was for Abu Musa (i.e. `Abdullah bin Qais)
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Nabi Hunain ki jung se faaragh hue, unhone Abu Amir ko ek fauj ka netritva dete huye Autas bheja. Woh (yaani Abu Amir) Duraid bin As-Simma se mile aur Duraid qatl hue, aur Allah ne unke sathiyon ko haara diya. Nabi ne mujhe Abu Amir ke saath bheja. Abu Amir ko unke ghutne mein ek teer laga jise Jushm qabile ke ek shaks ne chalaya tha aur woh unke ghutne mein gahra dhaans gaya tha. Main unke paas gaya aur kaha, "Aye chacha! Aapko kisne maara?" Unhone mujhe (unke hatyaare ki taraf) ishara karte huye kaha, "Yeh mera hatyaara hai jisne mujhe teer se maara." Isliye main unki taraf badha aur unhe pakad liya, aur jab unhone mujhe dekha, woh bhage, aur main unka picha karte huye kaha, "Kya aapko sharma nahi aati? Kya aap rukenge nahi?" Isliye woh shaks ruka, aur humne do baar talwaron se vaar kiya aur maine unhe qatl kar diya. Phir maine Abu Amir se kaha, "Allah ne aapke hatyaare ko qatl kar diya hai." Unhone kaha, "Yeh teer nikalo." Isliye maine ise nikala, aur zakhm se paani nikla. Phir unhone kaha, "Aye mere bhaee ke bete! Nabi ko mera salaam pahunchao aur unse guzarish karo ke woh mere liye Allah se maafi maangen." Abu Amir ne mujhe logon ka (yaani sainikon ka) netritva saunp diya apni jagah. Woh thoda der zinda rahe aur phir unka intiqal ho gaya. (Baad mein) main wapas aaya aur Nabi ke ghar unke paas gaya aur unhe khajoor ke patte ki daalon se bana ek bistar par lete hue paaya, rassiyon se buna hua, aur uske oopar kuch bistaring thi. Bistar ki rassiyon ne unki peeth aur pahluon par apne nishaan chhod diye the. Phir maine Nabi ko humare aur Abu Amir ke baare mein bataya aur kaise unhone kaha tha "Unse kaho woh mere liye maafi maangen." Nabi ne paani maanga, wudu kiya aur phir haath uthaye, kehte huye, "Aye Allah, Ubaid, Abu Amir ko maaf kar." Us waqt maine Nabi ke baghlon ki safedi dekhi. Nabi ne phir kaha, "Aye Allah, Qiyamat ke din unhe (yaani Abu Amir ko) teri bahut sari insaani makhlooqaat se behtareen bana." Maine kaha, "Kya aap mere liye bhi Allah se maafi maangenge?" (Ispar) Nabi ne kaha, "Aye Allah, Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Qais ke gunahon ko maaf kar aur unhe Qiyamat ke din ek achhi jagah (yaani Jannat) mein pravesh de." Abu Burda ne kaha, "Ek dua Abu Amir ke liye thi aur doosri Abu Musa (yaani Abdullah bin Qais) ke liye."

e: Narrated Um Salama:The Prophet (ﷺ) came to me while there was an effeminate man sitting with me, and I heard him (i.e. the effeminate man) saying to `Abdullah bin Abi Umaiya, "O `Abdullah! See if Allah should make you conquer Ta'if tomorrow, then take the daughter of Ghailan (in marriage) as (she is so beautiful and fat that) she shows four folds of flesh when facing you, and eight when she turns her back." The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "These (effeminate men) should never enter upon you (O women!)." Ibn Juraij said, "That effeminate man was called Hit." Narrated Hisham: The above narration and added extra, that at that time, the Prophet, was besieging Taif
hi: Um Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataate hain: Nabi mere paas aaye jabke mere paas ek staanti shaks baitha hua tha, aur maine unhe (yaani us staanti shaks ko) Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Umaiya se yeh kehte suna, "Aye Abdullah! Dekho agar Allah aapko kal Taif fatah karane de, phir Ghailan ki beti se (shaadi mein) le lo (kyunke woh itni khoobsurat aur moti hai ke woh saamne chaar chikanaee ki tahen dikhati hai aur peeche mudne par aath)." Nabi ne phir kaha, "Yeh (staanti mard) kabhi bhi tumhare paas nahi aane chahiye, (Aye aurato!)." Ibn Juraij ne kaha, "Us staanti shaks ka naam Hit tha." Hisham bataate hain: (upar wali riwaayat aur) joda ke us waqt, Nabi Taif ko gher rahe the.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) besieged Taif and could not conquer its people, he said, "We will return (to Medina) If Allah wills." That distressed the Companions (of the Prophet (ﷺ) and they said, "Shall we go away without conquering it (i.e. the Fort of Taif)?" Once the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Let us return." Then the Prophet said (to them), "Fight tomorrow." They fought and (many of them) got wounded, whereupon the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "We will return (to Medina) tomorrow if Allah wills." That delighted them, whereupon the Prophet (ﷺ) smiled. The sub-narrator, Sufyan said once, "(The Prophet) smiled
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool ne Taif ko gher liya aur uske logon ko fatah nahi kar sake, unhone kaha, "Hum (Madina) wapas jaenge, Insha Allah." Isse Nabi ke sahaba dukhi hue aur unhone kaha, "Kya hum ise (yaani Taif ke qile ko) fatah kiye bina chale jaen?" Ek baar Nabi ne kaha, "Chalo wapas chalte hain." Phir Nabi ne (unse) kaha, "Kal jung karo." Woh jung karte rahe aur (kaee) zakhmi hue, ispar Nabi ne kaha, "Hum kal wapas jaenge, Insha Allah." Isse woh khush hue, ispar Nabi muskurae. (Subordinate raawi, Sufyan ne ek baar kaha, "[Nabi] muskurae.")

e: Narrated Abu `Uthman:I heard from Sa`d, the first man who had thrown an arrow in Allah's Cause, and from Abu Bakra who jumped over the wall of the Ta'if Fort along with a few persons and came to the Prophet. They both said, "We heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, " If somebody claims to be the son of somebody other than his father knowingly, he will be denied Paradise (i.e. he will not enter Paradise).' " Narrated Ma`mar from `Asim from Abu Al-`Aliya or Abu `Uthman An-Nahdi who said. "I heard Sa`d and Abu Bakra narrating from the Prophet." `Asim said, "I said (to him), 'Very trustworthy persons have narrated to you.' He said, 'Yes, one of them was the first to throw an arrow in Allah's Cause and the other came to the Prophet (ﷺ) in a group of thirty-three persons from Ta'if
hi: Abu Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Sa'd se suna, jo pahle shaks the jinhone Allah ki raah mein teer chalaya, aur Abu Bakra (رضی اللہ عنہ) se, jo Taif ke qile ki deewaar se kuch logon ke saath kood pade aur Nabi ke paas aaye. Donon ne kaha, "Humne Nabi ko kehte suna, 'Agar koee jaanboojhkar apne waalid ke ilawa kisi aur ka beta hone ka daava karta hai, use Jannat se vanchit kiya jaayega (yaani woh Jannat mein daakhil nahi hoga).'" Ma'mar ne Asim se, Abu Al-Aliya ya Abu Uthman An-Nahdi se riwaayat ki jinhone kaha, "Maine Sa'd aur Abu Bakra ko Nabi se riwaayat karte suna." Asim ne kaha, "Maine (unse) kaha, 'Bahut zyada bharosemand log ne aapko yeh sunaya hai.' Unhone kaha, 'Haan, unmein se ek pahle shaks the jinhone Allah ki raah mein teer chalaya, aur doosre Nabi ke paas Taif se tees-teen (33) logon ke ek giroh mein aaye.'"

e: Narrated Abu Burda:Abu Musa said, "I was with the Prophet (ﷺ) when he was encamping at Al-Ji'rana (a place) between Mecca and Medina and Bilal was with him. A bedouin came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "Won't you fulfill what you have promised me?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Rejoice (at what I will do for you).' The bedouin said, "(You have said to me) rejoice too often." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) turned to me (i.e. Abu Musa) and Bilal in an angry mood and said, 'The bedouin has refused the good tidings, so you both accept them.' Bilal and I said, 'We accept them.' Then the Prophet (ﷺ) asked for a drinking bowl containing water and washed his hands and face in it, and then took a mouthful of water and threw it therein saying (to us), "Drink (some of) it and pour (some) over your faces and chests and be happy at the good tidings." So they both took the drinking bowl and did as instructed. Um Salama called from behind a screen, "Keep something (of the water for your mother." So they left some of it for her)
hi: Abu Burda bataate hain: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Main Nabi ke saath tha jab woh Al-Ji'rana (naam ki jagah) mein padaav liye hue the, jo Mecca aur Madina ke beech hai, aur Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) unke saath the. Ek dehati Nabi ke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Kya aap woh poora nahi karenge jo aapne mujhse waada kiya tha?' Nabi ne kaha, 'Khush ho jao (jo main tumhare liye karunga uspar).' Dehati ne kaha, '(Aapne mujhse kaha) khush ho jao bahut baar.' Phir Nabi mere (yaani Abu Musa) aur Bilal ki taraf gusse mein mude aur kaha, 'Dehati ne achhi khabar radd ki hai, isliye tum donon ise qubool karo.' Bilal aur maine kaha, 'Hum ise qubool karte hain.' Phir Nabi ne ek paani se bhara pyala maanga aur usmein apne haath aur chehra dhoye, aur phir paani ka ek ghoont liya aur usmein thooka, kehte huye (humse), 'Ise piyo (kuch) aur apne chehre aur seenon par daalo aur achhi khabar se khush ho jao.' Isliye donon ne pyala liya aur waisa hi kiya jaisa hukum diya gaya tha. Um Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne ek parde ke peeche se pukara, 'Kuch (paani) rakho (apni maa ke liye).' Isliye unhone unke liye thoda bacha diya."

e: Narrated Safwan bin Ya`la bin Umaiya:Ya`la used to say, "I wish I could see Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) at the time when he is being inspired divinely." Ya`la added "While the Prophet (ﷺ) was at Al-Ji'rana, shaded with a cloth sheet (in the form of a tent) and there were staying with him, some of his companions under it, suddenly there came to him a bedouin wearing a cloak and perfumed extravagantly. He said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ! What is your opinion regarding a man who assumes the state of Ihram for `Umra wearing a cloak after applying perfume to his body?" `Umar signalled with his hand to Ya`la to come (near). Ya`la came and put his head (underneath that cloth sheet) and saw the Prophet (ﷺ) red-faced and when that state (of the Prophet (ﷺ) ) was over, he said, "Where is he who as already asked me about the `Umra?" The man was looked for and brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to him), "As for the perfume you have applied to your body, wash it off your body) thrice, and take off your cloak, and then do in your `Umra the rites you do in your Hajj
hi: Safwan bin Ya'la bin Umaiya bataate hain: Ya'la kaha karte the, "Kaash main Allah ke Rasool ko dekh sakta jab unhe Divine ilham mil raha ho." Ya'la ne joda, "Jabke Nabi Al-Ji'rana mein the, ek kapde ki chaadar ke neeche chhaye mein (ek qisam ke tambu mein) aur unke kuch sahaba unke saath us tambu ke neeche the, achanak ek dehati unke paas aaya jo ek choga pahne tha aur bahut zyada khushbu lagaee thi. Usne kaha, 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Aapki kya raay hai us shaks ke baare mein jo apne shareer par khushbu lagakar Umrah ke liye Ihram ki haalat mein choga pahne?' Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne apne haath se Ya'la ko ishara kiya (aane ko). Ya'la aaya aur apna sar (us kapde ke neeche) daala aur Nabi ko laal chehre ke saath dekha, aur jab woh haalat khatm huee, unhone kaha, 'Woh kahaan hain jinhone mujhse Umrah ke baare mein pucha tha?' Us shaks ko dhoondha gaya aur Nabi ke paas laaya gaya. Nabi ne (unse) kaha, 'Jahaan tak khushbu ka sawal hai jo aapne apne shareer par lagaee hai, ise teen baar dho lijiye, aur apna choga utariye, aur phir apni Umrah mein wahi riwajen kariye jo aap apne Hajj mein karte hain.'"

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Zaid bin `Asim:When Allah gave to His Apostle the war booty on the day of Hunain, he distributed that booty amongst those whose hearts have been (recently) reconciled (to Islam), but did not give anything to the Ansar. So they seemed to have felt angry and sad as they did not get the same as other people had got. The Prophet (ﷺ) then delivered a sermon before them, saying, "O, the assembly of Ansar! Didn't I find you astray, and then Allah guided you on the Right Path through me? You were divided into groups, and Allah brought you together through me; you were poor and Allah made you rich through me." Whatever the Prophet (ﷺ) said, they (i.e. the Ansar) said, "Allah and His Apostle have more favours to do." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "What stops you from answering the Messenger of Allah?" But whatever he said to them, they replied, "Allah and His Apostle have more favours to do." The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "If you wish you could say: 'You came to us in such-and-such state (at Medina).' Wouldn't you be willing to see the people go away with sheep and camels while you go with the Prophet (ﷺ) to your homes? But for the migration, I would have been one of the Ansar, and if the people took their way through a valley or mountain pass, I would select the valley or mountain pass of the Ansar. The Ansar are Shiar (i.e. those clothes which are in direct contact with the body and worn inside the other garments), and the people are Dithar (i.e. those clothes which are not in direct contact with the body and are worn over other garments). No doubt, you will see other people favoured over you, so you should be patient till you meet me at the Tank (of Kauthar)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Asim bataate hain: Jab Allah ne apne Rasool ko Hunain ke din maal-e-ghanimat diya, unhone woh maal-e-ghanimat un logon mein baanta jinke dil (nikat hi Islam ki taraf) mel-jol karvaye gaye the, magar Ansaar ko kuch nahi diya. Isliye woh gusse aur udaas hue kyunke unhe woh nahi mila jo doosron ko mila. Nabi ne phir unke saamne ek khutba diya, kehte huye, "Aye Ansaar ki jamaat! Kya maine tumhe bhataka hua nahi paya, aur phir Allah ne mere zariye tumhe Seedhe Raste par le aaya? Tum baante hue the, aur Allah ne tumhe mere zariye ek saath joda; tum gareeb the, aur Allah ne tumhe mere zariye daulatvaan banaya." Nabi jo bhi kahte, woh (yaani Ansaar) kahte, "Allah aur uske Rasool ki aur zyada meherbani hai." Nabi ne kaha, "Tumhe Allah ke Rasool ka jawab dene se kya rokta hai?" Magar jo bhi woh unse kahte, woh jawab dete, "Allah aur uske Rasool ki aur zyada meherbani hai." Nabi ne phir kaha, "Agar tum chaho tum kah sakte the: 'Aap humare paas aisi-aisi haalat mein aaye (Madina mein).' Kya tum yeh dekhkar khush nahi hoge ke log bhed aur unton ke saath jaen jabke tum Nabi ko apne saath apne ghars le jaao? Hijrat na hoti to main Ansaar mein se ek hota, aur agar log kisi waadi ya pahaad ke raste se jate, main Ansaar ke raste ya pahaad ke raste ko chunta. Ansaar Shiar hain (yaani woh kapde jo seedhe shareer par pahne jate hain, doosre kapdon ke neeche), aur log Dithar hain (yaani woh kapde jo seedhe shareer se mutaliq nahi hote, aur doosre kapdon ke oopar pahne jate hain). Koee shak nahi, tum dekhoge ke doosre logon ko tumse zyada tarjih milegi, isliye tumhe sabr karna chahiye jab tak tum mujhse (Jannat mein) Talab (yaani Al-Kauthar) par milo."

e: Narrated Anas Bin Malik:When Allah gave Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) what he gave of the properties of the Hawazin tribe as a war booty, the Prophet (ﷺ) started giving some men 100 camels each. The Ansar (then) said, "May Allah forgive Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as he gives to Quraish and leaves us although our swords are still dribbling with the blood of Quraish." Allah's Apostle was informed of their statement, so he sent for the Ansar and gathered them in a leather tent, and did not call anybody else along with them. When they all gathered, the Prophet (ﷺ) got up and said, "What is this talk being informed to me about you?" The learned men amongst the Ansar said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Our chiefs did not say anything, but some people amongst us who are younger in age said, 'May Allah forgive Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as he gives (of the booty) to Quraish and leaves us though our swords are still dribbling with their blood." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I give to these men who have newly deserted heathenism (and embraced Islam) so as to attract their hearts. Won't you be happy that the people take the wealth while you take the Prophet (ﷺ) with you to your homes? By Allah, what you are taking is better than whatever they are taking." They (i.e. the Ansar) said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We are satisfied." The Prophet (ﷺ) then said to them, "You will find others favored over you greatly, so be patient till you meet Allah and His Apostle and I will be at the Tank then." Anas added: But they did not remain patient
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Allah ne Allah ke Rasool ko Hawazin qabile ki maal se maal-e-ghanimat diya, Nabi ne kuch logon ko sau-sau (100) unt dene shuru kiye. Ansaar ne (ispar) kaha, "Allah, Allah ke Rasool ko maaf kare kyunke woh Quraish ko dete hain aur humein chhod dete hain chahe humari talwaren abhi bhi Quraish ke khoon se tapak rahi hain." Allah ke Rasool ko unki baat ki khabar di gaee, isliye unhone Ansaar ko bulaya aur unhe ek chamde ke tambu mein jama kiya, aur unke ilawa kisi aur ko nahi bulaya. Jab sab jama ho gaye, Nabi uthe aur kaha, "Yeh kaisi baat hai jo mujhtak tumhare baare mein pahunchi hai?" Ansaar mein se ilm rakhne waale logon ne kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Humare sardaron ne kuch nahi kaha, magar humme se kuch jawan log ne kaha, 'Allah, Allah ke Rasool ko maaf kare kyunke woh (maal-e-ghanimat) Quraish ko dete hain aur humein chhod dete hain chahe humari talwaren abhi bhi unke khoon se tapak rahi hain.'" Nabi ne kaha, "Main un logon ko deta hoon jinhone hal hi mein but-parasti chhodi hai (aur Islam qubool kiya hai) unke dilon ko mel-jol karvane ke liye. Kya tumhe khushi nahi hogi ke log daulat lekar jaen jabke tum Nabi ko apne saath apne gharon le jate ho? Allah ki qasam, jo tum le ja rahe ho woh unse behtar hai jo woh le ja rahe hain." Woh (yaani Ansaar) ne kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Hum santusht hain." Nabi ne phir unce kaha, "Tum dekhoge doosron ko tumse zyada tarjih di jaayegi, isliye sabr karna jab tak tum Allah aur uske Rasool se milo, aur main us waqt (Jannat mein) Talab (yaani Kauthar) par hoonga." Anas ne joda: Magar woh (yaani Ansaar) sabr nahi kar sake.

e: Narrated Anas:When it was the day of the Conquest (of Mecca) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) distributed the war booty amongst the people of Quraish which caused the Ansar to become angry. So the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Won't you be pleased that the people take the worldly things and you take Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with you? "They said, "Yes." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If the people took their way through a valley or mountain pass, I would take my way through the Ansar's valley or mountain pass
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Fatah (Mecca) ke din, Allah ke Rasool ne maal-e-ghanimat Quraish ke logon mein baanta jisse Ansaar naraaj hue. Isliye Nabi ne kaha, "Kya tumhe khushi nahi hogi ke log duniyavi cheezen lekar jaen aur tum Allah ke Rasool ko apne saath le jao?" Unhone kaha, "Haan." Nabi ne kaha, "Agar log kisi waadi ya pahad ke raste se jate, main Ansaar ki waadi ya pahad ke raste se jata."

e: Narrated Anas:When it was the day of (the battle of) Hunain, the Prophet (ﷺ) confronted the tribe of Hawazin while there were ten-thousand (men) besides the Tulaqa' (i.e. those who had embraced Islam on the day of the Conquest of Mecca) with the Prophet. When they (i.e. Muslims) fled, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O the group of Ansar!" They replied, "Labbaik, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Sadaik! We are under your command." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) got down (from his mule) and said, "I am Allah's Slave and His Apostle." Then the pagans were defeated. The Prophet (ﷺ) distributed the war booty amongst the Tulaqa and Muhajirin (i.e. Emigrants) and did not give anything to the Ansar. So the Ansar spoke (i.e. were dissatisfied) and he called them and made them enter a leather tent and said, Won't you be pleased that the people take the sheep and camels, and you take Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) along with you?" The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "If the people took their way through a valley and the Ansar took their way through a mountain pass, then I would choose a mountain pass of the Ansar
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Hunain ka din tha, Nabi ne Hawazin qabile ka saamna kiya jabke unke saath das hazaar (log) the Nabi ke saath Tulaqa (yaani woh log jinhone Fatah-e-Mecca ke din Islam qubool kiya tha) ke ilawa. Jab woh (yaani Musalman) bhage, Nabi ne kaha, "Aye Ansaar ki jamaat!" Unhone jawab diya, "Labbaik, Aye Allah ke Rasool aur Sadaik! Hum aapke hukum mein hain." Phir Nabi (apne khachchar se) utre aur kaha, "Main Allah ka gulaam hoon aur unka Rasool hoon." Phir mushrik haare, aur Nabi ne maal-e-ghanimat Tulaqa aur Muhajir ke beech baanta aur Ansaar ko kuch nahi diya. Isliye Ansaar ne (asantushti zaahir ki), aur unhone unhe bulaya aur unhe ek chamde ke tambu mein jama kiya aur kaha, "Kya tumhe khushi nahi hogi ke log bhed aur unt lekar jaen, aur tum Allah ke Rasool ko apne saath le jao?" Nabi ne joda, "Agar log kisi waadi se aur Ansaar kisi pahad ke raste se jate, phir main Ansaar ke pahad ke raste ko chunta."
