e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) gathered some people of Ansar and said, "The People of Quraish are still close to their Pre-Islamic period of ignorance and have suffered a lot, and I want to help them and attract their hearts (by giving them the war booty). Won't you be pleased that the people take the worldly things) and you take Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with you to your homes?" They said, "Yes, (i.e. we are pleased with this distribution)." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "'If the people took their way through a valley and the Ansar took their way through a mountain pass, then I would take the Ansar's valley or the Ansar's mountain pass
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kuch Ansaar logon ko jama kiya aur kaha, "Quraish ke log abhi bhi apni jahiliyat ki niktata mein hain aur unhone bahut si takleef jheli hai, aur main unki madad karna aur unke dilon ko mel-jol karvana chahta hoon (unhe maal-e-ghanimat dekar). Kya tumhe khushi nahi hogi ke log duniyavi cheezen len aur tum Allah ke Rasool ko apne gharon le jao?" Unhone kaha, "Haan, (yaani hum is taqseem se khush hain)." Nabi ne kaha, "Agar log kisi waadi se aur Ansaar kisi pahad ke raste se jate, phir main Ansaar ki waadi ya Ansaar ke pahad ke raste se jata."

e: Narrated `Abdullah:When the Prophet (ﷺ) distributed the war booty of Hunain, a man from the Ansar said, "He (i.e. the Prophet), did not intend to please Allah in this distribution." So I came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and informed him of that (statement) whereupon the color of his face changed and he said, "May Allah bestow His Mercy on Moses, for he was troubled with more than this, but he remained patient
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Nabi ne Hunain ka maal-e-ghanimat baanta, Ansaar mein se ek shaks ne kaha, "Unki (yaani Nabi ki) is taqseem mein Allah ki khushi paane ka irada nahi tha." Isliye main Nabi ke paas gaya aur unhe yeh (baat) bataee, ispar unke chehre ka rang badal gaya aur unhone kaha, "Allah Musa par apni rehmat naazil kare, kyunke unhe isse zyada takleef di gaee thi, magar woh sabr karte rahe."

e: Narrated `Abdullah:When it was the day of Hunain, the Prophet (ﷺ) favored some people over some others (in the distribution of the booty). He gave Al-Aqra' one-hundred camels and gave Uyaina the same, and also gave other people (of Quraish). A man said, "Allah's Pleasure was not the aim, in this distribution." I said, "I will inform the Prophet (about your statement)." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "May Allah bestow Mercy on Moses, for he was troubled more than this but he remained patient
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Hunain ka din tha, Nabi ne (maal-e-ghanimat ki taqseem mein) kuch logon ko doosron par tarjih di. Unhone Al-Aqra ko sau unt diye aur Uyaina ko bhi utne hi diye, aur doosron (Quraish) ko bhi diye. Ek shaks ne kaha, "Is taqseem mein Allah ki khushi pane ka irada nahi tha." Maine kaha, "Main Nabi ko (aapki baat) bataunga." Nabi ne kaha, "Allah Musa par apni rehmat naazil kare, kyunke unhe isse zyada takleef di gaee thi, magar woh sabr karte rahe."

e: Narrated Anas Bin Malik:When it was the day (of the battle) of Hunain, the tribes of Hawazin and Ghatafan and others, along with their animals and offspring (and wives) came to fight against the Prophet (ﷺ) The Prophet (ﷺ) had with him, ten thousand men and some of the Tulaqa. The companions fled, leaving the Prophet (ﷺ) alone. The Prophet then made two calls which were clearly distinguished from each other. He turned right and said, "O the group of Ansar!" They said, "Labbaik, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Rejoice, for we are with you!" Then he turned left and said, "O the group of Ansar!" They said, "Labbaik! O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Rejoice, for we are with you!" The Prophet (ﷺ) at that time, was riding on a white mule; then he dismounted and said, "I am Allah's Slave and His Apostle." The infidels then were defeated, and on that day the Prophet (ﷺ) gained a large amount of booty which he distributed amongst the Muhajirin and the Tulaqa and did not give anything to the Ansar. The Ansar said, "When there is a difficulty, we are called, but the booty is given to other than us." The news reached the Prophet (ﷺ) and he gathered them in a leather tent and said, "What is this news reaching me from you, O the group of Ansar?" They kept silent, He added," O the group of Ansar! Won't you be happy that the people take the worldly things and you take Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to your homes reserving him for yourself?" They said, "Yes." Then the Prophet said, "If the people took their way through a valley, and the Ansar took their way through a mountain pass, surely, I would take the Ansar's mountain pass." Hisham said, "O Abu Hamza (i.e. Anas)! Did you witness that? " He replied, "And how could I be absent from him?
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Hunain ki jung ka din tha, Hawazin aur Ghatafan qabile, aur doosre, apne janwaron, santanon, aur (biviyon) ke saath Nabi ke khilaf jung karne aaye. Nabi ke saath das hazaar log the aur kuch Tulaqa bhi. Sahaba bhaage, Nabi ko akele chhodkar. Nabi ne phir do pukaren di jo ek-doosre se saaf alag thi. Woh dahine taraf mude aur kaha, "Aye Ansaar ki jamaat!" Unhone kaha, "Labbaik! Aye Allah ke Rasool! Khush ho jaiye, hum aapke saath hain!" Phir woh baaeen taraf mude aur kaha, "Aye Ansaar ki jamaat!" Unhone kaha, "Labbaik! Aye Allah ke Rasool! Khush ho jaiye, hum aapke saath hain!" Nabi us waqt ek safed khachchar par sawar the; phir woh utre aur kaha, "Main Allah ka gulaam hoon aur unka Rasool hoon." Phir kaafir haare, aur us din Nabi ne bhaari matra mein maal-e-ghanimat hasil kiya jise unhone Muhajir aur Tulaqa mein baanta aur Ansaar ko kuch nahi diya. Ansaar ne kaha, "Jab koee mushkil hoti hai, humein bulaya jata hai, magar maal-e-ghanimat kisi aur ko diya jata hai." Yeh khabar Nabi tak pahunchi aur unhone unhe ek chamde ke tambu mein jama kiya aur kaha, "Yeh kaisi khabar hai jo mujhtak tumhare baare mein pahunchi hai, Aye Ansaar ki jamaat?" Woh khaamosh rahe. Unhone joda, "Aye Ansaar ki jamaat! Kya tumhe khushi nahi hogi ke log duniyavi cheezen len aur tum Allah ke Rasool ko apne gharon apne liye lekar jao?" Unhone kaha, "Haan." Phir Nabi ne kaha, "Agar log kisi waadi se aur Ansaar kisi pahad ke raste se jate, zaroor main Ansaar ka pahad ka raasta chunta." Hisham ne kaha, "Aye Abu Hamza (yaani Anas)! Kya aapne yeh dekha tha?" Unhone jawab diya, "Aur main unse door kaise ho sakta tha?"

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) sent a Sariya towards Najd and I was in it, and our share from the booty amounted to twelve camels each, and we were given an additional camel each. So we returned with thirteen camels each
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Najd ki taraf ek Sariya (yaani chhota dasta) bheja aur main usmein tha, aur humara maal-e-ghanimat ka hissa baarah unt har ek ke liye tha, aur humein ek atirikt unt bhi diya gaya har ek ko. Isliye hum terah-terah unton ke saath wapas aaye.

e: Narrated Salim's father:The Prophet (ﷺ) sent Khalid bin Al-Walid to the tribe of Jadhima and Khalid invited them to Islam but they could not express themselves by saying, "Aslamna (i.e. we have embraced Islam)," but they started saying "Saba'na! Saba'na (i.e. we have come out of one religion to another)." Khalid kept on killing (some of) them and taking (some of) them as captives and gave every one of us his Captive. When there came the day then Khalid ordered that each man (i.e. Muslim soldier) should kill his captive, I said, "By Allah, I will not kill my captive, and none of my companions will kill his captive." When we reached the Prophet, we mentioned to him the whole story. On that, the Prophet (ﷺ) raised both his hands and said twice, "O Allah! I am free from what Khalid has done
hi: Salim ke waalid bataate hain: Nabi ne Khalid bin Al-Walid ko Jadhima qabile ki taraf bheja aur Khalid ne unhe Islam qubool karne ki dawat di magar woh "Aslamna" (yaani "hamne Islam qubool kar liya") kahte huye khud ko sahi tarike se zaahir nahi kar sake, aur unhone "Saba'na! Saba'na" (yaani "hum ek deen se doosre mein aaye hain") kahna shuru kiya. Khalid unmein se (kuch) ko qatl karte aur (kuch) ko qaidi banate rahe, aur humme se har ek ko unka ek-ek qaidi diya. Jab agla din aaya, Khalid ne hukum diya ke har shaks (yaani Musalman soldier) apne qaidi ko qatl kare. Maine kaha, "Allah ki qasam, main apne qaidi ko qatl nahi karunga, aur mere kisi bhi sathi ka koee qaidi qatl nahi hoga." Jab hum Nabi tak pahunche, humne unhe poori kahani sunaee. Ispar, Nabi ne apne donon haath uthaye aur do baar kaha, "Aye Allah! Main us se azad hoon jo Khalid ne kiya hai."

e: Narrated `Ali:The Prophet (ﷺ) sent a Sariya under the command of a man from the Ansar and ordered the soldiers to obey him. He (i.e. the commander) became angry and said "Didn't the Prophet (ﷺ) order you to obey me!" They replied, "Yes." He said, "Collect fire-wood for me." So they collected it. He said, "Make a fire." When they made it, he said, "Enter it (i.e. the fire)." So they intended to do that and started holding each other and saying, "We run towards (i.e. take refuge with) the Prophet (ﷺ) from the fire." They kept on saying that till the fire was extinguished and the anger of the commander abated. When that news reached the Prophet (ﷺ) he said, "If they had entered it (i.e. the fire), they would not have come out of it till the Day of Resurrection. Obedience (to somebody) is required when he enjoins what is good
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Nabi ne Ansaar mein se ek shaks ki kamandan mein ek Sariya bheja aur soldieron ko unki baat maanne ka hukum diya. Woh (yaani kamandar) gusse mein aa gaye aur kaha, "Kya Nabi ne tumhe mere kahne par chalne ka hukum nahi diya?" Unhone jawab diya, "Haan." Unhone kaha, "Mere liye lakdi jama karo." Isliye unhone use jama kiya. Unhone kaha, "Aag jalao." Jab unhone use jalaya, unhone kaha, "Ismein daakhil ho jao (yaani aag mein)." Isliye woh aisa karne ka irada karne lage aur ek-doosre ko pakadte hue kahne lage, "Hum Nabi ki taraf bhaagte hain aag se." Woh yeh kahte rahe jab tak aag bujh gaee aur kamandar ka gussa shant huA. Jab yeh khabar Nabi tak pahunchi, unhone kaha, "Agar woh ismein daakhil ho jate (yaani aag mein), woh Qiyamat ke din tak isse bahar nahi aate. Itaaat (kisi ki) sirf tab zaroori hai jab woh achhaee ka hukum de."

e: Narrated Abu Burda:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent Abu Musa and Mu`adh bin Jabal to Yemen. He sent each of them to administer a province as Yemen consisted of two provinces. The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to them), "Facilitate things for the people and do not make things difficult for them (Be kind and lenient (both of you) with the people, and do not be hard on them) and give the people good tidings and do not repulse them. So each of them went to carry on his job. So when any one of them toured his province and happened to come near (the border of the province of) his companion, he would visit him and greet him. Once Mu`adh toured that part of his state which was near (the border of the province of) his companion Abu Musa. Mu`adh came riding his mule till he reached Abu Musa and saw him sitting, and the people had gathered around him. Behold! There was a man tied with his hands behind his neck. Mu`adh said to Abu Musa, "O `Abdullah bin Qais! What is this?" Abu Musa replied. "This man has reverted to Heathenism after embracing Islam." Mu`adh said, "I will not dismount till he is killed." Abu Musa replied, "He has been brought for this purpose, so come down." Mu`adh said, "I will not dismount till he is killed." So Abu Musa ordered that he be killed, and he was killed. Then Mu`adh dismounted and said, "O `Abdullah (bin Qais)! How do you recite the Qur'an ?" Abu Musa said, "I recite the Qur'an regularly at intervals and piecemeal. How do you recite it O Mu`adh?" Mu`adh said, "I sleep in the first part of the night and then get up after having slept for the time devoted for my sleep and then recite as much as Allah has written for me. So I seek Allah's Reward for both my sleep as well as my prayer (at night)
hi: Abu Burda bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Mu'adh bin Jabal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko Yemen bheja. Unhone har ek ko ek prant ka intezam karne bheja kyunke Yemen do prantoin mein baanta tha. Nabi ne (unse) kaha, "Logon ke liye cheezen aasaan banao aur unhe mushkil mat banao, aur logon ko achhi khabar do aur unhe door mat bhagao." Isliye har ek apne kaam par gaya. Jab bhi unmein se ek apne prant ka daura karta aur apne sathi ke (prant ke) najdik aata, woh unse milne jata aur unhe salaam karta. Ek baar Mu'adh ne apne ilaaka ke us hisse ka daura kiya jo unke sathi Abu Musa ke qareeb tha. Mu'adh apne khachchar par sawar aaye jab tak woh Abu Musa tak pahunche aur unhe baithe dekha, aur log unke aas-paas jama the. Dekho! Wahaan ek shaks tha jinke haath unki gale ke peeche baandhe the. Mu'adh ne Abu Musa se kaha, "Aye Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Qais! Yeh kya hai?" Abu Musa ne jawab diya, "Yeh shaks Islam qubool karne ke baad phir se but-parasti mein laut gaya hai." Mu'adh ne kaha, "Main tab tak nahi utarunga jab tak unhe qatl na kar diya jaaye." Abu Musa ne jawab diya, "Unhe isi maksad ke liye laaya gaya hai, isliye neeche aiye." Mu'adh ne kaha, "Main tab tak nahi utarunga jab tak unhe qatl na kar diya jaaye." Isliye Abu Musa ne hukum diya ke unhe qatl kiya jaaye, aur unhe qatl kiya gaya. Phir Mu'adh utre aur kaha, "Aye Abdullah (bin Qais)! Aap Quran kaise padhte hain?" Abu Musa ne kaha, "Main Quran mukhtalif aur tukdon mein muqarrar waqfon par padhta hoon. Aap kaise padhte hain, Aye Mu'adh?" Mu'adh ne kaha, "Main raat ke pahle hisse mein sota hoon aur phir sone ke apne nirdharit waqt ke baad uthta hoon aur phir jitna Allah ne mere liye likha hai utna padhta hoon. Isliye main apne sone aur apne (raat ki) namaz donon ke liye Allah ke ajr ki khoj karta hoon."

e: Narrated Abi Burda:That Abu Musa Al-Ash`ari said that the Prophet (ﷺ) had sent him to Yemen and he asked the Prophet (ﷺ) about certain (alcoholic) drink which used to be prepared there The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "What are they?" Abu Musa said, "Al-Bit' and Al-Mizr?" He said, "Al-Bit is an alcoholic drink made from honey; and Al-Mizr is an alcoholic drink made from barley." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "All intoxicants are prohibited
hi: Abi Burda bataate hain: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ash'ari ne kaha ke Nabi ne unhe Yemen bheja tha aur unhone Nabi se kuch (nashile) peyon ke baare mein pucha jo wahaan taiyaar kiye jate the. Nabi ne pucha, "Woh kya hain?" Abu Musa ne kaha, "Al-Bit aur Al-Mizr." Unhone kaha, "Al-Bit shahad se bana nashila peya hai; aur Al-Mizr jau se bana nashila peya hai." Nabi ne kaha, "Sab nashile peya mana hain."

e: Narrated Abu Burda:That the Prophet (ﷺ) sent his (i.e. Abu Burda's) grandfather, Abu Musa and Mu`adh to Yemen and said to both of them "Facilitate things for the people (Be kind and lenient) and do not make things difficult (for people), and give them good tidings, and do not repulse them and both of you should obey each other." Abu Musa said, "O Allah's Prophet! In our land there is an alcoholic drink (prepared) from barley called Al-Mizr, and another (prepared) from honey, called Al-Bit"' The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "All intoxicants are prohibited." Then both of them proceeded and Mu`adh asked Abu Musa, "How do you recite the Qur'an?" Abu Musa replied, "I recite it while I am standing, sitting or riding my riding animals, at intervals and piecemeal." Mu`adh said, "But I sleep and then get up. I sleep and hope for Allah's Reward for my sleep as I seek His Reward for my night prayer." Then he (i.e. Mu`adh) pitched a tent and they started visiting each other. Once Mu`adh paid a visit to Abu Musa and saw a chained man. Mu`adh asked, "What is this?" Abu Musa said, "(He was) a Jew who embraced Islam and has now turned apostate." Mu`adh said, "I will surely chop off his neck
hi: Abu Burda bataate hain: Nabi ne unke (yaani Abu Burda ke) dada, Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Mu'adh ko Yemen bheja aur donon se kaha, "Logon ke liye cheezen aasaan banao (yaani dayaalu aur narma raho) aur cheezen mushkil mat banao (logon ke liye), aur unhe achhi khabar do, aur unhe door mat bhagao, aur tum donon ek-doosre ki baat mano." Abu Musa ne kaha, "Ya Allah ke Nabi! Humare desh mein ek nashila peya hai jau se, jise Al-Mizr kaha jata hai, aur doosra shahad se, jise Al-Bit kaha jata hai." Nabi ne kaha, "Sab nashile peya mana hain." Phir donon aage badhe aur Mu'adh ne Abu Musa se pucha, "Aap Quran kaise padhte hain?" Abu Musa ne jawab diya, "Main ise khade, baithe, ya apne sawari ke janwaron par sawar hokar padhta hoon, vichchhinnato aur tukdon mein." Mu'adh ne kaha, "Magar main sota hoon aur phir uthta hoon. Main sota hoon aur apne sone ke liye bhi Allah ke ajr ki umeed karta hoon jaisi umeed main apni raat ki namaz ke liye karta hoon." Phir unhone (yaani Mu'adh ne) ek tambu lagaya aur woh ek-doosre se milne jate rahe. Ek baar Mu'adh Abu Musa se milne gaye aur ek zanjeeron mein jakde shaks ko dekha. Mu'adh ne pucha, "Yeh kya hai?" Abu Musa ne kaha, "(Yeh) ek Yahudi hai jinhone Islam qubool kiya tha aur ab dobara kaafir ban gaya hai." Mu'adh ne kaha, "Main zaroor unka sar kaatunga."

e: Narrated Abu Musa Al-Ash`ari:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent me (as a governor) to the land of my people, and I came while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was encamping at a place called Al-Abtah. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Have you made the intention to perform the Hajj, O `Abdullah bin Qais?" I replied, "Yes, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" He said, "What did you say?" I replied, "I said, 'Labbaik' and expressed the same intention as yours." He said, "Have you driven the Hadi along with you?" I replied, "No, I did not drive the Hadi." He said, "So perform the Tawaf of the Ka`ba and then the Sai, between Safa and Marwa and then finish the state of Ihram." So I did the same, and one of the women of (the tribe of) Banu-Qais combed my hair. We continued to follow in that tradition till the caliphate of `Umar
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ash'ari bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne mujhe (ek gawarnar ke tor par) meri qaum ki zameen par bheja, aur main aaya jabke Allah ke Rasool Al-Abtah naam ki jagah par padaav liye hue the. Nabi ne kaha, "Kya aapne Hajj karne ka irada kiya hai, Aye Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Qais?" Maine jawab diya, "Haan, Aye Allah ke Rasool!" Unhone kaha, "Aapne kya kaha?" Maine jawab diya, "Maine 'Labbaik' kaha aur aapjaisi hi niyyat zaahir ki." Unhone kaha, "Kya aap apne saath Hadi lekar aaye hain?" Maine jawab diya, "Nahi, main Hadi nahi laaya." Unhone kaha, "Phir Ka'ba ka Tawaf kariye aur phir Safa aur Marwa ke beech Sai kariye aur phir Ihram ki haalat khatm kar dijiye." Isliye maine waisa hi kiya, aur Banu Qais qabile ki ek aurat ne mere baal sanvaare. Hum isi riwaj ki pairvi karte rahe jab tak Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki khilafat aee.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to Mu`adh bin Jabal when he sent him to Yemen, "You will come to the people of Scripture, and when you reach them, invite them to testify that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah and that Muhammad is His Apostle. And if they obey you in that, then tell them that Allah has enjoined on them five prayers to be performed every day and night. And if they obey you in that, then tell them that Allah has enjoined on them Sadaqa (i.e. Zakat) to be taken from the rich amongst them and given to the poor amongst them. And if they obey you in that, then be cautious! Don't take their best properties (as Zakat) and be afraid of the curse of an oppressed person as there is no screen between his invocation and Allah
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Mu'adh bin Jabal (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kaha jab unhone unhe Yemen bheja, "Tum Kitaab wale (yaani Yahudi aur Isaee) logon ke paas jaenge, aur jab tum unke paas pahunche, unhe gawahi dene ki dawat do ke Allah ke siwa koee mabood nahi aur Muhammad unke Rasool hain. Aur agar woh ismein tumhari baat manate hain, phir unhe batao ke Allah ne unpar din aur raat mein paanch namazen farz ki hain. Aur agar woh ismein tumhari baat manate hain, phir unhe batao ke Allah ne unpar Sadaqa (yaani Zakat) farz ki hai jo unke daulatmandon se lekar unke gareebon mein baanti jaayegi. Aur agar woh ismein tumhari baat mante hain, phir saavdhaan raho! Unki sabse behtar maal (Zakat ke tor par) mat lo, aur ek utpidit shaks ki bad-dua se darte raho kyunke unki pukaar aur Allah ke beech koee parda nahi hai."

e: Narrated `Amr bin Maimuin:When Mu`adh arrived at Yemen, he led them (i.e. the people of Yemen) in the Fajr prayer wherein he recited: 'Allah took Abraham as a Khalil.' A man amongst the people said, "(How) glad the mother of Abraham is!" (In another narration) `Amr said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) sent Mu`adh to Yemen and he (led the people) in the Fajr prayer and recited: 'Allah took Abraham as a Khalil. A man behind him said, "(How) glad the mother of Abraham is
hi: Amr bin Maimun bataate hain: Jab Mu'adh Yemen pahunche, unhone unhe (yaani Yemen ke logon ko) Fajr ki namaz padhaee jismein unhone padha: 'Allah ne Ibrahim ko apna Khalil banaya.' Logon mein se ek shaks ne kaha, "(Kitna) khushnaseeb hain Ibrahim ki maa!" (Ek doosri riwaayat mein) Amr ne kaha, "Nabi ne Mu'adh ko Yemen bheja aur unhone (logon ko) Fajr ki namaz padhaee aur padha: 'Allah ne Ibrahim ko apna Khalil banaya.' Unke peeche khade ek shaks ne kaha, "(Kitna) khushnaseeb hain Ibrahim ki maa!"

e: Narrated Al-Bara:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent us to Yemen along with Khalid bin Al-Walid. Later on he sent `Ali bin Abi Talib in his place. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to `Ali, "Give Khalid's companions the choice of either staying with you (in Yemen) or returning to Medina." I was one of those who stayed with him (i.e. `Ali) and got several Awaq (of gold from the war booty)
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne humein Yemen ki taraf Khalid bin Al-Walid ke saath bheja. Baad mein unhone unki jagah Ali (Alayhis Salam) bin Abi Talib ko bheja. Nabi ne Ali (Alayhis Salam) se kaha, "Khalid ke sathiyon ko yeh chunaav do ke woh aapke saath (Yemen mein) ruke ya Madina wapas jaen." Main un logon mein tha jo unke (yaani Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke) saath ruke aur maal-e-ghanimat mein se kaee Awaq (yaani sona ki naap) hasil ki.

e: Narrated Buraida:The Prophet (ﷺ) sent `Ali to Khalid to bring the Khumus (of the booty) and I hated `Ali, and `Ali had taken a bath (after a sexual act with a slave-girl from the Khumus). I said to Khalid, "Don't you see this (i.e. `Ali)?" When we reached the Prophet (ﷺ) I mentioned that to him. He said, "O Buraida! Do you hate `Ali?" I said, "Yes." He said, "Do you hate him, for he deserves more than that from the Khumlus
hi: Buraida (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko Khalid ke paas bheja Khumus (yaani maal-e-ghanimat ka paanchvaan hissa) lane ke liye, aur main Ali (Alayhis Salam) se nafrat karta tha, aur Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne ghusal kiya tha (Khumus mein se ek launDi se shaareerik ta'alluq ke baad). Maine Khalid se kaha, "Kya aap yeh (yaani Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko) nahi dekh rahe?" Jab hum Nabi tak pahunche, maine unhe yeh bataya. Unhone kaha, "Aye Buraida! Kya tum Ali (Alayhis Salam) se nafrat karte ho?" Maine kaha, "Haan." Unhone kaha, "Unse nafrat mat karo, kyunke woh Khumus se isse zyada ke haqdaar hain."

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:`Ali bin Abi Talib sent a piece of gold not yet taken out of its ore, in a tanned leather container to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) distributed that amongst four Persons: 'Uyaina bin Badr, Aqra bin H`Abis, Zaid Al-Khail and the fourth was either Alqama or Amir bin at-Tufail. On that, one of his companions said, "We are more deserving of this (gold) than these (persons)." When that news reached the Prophet (ﷺ) , he said, "Don't you trust me though I am the trustworthy man of the One in the Heavens, and I receive the news of Heaven (i.e. Divine Inspiration) both in the morning and in the evening?" There got up a man with sunken eyes, raised cheek bones, raised forehead, a thick beard, a shaven head and a waist sheet that was tucked up and he said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Be afraid of Allah." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Woe to you! Am I not of all the people of the earth the most entitled to fear Allah?" Then that man went away. Khalid bin Al-Walid said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shall I chop his neck off?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No, for he may offer prayers." Khalid said, "Numerous are those who offer prayers and say by their tongues (i.e. mouths) what is not in their hearts." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I have not been ordered (by Allah) to search the hearts of the people or cut open their bellies." Then the Prophet looked at him (i.e. that man) while the latter was going away and said, "From the offspring of this (man there will come out (people) who will recite the Qur'an continuously and elegantly but it will not exceed their throats. (They will neither understand it nor act upon it). They would go out of the religion (i.e. Islam) as an arrow goes through a game's body." I think he also said, "If I should be present at their time I would kill them as the nation of Thamud were killed
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bin Abi Talib ne sone ka ek tukda, jise abhi tak uski dhatu se nikala nahi gaya tha, ek taanbe ke chamde ke bartan mein Allah ke Rasool ko bheja. Allah ke Rasool ne use chaar logon mein baanta: Uyaina bin Badr, Aqra bin H'Abis, Zaid Al-Khail, aur chautha ya to Alqama ya Amir bin at-Tufail tha. Ispar, unke kisi sathi ne kaha, "Hum in (log) se iske (yaani sone ke) zyada haqdaar hain." Jab yeh khabar Nabi tak pahunchi, unhone kaha, "Kya tumhe mujhpar bharosa nahi hai chahe main aasman mein maujood (Allah) ka bharosemand shaks hoon, aur mujhe subah aur shaam donon waqt aasman ki khabar (yaani Divine ilham) milti hai?" Ispar, dhansi huee aankhon, uthe gaal ki haddiyon, uthe mathe, gahri daadhi, munde hue sar, aur ek udan kapde ke saath ek shaks utha aur kaha, "Aye Allah ke Rasool! Allah se daro." Nabi ne kaha, "Tumpar afsos ho! Kya main zameen ke sab logon mein Allah se darne ka sabse zyada haq nahi rakhta?" Phir woh shaks chala gaya. Khalid bin Al-Walid ne kaha, "Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya main unki gala kaat dun?" Nabi ne kaha, "Nahi, kyunke woh shaayad namaz padhte hon." Khalid ne kaha, "Bahut se namaz padhne wale apni zubaan se woh kahte hain jo unke dil mein nahi hota." Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Mujhe (Allah dwaara) logon ke dilon ki khoj karne ka ya unke pet chirne ka hukum nahi diya gaya." Phir Nabi ne unki taraf dekha jabke woh ja rahe the aur kaha, "Is (shaks) ki santanon mein se (log) niklenge jo Quran ko lagataar aur khoobsurati se padhenge magar yeh unke gale se aage nahi jaega (na woh ise samjhenge na uspar amal karenge). Woh (Islam) deen se aise niklenge jaise teer shikaar ke jism se aar-paar nikla jata hai." Mujhe lagta hai unhone yeh bhi kaha, "Agar main unke waqt mein maujood hota, main unhe usi tarah qatl karta jaisa Thamud qaum qatl ki gaee thi."

e: Narrated 'Ata:Jabir said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered `Ali to keep the state of Ihram." Jabir added, "Ali bin Abi Talib returned (from Yemen) when he was a governor (of Yemen). The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, 'With what intention have you assumed the state of Ihram?' `Ali said, "I have assumed Ihram with an intention as that of the Prophet." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said (to him), 'Offer a Hadi and keep the state of Ihram in which you are now.' `Ali slaughtered a Hadi on his behalf
hi: Ata bataate hain: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Nabi ne Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko Ihram ki haalat mein rehne ka hukum diya." Jabir ne joda, "Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) (Yemen se) wapas aaye jabke woh (Yemen ke) gawarnar the. Nabi ne unse kaha, 'Aapne kis niyyat se Ihram dhaaran kiya hai?' Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha, 'Maine Ihram usi niyyat se dhaaran kiya hai jaisi Nabi ki hai.' Phir Nabi ne (unse) kaha, 'Ek Hadi (yaani qurbani ka janwar) pesh kariye aur isi Ihram mein rahiye jismein aap ab hain.' Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne unki taraf se ek Hadi zabah ki."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) assumed the state of Ihram for Umra and Hajj, and we too assumed it for Hajj with him. When we arrived at Mecca, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever does not possess a Hadi should regard his Ihram for Umra only." The Prophet (ﷺ) had a Hadi with him. `Ali bin Abi Talib came to us from Yemen with the intention of performing Hajj. The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to him), "With what intention have you assumed the Ihram, for your wife is with us?" `Ali said, "I assumed the Ihram with the same intention as that of the Prophet (ﷺ) ." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Keep on the state of Ihram, as we have got the Hadi
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Umrah aur Hajj donon ke liye Ihram dhaaran kiya, aur humne bhi unke saath Hajj ke liye Ihram dhaaran kiya. Jab hum Mecca pahunche, Nabi ne kaha, "Jinke paas Hadi nahi hai, unhe apna Ihram sirf Umrah ke liye maanna chahiye." Nabi ke paas ek Hadi thi. Ali (Alayhis Salam) bin Abi Talib Yemen se humare paas aaye Hajj karne ki niyyat se. Nabi ne (unse) kaha, "Aapne kis niyyat se Ihram dhaaran kiya hai, jabke aapki biwi humare saath hai?" Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha, "Maine usi niyyat se Ihram dhaaran kiya jaisi Nabi ki thi." Nabi ne kaha, "Ihram ki haalat mein rahiye, kyunke humare paas Hadi hai."

e: Narrated Jarir:In the Pre-Islamic Period of Ignorance there was a house called Dhu-l-Khalasa or Al-Ka`ba Al- Yamaniya or Al-Ka`ba Ash-Shamiya. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to me, "Won't you relieve me from Dhu-l- Khalasa?" So I set out with one-hundred-and-fifty riders, and we dismantled it and killed whoever was present there. Then I came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and informed him, and he invoked good upon us and Al- Ahmas (tribe)
hi: Jarir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jahiliyat ke daur mein ek ghar tha jise Dhu-l-Khalasa ya Al-Ka'ba Al-Yamaniya ya Al-Ka'ba Ash-Shamiya kaha jata tha. Nabi ne mujhse kaha, "Kya tum mujhe Dhu-l-Khalasa se rahat nahi doge?" Isliye main paanch sau pachas ghudswaron ke saath nikla, aur humne use dhwast kiya aur wahaan jo bhi maujood tha use qatl kiya. Phir main Nabi ke paas aaya aur unhe khabar di, aur unhone humare liye aur Al-Ahmas (qabile) ke liye achhi dua ki.

e: Narrated Qais:Jarir said to me, The Prophet (ﷺ) said to me, "Won't you relieve me from Dhu-l-Khalasa?" And that was a house (in Yemen belonging to the tribe of) Khatham called Al-Ka`ba Al Yamaniya. I proceeded with one-hundred and-fifty cavalry from Ahmas (tribe) who were horse riders. I used not to sit firm on horses, so the Prophet (ﷺ) stroke me over my chest till I saw the mark of his fingers over my chest, and then he said, 'O Allah! Make him (i.e. Jarir) firm and one who guides others and is guided on the right path." So Jarir proceeded to it dismantled and burnt it, and then sent a messenger to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). The messenger of Jarir said (to the Prophet), "By Him Who sent you with the Truth, I did not leave that place till it was like a scabby camel." The Prophet (ﷺ) blessed the horses of Ahmas and their men five times
hi: Qais bataate hain: Jarir (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne mujhse kaha, Nabi ne mujhe kaha, "Kya tum mujhe Dhu-l-Khalasa se rahat nahi doge?" Aur yeh (Yemen mein) Khatham qabile ka ek ghar tha jise Al-Ka'ba Al Yamaniya kaha jata tha. Main paanch sau pachas ghudswaron ke saath badha jo Ahmas (qabile) se the aur ghode ke sawar the. Main ghodon par sthir baithna nahi jaanta tha, isliye Nabi ne mere seene par apni ungli se thap-thapaya jab tak maine unki ungliyon ka nishaan apne seene par dekha, aur phir unhone kaha, 'Aye Allah! Ise (yaani Jarir ko) sthir aur ek aisa shaks banaa jo doosron ko sahi raste par le jaye aur khud bhi sahi raste par ho.'" Isliye Jarir uski taraf badhe, use dhwast kiya aur jala diya, aur phir Allah ke Rasool ke paas ek sandesh-vahak bheja. Jarir ke sandesh-vahak ne (Nabi se) kaha, "Us Zaat ki qasam jisne aapko Haqq ke saath bheja hai, maine woh jagah tab tak nahi chhoda jab tak yeh ek kharaab untni jaisa nahi ban gaya." Nabi ne Ahmas ke ghodon aur unke logon ko paanch baar barkat di.

e: Narrated Qais:Jarir said "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me, "Won't you relieve me from Dhul-Khalasa?" I replied, "Yes, (I will relieve you)." So I proceeded along with one-hundred and fifty cavalry from Ahmas tribe who were skillful in riding horses. I used not to sit firm over horses, so I informed the Prophet (ﷺ) of that, and he stroke my chest with his hand till I saw the marks of his hand over my chest and he said, O Allah! Make him firm and one who guides others and is guided (on the right path).' Since then I have never fallen from a horse. Dhul-l--Khulasa was a house in Yemen belonging to the tribe of Khatham and Bajila, and in it there were idols which were worshipped, and it was called Al-Ka`ba." Jarir went there, burnt it with fire and dismantled it. When Jarir reached Yemen, there was a man who used to foretell and give good omens by casting arrows of divination. Someone said to him. "The messenger of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) is present here and if he should get hold of you, he would chop off your neck." One day while he was using them (i.e. arrows of divination), Jarir stopped there and said to him, "Break them (i.e. the arrows) and testify that None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, or else I will chop off your neck." So the man broke those arrows and testified that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah. Then Jarir sent a man called Abu Artata from the tribe of Ahmas to the Prophet to convey the good news (of destroying Dhu-l-Khalasa). So when the messenger reached the Prophet, he said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! By Him Who sent you with the Truth, I did not leave it till it was like a scabby camel." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) blessed the horses of Ahmas and their men five times
hi: Qais bataate hain: Jarir (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Allah ke Rasool ne mujhse kaha, 'Kya tum mujhe Dhul-Khalasa se rahat nahi doge?' Maine jawab diya, 'Haan, (main aapko rahat dunga).' Isliye main paanch sau pachas ghudswaron ke saath badha jo Ahmas qabile se the aur ghode chalane mein maahir the. Main ghodon par sthir nahi baith pata tha, isliye maine Nabi ko iske baare mein bataya, aur unhone apne haath se mere seene par thap-thapaya jab tak maine unke haath ke nishaan apne seene par dekhe aur unhone kaha, 'Aye Allah! Ise sthir bana aur ek aisa shaks jo doosron ko sahi raste par le jaye aur khud bhi sahi raste par ho (dikhaee de).' Tab se main kabhi ghode se nahi gira. Dhu-l-Khulasa Yemen mein ek ghar tha Khatham aur Bajila qabile ka, aur usmein but the jinki puja ki jati thi, aur use Al-Ka'ba kaha jata tha." Jarir wahaan gaye, use aag se jala diya aur dhwast kiya. Jab Jarir Yemen pahunche, wahaan ek shaks tha jo peshangoi karta tha aur peshangoi ke teeron se shubh-ashubh batata tha. Kisi ne unse kaha, "Allah ke Rasool ka sandesh-vahak yahaan maujood hai aur agar woh tumhe pakad le, woh tumhari gala kaat dega." Ek din jabke woh unka istemal kar rahe the (yaani peshangoi ke teer), Jarir wahaan ruke aur unse kaha, "Inhe todo (yaani teeron ko) aur gawahi do ke Allah ke siwa koee mabood nahi, warna main tumhari gala kaat dunga." Isliye us shaks ne woh teer tode aur gawahi di ke Allah ke siwa koee mabood nahi. Phir Jarir ne Ahmas qabile se ek shaks jinka naam Abu Artata tha use Nabi ko achhi khabar (Dhu-l-Khalasa ke tabaahi ki) dene ke liye bheja. Isliye jab sandesh-vahak Nabi tak pahunche, unhone kaha, "Aye Allah ke Rasool! Us Zaat ki qasam jisne aapko Haqq ke saath bheja hai, maine ise tab tak nahi chhoda jab tak yeh ek kharaab untni jaisa nahi ban gaya." Phir Nabi ne Ahmas ke ghodon aur unke logon ko paanch baar barkat di.

e: Narrated Abu `Uthman:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent `Amr bin Al As as the commander of the troops of Dhat-us-Salasil. `Amr bin Al- `As said, "(On my return) I came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, 'Which people do you love most?' He replied, `Aisha.' I said, 'From amongst the men?' He replied, 'Her father (Abu Bakr)'. I said, 'Whom (do you love) next?' He replied, "`Umar.' Then he counted the names of many men, and I became silent for fear that he might regard me as the last of them
hi: Abu Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Amr bin Al-As (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko Dhat-us-Salasil ki fauj ka kamandar banakar bheja. Amr bin Al-As ne kaha, "(Mere lautne par) main Nabi ke paas gaya aur pucha, 'Aap sabse zyada kisse pyar karte hain?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Ayesha.' Maine kaha, 'Mardon mein se?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Unke waalid (Abu Bakr).' Maine kaha, 'Phir kaun (unke baad)?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Umar.' Phir unhone kaee aur logon ke naam gine, aur main khaamosh ho gaya isliye ke mujhe dar tha ke woh mujhe unmein sabse aakhri na maan len."

e: Narrated Jarir:While I was at Yemen, I met two men from Yemen called Dhu Kala and Dhu `Amr, and I started telling them about Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Dhu `Amr said to me, "If what you are saying about your friend (i.e. the Prophet) is true, then he has died three days ago." Then both of them accompanied me to Medina, and when we had covered some distance on the way to Medina, we saw some riders coming from Medina. We asked them and they said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has died and Abu Bakr has been appointed as the Caliph and the people are in a good state.' Then they said, "Tell your friend (Abu Bakr) that we have come (to visit him), and if Allah will, we will come again." So they both returned to Yemen. When I told Abu Bakr their statement, he said to me, "I wish you had brought them (to me)." Afterwards I met Dhu `Amr, and he said to me, "O Jarir! You have done a favor to me and I am going to tell you something, i.e. you, the nation of 'Arabs, will remain prosperous as long as you choose and appoint another chief whenever a former one is dead. But if authority is obtained by the power of the sword, then the rulers will become kings who will get angry, as kings get angry, and will be delighted as kings get delighted
hi: Jarir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jabke main Yemen mein tha, meri mulaqaat do Yemeni logon se huee jinke naam Dhu Kala aur Dhu Amr the, aur maine unhe Allah ke Rasool ke baare mein batana shuru kiya. Dhu Amr ne mujhse kaha, "Agar jo aap apne doost (yaani Nabi) ke baare mein kah rahe hain sach hai, phir unka intiqal teen din pahle ho chuka hai." Phir donon mere saath Madina aaye, aur jab humne Madina ke raste par kuch doori tay ki, humne kuch sawaron ko Madina se aate dekha. Humne unse pucha aur unhone kaha, "Allah ke Rasool ka intiqal ho gaya hai aur Abu Bakr ko Khalifa muqarrar kiya gaya hai, aur log achhi haalat mein hain." Phir unhone kaha, "Apne dost (yaani Abu Bakr) se kahiye ke hum aaye (unse milne), aur agar Allah ne chaha, hum phir aenge." Isliye donon Yemen wapas gaye. Jab maine unki baat Abu Bakr ko bataee, unhone mujhse kaha, "Kaash tum unhe (mere paas) le aate." Baad mein maine Dhu Amr se mulaqaat ki, aur unhone mujhse kaha, "Aye Jarir! Aapne mujhpar ek ehsaan kiya hai aur main aapko kuch batane ja raha hoon, yaani, tum, Arbon ki qaum, tabtak samriddh rahoge jab tak tum har baar ek purane sardaar ki maut ke baad ek doosra sardaar chunte aur muqarrar karte rahoge. Magar agar hukumat talwaar ki taakat se hasil ki jaati hai, phir hukmaran (aise) baadshah bane jaenge jo naraaj honge jaise baadshah naraaj hote hain, aur khushi honge jaise baadshah khushi hote hain."

e: Narrated Wahab bin Kaisan:Jabir bin `Abdullah said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent troops to the sea coast and appointed Abu 'Ubaida bin Al-Jarrah as their commander, and they were 300 (men). We set out, and we had covered some distance on the way, when our journey food ran short. So Abu 'Ubaida ordered that all the food present with the troops be collected, and it was collected. Our journey food was dates, and Abu Ubaida kept on giving us our daily ration from it little by little (piecemeal) till it decreased to such an extent that we did not receive except a date each." I asked (Jabir), "How could one date benefit you?" He said, "We came to know its value when even that finished." Jabir added, "Then we reached the sea (coast) where we found a fish like a small mountain. The people (i.e. troops) ate of it for 18 nights (i.e. days). Then Abu 'Ubaida ordered that two of its ribs be fixed on the ground (in the form of an arch) and that a she-camel be ridden and passed under them. So it passed under them without touching them
hi: Wahab bin Kaisan bataate hain: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Allah ke Rasool ne samundar ke kinare ki taraf sainikon ko bheja aur Abu Ubaida bin Al-Jarrah ko unka kamandar muqarrar kiya, aur woh teen sau (300) the. Hum nikle, aur humne raste par kuch doori tay ki jab humari safar ka khaana kam pad gaya. Isliye Abu Ubaida ne hukum diya ke sainikon ke paas jo bhi khaana hai woh jama kiya jaaye, aur use jama kiya gaya. Humara safar ka khaana khajoor tha, aur Abu Ubaida usmein se humari rozana raashan thoda-thoda karke (tukdon mein) dete rahe jab tak yeh itna kam ho gaya ke humein ek-ek khajoor hi mili." Maine (Jabir se) pucha, "Ek khajoor tumhe kaise faayda deti thi?" Unhone kaha, "Humein iski qeemat pata chali jab woh bhi khatm ho gaee." Jabir ne joda, "Phir hum samundar (ke kinare) tak pahunche jahaan humein ek pahad jaisi machhli mili. Log (yaani sainik) use atharah raaton (yaani dinon) tak khate rahe. Phir Abu Ubaida ne hukum diya ke uski do paansuliyon ko zameen mein (ek mihrab jaisa) gaada jaaye aur ek untni par sawar hokar unke neeche se guzaraee jaaye. Isliye woh unke neeche se bina chhuye guzari."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent us who were three-hundred riders under the command of Abu Ubaida bin Al- Jarrah in order to watch the caravan of the Quraish pagans. We stayed at the seashore for half a month and were struck with such severe hunger that we ate even the Khabat (i.e. the leaves of the Salam, a thorny desert tree), and because of that, the army was known as Jaish-ul-Khabat. Then the sea threw out, an animal (i.e. a fish) called Al-`Anbar and we ate of that for half a month, and rubbed its fat on our bodies till our bodies returned to their original state (i.e. became strong and healthy). Abu Ubaida took one of its ribs, fixed it on the ground; then he went to the tallest man of his companions (to let him pass under the rib). Once Sufyan said, "He took a rib from its parts and fixed it, and then took a man and camel and they passed from underneath it (without touching it). " Jabir added: There was a man amongst the people who slaughtered three camels and then slaughtered another three camels and then slaughtered another three camels, and then Abu 'Ubaida forbade him to do so. Narrated Abu Salih: Qais bin Sa`d said to his father. "I was present in the army and the people were struck with severe hunger." He said, "You should have slaughtered (camels) (for them)." Qais said, "I did slaughter camels but they were hungry again. He said, "You should have slaughtered (camels) again." Qais said, "I did slaughter (camels) again but the people felt hungry again." He said, "You should have slaughtered (camels) again." Qais said, "I did slaughter (camels) again, but the people again felt hungry." He said, "You should have slaughtered (camels) again." Qais said, "But I was forbidden (by Abu 'Ubaida this time)
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne humein, jo teen sau (300) sawar the, Abu Ubaida bin Al-Jarrah ke netritva mein bheja taaki Quraish mushrikon ke caravan par nazar rakhen. Hum aadhe mahine tak samundar ke kinare ruke aur itni sakht bhookh se pareshaan hue ke humne Khabat (yaani Salam paudhe, ek kaantedaar registaan paudha, ke patte) bhi khaae, aur isi wajah se saina ko Jaish-ul-Khabat kaha jane laga. Phir samundar ne ek janwar (yaani ek machhli) jise Al-Anbar kaha jata tha, phenka aur humne use aadhe mahine tak khaya, aur uski charbi apne shareer par mali jab tak humare shareer apni asal haalat mein wapas aa gaye (yaani takatvaan aur svasth ban gaye). Abu Ubaida ne uski ek paansuli li, use zameen mein gaada; phir woh apne sathiyon mein sabse lambe shaks ke paas gaye (unhe uske neeche se guzarne dene ke liye). (Ek baar Sufyan ne kaha, "Unhone uske hisson mein se ek paansuli li aur use gaada, aur phir ek shaks aur ek unt liya aur woh uske neeche se guzre (bina chhuye).") Jabir ne joda: Logon mein se ek shaks the jinhone teen unt zabah kiye aur phir doosre teen aur phir doosre teen zabah kiye, aur phir Abu Ubaida ne unhe aisa karne se mana kiya. Abu Salih bataate hain: Qais bin Sa'd ne apne waalid se kaha, "Main saina mein maujood tha aur log sakht bhookh se pareshaan hue." Unhone kaha, "Tumhe (unke liye unt) zabah karna chahiye tha." Qais ne kaha, "Maine unt zabah kiye magar woh phir bhookhe ho gaye." Unhone kaha, "Tumhe phir zabah karna chahiye tha." Qais ne kaha, "Maine phir zabah kiya magar log phir bhookhe ho gaye." Unhone kaha, "Tumhe phir zabah karna chahiye tha." Qais ne kaha, "Maine phir zabah kiya, magar log phir bhookhe ho gaye." Unhone kaha, "Tumhe phir zabah karna chahiye tha." Qais ne kaha, "Magar mujhe (Abu Ubaida dwaara isse) roka gaya."

e: Narrated Jabir:We set out in the army of Al-Khabat and Abu Ubaida was the commander of the troops. We were struck with severe hunger and the sea threw out a dead fish the like of which we had never seen, and it was called Al-`Anbar. We ate of it for half a month. Abu Ubaida took (and fixed) one of its bones and a rider passed underneath it (without touching it). (Jabir added:) Abu 'Ubaida said (to us), "Eat (of that fish)." When we arrived at Medina, we informed the Prophet (ﷺ) about that, and he said, "Eat, for it is food Allah has brought out for you, and feed us if you have some of it." So some of them gave him (of that fish) and he ate it
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Al-Khabat ki saina mein nikle aur Abu Ubaida sainikon ke kamandar the. Hum sakht bhookh se pareshaan hue aur samundar ne ek murda machhli phenki jaisi humne kabhi nahi dekhi thi, aur use Al-Anbar kaha jata tha. Humne use aadhe mahine tak khaya. Abu Ubaida ne uski ek haddi li (aur gaadi) aur ek sawar uske neeche se guzra (bina chhuye). (Jabir ne joda:) Abu Ubaida ne (humse) kaha, "Khaao (yeh machhli)." Jab hum Madina pahunche, humne Nabi ko iske baare mein bataya, aur unhone kaha, "Khaao, kyunke yeh khaana hai jo Allah ne tumhare liye nikala hai, aur agar tumhare paas usmein se kuch ho to humein bhi khilao." Isliye unmein se kuch ne unhe (yaani us machhli mein se) diya aur unhone use khaya.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:That during the Hajj in which the Prophet (ﷺ) had made Abu Bakr As Siddiq as chief of the, Hajj before the Hajj-ul-Wida,' on the day of Nahr, Abu Bakr sent him along with a group of persons to announce to the people. "No pagan is permitted to perform Hajj after this year, and nobody is permitted to perform the Tawaf of the Ka`ba naked
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Us Hajj ke dauran jismein Nabi ne Abu Bakr As-Siddiq ko Hajj-ul-Wida se pahle Hajj ka pramukh banaya tha, Nahr (yaani qurbani) ke din, Abu Bakr ne unhe kuch logon ke ek giroh ke saath bheja logon ko elaan karne ke liye, "Is saal ke baad koee bhi mushrik Hajj nahi karega, aur koee bhi shakhs nagn hokar Ka'ba ka Tawaf nahi karega."

e: Narrated Al-Bara:The last Sura which was revealed in full was Baraa (i.e. Sura-at-Tauba), and the last Sura (i.e. part of a Sura) which was revealed was the last Verses of Sura-an-Nisa':-- "They ask you for a legal decision. Say: Allah directs (thus) About those who have No descendants or ascendants As heirs
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Poori tarah naazil hone wali aakhiri Surah Baraa thi (yaani Surah At-Tauba), aur naazil hone wali aakhiri Surah (yaani ek Surah ka hissa) Surah An-Nisa ki aakhiri Ayaten thi: "Woh aapse deeni faisla puchte hain. Kahiye: Allah tumhe (iske baare mein) hidaayat deta hai un logon ke baare mein jinke koee aulad ya waalidain waaris ke tor par na hon...."

e: Narrated `Imran bin Hussein:A delegation from Banu Tamim came to the Prophet (ﷺ) . The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Accept the good tidings, O Banu Tamim!" They said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! You have given us good tidings, so give us (something)." Signs of displeasure appeared on his face. Then another delegation from Yemen came and he said (to them), "Accept the good tidings, for Banu Tamim refuses to accept them." They replied, "We have accepted them, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
hi: Imran bin Hussein bataate hain: Banu Tamim ka ek pratinidhimandal Nabi ke paas aaya. Nabi ne kaha, "Achhi khabar qubool karo, Aye Banu Tamim!" Unhone kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Aapne humein achhi khabar di hai, isliye humein (kuch aur) dijiye." Nabi ke chehre par napasandgi ke asaraat dikhe. Phir Yemen se ek doosra pratinidhimandal aaya aur unhone (unse) kaha, "Achhi khabar qubool karo, kyunke Banu Tamim ne ise qubool karne se inkaar kar diya." Unhone jawab diya, "Humne ise qubool kiya hai, Aye Allah ke Rasool!"

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I have not ceased to like Banu Tamim ever since I heard of three qualities attributed to them by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (He said): They, out of all my followers, will be the strongest opponent of Ad-Dajjal; `Aisha had a slave-girl from them, and the Prophet (ﷺ) told her to manumit her as she was from the descendants of (the Prophet) Ishmael; and, when their Zakat was brought, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "This is the Zakat of my people
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Banu Tamim se pyar karna band nahi kar sakta jab se maine Allah ke Rasool dwaara unke teen gunon ke baare mein suna. (Unhone kaha:) Mere sab pairokaron mein se, woh Ad-Dajjal ke sabse taakatvar virodhi honge; Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas unmein se ek launDi thi, aur Nabi ne unse kaha ke woh use azad kar den kyunke woh Ismail (Nabi) ki santanon mein se thi; aur, jab unki Zakat laee gaee, Nabi ne kaha, "Yeh meri qaum ki Zakat hai."

e: Narrated Ibn Abi Mulaika:`Abdullah bin Az-Zubair said that a group of riders belonging to Banu Tamim came to the Prophet, Abu Bakr said (to the Prophet (ﷺ) ), "Appoint Al-Qa'qa bin Mabad bin Zurara as (their) ruler." `Umar said (to the Prophet). "No! But appoint Al-Aqra bin H`Abis." Thereupon Abu Bakr said (to `Umar). "You just wanted to oppose me." `Umar replied. "I did not want to oppose you." So both of them argued so much that their voices became louder, and then the following Divine Verses were revealed in that connection:-- "O you who believe ! Do not be forward in the presence of Allah and His Apostle..." (till the end of Verse)
hi: Ibn Abi Mulaika bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha ke Banu Tamim ke ghudswaron ka ek giroh Nabi ke paas aaya. Abu Bakr ne (Nabi se) kaha, "Al-Qa'qa bin Mabad bin Zurara ko (unka) sardaar muqarrar kariye." Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne (Nabi se) kaha, "Nahi! Balki Al-Aqra bin H'Abis ko muqarrar kariye." Ispar Abu Bakr ne (Umar se) kaha, "Aapka irada sirf mera virodh karne ka tha." Umar ne jawab diya, "Mera irada aapka virodh karne ka nahi tha." Isliye donon itna baat karte rahe ke unki aawaazen buland ho gaee, aur phir isi silsile mein yeh Divine Ayaten naazil huee: "Aye mominon! Allah aur uske Rasool ki maujoodgi mein aage mat badho...." (aakhri tak)

e: Narrated Abu Jamra:I said to Ibn `Abbas, "I have an earthenware pot containing Nabidh (i.e. water and dates or grapes) for me, and I drink of it while it is sweet. If I drink much of it and stay with the people for a long time, I get afraid that they may discover it (for I will appear as if I were drunk). Ibn `Abbas said, "A delegation of `Abdul Qais came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he said, "Welcome, O people! Neither will you have disgrace nor will you regret." They said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! There are the Mudar pagans between you and us, so we cannot come to you except in the sacred Months. So please teach us some orders on acting upon which we will enter Paradise. Besides, we will preach that to our people who are behind us." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I order you to do four things and forbid you from four things (I order you): To believe in Allah...Do you know what is to believe in Allah? That is to testify that None has the right to be worshipped except Allah: (I order you also to offer prayers perfectly to pay Zakat; and to fast the month of Ramadan and to give the Khumus (i.e. one-fifth of the booty) (for Allah's Sake). I forbid you from four other things (i.e. the wine that is prepared in) Ad-Dubba, An-Naqir, Al-Hantam and Al-Muzaffat. (See Hadith No. 50 Vol)
hi: Abu Jamra bataate hain: Maine Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kaha, "Mere paas Nabidh (yaani paani aur khajoor ya angoor se bana peya) se bhara ek mitti ka bartan hai, aur main ise meetha rahte hue pita hoon. Agar main ise bahut zyada pita hoon aur logon ke saath lambe waqt tak rahta hoon, mujhe dar lagta hai ke unhe pata chal jaayega (kyunke main nashe mein dikhunga)." Ibn Abbas ne kaha, "Abdul Qais ka ek pratinidhimandal Allah ke Rasool ke paas aaya aur unhone kaha, 'Swagat hai, Aye logo! Na tumhe apman milega na hi tumhe pachhtava hoga.' Unhone kaha, 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Aapke aur humare beech Mudar ke kaafiron ka ilaka hai, isliye hum aapke paas sirf pavitra mahinon mein aa sakte hain. Isliye kripya humein kuch hukum sikhaiye jinpar amal karke hum Jannat mein daakhil hon. Iske alaava, hum apni qaum ko bhi yeh sikhaenge jo humare peeche hain.' Nabi ne kaha, 'Main tumhe chaar cheezen karne ka hukum deta hoon aur chaar cheezon se mana karta hoon (main tumhe hukum deta hoon:) Allah par iman lao...Kya tumhe pata hai Allah par iman lane ka matlab kya hai? Yeh hai gawahi dena ke Allah ke siwa koee mabood nahi hai: (main tumhe yeh bhi hukum deta hoon ke) namazen poori tarah se padho; Zakat do; aur Ramadan ke mahine ka roza rakho aur Khumus (yaani maal-e-ghanimat ka paanchvaan hissa) do (Allah ki khaatir). Main tumhe chaar doosri cheezon se mana karta hoon (yaani un mein banaye gaye sharaab se): Ad-Dubba, An-Naqir, Al-Hantam, aur Al-Muzaffat.'"

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The delegation of `Abdul Qais came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) We belong to the tribe of Rabi`a. The infidels of Mudar tribe intervened between us and you so that we cannot come to you except in the Sacred Months, so please order us some things we may act on and invite those left behind to act on. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I order you to observe four things and forbid you from four things: (I order you) to believe in Allah, i.e. to testify that None has the right to be worshipped except Allah." The Prophet (ﷺ) pointed with his finger indicating one and added, "To offer prayers perfectly: to give Zakat, and to give one-fifth of the booty you win (for Allah's Sake). I forbid you to use Ad-Dubba', An-Naqir, Al-Hantam and Al-Muzaffat, (Utensils used for preparing alcoholic liquors and drinks)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abdul Qais ka pratinidhimandal Nabi ke paas aaya aur kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Hum Rabi'a qabile se hain. Mudar qabile ke kaafiron ne humare aur aapke beech dakhal diya hai isliye hum aapke paas sirf pavitra mahinon mein aa sakte hain, isliye kripya humein kuch cheezen sikhaiye jinpar hum amal kar saken aur unhe apne peeche chhode gaye logon ko bhi bulane ke liye istemal kar saken." Nabi ne kaha, "Main tumhe chaar cheezen karne ka hukum deta hoon aur chaar cheezon se mana karta hoon: (Main tumhe hukum deta hoon) Allah par iman rakhne ka, yaani gawahi dene ka ke Allah ke siwa koee mabood nahi hai." Nabi ne apni ungli se ishara kiya, ek gina, aur joda, "Namazen poori tarah se padhna; Zakat dena, aur jo maal-e-ghanimat tum jitte ho uska ek-paanchvaan hissa dena (Allah ki khaatir). Main tumhe Ad-Dubba, An-Naqir, Al-Hantam, aur Al-Muzaffat (yaani alcoholic peyon aur peyon ke bartan taiyaar karne mein istemal hone wale bartan) istemal karne se mana karta hoon."

e: Narrated Bukair:That Kuraib, the freed slave of Ibn `Abbas told him that Ibn `Abbas, `Abdur-Rahman bin Azhar and Al-Miswar bin Makhrama sent him to `Aisha saying, "Pay her our greetings and ask her about our offering of the two-rak`at after `Asr Prayer, and tell her that we have been informed that you offer these two rak`at while we have heard that the Prophet (ﷺ) had forbidden their offering." Ibn `Abbas said, "I and `Umar used to beat the people for their offering them." Kuraib added, "I entered upon her and delivered their message to her.' She said, 'Ask Um Salama.' So, I informed them (of `Aisha's answer) and they sent me to Um Salama for the same purpose as they sent me to `Aisha. Um Salama replied, 'I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) forbidding the offering of these two rak`at. Once the Prophet (ﷺ) offered the `Asr prayer, and then came to me. And at that time some Ansari women from the Tribe of Banu Haram were with me. Then (the Prophet (ﷺ) ) offered those two rak`at, and I sent my (lady) servant to him, saying, 'Stand beside him and say (to him): Um Salama says, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Didn't I hear you forbidding the offering of these two rak`at (after the `Asr prayer yet I see you offering them?' And if he beckons to you with his hand, then wait behind.' So the lady slave did that and the Prophet (ﷺ) beckoned her with his hand, and she stayed behind, and when the Prophet (ﷺ) finished his prayer, he said, 'O the daughter of Abu Umaiya (i.e. Um Salama), You were asking me about these two rak`at after the `Asr prayer. In fact, some people from the tribe of `Abdul Qais came to me to embrace Islam and busied me so much that I did not offer the two rak`at which were offered after Zuhr compulsory prayer, and these two rak`at (you have seen me offering) make up for those
hi: Bukair bataate hain: Kuraib, Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke azaad kiye gulaam, ne unhe bataya ke Ibn Abbas, Abdur-Rahman bin Azhar, aur Al-Miswar bin Makhrama (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne unhe Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas bheja, kehte huye, "Unhe humara salaam kaho aur Asr ki namaz ke baad ki do rakaton ke baare mein pucho, aur unse kaho ke humein bataya gaya hai ke aap yeh do rakat padhte hain jabke humne suna hai ke Nabi ne in donon rakaton ko padhne se mana kiya tha." Ibn Abbas ne kaha, "Main aur Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) logon ko in do rakaton ke padhne par (rokne ke liye) maarte the." Kuraib ne joda, "Main unke paas gaya aur unka paighaam pahunchaya. Unhone kaha, 'Um Salama se puchho.' Isliye maine unhe (yeh jawab) bataya aur unhone mujhe Um Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas usi maksad ke liye bheja jaisa Ayesha ke paas bheja tha. Um Salama ne jawab diya, 'Maine Nabi ko in do rakaton ko padhne se mana karte suna. Ek baar Nabi ne Asr ki namaz padhi aur phir mere paas aaye. Us waqt kuch Ansaari aurten, Banu Haram qabile se, mere saath thi. Phir (Nabi ne) woh do rakaten padhi, aur maine apni launDi ko unke paas bheja, kehte huye, "Unke bagal mein khade ho jao aur (unse) kaho: Um Salama kahti hain, Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya maine aapko in do rakaton ko padhne se mana karte hue nahi suna jabke main aapko unhe padhte dekh rahi hoon? Aur agar woh apne haath se ishaara karen, phir peeche ruko." Isliye launDi ne waisa hi kiya aur Nabi ne unhe apne haath se ishara kiya, aur woh peeche ruki, aur jab Nabi ne apni namaz khatm ki, unhone kaha, "Aye Abu Umaiya ki beti (yaani Um Salama), aapne mujhse in do rakaton ke baare mein pucha jo Asr ki namaz ke baad padhi jaati hain. Asal mein, Abdul Qais qabile ke kuch log mere paas Islam qubool karne aaye aur mujhe itna vyast kar diya ke maine woh do rakat nahi padhi jo Zuhr ki farz namaz ke baad padhi jaati hain, aur yeh do rakat (jo aapne mujhe abhi padhte dekha) un donon ki kami poori karte hain.'"'"

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The first Friday (i.e. Jumua) prayer offered after the Friday Prayer offered at the Mosque of Allah's Apostle was offered at the mosque of `Abdul Qais situated at Jawathi, that is a village at Al Bahrain
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Pahli Jumme ki namaz jo Nabi ki masjid mein padhi gaee Jumme ki namaz ke baad padhi gaee thi, woh Abdul Qais ki masjid mein padhi gaee thi jo Jawathi mein thi, yaani Al-Bahrain ka ek gaanv.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) sent some cavalry towards Najd and they brought a man from the tribe of Banu Hanifa who was called Thumama bin Uthal. They fastened him to one of the pillars of the Mosque. The Prophet went to him and said, "What have you got, O Thumama?" He replied," I have got a good thought, O Muhammad! If you should kill me, you would kill a person who has already killed somebody, and if you should set me free, you would do a favor to one who is grateful, and if you want property, then ask me whatever wealth you want." He was left till the next day when the Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "What have you got, Thumama? He said, "What I told you, i.e. if you set me free, you would do a favor to one who is grateful." The Prophet (ﷺ) left him till the day after, when he said, "What have you got, O Thumama?" He said, "I have got what I told you. "On that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Release Thumama." So he (i.e. Thumama) went to a garden of date-palm trees near to the Mosque, took a bath and then entered the Mosque and said, "I testify that None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, and also testify that Muhammad is His Apostle! By Allah, O Muhammad! There was no face on the surface of the earth most disliked by me than yours, but now your face has become the most beloved face to me. By Allah, there was no religion most disliked by me than yours, but now it is the most beloved religion to me. By Allah, there was no town most disliked by me than your town, but now it is the most beloved town to me. Your cavalry arrested me (at the time) when I was intending to perform the `Umra. And now what do you think?" The Prophet (ﷺ) gave him good tidings (congratulated him) and ordered him to perform the `Umra. So when he came to Mecca, someone said to him, "You have become a Sabian?" Thumama replied, "No! By Allah, I have embraced Islam with Muhammad, Apostle of Allah. No, by Allah! Not a single grain of wheat will come to you from Yamamah unless the Prophet gives his permission
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Najd ki taraf kuch ghudswaron ko bheja aur woh Banu Hanifa qabile ke ek shaks ko laye jinka naam Thumama bin Uthal tha. Unhone unhe masjid ke ek khambe se baandha. Nabi unke paas gaye aur kaha, "Tumhare paas kya hai, Aye Thumama?" Unhone jawab diya, "Mere paas ek achha vichaar hai, Aye Muhammad! Agar aap mujhe qatl karte hain, aap ek aise shaks ko qatl karenge jisne pahle hi kisi ko qatl kiya hai, aur agar aap mujhe azad karte hain, aap ek aise shaks ka ehsaan karenge jo shukrguzaar hai, aur agar aap maal chahte hain, phir mujhse jitna daulat chahiye pucha lijiye." Unhe agle din tak chhod diya gaya jab Nabi ne unse kaha, "Tumhare paas kya hai, Thumama? Unhone kaha, "Woh jo maine aapko bataya, yaani agar aap mujhe azad karte hain, aap ek shaks ka ehsaan karenge jo shukrguzaar hai." Nabi ne unhe agle din tak chhod diya, jab unhone kaha, "Tumhare paas kya hai, Aye Thumama?" Unhone kaha, "Mere paas woh hai jo maine aapko bataya." Ispar Nabi ne kaha, "Thumama ko azad karo." Isliye woh (yaani Thumama) masjid ke qareeb khajoor ke darakhton ke ek baag mein gaye, ghusal kiya aur phir masjid mein daakhil hue aur kaha, "Main gawahi deta hoon ke Allah ke siwa koee mabood nahi, aur main yeh bhi gawahi deta hoon ke Muhammad unke Rasool hain! Allah ki qasam, Aye Muhammad! Zameen ki satha par koee chehra aisa nahi tha jise main aapke chehre se zyada napasand karta tha, magar ab aapka chehra mujhe sabse pyara chehra ban gaya hai. Allah ki qasam, koee deen aisa nahi tha jise main aapke deen se zyada napasand karta tha, magar ab yeh mujhe sabse pyara deen hai. Allah ki qasam, koee sheher aisa nahi tha jise main aapke sheher se zyada napasand karta tha, magar ab yeh mujhe sabse pyara sheher hai. Aapke ghudswaron ne mujhe pakda jabke main Umrah karne ka irada kar raha tha. Ab aapki kya raay hai?" Nabi ne unhe khushkhabri di (badhaee di) aur unhe Umrah karne ka hukum diya. Isliye jab woh Mecca aaye, kisi ne unse kaha, "Kya aap Sabian ban gaye ho?" Thumama ne jawab diya, "Nahi! Allah ki qasam, maine Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool, ke saath Islam qubool kiya hai. Nahi, Allah ki qasam! Ek bhi gehun ka daana tumhare paas Yamama se nahi aayega jab tak Nabi apni ijazat na den."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Musailima Al-Kadhdhab came during the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) and started saying, "If Muhammad gives me the rule after him, I will follow him." And he came to Medina with a great number of the people of his tribe. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went to him in the company of Thabit bin Qais bin Shammas, and at that time, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had a stick of a date-palm tree in his hand. When he (i.e. the Prophet (ﷺ) ) stopped near Musailima while the latter was amidst his companions, he said to him, "If you ask me for this piece (of stick), I will not give it to you, and Allah's Order you cannot avoid, (but you will be destroyed), and if you turn your back from this religion, then Allah will destroy you. And I think you are the same person who was shown to me in my dream, and this is Thabit bin Qais who will answer your questions on my behalf." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) went away from him. I asked about the statement of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) : "You seem to be the same person who was shown to me in my dream," and Abu Huraira informed me that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When I was sleeping, I saw (in a dream) two bangles of gold on my hands and that worried me. And then I was inspired Divinely in the dream that I should blow on them, so I blew on them and both the bangles flew away. And I interpreted it that two liars (who would claim to be prophets) would appear after me. One of them has proved to be Al Ansi and the other, Musailima
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Musailima Al-Kadhdhab Nabi ki zindagi mein aaya aur kahne laga, "Agar Muhammad mujhe apne baad hukumat deta hai, main unki pairvi karunga." Aur woh Madina mein apni qaum ke bahut se logon ke saath aaya. Allah ke Rasool unke paas gaye Thabit bin Qais bin Shammas ki sohbat mein, aur us waqt, Allah ke Rasool ke haath mein khajoor ke darakht ki ek laathi thi. Jab woh Musailima ke qareeb ruke jabke woh apne sathiyon ke beech tha, unhone unse kaha, "Agar tum mujhse is tukde (yaani daadi ki laathi) ki maang karte ho, main tumhe ise nahi dunga, aur Allah ka hukum tum taal nahi sakte, (magar tum barbaad ho jaoge), aur agar tum is deen se apni peeth mudte ho, phir Allah tumhe barbaad karega. Aur mujhe lagta hai tum wahi shaks ho jo mujhe khwab mein dikhaye gaye the." Yeh (yaani Thabit) hain jo tumhare sawalon ka jawab mere taraf se denge." Phir Nabi unke paas se chale gaye. Maine Allah ke Rasool ki baat ke baare mein pucha: "Tum wahi shaks lagte ho jo mujhe khwab mein dikhaye gaye the," aur Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne mujhe bataya ke Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Jabke main so raha tha, maine (ek khwab mein) apne haathon par sone ki do chudiyaan dekhi aur isne mujhe pareshaan kiya. Phir mujhe Divine soorat se hidaayat mili ke main unpar phoonk maar dun, isliye maine phoonka aur donon uda gaee. Maine ise samjha ke mere baad do jhoote (log jo Nabi hone ka daava karenge) aenge. Unmein se ek Al-Ansi saabit hue, aur doosre Musailima."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "While I was sleeping, I was given the treasures of the earth and two gold bangles were put in my hands, and I did not like that, but I received the inspiration that I should blow on them, and I did so, and both of them vanished. I interpreted it as referring to the two liars between whom I am present; the ruler of Sana and the Ruler of Yamama
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Jabke main so raha tha, mujhe zameen ke khazanon di gaee, aur mere haath mein sone ki do chudiyaan rakhi gaee, aur mujhe yeh achha nahi laga, magar mujhe hidaayat mili ke main unpar phoonk maar dun, aur maine aisa hi kiya, aur donon gaayab ho gaee. Maine ise samjha do jhooton ke silsile mein jinke beech main hoonga; Sana ka hukmaran aur Yamama ka hukmaran."

e: Narrated Abu Raja Al-Utaridi:We used to worship stones, and when we found a better stone than the first one, we would throw the first one and take the latter, but if we could not get a stone then we would collect some earth (i.e. soil) and then bring a sheep and milk that sheep over it, and perform the Tawaf around it. When the month of Rajab came, we used (to stop the military actions), calling this month the iron remover, for we used to remove and throw away the iron parts of every spear and arrow in the month of Rajab. Abu Raja' added: When the Prophet (ﷺ) was sent with (Allah's) Message, I was a boy working as a shepherd of my family camels. When we heard the news about the appearance of the Prophet, we ran to the fire, i.e. to Musailima al-Kadhdhab
hi: Abu Raja Al-Utaridi bataate hain: Hum partharon ki ibadat karte the, aur jab humein pahle wale se behtar koee pathar milta, hum pahle wale ko phenkkar naya wala le lete, magar agar humein koee pathar na milta, phir hum kuch mitti jama karte aur phir ek bhed laate aur us mitti par uska doodh dohte, aur uska Tawaf karte. Jab Rajab ka mahina aata, hum (sainy karrvaee rokne ka) riwaj karte the, is mahine ko "lohe hatane wala" kahte hue, kyunke hum Rajab mahine mein har bhaale aur teer ke lohe ke hisson ko hatakar phenk dete the. Abu Raja ne joda: Jab Nabi ko (Allah ke) paighaam ke saath bheja gaya, main ek jawan ladka tha jo apne pariwara ke unton ka charwaha tha. Jab humein Nabi ke prakat hone ki khabar mili, hum aag ki taraf daude, yaani Musailima al-Kadhdhab ki taraf.

e: Narrated Ubaidullah bin `Abdullah bin `Utba:We were informed that Musailima Al-Kadhdhab had arrived in Medina and stayed in the house of the daughter of Al-Harith. The daughter of Al-Harith bin Kuraiz was his wife and she was the mother of `Abdullah bin 'Amir. There came to him Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) accompanied by Thabit bin Qais bin Shammas who was called the orator of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had a stick in his hand then. The Prophet (ﷺ) stopped before Musailima and spoke to him. Musailima said to him, "If you wish, we would not interfere between you and the rule, on condition that the rule will be ours after you... The Prophet said, "If you asked me for this stick, I would not give it to you. I think you are the same person who was shown to me in a dream. And this is Thabit bin Al-Qais who will answer you on my behalf." The Prophet (ﷺ) then went away. I asked Ibn `Abbas about the dream Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had mentioned. Ibn `Abbas said, "Someone told me that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When I was sleeping, I saw in a dream that two gold bangles were put in my hands, and that frightened me and made me dislike them. Then I was allowed to blow on them, and when I blew at them, both of them flew. Then I interpreted them as two liars who would appear.' One of them was Al-`Ansi who was killed by Fairuz in Yemen and the other was Musailima Al-Kadhdhab
hi: Ubaidullah bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Utba bataate hain: Humein bataya gaya ke Musailima Al-Kadhdhab Madina aaya tha aur Al-Harith ki beti ke ghar mein ruka tha. Al-Harith bin Kuraiz ki beti unki biwi thi aur woh Abdullah bin Amir ki maa thi. Allah ke Rasool unke paas aaye Thabit bin Qais bin Shammas ki sohbat mein jinhe Allah ke Rasool ka vakta kaha jata tha. Allah ke Rasool ke haath mein us waqt ek laathi thi. Nabi Musailima ke saamne ruke aur unse baat ki. Musailima ne unse kaha, "Agar aap chahen, hum aapke aur hukumat ke beech dakhal nahi denge, is shart par ke hukumat aapke baad humari hoga." Nabi ne kaha, "Agar tum mujhse yeh laathi maangte, main tumhe ise nahi dunga. Mujhe lagta hai tum wahi shaks ho jo mujhe khwab mein dikhaye gaye the. Aur yeh Thabit bin Al-Qais hain jo mere taraf se tumhe jawab denge." Phir Nabi chale gaye. Maine Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se us khwab ke baare mein pucha jiska Allah ke Rasool ne zikar kiya tha. Ibn Abbas ne kaha, "Kisi ne mujhe bataya ke Nabi ne kaha, 'Jabke main so raha tha, maine ek khwab mein dekha ke mere haathon mein sone ki do chudiyaan rakhi gaee thi, aur isne mujhe daraya aur napasand kiya. Phir mujhe unpar phoonkne ki ijazat mili, aur jab maine unpar phoonka, donon uda gaee. Phir maine unhe do jhooton ka pratik maana jo prakat honge.' Unmein se ek Al-Ansi the jinhe Yemen mein Fairuz ne qatl kiya tha, aur doosre Musailima Al-Kadhdhab the."

e: Narrated Hudhaifa:Al-`Aqib and Saiyid, the rulers of Najran, came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with the intention of doing Lian one of them said to the other, "Do not do (this Lian) for, by Allah, if he is a Prophet and we do this Lian, neither we, nor our offspring after us will be successful." Then both of them said (to the Prophet (ﷺ) ), "We will give what you should ask but you should send a trustworthy man with us, and do not send any person with us but an honest one." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I will send an honest man who Is really trustworthy." Then every one of the companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) wished to be that one. Then the Prophet said, "Get up, O Abu 'Ubaida bin Al-Jarrah." When he got up, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "This is the Trustworthy man of this (Muslim) nation
hi: Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Al-Aqib aur Saiyid, Najran ke shaasak, Allah ke Rasool ke paas Lian karne ke irade se aaye. Unmein se ek ne doosre se kaha, "Yeh mat karo (yaani Lian), kyunke, Allah ki qasam, agar woh ek Nabi hain aur hum yeh Lian karte hain, na hum na humare baad ki santanen kaamyaab honge." Phir donon ne (Nabi se) kaha, "Hum woh denge jo aap maangenge, magar aapko humare saath ek bharosemand shaks bhejna chahiye, aur kisi ko humare saath mat bhejiye siwaye ek imandaar shaks ke." Nabi ne kaha, "Main ek imandaar shaks bhejunga jo sach mein bharosemand hai." Phir Allah ke Rasool ke har ek sathi ki khushi thi ki woh hi wahi shaks hon. Nabi ne phir kaha, "Utho, Aye Abu Ubaida bin Al-Jarrah." Jab woh uthe, Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Yeh is (Musalman) ummat ke bharosemand shaks hain."

e: Narrated Hudhaifa:The people of Najran came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "Send an honest man to us." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I will send to you an honest man who is really trustworthy." Everyone of the (Muslim) people hoped to be that one. The Prophet (ﷺ) then sent Abu Ubaida bin Al-Jarrah
hi: Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Najran ke log Nabi ke paas aaye aur kaha, "Humare paas ek imandaar shaks bhejiye." Nabi ne kaha, "Main tumhare paas ek imandaar shaks bhejunga jo sach mein bharosemand hai." Har koee (Musalman) chahta tha ke woh hi woh shaks bane. Nabi ne phir Abu Ubaida bin Al-Jarrah ko bheja.

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Every nation has an Amin (i.e. the most honest man), and the Amin of this nation is Abu 'Ubaida bin Al-Jarrah
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Har ummat ka ek Amin (yaani sabse imandaar shaks) hota hai, aur is ummat ka Amin Abu Ubaida bin Al-Jarrah hain."

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me, "If the revenue of Al-Bahrain should come, I will give you so much and so much," repeating "so much" thrice. But the revenue of Al-Bahrain did not come till Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had died. When the revenue came during the rule of Abu Bakr. Abu Bakr ordered an announcer to announce, "Whoever had any debt or promise due upon the Prophet, should present himself to me (i.e. Abu Bakr). I came to Abu Bakr and informed him that the Prophet (ﷺ) had said (to me), "If the revenue of Al-Bahrain should come, I will give you so-much and so much," repeating "so much" thrice. So Abu Bakr gave me. (In another narration Jabir said:) I met Abu Bakr after that and asked him (to give me what the Prophet (ﷺ) had promised me) but he did not give me. I again went to him but he did not give me. I again went to him (for the third time) but he did not give me, On that I said to him, "I came to you but you did not give me, then I came to you and you did not give me, and then again I came to you, but you did not give me; so you should either give me or else you are like a miserly to me. On that, Abu Bakr said, "Do you say, 'You are like a miserly to me?' There is no worse disease than miserliness." Abu Bakr said it thrice and added, "Whenever I refused to give you, I had the intention of giving you." (In another narration) Jabir bin `Abdullah said, "I went to Abu Bakr (and he gave me a handful of money) and told me to count it, I counted and found it five-hundred, and then Abu Bakr said (to me), "Take the same amount twice
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne mujhse kaha, "Agar Al-Bahrain se rajaswa aaya, main tumhe itna aur itna dunga," "itna" teen baar doharate hue. Magar Al-Bahrain ka rajaswa Nabi ki maut se pahle nahi aaya. Jab woh rajaswa Abu Bakr ke shaasan mein aaya, Abu Bakr ne ek elaan karne wale ko elaan karne ka hukum diya, "Jiske bhi paas Nabi ke saath koee qarza ya waada baaki hai, unke paas (yaani mere paas) aaye." Main Abu Bakr ke paas gaya aur unhe bataya ke Nabi ne (mujhse) kaha tha, "Agar Al-Bahrain se rajaswa aae, main tumhe itna aur itna dunga," "itna" teen baar doharate hue. Isliye Abu Bakr ne mujhe diya. (Ek doosri riwaayat mein Jabir ne kaha:) Baad mein main Abu Bakr se mila aur unse (yeh) maanga (jo Nabi ne mujhse waada kiya tha) magar unhone mujhe nahi diya. Main phir unke paas gaya magar unhone mujhe nahi diya. Main phir unke paas gaya (teesri baar) magar unhone mujhe nahi diya. Ispar maine unse kaha, "Main aapke paas aaya magar aapne mujhe nahi diya, phir main aapke paas aaya aur aapne mujhe nahi diya, aur phir main phir aapke paas aaya, magar aapne mujhe nahi diya; isliye aapko ya to mujhe dena chahiye ya phir aap mere liye kanjoos jaise hain." Ispar, Abu Bakr ne kaha, "Kya aap kah rahe hain, 'Aap mere liye kanjoos jaise hain'? Kanjoosi se badtar koee bimari nahi hai." Abu Bakr ne yeh teen baar kaha aur joda, "Jab bhi maine aapko dene se inkaar kiya, mera irada aapko dene ka tha." (Ek doosri riwaayat mein) Jabir bin Abdullah ne kaha, "Main Abu Bakr ke paas gaya (aur unhone mujhe paise ki ek mutthi di) aur mujhe use ginne ko kaha. Maine gina aur paanch sau (500) paye, aur phir Abu Bakr ne (mujhse) kaha, 'Yehi matra do baar le lo.'"

e: Narrated Abu Musa:My brother and I came from Yemen (to Medina) and remained for some time, thinking that Ibn Masud and his mother belonged to the family of the Prophet (ﷺ) because of their frequent entrance (upon the Prophet) and their being attached to him
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Mera bhai aur main Yemen se (Madina) aaye aur kuch waqt tak rahte rahe, yeh sochte huye ke Ibn Masud aur unki maa Nabi ke pariwara mein se the unke baar-baar (Nabi ke paas) aane aur unse jude hue hone ki wajah se.

e: Narrated Zahdam:When Abu Musa arrived (at Kufa as a governor) he honored this family of Jarm (by paying them a visit). I was sitting near to him, and he was eating chicken as his lunch, and there was a man sitting amongst the people. Abu Musa invited the man to the lunch, but the latter said, "I saw chickens (eating something (dirty) so I consider them unclean." Abu Musa said, "Come on! I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) eating it (i.e. chicken)." The man said "I have taken an oath that I will not eat (chicken)" Abu Musa said, "Come on! I will tell you about your oath. We, a group of Al-Ash`ariyin people went to the Prophet and asked him to give us something to ride, but the Prophet (ﷺ) refused. Then we asked him for the second time to give us something to ride, but the Prophet (ﷺ) took an oath that he would not give us anything to ride. After a while, some camels of booty were brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he ordered that five camels be given to us.
