When we took those camels we said, "We have made the Prophet (ﷺ) forget his oath, and we will not be successful after that." So I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Apostle ! You took an oath that you would not give us anything to ride, but you have given us." He said, "Yes, for if I take an oath and later I see a better solution than that, I act on the later (and gave the expiation of that oath)
hi: Zahdam bataate hain: Jab Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) (Kufa ke gawarnar ke tor par) pahunche, unhone Jarm qabile ki is pariwara ki izzat ki (unse milne jate huye). Main unke qareeb baitha tha, aur woh apne dopahar ke khaane mein murgi khaa rahe the, aur ek shaks logon ke beech baitha tha. Abu Musa ne us shaks ko khaane ke liye bulaya, magar usne kaha, "Maine murgiyon ko (kuch ganda) khate hue dekha hai isliye main unhe apavitra maanta hoon." Abu Musa ne kaha, "Aiye! Maine Nabi ko ise khate dekha tha (yaani murgi ko)." Us shaks ne kaha, "Maine qasam khaee hai ke main (murgi) nahi khaunga." Abu Musa ne kaha, "Aiye! Main aapko aapki qasam ke baare mein batataa hoon. Hum, Al-Ashariyin logon ka ek giroh, Nabi ke paas gaye aur unse humein sawar karne ke liye kuch maanga, magar Nabi ne inkaar kiya. Phir humne unse doosri baar mangaa sawar karne ke liye kuch dene ko, magar Nabi ne qasam khaee ke woh humein sawar karne ke liye kuch nahi denge. Kuch der baad, kuch maal-e-ghanimat ke unt Nabi ke paas laaye gaye aur unhone hukum diya ke paanch unt humein diye jaen. Jab humne un unton ko liya, humne kaha, 'Humne Nabi ko unki qasam bhula di hai, aur is baat ke baad hum kaamyaab nahi honge.' Isliye main Nabi ke paas gaya aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Aapne qasam khaee thi ke aap humein sawar karne ke liye kuch nahi denge, magar aapne humein diya.' Unhone kaha, 'Haan, kyunke agar main qasam khata hoon aur baad mein isse behtar koee hal dekhta hoon, main baad wale par amal karta hoon (aur us qasam ka kaffara deta hoon).'"

e: Narrated `Imran bin Husain:The people of Banu Tamim came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and he said, "Be glad (i.e. have good tidings). O Banu Tamim!" They said, "As you have given us good tidings then give us (some material things)." On that the features of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) changed (i.e. he took it ill). Then some people from Yemen came, and the Prophet (ﷺ) said (to them) "Accept good tidings as Banu Tamim have not accepted them." They said, "We accept them, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
hi: Imran bin Husain (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Banu Tamim ke log Allah ke Rasool ke paas aaye, aur unhone kaha, "Khush ho jao (yaani achhi khabar qubool karo). Aye Banu Tamim!" Unhone kaha, "Jabse aapne humein achhi khabar di hai phir humein (kuch material cheezen) dijiye." Ispar Allah ke Rasool ki bhaav-bhangima badal gaee (yaani unhe yeh baat buri lagi). Phir Yemen se kuch log aaye, aur Nabi ne (unse) kaha "Achhi khabar qubool karo kyunke Banu Tamim ne ise qubool nahi kiya hai." Unhone kaha, "Hum ise qubool karte hain, Aye Allah ke Rasool!"

e: Narrated Abu Masud:The Prophet (ﷺ) beckoned with his hand towards Yemen and said, "Belief is there." The harshness and mercilessness are the qualities of those farmers etc, who are busy with their camels and pay no attention to the religion (is towards the east) from where the side of the head of Satan will appear; those are the tribes of Rabi`a and Mudar
hi: Abu Masud bataate hain: Nabi ne apne haath se Yemen ki taraf ishara kiya aur kaha, "Iman wahaan hai." Sakhtaee aur nirdayta un kisanon aadi ki khasiyat hain jo apne unton mein vyast rahte hain aur deen par dhyaan nahi dete (yaani purab ki taraf) jahaan se Shaitan ke sar ka pahlu prakat hoga; woh Rabi'a aur Mudar qabile hain.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The people of Yemen have come to you and they are more gentle and soft-hearted. Belief is Yemenite and Wisdom is Yemenite, while pride and haughtiness are the qualities of the owners of camels (i.e. bedouins). Calmness and solemnity are the characters of the owners of sheep
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Yemen ke log tumhare paas aaye hain aur woh zyada narm aur narm-dil hain. Iman Yemeni hai aur ilm Yemeni hai, jabke ghamand aur akadan unton ke maalikon (yaani dehati logon) ki khasiyat hai. Shaanti aur sanginta bhedon ke maalikon ki khasiyat hai."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Belief is Yemenite while afflictions appear from there (the east) from where the side of the head of Satan will appear
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Iman Yemeni hai jabke aazmaishen wahaan (yaani purab) se prakat hoti hain jahaan se Shaitan ke sar ka pahlu prakat hoga."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The people of Yemen have come to you, and they are more soft hearted and gentle hearted people. The capacity for understanding religion is Yemenite and Wisdom is Yemenite
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Yemen ke log tumhare paas aaye hain, aur woh zyada narm-dil aur narm log hain. Deen ki samajh ki kshamata Yemeni hai aur ilm Yemeni hai."

e: Narrated Alqama:We were sitting with Ibn Masud when Khabbab came and said, "O Abu `Abdur-Rahman! Can these young fellows recite Qur'an as you do?" Ibn Mas`ud said, "If you wish I can order one of them to recite (Qur'an) for you ." Khabbab replied, "Yes. "Ibn Mas`ud said, "Recite, O 'Alqama!" On that, Zaid bin Hudair, the brother of Ziyad bin Hudair said, (to Ibn Mas`ud), "Why have you ordered 'Alqama to recite though he does not recite better than we?" Ibn Mas`ud said, "If you like, I would tell you what the Prophet (ﷺ) said about your nation and his (i.e. 'Alqama's) nation." So I recited fifty Verses from Sura-Maryam. `Abdullah (bin Mas`ud) said to Khabbab, "What do you think (about 'Alqama's recitation)?" Khabbab said, "He has recited well." `Abdullah said, "Whatever I recite, 'Alqama recites." Then `Abdullah turned towards Khabbab and saw that he was wearing a gold ring, whereupon he said, "Hasn't the time for its throwing away come yet?" Khabbab said, "You will not see me wearing it after today," and he threw it away
hi: Alqama bataate hain: Hum Ibn Masud ke saath baithe the jab Khabbab (رضی اللہ عنہ) aaye aur kaha, "Aye Abu Abdur-Rahman! Kya yeh jawan log Quran padh sakte hain jaise aap padhte hain?" Ibn Masud ne kaha, "Agar aap chahte hain, main unmein se ek ko aapke liye padhne ka hukum de sakta hoon." Khabbab ne jawab diya, "Haan." Ibn Masud ne kaha, "Padho, Aye Alqama!" Ispar, Zaid bin Hudair, Ziyad bin Hudair ke bhai, ne (Ibn Masud se) kaha, "Aapne Alqama ko padhne ka hukum kyun diya jabke woh humein behtar nahi padhte?" Ibn Masud ne kaha, "Agar aapko achha lage, main aapko bataunga Nabi ne aapki qaum aur unki (yaani Alqama ki) qaum ke baare mein kya kaha tha." Isliye maine Surah Maryam se pachas (50) Ayaten padhi. Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) (bin Masud) ne Khabbab se kaha, "Aapki kya raay hai (Alqama ki tilaawat ke baare mein)?" Khabbab ne kaha, "Unhone achha padha hai." Abdullah ne kaha, "Jo bhi main padhta hoon, Alqama bhi padhta hai." Phir Abdullah Khabbab ki taraf mude aur dekha ke unhone sone ki ek angoothi pahni huee thi, ispar unhone kaha, "Kya ise phenkne ka waqt nahi aaya hai?" Khabbab ne kaha, "Aap mujhe aaj ke baad ise pahne huye nahi dekhenge," aur unhone ise phenk diya.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Tufail bin `Amr came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "The Daus (nation) have perished as they disobeyed and refused to accept Islam. So invoke Allah against them." But the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! Give guidance to the Daus (tribe) and bring them (to Islam)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Tufail bin Amr Nabi ke paas aaye aur kaha, "Daus (qabile) khatm ho chuki hai kyunke unhone na-farmani ki aur Islam qubool karne se inkaar kiya. Isliye unke khilaf bad-dua kariye." Magar Nabi ne kaha, "Aye Allah! Daus (qabile) ko hidaayat de aur unhe (Islam ki taraf) le aa."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:When I came to the Prophet (ﷺ), I said on my way, "O what a long tedious tiresome night; nevertheless, it has rescued me from the place of Heathenism." A slave of mine ran away on the way. When I reached the Prophet (ﷺ) I gave him the oath of allegiance (for Islam), and while I was sitting with him, suddenly the slave appeared. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to me. "O Abu Huraira! Here is your slave," I said, "He (i.e. the slave) is (free) for Allah's Sake," and manumitted him
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab main Nabi ke paas aaya, main raste mein kaha, "Aye kitni lambi, thaka dene wali raat; phir bhi, isne mujhe jahiliyat ki jagah se bacha liya." Mera ek gulaam raste mein bhaag gaya. Jab main Nabi tak pahuncha, maine unhe Bai'at di (Islam ke liye), aur jabke main unke saath baitha tha, achanak gulaam prakat hua. Nabi ne mujhse kaha, "Aye Abu Huraira! Yeh raha tumhara gulaam," Maine kaha, "Woh (yaani gulaam) Allah ki khaatir (azad) hai," aur maine unhe azad kar diya.

e: Narrated `Adi bin Hatim:We came to `Umar in a delegation (during his rule). He started calling the men one by one, calling each by his name. (As he did not call me early) I said to him. "Don't you know me, O chief of the Believers?" He said, "Yes, you embraced Islam when they (i.e. your people) disbelieved; you have come (to the Truth) when they ran away; you fulfilled your promises when they broke theirs; and you recognized it (i.e. the Truth of Islam) when they denied it." On that, `Adi said, "I therefore don't care
hi: Adi bin Hatim (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum ek pratinidhimandal mein Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas aaye (unki shaasan avadhi ke dauran). Unhone ek-ek karke logon ko unke naam se bulana shuru kiya. (Chunke unhone mujhe jaldi nahi bulaya) maine unse kaha, "Kya aap mujhe nahi jaante, Aye Mominon ke Ameer?" Unhone kaha, "Haan, aapne Islam qubool kiya jabke woh (yaani aapki qaum) kaafir thi; aap (Sach ki taraf) aaye jabke woh bhaag gaye; aapne apne waade poore kiye jabke unhone unke waade tode; aur aapne ise (yaani Islam ki sachaee) pahchana jabke unhone ise nakaar diya." Ispar, Adi ne kaha, "Isliye mujhe (aapke deri se bulaane ki) parwaah nahi hai."

e: Narrated `Aisha:We went out with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) during Hajjat-ul-Wada` and we assumed the Ihram for `Umra. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to us, "Whoever has got the Hadi should assume the Ihram for Hajj and `Umra and should not finish his Ihram till he has performed both (`Umra and Hajj)." I arrived at Mecca along with him (i.e. the Prophet (ﷺ) ) while I was menstruating, so I did not perform the Tawaf around the Ka`ba or between Safa and Marwa. I informed Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about that and he said, "Undo your braids and comb your hair, and then assume the Ihram for Hajj and leave the `Umra." I did so, and when we performed and finished the Hajj, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent me to at-Tan`im along with (my brother) `Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Bakr As-Siddiq, to perform the `Umra. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "This `Umra is in lieu of your missed `Umra." Those who had assumed the Ihram for `Umra, performed the Tawaf around the Ka`ba and between Safa and Marwa, and then finished their Ihram, and on their return from Mina, they performed another Tawaf (around the Ka`ba and between Safa and Marwa), but those who combined their Hajj and `Umra, performed only one Tawaf (between Safa and Marwa) (for both)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Hum Allah ke Rasool ke saath Hajjat-ul-Wada ke dauran nikle aur Umrah ke liye Ihram dhaaran kiya. Phir Allah ke Rasool ne humse kaha, "Jiske paas Hadi hai use Hajj aur Umrah donon ke liye Ihram dhaaran karna chahiye aur apna Ihram tab tak khatm nahi karna chahiye jab tak woh donon (Umrah aur Hajj) poore na kar len." Main Mecca unke (yaani Nabi ke) saath pahunchi jabke main maasik dhaarav mein thi, isliye maine Ka'ba ka Tawaf ya Safa aur Marwa ke beech (Sai) nahi kiya. Maine Allah ke Rasool ko iske baare mein bataya aur unhone kaha, "Apni chotiyaan kholiye aur apne baal sanvariye, aur phir Hajj ke liye Ihram dhaaran kariye aur Umrah chhod dijiye." Maine waisa hi kiya, aur jab humne Hajj poora kar liya, Allah ke Rasool ne mujhe At-Tan'im bheja Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (mere bhai) ke saath, Umrah karne ke liye. Nabi ne kaha, "Yeh Umrah aapke chhut gaye Umrah ke badle mein hai." Jinhone Umrah ke liye Ihram dhaaran kiya tha, unhone Ka'ba ka Tawaf aur Safa aur Marwa ke beech (Sai) kiya, aur phir apna Ihram khatm kiya, aur Mina se wapas aane par, unhone ek aur Tawaf kiya (Ka'ba ke gird aur Safa aur Marwa ke beech), magar jinhone apna Hajj aur Umrah ek saath kiya tha, unhone sirf ek hi Tawaf (Safa aur Marwa ke beech) kiya (donon ke liye).

e: Narrated Ibn Juraij:`Ata' said, "Ibn `Abbas said, 'If he (i.e. the one intending to perform `Umra) has performed the Tawaf around the Ka`ba, his Ihram is considered to have finished.' I said, 'What proof does Ibn `Abbas has as to this saying?" `Ata' said, "(The proof is taken) from the Statement of Allah:-- "And afterwards they are brought For sacrifice unto Ancient House (Ka`ba at Mecca)" (22.33) and from the order of the Prophet to his companions to finish their Ihram during Hajjat-ul-Wada`." I said (to `Ata'), "That (i.e. finishing the Ihram) was after coming from `Arafat." `Ata' said, "Ibn `Abbas used to allow it before going to `Arafat (after finishing the `Umra) and after coming from it (i.e. after performing the Hajj)
hi: Ibn Juraij bataate hain: Ata ne kaha, "Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Agar unhone (yaani Umrah karne wale ne) Ka'ba ka Tawaf kar liya hai, unka Ihram khatm maana jaayega.' Maine kaha, 'Ibn Abbas ke paas is baat ka kya saboot hai?'" Ata ne kaha, "(Saboot liya gaya hai) Allah ke is farmaan se: 'Aur baad mein unhe qurbani ke liye Purane Ghar (yaani Ka'ba, Mecca mein) laaya jata hai' (22:33) aur Nabi ke apne sahaba ko Hajjat-ul-Wada ke dauran apna Ihram khatm karne ka hukum dene se." Maine (Ata se) kaha, "Yeh (yaani Ihram khatm karna) Arafat se aane ke baad tha." Ata ne kaha, "Ibn Abbas iski ijazat dete the Arafat jane se pahle bhi (Umrah poora karne ke baad) aur wahaan se aane ke baad bhi (yaani Hajj poora karne ke baad)."

e: Narrated Abu Musa Al-Ash`ari:I came to the Prophet (ﷺ) at a place called Al-Batha'. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Did you assume the Ihram for Hajj?" I said, "Yes," He said, "How did you express your intention (for performing Hajj)? " I said, "Labbaik (i.e. I am ready) to assume the Ihram with the same intention as that of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." The Prophet said, "Perform the Tawaf around the Ka`ba and between Safa and Marwa, and then finish your Ihram." So I performed the Tawaf around the Ka`ba and between Safa and Marwa and then I came to a woman from the tribe of Qais who removed the lice from my head
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ash'ari bataate hain: Main Nabi ke paas Al-Batha naam ki jagah par aaya. Nabi ne pucha, "Kya aapne Hajj ke liye Ihram dhaaran kiya hai?" Maine kaha, "Haan," Unhone kaha, "Aapne apni niyyat kaise zaahir ki (Hajj karne ke liye)?" Maine kaha, "Labbaik (yaani main taiyaar hoon) Ihram dhaaran karne ke liye Allah ke Rasool jaisi hi niyyat se." Nabi ne kaha, "Ka'ba ke gird Tawaf aur Safa aur Marwa ke beech (Sai) kariye, aur phir apna Ihram khatm kariye." Isliye maine Ka'ba ke gird aur Safa aur Marwa ke beech Tawaf kiya aur phir main Qais qabile ki ek aurat ke paas gaya jinhone mere sar se joonen nikali.

e: Narrated Hafsa:(the wife of the Prophet) The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered all his wives to finish their Ihram during the year of Hajjat-ul-Wada`. On that, I asked the Prophet (ﷺ) "What stops you from finishing your Ihram?" He said, "I have matted my hair and garlanded my Hadi. So I will not finish my Ihram unless I have slaughtered my Hadi
hi: Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain (Nabi ki biwi): Nabi ne apni sab biviyon ko Hajjat-ul-Wada ke saal apna Ihram khatm karne ka hukum diya. Ispar, maine Nabi se pucha, "Aapko apna Ihram khatm karne se kya roka raha hai?" Unhone kaha, "Maine apni jaten laee hain aur apni Hadi ko malaen pahnaee hai. Isliye main apna Ihram tab tak khatm nahi karunga jab tak main apni Hadi zabah nahi kar leta."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:A woman from the tribe of Khath'am asked for the verdict of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (regarding something) during Hajjat-ul-Wada` while Al-Fadl bin `Abbas was the companion-rider behind Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). She asked, "Allah's ordained obligation (i.e. compulsory Hajj) enjoined on His slaves has become due on my old father who cannot sit firmly on the riding animal. Will it be sufficient if I perform the Hajj on his behalf?" He said, "Yes
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Khath'am qabile ki ek aurat ne Allah ke Rasool se ek deeni faisla pucha Hajjat-ul-Wada ke dauran jabke Al-Fadl bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) Allah ke Rasool ke saath (unki untni par) peeche baithe the. Usne pucha, "Allah dwaara apne bandon par farz kiya gaya farz (yaani Hajj) mere boodhe waalid par farz ho gaya hai, jo sawari ke janwar par sthir baith nahi sakte. Kya yeh kaafi hoga agar main unki taraf se Hajj karun?" Unhone kaha, "Haan."

e: Narrated (Abdullah) bin `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) arrived (at Mecca) in the year of the Conquest (of Mecca) while Usama was riding behind him on (his she-camel)'. Al-Qaswa.' Bilal and `Uthman bin Talha were accompanying him. When he made his she-camel kneel down near the Ka`ba, he said to `Uthman, "Get us the key (of the Ka`ba). He brought the key to him and opened the gate (of the Ka`ba), for him. The Prophet, Usama, Bilal and `Uthman (bin Talha) entered the Ka`ba and then closed the gate behind them (from inside). The Prophet (ﷺ) stayed there for a long period and then came out. The people rushed to get in, but I went in before them and found Bilal standing behind the gate, and I said to him, "Where did the Prophet (ﷺ) pray?" He said, "He prayed between those two front pillars." The Ka`ba was built on six pillars, arranged in two rows, and he prayed between the two pillars of the front row leaving the gate of the Ka`ba at his back and facing (in prayer) the wall which faces one when one enters the Ka`ba. Between him and that wall (was the distance of about three cubits). But I forgot to ask Bilal about the number of rak`at the Prophet (ﷺ) had prayed. There was a red piece of marble at the place where he (i.e. the Prophet) had offered the prayer
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (Mecca) pahunche Fatah ke saal jabke Usama unke peeche (unki untni) Al-Qaswa par baithe the. Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) unke saath the. Jab unhone apni untni Ka'ba ke qareeb bithaee, unhone Uthman se kaha, "Humein chaabi lao (yaani Ka'ba ki)." Woh unke liye chaabi laye aur unke liye (Ka'ba ka) darwaza khola. Nabi, Usama, Bilal, aur Uthman (bin Talha) Ka'ba mein daakhil hue aur phir unke peeche darwaza band kar diya (andar se). Nabi wahaan lambe waqt tak ruke aur phir bahar aaye. Log andar jane ke liye daude, magar main unse pahle andar gaya aur Bilal ko darwaze ke peeche khada paaya, aur maine unse pucha, "Nabi ne kahaan namaz padhi?" Unhone kaha, "Unhonne un do saamne wale khambon ke beech namaz padhi." Ka'ba chhah khambon par bana tha, do panktiyon mein vyavasthit, aur unhone saamne wali paankti ke do khambon ke beech namaz padhi, Ka'ba ka darwaza apni peeth ke peeche chhodkar aur us deewaar ki taraf munh karke (namaz mein) jo insaan ke Ka'ba mein pravesh karte waqt saamne aati hai. Unke aur us deewaar ke beech (taquriban teen haath ki doori thi). Magar main Bilal se poochhna bhool gaya ke Nabi ne kitni rakaten padhi thi. Us jagah par jahaan unhone (yaani Nabi ne) namaz padhi thi, ek laal sangmarmar (marble) ka tukda tha.

e: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) Safiya bint Huyai, the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ) menstruated during Hajjat-ul- Wada` The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Is she going to detain us?" I said to him, "She has already come to Mecca and performed the Tawaf (ul-ifada) around the Ka`ba, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, " Let her then proceed on (to Medina)
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain (Nabi ki biwi): Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Huyai, Nabi ki biwi, ko Hajjat-ul-Wada ke dauran maasik dhaarav aee. Nabi ne kaha, "Kya woh humein rokegi?" Maine unse kaha, "Woh pahle hi Mecca aa chuki hain aur Ka'ba ka Tawaf (yaani Tawaf-ul-Ifada) kar chuki hain, Aye Allah ke Rasool!" Nabi ne kaha, "Phir unhe (Madina ki taraf) badhne dijiye."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:We were talking about Hajjat-ul-Wada`, while the Prophet (ﷺ) was amongst us. We did not know what Hajjat-ul-Wada` signified. The Prophet (ﷺ) praised Allah and then mentioned Al-Masih Ad-Dajjal and described him extensively, saying, "Allah did not send any prophet but that prophet warned his nation of Al-Masih Ad-Dajjal. Noah and the prophets following him warned (their people) of him. He will appear amongst you (O Muhammad's followers), and if it happens that some of his qualities may be hidden from you, but your Lord's State is clear to you and not hidden from you. The Prophet (ﷺ) said it thrice. Verily, your Lord is not blind in one eye, while he (i.e. Ad-Dajjal) is blind in the right eye which looks like a grape bulging out (of its cluster). No doubt,! Allah has made your blood and your properties sacred to one another like the sanctity of this day of yours, in this town of yours, in this month of yours." The Prophet (ﷺ) added: No doubt! Haven't I conveyed Allah's Message to you? " They replied, "Yes," The Prophet (ﷺ) said thrice, "O Allah! Be witness for it." The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "Woe to you!" (or said), "May Allah be merciful to you! Do not become infidels after me (i.e. my death) by cutting the necks (throats) of one another
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Hajjat-ul-Wada ke baare mein baat kar rahe the, jabke Nabi humare beech maujood the. Humein nahi pata tha Hajjat-ul-Wada ka kya matlab tha. Nabi ne Allah ki taarif ki aur phir Al-Masih Ad-Dajjal ka zikar kiya aur unka vistrit varnan diya, kehte huye, "Allah ne koee bhi Nabi nahi bheja siwaye iske ke woh Nabi apni qaum ko Al-Masih Ad-Dajjal ke baare mein chetaavni dete. Nuh aur unke baad ke Nabiyon ne unke khilaf chetaavni di. Woh tumhare beech prakat hoga (Aye Muhammad ke pairokaro), aur agar aisa hota hai ke unke kuch gun tumse chhipe rah jaen, magar tumhare Rab ki haalat tumhe saaf hai aur chhipi huee nahi hai." Nabi ne yeh teen baar kaha. "Yaqinan, tumhara Rab ek aankh se andha nahi hai, jabke woh (yaani Ad-Dajjal) apni dahini aankh se andha hai jo angoor ke ek guchhe se nikle angoor jaisi dikhti hai. Koee shak nahi! Allah ne tumhare khoon aur tumhari maal ko ek-doosre ke liye pavitra banaya hai jaise is din ki, is shehar mein, is mahine mein pavitrata hai." Nabi ne joda: "Koee shak nahi! Kya maine Allah ka paighaam tumtak pahuncha nahi diya?" Unhone jawab diya, "Haan," Nabi ne teen baar kaha, "Aye Allah! Iske gawah raho." Nabi ne joda, "Tumpar afsos ho!" (ya kaha), "Allah tumpar reham kare! Mere baad kaafir mat ban jana, ek-doosre ki gala (gala) kaatte hue."

e: Narrated Zaid bin Arqam:The Prophet (ﷺ) fought nineteen Ghazwas and performed only one Hajj after he migrated (to Medina), and did not perform another Hajj after it, and that was Hajj-ul-Wada`,' Abu 'Is-haq said, "He performed when he was in Mecca
hi: Zaid bin Arqam (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne unnees Ghazwaten ladi aur apni hijrat (Madina) ke baad sirf ek hi Hajj kiya, aur uske baad koee aur Hajj nahi kiya, aur woh Hajj-ul-Wada tha. Abu Ishaq ne kaha, "Unhone (Hajj) unhone (baad mein) Mecca mein bhi kiya."

e: Narrated Jarir:The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered me during Hajjatul-Wada`. "Ask the people to listen." He then said, "Do not become infidels after me by cutting the necks (throats) of one another
hi: Jarir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne mujhe Hajjat-ul-Wada ke dauran hukum diya, "Logon ko sunne ko kaho." Unhone phir kaha, "Mere baad kaafir mat ban jana, ek-doosre ki gala kaatte hue."

e: Narrated Abu Bakra:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Time has taken its original shape which it had when Allah created the Heavens and the Earth. The year is of twelve months, four of which are sacred, and out of these (four) three are in succession, i.e. Dhul-Qa'da, Dhul-Hijja and Al-Muharram, and the fourth is Rajab which is named after the Mudar tribe, between (the month of) Jumaida (ath-thania) and Sha'ban." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "Which is this month?" We said, "Allah and His Apostle know better." On that the Prophet (ﷺ) kept quiet so long that we thought that he might name it with another name. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Isn't it the month of Dhul-Hijja?" We replied, "Yes." Then he said, "Which town is this?" "We replied, "Allah and His Apostle know better." On that he kept quiet so long that we thought that he might name it with another name. Then he said, "Isn't it the town of Mecca?" We replied, "Yes, " Then he said, "Which day is today?" We replied, "Allah and His Apostle know better." He kept quiet so long that we thought that he might name it with another name. Then he said, "Isn't it the day of An- Nahr (i.e. sacrifice)?" We replied, "Yes." He said, "So your blood, your properties, (The sub-narrator Muhammad said, 'I think the Prophet (ﷺ) also said: And your honor..) are sacred to one another like the sanctity of this day of yours, in this city of yours, in this month of yours; and surely, you will meet your Lord, and He will ask you about your deeds. Beware! Do not become infidels after me, cutting the throats of one another. It is incumbent on those who are present to convey this message (of mine) to those who are absent. May be that some of those to whom it will be conveyed will understand it better than those who have actually heard it." (The sub-narrator, Muhammad, on remembering that narration, used to say, "Muhammad spoke the truth!") He (i.e. Prophet) then added twice, "No doubt! Haven't I conveyed (Allah's Message) to you?
hi: Abu Bakra (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Waqt phir apne asal soorat mein aa gaya hai jaisa usne Allah ke aasman aur zameen banane ke waqt tha. Saal baarah mahinon ka hota hai, jinmein se chaar pavitra hain, aur inmein se teen lagataar hote hain, yaani Dhul-Qa'da, Dhul-Hijja, aur Al-Muharram, aur chautha Rajab hai jiska naam Mudar qabile ke naam par rakha gaya hai, jo Jumaida (ath-thania) aur Sha'ban ke beech hai." Phir Nabi ne pucha, "Yeh kaunsa mahina hai?" Humne kaha, "Allah aur unke Rasool behtar jaante hain." Ispar Nabi khaamosh rahe itna der ke humne socha shaayad woh ise kisi aur naam se pukarenge. Phir Nabi ne kaha, "Kya yeh Dhul-Hijja ka mahina nahi hai?" Humne jawab diya, "Haan." Phir unhone kaha, "Yeh kaunsa sheher hai?" Humne jawab diya, "Allah aur unke Rasool behtar jaante hain." Ispar woh itna der khaamosh rahe ke humne socha shaayad woh ise kisi aur naam se pukarenge. Phir unhone kaha, "Kya yeh Mecca sheher nahi hai?" Humne jawab diya, "Haan." Phir unhone kaha, "Aaj kaunsa din hai?" Humne jawab diya, "Allah aur unke Rasool behtar jaante hain." Woh itna der khaamosh rahe ke humne socha shaayad woh ise kisi aur naam se pukarenge. Phir unhone kaha, "Kya yeh An-Nahr (yaani qurbani) ka din nahi hai?" Humne jawab diya, "Haan." Unhone kaha, "Isliye tumhara khoon, tumhari maal, (Subordinate raawi Muhammad ne kaha, 'Mujhe lagta hai Nabi ne yeh bhi kaha: Aur tumhari izzat,') ek-doosre ke liye pavitra hai jaise is din ki, is sheher mein, is mahine mein pavitrata hai; aur nishchit soorat se, tum apne Rab se miloge, aur woh tumse tumhare amalon ke baare mein puchega. Saavdhaan raho! Mere baad kaafir mat ban jana, ek-doosre ki gala kaatte hue. Yeh un logon ka farz hai jo maujood hain ke woh yeh paighaam (mera) un logon tak pahunchaen jo maujood nahi hain. Ho sakta hai jintak yeh pahunchaya jaayega unmein se kuch ise usse behtar samjhen jinhone khud ise suna hai." (Subordinate raawi, Muhammad, jab use yaad karte, kahte, "Muhammad ne sach kaha!") Unhone (yaani Nabi ne) phir do baar joda, "Koee shak nahi! Kya maine tumtak (Allah ka paighaam) pahuncha nahi diya?"

e: Narrated Tariq bin Shihab:Some Jews said, "Had this Verse been revealed to us, we would have taken that day as `Id (festival)." `Umar said, "What Verse?" They said:-- "This day I have Perfected your religion for you, Completed My Favor upon you And have chosen for you Islam as your religion" (5.3) `Umar said, "I know the place where it was revealed; It was revealed while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was staying at `Arafat
hi: Tariq bin Shihab bataate hain: Kuch Yahudiyon ne kaha, "Agar yeh Ayat humpar naazil huee hoti, humne us din ko Eid (yaani tyohaar) mana liya hota." Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Kaunsi Ayat?" Unhone kaha: "Aaj Maine tumhare liye tumhare deen ko poora kiya hai, tumpar Meri niyaamaten poori ki hain aur Islam ko tumhare liye deen ke tor par chuna hai." (5:3) Umar ne kaha, "Mujhe pata hai yeh kahaan naazil huee thi; yeh naazil huee thi jab Allah ke Rasool Arafat mein padaav liye hue the."

e: Narrated `Aisha:We set out with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and some of us assumed the Ihram for `Umra, some assumed it for Hajj, and some assumed it for both Hajj and `Umra. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) assumed the Ihram for Hajj. So those who had assumed the Ihram for Hajj or for both Hajj and `Umra, did not finish their Ihram till the day of An-Nahr (i.e. slaughter of sacrifices). Malik also narrated as above, saying, "(We set out) with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in Hajjat-ul-Wada`...)" This hadith also reaches us through another chain
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Hum Allah ke Rasool ke saath nikle, aur humme se kuch ne Umrah ke liye Ihram dhaaran kiya, kuch ne Hajj ke liye, aur kuch ne Hajj aur Umrah donon ke liye. Allah ke Rasool ne Hajj ke liye Ihram dhaaran kiya. Isliye jinhone Hajj ke liye ya Hajj aur Umrah donon ke liye Ihram dhaaran kiya tha, unhone An-Nahr (yaani qurbaniyon ki zabah) ke din tak apna Ihram khatm nahi kiya. Malik ne bhi upar jaisa hi riwaayat ki, kehte huye, "(Hum nikle) Allah ke Rasool ke saath Hajjat-ul-Wada mein...)" Yeh Hadith humtak ek doosri chain se bhi pahunchti hai.

e: Narrated Sa`d:The Prophet (ﷺ) visited me during Hajjat ul-Wada` while I was suffering from a disease which brought me to the verge of death. I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! My ailment has reached such a (bad) state as you see, and I have much wealth, but I have no-one to inherit from me except my only daughter. Shall I give 2/3 of my property as alms (in charity)?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No," I said, "Shall I give half of my property as alms?" He said, "No." I said, "(Shall I give) 1/3 of it? " He replied, " 1/3, and even 1/3 is too much. It is better for you to leave your inheritors wealthy rather than to leave them poor, begging people (for their sustenance); and whatever you spend for Allah's Sake, you will get reward for it even for the morsel of food which you put in your wives mouth." I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Should I remain (in Mecca) behind my companions (who are going with you to Medina)?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If you remain behind, any good deed which you will do for Allah's Sake, will upgrade and elevate you. May be you will live longer so that some people may benefit by you and some other (i.e. infidels) may get harmed by you." The Prophet (ﷺ) then added, "O Allah! Complete the Migration of my companions and do not turn them on their heels. But the poor Sa`d bin Khaula (not the above mentioned Sa`d) (died in Mecca) ." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) pitied Sa`d for he died in Mecca
hi: Sa'd bataate hain: Nabi mujhe Hajjat-ul-Wada ke dauran milne aaye jabke main ek bimari se pareshaan tha jo mujhe maut ke qareeb le aee thi. Maine kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Meri bimari aisi haalat mein pahunch gaee hai jaisi aap dekh rahe hain, aur mere paas bahut sari daulat hai, magar mera koee waaris nahi siwaye meri ek beti ke. Kya main apni maal ka do-tihaee sadqe mein dun?" Nabi ne kaha, "Nahi." Maine kaha, "Kya main apni aadhi maal sadqe mein dun?" Unhone kaha, "Nahi." Maine kaha, "(Kya main dun) uska ek-tihaee?" Unhone jawab diya, "Ek-tihaee, aur ek-tihaee bhi bahut zyada hai. Aapke liye behtar hai apne waarison ko daulatvaan chhodna bajaye unhe gareeb chhodne ke, doosron se bhiksha maangne ki haalat mein; aur jo bhi aap Allah ki khaatir kharch karte hain, aapko uska ajr milega, chahe woh khaane ka ek gras hi ho jo aap apni biwi ke munh mein daalte hain." Maine kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Kya mujhe apne sathiyon (yaani jo aapke saath Madina ja rahe hain) se peeche (Mecca mein) rah jana chahiye?" Nabi ne kaha, "Agar aap peeche rah jate hain, koee bhi neik amal jo aap Allah ki khaatir karenge, aapko uthaega aur oocha karega. Ho sakta hai aap lambe waqt tak zinda rahen taaki kuch log aapse faayda uthaen aur kuch aur (yaani kaafir) ko nuksaan pahunche." Nabi ne phir joda, "Aye Allah! Mere sathiyon ki hijrat poori kar aur unhe peeche mat mudne de. Magar bechaare Sa'd bin Khaula (yeh doosre Sa'd hain, upar wale Sa'd nahi) (Mecca mein mar gaye)." Allah ke Rasool ko Sa'd par taras aaya kyunke unka intiqal Mecca mein hua tha.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) got his head shaved during Hajjat-ul-Wada
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Hajjat-ul-Wada ke dauran apna sar munwaya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:During Hajjat-ul-Wada`, the Prophet (ﷺ) and some of his companions got their heads shaved while some of his companions got their head-hair cut short
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hajjat-ul-Wada ke dauran, Nabi aur unke kuch sahaba ne apne sar munwaye jabke unke kuch sahaba ne apne baal chhote kate.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abbas:That he came riding a donkey when Allah's Apostle was standing at Mina during Hajjat-ul-Wada`, leading the people in prayer. The donkey passed in front of a part of the row (of the people offering the prayer). Then he dismounted from it and took his position in the row with the people
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Woh ek gadhe par sawar hokar aaye jab Allah ke Rasool Mina mein khade the, logon ko namaz padhate huye, Hajjat-ul-Wada ke dauran. Gadha namaz padhne walon ki saf ke ek hisse ke saamne se guzra. Phir woh (gadhe se) utre aur logon ke saath saf mein apni jagah le li.

e: Narrated Hisham's father:In my presence, Usama was asked about the speed of the Prophet (ﷺ) during his Hajj. He replied, "It was Al-`Anaq (i.e. moderate easy speed) and if he encountered an open space, he used to increase his speed
hi: Hisham ke waalid bataate hain: Mere saamne, Usama se unke Hajj ke dauran Nabi ki chalne ki gati ke baare mein pucha gaya. Unhone jawab diya, "Yeh Al-Anaq thi (yaani darmiyana, aasaan gati) aur agar unhe koee khuli jagah milti, woh apni gati badha dete the."

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Yazid Al-Khatmi:That Abu Aiyub informed him that he offered the Maghrib and `Isha' prayers together with the Prophet during Hajjat-ul-Wada
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Yazid Al-Khatmi bataate hain: Abu Aiyub ne unhe bataya ke unhone Maghrib aur Isha ki namazen ek saath Nabi ke saath padhi Hajjat-ul-Wada ke dauran.

e: Narrated Abu Musa:My Companions sent me to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to ask him for some animals to ride on as they were accompanying him in the army of Al-Usra, and that was the Ghazwa (Battle) of Tabuk, I said, "O Allah's Prophet! My companions have sent me to you to provide them with means of transportation." He said, "By Allah! I will not make you ride anything." It happened that when I reached him, he was in an angry mood, and I didn't notice it. So I returned in a sad mood because of the refusal of the Prophet (ﷺ) and for the fear that the Prophet (ﷺ) might have become 'angry with me. So I returned to my companions and informed them of what the Prophet (ﷺ) had said. Only a short while had passed when I heard Bilal calling, "O `Abdullah bin Qais!" I replied to his call. Bilal said, "Respond to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who is calling you." When I went to him (i.e. the Prophet), he said, "Take these two camels tied together and also these two camels tied together,"' referring to six camels he had brought them from Sa`d at that time. The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "Take them to your companions and say, 'Allah (or Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ) allows you to ride on these,' so ride on them." So I took those camels to them and said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) allows you to ride on these (camels) but by Allah, I will not leave you till some of you proceed with me to somebody who heard the statement of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Do not think that I narrate to you a thing which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has not said." They said to me, "We consider you truthful, and we will do what you like." The sub-narrator added: So Abu Musa proceeded along with some of them till they came to those who have heard the statement of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) wherein he denied them (some animals to ride on) and (his statement) whereby he gave them the same. So these people told them the same information as Abu Musa had told them
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Mere sathiyon ne mujhe Allah ke Rasool ke paas bheja unse kuch sawari ke janwar maangne ke liye kyunke woh Al-Usra ki fauj mein unke saath the, aur woh Ghazwa Tabuk tha. Maine kaha, "Aye Allah ke Nabi! Mere sathiyon ne mujhe aapke paas bheja hai taaki aap unhe sawari ke saadhan dijiye." Unhone kaha, "Allah ki qasam! Main tumhe kuch bhi sawar karne ke liye nahi denge." Aisa hua ke jab main untak pahuncha, woh gusse mein the, aur maine ise dhyaan nahi diya. Isliye main udaas mood mein wapas aaya Nabi ke inkaar ki wajah se aur is dar se ke Nabi mujhpar naraaj ho sakte hain. Isliye main apne sathiyon ke paas wapas gaya aur unhe bataya jo Nabi ne kaha tha. Thoda hi waqt guzra tha ke maine Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko pukarte suna, "Aye Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Qais!" Maine unki pukar ka jawab diya. Bilal ne kaha, "Allah ke Rasool ka jawab do jo aapko bula rahe hain." Jab main unke (yaani Nabi ke) paas gaya, unhone kaha, "In do baandhe hue unton ko lo aur in do baandhe hue unton ko bhi," chhah unton ka ishara karte huye jo unhone us waqt Sa'd se laye the. Nabi ne joda, "Unhe apne sathiyon ke paas le jao aur kaho, 'Allah (ya Allah ke Rasool) tumhe in par sawar karne ki ijazat deta hai,' isliye inpar sawar ho jao." Isliye main woh unt unke paas le gaya aur kaha, "Nabi tumhe in (unton) par sawar hone ki ijazat dete hain magar Allah ki qasam, main tumhe tab tak nahi chhodunga jab tak tumme se kuch mere saath us shaks ke paas nahi jate jinhone Allah ke Rasool ka farmaan suna hai. Yeh mat socho ke main tumhe kuch aisi cheez bata raha hoon jo Allah ke Rasool ne nahi kahi." Unhone mujhse kaha, "Hum tumhe sachcha maante hain, aur hum wahi karenge jo aapko achha lage." Subordinate raawi ne joda: Isliye Abu Musa unmein se kuch ke saath badhe jab tak woh un logon tak pahunche jinhone Allah ke Rasool ka farmaan suna tha jismein unhone unhe (kuch janwar sawar karne ke liye) mana kiya tha aur (unka farmaan) jismein unhone unhe (donon unt) diye. Isliye in logon ne unhe wahi jaankari batai jo Abu Musa ne unhe bataee thi.

e: Narrated Sa`d:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) set out for Tabuk. appointing `Ali as his deputy (in Medina). `Ali said, "Do you want to leave me with the children and women?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Will you not be pleased that you will be to me like Aaron to Moses? But there will be no prophet after me
hi: Sa'd bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool Tabuk ke liye nikle, Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko apna janshin muqarrar karte huye (Madina mein). Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha, "Kya aap mujhe bachchon aur aurton ke saath chhodna chahte hain?" Nabi ne kaha, "Kya tumhe khushi nahi hogi ke tum mere liye waise ho jaise Harun Musa ke liye the? Magar mere baad koee Nabi nahi hai."

e: Narrated Safwan bin Ya`la bin Umaiya:that his father said, "I participated in Al-Usra (i.e. Tabuk) along with the Prophet." Ya`la added, "(My participation in) that Ghazwa was the best of my deeds to me." Ya`la said, "I had a laborer who quarrelled with somebody, and one of the two bit the hand of the other (`Ata', the sub-narrator, said, "Safwan told me who bit whom but I forgot it"), and the one who was bitten, pulled his hand out of the mouth of the biter, so one of the incisors of the biter was broken. So we came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he considered the biter's claim as invalid (i.e. the biter did not get a recompense for his broken incisor). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Should he leave his hand in your mouth so that you might snap it as if it were in the mouth of a male camel to snap it?
hi: Safwan bin Ya'la bin Umaiya bataate hain (apne waalid se): "Main Al-Usra (yaani Tabuk) mein Nabi ke saath shaamil hua." Ya'la ne joda, "(Mere us Ghazwe mein hissa lene ka) mere liye mere amalon mein sabse behtar tha." Ya'la ne kaha, "Mere paas ek mazdoor tha jiska kisi se jhagda hua, aur ek ne doosre ke haath ko kata (Ata, subordinate raawi, ne kaha, 'Safwan ne mujhe bataya kisne kisko kata magar main bhool gaya'), aur jisko kata gaya tha, usne apna haath kaatne wale ke munh se khinch liya, isliye kaatne wale ki ek daadh ka daant toot gaya. Isliye hum Nabi ke paas aaye aur unhone kaatne wale ke daave ko avaidh thahraya (yaani kaatne wale ko apne toote hue daadh ke daant ke liye koee muaawza nahi mila). Nabi ne kaha, 'Kya unhe apna haath tumhare munh mein chhod dena chahiye tha taaki tum use aise todkar dete jaise woh ek nar unt ke munh mein hota?'"

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Ka`b bin Malik:Who, from among Ka`b's sons, was the guide of Ka`b when he became blind: I heard Ka`b bin Malik narrating the story of (the Ghazwa of) Tabuk in which he failed to take part. Ka`b said, "I did not remain behind Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in any Ghazwa that he fought except the Ghazwa of Tabuk, and I failed to take part in the Ghazwa of Badr, but Allah did not admonish anyone who had not participated in it, for in fact, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had gone out in search of the caravan of Quraish till Allah made them (i.e. the Muslims) and their enemy meet without any appointment. I witnessed the night of Al-`Aqaba (pledge) with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) when we pledged for Islam, and I would not exchange it for the Badr battle although the Badr battle is more popular amongst the people than it (i.e. Al-`Aqaba pledge). As for my news (in this battle of Tabuk), I had never been stronger or wealthier than I was when I remained behind the Prophet (ﷺ) in that Ghazwa. By Allah, never had I two she-camels before, but I had then at the time of this Ghazwa. Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) wanted to make a Ghazwa, he used to hide his intention by apparently referring to different Ghazwa till it was the time of that Ghazwa (of Tabuk) which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) fought in severe heat, facing, a long journey, desert, and the great number of enemy. So the Prophet (ﷺ) announced to the Muslims clearly (their destination) so that they might get prepared for their Ghazwa. So he informed them clearly of the destination he was going to. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was accompanied by a large number of Muslims who could not be listed in a book namely, a register." Ka`b added, "Any man who intended to be absent would think that the matter would remain hidden unless Allah revealed it through Divine Revelation. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) fought that Ghazwa at the time when the fruits had ripened and the shade looked pleasant. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and his companions prepared for the battle and I started to go out in order to get myself ready along with them, but I returned without doing anything. I would say to myself, 'I can do that.' So I kept on delaying it every now and then till the people got ready and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and the Muslims along with him departed, and I had not prepared anything for my departure, and I said, I will prepare myself (for departure) one or two days after him, and then join them.' In the morning following their departure, I went out to get myself ready but returned having done nothing. Then again in the next morning, I went out to get ready but returned without doing anything. Such was the case with me till they hurried away and the battle was missed (by me). Even then I intended to depart to take them over. I wish I had done so! But it was not in my luck. So, after the departure of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), whenever I went out and walked amongst the people (i.e, the remaining persons), it grieved me that I could see none around me, but one accused of hypocrisy or one of those weak men whom Allah had excused. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not remember me till he reached Tabuk. So while he was sitting amongst the people in Tabuk, he said, 'What did Ka`b do?' A man from Banu Salama said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! He has been stopped by his two Burdas (i.e. garments) and his looking at his own flanks with pride.' Then Mu`adh bin Jabal said, 'What a bad thing you have said! By Allah! O Allah's Apostle! We know nothing about him but good.' Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) kept silent." Ka`b bin Malik added, "When I heard that he (i.e. the Prophet (ﷺ) ) was on his way back to Medina. I got dipped in my concern, and began to think of false excuses, saying to myself, 'How can I avoid his anger tomorrow?' And I took the advice of every wise member of my family in this matter. When it was said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), had come near all the evil false excuses abandoned from my mind and I knew well that I could never come out of this problem by forging a false statement. Then I decided firmly to speak the truth. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) arrived in the morning, and whenever he returned from a journey., he used to visit the Mosque first of all and offer a two-rak`at prayer therein and then sit for the people. So when he had done all that (this time), those who had failed to join the battle (of Tabuk) came and started offering (false) excuses and taking oaths before him. They were something over eighty men; Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) accepted the excuses they had expressed, took their pledge of allegiance asked for Allah's Forgiveness for them, and left the secrets of their hearts for Allah to judge. Then I came to him, and when I greeted him, he smiled a smile of an angry person and then said, 'Come on.' So I came walking till I sat before him. He said to me, 'What stopped you from joining us. Had you not purchased an animal For carrying you?' I answered, "Yes, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! But by Allah, if I were sitting before any person from among the people of the world other than you, I would have avoided his anger with an excuse. By Allah, I have been bestowed with the power of speaking fluently and eloquently, but by Allah, I know well that if today I tell you a lie to seek your favor, Allah would surely make you angry with me in the near future, but if I tell you the truth, though you will get angry because of it, I hope for Allah's Forgiveness. Really, by Allah, there was no excuse for me. By Allah, I had never been stronger or wealthier than I was when I remained behind you.' Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'As regards this man, he has surely told the truth. So get up till Allah decides your case.' I got up, and many men of Banu Salama followed me and said to me, 'By Allah, we never witnessed you doing any sin before this. Surely, you failed to offer excuse to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as the others who did not join him, have offered. The prayer of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to Allah to forgive you would have been sufficient for you.' By Allah, they continued blaming me so much that I intended to return (to the Prophet) and accuse myself of having told a lie, but I said to them, 'Is there anybody else who has met the same fate as I have?' They replied, 'Yes, there are two men who have said the same thing as you have, and to both of them was given the same order as given to you.' I said, 'Who are they?' They replied, 'Murara bin Ar-Rabi Al-Amri and Hilal bin Umaiya Al-Waqifi.' By that they mentioned to me two pious men who had attended the Ghazwa (Battle) of Badr, and in whom there was an example for me. So I did not change my mind when they mentioned them to me. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade all the Muslims to talk to us, the three aforesaid persons out of all those who had remained behind in that Ghazwa. So we kept away from the people and they changed their attitude towards us till the very land (where I lived) appeared strange to me as if I did not know it. We remained in that condition for fifty nights. As regards my two fellows, they remained in their houses and kept on weeping, but I was the youngest of them and the firmest of them, so I used to go out and witness the prayers along with the Muslims and roam about in the markets, but none would talk to me, and I would come to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and greet him while he was sitting In his gathering after the prayer, and I would wonder whether the Prophet (ﷺ) did move his lips in return to my greetings or not. Then I would offer my prayer near to him and look at him stealthily. When I was busy with my prayer, he would turn his face towards me, but when I turned my face to him, he would turn his face away from me. When this harsh attitude of the people lasted long, I walked till I scaled the wall of the garden of Abu Qatada who was my cousin and the dearest person to me, and I offered my greetings to him. By Allah, he did not return my greetings. I said, 'O Abu Qatada! I beseech you by Allah! Do you know that I love Allah and His Apostle?' He kept quiet. I asked him again, beseeching him by Allah, but he remained silent. Then I asked him again in the Name of Allah. He said, "Allah and His Apostle know it better.' Thereupon my eyes flowed with tears and I returned and jumped over the wall." Ka`b added, "While I was walking in the market of Medina, suddenly I saw a Nabati (i.e. a Christian farmer) from the Nabatis of Sham who came to sell his grains in Medina, saying, 'Who will lead me to Ka`b bin Malik?' The people began to point (me) out for him till he came to me and handed me a letter from the king of Ghassan in which the following was written: "To proceed, I have been informed that your friend (i.e. the Prophet (ﷺ) ) has treated you harshly. Anyhow, Allah does not let you live at a place where you feel inferior and your right is lost. So join us, and we will console you." When I read it, I said to myself, 'This is also a sort of a test.' Then I took the letter to the oven and made a fire therein by burning it. When forty out of the fifty nights elapsed, behold ! There came to me the messenger of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, 'Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) orders you to keep away from your wife,' I said, 'Should I divorce her; or else what should I do?' He said, 'No, only keep aloof from her and do not cohabit her.' The Prophet (ﷺ) sent the same message to my two fellows. Then I said to my wife. 'Go to your parents and remain with them till Allah gives His Verdict in this matter." Ka`b added, "The wife of Hilal bin Umaiya came to Allah's Apostle and said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Hilal bin Umaiya is a helpless old man who has no servant to attend on him. Do you dislike that I should serve him? ' He said, 'No (you can serve him) but he should not come near you.' She said, 'By Allah, he has no desire for anything. By, Allah, he has never ceased weeping since his case began till this day of his.' On that, some of my family members said to me, 'Will you also ask Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to permit your wife (to serve you) as he has permitted the wife of Hilal bin Umaiya to serve him?' I said, 'By Allah, I will not ask the permission of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) regarding her, for I do not know What Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) would say if I asked him to permit her (to serve me) while I am a young man.' Then I remained in that state for ten more nights after that till the period of fifty nights was completed starting from the time when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prohibited the people from talking to us. When I had offered the Fajr prayer on the 50th morning on the roof of one of our houses and while I was sitting in the condition which Allah described (in the Qur'an) i.e. my very soul seemed straitened to me and even the earth seemed narrow to me for all its spaciousness, there I heard the voice of one who had ascended the mountain of Sala' calling with his loudest voice, 'O Ka`b bin Malik! Be happy (by receiving good tidings).' I fell down in prostration before Allah, realizing that relief has come. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had announced the acceptance of our repentance by Allah when he had offered the Fajr prayer. The people then went out to congratulate us. Some bringers of good tidings went out to my two fellows, and a horseman came to me in haste, and a man of Banu Aslam came running and ascended the mountain and his voice was swifter than the horse. When he (i.e. the man) whose voice I had heard, came to me conveying the good tidings, I took off my garments and dressed him with them; and by Allah, I owned no other garments than them on that day. Then I borrowed two garments and wore them and went to Allah's Apostle. The people started receiving me in batches, congratulating me on Allah's Acceptance of my repentance, saying, 'We congratulate you on Allah's Acceptance of your repentance." Ka`b further said, "When I entered the Mosque, I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sitting with the people around him. Talha bin Ubaidullah swiftly came to me, shook hands with me and congratulated me. By Allah, none of the Muhajirin (i.e. Emigrants) got up for me except him (i.e. Talha), and I will never forget this for Talha." Ka`b added, "When I greeted Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) his face being bright with joy, he said, "Be happy with the best day that you have got ever since your mother delivered you." Ka`b added, "I said to the Prophet (ﷺ) 'Is this forgiveness from you or from Allah?' He said, 'No, it is from Allah.' Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) became happy, his face would shine as if it were a piece of moon, and we all knew that characteristic of him. When I sat before him, I said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Because of the acceptance of my repentance I will give up all my wealth as alms for the Sake of Allah and His Apostle. Allah's Apostle said, 'Keep some of your wealth, as it will be better for you.' I said, 'So I will keep my share from Khaibar with me,' and added, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Allah has saved me for telling the truth; so it is a part of my repentance not to tell but the truth as long as I am alive. By Allah, I do not know anyone of the Muslims whom Allah has helped fortelling the truth more than me. Since I have mentioned that truth to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) till today, I have never intended to tell a lie. I hope that Allah will also save me (from telling lies) the rest of my life. So Allah revealed to His Apostle the Verse:-- "Verily, Allah has forgiven the Prophet, the Muhajirin (i.e. Emigrants (up to His Saying) And be with those who are true (in word and deed)." (9.117-119) By Allah, Allah has never bestowed upon me, apart from His guiding me to Islam, a Greater blessing than the fact that I did not tell a lie to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) which would have caused me to perish as those who have told a lie perished, for Allah described those who told lies with the worst description He ever attributed to anybody else. Allah said:-- "They (i.e. the hypocrites) will swear by Allah to you when you return to them (up to His Saying) Certainly Allah is not pleased with the rebellious people-- " (9.95-96) Ka`b added, "We, the three persons, differed altogether from those whose excuses Allah's Apostle accepted when they swore to him. He took their pledge of allegiance and asked Allah to forgive them, but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) left our case pending till Allah gave His Judgment about it. As for that Allah said):-- And to the three (He did forgive also) who remained behind." (9.118) What Allah said (in this Verse) does not indicate our failure to take part in the Ghazwa, but it refers to the deferment of making a decision by the Prophet (ﷺ) about our case in contrast to the case of those who had taken an oath before him and he excused them by accepting their excuses
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ka'b bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain (jo, Ka'b ke beton mein se, Ka'b ke andhe hone par unke margdarshak the): Maine Ka'b bin Malik ko Tabuk (ki jung) ki kahani sunate suna jismein woh shaamil nahi ho paye. Ka'b ne kaha, "Main kabhi Allah ke Rasool ki kisi Ghazwe se peeche nahi raha jo unhone ladi siwaye Tabuk ke Ghazwe ke, aur main Badr ki jung mein bhi shaamil nahi ho paya, magar Allah ne usmein shaamil na hone wale kisi ko bhi doshi nahi thahraya, kyunke asal mein, Allah ke Rasool Quraish ke caravan ka picha karne nikle the jab tak Allah ne unhe (yaani Musalmanon ko) aur unke dushman ko bina koee pahle se tay ke aamne-saamne la diya. Maine Al-Aqaba ki raat Allah ke Rasool ke saath dekhi jab humne Islam ke liye bai'at di, aur main ise Badr ki jung se badal nahi karunga chahe Badr ki jung logon ke beech isse (yaani Al-Aqaba bai'at se) zyada prasiddh hai. Jahaan tak meri khabar (is Ghazwa-e-Tabuk mein) ka sawal hai, main kabhi itna taakatvar ya daulatvaan nahi tha jitna main tha jab main Nabi se is Ghazwa mein peeche raha. Allah ki qasam, mere paas kabhi do untniyaan pahle nahi thi, magar mere paas is Ghazwa ke waqt thi. Jab bhi Allah ke Rasool koee Ghazwa karna chahte, woh apna irada chhupate hue doosre Ghazwe ka zikar karte the jab tak (Tabuk ki) Ghazwa ka waqt aaya, jise Allah ke Rasool ne sakht garmi mein lada, lambe safar, registaan, aur bade tadaad mein dushman ka saamna karte huye. Isliye Nabi ne Musalmanon ko saaf-saaf (unki manzil) elaan ki taaki woh apni Ghazwa ki taiyaari kar saken. Isliye unhone unhe saaf-saaf bataya ke woh kahaan ja rahe the. Allah ke Rasool ke saath bade tadaad mein Musalman the jinhe ek kitaab, yaani register mein nahi likha ja sakta tha." Ka'b ne joda, "Koee bhi shaks jo gair-hazir rehne ka irada rakhta tha, sochta tha ke maamla chhipa rah jaayega jab tak Allah use Divine Ilham ke zariye zaahir na kare. Isliye Allah ke Rasool ne yeh Ghazwa us waqt lada jab phal pak chuke the aur chhaye achhi lag rahi thi. Allah ke Rasool aur unke sathi jung ki taiyaari karne lage aur main bhi unke saath taiyaari karne ke liye nikla, magar main kuch kiye bina wapas aa gaya. Main khud se kahta, 'Main woh kar sakta hoon.' Isliye main ise baat-baat mein taalta raha jab tak log taiyaar ho gaye aur Allah ke Rasool aur Musalman unke saath rawana hue, aur maine apne prasthaan ke liye kuch taiyaar nahi kiya tha, aur maine kaha, 'Main unke ek ya do din baad khud ko taiyaar karunga, aur phir unse ja milunga.' Unke prasthaan ke agli subah, main taiyaar hone ke liye nikla magar kuch kiye bina wapas aa gaya. Phir agli subah bhi, main taiyaar hone ke liye nikla magar kuch kiye bina wapas aaya. Yehi haalat meri rahi jab tak woh jaldi se chale gaye aur jung chhut gaee (mujhse). Phir bhi maine unke saath milne ke liye prasthaan karne ka irada kiya. Kaash maine aisa kiya hota! Magar yeh mere naseeb mein nahi tha. Isliye, Allah ke Rasool ke prasthaan ke baad, jab bhi main bahar jata aur logon (yaani baaki rah gaye logon) ke beech ghumta, mujhe dukh hota ke main apne aas-paas koee bhi nahi dekh pata siwaye un logon ke jinpar munafik hone ka ilzaam tha ya un kamzor logon ke jinhe Allah ne maaf kar diya tha. Allah ke Rasool ne mujhe tab tak yaad nahi kiya jab tak woh Tabuk nahi pahunche. Isliye jabke woh Tabuk mein logon ke beech baithe the, unhone kaha, 'Ka'b ne kya kiya?' Banu Salama ke ek shaks ne kaha, 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Unhe unke do Burda (yaani kapdon) ne aur unke apne pahluon ko garv se dekhne ne roka hai.' Ispar Mu'adh bin Jabal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Aapne kitni buri baat kahi hai! Allah ki qasam! Aye Allah ke Rasool! Hum unke baare mein achhe ke siwa kuch nahi jaante.' Allah ke Rasool khaamosh rahe." Ka'b bin Malik ne joda, "Jab mujhe khabar mili ke woh (yaani Nabi) Madina wapas aa rahe hain, main chinta mein doob gaya, aur jhoote bahane sochne laga, khud se kahte hue, 'Main kal unke gusse se kaise bachunga?' Aur maine is maamle mein apne pariwara ke har aqlmand sadasya ki raay li. Jab yeh kaha gaya ke Allah ke Rasool nazdik aa chuke hain, sab bure jhoote bahane mere man se hat gaye aur mujhe achhi tarah pata chal gaya ke main is samasya se kabhi ek jhoote byaan ke zariye bahar nahi aa sakta. Phir maine sach kahne ka dradh nirnay liya. Isliye Allah ke Rasool subah pahunche, aur jab bhi woh kisi safar se wapas aate, woh sabse pahle masjid jate aur usmein do rakat namaz padhte aur phir logon ke liye baith jate. Isliye jab unhone aisa kiya (is baar), jinhone jung mein shaamil hone se chhod diya tha woh aaye aur unke saamne (jhoote) bahane pesh karne aur qasamen khane lage. Woh assi se zyada log the; Allah ke Rasool ne unke daava kiye gaye bahanon ko qubool kiya, unki bai'at li, unke liye Allah se maafi maangi, aur unke dilo ke raazon ko Allah ke faisle par chhod diya. Phir main unke paas gaya, aur jab maine unhe salaam kiya, woh ek naraaj insaan ki tarah muskurae aur phir kaha, 'Aao.' Isliye main chalte hue aaya jab tak main unke saamne baith gaya. Unhone mujhse kaha, 'Tumhe humare saath jane se kis cheez ne roka? Kya tumne ek sawari ka janwar khareeda nahi tha?' Maine jawab diya, 'Haan, Aye Allah ke Rasool! Magar Allah ki qasam, agar main duniya ke kisi aur shaks ke saamne baitha hota aapke siwaye, main uske gusse ko ek bahane se tod leta. Allah ki qasam, mujhe ravaan aur naipuny tarike se bolne ki taakat di gaee hai, magar Allah ki qasam, mujhe achhi tarah pata hai ke agar aaj main aapse jhoot bolkar aapki prasannata haasil karna chahta hoon, Allah zaroor mujhse aapka gussa jald hi dilane wala hai, magar agar main aapse sach bolta hoon, chahe aap isse naraaj hon, mujhe Allah ki maafi ki ummeed hai. Sach mein, Allah ki qasam, mere paas koee bahana nahi tha. Allah ki qasam, main aapke saath rahte huye kabhi itna taakatvar ya daulatvaan nahi tha jitna main tha jab main aapse peeche raha.'" Phir Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Jahaan tak is shaks ka sawal hai, unhonne zaroor sach kaha hai. Isliye utho jab tak Allah tumhare baare mein faisla na de." Main utha, aur Banu Salama ke bahut se log mere peeche aaye aur mujhse kaha, "Allah ki qasam, humne kabhi aapko isse pahle koee gunah karte dekha hi nahi. Zaroor aap Allah ke Rasool ke saamne ek bahana pesh karne mein asamartha rahe jaisa doosron ne jo unke saath nahi gaye, pesh kiya. Allah ke Rasool ki Allah se aapko maaf karne ki dua hi aapke liye kaafi hoti." Allah ki qasam, woh mujhe itna dosh dete rahe ke maine (Nabi ke paas) wapas jane aur khud par jhoot bolne ka ilzaam lagane ka irada kiya, magar maine unse kaha, "Kya koee aur bhi hai jinke saath aisa hi hua jaisa mere saath?" Unhone jawab diya, "Haan, do log ne bhi aapke jaisi hi baat kahi, aur unhe bhi wahi hukum diya gaya jaisa aapko diya gaya." Maine pucha, "Woh kaun hain?" Unhone jawab diya, "Murara bin Ar-Rabi Al-Amri aur Hilal bin Umaiya Al-Waqifi." Iske zariye unhone mujhe do pakbaz logon ka zikar kiya jo Badr ki jung mein shaamil hue the aur jinmein mere liye ek udaaharan tha. Isliye maine apna man nahi badala jab unhone unka zikar mujhse kiya. Allah ke Rasool ne sab Musalmanon ko humare teenon se baat karne se mana kiya, yaani, us Ghazwe mein peeche rah gaye teenon mein se. Isliye humne apne aap ko logon se door kiya, aur unhone humare prati apna vyavhaar badal diya jab tak zameen tak mere liye ajnabi lagne lagi mano main ise pahchanta hi nahi tha. Hum us haalat mein pachaas raaten rahe. Jahaan tak mere do sathiyon ka sawal hai, woh apne gharon mein rahe aur rote rahe, magar main unmein sabse jawan aur sabse dradh tha, isliye main bahar jata aur Musalmanon ke saath namazen dekhta aur bazaron mein ghumta, magar koee bhi mujhse baat nahi karta, aur main Allah ke Rasool ke paas aata aur namaz ke baad jab woh apni baithak mein baithe hote, unhe salaam karta, aur main sochta ke Nabi ne jawab mein apne honth hilaye ya nahi. Phir main unke qareeb namaz padhta aur churakar unhe dekhta. Jab main apni namaz mein vyast hota, woh apna chehra meri taraf mudte, magar jab main apna chehra unki taraf mudta, woh apna chehra mujhse door kar lete. Jab logon ka yeh sakht vyavhaar lambe waqt tak chala, main chalta hua Abu Qatada (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke baag ki deewaar tak gaya, jo mere chachere bhai the aur mujhe sabse pyare insaan the, aur maine unhe salaam kiya. Allah ki qasam, unhone mera salaam ka jawab nahi diya. Maine kaha, 'Aye Abu Qatada! Main aapko Allah ki qasam deta hoon! Kya aapko pata hai main Allah aur uske Rasool se pyar karta hoon?' Woh khaamosh rahe. Maine unse phir Allah ki qasam dekar pucha, magar woh khaamosh rahe. Phir maine unse Allah ke naam par phir pucha. Unhone kaha, 'Allah aur unke Rasool behtar jaante hain.' Ispar mere aansu behne lage aur main wapas gaya aur deewaar par se kood gaya." Ka'b ne joda, "Jabke main Madina ke bazaar mein chal raha tha, achanak maine dekha Sham ke ek Nabati (yaani Isaee kisan) ko jo apna anaaj bechne Madina aaya tha, kahte huye, 'Kaun mujhe Ka'b bin Malik tak le jaayega?' Log mujhe unke liye ishara karne lage jab tak woh mere paas aaye aur mujhe Ghassan ke baadshah ki taraf se ek khat diya jismein yeh likha tha: 'Aage ki baat yeh hai ki, mujhe pata chala hai ke aapke dost (yaani Nabi) ne aapke saath sakhti se pesh aaya hai. Allah aapko aisi jagah nahi rakhega jahaan aap khud ko heen mahsoos karen aur aapka haqq kho jaaye. Isliye humare saath aa jaiye, aur hum aapko saantvana denge.' Jab maine ise padha, maine khud se kaha, 'Yeh bhi ek qisam ki aazmaish hai.' Phir main ise tandoor mein le gaya aur use jala diya." "Jab pachaas raaton mein se chaalis poori huee, achanak Allah ke Rasool ka ek sandesh-vahak mere paas aaya aur kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool tumhe apni biwi se door rehne ka hukum dete hain.' Maine pucha, 'Kya main unhe talaq de dun, ya main kya karun?' Usne kaha, 'Nahi, sirf unse door raho aur unke saath ta'alluq mat rakho.' Nabi ne mere donon sathiyon ko bhi wahi paighaam bheja. Phir maine apni biwi se kaha, 'Apne maa-baap ke paas jao aur unke saath tab tak raho jab tak Allah is maamle mein apna faisla na de.'" Ka'b ne joda, "Hilal bin Umaiya ki biwi Allah ke Rasool ke paas aee aur kaha, 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Hilal bin Umaiya ek asahaya boodhe aadmi hain jinke paas koee gulaam nahi hai jo unki sewa kare. Kya aapko napasand hoga agar main unki sewa karun?' Unhone kaha, 'Nahi (aap unki sewa kar sakti hain) magar unhe aapke najdik nahi aana chahiye.' Unhone kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, unmein kisi cheez ki iccha nahi hai. Allah ki qasam, woh jab se unka maamla shuru hua tab se lekar aaj tak rote hi rahe hain.'" Ispar, mere pariwara ke kuch sadasyon ne mujhse kaha, "Kya aap bhi Allah ke Rasool se apni biwi (ki sewa) ke liye ijazat maangenge jaisi unhone Hilal bin Umaiya ki biwi ko unki sewa karne ki ijazat di hai?" Maine kaha, "Allah ki qasam, main iske baare mein Allah ke Rasool se ijazat nahi maagunga, kyunke mujhe nahi pata Allah ke Rasool kya kahenge agar main unse ijazat maagun jabke main ek jawan aadmi hoon." Phir main aur das raaton tak usi haalat mein raha jab tak pachaas raaton ki muddat poori ho gaee, us waqt se lekar jab Allah ke Rasool ne logon ko humme se baat karne se mana kiya tha. Jab maine pachaasvin subah ki Fajr ki namaz humare gharon mein se ek ki chhat par padhi, aur jabke main us haalat mein baitha tha jiska varnan Allah ne (Quran mein) kiya hai, yaani meri jaan mujhe tang lagti thi aur zameen bhi apni vishaalta ke bavjood mujhe tang lagti thi, wahaan maine Sala pahad par chadhe hue ek shakhs ki aawaaz suni jo apni sabse buland aawaaz mein pukar raha tha, "Aye Ka'b bin Malik! Khush ho jao (achhi khabar paane ke liye)." Main Allah ke saamne sajda mein gir gaya, yeh samajhkar ke rahat aa chuki hai. Allah ke Rasool ne Fajr ki namaz padhne ke baad humari tauba ki Allah dwaara sweekar hone ki khabar de di thi. Log humein badhaee dene ke liye nikle. Kuch log achhi khabar lekar mere donon sathiyon ke paas gaye, aur ek sawar jaldi se mere paas aaya, aur Banu Aslam qabile ka ek shaks daudta hua aaya aur pahad par chadha, aur uski aawaaz ghode se tez thi. Jab woh shakhs jinki aawaaz maine suni thi mere paas achhi khabar dene aaya, maine apne kapde utare aur unhe (badhaee ki khaatir) unse pahna diye; aur Allah ki qasam, us din ke ilawa mere paas koee aur kapde nahi the. Phir maine (kisi se) do kapde udhaar liye aur unhe pahna aur Allah ke Rasool ki taraf gaya. Log mujhse girohon mein milne lage, mujhe Allah dwaara meri tauba sweekar hone par badhaee dete huye, kahte huye, "Hum aapko Allah ki taraf se aapki tauba ki sweekriti par badhaee dete hain." Ka'b ne aage kaha, "Jab main masjid mein daakhil hua, maine Allah ke Rasool ko unke aas-paas baithe logon ke saath dekha. Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ubaidullah jaldi se mere paas aaye, mujhse haath milaya aur badhaee di. Allah ki qasam, unke (yaani Talha ke) siwaye Muhajirin mein se koee bhi mere liye khade nahi hue, aur main ise kabhi Talha ke liye nahi bhoolunga." Ka'b ne joda, "Jab maine Allah ke Rasool ko salaam kiya, unka chehra khushi se chamakte huye, unhone kaha, 'Aapko wahi din khushi haasil karna chahiye jo aapke liye sabse achha raha hai jab se aapki maa ne aapko paidaish diya.'" Ka'b ne joda, "Maine Nabi se kaha, 'Kya yeh maafi aapki taraf se hai ya Allah ki taraf se?' Unhone kaha, 'Nahi, yeh Allah ki taraf se hai.' Jab bhi Allah ke Rasool khushi hote, unka chehra chamakta jaise woh chaand ka ek tukda ho, aur hum sab is baat ko unki khasiyat ke soorat mein jaante the. Jab main unke saamne baitha, maine kaha, 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Meri tauba ki sweekriti ki wajah se, main apni sari daulat Allah aur unke Rasool ki khaatir sadqe mein dunga.' Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, 'Apni kuch daulat apne paas rakho, kyunke yeh aapke liye behtar hoga.' Maine kaha, 'Isliye main Khaibar mein apna hissa apne paas rakhunga,' aur joda, 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Allah ne mujhe sach bolne ki wajah se bacha liya hai; isliye mera yeh farz hai ke jab tak main zinda hoon, main sirf sach hi bolun. Allah ki qasam, main kisi aur Musalman ko nahi jaanta jinhe Allah ne sach bolne ki wajah se itna sammanit kiya hoga jitna mujhe kiya hai. Jab se maine yeh sach Allah ke Rasool se kaha, aaj tak, maine kabhi jhoot bolne ka irada nahi kiya. Mujhe ummeed hai Allah mujhe (jhoot se) apni baaki zindagi mein bhi bacha kar rakhega.' Isliye Allah ne apne Nabi par yeh Ayat naazil ki: 'Sach mein, Allah ne Nabi, Muhajir...ko maaf kar diya hai (aage tak)...aur unke saath raho jo sach (baat aur amal mein) hain.' (9:117-119) Allah ki qasam, Allah ne mujhe, Islam ki taraf hidaayat dene ke ilawa, isse bade daan se kabhi nawaza nahi jitna bada daan yeh tha ke maine Allah ke Rasool se jhoot nahi bola jisse main un logon ki tarah barbaad ho jata jinhone jhoot bola, kyunke Allah ne jhooton ka varnan unse bade shabdon mein kiya jitna usne kisi aur ke liye kiya, Allah ne kaha: 'Woh (yaani munafik) tumse Allah ki qasam khaenge jab tum unki taraf lautte ho (aage tak)...Yaqinan Allah bagaavat karne walon se khush nahi hota.' (9:95-96)" Ka'b ne joda, "Hum teenon shaks alag the un logon se jinke bahanen Allah ke Rasool ne qubool kiye jab unhone unke saamne qasam khaee. Unhone unki bai'at li aur unke liye Allah se maafi maangi, magar Allah ke Rasool ne humara maamla lambit rakha jab tak Allah ne iske baare mein apna faisla nahi diya. Jaisa ke Allah ne kaha:) 'Aur teenon (ko bhi maaf kiya) jo peeche rah gaye the.' (9:118) Allah ne (is Ayat mein) jo kaha uska matlab jung mein humari gair-hajari nahi hai, balki yeh Nabi dwaara humare maamle mein faisla dene mein deri ka ishara hai us tulna mein jinhonne unke saamne qasam khaee thi aur unhone unke bahanon ko qubool karke unhe maaf kar diya tha."

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:When the Prophet (ﷺ) passed by Al-Hijr, he said, "Do not enter the dwelling places of those people who were unjust to themselves unless you enter in a weeping state lest the same calamity as of theirs should befall you." Then he covered his head and made his speed fast till he crossed the valley
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Nabi Al-Hijr se guzre, unhone kaha, "Un logon ke gharon mein daakhil mat hona jinhone khud par zulm kiya (yaani jinke ghar Thamud qaum ke the) siwaye rote hue haalat mein, is dar se ke tumpar bhi wahi tabaahi na aa jaaye jaisa unpar aaya tha." Phir unhone apna sar dhaanka aur apni raftar tez ki jab tak unhone us waadi ko paar kar liya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to his companions who were at Al-Hijr, "Do not enter upon these people who are being punished, except in a weeping state, lest the same calamity as of theirs should befall you
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne apne sathiyon se, jo Al-Hijr mein the, kaha, "In logon ke paas mat jao jinke saath saza ho rahi hai, siwaye rote hue haalat mein, is dar se ke tumpar bhi wahi tabaahi na aa jaaye jaisa unpar aaya tha."

e: Narrated `Urwa bin Al-Mughira:Al-Mughira bin Shu`ba, said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) went out to answer the call of nature and (when he had finished) I got up to pour water for him." I think that he said that the event had taken place during the Ghazwa of Tabuk. Al-Mughira added. "The Prophet (ﷺ) washed his face, and when he wanted to wash his forearms, the sleeves of his cloak became tight over them, so he took them out from underneath the cloak and then he washed them (i.e. his forearms) and passed wet hands over his Khuffs (socks made from thick fabric or leather)
hi: Urwa bin Al-Mughira bataate hain: Al-Mughira bin Shu'ba (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Nabi qaza-e-hajat ke liye bahar gaye, aur (jab unhone khatm kiya) main unke liye paani daalne ke liye utha." Mujhe lagta hai unhone kaha ke yeh ghatna Ghazwa Tabuk ke dauran huee thi. Al-Mughira ne joda, "Nabi ne apna chehra dhoya, aur jab woh apni baahen dhone chahte the, unke choge ki aastinen unke haathon par tang ho gaee, isliye unhone unhe (yaani apni baahon ko) choge ke neeche se nikala aur phir unhe (yaani apni baahon ko) dhoya aur apne Khuffs (yaani mote kapde ya chamde se bane mojen) par gile haath phera."

e: Narrated Abu Humaid:We returned in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) from the Ghazwa of Tabuk, and when we looked upon Medina, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "This is Taba (i.e. Medina), and this is Uhud, a mountain that loves us and is loved by us
hi: Abu Humaid bataate hain: Hum Nabi ki sohbat mein Ghazwa Tabuk se wapas aaye, aur jab humne Madina ko dekha, Nabi ne kaha, "Yeh Taba hai (yaani Madina), aur yeh Uhud hai, ek pahad jo humse pyar karta hai aur jise hum pyar karte hain."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) returned from the Ghazwa of Tabuk, and when he approached Medina, he said, "There are some people in Medina who were with you all the time, you did not travel any portion of the journey nor crossed any valley, but they were with you." They (i.e. the people) said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Even though they were at Medina?" He said, "Yes, because they were stopped by a genuine excuse
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool Ghazwa Tabuk se wapas aaye, aur jab woh Madina ke qareeb pahunche, unhone kaha, "Madina mein kuch log hain jo poore safar mein tumhare saath the; tumne safar ka koee hissa tay nahi kiya, na koee waadi paar ki, magar woh tumhare saath the." Unhone (yaani logon ne) kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Chahe woh Madina mein hi rahe?" Unhone kaha, "Haan, kyunke unhe ek sachcha bahane ne roka tha."

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent a letter to Khosrau with `Abdullah bin Hudhafa As-Sahmi and told him to hand it over to the governor of Al-Bahrain. The governor of Al-Bahrain handed it over to Khosrau, and when he read the latter, he tore it into pieces. (The sub-narrator added, "I think that Ibn Al-Musaiyab said, 'Allah's Apostle invoked (Allah) to tear them all (Khosrau and his companions) totally into pieces
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Khosrau ko ek khat Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Hudhafa As-Sahmi ke haathon bheja aur unse kaha ke woh use Al-Bahrain ke gawarnar ko saunp den. Al-Bahrain ke gawarnar ne use Khosrau ko diya, aur jab unhone khat padha, unhone use tukdon mein phaad diya. (Subordinate raawi ne joda, "Mujhe lagta hai Ibn Al-Musaiyab ne kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool ne bad-dua ki ke woh (yaani Khosrau aur unke sathi) sab bhi poori tarah tukdon mein phaade jaen.'")

e: Narrated Abu Bakra:During the days (of the battle) of Al-Jamal, Allah benefited me with a word I had heard from Allah's Apostle after I had been about to join the Companions of Al-Jamal (i.e. the camel) and fight along with them. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was informed that the Persians had crowned the daughter of Khosrau as their ruler, he said, "Such people as ruled by a lady will never be successful
hi: Abu Bakra (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Al-Jamal (yaani unt) ki jung ke dinon mein, Allah ne mujhe ek shabd se faayda diya jo maine Allah ke Rasool se suna tha, ismein mera Al-Jamal ke sathiyon mein shaamil hone aur unke saath jung karne ke bahut qareeb aane ke baad. Jab Allah ke Rasool ko yeh bataya gaya ke Faarsiyon ne Khosrau ki beti ko apni shaasak muqarrar kiya hai, unhone kaha, "Aise log jinki hukumat ek aurat karti hai, kabhi kaamyaab nahi honge."

e: Narrated As-Sa'ib bin Yazid:I remember that I went out with the boys to (the place called) Thaniyat-ul-Wada` to receive Allah's Apostle
hi: As-Sa'ib bin Yazid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Mujhe yaad hai main aur baaki bachche Thaniyat-ul-Wada nikle Allah ke Rasool ka swagat karne ke liye.

e: Narrated As-Saib:I remember I went out with the boys to Thaniyat-ul-Wada` to receive the Prophet (ﷺ) when he returned from the Ghazwa of Tabuk
hi: As-Saib bataate hain: Mujhe yaad hai main aur baaki bachche Thaniyat-ul-Wada nikle Nabi ka swagat karne jab woh Ghazwa Tabuk se wapas aaye.

e: Narrated `Aisha: The Prophet (ﷺ) in his ailment in which he died, used to say, "O `Aisha! I still feel the pain caused by the food I ate at Khaibar, and at this time, I feel as if my aorta is being cut from that poison
hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi apni us bimari mein jismein unka intiqal hua, kaha karte the, "Aye Ayesha! Mujhe abhi bhi Khaibar mein khaye hue khaane ka dard mahsoos ho raha hai, aur is waqt, mujhe lagta hai mano meri mukhya dhamani us zahar ki wajah se kati ja rahi hai."

e: Narrated Um Al-Fadl bint Al-Harith:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) reciting Surat-al-Mursalat `Urfan (77) in the Maghrib prayer, and after that prayer he did not lead us in any prayer till he died
hi: Umm Al-Fadl bint Al-Harith bataati hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko Maghrib ki namaz mein Surah Al-Mursalat padhte suna, aur us namaz ke baad unhone humein kabhi koi aur namaz nahi padhaayi, yahaan tak ke unka wisal ho gaya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas: `Umar bin Al-Khattab used to let Ibn `Abbas sit beside him, so `AbdurRahman bin `Auf said to `Umar, "We have sons similar to him." `Umar replied, "(I respect him) because of his status that you know." `Umar then asked Ibn `Abbas about the meaning of this Holy Verse:-- "When comes the help of Allah and the conquest of Mecca . . ." (110.1) Ibn `Abbas replied, "That indicated the death of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) which Allah informed him of." `Umar said, "I do not understand of it except what you understand
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab unhe apne paas baithaya karte the. Isper Abdur Rahman bin Auf (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Umar se kaha, 'Hamare bhi to iske jaise bete hain (jo yahan baith sakte hain).' Umar ne jawab diya, 'Iska jo martaba tumhe pata hai, usi wajah se (main isse apne paas baithata hoon).' Phir Umar ne Ibn Abbas se is Ayat ka matlab pucha: 'Jab Allah ki madad aur Makkah ki fatah aa jaaye...' Ibn Abbas ne jawab diya, 'Ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki wafat ki taraf ishara hai, jiski khabar Allah ne unhe de di thi.' Umar ne kaha, 'Jo tum samajhte ho, main bhi wahi samajhta hoon iska.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Thursday! And how great that Thursday was!
