The ailment of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) became worse (on Thursday) and he said, "Fetch me something so that I may write to you something after which you will never go astray." The people (present there) differed in this matter, and it was not right to differ before a prophet. Some said, "What is wrong with him ? (Do you think ) he is delirious (seriously ill)? Ask him ( to understand his state )." So they went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and asked him again. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Leave me, for my present state is better than what you call me for." Then he ordered them to do three things. He said, "Turn the pagans out of the 'Arabian Peninsula; respect and give gifts to the foreign delegations as you have seen me dealing with them." (Sa`id bin Jubair, the sub-narrator said that Ibn `Abbas kept quiet as regards the third order, or he said, "I forgot it.") (See Hadith No. 116 Vol)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Guruwar (Thursday)! Aur wo Guruwar kaisa tha! Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki bimari us din aur badh gayi thi, aur unhone farmaya, 'Kuch lao, main tumhare liye kuch likh doon jiske baad tum kabhi gumraah nahi hoge.' Wahan maujood logon mein ikhtelaf ho gaya, halaanke Nabi ke saamne ikhtelaf karna theek nahi tha. Kuch logon ne kaha, 'Inhe kya ho gaya hai? (Kahin) ye bimari ki shiddat mein bahekne to nahi lage? Inse (saaf saaf) pucho.' Wo Nabi (SAW) ke paas gaye aur dobara pucha. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Mujhe chhod do, jis haalat mein main hoon wo us se behtar hai jiske liye tum mujhe bula rahe ho.' Phir unhone teen baatein karne ka hukm diya. Farmaya, 'Mushrikon ko Jazeera-e-Arab se nikaal do, aur bahar se aane waale wafdon ki izzat karo aur unhe tohfe do, jaisa tumne mujhe unke saath karte dekha hai.' (Ravi Saeed bin Jubair kehte hain ke Ibn Abbas teesri baat par khamosh ho gaye, ya kaha ke main use bhool gaya.)

e: Narrated Ubaidullah bin `Abdullah:Ibn `Abbas said, "When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was on his deathbed and there were some men in the house, he said, 'Come near, I will write for you something after which you will not go astray.' Some of them ( i.e. his companions) said, 'Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) is seriously ill and you have the (Holy) Qur'an. Allah's Book is sufficient for us.' So the people in the house differed and started disputing. Some of them said, 'Give him writing material so that he may write for you something after which you will not go astray.' while the others said the other way round. So when their talk and differences increased, Allah's Apostle said, "Get up." Ibn `Abbas used to say, "No doubt, it was very unfortunate (a great disaster) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was prevented from writing for them that writing because of their differences and noise
hi: Ubaidullah bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apni wafat ki bimari mein the aur ghar mein kuch log maujood the, unhone farmaya, 'Paas aao, main tumhare liye kuch likh doon jiske baad tum gumraah nahi hoge.' Unmein se kuch (sahaba) ne kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) sakht bimar hain aur tumhare paas Quran maujood hai, Allah ki Kitaab hamare liye kaafi hai.' Isper ghar ke logon mein ikhtelaf ho gaya aur bahas shuru ho gayi. Kuch ne kaha, 'Inhe likhne ka saamaan do taake ye tumhare liye kuch likh dein jiske baad tum gumraah na ho,' jabke doosron ne iske khilaaf kaha. Jab unki baaton aur ikhtelaf mein izaafa hua, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Uth jao (chale jao).' Ibn Abbas kaha karte the, 'Ye bahut bada nuqsaan (musibat) tha ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko unke ikhtelaf aur shor ki wajah se wo baat likhne se rok diya gaya.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) called Fatima during his fatal illness and told her something secretly and she wept. Then he called her again and told her something secretly, and she started laughing. When we asked her about that, she said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) first told me secretly that he would expire in that disease in which he died, so I wept; then he told me secretly that I would be the first of his family to follow him, so I laughed ( at that time)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ne apni aakhri bimari mein Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ko bulaya aur unse kuch chupke se kaha, jispar wo ro padi. Phir unhone dobara bulaya aur kuch aur chupke se kaha, jispar wo hansne lagi. Jab humne unse iski wajah poochi, to unhone bataya, 'Nabi (SAW) ne pehle mujhe chupke se bataya ke wo isi bimari mein wafat pa jaayenge, is liye main ro padi; phir unhone bataya ke unke gharwalon mein sabse pehle main unse (jaakar) milungi, is liye main has padi.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:I used to hear (from the Prophet) that no Prophet dies till he is given the option to select either the worldly life or the life of the Hereafter. I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) in his fatal disease, with his voice becoming hoarse, saying, "In the company of those on whom is the grace of Allah ..( to the end of the Verse )." (4.69) Thereupon I thought that the Prophet (ﷺ) had been given the option
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Main (Nabi SAW se) suna karti thi ke koi Nabi tab tak wafat nahi paata jab tak use duniya ki zindagi aur aakhirat ki zindagi mein se ek chunne ka ikhtiyar na diya jaaye. Maine Nabi (SAW) ko unki aakhri bimari mein, jab unki awaaz bhaari ho gayi thi, ye kehte suna, 'Un logon ke saath jinpar Allah ka inaam hua hai...' (aayat ke aakhir tak). Isse mujhe laga ke unhe (aakhirat chunne ka) ikhtiyar de diya gaya hai.

e: Narrated `Aisha:When the Prophet (ﷺ) fell ill in his fatal illness, he started saying, "With the highest companion
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab Nabi (SAW) apni aakhri bimari mein bimar pade, to wo kehne lage, '(Mujhe) sabse buland saathi ke saath (rakh).'

e: Narrated Aisha:When Allah's Apostle was in good health, he used to say, "Never does a prophet die unless he is shown his place in Paradise ( before his death ), and then he is made alive or given the option." When the Prophet became ill and his last moments came while his head was on my thigh, he became unconscious, and when he came to his senses, he looked towards the roof of the house and then said, "O Allah! (Please let me be) with the highest companion." Thereupon I said, "Hence he is not going to stay with us?" Then I came to know that his state was the confirmation of the narration he used to mention to us while he was in good health
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) tandurust the, to farmaya karte the, 'Koi Nabi tab tak wafat nahi paata jab tak use jannat mein uski jagah dikha na di jaaye, uske baad use zinda rakha jaata hai ya ikhtiyar diya jaata hai.' Jab Nabi (SAW) bimar hue aur unke aakhri lamhe aaye, us waqt unka sar mere ran par tha, wo behosh ho gaye, aur jab hosh mein aaye to chhat ki taraf dekha aur farmaya, 'Aye Allah! (Mujhe) sabse buland saathi ke saath rakh.' Isper maine (dil mein) socha, 'To ab ye hamare saath nahi rahenge.' Phir mujhe samajh aaya ke unki ye halat usi baat ki tasdeeq thi jo wo tandurusti mein hamein bataya karte the.

e: Narrated Aisha:`Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Bakr entered upon the Prophet (ﷺ) while I was supporting the Prophet (ﷺ) on my chest. `AbdurRahman had a fresh Siwak then and he was cleaning his teeth with it. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) looked at it, so I took the Siwak, cut it (chewed it with my teeth), shook it and made it soft (with water), and then gave it to the Prophet (ﷺ) who cleaned his teeth with it. I had never seen Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) cleaning his teeth in a better way. After finishing the brushing of his teeth, he lifted his hand or his finger and said thrice, "O Allah! Let me be with the highest companions," and then died. `Aisha used to say, "He died while his head was resting between my chest and chin
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Abdur Rahman bin Abu Bakr Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye, us waqt main Nabi (SAW) ko apne seene se tikaaye hue thi. Abdur Rahman ke paas ek taaza Siwak tha aur wo usse apne daant saaf kar rahe the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne uski taraf dekha, to maine wo Siwak le liya, use chaba kar aur paani se naram karke Nabi (SAW) ko de diya, unhone usse apne daant saaf kiye. Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko isse pehle kabhi itni achi tarah daant saaf karte nahi dekha tha. Daant saaf karne ke baad, unhone apna haath ya ungli uthaayi aur teen baar farmaya, 'Aye Allah! Mujhe sabse buland saathiyon ke saath rakh,' aur phir wafat ho gayi. Aisha kaha karti thin, 'Unka wisal us waqt hua jab unka sar mere seene aur thodi ke beech tha.'

e: Narrated Aisha:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) became ill, he used to recite the Muawidhatan (i.e. the last two surahs of the Qur'an) and blow his breath over himself (after their recitation ) and rubbed his hands over his body. So when he was afflicted with his fatal illness. I started reciting the Muawidhatan and blowing my breath over him as he used to do and then I rubbed the hand of the Prophet (ﷺ) over his body
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab bhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) bimar hote, to Muawwidhatain (Quran ki aakhri do Surahein) padhte, apni saans khud par phoonkte aur apne haathon ko apne badan par phairte. Jab wo apni aakhri bimari mein mubtala hue, to main unki jagah Muawwidhatain padhne aur unpar phoonkne lagi, jaisa wo khud kiya karte the, phir unke apne haath ko unke badan par phairne lagi.

e: Narrated `Aisha:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) and listened to him before his death while he was leaning his back on me and saying, "O Allah! Forgive me, and bestow Your Mercy on me, and let me meet the (highest) companions (of the Hereafter)." (See the Qur'an (4:69) and Hadith
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine apni maut se pehle Nabi (SAW) ko, jab wo mere upar tek lagaaye hue the, ye kehte suna, 'Aye Allah! Mujhe maaf farma, mujh par apni rehmat naazil farma, aur mujhe (sabse) buland saathiyon se mila de.'

e: Narrated `Urwa bin Az-Zubair:`Aisha said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) said during his fatal illness, "Allah cursed the Jews for they took the graves of their prophets as places for worship." `Aisha added, "Had it not been for that (statement of the Prophet ) his grave would have been made conspicuous. But he was afraid that it might be taken as a place for worship
hi: Urwa bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha, 'Nabi (SAW) ne apni aakhri bimari mein farmaya, "Allah ne Yahudiyon par laanat ki, kyunke unhone apne Nabiyon ki qabron ko ibaadat-gaah bana liya tha."' Aisha ne aage kaha, 'Agar ye baat na hoti to unki qabr khuli-aam (numaayan) banayi jaati, magar unhe dar tha ke kahin ise ibaadat-gaah na bana liya jaaye.'

e: Narrated Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) "When the ailment of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) became aggravated, he requested his wives to permit him to be (treated) nursed in my house, and they gave him permission. He came out (to my house), walking between two men with his feet dragging on the ground, between `Abbas bin `Abdul--Muttalib and another man" 'Ubaidullah said, "I told `Abdullah of what `Aisha had said, `Abdullah bin `Abbas said to me, 'Do you know who is the other man whom `Aisha did not name?' I said, 'No.' Ibn `Abbas said, 'It was `Ali bin Abu Talib." `Aisha, the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ) used to narrate saying, "When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered my house and his disease became aggravated, he said, " Pour on me the water of seven water skins, the mouths of which have not been untied, so that I may give advice to the people.' So we let him sit in a big basin belonging to Hafsa, the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ) and then started to pour water on him from these water skins till he started pointing to us with his hands intending to say, 'You have done your job." `Aisha added, "Then he went out to the people and led them in prayer and preached to them
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki zawja) bataati hain: 'Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki bimari badh gayi, to unhone apni azwaaj se ijaazat maangi ke unka ilaaj mere ghar mein ho, aur unhone ijaazat de di. Wo (mere ghar) do aadmiyon ke sahaare, paanv zameen par ghisaite hue nikle - Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib aur ek aur shaks ke darmiyan.' Ubaidullah kehte hain, 'Maine Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko Aisha ki ye baat bataayi. Abdullah bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne mujhse pucha, "Kya tumhe pata hai wo dusra shaks kaun tha jiska naam Aisha ne nahi liya?" Maine kaha, "Nahi." Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Wo Ali (Alayhis Salam) bin Abu Talib the."' Aisha (Nabi ki zawja) bataya karti thin, 'Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mere ghar mein daakhil hue aur unki bimari badh gayi, to unhone farmaya, "Mujh par saat mashkon ka paani daalo, jinke muh nahi khole gaye hon, taake main logon ko naseehat kar sakoon."' Hum unhe Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki zawja) ke ek bade tashat mein bithaya, aur unpar in mashkon se paani daalne lage, yahaan tak ke unhone apne haathon se ishara karke kaha, 'Tumne apna kaam kar diya.' Aisha ne aage kaha, 'Phir wo bahar aaye aur logon ko namaz padhaayi aur unhe naseehat ki.'

e: Aisha and `Abdullah bin `Abbas said, "When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) became ill seriously, he started covering his face with his woolen sheet, and when he felt short of breath, he removed it from his face and said, 'That is so! Allah's curse be on the Jews and the Christians, as they took the graves of their prophets as (places of worship),' intending to warn (the Muslims) of what they had done
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) aur Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: 'Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) sakht bimar hue, to wo apna chehra apni oon ki chaadar se dhakne lage, aur jab unhe saans lene mein dikkat hoti to chaadar hata dete aur farmate, "Aisa hi hai! Yahudiyon aur Nasaara par Allah ki laanat ho, unhone apne Nabiyon ki qabron ko ibaadat-gaah bana liya tha," (Musalmanon ko) usi cheez se khabardaar karte hue jo unhone (Yahud-o-Nasaara ne) ki thi.'

e: Aisha added, "I argued with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) repeatedly about that matter (i.e. his order that Abu Bakr should lead the people in prayer in his place when he was ill), and what made me argue so much, was, that it never occurred to my mind that after the Prophet, the people would ever love a man who had taken his place, and I felt that anybody standing in his place, would be a bad omen to the people, so I wanted Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to give up the idea of choosing Abu Bakr (to lead the people in prayer)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne aage kaha: 'Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se is baat par (yaani unka ye hukm ke bimari mein Abu Bakr unki jagah namaz padhaayein) baar baar bahas ki, aur itni zyada bahas karne ki wajah ye thi ke mere zehen mein kabhi ye baat nahi aayi thi ke Nabi (SAW) ke baad log unki jagah lene waale kisi shaks se mohabbat karenge, aur mujhe laga ke jo bhi unki jagah khada hoga uske liye ye logon ki nazar mein badshugooni (bad-faal) hogi, is liye main chahti thi ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Abu Bakr ko (is kaam ke liye) chunne ka iraada chhod dein.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) died while he was between my chest and chin, so I never dislike the death agony for anyone after the Prophet
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ki wafat us waqt hui jab wo mere seene aur thodi ke beech the, isliye mujhe Nabi (SAW) ke baad kisi ki bhi maut ki sakhti buri nahi lagti.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abbas:`Ali bin Abu Talib came out of the house of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) during his fatal illness. The people asked, "O Abu Hasan (i.e. `Ali)! How is the health of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) this morning?" `Ali replied, "He has recovered with the Grace of Allah." `Abbas bin `Abdul Muttalib held him by the hand and said to him, "In three days you, by Allah, will be ruled (by somebody else). And by Allah, I feel that Allah's Apostle will die from this ailment of his, for I know how the faces of the offspring of `Abdul Muttalib look at the time of their death. So let us go to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and ask him who will take over the Caliphate. If it is given to us we will know as to it, and if it is given to somebody else, we will inform him so that he may tell the new ruler to take care of us." `Ali said, "By Allah, if we asked Allah's Apostle for it (i.e. the Caliphate) and he denied it to us, the people will never give it to us after that. And by Allah, I will not ask Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for it
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bin Abu Talib Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki aakhri bimari ke dauraan (ghar se) baahar aaye. Logon ne pucha, 'Aye Abu Hasan (yaani Ali (Alayhis Salam))! Aaj subah Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki tabiyat kaisi hai?' Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne jawab diya, 'Allah ke fazl se, wo theek ho gaye hain.' Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib ne unka haath pakda aur kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, teen din mein tum par (kisi aur ki) hukoomat ho jaayegi. Aur Allah ki qasam, mujhe lagta hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) is bimari mein wafat pa jaayenge, kyunke mujhe pata hai Abdul Muttalib ki aulaad ke chehre maut ke waqt kaise hote hain. Chalo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas chalte hain aur unse pucchte hain ke Khilafat kise di jaayegi. Agar wo humein di gayi to hum jaan jaayenge, aur agar kisi aur ko di gayi to hum use bata denge taake wo naye Khalifa se hamara khayal rakhne ko keh sake.' Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, agar humne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye (Khilafat) maangi aur unhone hume na di, to log hume kabhi ye nahi denge iske baad. Aur Allah ki qasam, main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye nahi maangunga.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:While the Muslims were offering the Fajr prayer on Monday and Abu Bakr was leading them in prayer, suddenly Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) lifted the curtain of `Aisha's dwelling and looked at them while they were in the rows of the prayers and smiled. Abu Bakr retreated to join the row, thinking that Allah's Apostle wanted to come out for the prayer. The Muslims were about to be put to trial in their prayer (i.e. were about to give up praying) because of being overjoyed at seeing Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). But Allah's Apostle beckoned them with his hand to complete their prayer and then entered the dwelling and let fall the curtain
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Musalmaan Somwaar ke din Fajr ki namaz padh rahe the aur Abu Bakr unhe namaz padha rahe the, achanak Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke hujre ka parda utha diya aur unhe namaz ki safon mein dekha aur muskuraaye. Abu Bakr (namaz chodkar) saf mein wapas aane laage, ye soch kar ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) namaz ke liye baahar aana chahte hain. Musalmaan Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko dekh kar khushi se apni namaz mein fitne mein padne hi waale the (yaani namaz chodne hi waale the), magar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe haath se ishara karke apni namaz poori karne ko kaha, phir hujre mein wapas chale gaye aur parda gira diya.

e: Narrated Aisha:It was one of the favors of Allah towards me that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) expired in my house on the day of my turn while he was leaning against my chest and Allah made my saliva mix with his saliva at his death. `Abdur-Rahman entered upon me with a Siwak in his hand and I was supporting (the back of) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (against my chest ). I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) looking at it (i.e. Siwak) and I knew that he loved the Siwak, so I said ( to him ), "Shall I take it for you ? " He nodded in agreement. So I took it and it was too stiff for him to use, so I said, "Shall I soften it for you ?" He nodded his approval. So I softened it and he cleaned his teeth with it. In front of him there was a jug or a tin, (The sub-narrator, `Umar is in doubt as to which was right) containing water. He started dipping his hand in the water and rubbing his face with it, he said, "None has the right to be worshipped except Allah. Death has its agonies." He then lifted his hands (towards the sky) and started saying, "With the highest companion," till he expired and his hand dropped down
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ye Allah ki mujh par ek badi meharbaani thi ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki wafat mere hi ghar mein hui, mere hi baari ke din, jab wo mere seene se tikaaye hue the, aur Allah ne unki maut ke waqt mera lar unke lar ke saath mila diya. Abdur Rahman mere paas ek Siwak liye aaye, aur us waqt main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko (apne seene se) sahaara de rahi thi. Maine dekha ke Nabi (SAW) us (Siwak) ki taraf dekh rahe hain aur mujhe pata tha ke unhe Siwak pasand hai, to maine (unse) kaha, 'Kya main ye aapke liye le loon?' Unhone sar hila kar haan kaha. To maine wo le liya, lekin wo unke istemaal ke liye zyada sakht tha, to maine kaha, 'Kya main ise aapke liye naram kar doon?' Unhone phir sar hila kar haan kaha. To maine use naram kiya aur unhone usse apne daant saaf kiye. Unke saamne ek ghada ya tasla tha (ravi Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko yaqeen nahi ke kaunsa tha) jismein paani tha. Wo apna haath paani mein daal kar apne chehre par phairne lage, aur farmaya, 'Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi. Maut ki apni sakhtiyaan hoti hain.' Phir unhone apne haath (aasman ki taraf) uthaaye aur kehne lage, 'Sabse buland saathi ke saath,' yahaan tak ke unki wafat ho gayi aur unka haath neeche gir gaya.

e: Narrated `Urwa:`Aisha said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in his fatal illness, used to ask, 'Where will I be tomorrow? Where will I be tomorrow?", seeking `Aisha's turn. His wives allowed him to stay wherever he wished. So he stayed at `Aisha's house till he expired while he was with her." `Aisha added, "The Prophet (ﷺ) expired on the day of my turn in my house and he was taken unto Allah while his head was against my chest and his saliva mixed with my saliva." `Aisha added, "Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Bakr came in, carrying a Siwak he was cleaning his teeth with. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) looked at it and I said to him, 'O `AbdurRahman! Give me this Siwak.' So he gave it to me and I cut it, chewed it (it's end) and gave it to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who cleaned his teeth with it while he was resting against my chest
hi: Urwa bataate hain: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apni aakhri bimari mein pucha karte the, "Kal main kahaan hounga? Kal main kahaan hounga?" - wo Aisha ki baari (jaldi aane) ki tamanna kar rahe the. Unki azwaaj ne unhe ijaazat de di ke wo jahaan chahein reh sakte hain. To wo Aisha ke ghar mein rahe, yahaan tak ke unka wisal wahin hua.' Aisha ne aage kaha, 'Nabi (SAW) ki wafat mere ghar mein, mere hi baari ke din hui, aur unhe Allah ke paas is haal mein le jaaya gaya ke unka sar mere seene se tika hua tha aur unka lar mere lar mein mil gaya tha.' Aisha ne ye bhi bataya, 'Abdur Rahman bin Abu Bakr andar aaye, unke haath mein ek Siwak tha jisse wo apne daant saaf kar rahe the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne usko dekha aur maine unse kaha, "Aye Abdur Rahman! Ye Siwak mujhe do." To unhone wo mujhe de diya, maine use kaat kar chabaaya aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko de diya, jinhone usse apne daant saaf kiye jabke wo mere seene se tike hue the.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) expired in my house and on the day of my turn, leaning against my chest. One of us (i.e. the Prophet's wives ) used to recite a prayer asking Allah to protect him from all evils when he became sick. So I started asking Allah to protect him from all evils (by reciting a prayer ). He raised his head towards the sky and said, "With the highest companions, with the highest companions." `Abdur- Rahman bin Abu Bakr passed carrying a fresh leaf-stalk of a date-palm and the Prophet (ﷺ) looked at it and I thought that the Prophet (ﷺ) was in need of it (for cleaning his teeth ). So I took it (from `Abdur Rahman) and chewed its head and shook it and gave it to the Prophet (ﷺ) who cleaned his teeth with it, in the best way he had ever cleaned his teeth, and then he gave it to me, and suddenly his hand dropped down or it fell from his hand (i.e. he expired). So Allah made my saliva mix with his saliva on his last day on earth and his first day in the Hereafter
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ki wafat mere ghar mein, mere baari ke din, mere seene se tike hue hui. Hum mein se koi (Nabi ki koi biwi) jab wo bimar hote to unke liye ek dua padha karti thi jismein Allah se unhe har buraai se mahfooz rakhne ki dua ki jaati thi. To main bhi (dua padh kar) Allah se unhe har buraai se bachaane ki dua karne lagi. Unhone apna sar aasman ki taraf uthaaya aur kaha, 'Sabse buland saathiyon ke saath, sabse buland saathiyon ke saath.' Abdur Rahman bin Abu Bakr khajoor ki ek taazi shaakh liye guzre aur Nabi (SAW) ne usko dekha, aur mujhe laga ke unhe (daant saaf karne ke liye) uski zaroorat hai. To maine wo (Abdur Rahman se) le li aur uske sirey ko chaba kar aur hila kar Nabi (SAW) ko de di, unhone usse apne daant is tarah saaf kiye jaise pehle kabhi nahi kiye the, phir wo mujhe wapas de di, aur achanak unka haath neeche gir gaya ya haath se gir gayi (yaani unki wafat ho gayi). Is tarah Allah ne unki zameen ki aakhri aur aakhirat ki pehli ghadi mein mera lar unke lar ke saath mila diya.

e: Narrated `Aisha:Abu Bakr came from his house at As-Sunh on a horse. He dismounted and entered the Mosque, but did not speak to the people till he entered upon `Aisha and went straight to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who was covered with Hibra cloth (i.e. a kind of Yemenite cloth). He then uncovered the Prophet's face and bowed over him and kissed him and wept, saying, "Let my father and mother be sacrificed for you. By Allah, Allah will never cause you to die twice. As for the death which was written for you, has come upon you." Narrated Ibn `Abbas: Abu Bakr went out while `Umar bin Al-Khattab was talking to the people. Abu Bakr said, "Sit down, O `Umar!" But `Umar refused to sit down. So the people came to Abu Bakr and left `Umar. Abu Bakr said, "To proceed, if anyone amongst you used to worship Muhammad , then Muhammad is dead, but if (anyone of) you used to worship Allah, then Allah is Alive and shall never die. Allah said:--"Muhammad is no more than an Apostle, and indeed (many) apostles have passed away before him..(till the end of the Verse )......Allah will reward to those who are thankful." (3.144) By Allah, it was as if the people never knew that Allah had revealed this Verse before till Abu Bakr recited it and all the people received it from him, and I heard everybody reciting it (then). Narrated Az-Zuhri: Sa`id bin Al-Musaiyab told me that `Umar said, "By Allah, when I heard Abu Bakr reciting it, my legs could not support me and I fell down at the very moment of hearing him reciting it, declaring that the Prophet (ﷺ) had died
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Abu Bakr apne ghar As-Sunh se ghode par sawaar hokar aaye. Wo utre aur Masjid mein daakhil hue, magar kisi se baat nahi ki jab tak Aisha ke paas nahi pahunche aur seedhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaye, jinhein Hibra kapde (yaman ka ek kism ka kapda) se dhaka gaya tha. Unhone Nabi (SAW) ka chehra khola, unpar jhuk gaye, unhe chooma aur rone lage, kaha, 'Mere maa baap aap par qurbaan hon. Allah ki qasam, Allah aapko kabhi do baar maut nahi dega. Jo maut aapke liye likhi thi, wo aa chuki hai.' Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Bakr baahar aaye jabke Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab logon se baat kar rahe the. Abu Bakr ne kaha, 'Baith jao, aye Umar!' Magar Umar ne baithne se inkaar kar diya. To log Abu Bakr ke paas aa gaye aur Umar ko chhod diya. Abu Bakr ne kaha, 'Ab, agar tum mein se koi Muhammad ki ibaadat karta tha, to Muhammad wafat pa chuke hain, lekin agar tum mein se koi Allah ki ibaadat karta hai, to Allah zinda hai aur kabhi nahi marega. Allah ne farmaya hai: "Muhammad ek Rasool hi to hain, aur unse pehle bhi kai Rasool guzar chuke hain..." (Surah Aal-e-Imran, 3:144, aayat ke aakhir tak) "...Allah shukr karne walon ko badla dega."' Allah ki qasam, aisa lagta tha ke logon ko is aayat ke pehle se Allah ke naazil karne ka pata hi nahi tha, jab tak Abu Bakr ne ise padha, aur sab logon ne usse ye seekh li, aur maine sabko usko (baad mein) padhte hue suna. Az-Zuhri bataate hain ke Saeed bin Al-Musaiyab ne mujhe bataya ke Umar ne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, jab maine Abu Bakr ko ye padhte suna, to mere pair mera saath nahi de sake aur main usi waqt gir pada jab maine unse ye sunte hue jaana ke Nabi (SAW) ki wafat ho chuki hai.'

e: Narrated Aisha and Ibn `Abbas:Abu Bakr kissed the Prophet (ﷺ) after his death
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) aur Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Bakr ne Nabi (SAW) ko unki wafat ke baad chooma.

e: Narrated `Aisha:We poured medicine in one side of the Prophet's mouth during his illness and he started pointing to us, meaning to say, "Don't pour medicine in my mouth." We said, "(He says so) because a patient dislikes medicines." When he improved and felt a little better, he said, "Didn't I forbid you to pour medicine in my mouth ?" We said, " ( We thought it was because of) the dislike, patients have for medicines. He said, "Let everyone present in the house be given medicine by pouring it in his mouth while I am looking at him, except `Abbas as he has not witnessed you (doing the same to me)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Humne Nabi (SAW) ki bimari ke dauraan unke muh ke ek taraf dawa daali, to wo humein ishara karne lage, matlab ye ke 'mere muh mein dawa mat daalo.' Humne (aapas mein) socha, '(Wo aisa isliye keh rahe hain kyunke) bimar aadmi ko dawa pasand nahi aati.' Jab unki tabiyat kuch sudhri aur unhe thoda achha laga, to unhone kaha, 'Kya maine tumhe mana nahi kiya tha ke mere muh mein dawa mat daalo?' Humne kaha, '(Humne socha ye) bimaron ka dawa se natthak hai.' Unhone farmaya, 'Ghar mein jitne log maujood hain sabko dawa unke muh mein daal kar do jabki main dekh raha hoon, siwaaye Abbas ke, kyunke unhone tumhe (mujh par) aisa karte nahi dekha.'

e: Narrated Al-Aswad:It was mentioned in the presence of `Aisha that the Prophet (ﷺ) had appointed `Ali as successor by will. Thereupon she said, "Who said so? I saw the Prophet, while I was supporting him against my chest. He asked for a tray, and then fell on one side and expired, and I did not feel it. So how (do the people say) he appointed `Ali as his successor?
hi: Al-Aswad bataate hain: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke saamne ye baat ki gayi ke Nabi (SAW) ne Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko apna waaris muqarrar kiya tha (wasiyat ke zariye). Isper unhone kaha, 'Ye kisne kaha? Maine Nabi (SAW) ko dekha, jab main unhe apne seene se sahaara de rahi thi. Unhone ek tashtri maangi, phir ek taraf gir gaye aur unki wafat ho gayi, aur mujhe iska ehsaas bhi nahi hua. To phir (log kaise kehte hain ke) unhone Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko apna waaris muqarrar kiya?'

e: Narrated Talha:I asked `Abdullah bin Abu `Aufa "Did the Prophet (ﷺ) make a will? ' He replied, "No." I further asked, "How come is it that the making of a will was enjoined on the people or that they were ordered to make it? " He said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) made a will concerning Allah's Book
hi: Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abu Aufa se pucha, 'Kya Nabi (SAW) ne koi wasiyat ki thi?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Nahi.' Maine phir pucha, 'To phir logon ko wasiyat karne ka hukm kyun diya gaya, ya unhe iska aadesh kyun diya gaya?' Unhone kaha, 'Nabi (SAW) ne Allah ki Kitaab ke baare mein wasiyat ki thi.'

e: Narrated 'Amir bin Al-Harith:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not leave a Dinar or a Dirham or a male or a female slave. He left only his white mule on which he used to ride, and his weapons, and a piece of land which he gave in charity for the needy travelers
hi: Amir bin Al-Harith bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne peeche na koi Dinar chhoda, na Dirham, na koi ghulaam, na koi launDi. Unhone sirf apna safed khachar chhoda jispar wo sawaar hote the, apne hathiyaar, aur zameen ka ek tukda jo unhone zaroorat-mand musaafiron ke liye sadqa kar diya tha.

e: Narrated Anas:When the ailment of the Prophet (ﷺ) got aggravated, he became unconscious whereupon Fatima said, "Oh, how distressed my father is!" He said, "Your father will have no more distress after today." When he expired, she said, "O Father! Who has responded to the call of the Lord Who has invited him! O Father, whose dwelling place is the Garden of Paradise (i.e. Al-Firdaus)! O Father! We convey this news (of your death) to Gabriel." When he was buried, Fatima said, "O Anas! Do you feel pleased to throw earth over Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Nabi (SAW) ki bimari badh gayi to wo behosh ho gaye, isper Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ne kaha, 'Haaye, mere abba kitni takleef mein hain!' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Aaj ke baad tumhare abba par koi takleef nahi hogi.' Jab unki wafat ho gayi, to Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ne kaha, 'Aye Abba! Us Rab ki pukaar par labbaik kaha jisne aapko bulaya! Aye Abba, jinka thikaana Jannat-ul-Firdaus hai! Aye Abba! Hum ye khabar Jibrael ko sunaate hain.' Jab unhein dafn kar diya gaya, to Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ne kaha, 'Aye Anas! Kya tumhe achha laga ke tum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) par mitti daalo?'

e: Narrated `Aisha:When the Prophet (ﷺ) was healthy, he used to say, "No soul of a prophet is captured till he is shown his place in Paradise and then he is given the option." When death approached him while his head was on my thigh, he became unconscious and then recovered his consciousness. He then looked at the ceiling of the house and said, "O Allah! (with) the highest companions." I said (to myself), "Hence, he is not going to choose us." Then I realized that what he had said was the application of the narration which he used to mention to us when he was healthy. The last word he spoke was, "O Allah! (with) the highest companion
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab Nabi (SAW) tandurust hote, to farmaya karte the, 'Kisi Nabi ki rooh tab tak nahi qabz ki jaati jab tak use jannat mein uski jagah dikha na di jaaye, uske baad use ikhtiyar diya jaata hai.' Jab unki maut nazdeek aayi, us waqt unka sar mere ran par tha, wo behosh ho gaye aur phir hosh mein aaye. Phir unhone ghar ki chhat ki taraf dekha aur farmaya, 'Aye Allah! (Mujhe) sabse buland saathiyon ke saath (rakh).' Maine (dil mein) socha, 'To ab ye hamein nahi chunenge.' Phir mujhe samajh aaya ke unhone jo kaha wo usi baat ki tasdeeq thi jo wo tandurusti mein hamein bataya karte the. Unke aakhri alfaaz the, 'Aye Allah! (Mujhe) sabse buland saathi ke saath (rakh).'

e: Narrated Aisha and Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) stayed for ten years in Mecca with the Qur'an being revealed to him and he stayed in Medina for ten years
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) aur Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) Makkah mein das saal tak rahe, is dauraan unpar Quran naazil hota raha, aur Madina mein bhi wo das saal tak rahe.

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Apostle died when he was sixty-three years of age
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki wafat us waqt hui jab unki umar teisath (63) saal thi.

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) died while his armor was mortgaged to a Jew for thirty Sa's of barley
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ki wafat is haal mein hui ke unki zirah (loha ki jaali wali jacket) ek yahudi ke paas tees Saa jau ke badle girvi rakhi hui thi.

e: Narrated Salim's father:The Prophet (ﷺ) appointed Usama as the commander of the troops (to be sent to Syria). The Muslims spoke about Usama (unfavorably ). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, " I have been informed that you spoke about Usama. (Let it be known that ) he is the most beloved of all people to me
hi: Salim ke waalid bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne Usama ko (Sham bhejne wale) lashkar ka sardaar muqarrar kiya. Musalmaanon ne Usama ke baare mein (na-pasandeedgi se) baatein kin. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Mujhe pata chala hai ke tum Usama ke baare mein baatein kar rahe ho. (Jaan lo ke) wo mujhe sab logon mein sabse aziz hai.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent troops and appointed Usama bin Zaid as their commander. The people criticized his leadership. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got up and said, "If you (people) are criticizing his (i.e. Usama's) leadership you used to criticize the leadership of his father before. By Allah, he (i.e. Zaid) deserved the leadership indeed, and he used to be one of the most beloved persons to me, and now this (i.e. his son, Usama) is one of the most beloved persons to me after him
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek lashkar bheja aur Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko unka sardaar muqarrar kiya. Logon ne unki sardaari par aitraaz kiya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khade hue aur farmaya, 'Agar tum log iski (yaani Usama ki) sardaari par aitraaz kar rahe ho, to tum log isse pehle iske waalid ki sardaari par bhi aitraaz kiya karte the. Allah ki qasam, wo (yaani Zaid) sardaari ke haq-daar the, aur wo mujhe sabse aziz logon mein se the, aur ab ye (yaani unka beta Usama) unke baad mujhe sabse aziz hai.'

e: Narrated Ibn Abu Habib:Abu Al-Khair said, "As-Sunabihi asked (me), 'When did you migrate?' I (i.e. Abu Al-Khair) said, 'We went out from Yemen as emigrants and arrived at Al-Juhfa, and there came a rider whom I asked about the news. The rider said: We buried the Prophet (ﷺ) five days ago." I asked (As-Sunabihi), 'Did you hear anything about the night of Qadr?' He replied, 'Bilal, the Mu'adh-dhin of the Prophet (ﷺ) informed me that it is on one of the seven nights of the last ten days (of Ramadan)
hi: Ibn Abu Habib bataate hain: Abu Al-Khair ne kaha, 'As-Sunabihi ne mujhse pucha, "Tum kab hijrat karke aaye?" Maine (yaani Abu Al-Khair ne) kaha, "Hum Yemen se hijrat karke nikle aur Al-Juhfa pahunche, wahaan ek sawaar aaya jisse maine khabar poochi. Us sawaar ne kaha: Humne Nabi (SAW) ko paanch din pehle dafn kiya."' Maine (As-Sunabihi se) pucha, 'Kya tumne Laila-tul-Qadr ke baare mein kuch suna?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Nabi (SAW) ke Muazzin Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne mujhe bataya ke ye (Ramzan ke) aakhri dus dinon ki saat raaton mein se ek hai.'

e: Narrated Abu 'Is-haq:I asked Zaid bin Al-Arqam, "In how many Ghazawat did you take part in the company of Allah's Apostle?" He replied, "Seventeen." I further asked, "How many Ghazawat did the Prophet (ﷺ) fight?" He replied, "Nineteen
hi: Abu Ishaq bataate hain: Maine Zaid bin Al-Arqam se pucha, 'Aap Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath kitni Ghazwaaton mein shareek hue?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Satrah (17).' Maine phir pucha, 'Nabi (SAW) ne kitni Ghazwaaten ladin?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Unnis (19).'

e: Narrated Al-Bara:I fought fifteen Ghazawat in the company of the Prophet
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ke saath pandrah (15) Ghazwaaton mein hissa liya.

e: Narrated Buraida:That he fought sixteen Ghazawat with Allah's Apostle
hi: Buraida (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath solah (16) Ghazwaaten lariin.

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id bin Al-Mu'alla:While I was praying in the Mosque, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) called me but I did not respond to him. Later I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I was praying." He said, "Didn't Allah say'--"Give your response to Allah (by obeying Him) and to His Apostle when he calls you." (8.24) He then said to me, "I will teach you a Sura which is the greatest Sura in the Qur'an, before you leave the Mosque." Then he got hold of my hand, and when he intended to leave (the Mosque), I said to him, "Didn't you say to me, 'I will teach you a Sura which is the greatest Sura in the Qur'an?' He said, "Al-Hamdu-Li l-lah Rabbi-l-`alamin (i.e. Praise be to Allah, the Lord of the worlds) which is Al-Sab'a Al-Mathani (i.e. seven repeatedly recited Verses) and the Grand Qur'an which has been given to me
hi: Abu Saeed bin Al-Mu'alla bataate hain: Main Masjid mein namaz padh raha tha ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe bulaya, magar maine jawab nahi diya. Baad mein maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Main namaz mein tha.' Unhone farmaya, 'Kya Allah ne nahi farmaya, "Jab Allah aur Rasool tumhe bulaayein to unki pukaar ka jawab do" (Surah Al-Anfal 8:24)?' Phir unhone mujhse kaha, 'Masjid se nikalne se pehle main tumhe wo Surah sikhaunga jo Quran ki sabse azeem Surah hai.' Phir unhone mera haath pakad liya, aur jab wo (Masjid se) nikalne lage to maine unse kaha, 'Kya aapne mujhse nahi kaha tha ke aap mujhe Quran ki sabse azeem Surah sikhaayenge?' Unhone farmaya, 'Alhamdulillahi Rabbil Aalameen (yaani sab tareef Allah ke liye jo saare jahaanon ka Rab hai) - yahi As-Sab'a Al-Mathani (baar baar padhi jaane wali saat aayatein) hai, aur yahi wo azeem Quran hai jo mujhe diya gaya hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When the Imam says: 'Ghair-il-Maghdubi `alaihim Walad-Dallin (i.e. not the path of those who earn Your Anger, nor the path of those who went astray (1.7)), then you must say, 'Ameen', for if one's utterance of 'Ameen' coincides with that of the angels, then his past sins will be forgiven
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab Imaam "Ghair-il-Maghdoobi Alaihim Walad-Daaalliin" (na un logon ka raasta jinpar Tera ghazab hua, na gumraahon ka) kahe, to tum "Ameen" kaho, kyunke agar kisi ka "Ameen" kehna farishton ke "Ameen" kehne se mil jaaye, to uske pichhle gunaah maaf kar diye jaate hain.'

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "On the Day of Resurrection the Believers will assemble and say, 'Let us ask somebody to intercede for us with our Lord.' So they will go to Adam and say, 'You are the father of all the people, and Allah created you with His Own Hands, and ordered the angels to prostrate to you, and taught you the names of all things; so please intercede for us with your Lord, so that He may relieve us from this place of ours.' Adam will say, 'I am not fit for this (i.e. intercession for you).' Then Adam will remember his sin and feel ashamed thereof. He will say, 'Go to Noah, for he was the first Apostle, Allah sent to the inhabitants of the earth.' They will go to him and Noah will say, 'I am not fit for this undertaking.' He will remember his appeal to his Lord to do what he had no knowledge of, then he will feel ashamed thereof and will say, 'Go to the Khalil-ur-Rahman (i.e. Abraham).' They will go to him and he will say, 'I am not fit for this undertaking. Go to Moses, the slave to whom Allah spoke (directly) and gave him the Torah .' So they will go to him and he will say, 'I am not fit for this undertaking.' and he will mention (his) killing a person who was not a killer, and so he will feel ashamed thereof before his Lord, and he will say, 'Go to Jesus, Allah's Slave, His Apostle and Allah's Word and a Spirit coming from Him. Jesus will say, 'I am not fit for this undertaking, go to Muhammad the Slave of Allah whose past and future sins were forgiven by Allah.' So they will come to me and I will proceed till I will ask my Lord's Permission and I will be given permission. When I see my Lord, I will fall down in Prostration and He will let me remain in that state as long as He wishes and then I will be addressed.' (Muhammad!) Raise your head. Ask, and your request will be granted; say, and your saying will be listened to; intercede, and your intercession will be accepted.' I will raise my head and praise Allah with a saying (i.e. invocation) He will teach me, and then I will intercede. He will fix a limit for me (to intercede for) whom I will admit into Paradise. Then I will come back again to Allah, and when I see my Lord, the same thing will happen to me. And then I will intercede and Allah will fix a limit for me to intercede whom I will let into Paradise, then I will come back for the third time; and then I will come back for the fourth time, and will say, 'None remains in Hell but those whom the Qur'an has imprisoned (in Hell) and who have been destined to an eternal stay in Hell.' " (The compiler) Abu `Abdullah said: 'But those whom the Qur'an has imprisoned in Hell,' refers to the Statement of Allah: "They will dwell therein forever
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Qayamat ke din momineen ikattha honge aur kahenge, "Chalo kisi se kahen ke hamare Rab ke saamne hamari shifaarish kare." To wo Adam ke paas jaayenge aur kahenge, "Aap sab insaano ke waalid hain, Allah ne aapko apne haathon se banaya, farishton ko aapko sajda karne ka hukm diya, aur aapko sab cheezon ke naam sikhaaye; hamare liye apne Rab ke saamne shifaarish kijiye, taake wo humein is jagah se rihaai de." Adam kahenge, "Main is kaabil nahi." Phir unhe apna gunaah yaad aayega aur wo sharminda ho jaayenge. Wo kahenge, "Nooh ke paas jao, wo pehle Rasool the jo Allah ne zameen walon ke liye bheje." Log Nooh ke paas jaayenge, wo kahenge, "Main is kaam ke laayak nahi." Unhe apni wo dua yaad aayegi jo unhone bina ilm ke ki thi, aur wo sharminda hokar kahenge, "Ibrahim (Khalilur-Rahman) ke paas jao." Wo Ibrahim ke paas jaayenge, wo kahenge, "Main is laayak nahi. Musa ke paas jao, jinse Allah ne khud kalaam kiya aur unhe Tauret di." Wo Musa ke paas jaayenge, wo kahenge, "Main is laayak nahi," aur unhe ek insaan ko (galti se) qatl karne ki baat yaad aayegi, jispar wo apne Rab ke saamne sharminda honge, aur kahenge, "Isa ke paas jao, jo Allah ke bande, Rasool, Allah ka Kalima aur uski taraf se ek Rooh hain." Isa kahenge, "Main is laayak nahi, Muhammad (SAW) ke paas jao, jinke agle-pichhle sab gunaah Allah ne maaf kar diye." To wo log mere paas aayenge aur main (Allah ke paas) jaaunga, apne Rab se ijaazat maangunga aur mujhe ijaazat mil jaayegi. Jab main apne Rab ko dekhunga, to main sajde mein gir jaaunga, aur Allah mujhe jitni der chaahega usi haalat mein rehne dega, phir mujhse kaha jaayega, "(Aye Muhammad!) Apna sar uthao. Maango, tumhe diya jaayega; kaho, tumhari baat suni jaayegi; shifaarish karo, tumhari shifaarish qubool ki jaayegi." Main apna sar uthaunga aur Allah ki aisi tareef karunga jo wo mujhe sikhaayega, phir main shifaarish karunga. Wo mere liye ek hadd muqarrar karega ke main kitne logon ko Jannat mein daakhil kar sakta hoon. Phir main dobara Allah ke paas jaaunga, aur jab main apne Rab ko dekhunga, to yahi sab dobara hoga. Phir main shifaarish karunga aur Allah phir ek hadd muqarrar karega, phir main teesri baar jaaunga; aur chauthi baar jaaunga, aur kahunga, "Jahannam mein sirf wo log bache rahenge jinhe Quran ne (wahin) qaid kar diya hai aur jinka hamesha ke liye wahin rehna tay ho chuka hai."' (Kitaab ke musannif Abu Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) kehte hain: 'Jinhe Quran ne qaid kar diya hai' - ye Allah ke us farmaan ki taraf ishara hai jo kehta hai ke wo hamesha usi mein rahenge.)

e: Narrated `Abdullah:I asked the Prophet, "What is the greatest sin in the Sight of Allah?" He said, "That you set up a rival unto Allah though He Alone created you." I said, "That is indeed a great sin." Then asked, "What is next?" He said, "To kill your son lest he should share your food with you." I asked, "What is next?" He said, "To commit illegal sexual intercourse with the wife of your neighbor
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) se pucha, 'Allah ke nazdeek sabse bada gunaah kya hai?' Unhone farmaya, 'Ye ke tum Allah ka koi shareek thehrao, jabke usne akele tumhe paida kiya.' Maine kaha, 'Ye to waaqai bahut bada gunaah hai.' Maine pucha, 'Uske baad kya?' Unhone farmaya, 'Apne bete ko is dar se qatl karna ke wo tumhare khaane mein hissedaar banega.' Maine pucha, 'Uske baad kya?' Unhone farmaya, 'Apne padosi ki biwi se zina karna.'

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Zaid:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The Kam'a (i.e. a kind of edible fungus) is like the Manna (in that it is obtained without effort) and its water is a (medicine) cure for eye trouble
hi: Saeed bin Zaid bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kam'a (ek qism ka khaane laayak fungus/khumb) Mann (bagair mehnat ke milne wali cheez) ki tarah hai, aur uska paani aankhon ki bimari ke liye ilaaj hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It was said to the children of Israel, 'Enter the gate (of the town), prostrate (in humility) and say: Hittatun (i.e. repentance) i.e. O Allah! Forgive our sins.' But they entered by dragging themselves on their buttocks, so they did something different (from what they had been ordered to do) and said, 'Hittatun,' but added, "A grain in a hair
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Bani Israel se kaha gaya tha, "Shehar ke darwaze mein jhukte hue daakhil ho aur kaho: Hittatun (yaani Aye Allah! Hamare gunaah maaf kar de)." Magar wo apne chootadon ke bal ghisadte hue daakhil hue, is tarah unhone wo kaam alag tarike se kiya (jaisa unhe kaha gaya tha uske khilaaf), aur "Hittatun" kehne ki bajaaye kuch aur (mazaakiya baat) mila kar keh diya.'

e: Narrated Anas:`Abdullah bin Salam heard the news of the arrival of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (at Medina) while he was on a farm collecting its fruits. So he came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "I will ask you about three things which nobody knows unless he be a prophet. Firstly, what is the first portent of the Hour? What is the first meal of the people of Paradise? And what makes a baby look like its father or mother?'. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Just now Gabriel has informed me about that." `Abdullah said, "Gabriel?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Yes." `Abdullah said, "He, among the angels is the enemy of the Jews." On that the Prophet (ﷺ) recited this Holy Verse:-- "Whoever is an enemy to Gabriel (let him die in his fury!) for he has brought it (i.e. Qur'an) down to your heart by Allah's permission." (2.97) Then he added, "As for the first portent of the Hour, it will be a fire that will collect the people from the East to West. And as for the first meal of the people of Paradise, it will be the caudate (i.e. extra) lobe of the fish liver. And if a man's discharge preceded that of the woman, then the child resembles the father, and if the woman's discharge preceded that of the man, then the child resembles the mother." On hearing that, `Abdullah said, "I testify that None has the right to be worshipped but Allah, and that you are the Messenger of Allah. O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ); the Jews are liars, and if they should come to know that I have embraced Islam, they would accuse me of being a liar." In the meantime some Jews came (to the Prophet) and he asked them, "What is `Abdullah's status amongst you?" They replied, "He is the best amongst us, and he is our chief and the son of our chief." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "What would you think if `Abdullah bin Salam embraced Islam?" They replied, "May Allah protect him from this!" Then `Abdullah came out and said, "I testify that None has the right to be worshipped but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah." The Jews then said, "Abdullah is the worst of us and the son of the worst of us," and disparaged him. On that `Abdullah said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! This is what I was afraid of
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Salam (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke (Madina) aane ki khabar suni jabke wo apne khet mein phal tod rahe the. Wo Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha, 'Main aapse teen aisi baatein poochunga jo koi Nabi ke siwa nahi jaanta. Pehli, Qayamat ki pehli alaamat kya hogi? Jannatiyon ka pehla khaana kya hoga? Aur bacha apne waalid ya waalida se kyun milta-julta hai?' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Abhi abhi Jibrael ne mujhe ye batlaaya hai.' Abdullah ne kaha, 'Jibrael?' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Haan.' Abdullah ne kaha, 'Farishton mein wahi to Yahudiyon ka dushman hai.' Isper Nabi (SAW) ne ye Aayat padhi: 'Jo koi Jibrael ka dushman ho... kyunke usne isko (yaani Quran ko) Allah ke hukm se tumhare dil par utaara hai.' (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:97) Phir farmaya, 'Qayamat ki pehli alaamat aisi aag hogi jo logon ko purab se pashchim tak ikattha karegi. Jannatiyon ka pehla khaana machhli ke jigar ka extra (zaayed) hissa hoga. Aur agar mard ka maadda pehle nikle to bacha waalid jaisa hota hai, aur agar aurat ka pehle nikle to bacha waalida jaisa hota hai.' Ye sunkar Abdullah ne kaha, 'Main gawaahi deta hoon ke Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi, aur aap Allah ke Rasool hain. Aye Allah ke Rasool! Yahudi jhoote hain, agar unhe pata chal gaya ke maine Islam qubool kar liya hai, to wo mujh par jhoot ka ilzaam lagaayenge.' Isi dauraan kuch Yahudi (Nabi ke paas) aaye, unhone unse pucha, 'Abdullah ki tumhare darmiyaan kya hasiyat hai?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Wo hum mein sabse behtar hain, hamare sardaar aur sardaar ke bete hain.' Nabi (SAW) ne pucha, 'Tumhara kya khayaal hoga agar Abdullah bin Salam Islam qubool kar le?' Unhone kaha, 'Allah unhe is se bachaaye!' Phir Abdullah baahar aaye aur kaha, 'Main gawaahi deta hoon ke Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi aur Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain.' Isper Yahudiyon ne kaha, 'Abdullah hum mein sabse bura hai aur bure ka beta hai,' aur unki burayi karne lage. Isper Abdullah ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Yahi to mujhe dar tha.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:`Umar said, "Our best Qur'an reciter is Ubai and our best judge is `Ali; and in spite of this, we leave some of the statements of Ubai because Ubai says, 'I do not leave anything that I have heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while Allah said: "Whatever verse (Revelations) do We abrogate or cause to be forgotten but We bring a better one or similar to it
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Hamara sabse achha Quran padhne wala Ubai hai aur sabse achha qaazi Ali (Alayhis Salam) hain; is ke bawajood, hum Ubai ki kuch baaton ko chhod dete hain kyunke Ubai kehte hain, "Maine jo kuch Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna hai, usmein se kuch nahi chhodta," jabke Allah ne farmaya hai: "Jo aayat hum mansookh karte hain ya bhula dete hain, uski jagah usse behtar ya usi jaisi le aate hain."'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah said, 'The son of Adam tells a lie against Me though he has no right to do so, and he abuses Me though he has no right to do so. As for his telling a lie against Me, it is that he claims that I cannot recreate him as I created him before; and as for his abusing Me, it is his statement that I have offspring. No! Glorified be Me! I am far from taking a wife or offspring
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah farmaata hai, "Aadam ka beta Mujh par jhoot bolta hai, halaanke usse aisa karne ka koi haq nahi, aur wo Mujhe bura-bhala kehta hai, halaanke usse aisa karne ka bhi koi haq nahi. Uska Mujh par jhoot bolna ye hai ke wo dava karta hai ke Main use dobara paida nahi kar sakta jaise pehle kiya tha; aur uska Mujhe bura-bhala kehna ye hai ke wo kehta hai ke Meri aulaad hai. Nahi! Main is se paak hoon ke Main koi biwi ya aulaad rakhoon."'

e: Narrated Anas:`Umar said, "I agreed with Allah in three things," or said, "My Lord agreed with me in three things. I said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Would that you took the station of Abraham as a place of prayer.' I also said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Good and bad persons visit you! Would that you ordered the Mothers of the believers to cover themselves with veils.' So the Divine Verses of Al-Hijab (i.e. veiling of the women) were revealed. I came to know that the Prophet (ﷺ) had blamed some of his wives so I entered upon them and said, 'You should either stop (troubling the Prophet (ﷺ) ) or else Allah will give His Apostle better wives than you.' When I came to one of his wives, she said to me, 'O `Umar! Does Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) haven't what he could advise his wives with, that you try to advise them?' " Thereupon Allah revealed:-- "It may be, if he divorced you (all) his Lord will give him instead of you, wives better than you Muslims (who submit to Allah)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Main teen baaton mein Allah se muttafiq raha,' ya kaha, 'Mere Rab ne teen baaton mein mere saath muwaafiqat ki. Maine kaha, "Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kaash aap Maqam-e-Ibrahim ko namaz ki jagah banaate." Maine ye bhi kaha, "Aye Allah ke Rasool! Achhe aur bure sab log aapke paas aate hain! Kaash aap Ummahaat-ul-Momineen (Nabi ki azwaaj) ko parda karne ka hukm dete." To Hijab ki Aayaten naazil hui. Mujhe pata chala ke Nabi (SAW) ne apni kuch azwaaj ko naaraaz kiya tha, to main unke paas gaya aur kaha, "Ya to (Nabi ko takleef dena) chhod do, warna Allah apne Rasool ko tum se behtar biwiyaan de dega." Jab main unki ek biwi ke paas gaya, to unhone mujhse kaha, "Aye Umar! Kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas apni biwiyon ko naseehat karne ke liye kuch nahi hai ke tum unhe naseehat karne lage ho?"' Isper Allah ne ye naazil farmaya: 'Agar wo tum sab ko talaaq de dein, to unka Rab unhe tum se behtar biwiyaan de sakta hai, jo Musalmaan (Allah ki farmaabardaar) hon.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:(The wife of the Prophet) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Don't you see that when your people built the Ka`ba, they did not build it on all Abraham's foundations?" I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Why don't you rebuild it on Abraham's foundations?" He said, "Were your people not so close to (the period of Heathenism, i.e. the Period between their being Muslims and being infidels), I would do so." The sub-narrator, `Abdullah bin `Umar said, "Aisha had surely heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying that, for I do not think that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) left touching the two corners of the Ka`ba facing Al-Hijr except because the Ka`ba was not built on all Abraham's foundations
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki zawja) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kya tumhe pata nahi ke jab tumhari qaum ne Kaaba banaya, to unhone use Ibrahim ki poori buniyaadon par nahi banaya?' Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Aap ise Ibrahim ki buniyaadon par dobara kyun nahi bana lete?' Unhone farmaya, 'Agar tumhari qaum jaahiliyat ke daur se itni nazdeek na hoti (yaani abhi haal hi mein Islam laayi hoti), to main aisa zaroor karta.' Ravi Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) kehte hain, 'Aisha ne zaroor Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye sunna hoga, kyunke mujhe nahi lagta ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Hijr ki taraf wale Kaaba ke do konon ko chhoona chhodte, siwaaye is wajah se ke Kaaba Ibrahim ki poori buniyaadon par nahi bana tha.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The people of the Scripture (Jews) used to recite the Torah in Hebrew and they used to explain it in Arabic to the Muslims. On that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Do not believe the people of the Scripture or disbelieve them, but say:-- "We believe in Allah and what is revealed to us
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ahl-e-Kitaab (Yahudi) Tauret Ibrani zabaan mein padha karte the aur Musalmaanon ko Arabi mein uski tafseer bataate the. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ahl-e-Kitaab ki baat na to poori tarah maano na jhutlaao, balke ye kaho: "Hum Allah par aur jo hum par naazil kiya gaya usper Iman laaye..."'

e: Narrated Al-Bara:The Prophet (ﷺ) prayed facing Bait-ulMaqdis (i.e. Jerusalem) for sixteen or seventeen months but he wished that his Qibla would be the Ka`ba (at Mecca). (So Allah Revealed (2.144) and he offered `Asr prayers(in his Mosque facing Ka`ba at Mecca) and some people prayed with him. A man from among those who had prayed with him, went out and passed by some people offering prayer in another mosque, and they were in the state of bowing. He said, "I, (swearing by Allah,) testify that I have prayed with the Prophet (ﷺ) facing Mecca." Hearing that, they turned their faces to the Ka`ba while they were still bowing. Some men had died before the Qibla was changed towards the Ka`ba. They had been killed and we did not know what to say about them (i.e. whether their prayers towards Jerusalem were accepted or not). So Allah revealed:-- "And Allah would never make your faith (i.e. prayer) to be lost (i.e. your prayers offered (towards Jerusalem). Truly Allah is Full of Pity, Most Merciful towards mankind
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) solah ya satrah mahine tak Bait-ul-Maqdis (Yerushalem) ki taraf rukh karke namaz padhte rahe, magar unki khwaish thi ke unka Qibla Kaaba ho. (To Allah ne 2:144 naazil ki) aur unhone Asr ki namaz (Kaaba ki taraf rukh karke) padhi aur kuch log unke saath padhe. Unmein se ek shaks jo unke saath namaz padh chuka tha, baahar nikla aur ek doosri masjid mein namaz padh rahe kuch logon ke paas se guzra, jo (us waqt) ruku ki haalat mein the. Usne kaha, 'Main Allah ki qasam khaakar gawaahi deta hoon ke maine Nabi (SAW) ke saath Makkah ki taraf rukh karke namaz padhi hai.' Ye sunkar unhone apne chehre Kaaba ki taraf mod liye jabke wo abhi ruku mein hi the. Kuch log Qibla badalne se pehle wafat pa chuke the, unhe shaheed kiya gaya tha aur humein nahi pata tha ke unke baare mein kya kahein (ke unki namaz - jo Yerushalem ki taraf thi - qubool hui ya nahi). To Allah ne naazil farmaya: 'Aur Allah tumhare Iman (yaani tumhari namaz) ko zaya nahi karega. Beshak Allah logon par bahut shafqat aur reham karne wala hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Noah will be called on the Day of Resurrection and he will say, 'Labbaik and Sa`daik, O my Lord!' Allah will say, 'Did you convey the Message?' Noah will say, 'Yes.' His nation will then be asked, 'Did he convey the Message to you?' They will say, 'No Warner came to us.' Then Allah will say (to Noah), 'Who will bear witness in your favor?' He will say, 'Muhammad and his followers. So they (i.e. Muslims) will testify that he conveyed the Message. And the Apostle (Muhammad) will be a witness over yourselves, and that is what is meant by the Statement of Allah "Thus We have made of you a just and the best nation that you may be witnesses over mankind and the Apostle (Muhammad) will be a witness over yourselves
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Qayamat ke din Nooh ko bulaaya jaayega aur wo kahenge, "Labbaik wa Sa'daik, aye mere Rab!" Allah farmaayega, "Kya tumne (mera) paigham pahuncha diya?" Nooh kahenge, "Haan." Phir unki qaum se poocha jaayega, "Kya usne tumhe paigham pahunchaaya tha?" Wo kahenge, "Hamare paas koi khabardaar karne wala nahi aaya." Isper Allah (Nooh se) farmaayega, "Tumhare haq mein kaun gawaahi dega?" Wo kahenge, "Muhammad aur unke maanne waale." To wo (yaani Musalmaan) gawaahi denge ke unhone paigham pahunchaaya tha, aur Rasool (Muhammad) khud tum sab par gawaah honge, aur yahi Allah ke is farmaan ka matlab hai: "Isi tarah Humne tumhein ek behtareen ummat banaaya hai taake tum logon par gawaah bano aur Rasool (SAW) tumpar gawaah hon."'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:While some people were offering Fajr prayer in the Quba' mosque, some-one came and said, "Allah has revealed to the Prophet (ﷺ) Qur'anic instructions that you should face the Ka`ba (while praying) so you too, should face it." Those people then turned towards the Ka`ba
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab kuch log Quba ki masjid mein Fajr ki namaz padh rahe the, koi aaya aur kaha, 'Allah ne Nabi (SAW) par Quran naazil kiya hai ke aap (namaz mein) Kaaba ki taraf rukh karein, isliye tum bhi Kaaba ki taraf hi rukh karo.' Ye sunkar wo log Kaaba ki taraf mud gaye.

e: Narrated Anas:None remains of those who prayed facing both Qiblas (that is, Jerusalem and Mecca) except myself
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Un logon mein se jo dono Qibla (yaani pehle Bait-ul-Maqdis aur phir Makkah) ki taraf rukh karke namaz padh chuke the, ab mere siwa koi baaki nahi bacha.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:While some people were offering morning prayer at Quba' a man came to them and said, "A Qur'anic Order has been revealed to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) tonight that he should face the Ka`ba at Mecca (in prayer), so you too should turn your faces towards it." At that moment their faces were towards Sham (i.e. Jerusalem) (and on hearing that) they turned towards the Ka`ba (at Mecca)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Quba mein kuch log Fajr ki namaz padh rahe the, ek shaks unke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Aaj raat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) par ek Quraani hukm naazil hua hai ke wo (namaz mein) Kaaba ki taraf rukh karein, isliye tum bhi Kaaba ki taraf rukh karo.' Us waqt unke chehre Sham (Yerushalem) ki taraf the, (ye sunte hi) wo Kaaba ki taraf mud gaye.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:While some people were offering Fajr prayer at Quba' (mosque), some-one came to them and said, "Tonight some Qur'anic Verses have been revealed to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he has been ordered to face the Ka`ba (at Mecca) (during prayers), so you too should turn your faces towards it." At that time their faces were towards Sham (Jerusalem) so they turned towards the Ka`ba (at Mecca)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Quba mein kuch log Fajr ki namaz padh rahe the, koi aaya aur kaha, 'Aaj raat Nabi (SAW) par kuch Quraani Aayaten naazil hui hain aur unhe Kaaba ki taraf rukh karne ka hukm diya gaya hai, isliye tum bhi Kaaba ki taraf hi rukh karo.' Us waqt unka rukh Sham (Yerushalem) ki taraf tha, to wo Kaaba ki taraf mud gaye.

e: Narrated Al-Bara:We prayed along with the Prophet (ﷺ) facing Jerusalem for sixteen or seventeen months. Then Allah ordered him to turn his face towards the Qibla (in Mecca):-- "And from whence-so-ever you start forth (for prayers) turn your face in the direction of (the Sacred Mosque of Mecca) Al-Masjid-ul Haram
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Humne Nabi (SAW) ke saath solah ya satrah mahine tak Yerushalem ki taraf rukh karke namaz padhi. Phir Allah ne unhe Qibla (Makkah) ki taraf rukh karne ka hukm diya: 'Aur jahaan se bhi tum (namaz ke liye) niklo, apna chehra Masjid-e-Haraam ki taraf mod lo.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:While some people were at Quba (offering) morning prayer, a man came to them and said, "Last night Qur'anic Verses have been revealed whereby the Prophet (ﷺ) has been ordered to face the Ka`ba (at Mecca), so you too should face it." So they, keeping their postures, turned towards the Ka`ba. Formerly the people were facing Sham (Jerusalem) (Allah said):-- "And from whence-so-ever you start forth (for prayers), turn your face in the direction of the Sacred Mosque of Mecca (Al-Masjid-ul-Haram), and whence-so-ever you are, turn your face towards it (when you pray)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Quba mein kuch log subah ki namaz padh rahe the, ek shaks unke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Kal raat Quraani Aayaten naazil hui hain jinmein Nabi (SAW) ko Kaaba ki taraf rukh karne ka hukm diya gaya hai, isliye tum bhi usi ki taraf rukh karo.' To wo apni usi haalat mein (jismein the) Kaaba ki taraf mud gaye. Pehle log Sham (Yerushalem) ki taraf rukh karte the. (Allah ne farmaya:) 'Jahaan se bhi tum (namaz ke liye) niklo, apna chehra Masjid-e-Haraam ki taraf mod lo, aur jahaan bhi ho, apna chehra usi ki taraf karo.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:While some people were offering Fajr prayer at Quba mosque, someone came to them and said, "Qur'anic literature" has been revealed to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) tonight, and he has been ordered to face the Ka`ba (of Mecca) so you too, should turn your faces towards it. Their faces were then towards Sham (Jerusalem), so they turned towards the Qibla (i.e. Ka`ba of Mecca)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab kuch log Quba ki masjid mein Fajr ki namaz padh rahe the, koi unke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Aaj raat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) par Quran naazil hua hai, aur unhe Kaaba ki taraf rukh karne ka hukm diya gaya hai, isliye tum bhi usi ki taraf rukh karo.' Us waqt unka rukh Sham (Yerushalem) ki taraf tha, to wo Qibla (Kaaba) ki taraf mud gaye.

e: Narrated `Urwa:I said to `Aisha, the wife of the Prophet, and I was at that time a young boy, "How do you interpret the Statement of Allah: "Verily, Safa and Marwa (i.e. two mountains at Mecca) are among the Symbols of Allah." So it is not harmful of those who perform the Hajj to the House of Allah) or perform the Umra, to ambulate (Tawaf) between them. In my opinion it is not sinful for one not to ambulate (Tawaf) between them." `Aisha said, "Your interpretation is wrong for as you say, the Verse should have been: "So it is not harmful of those who perform the Hajj or Umra to the House, not to ambulate (Tawaf) between them.' This Verse was revealed in connection with the Ansar who (during the Pre-Islamic Period) used to visit Manat (i.e. an idol) after assuming their Ihram, and it was situated near Qudaid (i.e. a place at Mecca), and they used to regard it sinful to ambulate between Safa and Marwa after embracing Islam. When Islam came, they asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about it, whereupon Allah revealed:-- "Verily, Safa and Marwa (i.e. two mountains at Mecca) are among the Symbols of Allah. So it is not harmful of those who perform the Hajj of the House (of Allah) or perform the Umra, to ambulate (Tawaf) between them
hi: Urwa bataate hain: Maine Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki zawja) se pucha - us waqt main choti umar ka tha - 'Aap Allah ke is farmaan ki kya tafseer karti hain: "Beshak Safa aur Marwa Allah ki nishaaniyon mein se hain, is liye jo koi Baitullah ka Hajj ya Umra kare, unke darmiyaan (Tawaf) karne mein koi gunaah nahi"? Mere khayaal se to jo inke darmiyaan Tawaf na kare uspar bhi koi gunaah nahi.' Aisha ne kaha, 'Tumhari tafseer galat hai, agar aisa hota to Aayat yun hoti: "...unke darmiyaan Tawaf na karne mein koi gunaah nahi." Ye Aayat un Ansaar ke baare mein naazil hui thi jo (Islam se pehle) Ihram baandhne ke baad Manaat (ek but) ki ziyarat karte the, jo Qudaid ke qareeb tha, aur Islam laane ke baad unhe Safa aur Marwa ke darmiyaan Tawaf karna gunaah lagta tha. Jab Islam aaya, to unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se iske baare mein pucha, isper Allah ne ye naazil farmaya: "Beshak Safa aur Marwa Allah ki nishaaniyon mein se hain, is liye jo koi Baitullah ka Hajj ya Umra kare, unke darmiyaan Tawaf karne mein koi gunaah nahi."'

e: Narrated `Asim bin Sulaiman:I asked Anas bin Malik about Safa and Marwa. Anas replied, "We used to consider (i.e. going around) them a custom of the Pre-islamic period of Ignorance, so when Islam came, we gave up going around them. Then Allah revealed" "Verily, Safa and Marwa (i.e. two mountains at Mecca) are among the Symbols of Allah. So it is not harmful of those who perform the Hajj of the House (of Allah) or perform the Umra to ambulate (Tawaf) between them
hi: Aasim bin Sulaiman bataate hain: Maine Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se Safa aur Marwa ke baare mein pucha. Anas ne jawab diya, 'Hum inke gird (Tawaf karna) jaahiliyat ka ek rivaaz samajhte the, isliye jab Islam aaya to humne inka Tawaf karna chhod diya. Phir Allah ne naazil farmaya: "Beshak Safa aur Marwa Allah ki nishaaniyon mein se hain, is liye jo koi Baitullah ka Hajj ya Umra kare, unke darmiyaan Tawaf karne mein koi gunaah nahi."'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said one statement and I said another. The Prophet (ﷺ) said "Whoever dies while still invoking anything other than Allah as a rival to Allah, will enter Hell (Fire)." And I said, "Whoever dies without invoking anything as a rival to Allah, will enter Paradise
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne ek baat kahi aur maine ek aur baat kahi. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo shaks Allah ke siwa kisi aur ko uska shareek banaate hue mare, wo Jahannam mein jaayega.' Aur maine kaha, 'Jo shaks Allah ka koi shareek banaaye bagair mare, wo Jannat mein jaayega.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The law of Qisas (i.e. equality in punishment) was prescribed for the children of Israel, but the Diya (i.e. blood money was not ordained for them). So Allah said to this Nation (i.e. Muslims): "O you who believe! The law of Al-Qisas (i.e. equality in punishment) is prescribed for you in cases of murder: The free for the free, the slave for the slave, and the female for the female. But if the relatives (or one of them) of the killed (person) forgive their brother (i.e. the killers something of Qisas (i.e. not to kill the killer by accepting blood money in the case of intentional murder)----then the relatives (of the killed person) should demand blood-money in a reasonable manner and the killer must pay with handsome gratitude. This is an alleviation and a Mercy from your Lord, (in comparison to what was prescribed for the nations before you). So after this, whoever transgresses the limits (i.e. to kill the killer after taking the blood-money) shall have a painful torment
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Bani Israel ke liye Qisas (barabar ka badla) ka qanoon tha, magar unke liye Diya (khoon-baha) muqarrar nahi ki gayi thi. To Allah ne is Ummat (yaani Musalmaanon) se farmaya: 'Aye Iman waalo! Qatl ke maamlon mein tumpar Qisas farz kiya gaya hai: aazaad ke badle aazaad, ghulaam ke badle ghulaam, aurat ke badle aurat. Lekin agar maqtool ke waaris (qaatil ko) kuch maaf kar dein, to (waaris ko) achhe tareeke se (khoon-baha) maangna chahiye aur qaatil ko khushi se ada karna chahiye. Ye tumhare Rab ki taraf se ek raahat aur rehmat hai (pichhli ummaton ke muqaable mein). Is ke baad jo koi hadd se aage badhe (yaani khoon-baha lene ke baad bhi qaatil ko qatl kar de), uske liye dardnaak azaab hai.'

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The prescribed Law of Allah is the equality in punishment (i.e. Al-Qisas)." (In cases of murders, etc)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah ka muqarrar kiya hua qanoon Qisas (barabar ka badla) hai.'

e: Narrated Anas:That his aunt, Ar-Rubai' broke an incisor tooth of a girl. My aunt's family requested the girl's relatives for forgiveness but they refused; then they proposed a compensation, but they refused. Then they went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and refused everything except Al-Qisas (i.e. equality in punishment). So Allah's Apostle passed the judgment of Al-Qisas (i.e. equality of punishment). Anas bin Al-Nadr said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Will the incisor tooth of Ar-Rubai be broken? No, by Him Who sent you with the Truth, her incisor tooth will not be broken." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O Anas! The prescribed law of Allah is equality in punishment (i.e. Al-Qisas.)" Thereupon those people became satisfied and forgave her. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Among Allah's Worshippers there are some who, if they took Allah's Oath (for something), Allah fulfills their oaths
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke unki khaala Ar-Rubai ne ek ladki ka ek daant tod diya. Unke gharwaalon ne ladki ke gharwaalon se maafi ki darkhwaast ki magar unhone inkaar kiya, phir muawza (badla) dene ki peshkash ki, wo bhi thukra diya. Phir wo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaye, unhone bhi Qisas ke siwa kuch aur qubool nahi kiya. To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Qisas ka faisla sunaya. Anas bin An-Nadr ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya Rubai ka daant toda jaayega? Nahi, us Zaat ki qasam jisne aapko haq ke saath bheja, unka daant nahi tootega.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Aye Anas! Allah ka muqarrar kiya qanoon Qisas hi hai.' Isper wo log raazi ho gaye aur ladki ko maaf kar diya. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah ke bandon mein kuch aise hote hain ke agar wo Allah ka naam lekar (kisi baat ki) qasam khaa lein, to Allah unki qasam poori kar deta hai.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Fasting was observed on the day of 'Ashura' (i.e. 10th of Muharram) by the people of the Pre-Islamic Period. But when (the order of compulsory fasting) in the month of Ramadan was revealed, the Prophet said, "It is up to one to fast on it (i.e. day of 'Ashura') or not
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jaahiliyat ke daur ke log Ashura (yaani Muharram ki dus tareekh) ke din roza rakha karte the. Magar jab Ramzan (ke farz roze) ka hukm naazil hua, to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ab jo chaahe Ashura ka roza rakhe, jo na chaahe na rakhe.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The people used to fast on the day of 'Ashura' before fasting in Ramadan was prescribed but when (the order of compulsory fasting in) Ramadan was revealed, it was up to one to fast on it (i.e. 'Ashura') or not
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Log Ashura ke din roza rakha karte the, is se pehle ke Ramzan ke roze farz kiye jaayein. Magar jab Ramzan (ke roze) ka hukm naazil hua, to Ashura ka roza rakhna ikhtiyaari ho gaya - jo chaahe rakhe, jo na chaahe na rakhe.

e: Narrated `Abdullah:That Al-Ash'ath entered upon him while he was eating. Al-Ash'ath said, "Today is 'Ashura." I said (to him), "Fasting had been observed (on such a day) before (the order of compulsory fasting in) Ramadan was revealed. But when (the order of fasting in) Ramadan was revealed, fasting (on 'Ashura') was given up, so come and eat
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Al-Ash'ath unke paas aaye jabke wo khaana kha rahe the. Al-Ash'ath ne kaha, 'Aaj Ashura hai.' Maine (Abdullah ne) kaha, 'Ramzan (ke roze) ka hukm naazil hone se pehle (Ashura ka) roza rakha jaata tha. Magar jab Ramzan (ke roze) ka hukm naazil hua, to Ashura ka roza rakhna chhod diya gaya, isliye aao aur khaao.'

e: Narrated Aisha:During the Pre-Islamic Period of ignorance the Quraish used to observe fasting on the day of 'Ashura', and the Prophet (ﷺ) himself used to observe fasting on it too. But when he came to Medina, he fasted on that day and ordered the Muslims to fast on it. When (the order of compulsory fasting in ) Ramadan was revealed, fasting in Ramadan became an obligation, and fasting on 'Ashura' was given up, and who ever wished to fast (on it) did so, and whoever did not wish to fast on it, did not fast
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jaahiliyat ke daur mein Quraish Ashura ke din roza rakha karte the, aur Nabi (SAW) khud bhi us din roza rakha karte the. Jab wo Madina aaye, to unhone us din roza rakha aur Musalmaanon ko bhi roza rakhne ka hukm diya. Jab Ramzan (ke farz roze) ka hukm naazil hua, to Ramzan ka roza farz ho gaya aur Ashura ka roza (farziyat se) hata diya gaya - jo chaahe us din roza rakhta, jo na chaahe na rakhta.

e: Narrated 'Ata:That he heard Ibn `Abbas reciting the Divine Verse:-- "And for those who can fast they had a choice to either fast, or feed a poor for every day.." (2.184) Ibn `Abbas said, "This Verse is not abrogated, but it is meant for old men and old women who have no strength to fast, so they should feed one poor person for each day of fasting (instead of fasting)
hi: Ata bataate hain ke unhone Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko ye Aayat padhte suna: 'Aur jo roza rakh sakte hain unke paas ye ikhtiyar tha ke wo ya to roza rakhein ya har din ke badle ek miskeen ko khaana khilaayein...' (2:184) Ibn Abbas ne kaha, 'Ye Aayat mansookh nahi hui hai, balke ye un budhe mard aur aurton ke liye hai jinmein roza rakhne ki taaqat nahi hai, wo har din ke badle ek miskeen ko khaana khilaayein (roze ki jagah).'

e: Narrated Nafi`:Ibn `Umar recited: "They had a choice, either fast or feed a poor for every day.." and added, "This Verse is abrogated
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne padha, 'Unke paas ikhtiyar tha ke wo roza rakhein ya har din ke badle ek miskeen ko khaana khilaayein...' aur kaha, 'Ye Aayat mansookh (khatam) ho chuki hai.'

e: Narrated Salama:When the Divine Revelation: "For those who can fast, they had a choice to either fast, or feed a poor for every day," (2.184) was revealed, it was permissible for one to give a ransom and give up fasting, till the Verse succeeding it was revealed and abrogated it
hi: Salama bataate hain: Jab ye Aayat naazil hui, 'Jo roza rakh sakte hain unke paas ikhtiyar tha ke wo roza rakhein ya har din ke badle ek miskeen ko khaana khilaayein' (2:184), to us waqt fidya deke roza chhodna jaayez tha, yahaan tak ke iske baad wali Aayat naazil hui jisne isse mansookh kar diya.

e: Narrated Al-Bara':When the order of compulsory fasting of Ramadan was revealed, the people did not have sexual relations with their wives for the whole month of Ramadan, but some men cheated themselves (by violating that restriction). So Allah revealed: "Allah is aware that you were deceiving yourselves but He accepted your repentance and forgave you
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Jab Ramzan ke farz roze ka hukm naazil hua, to log poore Ramzan mein apni biwiyon se humbistari nahi karte the, magar kuch log khud ko dhoka dete (yaani ye pabandi tod dete).
