To Allah ne naazil farmaya: 'Allah ko pata tha ke tum khud ko dhoka de rahe the, magar usne tumhari tauba qubool ki aur tumhein maaf kar diya.'

e: Narrated Ash-Shu`bi:`Adi took a white rope (or thread) and a black one, and when some part of the night had passed, he looked at them but he could not distinguish one from the other. The next morning he said, "O Allah's Apostle! I put (a white thread and a black thread) underneath my pillow." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Then your pillow is too wide if the white thread (of dawn) and the black thread (of the night) are underneath your pillow
hi: Ash-Shu'bi bataate hain: Adi ne ek safed dhaaga aur ek kaala dhaaga liya, aur jab raat ka kuch hissa guzar gaya to unhone unhe dekha magar wo ek ko doosre se pehchaan na sake. Agli subah unhone kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Maine (ek safed aur ek kaala dhaaga) apne takiye ke neeche rakha tha.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'To tumhara takiya bahut chauda hai agar safed dhaaga (subah) aur kaala dhaaga (raat) tumhare takiye ke neeche aa rahe hain!'

e: Narrated `Adi bin Hatim:I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What is the meaning of the white thread distinct from the black thread? Are these two threads?" He said, "You are not intelligent if you watch the two threads." He then added, "No, it is the darkness of the night and the whiteness of the day
hi: Adi bin Hatim (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine pucha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Safed dhaage ka kaale dhaage se alag hone ka kya matlab hai? Kya ye do (asli) dhaage hain?' Unhone farmaya, 'Tum aqlmand nahi ho agar tum (asli) do dhaagon ko dekhte ho.' Phir farmaya, 'Nahi, iska matlab hai raat ka andhera aur din ki roshni.'

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d The Verse "And eat and drink until the white thread appears to you distinct from the black thread." was revealed, but: '... of dawn' was not revealed (along with it). So some men, when intending to fast, used to tie their legs, one with white thread and the other with black thread and would keep on eating till they could distinguish one thread from the other. Then Allah revealed' ... of dawn,' whereupon they understood that meant the night and the day
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ye Aayat naazil hui, 'Aur khaao piyo yahaan tak ke safed dhaaga kaale dhaage se saaf zaahir ho jaaye,' magar '...subah ka' (ye alfaaz) us waqt naazil nahi hue the. To kuch log jab roza rakhna chahte, apne pairon mein ek taraf safed dhaaga aur doosri taraf kaala dhaaga baandh lete aur khaate rehte jab tak ek ko doosre se pehchaan na paate. Phir Allah ne '...subah ka' naazil kiya, isse unhe samajh aaya ke iska matlab raat aur din hai.

e: Narrated Al-Bara:In the Pre-Islamic Period when the people assumed Ihram, they would enter their houses from the back. So Allah revealed:-- "And it is not righteousness that you enter houses from the back, but the righteous man is he who fears Allah, obeys His Orders and keeps away from what He has forbidden. So enter houses through their doors
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Jaahiliyat ke daur mein jab log Ihram baandhte, to apne gharon mein peeche ke raaste se daakhil hote the. To Allah ne naazil farmaya: 'Aur ye koi neki nahi ke tum gharon mein peeche se daakhil ho, balke asli neki wo hai jo Allah se darta hai (yaani parhezgaari ikhtiyaar karta hai). Isliye gharon mein unke darwazon se daakhil ho.'

e: Narrated Nafi`:During the affliction of Ibn Az-Zubair, two men came to Ibn `Umar and said, "The people are lost, and you are the son of `Umar, and the companion of the Prophet, so what forbids you from coming out?" He said, "What forbids me is that Allah has prohibited the shedding of my brother's blood." They both said, "Didn't Allah say, 'And fight them until there is no more affliction?" He said "We fought until there was no more affliction and the worship is for Allah (Alone while you want to fight until there is affliction and until the worship becomes for other than Allah." Narrated Nafi` (through another group of sub-narrators): A man came to Ibn `Umar and said, "O Abu `Abdur Rahman! What made you perform Hajj in one year and Umra in another year and leave the Jihad for Allah' Cause though you know how much Allah recommends it?" Ibn `Umar replied, "O son of my brother! Islam is founded on five principles, i.e. believe in Allah and His Apostle, the five compulsory prayers, the fasting of the month of Ramadan, the payment of Zakat, and the Hajj to the House (of Allah)." The man said, "O Abu `Abdur Rahman! Won't you listen to what Allah has mentioned in His Book: 'If two groups of believers fight each other, then make peace between them, but if one of them transgresses beyond bounds against the other, then you all fight against the one that transgresses. (49.9) and:--"And fight them till there is no more affliction (i.e. no more worshiping of others along with Allah)." Ibn `Umar said, "We did it, during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) when Islam had only a few followers. A man would be put to trial because of his religion; he would either be killed or tortured. But when the Muslims increased, there was no more afflictions or oppressions." The man said, "What is your opinion about `Uthman and `Ali?" Ibn `Umar said, "As for `Uthman, it seems that Allah has forgiven him, but you people dislike that he should be forgiven. And as for `Ali, he is the cousin of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and his son-in-law." Then he pointed with his hand and said, "That is his house which you see
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Ibn Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke fitne (dauraan) ke waqt, do aadmi Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas aaye aur kaha, 'Log tabaah ho rahe hain, aur aap Umar ke bete aur Nabi (SAW) ke saathi hain, to aapko (jang mein) nikalne se kya rok raha hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Mujhe ye baat rokti hai ke Allah ne mere bhai ka khoon behaana haraam kar diya hai.' Unhone kaha, 'Kya Allah ne nahi farmaya, "Unse laro jab tak fitna khatam na ho jaaye"?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Humne jang ki thi jab tak fitna khatam ho gaya aur ibaadat sirf Allah ke liye rah gayi, jabke tum log itni jang chahte ho ke fitna paida ho jaaye aur ibaadat Allah ke siwa kisi aur ke liye ho jaaye.' Ek doosri riwayat mein Nafi bataate hain: Ek shaks Ibn Umar ke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Aye Abu Abdur Rahman! Aapne ek saal Hajj aur doosre saal Umra kyun kiya aur Allah ki raah mein Jihad kyun chhod diya, jabke aapko pata hai Allah isko kitna zaroori maanta hai?' Ibn Umar ne jawab diya, 'Aye mere bhatije! Islam paanch cheezon par qaayam hai: Allah aur uske Rasool par Iman laana, paanch waqt ki farz namaz, Ramzan ka roza, Zakat adaa karna, aur Baitullah ka Hajj karna.' Us shaks ne kaha, 'Aye Abu Abdur Rahman! Kya aap ye nahi sunte jo Allah ne apni Kitaab mein farmaya hai: "Agar Musalmaanon ke do giroh aapas mein lad jaayein to unke darmiyaan sulah karao, magar agar unmein se ek zyaadti kare doosre ke khilaaf to us zyaadti karne wale se lado" (49:9), aur "unse lado jab tak fitna khatam na ho jaaye (yaani Allah ke siwa kisi aur ki ibaadat na ho)"?' Ibn Umar ne kaha, 'Humne ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zindagi mein kiya, jab Islam ke maanne wale kam the. Kisi shaks ko uske deen ki wajah se aazmaaya jaata, use ya to qatl kar diya jaata ya sataaya jaata. Magar jab Musalmaan zyaada ho gaye, to koi fitna ya zulm baaki nahi raha.' Us shaks ne pucha, 'Uthman aur Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke baare mein aapki kya raay hai?' Ibn Umar ne kaha, 'Jahaan tak Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki baat hai, lagta hai Allah ne unhe maaf kar diya hai, magar tum logon ko ye pasand nahi ke unhe maaf kiya jaaye. Aur jahaan tak Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki baat hai, wo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke chachazaad bhai aur damaad hain.' Phir unhone haath se ishara karke kaha, 'Wo raha unka ghar jo tum dekh rahe ho.'

e: Narrated Abu Wail:Hudhaifa said, "The Verse:-- "And spend (of your wealth) in the Cause of Allah and do not throw yourselves in destruction," (2.195) was revealed concerning spending in Allah's Cause (i.e. Jihad)
hi: Abu Wail bataate hain: Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Ye Aayat, "Aur Allah ki raah mein (apna maal) kharch karo aur apne haathon apne aap ko halaakat mein na daalo" (2:195), Allah ki raah (yaani Jihad) mein kharch karne ke baare mein naazil hui thi.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Ma`qil:I sat with Ka`b bin Ujra in this mosque, i.e. Kufa Mosque, and asked him about the meaning of: "Pay a ransom (i.e. Fidya) of either fasting or . . . . (2.196)" He said, "I was taken to the Prophet (ﷺ) while lice were falling on my face. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'I did not think that your trouble reached to such an extent. Can you afford to slaughter a sheep (as a ransom for shaving your head)?' I said, 'No.' He said, 'Then fast for three days, or feed six poor persons by giving half a Sa of food for each and shave your head.' So the above Verse was revealed especially for me and generally for all of you
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ma'qil bataate hain: Main is masjid (yaani Kufa ki masjid) mein Ka'b bin Ujra ke saath baitha aur unse is Aayat ka matlab pucha: 'Fidya de do, ya to roza rakh kar...' (2:196). Unhone kaha, 'Mujhe Nabi (SAW) ke paas le jaaya gaya jabke jooen mere chehre par gir rahi thin. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, "Mujhe nahi pata tha tumhari takleef itni badh gayi hai. Kya tum (sar mundwaane ke fidya mein) ek bakri zibah kar sakte ho?" Maine kaha, "Nahi." Unhone farmaya, "To teen din roza rakho, ya chhe miskeenon ko khaana khilaao, har ek ko aadha Saa, aur apna sar mundwa lo." To ye Aayat khaas taur par mere baare mein aur aam taur par tum sab ke liye naazil hui.'

e: Narrated `Imran bin Husain:The Verse of Hajj-at-Tamattu was revealed in Allah's Book, so we performed it with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and nothing was revealed in Qur'an to make it illegal, nor did the Prophet (ﷺ) prohibit it till he died. But the man (who regarded it illegal) just expressed what his own mind suggested
hi: Imran bin Husain (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hajj-e-Tamattu ki Aayat Allah ki Kitaab mein naazil hui, to humne ise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath ada kiya, aur Quran mein aisa kuch naazil nahi hua jo isse haraam kare, na hi Nabi (SAW) ne apni wafat tak ise mana kiya. Balke jisne ise haraam samjha, usne sirf apni raay se kaha.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:`Ukaz, Mijanna and Dhul-Majaz were markets during the Pre-islamic Period. They (i.e. Muslims) considered it a sin to trade there during the Hajj time (i.e. season), so this Verse was revealed:-- "There is no harm for you if you seek of the Bounty of your Lord during the Hajj season
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ukaz, Mijanna aur Zul-Majaz jaahiliyat ke daur ke bazaar the. (Musalmaan) Hajj ke mausam mein wahaan tijaarat karna gunaah samajhte the, isliye ye Aayat naazil hui: 'Tumhare liye is mein koi harj nahi ke tum apne Rab ke fazl (yaani rozi-kamai) ki talaash karo (Hajj ke dauraan).'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Quraish people and those who embraced their religion, used to stay at Muzdalifa and used to call themselves Al-Hums, while the rest of the Arabs used to stay at `Arafat. When Islam came, Allah ordered His Prophet to go to `Arafat and stay at it, and then pass on from there, and that is what is meant by the Statement of Allah:--"Then depart from the place whence all the people depart
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Quraish aur jo unke deen ko maanate the wo Muzdalifa mein thehra karte the aur khud ko 'Al-Hums' kehte the, jabke baaqi Arab Arafat mein thehrate the. Jab Islam aaya, to Allah ne apne Nabi (SAW) ko hukm diya ke wo Arafat jaayein aur wahaan thehrein, phir wahaan se (Muzdalifa ki taraf) rawaana hon, aur yahi Allah ke is farmaan ka matlab hai: 'Phir wahin se palto jahaan se sab log palte hain.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:A man who wants to perform the Hajj (from Mecca) can perform the Tawaf around the Ka`ba as long as he is not in the state of Ihram till he assumes the Ihram for Hajj. Then, if he rides and proceeds to `Arafat, he should take a Hadi (i.e. animal for sacrifice), either a camel or a cow or a sheep, whatever he can afford; but if he cannot afford it, he should fast for three days during the Hajj before the day of `Arafat, but if the third day of his fasting happens to be the day of `Arafat (i.e. 9th of Dhul-Hijja) then it is no sin for him (to fast on it). Then he should proceed to `Arafat and stay there from the time of the `Asr prayer till darkness falls. Then the pilgrims should proceed from `Arafat, and when they have departed from it, they reach Jam' (i.e. Al-Muzdalifa) where they ask Allah to help them to be righteous and dutiful to Him, and there they remember Allah greatly or say Takbir (i.e. Allah is Greater) and Tahlil (i.e. None has the right to be worshipped but Allah) repeatedly before dawn breaks. Then, after offering the morning (Fajr) prayer you should pass on (to Mina) for the people used to do so and Allah said:-- "Then depart from the place whence all the people depart. And ask for Allah's Forgiveness. Truly! Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful." (2.199) Then you should go on doing so till you throw pebbles over the Jamra
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jo shaks (Makkah se) Hajj karna chahta hai, wo jab tak Hajj ke liye Ihram na baandhe, Kaaba ka Tawaf kar sakta hai. Phir jab wo sawaar hokar Arafat ki taraf jaaye, to use Hadi (qurbaani ka jaanwar) - oont, gaay ya bakri, jo bhi uski hasiyat mein ho - saath le jaana chahiye. Agar iski taaqat na ho, to use Arafat ke din se pehle Hajj ke dauraan teen din roza rakhna chahiye, aur agar teesra roza Arafat ke din (yaani Zul-Hijja ki 9 tareekh) par aa jaaye, to isme koi gunaah nahi. Phir use Arafat jaana chahiye aur wahaan Asr ki namaz se lekar andhera hone tak thehrna chahiye. Phir jab Hajji Arafat se rawaana hon aur wahaan se nikal kar Jama (yaani Muzdalifa) pahunchein, to wahaan Allah se apni raah-nigahi aur farmaabardaari ki dua maangein, aur subah hone se pehle bahut Allah ka zikr karein ya Takbeer (Allahu Akbar) aur Tahleel (Laa ilaaha illallah) baar baar padhein. Phir Fajr ki namaz padhne ke baad (Mina ki taraf) aage badho, kyunke log yahi kiya karte the, aur Allah ne farmaya: 'Phir wahin se palto jahaan se sab log palte hain. Aur Allah se maafi maango. Beshak Allah bahut maaf karne wala, bahut reham karne wala hai.' (2:199) Phir yahi silsila jaari rakho yahaan tak ke tum Jamra par kankariyaan maaro.

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to say, "O Allah! Our Lord! Give us in this world that, which is good and in the Hereafter that, which is good and save us from the torment of the Fire
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ye dua padha karte the, 'Aye Allah! Aye hamare Rab! Humein duniya mein bhalayi de aur aakhirat mein bhi bhalayi de, aur humein aag (Jahannam) ke azaab se bacha.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The most hated man in the Sight of Allah is the one who is the most quarrelsome
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah ke nazdeek sabse zyaada naapasand insaan wo hai jo sabse zyaada jhagdaalu ho.'

e: Narrated Ibn Abu Mulaika:Ibn `Abbas recited: "(Respite will be granted) until when the Apostles gave up hope (of their people) and thought that they were denied (by their people). There came to them Our Help ...." (12.110) reading Kudhibu without doubling the sound 'dh', and that was what he understood of the Verse. Then he went on reciting: "..even the Apostle and those who believed along with him said: When (will come) Allah's Help? Yes, verily, Allah's Help is near." (2.214) Then I met `Urwa bin Az-Zubair and I mentioned that to him. He said, "Aisha said, 'Allah forbid! By Allah, Allah never promised His Apostle anything but he knew that it would certainly happen before he died. But trials were continuously presented before the Apostles till they were afraid that their followers would accuse them of telling lies. So I used to recite:-- "Till they (come to) think that they were treated as liars." reading 'Kudh-dhibu with double 'dh
hi: Ibn Abu Mulaika bataate hain: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne padha, '...yahaan tak ke jab Rasool naa-umeed ho gaye aur unhe laga ke unke saath jhoothi baat kahi gayi thi (ya: unhe jhutlaaya ja chuka hai), to hamari madad unke paas aayi...' (12:110) - unhone 'Kudhibu' ko bagair 'dh' double kiye padha, aur yahi unki is Aayat ki samajh thi. Phir unhone aage padha, '...yahaan tak ke Rasool aur unke saath Iman laane wale kehne lage, "Allah ki madad kab aayegi?" Sun lo! Beshak Allah ki madad qareeb hai.' (2:214) Ravi kehte hain: Phir main Urwa bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) se mila aur unhe ye baat bataayi. Unhone kaha, 'Aisha ne kaha, "Allah maaf kare! Allah ki qasam, Allah ne apne Rasool se koi wada nahi kiya jiske baare mein unhe ye yaqeen na ho ke wo unki wafat se pehle zaroor poora hoga. Magar Rasoolon ko musalsal aazmaaishon se guzarna pada yahaan tak ke unhe dar hua ke unke maanne wale unhe jhoota (samajhne) lagenge. Isliye main padhti hoon, '...yahaan tak ke unhe laga ke unhe jhoota keh diya gaya,' 'Kudh-dhibu' ko 'dh' double karke."'

e: Narrated Nafi`:Whenever Ibn `Umar recited the Qur'an, he would not speak to anyone till he had finished his recitation. Once I held the Qur'an and he recited Surat-al-Baqara from his memory and then stopped at a certain Verse and said, "Do you know in what connection this Verse was revealed? " I replied, "No." He said, "It was revealed in such-and-such connection." Ibn `Umar then resumed his recitation. Nafi` added regarding the Verse:--"So go to your tilth when or how you will" Ibn `Umar said, "It means one should approach his wife in
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Jab bhi Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) Quran padhte, wo apni tilawat khatam kiye bagair kisi se baat nahi karte the. Ek baar maine Quran apne haath mein liya aur unhone Surah Al-Baqarah apni yaadasht se padhi, phir ek khaas Aayat par ruk gaye aur kaha, 'Kya tumhe pata hai ye Aayat kis silsile mein naazil hui thi?' Maine kaha, 'Nahi.' Unhone kaha, 'Ye falaan-falaan waqiya ke silsile mein naazil hui thi.' Phir Ibn Umar ne apni tilawat jaari rakhi. Nafi ne ye bhi bataya ke Aayat 'Apni khetiyon (biwiyon) mein jab aur jaise chaaho jao' ke baare mein Ibn Umar ne kaha ke iska matlab ye hai ke aadmi apni biwi ke paas (sirf) us tareeke se jaaye jo Shariat mein jaayez hai.

e: Narrated Jabir:Jews used to say: "If one has sexual intercourse with his wife from the back, then she will deliver a squint-eyed child." So this Verse was revealed:-- "Your wives are a tilth unto you; so go to your tilth when or how you will
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Yahudi kaha karte the, 'Agar koi apni biwi se peechhe se (yaani peeth ki taraf se) humbistari kare, to bacha bhengi (tirchhi) aankhon wala paida hoga.' Isper ye Aayat naazil hui: 'Tumhari biwiyaan tumhari khetiyon ki manind hain, isliye apni khetiyon mein jab aur jaise chaaho jao.'

e: Narrated Al-Hasan:The sister of Ma'qil bin Yasar was divorced by her husband who left her till she had fulfilled her term of 'Iddat (i.e. the period which should elapse before she can Remarry) and then he wanted to remarry her but Ma'qil refused, so this Verse was revealed:-- "Do not prevent them from marrying their (former) husbands
hi: Al-Hasan bataate hain: Ma'qil bin Yasar ki behen ko unke shohar ne talaaq de di aur unhe chhod diya yahaan tak ke unki Iddat poori ho gayi. Phir wo unse dobara nikaah karna chahta tha magar Ma'qil ne inkaar kar diya. Isper ye Aayat naazil hui: 'Unhe apne (pehle) shohar se nikaah karne se mat roko.'

e: Narrated Ibn Az-Zubair:I said to `Uthman bin `Affan (while he was collecting the Qur'an) regarding the Verse:-- "Those of you who die and leave wives ..." (2.240) "This Verse was abrogated by another Verse. So why should you write it? (Or leave it in the Qur'an)?" `Uthman said. "O son of my brother! I will not shift anything of it from its place
hi: Ibn Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Affan se (jab wo Quran jama kar rahe the) is Aayat ke baare mein kaha: 'Jo tum mein se wafat pa jaayein aur biwiyaan chhod jaayein...' (2:240) 'Ye Aayat ek doosri Aayat se mansookh ho chuki hai, to phir aap ise (Quran mein) kyun likh rahe hain?' Uthman ne kaha, 'Aye mere bhatije! Main Quran ki kisi cheez ko uski jagah se nahi hataaunga.'

e: Narrated Mujahi:(regarding the Verse):-- "Those of you who die and leave wives behind. They - (their wives) -- shall wait (as regards their marriage ) for four months and ten days)." (2.234) The widow, according to this Verse, was to spend this period of waiting with her husband's family, so Allah revealed: "Those of you who die and leave wives (i.e. widows) should bequeath for their wives, a year's maintenance and residence without turning them out, but if they leave (their residence), there is no blame on you for what they do with themselves provided it is honorable.' (i.e. lawful marriage) (2.240). So Allah entitled the widow to be bequeathed extra maintenance for seven months and twenty nights, and that is the completion of one year. If she wished she could stay (in her husband's home) according to the will, and she could leave it if she wished, as Allah says: "..without turning them out, but if they leave (the residence), there is no blame on you." So the 'Idda (i.e. four months and ten days as it) is obligatory for her. 'Ata said: Ibn `Abbas said, "This Verse, i.e. the Statement of Allah: "..without turning them out.." cancelled the obligation of staying for the waiting period in her dead husband's house, and she can complete this period wherever she likes." 'Ata' said: If she wished, she could complete her 'Idda by staying in her dead husband's residence according to the will or leave it according to Allah's Statement:-- "There is no blame on you for what they do with themselves." `Ata' added: Later the regulations of inheritance came and abrogated the order of the dwelling of the widow (in her dead husband's house), so she could complete the 'Idda wherever she likes. And it was no longer necessary to provide her with a residence. Ibn `Abbas said, "This Verse abrogated her (i.e. widow's) dwelling in her dead husband's house and she could complete the 'Idda (i.e. four months and ten days) wherever she liked, as Allah's Statement says:--"...without turning them out
hi: Mujahid is Aayat ke baare mein bataate hain: 'Jo tum mein se wafat pa jaayein aur biwiyaan chhod jaayein, wo (biwiyaan) apne (nikaah ke) maamle mein chaar mahine dus din intezaar karein' (2:234). Is Aayat ke mutaabik, bewa apni Iddat apne shohar ke gharwaalon ke saath guzaarti thi, phir Allah ne naazil farmaya: 'Jo tum mein se wafat pa jaayein aur biwiyaan (bewaayein) chhod jaayein, unhe chaahiye ke apni biwiyon ke liye ek saal ka kharcha aur rehne ki jagah ki wasiyat karein, unhe (ghar se) nikaale bagair, magar agar wo (khud) chali jaayein, to unke apne baare mein jo bhi (jaayez) kaam wo karein, us par tum par koi gunaah nahi (yaani jaayez nikaah)' (2:240). Is tarah Allah ne bewa ko saat mahine bees raaton ke izaafi kharche ki wasiyat ka haq diya, jo ek saal poora karta hai. Agar wo chaahe to wasiyat ke mutaabik (shohar ke ghar mein hi) reh sakti thi, aur chaahe to chali bhi ja sakti thi, jaisa Allah ne farmaya, '...unhe nikaale bagair, magar agar wo chali jaayein to koi gunaah nahi.' Iddat (yaani chaar mahine dus din) uske liye zaroori (farz) hai. Ata kehte hain: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Is Aayat - yaani "unhe nikaale bagair" - ne (bewa ke liye) shohar ke ghar mein Iddat guzaarne ki pabandi khatam kar di, aur wo jahaan chaahe apni Iddat poori kar sakti hai.' Ata kehte hain: Agar wo chaahe to wasiyat ke mutaabik shohar ke ghar mein hi Iddat poori kar sakti thi, ya Allah ke farmaan ke mutaabik chali jaa sakti thi, 'unke apne baare mein jo bhi kaam wo karein, tum par koi gunaah nahi.' Ata ne aage kaha: Baad mein miraas (wirasat) ke ahkaam naazil hue jinhone bewa ke shohar ke ghar mein rehne ke hukm ko mansookh kar diya, ab wo Iddat jahaan chaahe poori kar sakti thi, aur uske liye rehne ki jagah muhaiya karna zaroori nahi raha. Ibn Abbas ne kaha, 'Is Aayat ne uske shohar ke ghar mein rehne (ke hukm) ko mansookh kar diya, aur wo apni Iddat (yaani chaar mahine dus din) jahaan chaahe poori kar sakti hai, jaisa Allah ke farmaan mein hai, "unhe nikaale bagair."'

e: Narrated Muhammad bin Seereen:I sat in a gathering in which the chiefs of the Ansar were present, and `Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Laila was amongst them. I mentioned the narration of `Abdullah bin `Utba regarding the question of Subai'a bint Al-Harith. `Abdur-Rahman said, "But `Abdullah's uncle used not to say so." I said, "I am too brave if I tell a lie concerning a person who is now in Al-Kufa," and I raised my voice. Then I went out and met Malik bin 'Amir or Malik bin `Auf, and said, "What was the verdict of Ibn Mas`ud about the pregnant widow whose husband had died?" He replied, "Ibn Mas`ud said, 'Why do you impose on her the hard order and don't let her make use of the leave? The shorter Sura of women (i.e. Surat-at- Talaq) was revealed after the longer Sura (i.e. Surat-al-Baqara)." (i.e. Her 'Idda is until she delivers)
hi: Muhammad bin Seereen bataate hain: Main ek majlis mein baitha tha jismein Ansaar ke sardaar maujood the, aur unmein Abdur Rahman bin Abu Laila bhi the. Maine Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Utba ki riwayat ka zikr kiya jo Subai'a bint Al-Harith ke masle ke baare mein thi. Abdur Rahman ne kaha, 'Magar Abdullah ke chacha to aisa nahi kaha karte the.' Maine kaha, 'Main itna himmatwar hoon ke agar main ek aise shaks ke baare mein jhoot bolunga jo abhi Kufa mein maujood hai (to log jaan lenge),' aur maine apni aawaaz buland ki. Phir main (wahaan se) nikla aur Malik bin Aamir ya Malik bin Auf se mila, aur pucha, 'Ibn Mas'ud ka us hamila bewa ke baare mein kya faisla tha jiska shohar mar chuka ho?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Ibn Mas'ud ne kaha, "Tum use kyun sakht hukm par majboor karte ho aur usse chhoot (rukhsat) kyun nahi lene dete? Auraton ki chhoti Surah (yaani Surah At-Talaq) badi Surah (yaani Surah Al-Baqarah) ke baad naazil hui thi." (Yaani uski Iddat wilaadat, yaani bache ki paidaish, tak hai.)'

e: Narrated `Ali (through two chains):On the day of Al-Khandaq (the battle of the Trench). the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "They (i.e. pagans prevented us from offering the middle (the Best) Prayer till the sun had set. May Allah fill their graves, their houses (or their bodies) with fire
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) (do sanadon se) bataate hain: Khandaq ki jang ke din Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Unhone (yaani mushrikeen ne) humein beech waali (behtareen) namaz padhne se roka, yahaan tak ke suraj doob gaya. Allah unki qabron ko, unke gharon ko (ya unke jismon ko) aag se bhar de.'

e: Narrated Zaid bin Arqam:We used to speak while in prayer. One of us used to speak to his brother (while in prayer) about his need, till the Verse was revealed:-- "Guard strictly the (five obligatory) prayers, especially the middle (the Best) (`Asr) Prayer and stand before Allah with obedience (and not to speak to others during the prayers)." Then we were ordered not to speak in the prayers
hi: Zaid bin Arqam (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum namaz mein baat kiya karte the. Hum mein se koi apne bhai se (namaz ke dauraan) apni zaroorat ke baare mein baat kar leta, yahaan tak ke ye Aayat naazil hui: 'Namazon ki hifaazat karo, khaas taur par beech waali (behtareen) namaz (yaani Asr) ki, aur Allah ke saamne farmaabardaari se khade raho (yaani namaz mein baat mat karo).' Iske baad humein namaz mein baat karne se mana kar diya gaya.

e: Narrated Nafi`:Whenever `Abdullah bin `Umar was asked about Salat-al-Khauf (i.e. prayer of fear) he said, "The Imam comes forward with a group of people and leads them in a one rak`a prayer while another group from them who has not prayed yet, stay between the praying group and the enemy. When those who are with the Imam have finished their one rak`a, they retreat and take the positions of those who have not prayed but they will not finish their prayers with Taslim. Those who have not prayed, come forward to offer a rak`a with the Imam (while the first group covers them from the enemy). Then the Imam, having offered two rak`at, finishes his prayer. Then each member of the two groups offer the second rak`a alone after the Imam has finished his prayer. Thus each one of the two groups will have offered two rak`at. But if the fear is too great, they can pray standing on their feet or riding on their mounts, facing the Qibla or not." Nafi` added: I do not think that `Abdullah bin `Umar narrated this except from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (See Hadith No. 451, Vol 5 to know exactly "The Fear Prayer)
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Jab bhi Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se Salat-ul-Khauf (khauf ki namaz) ke baare mein pucha jaata, wo kehte, 'Imaam logon ke ek giroh ke saath aage aata hai aur unhe ek rakat namaz padhaata hai, jabke doosra giroh jinhone abhi namaz nahi padhi wo namaz padhne walon aur dushman ke darmiyaan (pehre par) khada rehta hai. Jab Imaam ke saath wale apni ek rakat poori kar lete hain, to wo peeche hat jaate hain aur un logon ki jagah le lete hain jinhone namaz nahi padhi, magar wo apni namaz Salaam pherke khatam nahi karte. Jinhone namaz nahi padhi, wo aage aakar Imaam ke saath ek rakat ada karte hain (jabke pehla giroh unhe dushman se bachaata hai). Phir Imaam, do rakat padhaane ke baad, apni namaz khatam kar deta hai. Phir dono giroh ke log Imaam ke namaz khatam karne ke baad apni doosri rakat akele akele ada karte hain. Is tarah dono giroh ki do-do rakat ho jaati hain. Magar agar khatra bahut zyaada ho, to log khade khade ya sawaari par, Qibla ki taraf rukh karke ya bina rukh kiye bhi namaz padh sakte hain.' Nafi ne aage kaha, 'Mera khayaal hai ke Abdullah bin Umar ne ye baat sirf Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se hi riwayat ki hai.'

e: Narrated Ibn Az-Zubair:I said to `Uthman, "This Verse which is in Surat-al-Baqara: "Those of you who die and leave widows behind...without turning them out." has been abrogated by another Verse. Why then do you write it (in the Qur'an)?" `Uthman said. "Leave it (where it is), O the son of my brother, for I will not shift anything of it (i.e. the Qur'an) from its original position
hi: Ibn Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kaha, 'Surah Al-Baqarah ki ye Aayat: "Jo tum mein se wafat pa jaayein aur bewaayein chhod jaayein... unhe nikaale bagair" ek doosri Aayat se mansookh ho chuki hai, to phir aap ise (Quran mein) kyun likh rahe hain?' Uthman ne kaha, 'Ise chhod do, aye mere bhatije, main Quran ki kisi cheez ko uski asal jagah se nahi hataaunga.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "We have more right to be in doubt than Abraham when he said, 'My Lord! Show me how You give life to the dead.' He said, 'Do you not believe?' He said, 'Yes (I believe) but to be stronger in Faith
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Humein Ibrahim se zyaada shak karne ka haq hai, jab unhone kaha tha, "Aye mere Rab! Mujhe dikha de tu murdon ko kaise zinda karta hai." Allah ne pucha, "Kya tum Iman nahin rakhte?" Ibrahim ne jawab diya, "Kyun nahi (mujhe Iman hai), magar (chahta hoon ke) mera dil aur mutmain ho jaaye."'

e: Narrated Ubaid bin Umair:Once `Umar (bin Al-Khattab) said to the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) "What do you think about this Verse:--"Does any of you wish that he should have a garden?" They replied, "Allah knows best." `Umar became angry and said, "Either say that you know or say that you do not know!" On that Ibn `Abbas said, "O chief of the believers! I have something in my mind to say about it." `Umar said, "O son of my brother! Say, and do not under estimate yourself." Ibn `Abbas said, "This Verse has been set up as an example for deeds." `Umar said, "What kind of deeds?" Ibn `Abbas said, "For deeds." `Umar said, "This is an example for a rich man who does good out of obedience of Allah and then Allah sends him Satan whereupon he commits sins till all his good deeds are lost
hi: Ubaid bin Umair bataate hain: Ek baar Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab ne Nabi (SAW) ke sahaaba se pucha, 'Is Aayat ke baare mein tumhara kya khayaal hai: "Kya tum mein se koi chahega ke uska ek baagh ho..."?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Allah behtar jaanta hai.' Umar naaraaz ho gaye aur kaha, 'Ya to kaho tumhe pata hai, ya kaho tumhe nahi pata!' Isper Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen! Mere zehen mein iske baare mein kuch hai jo main kehna chahta hoon.' Umar ne kaha, 'Aye mere bhatije! Kaho, apne aap ko kam mat samjho.' Ibn Abbas ne kaha, 'Ye Aayat amaal (kaamon) ke liye ek misaal ke taur par pesh ki gayi hai.' Umar ne pucha, 'Kaunse amaal ke liye?' Ibn Abbas ne kaha, 'Amaal ke liye.' Umar ne kaha, 'Ye ek aise dolatmand aadmi ki misaal hai jo Allah ki farmaabardaari mein nek kaam karta hai, phir Allah uske paas Shaitaan bhej deta hai, jiski wajah se wo gunaah karne lagta hai yahaan tak ke uske sab nek amaal zaya ho jaate hain.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The poor person is not the one for whom a date or two or a morsel or two (of food is sufficient but the poor person is he who does not (beg or) ask the people (for something) or show his poverty at all. Recite if you wish, (Allah's Statement): "They do not beg of people at all
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Miskeen (asli gareeb) wo nahi jise ek ya do khajoorein, ya ek ya do luqme (khaana) mil jaayein to kaafi ho jaaye, balke asli miskeen wo hai jo (logon se) na maange aur na hi apni gurbat zaahir kare. Chaho to padho: "Wo logon se bilkul nahi maangte."'

e: Narrated `Aisha:When the Verses of Surat-al-Baqara regarding usury (i.e. Riba) were revealed, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) recited them before the people and then he prohibited the trade of alcoholic liquors
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab Surah Al-Baqarah ki soodkhori (Riba) ke baare mein Aayaten naazil hui, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe logon ke saamne padha, phir sharaab ki tijaarat ko haraam qaraar diya.

e: Narrated `Aisha:When the last Verses of Surat-al-Baqara were revealed. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went out and recited them in the Mosque and prohibited the trade of alcoholic liquors
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab Surah Al-Baqarah ki aakhri Aayaten naazil hui, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) baahar aaye aur unhe Masjid mein padha, aur sharaab ki tijaarat ko haraam qaraar diya.

e: Narrated `Aisha:When the last Verses of Surat-al-Baqara were revealed, the Prophet (ﷺ) read them in the Mosque and prohibited the trade of alcoholic liquors
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab Surah Al-Baqarah ki aakhri Aayaten naazil hui, to Nabi (SAW) ne unhe Masjid mein padha aur sharaab ki tijaarat ko haraam qaraar diya.

e: Narrated `Aisha:When the last Verses of Surat-al-Baqara were revealed, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up and recited them before us and then prohibited the trade of alcoholic liquors
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab Surah Al-Baqarah ki aakhri Aayaten naazil hui, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khade hue aur humare saamne unhe padha, phir sharaab ki tijaarat ko haraam qaraar diya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The last Verse (in the Qur'an) revealed to the Prophet (ﷺ) was the Verse dealing with usury (i.e. Riba)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) par naazil hone wali (Quran ki) aakhri Aayat soodkhori (Riba) ke baare mein thi.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:This Verse:--"Whether you show what is in your minds or conceal it.." (2.284) was abrogated
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ye Aayat, 'Chaahe tum apne dilon mein jo hai zaahir karo ya chhupaao...' (2:284), mansookh ho chuki hai.

e: Narrated Marwan Al-Asfar:A man from the companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who I think, was Ibn `Umar said, "The Verse:-- "Whether you show what is in your minds or conceal it...." was abrogated by the Verse following it
hi: Marwan Al-Asfar bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke sahaaba mein se ek shaks ne - mera khayaal hai wo Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) the - kaha, 'Aayat "Chaahe tum apne dilon mein jo hai zaahir karo ya chhupaao..." iske baad wali Aayat se mansookh ho gayi thi.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) recited the Verse:-- "It is He who has sent down to you the Book. In it are Verses that are entirely clear, they are the foundation of the Book, others not entirely clear. So as for those in whose hearts there is a deviation (from the Truth ). follow thereof that is not entirely clear seeking affliction and searching for its hidden meanings; but no one knows its hidden meanings but Allah. And those who are firmly grounded in knowledge say: "We believe in it (i.e. in the Qur'an) the whole of it (i.e. its clear and unclear Verses) are from our Lord. And none receive admonition except men of understanding." (3.7) Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If you see those who follow thereof that is not entirely clear, then they are those whom Allah has named [as having deviation (from the Truth)] 'So beware of them
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ye Aayat padhi: 'Wahi hai jisne tumpar Kitaab naazil ki, isme kuch Aayaten saaf aur wazeh hain, wo Kitaab ki buniyaad hain, aur kuch mutashaabih (ghair-wazeh) hain. Jinke dilon mein kaji (tirchhaapan) hai wo un mutashaabih Aayaton ke peechhe padte hain, fitna failaane aur unke chhupe maayne dhoondhne ke liye; jabke unke chhupe maayne sirf Allah jaanta hai. Aur jo ilm mein pukhta hain wo kehte hain, "Hum is (Quran) par Iman laaye, iski har baat hamare Rab ki taraf se hai." Aur naseehat sirf aqlmand log hi haasil karte hain.' (3:7) Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab tum unhe dekho jo mutashaabih Aayaton ke peechhe padte hain, to jaan lo ke Allah ne unhi logon ko (kaji rakhne wala) bataya hai, isliye unse hoshiyaar raho.'

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Al-Musaiyab:Abu Huraira said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'No child is born but that, Satan touches it when it is born whereupon it starts crying loudly because of being touched by Satan, except Mary and her son." Abu Huraira then said, "Recite, if you wish: "And I seek Refuge with You (Allah) for her and her offspring from Satan, the outcast
hi: Saeed bin Al-Musaiyab bataate hain ke Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Har bacha jo paida hota hai, Shaitaan use paidaish ke waqt chhoo leta hai, isi wajah se bacha zor se rota hai, siwaaye Maryam aur unke bete (Isa) ke.' Phir Abu Huraira ne kaha, 'Chaho to padho: "Aur main isse aur iski aulaad ko dhutkaare hue Shaitaan se Teri panaah mein deta hoon."'

e: Narrated Abu Wail:`Abdullah bin Masud said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Whoever takes an oath when asked to do so, in which he may deprive a Muslim of his property unlawfully, will meet Allah Who will be angry with him.' So Allah revealed in confirmation of this statement:--"Verily! Those who Purchase a small gain at the cost of Allah's Covenant and oaths, they shall have no portion in the Hereafter..." (3.77) Then entered Al-Ash'ath bin Qais and said, "What is Abu `Abdur-Rahman narrating to you?" We replied, 'So-and-so." Al-Ash'ath said, "This Verse was revealed in my connection. I had a well in the land of my cousin (and he denied my, possessing it). On that the Prophet (ﷺ) said to me, 'Either you bring forward a proof or he (i.e. your cousin) takes an oath (to confirm his claim)' I said, 'I am sure he would take a (false) oath, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).' He said, 'If somebody takes an oath when asked to do so through which he may deprive a Muslim of his property (unlawfully) and he is a liar in his oath, he will meet Allah Who will be angry with him
hi: Abu Wail bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Masud ne kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, "Jo shaks (kisi jhagde mein) qasam khaane ko kaha jaaye aur wo aisi qasam khaaye jisse kisi Musalmaan ka maal naahaq chheenna maqsood ho, wo Allah se aisi haalat mein milega ke Allah usse naaraaz hoga." Isper Allah ne is baat ki tasdeeq mein naazil farmaya: "Beshak jo log Allah ke ahd aur apni qasmon ke badle thodi si keemat kharidte hain, unke liye Aakhirat mein koi hissa nahi..." (3:77)' Isi dauraan Al-Ash'ath bin Qais andar aaye aur pucha, 'Abu Abdur Rahman tumhe kya bata rahe hain?' Humne kaha, 'Falaan baat.' Al-Ash'ath ne kaha, 'Ye Aayat mere hi silsile mein naazil hui thi. Mera ek kuaan mere chachazaad bhai ki zameen mein tha (aur usne mera haq maanne se inkaar kiya). Isper Nabi (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya, "Ya to tum saboot pesh karo, ya wo (tumhara chachazaad) qasam khaaye." Maine kaha, "Mujhe yaqeen hai ke wo (jhoothi) qasam khaa lega, Aye Allah ke Rasool!" Unhone farmaya, "Jo koi qasam khaane ko kaha jaaye aur wo aisi qasam khaaye jisse kisi Musalmaan ka maal naahaq chheenna ho aur apni qasam mein jhoota ho, wo Allah se aisi haalat mein milega ke Allah usse naaraaz hoga."'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abu `Aufa:A man displayed some merchandise in the market and took an oath that he had been offered a certain price for it while in fact he had not, in order to cheat a man from the Muslims. So then was revealed:-- "Verily! Those who purchase a small gain at the cost of Allah's Covenant and their oaths
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abu Aufa bataate hain: Ek shaks ne bazaar mein apna saamaan pesh kiya aur qasam khaayi ke usse iske liye (asal se zyaada) qeemat ki peshkash ki gayi thi, jabke aisa nahi hua tha, taake wo kisi Musalmaan ko dhoka de sake. Isper ye Aayat naazil hui: 'Beshak jo log Allah ke ahd aur apni qasmon ke badle thodi si keemat kharidte hain...'

e: Narrated Ibn Abu Mulaika:Two women were stitching shoes in a house or a room. Then one of them came out with an awl driven into her hand, and she sued the other for it. The case was brought before Ibn `Abbas, Ibn `Abbas said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'If people were to be given what they claim (without proving their claim) the life and property of the nation would be lost.' Will you remind her (i.e. the defendant), of Allah and recite before her:--"Verily! Those who purchase a small gain at the cost of Allah's Covenant and their oaths..."(3.77) So they reminded her and she confessed. Ibn `Abbas then said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'The oath is to be taken by the defendant (in the absence of any proof against him)
hi: Ibn Abu Mulaika bataate hain: Do auratein ek ghar ya kamre mein joote sil rahi thin. Unmein se ek suja (awl) haath mein ghusa hone ke saath baahar aayi, aur usne doosri par ilzaam lagaaya. Maamla Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas laaya gaya. Ibn Abbas ne kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, "Agar logon ko wo sab kuch de diya jaaye jo wo (bina saboot ke) dava karein, to logon ki jaan aur maal barbaad ho jaaye." (Isliye tum) usse (yaani mulzima ko) Allah ka khauf yaad dilaao aur uske saamne ye padho: "Beshak jo log Allah ke ahd aur apni qasmon ke badle thodi si keemat kharidte hain..." (3:77)' To unhone usse yaad dilaaya aur usne iqraar kar liya. Ibn Abbas ne aage kaha, 'Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, "Qasam mulzim (jispar ilzaam ho, jab saboot na ho) ko uthaani hoti hai."'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Abu Sufyan narrated to me personally, saying, "I set out during the Truce that had been concluded between me and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). While I was in Sham, a letter sent by the Prophet (ﷺ) was brought to Heraclius. Dihya Al-Kalbi had brought and given it to the governor of Busra, and the latter forwarded it to Heraclius. Heraclius said, 'Is there anyone from the people of this man who claims to be a prophet?' The people replied, 'Yes.' So I along with some of Quraishi men were called and we entered upon Heraclius, and we were seated in front of him. Then he said, 'Who amongst you is the nearest relative to the man who claims to be a prophet?' So they made me sit in front of him and made my companions sit behind me. Then he called upon his translator and said (to him), 'Tell them (i.e. Abu Sufyan's companions) that I am going to ask him (i.e. Abu Sufyan) regarding that man who claims to be a prophet. So, if he tells me a lie, they should contradict him (instantly).' By Allah, had I not been afraid that my companions would consider me a liar, I would have told lies. Heraclius then said to his translator, 'Ask him: What is his (i.e. the Prophet's) family status amongst you? I said, 'He belongs to a noble family amongst us." Heraclius said, 'Was any of his ancestors a king?' I said, 'No.' He said, 'Did you ever accuse him of telling lies before his saying what he has said?' I said, 'No.' He said, 'Do the nobles follow him or the poor people?' I said, 'It is the poor who followed him.' He said, 'Is the number of his followers increasing or decreasing?' I said, 'They are increasing.' He said, 'Does anyone renounce his religion (i.e. Islam) after embracing it, being displeased with it?' I said, 'No.' He said, 'Did you fight with him?' I replied, 'Yes.' He said, 'How was your fighting with him?' I said, 'The fighting between us was undecided and victory was shared by him and us by turns. He inflicts casualties upon us and we inflict casualties upon him.' He said, 'Did he ever betray?' I said, 'No, but now we are away from him in this truce and we do not know what he will do in it" Abu Sufyan added, "By Allah, I was not able to insert in my speech a word (against him) except that. Heraclius said, 'Did anybody else (amongst you) ever claim the same (i.e. Islam) before him?' I said, 'No.' Then Heraclius told his translator to tell me (i.e. Abu Sufyan), 'I asked you about his family status amongst you, and you told me that he comes from a noble family amongst you. Verily, all Apostles come from the noblest family among their people. Then I asked you whether any of his ancestors was a king, and you denied that. Thereupon I thought that had one of his fore-fathers been a king, I would have said that he (i.e. Muhammad) was seeking to rule the kingdom of his fore-fathers. Then I asked you regarding his followers, whether they were the noble or the poor among the people, and you said that they were only the poor (who follow him). In fact, such are the followers of the Apostles. Then I asked you whether you have ever accused him of telling lies before saying what he said, and your reply was in the negative. Therefore, I took for granted that a man who did not tell a lie about others, could ever tell a lie about Allah. Then I asked you whether anyone of his followers had renounced his religion (i.e. Islam) after embracing it, being displeased with it, and you denied that. And such is Faith when it mixes with the cheerfulness of the hearts. Then I asked you whether his followers were increasing or decreasing. You claimed that they were increasing. That is the way of true faith till it is complete. Then I asked you whether you had ever fought with him, and you claimed that you had fought with him and the battle between you and him was undecided and the victory was shared by you and him in turns; he inflicted casualties upon you and you inflicted casualties upon them. Such is the case with the Apostles; they are put to test and the final victory is for them. Then I asked you whether he had ever betrayed; you claimed that he had never betrayed. Indeed, Apostles never betray. Then I asked you whether anyone had said this statement before him; and you denied that. Thereupon I thought if somebody had said that statement before him, then I would have said that he was but a man copying some sayings said before him." Abu Sufyan said, "Heraclius then asked me, 'What does he order you to do?' I said, 'He orders us (to offer) prayers and (to pay) Zakat and to keep good relationship with the Kith and kin and to be chaste.' Then Heraclius said, 'If whatever you have said, is true, he is really a prophet, and I knew that he ( i.e. the Prophet (ﷺ) ) was going to appear, but I never thought that he would be from amongst you. If I were certain that I can reach him, I would like to meet him and if I were with him, I would wash his feet; and his kingdom will expand (surely to what is under my feet).' Then Heraclius asked for the letter of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and read it wherein was written: "In the Name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful. This letter is from Muhammad, Apostle of Allah, to Heraclius, the sovereign of Byzantine........ Peace be upon him who follows the Right Path. Now then, I call you to embrace Islam. Embrace Islam and you will be saved (from Allah's Punishment); embrace Islam, and Allah will give you a double reward, but if you reject this, you will be responsible for the sins of the tillers (i.e. the people of your kingdom) and (Allah's Statement):--"O the people of the Scripture (Jews and Christians)! Come to a word common to you and us that we worship None but Allah....bear witness that we are Muslims.' (3.64) When he finished reading the letter, voices grew louder near him and there was a great hue and cry, and we were ordered to go out." Abu Sufyan added, "While coming out, I said to my companions, 'The situation of Ibn Abu Kabsha (i.e. Muhammad) has become strong; even the king of Banu Al-Asfar is afraid of him.' So I continued to believe that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) would be victorious, till Allah made me embrace Islam." Az-Zuhri said, "Heraclius then invited all the chiefs of the Byzantines and had them assembled in his house and said, 'O group of Byzantines! Do you wish to have a permanent success and guidance and that your kingdom should remain with you?' (Immediately after hearing that), they rushed towards the gate like onagers, but they found them closed. Heraclius then said, 'Bring them back to me.' So he called them and said, 'I just wanted to test the strength of your adherence to your religion. Now I have observed of you that which I like.' Then the people fell in prostration before him and became pleased with him." (See Hadith No. 6,Vol)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne unhe khud bataya: 'Main us sulah ke dauraan (Sham) nikla tha jo mere aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke darmiyaan hui thi. Main Sham mein tha jab Nabi (SAW) ka bheja hua khat Heraclius (Rome ke baadshaah) ke paas laaya gaya. Dihya Al-Kalbi ne wo khat Busra ke haakim ko diya tha aur usne aage Heraclius tak pahunchaaya. Heraclius ne pucha, "Kya yahaan is shaks ke logon mein se koi hai jo Nabi hone ka dava karta hai?" Logon ne kaha, "Haan." To mujhe aur kuch Quraishi aadmiyon ko bulaaya gaya aur hum Heraclius ke saamne baithaaye gaye. Usne pucha, "Tum mein se is Nabi ke dava karne wale se sabse zyaada qareebi rishtedaar kaun hai?" To mujhe uske saamne baithaaya gaya aur mere saathiyon ko mere peechhe. Usne apne tarjuman se kaha, "Unhe bata do ke main is shaks se us aadmi ke baare mein sawaal karunga jo Nabi hone ka dava karta hai. Agar wo jhoot bole, to ye log turant usse jhutla dein." Allah ki qasam, agar mujhe apne saathiyon ke saamne jhoota kehlaane ka dar na hota, to shaayad main jhoot bol deta. Heraclius ne apne tarjuman se kaha, "Usse pucho: unke darmiyaan uska khaandaani martaba kaisa hai?" Maine kaha, "Wo humare beech ek izzatdaar khaandaan se hain." Usne pucha, "Kya unke baap-dadaon mein koi baadshaah tha?" Maine kaha, "Nahi." Usne pucha, "Unke ye baatein kehne se pehle, kya tumne kabhi unhe jhoot bolte pakda tha?" Maine kaha, "Nahi." Usne pucha, "Kya izzatdaar log unki pairvi karte hain ya gareeb log?" Maine kaha, "Gareeb log hi unki pairvi karte hain." Usne pucha, "Kya unke maanne walon ki tadaad badh rahi hai ya ghat rahi hai?" Maine kaha, "Badh rahi hai." Usne pucha, "Kya koi unka deen qubool karne ke baad usse naaraaz hokar wapas mud jaata hai?" Maine kaha, "Nahi." Usne pucha, "Kya tumne unse jang ki hai?" Maine kaha, "Haan." Usne pucha, "Wo jang kaisi rahi?" Maine kaha, "Humari aur unki jang mein kabhi hum jeette, kabhi wo jeette, kabhi wo hamein nuqsaan pahunchaate, kabhi hum unhe." Usne pucha, "Kya unhone kabhi ahad-shikani (waada-khilaafi) ki hai?" Maine kaha, "Nahi, magar abhi hum sulah ki wajah se unse door hain, aage kya hoga hume nahi pata." (Abu Sufyan kehte hain:) Allah ki qasam, main iske siwa unke khilaaf koi aisi baat nahi kaha jo unke liye nuqsaandeh ho. Usne pucha, "Kya unse pehle kisi aur ne bhi (Nabuwwat ka) aisa hi dava kiya tha?" Maine kaha, "Nahi." Phir Heraclius ne apne tarjuman se mujhe kehlaaya, "Maine tumse unka khaandaani martaba pucha, tumne kaha wo izzatdaar khaandaan se hain - haqeeqat mein sab Nabi apni qaum ke behtareen khaandaanon se hi aate hain. Maine pucha kya unke baap-dadaon mein koi baadshaah tha, tumne inkaar kiya - agar aisa hota to main sochta ke wo apne baap-dadaon ki saltanat wapas paane ki koshish kar rahe hain. Maine pucha unke maanne wale izzatdaar hain ya gareeb, tumne kaha sirf gareeb log unki pairvi karte hain - aur yahi Rasoolon ke maanne wale hote hain. Maine pucha kya unhe jhoot bolte pakda tha is dava se pehle, tumne inkaar kiya - to main jaan gaya ke jo insaanon se jhoot nahi bolta wo Allah par jhoot kaise bandhega. Maine pucha kya koi unka deen chhod kar wapas mudta hai, tumne inkaar kiya - aisa hi Iman hota hai jab dilon mein poora utar jaaye. Maine pucha unke maanne walon ki tadaad badh rahi hai ya ghat, tumne kaha badh rahi hai - yahi sacche Iman ka raasta hai jab tak wo mukammal na ho jaaye. Maine pucha kya tumne unse jang ki, tumne kaha ki aur bataya ke jeet-haar barabar rahi, kabhi wo tumhe nuqsaan dete kabhi tum unhe - yahi Rasoolon ka tareeka hota hai, unhe aazmaaya jaata hai magar aakhir mein jeet unhi ki hoti hai. Maine pucha kya unhone kabhi ahad tori, tumne inkaar kiya - Rasool kabhi ahad nahi todte. Maine pucha kya unse pehle kisi aur ne aisa dava kiya, tumne inkaar kiya - agar aisa hota to main sochta ke ye shaks pehle kahi hui baat dohara raha hai." Abu Sufyan ne aage kaha, 'Phir Heraclius ne pucha, "Wo tumhe kya karne ka hukm dete hain?" Maine kaha, "Namaz padhne, Zakat dene, rishtedaari nibhaane aur pakeezgi (paakbaazi) ikhtiyaar karne ka." Isper Heraclius ne kaha, "Agar tumne jo bataya wo sach hai, to wo waaqai Nabi hain, aur mujhe pehle se pata tha ke wo aane wale hain, magar mujhe khayaal nahi tha ke wo tum mein se honge. Agar mujhe yaqeen hota ke main unke paas pahunch sakta hoon, to main zaroor unse milta, aur agar main unke paas hota to unke pair dhota; aur unki saltanat wahaan tak phailegi jahaan is waqt mere pair hain." Phir Heraclius ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka khat mangwaaya aur padha, usmein likha tha: "Allah ke naam se jo bada meharbaan, nihaayat reham karne wala hai. Ye khat Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool, ki taraf se hai, Heraclius, Rome ke baadshaah, ke naam... Salaam ho us par jo Hidaayat ki pairvi kare. Ab, main tumhein Islam ki taraf bulaata hoon. Islam qubool karo, aamaan mein rahoge; Islam qubool karo, Allah tumhe dohra ajr dega, magar agar tum inkaar karo, to apni raaya (praja) ke gunaahon ka bojh bhi tum par hoga." Aur (khat mein ye Aayat bhi thi): "Aye Ahl-e-Kitaab! Aao us baat ki taraf jo hamare aur tumhare darmiyaan yaksaan hai - ke hum sirf Allah ki ibaadat karein... aur gawaahi do ke hum farmaabardaar (Muslim) hain." (3:64) Jab usne khat padhna khatam kiya, to uske aas-paas shor aur cheekh-pukaar badh gayi, aur humein baahar nikal jaane ka hukm diya gaya.' Abu Sufyan ne aage kaha, 'Baahar nikalte waqt maine apne saathiyon se kaha, "Ibn Abi Kabsha (yaani Muhammad) ka maamla to bahut zor pakad chuka hai, ab to Banu Al-Asfar (Rome) ka baadshaah bhi unse darta hai." Aur main isi yaqeen par rehta raha ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki fatah honi hai, yahaan tak ke Allah ne mujhe bhi Islam qubool karne ki taufeeq di.' Ravi Az-Zuhri kehte hain: Heraclius ne baad mein Rome ke sab sardaaron ko apne mahal mein bulaaya aur unse kaha, 'Aye Rome ke logo! Kya tum chahte ho ke tumhein hamesha ki kaamyaabi aur hidaayat mile aur tumhari saltanat qaayam rahe?' Ye sunte hi wo darwaaze ki taraf bhaage jaise jangli gadhe, magar darwaaze band mil gaye. Heraclius ne kaha, 'Unhe wapas laao.' Jab wo wapas aaye to usne kaha, 'Main to sirf tumhare deen ke saath tumhari wafaadaari ki jaanch kar raha tha, aur ab maine tum mein wo dekh liya hai jo mujhe pasand hai.' Isper log uske saamne sajde mein gir gaye aur uske saath raazi ho gaye.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Out of all the Ansar, living in Medina, Abu Talha had the largest number of (date palm trees) gardens, and the most beloved of his property to him was Bairuha garden which was standing opposite the Mosque (of the Prophet). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to enter it and drink of its good water. When the Verse was revealed:--"By no means shall you attain righteousness unless you spend (in charity) of that which you love." (3.92) Abu Talha got up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), Allah says:--"By no means shall you attain righteousness unless you spend (in charity) of that which you love." (3.92) and the most beloved of my property to me is the Bairuha garden, so I give it (as a charitable gift) in Allah's Cause and hope to receive good out of it, and to have it stored for me with Allah. So, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Dispose it of (i.e. utilize it) in the way Allah orders you (to dispose it of)." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Bravo! That is a fruitful property! That is a fruitful property! I have heard what you have said and I think that you should distribute that (garden) amongst your relatives." Then Abu Talha distributed that garden amongst his relatives and his cousins. Narrated Yahya bin Yahya: I learnt from Malik, "..a fruitful property
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Madina ke tamaam Ansaar mein Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas sabse zyaada khajoor ke baagh the, aur unki sabse aziz milkiyat 'Bairuha' baagh thi jo Masjid-e-Nabvi ke saamne thi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) usme jaaya karte the aur uska achha paani piya karte the. Jab ye Aayat naazil hui, 'Tum haqeeqi neki tab tak nahi paa sakte jab tak wo cheez (Allah ki raah mein) na kharch karo jo tumhe aziz hai' (3:92), to Abu Talha khade hue aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Allah farmaata hai, "Tum haqeeqi neki tab tak nahi paa sakte jab tak wo cheez kharch na karo jo tumhe aziz hai," aur meri sabse aziz milkiyat Bairuha baagh hai, isliye main ise Allah ki raah mein sadqa deta hoon aur ummeed rakhta hoon ke ye mere liye Allah ke yahaan nekiyon mein jama ho. Aye Allah ke Rasool! Isse jahaan Allah ka hukm ho wahaan istemaal kar lijiye.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Wah! Ye to bahut hi mufeed milkiyat hai! Ye bahut hi mufeed milkiyat hai! Maine jo tumne kaha wo sun liya, aur mera khayaal hai ke tum ise apne rishtedaaron mein baant do.' To Abu Talha ne wo baagh apne rishtedaaron aur chachazaad bhaion mein baant diya. Ravi Yahya bin Yahya kehte hain: Maine Malik se seekha ke iska matlab hai '...ek nihaayat mufeed milkiyat.'

e: Narrated Anas:Abu Talha distributed the garden between Hassan and Ubai, but he did not give me anything thereof although I was a nearer relative to him
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne wo baagh Hassan aur Ubai ke darmiyaan baant diya, magar mujhe usmein se kuch nahi diya, halaanke main unka zyaada qareebi rishtedaar tha.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The Jews brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) a man and a woman from among them who had committed illegal sexual intercourse. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to them, "How do you usually punish the one amongst you who has committed illegal sexual intercourse?" They replied, "We blacken their faces with coal and beat them," He said, "Don't you find the order of Ar-Rajm (i.e. stoning to death) in the Torah?" They replied, "We do not find anything in it." `Abdullah bin Salam (after hearing this conversation) said to them. "You have told a lie! Bring here the Torah and recite it if you are truthful." (So the Jews brought the Torah). And the religious teacher who was teaching it to them, put his hand over the Verse of Ar- Rajm and started reading what was written above and below the place hidden with his hand, but he did not read the Verse of Ar-Rajm. `Abdullah bin Salam removed his (i.e. the teacher's) hand from the Verse of Ar-Rajm and said, "What is this?" So when the Jews saw that Verse, they said, "This is the Verse of Ar-Rajm." So the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered the two adulterers to be stoned to death, and they were stoned to death near the place where biers used to be placed near the Mosque. I saw her companion (i.e. the adulterer) bowing over her so as to protect her from the stones
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Yahudi Nabi (SAW) ke paas apne mein se ek mard aur ek aurat ko le aaye jinhone zina kiya tha. Nabi (SAW) ne unse pucha, 'Tum log zina karne wale ko aam taur par kya saza dete ho?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Hum unke chehre koyle se kaale kar dete hain aur unhe maarte hain.' Unhone farmaya, 'Kya tumhein Tauret mein Rajm (patthar maar kar maut ki saza) ka hukm nahi milta?' Unhone kaha, 'Humein usmein kuch nahi milta.' Abdullah bin Salam (رضی اللہ عنہ) (ye sunkar) ne unse kaha, 'Tum jhoot bol rahe ho! Tauret laao aur padho agar tum sachche ho.' To Yahudi Tauret le aaye, aur jo aalim unhe padha raha tha, usne Rajm ki Aayat par apna haath rakh diya aur uske upar aur neeche ki ibaarat padhne laga, magar Rajm ki Aayat nahi padhi. Abdullah bin Salam ne uska haath Rajm ki Aayat se hataaya aur kaha, 'Ye kya hai?' Jab Yahudiyon ne wo Aayat dekhi, to unhone kaha, 'Ye to Rajm ki hi Aayat hai.' Isper Nabi (SAW) ne un dono zina karne walon ko Rajm karne ka hukm diya, aur unhein Masjid ke qareeb, jahaan janaaze rakhe jaate the, wahin Rajm kiya gaya. Ravi kehte hain, 'Maine dekha ke us aurat ka saathi (yaani wo mard) uske upar jhuk gaya taake wo patthron se usko bacha sake.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Verse:--"You (true Muslims) are the best of peoples ever raised up for mankind." means, the best of peoples for the people, as you bring them with chains on their necks till they embrace Islam
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Is Aayat, 'Tum sab logon ke liye khada ki gayi sabse behtareen ummat ho,' ka matlab ye hai ke tum logon ke liye behtareen ho, kyunke tum unhe (jaise ke qaidiyon ki tarah) zanjeeron mein baandh kar laate ho yahaan tak ke wo Islam qubool kar lete hain.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Verse:--"When two parties from among you were about to lose heart, but Allah was their Protector," (3.122) was revealed concerning us, and we were the two parties, i.e. Banu Haritha and Banu Salama, and we do not wish (that it had not been revealed) or I would not have been pleased (if it had not been revealed), for Allah says:--"...Allah was their Protector
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ye Aayat, 'Jab tum mein se do giroh himmat haarne ke qareeb the, magar Allah unka hifaazat karne wala tha' (3:122), hamare baare mein naazil hui thi, aur hum hi wo do giroh the, yaani Banu Haritha aur Banu Salama. Hum chahte nahi ke (kaash) ye naazil na hoti (kyunke) Allah farmaata hai, '...Allah unka hifaazat karne wala tha.'

e: Narrated Salim's father:That he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on raising his head from the bowing in the last rak`a in the Fajr prayer, saying, "O Allah, curse such-and-such person and such-and-such person, and such-and-such person," after saying, "Allah hears him who sends his praises to Him, O our Lord, all praise is for You." So Allah revealed:--"Not for you (O Muhammad) (but for Allah) is the decision, verily they are indeed wrongdoers
hi: Salim ke waalid (Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ)) bataate hain: Unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Fajr ki namaz ki aakhri rakat mein ruku se sar uthaate hue, 'Sami Allahu liman hamidah, Rabbana wa lakal hamd' kehne ke baad, farmaate suna, 'Aye Allah! Falaan aur falaan aur falaan par laanat kar.' Isper Allah ne naazil farmaya: '(Aye Muhammad) ye faisla aapke ikhtiyaar mein nahi (balke Allah ke ikhtiyaar mein hai); ye log zaalim hain.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) intended to invoke evil upon somebody or invoke good upon somebody, he used to invoke (Allah) after bowing (in the prayer). Sometimes after saying, "Allah hears him who sends his praises to Him, all praise is for You, O our Lord," he would say, "O Allah. Save Al-Walid bin Al-Walid and Salama bin Hisham, and `Aiyash bin Abu Rabi`a. O Allah! Inflict Your Severe Torture on Mudar (tribe) and strike them with (famine) years like the years of Joseph." The Prophet (ﷺ) used to say in a loud voice, and he also used to say in some of his Fajr prayers, "O Allah! Curse so-and-so and so-and-so." naming some of the Arab tribes till Allah revealed:--"Not for you (O Muhammad) (but for Allah) is the decision
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab bhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) kisi ke liye buraai ya bhalaai ki dua karna chahte, to namaz mein ruku ke baad ye dua karte. Kabhi 'Sami Allahu liman hamidah, Rabbana wa lakal hamd' kehne ke baad wo farmaate, 'Aye Allah! Al-Walid bin Al-Walid, Salama bin Hisham, aur Aiyash bin Abu Rabi'a ko bacha le. Aye Allah! Qabeela Mudar par apna sakht azaab utaar aur unhe Yusuf (Alaihissalam) ke zamaane jaisa qehat (aakaal) mein daal de.' Nabi (SAW) ye buland aawaaz se kaha karte the, aur kuch Fajr ki namazon mein farmate, 'Aye Allah! Falaan aur falaan par laanat kar,' kuch Arab qabeelon ke naam lete hue, yahaan tak ke Allah ne ye naazil farmaya: '(Aye Muhammad) ye faisla aapke ikhtiyaar mein nahi.'

e: Narrated Al-Bara bin Azib:The Prophet (ﷺ) appointed `Abdullah bin Jubair as the commander of the infantry during the battle of Uhud. They returned defeated, and that is what is meant by:-- "And the Apostle was calling them back in the rear. None remained with the Prophet (ﷺ) then, but twelve men
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne Uhud ki jang mein Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Jubair ko paidal fauj ka sardaar muqarrar kiya tha. Wo shikast khaake wapas aa gaye, aur yahi wo baat hai jiski taraf Allah ne ishara kiya, 'Aur Rasool tumhein peechhe se pukaar rahe the. (Us waqt) Nabi (SAW) ke paas baarah aadmiyon ke siwa koi nahi bacha tha.'

e: Narrated Abu Talha:Slumber overtook us during the battle of Uhud while we were in the front files. My sword would fall from my hand and I would pick it up, and again it would fall down and I would pick it up again
hi: Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jung-e-Uhud ke dauraan hum agli safon mein the aur humpar neend (ungh) chhaa gayi thi. Mera talwaar mere haath se gir jaata aur main use uthaa leta, phir dobara gir jaata aur main phir se uthaa leta.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:'Allah is Sufficient for us and He Is the Best Disposer of affairs," was said by Abraham when he was thrown into the fire; and it was said by Muhammad when they (i.e. hypocrites) said, "A great army is gathering against you, therefore, fear them," but it only increased their faith and they said: "Allah is Sufficient for us, and He is the Best Disposer (of affairs, for us)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: 'Hamare liye Allah kaafi hai aur wo behtareen kaarsaaz hai' - ye alfaaz Ibrahim (Alaihissalam) ne kahe the jab unhe aag mein daala gaya tha; aur yahi alfaaz Muhammad (SAW) ne kahe jab (munaafiqon) ne kaha, 'Tumhare khilaaf ek bada lashkar jama ho raha hai, isliye unse daro,' magar isse unka Iman aur badh gaya aur unhone kaha, 'Hamare liye Allah kaafi hai aur wo behtareen kaarsaaz hai.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The last statement of Abraham when he was thrown into the fire was:--"Allah is Sufficient for us and He is the Best Disposer (of affairs for us)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ibrahim (Alaihissalam) ke aakhri alfaaz jab unhe aag mein daala gaya, ye the: 'Hamare liye Allah kaafi hai aur wo behtareen kaarsaaz hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Anyone whom Allah has given wealth but he does not pay its Zakat, then, on the Day of Resurrection, his wealth will be presented to him in the shape of a bald-headed poisonous male snake with two poisonous glands in its mouth and it will encircle itself round his neck and bite him over his cheeks and say, "I am your wealth; I am your treasure." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) recited this Divine Verse:-- "And let not those who covetously withhold of that which Allah has bestowed upon them of His Bounty
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jise Allah ne maal diya ho aur wo uski Zakat na de, to Qayamat ke din uska maal ek gunje sar wale zehreele saanp ki shakl mein uske saamne laaya jaayega, jiske munh mein zehar ke do gilte honge, wo uski gardan mein lipat jaayega aur uske gaal kaatega aur kahega, "Main tera maal hoon, main tera khazaana hoon."' Phir Nabi (SAW) ne ye Aayat padhi: 'Aur jo log Allah ke fazl se diye gaye maal ko lalach ke saath rok lete hain (khairaat karne se), ye unke liye achha na samjhein...'

e: Narrated Usama bin Zaid:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) rode a donkey, equipped with a thick cloth-covering made in Fadak and I was riding behind him. He was going to pay visit to Sa`d bin Ubada in Banu Al-Harith bin Al-Khazraj; and this incident happened before the battle of Badr. The Prophet (ﷺ) passed by a gathering in which `Abdullah bin Ubai bin Salul was present, and that was before `Abdullah bin Ubai embraced Islam. Behold in that gathering there were people of different religions: there were Muslims, pagans, idol-worshippers and Jews, and in that gathering `Abdullah bin Rawaha was also present. When a cloud of dust raised by the donkey reached that gathering, `Abdullah bin Ubai covered his nose with his garment and then said, "Do not cover us with dust." Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) greeted them and stopped and dismounted and invited them to Allah (i.e. to embrace Islam) and recited to them the Holy Qur'an. On that, `Abdullah bin Ubai bin Salul said, "O man ! There is nothing better than that what you say. If it is the truth, then do not trouble us with it in our gatherings. Return to your mount (or residence) and if somebody comes to you, relate (your tales) to him." On that `Abdullah bin Rawaha said, "Yes, O Allah's Apostle! Bring it (i.e. what you want to say) to us in our gathering, for we love that." So the Muslims, the pagans and the Jews started abusing one another till they were on the point of fighting with one another. The Prophet (ﷺ) kept on quietening them till they became quiet, whereupon the Prophet rode his animal (mount) and proceeded till he entered upon Sa`d bin Ubada. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to Sa`d, "Did you not hear what 'Abu Hubab said?" He meant `Abdullah bin Ubai. "He said so-and-so." On that Sa`d bin Ubada said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Excuse and forgive him, for by Him Who revealed the Book to you, Allah brought the Truth which was sent to you at the time when the people of this town (i.e. Medina) had decided unanimously to crown him and tie a turban on his head (electing him as chief). But when Allah opposed that (decision) through the Truth which Allah gave to you, he (i.e. `Abdullah bin Ubai) was grieved with jealousy, and that caused him to do what you have seen." So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) excused him, for the Prophet (ﷺ) and his companions used to forgive the pagans and the people of Scripture as Allah had ordered them, and they used to put up with their mischief with patience. Allah said: "And you shall certainly hear much that will grieve you from those who received the Scripture before you and from the pagans........'(3.186) And Allah also said:--"Many of the people of the Scripture wish if they could turn you away as disbelievers after you have believed, from selfish envy.." (2.109) So the Prophet (ﷺ) used to stick to the principle of forgiveness for them as long as Allah ordered him to do so till Allah permitted fighting them. So when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) fought the battle of Badr and Allah killed the nobles of Quraish infidels through him, Ibn Ubai bin Salul and the pagans and idolaters who were with him, said, "This matter (i.e. Islam) has appeared (i.e. became victorious)." So they gave the pledge of allegiance (for embracing Islam) to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and became Muslims
hi: Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek gadhe par sawaar the jispar Fadak mein banaayi gayi ek moti chaadar dali hui thi, aur main unke peechhe sawaar tha. Wo Sa'd bin Ubada (رضی اللہ عنہ) se milne Banu Al-Harith bin Al-Khazraj ja rahe the - ye waqiya jang-e-Badr se pehle ka hai. Raaste mein Nabi (SAW) ek majlis (baithak) ke paas se guzre jismein Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ubai bin Salul maujood tha - ye us waqt ki baat hai jab wo abhi Islam nahi laaya tha. Us majlis mein alag alag mazhab ke log the: Musalmaan, mushrik, but-parast aur Yahudi, aur Abdullah bin Rawaha bhi wahaan maujood the. Jab gadhe se uthi dhool us majlis tak pahunchi, to Abdullah bin Ubai ne apni chaadar se apni naak dhaanp li aur kaha, 'Humein dhool se mat dhaanpo.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe salaam kiya, ruke, utre, aur unhe Allah ki taraf (yaani Islam qubool karne ki) dawat di aur unke saamne Quran padha. Isper Abdullah bin Ubai bin Salul ne kaha, 'Aye shaks! Jo tum keh rahe ho usse behtar to kuch nahi, magar agar ye sach hai to hamein hamari majlison mein takleef mat do. Apni sawaari (ya ghar) par wapas jao, aur jo tumhare paas aaye usse apni baatein sunaao.' Isper Abdullah bin Rawaha ne kaha, 'Nahi, Aye Allah ke Rasool! Aap ye baat hamari majlison mein hi laayein, kyunke humein ye pasand hai.' Isper Musalmaan, mushrik aur Yahudi ek doosre ko bura-bhala kehne lage yahaan tak ke jhagda hone hi wala tha. Nabi (SAW) unhe shaant karte rahe jab tak wo shaant ho gaye, phir Nabi (SAW) apni sawaari par sawaar hokar aage badhe aur Sa'd bin Ubada ke paas pahunche. Nabi (SAW) ne Sa'd se kaha, 'Kya tumne suna Abu Hubab (yaani Abdullah bin Ubai) ne kya kaha?' Aur unhone bataya ke Abdullah bin Ubai ne kya kaha tha. Isper Sa'd bin Ubada ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Unhe maaf kar dijiye aur darguzar kijiye, us Zaat ki qasam jisne aap par Kitaab naazil ki, Allah ne aap ke zariye jo haq bheja hai, us se pehle is shehar (Madina) ke log usse (yaani Abdullah bin Ubai ko) apna sardaar banaane aur uske sar par taaj (pagdi) baandhne par muttafiq ho chuke the. Jab Allah ne us Haqq ke zariye jo aapko diya, uske iraade ko rok diya, to wo hasad ki wajah se dukhi ho gaya, aur isi wajah se usne wo kiya jo aapne dekha.' To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe maaf kar diya, kyunke Nabi (SAW) aur unke saathi mushrikeen aur Ahl-e-Kitaab ko maaf kiya karte the jaisa Allah ne unhe hukm diya tha, aur unki takleefon par sabr se kaam lete the. Allah ne farmaya: 'Aur tum zaroor sunoge unki taraf se bahut si dukh dene wali baatein, jinhe tumse pehle Kitaab di gayi thi aur mushrikeen ki taraf se bhi...' (3:186) Aur Allah ne ye bhi farmaya: 'Ahl-e-Kitaab mein se bahut log chahte hain ke apni hasad ki wajah se, tumhare Iman laane ke baad, tumhein dobara kaafir bana dein...' (2:109) Isliye Nabi (SAW) unhe maaf karne ke usool par qaayam rahe jab tak Allah ne unhe hukm diya, yahaan tak ke Allah ne unse jang karne ki ijaazat de di. Phir jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne jang-e-Badr ladi aur Allah ne unke zariye Quraish ke kaafir sardaaron ko qatl kiya, to Ibn Ubai bin Salul aur uske saath ke mushrik aur but-parast log bole, 'Ye maamla (Islam) ab ubhar chuka hai (kaamyaab ho gaya hai).' To unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se baiat (wafaadaari ka ahad) ki aur Musalmaan ho gaye.

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:During the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), some men among the hypocrites used to remain behind him (i.e. did not accompany him) when he went out for a Ghazwa and they would be pleased to stay at home behind Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) returned (from the battle) they would put forward (false) excuses and take oaths, wishing to be praised for what they had not done. So there was revealed:-- "Think not that those who rejoice in what they have done, and love to be praised for what they have not done
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zindagi mein, kuch munaafiq jab wo Ghazwe par jaate to peechhe reh jaate aur khush hote ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se peechhe reh gaye. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) (jang se) wapas aate, to wo (jhoothi) mazrat pesh karte aur qasmein khaate, chahte ke jo kaam unhone nahi kiya uski taareef mile. Isper ye Aayat naazil hui: 'Ye mat samjho ke jo log apne kiye par khush hote hain aur jo unhone nahi kiya uski taareef pasand karte hain...'

e: Narrated Alqama bin Waqqas:Marwan said to his gatekeeper, "Go to Ibn `Abbas, O Rafi`, and say, 'If everybody who rejoices in what he has done, and likes to be praised for what he has not done, will be punished, then all of us will be punished." Ibn `Abbas said, "What connection have you with this case? It was only that the Prophet (ﷺ) called the Jews and asked them about something, and they hid the truth and told him something else, and showed him that they deserved praise for the favor of telling him the answer to his question, and they became happy with what they had concealed. Then Ibn `Abbas recited:-- "(And remember) when Allah took a Covenant from those who were given the Scripture..and those who rejoice in what they have done and love to be praised for what they have not done.' " (3.187-188) Humaid bin `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf narrated that Marwan had told him (the above narration)
hi: Alqama bin Waqqas bataate hain: Marwan ne apne darbaan se kaha, 'Ibn Abbas ke paas jao, Aye Rafi, aur kaho, "Agar har wo shaks jo apne kiye par khush ho aur jo usne nahi kiya uski taareef chahta ho, use saza mile, to hum sab ko saza milegi."' Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Tumhara is maamle se kya taalluq? Baat sirf ye hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne Yahudiyon ko bulaaya aur unse kisi baat ke baare mein pucha, unhone haqeeqat chhupaayi aur kuch aur bata diya, aur ye zaahir kiya ke unhone jo jawab bataya uske liye wo taareef ke haqdaar hain, aur wo apni chhupaayi hui baat par khush ho gaye.' Phir Ibn Abbas ne ye Aayat padhi: '(Yaad karo) jab Allah ne un logon se ahad liya jinhe Kitaab di gayi thi... aur jo log apne kiye par khush hote hain aur jo unhone nahi kiya uski taareef pasand karte hain...' (3:187-188) Ravi Humaid bin Abdur Rahman bin Auf (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Marwan ne unhe ye baat sunaayi thi.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I stayed overnight in the house of my aunt Maimuna. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) talked with his wife for a while and then went to bed. When it was the last third of the night, he got up and looked towards the sky and said: "Verily! In the creation of the Heavens and the Earth and in the alteration of night and day, there are indeed signs for men of understanding." (3.190) Then he stood up, performed ablution, brushed his teeth with a Siwak, and then prayed eleven rak`at. Then Bilal pronounced the Adhan (i.e. call for the Fajr prayer). The Prophet (ﷺ) then offered two rak`at (Sunna) prayer and went out (to the Mosque) and offered the (compulsory congregational) Fajr prayer
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main apni khaala Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki zawja) ke ghar raat guzaari. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kuch der apni biwi se baatein kin, phir so gaye. Jab raat ka aakhri tihaai hissa aaya, to wo uthe aur aasman ki taraf dekh kar farmaya: 'Beshak aasmaanon aur zameen ki paidaish mein, aur raat aur din ke aane-jaane mein, aqlmand logon ke liye zaroor nishaaniyaan hain.' (3:190) Phir wo khade hue, wuzu kiya, Siwak se daant saaf kiye, aur giyaarah rakat namaz padhi. Phir Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Fajr ki azaan di. Nabi (SAW) ne do rakat (Sunnat) padhi aur (Masjid) baahar nikal kar farz Fajr ki namaz padhaayi.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:(One night) I stayed overnight in the house of my aunt Maimuna, and said to myself, "I will watch the prayer of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) " My aunt placed a cushion for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he slept on it in its length-wise direction and (woke-up) rubbing the traces of sleep off his face and then he recited the last ten Verses of Surat-al-`Imran till he finished it.
