Then he went to a hanging water skin and took it, performed the ablution and then stood up to offer the prayer. I got up and did the same as he had done, and stood beside him. He put his hand on my head and held me by the ear and twisted it. He offered two rak`at, then two rak`at, then two rak`at, then two rak`at, then two rak`at, then two rak`at, and finally the witr (i.e. one rak`a) prayer
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine ek raat apni khaala Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki zawja) ke ghar guzaari, aur socha, 'Main dekhunga Allah ke Rasool (SAW) kaise namaz padhte hain.' Meri khaala ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke liye ek gaddi bichhai aur wo uspar lambaai ki taraf let gaye. (So kar uthne ke baad) unhone apne chehre se neend ke asaar (nishaan) ragadte hue Surah Aal-e-Imran ki aakhri das Aayaten padhin yahaan tak ke wo poori kar li. Phir wo latki hui mashk ke paas gaye aur usse wuzu kiya, phir khade hokar namaz padhne lage. Main bhi utha aur unhi ki tarah kiya, aur unke paas jaakar khada ho gaya. Unhone apna haath mere sar par rakha aur mera kaan pakad kar mroda (halka sa moda). Phir unhone do-do rakat karke chhe baar namaz padhi, aur aakhir mein Witr (ek rakat) padhi.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abbas:That once he stayed overnight (in the house) of his aunt Maimuna. the wife of the Prophet. He added: I lay on the cushion transversely and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) lay along with his wife in the lengthwise direction of the pillow. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) slept till the middle of the night, either a bit before or a bit after it, and then woke up rubbing the traces of sleep off his face with his hands and then he recited the last ten Verses of Surat-al-`Imran, got up and went to a hanging water skin. He then performed the ablution from it, and it was perfect ablution, and then stood up to offer the prayer. I too did the same as he had done, and then went to stand beside him. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) put his right hand on my head and held and twisted my right ear. He then offered two rak`at, then two rak`at, then two rak`at, then two rak`at, then two rak`at. then two rak`at, and finally one rak`a, the witr. Then he lay down again till the Muadhdhin (i.e. the call-maker) came to him, whereupon he got up and offered a light two-rak`at prayer, and went out (to the Mosque) and offered the (compulsory congregational) Fajr prayer
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar unhone apni khaala Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا), jo Nabi (SAW) ki zawja thin, ke ghar raat guzaari. Unhone bataya: Main gaddi par aade-tirche let gaya, jabke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apni biwi ke saath gaddi ki lambaai ki taraf lete. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aadhi raat tak, ya us se kuch pehle ya baad tak, sote rahe, phir apne haathon se chehre se neend ke asaar ragadte hue uthe aur Surah Aal-e-Imran ki aakhri das Aayaten padhin. Phir wo utthe aur latki hui mashk ke paas gaye, usse wuzu kiya - aur wo mukammal wuzu tha - phir namaz padhne khade ho gaye. Maine bhi wahi kiya jo unhone kiya, phir unke paas jaakar khada ho gaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apna daayaan haath mere sar par rakha aur mera daayaan kaan pakad kar mroda. Phir unhone do-do rakat karke chhe baar namaz padhi, aur aakhir mein ek rakat Witr padhi. Phir wo phir se let gaye yahaan tak ke Muazzin unke paas aaya, isper wo uthe aur halki do rakat namaz padhi, phir Masjid ke liye nikle aur farz Fajr ki namaz padhaayi.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:That once he stayed overnight in the house of his aunt, the wife of the Prophet. He added: I lay on the cushion transversely while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) lay along with his wife in the lengthwise direction of the cushion. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) slept till the middle of the night, either a bit before or a bit after it, and then woke up rubbing the traces of sleep off his face with his hands, and then recited the last ten Verses of Surat ali-`Imran. Then he got up and went to a hanging water skin, performed ablution from it ---- and performed it perfectly. Then he stood up to perform the prayer. I also did the same as he had done and then went to stand beside him. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) put his right hand on my head and held and twisted my right ear. He then offered two rak`at, then two rak`at then two rak`at, then two rak`at, then two rak`at, then two rak`at, and finally, one rak`a witr. Then he lay down again till the Muadhdhin (i.e. the call-maker) came to him, whereupon he got up and offered a light two rak`at prayer and went out (to the Mosque) and offered the (compulsory congregational) Fajr prayer
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar unhone apni khaala, jo Nabi (SAW) ki zawja thin, ke ghar raat guzaari. Unhone bataya: Main gaddi par aade-tirche let gaya, jabke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apni biwi ke saath gaddi ki lambaai ki taraf lete. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aadhi raat tak, ya us se kuch pehle ya baad tak, sote rahe, phir apne haathon se chehre se neend ke asaar ragadte hue uthe, aur phir Surah Aal-e-Imran ki aakhri das Aayaten padhin. Phir wo utthe aur latki hui mashk ke paas gaye, usse wuzu kiya - aur mukammal wuzu kiya - phir namaz padhne khade ho gaye. Maine bhi wahi kiya jo unhone kiya, phir unke paas jaakar khada ho gaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apna daayaan haath mere sar par rakha aur mera daayaan kaan pakad kar mroda. Phir unhone do-do rakat karke chhe baar namaz padhi, aur aakhir mein ek rakat Witr padhi. Phir wo phir se let gaye yahaan tak ke Muazzin unke paas aaya, isper wo uthe aur halki do rakat namaz padhi, phir Masjid ke liye nikle aur farz Fajr ki namaz padhaayi.

e: Narrated Aisha:There was an orphan (girl) under the care of a man. He married her and she owned a date palm (garden). He married her just because of that and not because he loved her. So the Divine Verse came regarding his case: "If you fear that you shall not be able to deal justly with the orphan girls..." (4.3) The sub-narrator added: I think he (i.e. another sub-narrator) said, "That orphan girl was his partner in that datepalm (garden) and in his property
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ek yateem ladki ek shaks ki nigrani mein thi. Usne us ladki se nikaah kar liya, jiske paas khajoor ka ek baagh tha. Usne sirf isi (maal) ki wajah se nikaah kiya, us se mohabbat ki wajah se nahi. Isper Allah ki Aayat naazil hui: 'Agar tumhe dar ho ke tum yateem ladkiyon ke saath insaaf nahi kar sakoge...' (4:3) Ravi kehte hain, 'Mera khayaal hai ke wo yateem ladki us shaks ki us khajoor ke baagh aur uski milkiyat mein saajhedaar thi.'

e: Narrated `Urwa bin Az-Zubair:That he asked `Aisha regarding the Statement of Allah: "If you fear that you shall not be able to deal justly with the orphan girls..." (4.3) She said, "O son of my sister! An Orphan girl used to be under the care of a guardian with whom she shared property. Her guardian, being attracted by her wealth and beauty, would intend to marry her without giving her a just Mahr, i.e. the same Mahr as any other person might give her (in case he married her). So such guardians were forbidden to do that unless they did justice to their female wards and gave them the highest Mahr their peers might get. They were ordered (by Allah, to marry women of their choice other than those orphan girls." `Aisha added," The people asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) his instructions after the revelation of this Divine Verse whereupon Allah revealed: "They ask your instruction regarding women " (4.127) `Aisha further said, "And the Statement of Allah: "And yet whom you desire to marry." (4.127) as anyone of you refrains from marrying an orphan girl (under his guardianship) when she is lacking in property and beauty." `Aisha added, "So they were forbidden to marry those orphan girls for whose wealth and beauty they had a desire unless with justice, and that was because they would refrain from marrying them if they were lacking in property and beauty
hi: Urwa bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke unhone Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se is Aayat ke baare mein pucha: 'Agar tumhe dar ho ke tum yateem ladkiyon ke saath insaaf nahi kar sakoge...' (4:3) Unhone kaha, 'Aye mere bhanje! Ek yateem ladki apne sarparast (guardian) ki nigrani mein hoti thi jiske saath uski maal-milkiyat saajha hoti thi. Uska sarparast, uski daulat aur khoobsurati se mutaassir hokar, use bina uski jaayez Mahr diye - yaani utni Mahr jitni koi aur deta - nikaah karna chahta tha. Isliye aise sarparaston ko iski mumaana't (rok) ki gayi jab tak wo apni zer-e-nigraani ladkiyon ke saath poora insaaf na karein aur unhe wahi behtareen Mahr na dein jo unke jaisi doosri auraton ko milti hai. Unhein hukm diya gaya ke wo in yateem ladkiyon ke ilaava apni pasand ki kisi aur aurat se nikaah karein.' Aisha ne aage kaha, 'Log Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se is Aayat ke naazil hone ke baad hidaayat maangte the, isper Allah ne naazil farmaya: "Wo aapse auraton ke baare mein hukm poochte hain..." (4:127)' Aisha ne ye bhi kaha, 'Aur Allah ka farmaan, "Aur jinse tum nikaah karna chahte ho," (4:127) - iska matlab hai jab tum mein se koi yateem ladki se, jiske paas maal ya khoobsurati kam ho, nikaah karne se bachta hai.' Aisha ne aage kaha, 'To unhein rokaa gaya un yateem ladkiyon se nikaah karne se jinki daulat aur khoobsurati ki wo khwaish rakhte the, jab tak insaaf na karein, kyunke agar unke paas maal ya khoobsurati kam hoti to yahi log unse nikaah karne se bachte.'

e: Narrated Aisha:regarding the Statement of Allah: "And whoever amongst the guardian is rich, he should take no wages, but if he is poor, let him have for himself what is just and reasonable (according to his work). This Verse was revealed regarding the orphan's property. If the guardian is poor, he can take from the property of the orphan, what is just and reasonable according to his work and the time he spends on managing it
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke is farmaan ke baare mein: 'Aur jo sarparast maal-daar ho, wo (yateem ke maal se) koi ujrat na le, magar jo gareeb ho, wo apni mehnat ke mutaabik jaayez tareeke se le sakta hai,' ye Aayat yateem ke maal ke baare mein naazil hui thi. Agar sarparast gareeb ho, to wo yateem ke maal se, uski mehnat aur us mein jo waqt lagaaya uske hisaab se, jaayez aur munaasib hissa le sakta hai.

e: Narrated Ikrima:Ibn `Abbas said ( regarding the verse), "And when the relatives and the orphans and the poor are present at the time of division, "this verse and its order is valid and not abrogated
hi: Ikrima bataate hain: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne is Aayat ke baare mein kaha, 'Aur jab (miraas ki) taqseem ke waqt rishtedaar, yateem aur miskeen maujood hon...' - ye Aayat aur iska hukm abhi bhi jaari hai, ye mansookh nahi hui.

e: Narrated Jabir:The Prophet (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr came on foot to pay me a visit (during my illness) at Banu Salama's (dwellings). The Prophet (ﷺ) found me unconscious, so he asked for water and performed the ablution from it and sprinkled some water over me. I came to my senses and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What do you order me to do as regards my wealth?" So there was revealed:-- "Allah commands you as regards your children's (inheritance):
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur Abu Bakr paidal chal kar Banu Salama ki basti mein mujhe (meri bimari ke dauraan) milne aaye. Nabi (SAW) ne mujhe behosh paaya, to unhone paani mangwaaya, usse wuzu kiya aur mujhpar thoda paani chidka. Main hosh mein aa gaya aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Aap mujhe mere maal ke baare mein kya hukm dete hain?' Isper ye Aayat naazil hui: 'Allah tumhein tumhare bacchon (ki miraas) ke baare mein hukm deta hai...'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:(In the Pre-Islamic Period ) the children used to inherit all the property but the parents used to inherit only through a will. So Allah cancelled that which He liked to cancel and put decreed that the share of a son was to be twice the share of a daughter, and for the parents one-sixth for each one of them, or one third, and for the wife one-eighth or one-fourth, and for the husband one-half, or one-fourth
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jaahiliyat ke daur mein bacche hi poori miraas ke waaris hote the, jabke waalidain sirf wasiyat ke zariye kuch paate the. Allah ne jo cheez chaha mansookh kar di aur ye faisla diya ke bete ka hissa beti ke hisse se dugna ho, waalidain mein se har ek ko chhati (1/6) hissa ya tihaai (1/3), biwi ko aathwaan (1/8) ya chauthaai (1/4), aur shohar ko aadha (1/2) ya chauthaai (1/4) hissa mile.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:regarding the Divine Verse: "O you who believe! You are forbidden to inherit women against their will, and you should not treat them with harshness that you may take back part of the (Mahr) dower you have given them." (4.19) (Before this revelation) if a man died, his relatives used to have the right to inherit his wife, and one of them could marry her if he wished, or they would give her in marriage if they wished, or, if they wished, they would not give her in marriage at all, and they would be more entitled to dispose her, than her own relatives. So the above Verse was revealed in this connection
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Is Aayat ke baare mein: 'Aye Iman waalo! Tumhare liye jaayez nahi ke tum auraton ko unki marzi ke bagair (miraas mein) waaris bano, aur na hi unke saath sakhti se pesh aao taake tum unhe diye hue Mahr ka kuch hissa wapas le sako' (4:19). Is Aayat ke naazil hone se pehle, agar koi shaks mar jaata to uske rishtedaar uski biwi ke waaris hone ka haq rakhte the - unmein se koi chaahe to khud usse nikaah kar leta, ya chaahe to kisi aur se uska nikaah kara deta, ya chaahe to uska nikaah karwaate hi nahi, aur wo uske apne khaandaan waalon se zyaada haqdaar samjhe jaate the ke uske baare mein faisla karein. Isi silsile mein ye Aayat naazil hui.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Regarding the Verse: "To everyone, We have appointed heirs." (4.33) 'Mawali' means heirs. And regarding:-- "And those to whom your right hands have pledged." When the Emigrants came to Medina, an Emigrant used to be the heir of an Ansari with the exclusion of the latter's relatives, and that was because of the bond of brotherhood which the Prophet (ﷺ) had established between them (i.e. the Emigrants and the Ansar). So when the Verses:-- "To everyone We have appointed heirs." was revealed, (the inheritance through bond of brotherhood) was cancelled. Ibn `Abbas then said: "And those to whom your right hands have pledged." is concerned with the covenant of helping and advising each other. So allies are no longer to be the heir of each other, but they can bequeath each other some of their property by means of a will
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Is Aayat ke baare mein, 'Har shaks ke liye Humne waaris muqarrar kiye hain' (4:33), 'Mawali' ka matlab hai waaris. Aur is hisse ke baare mein, 'Aur jinse tumhare haathon ne ahad kiya hai' - jab Muhaajireen Madina aaye, to ek Muhaajir apne Ansaari bhai ka waaris ban jaata tha, uske apne rishtedaaron ko chhod kar, kyunke Nabi (SAW) ne unke darmiyaan bhai-chaare ka rishta qaayam kiya tha. To jab ye Aayat, 'Har shaks ke liye Humne waaris muqarrar kiye hain,' naazil hui, to bhai-chaare ke zariye milne wali miraas mansookh ho gayi. Ibn Abbas ne aage kaha, 'Aur jinse tumhare haathon ne ahad kiya hai' - iska taalluq ek doosre ki madad aur naseehat ke ahad se hai. Isliye ab saathi (halif) ek doosre ke waaris nahi rahenge, magar wo ek doosre ke liye apni kuch milkiyat ki wasiyat kar sakte hain.

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:During the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) some people said, : O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shall we see our Lord on the Day of Resurrection?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Yes; do you have any difficulty in seeing the sun at midday when it is bright and there is no cloud in the sky?" They replied, "No." He said, "Do you have any difficulty in seeing the moon on a full moon night when it is bright and there is no cloud in the sky?" They replied, "No." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "(Similarly) you will have no difficulty in seeing Allah on the Day of Resurrection as you have no difficulty in seeing either of them. On the Day of Resurrection, a call-maker will announce, "Let every nation follow that which they used to worship." Then none of those who used to worship anything other than Allah like idols and other deities but will fall in Hell (Fire), till there will remain none but those who used to worship Allah, both those who were obedient (i.e. good) and those who were disobedient (i.e. bad) and the remaining party of the people of the Scripture. Then the Jews will be called upon and it will be said to them, 'Who did you use to worship?' They will say, 'We used to worship Ezra, the son of Allah.' It will be said to them, 'You are liars, for Allah has never taken anyone as a wife or a son. What do you want now?' They will say, 'O our Lord! We are thirsty, so give us something to drink.' They will be directed and addressed thus, 'Will you drink,' whereupon they will be gathered unto Hell (Fire) which will look like a mirage whose different sides will be destroying each other. Then they will fall into the Fire. Afterwards the Christians will be called upon and it will be said to them, 'Who did you use to worship?' They will say, 'We used to worship Jesus, the son of Allah.' It will be said to them, 'You are liars, for Allah has never taken anyone as a wife or a son,' Then it will be said to them, 'What do you want?' They will say what the former people have said. Then, when there remain (in the gathering) none but those who used to worship Allah (Alone, the real Lord of the Worlds) whether they were obedient or disobedient. Then (Allah) the Lord of the worlds will come to them in a shape nearest to the picture they had in their minds about Him. It will be said, 'What are you waiting for?' Every nation has followed what they used to worship.' They will reply, 'We left the people in the world when we were in great need of them and we did not take them as friends. Now we are waiting for our Lord Whom we used to worship.' Allah will say, 'I am your Lord.' They will say twice or thrice, 'We do not worship any besides Allah
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ki zindagi mein kuch logon ne pucha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya hum Qayamat ke din apne Rab ko dekhenge?' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Haan, kya tumhein dopahar ke waqt, jab aasman saaf ho aur baadal na ho, suraj dekhne mein koi mushkil hoti hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Nahi.' Unhone pucha, 'Kya tumhein poore chaand ki raat, jab aasman saaf ho aur baadal na ho, chaand dekhne mein koi mushkil hoti hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Nahi.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, '(Isi tarah) Qayamat ke din Allah ko dekhne mein tumhein koi mushkil nahi hogi, jaise in dono ko dekhne mein nahi hoti. Us din ek pukaarne wala aawaaz dega, "Har ummat us cheez ki pairvi kare jiski wo ibaadat karti thi." To Allah ke siwa but ya doosre maabudon ki ibaadat karne wala har shaks Jahannam mein gir jaayega, yahaan tak ke sirf wo log bachenge jo sirf Allah ki ibaadat karte the, chaahe wo farmaabardaar the ya na-farmaan, aur Ahl-e-Kitaab ka kuch hissa bhi. Phir Yahudiyon ko bulaaya jaayega aur unse pucha jaayega, "Tum kis ki ibaadat karte the?" Wo kahenge, "Hum Uzair ki, jise hum Allah ka beta maante the, ibaadat karte the." Unse kaha jaayega, "Tum jhoote ho, Allah ne kabhi koi biwi ya beta nahi banaaya. Ab tum kya chahte ho?" Wo kahenge, "Aye hamare Rab! Hum pyaase hain, humein kuch pilaa de." Unhe ishara karke kaha jaayega, "Kya tum piyoge?", aur unhe Jahannam ki taraf le jaaya jaayega jo (door se) sarab (registan ki dhoop mein paani ka bhram) jaisi lagegi, uske alag hisse ek doosre ko khatam karte hue nazar aayenge, aur wo log usi aag mein gir jaayenge. Phir Isaaiyon ko bulaaya jaayega aur pucha jaayega, "Tum kis ki ibaadat karte the?" Wo kahenge, "Hum Isa ki, jise hum Allah ka beta maante the." Unse kaha jaayega, "Tum jhoote ho, Allah ne kabhi koi biwi ya beta nahi banaaya." Phir unse bhi wahi pucha jaayega, aur wo bhi pichli ummat jaisa jawab denge. Aakhir mein sirf wo log bachenge jo sirf Allah ki ibaadat karte the, chaahe farmaabardaar the ya na-farmaan. Phir Allah, saare jahaanon ka Rab, unke saamne us shakl mein aayega jo unke zehen mein sabse zyaada qareeb hogi. Unse kaha jaayega, "Tum kis cheez ka intezaar kar rahe ho? Har ummat to us cheez ki pairvi kar chuki jiski wo ibaadat karti thi." Wo jawab denge, "Hum duniya mein logon se, jab humein unki sabse zyaada zaroorat thi, alag ho gaye the aur unhe apna dost nahi banaaya. Ab hum apne Rab ka intezaar kar rahe hain jiski hum ibaadat karte the." Allah farmaayega, "Main hi tumhara Rab hoon." Wo do ya teen baar kahenge, "Hum Allah ke siwa kisi aur ki ibaadat nahi karte."'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Masud:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me, "Recite (of the Qur'an) for me," I said, "Shall I recite it to you although it had been revealed to you?" He said, "I like to hear (the Qur'an) from others." So I recited Surat-an- Nisa' till I reached: "How (will it be) then when We bring from each nation a witness, and We bring you (O Muhammad) as a witness against these people?" (4.41) Then he said, "Stop!" And behold, his eyes were overflowing with tears
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Masud bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse kaha, 'Mujhe (Quran) suna do.' Maine kaha, 'Kya main aapko sunaaun jabke ye aap hi par naazil hui hai?' Unhone farmaya, 'Mujhe pasand hai ke main Quran doosron se sunun.' To maine Surah An-Nisa padhni shuru ki yahaan tak ke main is Aayat par pahuncha: 'To (us waqt) kya hoga jab Hum har ummat se ek gawaah laayenge, aur (Aye Muhammad) tumhein in sab par gawaah banaakar laayenge?' (4:41) Isper unhone farmaya, 'Bas, ruk jao.' Aur maine dekha ke unki aankhon se aansu beh rahe the.

e: Narrated `Aisha:The necklace of Asma' was lost, so the Prophet (ﷺ) sent some men to look for it. The time for the prayer became due and they had not performed ablution and could not find water, so they offered the prayer without ablution. Then Allah revealed (the Verse of Tayammum)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) ka haar kho gaya, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kuch aadmi use dhoondhne bheje. Namaz ka waqt aa gaya jabke unhone wuzu nahi kiya tha aur unhe paani bhi nahi mila, isliye unhone bagair wuzu ke namaz padh li. Isper Allah ne Tayammum ki Aayat naazil farmayi.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Verse: "Obey Allah and Obey the Apostle and those of you (Muslims) who are in authority." (4.59) was revealed in connection with `Abdullah bin Hudhafa bin Qais bin `Adi' when the Prophet (ﷺ) appointed him as the commander of a Sariyya (army detachment)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ye Aayat, 'Allah ki itaa'at karo aur Rasool ki itaa'at karo, aur apne mein se jo saahib-e-ikhtiyaar (ameer) hon unki bhi' (4:59), Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Hudhafa bin Qais bin Adi ke silsile mein naazil hui thi, jab Nabi (SAW) ne unhe ek fauji dastey (Sariyya) ka sardaar muqarrar kiya tha.

e: Narrated `Urwa:Az-Zubair quarrelled with a man from the Ansar because of a natural mountainous stream at Al-Harra. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Zubair! Irrigate (your lands) and then let the water flow to your neighbor." The Ansar said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (This is because) he (Zubair) is your cousin?" At that, the Prophet's face became red (with anger) and he said "O Zubair! Irrigate (your land) and then withhold the water till it fills the land up to the walls and then let it flow to your neighbor." So the Prophet (ﷺ) enabled Az-Zubair to take his full right after the Ansari provoked his anger. The Prophet (ﷺ) had previously given an order that was in favor of both of them Az-Zubair said, "I don't think but the Verse was revealed in this connection: "But no, by your Lord, they can have no faith, until they make you judge in all disputes between them
hi: Urwa bataate hain: Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ka ek Ansaari shaks se Al-Harra mein ek pahaadi naale (paani ke behne) ke maamle par jhagda ho gaya. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Aye Zubair! Tum (apni zameen ki) sichaai karo, phir paani apne padosi ke liye chhod do.' Ansaari ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! (Ye faisla isliye hai ke) wo aapke chachazaad bhai hain?' Isper Nabi (SAW) ka chehra (naaraazgi se) surkh ho gaya aur unhone farmaya, 'Aye Zubair! Tum sichaai karo, phir paani ko rok kar rakho yahaan tak ke wo tumhari zameen ki deewaron tak bhar jaaye, phir apne padosi ke liye chhod do.' Is tarah Nabi (SAW) ne Zubair ko unka poora haq dilaaya jab Ansaari ne unhe naaraaz kar diya tha, jabke pehle unhone dono ke haq mein faisla diya tha. Az-Zubair ne kaha, 'Mera khayaal hai ke ye Aayat isi silsile mein naazil hui thi: "Nahi, tumhare Rab ki qasam, ye log momin nahi ho sakte jab tak apne aapas ke jhagdon mein tumhein faisla karne wala na maan lein..."'

e: Narrated `Aisha:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "No prophet gets sick but he is given the choice to select either this world or the Hereafter." `Aisha added: During his fatal illness, his voice became very husky and I heard him saying: "In the company of those whom is the Grace of Allah, of the prophets, the Siddiqin (those followers of the prophets who were first and foremost to believe in them), the martyrs and the pious.' (4.69) And from this I came to know that he has been given the option
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Koi Nabi bimar nahi hota jab tak use duniya aur aakhirat mein se kisi ek ko chunne ka ikhtiyar na diya jaaye.' Aisha ne aage kaha: Unki aakhri bimari mein, jab unki awaaz kaafi bhaari ho gayi thi, maine unhe ye kehte suna, 'Un logon ke saath jinpar Allah ka fazl hua hai - Nabiyon, Siddiqeen, shuhada aur nekokaaron ke saath.' (4:69) Isse mujhe pata chal gaya ke unhe ikhtiyar diya gaya tha.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:My mother and I were among the weak and oppressed (Muslims at Mecca)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Meri maa aur main un kamzor aur mazloom (Musalmaanon) mein se the (jo Makkah mein reh gaye the).

e: Narrated Ibn Abi Mulaika:Ibn `Abbas recited:-- "Except the weak ones among men women and children," (4.98) and said, "My mother and I were among those whom Allah had excused
hi: Ibn Abu Mulaika bataate hain: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne ye Aayat padhi, 'Siwaaye un kamzor mardon, auraton aur bachchon ke...' (4:98) aur kaha, 'Meri maa aur main unhi logon mein se the jinhe Allah ne muaaf kar diya tha (yaani hijrat na kar paane ka azr rakh diya tha).'

e: Narrated Zaid bin Thabit:Regarding the Verse:-- "Then what is the matter with you that you are divided into two parties about the hypocrites?" (4.88) Some of the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) returned from the battle of Uhud (i.e. refused to fight) whereupon the Muslims got divided into two parties; one of them was in favor of their execution and the other was not in favour of it. So there was revealed: "Then what is the matter with you that you are divided into two parties about the hypocrites?" (4.88). Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said "It (i.e. Medina) is Taybah (good), it expels impurities as the fire expels the impurities of silver
hi: Zaid bin Thabit (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain, is Aayat ke baare mein: 'To tumhein kya ho gaya hai ke tum munaafiqon ke maamle mein do giroh ban gaye ho?' (4:88) - Nabi (SAW) ke kuch sahaaba jang-e-Uhud se (bagair ladein) wapas laut aaye the, jispar Musalmaan do giroh mein baant gaye - ek giroh unhein saza dene (qatl karne) ke haq mein tha aur doosra iske haq mein nahi tha. Isper ye Aayat naazil hui: 'To tumhein kya ho gaya hai ke tum munaafiqon ke maamle mein do giroh ban gaye ho?' (4:88) Phir Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ye (yaani Madina) Tayyaba hai (yaani paak-saaf shehar), ye buraiyon ko yun nikaal deta hai jaise aag chaandi ki khot nikaal deti hai.'

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:The people of Kufa disagreed (disputed) about the above Verse. So I went to Ibn `Abbas and asked him about it. He said, "This Verse:-- "And whoever kills a believer intentionally, his recompense is Hell." was revealed last of all (concerning premeditated murder) and nothing abrogated it
hi: Saeed bin Jubair bataate hain: Kufa ke logon mein is Aayat ke baare mein ikhtelaf ho gaya. To main Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas gaya aur unse iske baare mein pucha. Unhone kaha, 'Ye Aayat: "Aur jo koi kisi momin ko jaan-boojh kar qatl kare, uski saza Jahannam hai," (jaan-boojh kar qatl ke baare mein) sabse aakhir mein naazil hui thi, aur isse mansookh karne wali koi Aayat naazil nahi hui.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Regarding the Verse: "And say not to anyone who offers you peace (by accepting Islam), You are not a believer." There was a man amidst his sheep. The Muslims pursued him, and he said (to them) "Peace be on you." But they killed him and took over his sheep. Thereupon Allah revealed in that concern, the above Verse up to:-- "...seeking the perishable good of this life." (4.94) i.e. those sheep
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Is Aayat ke baare mein, 'Aur jo tumhein salaam pesh kare (yaani Islam laane ka izhaar kare), usse ye mat kaho ke tum momin nahi ho' - ek shaks apni bakriyon ke saath tha. Musalmaanon ne uska peecha kiya, to usne unse kaha, 'Tum par salaam ho (yaani main Musalmaan hoon).' Magar unhone use qatl kar diya aur uski bakriyaan le lin. Isper Allah ne isi silsile mein ye Aayat naazil ki, '...duniya ki faani cheez (yaani wo bakriyaan) haasil karne ki gharaz se...' (4:94) tak.

e: Narrated Zaid bin Thabit:That the Prophet (ﷺ) dictated to him: "Not equal are those of the believers who sit (at home) and those who strive and fight in the Cause of Allah." Zaid added: Ibn Um Maktum came while the Prophet (ﷺ) was dictating to me and said, "O Allah's Apostle! By Allah, if I had the power to fight (in Allah's Cause), I would," and he was a blind man. So Allah revealed to His Apostle while his thigh was on my thigh, and his thigh became so heavy that I was afraid it might fracture my thigh. Then that state of the Prophet (ﷺ) passed and Allah revealed:-- "Except those who are disabled (by injury or are blind or lame etc)
hi: Zaid bin Thabit (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne mujhse ye likhwaaya: 'Wo Musalmaan jo (ghar mein) baithe rehte hain aur wo jo Allah ki raah mein jihaad karte hain, dono barabar nahi hain.' Zaid ne aage kaha: Jab Nabi (SAW) mujhse ye likhwaa rahe the, Ibn Umm Maktoom aaye aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Allah ki qasam, agar mujhme jihaad karne ki taaqat hoti to main zaroor karta,' aur wo ek nabeena (andhe) shaks the. Isper Allah ne Apne Rasool par wahi naazil ki jabke unki jaanghen meri jaangh par thi, aur unka wazan itna badh gaya ke mujhe dar hua ke kahin meri jaangh na toot jaaye. Phir Nabi (SAW) ki ye kaifiyat guzar gayi aur Allah ne naazil farmaya: '...siwaaye un logon ke jo maazoor hain (chot ki wajah se ya andhepan ya langdepan ki wajah se)...'

e: Narrated Al-Bara:When the Verse:-- "Not equal are those of the believers who sit (at home)" (4.95) was revealed, Allah's Apostle called for Zaid who wrote it. In the meantime Ibn Um Maktum came and complained of his blindness, so Allah revealed: "Except those who are disabled (by injury or are blind or lame..." etc)
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Jab ye Aayat naazil hui, 'Wo Musalmaan jo (ghar mein) baithe rehte hain, dono barabar nahi hain' (4:95), Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Zaid ko bulaaya jinhone use likha. Isi dauraan Ibn Umm Maktoom aaye aur apne andhepan ki shikaayat ki, isper Allah ne naazil farmaya: '...siwaaye un logon ke jo maazoor hain (chot ki wajah se ya andhe ya langde hon)...'

e: Narrated Al-Bara:When the Verse:--"Not equal are those of the believers who sit (at home)," (4.95) was revealed, the Prophet said, "Call so-and-so." That person came to him with an ink-pot and a wooden board or a shoulder scapula bone. The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to him), "Write: 'Not equal are those believers who sit (at home) and those who strive and fight in the Cause of Allah." Ibn Um Maktum who was sitting behind the Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I am a blind man." So there was revealed in the place of that Verse, the Verse:--"Not equal are those of the believers who sit (at home) except those who are disabled (by injury, or are blind or lame etc.) and those who strive and fight in the Cause of Allah
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Jab ye Aayat naazil hui, 'Wo Musalmaan jo (ghar mein) baithe rehte hain, dono barabar nahi hain' (4:95), Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Falaan ko bulaao.' Wo shaks siyaahi ki dawaat aur lakdi ka takhta ya kandhe ki haddi (jispar likha jaata tha) leke aaya. Nabi (SAW) ne (unse) kaha, 'Likho: "Wo Musalmaan jo (ghar mein) baithe rehte hain aur wo jo Allah ki raah mein jihaad karte hain, dono barabar nahi hain."' Ibn Umm Maktoom, jo Nabi (SAW) ke peechhe baithe the, ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Main ek andha aadmi hoon.' Isper us Aayat ki jagah ye Aayat naazil hui: 'Wo Musalmaan jo (ghar mein) baithe rehte hain - siwaaye un logon ke jo maazoor hain (chot ki wajah se ya andhe ya langde hon) - aur wo jo Allah ki raah mein jihaad karte hain, dono barabar nahi hain.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Not equal are those believers who sat (at home) and did not join the Badr battle and those who joined the Badr battle
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: 'Wo Musalmaan jo (ghar mein) baithe rahe aur jang-e-Badr mein shareek nahi hue, aur wo jo jang-e-Badr mein shareek hue, dono barabar nahi hain.'

e: Narrated Muhammad bin `Abdur-Rahman Abu Al-Aswad:The people of Medina were forced to prepare an army (to fight against the people of Sham during the caliphate of `Abdullah bin Az-Zubair at Mecca), and I was enlisted in it; Then I met `Ikrima, the freed slave of Ibn `Abbas, and informed him (about it), and he forbade me strongly to do so (i.e. to enlist in that army), and then said, "Ibn `Abbas informed me that some Muslim people were with the pagans, increasing the number of the pagans against Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). An arrow used to be shot which would hit one of them (the Muslims in the company of the pagans) and kill him, or he would be struck and killed (with a sword)." Then Allah revealed:-- "Verily! as for those whom the angels take (in death) while they are wronging themselves (by staying among the disbelievers)" (4.97) Abu AlAswad also narrated it
hi: Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman Abu Al-Aswad bataate hain: Madina ke logon ko (Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki khilafat ke dauraan, Sham walon se ladne ke liye) ek fauj taiyaar karne par majboor kiya gaya, aur mujhe bhi usmein bharti kar liya gaya. Phir main Ikrima, jo Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke azaad kiye ghulaam the, se mila aur unhe ye baat bataayi. Unhone mujhe isse sakht mana kiya, aur kaha, 'Ibn Abbas ne mujhe bataya tha ke kuch Musalmaan mushrikeen ke saath rehte the, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke khilaaf mushrikeen ki tadaad badha rahe the. (Jang mein) ek teer chalta jo unmein se kisi ko (yaani mushrikeen ke saath rehne wale Musalmaan ko) lag jaata aur use maar deta, ya wo talwaar se maara jaata.' Phir Allah ne naazil farmaya: 'Beshak jinki jaan farishte is haal mein qabz karte hain ke wo apne aap par zulm kar rahe hote hain (yaani kaafiron ke saath rehne ki wajah se)...' (4:97) Abu Al-Aswad ne bhi yahi riwayat ki hai.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:'"Except the weak ones" (4.98) and added: My mother was one of those whom Allah excused
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: 'Siwaaye un kamzor logon ke...' (4:98), aur unhone kaha, 'Meri maa bhi unhi logon mein se thi jinhe Allah ne muaaf kar diya tha.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:While the Prophet (ﷺ) was offering the `Isha' prayer, he said, "Allah hears him who sends his praises to Him," and then said before falling in prostration, "O Allah, save `Aiyash bin Rabi`a. O Allah, save Salama bin Hisham. O Allah, save Al-Walid bin Al-Walid. O Allah, save the weak ones among the believers. O Allah, let Your punishment be severe on the tribe of Mudar. O Allah, inflict upon them years (of famine) like the years of Joseph
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Nabi (SAW) Isha ki namaz padha rahe the, unhone 'Sami Allahu liman hamidah' kaha, aur phir sajde mein jaane se pehle farmaya, 'Aye Allah! Aiyash bin Rabi'a ko bacha le. Aye Allah! Salama bin Hisham ko bacha le. Aye Allah! Al-Walid bin Al-Walid ko bacha le. Aye Allah! Kamzor Musalmaanon ko bacha le. Aye Allah! Qabeela Mudar par apna azaab sakht kar de. Aye Allah! Unhe Yusuf (Alaihissalam) ke zamaane jaise qehat (aakaal) mein daal de.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Regarding the Verse: "Because of the inconvenience of rain or because you are ill." (4.102) (It was revealed in connection with) `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf who was wounded
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ye Aayat, 'Baarish ki takleef ki wajah se ya bimaari ki wajah se...' (4:102), Abdur Rahman bin Auf (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke silsile mein naazil hui thi jo zakhmi ho gaye the.

e: Narrated `Aisha:Regarding the Verse:--"They ask your instruction concerning the women. Say: Allah instructs you about them and yet whom you desire to marry." (4.127) (has been revealed regarding the case of) a man who has an orphan girl, and he is her guardian and her heir. The girl shares with him all his property, even a date-palm (garden), but he dislikes to marry her and dislikes to give her in marriage to somebody else who would share with him the property she is sharing with him, and for this reason that guardian prevents that orphan girl from marrying. So, this Verse was revealed: (And Allah's statement:) "If a woman fears cruelty or desertion on her husband's part
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Is Aayat ke baare mein, 'Log aapse auraton ke baare mein hukm poochte hain. Kaho: Allah tumhein unke baare mein hukm deta hai, aur wo bhi jinse tum nikaah karna chahte ho...' (4:127) - ye us shaks ke maamle mein naazil hui jiske paas ek yateem ladki thi, wo uska sarparast aur waaris tha. Wo ladki uske saath uski poori milkiyat mein saajhedaar thi, khajoor ke baagh tak mein, magar wo na to khud usse nikaah karna chahta tha, na hi kisi aur se uska nikaah karna chahta tha, kyunke tab wo doosra shaks bhi us maal mein saajhedaar ban jaata jo ladki uske saath saanjha kar rahi thi, isi wajah se wo sarparast us yateem ladki ko nikaah se rokta tha. Isi silsile mein ye Aayat naazil hui. (Aur Allah ka farmaan:) 'Agar kisi aurat ko apne shohar ki sakhti ya beruKhi ka dar ho...'

e: Narrated `Aisha:Regarding the Verse:--"If a woman fears cruelty or desertion on her husband's part." (4.128) It is about a man who has a woman (wife) and he does not like her and wants to divorce her but she says to him, "I make you free as regards myself." So this Verse was revealed in this connection
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Is Aayat ke baare mein, 'Agar kisi aurat ko apne shohar ki sakhti ya beruKhi ka dar ho...' (4:128), ye us aadmi ke baare mein hai jiski ek biwi hoti hai jo use pasand nahi hoti aur wo use talaaq dena chahta hai, magar wo aurat usse kehti hai, 'Main apne (haq) ke maamle mein tumhein azaad karti hoon (yaani apna haq maaf karti hoon, bas mujhe talaaq mat do).' Isi silsile mein ye Aayat naazil hui.

e: Narrated Al-Aswad:While we were sitting in a circle in `Abdullah's gathering, Hudhaifa came and stopped before us, and greeted us and then said, "People better than you became hypocrites." Al-Aswad said: I testify the uniqueness of Allah! Allah says: "Verily! The hypocrites will be in the lowest depths of the Fire." (4.145) On that `Abdullah smiled and Hudhaifa sat somewhere in the Mosque. `Abdullah then got up and his companions (sitting around him) dispersed. Hudhaifa then threw a pebble at me (to attract my attention). I went to him and he said, "I was surprised at `Abdullah's smile though he understood what I said. Verily, people better than you became hypocrites and then repented and Allah forgave them
hi: Al-Aswad bataate hain: Jab hum Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) (bin Masud) ki majlis mein ghera banaakar baithe the, Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) aaye aur hamare saamne ruk gaye, salaam kiya, aur kaha, 'Tum se behtar log bhi munaafiq ban gaye the.' Al-Aswad ne kaha, 'Main Allah ki wahdaniyat ki gawaahi deta hoon! Allah farmaata hai: "Beshak munaafiq Jahannam ke sabse neeche gaddhe mein honge." (4:145)' Isper Abdullah muskuraaye aur Hudhaifa Masjid mein kahin baith gaye. Phir Abdullah uthe aur unke saathi bhi (majlis se) alag ho gaye. Hudhaifa ne (mera dhyan kheenchne ke liye) mere paas ek kankar phenka. Main unke paas gaya to unhone kaha, 'Mujhe Abdullah ki muskuraahat par hairaani hui, jabke unhe pata tha maine kya kaha. Beshak tum se behtar log bhi munaafiq ban gaye the, phir unhone tauba ki aur Allah ne unhe maaf kar diya.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "None has the right to say that I am better than Jonah bin Matta
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kisi ko ye kehne ka haq nahi ke main Yunus bin Matta se behtar hoon.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever says that I am better than Jonah bin Matta, is a liar
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi kahe ke main Yunus bin Matta se behtar hoon, wo jhoota hai.'

e: Narrated Al-Bara:The last Sura that was revealed was Bara'a, and the last Verse that was revealed was: "They ask you for a legal verdict, Say: Allah directs (thus) about those who leave no descendants or ascendants as heirs
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Sabse aakhir mein naazil hone wali Surah 'Bara'a' (Surah At-Tauba) thi, aur sabse aakhir mein naazil hone wali Aayat ye thi: 'Wo aapse (miraas ke baare mein) fatwa poochte hain. Kaho: Allah tumhein un logon ke baare mein hukm deta hai jinke koi aulaad ya waalidain waaris na hon...'

e: Narrated Tariq bin Shihab:The Jews said to `Umar, "You (i.e. Muslims) recite a Verse, and had it been revealed to us, we would have taken the day of its revelation as a day of celebration." `Umar said, "I know very well when and where it was revealed, and where Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was when it was revealed. (It was revealed on) the day of `Arafat (Hajj Day), and by Allah, I was at `Arafat" Sufyan, a sub-narrator said: I am in doubt whether the Verse:-- "This day I have perfected your religion for you." was revealed on a Friday or not
hi: Tariq bin Shihab bataate hain: Yahudiyon ne Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kaha, 'Tum log ek Aayat padhte ho, agar wo humpar naazil hui hoti to hum uske naazil hone ke din ko jashn ka din banaate.' Umar ne kaha, 'Mujhe achhi tarah pata hai wo kab aur kahaan naazil hui, aur us waqt Allah ke Rasool (SAW) kahaan the jab wo naazil hui. Wo Arafat ke din (yaani Hajj ke din) naazil hui thi, aur Allah ki qasam, main khud us waqt Arafat mein tha.' Ravi Sufyan kehte hain: Mujhe shak hai ke kya ye Aayat, 'Aaj Maine tumhare liye tumhara deen mukammal kar diya,' Juma ke din naazil hui thi ya nahi.

e: Narrated Aisha:The wife of the Prophet (ﷺ) : We set out with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on one of his journeys, and when we were at Baida' or at Dhat-al-Jaish, a necklace of mine was broken (and lost). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stayed there to look for it, and so did the people along with him. Neither were they at a place of water, nor did they have any water with them. So the people went to Abu Bakr As-Siddiq and said, "Don't you see what `Aisha has done? She has made Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and the people, stay where there is no water and they have no water with them." Abu Bakr came while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was sleeping with his head on my thigh. He said (to me), "You have detained Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and the people where there is no water, and they have no water with them." So he admonished me and said what Allah wished him to say, and he hit me on my flanks with his hand. Nothing prevented me from moving (because of pain) but the position of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on my thigh. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got up when dawn broke and there was no water, so Allah revealed the Verse of Tayammum. Usaid bin Hudair said, "It is not the first blessing of yours, O the family of Abu Bakr." Then we made the camel on which I was riding get up, and found the necklace under it
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki zawja) bataati hain: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath ek safar par nikle, aur jab hum Baida ya Zaat-ul-Jaish pahunche, to mera haar toot kar kho gaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) usse dhoondhne ke liye wahin ruk gaye, aur unke saath log bhi ruk gaye. Na wahan paani ki jagah thi, na unke paas paani tha. To log Abu Bakr As-Siddiq ke paas gaye aur kaha, 'Kya aap dekh nahi rahe Aisha ne kya kiya hai? Unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur logon ko aisi jagah ruka diya jahaan na paani hai na unke paas paani hai.' Abu Bakr aaye jabke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mere ran par sar rakh kar so rahe the. Unhone (mujhse) kaha, 'Tumne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur logon ko bagair paani ki jagah roka hai.' To unhone mujhe daant-daant kar samjhaaya aur jo Allah ne chaaha wo kaha, aur apne haath se mere pehlu par maara. Mujhe hilne se sirf dard ne nahi, balke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke mere ran par sar hone ki wajah se roka. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) subah hone par uthe aur paani nahi tha, isper Allah ne Tayammum ki Aayat naazil farmayi. Usaid bin Hudair ne kaha, 'Ye tumhari pehli barkat nahi hai, aye Abu Bakr ke ghar walo.' Phir humne us oont ko, jispar main sawaar thi, uthaaya, to haar usi ke neeche mila.

e: Narrated Aisha:A necklace of mine was lost at Al-Baida' and we were on our way to Medina. The Prophet (ﷺ) made his camel kneel down and dismounted and laid his head on my lap and slept. Abu Bakr came to me and hit me violently on the chest and said, "You have detained the people because of a necklace." I kept as motionless as a dead person because of the position of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ; (on my lap) although Abu Bakr had hurt me (with the slap). Then the Prophet (ﷺ) woke up and it was the time for the morning (prayer). Water was sought, but in vain; so the following Verse was revealed:-- "O you who believe! When you intend to offer prayer.." (5.6) Usaid bin Hudair said, "Allah has blessed the people for your sake, O the family of Abu Bakr. You are but a blessing for them
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Mera haar Al-Baida mein kho gaya jabke hum Madina ki taraf ja rahe the. Nabi (SAW) ne apna oont bithaaya aur utar kar apna sar mere godi mein rakh kar so gaye. Abu Bakr mere paas aaye aur mere seene par zor se maara aur kaha, 'Tumne ek haar ki wajah se logon ko roka.' Main us waqt murde ki tarah bilkul be-harkat rahi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke (mere godi mein) hone ki wajah se, halaanke Abu Bakr ne mujhe (thappad se) takleef pahunchaayi thi. Phir Nabi (SAW) jaage aur subah ki namaz ka waqt ho gaya tha. Paani dhoonda gaya magar nahi mila, isper ye Aayat naazil hui: 'Aye Iman waalo! Jab tum namaz ke liye khade hone ka iraada karo...' (5:6) Usaid bin Hudair ne kaha, 'Allah ne tumhari wajah se logon ko barkat di hai, aye Abu Bakr ke ghar walo. Tum unke liye sirf barkat hi ho.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah (bin Masud):On the day of Badr, Al-Miqdad said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We do not say to you as the children of Israel said to Moses, 'Go you and your Lord and fight you two; we are sitting here, (5.24) but (we say). "Proceed, and we are with you." That seemed to delight Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) greatly
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Masud bataate hain: Jang-e-Badr ke din Al-Miqdad (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Hum aapse wo baat nahi kahenge jo Bani Israel ne Musa se kahi thi, "Jao tum aur tumhara Rab, tum dono jaakar lado, hum yahin baithe hain," (5:24) balke hum kehte hain, "Aap aage badhein, hum aapke saath hain."' Ye sunkar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) bahut khush hue.

e: Narrated Abu Qilaba:That he was sitting behind `Umar bin `Abdul `Aziz and the people mentioned and mentioned (about al-Qasama) and they said (various things), and said that the Caliphs had permitted it. `Umar bin `Abdul `Aziz turned towards Abu Qilaba who was behind him and said. "What do you say, O `Abdullah bin Zaid?" or said, "What do you say, O Abu Qilaba?" Abu Qilaba said, "I do not know that killing a person is lawful in Islam except in three cases: a married person committing illegal sexual intercourse, one who has murdered somebody unlawfully, or one who wages war against Allah and His Apostle." 'Anbasa said, "Anas narrated to us such-and-such." Abu Qilaba said, "Anas narrated to me in this concern, saying, some people came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and they spoke to him saying, 'The climate of this land does not suit us.' The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'These are camels belonging to us, and they are to be taken out to the pasture. So take them out and drink of their milk and urine.' So they took them and set out and drank of their urine and milk, and having recovered, they attacked the shepherd, killed him and drove away the camels.' Why should there be any delay in punishing them as they murdered (a person) and waged war against Allah and His Apostle and frightened Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ?" Anbasa said, "I testify the uniqueness of Allah!" Abu Qilaba said, "Do you suspect me?" 'Anbasa said, "No, Anas narrated that (Hadith) to us." Then 'Anbasa added, "O the people of such-and-such (country), you will remain in good state as long as Allah keeps this (man) and the like of this (man) amongst you
hi: Abu Qilaba bataate hain: Wo Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdul Aziz ke peechhe baithe the aur logon ne Qasama (qatl ke ilzaam sabit karne ke liye qasmon ka usool) ka zikr kiya aur mukhtalif baatein kahin, aur kaha ke pichhle Khulafa ne isse ijaazat di thi. Umar bin Abdul Aziz apne peechhe baithe Abu Qilaba ki taraf mude aur kaha, 'Tumhara kya khayaal hai, Aye Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ)?' ya kaha, 'Aye Abu Qilaba?' Abu Qilaba ne kaha, 'Mujhe nahi maloom ke Islam mein kisi ki jaan lena jaayez hai siwaaye teen soorat mein: ek shaadi-shuda shaks jo zina kare, doosra jo kisi ko naahaq qatl kare, ya teesra jo Allah aur uske Rasool ke khilaaf jang chhede.' Anbasa ne kaha, 'Anas ne humein falaan-falaan baat sunaayi thi.' Abu Qilaba ne kaha, 'Anas ne mujhe is silsile mein bataaya tha ke kuch log Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha, "Is zameen ki aab-o-hawa hamare liye theek nahi." Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, "Ye hamare oont hain jo charne ke liye bahar bheje jaate hain, tum inhe le jao aur inka doodh aur peshaab piyo." To unhone unhe liya aur nikal gaye aur unka doodh aur peshaab piya, aur jab tandurust ho gaye to chowkidaar par hamla karke use qatl kar diya aur oont hankaa kar le gaye." To fir unhe saza dene mein kya deri honi chaahiye jabke unhone qatl kiya aur Allah aur uske Rasool ke khilaaf jang chhedi aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko dara diya?' Anbasa ne kaha, 'Main Allah ki wahdaniyat ki gawaahi deta hoon!' Abu Qilaba ne kaha, 'Kya tumhein mujhpar shak hai?' Anbasa ne kaha, 'Nahi, Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne humein wahi riwayat sunaayi thi.' Phir Anbasa ne kaha, 'Aye falaan mulk ke logo! Tum tab tak achhi haalat mein rahoge jab tak Allah tum mein aise (imaandaar) log rakhta rahega.'

e: Narrated Anas (bin Malik):Ar-Rubai (the paternal aunt of Anas bin Malik) broke the incisor tooth of a young Ansari girl. Her family demanded the Qisas and they came to the Prophet (ﷺ) who passed the judgment of Qisas. Anas bin An-Nadr (the paternal uncle of Anas bin Malik) said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! By Allah, her tooth will not be broken." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Anas! (The law prescribed in) Allah's Book is Qisas." But the people (i.e. the relatives of the girl) gave up their claim and accepted a compensation. On that Allah's Apostle said, "Some of Allah's worshippers are such that if they take an oath, Allah will fulfill it for them
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ar-Rubai (Anas ki khaala) ne ek jawaan Ansaari ladki ka daant tod diya. Uske gharwaalon ne Qisas ki maang ki aur Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye, jinhone Qisas ka faisla sunaaya. Anas bin An-Nadr (Anas ke chacha) ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Allah ki qasam, unka daant nahi tootega.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Aye Anas! Allah ki Kitaab mein muqarrar kiya hua qanoon Qisas hi hai.' Magar log (yaani ladki ke rishtedaar) apni maang se hat gaye aur muawze par raazi ho gaye. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah ke kuch bande aise hote hain ke agar wo qasam khaa lein, to Allah unki qasam poori kar deta hai.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:Whoever tells that Muhammad concealed part of what was revealed to him, is a liar, for Allah says:-- "O Apostle (Muhammad)! Proclaim (the Message) which has been sent down to you from your Lord
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jo koi ye kahe ke Muhammad (SAW) ne unpar naazil ki gayi wahi ka kuch hissa chhupaaya, wo jhoota hai, kyunke Allah farmaata hai: 'Aye Rasool! Jo aapke Rab ki taraf se aap par naazil kiya gaya hai, use pahuncha dijiye...'

e: Narrated `Aisha:This Verse: "Allah will not punish you for what is unintentional in your oaths." (5.89) was revealed about a man's statement (during his talk), "No, by Allah," and "Yes, by Allah
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ye Aayat, 'Allah tumhein tumhari be-iraada (baghair niyat ke) qasmon par nahi pakdega' (5:89), us waqt naazil hui jab log baaton baaton mein kehte, 'Nahi, Allah ki qasam,' aur 'Haan, Allah ki qasam.'

e: Narrated Aisha:That her father (Abu Bakr) never broke his oath till Allah revealed the order of the legal expiation for oath. Abu Bakr said, "If I ever take an oath (to do something) and later find that to do something else is better, then I accept Allah's permission and do that which is better, (and do the legal expiation for my oath)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Unke waalid (Abu Bakr) kabhi apni qasam nahi todte the, yahaan tak ke Allah ne qasam ke kaffare (expiation) ka hukm naazil kiya. Abu Bakr ne kaha, 'Agar main kabhi kisi baat ki qasam khaa loon aur baad mein mujhe laga ke koi doosri cheez behtar hai, to main Allah ki ijaazat qubool karta hoon aur wahi karta hoon jo behtar ho (aur apni qasam ka kaffara ada karta hoon).'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:We used to participate in the holy wars carried on by the Prophet (ﷺ) and we had no women (wives) with us. So we said (to the Prophet (ﷺ) ). "Shall we castrate ourselves?" But the Prophet (ﷺ) forbade us to do that and thenceforth he allowed us to marry a woman (temporarily) by giving her even a garment, and then he recited: "O you who believe! Do not make unlawful the good things which Allah has made lawful for you
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Nabi (SAW) ke saath jihaad mein shareek hote the aur hamare saath koi biwiyaan nahi hoti thin. To humne (Nabi se) pucha, 'Kya hum khud ko khassi kara lein?' Nabi (SAW) ne humein aisa karne se mana kiya, aur uske baad humein ijaazat di ke hum ek chaadar ke badle mein bhi ek aurat se (waqt ki) shaadi kar lein. Phir unhone ye Aayat padhi: 'Aye Iman waalo! In paak cheezon ko haraam mat karo jo Allah ne tumhare liye halaal ki hain...'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:(The Verse of) prohibiting alcoholic drinks was revealed when there were in Medina five kinds of (alcoholic) drinks none of which was produced from grapes
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Sharaab ko haraam karne wali Aayat us waqt naazil hui jab Madina mein paanch tarah ke (nashe wale) mashroob (peene ki cheezein) maujood the, jinmein se koi bhi angoor se nahi banta tha.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:We had no alcoholic drink except that which was produced from dates and which you call Fadikh. While I was standing offering drinks to Abu Talha and so-and-so and so-and-so, a man came and said, "Has the news reached you? They said, "What is that?" He said, "Alcoholic drinks have been prohibited. They said, "Spill (the contents of these pots, O Anas!" Then they neither asked about it (alcoholic drinks) nor returned to it after the news from that man
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Humare paas khajoor se banaayi gayi sharaab ke siwa koi aur sharaab nahi thi, jise hum 'Fadikh' kehte the. Ek din main Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur falaan falaan logon ko sharaab pila raha tha, ke ek shaks aaya aur kaha, 'Kya tumhein khabar mili?' Unhone pucha, 'Kya baat hai?' Usne kaha, 'Sharaab haraam kar di gayi hai.' Unhone kaha, 'Aye Anas! In bartanon ko ulta do (sharaab bahaa do).' Phir unhone na to iske baare mein kuch poocha aur na hi us khabar ke baad wapas usko haath lagaaya.

e: Narrated Jabir:Some people drank alcoholic beverages in the morning (of the day) of the Uhud battle and on the same day they were killed as martyrs, and that was before wine was prohibited
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Kuch logon ne jang-e-Uhud ke din subah sharaab pi thi, aur usi din wo shaheed ho gaye, aur ye us waqt ki baat hai jab sharaab abhi haraam nahi hui thi.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:I heard `Umar while he was on the pulpit of the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Now then O people! The revelation about the prohibition of alcoholic drinks was revealed; and alcoholic drinks are extracted from five things: Grapes, dates, honey, wheat and barley. And the alcoholic drink is that which confuses and stupefies the mind
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Umar ko Nabi (SAW) ke mimbar par ye kehte suna, 'Ab, aye logo! Sharaab ki haraamiyat ki Aayat naazil ho chuki hai, aur sharaab paanch cheezon se banti hai: angoor, khajoor, shehad, gehun aur jau se. Aur sharaab wo hai jo aqal ko dhaank de aur behosh kar de.'

e: Narrated Anas:The alcoholic drink which was spilled was Al-Fadikh. I used to offer alcoholic drinks to the people at the residence of Abu Talha. Then the order of prohibiting Alcoholic drinks was revealed, and the Prophet ordered somebody to announce that: Abu Talha said to me, "Go out and see what this voice (this announcement ) is." I went out and (on coming back) said, "This is somebody announcing that alcoholic beverages have been prohibited." Abu Talha said to me, "Go and spill it (i.e. the wine)," Then it (alcoholic drinks) was seen flowing through the streets of Medina. At that time the wine was Al-Fadikh. The people said, "Some people (Muslims) were killed (during the battle of Uhud) while wine was in their stomachs." So Allah revealed: "On those who believe and do good deeds there is no blame for what they ate (in the past)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jo sharaab bahaayi gayi wo 'Al-Fadikh' thi. Main Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke ghar logon ko sharaab pilaaya karta tha. Phir jab sharaab ki haraamiyat ka hukm naazil hua, to Nabi (SAW) ne kisi se elaan karwaaya. Abu Talha ne mujhse kaha, 'Baahar jaakar dekho ye kaisi aawaaz (elaan) hai.' Main baahar gaya aur (wapas aakar) kaha, 'Koi elaan kar raha hai ke sharaab haraam kar di gayi hai.' Abu Talha ne mujhse kaha, 'Jaao aur ise (sharaab ko) bahaa do.' Phir wo (sharaab) Madina ki galiyon mein behti dikhaayi di. Us waqt wo sharaab 'Al-Fadikh' thi. Logon ne kaha, 'Kuch log (jang-e-Uhud mein) is haal mein maare gaye the ke sharaab unke pet mein thi.' Isper Allah ne naazil farmaya: 'Jo log Iman laaye aur nek amal kiye, unpar (pehle jo unhone khaaya-piya) uska koi gunaah nahi...'

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) delivered a sermon the like of which I had never heard before. He said, "If you but knew what I know then you would have laughed little and wept much." On hearing that, the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) covered their faces and the sound of their weeping was heard. A man said, "Who is my father?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "So-and-so." So this Verse was revealed: "Ask not about things which, if made plain to you, may cause you trouble
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne ek aisa khutba diya jaisa maine kabhi pehle nahi suna tha. Unhone farmaya, 'Agar tumhein wo pata hota jo mujhe pata hai, to tum kam hansate aur zyaada rote.' Ye sunkar sahaaba ne apne chehre dhaank liye aur unke rone ki aawaaz sunayi di. Ek shaks ne pucha, 'Mera baap kaun hai?' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Falaan.' Isper ye Aayat naazil hui: 'Aisi baaton ke baare mein mat poocho jo agar tumhare saamne zaahir kar di jaayein to tumhein takleef pahunchaayein.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Some people were asking Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) questions mockingly. A man would say, "Who is my father?" Another man whose she-camel had gone astray would say, "Where is my she-camel? "So Allah revealed this Verse in this connection: "O you who believe! Ask not about things which, if made plain to you, may cause you trouble
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Kuch log Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se mazaak mein sawaal poochte the. Koi kehta, 'Mera baap kaun hai?' Kisi ki oontni kho gayi hoti to wo poochta, 'Meri oontni kahaan hai?' To Allah ne isi silsile mein ye Aayat naazil ki: 'Aye Iman waalo! Aisi baaton ke baare mein mat poocho jo agar tumhare saamne zaahir kar di jaayein to tumhein takleef pahunchaayein.'

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Al-Musaiyab:Bahira is a she-camel whose milk is kept for the idols and nobody is allowed to milk it; Sa'iba was the she-camel which they used to set free for their gods and nothing was allowed to be carried on it. Abu Huraira said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I saw `Amr bin 'Amir Al-Khuza`i (in a dream) dragging his intestines in the Fire, and he was the first person to establish the tradition of setting free the animals (for the sake of their deities)," Wasila is the she-camel which gives birth to a she-camel as its first delivery, and then gives birth to another she-camel as its second delivery. People (in the Pre-Islamic periods of ignorance) used to let that she camel loose for their idols if it gave birth to two she-camels successively without giving birth to a male camel in between. 'Ham' was the male camel which was used for copulation. When it had finished the number of copulations assigned for it, they would let it loose for their idols and excuse it from burdens so that nothing would be carried on it, and they called it the 'Hami.' Abu Huraira said, "I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying so
hi: Saeed bin Al-Musaiyab bataate hain: Bahira wo oontni thi jiska doodh buton ke naam mehfooz rakha jaata tha aur koi use doodh nahi nikaal sakta tha. Sa'iba wo oontni thi jise log apne devi-but ke naam azaad chhod dete the aur usper koi bojh nahi laada jaata tha. Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Maine (khwaab mein) Amr bin Aamir Al-Khuzaai ko apni aantein Jahannam mein ghaseette hue dekha, aur wahi pehla shaks tha jisne jaanwaron ko (buton ke naam) azaad chhodne ka rivaaj shuru kiya.' Wasila wo oontni thi jo pehli baar oontni janti aur phir doosri baar bhi oontni janti - agar wo lagaataar do baar oontni janti bagair beech mein nar oont paida ho, to log use buton ke naam azaad chhod dete the. 'Ham' us nar oont ko kehte the jo afzaayish-e-nasl ke liye istemaal hota, jab uski muqarrar tadaad ki afzaayish poori ho jaati to use bhi buton ke naam azaad chhod dete aur uspar koi bojh nahi laadte, aur use 'Haami' kehte the. Abu Huraira ne kaha, 'Maine ye Nabi (SAW) se suna hai.'

e: Narrated Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I saw Hell and its different portions were consuming each other and saw `Amr dragging his intestines (in it), and he was the first person to establish the tradition of letting animals loose (for the idols)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Maine Jahannam dekha, uske alag hisse ek doosre ko khaa rahe the, aur maine Amr ko apni aantein ghaseette hue dekha, aur wahi pehla shaks tha jisne jaanwaron ko (buton ke naam) azaad chhodne ka rivaaj shuru kiya.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) delivered a sermon and said, "O people! You will be gathered before Allah barefooted, naked and not circumcised." Then (quoting Qur'an) he said:-- "As We began the first creation, We shall repeat it. A promise We have undertaken: Truly We shall do it.." (21.104) The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "The first of the human beings to be dressed on the Day of Resurrection, will be Abraham. Lo! Some men from my followers will be brought and then (the angels) will drive them to the left side (Hell-Fire). I will say. 'O my Lord! (They are) my companions!' Then a reply will come (from the Almighty), 'You do not know what they did after you.' I will say as the pious slave (the Prophet Jesus (ﷺ)) said: And I was a witness over them while I dwelt amongst them. When You took me up, You were the Watcher over them and You are a Witness to all things.' (5.117) Then it will be said, "These people have continued to be apostates since you left them
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek khutba diya aur farmaya, 'Aye logo! Tum sab Allah ke saamne nange pair, nange badan aur bagair khatna kiye jama kiye jaaoge.' Phir (Quran ki Aayat padh kar) farmaya: 'Jaise Humne pehli baar paidaish shuru ki, waise hi dobara karenge - ye ek waada hai jo Humne apne zimme liya hai, Hum ise zaroor poora karenge.' (21:104) Phir Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Qayamat ke din sabse pehle jinhe kapde pehnaaye jaayenge wo Ibrahim (Alaihissalam) honge. Sun lo! Meri ummat mein se kuch logon ko laaya jaayega aur unhe baayin taraf (Jahannam ki taraf) le jaaya jaayega. Main kahunga, "Aye mere Rab! Ye to mere saathi hain!" To jawab aayega, "Tumhein nahi pata unhone tumhare baad kya kiya." Main wahi kahunga jo Isa (Alaihissalam), Allah ke nek bande, ne kaha tha: "Aur main unpar gawaah tha jab tak main unke saath tha, phir jab Tu ne mujhe utha liya to Tu hi unpar nigraan tha, aur Tu har cheez par gawaah hai." (5:117) Phir kaha jaayega, "Ye log tere jaane ke baad se hi murtad (deen se phir jaane wale) ho gaye the."'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You will be gathered (on the Day of Resurrection) and some people will be driven (by the angels) to the left side (and taken to Hell) whereupon I will say as the pious slave (Jesus) said:- - "And I was a witness over them while I dwelt amongst them...the ALMIGHTY, the All Wise
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Tum (Qayamat ke din) jama kiye jaaoge, aur kuch logon ko (farishte) baayin taraf (Jahannam ki taraf) hankaayenge, isper main wahi kahunga jo Isa (Alaihissalam), Allah ke nek bande, ne kaha tha: "Aur main unpar gawaah tha jab tak main unke saath tha..." (Aayat ke aakhir tak) "...Beshak Tu hi Zabardast, Hikmat waala hai."'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The keys of the Unseen are five: Verily with Allah (Alone) is the knowledge of the Hour He sends down the rain and knows what is in the wombs. No soul knows what it will earn tomorrow, and no soul knows in what land it will die. Verily, Allah is All-Knower, All-Aware
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ghaib ki chaabiyaan paanch hain: Beshak sirf Allah ko hi Qayamat (ke waqt) ka ilm hai, wahi baarish barsaata hai, aur wo jaanta hai jo (maaon ke) rehm mein hai. Koi bhi shaks nahi jaanta ke wo kal kya kamaayega, aur koi bhi shaks nahi jaanta ke wo kis zameen mein marega. Beshak Allah khoob jaanne wala, khoob khabar rakhne wala hai.'

e: Narrated Jabir:When this Verse was revealed: "Say: He has power to send torment on you from above." (6.65) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! I seek refuge with Your Face (from this punishment)." And when the verse: "or send torment from below your feet," (was revealed), Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "(O Allah!) I seek refuge with Your Face (from this punishment)." (But when there was revealed): "Or confuse you in party strife and make you to taste the violence of one another." (6.65) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "This is lighter (or, this is easier)
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab ye Aayat naazil hui, 'Kaho: Wahi is baat par qaadir hai ke tumpar upar se azaab bheje' (6:65), Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Aye Allah! Main Teri zaat ki panaah maangta hoon (is azaab se).' Aur jab ye naazil hui, 'Ya tumhare pairon ke neeche se (azaab bheje),' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (phir) farmaya, 'Aye Allah! Main Teri zaat ki panaah maangta hoon.' (Magar) jab ye naazil hui, 'Ya tumhein guton mein baant kar ek doosre ki takleef chakhaa de' (6:65), Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ye (pehle do azaabon se) halka (ya asaan) hai.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:When:"...and confuse not their belief with wrong." (6.82) was revealed, the Prophet's companions said, "Which of us has not done wrong?" Then there was revealed:-- "Verily joining others in worship with Allah is a tremendous wrong indeed
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab ye Aayat naazil hui, '...aur apne Iman ko zulm ke saath na mila lein...' (6:82), to Nabi (SAW) ke sahaaba ne kaha, 'Hum mein se kisne zulm nahi kiya?' Isper ye Aayat naazil hui: 'Beshak Allah ke saath shirk karna bahut bada zulm hai.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Nobody has the rights to say that I am better than Jonah bin Matta
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kisi ko ye kehne ka haq nahi ke main Yunus bin Matta se behtar hoon.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Nobody has the right to say that I am better than Jonah bin Matta
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kisi ko ye kehne ka haq nahi ke main Yunus bin Matta se behtar hoon.'

e: Narrated Mujahid:That he asked Ibn `Abbas, "Is there a prostration in Surat-al-Sa`d?" (38.24) Ibn `Abbas said, "Yes," and then recited: "We gave...So follow their guidance." (6.85,90) Then he said, "He (David ) is one of them (i.e. those prophets)." Mujahid narrated: I asked Ibn `Abbas (regarding the above Verse). He said, "Your Prophet (Muhammad) was one of those who were ordered to follow them
hi: Mujahid bataate hain ke unhone Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha, 'Kya Surah Sa'd (38:24) mein sajda hai?' Ibn Abbas ne kaha, 'Haan,' aur ye Aayat padhi: '...Humne unhein (hidaayat) di... to unki hidaayat ki pairvi karo.' (6:85,90) Phir unhone kaha, 'Dawood (Alaihissalam) bhi unhi Nabiyon mein se ek hain.' Mujahid kehte hain: Maine Ibn Abbas se is Aayat ke baare mein pucha, unhone kaha, 'Tumhaare Nabi Muhammad (SAW) bhi un logon mein se the jinhe (in Nabiyon ki) pairvi karne ka hukm diya gaya tha.'

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "May Allah curse the Jews! When Allah forbade them to eat the fat of animals, they melted it and sold it, and utilized its price
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah Yahudiyon par laanat kare! Jab Allah ne unhe jaanwaron ki charbi khaane se mana kiya, to unhone use pighla kar bech diya aur uski qeemat istemaal ki.'

e: Narrated Abu Wail:`Abdullah (bin Mas`ud) said, "None has more sense of ghaira than Allah therefore - He prohibits shameful sins (illegal sexual intercourse, etc.) whether committed openly or secretly. And none loves to be praised more than Allah does, and for this reason He praises Himself." I asked Abu Wail, "Did you hear it from `Abdullah?" He said, "Yes," I said, "Did `Abdullah ascribe it to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" He said, "Yes
hi: Abu Wail bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Masud ne kaha, 'Allah se zyaada ghairat (namoos) ki hifaazat karne wala koi nahi, isi wajah se wo besharmi ke gunaahon ko, chaahe khule mein hon ya chhupe mein, haraam qaraar deta hai. Aur Allah se zyaada koi apni taareef pasand karne wala nahi, isi wajah se wo khud apni taareef karta hai.' (Ravi kehte hain:) Maine Abu Wail se pucha, 'Kya aapne ye khud Abdullah se suna?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan.' Maine pucha, 'Kya Abdullah ne ise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki taraf mansoob kiya?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The Hour will not be established until the sun rises from the West: and when the people see it, then whoever will be living on the surface of the earth will have faith, and that is (the time) when no good will it do to a soul to believe then, if it believed not before
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Qayamat us waqt tak nahi aayegi jab tak suraj magrib (pashchim) se na nikle. Aur jab log use dekhenge, to zameen par jitne log zinda honge sab Iman le aayenge, magar us waqt kisi shaks ko uska Iman kaam nahi aayega agar wo pehle se Iman na laaya ho.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The hour will not be established till the sun rises from the West; and when it rises (from the West) and the people see it, they all will believe. And that is (the time) when no good will it do to a soul to believe then." Then he recited the whole Verse
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Qayamat us waqt tak nahi aayegi jab tak suraj magrib se na nikle. Aur jab wo (magrib se) niklega aur log use dekhenge, to sab Iman le aayenge. Magar us waqt kisi shaks ko uska Iman kaam nahi aayega.' Phir unhone poori Aayat padhi.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Mas`ud:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "None has more sense of ghaira than Allah, and for this He has forbidden shameful sins whether committed openly or secretly, and none loves to be praised more than Allah does, and this is why He Praises Himself
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Masud bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah se zyaada ghairat rakhne wala koi nahi, isi wajah se usne besharmi ke gunaahon ko, chaahe khule mein hon ya chhupe mein, haraam qaraar diya hai. Aur Allah se zyaada apni taareef pasand karne wala koi nahi, isi wajah se wo khud apni taareef karta hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:A man from the Jews, having been slapped on his face, came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Muhammad! A man from your companions from the Ansar has slapped me on my face!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Call him." When they called him, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Why did you slap him?" He said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! While I was passing by the Jews, I heard him saying, 'By Him Who selected Moses above the human beings,' I said, 'Even above Muhammad?' I became furious and slapped him on the face." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not give me superiority over the other prophets, for on the Day of Resurrection the people will become unconscious and I will be the first to regain consciousness. Then I will see Moses holding one of the legs of the Throne. I will not know whether he has come to his senses before me or that the shock he had received at the Mountain, (during his worldly life) was sufficient for him
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek Yahudi shaks, jise thappad maara gaya tha, Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Aye Muhammad! Aapke Ansaari sahaabiyon mein se ek ne mujhe thappad maara hai!' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Use bulaao.' Jab use bulaaya gaya, Nabi (SAW) ne pucha, 'Tumne isse thappad kyun maara?' Usne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Main Yahudiyon ke paas se guzar raha tha, maine isse kehte suna, "Us Zaat ki qasam jisne Musa ko sab insaanon se afzal chuna," maine kaha, "Kya Muhammad se bhi zyaada?" Mujhe gussa aaya aur maine isse thappad maara.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Mujhe doosre Nabiyon par fazilat mat do, kyunke Qayamat ke din log behosh ho jaayenge aur sabse pehle hosh mein aane wala main hounga. Phir main Musa ko Arsh ka ek paaya thaame hue paaunga. Mujhe nahi maloom ke wo mujhse pehle hosh mein aa chuke honge, ya (Toor pahaad par) jo sadma unhe (duniya mein) laga tha wahi unke liye kaafi tha (isliye is baar unhein behosh hone se chhoot mil gayi).'

e: Narrated Sa`id Ibn Zaid:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Al-Kam'a is like the Manna (sweet resin or gum) (in that it grows naturally without human care) and its water is a cure for the eye diseases
hi: Saeed bin Zaid bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kam'a Mann ki tarah hai (yaani bagair mehnat ke, khud-ba-khud ugta hai), aur uska paani aankhon ki bimariyon ka ilaaj hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Ad-Darda:There was a dispute between Abu Bakr and `Umar, and Abu Bakr made `Umar angry. So `Umar left angrily. Abu Bakr followed him, requesting him to ask forgiveness (of Allah) for him, but `Umar refused to do so and closed his door in Abu Bakr's face. So Abu Bakr went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while we were with him. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "This friend of yours must have quarrelled (with somebody)." In the meantime `Umar repented and felt sorry for what he had done, so he came, greeted (those who were present) and sat with the Prophet (ﷺ) and related the story to him. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) became angry and Abu Bakr started saying, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! By Allah, I was more at fault (than `Umar)." Allah's Apostle said, "Are you (people) leaving for me my companion? (Abu Bakr), Are you (people) leaving for me my companion? When I said, 'O people I am sent to you all as the Messenger of Allah,' you said, 'You tell a lie.' while Abu Bakr said, 'You have spoken the truth
hi: Abu Ad-Darda bataate hain: Abu Bakr aur Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke darmiyaan ikhtelaf hua aur Abu Bakr ne Umar ko naaraaz kar diya. Umar naaraaz hokar chale gaye. Abu Bakr unke peechhe gaye (Allah se) unke liye maafi maangne ki darkhwaast lekar, magar Umar ne maafi maangne se inkaar kar diya aur apna darwaaza Abu Bakr ke muh par band kar diya. To Abu Bakr Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaye, aur hum bhi wahaan unke saath maujood the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Lagta hai tumhare is dost ka (kisi se) jhagda ho gaya hai.' Isi dauraan Umar ko apni ghalti ka ehsaas hua aur wo pachhtaaye, to wo (majlis mein) aaye, salaam kiya, aur Nabi (SAW) ke saath baith gaye aur unhe poora waqiya sunaaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) (Abu Bakr ki taraf) naaraaz ho gaye, isper Abu Bakr kehne lage, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Allah ki qasam, main hi zyaada qusoorwaar tha.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kya tum log mere is saathi ko mere haal par nahi chhodoge? Kya tum mere is saathi ko mere haal par nahi chhodoge? Jab maine (logon ko) kaha tha, "Aye logo! Main Allah ka Rasool banaakar tum sab ki taraf bheja gaya hoon," to tumne kaha tha, "Tum jhoot bolte ho," jabke Abu Bakr ne kaha tha, "Aapne sach kaha."'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "It was said to the children of Israel, 'Enter the gate in prostration and say Hittatun. We shall forgive you your faults.' (7.161) But they changed (Allah's Order) and entered, dragging themselves on their buttocks and said, 'Habbatun (a grain) in a Sha'ratin (hair)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Bani Israel se kaha gaya tha, "Darwaaze mein jhukte hue daakhil ho aur kaho: Hittatun (yaani Aye Allah! Hamare gunaah maaf kar de), Hum tumhari khataayen maaf kar denge."' (7:161) Magar unhone (Allah ke hukm ko) badal diya aur apne chootadon ke bal ghisadte hue daakhil hue aur kaha, 'Habbatun (yaani ek daana) Sha'ratin (baal) mein' (yaani tazheek ke taur par ek bemaani baat kah di).

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:'Uyaina bin Hisn bin Hudhaifa came and stayed with his nephew Al-Hurr bin Qais who was one of those whom `Umar used to keep near him, as the Qurra' (learned men knowing Qur'an by heart) were the people of `Umar's meetings and his advisors whether they were old or young. 'Uyaina said to his nephew, "O son of my brother! You have an approach to this chief, so get for me the permission to see him." Al-Hurr said, "I will get the permission for you to see him." So Al-Hurr asked the permission for 'Uyaina and `Umar admitted him. When 'Uyaina entered upon him, he said, "Beware! O the son of Al-Khattab! By Allah, you neither give us sufficient provision nor judge among us with justice." Thereupon `Umar became so furious that he intended to harm him, but Al-Hurr said, "O chief of the Believers! Allah said to His Prophet: "Hold to forgiveness; command what is right; and leave (don't punish) the foolish." (7.199) and this (i.e. 'Uyaina) is one of the foolish." By Allah, `Umar did not overlook that Verse when Al-Hurr recited it before him; he observed (the orders of) Allah's Book strictly
