hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Uyaina bin Hisn bin Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) aaye aur apne bhatije Al-Hurr bin Qais ke paas thehre, jo un logon mein se the jinhe Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) apne qareeb rakhte the, kyunke Qurra (Quran ke haafiz aur ilm rakhne wale log) Umar ki majlison mein shaamil hote the aur unke mashwiraati (salaahkaar) hote the, chaahe wo bade hon ya jawaan. Uyaina ne apne bhatije se kaha, 'Aye mere bhatije! Tumhaari is Ameer tak rasaai hai, mujhe unse milne ki ijaazat dilwaao.' Al-Hurr ne kaha, 'Main tumhare liye ijaazat le lunga.' To Al-Hurr ne Uyaina ke liye ijaazat maangi aur Umar ne unhe andar bulaaya. Jab Uyaina andar gaye, to unhone kaha, 'Khabardaar, aye Ibn Al-Khattab! Allah ki qasam, na to aap humein poora hissa dete hain aur na hi insaaf se hamare beech faisla karte hain.' Isper Umar itne naaraaz ho gaye ke unhe nuqsaan pahunchaane ka iraada kar liya, magar Al-Hurr ne kaha, 'Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen! Allah ne apne Nabi se farmaya hai: "Maafi ka rasta ikhtiyaar karo, achhi baat ka hukm do, aur jaahilon se (unhe saza dene se) door raho" (7:199), aur ye (Uyaina) bhi unhi jaahilon mein se hain.' Allah ki qasam, jab Al-Hurr ne ye Aayat padhi, to Umar ne isse nazar-andaaz nahi kiya, wo Allah ki Kitaab ke hukm par sakhti se amal karte the.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Az-Zubair:(The Verse) "Hold to forgiveness; command what is right..." was not revealed by Allah except in connection with the character of the people
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ye Aayat, 'Maafi ka rasta ikhtiyaar karo, achhi baat ka hukm do...' Allah ne sirf logon ke akhlaaq (chaal-chalan) ke silsile mein hi naazil ki thi.

e: Abdullah bin Az-Zubair said:Allah ordered His Prophet to forgive the people their misbehavior (towards him)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) kehte hain: Allah ne apne Nabi (SAW) ko hukm diya ke wo logon ki (unke saath) badtameezi ko maaf kar dein.

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:I asked Ibn `Abbas regarding Surat-al-Anfal. He said, "It was revealed in connection with the Battle of Badr
hi: Saeed bin Jubair bataate hain: Maine Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se Surah Al-Anfal ke baare mein pucha. Unhone kaha, 'Ye jang-e-Badr ke silsile mein naazil hui thi.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Regarding the Verse: "Verily! The worst of beasts in the Sight of Allah are the deaf and the dumb---- those who understand not." (8.22) (The people referred to here) were some persons from the tribe of Bani `Abd-Ad-Dar
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Is Aayat ke baare mein, 'Beshak Allah ke nazdeek sabse buri makhlooq wo behre-goonge log hain jo aqal se kaam nahi lete' (8:22) - jinki taraf ishara hai wo Banu Abd-Ad-Dar qabeele ke kuch log the.

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id bin Al-Mu'alla:While I was praying, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) passed me and called me, but I did not go to him until I had finished the prayer. Then I went to him, and he said, "What prevented you from coming to me? Didn't Allah say:-- "O you who believe! Answer the call of Allah (by obeying Him) and His Apostle when He calls you?" He then said, "I will inform you of the greatest Sura in the Qur'an before I leave (the mosque)." When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got ready to leave (the mosque), I reminded him. He said, "It is: 'Praise be to Allah, the Lord of the worlds.' (i.e. Surat-al-Fatiha) As-sab'a Al-Mathani (the seven repeatedly recited Verses)
hi: Abu Saeed bin Al-Mu'alla bataate hain: Jab main namaz padh raha tha, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mere paas se guzre aur mujhe bulaaya, magar main namaz khatam kiye bagair unke paas nahi gaya. Phir jab main unke paas gaya, to unhone farmaya, 'Tumhein mere paas aane se kya cheez roka? Kya Allah ne nahi farmaya, "Aye Iman waalo! Jab Allah aur uske Rasool tumhein bulaayein to unki pukaar ka jawab do"?' Phir unhone farmaya, 'Masjid se nikalne se pehle main tumhein Quran ki sabse azeem Surah bataunga.' Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) (Masjid se) nikalne ki taiyaari karne lage, to maine unhe yaad dilaaya. Unhone farmaya, 'Ye hai: "Alhamdulillahi Rabbil Aalameen" (yaani Surah Al-Fatiha), jo As-Sab'a Al-Mathani (baar baar padhi jaane wali saat Aayaten) hai.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Abu Jahl said, "O Allah! If this (Qur'an) is indeed the Truth from You, then rain down on us a shower of stones from the sky or bring on us a painful torment." So Allah revealed:-- "But Allah would not punish them while you were amongst them, nor He will punish them while they seek (Allah's) forgiveness..." (8.33) And why Allah should not punish them while they turn away (men) from Al- Masjid-al-Haram (the Sacred Mosque of Mecca)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Jahl ne kaha, 'Aye Allah! Agar ye (Quran) waaqai Teri taraf se haq hai, to hampar aasman se pattharon ki baarish barsa de ya humpar koi dardnaak azaab bhej de.' Isper Allah ne naazil farmaya: 'Aur Allah unhe azaab nahi dega jab tak tum (Aye Muhammad) unke darmiyaan maujood ho, aur na hi wo unhe azaab dega jab tak wo maafi maangte rahenge... Aur Allah kyun na unhe azaab de jabke wo logon ko Masjid-e-Haraam se rokte hain...' (8:33)

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Abu Jahl said, "O Allah! If this (Qur'an) is indeed the Truth from You), then rain down on us a shower of stones from the sky or bring on us a painful punishment." So there was revealed:-- 'But Allah would not punish them while you (Muhammad) were amongst them, nor will He punish them while they seek (Allah's) Forgiveness. And why Allah should not punish them while they stop (men) from Al-Masjid-al-Haram
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Jahl ne kaha, 'Aye Allah! Agar ye (Quran) waaqai Teri taraf se haq hai, to hampar aasman se pattharon ki baarish barsa de ya humein koi dardnaak saza de.' Isper ye Aayat naazil hui: 'Aur Allah unhe (yaani Makkah waalon ko) azaab nahi dega jab tak tum (Muhammad) unke darmiyaan ho, aur na hi wo unhe azaab dega jab tak wo Allah se maafi maangte rahenge. Aur Allah kyun na unhe azaab de jabke wo (logon ko) Masjid-e-Haraam se rokte hain...'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:That a man came to him (while two groups of Muslims were fighting) and said, "O Abu `Abdur Rahman! Don't you hear what Allah has mentioned in His Book: 'And if two groups of believers fight against each other...' (49.9) So what prevents you from fighting as Allah has mentioned in His Book?"' Ibn `Umar said, "O son of my brother! I would rather be blamed for not fighting because of this Verse than to be blamed because of another Verse where Allah says: 'And whoever kills a believer intentionally..." (4.93) Then that man said, "Allah says:-- 'And fight them until there is no more afflictions (worshipping other besides Allah) and the religion (i.e. worship) will be all for Allah (Alone)" (8.39) Ibn `Umar said, "We did this during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) when the number of Muslims was small, and a man was put to trial because of his religion, the pagans would either kill or chain him; but when the Muslims increased (and Islam spread), there was no persecution." When that man saw that Ibn `Umar did not agree to his proposal, he said, "What is your opinion regarding `Ali and `Uthman?" Ibn `Umar said, "What is my opinion regarding `Ali and `Uthman? As for `Uthman, Allah forgave him and you disliked to forgive him, and `Ali is the cousin and son-in-law of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ." Then he pointed out with his hand and said, "And that is his daughter's (house) which you can see
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks unke paas aaya (jabke Musalmaanon ke do giroh aapas mein lad rahe the) aur kaha, 'Aye Abu Abdur Rahman! Kya aap nahi sunte jo Allah ne apni Kitaab mein farmaya hai: "Agar momineen ke do giroh aapas mein lad jaayein..." (49:9) To phir aapko Allah ke farmaan ke mutaabik jang karne se kya rok raha hai?' Ibn Umar ne kaha, 'Aye mere bhatije! Main ye pasand karunga ke mujhe is Aayat ki wajah se jang na karne par malaamat ki jaaye, is se behtar hai ke mujhe us doosri Aayat ki wajah se malaamat ki jaaye jismein Allah farmaata hai, "Aur jo koi kisi momin ko jaan-boojh kar qatl kare..." (4:93)' Phir us shaks ne kaha, 'Allah farmaata hai: "Unse jang karo jab tak fitna khatam na ho jaaye aur deen (ibaadat) sirf Allah ke liye reh jaaye." (8:39)' Ibn Umar ne kaha, 'Humne ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zindagi mein kiya jab Musalmaanon ki tadaad kam thi, aur kisi shaks ko uske deen ki wajah se aazmaaya jaata, mushrik use ya to qatl kar dete ya zanjeeron mein jakad dete; magar jab Musalmaan badh gaye (aur Islam faila) to koi zulm-o-sitam baaki nahi raha.' Jab us shaks ne dekha ke Ibn Umar unke prastaav se muttafiq nahi ho rahe, to usne pucha, 'Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke baare mein aapki kya raay hai?' Ibn Umar ne kaha, 'Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Uthman ke baare mein meri raay? Jahaan tak Uthman ki baat hai, Allah ne unhe maaf kar diya, magar tumhein ye pasand nahi ke unhe maaf kiya jaaye, aur Ali (Alayhis Salam) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke chachazaad bhai aur damaad hain.' Phir unhone haath se ishara karke kaha, 'Wo raha unki beti ka ghar jo tum dekh sakte ho.'

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:Ibn `Umar came to us and a man said (to him), "What do you think about 'Qit-alal-Fitnah' (fighting caused by afflictions)." Ibn `Umar said (to him), "And do you understand what an affliction is? Muhammad used to fight against the pagans, and his fighting with them was an affliction, (and his fighting was) not like your fighting which is carried on for the sake of ruling
hi: Saeed bin Jubair bataate hain: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) hamare paas aaye aur ek shaks ne (unse) pucha, 'Fitne ki wajah se hone wali jang ke baare mein aapki kya raay hai?' Ibn Umar ne (usse) pucha, 'Aur kya tumhein pata hai fitna kya hota hai? Muhammad (SAW) mushrikeen ke khilaaf jang karte the, aur unki wo jang fitna (yaani kufr) ke khilaaf thi, tumhari is jang ki tarah nahi jo hukoomat haasil karne ke liye hoti hai.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When the Verse:-- "If there are twenty steadfast amongst you, they will overcome two hundred." (8.65) was revealed, then it became obligatory for the Muslims that one (Muslim) should not flee from ten (non-Muslims). Sufyan (the sub-narrator) once said, "Twenty (Muslims) should not flee before two hundred (non Muslims)." Then there was revealed: 'But now Allah has lightened your (task)..' (8.66) So it became obligatory that one-hundred (Muslims) should not flee before two hundred (nonmuslims). (Once Sufyan said extra, "The Verse: 'Urge the believers to the fight. If there are twenty steadfast amongst you (Muslims) ..' was revealed.) Sufyan said, "Ibn Shubruma said, "I see that this order is applicable to the obligation of enjoining good and forbidding evil
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab ye Aayat naazil hui, 'Agar tum mein se bees (log) sabar karne wale hon to wo do sau par ghaalib aa jaayenge' (8:65), to Musalmaanon par farz ho gaya ke ek Musalmaan das (ghair-Musalmaanon) ke saamne se na bhaage. (Ravi Sufyan ne ek baar kaha, 'Bees Musalmaan do sau ke saamne se na bhaagein.') Phir ye naazil hui: 'Ab Allah ne tumhara bojh halka kar diya...' (8:66) To ab farz ho gaya ke sau (Musalmaan) do sau ke saamne se na bhaagein. (Sufyan ne ek baar ye bhi kaha, 'Aayat, "Momineen ko jang par ubhaaro, agar tum mein se bees sabar karne waale hon..." naazil hui thi.') Sufyan kehte hain: Ibn Shubruma ne kaha, 'Mera khayaal hai ye hukm neki ka hukm dene aur burayi se rokne ki zimmedaari par bhi laagu hota hai.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When the Verse:--'If there are twenty steadfast amongst you (Muslims), they will overcome two-hundred (non-Muslims).' was revealed, it became hard on the Muslims when it became compulsory that one Muslim ought not to flee (in war) before ten (non-Muslims). So (Allah) lightened the order by revealing: '(But) now Allah has lightened your (task) for He knows that there is weakness in you. So if there are of you one-hundred steadfast, they will overcome (two-hundred (non-Muslims).' (8.66) So when Allah reduced the number of enemies which Muslims should withstand, their patience and perseverance against the enemy decreased as much as their task was lightened for them
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab ye Aayat naazil hui, 'Agar tum mein se bees (log) sabar karne wale hon to wo do sau par ghaalib aa jaayenge,' to Musalmaanon ke liye ye mushkil ho gaya jab ye farz ho gaya ke ek Musalmaan das (ghair-Musalmaanon) ke saamne se na bhaage. To Allah ne is hukm ko halka karte hue naazil farmaya: 'Ab Allah ne tumhara bojh halka kar diya, kyunke usne jaan liya ke tum mein kamzori hai. To agar tum mein se sau (log) sabar karne waale hon, to wo do sau par ghaalib aayenge.' (8:66) To jab Allah ne dushmanon ki wo tadaad kam kar di jiske muqaable mein Musalmaanon ko dat kar khada rehna tha, to unki sabar aur mustaqil mizaji bhi utni hi kam ho gayi jitna unka bojh halka kiya gaya.

e: Narrated Al-Bara:The last Verse that was revealed was: 'They ask you for a legal verdict: Say: Allah directs (thus) about Al-Kalalah (those who leave no descendants or ascendants as heirs).' And the last Sura which was revealed was Baraatun
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Sabse aakhir mein naazil hone wali Aayat ye thi, 'Wo aapse (miraas ke baare mein) fatwa poochte hain, kaho: Allah tumhein Kalaalah (yaani jinke koi aulaad ya waalidain waaris na hon) ke baare mein hukm deta hai...' aur sabse aakhir mein naazil hone wali Surah 'Bara'atun' thi.

e: Narrated Humaid bin `Abdur-Rahman:Abu Huraira said, "During that Hajj (in which Abu Bakr was the chief of the pilgrims) Abu Bakr sent me along with announcers on the Day of Nahr ( 10th of Dhul-Hijja) in Mina to announce: "No pagans shall perform, Hajj after this year, and none shall perform the Tawaf around the Ka`ba in a naked state." Humaid bin `Abdur Rahman added: Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent `Ali bin Abi Talib (after Abu Bakr) and ordered him to recite aloud in public Surat Bara'a. Abu Huraira added, "So `Ali, along with us, recited Bara'a (loudly) before the people at Mina on the Day of Nahr and announced; "No pagan shall perform Hajj after this year and none shall perform the Tawaf around the Ka`ba in a naked state
hi: Humaid bin Abdur Rahman bataate hain: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Us Hajj mein (jismein Abu Bakr Hajjiyon ke ameer the), Abu Bakr ne mujhe Nahr ke din (Zul-Hijja ki dus tareekh) Mina mein elaan karne walon ke saath bheja taake elaan karein: "Is saal ke baad koi mushrik Hajj nahi kar sakta, aur na hi koi Kaaba ka Tawaf nange badan karke kar sakta hai."' Humaid ne aage kaha: Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (Abu Bakr ke baad) Ali (Alayhis Salam) bin Abu Talib ko bheja aur unhe hukm diya ke wo aam logon ke saamne buland aawaaz mein Surah Bara'a padhein. Abu Huraira ne aage kaha, 'To Ali (Alayhis Salam), hamare saath, Mina mein Nahr ke din logon ke saamne buland aawaaz mein Bara'a padhi aur elaan kiya: "Is saal ke baad koi mushrik Hajj nahi kar sakta, aur na hi koi Kaaba ka Tawaf nange badan karke kar sakta hai."'

e: Narrated Humaid bin `Abdur Rahman:Abu Huraira said, "Abu Bakr sent me in that Hajj in which he was the chief of the pilgrims along with the announcers whom he sent on the Day of Nahr to announce at Mina: "No pagan shall perform Hajj after this year, and none shall perform the Tawaf around the Ka`ba in a naked state." Humaid added: That the Prophet (ﷺ) sent `Ali bin Abi Talib (after Abu Bakr) and ordered him to recite aloud in public Surat-Baraa. Abu Huraira added, "So `Ali, along with us, recited Bara'a (loudly) before the people at Mina on the Day of Nahr and announced "No pagan shall perform Hajj after this year and none shall perform the Tawaf around the Ka`ba in a naked state
hi: Humaid bin Abdur Rahman bataate hain: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Abu Bakr ne mujhe us Hajj mein bheja jismein wo Hajjiyon ke ameer the, elaan karne walon ke saath jinhe unhone Nahr ke din Mina mein elaan karne bheja: "Is saal ke baad koi mushrik Hajj nahi kar sakta, aur na hi koi Kaaba ka Tawaf nange badan karke kar sakta hai."' Humaid ne aage kaha ke Nabi (SAW) ne (Abu Bakr ke baad) Ali (Alayhis Salam) bin Abu Talib ko bheja aur unhe hukm diya ke wo aam logon ke saamne buland aawaaz mein Surah Bara'a padhein. Abu Huraira ne aage kaha, 'To Ali (Alayhis Salam), hamare saath, Mina mein Nahr ke din logon ke saamne buland aawaaz mein Bara'a padhi aur elaan kiya: "Is saal ke baad koi mushrik Hajj nahi kar sakta, aur na hi koi Kaaba ka Tawaf nange badan karke kar sakta hai."'

e: Narrated Humaid bin `Abdur-Rahman:Abu Huraira said that Abu Bakr sent him during the Hajj in which Abu Bakr was made the chief of the pilgrims by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) before (the year of) Hajjat al-Wada` in a group (of announcers) to announce before the people; 'No pagan shall perform the Hajj after this year, and none shall perform the Tawaf around the Ka`ba in a naked state. Humaid used to say The Day of Nahr is the day of Al- Hajj Al-Akbar (the Greatest Day) because of the narration of Abu Huraira
hi: Humaid bin Abdur Rahman bataate hain: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne bataya ke Abu Bakr ne unhe us Hajj mein bheja jismein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Abu Bakr ko Hajjat-ul-Wida se pehle Hajjiyon ka ameer banaaya tha, ek jamaat (elaan karne walon) ke saath, taake wo logon ke saamne elaan karein: 'Is saal ke baad koi mushrik Hajj nahi kar sakta, aur na hi koi Kaaba ka Tawaf nange badan karke kar sakta hai.' Humaid kaha karte the ke Nahr ka din 'Hajj-e-Akbar' (sabse bada din) hai, aur ye baat Abu Huraira ki riwayat ki wajah se maani jaati hai.

e: Narrated Zaid bin Wahb:We were with Hudhaifa and he said, "None remains of the people described by this Verse (9.12), except three, and of the hypocrites except four." A bedouin said, "You the companions of Muhammad! Tell us (things) and we do not know that about those who break open our houses and steal our precious things? ' He (Hudhaifa) replied, "Those are Al Fussaq (rebellious wrongdoers) (not disbelievers or hypocrites). Really, none remains of them (hypocrite) but four, one of whom is a very old man who, if he drinks water, does not feel its coldness
hi: Zaid bin Wahb bataate hain: Hum Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath the, unhone kaha, 'Is Aayat (9:12) mein jin logon ka zikr hai, unme se ab sirf teen baaki hain, aur munaafiqon mein se sirf chaar.' Ek badawi ne kaha, 'Tum Muhammad (SAW) ke sahaaba ho! Humein bataao, humein to un logon ke baare mein bhi kuch nahi pata jo hamare ghar tod kar hamari qeemti cheezein churaate hain?' Hudhaifa ne jawab diya, 'Wo log Fussaq (sarkash gunaahgaar) hain, na ke kaafir ya munaafiq. Haqeeqat mein munaafiqon mein se ab sirf chaar hi baaki hain, unmein se ek itna budha ho chuka hai ke agar wo paani piye to use uski thandak mehsoos nahi hoti.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The Kanz (money, the Zakat of which is not paid) of anyone of you will appear in the form of bald-headed poisonous male snake on the Day of Resurrection
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Tum mein se jiska bhi Kanz (jama-shuda maal jiski Zakat ada nahi ki gayi) hoga, Qayamat ke din wo ek gunje sar wale zehreele nar saanp ki shakl mein zaahir hoga.'

e: Narrated Zaid bin Wahb:I passed by (visited ) Abu Dhar at Ar-Rabadha and said to him, "What has brought you to this land?" He said, "We were at Sham and I recited the Verse: "They who hoard up gold and silver and spend them not in the way of Allah; announce to them a painful torment, " (9.34) where upon Muawiya said, 'This Verse is not for us, but for the people of the Scripture.' Then I said, 'But it is both for us (Muslims) and for them
hi: Zaid bin Wahb bataate hain: Main Ar-Rabadha mein Abu Dhar se milne gaya aur unse pucha, 'Aapko is jagah kya le aaya?' Unhone kaha, 'Hum Sham mein the aur maine ye Aayat padhi thi: "Jo log sona-chaandi jama karte hain aur usse Allah ki raah mein kharch nahi karte, unhe dardnaak azaab ki khushkhabri de do." (9:34) Isper Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Ye Aayat hamare liye nahi, balke Ahl-e-Kitaab ke liye hai." Isper maine kaha, "Nahi, ye hum Musalmaanon aur unke, dono ke liye hai."'

e: Narrated Khãlid bin Aslam:We went out with 'Abdullãh bin 'Umar and he said, "This (Verse) was revealed before the prescription of Zakat, and when Zakãt was prescribed, Allah made it a means of purifying one's wealth
hi: Khalid bin Aslam bataate hain: Hum Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath nikle aur unhone kaha, 'Ye Aayat Zakat farz hone se pehle naazil hui thi, aur jab Zakat farz ki gayi, to Allah ne use maal ko paak karne ka zariya bana diya.'

e: Narrated Abu Bakr:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Time has come back to its original state which it had when Allah created the Heavens and the Earth; the year is twelve months, four of which are sacred. Three of them are in succession; Dhul-Qa'da, Dhul-Hijja and Al-Muharram, and (the fourth being) Rajab Mudar (named after the tribe of Mudar as they used to respect this month) which stands between Jumad (ath-thani) and Sha'ban
hi: Abu Bakr bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Waqt apni asal soorat par wapas aa gaya hai, jaisa Allah ne aasmaanon aur zameen ko banaate waqt banaaya tha - saal barah mahine ka hota hai, jinmein se chaar mahine izzat waale hain. Teen musalsal hain: Zul-Qa'da, Zul-Hijja aur Al-Muharram, aur (chautha) Rajab Mudar (Qabeela Mudar ke naam par, kyunke wo is mahine ki bahut izzat karte the), jo Jumaad-us-Saani aur Shabaan ke beech aata hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Bakr:I was in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) in the cave, and on seeing the traces of the pagans, I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) If one of them (pagans) should lift up his foot, he will see us." He said, "What do you think of two, the third of whom is Allah?
hi: Abu Bakr bataate hain: Main Nabi (SAW) ke saath ghaar mein tha, aur mushrikeen ke nishaan (paun ke nishaan) dekh kar maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Agar unmein se koi apna paanv thoda upar uthaaye, to wo humein dekh lega.' Unhone farmaya, 'Un do (logon) ke baare mein kya khayaal hai jinka teesra khud Allah ho?'

e: Narrated Ibn Abi Mulaika:When there happened the disagreement between Ibn Az-Zubair and Ibn `Abbas, I said (to the latter), "(Why don't you take the oath of allegiance to him as) his father is Az-Zubair, and his mother is Asma,' and his aunt is `Aisha, and his maternal grandfather is Abu Bakr, and his grandmother is Safiya?
hi: Ibn Abu Mulaika bataate hain: Jab Ibn Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke darmiyaan ikhtelaf hua, to maine (Ibn Abbas se) kaha, '(Aap unki baiat kyun nahi le lete jabke) unke waalid Az-Zubair hain, unki maa Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) hain, unki khaala Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) hain, unke naanaa Abu Bakr hain, aur unki naani Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) hain?'

e: Narrated Ibn Abi Mulaika:There was a disagreement between them (i.e. Ibn `Abbas and Ibn Az-Zubair) so I went to Ibn `Abbas in the morning and said (to him), "Do you want to fight against Ibn Az-Zubair and thus make lawful what Allah has made unlawful (i.e. fighting in Mecca)?" Ibn `Abbas said, "Allah forbid! Allah ordained that Ibn Az-Zubair and Bani Umaiya would permit (fighting in Mecca), but by Allah, I will never regard it as permissible." Ibn `Abbas added. "The people asked me to take the oath of allegiance to Ibn Az-Zubair. I said, 'He is really entitled to assume authority for his father, Az-Zubair was the helper of the Prophet, his (maternal) grandfather, Abu Bakr was (the Prophet's) companion in the cave, his mother, Asma' was 'Dhatun-Nitaq', his aunt, `Aisha was the mother of the Believers, his paternal aunt, Khadija was the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ) , and the paternal aunt of the Prophet (ﷺ) was his grandmother. He himself is pious and chaste in Islam, well versed in the Knowledge of the Qur'an. By Allah! (Really, I left my relatives, Bani Umaiya for his sake though) they are my close relatives, and if they should be my rulers, they are equally apt to be so and are descended from a noble family
hi: Ibn Abu Mulaika bataate hain: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Ibn Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke darmiyaan ikhtelaf tha, to main subah Ibn Abbas ke paas gaya aur kaha, 'Kya aap Ibn Az-Zubair ke khilaaf jang karna chahte hain aur is tarah wo cheez halaal karna chahte hain jise Allah ne haraam kiya hai (yaani Makkah mein jang)?' Ibn Abbas ne kaha, 'Allah maaf kare! Allah ne muqarrar kiya hai ke Ibn Az-Zubair aur Bani Umaiya (Makkah mein jang) jaayez qaraar denge, magar Allah ki qasam, main ise kabhi jaayez nahi maanunga.' Ibn Abbas ne aage kaha, 'Logon ne mujhse Ibn Az-Zubair ki baiat karne ko kaha. Maine kaha, "Wo waaqai hukoomat sambhaalne ke haqdaar hain, kyunke unke waalid Az-Zubair Nabi (SAW) ke madadgaar the, unke naanaa Abu Bakr Nabi (SAW) ke ghaar ke saathi the, unki maa Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) 'Zaatun-Nitaaq' thi, unki khaala Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) Ummul-Momineen thin, unki phuppi Khadija (رضی اللہ عنہا) Nabi (SAW) ki biwi thin, aur Nabi (SAW) ki phuppi unki naani thin. Wo khud Islam mein nek aur paak-daaman hain, Quran ke ilm mein maahir hain. Allah ki qasam! (Maine apne rishtedaar) Bani Umaiya ko unki khaatir chhod diya (halaanke) wo mere qareebi rishtedaar hain, aur agar wo mere hukmaraan bhi hote, to wo bhi isi tarah izzatdaar khaandaan se hote."'

e: Narrated Ibn Abi Mulaika:We entered upon Ibn `Abbas and he said "Are you not astonished at Ibn Az-Zubair's assuming the caliphate?" I said (to myself), "I will support him and speak of his good traits as I did not do even for Abu Bakr and `Umar though they were more entitled to receive all good than he was." I said "He (i.e Ibn Az-Zubair) is the son of the aunt of the Prophet (ﷺ) and the son of Az-Zubair, and the grandson of Abu Bakr and the son of Khadija's brother, and the son of `Aisha's sister." Nevertheless, he considers himself to be superior to me and does not want me to be one of his friends. So I said, "I never expected that he would refuse my offer to support him, and I don't think he intends to do me any good, therefore, if my cousins should inevitably be my rulers, it will be better for me to be ruled by them than by some others
hi: Ibn Abu Mulaika bataate hain: Hum Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas gaye, unhone kaha, 'Kya tumhein Ibn Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke khilaafat sambhaalne par hairaani nahi hui?' Maine (dil mein) socha, 'Main unki taraf-daari karunga aur unki achhaaiyaan bayaan karunga, jo maine Abu Bakr aur Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke liye bhi nahi kiya tha, halaanke wo dono is se zyaada har achhaai ke haqdaar the.' Maine kaha, 'Wo (yaani Ibn Az-Zubair) Nabi (SAW) ki phuppi ke bete hain, Az-Zubair ke bete hain, Abu Bakr ke naati hain, Khadija (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke bhai ke bete hain, aur Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ki behen ke bete hain.' Iske bawajood, unhone khud ko mujhse afzal samjha aur nahi chaahte the ke main unka dost banoon. To maine (dil mein) kaha, 'Mujhe kabhi ye ummeed nahi thi ke wo mera saath dene ka mera prastaav thukra denge, aur mujhe nahi lagta ke wo mera bhala chaahte hain, isliye agar mere chachazaad bhai hi mere hukmaraan bane, to unke haath mein rehna kisi aur ke haath mein rehne se behtar hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id:Something was sent to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he distributed it amongst four (men) and said, "I want to attract their hearts,(to Islam thereby)," A man said (to the Prophet (ﷺ) ), "You have not done justice." Thereupon the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There will emerge from the offspring of this (man) some people who will renounce the religion
hi: Abu Saeed bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ke paas kuch (maal) aaya jise unhone chaar aadmiyon mein baant diya aur farmaya, 'Main chahta hoon ke isse unke dil (Islam ki taraf) maael ho jaayein.' Ek shaks ne (Nabi se) kaha, 'Aapne insaaf nahi kiya.' Isper Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Is (shaks) ki aulaad mein se kuch aise log paida honge jo deen se phir jaayenge.'

e: Narrated Abu Mas`ud:When we were ordered to give alms, we began to work as porters (to earn something we could give in charity). Abu `Aqil came with one half of a Sa` (special measure for food grains) and another person brought more than he did. So the hypocrites said, "Allah is not in need of the alms of this (i.e. Abu `Aqil); and this other person did not give alms but for showing off." Then Allah revealed:-- 'Those who criticize such of the Believers who give charity voluntarily and those who could not find to give in charity except what is available to them
hi: Abu Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab hamein sadqa dene ka hukm diya gaya, to hum log mazdoori karne lage (taake kuch kama kar sadqa de sakein). Abu Aqil aadhe Saa (anaaj naapne ki ek ikaai) ke saath aaye, aur ek doosre shaks ne unse zyaada laaya. Isper munaafiqon ne kaha, 'Allah ko is (yaani Abu Aqil) ke sadqe ki koi zaroorat nahi hai, aur ye doosra shaks bhi sirf dikhawe ke liye laaya hai.' Phir Allah ne naazil farmaya: 'Jo log un momineen par tanaz karte hain jo apni khushi se khairaat dete hain, aur un logon par bhi jinke paas apni mehnat ke siwa (khairaat dene ko) kuch nahi milta...'

e: Narrated Shaqiq:Abu Mas`ud Al-Ansari said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), used to order us to give alms. So one of us would exert himself to earn one Mud (special measure of wheat or dates, etc.,) to give in charity; while today one of us may have one hundred thousand." Shaqiq said: As if Abu Masud referred to himself
hi: Shaqiq bataate hain: Abu Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ansari (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) humein sadqa dene ka hukm diya karte the, to hum mein se koi mehnat karke ek Mudd (anaaj naapne ki ikaai, gehun ya khajoor waghera) kama kar sadqa deta, jabke aaj hum mein se kisi ke paas ek lakh (dirham) tak hote hain.' Shaqiq kehte hain, 'Aisa lagta tha ke Abu Mas'ud apne baare mein hi ishara kar rahe the.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When `Abdullah bin 'Ubai died, his son `Abdullah bin `Abdullah came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and asked him to give him his shirt in order to shroud his father in it. He gave it to him and then `Abdullah asked the Prophet (ﷺ) to offer the funeral prayer for him (his father). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got up to offer the funeral prayer for him, but `Umar got up too and got hold of the garment of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) Will you offer the funeral prayer for him though your Lord has forbidden you to offer the prayer for him" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "But Allah has given me the choice by saying: '(Whether you) ask forgiveness for them, or do not ask forgiveness for them; even if you ask forgiveness for them seventy times..' (9.80) so I will ask more than seventy times." `Umar said, "But he (`Abdullah bin 'Ubai) is a hypocrite!" However, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did offer the funeral prayer for him whereupon Allah revealed: 'And never (O Muhammad) pray for anyone of them that dies, nor stand at his grave
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ubai marr gaya, to uska beta Abdullah bin Abdullah Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unse apni kameez maangi taake wo apne waalid ko usme kafan de sakein. Nabi (SAW) ne wo de di, phir Abdullah ne Nabi (SAW) se unke waalid ke liye janaaza ki namaz padhne ki darkhwaast ki. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) janaaza ki namaz padhaane khade hue, magar Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bhi khade ho gaye aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka kapda pakad liya aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya aap uski janaaza ki namaz padhaayenge jabke aapke Rab ne aapko uski namaz padhaane se mana kiya hai?' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Magar Allah ne mujhe ikhtiyaar diya hai, farmaaya: "Chaahe tum unke liye maafi maango, ya na maango; agar tum unke liye sattar (70) baar bhi maafi maango..." (9:80) isliye main sattar se bhi zyaada baar maafi maangunga.' Umar ne kaha, 'Magar wo (Abdullah bin Ubai) to munaafiq hai!' Phir bhi, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne uski janaaza ki namaz padhaayi, isper Allah ne naazil farmaya: 'Aur (Aye Muhammad) unmein se kisi ke marne par kabhi namaz mat padho, na uski qabr par khade ho...'

e: Narrated `Umar bin Al-Khattab:When `Abdullah bin Ubai bin Salul died, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was called in order to offer the funeral prayer for him. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got up (to offer the prayer) I jumped towards him and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Do you offer the prayer for Ibn Ubai although he said so-and-so on such-and-such-a day?" I went on mentioning his sayings. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) smiled and said, "Keep away from me, O `Umar!" But when I spoke too much to him, he said, "I have been given the choice, and I have chosen (this) ; and if I knew that if I asked forgiveness for him more than seventy times, he would be forgiven, I would ask it for more times than that." So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) offered the funeral prayer for him and then left, but he did not stay long before the two Verses of Surat-Bara'a were revealed, i.e.:-- 'And never (O Muhammad) pray for anyone of them that dies.... and died in a state of rebellion.' (9.84) Later I was astonished at my daring to speak like that to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Allah and His Apostle know best
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab bataate hain: Jab Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ubai bin Salul mar gaya, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko uski janaaza ki namaz padhaane ke liye bulaaya gaya. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) (namaz padhaane) khade hue, to main unki taraf lapka aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya aap Ibn Ubai ki namaz padhaayenge, jabke usne falaan din aisi aisi baat kahi thi?' Aur main uski baaton ka zikr karta gaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) muskuraaye aur kaha, 'Aye Umar! Mujhse door raho.' Magar jab maine bahut zyaada bolna jaari rakha, to unhone farmaya, 'Mujhe ikhtiyaar diya gaya hai, aur maine (ye) chun liya hai; agar mujhe pata hota ke agar main sattar se zyaada baar uske liye maafi maangoon to use maaf kar diya jaayega, to main usse bhi zyaada baar maangta.' To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne uski janaaza ki namaz padhaayi aur phir wahaan se chale gaye, magar zyaada der nahi guzri thi ke Surah Bara'a ki do Aayaten naazil hui, yaani: 'Aur (Aye Muhammad) unmein se kisi ke marne par kabhi namaz mat padho... jinhone sarkashi ki haalat mein wafat paayi.' (9:84) Baad mein mujhe khud hairaani hoti thi ke maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se is tarah kaise bol diya tha, aur Allah aur uske Rasool hi behtar jaante hain.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:When `Abdullah bin Ubai died, his son `Abdullah bin `Abdullah came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who gave his shirt to him and ordered him to shroud his father in it. Then he stood up to offer the funeral prayer for the deceased, but `Umar bin Al-Khattab took hold of his garment and said, "Do you offer the funeral prayer for him though he was a hypocrite and Allah has forbidden you to ask forgiveness for hypocrites?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah has given me the choice (or Allah has informed me) saying: "Whether you, O Muhammad, ask forgiveness for them, or do not ask forgiveness for them, even if you ask forgiveness for them seventy times, Allah will not forgive them," (9.80) Then he added, "I will (appeal to Allah for his sake) more than seventy times." So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) offered the funeral prayer for him and we too, offered the prayer along with him. Then Allah revealed: "And never, O Muhammad, pray (funeral prayer) for anyone of them that dies, nor stand at his grave. Certainly they disbelieved in Allah and His Apostle and died in a state of rebellion
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ubai mar gaya, to uska beta Abdullah bin Abdullah Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya, jinhone unhein apni kameez di aur hukm diya ke wo apne waalid ko usme kafan dein. Phir Nabi (SAW) uski janaaza ki namaz padhaane khade hue, magar Umar bin Al-Khattab ne unka kapda pakad liya aur kaha, 'Kya aap uski namaz padhaayenge jabke wo munaafiq tha aur Allah ne aapko munaafiqon ke liye maafi maangne se mana kiya hai?' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah ne mujhe ikhtiyaar diya hai (ya: Allah ne mujhe bataaya hai), farmaaya: "Chaahe tum, Aye Muhammad, unke liye maafi maango ya na maango, chaahe tum sattar baar bhi maafi maango, Allah unhe kabhi maaf nahi karega." (9:80)' Phir unhone farmaya, 'Main sattar se bhi zyaada baar (Allah se unke liye guzaarish) karunga.' To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne uski janaaza ki namaz padhaayi aur hum sab ne bhi unke saath namaz padhi. Phir Allah ne naazil farmaya: 'Aur unmein se kisi ke marne par kabhi bhi namaz mat padho, Aye Muhammad, aur na hi uski qabr par khade ho. Beshak unhone Allah aur uske Rasool ka inkaar kiya aur sarkashi ki haalat mein wafat paayi.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Ka`b:I heard Ka`b bin Malik at the time he remained behind and did not join (the battle of) Tabuk, saying, "By Allah, no blessing has Allah bestowed upon me, besides my guidance to Islam, better than that of helping me speak the truth to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) otherwise I would have told the Prophet (ﷺ) a lie and would have been ruined like those who had told a lie when the Divine Inspiration was revealed:-- "They will swear by Allah to you (Muslims) when you return to them.. the rebellious people
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ka'b bataate hain: Maine Ka'b bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko, us waqt ke baare mein jab wo jang-e-Tabuk mein shareek nahi ho paaye the, ye kehte suna: 'Allah ki qasam, Islam ki hidaayat ke ilaawa Allah ne mujhpar jo sabse badi meharbaani ki wo ye thi ke maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se sach bola, warna main Nabi (SAW) se jhoot bol deta aur main un logon ki tarah tabaah ho jaata jinhone (Nabi se) jhoot bola tha, jab Allah ne ye wahi naazil ki: "Ye log tumhare (Musalmaanon ke) paas wapas aane par Allah ki qasam khaayenge..." (yaani un) sarkash logon ke baare mein.'

e: Narrated Samura bin Jundab:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Tonight two (visitors) came to me (in my dream) and took me to a town built with gold bricks and silver bricks. There we met men who, half of their bodies, look like the most handsome human beings you have ever seen, and the other half, the ugliest human beings you have ever seen. Those two visitors said to those men, 'Go and dip yourselves in that river. So they dipped themselves therein and then came to us, their ugliness having disappeared and they were in the most handsome shape. The visitors said, 'The first is the Garden of Eden and that is your dwelling place.' Then they added, 'As for those people who were half ugly and half handsome, they were those who mixed good deeds and bad deeds, but Allah forgave them
hi: Samura bin Jundab bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Aaj raat mere paas do (mehmaan) aaye (khwaab mein) aur mujhe ek aise shehar le gaye jo sone aur chaandi ki eenton se bana tha. Wahaan humein kuch log mile jinke jism ka aadha hissa sabse khoobsurat insaan jaisa tha jo tumne kabhi dekha ho, aur baaki aadha hissa sabse buda-soorat jaisa. Un do mehmaanon ne un logon se kaha, "Jao aur us nadi mein dubki lagaao." To wo usme dube aur hamare paas wapas aaye, unki buri soorat ghaayab ho chuki thi aur wo sabse khoobsurat shakl mein the. Un mehmaanon ne kaha, "Ye Jannat-ul-Firdaus hai, aur wahi tumhaari rehne ki jagah hai." Phir unhone kaha, "Aur jo log aadhe bade aur aadhe khoobsurat the, wo wo log the jinhone nek aur bure kaam dono mile-jule tarike se kiye the, magar Allah ne unhe maaf kar diya."'

e: Narrated Al-Musaiyab:When Abu Talib's death approached, the Prophet (ﷺ) went to him while Abu Jahl and `Abdullah bin Abi Umaiya were present with him. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O uncle, say: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, so that I may argue for your case with it before Allah." On that, Abu Jahl and `Abdullah bin Abu Umaiya said, "O Abu Talib! Do you want to renounce `Abdul Muttalib's religion?" Then the Prophet said, "I will keep on asking (Allah for) forgiveness for you unless I am forbidden to do so." Then there was revealed:-- 'It is not fitting for the Prophet (ﷺ) and those who believe that they should invoke (Allah) for forgiveness for pagans even though they be of kin, after it has become clear to them that they are companions of the Fire
hi: Al-Musaiyab bataate hain: Jab Abu Talib ki maut nazdeek aayi, Nabi (SAW) unke paas gaye jabke Abu Jahl aur Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Umaiya bhi wahaan maujood the. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Aye chacha! Kaho: Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi, taake main iske zariye Allah ke saamne aapki taraf se hujjat pesh kar sakoon.' Isper Abu Jahl aur Abdullah bin Abi Umaiya ne kaha, 'Aye Abu Talib! Kya tum Abdul Muttalib ke deen ko chhodna chahte ho?' Phir Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Main aapke liye maafi maangta rahunga jab tak mujhe (aisa karne se) mana nahi kiya jaata.' Phir ye naazil hui: 'Nabi aur Iman waalon ke liye ye jaayez nahi ke wo mushrikeen ke liye maafi maangein, chaahe wo unke rishtedaar hi kyun na hon, jabke unpar zaahir ho chuka ho ke wo Jahannami hain.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Ka`b:I heard Ka`b bin Malik talking about the Verse:-- 'And to the three (He also forgave) who remained behind.' (9.118) saying in the last portion of his talk, "(I said), 'As a part (sign) of my repentance, I would like to give up all my property in the cause of Allah and His Apostle,' The Prophet (ﷺ) said to me, 'Keep some of your wealth as it is good for you." (To the three (He also forgave) who remained behind till for them the earth, vast as it is, was straitened
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ka'b bataate hain: Maine Ka'b bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko is Aayat ke baare mein baat karte suna, 'Aur un teen logon ko bhi (Allah ne maaf kiya) jo peechhe reh gaye the' (9:118), aur apni baat ke aakhri hisse mein unhone kaha, '(Maine kaha), "Apni tauba ke ek hisse ke taur par, main apna sara maal Allah aur uske Rasool ki raah mein de dena chahta hoon." Nabi (SAW) ne mujhse kaha, "Apna kuch maal apne paas rakh lo, ye tumhare liye behtar hai."' Aur un teen logon ko bhi (Allah ne maaf kiya) jo peechhe reh gaye the, yahaan tak ke unke liye zameen, itni wasee hote hue bhi, tang ho gayi thi.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Ka`b:I heard Ka`b bin Malik who was one of the three who were forgiven, saying that he had never remained behind Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in any Ghazwa which he had fought except two Ghazwat Ghazwat- Al-`Usra (Tabuk) and Ghazwat-Badr. He added. "I decided to tell the truth to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the forenoon, and scarcely did he return from a journey he made, except in the forenoon, he would go first to the mosque and offer a two-rak`at prayer. The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade others to speak to me or to my two companions, but he did not prohibit speaking to any of those who had remained behind excepting us. So the people avoided speaking to us, and I stayed in that state till I could no longer bear it, and the only thing that worried me was that I might die and the Prophet (ﷺ) would not offer the funeral prayer for me, or Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) might die and I would be left in that social status among the people that nobody would speak to me or offer the funeral prayer for me. But Allah revealed His Forgiveness for us to the Prophet (ﷺ) in the last third of the night while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was with Um Salama. Um Salama sympathized with me and helped me in my disaster. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'O Um Salama! Ka`b has been forgiven!' She said, 'Shall I send someone to him to give him the good tidings?' He said, 'If you did so, the people would not let you sleep the rest of the night.' So when the Prophet (ﷺ) had offered the Fajr prayer, he announced Allah's Forgiveness for us. His face used to look as bright as a piece of the (full) moon whenever he was pleased. When Allah revealed His Forgiveness for us, we were the three whose case had been deferred while the excuse presented by those who had apologized had been accepted. But when there were mentioned those who had told the Prophet (ﷺ) lies and remained behind (the battle of Tabuk) and had given false excuses, they were described with the worse description one may be described with. Allah said: 'They will present their excuses to you (Muslims) when you return to them. Say: Present no excuses; we shall not believe you. Allah has already informed us of the true state of matters concerning you. Allah and His Apostle will observe your actions
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ka'b bataate hain: Maine Ka'b bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko, jo un teen logon mein se ek the jinhe Allah ne maaf kiya tha, ye kehte suna ke wo kabhi bhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke kisi Ghazwe se peechhe nahi rahe siwaaye do Ghazwaton ke - Ghazwa Al-Usra (Tabuk) aur Ghazwa Badr. Unhone aage kaha: 'Maine faisla kiya ke main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se din ke pehle hisse mein hi sach bataunga, kyunke jab bhi wo kisi safar se lautte, wo pehle Masjid jaate aur do rakat namaz padhte. Nabi (SAW) ne logon ko mujhse aur mere do saathiyon se baat karne se mana kar diya, lekin doosre jo peechhe reh gaye the unse baat karne se mana nahi kiya. To log humse baat karna chhod dete, aur main is haalat mein rahaa yahaan tak ke ye mere liye na-qaabil-e-bardaasht ho gaya. Sirf ek hi cheez ne mujhe pareshaan kiya - ke kahin main mar na jaaun aur Nabi (SAW) meri janaaza ki namaz na padhein, ya Nabi (SAW) mar jaayein aur main isi haalat mein reh jaaun jahaan koi mujhse baat nahi karta na hi meri janaaza padhega. Magar Allah ne humari maafi Nabi (SAW) par raat ke aakhri tihaai hisse mein naazil ki, jabke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Umm Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas the. Umm Salama ne mere saath hamdardi ki aur meri musibat mein meri madad ki. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, "Aye Umm Salama! Ka'b ko maaf kar diya gaya hai!" Unhone pucha, "Kya main kisi ko unhe khush-khabri dene bheju?" Unhone kaha, "Agar tum aisa karogi, to log tumhe raat baaki hisse mein sone nahi denge." To jab Nabi (SAW) ne Fajr ki namaz padhaayi, unhone humari maafi ka elaan kiya. Unka chehra jab wo khush hote to poore chaand ke tukde jaisa chamakta tha. Jab Allah ne humari maafi naazil ki, hum wo teen log the jinka maamla taal diya gaya tha, jabke jinhone (jhoothi) maazrat pesh ki thi unki maazrat qubool ki gayi thi. Magar jab un logon ka zikr aaya jinhone Nabi (SAW) se jhoot bola tha aur Tabuk mein peechhe reh gaye the aur jhoothi mazrat pesh ki thi, to unhein sabse buri sifat se bayaan kiya gaya. Allah ne farmaya: "Wo tumhaare paas wapas aane par apni mazrat pesh karenge. Kaho: Koi mazrat pesh mat karo, hum tumhaari baat nahi maanenge. Allah humein tumhaare haalaat ki khabar de chuka hai. Allah aur uska Rasool tumhaare aamaal dekhte rahenge."'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Ka`b:I heard Ka`b bin Malik talking about the story of the battle of Tabuk when he remained behind, "By Allah, I do not know anyone whom Allah has helped for telling the truth more than me since I mentioned that truth to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) till today, I have never intended to tell a lie. And Allah revealed to His Apostle: "Verily! Allah has forgiven the Prophet, the Muhajirin............ and be with those who are true (in words and deeds)." (9.117-119) (See Hadith No. 702 Vol)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ka'b bataate hain: Maine Ka'b bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko jang-e-Tabuk ke waqiye ke baare mein, jab wo peechhe reh gaye the, ye kehte suna: 'Allah ki qasam, mujhe nahi maloom ke Allah ne mujhse zyaada kisi aur ki sach bolne ki wajah se madad ki ho, jab se maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko wo sach bataaya tha, aaj tak maine kabhi jhoot bolne ka iraada nahi kiya. Aur Allah ne apne Rasool par naazil farmaya: "Beshak Allah ne Nabi ko, Muhaajireen ko maaf kar diya... aur sachche logon (baaton aur amal mein) ke saath ho jaao." (9:117-119)'

e: Narrated Zaid bin Thabit Al-Ansari:who was one of those who used to write the Divine Revelation: Abu Bakr sent for me after the (heavy) casualties among the warriors (of the battle) of Yamama (where a great number of Qurra' were killed). `Umar was present with Abu Bakr who said, `Umar has come to me and said, The people have suffered heavy casualties on the day of (the battle of) Yamama, and I am afraid that there will be more casualties among the Qurra' (those who know the Qur'an by heart) at other battle-fields, whereby a large part of the Qur'an may be lost, unless you collect it. And I am of the opinion that you should collect the Qur'an." Abu Bakr added, "I said to `Umar, 'How can I do something which Allah's Apostle has not done?' `Umar said (to me), 'By Allah, it is (really) a good thing.' So `Umar kept on pressing, trying to persuade me to accept his proposal, till Allah opened my bosom for it and I had the same opinion as `Umar." (Zaid bin Thabit added:) `Umar was sitting with him (Abu Bakr) and was not speaking to me. "You are a wise young man and we do not suspect you (of telling lies or of forgetfulness): and you used to write the Divine Inspiration for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Therefore, look for the Qur'an and collect it (in one manuscript). " By Allah, if he (Abu Bakr) had ordered me to shift one of the mountains (from its place) it would not have been harder for me than what he had ordered me concerning the collection of the Qur'an. I said to both of them, "How dare you do a thing which the Prophet has not done?" Abu Bakr said, "By Allah, it is (really) a good thing. So I kept on arguing with him about it till Allah opened my bosom for that which He had opened the bosoms of Abu Bakr and `Umar. So I started locating Qur'anic material and collecting it from parchments, scapula, leaf-stalks of date palms and from the memories of men (who knew it by heart). I found with Khuza`ima two Verses of Surat-at-Tauba which I had not found with anybody else, (and they were):-- "Verily there has come to you an Apostle (Muhammad) from amongst yourselves. It grieves him that you should receive any injury or difficulty He (Muhammad) is ardently anxious over you (to be rightly guided)" (9.128) The manuscript on which the Qur'an was collected, remained with Abu Bakr till Allah took him unto Him, and then with `Umar till Allah took him unto Him, and finally it remained with Hafsa, `Umar's daughter
hi: Zaid bin Thabit (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ansari, jo Allah ki wahi likhne walon mein se the, bataate hain: Abu Bakr ne mujhe jang-e-Yamama mein hue bhaari nuqsaan (jismein bahut se Qurra shaheed hue the) ke baad bulaaya. Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bhi Abu Bakr ke saath maujood the. Abu Bakr ne kaha, 'Umar mere paas aaye aur kaha, "Yamama ki jang mein bahut zyaada nuqsaan hua hai, aur mujhe dar hai ke aage bhi doosre maidan-e-jang mein Qurra shaheed hote rahenge, jiski wajah se Quran ka bada hissa zaaya ho sakta hai, jab tak aap ise jama na karein. Mera khayaal hai ke aapko Quran jama kar lena chahiye."' Abu Bakr ne aage kaha, 'Maine Umar se kaha, "Main wo kaam kaise karoon jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne khud nahi kiya?" Umar ne kaha, "Allah ki qasam, ye ek achha kaam hai." Umar mujhe manaane ki koshish karte rahe yahaan tak ke Allah ne mera seena is kaam ke liye khol diya aur meri raay bhi Umar jaisi ho gayi."' (Zaid bin Thabit ne aage bataya:) Umar Abu Bakr ke saath baithe the aur mujhse kuch nahi keh rahe the. (Abu Bakr ne mujhse kaha:) 'Tum ek aqlmand jawaan aadmi ho aur humein tum par (jhoot bolne ya bhool jaane ka) shak nahi hai, aur tum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke liye wahi likha karte the. Isliye Quran ko dhoondho aur ise (ek nuskhe mein) jama karo.' Allah ki qasam, agar Abu Bakr mujhe kisi pahaad ko uski jagah se hataane ka hukm dete, to wo mujhe Quran jama karne ke hukm se zyaada bhaari nahi lagta. Maine dono se kaha, 'Aap ye kaam kaise kar sakte hain jo Nabi (SAW) ne khud nahi kiya?' Abu Bakr ne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, ye ek achha kaam hai.' To main unse behas karta raha yahaan tak ke Allah ne mera seena bhi usi tarah khol diya jaise usne Abu Bakr aur Umar ka khola tha. Phir maine Quran ka maadda dhoondhna aur jama karna shuru kiya - chamde ke tukdon, haddiyon, khajoor ke patton ki daalon aur un logon ki yaadasht se jo ise zabaani yaad rakhte the. Mujhe Khuzaima ke paas Surah At-Tauba ki do Aayaten milin jo mujhe kisi aur ke paas nahi milin: 'Beshak tumhaare paas tum mein se hi ek Rasool aaya hai, tumhaari takleef aur mushkilaat uspar bhaari guzarti hain, wo tumhaari hidaayat ke liye bahut fikramand hai...' (9:128) Wo nuskha jispar Quran jama kiya gaya tha, Abu Bakr ke paas raha yahaan tak ke Allah ne unhe apne paas bula liya, phir Umar ke paas raha yahaan tak ke Allah ne unhe bhi apne paas bula liya, aur aakhir mein wo Umar ki beti Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas raha.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When the Prophet (ﷺ) arrived at Medina, the Jews were observing the fast on 'Ashura' (10th of Muharram) and they said, "This is the day when Moses became victorious over Pharaoh," On that, the Prophet (ﷺ) said to his companions, "You (Muslims) have more right to celebrate Moses' victory than they have, so observe the fast on this day
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Nabi (SAW) Madina pahunche, to Yahudi Ashura (Muharram ki dus tareekh) ke din roza rakh rahe the aur unhone kaha, 'Ye wo din hai jab Musa ne Firaun par fatah paayi thi.' Isper Nabi (SAW) ne apne sahaaba se farmaya, 'Tum (Musalmaan) Musa ki is fatah ka jashn manaane ke unse zyaada haqdaar ho, isliye is din ka roza rakho.'

e: Narrated Muhammad bin `Abbas bin Ja`far:That he heard Ibn `Abbas reciting: "No doubt! They fold up their breasts." (11.5) and asked him about its explanation. He said, "Some people used to hide themselves while answering the call of nature in an open space lest they be exposed to the sky, and also when they had sexual relation with their wives in an open space lest they be exposed to the sky, so the above revelation was sent down regarding them
hi: Muhammad bin Abbas bin Ja'far bataate hain ke unhone Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko ye Aayat padhte suna, 'Khabardaar! Wo apne seene mod lete hain (chhupne ke liye)...' (11:5) aur unse iski tafseer poochi. Unhone kaha, 'Kuch log khuli jagah mein qaza-e-haajat (paakhaana) karte waqt chhup jaate the taake aasman ke saamne zaahir na ho jaayein, aur isi tarah khuli jagah mein apni biwiyon se humbistari karte waqt bhi, isi wajah se ye Aayat unke baare mein naazil hui.'

e: Narrated Muhammad bin `Abbas bin Ja`far:Ibn `Abbas recited. "No doubt! They fold up their breasts." I said, "O Abu `Abbas! What is meant by "They fold up their breasts?" He said, "A man used to feel shy on having sexual relation with his wife or on answering the call of nature (in an open space) so this Verse was revealed:-- "No doubt! They fold up their breasts
hi: Muhammad bin Abbas bin Ja'far bataate hain: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne ye Aayat padhi, 'Khabardaar! Wo apne seene mod lete hain...' Maine pucha, 'Aye Abu Abbas! "Wo apne seene mod lete hain" ka kya matlab hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Ek aadmi apni biwi se humbistari karte waqt ya khuli jagah mein qaza-e-haajat karte waqt sharmaata tha, isliye ye Aayat naazil hui: "Khabardaar! Wo apne seene mod lete hain."'

e: Narrated `Amr:Ibn `Abbas recited:-- "No doubt! They fold up their breasts in order to hide from Him. Surely! Even when they cover themselves with their garments
hi: Amr bataate hain: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne ye Aayat padhi: 'Khabardaar! Wo apne seene mod lete hain taake usse (Allah se) chhup sakein. Sun lo! Jab bhi wo apne kapdon se apne aap ko dhaankte hain (tab bhi Allah unhe dekhta hai)...'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah said, 'Spend (O man), and I shall spend on you." He also said, "Allah's Hand is full, and (its fullness) is not affected by the continuous spending night and day." He also said, "Do you see what He has spent since He created the Heavens and the Earth? Nevertheless, what is in His Hand is not decreased, and His Throne was over the water; and in His Hand there is the balance (of justice) whereby He raises and lowers (people)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah farmaata hai, "Aye insaan! Tu kharch kar, Main tujhpar kharch karunga."' Unhone ye bhi farmaya, 'Allah ka haath bhara hua hai, aur raat-din musalsal kharch karne se uski bharpoori mein koi kami nahi aati.' Unhone ye bhi farmaya, 'Kya tum dekhte ho ke usne aasmaan aur zameen banaane se ab tak kitna kharch kiya hai? Iske bawajood, jo uske haath mein hai wo kam nahi hua. Uska Arsh paani ke upar tha, aur uske haath mein (insaaf ka) taraazu hai jiske zariye wo (logon ko) ooncha ya neecha karta hai.'

e: Narrated Safwan bin Muhriz:While Ibn `Umar was performing the Tawaf (around the Ka`ba), a man came up to him and said, "O Abu `AbdurRahman!" or said, "O Ibn `Umar! Did you hear anything from the Prophet (ﷺ) about An-Najwa?" Ibn `Umar said, "I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, 'The Believer will be brought near his Lord." (Hisham, a sub-narrator said, reporting the Prophet's words), "The believer will come near (his Lord) till his Lord covers him with His screen and makes him confess his sins. (Allah will ask him), 'Do you know (that you did) 'such-and-such sin?" He will say twice, 'Yes, I do.' Then Allah will say, 'I concealed it in the world and I forgive it for you today.' Then the record of his good deeds will be folded up. As for the others, or the disbelievers, it will be announced publicly before the witnesses: 'These are ones who lied against their Lord
hi: Safwan bin Muhriz bataate hain: Jab Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) Kaaba ka Tawaf kar rahe the, ek shaks unke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Aye Abu Abdur Rahman!' ya kaha, 'Aye Ibn Umar! Kya aapne Nabi (SAW) se An-Najwa (khufiya guftgu/hisaab-kitaab) ke baare mein kuch suna hai?' Ibn Umar ne kaha, 'Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, "Momin ko apne Rab ke qareeb laaya jaayega."' (Ravi Hisham kehte hain, Nabi (SAW) ke alfaaz naql karte hue:) 'Momin apne Rab ke qareeb aayega yahaan tak ke uska Rab use apni chaadar (parda) se dhaank lega aur use apne gunaahon ka iqraar karwaayega. (Allah usse poochega,) "Kya tumhein pata hai (tumne) falaan falaan gunaah kiya tha?" Wo do baar kahega, "Haan, mujhe pata hai." Phir Allah farmaayega, "Maine duniya mein use chhupaaya tha, aur aaj main tumhein maaf karta hoon." Phir uske nek amaal ka register (record) lapet diya jaayega. Magar doosron ke liye, yaani kaafiron ke liye, gawaahon ke saamne khule aam elaan kiya jaayega: "Yahi wo log hain jinhone apne Rab par jhoot bola tha."'

e: Narrated Abu Musa:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah gives respite to the oppressor, but when He takes him over, He never releases him." Then he recited:-- "Such is the seizure of your Lord when He seizes (population of) towns in the midst of their wrong: Painful indeed, and severe is His seizure
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah zaalim ko mohlat deta hai, magar jab wo use pakadta hai, to phir use kabhi nahi chhodta.' Phir unhone ye Aayat padhi: 'Aisa hi hai tumhaare Rab ka pakadna jab wo un bastiyon ko pakadta hai jo zulm mein duboyi hui hoti hain: waaqai uska pakadna dardnaak aur sakht hai.'

e: Narrated Ibn Masud:A man kissed a woman and then came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and told him of that, so this Divine Inspiration was revealed to the Prophet (ﷺ) 'And offer Prayers perfectly at the two ends of the day, and in some hours of the night; (i.e. (five) compulsory prayers). Verily, the good deeds remove the evil deeds (small sins) That is a reminder for the mindful.' (11.114) The man said, Is this instruction for me only?' The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It is for all those of my followers who encounter a similar situation
hi: Ibn Masud bataate hain: Ek shaks ne (kisi) aurat ko chooma, phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unhein ye baat bataayi. Isper Nabi (SAW) par ye wahi naazil hui: 'Aur namaz qaayam karo din ke dono siron par aur raat ke kuch hisson mein; (yaani paanch farz namazein). Beshak neki (achhe kaam) buraaiyon (chhote gunaahon) ko mita deti hai. Ye naseehat karne walon ke liye ek yaad-dahaani hai.' (11:114) Us shaks ne pucha, 'Kya ye hukm sirf mere liye hai?' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ye meri ummat mein us har shaks ke liye hai jo aisi hi soorat-e-haal mein padh jaaye.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The honorable, the son of the honorable, the son of the honorable, the son of the honorable, i.e. Joseph, the son of Jacob, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Izzatdaar, izzatdaar ke bete, izzatdaar ke bete, izzatdaar ke bete - yaani Yusuf, Yaqub ke bete, Ishaq ke bete, Ibrahim ke bete (Alaihimus-salaam).'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked, "Who are the most honorable of the people?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The most honorable of them in Allah's Sight are those who keep their duty to Allah and fear Him. They said, "We do not ask you about that." He said, "Then the most honorable of the people is Joseph, Allah's prophet, the son of Allah's prophet, the son of Allah's prophet, the son of Allah's Khalil i.e. Abraham) They said, "We do not ask you about that." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, Do you ask about (the virtues of the ancestry of the Arabs?" They said, "Yes," He said, "Those who were the best amongst you in the pre-Islamic Period are the best amongst you in Islam if they comprehend (the Islamic religion)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se pucha gaya, 'Log mein sabse izzatdaar kaun hai?' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah ke nazdeek sabse izzatdaar wo hain jo Allah se sabse zyaada darte hain aur apna farz nibhaate hain.' Unhone kaha, 'Hum ye nahi poochna chahte.' Unhone farmaya, 'To phir sabse izzatdaar shaks Yusuf hain, Allah ke Nabi, jo Allah ke Nabi (Yaqub) ke bete hain, jo Allah ke Nabi (Ishaq) ke bete hain, jo Allah ke Khalil (Ibrahim) ke bete hain.' Unhone kaha, 'Hum ye bhi nahi poochna chahte.' Nabi (SAW) ne pucha, 'Kya tum Arabon ke khaandaani martabe ke baare mein poochna chahte ho?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan.' Unhone farmaya, 'Jaahiliyat ke daur mein jo tum mein behtareen the, wahi Islam mein bhi behtareen hain, bashart-e-ke unhein (deen ki) samajh ho.'

e: Narrated Az-Zuhri:`Urwa bin Az-Zubair, Sa`id bin Al-Musaiyab, 'Al-Qama bin Waqqas and 'Ubaidullah bin `Abdullah related the narration of `Aisha, the wife of the Prophet, when the slanderers had said about her what they had said and Allah later declared her innocence. Each of them related a part of the narration (wherein) the Prophet (ﷺ) said (to `Aisha). "If you are innocent, then Allah will declare your innocence: but if you have committed a sin, then ask for Allah's Forgiveness and repent to Him." `Aisha said, "By Allah, I find no example for my case except that of Joseph's father (when he said), 'So (for me) patience is most fitting.' " Then Allah revealed the ten Verses:-- "Verily those who spread the slander are a gang amongst you
hi: Az-Zuhri bataate hain: Urwa bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ), Saeed bin Al-Musaiyab, Alqama bin Waqqas aur Ubaidullah bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki zawja) ka waaqiya bayaan kiya, jab tohmat lagaane walon ne unke baare mein wo baat kahi thi jo unhone kahi, aur baad mein Allah ne unki paakeezgi (be-gunaahi) ka elaan kiya. Har ek ne is riwayat ka ek hissa bayaan kiya, jismein Nabi (SAW) ne (Aisha se) farmaya tha, 'Agar tum be-gunaah ho, to Allah tumhaari be-gunaahi zaahir kar dega, magar agar tumse koi gunaah hua hai, to Allah se maafi maango aur uski taraf tauba karo.' Aisha ne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, mujhe apni misaal Yusuf ke waalid (Yaqub) ke siwa kahin nahi milti, (jinhone kaha tha), "To (mere liye) sabar hi behtar hai."' Phir Allah ne dus Aayaten naazil kin: 'Beshak jinhone ye tohmat lagaayi, wo tum mein se ek giroh hai...'

e: Narrated Um Ruman:Who was `Aisha's mother: While I was with `Aisha, `Aisha got fever, whereupon the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Probably her fever is caused by the story related by the people (about her)." I said, "Yes." Then `Aisha sat up and said, "My example and your example is similar to that of Jacob and his sons:--'Nay, but your minds have made up a tale. So (for me) patience is most fitting. It is Allah (alone) Whose help can be sought against that which you assert
hi: Umm Ruman, jo Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ki maa thi, bataati hain: Jab main Aisha ke paas thi, Aisha ko bukhaar aa gaya, isper Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Shaayad unka bukhaar us baat ki wajah se hai jo logon ne (unke baare mein) kahi.' Maine kaha, 'Haan.' Phir Aisha uth kar baithi aur kaha, 'Meri misaal aur tumhaari misaal Yaqub aur unke beton jaisi hai: "Nahi, balke tumhaare dilon ne ek kahaani gadh li hai. To (mere liye) sabar hi behtar hai. Aur Allah hi (sirf) hai jiski madad maangi jaa sakti hai us baat ke khilaaf jo tum bayaan karte ho."'

e: Narrated Abu Wail:`Abdullah bin Mas`ud recited "Haita laka (Come you)," and added, "We recite it as we were taught it
hi: Abu Wail bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Masud ne 'Haita laka' (Aao tumhaare liye) padha, aur kaha, 'Hum ise waise hi padhte hain jaisa humein sikhaaya gaya tha.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah (bin Mas`ud):When the Prophet (ﷺ) realized that the Quraish had delayed in embracing Islam, he said, "O Allah! Protect me against their evil by afflicting them with seven (years of famine) like the seven years of (Prophet) Joseph." So they were struck with a year of famine that destroyed everything till they had to eat bones, and till a man would look towards the sky and see something like smoke between him and it. Allah said:-- "Then watch you (O Muhammad) for the day when the sky will produce a kind of smoke plainly visible." (44.10) And Allah further said:-- "Verily! We shall withdraw the punishment a little, Verily you will return (to disbelief)." (44.15) (Will Allah relieve them from torture on the Day of Resurrection?) (The punishment of) the smoke had passed and Al-Batsha (the destruction of the pagans in the Badr battle) had passed too
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Masud bataate hain: Jab Nabi (SAW) ko ehsaas hua ke Quraish Islam qubool karne mein der kar rahe hain, to unhone dua ki, 'Aye Allah! Mujhe unki buraai se bacha, unpar saat (saal ka qehat) daal de jaise Yusuf (Alaihissalam) ke zamaane ke saat saal the.' To unpar aisa qehat aaya jisne sab kuch tabaah kar diya yahaan tak ke wo haddiyaan khaane lage, aur ek aadmi aasman ki taraf dekhta to usse aur usme dhuein jaisi koi cheez nazar aati. Allah ne farmaya: 'To (Aye Muhammad) us din ka intezaar karo jab aasman saaf zaahir dhuaan laayega.' (44:10) Aur Allah ne aage farmaya: 'Beshak Hum azaab thoda hataa denge, (magar) tum phir wahi (kufr ki taraf) laut jaaoge.' (44:15) Dhuein ka azaab guzar chuka tha aur Al-Batsha (yaani jang-e-Badr mein mushrikeen ki tabaahi) bhi guzar chuki thi.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "May Allah bestow His Mercy on (Prophet) Lot. (When his nation troubled him) he wished if he could betake himself to some powerful support; and if I were to remain in prison for the period Joseph had remained, I would surely respond to the call; and we shall have more right (to be in doubt) than Abraham: When Allah said to him, "Don't you believe?' Abraham said, 'Yes, (I do believe) but to be stronger in faith;
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah Lut (Alaihissalam) par apni rehmat naazil kare. (Jab unki qaum ne unhein takleef di) to unhone chaaha ke kaash unke paas koi mazboot sahaara hota; aur agar main utne saal jail mein rehta jitne Yusuf (Alaihissalam) rahe, to main zaroor (rihaai ke) bulaawe ka jawab deta; aur humein Ibrahim se zyaada shak karne ka haq hai: jab Allah ne unse pucha, "Kya tum Iman nahi rakhte?" Ibrahim ne kaha, "Haan (mujhe Iman hai), magar (chahta hoon ke) mera Iman aur mazboot ho jaaye."'

e: Narrated `Urwa bin Az-Zubair:That when he asked `Aisha about the statement of Allah "Until when the Apostles gave up hope (of their people)." (12.110) she told him (its meaning), `Urwa added, "I said, 'Did they (Apostles) suspect that they were betrayed (by Allah) or that they were treated as liars by (their people)?' `Aisha said, '(They suspected) that they were treated as liars by (their people),' I said, 'But they were sure that their people treated them as liars and it was not a matter of suspicion.' She said, 'Yes, upon my life they were sure about it.' I said to her. 'So they (Apostles) suspected that they were betrayed (by Allah).' She said, "Allah forbid! The Apostles never suspected their Lord of such a thing.' I said, 'What about this Verse then?' She said, 'It is about the Apostles' followers who believed in their Lord and trusted their Apostles, but the period of trials was prolonged and victory was delayed till the Apostles gave up all hope of converting those of the people who disbelieved them and the Apostles thought that their followers treated them as liars; thereupon Allah's help came to them
hi: Urwa bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke unhone Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se Allah ke is farmaan ke baare mein pucha, 'Yahaan tak ke jab Rasool naa-umeed ho gaye (apni qaum se)...' (12:110), to unhone (iska matlab) bataaya. Urwa ne aage kaha, 'Maine pucha, "Kya unhein (Rasoolon ko) shak hua ke unke saath (Allah ki taraf se) dhoka hua hai, ya ke unhein unki qaum ne jhoota samjha?" Aisha ne kaha, "(Unhein shak hua) ke unki qaum ne unhein jhoota samjha." Maine kaha, "Magar unhein to yaqeen tha ke unki qaum unhein jhoota samajh chuki hai, ye shak ki baat nahi thi." Unhone kaha, "Haan, mujhe apni zindagi ki qasam, unhein iska yaqeen tha." Maine unse kaha, "To (iska matlab hai) Rasoolon ko shak hua ke unke saath (Allah ki taraf se) dhoka hua hai." Unhone kaha, "Allah maaf kare! Rasool kabhi apne Rab par aisa shak nahi karte." Maine pucha, "To phir is Aayat ka kya matlab hai?" Unhone kaha, "Ye un Rasoolon ke maanne walon ke baare mein hai jo apne Rab par Iman laaye the aur apne Rasoolon par bharosa karte the, magar aazmaaish ka daur lamba ho gaya aur fatah mein deri hui, yahaan tak ke Rasool apni qaum ke un logon se, jo unhein jhutlaate the, umeed chhod baithe, aur Rasoolon ko laga ke unke maanne wale bhi unhein jhoota samajh rahe hain; isi waqt Allah ki madad unke paas aa gayi."'

e: Narrated `Urwa:"I told her (`Aisha): (Regarding the above narration), they (Apostles) were betrayed (by Allah)." She said: Allah forbid or said similarly
hi: Urwa bataate hain: 'Maine unse (Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se) kaha (upar wali riwayat ke silsile mein): unke (Rasoolon ke) saath dhoka hua tha.' Unhone kaha: Allah maaf kare, ya isi tarah ki koi baat kahi.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The keys of Unseen are five which none knows but Allah: None knows what will happen tomorrow but Allah; none knows what is in the wombs (a male child or a female) but Allah; none knows when it will rain but Allah; none knows at what place one will die; none knows when the Hour will be established but Allah." (See The Qur'an 31:)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ghaib ki chaabiyaan paanch hain jinhe Allah ke siwa koi nahi jaanta: koi nahi jaanta kal kya hoga siwaaye Allah ke; koi nahi jaanta (maaon ke) rehm mein kya hai (ladka ya ladki) siwaaye Allah ke; koi nahi jaanta kab baarish hogi siwaaye Allah ke; koi nahi jaanta wo kis jagah marega; koi nahi jaanta Qayamat kab aayegi siwaaye Allah ke.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:While we were with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) he said, "Tell me of a tree which resembles a Muslim man. Its leaves do not fall and it does not, and does not, and does not, and it gives its fruits every now and then." It came to my mind that such a tree must be the date palm, but seeing Abu Bakr and `Umar saying nothing, I disliked to speak. So when they did not say anything, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "It is the date-palm tree." When we got up (from that place), I said to `Umar, "O my father! By Allah, it came to my mind that it must be the date palm tree." `Umar said, "What prevented you from speaking?" I replied, "I did not see you speaking, so I disliked to speak or say anything." `Umar then said, "If you had said it, it would have been dearer to me than so-and-so
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath the, unhone farmaya, 'Mujhe ek aise darakht ke baare mein bataao jo Musalmaan aadmi jaisa hai. Uske patte nahi girte, aur nahi... aur nahi... aur nahi, aur wo waqt waqt par apne phal deta hai.' Mere zehen mein aaya ke shaayad ye khajoor ka darakht ho, magar Abu Bakr aur Umar ko khaamosh dekh kar mujhe bolna theek nahi laga. To jab unhone kuch nahi kaha, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne khud farmaya, 'Ye khajoor ka darakht hai.' Jab hum wahaan se uthe, to maine Umar (apne waalid) se kaha, 'Aye mere Abbu! Allah ki qasam, mere zehen mein bhi aaya tha ke ye khajoor ka darakht hoga.' Umar ne pucha, 'Tumhein bolne se kis cheez ne roka?' Maine jawab diya, 'Maine aapko bolte nahi dekha, isliye mujhe bhi kuch kehna theek nahi laga.' Umar ne kaha, 'Agar tumne ye baat keh di hoti, to ye mere liye falaan falaan cheez se bhi zyaada aziz hoti.'

e: Narrated Al-Bara bin Azib:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When a Muslim is questioned in his grave, he will testify that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah and that Muhammad is Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and that is what is meant by Allah's Statement:-- "Allah will keep firm those who believe with a Word that stands firm in this world and in the Hereafter
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab ek Musalmaan se uski qabr mein sawaal kiya jaata hai, to wo gawaahi deta hai ke Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi aur Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain, aur yahi Allah ke is farmaan ka matlab hai: "Allah Iman waalon ko duniya aur aakhirat mein ek mazboot baat (kalima) par qaayam rakhega."'

e: Narrated Ata:When Ibn `Abbas heard:-- "Have you not seen those who have changed the favor of Allah into disbelief?" (14.28) he said, "Those were the disbelieving pagans of Mecca
hi: Ata bataate hain: Jab Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne ye Aayat suni, 'Kya tumne unhe nahi dekha jinhone Allah ki nemat ko kufr se badal diya?' (14:28), to unhone kaha, 'Ye Makkah ke wo kaafir mushrik the.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When Allah has ordained some affair in the Heaven, the angels beat with their wings in obedience to His statement, which sounds like a chain dragged over a rock." (`Ali and other sub-narrators said, "The sound reaches them.") "Until when fear is banished from their (angels) hearts, they (angels) say, 'What was it that your Lord said? They say, 'The truth; And He is the Most High, the Most Great.' (34.23) Then those who gain a hearing by stealing (i.e. devils) will hear Allah's Statement:-- 'Those who gain a hearing by stealing, (stand one over the other like this). (Sufyan, to illustrate this, spread the fingers of his right hand and placed them one over the other horizontally.) A flame may overtake and burn the eavesdropper before conveying the news to the one below him; or it may not overtake him till he has conveyed it to the one below him, who in his turn, conveys it to the one below him, and so on till they convey the news to the earth. (Or probably Sufyan said, "Till the news reaches the earth.") Then the news is inspired to a sorcerer who would add a hundred lies to it. His prophecy will prove true (as far as the heavenly news is concerned). The people will say. 'Didn't he tell us that on such-and-such a day, such-and-such a thing will happen? We have found that is true because of the true news heard from heaven." The above hadith is also narrated by Abu Huraira, starting: 'When Allah has ordained some affair...') In this narration the word foreteller is added to the word wizard
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab Allah aasman mein koi maamla (hukm) tay karta hai, to farishte uski itaa'at mein apne par phadphadaate hain, jiski aawaaz pathar par zanjeer ghisaite jaane jaisi lagti hai.' (Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur doosre raaviyon ne kaha, 'Ye aawaaz unhein pahunchti hai.') 'Yahaan tak ke jab unke (farishton ke) dilon se khauf door ho jaata hai, to wo (ek doosre se) poochte hain, "Tumhaare Rab ne kya farmaya?" Wo kehte hain, "Haq baat," aur wo Sabse Buland, Sabse Azeem hai.' (34:23) Phir jo (Shaitaan) chori-chhupe sunte hain, unhein Allah ka farmaan sunayi deta hai: 'Jo chori-chhupe sunte hain, (wo ek doosre ke upar is tarah khade hote hain).' (Sufyan ne isse samjhaane ke liye apne daayen haath ki ungliyaan phaila kar unhein afqi tor par ek doosre ke upar rakh diya.) Ek shola (chingari) sunne waale ko pakad kar jala sakta hai isse pehle ke wo khabar apne neeche wale tak pahunchaaye, ya wo tab tak nahi pakadta jab tak wo apne neeche wale ko khabar na de de, jo aage apne neeche wale ko batata hai, aur isi tarah yahaan tak ke khabar zameen tak pahunch jaati hai. (Ya shaayad Sufyan ne kaha, 'Yahaan tak ke khabar zameen tak pahunchti hai.') Phir ye khabar kisi jaadugar ko wahi ke zariye di jaati hai, jo isme sau jhoot mila deta hai. Uski (aasmaani baat ke hisse ki) peshangoi sach saabit hoti hai. Log kehte hain, 'Kya usne humein nahi bataaya tha ke falaan din falaan cheez hogi? Humne paaya ke ye sach hai, aasman se suni gayi sachchi khabar ki wajah se.' (Ye hadees Abu Huraira se bhi is tarah riwayat ki gayi hai, shuru hoti hai: 'Jab Allah koi maamla tay karta hai...' Is riwayat mein 'jaadugar' ke saath 'nujoomi (peshangoi karne wala)' ka lafz bhi shaamil hai.)

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:(While we were going for the Battle of Tabuk and when we reached the places of the dwellers of Al- Hijr), Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said about the dwellers of Al-Hijr (to us). "Do not enter (the dwelling places) of these people unless you enter weeping, but if you weep not, then do not enter upon them, lest you be afflicted with what they were afflicted with
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: (Jab hum jang-e-Tabuk ke liye ja rahe the aur Al-Hijr ke rehne walon ki bastiyon tak pahunche), Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Al-Hijr ke logon ke baare mein (humse) farmaya, 'In logon ki (bastiyon) mein daakhil mat ho, siwaaye is haal mein ke tum rote hue daakhil ho, aur agar tum na ro sako, to unke paas daakhil hi mat ho, kahin tum bhi usi mein na phans jaao jismein wo phanse the.'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Mualla:While I was praying, the Prophet (ﷺ) passed by and called me, but I did not go to him till I had finished my prayer. When I went to him, he said, "What prevented you from coming?" I said, "I was praying." He said, "Didn't Allah say" "O you who believes Give your response to Allah (by obeying Him) and to His Apostle." (8.24) Then he added, "Shall I tell you the most superior Sura in the Qur'an before I go out of the mosque?" When the Prophet (ﷺ) intended to go out (of the Mosque), I reminded him and he said, "That is: "Al hamdu-li l-lahi Rabbil-`alamin (Surat-al-fatiha)' which is the seven oft repeated verses (Al-Mathani) and the Grand Qur'an which has been given to me
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Mu'alla bataate hain: Jab main namaz padh raha tha, Nabi (SAW) mere paas se guzre aur mujhe bulaaya, magar main namaz khatam kiye bagair unke paas nahi gaya. Jab main unke paas gaya, to unhone pucha, 'Tumhein aane se kis cheez ne roka?' Maine kaha, 'Main namaz padh raha tha.' Unhone farmaya, 'Kya Allah ne nahi farmaya, "Aye Iman waalo! Allah ki pukaar ka jawab do (uski itaa'at karke) aur uske Rasool ki bhi"?' (8:24) Phir unhone farmaya, 'Kya main tumhein Masjid se nikalne se pehle Quran ki sabse azeem Surah bataun?' Jab Nabi (SAW) (Masjid se) nikalne lage, to maine unhein yaad dilaaya, unhone farmaya, 'Wo hai: "Alhamdulillahi Rabbil Aalameen" (Surah Al-Fatiha), jo saat baar-baar padhi jaane wali Aayaten (Al-Mathani) hain aur wo azeem Quran hai jo mujhe diya gaya hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The Um (substance) of the Qur'an is the seven oft-repeated verses (Al-Mathani) and is the Great Qur'an (i.e. Surat-al-Fatiha)
