hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Quran ki Umm (asal buniyaad) saat baar-baar padhi jaane wali Aayaten (Al-Mathani) hain, aur wahi azeem Quran hai (yaani Surah Al-Fatiha).'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Those who have made their Scripture into parts are the people of the Scripture who divided it into portions and believed in a part of it and disbelieved the other
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jinhone apni Kitaab ko tukdon mein baant diya, wo Ahl-e-Kitaab hain jinhone use hisson mein baant kar ek hisse par Iman laaye aur doosre ka inkaar kar diya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas concerning:"As We have sent down (the Scripture) on those who are divided (Jews and Christians)." (15.90) They believed in part of it and disbelieved in the other, (and they) are the Jews and the Christians
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) is Aayat ke baare mein bataate hain: 'Jaisa Humne un logon par (Kitaab) naazil ki jinhone ise baant liya (yaani Yahudi aur Isaai)...' (15:90) - unhone kuch hisse par Iman laaya aur kuch ka inkaar kiya, aur wo Yahudi aur Isaai hain.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to invoke thus: "O Allah! I seek refuge with You from miserliness, laziness; from old geriatric age the punishment in the grave; from the affliction of Ad-Dajjal; and from the afflictions of life and death
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ye dua padha karte the, 'Aye Allah! Main Teri panaah maangta hoon kanjoosi se, sustee se, budhaape ki kamzori se, qabr ke azaab se, Dajjal ke fitne se, aur zindagi aur maut ke fitnon se.'

e: Narrated Ibn Mas`ud:Surat Bani Israel and Al-Kahf and Mary are among my first old property
hi: Ibn Masud bataate hain: Surah Bani Israel, Al-Kahf aur Maryam un Surahon mein se hain jo mujhe sabse pehle (Quran mein) di gayi thin (yaani meri sabse purani milkiyat mein se hain).

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was presented with two cups one containing wine and the other milk on the night of his night journey at Jerusalem. He looked at it and took the milk. Gabriel said, "Thanks to Allah Who guided you to the Fitra (i.e. Islam); if you had taken the wine, your followers would have gone astray
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saamne Yerushalem mein, Isra ki raat, do pyaale rakhe gaye, ek sharaab ka aur doosra doodh ka. Unhone dono ko dekha aur doodh liya. Jibrael ne kaha, 'Allah ka shukr hai jisne aapko Fitra (yaani Islam) ki taraf hidaayat di; agar aapne sharaab li hoti, to aapke maanne wale gumraah ho jaate.'

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When the Quraish disbelieved me (concerning my night journey), I stood up in Al- Hijr (the unroofed portion of the Ka`ba) and Allah displayed Bait-ul-Maqdis before me, and I started to inform them (Quraish) about its signs while looking at it
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab Quraish ne mujhpar (meri raat ki safar ke baare mein) yaqeen na kiya, to main Hijr (Kaaba ke bagair-chhat wale hisse) mein khada hua, aur Allah ne Bait-ul-Maqdis ko mere saamne zaahir kar diya, aur main use dekhte hue unhein uski nishaaniyon ke baare mein bataane laga.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:During the Pre-Islamic period of ignorance if any tribe became great in number, we used to say, "Amira the children of so-and-so." Narrated Al-Humaidi: Sufyan narrated to us something and used the word 'Amira
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jaahiliyat ke daur mein, agar koi qabeela tadaad mein bahut bada ho jaata, to hum kehte, 'Falaan qabeele ki aulaad Amira (yaani bahut zyaada) ho gayi hai.' Al-Humaidi bataate hain: Sufyan ne humein kuch bataaya jismein 'Amira' lafz ka istemaal kiya.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Some (cooked) meat was brought to Allah's Apostle and the meat of a forearm was presented to him as he used to like it. He ate a morsel of it and said, "I will be the chief of all the people on the Day of Resurrection. Do you know the reason for it? Allah will gather all the human beings of early generations as well as late generations on one plain so that the announcer will be able to make them all hear his voice and the watcher will be able to see all of them. The sun will come so close to the people that they will suffer such distress and trouble as they will not be able to bear or stand. Then the people will say, 'Don't you see to what state you have reached? Won't you look for someone who can intercede for you with your Lord?' Some people will say to some others, 'Go to Adam.' So they will go to Adam and say to him, 'You are the father of mankind; Allah created you with His Own Hand, and breathed into you of His Spirit (meaning the spirit which He created for you); and ordered the angels to prostrate before you; so (please) intercede for us with your Lord. Don't you see in what state we are? Don't you see what condition we have reached?' Adam will say, 'Today my Lord has become angry as He has never become before, nor will ever become thereafter. He forbade me (to eat of the fruit of) the tree, but I disobeyed Him . Myself! Myself! Myself! (I am preoccuied with my own problems). Go to someone else; go to Noah.' So they will go to Noah and say (to him), 'O Noah! You are the first (of Allah's Messengers) to the people of the earth, and Allah has named you a thankful slave; please intercede for us with your Lord. Don't you see in what state we are?' He will say, 'Today my Lord has become angry as He has never become nor will ever become thereafter. I had (in the world) the right to make one definitely accepted invocation, and I made it against my nation. Myself! Myself! Myself! Go to someone else; go to Abraham.' They will go to Abraham and say, 'O Abraham! You are Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and His Khalil from among the people of the earth; so please intercede for us with your Lord. Don't you see in what state we are?' He will say to them, 'My Lord has today become angry as He has never become before, nor will ever become thereafter. I had told three lies (Abu Haiyan (the sub-narrator) mentioned them in the Hadith) Myself! Myself! Myself! Go to someone else; go to Moses.' The people will then go to Moses and say, 'O Moses! You are Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Allah gave you superiority above the others with His message and with His direct Talk to you; (please) intercede for us with your Lord Don't you see in what state we are?' Moses will say, 'My Lord has today become angry as He has never become before, nor will become thereafter, I killed a person whom I had not been ordered to kill. Myself! Myself! Myself! Go to someone else; go to Jesus.' So they will go to Jesus and say, 'O Jesus! You are Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and His Word which He sent to Mary, and a superior soul created by Him, and you talked to the people while still young in the cradle. Please intercede for us with your Lord. Don't you see in what state we are?' Jesus will say, 'My Lord has today become angry as He has never become before nor will ever become thereafter. Jesus will not mention any sin, but will say, 'Myself! Myself! Myself! Go to someone else; go to Muhammad.' So they will come to me and say, 'O Muhammad! You are Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and the last of the prophets, and Allah forgave your early and late sins. (Please) intercede for us with your Lord. Don't you see in what state we are?" The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "Then I will go beneath Allah's Throne and fall in prostration before my Lord. And then Allah will guide me to such praises and glorification to Him as He has never guided anybody else before me. Then it will be said, 'O Muhammad Raise your head. Ask, and it will be granted. Intercede and It (your intercession) will be accepted.' So I will raise my head and Say, 'My followers, O my Lord! My followers, O my Lord'. It will be said, 'O Muhammad! Let those of your followers who have no accounts, enter through such a gate of the gates of Paradise as lies on the right; and they will share the other gates with the people." The Prophet (ﷺ) further said, "By Him in Whose Hand my soul is, the distance between every two gate-posts of Paradise is like the distance between Mecca and Busra (in Sham)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas kuch (pakaaya hua) gosht laaya gaya, aur unhein bazoo (foreleg) ka gosht diya gaya jise wo pasand karte the. Unhone uska ek luqma khaaya aur farmaya, 'Main Qayamat ke din tamaam logon ka sardaar hounga. Kya tumhein pata hai iski wajah kya hai? Allah pehli aur baad ki tamaam nasal ke insaanon ko ek maidaan mein jama karega, taake pukaarne wala apni aawaaz sabko sunaa sake aur dekhne wala sabko dekh sake. Suraj logon ke itna qareeb aa jaayega ke unhein aisi takleef aur pareshaani hogi jise wo bardaasht nahi kar paayenge. Log kahenge, "Kya tum nahi dekhte tumhaari kya haalat ho gayi hai? Kya tum kisi aise ko nahi dhoondhte jo tumhaare Rab ke saamne tumhaari shifaarish kare?" Kuch log doosron se kahenge, "Adam ke paas jao." To wo Adam ke paas jaayenge aur kahenge, "Aap insaaniyat ke waalid hain; Allah ne aapko apne haathon se banaaya, aur aapme apni Rooh phoonki (yaani wo Rooh jo usne khaas aapke liye banaayi), aur farishton ko aapke saamne sajda karne ka hukm diya; (Meharbaani karke) hamare liye apne Rab ke saamne shifaarish kijiye. Kya aap nahi dekhte hum kis haal mein hain?" Adam kahenge, "Aaj mera Rab itna naaraaz hai jitna wo pehle kabhi nahi hua aur baad mein bhi kabhi nahi hoga. Usne mujhe (us) darakht (ka phal khaane) se mana kiya tha, magar maine uski na-farmaani ki. Mujhe apni pade hai! Mujhe apni pade hai! Mujhe apni pade hai! Kisi aur ke paas jao; Nooh ke paas jao." To wo Nooh ke paas jaayenge aur kahenge, "Aye Nooh! Aap zameen walon ke liye (Allah ke Rasoolon mein se) sabse pehle hain, aur Allah ne aapko shukr-guzaar banda kaha hai; humare liye apne Rab ke saamne shifaarish kijiye. Kya aap nahi dekhte hum kis haal mein hain?" Wo kahenge, "Aaj mera Rab itna naaraaz hai jitna wo pehle kabhi nahi hua aur baad mein bhi kabhi nahi hoga. Mujhe (duniya mein) ek dua qubool hone ka haq mila tha, aur maine wo apni qaum ke khilaaf istemaal kar li thi. Mujhe apni pade hai! Mujhe apni pade hai! Kisi aur ke paas jao; Ibrahim ke paas jao." Wo Ibrahim ke paas jaayenge aur kahenge, "Aye Ibrahim! Aap Allah ke Rasool aur zameen walon mein uske Khalil hain; hamare liye apne Rab ke saamne shifaarish kijiye. Kya aap nahi dekhte hum kis haal mein hain?" Wo unse kahenge, "Mera Rab aaj itna naaraaz hai jitna wo pehle kabhi nahi hua aur baad mein bhi kabhi nahi hoga. Maine teen jhoot bole the (Abu Haiyan, is hadees ke ravi, ne unka zikr kiya hai). Mujhe apni pade hai! Mujhe apni pade hai! Kisi aur ke paas jao; Musa ke paas jao." Log phir Musa ke paas jaayenge aur kahenge, "Aye Musa! Aap Allah ke Rasool hain, aur Allah ne aapko apni risaalat aur apne khud kalaam karne se doosron par fazilat di; hamare liye apne Rab ke saamne shifaarish kijiye. Kya aap nahi dekhte hum kis haal mein hain?" Musa kahenge, "Mera Rab aaj itna naaraaz hai jitna wo pehle kabhi nahi hua aur baad mein bhi kabhi nahi hoga. Maine ek shaks ko qatl kiya tha jise qatl karne ka mujhe hukm nahi tha. Mujhe apni pade hai! Mujhe apni pade hai! Kisi aur ke paas jao; Isa ke paas jao." To wo Isa ke paas jaayenge aur kahenge, "Aye Isa! Aap Allah ke Rasool hain aur uska Kalima jo usne Maryam ki taraf bheja, aur uski taraf se ek azeem rooh, aur aapne godh mein hote hue hi logon se baat ki thi. Hamare liye apne Rab ke saamne shifaarish kijiye. Kya aap nahi dekhte hum kis haal mein hain?" Isa kahenge, "Mera Rab aaj itna naaraaz hai jitna wo pehle kabhi nahi hua aur baad mein bhi kabhi nahi hoga." Isa kisi gunaah ka zikr nahi karenge, balke kahenge, "Mujhe apni pade hai! Mujhe apni pade hai! Kisi aur ke paas jao; Muhammad ke paas jao." To wo log mere paas aayenge aur kahenge, "Aye Muhammad! Aap Allah ke Rasool aur aakhri Nabi hain, aur Allah ne aapke agle-pichhle sab gunaah maaf kar diye. Hamare liye apne Rab ke saamne shifaarish kijiye. Kya aap nahi dekhte hum kis haal mein hain?"' Nabi (SAW) ne aage kaha, 'Phir main Arsh ke neeche jaaunga aur apne Rab ke saamne sajde mein gir jaaunga. Phir Allah mujhe aisi tareef aur azmat bayaan karne ki taufeeq dega jo usne mujhse pehle kisi ko nahi di. Phir kaha jaayega, "Aye Muhammad! Apna sar uthao. Maango, tumhein diya jaayega. Shifaarish karo, tumhaari shifaarish qubool ki jaayegi." To main apna sar uthaunga aur kahunga, "Mere maanne wale, Aye mere Rab! Mere maanne wale, Aye mere Rab!" Kaha jaayega, "Aye Muhammad! Tumhaare maanne walon mein se jinka koi hisaab nahi hoga, unhein Jannat ke us darwaaze se daakhil hone do jo daayin taraf hai; aur wo baaki darwaazon mein bhi doosre logon ke saath saanjha karenge."' Nabi (SAW) ne aage farmaya, 'Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, Jannat ke har do darwaazon ke beech ka faasla Makkah aur Busra (Sham mein) ke beech ke faasle jitna hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The recitation of Psalms (David's Qur'an) was made light and easy for David that he used to have his ridding animal be saddled while he would finish the recitation before the servant had saddled it
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Dawood (Alaihissalam) ke liye Zuboor (unka Quran) padhna itna aasan kar diya gaya tha ke wo apni sawaari par zeen kasne ka hukm dete aur naukar ke zeen kasne se pehle hi wo (poori Zuboor) padh chuke hote.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:Regarding the explanation of the Verse: 'Those whom they call upon (worship) (like Jesus the Son of Mary, angels etc.) desire (for themselves) means of access to their Lord (Allah) as to which of them should be the nearer and they hope for His Mercy and fear His torment.' (17.57) They themselves (e.g. Angels, saints, Apostles, Jesus, etc.,) worshipped Allah, Those Jinns who were worshipped by some Arabs became Muslims (embraced Islam), but those human beings stuck to their (old) religion. Al- A`mash said extra: 'Say, (O Muhammad): Call unto those besides Him whom you assume (to be gods)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) is Aayat ki tafseer mein bataate hain: 'Jinhe wo pukaarte (parastish karte) hain (jaise Isa ibn Maryam, farishte waghera), wo khud apne Rab ke qareeb hone ka zariya dhoondhte hain ke unmein se kaun zyaada qareeb ho, aur wo uski rehmat ki ummeed rakhte hain aur uske azaab se darte hain.' (17:57) Ye log khud (yaani farishte, waliullah, Rasool, Isa waghera) Allah ki ibaadat karte the. Jin Jinnaat ki kuch Arab log ibaadat karte the, wo khud Musalmaan ho gaye, magar jo insaan the wo apne (purane) mazhab par qaayam rahe. Al-A'mash ne izaafi baat kahi: 'Kaho (Aye Muhammad): Unhein bulaao jinhe tum uske siwa (khuda) samajhte ho.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:Regarding the Verse: 'Those whom they call upon (worship) (like Jesus the Son of Mary or angels etc.) desire (for themselves) means of access, to their Lord....' (17.57) (It was revealed regarding) some Jinns who used to be worshipped (by human beings). They later embraced Islam (while those people kept on worshipping them)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) is Aayat ke baare mein bataate hain: 'Jinhe wo pukaarte (parastish karte) hain, wo khud apne Rab ke qareeb hone ka zariya dhoondhte hain...' (17:57) - ye kuch Jinnaat ke baare mein naazil hui jinki insaan ibaadat kiya karte the. Baad mein wo Jinnaat khud Musalmaan ho gaye (jabke wo insaan unki ibaadat karte rahe).

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Regarding: 'And We granted the vision (Ascension to the Heaven "Miraj") which We showed you (O Muhammad as an actual eye witness) but as a trial for mankind.' (17.60) It was an actual eyewitness which was shown to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) during the night he was taken on a journey (through the heavens). And the cursed tree is the tree of Az-Zaqqum (a bitter pungent tree which grows at the bottom of Hell)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) is Aayat ke baare mein bataate hain: 'Aur Humne wo darshan (Miraj) jo Humne aapko dikhaya, sirf logon ke liye ek aazmaaish banaaya...' (17:60) - ye ek haqeeqi aankhon-dekha nazaara tha jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko us raat dikhaaya gaya jab unhein (aasmaanon ki) safar par le jaaya gaya. Aur us la'anati darakht se muraad Zaqqoom ka darakht hai (ek kadwa aur teekhaa darakht jo Jahannam ki tah mein ugta hai).

e: Narrated Ibn Al-Musaiyab:Abu Huraira said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'A prayer performed in congregation is twenty-five times more superior in reward to a prayer performed by a single person. The angels of the night and the angels of the day are assembled at the time of the Fajr (Morning) prayer." Abu Huraira added, "If you wish, you can recite:-- 'Verily! The recitation of the Qur'an in the early dawn (Morning prayer) is ever witnessed (attended by the angels of the day and the night)
hi: Ibn Al-Musaiyab bataate hain ke Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jamaat mein padhi gayi namaz akele padhi gayi namaz se pachees guna zyaada sawaab rakhti hai. Raat ke farishte aur din ke farishte Fajr ki namaz ke waqt jama hote hain.' Abu Huraira ne aage kaha, 'Chaho to padho: "Beshak Fajr ke Quran (yaani Fajr ki namaz) ki tilawat ki hamesha gawaahi di jaati hai (raat aur din ke farishton dwara)."'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:On the Day of Resurrection the people will fall on their knees and every nation will follow their prophet and they will say, "O so-and-so! Intercede (for us with Allah), "till (the right) intercession is given to the Prophet (Muhammad) and that will be the day when Allah will raise him into a station of praise and glory (i.e. Al-Maqam -al-Mahmud)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Qayamat ke din log ghutno ke bal gir jaayenge aur har ummat apne Nabi ki pairvi karegi, aur wo kahenge, 'Aye falaan! Hamari (Allah ke saamne) shifaarish karo,' yahaan tak ke (asli) shifaarish ka haq Nabi Muhammad (SAW) ko de diya jaayega, aur yahi wo din hoga jab Allah unhe Maqam-e-Mahmood (taareef aur azmat ke maqaam) par uthaayega.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever, after listening to the Adhan (for the prayer) says, 'O Allah, the Lord of this complete call and of this prayer, which is going to be established! Give Muhammad Al-Wasila and Al-Fadila and raise him to Al-Maqam-al-Mahmud which You have promised him,' will be granted my intercession for him on the Day of Resurrection
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo shaks Azaan sunne ke baad kahe, "Aye Allah, is mukammal pukaar aur is qaayam hone waali namaz ke Rab! Muhammad ko Wasila aur Fazeelat ata farma, aur unhein Maqam-e-Mahmood par pahuncha jiska Tu ne unse waada kiya hai," to Qayamat ke din uske liye meri shifaarish zaroor honi hai.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Masud:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered Mecca (in the year of the Conquest) and there were three-hundred and sixty idols around the Ka`ba. He then started hitting them with a stick in his hand and say: 'Truth (i.e. Islam) has come and falsehood (disbelief) vanished. Truly falsehood (disbelief) is ever bound to vanish.' (17.81) 'Truth has come and falsehood (Iblis) can not create anything
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Masud bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Makkah mein daakhil hue (Fatah-e-Makkah ke saal) aur Kaaba ke gird teen sau saath (360) but the. Wo apne haath ki chhadi se unhein maarne lage aur kehte gaye, 'Haq (yaani Islam) aa gaya aur baatil (kufr) mit gaya. Beshak baatil mitne ke liye hi hota hai.' (17:81) 'Haq aa gaya aur baatil (Iblis) kuch bhi naya paida nahi kar sakta.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:While I was in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) on a farm and he was reclining on a palm leaf stalk, some Jews passed by. Some of them said to the others. "Ask him (the Prophet (ﷺ) about the spirit." Some of them said, "What urges you to ask him about it" Others said, "(Don't) lest he should give you a reply which you dislike." But they said, "Ask him." So they asked him about the Spirit. The Prophet (ﷺ) kept quiet and did not give them any answer. I knew that he was being divinely inspired so I stayed at my place. When the divine inspiration had been revealed, the Prophet (ﷺ) said. "They ask you (O, Muhammad) concerning the Spirit, Say: "The spirit," its knowledge is with my Lord; and of knowledge you (mankind) have been given only a Little
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Nabi (SAW) ke saath ek khet mein tha aur wo khajoor ke patte ki daali par tek lagaaye hue the, ke kuch Yahudi wahaan se guzre. Unmein se kuch ne doosron se kaha, 'Inse Rooh ke baare mein pucho.' Kuch ne kaha, 'Tumhein isse poochne ki kya zaroorat hai?' Doosron ne kaha, '(Mat poocho) kahin wo tumhein aisa jawab na de jo tumhein pasand na aaye.' Magar unhone kaha, 'Inse pucho.' To unhone Nabi (SAW) se Rooh ke baare mein pucha. Nabi (SAW) khaamosh rahe aur unhein koi jawab nahi diya. Mujhe pata chal gaya ke unpar wahi naazil ho rahi hai, isliye main apni jagah par khada raha. Jab wahi naazil ho chuki, to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Wo aapse Rooh ke baare mein poochte hain. Kaho: "Rooh mere Rab ka maamla hai, aur tumhein (insaano ko) bahut kam ilm diya gaya hai."'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:(regarding): 'Neither say your, prayer aloud, nor say it in a low tone.' (17.110) This Verse was revealed while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was hiding himself in Mecca. When he prayed with his companions, he used to raise his voice with the recitation of Qur'an, and if the pagans happened to hear him, they would abuse the Qur'an, the One who revealed it and the one who brought it. Therefore Allah said to His Prophet : 'Neither say your prayer aloud.' (17.110) i.e. do not recite aloud lest the pagans should hear you, but follow a way between
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) is Aayat ke baare mein bataate hain: 'Na apni namaz buland aawaaz mein padho, na bilkul dabi aawaaz mein...' (17:110) - ye Aayat us waqt naazil hui jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Makkah mein chhup kar (namaz padhte) the. Jab wo apne sahaaba ke saath namaz padhte, to Quran ki tilawat buland aawaaz mein karte, aur agar mushrikeen unhein sun lete, to wo Quran ko, use naazil karne wale ko, aur use laane wale ko bura-bhala kehte. Isliye Allah ne apne Nabi se farmaya: 'Na apni namaz buland aawaaz mein padho' (17:110) - yaani itni buland aawaaz mein tilawat mat karo ke mushrikeen sun lein, balke in dono ke beech ka rasta ikhtiyaar karo.

e: Narrated Aisha:The (above) verse was revealed in connection with the invocations
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ye (upar wali) Aayat duaon ke silsile mein naazil hui thi.

e: Narrated `Ali:That one night Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to him and Fatima and said, "Don't you (both offer the (Tahajjud) prayer?" `Ali said, 'When Allah wishes us to get up, we get up." The Prophet (ﷺ) then recited: 'But man is more quarrelsome than anything.' (18.54) (See Hadith No. 227,Vol)
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Ek raat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unke aur Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ke paas aaye aur pucha, 'Kya tum dono Tahajjud ki namaz nahi padhte?' Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha, 'Jab Allah chaahega ke hum uthein, hum uth jaayenge.' Isper Nabi (SAW) ne ye Aayat padhi: 'Aur insaan sabse zyaada jhagdaalu hai.' (18:54)

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:I said to Ibn `Abbas, "Nauf Al-Bikali claims that Moses, the companion of Al-Khadir was not the Moses of the children of Israel" Ibn `Abbas said, "The enemy of Allah (Nauf) told a lie." Narrated Ubai bin Ka`b that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "Moses got up to deliver a speech before the children of Israel and he was asked, Who is the most learned person among the people?' Moses replied, 'I (am the most learned).' Allah admonished him for he did not ascribe knowledge to Allah alone. So Allah revealed to him: 'At the junction of the two seas there is a slave of Ours who is more learned than you.' Moses asked, 'O my Lord, how can I meet him?' Allah said, 'Take a fish and put it in a basket (and set out), and where you, will lose the fish, you will find him.' So Moses (took a fish and put it in a basket and) set out, along with his boy-servant Yusha` bin Noon, till they reached a rock (on which) they both lay their heads and slept. The fish moved vigorously in the basket and got out of it and fell into the sea and there it took its way through the sea (straight) as in a tunnel). (18.61) Allah stopped the current of water on both sides of the way created by the fish, and so that way was like a tunnel. When Moses got up, his companion forgot to tell him about the fish, and so they carried on their journey during the rest of the day and the whole night. The next morning Moses asked his boy-servant 'Bring us our early meal; no doubt, we have suffered much fatigue in this journey of ours.' (18.62) Moses did not get tired till he had passed the place which Allah had ordered him to seek after. His boy-servant then said to him,' 'Do you remember when we be-took ourselves to the rock I indeed forgot the fish, none but Satan made me forget to remember it. It took its course into the sea in a marvelous way.' (18.63) There was a tunnel for the fish and for Moses and his boy-servant there was astonishment. Moses said, 'That is what we have been seeking'. So they went back retracing their footsteps. (18.64) They both returned, retracing their steps till they reached the rock. Behold ! There they found a man covered with a garment. Moses greeted him. Al-Khadir said astonishingly, 'Is there such a greeting in your land?' Moses said, 'I am Moses.' He said, 'Are you the Moses of the children of Israel?' Moses said, 'I have come to you so that you may teach me of what you have been taught. Al-Khadir said, 'You will not be able to have patience with me. (18.66) O Moses! I have some of Allah's knowledge which He has bestowed upon me but you do not know it; and you too, have some of Allah's knowledge which He has bestowed upon you, but I do not know it." Moses said, "Allah willing, you will find me patient, and I will not disobey you in anything.' (18.6) Al-Khadir said to him, 'If you then follow me, do not ask me about anything until I myself speak to you concerning it.' (18.70), After that both of them proceeded along the sea coast, till a boat passed by and they requested the crew to let them go on board. The crew recognized Al-Khadir and allowed them to get on board free of charge. When they got on board suddenly Moses saw that Al-Khadir had pulled out one of the planks of the boat with an adze. Moses said to him.' These people gave us a free lift, yet you have scuttled their boat so as to drown its people! Truly, you have done a dreadful thing.' (18.71) Al-Khadir said, 'Didn't I say that you can have no patience with me ?' (18.72) Moses said, 'Call me not to account for what I forgot and be not hard upon me for my affair (with you.)" (18.73) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The first excuse given by Moses, was that he had forgotten. Then a sparrow came and sat over the edge of the boat and dipped its beak once in the sea. Al-Khadir said to Moses, 'My knowledge and your knowledge, compared to Allah's knowledge is like what this sparrow has taken out of the sea.' Then they both got out of the boat, and while they were walking on the sea shore, Al-Khadir saw a boy playing with other boys. Al-Khadir got hold of the head of that boy and pulled it out with his hands and killed him. Moses said, 'Have you killed an innocent soul who has killed nobody! Truly, you have done an illegal thing.' (18.74) He said, "Didn't I tell you that you can have no patience with me?' (18.75) (The sub narrator said, the second blame was stronger than the first one.) Moses said, 'If I ask you about anything after this, keep me not in your company, you have received an excuse from me.' (18.76) Then they both proceeded until they came to the inhabitants of a town. They asked them for food but they refused to entertain them. (In that town) they found there a wall on the point of falling down. (18.77) Al-Khadir set it up straight with his own hands. Moses said, 'These are people to whom we came, but they neither fed us nor received us as guests. If you had wished, you could surely have exacted some recompense for it. Al-Khadir said, 'This is the parting between me and you ..that is the interpretation of (those things) over which you were unable to hold patience.' (18.78-82) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "We wished that Moses could have been more patient so that Allah might have described to us more about their story
hi: Saeed bin Jubair bataate hain: Maine Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kaha, 'Nauf Al-Bikali ka dava hai ke Khidr ke saathi Musa, Bani Israel wale Musa nahi the.' Ibn Abbas ne kaha, 'Allah ke dushman (Nauf) ne jhoot bola.' Ubai bin Ka'b (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: 'Musa Bani Israel ke saamne khutba dene khade hue, to unse pucha gaya, "Sabse zyaada ilm rakhne wala kaun hai?" Musa ne jawab diya, "Main (sabse zyaada ilm rakhta hoon)." Allah ne unhe iski wajah se tanbeeh ki, kyunke unhone ilm ko sirf Allah ki taraf mansoob nahi kiya. To Allah ne unhe wahi ki: "Do samundaron ke sangam par Hamaara ek banda hai jo tumse zyaada ilm rakhta hai." Musa ne pucha, "Aye mere Rab! Main unse kaise mil sakta hoon?" Allah ne farmaya, "Ek machhli lo aur use ek tokri mein rakho, aur jahaan machhli kho jaaye, wahin tumhein wo milenge." To Musa (machhli tokri mein rakh kar) apne khidmatgaar Yusha bin Noon ke saath nikle, yahaan tak ke wo ek chattaan tak pahunche jahaan dono ne sar rakh kar (aaraam kiya aur) so gaye. Machhli tokri mein tadapi aur usse nikal kar samundar mein gir gayi aur samundar mein ek surang jaisa raasta bana kar chali gayi.' (18:61) Allah ne machhli ke bane raaste ke dono taraf paani ka behna rok diya, isliye wo raasta ek surang jaisa ban gaya. Jab Musa uthe, to unke saathi ko machhli ke baare mein batana yaad nahi raha, isliye wo poora din aur poori raat safar karte rahe. Agli subah Musa ne apne khidmatgaar se kaha, 'Hamara subah ka khaana le aao; humein is safar mein kaafi thakaan ho gayi hai.' (18:62) Musa ko thakaan nahi hui thi jab tak wo us jagah se aage nahi nikal gaye the jahaan Allah ne unhein dhoondhne ka hukm diya tha. Unke khidmatgaar ne unse kaha, 'Kya aapko yaad hai jab hum chattaan ke paas the? Main waaqai machhli (batana) bhool gaya, aur Shaitaan ke siwa kisi ne mujhe bhulaaya nahi. Wo ajeeb tareeke se samundar mein apna raasta bana kar chali gayi.' (18:63) Machhli ke liye ek surang thi, aur Musa aur unke khidmatgaar ke liye ye hairaani ki baat thi. Musa ne kaha, 'Yahi to hum dhoondh rahe the.' To wo apne qadmon ke nishaan dekhte hue wapas laut gaye (18:64) yahaan tak ke wo chattaan tak pahunche. Wahaan unhein ek shaks mila jo ek chaadar odhe hue tha. Musa ne unhe salaam kiya. Khidr ne hairaan hokar kaha, 'Kya tumhaare mulk mein aisa salaam hota hai?' Musa ne kaha, 'Main Musa hoon.' Unhone pucha, 'Bani Israel wale Musa?' Musa ne kaha, 'Main aapke paas isliye aaya hoon ke aap mujhe wo sikhaayein jo aapko sikhaaya gaya hai.' Khidr ne kaha, 'Tum mere saath sabar nahi kar paaoge.' (18:66) 'Aye Musa! Mere paas Allah ke ilm ka wo hissa hai jo usne mujhe diya hai magar tumhein nahi pata, aur tumhaare paas Allah ke ilm ka wo hissa hai jo usne tumhein diya hai magar mujhe nahi pata.' Musa ne kaha, 'Allah ne chaaha to aap mujhe sabar karne wala paayenge, aur main kisi baat mein aapki na-farmaani nahi karunga.' (18:69) Khidr ne unse kaha, 'Agar tum mere saath chalte ho, to jab tak main khud tumhein kisi baat ke baare mein na bataun, mujhse kuch mat poochna.' (18:70) Iske baad dono samundar ke kinaare chalte rahe, yahaan tak ke ek kashti guzri aur unhone unse iltimaas ki ke unhein sawaar kar lein. Kashti waalon ne Khidr ko pehchaan liya aur unhein bagair kiraaye ke sawaar kar liya. Jab wo sawaar hue, achaanak Musa ne dekha ke Khidr ne kashti ka ek takhta apne aar (basoola) se ukhaad diya. Musa ne unse kaha, 'In logon ne humein bagair kiraaye ke sawaar kiya, aur aapne unki kashti mein chhed kar diya taake unke logon ko dubo dein! Aapne to bahut hi buri baat ki hai.' (18:71) Khidr ne kaha, 'Kya maine nahi kaha tha ke tum mere saath sabar nahi kar paaoge?' (18:72) Musa ne kaha, 'Mujhe mere bhool jaane par mat pakdo, aur mere maamle mein mujhpar sakhti mat karo.' (18:73) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Musa ne pehli baar bhool jaane ka bahaana pesh kiya.' Phir ek chidiya aayi aur kashti ke kinaare baith gayi aur apni chonch ek baar samundar mein daali. Khidr ne Musa se kaha, 'Mera aur tumhaara ilm, Allah ke ilm ke muqaable mein, utna hi hai jitna is chidiya ne apni chonch se samundar se nikaala.' Phir dono kashti se utre, aur jab wo samundar ke kinaare chal rahe the, Khidr ne kuch doosre bachchon ke saath khel rahe ek ladke ko dekha. Khidr ne uska sar apne haathon se pakad kar ukhaad diya aur use qatl kar diya. Musa ne kaha, 'Kya aapne ek be-gunaah jaan ko, jisne kisi ko qatl nahi kiya, maar diya! Waaqai aapne ek bahut bura kaam kiya.' (18:74) Khidr ne kaha, 'Kya maine nahi kaha tha ke tum mere saath sabar nahi kar paaoge?' (18:75) (Ravi kehte hain, ye doosri malaamat pehli se zyaada sakht thi.) Musa ne kaha, 'Agar iske baad main aapse kisi baat ke baare mein poochun, to mujhe apne saath mat rakhna, ab tumhaare paas mujhse (koi aur) mazrat nahi.' (18:76) Phir dono chalte rahe yahaan tak ke wo ek basti ke logon ke paas pahunche. Unhone khaana maanga magar unhone unki mehmaan-nawaazi se inkaar kar diya. (Us basti mein) unhein ek deewaar mili jo girne hi wali thi. (18:77) Khidr ne apne haathon se use seedha kar diya. Musa ne kaha, 'Ye wo log hain jinke paas hum aaye, na to unhone humein khaana khilaaya na hi mehmaan banaaya. Agar aap chahte to iske badle koi ujrat le sakte the.' Khidr ne kaha, 'Ye mere aur tumhaare beech judaai hai... yahi un cheezon ki tafseer hai jinpar tum sabar na kar sake.' (18:78-82) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Humari khwaish thi ke Musa aur zyaada sabar karte, taake Allah humein unke kisse ke baare mein aur bataata.'

e: Narrated Ibn Juraij:Ya`la bin Muslim and `Amr bin Dinar and some others narrated the narration of Sa`id bin Jubair. Narrated Sa`id: While we were at the house of Ibn `Abbas, Ibn `Abbas said, "Ask me (any question)" I said, "O Abu `Abbas! May Allah let me be sacrificed for you ! There is a man at Kufa who is a storyteller called Nauf; who claims that he (Al-Khadir's companion) is not Moses of Bani Israel." As for `Amr, he said to me, "Ibn `Abbas said, "(Nauf) the enemy of Allah told a lie." But Ya`la said to me, "Ibn `Abbas said, Ubai bin Ka`b said, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Once Moses, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), preached to the people till their eyes shed tears and their hearts became tender, whereupon he finished his sermon. Then a man came to Moses and asked, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Is there anyone on the earth who is more learned than you?' Moses replied, 'No.' So Allah admonished him (Moses), for he did not ascribe all knowledge to Allah. It was said, (on behalf of Allah), 'Yes, (there is a slave of ours who knows more than you ).' Moses said, 'O my Lord! Where is he?' Allah said, 'At the junction of the two seas.' Moses said, 'O my Lord! Tell me of a sign whereby I will recognize the place.' " `Amr said to me, Allah said, "That place will be where the fish will leave you." Ya`la said to me, "Allah said (to Moses), 'Take a dead fish (and your goal will be) the place where it will become alive.' " So Moses took a fish and put it in a basket and said to his boy-servant "I don't want to trouble you, except that you should inform me as soon as this fish leaves you." He said (to Moses)." You have not demanded too much." And that is as mentioned by Allah: 'And (remember) when Moses said to his attendant .... ' (18.60) Yusha` bin Noon. (Sa`id did not state that). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "While the attendant was in the shade of the rock at a wet place, the fish slipped out (alive) while Moses was sleeping. His attendant said (to himself), "I will not wake him," but when he woke up, he forgot to tell him the fish slipped out and entered the sea. Allah stopped the flow of the sea where the fish was, so that its trace looked as if it was made on a rock. `Amr forming a hole with his two thumbs and index fingers, said to me, "Like this, as in its trace was made on a rock." Moses said "We have suffered much fatigue on this journey of ours." (This was not narrated by Sa`id). Then they returned back and found Al-Khadir. `Uthman bin Abi Sulaiman said to me, (they found him) on a green carpet in the middle of the sea. Al-Khadir was covered with his garment with one end under his feet and the other end under his head. When Moses greeted, he uncovered his face and said astonishingly, 'Is there such a greeting in my land? Who are you?' Moses said, 'I am Moses.' Al- Khadir said, 'Are you the Moses of Bani Israel?' Moses said, 'Yes.' Al-Khadir said, "What do you want?' Moses said, ' I came to you so that you may teach me of the truth which you were taught.' Al- Khadir said, 'Is it not sufficient for you that the Torah is in your hands and the Divine Inspiration comes to you, O Moses? Verily, I have a knowledge that you ought not learn, and you have a knowledge which I ought not learn.' At that time a bird took with its beak (some water) from the sea: Al-Khadir then said, 'By Allah, my knowledge and your knowledge besides Allah's Knowledge is like what this bird has taken with its beak from the sea.' Until, when they went on board the boat (18.71). They found a small boat which used to carry the people from this sea-side to the other sea-side. The crew recognized Al-Khadir and said, 'The pious slave of Allah.' (We said to Sa`id "Was that Khadir?" He said, "Yes.") The boat men said, 'We will not get him on board with fare.' Al-Khadir scuttled the boat and then plugged the hole with a piece of wood. Moses said, 'Have you scuttled it in order to drown these people? Surely, you have done a dreadful thing. (18.71) (Mujahid said. "Moses said so protestingly.") Al-Khadir said, didn't I say that you can have no patience with me?' (18.72) The first inquiry of Moses was done because of forgetfulness, the second caused him to be bound with a stipulation, and the third was done intentionally. Moses said, 'Call me not to account for what I forgot and be not hard upon me for my affair (with you).' (18.73) (Then) they found a boy and Al-Khadir killed him. Ya`la- said: Sa`id said 'They found boys playing and Al-Khadir got hold of a handsome infidel boy laid him down and then slew him with knife. Moses said, 'Have you killed a innocent soul who has killed nobody' (18.74) Then they proceeded and found a wall which was on the point of falling down, and Al-Khadir set it up straight. Sa`id moved his hand thus and said 'Al-Khadir raised his hand and the wall became straight. Ya`la said, 'I think Sa`id said, 'Al-Khadir touched the wall with his hand and it became straight (Moses said to Al-Khadir), 'If you had wished, you could have taken wages for it.' Sa`id said, 'Wages that we might had eaten.' And there was a king in furor (ahead) of them" (18.79) And there was in front of them. Ibn `Abbas recited: 'In front of them (was) a king.' It is said on the authority of somebody other than Sa`id that the king was Hudad bin Budad. They say that the boy was called Jaisur. 'A king who seized every ship by force. (18.79) So I wished that if that boat passed by him, he would leave it because of its defect and when they have passed they would repair it and get benefit from it. Some people said that they closed that hole with a bottle, and some said with tar. 'His parents were believers, and he (the boy) was a non-believer and we (Khadir) feared lest he would oppress them by obstinate rebellion and disbelief.' (18.80) (i.e. that their love for him would urge them to follow him in his religion, 'so we (Khadir) desired that their Lord should change him for them for one better in righteousness and near to mercy' (18:81). This was in reply to Moses' saying: Have you killed an innocent soul.'? (18.74). 'Near to mercy" means they will be more merciful to him than they were to the former whom Khadir had killed. Other than Sa`id, said that they were compensated with a girl. Dawud bin Abi `Asim said on the authority of more than one that this next child was a girl
hi: Ibn Juraij bataate hain: Ya'la bin Muslim, Amr bin Dinar aur kuch aur logon ne Saeed bin Jubair ki riwayat bayaan ki. Saeed bataate hain: Hum Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke ghar par the, Ibn Abbas ne kaha, 'Mujhse (koi bhi sawaal) pucho.' Maine kaha, 'Aye Abu Abbas! Allah mujhe aap par qurbaan kare! Kufa mein ek shaks hai jo qissa-goi karta hai, uska naam Nauf hai, jo dava karta hai ke wo (Khidr ke saathi) Bani Israel wale Musa nahi the.' Amr ke mutaabik, Ibn Abbas ne kaha, 'Us (Nauf), Allah ke dushman, ne jhoot bola.' Magar Ya'la ke mutaabik, Ibn Abbas ne bataaya ke Ubai bin Ka'b (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Ek baar Musa (Allah ke Rasool) ne logon ko itna zabardast khutba diya ke unki aankhon se aansu behne lage aur unke dil naram pad gaye, phir unhone apna khutba khatam kiya. Isi waqt ek shaks Musa ke paas aaya aur pucha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya zameen par koi aisa hai jo aapse zyaada ilm rakhta ho?' Musa ne jawab diya, 'Nahi.' Isper Allah ne Musa ko tanbeeh ki, kyunke unhone sara ilm Allah ki taraf mansoob nahi kiya. (Allah ki taraf se) kaha gaya, 'Haan, (Hamaara ek banda hai jo tumse zyaada jaanta hai).' Musa ne kaha, 'Aye mere Rab! Wo kahaan hai?' Allah ne kaha, 'Do samundaron ke sangam par.' Musa ne kaha, 'Aye mere Rab! Mujhe koi nishaani bataao jisse main us jagah ko pehchaan sakoon.' Amr ke mutaabik Allah ne kaha, 'Wo jagah hogi jahaan machhli tumse alag ho jaayegi.' Ya'la ke mutaabik Allah ne (Musa se) kaha, 'Ek mari hui machhli le lo, (tumhaara nishaana ye hoga) jahaan wo (dobara) zinda ho jaaye.' To Musa ne machhli li aur tokri mein rakh li aur apne khidmatgaar se kaha, 'Main tumhein takleef nahi dena chahta, sirf itna ke jab ye machhli tumse alag ho jaaye to mujhe zaroor bataana.' Usne (Musa se) kaha, 'Aapne koi zyaada baat nahi maangi.' Aur yahi Allah ke is farmaan ka matlab hai: 'Aur (yaad karo) jab Musa ne apne khidmatgaar se kaha...' (18:60) - yani Yusha bin Noon (Saeed ne ye naam nahi liya). Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab khidmatgaar chattaan ke saaye mein, ek geeli jagah par tha, machhli chupke se (zinda hokar) nikal gayi jabke Musa so rahe the. Khidmatgaar ne (dil mein) socha, 'Main inhe nahi jagaunga,' magar jab wo jaage, to wo machhli ke samundar mein chale jaane ki baat bataana bhool gaya. Allah ne us jagah samundar ka behna rok diya jahaan machhli thi, isliye uska nishaan aisa lagta tha jaise chattaan mein bana ho. (Amr ne apne angoothon aur ungliyon se ek chhed banaakar dikhaaya, 'Aise, jaise chattaan mein bana ho.') Musa ne kaha, 'Humein is safar mein kaafi thakaan ho gayi hai.' (Ye Saeed ne bayaan nahi kiya.) Phir wo laut aaye aur Khidr ko paaya. Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Sulaiman ke mutaabik, unhone unhe samundar ke beech ek hare qaaleen par paaya. Khidr apni chaadar odhe hue the jiska ek sira unke pairon ke neeche aur doosra unke sar ke neeche tha. Jab Musa ne salaam kiya, to unhone apna chehra khola aur hairaan hokar kaha, 'Kya mere mulk mein aisa salaam hota hai? Tum kaun ho?' Musa ne kaha, 'Main Musa hoon.' Khidr ne pucha, 'Bani Israel wale Musa?' Musa ne kaha, 'Haan.' Khidr ne pucha, 'Tum kya chahte ho?' Musa ne kaha, 'Main aapke paas isliye aaya hoon ke aap mujhe wo haq (ilm) sikhaayein jo aapko sikhaaya gaya hai.' Khidr ne kaha, 'Kya ye tumhaare liye kaafi nahi ke Tauret tumhaare haath mein hai aur wahi tumhaare paas aati hai, Aye Musa? Mere paas ek aisa ilm hai jo tumhein seekhne ki zaroorat nahi, aur tumhaare paas aisa ilm hai jo mujhe seekhne ki zaroorat nahi.' Usi waqt ek chidiya ne apni chonch se samundar se (paani) liya. Khidr ne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, mera aur tumhaara ilm, Allah ke ilm ke saamne, utna hi hai jitna is chidiya ne apni chonch se samundar se liya.' Yahaan tak ke, jab wo kashti mein sawaar hue (18:71), unhein ek chhoti kashti mili jo logon ko samundar ke ek kinaare se doosre kinaare tak le jaati thi. Kashti waalon ne Khidr ko pehchaan liya aur kaha, 'Ye Allah ka neik banda hai.' (Humne Saeed se pucha, 'Kya wo Khidr the?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan.') Kashti waalon ne kaha, 'Hum inhe bagair kiraaye ke sawaar karenge.' Khidr ne kashti mein chhed kar diya aur phir use lakdi ke ek tukde se band kar diya. Musa ne kaha, 'Kya aapne inhe dubaane ke liye chhed kiya? Aapne to bahut bura kaam kiya.' (18:71) (Mujahid ke mutaabik Musa ne ye baat ehtejaaj karte hue kahi.) Khidr ne kaha, 'Kya maine nahi kaha tha ke tum mere saath sabar nahi kar paaoge?' (18:72) Musa ka pehla sawaal bhool jaane ki wajah se tha, doosre ne unhein ek shart se baandh diya, aur teesra jaan-boojh kar kiya gaya. Musa ne kaha, 'Mujhe mere bhool jaane par mat pakdo, aur mere maamle mein mujhpar sakhti mat karo.' (18:73) Phir unhein ek ladka mila aur Khidr ne use qatl kar diya. Ya'la ke mutaabik Saeed ne kaha ke unhein kuch ladke khelte mile aur Khidr ne ek khoobsurat kaafir ladke ko pakda, use letaya aur churi se zibah kar diya. Musa ne kaha, 'Kya aapne ek be-gunaah jaan ko qatl kiya jisne kisi ko qatl nahi kiya?' (18:74) Phir wo aage badhe aur ek deewaar paayi jo girne hi wali thi, aur Khidr ne use seedha kar diya. Saeed ne apna haath hilaakar dikhaaya ke Khidr ne apna haath uthaaya aur deewaar seedhi ho gayi. (Ya'la ke mutaabik shaayad Saeed ne kaha ke Khidr ne deewaar ko haath se chhua aur wo seedhi ho gayi.) (Musa ne Khidr se kaha,) 'Agar aap chahte to iske badle ujrat le sakte the.' Saeed ne kaha, 'Ujrat jo hum kha sakte.' Aur unke aage ek baadshaah tha (18:79). Ibn Abbas ne padha, 'Unke saamne ek baadshaah tha.' Saeed ke ilaava kisi aur ke mutaabik us baadshaah ka naam Hudaad bin Budaad tha, aur us ladke ka naam Jaisur tha. 'Ek baadshaah jo har (kaam ki) kashti zabardasti chheen leta tha' (18:79), isliye main (Khidr) chahta tha ke agar wo kashti uske paas se guzre, to wo isse iski kami (chhed) ki wajah se chhod de, aur jab wo aage nikal jaayein to wo ise theek karke istemaal kar sakein. Kuch logon ne kaha ke unhone wo chhed ek botal se band kiya, kuch ne kaha tar se. 'Uske waalidain momin the, aur wo (ladka) kaafir tha, aur humein (Khidr ko) dar tha ke kahin wo apni zid aur kufr se unhein pareshan na kare' (18:80) (yaani unka usse muhabbat unhe uske deen ki pairvi karne par majboor kar de), 'isliye humne (Khidr ne) chaaha ke unka Rab unhein iske badle koi behtar - nekokaar aur rehmat mein zyaada qareeb - ladka de' (18:81). Ye Musa ke is sawaal ka jawab tha, 'Kya aapne ek be-gunaah jaan ko qatl kiya?' (18:74) 'Rehmat mein zyaada qareeb' ka matlab hai ke wo naya bachcha unke saath us pehle bachche se zyaada meherbaan hoga jise Khidr ne qatl kiya tha. Saeed ke ilaava doosron ne kaha ke unhein badle mein ek ladki di gayi. Dawud bin Abi Aasim ne ek se zyaada logon ke hawaale se kaha ke agla bachcha ek ladki thi.

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:I said to Ibn `Abbas, "Nauf-al-Bakali " claims that Moses of Bani Israel was not Moses, the companion of Al-Khadir." Ibn `Abbas said, "Allah's enemy tells a lie! Ubai bin Ka`b narrated to us that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Moses got up to deliver a sermon before Bani Israel and he was asked, 'Who is the most learned person among the people?' Moses replied, 'I (am the most learned).' Allah then admonished Moses for he did not ascribe all knowledge to Allah only (Then) came the Divine Inspiration:-- 'Yes, one of Our slaves at the junction of the two seas is more learned than you.' Moses said, 'O my Lord ! How can I meet him?' Allah said, 'Take a fish in a basket and wherever the fish is lost, follow it (you will find him at that place). So Moses set out along with his attendant Yusha` bin Noon, and they carried with them a fish till they reached a rock and rested there. Moses put his head down and slept. (Sufyan, a sub-narrator said that somebody other than `Amr said) 'At the rock there was a water spring called 'Al-Hayat' and none came in touch with its water but became alive. So some of the water of that spring fell over that fish, so it moved and slipped out of the basket and entered the sea. When Moses woke up, he asked his attendant, 'Bring our early meal' (18.62). The narrator added: Moses did not suffer from fatigue except after he had passed the place he had been ordered to observe. His attendant Yusha` bin Noon said to him, 'Do you remember (what happened) when we betook ourselves to the rock? I did indeed forget (about) the fish ...' (18.63) The narrator added: So they came back, retracing their steps and then they found in the sea, the way of the fish looking like a tunnel. So there was an astonishing event for his attendant, and there was tunnel for the fish. When they reached the rock, they found a man covered with a garment. Moses greeted him. The man said astonishingly, 'Is there any such greeting in your land?' Moses said, 'I am Moses.' The man said, 'Moses of Bani Israel?' Moses said, 'Yes,' and added, 'may I follow you so that you teach me something of the Knowledge which you have been taught?' (18.66). Al-Khadir said to him, 'O Moses! You have something of Allah's knowledge which Allah has taught you and which I do not know; and I have something of Allah's knowledge which Allah has taught me and which you do not know.' Moses said, 'But I will follow you.' Al-Khadir said, 'Then if you follow me, ask me no question about anything until I myself speak to you concerning it.' (18.70). After that both of them proceeded along the seashore. There passed by them a boat whose crew recognized Al-Khadir and received them on board free of charge. So they both got on board. A sparrow came and sat on the edge of the boat and dipped its beak unto the sea. Al-Khadir said to Moses, 'My knowledge and your knowledge and all the creation's knowledge compared to Allah's knowledge is not more than the water taken by this sparrow's beak.' Then Moses was startled by Al-Khadir's action of taking an adze and scuttling the boat with it. Moses said to him, 'These people gave us a free lift, but you intentionally scuttled their boat so as to drown them. Surely you have...' (18.71) Then they both proceeded and found a boy playing with other boys. Al-Khadir took hold of him by the head and cut it off. Moses said to him, 'Have you killed an innocent soul who has killed nobody? Surely you have done an illegal thing! ' (18.74) He said, "Didn't I tell you that you will not be able to have patient with me up to ..but they refused to entertain them as their guests. There they found a wall therein at the point of collapsing.' (18.75-77) Al-Khadir moved his hand thus and set it upright (repaired it). Moses said to him, 'When we entered this town, they neither gave us hospitality nor fed us; if you had wished, you could have taken wages for it,' Al- Khadir said, 'This is the parting between you and me I will tell you the interpretation of (those things) about which you were unable to hold patience.'...(18.78) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'We wished that Moses could have been more patient so that He (Allah) could have described to us more about their story.' Ibn `Abbas used to recite:-- 'And in front (ahead) of them there was a king who used to seize every (serviceable) boat by force. (18.79) ...and as for the boy he was a disbeliever
hi: Saeed bin Jubair bataate hain: Maine Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kaha, 'Nauf-al-Bakali ka dava hai ke Bani Israel wale Musa, Khidr ke saathi Musa nahi the.' Ibn Abbas ne kaha, 'Allah ka dushman jhoot bolta hai! Ubai bin Ka'b (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne humein bataaya ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Musa Bani Israel ke saamne khutba dene khade hue, unse pucha gaya, "Sabse zyaada ilm rakhne wala kaun hai?" Musa ne jawab diya, "Main (sabse zyaada ilm rakhta hoon)." Isper Allah ne Musa ko tanbeeh ki, kyunke unhone sara ilm Allah ki taraf mansoob nahi kiya. (Phir) wahi aayi: "Haan, Hamaara ek banda hai do samundaron ke sangam par jo tumse zyaada ilm rakhta hai." Musa ne kaha, "Aye mere Rab! Main unse kaise mil sakta hoon?" Allah ne kaha, "Ek machhli tokri mein le lo, aur jahaan bhi machhli kho jaaye, uska peecha karo (tumhein wahin milenge)." To Musa apne khidmatgaar Yusha bin Noon ke saath, machhli lekar nikle, yahaan tak ke ek chattaan tak pahunche aur wahaan aaraam kiya. Musa ne apna sar rakha aur so gaye.' (Sufyan, is hadees ke ravi, kehte hain ke Amr ke ilaava kisi ne bataaya ke) 'Us chattaan par "Al-Hayat" naami ek chashma tha, aur jo bhi uske paani se chhoo jaata, wo zinda ho jaata. To us chashme ka kuch paani us machhli par gira, aur wo hilne lagi aur tokri se nikal kar samundar mein chali gayi. Jab Musa jaage, to unhone apne khidmatgaar se kaha, "Hamara subah ka khaana laao." (18:62) Ravi ne aage kaha: Musa ko thakaan nahi hui thi jab tak wo us jagah se aage nahi nikal gaye jahaan unhein rukne ka hukm tha. Unke khidmatgaar Yusha bin Noon ne unse kaha, "Kya aapko yaad hai jab hum chattaan ke paas the? Main waaqai machhli (batana) bhool gaya..." (18:63) Ravi ne aage kaha: To wo apne qadmon ke nishaan dhoondhte hue wapas laute aur samundar mein machhli ka raasta ek surang jaisa paaya. Ye unke khidmatgaar ke liye hairaani ki baat thi, aur machhli ke liye ek surang thi. Jab wo chattaan tak pahunche, unhein ek shaks mila jo chaadar odhe hue tha. Musa ne unhe salaam kiya. Us shaks ne hairaan hokar kaha, "Kya tumhaare mulk mein aisa salaam hota hai?" Musa ne kaha, "Main Musa hoon." Usne pucha, "Bani Israel wale Musa?" Musa ne kaha, "Haan," aur kaha, "Kya main aapke saath chal sakta hoon taake aap mujhe wo sikhaayein jo aapko sikhaaya gaya hai?" (18:66) Khidr ne unse kaha, "Aye Musa! Tumhaare paas Allah ka wo ilm hai jo usne tumhein sikhaaya hai aur jo main nahi jaanta; aur mere paas Allah ka wo ilm hai jo usne mujhe sikhaaya hai aur jo tum nahi jaante." Musa ne kaha, "Lekin main aapke saath chalunga." Khidr ne kaha, "Agar tum mere saath chalte ho, to mujhse kisi baat ke baare mein tab tak mat poochna jab tak main khud tumhein na bataun." (18:70) Iske baad dono samundar ke kinaare chalte rahe. Ek kashti unke paas se guzri jiske log Khidr ko pehchaante the aur unhein bagair kiraaye ke sawaar kar liya. To dono sawaar ho gaye. Ek chidiya aayi aur kashti ke kinaare baith gayi aur apni chonch samundar mein dubaayi. Khidr ne Musa se kaha, "Mera aur tumhaara aur saari makhlooq ka ilm, Allah ke ilm ke muqaable mein, is chidiya ki chonch se liye gaye paani se zyaada nahi." Phir Musa hairaan reh gaye jab Khidr ne ek basoola lekar kashti mein chhed kar diya. Musa ne unse kaha, "In logon ne humein bagair kiraaye sawaar kiya, magar aapne jaan-boojh kar unki kashti mein chhed kar diya taake unhein doobaa dein. Waaqai aapne..." (18:71) Phir dono aage badhe aur unhein kuch bachchon ke saath khel raha ek ladka mila. Khidr ne uska sar pakad kar kaat diya. Musa ne unse kaha, "Kya aapne ek be-gunaah jaan ko qatl kiya jisne kisi ko qatl nahi kiya? Waaqai aapne ek ghinaunaa kaam kiya!" (18:74) Unhone kaha, "Kya maine tumse nahi kaha tha ke tum mere saath sabar nahi kar paaoge..." yahaan tak ke ... "magar unhone unhein mehmaan banaane se inkaar kiya. Wahaan unhein ek deewaar mili jo girne hi waali thi." (18:75-77) Khidr ne apna haath is tarah hilaaya aur use seedha kar diya (theek kar diya). Musa ne unse kaha, "Jab hum is basti mein aaye, na unhone humaari mehmaan-nawaazi ki na khaana khilaaya; agar aap chahte to iske badle ujrat le sakte the." Khidr ne kaha, "Ye mere aur tumhaare beech judaai hai, main tumhein un cheezon ki tafseer bataunga jinpar tum sabar na kar sake..." (18:78) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, "Humaari khwaish thi ke Musa aur sabar karte, taake Allah humein unke kisse ke baare mein aur bataata."' Ibn Abbas padha karte the: 'Aur unke aage ek baadshaah tha jo har (kaam ki) kashti zabardasti chheen leta tha.' (18:79) ... aur wo ladka ek kaafir tha.

e: Narrated Mus`ab:I asked my father, "Was the Verse:-- 'Say: (O Muhammad) Shall We tell you the greatest losers in respect of their deeds?'(18.103) revealed regarding Al-Haruriyya?" He said, "No, but regarding the Jews and the Christians, for the Jews disbelieved Muhammad and the Christians disbelieved in Paradise and say that there are neither meals nor drinks therein. Al- Hururiyya are those people who break their pledge to Allah after they have confirmed that they will fulfill it, and Sa`d used to call them 'Al-Fasiqin (evildoers who forsake Allah's obedience)
hi: Mus'ab bataate hain: Maine apne waalid se pucha, 'Kya ye Aayat, "Kaho (Aye Muhammad): Kya hum tumhein bataayein ke apne amaal ke lihaaz se sabse bada nuqsaan uthaane wale kaun hain?" (18:103), Al-Haruriya (Khawaarij) ke baare mein naazil hui thi?' Unhone kaha, 'Nahi, balke ye Yahudiyon aur Isaaiyon ke baare mein hai, kyunke Yahudiyon ne Muhammad (SAW) ka inkaar kiya, aur Isaaiyon ne Jannat ka inkaar kiya aur kehte hain ke usme na khaana hai na peene ki cheez. Al-Haruriya wo log hain jo Allah se kiya hua apna ahad todte hain, us baat ki tasdeeq karne ke baad ke wo usse poora karenge, aur Sa'd inhein "Al-Fasiqeen" (Allah ki farmaabardaari chhodne wale gunaahgaar) kaha karte the.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "On the Day of Resurrection, a huge fat man will come who will not weigh, the weight of the wing of a mosquito in Allah's Sight." and then the Prophet (ﷺ) added, 'We shall not give them any weight on the Day of Resurrection
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Qayamat ke din ek mota-taaza aadmi laaya jaayega jiska wazan Allah ke nazdeek machhar ke par jitna bhi nahi hoga.' Phir Nabi (SAW) ne ye Aayat padhi, 'Hum Qayamat ke din unhein koi wazan (ehmiyat) nahi denge.'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "On the Day of Resurrection Death will be brought forward in the shape of a black and white ram. Then a call maker will call, 'O people of Paradise!' Thereupon they will stretch their necks and look carefully. The caller will say, 'Do you know this?' They will say, 'Yes, this is Death.' By then all of them will have seen it. Then it will be announced again, 'O people of Hell !' They will stretch their necks and look carefully. The caller will say, 'Do you know this?' They will say, 'Yes, this is Death.' And by then all of them will have seen it. Then it (that ram) will be slaughtered and the caller will say, 'O people of Paradise! Eternity for you and no death O people of Hell! Eternity for you and no death."' Then the Prophet, recited:-- 'And warn them of the Day of distress when the case has been decided, while (now) they are in a state of carelessness (i.e. the people of the world) and they do not believe
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Qayamat ke din Maut ko ek kaale-safed mendhe ki shakl mein laaya jaayega. Phir ek pukaarne wala aawaaz dega, "Aye Jannat waalo!" To wo apni gardanein badha kar dhyaan se dekhenge. Pukaarne wala poochega, "Kya tum ise pehchaante ho?" Wo kahenge, "Haan, ye Maut hai." Us waqt tak sab isse dekh chuke honge. Phir dobara elaan hoga, "Aye Jahannam waalo!" Wo bhi apni gardanein badha kar dekhenge. Pukaarne wala poochega, "Kya tum ise pehchaante ho?" Wo kahenge, "Haan, ye Maut hai." Aur tab tak sab ise dekh chuke honge. Phir use (us mendhe ko) zibah kar diya jaayega aur pukaarne wala kahega, "Aye Jannat waalo! Ab tumhaare liye hamesha ki zindagi hai, koi maut nahi. Aye Jahannam waalo! Tumhaare liye bhi hamesha ki zindagi hai, koi maut nahi."' Phir Nabi (SAW) ne ye Aayat padhi: 'Aur unhein us afsos ke din se daraao jab faisla ho chuka hoga, jabke wo (duniya waale) abhi ghaflat mein hain aur Iman nahi laate.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said to Gabriel, "What prevents you from visiting us more often than you visit us now?" So there was revealed:-- 'And we (angels) descend not but by the command of your Lord. To Him belongs what is before us and what is behind us
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne Jibrael se kaha, 'Aap humein aksar milne kyun nahi aate jitna abhi milte hain?' Isper ye Aayat naazil hui: 'Aur hum (farishte) tumhaare Rab ke hukm ke bagair nahi utarte. Jo kuch hamare aage hai aur jo kuch hamare peechhe hai, aur jo kuch in dono ke beech hai, sab usi ka hai...'

e: Narrated Khabbab:I came to Al-`Asi bin Wail As-Sahmi and demanded something which he owed me. He said, "I will not give you (your money) till you disbelieve in Muhammad." I said, "No, I shall not disbelieve in Muhammad till you die and then be resurrected." He said, "Will I die and then be resurrected?" I said, 'Yes'. He said', "Then I will have wealth and children there, and I will pay you (there)." So this Verse was revealed:-- 'Have you then seen him who disbelieved in Our Signs and (yet) says: I shall certainly be given wealth and children?
hi: Khabbab (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Al-Aasi bin Wail As-Sahmi ke paas gaya aur usse apna wo haq maanga jo uspar tha. Usne kaha, 'Main tujhe (tera paisa) tab tak nahi dunga jab tak tu Muhammad ka inkaar nahi karta.' Maine kaha, 'Nahi, main Muhammad ka inkaar tab tak nahi karunga jab tak tu mar na jaaye aur phir zinda na kiya jaaye.' Usne kaha, 'Kya main marunga aur phir zinda kiya jaaunga?' Maine kaha, 'Haan.' Usne kaha, 'To wahaan bhi mere paas maal aur bachche honge, aur main tujhe wahaan ada kar dunga.' Isper ye Aayat naazil hui: 'Kya tumne use nahi dekha jisne Hamaari Aayaton ka inkaar kiya, aur (phir bhi) kehta hai ke mujhe zaroor maal aur aulaad di jaayegi?'

e: Narrated Khabbab:I was a blacksmith in Mecca Once I made a sword for Al-`Asi bin Wail As-Sahmi. When I went to demand its price, he said, "I will not give it to you till you disbelieve in Muhammad." I said, "I shall not disbelieve in Muhammad till Allah makes you die and then bring you to life again." He said, "If Allah should make me die and then resurrect me, I would have wealth and children." So Allah revealed:-- 'Have you seen him who disbelieved in Our Signs, and (yet) says I shall certainly be given wealth and children? Has he known the unseen or has he taken a covenant from (Allah) the Beneficent?
hi: Khabbab (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Makkah mein loharkaam karta tha. Ek baar maine Al-Aasi bin Wail As-Sahmi ke liye ek talwaar banaayi. Jab main uski qeemat maangne gaya, usne kaha, 'Main tujhe wo tab tak nahi dunga jab tak tu Muhammad ka inkaar nahi karta.' Maine kaha, 'Main Muhammad ka inkaar tab tak nahi karunga jab tak Allah tujhe maut na de aur phir tujhe dobara zinda na kare.' Usne kaha, 'Agar Allah mujhe maut de aur phir zinda kare, to mere paas (wahaan bhi) maal aur bachche honge.' Isper Allah ne naazil farmaya: 'Kya tumne use dekha jisne Hamaari Aayaton ka inkaar kiya, aur (phir bhi) kehta hai ke mujhe zaroor maal aur aulaad di jaayegi? Kya usne ghaib ka ilm paa liya hai, ya usne Rahmaan (Allah) se koi ahad le liya hai?'

e: Narrated Masruq:Khabbab said, "During the pre-Islamic period, I was a blacksmith and Al-Asi bin Wail owed me a debt." So Khabbab went to him to demand the debt. He said, "I will not give you (your due) till you disbelieve in Muhammad." Khabbab said, "By Allah, I shall not disbelieve in Muhammad till Allah makes you die and then resurrects you." Al-Asi said, "So leave me till I die and then be resurrected, for I will be given wealth and children whereupon I will pay you your debt." So this Verse was revealed:-- 'Have you seen him who disbelieved in Our Signs and, (yet) says: I shall certainly be given wealth and children
hi: Masruq bataate hain: Khabbab (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Jaahiliyat ke daur mein main lohar tha aur Al-Aasi bin Wail par mera qarz tha.' To Khabbab uske paas apna qarz maangne gaya. Usne kaha, 'Main tujhe (tera haq) tab tak nahi dunga jab tak tu Muhammad ka inkaar nahi karta.' Khabbab ne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, main Muhammad ka inkaar tab tak nahi karunga jab tak Allah tujhe maut na de aur phir zinda na kare.' Al-Aasi ne kaha, 'To mujhe rehne de jab tak main mar na jaaun aur phir zinda na kiya jaaun, mujhe wahaan maal aur bachche milenge, tab main tera qarz ada kar dunga.' Isper ye Aayat naazil hui: 'Kya tumne use dekha jisne Hamaari Aayaton ka inkaar kiya, aur (phir bhi) kehta hai ke mujhe zaroor maal aur aulaad di jaayegi?'

e: Narrated Khabbab:I was a blacksmith and Al-Asi Bin Wail owed me a debt, so I went to him to demand it. He said to me. "I will not pay you your debt till you disbelieve in Muhammad." I said, "I will not disbelieve in Muhammad till you die and then be resurrected." He said, "Will I be resurrected after my death? If so, I shall pay you (there) if I should find wealth and children." So there was revealed:-- 'Have you seen him who disbelieved in Our Signs, and yet says: I shall certainly be given wealth and children? Has he, known to the unseen or has he taken a covenant from (Allah) the Beneficent? Nay ! We shall record what he says, and we shall add and add to his punishment. And We shall inherit from him all that he talks of, and he shall appear before Us alone
hi: Khabbab (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main lohar tha aur Al-Aasi bin Wail par mera qarz tha, to main usse maangne gaya. Usne mujhse kaha, 'Main tera qarz tab tak ada nahi karunga jab tak tu Muhammad ka inkaar nahi karta.' Maine kaha, 'Main Muhammad ka inkaar tab tak nahi karunga jab tak tu mar na jaaye aur phir zinda na kiya jaaye.' Usne kaha, 'Kya main apni maut ke baad dobara zinda kiya jaaunga? Agar aisa hai, to main tujhe (wahaan) ada kar dunga agar mujhe maal aur bachche milein.' Isper ye Aayat naazil hui: 'Kya tumne use dekha jisne Hamaari Aayaton ka inkaar kiya, aur (phir bhi) kehta hai ke mujhe zaroor maal aur aulaad di jaayegi? Kya usne ghaib ka ilm paa liya hai, ya usne Rahmaan se koi ahad le liya hai? Hargiz nahi! Hum jo kuch wo kehta hai likh lenge, aur uske azaab mein aur izaafa karte jaayenge. Aur jo kuch wo bataata hai uska (maal-o-aulaad ka) Hum waaris banenge, aur wo Hamare paas akela hi aayega.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Adam and Moses met, and Moses said to Adam "You are the one who made people miserable and turned them out of Paradise." Adam said to him, "You are the one whom Allah selected for His message and whom He selected for Himself and upon whom He revealed the Torah." Moses said, 'Yes.' Adam said, "Did you find that written in my fate before my creation?' Moses said, 'Yes.' So Adam overcame Moses with this argument
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Adam aur Musa (Alaihimus-salaam) aapas mein mile, aur Musa ne Adam se kaha, "Aap wahi hain jinhone logon ko takleef mein daala aur unhein Jannat se nikalwaaya." Adam ne unse kaha, "Aap wo hain jinhein Allah ne apni risaalat ke liye chuna aur apne khaas kalaam ke liye chuna, aur jinpar Tauret naazil ki." Musa ne kaha, "Haan." Adam ne pucha, "Kya aapko wo baat meri paidaish se pehle hi mere naseeb mein likhi hui mili thi?" Musa ne kaha, "Haan." To Adam ne is dalil se Musa par ghaalib aa gaye.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) arrived at Medina, he found the Jews observing the fast on the day of 'Ashura' (10th of Muharram). The Prophet (ﷺ) asked them (about it) and they replied, "This is the day when Moses became victorious over Pharaoh." The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to the Muslims), "We are nearer to Moses than they, so fast on this day
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Madina pahunche, to unhone dekha ke Yahudi Ashura (Muharram ki dus tareekh) ke din roza rakh rahe hain. Nabi (SAW) ne unse (iske baare mein) pucha, unhone jawab diya, 'Ye wo din hai jab Musa ne Firaun par fatah paayi thi.' Nabi (SAW) ne (Musalmaanon se) farmaya, 'Hum Musa se unse (Yahudiyon se) zyaada qareeb hain, isliye is din ka roza rakho.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Moses argued with Adam and said to him (Adam), 'You are the one who got the people out of Paradise by your sin, and thus made them miserable." Adam replied, 'O Moses! You are the one whom Allah selected for His Message and for His direct talk. Yet you blame me for a thing which Allah had ordained for me before He created me?." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) further said, "So Adam overcame Moses by this Argument
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Musa ne Adam se behas ki aur unse kaha, "Aap wahi hain jinhone apne gunaah ki wajah se logon ko Jannat se nikalwaaya aur unhein musibat mein daala." Adam ne jawab diya, "Aye Musa! Aap wo hain jinhein Allah ne apni risaalat ke liye aur apne khud kalaam karne ke liye chuna. Phir bhi aap mujhe us baat ke liye mulzim thehraate hain jo Allah ne meri paidaish se pehle hi mere liye likh di thi?"' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne aage farmaya, 'To Adam is dalil se Musa par ghaalib aa gaye.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Suras of Bani Israel, Al-Kahf, Mariyam, Taha and Al-Anbiya are from the very old Suras which I learnt by heart, and they are my first property
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Surah Bani Israel, Al-Kahf, Maryam, Ta-Ha aur Al-Anbiya un bahut purani Surahon mein se hain jo maine zabaani yaad kin, aur wo meri sabse pehli milkiyat hain.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) delivered a sermon and said, "You (people) will be gathered before Allah (on the Day of Resurrection) bare-footed, naked and uncircumcised." (The Prophet (ﷺ) then recited):-- 'As We began the first creation We shall repeat it. (It is) a promise We have undertaken and truly We shall do it.' and added, "The first man who will be dressed on the Day of Resurrection, will be Abraham. Lo! Some men from my followers will be brought and taken towards the left side, whereupon I will say, 'O Lord, (these are) my companions!' It will be said, 'You do not know what new things they introduced (into the religion) after you.' I will then say as the righteous pious slave, Jesus, said, 'I was a witness over them while I dwelt among them...(to His Statement)..and You are the Witness to all things.' (5.117) Then it will be said, '(O Muhammad) These people never stopped to apostate since you left them
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne khutba diya aur farmaya, 'Tum (log) Qayamat ke din Allah ke saamne nange pair, nange badan aur bagair khatna kiye jama kiye jaaoge.' (Phir Nabi (SAW) ne padha): 'Jaise Humne pehli baar paidaish shuru ki, waise hi dobara karenge - ye ek waada hai jo Humne apne zimme liya hai, Hum ise zaroor poora karenge.' Aur aage farmaya, 'Qayamat ke din sabse pehle jinhe kapde pehnaaye jaayenge wo Ibrahim honge. Sun lo! Meri ummat mein se kuch logon ko laaya jaayega aur unhe baayin taraf le jaaya jaayega, isper main kahunga, "Aye mere Rab! (Ye) to mere saathi hain!" Kaha jaayega, "Tumhein nahi pata unhone tumhare baad kaunse naye kaam (deen mein) shaamil kar liye the." Main phir wahi kahunga jo Isa, nek bande, ne kaha tha: "Aur main unpar gawaah tha jab tak main unke saath tha..." (Aayat ke aakhir tak) "...aur Tu har cheez par gawaah hai." (5:117) Phir kaha jaayega, "(Aye Muhammad) Ye log tere jaane ke baad se hi murtad hote rahe."'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "On the day of Resurrection Allah will say, 'O Adam!' Adam will reply, 'Labbaik our Lord, and Sa`daik ' Then there will be a loud call (saying), Allah orders you to take from among your offspring a mission for the (Hell) Fire.' Adam will say, 'O Lord! Who are the mission for the (Hell) Fire?' Allah will say, 'Out of each thousand, take out 999.' At that time every pregnant female shall drop her load (have a miscarriage) and a child will have grey hair. And you shall see mankind as in a drunken state, yet not drunk, but severe will be the torment of Allah." (22.2) (When the Prophet (ﷺ) mentioned this), the people were so distressed (and afraid) that their faces got changed (in color) whereupon the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "From Gog and Magog nine-hundred ninety-nine will be taken out and one from you. You Muslims (compared to the large number of other people) will be like a black hair on the side of a white ox, or a white hair on the side of a black ox, and I hope that you will be onefourth of the people of Paradise." On that, we said, "Allahu-Akbar!" Then he said, "I hope that you will be one-third of the people of Paradise." We again said, "Allahu-Akbar!" Then he said, "(I hope that you will be) one-half of the people of Paradise." So we said, "Allahu Akbar
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Qayamat ke din Allah farmaayega, "Aye Adam!" Adam jawab denge, "Labbaik, aye hamare Rab, aur Sa'daik." Phir ek buland aawaaz aayegi (jismein kaha jaayega), "Allah tujhe hukm deta hai ke apni aulaad mein se Jahannam ke liye ek fauj nikaal." Adam kahenge, "Aye Rab! Kitni tadaad Jahannam ke liye hogi?" Allah farmaayega, "Har hazaar mein se, nau sau ninanabe (999) nikaal." Us waqt har hamila aurat apna hamal gira degi (miscarriage ho jaayega), aur (choti umar ka) bachcha bhi budhaape ke baal wala nazar aayega. Aur tum insaanon ko nashe mein dekhoge, jabke wo asal mein nashe mein nahi honge, balke Allah ka azaab hi itna sakht hoga.' (22:2) (Jab Nabi (SAW) ne ye bataaya, to log itne pareshaan aur khaufzada ho gaye ke unke chehron ka rang badal gaya), isper Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Yajooj-Majooj mein se nau sau ninanabe (999) nikaale jaayenge aur tum mein se ek. Tum Musalmaan (baaki logon ki bhaari tadaad ke muqaable), safed bail ke pehlu mein kaale baal ki tarah, ya kaale bail ke pehlu mein safed baal ki tarah hoge, aur mujhe ummeed hai ke tum Jannatiyon ka chauthaai hoge.' Isper humne kaha, 'Allahu Akbar!' Phir unhone farmaya, 'Mujhe ummeed hai ke tum Jannatiyon ka tihaai hoge.' Humne phir kaha, 'Allahu Akbar!' Phir unhone farmaya, '(Mujhe ummeed hai ke tum) Jannatiyon ka aadha (hoge).' To humne kaha, 'Allahu Akbar!'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Regarding the Verse: "And among men is he who worships Allah's as it were on the very edge." (22.11). A man used to come to Medina and if his wife brought a son and his mares produces offspring, he would say, "This religion (Islam) is good," but if his wife did not give birth to a child and his mares produced no offspring, he would say, "This religion is bad
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) is Aayat ke baare mein bataate hain: 'Aur insaanon mein aisa bhi hai jo Allah ki ibaadat (deen ke) kinaare par (khada hokar) karta hai...' (22:11) - ek shaks Madina aaya karta tha, agar uski biwi ko beta hota aur uski ghodiyaan bachhe deti, to wo kehta, 'Ye deen (Islam) achha hai,' magar agar uski biwi ke koi bacha na hota aur ghodiyaan bachhe na deti, to wo kehta, 'Ye deen bura hai.'

e: Narrated Qais bin Ubad:Abu Dharr used to take an oath confirming that the Verse: 'These two opponents (believers, and disbelievers) dispute with each other about their Lord.' (22.19) was Revealed in connection with Hamza and his two companions and `Utbah and his two companions on the day when they went out to the battle of Badr
hi: Qais bin Ubad bataate hain: Abu Dharr (رضی اللہ عنہ) qasam khaakar kaha karte the ke ye Aayat, 'Ye do fareeq (momin aur kaafir) apne Rab ke baare mein aapas mein jhagadte hain...' (22:19), Hamza aur unke do saathiyon, aur Utbah aur unke do saathiyon ke baare mein naazil hui thi, us din jab wo jang-e-Badr ke liye nikle the.

e: Narrated Qais bin Ubad:`Ali said, "I will be the first to kneel before the Beneficent on the Day of Resurrection because of the dispute." Qais said; This Verse: 'These two opponents (believers and disbelievers dispute with each other about their Lord,' (22.19) was revealed in connection with those who came out for the Battle of Badr, i.e. `Ali, Hamza, 'Ubaida, Shaiba bin Rabi`a, `Utba bin Rabi`a and Al-Walid bin `Utba
hi: Qais bin Ubad bataate hain: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha, 'Main Qayamat ke din Rahmaan ke saamne sabse pehle (is jhagde ki wajah se) ghutno ke bal baithne wala hounga.' Qais kehte hain: Ye Aayat, 'Ye do fareeq apne Rab ke baare mein aapas mein jhagadte hain...' (22:19), un logon ke baare mein naazil hui thi jo jang-e-Badr ke liye nikle the, yaani Ali (Alayhis Salam), Hamza, Ubaida, Shaiba bin Rabi'a, Utba bin Rabi'a aur Al-Walid bin Utba.

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:'Uwaimir came to `Asim bin `Adi who was the chief of Bani Ajlan and said, "What do you say about a man who has found another man with his wife? Should he kill him whereupon you would kill him (i.e. the husband), or what should he do? Please ask Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about this matter on my behalf." `Asim then went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! (And asked him that question) but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) disliked the question," When 'Uwaimir asked `Asim (about the Prophet's answer) `Asim replied that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) disliked such questions and considered it shameful. "Uwaimir then said, "By Allah, I will not give up asking unless I ask Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about it." Uwaimir came (to the Prophet ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! A man has found another man with his wife! Should he kill him whereupon you would kill him (the husband, in Qisas) or what should he do?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah has revealed regarding you and your wife's case in the Qur'an "So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered them to perform the measures of Mula'ana according to what Allah had mentioned in His Book. So 'Uwaimir did Mula'ana with her and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! If I kept her I would oppress her." So 'Uwaimir divorced her and so divorce became a tradition after them for those who happened to be involved in a case of Mula'ana. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then said, "Look! If she (Uwaimir's wife) delivers a black child with deep black large eyes, big hips and fat legs, then I will be of the opinion that 'Uwaimir has spoken the truth; but if she delivers a red child looking like a Wahra then we will consider that 'Uwaimir has told a lie against her." Later on she delivered a child carrying the qualities which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had mentioned as a proof for 'Uwaimir's claim; therefore the child was ascribed to its mother henceforth
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Uwaimir Aasim bin Adi ke paas aaye, jo Bani Ajlan ke sardaar the, aur kaha, 'Uss aadmi ke baare mein aapki kya raay hai jo apni biwi ke saath kisi doosre mard ko paaye? Kya wo use qatl kar de, aur phir tum use (yaani shohar ko) qisaas mein qatl karoge, ya wo kya kare? Meri taraf se Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye baat pucho.' Aasim Nabi (SAW) ke paas gaye aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool!' (aur unse ye sawaal pucha), magar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye sawaal pasand nahi aaya. Jab Uwaimir ne Aasim se (Nabi ke jawab ke baare mein) pucha, to Aasim ne bataaya ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko aise sawaalaat pasand nahi the aur unhein sharmnaak samajhte the. Uwaimir ne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, main tab tak nahi rukunga jab tak main khud Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye na poochh loon.' Uwaimir (Nabi ke paas) aaye aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Ek aadmi apni biwi ke saath kisi doosre mard ko paaye. Kya wo use qatl kar de, aur phir tum use (Qisaas mein) qatl karoge, ya wo kya kare?' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah ne tumhaare aur tumhaari biwi ke maamle mein Quran mein hukm naazil kar diya hai.' To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhein hukm diya ke wo Mulaa'ana (laanat lagaane ki qasmein) karein, jaisa Allah ne apni Kitaab mein bataaya tha. To Uwaimir ne apni biwi ke saath Mulaa'ana kiya aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Agar main use apne paas rakhoon to main uspar zulm karunga.' To Uwaimir ne use talaaq de di, aur iske baad Mulaa'ana karne walon ke liye talaaq dena ek rivaaj ban gaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne phir farmaya, 'Dekho!
