Agar wo (Uwaimir ki biwi) ek kaale rang ka bacha paida ho jiski aankhen ghani kaali aur badi hon, chaudi kamar aur mote paanv hon, to main samjhunga ke Uwaimir ne sach kaha; magar agar wo ek surkh rang ka bacha paida ho jo Wahra (chhipkali) jaisa dikhe, to hum samjhenge ke Uwaimir ne uspar jhoot bola.' Baad mein usne wahi bacha paida hua jismein wo alaamaten thin jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Uwaimir ke dawe ke saboot ke taur par bataayi thin; isliye bacha uski maa ki taraf mansoob kiya gaya.

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:A man came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Suppose a man saw another man with his wife, should he kill him whereupon you might kill him (i.e. the killer) (in Qisas) or what should he do?" So Allah revealed concerning their case what is mentioned of the order of Mula'ana. Allah's Apostle said to the man, "The matter between you and your wife has been decided." So they did Mula'ana in the presence of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and I was present there, and then the man divorced his wife. So it became a tradition to dissolve the marriage of those spouses who were involved in a case of Mula'ana. The woman was pregnant and the husband denied that he was the cause of her pregnancy, so the son was (later) ascribed to her. Then it became a tradition that such a son would be the heir of his mother, and she would inherit of him what Allah prescribed for her
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek aadmi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Agar koi aadmi apni biwi ke saath kisi doosre mard ko dekhe, to kya wo use qatl kar de aur phir aap use (Qisaas mein) qatl karenge, ya wo kya kare?' Isper Allah ne Mulaa'ana ka hukm naazil kiya jiska zikr hua hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne us aadmi se kaha, 'Tumhaare aur tumhaari biwi ke darmiyaan faisla ho chuka hai.' To unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saamne Mulaa'ana kiya, aur main wahaan maujood tha, phir us aadmi ne apni biwi ko talaaq de di. To Mulaa'ana karne walon ke liye nikaah khatam karna ek rivaaj ban gaya. Wo aurat hamila thi aur shohar ne is hamal ki zimmedaari lene se inkaar kiya, isliye bacha (baad mein) uski maa ki taraf mansoob kiya gaya. Phir ye rivaaj ban gaya ke aisa bacha apni maa ka waaris hoga, aur wo bhi uski miraas mein se wo hissa paayegi jo Allah ne uske liye muqarrar kiya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Hilal bin Umaiya accused his wife of committing illegal sexual intercourse with Sharik bin Sahma' and filed the case before the Prophet. The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to Hilal), "Either you bring forth a proof (four witnesses) or you will receive the legal punishment (lashes) on your back." Hilal said, "O Allah's Apostle! If anyone of us saw a man over his wife, would he go to seek after witnesses?" The Prophet (ﷺ) kept on saying, "Either you bring forth the witnesses or you will receive the legal punishment (lashes) on your back." Hilal then said, "By Him Who sent you with the Truth, I am telling the truth and Allah will reveal to you what will save my back from legal punishment." Then Gabriel came down and revealed to him:-- 'As for those who accuse their wives...' (24.6-9) The Prophet (ﷺ) recited it till he reached: '... (her accuser) is telling the truth.' Then the Prophet (ﷺ) left and sent for the woman, and Hilal went (and brought) her and then took the oaths (confirming the claim). The Prophet (ﷺ) was saying, "Allah knows that one of you is a liar, so will any of you repent?" Then the woman got up and took the oaths and when she was going to take the fifth one, the people stopped her and said, "It (the fifth oath) will definitely bring Allah's curse on you (if you are guilty)." So she hesitated and recoiled (from taking the oath) so much that we thought that she would withdraw her denial. But then she said, "I will not dishonor my family all through these days," and carried on (the process of taking oaths). The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "Watch her; if she delivers a black-eyed child with big hips and fat shins then it is Sharik bin Sahma's child." Later she delivered a child of that description. So the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If the case was not settled by Allah's Law, I would punish her severely
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hilal bin Umaiya ne apni biwi par Sharik bin Sahma ke saath zina karne ka ilzaam lagaaya aur maamla Nabi (SAW) ke saamne pesh kiya. Nabi (SAW) ne (Hilal se) farmaya, 'Ya to saboot (chaar gawaah) pesh karo, ya tumhaari peeth par shariyat ki saza (koda) lagegi.' Hilal ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Agar hum mein se koi apni biwi ke saath kisi mard ko dekh le, to kya wo gawaah dhoondhne jaayega?' Nabi (SAW) kehte rahe, 'Ya to gawaah pesh karo, ya tumhaari peeth par shariyat ki saza lagegi.' Hilal ne kaha, 'Us Zaat ki qasam jisne aapko haq ke saath bheja hai, main sach keh raha hoon, aur Allah aapko wo naazil karega jo meri peeth ko saza se bacha le.' Phir Jibrael utre aur unpar naazil kiya: 'Jo log apni biwiyon par (bina gawaahon ke) ilzaam lagaayein...' (24:6-9) Nabi (SAW) ne ise padha yahaan tak ke pahunche, '...(uska ilzaam lagaane wala) sach bol raha hai.' Phir Nabi (SAW) wahaan se gaye aur us aurat ko bulwaaya, Hilal gaye aur usse le aaye, phir dono ne qasmein khaayin (dawe ki tasdeeq karte hue). Nabi (SAW) kehte rahe, 'Allah jaanta hai ke tum mein se ek jhoota hai, to kya tum mein se koi tauba karega?' Phir wo aurat khadi hui aur qasmein khaayin, aur jab wo paanchvi qasam khaane lagi, to logon ne use roka aur kaha, 'Ye (paanchvi qasam) waaqai Allah ki laanat tumpar le aayegi (agar tum gunaahgaar ho).' To wo hichkichaayi aur peeche hati, itna ke humein laga ke wo apna inkaar wapas le legi. Magar phir usne kaha, 'Main in dinon (jab tak main zinda hoon) apne khaandaan ki be-izzati nahi karungi,' aur (qasmein khaana) jaari rakha. Phir Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Uspar nazar rakho; agar wo kaali aankhon wala, chaudi kamar aur mote pindliyon wala bacha paida ho, to wo Sharik bin Sahma ka bacha hai.' Baad mein usne wahi jism ke lakshan wala bacha paida hua jinka zikr Nabi (SAW) ne kiya tha. To Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar ye maamla Allah ke qanoon se tay na hua hota, to main use sakht saza deta.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:A man accused his wife of illegal sexual intercourse and denied his paternity to her (conceived) child during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered them both to do Mula'ana as Allah decreed and then gave his decision that the child would be for the mother, and a divorce decree was issued for the couple involved in a case of Mula'ana
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ki zindagi mein ek aadmi ne apni biwi par zina ka ilzaam lagaaya aur uske (hamal se) bache ki wilaadat se inkaar kiya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne dono ko Mulaa'ana karne ka hukm diya, jaisa Allah ne muqarrar kiya tha, phir faisla diya ke bacha maa ka hoga, aur Mulaa'ana karne wale jode ke liye talaaq ka hukm jaari kiya gaya.

e: Narrated `Aisha:And as for him among them who had the greater share..' (24.11) was `Abdullah bin Ubai bin Salul
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Is Aayat mein, 'Aur jisne inmein se sabse bada hissa liya...' (24:11), ye Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ubai bin Salul ke baare mein hai.

e: Narrated Aisha:(The wife of the Prophet) Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) intended to go on a journey, he used to draw lots among his wives and would take with him the one on whom the lot had fallen. Once he drew lots when he wanted to carry out a Ghazwa, and the lot came upon me. So I proceeded with Allah's Apostle after Allah's order of veiling (the women) had been revealed and thus I was carried in my howdah (on a camel) and dismounted while still in it. We carried on our journey, and when Allah's Apostle had finished his Ghazwa and returned and we approached Medina, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered to proceed at night. When the army was ordered to resume the homeward journey, I got up and walked on till I left the army (camp) behind. When I had answered the call of nature, I went towards my howdah, but behold ! A necklace of mine made of Jaz Azfar (a kind of black bead) was broken and I looked for it and my search for it detained me. The group of people who used to carry me, came and carried my howdah on to the back of my camel on which I was riding, considering that I was therein. At that time women were light in weight and were not fleshy for they used to eat little (food), so those people did not feel the lightness of the howdah while raising it up, and I was still a young lady. They drove away the camel and proceeded. Then I found my necklace after the army had gone. I came to their camp but found nobody therein so I went to the place where I used to stay, thinking that they would miss me and come back in my search. While I was sitting at my place, I felt sleepy and slept. Safwan bin Al-Mu'attil As-Sulami Adh- Dhakw-ani was behind the army. He had started in the last part of the night and reached my stationing place in the morning and saw the figure of a sleeping person. He came to me and recognized me on seeing me for he used to see me before veiling. I got up because of his saying: "Inna Li l-lahi wa inna ilaihi rajiun," which he uttered on recognizing me. I covered my face with my garment, and by Allah, he did not say to me a single word except, "Inna Li l-lahi wa inna ilaihi rajiun," till he made his she-camel kneel down whereupon he trod on its forelegs and I mounted it. Then Safwan set out, leading the she-camel that was carrying me, till we met the army while they were resting during the hot midday. Then whoever was meant for destruction, fell in destruction, and the leader of the Ifk (forged statement) was `Abdullah bin Ubai bin Salul. After this we arrived at Medina and I became ill for one month while the people were spreading the forged statements of the people of the Ifk, and I was not aware of anything thereof. But what aroused my doubt while I was sick, was that I was no longer receiving from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) the same kindness as I used to receive when I fell sick. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) would enter upon me, say a greeting and add, "How is that (lady)?" and then depart. That aroused my suspicion but I was not aware of the propagated evil till I recovered from my ailment. I went out with Um Mistah to answer the call of nature towards Al-Manasi, the place where we used to relieve ourselves, and used not to go out for this purpose except from night to night, and that was before we had lavatories close to our houses. And this habit of ours was similar to the habit of the old 'Arabs (in the deserts or in the tents) concerning the evacuation of the bowels, for we considered it troublesome and harmful to take lavatories in the houses. So I went out with Um Mistah who was the daughter of Abi Ruhm bin `Abd Manaf, and her mother was daughter of Sakhr bin Amir who was the aunt of Abi Bakr As-Siddiq, and her son was Mistah bin Uthatha. When we had finished our affair, Um Mistah and I came back towards my house. Um Mistah stumbled over her robe whereupon she said, "Let Mistah be ruined ! " I said to her, "What a bad word you have said! Do you abuse a man who has taken part in the Battle of Badr?' She said, "O you there! Didn't you hear what he has said?" I said, "And what did he say?" She then told me the statement of the people of the Ifk (forged statement) which added to my ailment. When I returned home, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to me, and after greeting, he said, "How is that (lady)?" I said, "Will you allow me to go to my parents?" At that time I intended to be sure of the news through them. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) allowed me and I went to my parents and asked my mother, "O my mother! What are the people talking about?" My mother said, "O my daughter! Take it easy, for by Allah, there is no charming lady who is loved by her husband who has other wives as well, but that those wives would find fault with her." I said, "Subhan Allah! Did the people really talk about that?" That night I kept on weeping the whole night till the morning. My tears never stopped, nor did I sleep, and morning broke while I was still weeping, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) called `Ali bin Abi Talib and Usama bin Zaid when the Divine Inspiration delayed, in order to consult them as to the idea of divorcing his wife. Usama bin Zaid told Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) of what he knew about the innocence of his wife and of his affection he kept for her. He said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! She is your wife, and we do not know anything about her except good." But `Ali bin Abi Talib said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Allah does not impose restrictions on you; and there are plenty of women other than her. If you however, ask (her) slave girl, she will tell you the truth." `Aisha added: So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) called for Barira and said, "O Barira! Did you ever see anything which might have aroused your suspicion? (as regards Aisha). Barira said, "By Allah Who has sent you with the truth, I have never seen anything regarding Aisha which I would blame her for except that she is a girl of immature age who sometimes sleeps and leaves the dough of her family unprotected so that the domestic goats come and eat it." So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got up (and addressed) the people and asked for somebody who would take revenge on `Abdullah bin Ubai bin Salul then. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), while on the pulpit, said, "O Muslims! Who will help me against a man who has hurt me by slandering my family? By Allah, I know nothing except good about my family, and people have blamed a man of whom I know nothing except good, and he never used to visit my family except with me," Sa`d bin Mu`adh Al-Ansari got up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! By Allah, I will relieve you from him. If he be from the tribe of (Bani) Al-Aus, then I will chop his head off; and if he be from our brethren, the Khazraj, then you give us your order and we will obey it." On that, Sa`d bin 'Ubada got up, and he was the chief of the Khazraj, and before this incident he had been a pious man but he was incited by his zeal for his tribe. He said to Sa`d (bin Mu`adh), "By Allah the Eternal, you have told a lie! You shall not kill him and you will never be able to kill him!" On that, Usaid bin Hudair, the cousin of Sa`d (bin Mu`adh) got up and said to Sa`d bin 'Ubada, "You are a liar! By Allah the Eternal, we will surely kill him; and you are a hypocrite defending the hypocrites!" So the two tribes of Al-Aus and Al-Khazraj got excited till they were on the point of fighting with each other while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was standing on the pulpit. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) continued quietening them till they became silent whereupon he became silent too. On that day I kept on weeping so much that neither did my tears stop, nor could I sleep. In the morning my parents were with me, and I had wept for two nights and a day without sleeping and with incessant tears till they thought that my liver would burst with weeping. While they were with me and I was weeping, an Ansari woman asked permission to see me. I admitted her and she sat and started weeping with me. While I was in that state, Allah's Apostle came to us, greeted, and sat down. He had never sat with me since the day what was said, was said. He had stayed a month without receiving any Divine Inspiration concerning my case. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) recited the Tashahhud after he had sat down, and then said, "Thereafter, O `Aisha! I have been informed such and-such a thing about you; and if you are innocent, Allah will reveal your innocence, and if you have committed a sin, then ask for Allah's forgiveness and repent to Him, for when a slave confesses his sin and then repents to Allah, Allah accepts his repentance." When Allah's Apostle had finished his speech, my tears ceased completely so that I no longer felt even a drop thereof. Then I said to my father, "Reply to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on my behalf as to what he said." He said, "By Allah, I do not know what to say to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." Then I said to my mother, "Reply to Allah's Apostle." She said, "I do not know what to say to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." Still a young girl as I was and though I had little knowledge of Qur'an, I said, "By Allah, I know that you heard this story (of the Ifk) so much so that it has been planted in your minds and you have believed it. So now, if I tell you that I am innocent, and Allah knows that I am innocent, you will not believe me; and if I confess something, and Allah knows that I am innocent of it, you will believe me. By Allah, I cannot find of you an example except that of Joseph's father: "So (for me) patience is most fitting against that which you assert and it is Allah (Alone) Whose help can be sought. Then I turned away and lay on my bed, and at that time I knew that I was innocent and that Allah would reveal my innocence. But by Allah, I never thought that Allah would sent down about my affair, Divine Inspiration that would be recited (forever), as I considered myself too unworthy to be talked of by Allah with something that was to be recited: but I hoped that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) might have a vision in which Allah would prove my innocence. By Allah, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had not left his seat and nobody had left the house when the Divine Inspiration came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . So there overtook him the same hard condition which used to overtake him (when he was Divinely Inspired) so that the drops of his sweat were running down, like pearls, though it was a (cold) winter day, and that was because of the heaviness of the Statement which was revealed to him. When that state of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was over, and he was smiling when he was relieved, the first word he said was, "Aisha, Allah has declared your innocence." My mother said to me, "Get up and go to him." I said, "By Allah, I will not go to him and I will not thank anybody but Allah." So Allah revealed: "Verily! They who spread the Slander are a gang among you. Think it not...." (24.11-20). When Allah revealed this to confirm my innocence, Abu Bakr As-Siddiq who used to provide for Mistah bin Uthatha because of the latter's kinship to him and his poverty, said, "By Allah, I will never provide for Mistah anything after what he has said about Aisha". So Allah revealed: "Let not those among you who are good and are wealthy swear not to give (help) to their kinsmen, those in need, and those who have left their homes for Allah's Cause. Let them Pardon and forgive (i.e. do not punish them). Do you not love that should forgive you? Verily Allah is Oft-forgiving. Most Merciful." (24.22) Abu Bakr said, "Yes, by Allah, I wish that Allah should forgive me." So he resumed giving Mistah the aid he used to give him before and said, "By Allah, I will never withhold it from him at all." Aisha further said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) also asked Zainab bint Jahsh about my case. He said, "O Zainab! What have you seen?" She replied, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I protect my hearing and my sight (by refraining from telling lies). I know nothing but good (about Aisha)." Of all the wives of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), it was Zainab who aspired to receive from him the same favor as I used to receive, yet, Allah saved her (from telling lies) because of her piety. But her sister, Hamna, kept on fighting on her behalf so she was destroyed as were those who invented and spread the slander
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki zawja) bataati hain: Jab bhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) kisi safar par nikalte, to apni biwiyon mein qura (lottery) daalte aur jiska naam nikalta, use apne saath le jaate. Ek baar jab wo ek Ghazwe ke liye nikalne wale the, unhone qura daala aur mera naam nikla. To main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath rawaana hui - ye Hijab ki Aayat naazil hone ke baad ki baat hai - aur mujhe ek howdah (oont par baithne ka pinjra) mein baithaaya jaata aur usi mein utaara jaata. Hum safar karte rahe, aur jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apna Ghazwa poora karke wapas ho liye aur hum Madina ke qareeb pahunche, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne raat ko safar karne ka hukm diya. Jab lashkar ko safar shuru karne ka hukm diya gaya, to main uthi aur chal padi yahaan tak ke main lashkar se peeche reh gayi. Jab main qaza-e-haajat se faarigh hui, to main apne howdah ki taraf gayi, magar mera haar - jo Jaz Azfar (ek kism ke kaale moti) ka bana tha - toot gaya tha, aur main use dhoondhne lagi, aur meri talaash ne mujhe rok liya. Jo log mujhe uthaate the, unhone aakar mera howdah mere oont ki peeth par rakh diya, ye samajhkar ke main usi mein hoon. Us zamaane mein auratein halki-phulki hoti thin aur mote taaze nahi hoti thin kyunke wo bahut kam khaati thin, isliye un logon ko howdah uthaate waqt uski halki hone ka ehsaas nahi hua, aur main abhi bhi ek jawaan ladki thi. Unhone oont ko hankaa diya aur chal pade. Phir lashkar ke jaane ke baad mujhe apna haar mil gaya. Main unke khaime tak aayi magar wahaan koi nahi mila, to main us jagah gayi jahaan main pehle thi, ye soch kar ke wo mujhe miss karenge aur mujhe dhoondhte hue wapas aayenge. Jab main wahaan baithi thi, mujhe neend aa gayi aur main so gayi. Safwan bin Al-Mu'attil As-Sulami Adh-Dhakwani, jo lashkar ke peechhe the, raat ke aakhri hisse mein chale the aur subah mere thehrne ki jagah pahunche aur ek sote hue insaan ki soorat dekhi. Wo mere paas aaye aur mujhe pehchaan liya kyunke wo mujhe Hijab se pehle dekh chuke the. Main unki 'Inna Lillahi wa Inna Ilaihi Raji'un' kehne ki aawaaz se jaag gayi. Maine apna chehra apni chaadar se dhaank liya, aur Allah ki qasam, unhone mujhse ek lafz bhi nahi kaha siwaaye 'Inna Lillahi wa Inna Ilaihi Raji'un' ke, yahaan tak ke unhone apni oontni bithaayi aur uski agli taangon par pair rakh kar (mujhe chadhne mein madad ki), aur main uspar sawaar ho gayi. Phir Safwan mera oont leke chal pade yahaan tak ke hum lashkar se mile jo dopahar ki garmi mein aaraam kar raha tha. Phir jo bhi tabaahi ke liye tay tha, wo usi mein gir gaya, aur Ifk (jhooti tohmat) ka sardaar Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ubai bin Salul tha. Iske baad hum Madina pahunche aur main ek mahine tak bimar rahi jabke log Ifk ki baaten faila rahe the, aur mujhe iska koi ilm nahi tha. Magar jo baat mujhe shak mein daalti thi jab main bimar thi, wo ye thi ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mujhse wo shafqat nahi dikha rahe the jo pehle bimari mein dikhaate the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mere paas aate, salaam karte aur poochte, 'Wo (khaatoon) kaisi hain?' aur phir chale jaate. Isse mujhe shak hua magar mujhe phaili hui buri baat ka ilm nahi tha yahaan tak ke main achhi ho gayi. Main Umm Mistah ke saath qaza-e-haajat ke liye Al-Manasi ki taraf gayi, jahaan hum jaaya karte the, aur hum ye kaam sirf raat ko karte the, kyunke us waqt hamare gharon ke paas latrine (bathroom) nahi hote the. Ye humaari aadat purane Arabon jaisi thi. To main Umm Mistah ke saath gayi, jo Abu Ruhm bin Abd Manaf ki beti thi, aur uski maa Sakhr bin Aamir ki beti thi jo Abu Bakr As-Siddiq ki khaala thi, aur uska beta Mistah bin Uthatha tha. Jab hum apna kaam khatam karke wapas aa rahe the, to Umm Mistah apni chaadar mein thokar khaakar gir padi aur usne kaha, 'Mistah barbaad ho!' Maine kaha, 'Kya buri baat tumne kahi! Kya tum ek aise shaks ko bura kehti ho jo jang-e-Badr mein shareek hua tha?' Usne kaha, 'Aye tum! Kya tumne nahi suna usne kya kaha?' Maine kaha, 'Usne kya kaha?' Phir usne mujhe Ifk waalon ki baat bataayi, jisse meri bimari aur badh gayi. Jab main ghar wapas aayi, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mere paas aaye, salaam karke poocha, 'Wo (khaatoon) kaisi hain?' Maine kaha, 'Kya aap mujhe mere waalidain ke paas jaane ki ijaazat denge?' Us waqt main unse (khabar ki) tasdeeq karna chahti thi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe ijaazat di aur main apne waalidain ke paas gayi aur apni maa se poocha, 'Aye ammi! Log kya baat kar rahe hain?' Meri maa ne kaha, 'Aye meri beti! Isse halka lo, kyunke Allah ki qasam, koi khoobsurat aurat jise uska shohar chaahta ho aur uski aur biwiyaan bhi hon, aisi kam hi hoti hai jispar wo biwiyaan aib na nikaalein.' Maine kaha, 'Subhan-Allah! Kya log waaqai ye baat kar rahe hain?' Us raat main poori raat roti rahi subah tak. Mere aansu nahi rukte the, na mujhe neend aati thi, aur subah ho gayi jabke main abhi bhi ro rahi thi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ali (Alayhis Salam) bin Abu Talib aur Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko bulaaya jab wahi mein deri hui, taake unse mashwara karein apni biwi ko talaaq dene ke baare mein. Usama bin Zaid ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko wo bataaya jo wo mere baare mein jaante the aur mere liye jo muhabbat rakhte the. Unhone kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Wo aapki biwi hain, aur humein unke baare mein achhi baat ke siwa kuch nahi pata.' Magar Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Allah aap par koi pabandi nahi lagaata; aur unke ilaava bhi bahut si auratein hain. Agar aap unki khaadima se poochein, to wo aapko sach bataayegi.' Aisha ne aage kaha: To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Barira (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko bulaaya aur kaha, 'Aye Barira! Kya tumne kabhi kuch aisa dekha jisse tumhe (Aisha ke baare mein) shak ho?' Barira ne kaha, 'Us Zaat ki qasam jisne aapko haq ke saath bheja hai, maine Aisha mein kabhi kuch aisa nahi dekha jiske liye main unhe qusoorwaar thehraaun, siwaaye is ke ke wo ek kam-umar ladki hain jo kabhi so jaati hain aur apne ghar ka aata bagair dhaake chhod deti hain, jise ghar ki bakriyaan aakar kha jaati hain.' Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khade hue (aur logon se khitaab kiya) aur kisi se poocha jo Abdullah bin Ubai bin Salul se badla le sake. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne, mimbar par khade hokar, farmaya, 'Aye Musalmaano! Kaun mere us shaks ke khilaaf meri madad karega jisne mujhe meri biwi par tohmat lagaakar takleef pahunchaayi hai? Allah ki qasam, mujhe apni biwi ke baare mein achhi baat ke siwa kuch nahi pata, aur logon ne ek aise aadmi ka naam liya hai jiske baare mein bhi mujhe achhi baat ke siwa kuch nahi pata, aur wo kabhi mere ghar mein mere bagair nahi aata tha.' Sa'd bin Mu'adh Al-Ansari khade hue aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Allah ki qasam, main aapko usse chhutkaara dilaaunga. Agar wo Banu Al-Aus qabeele se hai, to main uska sar kaat dunga; aur agar wo hamaare bhai Khazraj se hai, to aap hukm dein, hum use maanenge.' Isper Sa'd bin Ubada (رضی اللہ عنہ), jo Khazraj ke sardaar the aur is waqiye se pehle ek neik aadmi the, magar apni qaum ki himayat mein josh mein aa gaye, khade hue aur Sa'd (bin Mu'adh) se kaha, 'Hamesha rehne wale Allah ki qasam, tum jhoot bolte ho! Tum use qatl nahi karoge aur kabhi kar bhi nahi paaoge!' Isper Usaid bin Hudair, jo Sa'd (bin Mu'adh) ke chachazaad bhai the, khade hue aur Sa'd bin Ubada se kaha, 'Tum jhoote ho! Hamesha rehne wale Allah ki qasam, hum use zaroor qatl karenge; aur tum munaafiqon ki himaayat karne wale munaafiq ho!' Isper Aus aur Khazraj ke dono qabeele josh mein aa gaye yahaan tak ke wo aapas mein ladne hi wale the, jabke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mimbar par khade the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unhein shaant karte rahe yahaan tak ke wo shaant ho gaye aur khud bhi khaamosh ho gaye. Us din main itna roti rahi ke na mere aansu rukte the na mujhe neend aati thi. Subah mere waalidain mere paas the, aur main do raaton aur ek din tak roti rahi thi bagair sote hue itna ke unhein laga meri kaleji phat jaayegi rone se. Jab wo mere paas the aur main ro rahi thi, ek Ansaari aurat ne mujhse milne ki ijaazat maangi. Maine use andar bulaaya aur wo baithi aur mere saath rone lagi. Isi haalat mein, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) hamare paas aaye, salaam kiya, aur baith gaye. Wo us din se mere saath nahi baithe the jab se ye baat kahi gayi thi. Unhone ek mahina bina kisi wahi ke guzaara mere maamle mein. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne baithne ke baad Tashahhud padha, phir kaha, 'Iske baad, Aye Aisha! Mujhe tumhaare baare mein aisi aisi baat batayi gayi hai; agar tum be-gunaah ho, to Allah tumhaari be-gunaahi zaahir karega, aur agar tumse koi gunaah hua hai, to Allah se maafi maango aur tauba karo, kyunke jab koi banda apna gunaah maan kar Allah ke saamne tauba karta hai, to Allah uski tauba qubool karta hai.' Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apni baat khatam kar chuke, to mere aansu bilkul ruk gaye, itne ke mujhe ek boond bhi mehsoos nahi hui. Phir maine apne waalid se kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko mere taraf se jawab dijiye.' Unhone kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, mujhe nahi pata Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kya kahoon.' Phir maine apni maa se kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko jawab dijiye.' Unhone kaha, 'Mujhe nahi pata Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kya kahoon.' Main abhi bhi ek jawaan ladki thi aur mujhe Quran ka bahut zyaada ilm nahi tha, maine kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, mujhe pata hai ke aapne ye kahaani itni baar suni hai ke ye aapke zehen mein baith gayi hai aur aapne isse maan liya hai. To ab, agar main aapko kahoon ke main be-gunaah hoon, aur Allah jaanta hai ke main be-gunaah hoon, to aap mera yaqeen nahi karenge; aur agar main kisi baat ka iqraar karoon, aur Allah jaanta hai ke main be-gunaah hoon, to aap mera yaqeen kar lenge. Allah ki qasam, mujhe apne aur tumhaare liye Yusuf ke waalid (Yaqub) ke siwa koi misaal nahi milti: "To (mere liye) sabar hi behtar hai us baat ke khilaaf jo tum bayaan karte ho, aur Allah hi hai jiski madad maangi jaa sakti hai."' Phir main mud gayi aur apne bistar par let gayi, aur us waqt mujhe pata tha ke main be-gunaah hoon aur Allah meri be-gunaahi zaahir karega. Magar Allah ki qasam, mujhe kabhi khayaal nahi tha ke Allah mere maamle mein aisi wahi naazil karega jo (hamesha) padhi jaayegi, kyunke main khud ko is laayak nahi samajhti thi ke Allah mere baare mein kuch aisi baat kahe jo padhi jaaye; magar mujhe ummeed thi ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko koi khwaab aayega jismein Allah meri be-gunaahi zaahir karega. Allah ki qasam, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apni jagah nahi chhodi thi aur na hi ghar se koi baahar gaya tha, ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) par wahi aane lagi. To unhein wahi ke waqt jo sakht haalat hoti thi, wahi tari, unke paseene ke qatre motiyon ki tarah tapakne lage, halaanke sardi ka din tha, ye is wahi ke bhaari hone ki wajah se tha jo unpar naazil ki gayi. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki ye haalat khatam hui, aur wo muskuraa rahe the jab unhein araam mila, to unka pehla lafz tha, 'Aisha, Allah ne tumhaari be-gunaahi zaahir kar di hai.' Meri maa ne mujhse kaha, 'Utho aur unke paas jao.' Maine kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, main unke paas nahi jaaungi aur Allah ke siwa kisi ka shukriya ada nahi karungi.' To Allah ne naazil farmaya: 'Beshak jinhone ye jhooti tohmat lagaayi, wo tum mein se ek giroh hai. Ise bura mat samjho...' (24:11-20) Jab Allah ne ye meri be-gunaahi ki tasdeeq mein naazil kiya, to Abu Bakr As-Siddiq, jo Mistah bin Uthatha ko unki rishtedaari aur gurbat ki wajah se maali madad diya karte the, ne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, ab Mistah ko Aisha ke baare mein jo usne kaha uske baad main kabhi kuch nahi dunga.' Isper Allah ne naazil farmaya: 'Aur tum mein se jo log fazl-o-daulat waale hain, wo apne rishtedaaron, zaroorat-manon aur Allah ki raah mein hijrat karne walon ki madad karne se qasam na khaayein. Unhein maaf karna aur darguzar karna chaahiye. Kya tum nahi chahte ke Allah tumhein maaf kare? Aur Allah bada maaf karne wala, bahut reham karne wala hai.' (24:22) Abu Bakr ne kaha, 'Haan, Allah ki qasam, main chahta hoon ke Allah mujhe maaf kare.' To unhone dobara Mistah ko wahi madad dena shuru kiya jo pehle diya karte the aur kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, main use kabhi nahi rokunga.' Aisha ne aage kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Jahsh (رضی اللہ عنہا) se bhi mere baare mein pucha. Unhone kaha, 'Aye Zainab! Tumne kya dekha hai?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Main apni aankh aur kaan ki hifaazat karti hoon (jhoot bolne se bachte hue). Mujhe (Aisha ke baare mein) achhi baat ke siwa kuch nahi pata.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sab biwiyon mein, Zainab hi wo thi jo mujhse pratispardha karti thi (izzat ke maamle mein), phir bhi Allah ne unhein (jhoot bolne se) apni parhezgaari ki wajah se bacha liya. Magar unki behen, Hamna, unke haq mein ladti rahi, isliye wo bhi unhi logon mein tabaah ho gayi jinhone ye jhooti tohmat ghadhi aur failaayi thi.

e: Narrated Um Ruman:Aisha's mother, When `Aisha was accused, she fell down Unconscious
hi: Umm Ruman, Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ki maa, bataati hain: Jab Aisha par ilzaam lagaaya gaya, to wo (khud, yaani Umm Ruman) behosh hokar gir gayi.

e: Narrated Ibn Abi Mulaika:I heard `Aisha reciting: "When you invented a lie (and carry it) on your tongues
hi: Ibn Abu Mulaika bataate hain: Maine Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko ye Aayat padhte suna: 'Jab tumne apni zabaanon se jhoot ghadha (aur usse phailaaya)...'

e: Narrated Ibn Abu Mulaika:Ibn `Abbas asked permission to visit Aisha before her death, and at that time she was in a state of agony. She then said. "I am afraid that he will praise me too much." And then it was said to her, "He is the cousin of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and one of the prominent Muslims." Then she said, "Allow him to enter." (When he entered) he said, "How are you?" She replied, "I am Alright if I fear (Allah)." Ibn `Abbas said, "Allah willing, you are Alright as you are the wife of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he did not marry any virgin except you and proof of your innocence was revealed from the Heaven." Later on Ibn Az-Zubair entered after him and `Aisha said to him, "Ibn `Abbas came to me and praised me greatly, but I wish that I was a thing forgotten and out of sight
hi: Ibn Abu Mulaika bataate hain: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ki maut se pehle unse milne ki ijaazat maangi, us waqt wo bahut takleef mein thi. Unhone kaha, 'Mujhe dar hai ke wo meri bahut zyaada taareef karenge.' Isper unse kaha gaya, 'Wo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke chachazaad bhai aur ek buzurg Musalmaan hain.' To unhone kaha, 'Unhein andar aane do.' (Jab wo andar aaye) unhone pucha, 'Aap kaisi hain?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Main theek hoon agar (Allah se) darti rahoon.' Ibn Abbas ne kaha, 'Allah ne chaaha to aap theek hain, kyunke aap Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki biwi hain, unhone aapke siwa kisi kunwaari se nikaah nahi kiya, aur aapki paakizgi ka saboot aasman se naazil hua.' Baad mein Ibn Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) unke baad andar aaye aur Aisha ne unse kaha, 'Ibn Abbas mere paas aaye aur meri bahut taareef ki, magar main to chahti hoon ke main ek bhulaayi hui aur nazron se ojhal cheez hoti.'

e: Narrated Al-Qasim:Ibn `Abbas asked `Aisha's permission to enter. Al-Qasim then narrated the whole Hadith (as in 277) but did not mention: "Would that I had been forgotten and out of sight
hi: Al-Qasim bataate hain: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se andar aane ki ijaazat maangi. (Al-Qasim ne poori hadees bayaan ki, magar) unhone ye zikr nahi kiya, 'Kaash main bhulaayi hui aur nazron se ojhal hoti.'

e: Narrated Masruq:`Aisha said that Hassan bin Thabit came and asked permission to visit her. I said, "How do you permit such a person?" She said, "Hasn't he received a severely penalty?" (Sufyan, the subnarrator, said: She meant the loss of his sight.) Thereupon Hassan said the following poetic verse: "A chaste pious woman who arouses no suspicion. She never talks about chaste heedless women behind their backs.' On that she said, "But you are not so
hi: Masruq bataate hain: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas Hassan bin Thabit aaye aur unse milne ki ijaazat maangi. Maine (Aisha se) kaha, 'Aap aise shaks ko kaise ijaazat dete hain?' Unhone kaha, 'Kya usne sakht saza nahi paayi?' (Ravi Sufyan kehte hain: unka ishara uski nazar chale jaane ki taraf tha.) Isper Hassan ne ye sher padha: 'Ek paak-daaman aur nek aurat jispar shak nahi kiya jaata. Wo kabhi paak-daaman aur ghaafil auraton ke baare mein unki peeth peeche baat nahi karti.' Isper Aisha ne kaha, 'Magar tum aise nahi ho.'

e: Narrated Masruq:Hassan came to Aisha and said the following poetic Verse: 'A chaste pious woman who arouses no suspicion. She never talks against chaste heedless women behind their backs.' `Aisha said, "But you are not," I said (to `Aisha), "Why do you allow such a person to enter upon you after Allah has revealed: "...and as for him among them who had the greater share therein'?" (24.11) She said, "What punishment is worse than blindness?" She added, "And he used to defend Allah's Apostle against the pagans (in his poetry)
hi: Masruq bataate hain: Hassan Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas aaye aur ye sher padha: 'Ek paak-daaman aur nek aurat jispar shak nahi kiya jaata. Wo kabhi paak-daaman aur ghaafil auraton ke baare mein unki peeth peeche baat nahi karti.' Aisha ne kaha, 'Magar tum aise nahi ho.' Maine (Aisha se) pucha, 'Aap aise shaks ko apne paas aane ki ijaazat kyun dete hain jabke Allah ne naazil kiya hai, "...aur jisne inmein se sabse bada hissa liya..."?' (24:11) Unhone kaha, 'Andhepan se badi saza aur kya ho sakti hai?' Unhone aage kaha, 'Aur wo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki taraf se mushrikeen ke khilaaf (apni shaayari mein) difaa karte the.'

e: Narrated Aisha:When there was said about me what was said which I myself was unaware of, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got up and addressed the people. He recited Tashah-hud, and after glorifying and praising Allah as He deserved, he said, "To proceed: O people Give me your opinion regarding those people who made a forged story against my wife. By Allah, I do not know anything bad about her. By Allah, they accused her of being with a man about whom I have never known anything bad, and he never entered my house unless I was present there, and whenever I went on a journey, he went with me." Sa`d bin Mu`adh got up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) Allow me to chop their heads off". Then a man from the Al-Khazraj (Sa`d bin 'Ubada) to whom the mother of (the poet) Hassan bin Thabit was a relative, got up and said (to Sa`d bin Mu`adh), "You have told a lie! By Allah, if those persons were from the Aus Tribe, you would not like to chop their heads off." It was probable that some evil would take place between the Aus and the Khazraj in the mosque, and I was unaware of all that. In the evening of that day, I went out for some of my needs (i.e. to relieve myself), and Um Mistah was accompanying me. On our return, Um Mistah stumbled and said, "Let Mistah. be ruined" I said to her, "O mother Why do you abuse your Son" On that Um Mistah became silent for a while, and stumbling again, she said, "Let Mistah be ruined" I said to her, "Why do you abuse your son?" She stumbled for the third time and said, "Let Mistah be ruined" whereupon I rebuked her for that. She said, "By Allah, I do not abuse him except because of you." I asked her, "Concerning what of my affairs?" So she disclosed the whole story to me. I said, "Has this really happened?" She replied, "Yes, by Allah." I returned to my house, astonished (and distressed) that I did not know for what purpose I had gone out. Then I became sick (fever) and said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) "Send me to my father's house." So he sent a slave with me, and when I entered the house, I found Um Rum-an (my mother) downstairs while (my father) Abu Bakr was reciting something upstairs. My mother asked, "What has brought you, O (my) daughter?" I informed her and mentioned to her the whole story, but she did not feel it as I did. She said, "O my daughter! Take it easy, for there is never a charming lady loved by her husband who has other wives but that they feel jealous of her and speak badly of her." But she did not feel the news as I did. I asked (her), "Does my father know about it?" She said, "yes" I asked, Does Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) know about it too?" She said, "Yes, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) does too." So the tears filled my eyes and I wept. Abu Bakr, who was reading upstairs heard my voice and came down and asked my mother, "What is the matter with her? " She said, "She has heard what has been said about her (as regards the story of Al-Ifk)." On that Abu- Bakr wept and said, "I beseech you by Allah, O my daughter, to go back to your home". I went back to my home and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had come to my house and asked my maid-servant about me (my character). The maid-servant said, "By Allah, I do not know of any defect in her character except that she sleeps and let the sheep enter (her house) and eat her dough." On that, some of the Prophet's companions spoke harshly to her and said, "Tell the truth to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." Finally they told her of the affair (of the slander). She said, "Subhan Allah! By Allah, I know nothing against her except what goldsmith knows about a piece of pure gold." Then this news reached the man who was accused, and he said, "Subhan Allah! By Allah, I have never uncovered the private parts of any woman." Later that man was martyred in Allah's Cause. Next morning my parents came to pay me a visit and they stayed with me till Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to me after he had offered the `Asr prayer. He came to me while my parents were sitting around me on my right and my left. He praised and glorified Allah and said, "Now then O `Aisha! If you have committed a bad deed or you have wronged (yourself), then repent to Allah as Allah accepts the repentance from his slaves." An Ansari woman had come and was sitting near the gate. I said (to the Prophet), "Isn't it improper that you speak in such a way in the presence of this lady? Allah's Apostle then gave a piece of advice and I turned to my father and requested him to answer him (on my behalf). My father said, "What should I say?" Then I turned to my mother and asked her to answer him. She said, "What should I say?" When my parents did not give a reply to the Prophet, I said, "I testify that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, and that Muhammad is His Apostle!" And after praising and glorifying Allah as He deserves, I said, "Now then, by Allah, if I were to tell you that I have not done (this evil action) and Allah is a witness that I am telling the truth, that would not be of any use to me on your part because you (people) have spoken about it and your hearts have absorbed it; and if I were to tell you that I have done this sin and Allah knows that I have not done it, then you will say, 'She has confessed herself guilty." By Allah, 'I do not see a suitable example for me and you but the example of (I tried to remember Jacob's name but couldn't) Joseph's father when he said; So (for me) "Patience is most fitting against that which you assert. It is Allah (alone) whose help can be sought.' At that very hour the Divine Inspiration came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and we remained silent. Then the Inspiration was over and I noticed the signs of happiness on his face while he was removing (the sweat) from his forehead and saying, "Have the good tidings O ' "Aisha! Allah has revealed your innocence." At that time I was extremely angry. My parents said to me, "Get up and go to him." I said, "By Allah, I will not do it and will not thank him nor thank either of you, but I will thank Allah Who has revealed my innocence. You have heard this story but neither did not deny it nor change it (to defend me)." (Aisha used to say:) "But as regards Zainab bint Jahsh, (the Prophet's wife), Allah protected her because of her piety, so she did not say anything except good (about me), but her sister, Hamna, was ruined among those who were ruined. Those who used to speak evil about me were Mistah, Hassan bin Thabit, and the hypocrite, `Abdullah bin Ubai, who used to spread that news and tempt others to speak of it, and it was he and Hamna who had the greater share therein. Abu Bakr took an oath that he would never do any favor to Mistah at all. Then Allah revealed the Divine Verse: "Let not those among you who are good and wealthy (i.e. Abu Bakr) swear not to give (any sort of help) to their kinsmen, and those in need, (i.e. Mistah) ...Do you not love that Allah should forgive you? And Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful." (24.22) On that, Abu Bakr said, "Yes, by Allah, O our Lord! We wish that You should forgive us." So Abu Bakr again started giving to Mistah the expenditure which he used to give him before
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab mere baare mein wo baat kahi gayi jiska mujhe khud pata nahi tha, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khade hue aur logon se khitaab kiya. Unhone Tashahhud padha, Allah ki jitni tareef ki jaani chaahiye utni ki, phir farmaya, 'Aage: Aye logo! Mujhe un logon ke baare mein apni raay do jinhone meri biwi ke khilaaf jhooti baat ghadi hai. Allah ki qasam, mujhe unke baare mein achhi baat ke siwa kuch nahi pata. Aur Allah ki qasam, unhone unhein ek aise mard ke saath jodkar tohmat lagaayi hai jiske baare mein bhi mujhe achhi baat ke siwa kabhi kuch nahi pata, aur wo mere ghar mein mere bagair kabhi nahi aata tha, aur jab bhi main safar par jaata, wo mere saath jaata tha.' Sa'd bin Mu'adh khade hue aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe ijaazat dijiye ke main unke sar kaat doon.' Phir Khazraj qabeele ka ek shaks (Sa'd bin Ubada (رضی اللہ عنہ)), jiski Hassan bin Thabit (shaayar) ki maa se rishtedaari thi, khade hue aur (Sa'd bin Mu'adh se) kaha, 'Tumne jhoot bola! Allah ki qasam, agar ye log Aus qabeele se hote, to tumhein unke sar kaatna pasand na aata.' Aisar aur Khazraj ke darmiyaan Masjid mein koi buri baat ho sakti thi, aur mujhe iska kuch bhi pata nahi tha. Us din shaam ko, main apni zaroorat ke liye baahar gayi (yaani qaza-e-haajat ke liye), aur Umm Mistah mere saath thi. Wapas aate waqt Umm Mistah thokar khaakar giri aur usne kaha, 'Mistah barbaad ho.' Maine usse kaha, 'Aye ammi! Aap apne bete ko bura kyun kehti hain?' Isper Umm Mistah kuch der khaamosh rahi, phir dobara thokar khaakar usne kaha, 'Mistah barbaad ho.' Maine phir kaha, 'Aap apne bete ko bura kyun kehti hain?' Teesri baar bhi thokar khaakar usne kaha, 'Mistah barbaad ho,' isper maine use daanta. Usne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, main use sirf tumhaari wajah se bura kehti hoon.' Maine poocha, 'Mere kis maamle ki wajah se?' To usne mujhe poori baat bataayi. Maine poocha, 'Kya waaqai aisa hua?' Usne kaha, 'Haan, Allah ki qasam.' Main apne ghar wapas aayi, hairaan aur pareshaan, mujhe ye bhi yaad nahi tha ke main kis kaam se baahar nikli thi. Phir mujhe bukhaar aa gaya aur maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kaha, 'Mujhe mere waalid ke ghar bhej dijiye.' To unhone ek ghulaam ke saath mujhe bhej diya, aur jab main ghar pahunchi, to maine Umm Ruman (meri maa) ko neeche paaya jabke (mere waalid) Abu Bakr upar kuch padh rahe the. Meri maa ne poocha, 'Kya baat hai, aye meri beti?' Maine unhein poori baat bataayi, magar unhone isse waisa mehsoos nahi kiya jaisa maine kiya tha. Unhone kaha, 'Aye meri beti! Isse halka lo, kyunke koi bhi khoobsurat aurat, jise uska shohar chaahta ho aur uski aur biwiyaan bhi hon, to wo unse jalti hain aur uske baare mein bura kehti hain.' Magar unhone bhi khabar ko waisa mehsoos nahi kiya jaisa maine kiya. Maine poocha, 'Kya mere waalid ko iska pata hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan.' Maine poocha, 'Kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko bhi pata hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko bhi pata hai.' To meri aankhon mein aansu bhar aaye aur main rone lagi. Abu Bakr, jo upar padh rahe the, meri aawaaz sunkar neeche aaye aur meri maa se poocha, 'Isko kya hua hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Isne Ifk ke baare mein jo kaha gaya wo sun liya hai.' Isper Abu Bakr ro pade aur kaha, 'Main tumhein Allah ki qasam deta hoon, aye meri beti, apne ghar wapas jao.' Main apne ghar wapas gayi aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mere ghar aa chuke the aur meri khaadima se mere baare mein pucha tha. Khaadima ne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, mujhe unmein koi buraai nahi maloom, siwaaye ye ke wo so jaati hain aur bakriyon ko andar aa kar unka aata khaane dete hain.' Isper Nabi (SAW) ke kuch sahaaba ne usse sakhti se kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko sach batao.' Aakhir unhone usse (tohmat ki) poori baat bataayi. Usne kaha, 'Subhan-Allah! Allah ki qasam, mujhe unke baare mein utna hi pata hai jitna sunaar khaalis sone ke baare mein jaanta hai.' Phir ye khabar us aadmi tak pahunchi jispar ilzaam lagaaya gaya tha, usne kaha, 'Subhan-Allah! Allah ki qasam, maine kabhi kisi aurat ka parda nahi khola.' Baad mein wo shaks Allah ki raah mein shaheed ho gaya. Agli subah mere waalidain mujhse milne aaye aur mere paas rahe yahaan tak ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Asr ki namaz padhne ke baad mere paas aaye. Wo mere paas aaye jabke mere waalidain mere daayen aur baayen baithe the. Unhone Allah ki tareef aur azmat bayaan ki aur farmaya, 'Ab, Aye Aisha! Agar tumse koi bura kaam hua hai ya tumne apne aap par zulm kiya hai, to Allah se tauba karo, kyunke Allah apne bandon ki tauba qubool karta hai.' Ek Ansaari aurat aayi thi aur darwaaze ke paas baithi thi. Maine (Nabi se) kaha, 'Kya ye theek nahi ke aap is khaatoon ki maujoodgi mein aisi baat karein?' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne phir naseehat ki, aur main apne waalid ki taraf mudi aur unse darkhwaast ki ke wo (mere taraf se) jawab dein. Mere waalid ne kaha, 'Mujhe kya kehna chaahiye?' Phir maine apni maa se kaha jawab dene ko. Unhone kaha, 'Mujhe kya kehna chaahiye?' Jab mere waalidain ne Nabi (SAW) ko jawab nahi diya, to maine khud kaha, 'Main gawaahi deti hoon ke Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi, aur Muhammad uske Rasool hain!' Aur Allah ki jitni tareef ki jaani chaahiye utni karne ke baad, maine kaha, 'Ab, Allah ki qasam, agar main aapko kahoon ke maine ye (bura kaam) nahi kiya, aur Allah gawaah hai ke main sach keh rahi hoon, to iska aapke saamne koi faayda nahi hoga kyunke aap logon ne ye baat kahi hai aur aapke dilon ne isse qubool kar liya hai; aur agar main kahoon ke maine ye gunaah kiya hai, jabke Allah jaanta hai ke maine nahi kiya, to aap kahenge, "Usne khud apna gunaah maan liya." Allah ki qasam, mujhe apne aur aapke liye - (maine Yaqub ka naam yaad karne ki koshish ki magar yaad nahi aaya) - Yusuf ke waalid ke siwa koi misaal nahi milti jab unhone kaha tha: "To (mere liye) sabar hi behtar hai us baat ke khilaaf jo tum bayaan karte ho. Aur Allah hi hai jiski madad maangi jaa sakti hai."' Usi waqt Allah ke Rasool (SAW) par wahi naazil hone lagi aur hum khaamosh rahe. Phir wahi khatam hui aur maine unke chehre par khushi ke asaar dekhe jabke wo apni peshaani se (paseena) pochh rahe the aur kaha, 'Khush-khabri ho, Aye Aisha! Allah ne tumhaari be-gunaahi zaahir kar di hai.' Us waqt main bahut naaraaz thi. Mere waalidain ne mujhse kaha, 'Utho aur unke paas jao.' Maine kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, main aisa nahi karungi, aur na unka na tum dono ka shukriya ada karungi, balke sirf Allah ka shukriya ada karungi jisne meri be-gunaahi zaahir ki hai. Tumne ye baat suni thi lekin na to isse jhutlaaya na hi (mere haq mein) badla.' (Aisha kaha karti thin:) Lekin Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Jahsh (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki biwi) ke maamle mein, Allah ne unhein unki parhezgaari ki wajah se bacha liya, isliye unhone (mere baare mein) achhi baat ke siwa kuch nahi kaha, magar unki behen, Hamna, unhi logon mein tabaah ho gayi jo tabaah hue the. Jo log mere baare mein bura kaha karte the wo the Mistah, Hassan bin Thabit, aur munaafiq Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ubai, jo ye khabar failaata aur doosron ko usmein hissa lene ke liye ubhaarta tha, aur usi aur Hamna ne isme sabse bada hissa liya tha. Abu Bakr ne qasam khaayi ke wo Mistah ke liye kabhi koi ehsaan nahi karenge. Phir Allah ne ye Aayat naazil ki: 'Aur tum mein se jo fazl aur daulat wale hain (yaani Abu Bakr), wo apne rishtedaaron aur zaroorat-manon (yaani Mistah) ki madad na karne ki qasam na khaayein... Kya tum nahi chahte ke Allah tumhein maaf kare? Aur Allah bada maaf karne wala, bahut reham karne wala hai.' (24:22) Isper Abu Bakr ne kaha, 'Haan, Allah ki qasam, Aye hamare Rab! Hum chahte hain ke Tu humein maaf kare.' To Abu Bakr ne dobara Mistah ko wahi kharcha dena shuru kiya jo pehle diya karte the.

e: Narrated `Aishah:May Allah bestow His Mercy on the early emigrant women. When Allah revealed: "... and to draw their veils all over their Juyubihinna (i.e., their bodies, faces, necks and bosoms)..." (V.24:31) they tore their Murut (woolen dresses or waist-binding clothes or aprons etc.) and covered their heads and faces with those torn Muruts
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah un pehli hijrat karne wali auraton par rehmat naazil kare. Jab Allah ne naazil kiya, '...aur apne sar ke dupatte apne seenon (aur gale) par daale rahein...' (24:31), to unhone apni Murut (oon ki chaadarein/kamar-band) phaad din aur unhi phate hue tukdon se apne sar aur chehre dhaank liye.

e: Narrated Safiya bint Shaiba:`Aisha used to say: "When (the Verse): "They should draw their veils over their necks and bosoms," was revealed, (the ladies) cut their waist sheets at the edges and covered their heads and faces with those cut pieces of cloth
hi: Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Shaiba bataati hain: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) kaha karti thin: 'Jab ye Aayat naazil hui, "Wo apne dupatte apni gardan aur seenon par daal lein," to auraton ne apni kamar ki chaadaron ko kinaaron se kaat liya aur unhi kaate hue tukdon se apne sar aur chehre dhaank liye.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:A man said, "O Allah's Prophet! Will Allah gather the non-believers on their faces on the Day of Resurrection?" He said, "Will not the One Who made him walk on his feet in this world, be able to make him walk on his face on the Day of Resurrection?" (Qatada, a subnarrator, said: Yes, By the Power of Our Lord)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks ne pucha, 'Aye Allah ke Nabi! Kya Allah kaafiron ko Qayamat ke din unke chehron ke bal jama karega?' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jisne unhein is duniya mein unke pairon par chalvaaya, kya wo Qayamat ke din unhein unke chehre ke bal chalvaane par qaadir nahi?' (Ravi Qatada kehte hain: Haan, hamare Rab ki qudrat se.)

e: Narrated `Abdullah:I or somebody, asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) "Which is the biggest sin in the Sight of Allah?" He said, "That you set up a rival (in worship) to Allah though He Alone created you." I asked, "What is next?" He said, "Then, that you kill your son, being afraid that he may share your meals with you." I asked, "What is next?" He said, "That you commit illegal sexual intercourse with the wife of your neighbor." Then the following Verse was revealed to confirm the statement of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ): "Those who invoke not with Allah, any other god, nor kill life as Allah has forbidden except for just cause, nor commit illegal sexual intercourse
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine ya kisi aur ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se pucha, 'Allah ke nazdeek sabse bada gunaah kya hai?' Unhone farmaya, 'Ye ke tum Allah ka shareek thehraao, jabke usne akele tumhe paida kiya.' Maine pucha, 'Uske baad kya?' Unhone farmaya, 'Phir ye ke tum apne bete ko is dar se qatl karo ke wo tumhaare saath khaana khaayega.' Maine pucha, 'Uske baad kya?' Unhone farmaya, 'Apne padosi ki biwi se zina karna.' Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke is bayaan ki tasdeeq mein ye Aayat naazil hui: 'Jo log Allah ke saath kisi aur maabood ko nahi pukaarte, na haq ke bagair kisi jaan ko qatl karte jise Allah ne haraam kiya hai, na zina karte hain...'

e: Narrated Al-Qasim bin Abi Bazza:That he asked Sa`id bin Jubair, "Is there any repentance of the one who has murdered a believer intentionally?" Then I recited to him:-- "Nor kill such life as Allah has forbidden except for a just cause." Sa`id said, "I recited this very Verse before Ibn `Abbas as you have recited it before me. Ibn `Abbas said, 'This Verse was revealed in Mecca and it has been abrogated by a Verse in Surat-An-Nisa which was later revealed in Medina
hi: Al-Qasim bin Abi Bazza bataate hain ke unhone Saeed bin Jubair se pucha, 'Kya kisi momin ko jaan-boojh kar qatl karne wale ki koi tauba (qubool) hai?' Phir maine unke saamne ye Aayat padhi: 'Na kisi jaan ko qatl karo jise Allah ne haraam kiya hai siwaaye haq ke.' Saeed ne kaha, 'Maine bhi yahi Aayat Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saamne padhi thi jaisa tumne mere saamne padha. Ibn Abbas ne kaha, "Ye Aayat Makkah mein naazil hui thi, aur ise Surah An-Nisa ki ek Aayat ne mansookh kar diya jo baad mein Madina mein naazil hui."'

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:The people of Kufa differed as regards the killing of a believer so I entered upon Ibn `Abbas (and asked him) about that. Ibn `Abbas said, "The Verse (in Surat-An-Nisa', 4:93) was the last thing revealed in this respect and nothing cancelled its validity
hi: Saeed bin Jubair bataate hain: Kufa ke logon mein kisi momin ko qatl karne ke maamle mein ikhtelaf ho gaya, to main Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas gaya (aur unse iske baare mein pucha). Ibn Abbas ne kaha, 'Ye Aayat (Surah An-Nisa, 4:93) is silsile mein sabse aakhir mein naazil hui thi, aur isse mansookh karne wali koi Aayat naazil nahi hui.'

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:I asked Ibn `Abbas about Allah's saying:-- '.. this reward is Hell Fire.' (4.93) He said, "No repentance is accepted from him (i.e. the murderer of a believer)." I asked him regarding the saying of Allah: 'Those who invoke not with Allah any other god.' ...(25.68) He said, "This Verse was revealed concerning the pagans of the pre-Islamic period
hi: Saeed bin Jubair bataate hain: Maine Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se Allah ke is farmaan ke baare mein pucha: '...uska badla Jahannam hai' (4:93). Unhone kaha, 'Uski (yaani momin ke qaatil ki) koi tauba qubool nahi hoti.' Maine unse Allah ke is farmaan ke baare mein bhi pucha: 'Jo log Allah ke saath kisi aur maabood ko nahi pukaarte...' (25:68) Unhone kaha, 'Ye Aayat jaahiliyat ke daur ke mushrikeen ke baare mein naazil hui thi.'

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:Ibn Abza said to me, "Ask Ibn `Abbas regarding the Statement of Allah: 'And whoever murders a believer intentionally, his recompense is Hell.' (4.69) And also His Statement: '...nor kill such life as Allah has forbidden, except for a just cause .....except those who repent, believe, and do good deeds.' " (25.68-70) So I asked Ibn `Abbas and he said, "When this (25.68-69) was revealed, the people of Mecca said, "We have invoked other gods with Allah, and we have murdered such lives which Allah has made sacred, and we have committed illegal sexual intercourse. So Allah revealed: 'Except those who repent, believe, and do good deeds and Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful
hi: Saeed bin Jubair bataate hain: Ibn Abza ne mujhse kaha, 'Ibn Abbas se Allah ke is farmaan ke baare mein pucho: "Aur jo koi kisi momin ko jaan-boojh kar qatl kare, uska badla Jahannam hai" (4:93), aur ye bhi: "...na kisi jaan ko qatl karo jise Allah ne haraam kiya hai siwaaye haq ke...siwaaye un logon ke jo tauba karte hain, Iman laate hain aur nek amal karte hain" (25:68-70).' To maine Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha, unhone kaha, 'Jab ye (25:68-69) naazil hui, to Makkah waalon ne kaha, "Humne Allah ke saath aur maabood pukaare hain, aur humne un jaanon ko qatl kiya hai jinhe Allah ne haraam qaraar diya tha, aur humne zina kiya hai." Isper Allah ne naazil farmaya: "Siwaaye un logon ke jo tauba karte hain, Iman laate hain aur nek amal karte hain, aur Allah bada maaf karne wala, bahut reham karne wala hai."'

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:`Abdur-Rahman bin Abza ordered me to ask Ibn `Abbas regarding the two Verses (the first of which was ): "And whosoever murders a believer intentionally." (4.93) So I asked him, and he said, "Nothing has abrogated this Verse." About (the other Verse): 'And those who invoke not with Allah any other god.' he said, "It was revealed concerning the pagans
hi: Saeed bin Jubair bataate hain: Abdur Rahman bin Abza ne mujhe hukm diya ke main Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se do Aayaton ke baare mein pucchoon (jinme se pehli thi): 'Jo koi kisi momin ko jaan-boojh kar qatl kare...' (4:93) To maine unse pucha, unhone kaha, 'Isse kisi Aayat ne mansookh nahi kiya.' Doosri Aayat ke baare mein, 'Aur jo log Allah ke saath kisi aur maabood ko nahi pukaarte,' unhone kaha, 'Ye mushrikeen ke baare mein naazil hui thi.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:Five (great events) have passed: the Smoke, the Moon, the Romans, the Mighty grasp and the constant Punishment which occurs in 'So the torment will be yours forever
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Paanch (badi nishaaniyaan) guzar chuki hain: Dhuaan, Chaand (ka phatna), Romiyon (ki shikast), Sakht Pakad, aur musalsal azaab jiska zikr, 'To ye azaab tumhaare liye hamesha ke liye hai,' mein hai.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "On the Day of Resurrection Abraham will see his father covered with Qatara and Ghabara. (i.e. having a dark face)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Qayamat ke din Ibrahim (Alaihissalam) apne waalid ko Qatara aur Ghabara (yaani tareeki aur gard) se dhaka hua dekhenge (yaani unka chehra kaala hoga).'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, Abraham will meet his father (on the Day of Resurrection) and will say, 'O my Lord! You promised me that You would not let me in disgrace on the Day when people will be resurrected.' Allah will say, 'I have forbidden Paradise to the non-believers
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ibrahim (Alaihissalam) apne waalid se (Qayamat ke din) milenge aur kahenge, "Aye mere Rab! Tune mujhse waada kiya tha ke Tu mujhe us din ruswaa nahi karega jis din log dobara zinda kiye jaayenge." Allah farmaayega, "Maine kaafiron par Jannat haraam kar di hai."'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When the Verse:--'And warn your tribe of near-kindred, was revealed, the Prophet (ﷺ) ascended the Safa (mountain) and started calling, "O Bani Fihr! O Bani `Adi!" addressing various tribes of Quraish till they were assembled. Those who could not come themselves, sent their messengers to see what was there. Abu Lahab and other people from Quraish came and the Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "Suppose I told you that there is an (enemy) cavalry in the valley intending to attack you, would you believe me?" They said, "Yes, for we have not found you telling anything other than the truth." He then said, "I am a warner to you in face of a terrific punishment." Abu Lahab said (to the Prophet) "May your hands perish all this day. Is it for this purpose you have gathered us?" Then it was revealed: "Perish the hands of Abu Lahab (one of the Prophet's uncles), and perish he! His wealth and his children will not profit him
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab ye Aayat naazil hui, 'Aur apne qareebi rishtedaaron ko dara,' to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Safa pahaad par chadhe aur pukaarne lage, 'Aye Banu Fihr! Aye Banu Adi!' Quraish ke alag alag qabeelon ka naam lekar, yahaan tak ke sab jama ho gaye. Jo khud nahi aa sake, unhone apne namaainde bheje dekhne ke liye kya maamla hai. Abu Lahab aur Quraish ke doosre log aaye, aur Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar main tumhein bataun ke wadi mein (dushman ke) sawaar tumpar hamla karne wale hain, to kya tum mera yaqeen karoge?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan, kyunke humne aapko kabhi jhoot bolte nahi paaya.' Unhone farmaya, 'To main tumhein ek sakht azaab se pehle khabardaar karta hoon.' Abu Lahab ne (Nabi se) kaha, 'Tumhaare haath aaj ke din barbaad hon! Kya isi kaam ke liye tumne humein bulaaya hai?' Isper naazil hui: 'Barbaad hon Abu Lahab (Nabi ke ek chacha) ke haath, aur wo khud bhi barbaad ho! Na uska maal aur na uski aulaad usko koi faayda dengi...'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got up when the Verse:--'And warn your tribe of near kindred...." (26.214) was revealed and said, "O Quraish people! (or he said a similar word) Buy yourselves! I cannot save you from Allah (if you disobey Him) O Bani Abd Manaf! I cannot save you from Allah (if you disobey Him). O `Abbas, the son of `Abdul Muttalib! I cannot save you from Allah (if you disobey Him). O Safiya, (the aunt of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)) I cannot save you from Allah (if you disobey Him). O Fatima, the daughter of Muhammad! Ask what you wish from my property, but I cannot save you from Allah (if you disobey Him)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab ye Aayat naazil hui, 'Aur apne qareebi rishtedaaron ko dara' (26:214), to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khade hue aur farmaya, 'Aye Quraish ke logo! (ya isi tarah ki koi baat kahi) apne aap ko (Allah se) khareed lo! Main Allah se tumhein bacha nahi sakta. Aye Banu Abd Manaf! Main Allah se tumhein bacha nahi sakta. Aye Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib! Main Allah se tumhein bacha nahi sakta. Aye Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Allah ke Rasool ki phuppi)! Main Allah se tumhein bacha nahi sakta. Aye Fatima (Alayhas Salam), Muhammad ki beti! Mere maal se jo chaaho maang lo, magar main Allah se tumhein bacha nahi sakta.'

e: Narrated Al-Musaiyab:When Abu Talib was on his death bed, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to him and found with him, Abu Jahl and `Abdullah bin Abi Umaiya bin Al-Mughira. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O uncle! Say: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, a sentence with which I will defend you before Allah." On that Abu Jahl and `Abdullah bin Abi Umaiya said to Abu Talib, "Will you now leave the religion of `Abdul Muttalib?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) kept on inviting him to say that sentence while the other two kept on repeating their sentence before him till Abu Talib said as the last thing he said to them, "I am on the religion of `Abdul Muttalib," and refused to say: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah. On that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "By Allah, I will keep on asking Allah's forgiveness for you unless I am forbidden (by Allah) to do so." So Allah revealed:-- 'It is not fitting for the Prophet (ﷺ) and those who believe that they should invoke (Allah) for forgiveness for pagans.' (9.113) And then Allah revealed especially about Abu Talib:--'Verily! You (O, Muhammad) guide not whom you like, but Allah guides whom He will
hi: Al-Musaiyab bataate hain: Jab Abu Talib ki maut nazdeek aayi, Nabi (SAW) unke paas gaye aur wahaan Abu Jahl aur Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Umaiya bin Al-Mughira maujood the. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Aye chacha! Kaho: Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi, aur is kalime ke zariye main Allah ke saamne aapki hifaazat karunga.' Isper Abu Jahl aur Abdullah bin Abi Umaiya ne Abu Talib se kaha, 'Kya ab tum Abdul Muttalib ka deen chhod doge?' Nabi (SAW) unhein wo kalima kehne ki dawat dete rahe, jabke doosre dono baar baar apni baat dohraate rahe, yahaan tak ke Abu Talib ne apni aakhri baat kahi, 'Main Abdul Muttalib ke deen par hoon,' aur 'Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi' kehne se inkaar kar diya. Isper Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah ki qasam, main aapke liye maafi maangta rahunga jab tak mujhe (aisa karne se) mana nahi kiya jaata.' To Allah ne naazil farmaya: 'Nabi aur Iman waalon ke liye ye jaayez nahi ke wo mushrikeen ke liye maafi maangein.' (9:113) Phir Allah ne khaas Abu Talib ke baare mein naazil farmaya: 'Beshak (Aye Muhammad) aap jise chaahein hidaayat nahi de sakte, balke Allah jise chaahe hidaayat deta hai.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Qur'an 28.85'...will bring you home' means to Mecca
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Quran 28:85 mein, '...tumhein tumhaare (asli) ghar wapas le aayega,' iska matlab hai Makkah.

e: Narrated Masruq:While a man was delivering a speech in the tribe of Kinda, he said, "Smoke will prevail on the Day of Resurrection and will deprive the hypocrites their faculties of hearing and seeing. The believers will be afflicted with something like cold only thereof." That news scared us, so I went to (Abdullah) Ibn Mas`ud while he was reclining (and told him the story) whereupon he became angry, sat up and said, "He who knows a thing can say, it, but if he does not know, he should say, 'Allah knows best,' for it is an aspect of knowledge to say, 'I do not know,' if you do not know a certain thing. Allah said to His prophet. 'Say (O Muhammad): No wage do I ask of you for this (Qur'an), nor I am one of the pretenders (a person who pretends things which do not exist.)' (38.86) The Quraish delayed in embracing Islam for a period, so the Prophet (ﷺ) invoked evil on them, saying, 'O Allah! Help me against them by sending seven years of (famine) like those of Joseph.' So they were afflicted with such a severe year of famine that they were destroyed therein and ate dead animals and bones. They started seeing something like smoke between the sky and the earth (because of severe hunger). Abu Sufyan then came (to the Prophet) and said, "O Muhammad! You came to order us for to keep good relations with Kith and kin, and your kinsmen have now perished, so please invoke Allah (to relieve them).' Then Ibn Mas`ud recited:-- 'Then watch you for the day that the sky will bring forth a kind of smoke plainly visible....but truly you will return! (to disbelief) (44.10-15) Ibn Mas`ud added, Then the punishment was stopped, but truly, they reverted to heathenism (their old way). So Allah (threatened them thus): 'On the day when we shall seize you with a mighty grasp.' (44.16) And that was the day of the Battle of Badr. Allah's saying- "Lizama" (the punishment) refers to the day of Badr Allah's Statement: Alif-Lam-Mim, the Romans have been defeated, and they, after their defeat, will be victorious,' (30.1- 3) (This verse): Indicates that the defeat of Byzantine has already passed
hi: Masruq bataate hain: Jab ek shaks Kinda qabeele mein taqreer de raha tha, usne kaha, 'Qayamat ke din dhuaan chha jaayega aur munaafiqon ki sunne aur dekhne ki taaqat chheen lega, jabke Momineen par sirf zukaam jaisi halki asar hogi.' Ye baat sunkar hum darr gaye, to main Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) Ibn Masud ke paas gaya jabke wo tek lagaaye hue baithe the (aur unhein ye baat bataayi), isper wo naaraaz ho gaye, seedhe baith gaye, aur kaha, 'Jo shaks kisi baat ko jaanta hai wo use bayaan kare, magar jo nahi jaanta usse kehna chaahiye, "Allah behtar jaanta hai," kyunke ilm ka hi ek hissa ye kehna hai, "Mujhe nahi pata," jab tumhein kisi baat ka pata na ho. Allah ne apne Nabi se kaha: "Kaho (Aye Muhammad): Main is (Quran) ke badle tum se koi ujrat nahi maangta, aur na hi main jhoota dava karne wala hoon." (38:86) Quraish Islam qubool karne mein taalte rahe, isliye Nabi (SAW) ne unke khilaaf bad-dua ki, "Aye Allah! Meri madad kar unke khilaaf, unpar Yusuf ke zamaane jaise saat saal (ka qehat) daal de." To unpar itna sakht qehat aaya ke wo usme tabaah ho gaye aur murda jaanwar aur haddiyaan khaane lage. Wo aasman aur zameen ke beech dhuein jaisi cheez dekhne lage (bhookh ki shiddat ki wajah se). Phir Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ) (Nabi ke paas) aaye aur kaha, "Aye Muhammad! Tum humein rishtedaari nibhaane ka hukm dene aaye the, aur ab tumhaare hi rishtedaar tabaah ho rahe hain, isliye barah-e-meherbaani Allah se dua kijiye (ke wo unhein raahat de)." Phir Ibn Masud ne ye Aayat padhi: "To (Aye Muhammad) us din ka intezaar karo jab aasman saaf zaahir dhuaan laayega... magar tum phir (kufr ki taraf) laut jaaoge." (44:10-15)' Ibn Masud ne aage kaha, 'Phir azaab ruk gaya, magar wo waaqai apne purane kufr ki taraf laut gaye. Isliye Allah ne (unhein dhamki di): "Jis din Hum tumhein sakht pakad se pakdenge..." (44:16) Aur wo jang-e-Badr ka din tha. Allah ke farmaan "Lizama" (sakht saza) se muraad Badr ka din hai. Allah ka farmaan: "Alif-Laam-Meem. Romi haar chuke hain, aur wo, apni haar ke baad, jald hi fatah paayenge..." (30:1-3) ye zaahir karta hai ke Rome (Byzantine) ki haar us waqt guzar chuki thi.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "No child is born except on Al-Fitra (Islam) and then his parents make him Jewish, Christian or Magian, as an animal produces a perfect young animal: do you see any part of its body amputated?" Then he recited, 'The religion of pure Islamic Faith (Hanifa),(i.e. to worship none but Allah), The pure Allah's Islamic nature with which He (Allah) has created mankind. Let There be no change in Allah's religion (i.e. to join none in Allah's worship). That is the straight religion; but most of men know not
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Har bachcha Fitra (Islam) par hi paida hota hai, phir uske waalidain use Yahudi, Isaai ya Majoosi bana dete hain, jaise koi jaanwar ek mukammal bachcha paida karta hai; kya tumhe uske jism ka koi hissa kata hua dikhta hai?' Phir unhone padha: 'Allah ki fitrat jispar usne insaanon ko paida kiya. Allah ke deen mein koi tabdeeli nahi (yaani sirf usi ki ibaadat karna, kisi shareek ke bagair). Yahi seedha deen hai, magar aksar log nahi jaante.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:When there was revealed: 'It is those who believe and confuse not their beliefs with wrong.' (6.82) It was very hard for the companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), so they said, "Which of us has not confused his belief with wrong?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The Verse does not mean this. Don't you hear Luqman's statement to his son: 'Verily! Joining others in worship, with Allah is a great wrong indeed
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab ye Aayat naazil hui, 'Wo log jo Iman laaye aur apne Iman ko zulm ke saath na mila len...' (6:82), to Nabi (SAW) ke sahaaba ke liye ye bahut mushkil ho gaya, unhone kaha, 'Hum mein se kisne apna Iman zulm ke saath nahi mila liya?' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Is Aayat ka ye matlab nahi hai. Kya tumne Luqman ki apne bete ko di gayi naseehat nahi suni: "Beshak Allah ke saath shirk karna bahut bada zulm hai"?'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:One day while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was sitting with the people, a man came to him walking and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). What is Belief?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Belief is to believe in Allah, His Angels, His Books, His Apostles, and the meeting with Him, and to believe in the Resurrection." The man asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) What is Islam?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Islam is to worship Allah and not worship anything besides Him, to offer prayers perfectly, to pay the (compulsory) charity (i.e. Zakat) and to fast the month of Ramadan." The man again asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) What is Ihsan (i.e. perfection or Benevolence)?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Ihsan is to worship Allah as if you see Him, and if you do not achieve this state of devotion, then (take it for granted that) Allah sees you." The man further asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) When will the Hour be established?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "The one who is asked about it does not know more than the questioner does, but I will describe to you its portents. When the lady slave gives birth to her mistress, that will be of its portents; when the bare-footed naked people become the chiefs of the people, that will be of its portents. The Hour is one of five things which nobody knows except Allah. Verily, the knowledge of the Hour is with Allah (alone). He sends down the rain, and knows that which is in the wombs." (31.34) Then the man left. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Call him back to me." They went to call him back but could not see him. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "That was Gabriel who came to teach the people their religion." (See Hadith No. 47 Vol)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek din jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) logon ke saath baithe the, ek shaks chal kar unke paas aaya aur pucha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Iman kya hai?' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Iman ye hai ke tum Allah par, uske farishton par, uski kitaabon par, uske Rasoolon par, aur usse milne par Iman rakho, aur Qayamat par Iman laao.' Us shaks ne pucha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Islam kya hai?' Nabi (SAW) ne jawab diya, 'Islam ye hai ke tum sirf Allah ki ibaadat karo aur uske siwa kisi aur ki ibaadat na karo, namaz mukammal padho, Zakat ada karo, aur Ramzan ke roze rakho.' Us shaks ne phir pucha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Ihsan kya hai?' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ihsan ye hai ke tum Allah ki ibaadat aise karo jaise tum use dekh rahe ho, aur agar ye martaba haasil na kar sako, to (jaan lo ke) wo tumhein dekh raha hai.' Us shaks ne aage pucha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Qayamat kab aayegi?' Nabi (SAW) ne jawab diya, 'Jispar sawaal kiya jaa raha hai, wo puchne wale se zyaada nahi jaanta, magar main tumhein iski alaamaten batata hoon. Jab launDi apni maalkin ko paida ho, ye ek alaamat hai; jab nange pair aur nange badan wale log (duniya ke) sardaar ban jaayein, ye bhi ek alaamat hai. Qayamat ka waqt un paanch cheezon mein se ek hai jo Allah ke siwa koi nahi jaanta. "Beshak Qayamat ka ilm sirf Allah ke paas hai. Wahi baarish barsaata hai, aur jaanta hai jo (maaon ke) rehm mein hai."' (31:34) Phir wo shaks wahaan se chala gaya. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Use wapas bulaao.' Log use bulaane gaye magar unhein wo dikhaayi nahi diya. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Wo Jibrael the jo logon ko unka deen sikhaane aaye the.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The keys of the Unseen are five." And then he recited: 'Verily, the knowledge of the Hour is with Allah (alone)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ghaib ki chaabiyaan paanch hain.' Phir unhone padha: 'Beshak Qayamat ka ilm sirf Allah ke paas hai...'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah said, 'I have prepared for my pious worshipers such things as no eye has ever seen, no ear has ever heard of, and nobody has ever thought of." Abu Huraira added: If you wish you can read:-- 'No soul knows what is kept hidden (in reserve) for them of joy as reward for what they used to do
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah farmaata hai, "Maine apne nek bandon ke liye aisi cheezein taiyaar ki hain jinhe na kisi aankh ne dekha, na kisi kaan ne suna, aur na hi kisi ke dil mein khayaal aaya."' Abu Huraira ne aage kaha, 'Chaho to padho: "Koi jaan nahi jaanti unke liye kya khushi chhupaayi gayi hai unke amaal ke badle mein."'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet, said, "Allah said, 'I have prepared for My pious worshipers such things as no eye has ever seen, no ear has ever heard of, and nobody has ever thought of. All that is reserved, besides which, all that you have seen, is nothing." Then he recited:-- 'No soul knows what is kept hidden (in reserve) for them of joy as a reward for what they used to do
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah farmaata hai, "Maine apne nek bandon ke liye aisi cheezein taiyaar ki hain jinhe na kisi aankh ne dekha, na kisi kaan ne suna, aur na hi kisi ke dil mein khayaal aaya. Ye sab (Jannat mein) mehfooz hai, aur jo kuch (duniya mein) tumne dekha hai wo iske aage kuch bhi nahi."' Phir unhone padha: 'Koi jaan nahi jaanti unke liye kya khushi chhupaayi gayi hai unke amaal ke badle mein.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There is no believer but I, of all the people, I am the closest to him both in this world and in the Hereafter. Recite if you wish: 'The Prophet (ﷺ) is closer to the believers than their own selves.' (33.6) so if a believer (dies) leaves some property then his relatives will inherit that property; but if he is in debt or he leaves poor children, let those (creditors and children) come to me (that I may pay the debt and provide for the children), for them I am his sponsor (surely)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Har momin ke liye main sab logon mein sabse zyaada qareeb hoon, is duniya mein bhi aur aakhirat mein bhi. Chaho to padho: "Nabi Momineen ke liye unki apni jaan se bhi zyaada qareeb hain." (33:6) To agar koi momin (marte waqt) kuch maal chhod jaaye, to uske rishtedaar uske waaris honge; magar agar wo qarzdaar ho ya gareeb bacche chhod jaaye, to wo (qarzkhwaah aur bacche) mere paas aayein, main unka zamin hoon.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:We used not to call Zaid bin Haritha the freed slave of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) except Zaid bin Muhammad till the Qur'anic Verse was revealed: "Call them (adopted sons) by (the names of) their fathers. That is more than just in the Sight of Allah
