hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Zaid bin Haritha, Nabi (SAW) ke azaad kiye ghulaam, ko Zaid bin Muhammad hi kehte the yahaan tak ke ye Quraani Aayat naazil hui: 'Unhein (gode liye hue beton ko) unke asal baap ke naam se bulaao, ye Allah ke nazdeek zyaada insaaf ki baat hai.'

e: Narrated Anas:We think that the Verse: 'Among the Believers are men who have been true to their covenant with Allah,' was revealed in favor of Anas bin An-Nadr
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hamara khayaal hai ke ye Aayat, 'Momineen mein aise log hain jinhone Allah se kiye apne ahad ko sach kar dikhaaya,' Anas bin An-Nadr ki taareef mein naazil hui thi.

e: Narrated Zaid bin Thabit:When we collected the fragmentary manuscripts of the Qur'an into copies, I missed one of the Verses of Surat al-Ahzab which I used to hear Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) reading. Finally I did not find it with anybody except Khuza`ima Al-Ansari, whose witness was considered by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) equal to the witness of two men. (And that Verse was:) 'Among the believers are men who have been true to their covenant with Allah
hi: Zaid bin Thabit (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab hum Quran ke bikhre huye tukdon ko ek nuskhe mein jama kar rahe the, mujhe Surah Al-Ahzab ki ek Aayat nahi mili jise main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko padhte sunta tha. Aakhir mujhe wo kisi ke paas nahi mili siwaaye Khuzaima Al-Ansari ke, jinki gawaahi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke nazdeek do aadmiyon ki gawaahi ke barabar samjhi jaati thi. (Aur wo Aayat thi:) 'Momineen mein aise log hain jinhone Allah se kiye apne ahad ko sach kar dikhaaya...'

e: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to me when Allah ordered him to give option to his wives. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) started with me, saying, "I am going to mention to you something but you should not hasten (to give your reply) unless you consult your parents.' He knew that my parents would not order me to leave him. Then he said, "Allah says:-- "O Prophet! Say to your wives..." (33.28-29) On that I said to him, "Then why should I consult my parents? Verily, I seek Allah, His Apostle and the Home of the Hereafter
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki zawja) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mere paas aaye jab Allah ne unhein hukm diya ke wo apni biwiyon ko ikhtiyaar dein. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse shuru kiya aur kaha, 'Main tumhein kuch bataane wala hoon, magar jawab dene mein jaldi mat karo jab tak apne waalidain se mashwara na kar lo.' Unhein pata tha ke mere waalidain mujhe unhe chhodne ka hukm nahi denge. Phir unhone kaha, 'Allah farmaata hai: "Aye Nabi! Apni biwiyon se kaho..."' (33:28-29) Isper maine unse kaha, 'To phir mujhe apne waalidain se mashwara karne ki kya zaroorat hai? Main to sirf Allah, uske Rasool aur Aakhirat ke ghar ko chahti hoon.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was ordered to give option to his wives, he started with me, saying, "I am going to mention to you something, but you shall not hasten (to give your reply) unless you consult your parents." The Prophet (ﷺ) knew that my parents would not order me to leave him. Then he said, "Allah says: 'O Prophet (Muhammad)! Say to your wives: If you desire the life of this world and its glitter........a great reward." (33.28-29) I said, "Then why I consult my parents? Verily, I seek Allah, His Apostle and the Home of the Hereafter." Then all the other wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) did the same as I did
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki zawja) bataati hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko apni biwiyon ko ikhtiyaar dene ka hukm diya gaya, to unhone mujhse shuru kiya aur kaha, 'Main tumhein kuch bataane wala hoon, magar jawab dene mein jaldi mat karo jab tak apne waalidain se mashwara na kar lo.' Nabi (SAW) ko pata tha ke mere waalidain mujhe unhe chhodne ka hukm nahi denge. Phir unhone kaha, 'Allah farmaata hai: "Aye Nabi (Muhammad)! Apni biwiyon se kaho: Agar tum duniya ki zindagi aur uski raunak chahti ho..." (aakhir tak) "...ek bada ajr."' (33:28-29) Maine kaha, 'To phir main apne waalidain se kyun mashwara karoon? Main to sirf Allah, uske Rasool aur Aakhirat ke ghar ko chahti hoon.' Phir Nabi (SAW) ki baaki sab biwiyon ne bhi wahi kiya jo maine kiya.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Verse: 'But you did hide in your mind that which Allah was about to make manifest.' (33.37) was revealed concerning Zainab bint Jahsh and Zaid bin Haritha
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ye Aayat, 'Aur tum apne dil mein wo baat chhupaate the jise Allah zaahir karne wala tha' (33:37), Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Jahsh (رضی اللہ عنہا) aur Zaid bin Haritha ke silsile mein naazil hui thi.

e: Narrated Aisha:I used to look down upon those ladies who had given themselves to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and I used to say, "Can a lady give herself (to a man)?" But when Allah revealed: "You (O Muhammad) can postpone (the turn of) whom you will of them (your wives), and you may receive any of them whom you will; and there is no blame on you if you invite one whose turn you have set aside (temporarily).' (33.51) I said (to the Prophet), "I feel that your Lord hastens in fulfilling your wishes and desires
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Main un auraton ko haqir samajhti thi jinhone khud ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko hiba (bagair Mahr ke) de diya tha, aur kehti thi, 'Kya koi aurat khud ko (kisi mard ko) hiba kar sakti hai?' Magar jab Allah ne naazil kiya: '(Aye Muhammad) aap chaahein to inmein se jiski chaho baari peeche daalein, aur jiski chaho apne paas rakhein; aur agar aap kisi aise (biwi) ko bulaayein jise aapne (waqti taur par) alag rakha tha, to aap par koi gunaah nahi' (33:51), to maine (Nabi se) kaha, 'Mujhe lagta hai ke aapka Rab aapki khwaahishon ko poora karne mein jaldi karta hai.'

e: Narrated Mu`adha:`Aisha said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to take the permission of that wife with whom he was supposed to stay overnight if he wanted to go to one other than her, after this Verse was revealed:-- "You (O Muhammad) can postpone (the turn of) whom you will of them (your wives) and you may receive any (of them) whom you will; and there is no blame on you if you invite one whose turn you have set aside (temporarily). (33.51) I asked Aisha, "What did you use to say (in this case)?" She said, "I used to say to him, "If I could deny you the permission (to go to your other wives) I would not allow your favor to be bestowed on any other person
hi: Mu'adha bataate hain: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) us biwi se ijaazat le liya karte the jiske paas unhe raat guzaarni hoti thi, agar wo kisi doosri biwi ke paas jaana chahte, us Aayat ke naazil hone ke baad: "(Aye Muhammad) aap chaahein to inmein se jiski chaho baari peeche daalein, aur jiski chaho apne paas rakhein; aur agar aap kisi aise (biwi) ko bulaayein jise aapne alag rakha tha, to aap par koi gunaah nahi." (33:51)' Maine Aisha se pucha, 'Aap (aise mauqe par) kya kehti thin?' Unhone kaha, 'Main unse kehti thi, "Agar main aapko (doosri biwiyon ke paas jaane ki) ijaazat na de sakoon, to bhi main nahi chahungi ke aapki meherbaani kisi aur ko na mile."'

e: Narrated `Umar:I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Good and bad persons enter upon you, so I suggest that you order the mothers of the Believers (i.e. your wives) to observe veils." Then Allah revealed the Verses of Al- Hijab
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Achhe aur bure sab log aapke paas aate hain, isliye main sujhaav deta hoon ke aap Ummahaat-ul-Momineen (apni biwiyon) ko parda karne ka hukm dein.' Isper Allah ne Hijab ki Aayaten naazil kin.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) married Zainab bint Jahsh, he invited the people to a meal. They took the meal and remained sitting and talking. Then the Prophet (showed them) as if he is ready to get up, yet they did not get up. When he noticed that (there was no response to his movement), he got up, and the others too, got up except three persons who kept on sitting. The Prophet (ﷺ) came back in order to enter his house, but he went away again. Then they left, whereupon I set out and went to the Prophet (ﷺ) to tell him that they had departed, so he came and entered his house. I wanted to enter along with him, but he put a screen between me and him. Then Allah revealed: 'O you who believe! Do not enter the houses of the Prophet
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Jahsh (رضی اللہ عنہا) se nikaah kiya, to unhone logon ko khaane ki dawat di. Log khaana khaakar baithe rahe aur baatein karte rahe. Phir Nabi (SAW) ne (jaise) uthne ka ishara diya, phir bhi wo log nahi uthe. Jab unhone dekha (ke uthne ke ishare ka koi asar nahi hua), to wo khud uth gaye, aur baaki log bhi uth gaye siwaaye teen aadmiyon ke jo baithe rahe. Nabi (SAW) apne ghar mein jaane ke liye laute, magar phir wapas chale gaye. Phir wo log (teenon) bhi chale gaye, isper main gaya aur Nabi (SAW) ko bataaya ke sab chale gaye hain, to wo aaye aur apne ghar mein daakhil hue. Main bhi unke saath andar jaana chahta tha, magar unhone mere aur apne beech ek parda daal diya. Phir Allah ne naazil farmaya: 'Aye Iman waalo! Nabi ke gharon mein daakhil na ho...'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:I of all the people know best this verse of Al-Hijab. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) married Zainab bint Jahsh she was with him in the house and he prepared a meal and invited the people (to it). They sat down (after finishing their meal) and started chatting. So the Prophet (ﷺ) went out and then returned several times while they were still sitting and talking. So Allah revealed the Verse: 'O you who believe! Enter not the Prophet's houses until leave is given to you for a meal, (and then) not (so early as) to wait for its preparation .....ask them from behind a screen.' (33.53) So the screen was set up and the people went away
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Sab logon mein main is Hijab ki Aayat ko sabse achhi tarah jaanta hoon. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Jahsh (رضی اللہ عنہا) se nikaah kiya, wo unke saath ghar mein thi aur unhone khaana taiyaar karke logon ko dawat di. Wo (khaana khaakar) baith gaye aur baatein karne lage. Nabi (SAW) baahar jaate aur baar baar wapas aate jabke wo abhi bhi baithe hue baaten kar rahe the. To Allah ne ye Aayat naazil ki: 'Aye Iman waalo! Nabi ke gharon mein daakhil mat ho jab tak ijaazat na di jaaye khaane ke liye, (aur phir) khaane ki taiyaari ka intezaar karne ke liye mat baitho... unse parde ke peechhe se poochho.' (33:53) To parda laga diya gaya aur log chale gaye.

e: Narrated Anas:A banquet of bread and meat was held on the occasion of the marriage of the Prophet (ﷺ) to Zainab bint Jahsh. I was sent to invite the people (to the banquet), and so the people started coming (in groups); They would eat and then leave. Another batch would come, eat and leave. So I kept on inviting the people till I found nobody to invite. Then I said, "O Allah's Prophet! I do not find anybody to invite." He said, "Carry away the remaining food." Then a batch of three persons stayed in the house chatting. The Prophet (ﷺ) left and went towards the dwelling place of Aisha and said, "Peace and Allah's Mercy be on you, O the people of the house!" She replied, "Peace and the mercy of Allah be on you too. How did you find your wife? May Allah bless you. Then he went to the dwelling places of all his other wives and said to them the same as he said to Aisha and they said to him the same as Aisha had said to him. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) returned and found a group of three persons still in the house chatting. The Prophet was a very shy person, so he went out (for the second time) and went towards the dwelling place of `Aisha. I do not remember whether I informed him that the people have gone away. So he returned and as soon as he entered the gate, he drew the curtain between me and him, and then the Verse of Al-Hijab was revealed
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Jahsh (رضی اللہ عنہا) se nikaah ke mauqe par roti aur gosht ki dawat rakhi gayi. Mujhe logon ko bulaane bheja gaya, to log guton mein aate rahe; wo khaate aur chale jaate. Phir doosra gut aata, khaata aur chala jaata. Main logon ko bulaata rahaa yahaan tak ke mujhe koi aur bulaane ko nahi bacha. Phir maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Nabi! Mujhe koi aur bulaane ko nahi mil raha.' Unhone kaha, 'Bacha hua khaana hata do.' Phir teen aadmiyon ka ek gut ghar mein baithkar baaten karta raha. Nabi (SAW) wahaan se Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke ghar ki taraf gaye aur kaha, 'Aap sab par salaam aur Allah ki rehmat ho, aye ghar walo!' Unhone jawab diya, 'Aap par bhi salaam aur Allah ki rehmat ho. Aapki biwi kaisi lagi? Allah aapko barkat de.' Phir wo apni baaki sab biwiyon ke ghar gaye aur unse bhi wahi kaha jo Aisha se kaha tha, aur unhone bhi wahi jawab diya jo Aisha ne diya tha. Phir Nabi (SAW) wapas aaye aur dekha ke teen logon ka wo gut abhi bhi ghar mein baithkar baaten kar raha hai. Nabi (SAW) bahut sharmeele the, isliye wo (dusri baar) baahar chale gaye aur Aisha ke ghar ki taraf gaye. Mujhe yaad nahi ke maine unhein bataya tha ke log chale gaye hain ya nahi. To wo wapas aaye aur jaise hi darwaaze mein daakhil hue, unhone mere aur apne beech parda kheench diya, aur phir Hijab ki Aayat naazil hui.

e: Narrated Anas:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) married Zainab bint Jahsh, he made the people eat meat and bread to their fill (by giving a Walima banquet). Then he went out to the dwelling places of the mothers of the believers (his wives), as he used to do in the morning of his marriage. He would greet them and invoke good on them, and they (too) would return his greeting and invoke good on him. When he returned to his house, he found two men talking to each other; and when he saw them, he went out of his house again. When those two men saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ): going out of his house, they quickly got up (and departed). I do not remember whether I informed him of their departure, or he was informed (by somebody else). So he returned, and when he entered the house, he lowered the curtain between me and him. Then the Verse of Al-Hijab was revealed
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Jahsh (رضی اللہ عنہا) se nikaah kiya, to unhone logon ko peth bhar kar gosht aur roti khilaayi (Walima ki dawat dekar). Phir wo apni azwaaj ke gharon ki taraf gaye, jaisa wo nikaah ki subah kiya karte the. Wo unhein salaam karte aur unke liye dua karte, aur wo bhi unhein salaam ka jawab dete aur unke liye dua karte. Jab wo apne ghar wapas aaye, to unhone do aadmiyon ko aapas mein baat karte paaya; unhein dekh kar wo dobara apne ghar se baahar chale gaye. Jab un dono aadmiyon ne Nabi (SAW) ko baahar jaate dekha, to wo jaldi se uth (kar chale) gaye. Mujhe yaad nahi ke maine unhein unke jaane ki khabar di ya kisi aur ne bataayi. To wo (Nabi) wapas aaye, aur jab ghar mein daakhil hue, to unhone mere aur apne beech parda gira diya. Phir Hijab ki Aayat naazil hui.

e: Narrated Aisha:Sauda (the wife of the Prophet) went out to answer the call of nature after it was made obligatory (for all the Muslims ladies) to observe the veil. She had a large frame and everybody who knew her before could recognize her. So `Umar bin Al-Khattab saw her and said, "O Sauda! By Allah, you cannot hide yourself from us, so think of a way by which you should not be recognized on going out. Sauda returned while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was in my house taking his supper and a bone covered with meat was in his hand. She entered and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I went out to answer the call of nature and `Umar said to me so-and-so." Then Allah inspired him (the Prophet) and when the state of inspiration was over and the bone was still in his hand as he had not put in down, he said (to Sauda), "You (women) have been allowed to go out for your needs
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Sauda (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki zawja) qaza-e-haajat ke liye baahar gayi, iske baad ke ye farz ho gaya tha (sab Musalmaan auraton par) parda karna. Wo dabla-patla nahi thin aur jo koi unhe pehle jaanta tha wo unhe pehchaan sakta tha. Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab ne unhe dekha aur kaha, 'Aye Sauda! Allah ki qasam, tum humse chhup nahi sakti, isliye koi tareeka socho ke baahar jaate waqt tum pehchaani na jao.' Sauda wapas aayi jabke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mere ghar mein raat ka khaana kha rahe the aur unke haath mein gosht laga hua ek haddi thi. Wo andar aayi aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Main qaza-e-haajat ke liye baahar gayi thi aur Umar ne mujhse aisi aisi baat kahi.' Isper Allah ne unhein wahi bheji, aur jab wahi ka daur khatam hua aur haddi abhi bhi unke haath mein thi (unhone abhi tak rakhi nahi thi), unhone (Sauda se) farmaya, '(Tum auraton ko) apni zaroorat ke liye baahar jaane ki ijaazat de di gayi hai.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:Aflah, the brother of Abi Al-Qu`ais, asked permission to visit me after the order of Al-Hijab was revealed. I said, "I will not permit him unless I take permission of the Prophet (ﷺ) about him for it was not the brother of Abi Al-Qu`ais but the wife of Abi Al-Qu`ais that nursed me." The Prophet (ﷺ) entered upon me, and I said to him, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Aflah, the brother of Abi Al-Qu`ais asked permission to visit me but I refused to permit him unless I took your permission." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "What stopped you from permitting him? He is your uncle." I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! The man was not the person who had nursed me, but the woman, the wife of Abi Al-Qu`ais had nursed me." He said, "Admit him, for he is your uncle. Taribat Yaminuki (may your right hand be saved)" `Urwa, the sub-narrator added: For that `Aisha used to say, "Consider those things which are illegal because of blood relations as illegal because of the corresponding foster relations
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Aflah, Abi Al-Qu'ais ke bhai, ne mujhse milne ki ijaazat maangi, ye Hijab ka hukm naazil hone ke baad ki baat hai. Maine kaha, 'Main unhein ijaazat nahi dungi jab tak Nabi (SAW) se unke baare mein ijaazat na le loon, kyunke mujhe doodh Abi Al-Qu'ais ke bhai ne nahi, balke Abi Al-Qu'ais ki biwi ne pilaaya tha.' Nabi (SAW) mere paas aaye, maine unse kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Aflah, Abi Al-Qu'ais ke bhai, ne mujhse milne ki ijaazat maangi hai magar maine unhein ijaazat nahi di jab tak aapse ijaazat na le loon.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Tumhein unhein ijaazat dene se kis cheez ne roka? Wo to tumhaare chacha hain.' Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Wo aadmi wo shaks nahi tha jisne mujhe doodh pilaaya, balke aurat, yaani Abi Al-Qu'ais ki biwi, ne mujhe doodh pilaaya tha.' Unhone farmaya, 'Unhein andar aane do, wo tumhaare chacha hain. Taribat Yaminuki (Allah tumhaare daayen haath ko mehfooz rakhe).' Ravi Urwa kehte hain: Isi wajah se Aisha kaha karti thin, 'Jo cheezein khoon ke rishte ki wajah se haraam hain, unhein doodh ke rishte ki wajah se bhi haraam samjho.'

e: Narrated Ka`b bin Ujra:It was said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We know how to greet you, but how to invoke Allah for you?" The Prophet said, "Say: Allahumma salli ala Muhammadin wa'ala `Ali Muhammaddin, kama sallaita 'ala all Ibrahim, innaka Hamidun Majid
hi: Ka'b bin Ujra bataate hain: Kaha gaya, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Humein aapko salaam karna aata hai, magar aapke liye Allah se kaise dua karein?' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kaho: Allahumma salli ala Muhammadin wa ala aali Muhammadin, kama sallaita ala aali Ibrahim, innaka Hamidum-Majid (Aye Allah! Muhammad aur unki aal par apni rehmat naazil kar, jaise Tu ne Ibrahim ki aal par ki, beshak Tu bahut taareef ke laayak, bahut azmat waala hai).'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:We said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! (We know) this greeting (to you) but how shall we invoke Allah for you?" He said, "Say! Allahumma salli ala Muhammadin `Abdika wa rasulika kama- sallaita 'ala all Ibrahim wa barik ala Muhammadin wa'ala all Muhammadin kama barakta 'ala all Ibrahim.' Al-Laith said: 'Ala Muhammadin wa 'ala all Muhammadin kama barakta ala all Ibrahim. Narrated Ibn Abi Hazim and Ad-Darawardi: Yazid said, "Kama sallaita ala Ibrahima wa barik 'ala Muhammad in wa all Muhammadin kama barakta 'ala Abrahima wa all Ibrahim
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Humne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! (Humein) ye salaam (karna to pata hai), magar aapke liye Allah se kaise dua karein?' Unhone farmaya, 'Kaho: "Allahumma salli ala Muhammadin Abdika wa Rasulika, kama sallaita ala aali Ibrahim, wa baarik ala Muhammadin wa ala aali Muhammadin, kama baarakta ala aali Ibrahim" (Aye Allah! Muhammad, apne bande aur Rasool, par rehmat naazil kar, jaise Tu ne Ibrahim ki aal par ki, aur Muhammad aur unki aal par barkat naazil kar, jaise Tu ne Ibrahim ki aal par ki).' (Ravi Al-Laith ke mutaabik alfaaz thode farq se the: 'Ala Muhammadin wa ala aali Muhammadin kama baarakta ala aali Ibrahim.' Ravi Ibn Abi Hazim aur Ad-Darawardi ke mutaabik, Yazid ne kaha: 'Kama sallaita ala Ibrahima wa baarik ala Muhammadin wa aali Muhammadin kama baarakta ala Ibrahima wa aali Ibrahim.')

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Moses was a shy man, and that is what the Statement of Allah means: 'O you who believe Be not like those who annoyed Moses, but Allah proved his innocence of that which they alleged and he was honorable in Allah's Sight
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Musa (Alaihissalam) bahut sharmeele insaan the,' aur yahi Allah ke is farmaan ka matlab hai: 'Aye Iman waalo! Un logon jaisa mat bano jinhone Musa ko takleef pahunchaayi, magar Allah ne unhein us ilzaam se paak saabit kiya jo unpar lagaaya gaya, aur wo Allah ke nazdeek izzat waale the.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Prophet said, "When Allah decrees some order in the heaven, the angels flutter their wings indicating complete surrender to His saying which sounds like chains being dragged on rock. And when the state of fear disappears, they ask each other, "What has your Lord ordered? They say that He has said that which is true and just, and He is the Most High, the Most Great." (34.23). Then the stealthy listeners (devils) hear this order, and these stealthy listeners are like this, one over the other." (Sufyan, a sub-narrator demonstrated that by holding his hand upright and separating the fingers.) A stealthy listener hears a word which he will convey to that which is below him and the second will convey it to that which is below him till the last of them will convey it to the wizard or foreteller. Sometimes a flame (fire) may strike the devil before he can convey it, and sometimes he may convey it before the flame (fire) strikes him, whereupon the wizard adds to that word a hundred lies. The people will then say, 'Didn't he (i.e. magician) tell such-and-such a thing on such-and-such date?' So that magician is said to have told the truth because of the Statement which has been heard from the heavens
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab Allah aasman mein koi hukm tay karta hai, to farishte uski itaa'at mein poori tarah surrender karte hue apne par phadphadaate hain, jiski aawaaz pathar par zanjeer ghisaite jaane jaisi lagti hai. Jab (unke dilon se) khauf door ho jaata hai, to wo ek doosre se poochte hain, "Tumhaare Rab ne kya farmaya?" Wo kehte hain, "Haq baat, aur wo Sabse Buland, Sabse Azeem hai." (34:23) Phir chori-chhupe sunne wale (Shaitaan) is hukm ko sunte hain, aur ye chupke se sunne wale is tarah hote hain, ek doosre ke upar.' (Ravi Sufyan ne haath khada karke aur ungliyaan phaila kar isse samjhaaya.) 'Ek chupke se sunne wala ek lafz sunta hai jise wo apne neeche wale ko pahunchaata hai, aur doosra apne neeche wale ko, yahaan tak ke aakhri wala use jaadugar ya nujoomi (peshangoi karne wala) tak pahunchaata hai. Kabhi ek shola (chingari) Shaitaan ko us khabar ke pahunchaane se pehle hi jala deti hai, aur kabhi wo shole se pehle hi khabar pahuncha deta hai, phir jaadugar us baat mein sau jhoot mila deta hai. Log kehte hain, "Kya usne humein pehle nahi bataya tha ke falaan din falaan cheez hogi?" To us jaadugar ko sach bolne wala samjha jaata hai us ek baat ki wajah se jo aasman se suni gayi thi.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:One day the Prophet (ﷺ) ascended Safa mountain and said, "Oh Sabahah! " All the Quraish gathered round him and said, "What is the matter?" He said, Look, if I told you that an enemy is going to attack you in the morning or in the evening, would you not believe me?" They said, "Yes, we will believe you." He said, "I am a warner to you in face of a terrible punishment." On that Abu Lahab said, "May you perish ! Is it for this thing that you have gathered us?" So Allah revealed: 'Perish the hands of Abu Lahab
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek din Nabi (SAW) Safa pahaad par chadhe aur kaha, 'Aye Sabahah!' (khatre ka elaan). Saare Quraish unke gird jama ho gaye aur pucha, 'Kya baat hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Dekho, agar main tumhein bataun ke ek dushman subah ya shaam tumpar hamla karne wala hai, to kya tum mera yaqeen nahi karoge?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan, hum aapka yaqeen karenge.' Unhone farmaya, 'To main tumhein ek sakht azaab se pehle khabardaar karta hoon.' Isper Abu Lahab ne kaha, 'Tum barbaad ho! Kya isi liye tumne humein bulaaya hai?' To Allah ne naazil farmaya: 'Barbaad hon Abu Lahab ke haath...'

e: Narrated Abu Dharr:Once I was with the Prophet (ﷺ) in the mosque at the time of sunset. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Abu Dharr! Do you know where the sun sets?" I replied, "Allah and His Apostle know best." He said, "It goes and prostrates underneath (Allah's) Throne; and that is Allah's Statement:-- 'And the sun runs on its fixed course for a term (decreed). And that is the decree of All-Mighty, the All-Knowing
hi: Abu Dharr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar main Masjid mein Nabi (SAW) ke saath tha, suraj doobne ke waqt. Nabi (SAW) ne pucha, 'Aye Abu Dharr! Kya tumhein pata hai suraj kahaan doobta hai?' Maine jawab diya, 'Allah aur uske Rasool behtar jaante hain.' Unhone farmaya, 'Wo jaakar Arsh (Allah ke takht) ke neeche sajda karta hai, aur yahi Allah ke is farmaan ka matlab hai: "Aur suraj apne muqarrar waqt tak apni raah par chalta hai. Ye us Zabardast, Sab kuch Jaanne wale ka hukm hai."'

e: Narrated Abu Dharr:I asked the Prophet (ﷺ) about the Statement of Allah:-- 'And the sun runs on fixed course for a term (decreed), ' (36.38) He said, "Its course is underneath "Allah's Throne." (Prostration of Sun trees, stars. mentioned in Qur'an and Hadith does not mean like our prostration but it means that these objects are obedient to their Creator (Allah) and they obey for what they have been created for
hi: Abu Dharr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) se Allah ke is farmaan ke baare mein pucha, 'Aur suraj apne muqarrar waqt tak apni raah par chalta hai' (36:38). Unhone farmaya, 'Uska raasta Arsh (Allah ke takht) ke neeche hai.' (Suraj, darakhton aur sitaaron ka Quran aur Hadees mein 'sajda karna' zikr hona, hamare sajda karne jaisa nahi hai, balke iska matlab hai ke ye cheezein apne Khaaliq (Allah) ki farmaabardaar hain aur jis maqsad ke liye banaayi gayi hain uski itaa'at karti hain.)

e: Narrated `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Nobody has the right to be better than (Jonah) bin Matta
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kisi ko ye kehne ka haq nahi ke wo Yunus bin Matta se behtar hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who says that I am better than Jonah bin Matta, tells a lie
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi kahe ke main Yunus bin Matta se behtar hoon, wo jhoot bolta hai.'

e: Narrated Al-Awwam:I asked Mujahid regarding the prostration in Surat Sa`d. He said, "Ibn `Abbas was asked the same question and he said, 'Those are they (the prophets) whom Allah had Guided. So follow their guidance." (6.90) Ibn `Abbas used to perform a prostration (on reading this Sura)
hi: Al-Awwam bataate hain: Maine Mujahid se Surah Sa'd mein sajda ke baare mein pucha. Unhone kaha, 'Ibn Abbas se bhi yahi sawaal poocha gaya tha, unhone kaha, "Yahi wo (Nabi) hain jinhe Allah ne hidaayat di thi, isliye unki hidaayat ki pairvi karo." (6:90)' Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) is Surah ko padhte waqt sajda kiya karte the.

e: Narrated Al-Awwam:I asked Mujahid regarding the prostration in Surat Sa`d. He said, "I asked Ibn `Abbas, 'What evidence makes you prostrate?' He said, "Don't you recite:--'And among his progeny, David and Solomon..(6.84). Those are they whom Allah had guided. So follow their guidance.' (6.90) So David was the one of those prophets whom Prophet (Muhammad) was ordered to follow. David prostrated, so Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (Muhammad) performed this prostration too
hi: Al-Awwam bataate hain: Maine Mujahid se Surah Sa'd mein sajda ke baare mein pucha. Unhone kaha, 'Maine Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha, "Aap kis daleel se sajda karte hain?" Unhone kaha, "Kya tum ye nahi padhte: 'Aur unki naslon mein Dawood aur Sulaiman...' (6:84) 'Yahi wo (Nabi) hain jinhe Allah ne hidaayat di thi, isliye unki hidaayat ki pairvi karo.' (6:90) To Dawood bhi un Nabiyon mein se the jinki pairvi ka hukm Nabi (Muhammad SAW) ko diya gaya tha. Dawood ne sajda kiya tha, isliye Allah ke Rasool (Muhammad SAW) ne bhi ye sajda kiya."'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Last night a demon from the Jinns came to me (or the Prophet (ﷺ) said, a similar sentence) to disturb my prayer, but Allah gave me the power to overcome him. I intended to tie him to one of the pillars of the mosque till the morning so that all of you could see him, but then I remembered the Statement of my brother Solomon:--'My Lord! Forgive me and bestow on me a kingdom such as shall not belong to any other after me.' (38.35) The narrator added: Then he (the Prophet) dismissed him, rejected
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kal raat ek Jinn (Shaitaan) mera namaz mein khalal daalne aaya (ya isi tarah ki koi baat kahi), magar Allah ne mujhe usko qaabu karne ki taaqat di. Main chahta tha ke use Masjid ke kisi khambe se baandh doon subah tak, taake tum sab use dekh sako, magar phir mujhe apne bhai Sulaiman (Alaihissalam) ka ye qaul yaad aaya: "Aye mere Rab! Mujhe maaf farma, aur mujhe aisi saltanat de jo mere baad kisi aur ko na mile." (38:35)' Ravi ne aage kaha: Phir Nabi (SAW) ne use dhutkaar kar chhod diya.

e: Narrated Masruq:We came upon `Abdullah bin Mas`ud and he said "O people! If somebody knows something, he can say it, but if he does not know it, he should say, "Allah knows better,' for it is a sign of having knowledge to say about something which one does not know, 'Allah knows better.' Allah said to His Prophet: 'Say (O Muhammad ! ) No wage do I ask of You for this (Qur'an) nor am I one of the pretenders (a person who pretends things which do not exist).' (38.86) Now I will tell you about Ad- Dukhan (the smoke), Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) invited the Quraish to embrace Islam, but they delayed their response. So he said, "O Allah! Help me against them by sending on them seven years of famine similar to the seven years of famine of Joseph." So the famine year overtook them and everything was destroyed till they ate dead animals and skins. People started imagining to see smoke between them and the sky because of severe hunger. Allah said: 'Then watch you for the Day that the sky will bring forth a kind of smoke plainly visible, covering the people. . . This is painful torment.' (44.10-11) (So they invoked Allah) "Our Lord! Remove the punishment from us really we are believers." How can there be an (effectual) reminder for them when an Apostle, explaining things clearly, has already come to them? Then they had turned away from him and said: 'One taught (by a human being), a madman?' 'We shall indeed remove punishment for a while, but truly, you will revert (to disbelief).' (44.12-15) Will the punishment be removed on the Day of Resurrection?" `Abdullah added, "The punishment was removed from them for a while but they reverted to disbelief, so Allah destroyed them on the Day of Badr. Allah said: 'The day We shall seize you with a mighty grasp. We will indeed (then) exact retribution
hi: Masruq bataate hain: Hum Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Masud ke paas aaye, unhone kaha, 'Aye logo! Agar kisi ko koi baat pata ho, to wo use bataaye, magar agar nahi pata to kahe, "Allah behtar jaanta hai," kyunke ilm ka hi ek hissa ye kehna hai, "Allah behtar jaanta hai," jab kisi baat ka pata na ho. Allah ne apne Nabi se kaha: "Kaho (Aye Muhammad): Main is (Quran) ke badle tumse koi ujrat nahi maangta, aur na hi main jhoota dava karne wala hoon." (38:86) Ab main tumhein Ad-Dukhan (dhuein) ke baare mein bataata hoon. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Quraish ko Islam qubool karne ki dawat di, magar unhone jawab dene mein deri ki. To unhone kaha, "Aye Allah! Meri madad kar unke khilaaf, unpar Yusuf ke saat saal ke qehat jaisa saat saal ka qehat daal de." To qehat ka saal unpar aaya aur sab kuch tabaah ho gaya yahaan tak ke wo murda jaanwar aur khaal khaane lage. Log bhookh ki shiddat se aasman aur apne beech dhuaan jaisi cheez dekhne lage. Allah ne farmaya: "To (Aye Muhammad) us din ka intezaar karo jab aasman saaf zaahir dhuaan laayega jo logon ko dhaank lega; ye dardnaak azaab hai." (44:10-11) (Isper unhone Allah se dua ki) "Aye hamare Rab! Ye azaab hamse hata de, hum waaqai Iman laate hain." Unke liye naseehat ka kya fayda jabke unke paas ek saaf saaf samjhaane wala Rasool aa chuka tha, phir bhi unhone unse munh mod liya aur kaha, "Ye to kisi (insaan) ka sikhaaya hua hai, ye deewaana hai." "Hum kuch waqt ke liye azaab hataa denge, magar tum zaroor (kufr ki taraf) laut jaaoge." (44:12-15) Kya Qayamat ke din azaab hataaya jaayega?' Abdullah ne aage kaha, 'Kuch waqt ke liye unse azaab hataaya gaya, magar wo kufr ki taraf laut gaye, isliye Allah ne unhein Badr ke din tabaah kar diya. Allah ne farmaya: "Jis din Hum tumhein sakht pakad se pakdenge, Hum waaqai badla lenge."'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Some pagans who committed murders in great number and committed illegal sexual intercourse excessively, came to Muhammad and said, "O Muhammad! Whatever you say and invite people to, is good: but we wish if you could inform us whether we can make an expiation for our (past evil) deeds." So the Divine Verses came: 'Those who invoke not with Allah any other god, not kill such life as Allah has forbidden except for just cause, nor commit illegal sexual intercourse.' (25.68) And there was also revealed:-- 'Say: O My slaves who have transgressed against their souls! Despair not of the Mercy of Allah
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Kuch mushrik jinhone bahut zyaada qatl kiye the aur zyaadti se zina kiya tha, Muhammad (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha, 'Aye Muhammad! Jo kuch aap kehte hain aur jiski taraf log ko bulaate hain wo achha hai, magar hum jaanna chahte hain ke kya hum apne (pichhle) gunaahon ka kaffara ada kar sakte hain.' Isper ye Quraani Aayaten naazil hui: 'Jo log Allah ke saath kisi aur maabood ko nahi pukaarte, na haq ke bagair kisi jaan ko qatl karte jise Allah ne haraam kiya hai, na zina karte hain...' (25:68) Aur ye bhi naazil hui: 'Kaho: Aye mere bando jinhone apne aap par zyaadti ki hai, Allah ki rehmat se naa-umeed mat ho.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:A (Jewish) Rabbi came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he said, "O Muhammad! We learn that Allah will put all the heavens on one finger, and the earths on one finger, and the trees on one finger, and the water and the dust on one finger, and all the other created beings on one finger. Then He will say, 'I am the King.' Thereupon the Prophet (ﷺ) smiled so that his pre-molar teeth became visible, and that was the confirmation of the Rabbi. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) recited: 'They made not a just estimate of Allah such as is due to Him. And on the Day of Resurrection the whole of the earth will be grasped by His Hand and the heavens will be rolled up in His Right Hand. Glorified is He, and High is He above all that they associate as partners with Him
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek Yahudi rabbi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Aye Muhammad! Humein pata chala hai ke Allah saare aasmaanon ko ek ungli par, zameeno ko ek ungli par, darakhton ko ek ungli par, paani aur mitti ko ek ungli par, aur baaki saari makhlooq ko ek ungli par rakhega. Phir wo kahega, "Main hi Baadshaah hoon."' Isper Nabi (SAW) itne muskuraaye ke unke damle wale daant zaahir ho gaye, aur ye us rabbi ki baat ki tasdeeq thi. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ye Aayat padhi: 'Aur unhone Allah ki azmat ka haq waisa nahi pehchaana jaisa uska haq hai. Aur Qayamat ke din poori zameen uske haath mein hogi aur aasman uske daaye haath mein lipte huye honge. Wo paak hai aur us se bahut buland hai jo wo (uske saath) shareek thehraate hain.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "Allah will hold the whole earth, and roll all the heavens up in His Right Hand, and then He will say, 'I am the King; where are the kings of the earth?
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Allah poori zameen ko thaam lega aur saare aasmaanon ko apne daaye haath mein lapet lega, phir kahega, "Main hi Baadshaah hoon; zameen ke baadshaah kahaan hain?"'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I will be the first to raise my head after the second blowing of the trumpet and will see Moses hanging on the Throne, and I will not know whether he had been in that state all the time or after the blowing of the trumpet
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Doosre soor phoonke jaane ke baad sabse pehle sar uthaane wala main hounga, aur main Musa (Alaihissalam) ko Arsh se lipte hue paaunga, aur mujhe nahi pata ke wo hamesha se isi haalat mein the ya soor phoonke jaane ke baad (hosh mein aaye).'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Between the two blowing of the trumpet there will be forty." The people said, "O Abu Huraira! Forty days?" I refused to reply. They said, "Forty years?" I refused to reply and added: Everything of the human body will decay except the coccyx bone (of the tail) and from that bone Allah will reconstruct the whole body
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Do soor phoonke jaane ke darmiyaan chaalis (din/mahine/saal) ka faasla hoga.' Logon ne pucha, 'Aye Abu Huraira! Chaalis din?' Maine jawab dene se inkaar kiya. Unhone pucha, 'Chaalis saal?' Maine phir jawab dene se inkaar kiya aur (baad mein) kaha: Insaan ke jism ka har hissa gal jaayega siwaaye reedh ki haddi ke aakhri hisse (coccyx) ke, aur usi haddi se Allah poora jism dobara banaayega.

e: Narrated `Urwa bin Az-Zubair:I asked `Abdullah bin `Amr bin Al-`As to inform me of the worst thing the pagans had done to Allah's Apostle. He said: "While Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was praying in the courtyard of the Ka`ba, `Uqba bin Abi Mu'ait came and seized Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) by the shoulder and twisted his garment round his neck and throttled him severely. Abu Bakr came and seized `Uqba's shoulder and threw him away from Allah's Apostle and said, "Would you kill a man because he says: 'My Lord is Allah,' and has come to you with clear Signs from your Lord?
hi: Urwa bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-As se poocha ke mushrikeen ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath sabse buri harkat kya ki thi. Unhone kaha: 'Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Kaaba ke aangan mein namaz padh rahe the, Uqba bin Abi Mu'ait aaya aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke kandhe ko pakda aur unki chaadar unki gardan mein lapet kar unhein sakhti se dabaane laga. Abu Bakr aaye aur Uqba ka kandha pakad kar use Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se door phenka aur kaha, "Kya tum ek aise aadmi ko qatl karoge sirf isliye ke wo kehta hai, 'Mera Rab Allah hai,' aur tumhaare paas tumhaare Rab ki taraf se saaf nishaaniyaan lekar aaya hai?"'

e: Narrated Ibn Mas`ud:(regarding) the Verse: 'And you have not been screening against yourself lest your ears, and your eyes and your skins should testify against you..' (41.22) While two persons from Quraish and their brother-in-law from Thaqif (or two persons from Thaqif and their brother-in-law from Quraish) were in a house, they said to each other, "Do you think that Allah hears our talks?" Some said, "He hears a portion thereof" Others said, "If He can hear a portion of it, He can hear all of it." Then the following Verse was revealed: 'And you have not been screening against yourself lest your ears, and your eyes and your skins should testify against you
hi: Ibn Masud is Aayat ke baare mein bataate hain: 'Aur tum apne aap ko is baat se bacha nahi sakte the ke tumhaare kaan, tumhaari aankhen aur tumhaari khaal tumhaare khilaaf gawaahi dein...' (41:22) Do Quraishi log aur unke Thaqif qabeele ke bahnoi (ya do Thaqif log aur unka Quraish qabeele ka bahnoi) ek ghar mein the, unhone aapas mein kaha, 'Tumhaara kya khayaal hai, kya Allah hamaari baatein sunta hai?' Kuch ne kaha, 'Wo iska ek hissa sunta hai.' Doosron ne kaha, 'Agar wo iska ek hissa sun sakta hai, to wo poora bhi sun sakta hai.' Phir ye Aayat naazil hui: 'Aur tum apne aap ko is baat se bacha nahi sakte the ke tumhaare kaan, tumhaari aankhen aur tumhaari khaal tumhaare khilaaf gawaahi dein...'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:There gathered near the House (i.e. the Ka`ba) two Quraishi persons and a person from Thaqif (or two persons from Thaqif and one from Quraish), and all of them with very fat bellies but very little intelligence. One of them said, "Do you think that Allah hears what we say?" Another said, "He hears us when we talk in a loud voice, but He doesn't hear us when we talk in a low tone." The third said, "If He can hear when we talk in a loud tone, then He can also hear when we speak in a low tone." Then Allah, the Honorable, the Majestic revealed: 'And you have not been screening against yourself lest your ears, and eyes and your skins should testify against you....' (41.22-23) This hadith has been narrated through another chain as well
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Kaaba ke paas do Quraishi log aur Thaqif qabeele ka ek shaks (ya do Thaqif log aur ek Quraishi) jama hue, sab ke pet mote the magar aqal kam thi. Unmein se ek ne kaha, 'Tumhaara kya khayaal hai, kya Allah wo sunta hai jo hum kehte hain?' Doosre ne kaha, 'Jab hum buland aawaaz mein baat karte hain to wo sunta hai, magar jab hum halki aawaaz mein baat karte hain to nahi sunta.' Teesre ne kaha, 'Agar wo buland aawaaz sun sakta hai, to halki aawaaz bhi sun sakta hai.' Isper Allah, Izzat-o-Jalaal waale, ne naazil farmaya: 'Aur tum apne aap ko is baat se bacha nahi sakte the ke tumhaare kaan, tumhaari aankhen aur tumhaari khaal tumhaare khilaaf gawaahi dein...' (41:22-23) Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:That he was asked (regarding): "Except to be kind to me for my Kinship with you.' (42.23) Sa`id bin Zubair (who was present then) said, "It means here (to show what is due for) the relatives of Muhammad." On that Ibn `Abbas said: you have hurried in giving the answer! There was no branch of the tribe of Quraish but the Prophet (ﷺ) had relatives therein. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I do not want anything from (you ) except to be Kind to me for my Kinship with you
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se is Aayat ke baare mein pucha gaya: '...siwaaye ye ke mere rishte ki wajah se mujhse mohabbat rakho' (42:23). Saeed bin Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) (jo us waqt maujood the) ne kaha, 'Iska matlab hai Muhammad (SAW) ke rishtedaaron ke haq ka khayaal rakhna.' Isper Ibn Abbas ne kaha, 'Tumne jawab dene mein jaldi ki! Quraish ka koi khaandaan aisa nahi tha jismein Nabi (SAW) ke rishtedaar na hon. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, "Main tumse kuch nahi chahta siwaaye ye ke tum mere rishte ki wajah se mujhse mohabbat rakho."'

e: Narrated Ya`la:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) reciting when on the pulpit: 'They will cry, "O Malik (Keeper of Hell) Let your Lord make an end of us
hi: Ya'la bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko mimbar par ye Aayat padhte suna: 'Wo pukaarenge, "Aye Malik (Jahannam ke daroga)! Aapka Rab hamein khatam kar de (yaani maut de de)."'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:Five things have passed, i.e. the smoke, the defeat of the Romans, the splitting of the moon, Al-Batsha (the defeat of the infidels in the battle of Badr) and Al-Lizam (the punishment)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Paanch cheezein guzar chuki hain: Dhuaan, Romiyon ki shikast, Chaand ka phatna, Al-Batsha (yaani jang-e-Badr mein kaafiron ki shikast), aur Al-Lizam (yaani sakht saza).

e: Narrated `Abdullah:It (i.e., the imagined smoke) was because, when the Quraish refused to obey the Prophet, he asked Allah to afflict them with years of famine similar to those of (Prophet) Joseph. So they were stricken with famine and fatigue, so much so that they ate even bones. A man would look towards the sky and imagine seeing something like smoke between him and the sky because of extreme fatigue. So Allah revealed:-- 'Then watch you for the Day that the sky will bring forth a kind of smoke plainly visible, covering the people; this is a painful torment.' (44.10-11) Then someone (Abu Sufyan) came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Invoke Allah to send rain for the tribes of Mudar for they are on the verge of destruction." On that the Prophet (ﷺ) said (astonishingly) "Shall I invoke Allah) for the tribes of Mudar? Verily, you are a brave man!" But the Prophet prayed for rain and it rained for them. Then the Verse was revealed. 'But truly you will return (to disbelief).' (44.15) (When the famine was over and) they restored prosperity and welfare, they reverted to their ways (of heathenism) whereupon Allah revealed: 'On the Day when We shall seize you with a Mighty Grasp. We will indeed (then) exact retribution.' (44.16) The narrator said, "That was the day of the Battle of Badr
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Wo (jo dhuaan mehsoos hua tha) is wajah se tha ke jab Quraish ne Nabi (SAW) ki baat maanne se inkaar kiya, to unhone Allah se dua ki ke unpar Yusuf (Alaihissalam) jaise saal ka qehat daal de. To unhein qehat aur thakaan ne itna jakad liya ke wo haddiyaan tak khaane lage. Koi shaks aasman ki taraf dekhta to shiddat ki thakaan ki wajah se usse aur aasman ke beech dhuaan jaisi cheez mehsoos hoti. To Allah ne naazil farmaya: 'To (Aye Muhammad) us din ka intezaar karo jab aasman saaf zaahir dhuaan laayega jo logon ko dhaank lega; ye dardnaak azaab hai.' (44:10-11) Phir koi (Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ)) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Allah se Qabeela Mudar ke liye baarish ki dua kijiye, kyunke wo tabaahi ke kagaar par hain.' Isper Nabi (SAW) ne (hairaan hoke) kaha, 'Kya main Qabeela Mudar ke liye dua karoon? Waaqai tum bade himmat waale ho!' Magar Nabi (SAW) ne baarish ki dua ki aur unke liye baarish hui. Phir ye Aayat naazil hui: 'Magar tum zaroor (kufr ki taraf) laut jaaoge.' (44:15) (Jab qehat khatam hua aur) unhone khushhaali wapas paayi, to wo apne (jaahiliyat ke) purane raaste par laut gaye, isper Allah ne naazil farmaya: 'Jis din Hum tumhein sakht pakad se pakdenge, Hum waaqai badla lenge.' (44:16) Ravi kehte hain, 'Ye jang-e-Badr ka din tha.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:It is a sign of having knowledge that, when you do not know something, you say: 'Allah knows better.' Allah said to his Prophet: 'Say: No wage do I ask of you for this (Qur'an), nor am I one of the pretenders (a person who pretends things which do not exist)' (38.86) When the Quraish troubled and stood against the Prophet (ﷺ) he said, "O Allah! Help me against them by afflicting them with seven years of famine like the seven years of Joseph." So they were stricken with a year of famine during which they ate bones and dead animals because of too much suffering, and one of them would see something like smoke between him and the sky because of hunger. Then they said: Our Lord! Remove the torment from us, really we are believers. (44.12) And then it was said to the Prophet (by Allah), "If We remove it from them, they will revert to their ways (of heathenism)." So the Prophet (ﷺ) invoked his Lord, who removed the punishment from them, but later they reverted (to heathenism), whereupon Allah punished them on the day of the Battle of Badr, and that is what Allah's Statement indicates: 'Then watch for the day that the sky will bring forth a kind of smoke plainly visible...We will indeed (then) exact retribution
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ye ilm ka hi ek hissa hai ke jab tumhein kisi baat ka pata na ho, to tum kaho, 'Allah behtar jaanta hai.' Allah ne apne Nabi se kaha: 'Kaho: Main is (Quran) ke badle tumse koi ujrat nahi maangta, aur na hi main jhoota dava karne wala hoon.' (38:86) Jab Quraish ne Nabi (SAW) ko takleef di aur unke khilaaf khade ho gaye, to unhone kaha, 'Aye Allah! Meri madad kar unke khilaaf, unpar Yusuf jaise saat saal ka qehat daal de.' To unpar aisa qehat aaya ke wo bahut zyaada taklif ki wajah se haddiyaan aur murda jaanwar khaane lage, aur koi shaks bhook ki wajah se apne aur aasman ke beech dhuaan jaisi cheez dekhta. Phir unhone kaha: 'Aye hamare Rab! Ye azaab hamse hataa de, hum waaqai Iman laate hain.' (44:12) Phir Nabi (SAW) se (Allah ki taraf se) kaha gaya, 'Agar Hum ye unse hataa dein, to wo apne (jaahiliyat ke) purane raaste par laut jaayenge.' To Nabi (SAW) ne apne Rab se dua ki, jisne unse azaab hataa diya, magar baad mein wo (kufr ki taraf) laut gaye, isper Allah ne unhein jang-e-Badr ke din saza di, aur yahi Allah ke is farmaan ka matlab hai: 'To us din ka intezaar karo jab aasman saaf zaahir dhuaan laayega... Hum waaqai badla lenge.'

e: Narrated Masruq:I came upon `Abdullah and he said, "When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) invited Quraish (to Islam), they disbelieved him and stood against him. So he (the Prophet) said, "O Allah! Help me against them by afflicting them with seven years of famine similar to the seven years of Joseph.' So they were stricken with a year of drought that destroyed everything, and they started eating dead animals, and if one of them got up he would see something like smoke between him and the sky from the severe fatigue and hunger." `Abdullah then recited:-- 'Then watch you for the Day that the sky will bring forth a kind of smoke plainly visible, covering the people. This is a painful torment... (till he reached) ........ We shall indeed remove the punishment for a while, but truly you will revert (to heathenism): (44.10-15) `Abdullah added: "Will the punishment be removed from them on the Day of Resurrection?" He added," The severe grasp" was the Day of the Battle of Badr
hi: Masruq bataate hain: Main Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas aaya, unhone kaha, 'Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Quraish ko (Islam ki) dawat di, unhone unka inkaar kiya aur unke khilaaf khade ho gaye. To unhone (Nabi ne) kaha, "Aye Allah! Meri madad kar unke khilaaf, unpar Yusuf jaise saat saal ka qehat daal de." To unpar aisa qehat aaya jisne sab kuch tabaah kar diya, aur wo murda jaanwar khaane lage, aur agar unmein se koi khada hota to shiddat ki thakaan aur bhook ki wajah se usse aur aasman ke beech dhuaan jaisi cheez dikhti.' Abdullah ne phir ye Aayat padhi: 'To (Aye Muhammad) us din ka intezaar karo jab aasman saaf zaahir dhuaan laayega jo logon ko dhaank lega; ye dardnaak azaab hai... (yahaan tak ke) Hum kuch waqt ke liye azaab hataa denge, magar tum zaroor (kufr ki taraf) laut jaaoge.' (44:10-15) Abdullah ne aage kaha, 'Kya Qayamat ke din unse azaab hataaya jaayega?' Unhone aage kaha, '"Sakht pakad" jang-e-Badr ka din tha.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:Allah sent (the Prophet) Muhammad and said:-- 'Say, No wage do I ask of you for this (Qur'an) nor am I one of the pretenders (i.e. a person who pretends things which do not exist). (38.68) When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw Quraish standing against him, he said, "O Allah! Help me against them by afflicting them with seven years of famine similar to the seven years (of famine) of Joseph. So they were afflicted with a year of drought that destroyed everything, and they ate bones and hides. (One of them said), "And they ate hides and dead animals, and (it seemed to them that) something like smoke was coming out of the earth. So Abu Sufyan came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Muhammad! Your people are on the verge of destruction! Please invoke Allah to relieve them." So the Prophet (ﷺ) invoked Allah for them (and the famine disappeared). He said to them. "You will revert (to heathenism) after that." `Abdullah then recited: 'Then watch you for the Day that the sky will bring forth a kind of smoke plainly visible.......but truly you will revert (to disbelief).' He added, "Will the punishment be removed from them in the Hereafter? The smoke and the grasp and the Al-Lizam have all passed." One of the sub-narrators said, "The splitting of the moon." And another said, "The defeat of the Romans (has passed)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ne Muhammad (SAW) ko bheja aur farmaya: 'Kaho: Main is (Quran) ke badle tumse koi ujrat nahi maangta, aur na hi main jhoota dava karne wala hoon.' (38:86) Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Quraish ko apne khilaaf khada dekha, to unhone kaha, 'Aye Allah! Meri madad kar unke khilaaf, unpar Yusuf jaise saat saal ka qehat daal de.' To unpar aisa qehat aaya jisne sab kuch tabaah kar diya, aur wo haddiyaan aur khaal khaane lage. (Kisi ravi ne kaha,) 'Aur wo khaal aur murda jaanwar khaate the, aur (unhein lagta) ke zameen se dhuaan jaisi cheez nikal rahi hai.' To Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ) Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha, 'Aye Muhammad! Aapki qaum tabaahi ke kagaar par hai! Barah-e-meharbaani Allah se dua kijiye ke unhein raahat mile.' To Nabi (SAW) ne unke liye Allah se dua ki (aur qehat khatam ho gaya). Unhone unse kaha, 'Iske baad tum (kufr ki taraf) laut jaaoge.' Abdullah ne phir padha: 'To us din ka intezaar karo jab aasman saaf zaahir dhuaan laayega... magar tum zaroor (kufr ki taraf) laut jaaoge.' Unhone aage kaha, 'Kya Aakhirat mein unse azaab hataaya jaayega? Dhuaan, sakht pakad aur Al-Lizam sab guzar chuke hain.' Ek ravi ne kaha, 'Chaand ka phatna,' aur doosre ne kaha, 'Romiyon ki shikast (bhi guzar chuki hai).'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:Five things have passed: Al-Lizam, the defeat of the Romans, the mighty grasp, the splitting of the moon, and the smoke
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Paanch cheezein guzar chuki hain: Al-Lizam (sakht saza), Romiyon ki shikast, Sakht Pakad, Chaand ka phatna, aur Dhuaan.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah said, 'The son of Adam hurts me for he abuses Time though I am Time: in My Hands are all things, and I cause the revolution of day and night
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah farmaata hai, "Aadam ka beta mujhe takleef pahunchaata hai kyunke wo Zamaane (waqt) ko bura-bhala kehta hai, jabke Main hi Zamaana hoon; sab cheezein Mere haath mein hain, Main hi din aur raat ka chakkar chalaata hoon."'

e: Narrated Yusuf bin Mahak:Marwan had been appointed as the governor of Hijaz by Muawiya. He delivered a sermon and mentioned Yazid bin Muawiya so that the people might take the oath of allegiance to him as the successor of his father (Muawiya). Then `Abdur Rahman bin Abu Bakr told him something whereupon Marwan ordered that he be arrested. But `Abdur-Rahman entered `Aisha's house and they could not arrest him. Marwan said, "It is he (`AbdurRahman) about whom Allah revealed this Verse:-- 'And the one who says to his parents: 'Fie on you! Do you hold out the promise to me..?'" On that, `Aisha said from behind a screen, "Allah did not reveal anything from the Qur'an about us except what was connected with the declaration of my innocence (of the slander)
hi: Yusuf bin Mahak bataate hain: Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Marwan ko Hijaz ka governor muqarrar kiya tha. Marwan ne ek khutba diya aur Yazid bin Muawiya ka zikr kiya taake log unhein apne waalid (Muawiya) ke jaanasheen ke taur par baiat kar lein. Isper Abdur Rahman bin Abu Bakr ne unse kuch kaha, jispar Marwan ne unhein giraftaar karne ka hukm diya. Magar Abdur Rahman Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke ghar mein daakhil ho gaye aur wo unhein giraftaar nahi kar sake. Marwan ne kaha, 'Yahi wo shaks hai jiske baare mein Allah ne ye Aayat naazil ki: "Aur wo shaks jo apne waalidain se kehta hai, 'Uff tumpar! Kya tum mujhse waada karte ho ke...'"' Isper Aisha ne parde ke peechhe se kaha, 'Allah ne humaare baare mein Quran mein sirf wahi naazil kiya jo meri be-gunaahi ki tasdeeq se mutaalliq tha (Ifk ke ilzaam ke silsile mein).'

e: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet), I never saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) laughing loudly enough to enable me to see his uvula, but he used to smile only. And whenever he saw clouds or winds, signs of deep concern would appear on his face. I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! When people see clouds they usually feel happy, hoping that it would rain, while I see that when you see clouds, one could notice signs of dissatisfaction on your face." He said, "O `Aisha! What is the guarantee for me that there will be no punishment in it, since some people were punished with a wind? Verily, some people saw (received) the punishment, but (while seeing the cloud) they said, 'This cloud will give us rain
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine kabhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko itni zor se hansta nahi dekha ke main unka kauva (halq ka andar wala hissa) dekh sakoon, wo sirf muskuraaya karte the. Aur jab bhi wo baadal ya hawa dekhte, unke chehre par fikr ke aasaar zaahir ho jaate. Maine (unse) kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Log to baadal dekh kar khush hote hain ye ummeed karte hue ke baarish hogi, jabke maine dekha hai ke jab aap baadal dekhte hain, to aapke chehre par be-chaini ke aasaar nazar aate hain.' Unhone farmaya, 'Aye Aisha! Mujhe kya zamaanat hai ke isme koi azaab nahi hoga, jabke kuch logon ko (aage) hawa se saza mili thi? Kuch logon ne (azaab) dekha (magar unhone use pehchaana nahi) aur (baadal dekh kar) kaha, "Ye baadal humpar baarish barsaayega."'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah created His creation, and when He had finished it, the womb, got up and caught hold of Allah whereupon Allah said, "What is the matter?' On that, it said, 'I seek refuge with you from those who sever the ties of Kith and kin.' On that Allah said, 'Will you be satisfied if I bestow My favors on him who keeps your ties, and withhold My favors from him who severs your ties?' On that it said, 'Yes, O my Lord!' Then Allah said, 'That is for you.' " Abu Huraira added: If you wish, you can recite: "Would you then if you were given the authority. do mischief in the land and sever your ties of kinship
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah ne apni makhlooq banaayi, aur jab wo iska kaam khatam kar chuka, to Rehm (kokh) khadi hui aur Allah ko pakad liya. Isper Allah ne pucha, "Kya baat hai?" Rehm ne kaha, "Main teri panaah maangti hoon un logon se jo rishtedaari ke rishton ko todte hain." Allah ne kaha, "Kya tu isse khush hogi ke Main us par apni meharbaani karoon jo tera (rishta) qaayam rakhe, aur usse rok loon jo tera rishta tode?" Rehm ne kaha, "Haan, aye mere Rab!" Phir Allah ne kaha, "Ye tere liye hai."' Abu Huraira ne aage kaha, 'Chaho to padho: "Kya agar tumhein hukoomat mil jaaye to tum zameen mein fasaad phailaaoge aur apni rishtedaari ke rishte todoge?"'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:(As above, No. 354, but added) Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Recite if you wish: "Would you then
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: (Upar wali hadees jaisi hi, magar isme ye izaafa hai) Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Chaho to padho: "Kya agar tum (hukoomat mein) ho jaao to..."'

e: Narrated Muawiya bin Abi Al-Muzarrad:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), said, "Recite if you wish: Would you then if you were given the authority
hi: Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Al-Muzarrad bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Chaho to padho: "Kya agar tumhein hukoomat mil jaaye to..."'

e: Narrated Aslam:While Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was proceeding at night during one of his journeys and `Umar bin Al-Khattab was traveling beside him, `Umar asked him about something but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not reply. He asked again, but he did not reply, and then he asked (for the third time) but he did not reply. On that, `Umar bin Al-Khattab said to himself, "Thakilat Ummu `Umar (May `Umar's mother lose her son)! I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) three times but he did not reply." `Umar then said, "I made my camel run faster and went ahead of the people, and I was afraid that some Qur'anic Verses might be revealed about me. But before getting involved in any other matter. I heard somebody calling me. I said to myself, 'I fear that some Qur'anic Verses have been revealed about me,' and so I went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and greeted him. He (Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ) said, 'Tonight a Sura has been revealed to me, and it is dearer to me than that on which the sun rises (i.e. the world)' Then he recited: "Verily, We have given you a manifest victory
hi: Aslam bataate hain: Ek safar mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) raat ko chal rahe the aur Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab unke saath the, Umar ne unse kuch pucha magar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne jawab nahi diya. Unhone dobara pucha, phir bhi jawab nahi diya, phir teesri baar pucha, phir bhi jawab nahi diya. Isper Umar bin Al-Khattab ne apne dil mein kaha, 'Thakilat Ummu Umar (kaash Umar ki maa apna beta kho de)! Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se teen baar pucha magar unhone jawab nahi diya.' Umar ne aage kaha, 'Maine apne oont ko tez daudaaya aur logon se aage nikal gaya, aur mujhe dar hua ke kahin mere baare mein koi Quraani Aayat naazil na ho. Magar iske pehle ke kisi aur baat mein ulajhoon, maine kisi ko mujhe bulaate suna. Maine dil mein socha, "Mujhe dar hai ke mere baare mein koi Quraani Aayat naazil ho gayi hai," to main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaya aur salaam kiya. Unhone farmaya, "Aaj raat mujhpar ek Surah naazil hui hai, jo mujhe us (duniya) se zyaada aziz hai jispar suraj chamakta hai." Phir unhone padha: "Beshak Humne tumhein khuli fatah di hai."'

e: Narrated Anas:"Verily, We have given you (O Muhammad) a manifest victory.' refers to Al-Hudaibiya Peace treaty
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: 'Beshak Humne aapko (Aye Muhammad) khuli fatah di hai,' iska matlab hai Hudaibiya ki sulah (sandhi).

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Mughaffal:On the Day of the Conquest of Mecca, the Prophet (ﷺ) recited Surat Al-Fath in a vibrating and pleasant voice. (Muawiya, the sub-narrator said, "If I could imitate the recitation of the Prophet (ﷺ) I would do so
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Mughaffal bataate hain: Fatah-e-Makkah ke din, Nabi (SAW) ne Surah Al-Fath ko ek khoobsurat, laraztaa hui aawaaz mein padha. (Ravi Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) kehte hain, 'Agar main Nabi (SAW) ki tilawat ki nakal kar sakta, to zaroor karta.')

e: Narrated Al-Mughira:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to offer night prayers till his feet became swollen. Somebody said, to him," "Allah has forgiven you, your faults of the past and those to follow." On that, he said, "Shouldn't I be a thankful slave of Allah)?
hi: Al-Mughira bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) itni raaton ki namaz padhte the ke unke pair soojh jaate. Kisi ne unse kaha, 'Allah ne to aapke agle-pichhle sab gunaah maaf kar diye hain (isliye itni mehnat kyun)?' Isper unhone farmaya, 'To kya main Allah ka shukr-guzaar banda na banoon?'

e: Narrated Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to offer prayer at night (for such a long time) that his feet used to crack. I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Why do you do it since Allah has forgiven you your faults of the past and those to follow?" He said, "Shouldn't I love to be a thankful slave (of Allah)?' When he became old, he prayed while sitting, but if he wanted to perform a bowing, he would get up, recite (some other verses) and then perform the bowing
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) raat ko itni der tak namaz padhte ke unke pair phat jaate. Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Aap aisa kyun karte hain jabke Allah ne aapke agle-pichhle sab gunaah maaf kar diye hain?' Unhone farmaya, 'To kya mujhe Allah ka shukr-guzaar banda na banna chaahiye?' Jab wo budhe ho gaye, to baithkar namaz padhte, magar jab ruku karna hota to khade hokar (kuch Aayaten) padhte, phir ruku karte.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr bin Al-As:This Verse: 'Verily We have sent you (O Muhammad) as a witness, as a bringer of glad tidings and as a warner.' (48.8) which is in the Qur'an, appears in the Torah thus: 'Verily We have sent you (O Muhammad) as a witness, as a bringer of glad tidings and as a warner, and as a protector for the illiterates (i.e., the Arabs.) You are my slave and My Apostle, and I have named you Al-Mutawakkil (one who depends upon Allah). You are neither hard-hearted nor of fierce character, nor one who shouts in the markets. You do not return evil for evil, but excuse and forgive. Allah will not take you unto Him till He guides through you a crooked (curved) nation on the right path by causing them to say: "None has the right to be worshipped but Allah." With such a statement He will cause to open blind eyes, deaf ears and hardened hearts
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-As bataate hain: Ye Aayat, 'Beshak Humne aapko (Aye Muhammad) gawaah, khush-khabri dene wala aur khabardaar karne wala bana kar bheja hai' (48:8), jo Quran mein hai, Tauret mein is tarah aati hai: 'Beshak Humne tumhein gawaah, khush-khabri dene wala, khabardaar karne wala, aur an-parhon (yaani Arabon) ka hifaazat karne wala bana kar bheja hai. Tum Mera banda aur Mera Rasool ho, aur Maine tumhaara naam Al-Mutawakkil (Allah par bharosa karne wala) rakha hai. Tum na sakht-dil ho, na tund-mizaaj, na bazaaron mein shor machaane wale. Tum buraai ka badla buraai se nahi dete, balke maaf karte ho aur darguzar karte ho. Allah tumhein apni taraf tab tak nahi bulaayega jab tak wo tumhaare zariye ek tedhi (bigdi hui) qaum ko seedhe raaste par na le aaye, unhein ye kehne par majboor karke: "Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi." Isi kalime ke zariye wo andhi aankhon, behre kaanon aur sakht dilon ko khol dega.'

e: Narrated Al-Bara:While a man from the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) was reciting (Qur'an) and his horse was tied in the house, the horse got startled and started jumping. The man came out, looked around but could not find anything, yet the horse went on jumping. The next morning he mentioned that to the Prophet. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "That was the tranquility (calmness) which descended because of the recitation of the Qur'an
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Jab Nabi (SAW) ke ek sahaabi Quran padh rahe the aur unka ghoda ghar mein baandha hua tha, ghoda achaanak bhadak gaya aur uchalne laga. Wo shaks baahar aaya, chaaron taraf dekha magar kuch nahi mila, phir bhi ghoda uchalta raha. Agli subah unhone ye baat Nabi (SAW) ko bataayi. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Wo sukoon (Sakina) thi jo Quran ki tilawat ki wajah se naazil hui thi.'

e: Narrated Jabir:We were one thousand and four hundred on the Day of Al-Hudaibiya
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Hudaibiya ke din chaudah sau (1400) log the.

e: Narrated `Uqba bin Suhban:`Abdullah bin Mughaffal Al-Muzani who was one of those who witnessed (the event of) the tree, said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the throwing of small stones (with two fingers)
hi: Uqba bin Suhban bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Mughaffal Al-Muzani, jo un logon mein se the jinhone (darakht ke waaqiye) ki gawaahi di thi, ne kaha, 'Nabi (SAW) ne (do ungliyon se) chhote kankar phenkne se mana kiya tha.'

e: Abdullah bin Al-Mughaffal Al-Muzani also said:"The Prophet (ﷺ) also forbade urinating at the place where one takes a bath
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Mughaffal Al-Muzani ne ye bhi kaha: 'Nabi (SAW) ne us jagah peshaab karne se bhi mana kiya jahaan koi nahaata hai.'

e: Narrated Thabit bin Ad-Dahhak:who was one of the companions of the tree (those who swore allegiance to the Prophet (ﷺ) beneath the tree at Al-Hudaibiya):
hi: Thabit bin Ad-Dahhak, jo un logon mein se the jinhone Hudaibiya mein darakht ke neeche Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki baiat ki thi, bataate hain:

e: Narrated Habib bin Abi Thabit:I went to Abu Wail to ask him (about those who had rebelled against `Ali). On that Abu Wail said, "We were at Siffin (a city on the bank of the Euphrates, the place where the battle took place between `Ali and Muawiya) A man said, "Will you be on the side of those who are called to consult Allah's Book (to settle the dispute)?" `Ali said, 'Yes (I agree that we should settle the matter in the light of the Qur'an)." ' Some people objected to `Ali's agreement and wanted to fight. On that Sahl bin Hunaif said, 'Blame yourselves! I remember how, on the day of Al-Hudaibiya (i.e. the peace treaty between the Prophet (ﷺ) and the Quraish pagans), if we had been allowed to choose fighting, we would have fought (the pagans). At that time `Umar came (to the Prophet) and said, "Aren't we on the right (path) and they (pagans) in the wrong? Won't our killed persons go to Paradise, and theirs in the Fire?" The Prophet replied, "Yes." `Umar further said, "Then why should we let our religion be degraded and return before Allah has settled the matter between us?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O the son of Al-Khattab! No doubt, I am Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Allah will never neglect me." So `Umar left the place angrily and he was so impatient that he went to Abu Bakr and said, "O Abu Bakr! Aren't we on the right (path) and they (pagans) on the wrong?" Abu Bakr said, "O the son of Al-Khattab! He is Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and Allah will never neglect him." Then Sura Al-Fath (The Victory) was revealed
hi: Habib bin Abi Thabit bataate hain: Main Abu Wail ke paas gaya unse un logon ke baare mein poochne jinhone Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke khilaaf baghaawat ki thi. Isper Abu Wail ne kaha: Hum Siffin mein the (Farat nadi ke kinaare wala shehar, jahaan Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke darmiyaan jang hui thi). Ek shaks ne pucha, 'Kya aap unke saath honge jo Allah ki Kitaab se faisla karwaane ki dawat dete hain (maamla suljhaane ke liye)?' Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha, 'Haan (main mante hoon ke maamla Quran ki roshni mein tay karna chaahiye).' Kuch logon ne Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke is faisle par aitraaz kiya aur jang karna chaahte the. Isper Sahl bin Hunaif ne kaha: Apne aap ko malaamat karo! Mujhe yaad hai Hudaibiya ke din (yaani Nabi (SAW) aur Quraish mushrikeen ke darmiyaan sulah ki sandhi), agar humein jang karne ka ikhtiyaar diya jaata, to hum zaroor (mushrikeen se) jang karte. Us waqt Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) (Nabi ke paas) aaye aur kaha, 'Kya hum haq par nahi hain aur wo (mushrikeen) baatil par nahi? Kya hamaare maare gaye log Jannat mein nahi jaayenge, aur unke Jahannam mein nahi?' Nabi (SAW) ne jawab diya, 'Haan.' Umar ne aage kaha, 'To phir hum apne deen ko zaleel kyun hone dein aur Allah ke hamaare beech faisla karne se pehle kyun laut jaayein?' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Aye Ibn Al-Khattab! Beshak main Allah ka Rasool hoon aur Allah mujhe kabhi zaya nahi karega.' To Umar naaraaz hokar wahaan se chale gaye, aur be-sabra hokar Abu Bakr ke paas gaye aur kaha, 'Aye Abu Bakr! Kya hum haq par nahi hain aur wo (mushrikeen) baatil par?' Abu Bakr ne kaha, 'Aye Ibn Al-Khattab! Wo Allah ke Rasool hain, aur Allah unhe kabhi zaya nahi karega.' Phir Surah Al-Fath (Fatah) naazil hui.

e: Narrated Ibn Abi Mulaika:The two righteous persons were about to be ruined. They were Abu Bakr and `Umar who raised their voices in the presence of the Prophet (ﷺ) when a mission from Bani Tamim came to him. One of the two recommended Al-Aqra' bin Habis, the brother of Bani Mujashi (to be their governor) while the other recommended somebody else. (Nafi`, the sub-narrator said, I do not remember his name). Abu Bakr said to `Umar, "You wanted nothing but to oppose me!" `Umar said, "I did not intend to oppose you." Their voices grew loud in that argument, so Allah revealed: 'O you who believe! Raise not your voices above the voice of the Prophet.' (49.2) Ibn Az-Zubair said, "Since the revelation of this Verse, `Umar used to speak in such a low tone that the Prophet (ﷺ) had to ask him to repeat his statements." But Ibn Az-Zubair did not mention the same about his (maternal) grandfather (i.e. Abu Bakr)
hi: Ibn Abu Mulaika bataate hain: Do neik log tabaah hote hote bache - Abu Bakr aur Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ), jinhone Nabi (SAW) ki maujoodgi mein apni aawaazein buland ki jab Banu Tamim ka ek wafd unke paas aaya. Unmein se ek ne Al-Aqra' bin Habis, Banu Mujashi ke bhai, ki (governor ke taur par) sifaarish ki, jabke doosre ne kisi aur ki sifaarish ki. (Ravi Nafi kehte hain: Mujhe uska naam yaad nahi.) Abu Bakr ne Umar se kaha, 'Tum sirf mera muqaabla karna chahte the!' Umar ne kaha, 'Mera iraada tumhaara muqaabla karne ka nahi tha.' Unki behas mein aawaazein buland ho gayin, isper Allah ne naazil farmaya: 'Aye Iman waalo! Apni aawaazein Nabi ki aawaaz se buland mat karo.' (49:2) Ibn Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) kehte hain, 'Is Aayat ke naazil hone ke baad, Umar itni dhimi aawaaz mein baat karte the ke Nabi (SAW) ko unse apni baat dohraane ko kehna padta.' Magar Ibn Az-Zubair ne apne (naani ke taraf se) daada, yaani Abu Bakr, ke baare mein aisi koi baat zikr nahi ki.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) missed Thabit bin Qais for a period (So he inquired about him). A man said. "O Allah's Apostle! I will bring you his news." So he went to Thabit and found him sitting in his house and bowing his head. The man said to Thabit, " 'What is the matter with you?" Thabit replied that it was an evil affair, for he used to raise his voice above the voice of the Prophet (ﷺ) and so all his good deeds had been annulled, and he considered himself as one of the people of the Fire. Then the man returned to the Prophet (ﷺ) and told him that Thabit had said, so-and-so. (Musa bin Anas) said: The man returned to Thabit with great glad tidings. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to the man. "Go back to him and say to him: "You are not from the people of the Hell Fire, but from the people of Paradise
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne Thabit bin Qais ko kuch waqt tak nahi dekha (aur unke baare mein poocha). Ek shaks ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Main aapke liye unki khabar laata hoon.' To wo Thabit ke paas gaye aur unhe ghar mein baithe, sar jhukaaye paaya. Us shaks ne Thabit se pucha, 'Kya baat hai?' Thabit ne jawab diya ke ye ek buri baat hai, kyunke wo Nabi (SAW) ki aawaaz se apni aawaaz buland kiya karte the, isliye unke sab nek amal zaya ho gaye hain, aur wo khud ko Jahannami samajhte hain. Phir wo shaks Nabi (SAW) ke paas laut gaya aur unhe bataaya ke Thabit ne aisi aisi baat kahi. (Ravi Musa bin Anas kehte hain:) Wo shaks bahut achhi khush-khabri leke Thabit ke paas wapas gaya. Nabi (SAW) ne us shaks se kaha, 'Wapas jao aur unse kaho: Tum Jahannam waalon mein se nahi ho, balke Jannat waalon mein se ho.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Az-Zubair:A group of Bani Tamim came to the Prophet (and requested him to appoint a governor for them). Abu Bakr said, "Appoint Al-Qaqa bin Mabad." `Umar said, "Appoint Al-Aqra' bin Habis." On that Abu Bakr said (to `Umar). "You did not want but to oppose me!" `Umar replied "I did not intend to oppose you!" So both of them argued till their voices grew loud. So the following Verse was revealed: 'O you who believe! Be not forward
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Banu Tamim ka ek giroh Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya (aur unse apne liye ek governor muqarrar karne ki darkhwaast ki). Abu Bakr ne kaha, 'Al-Qaqa bin Ma'bad ko muqarrar kijiye.' Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Al-Aqra' bin Habis ko muqarrar kijiye.' Isper Abu Bakr ne (Umar se) kaha, 'Tum sirf mera muqaabla karna chahte the!' Umar ne jawab diya, 'Mera iraada tumhaara muqaabla karne ka nahi tha!' To dono mein behas hui yahaan tak ke unki aawaazein buland ho gayin. To ye Aayat naazil hui: 'Aye Iman waalo! Aage mat badho...'

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The people will be thrown into the (Hell) Fire and it will say: "Are there any more (to come)?' (50.30) till Allah puts His Foot over it and it will say, 'Qati! Qati! (Enough Enough)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Logon ko Jahannam mein dala jaayega aur wo kahega, "Kya aur (log) nahi hain?"' (50:30) 'Yahaan tak ke Allah apna Qadam usme rakhega aur wo kahega, "Bas! Bas! (Kaafi hai! Kaafi hai!)"'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:(that the Prophet (ﷺ) said) "It will be said to the Hell, 'Are you filled?' It will say, 'Are there any more (to come)?' On that Allah will put His Foot on it, and it will say 'Qati! Qati! (Enough! Enough)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: (Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya) 'Jahannam se kaha jaayega, "Kya tu bhar gaya?" Wo kahega, "Kya aur (log) nahi hain?"' Isper Allah apna Qadam usme rakhega, aur wo kahega, 'Bas! Bas! (Kaafi hai! Kaafi hai!)'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Paradise and the Fire (Hell) argued, and the Fire (Hell) said, "I have been given the privilege of receiving the arrogant and the tyrants.' Paradise said, 'What is the matter with me? Why do only the weak and the humble among the people enter me?' On that, Allah said to Paradise. 'You are My Mercy which I bestow on whoever I wish of my servants.' Then Allah said to the (Hell) Fire, 'You are my (means of) punishment by which I punish whoever I wish of my slaves. And each of you will have its fill.' As for the Fire (Hell), it will not be filled till Allah puts His Foot over it whereupon it will say, 'Qati! Qati!' At that time it will be filled, and its different parts will come closer to each other; and Allah will not wrong any of His created beings. As regards Paradise, Allah will create a new creation to fill it with
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jannat aur Jahannam mein behas hui. Jahannam ne kaha, "Mujhe takabbur karne walon aur zaalimon ko lene ka khaas martaba diya gaya hai." Jannat ne kaha, "Mujhe kya ho gaya hai? Sirf kamzor aur aajiz log hi mujhme kyun daakhil hote hain?" Isper Allah ne Jannat se farmaya, "Tu Meri rehmat hai jo Main apne bandon mein se jise chaahoon usko deta hoon." Phir Allah ne Jahannam se farmaya, "Tu Meri saza hai jiske zariye Main apne bandon mein se jise chaahoon saza deta hoon. Aur tum dono, har ek ko apni bharpoori miilegi."' Jahannam tab tak nahi bharega jab tak Allah apna Qadam usme na rakhe, jispar wo kahega, "Bas! Bas!" Us waqt wo bhar jaayega, aur uske alag hisse ek doosre ke qareeb aa jaayenge; aur Allah apni banaayi hui kisi bhi makhlooq par zulm nahi karega. Aur Jannat ke liye, Allah ek nayi makhlooq paida karke usse bhar dega.'

e: Narrated Jarir bin `Abdullah:We were in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) on a fourteenth night (of the lunar month), and he looked at the (full) moon and said, "You will see your Lord as you see this moon, and you will have no trouble in looking at Him. So, whoever can, should not miss the offering of prayers before sunrise (Fajr prayer) and before sunset (`Asr prayer)." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) recited: 'And celebrate the praises of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before (its) setting
