hi: Jarir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Nabi (SAW) ke saath (chaandi mahine ki) chaudhvin raat ko the, unhone (poore) chaand ki taraf dekha aur farmaya, 'Tum apne Rab ko aise dekhoge jaise tum is chaand ko dekh rahe ho, aur tumhein use dekhne mein koi mushkil nahi hogi. To jo bhi kar sake, use suraj nikalne se pehle (Fajr) aur suraj doobne se pehle (Asr) ki namaz kabhi na chhodni chaahiye.' Phir Nabi (SAW) ne padha: 'Aur apne Rab ki tareef ke saath tasbeeh karo, suraj nikalne se pehle aur uske doobne se pehle...'

e: Narrated Mujahid:Ibn `Abbas said, "Allah ordered His Prophet to celebrate Allah's praises after all prayers." He refers to His Statement: 'After the prayers
hi: Mujahid bataate hain: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Allah ne apne Nabi ko hukm diya ke wo har namaz ke baad Allah ki tasbeeh karein.' Ye Allah ke is farmaan ki taraf ishara hai: 'Namazon ke baad...'

e: Narrated Um Salama:I complained to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that I was sick, so he said, "Perform the Tawaf (of Ka`ba at Mecca) while riding behind the people (who are performing the Tawaf on foot)." So I performed the Tawaf while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was offering the prayer by the side of the Ka`ba and was reciting: 'By the Mount (Sinai) and by a Decree Inscribed
hi: Umm Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se apni bimaari ki shikaayat ki, to unhone farmaya, 'Tawaf (Kaaba ka) logon ke peechhe sawaari par baithkar karo (jo paidal Tawaf kar rahe hain).' To maine Tawaf kiya jabke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Kaaba ke ek taraf namaz padha rahe the aur ye Aayat padh rahe the: 'Qasam hai Toor (Sina Pahaad) ki, aur ek likhi hui Kitaab ki...'

e: Narrated Jubair bin Mut`im:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) reciting Surat at-Tur in the Maghrib prayer, and when he reached the Verse: 'Were they created by nothing, Or were they themselves the creators, Or did they create the Heavens and the Earth? Nay, but they have no firm belief Or do they own the treasures of Your Lord? Or have they been given the authority to do as they like...' (52.35-37) my heart was about to fly (when I realized this firm argument)
hi: Jubair bin Mut'im bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko Maghrib ki namaz mein Surah At-Toor padhte suna, aur jab wo is Aayat par pahunche: 'Kya wo bagair kisi (khaaliq) ke paida hue, ya wo khud apne khaaliq hain? Ya unhone aasmaan aur zameen ko paida kiya? Nahi, balke unhein yaqeen hi nahi. Ya kya unke paas tumhaare Rab ke khazaane hain? Ya wo (sab par) ikhtiyaar rakhte hain?' (52:35-37) - to mera dil (is mazboot dalil ko samajhkar) ud jaane ko tha.

e: Narrated Masruq:I said to `Aisha, "O Mother! Did Prophet Muhammad see his Lord?" Aisha said, "What you have said makes my hair stand on end ! Know that if somebody tells you one of the following three things, he is a liar: Whoever tells you that Muhammad saw his Lord, is a liar." Then Aisha recited the Verse: 'No vision can grasp Him, but His grasp is over all vision. He is the Most Courteous Well-Acquainted with all things.' (6.103) 'It is not fitting for a human being that Allah should speak to him except by inspiration or from behind a veil.' (42.51) `Aisha further said, "And whoever tells you that the Prophet knows what is going to happen tomorrow, is a liar." She then recited: 'No soul can know what it will earn tomorrow.' (31.34) She added: "And whoever tells you that he concealed (some of Allah's orders), is a liar." Then she recited: 'O Apostle! Proclaim (the Message) which has been sent down to you from your Lord..' (5.67) `Aisha added, "But the Prophet (ﷺ) saw Gabriel in his true form twice
hi: Masruq bataate hain: Maine Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se kaha, 'Aye Ammi! Kya Nabi Muhammad (SAW) ne apne Rab ko dekha tha?' Aisha ne kaha, 'Jo tumne kaha usse mere baal khade ho gaye! Jaan lo ke agar koi tumhein in teen baaton mein se koi ek kahe, to wo jhoota hai: jo koi tumse kahe ke Muhammad ne apne Rab ko dekha hai, wo jhoota hai.' Phir Aisha ne ye Aayat padhi: 'Nazrein use paa nahi sakti, magar uski pakad tamaam nazron par hai. Wo bade rehmat waala aur har cheez se khoob waaqif hai.' (6:103) 'Kisi bhi insaan ke liye ye mumkin nahi ke Allah usse seedhe baat kare, siwaaye wahi ke zariye ya parde ke peechhe se.' (42:51) Aisha ne aage kaha, 'Aur jo koi tumse kahe ke Nabi (SAW) ko pata hai kal kya hoga, wo jhoota hai.' Phir unhone ye padha: 'Koi jaan nahi jaanti wo kal kya kamaayegi.' (31:34) Unhone aage kaha, 'Aur jo koi tumse kahe ke unhone (Allah ke hukmon mein se) kuch chhupaaya, wo jhoota hai.' Phir unhone ye padha: 'Aye Rasool! Jo aapke Rab ki taraf se aap par naazil kiya gaya hai, use pahuncha dijiye...' (5:67) Aisha ne aage kaha, 'Magar Nabi (SAW) ne Jibrael ko unki asal soorat mein do baar dekha tha.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:Regarding the Verses: 'And was at a distance of but two bow-lengths or (even) nearer; So did (Allah) convey the Inspiration to His slave (Gabriel) and then he Gabriel) conveyed (that to Muhammad...' (53.9-10) Ibn Mas`ud narrated to us that the Prophet (ﷺ) had seen Gabriel with six hundred wings
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Is Aayat ke baare mein: 'Aur wo (fasla) do kamaanon ki lambaai ke barabar ya usse bhi kam tha; to Allah ne apne bande (Jibrael) ko wahi bheji jo unhone (Muhammad ko) pahunchaayi...' (53:9-10) Ibn Masud ne humein bataaya ke Nabi (SAW) ne Jibrael ko chhe sau (600) par waale (soorat mein) dekha tha.

e: Narrated Ash-Shaibani:I asked Zirr about the Statement of Allah: 'And was at a distance of but two bow-lengths or (even) nearer. So did Allah convey the Inspiration to His slave (Gabriel) and then he (Gabriel) conveyed that to Muhammad.' (53.10) He said, "Abdullah (bin Mas`ud) informed us that Muhammad had seen Gabriel with six hundred wings
hi: Ash-Shaibani bataate hain: Maine Zirr se Allah ke is farmaan ke baare mein pucha, 'Aur wo (fasla) do kamaanon ki lambaai ke barabar ya usse bhi kam tha; to Allah ne apne bande (Jibrael) ko wahi bheji jo unhone (Muhammad ko) pahunchaayi...' (53:10) Unhone kaha, 'Abdullah (bin Masud) ne humein bataaya ke Muhammad (SAW) ne Jibrael ko chhe sau (600) par waale (soorat mein) dekha tha.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:(regarding the revelation) Truly he (Muhammad) did see of the signs of his Lord; the Greatest!' (53.18) The Prophet (ﷺ) saw a green screen covering the horizon
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: (Is wahi ke baare mein) 'Beshak unhone (Muhammad ne) apne Rab ki badi nishaaniyon mein se dekhi!' (53:18) Nabi (SAW) ne ek hara parda dekha jo poora ufaq (kshitij) dhaanke hue tha.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:(regarding His Statement about the Lat and the `Uzza: Lat was originally a man who used to mix Sawiq for the pilgrim)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) is Aayat ke baare mein bataate hain jismein Laat aur Uzza (do jaahili but) ka zikr hai: 'Laat asal mein ek aadmi tha jo Hajj karne walon ke liye Sawiq (jau ka aata) ghol-mila kar taiyaar karta tha.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whomever takes an oath in which he mentions Lat and `Uzza (forgetfully), should say: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah, and whoever says to his companion. 'Come along, let us gamble' must give alms (as an expiation)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi qasam khaate waqt (bhool se) Laat aur Uzza ka naam le le, use kehna chaahiye: Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi. Aur jo koi apne saathi se kahe, "Aao juaa khelein," use (iske kaffare mein) sadqa dena chaahiye.'

e: Narrated `Urwa:I asked `Aisha (regarding the Sai between As Safa and Al-Marwa). She said, "Out of reverence to the idol Manat which was placed in Al-Mushallal, those who used to assume Ihram in its name, used not to perform Sai between As-Safa and Al-Marwa, so Allah revealed: 'Verily! The As-Safa and Al-Marwa (two mountains at Mecca) are among the symbols of Allah.' (2.158). Thereupon, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and the Muslims used to perform Sai (between them)." Sufyan said: The (idol) Manat was at Al-Mushallal in Qudaid. `Aisha added, "The Verse was revealed in connection with the Ansar. They and (the tribe of) Ghassan used to assume Ihram in the name of Manat before they embraced Islam." `Aisha added, "There were men from the Ansar who used to assume Ihram in the name of Manat which was an idol between Mecca and Medina. They said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We used not to perform the Tawaf (Sai) between As-Safa and Al-Marwa out of reverence to Manat
hi: Urwa bataate hain: Maine Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se (Safa aur Marwa ke darmiyaan Sai ke baare mein) pucha. Unhone kaha, 'Manat but ki izzat ki wajah se, jo Al-Mushallal mein rakha hua tha, jo log uske naam par Ihram baandhte the wo Safa aur Marwa ke darmiyaan Sai nahi karte the, isliye Allah ne naazil farmaya: "Beshak Safa aur Marwa (Makkah ke do pahaad) Allah ki nishaaniyon mein se hain." (2:158) Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur Musalmaan (dono ke darmiyaan) Sai karne lage.' Ravi Sufyan kehte hain: Manat (but) Qudaid mein Al-Mushallal mein tha. Aisha ne aage kaha, 'Ye Aayat Ansaar ke silsile mein naazil hui thi. Wo aur Ghassan qabeela Islam laane se pehle Manat ke naam par Ihram baandhte the.' Aisha ne aage kaha, 'Ansaar mein kuch aise log the jo Manat, jo Makkah aur Madina ke beech ek but tha, ke naam par Ihram baandhte the. Unhone kaha, "Aye Allah ke Rasool! Hum Manat ki izzat ki wajah se Safa aur Marwa ke darmiyaan Tawaf (Sai) nahi karte the."'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) performed a prostration when he finished reciting Surat-an-Najm, and all the Muslims and pagans and Jinns and human beings prostrated along with him
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne Surah An-Najm padhne ke baad sajda kiya, aur sab Musalmaan, mushrikeen, Jinnat aur insaan unke saath sajde mein chale gaye.

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The first Sura in which a prostration was mentioned, was Sura An-Najm (The Star). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prostrated (while reciting it), and everybody behind him prostrated except a man whom I saw taking a hand-full of dust in his hand and prostrated on it. Later I saw that man killed as an infidel, and he was Umaiya bin Khalaf
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Sabse pehli Surah jismein sajda ka zikr hua wo Surah An-Najm (Sitaara) thi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (ise padhte hue) sajda kiya, aur unke peechhe sab logon ne bhi sajda kiya, siwaaye ek shaks ke jise maine ek mutthi mitti uthaakar usi par sajda karte dekha. Baad mein maine us shaks ko kaafir ki haisiyat mein maara hua dekha, aur wo Umaiya bin Khalaf tha.

e: Narrated Ibn Masud:During the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) the moon was split into two parts; one part remained over the mountain, and the other part went beyond the mountain. On that, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Witness this miracle
hi: Ibn Masud bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ki zindagi mein chaand do tukdon mein taqseem ho gaya; ek tukda pahaad ke upar raha aur doosra pahaad ke us paar chala gaya. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Is mojze ki gawaahi do.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The moon was cleft asunder while we were in the company of the Prophet, and it became two parts. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, Witness, witness (this miracle)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Chaand do tukdon mein bant gaya jab hum Nabi (SAW) ke saath the. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Gawaah raho, gawaah raho (is mojze ke).'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The moon was cleft asunder during the lifetime of the Prophet
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Chaand Nabi (SAW) ki zindagi mein do tukdon mein bant gaya tha.

e: Narrated Anas:The people of Mecca asked the Prophet (ﷺ) to show them a sign (miracle). So he showed them (the miracle) of the cleaving of the moon
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Makkah walon ne Nabi (SAW) se ek nishaani (mojza) dikhaane ki darkhwaast ki. To unhone unhein chaand ke phatne ka mojza dikhaaya.

e: Narrated Anas:The moon was cleft asunder into two parts
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Chaand do tukdon mein bant gaya tha.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Masud:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to recite: "Fahal-min-Maddakir (then is there any that will receive admonition?)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Masud bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) 'Fahal-min-Muddakir' (yaani 'Kya koi hai jo naseehat haasil kare?') padha karte the.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Masud:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to recite: "Fahal-min-Maddakir (then is there any that will receive admonition?)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Masud bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) 'Fahal-min-Muddakir' padha karte the.

e: Narrated Abu 'Is-haq:A man asked Al-Aswad, 'is it 'Fahal min-Muddakir' or'..Mudhdhakir?" Al Aswad replied, 'I have heard `Abdullah bin Masud reciting it, 'Fahal-min Muddakir'; I too, heard the Prophet (ﷺ) reciting it 'Fahal-min-Muddakir' with 'd
hi: Abu Ishaq bataate hain: Ek shaks ne Al-Aswad se pucha, 'Kya ye "Fahal-min-Muddakir" hai ya "Mudhdhakir"?' Al-Aswad ne jawab diya, 'Maine Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Masud ko ise "Fahal-min-Muddakir" padhte suna hai; aur maine khud bhi Nabi (SAW) ko ise "Fahal-min-Muddakir" (daal ke saath) padhte suna hai.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Masud: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to recite: "Fahal-min-Maddakir (then is there any that will receive admonition?)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Masud bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) 'Fahal-min-Muddakir' padha karte the.

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) recited: 'Fahal-min Muddakir': 'And verily, We have destroyed nations like unto you; then is there any that will receive admonition?
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne padha, 'Fahal-min-Muddakir': 'Aur beshak Humne tum jaisi kayi ummaton ko tabaah kiya, to kya koi hai jo naseehat haasil kare?'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:I recited before the Prophet (ﷺ) 'Fahal-min-Mudhdhakir'. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It is Fahal-min Muddakir
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ke saamne 'Fahal-min-Mudhdhakir' padha. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ye "Fahal-min-Muddakir" hai.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while in a tent on the day of the Battle of Badr, said, "O Allah! I request you (to fulfill) Your promise and contract! O Allah! If You wish that you will not be worshipped henceforth.." On that Abu Bakr held the Prophet (ﷺ) by the hand and said, "That is enough, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) You have appealed to your Lord too pressingly," while the Prophet (ﷺ) was putting on his armor. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went out, reciting Their multitude will be put to flight, and they will show their backs
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jang-e-Badr ke din apne khaime mein, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Aye Allah! Main Tujhse Tera waada aur ahad poora karne ki darkhwaast karta hoon! Aye Allah! Agar Tu chaahe to (Musalmaanon ke shikast khaane ke baad) Teri ibaadat kabhi nahi ki jaayegi.' Isper Abu Bakr ne Nabi (SAW) ka haath pakad liya aur kaha, 'Bas kijiye, Aye Allah ke Rasool! Aapne apne Rab se bahut zor de kar dua ki hai,' jabke Nabi (SAW) apna zirah pehen rahe the. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) baahar nikle, ye padhte hue: 'Unki jamaat abhi bhaagegi aur wo peeth dikha denge.'

e: Narrated Yusuf bin Mahak:I was in the house of `Aisha, the mother of the Believers. She said, "This revelation: "Nay, but the Hour is their appointed time (for their full recompense); and the Hour will be more previous and most bitter." (54.46) was revealed to Muhammad at Mecca while I was a playful little girl
hi: Yusuf bin Mahak bataate hain: Main Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا), Ummul-Momineen, ke ghar mein tha. Unhone kaha, 'Ye wahi: "Balke Qayamat hi unke (poore badle ke) muqarrar waqt ki jagah hai; aur Qayamat bahut hi sakht aur kadwi hogi" (54:46), Makkah mein Muhammad (SAW) par naazil hui thi jab main ek khelti-koodti chhoti ladki thi.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:While in his tent on the day the Battle of Badr, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! I request You (to fulfill) Your promise and contract. O Allah! It You wish that the Believers be destroyed). You will never be worshipped henceforth." On that, Abu Bakr held the Prophet (ﷺ) by the hand and said, "That is enough, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! You have appealed to your Lord too pressingly" The Prophet (ﷺ) was wearing his armor and then went out reciting: 'Their multitude will be put to flight and they will show their backs. Nay, but the Hour is their appointed time (for their full recompense), and the Hour will be more previous and most bitter
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jang-e-Badr ke din apne khaime mein, Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Aye Allah! Main Tujhse Tera waada aur ahad poora karne ki darkhwaast karta hoon. Aye Allah! Agar Tu chaahe (ke Momineen tabaah ho jaayein), to Teri ibaadat kabhi nahi ki jaayegi.' Isper Abu Bakr ne Nabi (SAW) ka haath pakad liya aur kaha, 'Bas kijiye, Aye Allah ke Rasool! Aapne apne Rab se bahut zor de kar dua ki hai.' Nabi (SAW) apna zirah pehne hue the, phir wo baahar nikle, ye padhte hue: 'Unki jamaat abhi bhaagegi aur wo peeth dikha denge. Balke Qayamat hi unke (poore badle ke) muqarrar waqt ki jagah hai, aur Qayamat bahut hi sakht aur kadwi hogi.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Qais:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Two gardens, the utensils and the contents of which are of silver, and two other gardens, the utensils and contents of which are of gold. And nothing will prevent the people who will be in the Garden of Eden from seeing their Lord except the curtain of Majesty over His Face
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Qais bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Do baagh hain jinke bartan aur cheezein chaandi ki hain, aur do aur baagh hain jinke bartan aur cheezein sone ki hain. Aur Jannat-ul-Adan (baagh-e-adan) mein rehne walon ko apne Rab ko dekhne se sirf uski Azmat ka parda hi rokega.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Qais:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "In Paradise there is a pavilion made of a single hollow pearl sixty miles wide, in each corner of which there are wives who will not see those in the other corners; and the believers will visit and enjoy them. And there are two gardens, the utensils and contents of which are made of silver; and two other gardens, the utensils and contents of which are made of so-and-so (i.e. gold) and nothing will prevent the people staying in the Garden of Eden from seeing their Lord except the curtain of Majesty over His Face
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Qais bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jannat mein ek khaas khaima hai jo ek khokhle moti se bana hai, saath meel chauda; uske har kone mein biwiyaan hongi jo doosre konon mein rehne walon ko nahi dekhengi, aur momineen unse milne aayenge aur unke saath khushiyaan manaayenge. Aur do baagh hain jinke bartan aur cheezein chaandi ki hain, aur do aur baagh hain jinke bartan aur cheezein falaan (yaani sone) ki hain, aur Jannat-ul-Adan mein rehne walon ko apne Rab ko dekhne se sirf uski Azmat ka parda hi rokega.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "In Paradise there is a tree which is so big that a rider can travel in its shade for one hundred years without passing it; and if you wish, you can recite: 'In shade long extended
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jannat mein ek darakht hai itna bada ke ek sawaar sau saal tak uske saaye mein safar kare phir bhi wo khatam na ho. Chaho to padho: "Lambe phaile hue saaye mein."'

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:I asked Ibn `Abbas about Surat Al-Tauba, and he said, "Surat Al-Tauba? It is exposure (of all the evils of the infidels and the hypocrites). And it continued revealing (that the oft-repeated expression): '...and of them ...and of them.' till they started thinking that none would be left unmentioned therein." I said, "What about) Surat Al-Anfal?" He replied, "Surat Al-Anfal was revealed in connection with the Badr Battle." I said, "(What about) Surat Al-Hashr?" He replied, "It was revealed in connection with Bani an-Nadir
hi: Saeed bin Jubair bataate hain: Maine Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se Surah At-Tauba ke baare mein pucha, unhone kaha, 'Surah At-Tauba? Ye (munaafiqon aur kaafiron ke tamaam gunaahon ka) parda-faash karti hai. Aur ye baar baar aati rahi (jismein baar baar dohraaya jaata hai): "...aur unmein se... aur unmein se..." yahaan tak ke unhein laga ke shaayad koi bhi is se bacha na rahega jiska zikr na ho.' Maine pucha, '(Aur) Surah Al-Anfal (ke baare mein kya)?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Surah Al-Anfal jang-e-Badr ke silsile mein naazil hui thi.' Maine pucha, '(Aur) Surah Al-Hashr?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Ye Banu An-Nadir ke silsile mein naazil hui thi.'

e: Narrated Sa`id:I asked Ibn `Abbas about Surat Al-Hashr. He replied, "Say Surat An-Nadir
hi: Saeed bataate hain: Maine Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se Surah Al-Hashr ke baare mein pucha. Unhone jawab diya, 'Kaho Surah An-Nadir.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:'Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) burnt and cut down the palm trees of Bani An-Nadir which were at Al-Buwaira (a place near Medina). There upon Allah revealed: 'What you (O Muslims) cut down of the palm trees (of the enemy) or you left them standing on their stems, it was by the leave of Allah, so that He might cover with shame the rebellious
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Banu An-Nadir ke khajoor ke darakhton ko jala diya aur kaat diya jo Al-Buwaira (Madina ke qareeb ek jagah) mein the. Isper Allah ne naazil farmaya: 'Tumne (Aye Musalmaano) jo bhi khajoor ke darakht (dushman ke) kaate, ya unhein unke tanon par khada chhod diya, ye sab Allah ki ijaazat se tha, taake wo sarkash logon ko ruswaa kare.'

e: Narrated `Umar:The properties of Bani An-Nadir were among the booty that Allah gave to His Apostle such Booty were not obtained by any expedition on the part of Muslims, neither with cavalry, nor with camelry. So those properties were for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) only, and he used to provide thereof the yearly expenditure for his wives, and dedicate the rest of its revenues for purchasing arms and horses as war material to be used in Allah's Cause
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Banu An-Nadir ki jaayadaadein us maal-e-ganimat mein se thin jo Allah ne apne Rasool (SAW) ko diya, aisi ganimat jo Musalmaanon ne kisi mohim mein na oont se na ghode se haasil ki thi. To ye jaayadaadein sirf Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke liye thin, aur wo unse apni biwiyon ke saalana kharche ke liye maal deate the, aur baaki aamdani hathiyaar aur ghode kharidne ke liye Allah ki raah mein jihaad ke saamaan ke taur par waqf kar dete the.

e: Narrated Alqama:`Abdullah (bin Masud) said, "Allah curses those ladies who practice tattooing and those who get themselves tattooed, and those ladies who remove the hair from their faces and those who make artificial spaces between their teeth in order to look more beautiful whereby they change Allah's creation." His saying reached a lady from Bani Asad called Um Yaqub who came (to `Abdullah) and said, "I have come to know that you have cursed such-and-such (ladies)?" He replied, "Why should I not curse these whom Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has cursed and who are (cursed) in Allah's Book!" Um Yaqub said, "I have read the whole Qur'an, but I did not find in it what you say." He said, "Verily, if you have read it (i.e. the Qur'an), you have found it. Didn't you read: 'And whatsoever the Apostle gives you take it and whatsoever he forbids you, you abstain (from it). (59.7) She replied, "Yes, I did," He said, "Verily, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade such things." "She said, "But I see your wife doing these things?" He said, "Go and watch her." She went and watched her but could not see anything in support of her statement. On that he said, "If my wife was as you thought, I would not keep her in my company
hi: Alqama bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Masud ne kaha, 'Allah un auraton par laanat kare jo gudna (tattoo) banaati hain aur jo gudna banwaati hain, aur jo apne chehre ke baal nochti hain, aur jo khoobsurati ke liye apne daanton ke beech kritrim faasla banaati hain, is tarah Allah ki paidaish ko badalti hain.' Ye baat Banu Asad ki ek khaatoon, Umm Yaqub, tak pahunchi, wo (Abdullah ke paas) aayi aur kaha, 'Mujhe pata chala hai ke aapne aisi aisi (auraton) par laanat ki hai?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Main un logon par laanat kyun na karoon jinpar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne laanat ki hai aur jo Allah ki Kitaab mein (bhi mal'oon) hain!' Umm Yaqub ne kaha, 'Maine poora Quran padha hai, magar mujhe usme aapki kahi hui baat nahi mili.' Unhone kaha, 'Agar tumne ise (Quran ko) padha hota, to tumhein wo mil jaati. Kya tumne nahi padha: "Aur Rasool jo kuch tumhein dein wo le lo, aur jis cheez se mana karein usse ruk jaao"?' (59:7) Usne jawab diya, 'Haan, maine padha hai.' Unhone kaha, 'Beshak Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne aisi cheezon se mana kiya hai.' Usne kaha, 'Magar main to dekh rahi hoon aapki biwi bhi ye kaam karti hain?' Unhone kaha, 'Jaao aur unhein dekho.' Wo gayi aur unhein dekha magar apne dawe ke haq mein kuch nahi paaya. Isper unhone kaha, 'Agar meri biwi waisi hoti jaisa tum sochti ho, to main use apne saath na rakhta.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah (bin Mas'ud):Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has cursed the lady who uses false hair
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Masud bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne us aurat par laanat ki jo nakli baal (wig) lagaati hai.

e: Narrated `Umar:I recommend that my successor should take care of and secure the rights of the early emigrants; and I also advise my successor to be kind to the Ansar who had homes (in Medina) and had adopted the Faith, before the Prophet (ﷺ) migrated to them, and to accept the good from their good ones and excuse their wrong doers
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main apne jaanasheen ko sifaarish karta hoon ke wo pehle Muhaajireen ka khayaal rakhein aur unke haqon ki hifaazat karein; aur main apne jaanasheen ko ye bhi naseehat karta hoon ke wo un Ansaar ke saath achha sulook karein jinke Madina mein ghar the aur jo Nabi (SAW) ke hijrat karne se pehle hi Iman le aaye the, aur unke achhe logon se achhaai qubool karein aur unke bure logon ko maaf karein.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:A man came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I am suffering from fatigue and hunger." The Prophet (ﷺ) sent (somebody) to his wives (to get something), but the messenger found nothing with them. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said (to his companions). "Isn't there anybody who can entertain this man tonight so that Allah may be merciful to him?" An Ansari man got up and said, "I (will, entertain him), O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" So he went to his wife and said to her, "This is the guest of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), so do not keep anything away from him." She said. "By Allah, I have nothing but the children's food." He said, "When the children ask for their dinner, put them to bed and put out the light; we shall not take our meals tonight," She did so. In the morning the Ansari man went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who said, "Allah was pleased with (or He bestowed His Mercy) on so-and-so and his wife (because of their good deed)." Then Allah revealed: 'But give them preference over themselves even though they were in need of that
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Main thakaan aur bhookh se pareshaan hoon.' Nabi (SAW) ne apni azwaaj ke paas (kuch mangwaane) bheja, magar bheje gaye shaks ko unke paas kuch nahi mila. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (apne sahaaba se) kaha, 'Kya koi hai jo aaj raat is shaks ki mehmaan-nawaazi kare, taake Allah uspar reham kare?' Ek Ansaari shaks khade hue aur kaha, 'Main karunga, Aye Allah ke Rasool!' To wo apni biwi ke paas gaye aur kaha, 'Ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka mehmaan hai, isse kuch bhi mat rokna.' Usne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, mere paas bachchon ke khaane ke siwa kuch nahi hai.' Unhone kaha, 'Jab bacche khaana maangein, to unhein so jaane do aur diya bujha do; hum aaj raat khaana nahi khaayenge.' Usne aisa hi kiya. Subah Ansaari shaks Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaye, unhone farmaya, 'Allah falaan aur uski biwi se khush hua (ya unpar apni rehmat naazil ki), (unke is nek kaam ki wajah se).' Phir Allah ne naazil farmaya: 'Balke wo apni zaroorat ke bawajood doosron ko apne aap par tarjeeh dete hain...'

e: Narrated `Ali:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent me along with Az-Zubair and Al-Miqdad and said, "Proceed till you reach a place called Raudat-Khakh where there is a lady travelling in a howda on a camel. She has a letter. Take the letter from her." So we set out, and our horses ran at full pace till we reached Raudat Khakh, and behold, we saw the lady and said (to her), "Take out the letter!" She said, "I have no letter with me." We said, "Either you take out the letter or we will strip you of your clothes." So she took the letter out of her hair braid. We brought the letter to the Prophet (ﷺ) and behold, it was addressed by Hatib bin Abi Balta'a to some pagans at Mecca, informing them of some of the affairs of the Prophet. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "What is this, O Hatib?" Hatib replied, "Do not be hasty with me, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I am an Ansari man and do not belong to them (Quraish infidels) while the emigrants who were with you had their relatives who used to protect their families and properties at Mecca. So, to compensate for not having blood relation with them.' I intended to do them some favor so that they might protect my relatives (at Mecca), and I did not do this out of disbelief or an inclination to desert my religion." The Prophet then said (to his companions), "He (Hatib) has told you the truth." `Umar said, "O Allah's Apostle! Allow me to chop his head off?" The Apostle said, "He is one of those who witnessed (fought in) the Battle of Badr, and what do you know, perhaps Allah looked upon the people of Badr (Badr warriors) and said, 'Do what you want as I have forgiven you.' " (`Amr, a sub-narrator, said,: This Verse was revealed about him (Hatib): 'O you who believe! Take not My enemies and your enemies as friends or protectors.' (60.1) Narrated `Ali: Sufyan was asked whether (the Verse): 'Take not My enemies and your enemies...' was revealed in connection with Hatib. Sufyan replied, "This occurs only in the narration of the people. I memorized the Hadith from `Amr, not overlooking even a single letter thereof, and I do not know of anybody who remembered it by heart other than myself
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Al-Miqdad (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath bheja aur kaha, 'Jao yahaan tak ke Raudat-Khakh naami ek jagah pahuncho, jahaan ek aurat oont par howdah mein safar kar rahi hogi. Uske paas ek khat hai. Wo khat usse le lo.' To hum nikle aur hamare ghode poori raftaar se daude yahaan tak ke hum Raudat-Khakh pahunche, aur waaqai wahaan wo aurat mili, humne (usse) kaha, 'Khat nikaalo!' Usne kaha, 'Mere paas koi khat nahi hai.' Humne kaha, 'Ya to khat nikaalo, ya hum tumhaare kapde utaar denge.' To usne khat apni chuti hui zulf mein se nikaala. Hum wo khat Nabi (SAW) ke paas laaye, aur wo Hatib bin Abi Balta'a ki taraf se Makkah ke kuch mushrikeen ke naam likha hua tha, jismein Nabi (SAW) ke kuch maamlaat ki khabar di gayi thi. Nabi (SAW) ne pucha, 'Ye kya hai, aye Hatib?' Hatib ne jawab diya, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mere saath jaldbaazi mat kijiye! Main Ansaari nahi hoon aur mera Quraish se koi taalluq nahi, jabke jo Muhaajireen aapke saath hain unke Makkah mein rishtedaar hain jo unke ghar-baar aur maal ki hifaazat karte hain. To unke saath khoon ke rishte na hone ki bhar-paai ke liye, maine socha unki kuch madad kar doon taake wo mere rishtedaaron ki (Makkah mein) hifaazat karein, aur maine ye kufr ya deen se phirne ki wajah se nahi kiya.' Nabi (SAW) ne (apne sahaaba se) farmaya, 'Isne (Hatib ne) tumse sach kaha hai.' Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe ijaazat dijiye ke main uska sar kaat doon!' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ye jang-e-Badr mein shareek honay walon mein se hai, aur tumhein kya pata, shaayad Allah ne Badr walon ko dekh kar farmaya ho, "Jo chaaho karo, Maine tumhein maaf kar diya."' (Ravi Amr kehte hain: Ye Aayat Hatib ke silsile mein naazil hui: 'Aye Iman waalo! Mere aur apne dushmanon ko dost ya madadgaar mat banaao.' (60:1)) Ravi Ali (Alayhis Salam) kehte hain: Sufyan se pucha gaya ke kya ye Aayat, 'Mere aur apne dushmanon ko...' Hatib ke silsile mein naazil hui, Sufyan ne jawab diya, 'Ye sirf logon ki riwayat mein aata hai. Maine ye hadees Amr se zabaani yaad ki, ek harf bhi chhoote bagair, aur mujhe nahi maloom ke mere siwa kisi aur ne ise zabaani yaad kiya ho.'

e: Narrated `Urwa:Aisha the wife of the Prophet, said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to examine the believing women who migrated to him in accordance with this Verse: 'O Prophet! When believing women come to you to take the oath of allegiance to you... Verily! Allah is Oft-Forgiving Most Merciful.' (60.12) `Aisha said, "And if any of the believing women accepted the condition (assigned in the above-mentioned Verse), Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) would say to her. "I have accepted your pledge of allegiance." "He would only say that, for, by Allah, his hand never touched, any lady during that pledge of allegiance. He did not receive their pledge except by saying, "I have accepted your pledge of allegiance for that
hi: Urwa bataate hain: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا), Nabi ki zawja, ne kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apne paas hijrat karke aane wali momin auraton ka imtihaan is Aayat ke mutaabik lete the: "Aye Nabi! Jab momin auraten aapke paas aayein aapse baiat karne ke liye... Beshak Allah bada maaf karne wala, bahut reham karne wala hai." (60:12)' Aisha ne kaha, 'Aur agar koi momin aurat is (upar zikr ki gayi) shart ko qubool kar leti, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) usse kehte, "Maine tumhaari baiat qubool kar li."' Wo bas itna hi kehte, kyunke Allah ki qasam, baiat ke dauraan unka haath kabhi kisi aurat ko chhoota tak nahi. Wo sirf itna kehkar hi baiat qubool karte, 'Maine tumhaari baiat is baat par qubool ki.'

e: Narrated Um Atiya:We took the oath of allegiance to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he recited to us: 'They will not associate anything in worship with Allah,' and forbade us to bewail the dead. Thereupon a lady withdrew her hand (refrained from taking the oath of allegiance), and said, "But such-and-such lady lamented over one of my relatives, so I must reward (do the same over the dead relatives of) hers." The Prophet (ﷺ) did not object to that, so she went (there) and returned to the Prophet (ﷺ) so he accepted her pledge of allegiance
hi: Umm Atiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Humne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se baiat ki, unhone humein padh kar sunaya: 'Wo Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek nahi thehraayengi,' aur humein murde par bain (matam) karne se mana kiya. Isper ek aurat ne apna haath khainch liya (baiat karne se ruk gayi) aur kaha, 'Magar falaan aurat ne mere ek rishtedaar ki maut par bain kiya tha, to mujhe bhi uska badla dena hoga (uske murde rishtedaar par bain karke).' Nabi (SAW) ne isper aitraaz nahi kiya, to wo gayi (aur bain karke) wapas Nabi (SAW) ke paas aayi, phir unhone uski baiat qubool kar li.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Regarding the saying of Allah: 'And they will not disobey you in any just matter.' (60.12) That was one of the conditions which Allah imposed on The believing) women (who came to take the oath of allegiance to the Prophet)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) Allah ke is farmaan ke baare mein bataate hain: 'Aur wo kisi jaayez baat mein aapki na-farmaani nahi karengi' (60:12) - ye un shartton mein se ek thi jo Allah ne un momin auraton par rakhi thin jo Nabi (SAW) se baiat karne aati thin.

e: Narrated 'Ubada bin As-Samit:While we were with the Prophet, he said, "Will you swear to me the pledge of allegiance that you will not worship any thing besides Allah, will not commit illegal sexual intercourse, and will not steal?" Then he recited the Verse concerning the women. (Sufyan, the subnarrator, often said that the Prophet: added, "Whoever among you fulfills his pledge, will receive his reward from Allah, and whoever commits any of those sins and receives the legal punishment (in this life), his punishment will be an expiation for that sin; and whoever commits any of those sins and Allah screens him, then it is up to Allah to punish or forgive them
hi: Ubada bin As-Samit bataate hain: Jab hum Nabi (SAW) ke saath the, unhone farmaya, 'Kya tum mujhse is baat ki baiat karoge ke tum Allah ke siwa kisi ki ibaadat nahi karoge, zina nahi karoge, aur chori nahi karoge?' Phir unhone auraton ke baare mein ye Aayat padhi. (Ravi Sufyan aksar kehte the ke Nabi ne) aage farmaya, 'Jo koi tum mein se apni baiat poori kare, uska ajr Allah ke zimme hoga; aur jo koi inmein se koi gunaah kare aur usse (isi duniya mein) shariyat ki saza mil jaaye, to wo saza us gunaah ka kaffara ban jaayegi; aur jo koi inmein se koi gunaah kare aur Allah usse chhupaa le, to phir Allah ka ikhtiyaar hai, chaahe saza de ya maaf kar de.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I witnessed the `Id-al-Fitr prayer with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) , Abu Bakr, `Umar and `Uthman; and all of them offered it before delivering the sermon... and then delivered the sermon. Once the Prophet (after completing the prayer and the sermon) came down, as if I am now looking at him waving at the men with his hand to sit down, and walked through them till he, along with Bilal, reached (the rows of) the women. Then he recited: 'O Prophet! When believing women come to you to take the oath of allegiance that they will not worship anything other than Allah, will not steal, will not commit illegal sexual intercourse, will not kill their children, and will not utter slander, intentionally forging falsehood (by making illegal children belonging to their husbands)'....(60.12) Having finished, he said, 'Do you agree to that?" One lady, other than whom none replied the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Yes, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" (The, sub-narrator, Al-Hasan did not know who the lady was.) Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said to them: "Will you give alms?" Thereupon Bilal spread out his garment and the women started throwing big rings and small rings into Bilal's garment. (See Hadith No. 95 vol)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW), Abu Bakr, Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath Eid-ul-Fitr ki namaz padhi; unmein se sab ne khutba dene se pehle namaz padhaayi... phir khutba diya. Ek baar Nabi (SAW) (namaz aur khutba khatam karke) neeche utre, aisa lagta hai jaise main ab bhi unhein dekh raha hoon apne haath se mardon ko baithne ka ishara karte hue, aur wo unke beech se chalte hue, Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath, (auraton ki) safon tak pahunche. Phir unhone padha: 'Aye Nabi! Jab momin auraten aapke paas is baat par baiat karne aayein ke wo Allah ke siwa kisi ki ibaadat nahi karengi, chori nahi karengi, zina nahi karengi, apni aulaad ko qatl nahi karengi, aur jaan-boojh kar koi jhooti tohmat nahi ghadegi (yaani apne shohar ke naam par ghair ke bachche na lagaayein)...' (60:12) Ye khatam karke unhone pucha, 'Kya tum is baat par raazi ho?' Ek khaatoon ke siwa, jinka naam Al-Hasan (ravi) ko nahi pata, kisi aur ne jawab nahi diya, unhone kaha, 'Haan, Aye Allah ke Rasool!' Phir Nabi (SAW) ne unse kaha, 'Kya tum sadqa doge?' Isper Bilal ne apna kapda phaila diya aur auraten Bilal ke kapde mein badi aur choti anguthiyaan daalne lagi.

e: Narrated Jubair bin Mut`im:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, 'I have several names: I am Muhammad and I am Ahmad, and I am Al- Mahi with whom Allah obliterates Kufr (disbelief), and I am Al-Hashir (gatherer) at whose feet (i.e. behind whom) the people will be gathered (on the Day of Resurrection), and I am Al-Aqib (i.e. who succeeds the other prophets in bringing about good)
hi: Jubair bin Mut'im bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Mere kai naam hain: Main Muhammad hoon, aur main Ahmad hoon, aur main Al-Maahi (mitaane wala) hoon jiske zariye Allah kufr ko mita deta hai, aur main Al-Haashir (jama karne wala) hoon jiske pairon (yaani jiske peechhe) log Qayamat ke din jama kiye jaayenge, aur main Al-Aaqib (aakhri, doosre Nabiyon ke baad aane wala jo bhalaai laata hai) hoon.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:While we were sitting with the Prophet (ﷺ) Surat Al-Jumu'a was revealed to him, and when the Verse, "And He (Allah) has sent him (Muhammad) also to other (Muslims).....' (62.3) was recited by the Prophet, I said, "Who are they, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" The Prophet (ﷺ) did not reply till I repeated my question thrice. At that time, Salman Al-Farisi was with us. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) put his hand on Salman, saying, "If Faith were at (the place of) Ath-Thuraiya (pleiades, the highest star), even then (some men or man from these people (i.e. Salman's folk) would attain it
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab hum Nabi (SAW) ke saath baithe the, unpar Surah Al-Jumu'a naazil hui, aur jab Nabi (SAW) ne ye Aayat padhi, '...aur usne (Allah ne) unhein doosron ke liye bhi (bheja hai)...' (62:3), maine pucha, 'Wo kaun hain, Aye Allah ke Rasool?' Nabi (SAW) ne jawab nahi diya jab tak maine apna sawaal teen baar nahi dohraaya. Us waqt Salman (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Farisi hamare saath the. To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apna haath Salman par rakha aur farmaya, 'Agar Iman Suraiya (Pleiades, sabse ooncha sitaara) tak bhi chala jaaye, to bhi in logon (yaani Salman ki qaum) mein se koi na koi use paa lega.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said. Then some men from these people would attain it
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Phir in logon mein se kuch log ise (Iman ko) zaroor paa lenge.'

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:A caravan of merchandise arrived at Medina on a Friday while we were with the Prophet (ﷺ) All the people left (the Prophet (ﷺ) and headed for the caravan) except twelve persons. Then Allah revealed:-- 'But when they see some bargain or some amusement they disperse headlong to it
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek Juma ke din Madina mein saudagari ka ek kaafla aaya jabke hum Nabi (SAW) ke saath the. Sab log (Nabi ko chhod kar kaafle ki taraf) chale gaye siwaaye baarah logon ke. Isper Allah ne naazil farmaya: 'Magar jab wo koi tijaarat ya tafreeh dekhte hain, to usi ki taraf daud padte hain...'

e: Narrated Zaid bin Arqam:While I was taking part in a Ghazwa. I heard `Abdullah bin Ubai (bin Abi Salul) saying. "Don't spend on those who are with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), that they may disperse and go away from him. If we return (to Medina), surely, the more honorable will expel the meaner amongst them." I reported that (saying) to my uncle or to `Umar who, in his turn, informed the Prophet (ﷺ) of it. The Prophet (ﷺ) called me and I narrated to him the whole story. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent for `Abdullah bin Ubai and his companions, and they took an oath that they did not say that. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) disbelieved my saying and believed his. I was distressed as I never was before. I stayed at home and my uncle said to me. "You just wanted Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to disbelieve your statement and hate you." So Allah revealed (the Sura beginning with) 'When the hypocrites come to you.' (63.1) The Prophet (ﷺ) then sent for me and recited it and said, "O Zaid! Allah confirmed your statement
hi: Zaid bin Arqam (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek Ghazwe mein shareek hote hue, maine Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ubai (bin Abi Salul) ko ye kehte suna, 'Un logon par kharch mat karo jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath hain, taake wo bikhar jaayein aur unse alag ho jaayein. Agar hum (Madina) wapas gaye, to izzat waale zaroor beizzaton ko wahaan se nikaal denge.' Maine ye baat apne chacha ya Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko bataayi, jinhone aage Nabi (SAW) ko bataayi. Nabi (SAW) ne mujhe bulaaya aur maine unhein poori baat sunaayi. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Abdullah bin Ubai aur uske saathiyon ko bulwaaya, aur unhone qasam khaayi ke unhone aisa kuch nahi kaha. To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne meri baat ka yaqeen nahi kiya aur uski baat maan li. Main pehle se zyaada pareshaan ho gaya. Main ghar par raha, aur mere chacha ne mujhse kaha, 'Tum bas ye chahte the ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) tumhaari baat ka yaqeen na karein aur tumse naaraaz ho jaayein.' Isper Allah ne (Surah jo shuru hoti hai) 'Jab munaafiq tumhaare paas aate hain' (63:1) naazil ki. Phir Nabi (SAW) ne mujhe bulwaaya, ye padh kar sunaayi aur farmaya, 'Aye Zaid! Allah ne tumhaari baat ki tasdeeq kar di.'

e: Narrated Zaid bin Arqam:I was with my uncle and I heard `Abdullah bin Ubai bin Salul, saying, "Don't spend on those who are with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that they may disperse and go away from him." He also said, "If we return to Medina, surely, the more honorable will expel the meaner." So I informed my uncle of that and then my uncle informed Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) thereof. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent for `Abdullah bin Ubai and his companions. They swore that they did not say anything of that sort Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) deemed their statement true and rejected mine. Thereof I became as distressed as I have never been before, and stayed at home. Then Allah revealed (Surat Al-Munafiqin): 'When the hypocrites come to you.....(63.1) They are the ones who say: Spend nothing on those who are with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ..(63.7) Verily the more honorable will expel therefrom the meaner..' (63.7-8) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent for me and recited that Sura for me and said, "Allah has confirmed your statement
hi: Zaid bin Arqam (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main apne chacha ke saath tha aur maine Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ubai bin Salul ko kehte suna, 'Un logon par kharch mat karo jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath hain, taake wo bikhar jaayein aur unse alag ho jaayein.' Usne ye bhi kaha, 'Agar hum Madina wapas gaye, to izzat waale zaroor beizzaton ko wahaan se nikaal denge.' To maine ye baat apne chacha ko bataayi, aur mere chacha ne ye baat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko bataayi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Abdullah bin Ubai aur uske saathiyon ko bulwaaya. Unhone qasam khaayi ke unhone aisa kuch nahi kaha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unki baat sach maan li aur meri baat ko thukra diya. Isse main pehle se zyaada pareshaan ho gaya aur ghar par hi raha. Phir Allah ne (Surah Al-Munafiqoon) naazil ki: 'Jab munaafiq tumhaare paas aate hain...' (63:1) '...Yahi wo log hain jo kehte hain: Un par kharch mat karo jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath hain...' (63:7) '...Beshak izzat waale zaroor beizzaton ko wahaan se nikaal denge...' (63:7-8) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe bulwaaya, ye Surah padh kar sunaayi aur farmaya, 'Allah ne tumhaari baat ki tasdeeq kar di.'

e: Narrated Zaid bin Arqam:When `Abdullah bin Ubai said, "Do not spend on those who are with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)," and also said, "If we return to Medina," I informed the Prophet (ﷺ) of his saying. The Ansar blamed me for that, and `Abdullah bin Ubai swore that he did not say. I returned to my house and slept. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then called me and I went to him. He said, "Allah has confirmed your statement." The Verse: "They are the one who say: Spend nothing......(63.7) was revealed
hi: Zaid bin Arqam (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ubai ne kaha, 'Un par kharch mat karo jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath hain,' aur ye bhi kaha, 'Agar hum Madina wapas gaye...' - maine Nabi (SAW) ko iski khabar di. Ansaar ne mujhe iske liye malaamat ki, aur Abdullah bin Ubai ne qasam khaayi ke usne aisa nahi kaha. Main apne ghar wapas gaya aur so gaya. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe bulwaaya aur main unke paas gaya. Unhone farmaya, 'Allah ne tumhaari baat ki tasdeeq kar di.' Ye Aayat naazil hui: 'Yahi wo log hain jo kehte hain: Kuch bhi kharch mat karo...' (63:7)

e: Narrated Zaid bin Arqam:We went out with the Prophet (ﷺ) : on a journey and the people suffered from lack of provisions. So `Abdullah bin Ubai said to his companions, "Don't spend on those who are with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), that they may disperse and go away from him." He also said, "If we return to Medina, surely, the more honorable will expel therefrom the meaner. So I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and informed him of that. He sent for `Abdullah bin Ubai and asked him, but `Abdullah bin Ubai swore that he did not say so. The people said, "Zaid told a lie to 'Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." What they said distressed me very much. Later Allah revealed the confirmation of my statement in his saying:-- '(When the hypocrites come to you.' (63.1) So the Prophet (ﷺ) called them that they might ask Allah to forgive them, but they turned their heads aside. (Concerning Allah's saying: 'Pieces of wood propped up,' Zaid said; They were the most handsome men)
hi: Zaid bin Arqam (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Nabi (SAW) ke saath ek safar par nikle aur logon ko rasad (khaana-peena) ki kami ka saamna karna pada. To Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ubai ne apne saathiyon se kaha, 'Un par kharch mat karo jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath hain, taake wo bikhar jaayein aur unse alag ho jaayein.' Usne ye bhi kaha, 'Agar hum Madina wapas gaye, to izzat waale zaroor beizzaton ko wahaan se nikaal denge.' To main Nabi (SAW) ke paas gaya aur unhein ye bataaya. Unhone Abdullah bin Ubai ko bulwaaya aur usse pucha, magar usne qasam khaayi ke usne aisa nahi kaha. Logon ne kaha, 'Zaid ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se jhoot bola.' Unki ye baat mujhe bahut pareshaan kar gayi. Baad mein Allah ne meri baat ki tasdeeq naazil ki apne is farmaan mein: 'Jab munaafiq tumhaare paas aate hain...' (63:1) To Nabi (SAW) ne unhein bulaaya taake wo Allah se maafi maangein, magar unhone apne sar ghuma liye. (Allah ke is farmaan ke baare mein, 'Lakdi ke khambon ki tarah,' Zaid kehte hain: Wo (munaafiq) sabse khoobsurat mard the.)

e: Narrated Zaid bin Arqam:While I was with my uncle, I heard `Abdullah bin Ubai bin Salul saying, "Do not spend on those who are with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), that they may disperse and go away (from him). And if we return to Medina, surely, the more honorable will expel therefrom the meaner. "I mentioned that to my uncle who, in turn, mentioned it to the Prophet. The Prophet (ﷺ) called me and I told him about that. Then he sent for `Abdullah bin Ubai and his companions, and they swore that they did not say so. The Prophet (ﷺ) disbelieved my statement and believed theirs. I was distressed as I have never been before, and I remained in my house. My uncle said to me, "You just wanted the Prophet (ﷺ) to consider you a liar and hate you." Then Allah revealed:-- 'When the hypocrites come to you, they say: 'We bear witness that you are indeed the Apostle of Allah." (63.1) So the Prophet (ﷺ) sent for me and recited it and said, "Allah has confirmed your statement
hi: Zaid bin Arqam (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab main apne chacha ke saath tha, maine Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ubai bin Salul ko kehte suna, 'Un par kharch mat karo jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath hain, taake wo bikhar jaayein (unse alag ho jaayein). Aur agar hum Madina wapas gaye, to izzat waale zaroor beizzaton ko wahaan se nikaal denge.' Maine ye baat apne chacha ko bataayi, jinhone ye Nabi (SAW) ko bataayi. Nabi (SAW) ne mujhe bulwaaya aur maine unhein poori baat bataayi. Phir unhone Abdullah bin Ubai aur uske saathiyon ko bulwaaya, aur unhone qasam khaayi ke unhone aisa nahi kaha. Nabi (SAW) ne meri baat ka yaqeen nahi kiya aur unki baat maan li. Main pehle se zyaada pareshaan ho gaya, aur ghar par hi raha. Mere chacha ne mujhse kaha, 'Tum bas ye chahte the ke Nabi (SAW) tumhein jhoota samjhein aur tumse naaraaz ho jaayein.' Phir Allah ne naazil farmaya: 'Jab munaafiq tumhaare paas aate hain, wo kehte hain: Hum gawaahi dete hain ke aap waaqai Allah ke Rasool hain.' (63:1) To Nabi (SAW) ne mujhe bulwaaya, ye padh kar sunaayi aur farmaya, 'Allah ne tumhaari baat ki tasdeeq kar di.'

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:We were in a Ghazwa (Sufyan once said, in an army) and a man from the emigrants kicked an Ansari man (on the buttocks with his foot). The Ansari man said, "O the Ansar! (Help!)" and the emigrant said. "O the emigrants! (Help!) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) heard that and said, "What is this call for, which is characteristic of the period of ignorance?" They said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! A man from the emigrants kicked one of the Ansar (on the buttocks with his foot)." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Leave it (that call) as is a detestable thing." `Abdullah bin Ubai heard that and said, 'Have the (the emigrants) done so? By Allah, if we return Medina, surely, the more honorable will expel therefrom the meaner." When this statement reached the Prophet. `Umar got up an, said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Let me chop off the head of this hypocrite (`Abdullah bin Ubai)!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said "Leave him, lest the people say that Muhammad kills his companions." The Ansar were then more in number than the emigrants when the latter came to Medina, but later on the emigrant increased
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum ek Ghazwe mein the (Ravi Sufyan ne ek baar kaha, 'ek fauj mein'), aur Muhaajireen mein se ek shaks ne ek Ansaari shaks ko (chootadon par) laat maar di. Ansaari shaks ne pukaara, 'Aye Ansaar! (Madad!)' aur Muhaajir ne pukaara, 'Aye Muhaajireen! (Madad!)' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ye suna aur farmaya, 'Ye kaisi pukaar hai jo jaahiliyat ke daur ki khaasiyat hai?' Logon ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Muhaajireen mein se ek shaks ne Ansaar mein se ek ko (chootadon par) laat maar di.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ye (pukaar) chhod do, ye ek napasand cheez hai.' Abdullah bin Ubai ne ye suna aur kaha, 'Kya (Muhaajireen ne) aisa kiya hai? Allah ki qasam, agar hum Madina wapas gaye, to izzat waale zaroor beizzaton ko wahaan se nikaal denge.' Jab ye baat Nabi (SAW) tak pahunchi, Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) khade hue aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe is munaafiq (Abdullah bin Ubai) ka sar kaatne dijiye!' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Use chhod do, kahin log ye na kahein ke Muhammad apne saathiyon ko qatl karta hai.' Us waqt Ansaar, Muhaajireen ke Madina aane par unse tadaad mein zyaada the, magar baad mein Muhaajireen ki tadaad badh gayi.

e: Narrated Musa bin `Uqba:`Abdullah bin Al-Fadl told me that Anas bin Malik said, "I was much grieve over those who had been killed in the Battle of Al-Harra. When Zaid bin Arqarr heard of my intense grief (over the killed Ansar), he wrote a letter to me saying that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, O Allah! Forgive the Ansar and the Ansar children. The subnarrator, Ibn Al-Fadl, is not sure whether the Prophet (ﷺ) also said, And their grand-children." Some of those who were present, asked Anas (about Zaid). He said, "He (Zaid) is the one about whom Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'He is the one whose sound hearing Allah testified
hi: Musa bin Uqba bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Fadl ne mujhe bataaya ke Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Main jang-e-Al-Harra mein maare gaye logon ke liye bahut gam-zada tha. Jab Zaid bin Arqam (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne mera (Ansaar ke maqtool logon ke liye) shadeed gam suna, to unhone mujhe ek khat likha jismein bataya ke unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, "Aye Allah! Ansaar aur Ansaar ke bachon ko maaf farma."' (Ravi Ibn Al-Fadl ko yaqeen nahi ke Nabi ne 'aur unki naati-poti ko bhi' kaha ya nahi.) Wahaan maujood kuch logon ne Anas se (Zaid ke baare mein) pucha. Unhone kaha, 'Wo (Zaid) wahi hain jinke baare mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya tha, "Unki sunne ki taaqat ki gawaahi khud Allah ne di hai."'

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:We were in a Ghazwa and a man from the emigrants kicked an Ansari (on the buttocks with his foot). The Ansari man said, "O the Ansari! (Help!)" The emigrant said, "O the emigrants! (Help)." When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) heard that, he said, "What is that?" They said, "A man from the emigrants kicked a man from the Ansar (on the buttocks his foot). On that the Ansar said, 'O the Ansar!' and the emigrant said, 'O the emigrants!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said' "Leave it (that call) for it Is a detestable thing." The number of Ansar was larger (than that of the emigrants) at the time when the Prophet (ﷺ) came to Medina, but later the number of emigrants increased. `Abdullah bin Ubai said, "Have they, (the emigrants) done so? By Allah, if we return to Medina, surely, the more honorable will expel therefrom the meaner," `Umar bin Al-Khattab said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Let me chop off the head of this hypocrite!" The Prophet said, "Leave him, lest the people say Muhammad kills his companions:
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum ek Ghazwe mein the, aur Muhaajireen mein se ek shaks ne ek Ansaari ko (chootadon par) laat maar di. Ansaari shaks ne pukaara, 'Aye Ansaar! (Madad!)' Muhaajir ne pukaara, 'Aye Muhaajireen! (Madad!)' Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ye suna, to unhone pucha, 'Ye kya hai?' Logon ne kaha, 'Muhaajireen mein se ek shaks ne Ansaar mein se ek ko (chootadon par) laat maar di. Isper Ansaari ne "Aye Ansaar!" pukaara aur Muhaajir ne "Aye Muhaajireen!" pukaara.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ye (pukaar) chhod do, ye ek napasand cheez hai.' Jab Nabi (SAW) Madina aaye the, us waqt Ansaar ki tadaad Muhaajireen se zyaada thi, magar baad mein Muhaajireen ki tadaad badh gayi. Abdullah bin Ubai ne kaha, 'Kya (Muhaajireen ne) aisa kiya hai? Allah ki qasam, agar hum Madina wapas gaye, to izzat waale zaroor beizzaton ko wahaan se nikaal denge.' Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe is munaafiq ka sar kaatne dijiye!' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Use chhod do, kahin log ye na kahein ke Muhammad apne saathiyon ko qatl karta hai.'

e: Narrated Salim:That `Abdullah bin `Umar told him that he had divorced his wife while she was in her menses so `Umar informed Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) of that. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) became very angry at that and said, "(Ibn `Umar must return her to his house and keep her as his wife till she becomes clean and then menstruates and becomes clean again, whereupon, if he wishes to divorce her, he may do so while she is still clean and before having any sexual relations with her, for that is the legally prescribed period for divorce as Allah has ordered)
hi: Salim bataate hain ke Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne unhein bataaya ke unhone apni biwi ko haiz (maasik dharm) ki haalat mein talaaq de di thi, isper Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko iski khabar di. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko isse bahut gussa aaya aur unhone farmaya, '(Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko chaahiye ke wo use apne ghar wapas laayein aur biwi ki tarah rakhein jab tak wo paak na ho jaaye, phir dobara haiz aaye aur phir paak ho jaaye; iske baad, agar wo talaaq dena chaahein, to unhe paakizgi ki haalat mein aur usse humbistari kiye bagair talaaq deni chaahiye, kyunke yahi Shariyat mein muqarrar talaaq ka waqt hai jaisa Allah ne hukm diya hai.)'

e: Narrated Abu Salama:A man came to Ibn `Abbas while Abu Huraira was sitting with him and said, "Give me your verdict regarding a lady who delivered a baby forty days after the death of her husband." Ibn `Abbas said, "This indicates the end of one of the two prescribed periods." I said "For those who are pregnant, their prescribed period is until they deliver their burdens." Abu Huraira said, I agree with my cousin (Abu Salama)." Then Ibn `Abbas sent his slave, Kuraib to Um Salama to ask her (regarding this matter). She replied. "The husband of Subai'a al Aslamiya was killed while she was pregnant, and she delivered a baby forty days after his death. Then her hand was asked in marriage and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) married her (to somebody). Abu As-Sanabil was one of those who asked for her hand in marriage
hi: Abu Salama bataate hain: Ek shaks Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas aaya jabke Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) unke saath baithe the, aur kaha, 'Mujhe fatwa dijiye us aurat ke baare mein jisne apne shohar ki maut ke chaalis din baad bacha paidaish diya.' Ibn Abbas ne kaha, 'Ye do muqarrar muddaton mein se ek ke khatam hone ki nishaani hai.' Maine kaha, 'Hamila auraton ki Iddat unke hamal ki paidaish tak hoti hai.' Abu Huraira ne kaha, 'Main apne chachazaad bhai (Abu Salama) se muttafiq hoon.' Phir Ibn Abbas ne apne ghulaam Kuraib ko Umm Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas bheja unse (is maamle ke baare mein) poochne. Unhone jawab diya, 'Subai'a Al-Aslamiya ka shohar mar gaya jabke wo hamila thi, aur usne apne shohar ki maut ke chaalis din baad bacha paidaish diya. Phir uske nikaah ka rishta aaya aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unka nikaah (kisi se) karwaaya. Abu As-Sanabil bhi unse nikaah karne ki khwaahish rakhne walon mein se the.'

e: See hadith
hi: (Ye hadees ek doosri jagah dekhi jaaye - is jagah sirf hawaala diya gaya hai.)

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:If someone says to his wife, "You are unlawful to me." he must make an expiation (for his oath). Ibn `Abbas added: There is for you in Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), an excellent example to follow
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Agar koi apni biwi se kahe, 'Tum mujhpar haraam ho,' to usse apni qasam ka kaffara adaa karna hoga. Ibn Abbas ne aage kaha: 'Tumhaare liye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mein behtareen namoona hai jise tum apna sakte ho.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to drink honey in the house of Zainab, the daughter of Jahsh, and would stay there with her. So Hafsa and I agreed secretly that, if he come to either of us, she would say to him. "It seems you have eaten Maghafir (a kind of bad-smelling resin), for I smell in you the smell of Maghafir," (We did so) and he replied. "No, but I was drinking honey in the house of Zainab, the daughter of Jahsh, and I shall never take it again. I have taken an oath as to that, and you should not tell anybody about it
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Jahsh (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke ghar shehad piya karte the aur wahaan unke saath kuch waqt guzarte the. To Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) aur maine chupke se ye tay kiya ke agar wo hum mein se kisi ke paas aayein, to wo unse kahe, 'Aisa lagta hai aapne Maghaafir (ek badbudaar gond) khaayi hai, kyunke mujhe aapse Maghaafir ki khushboo aa rahi hai.' (Humne aisa kiya) aur unhone jawab diya, 'Nahi, magar main Zainab bint Jahsh ke ghar shehad pee raha tha, aur main isse phir kabhi nahi piyunga. Maine iski qasam khaayi hai, aur tum isse kisi ko mat batana.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:For the whole year I had the desire to ask `Umar bin Al-Khattab regarding the explanation of a Verse (in Surat Al-Tahrim) but I could not ask him because I respected him very much. When he went to perform the Hajj, I too went along with him. On our return, while we were still on the way home. `Umar went aside to answer the call of nature by the Arak trees. I waited till he finished and then I proceeded with him and asked him. "O chief of the Believers! Who were the two wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) who aided one another against him?" He said, "They were Hafsa and `Aisha." Then I said to him, "By Allah, I wanted to ask you about this a year ago, but I could not do so owing to my respect for you." `Umar said, "Do not refrain from asking me. If you think that I have knowledge (about a certain matter), ask me; and if I know (something about it), I will tell you." Then `Umar added, "By Allah, in the Pre-Islamic Period of Ignorance we did not pay attention to women until Allah revealed regarding them what He revealed regarding them and assigned for them what He has assigned. Once while I was thinking over a certain matter, my wife said, "I recommend that you do so-and-so." I said to her, "What have you got to do with the is matter? Why do you poke your nose in a matter which I want to see fulfilled.?" She said, How strange you are, O son of Al-Khattab! You don't want to be argued with whereas your daughter, Hafsa surely, argues with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) so much that he remains angry for a full day!" `Umar then reported; how he at once put on his outer garment and went to Hafsa and said to her, "O my daughter! Do you argue with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) so that he remains angry the whole day?" H. afsa said, "By Allah, we argue with him." `Umar said, "Know that I warn you of Allah's punishment and the anger of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . . . O my daughter! Don't be betrayed by the one who is proud of her beauty because of the love of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for her (i.e. `Aisha)." `Umar addled, "Then I went out to Um Salama's house who was one of my relatives, and I talked to her. She said, O son of Al-Khattab! It is rather astonishing that you interfere in everything; you even want to interfere between Allah's Apostle and his wives!' By Allah, by her talk she influenced me so much that I lost some of my anger. I left her (and went home). At that time I had a friend from the Ansar who used to bring news (from the Prophet) in case of my absence, and I used to bring him the news if he was absent. In those days we were afraid of one of the kings of Ghassan tribe. We heard that he intended to move and attack us, so fear filled our hearts because of that. (One day) my Ansari friend unexpectedly knocked at my door, and said, "Open Open!' I said, 'Has the king of Ghassan come?' He said, 'No, but something worse; Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has isolated himself from his wives.' I said, 'Let the nose of `Aisha and Hafsa be stuck to dust (i.e. humiliated)!' Then I put on my clothes and went to Allah's Messenger's (ﷺ) residence, and behold, he was staying in an upper room of his to which he ascended by a ladder, and a black slave of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was (sitting) on the first step. I said to him, 'Say (to the Prophet (ﷺ) ) `Umar bin Al-Khattab is here.' Then the Prophet (ﷺ) admitted me and I narrated the story to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). When I reached the story of Um Salama, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) smiled while he was lying on a mat made of palm tree leaves with nothing between him and the mat. Underneath his head there was a leather pillow stuffed with palm fibres, and leaves of a saut tree were piled at his feet, and above his head hung a few water skins. On seeing the marks of the mat imprinted on his side, I wept. He said.' 'Why are you weeping?' I replied, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Caesar and Khosrau are leading the life (i.e. Luxurious life) while you, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) though you are, is living in destitute". The Prophet (ﷺ) then replied. 'Won't you be satisfied that they enjoy this world and we the Hereafter?
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek saal tak mera dil chaahta raha ke main Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab se Surah At-Tahrim ki ek Aayat ki tafseer poochun, magar unki izzat ki wajah se main poochh na saka. Jab wo Hajj karne gaye, to main bhi unke saath gaya. Wapasi mein, jab hum abhi raaste mein hi the, Umar Arak ke darakhton ke paas qaza-e-haajat ke liye alag gaye. Main unke faarigh hone ka intezaar karta raha, phir unke saath chala aur unse pucha, 'Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen! Nabi (SAW) ki wo do biwiyaan kaun thin jinhone unke khilaaf ek doosre ki madad ki thi?' Unhone kaha, 'Wo Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) aur Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) thin.' Maine unse kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, main ye baat ek saal pehle aapse poochna chahta tha, magar aapki izzat ki wajah se poochh nahi paaya.' Umar ne kaha, 'Mujhse poochhne se mat rukna. Agar tumhein lagta hai ke mujhe (kisi maamle ka) ilm hai, to poochho; aur agar mujhe ilm hoga, to main tumhein bataunga.' Phir Umar ne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, jaahiliyat ke daur mein hum auraton ko koi ehmiyat nahi dete the, yahaan tak ke Allah ne unke baare mein wo naazil kiya jo naazil kiya aur unke liye jo muqarrar kiya so kiya. Ek baar jab main kisi maamle ke baare mein soch raha tha, meri biwi ne kaha, "Main sujhaav deti hoon ke aap aisa aisa karein." Maine unse kaha, "Tumhein is maamle se kya lena-dena? Tum kyun apni naak isme dete ho jo main poora karna chahta hoon?" Unhone kaha, "Tum kitne ajeeb ho, Aye Ibn Al-Khattab! Tum khud behas pasand nahi karte, jabke tumhaari beti Hafsa Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se itni behas karti hai ke wo poore din naaraaz rehte hain!" Umar ne aage bataya ke unhone foran apni chaadar pehni aur Hafsa ke paas gaye aur unse kaha, "Aye meri beti! Kya tum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se itni behas karti ho ke wo poore din naaraaz rehte hain?" Hafsa ne kaha, "Allah ki qasam, hum unse behas karte hain." Umar ne kaha, "Jaan lo ke main tumhein Allah ke azaab aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki naaraazgi se khabardaar karta hoon... Aye meri beti! (Aisha) ki khoobsurati aur unke liye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki mohabbat se dhoka mat khaana."' Umar ne aage kaha, 'Phir main Umm Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke ghar gaya, jo meri rishtedaar thin, aur unse baat ki. Unhone kaha, "Aye Ibn Al-Khattab! Ye hairaani ki baat hai ke tum har cheez mein dakhal dete ho; tum Allah ke Rasool aur unki biwiyon ke beech bhi dakhal dena chahte ho!" Allah ki qasam, unki baaton ne mujhpar itna asar kiya ke mera gussa kuch kam ho gaya. Main unke paas se chala gaya (ghar wapas). Us waqt mera ek Ansaari dost tha jo mere na hone par Nabi ki khabar laata tha, aur main uski gair-maujoodgi mein use khabar deta tha. Un dinon humein Ghassan qabeele ke ek baadshaah ka dar tha. Humne suna tha ke wo hum par hamla karne ka iraada rakhta hai, isliye is baat se hamare dil khauf se bhar gaye. (Ek din) mera Ansaari dost achaanak mera darwaaza khatkhataane laga aur kaha, "Khol! Khol!" Maine kaha, "Kya Ghassan ka baadshaah aa gaya?" Usne kaha, "Nahi, magar isse bhi buri baat; Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apni biwiyon se alag ho gaye hain." Maine kaha, "Aisha aur Hafsa ki naak mitti mein sane (yaani wo ruswaa hon)!" Phir maine apne kapde pehne aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke ghar gaya, aur dekha ke wo apne ek upar wale kamre mein the jahaan seedhi se chadha jaata tha, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka ek kaala ghulaam pehli sidi par (baitha) tha. Maine usse kaha, "(Nabi se) kaho, Umar bin Al-Khattab aa gaya hai." Phir Nabi (SAW) ne mujhe andar bulaaya aur maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko poora waqiya sunaaya. Jab main Umm Salama ke waqiye tak pahuncha, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) muskuraaye, jabke wo khajoor ke patton se bani chatai par lete hue the aur unke aur chatai ke beech kuch nahi tha. Unke sar ke neeche khajoor ki chhaal se bhara chamde ka takiya tha, aur unke pairon ke paas Saut darakht ke patte dhere lage the, aur unke sar ke upar kuch mashkein latki hui thin. Unke pehlu par chatai ke nishaan dekh kar main ro pada. Unhone pucha, 'Kyun ro rahe ho?' Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kaisar aur Khusro aish-o-aaraam ki zindagi guzaar rahe hain, jabke aap, Allah ke Rasool hone ke bawajood, itni tangi mein reh rahe hain.' Nabi (SAW) ne jawab diya, 'Kya tum is baat se khush nahi ke wo duniya ka aish le lein aur hum Aakhirat ka?'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I intended to ask `Umar so I said, "Who were those two ladies who tried to back each other against the Prophet?" I hardly finished my speech when he said, They were `Aisha and Hafsa
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se poochne ka iraada kiya, to maine kaha, 'Wo do khaatoonein kaun thin jinhone Nabi (SAW) ke khilaaf ek doosre ka saath diya?' Maine apni baat poori bhi nahi ki thi ke unhone kaha, 'Wo Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) aur Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) thin.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I intended to ask `Umar about those two ladies who back each other against 'Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . For one year I was seeking the opportunity to ask this question, but in vain, until once when I accompanied him for Hajj. While we were in Zahran, `Umar went to answer the call of nature and told me to follow him with some water for ablution. So I followed him with a container of water and started pouring water for him. I found it a good opportunity to ask him, so I said, "O chief of the Believers! Who were those two ladies who had backed each other (against the Prophet)?" Before I could complete my question, he replied, "They were `Aisha and Hafsa
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se un do khaatoonon ke baare mein poochne ka iraada kiya jinhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke khilaaf ek doosre ka saath diya tha. Ek saal tak main is sawaal ke liye mauqa dhoondhta raha magar be-faayda, yahaan tak ke ek baar main Hajj ke liye unke saath gaya. Jab hum Zahran mein the, Umar qaza-e-haajat ke liye gaye aur mujhse kaha ke main wuzu ka paani lekar unke peechhe aaun. To main paani ka bartan lekar unke peechhe gaya aur unhein paani daalne laga. Mujhe ye ek achha mauqa laga unse poochne ka, to maine kaha, 'Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen! Wo do khaatoonein kaun thin jinhone (Nabi ke khilaaf) ek doosre ka saath diya tha?' Maine apna sawaal poora bhi nahi kiya tha ke unhone jawab diya, 'Wo Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) aur Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) thin.'

e: Narrated `Umar:The wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) out of their jealousy, backed each other against the Prophet, so I said to them, "It may be, if he divorced you all, that Allah will give him, instead of you wives better than you." So this Verse was revealed
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ki azwaaj apni jalan ki wajah se, Nabi (SAW) ke khilaaf ek doosre ka saath deti thin, to maine unse kaha, 'Ho sakta hai ke agar wo tum sab ko talaaq de dein, to Allah unhe tum se behtar biwiyaan de.' Isper ye Aayat naazil hui.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:(regarding the Verse):-- 'Cruel after all that, base-born (of illegitimate birth).' (68.13) It was revealed in connection with a man from Quaraish who had a notable sign (Zanamah) similar to the notable sign which usually-hung on the neck of a sheep (to recognize it)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) is Aayat ke baare mein bataate hain: 'Iske baad bhi sakht-dil, aur haraam (najaayez) paidaish waala.' (68:13) Ye Quraish ke ek shaks ke silsile mein naazil hui thi jiske gale mein ek pehchaan-nishaan (Zanamah) latka hua tha, waisa hi jaisa bakriyon ki pehchaan ke liye unke gale mein latkaya jaata tha.

e: Narrated Haritha bin Wahb Al-Khuza`i:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying. "May I tell you of the people of Paradise? Every weak and poor obscure person whom the people look down upon but his oath is fulfilled by Allah when he takes an oath to do something. And may I inform you of the people of the Hell-Fire? They are all those violent, arrogant and stubborn people
hi: Haritha bin Wahb Al-Khuza'i bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Kya main tumhein Jannat waalon ke baare mein bataun? Har kamzor, gareeb aur gumnaam shaks jise log haqir samajhte hain, magar agar wo kisi baat ki qasam khaa le, to Allah use poora kar deta hai. Aur kya main tumhein Jahannam waalon ke baare mein bataun? Wo sab woh sakht, ghamandi aur ziddi log hain.'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Our Lord Allah will lay bare His Shin, and then all the Believers, men and women, will prostrate themselves before Him, but there will remain those who used to prostrate in the world for showing off and for gaining good reputation. Such people will try to prostrate (on the Day of Judgment) but their back swill be as stiff as if it is one bone (a single vertebra)
hi: Abu Saeed bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Hamara Rab Allah apni pindli khol dega, phir sab momin mard aur auraten uske saamne sajde mein gir jaayenge, magar wo log baaki rah jaayenge jo duniya mein dikhawe aur naam kamaane ke liye sajda karte the. Aise log (Qayamat ke din) sajda karne ki koshish karenge, magar unki peeth ek haddi ki tarah sakht ho jaayegi (jhukegi hi nahi).'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:All the idols which were worshiped by the people of Noah were worshiped by the Arabs later on. As for the idol Wadd, it was worshiped by the tribe of Kalb at Daumat-al-Jandal; Suwa` was the idol of (the tribe of) Hudhail; Yaghouth was worshiped by (the tribe of) Murad and then by Bani Ghutaif at Al-Jurf near Saba; Ya`uq was the idol of Hamdan, and Nasr was the idol of Himyar, the branch of Dhi-al-Kala`. The names (of the idols) formerly belonged to some pious men of the people of Noah, and when they died Satan inspired their people to (prepare and place idols at the places where they used to sit, and to call those idols by their names. The people did so, but the idols were not worshiped till those people (who initiated them) had died and the origin of the idols had become obscure, whereupon people began worshiping them
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Wo saare but jinki ibaadat Nooh (Alaihissalam) ki qaum karti thi, baad mein Arabon ne bhi unki ibaadat ki. Wadd but Kalb qabeele ke log Daumat-al-Jandal mein parastish karte the; Suwa' Hudhail qabeele ka but tha; Yaghous ki ibaadat Murad qabeela karta tha aur baad mein Banu Ghutaif Saba ke qareeb Al-Jurf mein; Ya'uq Hamdan qabeele ka but tha, aur Nasr Himyar ki shaakh Zil-Kala' ka but tha. In buton ke naam pehle Nooh ki qaum ke kuch neik logon ke the, jab wo mar gaye to Shaitaan ne unki qaum ko ye ilhaam diya ke un jagahon par jahaan wo baitha karte the murtiyaan banaakar rakh dein aur unhe unhi naamon se pukaarein. Logon ne aisa hi kiya, magar shuru mein in buton ki ibaadat nahi hoti thi jab tak wo (murtiyon ko lagaane waale) log mar nahi gaye aur buton ki asal wajah bhool nahi gayi, tab jaakar log inki ibaadat karne lage.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went out along with a group of his companions towards `Ukaz Market. At that time something intervened between the devils and the news of the Heaven, and flames were sent down upon them, so the devils returned. Their fellow-devils said, "What is wrong with you? " They said, "Something has intervened between us and the news of the Heaven, and fires (flames) have been shot at us." Their fellow-devils said, "Nothing has intervened between you and the news of the Heaven, but an important event has happened. Therefore, travel all over the world, east and west, and try to find out what has happened." And so they set out and travelled all over the world, east and west, looking for that thing which intervened between them and the news of the Heaven. Those of the devils who had set out towards Tihama, went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) at Nakhla (a place between Mecca and Taif) while he was on his way to `Ukaz Market. (They met him) while he was offering the Fajr prayer with his companions. When they heard the Holy Qur'an being recited (by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)), they listened to it and said (to each other). This is the thing which has intervened between you and the news of the Heavens." Then they returned to their people and said, "O our people! We have really heard a wonderful recital (Qur'an). It gives guidance to the right, and we have believed therein. We shall not join in worship, anybody with our Lord." (See 72.1-2) Then Allah revealed to His Prophet (Surat al- Jinn): 'Say: It has been revealed to me that a group (3 to 9) of Jinns listened (to the Qur'an).' (72.1) The statement of the Jinns was revealed to him
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apne kuch sahaaba ke saath Ukaz Bazaar ki taraf nikle. Us waqt Shaitaanon aur aasman ki khabar ke beech kuch rukaawat aa gayi, aur unpar (aasman se) shole utaare gaye, isliye Shaitaan wapas laut aaye. Unke saathi Shaitaanon ne pucha, 'Tumhein kya hua?' Unhone kaha, 'Hamare aur aasman ki khabar ke beech kuch aa gaya hai, aur hampar shole (aag) chalaaye gaye.' Saathi Shaitaanon ne kaha, 'Tumhaare aur aasman ki khabar ke beech kuch nahi aaya, balke koi bada waaqiya hua hai. Isliye poori duniya mein poorab aur pashchim tak safar karo aur pata lagaao ke kya hua hai.' To wo nikle aur poori duniya mein poorab-pashchim safar karte hue us cheez ko dhoondhne lage jo unke aur aasman ki khabar ke beech aayi thi. Jo Shaitaan Tihama ki taraf gaye, wo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas Nakhla (Makkah aur Taif ke beech ek jagah) pahunche, jabke wo Ukaz Bazaar jaane ke raaste mein the. (Unhone unhein dekha) jabke wo apne sahaaba ke saath Fajr ki namaz padha rahe the.
