Jab unhone Quran ki tilawat suni (Allah ke Rasool ki zabaani), wo dhyaan se sunne lage aur (aapas mein) kaha, 'Yahi wo cheez hai jo tumhaare aur aasman ki khabar ke beech aayi.' Phir wo apni qaum ke paas wapas gaye aur kaha, 'Aye hamaari qaum! Humne waaqai ek ajeeb tilawat suni hai. Ye seedhe raaste ki hidaayat deti hai, aur hum isper Iman le aaye hain. Hum apne Rab ke saath kisi ko shareek nahi karenge.' (Surah Al-Jinn 72:1-2 mulaahiza karein) Phir Allah ne apne Nabi par (Surah Al-Jinn) naazil ki: 'Kaho: Mujhpar wahi ki gayi hai ke Jinnaton ke ek giroh (teen se nau) ne (Quran ko) suna...' (72:1) Jinnaat ka bayaan unpar naazil hua.

e: Narrated Yahya bin Abi Kathir:I asked Aba Salama bin `Abdur-Rahman about the first Sura revealed of the Qur'an. He replied "O you, wrapped-up (i.e. Al Muddaththir)." I said, "They say it was, 'Read, in the Name of your Lord Who created,' (i.e. Surat Al-`Alaq (the Clot)." On that, Abu Salama said, "I asked Jabir bin `Abdullah about that, saying the same as you have said, whereupon he said, 'I will not tell you except what Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had told us. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I was in seclusion in the cave of Hiram', and after I completed the limited period of my seclusion. I came down (from the cave) and heard a voice calling me. I looked to my right, but saw nothing. Then I looked up and saw something. So I went to Khadija (the Prophet's wife) and told her to wrap me up and pour cold water on me. So they wrapped me up and poured cold water on me." Then, 'O you, (Muhammad) wrapped up! Arise and warn,' (Surat Al Muddaththir) was revealed
hi: Yahya bin Abi Kathir bataate hain: Maine Abu Salama bin Abdur Rahman se Quran ki sabse pehle naazil hone wali Surah ke baare mein pucha. Unhone jawab diya, 'Aye chaadar odhne wale (yaani Al-Muddaththir).' Maine kaha, 'Log kehte hain ye "Padho apne Rab ke naam se jisne paida kiya" (yaani Surah Al-Alaq) thi.' Isper Abu Salama ne kaha, 'Maine ye baat Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) se poochi thi, waisa hi jaisa tumne kaha, isper unhone kaha, "Main tumhein sirf wahi bataunga jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein bataya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Main Hira ki ghaar mein tanhaai mein tha, aur jab main apni muqarrar muddat poori karke (ghaar se) neeche utra, to maine ek aawaaz sunni jo mujhe bula rahi thi. Maine apni daayin taraf dekha, kuch nahi mila. Phir upar dekha to kuch dikha. To main Khadija (رضی اللہ عنہا) (apni biwi) ke paas gaya aur unse kaha ke mujhe chaadar odhaao aur mujhpar thanda paani daalo. To unhone mujhe chaadar odhaayi aur thanda paani daala.' Phir 'Aye (Muhammad) chaadar odhne wale! Utho aur khabardaar karo' (Surah Al-Muddaththir) naazil hui."'

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I was in a seclusion in the cave of Hira........."(similar to the narration related by `Ali bin Al-Mubarak, 444 above)
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Main Hira ki ghaar mein tanhaai mein tha...' (ye riwayat pehle Ali (Alayhis Salam) bin Al-Mubarak ki riwayat, hadees 444, jaisi hi hai).

e: Narrated Yahya:I asked Aba Salama, "Which Sura of the Qur'an was revealed first?" He replied, "O you, wrapped-up' (Al-Muddaththir)." I said, "I have been informed that it was, 'Read, in the Name of your Lord who created (i.e. Surat Al-Alaq)...similar to the narration related by `Ali bin Al-Mubarak, 444 above
hi: Yahya bataate hain: Maine Abu Salama se pucha, 'Quran ki kaunsi Surah sabse pehle naazil hui?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Aye chaadar odhne wale (Al-Muddaththir).' Maine kaha, 'Mujhe bataya gaya hai ke wo "Padho apne Rab ke naam se jisne paida kiya" (Surah Al-Alaq) thi...' (baaki riwayat Ali (Alayhis Salam) bin Al-Mubarak ki riwayat, hadees 444, jaisi hi hai).

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) describing the period of pause of the Divine Inspiration. He said in his talk, "While I was walking, I heard voices from the sky. I looked up, and behold ! I saw the same Angel who came to me in the cave of Hira' sitting on a chair between the sky and the earth. I was too much afraid of him (so I returned to my house) and said, 'Fold me up in garments!' They wrapped me up. Then Allah revealed: 'O you wrapped...and desert the idols before the prayer became compulsory.' Rujz means idols
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko wahi ke rukne ke dauraan ke baare mein bataate suna. Unhone apni baat mein kaha, 'Jab main chal raha tha, maine aasman se aawaazein sunin. Maine upar dekha, aur wahi Farishta jo Hira ki ghaar mein mere paas aaya tha, use aasman aur zameen ke beech ek kursi par baitha paaya. Main unse itna dar gaya ke (ghar wapas aakar) maine kaha, "Mujhe chaadaron mein lapet do!" Unhone mujhe lapet diya. Phir Allah ne naazil farmaya: "Aye chaadar odhne wale... aur buton ko chhod do," namaz farz hone se pehle.' (Rujz ka matlab hai but.)

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:That he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) describing the period of pause of the Divine Inspiration, and in his description he said, "While I was walking I heard a voice from the sky. I looked up towards the sky, and behold! I saw the same Angel who came to me in the Cave of Hira', sitting on a chair between the sky and the earth. I was so terrified by him that I fell down on the ground. Then I went to my wife and said, 'Wrap me in garments! Wrap me in garments!' They wrapped me, and then Allah revealed: "O you, (Muhammad) wrapped-up! Arise and warn...and desert the idols." (74.1-5) Abu Salama said....Rujz means idols." After that, the Divine Inspiration started coming more frequently and regularly
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko wahi ke rukne ke dauraan ke baare mein bataate suna, aur apne bayaan mein farmaya, 'Jab main chal raha tha, maine aasman se ek aawaaz sunni. Maine aasman ki taraf dekha, aur wahi Farishta jo Hira ki ghaar mein mere paas aaya tha, use aasman aur zameen ke beech ek kursi par baitha paaya. Main itna dar gaya ke zameen par gir pada. Phir main apni biwi ke paas gaya aur kaha, "Mujhe chaadaron mein lapet do! Mujhe chaadaron mein lapet do!" Unhone mujhe lapeta, phir Allah ne naazil farmaya: "Aye (Muhammad) chaadar odhne wale! Utho aur khabardaar karo... aur buton ko chhod do."' (74:1-5) Abu Salama ne kaha, '...Rujz ka matlab hai but.' Iske baad wahi zyaada baar aur mustaqil taur par aane lagi.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to move his tongue when the divine Inspiration was being revealed to him. (Sufyan, a subnarrator, demonstrated (how the Prophet (ﷺ) used to move his lips) and added. "In order to memorize it." So Allah revealed: "Move not your tongue concerning (the Qur'an) to make haste therewith
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) jab unpar wahi naazil hoti to apni zabaan hilaate the (yaad karne ki koshish mein). (Ravi Sufyan ne dikhaaya ke Nabi kaise apne honth hilaate the) aur kaha, 'Taake use yaad kar sakein.' To Allah ne naazil farmaya: 'Apni zabaan (Quran ko yaad karne ki) jaldi mein mat hilaao.'

e: Narrated Musa bin Abi Aisha:That he asked Sa`id bin Jubair regarding (the statement of Allah). 'Move not your tongue concerning (the Qur'an) to make haste therewith.' He said, "Ibn `Abbas said that the Prophet (ﷺ) used to move his lips when the Divine Inspiration was being revealed to him. So the Prophet (ﷺ) was ordered not to move his tongue, which he used to do, lest some words should escape his memory. 'It is for Us to collect it' means, We will collect it in your chest;' and its recitation' means, We will make you recite it. 'But when We recite it (i.e. when it is revealed to you), follow its recital; it is for Us to explain it and make it clear,' (i.e. We will explain it through your tongue)
hi: Musa bin Abi Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataate hain ke unhone Saeed bin Jubair se Allah ke is farmaan ke baare mein pucha, 'Apni zabaan (Quran ko yaad karne ki) jaldi mein mat hilaao.' Unhone kaha, 'Ibn Abbas ne kaha ke Nabi (SAW) jab unpar wahi naazil hoti to apne honth hilaate the. To Nabi (SAW) ko hukm diya gaya ke wo apni zabaan na hilaayein jaisa wo karte the, kahin koi lafz unki yaadasht se na chhoot jaaye. "Ise jama karna Hamaare zimme hai" ka matlab hai, "Hum ise tumhaare seene mein jama kar denge"; "aur iski tilawat" ka matlab hai, "Hum tumse ise padhwaayenge." "Magar jab Hum ise padhein (yaani jab tumpar naazil ho), to uski tilawat ki pairvi karo; iski tafseer karna Hamaare zimme hai" (yaani Hum tumhaari zabaan se hi iski wazaahat karenge).'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:(as regards) Allah's Statement: "Move not your tongue concerning (the Qur'an) to make haste therewith." (75.16) When Gabriel revealed the Divine Inspiration in Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) , he (Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)) moved his tongue and lips, and that state used to be very hard for him, and that movement indicated that revelation was taking place. So Allah revealed in Surat Al-Qiyama which begins: 'I do swear by the Day of Resurrection...' (75) the Verses:-- 'Move not your tongue concerning (the Qur'an) to make haste therewith. It is for Us to collect it (Qur'an) in your mind, and give you the ability to recite it by heart. (75.16-17) Ibn `Abbas added: It is for Us to collect it (Qur'an) (in your mind), and give you the ability to recite it by heart means, "When We reveal it, listen. Then it is for Us to explain it," means, 'It is for us to explain it through your tongue.' So whenever Gabriel came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ' he would keep quiet (and listen), and when the Angel left, the Prophet (ﷺ) would recite that revelation as Allah promised him
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) Allah ke is farmaan ke baare mein bataate hain: 'Apni zabaan (Quran ko yaad karne ki) jaldi mein mat hilaao.' (75:16) Jab Jibrael Allah ke Rasool (SAW) par wahi naazil karte, to wo apni zabaan aur honth hilaate, aur ye unke liye bahut mushkil haalat hoti thi, aur ye harkat is baat ki nishaani thi ke wahi naazil ho rahi hai. To Allah ne Surah Al-Qiyama, jo 'Main Qayamat ke din ki qasam khaata hoon...' se shuru hoti hai, mein ye Aayaten naazil kin: 'Apni zabaan (Quran ko yaad karne ki) jaldi mein mat hilaao. Ise (Quran ko) tumhaare zehen mein jama karna aur tumhein use zabaani padhne ki qaabiliyat dena Hamaare zimme hai.' (75:16-17) Ibn Abbas ne aage kaha, '"Ise tumhaare zehen mein jama karna aur tumhein padhne ki qaabiliyat dena Hamaare zimme hai" ka matlab hai, "Jab Hum ise naazil karein, to suno." Phir "iski tafseer karna Hamaare zimme hai" ka matlab hai, "Iski tafseer karna Hamaare zimme hai, tumhaari zabaan ke zariye."' To jab bhi Jibrael Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aate, wo khaamosh rehte (aur sunte), aur jab Farishta chala jaata, to Nabi (SAW) wo wahi padh dete jaisa Allah ne unse waada kiya tha.

e: Narrated `Abdullah:We were with the Prophet (ﷺ) when Surat Wal-Mursalat was revealed to him. While we were receiving it from his mouth, a snake suddenly came and we ran to kill it, but it outstripped us and entered its hole quickly. Allah's le said, "It has escaped your evil, and you too, have escaped its evil
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Nabi (SAW) ke saath the jab unpar Surah Al-Mursalat naazil hui. Jab hum unke munh se ise sun rahe the, achaanak ek saanp aaya aur hum use maarne ke liye daude, magar wo humse tez nikla aur apne bill mein chala gaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ye tumhaari buraai se bach gaya, aur tum bhi iski buraai se bach gaye.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:(Similarly--as no. 452 above)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: (Upar hadees number 452 jaisi hi riwayat).

e: Narrated `Abdullah:While we were with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in a cave, Surat "Wal Mursalat" was revealed to him and we received it directly from his mouth as soon as he had received the revelation. Suddenly a snake came out and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Get at it and kill it!" We ran to kill it but it outstripped us. Allah's Apostle said, "It has escaped your evil, as you too, have escaped its
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath ek ghaar mein the, unpar Surah Al-Mursalat naazil hui aur humne ise unke munh se seedhe seedhe suna jaise hi wahi unpar naazil hui. Achaanak ek saanp nikla aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Ise maaro!' Hum use maarne daude magar wo humse aage nikal gaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ye tumhaari buraai se bach gaya, jaise tum bhi iski buraai se bach gaye.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:(as regards the explanation of Hadith 454). 'Indeed, it (Hell) throws about sparks (huge) as Forts.' We used to collect wood in the form of logs, three cubits long or shorter. for heating purposes in winter., and we used to call such wood, the Qasr
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain (hadees 454 ki tafseer ke silsile mein): 'Beshak wo (Jahannam) chingariyaan uchaalti hai jo (badi) qile jaisi hain.' Hum sardi mein garmaane ke liye lakdi ke kunde (teen haath lambe ya usse kam) jama karte the, aur hum aisi lakdi ko 'Qasr' kehte the.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas: (regarding) the explanation of "... It throws sparks as Al-Qasr ..." (V. 77:32): We used to collect logs of wood, three cubits long or longer, to store for heating purposes in winter, and we used to call it Al- Qasr, it also means a castle or a fort. "As if they were Jimalatun Sufr (yellow camels or bundles of ropes)" (V.77:33): means the ropes of a ship which are made in bundles till it become as wide as men's waists
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) is Aayat ki tafseer mein bataate hain: '...wo Al-Qasr jaisi chingariyaan uchaalti hai...' (77:32) - hum lakdi ke kunde (teen haath lambe ya usse zyaada) sardi mein garmaane ke liye jama karke rakhte the, aur hum ise 'Al-Qasr' kehte the, iska matlab qila ya kila bhi hota hai. '...jaise wo Jimaalaatun Sufr (peele oont ya rasson ke bandhe hue gattar) hon...' (77:33) - iska matlab hai kashti ki rassiyaan jo bandal (gattar) mein banaayi jaati hain yahaan tak ke wo mardon ki kamar jitni moti ho jaati hain.

e: Narrated `Abdullah:While we were with the Prophet (ﷺ) in a cave, Surat wal-Mursalat was revealed to him and he recited it, and I heard it directly from his mouth as soon as he recited its revelation. Suddenly a snake sprang at us, and the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Kill it!" We ran to kill it but it escaped quickly. The Prophet (ﷺ) said. "It has escaped your evil, and you too have escaped its evil
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab hum Nabi (SAW) ke saath ek ghaar mein the, unpar Surah Al-Mursalat naazil hui aur unhone use padha, aur maine ise unke munh se seedhe suna jaise hi unhone iski tilawat ki. Achaanak ek saanp humpar jhapata, aur Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ise maaro!' Hum use maarne daude magar wo jaldi se bhaag gaya. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ye tumhaari buraai se bach gaya, aur tum bhi iski buraai se bach gaye.'

e: Narrated Al--A`mash:Abu Huraira said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Between the two sounds of the trumpet, there will be forty." Somebody asked Abu Huraira, "Forty days?" But he refused to reply. Then he asked, "Forty months?" He refused to reply. Then he asked, "Forty years?" Again, he refused to reply. Abu Huraira added. "Then (after this period) Allah will send water from the sky and then the dead bodies will grow like vegetation grows, There is nothing of the human body that does not decay except one bone; that is the little bone at the end of the coccyx of which the human body will be recreated on the Day of Resurrection." (See Hadith No)
hi: Al-A'mash bataate hain: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, "Do soor ki aawaazon ke darmiyaan chaalis (ka faasla) hoga."' Kisi ne Abu Huraira se pucha, 'Chaalis din?' Magar unhone jawab dene se inkaar kiya. Phir unhone pucha, 'Chaalis mahine?' Unhone phir jawab dene se inkaar kiya. Phir unhone pucha, 'Chaalis saal?' Unhone phir jawab dene se inkaar kiya. Abu Huraira ne aage kaha, 'Phir (is muddat ke baad) Allah aasman se paani bhejega, aur murda jism aise ugenge jaise sabzi ugti hai. Insaan ke jism ka koi hissa nahi bachta jo gal na jaaye siwaaye ek haddi ke; wo reedh ki haddi ke aakhri hisse (coccyx) ki chhoti si haddi hai, jisse Qayamat ke din poora jism dobara banaaya jaayega.'

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) pointing with his index and middle fingers, saying. "The time of my Advent and the Hour are like these two fingers
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko apni shahaadat aur beech ki ungli se ishara karke ye kehte dekha, 'Mere aane (Nabuwwat) ka waqt aur Qayamat is tarah (ek doosre ke qareeb) hain jaise ye do ungliyaan.'

e: Narrated Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Such a person as recites the Qur'an and masters it by heart, will be with the noble righteous scribes (in Heaven). And such a person exerts himself to learn the Qur'an by heart, and recites it with great difficulty, will have a double reward
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo shaks Quran padhta hai aur use zabaani yaad karta hai, wo (Jannat mein) izzatdaar aur nek likhne walon (farishton) ke saath hoga. Aur jo shaks mehnat karke Quran ko zabaani yaad karta hai aur usse mushkil se padhta hai, use dohra ajr milega.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "On the Day when all mankind will stand before the Lord of the Worlds, some of them will be enveloped in their sweat up to the middle of their ears
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jis din tamaam insaan Rab-ul-Aalameen ke saamne khade honge, unmein se kuch apne paseene mein doobe hue honge, kaanon ke beech tak.'

e: Narrated Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said," (On the Day of Resurrection) any one whose account will be taken will be ruined (i.e. go to Hell)." I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! May Allah make me be sacrificed for you. Doesn't Allah say: "Then as for him who will be given his record in his right hand, he surely will receive an easy reckoning.?" (84.7-8) He replied, "That is only the presentation of the accounts; but he whose record is questioned, will be ruined." (This hadith is also narrated through two other chains)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, '(Qayamat ke din) jiska bhi hisaab liya jaayega, wo tabaah ho jaayega (Jahannam mein jaayega).' Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Allah mujhe aap par qurbaan kare. Kya Allah nahi farmaata, "Jise uski kitaab uske daaye haath mein di jaayegi, uska hisaab aasan hoga"?' (84:7-8) Unhone jawab diya, 'Ye to bas amaal ka pesh kiya jaana hai; magar jiske hisaab mein sawaal-jawaab hoga, wo tabaah ho jaayega.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:(as regards the Verse):--'You shall surely travel from stage to stage (in this life and in the Hereafter).' (It means) from one state to another. That concerns your Prophet
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) is Aayat ke baare mein bataate hain: 'Tum zaroor ek daur se doosre daur ki taraf (duniya aur Aakhirat mein) safar karoge.' Iska matlab hai ek haalat se doosri haalat ki taraf. Ye aapke Nabi (SAW) ke baare mein hai.

e: Narrated Al-Bara:The first of the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) who came to us (in Medina), were Mus`ab bin `Umair and Ibn Um Maktum, and they started teaching us the Qur'an. Then came `Ammar, Bilal and Sa`d. Afterwards `Umar bin Al-Kkattab came along with a batch of twenty (men): and after that the Prophet (ﷺ) came. I never saw the people of Medina so pleased with anything as they were with his arrival, so that even the little boys and girls were saying, "This is Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who has come." He (the Prophet (ﷺ) ) did not come (to Medina) till I had learnt Surat Al-Ala and also other similar Suras
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ke sahaaba mein se sabse pehle jo humaare paas (Madina) aaye, wo Mus'ab bin Umair aur Ibn Umm Maktum the, aur unhone humein Quran sikhaana shuru kiya. Phir Ammar (رضی اللہ عنہ), Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Sa'd aaye. Uske baad Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab bees (20) logon ke saath aaye, aur uske baad Nabi (SAW) aaye. Maine kabhi Madina walon ko kisi cheez se itna khush nahi dekha jitna unke aane par the, yahaan tak ke chhote ladke-ladkiyan bhi keh rahe the, 'Ye Allah ke Rasool hain jo aaye hain.' Wo (Nabi) Madina tab tak nahi aaye the jab tak main Surah Al-Ala aur isi tarah ki doosri Surahein seekh chuka tha.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Zama:That he heard the Prophet (ﷺ) delivering a sermon, and he mentioned the she-camel and the one who hamstrung it. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) recited:-- 'When, the most wicked man among them went forth (to hamstrung the she-camel).' (91.12.) Then he said, "A tough man whose equal was rare and who enjoyed the protection of his people, like Abi Zama went forth to (hamstrung) it." The Prophet (ﷺ) then mentioned about the women (in his sermon). "It is not wise for anyone of you to lash his wife like a slave, for he might sleep with her the same evening." Then he advised them not to laugh when somebody breaks wind and said, "Why should anybody laugh at what he himself does?
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Zama bataate hain ke unhone Nabi (SAW) ko khutba dete suna, jismein unhone oontni aur uski kunji (pair ki nas) kaatne wale ka zikr kiya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ye Aayat padhi: 'Jab unmein sabse zyaada badbakht shaks (oontni ki kunji kaatne) uthaa...' (91:12) Phir unhone farmaya, 'Ek sakht-mizaaj shaks jiska koi jod nahi tha aur jise apni qaum ki hifaazat haasil thi, jaise Abi Zama, uski taraf (kunji kaatne) uthaa.' Phir Nabi (SAW) ne apne khutbe mein auraton ka zikr kiya, 'Tum mein se kisi ke liye ye theek nahi ke wo apni biwi ko ghulaam ki tarah kode maare, kyunke shaayad wahi shaam ko uske saath so bhi jaaye.' Phir unhone unhein hasi na udaane ki naseehat ki jab koi (hawa) chhode aur farmaya, 'Koi apni hi harkat par khud kyun hansega?'

e: Narrated Alqama:I went to Sham with a group of the companions of `Abdullah (bin Mas`ud). Abu Ad-Darda' heard of our arrival so he came to us and said, "Is there anybody among you who can recite (Qur'an)" We replied in the affirmative. Then he asked, "Who is the best reciter?" They pointed at me. Then he told me to recite, so I recited the verse:-- 'By the night as it envelops 'By the day as it appears in brightness; By (Him Who created) male and the female.' (92.1-3) Abu Ad-Darda' then said to me, "Did you hear it (like this) from the mouth of your friend (`Abdullah bin Mas`ud)?" I said, "Yes." He said, "I too, heard it (like this) from the mouth of the Prophet, but these people do not consider this recitation as the correct one
hi: Alqama bataate hain: Main Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) (bin Masud) ke kuch saathiyon ke saath Sham gaya. Abu Ad-Darda ne humaare aane ki khabar suni to wo humaare paas aaye aur pucha, 'Kya tum mein se koi (Quran) padh sakta hai?' Humne haan mein jawab diya. Phir unhone pucha, 'Sabse achha padhne wala kaun hai?' Sabne mera ishara kiya. Phir unhone mujhe padhne ko kaha, to maine ye Aayat padhi: 'Raat ki qasam jab wo (sab kuch) chhupaa leti hai, aur din ki qasam jab wo raushan hota hai, aur us (Zaat) ki qasam jisne mard aur aurat ko banaaya.' (92:1-3) Abu Ad-Darda ne mujhse pucha, 'Kya tumne ye apne dost (Abdullah bin Masud) ke munh se aisi hi suni hai?' Maine kaha, 'Haan.' Unhone kaha, 'Maine bhi ise Nabi (SAW) ke munh se aisi hi suna hai, magar ye log is qiraat ko sahi nahi maante.'

e: Narrated Ibrahim:The companions of `Abdullah (bin Mas`ud) came to Abu Darda', (and before they arrived at his home), he looked for them and found them. Then he asked them,: 'Who among you can recite (Qur'an) as `Abdullah recites it?" They replied, "All of us." He asked, "Who among you knows it by heart?" They pointed at 'Alqama. Then he asked Alqama. "How did you hear `Abdullah bin Mas`ud reciting Surat Al-Lail (The Night)?" Alqama recited: 'By the male and the female.' Abu Ad-Darda said, "I testify that I heard me Prophet reciting it likewise, but these people want me to recite it:-- 'And by Him Who created male and female.' but by Allah, I will not follow them
hi: Ibrahim bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) (bin Masud) ke saathi Abu Darda ke paas aaye, (unke ghar pahunchne se pehle) unhone unhein dhoondh liya. Phir unhone pucha, 'Tum mein se kaun Quran waise padh sakta hai jaise Abdullah padhte hain?' Unhone kaha, 'Hum sab.' Unhone pucha, 'Tum mein se kise ye zabaani yaad hai?' Unhone Alqama ki taraf ishara kiya. Phir unhone Alqama se pucha, 'Tumne Abdullah bin Masud ko Surah Al-Lail (Raat) kaise padhte suna?' Alqama ne padha, 'Mard aur aurat ki qasam.' Abu Ad-Darda ne kaha, 'Main gawaahi deta hoon ke maine Nabi (SAW) ko bhi isi tarah padhte suna hai, magar ye log chahte hain ke main ise "Aur us (Zaat) ki qasam jisne mard aur aurat ko banaaya" padhun. Magar Allah ki qasam, main inki baat nahi maanunga.'

e: Narrated `Ali:We were in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) in a funeral procession at Baqi Al-Gharqad. He said, "There is none of you but has his place written for him in Paradise or in the Hell- Fire." They said, "O Allah's Apostle! Shall we depend (on this fact and give up work)?" He said, "Carry on doing (good deeds), for every body will find it easy to do (what will lead him to his destined place)." Then he recited: 'As for him who gives (in charity) and keeps his duty to Allah, and believes in the Best reward from Allah (i.e. Allah will compensate him for what he will spend in Allah's way). So, We will make smooth for him the path of ease. But he who is a greedy miser....for him, the path for evil
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Hum Baqi Al-Gharqad mein ek janaaze ke jaloos mein Nabi (SAW) ke saath the. Unhone farmaya, 'Tum mein se koi nahi jiske liye Jannat ya Jahannam mein uski jagah pehle se likhi na ho.' Logon ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! To kya hum isi par bharosa kar lein (aur amal karna chhod dein)?' Unhone farmaya, 'Amal karte raho, kyunke har kisi ke liye wahi kaam aasan kar diya jaayega (jo uski muqaddar wali jagah tak le jaaye).' Phir unhone padha: 'Jo shaks (khairaat mein) deta hai aur Allah se darta hai, aur behtareen badle (Allah ki taraf se) par Iman rakhta hai... Hum uske liye aasaani ka raasta aasan kar denge. Magar jo kanjoos aur be-parwaah hai...uske liye buraai ka raasta.'

e: Narrated Abu `Abdur-Rahman:`Ali said, "We were sitting with the Prophet," (He then mentioned the Hadith above)
hi: Abu Abdur Rahman bataate hain: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha, 'Hum Nabi (SAW) ke saath baithe the,' (phir unhone upar wali hadees zikr ki).

e: Narrated `Ali:While the Prophet (ﷺ) was in a funeral procession, he took a small stick and started scraping the earth with it and said, "There is none among you but has his place written for him, either in the Hell Fire or in Paradise." They (the people) said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shall we depend on this (and leave work)?" He replied. "Carry on doing (good deeds), for everybody will find easy (to do) such deeds as will lead him to his destined place." The Prophet (ﷺ) then recited:-- 'As for him who gives (in charity) and keeps his duty to Allah, and believes in the Best Reward
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Jab Nabi (SAW) ek janaaze ke jaloos mein the, unhone ek chhoti si chhadi uthaayi aur usse zameen khurachne lage aur farmaya, 'Tum mein se koi nahi jiske liye Jahannam ya Jannat mein uski jagah pehle se likhi na ho.' Logon ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! To kya hum isi par bharosa kar lein (aur kaam chhod dein)?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Amal karte raho, kyunke har kisi ke liye aise amal aasan kar diye jaayenge jo use uski muqaddar wali jagah tak le jaayein.' Phir Nabi (SAW) ne padha: 'Jo shaks (khairaat mein) deta hai aur Allah se darta hai, aur behtareen badle par Iman rakhta hai...'

e: Narrated `Ali:We were in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) and he said, "There is none among you but has his place written for him, either in Paradise or in the Hell-Fire." We said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shall we depend (on this fact and give up work)?" He replied, "No! Carry on doing good deeds, for everybody will find easy (to do) such deeds as will lead him to his destined place." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) recited: 'As for him who gives (in charity) and keeps his duty to Allah, and believes in the Best reward. We will make smooth for him the path of ease....the path for evil
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Hum Nabi (SAW) ke saath the aur unhone farmaya, 'Tum mein se koi nahi jiske liye Jannat ya Jahannam mein uski jagah pehle se likhi na ho.' Humne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! To kya hum isi par bharosa kar lein (aur amal karna chhod dein)?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Nahi! Amal karte raho, kyunke har kisi ke liye aise amal aasan kar diye jaayenge jo use uski muqaddar wali jagah tak le jaayein.' Phir Nabi (SAW) ne padha: 'Jo shaks (khairaat mein) deta hai aur Allah se darta hai, aur behtareen badle par Iman rakhta hai. Hum uske liye aasaani ka raasta aasan kar denge...buraai ka raasta.'

e: Narrated `Ali:While we were in a funeral procession in Baqi Al-Gharqad, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came and sat down, and we sat around him. He had a small stick in his hand and he bent his head and started scraping the ground with it. He then said, "There is none among you, and no created soul but has his place written for him either in Paradise or in the Hell-Fire, and also has his happy or miserable fate (in the Hereafter) written for him." A man said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shall we depend upon what is written for us and give up doing (good) deeds? For whoever among us is destined to be fortunate (in the Hereafter), will join the fortunate peoples and whoever among us is destined to be miserable will do such deeds as are characteristic of the people who are destined to misery." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Those who are destined to be happy (in the Hereafter) will find it easy and pleasant to do the deeds characteristic of those destined to happiness, while those who are to be among the miserable (in the Hereafter), will find it easy to do the deeds characteristic of those destined to misery." Then he recited: 'As for him who gives (in charity) and keeps his duty to Allah and believes in the Best reward from Allah
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Jab hum Baqi Al-Gharqad mein ek janaaze ke jaloos mein the, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aaye aur baith gaye, aur hum unke gird baith gaye. Unke haath mein ek chhoti chhadi thi aur unhone sar jhukaakar usse zameen khurachna shuru kar diya. Phir unhone farmaya, 'Tum mein se koi nahi, aur koi bhi paida ki gayi jaan nahi, jiske liye Jannat ya Jahannam mein uski jagah pehle se na likhi ho, aur uski khushi ya bad-naseebi ka muqaddar (Aakhirat mein) pehle se na likha ho.' Ek shaks ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! To kya hum apne muqaddar par bharosa karke amal karna chhod dein? Kyunke hum mein se jo khush-naseeb hone waala hai, wo khush-naseebon jaise amal karega, aur jo bad-naseeb hona hai, wo bad-naseebon jaise amal karega.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo (Aakhirat mein) khush-naseeb hone waale hain, unke liye khush-naseebi ke amal aasan aur aziz ho jaayenge, jabke jo bad-naseeb hone waale hain, unke liye bad-naseebi ke amal aasan ho jaayenge.' Phir unhone padha: 'Jo shaks (khairaat mein) deta hai aur Allah se darta hai, aur behtareen badle par Iman rakhta hai...'

e: Narrated `Ali:While the Prophet (ﷺ) was in a funeral procession. he picked up something and started scraping the ground with it, and said, "There is none among you but has his place written for him either in the Hell Fire or in Paradise." They said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shall we not depend upon what has been written for us and give up deeds? He said, "Carry on doing (good) deeds, for everybody will find easy to do such deeds as will lead him to his destined place for which he has been created. So he who is destined to be among the happy (in the Hereafter), will find it easy to do the deeds characteristic of such people, while he who is destined to be among the miserable ones, will find it easy to do the deeds characteristic of such people." Then he recited: 'As for him who gives (in charity) and fears Allah, and believes in the best
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Jab Nabi (SAW) ek janaaze ke jaloos mein the, unhone kuch uthaaya aur usse zameen khurachna shuru kiya, aur farmaya, 'Tum mein se koi nahi jiske liye Jahannam ya Jannat mein uski jagah pehle se likhi na ho.' Logon ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! To kya hum us par bharosa na karein jo hamaare liye likha ja chuka hai aur amal karna chhod dein?' Unhone farmaya, 'Amal karte raho, kyunke har kisi ke liye aise amal aasan kar diye jaayenge jo use uski usi muqaddar wali jagah tak le jaayein jiske liye wo banaaya gaya hai. To jo (Aakhirat mein) khush-naseebon mein se hoga, uske liye khush-naseebon jaise amal aasan ho jaayenge, aur jo bad-naseebon mein se hoga, uske liye bad-naseebon jaise amal aasan ho jaayenge.' Phir unhone padha: 'Jo shaks (khairaat mein) deta hai aur Allah se darta hai, aur behtareen (badle) par Iman rakhta hai...'

e: Narrated Jundub bin Sufyan:Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) became sick and could not offer his night prayer (Tahajjud) for two or three nights. Then a lady (the wife of Abu Lahab) came and said, "O Muhammad! I think that your Satan has forsaken you, for I have not seen him with you for two or three nights!" On that Allah revealed: 'By the fore-noon, and by the night when it darkens, your Lord (O Muhammad) has neither forsaken you, nor hated you
hi: Jundub bin Sufyan bataate hain: Ek baar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) bimar pad gaye aur do-teen raatein Tahajjud ki namaz nahi padh sake. Phir ek khaatoon (Abu Lahab ki biwi) aayi aur kaha, 'Aye Muhammad! Mujhe lagta hai aapke Shaitaan ne aapko chhod diya hai, kyunke maine use do-teen raaton se aapke saath nahi dekha!' Isper Allah ne naazil farmaya: 'Chaasht (din chadhne) ki qasam, aur raat ki jab wo chhaa jaaye, tumhaare Rab (Aye Muhammad) ne na tumhein chhoda hai aur na hi tumse naaraaz hua hai.'

e: Narrated Jundub Al-Bajali:A lady said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I see that your friend has delayed. (in conveying Qur'an) to you." So there was revealed: 'Your Lord (O Muhammad) has neither forsaken you, not hated you
hi: Jundub Al-Bajali bataate hain: Ek khaatoon ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe lagta hai aapke dost (Jibrael) ne aapke paas aana der kar diya hai (Quran pahunchaane mein).' Isper naazil hui: 'Tumhaare Rab (Aye Muhammad) ne na tumhein chhoda hai aur na hi tumse naaraaz hua hai.'

e: Narrated Al-Bara:While the Prophet (ﷺ) was on a journey, he recited Surat at-Tini waz-Zaituni (95) in one of the first two rak`at of the `Isha prayer
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Jab Nabi (SAW) safar mein the, unhone Isha ki namaz ki pehli do rakaton mein se ek mein Surah At-Tin (95) padhi.

e: Narrated Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) The commencement (of the Divine Inspiration) to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was in the form of true dreams in his sleep, for he never had a dream but it turned out to be true and clear as the bright daylight. Then he began to like seclusions, so he used to go in seclusion in the cave of Hira where he used to worship Allah continuously for many nights before going back to his family to take the necessary provision (of food) for the stay. He come back to (his wife) Khadija again to take his provision (of food) likewise, till one day he received the Guidance while he was in the cave of Hira. An Angel came to him and asked him to read. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, "I do not know how to read." The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "Then the Angel held me (forcibly) and pressed me so hard that I felt distressed. Then he released me and again asked me to read, and I replied, 'I do not know how to read.' Thereupon he held me again and pressed me for the second time till I felt distressed. He then released me and asked me to read, but again I replied. 'I do not know how to read.' Thereupon he held me for the third time and pressed me till I got distressed, and then he released me and said, 'Read, in the Name of your Lord Who has created (all that exists), has created man out of a clot, Read! And your Lord is the Most Generous. Who has taught (the writing) by the pen, has taught man that which he knew not." (96.1-5). Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) returned with that experience; and the muscles between his neck and shoulders were trembling till he came upon Khadija (his wife) and said, "Cover me!" They covered him, and when the state of fear was over, he said to Khadija, "O Khadija! What is wrong with me? I was afraid that something bad might happen to me." Then he told her the story. Khadija said, "Nay! But receive the good tidings! By Allah, Allah will never disgrace you, for by Allah, you keep good relations with your Kith and kin, speak the truth, help the poor and the destitute, entertain your guests generously and assist those who are stricken with calamities." Khadija then took him to Waraqa bin Naufil, the son of Khadija's paternal uncle. Waraqa had been converted to Christianity in the Pre-Islamic Period and used to write Arabic and write of the Gospel in Arabic as much as Allah wished him to write. He was an old man and had lost his eyesight. Khadija said (to Waraqa), "O my cousin! Listen to what your nephew is going to say." Waraqa said, "O my nephew! What have you seen?" The Prophet (ﷺ) then described whatever he had seen. Waraqa said, "This is the same Angel (Gabriel) who was sent to Moses. I wish I were young." He added some other statement. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked, "Will these people drive me out?" Waraqa said, "Yes, for nobody brought the like of what you have brought, but was treated with hostility. If I were to remain alive till your day (when you start preaching). then I would support you strongly." But a short while later Waraqa died and the Divine Inspiration was paused (stopped) for a while so that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was very much grieved
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki zawja) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) par wahi ki shuruaat sacche khwaabon ke zariye hui, jo unhein neend mein aate the, aur unka koi bhi khwaab kabhi galat saabit nahi hua, wo hamesha subah ki roshni jaisa saaf aur sach saabit hota. Phir unhein tanhaai pasand aane lagi, isliye wo Hira ki ghaar mein jaakar kai raaton tak musalsal Allah ki ibaadat karte, phir apne ghar wapas aakar apne rehne ke liye zaroori saamaan (khaana) lekar dobara jaate. Wo Khadija (رضی اللہ عنہا) (apni biwi) ke paas wapas aate is tarah bhi saamaan lene ke liye, yahaan tak ke ek din unhein Hira ki ghaar mein hi hidaayat mili. Ek Farishta unke paas aaya aur unse padhne ko kaha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne jawab diya, 'Mujhe padhna nahi aata.' Nabi (SAW) ne aage bataya, 'Phir Farishte ne mujhe (zabardasti) pakda aur itni zor se dabaaya ke mujhe takleef hone lagi. Phir usne mujhe chhoda aur dobara padhne ko kaha, maine kaha, "Mujhe padhna nahi aata." Isper usne mujhe dobara pakda aur doosri baar dabaaya yahaan tak ke mujhe takleef hone lagi. Phir usne mujhe chhoda aur padhne ko kaha, magar maine phir kaha, "Mujhe padhna nahi aata." Isper usne mujhe teesri baar pakda aur dabaaya yahaan tak ke mujhe takleef hui, phir usne mujhe chhoda aur kaha, "Padho apne Rab ke naam se jisne (sab kuch) paida kiya, jisne insaan ko jamme hue khoon se banaaya, padho! Aur tumhaara Rab sabse zyaada karam karne wala hai, jisne kalam ke zariye sikhaaya, insaan ko wo sikhaaya jo wo nahi jaanta tha."' (96:1-5) Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) is tajurbe ke saath wapas laute; unki gardan aur kandhon ke beech ke pathhe kaanp rahe the yahaan tak ke wo Khadija (apni biwi) ke paas pahunche aur kaha, 'Mujhe chaadar odhaao!' Unhone unhein chaadar odhaayi, aur jab unka khauf khatam hua, to unhone Khadija se kaha, 'Aye Khadija! Mujhe kya ho gaya hai? Mujhe dar tha ke kahin mera koi bura anjaam na ho jaaye.' Phir unhone poora waqiya bataaya. Khadija ne kaha, 'Nahi! Balke khush-khabri lijiye! Allah ki qasam, Allah aapko kabhi be-izzat nahi karega, kyunke Allah ki qasam, aap apne rishtedaaron se achha sulook karte hain, sach bolte hain, gareebon aur be-sahaaron ki madad karte hain, mehmaanon ki khaatirdaari khule dil se karte hain, aur musibat mein padne walon ki madad karte hain.' Phir Khadija unhein Waraqa bin Naufil ke paas le gayi, jo Khadija ke chacha ke bete the. Waraqa jaahiliyat ke daur mein Isaai ho gaye the aur Arabi mein likhte the, aur Injeel ka jitna hissa Allah chaahta utna Arabi mein likh dete the. Wo ek budhe aadmi the aur unki nazar chali gayi thi. Khadija ne (Waraqa se) kaha, 'Aye mere chachazaad bhai! Suniye apne bhatije (Nabi) ki baat.' Waraqa ne pucha, 'Aye mere bhatije! Tumne kya dekha?' Nabi (SAW) ne unhein jo kuch dekha wo bataaya. Waraqa ne kaha, 'Ye wahi Farishta (Jibrael) hai jo Musa ke paas bheja gaya tha. Kaash main jawaan hota!' Unhone kuch aur bhi kaha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne pucha, 'Kya ye log mujhe (mere shehar se) nikaal denge?' Waraqa ne kaha, 'Haan, kyunke jo bhi tumhaare jaisi cheez lekar aaya, uske saath dushmani ki gayi. Agar main tumhaare us daur (jab tum dawat dena shuru karoge) tak zinda raha, to main zaroor tumhaari poori taaqat se madad karunga.' Magar thodi hi der baad Waraqa ka intekaal ho gaya, aur wahi ka silsila kuch waqt ke liye ruk gaya, jisse Allah ke Rasool (SAW) bahut gam-zada ho gaye.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:While Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was talking about the period of pause in revelation. he said in his narration. "Once while I was walking, all of a sudden I heard a voice from the sky. I looked up and saw to my surprise, the same Angel as had visited me in the cave of Hira.' He was sitting on a chair between the sky and the earth. I got afraid of him and came back home and said, Wrap me! Wrap me!" So they covered him and then Allah revealed: 'O you, wrapped up! Arise and warn and your Lord magnify, and your garments purify and dessert the idols.' (74.1-5) Abu Salama said, "(Rijz) are the idols which the people of the Pre-Islamic period used to worship." After this the revelation started coming frequently and regularly
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) wahi ke rukne ki muddat ke baare mein baat kar rahe the, unhone apni riwayat mein kaha, 'Ek baar jab main chal raha tha, achaanak maine aasman se ek aawaaz sunni. Maine upar dekha aur hairaan reh gaya, wahi Farishta jo Hira ki ghaar mein mere paas aaya tha, aasman aur zameen ke beech ek kursi par baitha tha. Main unse dar gaya aur ghar wapas aaya, aur kaha, "Mujhe chaadaron mein lapet do! Mujhe chaadaron mein lapet do!" To unhone mujhe lapeta, phir Allah ne naazil farmaya: "Aye chaadar odhne wale! Utho aur khabardaar karo, aur apne Rab ki azmat bayaan karo, aur apne kapdon ko paak rakho, aur buton ko chhod do."' (74:1-5) Abu Salama ne kaha, '"Rijz" wo but hain jinki ibaadat jaahiliyat ke daur ke log kiya karte the.' Iske baad wahi zyaada baar aur mustaqil taur par aane lagi.

e: Narrated Aisha:The commencement of the Divine Inspiration to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was in the form of true dreams. The Angel came to him and said, "Read, in the Name of your Lord Who has created (all that exists), has created man a clot. Read! And your Lord is Most Generous
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) par wahi ki shuruaat sacche khwaabon ki soorat mein hui. Farishta unke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Padho apne Rab ke naam se jisne (sab kuch) paida kiya, jisne insaan ko jamme hue khoon se banaaya, padho! Aur tumhaara Rab sabse zyaada karam karne wala hai.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The commencement of (the Divine Inspirations to) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was in the form of true dreams. The Angel came to him and said, "Read! In the Name of your Lord Who has created all exists), has created man from a clot. Read! And your Lord is Most Generous, Who has taught (the writing) by the pen
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) par wahi ki shuruaat sacche khwaabon ki soorat mein hui. Farishta unke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Padho! Apne Rab ke naam se jisne (sab kuch) paida kiya, jisne insaan ko jamme hue khoon se banaaya. Padho! Aur tumhaara Rab sabse zyaada karam karne wala hai, jisne kalam ke zariye (likhna) sikhaaya.'

e: Narrated Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) returned to Khadija and said, "Wrap me! Wrap me!" (Then the sub-narrator narrated the rest of the narration)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) Khadija (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas laute aur kaha, 'Mujhe chaadar odhaao! Mujhe chaadar odhaao!' (Baaki riwayat aage bayaan ki gayi hai).

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Abu Jahl said, "If I see Muhammad praying at the Ka`ba, I will tread on his neck." When the Prophet (ﷺ) heard of that, he said, "If he does so, the Angels will snatch him away
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Jahl ne kaha, 'Agar main Muhammad ko Kaaba ke paas namaz padhte dekhoon, to main unki gardan par pair rakhunga.' Jab Nabi (SAW) ne ye baat suni, to unhone farmaya, 'Agar wo aisa kare, to Farishte use pakad lenge (aur uchhaal denge).'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said to Ubai (bin Ka`b). "Allah has ordered me to recite to you:--'Those who disbelieve among the people of the Scripture and among the idolators are not going to stop (from their disbelief.') (Sura 98) Ubai said, "Did Allah mention me by name?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Yes." On that, Ubai wept
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne Ubai (bin Ka'b) se kaha, 'Allah ne mujhe hukm diya hai ke main tumhein padh kar sunaun: "Ahl-e-Kitaab aur mushrikeen mein se jo log kaafir hain, wo (apne kufr se) baaz aane wale nahi..." (Surah 98).' Ubai ne pucha, 'Kya Allah ne mera naam liya?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Haan.' Isper Ubai ro pade.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said to Ubai, "Allah has ordered me recite Qur'an to you." Ubai asked, "Did Allah mention me by name to you?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah has mentioned your name to me." On that Ubai started weeping. (The sub-narrator) Qatada added: I have been informed that the Prophet (ﷺ) recited: 'Those who disbelieve among the people of the Scripture," ...to Ubai
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne Ubai se kaha, 'Allah ne mujhe hukm diya hai ke main tumhein Quran padh kar sunaun.' Ubai ne pucha, 'Kya Allah ne aapko mera naam bataaya?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Allah ne mujhe tumhaara naam bataaya hai.' Isper Ubai rone lage. (Ravi Qatada ne aage kaha:) Mujhe bataya gaya hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne Ubai ke saamne 'Ahl-e-Kitaab mein se jo log kaafir hain...' padha.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Prophet said to Ubai bin Ka`b, "Allah has ordered me to recite Qur'an to you." Ubai said, "Did Allah mention me by name to you?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Yes." Ubai said, "Have I been mentioned by the Lord of the Worlds?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Yes." Then Ubai burst into tears
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne Ubai bin Ka'b (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kaha, 'Allah ne mujhe hukm diya hai ke main tumhein Quran padh kar sunaun.' Ubai ne pucha, 'Kya Allah ne aapko mera naam bataaya?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Haan.' Ubai ne pucha, 'Kya mera naam Rab-ul-Aalameen ne liya?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Haan.' Isper Ubai phoot phoot kar rone lage.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, " Horses are kept for one of three purposes: A man may keep them (for Allah's Cause) to receive a reward in the Hereafter; another may keep them as a means of protection; and a third may keep them to be a burden for him. As for the man for whom the horse is a source of reward, he is the one who ties it for Allah's Cause, and he ties it with a long rope in a pasture or a garden, then, whatever it eats or drinks in that pasture or garden will be added to his good deeds. And if it breaks its rope and jumps over one or two hills, then, for all its footsteps and its manure, good deeds will be written for him. And if it passes by a river and drinks of its water though its owner had no intention to water it from that river, even then he will have good deeds written for him. So that horse will be (a source of) reward for such a man. If a man ties a horse for earning his livelihood and abstaining from asking others for help and he does not forget Allah's right, i.e. pays its Zakat and gives it to be used in Allah's Cause, then that horse will be a means of protection for him. But if a man ties it out of pride and to show off and to excite others, then that horse will be a burden (of sins) for him." Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked regarding donkeys. He replied, "Nothing has been revealed to me except this comprehensive Verse which includes everything: 'So whoever does good equal to the weight of an atom (or a smallest ant) shall see it; and whoever does evil equal to the weight of an atom (or a smallest ant) shall see it
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ghode teen maqsad ke liye paale jaate hain: koi unhe (Allah ki raah mein) Aakhirat ke ajr ke liye paalta hai; koi unhe hifaazat ke zariye ke taur par rakhta hai; aur koi unhe apne liye bojh (gunaah) bana leta hai. Jo shaks ghode ko Allah ki raah mein rakhta hai aur use charaagaah ya baagh mein lambi rassi se baandh deta hai, to us charaagaah ya baagh mein wo jo bhi khaata ya peeta hai, uske nek amaal mein jama hota jaata hai. Aur agar wo apni rassi tod kar ek ya do pahaadiyaan phaand jaaye, to uske har qadam aur uski laid (khaad) ke badle bhi nek amaal likhe jaate hain. Aur agar wo kisi nadi ke paas se guzre aur uska paani piye, halaanke maalik ka iraada use wahaan se paani pilaane ka nahi tha, to bhi uske liye nek amaal likhe jaate hain. To wo ghoda aise shaks ke liye ajr ka zariya banega. Agar koi shaks apni rozi kamaane aur logon se maangne se bachne ke liye ghoda paalta hai, aur Allah ka haq nahi bhoolta, yaani uski Zakat ada karta hai aur use Allah ki raah mein istemaal ke liye deta hai, to wo ghoda uske liye hifaazat ka zariya banega. Magar agar koi shaks ghamand, dikhawe aur logon ko ubhaarne ke liye ghoda paalta hai, to wo ghoda uske liye (gunaahon ka) bojh banega.' Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se gadhon ke baare mein pucha gaya. Unhone jawab diya, 'Mujhpar sirf ye jaame Aayat naazil hui hai jo har cheez ko shaamil karti hai: "To jo koi zarre (ya chhoti chiuti) barabar bhi neki kare, wo use dekhega; aur jo koi zarre (ya chhoti chiuti) barabar bhi buraai kare, wo use dekhega."'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) was asked about donkeys and he replied, "Nothing has been revealed to me regarding donkeys except this comprehensive Verse which includes everything: "So whoever does good equal to the weight of an atom (or a smallest ant) shall see it; And whoever, does evil equal to the weight of an atom or a smallest ant) shall see it
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) se gadhon ke baare mein pucha gaya, unhone jawab diya, 'Gadhon ke baare mein mujhpar sirf ye jaame Aayat naazil hui hai jo har cheez ko shaamil karti hai: "To jo koi zarre barabar bhi neki kare, wo use dekhega; aur jo koi zarre barabar bhi buraai kare, wo use dekhega."'

e: Narrated Anas:When the Prophet (ﷺ) was made to ascend to the Heavens, he said (after his return), "I came upon a river the banks of which were made of tents of hollow pearls. I asked Gabriel. What is this (river?) He replied, 'This is the Kauthar
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Nabi (SAW) ko aasmaanon tak le jaaya gaya, to (wapas aane ke baad) unhone farmaya, 'Main ek nadi ke paas pahuncha jiske kinaare khokhle motiyon ke khaimon se bane the. Maine Jibrael se pucha, "Ye kya hai?" Unhone jawab diya, "Ye Kauthar hai."'

e: Narrated Abu Ubaida:I asked `Aisha 'regarding the verse:--'Verily we have granted you the Kauthar.' She replied, "The Kauthar is a river which has been given to your Prophet on the banks of which there are (tents of) hollow pearls and its utensils are as numberless as the stars
hi: Abu Ubaida bataate hain: Maine Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se is Aayat ke baare mein pucha, 'Beshak Humne aapko Kauthar ata kiya.' Unhone jawab diya, 'Kauthar ek nadi hai jo aapke Nabi (SAW) ko di gayi hai, jiske kinaare khokhle motiyon ke (khaimon se bane) hain, aur uske bartan sitaaron jitne be-shumaar hain.'

e: Narrated Abu Bishr:Sa`id bin Jubair said that Ibn `Abbas said about Al-Kauthar. "That is the good which Allah has bestowed upon His Apostle." I said to Sa`id bin Jubair. "But the people claim that it is a river in Paradise." Sa`id said, "The river in Paradise is part of the good which Allah has bestowed on His Apostle
hi: Abu Bishr bataate hain: Saeed bin Jubair kehte hain ke Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Al-Kauthar ke baare mein kaha, 'Ye wo bhalaai hai jo Allah ne apne Rasool (SAW) ko ata ki.' Maine Saeed bin Jubair se kaha, 'Magar log dava karte hain ke ye Jannat mein ek nadi hai.' Saeed ne kaha, 'Jannat ki nadi bhi us bhalaai ka hissa hai jo Allah ne apne Rasool (SAW) ko ata ki.'

e: Narrated Aisha:"When the "Surat-An-Nasr", 'When comes the Help of Allah and the conquest,' had been revealed to the Prophet (ﷺ) he did not offer any prayer except that he said therein, "Subhanka Rabbana wa bihamdika; Allahumma ighfirli (I testify the Uniqueness of our Lord, and all the praises are for Him: O Allah, forgive me)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: 'Jab Surah An-Nasr, "Jab Allah ki madad aur fatah aa jaaye..." Nabi (SAW) par naazil hui, to wo jab bhi namaz padhte, usme kehte, "Subhaanaka Rabbana wa bihamdika; Allahumma-ighfirli" (Aye hamare Rab! Teri paakizgi bayaan karta hoon aur Teri tareef karta hoon; Aye Allah! Mujhe maaf farma).'

e: Narrated Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to say very often in bowing and prostration (during his prayers), Subhanka Allahumma Rabbana wa bihamdika; Allahumma ighfirli," according to the order of the Qur'an
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) namaz mein ruku aur sajde ke dauraan aksar ye kaha karte the, 'Subhaanaka Allahumma Rabbana wa bihamdika; Allahumma-ighfirli,' Quran ke hukm ke mutaabik.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:`Umar asked the people regarding Allah's Statement: 'When comes the Help of Allah (to you O Muhammad against your enemies) and the conquest of Mecca.' (110.1) They replied, "It indicates the future conquest of towns and palaces (by Muslims)." `Umar said, "What do you say about it, O Ibn `Abbas?" I replied, "(This Surat) indicates the termination of the life of Muhammad. Through it he was informed of the nearness of his death
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne logon se Allah ke is farmaan ke baare mein pucha: 'Jab Allah ki madad (Aye Muhammad, aapke dushmanon ke khilaaf) aur Makkah ki fatah aa jaaye...' (110:1) Unhone jawab diya, 'Ye Musalmaanon dwara aane waale shehron aur mahalon ki fatah ki taraf ishara karta hai.' Umar ne pucha, 'Tumhaara is baare mein kya khayaal hai, Aye Ibn Abbas?' Maine jawab diya, '(Ye Surah) Muhammad (SAW) ki zindagi ke khatam hone ki taraf ishara karti hai. Isse unhein unki maut ki nazdeeki ki khabar di gayi thi.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:`Umar used to make me sit with the elderly men who had fought in the Battle of Badr. Some of them felt it (did not like that) and said to `Umar "Why do you bring in this boy to sit with us while we have sons like him?" `Umar replied, "Because of what you know of his position (i.e. his religious knowledge.)" One day `Umar called me and made me sit in the gathering of those people; and I think that he called me just to show them. (my religious knowledge). `Umar then asked them (in my presence). "What do you say about the interpretation of the Statement of Allah: 'When comes Help of Allah (to you O, Muhammad against your enemies) and the conquest (of Mecca).' (110.1) Some of them said, "We are ordered to praise Allah and ask for His forgiveness when Allah's Help and the conquest (of Mecca) comes to us." Some others kept quiet and did not say anything. On that, `Umar asked me, "Do you say the same, O Ibn `Abbas?" I replied, "No." He said, 'What do you say then?" I replied, "That is the sign of the death of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) which Allah informed him of. Allah said:-- '(O Muhammad) When comes the Help of Allah (to you against your enemies) and the conquest (of Mecca) (which is the sign of your death). You should celebrate the praises of your Lord and ask for His Forgiveness, and He is the One Who accepts the repentance and forgives.' (110.3) On that `Umar said, "I do not know anything about it other than what you have said
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) mujhe un buzurgon ke saath baithaya karte the jinhone jang-e-Badr mein hissa liya tha. Unmein se kuch ko ye achha nahi laga aur unhone Umar se kaha, 'Aap is ladke ko humaare saath kyun baithaate hain, jabke humaare bhi isi jaise bete hain?' Umar ne jawab diya, 'Iski wo hasiyat jo tum jaante ho, usi ki wajah se (main isse apne paas baithaata hoon).' Ek din Umar ne mujhe bulaaya aur un logon ki majlis mein baithaaya; mera khayaal hai ke unhone mujhe sirf unhein (mera ilm) dikhaane ke liye bulaaya tha. Umar ne (mere saamne) unse pucha, 'Is Aayat ki tafseer ke baare mein tumhaara kya khayaal hai: "Jab Allah ki madad (Aye Muhammad, aapke dushmanon ke khilaaf) aur (Makkah ki) fatah aa jaaye..."?' (110:1) Kuch ne kaha, 'Humein hukm diya gaya hai ke jab Allah ki madad aur (Makkah ki) fatah aa jaaye, to hum Allah ki tareef karein aur uski maafi maangein.' Kuch aur khaamosh rahe aur kuch nahi kaha. Isper Umar ne mujhse pucha, 'Kya tum bhi yahi kehte ho, Aye Ibn Abbas?' Maine jawab diya, 'Nahi.' Unhone pucha, 'To tum kya kehte ho?' Maine jawab diya, 'Ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki wafat ki nishaani hai jiski khabar Allah ne unhein di thi. Allah ne farmaya: "(Aye Muhammad) jab Allah ki madad (aapke dushmanon ke khilaaf) aur (Makkah ki) fatah aa jaaye (jo aapki maut ki nishaani hai), to aap apne Rab ki tareef bayaan karein aur uski maafi maangein, aur wo tauba qubool karne wala aur maaf karne wala hai."' (110:3) Isper Umar ne kaha, 'Mujhe iske baare mein wahi pata hai jo tumne kaha.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When the Verse:-- 'And warn your tribe of near kindred.' (26.214) was revealed. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went out, and when he had ascended As-Safa mountain, he shouted, "O Sabahah!" The people said, "Who is that?" "Then they gathered around him, whereupon he said, "Do you see? If I inform you that cavalrymen are proceeding up the side of this mountain, will you believe me?" They said, "We have never heard you telling a lie." Then he said, "I am a plain warner to you of a coming severe punishment." Abu Lahab said, "May you perish! You gathered us only for this reason? " Then Abu Lahab went away. So the "Surat:--ul--LAHAB" 'Perish the hands of Abu Lahab!' (111.1) was revealed
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab ye Aayat naazil hui, 'Aur apne qareebi rishtedaaron ko dara' (26:214), to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) baahar nikle, aur Safa pahaad par chadh kar chillaaye, 'Aye Sabahah!' Logon ne pucha, 'Ye kaun hai?' Phir wo unke gird jama ho gaye, isper unhone kaha, 'Kya tum dekhte ho? Agar main tumhein bataun ke sawaar is pahaad ke ek taraf se aa rahe hain, to kya tum mera yaqeen karoge?' Unhone kaha, 'Humne kabhi aapko jhoot bolte nahi suna.' Phir unhone farmaya, 'Main tumhein ek aane waale sakht azaab se saaf saaf khabardaar karta hoon.' Abu Lahab ne kaha, 'Tum barbaad ho! Kya isi liye tumne humein bulaaya?' Phir Abu Lahab chala gaya. To Surah 'Al-Lahab' naazil hui: 'Barbaad hon Abu Lahab ke haath!' (111:1)

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) went out towards Al-Batha' and ascended the mountain and shouted, "O Sabahah!" So the Quraish people gathered around him. He said, "Do you see? If I tell you that an enemy is going to attack you in the morning or in the evening, will you believe me?" They replied, "Yes." He said, "Then I am a plain warner to you of a coming severe punishment." Abu Lahab said, "Is it for this reason that you have gathered us? May you perish ! " Then Allah revealed: 'Perish the hands of Abu Lahab
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) Al-Batha ki taraf gaye aur pahaad par chadh kar chillaaye, 'Aye Sabahah!' To Quraish log unke gird jama ho gaye. Unhone kaha, 'Kya tum dekhte ho? Agar main tumhein bataun ke ek dushman subah ya shaam tumpar hamla karne wala hai, to kya tum mera yaqeen karoge?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan.' Unhone farmaya, 'To main tumhein ek aane waale sakht azaab se saaf saaf khabardaar karta hoon.' Abu Lahab ne kaha, 'Kya isi liye tumne humein bulaaya? Tum barbaad ho!' Isper Allah ne naazil farmaya: 'Barbaad hon Abu Lahab ke haath...'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Abu Lahab said, "May you perish! Is it' for this that you have gathered us?" So there was revealed:'Perish the hands of Abu Lahab
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Lahab ne kaha, 'Tum barbaad ho! Kya isi liye tumne humein bulaaya?' Isper naazil hui: 'Barbaad hon Abu Lahab ke haath...'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah said: 'The son of Adam tells a lie against Me,, though he hasn't the right to do so. He abuses me though he hasn't the right to do so. As for his telling a lie against Me, it is his saying that I will not recreate him as I created him for the first time. In fact, the first creation was not easier for Me than new creation. As for his abusing Me, it is his saying that Allah has begotten children, while I am the One, the Self-Sufficient Master Whom all creatures need, I beget not, nor was I begotten, and there is none like unto Me
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah farmaata hai, "Aadam ka beta Mujh par jhoot bolta hai, halaanke usse aisa karne ka koi haq nahi. Wo Mujhe bura-bhala kehta hai, halaanke usse aisa karne ka bhi koi haq nahi. Mujh par uska jhoot ye hai ke wo kehta hai ke Main use dobara paida nahi karunga jaise Maine pehli baar kiya tha - haqeeqat mein pehli paidaish Mere liye nayi paidaish se zyaada aasan nahi thi. Aur Mujhe uska bura-bhala kehna ye hai ke wo kehta hai ke Allah ki aulaad hai, jabke Main akela hoon, sabki zaroorat ka Maalik hoon jiski har makhlooq ko zaroorat hai, na Meri koi aulaad hai, na Main kisi se paida hua hoon, aur na hi koi Mere jaisa hai."'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah said:-- 'The son of Adam tells a lie against Me and he hasn't the right to do so; and he abuses me and he hasn't the right to do so. His telling a lie against Me is his saying that I will not recreate him as I created him for the first time; and his abusing Me is his saying that Allah has begotten children, while I am the self-sufficient Master, Whom all creatures need, Who begets not nor was He begotten, and there is none like unto Me
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah farmaata hai, "Aadam ka beta Mujh par jhoot bolta hai, halaanke usse aisa karne ka koi haq nahi; aur wo Mujhe bura-bhala kehta hai, halaanke usse aisa karne ka bhi koi haq nahi. Mujh par uska jhoot ye hai ke wo kehta hai ke Main use dobara paida nahi karunga jaise Maine pehli baar kiya tha; aur Mujhe uska bura-bhala kehna ye hai ke wo kehta hai ke Allah ki aulaad hai, jabke Main sabki zaroorat ka Maalik hoon jiski har makhlooq ko zaroorat hai, na Meri koi aulaad hai, na Main kisi se paida hua hoon, aur na hi koi Mere jaisa hai."'

e: Narrated Zirr bin Hubaish:I asked Ubai bin Ka`b regarding the two Muwwidhat (Surats of taking refuge with Allah). He said, "I asked the Prophet (ﷺ) about them, He said, 'These two Surats have been recited to me and I have recited them (and are present in the Qur'an).' So, we say as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said (i.e., they are part of the Qur'an)
hi: Zirr bin Hubaish bataate hain: Maine Ubai bin Ka'b (رضی اللہ عنہ) se do Muawwidhatain (panaah maangne wali Surahon) ke baare mein pucha. Unhone kaha, 'Maine Nabi (SAW) se unke baare mein pucha tha, unhone farmaya, "Ye dono Surahein mujhpar padhi gayin (naazil hui) aur maine unhein padha (aur wo Quran mein hi hain)."' Isliye hum wahi kehte hain jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha (yaani wo Quran ka hissa hain).

e: Narrated Zirr bin Hubaish:I asked Ubai bin Ka`b, "O Abu AlMundhir! Your brother, Ibn Mas`ud said so-and-so (i.e., the two Mu'awwidh-at do not belong to the Qur'an)." Ubai said, "I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about them, and he said, 'They have been revealed to me, and I have recited them (as a part of the Qur'an)," So Ubai added, "So we say as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has said
hi: Zirr bin Hubaish bataate hain: Maine Ubai bin Ka'b (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kaha, 'Aye Abu Al-Mundhir! Aapke bhai, Ibn Masud, ne aisi aisi baat kahi (yaani do Muawwidhatain Quran ka hissa nahi hain).' Ubai ne kaha, 'Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se unke baare mein pucha, unhone farmaya, "Ye mujhpar naazil hui hain, aur maine unhein padha hai (Quran ke hisse ke taur par)."' Ubai ne aage kaha, 'To hum wahi kehte hain jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha.'

e: Narrated `Aisha and Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) remained in Mecca for ten years, during which the Qur'an used to be revealed to him; and he stayed in Medina for ten years
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) aur Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) Makkah mein dus saal rahe, jiske dauraan unpar Quran naazil hota raha, aur Madina mein bhi wo dus saal rahe.

e: Narrated Abu `Uthman:I was informed that Gabriel came to the Prophet (ﷺ) while Um Salama was with him. Gabriel started talking (to the Prophet). Then the Prophet (ﷺ) asked Um Salama, "Who is this?" She replied, "He is Dihya (al-Kalbi)." When Gabriel had left, Um Salama said, "By Allah, I did not take him for anybody other than him (i.e. Dihya) till I heard the sermon of the Prophet (ﷺ) wherein he informed about the news of Gabriel." The subnarrator asked Abu `Uthman: From whom have you heard that? Abu `Uthman said: From Usama bin Zaid
hi: Abu Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Mujhe bataya gaya ke Jibrael Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye jabke Umm Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) bhi unke saath thin. Jibrael (Nabi se) baat karne lage. Phir Nabi (SAW) ne Umm Salama se pucha, 'Ye kaun hai?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Ye Dihya (Al-Kalbi) hain.' Jab Jibrael chale gaye, Umm Salama ne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, maine unhein Dihya ke siwa kisi aur ka nahi samjha tha, jab tak maine Nabi (SAW) ka khutba nahi suna jismein unhone Jibrael ki khabar batayi.' Ravi ne Abu Uthman se pucha, 'Aapne ye kisse suna?' Abu Uthman ne kaha, 'Usama bin Zaid se.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Every Prophet was given miracles because of which people believed, but what I have been given, is Divine Inspiration which Allah has revealed to me. So I hope that my followers will outnumber the followers of the other Prophets on the Day of Resurrection
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Har Nabi ko mojze diye gaye jinki wajah se log Iman laaye, magar mujhe jo diya gaya hai wo wahi hai jo Allah ne mujhpar naazil ki hai. Isliye mujhe ummeed hai ke Qayamat ke din mere maanne wale doosre Nabiyon ke maanne walon se zyaada honge.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah sent down His Divine Inspiration to His Apostle continuously and abundantly during the period preceding his death till He took him unto Him. That was the period of the greatest part of revelation; and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died after that
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ne apne Rasool (SAW) par unki wafat se pehle wale daur mein musalsal aur bahut zyaada wahi naazil ki, yahaan tak ke unhein apne paas bula liya. Ye wahi ke sabse zyaada hisse ka daur tha, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) iske baad wafat pa gaye.

e: Narrated Jundub:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) fell ill and did not offer the night prayer (Tahajjud prayer) for a night or two. A woman (the wife of Abu Lahab) came to him and said, "O Muhammad ! I do not see but that your Satan has left you." Then Allah revealed (Surat-Ad-Duha): 'By the fore-noon, and by the night when it darkens (or is still); Your Lord has not forsaken you, nor hated you
hi: Jundub bataate hain: Ek baar Nabi (SAW) bimar pad gaye aur ek ya do raat Tahajjud ki namaz nahi padh sake. Ek aurat (Abu Lahab ki biwi) unke paas aayi aur kaha, 'Aye Muhammad! Mujhe lagta hai aapke Shaitaan ne aapko chhod diya hai.' Isper Allah ne (Surah Ad-Duha) naazil ki: 'Chaasht ki qasam, aur raat ki jab wo chhaa jaaye (ya thehar jaaye); tumhaare Rab ne na tumhein chhoda hai aur na hi tumse naaraaz hua hai.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:(The Caliph `Uthman ordered Zaid bin Thabit, Sa`id bin Al-As, `Abdullah bin Az-Zubair and `Abdur- Rahman bin Al-Harith bin Hisham to write the Qur'an in the form of a book (Mushafs) and said to them. "In case you disagree with Zaid bin Thabit (Al-Ansari) regarding any dialectic Arabic utterance of the Qur'an, then write it in the dialect of Quraish, for the Qur'an was revealed in this dialect." So they did it
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: (Khalifa Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Zaid bin Thabit (رضی اللہ عنہ), Saeed bin Al-As, Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Abdur Rahman bin Al-Harith bin Hisham ko hukm diya ke wo Quran ko ek Kitaab (Mushaf) ki shakl mein likhein, aur unse kaha, 'Agar tum Zaid bin Thabit (Al-Ansari) se kisi Arabi lehje ke lafz ke baare mein ikhtelaf karo, to use Quraish ke lehje mein likho, kyunke Quran isi lehje mein naazil hua tha.' To unhone aisa hi kiya.)

e: Narrated Safwan bin Ya`la bin Umaiya:Ya`la used to say, "I wish I could see Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) at the time he is being inspired Divinely." When the Prophet (ﷺ) was at Al-Ji'rana and was shaded by a garment hanging over him and some of his companions were with him, a man perfumed with scent came and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What is your opinion regarding a man who assumes Ihram and puts on a cloak after perfuming his body with scent?" The Prophet (ﷺ) waited for a while, and then the Divine Inspiration descended upon him. `Umar pointed out to Ya`la, telling him to come. Ya`la came and pushed his head (underneath the screen which was covering the Prophet (ﷺ) ) and behold! The Prophet's face was red and he kept on breathing heavily for a while and then he was relieved. Thereupon he said, "Where is the questioner who asked me about `Umra a while ago?" The man was sought and then was brought before the Prophet (ﷺ) who said (to him), "As regards the scent which you perfumed your body with, you must wash it off thrice, and as for your cloak, you must take it off; and then perform in your `Umra all those things which you perform in Hajj
hi: Safwan bin Ya'la bin Umaiya bataate hain: Ya'la kaha karte the, 'Kaash main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko us waqt dekh paata jab unpar wahi naazil ho rahi ho.' Jab Nabi (SAW) Al-Ji'rana mein the aur unke upar ek kapda taan kar unhein chhaaya di gayi thi, aur unke kuch sahaaba unke saath the, ek khushbu lagaaye shaks aaya aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Uss aadmi ke baare mein aapki kya raay hai jo Ihram baandhta hai aur apna badan khushbu lagaane ke baad ek chogha pehnta hai?' Nabi (SAW) thodi der khaamosh rahe, phir unpar wahi naazil hone lagi. Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Ya'la ko ishara karke bulaaya. Ya'la aaye aur apna sar (us parde ke andar) ghusaaya jo Nabi (SAW) ko dhaanke hue tha, aur dekha ke Nabi (SAW) ka chehra surkh ho gaya tha aur wo thodi der tak zor se saans le rahe the, phir unhein raahat mili. Isper unhone farmaya, 'Wo sawaal poochne wala kahaan hai jisne mujhse Umra ke baare mein pucha tha?' Us aadmi ko dhoonda gaya aur Nabi (SAW) ke saamne laaya gaya, unhone (usse) farmaya, 'Jo khushbu tumne apne badan par lagaayi hai, use teen baar dho lo, aur apna chogha utaar do; phir apne Umra mein wo sab kaam karo jo Hajj mein karte ho.'

e: Narrated Zaid bin Thabit:Abu Bakr As-Siddiq sent for me when the people of Yamama had been killed (i.e., a number of the Prophet's Companions who fought against Musailima). (I went to him) and found `Umar bin Al- Khattab sitting with him. Abu Bakr then said (to me), "`Umar has come to me and said: "Casualties were heavy among the Qurra' of the Qur'an (i.e. those who knew the Qur'an by heart) on the day of the Battle of Yamama, and I am afraid that more heavy casualties may take place among the Qurra' on other battlefields, whereby a large part of the Qur'an may be lost. Therefore I suggest, you (Abu Bakr) order that the Qur'an be collected." I said to `Umar, "How can you do something which Allah's Apostle did not do?" `Umar said, "By Allah, that is a good project." `Umar kept on urging me to accept his proposal till Allah opened my chest for it and I began to realize the good in the idea which `Umar had realized." Then Abu Bakr said (to me). 'You are a wise young man and we do not have any suspicion about you, and you used to write the Divine Inspiration for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). So you should search for (the fragmentary scripts of) the Qur'an and collect it in one book." By Allah If they had ordered me to shift one of the mountains, it would not have been heavier for me than this ordering me to collect the Qur'an. Then I said to Abu Bakr, "How will you do something which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not do?" Abu Bakr replied, "By Allah, it is a good project." Abu Bakr kept on urging me to accept his idea until Allah opened my chest for what He had opened the chests of Abu Bakr and `Umar. So I started looking for the Qur'an and collecting it from (what was written on) palme stalks, thin white stones and also from the men who knew it by heart, till I found the last Verse of Surat at-Tauba (Repentance) with Abi Khuzaima Al-Ansari, and I did not find it with anybody other than him. The Verse is: 'Verily there has come unto you an Apostle (Muhammad) from amongst yourselves. It grieves him that you should receive any injury or difficulty..(till the end of Surat-Baraa' (at-Tauba) (9.128-129). Then the complete manuscripts (copy) of the Qur'an remained with Abu Bakr till he died, then with `Umar till the end of his life, and then with Hafsa, the daughter of `Umar
hi: Zaid bin Thabit (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Yamama ke logon (Musailima ke khilaaf jang mein maare gaye Nabi ke sahaaba) ke qatl hone ke baad Abu Bakr As-Siddiq ne mujhe bulwaaya. (Main unke paas gaya) aur Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab ko unke saath baitha paaya. Abu Bakr ne (mujhse) kaha, 'Umar mere paas aaye aur kaha, "Jang-e-Yamama ke din Quran ke Qurra (zabaani yaad karne walon) mein bhaari nuqsaan hua hai, aur mujhe dar hai ke doosre maidan-e-jang mein bhi Qurra mein bhaari nuqsaan hoga, jiski wajah se Quran ka bada hissa zaaya ho jaayega. Isliye main sujhaav deta hoon ke aap Quran ko jama karne ka hukm dein." Maine Umar se kaha, "Aap wo kaam kaise kar sakte hain jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne khud nahi kiya?" Umar ne kaha, "Allah ki qasam, ye ek achha kaam hai." Umar mujhe manaate rahe yahaan tak ke Allah ne mera seena is kaam ke liye khol diya aur mujhe bhi wahi bhalaai samajh aayi jo Umar ko samajh aayi thi.' Phir Abu Bakr ne (mujhse) kaha, 'Tum ek aqlmand jawaan aadmi ho aur humein tum par koi shak nahi, aur tum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke liye wahi likha karte the. Isliye tumhein Quran (ke bikhre hue tukdon) ko dhoondh kar ek Kitaab mein jama karna chaahiye.' Allah ki qasam, agar mujhe kisi pahaad ko uski jagah se hataane ka hukm diya jaata, to wo mujhe Quran jama karne ke hukm se zyaada bhaari nahi lagta. Phir maine Abu Bakr se kaha, 'Aap wo kaam kaise kar sakte hain jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne nahi kiya?' Abu Bakr ne jawab diya, 'Allah ki qasam, ye ek achha kaam hai.' Abu Bakr mujhe manaate rahe yahaan tak ke Allah ne mera seena bhi usi tarah khol diya jaise usne Abu Bakr aur Umar ka khola tha. To maine Quran ko dhoondhna aur jama karna shuru kiya - khajoor ke patton ki daalon, safed patthar ke tukdon, aur un logon se jo ise zabaani yaad karte the - yahaan tak ke mujhe Surah At-Tauba ki aakhri Aayat Abi Khuzaima Al-Ansari ke paas mili, mujhe wo kisi aur ke paas nahi mili. Wo Aayat hai: 'Beshak tumhaare paas tum mein se hi ek Rasool (Muhammad) aaya hai. Use tumhaari takleef aur mushkilaat par bahut dukh hota hai...' (Surah Bara'a/At-Tauba ke aakhir tak) (9:128-129) Phir Quran ka wo mukammal nuskha Abu Bakr ke paas raha yahaan tak ke unka intekaal ho gaya, phir Umar ke paas unki zindagi ke aakhir tak, aur phir Umar ki beti Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas raha.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Hudhaifa bin Al-Yaman came to `Uthman at the time when the people of Sham and the people of Iraq were Waging war to conquer Arminya and Adharbijan. Hudhaifa was afraid of their (the people of Sham and Iraq) differences in the recitation of the Qur'an, so he said to `Uthman, "O chief of the Believers! Save this nation before they differ about the Book (Qur'an) as Jews and the Christians did before." So `Uthman sent a message to Hafsa saying, "Send us the manuscripts of the Qur'an so that we may compile the Qur'anic materials in perfect copies and return the manuscripts to you." Hafsa sent it to `Uthman. `Uthman then ordered Zaid bin Thabit, `Abdullah bin Az-Zubair, Sa`id bin Al-As and `AbdurRahman bin Harith bin Hisham to rewrite the manuscripts in perfect copies. `Uthman said to the three Quraishi men, "In case you disagree with Zaid bin Thabit on any point in the Qur'an, then write it in the dialect of Quraish, the Qur'an was revealed in their tongue." They did so, and when they had written many copies, `Uthman returned the original manuscripts to Hafsa. `Uthman sent to every Muslim province one copy of what they had copied, and ordered that all the other Qur'anic materials, whether written in fragmentary manuscripts or whole copies, be burnt
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Yaman Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas aaye us waqt jab Sham aur Iraq ke log Armenia aur Azerbaijan fatah karne ke liye jang lad rahe the. Hudhaifa ko unki (Sham aur Iraq waalon ki) Quran ki qiraat mein ikhtelaf ka dar tha, isliye unhone Uthman se kaha, 'Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen! Is ummat ko bachaaiye is se pehle ke wo Kitaab (Quran) ke baare mein ikhtelaf karein jaisa Yahudiyon aur Isaaiyon ne pehle kiya tha.' To Uthman ne Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko paighaam bheja, 'Humein Quran ke nuskhe bhej dein taake hum Quraani maadde ko mukammal nuskhon mein jama kar sakein aur wo nuskhe aapko wapas kar dein.' Hafsa ne wo Uthman ko bhej diye. Uthman ne phir Zaid bin Thabit (رضی اللہ عنہ), Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ), Saeed bin Al-As aur Abdur Rahman bin Harith bin Hisham ko hukm diya ke wo nuskhon ko mukammal kaapiyon mein dobara likhein. Uthman ne teen Quraishi logon se kaha, 'Agar tum Zaid bin Thabit se Quran ke kisi maamle par ikhtelaf karo, to use Quraish ke lehje mein likho, kyunke Quran unki hi zabaan mein naazil hua tha.' Unhone aisa hi kiya, aur jab unhone bahut si kaapiyaan taiyaar kar li, to Uthman ne asal nuskhe Hafsa ko wapas kar diye. Uthman ne har Musalmaan ilaake ko unki taiyaar ki hui ek kaapi bheji, aur hukm diya ke baaki sab Quraani maadde, chaahe wo bikhre hue nuskhe hon ya poori kaapiyaan, jala diye jaayein.

e: Zaid bin Thabit added, "A verse from Surat Ahzab was missed by me when we copied the Qur'an and I used to hear Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) reciting it. So we searched for it and found it with Khuza`ima bin Thabit Al-Ansari. (That Verse was):'Among the Believers are men who have been true in their covenant with Allah
hi: Zaid bin Thabit (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne aage kaha, 'Surah Al-Ahzab ki ek Aayat jab hum Quran ki nuskhe bana rahe the tab mujhse chhoot gayi thi, jise main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko padhte suna karta tha. To humne use dhoondha aur wo Khuzaima bin Thabit Al-Ansari ke paas mili. (Wo Aayat thi:) "Momineen mein aise log hain jinhone Allah se kiye apne ahad ko sach kar dikhaaya..."'

e: Narrated Zaid bin Thabit:Abu Bakr sent for me and said, "You used to write the Divine Revelations for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) : So you should search for (the Qur'an and collect) it."
