I started searching for the Qur'an till I found the last two Verses of Surat at-Tauba with Abi Khuza`ima Al-Ansari and I could not find these Verses with anybody other than him. (They were): 'Verily there has come unto you an Apostle (Muhammad) from amongst yourselves. It grieves him that you should receive any injury or difficulty
hi: Zaid bin Thabit (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Bakr ne mujhe bulwaaya aur kaha, 'Tum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke liye wahi likha karte the, isliye tumhein Quran ko dhoondh kar jama karna chaahiye.' Maine Quran dhoondhna shuru kiya yahaan tak ke Surah At-Tauba ki aakhri do Aayaten mujhe Abi Khuzaima Al-Ansari ke paas milin, aur mujhe wo kisi aur ke paas nahi milin. (Wo Aayaten thin:) 'Beshak tumhaare paas tum mein se hi ek Rasool (Muhammad) aaya hai. Use tumhaari takleef aur mushkilaat par bahut dukh hota hai...'

e: Narrated Al-Bara:There was revealed: 'Not equal are those believers who sit (at home) and those who strive and fight in the Cause of Allah.' (4.95) The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Call Zaid for me and let him bring the board, the inkpot and the scapula bone (or the scapula bone and the ink pot)."' Then he said, "Write: 'Not equal are those Believers who sit..", and at that time `Amr bin Um Maktum, the blind man was sitting behind the Prophet (ﷺ) . He said, "O Allah's Apostle! What is your order For me (as regards the above Verse) as I am a blind man?" So, instead of the above Verse, the following Verse was revealed: 'Not equal are those believers who sit (at home) except those who are disabled (by injury or are blind or lame etc.) and those who strive and fight in the cause of Allah
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Ye Aayat naazil hui, 'Wo Musalmaan jo (ghar mein) baithe rehte hain aur wo jo Allah ki raah mein jihaad karte hain, dono barabar nahi hain' (4:95). Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Zaid ko bulaao aur unhein takhta, dawaat aur kandhe ki haddi (ya kandhe ki haddi aur dawaat) laane ko kaho.' Phir unhone kaha, 'Likho: "Wo Musalmaan jo (ghar mein) baithe rehte hain..."' Us waqt Amr bin Umm Maktoom, jo andhe the, Nabi (SAW) ke peechhe baithe hue the. Unhone kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mere liye (is Aayat ke baare mein) aapka kya hukm hai, kyunke main ek andha aadmi hoon?' To upar wali Aayat ki jagah ye Aayat naazil hui: 'Wo Musalmaan jo (ghar mein) baithe rehte hain - siwaaye un logon ke jo maazoor hain (chot ki wajah se ya andhe ya langde hon) - aur wo jo Allah ki raah mein jihaad karte hain, dono barabar nahi hain.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Gabriel recited the Qur'an to me in one way. Then I requested him (to read it in another way), and continued asking him to recite it in other ways, and he recited it in several ways till he ultimately recited it in seven different ways
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jibrael ne mujhe Quran ek tareeke se padha ke sunaaya. Phir maine unse (doosre tareeke se padhne ki) darkhwaast ki, aur baar baar unse aur tareekon mein padhne ko kaha, aur unhone kayi tareekon mein padha, yahaan tak ke aakhir mein wo saat alag alag tareekon mein padha.'

e: Narrated `Umar bin Al-Khattab:I heard Hisham bin Hakim reciting Surat Al-Furqan during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and I listened to his recitation and noticed that he recited in several different ways which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had not taught me. I was about to jump over him during his prayer, but I controlled my temper, and when he had completed his prayer, I put his upper garment around his neck and seized him by it and said, "Who taught you this Sura which I heard you reciting?" He replied, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) taught it to me." I said, "You have told a lie, for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has taught it to me in a different way from yours." So I dragged him to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said (to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)), "I heard this person reciting Surat Al-Furqan in a way which you haven't taught me!" On that Allah's Apostle said, "Release him, (O `Umar!) Recite, O Hisham!" Then he recited in the same way as I heard him reciting. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "It was revealed in this way," and added, "Recite, O `Umar!" I recited it as he had taught me. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then said, "It was revealed in this way. This Qur'an has been revealed to be recited in seven different ways, so recite of it whichever (way) is easier for you (or read as much of it as may be easy for you)
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab bataate hain: Maine Hisham bin Hakim ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zindagi mein Surah Al-Furqan padhte suna, aur maine dhyaan se unki qiraat suni aur dekha ke wo kayi alag alag tareekon mein padh rahe the jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe nahi sikhaaye the. Main unki namaz ke dauraan unpar tootne hi wala tha, magar maine apna gussa qaabu kiya, aur jab unhone apni namaz poori kar li, to maine unki chaadar unki gardan mein lapet kar unhein pakad liya aur kaha, 'Kisne tumhein ye Surah sikhaayi jo maine tumhein padhte suna?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe sikhaayi.' Maine kaha, 'Tumne jhoot bola, kyunke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe ise tumse alag tareeke se sikhaaya hai.' To main unhein khainch kar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas le gaya aur (unse) kaha, 'Maine is shaks ko Surah Al-Furqan aise padhte suna hai jo aapne mujhe nahi sikhaaya!' Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ise chhod do, Aye Umar! Padho, Aye Hisham!' Phir unhone waisa hi padha jaisa maine unhein padhte suna tha. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ye isi tarah naazil hui thi,' aur kaha, 'Padho, Aye Umar!' Maine ise waisa padha jaisa unhone mujhe sikhaaya tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne phir farmaya, 'Ye isi tarah bhi naazil hui thi. Ye Quran saat alag alag tareekon mein padhe jaane ke liye naazil hua hai, isliye jo tareeka tumhein aasan lage usi mein padho.'

e: Narrated Yusuf bin Mahk:While I was with Aisha, the mother of the Believers, a person from Iraq came and asked, "What type of shroud is the best?" `Aisha said, "May Allah be merciful to you! What does it matter?" He said, "O mother of the Believers! Show me (the copy of) your Qur'an," She said, "Why?" He said, "In order to compile and arrange the Qur'an according to it, for people recite it with its Suras not in proper order." `Aisha said, "What does it matter which part of it you read first? (Be informed) that the first thing that was revealed thereof was a Sura from Al-Mufassal, and in it was mentioned Paradise and the Fire. When the people embraced Islam, the Verses regarding legal and illegal things were revealed. If the first thing to be revealed was: 'Do not drink alcoholic drinks.' people would have said, 'We will never leave alcoholic drinks,' and if there had been revealed, 'Do not commit illegal sexual intercourse, 'they would have said, 'We will never give up illegal sexual intercourse.' While I was a young girl of playing age, the following Verse was revealed in Mecca to Muhammad: 'Nay! But the Hour is their appointed time (for their full recompense), and the Hour will be more grievous and more bitter.' (54.46) Sura Al-Baqara (The Cow) and Surat An-Nisa (The Women) were revealed while I was with him." Then `Aisha took out the copy of the Qur'an for the man and dictated to him the Verses of the Suras (in their proper order)
hi: Yusuf bin Mahk bataate hain: Jab main Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا), Ummul-Momineen, ke paas tha, ek shaks Iraq se aaya aur pucha, 'Sabse achha kafan kaunsa hota hai?' Aisha ne kaha, 'Allah tumpar reham kare! Isse kya farq padta hai?' Usne kaha, 'Aye Ummul-Momineen! Mujhe apna Quran dikhaaiye.' Unhone pucha, 'Kyun?' Usne kaha, 'Taake main iske mutaabik Quran ko jama aur tarteeb de sakoon, kyunke log ise (galat) tarteeb mein padhte hain.' Aisha ne kaha, 'Isse kya farq padta hai tum pehle kaunsa hissa padho? (Jaan lo ke) sabse pehle jo naazil hua wo Al-Mufassal ki ek Surah thi, jismein Jannat aur Jahannam ka zikr tha. Jab log Islam mein daakhil hue, to halaal aur haraam cheezon ki Aayaten naazil hui. Agar sabse pehle ye naazil hoti, "Sharaab mat piyo," to log kehte, "Hum kabhi sharaab nahi chhodenge," aur agar naazil hoti, "Zina mat karo," to wo kehte, "Hum zina kabhi nahi chhodenge." Jab main khelne-koodne ki umar ki ek chhoti ladki thi, ye Aayat Makkah mein Muhammad (SAW) par naazil hui: "Nahi! Balke Qayamat hi unke (poore badle ke) muqarrar waqt ki jagah hai; aur Qayamat bahut hi sakht aur kadwi hogi." (54:46) Surah Al-Baqarah aur Surah An-Nisa jab naazil hui main unke saath thi.' Phir Aisha ne us aadmi ke liye Quran ka nuskha nikaala aur usse Surahon ki Aayaten (sahi tarteeb mein) likhwaayi.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Mas`ud:Surat Bani-lsrael, Al-Kahf (The Cave), Maryam, Taha, Al-Anbiya' (The prophets) are amongst my first earnings and my old property, and (in fact) they are my old property
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Masud bataate hain: Surah Bani Israel, Al-Kahf, Maryam, Ta-Ha aur Al-Anbiya meri sabse pehli kamai aur meri purani milkiyat mein se hain, (haqeeqat mein) yahi meri purani milkiyat hain.

e: Narrated Al-Bara':I learnt, 'Glorify the Name of your Lord the Most High' (Surat al-A'la) No 87, before the Prophet (ﷺ) came (to Medina)
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Maine 'Apne Rab, Sabse Buland, ke Naam ki tasbeeh karo' (Surah Al-Ala, No. 87) us waqt seekh li thi jab Nabi (SAW) Madina nahi aaye the.

e: Narrated Shaqiq:`Abdullah said, "I learnt An-Naza'ir which the Prophet (ﷺ) used to recite in pairs in each rak`a." Then `Abdullah got up and Alqama accompanied him to his house, and when Alqama came out, we asked him (about those Suras). He said, "They are twenty Suras that start from the beginning of Al- Mufassal, according to the arrangement done be Ibn Mas`ud, and end with the Suras starting with Ha Mim, e.g. Ha Mim (the Smoke). and "About what they question one another?
hi: Shaqiq bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Maine "An-Nazair" seekh li hain jinhe Nabi (SAW) har rakat mein jode mein padha karte the.' Phir Abdullah utthe aur Alqama unke saath unke ghar gaye, aur jab Alqama baahar aaye, to humne unse (un Surahon ke baare mein) pucha. Unhone kaha, 'Ye bees Surahein hain jo Al-Mufassal ki shuruaat se lekar, Ibn Masud ki tarteeb ke mutaabik, "Ha-Mim" se shuru hone wali Surahon tak jaati hain, jaise Ha-Mim (Ad-Dukhan/Dhuaan), aur "Wo aapas mein kis baare mein sawaal karte hain?" (Surah An-Naba).'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) was the most generous person, and he used to become more so (generous) particularly in the month of Ramadan because Gabriel used to meet him every night of the month of Ramadan till it elapsed. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to recite the Qur'an for him. When Gabriel met him, he used to become more generous than the fast wind in doing good
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) sab logon mein sabse zyaada sakhi the, aur Ramzan ke mahine mein aur zyaada sakhi ho jaate the, kyunke Jibrael Ramzan ke mahine ki har raat unse milte the yahaan tak ke Ramzan khatam ho jaata. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unhein Quran padh kar sunaate. Jab Jibrael unse milte, to wo tez hawa se bhi zyaada sakhaawat mein aage badh jaate.

e: Narrated Abu-Huraira:Gabriel used to repeat the recitation of the Qur'an with the Prophet (ﷺ) once a year, but he repeated it twice with him in the year he died. The Prophet (ﷺ) used to stay in I`tikaf for ten days every year (in the month of Ramadan), but in the year of his death, he stayed in I`tikaf for twenty days
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jibrael Nabi (SAW) ke saath saal mein ek baar Quran ki tilawat dohraate the, magar jis saal unka intekaal hua, unhone do baar dohraayi. Nabi (SAW) har saal (Ramzan mein) das din Aitikaaf mein rehte the, magar apni maut wale saal wo bees din Aitikaaf mein rahe.

e: Narrated Masriq:`Abdullah bin `Amr mentioned `Abdullah bin Masud and said, "I shall ever love that man, for I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, 'Take (learn) the Qur'an from four: `Abdullah bin Masud, Salim, Mu`adh and Ubai bin Ka`b
hi: Masruq bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Abdullah bin Masud ka zikr kiya aur kaha, 'Main hamesha us aadmi se mohabbat karunga, kyunke maine Nabi (SAW) ko farmaate suna, "Quran chaar logon se seekho (haasil karo): Abdullah bin Masud, Salim, Mu'adh aur Ubai bin Ka'b (رضی اللہ عنہ) se."'

e: Narrated Shaqiq bin Salama:Once `Abdullah bin Mas`ud delivered a sermon before us and said, "By Allah, I learnt over seventy Suras direct from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . By Allah, the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) came to know that I am one of those who know Allah's Book best of all of them, yet I am not the best of them." Shaqiq added: I sat in his religious gathering and I did not hear anybody opposing him (in his speech)
hi: Shaqiq bin Salama bataate hain: Ek baar Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Masud ne humein khutba diya aur kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se seedhe sattar se zyaada Surahein seekhi hain. Allah ki qasam, Nabi (SAW) ke sahaaba ko pata hai ke main Allah ki Kitaab ka sabse zyaada ilm rakhne walon mein se hoon, phir bhi main unmein sabse behtar nahi hoon.' Shaqiq ne aage kaha: Main unki majlis mein baitha aur maine kisi ko unki baat par aitraaz karte nahi suna.

e: Narrated 'Alqama:While we were in the city of Hims (in Syria), Ibn Mas`ud recited Surat Yusuf. A man said to him), "It was not revealed in this way." Then Ibn Mas`ud said, "I recited it in this way before Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he confirmed my recitation by saying, 'Well done!' " Ibn Mas`ud detected the smell of wine from the man's mouth, so he said to him, "Aren't you ashamed of telling a lie about Allah's Book and (along with this) you drink alcoholic liquors too?" Then he lashed him according to the law
hi: Alqama bataate hain: Jab hum Hims shehar (Syria) mein the, Ibn Masud ne Surah Yusuf padhi. Ek shaks ne unse kaha, 'Ye is tarah naazil nahi hui thi.' Isper Ibn Masud ne kaha, 'Maine ise isi tarah Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saamne padha tha aur unhone meri qiraat ki tasdeeq karte hue kaha, "Wah, khoob padha!"' Ibn Masud ne us shaks ke munh se sharaab ki badbu mehsoos ki, to unhone usse kaha, 'Kya tumhein sharm nahi aati ke tum Allah ki Kitaab ke baare mein jhoot bolte ho, aur (iske saath) sharaab bhi peete ho?' Phir unhone use shariyat ke mutaabik koda lagwaaya.

e: Narrated `Abdullah (bin Mas`ud):By Allah other than Whom none has the right to be worshipped! There is no Sura revealed in Allah's Book but I know at what place it was revealed; and there is no Verse revealed in Allah's Book but I know about whom it was revealed. And if I know that there is somebody who knows Allah's Book better than I, and he is at a place that camels can reach, I would go to him
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) (bin Masud) bataate hain: Us Allah ki qasam jiske siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi! Allah ki Kitaab mein koi Surah naazil nahi hui jiske baare mein mujhe na pata ho ke wo kahaan naazil hui; aur koi Aayat naazil nahi hui jiske baare mein mujhe na pata ho ke wo kiske baare mein naazil hui. Aur agar mujhe pata chale ke koi hai jo mujhse zyaada Allah ki Kitaab jaanta hai, aur wo itni door ho jahaan oont pahunch sakta ho, to main uske paas zaroor jaaunga.

e: Narrated Qatada:I asked Anas bin Malik: "Who collected the Qur'an at the time of the Prophet (ﷺ) ?" He replied, "Four, all of whom were from the Ansar: Ubai bin Ka`b, Mu`adh bin Jabal, Zaid bin Thabit and Abu Zaid
hi: Qatada bataate hain: Maine Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha, 'Nabi (SAW) ke daur mein Quran kis-kisne jama kiya?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Chaar logon ne, jo sab Ansaar mein se the: Ubai bin Ka'b (رضی اللہ عنہ), Mu'adh bin Jabal (رضی اللہ عنہ), Zaid bin Thabit (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Abu Zaid.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:When the Prophet (ﷺ) died, none had collected the Qur'an but four persons;: Abu Ad-Darda'. Mu`adh bin Jabal, Zaid bin Thabit and Abu Zaid. We were the inheritor (of Abu Zaid) as he had no offspring
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Nabi (SAW) ki wafat hui, us waqt sirf chaar logon ne Quran jama kiya tha: Abu Ad-Darda, Mu'adh bin Jabal (رضی اللہ عنہ), Zaid bin Thabit (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Abu Zaid. Hum (Abu Zaid ki miraas ke) waaris the, kyunke unki koi aulaad nahi thi.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:`Umar said, Ubai was the best of us in the recitation (of the Qur'an) yet we leave some of what he recites.' Ubai says, 'PI have taken it from the mouth of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and will not leave for anything whatever." But Allah said "None of Our Revelations do We abrogate or cause to be forgotten but We substitute something better or similar
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Ubai hum mein Quran padhne mein sabse achhe hain, phir bhi hum unki kuch qiraat chhod dete hain.' Ubai kehte hain, 'Maine ise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke munh se liya hai aur main use kisi bhi wajah se nahi chhodunga.' Magar Allah ne farmaya, 'Hum apne kisi hukm ko mansookh nahi karte ya bhulaate nahi, magar usse behtar ya usi jaisa le aate hain.'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Mu'alla:While I was praying, the Prophet (ﷺ) called me but I did not respond to his call. Later I said, "O Allah's Apostle! I was praying." He said, "Didn't Allah say: 'O you who believe! Give your response to Allah (by obeying Him) and to His Apostle when he calls you'?" (8.24) He then said, "Shall I not teach you the most superior Surah in the Qur'an?" He said, '(It is), 'Praise be to Allah, the Lord of the worlds. ' (i.e., Surat Al-Fatiha) which consists of seven repeatedly recited Verses and the Magnificent Qur'an which was given to me
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Mu'alla bataate hain: Jab main namaz padh raha tha, Nabi (SAW) ne mujhe bulaaya magar maine unki pukaar ka jawab nahi diya. Baad mein maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Main namaz mein tha.' Unhone farmaya, 'Kya Allah ne nahi farmaya, "Aye Iman waalo! Allah ki pukaar ka jawab do (uski itaa'at karke) aur uske Rasool ki bhi jab wo tumhein bulaayein"?' (8:24) Phir unhone farmaya, 'Kya main tumhein Quran ki sabse azeem Surah na sikhaun?' Unhone kaha, '(Wo hai) "Alhamdulillahi Rabbil Aalameen" (yaani Surah Al-Fatiha), jo saat baar-baar padhi jaane wali Aayaten hain, aur wo azeem Quran jo mujhe diya gaya hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:While we were on one of our journeys, we dismounted at a place where a slave girl came and said, "The chief of this tribe has been stung by a scorpion and our men are not present; is there anybody among you who can treat him (by reciting something)?" Then one of our men went along with her though we did not think that he knew any such treatment. But he treated the chief by reciting something, and the sick man recovered whereupon he gave him thirty sheep and gave us milk to drink (as a reward). When he returned, we asked our friend, "Did you know how to treat with the recitation of something?" He said, "No, but I treated him only with the recitation of the Mother of the Book (i.e., Al-Fatiha)." We said, "Do not say anything (about it) till we reach or ask the Prophet (ﷺ) so when we reached Medina, we mentioned that to the Prophet (in order to know whether the sheep which we had taken were lawful to take or not). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "How did he come to know that it (Al-Fatiha) could be used for treatment? Distribute your reward and assign for me one share thereof as well
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum apne ek safar mein the, hum ek jagah utre jahaan ek launDi aayi aur kaha, 'Is qabeele ke sardaar ko bicchu ne kaat liya hai aur hamaare mard maujood nahi, kya tum mein se koi hai jo unka ilaaj (kuch padh kar) kar sake?' Phir hamaare ek shaks unke saath gaye, halaanke humein nahi lagta tha ke unhein aisa koi ilaaj aata hai. Magar unhone kuch padh kar sardaar ka ilaaj kiya aur wo bimaar theek ho gaya, isper usne unhein teen (30) bakriyaan din, aur (inaam mein) humein doodh pilaaya. Jab wo wapas aaye, humne apne dost se pucha, 'Kya tumhein kuch padh kar ilaaj karna aata tha?' Unhone kaha, 'Nahi, maine sirf Umm-ul-Kitaab (yaani Al-Fatiha) padh kar unka ilaaj kiya.' Humne kaha, 'Iske baare mein kuch mat kaho jab tak hum Nabi (SAW) ke paas pahunch kar unse na pucch lein.' To jab hum Madina pahunche, humne ye baat Nabi (SAW) ko bataayi (ye jaanne ke liye ke jo bakriyaan humne li thin wo lena jaayez tha ya nahi). Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Unhein kaise pata chala ke isse (Al-Fatiha se) ilaaj kiya jaa sakta hai? Apna inaam baant lo aur mera bhi ek hissa rakh do.'

e: Narrated Abu Mas'ud:Whoever recites two verses ... (text as in the following hadith)
hi: Abu Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jo koi (Surah Al-Baqarah ki) do Aayaten padhe... (baaki matn agli hadees mein hai).

e: Narrated Abu Mas'ud: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If somebody recited the last two Verses of Surat Al-Baqara at night, that will be sufficient for him
hi: Abu Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar koi raat ko Surah Al-Baqarah ki aakhri do Aayaten padh le, to ye uske liye kaafi ho jaayengi.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered me to guard the Zakat revenue of Ramadan. Then somebody came to me and started stealing from the foodstuff. I caught him and said, "I will take you to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" Then Abu Huraira described the whole narration and said: That person said (to me), "(Please don't take me to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and I will tell you a few words by which Allah will benefit you.) When you go to your bed, recite Ayat-al-Kursi, (2.255) for then there will be a guard from Allah who will protect you all night long, and Satan will not be able to come near you till dawn." (When the Prophet (ﷺ) heard the story) he said (to me), "He (who came to you at night) told you the truth although he is a liar; and it was Satan
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe Ramzan ki Zakat (sadqa-e-fitr) ki rakhwaali karne ka hukm diya. Phir koi mere paas aaya aur khaane ka saamaan churaane laga. Maine use pakad liya aur kaha, 'Main tujhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas le jaaunga!' Phir Abu Huraira ne poori riwayat bayaan ki aur kaha: Us shaks ne (mujhse) kaha, '(Mujhe Allah ke Rasool ke paas mat le jaao, main tumhein kuch aisi baaten bataunga jinse Allah tumhein faayda dega.) Jab tum apne bistar par jao, to Ayat-ul-Kursi (2:255) padho, phir Allah ki taraf se ek nigehbaan tumhaari poori raat hifaazat karega, aur Shaitaan subah tak tumhaare qareeb nahi aa payega.' (Jab Nabi (SAW) ne ye kahaani suni) unhone (mujhse) farmaya, 'Usne (jo tumhaare paas raat ko aaya) tumse sach kaha, halaanke wo khud jhoota hai; aur wo Shaitaan tha.'

e: Narrated Al-Bara':A man was reciting Surat Al-Kahf and his horse was tied with two ropes beside him. A cloud came down and spread over that man, and it kept on coming closer and closer to him till his horse started jumping (as if afraid of something). When it was morning, the man came to the Prophet, and told him of that experience. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "That was As-Sakina (tranquility) which descended because of (the recitation of) the Qur'an
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Ek shaks Surah Al-Kahf padh raha tha aur uska ghoda do rassiyon se uske paas baandha hua tha. Ek baadal aakar us shaks ke upar chha gaya aur wo aage badhkar unke aur qareeb aata gaya, yahaan tak ke ghoda (jaise kisi cheez se dar kar) uchalne laga. Subah hote hi wo shaks Nabi (SAW) ke paas gaya aur unhein apna ye tajurba bataaya. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Wo Sakina (sukoon) thi jo Quran ki (tilawat ki) wajah se naazil hui thi.'

e: Narrated Aslam:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was traveling on one of his journeys, and `Umar bin Al-Khattab was traveling along with him at night. `Umar asked him about something, but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not answer him. He asked again, but he did not answer. He asked for the third time, but he did not answer. On that, `Umar said to himself, "May your mother lose you! You have asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) three times, but he did not answer at all!" `Umar said, "So I made my camel go fast till I was ahead of the people, and I was afraid that something might be revealed about me. After a little while I heard a call maker calling me, I said, 'I was afraid that some Qur'anic Verse might be revealed about me.' So I went to Allah's Apostle and greeted him. He said, 'Tonight there has been revealed to me a Surah which is dearer to me than that on which the sun shines (i.e. the world).' Then he recited: 'Verily! We have given you (O Muhammad), a manifest victory.' " (Surat al-Fath) No
hi: Aslam bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apne ek safar mein the, aur Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab raat ko unke saath chal rahe the. Umar ne unse kuch pucha, magar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne jawab nahi diya. Unhone dobara pucha, phir bhi jawab nahi diya. Unhone teesri baar pucha, phir bhi jawab nahi diya. Isper Umar ne apne dil mein kaha, 'Teri maa tujhe kho de! Tumne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se teen baar pucha, magar unhone bilkul jawab nahi diya!' Umar ne kaha, 'To maine apne oont ko tez daudaaya yahaan tak ke main logon se aage nikal gaya, aur mujhe dar hua ke kahin mere baare mein koi Aayat naazil na ho jaaye. Thodi der baad maine ek pukaarne wale ko mujhe bulaate suna, maine socha, "Mujhe dar tha ke mere baare mein koi Quraani Aayat naazil ho gayi hai." To main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaya aur salaam kiya. Unhone farmaya, "Aaj raat mujhpar ek Surah naazil hui hai jo mujhe us (duniya) se zyaada aziz hai jispar suraj chamakta hai." Phir unhone padha: "Beshak Humne tumhein (Aye Muhammad) khuli fatah di hai."' (Surah Al-Fath, No. 48)

e: Narrated Abu Said Al-Khudri: A man heard another man reciting (Surat-Al-Ikhlas) 'Say He is Allah, (the) One.' (112. 1) repeatedly. The next morning he came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and informed him about it as if he thought that it was not enough to recite. On that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "By Him in Whose Hand my life is, this Surah is equal to one-third of the Qur'an
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks ne doosre shaks ko Surah Al-Ikhlas, 'Kaho: Wo Allah ek hai' (112:1), baar baar padhte suna. Agli subah wo Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unhein iski khabar di, jaise use laga ke sirf isi ko padhna kaafi nahi hai. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, ye Surah Quran ke tihaai hisse ke barabar hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Said Al-Khudri:My brother, Qatada bin An-Nau'man said, "A man performed the night prayer late at night in the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) and he read: 'Say: He is Allah, (the) One,' (112.1) and read nothing besides that. The next morning a man went to the Prophet (ﷺ) ,~ and told him about that . (The Prophet (ﷺ) replied the same as (in Hadith 532) above
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Mere bhai, Qatada bin An-Nau'man, ne kaha, 'Nabi (SAW) ki zindagi mein ek shaks ne raat ki namaz der raat padhi aur usme "Kaho: Wo Allah ek hai" (112:1) padha, aur iske siwa kuch aur nahi padha. Agli subah ek shaks Nabi (SAW) ke paas gaya aur unhein iski khabar di.' (Nabi (SAW) ne wahi jawab diya jo hadees 532 mein upar diya gaya hai.)

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) said to his companions, "Is it difficult for any of you to recite one third of the Qur'an in one night?" This suggestion was difficult for them so they said, "Who among us has the power to do so, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" Allah's Apostle replied: " Allah (the) One, the Self-Sufficient Master Whom all creatures need.' (Surat Al-Ikhlas 112.1--to the End) is equal to one third of the Qur'an
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne apne sahaaba se kaha, 'Kya tum mein se kisi ko ek raat mein Quran ka tihaai hissa padhna mushkil lagta hai?' Ye sujhaav unke liye mushkil lagi, to unhone pucha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Hum mein se kaunsa aisa kar sakta hai?' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne jawab diya, '"Allah ek hai, sabki zaroorat ka Maalik jiski har makhlooq ko zaroorat hai..." (Surah Al-Ikhlas, 112:1 se aakhir tak) Quran ke tihaai hisse ke barabar hai.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) became sick, he would recite Mu'awwidhat (Surat Al-Falaq and Surat An- Nas) and then blow his breath over his body. When he became seriously ill, I used to recite (these two Suras) and rub his hands over his body hoping for its blessings
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab bhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) bimar hote, wo Muawwidhatain (Surah Al-Falaq aur Surah An-Nas) padhte aur apni saans apne badan par phoonkte. Jab wo sakht bimar padhe, to main ye do Surahein padhti aur unke haath unke badan par phairti, unki barkat ki ummeed mein.

e: Narrated 'Aisha: Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) went to bed every night, he used to cup his hands together and blow over it after reciting Surat Al-Ikhlas, Surat Al-Falaq and Surat An-Nas, and then rub his hands over whatever parts of his body he was able to rub, starting with his head, face and front of his body. He used to do that three times
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab bhi Nabi (SAW) raat ko sone jaate, wo apne dono haathon ko jorte, Surah Al-Ikhlas, Surah Al-Falaq aur Surah An-Nas padh kar unmein phoonkte, phir apne badan ke jitne hisse par haath phairh sakte, phairte, apne sar, chehre aur badan ke agle hisse se shuru karke. Wo aisa teen baar karte.

e: Narrated Usaid bin Hudair: That while he was reciting Surat Al-Baqara (The Cow) at night, and his horse was tied beside him, the horse was suddenly startled and troubled. When he stopped reciting, the horse became quiet, and when he started again, the horse was startled again. Then he stopped reciting and the horse became quiet too. He started reciting again and the horse was startled and troubled once again. Then he stopped reciting and his son, Yahya was beside the horse. He was afraid that the horse might trample on him. When he took the boy away and looked towards the sky, he could not see it. The next morning he informed the Prophet who said, "Recite, O Ibn Hudair! Recite, O Ibn Hudair!" Ibn Hudair replied, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! My son, Yahya was near the horse and I was afraid that it might trample on him, so I looked towards the sky, and went to him. When I looked at the sky, I saw something like a cloud containing what looked like lamps, so I went out in order not to see it." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do you know what that was?" Ibn Hudair replied, "No." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Those were Angels who came near to you for your voice and if you had kept on reciting till dawn, it would have remained there till morning when people would have seen it as it would not have disappeared
hi: Usaid bin Hudair bataate hain: Jab wo raat ko Surah Al-Baqarah padh rahe the aur unka ghoda unke paas baandha hua tha, ghoda achaanak bhadak gaya aur pareshaan ho gaya. Jab unhone padhna band kiya, ghoda shaant ho gaya, aur jab unhone dobara padhna shuru kiya, ghoda phir bhadak gaya. Phir unhone padhna band kiya to ghoda phir shaant ho gaya. Unhone dobara padhna shuru kiya to ghoda phir bhadak gaya aur pareshaan ho gaya. Phir unhone padhna band kar diya, aur unka beta Yahya ghode ke paas tha. Unhein dar tha ke kahin ghoda usse kuchal na de. Jab unhone bacche ko wahaan se hataaya aur aasman ki taraf dekha, to unhein kuch dikhaayi nahi diya. Agli subah unhone Nabi (SAW) ko ye bataaya, unhone farmaya, 'Padho, Aye Ibn Hudair! Padho, Aye Ibn Hudair!' Ibn Hudair ne jawab diya, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mera beta Yahya ghode ke paas tha aur mujhe dar tha ke kahin wo use kuchal na de, isliye maine aasman ki taraf dekha aur uske paas gaya. Jab maine aasman ki taraf dekha, to mujhe ek baadal jaisi cheez dikhi jismein chiraaghon jaisi cheezein thin, isliye main baahar nikal gaya taake wo mujhe dikhaayi na de.' Nabi (SAW) ne pucha, 'Kya tumhein pata hai wo kya thi?' Ibn Hudair ne jawab diya, 'Nahi.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Wo Farishte the jo tumhaari aawaaz sunne ke liye qareeb aaye the, aur agar tum subah tak padhte rehte, to wo wahin rehti yahaan tak ke log use dekh lete, wo ghaayab nahi hoti.'

e: Narrated `Abdul `Aziz bin Rufai':Shaddad bin Ma'qil and I entered upon Ibn `Abbas. Shaddad bin Ma'qil asked him, "Did the Prophet (ﷺ) leave anything (besides the Qur'an)?" He replied. "He did not leave anything except what is Between the two bindings (of the Qur'an)." Then we visited Muhammad bin Al-Hanafiyya and asked him (the same question). He replied, "The Prophet (ﷺ) did not leave except what is between the bindings (of the Qur'an)
hi: Abdul Aziz bin Rufai bataate hain: Shaddad bin Ma'qil aur main Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas gaye. Shaddad bin Ma'qil ne unse pucha, 'Kya Nabi (SAW) ne (Quran ke ilaawa) kuch chhoda?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Unhone kuch nahi chhoda siwaaye us cheez ke jo (Quran ki) do jildon ke beech hai.' Phir hum Muhammad bin Al-Hanafiyya ke paas gaye aur unse (wahi sawaal) pucha. Unhone jawab diya, 'Nabi (SAW) ne kuch nahi chhoda siwaaye us cheez ke jo (Quran ki) jildon ke beech hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Musa Al-Ash`ari:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The example of him (a believer) who recites the Qur'an is like that of a citron which tastes good and smells good. And he (a believer) who does not recite the Qur'an is like a date which is good in taste but has no smell. And the example of a dissolute wicked person who recites the Qur'an is like the Raihana (sweet basil) which smells good but tastes bitter. And the example of a dissolute wicked person who does not recite the Qur'an is like the colocynth which tastes bitter and has no smell
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ashari bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo (momin) Quran padhta hai, uski misaal turanj (ek phal) jaisi hai jiska zaayeka bhi achha hai aur khushbu bhi achhi. Aur jo (momin) Quran nahi padhta, uski misaal khajoor jaisi hai jiska zaayeka achha hai magar khushbu nahi. Aur jo badkaar munafiq Quran padhta hai, uski misaal Raihaana (khushboodaar tulsi jaisi buti) jaisi hai jiski khushbu achhi hai magar zaayeka kadwa. Aur jo badkaar munafiq Quran nahi padhta, uski misaal hanzal (ek kadwa phal) jaisi hai jiska zaayeka kadwa hai aur koi khushbu nahi.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Your life in comparison to the lifetime of the past nations is like the period between the time of `Asr prayer and sunset. Your example and the example of the Jews and Christians is that of person who employed laborers and said to them, "Who will work for me till the middle of the day for one Qirat (a special weight)?' The Jews did. He then said, "Who will work for me from the middle of the day till the `Asr prayer for one Qirat each?" The Christians worked accordingly. Then you (Muslims) are working from the `Asr prayer till the Maghrib prayer for two Qirats each. They (the Jews and the Christians) said, 'We did more labor but took less wages.' He (Allah) said, 'Have I wronged you in your rights?' They replied, 'No.' Then He said, 'This is My Blessing which I give to whom I wish
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Tumhaari zindagi pichhli ummaton ke muqaable mein Asr ki namaz aur suraj doobne ke beech ke waqt jaisi hai. Tumhaari aur Yahudiyon-Isaaiyon ki misaal us shaks jaisi hai jisne kuch mazdoor rakhe aur unse kaha, "Kaun mere liye dopahar tak ek Qirat (khaas wazan) ke badle kaam karega?" Yahudiyon ne kaam kiya. Phir usne kaha, "Kaun mere liye dopahar se Asr ki namaz tak, ek-ek Qirat ke badle, kaam karega?" Isaaiyon ne is hisaab se kaam kiya. Phir tum (Musalmaan) Asr ki namaz se Maghrib ki namaz tak, do-do Qirat ke badle kaam kar rahe ho. Unhone (Yahudi aur Isaaiyon ne) kaha, "Humne zyaada mehnat ki magar kam mazdoori paayi." Usne (Allah ne) kaha, "Kya Maine tumhaare haqon mein tumpar zulm kiya?" Unhone jawab diya, "Nahi." Isper usne kaha, "Ye Meri wo meharbaani hai jo Main jisse chaahoon deta hoon."'

e: Narrated Talha:I asked `Abdullah bin Abi `Aufa, "Did the Prophet (ﷺ) make a will (to appoint his successor or bequeath wealth)?" He replied, "No." I said, "How is it prescribed then for the people to make wills, and they are ordered to do so while the Prophet (ﷺ) did not make any will?" He said, "He made a will wherein he recommended Allah's Book
hi: Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Aufa se pucha, 'Kya Nabi (SAW) ne koi wasiyat ki thi (apna jaanasheen muqarrar karne ya maal ke baare mein)?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Nahi.' Maine kaha, 'Phir logon ke liye wasiyat karna kyun muqarrar kiya gaya, aur unhein aisa karne ka hukm kyun diya gaya jabke Nabi (SAW) ne khud koi wasiyat nahi ki?' Unhone kaha, 'Unhone wasiyat ki thi jismein unhone Allah ki Kitaab ki sifaarish ki thi.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah does not listen to a prophet as He listens to a prophet who recites the Qur'an in a pleasant tone." The companion of the sub-narrator (Abu Salama) said, "It means, reciting it aloud
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah kisi Nabi ki baat utni ghor se nahi sunta jitni ghor se wo us Nabi ki sunta hai jo Quran ko khushnuma aawaaz mein padhta hai.' Ravi ke saathi (Abu Salama) kehte hain, 'Iska matlab hai ise buland aawaaz mein padhna.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah does not listen to a prophet as He listens to a prophet who recites the Qur'an in a loud and pleasant tone." Sufyan said, "This saying means: a prophet who regards the Qur'an as something that makes him dispense with many worldly pleasures
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah kisi Nabi ki utni ghor se nahi sunta jitni ghor se wo us Nabi ki sunta hai jo Quran ko buland aur khushnuma aawaaz mein padhta hai.' Ravi Sufyan kehte hain, 'Iska matlab hai wo Nabi jo Quran ko aisi cheez samajhta hai jiski wajah se wo duniya ki bahut si lazzaton se be-niyaz ho jaata hai.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Not to wish to be the like except of two men. A man whom Allah has given the knowledge of the Book and he recites it during the hours of the night, and a man whom Allah has given wealth, and he spends it in charity during the night and the hours of the day
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kisi jaisa banne ki khwaahish sirf do logon ke maamle mein karo: ek wo aadmi jise Allah ne Kitaab ka ilm diya hai aur wo raat ke waqt usse padhta hai; aur doosra wo aadmi jise Allah ne daulat di hai aur wo raat aur din ke waqt usse khairaat mein kharch karta hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Not to wish to be the like of except two men: A man whom Allah has taught the Qur'an and he recites it during the hours of the night and during the hours of the day, and his neighbor listens to him and says, 'I wish I had been given what has been given to so-and-so, so that I might do what he does; and a man whom Allah has given wealth and he spends it on what is just and right, whereupon an other man May say, 'I wish I had been given what so-and-so has been given, for then I would do what he does
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kisi jaisa banne ki khwaahish sirf do logon ke maamle mein karo: ek wo aadmi jise Allah ne Quran sikhaaya hai aur wo raat aur din ke waqt usse padhta hai, aur uska padosi use sunkar kehta hai, "Kaash mujhe bhi wahi diya gaya hota jo falaan ko diya gaya hai, taake main bhi wahi karta jo wo karta hai"; aur doosra wo aadmi jise Allah ne daulat di hai aur wo usse jaayez aur sahi kaam mein kharch karta hai, isper koi aur shaks kehta hai, "Kaash mujhe wahi diya gaya hota jo falaan ko diya gaya hai, taake main bhi wahi karta jo wo karta hai."'

e: Narrated `Uthman:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The best among you (Muslims) are those who learn the Qur'an and teach it
hi: Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Tum mein sabse behtar wo hain jo Quran seekhte hain aur usse sikhaate hain.'

e: Narrated `Uthman bin `Affan:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The most superior among you (Muslims) are those who learn the Qur'an and teach it
hi: Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Affan bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Tum mein sabse afzal wo hain jo Quran seekhte hain aur usse sikhaate hain.'

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:A lady came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and declared that she had decided to offer herself to Allah and His Apostle. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I am not in need of women." A man said (to the Prophet) "Please marry her to me." The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to him), "Give her a garment." The man said, "I cannot afford it." The Prophet said, "Give her anything, even if it were an iron ring." The man apologized again. The Prophet then asked him, "What do you know by heart of the Qur'an?" He replied, "I know such-andsuch portion of the Qur'an (by heart)." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Then I marry her to you for that much of the Qur'an which you know by heart
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek khaatoon Nabi (SAW) ke paas aayi aur elaan kiya ke usne khud ko Allah aur uske Rasool ke liye hiba karne ka faisla kiya hai. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Mujhe auraton ki koi zaroorat nahi.' Ek shaks ne kaha, '(Nabi se) Meherbaani karke unka nikaah mujhse kar dijiye.' Nabi (SAW) ne (usse) kaha, 'Unhein koi kapda do.' Us aadmi ne kaha, 'Mere paas itna nahi hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Kuch bhi do, chaahe wo loha ki ek anguthi hi ho.' Us aadmi ne phir mazrat pesh ki. Nabi (SAW) ne phir usse pucha, 'Tumhein Quran mein se kya zabaani yaad hai?' Usne jawab diya, 'Mujhe falaan falaan hissa (zabaani) yaad hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'To main unka nikaah tumse us Quran ke badle kar deta hoon jo tumhein zabaani yaad hai.'

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:A lady came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have come to you to offer myself to you." He raised his eyes and looked at her and then lowered his head. When the lady saw that he did not make any decision, she sat down. On that, a man from his companions got up and said. "O Allah's Apostle! If you are not in need of this woman, then marry her to me." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Do you have anything to offer her?" He replied. "No, by Allah, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "Go to your family and see if you can find something.' The man went and returned, saying, "No, by Allah, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have not found anything." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Try to find something, even if it is an iron ring.'' He went again and returned, saying, "No, by Allah, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), not even an iron ring, but I have this waist sheet of mine." The man had no upper garment, so he intended to give her, half his waist sheet. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, ''What would she do with your waist sheet? If you wear it, she will have nothing of it over her body, and if she wears it, you will have nothing over your body." So that man sat for a long period and then got up, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw him going away, so he ordered somebody to call him. When he came, the Prophet (ﷺ) asked him, " How much of the Qur'an do you know?" He replied, "I know such Surat and such Surat and such Surat," and went on counting it, The Prophet (ﷺ) asked him, "Can you recite it by heart?" he replied, "Yes." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Go, I have married this lady to you for the amount of the Qur'an you know by heart
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek khaatoon Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Main aapke paas khud ko aapko hiba karne aayi hoon.' Unhone apni aankhein uthaayi aur unhein dekha, phir apna sar jhuka liya. Jab khaatoon ne dekha ke unhone koi faisla nahi kiya, to wo baith gayi. Isper unke sahaaba mein se ek shaks khade hue aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Agar aapko is aurat ki zaroorat nahi hai, to unka nikaah mujhse kar dijiye.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne pucha, 'Kya tumhaare paas unhein dene ke liye kuch hai?' Usne jawab diya, 'Nahi, Allah ki qasam, Aye Allah ke Rasool!' Nabi (SAW) ne usse kaha, 'Apne ghar jaao aur dekho kya kuch mil sakta hai.' Wo aadmi gaya aur wapas aakar kaha, 'Nahi, Allah ki qasam, Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe kuch nahi mila.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Kuch aur dhoondho, chaahe wo loha ki ek anguthi hi ho.' Wo phir gaya aur wapas aakar kaha, 'Nahi, Allah ki qasam, Aye Allah ke Rasool, loha ki anguthi bhi nahi mili, magar mere paas ye meri kamar ki chaadar hai.' Us aadmi ke paas koi upar ka kapda nahi tha, isliye uska iraada tha ke wo apni aadhi kamar ki chaadar de de. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Wo tumhaari kamar ki chaadar ka kya karegi? Agar tum ise pehno, to unke badan par kuch nahi hoga, aur agar wo ise pehne, to tumhaare badan par kuch nahi hoga.' To wo aadmi kaafi der tak baitha raha, phir uthaa, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne use jaate hue dekha, to unhone kisi ko use bulaane ka hukm diya. Jab wo aaya, Nabi (SAW) ne usse pucha, 'Tumhein Quran mein se kitna yaad hai?' Usne jawab diya, 'Mujhe falaan Surah, falaan Surah, falaan Surah yaad hai,' aur ginta gaya. Nabi (SAW) ne pucha, 'Kya tum ise zabaani padh sakte ho?' Usne kaha, 'Haan.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jaao, maine unka nikaah tumse us Quran ke badle kar diya jo tumhein zabaani yaad hai.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The example of the person who knows the Qur'an by heart is like the owner of tied camels. If he keeps them tied, he will control them, but if he releases them, they will run away
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo shaks Quran zabaani yaad rakhta hai uski misaal baandhe hue oonton ke maalik jaisi hai. Agar wo unhein baandh kar rakhe, to unpar qaabu rakh sakta hai, magar agar unhein khula chhod de, to wo bhaag jaayenge.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It is a bad thing that some of you say, 'I have forgotten such-and-such verse of the Qur'an,' for indeed, he has been caused (by Allah) to forget it. So you must keep on reciting the Qur'an because it escapes from the hearts of men faster than camel do
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ye buri baat hai ke tum mein se koi kahe, "Main falaan Aayat bhool gaya," kyunke haqeeqat mein Allah ne hi use bhulaaya hai. Isliye tumhein Quran ki tilawat jaari rakhni chaahiye, kyunke ye logon ke dilon se oonton ke rassi todkar bhaagne se bhi tez nikal jaata hai.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying... (as above, no)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna... (upar wali hadees jaisa hi).

e: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Commit yourself to the Qur'an, for by Him in whose Hand is my soul, it is surely more prone to break away than a camel in its bind
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Quran se juda rehne mein lage raho, kyunke us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, ye oont ke apni rassi se chhoot kar bhaag jaane se bhi zyaada jaldi (dil se) nikal jaata hai.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Mughaffal:I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) reciting Surat-al-Fath on his she-camel on the day of the Conquest of Mecca
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Mughaffal bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Fatah-e-Makkah ke din apni oontni par Surah Al-Fath padhte dekha.

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:Those Suras which you people call the Mufassal, are the Muhkam. And Ibn `Abbas said, "Allah's Apostle died when I was a boy of ten years, and I had learnt the Muhkam (of the Qur'an)
hi: Saeed bin Jubair bataate hain: Jin Surahon ko tum log 'Mufassal' kehte ho, wo 'Muhkam' hain. Aur Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki wafat hui jab main dus saal ka ladka tha, aur maine Muhkam (Quran ka hissa) seekh liya tha.'

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:Ibn `Abbas said, "I have learnt all the Muhkam Suras during the life time of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." I said to him, 'What is meant by the Muhkam?" He replied, "The Mufassal
hi: Saeed bin Jubair bataate hain: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zindagi mein hi saari Muhkam Surahein seekh li thin.' Maine unse pucha, 'Muhkam se kya muraad hai?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Mufassal.'

e: Narrated Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) heard a man reciting the Qur'an in the mosque and said, "May Allah bestow His Mercy on him, as he has reminded me of such-and-such Verses of such a Surah
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ne Masjid mein ek shaks ko Quran padhte suna aur farmaya, 'Allah usse rehmat kare, kyunke usne mujhe falaan Surah ki falaan Aayaten yaad dilaayi hain.'

e: Narrated Hisham:(The same Hadith as 6.556, adding): which I missed (modifying the Verses)
hi: Hisham bataate hain: (Ye hadees pehle wali hadees 6.556 jaisi hi hai, iske saath ye izaafa hai:) '...jo mujhse chhoot gayi thin (Aayaton mein tabdeeli).'

e: Narrated Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) heard a man reciting the Qur'an at night, and said, "May Allah bestow His Mercy on him, as he has reminded me of such-and-such Verses of such-and-such Suras, which I was caused to forget
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne raat ko ek shaks ko Quran padhte suna aur farmaya, 'Allah usse rehmat kare, kyunke usne mujhe falaan falaan Surahon ki falaan Aayaten yaad dilaayi hain jo mujhe bhulaayi gayi thin.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Why does anyone of the people say, 'I have forgotten such-and-such Verses (of the Qur'an)?' He, in fact, is caused (by Allah) to forget
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Log kyun kehte hain, "Main falaan falaan Aayaten bhool gaya"? Haqeeqat mein Allah ne hi use bhulaaya hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Mas`ud al-Ansari:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If one recites the last two verses of Surat al-Baqarah at night, it is sufficient for him (for that night)
hi: Abu Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ansari (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar koi raat ko Surah Al-Baqarah ki aakhri do Aayaten padhe, to ye uske liye (us raat ke liye) kaafi hain.'

e: Narrated `Umar bin Khattab:I heard Hisham bin Hakim bin Hizam reciting Surat-al-Furqan during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and I listened to his recitation and noticed that he recited it in several ways which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had not taught me. So I was on the point of attacking him in the prayer, but I waited till he finished his prayer, and then I seized him by the collar and said, "Who taught you this Surah which I have heard you reciting?" He replied, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) taught it to me." I said, "You are telling a lie; By Allah! Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) taught me (in a different way) this very Surah which I have heard you reciting." So I took him, leading him to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I heard this person reciting Surat-al-Furqan in a way that you did not teach me, and you have taught me Surat-al-Furqan." The Prophet said, "O Hisham, recite!" So he recited in the same way as I heard him recite it before. On that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "It was revealed to be recited in this way." Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Recite, O `Umar!" So I recited it as he had taught me. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then said, "It was revealed to be recited in this way." Allah" Apostle added, "The Qur'an has been revealed to be recited in several different ways, so recite of it that which is easier for you
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Khattab (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Hisham bin Hakim bin Hizam (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zindagi mein Surah Al-Furqan padhte suna, aur maine unki qiraat dhyaan se suni aur dekha ke wo ise kayi alag alag tareekon mein padh rahe the jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe nahi sikhaaye the. Main unpar namaz mein hi hamla karne ke qareeb tha, magar maine intezaar kiya jab tak unhone apni namaz poori nahi kar li, phir maine unka gireban pakad liya aur kaha, 'Kisne tumhein ye Surah sikhaayi jo maine tumhein padhte suna?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe sikhaayi.' Maine kaha, 'Tum jhoot bol rahe ho; Allah ki qasam, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe (alag tareeke se) yahi Surah sikhaayi jo maine tumhein padhte suna.' To main unhein leke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaya aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Maine is shaks ko Surah Al-Furqan aise padhte suna jo aapne mujhe nahi sikhaaya, jabke aapne mujhe Surah Al-Furqan sikhaayi thi.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Aye Hisham, padho!' To unhone waisa hi padha jaisa maine unhein pehle padhte suna tha. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ye isi tarah padhe jaane ke liye naazil hui thi.' Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Padho, Aye Umar!' To maine waisa padha jaisa unhone mujhe sikhaaya tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne phir farmaya, 'Ye isi tarah bhi padhe jaane ke liye naazil hui thi.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne aage kaha, 'Quran kayi alag alag tareekon mein padhe jaane ke liye naazil hua hai, isliye jo tumhein aasan lage usi mein padho.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) heard a reciter reciting, the Qur'an in the mosque at night. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "May Allah bestow His Mercy on him, as he has remind ed me of such-and-such Verses of such and-such Suras, which I missed
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ne raat ko Masjid mein ek Quran padhne wale ko sunaa. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah usse rehmat kare, kyunke usne mujhe falaan falaan Surahon ki falaan Aayaten yaad dilaayi jo mujhse chhoot gayi thin.'

e: Narrated Abu Wail:We went to `Abdullah in the morning and a man said, "Yesterday I recited all the Mufassal Suras." On that `Abdullah said, "That is very quick, and we have the (Prophet's) recitation, and I remember very well the recitation of those Suras which the Prophet (ﷺ) used to recite, and they were eighteen Suras from the Mufassal, and two Suras from the Suras that start with Ha Mim
hi: Abu Wail bataate hain: Hum subah Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas gaye aur ek shaks ne kaha, 'Kal maine saari Mufassal Surahein padh li.' Isper Abdullah ne kaha, 'Ye to bahut jaldi hai, aur hamaare paas (Nabi ki) qiraat hai, mujhe achhi tarah yaad hai un Surahon ki qiraat jo Nabi (SAW) padha karte the, wo Al-Mufassal ki athaarah (18) Surahein thin, aur Ha-Mim se shuru hone wali Surahon mein se do.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Regarding His (Allah's) Statement:-- 'Move not your tongue concerning (the Qur'an) to make haste therewith.' (75.16) And whenever Gabriel descended to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with the Divine Inspiration, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to move his tongue and lips, and that used to be hard for him, and one could easily recognize that he was being inspired Divinely. So Allah revealed the Verse which occurs in the Surah starting with "I do swear by the Day of Resurrection.' (75.1) i.e. 'Move not your tongue concerning (the Qur'an) to make haste then with. It is for Us to collect it (in your mind) (O Muhammad) an give you the ability to recite it 'by heart.' (75.16-17) which means: It is for us to collect it (in your mind) and give you the ability to recite it by heart. And when We have recited it to you (O Muhammad) through Gabriel then follow you its recital. (75.18) means: 'When We reveal it (the Qur'an) to you, Listen to it.' for then: It is for Us to explain it and make it clear to you' (75.19) i.e. It is up to Us to explain it through your tongue. So, when Gabriel came to him, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) would listen to him attentively, and as soon as Gabriel left, he would recite the Revelations, as Allah had promised him
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) Allah ke is farmaan ke baare mein bataate hain: 'Apni zabaan (Quran ko yaad karne ki) jaldi mein mat hilaao.' (75:16) Jab bhi Jibrael Allah ke Rasool (SAW) par wahi lekar utarte, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apni zabaan aur honth hilaate, aur ye unke liye mushkil hota tha, aur koi bhi aasaani se pehchaan sakta tha ke unpar wahi naazil ho rahi hai. To Allah ne wo Aayat naazil ki jo Surah, jo 'Main Qayamat ke din ki qasam khaata hoon' se shuru hoti hai, mein hai (75:1), yaani: 'Apni zabaan (Quran ko yaad karne ki) jaldi mein mat hilaao. Ise (Quran ko) tumhaare zehen mein jama karna aur tumhein padhne ki qaabiliyat dena Hamaare zimme hai.' (75:16-17) Iska matlab hai: Ise tumhaare zehen mein jama karna aur tumhein padhne ki qaabiliyat dena Hamaare zimme hai. 'Aur jab Hum ise (Aye Muhammad) Jibrael ke zariye tumpar padhein, to iski tilawat ki pairvi karo.' (75:18) Iska matlab hai, 'Jab Hum ise (Quran ko) tumpar naazil karein, to use suno.' Phir: 'Iski tafseer karna Hamaare zimme hai' (75:19), yaani, Iski tafseer tumhaari zabaan ke zariye karna Hamaare zimme hai. To jab Jibrael unke paas aate, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) dhyaan se sunte, aur jaise hi Jibrael jaate, wo wahi padh dete jaisa Allah ne unse waada kiya tha.

e: Narrated Qatada:I asked Anas bin Malik about the recitation of the Prophet. He said, "He used to pray long (certain sounds) very much
hi: Qatada bataate hain: Maine Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se Nabi (SAW) ki qiraat ke baare mein pucha. Unhone kaha, 'Wo (kuch aawaazon ko) bahut lamba kheenchte the.'

e: Narrated Qatada:Anas was asked, "How was the recitation (of the Qur'an) of the Prophet?' He replied, "It was characterized by the prolongation of certain sounds." He then recited: In the Name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful prolonging the pronunciation of 'In the Name of Allah, 'the most Beneficent,' and 'the Most Merciful
hi: Qatada bataate hain: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha gaya, 'Nabi (SAW) ki Quran padhne ki tarz kaisi thi?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Kuch aawaazein lambi kheenchi jaati thin.' Phir unhone padha: 'Allah ke naam se jo bada meharbaan, nihaayat reham karne wala hai,' 'Allah ke naam se,' 'bada meharbaan,' aur 'nihaayat reham karne wala' ke uchcharan ko lamba kheenchte hue.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Mughaffal:I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) reciting (Qur'an) while he was riding on his she camel or camel which was moving, carrying him. He was reciting Surat Fath or part of Surat Fath very softly and in an Attractive vibrating tone
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Mughaffal bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko apni oontni ya oont par sawaar hokar, jo unhein leke chal raha tha, Quran padhte dekha. Wo Surah Al-Fath ya uska ek hissa nihaayat halki aur pursikoon, laraztaa hui aawaaz mein padh rahe the.

e: Narrated Abu Musa:That the Prophet (ﷺ) said to him' "O Abu Musa! You have been given one of the mazamir (sweet melodious voices) of the family of David
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Nabi (SAW) ne unse farmaya, 'Aye Abu Musa! Tumhein Dawood (Alaihissalam) ke khaandaan ki khoobsurat aawaazon mein se ek (Mazameer) di gayi hai.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:That the Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "Recite the Qur'an to me." `Abdullah said, "Shall I recite (the Qur'an) to you while it has been revealed to you?" He said, "I like to hear it from others
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Nabi (SAW) ne unse kaha, 'Mujhe Quran padh kar sunaao.' Abdullah ne kaha, 'Kya main aapko sunaaun jabke ye aap hi par naazil hua hai?' Unhone farmaya, 'Mujhe pasand hai ke main ise doosron se sunun.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Mas`ud:The Prophet (ﷺ) said to me, "Recite (the Qur'an) to me." I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) Shall I recite (the Qur'an) to you while it has been revealed to you?" He said, "Yes." So I recited Surat-An-Nisa' (The Women), but when I recited the Verse: 'How (will it be) then when We bring from each nation a witness and We bring you (O Muhammad) as a witness against these people.' (4.41) He said, "Enough for the present," I looked at him and behold! His eyes were overflowing with tears
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Masud bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne mujhse kaha, 'Mujhe (Quran) padh kar sunaao.' Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya main aapko sunaaun jabke ye aap hi par naazil hua hai?' Unhone farmaya, 'Haan.' To maine Surah An-Nisa padhni shuru ki, aur jab main is Aayat par pahuncha: 'To (us waqt) kya hoga jab Hum har ummat se ek gawaah laayenge, aur (Aye Muhammad) tumhein in sab par gawaah banaakar laayenge?' (4:41) Unhone farmaya, 'Bas, itna kaafi hai.' Maine unki taraf dekha, to unki aankhon se aansu beh rahe the.

e: Narrated Sufyan: Ibn Shubruma said, "I wanted to see how much of the Qur'an can be enough (to recite in prayer) and I could not find a Surah containing less than three Verses, therefore I said to myself), "One ought not to recite less than three (Quranic) Verses (in prayer)
hi: Sufyan bataate hain: Ibn Shubruma ne kaha, 'Main dekhna chahta tha ke namaz mein padhne ke liye Quran ka kitna hissa kaafi hai, aur mujhe teen Aayaton se kam ki koi Surah nahi mili, isliye maine (khud se) kaha, "Kisi ko namaz mein teen Quraani Aayaton se kam nahi padhna chaahiye."'

e: Narrated Abu Mas'ud:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If somebody recites the last two Verses of Surat al-Baqara at night, it will be sufficient for him
hi: Abu Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar koi raat ko Surah Al-Baqarah ki aakhri do Aayaten padh le, to ye uske liye kaafi hongi.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr bin Al `As:My father got me married to a lady of a noble family, and often used to ask my wife about me, and she used to reply, "What a wonderful man he is! He never comes to my bed, nor has he approached me since he married me." When this state continued for a long period, my father told the story to the Prophet who said to my father, "Let me meet him." Then I met him and he asked me, "How do you fast?" I replied, "I fast daily," He asked, "How long does it take you to finish the recitation of the whole Qur'an?" I replied, "I finish it every night." On that he said, "Fast for three days every month and recite the Qur'an (and finish it) in one month." I said, "But I have power to do more than that." He said, "Then fast for three days per week." I said, "i have the power to do more than that." He said, "Therefore, fast the most superior type of fasting, (that is, the fasting of (prophet) David who used to fast every alternate day; and finish the recitation of the whole Qur'an In seven days." I wish I had accepted the permission of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as I have become a weak old man. It is said that `Abdullah used to recite one-seventh of the Qur'an during the day-time to some of his family members, for he used to check his memorization of what he would recite at night during the daytime so that it would be easier for him to read at night. And whenever he wanted to gain some strength, he used to give up fasting for some days and count those days to fast for a similar period, for he disliked to leave those things which he used to do during the lifetime of the Prophet
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-As bataate hain: Mere waalid ne mera nikaah ek izzatdaar khaandaan ki ladki se karwaaya, aur wo aksar meri biwi se mere baare mein poochte the, aur wo jawab deti, 'Ye kaisa ajeeb aadmi hai! Wo kabhi mere bistar par nahi aata, na hi usne nikaah ke baad kabhi mujhse qareebi rishta banaaya.' Jab ye silsila lambe waqt tak chala, mere waalid ne ye baat Nabi (SAW) ko bataayi, jinhone mere waalid se kaha, 'Mujhe usse milwaao.' Phir main unse mila, unhone pucha, 'Tum roza kaise rakhte ho?' Maine jawab diya, 'Main har roz roza rakhta hoon.' Unhone pucha, 'Poora Quran khatam karne mein tumhein kitna waqt lagta hai?' Maine jawab diya, 'Main use har raat khatam karta hoon.' Isper unhone farmaya, 'Har mahine mein teen din roza rakho, aur Quran ek mahine mein (khatam karke) padho.' Maine kaha, 'Magar mujhme isse zyaada karne ki taaqat hai.' Unhone kaha, 'To phir haftey mein teen din roza rakho.' Maine kaha, 'Mujhme isse zyaada karne ki taaqat hai.' Unhone kaha, 'To phir sabse behtareen roze rakho - yaani Dawood (Alaihissalam) ke roze, jo ek din chhod kar roza rakhte the; aur Quran ko saat dinon mein khatam karo.' Kaash maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki ijaazat qubool kar li hoti, kyunke ab main ek kamzor budha aadmi ban chuka hoon. Kaha jaata hai ke Abdullah din mein apne khaandaan ke kuch logon ko Quran ka saatvan hissa padha karte the, kyunke wo din mein us hisse ki yaadasht ko jaanchte the jo wo raat ko padhne wale hote, taake unhein raat ko padhna aasan ho. Aur jab bhi unhein taaqat badhaani hoti, wo kuch dinon ke liye roza chhod dete aur un dinon ko ginte the taake baad mein utne hi din roza rakh sakein, kyunke unhein wo cheezein chhodna pasand nahi tha jo wo Nabi (SAW) ki zindagi mein karte the.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:The Prophet (ﷺ) asked me, "How long does it take you to finish the recitation of the whole Qur'an?
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne mujhse pucha, 'Poora Quran khatam karne mein tumhein kitna waqt lagta hai?'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me, "Recite the whole Qur'an in one month's time." I said, "But I have power (to do more than that)." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Then finish the recitation of the Qur'an in seven days, and do not finish it in less than this period
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse kaha, 'Poora Quran ek mahine mein padho.' Maine kaha, 'Magar mujhme (isse zyaada karne ki) taaqat hai.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'To phir Quran saat dinon mein khatam karo, aur isse kam waqt mein khatam mat karo.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah (bin Mas`ud):Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said (to me), "Recite the Qur'an to me." I said, "Shall I recite (it) to you while it has been revealed to you?" He said, "I like to hear it from another person." So I recited Surat An-Nisa (The Women) till I reached the Verse: 'How (will it be) then when We bring from each nation a witness, and We bring you (O Muhammad) as a witness against these people.' (4.41) Then he said to me, "Stop!" Thereupon I saw his eyes overflowing with tears
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) (bin Masud) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (mujhse) kaha, 'Mujhe Quran padh kar sunaao.' Maine kaha, 'Kya main aapko sunaaun jabke ye aap hi par naazil hua hai?' Unhone farmaya, 'Mujhe pasand hai ke main ise kisi aur se sunun.' To maine Surah An-Nisa padhni shuru ki yahaan tak ke main is Aayat par pahuncha: 'To (us waqt) kya hoga jab Hum har ummat se ek gawaah laayenge, aur (Aye Muhammad) tumhein in sab par gawaah banaakar laayenge?' (4:41) Phir unhone mujhse kaha, 'Ruk jao!' Isper maine dekha ke unki aankhon se aansu beh rahe the.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Masud:The Prophet (ﷺ) said to me, "Recite Qur'an to me." I said to him. "Shall I recite (it) to you while it has been revealed to you?" He said, "I like to hear it from another person
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Masud bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne mujhse kaha, 'Mujhe Quran padh kar sunaao.' Maine unse kaha, 'Kya main aapko sunaaun jabke ye aap hi par naazil hua hai?' Unhone farmaya, 'Mujhe pasand hai ke main ise kisi aur se sunun.'

e: Narrated `Ali:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "In the last days (of the world) there will appear young people with foolish thoughts and ideas. They will give good talks, but they will go out of Islam as an arrow goes out of its game, their faith will not exceed their throats. So, wherever you find them, kill them, for there will be a reward for their killers on the Day of Resurrection
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Aakhri zamaane mein aise jawaan log paida honge jinke khayaalat naadaan honge. Wo achhi baatein karenge, magar wo Islam se aise nikal jaayenge jaise teer shikaar se guzar jaata hai; unka Iman unke halq se aage nahi jaayega. To tumhein jahaan bhi wo milein, unhein qatl kar do, kyunke Qayamat ke din unke qaatilon ke liye ajr hoga.'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "There will appear some people among you whose prayer will make you look down upon yours, and whose fasting will make you look down upon yours, but they will recite the Qur'an which will not exceed their throats (they will not act on it) and they will go out of Islam as an arrow goes out through the game whereupon the archer would examine the arrowhead but see nothing, and look at the unfeathered arrow but see nothing, and look at the arrow feathers but see nothing, and finally he suspects to find something in the lower part of the arrow
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Tum mein aise log paida honge jinki namaz dekh kar tumhein apni namaz haqir lagegi, aur unka roza dekh kar tumhein apna roza haqir lagega, magar wo Quran padhenge jo unke halq se aage nahi jaayega (yaani wo isper amal nahi karenge), aur wo Islam se aise nikal jaayenge jaise teer shikaar se guzar jaata hai, jispar teer maarne wala uske phal ko dekhta hai magar kuch nahi paata, phir uske bina par wale hisse ko dekhta hai magar kuch nahi paata, phir teer ke paron ko dekhta hai magar kuch nahi paata, aur aakhir mein use shak hota hai ke shaayad teer ke neeche wale hisse mein kuch (khoon) mila ho.'

e: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The example of a believer who recites the Qur'an and acts on it, like a citron which tastes nice and smells nice. And the example of a believer who does not recite the Qur'an but acts on it, is like a date which tastes good but has no smell. And the example of a hypocrite who recites the Qur'an is like a Raihana (sweet basil) which smells good but tastes bitter And the example of a hypocrite who does not recite the Qur'an is like a colocynth which tastes bitter and has a bad smell
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo momin Quran padhta hai aur usper amal karta hai, uski misaal turanj (phal) jaisi hai jiska zaayeka bhi achha hai aur khushbu bhi achhi. Aur jo momin Quran nahi padhta magar usper amal karta hai, uski misaal khajoor jaisi hai jiska zaayeka achha hai magar khushbu nahi. Aur jo munafiq Quran padhta hai, uski misaal Raihaana jaisi hai jiski khushbu achhi hai magar zaayeka kadwa. Aur jo munafiq Quran nahi padhta, uski misaal hanzal jaisi hai jiska zaayeka kadwa hai aur badbu bhi.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Recite (and study) the Qur'an as long as you agree about its interpretation, but if you have any difference of opinion (as regards to its interpretation and meaning) then you should stop reciting it (for the time being)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Quran (padho aur) padhaai karo jab tak uski tafseer par tum sab muttafiq ho, magar agar tumhaare beech (uski tafseer aur maayne ke baare mein) koi ikhtelaf ho, to (kuch waqt ke liye) padhna rok do.'

e: Narrated Jundub:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Recite (and study) the Qur'an as long as you agree about its interpretation, but when you have any difference of opinion (as regards its interpretation and meaning) then you should stop reciting it (for the time being)
hi: Jundub bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Quran (padho aur) padhaai karo jab tak uski tafseer par tum sab muttafiq ho, magar jab tumhaare beech (uski tafseer aur maayne ke baare mein) koi ikhtelaf ho, to (kuch waqt ke liye) padhna rok do.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:That he heard a man reciting a Quranic Verse which he had heard the Prophet (ﷺ) reciting in a different way. So he took that man to the Prophet (and told him the story). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Both of you are reciting in a correct way, so carry on reciting." The Prophet (ﷺ) further added, "The nations which were before you were destroyed (by Allah) because they differed
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Unhone ek shaks ko ek Quraani Aayat aisi padhte suna jaisa unhone Nabi (SAW) ko alag tareeke se padhte suna tha. To wo us shaks ko Nabi (SAW) ke paas le gaye (aur unhein poori baat bataayi). Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Tum dono sahi tareeke se padh rahe ho, isliye padhte raho.' Nabi (SAW) ne aage kaha, 'Tumse pehle ki ummatein isliye tabaah ho gayin kyunke unmein ikhtelaf ho gaya tha.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:A group of three men came to the houses of the wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) asking how the Prophet (ﷺ) worshipped (Allah), and when they were informed about that, they considered their worship insufficient and said, "Where are we from the Prophet (ﷺ) as his past and future sins have been forgiven." Then one of them said, "I will offer the prayer throughout the night forever." The other said, "I will fast throughout the year and will not break my fast." The third said, "I will keep away from the women and will not marry forever." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to them and said, "Are you the same people who said so-and-so? By Allah, I am more submissive to Allah and more afraid of Him than you; yet I fast and break my fast, I do sleep and I also marry women. So he who does not follow my tradition in religion, is not from me (not one of my followers)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Teen aadmiyon ka ek giroh Nabi (SAW) ki azwaaj ke gharon mein aaya aur poocha ke Nabi (SAW) (Allah ki) ibaadat kaise karte hain. Jab unhein bataaya gaya, to unhone apni ibaadat ko kam samjha aur kaha, 'Hum Nabi (SAW) ke muqaable mein kahaan hain, jinke agle-pichhle sab gunaah maaf ho chuke hain?' Phir unmein se ek ne kaha, 'Main hamesha poori raat namaz padhunga.' Doosre ne kaha, 'Main saal bhar roza rakhunga aur kabhi roza nahi todunga.' Teesre ne kaha, 'Main auraton se door rahunga aur kabhi nikaah nahi karunga.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unke paas aaye aur farmaya, 'Kya tum wahi log ho jinhone aisi aisi baat kahi? Allah ki qasam, main tum sabse zyaada Allah se darta hoon aur uske aage jhukta hoon; phir bhi main roza rakhta hoon aur roza todta bhi hoon, main sota bhi hoon aur auraton se nikaah bhi karta hoon. To jo koi mere deen ke tareeke ki pairvi nahi karta, wo mujhse (yaani mere maanne walon mein) nahi hai.'

e: Narrated 'Urwa:that he asked `Aisha about the Statement of Allah: 'If you fear that you shall not be able to deal justly with the orphan girls, then marry (other) women of your choice, two or three or four; but if you fear that you shall not be able to deal justly (with them), then only one, or (the captives) that your right hands possess. That will be nearer to prevent you from doing injustice.' (4.3) `Aisha said, "O my nephew! (This Verse has been revealed in connection with) an orphan girl under the guardianship of her guardian who is attracted by her wealth and beauty and intends to marry her with a Mahr less than what other women of her standard deserve. So they (such guardians) have been forbidden to marry them unless they do justice to them and give them their full Mahr, and they are ordered to marry other women instead of them
hi: Urwa bataate hain ke unhone Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se Allah ke is farmaan ke baare mein pucha: 'Agar tumhe dar ho ke tum yateem ladkiyon ke saath insaaf nahi kar sakoge, to apni pasand ki (doosri) auraton se, do, teen ya chaar se, nikaah karo; magar agar tumhe dar ho ke tum unke saath insaaf nahi kar sakoge, to sirf ek se, ya jo tumhaare haath mein (laundiyaan) hon unse. Ye is baat ke zyaada qareeb hai ke tum zulm na karo.' (4:3) Aisha ne kaha, 'Aye mere bhatije! (Ye Aayat us) yateem ladki ke silsile mein naazil hui thi jo apne sarparast ki nigraani mein hoti thi, jo uski daulat aur khoobsurati se mutaassir hokar use kam Mahr ke saath nikaah karna chaahta tha, jitni doosri barabar ki auraton ko milti thi. To aise (sarparaston) ko rok diya gaya ke wo unse tab tak nikaah na karein jab tak unke saath insaaf na karein aur unhein poora Mahr na dein, aur unhein hukm diya gaya ke iske bajaaye kisi aur aurat se nikaah karein.'

e: Narrated 'Alqama:While I was with `Abdullah, `Uthman met him at Mina and said, "O Abu `Abdur-Rahman ! I have something to say to you." So both of them went aside and `Uthman said, "O Abu `Abdur-Rah. man! Shall we marry you to a virgin who will make you remember your past days?" When `Abdullah felt that he was not in need of that, he beckoned me (to join him) saying, "O 'Alqama!" Then I heard him saying (in reply to `Uthman), "As you have said that, (I tell you that) the Prophet (ﷺ) once said to us, 'O young people! Whoever among you is able to marry, should marry, and whoever is not able to marry, is recommended to fast, as fasting diminishes his sexual power
hi: Alqama bataate hain: Jab main Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath tha, Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) unse Mina mein mile aur kaha, 'Aye Abu Abdur Rahman! Mujhe aapse kuch kehna hai.' To dono alag ho gaye aur Uthman ne kaha, 'Aye Abu Abdur Rahman! Kya hum aapka nikaah ek kunwaari ladki se karwa dein jo aapko aapke pichhle din yaad dilaayegi?' Jab Abdullah ko laga ke unhein iski zaroorat nahi, to unhone mujhe ishara karke bulaaya: 'Aye Alqama!' Phir maine unhein (Uthman ke jawab mein) ye kehte suna: Jaisa aapne kaha hai, main aapko bataata hoon - Nabi (SAW) ne ek baar humse kaha tha, 'Aye jawaan logo! Tum mein se jo nikaah karne ki taaqat rakhta hai, use nikaah karna chahiye, aur jo taaqat nahi rakhta, use roza rakhna chahiye, kyunke roza uski jinsi khwaahish ko kam karta hai.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:We were with the Prophet (ﷺ) while we were young and had no wealth. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O young people! Whoever among you can marry, should marry, because it helps him lower his gaze and guard his modesty (i.e. his private parts from committing illegal sexual intercourse etc.), and whoever is not able to marry, should fast, as fasting diminishes his sexual power
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Nabi (SAW) ke saath the jab hum jawaan the aur hamaare paas koi daulat nahi thi. To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Aye jawaan logo! Tum mein se jo nikaah kar sakta hai, use nikaah karna chahiye, kyunke ye usko apni nazar neechi rakhne aur apni izzat (sharmgaah) ki hifaazat karne mein madad karta hai; aur jo nikaah nahi kar sakta, use roza rakhna chahiye, kyunke roza uski jinsi khwaahish ko kam karta hai.'

e: Narrated 'Ata:We presented ourselves along with Ibn `Abbas at the funeral procession of Maimuna at a place called Sarif. Ibn `Abbas said, "This is the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ) so when you lift her bier, do not Jerk it or shake it much, but walk smoothly because the Prophet (ﷺ) had nine wives and he used to observe the night turns with eight of them, and for one of them there was no night turn
hi: Ata bataate hain: Hum Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke janaaze ke jaloos mein Sarif naami jagah par maujood the. Ibn Abbas ne kaha, 'Ye Nabi (SAW) ki biwi hain, isliye jab tum unka janaaza uthaao, to use jhatka mat do ya zyaada mat hilaao, balke aahista chalo, kyunke Nabi (SAW) ki nau biwiyaan thin aur wo unmein se aath ke saath raaton ki baari maante the, aur ek ke liye koi raat ki baari nahi thi.'

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to go round (have sexual relations with) all his wives in one night, and he had nine wives
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ek hi raat mein apni sab biwiyon ke paas jaate the, aur unki nau biwiyaan thin.

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:Ibn `Abbas asked me, "Are you married?" I replied, "No." He said, "Marry, for the best person of this (Muslim) nation (i.e., Muhammad) of all other Muslims, had the largest number of wives
hi: Saeed bin Jubair bataate hain: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne mujhse pucha, 'Kya tumhaari shaadi ho chuki hai?' Maine jawab diya, 'Nahi.' Unhone kaha, 'Nikaah kar lo, kyunke is (Musalmaan) ummat ke sabse behtareen shaks (yaani Muhammad SAW) ki, sab Musalmaanon mein, sabse zyaada biwiyaan thin.'

e: Narrated `Umar bin Al-Khattab:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The rewards (of deeds) are according to the intention, and everybody will get the reward for what he has intended. So whoever emigrated for Allah's and His Apostle's sake, his emigration was for Allah and His Apostle; and whoever emigrated for worldly benefits, or to marry a woman, then his emigration was for the thing for what he emigrated for
