hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Amaal ka sawaab niyat par depend karta hai, aur har shaks ko wahi milega jiski usne niyat ki. To jisne Allah aur uske Rasool ke liye hijrat ki, uski hijrat Allah aur uske Rasool ke liye hui; aur jisne duniya ke faayde ke liye ya kisi aurat se nikaah karne ke liye hijrat ki, to uski hijrat usi cheez ke liye hui jiske liye usne hijrat ki.'

e: Narrated Ibn Masud:We used to fight in the holy battles in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) and we had no wives with us. So we said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shall we get castrated?" The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade us to do so
hi: Ibn Masud bataate hain: Hum Nabi (SAW) ke saath jihaad mein shareek hote the aur hamaare saath koi biwiyaan nahi hoti thin. To humne pucha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya hum khud ko khassi kara lein?' Nabi (SAW) ne humein aisa karne se mana kiya.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:`Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf came (from Mecca to Medina) and the Prophet (ﷺ) made a bond of brotherhood between him and Sa`d bin Ar-Rabi` Al-Ansari. Al-Ansari had two wives, so he suggested that `Abdur- Rahman take half, his wives and property. `Abdur-Rahman replied, "May Allah bless you with your wives and property. Kindly show me the market." So `Abdur-Rahman went to the market and gained (in bargains) some dried yoghurt and some butter. After a few days the Prophet (ﷺ) saw `Abdur-Rahman with some yellow stains on his clothes and asked him, "What is that, O `Abdur-Rahman?" He replied, "I had married an Ansari woman." The Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "How much Mahr did you give her?" He replied, "The weight of one (date) stone of gold." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Offer a banquet, even with one sheep
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abdur Rahman bin Auf (رضی اللہ عنہ) (Makkah se Madina) aaye, aur Nabi (SAW) ne unke aur Sa'd bin Ar-Rabi Al-Ansari ke darmiyaan bhaichaare ka rishta qaayam kiya. Al-Ansari ki do biwiyaan thin, isliye unhone sujhaav diya ke Abdur Rahman unki ek biwi aur aadhi jaayadaad le lein. Abdur Rahman ne jawab diya, 'Allah aapko aapki biwiyon aur jaayadaad mein barkat de. Barah-e-meharbaani mujhe bazaar dikha dijiye.' To Abdur Rahman bazaar gaye aur (len-den mein) kuch sukhi dahi aur makhan kamaaya. Kuch dinon baad Nabi (SAW) ne Abdur Rahman ke kapdon par kuch peela nishaan dekha aur pucha, 'Ye kya hai, Aye Abdur Rahman?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Maine ek Ansaari aurat se nikaah kiya hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne pucha, 'Tumne unhein kitna Mahr diya?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Ek khajoor ki guthli ke barabar sona.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Walima ki dawat do, chaahe ek hi bakri se ho.'

e: Narrated Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade `Uthman bin Maz'un to abstain from marrying (and other pleasures) and if he had allowed him, we would have gotten ourselves castrated
hi: Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Maz'un ko nikaah (aur doosri khushiyon) se door rehne se mana kiya, aur agar unhone ijaazat di hoti, to hum khud ko khassi kara lete.

e: Narrated Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas:The Prophet (ﷺ) prevented `Uthman bin Mazun from that (not marrying), and had he allowed him, we would have got ourselves castrated
hi: Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Maz'un ko us (nikaah na karne) se roka, aur agar unhone ijaazat di hoti, to hum khud ko khassi kara lete.

e: Narrated 'Abdullah: We used to participate in the holy battles led by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and we had nothing (no wives) with us. So we said, "Shall we get ourselves castrated?" He forbade us that and then allowed us to marry women with a temporary contract (2) and recited to us: -- 'O you who believe ! Make not unlawful the good things which Allah has made lawful for you, but commit no transgression
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki qayaadat mein jihaad mein shareek hote the aur hamaare paas kuch nahi hota tha (koi biwi nahi). To humne pucha, 'Kya hum khud ko khassi kara lein?' Unhone humein aisa karne se mana kiya, phir humein aurton se waqti nikaah (Mut'a) ki ijaazat di, aur humein padh kar sunaaya: 'Aye Iman waalo! In paak cheezon ko haraam mat karo jo Allah ne tumhare liye halaal ki hain, magar hadd se aage mat badho.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira: I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I am a young man and I am afraid that I may commit illegal sexual intercourse and I cannot afford to marry." He kept silent, and then repeated my question once again, but he kept silent. I said the same (for the third time) and he remained silent. Then repeated my question (for the fourth time), and only then the Prophet said, "O Abu Huraira! The pen has dried after writing what you are going to confront. So (it does not matter whether you) get yourself castrated or not
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Main ek jawaan aadmi hoon aur mujhe dar hai ke kahin main zina na kar baithoon, aur mujhme nikaah karne ki hasiyat nahi hai.' Wo khaamosh rahe, phir maine apna sawaal dobara dohraaya, magar wo phir khaamosh rahe. Maine phir wahi kaha (teesri baar) aur wo khaamosh rahe. Phir maine apna sawaal (chauthi baar) dohraaya, tab jaakar Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Aye Abu Huraira! Qalam sukh chuka hai jo kuch tumhaare saath hone wala hai use likhne ke baad. To (isse koi farq nahi padta ke tum) khud ko khassi karaao ya na karaao.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Suppose you landed in a valley where there is a tree of which something has been eaten and then you found trees of which nothing has been eaten, of which tree would you let your camel graze?" He said, "(I will let my camel graze) of the one of which nothing has been eaten before." (The sub-narrator added: `Aisha meant that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had not married a virgin besides herself
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Agar aap ek wadi mein utrein jahaan ek darakht ka phal khaaya jaa chuka ho, aur phir aapko aise darakht milein jinka phal na khaaya gaya ho, to aap apne oont ko kaunse darakht se charne denge?' Unhone kaha, '(Main apne oont ko us) darakht (se charne dunga) jiska phal pehle kisi ne na khaaya ho.' (Ravi ne kaha: Aisha ka matlab ye tha ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unke siwa kisi kunwaari se nikaah nahi kiya tha.)

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said (to me), "You have been shown to me twice in (my) dreams. A man was carrying you in a silken cloth and said to me, 'This is your wife.' I uncovered it; and behold, it was you. I said to myself, 'If this dream is from Allah, He will cause it to come true
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (mujhse) farmaya, 'Mujhe tumhein do baar khwaab mein dikhaaya gaya. Ek shaks tumhein resham ke kapde mein leke aaya aur mujhse kaha, "Ye aapki biwi hai." Maine use khola, aur dekha ke wo tum thi. Maine apne dil mein kaha, "Agar ye khwaab Allah ki taraf se hai, to wo ise sach kar dega."'

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:While we were returning from a Ghazwa (Holy Battle) with the Prophet, I started driving my camel fast, as it was a lazy camel A rider came behind me and pricked my camel with a spear he had with him, and then my camel started running as fast as the best camel you may see. Behold! The rider was the Prophet (ﷺ) himself. He said, 'What makes you in such a hurry?" I replied, I am newly married " He said, "Did you marry a virgin or a matron? I replied, "A matron." He said, "Why didn't you marry a young girl so that you may play with her and she with you?" When we were about to enter (Medina), the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Wait so that you may enter (Medina) at night so that the lady of unkempt hair may comb her hair and the one whose husband has been absent may shave her pubic region
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek Ghazwe se Nabi (SAW) ke saath wapas aate waqt, maine apne oont ko tez chalaana shuru kiya, kyunke wo sust tha. Ek sawaar mere peechhe aaya aur apne bhaale se mere oont ko chubho diya, phir mera oont sabse achhe oont jaisi raftaar se daudne laga. Dekha to wo sawaar khud Nabi (SAW) the. Unhone pucha, 'Tumhein itni jaldi kya hai?' Maine jawab diya, 'Meri nayi shaadi hui hai.' Unhone pucha, 'Kunwaari se ki ya biwaa se?' Maine jawab diya, 'Biwaa se.' Unhone pucha, 'Kisi jawaan ladki se kyun nahi ki, taake tum uske saath aur wo tumhaare saath khel sakti?' Jab hum (Madina mein) daakhil hone hi wale the, Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Thoda intezaar karo taake tum raat ko daakhil ho sako, taake bikhre baalon wali aurat apne baal sanwaar sake, aur jiske shohar door gaye hon wo apne baal saaf kar sake.'

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:When I got married, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me, "What type of lady have you married?" I replied, "I have married a matron' He said, "Why, don't you have a liking for the virgins and for fondling them?" Jabir also said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Why didn't you marry a young girl so that you might play with her and she with you?
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab meri shaadi hui, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse pucha, 'Tumne kaisi aurat se shaadi ki?' Maine jawab diya, 'Maine ek biwaa se shaadi ki hai.' Unhone pucha, 'Kyun, kya tumhein kunwaari ladkiyon aur unke saath khelne mein dilchaspi nahi?' Jabir ne ye bhi kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kisi jawaan ladki se kyun nahi ki, taake tum uske saath aur wo tumhaare saath khel sakti?'

e: Narrated 'Urwa:The Prophet (ﷺ) asked Abu Bakr for `Aisha's hand in marriage. Abu Bakr said "But I am your brother." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You are my brother in Allah's religion and His Book, but she (Aisha) is lawful for me to marry
hi: Urwa bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne Abu Bakr se Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ka rishta maanga. Abu Bakr ne kaha, 'Magar main to aapka bhai hoon.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Aap Allah ke deen aur uski Kitaab mein mere bhai hain, magar Aisha mere liye nikaah ke liye jaayez hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The best women are the riders of the camels and the righteous among the women of Quraish. They are the kindest women to their children in their childhood and the more careful women of the property of their husbands
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Sabse behtareen auraten wo hain jo oont par sawaar hoti hain (yaani Arab auraten), aur Quraish ki nek auraten. Wo apne bachon ke bachpan mein unke saath sabse zyaada mohabbat karti hain, aur apne shauharon ki jaayadaad ki sabse zyaada hifaazat karti hain.'

e: Narrated Abu Burda's father:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, any man who has a slave girl whom he educates properly, teaches good manners, manumits and marries her, will get a double reward And if any man of the people of the Scriptures believes in his own prophet and then believes in me too, he will (also) get a double reward And any slave who fulfills his duty to his master and to his Lord, will (also) get a double reward
hi: Abu Burda ke waalid bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo aadmi apni launDi ko achhi tarah taleem de, achhe akhlaaq sikhaaye, phir use azaad karke usse nikaah kare, use dohra ajr milega. Aur agar Ahl-e-Kitaab mein se koi apne Nabi par Iman laaya ho aur phir mujhpar bhi Iman laaye, to use bhi dohra ajr milega. Aur jo ghulaam apne maalik aur apne Rab dono ke haq poore kare, use bhi dohra ajr milega.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said: Abraham did not tell lies except three. (One of them was) when Abraham passed by a tyrant and (his wife) Sara was accompanying him (Abu Huraira then mentioned the whole narration and said:) (The tyrant) gave her Hajar. Sara said, "Allah saved me from the hands of the Kafir (i.e. infidel) and gave me Hajar to serve me." (Abu Huraira added:) That (Hajar) is your mother, O Banu Ma'-As-Sama' (i.e., the Arabs)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ibrahim (Alaihissalam) ne teen baar ke siwa kabhi jhoot nahi bola. (Unmein se ek tha) jab Ibrahim ek zaalim baadshaah ke paas se guzre aur (unki biwi) Sarah unke saath thi...' (Abu Huraira ne phir poori riwayat bayaan ki aur kaha:) '(Us zaalim ne) unhein Hajar di. Sarah ne kaha, "Allah ne mujhe us kaafir se bacha liya aur mujhe Hajar di taake wo meri khidmat kare."' (Abu Huraira ne aage kaha:) Wahi (Hajar) tumhaari maa hain, Aye Banu Ma-as-Samaa (yaani Arabo)!

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) stayed for three days between Khaibar and Medina, and there he consummated his marriage to Safiyya bint Huyai. I invited the Muslims to the wedding banquet in which neither meat nor bread was offered. He ordered for leather dining-sheets to be spread, and dates, dried yoghurt and butter were laid on it, and that was the Prophet's wedding banquet. The Muslims wondered, "Is she (Saffiyya) considered as his wife or his slave girl?" Then they said, "If he orders her to veil herself, she will be one of the mothers of the Believers; but if he does not order her to veil herself, she will be a slave girl. So when the Prophet (ﷺ) proceeded from there, he spared her a space behind him (on his she-camel) and put a screening veil between her and the people
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) Khaibar aur Madina ke beech teen din rahe, aur wahaan unhone Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Huyai se apni shaadi ka rishta poora kiya. Maine Musalmaanon ko unke Walima ki dawat di, jismein na gosht tha na roti. Unhone chamde ke dastarkhwaan bichhaane ka hukm diya, aur usmein khajoorein, sukhi dahi aur makhan rakha gaya, aur yahi Nabi (SAW) ka Walima tha. Musalmaanon ko hairaani hui, 'Kya wo (Safiya) unki biwi hain ya launDi?' Phir unhone kaha, 'Agar wo unhein parda karne ka hukm dein, to wo Ummahaat-ul-Momineen mein se hongi; magar agar unhein parda karne ka hukm na dein, to wo launDi hongi.' To jab Nabi (SAW) wahaan se rawaana hue, unhone unke liye apni oontni par apne peechhe jagah rakhi aur unke aur logon ke beech ek parda daal diya.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) manumitted Safiyya and regarded her manumission as her Mahr
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko azaad kiya aur unki azaadi ko hi unka Mahr maana.

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d As-Sa`idi:A woman came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have come to give you myself in marriage (without Mahr)." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) looked at her. He looked at her carefully and fixed his glance on her and then lowered his head. When the lady saw that he did not say anything, she sat down. A man from his companions got up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! If you are not in need of her, then marry her to me." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Have you got anything to offer?" The man said, "No, by Allah, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to him), "Go to your family and see if you have something." The man went and returned, saying, "No, by Allah, I have not found anything." Allah's Apostle said, "(Go again) and look for something, even if it is an iron ring." He went again and returned, saying, "No, by Allah, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I could not find even an iron ring, but this is my Izar (waist sheet)." He had no rida. He added, "I give half of it to her." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "What will she do with your Izar? If you wear it, she will be naked, and if she wears it, you will be naked." So that man sat down for a long while and then got up (to depart). When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw him going, he ordered that he be called back. When he came, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "How much of the Qur'an do you know?" He said, "I know such Sura and such Sura," counting them. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do you know them by heart?" He replied, "Yes." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Go, I marry her to you for that much of the Qur'an which you have
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) As-Sa'idi bataate hain: Ek aurat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Main aapke paas khud ko (bagair Mahr ke) hiba karne aayi hoon.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhein dekha, ghor se dekha aur apni nazar unpar jamaa di, phir apna sar jhuka liya. Jab khaatoon ne dekha ke unhone kuch nahi kaha, to wo baith gayi. Unke sahaaba mein se ek shaks khade hue aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Agar aapko unki zaroorat nahi, to unka nikaah mujhse kar dijiye.' Nabi (SAW) ne pucha, 'Kya tumhaare paas dene ke liye kuch hai?' Us aadmi ne kaha, 'Nahi, Allah ki qasam, Aye Allah ke Rasool!' Nabi (SAW) ne (usse) kaha, 'Apne ghar jaao aur dekho kya kuch mil sakta hai.' Wo gaya aur wapas aakar kaha, 'Nahi, Allah ki qasam, mujhe kuch nahi mila.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, '(Phir jaao) aur kuch dhoondho, chaahe wo loha ki ek anguthi hi ho.' Wo phir gaya aur wapas aakar kaha, 'Nahi, Allah ki qasam, Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe loha ki anguthi bhi nahi mili, magar ye meri Izar (kamar ki chaadar) hai.' Uske paas Rida (upar ka kapda) nahi tha. Usne kaha, 'Main isse aadhi unhein de deta hoon.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Wo tumhaari Izar ka kya karegi? Agar tum ise pehno, to wo nangi rahegi, aur agar wo ise pehne, to tum nange rahoge.' To wo aadmi kaafi der tak baitha raha, phir uthaa (jaane ke liye). Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne use jaate dekha, to unhone use wapas bulaane ka hukm diya. Jab wo aaya, Nabi (SAW) ne pucha, 'Tumhein Quran mein se kitna yaad hai?' Usne kaha, 'Mujhe falaan Surah, falaan Surah yaad hai,' aur ginta gaya. Nabi (SAW) ne pucha, 'Kya tum unhein zabaani padh sakte ho?' Usne kaha, 'Haan.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jaao, maine unka nikaah tumse us Quran ke badle kar diya jo tumhein zabaani yaad hai.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:Abu Hudhaifa bin `Utba bin Rabi`a bin `Abdi Shams who had witnessed the battle of Badr along with the Prophet (ﷺ) adopted Salim as his son, to whom he married his niece, Hind bint Al-Walid bin `Utba bin Rabi`a; and Salim was the freed slave of an Ansar woman, just as the Prophet (ﷺ) had adopted Zaid as his son. It was the custom in the Pre-Islamic Period that if somebody adopted a boy, the people would call him the son of the adoptive father and he would be the latter's heir. But when Allah revealed the Divine Verses: 'Call them by (the names of) their fathers . . . your freed-slaves,' (33.5) the adopted persons were called by their fathers' names. The one whose father was not known, would be regarded as a Maula and your brother in religion. Later on Sahla bint Suhail bin `Amr Al-Quraishi Al-`Amiri-- and she was the wife of Abu- Hudhaifa bin `Utba--came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We used to consider Salim as our (adopted) son, and now Allah has revealed what you know (regarding adopted sons)." The sub-narrator then mentioned the rest of the narration
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Abu Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Utba bin Rabi'a bin Abdi Shams, jinhone Nabi (SAW) ke saath jang-e-Badr mein hissa liya tha, ne Salim ko apna beta bana liya tha, aur unka nikaah apni bhatiji Hind bint Al-Walid bin Utba bin Rabi'a se karwaya; aur Salim ek Ansaari khaatoon ke azaad kiye ghulaam the, waise hi jaise Nabi (SAW) ne Zaid ko apna beta banaaya tha. Jaahiliyat ke daur mein ye rivaaj tha ke agar koi kisi ladke ko god le, to log use us god lene wale waalid ka beta kehte aur wo uski miraas ka waaris hota. Magar jab Allah ne ye Quraani Aayaten naazil kin: 'Unhein unke waalidon ke naam se bulaao... aur (agar naam maloom na ho) tumhaare azaad kiye ghulaam' (33:5), to god liye gaye logon ko unke asal waalidon ke naam se bulaaya jaane laga. Jiska waalid maloom na ho, use Maula aur deen mein bhai maana jaata. Baad mein Sahla bint Suhail bin Amr Al-Quraishi Al-Aamiri - jo Abu Hudhaifa bin Utba ki biwi thi - Nabi (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Hum Salim ko apna (god liya) beta samajhte the, aur ab Allah ne wo naazil kiya hai jo aapko pata hai (god liye beton ke baare mein).' (Ravi ne baaki riwayat bayaan ki.)

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered upon Dubaa bint Az-Zubair and said to her, "Do you have a desire to perform the Hajj?" She replied, "By Allah, I feel sick." He said to her, "Intend to perform Hajj and stipulate something by saying, 'O Allah, I will finish my Ihram at any place where You stop me (i.e. I am unable to go further)." She was the wife of Al-Miqdad bin Al-Aswad
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Dubaa bint Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas gaye aur unse pucha, 'Kya aap Hajj karna chahti hain?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Allah ki qasam, main bimar mehsoos karti hoon.' Unhone unse kaha, 'Hajj ki niyat karo aur ye shart rakho: "Aye Allah! Main apna Ihram wahin khatam karungi jahaan Tu mujhe rok de (yaani jahaan main aage na jaa sakoon)."' Wo Al-Miqdad (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Aswad ki biwi thin.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A woman is married for four things, i.e., her wealth, her family status, her beauty and her religion. So you should marry the religious woman (otherwise) you will be a losers
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Aurat se chaar cheezon ki wajah se nikaah kiya jaata hai: uska maal, uska khaandaan, uski khoobsurati, aur uska deen. To tum deendaar aurat se nikaah karo, warna tum nuqsaan mein rahoge.'

e: Narrated Sahl:A man passed by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Allah's Apostle asked (his companions) "What do you say about this (man)?" They replied "If he asks for a lady's hand, he ought to be given her in marriage; and if he intercedes (for someone) his intercessor should be accepted; and if he speaks, he should be listened to." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) kept silent, and then a man from among the poor Muslims passed by, an Allah's Apostle asked (them) "What do you say about this man?" They replied, "If he asks for a lady's hand in marriage he does not deserve to be married, and he intercedes (for someone), his intercession should not be accepted; And if he speaks, he should not be listened to.' Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "This poor man is better than so many of the first as filling the earth
hi: Sahl bataate hain: Ek shaks Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas se guzra, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (apne sahaaba se) pucha, 'Is (shaks) ke baare mein tumhaari kya raay hai?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Agar wo kisi aurat ka rishta maange, to use nikaah ke liye di jaani chaahiye; aur agar wo (kisi ke liye) sifaarish kare, to uski sifaarish qubool ki jaani chaahiye; aur agar wo baat kare, to usse suna jaana chaahiye.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khaamosh rahe, phir ek gareeb Musalmaan wahaan se guzra, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (unse) pucha, 'Is shaks ke baare mein tumhaari kya raay hai?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Agar wo kisi aurat ka rishta maange, to wo nikaah ke laayak nahi, aur agar wo sifaarish kare, to uski sifaarish qubool nahi ki jaani chaahiye; aur agar wo baat kare, to usse suna nahi jaana chaahiye.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ye gareeb aadmi, us pehle jaise itne logon se behtar hai jitne zameen bhar de.'

e: Narrated 'Urwa:that he asked `Aisha regarding the Verse: 'If you fear that you shall not be able to deal justly with the orphans (4.3) She said, "O my nephew! This Verse refers to the orphan girl who is under the guardianship of her guardian who likes her beauty and wealth and wishes to (marry her and) curtails her Mahr. Such guardians have been forbidden to marry them unless they do justice by giving them their full Mahr, and they have been ordered to marry other than them. The people asked for the verdict of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) after that, so Allah revealed: 'They ask your instruction concerning the women . . . whom you desire to marry.' (4.127) So Allah revealed to them that if the orphan girl had beauty and wealth, they desired to marry her and for her family status. They can only marry them if they give them their full Mahr. And if they had no desire to marry them because of their lack of wealth and beauty, they would leave them and marry other women. So, as they used to leave them, when they had no interest, in them, they were forbidden to marry them when they had such interest, unless they treated them justly and gave them their full Mahr Apostle said, 'If at all there is evil omen, it is in the horse, the woman and the house." a lady is to be warded off. And the Statement of Allah: 'Truly, among your wives and your children, there are enemies for you (i.e may stop you from the obedience of Allah)
hi: Urwa bataate hain ke unhone Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se is Aayat ke baare mein pucha: 'Agar tumhe dar ho ke tum yateemon ke saath insaaf nahi kar sakoge...' (4:3) Unhone kaha, 'Aye mere bhatije! Ye Aayat us yateem ladki ke baare mein hai jo apne sarparast ki nigraani mein hoti thi, jise uski khoobsurati aur daulat pasand aati thi aur wo (usse nikaah karke) uska Mahr kam karna chaahta tha. Aise sarparaston ko rok diya gaya ke wo unse tab tak nikaah na karein jab tak unke saath insaaf na karein aur unhein poora Mahr na dein, aur unhein hukm diya gaya ke iske bajaaye kisi aur se nikaah karein. Log iske baad Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se fatwa maangne lage, isliye Allah ne naazil farmaya: "Wo aapse auraton ke baare mein hukm poochte hain... jinse tum nikaah karna chahte ho." (4:127) To Allah ne unhein bataya ke agar yateem ladki khoobsurat aur ameer ho, to wo uske khaandaani rutbe ki wajah se bhi usse nikaah karna chaahte hain. Wo unse sirf tabhi nikaah kar sakte hain jab unhein poora Mahr dein. Aur agar unki uske paas maal aur khoobsurati kam hone ki wajah se koi dilchaspi na ho, to wo unhein chhod kar kisi aur aurat se nikaah kar lete. To jaise wo unhein dilchaspi na hone par chhod dete the, unhein rok diya gaya ke jab unmein dilchaspi ho, to unse nikaah na karein, jab tak insaaf na karein aur poora Mahr na dein.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Agar kisi cheez mein bad-shugooni ho sakti hai, to wo ghode, aurat aur ghar mein hai' - yaani aurat se bachna chaahiye. Aur Allah ka farmaan: 'Beshak tumhaari biwiyon aur bacchon mein se kuch tumhaare dushman hain (yaani Allah ki itaa'at se rok sakte hain).'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Evil omen is in the women, the house and the horse
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Bad-shugooni auraton, ghar aur ghode mein hoti hai.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Evil omen was mentioned before the Prophet: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If there is evil omen in anything, it is in the house, the woman and the horse
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ke saamne bad-shugooni ka zikr hua, Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar kisi cheez mein bad-shugooni ho sakti hai, to wo ghar, aurat aur ghode mein hai.'

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If at all there is bad omen, it is in the horse, the woman, and the house
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar kisi cheez mein bad-shugooni ho sakti hai, to wo ghode, aurat aur ghar mein hai.'

e: Narrated Usama bin Zaid:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "After me I have not left any trial more severe to men than women
hi: Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Mere baad maine mardon ke liye auraton se zyaada sakht koi aazmaaish nahi chhodi.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:Three principles were established because of Barira: (i) When Banra was manumitted she was given the option (to remain with her slave husband or not). (ii) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said "The Wala of the slave) is for the one who manumits (the slave). (iii) When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered (the house), he saw a cooking pot on the fire but he was given bread and meat soup from the soup of the home. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Didn't I see the cooking pot (on the fire)?" It was said, "That is the meat given in charity to Barira, and you do not eat the (things given in) charity." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It is an object of charity for Barira, and it is a present for us
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Barira (رضی اللہ عنہا) ki wajah se teen usool qaayam hue: (1) Jab Barira ko azaad kiya gaya, to unhein ikhtiyaar diya gaya (apne ghulaam shohar ke saath rehne ya na rehne ka). (2) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, '(Ghulaam ki) Wala uske liye hai jo use azaad kare.' (3) Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) andar aaye, unhone chulhe par ek deg dekha, magar unhein roti aur gosht ke shorbe (ghar ke shorbe se) diya gaya. Nabi (SAW) ne pucha, 'Kya maine deg (chulhe par) nahi dekhi thi?' Unhone kaha, 'Wo Barira ko sadqe mein diya gosht hai, aur aap sadqe ki cheez nahi khaate.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Wo Barira ke liye sadqa hai, aur hamare liye tohfa hai.'

e: Narrated Aisha":(regarding) the Verse: 'And if you fear that you shall not be able to deal justly with the orphans...' (4.3) It is about the orphan girl who is in the custody of a man who is her guardian, and he intends to marry her because of her wealth, but he treats her badly and does not manage her property fairly and honestly. Such a man should marry women of his liking other than her, two or three or four. 'Prohibited to you (for marriage) are: ...your foster-mothers (who suckled you).' (4.23) Marriage is prohibited between persons having a foster suckling relationship corresponding to a blood relationship which renders marriage unlawful
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) is Aayat ke baare mein bataati hain: 'Agar tumhe dar ho ke tum yateemon ke saath insaaf nahi kar sakoge...' (4:3) Ye us yateem ladki ke baare mein hai jo kisi aadmi ki nigraani mein ho jo uska sarparast hai, aur wo uski daulat ki wajah se use nikaah karna chaahta hai, magar uske saath bura sulook karta hai aur uski jaayadaad ko theek se aur imaandaari se sambhaal nahi paata. Aise aadmi ko chaahiye ke wo apni pasand ki kisi doosri aurat se nikaah kare, do, teen ya chaar se. 'Tumhaare liye (nikaah) haraam hain: ...tumhaari doodh-pilaane wali maayein.' (4:23) Nikaah un logon ke beech haraam hai jinke beech doodh-piyaai ka rishta hai jo khoon ke rishte ke barabar hai jisse nikaah haraam ho jaata hai.

e: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) that while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was with her, she heard a voice of a man asking permission to enter the house of Hafsa. `Aisha added: I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! This man is asking permission to enter your house." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I think he is so-and-so," naming the foster-uncle of Hafsa. `Aisha said, "If so-and-so," naming her foster uncle, "were living, could he enter upon me?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Yes, for foster suckling relations make all those things unlawful which are unlawful through corresponding birth (blood) relations
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki zawja) bataati hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unke saath the, unhone ek aadmi ki aawaaz suni jo Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke ghar mein daakhil hone ki ijaazat maang raha tha. Aisha ne aage kaha: Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Ye aadmi aapke ghar mein daakhil hone ki ijaazat maang raha hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Mujhe lagta hai wo falaan hai,' Hafsa ke doodh-rishte wale chacha ka naam lete hue. Aisha ne kaha, 'Agar falaan,' apne doodh-rishte wale chacha ka naam lete hue, 'zinda hote, to kya wo mere paas aa sakte the?' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Haan, kyunke doodh-piyaai ke rishte se wo sab cheezein haraam ho jaati hain jo khoon ke rishte se haraam hoti hain.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:It was said to the Prophet, "Won't you marry the daughter of Hamza?" He said, "She is my foster niece (brother's daughter)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) se kaha gaya, 'Aap Hamza ki beti se nikaah kyun nahi karte?' Unhone farmaya, 'Wo meri doodh-rishte ki bhatiji hain (mere bhai ki beti).'

e: Narrated Um Habiba:(daughter of Abu Sufyan) I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Marry my sister. the daughter of Abu Sufyan." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do you like that?" I replied, "Yes, for even now I am not your only wife and I like that my sister should share the good with me." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "But that is not lawful for me." I said, We have heard that you want to marry the daughter of Abu Salama." He said, "(You mean) the daughter of Um Salama?" I said, "Yes." He said, "Even if she were not my step-daughter, she would be unlawful for me to marry as she is my foster niece. I and Abu Salama were suckled by Thuwaiba. So you should not present to me your daughters or your sisters (in marriage)." Narrated 'Urwa: Thuwaiba was the freed slave girl of Abu Lahb whom he had manumitted, and then she suckled the Prophet. When Abu Lahb died, one of his relatives saw him in a dream in a very bad state and asked him, "What have you encountered?" Abu Lahb said, "I have not found any rest since I left you, except that I have been given water to drink in this (the space between his thumb and other fingers) and that is because of my manumitting Thuwaiba
hi: Umm Habiba (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki beti) bataati hain: Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Meri behen, Abu Sufyan ki beti, se nikaah kar lijiye.' Nabi (SAW) ne pucha, 'Kya tumhein ye pasand hai?' Maine jawab diya, 'Haan, kyunke abhi bhi main aapki akeli biwi nahi hoon, aur mujhe pasand hai ke meri behen bhi mere saath is bhalaai mein shareek ho.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Magar ye mere liye jaayez nahi.' Maine kaha, 'Humein pata chala hai ke aap Abu Salama ki beti se nikaah karna chahte hain.' Unhone pucha, '(Kya tumhaara matlab hai) Umm Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) ki beti?' Maine kaha, 'Haan.' Unhone farmaya, 'Agar wo meri saudari beti bhi na hoti, to bhi wo mere liye haraam hai, kyunke wo meri doodh-rishte ki bhatiji hai. Mujhe aur Abu Salama ko Thuwaiba ne doodh pilaaya tha. Isliye tumhein apni betiyaan ya behnein mere saamne pesh nahi karni chaahiye.' Ravi Urwa bataate hain: Thuwaiba, Abu Lahab ki azaad ki hui launDi thi, jise unhone azaad kiya tha, aur usne Nabi (SAW) ko doodh pilaaya tha. Jab Abu Lahab ka intekaal hua, uske ek rishtedaar ne use khwaab mein bahut buri haalat mein dekha aur pucha, 'Tumhein kya mila?' Abu Lahab ne kaha, 'Tumse juda hone ke baad mujhe koi araam nahi mila, siwaaye is ke ke mujhe (apne angoothe aur ungliyon ke beech) ek ghoont paani diya jaata hai, aur ye Thuwaiba ko azaad karne ki wajah se hai.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:that the Prophet (ﷺ) entered upon her while a man was sitting with her. Signs of answer seemed to appear on his face as if he disliked that. She said, "Here is my (foster) brother." He said, "Be sure as to who is your foster brother, for foster suckling relationship is established only when milk is the only food of the child
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) unke paas aaye jabke ek aadmi unke saath baitha tha. Unke chehre par na-pasandeedgi ke aasaar zaahir hue. Unhone kaha, 'Ye mera (doodh-rishte ka) bhai hai.' Unhone farmaya, 'Dhyaan se dekho tumhaara doodh-rishte ka bhai kaun hai, kyunke doodh-piyaai ka rishta sirf tab qaayam hota hai jab doodh bachche ki sirf khuraak ho.'

e: Narrated Aisha:that Aflah the brother of Abu Al-Qu'ais, her foster uncle, came, asking permission to enter upon her after the Verse of Al-Hijab (the use of veils by women) was revealed. `Aisha added: I did not allow him to enter, but when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came, I told him what I had done, and he ordered me to give him permission
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Aflah, Abu Al-Qu'ais ke bhai, unke doodh-rishte ke chacha, unse milne ki ijaazat maangne aaye, ye Hijab ki Aayat naazil hone ke baad ki baat hai. Aisha ne aage kaha: Maine unhein andar aane ki ijaazat nahi di, magar jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aaye, maine unhein bataaya ke maine kya kiya, to unhone mujhe use ijaazat dene ka hukm diya.

e: Narrated `Uqba bin Al-Harith:I married a woman and then a black lady came to us and said, "I have suckled you both (you and your wife)." So I came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "I married so-and-so and then a black lady came to us and said to me, 'I have suckled both of you.' But I think she is a liar." The Prophet (ﷺ) turned his face away from me and I moved to face his face, and said, "She is a liar." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "How (can you keep her as your wife) when that lady has said that she has suckled both of you? So abandon (i.e., divorce) her (your wife)
hi: Uqba bin Al-Harith bataate hain: Maine ek aurat se nikaah kiya, phir ek kaali (rangat ki) khaatoon humaare paas aayi aur kaha, 'Maine tum dono ko doodh pilaaya hai.' To main Nabi (SAW) ke paas gaya aur kaha, 'Maine falaan se nikaah kiya, aur ek kaali khaatoon aayi aur mujhse kaha, "Maine tum dono ko doodh pilaaya hai," magar mujhe lagta hai wo jhoot bol rahi hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne mujhse apna chehra pher liya, aur main unke chehre ki taraf ghooma aur kaha, 'Wo jhoot bol rahi hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, '(Tum use apni biwi kaise rakh sakte ho) jabke us khaatoon ne kaha hai ke usne tum dono ko doodh pilaaya hai? Isliye use (apni biwi ko) chhod do (talaaq de do).'

e: Ibn 'Abbas further said, "Seven types of marriages are unlawful because of blood relations, and seven because of marriage relations." Then Ibn 'Abbas recited the Verse:"Forbidden for you (for marriages) are your mothers..." (4:23). 'Abdullah bin Ja'far married the daughter and wife of 'Ali at the same time (they were step-daughter and mother). Ibn Sirin said, "There is no harm in that." But Al-Hasan Al-Basri disapproved of it at first, but then said that there was no harm in it. Al-Hasan bin Al-Hasan bin 'Ali married two of his cousins in one night. Ja'far bin Zaid disapproved of that because of it would bring hatred (between the two cousins), but it is not unlawful, as Allah said, "Lawful to you are all others [beyond those (mentioned)]. (4:24). Ibn 'Abbas said: "If somebody commits illegal sexual intercourse with his wife's sister, his wife does not become unlawful for him." And narrated Abu Ja'far, "If a person commits homosexuality with a boy, then the mother of that boy is unlawful for him to marry." Narrated Ibn 'Abbas, "If one commits illegal sexual intercourse with his mother in law, then his married relation to his wife does not become unlawful." Abu Nasr reported to have said that Ibn 'Abbas in the above case, regarded his marital relation to his wife unlawful, but Abu Nasr is not known well for hearing Hadith from Ibn 'Abbas. Imran bin Hussain, Jabir b. Zaid, Al-Hasan and some other Iraqi's, are reported to have judged that his marital relations to his wife would be unlawful. In the above case Abu Hurairah said, "The marital relation to one's wife does not become unlawful except if one as had sexual intercourse (with her mother)." Ibn Al-Musaiyab, 'Urwa, and Az-Zuhri allows such person to keep his wife. 'Ali said, "His marital relations to his wife does not become unlawful
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne aage kaha, 'Khoon ke rishton ki wajah se saat qism ke nikaah haraam hain, aur nikaah ke rishton ki wajah se saat aur.' Phir Ibn Abbas ne ye Aayat padhi: 'Tumhaare liye haraam hain (nikaah ke liye) tumhaari maayein...' (4:23) Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ja'far ne ek hi waqt mein Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki beti aur biwi se nikaah kiya (jo saudari beti aur (pehli biwi ki) maa thin). Ibn Sirin ne kaha, 'Isme koi harj nahi.' Magar Al-Hasan Al-Basri ne pehle isse napasand kiya, phir kaha ke isme koi harj nahi. Al-Hasan bin Al-Hasan bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne ek hi raat mein apne do chachazaad bahno se nikaah kiya. Ja'far bin Zaid ne isse napasand kiya kyunke isse (donon behno ke beech) dushmani paida ho sakti thi, magar ye haraam nahi, jaisa Allah ne farmaya, 'In (zikr ki gayi auraton) ke ilaawa sab (auraten) tumhaare liye halaal hain.' (4:24) Ibn Abbas ne kaha, 'Agar koi apni biwi ki behen ke saath zina kare, to uski biwi uske liye haraam nahi hoti.' Aur Abu Ja'far ne riwayat ki, 'Agar koi kisi ladke ke saath samlaingikta kare, to us ladke ki maa se nikaah karna uske liye haraam ho jaata hai.' Ibn Abbas ne kaha, 'Agar koi apni saas ke saath zina kare, to uska apni biwi se nikaahi rishta haraam nahi hota.' Abu Nasr ke mutaabik Ibn Abbas ne is soorat mein biwi se nikaahi rishta haraam maana, magar Abu Nasr ka Ibn Abbas se hadees sunna zyaada maroof nahi hai. Imran bin Husain (رضی اللہ عنہ), Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Zaid, Al-Hasan aur kuch Iraqi ulama ne is soorat mein biwi se nikaahi rishta haraam maana. Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Biwi se nikaahi rishta tab tak haraam nahi hota jab tak (uski maa ke saath) sambhog (jinsi talluq) na ho.' Ibn Al-Musaiyab, Urwa aur Az-Zuhri aise shaks ko apni biwi rakhne ki ijaazat dete hain. Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha, 'Uska biwi se nikaahi rishta haraam nahi hota.'

e: Narrated Um Habiba:I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Do you like to have (my sister) the daughter of Abu Sufyan?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "What shall I do (with her)?" I said, "Marry her." He said, "Do you like that?" I said, "(Yes), for even now I am not your only wife, so I like that my sister should share you with me." He said, "She is not lawful for me (to marry)." I said, "We have heard that you want to marry." He said, "The daughter of Um Salama?" I said, "Yes." He said, "Even if she were not my stepdaughter, she should be unlawful for me to marry, for Thuwaiba suckled me and her father (Abu Salama). So you should neither present your daughters, nor your sisters, to me
hi: Umm Habiba (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya aap chaahenge ke (meri behen) Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki beti aapke paas ho?' Nabi (SAW) ne pucha, 'Main unke saath kya karoon?' Maine kaha, 'Unse nikaah kar lijiye.' Unhone pucha, 'Kya tumhein ye pasand hai?' Maine kaha, '(Haan), kyunke abhi bhi main aapki akeli biwi nahi hoon, isliye mujhe pasand hai ke meri behen aapko mere saath baante.' Unhone farmaya, 'Wo mere liye jaayez nahi (nikaah ke liye).' Maine kaha, 'Humein pata chala hai ke aap nikaah karna chahte hain.' Unhone pucha, 'Umm Salama ki beti se?' Maine kaha, 'Haan.' Unhone farmaya, 'Agar wo meri saudari beti bhi na hoti, to bhi wo mere liye haraam honi chaahiye, kyunke Thuwaiba ne mujhe aur unke waalid (Abu Salama) ko doodh pilaaya tha. Isliye tumhein na apni betiyaan aur na apni behnein mere saamne peshkash karni chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Um Habiba:I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Marry my sister, the daughter of Abu Sufyan." He said, "Do you like that?" I said, "Yes, for even now I am not your only wife; and the most beloved person to share the good with me is my sister." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "But that is not lawful for me (i.e., to be married to two sisters at a time.)" I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! By Allah, we have heard that you want to marry Durra, the daughter of Abu Salama." He said, "You mean the daughter of Um Salama?" I said, "Yes." He said, "By Allah ! Even if she were not my stepdaughter, she would not be lawful for me to marry, for she is my foster niece, for Thuwaiba has suckled me and Abu Salama; so you should neither present your daughters, nor your sisters to me
hi: Umm Habiba (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Meri behen, Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki beti, se nikaah kar lijiye.' Unhone pucha, 'Kya tumhein ye pasand hai?' Maine kaha, 'Haan, kyunke abhi bhi main aapki akeli biwi nahi hoon, aur mujhe sabse zyaada aziz cheez ye hai ke meri behen mere saath bhalaai mein shareek ho.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Magar ye mere liye jaayez nahi (yaani ek waqt mein do behno se nikaah).' Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Allah ki qasam, humein pata chala hai ke aap Durra, Abu Salama ki beti, se nikaah karna chahte hain.' Unhone pucha, '(Kya tumhaara matlab hai) Umm Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) ki beti?' Maine kaha, 'Haan.' Unhone farmaya, 'Allah ki qasam! Agar wo meri saudari beti bhi na hoti, to bhi wo mere liye jaayez na hoti, kyunke wo meri doodh-rishte ki bhatiji hai, kyunke Thuwaiba ne mujhe aur Abu Salama ko doodh pilaaya tha; isliye tumhein apni betiyaan ya behnein mere saamne pesh nahi karni chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Jabir:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade that a woman should be married to man along with her paternal or maternal aunt
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mana kiya ke ek aurat ka nikaah usi mard se ho jiske nikaah mein uski chachi (baap ki behen) ya khaala (maa ki behen) pehle se ho.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "A woman and her paternal aunt should not be married to the same man; and similarly, a woman and her maternal aunt should not be married to the same man
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ek aurat aur uski chachi ka nikaah ek hi mard se nahi hona chaahiye; isi tarah ek aurat aur uski khaala ka nikaah bhi ek hi mard se nahi hona chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade that a woman should be married to a man along with her paternal aunt or with her maternal aunt (at the same time). Az-Zuhri (the sub-narrator) said: There is a similar order for the paternal aunt of the father of one's wife, for 'Urwa told me that `Aisha said, "What is unlawful because of blood relations, is also unlawful because of the corresponding foster suckling relations
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne mana kiya ke ek aurat ka nikaah usi mard se ho jiske nikaah mein uski chachi ya khaala (ek hi waqt mein) ho. Az-Zuhri (ravi) kehte hain: Isi tarah ka hukm biwi ke waalid ki chachi ke baare mein bhi hai, kyunke Urwa ne mujhe bataaya ke Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha, 'Jo khoon ke rishte ki wajah se haraam hai, wo doodh-piyaai ke usi tarah ke rishte ki wajah se bhi haraam hai.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade Ash-Shighar, which means that somebody marries his daughter to somebody else, and the latter marries his daughter to the former without paying Mahr
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ash-Shighar se mana kiya, jiska matlab hai ke koi apni beti ka nikaah kisi doosre se kare, aur wo doosra apni beti ka nikaah pehle se kare, bagair Mahr adaa kiye.

e: Narrated Hisham's father:Khaula bint Hakim was one of those ladies who presented themselves to the Prophet (ﷺ) for marriage. `Aisha said, "Doesn't a lady feel ashamed for presenting herself to a man?" But when the Verse: "(O Muhammad) You may postpone (the turn of) any of them (your wives) that you please,' (33.51) was revealed, " `Aisha said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I do not see, but, that your Lord hurries in pleasing you
hi: Hisham ke waalid bataate hain: Khaula bint Hakim un khawaateen mein se thi jinhone Nabi (SAW) ko nikaah ke liye khud pesh kiya. Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha, 'Kya kisi aurat ko khud ko kisi mard ke saamne pesh karte hue sharm nahi aati?' Magar jab ye Aayat naazil hui, '(Aye Muhammad) aap chaahein to inmein se jiski chaho baari peeche daalein...' (33:51), Aisha ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe to yahi lagta hai ke aapka Rab aapki pasand ko poora karne mein jaldi karta hai.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) got married while he was in the state of Ihram
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne Ihram ki haalat mein nikaah kiya.

e: Narrated `Ali:I said to Ibn `Abbas, "During the battle of Khaibar the Prophet (ﷺ) forbade (Nikah) Al-Mut'a and the eating of donkey's meat
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Maine Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kaha, 'Jang-e-Khaibar ke dauraan, Nabi (SAW) ne Mut'a (waqti nikaah) aur gadhe ka gosht khaane se mana kiya tha.'

e: Narrated Abu Jamra:I heard Ibn `Abbas (giving a verdict) when he was asked about the Mut'a with the women, and he permitted it (Nikah-al-Mut'a). On that a freed slave of his said to him, "That is only when it is very badly needed and women are scarce." On that, Ibn `Abbas said, "Yes
hi: Abu Jamra bataate hain: Maine Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko (fatwa dete) suna jab unse Mut'a (waqti nikaah) ke baare mein pucha gaya, aur unhone ise ijaazat di. Isper unke ek azaad kiye ghulaam ne unse kaha, 'Ye sirf tab hai jab sakht zaroorat ho aur auraten kam hon.' Ibn Abbas ne kaha, 'Haan.'

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah and Salama bin Al-Akwa`:While we were in an army, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to us and said, "You have been allowed to do the Mut'a (marriage), so do it
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Salama bin Al-Akwa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab hum ek fauj mein the, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) humaare paas aaye aur kaha, 'Tumhein Mut'a (waqti nikaah) karne ki ijaazat di gayi hai, isliye ye karo.'

e: Salama bin Al-Akwa` said:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If a man and a woman agree (to marry temporarily), their marriage should last for three nights, and if they like to continue, they can do so; and if they want to separate, they can do so." I do not know whether that was only for us or for all the people in general. Abu `Abdullah (Al-Bukhari) said: `Ali made it clear that the Prophet said, "The Mut'a marriage has been cancelled (made unlawful)
hi: Salama bin Al-Akwa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar koi mard aur aurat (waqti nikaah karne par) razi ho jaayein, to unka nikaah teen raaton tak rahega, aur agar wo jaari rakhna chaahein to rakh sakte hain, aur agar alag hona chaahein to ho sakte hain.' Mujhe nahi pata ke ye sirf humaare liye tha ya sab logon ke liye aam taur par. Abu Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) (Al-Bukhari) kehte hain: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne saaf kiya ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Mut'a nikaah ab mansookh (haraam) kar diya gaya hai.'

e: Narrated Thabit Al-Banani:I was with Anas while his daughter was present with him. Anas said, "A woman came to Allah's Apostle and presented herself to him, saying, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), have you any need for me (i.e. would you like to marry me)?' "Thereupon Anas's daughter said, "What a shameless lady she was ! Shame! Shame!" Anas said, "She was better than you; she had a liking for the Prophet (ﷺ) so she presented herself for marriage to him
hi: Thabit Al-Banani bataate hain: Main Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath tha jab unki beti bhi wahaan maujood thi. Anas ne kaha, 'Ek aurat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur khud ko pesh kiya, kaha, "Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya aapko meri zaroorat hai (yaani aap mujhse nikaah karenge)?"' Isper Anas ki beti ne kaha, 'Wo kitni be-hayaa aurat thi! Sharm, sharm!' Anas ne kaha, 'Wo tumse behtar thi; usse Nabi (SAW) ke liye pasandeedgi thi, isliye usne khud ko unhein nikaah ke liye pesh kiya.'

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:A woman presented herself to the Prophet (for marriage). A man said to him, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! (If you are not in need of her) marry her to me." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "What have you got?" The man said, "I have nothing." The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to him), "Go and search for something) even if it were an iron ring." The man went and returned saying, "No, I have not found anything, not even an iron ring; but this is my (Izar) waist sheet, and half of it is for her." He had no Rida' (upper garment). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "What will she do with your waist sheet? If you wear it, she will have nothing over her; and if she wears it, you will have nothing over you." So the man sat down and when he had sat a long time, he got up (to leave). When the Prophet (ﷺ) saw him (leaving), he called him back, or the man was called (for him), and he said to the man, "How much of the Qur'an do you know (by heart)?" The man replied I know such Sura and such Sura (by heart)," naming the Suras The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I have married her to you for what you know of the Qur'an
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek aurat ne khud ko Nabi (SAW) ko (nikaah ke liye) pesh kiya. Ek shaks ne unse kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! (Agar aapko unki zaroorat nahi) to unka nikaah mujhse kar dijiye.' Nabi (SAW) ne pucha, 'Tumhaare paas kya hai?' Us shaks ne kaha, 'Mere paas kuch nahi hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne (usse) kaha, 'Jaao aur kuch dhoondho, chaahe wo loha ki ek anguthi hi ho.' Wo aadmi gaya aur wapas aakar kaha, 'Nahi, mujhe kuch nahi mila, loha ki anguthi bhi nahi, magar ye meri (Izar) kamar ki chaadar hai, iska aadha unke liye hai.' Uske paas Rida (upar ka kapda) nahi tha. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Wo tumhaari kamar ki chaadar ka kya karegi? Agar tum ise pehno, to unke badan par kuch nahi hoga, aur agar wo ise pehne, to tumhaare badan par kuch nahi hoga.' To wo aadmi baith gaya, aur kaafi der baithne ke baad, wo uthaa (jaane ke liye). Jab Nabi (SAW) ne use (jaate) dekha, to unhone use wapas bulaaya, ya use bulaaya gaya, aur unhone us aadmi se kaha, 'Tumhein Quran mein se kitna (zabaani) yaad hai?' Us aadmi ne jawab diya, 'Mujhe falaan Surah aur falaan Surah (zabaani) yaad hai,' Surahon ke naam lete hue. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Maine unka nikaah tumse us Quran ke badle kar diya jo tumhein yaad hai.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:`Umar bin Al-Khattab said, "When Hafsa bint `Umar became a widow after the death of (her husband) Khunais bin Hudhafa As-Sahmi who had been one of the companions of the Prophet, and he died at Medina. I went to `Uthman bin `Affan and presented Hafsa (for marriage) to him. He said, "I will think it over.' I waited for a few days, then he met me and said, 'It seems that it is not possible for me to marry at present.' " `Umar further said, "I met Abu Bakr As-Siddique and said to him, 'If you wish, I will marry my daughter Hafsa to you." Abu Bakr kept quiet and did not say anything to me in reply. I became more angry with him than with `Uthman. I waited for a few days and then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked for her hand, and I gave her in marriage to him. Afterwards I met Abu Bakr who said, 'Perhaps you became angry with me when you presented Hafsa to me and I did not give you a reply?' I said, 'Yes.' Abu Bakr said, 'Nothing stopped me to respond to your offer except that I knew that Allah's Apostle had mentioned her, and I never wanted to let out the secret of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). And if Allah's Apostle had refused her, I would have accepted her
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Umar bin Al-Khattab ne kaha, 'Jab Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Umar apne shohar Khunais bin Hudhafa As-Sahmi, jo Nabi (SAW) ke sahaabi the, ki maut ke baad biwaa ho gayi - unka intekaal Madina mein hua tha - main Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Affan ke paas gaya aur unhein Hafsa ka rishta pesh kiya. Unhone kaha, "Main isper socha karunga." Maine kuch dinon intezaar kiya, phir wo mujhse mile aur kaha, "Mujhe lagta hai ke abhi mera nikaah karna mumkin nahi hai." Umar ne aage kaha, "Main Abu Bakr As-Siddique se mila aur unse kaha, 'Agar aap chaahein, to main apni beti Hafsa ka nikaah aapse kar doon.' Abu Bakr khaamosh rahe aur mujhe koi jawab nahi diya. Main unse Uthman se zyaada naaraaz ho gaya. Maine kuch dinon intezaar kiya, phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unka rishta maanga aur maine unka nikaah unse kar diya. Baad mein main Abu Bakr se mila, jinhone kaha, 'Shaayad aap mujhse naaraaz ho gaye the jab aapne Hafsa ka rishta mujhe diya aur maine aapko jawab nahi diya?' Maine kaha, 'Haan.' Abu Bakr ne kaha, 'Mujhe aapke prastaav ka jawab dene se sirf isliye roka kyunke mujhe pata tha ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unka zikr kiya hai, aur main kabhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka raaz zaahir nahi karna chahta tha. Aur agar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unhein qubool na karte, to main unhein qubool kar leta.'"'

e: Narrated Zainab bint Salama:Um Habiba said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) "We have heard that you want to marry Durra bint Abu-Salama." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Can she be married along with Um Salama (her mother)? Even if I have not married Um Salama, she would not be lawful for me to marry, for her father is my foster brother
hi: Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Salama bataati hain: Umm Habiba (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kaha, 'Humein pata chala hai ke aap Durra bint Abu Salama se nikaah karna chahte hain.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kya unka nikaah Umm Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) (unki maa) ke saath (ek waqt mein) ho sakta hai? Agar main Umm Salama se nikaah na bhi karta, to bhi wo mere liye jaayez nahi hoti, kyunke unke waalid mere doodh-rishte ke bhai hain.'

e: Ibn `Abbas said: "Hint your intention of marrying' is made by saying (to the widow) for example: "I want to marry, and I wish that Allah will make a righteous lady available for me.' " Al-Qasim said: One may say to the widow: 'I hold all respect for you, and I am interested in you; Allah will bring you much good, or something similar 'Ata said: One should hint his intention, and should not declare it openly. One may say: 'I have some need. Have good tidings. Praise be to Allah; you are fit to remarry.' She (the widow) may say in reply: I am listening to what you say,' but she should not make a promise. Her guardian should not make a promise (to somebody to get her married to him) without her knowledge. But if, while still in the Iddat period, she makes a promise to marry somebody, and he ultimately marries her, they are not to be separated by divorce (i.e., the marriage is valid)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: 'Nikaah ka iraada ishare mein zaahir karna' iska matlab hai (biwaa se) kehna, jaise: 'Main nikaah karna chahta hoon, aur ummeed rakhta hoon ke Allah mere liye ek neik aurat muhaiya karega.' Al-Qasim ne kaha: Koi biwaa se keh sakta hai: 'Main aapki bahut izzat karta hoon, aur aapme dilchaspi rakhta hoon; Allah aapko bahut bhalaai dega,' ya isi tarah ki koi baat. Ata ne kaha: Insaan ko apna iraada ishare mein zaahir karna chaahiye, khule aam nahi. Koi keh sakta hai: 'Mujhe kuch zaroorat hai. Khush-khabri ho. Allah ka shukr hai, aap dobara nikaah karne ke laayak hain.' Wo (biwaa) jawab mein keh sakti hai, 'Main sun rahi hoon aap kya keh rahe hain,' magar use koi waada nahi karna chaahiye. Uske sarparast ko bhi (kisi se) uski marzi ke bagair koi waada nahi karna chaahiye. Magar agar wo Iddat ke dauraan hi kisi se nikaah ka waada kar de, aur wo aakhir mein usse nikaah kar le, to unhein talaaq dekar alag nahi kiya jaayega (yaani nikaah jaayez hoga).

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said (to me), "You were shown to me in a dream. An angel brought you to me, wrapped in a piece of silken cloth, and said to me, 'This is your wife.' I removed the piece of cloth from your face, and there you were. I said to myself. 'If it is from Allah, then it will surely be
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (mujhse) farmaya, 'Tumhein mujhe khwaab mein dikhaaya gaya. Ek Farishta tumhein resham ke ek kapde mein lapetkar mere paas laaya aur mujhse kaha, "Ye aapki biwi hai." Maine tumhaare chehre se wo kapda hataya, aur wahaan tum thi. Maine apne dil mein kaha, "Agar ye Allah ki taraf se hai, to ye zaroor sach hoga."'

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:A woman came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have come to you to present myself to you (for marriage)." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) glanced at her. He looked at her carefully and fixed his glance on her and then lowered his head. When the lady saw that he did not say anything, she sat down. A man from his companions got up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! If you are not in need of her, then marry her to me." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Have you got anything to offer." The man said, 'No, by Allah, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to him), "Go to your family and try to find something." So the man went and returned, saying, "No, by Allah, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have not found anything." The Prophet said, "Go again and look for something, even if it were an iron ring." He went and returned, saying, "No, by Allah, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I could not find even an iron ring, but this is my Izar (waist sheet).' He had no Rida (upper garment). He added, "I give half of it to her." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said "What will she do with your Izar? If you wear it, she will have nothing over herself thereof (will be naked); and if she wears it, then you will have nothing over yourself thereof ' So the man sat for a long period and then got up (to leave). When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw him leaving, he ordered that he e called back. When he came, the Prophet (ﷺ) asked (him), "How much of the Qur'an do you know (by heart)?" The man replied, I know such Sura and such Sura and such Sura," naming the suras. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Can you recite it by heart?" He said, 'Yes." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Go I let you marry her for what you know of the Qur'an (as her Mahr)
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek aurat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Main aapke paas khud ko (nikaah ke liye) pesh karne aayi hoon.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unki taraf dekha, ghor se dekha aur apni nazar unpar jamaa di, phir apna sar jhuka liya. Jab khaatoon ne dekha ke unhone kuch nahi kaha, to wo baith gayi. Unke sahaaba mein se ek shaks khade hue aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Agar aapko unki zaroorat nahi, to unka nikaah mujhse kar dijiye.' Nabi (SAW) ne pucha, 'Kya tumhaare paas dene ke liye kuch hai?' Us aadmi ne kaha, 'Nahi, Allah ki qasam, Aye Allah ke Rasool!' Nabi (SAW) ne (usse) kaha, 'Apne ghar jaao aur kuch dhoondhne ki koshish karo.' To wo aadmi gaya aur wapas aakar kaha, 'Nahi, Allah ki qasam, Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe kuch nahi mila.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Dobara jaao aur kuch dhoondho, chaahe wo loha ki ek anguthi hi ho.' Wo gaya aur wapas aakar kaha, 'Nahi, Allah ki qasam, Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe loha ki anguthi bhi nahi mili, magar ye meri Izar (kamar ki chaadar) hai.' Uske paas Rida (upar ka kapda) nahi tha. Usne kaha, 'Main isse aadhi unhein de deta hoon.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Wo tumhaari Izar ka kya karegi? Agar tum ise pehno, to unke badan par kuch nahi hoga (wo nangi rahegi), aur agar wo ise pehne, to tumhaare badan par kuch nahi hoga.' To wo aadmi kaafi der tak baitha raha, phir uthaa (jaane ke liye). Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne use jaate dekha, to unhone use wapas bulaane ka hukm diya. Jab wo aaya, Nabi (SAW) ne (usse) pucha, 'Tumhein Quran mein se kitna yaad hai?' Us aadmi ne jawab diya, 'Mujhe falaan Surah, falaan Surah aur falaan Surah yaad hai,' Surahon ke naam lete hue. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jaao, maine unka nikaah tumse us Quran (Mahr) ke badle kar diya jo tumhein zabaani yaad hai.'

e: Narrated 'Urwa bin Az-Zubair: 'Aishah, the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ) told him that there were four types of marriage during Pre-Islamic period of Ignorance. One type was similar to that of the present day i.e. a man used to ask somebody else for the hand of a girl under his guardianship or for his daughter's hand, and give her Mahr and then marry her. The second type was that a man would say to his wife after she had become clean from her period. "Send for so-and-so and have sexual intercourse with him." Her husband would then keep away from her and would never sleep with her till she got pregnant from the other man with whom she was sleeping. When her pregnancy became evident, he husband would sleep with her if he wished. Her husband did so (i.e. let his wife sleep with some other man) so that he might have a child of noble breed. Such marriage was called as Al-Istibda'. Another type of marriage was that a group of less than ten men would assemble and enter upon a woman, and all of them would have sexual relation with her. If she became pregnant and delivered a child and some days had passed after delivery, she would sent for all of them and none of them would refuse to come, and when they all gathered before her, she would say to them, "You (all) know waht you have done, and now I have given birth to a child. So, it is your child so-and-so!" naming whoever she liked, and her child would follow him and he could not refuse to take him. The fourth type of marriage was that many people would enter upon a lady and she would never refuse anyone who came to her. Those were the prostitutes who used to fix flags at their doors as sign, and he who would wished, could have sexual intercourse with them. If anyone of them got pregnant and delivered a child, then all those men would be gathered for her and they would call the Qa'if (persons skilled in recognizing the likeness of a child to his father) to them and would let the child follow the man (whom they recognized as his father) and she would let him adhere to him and be called his son. The man would not refuse all that. But when Muhammad (ﷺ) was sent with the Truth, he abolished all the types of marriages observed in pre-Islamic period of Ignorance except the type of marriage the people recognize today
hi: Urwa bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا), Nabi (SAW) ki zawja, ne unhein bataaya ke jaahiliyat ke daur mein nikaah ke chaar tarike the. Pehla tareeka aaj ke jaisa hi tha - ek aadmi kisi doosre se uski nigraani mein ladki ya uski beti ka rishta maangta, use Mahr deta aur phir usse nikaah karta. Doosra tareeka ye tha ke ek aadmi apni biwi se, uske haiz se paak hone ke baad, kehta, "Falaan ke paas jaao aur uske saath humbistari karo." Uska shohar phir usse door rehta aur usse tab tak nahi sota jab tak wo us doosre aadmi se hamila na ho jaaye jiske saath wo so rahi thi. Jab uska hamal zaahir ho jaata, uska shohar chaahe to usse phir se sota. Wo aisa isliye karta taake use ek shareef nasal ka bacha mil sake. Aisa nikaah 'Al-Istibda' kehlaata tha. Nikaah ka ek aur tareeka ye tha ke das se kam mardon ka ek giroh ikattha hokar ek aurat ke paas jaata, aur wo sab uske saath jinsi rishta rakhte. Agar wo hamila ho jaati aur bacha paidaish deti, aur kuch din guzarne ke baad wo un sab logon ko bulwaati, aur unmein se koi bhi aane se inkaar nahi karta, aur jab sab uske saamne jama ho jaate, to wo unse kehti, 'Tum (sab) jaante ho tumne kya kiya, aur ab maine bacha paidaish diya hai. To ye tumhaara bacha hai, falaan!' jiska bhi naam wo lena chaahti, aur uska bacha usi ke naam se jaana jaata aur wo usse inkaar nahi kar sakta tha. Chautha tareeka ye tha ke bahut se log ek aurat ke paas jaate aur wo kisi ko bhi mana nahi karti thi. Ye wahi randiya thin jo apne darwaazon par nishaan ke taur par jhande lagaati thin, aur jo bhi chaahta unke saath jinsi rishta rakh sakta tha. Agar unmein se koi hamila ho jaati aur bacha paidaish deti, to un sab mardon ko uske paas bulaaya jaata aur Qaaif (bachche ki shakl se uske baap ko pehchaanne mein maahir log) ko bulaaya jaata, aur bache ko usi shaks se jodha jaata (jise wo baap maante), aur wo aurat use usi ke saath rehne deti aur use uska beta kehlaati. Wo aadmi isse inkaar nahi karta. Magar jab Muhammad (SAW) ko haq ke saath bheja gaya, unhone jaahiliyat ke daur ke ye sab nikaah ke tareeke khatam kar diye, siwaaye us tareeke ke jo aaj log jaante hain.

e: Narrated `Aisha:(as regards the Verse): 'And about what is recited unto you in the Book, concerning orphan girls to whom you give not the prescribed portions and yet, whom you desire to marry.' (4.127) This Verse is about the female orphan who is under the guardianship of a man with whom she shares her property and he has more right over her (than anybody else) but does not like to marry her, so he prevents her, from marrying somebody else, lest he should share the property with him
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) is Aayat ke baare mein bataati hain: 'Aur jo tumhein Kitaab mein padha jaata hai yateem ladkiyon ke baare mein jinhein tum unka muqarrar hissa nahi dete phir bhi jinse tum nikaah karna chahte ho...' (4:127) Ye us yateem ladki ke baare mein hai jo ek aise aadmi ki nigraani mein hoti hai jiske saath wo apni jaayadaad saanjha karti hai aur usse zyaada haq rakhta hai (kisi aur se), magar use nikaah karna pasand nahi karta, isliye use kisi aur se nikaah karne se rokta hai, kahin wo jaayadaad mein saanjhedaar na ban jaaye.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:When Hafsa, `Umar's daughter became a widow because of the death of her (husband) Ibn Hudhafa As-Sahmi who was one of the companion of the Prophet (ﷺ) and the one of the Badr warriors and died at Medina, `Umar said, "I met `Uthman bin `Affan and gave him an offer, saying, 'If you wish, I will marry Hafsa to you.' He said. 'I will think it over' I waited for a few days, then he met me and said, 'I have made up my mind not to marry at present' "`Umar added, "Then I met Abu Bakr and said to him, 'If you wish, I will marry Hafsa to you
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا), Umar ki beti, apne shohar Ibn Hudhafa As-Sahmi, jo Nabi (SAW) ke sahaabi aur Badr ke jaanbaaz the aur Madina mein jinka intekaal hua, ki maut ke baad biwaa ho gayi, Umar ne kaha, 'Main Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Affan se mila aur unhein ye pesh kiya, "Agar aap chaahein, to main Hafsa ka nikaah aapse kar doon." Unhone kaha, "Main isper socha karunga." Maine kuch dinon intezaar kiya, phir wo mujhse mile aur kaha, "Maine faisla kiya hai ke abhi nikaah nahi karunga."' Umar ne aage kaha, 'Phir main Abu Bakr se mila aur unse kaha, "Agar aap chaahein, to main Hafsa ka nikaah aapse kar doon."'

e: Narrated Al-Hasan:concerning the Verse: 'Do not prevent them' (2.232) Ma'qil bin Yasar told me that it was revealed in his connection. He said, "I married my sister to a man and he divorced her, and when her days of 'Idda (three menstrual periods) were over, the man came again and asked for her hand, but I said to him, 'I married her to you and made her your bed (your wife) and favored you with her, but you divorced her. Now you come to ask for her hand again? No, by Allah, she will never go back to you (again)!' That man was not a bad man and his wife wanted to go back to him. So Allah revealed this Verse: 'Do not prevent them.' (2.232) So I said, 'Now I will do it (let her go back to him), O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)."So he married her to him again
hi: Al-Hasan is Aayat ke baare mein bataate hain: 'Unhein rokoo mat...' (2:232) Ma'qil bin Yasar ne mujhe bataaya ke ye unke silsile mein naazil hui thi. Unhone kaha, 'Maine apni behen ka nikaah ek aadmi se karwaaya, aur usne use talaaq de di. Jab uski Iddat (teen haiz ki muddat) poori ho gayi, wo aadmi dobara aaya aur uska rishta maanga, magar maine usse kaha, "Maine tumhaari shaadi usse karwaayi aur use tumhaari biwi banaaya aur tumhein usse nawaaza, magar tumne use talaaq de di. Ab tum dobara uska rishta maangne aaye ho? Nahi, Allah ki qasam, wo tumhaare paas kabhi wapas nahi jaayegi!" Wo aadmi bura aadmi nahi tha, aur uski (pehli) biwi bhi usse wapas jaana chaahti thi. To Allah ne ye Aayat naazil ki: "Unhein rokoo mat." (2:232) Isper maine kaha, "Ab main aisa hi karunga (use wapas jaane doonga), Aye Allah ke Rasool!" To unhone dobara uska nikaah usse karwaa diya.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:(regarding His Statement): 'They ask your instruction concerning the women. Say: Allah instructs you about them ...' (4.127) It is about the female orphan who is under the guardianship of a man with whom she shares her property and he does not want to marry her and dislikes that someone else should marry her, lest he should share the property with him, so he prevents her from marrying. So Allah forbade such a guardian to do so (i.e. to prevent her from marrying)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) Allah ke is farmaan ke baare mein bataati hain: 'Wo aapse auraton ke baare mein hukm poochte hain. Kaho: Allah tumhein unke baare mein hukm deta hai...' (4:127) Ye us yateem ladki ke baare mein hai jo ek aise aadmi ki nigraani mein hoti hai jiske saath wo apni jaayadaad saanjha karti hai, aur wo use nikaah karna nahi chaahta aur ye bhi napasand karta hai ke koi aur usse nikaah kare, kahin wo jaayadaad mein saanjhedaar na ban jaaye, isliye wo use nikaah karne se rokta hai. To Allah ne aise sarparast ko aisa karne se mana kiya.

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:While we were sitting in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) a woman came to him and presented herself (for marriage) to him. The Prophet (ﷺ) looked at her, lowering his eyes and raising them, but did not give a reply. One of his companions said, "Marry her to me O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" The Prophet (ﷺ) asked (him), "Have you got anything?" He said, "I have got nothing." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Not even an iron ring?" He Sa`d, "Not even an iron ring, but I will tear my garment into two halves and give her one half and keep the other half." The Prophet; said, "No. Do you know some of the Qur'an (by heart)?" He said, "Yes." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Go, I have agreed to marry her to you with what you know of the Qur'an (as her Mahr)
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab hum Nabi (SAW) ki majlis mein baithe the, ek aurat unke paas aayi aur khud ko (nikaah ke liye) pesh kiya. Nabi (SAW) ne unki taraf dekha, apni nazar neechi aur ooper ki, magar koi jawab nahi diya. Unke ek sahaabi ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Unka nikaah mujhse kar dijiye!' Nabi (SAW) ne (usse) pucha, 'Kya tumhaare paas kuch hai?' Usne kaha, 'Mere paas kuch nahi hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne pucha, 'Loha ki anguthi bhi nahi?' Usne kaha, 'Loha ki anguthi bhi nahi, magar main apna kapda do hisson mein phaad kar ek hissa unhein doonga aur doosra apne paas rakhunga.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Nahi. Kya tumhein Quran mein se kuch (zabaani) yaad hai?' Usne kaha, 'Haan.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jaao, maine unka nikaah tumse us Quran (Mahr) ke badle karne ki manzoori de di jo tumhein yaad hai.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:that the Prophet (ﷺ) married her when she was six years old and he consummated his marriage when she was nine years old, and then she remained with him for nine years (i.e., till his death)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ne unse un chhe saal ki umar mein nikaah kiya aur nau saal ki umar mein rukhsati ki, aur wo unke saath nau saal (unki wafat tak) rahi.

e: Narrated `Aisha:that the Prophet (ﷺ) married her when she was six years old and he consummated his marriage when she was nine years old. Hisham said: I have been informed that `Aisha remained with the Prophet (ﷺ) for nine years (i.e. till his death)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ne unse chhe saal ki umar mein nikaah kiya aur nau saal ki umar mein rukhsati ki. Ravi Hisham kehte hain: Mujhe bataya gaya hai ke Aisha Nabi (SAW) ke saath nau saal (unki wafat tak) rahi.

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:A woman came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "I present myself (to you) (for marriage). She stayed for a long while, then a man said, "If you are not in need of her then marry her to me." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Have you got anything m order to pay her Mahr?" He said, "I have nothing with me except my Izar (waist sheet)." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If you give her your Izar, you will have no Izar to wear, (so go) and search for something. He said, "I could not find anything." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Try (to find something), even if it were an iron ring But he was not able to find (even that) The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to him). "Do you memorize something of the Qur'an?" "Yes. ' he said, "such Sura and such Sura," naming those Suras The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "We have married her to you for what you know of the Qur'an (by heart)
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek aurat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha, 'Main khud ko (aapko nikaah ke liye) pesh karti hoon.' Wo kaafi der wahaan rahi, phir ek aadmi ne kaha, 'Agar aapko unki zaroorat nahi, to unka nikaah mujhse kar dijiye.' Nabi (SAW) ne pucha, 'Kya tumhaare paas unhein Mahr dene ke liye kuch hai?' Usne kaha, 'Mere paas apni Izar (kamar ki chaadar) ke siwa kuch nahi hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar tum unhein apni Izar do, to tumhaare paas pehanne ko koi Izar nahi bachegi, (isliye jao) aur kuch aur dhoondho.' Usne kaha, 'Mujhe kuch nahi mila.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kuch aur dhoondhne ki koshish karo, chaahe wo loha ki ek anguthi hi ho.' Magar wo (wo bhi) nahi paa saka. Nabi (SAW) ne (usse) pucha, 'Kya tumhein Quran mein se kuch (zabaani) yaad hai?' Usne kaha, 'Haan, falaan Surah aur falaan Surah,' un Surahon ke naam lete hue. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Humne unka nikaah tumse us Quran ke badle kar diya jo tumhein zabaani yaad hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A matron should not be given in marriage except after consulting her; and a virgin should not be given in marriage except after her permission." The people asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! How can we know her permission?" He said, "Her silence (indicates her permission)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ek biwaa ka nikaah tab tak nahi hona chaahiye jab tak uski raay na li jaaye; aur ek kunwaari ka nikaah tab tak nahi hona chaahiye jab tak uski ijaazat na li jaaye.' Logon ne pucha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Humein uski ijaazat ka kaise pata chalega?' Unhone farmaya, 'Uski khaamoshi (uski ijaazat zaahir karti hai).'

e: Narrated `Aisha:I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! A virgin feels shy." He said, "Her consent is (expressed by) her silence
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Ek kunwaari ladki sharmaati hai.' Unhone farmaya, 'Uska raazi hona uski khaamoshi se zaahir hota hai.'

e: Narrated Khansa bint Khidam Al-Ansariya:that her father gave her in marriage when she was a matron and she disliked that marriage. So she went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he declared that marriage invalid
hi: Khansa bint Khidam Al-Ansariya bataati hain: Unke waalid ne unka nikaah kiya jabke wo biwaa thi aur unhein wo nikaah pasand nahi tha. To wo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gayi, aur unhone us nikaah ko naa-jaayez qaraar diya.

e: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin Yazid and Majammi bin Yazid:The same ,Hadith above: A man called Khidam married a daughter of his (to somebody) against her consent. 'If you fear that you shall not be able to deal justly with the orphan girls then marry (other) women of your choice.' (4.3) And if somebody says to the guardian (of a woman), "Marry me to so-and-so," and the guardian remained silent or said to him, "What have you got?" And the other said, "I have so much and so much (Mahr)," or kept quiet, and then the guardian said, "I have married her to you," then the marriage is valid (legal). This narration was told by Sahl on the authority of the Prophet
hi: Abdur Rahman bin Yazid aur Majammi bin Yazid bataate hain: (Upar wali hadees jaisa hi hai): Khidam naami ek shaks ne apni beti ka nikaah (kisi se) uski razaamandi ke bagair karwaaya. 'Agar tumhe dar ho ke tum yateem ladkiyon ke saath insaaf nahi kar sakoge, to (doosri) apni pasand ki auraton se nikaah karo.' (4:3) Aur agar koi (aurat ke) sarparast se kahe, 'Mera nikaah falaan se kar dijiye,' aur sarparast khaamosh rahe ya kahe, 'Tumhaare paas kya hai?' aur doosra kahe, 'Mere paas itna itna (Mahr) hai,' ya khaamosh rahe, phir sarparast kahe, 'Maine unka nikaah tumse kar diya,' to nikaah jaayez (qaanooni) hoga. Ye riwayat Sahl ne Nabi (SAW) ke hawaale se bayaan ki hai.

e: Narrated 'Urwa bin Az-Zubair:that he asked `Aisha, saying to her, "O Mother! (In what connection was this Verse revealed): 'If you fear that you shall not be able to deal justly with orphan girls (to the end of the verse) that your right hands possess?" (4.3) Aisha said, "O my nephew! It was about the female orphan under the protection of her guardian who was interested in her beauty and wealth and wanted to marry her with a little or reduced Mahr. So such guardians were forbidden to marry female orphans unless they deal with them justly and give their full Mahr; and they were ordered to marry women other than them."`Aisha added, "(Later) the people asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), for instructions, and then Allah revealed: 'They ask your instruction concerning the women . . . And yet whom you desire to marry.' (4.127) So Allah revealed to them in this Verse that-if a female orphan had wealth and beauty, they desired to marry her and were interested in her noble descent and the reduction of her Mahr; but if she was not desired by them because of her lack in fortune and beauty they left her and married some other woman.
