So, as they used to leave her when they had no interest in her, they had no right to marry her if they had the desire to do so, unless they deal justly with her and gave her a full amount of Mahr
hi: Urwa bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke unhone Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se pucha, 'Aye Ammi! (Ye Aayat kis silsile mein naazil hui): "Agar tumhe dar ho ke tum yateem ladkiyon ke saath insaaf nahi kar sakoge... ya jo tumhaare haath mein (laundiyaan) hon"?' (4:3) Aisha ne kaha, 'Aye mere bhatije! Ye us yateem ladki ke baare mein thi jo apne sarparast ki nigraani mein hoti thi jise uski khoobsurati aur daulat pasand aati thi, aur wo use kam ya ghatta hua Mahr dekar nikaah karna chaahta tha. To aise sarparaston ko yateem ladkiyon se nikaah karne se mana kiya gaya, jab tak wo unke saath insaaf na karein aur unhein poora Mahr na dein; aur unhein hukm diya gaya ke wo unke ilaawa kisi aur aurat se nikaah karein.' Aisha ne aage kaha, '(Baad mein) log Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se hidaayat maangne lage, isper Allah ne naazil farmaya: "Wo aapse auraton ke baare mein hukm poochte hain... aur wo bhi jinse tum nikaah karna chahte ho." (4:127) To Allah ne is Aayat mein unhein bataya ke agar kisi yateem ladki ke paas daulat aur khoobsurati ho, to wo uske izzatdaar khaandaan aur kam Mahr ki wajah se usse nikaah karna chaahte the; magar agar unhein uski gareebi aur kam khoobsurati ki wajah se koi dilchaspi na ho, to wo use chhod kar kisi aur aurat se nikaah kar lete. To jaise wo unhein dilchaspi na hone par chhod dete the, unhein haq nahi tha ke jab unmein dilchaspi ho to unse nikaah karein, jab tak unke saath insaaf na karein aur unhein poora Mahr na dein.'

e: Narrated Sahl:A woman came to the Prophet,, and presented herself to him (for marriage). He said, "I am not in need of women these days." Then a man said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Marry her to me." The Prophet (ﷺ) asked him, "What have you got?" He said, "I have got nothing." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Give her something, even an iron ring." He said, "I have got nothing." The Prophet (ﷺ) asked (him), "How much of the Qur'an do you know (by heart)?" He said, "So much and so much." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I have married her to you for what you know of the Qur'an
hi: Sahl bataate hain: Ek aurat Nabi (SAW) ke paas aayi aur khud ko pesh kiya. Unhone kaha, 'Mujhe in dinon auraton ki zaroorat nahi.' Phir ek shaks ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Unka nikaah mujhse kar dijiye.' Nabi (SAW) ne unse pucha, 'Tumhaare paas kya hai?' Usne kaha, 'Mere paas kuch nahi hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Unhein kuch do, chaahe wo loha ki anguthi hi ho.' Usne kaha, 'Mere paas kuch nahi hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne (usse) pucha, 'Tumhein Quran mein se kitna yaad hai?' Usne kaha, 'Itna itna.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Maine unka nikaah tumse us Quran ke badle kar diya jo tumhein yaad hai.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) decreed that one should not try to cancel a bargain already agreed upon between some other persons (by offering a bigger price). And a man should not ask for the hand of a girl who is already engaged to his Muslim brother, unless the first suitor gives her up, or allows him to ask for her hand
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne hukm diya ke koi kisi aise saude ko radd karne ki koshish na kare jo doosre logon ke beech pehle se tay ho chuka ho (zyaada qeemat dekar). Aur koi aisi ladki ka rishta na maange jiska rishta pehle se hi uske Musalmaan bhai ke saath tay ho chuka ho, jab tak pehla rishta maangne wala use chhod na de, ya use rishta maangne ki ijaazat na de.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Beware of suspicion (about others), as suspicion is the falsest talk, and do not spy upon each other, and do not listen to the evil talk of the people about others' affairs, and do not have enmity with one another, but be brothers. And none should ask for the hand of a girl who is already engaged to his (Muslim) brother, but one should wait till the first suitor marries her or leaves her
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Shak (doosron ke baare mein) se bacho, kyunke shak sabse jhoothi baat hai, aur ek doosre ki jaasoosi mat karo, aur logon ke maamlaat ke baare mein buri baatein mat suno, aur aapas mein dushmani mat rakho, balke bhai bano. Aur koi aisi ladki ka rishta na maange jiska rishta pehle se hi apne (Musalmaan) bhai ke saath tay ho chuka ho, balke intezaar kare jab tak pehla rishta maangne wala usse nikaah kar le ya use chhod de.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:"When Hafsa became a widow," `Umar said, "I met Abu Bakr and said to him, 'If you wish I will marry Hafsa bint `Umar to you.' I waited for a few days then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked for her hand. Later Abu Bakr met me and said, 'Nothing stopped me from returning to you concerning your offer except that I knew that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had mentioned (his wish to marry) her, and I could never let out the secret of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . If he had left her, I would have accepted her
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: 'Jab Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) biwaa hui,' Umar ne kaha, 'Main Abu Bakr se mila aur unse kaha, "Agar aap chaahein, to main Hafsa bint Umar ka nikaah aapse kar doon." Maine kuch dinon intezaar kiya, phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unka rishta maanga. Baad mein Abu Bakr mujhse mile aur kaha, "Mujhe aapke prastaav ka jawab dene se sirf isliye roka ke mujhe pata tha ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse nikaah karne ki khwaahish zaahir ki hai, aur main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka raaz kabhi zaahir nahi kar sakta tha. Agar unhone use chhod diya hota, to main use qubool kar leta."'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Two men came from the east and delivered speeches, and the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Some eloquent speech has the influence of magic." (e.g., some people refuse to do something and then a good eloquent speaker addresses them and then they agree to do that very thing after his speech)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Do log poorab se aaye aur taqreerein din, aur Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kuch bayaan itne shaandar hote hain ke unmein jaadu jaisa asar hota hai.'

e: Narrated Ar-Rabi`:(the daughter of Muawwidh bin Afra) After the consummation of my marriage, the Prophet (ﷺ) came and sat on my bed as far from me as you are sitting now, and our little girls started beating the tambourines and reciting elegiac verses mourning my father who had been killed in the battle of Badr. One of them said, "Among us is a Prophet who knows what will happen tomorrow." On that the Prophet said, "Leave this (saying) and keep on saying the verses which you had been saying before
hi: Ar-Rabi (Muawwidh bin Afra ki beti) bataati hain: Meri rukhsati ke baad, Nabi (SAW) aaye aur mere bistar par baithe, utni door jitna aap abhi baithe hain, aur hamaari chhoti ladkiyaan daf bajaakar mere waalid ke marsiye padhne lagi jo jang-e-Badr mein shaheed ho gaye the. Unmein se ek ne kaha, 'Humaare beech ek Nabi hai jo jaanta hai kal kya hoga.' Isper Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ye baat chhod do aur wahi padhte raho jo tum pehle padh rahi thi.'

e: Narrated Anas:`Abdur Rahman bin `Auf married a woman and gave her gold equal to the weight of a date stone (as Mahr). When the Prophet (ﷺ) noticed the signs of cheerfulness of the marriage (on his face) and asked him about it, he said, "I have married a woman and gave (her) gold equal to a date stone in weight (as Mahr)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abdur Rahman bin Auf (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne ek aurat se nikaah kiya aur unhein khajoor ki guthli ke barabar wazan ka sona (Mahr ke taur par) diya. Jab Nabi (SAW) ne unke chehre par shaadi ki khushi ke asaar dekhe aur unse iske baare mein pucha, unhone kaha, 'Maine ek aurat se nikaah kiya hai aur (unhein) khajoor ki guthli ke barabar wazan ka sona (Mahr ke taur par) diya hai.'

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d As-Sa`idi:While I was (sitting) among the people in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) a woman stood up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! She has given herself in marriage to you; please give your opinion of her." The Prophet did not give her any reply. She again stood up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! She has given herself (in marriage) to you; so please give your opinion of her. The Prophet (ﷺ) did not give her any reply. She again stood up for the third time and said, "She has given herself in marriage to you: so give your opinion of her." So a man stood up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Marry her to me." The Prophet asked him, "Have you got anything?" He said, "No." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Go and search for something, even if it were an iron ring." The man went and searched and then returned saying, "I could not find anything, not even an iron ring." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do you know something of the Qur'an (by heart)?" He replied, "I know (by heart) such Sura and such Sura." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Go! I have married her to you for what you know of the Qur'an (by heart)
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) As-Sa'idi bataate hain: Jab main logon ke beech Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki majlis mein (baitha) tha, ek aurat khadi hui aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Usne khud ko aapko nikaah mein de diya hai; barah-e-meharbaani apni raay bataiye.' Nabi (SAW) ne koi jawab nahi diya. Wo dobara khadi hui aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Usne khud ko aapko de diya hai; barah-e-meharbaani apni raay bataiye.' Nabi (SAW) ne phir koi jawab nahi diya. Wo teesri baar khadi hui aur kaha, 'Usne khud ko aapko de diya hai; apni raay bataiye.' To ek aadmi khada hua aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Unka nikaah mujhse kar dijiye.' Nabi (SAW) ne unse pucha, 'Kya tumhaare paas kuch hai?' Usne kaha, 'Nahi.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Jaao aur kuch dhoondho, chaahe wo loha ki anguthi hi ho.' Wo aadmi gaya aur dhoondh kar wapas aaya aur kaha, 'Mujhe kuch nahi mila, loha ki anguthi bhi nahi.' Phir Nabi (SAW) ne pucha, 'Kya tumhein Quran mein se kuch (zabaani) yaad hai?' Usne jawab diya, 'Mujhe falaan Surah aur falaan Surah (zabaani) yaad hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jaao! Maine unka nikaah tumse us Quran ke badle kar diya jo tumhein zabaani yaad hai.'

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:The Prophet (ﷺ) said to a man, "Marry, even with (a Mahr equal to) an iron ring
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne ek aadmi se kaha, 'Nikaah karo, chaahe (Mahr) loha ki anguthi ke barabar hi kyun na ho.'

e: Narrated `Uqba:The Prophet (ﷺ) said: "The stipulations most entitled to be abided by are those with which you are given the right to enjoy the (women's) private parts (i.e. the stipulations of the marriage contract)
hi: Uqba bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Un shartton ko poora karna sabse zyaada zaroori hai jinke zariye tumhein (auraton ki) izzat (sharmgaah) se lutf uthaane ka haq milta hai' (yaani nikaah ke muaahide ki shartein).

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It is not lawful for a woman (at the time of wedding) to ask for the divorce of her sister (i.e. the other wife of her would-be husband) in order to have everything for herself, for she will take only what has been written for her
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kisi aurat ke liye ye jaayez nahi ke wo (nikaah ke waqt) apni behen (yaani hone wale shohar ki doosri biwi) ki talaaq maange taake sab kuch khud ke liye le le, kyunke usse to wahi milega jo uske liye likh diya gaya hai.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:`Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he had marks of Sufra (yellow perfume). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked him (about those marks). `AbdurRahman bin `Auf told him that he had married a woman from the Ansar. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "How much Mahr did you pay her?" He said, "I paid gold equal to the weight of a date stone." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him, "Give a wedding banquet, even if with one sheep
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abdur Rahman bin Auf (رضی اللہ عنہ) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unpar peele khushbu (Sufra) ke nishaan the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse (in nishaanon ke baare mein) pucha. Abdur Rahman bin Auf ne unhein bataaya ke unhone ek Ansaari aurat se nikaah kiya hai. Nabi (SAW) ne pucha, 'Tumne unhein kitna Mahr diya?' Unhone kaha, 'Maine khajoor ki guthli ke barabar sona diya.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha, 'Walima ki dawat do, chaahe ek hi bakri se ho.'

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) offered a wedding banquet on the occasion of his marriage to Zainab, and provided a good meal for the Muslims. Then he went out as was his custom on marrying, he came to the dwelling places of the mothers of the Believers (i.e. his wives) invoking good (on them), and they were invoking good (on him). Then he departed (and came back) and saw two men (still sitting there). So he left again. I do not remember whether I informed him or he was informed (by somebody else) of their departure
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) se nikaah ke mauqe par Walima ki dawat di aur Musalmaanon ke liye achha khaana muhaiya kiya. Phir wo baahar nikle, jaisa unka nikaah ke waqt rivaaj tha, aur Ummahaat-ul-Momineen (apni biwiyon) ke gharon mein gaye, unke liye dua karte hue, aur wo bhi unke liye dua karti rahin. Phir wo wahaan se gaye (aur wapas aaye) aur do aadmiyon ko (abhi bhi wahaan baithe) dekha. To wo phir chale gaye. Mujhe yaad nahi ke maine unhein unke jaane ki khabar di ya kisi aur ne bataayi.

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) saw the traces of Sufra (yellow perfume) on `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf and said, "What is this?" `Abdur-Rahman, said, "I have married a woman and have paid gold equal to the weight of a datestone (as her Mahr). The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "May Allah bless you: Offer a wedding banquet even with one sheep
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne Abdur Rahman bin Auf (رضی اللہ عنہ) par peele khushbu (Sufra) ke nishaan dekhe aur pucha, 'Ye kya hai?' Abdur Rahman ne kaha, 'Maine ek aurat se nikaah kiya hai aur unhein khajoor ki guthli ke barabar wazan ka sona (Mahr ke taur par) diya hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne unse kaha, 'Allah tumhein barkat de! Walima ki dawat do, chaahe ek hi bakri se ho.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:When the Prophet (ﷺ) married me, my mother came to me and made me enter the house where I saw some women from the Ansar who said, "May you prosper and have blessings and have good omen
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab Nabi (SAW) ne mujhse nikaah kiya, meri maa mere paas aayi aur mujhe ghar mein daakhil kiya, jahaan maine Ansaar ki kuch auraton ko dekha jo kaha karti thin, 'Aap khushhaal hon aur aapko barkatein aur achhi qismat mile.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A prophet among the prophets went for a military expedition and said to his people: "A man who has married a lady and wants to consummate his marriage with her and he has not done so yet, should not accompany me
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Nabiyon mein se ek Nabi jihaad par gaye aur apni qaum se kaha: "Jis shaks ne kisi aurat se nikaah kiya ho aur wo apni shaadi poori (rukhsati) karna chahta ho magar abhi aisa na kiya ho, wo mere saath na aaye."'

e: Narrated 'Urwa:The Prophet (ﷺ) wrote the (marriage contract) with `Aisha while she was six years old and consummated his marriage with her while she was nine years old and she remained with him for nine years (i.e. till his death)
hi: Urwa bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se nikaah ka muaahida likha jab wo chhe saal ki thin, aur unki rukhsati ki jab wo nau saal ki thin, aur wo unke saath nau saal (unki wafat tak) rahi.

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) stayed for three days at a place between Khaibar and Medina, and there he consummated his marriage with Safiyya bint Huyay. I invited the Muslims to a banquet which included neither meat nor bread. The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered for the leather dining sheets to be spread, and then dates, dried yogurt and butter were provided over it, and that was the Walima (banquet) of the Prophet. The Muslims asked whether Safiyya would be considered as his wife or as a slave girl of what his right hands possessed. Then they said, "If the Prophet (ﷺ) screens her from the people, then she Is the Prophet's wife but if he does not screen her, then she is a slave girl." So when the Prophet (ﷺ) proceeded, he made a place for her (on the camel) behind him and screened her from people
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) Khaibar aur Madina ke beech teen din rahe, aur wahaan unhone Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Huyai ki rukhsati ki. Maine Musalmaanon ko ek Walima ki dawat di jismein na gosht tha na roti. Nabi (SAW) ne chamde ke dastarkhwaan bichhaane ka hukm diya, phir khajoorein, sukhi dahi aur makhan usmein rakha gaya, aur yahi Nabi (SAW) ka Walima tha. Musalmaanon ne pucha ke kya Safiya unki biwi maani jaayengi ya launDi. Phir unhone kaha, 'Agar Nabi (SAW) unhein logon se parde mein rakhein, to wo Nabi ki biwi hain, magar agar parda na karein, to wo launDi hain.' To jab Nabi (SAW) rawaana hue, unhone unke liye (oont par) apne peechhe jagah rakhi aur unhein logon se parde mein rakha.

e: Narrated Aisha:When the Prophet (ﷺ) married me, my mother came to me and made me enter the house (of the Prophet) and nothing surprised me but the coming of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to me in the forenoon
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab Nabi (SAW) ne mujhse nikaah kiya, meri maa mere paas aayi aur mujhe (Nabi ke) ghar mein daakhil kiya, aur mujhe kisi baat ne hairaan nahi kiya siwaaye is ke ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) subah ke waqt mere paas aaye.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Did you get Anmat?" I said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! From where can we have Anmat?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Soon you will have them (Anmat)
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne pucha, 'Kya tumne Anmat (takiye/gaddiyaan) le liye?' Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Humein Anmat kahaan se milenge?' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jald hi tumhaare paas ye (Anmat) hongi.'

e: Narrated 'Aisha: that she prepared a lady for a man from the Ansar as his bride and the Prophet said, "O 'Aisha! Haven't you got any amusement (during the marriage ceremony) as the Ansar like amusement?
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Unhone Ansaar ke ek shaks ke liye ek dulhan taiyaar ki, aur Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Aye Aisha! Kya tumhaare paas (shaadi ki rasm ke dauraan) koi manoranjan nahi tha, kyunke Ansaar ko manoranjan pasand hai?'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik: "Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) passed by (my mother Um-Sulaim) he used to enter her and greet her. Anas further said: Once the Prophet (ﷺ) way a bridegroom during his marriage with Zainab, Um Sulaim said to me, "Let us give a gift to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ." I said to her, "Do it." So she prepared Haisa (a sweet dish) made from dates, butter and dried yoghurt and she sent it with me to him. I took it to him and he said, "Put it down," and ordered me to call some men whom he named, and to invite whomever I would meet. I did what he ordered me to do, and when I returned, I found the house crowded with people and saw the Prophet (ﷺ) keeping his hand over the Haisa and saying over it whatever Allah wished (him to say). Then he called the men in batches of ten to eat of it, and he said to them, "Mention the Name of Allah, and each man should eat of the dish the nearest to him." When all of them had finished their meals, some of them left and a few remained there talking, over which I felt unhappy. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) went out towards the dwelling places (of his wives) and I too, went out after him and told him that those people had left. Then he returned and entered his dwelling place and let the curtains fall while I was in (his) dwelling place, and he was reciting the Verses:-- 'O you who believe! Enter not the Prophet's house until leave is given you for a meal, (and then) not (as early as) to what for its preparation. But when you are invited, enter, and when you have taken your meals, disperse without sitting for a talk. Verily such (behavior) annoys the Prophet; and he would be shy of (asking) you (to go), but Allah is not shy of (telling you) the Truth.' (33-53) Abu Uthman said: Anas said, "I served the Prophet for ten years
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab bhi Nabi (SAW) (meri maa) Umm Sulaim (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas se guzarte, wo unke paas jaakar unhein salaam karte. Anas ne aage kaha: Ek baar Nabi (SAW) Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) se apni shaadi ke waqt dulha the, Umm Sulaim ne mujhse kaha, 'Chalo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ek tohfa dete hain.' Maine unse kaha, 'Aisa karo.' To unhone khajoor, makhan aur sukhi dahi se 'Haisa' (ek meethi cheez) banaayi aur mere saath unhein bhejwaayi. Main use unke paas laaya, unhone kaha, 'Ise neeche rakh do,' aur mujhe kuch mardon ka naam lekar bulaane ka hukm diya, aur jise bhi main milun use bhi bulaane ko kaha. Maine wahi kiya jo unhone hukm diya, aur jab main wapas aaya, to ghar logon se bhara paaya, aur maine dekha ke Nabi (SAW) apna haath Haisa par rakhe hue the aur usper Allah ki jo marzi thi wo kehte the. Phir unhone das-das ke gutt mein logon ko khaane ke liye bulaaya, aur unse kaha, 'Allah ka naam lo, aur har shaks apne saamne wali cheez khaaye.' Jab sab khaana khaa chuke, kuch chale gaye aur kuch wahi baithe baaten karte rahe, jispar mujhe be-araami hui. Phir Nabi (SAW) apni azwaaj ke gharon ki taraf gaye, aur main bhi unke peechhe gaya, aur unhein bataaya ke wo log chale gaye hain. Phir wo wapas aaye aur apne ghar mein daakhil hue aur parda gira diya jabke main (unke) ghar mein tha, aur wo ye Aayaten padh rahe the: 'Aye Iman waalo! Nabi ke gharon mein daakhil na ho jab tak khaane ke liye ijaazat na di jaaye, (aur phir) uski taiyaari ka intezaar karne ke liye mat baitho. Magar jab tumhein bulaaya jaaye, to daakhil ho, aur jab khaana khaa lo, to baaten karne ke liye baithe bagair chale jaao. Beshak aisa (rawaiya) Nabi ko takleef deta hai, aur wo tumse (jaane ko kehne mein) sharmaate hain, magar Allah haq (baat) kehne mein nahi sharmaata.' (33:53) Abu Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) kehte hain: Anas ne kaha, 'Maine Nabi (SAW) ki das saal khidmat ki.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:That she borrowed a necklace from Asma' and then it got lost. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent some people from his companions in search of it. In the meantime the stated time for the prayer became due and they offered their prayer without ablution. When they came to the Prophet, they complained about it to him, so the Verse regarding Tayammum was revealed . Usaid bin Hudair said, "(O `Aisha!) may Allah bless you with a good reward, for by Allah, never did a difficulty happen in connection with you, but Allah made an escape from it for you, and brought Allah's Blessings for the Muslims
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Unhone Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) se ek haar udhaar liya tha, jo kho gaya. To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne sahaaba mein se kuch logon ko use dhoondhne bheja. Isi dauraan namaz ka waqt aa gaya aur unhone bagair wuzu ke namaz padh li. Jab wo Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye, to unhone iski shikaayat ki, isper Tayammum ki Aayat naazil hui. Usaid bin Hudair ne kaha, '(Aye Aisha!) Allah aapko achha ajr de, kyunke Allah ki qasam, aapke silsile mein kabhi koi mushkil nahi aayi jispar Allah ne aapke liye koi raasta na nikaala ho, aur Musalmaanon ke liye Allah ki barkatein na laayi ho.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If anyone of you, when having sexual intercourse with his wife, says: Bismillah, Allahumma jannibni-Sh-Shaitan wa jannib-ish-Shaitan ma razaqtana, and if it is destined that they should have a child, then Satan will never be able to harm him
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar tum mein se koi apni biwi ke saath humbistari karte waqt kahe: "Bismillah, Allahumma jannibni-sh-Shaitaana wa jannib-ish-Shaitaana maa razaqtana" (Allah ke naam se, Aye Allah! Humein Shaitaan se bacha aur jo Tu humein aulaad de use bhi Shaitaan se bacha), aur agar unke muqaddar mein bacha ho, to Shaitaan use kabhi nuqsaan nahi pahuncha payega.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:I was ten years old when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) arrived at Medina. My mother and aunts used to urge me to serve the Prophet (ﷺ) regularly, and I served him for ten years. When the Prophet (ﷺ) died I was twenty years old, and I knew about the order of Al-Hijab (veiling of ladies) more than any other person when it was revealed. It was revealed for the first time when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had consummated his marriage with Zainab bint Jahsh. When the day dawned, the Prophet (ﷺ) was a bridegroom and he invited the people to a banquet, so they came, ate, and then all left except a few who remained with the Prophet (ﷺ) for a long time. The Prophet (ﷺ) got up and went out, and I too went out with him so that those people might leave too. The Prophet (ﷺ) proceeded and so did I, till he came to the threshold of `Aisha's dwelling place. Then thinking that these people have left by then, he returned and so did I along with him till he entered upon Zainab and behold, they were still sitting and had not gone. So the Prophet (ﷺ) again went away and I went away along with him. When we reached the threshold of `Aisha's dwelling place, he thought that they had left, and so he returned and I too, returned along with him and found those people had left. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) drew a curtain between me and him, and the Verses of Al-Hijab were revealed
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main dus saal ka tha jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Madina pahunche. Meri maa aur khaalaein mujhse Nabi (SAW) ki musalsal khidmat karwaati thin, aur maine unki dus saal khidmat ki. Jab Nabi (SAW) ka intekaal hua, main bees saal ka tha, aur mujhe Hijab (auraton ke parde) ke hukm ke baare mein kisi aur se zyaada pata tha jab wo naazil hua. Wo pehli baar naazil hua jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Jahsh (رضی اللہ عنہا) ki rukhsati ki. Jab din chadha, Nabi (SAW) dulha the aur unhone logon ko Walima ki dawat di, to wo aaye, khaana khaaya, phir sab chale gaye siwaaye chand logon ke jo Nabi (SAW) ke saath lambe waqt tak rahe. Nabi (SAW) uthe aur baahar chale gaye, aur main bhi unke saath baahar gaya taake wo log bhi chale jaayein. Nabi (SAW) aage badhe aur main bhi, yahaan tak ke wo Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke ghar ki dahleez par pahunche. Phir ye soch kar ke ab tak wo log chale gaye honge, wo wapas mud gaye aur main bhi unke saath, yahaan tak ke wo Zainab ke ghar daakhil hue, aur dekha ke wo log abhi bhi baithe hain aur gaye nahi. To Nabi (SAW) phir se chale gaye aur main bhi unke saath. Jab hum Aisha ke ghar ki dahleez par pahunche, unhein laga ke wo log chale gaye honge, to wo wapas mude aur main bhi unke saath wapas gaya, aur paaya ke wo log chale gaye the. Phir Nabi (SAW) ne mere aur apne beech parda daal diya, aur Hijab ki Aayaten naazil hui.

e: Narrated Anas:When `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf married an Ansari woman, the Prophet (ﷺ) asked him, "How much Mahr did you give her?" `Abdur-Rahman said, "Gold equal to the weight of a date stone." Anas added: When they (i.e. the Prophet (ﷺ) and his companions) arrived at Medina, the emigrants stayed at the Ansar's houses. `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf stayed at Sa`d bin Ar-Rabi's house. Sa`d said to `Abdur- Rahman, "I will divide and share my property with you and will give one of my two wives to you." `Abdur-Rahman said, "May Allah bless you, your wives and property (I am not in need of that; but kindly show me the way to the market)." So `Abdur-Rahman went to the market and traded there gaining a profit of some dried yoghurt and butter, and married (an Ansari woman). The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "Give a banquet, even if with one sheep
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Abdur Rahman bin Auf (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne ek Ansaari aurat se nikaah kiya, Nabi (SAW) ne unse pucha, 'Tumne unhein kitna Mahr diya?' Abdur Rahman ne kaha, 'Khajoor ki guthli ke barabar sona.' Anas ne aage kaha: Jab wo (Nabi SAW aur unke sahaaba) Madina pahunche, Muhaajireen Ansaar ke gharon mein thehre. Abdur Rahman bin Auf Sa'd bin Ar-Rabi ke ghar thehre. Sa'd ne Abdur Rahman se kaha, 'Main apni jaayadaad aapke saath baant dunga aur apni do biwiyon mein se ek aapko de dunga.' Abdur Rahman ne kaha, 'Allah aapko, aapki biwiyon aur jaayadaad ko barkat de (mujhe iski zaroorat nahi, magar meherbaani karke mujhe bazaar ka raasta dikha do).' To Abdur Rahman bazaar gaye aur wahaan tijaarat karke kuch sukhi dahi aur makhan ka munaafa kamaaya aur (ek Ansaari aurat se) nikaah kiya. Nabi (SAW) ne unse kaha, 'Dawat do, chaahe ek hi bakri se ho.'

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) did not give a better wedding banquet on the occasion of marrying any of his wives than the one he gave on marrying Zainab, and that banquet was with (consisted of) one sheep
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne apni kisi bhi biwi se nikaah ke mauqe par Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) se nikaah ke mauqe par diye gaye Walima se behtar Walima nahi diya, aur wo Walima ek bakri se tha.

e: Narrated Anas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) manumitted Safiyya and then married her, and her Mahr was her manumission, and he gave a wedding banquet with Hais (a sort of sweet dish made from butter, cheese and dates)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko azaad kiya phir unse nikaah kiya, aur unka Mahr unki azaadi hi thi, aur unhone Hais (makhan, panir aur khajoor se banaayi ek meethi cheez) se Walima ki dawat di.

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) consummated his marriage with a woman (Zainab), so he sent me to invite men to the meals
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne ek aurat (Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا)) se rukhsati ki, aur mujhe logon ko khaane ke liye bulaane bheja.

e: Narrated Thabit:The marriage of Zainab bint Jahash was mentioned in the presence of Anas and he said, "I did not see the Prophet (ﷺ) giving a better banquet on marrying any of his wives than the one he gave on marrying Zainab. He then gave a banquet with one sheep
hi: Thabit bataate hain: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki maujoodgi mein Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Jahsh (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke nikaah ka zikr hua aur unhone kaha, 'Maine kabhi Nabi (SAW) ko apni kisi biwi se nikaah ke mauqe par Zainab se nikaah ke Walima se behtar Walima dete nahi dekha. Unhone tab ek bakri se Walima diya tha.'

e: Narrated Safiyya bint Shaiba:The Prophet (ﷺ) gave a banquet with two Mudds of barley on marrying some of his wives. (1 Mudd= 1 3/4 of a kilogram)
hi: Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Shaiba bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ne apni kuch biwiyon se nikaah ke mauqe par do Mudd jau se Walima diya (1 Mudd taqreeban paune do kilo).

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If anyone of you is invited to a wedding banquet, he must go for it (accept the invitation)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar tum mein se kisi ko shaadi ke Walima ki dawat mile, to use zaroor jaana chaahiye (dawat qubool karni chaahiye).'

e: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Set the captives free, accept the invitation (to a wedding banquet), and visit the patients
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Qaidiyon ko azaad karo, (shaadi ke Walima ki) dawat qubool karo, aur bimaron ki mizaajpursi karo.'

e: Narrated Al-Bara' bin `Azib:The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered us to do seven (things) and forbade us from seven. He ordered us to visit the patients, to follow the funeral procession, to reply to the sneezer (i.e., say to him, 'Yarhamuka-l-lah (May Allah bestow His Mercy upon you), if he says 'Al-hamduli l-lah' (Praise be to Allah), to help others to fulfill their oaths, to help the oppressed, to greet (whomever one should meet), and to accept the invitation (to a wedding banquet). He forbade us to wear golden rings, to use silver utensils, to use Maiyathir (cushions of silk stuffed with cotton and placed under the rider on the saddle), the Qasiyya (linen clothes containing silk brought from an Egyptian town), the Istibraq (thick silk) and the Dibaj (another kind of silk). (See Hadith No. 539 and)
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne humein saat (cheezon) ka hukm diya aur saat se mana kiya. Unhone humein hukm diya: bimaron ki mizaajpursi karna, janaaze ke jaloos mein shaamil hona, chheenkne wale ka jawab dena (yaani agar wo 'Al-hamdulillah' kahe to usse 'Yarhamuk-Allah' kehna), doosron ko unki qasmein poori karne mein madad karna, mazloomon ki madad karna, (jisse bhi milo use) salaam karna, aur (shaadi ki) dawat qubool karna. Unhone humein mana kiya: sone ki anguthiyaan pehnne se, chaandi ke bartan istemaal karne se, Maiyathir (resham ki gaddiyaan jo rui se bhari hoti hain aur sawaari ki zeen ke neeche rakhi jaati hain) istemaal karne se, Qasiyya (Misri shehar se laaye jaane wale resham mile hue sooti kapde) se, Istibraq (mota resham) aur Dibaj (ek aur qism ka resham) se.

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:Abu Usaid As-Sa'di invited Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to his wedding party and his wife who was the bride, served them on that day. Do you know what drink she gave Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? She had soaked some dates for him (in water) overnight, and when he had finished his meal she gave him that drink (of soaked dates)
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Usaid As-Sa'di ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko apni shaadi ki dawat par bulaaya, aur unki biwi, jo dulhan thi, us din unki khidmat karti rahi. Kya tumhein pata hai unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kya pilaaya? Unhone unke liye khajoorein raat bhar (paani mein) bhigo kar rakhi thin, aur jab unhone khaana khaa liya, to unhone unhein wahi (bhigi hui khajoor ka) sharbat diya.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The worst food is that of a wedding banquet to which only the rich are invited while the poor are not invited. And he who refuses an invitation (to a banquet) disobeys Allah and His Apostle
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Sabse buri khurak wo hai jo shaadi ke Walima mein sirf ameeron ko bulaayi jaaye aur gareebon ko na bulaayi jaaye. Aur jo koi (Walima ki) dawat qubool karne se inkaar kare, wo Allah aur uske Rasool ki na-farmaani karta hai.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If I am invited to a meal of trotters I will accept it; and if I am given a trotter as a present I will accept it
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar mujhe bakri ke pairon (khursi/paayacha) ke khaane ki dawat di jaaye, to main use qubool karunga; aur agar mujhe bakri ka pair tohfe mein diya jaaye, to main use bhi qubool karunga.'

e: Narrated Nafi`:`Abdullah bin `Umar said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Accept the marriage invitation if you are invited to it.' " Ibn `Umar used to accept the invitation whether to a wedding banquet or to any other party, even when he was fasting
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, "Nikaah ki dawat qubool karo agar tumhein us mein bulaaya jaaye."' Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) shaadi ke Walima ya kisi bhi doosri dawat ko qubool kiya karte the, chaahe wo roze mein hi kyun na hon.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) saw some women and children coming from a wedding party. He got up energetically and happily and said, "By Allah! You (i.e., the Ansar) are the most beloved of all people to me
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Nabi (SAW) ne kuch auraton aur bachchon ko ek shaadi ki dawat se aate dekha. Wo josh aur khushi se khade hue aur kaha, 'Allah ki qasam! Tum (yaani Ansaar) mujhe sab logon mein sabse zyaada aziz ho.'

e: Narrated Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) I bought a cushion having on it pictures (of animals). When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw it, he stood at the door and did not enter. I noticed the sign of disapproval on his face and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I repent to Allah and His Apostle. What sin have I committed?' Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said. "What is this cushion?" I said, "I have bought it for you so that you may sit on it and recline on it." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The makers of these pictures will be punished on the Day of Resurrection, and it will be said to them, 'Give life to what you have created (i.e., these pictures).' " The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "The Angels of (Mercy) do not enter a house in which there are pictures (of animals)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine ek takiya khareeda jispar (jaanwaron ki) tasveerein banaayi hui thin. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ise dekha, wo darwaaze par khade rahe aur andar nahi aaye. Maine unke chehre par na-pasandeedgi ke aasaar dekhe aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Main Allah aur uske Rasool ki taraf tauba karti hoon. Maine kya gunaah kiya hai?' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne pucha, 'Ye takiya kya hai?' Maine kaha, 'Maine ise aapke liye khareeda hai taake aap ispar baith sakein aur tek laga sakein.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'In tasveeron ke banaane walon ko Qayamat ke din saza di jaayegi, aur unse kaha jaayega, "Jo tumne banaaya use zinda karo (in tasveeron ko)."' Nabi (SAW) ne aage kaha, 'Rehmat ke Farishte us ghar mein daakhil nahi hote jismein (jaanwaron ki) tasveerein hon.'

e: Narrated Sahl:When Abu Usaid As-Sa`idi got married, he invited the Prophet (ﷺ) and his companions. None prepared the food for them and brought it to them but his wife. She soaked some dates in water in a stone pot overnight, and when the Prophet (ﷺ) had finished his food, she provided him with that drink (of soaked dates)
hi: Sahl bataate hain: Jab Abu Usaid As-Sa'idi ki shaadi hui, unhone Nabi (SAW) aur unke sahaaba ko bulaaya. Unke liye khaana kisi ne nahi banaaya aur laaya siwaaye unki biwi ke. Unhone kuch khajoorein raat bhar ek patthar ke bartan mein paani mein bhigo kar rakhi thin, aur jab Nabi (SAW) khaana khatam kar chuke, to unhone unhein wahi (bhigi hui khajoor ka) sharbat pesh kiya.

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:Abu Usaid As-Sa`idi invited the Prophet (ﷺ) to his wedding party and his wife served him on that day, and she was the bride. She said (or Sahl said), "Do you know what she soaked for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? She soaked some dates for him (in water) in a drinking bowl overnight
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Usaid As-Sa'idi ne Nabi (SAW) ko apni shaadi ki dawat par bulaaya, aur unki biwi ne us din unki khidmat ki, aur wahi dulhan thi. Unhone (ya Sahl ne) kaha, 'Kya tumhein pata hai unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke liye kya bhigo kar rakha tha? Unhone unke liye khajoorein ek peene ke pyaale mein raat bhar (paani mein) bhigo kar rakhi thin.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The woman is like a rib; if you try to straighten her, she will break. So if you want to get benefit from her, do so while she still has some crookedness
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Aurat pasli ki tarah hai; agar tum use seedha karne ki koshish karoge, to wo toot jaayegi. To agar tum usse faayda uthaana chahte ho, to usse uski kuch tedhaapan ke saath hi (jaisi hai waisi hi) rehne do.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should not hurt (trouble) his neighbor. And I advise you to take care of the women, for they are created from a rib and the most crooked portion of the rib is its upper part; if you try to straighten it, it will break, and if you leave it, it will remain crooked, so I urge you to take care of the women
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par Iman rakhta hai, use apne padosi ko takleef nahi deni chaahiye. Aur main tumhein sifaarish karta hoon ke auraton ka khayaal rakho, kyunke unhein pasli se banaaya gaya hai, aur pasli ka sabse tedha hissa uska upar wala hissa hota hai; agar tum use seedha karne ki koshish karoge, to wo toot jaayegi, aur agar tum use waisa hi rehne doge, to wo tedha hi rahega. Isliye main tumhein zor de kar kehta hoon ke auraton ka khayaal rakho.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:During the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) we used to avoid chatting leisurely and freely with our wives lest some Divine inspiration might be revealed concerning us. But when the Prophet (ﷺ) had died, we started chatting leisurely and freely (with them)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ki zindagi mein hum apni biwiyon ke saath khule dil se aur azaad hoke baat karne se bachte the, kahin humaare baare mein koi Quraani wahi naazil na ho jaaye. Magar jab Nabi (SAW) ka intekaal ho gaya, to hum unke saath khule dil se baaten karne lage.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Everyone of you is a guardian and everyone of you is responsible (for his wards). A ruler is a guardian and is responsible(for his subjects); a man is a guardian of his family and responsible (for them); a wife is a guardian of her husband's house and she is responsible (for it), a slave is a guardian of his master's property and is responsible (for that). Beware! All of you are guardians and are responsible (for your wards)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Tum mein har koi nigraan hai, aur har koi apni zimmedaari ke liye jawaabdeh hai. Hukmaraan nigraan hai aur apni praja ke liye zimmedaar hai; aadmi apne khaandaan ka nigraan hai aur unke liye zimmedaar hai; biwi apne shohar ke ghar ki nigraan hai aur uske liye zimmedaar hai; ghulaam apne maalik ki jaayadaad ka nigraan hai aur uske liye zimmedaar hai. Khabardaar! Tum sab nigraan ho aur apni zimmedaari ke liye jawaabdeh ho.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:Eleven women sat (at a place) and promised and contracted that they would not conceal anything of the news of their husbands. The first one said, "My husband is like the meat of a slim weak camel which is kept on the top of a mountain which is neither easy to climb, nor is the meat fat, so that one might put up with the trouble of fetching it." The second one said, "I shall not relate my husband's news, for I fear that I may not be able to finish his story, for if I describe him, I will mention all his defects and bad traits." The third one said, "My husband, the "too-tall"! if I describe him (and he hears of that) he will divorce me, and if I keep quiet, he will keep me hanging (neither divorcing me nor treating me as a wife)." The fourth one said, "My husband is (moderate in temper) like the night of Tihama: neither hot nor cold; I am neither afraid of him, nor am I discontented with him." The fifth one said, "My husband, when entering (the house) is a leopard (sleeps a lot), and when going out, is a lion (boasts a lot). He does not ask about whatever is in the house." The sixth one said, "If my husband eats, he eats too much (leaving the dishes empty), and if he drinks he leaves nothing; if he sleeps he sleeps he rolls himself (alone in our blankets); and he does not insert his palm to inquire about my feelings." The seventh one said, "My husband is a wrong-doer or weak and foolish. All the defects are present in him. He may injure your head or your body or may do both." The eighth one said, "My husband is soft to touch like a rabbit and smells like a Zarnab (a kind of good smelling grass)." The ninth one said, "My husband is a tall generous man wearing a long strap for carrying his sword. His ashes are abundant (i.e. generous to his guests) and his house is near to the people (who would easily consult him)." The tenth one said, "My husband is Malik (possessor), and what is Malik? Malik is greater than whatever I say about him. (He is beyond and above all praises which can come to my mind). Most of his camels are kept at home (ready to be slaughtered for the guests) and only a few are taken to the pastures. When the camels hear the sound of the lute (or the tambourine) they realize that they are going to be slaughtered for the guests." The eleventh one said, "My husband is Abu Zar` and what is Abu Zar` (i.e., what should I say about him)? He has given me many ornaments and my ears are heavily loaded with them and my arms have become fat (i.e., I have become fat). And he has pleased me, and I have become so happy that I feel proud of myself. He found me with my family who were mere owners of sheep and living in poverty, and brought me to a respected family having horses and camels and threshing and purifying grain. Whatever I say, he does not rebuke or insult me. When I sleep, I sleep till late in the morning, and when I drink water (or milk), I drink my fill. The mother of Abu Zar and what may one say in praise of the mother of Abu Zar? Her saddle bags were always full of provision and her house was spacious. As for the son of Abu Zar, what may one say of the son of Abu Zar? His bed is as narrow as an unsheathed sword and an arm of a kid (of four months) satisfies his hunger. As for the daughter of Abu Zar, she is obedient to her father and to her mother. She has a fat well-built body and that arouses the jealousy of her husband's other wife. As for the (maid) slave girl of Abu Zar, what may one say of the (maid) slavegirl of Abu Zar? She does not uncover our secrets but keeps them, and does not waste our provisions and does not leave the rubbish scattered everywhere in our house." The eleventh lady added, "One day it so happened that Abu Zar went out at the time when the milk was being milked from the animals, and he saw a woman who had two sons like two leopards playing with her two breasts. (On seeing her) he divorced me and married her. Thereafter I married a noble man who used to ride a fast tireless horse and keep a spear in his hand. He gave me many things, and also a pair of every kind of livestock and said, Eat (of this), O Um Zar, and give provision to your relatives." She added, "Yet, all those things which my second husband gave me could not fill the smallest utensil of Abu Zar's." `Aisha then said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me, "I am to you as Abu Zar was to his wife Um Zar
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Gyarah auraten baithi (kisi jagah) aur aapas mein waada aur ahad kiya ke wo apne shauharon ki koi bhi baat nahi chhupaayengi. Pehli ne kaha, 'Mera shohar ek dubla-patla oont ke gosht jaisa hai jo ek pahaad ki choti par rakha ho, jahaan na chadhna aasaan hai, na wo gosht mota hai ke koi use laane ki mehnat kare.' Doosri ne kaha, 'Main apne shohar ki khabar nahi sunaaungi, kyunke mujhe dar hai ke main uski poori baat khatam na kar paaun, kyunke agar main use bayaan karti hoon, to uske sab aib-o-buraaiyaan gina dungi.' Teesri ne kaha, 'Mera shohar, "bahut lamba"! Agar main use bayaan karoon (aur usne suna), to wo mujhe talaaq de dega, aur agar main khaamosh rahi, to wo mujhe latka (na talaaq na biwi ki tarah) rakhega.' Chauthi ne kaha, 'Mera shohar Tihama ki raat jaisa hai: na garam na thanda; mujhe na uska dar hai na main usse nakhush hoon.' Paanchvi ne kaha, 'Mera shohar, jab ghar mein aata hai to chita jaisa hai (bahut sota hai), aur jab baahar jaata hai to sher jaisa hai (bahut ghamand karta hai). Wo ghar mein kya hai iske baare mein kuch nahi poochta.' Chhati ne kaha, 'Agar mera shohar khaata hai, to bahut khaata hai (bartan khaali kar deta hai), aur agar peeta hai, to kuch nahi chhodta; agar sota hai, to (akela hamaari chaadaron mein) lipat kar sota hai, aur mere ehsaas jaanne ke liye apna haath nahi daalta.' Saatvi ne kaha, 'Mera shohar zulm karne wala ya kamzor aur bewaqoof hai. Sab buraaiyaan usme hain. Wo tumhaara sar ya jism ya dono ko chot pahuncha sakta hai.' Aathvi ne kaha, 'Mera shohar chhoone mein khargosh jaisa naram hai aur Zarnab (ek khushbudaar ghaas) jaisi khushbu deta hai.' Nauvi ne kaha, 'Mera shohar ek lamba, sakhi aadmi hai jo apni talwaar ke liye lamba fita pehanta hai. Uski raakh (yaani sakhaawat) bahut hai aur uska ghar logon (jo aasaani se uske paas salaah lene aayein) ke qareeb hai.' Dasvi ne kaha, 'Mera shohar Malik hai, aur Malik kya hai? Malik jitna main uske baare mein kahoon usse bhi bada hai. (Wo un sab tareefon se ooncha hai jo mere zehen mein aayein.) Uske zyaadatar oont ghar mein hi rakhe jaate hain (mehmaan ke liye zibah hone ko taiyaar), aur bahut kam charne ke liye le jaaye jaate hain. Jab oont been ya daf ki aawaaz sunte hain, to unhein pata chal jaata hai ke unhein mehmaanon ke liye zibah kiya jaayega.' Gyarahvi ne kaha, 'Mera shohar Abu Zar hai, aur Abu Zar kya hai (yaani main uske baare mein kya kahoon)? Usne mujhe itne zewar diye hain ke mere kaan unse bhaari ho gaye hain aur meri baahein mota ho gayi hain (yaani main mota ho gayi hoon). Aur usne mujhe itna khush kiya hai ke mujhe apne aap par fakhar mehsoos hota hai. Usne mujhe ek aise khaandaan mein paaya jo sirf bakriyon ke maalik the aur gareebi mein rehte the, aur mujhe ek izzatdaar khaandaan mein le aaya jinke paas ghode, oont, aur anaaj peesne aur saaf karne ke saadhan the. Main jo bhi kahoon, wo mujhe daantta ya bezzat nahi karta. Jab main sotoi hoon, to der subah tak sotoi hoon, aur jab paani (ya doodh) peeti hoon, to pet bhar kar peeti hoon. Abu Zar ki maa, aur Abu Zar ki maa ki tareef mein kya kahoon? Unke thaile hamesha rasad se bhare rehte the aur unka ghar khula-khula tha. Aur Abu Zar ke bete ke baare mein, uske bete ke baare mein kya kahoon? Uska bistar ek nangi talwaar jitna tang hai, aur ek bache bakri ke bazu se hi uski bhookh mit jaati hai. Aur Abu Zar ki beti apne waalid aur maa ki farmaabardaar hai. Uska jism mota aur khoob-surat hai, jo uske shohar ki doosri biwi ki hasad ka sabab banta hai. Aur Abu Zar ki laundi ke baare mein kya kahoon? Wo hamaare raaz zaahir nahi karti, unhein sambhaal kar rakhti hai, aur na hamaara rasad zaaya karti hai, na hamaare ghar mein kachra bikharti hai.' Gyarahvi khaatoon ne aage kaha, 'Ek din Abu Zar us waqt baahar gaye jab doodh nikaala ja raha tha, aur unhone ek aisi aurat dekhi jiske do bete tende jaisa uske dono seenon ke saath khel rahe the. (Use dekh kar) unhone mujhe talaaq de di aur usse nikaah kar liya. Iske baad maine ek izzatdaar aadmi se nikaah kiya jo ek tez, na-thakane wala ghoda sawaari karta tha aur haath mein neza rakhta tha. Usne mujhe bahut si cheezein di, aur har qism ke maweshi ka ek jodha bhi diya, aur kaha, "Khaao, Aye Umm Zar, aur apne rishtedaaron ko rasad do."' Usne aage kaha, 'Phir bhi, jo kuch mere doosre shohar ne mujhe diya, wo Abu Zar ke sabse chhote bartan ko bhi nahi bhar sakta.' Aisha ne phir kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse kaha, 'Main tumhaare liye waisa hi hoon jaisa Abu Zar apni biwi Umm Zar ke liye tha.'

e: Narrated 'Urwa:Aisha said, "While the Ethiopians were playing with their small spears, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) screened me behind him and I watched (that display) and kept on watching till I left on my own." So you may estimate of what age a little girl may listen to amusement
hi: Urwa bataate hain: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha, 'Jab Habshi log apne chhote neze lekar khel rahe the, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe apne peechhe chhupa liya aur main (wo nazaara) dekhti rahi, yahaan tak ke main khud (dekhna band karke) chali gayi.' To andaaza lagaao ke kis umar ki chhoti ladki manoranjan dekhne ki ijaazat paa sakti hai.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I had been eager to ask `Umar bin Al-Khattab about the two ladies from among the wives of the Prophet regarding whom Allah said 'If you two (wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) namely Aisha and Hafsa) turn in repentance to Allah, your hearts are indeed so inclined (to oppose what the Prophet (ﷺ) likes). (66.4) till `Umar performed the Hajj and I too, performed the Hajj along with him. (On the way) `Umar went aside to answer the call of nature, and I also went aside along with him carrying a tumbler full of water, and when `Umar had finished answering the call of nature, I poured water over his hands and he performed the ablution. Then I said to him, "O chief of the Believers! Who were the two ladies from among the wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) regarding whom Allah said: 'If you two (wives of the Prophet) turn in repentance to Allah your hearts are indeed so inclined (to oppose what the Prophet (ﷺ) likes)?" (66.4) He said, "I am astonished at your question, O Ibn `Abbas. They were `Aisha and Hafsa." Then `Umar went on narrating the Hadith and said, "I and an Ansari neighbor of mine from Bani Umaiyya bin Zaid who used to live in `Awali-al-Medina, used to visit the Prophet (ﷺ) in turn. He used to go one day and I another day. When I went, I would bring him the news of what had happened that day regarding the Divine Inspiration and other things, and when he went, he used to do the same for me. We, the people of Quraish used to have the upper hand over our wives, but when we came to the Ansar, we found that their women had the upper hand over their men, so our women also started learning the ways of the Ansari women. I shouted at my wife and she retorted against me and I disliked that she should answer me back. She said to me, 'Why are you so surprised at my answering you back? By Allah, the wives of the Prophet answer him back and some of them may leave (does not speak to) him throughout the day till the night.' The (talk) scared me and I said to her, 'Whoever has done so will be ruined!' Then I proceeded after dressing myself, and entered upon Hafsa and said to her, 'Does anyone of you keep the Prophet (ﷺ) angry till night?' She said, 'Yes.' I said, 'You are a ruined losing person! Don't you fear that Allah may get angry for the anger of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and thus you will be ruined? So do not ask more from the Prophet (ﷺ) and do not answer him back and do not give up talking to him. Ask me whatever you need and do not be tempted to imitate your neighbor (i.e., `Aisha) in her manners for she is more charming than you and more beloved to the Prophet (ﷺ) ." `Umar added,"At that time a talk was circulating among us that (the tribe of) Ghassan were preparing their horses to invade us. My Ansari companion, on the day of his turn, went (to the town) and returned to us at night and knocked at my door violently and asked if I was there. I became horrified and came out to him. He said, 'Today a great thing has happened.' I asked, 'What is it? Have (the people of) Ghassan come?' He said, 'No, but (What has happened) is greater and more horrifying than that: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ); has divorced his wives. `Umar added, "The Prophet (ﷺ) kept away from his wives and I said "Hafsa is a ruined loser.' I had already thought that most probably this (divorce) would happen in the near future. So I dressed myself and offered the morning prayer with the Prophet (ﷺ) and then the Prophet; entered an upper room and stayed there in seclusion. I entered upon Hafsa and saw her weeping. I asked, 'What makes you weep? Did I not warn you about that? Did the Prophet (ﷺ) divorce you all?' She said, 'I do not know. There he is retired alone in the upper room.' I came out and sat near the pulpit and saw a group of people sitting around it and some of them were weeping. I sat with them for a while but could not endure the situation, so I went to the upper room where the Prophet; was and said to a black slave of his, 'Will you get the permission (of the Prophet (ﷺ) ) for `Umar (to enter)?' The slave went in, talked to the Prophet (ﷺ) about it and then returned saying, 'I have spoken to the Prophet (ﷺ) and mentioned you but he kept quiet.' Then I returned and sat with the group of people sitting near the pulpit. but I could not bear the situation and once again I said to the slave, 'Will you get the permission for `Umar?' He went in and returned saying, 'I mentioned you to him but he kept quiet.' So I returned again and sat with the group of people sitting near the pulpit, but I could not bear the situation, and so I went to the slave and said, 'Will you get the permission for `Umar?' He went in and returned to me saying, 'I mentioned you to him but he kept quiet.' When I was leaving, behold! The slave called me, saying, 'The Prophet (ﷺ) has given you permission.' Then I entered upon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and saw him Lying on a bed made of stalks of date palm leaves and there was no bedding between it and him. The stalks left marks on his side and he was leaning on a leather pillow stuffed with date-palm fibres. I greeted him and while still standing I said, 'O Allah's Apostle! Have you divorced your wives?' He looked at me and said, 'No.' I said, 'Allah Akbar!' And then, while still standing, I said chatting, 'Will you heed what I say, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? We, the people of Quraish used to have power over our women, but when we arrived at Medina we found that the men (here) were overpowered by their women.' The Prophet (ﷺ) smiled and then I said to him, 'Will you heed what I say, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? I entered upon Hafsa and said to her, "Do not be tempted to imitate your companion (`Aisha), for she is more charming than you and more beloved to the Prophet.' " The Prophet (ﷺ) smiled for a second time. When I saw him smiling, I sat down. Then I looked around his house, and by Allah, I could not see anything of importance in his house except three hides, so I said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Invoke Allah to make your followers rich, for the Persians and the Romans have been made prosperous and they have been given (the pleasures of the world), although they do not worship Allah.' Thereupon the Prophet (ﷺ) sat up as he was reclining. and said, 'Are you of such an opinion, O the son of Al-Khattab? These are the people who have received the rewards for their good deeds in this world.' I said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Ask Allah to forgive me.' Then the Prophet (ﷺ) kept away from his wives for twenty-nine days because of the story which Hafsa had disclosed to `Aisha. The Prophet (ﷺ) had said, 'I will not enter upon them (my wives) for one month,' because of his anger towards them, when Allah had admonished him. So, when twenty nine days had passed, the Prophet (ﷺ) first entered upon `Aisha. `Aisha said to him, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! You had sworn that you would not enter upon us for one month, but now only twenty-nine days have passed, for I have been counting them one by one.' The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'The (present) month is of twenty nine days.' `Aisha added, 'Then Allah revealed the Verses of the option. (2) And out of all his-wives he asked me first, and I chose him.' Then he gave option to his other wives and they said what `Aisha had said . " (1) The Prophet, ' had decided to abstain from eating a certain kind of food because of a certain event, so Allah blamed him for doing so. Some of his wives were the cause of him taking that decision, therefore he deserted them for one month. See Qur'an:
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main bahut arse se Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab se un do khaatoonon ke baare mein poochna chahta tha jinke baare mein Allah ne farmaya: 'Agar tum dono (Nabi ki azwaaj, yaani Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) aur Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا)) Allah ki taraf tauba karo, to tumhaare dil waaqai (Nabi ki napasand baat ke khilaaf) jhuk gaye hain.' (66:4) Yahaan tak ke Umar ne Hajj kiya aur main bhi unke saath gaya. (Raaste mein) Umar qaza-e-haajat ke liye alag gaye aur main bhi paani ka bartan lekar unke saath gaya, aur jab Umar faarigh ho gaye, maine unke haathon par paani daala aur unhone wuzu kiya. Phir maine unse kaha, 'Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen! Nabi ki azwaaj mein se wo do khaatoonein kaun thin jinke baare mein Allah ne farmaya: "Agar tum dono Allah ki taraf tauba karo, to tumhaare dil waaqai jhuk gaye hain"?' (66:4) Unhone kaha, 'Mujhe tumhaare sawaal par hairaani hui, Aye Ibn Abbas. Wo Aisha aur Hafsa thin.' Phir Umar ne poori kahaani sunaayi aur kaha, 'Main aur mera Ansaari padosi, Banu Umaiyya bin Zaid se, jo Awali-al-Madina mein rehte the, hum baari baari Nabi (SAW) se milne jaate the. Wo ek din jaate aur main doosre din. Jab main jaata, to unhein us din ke wahi aur doosri baaton ki khabar deta, aur jab wo jaate, to wo mere liye wahi karte. Hum Quraish walon ki apni biwiyon par hukmaraani hoti thi, magar jab hum Ansaar ke paas aaye, to humne paaya ke unki auraton ki apne mardon par hukmaraani hai, isliye hamaari auraten bhi Ansaari auraton ke tareeke seekhne lagi. Maine apni biwi par chillaaya aur usne mujhe jawab diya, aur mujhe ye pasand nahi aaya ke wo mujhe jawab de. Usne mujhse kaha, "Tumhein mere jawab dene par itni hairaani kyun hoti hai? Allah ki qasam, Nabi (SAW) ki biwiyaan bhi unhein jawab deti hain, aur unmein se koi to poore din raat tak unse baat nahi karti." Ye baat sunkar mujhe dar laga aur maine kaha, "Jisne bhi aisa kiya hai, wo tabaah ho jaayega!" Phir main kapde pehankar Hafsa ke paas gaya aur unse kaha, "Kya tum mein se koi Nabi (SAW) ko raat tak naaraaz rakhti hai?" Unhone kaha, "Haan." Maine kaha, "Tum tabaah ho jaane wali ho! Kya tumhein dar nahi ke kahin Allah, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki naaraazgi ki wajah se naaraaz na ho jaaye aur tum tabaah ho jaao? Isliye Nabi se zyaada mat maango, unhein jawab mat do, aur unse baat karna mat chhodo. Jo bhi zaroorat ho mujhse maango, aur apni padosan (yaani Aisha) ke tareeke apnaane ka lalach mat karo, kyunke wo tumse zyaada aziz hai aur Nabi ki nazron mein zyaada mahboob hai."' Umar ne aage kaha, 'Us waqt hamare beech ye baat chal rahi thi ke Ghassan qabeela hum par hamla karne ke liye apne ghode taiyaar kar raha hai. Mera Ansaari saathi, apni baari ke din, (shehar) gaya aur raat ko wapas aaya aur mera darwaaza zor se khatkhataaya aur pucha ke kya main andar hoon. Main dar gaya aur baahar aaya. Usne kaha, "Aaj ek badi baat hui hai." Maine pucha, "Kya hua? Kya Ghassan aa gaya?" Usne kaha, "Nahi, magar isse bhi bada aur khaufnaak: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apni biwiyon ko talaaq de di hai." Umar ne aage kaha, 'Nabi (SAW) apni biwiyon se door rahe aur maine kaha, "Hafsa tabaah ho gayi." Mujhe pehle hi laga tha ke aisa (talaaq) jald ho sakta hai. To maine kapde pehne aur Nabi (SAW) ke saath Fajr ki namaz padhi, phir Nabi (SAW) ek upar wale kamre mein daakhil hue aur wahaan tanhaai mein rahe. Main Hafsa ke paas gaya aur unhein rote hue paaya. Maine pucha, "Kis baat ne tumhein rulaaya? Kya maine tumhein khabardaar nahi kiya tha? Kya Nabi (SAW) ne tum sab ko talaaq de di?" Unhone kaha, "Mujhe nahi pata. Wahaan wo akele us upar wale kamre mein hain." Main baahar aaya aur mimbar ke paas baitha, aur wahaan kuch log baithe the, unmein se kuch ro rahe the. Main unke saath kuch der baitha magar ye haalat bardaasht na kar saka, to main us upar wale kamre ki taraf gaya jahaan Nabi (SAW) the, aur unke ek kaale ghulaam se kaha, "Kya tum Umar ke liye (Nabi ki) ijaazat le sakte ho?" Ghulaam andar gaya, Nabi se baat ki aur wapas aakar kaha, "Maine Nabi (SAW) se baat ki aur aapka zikr kiya magar wo khaamosh rahe." Phir main wapas gaya aur mimbar ke paas baithe logon ke saath baitha. magar main haalat bardaasht na kar saka aur dobara ghulaam se kaha, "Kya tum Umar ke liye ijaazat le sakte ho?" Wo andar gaya aur wapas aakar kaha, "Maine aapka zikr kiya magar wo khaamosh rahe." Main phir wapas gaya aur mimbar ke paas baithe logon ke saath baitha, magar main haalat bardaasht na kar saka, aur main ghulaam ke paas gaya aur kaha, "Kya tum Umar ke liye ijaazat le sakte ho?" Wo andar gaya aur mere paas wapas aakar kaha, "Maine aapka zikr kiya magar wo khaamosh rahe." Jab main jaa raha tha, achaanak ghulaam ne mujhe bulaaya aur kaha, "Nabi (SAW) ne aapko ijaazat de di hai." Phir main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaya aur unhein khajoor ke patton ki chatai par lete hue paaya, aur unke aur chatai ke beech koi bistar nahi tha. Chatai ke nishaan unke pehlu par pade the, aur wo khajoor ki chhaal se bhare ek chamde ke takiye par tek lagaaye hue the. Maine unhein salaam kiya aur khade khade kaha, "Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya aapne apni biwiyon ko talaaq de di hai?" Unhone meri taraf dekha aur kaha, "Nahi." Maine kaha, "Allahu Akbar!" Phir khade khade maine kaha, "Kya aap suneinge jo main kehta hoon, Aye Allah ke Rasool? Hum Quraish walon ki apni auraton par hukmaraani thi, magar jab hum Madina pahunche, to humne paaya ke yahaan ke mardon par unki auraton ki hukmaraani hai." Nabi (SAW) muskuraaye. Phir maine unse kaha, "Kya aap suneinge jo main kehta hoon, Aye Allah ke Rasool? Main Hafsa ke paas gaya aur unse kaha, 'Apni saathan (Aisha) ke tareeke apnaane ka lalach mat karo, kyunke wo tumse zyaada aziz hai aur Nabi ki nazron mein zyaada mahboob hai.'" Nabi (SAW) doosri baar muskuraaye. Jab maine unhein muskuraate dekha, main baith gaya. Phir maine unke ghar ke chaaron taraf dekha, aur Allah ki qasam, mujhe unke ghar mein teen chamdon ke siwa koi ehmiyat wali cheez nazar nahi aayi, isliye maine kaha, "Aye Allah ke Rasool! Allah se dua kijiye ke wo aapke maanne walon ko ameer kare, kyunke Faaris aur Rome walon ko itni khushhaali di gayi hai, halaanke wo Allah ki ibaadat nahi karte." Isper Nabi (SAW) sidhe baith gaye (jo pehle tek lagaaye hue the) aur kaha, "Kya tumhaari yahi raay hai, Aye Ibn Al-Khattab? Ye wo log hain jinhein unke nek amaal ka badla isi duniya mein de diya gaya hai." Maine kaha, "Aye Allah ke Rasool! Allah se meri maafi maangiye." Phir Nabi (SAW) unnattis (29) dinon tak apni biwiyon se door rahe, us kahaani ki wajah se jo Hafsa ne Aisha ko batayi thi. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha tha, "Main ek mahine tak unke (apni biwiyon ke) paas nahi jaaunga," apni naaraazgi ki wajah se, jab Allah ne unhein tanbeeh ki thi. To jab unnattis din guzar gaye, Nabi (SAW) sabse pehle Aisha ke paas gaye. Aisha ne unse kaha, "Aye Allah ke Rasool! Aapne qasam khaayi thi ke aap hamare paas ek mahine tak nahi aayenge, magar abhi sirf unnattis din guzre hain, kyunke maine unhein ek-ek karke gina hai." Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, "Ye mahina unnattis dinon ka hai." Aisha ne aage kaha, "Phir Allah ne ikhtiyaar ki Aayaten naazil kin." Aur unhone sabse pehle mujhse hi pucha, aur maine unhein chuna. Phir unhone apni doosri biwiyon ko bhi ikhtiyaar diya aur unhone bhi wahi kaha jo Aisha ne kaha tha.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A woman should not fast (optional fasts) except with her husband's permission if he is at home (staying with her)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ek aurat ko (nafl) roza tab tak nahi rakhna chaahiye jab tak uske shohar ki ijaazat na ho, agar wo ghar mein maujood ho (uske saath ho).'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If a man Invites his wife to sleep with him and she refuses to come to him, then the angels send their curses on her till morning
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar koi aadmi apni biwi ko apne saath sone ki dawat de aur wo aane se inkaar kare, to Farishte subah tak usper laanat bhejte rehte hain.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If a woman spends the night deserting her husband's bed (does not sleep with him), then the angels send their curses on her till she comes back (to her husband)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar koi aurat apne shohar ka bistar chhod kar raat guzaare (uske saath na soye), to Farishte usper tab tak laanat bhejte rehte hain jab tak wo wapas (apne shohar ke paas) na aa jaaye.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "It is not lawful for a lady to fast (Nawafil) without the permission of her husband when he is at home; and she should not allow anyone to enter his house except with his permission; and if she spends of his wealth (on charitable purposes) without being ordered by him, he will get half of the reward
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kisi aurat ke liye jaayez nahi ke wo (nafl) roza rakhe apne shohar ki ijaazat ke bagair jab wo ghar mein maujood ho; aur usse kisi ko bhi ghar mein daakhil nahi hone dena chaahiye siwaaye uski ijaazat ke; aur agar wo uske hukm ke bagair uske maal se (khairaat) kharch kare, to uske shohar ko bhi (uske) aadhe ajr ka haq milega.'

e: Narrated Usama:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I stood at the gate of Paradise and saw that the majority of the people who entered it were the poor, while the wealthy were stopped at the gate (for the accounts). But the companions of the Fire were ordered to be taken to the Fire. Then I stood at the gate of the Fire and saw that the majority of those who entered it were women
hi: Usama bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Main Jannat ke darwaaze par khada hua aur dekha ke jo log usme daakhil ho rahe the unmein zyaadatar gareeb the, jabke ameeron ko darwaaze par roka gaya (hisaab ke liye). Aur Jahannami logon ko Jahannam mein bhejne ka hukm diya gaya. Phir main Jahannam ke darwaaze par khada hua aur dekha ke usme daakhil hone walon mein zyaadatar auraten thin.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abbas:During the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), the sun eclipsed. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) offered the prayer of (the) eclipse) and so did the people along with him. He performed a long Qiyam (standing posture) during which Surat-al-Baqara could have been recited; then he performed a pro-longed bowing, then raised his head and stood for a long time which was slightly less than that of the first Qiyam (and recited Qur'an). Then he performed a prolonged bowing again but the period was shorter than the period of the first bowing, then he stood up and then prostrated. Again he stood up, but this time the period of standing was less than the first standing. Then he performed a prolonged bowing but of a lesser duration than the first, then he stood up again for a long time but for a lesser duration than the first. Then he performed a prolonged bowing but of lesser duration than the first, and then he again stood up, and then prostrated and then finished his prayer. By then the sun eclipse had cleared. The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "The sun and the moon are two signs among the signs of Allah, and they do not eclipse because of the death or birth of someone, so when you observe the eclipse, remember Allah (offer the eclipse prayer)." They (the people) said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We saw you stretching your hand to take something at this place of yours, then we saw you stepping backward." He said, "I saw Paradise (or Paradise was shown to me), and I stretched my hand to pluck a bunch (of grapes), and had I plucked it, you would have eaten of it as long as this world exists. Then I saw the (Hell) Fire, and I have never before, seen such a horrible sight as that, and I saw that the majority of its dwellers were women." The people asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What is the reason for that?" He replied, "Because of their ungratefulness." It was said. "Do they disbelieve in Allah (are they ungrateful to Allah)?" He replied, "They are not thankful to their husbands and are ungrateful for the favors done to them. Even if you do good to one of them all your life, when she seems some harshness from you, she will say, "I have never seen any good from you
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ke daur mein ek baar suraj grahan hua. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne grahan ki namaz padhi aur log bhi unke saath padhe. Unhone lamba Qiyaam kiya jismein Surah Al-Baqarah padhi ja sakti thi, phir lamba ruku kiya, phir sar uthaakar phir lambi der khade rahe jo pehle Qiyaam se thoda kam thi (aur Quran padha). Phir unhone doosra lamba ruku kiya magar pehle ruku se chhota, phir khade hue aur phir sajda kiya. Phir wo khade hue, magar is baar khade hone ki muddat pehli baar se kam thi. Phir unhone lamba ruku kiya magar pehle se kam, phir dobara lambi der khade rahe magar pehle se kam. Phir unhone lamba ruku kiya magar pehle se kam, aur phir khade hue, phir sajda kiya aur apni namaz khatam ki. Us waqt tak suraj grahan khatam ho chuka tha. Nabi (SAW) ne phir farmaya, 'Suraj aur chaand Allah ki nishaaniyon mein se do nishaaniyaan hain, aur wo kisi ki maut ya paidaish ki wajah se grahan nahi hote, isliye jab tum grahan dekho, to Allah ko yaad karo (grahan ki namaz padho).' Logon ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Humne dekha ke aap apni jagah kuch pakadne ke liye haath badha rahe the, phir humne dekha ke aap peeche hat rahe the.' Unhone farmaya, 'Maine Jannat dekhi (ya Jannat mujhe dikhaayi gayi), aur maine angoor ka ek guchcha todne ke liye apna haath badhaaya, aur agar main use tod leta, to tum log is duniya ke rehte tak usse khaate rehte. Phir maine (Jahannam ki) Aag dekhi, aur maine kabhi is se pehle aisa khaufnaak manzar nahi dekha tha, aur maine dekha ke usme zyaadatar log auraten thin.' Logon ne pucha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Iski kya wajah hai?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Unki na-shukri ki wajah se.' Pucha gaya, 'Kya wo Allah ka inkaar karti hain?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Wo apne shauharon ki shukr-guzaar nahi hoti aur unke ehsaanon ki na-shukri karti hain. Agar tum unmein se kisi ke saath saari zindagi bhalaai karo, aur wo tumse thodi si sakhti dekh le, to wo kahegi, "Maine tumse kabhi koi bhalaai nahi dekhi."'

e: Narrated `Imran:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I looked at Paradise and saw that the majority of its residents were the poor; and I looked at the (Hell) Fire and saw that the majority of its residents were women
hi: Imran bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Maine Jannat mein dekha aur paaya ke usme zyaadatar log gareeb the; aur maine (Jahannam ki) Aag mein dekha aur paaya ke usme zyaadatar log auraten thin.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr bin Al-`As:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O `Abdullah! Have I not been formed that you fast all the day and stand in prayer all night?" I said, "Yes, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" He said, "Do not do that! Observe the fast sometimes and also leave them (the fast) at other times; stand up for the prayer at night and also sleep at night. Your body has a right over you, your eyes have a right over you and your wife has a right over you
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-As bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Aye Abdullah! Kya mujhe bataya nahi gaya ke tum poore din roza rakhte ho aur poori raat namaz mein khade rehte ho?' Maine kaha, 'Haan, Aye Allah ke Rasool!' Unhone farmaya, 'Aisa mat karo! Kabhi roza rakho aur kabhi chhodo; raat ko namaz padho aur raat ko so bhi lo. Tumhaare jism ka bhi tumpar haq hai, tumhaari aankhon ka bhi tumpar haq hai, aur tumhaari biwi ka bhi tumpar haq hai.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "All of you are guardians and are responsible for your wards. The ruler is a guardian and the man is a guardian of his family; the lady is a guardian and is responsible for her husband's house and his offspring; and so all of you are guardians and are responsible for your wards
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Tum sab nigraan ho aur apni zimmedaari ke liye jawaabdeh ho. Hukmaraan nigraan hai; aadmi apne khaandaan ka nigraan hai; aurat nigraan hai aur apne shohar ke ghar aur uski aulaad ke liye zimmedaar hai; aur is tarah tum sab nigraan ho aur apni zimmedaari ke liye jawaabdeh ho.'

e: Narrated Anas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took an oath that he would not visit his wives for one month, and he sat in an upper room belonging to him. Then, on the twenty ninth day he came down. It was said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! You had taken an oath not to visit your wives for one month." He said, "The (present) month is of twenty-nine days
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne qasam khaayi ke wo ek mahine tak apni biwiyon ke paas nahi jaayenge, aur wo apne ek upar wale kamre mein baith gaye. Phir unnattisvein din wo neeche utre. Kaha gaya, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Aapne qasam khaayi thi ke aap ek mahine tak apni biwiyon ke paas nahi jaayenge.' Unhone farmaya, 'Ye (mojooda) mahina unnattis dinon ka hai.'

e: Narrated Um Salama:The Prophet (ﷺ) took an oath that he would not enter upon some of his wives for one month. But when twenty nine days had elapsed, he went to them in the morning or evening. It was said to him, "O Allah's Prophet! You had taken an oath that you would not enter upon them for one month." He replied, "The month can be of twenty nine days
hi: Umm Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ne qasam khaayi ke wo ek mahine tak apni kuch biwiyon ke paas nahi jaayenge. Magar jab unnattis din guzar gaye, wo subah ya shaam unke paas gaye. Unse kaha gaya, 'Aye Allah ke Nabi! Aapne qasam khaayi thi ke ek mahine tak unke paas nahi jaayenge.' Unhone jawab diya, 'Mahina unnattis dinon ka bhi ho sakta hai.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:One morning we saw the wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) weeping, and everyone of them had her family with her, I went to the mosque and found that it was crowded with people. Then `Umar bin Al-Khattab came and went up to the Prophet (ﷺ) who was in his upper room. He greeted him but nobody answered. He greeted again, but nobody answered. Then the gatekeeper called him and he entered upon the Prophet, and asked, "Have you divorced your wives?" The Prophet, said, "No, but I have taken an oath not to go to them for one month." So the Prophet (ﷺ) stayed away (from his wives) for twenty nine days and then entered upon them
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek subah humne Nabi (SAW) ki azwaaj ko rote dekha, aur har ek ke saath uska khaandaan tha. Main Masjid gaya aur paaya ke wo logon se bhari thi. Phir Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab aaye aur Nabi (SAW) ke paas gaye jo apne upar wale kamre mein the. Unhone salaam kiya, kisi ne jawab nahi diya. Dobara salaam kiya, phir bhi kisi ne jawab nahi diya. Phir darwaan ne unhein bulaaya aur wo Nabi (SAW) ke paas daakhil hue, aur pucha, 'Kya aapne apni biwiyon ko talaaq de di?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Nahi, magar maine qasam khaayi hai ke ek mahine tak unke paas nahi jaaunga.' To Nabi (SAW) unnattis dinon tak (biwiyon se) door rahe, phir unke paas gaye.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Zam`a:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "None of you should flog his wife as he flogs a slave and then have sexual intercourse with her in the last part of the day
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Zam'a bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Tum mein se koi apni biwi ko ghulaam ki tarah koda na maare aur phir din ke aakhri hisse mein uske saath humbistari kare.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:An Ansari woman gave her daughter in marriage and the hair of the latter started falling out. The Ansari women came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and mentioned that to him and said, "Her (my daughter's) husband suggested that I should let her wear false hair." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No, (don't do that) for Allah sends His curses upon such ladies who lengthen their hair artificially
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ek Ansaari khaatoon ne apni beti ka nikaah karwaaya, aur uske baal jhadne lage. Ansaari khaatoon Nabi (SAW) ke paas aayi aur unhein ye baat bataayi aur kaha, 'Uske (meri beti ke) shohar ne sujhaav diya hai ke main use nakli baal lagwaane doon.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Nahi, (aisa mat karo), kyunke Allah aisi auraton par laanat bhejta hai jo apne baal kritrim tareeke se lambe karti hain.'

e: (Narrated Aisha:regarding the Verse: 'If a wife fears cruelty or desertion on her husband's part ...') (4.128) It concerns the woman whose husband does not want to keep her with him any longer, but wants to divorce her and marry some other lady, so she says to him: 'Keep me and do not divorce me, and then marry another woman, and you may neither spend on me, nor sleep with me.' This is indicated by the Statement of Allah: 'There is no blame on them if they arrange an amicable settlement between them both, and (such) settlement is better
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) is Aayat ke baare mein bataati hain: 'Agar biwi ko apne shohar ki taraf se sakhti ya be-rukhi ka dar ho...'
