(4:128) Ye us aurat ke baare mein hai jiska shohar use aage apne paas rakhna nahi chaahta, balke use talaaq dekar kisi aur se nikaah karna chaahta hai, isliye wo usse kehti hai: 'Mujhe rakho aur talaaq mat do, phir kisi doosri aurat se nikaah kar lo, aur tumhein na mujhpar kharch karna hoga na mere saath sona hoga.' Isi ka ishara Allah ke is farmaan mein hai: 'Unpar koi gunaah nahi agar wo aapas mein koi sulah kar lein, aur sulah hi behtar hai.'

e: Narrated Jabir:We used to practice coitus interruptus during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zindagi mein Azl (sambhog ke dauraan bahar nikaalne ka tareeka) karte the.

e: Narrated Jabir:We used to practice coitus interruptus while the Qur'an was being revealed. Jabir added: We used to practice coitus interruptus during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while the Qur'an was being Revealed
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Azl karte the jabke Quran naazil ho raha tha. Jabir ne aage kaha: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zindagi mein Azl karte the jabke Quran naazil ho raha tha.

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:We got female captives in the war booty and we used to do coitus interruptus with them. So we asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about it and he said, "Do you really do that?" repeating the question thrice, "There is no soul that is destined to exist but will come into existence, till the Day of Resurrection
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Humein jang ke maal-e-ganimat mein kuch auraten (qaidiyaan) milin aur hum unke saath Azl kiya karte the. To humne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se iske baare mein pucha, unhone farmaya, 'Kya tum waaqai aisa karte ho?' - teen baar ye sawaal dohraate hue - 'Koi bhi rooh jo paida hone ke liye muqarrar hai, wo zaroor paida hogi, Qayamat tak.'

e: Narrated al-Qasim:Aisha said that whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) intended to go on a journey, he drew lots among his wives (so as to take one of them along with him). During one of his journeys the lot fell on `Aisha and Hafsa. When night fell the Prophet (ﷺ) would ride beside `Aisha and talk with her. One night Hafsa said to `Aisha, "Won't you ride my camel tonight and I ride yours, so that you may see (me) and I see (you) (in new situation)?" `Aisha said, "Yes, (I agree.)" So `Aisha rode, and then the Prophet (ﷺ) came towards `Aisha's camel on which Hafsa was riding. He greeted Hafsa and then proceeded (beside her) till they dismounted (on the way). `Aisha missed him, and so, when they dismounted, she put her legs in the Idhkhir and said, "O Lord (Allah)! Send a scorpion or a snake to bite me for I am not to blame him (the Prophet (ﷺ)
hi: Al-Qasim bataate hain: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha ke jab bhi Nabi (SAW) safar par jaane ka iraada karte, wo apni biwiyon mein qura (lottery) daalte (taake unmein se ek unke saath jaaye). Ek safar mein qura Aisha aur Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke naam nikla. Jab raat hoti, Nabi (SAW) Aisha ke paas sawaar hokar unse baat karte. Ek raat Hafsa ne Aisha se kaha, 'Kya tum aaj raat mera oont sawaar nahi karogi aur main tumhaara karoon, taake tum (mujhe) dekh sako aur main (tumhein) dekh sakoon (naye andaaz mein)?' Aisha ne kaha, 'Haan, (main razi hoon).' To Aisha (Hafsa ke oont par) sawaar hui, phir Nabi (SAW) Aisha ke oont ki taraf aaye jispar Hafsa sawaar thi. Unhone Hafsa ko salaam kiya aur (unke paas) chalte rahe yahaan tak ke wo utre (raaste mein). Aisha ko unki kami mehsoos hui, to jab wo utri, unhone apne paanv Idhkhir (ek ghaas) mein rakhe aur kaha, 'Aye mere Rab! Mujhe kaatne ke liye ek bicchu ya saanp bhej de, kyunke main use (Nabi ko) qusoorwaar nahi thehraati.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:Sauda bint Zam`a gave up her turn to me (`Aisha), and so the Prophet (ﷺ) used to give me (`Aisha) both my day and the day of Sauda
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Sauda (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Zam'a ne apni baari mujhe (Aisha ko) de di, isliye Nabi (SAW) mujhe meri apni baari aur Sauda ki baari dono dete the.

e: Narrated Anas:The tradition, (of the Prophet) is that if someone marries a virgin and he has already a matron wife (with him), then he should stay with the virgin for seven days; and if someone marries a matron (and he has already a virgin wife with him) then he should stay with her for three days
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: (Nabi ka) tareeka ye hai ke agar koi kunwaari se nikaah kare jabke uski pehle se biwaa biwi (uske saath) ho, to use kunwaari ke saath saat din rehna chaahiye; aur agar koi biwaa se nikaah kare (jabke uski pehle se kunwaari biwi ho), to use uske saath teen din rehna chaahiye.

e: Narrated Anas:It is the Prophet's tradition that if someone marries a virgin and he has already a matron wife then he should stay for seven days with her (the virgin) and then by turns; and if someone marries a matron and he has already a virgin wife then he should stay with her (the matron) for three days, and then by turns
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ka tareeka hai ke agar koi kunwaari se nikaah kare jabke uski pehle se biwaa biwi ho, to use uske (kunwaari ke) saath saat din rehna chaahiye, phir baari baari; aur agar koi biwaa se nikaah kare jabke uski pehle se kunwaari biwi ho, to use uske (biwaa ke) saath teen din rehna chaahiye, phir baari baari.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to pass by (have sexual relation with) all his wives in one night, and at that time he had nine wives
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ek hi raat mein apni sab biwiyon ke paas jaate the, aur us waqt unki nau biwiyaan thin.

e: Narrated `Aisha:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) finished his `Asr prayer, he would enter upon his wives and stay with one of them. One day he went to Hafsa and stayed with her longer than usual
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab bhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Asr ki namaz khatam karte, wo apni biwiyon ke paas jaate aur unmein se ek ke paas rukte. Ek din wo Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas gaye aur maamool se zyaada der unke paas ruke.

e: Narrated `Aisha:that during his fatal ailment, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), used to ask his wives, "Where shall I stay tomorrow? Where shall I stay tomorrow?" He was looking forward to Aisha's turn. So all his wives allowed him to stay where he wished, and he stayed at `Aisha's house till he died there. `Aisha added: He died on the day of my usual turn at my house. Allah took him unto Him while his head was between my chest and my neck and his saliva was mixed with my saliva
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Apni aakhri bimari ke dauraan, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apni biwiyon se poochte the, 'Main kal kahaan rahunga? Main kal kahaan rahunga?' Wo Aisha ki baari ka intezaar kar rahe the. To sab biwiyon ne unhein ijaazat de di ke wo jahaan chaahein rahein, aur wo Aisha ke ghar mein rahe yahaan tak ke wahin unka intekaal ho gaya. Aisha ne aage kaha: Unka intekaal usi din hua jab mere ghar mein meri maamooli baari thi. Allah ne unhein apne paas bula liya jabke unka sar mere seene aur gardan ke beech tha aur unka lar mere lar mein mil gaya tha.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:that `Umar entered upon Hafsa and said, "O my daughter! Do not be misled by the manners of her who is proud of her beauty because of the love of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for her." By 'her' he meant `Aisha. `Umar added, "Then I told that to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he smiled (on hearing that)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas gaye aur kaha, 'Aye meri beti! Uski chaal-dhaal se dhoka mat khaana jo apni khoobsurati par ghamand karti hai kyunke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) usse mohabbat karte hain.' 'Uski' se unka ishara Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ki taraf tha. Umar ne aage kaha, 'Phir maine ye baat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko bataayi aur wo (ye sunkar) muskuraaye.'

e: Narrated Asma:Some lady said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! My husband has another wife, so it is sinful of me to claim that he has given me what he has not given me (in order to tease her)?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, The one who pretends that he has been given what he has not been given, is just like the (false) one who wears two garments of falsehood
hi: Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataate hain: Ek khaatoon ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mere shohar ki ek aur biwi bhi hai, to kya mera ye kehna gunaah hai ke usne mujhe wo diya hai jo usne nahi diya (taake main use chidhaa saku)?' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo shaks aisa zaahir kare ke use wo diya gaya hai jo nahi diya gaya, wo uske jaisa hai jo jhoot ke do kapde pehne hue ho.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Masud:The Prophet, said, "There is none having a greater sense of Ghira than Allah. And for that He has forbidden the doing of evil actions (illegal sexual intercourse etc.) There is none who likes to be praised more than Allah does
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Masud bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah se zyaada ghairat rakhne wala koi nahi, isi wajah se usne buri harkatein (jaise zina) haraam qaraar di hain. Aur Allah se zyaada apni taareef pasand karne wala koi nahi.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O followers of Muhammad! There is none, who has a greater sense of Ghira (self-respect) than Allah, so He has forbidden that His slave commits illegal sexual intercourse or His slave girl commits illegal sexual intercourse. O followers of Muhammad! If you but knew what I know, you would laugh less and weep more
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Aye Muhammad ke maanne walo! Allah se zyaada ghairat (khud-daari) rakhne wala koi nahi, isi wajah se usne apne bande ke zina karne ko aur apni bandi ke zina karne ko haraam qaraar diya hai. Aye Muhammad ke maanne walo! Agar tumhein wo pata hota jo mujhe pata hai, to tum kam hansate aur zyaada rote.'

e: Narrated Asma':I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "There is nothing (none) having a greater sense of Ghira (self-respect) than Allah." And narrated Abu Huraira that he heard the Prophet (saying the same)
hi: Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Allah se zyaada ghairat rakhne wala koi nahi.' Aur Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne bhi Nabi (SAW) se yahi sunne ki riwayat ki hai.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet; said, "Allah has a sense of Ghira, and Allah's sense of Ghira is provoked when a believer does something which Allah has prohibited
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah ki ghairat hoti hai, aur Allah ki ghairat tab jaagti hai jab koi momin aisa kaam kare jo Allah ne haraam kiya ho.'

e: Narrated Asma' bint Abu Bakr:When Az-Zubair married me, he had no real property or any slave or anything else except a camel which drew water from the well, and his horse. I used to feed his horse with fodder and drew water and sew the bucket for drawing it, and prepare the dough, but I did not know how to bake bread. So our Ansari neighbors used to bake bread for me, and they were honorable ladies. I used to carry the date stones on my head from Zubair's land given to him by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and this land was two third Farsakh (about two miles) from my house. One day, while I was coming with the date stones on my head, I met Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) along with some Ansari people. He called me and then, (directing his camel to kneel down) said, "Ikh! Ikh!" so as to make me ride behind him (on his camel). I felt shy to travel with the men and remembered Az-Zubair and his sense of Ghira, as he was one of those people who had the greatest sense of Ghira. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) noticed that I felt shy, so he proceeded. I came to Az-Zubair and said, "I met Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while I was carrying a load of date stones on my head, and he had some companions with him. He made his camel kneel down so that I might ride, but I felt shy in his presence and remembered your sense of Ghira (See the glossary). On that Az-Zubair said, "By Allah, your carrying the date stones (and you being seen by the Prophet (ﷺ) in such a state) is more shameful to me than your riding with him." (I continued serving in this way) till Abu Bakr sent me a servant to look after the horse, whereupon I felt as if he had set me free
hi: Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Abu Bakr (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne mujhse nikaah kiya, unke paas koi zameen, ghulaam ya aur kuch nahi tha siwaaye ek oont ke jo kuen se paani kheenchta tha, aur unke ghode ke. Main unke ghode ko chaara khilaati, paani kheenchti, paani nikaalne ki dol siti, aur aata gundh-ti, magar mujhe roti banaana nahi aata tha. To hamaare Ansaari padosi mere liye roti banaaya karti thin, aur wo bahut izzatdaar khawaatin thin. Main Zubair ki zameen se, jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhein di thi, khajoor ki guthliyaan apne sar par le jaaya karti thi, aur ye zameen mere ghar se do-tihaai Farsakh (taqreeban do meel) door thi. Ek din, jab main sar par khajoor ki guthliyaan lekar aa rahi thi, main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se mili jinke saath kuch Ansaari log the. Unhone mujhe bulaaya aur (apne oont ko baithane ka ishara karke) kaha, 'Ikh! Ikh!' taake main unke (oont ke) peechhe sawaar ho jaaun. Mujhe mardon ke saath safar karne mein sharm mehsoos hui aur mujhe Az-Zubair aur unki ghairat yaad aayi, kyunke wo un logon mein se the jinme sabse zyaada ghairat thi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mahsoos kiya ke mujhe sharm aa rahi hai, isliye wo aage badh gaye. Main Az-Zubair ke paas aayi aur kaha, 'Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se mili jabke main apne sar par khajoor ki guthliyon ka bojh lekar aa rahi thi, aur unke saath kuch sahaaba the. Unhone apna oont bithaaya taake main sawaar ho jaaun, magar unki maujoodgi mein mujhe sharm aayi aur mujhe aapki ghairat yaad aayi.' Isper Az-Zubair ne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, tumhaara khajoor ki guthliyaan uthaana (aur Nabi ke saamne aise dikhna) mere liye unke saath sawaar hone se zyaada sharm ki baat hai.' (Main isi tarah kaam karti rahi) yahaan tak ke Abu Bakr ne mere paas ek naukar bheja jo ghode ki dekhbhaal karta, aur mujhe laga jaise unhone mujhe azaad kar diya ho.

e: Narrated Anas:While the Prophet (ﷺ) was in the house of one of his wives, one of the mothers of the believers sent a meal in a dish. The wife at whose house the Prophet (ﷺ) was, struck the hand of the servant, causing the dish to fall and break. The Prophet (ﷺ) gathered the broken pieces of the dish and then started collecting on them the food which had been in the dish and said, "Your mother (my wife) felt jealous." Then he detained the servant till a (sound) dish was brought from the wife at whose house he was. He gave the sound dish to the wife whose dish had been broken and kept the broken one at the house where it had been broken
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Nabi (SAW) apni ek biwi ke ghar the, Ummahaat-ul-Momineen mein se ek ne khaana ek thaali mein bheja. Jis biwi ke ghar Nabi (SAW) the, unhone naukar ka haath maara, jisse thaali gir kar toot gayi. Nabi (SAW) ne thaali ke tukde ikattha kiye aur unpar wo khaana jama karne lage jo thaali mein tha, aur farmaya, 'Tumhaari maa (yaani meri biwi) ko jalan hui hai.' Phir unhone naukar ko roka jab tak us biwi se ek achhi thaali nahi laayi gayi jinke ghar wo the. Unhone wo achhi thaali us biwi ko di jiski thaali toot gayi thi, aur toota hua thaali usi ghar mein rakh diya jahaan wo toota tha.

e: Narrated Jabir:The Prophet, said, "I entered Paradise and saw a palace and asked whose palace is this? They (the Angels) said, "This palace belongs to `Umar bin Al-Khattab.' I intended to enter it, and nothing stopped me except my knowledge about your sense of Ghira (self-respect (O `Umar)." `Umar said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Let my father and mother be sacrificed for you! O Allah's Prophet! How dare I think of my Ghira (self-respect) being offended by you?
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Main Jannat mein daakhil hua aur ek mahal dekha, maine pucha, "Ye kiska mahal hai?" Unhone (Farishton ne) kaha, "Ye mahal Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab ka hai." Main isme daakhil hone ka iraada rakhta tha, magar mujhe sirf tumhaari ghairat (Aye Umar) ka ilm hi rokta raha.' Umar ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mere maa baap aap par qurbaan hon! Aye Allah ke Nabi! Main kaise soch sakta hoon ke mujhe aapse ghairat mehsoos ho?'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:While we were sitting with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), (he) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "While I was sleeping, I saw a woman performing ablution beside a palace. I asked, "Whose palace is this?' It was said, 'This palace belongs to `Umar.' Then I remembered his sense of Ghira and returned." On that `Umar started weeping in that gathering and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! How dare I think of my self-respect being offended by you?
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath baithe the, unhone farmaya, 'Jab main so raha tha, maine ek aurat ko ek mahal ke paas wuzu karte dekha. Maine pucha, "Ye kiska mahal hai?" Kaha gaya, "Ye mahal Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ka hai." Phir mujhe unki ghairat yaad aayi aur main laut aaya.' Isper Umar us majlis mein rone lage aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Main kaise soch sakta hoon ke mujhe aapse khud-daari (ghairat) mehsoos ho?'

e: Narrated Aisha:That Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to her, "I know when you are pleased with me or angry with me." I said, "Whence do you know that?" He said, "When you are pleased with me, you say, 'No, by the Lord of Muhammad,' but when you are angry with me, then you say, 'No, by the Lord of Abraham.' " Thereupon I said, "Yes (you are right), but by Allah, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), I leave nothing but your name
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha, 'Mujhe pata chal jaata hai jab tum mujhse khush hoti ho ya naaraaz.' Maine kaha, 'Aapko ye kaise pata chalta hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Jab tum mujhse khush hoti ho, to kehti ho, "Nahi, Muhammad ke Rab ki qasam," magar jab naaraaz hoti ho, to kehti ho, "Nahi, Ibrahim ke Rab ki qasam."' Isper maine kaha, 'Haan (aap sahi hain), magar Allah ki qasam, Aye Allah ke Rasool, main sirf aapka naam (na lena) chhodti hoon.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:I never felt so jealous of any wife of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as I did of Khadija because Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to remember and praise her too often and because it was revealed to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that he should give her (Khadija) the glad tidings of her having a palace of Qasab in Paradise
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Mujhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki kisi bhi biwi se itni jalan nahi hui jitni Khadija (رضی اللہ عنہا) se hui, kyunke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unhein aksar yaad karte aur unki tareef karte the, aur kyunke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) par ye wahi hui thi ke unhein Khadija ko Jannat mein Qasab (moti) ke ek mahal ki khush-khabri deni chaahiye.

e: Narrated Al-Miswar bin Makhrama:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who was on the pulpit, saying, "Banu Hisham bin Al-Mughira have requested me to allow them to marry their daughter to `Ali bin Abu Talib, but I don't give permission, and will not give permission unless `Ali bin Abi Talib divorces my daughter in order to marry their daughter, because Fatima is a part of my body, and I hate what she hates to see, and what hurts her, hurts me
hi: Al-Miswar bin Makhrama (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko, jab wo mimbar par the, ye farmaate suna, 'Banu Hisham bin Al-Mughira ne mujhse darkhwaast ki hai ke wo apni beti ka nikaah Ali (Alayhis Salam) bin Abu Talib se kar sakein, magar main ijaazat nahi deta, aur na hi doonga jab tak Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) meri beti ko talaaq na de dein taake unki beti se nikaah kar sakein, kyunke Fatima (Alayhas Salam) mere jism ka hissa hain, mujhe wahi napasand hai jo unhein napasand hai, aur jo unhein takleef deta hai wo mujhe bhi takleef deta hai.'

e: Narrated Anas:I will narrate to you a Habith I heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and none other than I will tell you of it. I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "From among the portents of the Hour are the following: Religious knowledge will be taken away; General ignorance (in religious matters) will increase; illegal Sexual intercourse will prevail: Drinking of alcoholic drinks will prevail. Men will decrease in number, and women will increase in number, so much so that fifty women will be looked after by one man
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main tumhein ek hadees sunaunga jo maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suni hai, aur mere siwa koi tumhein ye nahi sunaayega. Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Qayamat ki nishaaniyon mein se ye hain: Deeni ilm khatam ho jaayega, jahaalat (deeni maamlon mein) badh jaayegi, zina aam ho jaayega, sharaab peena aam ho jaayega, mard kam ho jaayenge aur auraten badh jaayengi, yahaan tak ke pachaas auraton ki dekhbhaal ek hi mard karega.'

e: Narrated `Uqba bin 'Amir:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Beware of entering upon the ladies." A man from the Ansar said, "Allah's Apostle! What about Al-Hamu the in-laws of the wife (the brothers of her husband or his nephews etc.)?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied: The in-laws of the wife are death itself
hi: Uqba bin Aamir bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Auraton ke paas (akele) jaane se bacho.' Ansaar ke ek shaks ne pucha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Al-Hamu (biwi ke sasural waale, yaani shohar ke bhai ya bhatije) ke baare mein kya khayaal hai?' Nabi (SAW) ne jawab diya, 'Biwi ke sasural waale to khud maut hain.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No man should stay with a lady in seclusion except in the presence of a Dhu-Mahram." A man stood up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! My wife has gone out intending to perform the Hajj and I have been enrolled (in the army) for such-and-such campaign." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Return and perform the Hajj with your wife
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Koi bhi aadmi kisi aurat ke saath tanhaai mein na rahe siwaaye is ke ke uske saath uska Mehram maujood ho.' Ek shaks khada hua aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Meri biwi Hajj karne nikal gayi hai, aur mera naam falaan falaan mohim ke liye (fauj mein) likh diya gaya hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Wapas jaao aur apni biwi ke saath Hajj karo.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:An Ansari woman came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he took her aside and said (to her). "By Allah, you (Ansar) are the most beloved people to me
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek Ansaari khaatoon Nabi (SAW) ke paas aayi, unhone unhein alag le jaakar kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, tum (Ansaar) mujhe sab logon mein sabse zyaada aziz ho.'

e: Narrated Um Salama:that while the Prophet (ﷺ) was with her, there was an effeminate man in the house. The effeminate man said to Um Salama's brother, `Abdullah bin Abi Umaiyya, "If Allah should make you conquer Ta'if tomorrow, I recommend that you take the daughter of Ghailan (in marriage) for (she is so fat) that she shows four folds of flesh when facing you and eight when she turns her back." Thereupon the Prophet (ﷺ) said (to us), "This (effeminate man) should not enter upon you (anymore)
hi: Umm Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab Nabi (SAW) unke paas the, ghar mein ek zanaana mard (effeminate) tha. Us zanaana mard ne Umm Salama ke bhai, Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Umaiyya, se kaha, 'Agar Allah tumhein kal Taif fatah karne de, to main sujhaav deta hoon ke tum Ghailan ki beti se (nikaah) karo, kyunke wo itni mote hain ke saamne se dekhne par unke chaar (moti) sikan dikhaayi deti hain, aur peeth phirti hain to aath.' Isper Nabi (SAW) ne (hamse) farmaya, 'Ye (zanaana mard) ab tumhaare paas nahi aana chaahiye.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) was screening me with his Rida' (garment covering the upper part of the body) while I was looking at the Ethiopians who were playing in the courtyard of the mosque. (I continued watching) till I was satisfied. So you may deduce from this event how a little girl (who has not reached the age of puberty) who is eager to enjoy amusement should be treated in this respect
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) mujhe apni Rida (upar ka kapda) se chhupaaye hue the jabke main Habshi logon ko Masjid ke aangan mein khelte dekh rahi thi. (Main dekhti rahi) yahaan tak ke mera dil bhar gaya. To isse andaaza lagaao ke jo chhoti ladki (jo abhi baaligh nahi hui) manoranjan dekhna chaahti hai, uske saath is maamle mein kaisa sulook karna chahiye.

e: Narrated `Aisha:Once Sa`da bint Zam`a went out at night for some need, and `Umar saw her, and recognizing her, he said (to her), "By Allah, O Sa`da! You cannot hide yourself from us." So she returned to the Prophet (ﷺ) and mentioned that to him while he was sitting in my dwelling taking his supper and holding a bone covered with meat in his hand. Then the Divine Inspiration was revealed to him and when that state was over, he (the Prophet (ﷺ) was saying: "O women! You have been allowed by Allah to go out for your needs
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ek baar Sauda (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Zam'a raat ko kisi zaroorat ke liye baahar gayi, aur Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne unhein dekha aur pehchaan liya, unhone (unse) kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, Aye Sauda! Tum humse chhup nahi sakti.' To wo Nabi (SAW) ke paas wapas gayi aur unhein ye baat bataayi jabke wo mere ghar mein raat ka khaana kha rahe the aur unke haath mein gosht laga hua ek haddi thi. Phir unpar wahi naazil hui, aur jab wo haalat khatam hui, unhone (Nabi ne) farmaya, 'Aye auraton! Allah ne tumhein apni zaroorat ke liye baahar jaane ki ijaazat de di hai.'

e: Narrated Salim's father:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If the wife of anyone of you asks permission to go to the mosque, he should not forbid her
hi: Salim ke waalid bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar tum mein se kisi ki biwi Masjid jaane ki ijaazat maange, to use mana nahi karna chaahiye.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:My foster uncle came and asked permission (to enter) but I refused to admit him till I asked Allah's Apostle about that. He said, "He is your uncle, so allow him to come in." I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have been suckled by a woman and not by a man." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "He is your uncle, so let him enter upon you." And that happened after the order of Al-Hijab (compulsory veiling) was revealed. All things which become unlawful because of blood relations are unlawful because of the corresponding foster suckling relations
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Mera doodh-rishte ka chacha aaya aur ijaazat maangi (andar aane ki), magar maine unhein andar aane se inkaar kiya jab tak Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se iske baare mein na pucch loon. Unhone farmaya, 'Wo tumhaare chacha hain, unhein andar aane do.' Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe ek aurat ne doodh pilaaya tha, na ke kisi mard ne.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Wo tumhaare chacha hain, unhein tumhaare paas aane do.' Aur ye Hijab (parde) ke hukm naazil hone ke baad hua tha. Jo cheezein khoon ke rishte ki wajah se haraam hoti hain, wo doodh-piyaai ke usi tarah ke rishte ki wajah se bhi haraam hoti hain.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Mas`ud:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A woman should not look at or touch another woman to describe her to her husband in such a way as if he was actually looking at her
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Masud bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ek aurat ko doosri aurat ko dekh kar ya chhoo kar apne shohar ke saamne is tarah bayaan nahi karna chaahiye jaise wo khud use dekh raha ho.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A woman should not look at or touch another woman to describe her to her husband in such a way as if he was actually looking at her
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ek aurat ko doosri aurat ko dekh kar ya chhoo kar apne shohar ke saamne is tarah bayaan nahi karna chaahiye jaise wo khud use dekh raha ho.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:(The Prophet) Solomon son of (the Prophet) David said, "Tonight I will go round (i.e. have sexual relations with) one hundred women (my wives) everyone of whom will deliver a male child who will fight in Allah's Cause." On that an Angel said to him, "Say: 'If Allah will.' " But Solomon did not say it and forgot to say it. Then he had sexual relations with them but none of them delivered any child except one who delivered a half person. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If Solomon had said: 'If Allah will,' Allah would have fulfilled his (above) desire and that saying would have made him more hopeful
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi Sulaiman, Nabi Dawood ke bete, ne kaha, 'Aaj raat main (apni) sau biwiyon ke paas jaaunga, har ek ek beta paida karegi jo Allah ki raah mein jihaad karega.' Isper ek Farishte ne unse kaha, 'Kaho: "Agar Allah ne chaaha."' Magar Sulaiman ne ye nahi kaha aur kehna bhool gaye. Phir unhone unke saath sambhog kiya, magar unmein se kisi ne bhi bacha nahi paida hua siwaaye ek ke, jisne aadhaa insaan paida hua. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar Sulaiman ne "Agar Allah ne chaaha" kaha hota, to Allah unki (upar wali) khwaahish poori kar deta, aur wo baat unhein aur ummeed bhari banaati.'

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) disliked that one should go to one's family at night (on returning from a journey)
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) napasand karte the ke koi safar se wapas aakar raat ko apne ghar chala jaaye.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When anyone of you is away from his house for a long time, he should not return to his family at night
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab tum mein se koi lambe waqt tak apne ghar se door raha ho, to use raat ko apne khaandaan ke paas wapas nahi jaana chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Jabir:I was with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in a Ghazwa, and when we returned, I wanted to hurry, while riding a slow camel. A rider came behind me. I looked back and saw that the rider was Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . He said (to me), "What makes you in such a hurry?" I replied, "I am newly married." He said, "Did you marry a virgin or a matron?" I replied, "(Not a virgin but) a matron." He said, "Why didn't you marry a young girl with whom you could play and who could play with you?" Then when we approached (Medina) and were going to enter (it), the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Wait till you enter (your homes) at night (in the first part of the night) so that the ladies with unkempt hair may comb their hair, and those whose husbands have been absent (for a long time) may shave their pubic hair." (The sub-narrator, Hashim said: A reliable narrator told me that the Prophet (ﷺ) added in this Hadith: "(Seek to beget) children! Children, O Jabir
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath ek Ghazwe mein tha, aur jab hum wapas aa rahe the, main jaldi karna chahta tha, jabke main ek sust oont par sawaar tha. Ek sawaar mere peechhe aaya. Maine peeche mudkar dekha to wo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) the. Unhone (mujhse) pucha, 'Tumhein itni jaldi kya hai?' Maine jawab diya, 'Meri nayi shaadi hui hai.' Unhone pucha, 'Kunwaari se ki ya biwaa se?' Maine jawab diya, '(Kunwaari nahi) biwaa se.' Unhone kaha, 'Kisi jawaan ladki se kyun nahi ki jiske saath tum khel sakte aur wo tumhaare saath khel sakti?' Phir jab hum (Madina ke) qareeb pahunche aur daakhil hone hi wale the, Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Intezaar karo yahaan tak ke tum raat ko (raat ke pehle hisse mein) daakhil ho sako, taake bikhre baalon wali auraten apne baal sanwaar sakein, aur jinke shauhar (lambe waqt se) door gaye hon wo apne baal saaf kar sakein.' (Ravi Hashim kehte hain: Ek bharosemand ravi ne mujhe bataaya ke Nabi (SAW) ne is hadees mein ye bhi izaafa kiya: '(Aulaad paida karne ki koshish karo!) Aulaad, Aye Jabir!')

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If you enter (your town) at night (after coming from a journey), do not enter upon your family till the woman whose husband was absent (from the house) shaves her pubic hair and the woman with unkempt hair, combs her hair" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) further said, "(O Jabir!) Seek to have offspring, seek to have offspring
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar tum raat ko (safar se aakar apne shehar mein) daakhil ho, to apne khaandaan ke paas tab tak mat jaao jab tak wo aurat jiska shohar (ghar se) door tha apne baal saaf na kar le, aur wo aurat jiske baal bikhre hue hain, apne baal sanwaar na le.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne aage farmaya, '(Aye Jabir!) Aulaad paida karne ki koshish karo, aulaad paida karne ki koshish karo.'

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:We were with the Prophet (ﷺ) in Ghazwa, and when we returned and approached Medina, I wanted to hurry while riding a slow camel. A rider overtook me and pricked my camel with a spear which he had, whereupon my camel started running as fast as any other fast camel you may see. I looked back, and behold, the rider was Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I am newly married " He asked, "Have you got married?" I replied, "Yes." He said, "A virgin or a matron?" I replied, "(Not a virgin) but a matron" He said, "Why didn't you marry a young girl so that you could play with her and she with you?" When we reached (near Medina) and were going to enter it, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Wait till you enter your home early in the night so that the lady whose hair is unkempt may comb her hair and that the lady whose husband has been away may shave her pubic hair
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Nabi (SAW) ke saath ek Ghazwe mein the, aur jab hum wapas aa rahe the aur Madina ke qareeb pahunche, main jaldi karna chahta tha jabke main ek sust oont par sawaar tha. Ek sawaar ne mujhe pakad liya aur apne bhaale se mera oont chubho diya, jispar mera oont kisi bhi tez oont jitni raftaar se daudne laga. Maine peeche mudkar dekha, to wo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) the. Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Meri nayi shaadi hui hai.' Unhone pucha, 'Kya tumhaari shaadi ho chuki hai?' Maine jawab diya, 'Haan.' Unhone pucha, 'Kunwaari se ya biwaa se?' Maine jawab diya, '(Kunwaari nahi) biwaa se.' Unhone kaha, 'Kisi jawaan ladki se kyun nahi ki, taake tum uske saath aur wo tumhaare saath khel sakti?' Jab hum (Madina ke qareeb) pahunche aur daakhil hone hi wale the, Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Intezaar karo yahaan tak ke tum raat ke shuru mein apne ghar daakhil ho sako, taake jiski aurat ke baal bikhre hain wo apne baal sanwaar sake, aur jiski aurat ka shohar door raha ho wo apne baal saaf kar sake.'

e: Narrated Abu Hazim:The people differed about the type of treatment which had been given to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the day (of the battle) of Uhud. So they asked Sahl bin Sa`d As-Sa`id who was the only surviving Companion (of the Prophet) at Medina. He replied, "Nobody Is left at Medina who knows it better than I. Fatima was washing the blood off his face and `Ali was bringing water in his shield, and then a mat of datepalm leaves was burnt and (the ash) was inserted into the wound
hi: Abu Hazim bataate hain: Logon mein jang-e-Uhud ke din Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko diye gaye ilaaj ke baare mein ikhtelaf ho gaya. To unhone Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) As-Sa'idi se pucha, jo Madina mein bache hue akele sahaabi the. Unhone jawab diya, 'Madina mein mujhse behtar koi nahi jaanta. Fatima (Alayhas Salam) unke chehre se khoon dho rahi thin, aur Ali (Alayhis Salam) apni dhaal mein paani laa rahe the, phir khajoor ke patton ki ek chatai jalaayi gayi aur (uski raakh) zakhm mein daali gayi.'

e: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin `Abis:I heard Ibn `Abbas answering a man who asked him, "Did you attend the prayer of `Id al Adha or `Idal- Fitr with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" Ibn `Abbas replied, "Yes, and had it not been for my close relationship with him, I could not have offered it." (That was because of his young age). Ibn `Abbas further said, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went out and offered the Id prayer and then delivered the sermon." Ibn `Abbas did not mention anything about the Adhan (the call for prayer) or the Iqama. He added, "Then the Prophet (ﷺ) went to the women and instructed them and gave them religious advice and ordered them to give alms and I saw them reaching out (their hands to) their ears and necks (to take off the earrings and necklaces, etc.) and throwing (it) towards Bilal. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) returned with Bilal to his house
hi: Abdur Rahman bin Abis bataate hain: Maine Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko ek shaks ka jawab dete suna jisne unse pucha, 'Kya aap Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Eid-ul-Adha ya Eid-ul-Fitr ki namaz mein shaamil hue the?' Ibn Abbas ne jawab diya, 'Haan, aur agar main unse qareebi rishtedaar na hota, to main ye namaz na padh paata.' (Ye unki kam umar ki wajah se tha.) Ibn Abbas ne aage kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) baahar aaye aur Eid ki namaz padhaayi, phir khutba diya.' Ibn Abbas ne Azaan ya Iqaamat ka koi zikr nahi kiya. Unhone aage kaha, 'Phir Nabi (SAW) auraton ke paas gaye aur unhein hidaayat aur deeni naseehat di, aur unhein sadqa dene ka hukm diya, aur maine dekha ke wo apne kaan aur gardan tak haath le ja rahi thin (baaliyaan aur haar utaarne ke liye) aur unhein Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki taraf phenk rahi thin. Phir Nabi (SAW) Bilal ke saath apne ghar wapas gaye.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:Abu Bakr admonished me and poked me with his hands in the flank, and nothing stopped me from moving at that time except the position of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) whose head was on my thigh
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Abu Bakr ne mujhe daanta aur apne haathon se mere pehlu mein cheda, aur us waqt mujhe hilne se sirf isi baat ne roka ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka sar mere ran par tha.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:that he had divorced his wife while she was menstruating during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . `Umar bin Al-Khattab asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about that. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Order him (your son) to take her back and keep her till she is clean and then to wait till she gets her next period and becomes clean again, whereupon, if he wishes to keep her, he can do so, and if he wishes to divorce her he can divorce her before having sexual intercourse with her; and that is the prescribed period which Allah has fixed for the women meant to be divorced
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke unhone apni biwi ko haiz ki haalat mein talaaq de di thi Nabi (SAW) ki zindagi mein. Umar bin Al-Khattab ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se iske baare mein pucha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Use (apne bete ko) hukm do ke wo use wapas laaye aur paak hone tak rakhe, phir intezaar kare jab tak use agli haiz aaye aur wo dobara paak ho jaaye, iske baad, agar wo use rakhna chaahe, to rakh sakta hai, aur agar talaaq dena chaahe, to humbistari se pehle talaaq de sakta hai; aur yahi wo muddat hai jo Allah ne talaaq di jaane wali auraton ke liye muqarrar ki hai.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Seereen:Ibn `Umar said: "I divorced my wife while she was menstruating. `Umar mentioned that to the Prophet . The Prophet (ﷺ) said, (to my father), "Let your son take her back." I asked (Ibn `Umar), "Is such a divorce counted (i.e. as one legal divorce)?" Ibn `Umar said, "Of course." Narrated Yunus bin Jubair: Ibn `Umar said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) said to `Umar, 'Order him (Ibn `Umar) to take her back.' " I asked, "Is such a divorce counted (as one legal divorce)?" Ibn `Umar said, "What do you think if someone becomes helpless and foolish?
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Seereen bataate hain: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Maine apni biwi ko haiz ki haalat mein talaaq de di thi. Umar ne ye baat Nabi (SAW) ko bataayi. Nabi (SAW) ne (mere waalid se) farmaya, "Apne bete ko use wapas laane ko kaho."' Maine (Ibn Umar se) pucha, 'Kya aisi talaaq (ek qaanooni talaaq ke taur par) gini jaati hai?' Ibn Umar ne kaha, 'Zaroor.' Yunus bin Jubair bataate hain: Ibn Umar ne kaha, 'Nabi (SAW) ne Umar se kaha, "Use (Ibn Umar ko) hukm do ke wo use wapas laaye."' Maine pucha, 'Kya aisi talaaq (ek qaanooni talaaq ke taur par) gini jaati hai?' Ibn Umar ne kaha, 'Tumhaara kya khayaal hai agar koi be-bas aur bewaqoof ho jaaye (kya use maafi milegi? Bilkul nahi)?'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:(Divorcing my wife during her menses) was counted as one legal divorce
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: (Meri biwi ko uski haiz ke dauraan talaaq dena) ek qaanooni talaaq ke taur par gina gaya.

e: Narrated Al-Awza:I asked Az-Zuhri, "Which of the wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) sought refuge with Allah from him?" He said "I was told by 'Urwa that `Aisha said, 'When the daughter of Al-Jaun was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (as his bride) and he went near her, she said, "I seek refuge with Allah from you." He said, "You have sought refuge with The Great; return to your family
hi: Al-Awza'i bataate hain: Maine Az-Zuhri se pucha, 'Nabi (SAW) ki kaunsi biwi ne unse Allah ki panaah maangi thi?' Unhone kaha, 'Mujhe Urwa ne bataaya ke Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha, "Jab Al-Jaun ki beti ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas (dulhan ke taur par) laaya gaya aur wo unke paas gaye, unhone kaha, 'Main aapse Allah ki panaah maangti hoon.' Unhone kaha, 'Tumne ek Azeem (Zaat) ki panaah maangi hai; apne khaandaan ke paas wapas jaao.'"'

e: Narrated Abu Usaid:We went out with the Prophet (ﷺ) to a garden called Ash-Shaut till we reached two walls between which we sat down. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Sit here," and went in (the garden). The Jauniyya (a lady from Bani Jaun) had been brought and lodged in a house in a date-palm garden in the home of Umaima bint An- Nu`man bin Sharahil, and her wet nurse was with her. When the Prophet (ﷺ) entered upon her, he said to her, "Give me yourself (in marriage) as a gift." She said, "Can a princess give herself in marriage to an ordinary man?" The Prophet (ﷺ) raised his hand to pat her so that she might become tranquil. She said, "I seek refuge with Allah from you." He said, "You have sought refuge with One Who gives refuge. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) came out to us and said, "O Abu Usaid! Give her two white linen dresses to wear and let her go back to her family
hi: Abu Usaid bataate hain: Hum Nabi (SAW) ke saath Ash-Shaut naami ek baagh ki taraf gaye yahaan tak ke hum do deewaaron tak pahunche jinke beech hum baith gaye. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Yahin baitho,' aur (baagh mein) andar chale gaye. Al-Jauniya (Banu Jaun ki ek khaatoon) ko laaya gaya tha aur Umaima bint An-Nu'man bin Sharahil ke ghar mein khajoor ke baagh mein ek ghar mein thehraaya gaya tha, aur unki dhaai maa unke saath thi. Jab Nabi (SAW) unke paas gaye, to unhone unse kaha, 'Khud ko mujhe (nikaah mein) hiba kar do.' Unhone kaha, 'Kya ek shahzaadi khud ko ek aam aadmi ko nikaah mein de sakti hai?' Nabi (SAW) ne unhein sukoon dilaane ke liye apna haath uthaaya. Unhone kaha, 'Main aapse Allah ki panaah maangti hoon.' Unhone kaha, 'Tumne panaah dene wale (Allah) ki panaah maangi hai.' Phir Nabi (SAW) hamare paas wapas aaye aur kaha, 'Aye Abu Usaid! Unhein do safed sooti kapde do pehanne ke liye aur unhein apne khaandaan ke paas wapas jaane do.'

e: Narrated Sahl and Abu Usaid:The Prophet (ﷺ) married Umaima bint Sharahil, and when she was brought to him, he stretched his hand towards her. It seemed that she disliked that, whereupon the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered Abu Usaid to prepare her and to provide her with two white linen dresses
hi: Sahl aur Abu Usaid bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne Umaima bint Sharahil se nikaah kiya, aur jab unhein unke paas laaya gaya, unhone apna haath unki taraf badhaaya. Aisa laga jaise unhein ye pasand nahi aaya, isper Nabi (SAW) ne Abu Usaid ko hukm diya ke wo unhein taiyaar karein aur do safed sooti kapde muhaiya karein.

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:similarly as above
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: (Upar wali hadees jaisi hi).

e: Narrated Abi Ghallab Yunus bin Jubair:I asked Ibn `Umar,"(What is said regarding) a man divorces his wife during her period?" He said, "Do you know Ibn `Umar? Ibn `Umar divorced his wife while she was menstruating. `Umar then went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and mentioned that to him. The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered him to take her back and when she became clean, he could divorce her if he wanted." I asked (Ibn `Umar), "Was that divorce counted as one legal divorce?" He said, "If one becomes helpless and foolish (will he be excused? Of course not)
hi: Abi Ghallab Yunus bin Jubair bataate hain: Maine Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha, '(Iske baare mein kya kaha jaata hai) ek aadmi apni biwi ko uski haiz ke dauraan talaaq de?' Unhone kaha, 'Kya tumhein Ibn Umar ke baare mein pata hai? Ibn Umar ne apni biwi ko haiz ki haalat mein talaaq de di thi. Umar ne phir Nabi (SAW) ke paas jaakar unhein iski khabar di. Nabi (SAW) ne unhein use wapas laane ka hukm diya, aur jab wo paak ho gayi, wo chaahein to talaaq de sakte the.' Maine (Ibn Umar se) pucha, 'Kya wo talaaq ek qaanooni talaaq ke taur par gini gayi?' Unhone kaha, 'Agar koi be-bas aur bewaqoof ho jaaye (to kya use chhoot milegi? Bilkul nahi).'

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d As-Sa`idi:Uwaimir Al-`Ajlani came to `Asim bin Adi Al-Ansari and asked, "O `Asim! Tell me, if a man sees his wife with another man, should he kill him, whereupon you would kill him in Qisas, or what should he do? O `Asim! Please ask Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about that." `Asim asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about that. Allah's Apostle disliked that question and considered it disgraceful. What `Asim heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was hard on him. When he returned to his family, 'Uwaimir came to him and said "O `Asim! What did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say to you?" `Asim said, "You never bring me any good. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) disliked to hear the problem which I asked him about." 'Uwaimir said, "By Allah, I will not leave the matter till I ask him about it." So 'Uwaimir proceeded till he came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who was in the midst of the people and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! If a man finds with his wife another man, should he kill him, whereupon you would kill him (in Qisas): or otherwise, what should he do?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah has revealed something concerning the question of you and your wife. Go and bring her here." So they both carried out the judgment of Lian, while I was present among the people (as a witness). When both of them had finished, 'Uwaimir said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! If I should now keep my wife with me, then I have told a lie". Then he pronounced his decision to divorce her thrice before Allah's Apostle ordered him to do so. (Ibn Shihab said, "That was the tradition for all those who are involved in a case of Lian)
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) As-Sa'idi bataate hain: Uwaimir Al-Ajlani Aasim bin Adi Al-Ansari ke paas aaye aur pucha, 'Aye Aasim! Mujhe bataao, agar koi aadmi apni biwi ko kisi doosre mard ke saath dekhe, to kya wo use qatl kar de, aur phir tum use Qisaas mein qatl karoge, ya wo kya kare? Aye Aasim! Barah-e-meharbaani Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye pucho.' Aasim ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye pucha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye sawaal napasand aaya aur unhone ise sharmnaak samjha. Aasim ne jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna wo unke liye mushkil tha. Jab wo apne khaandaan ke paas laute, Uwaimir unke paas aaye aur kaha, 'Aye Aasim! Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne aapse kya kaha?' Aasim ne kaha, 'Tum mujhe kabhi achhi khabar nahi laate. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko wo sawaal sunna napasand aaya jo maine unse pucha.' Uwaimir ne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, main is maamle ko tab tak nahi chhodunga jab tak main khud unse ye na pucch loon.' To Uwaimir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaye, jo logon ke beech maujood the, aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Agar koi aadmi apni biwi ke saath kisi doosre mard ko paaye, to kya wo use qatl kar de, aur phir aap use (Qisaas mein) qatl karenge, ya wo kya kare?' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah ne tumhaare aur tumhaari biwi ke maamle mein kuch naazil kiya hai. Jaao aur unhein yahaan laao.' To dono ne Mulaa'ana (laanat lagaane wali qasmon) ki karvaayi poori ki, jabke main logon ke beech (gawaah ke taur par) maujood tha. Jab dono ne apni-apni baat khatam ki, Uwaimir ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Agar main ab apni biwi ko apne paas rakhoon, to maine jhoot bola hoga.' Phir unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke hukm dene se pehle hi teen baar talaaq dene ka faisla sunaaya. (Ibn Shihab ne kaha, 'Yahi tareeka un sab logon ke liye rivaaj ban gaya jo Lian (Mulaa'ana) ke maamle mein shaamil hote hain.')

e: Narrated `Aisha:The wife of Rifa`a Al-Qurazi came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Rifa`a divorced me irrevocably. After him I married `Abdur-Rahman bin Az-Zubair Al-Qurazi who proved to be impotent." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to her, "Perhaps you want to return to Rifa`a? Nay (you cannot return to Rifa`a) until you and `Abdur-Rahman consummate your marriage
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Rifa'a Al-Qurazi ki biwi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Rifa'a ne mujhe qatai (aakhri) talaaq de di. Unke baad maine Abdur Rahman bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Qurazi se nikaah kiya, jo napumsak (impotent) nikle.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha, 'Shaayad tum Rifa'a ke paas wapas jaana chahti ho? Nahi (tum Rifa'a ke paas wapas nahi ja sakti) jab tak tum aur Abdur Rahman apni shaadi poori (rukhsati) na kar lo.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:A man divorced his wife thrice (by expressing his decision to divorce her thrice), then she married another man who also divorced her. The Prophet (ﷺ) was asked if she could legally marry the first husband (or not). The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "No, she cannot marry the first husband unless the second husband consummates his marriage with her, just as the first husband had done
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ek aadmi ne apni biwi ko teen baar talaaq de di (yaani apna faisla teen baar zaahir kiya), phir usne ek doosre aadmi se nikaah kiya jisne bhi use talaaq de di. Nabi (SAW) se pucha gaya ke kya wo (pehle shohar se) dobara nikaah kar sakti hai (ya nahi). Nabi (SAW) ne jawab diya, 'Nahi, wo pehle shohar se nikaah nahi kar sakti jab tak doosra shohar usse apni shaadi poori (rukhsati) na kar le, jaise pehle shohar ne kiya tha.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave us the option (to remain with him or to be divorced) and we selected Allah and His Apostle . So, giving us that option was not regarded as divorce
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein ikhtiyaar diya (unke saath rehne ya talaaq lene ka) aur humne Allah aur uske Rasool ko chuna. To ye ikhtiyaar dena talaaq nahi maana gaya.

e: Narrated Masruq:I asked `Aisha about the option: She said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) gave us the option. Do you think that option was considered as a divorce?" I said, "It matters little to me if I give my wife the option once or a hundred times after she has chosen me
hi: Masruq bataate hain: Maine Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se ikhtiyaar ke baare mein pucha: Unhone kaha, 'Nabi (SAW) ne humein ikhtiyaar diya. Tumhaara kya khayaal hai, kya wo ikhtiyaar talaaq maana jaayega?' Maine kaha, 'Mujhe koi farq nahi padta agar main apni biwi ko ek baar ya sau baar ikhtiyaar doon, jab ke usne mujhe chun liya ho.'

e: Nafi' said:When Ibn 'Umar was asked about person who had given three divorces, he said, "Would that you gave one or two divorces, for the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered me to do so. If you give three divorces then she cannot be lawful for you until she has married another husband (and is divorced by him)
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Jab Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se us shaks ke baare mein pucha gaya jisne teen talaaq de di thi, unhone kaha, 'Kaash tumne ek ya do talaaqein di hoti, kyunke Nabi (SAW) ne mujhe aisa hi karne ka hukm diya tha. Agar tum teen talaaqein de do, to wo tumhaare liye jaayez nahi hogi jab tak wo kisi aur shohar se nikaah na kar le (aur usse talaaq na le le).'

e: Narrated `Aisha:A man divorced his wife and she married another man who proved to be impotent and divorced her. She could not get her satisfaction from him, and after a while he divorced her. Then she came to the Prophet and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! My first husband divorced me and then I married another man who entered upon me to consummate his marriage but he proved to be impotent and did not approach me except once during which he benefited nothing from me. Can I remarry my first husband in this case?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "It is unlawful to marry your first husband till the other husband consummates his marriage with you
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ek aadmi ne apni biwi ko talaaq de di, aur usne ek doosre aadmi se nikaah kiya jo napumsak nikla aur usne bhi use talaaq de di. Usse koi santushti nahi mili, aur kuch waqt baad usne use talaaq de di. Phir wo Nabi (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mere pehle shohar ne mujhe talaaq de di, phir maine ek doosre aadmi se nikaah kiya jo meri shaadi poori karne aaya magar wo napumsak nikla aur usne mere paas sirf ek baar aakar kuch faayda nahi uthaaya. Kya main is soorat mein apne pehle shohar se dobara nikaah kar sakti hoon?' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Tumhaare pehle shohar se nikaah karna haraam hai jab tak doosra shohar tumhaare saath apni shaadi poori (rukhsati) na kar le.'

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:that he heard Ibn `Abbas saying, "If a man makes his wife unlawful for him, it does not mean that she is divorced." He added, "Indeed in the Messenger of Allah , you have a good example to follow
hi: Saeed bin Jubair bataate hain: Unhone Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko ye kehte suna, 'Agar koi apni biwi ko apne liye haraam kar le, iska matlab ye nahi ke wo talaaq-shuda ho gayi.' Unhone aage kaha, 'Waaqai, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mein tumhaare liye ek behtareen namoona hai jise apnaao.'

e: Narrated `Ubaid bin `Umar:I heard `Aisha saying, "The Prophet (ﷺ) used to stay for a long while with Zanab bint Jahsh and drink honey at her house. So Hafsa and I decided that if the Prophet (ﷺ) came to anyone of us, she should say him, "I detect the smell of Maghafir (a nasty smelling gum) in you. Have you eaten Maghafir?' " So the Prophet (ﷺ) visited one of them and she said to him similarly. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Never mind, I have taken some honey at the house of Zainab bint Jahsh, but I shall never drink of it anymore." So there was revealed: 'O Prophet ! Why do you ban (for you) that which Allah has made lawful for you . . . If you two (wives of Prophet) turn in repentance to Allah,' (66.1-4) addressing Aisha and Hafsa. 'When the Prophet (ﷺ) disclosed a matter in confidence to some of his wives.' (66.3) namely his saying: But I have taken some honey
hi: Ubaid bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko kehte suna, 'Nabi (SAW) Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Jahsh (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke ghar kaafi der rukte the aur wahaan shehad piya karte the. To Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) aur maine tay kiya ke agar Nabi (SAW) hum mein se kisi ke paas aayein, to wo unse kahe, "Mujhe aapse Maghaafir (ek badbudaar gond) ki khushbu aa rahi hai. Kya aapne Maghaafir khaayi hai?"' To Nabi (SAW) unmein se ek ke paas gaye aur unhone bhi yahi kaha. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Koi baat nahi, maine Zainab bint Jahsh ke ghar thodi shehad li thi, magar main isse phir kabhi nahi piyunga.' To ye naazil hui: 'Aye Nabi! Aap us cheez ko apne liye kyun haraam karte hain jo Allah ne aapke liye halaal ki hai...Agar tum dono (Nabi ki azwaaj) Allah ki taraf tauba karo...' (66:1-4) jo Aisha aur Hafsa ko khitaab karti hai. 'Jab Nabi ne apni kuch biwiyon se ek baat raaz mein kahi' (66:3) - yaani unka ye kehna: 'Magar maine thodi shehad li thi.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was fond of honey and sweet edible things and (it was his habit) that after finishing the `Asr prayer he would visit his wives and stay with one of them at that time. Once he went to Hafsa, the daughter of `Umar and stayed with her more than usual. I got jealous and asked the reason for that. I was told that a lady of her folk had given her a skin filled with honey as a present, and that she made a syrup from it and gave it to the Prophet (ﷺ) to drink (and that was the reason for the delay). I said, "By Allah we will play a trick on him (to prevent him from doing so)." So I said to Sa`da bint Zam`a "The Prophet (ﷺ) will approach you, and when he comes near you, say: 'Have you taken Maghafir (a bad-smelling gum)?' He will say, 'No.' Then say to him: 'Then what is this bad smell which i smell from you?' He will say to you, 'Hafsa made me drink honey syrup.' Then say: Perhaps the bees of that honey had sucked the juice of the tree of Al-`Urfut.' I shall also say the same. O you, Safiyya, say the same." Later Sa`da said, "By Allah, as soon as he (the Prophet (ﷺ) ) stood at the door, I was about to say to him what you had ordered me to say because I was afraid of you." So when the Prophet (ﷺ) came near Sa`da, she said to him, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Have you taken Maghafir?" He said, "No." She said. "Then what is this bad smell which I detect on you?" He said, "Hafsa made me drink honey syrup." She said, "Perhaps its bees had sucked the juice of Al-`Urfut tree." When he came to me, I also said the same, and when he went to Safiyya, she also said the same. And when the Prophet (ﷺ) again went to Hafsa, she said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shall I give you more of that drink?" He said, "I am not in need of it." Sa`da said, "By Allah, we deprived him (of it)." I said to her, "Keep quiet
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko shehad aur meethi cheezein pasand thin, aur (unki aadat thi ke) Asr ki namaz khatam karne ke baad wo apni biwiyon ke paas jaate aur us waqt unmein se ek ke paas rukte. Ek baar wo Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا), Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki beti, ke paas gaye aur maamool se zyaada der unke paas ruke. Mujhe jalan hui aur maine iski wajah poochi. Mujhe bataya gaya ke Hafsa ki qaum ki ek khaatoon ne unhein shehad se bhari ek mashk tohfe mein di thi, aur unhone usse ek sharbat banaaya tha aur Nabi (SAW) ko pilaaya tha (aur yahi der ki wajah thi). Maine kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, hum unpar ek chaal chalenge (taake wo aisa karna chhod dein).' To maine Sauda (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Zam'a se kaha, 'Nabi (SAW) tumhaare paas aayenge, aur jab wo qareeb aayein, to kehna, "Kya aapne Maghaafir (ek badbudaar gond) khaayi hai?" Wo kahenge, "Nahi." Phir unse kehna, "To phir ye kaisi badbu hai jo mujhe aapse aa rahi hai?" Wo tumse kahenge, "Hafsa ne mujhe shehad ka sharbat pilaaya." Phir kehna, "Shaayad us shehad ki makhiyon ne Al-Urfut darakht ka ras choosa hoga." Main bhi yahi kahungi. Aye Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا), tum bhi yahi kehna.' Baad mein Sauda ne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, jaise hi wo (Nabi) darwaaze par khade hue, main tumhaare hukm ke mutaabik unse wahi kehne hi waali thi, kyunke mujhe tumhaara dar tha.' To jab Nabi (SAW) Sauda ke qareeb aaye, unhone unse kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya aapne Maghaafir khaayi hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Nahi.' Unhone kaha, 'To phir ye kaisi badbu hai jo mujhe aapse mehsoos ho rahi hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Hafsa ne mujhe shehad ka sharbat pilaaya.' Unhone kaha, 'Shaayad uski makhiyon ne Al-Urfut darakht ka ras choosa hoga.' Jab wo mere paas aaye, maine bhi yahi kaha, aur jab wo Safiya ke paas gaye, unhone bhi yahi kaha. Aur jab Nabi (SAW) dobara Hafsa ke paas gaye, unhone kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya main aapko us sharbat mein se aur doon?' Unhone kaha, 'Mujhe iski zaroorat nahi.' Sauda ne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, humne unhein (usse) mehroom kar diya.' Maine unse kaha, 'Khaamosh raho.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah has forgiven my followers the evil thoughts that occur to their minds, as long as such thoughts are not put into action or uttered." And Qatada said, "If someone divorces his wife just in his mind, such an unuttered divorce has no effect.:
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah ne mere maanne walon ke un buri khayaalon ko maaf kar diya hai jo unke zehen mein aate hain, jab tak wo unhein amal mein na laayein ya zabaan se na kahein.' Aur Qatada ne kaha, 'Agar koi apni biwi ko sirf dil mein talaaq de, to aisi bagair kahi hui talaaq ka koi asar nahi hota.'

e: Narrated Jabir:A man from the tribe of Bani Aslam came to the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was in the mosque and said, "I have committed illegal sexual intercourse." The Prophet (ﷺ) turned his face to the other side. The man turned towards the side towards which the Prophet (ﷺ) had turned his face, and gave four witnesses against himself. On that the Prophet (ﷺ) called him and said, "Are you insane?" (He added), "Are you married?" The man said, 'Yes." On that the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered him to be stoned to the death in the Musalla (a praying place). When the stones hit him with their sharp edges and he fled, but he was caught at Al- Harra and then killed
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Banu Aslam qabeele ka ek shaks Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya jabke wo Masjid mein the aur kaha, 'Maine zina kiya hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne apna chehra doosri taraf pher liya. Wo shaks jis taraf Nabi (SAW) ne chehra phera tha usi taraf mud gaya, aur apne khilaaf chaar baar gawaahi di. Isper Nabi (SAW) ne use bulaaya aur pucha, 'Kya tum paagal ho?' (Unhone ye bhi pucha,) 'Kya tumhaari shaadi ho chuki hai?' Us shaks ne kaha, 'Haan.' Isper Nabi (SAW) ne use Musalla (namaz ki jagah) mein rajm (patthar maar kar) qatl karne ka hukm diya. Jab patthar apni teekhi dhaar se use lagne lage aur wo bhaaga, magar use Al-Harra mein pakad liya gaya aur phir maar diya gaya.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:A man from Bani Aslam came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while he was in the mosque and called (the Prophet (ﷺ) ) saying, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have committed illegal sexual intercourse." On that the Prophet (ﷺ) turned his face from him to the other side, whereupon the man moved to the side towards which the Prophet (ﷺ) had turned his face, and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have committed illegal sexual intercourse." The Prophet turned his face (from him) to the other side whereupon the man moved to the side towards which the Prophet (ﷺ) had turned his face, and repeated his statement. The Prophet (ﷺ) turned his face (from him) to the other side again. The man moved again (and repeated his statement) for the fourth time. So when the man had given witness four times against himself, the Prophet (ﷺ) called him and said, "Are you insane?" He replied, "No." The Prophet (ﷺ) then said (to his companions), "Go and stone him to death." The man was a married one. Jabir bin `Abdullah Al-Ansari said: I was one of those who stoned him. We stoned him at the Musalla (`Id praying place) in Medina. When the stones hit him with their sharp edges, he fled, but we caught him at Al-Harra and stoned him till he died
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Banu Aslam ka ek shaks Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya jabke wo Masjid mein the aur (unhein) pukaara, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Maine zina kiya hai.' Isper Nabi (SAW) ne apna chehra unse doosri taraf pher liya, isper wo shaks us taraf mud gaya jis taraf Nabi (SAW) ne apna chehra phera tha, aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Maine zina kiya hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne (phir) apna chehra doosri taraf pher liya, isper wo shaks phir us taraf mud gaya jis taraf Nabi (SAW) ne apna chehra phera tha, aur apni baat dohraayi. Nabi (SAW) ne phir apna chehra doosri taraf pher liya. Wo shaks phir mud gaya (aur apni baat dohraayi) chauthi baar. To jab us shaks ne apne khilaaf chaar baar gawaahi de di, Nabi (SAW) ne use bulaaya aur pucha, 'Kya tum paagal ho?' Usne jawab diya, 'Nahi.' Nabi (SAW) ne phir (apne sahaaba se) kaha, 'Jaao aur use rajm karke maar do.' Wo shaks shaadi-shuda tha. Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ansari kehte hain: Main un logon mein se tha jinhone use rajm kiya. Humne use Madina ke Musalla (Eid ki namaz ki jagah) mein rajm kiya. Jab patthar apni teekhi dhaar se use lagne lage, wo bhaaga, magar humne use Al-Harra mein pakad liya aur usse rajm karke maar diya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The wife of Thabit bin Qais came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I do not blame Thabit for defects in his character or his religion, but I, being a Muslim, dislike to behave in un-Islamic manner (if I remain with him)." On that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said (to her), "Will you give back the garden which your husband has given you (as Mahr)?" She said, "Yes." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said to Thabit, "O Thabit! Accept your garden, and divorce her once
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Thabit bin Qais ki biwi Nabi (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Main Thabit ke akhlaaq ya deen mein koi kami ka ilzaam nahi lagaati, magar main, Musalmaan hone ke naate, na-Islami tareeke se pesh aane se bachna chahti hoon (agar main unke saath rahi).' Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (unse) kaha, 'Kya tum us baagh ko wapas karogi jo tumhaare shohar ne tumhein (Mahr ke taur par) diya tha?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan.' Phir Nabi (SAW) ne Thabit se kaha, 'Aye Thabit! Apna baagh le lo, aur unhein ek baar talaaq de do.'

e: Narrated `Ikrima:The sister of `Abdullah bin Ubai narrated (the above narration, 197) with the addition that the Prophet (ﷺ) said to Thabit's wife, "Will you return his garden?" She said, "Yes," and returned it, and (then) the Prophet ordered Thabit to divorce her
hi: Ikrima bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ubai ki behen ne (upar wali riwayat) sunaayi, is izaafe ke saath ke Nabi (SAW) ne Thabit ki biwi se kaha, 'Kya tum unka baagh unhein wapas karogi?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan,' aur wo wapas kiya, aur (phir) Nabi (SAW) ne Thabit ko unhein talaaq dene ka hukm diya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The wife of Thabit bin Qais came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I do not blame Thabit for any defects in his character or his religion, but I cannot endure to live with him." On that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Will you return his garden to him?" She said, "Yes
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Thabit bin Qais ki biwi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Main Thabit ke akhlaaq ya deen mein koi kami ka ilzaam nahi lagaati, magar main unke saath rehna bardaasht nahi kar sakti.' Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Kya tum unka baagh unhein wapas karogi?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The wife of Thabit bin Qais bin Shammas came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I do not blame Thabit for any defects in his character or his religion, but I am afraid that I (being a Muslim) may become unthankful for Allah's Blessings." On that, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said (to her), 'Will you return his garden to him?" She said, "Yes." So she returned his garden to him and the Prophet (ﷺ) told him to divorce her
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Thabit bin Qais bin Shammas ki biwi Nabi (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Main Thabit ke akhlaaq ya deen mein koi kami ka ilzaam nahi lagaati, magar mujhe dar hai ke main (Musalmaan hone ke naate) Allah ki nemat ki na-shukri karne lagoon.' Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (unse) kaha, 'Kya tum unka baagh unhein wapas karogi?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan.' To unhone unka baagh wapas kar diya aur Nabi (SAW) ne unhein talaaq dene ko kaha.

e: Narrated `Ikrima:that Jamila... Then he related the whole ,Hadith, (i.e)
hi: Ikrima bataate hain: Jamila ke baare mein... (phir unhone poori hadees bayaan ki, jaisi upar zikr hui).

e: Narrated Al-Miswar bin Makhrama Az-Zuhri:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Banu Al-Mughira have asked my leave to let `Ali marry their daughter, but I give no leave to this effect
hi: Al-Miswar bin Makhrama (رضی اللہ عنہ) Az-Zuhri bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Banu Al-Mughira ne mujhse ijaazat maangi hai ke Ali (Alayhis Salam) unki beti se nikaah kar sakein, magar main isper ijaazat nahi deta.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) Three traditions were established concerning situations in which Barra was involved: When she was manumitted, she was given the option to keep her husband or leave him; Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The wala is for the one who manumits, Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered the house while some meat was being cooked in a pot, but only bread and some soup of the house were placed before, him. He said, "Don't I see the pot containing meat?" They said, "Yes, but that meat was given to Barira in charity (by someone), and you do not eat what it given in charity."The Prophet (ﷺ) said "That meat is alms for her, but for us it is a present
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Barira (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke maamle mein teen usool qaayam hue: Jab unhein azaad kiya gaya, to unhein apne shohar ko rakhne ya chhodne ka ikhtiyaar diya gaya; Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Wala uske liye hai jo azaad kare.' Ek baar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ghar mein daakhil hue jabke ek deg mein gosht pak raha tha, magar unke saamne sirf roti aur ghar ka shorba rakha gaya. Unhone pucha, 'Kya main deg mein gosht nahi dekh raha?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan, magar wo gosht Barira ko sadqe mein (kisi ne) diya hai, aur aap sadqe ki cheez nahi khaate.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Wo gosht unke liye sadqa hai, magar hamare liye tohfa hai.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I saw him as a slave, (namely, Barira's husband)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine unhe ek ghulaam ke taur par dekha (yaani Barira (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke shohar ko).

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:That was Mughith, the slave of Bani so-and-so, i.e., Barira's husband as if I am now looking at him following her (Barira) along the streets of Medina
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Wo Mughith the, falaan qabeele ke ghulaam, yaani Barira (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke shohar, aisa lagta hai jaise main abhi bhi unhein Madina ki galiyon mein Barira ke peechhe peechhe chalte dekh raha hoon.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Barira's husband was a black slave called Mughith, the slave of Bani so-and-so-- as if I am seeing him now, walking behind her along the streets of Medina
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Barira (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke shohar ek kaale ghulaam the jinka naam Mughith tha, falaan qabeele ke ghulaam - aisa lagta hai jaise main abhi unhein Madina ki galiyon mein unke (Barira ke) peechhe chalte dekh raha hoon.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Barira's husband was a slave called Mughith, as if I am seeing him now, going behind Barira and weeping with his tears flowing down his beard. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to `Abbas, "O `Abbas ! are you not astonished at the love of Mughith for Barira and the hatred of Barira for Mughith?" The Prophet (ﷺ) then said to Barira, "Why don't you return to him?" She said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Do you order me to do so?" He said, "No, I only intercede for him." She said, "I am not in need of him
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Barira (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke shohar Mughith naami ek ghulaam the, aisa lagta hai jaise main abhi unhein Barira ke peechhe chalte, aansu daadhi se behte hue rote dekh raha hoon. Nabi (SAW) ne Abbas se kaha, 'Aye Abbas! Kya aapko Mughith ki Barira se mohabbat aur Barira ki Mughith se nafrat par hairaani nahi hoti?' Phir Nabi (SAW) ne Barira se kaha, 'Tum unke paas wapas kyun nahi jaati?' Unhone kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya aap mujhe aisa karne ka hukm dete hain?' Unhone kaha, 'Nahi, main sirf unki taraf se sifaarish kar raha hoon.' Unhone kaha, 'Mujhe unki zaroorat nahi.'

e: Narrated Al-Aswad:Aisha intended to buy Barira, but her masters stipulated that her wala wound be for them. Aisha mentioned that to the Prophet (ﷺ) who said (to `Aisha), "Buy and manumit her, for the wala is for the one who manumits." Once some meat was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) and was said, "This meat was given in charity to Barira. " The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It is an object of charity for Barira and a gift for us." Narrated Adam: Shu`ba related the same Hadith and added: Barira was given the option regarding her husband
hi: Al-Aswad bataate hain: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne Barira (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko khareedne ka iraada kiya, magar unke maalikon ne shart rakhi ke unki Wala unhi ke paas rahegi. Aisha ne ye baat Nabi (SAW) ko bataayi, unhone (Aisha se) kaha, 'Unhein khareed kar azaad kar do, kyunke Wala uski hoti hai jo azaad kare.' Ek baar Nabi (SAW) ke paas kuch gosht laaya gaya aur kaha gaya, 'Ye gosht Barira ko sadqe mein diya gaya tha.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ye Barira ke liye sadqa hai aur humare liye tohfa hai.' Ravi Adam kehte hain: Shu'ba ne yahi hadees bayaan ki aur izaafa kiya: Barira ko apne shohar ke baare mein ikhtiyaar diya gaya tha.

e: Narrated Nafi`:Whenever Ibn `Umar was asked about marrying a Christian lady or a Jewess, he would say: "Allah has made it unlawful for the believers to marry ladies who ascribe partners in worship to Allah, and I do not know of a greater thing, as regards to ascribing partners in worship, etc. to Allah, than that a lady should say that Jesus is her Lord although he is just one of Allah's slaves
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Jab bhi Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kisi Isaai ya Yahudi aurat se nikaah karne ke baare mein pucha jaata, wo kehte, 'Allah ne Musalmaanon ke liye un auraton se nikaah karna haraam kiya hai jo Allah ke saath shareek thehraati hain, aur mujhe shirk ke maamle mein isse badi koi baat nahi maloom ke koi aurat kahe ke Isa uska Rab hai, jabke wo Allah ke bandon mein se ek hain.'

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas: The pagans were of two kinds as regards their relationship to the Prophet and the Believers. Some of them were those with whom the Prophet was at war and used to fight against, and they used to fight him; the others were those with whom the Prophet (ﷺ) made a treaty, and neither did the Prophet (ﷺ) fight them, nor did they fight him. If a lady from the first group of pagans emigrated towards the Muslims, her hand would not be asked in marriage unless she got the menses and then became clean. When she became clean, it would be lawful for her to get married, and if her husband emigrated too before she got married, then she would be returned to him. If any slave or female slave emigrated from them to the Muslims, then they would be considered free persons (not slaves) and they would have the same rights as given to other emigrants. The narrator then mentioned about the pagans involved with the Muslims in a treaty, the same as occurs in Mujahid's narration. If a male slave or a female slave emigrated from such pagans as had made a treaty with the Muslims, they would not be returned, but their prices would be paid (to the pagans)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Mushrik Nabi (SAW) aur Momineen ke saath apne rishte ke lihaaz se do tarah ke the. Kuch wo the jinke saath Nabi (SAW) jung mein the aur unse ladte the, aur wo bhi unse ladte the; doosre wo the jinke saath Nabi (SAW) ne sulah ki thi, aur na Nabi (SAW) unse ladte the, na wo Nabi se ladte the. Agar pehle giroh ke mushrikeen mein se koi aurat Musalmaanon ki taraf hijrat kar aaye, to jab tak uski haiz na ho aur wo paak na ho jaaye, uska rishta nahi maanga jaayega. Jab wo paak ho jaaye, to uska nikaah karna jaayez ho jaayega, aur agar uska shohar bhi nikaah se pehle hijrat kar le, to use uske paas wapas kar diya jaayega. Agar koi ghulaam ya launDi unmein se Musalmaanon ki taraf hijrat kar aaye, to unhein azaad log samjha jaayega (ghulaam nahi) aur unhein doosre Muhaajireen jaise haq milenge. Ravi ne phir un mushrikeen ka zikr kiya jinke saath Musalmaanon ka muaahida tha, waisa hi jaisa Mujahid ki riwayat mein aata hai. Agar koi ghulaam ya launDi aise mushrikeen se, jinhone Musalmaanon se sulah ki thi, hijrat kar aaye, to unhein wapas nahi kiya jaayega, magar unki qeemat (mushrikeen ko) ada ki jaayegi.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas:Qariba, The daughter of Abi Umaiyya, was the wife of 'Umar bin Al-Khattab. 'Umar divorced her and then Mu'awiyya bin Abi Sufyan married her. Similarly, Um Al-Hakam, the daughter of Abi Sufyan was the wife of 'Iyad bin Ghanm Al-Fihri. He divorced her and then 'Abdullah bin 'Uthman Al-Thaqafi married her
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Qariba, Abi Umaiyya ki beti, Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab ki biwi thi. Umar ne unhein talaaq de di, phir Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Sufyan ne unse nikaah kiya. Isi tarah, Umm Al-Hakam, Abi Sufyan ki beti, Iyad bin Ghanm Al-Fihri ki biwi thi. Unhone unhein talaaq de di, phir Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Thaqafi ne unse nikaah kiya.

e: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) When believing women came to the Prophet (ﷺ) as emigrants, he used to test them in accordance with the order of Allah. 'O you who believe! When believing women come to you as emigrants, examine them . . .' (60.10) So if anyone of those believing women accepted the above mentioned conditions, she accepted the conditions of faith. When they agreed on those conditions and confessed that with their tongues, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) would say to them, "Go, I have accepted your oath of allegiance (for Islam). By Allah, and hand of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) never touched the hand of any woman, but he only used to take their pledge of allegiance orally. By Allah, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not take the pledge of allegiance of the women except in accordance with what Allah had ordered him. When he accepted their pledge of allegiance he would say to them, "I have accepted your oath of allegiance
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab momin auraten Nabi (SAW) ke paas hijrat karke aatin, to wo Allah ke hukm ke mutaabik unka imtihaan lete: 'Aye Iman waalo! Jab momin auraten hijrat karke tumhaare paas aayein, to unhein jaancho...' (60:10) To agar koi momin aurat upar zikr ki gayi shartein qubool kar leti, to wo Iman ki shartein qubool kar leti thi. Jab wo un shartton par razi ho jaatin aur apni zabaan se iqraar kar leti, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unse kehte, 'Jaao, maine tumhaari baiat qubool kar li (Islam ke liye).' Allah ki qasam, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka haath kisi bhi aurat ke haath se kabhi nahi chhuwa, wo sirf zabaani baiat lete the. Allah ki qasam, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne auraton ki baiat sirf usi tarah li jaisa Allah ne unhein hukm diya tha. Jab wo unki baiat qubool karte, to unse kehte, 'Maine tumhaari baiat qubool kar li.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took an oath that he would abstain from his wives, and at that time his leg had been sprained (dislocated). So he stayed in the Mashruba (an attic room) of his for 29 days. Then he came down, and they (the people) said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! You took an oath to abstain from your wives for one month." He said, "The month is of twenty nine days
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne qasam khaayi ke wo apni biwiyon se door rahenge, aur us waqt unka pair mud gaya tha (utar gaya tha). To wo apne Mashruba (upar wale kamre) mein unnattis (29) dinon tak rahe. Phir wo neeche utre, aur logon ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Aapne ek mahine tak apni biwiyon se door rehne ki qasam khaayi thi.' Unhone kaha, 'Ye mahina unnattis dinon ka hai.'

e: Narrated Nafi`:Ibn `Umar used to say about the Ila (which Allah defined (in the Holy Book), "If the period of Ila expires, then the husband has either to retain his wife in a handsome manner or to divorce her as Allah has ordered
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) Ila (jise Allah ne Quran mein bayaan kiya hai) ke baare mein kaha karte the, 'Agar Ila ki muddat khatam ho jaaye, to shohar ke paas ya to apni biwi ko izzat se rakhna hoga ya use talaaq deni hogi, jaisa Allah ne hukm diya hai.'
