e: Ibn `Umar added:"When the period of four months has expired, the husband should be put in prison so that he should divorce his wife, but the divorce does not occur unless the husband himself declares it. This has been mentioned by `Uthman, `Ali, Abu Ad-Darda, `Aisha and twelve other companions of the Prophet (ﷺ)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne aage kaha: 'Jab chaar mahine ki muddat khatam ho jaaye, to shohar ko qaid mein daal dena chaahiye taake wo apni biwi ko talaaq de de, magar talaaq tab tak nahi hoti jab tak shohar khud ise elaan na kare.' Ye baat Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ), Ali (Alayhis Salam), Abu Ad-Darda, Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) aur Nabi (SAW) ke barah aur sahaaba ne bhi bayaan ki hai.

e: Narrated Yazid:(the Maula of Munba'ith) The Prophet (ﷺ) was asked regarding the case of a lost sheep. He said, "You should take it, because it is for you, or for your brother, or for the wolf." Then he was asked about a lost camel. He got angry and his face became red and he said (to the questioner), "You have nothing to do with it; it has its feet and its water container with it; it can go on drinking water and eating trees till its owner meets it." And then the Prophet (ﷺ) was asked about a Luqata (money found by somebody). He said, "Remember and recognize its tying material and its container, and make public announcement about it for one year. If somebody comes and identifies it (then give it to him), otherwise add it to your property
hi: Yazid (Munba'ith ke Maula) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) se ek khoyi hui bakri ke baare mein pucha gaya. Unhone kaha, 'Use le lo, kyunke wo tumhaari hai, ya tumhaare bhai ki, ya bhediye ki.' Phir unse ek khoye hue oont ke baare mein pucha gaya. Unhein gussa aaya aur unka chehra surkh ho gaya, aur unhone (poochne wale se) kaha, 'Tumhaara isse koi lena-dena nahi; uske apne paanv hain aur uska paani ka bartan (uske andar) hai; wo paani peeta aur darakht khaata rahega jab tak uska maalik use na mil jaaye.' Phir Nabi (SAW) se Luqata (kisi ko mili hui rakam) ke baare mein pucha gaya. Unhone kaha, 'Uski bandhne wali cheez aur uska thaila yaad rakho aur pehchaano, aur ek saal tak iska aam elaan karo. Agar koi aakar ise pehchaan le (to use de do), warna ise apni jaayadaad mein shaamil kar lo.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) performed the Tawaf (around the Ka`ba while riding his camel, and every time he reached the corner (of the Black Stone) he pointed at it with his hand and said, "Allahu Akbar." (Zainab said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "An opening has been made in the wall of Gog and Magog like this and this," forming the number 90 (with his thumb and index finger)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apni oontni par sawaar hokar Kaaba ka Tawaf kiya, aur jab bhi wo (Hajr-e-Aswad ke) kone tak pahunchte, wo apne haath se ishara karke 'Allahu Akbar' kehte. (Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) kehti hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Yajooj-Majooj ki deewaar mein itni bada chhed ho gaya hai,' aur apne angoothe aur shahaadat ki ungli se 90 ka nishaan banaaya.)

e: Narrated Abu Huraira: Abul Qasim (the Prophet (ﷺ) ) said, "There is an hour (or a moment) of particular significance on Friday. If it happens that a Muslim is offering a prayer and invoking Allah for some good at that very moment, Allah will grant him his request." (The sub-narrator placed the top of his finger on the palm of the other hand between the middle finger and the little one)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abul Qasim (Nabi SAW) ne farmaya, 'Juma ke din ek khaas ghadi hoti hai. Agar koi Musalmaan us waqt namaz padh raha ho aur Allah se kisi bhalaai ki dua kare, to Allah uski dua qubool kar leta hai.' (Ravi ne apni ungli ki nok doosre haath ki hatheli par, beech ki ungli aur chhoti ungli ke beech, rakhi.)

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik: During the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) a Jew attacked a girl and took some silver ornaments she was wearing and crushed her head. Her relative brought her to the Prophet (ﷺ) while she was in her last breaths, and she was unable to speak. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked her, "Who has hit you? so-and-so?", mentioning somebody other than her murderer. She moved her head, indicating denial. The Prophet (ﷺ) mentioned another person other than the murderer, and she again moved her head indicating denial. Then he asked, "Was it so-and-so?", mentioning the name of her killer. She nodded, agreeing. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ); ordered that the head of that Jew be crushed between two stones
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zindagi mein ek Yahudi ne ek ladki par hamla kiya, uske chaandi ke zewar chheen liye aur uska sar kuchal diya. Uske rishtedaar use Nabi (SAW) ke paas laaye jabke wo aakhri saanse le rahi thi aur bol nahi paa rahi thi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse pucha, 'Kya tumhein falaan ne maara?' aur qaatil ke siwa kisi aur ka naam liya. Usne apna sar hilaakar inkaar kiya. Nabi (SAW) ne qaatil ke ilaawa ek aur shaks ka naam liya, usne phir sar hilaakar inkaar kiya. Phir unhone pucha, 'Kya ye falaan tha?' qaatil ka asli naam lete hue. Usne sar hilaakar haan kaha. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne us Yahudi ka sar do pattharon ke beech kuchalne ka hukm diya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Afflictions will emerge from here," pointing towards the East
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Fitna yahaan se paida hoga,' poorab ki taraf ishara karte hue.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abi A'ufa:We were with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on a journey, and when the sun set, he said to a man, "Get down and prepare a drink of Sawiq for me." The man said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Will you wait till it is evening?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) again said, "Get down and prepare a drink of Sawiq." The man said, "O Allah's Apostle! Will you wait till it is evening, for it is still daytime. " The Prophet (ﷺ) again said, "Get down and prepare a drink of Sawiq." So the third time the man got down and prepared a drink of sawiq for him. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) drank thereof and pointed with his hand towards the East, saying, "When you see the night falling from this side, then a fasting person should break his fast
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi A'ufa bataate hain: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath ek safar par the, aur jab suraj doob gaya, unhone ek shaks se kaha, 'Utro aur mere liye Sawiq (jau ke aate) ka sharbat taiyaar karo.' Us shaks ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya aap shaam tak intezaar karenge?' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne phir kaha, 'Utro aur Sawiq ka sharbat taiyaar karo.' Us shaks ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya aap shaam tak intezaar karenge, kyunke abhi din hi hai?' Nabi (SAW) ne phir kaha, 'Utro aur Sawiq ka sharbat taiyaar karo.' To teesri baar wo shaks utra aur unke liye Sawiq ka sharbat taiyaar kiya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne usme se piya aur apne haath se poorab ki taraf ishara karte hue kaha, 'Jab tum is taraf se raat aati dekho, to roze waale ko apna roza khol lena chaahiye.'

e: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The call (or the Adhan) of Bilal should not stop you from taking the Suhur-meals for Bilal calls (or pronounces the Adhan) so that the one who is offering the night prayer should take a rest, and he does not indicate the daybreak or dawn." The narrator, Yazid, described (how dawn breaks) by stretching out his hands and then separating them wide apart
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Masud bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Bilal ki azaan (pukaar) tumhein Sahri khaane se na roke, kyunke Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) azaan is liye deta hai taake raat ki namaz padhne wala aaraam kar sake, aur ye subah ya fajr ki nishaani nahi deta.' Ravi Yazid ne (subah kaise hoti hai) apne haath phailaakar aur unhein alag karke dikhaaya.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, The example of a miser and a generous person is like that of two persons wearing iron cloaks from the breast upto the neck When the generous person spends, the iron cloak enlarges and spread over his skin so much so that it covers his fingertips and obliterates his tracks. As for the miser, as soon as he thinks of spending every ring of the iron cloak sticks to its place (against his body) and he tries to expand it, but it does not expand. The Prophet (ﷺ) pointed with his hand towards his throat
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kanjoos aur sakhi shaks ki misaal do aise logon jaisi hai jinhone chhaati se gardan tak loha ke chogha pehne huye hon. Jab sakhi shaks kharch karta hai, to uska loha ka chogha phail jaata hai aur uski khaal par phail kar uski ungliyon ki nokon tak dhak deta hai aur uske pairon ke nishaan mita deta hai. Aur jahaan tak kanjoos ki baat hai, jaise hi wo kharch karne ka socha, loha ke chogha ka har halqa apni jagah (uske jism ke saath) chipak jaata hai, aur wo isse phailaane ki koshish karta hai, magar wo nahi phailta.' Nabi (SAW) ne apna haath apne gale ki taraf ishara karke dikhaaya.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Shall I tell you of the best families among the Ansar?" They (the people) said, "Yes, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The best are Banu- An-Najjar, and after them are Banu `Abdil Ash-hal, and after them are Banu Al-Harith bin Al-Khazraj, and after them are Banu Sa`ida." The Prophet (ﷺ) then moved his hand by closing his fingers and then opening them like one throwing something, and then said, "Anyhow, there is good in all the families of the Ansar
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kya main tumhein Ansaar ke behtareen khaandaanon ke baare mein bataun?' Logon ne kaha, 'Haan, Aye Allah ke Rasool!' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Sabse behtareen Banu An-Najjar hain, unke baad Banu Abdil Ash-hal, unke baad Banu Al-Harith bin Al-Khazraj, aur unke baad Banu Sa'ida.' Phir Nabi (SAW) ne apna haath ungliyaan band karke aur kholte hue hilaaya, jaise koi cheez phenk raha ho, aur farmaya, 'Bahar-haal, Ansaar ke sab khaandaanon mein bhalaai hai.'

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d As-Sa`idi:(a companion of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), holding out his middle and index fingers, said, "My advent and the Hour's are like this (or like these)," namely, the period between his era and the Hour is like the distance between those two fingers, i.e., very short
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) As-Sa'idi bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apni shahaadat aur beech ki ungli phailaakar farmaya, 'Mera aana aur Qayamat is tarah (in dono ungliyon jaisi) hain,' yaani unke daur aur Qayamat ke beech ka faasla in do ungliyon ke faasle jitna hai, yaani bahut kam.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (holding out his ten fingers thrice), said, "The month is thus and thus and thus," namely thirty days. Then (holding out his ten fingers twice and then nine fingers), he said, "It may be thus and thus and thus," namely twenty nine days. He meant once thirty days and once twenty nine days
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne (apni dus ungliyaan teen baar dikha kar) farmaya, 'Mahina aisa aisa aisa hota hai,' yaani tees din. Phir (dus ungliyaan do baar aur phir nau ungliyaan dikhaakar) unhone kaha, 'Ye aisa aisa aisa bhi ho sakta hai,' yaani unnattis din. Unka matlab tha ke kabhi mahina tees din ka hota hai aur kabhi unnattis din ka.

e: Narrated Abu Masud:The Prophet (ﷺ) pointed with his hand towards Yemen and said twice, "Faith is there," and then pointed towards the East, and said, "Verily, sternness and mercilessness are the qualities of those who are busy with their camels and pay no attention to their religion, where the two sides of the head of Satan will appear," namely, the tribes of Rabl'a and Muqar
hi: Abu Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne apne haath se Yemen ki taraf ishara karke do baar kaha, 'Iman wahaan hai,' phir poorab ki taraf ishara karke kaha, 'Beshak sakhti aur be-rehmi un logon ki khaasiyat hai jo apne oonton mein masroof hain aur apne deen par dhyaan nahi dete, jahaan Shaitaan ke sar ke dono kinaare zaahir honge,' yaani Rabi'a aur Mudar qabeele.

e: Narrated Sahl:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I and the one who looks after an orphan will be like this in Paradise," showing his middle and index fingers and separating them
hi: Sahl bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Main aur wo shaks jo kisi yateem ki dekhbhaal karta hai, Jannat mein is tarah (paas paas) honge,' apni shahaadat aur beech ki ungli dikhaakar aur unhein thoda alag karte hue.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! A black child has been born for me." The Prophet asked him, "Have you got camels?" The man said, "Yes." The Prophet (ﷺ) asked him, "What color are they?" The man replied, "Red." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Is there a grey one among them?' The man replied, "Yes." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whence comes that?" He said, "May be it is because of heredity." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "May be your latest son has this color because of heredity
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mere ghar ek kaale rang ka bacha paida hua hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne unse pucha, 'Kya tumhaare paas oont hain?' Us shaks ne kaha, 'Haan.' Nabi (SAW) ne pucha, 'Unka rang kaisa hai?' Us shaks ne jawab diya, 'Laal.' Nabi (SAW) ne pucha, 'Kya unmein koi khaakastari (grey) rang ka bhi hai?' Us shaks ne jawab diya, 'Haan.' Nabi (SAW) ne pucha, 'Wo kahaan se aaya?' Usne kaha, 'Shaayad ye nasal ki wajah se hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Shaayad tumhaare naye bete ka rang bhi isi nasal ki wajah se hai.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:An Ansari man accused his wife (of committing illegal sexual intercourse). The Prophet (ﷺ) made both of them takes the oath of Lian, and separated them from each other (by divorce)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek Ansaari aadmi ne apni biwi par (zina ka) ilzaam lagaaya. Nabi (SAW) ne dono se Lian ki qasmein li aur unhein ek doosre se alag (talaaq dekar) kar diya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Hilal bin Umaiyya accused his wife of illegal sexual intercourse and came to the Prophet (ﷺ) to bear witness (against her), (taking the oath of Lian). The Prophet (ﷺ) was saying, "Allah knows that either of you is a liar. Will anyone of you repent (to Allah)?" Then the lady got up and gave her witness
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hilal bin Umaiyya ne apni biwi par zina ka ilzaam lagaaya aur Nabi (SAW) ke paas (uske khilaaf) gawaahi dene aaye (Lian ki qasm khaate hue). Nabi (SAW) kehte rahe, 'Allah jaanta hai ke tum mein se ek jhoota hai. Kya tum mein se koi tauba karega?' Phir wo khaatoon khadi hui aur apni gawaahi di.

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d As-Sa`idi:'Uwaimir Al-Ajlani came to `Asim bin Ad Al-Ansari and said to him, "O `Asim! Suppose a man saw another man with his wife, would he kill him whereupon you would kill him; or what should he do? Please, O `Asim, ask about this on my behalf." `Asim asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about it. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), disliked that question and considered it disgraceful. What `Asim heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was hard on him. When `Asim returned to his family, 'Uwaimir came to him and said, "O `Asim! What did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). say to you?" `Asim said to 'Uwaimir, "You never bring me any good. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) disliked the problem which I asked him about." 'Uwaimir said, "By Allah, I will not give up this matter until I ask the Prophet (ﷺ) about it." So 'Uwaimir proceeded till he came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the midst of people, and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! If a man sees another man with his wife, would he kill him, whereupon you would kill him, or what should he do?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah has revealed some decree as regards you and your wives case. Go and bring her." So they carried out the process of Lian while I was present among the people with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). When they had finished their Lian, 'Uwaimir said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! If I should now keep her with me as a wife, then I have told a lie." So he divorced her thrice before Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered him. (Ibn Shihab said: So divorce was the tradition for all those who were involved in a case of Lian)
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) As-Sa'idi bataate hain: Uwaimir Al-Ajlani Aasim bin Adi Al-Ansari ke paas aaye aur unse kaha, 'Aye Aasim! Suppose ek aadmi apni biwi ke saath kisi doosre aadmi ko dekhe, to kya wo use qatl kar de, aur phir tum use qatl karoge, ya wo kya kare? Barah-e-meharbaani, Aye Aasim, meri taraf se Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye pucho.' Aasim ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye pucha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye sawaal napasand aaya aur ise sharmnaak samjha. Jo Aasim ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna, wo unke liye mushkil tha. Jab Aasim apne khaandaan ke paas laute, Uwaimir unke paas aaye aur kaha, 'Aye Aasim! Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne aapse kya kaha?' Aasim ne Uwaimir se kaha, 'Tum mujhe kabhi achhi khabar nahi laate. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko jo sawaal maine pucha wo napasand aaya.' Uwaimir ne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, main is maamle ko tab tak nahi chhodunga jab tak main khud Nabi (SAW) se ye na pucch loon.' To Uwaimir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaye, jo logon ke beech maujood the, aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Agar koi aadmi apni biwi ke saath kisi doosre aadmi ko dekhe, to kya wo use qatl kar de, aur phir aap use qatl karenge, ya wo kya kare?' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah ne tumhaare aur tumhaari biwi ke maamle mein kuch hukm naazil kiya hai. Jaao aur unhein le aao.' To unhone Lian ki karvaayi poori ki jabke main logon ke beech Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath maujood tha. Jab unhone apni Lian khatam ki, Uwaimir ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Agar main ab unhein apni biwi ke taur par rakhoon, to maine jhoot bola hoga.' To unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke hukm dene se pehle hi teen baar talaaq de di. (Ibn Shihab ne kaha: 'Isi tarah ye tareeka un sabke liye ban gaya jo Lian ke maamle mein shaamil hote hain.')

e: Narrated Ibn Juraij:Ibn Shihab informed me of Lian and the tradition related to it, referring to the narration of Sahl bin Sa`d, the brother of Bani Sa`idi He said, "An Ansari man came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, 'O Allah's Apostle! If a man saw another man with his wife, should he kill him, or what should he do?' So Allah revealed concerning his affair what is mentioned in the Holy Qur'an about the affair of those involved in a case of Lian. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Allah has given His verdict regarding you and your wife.' So they carried out Lian in the mosque while I was present there. When they had finished, the man said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! If I should now keep her with me as a wife then I have told a lie about her. Then he divorced her thrice before Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered him, when they had finished the Lian process. So he divorced her in front of the Prophet (ﷺ) ." Ibn Shihab added, "After their case, it became a tradition that a couple involved in a case of Lian should be separated by divorce. That lady was pregnant then, and later on her son was called by his mother's name. The tradition concerning their inheritance was that she would be his heir and he would inherit of her property the share Allah had prescribed for him." Ibn Shihab said that Sahl bin Sa`d As'Saidi said that the Prophet (ﷺ) said (in the above narration), "If that lady delivers a small red child like a lizard, then the lady has spoken the truth and the man was a liar, but if she delivers a child with black eyes and huge lips, then her husband has spoken the truth." Then she delivered it in the shape one would dislike (as it proved her guilty)
hi: Ibn Juraij bataate hain: Ibn Shihab ne mujhe Lian aur uske rivaaj ke baare mein bataaya, Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ), Bani Sa'idi ke bhai, ki riwayat ka hawaala dete hue. Unhone kaha, 'Ek Ansaari aadmi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha, "Aye Allah ke Rasool! Agar koi aadmi apni biwi ke saath kisi doosre aadmi ko dekhe, to kya wo use qatl kar de, ya wo kya kare?" Isper Allah ne uske maamle ke baare mein wo naazil kiya jo Quran mein Lian ke maamle mein shaamil logon ke baare mein hai. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, "Allah ne tumhaare aur tumhaari biwi ke maamle mein apna faisla de diya hai." To unhone Masjid mein Lian ki karvaayi poori ki jabke main wahaan maujood tha. Jab unhone khatam kiya, us aadmi ne kaha, "Aye Allah ke Rasool! Agar main ab unhein apni biwi ke taur par rakhoon, to maine unke baare mein jhoot bola hoga." Phir usne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke hukm dene se pehle hi teen baar talaaq de di, jab unhone Lian ki karvaayi khatam kar li. To usne Nabi (SAW) ke saamne hi use talaaq de di.' Ibn Shihab ne aage kaha, 'Unke maamle ke baad, ye tareeka ban gaya ke Lian mein shaamil jode ko talaaq dekar alag kar diya jaaye. Wo khaatoon us waqt hamila thi, aur baad mein uska beta uski maa ke naam se pukaara gaya. Unki miraas ke baare mein rivaaj ye tha ke wo uski waaris hogi aur wo uski jaayadaad mein se utna hissa paayega jitna Allah ne uske liye muqarrar kiya hai.' Ibn Shihab kehte hain ke Sahl bin Sa'd As-Sa'idi ne kaha ke Nabi (SAW) ne (upar wali riwayat mein) farmaya, 'Agar wo khaatoon ek chhota, laal, chhipkali jaisa bacha paida ho, to khaatoon ne sach kaha aur mard jhoota hai, magar agar wo kaali aankhon aur bade honth wala bacha paida ho, to uske shohar ne sach kaha.' Phir usne aisi hi shakl mein bacha paida hua jo napasand ki jaati hai (jisse uska qusoor saabit hua).

e: Narrated Al-Qasim bin Muhammad:Ibn `Abbas; said, "Once Lian was mentioned before the Prophet (ﷺ) whereupon `Asim bin Adi said something and went away. Then a man from his tribe came to him, complaining that he had found a man with his wife. `Asim said, 'I have not been put to task except for my statement (about Lian).' `Asim took the man to the Prophet (ﷺ) and the man told him of the state in which he had found his wife. The man was pale, thin, and of lank hair, while the other man whom he claimed he had seen with his wife, was brown, fat and had much flesh on his calves. The Prophet (ﷺ) invoked, saying, 'O Allah! Reveal the truth.' So that lady delivered a child resembling the man whom her husband had mentioned he had found her with. The Prophet (ﷺ) then made them carry out Lian." Then a man from that gathering asked Ibn `Abbas, "Was she the same lady regarding which the Prophet (ﷺ) had said, 'If I were to stone to death someone without witness, I would have stoned this lady'?" Ibn `Abbas said, "No, that was another lady who, though being a Muslim, used to arouse suspicion by her outright misbehavior
hi: Al-Qasim bin Muhammad bataate hain: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Ek baar Nabi (SAW) ke saamne Lian ka zikr hua, isper Aasim bin Adi ne kuch kaha aur chale gaye. Phir unki qaum ka ek shaks unke paas aaya aur shikaayat ki ke usne apni biwi ke saath ek aadmi ko paaya hai. Aasim ne kaha, "Mujhe (Lian ke baare mein meri baat ke siwa) kisi kaam ke liye pareshaan nahi kiya gaya." Aasim us aadmi ko Nabi (SAW) ke paas le gaye aur us aadmi ne unhein bataaya ke usne apni biwi ko kis haal mein paaya. Wo aadmi peela, dubla aur seedhe baalon wala tha, jabke wo doosra aadmi jise usne apni biwi ke saath dekhne ka dawa kiya tha, saanwla, mota aur mote pinduliyon wala tha. Nabi (SAW) ne dua ki, "Aye Allah! Sach zaahir kar de." To us khaatoon ne ek aisa bacha paida hua jo us aadmi se milta-julta tha jise uske shohar ne uske saath paane ka dawa kiya tha. Phir Nabi (SAW) ne unse Lian karvaaya.' Phir majlis mein se ek shaks ne Ibn Abbas se pucha, 'Kya wo wahi khaatoon thi jiske baare mein Nabi (SAW) ne kaha tha, "Agar main kisi ko bagair gawaah ke rajm karta, to main is khaatoon ko rajm karta"?' Ibn Abbas ne kaha, 'Nahi, wo ek aur khaatoon thi jo, Musalmaan hote hue bhi, apne khule aam bad-chalan sulook se shak paida karti thi.'

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:I asked Ibn `Umar, "(What is the verdict if) a man accuses his wife of illegal sexual intercourse?" Ibn `Umar said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) separated (by divorce) the couple of Bani Al-Ajlan, and said, (to them), 'Allah knows that one of you two is a liar; so will one of you repent?' But both of them refused. He again said, 'Allah knows that one of you two is a liar; so will one of you repent?' But both of them refused. So he separated them by divorce." (Aiyub, a sub-narrator said: `Amr bin Dinar said to me, "There is something else in this Hadith which you have not mentioned. It goes thus: The man said, 'What about my money (i.e. the Mahr that I have given to my wife)?' It was said, 'You have no right to restore any money, for if you have spoken the truth (as regards the accusation), you have also consummated your marriage with her; and if you have told a lie, you are less rightful to have your money back
hi: Saeed bin Jubair bataate hain: Maine Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha, '(Kya faisla hoga agar) koi aadmi apni biwi par zina ka ilzaam lagaaye?' Ibn Umar ne kaha, 'Nabi (SAW) ne Banu Al-Ajlan ke jode ko (talaaq dekar) alag kar diya, aur unse kaha, "Allah jaanta hai tum mein se ek jhoota hai; to kya tum mein se koi tauba karega?" Magar dono ne inkaar kiya. Unhone dobara kaha, "Allah jaanta hai tum mein se ek jhoota hai; to kya tum mein se koi tauba karega?" Magar dono ne phir inkaar kiya. To unhone unhein talaaq dekar alag kar diya.' (Ravi Aiyub kehte hain: Amr bin Dinar ne mujhse kaha, 'Is hadees mein ek aur baat bhi hai jo tumne zikr nahi ki. Wo ye hai: Us aadmi ne kaha, "Mere maal (yaani wo Mahr jo maine apni biwi ko diya tha) ka kya hoga?" Usse kaha gaya, "Tumhein koi bhi maal wapas lene ka haq nahi, kyunke agar tumne sach kaha (ilzaam ke baare mein), to tumne unke saath apni shaadi bhi poori (rukhsati) kar li thi; aur agar tumne jhoot bola, to tumhein apna maal wapas lene ka haq aur bhi kam hai."')

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:I asked Ibn `Umar about those who were involved in a case of Lien. He said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) said to those who were involved in a case of Lien, 'Your accounts are with Allah. One of you two is a liar, and you (the husband) have no right over her (she is divorced)." The man said, 'What about my property (Mahr) ?' The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'You have no right to get back your property. If you have told the truth about her then your property was for the consummation of your marriage with her; and if you told a lie about her, then you are less rightful to get your property back.' " Sufyan, a sub-narrator said: I learned the Hadith from `Amr. Narrated Aiyub: I heard Sa`id bin Jubair saying, "I asked Ibn `Umar, 'If a man (accuses his wife for an illegal sexual intercourse and) carries out the process of Lian (what will happen)?' Ibn `Umar set two of his fingers apart. (Sufyan set his index finger and middle finger apart.) Ibn `Umar said, 'The Prophet (ﷺ) separated the couple of Bani Al-Ajlan by divorce and said thrice, "Allah knows that one of you two is a liar; so will one of you repent (to Allah)?
hi: Saeed bin Jubair bataate hain: Maine Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se un logon ke baare mein pucha jo Lian ke maamle mein shaamil the. Unhone kaha, 'Nabi (SAW) ne Lian mein shaamil logon se kaha, "Tumhaara hisaab Allah ke zimme hai. Tum dono mein se ek jhoota hai, aur tumhein (shohar ko) uspar koi haq nahi (wo talaaq-shuda hai)."' Us aadmi ne pucha, 'Mere maal (Mahr) ka kya hoga?' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Tumhein apna maal wapas lene ka koi haq nahi. Agar tumne uske baare mein sach kaha, to tumhaara maal uske saath tumhaari shaadi poori karne (rukhsati) ke badle tha; aur agar tumne jhoot bola, to tumhein apna maal wapas lene ka aur bhi kam haq hai.' Ravi Sufyan kehte hain: Maine ye hadees Amr se seekhi. Ravi Aiyub bataate hain: Maine Saeed bin Jubair ko ye kehte suna, 'Maine Ibn Umar se pucha, "Agar koi aadmi (apni biwi par zina ka ilzaam lagaaye aur) Lian ki karvaayi poori kare (to kya hoga)?" Ibn Umar ne apni do ungliyaan alag kin. (Ravi Sufyan ne apni shahaadat aur beech ki ungli alag ki.) Ibn Umar ne kaha, "Nabi (SAW) ne Banu Al-Ajlan ke jode ko talaaq dekar alag kiya aur teen baar kaha, 'Allah jaanta hai tum mein se ek jhoota hai; to kya tum mein se koi tauba karega?'"'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) separated (divorced) the wife from her husband who accused her for an illegal sexual intercourse, and made them take the oath of Lian
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne us biwi ko uske shohar se alag (talaaq dekar) kar diya jisne uspar zina ka ilzaam lagaaya tha, aur unse Lian ki qasm khilwaayi.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) made an Ansari man and his wife carry out Lian, and then separated them by divorce
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne ek Ansaari aadmi aur uski biwi se Lian karvaayi, phir unhein talaaq dekar alag kar diya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) made a man and his wife carry out Lian, and the husband repudiated her child. So the Prophet got them separated (by divorce) and decided that the child belonged to the mother only
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne ek aadmi aur uski biwi se Lian karvaayi, aur shohar ne bachche ka inkaar kiya. To Nabi (SAW) ne unhein talaaq dekar alag kar diya aur faisla kiya ke bacha sirf maa ka hoga.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Those involved in a case of Lian were mentioned before Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) `Asim bin Adi said something about that and then left. Later on a man from his tribe came to him and told him that he had found another man with his wife. On that `Asim said, "I have not been put to task except for what I have said (about Lian)." `Asim took the man to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he told him of the state in which he found his wife. The man was pale, thin and lank-haired, while the other man whom he had found with his wife was brown, fat with thick calves and curly hair. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! Reveal the truth." Then the lady delivered a child resembling the man whom her husband had mentioned he had found with her. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered them to carry out Lien. A man from that gathering said to Ibn `Abbas, "Was she the same lady regarding whom Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'If I were to stone to death someone without witnesses, I would have stoned this lady'?" Ibn `Abbas said, "No, that was another lady who, though being a Muslim, used to arouse suspicion because of her outright misbehavior
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saamne Lian mein shaamil logon ka zikr hua, Aasim bin Adi ne kuch kaha aur chale gaye. Baad mein unki qaum ka ek shaks unke paas aaya aur bataya ke usne apni biwi ke saath ek aur aadmi ko paaya hai. Isper Aasim ne kaha, 'Mujhe (Lian ke baare mein meri baat ke siwa) kisi kaam ke liye pareshaan nahi kiya gaya.' Aasim us aadmi ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas le gaye aur usne unhein bataya ke usne apni biwi ko kis haal mein paaya. Wo aadmi peela, dubla aur seedhe baalon wala tha, jabke wo doosra aadmi jise usne apni biwi ke saath paaya tha, saanwla, mota, mote pinduliyon aur ghunghraale baalon wala tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne dua ki, 'Aye Allah! Sach zaahir kar de.' Phir us khaatoon ne ek aisa bacha paida hua jo us aadmi se milta-julta tha jise uske shohar ne uske saath paane ka zikr kiya tha. To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhein Lian karne ka hukm diya. Us majlis mein se ek shaks ne Ibn Abbas se pucha, 'Kya wo wahi khaatoon thi jiske baare mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha tha, "Agar main kisi ko bagair gawaahon ke rajm karta, to main is khaatoon ko rajm karta"?' Ibn Abbas ne kaha, 'Nahi, wo ek aur khaatoon thi jo, Musalmaan hote hue bhi, apne khule aam bad-chalan sulook ki wajah se shak paida karti thi.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:Rifa`a Al-Qurazi married a lady and then divorced her whereupon she married another man. She came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said that her new husband did not approach her, and that he was completely impotent. The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to her), "No (you cannot remarry your first husband) till you taste the second husband and he tastes you (i.e. till he consummates his marriage with you)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Rifa'a Al-Qurazi ne ek khaatoon se nikaah kiya, phir use talaaq de di, isper usne ek doosre aadmi se nikaah kiya. Wo Nabi (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha ke uska naya shohar uske paas nahi aata aur wo poora tarah napumsak hai. Nabi (SAW) ne (usse) kaha, 'Nahi (tum apne pehle shohar se dobara nikaah nahi kar sakti) jab tak tum doosre shohar ka zaayeka na chakho aur wo tumhaara (yaani jab tak wo tumhaare saath apni shaadi poori na kar le).'

e: Narrated Um Salama:(the wife of the Prophet) A lady from Bani Aslam, called Subai'a, become a widow while she was pregnant. Abu As-Sanabil bin Ba'kak demanded her hand in marriage, but she refused to marry him and said, "By Allah, I cannot marry him unless I have completed one of the two prescribed periods." About ten days later (after having delivered her child), she went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he said (to her), "You can marry now
hi: Umm Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Banu Aslam ki ek khaatoon, jinka naam Subai'a tha, biwaa ho gayi jabke wo hamila thin. Abu As-Sanabil bin Ba'kak ne unse nikaah ka rishta maanga, magar unhone inkaar karte hue kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, main unse tab tak nikaah nahi karungi jab tak do muqarrar muddaton mein se ek poori na ho jaaye.' Taqreeban das din baad (bacha paidaish dene ke baad), wo Nabi (SAW) ke paas gayi aur unhone (unse) kaha, 'Ab tum nikaah kar sakti ho.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abdullah:that his father had written to Ibn Al-Arqam a letter asking him to ask Subai'a Al-Aslamiya how the Prophet had given her the verdict. She said, "The Prophet, gave me his verdict that after I gave birth, I could marry
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah bataate hain: Unke waalid ne Ibn Al-Arqam ko ek khat likha, unse Subai'a Al-Aslamiya se pucchne ko kaha ke Nabi (SAW) ne unhein kya faisla diya tha. Unhone kaha, 'Nabi (SAW) ne mujhe faisla diya tha ke bacha paidaish dene ke baad main nikaah kar sakti hoon.'

e: Narrated Al-Miswer bin Makhrama:Subai'a Al-Aslamiya gave birth to a child a few days after the death of her husband. She came to the Prophet and asked permission to remarry, and the Prophet (ﷺ) gave her permission, and she got married
hi: Al-Miswar bin Makhrama (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Subai'a Al-Aslamiya ne apne shohar ki maut ke kuch din baad bacha paidaish diya. Wo Nabi (SAW) ke paas aayi aur dobara nikaah ki ijaazat maangi, aur Nabi (SAW) ne unhein ijaazat de di, aur unhone nikaah kar liya.

e: (Narrated Qasim bin Muhammad and Sulaiman bin Yasar:that Yahya bin Sa`id bin Al-`As divorced the daughter of `Abdur-Rahman bin Al-Hakarn. `Abdur- Rahman took her to his house. On that `Aisha sent a message to Marwan bin Al-Hakam who was the ruler of Medina, saying, "Fear Allah, and urge your brother) to return her to her house." Marwan (in Sulaiman's version) said, "Abdur-Rahman bin Al-Hakam did not obey me (or had a convincing argument)." (In Al-Qasim's versions Marwan said, "Have you not heard of the case of Fatima bint Qais?" Aisha said, "The case of Fatima bint Qais is not in your favor.' Marwan bin Al-Hakam said to `Aisha, "The reason that made Fatima bint Qais go to her father's house is just applicable to the daughter of `Abdur-Rahman)
hi: Qasim bin Muhammad aur Sulaiman bin Yasar bataate hain: Yahya bin Saeed bin Al-As ne Abdur Rahman bin Al-Hakam ki beti ko talaaq de di. Abdur Rahman unhein apne ghar le gaye. Isper Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne Marwan bin Al-Hakam, jo Madina ke governor the, ko paighaam bheja, 'Allah se daro, aur apne bhai ko unhein unke (asal) ghar wapas bhejne ko kaho.' Marwan ne (Sulaiman ki riwayat mein) kaha, 'Abdur Rahman bin Al-Hakam ne meri baat nahi maani.' (Al-Qasim ki riwayat mein Marwan ne kaha,) 'Kya aapne Fatima (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Qais (رضی اللہ عنہا) ka maamla nahi suna?' Aisha ne kaha, 'Fatima bint Qais ka maamla tumhaare haq mein nahi hai.' Marwan bin Al-Hakam ne Aisha se kaha, 'Jo wajah Fatima bint Qais ko unke waalid ke ghar le gayi thi, wahi Abdur Rahman ki beti par bhi laagu hoti hai.'

e: Narrated Al-Qasim:Aisha said, "What is wrong with Fatima? Why doesn't she fear Allah?" by saying that a divorced lady is not entitled to be provided with residence and sustenance (by her husband)
hi: Al-Qasim bataate hain: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha, 'Fatima ko kya ho gaya hai? Wo Allah se kyun nahi darti,' ye kehte hue ke ek talaaq-shuda aurat ko apne shohar se rehne ki jagah aur kharche ka haq nahi hai.

e: Narrated Qasim:Urwa said to Aisha, "Do you know so-and-so, the daughter of Al-Hakam? Her husband divorced her irrevocably and she left (her husband's house)." `Aisha said, "What a bad thing she has done!" 'Urwa said (to `Aisha), "Haven't you heard the statement of Fatima?" `Aisha replied, "It is not in her favor to mention." 'Urwa added, `Aisha reproached (Fatima) severely and said, "Fatima was in a lonely place, and she was prone to danger, so the Prophet (ﷺ) allowed her (to go out of her husband's house)
hi: Qasim bataate hain: Urwa ne Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se kaha, 'Kya aap falaan, Al-Hakam ki beti, ko jaanti hain? Uske shohar ne use qatai talaaq de di aur usne (apne shohar ka ghar) chhod diya.' Aisha ne kaha, 'Usne kitna bura kaam kiya!' Urwa ne kaha, 'Kya aapne Fatima (رضی اللہ عنہا) ki baat nahi suni?' Aisha ne jawab diya, 'Uska zikr karna uske haq mein nahi hai.' Urwa ne aage kaha: Aisha ne (Fatima ko) sakhti se malaamat ki aur kaha, 'Fatima ek tanha jagah mein thi aur khatre mein padne ki sambhaawna thi, isliye Nabi (SAW) ne unhein (apne shohar ke ghar se) baahar jaane ki ijaazat di thi.'

e: Narrated 'Urwa:Aisha disapproved of what Fatima used to say
hi: Urwa bataate hain: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) jo kuch Fatima (رضی اللہ عنہا) kaha karti thin usse napasand karti thin.

e: Narrated `Aisha:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) decided to leave Mecca after the Hajj, he saw Safiyya, sad and standing at the entrance of her tent. He said to her, "Aqr (or) Halq! You will detain us. Did you perform Tawaf-al- Ifada on the day of Nahr? She said, "Yes." He said, "Then you can depart
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Hajj ke baad Makkah chhodne ka faisla kiya, unhone Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko udaas aur apne khaime ke darwaaze par khada dekha. Unhone kaha, 'Aqr (ya) Halq! Tum humein rok logi. Kya tumne Nahr ke din Tawaf-e-Ifaza kiya tha?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan.' Unhone farmaya, 'To tum jaa sakti ho.'

e: Narrated Al-Hasan:Ma'qil gave his sister in marriage and later her husband divorced her once
hi: Al-Hasan bataate hain: Ma'qil ne apni behen ka nikaah karwaya, aur baad mein uske shohar ne use ek baar talaaq de di.

e: Narrated Al-Hasan:The sister of Ma'qil bin Yasar was married to a man and then that man divorced her and remained away from her till her period of the 'Iddah expired. Then he demanded for her hand in marriage, but Ma'qil got angry out of pride and haughtiness and said, "He kept away from her when he could still retain her, and now he demands her hand again?" So Ma'qil disagreed to remarry her to him. Then Allah revealed: 'When you have divorced women and they have fulfilled the term of their prescribed period, do not prevent them from marrying their (former) husbands.' (2.232) So the Prophet (ﷺ) sent for Ma'qil and recited to him (Allah's order) and consequently Ma'qil gave up his pride and haughtiness and yielded to Allah's order
hi: Al-Hasan bataate hain: Ma'qil bin Yasar ki behen ki shaadi ek aadmi se hui, phir us aadmi ne use talaaq de di aur uski Iddat khatam hone tak door raha. Phir usne dobara uska rishta maanga, magar Ma'qil ghamand aur khud-daari mein gussa ho gaye aur kaha, 'Usne use tab door kiya jab wo use rakh sakta tha, aur ab dobara uska rishta maang raha hai?' To Ma'qil ne usse dobara nikaah karne se inkaar kiya. Phir Allah ne naazil farmaya: 'Jab tum auraton ko talaaq de chuko aur wo apni muqarrar muddat poori kar chukein, to unhein apne (pehle) shauharon se nikaah karne se mat roko.' (2.232) To Nabi (SAW) ne Ma'qil ko bulwaaya aur unhein (Allah ka hukm) padh kar sunaaya, isper Ma'qil ne apna ghamand aur khud-daari chhod di aur Allah ke hukm ke saamne jhuk gaye.

e: Narrated Nafi`:Ibn `Umar bin Al-Khattab divorced his wife during her menses. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered him to take her back till she became clean, and when she got another period while she was with him, she should wait till she became clean again and only then, if he wanted to divorce her, he could do so before having sexual relations with her. And that is the period Allah has fixed for divorcing women. Whenever `Abdullah (bin `Umar) was asked about that, he would say to the questioner, "If you divorced her thrice, she is no longer lawful for you unless she marries another man (and the other man divorces her in his turn).' Ibn `Umar further said, 'Would that you (people) only give one or two divorces, because the Prophet (ﷺ) has ordered me so
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab ne apni biwi ko haiz ki haalat mein talaaq de di. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhein hukm diya ke wo use wapas laayein jab tak wo paak na ho jaaye, aur jab unke saath rehte hue use dobara haiz aaye, to wo tab tak intezaar kare jab tak dobara paak na ho jaaye, sirf tab, agar wo talaaq dena chaahe, to wo humbistari se pehle de sakta hai. Aur yahi wo muddat hai jo Allah ne auraton ko talaaq dene ke liye muqarrar ki hai. Jab bhi Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) (bin Umar) se iske baare mein pucha jaata, wo poochne wale se kehte, 'Agar tumne use teen baar talaaq de di, to wo tumhaare liye jaayez nahi jab tak wo kisi aur aadmi se nikaah na kare (aur wo aadmi bhi use talaaq de).' Ibn Umar ne aage kaha, 'Kaash tum (log) sirf ek ya do talaaqein hi do, kyunke Nabi (SAW) ne mujhe aisa hi karne ka hukm diya tha.'

e: Narrated Yunus Ibn Jubair:Ibn `Umar divorced his wife while she was having her menses. `Umar asked the Prophet (ﷺ) who said, "Order him (your son) to take her back, and then divorced her before her period of the 'Iddah has elapsed." I asked Ibn `Umar, "Will that divorce (during the menses) be counted?" He replied, "If somebody behaves foolishly (will his foolishness be an excuse for his misbehavior)?
hi: Yunus Ibn Jubair bataate hain: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne apni biwi ko haiz ki haalat mein talaaq de di. Umar ne Nabi (SAW) se pucha, unhone farmaya, 'Use (apne bete ko) hukm do ke wo use wapas laaye, phir uski Iddat khatam hone se pehle use talaaq de.' Maine Ibn Umar se pucha, 'Kya wo talaaq (haiz ke dauraan) gini jaayegi?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Agar koi bewaqoofi kare (to kya uski bewaqoofi uski galti ka bahaana banegi)?'

e: Narrated Humaid bin Nafi`:Zainab bint Abu Salama told me these three narrations: Zainab said: I went to Um Habiba, the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ) when her father, Abu- Sufyan bin Herb had died. Um ,Habiba asked for a perfume which contained yellow scent (Khaluq) or some other scent, and she first perfumed one of the girls with it and then rubbed her cheeks with it and said, "By Allah, I am not in need of perfume, but I have heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, 'It is not lawful for a lady who believes in Allah and the Last Day to mourn for a dead person for more than three days unless he is her husband for whom she should mourn for four months and ten days
hi: Humaid bin Nafi bataate hain: Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Abu Salama ne mujhe ye teen riwaayaten bataayin. Zainab ne kaha: Main Umm Habiba (رضی اللہ عنہا), Nabi (SAW) ki biwi, ke paas gayi jab unke waalid, Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Harb, ka intekaal hua. Umm Habiba ne ek khushbu maangi jismein peela rang (Khaluq) ya koi aur khushbu thi, aur pehle usse ek launDi ko lagaaya, phir apne gaalon par mali aur kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, mujhe khushbu ki zaroorat nahi, magar maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna hai, "Kisi aisi aurat ke liye jaayez nahi jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par Iman rakhti ho ke wo kisi mare hue ke liye teen din se zyaada maatam kare, siwaaye apne shohar ke, jiske liye use chaar mahine das din maatam karna chaahiye."'

e: Zainab further said:I want to Zainab bint Jahsh when her brother died. She asked for perfume and used some of it and said, "By Allah, I am not in need of perfume, but I have heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying on the pulpit, 'It is not lawful for a lady who believes in Allah and the last day to mourn for more than three days except for her husband for whom she should mourn for four months and ten days
hi: Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne aage kaha: Main Zainab bint Jahsh (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas gayi jab unke bhai ka intekaal hua. Unhone khushbu maangi aur kuch lagaayi aur kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, mujhe khushbu ki zaroorat nahi, magar maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko mimbar par ye farmaate suna hai, "Kisi aisi aurat ke liye jaayez nahi jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par Iman rakhti ho ke wo teen din se zyaada maatam kare, siwaaye apne shohar ke, jiske liye use chaar mahine das din maatam karna chaahiye."'

e: Zainab further said:"I heard my mother, Um Salama saying that a woman came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! The husband of my daughter has died and she is suffering from an eye disease, can she apply kohl to her eye?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, "No," twice or thrice. (Every time she repeated her question) he said, "No." Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) added, "It is just a matter of four months and ten days. In the Pre-Islamic Period of ignorance a widow among you should throw a globe of dung when one year has elapsed
hi: Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne aage kaha: Maine apni maa, Umm Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا), ko kehte suna ke ek aurat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Meri beti ke shohar ka intekaal ho gaya hai aur uski aankh mein takleef hai, kya wo apni aankh mein surma laga sakti hai?' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne do ya teen baar kaha, 'Nahi.' (Har baar jab usne apna sawaal dohraaya) unhone kaha, 'Nahi.' Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ye sirf chaar mahine das din ki baat hai. Jaahiliyat ke daur mein tum mein se koi biwaa ek saal guzarne par gobar ka golaa phenka karti thi.'

e: I (Humaid) said to Zainab, "What does 'throwing a globe of dung when one year had elapsed' mean?" Zainab said, "When a lady was bereaved of her husband, she would live in a wretched small room and put on the worst clothes she had and would not touch any scent till one year had elapsed. Then she would bring an animal, e.g. a donkey, a sheep or a bird and rub her body against it. The animal against which she would rub her body would scarcely survive. Only then she would come out of her room, whereupon she would be given a globe of dung which she would throw away and then she would use the scent she liked or the like
hi: Main (Humaid) ne Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) se pucha, 'Ek saal guzarne par gobar ka golaa phenkne ka kya matlab hai?' Zainab ne kaha, 'Jab koi aurat apne shohar ki maut se dukhi hoti, to wo ek chhoti aur kharaab kamre mein rehti, apne sabse bure kapde pehanti, aur ek saal guzarne tak koi khushbu na chhoo-ti. Phir wo koi jaanwar, jaise gadha, bakri ya panchi laati aur usse apna jism ragadti. Jis jaanwar se wo apna jism ragadti, wo shaayad hi zinda bachta. Tab jaakar wo apne kamre se baahar aati, aur usse gobar ka golaa diya jaata jise wo phenk deti, phir wo apni pasand ki khushbu istemaal kar sakti thi.'

e: Narrated Um Salama: A woman was bereaved of her husband and her relatives worried about her eyes (which were diseased). They came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and asked him to allow them to treat her eyes with kohl, but he said, "She should not apply kohl to her eyes. (In the Pre-Islamic period of Ignorance) a widowed woman among you would stay in the worst of her clothes (or the worst part of her house) and when a year had elapsed, if a dog passed by her, she would throw a globe of dung, Nay, (she cannot use kohl) till four months and ten days have elapsed
hi: Umm Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ek aurat apne shohar ki maut se dukhi thi aur uske rishtedaar uski (bimaar) aankhon ke baare mein pareshaan the. Wo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unhein surma se uski aankhon ka ilaaj karne ki ijaazat maangi, magar unhone kaha, 'Use surma nahi lagaana chaahiye. (Jaahiliyat ke daur mein) tum mein se koi biwaa apne sabse bure kapdon (ya ghar ke sabse bure hisse) mein rehti, aur jab ek saal guzar jaata, agar koi kutta uske paas se guzarta, to wo gobar ka golaa phenkti. Nahi, (wo surma tab tak nahi laga sakti) jab tak chaar mahine das din na guzar jaayein.'

e: Narrated Um Habiba:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It is not lawful for a Muslim woman who believes in Allah and the Last Day to mourn for more than three days, except for her husband, for whom she should mourn for four months and ten days
hi: Umm Habiba (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kisi Musalmaan aurat ke liye jaayez nahi jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par Iman rakhti ho ke wo teen din se zyaada maatam kare, siwaaye apne shohar ke, jiske liye use chaar mahine das din maatam karna chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Um 'Atiyya:We were forbidden to mourn for more than three days except for a husband
hi: Umm Atiyya bataati hain: Humein teen din se zyaada maatam karne se mana kiya gaya tha, siwaaye shohar ke liye.

e: Narrated Um 'Atiyya:We were forbidden to mourn for more than three days for a dead person, except for a husband, for whom a wife should mourn for four months and ten days (while in the mourning period) we were not allowed to put kohl in our eyes, nor perfume our-selves, nor wear dyed clothes, except a garment of 'Asb (special clothes made in Yemen). But it was permissible for us that when one of us became clean from her menses and took a bath, she could use a piece of a certain kind of incense. And it was forbidden for us to follow funeral processions
hi: Umm Atiyya bataati hain: Humein kisi mare hue ke liye teen din se zyaada maatam karne se mana kiya gaya tha, siwaaye shohar ke, jiske liye biwi ko chaar mahine das din maatam karna chaahiye. (Maatam ki muddat mein) humein aankhon mein surma lagaane, khushbu lagaane, ya rangeen kapde pehnne ki ijaazat nahi thi, siwaaye Asb (Yemen mein banaaye jaane wale khaas kapde) ke. Magar humein ye ijaazat thi ke jab hum mein se koi apni haiz se paak hokar nahaale, to wo ek khaas qism ki khushbu (loban) istemaal kar sakti thi. Aur humein janaaze ke jaloos mein shaamil hone se bhi mana kiya gaya tha.

e: Narrated Um 'Atiyya:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It is not lawful for a lady who believes in Allah and the Last Day, to mourn for more than three days for a dead person, except for her husband, in which case she should neither put kohl in her eyes, nor perfume herself, nor wear dyed clothes, except a garment of 'Asb
hi: Umm Atiyya bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kisi aisi aurat ke liye jaayez nahi jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par Iman rakhti ho ke wo kisi mare hue ke liye teen din se zyaada maatam kare, siwaaye apne shohar ke, jiske liye use na aankhon mein surma lagaana chaahiye, na khushbu lagaani chaahiye, na rangeen kapde pehnne chaahiye, siwaaye Asb ke kapde ke.'

e: Um 'Atiyya added:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "She should not use perfume except when she becomes clean from her menses whereupon she can use Qust, and Azfar (two kinds of incense)
hi: Umm Atiyya ne aage kaha: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Use khushbu istemaal nahi karni chaahiye siwaaye jab wo apni haiz se paak ho jaaye, tab wo Qust aur Azfar (do qism ki khushbu) istemaal kar sakti hai.'

e: Narrated Mujahid:(regarding the Verse): 'If any of you dies and leaves wives behind,' That was the period of the 'Iddah which the widow was obliged to spend in the house of the late husband. Then Allah revealed: And those of you who die and leave wives should bequeath for their wives a year's maintenance and residence without turning them out, but if they leave, there is no blame on you for what they do of themselves, provided it is honorable (i.e. lawful marriage) (2.240) Mujahid said: Allah has ordered that a widow has the right to stay for seven months and twenty days with her husband's relatives through her husband's will and testament so that she will complete the period of one year (of 'Iddah). But the widow has the right to stay that extra period or go out of her husband's house as is indicated by the statement of Allah: 'But if they leave there is no blame on you,... ' (2.240) Ibn `Abbas said: The above Verse has cancelled the order of spending the period of the 'Iddah at her late husband's house, and so she could spend her period of the 'Iddah wherever she likes. And Allah says: 'Without turning them out.' 'Ata said: If she would, she could spend her period of the 'Iddah at her husband's house, and live there according to her (husband's) will and testament, and if she would, she could go out (of her husband's house) as Allah says: 'There is no blame on you for what they do of themselves.' (2.240) 'Ata added: Then the Verses of inheritance were revealed and the order of residence (for the widow) was cancelled, and she could spend her period of the 'Iddah wherever she would like, and she was no longer entitled to be accommodated by her husband's family
hi: Mujahid is Aayat ke baare mein bataate hain: 'Agar tum mein se koi mar jaaye aur biwiyaan chhod jaaye.' Ye wo Iddat ki muddat thi jo biwaa ko apne marhoom shohar ke ghar mein guzaarni padti thi. Phir Allah ne naazil farmaya: 'Aur tum mein se jo mar jaayein aur biwiyaan chhod jaayein, unhein apni biwiyon ke liye ek saal ka kharcha aur rehne ki jagah ki wasiyat karni chaahiye, unhein (ghar se) nikaale bagair, magar agar wo khud chali jaayein, to tumpar koi gunaah nahi jo wo jaayez tareeke se (yaani jaayez nikaah) apne liye karein.' (2.240) Mujahid ne kaha, 'Allah ne hukm diya hai ke biwaa ko apne shohar ki wasiyat ke zariye sattar (7) mahine bees (20) din tak shohar ke rishtedaaron ke saath rehne ka haq hai, taake wo ek saal (ki Iddat) poori kar le. Magar biwaa ko ye bhi haq hai ke wo ye izaafi muddat rahe ya shohar ke ghar se chali jaaye, jaisa Allah ke is farmaan se zaahir hota hai: "Magar agar wo chali jaayein to tumpar koi gunaah nahi..."' (2.240) Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Upar wali Aayat ne Iddat marhoom shohar ke ghar mein guzaarne ke hukm ko mansookh kar diya, isliye ab wo apni Iddat jahaan chaahe guzaar sakti hai.' Aur Allah farmaata hai: 'Unhein nikaale bagair.' Ata ne kaha, 'Agar wo chaahe, to apni Iddat apne shohar ke ghar mein, uski wasiyat ke mutaabik, guzaar sakti hai; aur agar chaahe to (shohar ke ghar se) baahar jaa sakti hai, jaisa Allah farmaata hai: "Tumpar koi gunaah nahi jo wo khud apne liye karein."' (2.240) Ata ne aage kaha: 'Phir miraas ki Aayaten naazil hui aur (biwaa ke) rehne ka hukm mansookh ho gaya, aur wo apni Iddat jahaan chaahe guzaar sakti thi, aur use ab shohar ke khaandaan ki taraf se rehaayish paane ka haq nahi raha.'

e: Narrated Zainab bint Um Salama:When Um Habiba bint Abi Sufyan was informed of her father's death, she asked for perfume and rubbed it over her arms and said, "I am not in need of perfume, but I have heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "It is not lawful for a lady who believes in Allah and the Last Day to mourn for more than three days except for her husband for whom the (mourning) period is four months and ten days
hi: Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Umm Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab Umm Habiba (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Abi Sufyan ko unke waalid ki maut ki khabar mili, unhone khushbu maangi aur apni baahon par mali aur kaha, 'Mujhe khushbu ki zaroorat nahi, magar maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna hai, "Kisi aisi aurat ke liye jaayez nahi jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par Iman rakhti ho ke wo teen din se zyaada maatam kare, siwaaye apne shohar ke, jiske liye (maatam ki) muddat chaar mahine das din hai."'

e: Narrated Abu Mas`ud:The Prophet (ﷺ) prohibited taking the price of a dog, the earnings of a soothsayer and the money earned by prostitution
hi: Abu Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne kutte ki qeemat lene se, nujoomi ki kamaai se, aur badkaari se kamaaye gaye paise se mana kiya.

e: Narrated Abu Juhaifa:The Prophet (ﷺ) cursed the lady who practices tattooing and the one who gets herself tattooed, and one who eats (takes) Riba' (usury) and the one who gives it. And he prohibited taking the price of a dog, and the money earned by prostitution, and cursed the makers of pictures
hi: Abu Juhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne us aurat par laanat ki jo gudna banaati hai aur jo gudna banwaati hai, aur jo sood (riba) khaata hai aur jo deta hai. Aur unhone kutte ki qeemat lene se aur badkaari se kamaaye gaye paise se mana kiya, aur tasveerein banaane walon par laanat ki.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade taking the earnings of a slave girl by prostitution
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne launDi ki badkaari se kamaayi hui kamaai lene se mana kiya.

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:I said to Ibn `Umar, "If a man accuses his wife of illegal sexual intercourse (what is the judgment)?" He said, "Allah's Prophet separated the couple of Bani 'Ajlan (when the husband accused his wife for an illegal sexual intercourse). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Allah knows that one of you two IS a liar; so will one of you repent?' But they refused. He then again said, 'Allah knows that one of you two is a liar; so will one of you repent?' But they refused, whereupon he separated them by divorce." Aiyub (a subnarrator) said: `Amr bin Dinar said to me, "In the narration there is something which I do not see you mentioning, i.e. the husband said, "What about my money (Mahr)?' The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You are not entitled to take back money, for if you told the truth you have already entered upon her (and consummated your marriage with her) and if you are a liar then you are less entitled to take it back
hi: Saeed bin Jubair bataate hain: Maine Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kaha, 'Agar koi aadmi apni biwi par zina ka ilzaam lagaaye (to kya faisla hoga)?' Unhone kaha, 'Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne Banu Ajlan ke jode ko alag kiya (jab shohar ne apni biwi par zina ka ilzaam lagaaya). Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, "Allah jaanta hai tum mein se ek jhoota hai; to kya tum mein se koi tauba karega?" Magar unhone inkaar kiya. Unhone dobara kaha, "Allah jaanta hai tum mein se ek jhoota hai; to kya tum mein se koi tauba karega?" Magar unhone phir inkaar kiya, isper unhone unhein talaaq dekar alag kar diya.' Ravi Aiyub kehte hain: Amr bin Dinar ne mujhse kaha, 'Is riwayat mein ek baat hai jo tumne zikr nahi ki, yaani shohar ne kaha, "Mere maal (Mahr) ka kya hoga?" Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, "Tumhein maal wapas lene ka haq nahi, kyunke agar tumne sach kaha, to tum pehle hi unke paas ja chuke ho (aur shaadi poori kar chuke ho), aur agar tum jhoote ho, to tumhein isse bhi kam haq hai wapas lene ka."'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said to those who were involved in a case of Lian, "Your accounts are with Allah. One of you two is a liar. You (husband) have right on her (wife)." The husband said, "My money, O Allah's Apostle!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You are not entitled to take back any money. If you have told the truth, the Mahr that you paid, was for having sexual relations with her lawfully; and if you are a liar, then you are less entitled to get it back
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne Lian mein shaamil logon se kaha, 'Tumhaara hisaab Allah ke zimme hai. Tum dono mein se ek jhoota hai. Tumhein (shohar ko) uspar (koi) haq nahi.' Shohar ne kaha, 'Mera maal, Aye Allah ke Rasool!' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Tumhein koi bhi maal wapas lene ka haq nahi. Agar tumne sach kaha, to jo Mahr tumne diya wo unke saath jaayez tareeke se humbistari karne ke liye tha; aur agar tum jhoote ho, to tumhein use wapas lene ka aur bhi kam haq hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Mas`ud Al-Ansari:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When a Muslim spends something on his family intending to receive Allah's reward it is regarded as Sadaqa for him
hi: Abu Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ansari (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab koi Musalmaan apne khaandaan par kuch kharch karta hai aur Allah ke ajr ki niyat rakhta hai, to ye uske liye Sadqa mana jaata hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah said, 'O son of Adam! Spend, and I shall spend on you
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah farmaata hai, "Aye Aadam ke bete! Kharch karo, Main tumpar kharch karunga."'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The one who looks after a widow or a poor person is like a Mujahid (warrior) who fights for Allah's Cause, or like him who performs prayers all the night and fasts all the day
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi biwaa ya gareeb ki dekhbhaal karta hai, wo Allah ki raah mein jihaad karne wale Mujahid jaisa hai, ya us shaks jaisa hai jo poori raat namaz padhta hai aur poore din roza rakhta hai.'

e: Narrated Sa`d:The Prophet (ﷺ) visited me at Mecca while I was ill. I said (to him), "I have property; May I bequeath all my property in Allah's Cause?" He said, "No." I said, "Half of it?" He said, "No." I said, "One third of it?" He said, "One-third (is alright), yet it is still too much, for you'd better leave your inheritors wealthy than leave them poor, begging of others. Whatever you spend will be considered a Sadaqa for you, even the mouthful of food you put in the mouth of your wife. Anyhow Allah may let you recover, so that some people may benefit by you and others be harmed by you
hi: Sa'd bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne Makkah mein mujhse milne aaye jab main bimar tha. Maine kaha, 'Mere paas jaayadaad hai; kya main apni saari jaayadaad Allah ki raah mein wasiyat kar doon?' Unhone kaha, 'Nahi.' Maine kaha, 'Aadhi?' Unhone kaha, 'Nahi.' Maine kaha, 'Ek-tihaai?' Unhone kaha, 'Ek-tihaai (theek hai), phir bhi ye bahut zyaada hai, kyunke apne waarison ko ameer chhodna behtar hai gareeb chhodne se, jo doosron se bheekh maangte phirein. Jo kuch bhi tum kharch karoge, wo tumhaare liye Sadqa mana jaayega, chaahe wo apni biwi ke munh mein daala gaya ek nawaala hi kyun na ho. Beshak Allah tumhein sehat de sakta hai, taake kuch log tumse faayda uthaayein aur kuch nuqsaan.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:"The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'The best alms is that which is given when one is rich, and a giving hand is better than a taking one, and you should start first to support your dependents.' A wife says, 'You should either provide me with food or divorce me.' A slave says, 'Give me food and enjoy my service." A son says, "Give me food; to whom do you leave me?" The people said, "O Abu Huraira! Did you hear that from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ?" He said, "No, it is from my own self
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: 'Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, "Sabse behtar sadqa wo hai jo insaan tab de jab wo khud maldar ho, aur dene wala haath lene wale haath se behtar hai, aur tumhein pehle apne zimme daaron ka khayaal rakhna chaahiye." Ek biwi kehti hai, "Ya to mujhe khaana do ya mujhe talaaq de do." Ek ghulaam kehta hai, "Mujhe khaana do aur meri khidmat ka faayda uthao." Ek beta kehta hai, "Mujhe khaana do; tum mujhe kiske paas chhod rahe ho?"' Logon ne pucha, 'Aye Abu Huraira! Kya aapne ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna?' Unhone kaha, 'Nahi, ye meri apni raay hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The best alms is that which you give when you are rich, and you should start first to support your dependants
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Sabse behtar sadqa wo hai jo tum tab do jab tum maldaar ho, aur tumhein pehle apne zimme daaron ka khayaal rakhna chaahiye.'

e: Narrated `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to sell the dates of the garden of Bani An-Nadir and store for his family so much food as would cover their needs for a whole year
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) Banu An-Nadir ke baagh ki khajoorein becha karte the aur apne khaandaan ke liye itna anaaj jama karte the jo unki poore saal ki zaroorat poori kar sake.

e: Narrated Malik bin Aus bin Al-Hadathan:Once I set out to visit `Umar (bin Al-Khattab). (While I was sitting there with him his gate-keeper, Yarfa, came and said, "Uthman `AbdurRahman (bin `Auf), Az-Zubair and Sa`d (bin Abi Waqqas) are seeking permission (to meet you)." `Umar said, "Yes. So he admitted them and they entered, greeted, and sat down. After a short while Yarfa came again and said to `Umar 'Shall I admit `Ali and `Abbas?" `Umar said, "Yes." He admitted them and when they entered, they greeted and sat down. `Abbas said, "O Chief of the Believers! Judge between me and this (`Ali)." The group, `Uthman and his companions Sa`d, 'O Chief of the Believers! Judge between them and relieve one from the other." `Umar said. Wait! I beseech you by Allah, by Whose permission both the Heaven and the Earth stand fast ! Do you know that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said. 'We (Apostles) do not bequeath anything to our heirs, but whatever we leave is to be given in charity.' And by that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) meant himself?" The group said, "He did say so." `Umar then turned towards 'Ali and `Abbas and said. "I beseech you both by Allah, do you know that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said that?" They said, 'Yes " `Umar said, "Now, let me talk to you about this matter. Allah favored His Apostle with something of this property (war booty) which He did not give to anybody else. And Allah said:-- 'And what Allah has bestowed on His Apostle (as Fai Booty) from them for which you made no expedition with either cavalry or camelry . . . Allah is Able to do all things.' (59.6) So this property was especially granted to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). But by Allah he neither withheld it from you, nor did he keep it for himself and deprive you of it, but he gave it all to you and distributed it among you till only this remained out of it. And out of this property Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to provide his family with their yearly needs, and whatever remained, he would spend where Allah's Property (the revenues of Zakat) used to be spent. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) kept on acting like this throughout his lifetime. Now I beseech you by Allah, do you know that?" They said, "Yes." Then `Umar said to `Ali and `Abbas, "I beseech you by Allah, do you both know that?" They said, "Yes." `Umar added, "When Allah had taken His Apostle unto Him, Abu Bakr said, 'I am the successor of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). So he took charge of that property and did with it the same what Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to do, and both of you knew all about it then." Then `Umar turned towards `Ali and `Abbas and said, "You both claim that Abu- Bakr was so-and-so! But Allah knows that he was honest, sincere, pious and right (in that matter). Then Allah caused Abu Bakr to die, and I said, 'I am the successor of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr.' So I kept this property in my possession for the first two years of my rule, and I used to do the same with it as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr used to do. Later both of you (`Ali and `Abbas) came to me with the same claim and the same problem. (O `Abbas!) You came to me demanding your share from (the inheritance of) the son of your brother, and he (`Ali) came to me demanding his wives share from (the inheritance of) her father. So I said to you, 'If you wish I will hand over this property to you, on condition that you both promise me before Allah that you will manage it in the same way as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr did, and as I have done since the beginning of my rule; otherwise you should not speak to me about it.' So you both said, 'Hand over this property to us on this condition.' And on this condition I handed it over to you. I beseech you by Allah, did I hand it over to them on that condition?" The group said, "Yes." `Umar then faced `Ali and `Abbas and said, "I beseech you both by Allah, did I hand it over to you both on that condition?" They both said, "Yes." `Umar added, "Do you want me now to give a decision other than that? By Him with Whose permission (order) both the Heaven and the Earth stand fast, I will never give any decision other than that till the Hour is established! But if you are unable to manage it (that property), then return it to me and I will be sufficient for it on your behalf
hi: Malik bin Aus bin Al-Hadathan bataate hain: Ek baar main Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) (bin Al-Khattab) se milne gaya. (Jab main unke saath baitha tha) unke darwaan, Yarfa, aaye aur kaha, 'Uthman, Abdur Rahman (bin Auf), Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Sa'd (bin Abi Waqqas) ijaazat maang rahe hain (aapse milne ki).' Umar ne kaha, 'Haan.' To unhone unhein andar aane diya aur wo daakhil hue, salaam kiya aur baith gaye. Thodi der baad Yarfa dobara aaye aur Umar se kaha, 'Kya main Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Abbas ko andar aane doon?' Umar ne kaha, 'Haan.' Unhein andar aane diya, aur jab wo daakhil hue, unhone salaam kiya aur baith gaye. Abbas ne kaha, 'Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen! Mere aur inke (Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke) beech faisla kijiye.' Us giroh ne, Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur unke saathiyon ne, kaha, 'Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen! Unke beech faisla kar dijiye aur ek ko doosre se araam dijiye.' Umar ne kaha, 'Ruko! Main tumhein us Allah ki qasam deta hoon jiski ijaazat se aasman aur zameen qaayam hain! Kya tumhein pata hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya tha, "Hum (Nabi log) apne waarison ke liye kuch nahi chhodte, jo kuch hum chhodte hain wo sadqe mein diya jaata hai," aur ismein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka ishara khud unki taraf tha?' Giroh ne kaha, 'Unhone waaqai aisa kaha tha.' Umar phir Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Abbas ki taraf mude aur kaha, 'Main tum dono ko Allah ki qasam deta hoon, kya tumhein pata hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ye kaha tha?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan.' Umar ne kaha, 'Ab main tumse is maamle ke baare mein baat karta hoon. Allah ne apne Rasool (SAW) ko is jaayadaad (maal-e-ganimat) mein se kuch aisa diya jo kisi aur ko nahi diya. Allah farmaata hai: "Aur jo Allah ne apne Rasool ko unse (Fai ke taur par) diya, jiske liye tumne na oont se na ghode se koi mohim ki... Allah har cheez par qaadir hai." (59:6) To ye jaayadaad khaas taur par Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke liye di gayi thi. Magar Allah ki qasam, unhone na to ise tumse rok kar rakha, na hi khud ke liye rakha aur tumhein mehroom kiya, balke unhone ye sab tumhein de diya aur tum mein baant diya, yahaan tak ke sirf itna hi bacha. Aur is jaayadaad mein se, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apne khaandaan ki saalaana zaroorat poori karte the, aur jo bachta, use wahaan kharch karte jahaan Allah ki jaayadaad (Zakat ki aamdani) kharch ki jaati thi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apni poori zindagi aisa hi karte rahe. Ab main tumhein Allah ki qasam deta hoon, kya tumhein ye pata hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan.' Phir Umar ne Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Abbas se kaha, 'Main tum dono ko Allah ki qasam deta hoon, kya tum dono ko ye pata hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan.' Umar ne aage kaha, 'Jab Allah ne apne Rasool (SAW) ko apne paas bula liya, Abu Bakr ne kaha, "Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka jaanasheen hoon." To unhone us jaayadaad ka zimma liya aur usi tarah kaam kiya jaisa Allah ke Rasool (SAW) kiya karte the, aur tum dono ko ye sab pata tha.' Phir Umar ne Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Abbas ki taraf mudkar kaha, 'Tum dono dawa karte ho ke Abu Bakr aisa-aisa the! Magar Allah jaanta hai ke wo imaandaar, sacche, neik aur (us maamle mein) haq par the. Phir Allah ne Abu Bakr ko wafat de di, aur maine kaha, "Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur Abu Bakr ka jaanasheen hoon." To maine apne hukumat ke pehle do saal ye jaayadaad apne paas rakhi, aur maine usi tarah kaam kiya jaisa Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur Abu Bakr karte the. Baad mein tum dono (Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Abbas) mere paas isi dawe aur maamle ke saath aaye. (Aye Abbas!) Tum mere paas apne bhatije (Nabi) ki miraas mein se apna hissa maangne aaye, aur wo (Ali (Alayhis Salam)) apni biwi (Fatima (Alayhas Salam)) ke waalid ki miraas mein se unka hissa maangne aaye. To maine tumse kaha, "Agar tum chaaho, to main ye jaayadaad tumhein de doon, is shart par ke tum dono Allah ke saamne mujhse waada karo ke tum ise usi tarah sambhaaloge jaise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur Abu Bakr ne kiya, aur jaise maine apni hukumat ki shuruaat se kiya hai; warna tum iske baare mein mujhse baat na karo." To tum dono ne kaha, "Ye jaayadaad humein isi shart par de dijiye." Aur maine isi shart par tumhein ye di. Main tumhein Allah ki qasam deta hoon, kya maine ye tumhein isi shart par di thi?' Giroh ne kaha, 'Haan.' Umar phir Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Abbas ki taraf mude aur kaha, 'Main tum dono ko Allah ki qasam deta hoon, kya maine ye tumhein isi shart par di thi?' Unhone dono ne kaha, 'Haan.' Umar ne aage kaha, 'Kya tum chahte ho ke main ab iske ilaawa koi aur faisla doon? Us Zaat ki qasam jiski ijaazat se aasman aur zameen qaayam hain, main is faisle ke siwa koi aur faisla kabhi nahi dunga, Qayamat tak! Magar agar tum ise (jaayadaad ko) sambhaal nahi paate, to ise mujhe wapas kar do, aur main tumhaari taraf se iski dekhbhaal karunga.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:Hind bint `Utba came and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Abu Sufyan is a miser so is it sinful of me to feed our children from his property?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "No except if you take for your needs what is just and reasonable
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Hind bint Utba aayi aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ) kanjoos hain, to kya mera unke maal se apne bachon ko khilaana gunaah hoga?' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Nahi, siwaaye is ke ke tum sirf itna hi lo jo jaayez aur munasib ho.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If the wife gives of her husband's property (something in charity) without his permission, he will get half the reward
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar biwi apne shohar ke maal mein se (kuch) sadqa de, uski ijaazat ke bagair, to shohar ko (uska) aadha ajr milega.'

e: Narrated `Ali:Fatima went to the Prophet (ﷺ) complaining about the bad effect of the stone hand-mill on her hand. She heard that the Prophet (ﷺ) had received a few slave girls. But (when she came there) she did not find him, so she mentioned her problem to `Aisha. When the Prophet (ﷺ) came, `Aisha informed him about that. `Ali added, "So the Prophet (ﷺ) came to us when we had gone to bed. We wanted to get up (on his arrival) but he said, 'Stay where you are." Then he came and sat between me and her and I felt the coldness of his feet on my `Abdomen. He said, "Shall I direct you to something better than what you have requested? When you go to bed say 'Subhan Allah' thirty-three times, 'Al hamduli l-lah' thirty three times, and Allahu Akbar' thirty four times, for that is better for you than a servant
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Fatima (Alayhas Salam) Nabi (SAW) ke paas gayi aur chakki peesne se haath mein hone wali takleef ki shikaayat ki. Unhone suna tha ke Nabi (SAW) ko kuch laundiyaan mili hain. Magar (jab wo wahaan pahunchi) unhein Nabi (SAW) nahi mile, to unhone apni pareshaani Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko bataayi. Jab Nabi (SAW) aaye, Aisha ne unhein iske baare mein bataaya. Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne aage kaha, 'To Nabi (SAW) humare paas aaye jab hum bistar par ja chuke the. Hum unke aane par uthna chaahte the, magar unhone kaha, "Jahaan ho wahin raho."' Phir wo aaye aur mere aur unke (Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ke) beech baith gaye, aur maine unke pairon ki thandak apne pet par mehsoos ki. Unhone farmaya, 'Kya main tumhein us se behtar cheez na bataun jo tumne maanga? Jab tum bistar par jao, to "Subhan-Allah" taintees baar, "Al-Hamdulillah" taintees baar, aur "Allahu-Akbar" chauntees baar kaho, kyunke ye tumhaare liye ek naukar se behtar hai.'

e: Narrated `Ali bin Abi Talib:Fatima came to the Prophet (ﷺ) asking for a servant. He said, "May I inform you of something better than that? When you go to bed, recite "Subhan Allah' thirty three times, 'Al hamduli l-lah' thirty three times, and 'Allahu Akbar' thirty four times. `Ali added, 'I have never failed to recite it ever since." Somebody asked, "Even on the night of the battle of Siffin?" He said, "Even on the night of the battle of Siffin
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bin Abi Talib bataate hain: Fatima (Alayhas Salam) Nabi (SAW) ke paas ek naukar maangne aayi. Unhone kaha, 'Kya main tumhein usse behtar cheez na bataun? Jab tum bistar par jao, to "Subhan-Allah" taintees baar, "Al-Hamdulillah" taintees baar, aur "Allahu-Akbar" chauntees baar padho.' Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne aage kaha, 'Maine tab se ise kabhi padhna nahi chhoda.' Kisi ne pucha, 'Siffin ki jang ki raat bhi?' Unhone kaha, 'Siffin ki jang ki raat bhi.'

e: Narrated Al-Aswad bin Yazid:I asked `Aisha "What did the Prophet (ﷺ) use to do at home?" She said, "He used to work for his family, and when he heard the Adhan (call for the prayer), he would go out
hi: Al-Aswad bin Yazid bataate hain: Maine Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se pucha, 'Nabi (SAW) ghar mein kya kaam kiya karte the?' Unhone kaha, 'Wo apne khaandaan ke kaamon mein haath bataate the, aur jab Azaan sunte, to (namaz ke liye) baahar chale jaate.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:Hind bint `Utba said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Abu Sufyan is a miser and he does not give me what is sufficient for me and my children. Can I take of his property without his knowledge?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Take what is sufficient for you and your children, and the amount should be just and reasonable
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Hind bint Utba ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ) kanjoos hain aur mujhe aur mere bachon ke liye kaafi (kharcha) nahi dete. Kya main unke maal se unki jaankaari ke bagair le sakti hoon?' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo tumhaare aur tumhaare bachon ke liye kaafi ho, wo le lo, aur ye rakam jaayez aur munasib honi chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The best women among the camel riders, are the women of Quraish." (Another narrator said) The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The righteous among the women of Quraish are those who are kind to their young ones and who look after their husband's property
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Oont sawaari karne wali auraton mein sabse behtar Quraish ki auraten hain.' (Ek doosre ravi ne kaha) Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Quraish ki neik auraten wo hain jo apne chhote bachon ke saath meherbaan hoti hain aur apne shohar ke maal ki dekhbhaal karti hain.'

e: Narrated `Ali:The Prophet (ﷺ) gave me a silk suit and I wore it, but when I noticed anger on his face, I cut it and distributed it among my women-folk
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne mujhe resham ka ek suit diya aur maine wo pehna, magar jab maine unke chehre par gussa dekha, to maine use kaat kar apni auraton mein baant diya.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:My father died and left seven or nine girls and I married a matron. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me, "O Jabir! Have you married?" I said, "Yes." He said, "A virgin or a matron?" I replied, "A matron." he said, "Why not a virgin, so that you might play with her and she with you, and you might amuse her and she amuse you." I said, " `Abdullah (my father) died and left girls, and I dislike to marry a girl like them, so I married a lady (matron) so that she may look after them." On that he said, "May Allah bless you," or "That is good
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Mere waalid ka intekaal hua aur unhone saat ya nau ladkiyaan chhodi, aur maine ek biwaa se nikaah kiya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse pucha, 'Aye Jabir! Kya tumhaari shaadi ho gayi?' Maine kaha, 'Haan.' Unhone pucha, 'Kunwaari se ya biwaa se?' Maine jawab diya, 'Biwaa se.'
