Unhone kaha, 'Kunwaari se kyun nahi ki, taake tum uske saath aur wo tumhaare saath khel sakti, aur tum use hansaa sakte aur wo tumhein hansaa sakti?' Maine kaha, 'Abdullah (mere waalid) ka intekaal ho gaya aur unhone ladkiyaan chhodi hain, aur mujhe unke jaisi ek chhoti ladki se nikaah karna pasand nahi tha, isliye maine ek biwaa se nikaah kiya taake wo unki dekhbhaal kar sake.' Isper unhone kaha, 'Allah tumhein barkat de,' ya 'Ye achha hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "I am ruined!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Why?" He said, "I had sexual intercourse with my wife while fasting (in the month of Ramadan)." The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "Manumit a slave (as expiation)." He replied, "I cannot afford that." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Then fast for two successive months." He said, "I cannot." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Then feed sixty poor persons." He said, "I have nothing to do that." In the meantime a basket full of dates was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) . He said, "Where is the questioner." The man said, "I am here." The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to him), "Give this (basket of dates) in charity (as expiation)." He said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shall I give it to poorer people than us? By Him Who sent you with the Truth, there is no family between Medina's two mountains poorer than us." The Prophet (ﷺ) smiled till his pre-molar teeth became visible. He then said, "Then take it
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Main tabaah ho gaya!' Nabi (SAW) ne pucha, 'Kyun?' Usne kaha, 'Maine Ramzan mein roze ki haalat mein apni biwi ke saath humbistari kar li.' Nabi (SAW) ne usse kaha, 'Ek ghulaam azaad karo (kaffare mein).' Usne jawab diya, 'Mujhme itni hasiyat nahi.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'To do maheene lagataar roza rakho.' Usne kaha, 'Main nahi kar sakta.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'To saath gareebon ko khaana khilaao.' Usne kaha, 'Mere paas itna kuch nahi hai.' Isi dauraan Nabi (SAW) ke paas khajoor se bhari ek tokri laayi gayi. Unhone pucha, 'Sawaal poochne wala kahaan hai?' Us aadmi ne kaha, 'Main yahaan hoon.' Nabi (SAW) ne (usse) kaha, 'Ise (khajoor ki tokri) sadqe mein de do (kaffare ke taur par).' Usne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya main ise humse bhi zyaada gareeb logon ko doon? Us Zaat ki qasam jisne aapko Haq ke saath bheja, Madina ki do pahaadiyon ke beech koi khaandaan hamse zyaada gareeb nahi hai.' Nabi (SAW) itne muskuraaye ke unke damle wale daant zaahir ho gaye. Phir unhone farmaya, 'To ise khud le lo.'

e: Narrated Um Salama:I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shall I get a reward (in the Hereafter) if I spend on the children of Abu Salama and do not leave them like this and like this (i.e., poor) but treat them like my children?" The Prophet said, "Yes, you will be rewarded for that which you will spend on them
hi: Umm Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya mujhe Aakhirat mein ajr milega agar main Abu Salama ke bachon par kharch karoon aur unhein gareeb halat mein na chhodun, balke unhein apne bachon jaisa samjhoon?' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Haan, jo kuch tum unpar kharch karogi uska tumhein ajr milega.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:Hind (bint `Utba) said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Abu Sufyan is a miser. Is there any harm if I take of his property what will cover me and my children's needs?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Take (according to your needs) in a reasonable manner
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Hind (bint Utba) ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ) kanjoos hain. Kya isme koi harj hai agar main unke maal se utna le loon jo mujhe aur mere bachon ki zaroorat poori kare?' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, '(Apni zaroorat ke mutaabik) munasib tareeke se le lo.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:A dead man in debt used to be brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who would ask, "Has he left anything to re pay his debts?" If he was informed that he had left something to cover his debts the Prophet (ﷺ) would offer the funeral prayer for him; otherwise he would say to the Muslims present there), "Offer the funeral prayer for your friend:"but when Allah helped the Prophet (ﷺ) to gain victory (on his expeditions), he said, "I am closer to the Believers than themselves, so. if one of the Believers dies in debt, I will repay it, but if he leaves wealth, it will be for his heirs
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek qarzdaar mayyat ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laaya jaata, aur wo poochte, 'Kya usne apna qarz chukaane ke liye kuch chhoda hai?' Agar unhein bataya jaata ke usne itna chhoda hai ke uska qarz pura ho sake, to Nabi (SAW) uski namaz-e-janaza padhaate; warna wo (wahaan maujood Musalmaanon se) kehte, 'Apne saathi ki namaz-e-janaza tum padho.' Magar jab Allah ne Nabi (SAW) ko fatah di (unki mohimon mein), to unhone farmaya, 'Main Momineen ke liye unki apni jaan se bhi zyaada qareeb hoon, isliye agar koi momin qarz mein mar jaaye, to main uska qarz chukaunga, magar agar wo maal chhode, to wo uske waarison ke liye hoga.'

e: Narrated Um Habiba:(the wife of the Prophet) I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Will you marry my sister, the daughter of Abu Sufyan." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do you like that?" I said, "Yes, for I am not your only wife, and the person I like most to share the good with me, is my sister." He said, "That is not lawful for me." I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We have heard that you want to marry Durra, the daughter of Abu Salama." He said, "You mean the daughter of Um Salama?" I said, "Yes." He said, "Even if she were not my stepdaughter, she is unlawful for me, for she is my foster niece. Thuwaiba suckled me and Abu Salama. So you should not present to me your daughters and sisters." Narrated 'Urwa: Thuwaiba had been a slave girl whom Abu Lahab had emancipated
hi: Umm Habiba (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki zawja) bataati hain: Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya aap meri behen, Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki beti, se nikaah karenge?' Nabi (SAW) ne pucha, 'Kya tumhein ye pasand hai?' Maine kaha, 'Haan, kyunke main aapki akeli biwi nahi hoon, aur jis shaks ke saath main sabse zyaada bhalaai baantna chahti hoon wo meri behen hai.' Unhone kaha, 'Ye mere liye jaayez nahi hai.' Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Humein pata chala hai ke aap Durra, Abu Salama ki beti, se nikaah karna chahte hain.' Unhone pucha, 'Tumhaara matlab Umm Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) ki beti se hai?' Maine kaha, 'Haan.' Unhone farmaya, 'Agar wo meri saudari beti bhi na hoti, to bhi wo mere liye haraam hai, kyunke wo meri doodh-rishte ki bhatiji hai. Thuwaiba ne mujhe aur Abu Salama ko doodh pilaaya tha. Isliye tumhein apni betiyaan ya behnein mere saamne pesh nahi karni chaahiye.' Ravi Urwa kehte hain: Thuwaiba Abu Lahab ki azaad ki hui launDi thi.

e: Narrated Abu Musa Al-Ash`ari:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Give food to the hungry, pay a visit to the sick and release (set free) the one in captivity (by paying his ransom)
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ashari bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Bhooke ko khaana khilaao, bimar ki mizaajpursi karo, aur qaidi ko (fidya deke) azaad karao.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira: The family of Muhammad did not eat their fill for three successive days till he died
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Muhammad (SAW) ke khaandaan ne teen lagataar din tak pet bhar kar khaana nahi khaaya, yahaan tak ke unka intekaal ho gaya.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira: Once while I was in a state of fatigue (because of severe hunger), I met 'Umar bin Al-Khattab, so I asked him to recite a verse from Allah's Book to me. He entered his house and interpreted it to me. (Then I went out and) after walking for a short distance, I fell on my face because of fatigue and severe hunger. Suddenly I saw Allah's Apostle standing by my head. He said, "O Abu Huraira!" I replied, "Labbaik, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and Sadaik!" Then he held me by the hand, and made me get up. Then he came to know what I was suffering from. He took me to his house, and ordered a big bowl of milk for me. I drank thereof and he said, "Drink more, O Abu Hirr!" So I drank again, whereupon he again said, "Drink more." So I drank more till my belly became full and looked like a bowl. Afterwards I met 'Umar and mentioned to him what had happened to me, and said to him, "Somebody, who had more right than you, O 'Umar, took over the case. By Allah, I asked you to recite a Verse to me while I knew it better than you." On that Umar said to me, "By Allah, if I admitted and entertained you, it would have been dearer to me than having nice red camels
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar jab main (sakht bhookh ki wajah se) thakaan mein tha, main Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab se mila, to maine unse Allah ki Kitaab ki koi Aayat sunaane ko kaha. Wo apne ghar gaye aur mujhe uski tafseer batayi. (Phir main baahar nikla aur) thodi door chalne ke baad, main thakaan aur sakht bhookh ki wajah se munh ke bal gir pada. Achaanak maine dekha ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mere sar ke paas khade hain. Unhone farmaya, 'Aye Abu Huraira!' Maine jawab diya, 'Labbaik, Aye Allah ke Rasool, aur Sa'daik!' Phir unhone mera haath pakda aur mujhe uthaaya. Phir unhein pata chal gaya ke mujhe kya takleef hai. Wo mujhe apne ghar le gaye aur mere liye doodh ka ek bada pyaala mangwaaya. Maine usme se piya aur unhone kaha, 'Aur piyo, Aye Abu Hirr!' To maine phir piya, isper unhone phir kaha, 'Aur piyo.' To maine aur piya yahaan tak ke mera pet bhar gaya aur ek pyaale jaisa dikhne laga. Baad mein main Umar se mila aur unhein bataaya jo mere saath hua tha, aur unse kaha, 'Kisi ne, jiska aapse zyaada haq tha, is maamle ko sambhaal liya. Allah ki qasam, maine aapse Aayat sunaane ko kaha jabke main use aapse behtar jaanta tha.' Isper Umar ne mujhse kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, agar maine tumhaari mehmaan-nawaazi ki hoti, to wo mujhe khoobsurat surkh oonton se bhi zyaada aziz hoti.'

e: Narrated `Umar bin Abi Salama:I was a boy under the care of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and my hand used to go around the dish while I was eating. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me, 'O boy! Mention the Name of Allah and eat with your right hand, and eat of the dish what is nearer to you." Since then I have applied those instructions when eating
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Salama bataate hain: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki nigraani mein ek bachcha tha, aur khaana khaate waqt mera haath poori thaali mein ghoomta rehta tha. To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse kaha, 'Aye bachche! Allah ka naam lo, apne daaye haath se khaao, aur thaali mein se wahi khaao jo tumhaare qareeb ho.' Tab se main khaana khaate waqt yahi tareeka apnaata hoon.

e: Narrated `Umar bin Al Salama:Who was the son of Um Salama, the wife of the Prophet: Once I ate a meal with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and I was eating from all sides of the dish. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me, "Eat of the dish what is nearer to you
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Salama, jo Umm Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا), Nabi (SAW) ki biwi, ke bete the, bataate hain: Ek baar maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath khaana khaaya aur main thaali ke har taraf se kha raha tha. To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse kaha, 'Thaali mein se wahi khaao jo tumhaare qareeb ho.'

e: Narrated Wahb bin Kaisan Abi Nu'aim:A meal was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while his step-son, `Umar bin Abi Salama was with him. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him, "Mention the Name of Allah and eat of the dish what is nearer to you
hi: Wahb bin Kaisan Abi Nu'aim bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas khaana laaya gaya jabke unke saudari bete, Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Salama, unke saath the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha, 'Allah ka naam lo, aur thaali mein se wahi khaao jo tumhaare qareeb ho.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:A tailor invited Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to a meal which he had prepared. I went along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and saw him seeking to eat the pieces of gourd from the various sides of the dish. Since that day I have liked to eat gourd. `Umar bin Abi Salama said: The Prophet, said to me, "Eat with your right hand
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek darzi ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko apne taiyaar kiye hue khaane ki dawat di. Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath gaya aur dekha ke wo thaali ke alag alag hisson se kaddu ke tukde dhoond kar kha rahe the. Us din se mujhe kaddu pasand aane laga. Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Salama bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne mujhse kaha, 'Apne daaye haath se khaao.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to love to start doing things from the right side whenever possible, in performing ablution, putting on his shoes, and combing his hair. (Al-Ash'ath said: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to do so in all his affairs
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) jab bhi mumkin hota, kaam daayi taraf se shuru karna pasand karte the, jaise wuzu karna, jute pehnna, aur baal kanghi karna. (Al-Ash'ath ne kaha: Nabi (SAW) apne sab kaamon mein aisa karte the.)

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Abu Talha said to Um Sulaim, "I have heard the voice of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) which was feeble, and I think that he is hungry. Have you got something (to eat)?" She took out some loaves of barley bread, then took her face-covering sheet and wrapped the bread in part of it, and pushed it under my garment and turned the rest of it around my body and sent me to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . I went with that, and found Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the mosque with some people. I stood up near them, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked me, "Have you been sent by Abu Talha?" I said, "Yes." He asked, "With some food (for us)?" I said, "Yes." Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to all those who were with him, "Get up!" He set out (and all the people accompanied him) and I proceeded ahead of them till I came to Abu Talha. Abu Talha then said, "O Um Sulaim! Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has arrived along with the people, and we do not have food enough to feed them all." She said, "Allah and His Apostle know better." So Abu Talha went out till he met Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Then Abu Talha and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came and entered the house. Allah's Apostle said, "Um Sulaim ! Bring whatever you have." She brought that very bread. The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered that it be crushed into small pieces, and Um Sulaim pressed a skin of butter on it. Then Allah's Apostle said whatever Allah wished him to say (to bless the food) and then added, "Admit ten (men)." So they were admitted, ate their fill and went out. The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "Admit ten (more)." They were admitted, ate their full, and went out. He then again said, "Admit ten more!" They were admitted, ate their fill, and went out. He admitted ten more, and so all those people ate their fill, and they were eighty men
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Umm Sulaim (رضی اللہ عنہا) se kaha, 'Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki aawaaz kamzor suni hai, aur mujhe lagta hai wo bhooke hain. Kya tumhaare paas kuch (khaane ko) hai?' Unhone jau ki kuch rotiyaan nikaali, phir apni chaadar li aur roti ka ek hissa usmein lapeta, aur use mere kapdon ke andar daala, aur baaki chaadar mere jism ke gird lapet di, aur mujhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas bheja. Main wo lekar gaya aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Masjid mein kuch logon ke saath paaya. Main unke qareeb khada hua, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne pucha, 'Kya tumhein Abu Talha ne bheja hai?' Maine kaha, 'Haan.' Unhone pucha, '(Hamare liye) khaane ke saath?' Maine kaha, 'Haan.' Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne saath maujood sab logon se kaha, 'Utho!' Wo chal pade (aur sab log unke saath gaye) aur main unse aage aage Abu Talha ke paas pahuncha. Abu Talha ne kaha, 'Aye Umm Sulaim! Allah ke Rasool (SAW) logon ke saath aa rahe hain, aur hamaare paas unhein sabko khilaane ke liye kaafi khaana nahi hai.' Unhone kaha, 'Allah aur uske Rasool behtar jaante hain.' To Abu Talha baahar gaye aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se mile. Phir Abu Talha aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ghar mein daakhil hue. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Umm Sulaim! Jo bhi tumhaare paas hai laao.' Unhone wahi roti laayi. Nabi (SAW) ne hukm diya ke use chhote tukdon mein toda jaaye, aur Umm Sulaim ne usmein makkhan nichoda. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne jo Allah ne chaaha kaha (khaane par barkat ki dua) aur farmaya, 'Das (aadmiyon) ko andar bulao.' To unhein bulaaya gaya, unhone pet bhar kar khaaya aur chale gaye. Nabi (SAW) ne phir kaha, 'Das aur bulao.' Unhein bulaaya gaya, unhone pet bhar kar khaaya aur chale gaye. Unhone phir kaha, 'Das aur bulao!' Unhein bulaaya gaya, unhone pet bhar kar khaaya aur chale gaye. Unhone das aur bulaaye, aur is tarah sab logon ne pet bhar kar khaaya, aur wo assi (80) aadmi the.

e: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Bakr:We were one hundred and thirty men sitting with the Prophet. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Have anyone of you any food with him?" It happened that one man had one Sa of wheat flour (or so) which was turned into dough then. After a while a tall lanky pagan came, driving some sheep. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked, 'Will you sell us (a sheep), or give (it to) us as a gift?" The pagan said, "No, but I will sell it " So the Prophet bought from him a sheep which was slaughtered, and then the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered that the liver, the kidneys, lungs and heart, etc., of that sheep be roasted. By Allah, none of those one hundred and thirty men but had his share of those things. The Prophet (ﷺ) gave to those who were present, and also kept a share for those who were absent He then served that cooked sheep in two big trays and we all ate together our fill; yet there remained a part of it in those two trays which I carried on the camel
hi: Abdur Rahman bin Abu Bakr bataate hain: Hum ek sau tees (130) aadmi Nabi (SAW) ke saath baithe the. Nabi (SAW) ne pucha, 'Kya tum mein se kisi ke paas khaana hai?' Ek shaks ke paas ek Sa gehun ka aata tha (ya isi tarah kuch), jise gundh liya gaya. Thodi der baad ek lamba, dubla-patla mushrik apni bakriyaan hankaate hue aaya. Nabi (SAW) ne pucha, 'Kya tum humein (ek bakri) bechoge, ya tohfe mein doge?' Mushrik ne kaha, 'Nahi, magar main bechunga.' To Nabi (SAW) ne usse ek bakri khareedi jise zibah kiya gaya, phir Nabi (SAW) ne hukm diya ke uska kaleja, gurde, phephde aur dil, waghera, bhoona jaaye. Allah ki qasam, un sau tees aadmiyon mein se koi bhi nahi bacha jisne un cheezon mein se apna hissa na paaya ho. Nabi (SAW) ne jo maujood the unhein diya, aur jo gair-maujood the unke liye bhi hissa rakha. Phir unhone wo pakaayi hui bakri do badi thaaliyon mein pesh ki aur hum sab ne milkar pet bhar kar khaaya; phir bhi un do thaaliyon mein kuch bacha jise main oont par leke gaya.

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) died when we had satisfied our hunger with the two black things, i.e. dates and water
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ka intekaal us waqt hua jab hum do kaali cheezon - yaani khajoor aur paani - se apni bhookh mitaa rahe the.

e: Narrated Suwaid bin An-Nu`man:We went out with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to Khaibar, and when we were at As-Sahba', (Yahya, a sub-narrator said, "As-Sahba' is a place at a distance of one day's journey to Khaibar)." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked the people to bring their food, but there was nothing with the people except Sawiq. So we all chewed and ate of it. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) asked for some water and he rinsed his mouth, and we too, rinsed our mouths. Then he led us in the Maghrib prayer without performing ablution (again)
hi: Suwaid bin An-Nu'man (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Khaibar ke liye nikle, aur jab hum As-Sahba mein the (Ravi Yahya kehte hain: As-Sahba Khaibar se ek din ke safar ki doori par ek jagah hai), Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne logon se apna khaana laane ko kaha, magar logon ke paas Sawiq (jau ke aate) ke siwa kuch nahi tha. To hum sab ne use chabaaya aur khaaya. Phir Nabi (SAW) ne paani mangwaaya aur kulli ki, aur humne bhi kulli ki. Phir unhone humein bagair (dobara) wuzu kiye Maghrib ki namaz padhaayi.

e: Narrated Qatada:We were in the company of Anas whose baker was with him. Anas said, The Prophet (ﷺ) did not eat thin bread, or a roasted sheep till he met Allah (died)
hi: Qatada bataate hain: Hum Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath the jinke saath unka naanbaai (roti banaane wala) tha. Anas ne kaha, 'Nabi (SAW) ne apni wafat tak kabhi patli roti ya bhuni hui bakri nahi khaayi.'

e: Narrated Anas:To the best of my knowledge, the Prophet (ﷺ) did not take his meals in a big tray at all, nor did he ever eat well-baked thin bread, nor did he ever eat at a dining table
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Meri jaankari ki had tak, Nabi (SAW) ne kabhi kisi badi thaali mein khaana nahi khaaya, na kabhi achhi tarah pakaayi hui patli roti khaayi, na kabhi kisi khaane ki mez par khaana khaaya.

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) halted to consummate his marriage with Safiyya. I invited the Muslims to his wedding banquet. He ordered that leather dining sheets be spread. Then dates, dried yoghurt and butter were put on those sheets. Anas added: The Prophet (ﷺ) consummated his marriage with Safiyya (during a journey) whereupon Hais (sweet dish) was served on a leather dining sheet
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke saath apni shaadi poori karne (rukhsati) ke liye padaav dala. Maine Musalmaanon ko unke Walima ki dawat di. Unhone chamde ke dastarkhwaan bichhaane ka hukm diya. Phir khajoorein, sukhi dahi aur makkhan un dastarkhwaanon par rakha gaya. Anas ne aage kaha: Nabi (SAW) ne Safiya se apni shaadi (safar ke dauraan) poori ki, jispar Hais (meethi cheez) chamde ke dastarkhwaan par pesh ki gayi.

e: Narrated Wahb bin Kaisan:The People of Sham taunted `Abdullah bin Az-Zubair by calling him "The son of Dhatin-Nataqain" (the woman who has two waist-belts). (His mother) (Asma, said to him, "O my son! They taunt you with "Nataqain". Do you know what the Nataqain were? That was my waist-belt which I divided in two parts. I tied the water skin of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with one part, and with the other part I tied his food container
hi: Wahb bin Kaisan bataate hain: Sham ke logon ne Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko taane maarte hue kaha, 'Do Kamarband waali ka beta' (yaani unki maa, jinke do kamarband the). Unki maa, Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا), ne unse kaha, 'Aye mere bete! Wo tumhein "Nataqain" (do kamarband) kehkar taana maarte hain. Kya tumhein pata hai ye "Nataqain" kya thi? Wo mera kamarband tha jise maine do hisson mein baant diya tha. Ek hisse se maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki paani ki mashk baandhi thi, aur doosre hisse se unka khaane ka bartan.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:that his aunt, Um Hufaid bint Al-Harith bin Hazn, presented to the Prophet (ﷺ) butter, dried yoghurt and mastigures. The Prophet (ﷺ) invited the people to those mastigures and they were eaten on his dining sheet, but the Prophet (ﷺ) did not eat of it, as if he disliked it. Nevertheless. if it was unlawful to eat that, the people would not have eaten it on the dining sheet of the Prophet (ﷺ) nor would he have ordered that they be eaten
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Unki khaala, Umm Hufaid bint Al-Harith bin Hazn, ne Nabi (SAW) ko makhan, sukhi dahi aur guhera (chhipkali jaisa jaanwar) pesh kiya. Nabi (SAW) ne logon ko us guhere ke liye bulaaya aur wo unki dastarkhwaan par khaaya gaya, magar Nabi (SAW) ne khud usse nahi khaaya, jaise unhein wo napasand ho. Phir bhi, agar wo haraam hota, to log use Nabi (SAW) ki dastarkhwaan par na khaate, aur na hi wo khaane ka hukm dete.

e: Narrated Suwaid bin An-Nu`man:that while they were with the Prophet (ﷺ) at As-Sahba' which was at a distance of one day's journey from Khaibar the prayer became due, and the Prophet (ﷺ) asked the people for food but there was nothing with the people except Sawiq. He ate of it and we ate along with him, and then he asked for water and rinsed his mouth (with it), and then offered the (Maghrib) prayer and we too offered the prayer but the Prophet did not perform ablution (again after eating the Sawiq)
hi: Suwaid bin An-Nu'man (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab wo Nabi (SAW) ke saath As-Sahba mein the, jo Khaibar se ek din ke safar ki doori par hai, namaz ka waqt aa gaya, aur Nabi (SAW) ne logon se khaana maanga, magar unke paas Sawiq (jau ke aate) ke siwa kuch nahi tha. Unhone usme se khaaya aur hum bhi unke saath khaaye, phir unhone paani maanga aur (usse) kulla kiya, phir Maghrib ki namaz padhaayi aur hum bhi padhe, magar Nabi (SAW) ne Sawiq khaane ke baad dobara wuzu nahi kiya.

e: Narrated Khalid bin Al-Walid:That he went with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to the house of Maimuna, who was his and Ibn `Abbas' aunt. He found with her a roasted mastigure which her sister Hufaida bint Al-Harith had brought from Najd. Maimuna presented the mastigure before Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who rarely started eating any (unfamiliar) food before it was described and named for him. (But that time) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stretched his hand towards the (meat of the) mastigure whereupon a lady from among those who were present, said, "You should inform Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) of what you have presented to him. O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! It is the meat of a mastigure." (On learning that) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) withdrew his hand from the meat of the mastigure. Khalid bin Al-Walid said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Is this unlawful to eat?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, "No, but it is not found in the land of my people, so I do not like it." Khalid said, "Then I pulled the mastigure (meat) towards me and ate it while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was looking at me
hi: Khalid bin Al-Walid bataate hain: Wo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke ghar gaye, jo unki aur Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki khaala thin. Unhone wahaan ek bhuna hua guhera paaya jo unki behen, Hufaida bint Al-Harith, Najd se laayi thin. Maimuna ne wo guhera Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saamne pesh kiya, jabke wo aksar koi anjaan khaana khaane se pehle uske baare mein poochte aur uska naam jaanne ke baad hi khaate the. (Us waqt) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apna haath guhere ke (gosht ki) taraf badhaaya, isper wahaan maujood ek khaatoon ne kaha, 'Aapko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko bataana chaahiye ke aapne unhein kya pesh kiya hai. Aye Allah ke Rasool! Ye guhere ka gosht hai.' (Ye jaankar) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apna haath guhere ke gosht se hataa liya. Khalid bin Al-Walid ne pucha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya ye khaana haraam hai?' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne jawab diya, 'Nahi, magar ye meri qaum ki zameen mein nahi paaya jaata, isliye mujhe ye pasand nahi.' Khalid ne kaha, 'Phir maine guhere (ke gosht) ko apni taraf khainch liya aur khaaya, jabke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mujhe dekh rahe the.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The food for two persons is sufficient for three, and the food of three persons is sufficient for four persons
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Do logon ka khaana teen logon ke liye kaafi hai, aur teen logon ka khaana chaar logon ke liye kaafi hai.'

e: Narrated Nafi`:Ibn `Umar never used to take his meal unless a poor man was called to eat with him. One day I brought a poor man to eat with him, the man ate too much, whereupon Ibn `Umar said, "O Nafi`! Don't let this man enter my house, for I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "A believer eats in one intestine (is satisfied with a little food), and a kafir (unbeliever) eats in seven intestines (eats much food)
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) kabhi khaana nahi khaate the jab tak koi gareeb aadmi unke saath khaane ke liye bulaaya na jaaye. Ek din main ek gareeb aadmi ko unke saath khaane laaya, us aadmi ne bahut zyaada khaaya, isper Ibn Umar ne kaha, 'Aye Nafi! Is aadmi ko dobara mere ghar mein daakhil mat hone dena, kyunke maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna hai, "Momin ek aant se khaata hai (yaani thode khaane se santusht ho jaata hai), aur kaafir saat aanton se khaata hai (yaani bahut khaata hai)."'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "A believer eats in one intestine (is satisfied with a little food), and a kafir (unbeliever) or a hypocrite eats in seven intestines (eats too much)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Momin ek aant se khaata hai (thode khaane se santusht ho jaata hai), aur kaafir ya munaafiq saat aanton se khaata hai (bahut zyaada khaata hai).'

e: Narrated `Amr:Abu Nahik was avaricious eater. Ibn `Umar said to him, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "A Kafir (unbeliever) eats in seven intestines (eats much)." On that Abu Nahik said, "But I believe in Allah and His Apostle
hi: Amr bataate hain: Abu Nahik bahut zyaada khaane wale the. Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne unse kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya hai, "Kaafir saat aanton se khaata hai (bahut zyaada khaata hai)."' Isper Abu Nahik ne kaha, 'Magar main to Allah aur uske Rasool par Iman rakhta hoon.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "A Muslim eats in one intestine (i.e. he is satisfied with a little food) while a Kafir (unbeliever) eats in seven intestines (eats much)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Musalmaan ek aant se khaata hai (thode khaane se santusht ho jaata hai), jabke kaafir saat aanton se khaata hai (bahut zyaada khaata hai).'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:A man used to eat much, but when he embraced Islam, he started eating less. That was mentioned to the Prophet (ﷺ) who then said, "A believer eats in one intestine (is satisfied with a little food) and a Kafir eats in seven intestines (eats much)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek aadmi bahut zyaada khaaya karta tha, magar jab usne Islam qubool kiya, to wo kam khaane laga. Ye baat Nabi (SAW) ko batayi gayi, unhone farmaya, 'Momin ek aant se khaata hai (thode khaane se santusht ho jaata hai), aur kaafir saat aanton se khaata hai (bahut zyaada khaata hai).'

e: Narrated Abu Juhaifa:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I do not take my meals while leaning (against something)
hi: Abu Juhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Main tek lagaakar khaana nahi khaata.'

e: Narrated Abu Juhaifa:While I was with the Prophet (ﷺ) he said to a man who was with him, "I do not take my meals while leaning
hi: Abu Juhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab main Nabi (SAW) ke saath tha, unhone unke saath maujood ek aadmi se kaha, 'Main tek lagaakar khaana nahi khaata.'

e: Narrated Khalid bin Al-Walid:"A roasted mastigure was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) who stretched his hand towards it to eat it. But it was said to him, "It is a mastigure." So he withdrew his hand. Khalid asked, "Is it unlawful to eat?" the Prophet said, "No, but it is not found in the land of my people and that is why I do not like eating it." So Khalid started eating (it) while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was looking at him. An-Nadr said: 'Al-Khazira' (is prepared) from bran while 'Al-Harira' is prepared from milk
hi: Khalid bin Al-Walid bataate hain: Ek bhuna hua guhera Nabi (SAW) ke paas laaya gaya, unhone apna haath usse khaane ke liye badhaaya. Magar unhein kaha gaya, 'Ye guhera hai.' To unhone apna haath hataa liya. Khalid ne pucha, 'Kya ye khaana haraam hai?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Nahi, magar ye meri qaum ki zameen mein nahi milta, isliye mujhe ye khaana pasand nahi.' To Khalid ise khaane lage jabke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unhein dekh rahe the. (Ravi) An-Nadr ne kaha: 'Al-Khazira' choker se banaayi jaati hai jabke 'Al-Harira' doodh se.

e: Narrated 'Urban bin Malik:who attended the Badr battle and was from the Ansar, that he came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Apostle! I have lost my eyesight and I lead my people in the prayer (as an Imam). When it rains, the valley which is between me and my people, flows with water, and then I cannot go to their mosque to lead them in the prayer. O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I wish that you could come and pray in my house so that I may take it as a praying place. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah willing, I will do that." The next morning, soon after the sun had risen, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came with Abu Bakr. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked for the permission to enter and I admitted him. The Prophet (ﷺ) had not sat till he had entered the house and said to me, "Where do you like me to pray in your house?" I pointed at a place in my house whereupon he stood and said, "Allahu Akbar." We lined behind him and he prayed two rak`at and finished it with Taslim. We then requested him to stay for a special meal of Khazira which we had prepared. A large number of men from the adjoining area gathered in the house. One of them said, "Where is Malik bin Ad-Dukhshun?" Another man said, "He is a hypocrite and does not love Allah and His Apostle." The Prophet said, "Do not say so. Do you not think that he has said: "None has the right to be worshipped but Allah," seeking Allah's pleasure? The man said, "Allah and His Apostle know better, but we have always seen him mixing with hypocrites and giving them advice." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah has forbidden the (Hell) Fire for those who testify that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah, seeking Allah's pleasure
hi: 'Urban bin Malik bataate hain, jo Ansaar mein se the aur jang-e-Badr mein shareek hue the: Wo Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Meri nazar chali gayi hai aur main apni qaum ki namaz mein Imamat karta hoon. Jab baarish hoti hai, to meri aur meri qaum ke beech ki wadi paani se bhar jaati hai, aur main unki Masjid tak namaz padhaane nahi ja pata. Aye Allah ke Rasool! Main chahta hoon ke aap mere ghar aakar namaz padhein, taake main use apni namaz padhne ki jagah bana sakoon.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Insha-Allah, main aisa karunga.' Agli subah, suraj nikalte hi, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Abu Bakr ke saath aaye. Nabi (SAW) ne andar aane ki ijaazat maangi aur maine unhein andar aane diya. Nabi (SAW) baithe bhi nahi the ke unhone kaha, 'Aap chahenge ke main aapke ghar mein kahaan namaz padhun?' Maine apne ghar ki ek jagah ki taraf ishara kiya, isper wo khade hue aur kaha, 'Allahu Akbar.' Hum unke peechhe qataar mein khade hue, unhone do rakat namaz padhi aur salaam se khatam ki. Phir humne unhein Khazira ka khaas khaana khaane ke liye rukne ki darkhwaast ki jo humne taiyaar kiya tha. Aas-paas ke ilaake se kaafi log ghar mein jama ho gaye. Unmein se ek ne pucha, 'Malik bin Ad-Dukhshun kahaan hain?' Doosre shaks ne kaha, 'Wo ek munaafiq hai aur Allah aur uske Rasool se mohabbat nahi karta.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Aisa mat kaho. Kya tumhein nahi lagta ke usne "Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi" kaha tha, Allah ki khushi chaahte hue?' Us aadmi ne kaha, 'Allah aur uske Rasool behtar jaante hain, magar humne hamesha dekha hai ke wo munaafiqon ke saath ghulta-milta hai aur unhein salaah deta hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah ne (Jahannam ki) Aag un logon par haraam kar di hai jo gawaahi dete hain ke Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi, Allah ki khushi chaahte hue.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:My aunt presented (roasted) mastigures, Iqt and milk to the Prophet (ﷺ) . The mastigures were put on his dining sheet, and if it was unlawful to eat, it would not have been put there. The Prophet (ﷺ) drank the milk and ate the Iqt only
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Unki khaala ne Nabi (SAW) ke saamne bhune hue guhere, Iqt (sukha panir) aur doodh pesh kiya. Guhere unki dastarkhwaan par rakhe gaye, aur agar wo khaana haraam hota, to wo wahaan na rakhe jaate. Nabi (SAW) ne doodh piya aur sirf Iqt khaaya.

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:We used to be happy on Fridays, for there was an old lady who used to pull out the roots of Silq and put it in a cooking pot with some barley. When we had finished the prayer, we would visit her and she would present that dish before us. So we used to be happy on Fridays because of that, and we never used to take our meals or have a mid-day nap except after the Friday prayer. By Allah, that meal contained no fat
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Jumme ke din khush hote the, kyunke ek budhi khaatoon Silq (ek saag) ki jadein nikaal kar usse jau ke saath ek deg mein pakaati thin. Jab hum namaz khatam kar lete, to hum unke paas jaate aur wo hamare saamne wo dish pesh karti. To isi wajah se hum Jumme ke din khush hote the, aur hum kabhi apna khaana ya dophahar ka aaraam Jumme ki namaz ke baad ke siwa nahi karte the. Allah ki qasam, us khaane mein koi ghee (charbi) nahi hota tha.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas: The Prophet (ﷺ) ate of the meat of a shoulder (by cutting the meat with his teeth), and then got up and offered the prayer without performing the ablution anew
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne kandhe ka gosht khaaya (apne daanton se kaat kar), phir uthe aur bagair naye sire se wuzu kiye namaz padhi.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) took out a bone with meat on it from a cooking pot and ate of it, and then offered the prayer without performing ablution anew
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne ek degchi se gosht wali haddi nikaali aur usse khaaya, phir bagair naye sire se wuzu kiye namaz padhi.

e: Narrated Abu Qatada:We went out towards Mecca with the Prophet
hi: Abu Qatada (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Nabi (SAW) ke saath Makkah ki taraf nikle...

e: Narrated Abu Qatada:Once, while I was sitting with the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) at a station on the road to Mecca and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was stationing ahead of us and all the people were assuming Ihram while I was not. My companion, saw an onager while I was busy Mending my shoes. They did not Inform me of the onager but they wished that I would see it Suddenly I looked and saw the onager Then I headed towards my horse, saddled it and rode, but I forgot to take the lash and the spear. So I said to them my companions), "Give me the lash and the spear." But they said, "No, by Allah we will not help you in any way to hunt it ' I got angry, dismounted, took it the spear and the lash), rode (the horse chased the onager and wounded it Then I brought it when it had dyed. My companions started eating of its (cooked) meat, but they suspected that it might be unlawful to eat of its meat while they were in a state of Ihram Then I proceeded further and I kept one of its forelegs with me. When we met Allah's Apostle we asked him about that. He said, "Have you some of its meat with you?" I gave him that foreleg and he ate the meat till he stripped the bone of its flesh although he was in a state of Ihram
hi: Abu Qatada (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar, jab main Nabi (SAW) ke sahaaba ke saath Makkah ke raaste mein ek padaav par baitha tha, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) hamse aage thehre hue the, aur sab log Ihram baandh chuke the jabke main nahi tha. Mere saathiyon ne ek gorkhar (wild donkey) dekha jabke main apni jootiyaan theek kar raha tha. Unhone mujhe uske baare mein nahi bataya, magar wo chahte the ke main use dekh loon. Achaanak maine dekha aur gorkhar ko dekh liya. Phir main apne ghode ki taraf gaya, uspar zeen kasi aur sawaar ho gaya, magar main koda aur bhaala lena bhool gaya. To maine apne saathiyon se kaha, 'Mujhe koda aur bhaala do.' Magar unhone kaha, 'Nahi, Allah ki qasam, hum tumhaari shikaar mein kisi bhi tarah se madad nahi karenge.' Mujhe gussa aaya, main utra, koda aur bhaala liya, phir sawaar hua (ghode par) aur gorkhar ka peecha karke use zakhmi kar diya. Phir main use lekar aaya jab wo mar chuka tha. Mere saathi uska (pakaaya hua) gosht khaane lage, magar unhein shak hua ke shaayad Ihram ki haalat mein uska gosht khaana haraam ho. Phir main aage badha aur uski agli taangon mein se ek apne paas rakhi. Jab hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se mile, humne unse iske baare mein pucha. Unhone kaha, 'Kya tumhaare paas iska kuch gosht hai?' Maine unhein wo taang di aur unhone gosht khaaya, yahaan tak ke haddi se sara gosht utaar liya, halaanke wo Ihram ki haalat mein the.

e: Narrated `Amr bin Umaiyya:that he saw the Prophet (ﷺ) holding a shoulder piece of mutton in his hand and cutting part of it with a knife. Then he was called for the prayer whereupon he put down the shoulder piece and the knife with which he was cutting it, and then stood for prayer without performing ablution again
hi: Amr bin Umaiyya bataate hain: Unhone Nabi (SAW) ko haath mein bakri ke kandhe ka ek tukda pakde aur chaqoo se uska hissa kaatte dekha. Phir unhein namaz ke liye bulaaya gaya, isper unhone kandhe ka tukda aur chaqoo neeche rakh diya, aur bagair dobara wuzu kiye namaz ke liye khade ho gaye.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) never criticized any food (he was invited to) but he used to eat if he liked the food, and leave it if he disliked it
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne kabhi kisi khaane ki burai nahi ki (jiske liye unhein dawat di gayi), wo agar khaana pasand aata to khaate, aur agar napasand aata to chhod dete.

e: Narrated Abu Hazim:that he asked Sahl, "Did you use white flour during the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) ?" Sahl replied, "No. Hazim asked, "Did you use to sift barley flour?" He said, "No, but we used to blow off the husk (of the barley)
hi: Abu Hazim bataate hain: Unhone Sahl se pucha, 'Kya aap Nabi (SAW) ki zindagi mein safed aata istemaal karte the?' Sahl ne jawab diya, 'Nahi.' Hazim ne pucha, 'Kya aap jau ke aate ko chhaanate the?' Unhone kaha, 'Nahi, magar hum jau ke chhilke ko phoonk maar kar udaate the.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) distributed dates among his companions and gave each one seven dates. He gave me seven dates too, one of which was dry and hard, but none of the other dates was more liked by me than that one, for it prolonged my chewing it
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Nabi (SAW) ne apne sahaaba mein khajoorein baanti aur har ek ko saat khajoorein dein. Unhone mujhe bhi saat khajoorein din, jinmein se ek sukhi aur sakht thi, magar mujhe koi doosri khajoor us se zyaada pasand nahi aayi, kyunke usne mera chabaana lamba kar diya.

e: Narrated Sa`d:I was one of (the first) seven (who had embraced Islam) with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and we had nothing to eat then, except the leaves of the Habala or Hubula tree, so that our stool used to be similar to that of sheep. Now the tribe of Bani Asad wants to teach me Islam; I would be a loser and all my efforts would be in vain (if I learn Islam anew from them)
hi: Sa'd bataate hain: Main un pehle saat logon mein se tha jinhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Islam qubool kiya tha, aur us waqt hamare paas Habala ya Hubula naami darakht ke patton ke siwa khaane ko kuch nahi hota tha, yahaan tak ke hamaara paakhaana bakriyon jaisa ho jaata. Ab Banu Asad qabeela mujhe Islam sikhaana chahta hai; agar main unse dobara Islam seekhoon, to main ghaate mein rahunga aur meri saari mehnat zaaya ho jaayegi.

e: Narrated Abu Hazim:I asked Sahl bin Sa`d, "Did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ever eat white flour?" Sahl said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) never saw white flour since Allah sent him as an Apostle till He took him unto Him." I asked, "Did the people have (use) sieves during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" Sahl said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) never saw (used) a sieve since Allah sent him as an Apostle until He took him unto Him," I said, "How could you eat barley unsifted?" he said, "We used to grind it and then blow off its husk, and after the husk flew away, we used to prepare the dough (bake) and eat it
hi: Abu Hazim bataate hain: Maine Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha, 'Kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kabhi safed aata khaaya?' Sahl ne kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kabhi safed aata nahi dekha, jab se Allah ne unhein Rasool bana kar bheja tha yahaan tak ke unhein apne paas bula liya.' Maine pucha, 'Kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zindagi mein log chhalni ka istemaal karte the?' Sahl ne kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kabhi chhalni nahi dekhi (istemaal ki), jab se Allah ne unhein Rasool bana kar bheja tha yahaan tak ke unhein apne paas bula liya.' Maine pucha, 'To phir aap log bagair chhaane hue jau kaise khaate the?' Unhone kaha, 'Hum use peesa karte the, phir uska chhilka phoonk maar kar udaa dete the, aur jab chhilka udd jaata, to hum aata gundhkar rotiyaan banaakar khaate the.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:that he passed by a group of people in front of whom there was a roasted sheep. They invited him but he refused to eat and said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) left this world without satisfying his hunger even with barley bread
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Wo kuch logon ke paas se guzre jinke saamne ek bhuni hui bakri thi. Unhone unhein bulaaya magar unhone khaane se inkaar kiya aur kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) is duniya se aise gaye ke unhone jau ki roti se bhi apni bhookh poori tarah nahi mitaayi.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) never took his meals at a dining table, nor in small plates, and he never ate thin wellbaked bread. (The sub-narrator asked Qatada, "Over what did they use to take their meals?" Qatada said, "On leather dining sheets)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne kabhi dining table par khaana nahi khaaya, na chhoti thaliyon mein, aur na hi unhone kabhi patli, khoob pakayi hui roti khaayi. (Ravi ne Qatada se pucha, 'Wo kis cheez par khaana khaate the?' Qatada ne kaha, 'Chamde ki dastarkhwaan par.')

e: Narrated `Aisha:The family of Muhammad had not eaten wheat bread to their satisfaction for three consecutive days since his arrival at Medina till he died
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Muhammad (SAW) ke khaandaan ne Madina aane se lekar unki wafat tak, kabhi teen din lagataar gehun ki roti pet bhar kar nahi khaayi thi.

e: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) that whenever one of her relatives died, the women assembled and then dispersed (returned to their houses) except her relatives and close friends. She would order that a pot of Talbina be cooked. Then Tharid (a dish prepared from meat and bread) would be prepared and the Talbina would be poured on it. `Aisha would say (to the women),"Eat of it, for I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, 'The Talbina soothes the heart of the patient and relieves him from some of his sadness
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab bhi unke kisi rishtedaar ka intekaal hota, auraten jama hoti aur phir bikhar jaati (apne gharon ko laut jaati) siwaaye unke rishtedaaron aur qareebi doston ke. Wo Talbina (jau ka dalia) pakaane ka hukm deti. Phir Tharid (gosht aur roti se banaayi jaane wali dish) taiyaar kiya jaata aur usmein Talbina daala jaata. Aisha (auraton se) kehti, 'Ise khaao, kyunke maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna hai, "Talbina bimaar ke dil ko sukoon deta hai aur uske gam ko kam karta hai."'

e: Narrated Abu Musa Al-Ash`ari:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Many men reached perfection but none among the women reached perfection except Mary, the daughter of ' `Imran, and Asia, Pharoah's wife. And the superiority of `Aisha to other women is like the superiority of Tharid to other kinds of food
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ashari bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Bahut se mard kaamil hue, magar auraton mein sirf Maryam, Imran ki beti, aur Asiya, Firaun ki biwi, ke siwa koi kaamil nahi hui. Aur Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ki doosri auraton par fazilat aisi hai jaise Tharid ki doosri khaano par fazilat hai.'

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The superiority of `Aisha to other women is like the superiority of Tharid to other kinds of food
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Aisha ki doosri auraton par fazilat aisi hai jaise Tharid ki doosri khaano par fazilat hai.'

e: Narrated Anas:I went along with the Prophet (ﷺ) to the house of a young tailor of his. The tailor presented a dish of Tharid to the Prophet (ﷺ) and resumed his work. The Prophet (ﷺ) started picking the pieces of gourd and I too, started picking them and putting it before him. Since then I have always loved (to eat) gourd
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Nabi (SAW) ke saath unke ek jawaan darzi ke ghar gaya. Darzi ne Nabi (SAW) ko Tharid (ek dish) pesh ki aur apna kaam dobara shuru kar diya. Nabi (SAW) usmein se laukiye ke tukde chunkar khaane lage, aur main bhi chunkar unke saamne rakhne laga. Tab se mujhe hamesha laukiya (khaane mein) pasand raha hai.

e: Narrated Qatada:We used to visit Anas bin Malik while his baker was standing (and baking). Anas would say, "Eat! I do not know that the Prophet (ﷺ) had ever seen well-baked bread till he met Allah, nor had he ever seen a roasted sheep with his own eyes
hi: Qatada bataate hain: Hum Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se milne jaate the jab unka baawarchi khada hokar roti bana raha hota. Anas kehte, 'Khaao! Mujhe nahi lagta ke Nabi (SAW) ne kabhi khoob pakayi hui roti dekhi ho apni wafat tak, na hi unhone kabhi apni aankhon se bhuni hui bakri dekhi ho.'

e: Narrated `Amr bin Umaiyay Ad-Damri:I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) cutting part of the shoulder of mutton with a knife. He ate of it and then was called for prayer whereupon he got up and put down the knife and offered the prayer without performing new ablution
hi: Amr bin Umaiya Ad-Damri bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko bakri ke kandhe ka ek hissa chaqoo se kaatte dekha. Unhone usmein se khaaya, phir unhein namaz ke liye bulaaya gaya, isper wo uthe, chaqoo neeche rakha aur bagair naya wuzu kiye namaz padhi.

e: Narrated `Abis:I asked `Aisha "Did the Prophet (ﷺ) forbid eating the meat of sacrifices offered on `Id-ul-Adha for more than three days" She said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) did not do this except in the year when the people were hungry, so he wanted the rich to feed the poor. But later we used to store even a trotter of a sheep to eat it fifteen days later." She was asked, "What compelled you to do so?" She smiled and said, "The family of Muhammad did not eat to their satisfaction white bread with meat soup for three successive days till he met Allah
hi: Abis bataate hain: Maine Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se pucha, 'Kya Nabi (SAW) ne Eid-ul-Adha ki qurbaani ka gosht teen din se zyaada khaane se mana kiya tha?' Unhone kaha, 'Nabi (SAW) ne aisa sirf us saal kiya tha jab log bhookhe the, taake ameer gareebon ko khilaayein. Magar baad mein hum ek bakri ka pair bhi pandrah din baad khaane ke liye jama karte the.' Unse pucha gaya, 'Aisa karne ki kya majboori thi?' Unhone muskuraakar kaha, 'Muhammad (SAW) ka khaandaan kabhi teen din lagataar pet bhar kar safed roti aur gosht ka shorba nahi kha paaya, unki wafat tak.'

e: Narrated Jabir:We used to carry the meat of the Hadis (sacrificed animals) to Medina during the life-time of the Prophet
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Nabi (SAW) ki zindagi mein qurbaan kiye gaye jaanwaron (Hadi) ka gosht Madina le jaaya karte the.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to Abu Talha, "Seek one of your boys to serve me." Abu Talha mounted me behind him (on his riding animal) and took me (to the Prophet (ﷺ) ). So I used to serve Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) whenever he dismounted (to stay somewhere). I used to hear him saying very often, "O Allah! I seek refuge with You from, having worries sadness, helplessness, laziness, miserliness, cowardice, from being heavily in debt and from being overpowered by other persons unjustly." I kept on serving till we -returned from the battle of Khaibar. The Prophet (ﷺ) then brought Safiyya bint Huyai whom he had won from the war booty. I saw him folding up a gown or a garment for her to sit on behind him (on his she-camel). When he reached As-Sahba', he prepared Hais and placed it on a dining sheet. Then he sent me to invite men, who (came and) ate; and that was his and Safiyya's wedding banquet. Then the Prophet proceeded, and when he saw (noticed) the mountain of Uhud, he said, "This mountain loves us, and we love it." When we approached Medina, he said, "O Allah! I make the area between its two mountains a sanctuary as Abraham has made Mecca a sanctuary. O Allah! Bless their Mudd and Sa (special kinds of measure)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kaha, 'Apne ladkon mein se kisi ek ko meri khidmat ke liye dhoondho.' Abu Talha ne mujhe apni sawaari par apne peechhe bithaaya aur mujhe (Nabi ke paas) le gaye. To main jab bhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) kahin thehrte, unki khidmat karta. Main unhein aksar ye kehte suna karta tha, 'Aye Allah! Main teri panaah maangta hoon fikr, gam, laachaari, sustee, kanjoosi, buzdili, qarz mein doobne aur logon ke zulm mein daba diye jaane se.' Main khidmat karta raha yahaan tak ke hum jang-e-Khaibar se wapas aaye. Phir Nabi (SAW) Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Huyai ko laaye jinhein unhone jang ke maal-e-ganimat mein jeeta tha. Maine unhein dekha ke unhone unke baithne ke liye apne peechhe (oontni par) ek chogha ya kapda mod kar rakha. Jab wo As-Sahba pahunche, unhone Hais (ek meethi cheez) taiyaar ki aur ek dastarkhwaan par rakhi. Phir unhone mujhe logon ko bulaane bheja, jo aaye aur khaaya; aur yahi unka aur Safiya ka shaadi ka Walima tha. Phir Nabi (SAW) aage badhe, aur jab unhone Uhud pahaad dekha, to farmaya, 'Ye pahaad humse mohabbat karta hai, aur hum ispar.' Jab hum Madina ke qareeb pahunche, unhone farmaya, 'Aye Allah! Main iske do pahaadon ke beech ke ilaake ko haram (mehfooz) ka darja deta hoon, jaise Ibrahim (Alaihissalam) ne Makkah ko diya. Aye Allah! Unke Mudd aur Sa (naap ke khaas paimane) mein barkat de.'

e: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Laila:We were sitting in the company of Hudhaifa who asked for water and a Magian brought him water. But when he placed the cup in his hand, he threw it at him and said, "Had I not forbidden him to do so more than once or twice?" He wanted to say, "I would not have done so," adding, "but I heard the Prophet saying, "Do not wear silk or Dibaja, and do not drink in silver or golden vessels, and do not eat in plates of such metals, for such things are for the unbelievers in this worldly life and for us in the Hereafter
hi: Abdur Rahman bin Abi Laila bataate hain: Hum Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath baithe the jinhone paani maanga, aur ek Majoosi (agni-parastish) unke liye paani laaya. Magar jab usne pyaala unke haath mein rakha, unhone use us shaks par phenk diya aur kaha, 'Kya maine use ek ya do se zyaada baar mana nahi kiya tha?' (Unka matlab tha) 'Main aisa nahi karta,' unhone aage kaha, 'magar maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, "Resham ya Dibaja mat pehno, aur chaandi ya sone ke bartanon mein mat piyo, aur inhi dhaatuon ki thaaliyon mein mat khaao, kyunke ye cheezein kaafiron ke liye is duniya mein hain, aur humare liye Aakhirat mein."'

e: Narrated Abu Musa Al-Ash`ari:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The example of a Believer who recites the Qur'an, is that of a citron which smells good and tastes good; And the example of a Believer who does not recite the Qur'an, is that of a date which has no smell but tastes sweet; and the example of a hypocrite who recites the Qur'an, is that of an aromatic plant which smells good but tastes bitter; and the example of a hypocrite who does not recite the Qur'an, is that of a colocynth plant which has no smell and is bitter in taste
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ashari bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Us Momin ki misaal jo Quran padhta hai, turanj (phal) jaisi hai jiski khushbu bhi achhi hai aur zaayeka bhi achha. Aur us Momin ki misaal jo Quran nahi padhta, khajoor jaisi hai jiski koi khushbu nahi magar meetha zaayeka hai; aur us munafiq ki misaal jo Quran padhta hai, ek khushboodaar paudhe jaisi hai jiski khushbu achhi hai magar zaayeka kadwa; aur us munafiq ki misaal jo Quran nahi padhta, hanzal (kadwe phal) ke paudhe jaisi hai jiski koi khushbu nahi aur zaayeka kadwa hai.'

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The superiority of `Aisha to other ladies is like the superiority of Tharid to other kinds of food
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Aisha ki doosri auraton par fazilat aisi hai jaise Tharid ki doosri khaano par fazilat hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Traveling is a kind of torture, as it prevents one from sleeping and eating! So when one has finished his job, he should return quickly to his family
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Safar ek qism ki takleef hai, kyunke ye insaan ko sone aur khaane se rokta hai. To jab koi apna kaam khatam kar le, use jaldi apne khaandaan ke paas laut jaana chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Qasim bin Muhammad:Three traditions have been established because of Barira: `Aisha intended to buy her and set her free, but Barira's masters said, "Her wala' will be for us." `Aisha mentioned that to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who said, "You could accept their condition if you wished, for the wala is for the one who manumits the slave." Barira was manumitted, then she was given the choice either to stay with her husband or leave him; One day Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered `Aisha's house while there was a cooking pot of food boiling on the fire. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked for lunch, and he was presented with bread and some extra food from the home-made Udm (e.g. soup). He asked, "Don't I see meat (being cooked)?" They said, "Yes, O Allah's Apostle! But it is the meat that has been given to Barira in charity and she has given it to us as a present." He said, "For Barira it is alms, but for us it is a present
hi: Qasim bin Muhammad bataate hain: Barira (رضی اللہ عنہا) ki wajah se teen usool qaayam hue: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne unhein khareed kar azaad karna chaaha, magar Barira ke maalikon ne kaha, 'Unki Wala hamare paas rahegi.' Aisha ne ye baat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko bataayi, unhone kaha, 'Tum chaaho to unki shart maan sakti ho, kyunke Wala uske liye hoti hai jo azaad kare.' Barira azaad ki gayin, phir unhein apne shohar ke saath rehne ya use chhodne ka ikhtiyaar diya gaya. Ek din Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Aisha ke ghar daakhil hue jabke chulhe par khaane ki ek deg pak rahi thi. Nabi (SAW) ne khaana maanga, aur unhein roti aur ghar ke bane Udm (jaise shorba) mein se kuch pesh kiya gaya. Unhone pucha, 'Kya mujhe gosht (pakta hua) nazar nahi aa raha?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan, Aye Allah ke Rasool! Magar wo gosht hai jo Barira ko sadqe mein diya gaya tha aur unhone hamein tohfe mein diya hai.' Unhone farmaya, 'Barira ke liye ye sadqa hai, magar hamare liye ye tohfa hai.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to love sweet edible things and honey
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) meethi cheezein aur shehad bahut pasand karte the.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I used to accompany Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to fill my stomach; and that was when I did not eat baked bread, nor wear silk. Neither a male nor a female slave used to serve me, and I used to bind stones over my belly and ask somebody to recite a Qur'anic Verse for me though I knew it, so that he might take me to his house and feed me. Ja`far bin Abi Talib was very kind to the poor, and he used to take us and feed us with what ever was available in his house, (and if nothing was available), he used to give us the empty (honey or butter) skin which we would tear and lick whatever was in it
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath rehta taake apna pet bhar sakoon; us waqt main na pakayi hui roti khaata tha, na resham pehanta tha. Na koi ghulaam na koi laundi meri khidmat karti thi, aur main apne pet par patthar baandh leta tha aur kisi se koi Quraani Aayat mujhe sunaane ko kehta, halaanke mujhe wo pata hoti, taake wo mujhe apne ghar le jaaye aur khaana khilaaye. Ja'far bin Abi Talib gareebon ke saath bahut meherbaan the, aur wo humein apne saath le jaate aur ghar mein jo bhi maujood hota wo khilaate, (aur agar kuch na hota) to wo humein shehad ya makhan ki khaali khaal (mashk) de dete jise hum phaad kar usme jo bhi hota chaat lete.

e: Narrated Anas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went to (the house of) his slave tailor, and he was offered (a dish of) gourd of which he started eating. I have loved to eat gourd since I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) eating it
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apne ghulaam darzi ke ghar gaye, aur unhein laukiye ki ek dish pesh ki gayi jisme se unhone khaana shuru kiya. Mujhe tab se laukiya khaana pasand hai jab se maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko use khaate dekha.

e: Narrated Abu Mas`ud Al-Ansari:There was a man called Abu Shu'aib, and he had a slave who was a butcher. He said (to his slave), "Prepare a meal to which I may invite Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) along with four other men." So he invited Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and four other men, but another man followed them whereupon the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You have invited me as one of five guests, but now another man has followed us. If you wish you can admit him, and if you wish you can refuse him." On that the host said, "But I admit him." Narrated Muhammad bin Isma`il: If guests are sitting at a dining table, they do not have the right to carry food from other tables to theirs, but they can pass on food from their own table to each other; otherwise they should leave it
hi: Abu Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ansari (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks tha jinka naam Abu Shu'aib tha, aur unke paas ek ghulaam tha jo qassab (kasai) tha. Unhone (apne ghulaam se) kaha, 'Aisa khaana taiyaar karo jismein main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko chaar aur logon ke saath bula sakoon.' To unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur chaar aur logon ko bulaaya, magar ek aur shaks unke peechhe chal pada, isper Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Aapne mujhe paanch mehmaanon mein se ek ke taur par bulaaya hai, magar ab ek aur shaks humaare peechhe aa gaya hai. Agar chaahein to unhein bhi andar aane dein, aur agar chaahein to unhein mana kar dein.' Isper mezban ne kaha, 'Nahi, main unhein bhi andar aane deta hoon.' Ravi Muhammad bin Ismail kehte hain: Agar mehmaan ek dastarkhwaan par baithe hon, to unhein doosre dastarkhwaan se khaana apni taraf laane ka haq nahi, magar wo apne hi dastarkhwaan se ek doosre ko khaana de sakte hain; warna unhein chhod dena chaahiye.

e: Narrated Anas:I was a young boy when I once was walking with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered the house of his slave tailor and the latter brought a dish filled with food covered with pieces of gourd. Allah's Apostle started picking and eating the gourd. When I saw that, I started collecting and placing the gourd before him. Then the slave returned to his work. Anas added: I have kept on loving gourd since I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) doing what he was doing
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main ek chhota ladka tha jab ek baar main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath chal raha tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apne ghulaam darzi ke ghar daakhil hue aur usne khaane se bhari ek dish laayi jismein laukiye ke tukde the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) laukiya chunkar khaane lage. Jab maine ye dekha, to main bhi laukiye chunkar unke saamne rakhne laga. Phir ghulaam apne kaam par wapas chala gaya. Anas ne aage kaha: Mujhe tab se laukiya pasand hai jab se maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko aisa karte dekha.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:A tailor invited the Prophet (ﷺ) to a meal which he had prepared, and I went along with the Prophet (ﷺ) . The tailor presented barley bread and soup containing gourd and cured meat. I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) picking the pieces of gourd from around the dish, and since then I have kept on liking gourd
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek darzi ne Nabi (SAW) ko apne taiyaar kiye khaane ki dawat di, aur main Nabi (SAW) ke saath gaya. Darzi ne jau ki roti aur laukiye aur sukhe gosht ka shorba pesh kiya. Maine Nabi (SAW) ko dish ke aas-paas se laukiye ke tukde chunkar khaate dekha, aur tab se mujhe laukiya pasand hai.

e: Narrated Anas:I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) being served with soup and containing gourd and cured meat, and I saw him picking and eating the pieces of gourd
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko laukiye aur sukhe gosht ka shorba parosa jaate dekha, aur maine unhein laukiye ke tukde chunkar khaate dekha.

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) did not do that (i.e., forbade the storage of the meat of sacrifices for three days) except (he did so) so that the rich would feed the poor. But later we used to keep even trotters to cook, fifteen days later. The family of Muhammad did not eat wheat bread with meat or soup to their satisfaction for three successive days
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ne aisa (qurbaani ka gosht teen din se zyaada rakhne se mana) sirf isliye kiya taake ameer gareebon ko khilaayein. Magar baad mein hum bakri ka pair bhi pandrah din baad pakaane ke liye rakh lete the. Muhammad (SAW) ka khaandaan teen din lagataar gehun ki roti gosht ya shorba ke saath pet bhar kar kabhi nahi kha paaya.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:A tailor invited Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to a meal which he had prepared. I went with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to that meal, and the tailor served the Prophet (ﷺ) with barley bread and soup of gourd and cured meat. I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) picking the pieces of gourd from around the dish, and since then I have kept on liking gourd
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek darzi ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko apne taiyaar kiye khaane ki dawat di. Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath us khaane par gaya, aur darzi ne Nabi (SAW) ko jau ki roti aur laukiye aur sukhe gosht ka shorba pesh kiya. Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko dish ke aas-paas se laukiye ke tukde chunkar khaate dekha, aur tab se mujhe laukiya pasand hai.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Ja`far bin Abi Talib:I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) eating fresh dates with snake cucumber
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ja'far bin Abi Talib bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko taazi khajoorein khaira (kheera jaisi sabzi) ke saath khaate dekha.

e: Narrated Abu `Uthman:I was a guest of Abu Huraira for seven days. Abu Huraira, his wife and his slave used to get up and remain awake for one-third of the night by turns. Each would offer the night prayer and then awaken the other. I heard Abu Huraira saying, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) distributed dates among his companions and my share was seven dates, one of which was a Hashafa (a date which dried on the tree before it was fully ripe)
hi: Abu Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ka saat din mehmaan raha. Abu Huraira, unki biwi aur unka ghulaam raat ke ek-tihaai hisse mein baari baari uthkar jaage rehte the. Har ek raat ki namaz padhta, phir doosre ko jagaata. Maine Abu Huraira ko ye kehte suna, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne sahaaba mein khajoorein baanti aur mera hissa saat khajoorein thin, jinmein se ek Hashafa (sukhi hui khajoor jo daraKht par hi paki-poori honese pehle sookh gayi thi) thi.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) distributed dates among us, and my share was five dates, four of which were good, and one was a ,Hashafa, and I found the Hashafa the hardest for my teeth
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne humare beech khajoorein baanti, aur mera hissa paanch khajoorein thin, jinmein se chaar achhi thin aur ek Hashafa thi, aur mujhe Hashafa apne daanton ke liye sabse sakht lagi.

e: Aishah (ra) said, "When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died, we had been satisfied by the two black things, i.e., dates and water
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: 'Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka intekaal hua, hum sirf do kaali cheezon se santusht rehte the, yaani khajoor aur paani.'

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:There was a Jew in Medina who used to lend me money up to the season of plucking dates. (Jabir had a piece of land which was on the way to Ruma). That year the land was not promising, so the payment of the debt was delayed one year. The Jew came to me at the time of plucking, but gathered nothing from my land. I asked him to give me one year respite, but he refused. This news reached the Prophet (ﷺ) whereupon he said to his companions, "Let us go and ask the Jew for respite for Jabir." All of them came to me in my garden, and the Prophet (ﷺ) started speaking to the Jew, but he Jew said, "O Abu Qasim! I will not grant him respite." When the Prophet (ﷺ) saw the Jew's attitude, he stood up and walked all around the garden and came again and talked to the Jew, but the Jew refused his request. I got up and brought some ripe fresh dates and put it in front of the Prophet. He ate and then said to me, "Where is your hut, O Jabir?" I informed him, and he said, "Spread out a bed for me in it." I spread out a bed, and he entered and slept. When he woke up, I brought some dates to him again and he ate of it and then got up and talked to the Jew again, but the Jew again refused his request. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) got up for the second time amidst the palm trees loaded with fresh dates, and said, "O Jabir! Pluck dates to repay your debt." The Jew remained with me while I was plucking the dates, till I paid him all his right, yet there remained extra quantity of dates. So I went out and proceeded till I reached the Prophet and informed him of the good news, whereupon he said, "I testify that I am Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Madina mein ek Yahudi tha jo mujhe khajoor tudaayi ke mausam tak paisa udhaar diya karta tha. (Jabir ke paas Ruma ke raaste mein ek zameen ka tukda tha.) Us saal zameen mein achhi paidaawar nahi hui, isliye qarz ki adaayagi ek saal ke liye ruk gayi. Yahudi khajoor tudaayi ke waqt mere paas aaya, magar meri zameen se kuch nahi mila. Maine usse ek saal ki mohlat maangi, magar usne inkaar kiya. Ye baat Nabi (SAW) tak pahunchi, isper unhone apne sahaaba se kaha, 'Chalo, hum Jabir ke liye Yahudi se mohlat maangte hain.' Wo sab mere baag mein mere paas aaye, aur Nabi (SAW) Yahudi se baat karne lage, magar Yahudi ne kaha, 'Aye Abu Qasim! Main use mohlat nahi dunga.' Jab Nabi (SAW) ne Yahudi ka rawaiya dekha, wo khade hue aur poore baag ka chakkar lagaakar wapas aaye aur Yahudi se dobara baat ki, magar Yahudi ne phir inkaar kiya. Main uthaa aur kuch pakki taazi khajoorein laaya aur Nabi (SAW) ke saamne rakh diyeen. Unhone khaaya, phir mujhse pucha, 'Tumhaari jhopdi kahaan hai, Aye Jabir?' Maine unhein bataaya, aur unhone kaha, 'Usmein mere liye ek bistar bichha do.' Maine bistar bichhaaya, aur wo andar aakar so gaye. Jab wo uthe, main unke paas dobara khajoorein laaya, unhone khaaya, phir uthe aur dobara Yahudi se baat ki, magar Yahudi ne phir inkaar kiya. Phir Nabi (SAW) doosri baar taazi khajooron se lade khajoor ke darakhton ke beech khade hue aur farmaya, 'Aye Jabir! Apna qarz chukaane ke liye khajoorein todo.' Yahudi mere saath raha jabke main khajoorein tod raha tha, yahaan tak ke maine uska poora haq ada kar diya, phir bhi kuch khajoorein bach gayin. To main baahar nikla aur Nabi (SAW) tak pahuncha aur unhein khush-khabri di, isper unhone farmaya, 'Main gawaahi deta hoon ke main Allah ka Rasool hoon.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:While we were sitting with the Prophet, fresh dates were brought to him. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There is a tree among the trees which is as blessed as a Muslim" I thought that it was the date palm tree and intended to say, "It is the date-palm tree, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" but I looked behind to see that I was the tenth and youngest of ten men present there, so I kept quiet' Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It is the datepalm tree
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab hum Nabi (SAW) ke saath baithe the, unke paas taazi khajoorein laayi gayin. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Darakhton mein ek darakht hai jo Musalmaan jaisa mubaarak hai.' Mujhe laga ye khajoor ka darakht hai aur main kehna chahta tha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Ye khajoor ka darakht hai,' magar maine peeche mudkar dekha ke main wahaan maujood das logon mein sabse aakhri aur sabse chhota tha, isliye main khaamosh raha. Phir Nabi (SAW) ne khud kaha, 'Ye khajoor ka darakht hai.'

e: Narrated Sa`d:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "He who eats seven 'Ajwa dates every morning, will not be affected by poison or magic on the day he eats them
hi: Sa'd bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi har subah saat Ajwa khajoorein khaaye, use us din zeher ya jaadu asar nahi karega.'

e: Narrated Jabala bin Suhaim.:At the time of Ibn Az-Zubair, we were struck with famine, and he provided us with dates for our food. `Abdullah bin `Umar used to pass by us while we were eating, and say, "Do not eat two dates together at a time, for the Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the taking of two dates together at a time (in a gathering)." Ibn `Umar used to add, "Unless one takes the permission of one's companions
hi: Jabala bin Suhaim bataate hain: Ibn Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke daur mein humpar qehat (aakaal) aaya, aur unhone humein khaane ke liye khajoorein muhaiya karayin. Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) jab humein khaate hue dekhte to guzarte hue kehte, 'Ek saath do khajoorein mat khaao, kyunke Nabi (SAW) ne (kisi majlis mein) ek saath do khajoorein lene se mana kiya tha.' Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) aage kehte, 'Siwaaye is ke ke koi apne saathiyon se ijaazat le le.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Ja`far:I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) eating fresh dates with snake cucumbers
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ja'far bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko taazi khajoorein khaira (kheera jaisi sabzi) ke saath khaate dekha.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There is a tree among the trees which is similar to a Muslim (in goodness), and that is the date palm tree
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Darakhton mein ek darakht hai jo (achhaai mein) Musalmaan jaisa hai, aur wo khajoor ka darakht hai.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Ja`far:I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) eating fresh dates with snake cucumbers
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ja'far bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko taazi khajoorein khaira ke saath khaate dekha.

e: Narrated Anas:My mother, Um Sulaim, took a Mudd of barley grain, ground it and made porridge from it, and pressed (over it), a butter skin she had with her. Then she sent me to the Prophet, and I reached him while he was sitting with his companions. I invited him, whereupon he said, "And those who are with me?' I returned and said, "He says, 'And those who are with me?" Abu Talha went out to him and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! It is just a meal prepared by Um Sulaim." The Prophet (ﷺ) entered and the food was brought to him. He said, "Let ten persons enter upon me." Those ten entered and ate their fill. Again he said, 'Let ten (more) enter upon me." Those ten entered and ate their fill. Then he said, "Let ten (more) enter upon me." He called forty persons in all Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ate and got up. I started looking (at the food) to see if it decreased or not
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Meri maa, Umm Sulaim (رضی اللہ عنہا), ne ek Mudd jau liya, use peesa aur usse dalia banaaya, aur usmein makhan ki khaal jo unke paas thi mila di. Phir unhone mujhe Nabi (SAW) ke paas bheja, aur main unke paas pahuncha jab wo apne sahaaba ke saath baithe the. Maine unhein dawat di, isper unhone kaha, 'Aur jo mere saath hain?' Main wapas gaya aur kaha, 'Wo kehte hain, "Aur jo mere saath hain?"' Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) unke paas gaye aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Ye bas Umm Sulaim ka taiyaar kiya ek maamooli khaana hai.' Nabi (SAW) andar aaye aur unke saamne khaana laaya gaya. Unhone kaha, 'Das logon ko andar aane do.' Wo das aaye aur pet bhar kar khaaya. Phir unhone kaha, 'Das aur andar aane do.' Wo das aaye aur pet bhar kar khaaya. Phir unhone kaha, 'Das aur andar aane do.' Unhone kul chaalis logon ko bulaaya. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne khaaya aur uthe. Main (khaane ko) dekhne laga ke kya usmein kami aayi hai ya nahi.

e: Narrated `Abdul `Aziz:It was said to Anas "What did you hear the Prophet (ﷺ) saying about garlic?" Anas replied, "Whoever has eaten (garlic) should not approach our mosque
hi: Abdul Aziz bataate hain: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha gaya, 'Aapne Nabi (SAW) ko lehsun ke baare mein kya kehte suna?' Anas ne jawab diya, 'Jisne (lehsun) khaaya ho, use hamaari Masjid ke paas nahi aana chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever has eaten garlic or onion should keep away from us (or should keep away from our mosque)
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jisne lehsun ya pyaaz khaaya ho, use humse (ya hamaari Masjid se) door rehna chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:We were with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) collecting Al-Kabath at Mar-Az-Zahran. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Collect the black ones, for they are better." Somebody said, (O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!) Have you ever shepherded sheep?" He said, "There has been no prophet but has shepherded them
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Mar-Az-Zahran mein Al-Kabath (ek jangli phal) chun rahe the. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kaale wale chuno, wo behtar hote hain.' Kisi ne pucha, '(Aye Allah ke Rasool!) Kya aapne kabhi bakriyaan charaayi hain?' Unhone farmaya, 'Koi bhi Nabi aisa nahi guzra jisne bakriyaan na charaayi hon.'

e: Narrated Suwaid bin An Nu`man:We went out with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to Khaibar, and when we reached As-Sahba', the Prophet (ﷺ) asked for food, and he was offered nothing but Sawiq. We ate, and then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up for the prayer. He rinsed his mouth with water, and we too, rinsed our mouths
hi: Suwaid bin An-Nu'man (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Khaibar ki taraf nikle, aur jab hum As-Sahba pahunche, Nabi (SAW) ne khaana maanga, magar unhein Sawiq ke siwa kuch nahi diya gaya. Humne khaaya, phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) namaz ke liye khade hue. Unhone paani se kulla kiya, aur humne bhi kulla kiya.

e: Narrated Suwaid:We went out with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to Khaibar. and when we reached As-Sahba', which (Yahya says) is one day' journey from Khaibar, the Prophet (ﷺ) asked for food, and he was offered nothing but Sawiq which we chewed and ate. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) asked for water and rinsed his mouth, and we too, rinsed our mouths along with him. He then led us in the Maghrib prayer without performing ablution again
hi: Suwaid bataate hain: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Khaibar ki taraf nikle, aur jab hum As-Sahba pahunche, jo (ravi Yahya ke mutaabik) Khaibar se ek din ki doori par hai, Nabi (SAW) ne khaana maanga, magar unhein Sawiq ke siwa kuch nahi diya gaya jise humne chabaa kar khaaya. Phir Nabi (SAW) ne paani maanga aur kulla kiya, aur humne bhi unke saath kulla kiya. Phir unhone humein Maghrib ki namaz padhaayi bagair dobara wuzu kiye.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'When you eat, do not wipe your hands till you have licked it, or had it licked by somebody else
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab tum khaao, to apne haath tab tak mat pochho jab tak unhein chaat na lo, ya kisi aur se chatwa na lo.'

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Al-Harith:that he asked Jabir bin `Abdullah about performing ablution after taking a cooked meal. He replied, "It is not essential," and added, "We never used to get such kind of food during the lifetime of the Prophet except rarely; and if at all we got such a dish, we did not have any handkerchiefs to wipe our hands with except the palms of our hands, our forearms and our feet. We would perform the prayer thereafter with-out performing new ablution
hi: Sa'id bin Al-Harith bataate hain: Unhone Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha ke kya pakaya hua khaana khaane ke baad wuzu zaroori hai.
