Unhone jawab diya, 'Ye zaroori nahi hai,' aur aage kaha, 'Nabi (SAW) ki zindagi mein hamein aisa khaana kam hi milta tha; aur agar humein kabhi aisi koi dish milti, to humaare paas apne haath saaf karne ke liye rumaal nahi hote the siwaaye apni hatheliyon, baazuon aur pairon ke. Phir hum namaz padhte the bagair naya wuzu kiye.'

e: Narrated Abu Umama:Whenever the dining sheet of the Prophet (ﷺ) was taken away (i.e., whenever he finished his meal), he used to say: "Al-hamdu li l-lah kathiran taiyiban mubarakan fihi ghaira makfiy wala muWada` wala mustaghna'anhu Rabbuna
hi: Abu Umama (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab bhi Nabi (SAW) ki dastarkhwaan uthaayi jaati (yaani jab bhi wo khaana khatam karte), wo kehte, 'Al-Hamdu Lillahi Kathiran Tayyiban Mubaarakan Feehi, Ghaira Makfiyyin wala Mu-adda'in wala Mustaghnan 'anhu Rabbuna' (Bahut zyaada, paak aur mubaarak shukr Allah ke liye, jo na kaafi samjha jaaye, na chhoda jaaye, na jiski hamare Rab ko zaroorat na ho).

e: Narrated Abu Umama:Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) finished his meals (or when his dining sheet was taken away), he used to say. "Praise be to Allah Who has satisfied our needs and quenched our thirst. Your favor cannot by compensated or denied." Once he said, upraise be to You, O our Lord! Your favor cannot be compensated, nor can be left, nor can be dispensed with, O our Lord
hi: Abu Umama (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab bhi Nabi (SAW) khaana khatam karte (ya jab unki dastarkhwaan uthaayi jaati), wo kehte, 'Allah ka shukr hai jisne hamaari zaroortein poori kin aur hamaari pyaas bujhaayi. Tera ehsaan na chukaya jaa sakta hai na inkaar kiya jaa sakta hai.' Ek baar unhone kaha, 'Teri taareef ho, Aye hamare Rab! Tera ehsaan na chukaya jaa sakta hai, na chhoda jaa sakta hai, na jiski zaroorat na ho, Aye hamare Rab!'

e: Narrated .Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When your servant brings your food to you, if you do not ask him to join you, then at least ask him to take one or two handfuls, for he has suffered from its heat (while cooking it) and has taken pains to cook it nicely
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab tumhaara naukar tumhaare liye khaana laaye, agar tum use apne saath baithne ko na kaho, to kam se kam use ek ya do mutthi khaane ko do, kyunke usne khaana pakaate waqt garmi bardaasht ki hai aur ise achhi tarah pakaane ki mehnat ki hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Mas`ud Al-Ansari:There was an Ansari man nicknamed, Abu Shu'aib, who had a slave who was a butcher. He came to the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was sitting with his companions and noticed the signs of hunger on the face of the Prophet (ﷺ) . So he went to his butcher slave and said, "Prepare for me a meal sufficient for five persons so that I may invite the Prophet (ﷺ) along with four other men." He had the meal prepared for him and invited him. A (sixth) man followed them. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Abu Shu'aib! Another man has followed us. If you wish, you may invite him; and if you wish, you may refuse him." Abu Shu'aib said, "No, I will admit him
hi: Abu Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ansari (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek Ansaari shaks tha jinka laqab Abu Shu'aib tha, jinke paas ek ghulaam tha jo qassab (kasai) tha. Wo Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye jab wo apne sahaaba ke saath baithe the, aur unhone Nabi (SAW) ke chehre par bhookh ke aasaar dekhe. To wo apne qassab ghulaam ke paas gaye aur kaha, 'Mere liye paanch logon ke liye kaafi khaana taiyaar karo, taake main Nabi (SAW) ko chaar aur logon ke saath bula sakoon.' Unhone khaana taiyaar karwaaya aur unhein dawat di. Ek (chhata) aadmi unke peechhe chal pada. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Aye Abu Shu'aib! Ek aur shaks humaare peechhe aa gaya hai. Agar chaaho, to unhein bhi bula sakte ho; aur agar chaaho, to unhein mana kar sakte ho.' Abu Shu'aib ne kaha, 'Nahi, main unhein bhi andar aane doonga.'

e: Narrated `Amr bin Umaiyya:That he saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) cutting a piece of mutton from its shoulder part he was carrying in his hand. When he was called for prayer, he put it down and the knife with which he was cutting it. Then he stood up and offered the prayer without performing new ablution
hi: Amr bin Umaiyya bataate hain: Unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko apne haath mein pakde bakri ke kandhe se gosht ka ek tukda kaatte dekha. Jab unhein namaz ke liye bulaaya gaya, unhone use aur chaqoo jisse wo kaat rahe the, neeche rakh diya. Phir wo khade hue aur bagair naya wuzu kiye namaz padhi.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, If supper is served and the Iqama for (Isha) prayer is proclaimed, start with you supper first
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar raat ka khaana pesh kiya jaaye aur Isha ki namaz ki Iqamat ho jaaye, to pehle apna khaana khaao.'

e: Narrated Nafi: Once Ibn Umar was taking his supper while he was listening to the recitation of (Quran by) the Imam (in the Isha prayer)
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Ek baar Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) apna raat ka khaana kha rahe the jabke wo Isha ki namaz mein Imam ki Quran ki tilawat sun rahe the.

e: Narrated Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If the Iqama for (`Isha') prayer is proclaimed and supper is served, take your supper first
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar Isha ki namaz ki Iqamat ho jaaye aur raat ka khaana pesh kiya jaaye, to pehle apna khaana khaao.'

e: Narrated Anas:I know (about) the Hijab (the order of veiling of women) more than anybody else. Ubai bin Ka`b used to ask me about it. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) became the bridegroom of Zainab bint Jahsh whom he married at Medina. After the sun had risen high in the sky, the Prophet (ﷺ) invited the people to a meal. Allah's Apostle remained sitting and some people remained sitting with him after the other guests had left. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got up and went away, and I too, followed him till he reached the door of `Aisha's room. Then he thought that the people must have left the place by then, so he returned and I also returned with him. Behold, the people were still sitting at their places. So he went back again for the second time, and I went along with him too. When we reached the door of `Aisha's room, he returned and I also returned with him to see that the people had left. Thereupon the Prophet (ﷺ) hung a curtain between me and him and the Verse regarding the order for (veiling of women) Hijab was revealed
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Mujhe Hijab (auraton ke parde) ke hukm ke baare mein kisi se bhi zyaada pata hai. Ubai bin Ka'b (رضی اللہ عنہ) mujhse iske baare mein poocha karte the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Jahsh (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke dulha bane, jinse unhone Madina mein nikaah kiya. Jab suraj aasman mein kaafi upar aa gaya, Nabi (SAW) ne logon ko khaane ki dawat di. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) baithe rahe aur kuch log unke saath baithe rahe jab baaki mehmaan chale gaye. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) uthe aur chale gaye, aur main bhi unke peechhe gaya yahaan tak ke wo Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke kamre ke darwaaze tak pahunche. Phir unhein laga ke ab tak log wahaan se chale gaye honge, to wo wapas mude aur main bhi unke saath wapas gaya. Dekha to log abhi bhi apni jagah baithe the. To wo dobara wapas gaye, aur main bhi unke saath gaya. Jab hum Aisha ke kamre ke darwaaze tak pahunche, wo wapas mude aur main bhi unke saath wapas gaya, aur dekha ke log chale gaye the. Isper Nabi (SAW) ne mere aur apne beech ek parda laga diya, aur Hijab (parde) ke hukm ki Aayat naazil hui.

e: Narrated Abu Musa:A son was born to me and I took him to the Prophet (ﷺ) who named him Ibrahim, did Tahnik for him with a date, invoked Allah to bless him and returned him to me. (The narrator added: That was Abu Musa's eldest son)
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Mere ghar ek beta paida hua aur main use Nabi (SAW) ke paas le gaya, unhone uska naam Ibrahim rakha, khajoor se uska Tahnik kiya, Allah se dua ki ke wo use barkat de, aur use mujhe wapas kar diya. (Ravi ne aage kaha: Ye Abu Musa ka sabse bada beta tha.)

e: Narrated `Aisha:A boy was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) to do Tahnik for him, but the boy urinated on him, whereupon the Prophet had water poured on the place of urine
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ek bacche ko Nabi (SAW) ke paas Tahnik karwaane laaya gaya, magar bacche ne unpar peshaab kar diya, isper Nabi (SAW) ne peshaab wali jagah par paani daalwaaya.

e: Narrated Asma' bint Abu Bakr:I conceived `Abdullah bin Az-Zubair at Mecca and went out (of Mecca) while I was about to give birth. I came to Medina and encamped at Quba', and gave birth at Quba'. Then I brought the child to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and placed it (on his lap). He asked for a date, chewed it, and put his saliva in the mouth of the child. So the first thing to enter its stomach was the saliva of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Then he did its Tahnik with a date, and invoked Allah to bless him. It was the first child born in the Islamic era, therefore they (Muslims) were very happy with its birth, for it had been said to them that the Jews had bewitched them, and so they would not produce any offspring
hi: Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Abu Bakr (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Main Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) se Makkah mein hamila hui aur (Makkah se) nikli jab main bacha paidaish dene wali thi. Main Madina aayi aur Quba mein thehri, aur Quba mein hi bacha paida hua. Phir main bacche ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laayi aur use unki god mein rakh diya. Unhone khajoor maangi, use chabaaya, aur apna lar bacche ke munh mein daala. To sabse pehli cheez jo uske pet mein gayi wo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka lar tha. Phir unhone khajoor se uska Tahnik kiya, aur Allah se dua ki ke use barkat de. Ye Islami daur ka pehla bacha tha, isliye (Musalmaan) uski paidaish se bahut khush hue, kyunke unse kaha gaya tha ke Yahudiyon ne unpar jaadu kar diya hai, isliye unke ghar koi bacha paida nahi hoga.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik: Abu Talha had a child who was sick. Once, while Abu Talha was out, the child died. When Abu Talha returned home, he asked, "How does my son fare?" Um Salaim (his wife) replied, "He is quieter than he has ever been." Then she brought supper for him and he took his supper and slept with her. When he had finished, she said (to him), "Bury the child (as he's dead)." Next morning Abu Talha came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and told him about that. The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to him), "Did you sleep with your wife last night?" Abu Talha said, "Yes". The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! Bestow your blessing on them as regards that night of theirs." Um Sulaim gave birth to a boy. Abu Talha told me to take care of the child till it was taken to the Prophet. Then Abu Talha took the child to the Prophet (ﷺ) and Um Sulaim sent some dates along with the child. The Prophet (ﷺ) took the child (on his lap) and asked if there was something with him. The people replied, "Yes, a few dates." The Prophet took a date, chewed it, took some of it out of his mouth, put it into the child's mouth and did Tahnik for him with that, and named him 'Abdullah
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) ka ek bacha bimar tha. Ek baar, jab Abu Talha baahar the, bacche ka intekaal ho gaya. Jab Abu Talha ghar wapas aaye, unhone pucha, 'Mera beta kaisa hai?' Umm Sulaim (رضی اللہ عنہا) (unki biwi) ne jawab diya, 'Wo pehle se zyaada shaant hai.' Phir unhone unke liye raat ka khaana laaya, aur unhone khaana khaaya aur unke saath so gaye. Jab wo faarigh ho gaye, unhone (usse) kaha, 'Bacche ko dafan kar do (kyunke wo mar chuka hai).' Agli subah Abu Talha Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaye aur unhein ye baat bataayi. Nabi (SAW) ne (unse) pucha, 'Kya tum raat ko apni biwi ke saath soye?' Abu Talha ne kaha, 'Haan.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Aye Allah! Unki us raat mein barkat de.' Umm Sulaim ne ek bete ko paidaish diya. Abu Talha ne mujhse kaha ke main bacche ki dekhbhaal karoon jab tak use Nabi (SAW) ke paas na le jaaya jaaye. Phir Abu Talha bacche ko Nabi (SAW) ke paas le gaye aur Umm Sulaim ne bacche ke saath kuch khajoorein bhi bhejin. Nabi (SAW) ne bacche ko (apni god mein) liya aur pucha ke kya unke paas kuch hai. Logon ne jawab diya, 'Haan, kuch khajoorein hain.' Nabi (SAW) ne ek khajoor li, use chabaaya, kuch apne munh se nikaala, bacche ke munh mein daala aur usse uska Tahnik kiya, aur uska naam Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) rakha.

e: Narrated Anas: As above
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: (Upar wali riwayat jaisi hi).

e: Narrated Salman bin 'Amri Ad-Dabbi, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Aqiqa is to be offered for a (newly born) boy
hi: Salman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Aamir Ad-Dabbi bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Naye paida hue ladke ke liye Aqiqa (qurbaani) di jaani chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Salman bin 'Amir Ad-Dabbi:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "'Aqiqa is to be offered for a (newly born) boy, so slaughter (an animal) for him, and relieve him of his suffering." Narrated Habib bin Ash-Shahid: Ibn Seereen told me to ask Al-Hassan from whom he had heard the narration of 'Aqiqa. I asked him and he said, "From Samura bin Jundab
hi: Salman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Aamir Ad-Dabbi bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Naye paida hue ladke ke liye Aqiqa di jaani chaahiye, isliye uske liye (ek jaanwar) zibah karo, aur usse takleef door karo.' Ravi Habib bin Ash-Shahid bataate hain: Ibn Seereen ne mujhse kaha ke main Al-Hasan se pucchoon ke unhone Aqiqa ki riwayat kisse suni. Maine pucha, unhone kaha, 'Samura bin Jundab se.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Neither Fara' nor 'Atira (is permissible):" Al-Fara' nor 'Atira (is permissible):" Al- Fara' was the first offspring (of camels or sheep) which the pagans used to offer (as a sacrifice) to their idols. And Al-`Atira was (a sheep which was to be slaughtered) during the month of Rajab
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Na Fara aur na Atira (jaayez hain).' Al-Fara wo pehli aulaad (oont ya bakri ki) thi jise mushrik apne buton ko qurbaan karte the. Aur Al-Atira wo bakri thi jo Rajab ke mahine mein zibah ki jaati thi.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Neither Fara' nor 'Atira) is permissible)." Al-Fara' was the first offspring (they got of camels or sheep) which they (pagans) used to offer (as a sacrifice) to their idols. 'Atira was (a sheep which used to be slaughtered) during the month of Rajab
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Na Fara aur na Atira (jaayez hai).' Al-Fara wo pehli aulaad thi (oont ya bakri ki) jo wo (mushrik) apne buton ko qurbaan karte the. Atira wo bakri thi jo Rajab ke mahine mein zibah ki jaati thi.

e: Narrated Adi bin Hatim:I asked the Prophet (ﷺ) about the game killed by a Mi'rad (i.e. a sharp-edged piece of wood or a piece of wood provided with a sharp piece of iron used for hunting). He said, "If the game is killed with its sharp edge, eat of it, but if it is killed with its shaft, with a hit by its broad side then the game is (unlawful to eat) for it has been beaten to death." I asked him about the game killed by a trained hound. He said, "If the hound catches the game for you, eat of it, for killing the game by the hound, is like its slaughtering. But if you see with your hound or hounds another dog, and you are afraid that it might have shared in hunting the game with your hound and killed it, then you should not eat of it, because you have mentioned Allah's name on (sending) your hound only, but you have not mentioned it on some other hound
hi: Adi bin Hatim (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) se Mi'rad (lakdi ka teekha hathiyaar, ya loha lagi hui lakdi) se maare gaye shikaar ke baare mein pucha. Unhone farmaya, 'Agar shikaar iski teekhi dhaar se maara gaya ho, to use khaao, magar agar wo iski chaudi taraf ki chot se maara gaya ho, to wo shikaar (haraam hai), kyunke wo maar-maar kar mara gaya hai.' Maine unse trained kutte se maare gaye shikaar ke baare mein pucha. Unhone farmaya, 'Agar kutta tumhaare liye shikaar pakad le, to use khaao, kyunke kutte ka shikaar maarna zibah karne jaisa hai. Magar agar tum apne kutte ke saath koi aur kutta dekho, aur tumhein dar ho ke usne bhi shikaar pakadne mein hissa liya ho aur use maara ho, to use mat khaao, kyunke tumne Allah ka naam sirf apne kutte ko bhejte waqt liya tha, kisi aur kutte par nahi liya tha.'

e: Narrated `Adi bin Hatim:I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about the Mi'rad. He said, "If you hit the game with its sharp edge, eat it, but if the Mi'rad hits the game with its shaft with a hit by its broad side do not eat it, for it has been beaten to death with a piece of wood. (i.e. unlawful)." I asked, "If I let loose my trained hound after a game?" He said, "If you let loose your trained hound after game, and mention the name of Allah, then you can eat." I said, "If the hound eats of the game?" He said "Then you should not eat of it, for the hound has hunted the game for itself and not for you." I said, "Some times I send my hound and then I find some other hound with it?" He said "Don't eat the game, as you have mentioned the Name of Allah on your dog only and not on the other
hi: Adi bin Hatim (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se Mi'rad ke baare mein pucha. Unhone farmaya, 'Agar tum shikaar ko iski teekhi dhaar se maaro, to use khaao, magar agar Mi'rad shikaar ko iski chaudi taraf ki chot se maare, to use mat khaao, kyunke wo lakdi se maar-maar kar mara gaya hai (haraam hai).' Maine pucha, 'Agar main apna trained kutta shikaar ke peechhe chhod doon?' Unhone kaha, 'Agar tum apna trained kutta shikaar ke peechhe chhodo aur Allah ka naam lo, to tum khaa sakte ho.' Maine pucha, 'Agar kutta khud shikaar mein se khaa le?' Unhone kaha, 'To tumhein use nahi khaana chaahiye, kyunke kutte ne shikaar apne liye pakda hai, tumhaare liye nahi.' Maine pucha, 'Kabhi kabhi main apna kutta bhejta hoon aur uske saath koi aur kutta paata hoon?' Unhone kaha, 'Shikaar mat khaao, kyunke tumne Allah ka naam sirf apne kutte par liya, doosre par nahi.'

e: Narrated Adi bin Hatim:I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We let loose our trained hounds after a game?" He said, "Eat what they hunt for you." I said, "Even if they killed (the game)?" He replied, 'Even if they killed (the game)." I said, 'We also hit (the game) with the Mi'rad?" He said, "Eat of the animal which the Mi'rad kills by piercing its body, but do not eat of the animal which is killed by the broad side of the Mi'rad
hi: Adi bin Hatim (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Hum apne trained kutte shikaar ke peechhe chhodte hain.' Unhone kaha, 'Jo wo tumhaare liye shikaar karein use khaao.' Maine pucha, 'Chaahe wo (shikaar ko) maar dein?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Chaahe wo maar dein.' Maine kaha, 'Hum Mi'rad se bhi maarte hain.' Unhone kaha, 'Jo jaanwar Mi'rad chubhokar uske jism ko cheer kar maare use khaao, magar jo jaanwar Mi'rad ki chaudi taraf se maara jaaye use mat khaao.'

e: Narrated Abu Tha`laba Al-Khushani:I said, "O Allah's Prophet! We are living in a land ruled by the people of the Scripture; Can we take our meals in their utensils? In that land there is plenty of game and I hunt the game with my bow and with my hound that is not trained and with my trained hound. Then what is lawful for me to eat?" He said, "As for what you have mentioned about the people of the Scripture, if you can get utensils other than theirs, do not eat out of theirs, but if you cannot get other than theirs, wash their utensils and eat out of it. If you hunt an animal with your bow after mentioning Allah's Name, eat of it. and if you hunt something with your trained hound after mentioning Allah's Name, eat of it, and if you hunt something with your untrained hound (and get it before it dies) and slaughter it, eat of it
hi: Abu Thalaba Al-Khushani bataate hain: Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Nabi! Hum aise ilaake mein rehte hain jahaan Ahl-e-Kitaab (Yahudi-Isaai) ki hukumat hai; kya hum unke bartanon mein khaana khaa sakte hain? Us zameen mein bahut shikaar hai aur main apne teer-kamaan se aur apne bina-trained kutte se aur apne trained kutte se shikaar karta hoon. To mere liye khaana kya jaayez hai?' Unhone farmaya, 'Jahaan tak Ahl-e-Kitaab ka sawaal hai, agar tumhein unke ilaawa bhi bartan mil sakte hain, to unke bartanon mein mat khaao, magar agar unke siwa kuch aur na mile, to unke bartan dho lo aur usmein khaao. Agar tum apne teer-kamaan se koi jaanwar shikaar karo Allah ka naam lene ke baad, to use khaao, aur agar apne trained kutte se koi jaanwar shikaar karo Allah ka naam lene ke baad, to use khaao, aur agar apne bina-trained kutte se koi jaanwar shikaar karo (aur use mrityu se pehle paakar) zibah kar do, to use khaao.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Maghaffal:that he saw a man throwing stones with two fingers (at something) and said to him, "Do not throw stones, for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has forbidden throwing stones, or he used to dislike it." `Abdullah added: Throwing stones will neither hunt the game, nor kill (or hurt) an enemy, but it may break a tooth or gouge out an eye." Afterwards `Abdullah once again saw the man throwing stones. He said to him, "I tell you that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has forbidden or disliked the throwing the stones (in such a way), yet you are throwing stones! I shall not talk to you for such-and-such a period
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Maghaffal bataate hain: Unhone ek shaks ko do ungliyon se kankar phenkte dekha (kisi cheez par) aur unse kaha, 'Kankar mat phenko, kyunke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kankar phenkne se mana kiya hai, ya usse napasand karte the.' Abdullah ne aage kaha: 'Kankar phenkne se na shikaar hota hai, na dushman ko maara ya takleef pahunchaayi jaa sakti hai, magar isse daant toot sakta hai ya aankh phoot sakti hai.' Baad mein Abdullah ne dobara us shaks ko kankar phenkte dekha. Unhone usse kaha, 'Main tumhein bata raha hoon ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kankar phenkne se mana kiya hai ya use napasand kiya, phir bhi tum kankar phenk rahe ho! Main tumse itni-itni muddat tak baat nahi karunga.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever keeps a (pet) dog which is neither a watch dog nor a hunting dog, will get a daily deduction of two Qirat from his good deeds
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi ek (paaltu) kutta rakhe jo na chaukidaari ka ho na shikaar ka, uske nek amaal mein har roz do Qirat ki kami hogi.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "If someone keeps a dog neither for hunting, nor for guarding livestock, the reward (for his good deeds) will be reduced by two Qirats per day
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Agar koi shaks kutta rakhe jo na shikaar ke liye ho na maweshiyon ki hifaazat ke liye, to uske (nek amaal ka) ajr har roz do Qirat kam ho jaayega.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If someone keeps a dog neither for guarding livestock, nor for hunting, his good deeds will decrease (in reward) by two Qirats a day
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar koi shaks kutta rakhe jo na maweshiyon ki hifaazat ke liye ho na shikaar ke liye, to uske nek amaal (ka ajr) har roz do Qirat kam ho jaayega.'

e: Narrated Adi bin Hatim:I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). "We hunt with the help of these hounds." He said, "If you let loose your trained hounds after a game, and mention the name of Allah, then you can eat what the hounds catch for you, even if they killed the game. But you should not eat of it if the hound has eaten of it, for then it is likely that the hound has caught the game for itself. And if other hounds join your hound in hunting the game, then do not eat of it
hi: Adi bin Hatim (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se pucha, 'Hum in kutton ki madad se shikaar karte hain.' Unhone kaha, 'Agar tum apne trained kutton ko shikaar ke peechhe chhodo aur Allah ka naam lo, to tum wo khaa sakte ho jo kutte tumhaare liye pakden, chaahe wo shikaar ko maar dein. Magar tumhein use nahi khaana chaahiye agar kutte ne usmein se khaaya ho, kyunke tab ye sambhaawana hai ke kutte ne shikaar apne liye pakda ho. Aur agar tumhaare kutte ke saath doosre kutte bhi shikaar mein shaamil ho jaayein, to use mat khaao.'

e: Narrated Adi bin Hatim:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If you let loose your hound after a game and mention Allah's Name on sending it, and the hound catches the game and kills it, then you can eat of it. But if the hound eats of it, then you should not eat thereof, for the hound has caught it for itself. And if along with your hound, joined other hounds, and Allah's Name was not mentioned at the time of their sending, and they catch an animal and kill it, you should not eat of it, for you will not know which of them has killed it. And if you have thrown an arrow at the game and then find it (dead) two or three days later and, it bears no mark other than the wound inflicted by your arrow, then you can eat of it. But if the game is found (dead) in water, then do not eat of it
hi: Adi bin Hatim (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar tum apne kutte ko shikaar ke peechhe chhodo aur use bhejte waqt Allah ka naam lo, aur kutta shikaar pakad kar use maar de, to tum use khaa sakte ho. Magar agar kutta usmein se khaaye, to tumhein use nahi khaana chaahiye, kyunke kutte ne use apne liye pakda hai. Aur agar tumhaare kutte ke saath doosre kutte bhi shaamil ho jaayein, aur unhein bhejte waqt Allah ka naam na liya gaya ho, aur wo koi jaanwar pakad kar maar dein, to tumhein use nahi khaana chaahiye, kyunke tumhein nahi pata chalega ke kisne use maara. Aur agar tumne shikaar par teer chalaaya aur do-teen din baad use (mara hua) paao, aur usmein tumhaare teer ke zakhm ke siwa koi aur nishaan na ho, to tum use khaa sakte ho. Magar agar shikaar paani mein (mara hua) mile, to use mat khaao.'

e: And it has also been narrated by `Adi bin Hatim that he asked the Prophet (ﷺ) "If a hunter throws an arrow at the game and after tracing it for two or three days he finds it dead but still bearing his arrow, (can he eat of it)?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "He can eat if he wishes
hi: Adi bin Hatim (رضی اللہ عنہ) se ye bhi riwayat ki gayi hai ke unhone Nabi (SAW) se pucha, 'Agar shikaari shikaar par teer chalaaye aur do-teen din uska peecha karne ke baad use mara hua paaye magar abhi bhi uska teer usmein hi ho, (to kya wo khaa sakta hai)?' Nabi (SAW) ne jawab diya, 'Wo chaahe to khaa sakta hai.'

e: Narrated `Adi bin Hatim:I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I let loose my hound after a game and mention Allah's Name on sending it." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If you let loose your hound after a game and you mention Allah's Name on sending it and the hound catches and kills the game and eats of it, then you should not eat of it, for it has killed it for itself." I said, "Sometimes when I send my hound after a game, I find another hound along with it and I do not know which of them has caught the game." He said, "You must not eat of it because you have not mentioned, the Name of Allah except on sending your own hound, and you did not mention it on the other hound." Then I asked him about the game hunted with a Mi'rad (i.e. a sharp edged piece of wood or a piece of wood provided with a sharp piece of iron used for hunting). He said, "If the game is killed with its sharp edge, you can eat of it, but if it is killed by its broad side (shaft), you cannot eat of it, for then it is like an animal beaten to death with a piece of wood
hi: Adi bin Hatim (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Main apna kutta shikaar ke peechhe chhodta hoon aur use bhejte waqt Allah ka naam leta hoon.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar tum apna kutta shikaar ke peechhe chhodo aur use bhejte waqt Allah ka naam lo, aur kutta shikaar pakad kar use maar de aur usmein se khaaye, to tumhein use nahi khaana chaahiye, kyunke usne wo apne liye maara hai.' Maine kaha, 'Kabhi kabhi jab main apna kutta shikaar ke peechhe bhejta hoon, mujhe uske saath ek aur kutta bhi milta hai aur mujhe nahi pata kisne shikaar pakda.' Unhone kaha, 'Tumhein use nahi khaana chaahiye, kyunke tumne Allah ka naam sirf apne kutte ko bhejte waqt liya, doosre kutte par nahi liya.' Phir maine unse Mi'rad se hue shikaar ke baare mein pucha. Unhone kaha, 'Agar shikaar iski teekhi dhaar se maara gaya ho, to tum use khaa sakte ho, magar agar wo iski chaudi taraf (dande) se maara gaya ho, to tum use nahi khaa sakte, kyunke tab wo lakdi se maar-maar kar mare gaye jaanwar jaisa hai.'

e: Narrated Adi Bin Hatim:I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), "We hunt with these hounds." He said, "If you send your trained hounds after a game and mention Allah's Name on sending, you can eat of what they catch for you. But if the hound eats of the game, then you must not eat of it, for I am afraid that the hound caught it for itself, and if another hound joins your hounds (during the hunt), you should not eat of the game
hi: Adi bin Hatim (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se pucha, 'Hum in kutton se shikaar karte hain.' Unhone kaha, 'Agar tum apne trained kutte shikaar ke peechhe bhejo aur bhejte waqt Allah ka naam lo, to tum wo khaa sakte ho jo wo tumhaare liye pakden. Magar agar kutta shikaar mein se khaaye, to tumhein use nahi khaana chaahiye, kyunke mujhe dar hai ke kutte ne use apne liye pakda ho, aur agar shikaar ke dauraan tumhaare kutte ke saath koi aur kutta shaamil ho jaaye, to tumhein shikaar nahi khaana chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Abu Tha`laba Al-Khushani:I came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We are living in the land of the people of the Scripture and we take our meals in their utensils, and in the land there is game and I hunt with my bow and trained or untrained hounds; please tell me what is lawful for us of that." He said, "As for your saying that you are living in the land of the people of the Scripture and that you eat in their utensils, if you can get utensils other than theirs, do not eat in their utensils, but if you do not find (other than theirs), then wash their utensils and eat in them. As for your saying that you are in the land of game, if you hung something with your bow, and have mentioned Allah's Name while hunting, then you can eat (the game). And if you hunt something with your trained hound, and have mentioned Allah's Name on sending it for hunting then you can eat (the game). But if you hunt something with your untrained hound and you were able to slaughter it before its death, you can eat of it
hi: Abu Thalaba Al-Khushani bataate hain: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Hum Ahl-e-Kitaab ki zameen mein rehte hain aur unke bartanon mein khaate hain, aur us zameen mein shikaar hai aur main apne teer-kamaan aur trained ya bina-trained kutton se shikaar karta hoon; barah-e-meharbaani mujhe bataaiye is mein se kya hamare liye jaayez hai.' Unhone kaha, 'Jahaan tak tumhaari baat hai ke tum Ahl-e-Kitaab ki zameen mein rehte ho aur unke bartanon mein khaate ho, agar tumhein unke ilaawa bartan mil sakte hain, to unke bartanon mein mat khaao, magar agar na mile, to unke bartan dho lo aur unmein khaao. Jahaan tak shikaar ki zameen mein hone ki baat hai, agar tum apne teer-kamaan se kuch shikaar karo aur shikaar karte waqt Allah ka naam liya ho, to tum (shikaar) khaa sakte ho. Aur agar apne trained kutte se kuch shikaar karo aur use shikaar ke liye bhejte waqt Allah ka naam liya ho, to tum khaa sakte ho. Magar agar apne bina-trained kutte se kuch shikaar karo aur use mrityu se pehle zibah kar sako, to tum use khaa sakte ho.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:We provoked a rabbit at Marr Az-Zahran till it started jumping. My companions chased it till they got tired. But I alone ran after it and caught it and brought it to Abu Talha. He sent both its legs to the Prophet who accepted them
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Humne Marr Az-Zahran mein ek khargosh ko chhedhaa yahaan tak ke wo uchalne laga. Mere saathi uska peecha karte rahe yahaan tak ke wo thak gaye. Magar main akela uske peechhe daudkar use pakad laaya aur Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas laaya. Unhone uski dono taangein Nabi (SAW) ke paas bheji jinhein unhone qubool kiya.

e: Narrated Abu Qatada:that once he was with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (on the way to Mecca). When he had covered some of the way to Mecca, he and some companions of his, who were in the state of Ihram. remained behind the Prophet while Abu Qatada himself was not in the state of Ihram. Abu Qatada, seeing an onager rode his horse and asked his companions to hand him a whip, but they refused. He then asked them to hand him his spear, but they refused. Then he took it himself and attacked the onager and killed it. Some of the Companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ate of it, but some others refused to eat. When they met Allah's Apostle they asked him about that. He said, "It was meal given to you by Allah
hi: Abu Qatada (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar wo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath (Makkah ki taraf) the. Jab wo raaste ka kuch hissa tay kar chuke, wo aur unke kuch saathi, jo Ihram mein the, Nabi (SAW) se peeche reh gaye jabke Abu Qatada khud Ihram mein nahi the. Abu Qatada ne ek gorkhar (wild donkey) dekha, apne ghode par sawaar hue aur apne saathiyon se koda maangi, magar unhone inkaar kiya. Phir unhone bhaala maanga, magar unhone phir inkaar kiya. To unhone khud bhaala liya aur gorkhar par hamla karke use maar diya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke kuch sahaaba ne usmein se khaaya, magar kuch ne khaane se inkaar kiya. Jab wo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se mile, unhone unse iske baare mein pucha. Unhone farmaya, 'Ye Allah ki taraf se tumhein diya gaya khaana tha.'

e: Narrated Abu Qatada:(the same Hadith above, but he added); The Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "Is there any of its meat left with you?
hi: Abu Qatada (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: (Wahi upar wali hadees, is izaafe ke saath) Nabi (SAW) ne pucha, 'Kya iska kuch gosht tumhaare paas bacha hai?'

e: Narrated Abu Qatada:I was with the Prophet (on a journey) between Mecca and Medina, and all of them, (i.e. the Prophet (ﷺ) and his companions) were in the state of Ihram, while I was not in that state. I was riding my horse and I used to be fond of ascending mountains. So while I was doing so I noticed that the people were looking at something. I went to see what it was, and behold it was an onager. I asked my companions, "What is that?" They said, "We do not know." I said, "It is an onager.' They said, "It is what you have seen." I had left my whip, so I said to them, "Hand to me my whip." They said, "We will not help you in that (in hunting the onager)." I got down, took my whip and chased the animal (on my horse) and did not stop till I killed it. I went to them and said, "Come on, carry it!" But they said, "We will not even touch it." At last I alone carried it and brought it to them. Some of them ate of it and some refused to eat of it. I said (to them), "I will ask the Prophet (ﷺ) about it (on your behalf)." When I met the Prophet, I told him the whole story. He said to me, "Has anything of it been left with you?" I said, "Yes." He said, "Eat, for it is a meal Allah has offered to you
hi: Abu Qatada (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Nabi (SAW) ke saath (ek safar mein) Makkah aur Madina ke beech tha, aur sab log (Nabi aur unke sahaaba) Ihram mein the, jabke main nahi tha. Main apne ghode par sawaar tha aur pahaadon par chadhne ka shauqeen tha. To aisa karte hue maine dekha ke log kisi cheez ki taraf dekh rahe hain. Main dekhne gaya to wo ek gorkhar tha. Maine apne saathiyon se pucha, 'Ye kya hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Humein nahi pata.' Maine kaha, 'Ye gorkhar hai.' Unhone kaha, 'Wahi hai jo tumne dekha.' Meri koda pichhe reh gayi thi, to maine unse kaha, 'Meri koda mujhe do.' Unhone kaha, 'Hum tumhaari (iske shikaar mein) madad nahi karenge.' Main utra, apni koda li aur (apne ghode par) jaanwar ka peecha kiya aur tab tak nahi ruka jab tak use maar nahi diya. Main unke paas gaya aur kaha, 'Aao, ise uthaao!' Magar unhone kaha, 'Hum ise chhuenge bhi nahi.' Aakhir main akela hi ise leke aaya aur unke paas laaya. Kuch ne usmein se khaaya, kuch ne khaane se inkaar kiya. Maine (unse) kaha, 'Main Nabi (SAW) se iske baare mein pucchunga (tumhaari taraf se).' Jab main Nabi (SAW) se mila, maine unhein poori kahaani sunaayi. Unhone mujhse pucha, 'Kya iska kuch hissa tumhaare paas bacha hai?' Maine kaha, 'Haan.' Unhone farmaya, 'Khaao, kyunke ye Allah ki taraf se diya gaya khaana hai.'

e: Narrated Jabir:We went out in a campaign and the army was called The Army of the Khabat, and Abu 'Ubaida was our commander. We were struck with severe hunger. Then the sea threw a huge dead fish called Al- `Anbar, the like of which had never been seen. We ate of it for half a month, and then Abu 'Ubaida took one of its bones (and made an arch of it) so that a rider could easily pass under it
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum ek mohim par nikle jise 'Khabat ki Fauj' kaha gaya, aur Abu Ubaida hamare senapati the. Hum shadeed bhookh ka shikaar hue. Phir samundar ne ek bahut badi murda machhli, jise Al-Anbar kaha jaata hai, kinaare phenki, jaisi pehle kabhi nahi dekhi gayi thi. Humne usse aadhe mahine tak khaaya, phir Abu Ubaida ne uski ek haddi li (aur usse ek mehraab banaayi) jiske neeche se ek sawaar aasaani se guzar sakta tha.

e: Narrated Jabir:The Prophet (ﷺ) sent us as an army unit of three hundred warriors under the command of Abu 'Ubaida to ambush a caravan of the Quraish. But we were struck with such severe hunger that we ate the Khabat (desert bushes), so our army was called the Army of the Khabat. Then the sea threw a huge fish called Al-`Anbar and we ate of it for half a month and rubbed our bodies with its fat till our bodies became healthy. Then Abu Ubaida took one of its ribs and fixed it over the ground and a rider passed underneath it. There was a man amongst us who slaughtered three camels when hunger became severe, and he slaughtered three more, but after that Abu 'Ubaida forbade him to do so
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne humein teen sau (300) jaanbaazon ka ek fauji dasta banaakar Abu Ubaida ki qayaadat mein Quraish ke ek kaafle ko ghaat lagaane bheja. Magar humein itni shadeed bhookh lagi ke humne Khabat (registaani jhaadiyaan) khaayi, isliye hamaari fauj ko 'Khabat ki Fauj' kaha gaya. Phir samundar ne Al-Anbar naami ek badi machhli phenki aur humne usse aadhe mahine tak khaaya aur uski charbi se apne jism mile, yahaan tak ke hamare jism sehatmand ho gaye. Phir Abu Ubaida ne uski ek paseli li aur zameen par khadi ki, aur ek sawaar uske neeche se guzar gaya. Humaare beech ek shaks tha jisne bhookh shadeed hone par teen oont zibah kiye, aur usne teen aur zibah kiye, magar baad mein Abu Ubaida ne use aisa karne se mana kar diya.

e: Narrated Ibn Abi `Aufa:We participated with the Prophet (ﷺ) in six or seven Ghazawat, and we used to eat locusts with him
hi: Ibn Abi Aufa bataate hain: Humne Nabi (SAW) ke saath chhe ya saat Ghazwon mein hissa liya, aur hum unke saath tiddi khaaya karte the.

e: Narrated Abu Tha`laba Al-Khushani:I came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We are living in the land of the people of the Scripture, and we take our meals in their utensils, and there is game in that land and I hunt with my bow and with my trained hound and with my untrained hound." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "As for your saying that you are in the land of people of the Scripture, you should not eat in their utensils unless you find no alternative, in which case you must wash the utensils and then eat in them As for your saying that you are in the land of game, if you hunt something with your bow, mention Allah's Name (while hunting the game) and eat; and if you hunt something with your trained hound, mention Allah's Name on sending and eat; and if you hunt something with your untrained hound and get it alive, slaughter it and you can eat of it
hi: Abu Thalaba Al-Khushani bataate hain: Main Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Hum Ahl-e-Kitaab ki zameen mein rehte hain, aur unke bartanon mein khaate hain, aur us zameen mein shikaar hai aur main apne teer-kamaan se, apne trained kutte se, aur apne bina-trained kutte se shikaar karta hoon.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jahaan tak Ahl-e-Kitaab ki zameen mein hone ki baat hai, tumhein unke bartanon mein khaana nahi chaahiye jab tak koi doosra chaara na ho, aisi soorat mein bartan dho lo phir usmein khaao. Jahaan tak shikaar ki zameen mein hone ki baat hai, agar tum teer-kamaan se kuch shikaar karo, shikaar karte waqt Allah ka naam lo aur khaao; aur agar apne trained kutte se kuch shikaar karo, use bhejte waqt Allah ka naam lo aur khaao; aur agar apne bina-trained kutte se kuch shikaar karo aur use zinda paakar zibah kar do, to tum usmein se khaa sakte ho.'

e: Narrated Salama bin Al-Aqwa':In the evening of the day of the conquest of Khaibar, the army made fires (for cooking). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "For what have you made these fires?" They said, "For cooking the meat of domestic donkeys." He said, "Throw away what is in the cooking pots and break the pots." A man from the people got up and said, "Shall we throw the contents of the cooking pots and then wash the pots (instead of breaking them)?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Yes, you can do either
hi: Salama bin Al-Aqwa bataate hain: Khaibar fatah hone ki shaam ko, fauj ne (khaana pakaane ke liye) aag jalaayi. Nabi (SAW) ne pucha, 'Ye aag kis liye jalaayi hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Ghar ke gadhon ka gosht pakaane ke liye.' Unhone farmaya, 'Deg mein jo hai use phenk do aur degon ko todo.' Logon mein se ek shaks khada hua aur kaha, 'Kya hum deg ka saamaan phenk kar phir unhein dho lein (todne ke bajaaye)?' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Haan, tum jo bhi karo kar sakte ho.'

e: Narrated Rafi` bin Khadij:We were with the Prophet (ﷺ) in Dhul-Hulaifa and there the people were struck with severe hunger. Then we got camels and sheep as war booty (and slaughtered them). The Prophet (ﷺ) was behind all the people. The people hurried and fixed the cooking pots (for cooking) but the Prophet (ﷺ) came there and ordered that the cooking pots be turned upside down. Then he distributed the animals, regarding ten sheep as equal to one camel. One of the camels ran away and there were a few horses with the people. They chased the camel but they got tired, whereupon a man shot it with an arrow whereby Allah stopped it. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Among these animals some are as wild as wild beasts, so if one of them runs away from you, treat it in this way." I said. "We hope, or we are afraid that tomorrow we will meet the enemy and we have no knives, shall we slaughter (our animals) with canes?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If the killing tool causes blood to gush out and if Allah's Name is mentioned, eat (of the slaughterer animal). But do not slaughter with a tooth or a nail. I am telling you why: A tooth is a bone, and the nail is the knife of Ethiopians
hi: Rafi' bin Khadij (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Nabi (SAW) ke saath Dhul-Hulaifa mein the aur wahaan logon ko shadeed bhookh lagi. Phir hamein jang ke maal-e-ganimat mein oont aur bakriyaan milin (aur humne unhein zibah kiya). Nabi (SAW) sab logon se peeche the. Log jaldi mein aag jala kar khaana pakaane lage, magar Nabi (SAW) wahaan aaye aur hukm diya ke degon ko ulat diya jaaye. Phir unhone jaanwar baante, das bakriyon ko ek oont ke barabar maante hue. Ek oont bhaag gaya aur logon ke paas kuch ghode the. Unhone oont ka peecha kiya magar wo thak gaye, isper ek shaks ne use teer se maara jispar Allah ne use rok diya. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Inmein se kuch jaanwar jangli jaanwaron jaise hote hain, isliye agar unmein se koi tumse bhaag jaaye, to isi tarah uska ilaaj karo.' Maine kaha, 'Humein ummeed hai, ya humein dar hai, ke kal hum dushman se milenge aur hamare paas chaqoo nahi hai, kya hum (apne jaanwar) neizon se zibah kar sakte hain?' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar zibah karne wala hathiyaar khoon bahaaye aur Allah ka naam liya gaya ho, to (zibah kiye gaye jaanwar ko) khaao. Magar daant ya naakhoon se zibah mat karo. Main tumhein bataata hoon kyun: Daant ek haddi hai, aur naakhoon Habshiyon ka chaqoo hai.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said that he met Zaid bin `Amr Nufail at a place near Baldah and this had happened before Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) received the Divine Inspiration. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) presented a dish of meat (that had been offered to him by the pagans) to Zaid bin `Amr, but Zaid refused to eat of it and then said (to the pagans), "I do not eat of what you slaughter on your stonealtars (Ansabs) nor do I eat except that on which Allah's Name has been mentioned on slaughtering
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne bataaya ke unki mulaqaat Zaid bin Amr Nufail se Baldah ke qareeb ek jagah par hui, aur ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko wahi milne se pehle ki baat hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Zaid bin Amr ko gosht ki ek dish pesh ki (jo unhein mushrikeen ne di thi), magar Zaid ne usmein se khaane se inkaar kar diya aur (mushrikeen se) kaha, 'Main wo nahi khaata jo tum apne pathar ke buton (Ansab) par zibah karte ho, aur main sirf wo khaata hoon jispar zibah karte waqt Allah ka naam liya gaya ho.'

e: Narrated Jundub bin Sufyan Al-Bajali:Once during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) we offered some animals as sacrifices. Some people slaughtered their sacrifices before the (Id) prayer, so when the Prophet (ﷺ) finished his prayer, he saw that they had slaughtered their sacrifices before the prayer. He said, "Whoever has slaughtered (his sacrifice) before the prayer, should slaughter (another sacrifice) in lieu of it; and whoever has not yet slaughtered it till we have prayed; should slaughter (it) by mentioning Allah's Name
hi: Jundub bin Sufyan Al-Bajali bataate hain: Ek baar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zindagi mein humne kuch jaanwar qurbaani ke liye pesh kiye. Kuch logon ne (Eid ki) namaz se pehle apni qurbaani zibah kar di, to jab Nabi (SAW) ne apni namaz khatam ki, unhone dekha ke unhone namaz se pehle apni qurbaani zibah kar di thi. Unhone farmaya, 'Jisne namaz se pehle zibah kiya ho, use uski jagah (ek aur) zibah karna chaahiye; aur jisne abhi tak zibah nahi kiya jab tak hum namaz padh chuke hain, use Allah ka naam lekar zibah karna chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Ka`b:that a slave girl of theirs used to shepherd some sheep at Si'a (a mountain near Medina). On seeing one of her sheep dying, she broke a stone and slaughtered it. Ka`b said to his family, "Do not eat (of it) till I go to the Prophet (ﷺ) and ask him, or, till I send someone to ask him." So he went to the Prophet (ﷺ) or sent someone to him The Prophet (ﷺ) permitted (them) to eat it
hi: Ka'b bataate hain: Unki ek launDi Si'a (Madina ke qareeb ek pahaad) mein bakriyaan charaaya karti thi. Jab unhone dekha ke unki ek bakri mar rahi hai, usne ek patthar toda aur usse zibah kar diya. Ka'b ne apne khaandaan se kaha, 'Ise mat khaana jab tak main Nabi (SAW) ke paas na jaaun aur unse na pucchoon, ya jab tak main kisi ko unse poochne ke liye na bhejoon.' To wo Nabi (SAW) ke paas gaye ya kisi ko unke paas bheja. Nabi (SAW) ne ise khaane ki ijaazat de di.

e: Narrated `Abdullah:that Ka`b had a slave girl who used to graze his sheep on a small mountain, called "Sl'a", situated near the market. Once a sheep was dying, so she broke a stone and slaughtered it with it. When they mentioned that to the Prophet, he, permitted them to eat it
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ka'b ke paas ek launDi thi jo unki bakriyaan Sl'a naami ek chhoti pahaadi par charaati thi, jo bazaar ke qareeb thi. Ek baar ek bakri mar rahi thi, to usne ek patthar toda aur usse zibah kar diya. Jab unhone ye baat Nabi (SAW) ko bataayi, unhone use khaane ki ijaazat de di.

e: Narrated Rafi` bin Khadij:that he said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We have no knife." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "if the killing tool causes blood to gush out, and if Allah's Name is mentioned, eat (of the slaughtered animal). But do not slaughter with a nail or a tooth, for the nail is the knife of Ethiopians and a tooth is a bone." Suddenly a camel ran away and it was stopped (with an arrow). The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "Of these camels there are some which are as wild as wild beasts; so if one of them runs away from you and you cannot catch it, treat it in this manner (i.e. shoot it with an arrow)
hi: Rafi' bin Khadij (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Unhone kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Hamare paas chaqoo nahi hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar zibah karne wala hathiyaar khoon bahaaye, aur Allah ka naam liya gaya ho, to (zibah kiye gaye jaanwar ko) khaao. Magar naakhoon ya daant se zibah mat karo, kyunke naakhoon Habshiyon ka chaqoo hai aur daant ek haddi hai.' Achaanak ek oont bhaag gaya aur use rok diya gaya (teer se). Nabi (SAW) ne phir farmaya, 'Inmein se kuch oont jangli jaanwaron jaise hote hain; agar unmein se koi tumse bhaag jaaye aur tum use pakad na sako, to isi tarah (teer se) uska ilaaj karo.'

e: Narrated Ka`b bin Malik:A lady slaughtered a sheep with a stone and then the Prophet (ﷺ) was asked about it and he permitted it to be eaten
hi: Ka'b bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek khaatoon ne ek bakri ko patthar se zibah kiya, phir Nabi (SAW) se iske baare mein pucha gaya, aur unhone use khaane ki ijaazat de di.

e: Narrated Mu`adh bin Sa`d or Sa`d bin Mu`adh:A slave girl belonging to Ka`b used to graze some sheep at Sl'a (mountain). Once one of her sheep was dying. She reached it (before it died) and slaughtered it with a stone. The Prophet (ﷺ) was asked, and he said, "Eat it
hi: Mu'adh bin Sa'd (ya Sa'd bin Mu'adh) bataate hain: Ka'b ki ek launDi Sl'a (pahaad) mein kuch bakriyaan charaaya karti thi. Ek baar unki ek bakri mar rahi thi. Wo (uski maut se pehle) uske paas pahunchi aur usse patthar se zibah kar diya. Nabi (SAW) se pucha gaya, unhone kaha, 'Ise khaao.'

e: Narrated Rafi` bin Khadij:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Eat what is slaughtered (with any instrument) that makes blood flow out, except what is slaughtered with a tooth or a nail
hi: Rafi' bin Khadij (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo bhi (kisi bhi hathiyaar se) zibah kiya jaaye jo khoon bahaaye, use khaao, siwaaye us jaanwar ke jo daant ya naakhoon se zibah kiya gaya ho.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:A group of people said to the Prophet, "Some people bring us meat and we do not know whether they have mentioned Allah's Name or not on slaughtering the animal." He said, "Mention Allah's Name on it and eat." Those people had embraced Islam recently
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Kuch logon ne Nabi (SAW) se kaha, 'Kuch log humein gosht dete hain aur humein nahi pata ke unhone jaanwar zibah karte waqt Allah ka naam liya hai ya nahi.' Unhone kaha, 'Tum khud Allah ka naam liya kaho aur khaao.' Wo log haal hi mein Islam laaye the.

e: Narrates `Abdullah bin Mughaffal:While we were besieging the castle of Khaibar, Somebody threw a skin full of fat and I went ahead to take it, but on looking behind, I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) and I felt shy in his presence (and did not take it)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Mughaffal bataate hain: Jab hum Khaibar ke qile ka ghera daale hue the, kisi ne charbi se bhari ek khaal phenki, aur main use uthaane ke liye aage badha, magar peeche mudkar dekha to Nabi (SAW) ko dekha, aur unki maujoodgi mein mujhe sharm aayi (aur maine use nahi uthaaya).

e: Narrated Rafi` bin Khadij:I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We are going to face the enemy tomorrow and we do not have knives." He said, "Hurry up (in killing the animal). If the killing tool causes blood to flow out, and if Allah's Name is mentioned, eat (of the slaughtered animal). But do not slaughter with a tooth or a nail. I will tell you why: As for the tooth, it is a bone; and as for the nail, it is the knife of Ethiopians." Then we got some camels and sheep as war booty, and one of those camels ran away, whereupon a man shot it with an arrow and stopped it. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Of these camels there are some which are as wild as wild beasts, so if one of them (runs away and) makes you tired, treat it in this manner
hi: Rafi' bin Khadij (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Hum kal dushman ka saamna karne wale hain aur hamare paas chaqoo nahi hai.' Unhone kaha, 'Jaldi karo (jaanwar zibah karne mein). Agar zibah karne wala hathiyaar khoon bahaaye, aur Allah ka naam liya gaya ho, to (zibah kiye gaye jaanwar ko) khaao. Magar daant ya naakhoon se zibah mat karo. Main tumhein bataata hoon kyun: Daant ek haddi hai, aur naakhoon Habshiyon ka chaqoo hai.' Phir hamein jang ke maal-e-ganimat mein kuch oont aur bakriyaan milin, aur unmein se ek oont bhaag gaya, isper ek shaks ne use teer se maara aur rok diya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Inmein se kuch oont jangli jaanwaron jaise hote hain, isliye agar koi (bhaag jaaye aur) tumhein thaka de, to isi tarah uska ilaaj karo.'

e: Narrated Asma bint Abu Bakr:We slaughtered a horse (by Nahr) during the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) and ate it
hi: Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Abu Bakr (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Humne Nabi (SAW) ki zindagi mein ek ghoda (Nahr ke tareeke se) zibah kiya aur use khaaya.

e: Narrated Asma':We slaughtered a horse (by Dhabh) during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while we were at Medina, and we ate it
hi: Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Humne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zindagi mein ek ghoda (Dhabh ke tareeke se) zibah kiya jabke hum Madina mein the, aur humne use khaaya.

e: Narrated Asma' bint Abu Bakr:We slaughtered a horse (by Nahr) during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and ate it
hi: Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Abu Bakr (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Humne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zindagi mein ek ghoda (Nahr ke tareeke se) zibah kiya aur use khaaya.

e: Narrated Hisham bin Zaid:Anas and I went to Al-Hakam bin Aiyub. Anas saw some boys shooting at a tied hen. Anas said, "The Prophet has forbidden the shooting of tied or confined animals
hi: Hisham bin Zaid bataate hain: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur main Al-Hakam bin Aiyub ke paas gaye. Anas ne kuch ladkon ko ek baandhi hui murgi par nishaana lagaate dekha. Anas ne kaha, 'Nabi (SAW) ne baandhe ya qaid kiye jaanwaron par nishaana lagaane se mana kiya hai.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:that he entered upon Yahya bin Sa`id while one of Yahya's sons was aiming at a hen after tying it. Ibn `Umar walked to it and untied it. Then he brought it and the boy and said. "Prevent your boys from tying the birds for the sake of killing them, as I have heard the Prophet (ﷺ) forbidding the killing of an animal or other living thing after tying them
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Wo Yahya bin Sa'id ke ghar gaye jabke Yahya ka ek beta ek murgi ko baandh kar uspar nishaana lagaa raha tha. Ibn Umar uske paas gaye aur use khol diya. Phir wo use aur ladke ko laaye aur kaha, 'Apne ladkon ko parindon ko baandh kar unhein maarne se roko, kyunke maine Nabi (SAW) ko kisi jaanwar ya doosri jaandaar cheez ko baandh kar maarne se mana karte suna hai.'

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:While I was with Ibn `Umar, we passed by a group of young men who had tied a hen and started shooting at it. When they saw Ibn `Umar, they dispersed, leaving it. On that Ibn `Umar said, "Who has done this? The Prophet (ﷺ) cursed the one who did so." Narrated Ibn `Umar: The Prophet (ﷺ) cursed the one who did Muthla to an animal (i e., cut its limbs or some other part of its body while it is still alive)
hi: Saeed bin Jubair bataate hain: Jab main Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath tha, hum kuch jawaan logon ke paas se guzre jinhone ek murgi ko baandh kar uspar nishaana lagaana shuru kar diya tha. Jab unhone Ibn Umar ko dekha, wo bikhar gaye aur use chhod diya. Isper Ibn Umar ne kaha, 'Ye kisne kiya? Nabi (SAW) ne aisa karne wale par laanat ki hai.' Ibn Umar bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne us shaks par laanat ki jisne kisi jaanwar ki Muthla ki (yaani uske ang ya jism ke kisi hisse ko zinda haalat mein hi kaat diya).

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Yazid:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade An-Nuhba and Al-Muthla
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Yazid bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne An-Nuhba (loot-paat) aur Al-Muthla (jism ke ang kaatna) se mana kiya.

e: Narrated Abu Musa Al-Ash`ari:I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) eating chicken
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ashari bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko murgi ka gosht khaate dekha.

e: Narrated Zahdam:We were in the company of Abu Musa Al-Ash`ari and there were friendly relations between us and this tribe of Jarm. Abu Musa was presented with a dish containing chicken. Among the people there was sitting a red-faced man who did not come near the food. Abu Musa said (to him), "Come on (and eat), for I have seen Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) eating of it (i.e. chicken)." He said, "I have seen it eating something (dirty) and since then I have disliked it, and have taken an oath that I shall not eat it ' Abu Musa said, "Come on, I will tell you (or narrate to you). Once I went to Allah's Apostle with a group of Al-Ash`ariyin, and met him while he was angry, distributing some camels of rak`at. We asked for mounts but he took an oath that he would not give us any mounts, and added, 'I have nothing to mount you on' In the meantime some camels of booty were brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he asked twice, 'Where are Al-Ash`ariyin?" So he gave us five white camels with big humps. We stayed for a short while (after we had covered a little distance), and then I said to my companions, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has forgotten his oath. By Allah, if we do not remind Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) of his oath, we will never be successful." So we returned to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We asked you for mounts, but you took an oath that you would not give us any mounts; we think that you have forgotten your oath.' He said, 'It is Allah Who has given you mounts. By Allah, and Allah willing, if I take an oath and later find something else better than that. then I do what is better and expiate my oath
hi: Zahdam bataate hain: Hum Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ashari ke saath the aur hamare aur Jarm qabeele ke beech dostana rishtey the. Abu Musa ko murgi wali ek dish pesh ki gayi. Wahaan baithe logon mein se ek surkh chehre wale shaks khaane ke qareeb nahi aaye. Abu Musa ne (unse) kaha, 'Aao (aur khaao), kyunke maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ise (yaani murgi) khaate dekha hai.' Usne kaha, 'Maine ise (murgi ko) kuch (ganda) khaate dekha hai aur tab se mujhe ye napasand hai, aur maine qasam khaayi hai ke main ise nahi khaunga.' Abu Musa ne kaha, 'Aao, main tumhein bataata hoon (ya sunata hoon). Ek baar main Al-Asha'riyin ke ek giroh ke saath Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaya aur unse mila jab wo gussa mein the, kuch oont baant rahe the. Humne sawaari maangi magar unhone qasam khaayi ke wo humein koi sawaari nahi denge, aur kaha, "Mere paas tumhein sawaar karne ke liye kuch nahi hai." Isi dauraan Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas kuch maal-e-ganimat ke oont laaye gaye, aur unhone do baar pucha, "Al-Asha'riyin kahaan hain?" To unhone humein paanch safed, bade koohaan waale oont diye. Hum thodi door chalne ke baad thode waqt ruke, phir maine apne saathiyon se kaha, "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apni qasam bhool gaye hain. Allah ki qasam, agar hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko unki qasam yaad na dilaayein, to hum kabhi kaamyaab nahi honge." To hum Nabi (SAW) ke paas wapas gaye aur kaha, "Aye Allah ke Rasool! Humne aapse sawaari maangi thi, magar aapne qasam khaayi thi ke aap humein sawaari nahi denge; humein lagta hai ke aap apni qasam bhool gaye hain." Unhone farmaya, "Ye Allah hai jisne tumhein sawaari di hai. Allah ki qasam, Insha-Allah, agar main koi qasam khaaun aur baad mein usse behtar koi cheez paaun, to main wo behtar cheez karta hoon aur apni qasam ka kaffara ada karta hoon."'

e: Narrated Asma':We slaughtered a horse during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and ate it
hi: Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Humne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zindagi mein ek ghoda zibah kiya aur use khaaya.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:On the Day of the battle of Khaibar, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) made donkey's meat unlawful and allowed the eating of horse flesh
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jang-e-Khaibar ke din, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne gadhe ka gosht haraam kiya aur ghode ka gosht khaane ki ijaazat di.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) made the meat of donkeys unlawful on the day of the battle of Khaibar
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne jang-e-Khaibar ke din gadhon ka gosht haraam kar diya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) prohibited the eating of donkey's meat
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne gadhe ka gosht khaane se mana kiya.

e: Narrated `Ali:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prohibited Al-Mut'a marriage and the eating of donkey's meat in the year of the Khaibar battle
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Mut'a nikaah aur gadhe ka gosht khaane se jang-e-Khaibar ke saal mana kiya.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) prohibited the eating of donkey's meat on the day of the battle of Khaibar, and allowed the eating of horse flesh
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne jang-e-Khaibar ke din gadhe ka gosht khaane se mana kiya, aur ghode ka gosht khaane ki ijaazat di.

e: Narrated Al-Bara' and Ibn Abi `Aufa:The Prophet (ﷺ) prohibited the eating of donkey's meat
hi: Al-Bara aur Ibn Abi Aufa bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne gadhe ka gosht khaane se mana kiya.

e: Narrated Abu Tha'alba: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prohibited the eating of donkey's meat. Narrated Az-Zuhri: The Prophet (ﷺ) prohibited the eating of beasts having fangs
hi: Abu Thalaba bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne gadhe ka gosht khaane se mana kiya. Ravi Az-Zuhri bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne un jaanwaron ka gosht khaane se mana kiya jinke naukeele daant (canine) hote hain.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Someone came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "The donkeys have been (slaughtered and) eaten. Another man came and said, "The donkeys have been destroyed." On that the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered a caller to announce to the people: Allah and His Apostle forbid you to eat the meat of donkeys, for it is impure.' Thus the pots were turned upside down while the (donkeys') meat was boiling in them
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Koi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Gadhe zibah karke khaaye jaa chuke hain.' Ek aur shaks aaya aur kaha, 'Gadhe khatam ho chuke hain.' Isper Nabi (SAW) ne ek elaan karne wale ko hukm diya ke wo logon mein elaan kare: 'Allah aur uske Rasool tumhein gadhe ka gosht khaane se mana karte hain, kyunke ye napaak hai.' Isper degein ulat di gayin jabke unmein gadhe ka gosht ubal raha tha.

e: Narrated `Amr:I said to Jabir bin Zaid, "The people claim that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the eating of donkey's meat." He said, "Al-Hakam bin `Amr Al-Ghifari used to say so when he was with us, but Ibn `Abbas, the great religious learned man, refused to give a final verdict and recited:-- 'Say: I find not in that which has been inspired to me anything forbidden to be eaten by one who wishes to eat it, unless it be carrion, blood poured forth or the flesh of swine
hi: Amr bataate hain: Maine Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Zaid se kaha, 'Log dawa karte hain ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne gadhe ka gosht khaane se mana kiya tha.' Unhone kaha, 'Al-Hakam bin Amr Al-Ghifari aisa kaha karte the jab wo humare saath the, magar Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ), jo ek bade deeni aalim the, unhone aakhri faisla dene se inkaar kiya aur padha: "Kaho: Jo mujhpar wahi ki gayi hai usmein mujhe koi cheez haraam nahi milti jise koi khaana chaahe, siwaaye murda jaanwar ke, ya bahaaya hua khoon, ya khinzeer ka gosht."'

e: Narrated Abu Tha`laba:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the eating of the meat of beasts having fangs
hi: Abu Thalaba bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne naukeele daant waale jaanwaron ka gosht khaane se mana kiya.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abbas:Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) passed by a dead sheep and said (to the people), "Why don't you use its hide?" They said, "But it is dead," He said, "Only eating it, is prohibited
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek murda bakri ke paas se guzre aur (logon se) kaha, 'Tum iski khaal kyun istemaal nahi karte?' Unhone kaha, 'Magar ye murda hai.' Unhone farmaya, 'Sirf ise khaana haraam hai (istemaal karna nahi).'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) passed by a dead goat and said, "There is no harm if its owners benefit from its skin
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ek murda bakri ke paas se guzre aur farmaya, 'Koi harj nahi agar uske maalik uski khaal se faayda uthaayein.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "None is wounded in Allah's Cause but will come on the Day of Resurrection with his wound bleeding. The thing that will come out of his wound will be the color of blood, but its smell will be the smell of musk
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi Allah ki raah mein zakhmi hota hai, wo Qayamat ke din is haal mein aayega ke uska zakhm khoon beh raha hoga. Jo cheez uske zakhm se nikalegi wo rang mein khoon jaisi hogi, magar khushbu mein kasturi jaisi hogi.'

e: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'The example of a good pious companion and an evil one is that of a person carrying musk and another blowing a pair of bellows. The one who is carrying musk will either give you some perfume as a present, or you will buy some from him, or you will get a good smell from him, but the one who is blowing a pair of bellows will either burn your clothes or you will get a bad smell from him
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Achhe, neik saathi aur bure saathi ki misaal us shaks jaisi hai jo kasturi leke chalta hai aur us shaks jaisi jo bhatti ki dhaunkni chalaata hai. Kasturi lekar chalne wala ya to tumhein khushbu ka tohfa dega, ya tum usse kuch khareed loge, ya kam se kam tumhein uski achhi khushbu milegi, magar bhatti ki dhaunkni chalaane wala ya to tumhaare kapde jala dega ya tumhein uski buri badbu milegi.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Once we provoked a rabbit at Marr-az-Zahran. The people chased it till they got tired. Then I caught It and brought it to Abu Talha, who slaughtered it and then sent both its pelvic pieces (or legs) to the Prophet, and the Prophet (ﷺ) accepted the present
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar humne Marr-az-Zahran mein ek khargosh ko chhedhaa. Log uska peecha karte rahe yahaan tak ke wo thak gaye. Phir maine use pakad liya aur Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas laaya, unhone use zibah kiya aur uski dono pinduliyon (ya taangon) ko Nabi (SAW) ke paas bheja, aur Nabi (SAW) ne wo tohfa qubool kiya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I do not eat mastigure, but I do not prohibit its eating
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Main guhera (chhipkali jaisa jaanwar) nahi khaata, magar main iske khaane ko haraam nahi kehta.'

e: Narrated Khalid bin Al-Walid:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and I entered the house of Maimuna. A roasted mastigure was served. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stretched his hand out (to eat of it) but some woman said, "Inform Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) of what he is about to eat." So they said, "It is mastigure, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" He withdrew his hand, whereupon I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Is it unlawful?" He said, "No, but this is not found in the land of my people, so I dislike it." So I pulled the mastigure towards me and ate it while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was looking at me
hi: Khalid bin Al-Walid bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur main Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke ghar daakhil hue. Ek bhuna hua guhera pesh kiya gaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apna haath (usse khaane ke liye) badhaaya, magar kisi khaatoon ne kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko bataao ke wo kya khaane wale hain.' To unhone kaha, 'Ye guhera hai, Aye Allah ke Rasool!' Unhone apna haath hataa liya, isper maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya ye haraam hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Nahi, magar ye meri qaum ki zameen mein nahi milta, isliye mujhe ye pasand nahi.' To maine guhera apni taraf khainch liya aur khaaya jabke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mujhe dekh rahe the.

e: Narrated Maimuna:A mouse fell into the butter-fat and died. The Prophet (ﷺ) was asked about that. He said, "Throw away the mouse and the butter-fat that surrounded it, and eat the rest of the butter-fat (As-Samn)
hi: Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ek chuha ghee mein gir kar mar gaya. Nabi (SAW) se iske baare mein pucha gaya. Unhone kaha, 'Chuhe ko aur uske aas-paas ke ghee ko phenk do, aur baaki ghee (As-Samn) khaao.'

e: Narrated Az-Zhuri:regarding an animal, e.g., a mouse or some other animal that had fallen into solid or liquid oil or butter-fat: I had been informed that a mouse had died in butter-fat whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered that the butter-fat near it be thrown away and the rest of the butter-fat can be eaten
hi: Az-Zuhri bataate hain, ek jaanwar (jaise chuha ya koi aur jaanwar) ke thos ya tarl tel ya ghee mein girne ke baare mein: 'Mujhe bataya gaya hai ke ek chuha ghee mein mar gaya tha, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne hukm diya ke uske aas-paas ka ghee phenk diya jaaye aur baaki ghee khaaya jaa sakta hai.'

e: Narrated Maimuna:The Prophet (ﷺ) was asked about a mouse that had fallen into butter-fat (and died). He said, "Throw away the mouse and the portion of butter-fat around it, and eat the rest
hi: Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) se ek chuhe ke baare mein pucha gaya jo ghee mein gir kar mar gaya tha. Unhone kaha, 'Chuhe aur uske aas-paas ke ghee ko phenk do, aur baaki khaao.'

e: Narrated Salim:that Ibn `Umar disliked the branding of animals on the face. Ibn `Umar said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade beating (animals) on the face
hi: Salim bataate hain: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) jaanwaron ke chehre par daagh lagaana napasand karte the. Ibn Umar ne kaha, 'Nabi (SAW) ne jaanwaron ke chehre par maarne se mana kiya tha.'

e: Narrated Anas:I brought a brother of mine to the Prophet (ﷺ) to do Tahnik for him while the Prophet (ﷺ) was in a sheep fold of his, and I saw him branding a sheep. (The sub-narrator said: I think Anas said, branding it on the ear)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main apne ek bhai ko Nabi (SAW) ke paas Tahnik karwaane laaya jabke Nabi (SAW) apne bakriyon ke baade mein the, aur maine unhein ek bakri par daagh lagaate dekha. (Ravi kehte hain: Mera khayaal hai Anas ne kaha ke kaan par daagh lagaaya.)

e: Narrated Rait' bin Khadij:I said to the Prophet, "We will be facing the enemy tomorrow and we have no knives (for slaughtering)' He said, "If you slaughter the animal with anything that causes its blood to flow out, and if Allah's Name is mentioned on slaughtering it, eat of it, unless the killing instrument is a tooth or nail. I will tell you why: As for the tooth, it is a bone; and as for the nail, it is the knife of Ethiopians." The quick ones among the people got the war booty while the Prophet (ﷺ) was behind the people. So they placed the cooking pots on the fire, but the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered the cooking pots to be turned upside down. Then he distributed (the war booty) among them, considering one camel as equal to ten sheep. Then a camel belonging to the first party of people ran away and they had no horses with them, so a man shot it with an arrow whereby Allah stopped it. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Of these animals there are some which are as wild as wild beasts. So, if anyone of them runs away like this, do like this (shoot it with an arrow)
hi: Rafi' bin Khadij (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) se kaha, 'Hum kal dushman ka saamna karenge aur hamare paas (zibah karne ke liye) chaqoo nahi hai.' Unhone kaha, 'Agar tum jaanwar ko kisi bhi aisi cheez se zibah karo jo uska khoon bahaaye, aur zibah karte waqt Allah ka naam liya gaya ho, to use khaao, siwaaye is ke ke zibah karne wala hathiyaar daant ya naakhoon ho. Main tumhein bataata hoon kyun: Daant ek haddi hai, aur naakhoon Habshiyon ka chaqoo hai.' Jaldi karne wale logon ne maal-e-ganimat le liya jabke Nabi (SAW) logon se peeche the. To unhone deg chulhe par rakh di, magar Nabi (SAW) ne hukm diya ke degein ulat di jaayein. Phir unhone (maal-e-ganimat) unke beech baanta, ek oont ko das bakriyon ke barabar maante hue. Phir pehle giroh ka ek oont bhaag gaya aur unke paas ghode nahi the, to ek shaks ne use teer se maara jispar Allah ne use rok diya. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Inmein se kuch jaanwar jangli jaanwaron jaise hote hain. To agar unmein se koi is tarah bhaag jaaye, to isi tarah karo (teer se maaro).'

e: Narrated Rafi` bin Khadij:While we were with the Prophet. on a journey, one of the camels ran away. A man shot it with an arrow and stopped it. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Of these camels some are as wild as wild beasts, so if one of them runs away and you cannot catch it, then do like this (shoot it with an arrow)." I said, "O Allah's Apostle! Sometimes when we are in battles or on a journey we want to slaughter (animals) but we have no knives." He said, "Listen! If you slaughter the animal with anything that causes its blood to flow out, and if Allah's Name is mentioned on slaughtering it, eat of it, provided that the slaughtering instrument is not a tooth or a nail, as the tooth is a bone and the nail is the knife of Ethiopians
hi: Rafi' bin Khadij (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab hum Nabi (SAW) ke saath safar mein the, oonton mein se ek bhaag gaya. Ek shaks ne use teer se maara aur rok diya. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Inmein se kuch oont jangli jaanwaron jaise hote hain, isliye agar unmein se koi bhaag jaaye aur tum use pakad na sako, to isi tarah karo (teer se maaro).' Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kabhi kabhi jab hum jang mein ya safar mein hote hain aur (jaanwar) zibah karna chahte hain magar hamare paas chaqoo nahi hota.' Unhone kaha, 'Suno! Agar tum jaanwar ko kisi bhi aisi cheez se zibah karo jo uska khoon bahaaye, aur zibah karte waqt Allah ka naam liya gaya ho, to use khaao, bashart-e ke zibah karne wala hathiyaar daant ya naakhoon na ho, kyunke daant ek haddi hai aur naakhoon Habshiyon ka chaqoo hai.'

e: Narrated Al-Bara:The Prophet (ﷺ) said (on the day of Idal-Adha), "The first thing we will do on this day of ours, is to offer the (`Id) prayer and then return to slaughter the sacrifice. Whoever does so, he acted according to our Sunna (tradition), and whoever slaughtered (the sacrifice) before the prayer, what he offered was just meat he presented to his family, and that will not be considered as Nusak (sacrifice)." (On hearing that) Abu Burda bin Niyar got up, for he had slaughtered the sacrifice before the prayer, and said, "I have got a six month old ram." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Slaughter it (as a sacrifice) but it will not be sufficient for any-one else (as a sacrifice after you). Al-Bara' added: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever slaughtered (the sacrifice) after the prayer, he slaughtered it at the right time and followed the tradition of the Muslims
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne (Eid-ul-Adha ke din) farmaya, 'Aaj ke din sabse pehle jo hum karenge wo Eid ki namaz padhna hai, phir wapas jaakar qurbaani zibah karna. Jo aisa kare, usne humaari Sunnat ke mutaabik amal kiya; aur jisne namaz se pehle zibah kiya, to jo usne pesh kiya wo bas apne khaandaan ke liye gosht tha, use qurbaani (Nusak) nahi maana jaayega.' (Ye sunkar) Abu Burda bin Niyar khade hue, kyunke unhone namaz se pehle zibah kiya tha, aur kaha, 'Mere paas chhe mahine ki ek mendhi hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ise (qurbaani ke taur par) zibah karo, magar ye tumhaare baad kisi aur ke liye kaafi nahi hogi.' Al-Bara ne aage kaha: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jisne namaz ke baad zibah kiya, usne sahi waqt par zibah kiya aur Musalmaanon ki riwaayat ki pairvi ki.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever slaughtered the sacrifice before the prayer, he just slaughtered it for himself, and whoever slaughtered it after the prayer, he slaughtered it at the right time and followed the tradition of the Muslims
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jisne namaz se pehle qurbaani zibah ki, usne bas apne liye zibah ki, aur jisne namaz ke baad zibah ki, usne sahi waqt par zibah ki aur Musalmaanon ki riwaayat ki pairvi ki.'

e: Narrated `Uqba bin 'Amir Al-Juhani:that the Prophet (ﷺ) distributed among his companions some animals for sacrifice (to be slaughtered on `Id-al-Adha). `Uqba's share was a Jadha'a (a six month old goat). `Uqba said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I get in my share of Jadha'a (a six month old ram)." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Slaughter it as a sacrifice
hi: Uqba bin Aamir Al-Juhani bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne apne sahaaba mein kuch jaanwar baante taake wo unhein Eid-ul-Adha par zibah karein. Uqba ka hissa ek Jadha'a (chhe mahine ki bakri) tha. Uqba ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe hisse mein Jadha'a (chhe mahine ki mendhi) mili hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ise qurbaani ke taur par zibah karo.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:that the Prophet (ﷺ) entered upon her when she had her menses at Sarif before entering Mecca, and she was weeping (because she was afraid that she would not be able to perform the Hajj). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "What is wrong with you? Have you got your period?" She said, "Yes." He said, "This is a matter Allah has decreed for all the daughters of Adam, so perform all the ceremonies of Hajj like the others, but do not perform the Tawaf around the Ka`ba." `Aisha added: When we were at Mina, beef was brought to me and I asked, "What is this?" They (the people) said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has slaughtered some cows as sacrifices on behalf of his wives
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain ke Nabi (SAW) unke paas aaye jab unhein Sarif mein, Makkah mein daakhil hone se pehle, haiz aaya hua tha, aur wo ro rahi thi (kyunke unhein dar tha ke wo Hajj poora nahi kar paayengi). Nabi (SAW) ne pucha, 'Tumhein kya hua? Kya tumhein haiz aaya hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan.' Unhone farmaya, 'Ye ek aisi baat hai jo Allah ne Aadam ki sab betiyon ke liye muqarrar ki hai, isliye Hajj ki sab rasmein doosron ki tarah karo, magar Kaaba ka Tawaf mat karo.' Aisha ne aage kaha: Jab hum Mina mein the, mere paas gaay ka gosht laaya gaya aur maine pucha, 'Ye kya hai?' Unhone (logon ne) kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apni biwiyon ki taraf se kuch gaayein qurbaani mein zibah ki hain.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said on the day of Nahr, "Whoever has slaughtered his sacrifice before the prayer, should repeat it (slaughter another sacrifice)." A man got up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! This is a day on which meat is desired." He then mentioned his neighbors saying, "I have a six month old ram which is to me better than the meat of two sheep." The Prophet (ﷺ) allowed him to slaughter it as a sacrifice, but I do not know whether this permission was valid for other than that man or not. The Prophet (ﷺ) then went towards two rams and slaughtered them, and then the people went towards some sheep and distributed them among themselves
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne Nahr ke din farmaya, 'Jisne apni qurbaani namaz se pehle zibah ki ho, use dobara (ek aur qurbaani) zibah karni chaahiye.' Ek shaks khada hua aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Ye aisa din hai jab gosht ki khwaahish hoti hai.'
