Phir unhone apne padosiyon ka zikr karte hue kaha, 'Mere paas ek chhe mahine ki mendhi hai jo mere liye do bakriyon ke gosht se behtar hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne unhein use qurbaani ke taur par zibah karne ki ijaazat di, magar mujhe nahi pata ke ye ijaazat us shaks ke ilaawa kisi aur ke liye jaayez thi ya nahi. Phir Nabi (SAW) do mendhon ki taraf gaye aur unhein zibah kiya, aur phir log kuch bakriyon ki taraf gaye aur unhein aapas mein baant liya.

e: Narrated Abu Bakra:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Time has come back to its original state which it had on the day Allah created the Heavens and the Earth. The year is twelve months, four of which are sacred, three of them are in succession, namely Dhul-Qa'da, Dhul Hijja and Muharram, (the fourth being) Rajab Mudar which is between Juma'da (ath-thamj and Sha'ban. The Prophet (ﷺ) then asked, "Which month is this?" We said, "Allah and his Apostle know better." He kept silent so long that we thought that he would call it by a name other than its real name. He said, "Isn't it the month of Dhul-Hijja?" We said, "Yes." He said, "Which town is this?" We said, "Allah and His Apostle know better." He kept silent so long that we thought that he would call it t,y a name other than its real name. He said, "isn't it the town (of Mecca)?" We replied, "Yes." He said, "What day is today?" We replied, "Allah and His Apostle know better." He kept silent so long that we thought that he would call it by a name other than its real name. He said, "Isn't it the day of Nahr?" We replied, "Yes." He then said, "Your blood, properties and honor are as sacred to one another as this day of yours in this town of yours in this month of yours. You will meet your Lord, and He will ask you about your deeds. Beware! Do not go astray after me by cutting the necks of each other. It is incumbent upon those who are present to convey this message to those who are absent, for some of those to whom it is conveyed may comprehend it better than some of those who have heard it directly." (Muhammad, the sub-narrator, on mentioning this used to say: The Prophet then said, "No doubt! Haven't I delivered (Allah's) Message (to you)? Haven't I delivered Allah's message (to you)?
hi: Abu Bakra (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Zamaana apni asal haalat mein laut aaya hai jaisa wo us din tha jab Allah ne aasman aur zameen banaaye. Saal barah mahine ka hota hai, jinmein se chaar mahine haram (mohtaram) hain, teen lagataar - Zul-Qa'da, Zul-Hijja aur Muharram - aur (chautha) Rajab Mudar, jo Jumada Al-Aakhira aur Shaban ke beech hai.' Phir Nabi (SAW) ne pucha, 'Ye kaunsa mahina hai?' Humne kaha, 'Allah aur uske Rasool behtar jaante hain.' Wo itni der khaamosh rahe ke humein laga wo isse iske asal naam ke ilaawa kisi aur naam se pukaarenge. Unhone farmaya, 'Kya ye Zul-Hijja ka mahina nahi hai?' Humne kaha, 'Haan.' Unhone pucha, 'Ye kaunsa shehar hai?' Humne kaha, 'Allah aur uske Rasool behtar jaante hain.' Wo itni der khaamosh rahe ke humein laga wo isse iske asal naam ke ilaawa kisi aur naam se pukaarenge. Unhone farmaya, 'Kya ye (Makkah) shehar nahi hai?' Humne jawab diya, 'Haan.' Unhone pucha, 'Aaj kaunsa din hai?' Humne jawab diya, 'Allah aur uske Rasool behtar jaante hain.' Wo itni der khaamosh rahe ke humein laga wo isse iske asal naam ke ilaawa kisi aur naam se pukaarenge. Unhone farmaya, 'Kya ye Nahr (qurbaani) ka din nahi hai?' Humne jawab diya, 'Haan.' Phir unhone farmaya, 'Tumhaara khoon, tumhaari jaayadaadein aur tumhaari izzat ek doosre ke liye utni hi mohtaram hain jitna ye din tumhaare is shehar mein, is mahine mein hai. Tum apne Rab se milogey, aur wo tumse tumhaare amaal ke baare mein poochega. Khabardaar! Mere baad ek doosre ki gardanein kaat kar gumraah mat ho jaana. Jo yahaan maujood hain unpar ye zaroori hai ke wo ye paighaam un tak pahunchaayein jo maujood nahi hain, kyunke jinhein ye pahunchaya jaata hai unmein se kuch ise usse behtar samajh sakte hain jinhone use seedhe suna hai.' (Ravi Muhammad, jab ye zikr karte the, kehte the: Nabi (SAW) ne phir farmaya, 'Kya shak hai! Kya maine (Allah ka) paighaam tum tak nahi pahunchaya? Kya maine Allah ka paighaam tum tak nahi pahunchaya?')

e: Narrated Nafi': 'Abdullah (bin 'Umar) used to slaughter his sacrifice at the slaughtering place (i.e the slaughtering place of the Prophet (ﷺ)
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) (bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ)) apni qurbaani zibah karne ki jagah par zibah kiya karte the (yaani Nabi SAW ki zibah karne ki jagah).

e: Ibn 'Umar said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to slaughter (camels and sheep, etc.,) as sacrifices at the Musalla
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) (oont aur bakri waghera) Musalla (Eid ki namaz ki jagah) par qurbaani ke taur par zibah kiya karte the.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to offer two rams as sacrifices, and I also used to offer two rams
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) do mendhe qurbaani ke taur par diya karte the, aur main bhi do mendhe diya karta tha.

e: Narrated Anas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came towards two horned rams having black and white colors and slaughtered them with his own hands
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) do seengon waale mendhon ki taraf gaye jo kaale aur safed rang ke the, aur unhein apne haathon se zibah kiya.

e: Narrated `Uqba bin 'Amir:that the Prophet (ﷺ) gave him some sheep to distribute among his companions to slaughter as sacrifices (`Id--al--Adha). A kid goat was left and he told the Prophet (ﷺ) of that whereupon he said to him, "Slaughter it as a sacrifice (on your behalf)
hi: Uqba bin Aamir bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne unhein kuch bakriyaan din taake wo unhein apne sahaaba mein Eid-ul-Adha ki qurbaani ke liye zibah karne ke liye baant dein. Ek bachcha bakri bach gayi aur unhone Nabi (SAW) ko iski khabar di, isper unhone unse kaha, 'Ise (apni taraf se) qurbaani ke taur par zibah kar do.'

e: Narrated Al-Bara' bin `Azib:An uncle of mine called Abu Burda, slaughtered his sacrifice before the `Id prayer. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him, "Your (slaughtered) sheep was just mutton (not a sacrifice)." Abu Burda said, "O Allah's Apostle! I have got a domestic kid goat." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Slaughter it (as a sacrifice) but it will not be permissible for anybody other than you" The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "Whoever slaughtered his sacrifice before the (`Id) prayer, he only slaughtered for himself, and whoever slaughtered it after the prayer, he offered his sacrifice properly and followed the tradition of the Muslims
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Mere chacha, Abu Burda, ne apni qurbaani Eid ki namaz se pehle zibah kar di. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha, 'Tumhaari (zibah ki hui) bakri to sirf gosht thi (qurbaani nahi).' Abu Burda ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mere paas ek ghar ki paali hui bachcha bakri hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ise (qurbaani ke taur par) zibah karo, magar ye tumhaare siwa kisi aur ke liye jaayez nahi hogi.' Nabi (SAW) ne aage kaha, 'Jisne apni qurbaani namaz se pehle zibah ki, usne bas apne liye zibah ki, aur jisne namaz ke baad zibah ki, usne apni qurbaani sahi tareeke se pesh ki aur Musalmaanon ki riwaayat ki pairvi ki.'

e: Narrated Al-Bara':Abu Burda slaughtered (the sacrifice) before the (`Id) prayer whereupon the Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "Slaughter another sacrifice instead of that." Abu Burda said, "I have nothing except a Jadha'a." (Shu`ba said: Perhaps Abu Burda also said that Jadha'a was better than an old sheep in his opinion.) The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "(Never mind), slaughter it to make up for the other one, but it will not be sufficient for anyone else after you
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Abu Burda ne namaz se pehle zibah kiya, isper Nabi (SAW) ne unse kaha, 'Iski jagah ek aur qurbaani zibah karo.' Abu Burda ne kaha, 'Mere paas Jadha'a ke siwa kuch nahi hai.' (Ravi Shu'ba kehte hain: Shaayad Abu Burda ne ye bhi kaha ke unki raay mein Jadha'a ek purani bakri se behtar hai.) Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, '(Koi baat nahi), ise doosri ki bharpaai ke liye zibah karo, magar ye tumhaare baad kisi aur ke liye kaafi nahi hogi.'

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) slaughtered two rams, black and white in color (as sacrifices), and I saw him putting his foot on their sides and mentioning Allah's Name and Takbir (Allahu Akbar). Then he slaughtered them with his own hands
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne do mendhe, kaale aur safed rang ke, (qurbaani ke taur par) zibah kiye, aur maine unhein unke pehlu par apna pair rakh kar, Allah ka naam aur Takbeer (Allahu Akbar) kehte dekha. Phir unhone unhein apne haathon se zibah kiya.

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered upon me at Sarif while I was weeping (because I was afraid that I would not be able to perform the ,Hajj). He said, "What is wrong with you? Have you got your period?" I replied, "Yes." He said, "This is a matter Allah has decreed for all the daughters of Adam, so perform the ceremonies of the Hajj as the pilgrims do, but do not perform the Tawaf around the Ka`ba." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) slaughtered some cows as sacrifices on behalf of his wives
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mere paas Sarif mein aaye jabke main ro rahi thi (kyunke mujhe dar tha ke main Hajj poora nahi kar paaungi). Unhone pucha, 'Tumhein kya hua? Kya tumhein haiz aaya hai?' Maine kaha, 'Haan.' Unhone farmaya, 'Ye ek aisi baat hai jo Allah ne Aadam ki sab betiyon ke liye muqarrar ki hai, isliye Hajj ki wo sab rasmein karo jo haaji karte hain, magar Kaaba ka Tawaf mat karo.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apni biwiyon ki taraf se kuch gaayein qurbaani mein zibah ki.

e: Narrated Al-Bara':I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) delivering a sermon, and he said (on the Day of `Id-Allah. a), "The first thing we will do on this day of ours is that we will offer the `Id prayer, then we will return and slaughter our sacrifices; and whoever does so, then indeed he has followed our tradition, and whoever slaughtered his sacrifice (before the prayer), what he offered was just meat that he presented to his family, and that was not a sacrifice." Abu Burda got up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I slaughtered the sacrifice before the prayer and I have got a Jadha'a which is better than an old sheep." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Slaughter it to make up for that, but it will not be sufficient for anybody else after you
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko khutba dete suna, aur unhone (Eid-ul-Adha ke din) kaha, 'Aaj ke din sabse pehle jo hum karenge wo Eid ki namaz padhna hai, phir hum wapas jaakar apni qurbaani zibah karenge; aur jo aisa kare, usne waaqai humaari riwaayat ki pairvi ki hai, aur jisne (namaz se pehle) apni qurbaani zibah ki, to jo usne pesh kiya wo bas apne khaandaan ke liye gosht tha, wo qurbaani nahi thi.' Abu Burda khade hue aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Maine namaz se pehle qurbaani zibah ki thi, aur mere paas ek Jadha'a hai jo ek purani bakri se behtar hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ise uski bharpaai ke liye zibah karo, magar ye tumhaare baad kisi aur ke liye kaafi nahi hogi.'

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever slaughtered the sacrifice before the `Id prayer, should repeat it (slaughter another one)." A man said "This is the day on which meat is desired." Then he mentioned the need of his neighbors (for meat) and the Prophet (ﷺ) seemed to accept his excuse. The man said, "I have a Jadha'a which is to me better than two sheep." The Prophet (ﷺ) allowed him (to slaughter it as a sacrifice). But I do not know whether this permission was general for all Muslims or not. The Prophet (ﷺ) then went towards two rams and slaughtered them, and the people went towards their sheep and slaughtered them
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jisne Eid ki namaz se pehle qurbaani zibah ki ho, use dobara (ek aur) zibah karni chaahiye.' Ek shaks ne kaha, 'Ye aisa din hai jab gosht ki khwaahish hoti hai.' Phir unhone apne padosiyon ki zaroorat (gosht ki) ka zikr kiya aur Nabi (SAW) ne unki mazrat qubool kar li lagi. Us shaks ne kaha, 'Mere paas ek Jadha'a hai jo mere liye do bakriyon se behtar hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne unhein (use qurbaani ke taur par zibah karne ki) ijaazat di. Magar mujhe nahi pata ke ye ijaazat sab Musalmaanon ke liye aam thi ya nahi. Phir Nabi (SAW) do mendhon ki taraf gaye aur unhein zibah kiya, aur log apni bakriyon ki taraf gaye aur unhein zibah kiya.

e: Narrated Jundab bin Sufyan Al-Bajali:I witnessed the Prophet (ﷺ) on the Day of Nahr. He said, "Whoever slaughtered the sacrifice before offering the `Id prayer, should slaughter another sacrifice in its place; and whoever has not slaughtered their sacrifice yet, should slaughter now
hi: Jundab bin Sufyan Al-Bajali bataate hain: Maine Nahr ke din Nabi (SAW) ko dekha. Unhone farmaya, 'Jisne Eid ki namaz se pehle apni qurbaani zibah ki ho, use uski jagah ek aur qurbaani zibah karni chaahiye; aur jisne abhi tak apni qurbaani zibah nahi ki, use ab zibah karni chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Al-Bara':One day Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) offered the `Id prayer and said, "Whoever offers our prayer and faces our Qibla should not slaughter the sacrifice till he finishes the `Id prayer." Abu Burda bin Niyar got up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have already done it. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "That is something you have done before its due time." Abu Burda said, "I have a Jadha'a which is better than two old sheep; shall I slaughter it?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Yes, but it will not be sufficient for anyone after you
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Ek din Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Eid ki namaz padhaayi aur kaha, 'Jo hamaari namaz padhe aur hamaare Qibla ki taraf muh kare, use apni qurbaani tab tak zibah nahi karni chaahiye jab tak Eid ki namaz khatam na ho jaaye.' Abu Burda bin Niyar khade hue aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Maine ye pehle hi kar diya hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Wo to tumne apne muqarrar waqt se pehle hi kar diya.' Abu Burda ne kaha, 'Mere paas ek Jadha'a hai jo do purani bakriyon se behtar hai; kya main use zibah karoon?' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Haan, magar ye tumhaare baad kisi aur ke liye kaafi nahi hogi.'

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to offer as sacrifices, two horned rams, black and white in color, and used to put his foot on their sides and slaughter them with his own hands
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) do seengon waale mendhe, kaale aur safed rang ke, qurbaani ke taur par diya karte the, aur unke pehlu par apna pair rakh kar unhein apne haathon se zibah karte the.

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) offered as sacrifices, two horned rams, black and white in color. He slaughtered them with his own hands and mentioned Allah's Name over them and said Takbir and put his foot on their sides
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne do seengon waale mendhe, kaale aur safed rang ke, qurbaani ke taur par diye. Unhone unhein apne haathon se zibah kiya aur unpar Allah ka naam liya aur Takbeer kahi, aur unke pehlu par apna pair rakha.

e: Narrated Masruq:that he came to `Aisha and said to her, "O Mother of the Believers! There is a man who sends a Hadi to Ka`ba and stays in his city and requests that his Hadi camel be garlanded while he remains in a state of Ihram from that day till the people finish their Ihram (after completing all the ceremonies of Hajj)" (What do you say about it?) Masruq added, I heard the clapping of her hands behind the curtain. She said, "I used to twist the garlands for the Hadi of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he used to send his Hadi to Ka`ba but he never used to regard as unlawful what was lawful for men to do with their wives till the people returned (from the Hajj)
hi: Masruq bataate hain: Wo Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas aaye aur unse kaha, 'Aye Ummul-Momineen! Ek aadmi hai jo Kaaba ke liye Hadi (qurbaani ka jaanwar) bhejta hai aur khud apne shehar mein rehta hai, aur chahta hai ke uske Hadi oont ko haar pehnaaya jaaye jabke wo khud us din se Ihram ki haalat mein rahe jab tak log apna Ihram khatam na kar lein (Hajj ki saari rasmein poori karne ke baad) - (aap iske baare mein kya kehti hain?)' Masruq ne aage kaha: Maine parde ke peechhe unke haath thapthapaane ki aawaaz suni. Unhone kaha, 'Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke Hadi ke liye haar bunti thi, aur wo apna Hadi Kaaba bhejte the, magar wo kabhi apni biwiyon ke saath wo cheezein haraam nahi maante the jo mardon ke liye jaayez hain, jab tak log (Hajj se) wapas nahi aa jaate.'

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:During the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) we used to take with us the meat of the sacrifices (of Id al Adha) to Medina. (The narrator often said. The meat of the Hadi)
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ki zindagi mein hum Eid-ul-Adha ki qurbaani ka gosht Madina le jaaya karte the. (Ravi aksar 'Hadi ka gosht' kehte the.)

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:that once he was not present (at the time of `Id-al-Adha) and when he came. some meat was presented to him. and the people said (to him), 'This is the meat of our sacrifices" He said. 'Take it away; I shall not taste it. (In his narration) Abu Sa`id added: I got up and went to my brother, Abu Qatada (who was his maternal brother and was one of the warriors of the battle of Badr) and mentioned that to him He Sa`d. 'A new verdict was given in your absence (i.e., meat of sacrifices was allowed to be stored and eaten later on)
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar wo Eid-ul-Adha ke waqt maujood nahi the, aur jab wo aaye, unhein kuch gosht pesh kiya gaya, aur logon ne (unse) kaha, 'Ye hamari qurbaaniyon ka gosht hai.' Unhone kaha, 'Ise le jaao; main ise nahi chakhunga.' Abu Saeed ne aage kaha: Main uthaa aur apne bhai, Abu Qatada (رضی اللہ عنہ) (jo unke maadari bhai the aur jang-e-Badr ke jaanbaazon mein se the), ke paas gaya aur unhein ye baat bataayi. Unhone kaha, 'Tumhaari gair-maujoodgi mein ek naya faisla diya gaya tha (yaani qurbaani ke gosht ko rakhne aur baad mein khaane ki ijaazat di gayi thi).'

e: Narrated Salama bin Al-Aqua':The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever has slaughtered a sacrifice should not keep anything of Its meat after three days." When it was the next year the people said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shall we do as we did last year?" He said, ' Eat of it and feed of it to others and store of it for in that year the people were having a hard time and I wanted you to help (the needy)
hi: Salama bin Al-Aqwa bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jisne bhi qurbaani zibah ki ho, use teen din baad uska gosht apne paas nahi rakhna chaahiye.' Jab agla saal aaya, logon ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya hum wahi karein jo humne pichhle saal kiya tha?' Unhone kaha, 'Ise khaao, doosron ko khilaao, aur (kuch) jama karo, kyunke us saal log mushkil daur se guzar rahe the aur main chahta tha ke tum (zaroorat-mandon ki) madad karo.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:We used to salt some of the meat of sacrifice and present it to the Prophet (ﷺ) at Medina. Once he said, "Do not eat (of that meat) for more than three days." That was not a final order, but (that year) he wanted us to feed of it to others, Allah knows better
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Hum qurbaani ke kuch gosht mein namak lagaate the aur Madina mein Nabi (SAW) ko pesh karte the. Ek baar unhone kaha, 'Teen din se zyaada mat khaao.' Ye koi aakhri hukm nahi tha, balke (us saal) wo chahte the ke hum doosron ko khilaayein, Allah behtar jaanta hai.

e: Narrated Abu `Ubaid:the freed slave of Ibn Azhar that he witnessed the Day of `Id-al-Adha with `Umar bin Al-Khattab. `Umar offered the `Id prayer before the sermon and then delivered the sermon before the people, saying, "O people! Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has forbidden you to fast (on the first day of) each of these two 'Ida, for one of them is the Day of breaking your fast, and the other is the one, on which you eat the meat of your sacrifices
hi: Abu Ubaid, Ibn Azhar ke azaad kiye ghulaam, bataate hain: Unhone Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab ke saath Eid-ul-Adha ka din dekha. Umar ne khutba se pehle Eid ki namaz padhaayi, phir logon ke saamne khutba diya, kaha, 'Aye logo! Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne tumhein in dono Eidon mein se har ek ke (pehle) din roza rakhne se mana kiya hai, kyunke ek roza tod-ne ka din hai, aur doosra wo din hai jab tum apni qurbaani ka gosht khaate ho.'

e: Narrated Abu `Ubaid:(in continuation of above). Then I witnessed the `Id with `Uthman bin `Affan, and that was on a Friday. He offered the prayer before the sermon, saying, "O people! Today you have two 'Its (festivals) together, so whoever of those who live at Al-`Awali (suburbs) would like to wait for the Jumua prayer, he may wait, and whoever would like to return (home) Is granted my permission to do so
hi: Abu Ubaid bataate hain (upar ki riwayat ka silsila): Phir maine Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Affan ke saath Eid dekhi, aur wo Jumme ke din thi. Unhone khutba se pehle namaz padhaayi, kaha, 'Aye logo! Aaj tumhaari do Eidein ikattha hui hain, isliye jo Al-Awali (upnagar) mein rehte hain aur Jumme ki namaz ke liye rukna chahein, wo ruk sakte hain, aur jo wapas jaana chahein, unhein meri taraf se ijaazat hai.'

e: Narrated Abu `Ubaid:(in continuation of above). Then I witnessed (the 'Its) with `Ali bin Abi Talib, and he too offered the `Id prayer before the sermon and then delivered the sermon before the people and said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has forbidden you to eat the meat of your sacrifices for more than three days
hi: Abu Ubaid bataate hain (silsila jaari): Phir maine Ali (Alayhis Salam) bin Abi Talib ke saath Eidein dekhi, aur unhone bhi khutba se pehle Eid ki namaz padhaayi, phir logon ke saamne khutba diya aur kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne tumhein apni qurbaani ka gosht teen din se zyaada khaane se mana kiya hai.'

e: Narrated Salim:`Abdullah bin `Umar said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Eat of the meat of sacrifices (of `Id al Adha) for three days." When `Abdullah departed from Mina, he used to eat (bread with) oil, lest he should eat of the meat of Hadi (which is regarded as unlawful after the three days of the `Id)
hi: Salim bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, "Eid-ul-Adha ki qurbaani ka gosht teen din tak khaao."' Jab Abdullah Mina se rawaana hote, wo (roti ke saath) tel khaate the, kahin unhein Hadi ka gosht (jo Eid ke teen din baad haraam samjha jaata tha) na khaana pade.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever drinks alcoholic drinks in the world and does not repent (before dying), will be deprived of it in the Hereafter
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi duniya mein sharaab piye aur (mrityu se pehle) tauba na kare, use Aakhirat mein uska (Jannat ki sharaab ka) mehroom kar diya jaayega.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:On the night Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was taken on a night journey (Miraj) two cups, one containing wine and the other milk, were presented to him at Jerusalem. He looked at it and took the cup of milk. Gabriel said, "Praise be to Allah Who guided you to Al-Fitra (the right path); if you had taken (the cup of) wine, your nation would have gone astray
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jis raat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko raat ki mairaj (Miraj) par le jaaya gaya, Yerusalem mein unke saamne do pyaale pesh kiye gaye, ek sharaab ka aur ek doodh ka. Unhone dekha aur doodh ka pyaala liya. Jibrael ne kaha, 'Allah ka shukr hai jisne aapko Fitra (seedhi fitrat) ki taraf hidaayat di; agar aapne sharaab ka (pyaala) liya hota, to aapki ummat gumraah ho jaati.'

e: Narrated Anas:I heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) a narration which none other than I will narrate to you. The Prophet, said, "From among the portents of the our are the following: General ignorance (in religious affairs) will prevail, (religious) knowledge will decrease, illegal sexual intercourse will prevail, alcoholic drinks will be drunk (in abundance), men will decrease and women will increase so much so that for every fifty women there will be one man to look after them
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ek riwaayat suni jo mere siwa koi tumhein nahi sunaayega. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Qayamat ki nishaaniyon mein se ye hain: Aam jahaalat (deeni maamlon mein) chha jaayegi, (deeni) ilm kam ho jaayega, zina aam ho jaayega, sharaab (bahut zyaada) pi jaayegi, mard kam ho jaayenge aur auraten itni badh jaayengi ke pachaas auraton ki dekhbhaal karne ke liye sirf ek mard hoga.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "An adulterer, at the time he is committing illegal sexual intercourse is not a believer; and a person, at the time of drinking an alcoholic drink is not a believer; and a thief, at the time of stealing, is not a believer." Ibn Shihab said: `Abdul Malik bin Abi Bakr bin `Abdur-Rahman bin Al- Harith bin Hisham told me that Abu Bakr used to narrate that narration to him on the authority of Abu Huraira. He used to add that Abu Bakr used to mention, besides the above cases, "And he who robs (takes illegally something by force) while the people are looking at him, is not a believer at the time he is robbing (taking)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Zina karne wala zina karte waqt momin nahi hota; aur sharaab peene wala sharaab peete waqt momin nahi hota; aur chor chori karte waqt momin nahi hota.' Ravi Ibn Shihab kehte hain: Abdul Malik bin Abi Bakr bin Abdur Rahman bin Al-Harith bin Hisham ne mujhe bataya ke Abu Bakr unhein ye riwaayat Abu Huraira ke hawaale se sunaaya karte the. Wo ye bhi kehte the ke Abu Bakr, upar wale maamlon ke ilaawa, ye bhi kehte the, 'Aur jo koi (logon ke saamne khule aam zabardasti kuch le le) daakedaali kare jabke log use dekh rahe hon, wo daakedaali karte waqt momin nahi hota.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:"Alcoholic drinks were prohibited (by Allah) when there was nothing of it (special kind of wine) in Medina
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Sharaab tab haraam ki gayi jab Madina mein us khaas kism ki sharaab ka koi wajood hi nahi tha.

e: Narrated Anas:"Alcoholic drinks were prohibited at the time we could rarely find wine made from grapes in Medina, for most of our liquors were made from unripe and ripe dates
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Sharaab us waqt haraam ki gayi jab humein Madina mein angoor se banaayi gayi sharaab kam hi milti thi, kyunke hamaari zyaadatar sharaabein kachi aur pakki khajooron se banaayi jaati thin.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:`Umar stood up on the pulpit and said, "Now then, prohibition of alcoholic drinks have been revealed, and these drinks are prepared from five things, i.e.. grapes, dates, honey, wheat or barley And an alcoholic drink is that, that disturbs the mind
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Umar mimbar par khade hue aur kaha, 'Ab, sharaab ki mumaaniyat naazil ho chuki hai, aur ye sharaaben paanch cheezon se banaayi jaati hain: angoor, khajoor, shehad, gehun ya jau. Aur sharaab wo cheez hai jo dimaag ko khalal daale.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:I was serving Abu 'Ubaida, Abu Talha and Ubai bin Ka`b with a drink prepared from ripe and unripe dates. Then somebody came to them and said, "Alcoholic drinks have been prohibited." (On hearing that) Abu Talha said, "Get up. O Anas, and pour (throw) it out! So I poured (threw) it out
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Abu Ubaida, Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Ubai bin Ka'b (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki khidmat mein pakki aur kachi khajoor se banaayi gayi ek sharbat pila raha tha. Phir kisi ne unke paas aakar kaha, 'Sharaab haraam ho gayi hai.' (Ye sunkar) Abu Talha ne kaha, 'Utho, Aye Anas, aur ise (bahar) phenk do!' To maine use phenk diya.

e: Narrated Anas:While I was waiting on my uncles and serving them with (wine prepared from) dates----and I was the youngest of them----it was said, "Alcoholic drinks have been prohibited." So they said (to me), "Throw it away." So I threw it away
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab main apne chachaon ki khidmat kar raha tha aur unhein khajoor se banaayi gayi sharaab pila raha tha - aur main unmein sabse chhota tha - kaha gaya, 'Sharaab haraam ho gayi hai.' To unhone (mujhse) kaha, 'Ise phenk do.' To maine ise phenk diya.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Alcoholic drinks were prohibited. At that time these drinks used to be prepared from unripe and ripe dates
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Sharaab haraam ki gayi. Us waqt ye sharaaben kachi aur pakki khajooron se taiyaar ki jaati thin.

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked about Al-Bit. He said, "All drinks that intoxicate are unlawful (to drink)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se Al-Bit'a ke baare mein pucha gaya. Unhone kaha, 'Jo bhi peene ki cheez nasha de, wo (peena) haraam hai.'

e: Narrated 'Aisha: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked about Al-Bit a liquor prepared from honey which the Yemenites used to drink. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "All drinks that intoxicate are unlawful (to drink)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se Al-Bit'a, shehad se banaayi jaane wali sharaab jo Yemen waale piya karte the, ke baare mein pucha gaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo bhi peene ki cheez nasha de, wo (peena) haraam hai.'

e: Anas bin Malik said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Do not make drinks in Ad-Dubba' nor in Al-Muzaffat. Abu Huraira used to add to them Al-Hantam and An-Naqir
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ad-Dubba (kadduu ke khaal ke bartan) aur Al-Muzaffat (tar-poti hui matki) mein sharaab mat banaao.' Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) inmein Al-Hantam (hari matki) aur An-Naqir (khokhli lakdi ka bartan) bhi izaafa karte the.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:`Umar delivered a sermon on the pulpit of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), saying, "Alcoholic drinks were prohibited by Divine Order, and these drinks used to be prepared from five things, i.e., grapes, dates, wheat, barley and honey. Alcoholic drink is that, that disturbs the mind." `Umar added, "I wish Allah's Apostle had not left us before he had given us definite verdicts concerning three matters, i.e., how much a grandfather may inherit (of his grandson), the inheritance of Al-Kalala (the deceased person among whose heirs there is no father or son), and various types of Riba(1 ) (usury)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke mimbar par khutba diya aur kaha, 'Sharaab ko Ilaahi hukm se haraam kiya gaya hai, aur ye sharaaben paanch cheezon se taiyaar ki jaati hain: angoor, khajoor, gehun, jau aur shehad. Sharaab wo cheez hai jo dimaag ko khalal daale.' Umar ne aage kaha, 'Kaash Allah ke Rasool (SAW) humein chhod kar jaane se pehle teen maamlon mein saaf faisla de dete: dada apne pote se kitni miraas paayega, Al-Kalala (marne wala jiske waaris mein na baap na beta ho) ki miraas, aur sood ki alag alag qismein.'

e: Narrated 'Umar: "Alcoholic drinks are prepared from five things, i.e., raisins, dates. wheat, barley and honey
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Sharaab paanch cheezon se taiyaar ki jaati hai: kishmish, khajoor, gehun, jau, aur shehad.

e: Narrated Abu 'Amir or Abu Malik Al-Ash'ari: that he heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "From among my followers there will be some people who will consider illegal sexual intercourse, the wearing of silk, the drinking of alcoholic drinks and the use of musical instruments, as lawful. And there will be some people who will stay near the side of a mountain and in the evening their shepherd will come to them with their sheep and ask them for something, but they will say to him, 'Return to us tomorrow.' Allah will destroy them during the night and will let the mountain fall on them, and He will transform the rest of them into monkeys and pigs and they will remain so till the Day of Resurrection
hi: Abu Aamir ya Abu Malik Al-Ashari bataate hain: Unhone Nabi (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Mere maanne walon mein se kuch log honge jo zina, resham pehanna, sharaab peena, aur baaje bajaane ko jaayez samjhenge. Aur kuch log honge jo kisi pahaad ke kinaare aake rahenge, aur shaam ko unka charwaaha apni bakriyon ke saath unke paas aayega aur unse kuch maangega, magar wo usse kahenge, "Kal humaare paas wapas aana." Allah unhein raat ke waqt tabaah karega aur pahaad ko unpar gira dega, aur baaki logon ko bandar aur suar bana dega, aur wo Qayamat tak isi haal mein rahenge.'

e: Narrated Sahl:Abu Usaid As-Sa`idi came and invited Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the occasion of his wedding. His wife who was the bride, was serving them. Do you know what drink she prepared for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ? She had soaked some dates in water in a Tur overnight
hi: Sahl bataate hain: Abu Usaid As-Sa'idi aaye aur apni shaadi ke mauqe par Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko dawat di. Unki biwi, jo dulhan thi, unki khidmat kar rahi thi. Kya tumhein pata hai unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke liye kaunsa sharbat taiyaar kiya tha? Unhone raat bhar kuch khajoorein ek Tur (bartan) mein paani mein bhigo kar rakhi thin.

e: Narrated Jabir:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the use of (certain) containers, but the Ansar said, "We cannot dispense with them." The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "If so, then use them
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kuch (khaas) bartanon ke istemaal se mana kiya, magar Ansaar ne kaha, 'Hum inke bagair kaam nahi chala sakte.' Nabi (SAW) ne phir farmaya, 'Agar aisa hai, to inhein istemaal karo.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:When the Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the use of certain containers (that were used for preparing alcoholic drinks), somebody said to the Prophet (ﷺ) . "But not all the people can find skins." So he allowed them to use clay jars not covered with pitch
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Nabi (SAW) ne (sharaab banaane ke liye istemaal hone waale) kuch khaas bartanon se mana kiya, kisi ne Nabi (SAW) se kaha, 'Magar sab logon ke paas khaal ke bartan nahi milte.' To unhone unhein tar-poti na hui mitti ki matkiyaan istemaal karne ki ijaazat de di.

e: Narrated `Ali:the Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the use of Ad-Dubba' and Al Muzaffat. A'mash also narrated this
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne Ad-Dubba aur Al-Muzaffat (ke istemaal) se mana kiya. Ravi A'mash ne bhi ye riwaayat ki hai.

e: Narrated Ibrahim:I asked Al-Aswad, "Did you ask `Aisha, Mother of the Believers, about the containers in which it is disliked to prepare (non-alcoholic) drinks?" He said, "Yes, I said to her, 'O Mother of the Believers! What containers did the Prophet (ﷺ) forbid to use for preparing (non-alcoholic) drinks?" She said, 'The Prophet forbade us, (his family), to prepare (non-alcoholic) drinks in Ad-Dubba and Al-Muzaffat.' I asked, 'Didn't you mention Al Jar and Al Hantam?' She said, 'I tell what I have heard; shall I tell you what I have not heard?
hi: Ibrahim bataate hain: Maine Al-Aswad se pucha, 'Kya aapne Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا), Ummul-Momineen, se un bartanon ke baare mein pucha jinmein (bagair sharaab wale) sharbat banaana napasand kiya jaata hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan, maine unse pucha, "Aye Ummul-Momineen! Nabi (SAW) ne kaunse bartanon mein (bagair sharaab wale) sharbat banaane se mana kiya?" Unhone kaha, "Nabi (SAW) ne humein (apne khaandaan ko) Ad-Dubba aur Al-Muzaffat mein sharbat banaane se mana kiya." Maine pucha, "Aapne Al-Jar aur Al-Hantam ka zikr nahi kiya?" Unhone kaha, "Main wahi bataati hoon jo maine suna hai; kya main tumhein wo bhi bataun jo maine nahi suna?"'

e: Narrated Ash-Shaibani:I heard `Abdullah bin Abi `Aufa saying, "The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the use of green jars." I said, "Shall we drink out of white jars?" He said, "No
hi: Ash-Shaibani bataate hain: Maine Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Aufa ko ye kehte suna, 'Nabi (SAW) ne hare matkon ke istemaal se mana kiya.' Maine pucha, 'Kya hum safed matkon mein pee sakte hain?' Unhone kaha, 'Nahi.'

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:Abu Usaid As Sa`idi invited the Prophet (ﷺ) to his wedding banquet. At that time his wife was serving them and she was the bride. She said, ''Do you know what (kind of syrup) I soaked (made) for Allah's Apostle? I soaked some dates in water in a Tur (bowl) overnight
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Usaid As-Sa'idi ne Nabi (SAW) ko apni shaadi ki dawat par bulaaya. Us waqt unki biwi unki khidmat kar rahi thi aur wahi dulhan thi. Unhone kaha, 'Kya aapko pata hai maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke liye kya sharbat bhigo kar (taiyaar) kiya? Maine kuch khajoorein raat bhar ek Tur (bartan) mein paani mein bhigo kar rakhi thin.'

e: Narrated Abu Al-Juwairiyya:I asked Ibn `Abbas about Al-Badhaq. He said, "Muhammad prohibited alcoholic drinks before It was called Al-Badhaq (by saying), 'Any drink that intoxicates is unlawful.' I said, 'What about good lawful drinks?' He said,'Apart from what is lawful and good, all other things are unlawful and not good (unclean Al-Khabith)
hi: Abu Al-Juwairiyya bataate hain: Maine Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se Al-Badhaq ke baare mein pucha. Unhone kaha, 'Muhammad (SAW) ne sharaab ko us se pehle hi haraam kar diya tha jab ise Al-Badhaq kaha jaata tha, (ye kehte hue) "Jo bhi peene ki cheez nasha de, wo haraam hai."' Maine pucha, 'Achhi, jaayez cheezon ka kya?' Unhone kaha, 'Jo jaayez aur achha hai uske ilaawa baaki sab cheezein haraam aur nahi achhi (napaak) hain.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to like sweet edible things and honey
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) meethi cheezein aur shehad pasand karte the.

e: Narrated Anas:While I was serving Abu Talha. Abu Dujana and Abu Suhail bin Al-Baida' with a drink made from a mixture of unripe and ripe dates, alcoholic drinks, were made unlawful, whereupon I threw it away, and I was their butler and the youngest of them, and we used to consider that drink as an alcoholic drink in those days
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab main Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ), Abu Dujana aur Abu Suhail bin Al-Baida ko kachi aur pakki khajoor ke mile-jule sharbat se pila raha tha, sharaab ko haraam kar diya gaya, isper maine use phenk diya. Main unka saqi (pilaane wala) tha aur unmein sabse chhota tha, aur us zamaane mein hum us sharbat ko sharaab hi maante the.

e: Narrated Jabir:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the drinking of alcoholic drinks prepared from raisins, dates, unripe dates and fresh ripe dates
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne kishmish, khajoor, kachi khajoor aur taazi pakki khajoor se banaayi jaane wali sharaab peene se mana kiya.

e: Narrated Abu Qatada:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the mixing of ripe and unripe dates and also the mixing of dates and raisins (for preparing a syrup) but the syrup of each kind of fruit should be prepared separately. ( One may have such drinks as long as it is fresh)
hi: Abu Qatada (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne pakki aur kachi khajoor ko milaakar, aur khajoor aur kishmish ko milaakar sharbat banaane se mana kiya, balke har phal ka sharbat alag alag banaaya jaana chaahiye. (Ye peya ja sakta hai jab tak wo taaza ho.)

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was presented a bowl of milk and a bowl of wine on the night he was taken on a journey (Al-Mi'raj)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko us raat, jab unhein Al-Mi'raj ke safar par le jaaya gaya, doodh ka ek katora aur sharaab ka ek katora pesh kiya gaya.

e: Narrated Um Al-Fadl:The people doubted whether Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was fasting or the Day of `Arafat or not. So I sent a cup containing milk to him and he drank it
hi: Umm Al-Fadl bataati hain: Logon ko shak tha ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Arafat ke din roza rakhe hue hain ya nahi. To maine unke paas doodh se bhara ek pyaala bheja, aur unhone use piya.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:Abu Humaid brought a cup of mix from a place called Al-Naqi. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him, "Will you not cover it, even by placing a stick across its
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Humaid ek jagah, Al-Naqi, se doodh ka ek pyaala laaye. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha, 'Kya tum ise dhaankte nahi, chaahe ek lakdi hi uske aar-paar rakh do?'

e: Narrated Jabir:Abu Humaid, an Ansari man, came from AnNaqi carrying a cup of milk to the Prophet. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Will you not cover it even by placing a stick across it?
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Humaid, ek Ansaari aadmi, Al-Naqi se ek pyaala doodh lekar Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Kya tum ise dhaankte nahi, chaahe ek lakdi hi uske aar-paar rakh do?'

e: Narrated Al-Bara:The Prophet (ﷺ) came from Mecca with Abu Bakr. Abu Bakr said "We passed by a shepherd and at that time Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was thirsty. I milked a little milk in a bowl and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) drank till I was pleased. Suraqa bin Ju'shum came to us riding a horse (chasing us). The Prophet (ﷺ) invoked evil upon him, whereupon Suraqa requested him not to invoke evil upon him, in which case he would go back. The Prophet (ﷺ) agreed
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) Makkah se Abu Bakr ke saath aaye. Abu Bakr ne kaha, 'Hum ek charwaahe ke paas se guzre, aur us waqt Allah ke Rasool (SAW) pyaase the. Maine ek katore mein thoda doodh dooha aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne piya yahaan tak ke main khush ho gaya. Suraqa bin Ju'shum ghode par sawaar hokar (humaara peecha karte hue) hamare paas aaya. Nabi (SAW) ne uske khilaaf bad-dua ki, isper Suraqa ne guzaarish ki ke unke khilaaf bad-dua na karein, is soorat mein wo wapas chala jaayega. Nabi (SAW) ne maan liya.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The best object of charity is a she-camel which has (newly) given birth and gives plenty of milk, or a she-goat which gives plenty of milk; and is given to somebody to utilize its milk by milking one bowl in the morning and one in the evening
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Sabse behtareen sadqa wo oontni hai jisne naya bacha paida hua ho aur bahut doodh deti ho, ya wo bakri jo bahut doodh deti ho, aur jise kisi ko iske doodh ka faayda uthaane ke liye di jaaye - subah ek katora doodh nikaal kar aur shaam ko ek katora.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) drank milk and then rinsed his mouth and said, "It contains fat
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne doodh piya, phir kulla kiya aur kaha, 'Ismein charbi (chikanaai) hoti hai.'

e: The Prophet (ﷺ) added:I was raised to the Lote Tree and saw four rivers, two of which were coming out and two going in. Those which were coming out were the Nile and the Euphrates, and those which were going in were two rivers in paradise. Then I was given three bowls, one containing milk, and another containing honey, and a third containing wine. I took the bowl containing milk and drank it. It was said to me, "You and your followers will be on the right path (of Islam)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne aage kaha: 'Mujhe Sidrat-ul-Muntaha (Lote Tree) tak le jaaya gaya aur maine chaar nadiyaan dekhi, jinmein se do bahar nikal rahi thin aur do andar jaa rahi thin. Jo bahar nikal rahi thin wo Neel aur Furat (Euphrates) thin, aur jo andar jaa rahi thin wo Jannat ki do nadiyaan thin. Phir mujhe teen pyaale diye gaye, ek doodh ka, doosra shehad ka, aur teesra sharaab ka. Maine doodh ka pyaala liya aur use piya. Mujhse kaha gaya, "Aap aur aapke maanne wale seedhe raaste (Islam) par honge."'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Abu Talha had the largest number of datepalms from amongst the Ansars of Medina. The dearest of his property to him was Bairuha garden which was facing the (Prophet's) Mosque. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to enter it and drink of its good fresh water. When the Holy Verse:-- 'By no means shall you attain righteousness unless you spend (in charity) of that which you love.' (3.92) was revealed, Abu Talha got up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Allah says: By no means shall you attain righteousness unless you spend of that which you love,' and the dearest of my property to me is the Bairuha garden and I want to give it in charity in Allah's Cause, seeking to be rewarded by Allah for that. So you can spend it, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), where-ever Allah instructs you. ' Allah's Apostle said, "Good! That is a perishable (or profitable) wealth" (`Abdullah is in doubt as to which word was used.) He said, "I have heard what you have said but in my opinion you'd better give it to your kith and kin." On that Abu Talha said, "I will do so, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" Abu Talha distributed that garden among his kith and kin and cousins
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas Madina ke Ansaaron mein sabse zyaada khajoor ke darakht the. Unki sabse aziz jaayadaad Bairuha baagh thi, jo Nabi (SAW) ki Masjid ke saamne thi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) usmein daakhil hote aur uske achhe taaze paani se piya karte. Jab ye paak Aayat naazil hui, 'Tum kabhi neki tak nahi pahunch sakte jab tak us cheez mein se kharch na karo jo tumhein aziz hai' (3.92), Abu Talha khade hue aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Allah farmaata hai, "Tum kabhi neki tak nahi pahunch sakte jab tak us cheez mein se kharch na karo jo tumhein aziz hai," aur meri sabse aziz jaayadaad Bairuha baagh hai, aur main use Allah ki raah mein sadqa dena chahta hoon, iske badle mein Allah se ajr ki ummeed rakhte hue. To aap ise, Aye Allah ke Rasool, jahaan bhi Allah aapko hukm de, kharch kar sakte hain.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Wah! Ye ek naashwaan (ya munaafabakhsh) daulat hai.' (Ravi Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko shak hai ke kaunsa lafz istemaal hua tha.) Unhone kaha, 'Maine jo tumne kaha wo sun liya hai, magar meri raay mein tumhein ye apne rishtedaaron ko dena chaahiye.' Isper Abu Talha ne kaha, 'Main aisa hi karunga, Aye Allah ke Rasool!' Abu Talha ne wo baagh apne rishtedaaron aur chachazaad bhaiyon mein baant diya.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) drinking milk. He came to my house and I milked a sheep and then mixed the milk with water from the well for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He took the bowl and drank while on his left there was sitting Abu Bakr, and on his right there was a bedouin. He then gave the remaining milk to the bedouin and said, "The right! The right (first)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko doodh peete dekha. Wo mere ghar aaye, aur maine ek bakri ka doodh dooha aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke liye use kuen ke paani mein mila diya. Unhone katora liya aur piya, jabke unke baaen taraf Abu Bakr aur daaen taraf ek badawi (registaani Arab) baitha tha. Phir unhone baacha hua doodh us badawi ko de diya aur kaha, 'Daayin taraf! Daayin taraf pehle!'

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and one of his companions entered upon an Ansari man and the Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "If you have water kept overnight in a water skin, (give us), otherwise we will drink water by putting our mouth in it." The man was watering his garden then. He said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have water kept overnight; let us go to the shade." So he took them both there and poured water into a bowl and milked a domestic goat of his in it. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) drank, and then the man who had come along with him, drank
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur unke ek sahaabi ek Ansaari aadmi ke paas gaye, aur Nabi (SAW) ne unse kaha, 'Agar tumhaare paas paani ki mashk mein raat ka rakha paani hai, (to humein do), warna hum apna munh dalkar paani piyenge.' Wo aadmi us waqt apna baagh sinch raha tha. Usne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mere paas raat ka rakha paani hai; aaiye chhaaon mein chalte hain.' To wo dono ko wahaan le gaya aur ek katore mein paani daala aur usmein apni palai hui bakri ka doodh nikaala. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne piya, phir jo aadmi unke saath aaya tha usne piya.

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to like sweet edible things (syrup, etc.) and honey
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) meethi cheezein (sharbat waghera) aur shehad pasand karte the.

e: Narrated An-Nazzal:Ali came to the gate of the courtyard (of the Mosque) and drank (water) while he was standing and said, "Some people dislike to drink while standing, but I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) doing (drinking water) as you have seen me doing now
hi: An-Nazzal bataate hain: Ali (Alayhis Salam) Masjid ke aangan ke darwaaze par aaye aur khade hokar (paani) piya aur kaha, 'Kuch log khade hokar paani peena napasand karte hain, magar maine Nabi (SAW) ko waisa hi karte dekha hai jaisa tumne mujhe abhi karte dekha.'

e: Narrated An-Nazzal bin Sabra:`Ali offered the Zuhr prayer and then sat down in the wide courtyard (of the Mosque) of Kufa in order to deal with the affairs of the people till the `Asr prayer became due. Then water was brought to him and he drank of it, washed his face, hands, head and feet. Then he stood up and drank the remaining water while he was standing. and said, "Some people dislike to drink water while standing thought the Prophet did as I have just done
hi: An-Nazzal bin Sabra bataate hain: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne Zuhr ki namaz padhi, phir Kufa ki Masjid ke wasee aangan mein baith gaye taake wo logon ke maamlaat sulajha sakein, yahaan tak ke Asr ki namaz ka waqt aa gaya. Phir unke paas paani laaya gaya aur unhone piya, apna chehra, haath, sar aur pair dhoye. Phir wo khade hue aur baacha hua paani khade hokar piya, aur kaha, 'Kuch log khade hokar paani peena napasand karte hain, jabke Nabi (SAW) ne waisa hi kiya tha jaisa maine abhi kiya.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) drank Zamzam (water) while standing
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne Zamzam ka paani khade hokar piya.

e: Narrated Um Al-Fadl:(daughter of Al-Harith) that she sent a bowl of milk to the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was standing (at `Arafat) in the afternoon of the Day of `Arafat. He took it in his hands and drank it. Narrated Abu Nadr: The Prophet was on the back of his camel
hi: Umm Al-Fadl (Al-Harith ki beti) bataati hain: Unhone Arafat ke din dophar ko Nabi (SAW) ke paas doodh ka ek katora bheja jabke wo (Arafat mein) khade the. Unhone use apne haathon mein liya aur piya. (Ravi Abu Nadr bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) apne oont ki peeth par the.)

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Milk mixed with water was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while a bedouin was on his right and Abu Bakr was on his left. He drank (of it) and then gave (it) to the bedouin and said, 'The right" "The right (first)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Doodh mein paani milaakar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laaya gaya jabke ek badawi unke daaen taraf tha aur Abu Bakr unke baaen taraf. Unhone piya, phir badawi ko diya aur kaha, 'Daayin taraf! Daayin taraf pehle!'

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was offered something to drink. He drank of it while on his right was a boy and on his left were some elderly people. He said to the boy, "May I give these (elderly) people first?" The boy said, "By Allah, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I will not give up my share from you to somebody else." On that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) placed the cup in the hand of that boy
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko peene ke liye kuch pesh kiya gaya. Unhone usmein se piya jabke unke daaen taraf ek ladka aur baaen taraf kuch buzurg log the. Unhone ladke se kaha, 'Kya main ye (baacha hua) buzurgon ko pehle de doon?' Ladke ne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, Aye Allah ke Rasool! Main aapse mila apna hissa kisi aur ko nahi doonga.' Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne pyaala us ladke ke haath mein rakh diya.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) and one of his companions entered upon an Ansari man. The Prophet (ﷺ) and his companion greeted (the man) and he replied, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Let my father and mother be sacrificed for you! It is hot," while he was watering his garden. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked him, "If you have water kept overnight in a water skin, (give us), or else we will drink by putting our mouths in the basin." The man was watering the garden The man said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have water kept overnight in a water-skin. He went to the shade and poured some water into a bowl and milked some milk from a domestic goat in it. The Prophet (ﷺ) drank and then gave the bowl to the man who had come along with him to drink
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) aur unke ek sahaabi ek Ansaari aadmi ke paas gaye. Nabi (SAW) aur unke saathi ne (us aadmi ko) salaam kiya aur usne jawab diya, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mere maa-baap aap par qurbaan hon! Bahut garmi hai,' jabke wo apna baagh sinch raha tha. Nabi (SAW) ne usse pucha, 'Agar tumhaare paas paani ki mashk mein raat ka rakha paani hai, (to humein do), warna hum katore mein munh dalkar piyenge.' Wo aadmi baagh sinch raha tha. Usne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mere paas ek mashk mein raat ka rakha paani hai.' Wo chhaaon mein gaya aur ek katore mein kuch paani daala aur usmein apni palai hui bakri ka doodh nikaala. Nabi (SAW) ne piya, phir katora us aadmi ko diya jo unke saath aaya tha peene ke liye.

e: Narrated Anas:I was waiting on my uncles, serving them with an alcoholic drink prepared from dates, and I was the youngest of them. (Suddenly) it was said that alcoholic drinks had been prohibited. So they said (to me), 'Throw it away." And I threw it away The sub-narrator said: I asked Anas what their drink was (made from), He replied, "(From) ripe dates and unripe dates
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main apne chachaon ki khidmat kar raha tha aur unhein khajoor se banaayi gayi sharaab pila raha tha, aur main unmein sabse chhota tha. (Achaanak) kaha gaya ke sharaab haraam ho gayi hai. To unhone (mujhse) kaha, 'Ise phenk do.' Aur maine use phenk diya. Ravi ne Anas se pucha ke unka sharbat kis cheez se bana tha, unhone jawab diya, '(Pakki) khajoor aur kachi khajoor se.'

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When night falls (or when it is evening), stop your children from going out, for the devils spread out at that time. But when an hour of the night has passed, release them and close the doors and mention Allah's Name, for Satan does not open a closed door. Tie the mouth of your waterskin and mention Allah's Name; cover your containers and utensils and mention Allah's Name. Cover them even by placing something across it, and extinguish your lamps
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab raat ho jaaye (ya shaam ho), apne bachchon ko baahar jaane se roko, kyunke us waqt Shaitaan phail jaate hain. Magar jab raat ka ek pahar guzar jaaye, to unhein chhod do aur darwaaze band karo aur Allah ka naam lo, kyunke Shaitaan band darwaaza nahi khol sakta. Apni mashk ka munh baandho aur Allah ka naam lo; apne bartanon ko dhaanko aur Allah ka naam lo. Inhein dhaanko, chaahe kisi cheez ko unke aar-paar rakh kar hi kyun na ho, aur apne chiraagh bujha do.'

e: Narrated Jabir:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Extinguish the lamps when you go to bed; close your doors; tie the mouths of your water skins, and cover the food and drinks." I think he added, ". . . even with a stick you place across the container
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'So-ne jaate waqt chiraagh bujha do; apne darwaaze band karo; apni mashkon ka munh baandho, aur khaane aur peene ki cheezein dhaanko.' Mujhe lagta hai unhone izaafa kiya, '...chaahe ek lakdi hi bartan ke aar-paar rakh kar.'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the bending of the mouths of water skins for the sake of drinking from them
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mashkon ka munh mod kar unse peene se mana kiya.

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbidding the drinking of water by bending the mouths of water skins, i.e., drinking from the mouths directly
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko mashkon ka munh mod kar paani peene se, yaani seedhe munh se peene se, mana karte suna.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade drinking directly from the mouth of a water skin or other leather containers. and forbade preventing one's neighbor from fixing a peg in (the wall of) one's house
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mashk ya doosre chamde ke bartanon ke munh se seedhe peene se mana kiya, aur apne padosi ko apni deewaar mein khunti gaadne se rokne se bhi mana kiya.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the drinking of water directly from the mouth of a water skin
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne mashk ke munh se seedhe paani peene se mana kiya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the drinking of water direct from the mouth of a water-skin
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne mashk ke munh se seedhe paani peene se mana kiya.

e: Narrated Abu Qatada:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When you drink (water), do not breath in the vessel; and when you urinate, do not touch your penis with your right hand. And when you cleanse yourself after defecation, do not use your right hand
hi: Abu Qatada (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab tum (paani) piyo, to bartan mein saans mat lo; aur jab peshaab karo, to apne haath se apni sharmgaah ko mat chhuo. Aur jab qaza-e-haajat ke baad khud ko saaf karo, to daayaan haath istemaal mat karo.'

e: Narrated Thumama bin `Abdullah:Anas used to breathe twice or thrice in the vessel (while drinking) and used to say that the Prophet; used to take three breaths while drinking
hi: Thumama bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) (paani peete waqt) bartan mein do ya teen baar saans liya karte the, aur kehte the ke Nabi (SAW) paani peete waqt teen saans liya karte the.

e: Narrated Ibn Abi Laila:While Hudhaita was at Mada'in, he asked for water. The chief of the village brought him a silver vessel. Hudhaifa threw it away and said, "I have thrown it away because I told him not to use it, but he has not stopped using it. The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade us to wear clothes of silk or Dibaj, and to drink in gold or silver utensils, and said, 'These things are for them (unbelievers) in this world and for you (Muslims) in the Hereafter
hi: Ibn Abi Laila bataate hain: Jab Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) Mada'in mein the, unhone paani maanga. Gaon ke sardaar ne unhein chaandi ka ek bartan diya. Hudhaifa ne use phenk diya aur kaha, 'Maine ise isliye phenka kyunke maine usse kaha tha ke ise istemaal na kare, magar usne aisa karna nahi chhoda. Nabi (SAW) ne humein resham ya Dibaj ke kapde pehanne se, aur sone ya chaandi ke bartanon mein peene se mana kiya, aur farmaya, "Ye cheezein unke (kaafiron ke) liye is duniya mein hain, aur tumhaare (Musalmaanon ke) liye Aakhirat mein."'

e: Narrated Hudhaifa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not drink in gold or silver utensils, and do not wear clothes of silk or Dibaj, for these things are for them (unbelievers) in this world and for you in the Hereafter
hi: Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Sone ya chaandi ke bartanon mein mat piyo, aur resham ya Dibaj ke kapde mat pehno, kyunke ye cheezein unke (kaafiron ke) liye is duniya mein hain, aur tumhaare liye Aakhirat mein.'

e: Narrated Um Salama:(the wife of the Prophet) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "He who drinks in silver utensils is only filling his `Abdomen with Hell Fire
hi: Umm Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki zawja) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi chaandi ke bartan mein peeta hai, wo sirf apna pet Jahannam ki Aag se bhar raha hai.'

e: Narrated Al-Bara' bin `Azib:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered us to do seven things and forbade us from seven. He ordered us to visit the sick, to follow funeral processions, (to say) to a sneezer, (May Allah bestow His Mercy on you, if he says, Praise be to Allah), to accept invitations, to greet (everybody), to help the oppressed and to help others to fulfill their oaths. He forbade us to wear gold rings, to drink in silver (utensils), to use Mayathir (silken carpets placed on saddles), to wear Al-Qissi (a kind of silken cloth), to wear silk, Dibaj or Istabraq (two kinds of silk)
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein saat cheezon ka hukm diya aur saat se mana kiya. Unhone humein hukm diya: bimaar ki mizaajpursi karna, janaaze ke jaloos mein shaamil hona, chheenkne wale ko jawab dena (yaani 'Yarhamuk-Allah' kehna, agar wo 'Al-hamdulillah' kahe), dawat qubool karna, salaam karna, mazloomon ki madad karna, aur logon ko unki qasmein poori karne mein madad karna. Unhone humein mana kiya: sone ki anguthiyaan pehanne se, chaandi ke bartanon mein peene se, Maiyathir (resham ki gaddiyaan jo zeen par rakhi jaati hain) istemaal karne se, Al-Qissi (ek qism ka resham) pehanne se, aur resham, Dibaj ya Istabraq (do qism ke resham) pehanne se.

e: Narrated Um Al-Fadl:that the people were in doubt whether the Prophet (ﷺ) was fasting on the Day of `Arafat or not, so a (wooden) drinking vessel full of milk was sent to him, and he drank it
hi: Umm Al-Fadl bataati hain: Log shak mein the ke kya Nabi (SAW) Arafat ke din roza rakh rahe hain ya nahi, isliye ek (lakdi ka) doodh se bhara bartan unke paas bheja gaya, aur unhone use piya.

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:An Arab lady was mentioned to the Prophet (ﷺ) so he asked Abu Usaid As-Sa`idi to send for her, and he sent for her and she came and stayed in the castle of Bani Sa`ida. The Prophet (ﷺ) came out and went to her and entered upon her. Behold, it was a lady sitting with a drooping head. When the Prophet (ﷺ) spoke to her, she said, "I seek refuge with Allah from you." He said, "I grant you refuge from me." They said to her, "Do you know who this is?" She said, "No." They said, "This is Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who has come to command your hand in marriage." She said, "I am very unlucky to lose this chance." Then the Prophet and his companions went towards the shed of Bani Sa`ida and sat there. Then he said, "Give us water, O Sahl!" So I took out this drinking bowl and gave them water in it. The sub-narrator added: Sahl took out for us that very drinking bowl and we all drank from it. Later on `Umar bin `Abdul `Aziz requested Sahl to give it to him as a present, and he gave it to him as a present
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ke saamne ek Arab khaatoon ka zikr hua, to unhone Abu Usaid As-Sa'idi se kaha ke wo unhein bulaayein, aur unhone unhein bulwaaya aur wo aayi aur Bani Sa'ida ke qile mein thehri. Nabi (SAW) baahar aaye aur unke paas gaye aur unke paas daakhil hue. Dekha to ek khaatoon sar jhukaaye baithi thi. Jab Nabi (SAW) ne unse baat ki, unhone kaha, 'Main aapse Allah ki panaah maangti hoon.' Unhone kaha, 'Maine tumhein apni taraf se panaah di.' Logon ne unse kaha, 'Kya tumhein pata hai ye kaun hain?' Unhone kaha, 'Nahi.' Unhone kaha, 'Ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) hain jo tumhaara nikaah ka rishta lekar aaye hain.' Unhone kaha, 'Main bahut badnaseeb hoon ke maine ye mauka gawaan diya.' Phir Nabi (SAW) aur unke sahaaba Bani Sa'ida ke chhappar ki taraf gaye aur wahaan baith gaye. Phir unhone kaha, 'Humein paani do, Aye Sahl!' To maine ye peene ka bartan nikaala aur unhein usmein paani diya. (Ravi ne aage kaha:) Sahl ne humare liye wahi peene ka bartan nikaala aur hum sabne usmein se piya. Baad mein Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdul Aziz ne Sahl se ise tohfe mein maanga, aur unhone use unhein tohfe mein de diya.

e: Narrated `Asim al-Ahwal:I saw the drinking bowl of the Prophet (ﷺ) with Anas bin Malik, and it had been broken, and he had mended it with silver plates. That drinking bowl was quite wide and made of Nadar wood, Anas said, "I gave water to the Prophet (ﷺ) in that bowl more than so-and-so (for a long period)." Ibn Seereen said: Around that bowl there was an iron ring, and Anas wanted to replace it with a silver or gold ring, but Abu Talha said to him, "Do not change a thing that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has made." So Anas left it as it was
hi: Asim Al-Ahwal bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ka peene ka bartan Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas dekha, aur wo toota hua tha, aur unhone use chaandi ki patiyon se theek karwaaya tha. Wo bartan kaafi chauda tha aur Nadar lakdi ka bana tha. Anas ne kaha, 'Maine Nabi (SAW) ko is bartan mein falaan-falaan se bhi zyaada (lambe arse tak) paani diya hai.' Ibn Seereen kehte hain: Us bartan ke gird loha ka ek chhalla tha, aur Anas use chaandi ya sone ke chhalle se badalna chahte the, magar Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne unse kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne jo cheez banaayi hai use mat badlo.' To Anas ne use waisa hi rehne diya.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:I was with the Prophet (ﷺ) and the time for the `Asr prayer became due. We had no water with us except a little which was put in a vessel and was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) . He put his hand into it and spread out his fingers and then said, "Come along! Hurry up! All those who want to perform ablution. The blessing is from Allah.'' I saw the water gushing out from his fingers. So the people performed the ablution and drank, and I tried to drink more of that water (beyond my thirst and capacity), for I knew that it was a blessing. The sub-narrator said: I asked Jabir, "How many persons were you then?" He replied, "We were one-thousand four hundred men." Salim said: Jabir said
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Nabi (SAW) ke saath tha aur Asr ki namaz ka waqt aa gaya. Humare paas thoda sa paani tha jo ek bartan mein daala gaya aur Nabi (SAW) ke paas laaya gaya. Unhone apna haath usmein daala aur apni ungliyaan phailaayin, phir kaha, 'Aao! Jaldi karo! Jo bhi wuzu karna chahta hai (aaye). Barkat Allah ki taraf se hai.' Maine dekha paani unki ungliyon se ubalta hua nikal raha tha. To logon ne wuzu kiya aur piya, aur maine bhi us paani ko zyaada peene ki koshish ki (apni pyaas aur zaroorat se zyaada), kyunke mujhe pata tha ke ye ek barkat hai. Ravi ne pucha, 'Uss waqt tum kitne log the?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Hum chaudah sau (1400) log the.' Ravi Salim kehte hain: Jabir ne (aisa) kaha.

e: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "No calamity befalls a Muslim but that Allah expiates some of his sins because of it, even though it were the prick he receives from a thorn
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki zawja) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kisi Musalmaan par koi museebat nahi aati magar Allah uski wajah se uske kuch gunaah maaf kar deta hai, chaahe wo kaante ki chubhan hi kyun na ho.'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri and Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No fatigue, nor disease, nor sorrow, nor sadness, nor hurt, nor distress befalls a Muslim, even if it were the prick he receives from a thorn, but that Allah expiates some of his sins for that
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kisi Musalmaan par na thakaan, na bimaari, na gam, na udaasi, na takleef, na pareshaani aati hai, chaahe wo kaante ki chubhan hi kyun na ho, magar Allah uski wajah se uske kuch gunaah maaf kar deta hai.'

e: Narrated Ka`b:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The example of a believer is that of a fresh tender plant, which the wind bends lt sometimes and some other time it makes it straight. And the example of a hypocrite is that of a pine tree which keeps straight till once it is uprooted suddenly
hi: Ka'b bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Momin ki misaal ek naram, taazi paudhe jaisi hai jise hawa kabhi jhukaa deti hai aur kabhi seedha kar deti hai. Aur munaafiq ki misaal chad ke darakht jaisi hai jo seedha khada rehta hai yahaan tak ke achaanak ukhaad diya jaata hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The example of a believer is that of a fresh tender plant; from whatever direction the wind comes, it bends it, but when the wind becomes quiet, it becomes straight again. Similarly, a believer is afflicted with calamities (but he remains patient till Allah removes his difficulties.) And an impious wicked person is like a pine tree which keeps hard and straight till Allah cuts (breaks) it down when He wishes." (See Hadith No. 558, Vol)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Momin ki misaal ek naram, taazi paudhe jaisi hai; jis bhi taraf se hawa aaye, wo jhuk jaati hai, magar jab hawa shaant ho jaati hai, wo phir seedhi ho jaati hai. Isi tarah, momin ko museebaton ka saamna karna padta hai (magar wo sabra karta hai jab tak Allah uski mushkilein door na kar de). Aur ek bad-amal aur badkaar shaks chad ke darakht jaisa hai jo sakht aur seedha rehta hai yahaan tak ke Allah use kaat (tod) de jab wo chaahe.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If Allah wants to do good to somebody, He afflicts him with trials
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar Allah kisi ka bhala chahta hai, to wo use aazmaayishon mein daalta hai.'

e: Narrated Aisha:I never saw anybody suffering so much from sickness as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine kabhi kisi ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) jitni bimaari se taklif uthaate nahi dekha.

e: Narrated `Abdullah:I visited the Prophet (ﷺ) during his ailments and he was suffering from a high fever. I said, "You have a high fever. Is it because you will have a double reward for it?" He said, "Yes, for no Muslim is afflicted with any harm but that Allah will remove his sins as the leaves of a tree fall down
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Nabi (SAW) se unki bimaari ke dauraan milne gaya, aur unhein tez bukhaar tha. Maine kaha, 'Aapko tez bukhaar hai. Kya isliye ke aapko iska dohra ajr milega?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan, kyunke koi bhi Musalmaan kisi bhi takleef se pareshaan nahi hota magar Allah uske gunaah is tarah gira deta hai jaise darakht ke patte girte hain.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:I visited Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while he was suffering from a high fever. I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! You have a high fever." He said, "Yes, I have as much fever as two men of you." I said, "Is it because you will have a double reward?" He said, "Yes, it is so. No Muslim is afflicted with any harm, even if it were the prick of a thorn, but that Allah expiates his sins because of that, as a tree sheds its leaves
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se milne gaya jabke wo tez bukhaar se pareshaan the. Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Aapko tez bukhaar hai.' Unhone kaha, 'Haan, mujhe do aadmiyon jitna bukhaar hai.' Maine pucha, 'Kya isliye ke aapko dohra ajr milega?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan, aisa hi hai. Koi Musalmaan kisi bhi takleef se pareshaan nahi hota, chaahe wo kaante ki chubhan hi kyun na ho, magar Allah uski wajah se uske gunaah is tarah maaf kar deta hai jaise darakht apne patte girata hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Muisa Al-Ash`ari:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Feed the hungry, visit the sick, and set free the captives
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ashari bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Bhookhon ko khilaao, bimaaron ki mizaajpursi karo, aur qaidiyon ko azaad karo.'

e: Narrated Al-Bara bin Azib:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered us to do seven things and forbade us to do seven other things. He forbade us to wear gold rings, silk, Dibaj, Istabriq, Qissy, and Maithara; and ordered us to accompany funeral processions, visit the sick and greet everybody. (See Hadith No)
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein saat cheezon ka hukm diya aur saat se mana kiya. Unhone humein sone ki anguthiyaan, resham, Dibaj, Istabraq, Qissi aur Maithara pehanne/istemaal karne se mana kiya; aur humein janaaze ke jaloos mein shaamil hone, bimaaron ki mizaajpursi karne, aur sabko salaam karne ka hukm diya.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:Once I fell ill. The Prophet (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr came walking to pay me a visit and found me unconscious. The Prophet (ﷺ) performed ablution and then poured the remaining water on me, and I came to my senses to see the Prophet. I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What shall I do with my property? How shall I dispose of (distribute) my property?" He did not reply till the Verse of inheritance was revealed
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar main bimar pad gaya. Nabi (SAW) aur Abu Bakr paidal chal kar mujhse milne aaye aur mujhe behosh paaya. Nabi (SAW) ne wuzu kiya, phir baacha hua paani mujhpar daala, aur mujhe hosh aaya aur maine Nabi (SAW) ko dekha. Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Main apni jaayadaad ka kya karoon? Main apni jaayadaad kaise baantoon?' Unhone koi jawab nahi diya jab tak miraas ki Aayat naazil nahi hui.

e: Narrated 'Ata bin Abi Rabah:Ibn `Abbas said to me, "Shall I show you a woman of the people of Paradise?" I said, "Yes." He said, "This black lady came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, 'I get attacks of epilepsy and my body becomes uncovered; please invoke Allah for me.' The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to her), 'If you wish, be patient and you will have (enter) Paradise; and if you wish, I will invoke Allah to cure you.' She said, 'I will remain patient,' and added, 'but I become uncovered, so please invoke Allah for me that I may not become uncovered.' So he invoked Allah for her." Narrated 'Ata: That he had seen Um Zafar, the tall black lady, at (holding) the curtain of the Ka`ba
hi: Ata bin Abi Rabah bataate hain: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne mujhse kaha, 'Kya main tumhein Jannat waalon mein se ek aurat dikhaun?' Maine kaha, 'Haan.' Unhone kaha, 'Ye kaali khaatoon Nabi (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha, "Mujhe mirgi ke daure aate hain aur mera badan khul jaata hai; barah-e-meharbaani mere liye Allah se dua kijiye." Nabi (SAW) ne (unse) kaha, "Agar tum chaaho, to sabra karo aur tumhein Jannat milegi; aur agar chaaho, to main Allah se dua karta hoon ke wo tumhein sehatyaab kare." Unhone kaha, "Main sabra karungi," aur aage kaha, "magar mera badan khul jaata hai, isliye barah-e-meharbaani Allah se dua kijiye ke aisa na ho." To unhone unke liye dua ki.' Ravi Ata bataate hain: Unhone Umm Zafar, wo lambi qadd ki kaali khaatoon, ko Kaaba ke parde ko pakde hue dekha tha.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "Allah said, 'If I deprive my slave of his two beloved things (i.e., his eyes) and he remains patient, I will let him enter Paradise in compensation for them
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Allah farmaata hai, "Agar main apne bande ki do aziz cheezein (yaani uski aankhein) chheen loon aur wo sabra kare, to main uske badle mein use Jannat mein daakhil karunga."'

e: Narrated `Aisha:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) emigrated to Medina, Abu Bakr and Bilal got a fever. I entered upon them and asked, "O my father! How are you? O Bilal! How are you?" Whenever fever attacked Abu Bakr, he would recite the following poetic verses: 'Everybody is staying alive among his people, yet death is nearer to him than his shoe laces." And whenever the fever deserted Bilal, he would recite (two poetic lines): 'Would that I could stay overnight in a valley wherein I would be surrounded by Idhkhir and Jalil (two kinds of good smelling grass). Would that one day I would drink of the water of Majinna and would that Shama and Tafil (two mountains at Mecca) would appear to me.' Then I came and informed Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about that, whereupon he said, "O Allah! Make us love Medina as much or more than we love Mecca. O Allah! Make it healthy and bless its Mudd and Sa for us, and take away its fever and put it in Al Juhfa
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Madina hijrat kar gaye, Abu Bakr aur Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko bukhaar chad gaya. Main unke paas gayi aur pucha, 'Aye mere waalid! Aap kaise hain? Aye Bilal! Aap kaise hain?' Jab bhi Abu Bakr ko bukhaar chadta, wo ye sher padha karte: 'Har koi apni qaum mein zinda rehta hai, phir bhi maut uski jooti ke fite se bhi zyaada qareeb hai.' Aur jab Bilal ka bukhaar utarta, wo ye do sher padha karte: 'Kaash main kisi wadi mein raat guzaar sakoon jahaan mere aas-paas Idhkhir aur Jalil (do khushbudaar ghaasein) hon. Kaash ek din main Majinna ka paani pee sakoon, aur kaash Shama aur Tafil (Makkah ke do pahaad) mujhe dikhaayi de jaayein.' Phir main aayi aur ye baat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko bataayi, isper unhone farmaya, 'Aye Allah! Humein Madina se utni ya usse zyaada mohabbat karwaa jitni humein Makkah se hai. Aye Allah! Ise sehatmand bana de aur iske Mudd aur Sa mein humaare liye barkat de, aur iska bukhaar door karke Al-Juhfa mein bhej de.'

e: Narrated Abu `Uthman:Usama bin Zaid said that while he. Sa`d and Ubai bin Ka`b were with the Prophet (ﷺ) a daughter of the Prophet sent a message to him, saying. 'My daughter is dying; please come to us." The Prophet (ﷺ) sent her his greetings and added "It is for Allah what He takes, and what He gives; and everything before His sight has a limited period. So she should hope for Allah's reward and remain patient." She again sent a message, beseeching him by Allah, to come. So the Prophet (ﷺ) got up. and so did we (and went there). The child was placed on his lap while his breath was irregular. Tears flowed from the eyes of the Prophet. Sa`d said to him, "What is this, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" He said. "This Is Mercy which Allah has embedded in the hearts of whomever He wished of His slaves. And Allah does not bestow His Mercy, except on the merciful among His slaves. (See Hadith No. 373 Vol)
hi: Abu Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha ke jab wo, Sa'd aur Ubai bin Ka'b (رضی اللہ عنہ) Nabi (SAW) ke saath the, Nabi (SAW) ki ek beti ne unke paas paighaam bheja, 'Meri beti (yaani unki nawaasi) marne wali hai; barah-e-meharbaani humaare paas aaiye.' Nabi (SAW) ne unhein apna salaam bheja aur kaha, 'Jo Allah leta hai aur jo deta hai, sab uska hai; aur har cheez uske nazdeek ek muqarrar waqt tak hi hai. To unhein Allah ke ajr ki ummeed rakhni chaahiye aur sabra karna chaahiye.' Unhone dobara Allah ki qasam dekar paighaam bheja ke wo aayein. To Nabi (SAW) uthe, aur hum bhi (unke saath gaye). Bacchi ko unki god mein rakha gaya jabke uski saans ukhdi hui thi. Nabi (SAW) ki aankhon se aansu beh nikle. Sa'd ne unse kaha, 'Ye kya hai, Aye Allah ke Rasool?' Unhone kaha, 'Ye wo rehmat hai jo Allah ne apne bandon mein se jiske dil mein chaaha daali hai. Aur Allah apni rehmat sirf un bandon par karta hai jo (doosron par) reham karte hain.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) went to visit a sick bedouin. Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) went to a patient, he used to say to him, "Don't worry, if Allah will, it will be expiation (for your sins):" The bedouin said, "You say expiation? No, it is but a fever that is boiling or harassing an old man and will lead him to his grave without his will." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Then, yes, it is so
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ek bimaar badawi se milne gaye. Jab bhi Nabi (SAW) kisi mareez ke paas jaate, wo unse kehte, 'Pareshaan mat ho, agar Allah ne chaaha, to ye (tumhaare gunaahon ka) kaffara banega.' Badawi ne kaha, 'Aap kaffara kehte hain? Nahi, ye to bas ek bukhaar hai jo ek budhe aadmi ke andar ubal raha hai aur usse takleef de raha hai, aur bina uski marzi ke use uski qabr tak le jaayega.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'To, haan, phir aisa hi hoga.'
