e: Narrated Anas:A Jewish boy used to serve the Prophet (ﷺ) and became ill. The Prophet (ﷺ) went to pay him a visit and said to him, "Embrace Islam," and he did embrace Islam. Al-Musaiyab said: When Abu Talib was on his deathbed, the Prophet (ﷺ) visited him
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek Yahudi ladka Nabi (SAW) ki khidmat kiya karta tha aur bimar ho gaya. Nabi (SAW) unse milne gaye aur unse kaha, 'Islam qubool karo,' aur usne Islam qubool kar liya. Ravi Al-Musaiyab kehte hain: Jab Abu Talib maut ke bistar par the, Nabi (SAW) unse milne gaye.

e: Narrated `Aisha:During the ailment of the Prophet (ﷺ) some people came to visits him. He led them in prayer while sitting. but they prayed standing, so he waved to them to sit down. When he had finished the prayer, he said, "An Imam is to be followed, so when he bows, you should bow. and when he raises his head, you should raise yours, and if he prays sitting. you should pray sitting." Abu `Abdullah said Al-Humaidi said, (The order of ) "This narration has been abrogated by the last action of the Prophet (ﷺ) as he led the prayer sitting, while the people prayed standing behind him
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ki bimaari ke dauraan kuch log unse milne aaye. Unhone baithkar unhein namaz padhaayi, magar wo khade hokar padh rahe the, isper unhone unhein baithne ka ishara kiya. Jab unhone namaz khatam ki, unhone farmaya, 'Imam ki pairvi ki jaati hai, isliye jab wo ruku kare, tum bhi ruku karo, aur jab wo sar uthaaye, tum bhi uthaao, aur agar wo baithkar padhe, to tum bhi baithkar padho.' Abu Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) kehte hain: Al-Humaidi kehte hain, '(Ye) riwaayat Nabi (SAW) ke aakhri amal se mansookh ho gayi, kyunke unhone baithkar namaz padhaayi jabke log unke peechhe khade hokar padh rahe the.'

e: Narrated Sa`d:I became seriously ill at Mecca and the Prophet (ﷺ) came to visit me. I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I shall leave behind me a good fortune, but my heir is my only daughter; shall I bequeath two third of my property to be spent in charity and leave one third (for my heir)?" He said, "No." I said, "Shall I bequeath half and leave half?" He said, "No." I said, "Shall I bequeath one third and leave two thirds?" He said, "One third is alright, though even one third is too much." Then he placed his hand on his forehead and passed it over my face and `Abdomen and said, "O Allah! Cure Sa`d and complete his emigration." I feel as if I have been feeling the coldness of his hand on my liver ever since
hi: Sa'd bataate hain: Main Makkah mein sakht bimar ho gaya, aur Nabi (SAW) mujhse milne aaye. Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Main apne peeche ek achhi khaasi daulat chhodunga, magar mera waaris sirf meri ek beti hai; kya main apni jaayadaad ka do-tihaai sadqe mein wasiyat kar doon aur ek-tihaai (apni waaris ke liye) chhod doon?' Unhone kaha, 'Nahi.' Maine kaha, 'Kya main aadha wasiyat kar doon aur aadha chhod doon?' Unhone kaha, 'Nahi.' Maine kaha, 'Kya main ek-tihaai wasiyat kar doon aur do-tihaai chhod doon?' Unhone kaha, 'Ek-tihaai theek hai, phir bhi ek-tihaai bhi bahut zyaada hai.' Phir unhone apna haath meri peshaani par rakha aur mere chehre aur pet par phera aur kaha, 'Aye Allah! Sa'd ko shifa de aur unki hijrat poori kar.' Mujhe lagta hai jaise main aaj bhi unke haath ki thandak apne jigar mein mehsoos karta hoon.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Mas`ud:I visited Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while he was suffering from a high fever. I touched him with my hand and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! You have a high fever." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Yes, I have as much fever as two men of you have." I said, "Is it because you will get a double reward?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Yes, no Muslim is afflicted with harm because of sickness or some other inconvenience, but that Allah will remove his sins for him as a tree sheds its leaves
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Masud bataate hain: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se milne gaya jabke wo tez bukhaar se pareshaan the. Maine unhein apne haath se chhua aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Aapko tez bukhaar hai.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Haan, mujhe do aadmiyon jitna bukhaar hai.' Maine pucha, 'Kya isliye ke aapko dohra ajr milega?' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Haan, koi Musalmaan bimaari ya kisi aur takleef se pareshaan nahi hota, magar Allah uske gunaah is tarah maaf kar deta hai jaise darakht apne patte girata hai.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:I visited the Prophet (ﷺ) during his illness and touched him while he was having a fever. I said to him, "You have a high fever; is it because you will get a double reward?" He said, "Yes. No Muslim is afflicted with any harm, but that his sins will be annulled as the leave of a tree fall down
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Nabi (SAW) se unki bimaari ke dauraan milne gaya aur unhein chhua jabke unhein bukhaar tha. Maine unse kaha, 'Aapko tez bukhaar hai; kya isliye ke aapko dohra ajr milega?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan. Koi Musalmaan kisi bhi takleef se pareshaan nahi hota, magar uske gunaah is tarah maaf ho jaate hain jaise darakht ke patte girte hain.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered upon sick man to pay him a visit, and said to him, "Don't worry, Allah willing, (your sickness will be) an expiation for your sins." The man said, "No, it is but a fever that is boiling within an old man and will send him to his grave." On that, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Then yes, it is so
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek bimaar aadmi ke paas gaye unse milne, aur unse kaha, 'Pareshaan mat ho, Insha-Allah, (tumhaari bimaari) tumhaare gunaahon ka kaffara banegi.' Us aadmi ne kaha, 'Nahi, ye to bas ek bukhaar hai jo ek budhe aadmi ke andar ubal raha hai aur usse uski qabr tak bhej dega.' Isper Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'To, haan, phir aisa hi hoga.'

e: Narrated Usama bin Zaid:The Prophet (ﷺ) rode a donkey having a saddle with a Fadakiyya velvet covering. He mounted me behind him and went to visit Sa`d bin 'Ubada, and that had been before the battle of Badr. The Prophet (ﷺ) proceeded till he passed by a gathering in which `Abdullah bin Ubai bin Salul was present, and that had been before `Abdullah embraced Islam. The gathering comprised of Muslims, polytheists, i.e., isolators and Jews. `Abdullah bin Rawaha was also present in that gathering. When dust raised by the donkey covered the gathering, `Abdullah bin Ubai covered his nose with his upper garment and said, "Do not trouble us with dust." The Prophet (ﷺ) greeted them, stopped and dismounted. Then he invited them to Allah (i.e., to embrace Islam) and recited to them some verses of the Holy Qur'an. On that, `Abdullah bin Ubai said, "O man ! There is nothing better than what you say if it is true. Do not trouble us with it in our gathering, but return to your house, and if somebody comes to you, teach him there." On that `Abdullah bin Rawaha said, Yes, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Bring your teachings to our gathering, for we love that." So the Muslims, the pagans and the Jews started abusing each other till they were about to fight. The Prophet (ﷺ) kept on quietening them till they became calm. Thereupon the Prophet mounted his animal and proceeded till he entered upon Sa`d bin Ubada. He said to him "O Sa`d! Have you not heard what Abu Hubab (i.e., `Abdullah bin Ubai) said?" Sa`d said, 'O Allah's Apostle! Excuse and forgive him, for Allah has given you what He has given you. The people of this town (Medina decided unanimously to crown him and make him their chief by placing a turban on his head, but when that was prevented by the Truth which Allah had given you he (`Abdullah bin Ubai) was grieved out of jealously, and that was the reason which caused him to behave in the way you have seen
hi: Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ek gadhe par sawaar hue jispar Fadakiyya makhmal ki zeen thi. Unhone mujhe apne peechhe bithaaya aur Sa'd bin Ubada (رضی اللہ عنہ) se milne gaye, aur ye jang-e-Badr se pehle ki baat hai. Nabi (SAW) chalte rahe yahaan tak ke unhone ek majlis se guzre jismein Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ubai bin Salul maujood the, aur ye Abdullah ke Islam qubool karne se pehle ki baat hai. Us majlis mein Musalmaan, mushrik, aur Yahudi shaamil the. Abdullah bin Rawaha bhi us majlis mein maujood the. Jab gadhe ki uthaayi hui dhool majlis par pad gayi, Abdullah bin Ubai ne apni chaadar se apni naak dhaank li aur kaha, 'Humein apni dhool se takleef mat do.' Nabi (SAW) ne unhein salaam kiya, ruke aur utar gaye. Phir unhone unhein Allah ki taraf (yaani Islam qubool karne ki) dawat di aur Quran ki kuch Aayaten padh kar sunaayi. Isper Abdullah bin Ubai ne kaha, 'Aye aadmi! Agar tumhaari baat sach hai, to usse behtar kuch nahi, magar humein apni majlis mein isse takleef mat do, apne ghar wapas jao, aur agar koi tumhaare paas aaye to use wahaan sikhaao.' Isper Abdullah bin Rawaha ne kaha, 'Haan, Aye Allah ke Rasool! Apni taleemaat humaari majlis mein laaiye, kyunke humein ye pasand hai.' To Musalmaan, mushrik aur Yahudi ek doosre ko bura-bhala kehne lage yahaan tak ke wo jhagadne hi wale the. Nabi (SAW) unhein shaant karte rahe yahaan tak ke wo shaant ho gaye. Phir Nabi (SAW) apni sawaari par sawaar hue aur chalte rahe yahaan tak ke wo Sa'd bin Ubada ke paas gaye. Unhone usse kaha, 'Aye Sa'd! Kya tumne suna nahi Abu Hubab (yaani Abdullah bin Ubai) ne kya kaha?' Sa'd ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Unhein maaf kar dijiye aur darguzar kijiye, kyunke Allah ne aapko wo diya hai jo usne diya hai. Is shehar (Madina) ke log sarvasammati se unhe apna sardaar banaana chahte the, unke sar par pagdi rakh kar, magar jab Allah ne aapko di hui Haq (baat) ne isse rok diya, to wo (Abdullah bin Ubai) hasad ki wajah se udaas ho gaye, aur yahi wajah thi jisne unhein aisa karne par majboor kiya jaisa aapne dekha.'

e: Narrated Jabir:The Prophet (ﷺ) came to visit me (while I was sick) and he was riding neither a mule, nor a horse
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) mujhse milne aaye (jab main bimar tha) aur wo na khachar par sawaar the na ghode par.

e: Narrated Ka`b bin 'Ujara:The Prophet (ﷺ) passed by me while I was kindling a fire under a (cooking) pot. He said, "Do the lice of your head trouble you?" I said, "Yes." So he called a barber to shave my head and ordered me to make expiation for that
hi: Ka'b bin Ujra bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) mere paas se guzre jabke main ek degchi ke neeche aag jala raha tha. Unhone kaha, 'Kya tumhaare sar ki jueein tumhein pareshaan karti hain?' Maine kaha, 'Haan.' To unhone ek nai (hajaam) ko bulaaya taake wo mera sar mundwaaye, aur mujhe iske liye kaffara adaa karne ka hukm diya.

e: Narrated Al-Qasim bin Muhammad:`Aisha, (complaining of headache) said, "Oh, my head"! Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I wish that had happened while I was still living, for then I would ask Allah's Forgiveness for you and invoke Allah for you." Aisha said, "Wa thuklayah! By Allah, I think you want me to die; and If this should happen, you would spend the last part of the day sleeping with one of your wives!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Nay, I should say, 'Oh my head!' I felt like sending for Abu Bakr and his son, and appoint him as my successor lest some people claimed something or some others wished something, but then I said (to myself), 'Allah would not allow it to be otherwise, and the Muslims would prevent it to be otherwise
hi: Al-Qasim bin Muhammad bataate hain: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne (sar dard ki shikaayat karte hue) kaha, 'Haaye, mera sar!' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kaash aisa tab hota jab main abhi zinda hota, taake main tumhaare liye Allah se maafi maangta aur dua karta.' Aisha ne kaha, 'Wa Thuklayah! Allah ki qasam, mujhe lagta hai aap chahte hain ke main mar jaaun; aur agar aisa ho jaaye, to aap din ke aakhri hisse mein apni kisi doosri biwi ke saath so rahe honge!' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Nahi, mujhe to "Haaye mera sar!" kehna chaahiye. Mera mann kiya ke Abu Bakr aur unke bete ko bulaaun aur unhein apna jaanasheen muqarrar kar doon, kahin koi kuch dawa na kar de ya koi kuch aur na chaahe, magar phir maine (khud se) kaha, "Allah kisi aur tareeke se nahi chaahega, aur Musalmaan bhi isse rokenge."'

e: Narrated Ibn Mas`ud:I visited the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was having a high fever. I touched him an said, "You have a very high fever" He said, "Yes, as much fever as two me of you may have." I said. "you will have a double reward?" He said, "Yes No Muslim is afflicted with hurt caused by disease or some other inconvenience, but that Allah will remove his sins as a tree sheds its leaves
hi: Ibn Masud bataate hain: Main Nabi (SAW) se milne gaya jabke unhein tez bukhaar tha. Maine unhein chhua aur kaha, 'Aapko bahut tez bukhaar hai.' Unhone kaha, 'Haan, mujhe do aadmiyon jitna bukhaar hai.' Maine pucha, 'Kya aapko dohra ajr milega?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan. Koi Musalmaan bimaari ya kisi aur takleef se pareshaan nahi hota, magar Allah uske gunaah is tarah maaf kar deta hai jaise darakht apne patte girata hai.'

e: Narrated Sa`d:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to visit me during my ailment which had been aggravated during Hajjat-al- Wada`. I said to him, "You see how sick I am. I have much property but have no heir except my only daughter May I give two thirds of my property in charity?"! He said, "No." I said, "Half of it?" He said, "No." I said "One third?" He said, "One third is too much, for to leave your heirs rich is better than to leave them poor, begging of others. Nothing you spend seeking Allah's pleasure but you shall get a reward for it, even for what you put in the mouth of your wife
hi: Sa'd bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mujhse milne aaye meri us bimaari ke dauraan jo Hajjat-ul-Wada ke waqt aur badh gayi thi. Maine unse kaha, 'Aap dekh rahe hain main kitna bimar hoon. Mere paas bahut jaayadaad hai magar mera koi waaris nahi siwaaye meri ek beti ke. Kya main apni do-tihaai jaayadaad sadqe mein de doon?' Unhone kaha, 'Nahi.' Maine kaha, 'Aadhi?' Unhone kaha, 'Nahi.' Maine kaha, 'Ek-tihaai?' Unhone kaha, 'Ek-tihaai bhi bahut zyaada hai, kyunke apne waarison ko ameer chhodna behtar hai unhein gareeb chhodne se, jo doosron se bheekh maangte phirein. Tum jo bhi Allah ki khushi ke liye kharch karoge, uska ajr tumhein milega, chaahe wo apni biwi ke munh mein daala gaya ek nawaala hi kyun na ho.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was on his death-bed and in the house there were some people among whom was `Umar bin Al-Khattab, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Come, let me write for you a statement after which you will not go astray." `Umar said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) is seriously ill and you have the Qur'an; so the Book of Allah is enough for us." The people present in the house differed and quarrelled. Some said "Go near so that the Prophet (ﷺ) may write for you a statement after which you will not go astray," while the others said as `Umar said. When they caused a hue and cry before the Prophet, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Go away!" Narrated 'Ubaidullah: Ibn `Abbas used to say, "It was very unfortunate that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was prevented from writing that statement for them because of their disagreement and noise
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apni wafat ke bistar par the aur ghar mein kuch log maujood the, jinmein Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab bhi the, Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Aao, main tumhaare liye ek baat likh doon jiske baad tum kabhi gumraah nahi hoge.' Umar ne kaha, 'Nabi (SAW) sakht bimar hain aur tumhaare paas Quran hai; Allah ki Kitaab hamare liye kaafi hai.' Ghar mein maujood log alag-alag raay rakhte the aur bahas karne lage. Kuch ne kaha, 'Nazdeek jao taake Nabi (SAW) tumhaare liye ek baat likh dein jiske baad tum kabhi gumraah nahi hoge,' jabke doosron ne wahi kaha jo Umar ne kaha. Jab unhone Nabi (SAW) ke saamne shor-sharaba kiya, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Chale jaao!' Ravi Ubaidullah bataate hain: Ibn Abbas kaha karte the, 'Ye bahut hi badqismati thi ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unke ikhtelaf aur shor ki wajah se unke liye wo baat likhne se rok diye gaye.'

e: Narrated As-Sa'ib:My aunt took me to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! My nephew is- ill." The Prophet (ﷺ) touched my head with his hand and invoked Allah to bless me. He then performed ablution and I drank of the remaining water of his ablution and then stood behind his back and saw "Khatam An- Nubuwwa" (The Seal of Prophethood) between his shoulders like a button of a tent
hi: As-Sa'ib bataate hain: Meri khaala mujhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas le gayi aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mera bhatija bimar hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne apna haath mere sar par rakha aur mere liye dua ki. Phir unhone wuzu kiya aur maine unke wuzu ka baacha hua paani piya, phir main unki peeth ke peechhe khada hua aur maine 'Khatam An-Nubuwwa' (Nabuwwat ki muhar) unke kandhon ke beech dekhi, jaise kisi khaime ka bata ho.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "None of you should wish for death because of a calamity befalling him; but if he has to wish for death, he should say: "O Allah! Keep me alive as long as life is better for me, and let me die if death is better for me
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Tum mein se koi bhi kisi museebat ki wajah se maut ki tamanna na kare; magar agar maut ki tamanna karna zaroori ho, to use kehna chaahiye, "Aye Allah! Mujhe zinda rakh jab tak zindagi mere liye behtar ho, aur mujhe maut de agar maut mere liye behtar ho."'

e: Narrated Qais bin Abi Hazim:We went to pay a visit to Khabbab (who was sick) and he had been branded (cauterized) at seven places in his body. He said, "Our companions who died (during the lifetime of the Prophet) left (this world) without having their rewards reduced through enjoying the pleasures of this life, but we have got (so much) wealth that we find no way to spend It except on the construction of buildings Had the Prophet not forbidden us to wish for death, I would have wished for it.' We visited him for the second time while he was building a wall. He said, A Muslim is rewarded (in the Hereafter) for whatever he spends except for something that he spends on building
hi: Qais bin Abi Hazim bataate hain: Hum Khabbab (رضی اللہ عنہ) (jo bimar the) se milne gaye, aur unke jism par saat jagah daagh lagaaye gaye the. Unhone kaha, 'Hamare saathi jo (Nabi ki zindagi mein) intekaal kar gaye, wo is duniya ki khushiyaan uthaaye bagair, apna poora ajr paakar gaye, magar humein itni daulat mil gayi hai ke humein ise imaaraaton ke ilaawa kharch karne ka koi raasta nahi mil raha. Agar Nabi (SAW) ne humein maut ki tamanna karne se mana na kiya hota, to main iski tamanna karta.' Hum unse doosri baar milne gaye jab wo ek deewaar bana rahe the. Unhone kaha, 'Ek Musalmaan ko (Aakhirat mein) uske har kharch ka ajr milta hai siwaaye us cheez ke jo wo imaarat par kharch kare.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "The good deeds of any person will not make him enter Paradise." (i.e., None can enter Paradise through his good deeds.) They (the Prophet's companions) said, 'Not even you, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?' He said, "Not even myself, unless Allah bestows His favor and mercy on me." So be moderate in your religious deeds and do the deeds that are within your ability: and none of you should wish for death, for if he is a good doer, he may increase his good deeds, and if he is an evil doer, he may repent to Allah
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Kisi bhi shaks ke nek amaal use Jannat mein daakhil nahi karenge.' (Yaani koi apne nek amaal ke zariye Jannat mein daakhil nahi ho sakta.) Unhone (Nabi ke sahaaba ne) pucha, 'Aap bhi nahi, Aye Allah ke Rasool?' Unhone kaha, 'Main bhi nahi, siwaaye is ke ke Allah mujhpar apna karam aur reham kare. Isliye apne deeni amaal mein mautadil raho aur wahi amaal karo jo tumhaari hasiyat mein hon; aur tum mein se koi maut ki tamanna na kare, kyunke agar wo nek hai, to wo apne nek amaal aur badha sakta hai, aur agar wo badkaar hai, to wo Allah se tauba kar sakta hai.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) , who was resting against me, saying, "O Allah! Excuse me and bestow Your Mercy on me and let me join with the highest companions (in Paradise)." See Qur'an
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko, jo mujhpar tek lagaaye hue the, ye kehte suna, 'Aye Allah! Mujhe maaf kar de aur mujhpar apni rehmat naazil kar, aur mujhe (Jannat mein) sabse ooncha darja rakhne walon ke saath mila de.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) paid a visit to a patient, or a patient was brought to him, he used to invoke Allah, saying, "Take away the disease, O the Lord of the people! Cure him as You are the One Who cures. There is no cure but Yours, a cure that leaves no disease
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab bhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) kisi mareez se milne jaate, ya koi mareez unke paas laaya jaata, wo Allah se dua karte, 'Bimaari door kar de, Aye logon ke Rab! Ise shifa de, kyunke Tu hi shifa dene wala hai. Teri shifa ke siwa koi shifa nahi, aisi shifa jo koi bimaari na chhode.'

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) came to me while I was ill. He performed ablution and threw the remaining water on me (or said, "Pour it on him) " When I came to my senses I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have no son or father to be my heir, so how will be my inheritance?" Then the Verse of inheritance was revealed
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) mere paas aaye jab main bimar tha. Unhone wuzu kiya aur baacha hua paani mujhpar daala (ya kaha, 'Ise usper daalo'). Jab mujhe hosh aaya, maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mera koi beta ya waalid nahi jo mera waaris ho, to meri miraas kaise hogi?' Isper miraas ki Aayat naazil hui.

e: Narrated `Aisha:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) emigrated to Medina, Abu Bakr and Bilal had a fever. I entered upon them and said, "O my father! How are you? O Bilal! How are you?" Whenever Abu Bakr got the fever he used to say, "Everybody is staying alive with his people, yet death is nearer to him than his shoe laces." And when fever deserted Bilal, he would recite (two poetic verses): "Would that I could stay overnight in a valley wherein I would be surrounded by Idhkhir and Jalil (two kinds of good smelling grass). Would that one day I could drink of the water of Majinna, and would that Shama and Tafil (two mountains at Mecca) would appear to me!" I went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and informed him about that. He said, "O Allah! Make us love Medina as much or more than we love Mecca, and make it healthy, and bless its Sa and its Mudd, and take away its fever and put it in Al-Juhfa." (See Hadith No)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Madina hijrat kar gaye, Abu Bakr aur Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko bukhaar chad gaya. Main unke paas gayi aur kaha, 'Aye mere waalid! Aap kaise hain? Aye Bilal! Aap kaise hain?' Jab bhi Abu Bakr ko bukhaar chadta, wo kehte, 'Har koi apni qaum mein zinda rehta hai, phir bhi maut uski jooti ke fite se bhi zyaada qareeb hai.' Aur jab Bilal ka bukhaar utarta, wo ye do sher padhte: 'Kaash main kisi wadi mein raat guzaar sakoon jahaan mere aas-paas Idhkhir aur Jalil hon. Kaash ek din main Majinna ka paani pee sakoon, aur kaash Shama aur Tafil mujhe dikhaayi de jaayein!' Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gayi aur unhein ye baat bataayi. Unhone farmaya, 'Aye Allah! Humein Madina se utni ya usse zyaada mohabbat karwaa jitni humein Makkah se hai, aur ise sehatmand bana de, aur iske Sa aur Mudd mein barkat de, aur iska bukhaar door karke Al-Juhfa mein bhej de.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There is no disease that Allah has created, except that He also has created its treatment
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Koi bhi bimaari aisi nahi hai jo Allah ne banaayi ho, magar usne uska ilaaj bhi banaaya hai.'

e: Narrated Rubai bint Mu`adh bin Afra:We used to go for Military expeditions along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and provide the people with water, serve them and bring the dead and the wounded back to Medina
hi: Rubai bint Mu'adh bin Afra bataati hain: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath fauji mohimon par jaaya karte the aur logon ko paani dete, unki khidmat karte, aur murda aur zakhmiyon ko Madina wapas laate.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:(The Prophet (ﷺ) said), "Healing is in three things: A gulp of honey, cupping, and branding with fire (cauterizing)." But I forbid my followers to use (cauterization) branding with fire
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: (Nabi SAW ne kaha,) 'Shifa teen cheezon mein hai: shehad ka ek ghoont, Hijama (pachchhi/cupping), aur aag se daagh lagaana (cauterization). Magar main apne maanne walon ko daagh lagaane se mana karta hoon.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Healing is in three things: cupping, a gulp of honey or cauterization, (branding with fire) but I forbid my followers to use cauterization (branding with fire)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Shifa teen cheezon mein hai: Hijama, shehad ka ek ghoont, ya daagh lagaana, magar main apne maanne walon ko daagh lagaane se mana karta hoon.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to like sweet edible things and honey
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) meethi cheezein aur shehad pasand karte the.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "If there is any healing in your medicines, then it is in cupping, a gulp of honey or branding with fire (cauterization) that suits the ailment, but I don't like to be (cauterized) branded with fire
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Agar tumhaari dawaaon mein koi shifa hai, to wo Hijama mein hai, shehad ke ek ghoont mein, ya aag se daagh lagaane mein jo bimaari ke mutaabik ho, magar mujhe khud daagh lagaana pasand nahi.'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "My brother has some Abdominal trouble." The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him "Let him drink honey." The man came for the second time and the Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, 'Let him drink honey." He came for the third time and the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Let him drink honey." He returned again and said, "I have done that ' The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "Allah has said the truth, but your brother's `Abdomen has told a lie. Let him drink honey." So he made him drink honey and he was cured
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Mere bhai ke pet mein takleef hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne unse kaha, 'Use shehad pilaao.' Wo aadmi doosri baar aaya aur Nabi (SAW) ne unse kaha, 'Use shehad pilaao.' Wo teesri baar aaya aur Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Use shehad pilaao.' Wo phir wapas aaya aur kaha, 'Maine wo kar liya hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne phir farmaya, 'Allah ne sach kaha, magar tumhaare bhai ke pet ne jhoot bola hai. Use shehad pilaao.' To unhone use shehad pilaaya aur wo theek ho gaya.

e: Narrated Anas:Some people were sick and they said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Give us shelter and food. So when they became healthy they said, "The weather of Medina is not suitable for us." So he sent them to Al-Harra with some she-camels of his and said, "Drink of their milk." But when they became healthy, they killed the shepherd of the Prophet (ﷺ) and drove away his camels. The Prophet (ﷺ) sent some people in their pursuit. Then he got their hands and feet cut and their eyes were branded with heated pieces of iron. I saw one of them licking the earth with his tongue till he died
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Kuch log bimar the aur unhone kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Humein rehne ki jagah aur khaana dijiye.' To jab wo sehatmand ho gaye, unhone kaha, 'Madina ka mausam hamare liye theek nahi hai.' To unhone unhein apni kuch oontniyon ke saath Al-Harra bhej diya aur kaha, 'Inka doodh piyo.' Magar jab wo sehatmand ho gaye, unhone Nabi (SAW) ke charwaahe ko qatl kar diya aur unke oont hankaa kar le gaye. Nabi (SAW) ne unke peechhe kuch log bheje. Phir unke haath aur pair kaate gaye aur unki aankhon mein garam loha daaga gaya. Maine unmein se ek ko apni zubaan se zameen chaatte hue dekha yahaan tak ke wo mar gaya.

e: Narrated Anas:The climate of Medina did not suit some people, so the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered them to follow his shepherd, i.e. his camels, and drink their milk and urine (as a medicine). So they followed the shepherd that is the camels and drank their milk and urine till their bodies became healthy. Then they killed the shepherd and drove away the camels. When the news reached the Prophet (ﷺ) he sent some people in their pursuit. When they were brought, he cut their hands and feet and their eyes were branded with heated pieces of iron
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Kuch logon ke liye Madina ka mausam maafiq nahi tha, isliye Nabi (SAW) ne unhein hukm diya ke wo unke charwaahe, yaani unke oonton, ke saath jaayein aur unka doodh aur peshaab (dawa ke taur par) piyein. To wo charwaahe, yaani oonton, ke saath gaye aur unka doodh aur peshaab piya yahaan tak ke unke jism sehatmand ho gaye. Phir unhone charwaahe ko qatl kar diya aur oont hankaa kar le gaye. Jab ye khabar Nabi (SAW) tak pahunchi, unhone unke peechhe kuch log bheje. Jab unhein laaya gaya, unhone unke haath aur pair kaat diye aur unki aankhon mein garam loha daaga.

e: Narrated Khalid bin Sa`d:We went out and Ghalib bin Abjar was accompanying us. He fell ill on the way and when we arrived at Medina he was still sick. Ibn Abi 'Atiq came to visit him and said to us, "Treat him with black cumin. Take five or seven seeds and crush them (mix the powder with oil) and drop the resulting mixture into both nostrils, for `Aisha has narrated to me that she heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, 'This black cumin is healing for all diseases except As-Sam.' Aisha said, 'What is As-Sam?' He said, 'Death
hi: Khalid bin Sa'd bataate hain: Hum nikle aur Ghalib bin Abjar humaare saath the. Wo raaste mein bimar pad gaye aur jab hum Madina pahunche, wo abhi bhi bimar the. Ibn Abi Atiq unse milne aaye aur humse kaha, 'Inka ilaaj kaalonji se karo. Paanch ya saat daane lo aur unhein pees lo (tel mein mila kar) aur ye mishran dono naakon mein daalo, kyunke Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne mujhe bataaya hai ke unhone Nabi (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, "Ye kaalonji As-Saam ke siwa har bimaari ke liye shifa hai."' Aisha ne pucha, 'As-Saam kya hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Maut.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "There is healing in black cumin for all diseases except death
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Kaalonji mein maut ke siwa har bimaari ke liye shifa hai.'

e: Narrated 'Urwa:Aisha used to recommend at-Talbina for the sick and for such a person as grieved over a dead person. She used to say, "I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, 'at-Talbina gives rest to the heart of the patient and makes it active and relieves some of his sorrow and grief
hi: Urwa bataate hain: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bimaar aur us shaks ke liye jo kisi mayyat ke gam mein ho, Talbina (jau ka dalia) ki sifaarish kiya karti thin. Wo kehti thin, 'Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, "Talbina mareez ke dil ko sukoon deta hai aur use sakriya banaata hai, aur uske kuch gam aur dukh ko kam karta hai."'

e: Narrated Hisham's father:`Aisha used to recommend at-Talbina and used to say, "It is disliked (by the patient) although it is beneficial
hi: Hisham ke waalid bataate hain: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) Talbina ki sifaarish kiya karti thin aur kehti thin, 'Ye (mareez ko) napasand hoti hai, halaanke ye faaydemand hoti hai.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) was cupped and he paid the wages to the one who had cupped him and then took Su'ut (Medicine sniffed by nose)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ka Hijama (pachchhi) kiya gaya, aur unhone Hijama karne wale ki mazdoori adaa ki, phir Su'ut (naak se sungha jaane wali dawa) li.

e: Narrated Um Qais bint Mihsan:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Treat with the Indian incense, for it has healing for seven diseases; it is to be sniffed by one having throat trouble, and to be put into one side of the mouth of one suffering from pleurisy." Once I went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with a son of mine who would not eat any food, and the boy passed urine on him whereupon he asked for some water and sprinkled it over the place of urine
hi: Umm Qais bint Mihsan (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Hindustaani loban (Qust-e-Hindi) se ilaaj karo, kyunke isme saat bimaariyon ke liye shifa hai; ise gale ki takleef waale ko sunghaaya jaata hai, aur pasli ke dard waale ke munh ke ek taraf rakha jaata hai.' Ek baar main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas apne bete ke saath gayi jo kuch nahi khaata tha, aur us ladke ne unpar peshaab kar diya, isper unhone kuch paani maangaya aur peshaab wali jagah par chhidak diya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) was cupped while he was fasting
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ka Hijama (pachchhi) roze ki haalat mein kiya gaya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) was cupped while he was in a state of Ihram
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ka Hijama Ihram ki haalat mein kiya gaya.

e: Narrated Anas:that he was asked about the wages of the one who cups others. He said, 'Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was cupped by `Abd Taiba, to whom he gave two Sa of food and interceded for him with his masters who consequently reduced what they used to charge him daily. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The best medicines you may treat yourselves with are cupping and sea incense.' He added, "You should not torture your children by treating tonsillitis by pressing the tonsils or the palate with the finger, but use incense
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Unse Hijama karne wale ki mazdoori ke baare mein pucha gaya. Unhone kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka Hijama Abd Taiba ne kiya, jinhein unhone do Sa anaaj diya aur unke maalikon se sifaarish ki jinhone iske badle unse rozaana liye jaane wale (mahsool) mein kami kar di. Phir Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, "Behtareen dawaayein jinse tum apna ilaaj kar sakte ho wo Hijama aur samundari loban hain."' Unhone aage kaha, 'Tumhein apne bachon ko takleef nahi deni chaahiye tonsil ki bimaari ka ilaaj ungli se tonsil ya taalu daba kar karke, balke loban istemaal karo.'

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:that he paid Al-Muqanna a visit during his illness and said, "I will not leave till he gets cupped, for I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "There is healing in cupping
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Unhone Al-Muqanna se unki bimaari ke dauraan mulaakaat ki aur kaha, 'Main tab tak nahi jaunga jab tak wo Hijama na karwa lein, kyunke maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, "Hijama mein shifa hai."'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Buhaina:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was cupped on the middle of his head at Lahl Jamal on his way to Mecca while he was in a state of Ihram. Narrated Ibn `Abbas: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was cupped on his head
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Buhaina (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka Hijama unke sar ke beech mein, Lahl Jamal mein, Makkah jaane ke raaste mein, Ihram ki haalat mein kiya gaya. Ravi Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka Hijama unke sar par kiya gaya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) was cupped on his head for an ailment he was suffering from while he was in a state of Ihram. at a water place called Lahl Jamal. Ibn `Abbas further said: Allah's Apostle was cupped on his head for unilateral headache while he was in a state of Ihram
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ka Hijama unke sar par ek bimaari ke ilaaj ke liye kiya gaya jabke wo Ihram ki haalat mein the, Lahl Jamal naami ek paani ki jagah par. Ibn Abbas ne aage kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka Hijama unke sar par ek-taraf-a sardard ke liye kiya gaya jabke wo Ihram ki haalat mein the.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "If there is any good in your medicines, then it is in a gulp of honey, a cupping operation, or branding (cauterization), but I do not like to be (cauterized) branded
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Agar tumhaari dawaaon mein koi bhalaai hai, to wo shehad ke ek ghoont mein, Hijama mein, ya daagh lagaane mein hai, magar mujhe khud daagh lagwaana pasand nahi.'

e: Narrated Ka`b bin Ujrah:The Prophet (ﷺ) came to me during the period of Al-Hudaibiya, while I was lighting fire underneath a cooking pot and lice were falling down my head. He said, "Do your lice hurt your?" I said, "Yes." He said, "Shave your head and fast for three days or feed six poor persons or slaughter a sheep as a sacrifice:
hi: Ka'b bin Ujrah bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) Hudaibiya ke daur mein mere paas aaye, jabke main ek degchi ke neeche aag jala raha tha aur meri jueein mere sar se gir rahi thi. Unhone kaha, 'Kya jueein tumhein takleef deti hain?' Maine kaha, 'Haan.' Unhone kaha, 'Apna sar mundwaao aur teen din roza rakho, ya chhe gareebon ko khaana khilaao, ya qurbaani ke taur par ek bakri zibah karo.'

e: Narrated Jabir:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If there is any healing in your medicines then it is a cupping operation, or branding (cauterization), but I do not like to be (cauterized) branded
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar tumhaari dawaaon mein koi shifa hai, to wo Hijama mein hai, ya daagh lagaane mein, magar mujhe khud daagh lagwaana pasand nahi.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Nations were displayed before me; one or two prophets would pass by along with a few followers. A prophet would pass by accompanied by nobody. Then a big crowd of people passed in front of me and I asked, Who are they Are they my followers?" It was said, 'No. It is Moses and his followers It was said to me, 'Look at the horizon.'' Behold! There was a multitude of people filling the horizon. Then it was said to me, 'Look there and there about the stretching sky! Behold! There was a multitude filling the horizon,' It was said to me, 'This is your nation out of whom seventy thousand shall enter Paradise without reckoning.' "Then the Prophet (ﷺ) entered his house without telling his companions who they (the 70,000) were. So the people started talking about the issue and said, "It is we who have believed in Allah and followed His Apostle; therefore those people are either ourselves or our children who are born m the Islamic era, for we were born in the Pre-Islamic Period of Ignorance.'' When the Prophet (ﷺ) heard of that, he came out and said. "Those people are those who do not treat themselves with Ruqya, nor do they believe in bad or good omen (from birds etc.) nor do they get themselves branded (Cauterized). but they put their trust (only) in their Lord " On that 'Ukasha bin Muhsin said. "Am I one of them, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?' The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Yes." Then another person got up and said, "Am I one of them?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Ukasha has anticipated you
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Mere saamne ummaten pesh ki gayin; ek ya do Nabi apne kuch maanne walon ke saath guzarte, ek Nabi bina kisi ke saath guzarte. Phir ek bada hujoom mere saamne se guzra aur maine pucha, "Ye kaun hain? Kya ye mere maanne wale hain?" Kaha gaya, "Nahi. Ye Musa aur unke maanne wale hain." Phir mujhse kaha gaya, "Ufuq (kshitij) ki taraf dekho." Dekha to ek bhaari bheed thi jo poore ufuq ko bhar rahi thi. Phir mujhse kaha gaya, "Wahaan dekho aur wahaan, phaile hue aasman ki taraf!" Dekha to ek bhaari bheed thi jo poore ufuq ko bhar rahi thi. Mujhse kaha gaya, "Ye tumhaari ummat hai, jinmein se sattar hazaar bina hisaab-kitaab ke Jannat mein daakhil honge."' Phir Nabi (SAW) apne ghar chale gaye bina apne sahaaba ko bataaye ke wo (sattar hazaar) kaun hain. To log is baare mein baatein karne lage aur kaha, 'Hum hi wo hain jo Allah par Iman laaye aur uske Rasool ki pairvi ki; isliye wo log ya to hum khud hain ya humaare bachche jo Islami daur mein paida hue, kyunke hum Jaahiliyat ke daur mein paida hue the.' Jab Nabi (SAW) ne ye suna, wo baahar aaye aur kaha, 'Wo log wahi hain jo apna ilaaj Ruqya se nahi karwaate, na (parindon waghera se) shagun mein Yaqeen rakhte hain, na khud ko daagh lagwaate hain, balke wo sirf apne Rab par bharosa karte hain.' Isper Ukasha bin Muhsin ne kaha, 'Kya main unmein se hoon, Aye Allah ke Rasool?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Haan.' Phir ek aur shaks khada hua aur kaha, 'Kya main unmein se hoon?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Ukasha tumse pehle hi ye keh chuke.'

e: Narrated Um Salama:The husband of a lady died and her eyes became sore and the people mentioned her story to the Prophet They asked him whether it was permissible for her to use kohl as her eyes were exposed to danger. He said, "Previously, when one of you was bereaved by a husband she would stay in her dirty clothes in a bad unhealthy house (for one year), and when a dog passed by, she would throw a globe of dung. No, (she should observe the prescribed period Idda) for four months and ten days
hi: Umm Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ek khaatoon ke shohar ka intekaal ho gaya aur unki aankhein bimar ho gayin, aur logon ne unki kahaani Nabi (SAW) ko bataayi. Unhone Nabi (SAW) se pucha ke kya unke liye surma lagaana jaayez hai kyunke unki aankhein khatre mein hain. Unhone kaha, 'Pehle, jab tum mein se kisi ka shohar mar jaata, wo (ek saal tak) apne ganday kapdon mein ek bekaar aur naa-sehat ghar mein rehti, aur jab koi kutta guzarta, wo gobar ka golaa phenkti. Nahi, (usse muqarrar Iddat ki muddat, yaani) chaar mahine das din poore karne chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "(There is) no 'Adwa (no contagious disease is conveyed without Allah's permission). nor is there any bad omen (from birds), nor is there any Hamah, nor is there any bad omen in the month of Safar, and one should run away from the leper as one runs away from a lion." Note: The majority of scholars interpret this to mean that these things in and of themselves do not transmit or cause harm through supernatural or hidden means but that Allah is ultimately in control and any fearful superstition around these is false
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Koi bhi bimaari khud-ba-khud (Allah ki ijaazat ke bagair) ek se doosre mein nahi failti, na parindon se koi bad-shagun hota hai, na "Hamah" (ek purani jaahili maanyata) sach hai, na Safar mahine mein koi badshaguni hai, aur kodhi (kushth rog ke mareez) se aise bhaago jaise sher se bhaagte ho.' (Zyaadatar ulama iski tashreeh karte hain ke ye cheezein khud kisi jaadui ya chhupi taaqat se koi nuqsaan nahi pahunchaati, balke sab kuch Allah ke haath mein hai, aur inke baare mein koi bhi khauf ya andhvishwaas bebuniyaad hai.)

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Zaid:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Truffles are like Manna (i.e. they grow naturally without man's care) and their water heals eye diseases
hi: Saeed bin Zaid bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Kumbh (truffles) Mann jaisi hain (yaani wo bina kisi insaani mehnat ke khud-ba-khud ugti hain), aur unka paani aankhon ki bimaariyon ke liye shifa hai.'
(Is hadees ka asal matn maujood nahi hai — source data mein khaali chhoda gaya hai.)

e: Narrated Um Qais:I went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) along with a a son of mine whose palate and tonsils I had pressed with my finger as a treatment for a (throat and tonsil) disease. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Why do you pain your children by pressing their throats! Use Ud Al-Hindi (certain Indian incense) for it cures seven diseases, one of which is pleurisy. It is used as a snuff for treating throat and tonsil disease and it is inserted into one side of the mouth of one suffering from pleurisy
hi: Umm Qais bataati hain: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas apne ek bete ke saath gayi jiske taalu aur tonsil maine ek gale/tonsil ki bimaari ke ilaaj ke liye apni ungli se daba diye the. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Tum apne bachon ko unke gale dabaakar kyun takleef deti ho! Ud Al-Hindi (ek khaas Hindustaani loban) istemaal karo, kyunke ye saat bimaariyon ka ilaaj karta hai, jinmein se ek pasli ka dard hai. Ise gale aur tonsil ki bimaari ke ilaaj ke liye sunghaaya jaata hai, aur ise pasli ke dard waale ke munh ke ek taraf rakha jaata hai.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) When the health of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) deteriorated and his condition became serious, he asked the permission of all his wives to allow him to be treated In my house, and they allowed him. He came out, supported by two men and his legs were dragging on the ground between `Abbas and another man. (The sub-narrator told Ibn `Abbas who said: Do you know who was the other man whom `Aisha did not mention? The sub-narrator said: No. Ibn `Abbas said: It was `Ali.) `Aisha added: When the Prophet entered my house and his disease became aggravated, he said, "Pour on me seven water skins full of water (the tying ribbons of which had not been untied) so that I may give some advice to the people." So we made him sit in a tub belonging to Hafsa, the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ) and started pouring water on him from those water skins till he waved us to stop. Then he went out to the people and led them in prayer and delivered a speech before them
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki zawja) bataati hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sehat bigadne lagi aur unki haalat sanjeeda ho gayi, unhone apni sab biwiyon se ijaazat maangi ke unhein mere ghar mein ilaaj karwaane diya jaaye, aur unhone ijaazat de di. Wo do aadmiyon ke sahaare baahar aaye, unke pair zameen par ghisat rahe the, Abbas aur ek aur aadmi ke beech mein. (Ravi ne Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha, 'Kya aapko pata hai wo doosra aadmi kaun tha jiska naam Aisha ne nahi liya?' Ravi ne kaha, 'Nahi.' Ibn Abbas ne kaha, 'Wo Ali (Alayhis Salam) the.') Aisha ne aage kaha: Jab Nabi (SAW) mere ghar daakhil hue aur unki bimaari aur badh gayi, unhone kaha, 'Mujhpar saat mashkein bhar paani daalo (jinki dorī khuli na ho) taake main logon ko kuch naseehat de sakoon.' To humne unhein Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا), Nabi (SAW) ki zawja, ke ek tashtari mein bithaaya aur un mashkon se unpar paani daalna shuru kiya yahaan tak ke unhone humein rukne ka ishara kiya. Phir wo logon ke paas gaye aur unhein namaz padhaayi aur unke saamne khutba diya.

e: Narrated Um Qais:that she took to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) one of her sons whose palate and tonsils she had pressed because he had throat trouble. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Why do you pain your children by getting the palate pressed like that? Use the Ud Al-Hindi (certain Indian incense) for it cures seven diseases one of which is pleurisy
hi: Umm Qais bataati hain: Wo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas apne ek bete ko le gayin jiske taalu aur tonsil unhone gale ki takleef ki wajah se daba diye the. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Tum apne bachon ko taalu isi tarah dabaakar kyun takleef deti ho? Ud Al-Hindi (ek khaas Hindustaani loban) istemaal karo, kyunke ye saat bimaariyon ka ilaaj karta hai, jinmein se ek pasli ka dard hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id:A man came to the prophet and said, 'My brother has got loose motions. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, Let him drink honey." The man again (came) and said, 'I made him drink (honey) but that made him worse.' The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Allah has said the Truth, and the `Abdomen of your brother has told a lie." (See Hadith No)
hi: Abu Saeed bataate hain: Ek shaks Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Mere bhai ko dast lag rahe hain.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Use shehad pilaao.' Wo shaks phir aaya aur kaha, 'Maine use shehad pilaaya magar isse haalat aur bigad gayi.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Allah ne sach kaha, aur tumhaare bhai ke pet ne jhoot bola.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'There is no 'Adwa (no disease is conveyed from the sick to the healthy without Allah's permission), nor Safar, nor Hama." A bedouin stood up and said, "Then what about my camels? They are like deer on the sand, but when a mangy camel comes and mixes with them, they all get infected with mangy." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Then who conveyed the (mange) disease to the first one?
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Koi Adwa (khud-ba-khud failne wali bimaari) nahi hai, na Safar (mahine ki badshaguni), na Hamah (jaahili maanyata).' Ek badawi khada hua aur kaha, 'To phir mere oonton ka kya, jo registaan mein hiran jaise (sehatmand) hote hain, magar jab ek khaarish-zada oont unmein aakar mil jaata hai, to sab khaarish ke shikaar ho jaate hain?' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'To phir pehle (oont) ko ye bimaari kisne di?'

e: Narrated Um Oais:that she took to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) one of her sons whose palate and tonsils she had pressed to treat a throat trouble. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Be afraid of Allah! Why do you pain your children by having their tonsils pressed like that? Use the Ud Al-Hindi (a certain Indian incense) for it cures seven diseases, one of which is pleurisy
hi: Umm Qais bataati hain: Wo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas apne ek bete ko le gayin jiske taalu aur tonsil unhone gale ki takleef ke ilaaj ke liye daba diye the. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Allah se daro! Tum apne bachon ko unke tonsil isi tarah dabaakar kyun takleef deti ho? Ud Al-Hindi istemaal karo, kyunke ye saat bimaariyon ka ilaaj karta hai, jinmein se ek pasli ka dard hai.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) allowed one of the Ansar families to treat persons who have taken poison and also who are suffering from ear ailment with Ruqya. Anas added: I got myself branded cauterized) for pleurisy, when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was still alive. Abu Talha, Anas bin An-Nadr and Zaid bin Thabit witnessed that, and it was Abu Talha who branded (cauterized) me
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ansaar ke ek khaandaan ko un logon ka ilaaj Ruqya se karne ki ijaazat di jinhone zeher khaaya ho ya jinhein kaan ki bimaari ho. Anas ne aage kaha: Mujhe pasli ke dard ke liye daagh lagwaaya gaya, jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) zinda the. Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ), Anas bin An-Nadr aur Zaid bin Thabit (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne ye dekha, aur Abu Talha hi the jinhone mujhe daagh lagaaya.

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d As-Sa`idi:When the helmet broke on the head of the Prophet (ﷺ) and his face became covered with blood and his incisor tooth broke (i.e. during the battle of Uhud), `Ali used to bring water in his shield while Fatima was washing the blood off his face. When Fatima saw that the bleeding increased because of the water, she took a mat (of palm leaves), burnt it, and stuck it (the burnt ashes) on the wound of Allah's Apostle, whereupon the bleeding stopped
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) As-Sa'idi bataate hain: Jab Nabi (SAW) ke sar par khod (helmet) tooti aur unka chehra khoon se bhar gaya aur unka daant toota (jang-e-Uhud ke dauraan), Ali (Alayhis Salam) apni dhaal mein paani laate the jabke Fatima (Alayhas Salam) unke chehre ka khoon dho rahi thin. Jab Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ne dekha ke paani se khoon aur badh raha hai, unhone ek chataayi (khajoor ke patton ki) li, use jalaaya, aur use (jali hui raakh ko) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zakhm par chipka diya, isper khoon bahna ruk gaya.

e: Narrated Nazi':`Abdullah bin `Umar said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Fever is from the heat of Hell, so put it out (cool it) with water.' " Nafi` added: `Abdullah used to say, "O Allah! Relieve us from the punishment," (when he suffered from fever)
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, "Bukhaar Jahannam ki garmi se hai, isliye use paani se bujhaao (thanda karo)."' Nafi ne aage kaha: Abdullah (bin Umar) kaha karte the, 'Aye Allah! Humein azaab se raahat de,' (jab unhein bukhaar hota).

e: Narrated Fatima bint Al-Mundhir:Whenever a lady suffering from fever was brought to Asma' bint Abu Bakr, she used to invoke Allah for her and then sprinkle some water on her body, at the chest and say, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to order us to abate fever with water
hi: Fatima (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Al-Mundhir bataati hain: Jab bhi bukhaar se pareshaan koi khaatoon Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Abu Bakr (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas laayi jaati, wo unke liye Allah se dua karti aur phir unke jism, chhaati par, thoda paani chhidakti aur kehti, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) humein bukhaar ko paani se kam karne ka hukm diya karte the.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Fever is from the heat of Hell, so abate fever with water
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Bukhaar Jahannam ki garmi se hai, isliye bukhaar ko paani se kam karo.'

e: Narrated Rafi` bin Khadij:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "Fever is from the heat of Hell, so abate fever with water
hi: Rafi' bin Khadij (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Bukhaar Jahannam ki garmi se hai, isliye bukhaar ko paani se kam karo.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Some people from the tribes of `Ukl and `Uraina came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and embraced Islam and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We are owners of livestock and have never been farmers," and they found the climate of Medina unsuitable for them. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered that they be given some camels and a shepherd, and ordered them to go out with those camels and drink their milk and urine. So they set out, but when they reached a place called Al-Harra, they reverted to disbelief after their conversion to Islam, killed the shepherd and drove away the camels. When this news reached the Prophet (ﷺ) he sent in their pursuit (and they were caught and brought). The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered that their eyes be branded with heated iron bars and their hands be cut off, and they were left at Al-Harra till they died in that state
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ukl aur Uraina qabeelon ke kuch log Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur Islam qubool kiya aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Hum maweshiyon ke maalik hain aur kabhi kisaan nahi rahe,' aur unhein Madina ka mausam maafiq nahi laga. To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne hukm diya ke unhein kuch oont aur ek charwaaha diya jaaye, aur unhein hukm diya ke wo un oonton ke saath jaayein aur unka doodh aur peshaab piyein. To wo rawaana hue, magar jab wo Al-Harra naami jagah pahunche, Islam qubool karne ke baad wapas kufr ki taraf mud gaye, charwaahe ko qatl kar diya aur oont hankaa kar le gaye. Jab ye khabar Nabi (SAW) tak pahunchi, unhone unke peechhe log bheje (aur unhein pakad kar laaya gaya). Nabi (SAW) ne hukm diya ke unki aankhon mein garam loha daaga jaaye aur unke haath kaat diye jaayein, aur unhein Al-Harra mein chhod diya gaya yahaan tak ke wo usi haalat mein mar gaye.

e: Narrated Saud:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If you hear of an outbreak of plague in a land, do not enter it; but if the plague breaks out in a place while you are in it, do not leave that place
hi: (Ravi) Sa'd bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar tum kisi ilaake mein mahamaari (talaa'oon) failne ki khabar suno, to wahaan mat jaao; magar agar tum jahaan ho wahaan mahamaari phail jaaye, to wo jagah mat chhodo.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abbas:`Umar bin Al-Khattab departed for Sham and when he reached Sargh, the commanders of the (Muslim) army, Abu 'Ubaida bin Al-Jarrah and his companions met him and told him that an epidemic had broken out in Sham. `Umar said, "Call for me the early emigrants." So `Umar called them, consulted them and informed them that an epidemic had broken out in Sham. Those people differed in their opinions. Some of them said, "We have come out for a purpose and we do not think that it is proper to give it up," while others said (to `Umar), "You have along with you. other people and the companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) so do not advise that we take them to this epidemic." `Umar said to them, "Leave me now." Then he said, "Call the Ansar for me." I called them and he consulted them and they followed the way of the emigrants and differed as they did. He then said to them, Leave me now," and added, "Call for me the old people of Quraish who emigrated in the year of the Conquest of Mecca." I called them and they gave a unanimous opinion saying, "We advise that you should return with the people and do not take them to that (place) of epidemic." So `Umar made an announcement, "I will ride back to Medina in the morning, so you should do the same." Abu 'Ubaida bin Al-Jarrah said (to `Umar), "Are you running away from what Allah had ordained?" `Umar said, "Would that someone else had said such a thing, O Abu 'Ubaida! Yes, we are running from what Allah had ordained to what Allah has ordained. Don't you agree that if you had camels that went down a valley having two places, one green and the other dry, you would graze them on the green one only if Allah had ordained that, and you would graze them on the dry one only if Allah had ordained that?" At that time `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf, who had been absent because of some job, came and said, "I have some knowledge about this. I have heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, 'If you hear about it (an outbreak of plague) in a land, do not go to it; but if plague breaks out in a country where you are staying, do not run away from it.' " `Umar thanked Allah and returned to Medina
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab Sham ke liye rawaana hue, aur jab wo Sargh pahunche, fauj ke senapatiyon, Abu Ubaida bin Al-Jarrah aur unke saathiyon ne unse mulaakaat ki aur bataaya ke Sham mein mahamaari phail gayi hai. Umar ne kaha, 'Mere liye pehle hijrat karne walon ko bulaao.' To Umar ne unhein bulaaya, unse mashwara kiya, aur unhein bataaya ke Sham mein mahamaari phail gayi hai. Un logon ki raay alag-alag thi. Kuch ne kaha, 'Hum ek maqsad ke liye nikle hain aur humein nahi lagta ke ise chhodna theek hoga,' jabke doosron ne (Umar se) kaha, 'Aapke saath doosre log bhi hain aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke sahaaba bhi, isliye humein mashwara mat dijiye ke hum unhein is mahamaari mein le jaayein.' Umar ne unse kaha, 'Ab mujhe chhod do.' Phir unhone kaha, 'Mere liye Ansaar ko bulaao.' Maine unhein bulaaya, aur unhone unse mashwara liya, aur unhone bhi hijrat karne walon jaisa hi raasta apnaaya aur unki hi tarah ikhtelaaf kiya. Phir unhone unse kaha, 'Ab mujhe chhod do,' aur kaha, 'Mere liye Quraish ke un budhon ko bulaao jinhone Fatah-e-Makkah ke saal hijrat ki thi.' Maine unhein bulaaya aur unhone sarvasammati se raay di, 'Hum sifaarish karte hain ke aap logon ko lekar wapas jaayein aur unhein us mahamaari waali jagah mat le jaayein.' To Umar ne elaan kiya, 'Main subah Madina wapas jaunga, isliye tum bhi aisa hi karo.' Abu Ubaida bin Al-Jarrah ne (Umar se) kaha, 'Kya aap Allah ke muqarrar kiye hue se bhaag rahe hain?' Umar ne kaha, 'Kaash ye baat kisi aur ne kahi hoti, Aye Abu Ubaida! Haan, hum Allah ke ek muqarrar kiye hue se doosre muqarrar kiye hue ki taraf bhaag rahe hain. Kya tum nahi maante ke agar tumhaare paas oont hon jo ek wadi mein utrein jiske do hisse hon, ek harabhara aur doosra sookha, to agar Allah ne muqarrar kiya ho to tum unhein harabhare hisse mein hi charaoge, aur agar Allah ne muqarrar kiya ho to tum unhein sookhe hisse mein hi charaoge?' Us waqt Abdur Rahman bin Auf (رضی اللہ عنہ), jo kisi kaam ki wajah se gair-haazir the, aaye aur kaha, 'Mujhe iske baare mein kuch ilm hai. Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, "Agar tum kisi ilaake mein iske (mahamaari ke) phailne ki khabar suno, to wahaan mat jaao; magar agar mahamaari kisi mulk mein phail jaaye jahaan tum maujood ho, to wahaan se bhaago mat."' Umar ne Allah ka shukr adaa kiya aur Madina wapas laut gaye.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin 'Amir:`Umar went to Sham and when he reached Sargh, he got the news that an epidemic (of plague) had broken out in Sham. `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf told him that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If you hear that it (plague) has broken out in a land, do not go to it; but if it breaks out in a land where you are present, do not go out escaping from it
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Aamir bataate hain: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) Sham ke liye gaye, aur jab wo Sargh pahunche, unhein khabar mili ke Sham mein mahamaari phail gayi hai. Abdur Rahman bin Auf (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne unse kaha ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya tha, 'Agar tum suno ke kisi ilaake mein ye (mahamaari) phail gayi hai, to wahaan mat jaao; magar agar ye kisi ilaake mein phail jaaye jahaan tum maujood ho, to wahaan se bhaag kar mat nikalo.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Neither Messiah (Ad-Dajjal) nor plague will enter Medina
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Na Dajjal (Masih-Dajjal) aur na mahamaari Madina mein daakhil hongi.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "(Death from) plague is martyrdom for every Muslim
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, '(Mahamaari se maut) har Musalmaan ke liye shahaadat hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He (a Muslim) who dies of an abdominal disease is a martyr, and he who dies of plague is a martyr
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo (Musalmaan) pet ki bimaari se marta hai wo shaheed hai, aur jo mahamaari se marta hai wo shaheed hai.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) that she asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about plague, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) informed her saying, "Plague was a punishment which Allah used to send on whom He wished, but Allah made it a blessing for the believers. None (among the believers) remains patient in a land in which plague has broken out and considers that nothing will befall him except what Allah has ordained for him, but that Allah will grant him a reward similar to that of a martyr
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki zawja) bataati hain: Unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se mahamaari ke baare mein pucha, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhein bataaya, 'Mahamaari ek azaab thi jise Allah jispar chaahe bhejta tha, magar Allah ne ise Momineen ke liye rehmat bana diya. Koi bhi (Momin) aise ilaake mein sabra nahi karta jahaan mahamaari phaili ho aur ye samajhta hai ke usko sirf wahi pahunchega jo Allah ne uske liye muqarrar kiya hai, magar Allah use ek shaheed jaisa ajr dega.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:During the Prophet's fatal illness, he used to recite the Mu'auwidhat (Surat An-Nas and Surat Al- Falaq) and then blow his breath over his body. When his illness was aggravated, I used to recite those two Suras and blow my breath over him and make him rub his body with his own hand for its blessings." (Ma`mar asked Az-Zuhri: How did the Prophet (ﷺ) use to blow? Az-Zuhri said: He used to blow on his hands and then passed them over his face
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ki aakhri bimaari ke dauraan, wo Mu'auwidhataan (Surah An-Nas aur Surah Al-Falaq) padha karte the aur phir apni saans apne jism par phoonkte. Jab unki bimaari aur badh gayi, main wo do Surate padhti aur unpar apni saans phoonkti, aur unka haath unke jism par barkat ke liye phera deti.' (Ma'mar ne Az-Zuhri se pucha: Nabi (SAW) kaise phoonkte the? Az-Zuhri ne kaha: Wo apne haathon par phoonkte the phir unhein apne chehre par phera lete the.)

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Some of the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) came across a tribe amongst the tribes of the Arabs, and that tribe did not entertain them. While they were in that state, the chief of that tribe was bitten by a snake (or stung by a scorpion). They said, (to the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) ), "Have you got any medicine with you or anybody who can treat with Ruqya?" The Prophet's companions said, "You refuse to entertain us, so we will not treat (your chief) unless you pay us for it." So they agreed to pay them a flock of sheep. One of them (the Prophet's companions) started reciting Surat-al-Fatiha and gathering his saliva and spitting it (at the snake-bite). The patient got cured and his people presented the sheep to them, but they said, "We will not take it unless we ask the Prophet (whether it is lawful)." When they asked him, he smiled and said, "How do you know that Surat-al-Fatiha is a Ruqya? Take it (flock of sheep) and assign a share for me
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ke kuch sahaaba Arab ke ek qabeele se guzre, aur us qabeele ne unki mehmaan-nawaazi nahi ki. Isi dauraan, qabeele ke sardaar ko saanp ne kaat liya (ya bicchu ne dansa). Unhone (Nabi ke sahaaba se) kaha, 'Kya tumhaare paas koi dawa hai ya koi jo Ruqya se ilaaj kar sake?' Nabi (SAW) ke sahaaba ne kaha, 'Tumne hamaari mehmaan-nawaazi se inkaar kiya, isliye hum (tumhaare sardaar ka) ilaaj nahi karenge jab tak tum humein iske badle kuch do.' To wo unhein bakriyon ka ek jhund dene par razi ho gaye. Unmein se ek (Nabi ke sahaabi) ne Surah Al-Fatiha padhna shuru kiya aur apna lar jama karke (saanp ke kaate hue jagah par) thooka. Mareez theek ho gaya aur uske log unhein bakriyaan de gaye, magar unhone kaha, 'Hum ye tab tak nahi lenge jab tak hum Nabi (SAW) se na poochh lein (ke ye jaayez hai ya nahi).' Jab unhone unse pucha, wo muskuraaye aur kaha, 'Tumhein kaise pata Surah Al-Fatiha bhi ek Ruqya hai? Ise le lo aur mera hissa bhi rakho.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Some of the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) passed by some people staying at a place where there was water, and one of those people had been stung by a scorpion. A man from those staying near the water, came and said to the companions of the Prophet, "Is there anyone among you who can do Ruqya as near the water there is a person who has been stung by a scorpion." So one of the Prophet's companions went to him and recited Surat-al-Fatiha for a sheep as his fees. The patient got cured and the man brought the sheep to his companions who disliked that and said, "You have taken wages for reciting Allah's Book." When they arrived at Medina, they said, ' O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! (This person) has taken wages for reciting Allah's Book" On that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "You are most entitled to take wages for doing a Ruqya with Allah's Book
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ke kuch sahaaba ek jagah se guzre jahaan kuch log paani ke paas rehte the, aur unmein se ek shaks ko bicchu ne dansa tha. Paani ke paas rehne wale ek shaks ne aakar Nabi (SAW) ke sahaaba se kaha, 'Kya tum mein se koi Ruqya kar sakta hai, kyunke paani ke paas ek shaks ko bicchu ne dansa hai?' To Nabi (SAW) ke sahaaba mein se ek unke paas gaya aur ek bakri ke badle Surah Al-Fatiha padhi. Mareez theek ho gaya aur wo shaks bakri lekar apne saathiyon ke paas aaya, unhone ye napasand kiya aur kaha, 'Tumne Allah ki Kitaab padhne ke badle mazdoori li hai.' Jab wo Madina pahunche, unhone kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! (Is shaks) ne Allah ki Kitaab padhne ke badle mazdoori li hai.' Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Tum sabse zyaada haqdaar ho Allah ki Kitaab se Ruqya karne ke badle mazdoori lene ke.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered me or somebody else to do Ruqya (if there was danger) from an evil eye
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ne mujhe ya kisi aur ko hukm diya (agar khatra ho) nazar (bad-nazar) se Ruqya karne ka.

e: Narrated Um Salama:that the Prophet (ﷺ) saw in her house a girl whose face had a black spot. He said. "She is under the effect of an evil eye; so treat her with a Ruqya
hi: Umm Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ne unke ghar mein ek ladki dekhi jiske chehre par kaala daagh tha. Unhone kaha, 'Ye bad-nazar ka asar hai; isliye iska ilaaj Ruqya se karo.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The effect of an evil eye is a fact." And he prohibited tattooing
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Bad-nazar ka asar haqeeqat hai.' Aur unhone gudna (tattoo) banwaane se mana kiya.

e: Narrated Al-Aswad:I asked `Aisha about treating poisonous stings (a snake-bite or a scorpion sting) with a Ruqya. She said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) allowed the treatment of poisonous sting with Ruqya
hi: Al-Aswad bataate hain: Maine Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se zehreele dansh (saanp ya bicchu ke) ka ilaaj Ruqya se karne ke baare mein pucha. Unhone kaha, 'Nabi (SAW) ne zehreele dansh ka ilaaj Ruqya se karne ki ijaazat di thi.'

e: Narrated `Abdul `Aziz:Thabit and I went to Anas bin Malik. Thabit said, "O Abu Hamza! I am sick." On that Anas said, "Shall I treat you with the Ruqya of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" Thabit said, "Yes," Anas recited, "O Allah! The Lord of the people, the Remover of trouble! (Please) cure (Heal) (this patient), for You are the Healer. None brings about healing but You; a healing that will leave behind no ailment
hi: Abdul Aziz bataate hain: Main aur Thabit Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas gaye. Thabit ne kaha, 'Aye Abu Hamza! Main bimar hoon.' Isper Anas ne kaha, 'Kya main tumhaara ilaaj Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki Ruqya se karoon?' Thabit ne kaha, 'Haan.' Anas ne padha, 'Aye Allah! Logon ke Rab, takleef door karne wale! (Barah-e-meharbaani) ise (is mareez ko) shifa de, kyunke Tu hi shifa dene wala hai. Tere siwa koi shifa nahi laata; aisi shifa jo koi bimaari peeche na chhode.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to treat some of his wives by passing his right hand over the place of ailment and used to say, "O Allah, the Lord of the people! Remove the trouble and heal the patient, for You are the Healer. No healing is of any avail but Yours; healing that will leave behind no ailment
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) apni kuch biwiyon ka ilaaj apna daayaan haath takleef ki jagah par phera kar karte the aur kehte, 'Aye Allah, logon ke Rab! Takleef door kar aur mareez ko shifa de, kyunke Tu hi shifa dene wala hai. Teri shifa ke siwa koi shifa kaam nahi aati; aisi shifa jo koi bimaari peeche na chhode.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to treat with a Ruqya saying, "O the Lord of the people! Remove the trouble The cure is in Your Hands, and there is none except You who can remove it (the disease)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Ruqya se ilaaj karte hue kehte, 'Aye logon ke Rab! Takleef door kar. Shifa Teri Zaat mein hai, aur Tere siwa koi ise (bimaari ko) door nahi kar sakta.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to say to the patient, "In the Name of Allah The earth of our land and the saliva of some of us cure our patient
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) mareez se kaha karte, 'Allah ke naam se. Hamaari zameen ki mitti aur hum mein se kisi ka lar hamaare mareez ko shifa de.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to read in his Ruqya, "In the Name of Allah" The earth of our land and the saliva of some of us cure our patient with the permission of our Lord." with a slight shower of saliva) while treating with a Ruqya
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apni Ruqya mein padha karte the, 'Allah ke naam se. Hamaari zameen ki mitti aur hum mein se kisi ka lar hamaare Rab ki ijaazat se hamaare mareez ko shifa de,' (Ruqya karte waqt thoda lar chhidak kar).

e: Narrated Abu Qatada:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "A good dream is from Allah, and a bad dream is from Satan. So if anyone of you sees (in a dream) something he dislikes, when he gets up he should blow thrice (on his left side) and seek refuge with Allah from its evil for then it will not harm him
hi: Abu Qatada (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Achha khwaab Allah ki taraf se hota hai, aur bura khwaab Shaitaan ki taraf se. Isliye agar tum mein se koi (khwaab mein) koi napasandida cheez dekhe, to uthne par usko (apni baayi taraf) teen baar phoonk maar leni chaahiye aur uski buraai se Allah ki panaah maangni chaahiye, phir wo use nuqsaan nahi pahunchayega.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went to bed, he used to recite Surat-al-Ikhlas, Surat-al-Falaq and Surat-an- Nas and then blow on his palms and pass them over his face and those parts of his body that his hands could reach. And when he fell ill, he used to order me to do like that for him
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab bhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) bistar par jaate, wo Surah Al-Ikhlas, Surah Al-Falaq aur Surah An-Nas padhte, phir apni hatheliyon par phoonkte aur unhein apne chehre aur jism ke un hisson par pherte jahaan tak unke haath pahunch sakein. Aur jab wo bimar padte, to mujhe unke liye aisa hi karne ka hukm dete.

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id:A group of the companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) proceeded on a journey till they dismounted near one of the Arab tribes and requested them to entertain them as their guests, but they (the tribe people) refused to entertain them. Then the chief of that tribe was bitten by a snake (or stung by a scorpion) and he was given all sorts of treatment, but all in vain. Some of them said, "Will you go to the group (those travelers) who have dismounted near you and see if one of them has something useful?" They came to them and said, "O the group! Our leader has been bitten by a snake (or stung by a scorpion) and we have treated him with everything but nothing benefited him Has anyone of you anything useful?" One of them replied, "Yes, by Allah, I know how to treat with a Ruqya. But. by Allah, we wanted you to receive us as your guests but you refused. I will not treat your patient with a Ruqya till you fix for us something as wages." Consequently they agreed to give those travellers a flock of sheep. The man went with them (the people of the tribe) and started spitting (on the bite) and reciting Surat-al-Fatiha till the patient was healed and started walking as if he had not been sick. When the tribe people paid them their wages they had agreed upon, some of them (the Prophet's companions) said, "Distribute (the sheep)." But the one who treated with the Ruqya said, "Do not do that till we go to Allah's Apostle and mention to him what has happened, and see what he will order us." So they came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and mentioned the story to him and he said, "How do you know that Surat-al-Fatiha is a Ruqya? You have done the right thing. Divide (what you have got) and assign for me a share with you
hi: Abu Saeed bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke sahaaba ka ek giroh safar par nikla yahaan tak ke wo Arab ke ek qabeele ke paas thehre aur unse apni mehmaan-nawaazi ki darkhwaast ki, magar unhone (qabeele walon ne) inkaar kar diya. Phir us qabeele ke sardaar ko saanp ne kaat liya (ya bicchu ne dansa) aur unhein har tarah ka ilaaj diya gaya, magar sab bekaar gaya. Unmein se kuch ne kaha, 'Kya tum us giroh (musaafiron) ke paas jaoge jo tumhaare paas thehre hain aur dekhoge ke unmein se kisi ke paas koi kaam ki cheez hai?' Wo unke paas aaye aur kaha, 'Aye giroh! Hamaare sardaar ko saanp ne kaata hai (ya bicchu ne dansa hai) aur humne har cheez se unka ilaaj kiya magar kisi cheez se faayda nahi hua. Kya tum mein se kisi ke paas koi kaam ki cheez hai?' Unmein se ek ne jawab diya, 'Haan, Allah ki qasam, mujhe Ruqya se ilaaj karna aata hai. Magar, Allah ki qasam, hum chahte the ke tum humaari mehmaan-nawaazi karo magar tumne inkaar kiya. Main tumhaare mareez ka ilaaj Ruqya se tab tak nahi karunga jab tak tum humaare liye kuch mazdoori muqarrar na karo.' Isper wo unhein bakriyon ka ek jhund dene par razi ho gaye. Wo aadmi unke saath gaya aur (dansh par) thookna aur Surah Al-Fatiha padhna shuru kiya yahaan tak ke mareez theek ho gaya aur aise chalne laga jaise wo kabhi bimar hi nahi tha. Jab qabeele walon ne unhein muqarrar ki gayi mazdoori adaa ki, unmein se kuch (Nabi ke sahaaba) ne kaha, 'Ise baant lo.' Magar jisne Ruqya se ilaaj kiya tha usne kaha, 'Aisa mat karo jab tak hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas na jaayein aur unhein jo hua wo na bataayein, aur dekhein wo humein kya hukm dete hain.' To wo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unhein poori kahaani sunaayi, unhone kaha, 'Tumhein kaise pata Surah Al-Fatiha bhi ek Ruqya hai? Tumne sahi kiya. (Jo mila hai use) baanto aur mera hissa bhi rakho.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to treat some of his wives by passing his right hand over the place of ailment and used to say, "O Lord of the people! Remove the difficulty and bring about healing as You are the Healer. There is no healing but Your Healing, a healing that will leave no ailment
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) apni kuch biwiyon ka ilaaj apna daayaan haath takleef ki jagah par phera kar karte the aur kehte, 'Aye logon ke Rab! Mushkil door kar aur shifa de, kyunke Tu hi shifa dene wala hai. Teri shifa ke siwa koi shifa nahi, aisi shifa jo koi bimaari peeche na chhode.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet, during his fatal ailment used to blow (on his hands and pass them) over his body while reciting the Mu'auwidhat (Surat-an-Nas and Surat-al-Falaq). When his disease got aggravated, I used to recite them for him and blow (on his hands) and let him pass his hands over his body because of its blessing. (Ma`mar asked Ibn Shihab: How did he use to do Nafth? He said: He used to blow on his hands and then pass them over his face)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) apni aakhri bimaari ke dauraan (apne haathon par) phoonkte aur Mu'auwidhataan (Surah An-Nas aur Surah Al-Falaq) padhte hue unhein apne jism par phera dete the. Jab unki bimaari aur badh gayi, main unke liye ye Surate padhti aur (unke haathon par) phoonkti, aur unke haath unke jism par barkat ke liye phera deti.' (Ma'mar ne Ibn Shihab se pucha: Wo Nafth kaise karte the? Unhone kaha: Wo apne haathon par phoonkte the phir unhein apne chehre par phera lete the.)

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) once came out to us and said, "Some nations were displayed before me. A prophet would pass in front of me with one man, and another with two men, and another with a group of people. and another with nobody with him. Then I saw a great crowd covering the horizon and I wished that they were my followers, but it was said to me, 'This is Moses and his followers.' Then it was said to me, 'Look'' I looked and saw a big gathering with a large number of people covering the horizon. It was said, "Look this way and that way.' So I saw a big crowd covering the horizon. Then it was said to me, "These are your followers, and among them there are 70,000 who will enter Paradise without (being asked about their) accounts. " Then the people dispersed and the Prophet (ﷺ) did not tell who those 70,000 were. So the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) started talking about that and some of them said, "As regards us, we were born in the era of heathenism, but then we believed in Allah and His Apostle . We think however, that these (70,000) are our offspring." That talk reached the Prophet (ﷺ) who said, "These (70,000) are the people who do not draw an evil omen from (birds) and do not get treated by branding themselves and do not treat with Ruqya, but put their trust (only) in their Lord." then 'Ukasha bin Muhsin got up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Am I one of those (70,000)?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Yes." Then another person got up and said, "Am I one of them?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, " 'Ukasha has anticipated you
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ek baar hamare paas aaye aur kaha, 'Mere saamne kuch ummaten pesh ki gayin. Ek Nabi ek aadmi ke saath guzarte, doosre do aadmiyon ke saath, aur koi ek giroh ke saath, aur koi bina kisi ke saath.
