Phir maine ek bada hujoom dekha jo poore ufuq ko dhaanp raha tha aur maine socha ke ye mere maanne wale hain, magar mujhse kaha gaya, "Ye Musa aur unke maanne wale hain." Phir mujhse kaha gaya, "Dekho." Maine dekha to ek bada jama-avdesh tha jismein bahut se log the jo poore ufuq ko dhaanp rahe the. Kaha gaya, "Idhar dekho aur udhar." To maine ek bada hujoom dekha jo poore ufuq ko dhaanp raha tha. Phir mujhse kaha gaya, "Ye tumhaare maanne wale hain, aur inmein se sattar hazaar aise hain jo bina hisaab-kitaab ke Jannat mein daakhil honge."' Phir log bikhar gaye aur Nabi (SAW) ne nahi bataaya ke wo sattar hazaar kaun the. To Nabi (SAW) ke sahaaba is baare mein baatein karne lage aur unmein se kuch ne kaha, 'Jahaan tak hamaari baat hai, hum Jaahiliyat ke daur mein paida hue the, magar phir humne Allah aur uske Rasool par Iman laaya. Humein lagta hai ke ye (sattar hazaar) hamaari aulaad hain.' Ye baat Nabi (SAW) tak pahunchi, unhone kaha, 'Ye (sattar hazaar) wo log hain jo (parindon se) bad-shagun nahi lete, na khud ko daagh lagwaate hain, na Ruqya se ilaaj karwaate hain, balke sirf apne Rab par bharosa karte hain.' Isper Ukasha bin Muhsin khade hue aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya main unmein se hoon?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Haan.' Phir ek aur shaks khada hua aur kaha, 'Kya main unmein se hoon?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Ukasha tumse pehle keh chuke.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "There is neither 'Adwa (no contagious disease is conveyed to others without Allah's permission) nor Tiyara, but an evil omen may be in three a woman, a house or an animal
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Na Adwa (khud-ba-khud failne wali bimaari) hai, na Tiyara (badshaguni), magar bad-shagun teen cheezon mein ho sakta hai: aurat, ghar, ya jaanwar.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "There is no Tiyara, and the best omen is the Fal." They asked, "What is the Fal?" He said, "A good word that one of you hears (and takes as a good omen)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Koi Tiyara (badshaguni) nahi hai, aur sabse behtareen shagun Fal hai.' Unhone pucha, 'Fal kya hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Ek achhi baat jo tum mein se koi sune (aur use achhe shagun ke taur par le).'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There is no Tiyara and the best omen is the Fal," Somebody said, "What is the Fal, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" He said, "A good word that one of you hears (and takes as a good omen)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Koi Tiyara nahi hai, aur sabse behtareen shagun Fal hai.' Kisi ne kaha, 'Fal kya hai, Aye Allah ke Rasool?' Unhone kaha, 'Ek achhi baat jo tum mein se koi sune.'

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No 'Adwa (no contagious disease is conveyed to others without Allah's permission), nor Tiyara, but I like the good Fal, i.e., the good word
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Na Adwa hai, na Tiyara, magar mujhe achha Fal pasand hai, yaani achhi baat.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There is no 'Adwa, nor Tiyara, nor Hama, nor Safar
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Na Adwa hai, na Tiyara, na Hamah, na Safar (ki badshaguni).'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave his verdict about two ladies of the Hudhail tribe who had fought each other and one of them had hit the other with a stone. The stone hit her `Abdomen and as she was pregnant, the blow killed the child in her womb. They both filed their case with the Prophet (ﷺ) and he judged that the blood money for what was in her womb. was a slave or a female slave. The guardian of the lady who was fined said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shall I be fined for a creature that has neither drunk nor eaten, neither spoke nor cried? A case like that should be nullified." On that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "This is one of the brothers of soothsayers
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Hudhail qabeele ki do khawaateen ke baare mein faisla diya jo aapas mein lad gayi thin, aur unmein se ek ne doosri ko patthar se maara tha. Patthar uske pet par laga, aur chunke wo hamila thi, is chot se uske garbh mein bacha mar gaya. Dono ne Nabi (SAW) ke paas apna maamla rakha, aur unhone faisla diya ke garbh mein maare gaye bacche ka khoon-bahaa ek ghulaam ya launDi hai. Jurmaana bharne wali khaatoon ke sarparast ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya mujhpar ek aisi jaan ke liye jurmaana lagaya jaayega jisne na khaaya na piya, na bola na roya? Aisa maamla to rad karna chaahiye.' Isper Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ye (aadmi) unhi jyotishiyon ke bhaiyon mein se ek hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Two ladies (had a fight) and one of them hit the other with a stone on the `Abdomen and caused her to abort. The Prophet (ﷺ) judged that the victim be given either a slave or a female slave (as blood-money). Narrated Ibn Shihab: Sa`id bin Al-Musayyab said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) judged that in case of child killed in the womb of its mother, the offender should give the mother a slave or a female slave in recompense The offender said, How can I be fined for killing one who neither ate nor drank, neither spoke nor cried: a case like that should be denied ' On that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said 'He is one of the brothers of the foretellers
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Do khawaateen (jhagde mein) the, aur unmein se ek ne doosri ko patthar se uske pet par maara aur uska garbh-paat ho gaya. Nabi (SAW) ne faisla diya ke peedit ko ghulaam ya launDi (khoon-bahe ke taur par) di jaaye. Ravi Ibn Shihab bataate hain: Saeed bin Al-Musayyab ne kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne faisla diya ke agar maa ke garbh mein bacha maara jaaye, to zimmedaar shaks ko maa ko badle mein ek ghulaam ya launDi deni chaahiye.' Zimmedaar ne kaha, 'Main us jaan ke liye kaise jurmaana bhar sakta hoon jisne na khaaya, na piya, na bola, na roya; aisa maamla to khaarij karna chaahiye.' Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ye (aadmi) jyotishiyon ke bhaiyon mein se ek hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Mas`ud:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the utilization of the price of a dog, the earnings of prostitute and the earnings of a foreteller
hi: Abu Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne kutte ki qeemat, badkaari ki kamaai, aur jyotishi ki kamaai ke istemaal se mana kiya.

e: Narrated `Aisha:Some people asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about the fore-tellers He said. ' They are nothing" They said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Sometimes they tell us of a thing which turns out to be true." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "A Jinn snatches that true word and pours it Into the ear of his friend (the fore-teller) (as one puts something into a bottle) The foreteller then mixes with that word one hundred lies
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Kuch logon ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se jyotishiyon (foretellers) ke baare mein pucha. Unhone kaha, 'Wo kuch nahi hain.' Unhone kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kabhi kabhi wo humein aisi baat batate hain jo sach nikalti hai.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ek Jinn wo sachi baat chura leta hai aur apne dost (jyotishi) ke kaan mein daal deta hai (jaise koi bottle mein kuch daale). Phir jyotishi us baat mein sau jhoot mila deta hai.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:A man called Labid bin al-A'sam from the tribe of Bani Zaraiq worked magic on Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) till Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) started imagining that he had done a thing that he had not really done. One day or one night he was with us, he invoked Allah and invoked for a long period, and then said, "O `Aisha! Do you know that Allah has instructed me concerning the matter I have asked him about? Two men came to me and one of them sat near my head and the other near my feet. One of them said to his companion, "What is the disease of this man?" The other replied, "He is under the effect of magic.' The first one asked, 'Who has worked the magic on him?' The other replied, "Labid bin Al-A'sam.' The first one asked, 'What material did he use?' The other replied, 'A comb and the hairs stuck to it and the skin of pollen of a male date palm.' The first one asked, 'Where is that?' The other replied, '(That is) in the well of Dharwan;' " So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) along with some of his companions went there and came back saying, "O `Aisha, the color of its water is like the infusion of Henna leaves. The tops of the date-palm trees near it are like the heads of the devils." I asked. "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? Why did you not show it (to the people)?" He said, "Since Allah cured me, I disliked to let evil spread among the people." Then he ordered that the well be filled up with earth
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Banu Zuraiq qabeele ke Labid bin Al-A'sam naami ek shaks ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) par jaadu kar diya, yahaan tak ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko lagne laga ke unhone koi kaam kiya hai jo unhone waaqai nahi kiya tha. Ek din ya ek raat wo humaare saath the, unhone Allah se lambi dua ki, phir kaha, 'Aye Aisha! Kya tumhein pata hai Allah ne mujhe us maamle ke baare mein bataya hai jo maine unse pucha tha? Do aadmi mere paas aaye, ek mere sar ke paas baitha aur doosra mere pairon ke paas. Unmein se ek ne apne saathi se pucha, "Is aadmi ki bimaari kya hai?" Doosre ne jawab diya, "Ye jaadu ke asar mein hai." Pehle ne pucha, "Isper jaadu kisne kiya?" Doosre ne jawab diya, "Labid bin Al-A'sam ne." Pehle ne pucha, "Kis cheez se?" Doosre ne jawab diya, "Ek kangha aur usmein phanse baal, aur khajoor ke nar darakht ke phool ki chhaal se." Pehle ne pucha, "Wo kahaan hai?" Doosre ne jawab diya, "Dharwan ke kuen mein."' To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apne kuch sahaaba ke saath wahaan gaye aur wapas aakar kaha, 'Aye Aisha, uske paani ka rang Heena ke patton ke ghol jaisa tha. Uske paas khajoor ke darakhton ke sar Shaitaanon ke saron jaise the.' Maine pucha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Aapne ise (logon ko) kyun nahi dikhaya?' Unhone kaha, 'Jab se Allah ne mujhe shifa di, mujhe logon mein buraai failaana pasand nahi aaya.' Phir unhone hukm diya ke us kuen ko mitti se bhar diya jaaye.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Avoid the Mubiqat, i.e., shirk and witchcraft
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Mubiqat (tabaah karne wali cheezon) se bacho, yaani shirk aur jaadu se.'

e: Narrated Aisha:Magic was worked on Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) so that he used to think that he had sexual relations with his wives while he actually had not (Sufyan said: That is the hardest kind of magic as it has such an effect). Then one day he said, "O `Aisha do you know that Allah has instructed me concerning the matter I asked Him about? Two men came to me and one of them sat near my head and the other sat near my feet. The one near my head asked the other. What is wrong with this man?' The latter replied the is under the effect of magic The first one asked, Who has worked magic on him?' The other replied Labid bin Al-A'sam, a man from Bani Zuraiq who was an ally of the Jews and was a hypocrite.' The first one asked, What material did he use)?' The other replied, 'A comb and the hair stuck to it.' The first one asked, 'Where (is that)?' The other replied. 'In a skin of pollen of a male date palm tree kept under a stone in the well of Dharwan' '' So the Prophet (ﷺ) went to that well and took out those things and said "That was the well which was shown to me (in a dream) Its water looked like the infusion of Henna leaves and its date-palm trees looked like the heads of devils." The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "Then that thing was taken out' I said (to the Prophet (ﷺ) ) "Why do you not treat yourself with Nashra?" He said, "Allah has cured me; I dislike to let evil spread among my people
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) par jaadu kiya gaya, yahaan tak ke unhein lagne laga ke unhone apni biwiyon se humbistari ki hai jabke unhone waaqai nahi ki thi. (Ravi Sufyan ne kaha: Ye jaadu ki sabse sakht qism hai kyunke iska aisa asar hota hai.) Phir ek din unhone kaha, 'Aye Aisha, kya tumhein pata hai Allah ne mujhe us maamle ke baare mein bataya hai jo maine unse pucha tha? Do aadmi mere paas aaye, ek mere sar ke paas baitha aur doosra mere pairon ke paas. Sar ke paas waale ne doosre se pucha, "Is aadmi ko kya hua hai?" Usne jawab diya, "Ye jaadu ke asar mein hai." Pehle ne pucha, "Isper jaadu kisne kiya?" Usne jawab diya, "Labid bin Al-A'sam ne, Banu Zuraiq ka ek shaks jo Yahudiyon ka saathi tha aur munaafiq tha." Pehle ne pucha, "Kis cheez se?" Usne jawab diya, "Ek kangha aur usmein phanse baal se." Pehle ne pucha, "Wo kahaan hai?" Usne jawab diya, "Khajoor ke nar darakht ke phool ki chhaal mein, Dharwan ke kuen mein ek patthar ke neeche rakhi hui."' To Nabi (SAW) us kuen par gaye aur wo cheezein nikaali aur kaha, 'Yahi wo kuan hai jo mujhe (khwaab mein) dikhaya gaya tha. Iska paani Heena ke patton ke ghol jaisa dikhta tha aur iske khajoor ke darakht Shaitaanon ke saron jaise dikhte the.' Nabi (SAW) ne aage kaha, 'Phir wo cheez nikaal li gayi.' Maine (Nabi se) pucha, 'Aap khud ka Nashra (ilaaj) kyun nahi karte?' Unhone kaha, 'Allah ne mujhe shifa di hai; mujhe apne logon mein buraai failaana pasand nahi.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:Magic was worked on Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) so that he began to imagine that he had done something although he had not. One day while he was with me, he invoked Allah and invoked for a long period and then said, "O `Aisha! Do you know that Allah has instructed me regarding the matter I asked Him about?" I asked, "What is that, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" He said, "Two men came to me; one of them sat near my head and the other sat near my feet. One of them asked his companion, 'What is the disease of this man?' The other replied, 'He is under the effect of magic.' The first one asked, 'Who has worked magic on him?" The other replied, 'Labid bin A'sam, a Jew from the tribe of Bani Zuraiq.' The (first one asked), 'With what has it been done?' The other replied, 'With a a comb and the hair stuck to it and a skin of the pollen of a male datepalm tree.' The first one asked, 'Where is it?' The other replied, 'In the well of Dharwan.' Then the Prophet (ﷺ) went along with some of his companions to that well and looked at that and there were date palms near to it. Then he returned to me and said, 'By Allah the water of that well was (red) like the infusion of Henna leaves and its date-palms were like the heads of devils" I said, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Did you take those materials out of the pollen skin?" He said, 'No! As for me Allah has healed me and cured me and I was afraid that (by Showing that to the people) I would spread evil among them when he ordered that the well be filled up with earth, and it was filled up with earth
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) par jaadu kiya gaya, yahaan tak ke unhein lagne laga ke unhone kuch kiya hai jabke unhone nahi kiya tha. Ek din jab wo mere saath the, unhone Allah se lambi dua ki, phir kaha, 'Aye Aisha! Kya tumhein pata hai Allah ne mujhe us maamle ke baare mein bataya jo maine unse pucha tha?' Maine pucha, 'Wo kya hai, Aye Allah ke Rasool?' Unhone kaha, 'Do aadmi mere paas aaye; ek mere sar ke paas baitha aur doosra mere pairon ke paas. Unmein se ek ne apne saathi se pucha, "Is aadmi ki bimaari kya hai?" Doosre ne jawab diya, "Ye jaadu ke asar mein hai." Pehle ne pucha, "Isper jaadu kisne kiya?" Doosre ne jawab diya, "Labid bin Al-A'sam, Banu Zuraiq qabeele ka ek Yahudi." (Pehle ne pucha,) "Kis cheez se ye kiya gaya?" Doosre ne jawab diya, "Ek kangha aur usmein phanse baal, aur khajoor ke nar darakht ke phool ki chhaal se." Pehle ne pucha, "Wo kahaan hai?" Doosre ne jawab diya, "Dharwan ke kuen mein."' Phir Nabi (SAW) apne kuch sahaaba ke saath us kuen par gaye aur dekha, aur wahaan khajoor ke darakht the. Phir wo mere paas wapas aaye aur kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, us kuen ka paani Heena ke patton ke ghol jaisa (laal) tha aur uske khajoor ke darakht Shaitaanon ke saron jaise the.' Maine pucha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya aapne wo cheezein phool ki chhaal se nikaali?' Unhone kaha, 'Nahi! Jahaan tak meri baat hai, Allah ne mujhe shifa di aur theek kar diya hai, aur mujhe dar tha ke (ye logon ko dikhaakar) main unmein buraai failaunga,' jab unhone hukm diya ke us kuen ko mitti se bhar diya jaaye, aur use mitti se bhar diya gaya.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Two men came from the East and addressed the people who wondered at their eloquent speeches On that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said. Some eloquent speech is as effective as magic
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Do aadmi Poorab se aaye aur logon ko khitaab kiya, jo unki fasaahat (baksh-shudah taqreer) par hairaan reh gaye. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kuch fasaahat bhi jaadu jitni asardaar hoti hai.'

e: Narrated Saud:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If somebody takes some `Ajwa dates every morning, he will not be affected by poison or magic on that day till night." (Another narrator said seven dates)
hi: Sa'd bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar koi har subah kuch Ajwa khajoorein khaaye, to us din raat tak use zeher ya jaadu asar nahi karega.' (Ek doosre ravi ne 'saat khajoorein' kaha.)

e: Narrated Saud:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "If Somebody takes seven 'Ajwa dates in the morning, neither magic nor poison will hurt him that day
hi: Sa'd bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Agar koi subah saat Ajwa khajoorein khaaye, to na jaadu na zeher us din use nuqsaan pahunchayega.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'No 'Adwa (i.e. no contagious disease is conveyed to others without Allah's permission); nor (any evil omen in the month of) Safar; nor Hama" A bedouin said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What about the camels which, when on the sand (desert) look like deers, but when a mangy camel mixes with them they all get infected with mange?" On that Allah's Apostle said, "Then who conveyed the (mange) disease to the first (mangy) camel?
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Na Adwa (khud-ba-khud failne wali bimaari) hai, na Safar (ki badshaguni), na Hamah.' Ek badawi ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Un oonton ka kya jo registaan mein hiran jaise dikhte hain, magar jab ek khaarish-zada oont unmein mil jaata hai, to sab khaarish ke shikaar ho jaate hain?' Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'To phir pehle (khaarish-zada) oont ko ye bimaari kisne di?'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The cattle (sheep, cows, camels, etc.) suffering from a disease should not be mixed up with healthy cattle, (or said: "Do not put a patient with a healthy person ). " (as a precaution)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Bimaar maweshiyon (bakri, gaay, oont waghera) ko sehatmand maweshiyon ke saath nahi milaana chaahiye,' (ya kaha, 'Bimaar ko sehatmand ke saath mat rakho,') (ehtiyaat ke taur par).

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "there is neither 'Adwa nor Tiyara, and an evil omen is only in three: a horse, a woman and a house
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Na Adwa hai, na Tiyara, aur bad-shagun sirf teen cheezon mein hai: ghoda, aurat, aur ghar.'
(Is hadees ka asal matn maujood nahi hai — source data mein khaali chhoda gaya hai.)

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No 'Adwa nor Tiyara; but I like Fal." They said, "What is the Fal?" He said, "A good word
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Na Adwa hai, na Tiyara; magar mujhe Fal pasand hai.' Unhone pucha, 'Fal kya hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Ek achhi baat.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:When Khaibar was conquered, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was presented with a poisoned (roasted) sheep. Allah's Apostle said, "Collect for me all the Jews present in this area." (When they were gathered) Allah's Apostle said to them, "I am going to ask you about something; will you tell me the truth?" They replied, "Yes, O Abal-Qasim!" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to them, "Who is your father?" They said, "Our father is so-and-so." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "You have told a lie. for your father is so-and-so," They said, "No doubt, you have said the truth and done the correct thing." He again said to them, "If I ask you about something; will you tell me the truth?" They replied, "Yes, O Abal-Qasim! And if we should tell a lie you will know it as you have known it regarding our father," Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then asked, "Who are the people of the (Hell) Fire?" They replied, "We will remain in the (Hell) Fire for a while and then you (Muslims) will replace us in it" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to them. ''You will abide in it with ignominy. By Allah, we shall never replace you in it at all." Then he asked them again, "If I ask you something, will you tell me the truth?" They replied, "Yes." He asked. "Have you put the poison in this roasted sheep?" They replied, "Yes," He asked, "What made you do that?" They replied, "We intended to learn if you were a liar in which case we would be relieved from you, and if you were a prophet then it would not harm you
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Khaibar fatah hua, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ek zeher milaayi hui (bhuni hui) bakri pesh ki gayi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Is ilaake mein maujood sab Yahudiyon ko mere liye jama karo.' (Jab wo jama hue) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha, 'Main tumse kuch poochhne wala hoon; kya tum mujhe sach batoge?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Haan, Aye Abal-Qasim!' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha, 'Tumhaara baap kaun hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Humaara baap falaan hai.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Tumne jhoot bola, kyunke tumhaara baap falaan hai.' Unhone kaha, 'Beshak, aapne sach kaha aur sahi kiya.' Unhone phir unse kaha, 'Agar main tumse kuch aur poochhun, kya tum mujhe sach batoge?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Haan, Aye Abal-Qasim! Aur agar hum jhoot bolein, aap use pehchaan loge jaise aapne humaare baap ke maamle mein pehchaana.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne phir pucha, 'Jahannam ki Aag waale kaun hain?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Hum kuch waqt Aag mein rahenge, phir tum (Musalmaan) hamari jagah le loge.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha, 'Tum usmein zillat ke saath hamesha rahoge. Allah ki qasam, hum kabhi tumhaari jagah nahi lenge.' Phir unhone unse dobara pucha, 'Agar main tumse kuch poochhun, kya tum mujhe sach batoge?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Haan.' Unhone pucha, 'Kya tumne is bhuni bakri mein zeher mila diya tha?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Haan.' Unhone pucha, 'Tumne aisa kyun kiya?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Hum jaanna chahte the ke kya aap jhoote hain, is soorat mein hum aapse chhutkaara paa lete, aur agar aap sach mein Nabi hain, to ye aapko nuqsaan nahi pahunchaayega.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever purposely throws himself from a mountain and kills himself, will be in the (Hell) Fire falling down into it and abiding therein perpetually forever; and whoever drinks poison and kills himself with it, he will be carrying his poison in his hand and drinking it in the (Hell) Fire wherein he will abide eternally forever; and whoever kills himself with an iron weapon, will be carrying that weapon in his hand and stabbing his `Abdomen with it in the (Hell) Fire wherein he will abide eternally forever
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi jaan-boojh kar khud ko pahaad se giraakar apni jaan le, wo Jahannam ki Aag mein giregaa aur hamesha usmein rahega; aur jo koi zeher peekar khud ko maar de, wo Jahannam mein apne haath mein zeher liye rahega aur usmein peeta rahega, aur hamesha usmein rahega; aur jo koi loha hathiyaar se khud ko maare, wo Jahannam mein wo hathiyaar apne haath mein liye apna pet chhedta rahega, aur hamesha usmein rahega.'

e: Narrated Sa`d:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "Whoever takes seven 'Ajwa dates in the morning will not be effected by magic or poison on that day
hi: Sa'd bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Jo koi subah saat Ajwa khajoorein khaaye, use us din jaadu ya zeher asar nahi karega.'

e: Narrated Abu Tha`laba Al-Khushani:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the eating of wild animals having fangs. (Az-Zuhri said: I did not hear this narration except when I went to Sham.) Al-Laith said: Narrated Yunus: I asked Ibn Shihab, "May we perform the ablution with the milk of she-asses or drink it, or drink the bile of wild animals or urine of camels?" He replied, "The Muslims used to treat themselves with that and did not see any harm in it. As for the milk of she-asses, we have learnt that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the eating of their meat, but we have not received any information whether drinking of their milk is allowed or forbidden." As for the bile of wild animals, Ibn Shihab said, "Abu Idris Al-Khaulani told me that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the eating of the flesh of every wild beast having fangs
hi: Abu Thalaba Al-Khushani bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne naukeele daant waale jangli jaanwaron ka gosht khaane se mana kiya. (Az-Zuhri ne kaha: Maine ye riwayat sirf tab suni jab main Sham gaya.) Ravi Al-Laith bataate hain: Yunus ne bataya: Maine Ibn Shihab se pucha, 'Kya hum gadhi ke doodh se wuzu kar sakte hain ya use pee sakte hain, ya jangli jaanwaron ki pitt (bile) ya oonton ke peshaab pee sakte hain?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Musalmaan inse apna ilaaj kiya karte the aur ismein koi harj nahi samajhte the. Jahaan tak gadhi ke doodh ki baat hai, humein pata chala hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unka gosht khaane se mana kiya tha, magar humein koi khabar nahi mili ke unka doodh peena jaayez hai ya haraam.' Jangli jaanwaron ki pitt ke baare mein, Ibn Shihab ne kaha, 'Abu Idris Al-Khaulani ne mujhe bataya ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne naukeele daant waale har jangli jaanwar ka gosht khaane se mana kiya.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If a fly falls in the vessel of any of you, let him dip all of it (into the vessel) and then throw it away, for in one of its wings there is a disease and in the other there is healing (antidote for it) i e. the treatment for that disease
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar makkhi tum mein se kisi ke bartan mein gir jaaye, to use poori tarah (bartan mein) doobo do, phir use nikaal kar phenk do, kyunke uske ek pankh mein bimaari hai aur doosre mein shifa hai (yaani us bimaari ka ilaaj).'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Allah will not look at the person who drags his garment (behind him) out of conceit
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah us shaks ki taraf nahi dekhega jo ghamand mein apne kapde (zameen par) ghaseetta hai.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said Allah will not look, on the Day of Resurrection at the person who drags his garment (behind him) out of conceit. On that Abu Bakr said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! One side of my Izar hangs low if I do not take care of it." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'You are not one of those who do that out of conceit
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah Qayamat ke din us shaks ki taraf nahi dekhega jo ghamand mein apne kapde ghaseetta hai.' Isper Abu Bakr ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mere Izaar ka ek taraf neeche jhukta hai agar main iska khayaal na rakhoon.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Tum unmein se nahi ho jo ye ghamand mein karte hain.'

e: Narrated Abu Bakra:The solar eclipse occurred while we were sitting with the Prophet (ﷺ) He got up dragging his garment (on the ground) hurriedly till he reached the mosque The people turned (to the mosque) and he offered a two-rak`at prayer whereupon the eclipse was over and he traced us and said, "The sun and the moon are two signs among the signs of Allah, so if you see a thing like this (eclipse) then offer the prayer and invoke Allah till He remove that state
hi: Abu Bakra (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Suraj grahan hua jab hum Nabi (SAW) ke saath baithe the. Wo apna kapda ghaseettte hue jaldi se uthe yahaan tak ke Masjid pahunche. Log (Masjid ki taraf) mude aur unhone do rakat namaz padhaayi, isi dauraan grahan khatam ho gaya, aur unhone humari taraf mudkar kaha, 'Suraj aur chaand Allah ki nishaaniyon mein se do nishaaniyaan hain, isliye agar tum aisi cheez (grahan) dekho, to namaz padho aur Allah se dua karo jab tak wo haalat door na ho jaaye.'

e: Narrated Abu Juhaifa:I saw Bilal bringing a short spear (or stick) and fixing it in the ground, and then he proclaimed the Iqama of the prayer, and I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) coming out, wearing a cloak with its sleeves rolled up. He then offered a two-rak`at prayer while facing the stick, and I saw the people and animals passing in front of him beyond the stick
hi: Abu Juhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko ek chhoti bhaala (ya lakdi) laate aur zameen mein gaadte dekha, phir unhone namaz ki Iqamat ki, aur maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko baahar aate dekha, ek chogha pehne hue jiski aastin oopar chadhi hui thi. Unhone us lakdi ki taraf muh karke do rakat namaz padhi, aur maine logon aur jaanwaron ko us lakdi ke aage se guzarte dekha.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The part of an Izar which hangs below the ankles is in the Fire
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Izaar ka wo hissa jo takhnon se neeche latakta hai, (Jahannam ki) Aag mein hoga.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), "Allah will not look, on the Day of Resurrection, at a person who drags his Izar (behind him) out of pride and arrogance
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah Qayamat ke din us shaks ki taraf nahi dekhega jo ghamand aur takabbur mein apna Izaar (zameen par) ghaseetta hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (or 'Abul Qasim) said, "While a man was walking, clad in a two-piece garment and proud of himself with his hair well-combed, suddenly Allah made him sink into the earth and he will go on sinking into it till the Day of Resurrection
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) (ya Abul Qasim) ne farmaya, 'Jab ek aadmi do-tukde kapde pehne, apne oopar ghamand karte hue, apne baal sanwaare hue chal raha tha, achaanak Allah ne use zameen mein dhaans diya, aur wo Qayamat tak dhansta hi rahega.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "While a man was dragging his Izar on the ground (behind him), suddenly Allah made him sink into the earth and he will go on sinking into it till the Day of Resurrection." Narrated Abu Huraira: that he heard the Prophet (narrating as above No)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab ek aadmi apna Izaar zameen par ghaseett raha tha, achaanak Allah ne use zameen mein dhaans diya, aur wo Qayamat tak dhansta hi rahega.' Ravi Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke unhone bhi Nabi (SAW) se aisi hi riwaayat suni.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever drags his clothes (on the ground) out of pride and arrogance, Allah will not look at him on the Day of Resurrection
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi ghamand aur takabbur mein apne kapde (zameen par) ghaseette, Allah Qayamat ke din uski taraf nahi dekhega.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) The wife of Rifa`a Al-Qurazi came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while I was sitting, and Abu Bakr was also there. She said, 'O Allah's Apostle! I was the wife of Rifa`a and he divorced me irrevocably. Then I married `AbdurRahman bin Az-Zubair who, by Allah, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), has only something like a fringe of a garment, Showing the fringe of her veil. Khalid bin Sa`id, who was standing at the door, for he had not been admitted, heard her statement and said, "O Abu Bakr! Why do you not stop this lady from saying such things openly before Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" No, by Allah, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did nothing but smiled. Then he said to the lady, "Perhaps you want to return to Rifa`a? That is impossible unless `Abdur-Rahman consummates his marriage with you." That became the tradition after him
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki zawja) bataati hain: Rifa'a Al-Qurazi ki biwi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi jab main baithi thi, aur Abu Bakr bhi wahaan the. Usne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Main Rifa'a ki biwi thi aur unhone mujhe qatai talaaq de di. Phir maine Abdur Rahman bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) se nikaah kiya jinke paas, Allah ki qasam, Aye Allah ke Rasool, sirf ek kapde ke kinaare jaisa kuch hai,' apne dupatte ka kinaara dikhaate hue. Khalid bin Saeed, jo darwaaze par khade the kyunke unhein andar aane ki ijaazat nahi mili thi, unhone uski baat suni aur kaha, 'Aye Abu Bakr! Aap is khaatoon ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saamne aise khule aam ye baatein kehne se kyun nahi rokte?' Nahi, Allah ki qasam, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne bas muskuraaya. Phir unhone khaatoon se kaha, 'Shaayad tum Rifa'a ke paas wapas jaana chahti ho? Ye tab tak mumkin nahi jab tak Abdur Rahman tumhaare saath apna nikaah poora (rukhsati) na kar le.' Ye unke baad ek riwaayat (tareeka) ban gaya.

e: Narrated `Ali:The Prophet (ﷺ) asked for his Rida, put it on and set out walking. Zaid bin Haritha and I followed him till he reached the house where Harnza (bin `Abdul Muttalib) was present and asked for permission to enter, and they gave us permission
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne apni Rida (chaadar) maangi, use pehna, aur chalne lage. Zaid bin Haritha aur main unke peechhe gaye yahaan tak ke wo us ghar tak pahunche jahaan Hamza (bin Abdul Muttalib) maujood the aur andar aane ki ijaazat maangi, aur humein ijaazat de di gayi.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:A man asked, "O Allah's Apostle What kind of clothes should a Muhrim wear?" The Prophet, said, "A Muhrim should not wear a shirt, trousers a hooded cloak, or Khuffs (socks made from thick fabric or leather) unless he cannot get sandals, in which case he should cut the part (of the Khuff) that covers the ankles
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks ne pucha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Muhrim (Ihram waale) ko kaise kapde pehnne chaahiye?' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Muhrim ko qamees, pajaama, hood waala chogha, ya Khuff (mote kapde ya chamde ke mozon) nahi pehnne chaahiye, siwaaye is ke ke use jootiyaan na milein, aisi soorat mein use Khuff ka wo hissa kaat dena chaahiye jo takhne dhaankta hai.'

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) came to visit `Abdullah bin Ubai (bin Salul) after he had been put in his grave. The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered that `Abdullah be taken out. He was taken out and was placed on the knees of the Prophet, who blew his (blessed) breath on him and dressed the body with his own shirt. And Allah knows better
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) Abdullah bin Ubai (bin Salul) ko dekhne aaye unki qabr mein rakhe jaane ke baad. Nabi (SAW) ne hukm diya ke Abdullah ko nikaala jaaye. Unhein nikaala gaya aur Nabi (SAW) ke ghutnon par rakha gaya, unhone apni (mubarak) saans unpar phoonki aur jism ko apni khud ki qamees pehnaayi. Aur Allah behtar jaanta hai.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:When `Abdullah bin Ubdi (bin Salul) died, his son came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said ' O Allah's Apostle, give me your shirt so that I may shroud my fathers body in it. And please offer a funeral prayer for him and invoke Allah for his forgiveness." The Prophet (ﷺ) gave him his shirt and said to him 'Inform us when you finish (and the funeral procession is ready) call us. When he had finished he told the Prophet (ﷺ) and the Prophet (ﷺ) proceeded to order his funeral prayers but `Umar stopped him and said, "Didn't Allah forbid you to offer the funeral prayer for the hypocrites when He said: "Whether you (O Muhammad) ask forgiveness for them or ask not forgiveness for them: (and even) if you ask forgiveness for them seventy times. Allah will not forgive them." (9.80) Then there was revealed: "And never (O Muhammad) pray for any of them that dies, nor stand at his grave." (9.34) Thenceforth the Prophet (ﷺ) did not offer funeral prayers for the hypocrites
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Abdullah bin Ubai (bin Salul) ka intekaal hua, unke bete Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe apni qamees dijiye taake main apne waalid ke jism ko usmein kafan de sakoon. Aur barah-e-meharbaani unki namaz-e-janaza padhaiye aur unki maafi ke liye dua kijiye.' Nabi (SAW) ne unhein apni qamees di aur unse kaha, 'Jab (janaaza ka jaloos taiyaar ho jaaye) tumhaara kaam khatam ho jaaye, humein bataana.' Jab unka kaam khatam hua, unhone Nabi (SAW) ko bataaya aur Nabi (SAW) unki namaz-e-janaza padhaane ke liye aage badhe, magar Umar ne unhein roka aur kaha, 'Kya Allah ne aapko munaafiqon ki namaz-e-janaza padhaane se mana nahi kiya jab usne farmaaya, "Chaahe aap (Aye Muhammad) unke liye maafi maango ya na maango; (aur agar) aap unke liye sattar baar bhi maafi maangein, Allah unhein kabhi maaf nahi karega"' (9.80). Phir naazil hua: 'Aur (Aye Muhammad) kabhi unmein se kisi ke liye jo mar jaaye namaz mat padho, na uski qabr par khade ho.' (9.34) Iske baad Nabi (SAW) ne munaafiqon ki namaz-e-janaza padhaana chhod diya.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has set forth an example for a miser and a charitable person by comparing them to two men wearing two iron cloaks and their hands are raised to their breasts and necks. Whenever the charitable man tries to give a charitable gift, his iron cloak expands till it becomes so wide that it will cover his fingertips and obliterate his tracks And, whenever the miser wants to give a charitable gift, his cloak becomes very tight over him and every ring gets stuck to its place Abu Huraira added; I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) putting his finger in the (chest) pocket of his shirt like that If you but saw him trying to widen (the opening of his shirt) but it did not widen
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kanjoos aur sakhi shaks ki misaal do aise logon se di hai jo loha ke do chogha pehne hue hon aur unke haath unki chhaati aur gardan tak uthe hue hon. Jab bhi sakhi shaks sadqa dena chahta hai, uska loha ka chogha itna phail jaata hai ke wo uski ungliyon ke sirre tak dhaank leta hai aur uske pairon ke nishaan mita deta hai. Aur jab bhi kanjoos sadqa dena chahta hai, uska chogha uspar bahut kas jaata hai aur har halqa apni jagah chipak jaata hai. Abu Huraira ne aage kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko apni ungli apni qamees ki (chhaati ki) jeb mein daalte dekha, isi tarah. Agar tum dekhte ke wo (jeb) phailaane ki koshish kar rahe the magar wo nahi phaili.

e: Narrated Al-Mughira bin Shu`ba:The Prophet (ﷺ) went to answer the call of nature, and when he returned, I met him with water and he performed the ablution while he was wearing a Sham, cloak. He rinsed his mouth, put the water in his nose and blew it out, washed his face and tried to take his hands out of his sleeves, but they were too narrow, so he took out his hands from under his chest and washed them and then passed his wet hands over his head and Khuffs (socks made from thick fabric or leather)
hi: Al-Mughira bin Shu'ba (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) qaza-e-haajat ke liye gaye, aur jab wo wapas aaye, main unse paani lekar mila aur unhone wuzu kiya jabke wo Sham ka chogha pehne hue the. Unhone kulla kiya, naak mein paani daala aur nikaala, apna chehra dhoya, aur apne haath aastin se nikaalne ki koshish ki, magar wo bahut tang thin, isliye unhone apne haath apni chhaati ke neeche se nikaale aur unhein dhoya, phir apne geele haath apne sar aur Khuff (mote kapde ya chamde ke mozon) par phere.

e: Narrated Al-Mughira:One night I was with the Prophet (ﷺ) on a journey. He asked (me), "Have you got water with you?" I replied, "Yes" So he got down from his she-camel and went away till he disappeared in the darkness of the night. Then he came back and I poured water for him from the pot (for the ablution). He washed his face and hands while he was wearing a woollen cloak (the sleeves of which were narrow), so he could not take his arms out of it. So he took them out from underneath the cloak. Then he washed his forearms and passed his wet hands over his head. Then I tried to take off his Khuffs (socks made from thick fabric or leather), but he said, "Leave them, for I have performed ablution before putting them on." And so he passed his wet hands over them
hi: Al-Mughira bataate hain: Ek raat main Nabi (SAW) ke saath safar mein tha. Unhone (mujhse) pucha, 'Kya tumhaare paas paani hai?' Maine kaha, 'Haan.' To wo apni oontni se utre aur chal diye yahaan tak ke wo raat ke andhere mein ghayab ho gaye. Phir wo wapas aaye aur maine unke liye bartan se paani daala (wuzu ke liye). Unhone apna chehra aur haath dhoye jabke wo ek oon ka chogha pehne hue the (jiski aastin tang thi), isliye wo apni baahein usmein se nahi nikaal sake. To unhone unhein chogha ke neeche se nikaala. Phir unhone apni kalaaiyan dhoyi aur apne geele haath apne sar par phere. Phir maine unke Khuff utaarne ki koshish ki, magar unhone kaha, 'Inhein rehne do, kyunke maine inhein pehanne se pehle hi wuzu kiya tha.' Aur unhone apne geele haath unpar phere.

e: Narrated Al-Miswar bin Makhrama:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) distributed some Qaba's but he did not give anything to Makhrama. Makhrama said (to me), "O my son! Let us go to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." So I proceeded with him and he said, "Go in and call him 'or me." So I called the Prophet (ﷺ) for him The Prophet (ﷺ) came out to him, wearing one of those Qaba's and said, (to Makhrama), "I have kept this for you " Makhrama looked at it and said, "Makhrama is satisfied now
hi: Al-Miswar bin Makhrama (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kuch Qaba (chogha) baante, magar Makhrama ko kuch nahi diya. Makhrama ne kaha, 'Aye mere bete! Chalo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas chalte hain.' To main unke saath gaya aur unhone kaha, 'Andar jaao aur unhein bulaao (mere liye).' To maine Nabi (SAW) ko unke liye bulaaya. Nabi (SAW) unke paas baahar aaye, un Qabaon mein se ek pehne hue, aur kaha (Makhrama se), 'Maine ye tumhaare liye rakh liya hai.' Makhrama ne use dekha aur kaha, 'Makhrama ab santusht hai.'

e: Narrated `Uqba bin 'Amir:A silken Farruj was presented to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he put it on and offered the prayer in it. When he finished the prayer, he took it off violently as if he disliked it and said, "This (garment) does not befit those who fear Allah
hi: Uqba bin Aamir bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko resham ka ek Farruj (khula-samne wala chogha) pesh kiya gaya aur unhone use pehna aur usmein namaz padhi. Jab unhone namaz khatam ki, unhone use zor se utaara jaise unhein wo napasand ho, aur kaha, 'Ye (kapda) un logon ke liye theek nahi jo Allah se darte hain.'

e: Narrated Mu'tamir:I heard my father saying, "I saw Anas wearing a yellow hooded cloak of Khazz
hi: Mu'tamir bataate hain: Maine apne waalid ko ye kehte suna, 'Maine Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko Khazz ka ek peela hood-waala chogha pehne dekha.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:A man said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). What type of clothes should a Muhrim wear Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, 'Do not wear shirts, turbans trousers hooded cloaks or Khuffs (socks made from thick fabric or leather); but if someone cannot get sandals, then he can wear Khuffs after cutting them short below the ankles. Do not wear clothes touched by saffon or wars (two kinds of perfumes)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks ne pucha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Muhrim ko kaise kapde pehnne chaahiye?' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne jawab diya, 'Qamees, pagdi, pajaama, hood-waale chogha, ya Khuff mat pehno; magar agar kisi ko jootiyaan na mile, to wo takhnon se neeche kaat kar Khuff pehan sakta hai. Zafraan ya Wars (do khushbuon) se chhue kapde bhi mat pehno.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever cannot get an Izar, can wear trousers, and whoever cannot wear sandals can wear Khuffs (socks made from thick fabric or leather)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jise Izaar na mile, wo pajaama pehan sakta hai, aur jise jootiyaan na milein, wo Khuff pehan sakta hai.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:A man got up and said, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What do you order us to wear when we assume the state of Ihram?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Do not wear shirts, trousers, turbans, hooded cloaks or Khuffs (socks made from thick fabric or leather), but if a man has no sandals, he can wear Khuffs after cutting them short below the ankles; and do not wear clothes touched with (perfumes) of saffron or wars
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks khada hua aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Aap humein Ihram baandhte waqt kya pehnne ka hukm dete hain?' Nabi (SAW) ne jawab diya, 'Qamees, pajaama, pagdi, hood-waale chogha, ya Khuff mat pehno, magar agar kisi ke paas jootiyaan na hon, to wo takhnon se neeche kaat kar Khuff pehan sakta hai; aur Zafraan ya Wars se chhue kapde mat pehno.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A Muhrim should not wear a shirt, a turban, trousers, hooded cloaks, a garment touched with (perfumes) of saffron or wars, or Khuffs (socks made from thick fabric or leather) except if one has no sandals in which case he should cut short the Khuffs below the ankles
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Muhrim ko qamees, pagdi, pajaama, hood-waale chogha, Zafraan ya Wars se chhue kapde, ya Khuff nahi pehnne chaahiye, siwaaye is ke ke kisi ke paas jootiyaan na hon, aisi soorat mein use takhnon se neeche Khuff kaat lena chaahiye.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:Some Muslim men emigrated to Ethiopia whereupon Abu Bakr also prepared himself for the emigration, but the Prophet (ﷺ) said (to him), "Wait, for I hope that Allah will allow me also to emigrate." Abu Bakr said, "Let my father and mother be sacrificed for you. Do you hope that (emigration)?" The Prophet said, 'Yes." So Abu Bakr waited to accompany the Prophet (ﷺ) and fed two she-camels he had on the leaves of As-Samur tree regularly for four months One day while we were sitting in our house at midday, someone said to Abu Bakr, "Here is Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), coming with his head and a part of his face covered with a cloth-covering at an hour he never used to come to us." Abu Bakr said, "Let my father and mother be sacrificed for you, (O Prophet)! An urgent matter must have brought you here at this hour." The Prophet (ﷺ) came and asked the permission to enter, and he was allowed. The Prophet (ﷺ) entered and said to Abu Bakr, "Let those who are with you, go out." Abu Bakr replied, "(There is no stranger); they are your family. Let my father be sacrificed for you, O Allah's Apostle!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I have been allowed to leave (Mecca)." Abu Bakr said, " I shall accompany you, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), Let my father be sacrificed for you!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Yes," Abu Bakr said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Let my father be sacrificed for you. Take one of these two shecamels of mine" The Prophet (ﷺ) said. I will take it only after paying its price." So we prepared their baggage and put their journey food In a leather bag. And Asma' bint Abu Bakr cut a piece of her girdle and tied the mouth of the leather bag with it. That is why she was called Dhatan- Nitaqaln. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr went to a cave in a mountain called Thour and remained there for three nights. `Abdullah bin Abu Bakr. who was a young intelligent man. used to stay with them at night and leave before dawn so that in the morning, he would he with the Quraish at Mecca as if he had spent the night among them. If he heard of any plot contrived by the Quraish against the Prophet and Abu Bakr, he would understand it and (return to) inform them of it when it became dark. 'Amir bin Fuhaira, the freed slave of Abu Bakr used to graze a flock of milch sheep for them and he used to take those sheep to them when an hour had passed after the `Isha prayer. They would sleep soundly till 'Amir bin Fuhaira awakened them when it was still dark. He used to do that in each of those three nights
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Kuch Musalmaan Habsha (Ethiopia) hijrat kar gaye, isper Abu Bakr ne bhi hijrat ki taiyaari ki, magar Nabi (SAW) ne (unse) kaha, 'Ruko, kyunke mujhe ummeed hai ke Allah mujhe bhi hijrat karne dega.' Abu Bakr ne kaha, 'Mere maa-baap aap par qurbaan hon. Kya aapko iski (hijrat ki) ummeed hai?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Haan.' To Abu Bakr Nabi (SAW) ke saath jaane ke intezaar mein ruk gaye aur apni do oontniyon ko chaar mahine tak As-Samur darakht ke patton par palte rahe. Ek din jab hum apne ghar mein dophar ko baithe the, kisi ne Abu Bakr se kaha, 'Ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) hain, apna sar aur chehre ka kuch hissa kapde se dhaanke hue aa rahe hain, us waqt jab wo kabhi humaare paas nahi aate the.' Abu Bakr ne kaha, 'Mere maa-baap aap par qurbaan hon, (Aye Nabi)! Zaroor koi zaroori maamla aapko is waqt yahaan laaya hai.' Nabi (SAW) aaye aur andar aane ki ijaazat maangi, aur unhein ijaazat di gayi. Nabi (SAW) andar aaye aur Abu Bakr se kaha, 'Jo tumhaare saath hain unhein baahar bhejo.' Abu Bakr ne jawab diya, '(Koi ajnabi nahi hai); ye aapka hi khaandaan hai. Mere waalid aap par qurbaan hon, Aye Allah ke Rasool!' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Mujhe (Makkah se) nikalne ki ijaazat mil gayi hai.' Abu Bakr ne kaha, 'Main aapke saath chalunga, Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mere waalid aap par qurbaan hon!' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Haan.' Abu Bakr ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mere waalid aap par qurbaan hon. In do oontniyon mein se ek le lijiye.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Main ise sirf qeemat adaa karke lunga.' To humne unka saamaan taiyaar kiya aur unke safar ka khaana ek chamde ke thaile mein rakha. Aur Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Abu Bakr (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne apni kamarbandh ka ek tukda kaata aur usse thaile ka munh baandha. Isi wajah se unhein 'Dhatan-Nitaqain' (do kamarbandon wali) kaha jaane laga. Phir Nabi (SAW) aur Abu Bakr Thour naami pahaad ki ek gufaa mein gaye aur teen raatein wahaan rahe. Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abu Bakr, jo ek jawaan aur aqlmand shaks the, raat ko unke saath rehte aur subah hone se pehle chale jaate taake subah wo Makkah mein Quraish ke saath aise ho jaise unhone unke beech hi raat guzaari ho. Agar unhein Quraish ki Nabi aur Abu Bakr ke khilaaf kisi saazish ka pata chalta, to wo use samajhkar andhera hote hi unhein bataane (wapas) jaate. Aamir bin Fuhaira, Abu Bakr ke azaad kiye ghulaam, unke liye doodh dene wali bakriyon ka jhund charaate the aur wo unhein Isha ki namaz ke ek ghante baad unke paas le jaate. Wo gehri neend sote yahaan tak ke Aamir bin Fuhaira unhein andhera rehte hi jagaate. Wo aisa un teenon raaton mein har baar karte.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:In the year of the conquest of Mecca the Prophet (ﷺ) entered Mecca, wearing a helmet on his head
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Fatah-e-Makkah ke saal, Nabi (SAW) Makkah mein daakhil hue, apne sar par khod (helmet) pehne hue.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Once I was walking with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he was wearing a Najram Burd with thick margin. A bedouin followed him and pulled his Burd so violently that I noticed the side of the shoulder of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) affected by the margin of the Burd because of that violent pull. The Bedouin said, "O Muhammad! Give me some of Allah's wealth which is with you." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) turned and looked at him, and smiling, 'he ordered that he be given something
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath chal raha tha aur wo ek mote kinaare wale Najrani Burd (chaadar) pehne hue the. Ek badawi unke peechhe aaya aur unka Burd itni zor se khaincha ke maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke kandhe ka wo hissa dekha jahaan Burd ke kinaare ka nishaan pad gaya tha is zordaar khainchne ki wajah se. Badawi ne kaha, 'Aye Muhammad! Mujhe Allah ke maal mein se kuch do jo tumhaare paas hai.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mude aur usse dekha, aur muskuraate hue unhone hukm diya ke use kuch diya jaaye.

e: Narrated Abu Hazim:Shahl bin Sa`d said, "A lady came with a Burda. Sahl then asked (the people), "Do you know what Burda is?" Somebody said, "Yes. it is a Shamla with a woven border." Sahl added, "The lady said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have knitted this (Burda) with my own hands for you to wear it." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took it and he was in need of it. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came out to us and he was wearing it as an Izar. A man from the people felt it and said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Give it to me to wear.' The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Yes.' Then he sat there for some time (and when he went to his house), he folded it and sent it to him. The people said to that man, 'You have not done a right thing. You asked him for it, though you know that he does not put down anybody's request.' The man said, 'By Allah! I have only asked him so that it may be my shroud when I die." Sahl added, "Late it was his shroud
hi: Abu Hazim bataate hain: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Ek khaatoon ek Burda (bunayi hui chaadar) leke aayi.' Sahl ne (logon se) pucha, 'Kya tumhein pata hai Burda kya hoti hai?' Kisi ne kaha, 'Haan, ye bunayi hui kinaare wali Shamla hai.' Sahl ne aage kaha, 'Khaatoon ne kaha, "Aye Allah ke Rasool! Maine ye (Burda) apne haathon se buni hai taake aap ise pehnein." Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne use liya aur unhein iski zaroorat thi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) hamare paas baahar aaye aur wo ise Izaar ke taur par pehne hue the. Logon mein se ek shaks ne ise chhua aur kaha, "Aye Allah ke Rasool! Ise mujhe pehnne ke liye de dijiye." Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, "Theek hai." Phir wo kuch der wahaan baithe (aur jab wo apne ghar gaye), unhone ise mod kar us shaks ko bhej diya. Logon ne us shaks se kaha, "Tumne theek nahi kiya. Tumne unse ye maangi, jabke tumhein pata hai wo kisi ki darkhwaast wapas nahi karte." Us shaks ne kaha, "Allah ki qasam! Maine sirf isliye maangi taake ye meri maut ke waqt mera kafan bane." Sahl ne aage kaha, "Baad mein wahi uska kafan bana."'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying "From among my followers, a group (o 70,000) will enter Paradise without being asked for their accounts, Their faces will be shining like the moon." 'Ukasha bin Muhsin Al-Asadi got up, lifting his covering sheet and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) Invoke Allah for me that He may include me with them." The Prophet (ﷺ) said! "O Allah! Make him from them." Then another man from Al-Ansar got up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Invoke Allah for me that He may include me with them." On that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "'Ukasha has anticipated you
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Mere maanne walon mein se ek giroh (sattar hazaar) bina hisaab-kitaab ke Jannat mein daakhil hoga. Unke chehre chaand jaise chamakenge.' Ukasha bin Muhsin Al-Asadi apni chaadar utha kar khade hue aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mere liye dua kijiye ke Allah mujhe unmein shaamil kare.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Aye Allah! Ise unmein se bana de.' Phir Ansaar ka ek aur shaks khada hua aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mere liye dua kijiye ke Allah mujhe unmein shaamil kare.' Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Ukasha tumse pehle keh chuke.'

e: Narrated Qatada:I asked Anas, "What kind of clothes was most beloved to the Prophet?" He replied, "The Hibra (a kind of Yemenese cloth)
hi: Qatada bataate hain: Maine Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha, 'Nabi (SAW) ko kis qism ke kapde sabse zyaada pasand the?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Hibra (Yemen ka ek qism ka kapda).'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The most beloved garment to the Prophet (ﷺ) to wear was the Hibra (a kind of Yemenese cloth)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ko pehnne ke liye sabse zyaada aziz kapda Hibra (Yemen ka ek qism ka kapda) tha.

e: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died, he was covered with a Hibra Burd (green square decorated garment)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki zawja) bataati hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka intekaal hua, unhein Hibra Burd (hari, chaukor, sajaayi hui chaadar) se dhaanka gaya.

e: Narrated `Aisha and `Abdullah bin `Abbas:When the disease of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got aggravated, he covered his face with a Khamisa, but when he became short of breath, he would remove it from his face and say, "It is like that! May Allah curse the Jews Christians because they took the graves of their prophets as places of worship." By that he warned his follower of imitating them, by doing that which they did
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) aur Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki bimaari aur badh gayi, unhone apna chehra Khamisa (chaadar) se dhaank liya, magar jab unki saans phoolne lagi, wo use apne chehre se hata dete aur kehte, 'Aisa hi hai! Allah Yahudiyon aur Isaaiyon par laanat kare kyunke unhone apne Nabiyon ki qabron ko ibaadat ki jagah bana liya.' Isse unhone apne maanne walon ko unki tarah aisa karne ki nakal karne se khabardaar kiya.

e: Narrated Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) offered prayer while he was wearing a Khamisa of his that had printed marks. He looked at its marks and when he finished prayer, he said, "Take this Khamisa of mine to Abu Jahm, for it has just now diverted my attention from my prayer, and bring to me the Anbijania (a plain thick sheet) of Abu Jahm bin Hudhaifa bin Ghanim who belonged to Bani Adi bin Ka`b
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne namaz padhi jabke wo apna chhape hue nishaan waala Khamisa pehne hue the. Unhone uske nishaanon ki taraf dekha, aur jab namaz khatam ki, unhone kaha, 'Mera ye Khamisa Abu Jahm ke paas le jaao, kyunke isne abhi mera dhyaan meri namaz se hataaya. Aur mere liye Abu Jahm bin Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ghanim, jo Banu Adi bin Ka'b se the, ki Anbijania (ek saadi moti chaadar) le aao.'

e: Narrated Abu Burda:Aisha brought out to us a Kisa and an Izar and said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) died while wearing these two." (Kisa, a square black piece of woolen cloth. Izar, a sheet cloth garment covering the lower half of the body)
hi: Abu Burda bataate hain: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne hamare saamne ek Kisa (ooni chaukor kaali chaadar) aur ek Izaar nikaala aur kaha, 'Nabi (SAW) ka intekaal in dono ko pehne hue hua.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) had forbidden: (A) the Mulamasa and Munabadha (bargains), (B) the offering of two prayers, one after the morning compulsory prayer till the sun rises, and the others, after the `Asr prayer till the sun sets (C) He also forbade that one should sit wearing one garment, nothing of which covers his private parts (D) and prevent them from exposure to the sky; (E) he also forbade Ishtimalas- Samma
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne mana kiya tha: (A) Mulamasa aur Munabadha (khareed-farokht ke tareeke), (B) fajr ki farz namaz ke baad suraj nikalne tak, aur Asr ki namaz ke baad suraj doobne tak namaz padhne se, (C) unhone ye bhi mana kiya ke koi aisa ek kapda pehnkar baithe jo uski sharmgaah ko na dhaanke, (D) aur unhein aasman ki taraf khulne se roka; (E) unhone Ishtimal-as-Samma se bhi mana kiya.

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade two ways of wearing clothes and two kinds of dealings. (A) He forbade the dealings of the Mulamasa and the Munabadha. In the Mulamasa transaction the buyer just touches the garment he wants to buy at night or by daytime, and that touch would oblige him to buy it. In the Munabadha, one man throws his garment at another and the latter throws his at the former and the barter is complete and valid without examining the two objects or being satisfied with them (B) The two ways of wearing clothes were Ishtimal-as-Samma, i e., to cover one's shoulder with one's garment and leave the other bare: and the other way was to wrap oneself with a garment while one was sitting in such a way that nothing of that garment would cover one's private part
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kapde pehnne ke do tareeke aur do qism ki khareed-farokht se mana kiya. (A) Unhone Mulamasa aur Munabadha ki khareed-farokht se mana kiya. Mulamasa mein khareedaar raat ya din mein jis kapde ko khareedna chahta hai use sirf chhuta hai, aur wo chhuna hi use khareedne par majboor kar deta hai. Munabadha mein, ek shaks apna kapda doosre ki taraf phenkta hai aur doosra apna use ki taraf, aur ye badla dono cheezon ko dekhe ya santusht hue bagair mukammal aur maan liya jaata hai. (B) Kapde pehnne ke do tareeke the: Ishtimal-as-Samma, yaani apne ek kandhe ko apne kapde se dhaankna aur doosra khula chhodna; aur doosra tareeka apne aap ko ek kapde se aise lapetna ke baithte waqt kapde ka koi hissa sharmgaah ko na dhaanke.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade two types of dresses: (A) To sit in an Ihtiba' posture in one garment nothing of which covers his private parts. (B) to cover one side of his body with one garment and leave the other side bare The Prophet (ﷺ) also forbade the Mulamasa and Munabadha
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne do tarah ke kapde pehnne se mana kiya: (A) Ihtiba (ghutne modkar baithne) ki mudra mein ek aise kapde mein baithna jo sharmgaah ko na dhaanke. (B) apne jism ke ek taraf ko ek kapde se dhaankna aur doosri taraf khula chhodna. Nabi (SAW) ne Mulamasa aur Munabadha se bhi mana kiya.

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade Ishtimal-as-Samma' and that a man should sit in an Ihtiba' posture in one garment, nothing of which covers his private parts
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne Ishtimal-as-Samma se aur is baat se mana kiya ke koi shaks Ihtiba ki mudra mein ek aise kapde mein baithe jo sharmgaah ko na dhaanke.

e: Narrated Um Khalid bint Khalid:The Prophet (ﷺ) was given some clothes including a black Khamisa. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "To whom shall we give this to wear?" The people kept silent whereupon the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Fetch Um Khalid for me." I (Um Khalid) was brought carried (as I was small girl at that time). The Prophet (ﷺ) took the Khamisa in his hands and made me wear it and said, "May you live so long that your dress will wear out and you will mend it many times." On the Khamisa there were some green or pale designs (The Prophet (ﷺ) saw these designs) and said, "O Um Khalid! This is Sanah." (Sanah in a Ethiopian word meaning beautiful)
hi: Umm Khalid bint Khalid bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ko kuch kapde diye gaye jinmein ek kaala Khamisa bhi tha. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Ise kise pehnne ke liye dein?' Log khaamosh rahe, isper Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Umm Khalid ko mere paas laao.' Mujhe (Umm Khalid ko) uthaakar laaya gaya (kyunke main us waqt chhoti bachi thi). Nabi (SAW) ne Khamisa apne haathon mein liya aur mujhe pehnaaya aur kaha, 'Itni umar jiyo ke tumhaara ye kapda purana ho jaaye aur tum ise kayi baar theek karwaao.' Khamisa par kuch hare ya halke rang ke design the (Nabi SAW ne wo design dekhe) aur kaha, 'Aye Umm Khalid! Ye Sanah hai.' ('Sanah' ek Habshi lafz hai jiska matlab hai khoobsoorat.)

e: Narrated Anas:When Um Sulaim gave birth to a child. she said to me, "O Anas! Watch this boy carefully and do not give him anything to eat or drink until you have taken him to the Prophet (ﷺ) tomorrow morning for the Tahnik." So the next morning I took the child to the Prophet (ﷺ) who was sitting in a garden and was wearing a Huraithiya Khamisa and was branding the she-camel on which he had come during the Conquest of Mecca
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Umm Sulaim (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne ek bacche ko paidaish diya, unhone mujhse kaha, 'Aye Anas! Is bacche ka khayaal rakho aur use kuch khaane ya peene ko mat do jab tak tum use kal subah Tahnik ke liye Nabi (SAW) ke paas na le jao.' To agli subah main bacche ko Nabi (SAW) ke paas le gaya jo baagh mein baithe hue the, Huraithiya Khamisa pehne hue, aur us oontni par daagh laga rahe the jispar wo Fatah-e-Makkah ke dauraan aaye the.

e: Narrated `Ikrima:Rifa`a divorced his wife whereupon `AbdurRahman bin Az-Zubair Al-Qurazi married her. `Aisha said that the lady (came), wearing a green veil (and complained to her (Aisha) of her husband and showed her a green spot on her skin caused by beating). It was the habit of ladies to support each other, so when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came, `Aisha said, "I have not seen any woman suffering as much as the believing women. Look! Her skin is greener than her clothes!" When `AbdurRahman heard that his wife had gone to the Prophet, he came with his two sons from another wife. She said, "By Allah! I have done no wrong to him but he is impotent and is as useless to me as this," holding and showing the fringe of her garment, `Abdur-Rahman said, "By Allah, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! She has told a lie! I am very strong and can satisfy her but she is disobedient and wants to go back to Rifa`a." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, to her, "If that is your intention, then know that it is unlawful for you to remarry Rifa`a unless `Abdur-Rahman has had sexual intercourse with you." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) saw two boys with `Abdur- Rahman and asked (him), "Are these your sons?" On that `AbdurRahman said, "Yes." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You claim what you claim (i.e.. that he is impotent)? But by Allah, these boys resemble him as a crow resembles a crow
hi: Ikrima bataate hain: Rifa'a ne apni biwi ko talaaq de di, isper Abdur Rahman bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Qurazi ne unse nikaah kiya. Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne bataaya ke wo khaatoon (aayi), hara dupatta pehne hue (aur Aisha se apne shohar ki shikaayat ki aur unhein maar ki wajah se apni khaal par ek hara nishaan dikhaya). Auraton ki aadat thi ki wo ek doosre ki madad karti thin, to jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aaye, Aisha ne kaha, 'Maine kabhi kisi aurat ko Momin auraton jitna dukhi nahi dekha. Dekhiye! Uski khaal uske kapdon se bhi zyaada hari hai!' Jab Abdur Rahman ne suna ke uski biwi Nabi (SAW) ke paas gayi hai, wo apni doosri biwi se hue apne do beton ke saath aaye. Usne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam! Maine unke saath koi galat nahi kiya, magar wo napunsak hain aur mere kaam ke nahi, is (dupatte ke kinaare) jaise,' apne kapde ka kinaara pakadkar dikhaate hue. Abdur Rahman ne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, Aye Allah ke Rasool! Usne jhoot bola hai! Main bahut taaqatwar hoon aur use santusht kar sakta hoon, magar wo naafarmaan hai aur Rifa'a ke paas wapas jaana chahti hai.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne usse kaha, 'Agar yahi tumhaara irada hai, to jaan lo ke tumhaare liye Rifa'a se dobara nikaah karna jaayez nahi jab tak Abdur Rahman tumhaare saath humbistari na kare.' Phir Nabi (SAW) ne Abdur Rahman ke saath do ladke dekhe aur pucha (unse), 'Kya ye tumhaare bete hain?' Isper Abdur Rahman ne kaha, 'Haan.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Tum jo dawa karte ho wo karte ho (yaani ke tum napunsak ho)? Magar Allah ki qasam, ye ladke unse aise milte-julte hain jaise ek kauwa doosre kauwe se milta hai.'

e: Narrated Sa`d:On the day of the battle of Uhud, on the right and on the left of the Prophet (ﷺ) were two men wearing white clothes, and I had neither seen them before, nor did I see them afterwards
hi: Sa'd bataate hain: Jang-e-Uhud ke din, Nabi (SAW) ke daaen aur baaen taraf do aadmi the jo safed kapde pehne hue the, aur maine unhein na pehle kabhi dekha tha, na baad mein dekha.

e: Narrated Abu Dharr:I came to the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was wearing white clothes and sleeping. Then I went back to him again after he had got up from his sleep. He said, "Nobody says: 'None has the right to be worshipped but Allah' and then later on he dies while believing in that, except that he will enter Paradise." I said, "Even if he had committed illegal sexual intercourse and theft?" He said. 'Even if he had committed illegal sexual intercourse and theft." I said, "Even if he had committed illegal sexual intercourse and theft?" He said. 'Even if he had committed illegal sexual intercourse and theft." I said, 'Even it he had committed illegal sexual intercourse and theft?' He said, "Even if he had committed illegal sexual intercourse and theft, inspite of the Abu Dharr's dislike. Abu `Abdullah said, "This is at the time of death or before it if one repents and regrets and says "None has the right to be worshipped but Allah. He will be forgiven his sins
hi: Abu Dharr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya jabke wo safed kapde pehne hue so rahe the. Phir main unke jaagne ke baad dobara unke paas gaya. Unhone kaha, 'Koi bhi shaks "La ilaha illallah" (Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi) kehta hai aur phir isi Iman par mar jaata hai, wo Jannat mein daakhil hoga.' Maine pucha, 'Chaahe usne zina aur chori ki ho?' Unhone kaha, 'Chaahe usne zina aur chori ki ho.' Maine pucha, 'Chaahe usne zina aur chori ki ho?' Unhone kaha, 'Chaahe usne zina aur chori ki ho.' Maine pucha, 'Chaahe usne zina aur chori ki ho?' Unhone kaha, 'Chaahe usne zina aur chori ki ho,' Abu Dharr ki napasandidagi ke bawajood. Abu Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) kehte hain, 'Ye maut ke waqt ya usse pehle ki baat hai agar koi tauba kare, pachhtaawa kare aur kahe "La ilaha illallah." Uske gunaah maaf kar diye jaayenge.'

e: Narrated Aba `Uthman An-Nahdi:While we were with `Utba bin Farqad at Adharbijan, there came `Umar's letter indicating that Allah's Apostle had forbidden the use of silk except this much, then he pointed with his index and middle fingers. To our knowledge, by that he meant embroidery
hi: Aba Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) An-Nahdi bataate hain: Jab hum Utba bin Farqad ke saath Azerbaijan mein the, Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ka ek khat aaya jismein bataya gaya tha ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne resham istemaal karne se mana kiya siwaaye itne ke, phir unhone apni shahaadat aur beech ki ungli se ishara kiya. Hamaari samajh mein, unka matlab kadhaai (embroidery) se tha.

e: Narrated Abu `Uthman:While we were at Adharbijan, `Umar wrote to us: 'Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade wearing silk except this much. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) approximated his two fingers (index and middle fingers) (to illustrate that) to us.' Zuhair (the sub-narrator) raised up his middle and index fingers
hi: Abu Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab hum Azerbaijan mein the, Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne humein likha, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne resham pehanne se mana kiya, siwaaye itne ke.' Phir Nabi (SAW) ne apni do ungliyaan (shahaadat aur beech ki) paas-paas laa kar humein dikhaayi. (Ravi Zuhair ne apni beech ki aur shahaadat ki ungli uthaayi.)

e: Narrated Abu `Uthman:While we were with `Utba. `Umar wrote to us: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There is none who wears silk in this world except that he will wear nothing of it in the Hereafter." ' Abu `Uthman pointed out with his middle and index fingers. This hadith has also been narrated by Abu `Uthman
hi: Abu Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab hum Utba ke saath the, Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne humein likha, 'Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, "Jo koi is duniya mein resham pehanta hai, wo Aakhirat mein isme se kuch nahi pehanega."' Abu Uthman ne apni beech ki aur shahaadat ki ungli se ishara kiya. Ye hadees Abu Uthman se bhi riwaayat ki gayi hai.

e: Narrated Ibn Abi Laila:While Hudhaifa was at Al-Madain, he asked for water whereupon the chief of the village brought him water in a silver cup. Hudhaifa threw it at him and said, "I have thrown it only because I have forbidden him to use it, but he does not stop using it. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Gold, silver, silk and Dibaj (a kind of silk) are for them (unbelievers) in this world and for you (Muslims) in the hereafter
hi: Ibn Abi Laila bataate hain: Jab Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Mada'in mein the, unhone paani maanga, isper gaon ke sardaar ne unhein chaandi ke pyaale mein paani diya. Hudhaifa ne use unpar phenk diya aur kaha, 'Maine ise isliye phenka kyunke maine usse ise istemaal karne se mana kiya tha, magar wo istemaal karna nahi chhodta. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, "Sona, chaandi, resham aur Dibaj (ek qism ka resham) unke (kaafiron ke) liye is duniya mein hai, aur tumhaare (Musalmaanon ke) liye Aakhirat mein."'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, Whoever wears silk in this world shall not wear it in the Hereafter
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo is duniya mein resham pehanta hai, wo Aakhirat mein use nahi pehanega.'

e: Narrated Thabit:I heard Ibn Az-Zubair delivering a sermon, saying, "Muhammad said, 'Whoever wears silk in this world, shall not wear it in the Hereafter
hi: Thabit bataate hain: Maine Ibn Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko khutba dete hue ye kehte suna, 'Muhammad (SAW) ne farmaya, "Jo is duniya mein resham pehanta hai, wo Aakhirat mein use nahi pehanega."'

e: Narrated Ibn Az-Zubair:I heard `Umar saying, "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Whoever wears silk in this world, shall not wear it in the Hereafter." This hadith is also narrated through 'Umar ibn al-Khattab
hi: Ibn Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko ye kehte suna, 'Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, "Jo is duniya mein resham pehanta hai, wo Aakhirat mein use nahi pehanega."' Ye hadees Umar bin Al-Khattab ke zariye bhi riwaayat ki gayi hai.

e: Narrated 'Umar bin Al-Khattab (ra):Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "None wears silk in this world, but he who will have no share in the Hereafter
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Koi bhi is duniya mein resham nahi pehanta, siwaaye us shaks ke jiska Aakhirat mein koi hissa nahi hoga.'

e: Narrated Al-Bara:The Prophet (ﷺ) was given a silk garment as a gift and we started touching it with our hands and admiring it. On that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do you wonder at this?" We said, "Yes." He said, "The handkerchiefs of Sa`d bin Mu`adh in Paradise are better than this
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ko resham ka ek kapda tohfe mein diya gaya aur hum use apne haathon se chhoo kar uski taarif karne lage. Isper Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Kya tumhein isper hairaani hai?' Humne kaha, 'Haan.' Unhone kaha, 'Sa'd bin Mu'adh ke Jannat mein rumaal isse behtar hain.'

e: Narrated Hudhaifa:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade us to drink out of gold and silver vessels, or eat in it, Ann also forbade the wearing of silk and Dibaj or sitting on it
hi: Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne humein sone aur chaandi ke bartanon mein peene ya khaane se mana kiya, aur resham aur Dibaj pehanne ya unpar baithne se bhi mana kiya.

e: Narrated Ibn Azib:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade us to use the red Mayathir and to use Al-Qassiy
hi: Ibn Azib bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne humein laal Mayathir (resham ki gaddiyaan) aur Al-Qassiy (ek qism ka resham) istemaal karne se mana kiya.

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) allowed Az-Zubair and `Abdur-Rahman to wear silk because they were suffering from an itch
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Abdur Rahman ko resham pehanne ki ijaazat di kyunke unhein khujli ki bimaari thi.

e: Narrated `Ali bin Abi Talib:The Prophet (ﷺ) gave me a silk suit. I went out wearing it, but seeing the signs of anger on his face, I tore it and distributed it among my wives
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bin Abi Talib bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne mujhe resham ka ek suit diya. Main use pehan kar baahar gaya, magar unke chehre par gusse ke aasaar dekhkar, maine use phaad diya aur apni biwiyon mein baant diya.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:`Umar saw a silk suit being sold, so he said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Why don't you buy it so that you may wear it when delegates come to you, and also on Fridays?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "This is worn only by him who has no share in the Hereafter." Afterwards the Prophet (ﷺ) sent to `Umar a silk suit suitable for wearing. `Umar said to the Prophet, "You have given it to me to wear, yet I have heard you saying about it what you said?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I sent it to you so that you might either sell it or give it to somebody else to wear
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Umar ne resham ka ek suit bikte dekha, to unhone kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Aap ise kyun nahi khareedte taake jab aapke paas wafd (delegation) aayein ya Jumme ke din aap ise pehan sakein?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Ise sirf wahi pehanta hai jiska Aakhirat mein koi hissa nahi.' Baad mein Nabi (SAW) ne Umar ko pehanne laayak resham ka ek suit bheja. Umar ne Nabi (SAW) se kaha, 'Aapne mujhe ye pehanne ke liye diya, jabke maine aapko iske baare mein wo kehte suna jo aapne kaha?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Maine ye tumhein isliye bheja taake tum ise ya to bech do ya kisi aur ko pehanne ke liye de do.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:that he had seen Um Kulthum, the daughter of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) , wearing a red silk garment
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Unhone Umm Kulthum, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki beti, ko laal resham ka kapda pehne dekha tha.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:For one year I wanted to ask `Umar about the two women who helped each other against the Prophet (ﷺ) but I was afraid of him. One day he dismounted his riding animal and went among the trees of Arak to answer the call of nature, and when he returned, I asked him and he said, "(They were) `Aisha and Hafsa." Then he added, "We never used to give significance to ladies in the days of the Pre-Islamic period of ignorance, but when Islam came and Allah mentioned their rights, we used to give them their rights but did not allow them to interfere in our affairs. Once there was some dispute between me and my wife and she answered me back in a loud voice. I said to her, 'Strange! You can retort in this way?' She said, 'Yes. Do you say this to me while your daughter troubles Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?' So I went to Hafsa and said to her, 'I warn you not to disobey Allah and His Apostle.' I first went to Hafsa and then to Um Salama and told her the same. She said to me, 'O `Umar! It surprises me that you interfere in our affairs so much that you would poke your nose even into the affairs of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and his wives.' So she rejected my advice. There was an Ansari man; whenever he was absent from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and I was present there, I used to convey to him what had happened (on that day), and when I was absent and he was present there, he used to convey to me what had happened as regards news from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . During that time all the rulers of the nearby lands had surrendered to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) except the king of Ghassan in Sham, and we were afraid that he might attack us. All of a sudden the Ansari came and said, 'A great event has happened!' I asked him, 'What is it? Has the Ghassani (king) come?' He said, 'Greater than that! Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has divorced his wives! I went to them and found all of them weeping in their dwellings, and the Prophet (ﷺ) had ascended to an upper room of his. At the door of the room there was a slave to whom I went and said, "Ask the permission for me to enter." He admitted me and I entered to see the Prophet (ﷺ) lying on a mat that had left its imprint on his side. Under his head there was a leather pillow stuffed with palm fibres. Behold!
