There were some hides hanging there and some grass for tanning. Then I mentioned what I had said to Hafsa and Um Salama and what reply Um Salama had given me. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) smiled and stayed there for twenty nine days and then came down." (See Hadith No. 648, Vol. 3 for details)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek saal tak main Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se un do khawaateen ke baare mein poochna chahta tha jinhone Nabi (SAW) ke khilaaf ek doosre ki madad ki thi, magar main unse darta tha. Ek din wo apni sawaari se utre aur Arak ke darakhton ke beech qaza-e-haajat ke liye gaye, aur jab wapas aaye, maine unse pucha aur unhone kaha, '(Wo) Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) aur Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) (thin).' Phir unhone aage kaha, 'Hum Jaahiliyat ke daur mein auraton ko koi khaas ahmiyat nahi dete the, magar jab Islam aaya aur Allah ne unke haqq bataaye, hum unhein unke haqq dete the magar unhein hamare maamlon mein dakhal dene nahi dete the. Ek baar mere aur meri biwi ke beech kuch ikhtelaaf hua aur usne mujhe uncha awaaz mein jawab diya. Maine usse kaha, "Ajeeb baat hai! Tum mujhe is tarah jawab de sakti ho?" Usne kaha, "Haan. Kya aap mujhse ye kehte hain jabke aapki beti Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko pareshaan karti hai?" To main Hafsa ke paas gaya aur unse kaha, "Main tumhein Allah aur uske Rasool ki nafarmaani na karne ki chetaawani deta hoon." Pehle main Hafsa ke paas gaya, phir Umm Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas gaya aur unhein bhi yahi bataaya. Unhone mujhse kaha, "Aye Umar! Mujhe hairaani hai ke aap hamare maamlon mein itna dakhal dete hain ke aap Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur unki biwiyon ke maamlon mein bhi apni naak ghusaate hain." To unhone meri salaah rad kar di. Ek Ansaari shaks tha; jab bhi wo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas nahi hota aur main hota, main use us din ki khabar deta, aur jab main gair-haazir hota aur wo hota, wo mujhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se judi khabrein deta. Us waqt aas-paas ki saari zameenon ke hukmraan Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saamne jhuk chuke the, siwaaye Sham mein Ghassan ke baadshah ke, aur humein dar tha ke wo hum par hamla na kar de. Achaanak Ansaari aaya aur kaha, "Ek bada waaqia hua hai!" Maine pucha, "Kya hua? Kya Ghassani (baadshah) aa gaya?" Usne kaha, "Usse bhi bada! Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apni biwiyon ko talaaq de di hai!" Main unke paas gaya aur unhein apne kamron mein rote hue paaya, aur Nabi (SAW) apne oopar ke kamre mein chale gaye the. Kamre ke darwaaze par ek ghulaam tha jiske paas main gaya aur kaha, "Mere liye andar aane ki ijaazat maango." Usne mujhe andar jaane diya aur maine Nabi (SAW) ko ek chataayi par letā hua dekha jisne unki pasli par nishaan chhod diya tha. Unke sar ke neeche khajoor ke reshon se bhara chamde ka takiya tha. Dekha to kuch khaalein latki hui thin aur charmakaari ke liye kuch ghaas rakhi thi. Phir maine unhein bataaya jo maine Hafsa aur Umm Salama se kaha tha aur Umm Salama ne mujhe kya jawab diya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) muskuraaye aur unnees din wahaan rahe, phir neeche aaye.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 648, Jild 3 dekhein.)

e: Narrated Um Salama:One night the Prophet (ﷺ) woke up, saying, "None has the right to be worshipped but Allah! How many afflictions have been sent down tonight, and how many treasures have been sent down (disclosed)! Who will go and wake up (for prayers) the lady dwellers of these rooms? Many well dressed soul (people) in this world, will be naked on the Day of Resurrection
hi: Umm Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ek raat Nabi (SAW) uthe aur kehte, 'Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi! Aaj raat kitni museebaten naazil hui hain, aur kitne khazaane naazil (zaahir) hue hain! Kaun jaakar in kamron mein rehne wali khawaateen ko namaz ke liye jagayega? Kitne hi acche kapde pehne log is duniya mein Qayamat ke din nangy honge.'

e: Narrated Um Khalid bint Khalid:Some clothes were presented to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as a gift and there was a black Khamisa with it. The Prophet asked (his companions), "To whom do you suggest we give this Khamisa?" The people kept quiet. Then he said, "Bring me Um Khalid," So I was brought to him and he dressed me with it with his own hands and said twice, "May you live so long that you will wear out many garments." He then started looking at the embroidery of that Khamisa and said, "O Um Khalid! This is Sana!" (Sana in Ethiopian language means beautiful.) 'Is-haq, a sub-narrator, said: A woman of my family had told me that she had seen the Khamisa worn by Um Khalid
hi: Umm Khalid bint Khalid bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kuch kapde tohfe mein pesh kiye gaye, aur unmein ek kaala Khamisa bhi tha. Nabi (SAW) ne (apne sahaaba se) pucha, 'Tumhaari raay mein ye Khamisa hum kise dein?' Log khaamosh rahe. Phir unhone kaha, 'Umm Khalid ko mere paas laao.' To mujhe unke paas laaya gaya aur unhone mujhe apne haathon se ye pehnaaya aur do baar kaha, 'Itni umar jiyo ke tum bahut se kapde ghisaa do.' Phir unhone us Khamisa ki kadhaai dekhi aur kaha, 'Aye Umm Khalid! Ye Sana hai!' ('Sana' Habshi bhaasha mein khoobsoorat ke liye istemaal hota hai.) Ravi Ishaq kehte hain: Mere khaandaan ki ek khaatoon ne mujhe bataya ke unhone Umm Khalid ka pehna hua ye Khamisa dekha tha.

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade men to use saffron
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne mardon ko Zafraan istemaal karne se mana kiya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade Muhrims to wear clothes dyed with Wars or saffron
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne Muhrimon ko Wars ya Zafraan se rangaaye hue kapde pehanne se mana kiya.

e: Narrated Al-Bara:The Prophet (ﷺ) was of a modest height. I saw him wearing a red suit, and I did not see anything better than him
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) darmiyaani qad ke the. Maine unhein ek laal suit pehne dekha, aur maine unse behtar kuch nahi dekha.

e: Narrated Al-Bara:The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered us to observe seven things: To visit the sick; follow funeral processions; say 'May Allah bestow His Mercy on you', to the sneezer if he says, 'Praise be to Allah!; He forbade us to wear silk, Dibaj, Qassiy and Istibarq (various kinds of silken clothes); or to use red Mayathir (silkcushions). (See Hadith No. 253 A, Vol)
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne humein saat cheezon ka hukm diya: bimaar ki mizaajpursi karna; janaaze ke jaloos mein shaamil hona; chheenkne wale ko 'Yarhamuk-Allah' kehna agar wo 'Alhamdulillah' kahe; unhone humein resham, Dibaj, Qassiy aur Istibarq (resham ki alag-alag qismein) pehanne se, ya laal Mayathir (resham ki gaddiyaan) istemaal karne se mana kiya.

e: Narrated Sa`id Abu Maslama:I asked Anas (bin Malik), "Did the Prophet (ﷺ) use to offer the prayers with his shoes on?" He said, "Yes
hi: Saeed Abu Maslama bataate hain: Maine Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) (bin Malik) se pucha, 'Kya Nabi (SAW) jootiyaan pehankar namaz padhte the?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan.'

e: Narrated Sa`id Al-Maqburi:'Ubai bin Juraij said to `Abdullah Ben `Umar, "I see you doing four things which are not done by your friends." Ibn `Umar said, "What are they, O Ibn Juraij?" He said, "I see that you do not touch except the two Yemenite corners of the Ka`ba (while performing the Tawaf): and I see you wearing the Sabtiyya shoes; and I see you dyeing (your hair) with Sufra; and I see that when you are in Mecca, the people assume the state of Ihram on seeing the crescent (on the first day of Dhul-Hijja) while you do not assume the state of Ihram till the Day of Tarwiya (8th Dhul Hijja)." `Abdullah bin `Umar said to him, "As for the corners of the Ka`ba, I have not seen Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) touching except the two Yemenite corners, As for the Sabtiyya shoes, I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) wearing leather shoes that had no hair, and he used to perform the ablution while wearing them. Therefore, I like to wear such shoes. As regards dyeing with Sufra, I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) dyeing his hair with it, so I like to dye (my hair) with it. As regards the crescent (of Dhul-Hijja), I have not seen Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) assuming the state of Ihram till his she-camel set out (on the 8th of Dhul-Hijja)
hi: Saeed Al-Maqburi bataate hain: Ubai bin Juraij ne Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kaha, 'Main dekhta hoon aap chaar aisi cheezein karte hain jo aapke saathi nahi karte.' Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Wo kya hain, Aye Ibn Juraij?' Usne kaha, 'Main dekhta hoon ke aap (Tawaf karte waqt) Kaaba ke sirf Yemeni kone hi chhoote hain; aur main dekhta hoon ke aap Sabtiyya jootiyaan pehante hain; aur main dekhta hoon ke aap Sufra (peela rang) se (apne baal) rangte hain; aur main dekhta hoon ke jab aap Makkah mein hote hain, log chaand dekhkar (Zul-Hijja ke pehle din) Ihram baandh lete hain jabke aap Tarwiya ke din (8 Zul-Hijja) tak Ihram nahi baandhte.' Abdullah bin Umar ne usse kaha, 'Jahaan tak Kaaba ke konon ki baat hai, maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko sirf do Yemeni kone chhote dekha hai. Jahaan tak Sabtiyya jootiyon ki baat hai, maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko aise chamde ki jootiyaan pehante dekha jinpar baal nahi hote the, aur wo unhein pehankar wuzu karte the, isliye mujhe aisi jootiyaan pehanna pasand hai. Jahaan tak Sufra se rangne ki baat hai, maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko apne baal isse rangte dekha hai, isliye mujhe bhi (apne baal) isse rangna pasand hai. Jahaan tak Zul-Hijja ke chaand ki baat hai, maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko unki oontni ke rawaana hone (8 Zul-Hijja) tak Ihram baandhte nahi dekha.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade that a Muhrim should wear clothes dyed with Saffron or Wars, and said, "Whoever has no shoes can put on Khuffs (socks made from thick fabric or leather) after cutting it below the ankles
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Muhrim ko Zafraan ya Wars se rangaaye kapde pehanne se mana kiya, aur kaha, 'Jiske paas jootiyaan na hon, wo takhnon se neeche kaat kar Khuff pehan sakta hai.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever has no Izar (waist sheet), can wear trousers; and whoever has no sandals, can wear Khuffs (socks made from thick fabric or leather, but cut them short below the ankles)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jiske paas Izaar na ho, wo pajaama pehan sakta hai; aur jiske paas jootiyaan na hon, wo Khuff pehan sakta hai (magar takhnon se neeche kaat kar).'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to like starting from the right in performing ablution, combing his hair and putting on his shoes
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ko wuzu karte waqt, baal sanwaarte waqt, aur jootiyaan pehante waqt daayin taraf se shuru karna pasand tha.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If you want to put on your shoes, put on the right shoe first; and if you want to take them off, take the left one first. Let the right shoe be the first to be put on and the last to be taken off
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar tum jootiyaan pehanna chaaho, to pehle daayaan joota pehno; aur agar utaarna chaaho, to pehle baayaan joota utaaro. Daayaan joota pehla pehna jaaye aur aakhri utaara jaaye.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "None of you should walk, wearing one shoe only; he should either put on both shoes or put on no shoes whatsoever
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Tum mein se koi ek hi joota pehankar na chale; use ya to dono jootiyaan pehnni chaahiye ya bilkul nahi pehnni chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Anas:The sandal of the Prophet (ﷺ) had two straps
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ki chappal mein do fite (straps) the.

e: Narrated Isaa bin Tahman:Anas bin Malik brought out for us, two sandals having two straps. Thabit Al-Banani said, "These were the sandals of the Prophet (ﷺ)
hi: Isaa bin Tahman bataate hain: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne hamare saamne do fiton wali do chappalein nikaali. Thabit Al-Banani ne kaha, 'Ye Nabi (SAW) ki chappalein thin.'

e: Narrated Abu Juhaifa:I came to the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was inside a red leather tent, and I saw Bilal taking the remaining water of the ablution of the Prophet, and the people were taking of that water and rubbing it on their faces; and whoever could not get anything of it, would share the moisture of the hand of his companion (and then rub it on his face)
hi: Abu Juhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya jabke wo ek laal chamde ke khaime mein the, aur maine Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko Nabi (SAW) ke wuzu ka baacha hua paani lete dekha, aur log us paani ko lekar apne chehron par malte the; aur jo koi kuch na paata, wo apne saathi ke haath ki namee se hi (kaam chalaakar apne chehre par malta).

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) called for the Ansar and gathered them in a leather tent
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne Ansaar ko bulaaya aur unhein ek chamde ke khaime mein jama kiya.

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to construct a loom with a Hasir at night m order to pray therein, and during the day he used to spread it out and sit on it. The people started coming to the Prophet (ﷺ) at night to offer the prayer behind him When their number increased, the Prophet (ﷺ) faced them and said. O people! Do only those good deeds which you can do, for Allah does not get tired (of giving reward) till you get tired, and the best deeds to Allah are the incessant ones though they were few
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) raat ko ek Hasir (chataayi) se ek chhota ghera bana lete taake usmein namaz padh sakein, aur din mein use bicha kar uspar baith jaate. Log Nabi (SAW) ke paas raat mein unke peechhe namaz padhne aane lage. Jab unki tadaad badh gayi, Nabi (SAW) ne unki taraf mudkar kaha, 'Aye logo! Sirf wahi nek amaal karo jo tum kar sakte ho, kyunke Allah (ajr dete-dete) nahi thakta jab tak tum khud na thak jao, aur Allah ke nazdeek sabse behtareen amaal wo hain jo lagataar kiye jaayein, chaahe wo kam hi kyun na hon.'

e: Narrated Al-Miswar bin Makhrama:My father, Makhrama said to me, "I have come to know that some cloaks have come to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he is distributing them. So O my son! take me to him." We went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and found him in the house. My father said to me, "O my son! Call the Prophet (ﷺ) for me." I found it hard to do so, so I said surprisingly, "Shall I call Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for you ?" My father said, "O mu son! He is not a tyrant." So I called him and he came out wearing a Dibaj cloak having gold buttons, and said: "O Makhrama, I kept this for you." The Prophet (ﷺ) then gave it to him
hi: Al-Miswar bin Makhrama (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Mere waalid, Makhrama, ne mujhse kaha, 'Mujhe pata chala hai ke Nabi (SAW) ke paas kuch chogha aaye hain aur wo unhein baant rahe hain. To Aye mere bete! Mujhe unke paas le chalo.' Hum Nabi (SAW) ke paas gaye aur unhein ghar mein paaya. Mere waalid ne mujhse kaha, 'Aye mere bete! Nabi (SAW) ko mere liye bulao.' Mujhe ye mushkil laga, isliye maine hairaan hokar kaha, 'Kya main aapke liye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko bulaaun?' Mere waalid ne kaha, 'Aye mere bete! Wo koi zaalim nahi hain.' To maine unhein bulaaya aur wo baahar aaye, Dibaj ka ek chogha pehne hue jispar sone ke button the, aur kaha, 'Aye Makhrama, maine ye tumhaare liye rakha hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne phir wo unhein de diya.

e: Narrated Al-Bara' bin `Azib:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade us to use seven things: He forbade using gold rings, silk, Istabraq, Dibaj, red Mayathir, Al-Qassiy, and silver utensils. He ordered us to do seven other things. To pay a visit to the sick; to follow funeral processions; to say, "May Allah be merciful to you" to a sneezer if he says "Praise be to Allah"; to return greetings, to accept invitations; to help others to fulfil their oaths and to help the oppressed ones
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne humein saat cheezon se mana kiya: sone ki anguthiyaan, resham, Istabraq, Dibaj, laal Mayathir, Al-Qassiy, aur chaandi ke bartan istemaal karne se. Unhone humein saat aur cheezon ka hukm diya: bimaar ki mizaajpursi karna; janaaze ke jaloos mein shaamil hona; chheenkne wale ko 'Yarhamuk-Allah' kehna agar wo 'Alhamdulillah' kahe; salaam ka jawab dena; dawat qubool karna; doosron ko unki qasmein poori karne mein madad karna; aur mazloomon ki madad karna.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the wearing of a gold ring
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne sone ki anguthi pehanne se mana kiya.

e: Narrated `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) wore a gold or silver .. ring and placed its stone towards the palm of his hand. The people also started wearing gold rings like it, but when the Prophet (ﷺ) saw them wearing such rings, he threw away that golden ring and then wore a silver ring
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne sone ya chaandi ki anguthi pehni aur uska patthar apni hatheli ki taraf rakha. Log bhi unki tarah sone ki anguthiyaan pehanne lage, magar jab Nabi (SAW) ne unhein aisi anguthiyaan pehante dekha, unhone apni sone ki anguthi phenk di aur phir chaandi ki anguthi pehni.

e: Narrated Ibn. `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) wore a gold ring or a silver ring and placed its stone towards the palm of his hand and had the name 'Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah' engraved on it. The people also started wearing gold rings like it, but when the Prophet (ﷺ) saw them wearing such rings, he threw away his own ring and said. "I will never wear it," and then wore a silver ring, whereupon the people too started wearing silver rings. Ibn `Umar added: After the Prophet (ﷺ) Abu Bakr wore the ring, and then `Umar and then `Uthman wore it till it fell in the Aris well from `Uthman
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne sone ya chaandi ki anguthi pehni aur uska patthar apni hatheli ki taraf rakha aur usper 'Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool' likhwaaya. Log bhi unki tarah sone ki anguthiyaan pehanne lage, magar jab Nabi (SAW) ne unhein aisi anguthiyaan pehante dekha, unhone apni anguthi phenk di aur kaha, 'Main ise kabhi nahi pehanunga,' phir chaandi ki anguthi pehni, isper log bhi chaandi ki anguthiyaan pehanne lage. Ibn Umar ne aage kaha: Nabi (SAW) ke baad Abu Bakr ne wo anguthi pehni, phir Umar, phir Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne pehni yahaan tak ke wo Uthman ke haath se Aris kuen mein gir gayi.

e: Narrated Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) wore a gold ring, then he threw it and said, "I will never wear it." The people also threw their (gold) rings
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne sone ki anguthi pehni, phir use phenk diya aur kaha, 'Main ise kabhi nahi pehanunga.' Log bhi apni (sone ki) anguthiyaan phenkne lage.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:that he saw a silver ring on the hand of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for one day only. Then the people had silver rings made for themselves and wore it. On that, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) threw away their rings as well. (For the details of this Hadith, see Fath-ul-Bari, Vol. 12, page)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke haath mein chaandi ki anguthi sirf ek din dekhi. Phir logon ne bhi apne liye chaandi ki anguthiyaan banwaayi aur pehni. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unki anguthiyaan bhi phenk di.

e: Narrated Humaid:Anas was asked, "Did the Prophet (ﷺ) wear a ring?" Anas said, "Once he delayed the: `Isha' prayer till midnight. Then he came, facing us ..... as if I am now Looking at the glitter of his ring ..... and said, "The people have offered their prayers and slept but you have been in prayer as you have been waiting for it
hi: Humaid bataate hain: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha gaya, 'Kya Nabi (SAW) anguthi pehante the?' Anas ne kaha, 'Ek baar unhone Isha ki namaz aadhi raat tak der kar di. Phir wo aaye, hamaari taraf muh karke ..... jaise ke main abhi bhi unki anguthi ki chamak dekh raha hoon ..... aur kaha, "Logon ne apni namaz padh li hai aur so gaye hain, magar tum namaz mein rahe ho kyunke tum iska intezaar kar rahe the."'

e: Narrated Anas:The ring of the Prophet (ﷺ) was of silver, and its stone was of silver too
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ki anguthi chaandi ki thi, aur uska patthar bhi chaandi ka tha.

e: Narrated Sahl:A woman came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "I have come to present myself to you (for marriage)." She kept standing for a long period during which period the Prophet (ﷺ) looked at her carefully. When she stayed for a Long period, a man said to the Prophet (ﷺ) "If you are not in need of her, then marry her to me." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Have you got anything to give her (as Mahr)?" The man said, "No." The Prophet said, "Go (to your house) and search for something." The man went and came back to say, "By Allah, I could not find anything." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Go again and search for something, even if it be an iron ring." He went again and came back saying, "No, by Allah, I could not get even an iron ring." The man had only an Izar and had no Rida' (upper garment). He said, "I will give her my Izar as Mahr." On that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Your Izar? If she wears it, nothing of it will remain on you, and if you wear it nothing of it will be on her" The man went aside and sat down When the Prophet (ﷺ) saw him leaving (after a while), he called back and asked. "How much Qur'an do you know (by heart)? He said, 'I know such and such Suras," naming some Suras. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I marry her to you for the amount of Qur'an you know (by heart)
hi: Sahl bataate hain: Ek khaatoon Nabi (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha, 'Main aapke saamne (nikaah ke liye) apna aap pesh karne aayi hoon.' Wo lambe waqt tak khadi rahi, is dauraan Nabi (SAW) ne use ghaur se dekha. Jab wo lambe waqt tak khadi rahi, ek shaks ne Nabi (SAW) se kaha, 'Agar aapko iski zaroorat nahi, to inka nikaah mujhse kar dijiye.' Nabi (SAW) ne pucha, 'Kya tumhaare paas usse dene ke liye (Mahr) kuch hai?' Us shaks ne kaha, 'Nahi.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Jaao (apne ghar) aur kuch dhoondo.' Wo gaya aur wapas aakar kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, mujhe kuch nahi mila.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Phir jaao aur kuch dhoondo, chaahe wo loha ki anguthi hi kyun na ho.' Wo phir gaya aur wapas aakar kaha, 'Nahi, Allah ki qasam, mujhe loha ki anguthi bhi nahi mili.' Us shaks ke paas sirf ek Izaar tha aur koi Rida (oopari kapda) nahi tha. Usne kaha, 'Main use apna Izaar bataur Mahr doonga.' Isper Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Tumhaara Izaar? Agar wo use pehne, to tumhaare paas kuch nahi bachega, aur agar tum use pehno, to uske paas kuch nahi bachega.' Wo shaks ek taraf baith gaya. Jab Nabi (SAW) ne use jaate (kuch der baad) dekha, unhone use wapas bulwaaya aur pucha, 'Tumhein kitna Quran (yaad) aata hai?' Usne kaha, 'Mujhe falaan-falaan Surate aati hain,' kuch Suraton ke naam lete hue. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Main iska nikaah tumse us Quran ke badle mein karta hoon jo tumhein yaad hai.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) wanted to write a letter to a group of people or some non-Arabs. It was said to him, "They do not accept any letter unless it is stamped." So the Prophet (ﷺ) had a silver ring made for himself, and on it was engraved: 'Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah'. .. as if I am now looking at the glitter of the ring on the finger (or in the palm) of the Prophet (ﷺ)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) kuch logon ya gair-Arabon ke ek giroh ko khat likhna chahte the. Unse kaha gaya, 'Wo koi bhi khat qubool nahi karte jab tak usper mohar na lagi ho.' To Nabi (SAW) ne apne liye chaandi ki ek anguthi banwaayi jispar 'Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool' likhwaaya gaya ..... jaise ke main abhi bhi Nabi (SAW) ki ungli (ya hatheli) mein us anguthi ki chamak dekh raha hoon.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had a silver ring made for himself and it was worn by him on his hand. Afterwards it was worn by Abu Bakr, and then by `Umar, and then by `Uthman till it fell in the Aris well. (On that ring) was engraved: 'Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne liye chaandi ki ek anguthi banwaayi aur use apne haath mein pehna. Baad mein Abu Bakr ne use pehna, phir Umar ne, phir Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne, yahaan tak ke wo Aris kuen mein gir gayi. (Us anguthi par) 'Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool' likha hua tha.

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) got a ring made for himself and said, "I have got a ring made (for myself) and engraved a certain engraving on it so none of you should get such an engraving on his ring." I saw the glitter of the ring on his little finger
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne apne liye ek anguthi banwaayi aur kaha, 'Maine (apne liye) ek anguthi banwaayi hai aur usper ek khaas naqsh khudwaaya hai, isliye tum mein se koi apni anguthi par aisa naqsh na khudwaaye.' Maine unki chhoti ungli mein anguthi ki chamak dekhi.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:When the Prophet (ﷺ) intended to write to the Byzantines, it was said to him, "Those people do not read your letter unless it is stamped." So the Prophet (ﷺ) took a silver ring and got 'Muhammad, the Apostle of Allah' engraved on it .... as if I am now looking at its glitter in his hand
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Nabi (SAW) ne Rome ke logon (Byzantines) ko khat likhne ka iraada kiya, unse kaha gaya, 'Wo log tumhaara khat tab tak nahi padhte jab tak usper mohar na lagi ho.' To Nabi (SAW) ne chaandi ki anguthi li aur usper 'Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool' khudwaaya ..... jaise ke main abhi bhi unke haath mein uski chamak dekh raha hoon.

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) had a golden ring made for himself, and when he wore it. he used to turn its stone toward the palm of his! hand. So the people too had gold made for themselves. The Prophet (ﷺ) then ascended the pulpit, and after glorifying and praising Allah, he said, "I had it made for me, but now I will never wear it again." He threw it away, and then the people threw away their rings too. (Juwairiya, a subnarrator, said: I think Anas said that the Prophet (ﷺ) was wearing the ring in his right hand
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne apne liye sone ki anguthi banwaayi, aur jab wo use pehante, uska patthar apni hatheli ki taraf mod dete. To log bhi apne liye sone ki anguthiyaan banwaane lage. Nabi (SAW) phir mimbar par chadhe, aur Allah ki taarif aur hamd karne ke baad kaha, 'Maine ise apne liye banwaaya tha, magar ab main ise kabhi nahi pehanunga.' Unhone use phenk diya, phir logon ne bhi apni anguthiyaan phenk di. (Ravi Juwairiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) kehte hain: Mujhe lagta hai Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha ke Nabi (SAW) anguthi apne daaen haath mein pehante the.)

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took a silver ring and had 'Muhammad, the Apostle' of Allah' engraved on it. The Prophet then said (to us), 'I have a silver ring with 'Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah engraved on it, so none of you should have the same engraving on his ring
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne chaandi ki anguthi li aur usper 'Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool' khudwaaya. Phir Nabi (SAW) ne (humse) kaha, 'Meri chaandi ki anguthi hai jispar "Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool" khuda hai, isliye tum mein se koi apni anguthi par aisa hi naqsh na khudwaaye.'

e: Narrated Anas:that when Abu Bakr became the Caliph, he wrote a letter to him (and stamped it with the Prophet's ring) and the engraving of the ring was in three lines: Muhammad in one line, 'Apostle' in another line, and 'Allah' in a third line
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Abu Bakr Khalifa bane, unhone unhein ek khat likha (aur Nabi ki anguthi se mohar lagaayi) aur anguthi ka naqsh teen lakeeron mein tha: 'Muhammad' ek lakeer mein, 'Rasool' doosri lakeer mein, aur 'Allah' teesri lakeer mein.

e: Anas added:The ring of the Prophet (ﷺ) was in his hand, and after him, in Abu Bakr's hand, and then in `Umar's hand after Abu Bakr. When `Uthman was the Caliph, once he was sitting at the well of Aris. He removed the ring from his hand and while he was trifling with it, dropped into the well. We kept on going to the well with `Uthman for three days looking for the ring, and finally the well was drained, but the ring was not found
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne aage kaha: Nabi (SAW) ki anguthi unke haath mein rahi, unke baad Abu Bakr ke haath mein, phir Abu Bakr ke baad Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke haath mein. Jab Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) Khalifa the, ek baar wo Aris ke kuen par baithe the. Unhone anguthi apne haath se nikaali aur usse khelte hue, wo kuen mein gir gayi. Hum teen din tak Uthman ke saath kuen par anguthi dhoondhte rahe, aakhir kuen ka paani nikaala gaya, magar anguthi nahi mili.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I offered the `Id prayer with the Prophet (ﷺ) and he offered prayer before the Khutba (sermon). ibn `Abbas added: After the prayer the Prophet (ﷺ) came towards (the rows of) the women and ordered them to give alms, and the women started putting their big and small rings in the garment of Bilal
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ke saath Eid ki namaz padhi aur unhone khutba se pehle namaz padhaayi. Ibn Abbas ne aage kaha: Namaz ke baad Nabi (SAW) auraton ki qataaron ki taraf gaye aur unhein sadqa dene ka hukm diya, aur auraten apni badi aur chhoti anguthiyaan Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke kapde mein daalne lagi.

e: Narrated ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) came out on the day of `Id and offered a two-rak`at prayer, and he did not pray any rak`a before it, nor after it. Then he went towards the women and ordered them to give alms. The women started donating their earring and necklaces
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) Eid ke din baahar aaye aur do rakat namaz padhi, aur usse pehle ya baad koi aur rakat nahi padhi. Phir wo auraton ki taraf gaye aur unhein sadqa dene ka hukm diya. Auraten apni baaliyaan aur haar sadqa dene lagi.

e: Narrated `Aisha:A necklace belonging to Asma' was lost, and the Prophet (ﷺ) sent men in its search. The time for the prayer became due and they were without ablution and they could not find water; therefore they prayed without ablution, They mentioned that to the Prophet (ﷺ) . Then Allah revealed the Verse of Tayammum. (`Aisha added: that she had borrowed (the necklace) from Asma
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) ka ek haar kho gaya, aur Nabi (SAW) ne use dhoondhne ke liye log bheje. Namaz ka waqt aa gaya aur unke paas wuzu nahi tha aur unhein paani nahi mila; isliye unhone bagair wuzu ke namaz padhi. Unhone ye baat Nabi (SAW) ko bataayi. Phir Allah ne Tayammum ki Aayat naazil ki. (Aisha ne aage bataaya ke unhone (haar) Asma se udhaar liya tha.)

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:"The Prophet (ﷺ) offered a two-rak`at prayer on `Id day and he did not offer any (Nawafil prayer) before or after it. He then went towards the women, and Bilal was accompanying him, and ordered them to give alms. And so the women started giving their earrings (etc)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne Eid ke din do rakat namaz padhi aur usse pehle ya baad koi (Nawafil) namaz nahi padhi. Phir wo auraton ki taraf gaye, Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) unke saath the, aur unhein sadqa dene ka hukm diya. Aur auraten apni baaliyaan (waghera) dene lagi.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I was with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in one of the Markets of Medina. He left (the market) and so did I. Then he asked thrice, "Where is the small (child)?" Then he said, "Call Al-Hasan bin `Ali." So Al-Hasan bin `Ali got up and started walking with a necklace (of beads) around his neck. The Prophet (ﷺ) stretched his hand out like this, and Al-Hasan did the same. The Prophet (ﷺ) embraced him and said, "O Allah! I love him, so please love him and love those who love him." Since Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said that. nothing has been dearer to me than Al-Hasan
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Madina ke ek bazaar mein tha. Unhone (bazaar) chhoda aur maine bhi. Phir unhone teen baar pucha, 'Chhota (bacha) kahaan hai?' Phir unhone kaha, 'Al-Hasan bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko bulaao.' To Al-Hasan bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) uthe aur apni gardan mein (moti ke) haar pehne chalne lage. Nabi (SAW) ne apna haath is tarah phailaaya, aur Al-Hasan (Alayhis Salam) ne bhi waisa hi kiya. Nabi (SAW) ne unhein gale lagaya aur kaha, 'Aye Allah! Main ise muhabbat karta hoon, isliye tu bhi ise muhabbat kar aur un logon ko bhi muhabbat kar jo ise muhabbat karte hain.' Jab se Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ye kaha, mujhe Al-Hasan se zyaada aziz kuch nahi laga.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) cursed those men who are in the similitude (assume the manners) of women and those women who are in the similitude (assume the manners) of men
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne un mardon par laanat ki jo auraton jaisi harkatein karte hain aur un auraton par jo mardon jaisi harkatein karti hain.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) cursed effeminate men (those men who are in the similitude (assume the manners of women) and those women who assume the manners of men, and he said, "Turn them out of your houses ." The Prophet (ﷺ) turned out such-and-such man, and `Umar turned out such-and-such woman
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne un mardon par laanat ki jo zanaana (auraton jaisi) harkatein karte hain aur un auraton par jo mardaana harkatein karti hain, aur kaha, 'Inhein apne gharon se nikaal do.' Nabi (SAW) ne falaan-falaan aadmi ko nikaala, aur Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne falaan-falaan aurat ko nikaala.

e: Narrated Um Salama:that once the Prophet (ﷺ) was in her house, and an effeminate man was there too. The effeminate man said to `Abdullah, (Um Salama's brother) "0 `Abdullah! If Ta'if should be conquered tomorrow, I recommend you the daughter of Ghailan, for she is so fat that she has four curves in the front (of her belly) and eight at the back." So the Prophet (ﷺ) said (to his wives) "These effeminate (men) should not enter upon you (your houses)
hi: Umm Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ek baar Nabi (SAW) unke ghar mein the, aur wahaan ek zanaana (auraton jaisi harkatein karne wala) aadmi bhi tha. Us zanaana aadmi ne Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) (Umm Salama ke bhai) se kaha, 'Aye Abdullah! Agar kal Taif fatah ho jaaye, to main tumhein Ghailan ki beti ki sifaarish karta hoon, kyunke wo itni motaayi wali hai ke uske aage char sikan hain aur peeche aath.' Isper Nabi (SAW) ne (apni biwiyon se) kaha, 'In zanaana logon ko apne (gharon) mein aane mat do.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "To get the moustaches cut 'short is characteristic of the Fitra
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Moonchhein chhoti katwaana Fitra (fitrat) ki khaasiyat hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Five practices are characteristics of the Fitra: circumcision, shaving the pubic region, clipping the nails and cutting the moustaches short
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Paanch cheezein Fitra (fitrat) ki khaasiyat hain: khatna, sharmgaah ke baal mundwaana, naakhoon kaatna, aur moonchhein chhoti karna.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "To shave the pubic hair. to clip the nails and to cut the moustaches short, are characteristics of the Fitra
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Sharmgaah ke baal mundwaana, naakhoon kaatna, aur moonchhein chhoti karna, Fitra ki khaasiyaten hain.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying. "Five practices are characteristics of the Fitra: circumcision, shaving the pubic hair, cutting the moustaches short, clipping the nails, and depilating the hair of the armpits
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Paanch cheezein Fitra ki khaasiyat hain: khatna, sharmgaah ke baal mundwaana, moonchhein chhoti karna, naakhoon kaatna, aur baaghal ke baal saaf karna.'

e: Narrated Nafi`:Ibn `Umar said, The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Do the opposite of what the pagans do. Keep the beards and cut the moustaches short.' Whenever Ibn `Umar performed the Hajj or `Umra, he used to hold his beard with his hand and cut whatever remained outside his hold
hi: Nafi bataate hain: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Mushrikeen jo karte hain uske ulat karo. Daadi rakho aur moonchhein chhoti karo.' Jab bhi Ibn Umar Hajj ya Umra karte, wo apni daadi apne haath se pakadte aur jo bhi mutthi se bahar rehta use kaat dete.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Cut the moustaches short and leave the beard (as it is)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Moonchhein chhoti karo aur daadi (jaisi hai waisi) rehne do.'

e: Narrated Muhammad bin Seereen:I asked Anas, "Did the Prophet (ﷺ) dye his hair?" Anas replied, "The Prophet (ﷺ) did not have except a few grey hairs
hi: Muhammad bin Seereen bataate hain: Maine Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha, 'Kya Nabi (SAW) apne baal rangte the?' Anas ne jawab diya, 'Nabi (SAW) ke sirf kuch hi safed baal the.'

e: Narrated Thabit:Anas was asked whether the Prophet (ﷺ) used a a hair dye or not. He replied, "The Prophet (ﷺ) did not have enough grey hair to dye, (such that) if I wanted to count the fading hairs in his beard (I could have)
hi: Thabit bataate hain: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha gaya ke kya Nabi (SAW) baal rangne wali dawa (hair dye) istemaal karte the ya nahi. Unhone jawab diya, 'Nabi (SAW) ke paas rangne laayak itne safed baal nahi the, (itne kam the ke) agar main unki daadi ke halke baal ginana chahta (to gin sakta tha).'

e: Narrated IsraiI:`Uthman bin `Abdullah bin Mauhab said, "My people sent me with a bowl of water to Um Salama." Isra'il approximated three fingers ('indicating the small size of the container in which there was some hair of the Prophet. `Uthman added, "If any person suffered from evil eye or some other disease, he would send a vessel (containing water) to Um Salama. I looked into the container (that held the hair of the Prophet) and saw a few red hairs in it
hi: Israil bataate hain: Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Mauhab ne kaha, 'Mere logon ne mujhe ek katore paani ke saath Umm Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas bheja.' Israil ne apni teen ungliyaan paas laayin (us chhote bartan ka size dikhaate hue jismein Nabi (SAW) ke kuch baal the). Uthman ne aage kaha, 'Agar koi bad-nazar ya kisi aur bimaari se pareshaan hota, to wo ek bartan (paani ka) Umm Salama ke paas bhejta.' Maine us bartan mein dekha (jismein Nabi ke baal the) aur usmein kuch laal baal dekhe.

e: Narrated `Uthman bin `Abdullah bin Mauhab:I went to Um Salama and she brought out for us some of the dyed hair of the Prophet
hi: Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Mauhab bataate hain: Main Umm Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas gaya aur unhone humare liye Nabi (SAW) ke kuch rangaaye hue baal nikaale.

e: Ibn Mauhab also said that Um Salama had shown him the red hair of the Prophet
hi: Ibn Mauhab ne ye bhi kaha ke Umm Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne unhein Nabi (SAW) ke laal baal dikhaaye the.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Jews and Christians do not dye their hair so you should do the opposite of what they do
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Yahudi aur Isaai apne baal nahi rangte, isliye tumhein unke ulat karna chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) was neither conspicuously tall, nor short; neither, very white, nor tawny. His hair was neither much curled, nor very straight. Allah sent him (as an Apostle) at the age of forty (and after that) he stayed for ten years in Mecca, and for ten more years in Medina. Allah took him unto Him at the age of sixty, and he scarcely had ten white hairs on his head and in his beard
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) na to bahut lambe the, na chhote; na bahut gore the, na saanwle. Unke baal na bahut ghungraale the, na bilkul seedhe. Allah ne unhein chaalis saal ki umar mein (Rasool bana kar) bheja, aur (uske baad) wo das saal Makkah mein aur das saal Madina mein rahe. Allah ne unhein saath saal ki umar mein apne paas bula liya, aur us waqt unke sar aur daadi mein mushkil se das safed baal the.

e: Narrated Al-Bara':I did not see anybody in a red cloak looking more handsome than the Prophet. Narrated Malik: The hair of the Prophet (ﷺ) used to hang near his shoulders. Abu Ishaq said, "I heard him relate it more than once. He always laughed when he related it." Narrated Shu`ba: The hair of the Prophet (ﷺ) used to hang down to the earlobes
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Maine kabhi kisi ko laal chogha mein Nabi (SAW) se zyaada khoobsoorat nahi dekha. Ravi Malik bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ke baal unke kandhon ke qareeb latakte the. Abu Ishaq kehte hain, 'Maine unhein ye ek se zyaada baar bataate suna. Wo hamesha ise bataate waqt hanste the.' Ravi Shu'ba bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ke baal unke kaan ki lau tak latakte the.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Today I saw myself in a dream near the Ka`ba. I saw a whitish brown man, the handsomest of all brown men you might ever see. He had the most beautiful Limma (hair hanging down to the earlobes) you might ever see. He had combed it and it was dripping water; and he was performing the Tawaf around the Ka`ba leaning on two men or on the shoulders of two men. I asked, "Who is this?" It was said. "Messiah, the son of Mary." Suddenly I saw a curly-haired man, blind in the right eye which looked like a protruding out grape. I asked, "Who is this?" It was said, "He is Masiah Ad-Dajjal
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Aaj maine khud ko khwaab mein Kaaba ke qareeb dekha. Maine ek halke bhoore rang ka aadmi dekha, jaisa khoobsoorat bhoora aadmi tumne kabhi dekha ho. Unke baal sabse khoobsoorat Limma (kaan ki lau tak latakte baal) the jaise tumne kabhi dekhe hon. Unhone unhein kanghi ki thi aur usse paani tapak raha tha; aur wo do aadmiyon ke sahaare ya do aadmiyon ke kandhon par tek lagaakar Kaaba ka Tawaf kar rahe the. Maine pucha, "Ye kaun hai?" Kaha gaya, "Maseeh, Maryam ke bete." Achaanak maine ek ghunghraale baalon wala aadmi dekha, jiski daayin aankh andhi thi aur ubhri hui angoor jaisi lag rahi thi. Maine pucha, "Ye kaun hai?" Kaha gaya, "Ye Maseeh Ad-Dajjal hai."'

e: Narrated Anas : The hair of the Prophet (ﷺ) used to hang down up to his shoulders
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ke baal unke kandhon tak latakte the.

e: Narrated Anas: The head-hair of the Prophet (ﷺ) used to hang down to his shoulders
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ke sar ke baal unke kandhon tak latakte the.

e: Narrated Qatada:l asked Anas bin Malik about the hair of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He said, "The hair of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was neither much straight, nor much curly, and it used to hang down till between his shoulders and his earlobes
hi: Qatada bataate hain: Maine Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke baalon ke baare mein pucha. Unhone kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke baal na bahut seedhe the, na bahut ghungraale, aur wo unke kandhon aur kaan ki lau ke beech tak latakte the.'

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) had big hands, and I have never seen anybody like him after him. The hair of the Prophet was wavy, neither curly nor straight
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ke haath bade the, aur maine unke baad kabhi kisi ko unke jaisa nahi dekha. Nabi (SAW) ke baal lahardaar the, na ghungraale na seedhe.

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) had big hands and feet, and I have not seen anybody like him, neither before nor after him, and his palms were soft
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ke haath aur pair bade the, aur maine unse pehle ya baad mein kisi ko unke jaisa nahi dekha, aur unki hatheliyaan naram thi.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) had big feet and a good-looking face and I have not seen anybody like him after him
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ke pair bade the aur unka chehra khoobsoorat tha, aur maine unke baad kabhi kisi ko unke jaisa nahi dekha.

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) had big feet and hands
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ke pair aur haath bade the.

e: Narrated Anas or Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) had big hands and feet and I have not seen anybody like him after him
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ya Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ke haath aur pair bade the, aur maine unke baad kabhi kisi ko unke jaisa nahi dekha.

e: Narrated Mujahid:We were with Ibn `Abbas and the people mentioned Ad-Dajjal. Someone said, "The word 'Kafir' (unbeliever) is written in between his (Ad-Dajjal's) eyes." Ibn `Abbas said, "I have not heard the Prophet saying this, but he said, 'As regards Abraham, he looks like your companion (i.e. the Prophet, Muhammad), and as regards Moses, he is a brown curly haired man riding a camel and reigned with a strong jute rope, as if I am now looking at him getting down in the valley and saying, "Labbaik
hi: Mujahid bataate hain: Hum Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath the aur logon ne Dajjal ka zikr kiya. Kisi ne kaha, 'Uske (Dajjal ke) do aankhon ke beech "Kafir" likha hua hai.' Ibn Abbas ne kaha, 'Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye kehte nahi suna, magar unhone kaha, "Jahaan tak Ibrahim ki baat hai, wo tumhaare saathi (yaani Nabi Muhammad SAW) jaise dikhte hain, aur jahaan tak Musa ki baat hai, wo ek bhoore, ghungraale baalon wale aadmi hain jo oont par sawaar hain aur ek mazboot jute ki rassi se uski lagaam pakde hain, jaise ke main abhi bhi unhein wadi mein utarte aur 'Labbaik' kehte dekh raha hoon."'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:I heard `Umar saying, "Whoever braids his hair should shave it (on finishing Ihram). You'd better not do, something like Talbid." Ibn `Umar used to say: "I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with his hair stuck together with gum
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Umar ko ye kehte suna, 'Jo koi apne baal gunthta hai (braids), use (Ihram khatam karte waqt) mundwaana chaahiye. Behtar hai ke tum Talbid jaisa kuch na karo.' Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) kaha karte the, 'Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko apne baal gond se chipke hue dekha.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), while he was in the state of Ihram and his hair was stuck together with gum, saying, "Labbaik, Allahumma Labbaik, Labbaik La Sharika laka Labbaik. Inn-al-Hamda Wan-Ni'mata Laka wal-Mulk, La Sharika Lak." He did not add anything to those words
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko, jab wo Ihram ki haalat mein the aur unke baal gond se chipke hue the, ye kehte suna, 'Labbaik, Allahumma Labbaik, Labbaik La Sharika laka Labbaik. Inn-al-Hamda Wan-Ni'mata Laka wal-Mulk, La Sharika Lak.' Unhone in alfaaz mein kuch aur izaafa nahi kiya.

e: Narrated Hafsa:(the wife of the Prophet) I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Why have the people finished their Ihram after performing the `Umra while you have not finished your Ihram after your `Umra?" He said, "I have done Talbid (of my hair) and have decorated my Hadis with garlands, so I shall not finish my Ihram till I have slaughtered my Hadi (animal for sacrifice)
hi: Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki zawja) bataati hain: Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Logon ne Umra karne ke baad apna Ihram khatam kar liya hai, jabke aapne apni Umra ke baad apna Ihram khatam nahi kiya?' Unhone kaha, 'Maine apne baalon ka Talbid kiya hai aur apne Hadi (qurbaani ke jaanwar) ko haaron se sajaaya hai, isliye main apna Ihram tab tak khatam nahi karunga jab tak apna Hadi zibah na kar loon.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to copy the people of the Scriptures in matters in which there was no order from Allah. The people of the Scripture used to let their hair hang down while the pagans used to part their hair. So the Prophet (ﷺ) let his hair hang down first, but later on he parted it
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) un maamlon mein Ahl-e-Kitaab (Yahudi-Isaai) ki nakal kiya karte the jinmein Allah ki taraf se koi hukm nahi tha. Ahl-e-Kitaab apne baal latakne dete the jabke mushrikeen apne baal beech se juda karte the. To Nabi (SAW) ne pehle apne baal latakne diye, magar baad mein unhein beech se juda kiya.

e: Narrated `Aisha:As if I am now looking at the shine of the hair parting of the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was in the state of Ihram
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jaise ke main abhi bhi Nabi (SAW) ke juda kiye baalon ki chamak dekh rahi hoon jabke wo Ihram ki haalat mein the.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Once I stayed overnight in the house of my aunt Maimuna bint Al-Harith and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was with her as it was her turn. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got up to offer the night prayer. I stood on his left but he took hold of my two locks of hair and made me stand on his right. Narrated Abu Bishr: (the above Hadith) but he quoted: Ibn `Abbas said, (took hold of) my two braids on my head
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar main apni khaala Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Al-Harith ke ghar raat guzaari aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unke saath the kyunke uska baari thi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) raat ki namaz padhne ke liye uthe. Main unke baayen taraf khada hua, magar unhone mere baalon ki do lat pakdi aur mujhe apne daayen taraf khada kiya. (Ravi Abu Bishr ne yahi hadees bataayi, magar unhone Ibn Abbas ke shabdon ko is tarah kaha:) 'apne sar ki do choti (pakdi).'

e: Narrated Ubaidullah bin Hafs:that `Umar bin Nafi` told him that Nafi`, Maula `Abdullah had heard `Umar saying, "I heard Allah's Apostle forbidding Al-Qaza'." 'Ubaidullah added: I said, "What is Al-Qaza'?" 'Ubaidullah pointed (towards his head) to show us and added, "Nafi` said, 'It is when a boy has his head shaved leaving a tuft of hair here and a tuft of hair there." Ubaidullah pointed towards his forehead and the sides of his head. 'Ubaidullah was asked, "Does this apply to both girls and boys?" He said, "I don't know, but Nafi` said, 'The boy.'" 'Ubaidullah added, "I asked Nafi` again, and he said, 'As for leaving hair on the temples and the back part of the boy's head, there is no harm, but Al-Qaza' is to leave a tuft of hair on his forehead unshaved while there is no hair on the rest of his head, and also to leave hair on either side of his head
hi: Ubaidullah bin Hafs bataate hain ke Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Nafi ne unhein bataya ke Nafi, Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke Maula, ne Umar ko ye kehte suna, 'Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Al-Qaza' se mana karte suna.' Ubaidullah ne aage kaha: Maine pucha, 'Al-Qaza' kya hai?' Ubaidullah ne (apne sar ki taraf) ishara karke humein dikhaaya aur kaha, 'Nafi ne kaha, "Ye tab hota hai jab kisi ladke ka sar mundwa diya jaaye aur yahaan-wahaan baalon ke gutthe chhod diye jaayein."' Ubaidullah ne apni peshaani aur sar ke kinaaron ki taraf ishara kiya. Ubaidullah se pucha gaya, 'Kya ye ladkiyon aur ladkon dono par laagu hota hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Mujhe nahi pata, magar Nafi ne "ladka" kaha.' Ubaidullah ne aage kaha, 'Maine Nafi se dobara pucha, aur unhone kaha, "Jahaan tak kanpat aur sar ke peechhe ke hisse par baal chhodne ki baat hai, ismein koi harj nahi, magar Al-Qaza' ye hai ke ladke ki peshaani par baalon ka ek gutha chhod diya jaaye jabke baaki sar par koi baal na ho, aur sar ke dono taraf bhi baal chhod diye jaayein."'

e: Narrated (Abdullah) bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade Al-Qaza' (leaving a tuft of hair here and there after shaving one's head)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Al-Qaza' (sar mundwaane ke baad yahaan-wahaan baalon ke gutthe chhodne) se mana kiya.

e: Narrated `Aisha:I applied perfume to the Prophet (ﷺ) with my own hands when he wanted to assume the state of Ihram, and I also perfumed him at Mina before he departed from there (to perform Tawaf-al-Ifada)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine apne haathon se Nabi (SAW) ko khushbu lagaayi jab wo Ihram baandhna chahte the, aur maine unhein Mina mein bhi khushbu lagaayi Tawaf-al-Ifaza ke liye wahaan se rawaana hone se pehle.

e: Narrated `Aisha:I used to perfume Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with the best scent available till I saw the shine of the scent on his head and shine beard
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko sabse achhi khushbu lagaaya karti thi yahaan tak ke main unke sar aur daadi par khushbu ki chamak dekh leti.

e: Narrated Sa`d:A man peeped into the house of the Prophet (ﷺ) through a hole while the Prophet (ﷺ) was scratching his head with a Midrai (a certain kind of comb). On that the Prophet (ﷺ) said (to him), "If I had known you had been looking, then I would have pierced your eye with that instrument, because the asking of permission has been ordained so that one would not see things unlawfully
hi: Sa'd bataate hain: Ek shaks ne ek soorakh se Nabi (SAW) ke ghar mein jhaanka jabke Nabi (SAW) apna sar Midrai (ek qism ki kanghi) se khujla rahe the. Isper Nabi (SAW) ne (usse) kaha, 'Agar mujhe pata hota ke tum dekh rahe ho, to main tumhaari aankh usi hathiyaar se ched deta, kyunke ijaazat maangne ka hukm isliye diya gaya hai taake koi cheezein bagair ijaazat na dekhe.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:I used to comb the hair of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) during my periods. This hadith also reaches us through another chain
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Main apne haiz ke dauraan Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke baal kanghi kiya karti thi. Ye hadees ek aur silsile se bhi humein pahunchi hai.

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to like to start from the right side as far as possible in combing and in performing ablution
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ko kanghi karte waqt aur wuzu karte waqt jitna mumkin ho daayin taraf se shuru karna pasand tha.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "(Allah said), 'Every good deed of Adam's son is for him except fasting; it is for Me. and I shall reward (the fasting person) for it.' Verily, the smell of the mouth of a fasting person is better to Allah than the smell of musk
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, '(Allah farmaata hai,) "Aadam ke bete ka har nek amal uske apne liye hai, siwaaye roze ke; wo mere liye hai, aur main (roze-daar ko) iska ajr dunga." Beshak, roze-daar ke munh ki khushbu Allah ke nazdeek kasturi ki khushbu se behtar hai.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:used to perfume the Prophet (ﷺ) before his assuming the state of with the best scent available
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Main Nabi (SAW) ko Ihram baandhne se pehle sabse achhi khushbu lagaaya karti thi.

e: Narrated Thumama bin `Abdullah;:Anas never used to refuse (a gift of) scent and used to say that the Prophet (ﷺ) never used to refuse (a gift of) scent
hi: Thumama bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) kabhi khushbu ka tohfa thukraate nahi the, aur kehte the ke Nabi (SAW) bhi kabhi khushbu ka tohfa nahi thukraate the.

e: Narrated `Aisha:During Hajjat-al-Wada`, I perfumed Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with Dharira with my own hands, both on his assuming Ihram and on finishing it
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Hajjat-ul-Wada ke dauraan, maine apne haathon se Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Dharira (ek khushbu) lagaayi, unke Ihram baandhne aur khatam karne dono waqt.

e: Narrated `Abdullah:Allah has cursed those women who practise tattooing and those who get themselves tattooed, and those who remove their face hairs, and those who create a space between their teeth artificially to look beautiful, and such women as change the features created by Allah. Why then should I not curse those whom the Prophet (ﷺ) has cursed? And that is in Allah's Book. i.e. His Saying: 'And what the Apostle gives you take it and what he forbids you abstain (from it)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ne un auraton par laanat ki hai jo gudna banaati hain aur jo gudna banwaati hain, aur jo apni bhaunon ke baal nikaalti hain, aur jo khoobsoorat dikhne ke liye apne daanton ke beech nakli faasla banaati hain, aur jo Allah ki banaayi hui banaawat mein tabdeeli karti hain. To phir main kyun na un logon par laanat karoon jinpar Nabi (SAW) ne laanat ki hai? Aur ye Allah ki Kitaab mein hai, yaani uska farmaan: 'Aur jo Rasool tumhein de use lo, aur jisse mana kare usse ruk jao.'

e: Narrated Humaid bin `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf:that in the year he performed Hajj. he heard Mu'awiya bin Abi Sufyan, who was on the pulpit and was taking a tuft of hair from one of his guards, saying, "Where are your religious learned men? I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbidding this (false hair) and saying, 'The children of Israel were destroyed when their women started using this
hi: Humaid bin Abdur Rahman bin Auf (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jis saal unhone Hajj kiya, unhone Mu'awiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Sufyan ko, jo mimbar par apne ek pahre daar se baalon ka ek gutha lete hue, ye kehte suna, 'Tumhaare deeni aalim kahaan hain? Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ise (nakli baalon ko) mana karte suna aur kehte, "Bani Israel tab tabaah hue jab unki auraton ne ye istemaal karna shuru kiya."'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah has cursed the lady who artificially lengthens (her or someone else's) hair and the one who gets her hair lengthened and the One who tattoos (herself or someone else) and the one who gets herself tattooed
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah us khaatoon par laanat kare jo (apne ya kisi aur ke) baal nakli tareeke se lambe karti hai aur jo apne baal lambwaati hai, aur jo gudna banaati hai aur jo gudna banwaati hai.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:An Ansari girl was married and she became sick and all her hair fell out intending to provide her with false hair. They asked the Prophet (ﷺ) who said, "Allah has cursed the lady who artificially lengthens (her or someone else's) hair and also the one who gets her hair lengthened
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ek Ansaari ladki ki shaadi hui aur wo bimar pad gayi aur uske sab baal jhad gaye, isliye unhone use nakli baal dene ka iraada kiya. Unhone Nabi (SAW) se pucha, unhone kaha, 'Allah us khaatoon par laanat kare jo (apne ya kisi aur ke) baal nakli tareeke se lambe karti hai, aur jo apne baal lambwaati hai.'

e: Narrated Asma:(the daughter of Abu' Bakr) A woman came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "I married my daughter to someone, but she became sick and all her hair fell out, and (because of that) her husband does not like her. May I let her use false hair?" On that the Prophet (ﷺ) cursed such a lady as artificially lengthening (her or someone else's) hair or got her hair lengthened artificially
hi: Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Abu Bakr ki beti) bataati hain: Ek khaatoon Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha, 'Maine apni beti ki shaadi kisi se ki, magar wo bimar pad gayi aur uske sab baal jhad gaye, aur (isi wajah se) uske shohar ko wo pasand nahi aati. Kya main use nakli baal lagaane doon?' Isper Nabi (SAW) ne aisi khaatoon par laanat ki jo (apne ya kisi aur ke) baal nakli tareeke se lambe kare ya baal lambwaaye.

e: Narrated Asma':(the daughter of Abu Bakr) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has cursed such a lady as artificially lengthening (her or someone else's) hair or gets her hair lengthened
hi: Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Abu Bakr ki beti) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne aisi khaatoon par laanat ki hai jo (apne ya kisi aur ke) baal nakli tareeke se lambe kare ya baal lambwaaye.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah has cursed such a lady as lengthens (her or someone else's) hair artificially or gets it lengthened, and also a lady who tattoos (herself or someone else) or gets herself tattooed
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah us khaatoon par laanat kare jo (apne ya kisi aur ke) baal nakli tareeke se lambe kare ya baal lambwaaye, aur jo gudna banaaye ya gudna banwaaye.'

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Al-Musaiyab:Mu'awiya came to Medina for the last time and delivered a sermon. He took out a tuft of hair and said, "I thought that none used to do this (i.e. use false hair) except Jews. The Prophet (ﷺ) labelled such practice, (i.e. the use of false hair), as cheating
hi: Saeed bin Al-Musaiyab bataate hain: Mu'awiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) aakhri baar Madina aaye aur khutba diya. Unhone baalon ka ek gutha nikaala aur kaha, 'Mujhe laga tha ke ye (nakli baal istemaal karna) sirf Yahudi karte hain. Nabi (SAW) ne is amal (nakli baalon ke istemaal) ko dhoka kaha hai.'

e: Narrated 'Alqama:`Abdullah cursed those women who practiced tattooing and those who removed hair from their faces and those who created spaces between their teeth artificially to look beautiful, such ladies as changed what Allah has created. Um Ya'qub said, "What is that?" `Abdullah said, "Why should I not curse those who were cursed by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and are referred to in Allah's Book?" She said to him "By Allah, I have read the whole Qur'an but I have not found such a thing. `Abdullah said, "By Allah, if you had read it (carefully) you would have found it. (Allah says:) 'And what the Apostle gives you take it and what he forbids you abstain (from it)
hi: Alqama bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne un auraton par laanat ki jo gudna banaati hain, jo apni bhaunon ke baal nikaalti hain, aur jo khoobsoorat dikhne ke liye apne daanton ke beech nakli faasla banaati hain, aisi khawaateen jo Allah ki banaayi hui shaqal badalti hain. Umm Yaqub ne pucha, 'Ye kya hai?' Abdullah ne kaha, 'Main un logon par laanat kyun na karoon jinpar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne laanat ki hai aur jinka zikr Allah ki Kitaab mein hai?' Usne unse kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, maine poora Quran padha hai magar mujhe aisi koi baat nahi mili.' Abdullah ne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, agar tumne ise (dhyaan se) padha hota, to tumhein ye mil jaata. (Allah farmaata hai:) "Aur jo Rasool tumhein de use lo, aur jisse mana kare usse ruk jao."'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) has cursed the lady who lengthens her hair artificially and the one who gets her hair lengthened, and also the lady who tattoos (herself or others) and the one who gets herself tattooed
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne us khaatoon par laanat ki hai jo apne baal nakli tareeke se lambe kare aur us par jo baal lambwaaye, aur us khaatoon par bhi jo gudna banaaye (khud ka ya kisi aur ka) aur us par jo gudna banwaaye.

e: Narrated Asma':A woman asked the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! My daughter got measles and her hair fell out. Now that I got her married, may I let her use false hair?" He said (to her), "Allah has cursed the lady who lengthens hair artificially and the one who gets her hair lengthened artificially
hi: Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ek khaatoon ne Nabi (SAW) se pucha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Meri beti ko khasra (measles) ho gaya aur uske baal jhad gaye. Ab jab maine uski shaadi kar di hai, kya main use nakli baal lagaane doon?' Unhone (usse) kaha, 'Allah us khaatoon par laanat kare jo baal nakli tareeke se lambe kare aur us par jo apne baal nakli tareeke se lambwaaye.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, (or the Prophet (ﷺ) said), "Allah has cursed the lady who practices tattooing and that who gets it done for herself, and also the lady who lengthens hair artificially and that who gets her hair lengthened artificially." The Prophet (ﷺ) has cursed such ladies
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna (ya Nabi SAW ne farmaya), 'Allah us khaatoon par laanat kare jo gudna banaati hai aur us par jo apne liye gudna banwaati hai, aur us khaatoon par bhi jo baal nakli tareeke se lambe kare aur us par jo apne baal nakli tareeke se lambwaaye.' Nabi (SAW) ne aisi khawaateen par laanat ki hai.

e: Narrated Ibn Mas`ud:Allah has cursed those women who practise tattooing or get it done for themselves, and those who remove hair from their faces, and those who create spaces between their teeth artificially to look beautiful, such ladies as change the features created by Allah. Why then shall I not curse those whom Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has cursed and who are cursed in Allah's Book too?
hi: Ibn Masud bataate hain: Allah ne un auraton par laanat ki hai jo gudna banaati hain ya apne liye banwaati hain, aur jo apni bhaunon ke baal nikaalti hain, aur jo khoobsoorat dikhne ke liye apne daanton ke beech nakli faasla banaati hain, aisi khawaateen jo Allah ki banaayi hui banaawat badalti hain. To phir main un logon par laanat kyun na karoon jinpar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne laanat ki hai aur jinpar Allah ki Kitaab mein bhi laanat ki gayi hai?

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The evil eye is a fact," and he forbade tattooing
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Bad-nazar haqeeqat hai,' aur unhone gudna banaane se mana kiya.

e: Narrated `Abdullah:(As above)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: (Upar wali hadees jaisi hi).

e: Narrated Abu Juhaifa:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the use of the price of blood and the price of a dog, the one who takes (eats) usury the one who gives usury, the woman who practises tattooing and the woman who gets herself tattooed
hi: Abu Juhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne khoon ki qeemat, kutte ki qeemat, sood khaane wale, sood dene wale, gudna banaane wali khaatoon aur gudna banwaane wali khaatoon se mana kiya.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:A woman who used to practise tattooing was brought to `Umar. `Umar got up and said, "I beseech you by Allah, which of you heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying something about tattooing?" I got up and said, "O chief of the Believers! I heard something." He said, "What did you hear?" I said, "I heard the Prophet (addressing the ladies), saying, 'Do not practise tattooing and do not get yourselves tattooed
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Gudna banaane wali ek khaatoon ko Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas laaya gaya. Umar khade hue aur kaha, 'Main tumhein Allah ki qasam deta hoon, tum mein se kisne Nabi (SAW) ko gudna ke baare mein kuch kehte suna hai?' Main khada hua aur kaha, 'Aye Momineen ke Ameer! Maine kuch suna hai.' Unhone pucha, 'Tumne kya suna?' Maine kaha, 'Maine Nabi (SAW) ko (auraton se khitaab karte hue) ye kehte suna, "Gudna mat banaao aur apne aap ko gudna mat banwaao."'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) has cursed the lady who lengthens hair artificially and that who gets her hair lengthened in such away, and the lady who practises tattooing and that who gets it done for herself
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne us khaatoon par laanat ki jo baal nakli tareeke se lambe kare aur us par jo aise apne baal lambwaaye, aur us khaatoon par jo gudna banaati hai aur us par jo apne liye gudna banwaati hai.

e: Narrated `Abdullah:Allah has cursed those women who practise tattooing and those who get it done for themselves, and those who remove hair from their faces, and those who artificially create spaces between their teeth to look beautiful, such women as alter the features created by Allah. Why should I not then curse those whom Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has cursed and that is in Allah's Book?
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ne un auraton par laanat ki hai jo gudna banaati hain aur jo apne liye banwaati hain, aur jo apni bhaunon ke baal nikaalti hain, aur jo khoobsoorat dikhne ke liye apne daanton ke beech nakli faasla banaati hain, aisi khawaateen jo Allah ki banaayi hui banaawat badalti hain. To phir main un logon par laanat kyun na karoon jinpar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne laanat ki hai aur jo Allah ki Kitaab mein bhi hai?

e: Narrated Abu Talha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Angels do not enter a house in which there is a dog or there are pictures
hi: Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Farishte us ghar mein daakhil nahi hote jahaan kutta ho ya tasveerein hon.'

e: Narrated Muslim:We were with Masruq at the house of Yasar bin Numair. Masruq saw pictures on his terrace and said, "I heard `Abdullah saying that he heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "The people who will receive the severest punishment from Allah will be the picture makers
hi: Muslim bataate hain: Hum Masruq ke saath Yasar bin Numair ke ghar the. Masruq ne unke chhat par tasveerein dekhi aur kaha, 'Maine Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko ye kehte suna ke unhone Nabi (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, "Sabse sakht saza Allah ki taraf se tasveerein banaane walon ko milegi."'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Those who make these pictures will be punished on the Day of Resurrection, and it will be said to them. 'Make alive what you have created
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo log ye tasveerein banaate hain, unhein Qayamat ke din saza di jaayegi, aur unse kaha jaayega, "Jo tumne banaaya use zinda karo."'

e: Narrated `Aisha:I never used to leave in the Prophet (ﷺ) house anything carrying images or crosses but he obliterated it
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Main kabhi Nabi (SAW) ke ghar mein tasveeron ya salibon (crosses) waali koi cheez nahi chhodti thi jise unhone mita na diya ho.

e: Narrated Abu Zur'a:l entered a house in Medina with Abu Huraira, and he saw a man making pictures at the top of the house. Abu Huraira said, "I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying that Allah said, 'Who would be more unjust than the one who tries to create the like of My creatures? Let them create a grain: let them create a gnat.' "Abu Huraira then asked for a water container and washed his arms up to his armpits. I said, "0 Abu i Huraira! Is this something you have heard I from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" He said, "The limit for ablution is up to the place where the ornaments will reach on the Day of Resurrection
hi: Abu Zur'a bataate hain: Main Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath Madina ke ek ghar mein daakhil hua, aur unhone ek shaks ko ghar ki chhat par tasveerein banaate dekha. Abu Huraira ne kaha, 'Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna ke Allah ne farmaaya, "Us shaks se zyaada zaalim kaun hoga jo meri makhlooq jaisi cheez banaane ki koshish kare? Unhein ek anaaj ka daana banaane do; unhein ek machhar banaane do."' Phir Abu Huraira ne paani ka bartan maanga aur apni baahein kandhon tak dhoyi. Maine kaha, 'Aye Abu Huraira! Kya ye aapne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Wuzu ki hadd wahaan tak hai jahaan tak Qayamat ke din zewar pahunchenge.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) returned from a journey when I had placed a curtain of mine having pictures over (the door of) a chamber of mine. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw it, he tore it and said, "The people who will receive the severest punishment on the Day of Resurrection will be those who try to make the like of Allah's creations." So we turned it (i.e., the curtain) into one or two cushions
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek safar se wapas aaye jab maine apni ek chaadar, jispar tasveerein thin, apne kamre (ke darwaaze) par laga rakhi thi. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ise dekha, unhone ise phaad diya aur kaha, 'Qayamat ke din sabse sakht saza un logon ko milegi jo Allah ki takhleeqaat jaisi cheez banaane ki koshish karte hain.' To humne use ek ya do takiyon mein badal diya.

e: Narrated Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) returned from a journey when I had hung a thick curtain having pictures (in front of a door). He ordered me to remove it and I removed it
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ek safar se wapas aaye jab maine ek moti chaadar, jispar tasveerein thi, (darwaaze ke saamne) laga rakhi thi. Unhone mujhe use hataane ka hukm diya aur maine use hata diya.

e: Aisha added:The Prophet (ﷺ) and I used to take a bath from one container (of water)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne aage kaha: Nabi (SAW) aur main ek hi bartan (paani) se gusl kiya karte the.

e: Narrated `Aisha:I purchased a cushion with pictures on it. The Prophet (came and) stood at the door but did not enter. I said (to him), "I repent to Allah for what (the guilt) I have done." He said, "What is this cushion?" I said, "It is for you to sit on and recline on." He said, "The makers of these pictures will be punished on the Day of Resurrection and it will be said to them, 'Make alive what you have created.' Moreover, the angels do not enter a house where there are pictures
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine tasveeron waala ek takiya khareeda. Nabi (SAW) (aaye aur) darwaaze par khade ho gaye magar andar nahi aaye. Maine (unse) kaha, 'Main Allah se tauba karti hoon jo bhi (gunaah) maine kiya ho.' Unhone kaha, 'Ye takiya kya hai?' Maine kaha, 'Ye aapke baithne aur tek lagaane ke liye hai.' Unhone kaha, 'In tasveeron ke banaane walon ko Qayamat ke din saza di jaayegi aur unse kaha jaayega, "Jo tumne banaaya use zinda karo." Aur farishte us ghar mein daakhil nahi hote jahaan tasveerein hon.'

e: Narrated Abu Talha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Angels (of mercy) do not enter a house where there are pictures.'" The subnarrator Busr added: "Then Zaid fell ill and we paid him a visit. Behold! There was, hanging at his door, a curtain decorated with a picture. I said to 'Ubaidullah Al-Khaulani, the step son of Maimuna, the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ) , "Didn't Zaid tell us about the picture the day before yesterday?" 'Ubaidullah said, "Didn't you hear him saying: 'except a design in a garment'?
hi: Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Farishte (rehmat ke) us ghar mein daakhil nahi hote jahaan tasveerein hon.' Ravi Busr ne aage kaha: 'Phir Zaid bimar pad gaye aur hum unse milne gaye. Dekha to unke darwaaze par ek tasveer waali chaadar latki hui thi. Maine Ubaidullah Al-Khaulani se, jo Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki zawja) ke sautele bete the, kaha, "Kya Zaid ne parson humein tasveer ke baare mein nahi bataaya tha?" Ubaidullah ne kaha, "Kya tumne unhein ye kehte nahi suna: siwaaye kapde par bane naqsh ke?"'

e: Narrated Anas:Aisha had a thick curtain (having pictures on it) and she screened the side of her i house with it. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to her, "Remove it from my sight, for its pictures are still coming to my mind in my prayers
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas ek moti chaadar thi (jispar tasveerein thi) aur unhone apne ghar ke ek hisse ko usse parda kiya hua tha. Nabi (SAW) ne unse kaha, 'Ise mere saamne se hataao, kyunke iski tasveerein abhi bhi meri namaz mein mere zehen mein aati hain.'

e: Narrated Salim's father:Once Gabriel promised to visit the Prophet (ﷺ) but he delayed and the Prophet (ﷺ) got worried about that. At last he came out and found Gabriel and complained to him of his grief (for his delay). Gabriel said to him, "We do not enter a place in which there is a picture or a dog
hi: Salim ke waalid (Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ)) bataate hain: Ek baar Jibrael ne Nabi (SAW) se milne aane ka waada kiya magar der kar di, aur Nabi (SAW) is baat se pareshaan ho gaye. Aakhir wo baahar aaye aur Jibrael ko paaya, aur unse apni pareshaani (unki der ki wajah se) bataayi. Jibrael ne unse kaha, 'Hum aisi jagah daakhil nahi hote jahaan koi tasveer ya kutta ho.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) I bought a cushion having pictures on it. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw it, he stopped at the gate and did not enter. I noticed the signs of hatred (for that) on his face! I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I turn to Allah and His Apostle in repentance! What sin have I committed?" He said, "What about this cushion?" I said, 'I bought it for you to sit on and recline on." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The makers of these pictures will be punished (severely) on the Day of Resurrection and it will be said to them, 'Make alive what you have created.'" He added, "Angels do not enter a house in which there are pictures
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki zawja) bataati hain: Maine tasveeron waala ek takiya khareeda. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne use dekha, wo darwaaze par ruk gaye aur andar nahi aaye. Maine unke chehre par napasandidagi ke aasaar dekhe! Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Main Allah aur uske Rasool ki taraf tauba karti hoon! Maine kaunsa gunaah kiya hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Ye takiya kya hai?' Maine kaha, 'Maine ise aapke baithne aur tek lagaane ke liye khareeda.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'In tasveeron ke banaane walon ko Qayamat ke din (sakht) saza di jaayegi aur unse kaha jaayega, "Jo tumne banaaya use zinda karo."' Unhone aage kaha, 'Farishte us ghar mein daakhil nahi hote jahaan tasveerein hon.'

e: Narrated Abu Juhaifa:that he had bought a slave whose profession was cupping. The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade taking the price of blood and the price of a dog and the earnings of a prostitute, and cursed the one who took or gave (Riba') usury, and the lady who tattooed others or got herself tattooed, and the picture-maker
hi: Abu Juhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Unhone ek ghulaam khareeda jiska paisha Hijama (pachchhi) tha. Nabi (SAW) ne khoon ki qeemat, kutte ki qeemat, aur badkaari ki kamaai lene se mana kiya, aur sood lene ya dene wale par, gudna banaane ya banwaane wali khaatoon par, aur tasveer banaane wale par laanat ki.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I heard Muhammad saying, "Whoever makes a picture in this world will be asked to put life into it on the Day of Resurrection, but he will not be able to do so
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Muhammad (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, 'Jo koi is duniya mein tasveer banaata hai, use Qayamat ke din usmein jaan daalne ko kaha jaayega, magar wo aisa nahi kar payega.'

e: Narrated Usama bin Zaid:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) rode a donkey saddled with a saddle covered with a Fadakiyya velvet sheet, and he made me ride behind him
hi: Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek gadhe par sawaar hue jispar Fadakiyya makhmal ki chaadar se dhaanki hui zeen thi, aur unhone mujhe apne peechhe bithaaya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When the Prophet (ﷺ) arrived at Mecca, the children of Bani `Abdul Muttalib received him. He then mounted one of them in front of him and the other behind him
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Nabi (SAW) Makkah pahunche, Banu Abdul Muttalib ke bachon ne unka istikbaal kiya. Phir unhone unmein se ek ko apne aage aur doosre ko apne peechhe bithaaya.

e: Narrated Aiyub:The worst of three (persons riding one, animal) was mentioned in `Ikrima's presence `Ikrima said, "Ibn `Abbas said, '(In the year of the conquest of Mecca) the Prophet (ﷺ) came and mounted Qutham in front of him and Al-Fadl behind him, or Qutham behind him and Al-Fadl in front of him.' Now which of them was the worst off and which was the best?
hi: Aiyub bataate hain: Ikrima ki maujoodgi mein ek jaanwar par teen logon ke sawaar hone mein sabse bure ka zikr hua. Ikrima ne kaha, 'Ibn Abbas ne kaha, "(Fatah-e-Makkah ke saal) Nabi (SAW) aaye aur Qutham ko apne aage bithaaya aur Al-Fadl ko apne peechhe, ya Qutham ko peechhe aur Al-Fadl ko aage." To ab unmein se sabse bura kaun tha aur sabse behtar kaun?'

e: Narrated Mu`adh bin Jabal:While I was riding behind the Prophet (ﷺ) and between me and him and between me and him there was only the back of the saddle, he said, "0 Mu`adh!" I replied, "Labbaik, 0 Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and Sa`daik!" he said, "Do you know what is Allah's right upon his slave?"
