I said, "Allah and His Apostle know best" He said "Allah's right upon his slaves is that they should worship Him alone and not worship anything else besides Him." Then he proceeded for a while and then said, "O Mu`adh bin Jabal!" I replied, "Labbaik, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ):, Sa`daik!' He said, "Do you know what is the right of the slaves upon Allah if they do that?" I replied, "Allah and His Apostle know best." He said, "The right of the slaves upon Allah is that He will not punish them (if they do that)
hi: Mu'adh bin Jabal (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab main Nabi (SAW) ke peechhe sawaar tha aur mere aur unke beech sirf zeen ki peeth thi, unhone kaha, 'Aye Mu'adh!' Maine jawab diya, 'Labbaik, Aye Allah ke Rasool, aur Sa'daik!' Unhone kaha, 'Kya tumhein pata hai Allah ka apne bande par kya haq hai?' Maine kaha, 'Allah aur uska Rasool behtar jaante hain.' Unhone kaha, 'Allah ka apne bandon par haq ye hai ke wo sirf uski ibaadat karein aur uske siwa kisi aur ki ibaadat na karein.' Phir wo thodi der chalte rahe aur kaha, 'Aye Mu'adh bin Jabal!' Maine jawab diya, 'Labbaik, Aye Allah ke Rasool, Sa'daik!' Unhone kaha, 'Kya tumhein pata hai agar bande aisa karein to Allah par unka kya haq hai?' Maine jawab diya, 'Allah aur uska Rasool behtar jaante hain.' Unhone kaha, 'Bandon ka Allah par haq ye hai ke wo unhein saza nahi dega (agar wo aisa karein).'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:We were coming from Khaibar along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while I was riding behind Abu Talha and he was proceeding. While one of the wives of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was riding behind Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), suddenly the foot of the camel Slipped and I said, "The woman!" and alighted (hurriedly). Allah's Apostle said, "She is your mother." Sol resaddled the she-camel and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) mounted it. When he approached or saw Medina, he said, "Ayibun, ta'ibun, 'abidun, li-Rabbina hami-dun
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Khaibar se Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath aa rahe the jabke main Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke peechhe sawaar tha aur wo aage badh rahe the. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki ek biwi unke peechhe sawaar thi, achaanak oont ka pair phisla aur maine kaha, 'Khaatoon (gir gayi)!' aur (jaldi se) utar gaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Wo tumhaari maa hain.' To maine oontni ki zeen dobara kasi aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) uspar sawaar hue. Jab wo Madina ke qareeb pahunche ya Madina ko dekha, unhone kaha, 'Aayibun, Taaibun, Aabidun, Li-Rabbina Haamidun' (Hum laut rahe hain, tauba karte hue, ibaadat karte hue, apne Rab ki hamd karte hue).

e: Narrated `Abbad bin Tamim's uncle:I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) lying-down in the mosque and placing one leg on the other
hi: Abbad bin Tamim ke chacha bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko Masjid mein letā hua dekha, ek pair doosre par rakhe hue.

e: Narrated Al-Walid bin 'Aizar:I heard Abi `Amr 'Ash-Shaibani saying, "The owner of this house." he pointed to `Abdullah's house, "said, 'I asked the Prophet (ﷺ) 'Which deed is loved most by Allah?" He replied, 'To offer prayers at their early (very first) stated times.' " `Abdullah asked, "What is the next (in goodness)?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "To be good and dutiful to one's parents," `Abdullah asked, "What is the next (in goodness)?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "To participate in Jihad for Allah's Cause." `Abdullah added, "The Prophet (ﷺ) narrated to me these three things, and if I had asked more, he would have told me more
hi: Al-Walid bin Aizar bataate hain: Maine Abi Amr Ash-Shaibani ko ye kehte suna, 'Is ghar ke maalik' - unhone Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke ghar ki taraf ishara kiya - 'ne kaha, "Maine Nabi (SAW) se pucha, 'Kaunsa amal Allah ko sabse zyaada aziz hai?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Namaz ko unke sabse pehle muqarrar waqt par padhna.'"' Abdullah ne pucha, 'Uske baad kaunsa (achha amal)?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Apne maa-baap ke saath achha aur farmaanbardaar hona.' Abdullah ne pucha, 'Uske baad kaunsa?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Allah ki raah mein Jihad mein hissa lena.' Abdullah ne aage kaha, 'Nabi (SAW) ne mujhe ye teen cheezein bataayin, aur agar maine aur poocha hota, to wo mujhe aur bataate.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:A man came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Who is more entitled to be treated with the best companionship by me?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Your mother." The man said. "Who is next?" The Prophet said, "Your mother." The man further said, "Who is next?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Your mother." The man asked for the fourth time, "Who is next?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Your father
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kaun mera sabse achha saathi hone ka sabse zyaada haqdaar hai?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Tumhaari maa.' Us shaks ne kaha, 'Uske baad kaun?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Tumhaari maa.' Us shaks ne phir kaha, 'Uske baad kaun?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Tumhaari maa.' Us shaks ne chauthi baar pucha, 'Uske baad kaun?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Tumhaara baap.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:A man said to the Prophet, "Shall I participate in Jihad?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Are your parents living?" The man said, "Yes." the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do Jihad for their benefit
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks ne Nabi (SAW) se kaha, 'Kya main Jihad mein hissa loon?' Nabi (SAW) ne pucha, 'Kya tumhaare maa-baap zinda hain?' Us shaks ne kaha, 'Haan.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'To unki khidmat mein Jihad karo.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said. "It is one of the greatest sins that a man should curse his parents." It was asked (by the people), "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! How does a man curse his parents?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "'The man abuses the father of another man and the latter abuses the father of the former and abuses his mother
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ye sabse bade gunaahon mein se ek hai ke koi shaks apne maa-baap par laanat kare.' Logon ne pucha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Koi shaks apne maa-baap par kaise laanat karega?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Shaks doosre shaks ke baap ko bura-bhala kehta hai, aur wo doosra pehle ke baap ko bura-bhala kehta hai aur uski maa ko bhi.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "While three persons were traveling, they were overtaken by rain and they took shelter in a cave in a mountain. A big rock fell from the mountain over the mouth of the cave and blocked it. They said to each other. 'Think of such good (righteous) deeds which, you did for Allah's sake only, and invoke Allah by giving reference to those deeds so that Allah may relieve you from your difficulty. one of them said, 'O Allah! I had my parents who were very old and I had small children for whose sake I used to work as a shepherd. When I returned to them at night and milked (the sheep), I used to start giving the milk to my parents first before giving to my children. And one day I went far away in search of a grazing place (for my sheep), and didn't return home till late at night and found that my parents had slept. I milked (my livestock) as usual and brought the milk vessel and stood at their heads, and I disliked to wake them up from their sleep, and I also disliked to give the milk to my children before my parents though my children were crying (from hunger) at my feet. So this state of mine and theirs continued till the day dawned. (O Allah!) If you considered that I had done that only for seeking Your pleasure, then please let there be an opening through which we can see the sky.' So Allah made for them an opening through which they could see the sky. Then the second person said, 'O Allah! I had a she-cousin whom I loved as much as a passionate man love a woman. I tried to seduce her but she refused till I paid her one-hundred Dinars So I worked hard till I collected one hundred Dinars and went to her with that But when I sat in between her legs (to have sexual intercourse with her), she said, 'O Allah's slave! Be afraid of Allah ! Do not deflower me except legally (by marriage contract). So I left her O Allah! If you considered that I had done that only for seeking Your pleasure then please let the rock move a little to have a (wider) opening.' So Allah shifted that rock to make the opening wider for them. And the last (third) person said 'O Allah ! I employed a laborer for wages equal to a Faraq (a certain measure: of rice, and when he had finished his job he demanded his wages, but when I presented his due to him, he gave it up and refused to take it. Then I kept on sowing that rice for him (several times) till managed to buy with the price of the yield, some cows and their shepherd Later on the laborer came to me an said. '(O Allah's slave!) Be afraid o Allah, and do not be unjust to me an give me my due.' I said (to him). 'Go and take those cows and their shepherd. So he took them and went away. (So, O Allah!) If You considered that I had done that for seeking Your pleasure, then please remove the remaining part of the rock.' And so Allah released them (from their difficulty)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Teen aadmi safar kar rahe the, tabhi baarish shuru ho gayi aur unhone ek pahaad ki gufaa mein panaah li. Ek bada patthar pahaad se lud kar gufaa ke munh par gir gaya aur use band kar diya. Unhone aapas mein kaha, "Apne aise nek amaalon ko yaad karo jo tumne sirf Allah ki khaatir kiye hon, aur Allah se un amaalon ka wasta dekar dua karo taake Allah tumhein is museebat se nijaat de." Unmein se ek ne kaha, 'Aye Allah! Mere maa-baap bahut budhe the aur mere chhote bachche the jinke liye main charwaahe ka kaam karta tha. Jab main raat ko unke paas lautta aur doodh dooha, to main pehle apne maa-baap ko doodh pilaata, uske baad apne bachon ko. Ek din main charne ki jagah dhoondhne door nikal gaya aur raat der se ghar wapas aaya, aur dekha ke mere maa-baap so chuke hain. Maine hamesha ki tarah doodh dooha aur doodh ka bartan liye unke sar ke paas khada raha, aur mujhe unhein neend se jagaana napasand tha, aur mujhe apne maa-baap se pehle apne bachon ko doodh dena bhi napasand tha, halaanke mere bachche mere pairon ke paas bhookh se ro rahe the. Ye haalat meri aur unki subah hone tak jaari rahi. (Aye Allah!) Agar tujhe pata hai ke maine ye sirf teri khushnoodi ke liye kiya, to hamare liye ek raasta khol de jahaan se hum aasman dekh sakein.' To Allah ne unke liye ek khulaapan banaaya jahaan se wo aasman dekh sakte the. Phir doosre shaks ne kaha, 'Aye Allah! Meri ek chachazaad behen thi jise main utni hi shiddat se muhabbat karta tha jitna koi jazbaati aadmi kisi aurat se karta hai. Maine use behkaane ki koshish ki magar usne inkaar kiya jab tak maine use sau Dinar nahi diye. To maine mehnat karke sau Dinar jama kiye aur unhein lekar uske paas gaya. Magar jab main uske do pairon ke beech baitha (humbistari ke liye), usne kaha, "Aye Allah ke bande! Allah se daro! Mujhe jaayez tareeke (nikaah) ke bagair mat chhuo." To main use chhod kar chala gaya. Aye Allah! Agar tujhe pata hai ke maine ye sirf teri khushnoodi ke liye kiya, to us patthar ko thoda hataa de taake khulaapan (aur) ho jaaye.' To Allah ne wo patthar hataakar unke liye jagah bada kar di. Aur teesre (aakhri) shaks ne kaha, 'Aye Allah! Maine ek mazdoor ko ek Faraq (chaawal ki ek naap) ke barabar mazdoori par rakha, aur jab usne apna kaam khatam kiya, usne apni mazdoori maangi, magar jab maine usse uska haq diya, usne use chhod diya aur lene se inkaar kar diya. Phir main us chaawal ko uske liye bota rehta (kayi baar) yahaan tak ke maine uski paidaawaar se kuch gaayein aur unka charwaaha khareed liya. Baad mein wo mazdoor mere paas aaya aur kaha, "(Aye Allah ke bande!) Allah se daro, aur mujhpar zulm mat karo, aur mujhe mera haq do." Maine (usse) kaha, "Jaao aur wo gaayein aur unka charwaaha le lo." To wo unhein lekar chala gaya. (To, Aye Allah!) Agar tujhe pata hai ke maine ye sirf teri khushnoodi ke liye kiya, to patthar ka baacha hua hissa bhi hataa de.' To Allah ne unhein (unki museebat se) nijaat di.'

e: Narrated Al-Mughira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah has forbidden you ( 1 ) to be undutiful to your mothers (2) to withhold (what you should give) or (3) demand (what you do not deserve), and (4) to bury your daughters alive. And Allah has disliked that (A) you talk too much about others ( B), ask too many questions (in religion), or (C) waste your property
hi: Al-Mughira bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah ne tumhein haraam kiya hai: (1) apni maaon ke saath nafarmaani karna, (2) rokna jo tumhein dena chaahiye, ya (3) maangna jo tumhaare haqq mein nahi, aur (4) apni betiyon ko zinda dafan karna. Aur Allah ne napasand kiya hai: (A) doosron ke baare mein bahut baatein karna, (B) (deen mein) bahut zyaada sawaal poochna, ya (C) apni jaayadaad zaaya karna.'

e: Narrated Abu Bakra:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said thrice, "Shall I not inform you of the biggest of the great sins?" We said, "Yes, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)" He said, "To join partners in worship with Allah: to be undutiful to one's parents." The Prophet (ﷺ) sat up after he had been reclining and added, "And I warn you against giving forged statement and a false witness; I warn you against giving a forged statement and a false witness." The Prophet kept on saying that warning till we thought that he would not stop
hi: Abu Bakra (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne teen baar farmaya, 'Kya main tumhein sabse bade gunaahon ke baare mein na bataun?' Humne kaha, 'Haan, Aye Allah ke Rasool.' Unhone kaha, 'Allah ke saath shirk karna, apne maa-baap ke saath nafarmaani karna.' Nabi (SAW) tek lagaaye hue se seedhe baithe aur izaafa kiya, 'Aur main tumhein jhooti gawaahi dene aur jhoota bayaan dene se khabardaar karta hoon; main tumhein jhooti gawaahi dene aur jhoota bayaan dene se khabardaar karta hoon.' Nabi (SAW) ye chetaawani baar-baar dete rahe yahaan tak ke humein laga wo rukenge nahi.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) mentioned the greatest sins or he was asked about the greatest sins. He said, "To join partners in worship with Allah; to kill a soul which Allah has forbidden to kill; and to be undutiful or unkind to one's parents." The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "Shall I inform you of the biggest of the great sins? That is the forged statement or the false witness." Shu`ba (the sub-narrator) states that most probably the Prophet said, "the false witness
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne sabse bade gunaahon ka zikr kiya, ya unse sabse bade gunaahon ke baare mein pucha gaya. Unhone kaha, 'Allah ke saath shirk karna; wo jaan lena jise Allah ne haraam kiya hai; aur apne maa-baap ke saath nafarmaani ya bad-sulooki karna.' Nabi (SAW) ne aage kaha, 'Kya main tumhein sabse bade gunaahon mein se ek aur na bataun? Wo hai jhoota bayaan ya jhooti gawaahi.' Ravi Shu'ba kehte hain ke shaayad Nabi (SAW) ne 'jhooti gawaahi' kaha tha.

e: Narrated Asma' bint Abu Bakr:My mother came to me, hoping (for my favor) during the lifetime of the Prophet. I asked the Prophet, "May I treat her kindly?" He replied, "Yes." Ibn 'Uyaina said, "Then Allah revealed: 'Allah forbids you not with regards to those who fought not against you because of religion, and drove you not out from your homes, that you should show them kindness and deal justly with them
hi: Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Abu Bakr (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Meri (mushrik) maa Nabi (SAW) ki zindagi mein mere paas aayi, mujhse (kuch) ummeed rakhte hue. Maine Nabi (SAW) se pucha, 'Kya main unke saath achha sulook karoon?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Haan.' Ravi Ibn Uyaina kehte hain: Phir Allah ne naazil farmaya: 'Allah tumhein un logon ke saath achha sulook karne aur insaaf karne se nahi rokta jinhone deen ki wajah se tumse jang nahi ki, aur tumhein tumhaare gharon se nahi nikaala.'

e: Narrated Asma':"My mother who was a Mushrikah (pagan, etc.), came with her father during the period of peace pact between the Muslims and the Quraish infidels. I went to seek the advice of the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "My mother has arrived and she is hoping (for my favor)." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Yes, be good to your mother
hi: Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Meri maa, jo mushrikah thi, apne waalid ke saath Musalmaanon aur Quraish kaafiron ke beech sulah ke daur mein aayi. Main Nabi (SAW) se mashwara lene gayi aur kaha, 'Meri maa aayi hai aur wo (mujhse) ummeed rakhti hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Haan, apni maa ke saath achha sulook karo.'

e: Narrated Abu Sufyan:That Heraclius sent for him and said, "What did he, i.e. the Prophet (ﷺ) order you?" I replied, "He orders us to offer prayers; to give alms; to be chaste; and to keep good relations with our relatives
hi: Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Heraclius ne unhein bulwaaya aur kaha, 'Unhone (yaani Nabi SAW ne) tumhein kya hukm diya hai?' Maine jawab diya, 'Wo humein namaz padhne, sadqa dene, paakdaaman rehne, aur apne rishtedaaron ke saath achhe taaluqaat rakhne ka hukm dete hain.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:My father, seeing a silken cloak being sold, said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Buy this and wear it on Fridays and when the foreign delegates pay a visit to you." He said, "This is worn only by that person who will have no share in the Hereafter." Later a few silken cloaks were given to the Prophet (ﷺ) as a gift, and he sent one of those cloaks to `Umar. `Umar said (to the Prophet), "How can I wear it while you have said about it what you said?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I did not give it to you to wear but to sell or to give to someone else to wear." So `Umar sent it to his (pagan) brother who was from the inhabitants of Mecca before he (`Umar's brother) embraced Islam
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Mere waalid ne, resham ka ek chogha bikte dekh kar, kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Ise khareed lijiye aur Jumme ke din ya jab bahar se wafd aapke paas aayein tab pehnie.' Unhone kaha, 'Ise sirf wahi pehanta hai jiska Aakhirat mein koi hissa nahi.' Baad mein Nabi (SAW) ko resham ke kuch chogha tohfe mein diye gaye, aur unhone unmein se ek Umar ko bheja. Umar ne (Nabi se) kaha, 'Main ise kaise pehanoon jabke aapne iske baare mein wo kaha jo aapne kaha?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Maine ye tumhein pehanne ke liye nahi diya, balke bechne ya kisi aur ko pehanne ke liye dene ke liye diya.' To Umar ne use apne (mushrik) bhai ko bheja, jo Makkah ke rehne wale the, unke Islam qubool karne se pehle.

e: Narrated Abu Ayyub Al-Ansari:It was said" "O Allah's Messenger! Inform me of a deed which will make me enter Paradise." (continues through a different chain in the next hadith)
hi: Abu Ayyub Al-Ansari (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Kaha gaya, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe koi aisa amal bataiye jo mujhe Jannat mein daakhil karaaye.' (Ye agli hadees mein ek doosre silsile se jaari hai.)

e: Narrated Abu Aiyub Al-Ansari:A man said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Inform me of a deed which will make me enter Paradise." The people said, "What is the matter with him? What is the matter with him?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "He has something to ask (what he needs greatly)." The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to him), (In order to enter Paradise) you should worship Allah and join none in worship with Him: You should offer prayers perfectly, give obligatory charity (Zakat), and keep good relations with your Kith and kin." He then said, "Leave it!" (The sub-narrator said, "It seems that the Prophet (ﷺ) was riding his she camel
hi: Abu Aiyub Al-Ansari (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe koi aisa amal bataiye jo mujhe Jannat mein daakhil karaaye.' Logon ne kaha, 'Isko kya hua? Isko kya hua?' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Ise kuch poochna hai (jiski use bahut zaroorat hai).' Nabi (SAW) ne (usse) kaha, '(Jannat mein daakhil hone ke liye) Allah ki ibaadat karo aur uske saath kisi ko shareek na karo; namaz achhi tarah padho, farz sadqa (Zakat) do, aur apne rishtedaaron ke saath achhe taaluqaat rakho.' Phir unhone kaha, 'Ise chhod do!' (Ravi kehte hain: Aisa lagta hai Nabi SAW apni oontni par sawaar the.)

e: Narrated Jubair bin Mut`im:That he heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "The person who severs the bond of kinship will not enter Paradise
hi: Jubair bin Mut'im bataate hain: Unhone Nabi (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Jo shaks rishtedaari ka rishta tod deta hai, wo Jannat mein daakhil nahi hoga.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "Who ever is pleased that he be granted more wealth and that his lease of life be pro longed, then he should keep good relations with his Kith and kin
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Jo koi chahta hai ke usse zyaada daulat mile aur uski umar lambi ho, use apne rishtedaaron ke saath achhe taaluqaat rakhne chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Apostle said, "Whoever loves that he be granted more wealth and that his lease of life be prolonged then he should keep good relations with his Kith and kin
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi chahta hai ke usse zyaada daulat mile aur uski umar lambi ho, use apne rishtedaaron ke saath achhe taaluqaat rakhne chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah created the creations, and when He finished from His creations, Ar-Rahm i.e., womb said, "(O Allah) at this place I seek refuge with You from all those who sever me (i.e. sever the ties of Kith and kin). Allah said, 'Yes, won't you be pleased that I will keep good relations with the one who will keep good relations with you, and I will sever the relation with the one who will sever the relations with you.' It said, 'Yes, O my Lord.' Allah said, 'Then that is for you ' " Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) added. "Read (in the Qur'an) if you wish, the Statement of Allah: 'Would you then, if you were given the authority, do mischief in the land and sever your ties of kinship?
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah ne makhlooq banaayi, aur jab wo apni makhlooq banaakar faarigh hua, Ar-Rahm (yaani kokh) ne kaha, "(Aye Allah) is jagah main un sab se teri panaah maangti hoon jo mujhse (yaani rishtedaari ke rishton se) muh mode." Allah ne kaha, "Haan, kya tumhein pasand nahi ke main us se achhe taaluqaat rakhoon jo tumse achhe taaluqaat rakhe, aur us se rishta tod doon jo tumse rishta tode?" Usne kaha, "Haan, Aye mere Rab." Allah ne kaha, "To ye tumhaare liye hai."' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne aage kaha, 'Agar chaaho, to (Quran mein) Allah ka ye farmaan padho: "Kya phir agar tumhein ikhtiyaar diya jaaye, to tum zameen mein fasaad phailaoge aur apne rishtedaari ke rishte todoge?"'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The word 'Ar-Rahm (womb) derives its name from Ar-Rahman (i.e., one of the names of Allah) and Allah said: 'I will keep good relation with the one who will keep good relation with you, (womb i.e. Kith and Kin) and sever the relation with him who will sever the relation with you, (womb, i.e. Kith and Kin)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Lafz "Ar-Rahm" (kokh) apna naam "Ar-Rahman" (yaani Allah ke naamon mein se ek) se leta hai, aur Allah ne farmaya, "Main us se achhe taaluqaat rakhunga jo tumse (kokh, yaani rishtedaaron se) achhe taaluqaat rakhe, aur us se rishta todunga jo tumse rishta tode."'

e: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The word 'Ar-Rahm' (womb) derives its name from 'Ar- Rahman' (i.e. Allah). So whosoever keeps good relations with it (womb i.e. Kith and kin), Allah will keep good relations with him, and whosoever will sever it (i.e. severs his bonds of Kith and kin) Allah too will sever His relations with him
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki zawja) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Lafz "Ar-Rahm" (kokh) apna naam "Ar-Rahman" (yaani Allah) se leta hai. To jo koi ismein (kokh, yaani rishtedaaron mein) achhe taaluqaat rakhe, Allah bhi usse achhe taaluqaat rakhega, aur jo koi ise (yaani apne rishtedaari ke rishton ko) todega, Allah bhi usse apne rishte tod dega.'

e: Narrated `Amr bin Al-`As:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying openly not secretly, "The family of Abu so-and-so (i.e. Talib) are not among my protectors." `Amr said that there was a blank space (1) in the Book of Muhammad bin Ja`far. He added, "My Protector is Allah and the righteous believing people." `Amr bin Al-`As added: I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, 'But they (that family) have kinship (Rahm) with me and I will be good and dutiful to them
hi: Amr bin Al-As (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko khule aam, chhupkar nahi, ye kehte suna, 'Falaan (yaani Abu Talib) ka khaandaan mere hifaazatgaar nahi hain.' Amr kehte hain ke Muhammad bin Ja'far ki Kitaab mein yahaan ek khaali jagah thi. Unhone aage kaha, 'Mera hifaazatgaar Allah aur neik momin log hain.' Amr bin Al-As ne aage kaha: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, 'Magar unka (us khaandaan ka) mujhse rishta (Rahm) hai aur main unke saath achha aur farmaanbardaar rahunga.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Al-Wasil is not the one who recompenses the good done to him by his relatives, but Al-Wasil is the one who keeps good relations with those relatives who had severed the bond of kinship with him
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Al-Wasil (rishta jodne wala) wo nahi jo apne rishtedaaron ke achhe sulook ka badla deta hai, balke Al-Wasil wo hai jo un rishtedaaron ke saath achhe taaluqaat rakhta hai jinhone uske saath apna rishta tod diya ho.'

e: Narrated Hakim bin Hizam:That he said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What do you think about my good deeds which I used to do during the period of ignorance (before embracing Islam) like keeping good relations with my Kith and kin, manumitting of slaves and giving alms etc; Shall I receive the reward for that?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "You have embraced Islam with all those good deeds which you did
hi: Hakim bin Hizam (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Unhone kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Aap mere un nek amaalon ke baare mein kya sochte hain jo maine Jaahiliyat ke daur mein (Islam qubool karne se pehle) kiye the, jaise apne rishtedaaron ke saath achhe taaluqaat rakhna, ghulaam azaad karna, sadqa dena waghera; kya mujhe uska ajr milega?' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Tumne Islam qubool kiya hai un sab nek amaalon ke saath jo tumne kiye.'

e: Narrated Sa`id:Um Khalid bint Khalid bin Sa`id said, "I came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) along with my father and I was wearing a yellow shirt. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Sanah Sanah!" (`Abdullah, the sub-narrator said, "It means, 'Nice, nice!' in the Ethiopian language.") Um Khalid added, "Then I started playing with the seal of Prophethood. My father admonished me. But Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said (to my father), "Leave her," Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (then addressing me) said, "May you live so long that your dress gets worn out, and you will mend it many times, and then wear another till it gets worn out (i.e. May Allah prolong your life)." (The sub-narrator, `Abdullah aid, "That garment (which she was wearing remained usable for a long period)
hi: Saeed bataate hain: Umm Khalid bint Khalid bin Saeed ne kaha, 'Main apne waalid ke saath Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur maine peela kameez pehna hua tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, "Sanah Sanah!" (Ravi Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) kehte hain, "Iska matlab Habshi zabaan mein 'achha, achha!' hota hai.")' Umm Khalid ne aage kaha, 'Phir main Nabuwwat ki muhar (khatam an-nubuwwat) se khelne lagi. Mere waalid ne mujhe daanta. Magar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (mere waalid se) kaha, "Ise chhod do."' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (phir mujhse muKHatib hoke) kaha, 'Itni umar jiyo ke tumhaara kapda purana ho jaaye, aur tum ise kayi baar theek karwaao, phir doosra pehno yahaan tak ke wo bhi purana ho jaaye (yaani Allah tumhaari umar lambi kare).' (Ravi Abdullah kehte hain, 'Wo kapda (jo wo pehne hue thi) lambe arse tak istemaal hota raha.')

e: Narrated Ibn Abi Na'm:I was present when a man asked Ibn `Umar about the blood of mosquitoes. Ibn `Umar said, "From where are you?" The man replied. "From Iraq." Ibn `Umar said, "Look at that! he is asking me about the blood of Mosquitoes while they (the Iraqis ) have killed the (grand) son of the Prophet. I have heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "They (Hasan and Husain) are my two sweet-smelling flowers in this world
hi: Ibn Abi Na'm bataate hain: Main wahaan maujood tha jab ek shaks ne Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se machharon ke khoon ke baare mein pucha. Ibn Umar ne pucha, 'Tum kahaan se ho?' Us shaks ne jawab diya, 'Iraq se.' Ibn Umar ne kaha, 'Ye dekho! Wo mujhse machharon ke khoon ke baare mein pucchta hai jabke unhone (Iraqiyon ne) Nabi (SAW) ke pote ko qatl kiya. Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, "Wo dono (Hasan (Alayhis Salam) aur Husain (Alayhis Salam)) is duniya mein mere do khushbudaar phool hain."'

e: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) A lady along with her two daughters came to me asking me (for some alms), but she found nothing with me except one date which I gave to her and she divided it between her two daughters, and then she got up and went away. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) came in and I informed him about this story. He said, "Whoever is in charge of (put to test by) these daughters and treats them generously, then they will act as a shield for him from the (Hell) Fire
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki zawja) bataati hain: Ek khaatoon apni do betiyon ke saath mere paas aayi kuch sadqa maangte hue, magar mere paas ek khajoor ke siwa kuch nahi tha jo maine unhein di, aur usne use apni do betiyon mein baant diya, phir wo uthi aur chali gayi. Phir Nabi (SAW) andar aaye aur maine unhein ye kahaani sunaayi. Unhone kaha, 'Jo koi in betiyon (jaisi zimmedaari) ki aazmaish mein padta hai aur unke saath farakhdili se pesh aata hai, to wo uske liye Jahannam ki Aag se dhaal ban jaayengi.'

e: Narrated Abu Qatada:The Prophet (ﷺ) came out towards us, while carrying Umamah, the daughter of Abi Al-As (his granddaughter) over his shoulder. He prayed, and when he wanted to bow, he put her down, and when he stood up, he lifted her up
hi: Abu Qatada (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) hamare paas aaye, apni nawaasi Umamah, Abi Al-As ki beti, ko apne kandhe par uthaaye hue. Unhone namaz padhi, aur jab ruku karna chaahte, unhein neeche rakh dete, aur jab khade hote, unhein uthaa lete.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) kissed Al-Hasan bin `Ali while Al-Aqra' bin H`Abis at-Tamim was sitting beside him. Al-Aqra said, "I have ten children and I have never kissed anyone of them," Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) cast a look at him and said, "Whoever is not merciful to others will not be treated mercifully
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Al-Hasan bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko chooma jabke Al-Aqra bin Habis At-Tamimi unke paas baithe the. Al-Aqra ne kaha, 'Mere das bachche hain aur maine kabhi unmein se kisi ko nahi chooma.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unki taraf dekha aur kaha, 'Jo doosron par reham nahi karta, uspar reham nahi kiya jaayega.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:A bedouin came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "You (people) kiss the boys! We don't kiss them." The Prophet said, "I cannot put mercy in your heart after Allah has taken it away from it
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ek badawi Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Aap (log) bachon ko chumte hain! Hum unhein nahi chumte.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Main tumhaare dil mein reham nahi daal sakta jab Allah ne use isse nikaal diya hai.'

e: Narrated `Umar bin Al-Khattab:Some Sabi (i.e. war prisoners, children and woman only) were brought before the Prophet (ﷺ) and behold, a woman amongst them was milking her breasts to feed and whenever she found a child amongst the captives, she took it over her chest and nursed it (she had lost her child but later she found him) the Prophet said to us, "Do you think that this lady can throw her son in the fire?" We replied, "No, if she has the power not to throw it (in the fire)." The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "Allah is more merciful to His slaves than this lady to her son
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab bataate hain: Kuch Sabi (yaani jang ke qaidi, bachche aur auraten) Nabi (SAW) ke saamne laaye gaye, aur dekha to unmein ek aurat apna doodh apne haathon se nikaal rahi thi bachche ko pilaane ke liye, aur jab bhi use qaidiyon mein koi bachcha milta, wo use apni chhaati se lagaakar doodh pilaati (usne apna bachcha kho diya tha magar baad mein use paaya). Nabi (SAW) ne humse kaha, 'Kya tumhein lagta hai ye khaatoon apne bete ko aag mein phenk sakti hai?' Humne jawab diya, 'Nahi, agar uske paas usse na phenkne ki taaqat hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne phir kaha, 'Allah apne bandon par is khaatoon se bhi zyaada meherbaan hai jitna wo apne bete par hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, Allah divided Mercy into one hundred parts. He kept ninety nine parts with Him and sent down one part to the earth, and because of that, its one single part, His Creations are merciful to each other, so that even the mare lifts up its hoofs away from its baby animal, lest it should trample on it
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Allah ne Rehmat ko sau hisson mein baanta. Usne ninyaanve (99) hisse apne paas rakhe aur ek hissa zameen par bheja, aur usi ek hisse ki wajah se uski makhlooq ek doosre ke saath meherbaan hai, yahaan tak ke ghodi apna khur apne bachche se door uthaati hai, kahin wo usse kuchal na de.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:I said 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Which sin is the greatest?" He said, "To set up a rival unto Allah, though He Alone created you." I said, "What next?" He said, "To kill your son lest he should share your food with you." I further asked, "What next?" He said, "To commit illegal sexual intercourse with the wife of your neighbor." And then Allah revealed as proof of the statement of the Prophet: 'Those who invoke not with Allah any other god)................. (to end of verse)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kaunsa gunaah sabse bada hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Allah ka koi shareek thehraana, halaanke usi ne akele tumhein banaaya.' Maine kaha, 'Uske baad?' Unhone kaha, 'Apne bete ko is dar se qatl karna ke wo tumhaare saath tumhaara khaana baantega.' Maine aage pucha, 'Uske baad?' Unhone kaha, 'Apne padosi ki biwi ke saath zina karna.' Phir Allah ne Nabi (SAW) ke is bayaan ke saboot ke taur par naazil kiya: 'Jo log Allah ke saath kisi aur khuda ko nahi pukaarte...' (Aayat ke aakhir tak).

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) took a child in his lap for Tahnik (i.e. he chewed a date in his mouth and put its juice in the mouth of the child). The child urinated on him, so he asked for water and poured it over the place of the urine
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ne ek bacche ko apni god mein liya Tahnik ke liye (yaani unhone apne munh mein khajoor chabaa kar uska ras bacche ke munh mein daala). Bacche ne unpar peshaab kar diya, isliye unhone paani maanga aur peshaab wali jagah par daala.

e: Narrated Usama bin Zaid:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to put me on (one of) his thighs and put Al-Hasan bin `Ali on his other thigh, and then embrace us and say, "O Allah! Please be Merciful to them, as I am merciful to them
hi: Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mujhe apni ek jaangh par bithaate aur Al-Hasan bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko doosri jaangh par, phir humein gale lagaate aur kehte, 'Aye Allah! In dono par meherbaan ho, jaise main in par meherbaan hoon.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:I never felt so jealous of any woman as I did of Khadija, though she had died three years before the Prophet married me, and that was because I heard him mentioning her too often, and because his Lord had ordered him to give her the glad tidings that she would have a palace in Paradise, made of Qasab and because he used to slaughter a sheep and distribute its meat among her friends
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine kabhi kisi aurat se itni jalan mehsoos nahi ki jitni Khadija (رضی اللہ عنہا) se ki, halaanke unka intekaal Nabi (SAW) ke mujhse nikaah karne se teen saal pehle ho chuka tha, aur iski wajah ye thi ke maine unhein Khadija ka bahut zyaada zikr karte suna, aur is wajah se bhi ke unke Rab ne unhein hukm diya tha ke wo Khadija ko khush-khabri dein ke unke liye Jannat mein Qasab (khokhle moti) se bana ek mahal hai, aur is wajah se bhi ke wo bakri zibah karte aur uska gosht Khadija ke doston mein baantte.

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I and the person who looks after an orphan and provides for him, will be in Paradise like this," putting his index and middle fingers together
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Main aur wo shaks jo kisi yateem ki dekhbhaal karta hai aur uske liye faraaham karta hai, Jannat mein is tarah honge,' apni shahaadat aur beech ki ungli paas laate hue.

e: Narrated Safwan bin Salim:The Prophet (ﷺ) said "The one who looks after and works for a widow and for a poor person, is like a warrior fighting for Allah's Cause or like a person who fasts during the day and prays all the night." Narrated Abu Huraira that the Prophet (ﷺ) said as above
hi: Safwan bin Salim bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi biwaa aur gareeb ki dekhbhaal aur khidmat karta hai, wo Allah ki raah mein jihad karne wale jaanbaaz jaisa hai, ya us shaks jaisa hai jo din mein roza rakhta hai aur poori raat namaz padhta hai.' Ravi Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne bhi Nabi (SAW) ko yahi kehte bataaya.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The one who looks after and works for a widow and for a poor person is like a warrior fighting for Allah's Cause." (The narrator Al-Qa'nabi is not sure whether he also said "Like the one who prays all the night without slackness and fasts continuously and never breaks his fast)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi biwaa aur gareeb ki dekhbhaal aur khidmat karta hai, wo Allah ki raah mein jihad karne wale jaanbaaz jaisa hai.' (Ravi Al-Qa'nabi ko yaqeen nahi ke unhone ye bhi kaha, 'Ya us shaks jaisa jo bagair susti ke poori raat namaz padhta hai aur lagataar roza rakhta hai aur kabhi roza nahi todta.')

e: Narrated Abu Sulaiman and Malik bin Huwairith:We came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and we were (a few) young men of approximately equal age and stayed with him for twenty nights. Then he thought that we were anxious for our families, and he asked us whom we had left behind to look after our families, and we told him. He was kindhearted and merciful, so he said, "Return to your families and teach them (religious knowledge) and order them (to do good deeds) and offer your prayers in the way you saw me offering my prayers, and when the stated time for the prayer becomes due, then one of you should pronounce its call (i.e. the Adhan), and the eldest of you should lead you in prayer
hi: Abu Sulaiman aur Malik bin Huwairith (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye, aur hum kuch jawaan log the, taqreeban ek jaisi umar ke, aur unke saath bees raatein rahe. Phir unhein laga ke hum apne khaandaanon ke liye betaab hain, aur unhone humse pucha ke humne apne khaandaanon ki dekhbhaal ke liye kise chhoda hai, aur humne unhein bataaya. Wo dil se naram aur meherbaan the, isliye unhone kaha, 'Apne khaandaanon ke paas wapas jaao aur unhein (deeni ilm) sikhaao aur unhein (nek amaal karne ka) hukm do, aur namaz usi tarah padho jaise tumne mujhe padhte dekha, aur jab namaz ka muqarrar waqt aa jaaye, to tum mein se ek Azaan de, aur tum mein se jo sabse bada ho wo Imamat kare.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "While a man was walking on a road. he became very thirsty. Then he came across a well, got down into it, drank (of its water) and then came out. Meanwhile he saw a dog panting and licking mud because of excessive thirst. The man said to himself "This dog is suffering from the same state of thirst as I did." So he went down the well (again) and filled his shoe (with water) and held it in his mouth and watered the dog. Allah thanked him for that deed and forgave him." The people asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Is there a reward for us in serving the animals?" He said, "(Yes) There is a reward for serving any animate (living being)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ek aadmi raaste par chal raha tha, use bahut pyaas lagi. Phir usne ek kuan dekha, usmein utra, (uska paani) piya, phir baahar aaya. Isi dauraan usne ek kutte ko haanp-te aur pyaas ki shiddat se kicchad chaatte dekha. Us aadmi ne apne dil mein kaha, "Ye kutta bhi utni hi pyaas se pareshaan hai jitna maine mehsoos ki thi." To wo (dobara) kuen mein utra aur apni jooti mein paani bhara aur use apne munh mein pakde kutte ko pilaaya. Allah ne uske is amal ke liye uska shukriya adaa kiya aur use maaf kar diya.' Logon ne pucha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya jaanwaron ki khidmat karne mein humein ajr milega?' Unhone kaha, '(Haan) Har jaandaar (zinda praani) ki khidmat karne mein ajr hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up for the prayer and we too stood up along with him. Then a bedouin shouted while offering prayer. "O Allah! Bestow Your Mercy on me and Muhammad only and do not bestow it on anybody else along with us." When the Prophet (ﷺ) had finished his prayer with Taslim, he said to the Bedouin, "You have limited (narrowed) a very vast (thing)," meaning Allah's Mercy
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) namaz ke liye khade hue aur hum bhi unke saath khade hue. Phir ek badawi ne namaz padhte hue chillaaya, 'Aye Allah! Sirf mujhpar aur Muhammad par apni rehmat naazil kar, hamare siwa kisi aur par nahi.' Jab Nabi (SAW) ne apni namaz Taslim ke saath khatam ki, unhone badawi se kaha, 'Tumne ek bahut wasee cheez ko tang kar diya,' Allah ki rehmat ki taraf ishara karte hue.

e: Narrated An-Nu`man bin Bashir:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "You see the believers as regards their being merciful among themselves and showing love among themselves and being kind, resembling one body, so that, if any part of the body is not well then the whole body shares the sleeplessness (insomnia) and fever with it
hi: An-Nu'man bin Bashir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Tum Momineen ko dekhoge ke wo aapas mein reham karne, mohabbat dikhaane, aur meharbaani mein ek jism ki tarah hain, taake agar jism ka koi hissa bimar ho, to poora jism uske saath jaagta rahe aur bukhaar mehsoos kare.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If any Muslim plants any plant and a human being or an animal eats of it, he will be rewarded as if he had given that much in charity
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar koi Musalmaan koi paudha lagaaye aur koi insaan ya jaanwar usmein se khaaye, to use utna hi ajr milega jitna usne sadqa diya ho.'

e: Narrated Jarir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who is not merciful to others, will not be treated mercifully
hi: Jarir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo doosron par reham nahi karta, uspar bhi reham nahi kiya jaayega.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said "Gabriel continued to recommend me about treating the neighbors Kindly and politely so much so that I thought he would order me to make them as my heirs
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jibrael mujhe hamesha padosiyon ke saath achha aur narm sulook karne ki sifaarish karte rahe, yahaan tak ke mujhe laga wo mujhe unhein apna waaris banaane ka hukm denge.'

e: Narrates Ibn `Umar:Allah's Apostle said, Gabriel kept on recommending me about treating the neighbors in a kind and polite manner, so much so that I thought that he would order (me) to make them (my) heirs
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, Jibrael mujhe padosiyon ke saath achhe aur nazaakat bhare suluk ki taakeed karte rahe, itna ke mujhe laga wo (mujhe) hukm de denge ke main unhein apna waaris banaun.

e: Narrated Abu Shuraih:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "By Allah, he does not believe! By Allah, he does not believe! By Allah, he does not believe!" It was said, "Who is that, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" He said, "That person whose neighbor does not feel safe from his evil
hi: Abu Shuraih (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah ki qasam, wo momin nahi hai! Allah ki qasam, wo momin nahi hai! Allah ki qasam, wo momin nahi hai!' Pucha gaya, 'Wo kaun hai, Aye Allah ke Rasool?' Unhone kaha, 'Wo shaks jiska padosi uski buraai se mehfooz mehsoos na kare.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to say, "O Muslim ladies! A neighbouress should not look down upon the present of her neighbouress even it were the hooves of a sheep
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) kaha karte the, 'Aye Musalmaan khawaateen! Koi padosan apni padosan ke tohfe ko haqeer mat samjhe, chaahe wo bakri ke khur hi kyun na hon.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Anybody who believes in Allah and the Last Day should not harm his neighbor, and anybody who believes in Allah and the Last Day should entertain his guest generously and anybody who believes in Allah and the Last Day should talk what is good or keep quiet. (i.e. abstain from all kinds of evil and dirty talk)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par Iman rakhta hai, use apne padosi ko takleef nahi deni chaahiye, aur jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par Iman rakhta hai, use apne mehmaan ki achhi mehmaan-nawaazi karni chaahiye, aur jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par Iman rakhta hai, use achhi baat kehni chaahiye ya khaamosh rehna chaahiye (yaani har tarah ki buri aur ganda baat se bachna chaahiye).'

e: Narrated Abu Shuraih Al-Adawi:My ears heard and my eyes saw the Prophet (ﷺ) when he spoke, "Anybody who believes in Allah and the Last Day, should serve his neighbor generously, and anybody who believes in Allah and the Last Day should serve his guest generously by giving him his reward." It was asked. "What is his reward, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" He said, "(To be entertained generously) for a day and a night with high quality of food and the guest has the right to be entertained for three days (with ordinary food) and if he stays longer, what he will be provided with will be regarded as Sadaqa (a charitable gift). And anybody who believes in Allah and the Last Day should talk what is good or keep quiet (i.e. abstain from all kinds of dirty and evil talks)
hi: Abu Shuraih (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Adawi bataate hain: Meri kaanon ne suna aur meri aankhon ne dekha jab Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par Iman rakhta hai, use apne padosi ki achhi khidmat karni chaahiye, aur jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par Iman rakhta hai, use apne mehmaan ki khidmat karni chaahiye, uska haq adaa karte hue.' Pucha gaya, 'Uska haq kya hai, Aye Allah ke Rasool?' Unhone kaha, '(Achhi mehmaan-nawaazi) ek din aur raat behtareen khaane ke saath, aur mehmaan ko teen din tak (aam khaane ke saath) mehmaan-nawaazi ka haq hai, aur agar wo isse zyaada rahe, to jo bhi use diya jaayega wo Sadqa mana jaayega. Aur jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par Iman rakhta hai, use achhi baat kehni chaahiye ya khaamosh rehna chaahiye (yaani har tarah ki ganda aur buri baat se bachna chaahiye).'

e: Narrated `Aisha:I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have two neighbors! To whom shall I send my gifts?" He said, "To the one whose gate in nearer to you
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mere do padosi hain! Main apna tohfa kise bheju?' Unhone kaha, 'Jiske darwaaze tumhare zyaada qareeb hain.'

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, Enjoining, all that is good is a Sadaqa
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Har achhi baat ki taakeed karna Sadqa hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Musa Al-Ash`ari:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "On every Muslim there is enjoined (a compulsory) Sadaqa (alms)." They (the people) said, "If one has nothing?' He said, "He should work with his hands so that he may benefit himself and give in charity." They said, "If he cannot work or does not work?" He said, "Then he should help the oppressed unhappy person (by word or action or both)." They said, "If he does not do it?" He said, "Then he should enjoin what is good (or said what is reasonable).' They said, "If he does not do that''' He said, "Then he should refrain from doing evil, for that will be considered for Him as a Sadaqa (charity)
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ashari bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Har Musalmaan par (ek zaroori) Sadqa farz hai.' Unhone (logon ne) pucha, 'Agar kisi ke paas kuch na ho?' Unhone kaha, 'To use apne haathon se kaam karna chaahiye taake wo khud ko faayda pahunchaaye aur sadqa de.' Unhone kaha, 'Agar wo kaam nahi kar sakta ya nahi karta?' Unhone kaha, 'To use kisi mazloom, dukhi shaks ki madad karni chaahiye (baaton se, amal se, ya dono se).' Unhone kaha, 'Agar wo aisa nahi karta?' Unhone kaha, 'To use achhi baat ki taakeed karni chaahiye (ya kaha munaasib baat).' Unhone kaha, 'Agar wo aisa nahi karta?' Unhone kaha, 'To use bura karne se bachna chaahiye, kyunke ye bhi uske liye Sadqa mana jaayega.'

e: Narrated `Adi bin Hatim:The Prophet (ﷺ) mentioned the (Hell) Fire and sought refuge (with Allah) from it, and turned his face to the other side. He mentioned the (Hell) Fire again and took refuge (with Allah) from it and turned his face to the other side. (Shu`ba, the sub-narrator, said, "I have no doubt that the Prophet (ﷺ) repeated it twice.") The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "(O people!) Save yourselves from the (Hell) Fire even if with one half of a date fruit (given in charity), and if this is not available, then (save yourselves) by saying a good pleasant friendly word
hi: Adi bin Hatim (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne Jahannam ki Aag ka zikr kiya aur usse Allah ki panaah maangi, aur apna chehra doosri taraf mod liya. Unhone Jahannam ki Aag ka phir zikr kiya aur usse Allah ki panaah maangi aur apna chehra doosri taraf mod liya. (Ravi Shu'ba kehte hain, 'Mujhe shak nahi ke Nabi (SAW) ne ise do baar dohraaya.') Phir Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, '(Aye logo!) Apne aap ko Jahannam ki Aag se bachaao, chaahe khajoor ke aadhe tukde (ka sadqa) hi dekar, aur agar ye bhi mumkin na ho, to ek achhi, khushnuma, dostana baat kehkar (khud ko bachaao).'

e: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) A group of Jews entered upon the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "As-Samu-Alaikum." (i.e. death be upon you). I understood it and said, "Wa-Alaikum As-Samu wal-la'n. (death and the curse of Allah be Upon you)." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said "Be calm, O `Aisha! Allah loves that on, should be kind and lenient in all matters." I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Haven't you heard what they (the Jews) have said?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said "I have (already) said (to them) "And upon you
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki zawja) bataati hain: Yahudiyon ka ek giroh Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha, 'As-Samu-Alaikum' (yaani tumpar maut ho). Main samajh gayi aur kaha, 'Wa-Alaikum As-Samu wal-La'n' (tumpar maut aur Allah ki laanat ho). Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Shaant raho, Aye Aisha! Allah pasand karta hai ke insaan har maamle mein naram aur meharbaan rahe.' Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya aapne nahi suna unhone (Yahudiyon ne) kya kaha?' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Maine (unhein) pehle hi kah diya, "Aur tumpar bhi."'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:A bedouin urinated in the mosque and the people ran to (beat) him. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Do not interrupt his urination (i.e. let him finish)." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) asked for a tumbler of water and poured the water over the place of urine
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek badawi ne Masjid mein peshaab kar diya aur log (usse maarne) daude. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Uska peshaab beech mein mat roko (use khatam karne do).' Phir Nabi (SAW) ne paani ka ek pyaala maangaya aur peshaab ki jagah par daala.

e: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A believer to another believer is like a building whose different parts enforce each other." The Prophet (ﷺ) then clasped his hands with the fingers interlaced. (At that time) the Prophet (ﷺ) was sitting and a man came and begged or asked for something. The Prophet (ﷺ) faced us and said, "Help and recommend him and you will receive the reward for it, and Allah will bring about what He will through His Prophet's tongue
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ek Momin doosre Momin ke liye ek imaarat jaisa hai jiske alag-alag hisse ek doosre ko mazboot karte hain.' Nabi (SAW) ne phir apne haathon ki ungliyaan ek doosre mein pirota. (Us waqt) Nabi (SAW) baithe hue the aur ek aadmi aaya aur kuch maanga ya poocha. Nabi (SAW) ne hamari taraf muh karke kaha, 'Uski madad karo aur usse sifaarish karo, tumhein iska ajr milega, aur Allah apne Nabi ki zubaan se jo chaahega wo poora karega.'

e: Narrated Abu Musa: Whenever a beggar or a person in need came to the Prophet, the Prophet would say "Help and recommend him and you will receive the reward for it, and Allah will bring about what he will through His Prophet's tongue
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab bhi koi bhikaari ya zaroortmand shaks Nabi (SAW) ke paas aata, Nabi (SAW) kehte, 'Uski madad karo aur usse sifaarish karo, tumhein iska ajr milega, aur Allah apne Nabi ki zubaan se jo chaahega wo poora karega.'

e: Narrated Masruq: Abdullah bin 'Amr mentioned Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying that he was neither a Fahish nor a Mutafahish. Abdullah bin 'Amr added, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'The best among you are those who have the best manners and character
hi: Masruq bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka zikr karte hue kaha ke wo na Fahish (badzabaan) the na Mutafahish (jaan-boojh kar badzabaani karne wale). Abdullah bin Amr ne aage kaha, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Tum mein sabse behtar wo hain jinke akhlaaq aur charitra sabse behtar hain.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Mulaika:`Aisha said that the Jews came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "As-Samu 'Alaikum" (death be on you). `Aisha said (to them), "(Death) be on you, and may Allah curse you and shower His wrath upon you!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Be calm, O `Aisha ! You should be kind and lenient, and beware of harshness and Fuhsh (i.e. bad words)." She said (to the Prophet), "Haven't you heard what they (Jews) have said?" He said, "Haven't you heard what I have said (to them)? I said the same to them, and my invocation against them will be accepted while theirs against me will be rejected (by Allah)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Mulaika bataate hain: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha ke Yahudi Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha, 'As-Samu Alaikum' (tumpar maut ho). Aisha ne (unse) kaha, '(Maut) tumpar ho, aur Allah tumpar laanat kare aur apna gazab naazil kare!' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Shaant raho, Aye Aisha! Tumhein naram aur meherbaan rehna chaahiye, aur sakhti aur Fuhsh (buri baaton) se bacho.' Unhone (Nabi se) kaha, 'Kya aapne nahi suna unhone (Yahudiyon ne) kya kaha?' Unhone kaha, 'Kya tumne nahi suna maine (unhein) kya kaha? Maine unhein bhi wahi kaha, aur unke khilaaf meri dua qubool hogi jabke mere khilaaf unki dua rad ki jaayegi (Allah ke zariye).'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) was not one who would abuse (others) or say obscene words, or curse (others), and if he wanted to admonish anyone of us, he used to say: "What is wrong with him, his forehead be dusted
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) na to (logon ko) bura-bhala kehte the, na fahash baat karte the, na kisi par laanat bhejte the. Aur agar wo hum mein se kisi ko naseehat dena chaahte, to kehte, 'Isko kya hua hai, iski peshaani par mitti pade!'

e: Narrated 'Aisha: A man asked permission to enter upon the Prophet. When the Prophet (ﷺ) saw him, he said, "What an evil brother of his tribe! And what an evil son of his tribe!" When that man sat down, the Prophet (ﷺ) behaved with him in a nice and polite manner and was completely at ease with him. When that person had left, 'Aisha said (to the Prophet). "O Allah's Apostle! When you saw that man, you said so-and-so about him, then you showed him a kind and polite behavior, and you enjoyed his company?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O 'Aisha! Have you ever seen me speaking a bad and dirty language? (Remember that) the worst people in Allah's sight on the Day of Resurrection will be those whom the people leave (undisturbed) to be away from their evil (deeds)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ek shaks ne Nabi (SAW) ke paas aane ki ijaazat maangi. Jab Nabi (SAW) ne use dekha, unhone kaha, 'Kitna bura hai apni qaum ka bhai! Aur kitna bura hai apni qaum ka beta!' Jab wo shaks baith gaya, Nabi (SAW) ne unse bahut achhe aur adab se pesh aaye aur unke saath bilkul aaraam mehsoos kiya. Jab wo shaks chala gaya, Aisha ne (Nabi se) kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Jab aapne us shaks ko dekha, aapne uske baare mein aisa-aisa kaha, phir aap uske saath itni meherbaani aur adab se pesh aaye aur uski sohbat ka lutf uthaaya?' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Aye Aisha! Kya tumne mujhe kabhi buri aur ganda zubaan bolte dekha hai? Allah ke nazdeek Qayamat ke din sabse bure log wo honge jinhein log unki buraai se bachne ke liye chhod dete hain (yaani unse dosti nahi rakhte, unhein akela chhod dete hain).'

e: Narrated Anas: The Prophet (ﷺ) was the best among the people (both in shape and character) and was the most generous of them, and was the bravest of them. Once, during the night, the people of Medina got afraid (of a sound). So the people went towards that sound, but the Prophet (ﷺ) having gone to that sound before them, met them while he was saying, "Don't be afraid, don't be afraid." (At that time) he was riding a horse belonging to Abu Talha and it was naked without a saddle, and he was carrying a sword slung at his neck. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I found it (the horse) like a sea, or, it is the sea indeed
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) logon mein sabse behtar the (shakl aur charitra dono mein), aur sabse sakhi the, aur sabse zyaada bahaadur the. Ek baar, raat ko, Madina waale ek aawaaz se dar gaye. To log us aawaaz ki taraf gaye, magar Nabi (SAW) unse pehle wahaan pahunch chuke the aur unse milte hue kaha, 'Dar mat karo, dar mat karo.' (Us waqt) wo Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke ek ghode par bina zeen ke sawaar the, aur apni talwaar gale mein latkaaye hue the. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Maine ise (is ghode ko) samundar jaisa paaya, ya, ye sach mein samundar hai.'

e: Narrated Jabir:Never was the Prophet (ﷺ) asked for a thing to be given for which his answer was 'no
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) se kabhi koi cheez maangi nahi gayi jiske liye unhone 'nahi' kaha ho.

e: Narrated Masruq:We were sitting with `Abdullah bin `Amr who was narrating to us (Hadith): He said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was neither a Fahish nor a Mutafahhish, and he used to say, 'The best among you are the best in character (having good manners)
hi: Masruq bataate hain: Hum Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath baithe the jo humein riwaayat sunaa rahe the. Unhone kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) na Fahish the na Mutafahhish, aur wo kehte the, "Tum mein sabse behtar wo hain jinke akhlaaq sabse behtar hain (jinke suluk sabse achhe hain)."'

e: Narrated Abu Hazim:Sahl bin Sa`d said that a woman brought a Burda (sheet) to the Prophet. Sahl asked the people, "Do you know what is a Burda?" The people replied, "It is a 'Shamla', a sheet with a fringe." That woman said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have brought it so that you may wear it." So the Prophet (ﷺ) took it because he was in need of it and wore it. A man among his companions, seeing him wearing it, said, "O Allah's Apostle! Please give it to me to wear." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Yes." (and gave him that sheet). When the Prophet left, the man was blamed by his companions who said, "It was not nice on your part to ask the Prophet for it while you know that he took it because he was in need of it, and you also know that he (the Prophet) never turns down anybody's request that he might be asked for." That man said, "I just wanted to have its blessings as the Prophet (ﷺ) had put it on, so I hoped that I might be shrouded in it
hi: Abu Hazim bataate hain: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha ke ek khaatoon Nabi (SAW) ke paas ek Burda (chaadar) laayi. Sahl ne logon se pucha, 'Kya tumhein pata hai Burda kya hai?' Logon ne jawab diya, 'Ye ek "Shamla" hai, kinaare wali chaadar.' Us khaatoon ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Main ise laayi hoon taake aap ise pehnein.' To Nabi (SAW) ne ise liya kyunke unhein iski zaroorat thi aur ise pehna. Unke sahaaba mein se ek shaks, unhein ise pehne dekhkar, kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Barah-e-meharbaani mujhe ise pehnne ke liye dijiye.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Theek hai.' (aur use wo chaadar de di.) Jab Nabi (SAW) chale gaye, us shaks ko uske saathiyon ne malaamat ki aur kaha, 'Achha nahi kiya tumne Nabi (SAW) se ise maang kar, jabke tumhein pata hai ke unhone ise apni zaroorat ki wajah se liya tha, aur tumhein ye bhi pata hai ke wo (Nabi) kabhi kisi ki darkhwaast rad nahi karte.' Us shaks ne kaha, 'Maine sirf iski barkat chaahi thi kyunke Nabi (SAW) ne ise pehna tha, isliye mujhe ummeed thi ke shaayad mujhe isi mein kafan diya jaaye.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Time will pass rapidly, good deeds will decrease, and miserliness will be thrown (in the hearts of the people), and the Harj (will increase)." They asked, "What is the Harj?" He replied, "(It is) killing (murdering), (it is) murdering (killing)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Waqt jaldi guzrega, nek amaal kam ho jaayenge, aur kanjoosi (logon ke dilon mein) daal di jaayegi, aur Harj badh jaayega.' Logon ne pucha, 'Harj kya hai?' Unhone jawab diya, '(Ye) qatl (hatya) hai, qatl.'

e: Narrated Anas:I served the Prophet (ﷺ) for ten years, and he never said to me, "Uf" (a minor harsh word denoting impatience) and never blamed me by saying, "Why did you do so or why didn't you do so?
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ki das saal khidmat ki, aur unhone kabhi mujhse 'Uf' (halka sa bezaari ka lafz) nahi kaha, aur kabhi mujhe ye kehkar malaamat nahi ki, 'Tumne aisa kyun kiya' ya 'Tumne aisa kyun nahi kiya.'

e: Narrated Al-Aswad:I asked `Aisha what did the Prophet (ﷺ) use to do at home. She replied. "He used to keep himself busy serving his family and when it was time for the prayer, he would get up for prayer
hi: Al-Aswad bataate hain: Maine Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se pucha Nabi (SAW) ghar mein kya kiya karte the. Unhone jawab diya, 'Wo apne khaandaan ke kaamon mein masroof rehte, aur jab namaz ka waqt hota, to wo namaz ke liye uth jaate.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If Allah loves a person, He calls Gabriel saying: 'Allah loves so and so; O Gabriel, love him.' Gabriel would love him, and then Gabriel would make an announcement among the residents of the Heaven, 'Allah loves so-and-so, therefore, you should love him also.' So, all the residents of the Heavens would love him and then he is granted the pleasure of the people of the earth
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar Allah kisi shaks se mohabbat karta hai, to Jibrael ko bulaakar kehta hai, "Allah falaan se mohabbat karta hai; Aye Jibrael, tum bhi usse mohabbat karo." Jibrael bhi usse mohabbat karne lagte hain, phir Jibrael Aasman ke rehne walon mein elaan karte hain, "Allah falaan se mohabbat karta hai, isliye tum bhi usse mohabbat karo." To Aasmaanon ke sab rehne wale bhi usse mohabbat karne lagte hain, phir use zameen walon ki khushi (qubooliyat) bhi mil jaati hai.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "None will have the sweetness (delight) of Faith (a) till he loves a person and loves him only for Allah's sake, (b) and till it becomes dearer to him to be thrown in the fire than to revert to disbelief (Heathenism) after Allah has brought him out of it, (c) and till Allah and His Apostle become dearer to him than anything else
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Koi bhi Iman ki meethaas (khushi) mehsoos nahi karega jab tak (A) wo kisi se mohabbat kare aur sirf Allah ki khaatir kare, (B) aur jab tak use aag mein daala jaana kufr (bekhudai) ki taraf laut-ne se zyaada aziz na lage baad us se ke Allah ne use usse nikaal diya, (C) aur jab tak Allah aur uske Rasool use har cheez se zyaada aziz na lagein.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Zam`a:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade laughing at a person who passes wind, and said, "How does anyone of you beat his wife as he beats the stallion camel and then he may embrace (sleep with) her?" And Hisham said, "As he beats his slave
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Zam'a bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne kisi aise shaks par hansne se mana kiya jo hawaa (paad) chhode, aur kaha, 'Tum mein se koi apni biwi ko aise kaise maar sakta hai jaise wo ek nar oont ko maarta hai, aur phir use gale lagaaye (uske saath so jaaye)?' Aur Hisham ne kaha, 'Jaise wo apne ghulaam ko maarta hai.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said at Mina, "Do you know what day is today?" They (the people) replied, "Allah and His Apostle know better," He said "Today is 10th of Dhul-Hijja, the sacred (forbidden) day. Do you know what town is this town?" They (the people) replied, "Allah and His Apostle know better." He said, "This is the (forbidden) Sacred town (Mecca a sanctuary)." And do you know which month is this month?" They (the People) replied, "Allah and His Apostle know better." He said, ''This is the Sacred (forbidden) month ." He added, "Allah has made your blood, your properties and your honor Sacred to one another (i.e. Muslims) like the sanctity of this day of yours in this month of yours, in this town of yours." (See Hadith No. 797, Vol)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne Mina mein farmaya, 'Kya tumhein pata hai aaj kaunsa din hai?' Logon ne jawab diya, 'Allah aur uske Rasool behtar jaante hain.' Unhone kaha, 'Aaj Zul-Hijja ki dus tareek hai, ek muqaddas din. Kya tumhein pata hai ye kaunsa shehar hai?' Logon ne jawab diya, 'Allah aur uske Rasool behtar jaante hain.' Unhone kaha, 'Ye ek muqaddas shehar hai (Makkah, ek panaah-gah).' Aur kya tumhein pata hai ye kaunsa mahina hai?' Logon ne jawab diya, 'Allah aur uske Rasool behtar jaante hain.' Unhone kaha, 'Ye muqaddas mahina hai.' Unhone aage kaha, 'Allah ne tumhaara khoon, tumhaari jaayadaad, aur tumhaari izzat ek doosre ke liye utni hi muqaddas banaayi hai (yaani Musalmaanon ke liye) jitni is din ki tumhaare is mahine mein, tumhaare is shehar mein.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Abusing a Muslim is Fusuq (i.e., an evil-doing), and killing him is Kufr (disbelief)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kisi Musalmaan ko bura-bhala kehna Fusuq (buraai) hai, aur use qatl karna Kufr hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Dhar:That he heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "If somebody accuses another of Fusuq (by calling him 'Fasiq' i.e. a wicked person) or accuses him of Kufr, such an accusation will revert to him (i.e. the accuser) if his companion (the accused) is innocent
hi: Abu Dharr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke unhone Nabi (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Agar koi kisi doosre par Fusuq ka ilzaam lagaaye (usse "Fasiq" yaani badkaar kehkar) ya usse Kufr ka ilzaam lagaaye, to agar uska saathi (jispar ilzaam lagaaya gaya) bekasoor hai, to ye ilzaam ilzaam lagaane wale par hi laut aayega.'

e: Narrated Anas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was neither a Fahish (one who had a bad tongue) nor a Sabbaba (one who abuses others) and he used to say while admonishing somebody, "What is wrong with him? May dust be on his forehead
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) na Fahish the (badzabaan) na Sabbaba (doosron ko bura-bhala kehne wale), aur jab kisi ko naseehat dete, to kehte, 'Isko kya hua hai? Iski peshaani par mitti pade!'

e: Narrated Thabit bin Ad-Dahhak:(who was one of the companions who gave the pledge of allegiance to the Prophet (ﷺ) underneath the tree (Al-Hudaibiya)) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever swears by a religion other than Islam (i.e. if somebody swears by saying that he is a non-Muslim e.g., a Jew or a Christian, etc.) in case he is telling a lie, he is really so if his oath is false, and a person is not bound to fulfill a vow about a thing which he does not possess. And if somebody commits suicide with anything in this world, he will be tortured with that very thing on the Day of Resurrection; And if somebody curses a believer, then his sin will be as if he murdered him; And whoever accuses a believer of Kufr (disbelief), then it is as if he killed him
hi: Thabit bin Ad-Dahhak bataate hain (jo Hudaibiya ke daraKht ke neeche Nabi (SAW) se baiyat karne wale sahaaba mein se the): Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi Islam ke ilaawa kisi aur deen ki qasam khaaye (yaani agar koi kahe ke wo Yahudi ya Isaai hai waghera), agar wo jhoot bol raha hai, to wo waaqai wahi hai agar uski qasam jhoothi hai, aur koi is baat ka paaband nahi hai ke wo aisi kisi cheez ki nazar (mannat) poori kare jo uske paas nahi hai. Aur agar koi is duniya mein kisi cheez se khud ko qatl karta hai, to use Qayamat ke din usi cheez se azaab diya jaayega; aur agar koi kisi Momin par laanat bhejta hai, to uska gunaah aisa hoga jaise usne use qatl kiya ho; aur jo koi kisi Momin par Kufr ka ilzaam lagaaye, to ye aisa hai jaise usne use qatl kar diya.'

e: Narrated Sulaiman bin Surad:A man from the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Two men abused each other in front of the Prophet (ﷺ) and one of them became angry and his anger became so intense that his face became swollen and changed. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I know a word the saying of which will cause him to relax if he does say it." Then a man went to him and informed him of the statement of the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "Seek refuge with Allah from Satan." On that, angry man said, 'Do you find anything wrong with me? Am I insane? Go away
hi: Sulaiman bin Surad bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ke ek sahaabi ne kaha, 'Do aadmi Nabi (SAW) ke saamne ek doosre ko bura-bhala kehne lage, aur unmein se ek itna gussa ho gaya ke uska chehra soojh gaya aur badal gaya. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, "Main ek aisi baat jaanta hoon jise kehne se ye aadmi shaant ho jaayega agar wo ise kahe." Phir ek shaks uske paas gaya aur use Nabi (SAW) ka farmaan bataaya aur kaha, "Shaitaan se Allah ki panaah maango." Isper gusse waale aadmi ne kaha, "Kya tumhein mujhme koi khaami nazar aati hai? Kya main paagal hoon? Chale jaao."'

e: Narrated 'Ubada bin As-Samit:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went out to inform the people about the (date of the Night of decree (Al-Qadr). There happened a quarrel between two Muslim men. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I came out to inform you about the Night of Al-Qadr, but as so-and-so and so-and-so quarrelled, so the news about it had been taken away; and may be it was better for you. So look for it in the ninth, the seventh, or the fifth (of the last ten days of Ramadan)
hi: Ubada bin As-Samit bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) logon ko Shab-e-Qadr (Al-Qadr ki raat) ki taareekh batane baahar aaye. Do Musalmaan aadmiyon mein jhagda ho gaya. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Main tumhein Shab-e-Qadr ke baare mein bataane aaya tha, magar chunke falaan aur falaan ne jhagda kiya, isliye uski khabar utha li gayi; aur shaayad ye tumhare liye behtar ho. To ise Ramzan ke aakhri das dinon ke naveen, saatvi ya paanchvi raat mein dhoondho.'

e: Narrated Ma'rur:I saw Abu Dhar wearing a Burd (garment) and his slave too was wearing a Burd, so I said (to Abu Dhar), "If you take this (Burda of your slave) and wear it (along with yours), you will have a nice suit (costume) and you may give him another garment." Abu Dhar said, "There was a quarrel between me and another man whose mother was a non-Arab and I called her bad names. The man mentioned (complained about) me to the Prophet. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Did you abuse so-and-so?" I said, "Yes" He said, "Did you call his mother bad names?" I said, "Yes". He said, "You still have the traits of (the Pre-Islamic period of) ignorance." I said. "(Do I still have ignorance) even now in my old age?" He said, "Yes, they (slaves or servants) are your brothers, and Allah has put them under your command. So the one under whose hand Allah has put his brother, should feed him of what he eats, and give him dresses of what he wears, and should not ask him to do a thing beyond his capacity. And if at all he asks him to do a hard task, he should help him therein
hi: Ma'rur bataate hain: Maine Abu Dhar ko ek Burd (chogha) pehne dekha, aur unke ghulaam ko bhi ek Burd pehne dekha, isliye maine (Abu Dhar se) kaha, 'Agar aap ye (apne ghulaam ka Burda) le lein aur (apne saath) pehnein, to aapka ek achha suit ban jaayega, aur aap unhein koi doosra kapda de sakte hain.' Abu Dhar ne kaha, 'Mere aur ek doosre aadmi ke beech jhagda hua jiski maa ajami (gair-Arab) thi, aur maine unhein bura-bhala kaha. Us aadmi ne meri shikaayat Nabi (SAW) se ki. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, "Kya tumne falaan ko bura-bhala kaha?" Maine kaha, "Haan." Unhone kaha, "Kya tumne uski maa ko bura-bhala kaha?" Maine kaha, "Haan." Unhone kaha, "Tum mein abhi bhi (Jaahiliyat ke daur ki) jahaalat ke aasaar hain." Maine kaha, "(Kya mujhme ab bhi jahaalat hai) mera boodhapa hone ke bawajood?" Unhone kaha, "Haan, wo (ghulaam ya naukar) tumhaare bhai hain, aur Allah ne unhein tumhaare zeer-e-hukm rakha hai. Isliye jiske zeer-e-hukm Allah ne uske bhai ko rakha hai, use chaahiye ke wo use wahi khilaaye jo khud khaata hai, aur wahi pehnaaye jo khud pehanta hai, aur use uski taaqat se zyaada kaam na de. Aur agar wo use koi mushkil kaam de, to use us kaam mein uski madad karni chaahiye."'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) led us in the Zuhr prayer, offering only two rak`at and then (finished it) with Taslim, and went to a piece of wood in front of the mosque and put his hand over it. Abu Bakr and `Umar were also present among the people on that day but dared not talk to him (about his unfinished prayer). And the hasty people went away, wondering. "Has the prayer been shortened" Among the people there was a man whom the Prophet (ﷺ) used to call Dhul-Yadain (the longarmed). He said, "O Allah's Prophet! Have you forgotten or has the prayer been shortened?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Neither have I forgotten, nor has it been shortened." They (the people) said, "Surely, you have forgotten, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, Dhul-Yadain has told the truth." So the Prophet (ﷺ) got up and offered other two rak`at and finished his prayer with Taslim. Then he said Takbir, performed a prostration of ordinary duration or longer, then he raised his head and said Takbir and performed another prostration of ordinary duration or longer and then raised his head and said Takbir (i.e. he performed the two prostrations of Sahu, i.e., forgetfulness)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne humein Zuhr ki namaz padhaayi, sirf do rakat padhkar Taslim se khatam kar di, aur Masjid ke saamne ek lakdi ke tukde ki taraf gaye aur apna haath uspar rakha. Us din Abu Bakr aur Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bhi logon mein maujood the, magar unhone (unhein namaz adhoori chhodne ke baare mein) baat karne ki himmat nahi ki. Jaldbaaz log hairaan hokar chale gaye, sochte hue, 'Kya namaz chhoti kar di gayi?' Logon mein ek shaks tha jinhein Nabi (SAW) Dhul-Yadain (lambe haathon wale) kaha karte the. Unhone kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Nabi! Kya aap bhool gaye ya namaz chhoti kar di gayi?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Na main bhoola hoon, na namaz chhoti hui hai.' Logon ne kaha, 'Zaroor aap bhool gaye hain, Aye Allah ke Rasool!' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Dhul-Yadain ne sach kaha.' To Nabi (SAW) uthe aur baaki do rakat padhi aur Taslim se namaz khatam ki. Phir unhone Takbeer kahi, aam ya usse lambi sajda ki, phir apna sar uthaaya aur Takbeer kahi aur ek aur aam ya usse lambi sajda ki, phir apna sar uthaaya (yaani unhone Sahu ke do sajde kiye, bhool ki wajah se).

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) passed by two graves and said, "Both of them (persons in the grave) are being tortured, and they are not being tortured for a major sin. This one used not to save himself from being soiled with his urine, and the other used to go about with calumnies (among the people to rouse hostilities, e.g., one goes to a person and tells him that so-and-so says about him such-and-such evil things). The Prophet (ﷺ) then asked for a green leaf of a date-palm tree, split it into two pieces and planted one on each grave and said, "It is hoped that their punishment may be abated till those two pieces of the leaf get dried." (See Hadith No 215, Vol)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) do qabron ke paas se guzre aur farmaya, 'Dono (in qabron mein maujood log) azaab mein hain, aur unhein kisi bade gunaah ke liye azaab nahi diya jaa raha. Ye ek apne peshaab se khud ko bachaane ka khayaal nahi rakhta tha, aur doosra chugalkhori (Namima) karta phirta tha (logon ke beech dushmani badhaane ke liye).' Nabi (SAW) ne phir khajoor ke darakht ka ek hara patta maangaya, use do tukdon mein toda, aur ek-ek tukda har qabr par lagaaya, aur kaha, 'Ummeed hai ke unka azaab tab tak kam kiya jaayega jab tak wo do patton ke tukde sookh na jaayein.'

e: Narrated Abu Usaid As-Sa`idi:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The best family among the Ansar is the Banu An-Najjar
hi: Abu Usaid As-Sa'idi bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ansaar mein sabse behtar khaandaan Banu An-Najjar hai.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:A man asked permission to enter upon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Admit him. What an evil brother of his people or a son of his people." But when the man entered, the Prophet (ﷺ) spoke to him in a very polite manner. (And when that person left) I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! You had said what you had said, yet you spoke to him in a very polite manner?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O `Aisha! The worst people are those whom the people desert or leave in order to save themselves from their dirty language or from their transgression
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ek shaks ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aane ki ijaazat maangi. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Use andar aane do. Kitna bura hai apni qaum ka bhai ya apni qaum ka beta.' Magar jab wo shaks andar aaya, Nabi (SAW) ne unse bahut adab se baat ki. (Aur jab wo shaks chala gaya) maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Aapne jo kaha wo kaha, phir bhi aap unse itni adab se baat kar rahe the?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Aye Aisha! Sabse bure log wo hain jinhein log unki ganda zubaan ya unki zyaadti se bachne ke liye chhod dete hain ya tyaag dete hain.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) went through the grave-yards of Medina and heard the voices of two humans who were being tortured in their graves. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "They are being punished, but they are not being punished because of a major sin, yet their sins are great. One of them used not to save himself from (being soiled with) the urine, and the other used to go about with calumnies (Namima)."
