Then the Prophet asked for a green palm tree leaf and split it into two pieces and placed one piece on each grave, saying, "I hope that their punishment may be abated as long as these pieces of the leaf are not dried
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Nabi (SAW) Madina ke qabristanon se guzre aur unhone do logon ki aawazein suni jinhein unki qabron mein azaab diya jaa raha tha. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Unhein saza di jaa rahi hai, magar kisi bade gunaah ke liye nahi, phir bhi unke gunaah bade hain. Unmein se ek apne peshaab se khud ko bachaane ka khayaal nahi rakhta tha, aur doosra chugalkhori (Namima) karta phirta tha.' Phir Nabi (SAW) ne khajoor ke darakht ka ek hara patta maangaya, use do tukdon mein toda, aur ek-ek tukda har qabr par rakha, aur kaha, 'Ummeed hai ke unka azaab tab tak kam kiya jaayega jab tak ye patton ke tukde sookhe nahi hain.'

e: Narrated Hudhaifa:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "A Qattat will not enter Paradise
hi: Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Qattat (chugalkhor) Jannat mein daakhil nahi hoga.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever does not give up false statements (i.e. telling lies), and evil deeds, and speaking bad words to others, Allah is not in need of his (fasting) leaving his food and drink
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi jhooti baaton (yaani jhoot bolna), buri harkaton, aur doosron se buri baatein karna nahi chhodta, Allah ko uske khaana-peena chhodne (yaani roze) ki koi zaroorat nahi.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The worst people in the Sight of Allah on the Day of Resurrection will be the double faced people who appear to some people with one face and to other people with another face
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah ke nazdeek Qayamat ke din sabse bure log dohre-chehre wale honge, jo kuch logon ke saamne ek chehra dikhaate hain aur doosron ke saamne doosra.'

e: Narrated Ibn Mas`ud:Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) divided and distributed (the war booty). An Ansar man said, "By Allah ! Muhammad, by this distribution, did not intend to please Allah." So I came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and informed him about it whereupon his face became changed with anger and he said, "May Allah bestow His Mercy on Moses for he was hurt with more than this, yet he remained patient
hi: Ibn Masud bataate hain: Ek baar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne jang ka maal-e-ganimat baanta. Ek Ansaari shaks ne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam! Muhammad ne is taqseem se Allah ki khushi nahi chaahi.' To main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaya aur unhein ye baat bataayi, isper unka chehra gusse se badal gaya aur unhone kaha, 'Allah Musa par rehmat kare, kyunke unhein isse bhi zyaada takleef pahunchaayi gayi thi, phir bhi wo sabra karte rahe.'

e: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) heard a man praising another man and he was exaggerating in his praise. The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to him). "You have destroyed (or cut) the back of the man
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne ek aadmi ko doosre ki taarif karte suna, aur wo taarif mein had se guzar raha tha. Nabi (SAW) ne (usse) kaha, 'Tumne us aadmi ki peeth tod di (barbaad kar di).'

e: Narrated Abu Bakra:A man was mentioned before the Prophet (ﷺ) and another man praised him greatly The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "May Allah's Mercy be on you ! You have cut the neck of your friend." The Prophet (ﷺ) repeated this sentence many times and said, "If it is indispensable for anyone of you to praise someone, then he should say, 'I think that he is so-and-so," if he really thinks that he is such. Allah is the One Who will take his accounts (as He knows his reality) and no-one can sanctify anybody before Allah." (Khalid said, "Woe to you," instead of "Allah's Mercy be on you)
hi: Abu Bakra (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ke saamne ek shaks ka zikr hua aur ek doosre shaks ne uski bahut taarif ki. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Allah ki rehmat ho tumpar! Tumne apne dost ki gardan kaat di.' Nabi (SAW) ne ye baat kayi baar dohraayi aur kaha, 'Agar tum mein se kisi ke liye kisi ki taarif karna zaroori ho jaaye, to use kehna chaahiye, "Mera khayaal hai wo falaan-falaan hai," agar wo waaqai aisa sochta hai. Allah hi hisaab lega (kyunke wo uski asliyat jaanta hai), aur koi bhi Allah ke saamne kisi ko paak-saaf nahi keh sakta.' (Ravi Khalid ne 'Allah ki rehmat ho' ki jagah 'Tum par afsos' kaha.)

e: Narrated Salim:that his father said; "When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) mentioned what he mentioned about (the hanging of) the Izar (waist sheet), Abu Bakr said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! My Izar slackens on one side (without my intention)." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You are not among those (who, out of pride) drag their Izars behind them
hi: Salim bataate hain, unke waalid ke hawaale se: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Izaar (kamar ki chaadar) latakne ke baare mein jo kaha wo kaha, Abu Bakr ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mera Izaar ek taraf se apne aap dhila ho jaata hai (mere iraade ke bagair).' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Tum unmein se nahi ho (jo ghamand ki wajah se) apna Izaar zameen par ghaseette hain.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) continued for such-and-such period imagining that he has slept (had sexual relations) with his wives, and in fact he did not. One day he said, to me, "O `Aisha! Allah has instructed me regarding a matter about which I had asked Him. There came to me two men, one of them sat near my feet and the other near my head. The one near my feet, asked the one near my head (pointing at me), 'What is wrong with this man? The latter replied, 'He is under the effect of magic.' The first one asked, 'Who had worked magic on him?' The other replied, 'Lubaid bin Asam.' The first one asked, 'What material (did he use)?' The other replied, 'The skin of the pollen of a male date tree with a comb and the hair stuck to it, kept under a stone in the well of Dharwan."' Then the Prophet (ﷺ) went to that well and said, "This is the same well which was shown to me in the dream. The tops of its date-palm trees look like the heads of the devils, and its water looks like the Henna infusion." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered that those things be taken out. I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Won't you disclose (the magic object)?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah has cured me and I hate to circulate the evil among the people." `Aisha added, "(The magician) Lubaid bin Asam was a man from Bani Zuraiq, an ally of the Jews
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ek muddat tak ye samajhte rahe ke unhone apni biwiyon ke saath humbistari ki hai, jabke unhone waaqai nahi ki thi. Ek din unhone mujhse kaha, 'Aye Aisha! Allah ne mujhe us maamle ke baare mein bataya hai jo maine unse pucha tha. Do aadmi mere paas aaye, ek mere pairon ke paas baitha aur doosra mere sar ke paas. Pairon ke paas waale ne sar ke paas waale se pucha (mera ishara karte hue), "Is aadmi ko kya hua hai?" Doosre ne jawab diya, "Ye jaadu ke asar mein hai." Pehle ne pucha, "Isper jaadu kisne kiya?" Doosre ne jawab diya, "Labid bin Asam." Pehle ne pucha, "Kis cheez se?" Doosre ne jawab diya, "Khajoor ke nar darakht ke phool ki chhaal, ek kangha aur usmein phanse baal, Dharwan ke kuen mein ek patthar ke neeche."' Phir Nabi (SAW) us kuen par gaye aur kaha, 'Yahi wo kuan hai jo mujhe khwaab mein dikhaaya gaya tha. Iske khajoor ke darakhton ke sar Shaitaanon ke saron jaise dikhte hain, aur iska paani Heena ke ghol jaisa dikhta hai.' Phir Nabi (SAW) ne hukm diya ke wo cheezein nikaali jaayein. Maine pucha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya aap ise (jaadu ki cheez) zaahir nahi karenge?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Allah ne mujhe shifa di hai aur mujhe logon mein buraai failaana pasand nahi.' Aisha ne aage kaha, '(Jaadugar) Labid bin Asam Banu Zuraiq ka ek aadmi tha, Yahudiyon ka saathi.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Beware of suspicion, for suspicion is the worst of false tales; and do not look for the others' faults and do not spy, and do not be jealous of one another, and do not desert (cut your relation with) one another, and do not hate one another; and O Allah's worshipers! Be brothers (as Allah has ordered you)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Shak se bacho, kyunke shak sabse jhoothi baat hai; aur doosron ki khaamiyaan mat dhoondo, aur jaasoosi mat karo, aur ek doosre se hasad mat karo, aur ek doosre ko tyaag mat karo (rishta mat todo), aur ek doosre se nafrat mat karo; aur Aye Allah ke bandon! Bhai-bhai bano (jaisa Allah ne tumhein hukm diya hai).'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Do not hate one another, and do not be jealous of one another, and do not desert each other, and O, Allah's worshipers! Be brothers. Lo! It is not permissible for any Muslim to desert (not talk to) his brother (Muslim) for more than three days
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ek doosre se nafrat mat karo, aur ek doosre se hasad mat karo, aur ek doosre ko chhodo mat; aur Aye Allah ke bandon! Bhai-bhai bano. Suno! Kisi Musalmaan ke liye jaayez nahi ke wo apne Musalmaan bhai se teen din se zyaada baat na kare (tark kare).'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Beware of suspicion, for suspicion is the worst of false tales. and do not look for the others' faults, and do not do spying on one another, and do not practice Najsh, and do not be jealous of one another and do not hate one another, and do not desert (stop talking to) one another. And O, Allah's worshipers! Be brothers
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Shak se bacho, kyunke shak sabse jhoothi baat hai; aur doosron ki khaamiyaan mat dhoondo, aur ek doosre ki jaasoosi mat karo, aur Najsh mat karo (jhooti boli lagakar keemat badhaana), aur ek doosre se hasad mat karo, aur ek doosre se nafrat mat karo, aur ek doosre ko chhodo mat. Aur Aye Allah ke bandon! Bhai-bhai bano.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I do not think that so-and-so and so-and-so know anything of our religion." (And Al-Laith said, "These two persons were among the hypocrites)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Mujhe nahi lagta falaan aur falaan hamare deen ke baare mein kuch bhi jaante hain.' (Aur Al-Laith ne kaha, 'Ye dono log munaafiqon mein se the.')

e: Narrated Al-Laith:`Aisha said "The Prophet (ﷺ) entered upon me one day and said, 'O `Aisha! I do not think that so-and-so and so-and-so know anything of our religion which we follow
hi: Al-Laith bataate hain: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha, 'Nabi (SAW) ek din mere paas aaye aur kaha, "Aye Aisha! Mujhe nahi lagta falaan aur falaan hamare us deen ke baare mein kuch bhi jaante hain jiski hum pairvi karte hain."'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying. "All the sins of my followers will be forgiven except those of the Mujahirin (those who commit a sin openly or disclose their sins to the people). An example of such disclosure is that a person commits a sin at night and though Allah screens it from the public, then he comes in the morning, and says, 'O so-and-so, I did such-and-such (evil) deed yesterday,' though he spent his night screened by his Lord (none knowing about his sin) and in the morning he removes Allah's screen from himself
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Mere maanne walon ke sab gunaah maaf kar diye jaayenge siwaaye un logon ke jo Mujahirin hain (yaani jo apne gunaah khule aam karte hain ya logon ko apne gunaah bataate hain). Aisi khul-kar bataane ki ek misaal ye hai ke koi shaks raat ko gunaah karta hai aur Allah use logon se chupaata hai, phir subah wo kehta hai, "Aye falaan, maine kal aisa-aisa (bura) kaam kiya," jabke usne raat Apne Rab ke parde mein guzaari (koi uske gunaah ke baare mein nahi jaanta tha), aur subah wo Allah ka parda khud se hataa deta hai.'

e: Narrated Safwan bin Muhriz:A man asked Ibn `Umar, "What did you hear Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying regarding An-Najwa (secret talk between Allah and His believing worshipper on the Day of Judgment)?" He said, "(The Prophet (ﷺ) said), "One of you will come close to his Lord till He will shelter him in His screen and say: Did you commit such-and-such sin? He will say, 'Yes.' Then Allah will say: Did you commit such and such sin? He will say, 'Yes.' So Allah will make him confess (all his sins) and He will say, 'I screened them (your sins) for you in the world, and today I forgive them for you
hi: Safwan bin Muhriz bataate hain: Ek shaks ne Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha, 'Aapne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko An-Najwa (Allah aur uske Momin bande ke beech Qayamat ke din ka khufia bataayat) ke baare mein kya kehte suna?' Unhone kaha, '(Nabi SAW ne kaha,) "Tum mein se koi apne Rab ke itna qareeb aayega ke Wo use apne parde mein le lega aur kahega: Kya tumne falaan-falaan gunaah kiya tha? Wo kahega, ‘Haan.’ Phir Allah kahega: Kya tumne falaan-falaan gunaah kiya tha? Wo kahega, ‘Haan.’ To Allah use (sab gunaahon ka) iqraar karwaayega aur kahega, ‘Maine unhein duniya mein tumhaare liye chhupaaya tha, aur aaj main unhein tumhaare liye maaf karta hoon.’"'

e: Narrated Haritha bin Wahb: Al-Khuzai: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Shall I inform you about the people of Paradise? They comprise every obscure unimportant humble person, and if he takes Allah's Oath that he will do that thing, Allah will fulfill his oath (by doing that). Shall I inform you about the people of the Fire? They comprise every cruel, violent, proud and conceited person
hi: Haritha bin Wahb Al-Khuzai bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kya main tumhein Jannat waalon ke baare mein na bataun? Wo har us gumnaam, kam-ahmiyat, aajiz (halke) shaks ko shaamil karte hain, aur agar wo Allah ki qasam khaaye ke wo ye kaam karega, to Allah uski qasam poori karega (wo kaam karvaakar). Kya main tumhein Jahannam waalon ke baare mein na bataun? Wo har us zaalim, hinsak, ghamandi, aur mutakabbir (khud-pasand) shaks ko shaamil karte hain.'

e: Anas bin Malik said, "Any of the female slaves of Medina could take hold of the hand of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and take him wherever she wished
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Madina ki koi bhi launDi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka haath pakadkar unhein jahaan chaahe le ja sakti thi.'
(Is hadees ka asal matn maujood nahi hai — source data mein khaali chhoda gaya hai.)

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Do not hate one another, nor be jealous of one another; and do not desert one another, but O Allah's worshipers! Be Brothers! And it is unlawful for a Muslim to desert his brother Muslim (and not to talk to him) for more than three nights
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ek doosre se nafrat mat karo, na ek doosre se hasad karo; aur ek doosre ko tyaag mat karo, balke Aye Allah ke bandon! Bhai-bhai bano! Aur kisi Musalmaan ke liye jaayez nahi ke wo apne Musalmaan bhai se teen raaton se zyaada tark kare (baat na kare).'

e: Narrated Abu Aiyub Al-Ansari:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "It is not lawful for a man to desert his brother Muslim for more than three nights. (It is unlawful for them that) when they meet, one of them turns his face away from the other, and the other turns his face from the former, and the better of the two will be the one who greets the other first
hi: Abu Aiyub Al-Ansari (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kisi aadmi ke liye jaayez nahi ke wo apne Musalmaan bhai se teen raaton se zyaada tark kare (rishta tode). (Ye jaayez nahi ke) jab wo milte hain, ek doosre se apna chehra pher le, aur doosra bhi apna chehra pher le, aur unmein se behtar wo hoga jo pehle salaam kare.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, " I know whether you are angry or pleased." I said, "How do you know that, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" He said, "When you are pleased, you say, "Yes, by the Lord of Muhammad,' but when you are angry, you say, 'No, by the Lord of Abraham!' " I said, "Yes, I do not leave, except your name
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Mujhe pata chal jaata hai jab tum gussa ho ya khush ho.' Maine kaha, 'Aapko kaise pata chalta hai, Aye Allah ke Rasool?' Unhone kaha, 'Jab tum khush hoti ho, to kehti ho, "Haan, Muhammad ke Rab ki qasam." Magar jab tum gussa hoti ho, to kehti ho, "Nahi, Ibrahim ke Rab ki qasam!"' Maine kaha, 'Haan, main sirf aapka naam chhodti hoon (baaki sab wahi rehta hai).'

e: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) "I do not remember my parents believing in any religion other than the Religion (of Islam), and our being visited by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the morning and in the evening. One day, while we were sitting in the house of Abu Bakr (my father) at noon, someone said, 'This is Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) coming at an hour at which he never used to visit us.' Abu Bakr said, 'There must be something very urgent that has brought him at this hour.' The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'I have been allowed to go out (of Mecca) to migrate
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki zawja) bataati hain: 'Mujhe yaad nahi ke mere maa-baap Islam ke ilaawa kisi aur deen ko maante the, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) subah-shaam hamare paas aate the. Ek din, jab hum dophar ko Abu Bakr (mere waalid) ke ghar baithe the, kisi ne kaha, "Ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aa rahe hain, us waqt jab wo kabhi hamare paas nahi aate the." Abu Bakr ne kaha, "Zaroor koi bahut zaroori baat hai jo unhein is waqt yahaan laayi hai." Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, "Mujhe (Makkah se) hijrat karne ki ijaazat mil gayi hai."'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) visited a household among the Ansars, and he took a meal with them. When he intended to leave, he asked for a place in that house for him, to pray so a mat sprinkled with water was put and he offered prayer over it, and invoked for Allah's Blessing upon them (his hosts)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Ansaaron ke ek ghar gaye aur unke saath khaana khaaya. Jab wo jaana chahte the, unhone us ghar mein namaz padhne ki jagah maangi, isliye paani chhidki hui ek chataayi bichhaayi gayi aur unhone uspar namaz padhi, aur apne mezbaanon ke liye Allah se barkat ki dua ki.

e: Narrated `Abdullah:`Umar saw a silken cloak over a man (for sale) so he took it to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, 'O Allah's Apostle! Buy this and wear it when the delegate come to you.' He said, 'The silk is worn by one who will have no share (in the Here-after).' Some time passed after this event, and then the Prophet (ﷺ) sent a (similar) cloak to him. `Umar brought that cloak back to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, 'You have sent this to me, and you said about a similar one what you said?' The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'I have sent it to you so that you may get money by selling it.' Because of this, Ibn `Umar used to hate the silken markings on the garments
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne ek shaks ke paas resham ka ek chogha (bikaau) dekha, to wo use Nabi (SAW) ke paas le gaye aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Ise khareed lijiye aur jab aapke paas wafd (delegation) aaye tab pehniye.' Unhone kaha, 'Resham wahi pehanta hai jiska Aakhirat mein koi hissa nahi.' Kuch waqt guzarne ke baad, Nabi (SAW) ne unhein (Umar ko) ek (aisa hi) chogha bheja. Umar wo chogha wapas Nabi (SAW) ke paas le aaye aur kaha, 'Aapne ye mujhe bheja, jabke aapne isi jaisi cheez ke baare mein jo kaha wo kaha?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Maine ye tumhein isliye bheja hai taake tum ise bechkar paise kama sako.' Isi wajah se, Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) resham ke nishaanaat waale kapdon ko napasand karte the.

e: Narrated Anas:When `Abdur-Rahman came to us, the Prophet (ﷺ) established a bond of brotherhood between him and Sa`d bin Ar-Rabi`. Once the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "As you (O `Abdur-Rahman) have married, give a wedding banquet even if with one sheep
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Abdur Rahman hamare paas aaye, Nabi (SAW) ne unke aur Sa'd bin Ar-Rabi' ke beech bhaichaare ka rishta qaayam kiya. Ek baar Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Chunke tumne (Aye Abdur Rahman) nikaah kar liya hai, shaadi ka Walima do, chaahe ek bakri ke saath hi kyun na ho.'

e: Narrated `Asim:I said to Anas bin Malik, "Did it reach you that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There is no treaty of brotherhood in Islam'?" Anas said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) made a treaty (of brotherhood) between the Ansar and the Quraish in my home
hi: Aasim bataate hain: Maine Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kaha, 'Kya aapko ye baat pahunchi hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, "Islam mein bhaichaare ka koi mua'hida nahi hai"?' Anas ne kaha, 'Nabi (SAW) ne Ansaar aur Quraish ke beech (bhaichaare ka) mua'hida mere ghar mein kiya tha.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:Rifa`a Al-Qurazi divorced his wife irrevocably (i.e. that divorce was the final). Later on `Abdur- Rahman bin Az-Zubair married her after him. She came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I was Rifa`a's wife and he divorced me thrice, and then I was married to `Abdur-Rahman bin Az-Zubair, who, by Allah has nothing with him except something like this fringe, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)," showing a fringe she had taken from her covering sheet. Abu Bakr was sitting with the Prophet (ﷺ) while Khalid Ibn Sa`id bin Al-As was sitting at the gate of the room waiting for admission. Khalid started calling Abu Bakr, "O Abu Bakr! Why don't you reprove this lady from what she is openly saying before Allah's Apostle?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did nothing except smiling, and then said (to the lady), "Perhaps you want to go back to Rifa`a? No, (it is not possible), unless and until you enjoy the sexual relation with him (`Abdur Rahman), and he enjoys the sexual relation with you
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Rifa'a Al-Qurazi ne apni biwi ko qatai talaaq de di. Baad mein Abdur Rahman bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne unse nikaah kiya. Wo Nabi (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Main Rifa'a ki biwi thi aur unhone mujhe teen baar talaaq de di, phir mera nikaah Abdur Rahman bin Az-Zubair se hua, jinke paas, Allah ki qasam, is dupatte ke kinaare jaisi cheez ke siwa kuch nahi hai, Aye Allah ke Rasool,' apne kapde ka kinaara dikhaate hue. Abu Bakr Nabi (SAW) ke saath baithe the jabke Khalid bin Saeed bin Al-As kamre ke darwaaze par baithe andar aane ki ijaazat ka intezaar kar rahe the. Khalid ne Abu Bakr ko awaaz deni shuru ki, 'Aye Abu Bakr! Aap is khaatoon ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saamne khule aam ye baatein kehne se kyun nahi rokte?' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne bas muskuraaya, aur phir (khaatoon se) kaha, 'Shaayad tum Rifa'a ke paas wapas jaana chahti ho? Nahi, (ye mumkin nahi) jab tak tum (Abdur Rahman ke saath) apni shaadi poori na kar lo, aur wo bhi tumhaare saath apni shaadi poori na kar le.'

e: Narrated Sa`d:`Umar bin Al-Khattab asked permission of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to see him while some Quraishi women were sitting with him and they were asking him to give them more financial support while raising their voices over the voice of the Prophet. When `Umar asked permission to enter, all of them hurried to screen themselves the Prophet (ﷺ) admitted `Umar and he entered, while the Prophet (ﷺ) was smiling. `Umar said, "May Allah always keep you smiling, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Let my father and mother be sacrificed for you !" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I am astonished at these women who were with me. As soon as they heard your voice, they hastened to screen themselves." `Umar said, "You have more right, that they should be afraid of you, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" And then he (`Umar) turned towards them and said, "O enemies of your souls! You are afraid of me and not of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" The women replied, "Yes, for you are sterner and harsher than Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O Ibn Al-Khattab! By Him in Whose Hands my life is, whenever Satan sees you taking a way, he follows a way other than yours
hi: Sa'd bataate hain: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se milne ki ijaazat maangi jabke kuch Quraishi khawaateen unke saath baithi thin aur unse zyaada maali madad maangte hue apni aawaazein Nabi (SAW) ki aawaaz se bhi oonchi kar rahi thin. Jab Umar ne andar aane ki ijaazat maangi, sab khawaateen jaldi se parda karne lagi. Nabi (SAW) ne Umar ko andar aane diya, aur wo daakhil hue jabke Nabi (SAW) muskuraa rahe the. Umar ne kaha, 'Allah aapko hamesha muskuraata rakhe, Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mere maa-baap aap par qurbaan hon!' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Mujhe in khawaateen par hairaani hai jo mere paas thin. Jaise hi unhone tumhaari aawaaz suni, wo jaldi se parda karne lagi.' Umar ne kaha, 'Aapka haq zyaada hai ke wo aapse darein, Aye Allah ke Rasool!' Phir wo (Umar) unki taraf mudkar kaha, 'Aye apni jaanon ki dushman! Tum mujhse darti ho aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se nahi?' Khawaateen ne jawab diya, 'Haan, kyunke aap Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se zyaada sakht aur kadak hain.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Aye Ibn Al-Khattab! Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, jab bhi Shaitaan tumhein kisi raaste par jaate dekhta hai, wo tumhaare raaste ke siwa koi aur raasta apna leta hai.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:When Allah's Apostle was in Ta'if (trying to conquer it), he said to his companions, "Tomorrow we will return (to Medina), if Allah wills." Some of the companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "We will not leave till we conquer it." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Therefore, be ready to fight tomorrow." On the following day, they (Muslims) fought fiercely (with the people of Ta'if) and suffered many wounds. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Tomorrow we will return (to Medina), if Allah wills." His companions kept quiet this time. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then smiled
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Taif mein the (use fatah karne ki koshish mein), unhone apne sahaaba se kaha, 'Kal hum (Madina) wapas jaayenge, Insha-Allah.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke kuch sahaaba ne kaha, 'Hum tab tak nahi jaayenge jab tak hum ise fatah na kar lein.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'To kal ladne ke liye taiyaar raho.' Agle din, unhone (Musalmaanon ne) shiddat se jang ki (Taif waalon ke saath) aur bahut se zakhm khaaye. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Kal hum wapas jaayenge, Insha-Allah.' Iss baar unke sahaaba khaamosh rahe. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) phir muskuraaye.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "I have been ruined for I have had sexual relation with my wife in Ramadan (while I was fasting)" The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to him), "Manumit a slave." The man said, " I cannot afford that." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "(Then) fast for two successive months continuously". The man said, "I cannot do that." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "(Then) feed sixty poor persons." The man said, "I have nothing (to feed them with)." Then a big basket full of dates was brought to the Prophet. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Where is the questioner? Go and give this in charity." The man said, "(Shall I give this in charity) to a poorer person than l? By Allah, there is no family in between these two mountains (of Medina) who are poorer than we." The Prophet (ﷺ) then smiled till his premolar teeth became visible, and said, "Then (feed) your (family with it)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Main tabaah ho gaya, kyunke maine Ramzan mein (roze ki haalat mein) apni biwi ke saath humbistari kar li.' Nabi (SAW) ne (usse) kaha, 'Ek ghulaam azaad karo.' Us shaks ne kaha, 'Mujhme itni hasiyat nahi.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, '(To) do maheene lagataar roza rakho.' Usne kaha, 'Main nahi kar sakta.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, '(To) saath gareebon ko khaana khilaao.' Usne kaha, 'Mere paas (khilaane ko) kuch nahi hai.' Phir Nabi (SAW) ke paas khajoor se bhari ek badi tokri laayi gayi. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Sawaal karne wala kahaan hai? Jaao aur ise sadqe mein de do.' Us shaks ne kaha, '(Kya main ise) humse bhi gareeb kisi ko doon? Allah ki qasam, Madina ki in do pahaadiyon ke beech koi khaandaan hamse zyaada gareeb nahi hai.' Nabi (SAW) itne muskuraaye ke unke damle wale daant zaahir ho gaye, aur kaha, '(To) ise apne (khaandaan ke) liye rakh lo.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:While I was going along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who was wearing a Najrani Burd (sheet) with a thick border, a bedouin overtook the Prophet (ﷺ) and pulled his Rida' (sheet) forcibly. I looked at the side of the shoulder of the Prophet (ﷺ) and noticed that the edge of the Rida' had left a mark on it because of the violence of his pull. The bedouin said, "O Muhammad! Order for me some of Allah's property which you have." The Prophet (ﷺ) turned towards him, (smiled) and ordered that he be given something
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath chal raha tha, jo mote kinaare wale Najrani Burd (chaadar) pehne hue the, ek badawi unse aage nikal gaya aur unki Rida (chaadar) zor se khaincha. Maine Nabi (SAW) ke kandhe ki taraf dekha aur waha Rida ke kinaare ka nishaan paaya, unke zordaar khainchne ki wajah se. Badawi ne kaha, 'Aye Muhammad! Mujhe Allah ke maal mein se kuch do jo tumhaare paas hai.' Nabi (SAW) unki taraf mude, (muskuraaye) aur hukm diya ke use kuch diya jaaye.

e: Narrated Jarir:The Prophet (ﷺ) did not screen himself from me (had never prevented me from entering upon him) since I embraced Islam, and whenever he saw me, he would receive me with a smile. Once I told him that I could not sit firm on horses. He stroked me on the chest with his hand, and said, "O Allah! Make him firm and make him a guiding and a rightly guided man
hi: Jarir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne kabhi mujhse parda nahi kiya (mujhe unke paas aane se kabhi nahi roka) jab se maine Islam qubool kiya, aur jab bhi wo mujhe dekhte, muskuraakar mera istikbaal karte. Ek baar maine unhein bataya ke main ghodon par mazbooti se baith nahi paata. Unhone apna haath mere seene par phera aur kaha, 'Aye Allah! Ise mazboot bana, aur ise raah dikhaane wala aur raah paane wala bana.'

e: Narrated Zainab bint Um Salama:Um Sulaim said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Verily Allah is not shy of (telling you) the truth. Is it essential for a woman to take a bath after she had a wet dream (nocturnal sexual discharge)?" He said, "Yes, if she notices discharge. On that Um Salama laughed and said, "Does a woman get a (nocturnal sexual) discharge?" He said, "How then does (her) son resemble her (his mother)?
hi: Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Umm Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Umm Sulaim (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Allah sach batane mein sharmaata nahi. Kya aurat ko (raat mein khwaab mein humbistari ke) tar (discharge) hone ke baad gusl zaroori hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan, agar use tar mehsoos ho.' Isper Umm Salama hansi aur kaha, 'Kya aurat ko bhi (raat mein) discharge hota hai?' Unhone kaha, 'To phir uska bacha use kaise milta-julta hai?'

e: Narrated `Aisha:I never saw the Prophet (ﷺ) laughing to an extent that one could see his palate, but he always used to smile only
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine kabhi Nabi (SAW) ko itni zor se hasnte nahi dekha ke unka taalu dikhaayi de, wo hamesha bas muskuraate the.

e: Narrated Anas:A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) on a Friday while he (the Prophet) was delivering a sermon at Medina, and said, "There is lack of rain, so please invoke your Lord to bless us with the rain." The Prophet (ﷺ) looked at the sky when no cloud could be detected. Then he invoked Allah for rain. Clouds started gathering together and it rained till the Medina valleys started flowing with water. It continued raining till the next Friday. Then that man (or some other man) stood up while the Prophet (ﷺ) was delivering the Friday sermon, and said, "We are drowned; Please invoke your Lord to withhold it (rain) from us" The Prophet smiled and said twice or thrice, "O Allah! Please let it rain round about us and not upon us." The clouds started dispersing over Medina to the right and to the left, and it rained round about Medina and not upon Medina. Allah showed them (the people) the miracle of His Prophet and His response to his invocation
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks Jumme ke din Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya jabke wo Madina mein khutba de rahe the, aur kaha, 'Baarish nahi ho rahi, barah-e-meharbaani apne Rab se dua kijiye ke wo humpar baarish barsaaye.' Nabi (SAW) ne aasman ki taraf dekha jabke koi baadal nazar nahi aa raha tha. Phir unhone Allah se baarish ke liye dua ki. Baadal jama hone lage aur itni baarish hui ke Madina ki wadiyaan paani se behne lagi. Ye agle Jumme tak baarish hoti rahi. Phir wahi shaks (ya koi aur shaks) khada hua jabke Nabi (SAW) Jumme ka khutba de rahe the, aur kaha, 'Hum doob rahe hain; barah-e-meharbaani apne Rab se dua kijiye ke wo ise (baarish ko) hamse rok le.' Nabi (SAW) muskuraaye aur do ya teen baar kaha, 'Aye Allah! Baarish hamare aas-paas barsaa, hampar nahi.' Baadal Madina ke oopar se hatkar daayin aur baayin taraf failne lage, aur Madina ke aas-paas baarish hui, Madina par nahi. Allah ne logon ko apne Nabi ka mojiza aur unki dua ki qubooliyat dikhaayi.

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Truthfulness leads to righteousness, and righteousness leads to Paradise. And a man keeps on telling the truth until he becomes a truthful person. Falsehood leads to Al-Fajur (i.e. wickedness, evil-doing), and Al-Fajur (wickedness) leads to the (Hell) Fire, and a man may keep on telling lies till he is written before Allah, a liar
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Sachaai neki ki taraf le jaati hai, aur neki Jannat ki taraf le jaati hai. Aur insaan sach bolta rehta hai jab tak wo ek sachcha insaan na ban jaaye. Jhoot buraai (Al-Fajur) ki taraf le jaata hai, aur buraai (Jahannam ki) Aag ki taraf le jaati hai, aur insaan jhoot bolta rehta hai jab tak Allah ke yahaan use jhoota nahi likh diya jaata.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The signs of a hypocrite are three: Whenever he speaks, he tells a lie; and whenever he promises, he breaks his promise; and whenever he is entrusted, he betrays (proves to be dishonest)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Munaafiq ki nishaaniyaan teen hain: jab bhi bolta hai, jhoot bolta hai; jab bhi waada karta hai, waada todta hai; aur jab bhi usse kuch amaanat di jaati hai, wo khayaanat karta hai (bewafaai karta hai).'

e: Narrated Samura bin Jundub:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I saw (in a dream), two men came to me." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) narrated the story (saying), "They said, 'The person, the one whose cheek you saw being torn away (from the mouth to the ear) was a liar and used to tell lies and the people would report those lies on his authority till they spread all over the world. So he will be punished like that till the Day of Resurrection
hi: Samura bin Jundub (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Maine (khwaab mein) do aadmi mere paas aate dekhe.' Phir Nabi (SAW) ne kahaani sunaayi, (kehte hue), 'Unhone kaha, "Wo shaks jiska gaal (munh se kaan tak) phaadaa jaate dekha, wo jhoota tha aur jhoot bola karta tha, aur log uske jhoot ko aage badhaate the yahaan tak ke wo poori duniya mein phail gaye. Isliye use Qayamat tak isi tarah saza di jaayegi."'

e: Narrated Hudhaifa:From among the people, Ibn Um `Abd greatly resembled Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in solemn gate and good appearance of piety and in calmness and sobriety from the time he goes out of his house till he returns to it. But we do not know how he behaves with his family when he is alone with them
hi: Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Logon mein, Ibn Umm Abd, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se sabse zyaada milte-julte the apni waqaar wali chaal, achhi taqwe wali soorat, aur ghar se nikalne se lekar wapas aane tak apni shanti aur hikmat mein. Magar humein nahi pata wo apne khaandaan ke saath akele mein kaisa suluk karte hain.

e: Narrated Tariq:`Abdullah said, "The best talk is Allah's Book (Qur'an), and the best guidance is the guidance of Muhammad
hi: Tariq bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Sabse behtareen baat Allah ki Kitaab (Quran) hai, aur sabse behtareen raah-numaai Muhammad (SAW) ki raah-numaai hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said: None is more patient than Allah against the harmful saying. He hears from the people they ascribe children to Him, yet He gives them health and (supplies them with) provision
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Koi bhi Allah se zyaada sabra karne wala nahi hai takleef-dey baat sunne mein. Wo logon se sunta hai ke wo uski aulaad (jaise beta ya beti) hone ka dawa karte hain, phir bhi wo unhein sehat deta hai aur (unhein) rizq muhaiya karta hai.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) divided and distributed something as he used to do for some of his distributions. A man from the Ansar said, "By Allah, in this division the pleasure of Allah has not been intended." I said, "I will definitely tell this to the Prophet (ﷺ) ." So I went to him while he was sitting with his companions and told him of it secretly. That was hard upon the Prophet (ﷺ) and the color of his face changed, and he became so angry that I wished I had not told him. The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "Moses was harmed with more than this, yet he remained patient
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne kuch (maal-e-ganimat) baanta jaisa wo apni kuch taqseemon mein karte the. Ansaar mein se ek shaks ne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, is taqseem mein Allah ki khushi ka iraada nahi kiya gaya.' Maine kaha, 'Main zaroor ye baat Nabi (SAW) ko bataunga.' To main unke paas gaya jabke wo apne sahaaba ke saath baithe the, aur unhein chupke se ye baat bataayi. Ye Nabi (SAW) ke liye mushkil thi aur unke chehre ka rang badal gaya, aur wo itne gussa hue ke maine chaaha ke kaash maine unhein na bataaya hota. Nabi (SAW) ne phir kaha, 'Musa ko isse bhi zyaada takleef pahunchaayi gayi thi, phir bhi wo sabra karte rahe.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) did something and allowed his people to do it, but some people refrained from doing it. When the Prophet (ﷺ) learned of that, he delivered a sermon, and after having sent Praises to Allah, he said, "What is wrong with such people as refrain from doing a thing that I do? By Allah, I know Allah better than they, and I am more afraid of Him than they
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ne kuch kiya aur apne logon ko us kaam ki ijaazat di, magar kuch logon ne wo kaam karne se parhez kiya. Jab Nabi (SAW) ko iska pata chala, unhone khutba diya, aur Allah ki hamd ke baad kaha, 'Un logon ko kya hua hai jo wo kaam karne se parhez karte hain jo main karta hoon? Allah ki qasam, main unse zyaada Allah ko jaanta hoon, aur main unse zyaada usse darta hoon.'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) was more shy than a virgin in her separate room. And if he saw a thing which he disliked, we would recognize that (feeling) in his face
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) apne alag kamre mein rehne wali kunwaari ladki se bhi zyaada sharmeele the. Aur agar wo koi aisi cheez dekhte jo unhein napasand hoti, to hum unke chehre par wo bhaav pehchaan lete.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If a man says to his brother, O Kafir (disbeliever)!' Then surely one of them is such (i.e., a Kafir)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar koi aadmi apne bhai se kahe, "Aye kaafir!" to unmein se ek zaroor waisa hi hai.'

e: Narrated 'Abdullah bin 'Umar: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'If anyone says to his brother, 'O misbeliever! Then surely, one of them such
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar koi apne bhai se kahe, "Aye kaafir!" to unmein se ek zaroor waisa hi hai.'

e: Narrated Thabit bin Ad-Dahhak:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever swears by a religion other than Islam (i.e. if he swears by saying that he is a non-Muslim in case he is telling a lie), then he is as he says if his oath is false and whoever commits suicide with something, will be punished with the same thing in the (Hell) fire, and cursing a believer is like murdering him, and whoever accuses a believer of disbelief, then it is as if he had killed him
hi: Thabit bin Ad-Dahhak bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi Islam ke ilaawa kisi aur deen ki qasam khaaye (yaani agar wo kahe ke wo gair-Musalmaan hai jhoot bolne ki soorat mein), to wo waisa hi hai agar uski qasam jhoothi hai, aur jo koi kisi cheez se khud ko qatl kare, use Jahannam mein usi cheez se saza di jaayegi, aur kisi Momin par laanat bhejna aisa hai jaise use qatl kar diya ho, aur jo kisi Momin par Kufr ka ilzaam lagaaye, to ye aisa hai jaise usne use qatl kiya.'

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:Mu`adh bin Jabal used to pray with the Prophet (ﷺ) and then go to lead his people in prayer. Once he led the people in prayer and recited Surat-al-Baqara. A man left (the row of the praying people) and offered (light) prayer (separately) and went away. When Mu`adh came to know about it, he said. "He (that man) is a hypocrite." Later that man heard what Mu`adh said about him, so he came to the Prophet and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We are people who work with our own hands and irrigate (our farms) with our camels. Last night Mu`adh led us in the (night) prayer and he recited Sura-al-Baqara, so I offered my prayer separately, and because of that, he accused me of being a hypocrite." The Prophet called Mu`adh and said thrice, "O Mu`adh! You are putting the people to trials? Recite 'Washshamsi wad-uhaha' (91) or'Sabbih isma Rabbi ka-l-A'la' (87) or the like
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Mu'adh bin Jabal (رضی اللہ عنہ) Nabi (SAW) ke saath namaz padha karte the, phir apni qaum ko namaz padhaane jaate. Ek baar unhone logon ko namaz padhaayi aur Surah Al-Baqara padhi. Ek shaks (qataar se) nikal gaya aur (halki) namaz alag se padhi aur chala gaya. Jab Mu'adh ko iska pata chala, unhone kaha, 'Wo (shaks) munaafiq hai.' Baad mein us shaks ne suna ke Mu'adh ne uske baare mein kya kaha, isliye wo Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Hum aise log hain jo apne haathon se kaam karte hain aur apne oonton se (apni zameen) sinchate hain. Kal raat Mu'adh ne humein namaz padhaayi aur Surah Al-Baqara padhi, isliye maine apni namaz alag se padhi, aur isi wajah se unhone mujhpar munaafiq hone ka ilzaam lagaaya.' Nabi (SAW) ne Mu'adh ko bulaaya aur teen baar kaha, 'Aye Mu'adh! Kya tum logon ko aazmaish mein daal rahe ho? "Washshamsi Wa-Duhaha" (91) ya "Sabbih Isma Rabbika-l-Aala" (87) ya isi jaisi (chhoti) Surah padho.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: "Whoever amongst you swears, (saying by error) in his oath 'By Al-Lat and Al- Uzza', then he should say, 'None has the right to be worshipped but Allah.' And whoever says to his companions, 'Come let me gamble' with you, then he must give something in charity (as an expiation for such a sin)." (See Hadith No)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi tum mein se (galti se) apni qasam mein "Al-Lat aur Al-Uzza ki qasam" kahe, use "La ilaha illallah" (Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi) kehna chaahiye. Aur jo koi apne saathiyon se kahe, "Aao, main tumse jua khelun," use kuch sadqa dena chaahiye (is gunaah ke kaffare ke taur par).'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:that he found `Umar bin Al-Khattab in a group of people and he was swearing by his father. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) called them, saying, "Verily! Allah forbids you to swear by your fathers. If one has to take an oath, he should swear by Allah or otherwise keep quiet
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke unhone Umar bin Al-Khattab ko logon ke ek giroh mein apne baap ki qasam khaate hue paaya. To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhein bulwaakar kaha, 'Beshak, Allah tumhein apne baapon ki qasam khaane se mana karta hai. Agar kisi ko qasam khaani hi ho, to use Allah ki qasam khaani chaahiye, warna khaamosh rehna chaahiye.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) entered upon me while there was a curtain having pictures (of animals) in the house. His face got red with anger, and then he got hold of the curtain and tore it into pieces. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Such people as paint these pictures will receive the severest punishment on the Day of Resurrection
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) mere paas aaye jab ghar mein ek chaadar thi jispar (jaanwaron ki) tasveerein thin. Unka chehra gusse se laal ho gaya, phir unhone chaadar pakadi aur usse tukde-tukde phaad diya. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Aise log jo ye tasveerein banaate hain, unhein Qayamat ke din sabse sakht saza milegi.'

e: Narrated Abu Mas`ud:A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said "I keep away from the morning prayer only because such and such person prolongs the prayer when he leads us in it. The narrator added: I had never seen Allah's Apostle more furious in giving advice than he was on that day. He said, "O people! There are some among you who make others dislike good deeds) cause the others to have aversion (to congregational prayers). Beware! Whoever among you leads the people in prayer should not prolong it, because among them there are the sick, the old, and the needy." (See Hadith No. 670, Vol)
hi: Abu Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Main subah ki namaz mein nahi aata sirf isliye kyunke falaan shaks jab humein namaz padhaata hai to bahut lambi kar deta hai.' (Ravi ne aage kaha: Maine kabhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko naseehat dete waqt itna gussa nahi dekha jitna us din the.) Unhone kaha, 'Aye logo! Tum mein se kuch aise hain jo doosron ko (nek amaal se, yaani jamaat ki namaz se) nafrat karwaate hain. Khabardaar! Tum mein se jo koi logon ko namaz padhaaye, use use lambi nahi karni chaahiye, kyunke unmein bimaar, budhe aur zaroortmand log bhi hote hain.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:While the Prophet (ﷺ) was praying, he saw sputum (on the wall) of the mosque, in the direction of the Qibla, and so he scraped it off with his hand, and the sign of disgust (was apparent from his face) and then said, "Whenever anyone of you is in prayer, he should not spit in front of him (in prayer) because Allah is in front of him
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Nabi (SAW) namaz padh rahe the, unhone Masjid ki deewaar par, Qibla ki taraf, thook dekha, isliye unhone use apne haath se khurach diya, aur unke chehre par napasandidagi ke aasaar the, phir unhone kaha, 'Jab bhi tum mein se koi namaz mein ho, use apne saamne (namaz mein) nahi thookna chaahiye, kyunke Allah uske saamne hota hai.'

e: Narrated Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani:A man asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about "Al-Luqata" (a lost fallen purse or a thing picked up by somebody). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You should announce it publicly for one year, and then remember and recognize the tying material of its container, and then you can spend it. If its owner came to you, then you should pay him its equivalent." The man said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What about a lost sheep?" The Prophet said, "Take it because it is for you, for your brother, or for the wolf." The man again said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What about a lost camel?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) became very angry and furious and his cheeks became red (or his face became red), and he said, "You have nothing to do with it (the camel) for it has its food and its water container with it till it meets its owner
hi: Zaid bin Khalid (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Juhani (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se Al-Luqata (kho hua ya paaya hua maal) ke baare mein pucha. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Ek saal tak iska khule aam elaan karo, phir uske bandhan waali cheez yaad rakho aur pehchaano, aur phir use kharch kar sakte ho. Agar uska maalik tumhaare paas aaye, to use uski qeemat de do.' Us shaks ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kho hui bakri ka kya?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Ise le lo kyunke ye tumhaari hai, tumhaare bhai ki, ya bheda ki.' Us shaks ne phir pucha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kho hue oont ka kya?' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) bahut gussa ho gaye aur unke gaal laal ho gaye (ya unka chehra laal ho gaya), aur unhone kaha, 'Tumhaara isse (oont se) koi lena-dena nahi, kyunke uske paas apna khaana aur paani ka thaila hai jab tak wo apne maalik se na mile.'

e: Narrated Zaid bin Thabit:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) made a small room (with a palm leaf mat). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came out (of his house) and prayed in it. Some men came and joined him in his prayer. Then again the next night they came for the prayer, but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) delayed and did not come out to them. So they raised their voices and knocked the door with small stones (to draw his attention). He came out to them in a state of anger, saying, "You are still insisting (on your deed, i.e. Tarawih prayer in the mosque) that I thought that this prayer (Tarawih) might become obligatory on you. So you people, offer this prayer at your homes, for the best prayer of a person is the one which he offers at home, except the compulsory (congregational) prayer
hi: Zaid bin Thabit (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (khajoor ke patton ki chataayi se) ek chhota kamra banaaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) (apne ghar se) baahar aaye aur usmein namaz padhi. Kuch log aaye aur unke saath namaz mein shaamil hue. Phir agli raat wo dobara namaz ke liye aaye, magar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) der karte rahe aur unke paas baahar nahi aaye. To unhone apni aawazein oonchi ki aur chhote pattharon se darwaaza khatkhataaya (unka dhyaan kheenchne ke liye). Wo gusse ki haalat mein unke paas aaye aur kaha, 'Tum log ab bhi isper (yaani Masjid mein Tarawih ki namaz par) zid kar rahe ho, mujhe laga ke ye namaz tum par farz ho jaayegi. Isliye tum log ise apne gharon mein padho, kyunke kisi shaks ki sabse behtareen namaz wo hai jo wo apne ghar mein padhe, siwaaye farz (jamaat ki) namaz ke.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The strong is not the one who overcomes the people by his strength, but the strong is the one who controls himself while in anger
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Taaqatwar wo nahi jo apni taaqat se doosron par ghaalib aaye, balke taaqatwar wo hai jo gusse mein khud par kaboo rakhe.'

e: Narrated Sulaiman bin Sarad:Two men abused each other in front of the Prophet (ﷺ) while we were sitting with him. One of the two abused his companion furiously and his face became red. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I know a word (sentence) the saying of which will cause him to relax if this man says it. Only if he said, "I seek refuge with Allah from Satan, the outcast.' " So they said to that (furious) man, 'Don't you hear what the Prophet (ﷺ) is saying?" He said, "I am not mad
hi: Sulaiman bin Sarad bataate hain: Do aadmi Nabi (SAW) ke saamne, jabke hum unke saath baithe the, ek doosre ko bura-bhala kehne lage. Unmein se ek ne apne saathi ko itni shiddat se bura-bhala kaha ke uska chehra laal ho gaya. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Main ek aisi baat jaanta hoon jo agar ye shaks kahe to use shaant kar degi. Sirf agar wo kahe, "Main Shaitaan mardood se Allah ki panaah maangta hoon."' To unhone us (gusse waale) shaks se kaha, 'Kya tum nahi sunte Nabi (SAW) kya keh rahe hain?' Usne kaha, 'Main paagal nahi hoon.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:A man said to the Prophet (ﷺ) , "Advise me! "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not become angry and furious." The man asked (the same) again and again, and the Prophet (ﷺ) said in each case, "Do not become angry and furious
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks ne Nabi (SAW) se kaha, 'Mujhe naseehat kijiye!' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Gussa aur bhadakna mat.' Us shaks ne baar-baar wahi sawaal poocha, aur har baar Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Gussa aur bhadakna mat.'

e: Narrated Abu As-Sawar Al-Adawi:`Imran bin Husain said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Haya' (pious shyness from committing religeous indiscretions) does not bring anything except good." Thereupon Bashir bin Ka`b said, 'It is written in the wisdom paper: Haya' leads to solemnity; Haya' leads to tranquility (peace of mind)." `Imran said to him, "I am narrating to you the saying of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and you are speaking about your paper (wisdom book)?
hi: Abu As-Sawar Al-Adawi bataate hain: Imran bin Husain (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Haya (deeni sharm) sirf achhaai laati hai.' Isper Bashir bin Ka'b ne kaha, 'Hikmat ki kitaab mein likha hai: Haya waqar (izzat) laata hai; Haya sukoon (dil ki shanti) laata hai.' Imran ne unse kaha, 'Main tumhein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka farmaan sunaa raha hoon aur tum apni kitaab ki baat kar rahe ho?'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) passed by a man who was admonishing his brother regarding Haya' (pious shyness from committing religeous indiscretions) and was saying, "You are very shy, and I am afraid that might harm you." On that, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Leave him, for Haya' is (a part) of Faith
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ek shaks ke paas se guzre jo apne bhai ko Haya (sharm) ke baare mein naseehat de rahe the aur kaha rahe the, 'Tum bahut sharmeele ho, aur mujhe dar hai ke ye tumhein nuqsaan pahunchaa sakti hai.' Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Use chhod do, kyunke Haya Iman ka (ek hissa) hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id:The Prophet (ﷺ) was more shy (from Haya': pious shyness from committing religeous indiscretions) than a veiled virgin girl. (See Hadith No. 762, Vol)
hi: Abu Saeed bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) parde mein rehne wali kunwaari ladki se bhi zyaada sharmeele the.

e: Narrated Abu Mas`ud:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'One of the sayings of the early Prophets which the people have got is: If you don't feel ashamed (from Haya': pious shyness from committing religeous indiscretions) do whatever you like." (See Hadith No 690, 691, Vol)
hi: Abu Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Pehle Nabiyon ki baaton mein se ek jo logon tak pahunchi hai: Agar tumhein sharm nahi aati, to jo dil chaahe karo.'

e: Narrated Um Salama:Um Sulaim came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Verily, Allah does not feel shy to tell the truth. If a woman gets a nocturnal sexual discharge (has a wet dream), is it essential for her to take a bath? He replied, "Yes if she notices a discharge
hi: Umm Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Umm Sulaim (رضی اللہ عنہا) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Beshak, Allah sach batane mein sharmaata nahi. Agar aurat ko (raat mein) discharge ho, to kya use gusl zaroori hai?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Haan, agar use tar mehsoos ho.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The example of a believer is like a green tree, the leaves of which do not fall." The people said. "It is such-and-such tree: It is such-and-such tree." I intended to say that it was the datepalm tree, but I was a young boy and felt shy (to answer). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It is the date-palm tree." Ibn `Umar added, " I told that to `Umar who said, 'Had you said it, I would have preferred it to such-and such a thing
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Momin ki misaal ek hare darakht jaisi hai, jiske patte nahi jhadte.' Logon ne kaha, 'Ye falaan darakht hai; ye falaan darakht hai.' Main kehna chahta tha ke ye khajoor ka darakht hai, magar main ek chhota ladka tha aur sharmaaya (jawab dene se). Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Ye khajoor ka darakht hai.' Ibn Umar ne aage kaha, 'Maine ye baat Umar ko bataayi, unhone kaha, "Agar tum ye kehte, to mujhe wo falaan-falaan cheez se zyaada pasand aata."'

e: Narrated Thabit:that he heard Anas saying, "A woman came to the Prophet (ﷺ) offering herself to him in marriage, saying, "Have you got any interest in me (i.e. would you like to marry me?)" Anas's daughter said, "How shameless that woman was!" On that Anas said, "She is better than you, for she presented herself to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (for marriage)
hi: Thabit bataate hain ke unhone Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko ye kehte suna: 'Ek khaatoon Nabi (SAW) ke paas aayi aur khud ko nikaah ke liye pesh kiya, kaha, "Kya aap mujhme koi dilchaspi rakhte hain (yaani kya aap mujhse nikaah karenge)?" Anas ki beti ne kaha, "Wo khaatoon kitni be-sharam thi!" Isper Anas ne kaha, "Wo tumse behtar hai, kyunke usne khud ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saamne (nikaah ke liye) pesh kiya."'

e: Narrated Abu Musa:that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent him and Mu`adh bin Jabal to Yemen, he said to them, "Facilitate things for the people (treat the people in the most agreeable way), and do not make things difficult for them, and give them glad tidings, and let them not have aversion (i.e. to make the people hate good deeds) and you should both work in cooperation and mutual understanding, obey each other." Abu Musa said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We are in a land in which a drink named Al Bit' is prepared from honey, and another drink named Al-Mizr is prepared from barley." On that, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "All intoxicants (i.e. all alcoholic drinks) are prohibited
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhein aur Mu'adh bin Jabal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko Yemen bheja, unhone unse kaha, 'Logon ke liye cheezein aasaan karo, mushkil mat banaao, unhein khushkhabri do, unhein nafrat mat karwaao (nek amaal se), aur tum dono milkar kaam karo, ek doosre ki baat maano.' Abu Musa ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Hum aise ilaake mein hain jahaan shehad se Al-Bit'a naami ek sharbat, aur jau se Al-Mizr naami ek doosra sharbat banaaya jaata hai.' Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Har nasha-aawar cheez (yaani sab qism ki sharaab) haraam hai.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Make things easy for the people, and do not make it difficult for them, and make them calm (with glad tidings) and do not repulse (them)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Logon ke liye cheezein aasaan karo, unhein mushkil mat banaao, unhein shaant karo (khush-khabri se) aur unhein bhagaao mat.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was given the choice of one of two matters he would choose the easier of the two as long as it was not sinful to do so, but if it was sinful, he would not approach it. Allah's Apostle never took revenge over anybody for his own sake but (he did) only when Allah's legal bindings were outraged, in which case he would take revenge for Allah's sake." (See Hadith No. 760. Vol)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab bhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko do maamlon mein se ek chunna hota, wo hamesha aasaan waala chunte, jab tak wo gunaah na ho, magar agar wo gunaah hota, to wo uske paas bhi nahi jaate. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kabhi apni khaatir kisi se badla nahi liya, siwaaye jab Allah ke muqarrar kiye hue hukmon ka ulanghan hota, jispar wo Allah ki khaatir badla lete.

e: Narrated Al-Azraq bin Qais:We were in the city of Al-Ahwaz on the bank of a river which had dried up. Then Abu Barza Al- Aslami came riding a horse and he started praying and let his horse loose. The horse ran away, so Abu Barza interrupted his prayer and went after the horse till he caught it and brought it, and then he offered his prayer. There was a man amongst us who was (from the Khawari) having a different opinion. He came saying. "Look at this old man! He left his prayer because of a horse." On that Abu Barza came to us and said, "Since the time I left Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), nobody has admonished me; My house is very far from this place, and if I had carried on praying and left my horse, I could not have reached my house till night." Then Abu Barza mentioned that he had been in the company of the Prophet, and that he had seen his leniency
hi: Al-Azraq bin Qais bataate hain: Hum Al-Ahwaz shehar mein ek sookhi nadi ke kinaare the. Phir Abu Barza (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Aslami (رضی اللہ عنہ) ghode par sawaar hokar aaye aur namaz padhne lage, apne ghode ko azaad chhod diya. Ghoda bhaag gaya, isliye Abu Barza ne apni namaz beech mein rok di aur ghode ke peechhe gaye, use pakda aur wapas laaye, phir apni namaz padhi. Humaare beech ek shaks tha (Khawarij mein se) jinki alag raay thi. Wo aakar kehne laga, 'Is budhe aadmi ko dekho! Isne ghode ki khaatir apni namaz chhod di.' Isper Abu Barza hamare paas aaye aur kaha, 'Jab se maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko chhoda hai, kisi ne mujhe malaamat nahi ki; mera ghar yahaan se bahut door hai, aur agar main namaz jaari rakhta aur apna ghoda chhod deta, to main raat tak apne ghar nahi pahunch pata.' Phir Abu Barza ne bataya ke wo Nabi (SAW) ke saath rahe the, aur unhone unki narmi (aasaani-pasandi) dekhi thi.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:A bedouin urinated in the mosque, and the people rushed to beat him. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered them to leave him and pour a bucket or a tumbler (full) of water over the place where he has passed urine. The Prophet then said, " You have been sent to make things easy (for the people) and you have not been sent to make things difficult for them
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek badawi ne Masjid mein peshaab kar diya, aur log usse maarne ke liye daude. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhein hukm diya ke use chhod dein aur us jagah par ek bucket ya pyaala (bhar) paani daal dein jahaan usne peshaab kiya tha. Phir Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Tumhein aasaani karne ke liye bheja gaya hai, mushkilein banaane ke liye nahi.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to mix with us to the extent that he would say to a younger brother of mine, 'O Aba `Umair! What did the Nughair (a kind of bird) do?
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) hamare saath itni ghulmilti se pesh aate ke wo mere chhote bhai se kehte, 'Aye Abu Umair! Nughair (ek qism ka chidiya) ne kya kiya?'

e: Narrated `Aisha:I used to play with the dolls in the presence of the Prophet, and my girl friends also used to play with me. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to enter (my dwelling place) they used to hide themselves, but the Prophet would call them to join and play with me. (The playing with the dolls and similar images is forbidden, but it was allowed for `Aisha at that time, as she was a little girl, not yet reached the age of puberty.) (Fath-ul-Bari page 143, Vol)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Main Nabi (SAW) ki maujoodgi mein gudiyon se khela karti thi, aur meri saheliyaan bhi mere saath khela karti thin. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) andar aate, wo (saheliyaan) chhup jaati thin, magar Nabi (SAW) unhein bulaate taake wo mere saath khelein.

e: Narrated Aisha:A man asked permission to see the Prophet. He said, "Let Him come in; What an evil man of the tribe he is! (Or, What an evil brother of the tribe he is). But when he entered, the Prophet (ﷺ) spoke to him gently in a polite manner. I said to him, "O Allah's Apostle! You have said what you have said, then you spoke to him in a very gentle and polite manner? The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The worse people, in the sight of Allah are those whom the people leave (undisturbed) to save themselves from their dirty language
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ek shaks ne Nabi (SAW) se milne ki ijaazat maangi. Unhone kaha, 'Use andar aane do; wo apni qaum ka kitna bura aadmi hai! (ya, wo apni qaum ka kitna bura bhai hai!).' Magar jab wo daakhil hua, Nabi (SAW) ne unse naram aur adab se baat ki. Maine unse kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Aapne jo kaha wo kaha, phir bhi aapne unse itni naram aur adab se baat ki?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Allah ke nazdeek sabse bure log wo hain jinhein log unki ganda zubaan se bachne ke liye chhod dete hain.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abu Mulaika:The Prophet (ﷺ) was given a gift of a few silken cloaks with gold buttons. He distributed them amongst some of his companions and put aside one of them for Makhrama. When Makhrama came, the Prophet said, "I kept this for you." (Aiyub, the sub-narrator held his garment to show how the Prophet (ﷺ) showed the cloak to Makhrama who had something unfavorable about his temper
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abu Mulaika bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ko resham ke kuch chogon ka tohfa diya gaya jinpar sone ke buttons the. Unhone unhein apne kuch sahaaba mein baant diya aur ek chogha Makhrama ke liye alag rakha. Jab Makhrama aaye, Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Maine ye tumhaare liye rakha hai.' (Ravi Aiyub ne apna kapda pakadkar dikhaya ke Nabi (SAW) ne wo chogha Makhrama ko kaise dikhaya, jinka mizaaj thoda tez tha.)

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A believer is not stung twice (by something) out of one and the same hole
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Momin ko ek hi bill se do baar nahi kaataa jaata (yaani ek Momin ek hi galti ya dhoke ka shikaar dobara nahi hota).'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered upon me and said, "Have I not been informed that you offer prayer all the night and fast the whole day?" I said, "Yes." He said, "Do not do so; Offer prayer at night and also sleep; Fast for a few days and give up fasting for a few days because your body has a right on you, and your eye has a right on you, and your guest has a right on you, and your wife has a right on you. I hope that you will have a long life, and it is sufficient for you to fast for three days a month as the reward of a good deed, is multiplied ten times, that means, as if you fasted the whole year." I insisted (on fasting more) so I was given a hard instruction. I said, "I can do more than that (fasting)" The Prophet said, "Fast three days every week." But as I insisted (on fasting more) so I was burdened. I said, "I can fast more than that." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Fast as Allah's prophet David used to fast." I said, "How was the fasting of the prophet David?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "One half of a year (i.e. he used to fast on alternate days)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mere paas aaye aur kaha, 'Kya mujhe bataya nahi gaya ke tum poori raat namaz padhte ho aur poore din roza rakhte ho?' Maine kaha, 'Haan.' Unhone kaha, 'Aisa mat karo; raat mein namaz padho aur so bhi; kuch din roza rakho aur kuch din chhodo, kyunke tumhaare jism ka bhi tum par haq hai, tumhaari aankh ka bhi tum par haq hai, tumhaare mehmaan ka bhi tum par haq hai, aur tumhaari biwi ka bhi tum par haq hai. Mujhe ummeed hai tumhaari lambi umar hogi, aur tumhaare liye mahine mein teen din roza rakhna kaafi hai, kyunke nek amaal ka ajr das guna badhta hai, yaani jaise tumne poora saal roza rakha ho.' Maine (aur roze ki) zid ki, isliye mujhe ek sakht hidaayat di gayi. Maine kaha, 'Main isse zyaada kar sakta hoon.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Har hafte teen din roza rakho.' Magar chunke maine zid ki, mujhe (zyaada) bojh diya gaya. Maine kaha, 'Main isse zyaada roza rakh sakta hoon.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Allah ke Nabi Dawood jaisa roza rakho.' Maine pucha, 'Nabi Dawood ka roza kaisa tha?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Aadhe saal ka (yaani wo ek din chhod kar roza rakhte the).'

e: Narrated Abu Shuraih Al-Ka`bi:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, should serve his guest generously. The guest's reward is: To provide him with a superior type of food for a night and a day and a guest is to be entertained with food for three days, and whatever is offered beyond that, is regarded as something given in charity. And it is not lawful for a guest to stay with his host for such a long period so as to put him in a critical position." Narrated Malik: Similarly as above (156) adding, "Who believes in Allah and the Last Day should talk what is good or keep quiet." (i.e. abstain from dirty and evil talk, and should think before uttering)
hi: Abu Shuraih (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ka'bi bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par Iman rakhta hai, use apne mehmaan ki achhi khidmat karni chaahiye. Mehmaan ka haq ye hai: use ek raat aur din behtareen khaana diya jaaye, aur mehmaan ki teen din tak khidmat ki jaani chaahiye, aur jo bhi isse zyaada diya jaaye, wo Sadqa mana jaayega. Aur mehmaan ke liye ye jaayez nahi ke wo apne mezbaan ke paas itni lambi muddat rahe ke wo unhein mushkil mein daal de.' Ravi Malik bataate hain aisa hi (156), aur izaafa karte hain, 'Jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par Iman rakhta hai, use achhi baat kehni chaahiye ya khaamosh rehna chaahiye (yaani ganda aur buri baat se bachna chaahiye, aur bolne se pehle sochna chaahiye).'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, should not hurt his neighbor and whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, should serve his guest generously and whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, should speak what is good or keep silent
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par Iman rakhta hai, use apne padosi ko takleef nahi deni chaahiye, aur jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par Iman rakhta hai, use apne mehmaan ki achhi khidmat karni chaahiye, aur jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par Iman rakhta hai, use achhi baat kehni chaahiye ya khaamosh rehna chaahiye.'

e: Narrated `Uqba bin 'Amir:We said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! You send us out and it happens that we have to stay with such people as do not entertain us. What do you think about it?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to us, "If you stay with some people and they entertain you as they should for a guest, accept is; but if they do not do then you should take from them the right of the guest, which they ought to give
hi: Uqba bin Aamir bataate hain: Humne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Aap humein bhejte hain aur kabhi hum aise logon ke saath thehar jaate hain jo humaari mehmaan-nawaazi nahi karte. Aap iske baare mein kya farmaate hain?' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humse kaha, 'Agar tum kisi ke saath thehro aur wo tumhaari mehmaan ke haq ke mutaabik khidmat karein, to use qubool karo; magar agar wo aisa nahi karte, to unse mehmaan ka haq le lo jo unhein dena chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, should serve his guest generously; and whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, should unite the bond of kinship (i.e. keep good relation with his kith and kin); and whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, should talk what is good or keep quiet
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par Iman rakhta hai, use apne mehmaan ki achhi khidmat karni chaahiye; aur jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par Iman rakhta hai, use apne rishtedaaron ke saath achhe taaluqaat rakhne chaahiye; aur jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par Iman rakhta hai, use achhi baat kehni chaahiye ya khaamosh rehna chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Abu Juhaifa:The Prophet (ﷺ) established a bond of brotherhood between Salman and Abu Darda'. Salman paid a visit to Abu ad-Darda and found Um Ad-Darda' dressed in shabby clothes and asked her why she was in that state.?" She replied, "Your brother, Abu Ad-Darda is not interested in the luxuries of this world." In the meantime Abu Ad-Darda came and prepared a meal for him (Salman), and said to him, "(Please) eat for I am fasting." Salman said, "I am not going to eat, unless you eat." So Abu Ad-Darda' ate. When it was night, Abu Ad-Darda' got up (for the night prayer). Salman said (to him), "Sleep," and he slept. Again Abu- Ad-Darda' got up (for the prayer), and Salman said (to him), "Sleep." When it was the last part of the night, Salman said to him, "Get up now (for the prayer)." So both of them offered their prayers and Salman said to Abu Ad-Darda',"Your Lord has a right on you; and your soul has a right on you; and your family has a right on you; so you should give the rights of all those who have a right on you). Later on Abu Ad-Darda' visited the Prophet (ﷺ) and mentioned that to him. The Prophet, said, "Salman has spoken the truth
hi: Abu Juhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne Salman (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Abu Darda ke beech bhaichaare ka rishta qaayam kiya. Salman ne Abu Ad-Darda se milne unke ghar gaye aur Umm Ad-Darda ko purane kapdon mein dekha, aur pucha ke wo aise kyun hain? Unhone jawab diya, 'Tumhaare bhai, Abu Ad-Darda, is duniya ki aish-o-aaraam mein dilchaspi nahi rakhte.' Isi dauraan Abu Ad-Darda aaye aur unke (Salman ke) liye khaana taiyaar kiya, aur unse kaha, '(Barah-e-meharbaani) khaao, kyunke main roza rakhe hue hoon.' Salman ne kaha, 'Main tab tak nahi khaunga jab tak tum na khaao.' To Abu Ad-Darda ne khaaya. Jab raat hui, Abu Ad-Darda uthe (raat ki namaz ke liye). Salman ne (unse) kaha, 'So jao,' aur wo so gaye. Abu Ad-Darda dobara uthe, aur Salman ne (unse) kaha, 'So jao.' Jab raat ka aakhri hissa aaya, Salman ne unse kaha, 'Ab utho (namaz ke liye).' To dono ne apni namaz padhi aur Salman ne Abu Ad-Darda se kaha, 'Tumhaare Rab ka tumpar haq hai, tumhaari jaan ka bhi tumpar haq hai, aur tumhaare khaandaan ka bhi tumpar haq hai, isliye tumhein un sab ka haq dena chaahiye jinka tumpar haq hai.' Baad mein Abu Ad-Darda Nabi (SAW) se mile aur ye baat unhein bataayi. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Salman ne sach kaha.'

e: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Bakr:Abu Bakr invited a group of people and told me, "Look after your guests." Abu Bakr added, I am going to visit the Prophet (ﷺ) and you should finish serving them before I return." `Abdur-Rahman said, So I went at once and served them with what was available at that time in the house and requested them to eat." They said, "Where is the owner of the house (i.e., Abu Bakr)?" `Abdur-Rahman said, "Take your meal." They said, "We will not eat till the owner of the house comes." `Abdur-Rahman said, "Accept your meal from us, for if my father comes and finds you not having taken your meal yet, we will be blamed severely by him, but they refused to take their meals . So I was sure that my father would be angry with me. When he came, I went away (to hide myself) from him. He asked, "What have you done (about the guests)?" They informed him the whole story. Abu Bakr called, "O `Abdur Rahman!" I kept quiet. He then called again. "O `Abdur-Rahman!" I kept quiet and he called again, "O ignorant (boy)! I beseech you by Allah, if you hear my voice, then come out!" I came out and said, "Please ask your guests (and do not be angry with me)." They said, "He has told the truth; he brought the meal to us." He said, "As you have been waiting for me, by Allah, I will not eat of it tonight." They said, "By Allah, we will not eat of it till you eat of it." He said, I have never seen a night like this night in evil. What is wrong with you? Why don't you accept your meals of hospitality from us?" (He said to me), "Bring your meal." I brought it to him, and he put his hand in it, saying, "In the name of Allah. The first (state of fury) was because of Satan." So Abu Bakr ate and so did his guests
hi: Abdur Rahman bin Abu Bakr bataate hain: Abu Bakr ne kuch logon ko dawat di aur mujhse kaha, 'Apne mehmaanon ka khayaal rakho.' Abu Bakr ne kaha, 'Main Nabi (SAW) se milne jaa raha hoon, aur mere wapas aane se pehle tumhein unhein khaana khilaana khatam kar dena chaahiye.' Abdur Rahman ne kaha, 'To main foran gaya aur unhein ghar mein us waqt jo bhi maujood tha wo khilaaya aur unhein khaane ki darkhwaast ki.' Unhone kaha, 'Ghar ka maalik (yaani Abu Bakr) kahaan hai?' Abdur Rahman ne kaha, 'Apna khaana khaao.' Unhone kaha, 'Hum tab tak nahi khaayenge jab tak ghar ka maalik na aa jaaye.' Abdur Rahman ne kaha, 'Hamse apna khaana qubool karo, kyunke agar mere waalid aakar dekhein ke tumne abhi tak khaana nahi khaaya, to unhein humpar bahut gussa aayega,' magar unhone khaana khaane se inkaar kiya. To mujhe yaqeen ho gaya ke mere waalid mujhse naaraaz honge. Jab wo aaye, main unse (chhupne ke liye) chala gaya. Unhone pucha, 'Tumne (mehmaanon ke baare mein) kya kiya?' Unhone (mehmaanon ne) unhein poori kahaani bataayi. Abu Bakr ne pukaara, 'Aye Abdur Rahman!' Main khaamosh raha. Phir unhone dobara pukaara, 'Aye Abdur Rahman!' Main khaamosh raha aur unhone phir pukaara, 'Aye naadaan (ladke)! Main tumhein Allah ki qasam deta hoon, agar tum meri aawaaz sun rahe ho, to baahar aao!' Main baahar aaya aur kaha, 'Barah-e-meharbaani apne mehmaanon se poochiye (aur mujhpar naaraaz mat hoiye).' Unhone kaha, 'Usne sach kaha; wo hamare paas khaana laaya tha.' Abu Bakr ne kaha, 'Chunke tumne mera intezaar kiya, Allah ki qasam, main aaj raat isme se nahi khaunga.' Unhone kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, hum bhi isme se nahi khaayenge jab tak aap na khaayein.' Unhone kaha, 'Maine kabhi aisi buri raat nahi dekhi. Tumhein kya hua hai? Tum hamari mehmaan-nawaazi ka khaana kyun qubool nahi karte?' (Unhone mujhse kaha,) 'Apna khaana lao.' Main use unke paas laaya, aur unhone usmein apna haath daala, kehte hue, 'Allah ke naam se. Pehli (gusse ki haalat) Shaitaan ki taraf se thi.' To Abu Bakr ne khaaya aur unke mehmaanon ne bhi khaaya.

e: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Bakr:Abu Bakr came with a guest or some guests, but he stayed late at night with the Prophet (ﷺ) and when he came, my mother said (to him), "Have you been detained from your guest or guests tonight?" He said, "Haven't you served the supper to them?" She replied, "We presented the meal to him (or to them), but he (or they) refused to eat." Abu Bakr became angry, rebuked me and invoked Allah to cause (my) ears to be cut and swore not to eat of it!" I hid myself, and he called me, "O ignorant (boy)!" Abu Bakr's wife swore that she would not eat of it and so the guests or the guest swore that they would not eat of it till he ate of it. Abu Bakr said, "All that happened was from Satan." So he asked for the meals and ate of it, and so did they. Whenever they took a handful of the meal, the meal grew (increased) from underneath more than that mouthful. He said (to his wife), "O, sister of Bani Firas! What is this?" She said, "O, pleasure of my eyes! The meal is now more than it had been before we started eating'' So they ate of it and sent the rest of that meal to the Prophet. It is said that the Prophet (ﷺ) also ate of it
hi: Abdur Rahman bin Abu Bakr bataate hain: Abu Bakr ek ya kuch mehmaanon ke saath aaye, magar wo raat ko Nabi (SAW) ke saath der tak rahe, aur jab wo aaye, meri maa ne (unse) kaha, 'Kya aaj raat aap apne mehmaan(on) se ruk gaye the?' Unhone kaha, 'Kya tumne unhein raat ka khaana nahi diya?' Usne jawab diya, 'Humne unhein (ya unhein) khaana pesh kiya, magar unhone (ya unhone) khaane se inkaar kiya.' Abu Bakr gussa ho gaye, mujhe daanta, aur Allah se dua ki ke (mere) kaan kaat diye jaayein, aur qasam khaayi ke wo isme se nahi khaayenge! Main chhup gaya, aur unhone mujhe pukaara, 'Aye naadaan (ladke)!' Abu Bakr ki biwi ne qasam khaayi ke wo bhi isme se nahi khaayegi, isliye mehmaan(on) ne bhi qasam khaayi ke wo tab tak isme se nahi khaayenge jab tak wo (Abu Bakr) na khaayein. Abu Bakr ne kaha, 'Ye sab Shaitaan ki taraf se tha.' To unhone khaana maangaya aur khaaya, aur unhone bhi khaaya. Jab bhi wo khaane ka ek mutthi uthaate, khaana neeche se pehle se zyaada badh jaata. Unhone (apni biwi se) kaha, 'Aye Banu Firas ki behen! Ye kya hai?' Usne kaha, 'Aye meri aankhon ki khushi! Ye khaana ab hamare khaana shuru karne se pehle se bhi zyaada hai.' To unhone isme se khaaya aur baaki khaana Nabi (SAW) ke paas bhej diya. Kaha jaata hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne bhi isme se khaaya.
