e: Narrated Rafi` bin Khadij and Sahl bin Abu Hathma:`Abdullah bin Sahl and Muhaiyisa bin Mas`ud went to Khaibar and they dispersed in the gardens of the date-palm trees. `Abdullah bin Sahl was murdered. Then `Abdur-Rahman bin Sahl, Huwaiyisa and Muhaiyisa, the two sons of Mas`ud, came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and spoke about the case of their (murdered) friend. `Abdur-Rahman who was the youngest of them all, started talking. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Let the older (among you) speak first." So they spoke about the case of their (murdered) friend. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Will fifty of you take an oath whereby you will have the right to receive the blood money of your murdered man," (or said, "..your companion"). They said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! The murder was a thing we did not witness." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Then the Jews will release you from the oath, if fifty of them (the Jews) should take an oath to contradict your claim." They said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! They are disbelievers (and they will take a false oath)." Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) himself paid the blood money to them
hi: Rafi' bin Khadij (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Sahl bin Abu Hathma bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Sahl aur Muhaiyisa bin Mas'ud Khaibar gaye aur khajoor ke baagon mein bikhar gaye. Abdullah bin Sahl ka qatl ho gaya. Phir Abdur Rahman bin Sahl, Huwaiyisa aur Muhaiyisa, Mas'ud ke do bete, Nabi (SAW) ke paas gaye aur apne (murda) dost ke maamle ke baare mein baat ki. Abdur Rahman, jo unmein sabse chhote the, baat karne lage. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Bade (tum mein se) pehle bolein.' To unhone apne (murda) dost ke maamle ke baare mein baat ki. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Kya tum mein se pachaas log qasam khaayenge, jisse tumhein apne qatl kiye gaye aadmi ka khoon-bahaa lene ka haq milega?' (ya kaha, '...apne saathi ka...'). Unhone kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Ye ek aisi baat hai jise humne khud nahi dekha.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Phir Yahudi tumhein qasam se azaad kar denge, agar unmein se pachaas Yahudi tumhaare dawe ke khilaaf qasam khaayein.' Unhone kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Wo kaafir hain (aur jhoothi qasam khaayenge).' Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne khud unhein khoon-bahaa adaa kiya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Inform me of a tree which resembles a Muslim, giving its fruits at every season by the permission of its Lord, and the leaves of which do not fall." I thought of the date-palm tree, but I disliked to speak because Abu Bakr and `Umar were present there. When nobody spoke, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It is the date-palm tree" When I came out with my father, I said, "O father! It came to my mind that it was the date-palm tree." He said, "What prevented you from saying it?" Had you said it, it would have been more dearer to me than such-and-such a thing (fortune)." I said, "Nothing prevented me but the fact that neither you nor Abu Bakr spoke, so I disliked to speak (in your presence)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Mujhe ek aise darakht ke baare mein bataao jo Musalmaan jaisa hai, apne Rab ki ijaazat se har mausam mein phal deta hai, aur jiske patte nahi jhadte.' Maine khajoor ke darakht ke baare mein socha, magar mujhe bolna napasand tha kyunke Abu Bakr aur Umar wahaan maujood the. Jab koi nahi bola, Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Ye khajoor ka darakht hai.' Jab main apne waalid ke saath baahar aaya, maine kaha, 'Aye waalid! Mere zehen mein ye baat aayi thi ke ye khajoor ka darakht hai.' Unhone kaha, 'Tumhein kehne se kis cheez ne roka? Agar tum kehte, to mujhe wo falaan-falaan cheez (daulat) se bhi zyaada aziz lagta.' Maine kaha, 'Mujhe sirf isliye roka gaya kyunke na aap na Abu Bakr bole, isliye mujhe (aapki maujoodgi mein) bolna napasand tha.'

e: Narrated Ubai bin Ka`b:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Some poetry contains wisdom
hi: Ubai bin Ka'b (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kuch shayari mein hikmat hoti hai.'

e: Narrated Jundub:While the Prophet (ﷺ) was walking, a stone hit his foot and stumbled and his toe was injured. He then (quoting a poetic verse) said, "You are not more than a toe which has been bathed in blood in Allah's Cause
hi: Jundub bataate hain: Jab Nabi (SAW) chal rahe the, ek patthar unke pair se takraaya aur unki ungli zakhmi ho gayi. Unhone (ek shair ka hawaala dete hue) kaha, 'Tum bas ek aisi ungli ho jo Allah ki raah mein khoon se nahaayi gayi hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The most true words said by a poet were the words of Labid. He said, i.e. 'Verily, everything except Allah is perishable and Umaiya bin Abi As-Salt was about to embrace Islam
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Sabse sacchi baat jo kisi shaayar ne kahi wo Labid ke alfaaz the. Unhone kaha, "Beshak, Allah ke siwa har cheez faani hai."' Aur Umaiya bin Abi As-Salt Islam qubool karne ke qareeb the.

e: Narrated Salama bin Al-Aqwa:We went out with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to Khaibar and we travelled during the night. A man amongst the people said to 'Amir bin Al-Aqwa', "Won't you let us hear your poetry?" 'Amir was a poet, and so he got down and started (chanting Huda) reciting for the people, poetry that keep pace with the camel's foot steps, saying, "O Allah! Without You we would not have been guided on the right path, neither would we have given in charity, nor would we have prayed. So please forgive us what we have committed. Let all of us be sacrificed for Your cause and when we meet our enemy, make our feet firm and bestow peace and calmness on us and if they (our enemy) will call us towards an unjust thing we will refuse. The infidels have made a hue and cry to ask others help against us. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Who is that driver (of the camels)?" They said, "He is 'Amir bin Al-Aqwa."' He said, "May Allah bestow His mercy on him." A man among the people said, Has Martyrdom been granted to him, O Allah's Prophet! Would that you let us enjoy his company longer." We reached (the people of) Khaibar and besieged them till we were stricken with severe hunger but Allah helped the Muslims conquer Khaibar. In the evening of its conquest the people made many fires. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked, "What are those fires? For what are you making fires?" They said, "For cooking meat." He asked, "What kind of meat?" They said, "Donkeys' meat." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Throw away the meat and break the cooking pots." A man said, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shall we throw away the meat and wash the cooking pots?" He said, "You can do that too." When the army files aligned in rows (for the battle), 'Amir's sword was a short one, and while attacking a Jew with it in order to hit him, the sharp edge of the sword turned back and hit 'Amir's knee and caused him to die. When the Muslims returned (from the battle), Salama said, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw me pale and said, 'What is wrong with you?"' I said, "Let my parents be sacrificed for you! The people claim that all the deeds of Amir have been annulled." The Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "Who said so?" I replied, "So-and-so and so-and-so and Usaid bin Al-Hudair Al-Ansari said, 'Whoever says so is telling a lie. Verily, 'Amir will have double reward."' (While speaking) the Prophet (ﷺ) put two of his fingers together to indicate that, and added, "He was really a hard-working man and a Mujahid (devout fighter in Allah's Cause) and rarely have there lived in it (i.e., Medina or the battle-field) an "Arab like him
hi: Salama bin Al-Aqwa bataate hain: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Khaibar ki taraf nikle aur raat ko safar kiya. Logon mein se ek shaks ne Aamir bin Al-Aqwa se kaha, 'Kya tum humein apni shaayari nahi sunaaoge?' Aamir shaayar the, to wo utre aur (Huda ki tarz mein) log ke liye shaayari padhne lage jo oont ki chaal ke saath taal milaati thi, kehte hue, 'Aye Allah! Tere bagair hum seedha raasta na paate, na sadqa dete, na namaz padhte. Isliye humne jo kiya hai use maaf kar de. Hum sab tere kaam ke liye qurbaan hon, aur jab hum apne dushman se milein, humaare paaon mazboot rakh, aur hampar sukoon aur shanti naazil kar. Aur agar wo (dushman) humein kisi na-insaafi ki taraf bulaayein, to hum inkaar karenge. Kaafiron ne hamare khilaaf madad maangne mein shor macha diya hai.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne pucha, 'Wo (oonton ka) haankne wala kaun hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Wo Aamir bin Al-Aqwa hain.' Unhone kaha, 'Allah unpar reham kare.' Logon mein se ek shaks ne kaha, 'Kya unhein shahaadat mil gayi hai, Aye Allah ke Nabi? Kaash aap humein unki sohbat aur lambi der tak dete.' Hum Khaibar (waalon) tak pahunche aur unhein ghera daala yahaan tak ke humein shadeed bhookh lagi, magar Allah ne Musalmaanon ki madad ki aur Khaibar fatah hua. Uski fatah ki shaam ko, logon ne bahut si aagein jalaayi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne pucha, 'Ye kaisi aagein hain? Tum kyun aagein jala rahe ho?' Unhone kaha, 'Gosht pakaane ke liye.' Unhone pucha, 'Kaunsa gosht?' Unhone kaha, 'Gadhon ka gosht.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Gosht phenk do aur degein todo.' Ek shaks ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya hum gosht phenk kar degein dho lein?' Unhone kaha, 'Tum aisa bhi kar sakte ho.' Jab fauj qataaron mein khadi hui (jang ke liye), Aamir ki talwaar chhoti thi, aur ek Yahudi par hamla karte waqt, talwaar ki dhaar mud gayi aur Aamir ke ghutne se takraa gayi, jisse unki maut ho gayi. Jab Musalmaan (jang se) wapas laute, Salama kehte hain, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe pheela dekha aur kaha, 'Tumhein kya hua?' Maine kaha, 'Mere maa-baap aap par qurbaan hon! Log kehte hain ke Aamir ke sab amaal barbaad ho gaye.' Nabi (SAW) ne pucha, 'Kisne aisa kaha?' Maine jawab diya, 'Falaan aur falaan.' Aur Usaid bin Al-Hudair Al-Ansari ne kaha, 'Jo bhi aisa kahe wo jhoot bol raha hai. Beshak, Aamir ko dohra ajr milega.' (Baat karte hue) Nabi (SAW) ne apni do ungliyaan milaayi ye dikhaane ke liye, aur izaafa kiya, 'Wo waaqai ek mehnat karne wala aur Mujahid (Allah ki raah mein sacha jaanbaaz) the, aur (Madina ya jang ke maidaan mein) unke jaisa Arab kam hi rehta hai.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) came to some of his wives among whom there was Um Sulaim, and said, "May Allah be merciful to you, O Anjasha! Drive the camels slowly, as they are carrying glass vessels!" Abu Qalaba said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) said a sentence (i.e. the above metaphor) which, had anyone of you said it, you would have admonished him for it
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) apni kuch biwiyon ke paas gaye, jinmein Umm Sulaim (رضی اللہ عنہا) bhi thin, aur kaha, 'Allah tumpar reham kare, Aye Anjasha (رضی اللہ عنہ)! Oonton ko dheere-dheere le jao, kyunke wo (naazuk) shishe ke bartan le ja rahe hain!' (Yaani auraton ka ishara karte hue). Ravi Abu Qalaba kehte hain: 'Nabi (SAW) ne aisi baat kahi jo agar tum mein se koi kahta, to tum use isper daantte.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:Hassan bin Thabit asked the permission of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to lampoon the pagans (in verse). Allah's Apostle said, "What about my fore-fathers (ancestry)?' Hassan said (to the Prophet) "I will take you out of them as a hair is taken out of dough." Narrated Hisham bin `Urwa that his father said, "I called Hassan with bad names in front of `Aisha." She said, "Don't call him with bad names because he used to defend Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (against the pagans)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Hassan bin Thabit ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se mushrikon par (shaayari mein) taana kasne ki ijaazat maangi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Mere baap-daada ke baare mein kya (khayaal hai)?' Hassan ne (Nabi se) kaha, 'Main aapko unmein se aise nikaal loonga jaise aata mein se baal nikaal liya jaata hai.' Ravi Hisham bin Urwa apne waalid ke hawaale se bataate hain: 'Maine Aisha ke saamne Hassan ko bure naamon se pukaara.' Unhone kaha, 'Unhein bure naamon se mat pukaaro, kyunke wo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka (mushrikon ke khilaaf) difaa kiya karte the.'

e: Narrated Al-Haitham bin Abu Sinan:that he heard Abu Huraira in his narration, mentioning that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A Muslim brother of yours who does not say dirty words." and by that he meant Ibn Rawaha, "said (in verse): 'We have Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with us who recites the Holy Qur'an in the early morning time. He gave us guidance and light while we were blind and astray, so our hearts are sure that whatever he says, will certainly happen. He does not touch his bed at night, being busy in worshipping Allah while the pagans are sound asleep in their beds
hi: Al-Haitham bin Abu Sinan bataate hain ke unhone Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki riwayat mein sunaa, jismein Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Tumhaara ek Musalmaan bhai jo ganda alfaaz nahi bolta,' aur unka ishara Ibn Rawaha ki taraf tha, 'unhone (shaayari mein) kaha: "Hamare saath Allah ke Rasool (SAW) hain jo subah-savere paak Quran padhte hain. Unhone humein raah dikhaayi aur roshni di jabke hum andhe aur bhatke hue the, isliye hamare dil yaqeen se bhare hain ke wo jo bhi kahen, wo zaroor hoga. Wo raat ko apne bistar ko haath nahi lagaate, Allah ki ibaadat mein masroof rehte hain, jabke mushrik apne bistaron mein gehri neend soye hote hain."'

e: Narrated Abu Salama bin `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf:that he heard Hassan bin Thabit Al-Ansari asking the witness of Abu Huraira, saying, "O Abu- Huraira! I beseech you by Allah (to tell me). Did you hear Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying' 'O Hassan ! Reply on behalf of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). O Allah ! Support him (Hassan) with the Holy Spirit (Gabriel).'?" Abu Huraira said, "Yes
hi: Abu Salama bin Abdur Rahman bin Auf (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke unhone Hassan bin Thabit Al-Ansari ko Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) se gawaahi maangte suna, kehte hue, 'Aye Abu Huraira! Main tumhein Allah ki qasam deta hoon (bataao). Kya tumne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, "Aye Hassan! Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki taraf se jawab do. Aye Allah! Ise Ruh-ul-Qudus (Jibrael) se madad de"?' Abu Huraira ne kaha, 'Haan.'

e: Narrated Al-Bara:The Prophet (ﷺ) said to Hassan, "Lampoon them (the pagans) in verse, and Gabriel is with you
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne Hassan se kaha, 'Inpar (mushrikon par) shaayari mein taana kaso, aur Jibrael tumhaare saath hain.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It is better for a man to fill the inside of his body with pus than to fill it with poetry
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kisi aadmi ke liye apne jism ko pip se bharna, shaayari se bharne se behtar hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ); said, "It is better for anyone of you that the inside of his body be filled with pus which may consume his body, than it be filled with poetry
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Tum mein se kisi ke liye apne jism ke andar pip bhar jaana behtar hai, jo uske jism ko kha jaaye, is se ke wo shaayari se bhar jaaye.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah, the brother of Abu Al-Qu'ais asked my permission to enter after the verses of Al-Hijab (veiling the ladies) was revealed, and I said, "By Allah, I will not admit him unless I take permission of Allah's Apostle for it was not the brother of Al-Qu'ais who had suckled me, but it was the wife of Al-Qu'ais, who had suckled me." Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered upon me, and I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! The man has not nursed me but his wife has nursed me." He said, "Admit him because he is your uncle (not from blood relation, but because you have been nursed by his wife), Taribat Yaminuki." `Urwa said, "Because of this reason, ' Aisha used to say: Foster suckling relations render all those things (marriages etc.) illegal which are illegal because of the corresponding blood relations." (See Hadith No. 36, Vol)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Aflah, Abu Al-Qu'ais ke bhai, ne Hijab ki Aayat naazil hone ke baad mujhse milne ki ijaazat maangi, aur maine kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, main unhein andar nahi aane doongi jab tak Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ijaazat na le loon, kyunke mujhe Al-Qu'ais ke bhai ne nahi, balke Al-Qu'ais ki biwi ne doodh pilaaya tha.' Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mere paas aaye, aur maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Is aadmi ne mujhe doodh nahi pilaaya, unki biwi ne pilaaya hai.' Unhone kaha, 'Unhein andar aane do, kyunke wo tumhaare chacha hain (khoon ke rishte se nahi, balke iss wajah se ke tumhein unki biwi ne doodh pilaaya), Taribat Yaminuki (tumhaare haath mein khaak pade, ek Arabi muhaawara).' Urwa kehte hain, 'Isi wajah se, Aisha kaha karti thin: Doodh-rishte ke ta'alluq wahi cheezein haraam karte hain jo khoon ke rishte haraam karte hain.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 36, Jild 1 dekhein.)

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) intended to return home after the performance of the Hajj, and he saw Safiya standing at the entrance of her tent, depressed and sad because she got her menses. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Aqra Halqa! --An expression used in the Quraish dialect--"You will detain us." The Prophet (ﷺ) then asked (her), "Did you perform the Tawaf Al-Ifada on the Day of Sacrifice (10th of Dhul-Hijja)?" She said, "Yes." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Then you can leave (with us)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) Hajj poora karne ke baad ghar wapas jaana chahte the, aur unhone Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko apne khaime ke darwaaze par udaas aur pareshaan khada dekha kyunke unhein haiz aa gayi thi. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Aqra Halqa! -- Quraish ki bhaasha ka ek muhaawara -- Tum humein rok logi.' Phir Nabi (SAW) ne (unse) pucha, 'Kya tumne Nahr ke din (10 Zul-Hijja) Tawaf-e-Ifaza kiya tha?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'To tum (hamare saath) jaa sakti ho.'

e: Narrated Um Hani:(the daughter of Abu Talib) I visited Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the year of the Conquest of Mecca and found him taking a bath, and his daughter, Fatima was screening him. When I greeted him, he said, "Who is it?" I replied, "I am Um Hani, the daughter of Abu Talib." He said, "Welcome, O Um Hani ! " When the Prophet (ﷺ) had finished his bath, he stood up and offered eight rak`at of prayer while he was wrapped in a single garment. When he had finished his prayer, I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! My maternal brother assumes (or claims) that he will murder some man whom I have given shelter, i.e., so-and-so bin Hubaira." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O Um Hani! We shelter him whom you have sheltered." Um Hani added, "That happened in the forenoon
hi: Umm Hani (Abu Talib ki beti) bataati hain: Main Fatah-e-Makkah ke saal Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se milne gayi aur unhein gusl karte paaya, jabke unki beti Fatima (Alayhas Salam) unke liye parda kiye hue thin. Jab maine salaam kiya, unhone pucha, 'Ye kaun hai?' Maine jawab diya, 'Main Umm Hani, Abu Talib ki beti, hoon.' Unhone kaha, 'Khush-aamdeed, Aye Umm Hani!' Jab Nabi (SAW) apna gusl khatam kar chuke, wo khade hue aur aath rakat namaz padhi, ek hi kapde mein lipte hue. Jab unhone apni namaz khatam ki, maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mera maadari bhai dawa karta hai (ya iraada rakhta hai) ke wo ek aadmi ko qatl kar dega jise maine panaah di hai, yaani falaan bin Hubaira ko.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Aye Umm Hani! Hum use panaah dete hain jise tumne panaah di hai.' Umm Hani ne aage kaha, 'Ye subah ke waqt hua tha.'

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) saw a man driving a Badana (a camel for sacrifice) and said (to him). "Ride it." The man said, "It is a Badana." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Ride on it." The man said, "It is a Badana." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, Ride on it, woe to you
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne ek aadmi ko ek Badana (qurbaani ka oont) haankte dekha aur (usse) kaha, 'Isper sawaar ho jao.' Us aadmi ne kaha, 'Ye Badana hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Isper sawaar ho jao.' Us aadmi ne kaha, 'Ye Badana hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Isper sawaar ho jao, afsos hai tumpar.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw a man driving a Badana (a camel for sacrifice) and said to him, "Ride on it." The man said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! It is a Badana." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Ride on it, woe to you!" on the second or third time
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek aadmi ko ek Badana haankte dekha aur usse kaha, 'Isper sawaar ho jao.' Us aadmi ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Ye Badana hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Isper sawaar ho jao, afsos hai tumpar!' doosri ya teesri baar.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was on a journey and he had a black slave called Anjasha, and he was driving the camels (very fast, and there were women riding on those camels). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Waihaka (May Allah be merciful to you), O Anjasha! Drive slowly (the camels) with the glass vessels (women)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek safar par the aur unke saath Anjasha (رضی اللہ عنہ) naami ek kaale ghulaam the, jo oonton ko (bahut tez) haank rahe the, aur un oonton par auraten sawaar thin. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Waihaka (Allah tumpar reham kare), Aye Anjasha! (Oonton ko) dheere-dheere le jao, unmein shishe ke bartan (auraten) hain.'

e: Narrated Abu Bakra:A man praised another man in front of the Prophet. The Prophet (ﷺ) said thrice, "Wailaka (Woe on you) ! You have cut the neck of your brother!" The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "If it is indispensable for anyone of you to praise a person, then he should say, "I think that such-and-such person (is so-and-so), and Allah is the one who will take his accounts (as he knows his reality) and none can sanctify anybody before Allah (and that only if he knows well about that person)
hi: Abu Bakra (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks ne Nabi (SAW) ke saamne doosre ki taarif ki. Nabi (SAW) ne teen baar kaha, 'Wailaka (afsos hai tumpar)! Tumne apne bhai ki gardan kaat di!' Nabi (SAW) ne aage kaha, 'Agar tum mein se kisi ke liye kisi ki taarif karna zaroori ho, to use kehna chaahiye, "Mujhe lagta hai falaan (aisa hai)," aur Allah hi hai jo uska hisaab lega (kyunke wo uski asliyat jaanta hai), aur koi kisi ko Allah ke saamne paakeeza nahi thehra sakta (siwaaye is ke ke use us shaks ke baare mein achhi tarah pata ho).'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:While the Prophet (ﷺ) was distributing (war booty etc.) one day, Dhul Khawaisira, a man from the tribe of Bani Tamim, said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Act justly." The Prophets said, "Woe to you! Who else would act justly if I did not act justly?" `Umar said (to the Prophet (ﷺ) ), "Allow me to chop his neck off." The Prophet said, "No, for he has companions (who are apparently so pious that) if anyone of (you compares his prayer with) their prayer, he will consider his prayer inferior to theirs, and similarly his fasting inferior to theirs, but they will desert Islam (go out of religion) as an arrow goes through the victim's body (games etc.) in which case if its Nasl is examined nothing will be seen thereon, and if its Nady is examined, nothing will be seen thereon, and if its Qudhadh is examined, nothing will be seen thereon, for the arrow has gone out too fast even for the excretions and blood to smear over it. Such people will come out at the time of difference among the (Muslim) people and the sign by which they will be recognized, will be a man whose one of the two hands will look like the breast of a woman or a lump of flesh moving loosely." Abu Sa`id added, "I testify that I heard that from the Prophet (ﷺ) and also testify that I was with `Ali when `Ali fought against those people. The man described by the Prophet was searched for among the killed, and was found, and he was exactly as the Prophet (ﷺ) had described him." (See Hadith No. 807, Vol)
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Nabi (SAW) ek din (maal-e-ganimat) baant rahe the, Dhul Khawaisira, Banu Tamim qabeele ka ek shaks, ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Insaaf se kaam lijiye.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Afsos hai tumpar! Agar main insaaf nahi karunga, to aur kaun karega?' Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne (Nabi se) kaha, 'Mujhe ijaazat dijiye ke main iski gardan kaat doon.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Nahi, kyunke uske saathi hain (jo itne parhezgaar hain ke) agar tum mein se koi apni namaz unki namaz se, ya apna roza unke roze se, tulna kare, to use apni namaz aur roza unke saamne kam samjhega, magar wo Islam se aise nikal jaayenge jaise ek teer shikaar ke jism se guzar jaata hai, jismein agar uska Nasl (agla hissa) dekha jaaye, kuch nazar nahi aayega, aur agar uska Nady (beech ka hissa) dekha jaaye, kuch nazar nahi aayega, aur agar uska Qudhadh (peechhe ka hissa) dekha jaaye, kuch nazar nahi aayega, kyunke teer itni tezi se nikal gaya ke usme khoon ya gandagi lagne ka waqt hi nahi mila. Aise log Musalmaanon ke beech ikhtelaaf ke waqt zaahir honge, aur unki pehchaan ka nishaan ek aisa aadmi hoga jiske do haathon mein se ek aurat ke seene jaisa ya gosht ka ek dhila lotakta tukda jaisa hoga.' Abu Saeed ne aage kaha, 'Main gawaahi deta hoon ke maine ye Nabi (SAW) se suna, aur ye bhi gawaahi deta hoon ke main Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke saath tha jab Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne un logon ke khilaaf jang ki. Nabi (SAW) ne jis aadmi ka zikr kiya tha, use maare gaye logon mein dhoondha gaya, aur wo mil gaya, aur wo bilkul waisa hi tha jaisa Nabi (SAW) ne bataya tha.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 807, Jild 4 dekhein.)

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:A man came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I am ruined!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Waihaka (May Allah be merciful to you) !" The man said, "I have done sexual intercourse with my wife while fasting in Ramadan." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Manumit a slave." The man said, " I cannot afford that. " The Prophet (ﷺ) said; "Then fast for two successive months." The man said, " I have no power to do so." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Then feed sixty poor persons." The man said, "I have nothing (to feed sixty persons). Later a basket full of dates were brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he said (to the man), "Take it and give it in charity." The man said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shall I give it to people other than my family? By Him in Whose Hand my life is, there is nobody poorer than me in the whole city of Medina." The Prophet (ﷺ) smiled till his premolar teeth became visible, and said, "Take it." Az-Zuhri said (that the Prophet (ﷺ) said). "Wailaka
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Main tabaah ho gaya!' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Waihaka (Allah tumpar reham kare)!' Us aadmi ne kaha, 'Maine roze ki haalat mein apni biwi ke saath humbistari kar li Ramzan mein.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Ek ghulaam azaad karo.' Usne kaha, 'Mujhme itni hasiyat nahi.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'To do maheene lagataar roza rakho.' Usne kaha, 'Mujhme itni taaqat nahi.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'To saath gareebon ko khaana khilaao.' Usne kaha, 'Mere paas (khilaane ko) kuch nahi hai.' Baad mein Nabi (SAW) ke paas khajoor se bhari ek tokri laayi gayi, aur unhone (us aadmi se) kaha, 'Ise lo aur sadqe mein de do.' Us aadmi ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya main ise apne khaandaan ke ilaawa doosron ko doon? Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, poore Madina shehar mein mujhse zyaada gareeb koi nahi hai.' Nabi (SAW) itne muskuraaye ke unke damle wale daant zaahir ho gaye, aur kaha, 'Ise le lo (apne liye).' Az-Zuhri kehte hain (ke Nabi SAW ne kaha), 'Wailaka.'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:A bedouin said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Inform me about the emigration." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Waihaka (May Allah be merciful to you)! The question of emigration is a difficult one. Have you got some camels?" The bedouin said, "Yes." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do you pay their Zakat?" He said, "Yes." The Prophet said, "Go on doing like this from beyond the seas, for Allah will not let your deeds go in vain
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek badawi ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe hijrat ke baare mein bataiye.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Waihaka (Allah tumpar reham kare)! Hijrat ka maamla mushkil hai. Kya tumhaare paas oont hain?' Badawi ne kaha, 'Haan.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Kya tum unki Zakat dete ho?' Usne kaha, 'Haan.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'To samundar paar se bhi aisa hi karte raho, kyunke Allah tumhaare amaal zaaya nahi hone dega.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Wailakum" (woe to you) or "waihakum" (May Allah be merciful to you)." Shu`ba is not sure as to which was the right word. "Do not become disbelievers after me by cutting the necks of one another
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Wailakum' (afsos hai tumpar) ya 'Waihakum' (Allah tumpar reham kare). (Ravi Shu'ba ko yaqeen nahi kaunsa sahi lafz tha.) 'Mere baad ek doosre ki gardanein kaat kar kaafir mat ban jaana.'

e: Narrated Anas:A bedouin came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! When will The Hour be established?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Wailaka (Woe to you), What have you prepared for it?" The bedouin said, "I have not prepared anything for it, except that I love Allah and His Apostle." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You will be with those whom you love." We (the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) ) said, "And will we too be so? The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Yes." So we became very glad on that day. In the meantime, a slave of Al-Mughira passed by, and he was of the same age as I was. The Prophet (ﷺ) said. "If this (slave) should live long, he will not reach the geriatric old age, but the Hour will be established
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek badawi Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Qayamat kab aayegi?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Wailaka (afsos hai tumpar), Tumne iske liye kya taiyaari ki hai?' Badawi ne kaha, 'Maine iske liye kuch taiyaari nahi ki, siwaaye is ke ke main Allah aur uske Rasool se mohabbat karta hoon.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Tum unhi ke saath hoge jinse tum mohabbat karte ho.' Hum (Nabi ke sahaaba) ne kaha, 'Aur kya hum bhi aise hi honge?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Haan.' To hum us din bahut khush hue. Isi dauraan, Al-Mughira ka ek ghulaam guzra, jo meri hi umar ka tha. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Agar ye (ghulaam) lambi umar jiye, to ye budhaape tak nahi pahunchega, magar Qayamat aa jaayegi.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Everyone will be with those whom he loves
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Har koi unhi ke saath hoga jinse wo mohabbat karta hai.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Mas`ud:A man came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What do you say about a man who loves some people but cannot catch up with their good deeds?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Everyone will be with those whom he loves
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Masud bataate hain: Ek shaks Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Aap us aadmi ke baare mein kya kehte hain jo kuch logon se mohabbat karta hai magar unke nek amaal tak nahi pahunch paata?' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Har koi unhi ke saath hoga jinse wo mohabbat karta hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Musa:It was said to the Prophet; , "A man may love some people but he cannot catch up with their good deeds?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Everyone will be with those whom he loves
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) se kaha gaya, 'Koi shaks kuch logon se mohabbat kar sakta hai magar unke nek amaal tak nahi pahunch paata?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Har koi unhi ke saath hoga jinse wo mohabbat karta hai.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:A man asked the Prophet (ﷺ) "When will the Hour be established O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" The Prophet (ﷺ) . said, "What have you prepared for it?" The man said, " I haven't prepared for it much of prayers or fast or alms, but I love Allah and His Apostle." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You will be with those whom you love
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks ne Nabi (SAW) se pucha, 'Qayamat kab aayegi, Aye Allah ke Rasool?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Tumne iske liye kya taiyaari ki hai?' Us shaks ne kaha, 'Maine iske liye zyaada namaz, roza ya sadqa taiyaar nahi kiya, magar main Allah aur uske Rasool se mohabbat karta hoon.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Tum unhi ke saath hoge jinse tum mohabbat karte ho.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to Ibn Saiyad "I have hidden something for you in my mind; What is it?" He said, "Ad-Dukh." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Ikhsa
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ibn Saiyad se kaha, 'Maine tumhaare liye apne zehen mein kuch chhupaa rakha hai; wo kya hai?' Usne kaha, 'Ad-Dukh.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Ikhsa (zaleel ho, hat ja)!'
(Is hadees ka asal matn maujood nahi hai — source data mein khaali chhoda gaya hai.)

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When the delegation of `Abdul Qais came to the Prophet, he said, "Welcome, O the delegation who have come! Neither you will have disgrace, nor you will regret." They said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We are a group from the tribe of Ar-Rabi`a, and between you and us there is the tribe of Mudar and we cannot come to you except in the sacred months. So please order us to do something good (religious deeds) so that we may enter Paradise by doing that, and also that we may order our people who are behind us (whom we have left behind at home) to follow it." He said, "Four and four:" offer prayers perfectly , pay the Zakat, (obligatory charity), fast the month of Ramadan, and give one-fifth of the war booty (in Allah's cause), and do not drink in (containers called) Ad-Duba,' Al-Hantam, An-Naqir and Al-Muzaffat
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Abdul Qais qabeele ka wafd (delegation) Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya, unhone kaha, 'Khush-aamdeed, Aye wafd jo aaye ho! Na tumhein zillat hogi, na tumhein pachhtaawa hoga.' Unhone kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Hum Rabi'a qabeele ka ek giroh hain, aur hamare aur aapke beech Mudar qabeela hai, aur hum Haraam mahinon ke siwa aapke paas nahi aa sakte. Isliye barah-e-meharbaani humein koi achhi baat (deeni amaal) ka hukm dijiye taake hum use karke Jannat mein daakhil ho sakein, aur taake hum apne piche chhode logon ko bhi isper amal karne ka hukm de sakein.' Unhone kaha, 'Chaar aur chaar: namaz sahi tareeke se padho, Zakat do, Ramzan ka roza rakho, aur (maal-e-ganimat ka) paanchwaan hissa do; aur Ad-Duba, Al-Hantam, An-Naqir aur Al-Muzaffat (khaas bartanon) mein mat piyo.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "For every betrayer (perfidious person), a flag will be raised on the Day of Resurrection, and it will be announced (publicly) 'This is the betrayal (perfidy) of so-and-so, the son of so-and-so
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Har dhoke-baaz (badaeenat karne wale) ke liye Qayamat ke din ek jhanda uthaaya jaayega, aur elaan kiya jaayega, "Ye falaan bin falaan ki bewafaai hai."'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "A flag will be fixed on the Day of Resurrection for every betrayer, and it will be announced (publicly in front of everybody), 'This is the betrayal (perfidy) so-and-so, the son of so-and-so
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Har dhoke-baaz ke liye Qayamat ke din ek jhanda gaada jaayega, aur (sabke saamne) elaan kiya jaayega, "Ye falaan bin falaan ki bewafaai hai."'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "None of you should say Khabuthat Nafsi, but he is recommended to say 'Laqisat Nafsi
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Tum mein se koi ye na kahe, "Khabuthat Nafsi" (meri jaan ganda ho gayi), balke use kehna chaahiye, "Laqisat Nafsi" (meri jaan bojhal ho gayi).'

e: Narrated Sal:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "None of you should say Khabuthat Nafsi but he is recommended to say 'Laqisat Nafsi (See Hadith No)
hi: Sahl bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Tum mein se koi ye na kahe, "Khabuthat Nafsi," balke use kehna chaahiye, "Laqisat Nafsi."'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah said, "The offspring of Adam abuse the Dahr (Time), and I am the Dahr; in My Hands are the night and the day
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah ne farmaaya, "Aadam ki aulaad Dahr (Waqt/Zamaana) ko bura-bhala kehti hai, jabke Dahr Main hoon; raat aur din Mere haath mein hain."'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Don't call the grapes Al-Karm, and don't say 'Khaibat-ad-Dahri, for Allah is the Dahr. (See Hadith No)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Angoor ko "Al-Karm" mat kaho, aur "Khaibat-ad-Dahri" (zamaane ki maar ho) mat kaho, kyunke Allah hi Dahr (Waqt) hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "They say Al-Karm (the generous), and in fact Al-Karm is the heart of a believer
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Log "Al-Karm" (sakhi) kehte hain, jabke asal mein Al-Karm ek Momin ka dil hai.'

e: Narrated `Ali:I never heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "Let my father and mother be sacrificed for you," except for Sa`d (bin Abi Waqqas). I heard him saying, "Throw! (arrows), Let my father and mother be sacrificed for you !" (The sub-narrator added, "I think that was in the battle of Uhud)
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kabhi kisi ke liye 'Mere maa-baap aap par qurbaan hon' kehte nahi suna, siwaaye Sa'd (bin Abi Waqqas) ke. Maine unhein ye kehte suna, 'Chalao (teer)! Mere maa-baap tumpar qurbaan hon!' (Ravi ne izaafa kiya, 'Mera khayaal hai ye jang-e-Uhud mein hua tha.')

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:That he and Abu Talha were coming in the company of the Prophet (towards Medina), while Safiya (the Prophet's wife) was riding behind him on his she-camel. After they had covered a portion of the way suddenly the foot of the she-camel slipped and both the Prophet (ﷺ) and the woman (i.e., his wife, Safiya) fell down. Abu Talha jumped quickly off his camel and came to the Prophet (saying.) "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Let Allah sacrifice me for you! Have you received any injury?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No, but take care of the woman (my wife)." Abu Talha covered his face with his garment and went towards her and threw his garment over her. Then the woman got up and Abu Talha prepared their she-camel (by tightening its saddle, etc.) and both of them (the Prophet (ﷺ) and Safiya) mounted it. Then all of them proceeded and when they approached near Medina, or saw Medina, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Ayibun, taibun, `abidun, liRabbina hamidun (We are coming back (to Medina) with repentance, worshiping (our Lord) and celebrating His (our Lord's) praises". The Prophet (ﷺ) continued repeating these words till he entered the city of Medina
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Wo aur Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) Nabi (SAW) ke saath (Madina ki taraf) aa rahe the, jabke Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki biwi) unke peechhe unki oontni par sawaar thin. Kuch raasta tay karne ke baad, achaanak oontni ka pair phisla aur Nabi (SAW) aur khaatoon (yaani unki biwi, Safiya) dono gir gaye. Abu Talha jaldi se apni oontni se utre aur Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye (kehte hue), 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Allah mujhe aap par qurbaan kare! Kya aapko koi chot aayi?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Nahi, magar khaatoon (meri biwi) ka khayaal rakho.' Abu Talha ne apna chehra apne kapde se dhaanka aur unki taraf gaye aur apna kapda unpar daala. Phir khaatoon uthi, aur Abu Talha ne unki oontni taiyaar ki (zeen kaskar), aur dono (Nabi aur Safiya) uspar sawaar hue. Phir sab aage badhe, aur jab wo Madina ke qareeb pahunche, ya Madina dekha, Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Aayibun, Taaibun, Aabidun, Li-Rabbina Haamidun' (Hum wapas aa rahe hain, tauba karte hue, ibaadat karte hue, apne Rab ki hamd karte hue). Nabi (SAW) ye alfaaz dohraate rahe jab tak wo Madina shehar mein daakhil nahi hue.

e: Narrated Jabir:A boy was born for a man among us, and the man named him Al-Qasim. We said to him, "We will not call you Abu-l-Qasim, nor will we respect you for that." The Prophet (ﷺ) was informed about that, and he said, "Name your son `Abdur-Rahman
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hamare beech ek aadmi ke ghar ek ladka paida hua, aur us aadmi ne uska naam Al-Qasim rakha. Humne usse kaha, 'Hum tumhein Abu-l-Qasim nahi kahenge, na hum tumhein iske liye izzat denge.' Isse Nabi (SAW) ko bataya gaya, aur unhone kaha, 'Apne bete ka naam Abdur Rahman rakho.'

e: Narrated Jabi:A man among us begot a boy whom he named Al-Qasim. The people said, "We will not call him (i.e., the father) by that Kuniya (Abu-l-Qasim) till we ask the Prophet (ﷺ) about it. The Prophet (ﷺ) said. "Name yourselves by my name, but do not call (yourselves) by my Kuniya
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hamare beech ek aadmi ke ghar ek ladka paida hua jiska naam usne Al-Qasim rakha. Logon ne kaha, 'Hum aapko is Kuniya (Abu-l-Qasim) se tab tak nahi pukaarenge jab tak hum Nabi (SAW) se ispar na poochh lein.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Apne naam mera naam rakho, magar apni Kuniya mujhse mat rakho.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Abu-l-Qasim (The Prophet) said, "Name yourselves by my name, but do not call yourselves by my Kuniya
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu-l-Qasim (Nabi SAW) ne farmaya, 'Apne naam mera naam rakho, magar apni Kuniya mujhse mat rakho.'

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:A man among us begot a boy whom he named Al-Qasim. The people said (to him), "We will not call you Abul-l-Qasim, nor will we please you by calling you so." The man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and mentioned that to him. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "Name your son `Abdur-Rahman
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hamare beech ek aadmi ke ghar ek ladka paida hua jiska naam usne Al-Qasim rakha. Logon ne (usse) kaha, 'Hum tumhein Abu-l-Qasim nahi kahenge, na hum tumhein aisa kehkar khush karenge.' Wo aadmi Nabi (SAW) ke paas gaya aur ye baat unhein bataayi. Nabi (SAW) ne unse kaha, 'Apne bete ka naam Abdur Rahman rakho.'

e: Narrated Al-Musaiyab:That his father (Hazn bin Wahb) went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and the Prophet (ﷺ) asked (him), "What is your name?" He replied, "My name is Hazn." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You are Sahl." Hazn said, "I will not change the name with which my father has named me." Ibn Al-Musaiyab added: We have had roughness (in character) ever since. Narrated Al-Musaiyab: on the authority of his father similarly as above (i.e)
hi: Al-Musaiyab bataate hain: Unke waalid (Hazn bin Wahb) Nabi (SAW) ke paas gaye, aur Nabi (SAW) ne (unse) pucha, 'Tumhaara naam kya hai?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Mera naam Hazn hai (yaani sakhti/mushkil).' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Tum Sahl ho (yaani aasaan).' Hazn ne kaha, 'Main us naam ko nahi badloonga jo mere waalid ne mera rakha.' Ibn Al-Musaiyab ne aage kaha: Tab se hamare (khaandaan mein) sakhti (Hazn/mushkil) ka asar raha hai.

e: Narrated Sahl:When Al-Mundhir bin Abu Usaid was born, he was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) who placed him on his thigh. While Abu Usaid was sitting there, the Prophet (ﷺ) was busy with something in his hands so Abu Usaid told someone to take his son from the thigh of the Prophet (ﷺ) . When the Prophet (ﷺ) finished his job (with which he was busy), he said, "Where is the boy?" Abu Usaid replied, "We have sent him home." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "What is his name?" Abu Usaid said, "(His name is) so-and-so. " The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No, his name is Al-Mundhir." So he called him Al-Mundhir from that day
hi: Sahl bataate hain: Jab Al-Mundhir bin Abu Usaid paida hue, unhein Nabi (SAW) ke paas laaya gaya, jinhone unhein apni jaangh par rakha. Jabke Abu Usaid wahaan baithe the, Nabi (SAW) apne haathon mein kisi kaam mein masroof the, isliye Abu Usaid ne kisi se kaha ke wo unke bete ko Nabi (SAW) ki jaangh se le lein. Jab Nabi (SAW) apna kaam (jismein wo masroof the) khatam kar chuke, unhone pucha, 'Ladka kahaan hai?' Abu Usaid ne jawab diya, 'Humne use ghar bhej diya.' Nabi (SAW) ne pucha, 'Uska naam kya hai?' Abu Usaid ne kaha, '(Uska naam) falaan hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Nahi, uska naam Al-Mundhir hai.' To unhone us din se use Al-Mundhir pukaara.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Zainab's original name was "Barrah," but it was said' "By that she is giving herself the prestige of piety." So the Prophet (ﷺ) changed her name to Zainab
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) ka asal naam 'Barrah' tha, magar kaha gaya, 'Isse wo apne aap ko takwe ki izzat de rahi hai.' Isliye Nabi (SAW) ne unka naam badalkar Zainab kar diya.

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Al-Musaiyab:That when his grandfather, Hazn visited the Prophet (ﷺ) the Prophet (ﷺ) said (to him), "What is your name?" He said, "My name is Hazn." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, " But you are Sahl." He said, "I will not change my name with which my father named me." Ibn Al-Musaiyab added: So we have had roughness (in character) ever since
hi: Saeed bin Al-Musaiyab bataate hain ke jab unke dada, Hazn, Nabi (SAW) se milne gaye, Nabi (SAW) ne (unse) pucha, 'Tumhaara naam kya hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Mera naam Hazn hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Balke tum Sahl ho.' Unhone kaha, 'Main us naam ko nahi badloonga jo mere waalid ne mera rakha.' Ibn Al-Musaiyab ne aage kaha, 'Isi wajah se, hamare (khaandaan mein) tab se sakhti (Hazn) ka asar raha hai.'

e: Narrated Isma`il:I asked Abi `Aufa, "Did you see Ibrahim, the son of the Prophet (ﷺ) ?" He said, "Yes, but he died in his early childhood. Had there been a Prophet after Muhammad then his son would have lived, but there is no Prophet after him
hi: Ismail bataate hain: Maine Abi Aufa se pucha, 'Kya aapne Ibrahim, Nabi (SAW) ke bete, ko dekha tha?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan, magar unka intekaal chhoti umar mein hi ho gaya. Agar Muhammad (SAW) ke baad koi aur Nabi hota, to unka beta zinda rehta, magar unke baad koi Nabi nahi hai.'

e: Narrated Al-Bara:When Ibrahim (the son of the Prophet) died, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "There is a wet nurse for him in Paradise
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Jab Ibrahim (Nabi ke bete) ka intekaal hua, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Unke liye Jannat mein ek doodh pilaane wali (dhaai) hai.'

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah Al-Ansari:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Name yourselves after me (by my name) but do not call (yourselves) by my Kuniya (1), for I am Al-Qasim (distributor), and I distribute among you Allah's blessings." This narration has also come on the authority of Anas that the ! Prophet said so
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ansari bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Apne naam mera naam rakho (mere naam par), magar apni Kuniya mujhse mat rakho, kyunke main Al-Qasim (baantne wala) hoon, aur main tum mein Allah ki barkatein baantta hoon.' Ye riwayat Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke hawaale se bhi aayi hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne aisa kaha.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Name yourselves after me (by my name), but do not call yourselves by my Kuniya, and whoever sees me in a dream, he surely sees me, for Satan cannot impersonate me (appear in my figure). And whoever intentionally ascribes something to me falsely, he will surely take his place in the (Hell) Fire
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Apne naam mera naam rakho, magar apni Kuniya mujhse mat rakho, aur jo koi mujhe khwaab mein dekhta hai, wo waaqai mujhe dekhta hai, kyunke Shaitaan meri shakl nahi dhaar sakta. Aur jo koi jaan-boojh kar mujh par jhoothi baat manzoob kare, wo zaroor Jahannam ki Aag mein apni jagah paayega.'

e: Narrated Abu Musa:I got a son and I took him to the Prophet (ﷺ) who named him Ibrahim, and put in his mouth the juice of a date fruit (which be himself had chewed?, and invoked for Allah's blessing upon him, and then gave him back to me. He was the eldest son of Abu Musa)
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Mere ghar ek beta paida hua aur main use Nabi (SAW) ke paas le gaya, jinhone uska naam Ibrahim rakha, khajoor ka ras (jo unhone khud chabaaya tha) uske munh mein daala, Allah se uske liye barkat ki dua ki, phir use mujhe wapas kar diya. (Ye Abu Musa ka sabse bada beta tha.)

e: Narrated Al-Mughira bin Shuba:Solar eclipse occurred on the day of Ibrahim's death (the Prophet's son)
hi: Al-Mughira bin Shu'ba (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Suraj grahan Ibrahim (Nabi ke bete) ki maut ke din hua.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah (ra):When the Prophet (ﷺ) (once) raised his head after bowing [in the Salat (prayer)] he said, "O Allah, save Al-Walid bin Al-Walid and Salama bin Hisham and 'Aiyyash bin Abu Rabi'a and the helpless weak believers of Makkah. O Allah, be hard on the tribe of Mudar. O Allah, send on them (famine-drought) years like the (famine-drought) years of (the Prophet) Yusuf (Joseph)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Nabi (SAW) ne (namaz mein) ruku se sar uthaaya, unhone kaha, 'Aye Allah! Al-Walid bin Al-Walid, Salama bin Hisham, Ayyash bin Abi Rabi'a, aur Makkah ke kamzor, laachaar Momineen ko bacha. Aye Allah! Mudar qabeele par sakhti kar. Aye Allah! Unpar Yusuf (Nabi) ke daur jaisa qehat (aakaal) bhej.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O Aisha! This is Gabriel sending his greetings to you." I said, "Peace, and Allah's Mercy be on him." `Aisha added: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to see things which we used not to see
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki zawja) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Aye Aisha! Ye Jibrael hain jo tumhein salaam bhej rahe hain.' Maine kaha, 'Unpar salaam aur Allah ki rehmat ho.' Aisha ne aage kaha: Nabi (SAW) aisi cheezein dekha karte the jo hum nahi dekh paate the.

e: Narrated Anas:Once Um Sulaim was (with the women who were) in charge of the luggage on a journey, and Anjashah, the slave of the Prophet, was driving their camels (very fast). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Anjash! Drive slowly (the camels) with the glass vessels (i.e., ladies)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Umm Sulaim (رضی اللہ عنہا) (un auraton mein se the jo saamaan sambhaal rahi thi) safar mein the, aur Anjasha (رضی اللہ عنہ), Nabi (SAW) ke ghulaam, oonton ko (bahut tez) haank rahe the. Nabi (SAW) ne unse kaha, 'Aye Anjasha! (Naazuk) shishe ke bartanon (yaani auraton) ko lekar dheere-dheere chalo.'

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) was the best of all the people in character. I had a brother called Abu `Umar, who, I think, had been newly weaned. Whenever he (that child) was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) the Prophet (ﷺ) used to say, "O Abu `Umar! What did Al-Nughair (nightingale) (do)?" It was a nightingale with which he used to play. Sometimes the time of the Prayer became due while he (the Prophet) was in our house. He would order that the carpet underneath him be swept and sprayed with water, and then he would stand up (for the prayer) and we would line up behind him, and he would lead us in prayer
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) sab logon mein charitra ke lihaz se sabse behtar the. Mera ek chhota bhai tha jise Abu Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) kaha jaata tha, jo (mera khayaal hai) haal hi mein doodh chhoda gaya tha. Jab bhi use Nabi (SAW) ke paas laaya jaata, Nabi (SAW) kehte, 'Aye Abu Umar! Nughair (bulbul) ne kya kiya?' Ye ek bulbul thi jisse wo khela karta tha. Kabhi-kabhi namaz ka waqt aa jaata jab Nabi (SAW) hamare ghar mein hote. Wo hukm dete ke unke neeche ki chataayi jhaadi jaaye aur usmein paani chhidka jaaye, phir wo (namaz ke liye) khade hote aur hum unke peechhe qataar mein khade hote, aur wo humein namaz padhaate.

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:The most beloved names to `Ali was Abu Turab, and he used to be pleased when we called him by it, for none named him Abu Turab (for the first time), but the Prophet. Once `Ali got angry with (his wife) Fatima, and went out (of his house) and slept near a wall in the mosque. The Prophet (ﷺ) came searching for him, and someone said, "He is there, Lying near the wall." The Prophet (ﷺ) came to him while his (`Ali's) back was covered with dust. The Prophet (ﷺ) started removing the dust from his back, saying, "Get up, O Abu Turab
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke sabse aziz naamon mein 'Abu Turab' tha, aur wo khush hote the jab hum unhein isse pukaarte, kyunke sirf Nabi (SAW) ne unhein ye naam diya tha (pehli baar). Ek baar Ali (Alayhis Salam) apni biwi (Fatima (Alayhas Salam)) se gussa hokar (ghar se) baahar chale gaye aur Masjid ki ek deewaar ke paas so gaye. Nabi (SAW) unhein dhoondhte hue aaye, aur kisi ne kaha, 'Wo wahaan hain, deewaar ke paas letā hua.' Nabi (SAW) unke paas aaye jabke unki peeth mitti se dhaki hui thi. Nabi (SAW) unki peeth se mitti hataane lage, kehte hue, 'Utho, Aye Abu Turab (mitti ke baap)!'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The most awful name in Allah's sight on the Day of Resurrection, will be (that of) a man calling himself Malik Al-Amlak (the king of kings)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah ke nazdeek Qayamat ke din sabse ghatiya naam us aadmi ka hoga jo khud ko "Malik-ul-Amlak" (baadshaahon ka baadshah) kehta hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The most awful (meanest) name in Allah's sight." Sufyan said more than once, "The most awful (meanest) name in Allah's sight is (that of) a man calling himself king of kings." Sufyan said, "Somebody else (i.e. other than Abu Az-Zinad, a sub-narrator) says: What is meant by 'The king of kings' is 'Shahan Shah
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah ke nazdeek sabse ghatiya (buri) naam...' Ravi Sufyan ne ek se zyaada baar kaha, 'Allah ke nazdeek sabse ghatiya naam us aadmi ka hai jo khud ko "baadshahon ka baadshah" kehta hai.' Sufyan kehte hain, 'Kisi aur (Abu Az-Zinad ke ilaawa ek doosre ravi) ne kaha: "Baadshahon ka baadshah" se murad "Shahan Shah" hai.'

e: Narrated Usama bin Zaid:That Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) rode over a donkey covered with a Fadakiya (velvet sheet) and Usama was riding behind him. He was visiting Sa`d bin 'Ubada (who was sick) in the dwelling place of Bani Al-Harith bin Al-Khazraj and this incident happened before the battle of Badr. They proceeded till they passed by a gathering in which `Abdullah bin Ubai bin Salul was present., and that was before `Abdullah bin Ubat embraced Islam. In that gathering there were Muslims, pagan idolators and Jews, and among the Muslims there was `Abdullah bin Rawaha. When a cloud of dust raised by (the movement of ) the animal covered that gathering, `Abdullah bin Ubai covered his nose with his garment and said, "Do not cover us with dust." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) greeted them, stopped, dismounted and invited them to Allah (i.e. to embrace Islam) and recited to them the Holy Qur'an. On that `Abdullah bin Ubai bin Salul said to him, "O man! There is nothing better than what you say, if it is the truth. So do not trouble us with it in our gatherings, but if somebody comes to you, you can preach to him." On that `Abdullah bin Rawaha said "Yes, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Call on us in our gathering, for we love that." So the Muslims, the pagans and the Jews started abusing one another till they were about to fight with one another. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) kept on quietening them till all of them became quiet, and then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) rode his animal and proceeded till he entered upon Sa`d bin 'Ubada. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O Sa`d! Didn't you hear what Abu Habab said?" (meaning `Abdullah bin Unbar). "He said so-and-so." Sa`d bin Ubada said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Let my father be sacrificed for you ! Excuse and forgive him for, by Him Who revealed to you the Book, Allah sent the Truth which was revealed to you at the time when the people of this town had decided to crown him (`Abdullah bin Ubai) as their ruler. So when Allah had prevented that with the Truth He had given you, he was choked by that, and that caused him to behave in such an impolite manner which you had noticed." So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) excused him. (It was the custom of) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and his companions to excuse the pagans and the people of the scripture (Christians and Jews) as Allah ordered them, and they used to be patient when annoyed (by them). Allah said: 'You shall certainly hear much that will grieve you from those who received the Scripture before you.....and from the pagans (3.186) He also said: 'Many of the people of the scripture wish that if they could turn you away as disbelievers after you have believed. .... (2.109) So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to apply what Allah had ordered him by excusing them till he was allowed to fight against them. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had fought the battle of Badr and Allah killed whomever He killed among the chiefs of the infidels and the nobles of Quraish, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and his companions had returned with victory and booty, bringing with them some of the chiefs of the infidels and the nobles of the Quraish as captives. `Abdullah bin Ubai bin Salul and the pagan idolators who were with him, said, "This matter (Islam) has now brought out its face (triumphed), so give Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) the pledge of allegiance (for embracing Islam.)". Then they became Muslims
hi: Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek gadhe par sawaar hue jispar Fadakiyya makhmal ki chaadar thi, aur Usama unke peechhe sawaar the. Wo Sa'd bin Ubada (رضی اللہ عنہ) (jo bimar the) se milne Banu Al-Harith bin Al-Khazraj ke ilaake mein gaye, aur ye jang-e-Badr se pehle ki baat hai. Wo chalte rahe yahaan tak ke ek majlis ke paas se guzre jismein Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ubai bin Salul maujood the, aur ye Abdullah ke Islam qubool karne se pehle ki baat hai. Us majlis mein Musalmaan, mushrik aur Yahudi the, aur Musalmaanon mein Abdullah bin Rawaha bhi the. Jab jaanwar ki uthaayi hui dhool us majlis par pad gayi, Abdullah bin Ubai ne apni chaadar se apni naak dhaank li aur kaha, 'Humein apni dhool se takleef mat do.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhein salaam kiya, ruke, utre aur unhein Allah ki taraf (Islam qubool karne ki) dawat di aur unhein paak Quran padh kar sunaaya. Isper Abdullah bin Ubai bin Salul ne unse kaha, 'Aye aadmi! Agar tum jo kehte ho wo sach hai, to usse behtar kuch nahi, magar humaari majlison mein humein isse takleef mat do, apne ghar wapas jao, aur agar koi tumhaare paas aaye to use wahaan taleem do.' Isper Abdullah bin Rawaha ne kaha, 'Haan, Aye Allah ke Rasool! Humaari majlis mein aakar humein sikhaayiye, kyunke humein ye pasand hai.' To Musalmaan, mushrik aur Yahudi ek doosre ko bura-bhala kehne lage yahaan tak ke wo ladne ke qareeb pahunch gaye. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unhein shaant karte rahe yahaan tak ke wo sab shaant ho gaye, phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apni sawaari par sawaar hue aur chalte rahe yahaan tak ke wo Sa'd bin Ubada ke paas pahunche. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Aye Sa'd! Kya tumne suna nahi Abu Habab (yaani Abdullah bin Ubai) ne kya kaha?' Unhone kaha ke usne aisa-aisa kaha. Sa'd bin Ubada ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mere waalid aap par qurbaan hon! Unhein maaf kar dijiye aur darguzar kijiye, kyunke, us Zaat ki qasam jisne aap par Kitaab naazil ki, Allah ne Haq (Islam) us waqt naazil kiya jab is shehar ke log unhein (Abdullah bin Ubai ko) apna hukmraan banaane ka faisla kar chuke the. To jab Allah ne aapko di gayi Haq ke zariye usse roka, to wo isse ghut gaye, aur isi wajah se unhone waisa bewaqoofi bhara suluk kiya jaisa aapne dekha.' To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhein maaf kar diya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur unke sahaaba mushrikeen aur Ahl-e-Kitaab ko maaf kar diya karte the, jaisa Allah ne unhein hukm diya tha, aur wo (unse takleef milne par) sabra karte the. Allah farmaata hai: 'Tum zaroor unse jinhein tumse pehle Kitaab di gayi... aur mushrikon se bahut si takleef-dey baatein sunoge' (3.186). Usne ye bhi farmaaya: 'Ahl-e-Kitaab mein se bahut se chahte hain ke tumhein Iman laane ke baad kaafir bana kar wapas mod dein...' (2.109). To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) usi tarah amal karte rahe jaisa Allah ne unhein maaf karne ka hukm diya tha, yahaan tak ke unhein unke khilaaf jang karne ki ijaazat mil gayi. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne jang-e-Badr ladi aur Allah ne kaafiron ke sardaaron aur Quraish ke sharifon mein se jinhein maara wo maare gaye, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur unke sahaaba fatah aur maal-e-ganimat lekar laute, kuch kaafiron ke sardaar aur Quraish ke sharifon ko qaidi banaakar laaye, Abdullah bin Ubai bin Salul aur unke saath ke mushrikeen ne kaha, 'Is maamle (Islam) ne ab apna asar dikhaaya hai, isliye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se baiyat karo.' Phir wo Musalmaan ho gaye.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Al-Harith bin Naufal:`Abbas bin `Abdul Muttalib said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Did you benefit Abu Talib with anything as he used to protect and take care of you, and used to become angry for you?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Yes, he is in a shallow place of Fire. Were it not for me, he would have been in the bottom-most depth of the Fire
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Harith bin Naufal bataate hain: Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya aapne Abu Talib ko kisi cheez se faayda pahunchaya, kyunke wo aapki hifaazat aur dekhbhaal kiya karte the, aur aapke liye gussa hote the?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Haan, wo Aag ke ek uthle (halke) hisse mein hain. Agar main na hota, to wo Aag ki sabse gehri jagah mein hote.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) was on one of his journeys, and the driver of the camels started chanting (to let the camels go fast). The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him. "(Take care) Drive slowly with the glass vessels, O Anjasha! Waihaka (May Allah be Merciful to you)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Nabi (SAW) apne kisi safar mein the, aur oonton ke haankne wale ne (unhein tez le jaane ke liye) Huda gaana shuru kiya. Nabi (SAW) ne unse kaha, '(Khayaal rakho) shishe ke bartanon ke saath dheere-dheere chalo, Aye Anjasha (رضی اللہ عنہ)! Waihaka (Allah tumpar reham kare).'

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) was on a journey and a slave named Anjasha was chanting (singing) for the camels to let them go fast (while driving). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Anjasha, drive slowly (the camels) with the glass vessels!" Abu Qilaba said, "By the glass vessels' he meant the women (riding the camels)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) safar mein the, aur Anjasha (رضی اللہ عنہ) naami ek ghulaam oonton ke liye (unhein tez le jaane ke liye) gaana gaa raha tha. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Aye Anjasha! Shishe ke bartanon ko lekar dheere chalo!' Abu Qilaba kehte hain, 'Shishe ke bartanon' se unka ishara un auraton ki taraf tha jo oonton par sawaar thin.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) had a Had (a camel driver) called Anjasha, and he had a nice voice. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "(Drive) slowly, O Anjasha! Do not break the glass vessels!" And Qatada said, "(By vessels') he meant the weak women
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ke paas Anjasha (رضی اللہ عنہ) naami ek Had (oont haankne wala) tha, aur uski aawaaz achhi thi. Nabi (SAW) ne unse kaha, '(Chalao) dheere se, Aye Anjasha! Shishe ke bartan mat todo!' Aur Qatada kehte hain, '(Bartanon) se unka ishara kamzor auraton ki taraf tha.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:There was a state of fear in Medina. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) rode a horse belonging to Abu Talha (in order to see the matter). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "We could not see anything, and we found that horse like a sea (fast in speed)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Madina mein khauf ka mahaul tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) ka ek ghoda sawaar kiya (maamle ko dekhne ke liye). Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Humein kuch nazar nahi aaya, aur humein wo ghoda samundar jaisa (tezi mein) laga.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:Some people asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about the fore-tellers. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to them, "They are nothing (i.e., liars)." The people said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ! Sometimes they tell something which comes out to be true." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "That word which comes to be true is what a jinx snatches away by stealing and then pours it in the ear of his fore-teller with a sound similar to the cackle of a hen, and then they add to it one-hundred lies
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Kuch logon ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se jyotishiyon (foretellers) ke baare mein pucha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha, 'Wo kuch nahi hain (yaani jhoote hain).' Logon ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kabhi-kabhi wo kuch aisi baat batate hain jo sach nikalti hai.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Jo baat sach nikalti hai wo wahi hai jo ek Jinn chura kar apne jyotishi ke kaan mein daalta hai, murgi ki aawaaz jaisi ek aawaaz ke saath, phir wo (jyotishi) usmein sau jhoot mila deta hai.'

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:That he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying. "Then there was a pause in the revelation of the Divine Inspiration to me. Then while I was walking all of a sudden I heard a voice from the sky, and I raised my sight towards the sky and saw the same angel who had visited me in the cave of Hira,' sitting on a chair between the sky and the earth
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, 'Phir wahi (Divine Revelation) mujhpar naazil hone mein ek waqfa aa gaya. Phir jab main chal raha tha, achaanak maine aasman se ek aawaaz suni, aur maine apni nigaah aasman ki taraf uthaayi aur wahi farishta dekha jo Hira ki gufaa mein mere paas aaya tha, ek kursi par baithe hue aasman aur zameen ke beech.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Once I stayed overnight at the house of Maimuna and the Prophet (ﷺ) was there with her. When it was the last third of the night, or some part of the night, the Prophet (ﷺ) got up looking towards the sky and recited: 'Verily! In the creation of the heavens and the earth, and in the alternation of Night and Day, there are indeed signs for men of u understanding
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar main Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke ghar raat guzaari aur Nabi (SAW) unke saath the. Jab raat ka aakhri tihaai hissa (ya raat ka kuch hissa) aaya, Nabi (SAW) uthe, aasman ki taraf dekha aur padha: 'Beshak, aasmaanon aur zameen ki takhleeq mein, aur raat aur din ke badalne mein, aqlmand logon ke liye zaroor nishaaniyaan hain.'

e: Narrated Abu Musa:That he was in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) in one of the gardens of Medina and in the hand of the Prophet there was a stick, and he was striking (slowly) the water and the mud with it. A man came (at the gate of the garden) and asked permission to enter. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Open the gate for him and give him the glad tidings of entering Paradise. "I went, and behold! It was Abu Bakr. So I opened the gate for him and informed him of the glad tidings of entering Paradise. Then another man came and asked permission to enter. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Open the gate for him and give him the glad tidings of entering Paradise." Behold! It was `Umar. So I opened the gate for him and gave him the glad tidings of entering Paradise. Then another man came and asked permission to enter. The Prophet (ﷺ) was sitting in a leaning posture, so he sat up and said, "Open the gate for him and give him the glad tidings of entering Paradise with a calamity which will befall him or which will take place." I went, and behold ! It was `Uthman. So I opened the gate for him and gave him the glad tidings of entering Paradise and also informed him of what the Prophet (ﷺ) had said (about a calamity). `Uthman said, "Allah Alone Whose Help I seek (against that calamity)
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke wo Nabi (SAW) ke saath Madina ke ek baag mein the, aur Nabi (SAW) ke haath mein ek lakdi thi, aur wo usse (dheere) paani aur kichad ko chhoo rahe the. Ek shaks aaya (baag ke darwaaze par) aur andar aane ki ijaazat maangi. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Uske liye darwaaza kholo aur use Jannat mein daakhil hone ki khush-khabri do.' Main gaya, aur wo Abu Bakr the. To maine unke liye darwaaza khola aur unhein Jannat mein daakhil hone ki khush-khabri di. Phir ek aur shaks aaya aur andar aane ki ijaazat maangi. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Uske liye darwaaza kholo aur use Jannat mein daakhil hone ki khush-khabri do.' Wo Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) the. To maine unke liye darwaaza khola aur unhein Jannat mein daakhil hone ki khush-khabri di. Phir ek aur shaks aaya aur andar aane ki ijaazat maangi. Nabi (SAW) tek lagaaye baithe the, isliye wo seedhe baith gaye aur kaha, 'Uske liye darwaaza kholo aur use Jannat mein daakhil hone ki khush-khabri do, ek museebat ke saath jo unpar aayegi (ya hogi).' Main gaya, aur wo Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) the. To maine unke liye darwaaza khola aur unhein Jannat mein daakhil hone ki khush-khabri di aur Nabi (SAW) ke kahe (museebat ke baare mein) bhi bataaya. Uthman ne kaha, 'Sirf Allah hi hai jiski madad maangi jaaye (is museebat ke khilaaf).'

e: Narrated `Ali:We were with the Prophet (ﷺ) in a funeral procession, and he started scraping the ground with a small stick and said, "There is none amongst you but has been assigned a place (either) in Paradise and (or) in the Hell-Fire." The people said (to him), "Should we not depend upon it?" He said: carry on doing (good) deeds, for everybody will find easy such deeds as will lead him to his destined place. He then recited: "As for him who gives (in charity) and keeps his duty to Allah
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Hum Nabi (SAW) ke saath ek janaaze ke jaloos mein the, aur unhone zameen ko ek chhoti lakdi se khurachna shuru kiya aur kaha, 'Tum mein se koi bhi aisa nahi hai jiske liye Jannat ya Jahannam mein jagah muqarrar na ki gayi ho.' Logon ne (unse) kaha, 'To kya hum isi par bharosa na karein (aur amal chhod dein)?' Unhone kaha, 'Amal karte raho, kyunke har koi wahi amaal aasaani se karega jo use uski muqarrar jagah tak le jaayenge.' Phir unhone padha: 'Jo koi (sadqe mein) deta hai aur Allah se darta hai...'

e: Narrated Um Salama:(One night) the Prophet (ﷺ) woke up and said, "Subhan Allah ! How many treasures have been (disclosed) sent down! And how many afflictions have been descended! Who will go and wake the sleeping ladyoccupants up of these dwellings (for praying)?" (He meant by this his wives.) The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "A well-dressed soul (person) in this world may be naked in the "Hereafter." `Umar said, "I asked the Prophet, 'Have you divorced your wives?' He said, 'No.' I said, 'Allahu Akbar
hi: Umm Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: (Ek raat) Nabi (SAW) uthe aur kaha, 'Subhan Allah! Kitne hi khazaane (zaahir hokar) naazil hue hain! Aur kitni hi museebaten naazil hui hain! Kaun jaakar in kamron mein sone wali khawaateen ko jagayega (namaz ke liye)?' (Unka ishara apni biwiyon ki taraf tha.) Nabi (SAW) ne izaafa kiya, 'Is duniya mein achhe kapde pehne ek jaan Aakhirat mein nangi ho sakti hai.' Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Maine Nabi (SAW) se pucha, "Kya aapne apni biwiyon ko talaaq de di hai?" Unhone kaha, "Nahi." Maine kaha, "Allahu Akbar."'

e: Narrated Safiya bint Huyai:The wife of the Prophet (ﷺ) that she went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while he was in I`tikaf (staying in the mosque) during the last ten nights of the month of Ramadan. She spoke to him for an hour (a while) at night and then she got up to return home. The Prophet (ﷺ) got up to accompany her, and when they reached the gate of the mosque opposite the dwelling place of Um Salama, the wife of the Prophet, two Ansari men passed by, and greeting Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) , they quickly went ahead. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to them, "Do not be in a hurry She is Safiya, the daughter of Huyai." They said, "Subhan Allah! O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (how dare we suspect you)." That was a great thing for both of them. The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "Satan runs in the body of Adam's son (i.e. man) as his blood circulates in it, and I was afraid that he (Satan) might insert an evil thought in your hearts
hi: Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Huyai (Nabi ki zawja) bataati hain: Wo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gayi jabke wo Ramzan ke aakhri das dinon mein Itikaaf mein baithe hue the. Unhone raat mein ek ghante unse baat ki, phir apne ghar wapas jaane ke liye uthi. Nabi (SAW) unhein chhodne ke liye uthe, aur jab wo Masjid ke darwaaze par pahunche jo Umm Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا), Nabi ki zawja, ke ghar ke saamne tha, do Ansaari aadmi guzre, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko salaam karte hue jaldi se aage badh gaye. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha, 'Jaldi mat karo; ye Safiya, Huyai ki beti, hain.' Unhone kaha, 'Subhan Allah! Aye Allah ke Rasool! (Hum aapke baare mein shak kaise kar sakte hain).' Ye dono ke liye ek badi baat thi. Nabi (SAW) ne phir kaha, 'Shaitaan Aadam ke bete (yaani insaan) ke jism mein aise daudta hai jaise uska khoon daudta hai, aur mujhe dar tha ke wo (Shaitaan) tumhaare dilon mein koi bura khayaal na daal de.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Mughaffal Al-Muzani:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the throwing of stones (with the thumb and the index or middle finger), and said "It neither hunts a game nor kills (or hurts) an enemy, but it gouges out an eye or breaks a tooth
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Mughaffal Al-Muzani bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne kankar phenkne (angoothe aur shahaadat ya beech ki ungli se) se mana kiya, aur kaha, 'Isse na shikaar hota hai na dushman ko maara ya takleef pahunchaayi jaa sakti hai, magar isse aankh phoot sakti hai ya daant toot sakta hai.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Two men sneezed before the Prophet. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to one of them, "May Allah bestow His Mercy on you," but he did not say that to the other. On being asked (why), the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "That one praised Allah (at the time of sneezing), while the other did not praise Allah
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Do aadmi Nabi (SAW) ke saamne chheenke. Nabi (SAW) ne unmein se ek se kaha, 'Allah tumpar reham kare,' magar doosre se nahi kaha. Pucha gaya (kyun), Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Us shaks ne Allah ki hamd ki (chheenkte waqt), jabke doosre ne nahi ki.'

e: Narrated Al-Bara:The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered us to do seven (things) and forbade us from seven (other things): He ordered us to pay a visit to the sick, to follow funeral possessions, to say: May Allah be merciful to you to a sneezer, - if he says: Praise be to Allah, to accept invitation (invitation to a wedding banquet), to return greetings, to help the oppressed, and to help others to fulfill their oaths (provided it was not sinful). And he forbade us from seven (things): to wear golden rings or golden bangles, to wear silk (cloth), Dibaj, Sundus and Mayathir
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne humein saat cheezon ka hukm diya aur saat se mana kiya: Unhone humein hukm diya bimaar ki mizaajpursi karne, janaaze ke jaloos mein shaamil hone, chheenkne wale se 'Allah tumpar reham kare' kehne agar wo 'Alhamdulillah' kahe, dawat qubool karne (shaadi ki dawat), salaam ka jawab dene, mazloom ki madad karne, aur doosron ko unki qasmein poori karne mein madad karne ka. Aur unhone humein mana kiya sone ki anguthiyaan ya sone ki chudiyaan pehanne se, resham, Dibaj, Sundus aur Mayathir pehanne se.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah likes sneezing and dislikes yawning, so if someone sneezes and then praises Allah, then it is obligatory on every Muslim who heard him, to say: May Allah be merciful to you (Yar-hamuka-l-lah). But as regards yawning, it is from Satan, so one must try one's best to stop it, if one says 'Ha' when yawning, Satan will laugh at him
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah ko chheenkna pasand hai aur jamhaai (uba-si aana) napasand hai, isliye agar koi chheenke aur phir Allah ki hamd kare, to har Musalmaan jisne use suna use kehna chaahiye, "Yarhamuk-Allah" (Allah tumpar reham kare). Magar jahaan tak jamhaai ki baat hai, ye Shaitaan ki taraf se hai, isliye insaan ko apni poori koshish karni chaahiye ise rokne ki; agar koi jamhaai lete waqt "Ha" kahe, to Shaitaan uspar hansta hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, " If anyone of you sneezes, he should say 'Al-Hamduli l-lah' (Praise be to Allah), and his (Muslim) brother or companion should say to him, 'Yar-hamuka-l-lah' (May Allah bestow his Mercy on you). When the latter says 'Yar-hamuka-llah", the former should say, 'Yahdikumul-lah wa Yuslih balakum' (May Allah give you guidance and improve your condition)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar tum mein se koi chheenke, use "Al-Hamdulillah" (sab tareef Allah ke liye hai) kehna chaahiye, aur uska (Musalmaan) bhai ya saathi use kahe, "Yarhamuk-Allah" (Allah tumpar reham kare). Jab ye kaha jaaye, pehle wale ko kehna chaahiye, "Yahdikumul-lah wa Yuslih balakum" (Allah tumhein hidaayat de aur tumhaari haalat behtar kare).'

e: Narrated Anas:Two men sneezed before the Prophet (ﷺ) and he said Tashmit to one of them, while he did not say Tashmit to the other. So that man said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! You said Tashmit to that fellow but you did not say Tashmit to me. "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "That man praised Allah, but you did not praise Allah
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Do aadmi Nabi (SAW) ke saamne chheenke, aur unhone ek se Tashmit (Yarhamuk-Allah) kaha, magar doosre se nahi kaha. Isper us aadmi ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Aapne us shaks se Tashmit kaha magar mujhse nahi kaha.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Us shaks ne Allah ki hamd ki, magar tumne nahi ki.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah loves sneezing but dislikes yawning; so if anyone of you sneezes and then praises Allah, every Muslim who hears him (praising Allah) has to say Tashmit to him. But as regards yawning, it is from Satan, so if one of you yawns, he should try his best to stop it, for when anyone of you yawns, Satan laughs at him
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah ko chheenkna pasand hai magar jamhaai napasand hai; isliye agar tum mein se koi chheenke aur phir Allah ki hamd kare, to har Musalmaan jo use (hamd karte) sune, use Tashmit kehna chaahiye. Magar jahaan tak jamhaai ki baat hai, ye Shaitaan ki taraf se hai, isliye agar tum mein se koi jamhaai le, use apni poori koshish karni chaahiye ise rokne ki, kyunke jab tum mein se koi jamhaai leta hai, Shaitaan uspar hansta hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah created Adam in His picture, sixty cubits (about 30 meters) in height. When He created him, He said (to him), "Go and greet that group of angels sitting there, and listen what they will say in reply to you, for that will be your greeting and the greeting of your offspring." Adam (went and) said, 'As-Salamu alaikum (Peace be upon you).' They replied, 'AsSalamu-'Alaika wa Rahmatullah (Peace and Allah's Mercy be on you) So they increased 'Wa Rahmatullah' The Prophet (ﷺ) added 'So whoever will enter Paradise, will be of the shape and picture of Adam Since then the creation of Adam's (offspring) (i.e. stature of human beings is being diminished continuously) to the present time
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah ne Aadam ko apni soorat mein banaaya, saath haath (taqreeban 30 meter) lambe. Jab usne unhein banaaya, usne (unse) kaha, "Jaao aur wahaan baithe farishton ke us giroh ko salaam karo, aur suno wo tumhein jawab mein kya kahte hain, kyunke wahi tumhaara aur tumhaari aulaad ka salaam hoga." Aadam (gaye aur) kaha, "As-Salamu Alaikum" (Tumpar salaamati ho). Unhone jawab diya, "As-Salamu-Alaika wa Rahmatullah" (Tumpar salaamati aur Allah ki rehmat ho). To unhone "Wa Rahmatullah" izaafa kiya.' Nabi (SAW) ne aage kaha, 'Jo koi bhi Jannat mein daakhil hoga, wo Aadam ki shakl-o-soorat ka hoga. Tab se Aadam ki (aulaad ki) takhleeq (yaani insaanon ka qad) lagataar ghatta chala aa raha hai aaj tak.'
