e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abbas:Al-Fadl bin `Abbas rode behind the Prophet (ﷺ) as his companion rider on the back portion of his she camel on the Day of Nahr (slaughtering of sacrifice, 10th Dhul-Hijja) and Al-Fadl was a handsome man. The Prophet (ﷺ) stopped to give the people verdicts. In the meantime, a beautiful woman From the tribe of Khath'am came, asking the verdict of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Al-Fadl started looking at her as her beauty attracted him. The Prophet (ﷺ) looked behind while Al-Fadl was looking at her; so the Prophet (ﷺ) held out his hand backwards and caught the chin of Al-Fadl and turned his face (to the owner sides in order that he should not gaze at her. She said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! The obligation of Performing Hajj enjoined by Allah on His worshipers, has become due (compulsory) on my father who is an old man and who cannot sit firmly on the riding animal. Will it be sufficient that I perform Hajj on his behalf?" He said, "Yes
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Al-Fadl bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) Nahr ke din (10 Zul-Hijja qurbaani ka din) Nabi (SAW) ke saath unki oontni ki peeth par sawaar the, aur Al-Fadl khoobsoorat aadmi the. Nabi (SAW) log fatwa dene ke liye ruke. Isi dauraan Khath'am qabeele ki ek khoobsoorat khaatoon aayi, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se fatwa poochhne. Al-Fadl unhein dekhne lage kyunke unki khoobsoorati ne unhein aakarshit kiya. Nabi (SAW) ne peeche mudkar dekha jabke Al-Fadl unhein dekh rahe the; to Nabi (SAW) ne apna haath peeche badhaakar Al-Fadl ki thodi pakadi aur unka chehra doosri taraf mod diya taake wo (khaatoon ko) na taakein. Khaatoon ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Allah ne apne bandon par Hajj ka jo farz rakha hai, wo mere waalid par bhi farz ho chuka hai, jo ek boodhe aadmi hain aur sawaari par theek se baith nahi sakte. Kya ye kaafi hoga agar main unki taraf se Hajj karoon?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan.'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Beware! Avoid sitting on the roads." They (the people) said, "O Allah's Apostle! We can't help sitting (on the roads) as these are (our places) here we have talks." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'If you refuse but to sit, then pay the road its right ' They said, "What is the right of the road, O Allah's Apostle?" He said, 'Lowering your gaze, refraining from harming others, returning greeting, and enjoining what is good, and forbidding what is evil
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Khabardaar! Raaston par baithne se bacho.' Logon ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Hum (raaston par) baithe bagair nahi reh sakte, kyunke ye (hamaari jagah) hain jahaan hum baaten karte hain.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Agar tum baithne se inkaar karte ho, to raaste ka haq ada karo.' Unhone kaha, 'Raaste ka haq kya hai, Aye Allah ke Rasool?' Unhone kaha, 'Apni nazar neechi rakhna, doosron ko takleef na dena, salaam ka jawab dena, aur achhi baat ki taakeed karna, aur buraai se rokna.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:When we prayed with the Prophet (ﷺ) we used to say: As-Salam be on Allah from His worshipers, As- Salam be on Gabriel, As-Salam be on Michael, As-Salam be on so-and-so. When the Prophet (ﷺ) finished his prayer, he faced us and said, "Allah Himself is As-Salam (Peace), so when one sits in the prayer, one should say, 'at-Tahiyatu-li l-lahi Was-Salawatu, Wat-Taiyibatu, As-Salamu 'Alaika aiyuhan- Nabiyyu wa Rah-matul-iahi wa Barakatuhu, As-Salamu 'Alaina wa 'ala 'Ibadillahi assalihin, for if he says so, then it will be for all the pious slave of Allah in the Heavens and the Earth. (Then he should say), 'Ash-hadu an la ilaha illalllahu wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan `Abduhu wa rasulu-hu,' and then he can choose whatever speech (i.e. invocation) he wishes " (See Hadith No. 797, Vol)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab hum Nabi (SAW) ke saath namaz padhte, hum kehte, 'As-Salaam Allah par ho uske bandon ki taraf se, As-Salaam Jibrael par ho, As-Salaam Mikael par ho, As-Salaam falaan-falaan par ho.' Jab Nabi (SAW) ne apni namaz khatam ki, unhone hamaari taraf mudkar kaha, 'Allah khud As-Salaam (Shanti) hai, isliye jab koi namaz mein baithe, use kehna chaahiye, "At-Tahiyyatu-Lillahi Was-Salawatu, Wat-Taiyibatu, As-Salamu Alaika Aiyuhan-Nabiyyu wa Rahmatullahi wa Barakatuhu, As-Salamu Alaina wa Ala Ibadillahis-Saaliheen," kyunke agar wo aisa kahe, to ye aasman aur zameen ke sab neik bandon ke liye ho jaayega. (Phir use kehna chaahiye,) "Ash-hadu An La Ilaha Illallahu Wa Ash-hadu Anna Muhammadan Abduhu Wa Rasooluhu," aur phir wo jo bhi dua chaahe kar sakta hai.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 797, Jild 2 dekhein.)

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The young should greet the old, the passer by should greet the sitting one, and the small group of persons should greet the large group of persons
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jawaan ko boodhon ko salaam karna chaahiye, guzarne wale ko baithe hue ko salaam karna chaahiye, aur logon ke chhote giroh ko bade giroh ko salaam karna chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The riding one should greet the walking one, and the walking one should greet the sitting one, and the small number of persons should greet the large number of persons
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Sawaari par baithe ko paidal chalne wale ko salaam karna chaahiye, aur paidal chalne wale ko baithe hue ko salaam karna chaahiye, aur logon ke chhote giroh ko bade giroh ko salaam karna chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The riding person should greet the walking one, and the walking one should greet the sitting one, and the small number of persons should greet the large number of persons
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Sawaari par baithe ko paidal chalne wale ko salaam karna chaahiye, aur paidal chalne wale ko baithe hue ko salaam karna chaahiye, aur logon ke chhote giroh ko bade giroh ko salaam karna chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The younger person should greet the older one, and the walking person should greet the sitting one, and the small number of persons should greet the large number of persons
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jawaan ko boodhon ko salaam karna chaahiye, aur chalne wale ko baithe hue ko salaam karna chaahiye, aur logon ke chhote giroh ko bade giroh ko salaam karna chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Al-Bara' bin 'Azib: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered us to do seven (things): to visit the sick, to follow the funeral processions, to say Tashmit to a sneezer, to help the weak, to help the oppressed ones, to propagate As-Salam (greeting), and to help others to fulfill their oaths (if it is not sinful). He forbade us to drink from silver utensils, to wear gold rings, to ride on silken saddles, to wear silk clothes, Dibaj (thick silk cloth), Qassiy and Istabraq (two kinds of silk). (See Hadith No. 539, Vol)
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein saat cheezon ka hukm diya: bimaar ki mizaajpursi karna, janaaze ke jaloos mein shaamil hona, chheenkne wale se Tashmit kehna, kamzoron ki madad karna, mazloomon ki madad karna, As-Salaam (salaam) failaana, aur doosron ko unki qasmein poori karne mein madad karna (agar ye gunaah na ho). Unhone humein chaandi ke bartanon mein peene, sone ki anguthiyaan pehanne, resham ki zeen par sawaar hone, resham ke kapde, Dibaj (moti resham), Qassiy aur Istabraq (do qism ke resham) pehanne se mana kiya. (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 539, Jild 2 dekhein.)

e: Narrated 'Abdullah bin 'Amr: A man asked the Prophet, "What Islamic traits are the best?" The Prophet said, "Feed the people, and greet those whom you know and those whom you do not know
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks ne Nabi (SAW) se pucha, 'Islam ki kaunsi khaasiyaten sabse behtar hain?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Logon ko khaana khilaao, aur un logon ko bhi salaam karo jinhein tum jaante ho aur jinhein nahi jaante.'

e: Narrated Abu Aiyub:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It is not lawful for a Muslim to desert (not to speak to) his brother Muslim for more than three days while meeting, one turns his face to one side and the other turns his face to the other side. Lo! The better of the two is the one who starts greeting the other
hi: Abu Aiyub bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kisi Musalmaan ke liye jaayez nahi ke wo apne Musalmaan bhai se teen din se zyaada rishta tode (baat na kare); jab wo miltein, ek apna chehra ek taraf mod le aur doosra apna chehra doosri taraf mod le. Suno! Dono mein behtar wo hai jo pehle salaam karna shuru kare.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:that he was a boy of ten at the time when the Prophet (ﷺ) emigrated to Medina. He added: I served Allah's Apostle for ten years (the last part of his life time) and I know more than the people about the occasion whereupon the order of Al-Hijab was revealed (to the Prophet). Ubai b n Ka`b used to ask me about it. It was revealed (for the first time) during the marriage of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with Zainab bint Jahsh. In the morning, the Prophet (ﷺ) was a bride-groom of her and he Invited the people, who took their meals and went away, but a group of them remained with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and they prolonged their stay. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got up and went out, and I too, went out along with him till he came to the lintel of `Aisha's dwelling place. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) thought that those people had left by then, so he returned, and I too, returned with him till he entered upon Zainab and found that they were still sitting there and had not yet gone. The Prophet (ﷺ) went out again, and so did I with him till he reached the lintel of `Aisha's dwelling place, and then he thought that those people must have left by then, so he returned, and so did I with him, and found those people had gone. At that time the Divine Verse of Al-Hijab was revealed, and the Prophet (ﷺ) set a screen between me and him (his family)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke jab Nabi (SAW) ne Madina hijrat ki, wo das saal ke ladke the. Unhone aage kaha: 'Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki das saal khidmat ki (unki zindagi ke aakhri hisse mein), aur mujhe logon se zyaada pata hai ke kis mauqe par Hijab ka hukm naazil hua tha. Ubai bin Ka'b (رضی اللہ عنہ) mujhse iske baare mein poochte the. Ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Jahsh (رضی اللہ عنہا) se shaadi ke waqt naazil hua tha. Subah, Nabi (SAW) unki shaadi ke dulha the aur unhone logon ko dawat di, jinhone khaana khaaya aur chale gaye, magar unmein se ek giroh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath reh gaya aur der tak baitha raha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) uthe aur baahar gaye, aur main bhi unke saath gaya yahaan tak ke wo Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke kamre ki dahleez tak pahunche. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko laga ke wo log tab tak chale gaye honge, isliye wo wapas laut aaye, aur main bhi unke saath wapas gaya yahaan tak ke wo Zainab ke paas daakhil hue aur dekha ke wo log abhi bhi wahaan baithe hain aur nahi gaye the. Nabi (SAW) phir baahar gaye, aur main bhi unke saath, yahaan tak ke wo Aisha ke kamre ki dahleez tak pahunche, aur phir unhein laga ke wo log tab tak chale gaye honge, isliye wo wapas laute, aur main bhi unke saath wapas gaya, aur dekha ke wo log chale gaye the. Us waqt Hijab ki paak Aayat naazil hui, aur Nabi (SAW) ne mere aur apne (khaandaan ke) beech ek parda laga diya.'

e: Narrated Anas:When the Prophet (ﷺ) married Zainab, the people came and were offered a meal, and then they sat down (after finishing their meals) and started chatting. The Prophet (ﷺ) showed as if he wanted to get up, but they did not get up. When he noticed that, he got up, and some of the people also got up and went away, while some others kept on sitting. When the Prophet (ﷺ) returned to enter, he found the people still sitting, but then they got up and left. So I told the Prophet (ﷺ) of their departure and he came and went in. I intended to go in but the Prophet (ﷺ) put a screen between me and him, for Allah revealed:-- 'O you who believe! Enter not the Prophet's houses
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Nabi (SAW) ne Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) se shaadi ki, log aaye aur unhein khaana pesh kiya gaya, phir wo (khaana khatam karne ke baad) baith gaye aur baatein karne lage. Nabi (SAW) ne aisa zaahir kiya jaise wo uthna chahte hon, magar wo log nahi uthe. Jab unhone ye notice kiya, wo uthe, aur kuch log bhi uthe aur chale gaye, jabke kuch aur baithe rahe. Jab Nabi (SAW) andar aane ke liye wapas aaye, unhone dekha log abhi bhi baithe hain, magar phir wo uthe aur chale gaye. To maine Nabi (SAW) ko unke jaane ki khabar di aur wo aaye aur andar gaye. Main bhi andar jaana chahta tha magar Nabi (SAW) ne mere aur apne beech ek parda daal diya, kyunke Allah ne naazil kiya: 'Aye Iman waalon! Nabi ke gharon mein daakhil mat ho...'

e: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) `Umar bin Al-Khattab used to say to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) "Let your wives be veiled" But he did not do so. The wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) used to go out to answer the call of nature at night only at Al-Manasi.' Once Sauda, the daughter of Zam`a went out and she was a tall woman. `Umar bin Al-Khattab saw her while he was in a gathering, and said, "I have recognized you, O Sauda!" He (`Umar) said so as he was anxious for some Divine orders regarding the veil (the veiling of women.) So Allah revealed the Verse of veiling. (Al-Hijab; a complete body cover excluding the eyes). (See Hadith No. 148, Vol)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki zawja) bataati hain: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kaha karte the, 'Apni biwiyon ko parde mein rakhiye,' magar unhone aisa nahi kiya. Nabi (SAW) ki biwiyaan raat ko qaza-e-haajat ke liye sirf Al-Manasi jaate the. Ek baar Sauda (رضی اللہ عنہا), Zam'a ki beti, baahar gayi, aur wo lambi khaatoon thi. Umar bin Al-Khattab ne unhein dekha jab wo ek majlis mein the, aur kaha, 'Maine tumhein pehchaan liya, Aye Sauda!' Umar ne aisa isliye kaha kyunke unhein parde ke baare mein kisi Ilaahi hukm ki bezaari thi. To Allah ne parde ki Aayat naazil ki (Al-Hijab; poore jism ka parda, aankhon ke ilaawa). (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 148, Jild 1 dekhein.)

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:A man peeped through a round hole into the dwelling place of the Prophet, while the Prophet (ﷺ) had a Midray (an iron comb) with which he was scratching his head. the Prophet (ﷺ) said, " Had known you were looking (through the hole), I would have pierced your eye with it (i.e., the comb)." Verily! The order of taking permission to enter has been enjoined because of that sight, (that one should not look unlawfully at the state of others). (See Hadith No. 807, Vol)
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks ne ek gol chhed se Nabi (SAW) ke ghar mein jhaanka, jabke Nabi (SAW) ke paas ek Midrai (loha kanghi) thi jisse wo apna sar khujla rahe the. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Agar mujhe pata hota ke tum (chhed se) jhaank rahe ho, to main isse tumhaari aankh chubho deta.' Beshak! Andar aane ki ijaazat maangne ka hukm isi nazaare (waqia) ki wajah se diya gaya hai, (taake koi doosron ki haalat ko na-jaayez tareeke se na dekhe). (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 807, Jild 4 dekhein.)

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:A man peeped into a room of the Prophet. The Prophet (ﷺ) stood up, holding an arrow head. It is as if I am just looking at him, trying to stab the man
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks ne Nabi (SAW) ke ek kamre mein jhaanka. Nabi (SAW) khade hue, ek teer ka phal pakade hue. Jaise ke main abhi bhi unhein us shaks ko chubhone ki koshish karte dekh raha hoon.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I have not seen a thing resembling 'lamam' (minor sins) than what Abu Huraira 'narrated from the Prophet who said "Allah has written for Adam's son his share of adultery which he commits inevitably. The adultery of the eyes is the sight (to gaze at a forbidden thing), the adultery of the tongue is the talk, and the inner self wishes and desires and the private parts testify all this or deny it
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine 'Lamam' (chhote gunaah) se milti-julti koi baat nahi dekhi jaisa Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Nabi (SAW) se riwaayat ki hai ke unhone farmaaya, 'Allah ne Aadam ke bete ke liye zina mein uska hissa likha hai jo wo laazimi taur par karta hai. Aankhon ka zina dekhna hai (haraam cheez ko taktna), zubaan ka zina baat karna hai, aur dil chaahat aur khwaahish rakhta hai, aur sharmgaah in sabki tasdeeq karti hai ya inkaar karti hai.'

e: Narrated Anas:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) greeted somebody, he used to greet him three times, and if he spoke a sentence, he used to repeat it thrice
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab bhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) kisi ko salaam karte, wo teen baar salaam karte, aur agar wo koi baat kehte, to use teen baar dohraate.

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:While I was present in one of the gatherings of the Ansar, Abu Musa came as if he was scared, and said, "I asked permission to enter upon `Umar three times, but I was not given the permission, so I returned." (When `Umar came to know about it) he said to Abu Musa, "Why did you not enter?'. Abu Musa replied, "I asked permission three times, and I was not given it, so I returned, for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If anyone of you asks the permission to enter thrice, and the permission is not given, then he should return.' " `Umar said, "By Allah! We will ask Abu Musa to bring witnesses for it." (Abu Musa went to a gathering of the Ansar and said). "Did anyone of you hear this from the Prophet (ﷺ) ?" Ubai bin Ka`b said, "By Allah, none will go with you but the youngest of the people (as a witness)." (Abu Sa`id) was the youngest of them, so I went with Abu Musa and informed `Umar that the Prophet (ﷺ) had said so. (See Hadith No. 277, Vol)
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Ansaar ki ek majlis mein maujood tha, jab Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) ghabraaye hue se aaye aur kaha, 'Maine Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas jaane ki teen baar ijaazat maangi, magar mujhe ijaazat nahi mili, isliye main wapas laut aaya.' (Jab Umar ko iska pata chala) unhone Abu Musa se kaha, 'Tum andar kyun nahi aaye?' Abu Musa ne jawab diya, 'Maine teen baar ijaazat maangi, aur mujhe nahi mili, isliye main wapas laut aaya, kyunke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya, "Agar tum mein se koi teen baar andar aane ki ijaazat maange, aur ijaazat na mile, to use wapas laut jaana chaahiye."' Umar ne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam! Hum Abu Musa se iske gawaah laane ko kahenge.' (Abu Musa Ansaar ki ek majlis mein gaye aur kaha,) 'Kya tum mein se kisi ne ye Nabi (SAW) se suna hai?' Ubai bin Ka'b (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, tumhaare saath sirf logon mein sabse chhota hi jaayega (gawaahi dene).' (Abu Saeed) unmein sabse chhote the, isliye main Abu Musa ke saath gaya aur Umar ko bataaya ke Nabi (SAW) ne aisa kaha tha. (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 277, Jild 1 dekhein.)

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I entered (the house) along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . There he found milk in a basin. He said, "O Abu Hirr! Go and call the people of Suffa to me." I went to them and invited them. They came and asked permission to enter, and when it was given, they entered. (See Hadith No. 459 for details)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath (ghar mein) daakhil hua. Wahaan unhone ek tashtari mein doodh paaya. Unhone kaha, 'Aye Abu Hirr! Jaao aur Suffa ke logon ko mere paas bulaao.' Main unke paas gaya aur unhein bulaaya. Wo aaye aur andar aane ki ijaazat maangi, aur jab unhein ijaazat mili, wo daakhil hue. (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 459, Jild 2 dekhein.)

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:that he passed by a group of boys and greeted them and said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) used to do so
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke wo bachchon ke ek giroh ke paas se guzre aur unhein salaam kiya, aur kaha, 'Nabi (SAW) bhi aisa hi kiya karte the.'

e: Narrated Abu Hazim:Sahl said, "We used to feel happy on Fridays." I asked Sahl, "Why?" He said, "There was an old woman of our acquaintance who used to send somebody to Buda'a (Ibn Maslama said, "Buda'a was a garden of date-palms at Medina). She used to pull out the silq (a kind of vegetable) from its roots and put it in a cooking pot, adding some powdered barley over it (and cook it). After finishing the Jumua (Friday) prayer we used to (pass by her and) greet her, whereupon she would present us with that meal, so we used to feel happy because of that. We used to have neither a midday nap, nor meals, except after the Friday prayer." (See Hadith No. 60, Vol)
hi: Abu Hazim bataate hain: Sahl ne kaha, 'Hum Jumme ke din khush hote the.' Maine Sahl se pucha, 'Kyun?' Unhone kaha, 'Hamaari jaan-pehchaan ki ek boodhi khaatoon thin jo kisi ko Buda'a bhejti thin (Ravi Ibn Maslama kehte hain, "Buda'a Madina mein khajoor ke darakhton ka ek baag tha"). Wo silq (ek qism ki sabzi) uski jadon se nikaal kar ek degchi mein daalti, kuch pisi hui jau usmein milaakar (pakaati). Jumme ki namaz khatam karne ke baad, hum unhein salaam karte, isper wo hamein wo khaana dena, isliye hum uski wajah se khush hote the. Humaari koi dophar ki neend ya khaana nahi hota tha, siwaaye Jumme ki namaz ke baad.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 60, Jild 1 dekhein.)

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O `Aisha! This is Gabriel sending his greetings to you." I said, "Peace, and Allah's Mercy be on him (Gabriel). You see what we do not see." (She was addressing Allah's Apostle)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Aye Aisha! Ye Jibrael hain jo tumhein salaam bhej rahe hain.' Maine kaha, 'Unpar salaam ho, aur Allah ki rehmat (Jibrael par). Aap wo dekhte hain jo hum nahi dekhte.' (Wo Allah ke Rasool se khitaab kar rahi thin.)

e: Narrated Jabir:I came to the Prophet (ﷺ) in order to consult him regarding my father's debt. When I knocked on the door, he asked, "Who is that?" I replied, "I" He said, "I, I?" He repeated it as if he disliked it
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Nabi (SAW) ke paas apne waalid ke qarz ke baare mein salaah lene aaya. Jab maine darwaaza khatkhataaya, unhone pucha, 'Kaun hai?' Maine jawab diya, 'Main.' Unhone kaha, 'Main, Main?' Unhone ise dohraaya jaise unhein ye napasand ho.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:A man entered the mosque while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was sitting in one side of the mosque. The man prayed, came, and greeted the Prophet. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him, "Wa 'Alaikas Salam (returned his greeting). Go back and pray as you have not prayed (properly)." The man returned, repeated his prayer, came back and greeted the Prophet. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Wa alaika-s-Salam (returned his greeting). Go back and pray again as you have not prayed (properly)." The man said at the second or third time, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Kindly teach me how to pray". The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When you stand for prayer, perform ablution properly and then face the Qibla and say Takbir (Allahu-Akbar), and then recite what you know from the Qur'an, and then bow with calmness till you feel at ease then rise from bowing, till you stand straight, and then prostrate calmly (and remain in prostration) till you feel at ease, and then raise (your head) and sit with calmness till you feel at ease and then prostrate with calmness (and remain in prostration) till you feel at ease, and then raise (your head) and sit with calmness till you feel at ease in the sitting position, and do likewise in whole of your prayer." And Abu Usama added, "Till you stand straight." (See Hadith No. 759, Vol)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks Masjid mein daakhil hua jabke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Masjid ke ek taraf baithe hue the. Us shaks ne namaz padhi, aaya, aur Nabi (SAW) ko salaam kiya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Wa Alaikas Salaam' (unka salaam laut aaya). 'Wapas jao aur namaz padho, kyunke tumne (sahi tareeke se) namaz nahi padhi.' Wo shaks wapas gaya, apni namaz dohraayi, wapas aaya aur Nabi (SAW) ko salaam kiya. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Wa Alaikas Salaam' (unka salaam laut aaya). 'Wapas jao aur dobara namaz padho, kyunke tumne (sahi tareeke se) namaz nahi padhi.' Wo shaks doosri ya teesri baar bola, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Barah-e-meharbaani mujhe namaz padhna sikhaiye.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Jab tum namaz ke liye khade ho, sahi tareeke se wuzu karo, phir Qibla ki taraf muh karo aur Takbeer kaho (Allahu Akbar), phir Quran mein se jo tumhein aata hai wo padho, phir sukoon se ruku karo yahaan tak ke tumhein aaraam mehsoos ho, phir ruku se uthkar seedhe khade ho jao, phir sukoon se sajda karo (aur sajde mein raho) yahaan tak ke tumhein aaraam mehsoos ho, phir (apna sar) uthaao aur sukoon se baitho yahaan tak ke tumhein aaraam mehsoos ho, phir sukoon se sajda karo (aur sajde mein raho) yahaan tak ke tumhein aaraam mehsoos ho, phir (apna sar) uthaao aur baithne ki haalat mein sukoon se baitho yahaan tak ke tumhein aaraam mehsoos ho, aur apni poori namaz mein aisa hi karo.' Aur Abu Usama ne izaafa kiya, 'Yahaan tak ke tum seedhe khade ho jao.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 759, Jild 1 dekhein.)

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said (in the above narration No. 268), "And then raise your head till you feel at ease while sitting
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne (upar wali riwayat mein) farmaya, 'Aur phir apna sar uthaao yahaan tak ke tumhein baithe hue aaraam mehsoos ho.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:That the Prophet (ﷺ) said to her, "Gabriel sends Salam (greetings) to you." She replied, "Wa 'alaihi-s- Salam Wa Rahmatu-l-lah." (Peace and Allah's Mercy be on him)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain ke Nabi (SAW) ne unse kaha, 'Jibrael tumhein Salaam bhejte hain.' Unhone jawab diya, 'Wa Alaihi-s-Salaam Wa Rahmatullah' (Unpar Salaamati aur Allah ki rehmat ho).

e: Narrated `Urwa-bin Az-Zubair:Usama bin Zaid said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) rode over a donkey with a saddle underneath which there was a thick soft Fadakiya velvet sheet. Usama bin Zaid was his companion rider, and he was going to pay a visit to Sa`d bin Ubada (who was sick) at the dwelling place of Bani Al-Harith bin Al-Khazraj, and this incident happened before the battle of Badr. The Prophet (ﷺ) passed by a gathering in which there were Muslims and pagan idolators and Jews, and among them there was `Abdullah bin Ubai bin Salul, and there was `Abdullah bin Rawaha too. When a cloud of dust raised by the animal covered that gathering, `Abdullah bin Ubai covered his nose with his Rida (sheet) and said (to the Prophet), "Don't cover us with dust." The Prophet (ﷺ) greeted them and then stopped, dismounted and invited them to Allah (i.e., to embrace Islam) and also recited to them the Holy Qur'an. `Abdullah bin Ubai' bin Salul said, "O man! There is nothing better than what you say, if what you say is the truth. So do not trouble us in our gatherings. Go back to your mount (or house,) and if anyone of us comes to you, tell (your tales) to him." On that `Abdullah bin Rawaha said, "(O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!) Come to us and bring it(what you want to say) in our gatherings, for we love that." So the Muslims, the pagans and the Jews started quarreling till they were about to fight and clash with one another. The Prophet (ﷺ) kept on quietening them (till they all became quiet). He then rode his animal, and proceeded till he entered upon Sa`d bin 'Ubada, he said, "O Sa`d, didn't you hear what Abu Habbab said? (He meant `Abdullah bin Ubai). He said so-and-so." Sa`d bin 'Ubada said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Excuse and forgive him, for by Allah, Allah has given you what He has given you. The people of this town decided to crown him (as their chief) and make him their king. But when Allah prevented that with the Truth which He had given you, it choked him, and that was what made him behave in the way you saw him behaving." So the Prophet excused him
hi: Urwa bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Nabi (SAW) ek gadhe par sawaar hue jispar zeen thi, aur uske neeche ek moti, naram Fadakiyya makhmal ki chaadar thi. Usama bin Zaid unke saath sawaar the, aur wo Sa'd bin Ubada (رضی اللہ عنہ) (jo bimar the) se milne Banu Al-Harith bin Al-Khazraj ke ilaake mein jaa rahe the, aur ye jang-e-Badr se pehle ki baat hai. Nabi (SAW) ek majlis ke paas se guzre jismein Musalmaan, mushrik aur Yahudi the, aur unmein Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ubai bin Salul the, aur Abdullah bin Rawaha bhi wahaan the. Jab jaanwar ki uthaayi hui dhool us majlis par pad gayi, Abdullah bin Ubai ne apni Rida (chaadar) se apni naak dhaank li aur (Nabi se) kaha, "Humein dhool se mat dhaanko." Nabi (SAW) ne unhein salaam kiya, phir ruke, utre aur unhein Allah ki taraf (Islam qubool karne ki) dawat di aur unhein paak Quran padh kar sunaaya. Abdullah bin Ubai bin Salul ne kaha, "Aye aadmi! Agar jo tum kehte ho wo sach hai to usse behtar kuch nahi. Isliye humein hamaari majlison mein takleef mat do. Apni sawaari (ya ghar) ki taraf laut jao, aur agar hum mein se koi tumhaare paas aaye, to use (apni baaten) bataao." Isper Abdullah bin Rawaha ne kaha, "(Aye Allah ke Rasool!) Humaare paas aaiye aur ise humaari majlison mein laaiye, kyunke humein ye pasand hai." To Musalmaan, mushrik aur Yahudi jhagadne lage yahaan tak ke wo ladne aur takraane ke qareeb aa gaye. Nabi (SAW) unhein shaant karte rahe (yahaan tak ke wo sab shaant ho gaye). Phir wo apni sawaari par sawaar hue aur chalte rahe yahaan tak ke wo Sa'd bin Ubada ke paas pahunche, unhone kaha, "Aye Sa'd, kya tumne suna nahi Abu Habbab ne kya kaha?" (unka ishara Abdullah bin Ubai ki taraf tha). "Usne aisa-aisa kaha." Sa'd bin Ubada ne kaha, "Aye Allah ke Rasool! Unhein maaf kar dijiye aur darguzar kijiye, kyunke, Allah ki qasam, Allah ne aapko wo diya hai jo usne diya hai. Is shehar ke logon ne unhein (apna sardaar) taajposhi karke apna baadshah banaane ka faisla kiya tha. Magar jab Allah ne aapko di gayi Haq ke zariye usse roka, to wo isse ghut gaye, aur yahi wajah thi jisne unhein aapne dekha jaisa suluk karne par majboor kiya." To Nabi (SAW) ne unhein maaf kar diya.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Ka`b:I heard Ka`b bin Malik narrating (when he did not join the battle of Tabuk): Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade all the Muslims to speak to us. I would come to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and greet him, and I would wonder whether the Prophet (ﷺ) did move his lips to return to my greetings or not till fifty nights passed away. The Prophet (ﷺ) then announced (to the people) Allah's forgiveness for us (acceptance of our repentance) at the time when he had offered the Fajr (morning) prayer
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ka'b bataate hain: Maine Ka'b bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko ye bayaan karte suna (jab wo jang-e-Tabuk mein shaamil nahi hue the): Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne sab Musalmaanon ko hamse baat karne se mana kiya. Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aata aur unhein salaam karta, aur main sochta rehta ke kya Nabi (SAW) ne apne honth hilaaye mera salaam laut-aane ke liye ya nahi, yahaan tak ke pachaas raatein guzar gayi. Phir Nabi (SAW) ne humaare liye Allah ki maafi ka elaan kiya (yaani humaari tauba qubool hone ka) us waqt jab unhone Fajr ki namaz padhaayi thi.

e: Narrated `Aisha:A group of Jews came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "As-samu 'Alaika " (Death be on you), and I understood it and said to them, "Alaikum AsSamu wa-l-la'na (Death and curse be on you)." Allah's Apostle said, "Be calm! O `Aisha, for Allah loves that one should be kind and lenient in all matters." I said. "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Haven't you heard what they have said?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I have (already) said (to them), 'Alaikum (upon you)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Yahudiyon ka ek giroh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha, 'As-Samu Alaika' (tumpar maut ho), aur main samajh gayi aur unse kaha, 'Alaikum As-Samu wal-La'na' (Tumpar maut aur laanat ho). Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Shaant raho! Aye Aisha, kyunke Allah pasand karta hai ke insaan har maamle mein naram aur meharbaan rahe.' Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya aapne nahi suna unhone kya kaha?' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Maine (pehle hi) kah diya, "Aur tumpar bhi."'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When the Jews greet you, they usually say, 'As-Samu 'alaikum (Death be on you),' so you should say (in reply to them), 'Wa'alaikum (And on you)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab Yahudi tumhein salaam karein, wo aksar kehte hain, "As-Samu Alaikum" (tumpar maut ho), isliye tumhein (jawab mein) kehna chaahiye, "Wa Alaikum" (aur tumpar bhi).'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If the people of the Scripture greet you, then you should say (in reply), 'Wa'alaikum (And on you)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar Ahl-e-Kitaab tumhein salaam karein, to tumhein (jawab mein) kehna chaahiye, "Wa Alaikum" (aur tumpar bhi).'

e: Narrated `Ali:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent me, Az-Zubair bin Al-Awwam and Abu Marthad Al-Ghanawi, and all of us were horsemen, and he said, "Proceed till you reach Rawdat Khakh, where there is a woman from the pagans carrying a letter sent by Hatib bin Abi Balta'a to the pagans (of Mecca)." So we overtook her while she was proceeding on her camel at the same place as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) told us. We said (to her) "Where is the letter which is with you?" She said, "I have no letter with me." So we made her camel kneel down and searched her mount (baggage etc) but could not find anything. My two companions said, "We do not see any letter." I said, "I know that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not tell a lie. By Allah, if you (the lady) do not bring out the letter, I will strip you of your clothes' When she noticed that I was serious, she put her hand into the knot of her waist sheet, for she was tying a sheet round herself, and brought out the letter. So we proceeded to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with the letter. The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to Habib), "What made you o what you have done, O Hatib?" Hatib replied, "I have done nothing except that I believe in Allah and His Apostle, and I have not changed or altered (my religion). But I wanted to do the favor to the people (pagans of Mecca) through which Allah might protect my family and my property, as there is none among your companions but has someone in Mecca through whom Allah protects his property (against harm). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Habib has told you the truth, so do not say to him (anything) but good." `Umar bin Al-Khattab said, "Verily he has betrayed Allah, His Apostle, and the believers! Allow me to chop his neck off!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O `Umar! What do you know; perhaps Allah looked upon the Badr warriors and said, 'Do whatever you like, for I have ordained that you will be in Paradise.'" On that `Umar wept and said, "Allah and His Apostle know best
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe, Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Awwam aur Abu Marthad Al-Ghanawi ko bheja, aur hum sab ghudsawaar the, aur unhone kaha, 'Chalo yahaan tak ke tum Raudat Khakh pahuncho, jahaan ek mushrik khaatoon hogi jo Hatib bin Abi Balta'a ka mushrikeen (Makkah waalon) ke naam bheja hua ek khat le jaa rahi hogi.' To humne unhein pakad liya jabke wo apni oontni par usi jagah se guzar rahi thi jaisa Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne bataya tha. Humne (unse) kaha, 'Wo khat kahaan hai jo tumhaare paas hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Mere paas koi khat nahi hai.' To humne unki oontni ko bithaaya aur unki sawaari (saamaan waghera) ki talaashi li, magar kuch nahi mila. Mere do saathiyon ne kaha, 'Humein koi khat nazar nahi aata.' Maine kaha, 'Mujhe pata hai Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne jhoot nahi kaha. Allah ki qasam, agar tum (khaatoon) khat nahi nikaaloge, to main tumhaare kapde utaar dunga.' Jab unhone dekha main sangin hoon, unhone apna haath apni kamarband ke gaanth mein daala (kyunke wo ek chaadar apne aas-paas baandhe hui thin) aur khat nikaala. To hum khat lekar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaye. Nabi (SAW) ne (Hatib se) kaha, 'Aye Hatib! Tumne aisa kyun kiya?' Hatib ne jawab diya, 'Maine kuch bhi ghalat nahi kiya siwaaye is ke ke main Allah aur uske Rasool par Iman rakhta hoon, aur maine (apna deen) badla nahi. Magar main Makkah waalon ko ek ehsaan karna chahta tha jiske zariye Allah mere khaandaan aur meri jaayadaad ki hifaazat kare, kyunke aapke sahaaba mein se koi bhi aisa nahi hai jiska Makkah mein koi na koi na ho jiske zariye Allah uski jaayadaad ki hifaazat kare.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Hatib ne tumse sach kaha, isliye unhein (kuch bhi) mat kaho siwaaye achhi baat ke.' Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab ne kaha, 'Beshak, unhone Allah, uske Rasool aur Momineen ke saath dhoka kiya hai! Mujhe ijaazat dijiye ke main iski gardan kaat doon!' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Aye Umar! Tumhein kya pata; shaayad Allah ne Badr ke jaanbaazon ki taraf dekha ho aur kaha ho, "Jo chaaho karo, kyunke maine tumhaare liye Jannat muqarrar kar di hai."' Isper Umar ro pade aur kaha, 'Allah aur uska Rasool behtar jaante hain.'

e: Narrated Abu Sufyan bin Harb:that Heraclius had sent for him to come along with a group of the Quraish who were trading in Sha'm, and they came to him. Then Abu Sufyan mentioned the whole narration and said, "Heraclius asked for the letter of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . When the letter was read, its contents were as follows: 'In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful. From Muhammad, Allah's slave and His Apostle to Heraclius, the Chief of Byzantines: Peace be upon him who follows the right path (guidance)! Amma ba'du (to proceed )...' (See Hadith No 6, Vol 1 for details)
hi: Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Harb bataate hain ke Heraclius ne unhein bulwaaya taake wo Sham mein tijaarat kar rahe Quraish ke ek giroh ke saath aayein, aur wo unke paas aaye. Phir Abu Sufyan ne poori riwaayat sunaayi aur kaha, 'Heraclius ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka khat maangaya. Jab khat padha gaya, uski ibaarat aisi thi: "Allah ke naam se, jo bada meharbaan, nihaayat rehm karne wala hai. Muhammad, Allah ke bande aur uske Rasool, ki taraf se, Heraclius, Byzantines ke sardaar, ke naam: Salaamati ho us par jo seedhe raaste (hidaayat) ki pairvi kare! Amma Ba'du (aage)..."' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 6, Jild 1 dekhein.)

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah (ra):Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) mentioned a person from Bani Israel who took a piece of wood, made a hole in it, and put therein one thousand Dinar and letter from him to his friend. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "(That man) cut a piece of wood and put the money inside it and wrote a letter from such and such a person to such and such a person
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Bani Israel ke ek shaks ka zikr kiya jisne lakdi ka ek tukda liya, usmein ek chhed banaaya, aur usmein ek hazaar Dinar aur apne dost ke naam ek khat rakh diya. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, '(Us aadmi ne) lakdi ka tukda kaata, uske andar paise rakhe aur falaan shaks ki taraf se falaan shaks ke naam ek khat likha.'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id:The people of (the tribe of) Quraiza agreed upon to accept the verdict of Sa`d. The Prophet (ﷺ) sent for him (Sa`d) and he came. The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to those people), "Get up for your chief or the best among you!" Sa`d sat beside the Prophet (ﷺ) and the Prophet (ﷺ) said (to him), "These people have agreed to accept your verdict." Sa`d said, "So I give my judgment that their warriors should be killed and their women and children should be taken as captives." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You have judged according to the King's (Allah's) judgment." (See Hadith No. 447, Vol)
hi: Abu Saeed bataate hain: Quraiza qabeele ke log Sa'd ke faisle ko maanne par raazi ho gaye. Nabi (SAW) ne unhein (Sa'd ko) bulwaaya aur wo aaye. Nabi (SAW) ne (un logon se) kaha, 'Apne sardaar ya apne sabse behtar shaks ke liye khade ho jao!' Sa'd Nabi (SAW) ke paas baithe, aur Nabi (SAW) ne (unse) kaha, 'In logon ne tumhaare faisle ko maanne par raazi hain.' Sa'd ne kaha, 'To main faisla deta hoon ke unke jaanbaazon ko qatl kar diya jaaye aur unki auraton aur bachon ko qaidi banaaya jaaye.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Tumne Baadshah (Allah) ke faisle ke mutaabik faisla diya hai.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 447, Jild 5 dekhein.)

e: Narrated Qatada:I asked Anas, "Was it a custom of the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) to shake hands with one another?" He said, "Yes
hi: Qatada bataate hain: Maine Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha, 'Kya Nabi (SAW) ke sahaaba ki aadat thi ek doosre se haath milaane ki?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Hisham:We were in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) and he was holding the hand of `Umar bin Al-Khattab
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Hisham (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Nabi (SAW) ki sohbat mein the aur wo Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab ka haath pakde hue the.

e: Narrated Ibn Mas`ud:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) taught me the Tashah-hud as he taught me a Sura from the Qur'an, while my hand was between his hands. (Tashah-hud was) all the best compliments and the prayers and the good things are for Allah. Peace and Allah's Mercy and Blessings be on you, O Prophet! Peace be on us and on the pious slaves of Allah, I testify that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah, and I also testify that Muhammad is Allah's slave and His Apostle. (We used to recite this in the prayer) during the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) , but when he had died, we used to say, "Peace be on the Prophet
hi: Ibn Masud bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe Tashahhud sikhaaya jaise wo mujhe Quran ki koi Surah sikhaate, jabke mera haath unke haathon ke beech tha. (Tashahhud ye tha:) 'Sab tareef aur duayein aur achhi cheezein Allah ke liye hain. Salaamati, aur Allah ki rehmat aur barkaten aap par hon, Aye Nabi! Salaamati hum par ho aur Allah ke neik bandon par ho. Main gawaahi deta hoon ke Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi, aur main ye bhi gawaahi deta hoon ke Muhammad Allah ke bande aur uske Rasool hain.' (Hum ise Nabi (SAW) ki zindagi mein namaz mein padha karte the, magar unke intekaal ke baad, hum kehte, 'Salaamati Nabi par ho.')

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abbas:`Ali bin Abu Talib came out of the house of the Prophet (ﷺ) during his fatal ailment. The people asked (`Ali), "O Abu Hasan! How is the health of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) this morning?" `Ali said, "This morning he is better, with the grace of Allah." Al-`Abbas held `Ali by the hand and said, "Don't you see him (about to die)? By Allah, within three days you will be the slave of the stick (i.e., under the command of another ruler). By Allah, I think that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) will die from his present ailment, for I know the signs of death on the faces of the offspring of `Abdul Muttalib. So let us go to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to ask him who will take over the Caliphate. If the authority is given to us, we will know it, and if it is given to somebody else we will request him to recommend us to him. " `Ali said, "By Allah! If we ask Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for the rulership and he refuses, then the people will never give it to us. Besides, I will never ask Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for it." (See Hadith No 728, Vol)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bin Abi Talib Nabi (SAW) ke ghar se, unki aakhri bimaari ke dauraan, baahar aaye. Logon ne (Ali (Alayhis Salam) se) pucha, 'Aye Abu Hasan! Aaj subah Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki tabiyat kaisi hai?' Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha, 'Aaj subah wo, Allah ke fazl se, behtar hain.' Al-Abbas ne Ali (Alayhis Salam) ka haath pakda aur kaha, 'Kya tum unhein (marne ke qareeb) nahi dekhte? Allah ki qasam, teen din ke andar tum lakdi ke ghulaam ho jaaoge (yaani kisi aur hukmraan ke maatehat). Allah ki qasam, mujhe lagta hai Allah ke Rasool (SAW) is bimaari se intekaal kar jaayenge, kyunke mujhe Abdul Muttalib ki aulaad ke chehron par maut ki nishaaniyaan pehchaanani aati hain. To chalo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas chalte hain aur unse pooochte hain ke Khilaafat kise milegi. Agar ye hukumat hamein di jaati hai, to hum jaan jaayenge, aur agar ye kisi aur ko di jaati hai, to hum unse darkhwaast karenge ke wo humaari sifaarish karein.' Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam! Agar hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se hukumat maangein aur wo inkaar karein, to log ye hamein kabhi nahi denge. Iske ilaawa, main kabhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye nahi maangunga.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 728, Jild 1 dekhein.)

e: Narrated Mu`adh:While I was a companion rider with the Prophet (ﷺ) he said, "O Mu`adh!" I replied, "Labbaik wa Sa`daik." He repeated this call three times and then said, "Do you know what Allah's Right on His slaves is?" I replied, "No." He said, Allah's Right on His slaves is that they should worship Him (Alone) and should not join partners in worship with Him." He said, "O Mu`adh!" I replied, "Labbaik wa Sa`daik." He said, "Do you know what the right of (Allah's) salves on Allah is, if they do that (worship Him Alone and join none in His worship)? It is that He will not punish them." (another chain through Mu'adh)
hi: Mu'adh bataate hain: Jab main Nabi (SAW) ke peechhe sawaar tha, unhone kaha, 'Aye Mu'adh!' Maine jawab diya, 'Labbaik wa Sa'daik.' Unhone ye pukaar teen baar dohraayi aur phir kaha, 'Kya tumhein pata hai Allah ka apne bandon par kya haq hai?' Maine kaha, 'Nahi.' Unhone kaha, 'Allah ka apne bandon par haq ye hai ke wo sirf uski ibaadat karein aur uske saath kisi ko shareek na karein.' Unhone kaha, 'Aye Mu'adh!' Maine jawab diya, 'Labbaik wa Sa'daik.' Unhone kaha, 'Kya tumhein pata hai bandon ka Allah par kya haq hai, agar wo aisa karein (sirf uski ibaadat karein aur kisi ko shareek na karein)? Ye hai ke wo unhein saza nahi dega.' (Ek aur silsile se Mu'adh ke zariye.)

e: Narrated Abu Dhar:While I was walking with the Prophet (ﷺ) at the Hurra of Medina in the evening, the mountain of Uhud appeared before us. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Abu Dhar! I would not like to have gold equal to Uhud (mountain) for me, unless nothing of it, not even a single Dinar remains of it with me, for more than one day or three days, except that single Dinar which I will keep for repaying debts. I will spend all of it (the whole amount) among Allah's slaves like this and like this and like this." The Prophet (ﷺ) pointed out with his hand to illustrate it and then said, "O Abu Dhar!" I replied, "Labbaik wa Sa`daik, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" He said, "Those who have much wealth (in this world) will be the least rewarded (in the Hereafter) except those who do like this and like this (i.e., spend their money in charity)." Then he ordered me, "Remain at your place and do not leave it, O Abu Dhar, till I come back." He went away till he disappeared from me. Then I heard a voice and feared that something might have happened to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and I intended to go (to find out) but I remembered the statement of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that I should not leave, my place, so I kept on waiting (and after a while the Prophet (ﷺ) came), and I said to him, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), I heard a voice and I was afraid that something might have happened to you, but then I remembered your statement and stayed (there). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "That was Gabriel who came to me and informed me that whoever among my followers died without joining others in worship with Allah, would enter Paradise." I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Even if he had committed illegal sexual intercourse and theft?" He said, "Even if he had committed illegal sexual intercourse and theft
hi: Abu Dharr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab main Nabi (SAW) ke saath shaam ko Madina ki Harra mein chal raha tha, Uhud pahaad hamare saamne aayi. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Aye Abu Dharr! Mujhe pasand nahi ke mere paas Uhud jitna sona ho, jab tak isse ek bhi Dinar mere paas teen din se zyaada na rahe, siwaaye us ek Dinar ke jo main qarz chukaane ke liye rakhunga. Main ise (poori raqam ko) Allah ke bandon mein aise, aise aur aise baant dunga.' Nabi (SAW) ne apne haath se ishara kiya ye dikhaane ke liye, phir kaha, 'Aye Abu Dharr!' Maine jawab diya, 'Labbaik wa Sa'daik, Aye Allah ke Rasool!' Unhone kaha, 'Jinke paas (is duniya mein) bahut daulat hai, unhein (Aakhirat mein) sabse kam ajr milega, siwaaye un logon ke jo aisa, aisa karein (yaani apna paisa sadqe mein kharch karein).' Phir unhone mujhe hukm diya, 'Apni jagah rehna aur wahaan se mat hilna, Aye Abu Dharr, jab tak main wapas na aaun.' Wo chale gaye yahaan tak ke mujhse ojhal ho gaye. Phir maine ek aawaaz suni aur mujhe dar laga ke kahin Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kuch ho na gaya ho, aur main jaana chahta tha (dekhne), magar mujhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki baat yaad aayi ke mujhe apni jagah nahi chhodni chaahiye, isliye main intezaar karta raha (aur kuch der baad Nabi SAW wapas aaye), aur maine unse kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Maine ek aawaaz suni aur mujhe dar laga ke kahin aapko kuch ho na gaya ho, magar phir mujhe aapki baat yaad aayi aur main ruk gaya.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Wo Jibrael the jo mere paas aaye aur mujhe bataaya ke jo bhi mere maanne walon mein se bagair kisi ko Allah ke saath shareek kiye mara, wo Jannat mein daakhil hoga.' Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Chaahe usne zina aur chori ki ho?' Unhone kaha, 'Chaahe usne zina aur chori ki ho.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A man should not make another man get up from his (the latter's) seat (in a gathering) in order to sit there
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kisi aadmi ko doosre aadmi ko uski (doosre ki) jagah se uthaana nahi chaahiye taake wo khud wahaan baith jaaye.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade that a man should be made to get up from his seat so that another might sit on it, but one should make room and spread out. Ibn `Umar disliked that a man should get up from his seat and then somebody else sit at his place
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne kisi aadmi ko uski jagah se uthaakar doosre ko wahaan bithaane se mana kiya, balke jagah banaani chaahiye aur failaana chaahiye. Ibn Umar napasand karte the ke koi apni jagah se uthe aur koi aur uski jagah baithe.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) married Zainab bint Jahsh, he invited the people who took their meals and then remained sitting and talking. The Prophet (ﷺ) pretended to be ready to get up, but the people did not get up. When he noticed that, he got up, and when he had got up, some of those people got up along with him and there remained three (who kept on sitting). Then the Prophet (ﷺ) came back and found those people still sitting. Later on those people got up and went away. So I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and informed him that they had left. The Prophet (ﷺ) came, and entered (his house). I wanted to enter(along with him) but he dropped a curtain between me and him. Allah then revealed: 'O you who believe! Do not enter the Prophet's Houses until leave is given... (to His statement)... Verily! That shall be an enormity, in Allah's sight
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Jahsh (رضی اللہ عنہا) se shaadi ki, unhone logon ko dawat di, jinhone khaana khaaya aur phir baithe rahe aur baatein karte rahe. Nabi (SAW) ne aisa zaahir kiya jaise wo uthna chahte hon, magar log nahi uthe. Jab unhone ye notice kiya, wo uthe, aur jab wo uth gaye, unmein se kuch log unke saath uthe aur teen log baithe reh gaye. Phir Nabi (SAW) wapas aaye aur dekha wo log abhi bhi baithe hain. Baad mein wo log uthe aur chale gaye. To main Nabi (SAW) ke paas gaya aur unhein bataaya ke wo chale gaye hain. Nabi (SAW) aaye aur andar daakhil hue. Main bhi (unke saath) andar jaana chahta tha magar unhone mere aur apne beech ek parda daal diya. Allah ne phir naazil kiya: 'Aye Iman waalon! Nabi ke gharon mein daakhil mat ho jab tak tumhein ijaazat na di jaaye... (Aayat ke aakhir tak)... Beshak, ye Allah ke nazdeek ek bada gunaah hai.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the courtyard of the Ka`ba in the Ihtiba.' posture putting his hand round his legs like this
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Kaaba ke aangan mein Ihtiba (ghutne mod kar baithne) ki mudra mein dekha, apna haath is tarah apni taangon ke gird lapete hue.

e: Narrated Abu Bakra:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Shall I inform you of the biggest of the great sins?" They said, "Yes, O Allah's Apostle!" He said, "To join partners in worship with Allah, and to be undutiful to one's parents
hi: Abu Bakra (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Kya main tumhein sabse bade gunaahon ke baare mein na bataun?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan, Aye Allah ke Rasool!' Unhone kaha, 'Allah ke saath shareek thehraana, aur maa-baap ke saath badsuluki karna.'

e: Narrated Bishr:as above (No. 290) adding: The Prophet (ﷺ) was reclining (leaning) and then he sat up saying, "And I warn you against giving a false statement." And he kept on saying that warning so much so that we said, "Would that he had stopped
hi: Bishr bataate hain (upar wali riwayat jaisi hi), izaafa karte hue: Nabi (SAW) tek lagaaye hue baithe the, phir seedhe baith gaye aur kaha, 'Aur main tumhein jhoothi baat kehne se khabardaar karta hoon.' Unhone ye chetaawani itni baar dohraayi ke humne kaha, 'Kaash wo ruk jaate.'

e: Narrated `Uqba bin Al-Harith:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) offered the `Asr prayer and then he walked quickly and entered his house
hi: Uqba bin Al-Harith bataate hain: Ek baar Nabi (SAW) ne Asr ki namaz padhi aur phir jaldi se chal kar apne ghar daakhil hue.

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to offer his prayer (while standing) in the midst of the bed, and I used to lie in front of him between him and the Qibla It I had any necessity for getting up and I used to dislike to get up and face him (while he was in prayer), but I would gradually slip away from the bed
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) (khade hokar) apni namaz bistar ke beech mein padhte, aur main unke aage, unke aur Qibla ke beech leti hui hoti thi. Agar mujhe uthne ki koi zaroorat hoti, mujhe unke saamne (namaz ke dauraan) uthna napasand tha, isliye main aahista se bistar se sarak jaati.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:The news of my fasting was mentioned to the Prophet (ﷺ) . So he entered upon me and I put for him a leather cushion stuffed with palm-fibres. The Prophet (ﷺ) sat on the floor and the cushion was between me and him. He said to me, "Isn't it sufficient for you (that you fast) three days a month?" I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! (I can fast more than this)." He said, "You may fast) five days a month." I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! (I can fast more than this)." He said, "(You may fast) seven days." I said, "O Allah's Apostle!" He said, "Nine." I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" He said, "Eleven." I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" He said, "No fasting is superior to the fasting of (the Prophet David (ﷺ)) which was one half of a year, and he used, to fast on alternate days. (See Hadith No. 300, Vol)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Mere roze ki khabar Nabi (SAW) tak pahunchi. To wo mere paas aaye aur maine unke liye khajoor ke reshon se bhara chamde ka takiya rakha. Nabi (SAW) zameen par baithe aur takiya mere aur unke beech tha. Unhone mujhse kaha, 'Kya tumhaare liye mahine mein teen din roza rakhna kaafi nahi hai?' Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! (Main isse zyaada kar sakta hoon).' Unhone kaha, '(Tum) mahine mein paanch din (roza rakh sakte ho).' Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! (Main isse zyaada kar sakta hoon).' Unhone kaha, '(Tum) saat din (roza rakh sakte ho).' Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool!' Unhone kaha, 'Nau.' Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool!' Unhone kaha, 'Gyaarah.' Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool!' Unhone kaha, 'Koi roza Dawood (Nabi) ke roze se behtar nahi, jo saal ke aadhe hisse ka tha, aur wo ek din chhod kar roza rakhte the.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 300, Jild 3 dekhein.)

e: Narrated Ibrahim:'Alaqama went to Sham and came to the mosque and offered a two-rak`at prayer, and invoked Allah: "O Allah! Bless me with a (pious) good companion." So he sat beside Abu Ad-Darda' who asked, "From where are you?" He said, "From the people of Kufa." Abu Darda' said, "Wasn't there among you the person who keeps the secrets (of the Prophet (ﷺ) ) which nobody knew except him (i.e., Hudhaifa (bin Al-Yaman)). And isn't there among you the person whom Allah gave refuge from Satan through the request (tongue) of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? (i.e., `Ammar). Isn't there among you the one who used to carry the Siwak and the cushion (or pillows (of the Prophets)? (i.e., Ibn Mas`ud). How did Ibn Mas`ud use to recite 'By the night as it conceals (the light)?" (Sura 92). 'Alqama said, "Wadhdhakari Wal Untha' (And by male and female.") Abu Ad-Darda added. 'These people continued to argue with me regarding it till they were about to cause me to have doubts although I heard it from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
hi: Ibrahim bataate hain: Alqama Sham gaye aur Masjid mein aakar do rakat namaz padhi, aur Allah se dua ki, 'Aye Allah! Mujhe ek achha (neik) saathi de.' To wo Abu Ad-Darda ke paas baithe, jinhone pucha, 'Tum kahaan se ho?' Unhone kaha, 'Kufa ke logon mein se.' Abu Darda ne kaha, 'Kya tum mein wo shaks nahi tha jo (Nabi ke) raazdaar the jinhein koi aur nahi jaanta tha (yaani Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Yaman)? Aur kya tum mein wo shaks nahi hai jise Allah ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki darkhwaast (zubaan) se Shaitaan se panaah di (yaani Ammar (رضی اللہ عنہ))? Kya tum mein wo shaks nahi hai jo Siwak aur takiya (ya Nabi ke takiye) le jaaya karta tha (yaani Ibn Masud)? Ibn Masud "Wal-Laili Iza Yaghsha" (92) kaise padha karte the?' Alqama ne kaha, '"Wadhdhakari Wal Untha" (aur nar aur maada ki qasam).' Abu Ad-Darda ne aage kaha, 'In logon ne isper mere saath itni behas ki ke mujhe shak hone laga, halaanke maine ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se khud suna tha.'

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:We used to have a midday nap and take our meals after the Jumua (prayer)
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Jumme (ki namaz) ke baad hi dophar ki neend aur khaana lete the.

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:There was no name dearer to `Ali than his nickname Abu Turab (the father of dust). He used to feel happy whenever he was called by this name. Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to the house of Fatima but did not find `Ali in the house. So he asked "Where is your cousin?" She replied, "There was something (a quarrel) between me and him whereupon he got angry with me and went out without having a midday nap in my house." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked a person to look for him. That person came, and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! He (Ali) is sleeping in the mosque." So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went there and found him lying. His upper body cover had fallen off to one side of his body, and so he was covered with dust. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) started cleaning the dust from him, saying, "Get up, O Abu Turab! Get up, Abu Turab!" (See Hadith No. 432, Vol)
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke liye koi naam unke laqab 'Abu Turab' (mitti ke baap) se zyaada aziz nahi tha. Wo hamesha khush hote jab unhein isse pukaara jaata. Ek baar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ke ghar aaye magar Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko ghar mein nahi paaya. To unhone pucha, 'Tumhaara chachazaad kahaan hai?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Mere aur unke beech kuch (jhagda) hua tha, isper wo mujhse gussa hokar bina meri jagah dophar ki neend liye baahar chale gaye.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kisi se kaha ke unhein dhoondein. Wo shaks aaya aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Wo (Ali (Alayhis Salam)) Masjid mein so rahe hain.' To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) wahaan gaye aur unhein leta hua paaya. Unka oopari kapda ek taraf gir gaya tha, isliye wo mitti se dhaka hua the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unse mitti saaf karne lage, kehte hue, 'Utho, Aye Abu Turab! Utho, Abu Turab!' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 432, Jild 2 dekhein.)

e: Narrated Thumama:Anas said, "Um Sulaim used to spread a leather sheet for the Prophet (ﷺ) and he used to take a midday nap on that leather sheet at her home." Anas added, "When the Prophet (ﷺ) had slept, she would take some of his sweat and hair and collect it (the sweat) in a bottle and then mix it with Suk (a kind of perfume) while he was still sleeping. "When the death of Anas bin Malik approached, he advised that some of that Suk be mixed with his Hanut (perfume for embalming the dead body), and it was mixed with his Hanut
hi: Thumama bataate hain: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Umm Sulaim Nabi (SAW) ke liye ek chamde ki chataayi bichhaati thin, aur wo us chataayi par unke ghar mein dophar ki neend liya karte the.' Anas ne aage kaha, 'Jab Nabi (SAW) so jaate, wo unka kuch pasina aur baal lekar (pasine ko) ek shishi mein jama karti aur use Suk (ek qism ki khushbu) mein milaati jabke wo abhi so rahe hote. Jab Anas bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki maut nazdeek aayi, unhone naseehat di ke us Suk ka kuch hissa unke Hanut (murda jism ke embalming ke liye khushbu) mein mila diya jaaye, aur wo unke Hanut mein mila diya gaya.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went to Quba, he used to visit Um Haram bint Milhan who would offer him meals; and she was the wife of 'Ubada bin As-samit. One day he went to her house and she offered him a meal, and after that he slept, and then woke up smiling. She (Um Haram) said, "I asked him, 'What makes you laugh, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?' He said, 'Some people of my followers were displayed before me as warriors fighting for Allah's Cause and sailing over this sea, kings on thrones,' or said, 'like kings on thrones.' (The narrator, 'Is-haq is in doubt about it.) I (Um Haram) said, 'O Allah's Apostle! Invoke Allah that He may make me one of them.' He invoked (Allah) for her and then lay his head and slept again and then woke up smiling. I asked, 'What makes you laugh, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?' He said, 'Some people of my followers were displayed before me as warriors fighting for Allah's Cause and sailing over this sea, kings on the thrones,' or said, 'like kings on the thrones.' I (Um Haram) said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Invoke Allah that He may make me one of them.' He said, You will be amongst the first ones." It is said that Um Haram sailed over the sea at the time of Muawiya, and on coming out of the sea, she fell down from her riding animal and died
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab bhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Quba jaate, wo Umm Haram (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Milhan se milne jaate, jo unhein khaana khilaati thin, aur wo Ubada bin As-Samit ki biwi thin. Ek din wo unke ghar gaye aur unhone unhein khaana pesh kiya, aur uske baad wo so gaye, phir muskuraate hue jaage. Unhone (Umm Haram) kaha, 'Maine unse pucha, "Aapko kis baat par hansi aayi, Aye Allah ke Rasool?" Unhone kaha, "Mere maanne walon mein se kuch log mere saamne pesh kiye gaye, Allah ki raah mein jaanbaaz banke ladte hue aur is samundar ko paar karte hue, takhton par baithe baadshaahon jaise," ya kaha, "takhton par baithe baadshaahon jaise." (Ravi Is-haq ko iska yaqeen nahi.) Maine (Umm Haram) kaha, "Aye Allah ke Rasool! Allah se dua kijiye ke wo mujhe unmein se ek banaaye." Unhone (Allah se) unke liye dua ki, phir apna sar rakh kar dobara so gaye, aur phir muskuraate hue jaage. Maine pucha, "Aapko kis baat par hansi aayi, Aye Allah ke Rasool?" Unhone kaha, "Mere maanne walon mein se kuch log mere saamne pesh kiye gaye, Allah ki raah mein jaanbaaz banke ladte hue aur is samundar ko paar karte hue, takhton par baithe baadshaahon jaise," ya kaha, "takhton par baithe baadshaahon jaise." Maine (Umm Haram) kaha, "Aye Allah ke Rasool! Allah se dua kijiye ke wo mujhe unmein se ek banaaye." Unhone kaha, "Tum sabse pehlon mein hogi."' Kaha jaata hai ke Umm Haram ne Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke daur mein samundar paar kiya, aur samundar se nikalte hi, wo apni sawaari se gir gayi aur unka intekaal ho gaya.

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade two kinds of dresses and two kinds of bargains; Ishtimal As-Samma and Al- Ihtiba in one garment with no part of it covering one's private parts. (The two kinds of bargains were:) Al-Mulamasa and Al-Munabadha
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne do tarah ke kapde aur do qism ki khareed-farokht se mana kiya: Ishtimal As-Samma aur Al-Ihtiba ek hi kapde mein jiska koi hissa sharmgaah na dhaanke. (Do qism ki khareed-farokht thi:) Al-Mulamasa aur Al-Munabadha.

e: Narrated `Aisha:Mother of the Believers: We, the wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) were all sitting with the Prophet (ﷺ) and none of us had left when Fatima came walking, and by Allah, her gait was very similar to that of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) .' When he saw her, he welcomed her, saying, "Welcome, O my daughter!" Then he made her sit on his right or his left, confided something to her, whereupon she wept bitterly. When he noticed her sorrow, he confided something else to her for the second time, and she started laughing. Only I from among the Prophet's wives said to her, "(O Fatima), Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) selected you from among us for the secret talk and still you weep?" When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got up (and went away), I asked her, "What did he confide to you?" She said, "I wouldn't disclose the secrets of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)" But when he died I asked her, "I beseech you earnestly by what right I have on you, to tell me (that secret talk which the Prophet had with you)" She said, "As you ask me now, yes, (I will tell you)." She informed me, saying, "When he talked to me secretly the first time, he said that Gabriel used to review the Qur'an with him once every year. He added, 'But this year he reviewed it with me twice, and therefore I think that my time of death has approached. So, be afraid of Allah, and be patient, for I am the best predecessor for you (in the Hereafter).' " Fatima added, "So I wept as you (`Aisha) witnessed. And when the Prophet (ﷺ) saw me in this sorrowful state, he confided the second secret to me saying, 'O Fatima! Will you not be pleased that you will be chief of all the believing women (or chief of the women of this nation i.e. my followers?)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Ummul-Momineen) bataati hain: Hum, Nabi (SAW) ki biwiyaan, sab Nabi (SAW) ke saath baithi thin, aur hum mein se koi nahi gayi thi, jab Fatima (Alayhas Salam) chalti hui aayi, aur Allah ki qasam, unki chaal bilkul Allah ke Rasool (SAW) jaisi thi. Jab unhone unhein dekha, unhone unka istikbaal karte hue kaha, 'Khush-aamdeed, Aye meri beti!' Phir unhone unhein apne daaen ya baaen bithaaya, unse chupke se kuch kaha, isper wo phoot-phoot kar rone lagi. Jab Nabi (SAW) ne unka gam dekha, unhone unhein dobara kuch chupke se kaha, aur wo hansne lagi. Nabi ki biwiyon mein se sirf maine unse kaha, '(Aye Fatima (Alayhas Salam)), Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne khaas taur par tumhein chupki baat ke liye chuna, phir bhi tum ro rahi ho?' Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) uthe (aur chale gaye), maine unse pucha, 'Unhone tumse chupke se kya kaha?' Unhone kaha, 'Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke raaz zaahir nahi karungi.' Magar jab unka intekaal ho gaya, maine unse pucha, 'Main tumhein us haq ki qasam deti hoon jo mera tumpar hai, mujhe bataao (wo chupki baat jo Nabi ne tumse ki).' Unhone kaha, 'Ab jabke tum pooch rahi ho, haan, (main bataungi).' Unhone mujhe bataaya, 'Jab unhone mujhse pehli baar chupke se baat ki, unhone kaha ke Jibrael har saal ek baar Quran unke saath dohraate the. Unhone izaafa kiya, "Magar is saal unhone mujhse ise do baar dohraaya, isliye mujhe lagta hai meri maut ka waqt qareeb aa gaya hai. Isliye, Allah se daro aur sabra karo, kyunke main tumhaare liye behtareen agla (Aakhirat mein pehle jaane wala) hoon."' Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ne aage kaha, 'To main royi jaisa tumne (Aisha) dekha. Aur jab Nabi (SAW) ne mujhe is gamgeen haalat mein dekha, unhone doosri chupki baat kahi, "Aye Fatima (Alayhas Salam)! Kya tum khush nahi hogi ke tum sab Momin auraton ki (ya is ummat ki auraton ki) sardaar hogi?"'

e: Narrated the uncle of `Abbas bin Tamim:I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) lying on his back in the mosque and putting one of his legs over the other
hi: Abbas bin Tamim ke chacha bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Masjid mein peeth ke bal letā hua dekha, ek taang doosri par rakhe hue.

e: Narrated `Abdullah:the Prophet (ﷺ) said "When three persons are together, then no two of them should hold secret counsel excluding the third person
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab teen log saath hon, to unmein se do ko teesre ko chhod kar chupke se baat nahi karni chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) confided to me a secret which I did not disclose to anybody after him. And Um Sulaim asked me (about that secret) but I did not tell her
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne mujhse ek raaz kaha jo maine unke baad kisi ko nahi bataaya. Umm Sulaim (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne mujhse (us raaz ke baare mein) pucha magar maine unhein nahi bataaya.

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When you are three persons sitting together, then no two of you should hold secret counsel excluding the third person until you are with some other people too, for that would grieve him
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab tum teen log saath baithe ho, to tum mein se do ko teesre ko chhod kar chupke se baat nahi karni chaahiye, jab tak tum kisi aur (chauthe) ke saath na ho, kyunke isse use dukh pahunchega.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:One day the Prophet (ﷺ) divided and distributed something amongst the people whereupon an Ansari man said, "In this division Allah's Countenance has not been sought." I said, "By Allah! I will go (and inform) the Prophet." So I went to him while he was with a group of people, and I secretly informed him of that, whereupon he became so angry that his face became red, and he then said, "May Allah bestow His Mercy on Moses (for) he was hurt more than that, yet he remained patient
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek din Nabi (SAW) ne logon mein kuch cheez taqseem ki, isper ek Ansaari shaks ne kaha, 'Is taqseem mein Allah ki khushi nahi chaahi gayi.' Maine kaha, 'Allah ki qasam! Main jaakar Nabi (SAW) ko (ye baat) bataaunga.' To main unke paas gaya jabke wo logon ke ek giroh ke saath the, aur maine unhein chupke se ye bataaya, isper wo itne gussa hue ke unka chehra laal ho gaya, phir unhone kaha, 'Allah Musa par reham kare, (kyunke) unhein isse bhi zyaada takleef pahunchaayi gayi thi, phir bhi wo sabra karte rahe.'

e: Narrated Anas:The Iqama for the prayer was announced while a man was talking to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) privately. He continued talking in that way till the Prophet's companions slept, and afterwards the Prophet (ﷺ) got up and offered the prayer with them
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Namaz ki Iqama kahi gayi jabke ek shaks Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se chupke se baat kar raha tha. Wo isi tarah baat karta raha yahaan tak ke Nabi (SAW) ke sahaaba so gaye, aur uske baad Nabi (SAW) uthe aur unke saath namaz padhi.

e: Narrated Salim's father:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not keep the fire burning in your houses when you go to bed
hi: Salim ke waalid bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab so-ne jao, to apne gharon mein aag jalti hui mat chhodo.'

e: Narrated Abu Musa:One night a house in Medina was burnt with its occupants. The Prophet (ﷺ) spoke about them, saying, "This fire is indeed your enemy, so whenever you go to bed, put it out to protect yourselves
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek raat Madina mein ek ghar apne rehne walon samet jal gaya. Nabi (SAW) ne unke baare mein baat karte hue kaha, 'Ye aag waaqai tumhaari dushman hai, isliye jab bhi tum so-ne jao, khud ko bachaane ke liye ise bujha do.'

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "(At bedtime) cover the utensils, close the doors, and put out the lights, lest the evil creature (the rat) should pull away the wick and thus burn the people of the house
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, '(So-ne se pehle) bartanon ko dhaanko, darwaaze band karo, aur chiraagh bujha do, kahin bura jaandaar (chuha) battī khaincha kar ghar walon ko jalaa na de.'

e: Narrated Jabir:Allah's Apostle said, "When you intend going to bed at night, put out the lights, close the doors, tie the mouths of the water skins, and cover your food and drinks." Hamrnam said, "I think he (the other narrator) added, 'even with piece of wood across the utensil
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab tum raat ko so-ne ka iraada karo, chiraagh bujha do, darwaaze band karo, mashkon ka munh baandho, aur apne khaane aur peene ki cheezein dhaanko.' Ravi Hammam kehte hain, 'Mera khayaal hai unhone (doosre ravi ne) izaafa kiya, "chaahe kisi lakdi ke tukde se hi kyun na ho bartan ke aar-paar rakh kar."'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said "Five things are in accordance with Al Fitra (i.e. the tradition of prophets): to be circumcised, to shave the pelvic region, to pull out the hair of the armpits, to cut short the moustaches, and to clip the nails
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Paanch cheezein Al-Fitra (Nabiyon ki riwaayat) ke mutaabik hain: khatna karna, sharmgaah ke baal mundwaana, baaghal ke baal nochna, moonchhein chhoti karna, aur naakhoon kaatna.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said "The Prophet) Abraham circumcised himself after he had passed the age of eighty years and he circumcised himself with an adze
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, '(Nabi) Ibrahim ne apna khatna khud kiya jab wo assi (80) saal ki umar paar kar chuke the, aur unhone ye ek Qadum (basoola/adze) se kiya.'

e: Narrated Said bin Jubair:Ibn 'Abbas was asked, "How old were you when the Prophet (ﷺ) died?" He replied. "At that time I had been circumcised." At that time, people did not circumcise the boys till they attained the age of puberty. Sa'id bin Jubair said, "Ibn 'Abbas said, 'When the Prophet died, I had already been circumcised
hi: Saeed bin Jubair bataate hain: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha gaya, 'Jab Nabi (SAW) ka intekaal hua, aapki umar kitni thi?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Us waqt tak mera khatna ho chuka tha.' Us zamaane mein, log ladkon ka khatna tab tak nahi karte the jab tak wo baaligh na ho jaate. Saeed bin Jubair kehte hain, 'Ibn Abbas ne kaha, "Jab Nabi (SAW) ka intekaal hua, mera khatna pehle hi ho chuka tha."'

e: Sa'id ibn Jubair said, "Ibn 'Abbas said, 'When the Prophet (ﷺ) died, I had already been circumcised
hi: Saeed ibn Jubair kehte hain, 'Ibn Abbas ne kaha, "Jab Nabi (SAW) ka intekaal hua, mera khatna pehle hi ho chuka tha."'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever among you takes an oath wherein he says, 'By Al-Lat and Al-`Uzza,' names of two Idols worshipped by the Pagans, he should say, 'None has the right to be worshipped but Allah; And whoever says to his friend, 'Come, let me gamble with you ! He should give something in charity. " (See Hadith No)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi tum mein se qasam khaata hai jismein wo kehta hai, "Al-Lat aur Al-Uzza ki qasam" (mushrikon ki parastish ki jaane wali do buton ke naam), use kehna chaahiye, "Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi." Aur jo koi apne dost se kahe, "Aao, main tumse jua khelun," use kuch sadqa dena chaahiye.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees dekhein.)

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:During the life-time of the Prophet (ﷺ) I built a house with my own hands so that it might protect me from the rain and shade me from the sun; and none of Allah's creatures assisted me in building it
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ki zindagi ke dauraan maine apne haathon se ek ghar banaaya taake wo mujhe baarish se bachaaye aur dhoop se chhaaon de; aur Allah ki kisi makhlooq ne mujhe ise banaane mein madad nahi ki.

e: Narrated `Amr:Ibn `Umar said, "By Allah, I have not put a brick over a brick (i.e. constructed a building) or planted any date-palm tree since the death of the Prophet." Sufyan (the sub narrator) said, "I told this narration (of Ibn `Umar) to one of his (Ibn `Umar's) relatives, and he said, 'By Allah, he did build (something.' "Sufyan added, "I said, 'He must have said (the above narration) before he built
hi: Amr bataate hain: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, maine Nabi (SAW) ke intekaal ke baad se na ek eent ke oopar ek eent rakhi hai (yaani koi imaarat nahi banaayi), na koi khajoor ka darakht lagaaya hai.' Ravi Sufyan kehte hain, 'Maine ye riwaayat (Ibn Umar ki) unke ek rishtedaar ko sunaayi, aur unhone kaha, "Allah ki qasam, unhone (kuch) banaaya."' Sufyan ne aage kaha, 'Maine kaha, "Unhone shaayad (upar wali baat) ise banaane se pehle kahi hogi."'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "For every prophet there is one (special invocation (that will not be rejected) with which he appeals (to Allah), and I want to keep such an invocation for interceding for my followers in the Hereafter
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Har Nabi ke liye ek khaas dua hoti hai (jo rad nahi ki jaati) jiske zariye wo Allah se guhaar lagaata hai, aur main apni ye khaas dua Aakhirat mein apne maanne walon ki shifaa'at ke liye bacha kar rakhna chahta hoon.'

e: Narrated Anas: that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "For every prophet there is an invocation that surely will be responded by Allah," (or said), "For every prophet there was an invocation with which he appealed to Allah, and his invocation was accepted (in his lifetime), but I kept my (this special) invocation to intercede for my followers on the Day of Resurrection
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Har Nabi ke liye ek dua hai jise zaroor Allah qubool karta hai,' (ya kaha,) 'Har Nabi ki ek dua thi jiske zariye usne Allah se guhaar lagaayi, aur uski dua qubool ki gayi (uski zindagi mein), magar maine apni ye (khaas) dua Qayamat ke din apne maanne walon ki shifaa'at ke liye bacha kar rakhi hai.'

e: Narrated Shaddad bin Aus:The Prophet (ﷺ) said "The most superior way of asking for forgiveness from Allah is: 'Allahumma anta Rabbi la ilaha illa anta, Khalaqtani wa ana `Abduka, wa ana `ala `ahdika wa wa`dika mastata`tu, A`udhu bika min Sharri ma sana`tu, abu'u Laka bini`matika `alaiya, wa abu'u laka bidhanbi faghfir lee fa innahu la yaghfiru adhdhunuba illa anta." The Prophet (ﷺ) added. "If somebody recites it during the day with firm faith in it, and dies on the same day before the evening, he will be from the people of Paradise; and if somebody recites it at night with firm faith in it, and dies before the morning, he will be from the people of Paradise
hi: Shaddad bin Aus bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah se maafi maangne ka sabse behtareen tareeka ye hai: "Allahumma Anta Rabbi, La Ilaha Illa Anta, Khalaqtani Wa Ana Abduka, Wa Ana Ala Ahdika Wa Wa'dika Mastata'tu, A'udhu Bika Min Sharri Ma Sana'tu, Abu'u Laka Bini'matika Alaiya, Wa Abu'u Laka Bidhanbi Faghfir Li Fa Innahu La Yaghfirudh-Dhunuba Illa Anta."' (Aye Allah!
