Tu mera Rab hai; Tere siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi; Tune mujhe banaaya aur main tera bandaa hoon; aur main tere ahad aur waade par apni taaqat bhar qaayam hoon; main tere zeher se panaah maangta hoon jo maine kiya hai; main tere ehsaanaat ka iqraar karta hoon jo tune mujhpar kiye, aur main apne gunaahon ka iqraar karta hoon, isliye mujhe maaf kar de, kyunke tere siwa koi gunaah maaf nahi kar sakta.) Nabi (SAW) ne izaafa kiya, 'Agar koi ise din mein sacche Iman se padhe aur usi din shaam se pehle mar jaaye, wo Jannat waalon mein se hoga; aur agar koi ise raat ko sacche Iman se padhe aur subah se pehle mar jaaye, wo Jannat waalon mein se hoga.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying." By Allah! I ask for forgiveness from Allah and turn to Him in repentance more than seventy times a day
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Allah ki qasam! Main din mein sattar baar se zyaada Allah se maafi maangta hoon aur uski taraf tauba karke laut-ta hoon.'

e: Narrated Al-Harith bin Suwaid:`Abdullah bin Mas`ud related to us two narrations: One from the Prophet (ﷺ) and the other from himself, saying: A believer sees his sins as if he were sitting under a mountain which, he is afraid, may fall on him; whereas the wicked person considers his sins as flies passing over his nose and he just drives them away like this." Abu Shihab (the sub-narrator) moved his hand over his nose in illustration. (Ibn Mas`ud added): Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah is more pleased with the repentance of His slave than a man who encamps at a place where his life is jeopardized, but he has his riding beast carrying his food and water. He then rests his head and sleeps for a short while and wakes to find his riding beast gone. (He starts looking for it) and suffers from severe heat and thirst or what Allah wished (him to suffer from). He then says, 'I will go back to my place.' He returns and sleeps again, and then (getting up), he raises his head to find his riding beast standing beside him
hi: Al-Harith bin Suwaid bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Masud ne humein do riwaayaten sunaayi: Ek Nabi (SAW) se, aur doosri apni taraf se, kehte hue: 'Momin apne gunaahon ko aise dekhta hai jaise wo ek pahaad ke neeche baitha ho, jisse darta hai ke wo uspar gir jaayega; jabke badkaar shaks apne gunaahon ko aisi machhariyon jaisa samajhta hai jo uski naak se guzarti hain aur wo unhein aise hi udaa deta hai.' (Ravi Abu Shihab ne apna haath apni naak par phera ye dikhaane ke liye.) (Ibn Masud ne izaafa kiya:) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah apne bande ki tauba se us aadmi se bhi zyaada khush hota hai jo aise jagah pada hua ho jahaan uski jaan khatre mein ho, magar uski sawaari uska khaana aur paani leke jaa rahi ho. Phir wo apna sar rakhta hai aur thodi der so jaata hai, aur jaagta hai to paata hai uski sawaari chali gayi hai. (Wo use dhoondhta hai) aur sakht garmi ya pyaas se pareshaan hota hai ya jo Allah chahe. Phir wo kehta hai, "Main apni jagah wapas jaunga." Wo wapas jaata hai aur dobara so jaata hai, aur phir (uthkar) apna sar uthaata hai to paata hai uski sawaari uske paas khadi hai.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah is more pleased with the repentance of His slave than anyone of you is pleased with finding his camel which he had lost in the desert
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah apne bande ki tauba se us se bhi zyaada khush hota hai jitna tum mein se koi registaan mein kho hue apne oont ko paakar khush hota hai.'

e: Narrated Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to pray eleven rak`at in the late part of the night, and when dawn appeared, he would offer two rak`at and then lie on his right side till the Muadhdhin came to inform him (that the morning prayer was due)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) raat ke aakhri hisse mein gyaarah rakat padhte, aur jab pau phatti, wo do rakat padhte aur apni daayin taraf let jaate yahaan tak ke Muazzin unhein (Fajr ki namaz ki) khabar dene aata.

e: Narrated Al-Bara bin `Azib:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me, "When you want to go to bed, perform ablution as you do for prayer, then lie down on your right side and say: 'Allahumma aslamtu wajhi ilaika, wa fawwadtu 'amri ilaika wa alja'tu dhahri ilaika, raghbatan wa rahbatan ilaika, la malja'a wa la manja minka illa ilaika. Amantu bikitabik al-ladhi anzalta wa binabiyyika al-ladhi arsalta'. If you should die then (after reciting this) you will die on the religion of Islam (i.e., as a Muslim); so let these words be the last you say (before going to bed)" While I was memorizing it, I said, "Wa birasulika al-ladhi arsalta (in Your Apostle whom You have sent).' The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No, but say: Wa binabiyyika al-ladhi arsalta (in Your Prophet whom You have sent)
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse kaha, 'Jab tum so-ne ka iraada karo, wuzu karo jaisa tum namaz ke liye karte ho, phir apni daayin taraf let jao aur kaho: "Allahumma Aslamtu Wajhi Ilaika, Wa Fawwadtu Amri Ilaika, Wa Alja'tu Zahri Ilaika, Raghbatan Wa Rahbatan Ilaika, La Malja'a Wa La Manja Minka Illa Ilaika. Amantu Bikitabikal-ladhi Anzalta Wa Binabiyyikal-ladhi Arsalta." (Aye Allah! Maine apna chehra tere hawaale kiya, aur apna maamla tere supurd kiya, aur apni peeth tere sahaare tikaayi, teri raghbat aur khauf ke saath; koi panaah ya bachaao ki jagah nahi tere siwa. Main tujhpar aur teri utaari hui Kitaab par, aur tere bheje Nabi par Iman laata hoon.) Agar tum (ye padhne ke baad) mar jao, to tum Islam ke deen par marogei; isliye ye alfaaz apne aakhri alfaaz banao (so-ne se pehle).' Jab main ise yaad kar raha tha, maine kaha, 'Wa Birasulikal-ladhi Arsalta' (aur tere bheje Rasool par). Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Nahi, balke kaho: Wa Binabiyyikal-ladhi Arsalta (aur tere bheje Nabi par).'

e: Narrated Hudhaifa:When the Prophet (ﷺ) went to bed, he would say: "Bismika amutu wa ahya." and when he got up he would say:" Al-hamdu li l-lahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilaihin-nushur
hi: Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Nabi (SAW) bistar par jaate, wo kehte, 'Bismika Amutu Wa Ahya' (Tere naam se main marta hoon aur jeeta hoon), aur jab wo uthte, wo kehte, 'Al-Hamdu Lillahil-ladhi Ahyana Ba'da Ma Amatana Wa Ilaihin-Nushur' (Sab tareef Allah ke liye jisne humein maut dene ke baad zinda kiya, aur usi ki taraf hum uthaaye jaayenge).

e: Narrated Al-Bara bin `Azib:That the Prophet (ﷺ) advised a man, saying, "If you intend to lie down (i.e. go to bed), say, 'Allahumma aslamtu nafsi ilaika wa fauwadtu `Amri ilaika, wa wajjahtu wajhi ilaika wa alja'tu zahri ilaika, reghbatan wa rahbatan ilaika. La malja'a wa la manja minka illa ilaika. Amantu bikitabikal-ladhi anzalta; wa nabiyyikalladhi arsalta.' And if you should die then (after reciting this before going to bed) you will die on the religion of Islam
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne ek aadmi ko naseehat di, kehte hue, 'Agar tum letne (so-ne) ka iraada karo, to kaho, "Allahumma Aslamtu Nafsi Ilaika Wa Fauwadtu Amri Ilaika, Wa Wajjahtu Wajhi Ilaika Wa Alja'tu Zahri Ilaika, Raghbatan Wa Rahbatan Ilaika. La Malja'a Wa La Manja Minka Illa Ilaika. Amantu Bikitabikal-ladhi Anzalta; Wa Nabiyyikal-ladhi Arsalta." Aur agar tum (ye so-ne se pehle padhkar) mar jao, to tum Islam ke deen par marogei.'

e: Narrated Hudhaifa:When the Prophet (ﷺ) went to bed at night, he would put his hand under his cheek and then say, "Allahumma bismika amutu wa ahya," and when he got up, he would say, "Al-Hamdu lil-lahi al-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana, wa ilaihi an-nushur
hi: Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Nabi (SAW) raat ko bistar par jaate, wo apna haath apne gaal ke neeche rakhte aur phir kehte, 'Allahumma Bismika Amutu Wa Ahya,' aur jab wo uthte, wo kehte, 'Al-Hamdu Lillahil-ladhi Ahyana Ba'da Ma Amatana, Wa Ilaihin-Nushur.'

e: Narrated Al-Bara' bin `Azib:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went to bed, he used to sleep on his right side and then say, "All-ahumma aslamtu nafsi ilaika, wa wajjahtu wajhi ilaika, wa fauwadtu `Amri ilaika, wa alja'tu zahri ilaika, raghbatan wa rahbatan ilaika. La Malja'a wa la manja minka illa ilaika. Amantu bikitabika al-ladhi anzalta wa nabiyyika al-ladhi arsalta! Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever recites these words (before going to bed) and dies the same night, he will die on the Islamic religion (as a Muslim)
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) bistar par jaate, wo apni daayin taraf so-te aur phir kehte, 'Allahumma Aslamtu Nafsi Ilaika, Wa Wajjahtu Wajhi Ilaika, Wa Fauwadtu Amri Ilaika, Wa Alja'tu Zahri Ilaika, Raghbatan Wa Rahbatan Ilaika. La Malja'a Wa La Manja Minka Illa Ilaika. Amantu Bikitabikal-ladhi Anzalta Wa Nabiyyikal-ladhi Arsalta!' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi ye alfaaz (so-ne se pehle) padhe aur usi raat mar jaaye, wo Islami deen (Musalmaan) par marega.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:One night I slept at the house of Maimuna. The Prophet (ﷺ) woke up, answered the call of nature, washed his face and hands, and then slept. He got up (late at night), went to a water skin, opened the mouth thereof and performed ablution not using much water, yet he washed all the parts properly and then offered the prayer. I got up and straightened my back in order that the Prophet (ﷺ) might not feel that I was watching him, and then I performed the ablution, and when he got up to offer the prayer, I stood on his left. He caught hold of my ear and brought me over to his right side. He offered thirteen rak`at in all and then lay down and slept till he started blowing out his breath as he used to do when he slept. In the meantime Bilal informed the Prophet (ﷺ) of the approaching time for the (Fajr) prayer, and the Prophet offered the Fajr (Morning) prayer without performing new ablution. He used to say in his invocation, Allahumma ij`al fi qalbi nuran wa fi basari nuran, wa fi sam`i nuran, wa`an yamini nuran, wa`an yasari nuran, wa fawqi nuran, wa tahti nuran, wa amami nuran, wa khalfi nuran, waj`al li nuran." Kuraib (a sub narrator) said, "I have forgotten seven other words, (which the Prophet (ﷺ) mentioned in this invocation). I met a man from the offspring of Al-`Abbas and he narrated those seven things to me, mentioning, '(Let there be light in) my nerves, my flesh, my blood, my hair and my body,' and he also mentioned two other things
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek raat main Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke ghar so gaya. Nabi (SAW) uthe, qaza-e-haajat gaye, apna chehra aur haath dhoye, aur phir so gaye. Wo uthe (raat ke aakhri hisse mein), ek mashk ke paas gaye, uska munh khola aur bina zyaada paani istemaal kiye wuzu kiya, phir bhi unhone sab hisson ko theek se dhoya, aur phir namaz padhi. Main uthaa aur apni peeth seedhi ki taake Nabi (SAW) ko na lage ke main unhein dekh raha hoon, phir maine wuzu kiya, aur jab wo namaz padhne uthe, main unke baaen taraf khada hua. Unhone mera kaan pakda aur mujhe apni daayin taraf le aaye. Unhone kul terah rakat padhi, phir let gaye aur so gaye yahaan tak ke wo apni saans phoolne lagi jaisa wo so-te waqt karte the. Isi dauraan Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Nabi (SAW) ko (Fajr ki) namaz ke aane wale waqt ki khabar di, aur Nabi (SAW) ne bina naya wuzu kiye Fajr ki namaz padhi. Wo apni dua mein kehte the, 'Allahumma Ij'al Fi Qalbi Nuran Wa Fi Basari Nuran, Wa Fi Sam'i Nuran, Wa An Yamini Nuran, Wa An Yasari Nuran, Wa Fauqi Nuran, Wa Tahti Nuran, Wa Amami Nuran, Wa Khalfi Nuran, Waj'al Li Nuran.' (Aye Allah! Mere dil mein noor daal, aur meri nazar mein noor, aur mere kaan mein noor, aur mere daaen taraf noor, aur mere baaen taraf noor, aur mere oopar noor, aur mere neeche noor, aur mere aage noor, aur mere peechhe noor, aur mere liye noor bana.) Ravi Kuraib kehte hain, 'Main saat aur alfaaz bhool gaya hoon (jo Nabi SAW ne is dua mein kahe the). Maine Al-Abbas ki aulaad mein se ek shaks se mulaakaat ki aur unhone mujhe wo saat cheezein bataayi, zikr karte hue, "(Noor ho) meri naadiyon mein, mere gosht mein, mere khoon mein, mere baalon mein, aur mere jism mein," aur unhone do aur cheezon ka bhi zikr kiya.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When the Prophet (ﷺ) got up at night to offer the night prayer, he used to say: "Allahumma laka l-hamdu; Anta nuras-samawati wal ardi wa man fihinna. wa laka l-hamdu; Anta qaiyim as-samawati wal ardi wa man flhinna. Wa lakaI-hamdu; Anta-l-,haqqun, wa wa'daka haqqun, wa qauluka haqqun, wa liqauka haqqun, wal-jannatu haqqun, wannaru haqqun, was-sa atu haqqun, wan-nabiyyuna huqqun, Mahammadun haqqun, Allahumma laka aslamtu, wa Alaika tawakkaltu, wa bika amantu, wa ilaika anabtu, wa bika Khasamtu, wa ilaika hakamtu, faghfirli ma qaddamtu wa ma akh-khartu, wa ma asrartu, wa ma a'lantu. Anta al-muqaddimu, wa anta al-mu-'akhkhiru. La ilaha il-la anta (or La ilaha ghairuka)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Nabi (SAW) raat ko namaz ke liye uthte, wo kehte, 'Allahumma Laka-l-Hamdu; Anta Nuras-Samawati Wal Ardi Wa Man Fihinna. Wa Laka-l-Hamdu; Anta Qaiyim As-Samawati Wal Ardi Wa Man Fihinna. Wa Laka-l-Hamdu; Anta-l-Haqqu, Wa Wa'daka Haqqun, Wa Qauluka Haqqun, Wa Liqauka Haqqun, Wal-Jannatu Haqqun, Wan-Naru Haqqun, Was-Sa'atu Haqqun, Wan-Nabiyyuna Haqqun, Muhammadun Haqqun, Allahumma Laka Aslamtu, Wa Alaika Tawakkaltu, Wa Bika Amantu, Wa Ilaika Anabtu, Wa Bika Khasamtu, Wa Ilaika Hakamtu, Faghfirli Ma Qaddamtu Wa Ma Akh-khartu, Wa Ma Asrartu, Wa Ma A'lantu. Antal-Muqaddimu, Wa Anta-l-Mu'akhkhiru. La Ilaha Illa Anta (ya La Ilaha Ghairuka).' (Aye Allah! Tere liye hamd hai; Tu aasmaanon aur zameen aur unmein jo hai uska noor hai; aur tere liye hamd hai; Tu aasmaanon aur zameen aur unmein jo hai unka qaayam rakhne wala hai; aur tere liye hamd hai; Tu Haqq hai, aur tera waada Haqq hai, aur teri baat Haqq hai, aur teri mulaaqat Haqq hai, aur Jannat Haqq hai, aur Jahannam Haqq hai, aur Qayamat Haqq hai, aur Nabi Haqq hain, Muhammad Haqq hain. Aye Allah! Maine tujhe apna sar jhukaaya, aur tujhpar bharosa kiya, aur tujhpar Iman laaya, aur teri taraf lauta, aur tere liye jhagda kiya, aur tujhse faisla chaaha, isliye mujhe maaf kar de mere aage-peeche ke, mere chhupe aur zaahir gunaah. Tu hi aage badhaane wala hai, aur Tu hi peeche karne wala hai. Tere siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi (ya, Tere siwa koi ma'bood nahi).'

e: Narrated `Ali:Fatima complained about the blisters on her hand because of using a mill-stone. She went to ask the Prophet for servant, but she did not find him (at home) and had to inform `Aisha of her need. When he came, `Aisha informed him about it. `Ali added: The Prophet (ﷺ) came to us when we had gone to our beds. When I was going to get up, he said, "'Stay in your places," and sat between us, till I felt the coolness of the feet on my chest. The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "Shall I not tell you of a thing which is better for you than a servant? When you (both) go to your beds, say 'Allahu Akbar' thirty-three times, and 'Subhan Allah' thirty-three times, 'Al hamdu 'illah' thirty-three times, for that is better for you than a servant." Ibn Seereen said, "Subhan Allah' (is to be said for) thirty-four times
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ne chakki chalaane se apne haathon mein aaye chhaalon ki shikaayat ki. Wo Nabi (SAW) se ek khaadim maangne gayi, magar unhein wo (ghar par) nahi mila, isliye unhein Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko apni zaroorat bataani padi. Jab wo aaye, Aisha ne unhein iske baare mein bataaya. Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne aage kaha: Nabi (SAW) humare paas aaye jab hum apne bistar par ja chuke the. Jab main uthne wala tha, unhone kaha, 'Apni apni jagah rahiye,' aur humare beech baith gaye, yahaan tak ke maine unke pairon ki thandak apni chhaati par mehsoos ki. Nabi (SAW) ne phir kaha, 'Kya main tumhein ek aisi cheez na bataun jo tumhaare liye khaadim se behtar hai? Jab tum (dono) apne bistar par jao, "Allahu Akbar" tettis baar kaho, aur "Subhan Allah" tettis baar, "Alhamdulillah" tettis baar, kyunke ye tumhaare liye khaadim se behtar hai.' Ibn Seereen kehte hain, "Subhan Allah" chauntis baar (kaha jaana chaahiye).

e: Narrated `Aisha:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went to bed, he used to blow on his hands while reciting the Mu'auwidhat ( i.e. Suratal-Falaq 113 and Surat-an-Nas 114) and then pass his hands over his body
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab bhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) bistar par jaate, wo Mu'auwidhataan (yaani Surah Al-Falaq (113) aur Surah An-Nas (114)) padhte hue apne haathon par phoonkte, phir apne haath apne jism par phera dete.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When anyone of you go to bed, he should shake out his bed with the inside of his waist sheet, for he does not know what has come on to it after him, and then he should say: 'Bismika Rabbi Wada`tu Janbi wa bika arfa'uhu, In amsakta nafsi farhamha wa in arsaltaha fahfazha bima tahfazu bihi ibadakas-salihin
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab tum mein se koi bistar par jaaye, use apna kamarband ke andar ke hisse se apna bistar jhaad lena chaahiye, kyunke use nahi pata uske jaane ke baad usmein kya aa gaya hai, aur phir use kehna chaahiye, "Bismika Rabbi Wada'tu Janbi Wa Bika Arfa'uhu, In Amsakta Nafsi Farhamha Wa In Arsaltaha Fahfazha Bima Tahfazu Bihi Ibadakas-Saaliheen."' (Tere naam se, Aye mere Rab, maine apna pehlu rakha, aur tere hi zariye main ise uthaunga. Agar tu meri jaan rok le, to uspar reham kar, aur agar tu ise chhod de, to iski hifaazat kar jaise tu apne neik bandon ki hifaazat karta hai.)

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When it is the last third of the night, our Lord, the Blessed, the Superior, descends every night to the heaven of the world and says, 'Is there anyone who invokes Me (demand anything from Me), that I may respond to his invocation; Is there anyone who asks Me for something that I may give (it to) him; Is there anyone who asks My forgiveness that I may forgive him?
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab raat ka aakhri tihaai hissa aata hai, hamaara Rab, jo Mubarak aur Aala hai, har raat aasman-e-duniya par utarta hai aur kehta hai, "Hai koi jo mujhse dua kare (mujhse kuch maange), taake main uski dua qubool karoon? Hai koi jo mujhse kuch maange, taake main use (wo cheez) doon? Hai koi jo mujhse maafi maange, taake main use maaf karoon?"'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) went to the lavatory, he used to say: "Allahumma inni a`udhu bika min al-khubuthi wal khaba'ith
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab bhi Nabi (SAW) toilet jaate, wo kehte, 'Allahumma Inni A'udhu Bika Min Al-Khubuthi Wal Khaba'ith' (Aye Allah! Main tujhse (naapaak) jinn aur jinniyat se panaah maangta hoon).

e: Narrated Shaddad bin 'Aus:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The most superior way of asking for forgiveness from Allah is: 'Allahumma anta Rabbi la ilaha illa anta. Khalaqtani wa ana `Abduka, wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa Wa'dika mastata'tu abu'u Laka bi ni 'matika wa abu'u Laka bidhanbi; faghfirli fa'innahu la yaghfiru-dh-dhunuba ill a ant a. A'uidhu bika min sharri ma sana'tu.' If somebody recites this invocation during the night, and if he should die then, he will go to Paradise (or he will be from the people of Paradise). And if he recites it in the morning, and if he should die on the same day, he will have the same fate
hi: Shaddad bin Aus bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah se maafi maangne ka sabse behtareen tareeka ye hai: "Allahumma Anta Rabbi La Ilaha Illa Anta. Khalaqtani Wa Ana Abduka, Wa Ana Ala Ahdika Wa Wa'dika Mastata'tu, Abu'u Laka Bini'matika Wa Abu'u Laka Bidhanbi; Faghfirli Fa Innahu La Yaghfirudh-Dhunuba Illa Anta. A'udhu Bika Min Sharri Ma Sana'tu." Agar koi ye dua raat ko padhe, aur agar wo tab mar jaaye, to wo Jannat mein jaayega (ya Jannat waalon mein se hoga). Aur agar wo ise subah padhe, aur agar wo usi din mar jaaye, to uska bhi wahi anjaam hoga.'

e: Narrated Hudhaifa:Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) intended to go to bed, he would recite: "Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya (With Your name, O Allah, I die and I live)." And when he woke up from his sleep, he would say: "Al-hamdu lil-lahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana; wa ilaihi an-nushur (All the Praises are for Allah Who has made us alive after He made us die (sleep) and unto Him is the Resurrection
hi: Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab bhi Nabi (SAW) so-ne ka iraada karte, wo padhte, 'Bismika Allahumma Amutu Wa Ahya' (Tere naam se, Aye Allah, main marta hoon aur jeeta hoon). Aur jab wo apni neend se uthte, wo kehte, 'Al-Hamdu Lillahil-ladhi Ahyana Ba'da Ma Amatana; Wa Ilaihi An-Nushur' (Sab tareef Allah ke liye jisne humein maut (neend) dene ke baad zinda kiya; aur usi ki taraf Qayamat hai).

e: Narrated Abu Dhar:Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) lay on his bed, he used to say: "Allahumma bismika amutu wa ahya," and when he woke up he would say: "Al-hamdu lil-lahilladhi ahyana ba'da ma an atana, wa ilaihi an-nushur
hi: Abu Dharr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab bhi Nabi (SAW) apne bistar par lete, wo kehte, 'Allahumma Bismika Amutu Wa Ahya,' aur jab wo uthte, wo kehte, 'Al-Hamdu Lillahil-ladhi Ahyana Ba'da Ma Amatana, Wa Ilaihi An-Nushur.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:Abu Bakr As-Siddiq said to the Prophet, "Teach me an invocation with which I may invoke (Allah) in my prayer." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Say: Allahumma inni zalamtu nafsi zulman kathiran wala yaghfirudhdhunuba illa anta, Faghfirli maghfiratan min indika war-hamni, innaka antalGhafur-Rahim
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Bakr As-Siddiq ne Nabi (SAW) se kaha, 'Mujhe ek aisi dua sikhaiye jo main apni namaz mein padhun.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Kaho: "Allahumma Inni Zalamtu Nafsi Zulman Kathiran Wala Yaghfirudh-Dhunuba Illa Anta, Faghfirli Maghfiratan Min Indika War-Hamni, Innaka Antal-Ghafur-Rahim."' (Aye Allah! Maine apni jaan par bahut zulm kiya hai, aur tere siwa koi gunaah maaf nahi karta, isliye mujhe apni taraf se maafi de aur mujhpar reham kar, beshak tu hi bakshne wala, meharbaan hai.)

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Verse: 'Neither say your prayer aloud, nor say it in a low tone.' (17.110) was revealed as regards invocation
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Aayat, 'Na apni namaz oonchi aawaaz mein padho, na bahut halke se' (17:110), dua ke baare mein naazil hui thi.

e: Narrated `Abdullah:We used to say in the prayer: 'AsSalam be on Allah, As-Salam be on so-and-so.' So one day the Prophet said to us, "Allah Himself is As-Salam; when anyone of you sits during his prayer, he should say: 'at-tah, iyyatu-li l-lahi,' up to 'As-Salihin,' (All the compliments are for Allah ...righteous people) for when he recites this, then he says his Salam to all the righteous people present in the heavens and on the earth. Then he should say, 'I testify that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, and that Muhammad is His slave and His Apostle,' and then he can select whatever he likes to celebrate (Allah's) Praises
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum namaz mein kehte, 'As-Salaam Allah par ho, As-Salaam falaan-falaan par ho.' Ek din Nabi (SAW) ne humse kaha, 'Allah khud As-Salaam hai; jab tum mein se koi apni namaz mein baithe, use kehna chaahiye, "At-Tahiyyatu-Lillah," jab tak "As-Saaliheen" tak, (Sab tareefein Allah ke liye hain...neik logon tak) kyunke jab wo ise padhta hai, wo aasman aur zameen ke sab neik logon ko salaam kar raha hota hai. Phir use kehna chaahiye, "Main gawaahi deta hoon ke Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi, aur Muhammad uske bande aur Rasool hain," aur phir wo jo bhi Allah ki tareef karna chaahe kar sakta hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The people said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! The rich people have got the highest degrees of prestige and the permanent pleasures (in this life and the life to come in the Hereafter)." He said, "How is that?" They said, "The rich pray as we pray, and strive in Allah's Cause as we do, and spend from their surplus wealth in charity, while we have no wealth (to spend likewise)." He said, "Shall I not tell you a thing, by doing which, you will catch up with those who are ahead of you and supersede those who will come after you; and nobody will be able to do such a good deed as you do except the one who does the same (deed as you do). That deed is to recite 'Subhan Allah ten times, and 'Al-Hamduli l-lah ten times, and 'AllahuAkbar' ten times after every prayer
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Logon ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Ameer logon ko izzat ke sabse ooncha darja aur mustaqil khushiyaan (is duniya mein aur Aakhirat mein) mil gayi hain.' Unhone pucha, 'Wo kaise?' Unhone kaha, 'Ameer log humaari tarah namaz padhte hain, aur humaari tarah Allah ki raah mein koshish karte hain, aur apni zyaada daulat mein se sadqa dete hain, jabke hamaare paas (waisa) daulat nahi hai.' Unhone kaha, 'Kya main tumhein ek aisi cheez na bataun, jisse tum un logon tak pahunch jaoge jo tumse aage hain aur un logon se aage nikal jaoge jo tumhaare baad aayenge; aur koi bhi is nek amal jaisa nahi kar payega siwaaye us shaks ke jo waisa hi kare jaisa tum karoge? Wo amal ye hai: har namaz ke baad "Subhan Allah" das baar, "Alhamdulillah" das baar, aur "Allahu Akbar" das baar padho.'

e: Narrated Warrad:(the freed slave of Al-Mughira bin Shu`ba) Al-Mughira wrote to Muawiya bin Abu Sufyan that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to say at the end of every prayer after the Taslim, "La ilaha illa-l-lahu wahdahu la sharika lahu; lahu-l-mulk wa lahu-l-hamd, wahuwa 'ala kulli shai'n qadir. Allahumma la mani'a Lima a taita, wa la mu'ta Lima mana'ta, wa la yanfa'u dhal-jaddu minkal-jadd
hi: Warrad (Al-Mughira bin Shu'ba (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke azaad kiye ghulaam) bataate hain: Al-Mughira ne Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Sufyan ko likha ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) har namaz ke baad, Taslim ke baad, kehte the, 'La Ilaha Illal-lahu Wahdahu La Sharika Lahu; Lahul-Mulku Wa Lahul-Hamdu, Wa Huwa Ala Kulli Shai'in Qadir. Allahumma La Mani'a Lima A'taita, Wa La Mu'tia Lima Mana'ta, Wa La Yanfa'u Dhal-Jaddi Minkal-Jadd.' (Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi, akela, uska koi shareek nahi; uske liye baadshahat hai, aur uske liye tareef hai, aur wo har cheez par qaadir hai. Aye Allah! Koi rokne wala nahi jo tune diya use, aur koi dene wala nahi jo tune roka use, aur kisi kismat waale ki kismat tere saamne kaam nahi aati.)

e: Narrated Salama bin Al-Akwa`:We went out with the Prophet (ﷺ) to Khaibar. A man among the people said, "O 'Amir! Will you please recite to us some of your poetic verses?" So 'Amir got down and started chanting among them, saying, "By Allah! Had it not been for Allah, we would not have been guided." 'Amir also said other poetic verses which I do not remember. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Who is this (camel) driver?" The people said, "He is 'Amir bin Al-Akwa`," He said, "May Allah bestow His Mercy on him." A man from the People said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Would that you let us enjoy his company longer." When the people (Muslims) lined up, the battle started, and 'Amir was struck with his own sword (by chance) by himself and died. In the evening, the people made a large number of fires (for cooking meals). Allah's Apostle said, "What is this fire? What are you making the fire for?" They said, "For cooking the meat of donkeys." He said, "Throw away what is in the pots and break the pots!" A man said, "O Allah's Prophet! May we throw away what is in them and wash them?" He said, "Never mind, you may do so." (See Hadith No. 509, Vol)
hi: Salama bin Al-Akwa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Nabi (SAW) ke saath Khaibar ki taraf nikle. Logon mein se ek shaks ne kaha, 'Aye Aamir! Kya aap humein apni shaayari se kuch sunaayenge?' To Aamir utre aur unke beech (Huda ki tarz mein) padhna shuru kiya, kehte hue, 'Allah ki qasam! Agar Allah na hota, hum hidaayat na paate.' Aamir ne kuch aur sher bhi kahe jo mujhe yaad nahi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne pucha, 'Ye (oonton ka) haankne wala kaun hai?' Logon ne kaha, 'Ye Aamir bin Al-Akwa hain.' Unhone kaha, 'Allah unpar reham kare.' Logon mein se ek shaks ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kaash aap humein unki sohbat aur lambi der ka mauka dete.' Jab log qataaron mein khade hue, jang shuru hui, aur Aamir apni hi talwaar se (itefaaqan) apne aap zakhmi hue aur unka intekaal ho gaya. Shaam ko, logon ne bahut si aagein jalaayi (khaana pakaane ke liye). Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne pucha, 'Ye kaisi aag hai? Tum ye aag kis liye jala rahe ho?' Unhone kaha, 'Gadhon ka gosht pakaane ke liye.' Unhone kaha, 'Degon mein jo hai use phenk do aur degein todo!' Ek shaks ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Nabi! Kya hum unmein jo hai use phenk kar unhein dho sakte hain?' Unhone kaha, 'Koi baat nahi, tum aisa kar sakte ho.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 509, Jild 3 dekhein.)

e: Narrated Ibn Abi `Aufa:Whenever a man brought his alms to the Prophet, the Prophet (ﷺ) would say, "O Allah! Bestow Your Blessing upon the family of so-and-so." When my father came to him (with his alms), he said, "O Allah! Bestow Your Blessings upon the family of Abi `Aufa
hi: Ibn Abi Aufa bataate hain: Jab bhi koi aadmi apna sadqa Nabi (SAW) ke paas laata, Nabi (SAW) kehte, 'Aye Allah! Falaan khaandaan par apni barkat naazil kar.' Jab mere waalid unke paas (apna sadqa lekar) aaye, unhone kaha, 'Aye Allah! Abi Aufa ke khaandaan par apni barkat naazil kar.'

e: Narrated Jarir:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me. "Will you relieve me from Dhi-al-Khalasa? " Dhi-al-Khalasa was an idol which the people used to worship and it was called Al-Ka`ba al Yamaniyya. I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) I am a man who can't sit firm on horses." So he stroked my chest (with his hand) and said, "O Allah! Make him firm and make him a guiding and well-guided man." So I went out with fifty (men) from my tribe of Ahrnas. (The sub-narrator, Sufyan, quoting Jarir, perhaps said, "I went out with a group of men from my nation.") and came to Dhi-al-Khalasa and burnt it, and then came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have not come to you till I left it like a camel with a skin disease." The Prophet then invoked good upon Ahmas and their cavalry (fighters)
hi: Jarir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse kaha, 'Kya tum mujhe Dhi-al-Khalasa se raahat doge?' Dhi-al-Khalasa ek but tha jise log parastish karte the aur use 'Al-Kaaba Al-Yamaniyya' kaha jaata tha. Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Main ghodon par mazbooti se baith nahi paata.' To unhone (apne haath se) mera seena thapthapaaya aur kaha, 'Aye Allah! Ise mazboot bana aur ise raah dikhaane wala aur raah paane wala bana.' To main apne Ahmas qabeele ke pachaas (aadmiyon) ke saath nikla. (Ravi Sufyan, Jarir ke hawaale se, shaayad ye kaha, 'Main apni qaum ke ek giroh ke saath nikla.') aur Dhi-al-Khalasa pahunche aur use jala diya, phir Nabi (SAW) ke paas aakar kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Main aapke paas tab tak nahi aaya jab tak maine ise ek khaarish-zada oont jaisa (barbaad) na chhod diya.' Phir Nabi (SAW) ne Ahmas aur unke ghudsawaaron ke liye achhi dua ki.

e: Narrated Anas:Um Sulaim said to the Prophet (ﷺ) "Anas is your servant." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! increase his wealth and offspring, and bless (for him) what ever you give him
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Umm Sulaim (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne Nabi (SAW) se kaha, 'Anas aapka khaadim hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Aye Allah! Iski daulat aur aulaad badha, aur jo bhi tu use de use barkat de.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) heard a man reciting (the Qur'an) in the mosque. He said," May Allah bestow His Mercy on him, as he made me remember such and-such Verse which I had missed in such-and-such Sura
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ne Masjid mein ek shaks ko (Quran) padhte suna. Unhone kaha, 'Allah unpar reham kare, kyunke unhone mujhe falaan Surah ki falaan Aayat yaad dilaayi jo main bhool gaya tha.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) divided something (among the Muslims) and distributed the shares (of the booty). A man said, "This division has not been made to please Allah." When I informed the Prophet (ﷺ) about it, he became so furious that I noticed the signs of anger on his face and he then said, "May Allah bestow His Mercy on Moses, for he was hurt with more than this, yet he remained patient
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne (Musalmaanon mein) kuch cheez baanti aur maal-e-ganimat ke hisse taqseem kiye. Ek shaks ne kaha, 'Ye taqseem Allah ki khushi ke liye nahi ki gayi.' Jab maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye baat bataayi, wo itne gussa hue ke maine unke chehre par gusse ke aasaar dekhe, phir unhone kaha, 'Allah Musa par reham kare, kyunke unhein isse bhi zyaada takleef pahunchaayi gayi thi, phir bhi wo sabra karte rahe.'

e: Narrated `Ikrima:Ibn `Abbas said, "Preach to the people once a week, and if you won't, then preach them twice, but if you want to preach more, then let it be three times (a week only), and do not make the people fed-up with this Qur'an. If you come to some people who are engaged in a talk, don't start interrupting their talk by preaching, lest you should cause them to be bored. You should rather keep quiet, and if they ask you, then preach to them at the time when they are eager to hear what you say. And avoid the use of rhymed prose in invocation for I noticed that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and his companions always avoided it
hi: Ikrima bataate hain: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Logon ko hafte mein ek baar naseehat karo, aur agar aisa na karo, to unhein do baar karo, magar agar tum zyaada karna chaaho, to teen baar (ek hafte mein) hi karo, aur logon ko is Quran se ub mat karo. Agar tum aise logon ke paas jao jo kisi baat mein masroof hon, to unki baat ko naseehat se rok kar unhein bore mat karo. Balke khaamosh raho, aur agar wo tumse poochein, to unhein us waqt naseehat karo jab wo tumhaari baat sunne ke liye betaab hon. Aur dua mein qaafiye waali (bnaawti) zubaan istemaal karne se bacho, kyunke maine dekha hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur unke sahaaba hamesha isse bachte the.'

e: Narrated Anas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When anyone of you appeal to Allah for something, he should ask with determination and should not say, 'O Allah, if You wish, give me.', for nobody can force Allah to do something against His Will
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab tum mein se koi Allah se kisi cheez ke liye dua kare, use pakka iraada karke maangna chaahiye aur ye nahi kehna chaahiye, "Aye Allah, agar tu chaahe, to mujhe de," kyunke koi bhi Allah ko uski marzi ke khilaaf majboor nahi kar sakta.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "None of you should say: 'O Allah, forgive me if You wish; O Allah, be merciful to me if You wish,' but he should always appeal to Allah with determination, for nobody can force Allah to do something against His Will
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Tum mein se koi ye na kahe, "Aye Allah, agar tu chaahe to mujhe maaf kar; Aye Allah, agar tu chaahe to mujhpar reham kar," balke use hamesha pakke iraade ke saath Allah se dua karni chaahiye, kyunke koi bhi Allah ko uski marzi ke khilaaf majboor nahi kar sakta.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The invocation of anyone of you is granted (by Allah) if he does not show impatience (by saying, "I invoked Allah but my request has not been granted)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Tum mein se kisi ki dua (Allah ke zariye) qubool ki jaati hai agar wo be-sabri na dikhaaye (yaani ye na kahe, "Maine Allah se dua ki magar meri darkhwaast qubool nahi hui").'

e: Narrated Anas, "The Prophet (ﷺ) raised his hands (in invocation) till I saw the whiteness of his armpits
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne apne haath (dua mein) itne uthaaye ke maine unki baaghal ki safedi dekhi.

e: Narrated Anas:While the Prophet (ﷺ) was delivering a sermon on a Friday, a man stood up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Invoke Allah to bless us with rain." (The Prophet (ﷺ) invoked Allah for rain.) So, the sky became overcast and it started raining till one could hardly reach one's home. It kept on raining till the next Friday when the same man or another man got up and said (to the Prophet), "Invoke Allah to withhold the rain from us, for we have been drowned (with heavy rain )." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! Let it rain around us and not on us." Then the clouds started dispersing around Medina and rain ceased to fall on the people of Medina
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Nabi (SAW) Jumme ke din khutba de rahe the, ek shaks khada hua aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Allah se dua kijiye ke wo humein baarish se barkat de.' (Nabi SAW ne baarish ke liye Allah se dua ki.) To aasman baadalon se dhak gaya aur itni baarish hui ke ghar pahunchna mushkil ho gaya. Ye agle Jumme tak baarish hoti rahi yahaan tak ke wahi shaks (ya koi aur shaks) khada hua aur (Nabi se) kaha, 'Allah se dua kijiye ke wo hamse baarish rok le, kyunke hum (bhaari baarish se) doob rahe hain.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Aye Allah! Baarish hamare aas-paas barsaa, hampar nahi.' Phir baadal Madina ke oopar se hatkar bikharne lage aur Madina ke logon par baarish barasna band ho gaya.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Zaid:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went out to this Musalla (praying place) to offer the prayer of Istisqa.' He invoked Allah for rain and then faced the Qibla and turned his Rida' (upper garment) inside out
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) is Musalla (namaz ki jagah) mein baahar gaye Istisqa ki namaz padhne. Unhone baarish ke liye Allah se dua ki aur phir Qibla ki taraf muh kiya aur apni Rida (chaadar) ulti kar li.

e: Narrated Anas:My mother said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Please invoke Allah on behalf of your servant." He said, "O Allah! Increase his wealth and children, and bestow Your Blessing on whatever You give him." a time of distress
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Meri maa ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Barah-e-meharbaani apne khaadim (mere bete) ke liye Allah se dua kijiye.' Unhone kaha, 'Aye Allah! Iski daulat aur bacchon mein izaafa kar, aur jo bhi tu use de, use barkat de.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to invoke Allah at the time of distress, saying, "La ilaha illal-lahu Al-`Azim, al- Halim, La ilaha illal-lahu Rabbu-s-samawati wal-ard wa Rabbu-l-arsh il-azim
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) mushkil ke waqt ye dua padha karte the, 'La Ilaha Illal-lahul-Azim, Al-Haleem, La Ilaha Illal-lahu Rabbus-Samawati Wal Ardi Wa Rabbul-Arshil-Azeem.' (Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi, jo Azeem hai, jo Haleem hai; Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi, jo aasmaanon aur zameen ka Rab hai aur azeem Arsh ka Rab hai.)

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to say at a time of distress, "La ilaha illal-lahu Rabbul-l-'arsh il-'azim, La ilaha illallahu Rabbu-s-samawati wa Rabbu-l-ard, Rabbu-l-'arsh-il-Karim
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mushkil ke waqt ye kaha karte the, 'La Ilaha Illal-lahu Rabbul-Arshil-Azeem, La Ilaha Illal-lahu Rabbus-Samawati Wa Rabbul-Ardi, Rabbul-Arshil-Kareem.' (Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi, jo azeem Arsh ka Rab hai; Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi, jo aasmaanon ka Rab hai aur zameen ka Rab hai, karam waale Arsh ka Rab.)

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to seek refuge with Allah from the difficult moment of a calamity and from being overtaken by destruction and from being destined to an evil end, and from the malicious joy of enemies. Sufyan said, "This narration contained three items only, but I added one. I do not know which one that was
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) museebat ke mushkil pal se, aur barbaadi ke shikaar hone se, aur bure anjaam ki taqdeer se, aur dushmanon ki badnaseeb khushi se Allah ki panaah maanga karte the. (Ravi Sufyan kehte hain, 'Is riwaayat mein sirf teen cheezein thin, magar maine ek izaafa kiya. Mujhe nahi pata wo kaunsi thi.')

e: Narrated `Aisha:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was healthy, he used to say, "No prophet dies till he is shown his place in Paradise, and then he is given the option (to live or die)." So when death approached him(during his illness), and while his head was on my thigh, he became unconscious for a while, and when he recovered, he fixed his eyes on the ceiling and said, "O Allah! (Let me join) the Highest Companions (see Qur'an 4:69)," I said, "So, he does not choose us." Then I realized that it was the application of the statement he used to relate to us when he was healthy. So that was his last utterance (before he died), i.e. "O Allah! (Let me join) the Highest Companions
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) sehatmand the, wo kehte, 'Koi bhi Nabi tab tak nahi marta jab tak use Jannat mein uski jagah na dikhaayi jaaye, phir use (jeene ya marne ka) ikhtiyaar diya jaata hai.' To jab maut nazdeek aayi (unki bimaari ke dauraan), aur unka sar meri jaangh par tha, wo thodi der ke liye behosh ho gaye, aur jab hosh mein aaye, unhone apni nazrein chhat par gaad di aur kaha, 'Aye Allah! (Mujhe mila de) Sabse Uche Saathiyon (Quran 4:69) se.' Maine kaha, 'To, wo humein nahi chunte.' Phir mujhe yaad aaya ke ye wahi baat thi jo wo hamein sehatmand rehte hue bataaya karte the. To ye unka aakhri jumla tha (unke intekaal se pehle), yaani 'Aye Allah! Sabse Uche Saathiyon (se mujhe mila de).'

e: Narrated Qais:I came to Khabbab who had been branded with seven brands(1) and he said, "Had Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) not forbidden us to invoke (Allah) for death, I would have invoked (Allah) for it
hi: Qais bataate hain: Main Khabbab (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas aaya jinke jism par saat daagh lagaaye gaye the, aur unhone kaha, 'Agar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein maut ki dua maangne se mana na kiya hota, to main iski dua maangta.'

e: Narrated Qais:I came to Khabbab who had been branded with seven brands over his `Abdomen, and I heard him saying, "If the Prophet: had not forbidden us to invoke (Allah) for death, I would have invoked Allah for it
hi: Qais bataate hain: Main Khabbab (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas aaya jinke pet par saat daagh lagaaye gaye the, aur maine unhein kehte suna, 'Agar Nabi (SAW) ne humein maut ki dua maangne se mana na kiya hota, to main Allah se iski dua maangta.'

e: Narrated Anas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said," None of you should long for death because of a calamity that had befallen him, and if he cannot, but long for death, then he should say, 'O Allah! Let me live as long as life is better for me, and take my life if death is better for me
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Tum mein se koi bhi kisi museebat ki wajah se maut ki tamanna na kare, aur agar wo aisa na kar sake, phir bhi maut ki tamanna kare, to use kehna chaahiye, "Aye Allah! Mujhe zinda rakh jab tak zindagi mere liye behtar ho, aur mujhe maut de agar maut mere liye behtar ho."'

e: Narrated As-Sa'ib bin Yazid:My aunt took me to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! My sister's son is sick." So he passed his hand over my head and invoked for Allah's blessing upon me and then performed the ablution. I drank from the water of his ablution and I stood behind him and looked at his Khatam (the seal of Prophethood) between his shoulders (and its size was) like the button of a tent
hi: As-Sa'ib bin Yazid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Meri khaala mujhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas le gayi aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Meri behen ka beta bimar hai.' To unhone apna haath mere sar par phera aur mere liye Allah se barkat ki dua ki, phir wuzu kiya. Maine unke wuzu ka paani piya, aur main unke peechhe khada hokar unka Khatam (Nabuwwat ki muhar) unke kandhon ke beech dekha (jiska size) khaime ke bata jaisa (tha).

e: Narrated Abu `Aqil:that his grandfather. `Abdullah bin Hisham used to take him from the market or to the market (the narrator is in doubt) and used to buy grain and when Ibn Az-Zubair and Ibn `Umar met him, they would say to him, "Let us be your partners (in trading) as the Prophet (ﷺ) invoked for Allah's blessing upon you." He would then take them as partners and he would Sometimes gain a whole load carried by an animal which he would send home
hi: Abu Aqil bataate hain ke unke daada, Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Hisham (رضی اللہ عنہ), unhein bazaar se ya bazaar le jaate the (ravi ko is baare mein shak hai) aur anaaj khareedte the, aur jab Ibn Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) unse milte, wo unse kehte, 'Humein apna saathi bana lijiye (tijaarat mein), kyunke Nabi (SAW) ne aapke liye Allah se barkat ki dua ki thi.' To wo unhein apna saathi bana lete, aur kabhi-kabhi unhein ek poore jaanwar ke bojh jitna faayda hota jise wo ghar bhej dete.

e: Narrated Mahmud bin Ar-Rabi:On whose face Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had thrown water from his mouth, the water having been taken from their well while he was still a young boy (who has not yet attained the age of puberty)
hi: Mahmud bin Ar-Rabi' bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unke chehre par apne munh se paani daala tha, jo unke kuen se liya gaya tha, jab wo abhi ek chhote ladke the (jo abhi baaligh nahi hue the).

e: Narrated `Aisha:The boys used to be brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he used to invoke for Allah's blessing upon them. Once an infant was brought to him and it urinated on his clothes. He asked for water and poured it over the place of the urine and did not wash his clothes
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Bachchon ko Nabi (SAW) ke paas laaya jaata tha aur wo unke liye Allah se barkat ki dua karte the. Ek baar ek chhota bacha unke paas laaya gaya aur usne unke kapdon par peshaab kar diya. Unhone paani maangaya aur peshaab ki jagah par daala, aur apne kapde dhoye nahi.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Tha`laba bin Su'air:whose eye Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had touched, that he had seen Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas offering one rak`a only for the witr prayer
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Tha'laba bin Su'air, jinki aankh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne chhui thi, bataate hain ke unhone Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko sirf ek rakat Witr namaz padhte dekha.

e: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Laila:Ka`b bin 'Ujra met me and said, "Shall I give you a present? Once the Prophet (ﷺ) came to us and we said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ! We know how to greet you; but how to send 'Salat' upon you? He said, 'Say: Allahumma Salli ala Muhammadin wa 'ala `Ali Muhammadin, kama sal-laita 'ala all Ibrahima innaka Hamidun Majid. Allahumma barik 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala all Muhammadin, kama barakta 'ala all Ibrahima, innaka Hamidun Majid
hi: Abdur Rahman bin Abi Laila bataate hain: Ka'b bin Ujra mujhse mile aur kaha, 'Kya main tumhein ek tohfa doon? Ek baar Nabi (SAW) hamare paas aaye aur humne kaha, "Aye Allah ke Rasool! Humein pata hai aapko kaise salaam karein; magar aap par Salaat (durood) kaise bhejein?" Unhone kaha, "Kaho: Allahumma Salli Ala Muhammadin Wa Ala Aali Muhammadin, Kama Sallaita Ala Aali Ibrahima Innaka Hamidum Majid. Allahumma Barik Ala Muhammadin Wa Ala Aali Muhammadin, Kama Barakta Ala Aali Ibrahima, Innaka Hamidum Majid."'" (Aye Allah! Muhammad aur Muhammad ki Aal par apni rehmat naazil kar, jaise tune Ibrahim ki Aal par ki, beshak tu tareef ke laayak, buzurgi wala hai. Aye Allah! Muhammad aur Muhammad ki Aal ko barkat de, jaise tune Ibrahim ki Aal ko di, beshak tu tareef ke laayak, buzurgi wala hai.)

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:We said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) This is (i.e. we know) the greeting to you; will you tell us how to send Salat on you?" He said, "Say: 'Allahumma Salli 'ala Muhammadin `Abdika wa rasulika kama sal-laita 'ala Ibrahima wa barik 'ala Muhammadin wa all Muhammadin kama barakta 'ala Ibrahima wa `Ali Ibrahim
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Humne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Ye (humein pata hai) aap par salaam kaise karein; kya aap humein bataayenge Salaat kaise bhejein?' Unhone kaha, 'Kaho: "Allahumma Salli Ala Muhammadin Abdika Wa Rasulika Kama Sallaita Ala Ibrahima Wa Barik Ala Muhammadin Wa Aali Muhammadin Kama Barakta Ala Ibrahima Wa Aali Ibrahim."'" (Aye Allah! Muhammad, apne bande aur Rasool, par apni rehmat naazil kar jaise tune Ibrahim par ki, aur Muhammad aur Muhammad ki Aal ko barkat de jaise tune Ibrahim aur Ibrahim ki Aal ko di.)

e: Narrated Ibn Abi `Aufa:Whenever somebody brought alms to the Prophet (ﷺ) the used to say, "Allahumma Salli 'Alaihi (O Allah! Send Your Salat (Grace and Honor) on him)." Once when my father brought his alms to him, he said, "O Allah! Send Your Salat (Grace and Honor) on the family of Abi `Aufa
hi: Ibn Abi Aufa bataate hain: Jab bhi koi Nabi (SAW) ke paas sadqa laata, wo kehte, 'Allahumma Salli Alaihi' (Aye Allah! Uspar apni rehmat naazil kar). Ek baar jab mere waalid apna sadqa unke paas laaye, unhone kaha, 'Aye Allah! Abi Aufa ke khaandaan par apni rehmat naazil kar.'

e: Narrated Abu Humaid As-Saidi:The people said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ! How may we send Salat on you?" He said, "Say: Allahumma Salli 'ala- Muhammadin wa azwajihi wa dhurriyyatihi kama sal-laita 'ala `Ali Ibrahim; wa barik 'ala Muhammadin wa azwajihi wa dhurriyyatihi kamabarakta 'ala `Ali Ibrahim innaka hamidun majid
hi: Abu Humaid As-Sa'idi bataate hain: Logon ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Hum aap par Salaat kaise bhejein?' Unhone kaha, 'Kaho: "Allahumma Salli Ala Muhammadin Wa Azwajihi Wa Dhurriyyatihi Kama Sallaita Ala Aali Ibrahim; Wa Barik Ala Muhammadin Wa Azwajihi Wa Dhurriyyatihi Kama Barakta Ala Aali Ibrahim Innaka Hamidum Majid."'" (Aye Allah! Muhammad, unki biwiyon aur unki aulaad par apni rehmat naazil kar jaise tune Ibrahim ki Aal par ki; aur Muhammad, unki biwiyon aur unki aulaad ko barkat de jaise tune Ibrahim ki Aal ko di, beshak tu tareef ke laayak, buzurgi wala hai.)

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:that he heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "O Allah! If I should ever abuse a believer, please let that be a means of bringing him near to You on the Day of Resurrection
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke unhone Nabi (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, 'Aye Allah! Agar main kabhi kisi Momin ko bura-bhala kahun, to barah-e-meharbaani ise Qayamat ke din use tere qareeb laane ka zariya bana de.'

e: Narrated Anas:Once the people started asking Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) questions, and they asked so many questions that he became angry and ascended the pulpit and said, "I will answer whatever questions you may ask me today." I looked right and left and saw everyone covering his face with his garment and weeping. Behold ! There was a man who, on quarreling with the people, used to be called as a son of a person other than h is father. He said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Who is my father?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Your father is Hudhaifa." And then `Umar got up and said, "We accept Allah as our Lord, and Islam as (our) religion, and Muhammad as (our) Apostle; and we seek refuge with Allah from the afflictions." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, " I have never seen a day like today in its good and its evil for Paradise and the Hell Fire were displayed in front of me, till I saw them just beyond this wall." Qatada, when relating this Hadith, used to mention the following Verse:-- 'O you who believe! Ask not questions about things which, If made plain to you, May cause you trouble
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar logon ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se sawaal poochne shuru kiye, aur unhone itne sawaal poochhe ke wo gussa ho gaye aur mimbar par chadhe aur kaha, 'Main aaj tumhaare jitne bhi sawaal poochhoge unka jawab dunga.' Maine daaen aur baaen dekha aur har koi apna chehra apne kapde se dhaanke ro raha tha. Achaanak! Ek shaks tha jo logon se jhagde mein apne baap ke ilaawa kisi aur ke bete ke naam se pukaara jaata tha. Usne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mera baap kaun hai?' Nabi (SAW) ne jawab diya, 'Tumhaara baap Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) hai.' Phir Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) khade hue aur kaha, 'Hum Allah ko apna Rab, Islam ko (apna) deen, aur Muhammad (SAW) ko (apna) Rasool maante hain; aur hum museebaton se Allah ki panaah maangte hain.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Maine aaj jaisa din kabhi nahi dekha, na uski achhaai mein na uski buraai mein, kyunke Jannat aur Jahannam mere saamne pesh kiye gaye, yahaan tak ke maine unhein is deewaar ke bilkul aage dekha.' Ravi Qatada, jab ye hadees bayaan karte, is Aayat ka zikr kiya karte the: 'Aye Iman waalon! Aisi baaton ke baare mein sawaal mat poochho jo, agar tumpar zaahir ki jaayein, to tumhein museebat mein daal sakti hain.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said to Abu Talha, "Choose one of your boys to serve me." So Abu Talha took me (to serve the Prophet (ﷺ) ) by giving me a ride behind him (on his camel). So I used to serve Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) whenever he stayed somewhere. I used to hear him saying, "O Allah! I seek refuge with you (Allah) from (worries) care and grief, from incapacity and laziness, from miserliness and cowardice, from being heavily in debt and from being overpowered by other men." I kept on serving him till he returned from (the battle of) Khaibar. He then brought Safiya, the daughter of Huyay whom he had got (from the booty). I saw him making a kind of cushion with a cloak or a garment for her. He then let her ride behind him. When we reached a place called As-Sahba', he prepared (a special meal called) Hais, and asked me to invite the men who (came and) ate, and that was the marriage banquet given on the consummation of his marriage to her. Then he proceeded till the mountain of Uhud appeared, whereupon he said, "This mountain loves us and we love it." When he approached Medina, he said, "O Allah! I make the land between its (i.e., Medina's) two mountains a sanctuary, as the prophet Abraham made Mecca a sanctuary. O Allah! Bless them (the people of Medina) in their Mudd and the Sa' (units of measuring)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kaha, 'Apne ladkon mein se ek ko meri khidmat ke liye chuno.' To Abu Talha mujhe (Nabi ki khidmat ke liye) apne saath apne oont par bithaakar le gaye. Isliye main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki khidmat karta tha jab bhi wo kahin thehare. Maine unhein kehte suna, 'Aye Allah! Main tujhse (fikr aur) gam se, kamzori aur susti se, kanjoosi aur buzdili se, bhaari qarz aur doosron ke hukmraan hone se panaah maangta hoon.' Main unki khidmat karta raha yahaan tak ke wo Khaibar se wapas aaye. Phir wo Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا), Huyay ki beti, ko laaye jinhe unhone (maal-e-ganimat mein se) paaya tha. Maine unhein unke liye ek chogha ya kapde se ek takiya banaate dekha. Phir unhone unhein apne peechhe sawaar kiya. Jab hum As-Sahba naami jagah pahunche, unhone (ek khaas khaana) Hais taiyaar kiya, aur mujhse kaha ke logon ko dawat doon jo aaye aur khaana khaaya, aur wo unki shaadi poori hone ka Walima tha. Phir wo aage badhe yahaan tak ke Uhud pahaad nazar aayi, isper unhone kaha, 'Ye pahaad hamse mohabbat karti hai aur hum isse mohabbat karte hain.' Jab wo Madina ke qareeb pahunche, unhone kaha, 'Aye Allah! Main iske (Madina ke) do pahaadon ke beech ki zameen ko ek panaah-gah banaata hoon, jaisa Nabi Ibrahim ne Makkah ko ek panaah-gah banaaya tha. Aye Allah! Unhein (Madina waalon ko) unke Mudd aur Sa (naapne ki ikaaiyon) mein barkat de.'

e: Narrated Um Khalid bint Khalid:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) seeking refuge with Allah from the punishment of the grave
hi: Umm Khalid bint Khalid bataati hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko qabar ke azaab se Allah ki panaah maangte suna.

e: Narrated Mus`ab:Sa`d used to recommend five (statements) and mentioned that the Prophet (ﷺ) I used to recommend it. (It was) "O Allah! I seek refuge with You from miserliness; and seek refuge with You from cowardice; and seek refuge with You from being sent back to geriatric old age; and I seek refuge with You from the affliction of this world (i.e., the affliction of Ad-Dajjal etc.); and seek refuge with You from the punishment of the grave
hi: Mus'ab bataate hain: Sa'd paanch (baaton) ki sifaarish kiya karte the aur zikr karte the ke Nabi (SAW) inki sifaarish kiya karte the: '(Aye Allah!) Main tujhse kanjoosi se panaah maangta hoon; aur main tujhse buzdili se panaah maangta hoon; aur main tujhse buddhape ki nikammi umar mein wapas bheje jaane se panaah maangta hoon; aur main tujhse is duniya ki azmaaish (yaani Dajjal waghera ki azmaaish) se panaah maangta hoon; aur main tujhse qabar ke azaab se panaah maangta hoon.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:Two old ladies from among the Jewish ladies entered upon me and said' "The dead are punished in their graves," but I thought they were telling a lie and did not believe them in the beginning. When they went away and the Prophet (ﷺ) entered upon me, I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Two old ladies.." and told him the whole story. He said, "They told the truth; the dead are really punished, to the extent that all the animals hear (the sound resulting from) their punishment." Since then I always saw him seeking refuge with Allah from the punishment of the grave in his prayers
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Do budhi Yahudi khawaateen mere paas aayi aur kaha, 'Murda logon ko unki qabron mein azaab diya jaata hai,' magar maine socha ke wo jhoot bol rahi hain aur shuru mein unpar yaqeen nahi kiya. Jab wo chali gayi aur Nabi (SAW) mere paas aaye, maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Do budhi khawaateen ne...' aur unhein poori baat bataayi. Unhone kaha, 'Unhone sach kaha; murda log waaqai azaab diye jaate hain, itna ke sab jaanwar unke azaab ki (aawaaz) sunte hain.' Us waqt se maine unhein hamesha apni namazon mein qabar ke azaab se Allah ki panaah maangte dekha.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Prophet used to say, "O Allah! I seek refuge with You from incapacity and laziness, from cowardice and geriatric old age, and seek refuge with You from the punishment of the grave, and I seek refuge with You from the afflictions of life and death
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Nabi (SAW) kaha karte the, 'Aye Allah! Main tujhse kamzori aur susti se panaah maangta hoon, buzdili aur buddhape ki nikammi umar se, aur main tujhse qabar ke azaab se panaah maangta hoon, aur main tujhse zindagi aur maut ki azmaaishon se panaah maangta hoon.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to say, "O Allah! I seek refuge with You from laziness and geriatric old age, from all kinds of sins and from being in debt; from the trial and affliction of the grave and from the punishment in the grave; from the affliction of the Fire and from the punishment of the Fire; and from the evil of the affliction of wealth; and I seek refuge with You from the affliction of poverty, and I seek refuge with You from the affliction of Al-Mesiah Ad-Dajjal. O Allah! Wash away my sins with the water of snow and hail, and cleanse my heart from all the sins as a white garment is cleansed from the filth, and let there be a long distance between me and my sins, as You made East and West far from each other
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) kaha karte the, 'Aye Allah! Main tujhse susti aur buddhape ki nikammi umar se panaah maangta hoon, har qism ke gunaahon se aur qarzdaar hone se; qabar ki azmaaish aur qabar ke azaab se; Aag ki azmaaish aur Aag ke azaab se; aur daulat ki azmaaish ki buraai se; aur main tujhse gareebi ki azmaaish se panaah maangta hoon, aur main tujhse Maseeh Ad-Dajjal ki azmaaish se panaah maangta hoon. Aye Allah! Mere gunaahon ko barf aur olon ke paani se dho de, aur mere dil ko sab gunaahon se aise saaf kar jaise ek safed kapda gandagi se saaf kiya jaata hai, aur mere aur mere gunaahon ke beech itni door karde jitni tune Poorab aur Paschim ko ek doosre se door kiya hai.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to say, "O Allah! I seek refuge with You from worry and grief, from incapacity and laziness, from cowardice and miserliness, from being heavily in debt and from being overpowered by (other) men." (See Hadith No)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) kaha karte the, 'Aye Allah! Main tujhse fikr aur gam se panaah maangta hoon, kamzori aur susti se, buzdili aur kanjoosi se, bhaari qarz se aur (doosre) aadmiyon ke hukmraan hone se.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees dekhein.)

e: Narrated Mus`ab bin Sa`d:Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas used to recommend these five (statements) and say that the Prophet (ﷺ) said so (and they are): "O Allah! I seek refuge with You from miserliness, and seek refuge with You from cowardice, and seek refuge with You from being brought back to geriatric old age, and seek refuge with You from the afflictions of the world, and seek refuge with You from the punishment of the grave
hi: Mus'ab bin Sa'd bataate hain: Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ye paanch (baaton) ki sifaarish kiya karte the aur kehte ke Nabi (SAW) ne aisa kaha: '(Aye Allah!) Main tujhse kanjoosi se panaah maangta hoon, aur main tujhse buzdili se panaah maangta hoon, aur main tujhse buddhape ki nikammi umar mein wapas bheje jaane se panaah maangta hoon, aur main tujhse duniya ki azmaaishon se panaah maangta hoon, aur main tujhse qabar ke azaab se panaah maangta hoon.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to seek refuge with Allah saying, "O Allah! I seek refuge with You from laziness, and seek refuge with You from cowardice, and seek refuge with You from geriatric old age, and seek refuge with You from miserliness
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Allah ki panaah maangte hue kehte, 'Aye Allah! Main tujhse susti se panaah maangta hoon, aur main tujhse buzdili se panaah maangta hoon, aur main tujhse buddhape ki nikammi umar se panaah maangta hoon, aur main tujhse kanjoosi se panaah maangta hoon.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! Make us love Medina as You made us love Mecca, or more, and transfer the fever that is in it, to Al-Juhfa. O Allah! Bless our Mudd and our Sam' (kinds of measures)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Aye Allah! Humein Madina se utni ya usse zyaada mohabbat karwaa jitni humein Makkah se hai, aur iske bukhaar ko Al-Juhfa bhej de. Aye Allah! Hamare Mudd aur Sa (naapne ki ikaaiyon) ko barkat de.'

e: Narrated 'Amir bin Sa`d:that his father said, "In the year of Hajjatal-Wada`, the Prophet (ﷺ) paid me a visit while I was suffering from an ailment that had brought me to the verge of death. I said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! My sickness has reduced me to the (bad) state as you see, and I am a rich man, but have no heirs except one daughter. Shall I give 2/3 of my property in charity?' He said, 'No.' I said, 'Then 1/2 of it?' He said, 'Even 1/3 is too much, for, to leave your inheritors wealthy is better than to leave them in poverty, begging from people. And (know that) whatever you spend in Allah's Cause, you will get reward for it, even for the morsel of food which you put in your wife's mouth.' I said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Will I be left behind my companions (in Mecca)?' He said, 'If you remain behind, whatever good deed you will do for Allah's Sake, will raise and upgrade you to a higher position (in Allah's Sight). May be you will live longer so that some people may benefit by you, and some e others (pagans) may get harmed by you. O Allah! Complete the migration of my companions and do not turn them on their heels; But (we pity) the poor Sa`d bin Khaula (not the above mentioned Sa`d) (died in Mecca)" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) lamented (or pitied) for him as he died in Mecca. (See Hadith No. 693, Vol)
hi: Amir bin Sa'd bataate hain ke unke waalid ne kaha, 'Hajjat-ul-Wada ke saal, Nabi (SAW) mujhse milne aaye jabke main ek bimaari se maut ke kagaar par tha. Maine kaha, "Aye Allah ke Rasool! Meri bimaari ne mujhe aisi (buri) haalat mein pahuncha diya jaisa aap dekh rahe hain, aur main ameer aadmi hoon, magar mera koi waaris nahi siwaaye meri ek beti ke. Kya main apni do-tihaai jaayadaad sadqe mein doon?" Unhone kaha, "Nahi." Maine kaha, "Phir aadhi?" Unhone kaha, "Ek-tihaai bhi bahut zyaada hai, kyunke apne waarison ko ameer chhodna behtar hai unhein gareebi mein chhodne se, jo logon se bheekh maangte phirein. Aur (jaan lo ke) tum jo bhi Allah ki raah mein kharch karoge, uska ajr tumhein milega, chaahe wo ek nawaala hi kyun na ho jo tum apni biwi ke munh mein daalo." Maine kaha, "Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya main apne saathiyon (Makkah mein) se peechhe reh jaunga?" Unhone kaha, "Agar tum peechhe reh jao, to jo bhi nek amal tum Allah ki khaatir karoge, wo tumhein oonchaai aur behtar darja dega (Allah ki nazar mein). Shaayad tum lambi umar jio taake kuch log tumse faayda uthaayein, aur kuch doosre (mushrik) tumhaari wajah se nuqsaan uthaayein. Aye Allah! Mere saathiyon ki hijrat poori kar aur unhein unke qadmon par wapas mat modiye; magar (hum afsos karte hain) gareeb Sa'd bin Khaula (par)" (na ke upar zikr kiye Sa'd), (jinka Makkah mein intekaal ho gaya).' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unke liye afsos zaahir kiya kyunke unka intekaal Makkah mein hua. (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 693, Jild 3 dekhein.)

e: Narrated Sa`d:Seek refuge with Allah by saying the words which the Prophet (ﷺ) used to say while seeking refuge with Allah, "0 Allah! I seek refuge with You from cowardice, and seek refuge with You from miserliness, and seek refuge with You from reaching a degraded geriatric old age, and seek refuge with You from the afflictions of the world and from the punishment in the grave
hi: Sa'd bataate hain: Allah se panaah maango un alfaazon ke saath jo Nabi (SAW) Allah ki panaah maangte waqt kaha karte the, 'Aye Allah! Main tujhse buzdili se panaah maangta hoon, aur main tujhse kanjoosi se panaah maangta hoon, aur main tujhse zaleel buddhape tak pahunchne se panaah maangta hoon, aur main tujhse duniya ki azmaaishon se aur qabar ke azaab se panaah maangta hoon.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to say, "O Allah! I seek refuge with You from laziness from geriatric old age, from being in debt, and from committing sins. O Allah! I seek refuge with You from the punishment of the Fire, the afflictions of the grave, the punishment in the grave, and the evil of the affliction of poverty and from the evil of the affliction caused by Al-Masih Ad-Dajjal. O Allah! Wash away my sins with the water of snow and hail, and cleanse my heart from the sins as a white garment is cleansed of filth, and let there be a far away distance between me and my sins as You have set far away the East and the West from each other
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) kaha karte the, 'Aye Allah! Main tujhse susti se, buddhape ki nikammi umar se, qarzdaar hone se, aur gunaah karne se panaah maangta hoon. Aye Allah! Main tujhse Aag ke azaab se, qabar ki azmaaish se, qabar ke azaab se, aur gareebi ki azmaaish ki buraai se, aur Maseeh Ad-Dajjal ki azmaaish ki buraai se panaah maangta hoon. Aye Allah! Mere gunaahon ko barf aur olon ke paani se dho de, aur mere dil ko gunaahon se aise saaf kar jaise ek safed kapda gandagi se saaf kiya jaata hai, aur mere aur mere gunaahon ke beech itni door karde jitni tune Poorab aur Paschim ko ek doosre se door kiya hai.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to seek refuge with Allah (by saying), "O Allah! I seek refuge with You from the affliction of the Fire and from the punishment in the Fire, and seek refuge with You from the affliction of the grave, and I seek refuge with You from the affliction of wealth, and I seek refuge with You from the affliction of poverty, and seek refuge with You from the affliction of Al-Masih Ad-Dajjal
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) Allah ki panaah maangte hue kehte, 'Aye Allah! Main tujhse Aag ki azmaaish aur Aag ke azaab se panaah maangta hoon, aur main tujhse qabar ki azmaaish se panaah maangta hoon, aur main tujhse daulat ki azmaaish se panaah maangta hoon, aur main tujhse gareebi ki azmaaish se panaah maangta hoon, aur main tujhse Maseeh Ad-Dajjal ki azmaaish se panaah maangta hoon.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to say, 'O Allah! I seek refuge with You from the affliction of the Fire, the punishment of the Fire, the affliction of the grave, the punishment of the grave, and the evil of the affliction of poverty. O Allah! I seek refuge with You from the evil of the affliction of Al-Masih Ad- Dajjal, O Allah! Cleanse my heart with the water of snow and hail, and cleanse my heart from all sins as a white garment is cleansed from filth, and let there be a far away distance between me and my sins as You made the East and West far away from each other. O Allah! I seek refuge with You from laziness, sins, and from being in debt
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) kaha karte the, 'Aye Allah! Main tujhse Aag ki azmaaish, Aag ke azaab, qabar ki azmaaish, qabar ke azaab, aur gareebi ki azmaaish ki buraai se panaah maangta hoon. Aye Allah! Main tujhse Maseeh Ad-Dajjal ki azmaaish ki buraai se panaah maangta hoon. Aye Allah! Mera dil barf aur olon ke paani se saaf kar, aur mere dil ko sab gunaahon se aise saaf kar jaise ek safed kapda gandagi se saaf kiya jaata hai, aur mere aur mere gunaahon ke beech itni door karde jitni tune Poorab aur Paschim ko ek doosre se door kiya hai. Aye Allah! Main tujhse susti, gunaahon, aur qarzdaar hone se panaah maangta hoon.'

e: Narrated Um Sulaim:that she said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Anas is your servant, so please invoke for Allah's blessing for him." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! Increase his wealth and offspring and bless (for him) whatever You give him
hi: Umm Sulaim (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Unhone kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) aapka khaadim hai, isliye barah-e-meharbaani uske liye Allah se barkat ki dua kijiye.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Aye Allah! Iski daulat aur aulaad badha, aur jo bhi tu use de use barkat de.'

e: Narrated Anas:Um Sulaim said (to the Prophet), "Anas is your servant; so please invoke for Allah's blessings for him." He said "O Allah! Increase his wealth and offspring, and Bless (for him) whatever You give him
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Umm Sulaim (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne (Nabi se) kaha, 'Anas aapka khaadim hai; isliye barah-e-meharbaani uske liye Allah se barkat ki dua kijiye.' Unhone kaha, 'Aye Allah! Iski daulat aur aulaad badha, aur jo bhi tu use de use barkat de.'

e: Narrated Jabir:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to teach us the Istikhara for each and every matter as he used to teach us the Suras from the Holy Qur'an. (He used to say), "If anyone of you intends to do something, he should offer a two-rak`at prayer other than the obligatory prayer, and then say: 'Allahumma inni astakhiruka bi'ilmika, wa astaqdiruka biqudratika, wa as'aluka min fadlika-l-'azim, fa innaka taqdiru wala aqdiru, wa ta'lamu wala a'lamu, wa anta'allamu-l-ghuyub. Allahumma in kunta ta'lamu anna hadha-lamra khairun li fi dini wa ma'ashi wa 'aqibati `Amri (or said, fi 'ajili `Amri wa ajilihi) fa-qdurhu li, Wa in kunta ta'lamu anna ha-dha-l-amra sharrun li fi dini wa ma'ashi wa 'aqibati `Amri (or said, fi ajili `Amri wa ajilihi) fasrifhu 'anni was-rifni 'anhu wa aqdur li alkhaira haithu kana, thumma Raddani bihi," Then he should mention his matter (need)
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) humein har maamle ke liye Istikhara sikhaate the jaise wo humein Quran ki Surate sikhaate the. (Wo kehte,) 'Agar tum mein se koi kuch karne ka iraada kare, to use farz namaz ke ilaawa do rakat namaz padhni chaahiye, aur phir kehna chaahiye: "Allahumma Inni Astakhiruka Bi'ilmika, Wa Astaqdiruka Biqudratika, Wa As'aluka Min Fadlika-l-Azim, Fa Innaka Taqdiru Wala Aqdiru, Wa Ta'lamu Wala A'lamu, Wa Anta Allamul-Ghuyub. Allahumma In Kunta Ta'lamu Anna Hadhal-Amra Khairun Li Fi Deeni Wa Ma'aashi Wa Aaqibati Amri (ya kaha, Fi Aajili Amri Wa Aajilihi) Faqdurhu Li, Wa In Kunta Ta'lamu Anna Hadhal-Amra Sharrun Li Fi Deeni Wa Ma'aashi Wa Aaqibati Amri (ya kaha, Fi Aajili Amri Wa Aajilihi) Fasrifhu Anni Wasrifni Anhu Wa Aqdur Li Al-Khaira Haithu Kaana, Thumma Raddani Bihi." Phir use apna maamla (zaroorat) zikr karni chaahiye.' (Aye Allah! Main tere ilm se teri bhalaai maangta hoon, aur teri qudrat se tujhse taaqat maangta hoon, aur tujhse tera azeem fazl maangta hoon, kyunke tu qudrat rakhta hai aur main nahi rakhta, aur tu jaanta hai aur main nahi jaanta, aur tu ghaib ki baaton ka jaanne wala hai. Aye Allah! Agar tu jaanta hai ke ye maamla mere deen, meri zindagi aur mere anjaam ke liye behtar hai, to ise mere liye muqaddar kar de, aur agar tu jaanta hai ke ye maamla mere deen, meri zindagi aur mere anjaam ke liye bura hai, to ise mujhse door kar de aur mujhe usse door kar de, aur jahaan bhi bhalaai ho, use mere liye muqaddar kar, phir mujhe usse raazi kar.)

e: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) asked for some water and performed the ablution, and then raised his hands (towards the sky) and said, "O Allah! Forgive `Ubaid Abi 'Amir." I saw the whiteness of his armpits (while he was raising his hands) and he added, "O Allah! Upgrade him over many of Your human creatures on the Day of Resurrection
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne paani maangaya aur wuzu kiya, phir apne haath (aasman ki taraf) uthaaye aur kaha, 'Aye Allah! Ubaid Abi Aamir ko maaf kar de.' Maine unki baaghal ki safedi dekhi (jab wo apne haath uthaa rahe the) aur unhone izaafa kiya, 'Aye Allah! Qayamat ke din unhein apni bahut si insaani makhlooq se oonchaai de.'

e: Narrated Abu Musa:We were in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) on a journey, and whenever we ascended a high place, we used to say Takbir (in a loud voice). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O people! Be kind to yourselves, for you are not calling upon a deaf or an absent one, but You are calling an All-Hearer, and an All-Seer." Then he came to me as I was reciting silently, "La haul a wala quwwata illa bil-lah." He said, "O `Abdullah bin Qais! Say: La haul a walaquwata illa bil-lah, for it is one of the treasures of Paradise." Or he said, "Shall I tell you a word which is one of the treasures of Paradise? It is: La haul a wala quwwata illa bil-lah
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum ek safar mein Nabi (SAW) ki sohbat mein the, aur jab bhi hum kisi oonchi jagah chadhte, hum oonchi aawaaz mein Takbeer kehte. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Aye logo! Apne aap par meherbaan raho, kyunke tum kisi bahre ya gair-haazir ko nahi bula rahe, balke tum ek sunne wale, dekhne wale ko bula rahe ho.' Phir wo mere paas aaye jabke main chupke se padh raha tha, 'La Haula Wala Quwwata Illa Billah.' Unhone kaha, 'Aye Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Qais! Kaho: La Haula Wala Quwwata Illa Billah, kyunke ye Jannat ke khazaanon mein se ek hai.' Ya unhone kaha, 'Kya main tumhein ek aisi baat na bataun jo Jannat ke khazaanon mein se hai? Wo hai: La Haula Wala Quwwata Illa Billah.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) returned from a Ghazwa or Hajj or `Umra, he used to say, "Allahu Akbar," three times; whenever he went up a high place, he used to say, "La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la sharika lahu, lahu-l-mulk wa lahu-l-hamd, wa huwa'ala kulli Shai 'in qadir. Ayibuna ta'ibuna 'abiduna lirabbina hamidun. Sadaqa-l-lahu wa'dahu, wa nasara`Abdahu wa hazama-l-ahzaba wahdahu
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab bhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) kisi jang, Hajj ya Umra se wapas aate, wo teen baar 'Allahu Akbar' kehte; aur jab bhi wo kisi oonchi jagah chadhte, wo kehte, 'La Ilaha Illal-lahu Wahdahu La Sharika Lahu, Lahul-Mulku Wa Lahul-Hamdu, Wa Huwa Ala Kulli Shai'in Qadir. Aayibuna, Taaibuna, Aabiduna, Li-Rabbina Haamidun. Sadaqal-lahu Wa'dahu, Wa Nasara Abdahu Wa Hazamal-Ahzaba Wahdah.' (Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi, akela, uska koi shareek nahi; uske liye baadshahat hai, aur uske liye tareef hai, aur wo har cheez par qaadir hai. Hum laut rahe hain, tauba karte hue, ibaadat karte hue, apne Rab ki hamd karte hue. Allah ne apna waada sacha kiya, aur usne apne bande ki madad ki, aur akele hi giroh (dushmanon) ko haraaya.)

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) seeing a yellow mark (of perfume) on the clothes of `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf, said, "What about you?" `Abdur-Rahman replied, "I have married a woman with a Mahr of gold equal to a date-stone." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "May Allah bestow His Blessing on you (in your marriage). Give a wedding banquet, (Walima) even with one sheep
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne Abdur Rahman bin Auf (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke kapdon par khushbu ka ek peela nishaan dekha aur kaha, 'Ye kya hai?' Abdur Rahman ne jawab diya, 'Maine ek khaatoon se, khajoor ki gutli ke barabar sone ke Mahr par, nikaah kiya hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Allah tumhein barkat de (tumhaari shaadi mein). Walima do, chaahe ek bakri ke saath hi kyun na ho.'

e: Narrated Jabir:My father died and left behind seven or nine daughters, and I married a woman. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Did you get married, O Jabir?" I replied, "Yes." He asked, "Is she a virgin or a matron?" I replied, "She is a matron." He said, "Why didn't you marry a virgin girl so that you might play with her and she with you (or, you might make her laugh and she make you laugh)?" I said, "My father died, leaving seven or nine girls (orphans) and I did not like to bring a young girl like them, so I married a woman who can look after them." He said, "May Allah bestow His Blessing on you
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Mere waalid ka intekaal ho gaya aur saat ya nau betiyaan chhod gaye, aur maine ek (biwaa) khaatoon se nikaah kiya. Nabi (SAW) ne pucha, 'Kya tumne nikaah kiya, Aye Jabir?' Maine jawab diya, 'Haan.' Unhone pucha, 'Kya wo kunwaari hai ya biwaa?' Maine jawab diya, 'Wo biwaa hai.' Unhone kaha, 'Tumne kisi kunwaari ladki se nikaah kyun nahi kiya taake tum uske saath khelte aur wo tumhaare saath (ya, tum use hasaate aur wo tumhein hasaati)?' Maine kaha, 'Mere waalid ka intekaal ho gaya, saat ya nau ladkiyaan (yateem) chhod kar, aur mujhe unke jaisi jawaan ladki laana pasand nahi hua, isliye maine ek aisi khaatoon se nikaah kiya jo unki dekhbhaal kar sake.' Unhone kaha, 'Allah tumhein barkat de.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If anyone of you, when intending to have a sexual intercourse with his wife, says: 'Bismillah, Allahumma jannibna-sh-shaitan, wa jannibi-sh-shaitan ma razaqtana,' and if the couple are destined to have a child (out of that very sexual relation), then Satan will never be able to harm that child
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar tum mein se koi apni biwi ke saath humbistari ka iraada karte waqt kahe, "Bismillah, Allahumma Jannibnash-Shaitan, Wa Jannibish-Shaitan Ma Razaqtana," (Allah ke naam se; Aye Allah! Humein Shaitaan se door rakh, aur jo tu humein de use Shaitaan se door rakh) aur agar unke naseeb mein us mulaaqaat se bacha hona muqaddar ho, to Shaitaan us bacche ko kabhi nuqsaan nahi pahunchaa payega.'

e: Narrated Anas:The most frequent invocation of The Prophet (ﷺ) was: "O Allah! Give to us in the world that which is good and in the Hereafter that which is good, and save us from the torment of the Fire
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ki sabse zyaada padhi jaane wali dua thi: 'Aye Allah! Humein duniya mein achhaai de, aur Aakhirat mein achhaai de, aur humein Aag ke azaab se bacha.'
