e: Narrated Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to teach us these words as he used to teach us the Book (Qur'an): "O Allah! seek refuge with You from miserliness, and seek refuge with You from cowardice, and seek refuge with You from being brought back to (senile) geriatric old age, and seek refuge with You from the affliction of the world and from the punishment in the Hereafter
hi: Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) humein ye alfaaz sikhaate the jaise wo humein Kitaab (Quran) sikhaate the: 'Aye Allah! Main tujhse kanjoosi se panaah maangta hoon, aur main tujhse buzdili se panaah maangta hoon, aur main tujhse buddhape ki nikammi umar mein wapas bheje jaane se panaah maangta hoon, aur main tujhse duniya ki azmaaish aur Aakhirat ke azaab se panaah maangta hoon.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was affected by magic, so much that he used to think that he had done something which in fact, he did not do, and he invoked his Lord (for a remedy). Then (one day) he said, "O `Aisha!) Do you know that Allah has advised me as to the problem I consulted Him about?" `Aisha said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What's that?" He said, "Two men came to me and one of them sat at my head and the other at my feet, and one of them asked his companion, 'What is wrong with this man?' The latter replied, 'He is under the effect of magic.' The former asked, 'Who has worked magic on him?' The latter replied, 'Labid bin Al-A'sam.' The former asked, 'With what did he work the magic?' The latter replied, 'With a comb and the hair, which are stuck to the comb, and the skin of pollen of a date-palm tree.' The former asked, 'Where is that?' The latter replied, 'It is in Dharwan.' Dharwan was a well in the dwelling place of the (tribe of) Bani Zuraiq. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went to that well and returned to `Aisha, saying, 'By Allah, the water (of the well) was as red as the infusion of Hinna, (1) and the date-palm trees look like the heads of devils.' `Aisha added, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to me and informed me about the well. I asked the Prophet, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), why didn't you take out the skin of pollen?' He said, 'As for me, Allah has cured me and I hated to draw the attention of the people to such evil (which they might learn and harm others with).' " Narrated Hisham's father: `Aisha said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was bewitched, so he invoked Allah repeatedly requesting Him to cure him from that magic)." Hisham then narrated the above narration. (See Hadith No. 658, Vol)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) par jaadu ka asar hua, itna ke unhein lagta ke unhone kuch kiya hai jabke unhone waaqai nahi kiya, aur unhone apne Rab se (iske ilaaj ke liye) dua ki. Phir (ek din) unhone kaha, 'Aye Aisha! Kya tumhein pata hai Allah ne mujhe us maamle ke baare mein raay di jo maine unse pucha tha?' Aisha ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Wo kya hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Do aadmi mere paas aaye aur unmein se ek mere sar ke paas baitha aur doosra mere pairon ke paas, aur unmein se ek ne apne saathi se pucha, "Is aadmi ko kya hua hai?" Doosre ne jawab diya, "Ye jaadu ke asar mein hai." Pehle ne pucha, "Isper jaadu kisne kiya?" Doosre ne jawab diya, "Labid bin Al-A'sam ne." Pehle ne pucha, "Kis cheez se usne jaadu kiya?" Doosre ne jawab diya, "Ek kangha aur usmein phanse baal se, aur khajoor ke phool ki chhaal se." Pehle ne pucha, "Wo kahaan hai?" Doosre ne jawab diya, "Dharwan mein hai."' Dharwan Banu Zuraiq ke ilaake ka ek kuan tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) us kuen par gaye aur Aisha ke paas wapas aakar kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, (us kuen ka) paani Heena ke ghol jaisa laal tha, aur khajoor ke darakht Shaitaanon ke saron jaise dikh rahe the.' Aisha ne aage kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mere paas aaye aur mujhe kuen ke baare mein bataaya. Maine Nabi se pucha, "Aye Allah ke Rasool, aapne chhaal kyun nahi nikaali?" Unhone kaha, "Jahaan tak meri baat hai, Allah ne mujhe shifa di hai, aur mujhe dar tha ke main logon ka dhyaan aisi buraai ki taraf na kheenchun (jise wo seekh kar doosron ko nuqsaan pahunchaa sakein)."' Ravi Hisham ke waalid bataate hain: Aisha ne kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) par jaadu kiya gaya tha, isliye unhone Allah se baar-baar dua ki ke wo unhein us jaadu se shifa de.' Phir Hisham ne upar wali riwayat sunaayi. (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 658, Jild 4 dekhein.)

e: Narrated Ibn Abi `Aufa:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked for Allah's wrath upon the Ahzab (confederates), saying, "O Allah, the Revealer of the Holy Book, and the One swift at reckoning! Defeat the confederates; Defeat them and shake them
hi: Ibn Abi Aufa bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ahzab (dushman ke giroh) par Allah ka gazab maanga, kehte hue, 'Aye Allah, Kitaab utaarne wale, aur hisaab lene mein tez! Ahzab ko haraa; unhein haraa aur unhein hilaa de.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:When the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Sami' al-lahu liman hamidah (Allah heard him who sent his praises to Him)" in the last rak`a of the `Isha' prayer, he used to invoke Allah, saying, "O Allah! Save `Aiyash bin Abi Rabi`a; O Allah! Save Al-Walid bin Al-Walid; O Allah! Save the weak people among the believers; O Allah! Be hard on the Tribe of Mudar; O Allah! Inflict years of drought upon them like the years (of drought) of the Prophet (ﷺ) Joseph
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Nabi (SAW) Isha ki namaz ki aakhri rakat mein 'Sami Allahu Liman Hamidah' kehte, wo Allah se dua karte hue kehte, 'Aye Allah! Aiyash bin Abi Rabi'a ko bacha; Aye Allah! Al-Walid bin Al-Walid ko bacha; Aye Allah! Momineen mein se kamzor logon ko bacha; Aye Allah! Mudar qabeele par sakhti kar; Aye Allah! Unpar Nabi Yusuf ke saalon jaise (qehat ke) saal bhej.'

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) sent a Sariya (an army detachment) consisting of men called Al-Qurra', and all of them were martyred. I had never seen the Prophet (ﷺ) so sad over anything as he was over them. So he said Qunut (invocation in the prayer) for one month in the Fajr prayer, invoking for Allah's wrath upon the tribe of 'Usaiya, and he used to say, "The people of 'Usaiya have disobeyed Allah and His Apostle
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne ek Sariya (fauji dasta) bheja jismein Al-Qurra naami log the, aur unmein se sab shaheed ho gaye. Maine Nabi (SAW) ko kisi cheez par itna gamgeen kabhi nahi dekha jitna unke liye the. To unhone ek mahine tak Fajr ki namaz mein Qunut padhi, Usaiya qabeele par Allah ka gazab maangte hue, aur wo kehte, 'Usaiya qabeele ne Allah aur uske Rasool ki nafarmaani ki.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Jews used to greet the Prophet (ﷺ) by saying, "As-Samu 'Alaika (i.e., death be upon you), so I understood what they said, and I said to them, "As-Samu 'alaikum wal-la'na (i.e. Death and Allah's Curse be upon you)." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Be gentle and calm, O `Aisha, as Allah likes gentleness in all affairs." I said, "O Allah's Prophet! Didn't you hear what they said?" He said, "Didn't you hear me answering them back by saying, 'Alaikum (i.e., the same be upon you)?
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Yahudi Nabi (SAW) ko salaam karte hue kehte, 'As-Samu Alaika' (yaani tumpar maut ho), isliye main samajh gayi ke unhone kya kaha, aur maine unse kaha, 'As-Samu Alaikum Wal-La'na' (yaani tumpar maut aur Allah ki laanat ho). Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Naram aur shaant raho, Aye Aisha, kyunke Allah har maamle mein narmi pasand karta hai.' Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Nabi! Kya aapne nahi suna unhone kya kaha?' Unhone kaha, 'Kya tumne nahi suna maine unhein jawab mein kya kaha, "Alaikum" (tumpar bhi)?'

e: Narrated `Ali bin Abi Talib:We were in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) on the day (of the battle) of Al-Khandaq (the Trench). The Prophet said, "May Allah fill their (the infidels') graves and houses with fire, as they have kept us so busy that we could not offer the middle prayer till the sun had set; and that prayer was the `Asr prayer
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bin Abi Talib bataate hain: Hum jang-e-Khandaq (khaai) ke din Nabi (SAW) ke saath the. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah unki (kaafiron ki) qabron aur gharon ko aag se bhar de, jaisa unhone humein itna masroof rakha ke hum darmiyaani namaz suraj doobne tak nahi padh sake; aur wo namaz Asr thi.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:at-Tufail bin `Amr came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! The tribe of Daus has disobeyed (Allah and His Apostle) and refused (to embrace Islam), therefore, invoke Allah's wrath for them." The people thought that the Prophet (ﷺ) would invoke Allah's wrath for them, but he said, "O Allah! Guide the tribe Of Daus and let them come to us
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: At-Tufail bin Amr Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Daus qabeele ne (Allah aur uske Rasool ki) nafarmaani ki hai aur (Islam qubool karne se) inkaar kiya hai, isliye unke khilaaf Allah ka gazab maangiye.' Logon ne socha ke Nabi (SAW) unke khilaaf Allah ka gazab maangenge, magar unhone kaha, 'Aye Allah! Daus qabeele ko hidaayat de aur unhein hamare paas le aa.'

e: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to invoke Allah with the following invocation: 'Rabbi-ghfir-li Khati 'ati wa jahli wa israfi fi `Amri kullihi, wa ma anta a'lamu bihi minni. Allahumma ighfirli khatayaya wa 'amdi, wa jahli wa jiddi, wa kullu dhalika'indi. Allahumma ighrifli ma qaddamtu wa ma akhartu wa ma asrartu wa ma a'lantu. Anta-l-muqaddimu wa anta-l-mu'akh-khiru, wa anta 'ala kulli shai'in qadir
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) Allah se ye dua kiya karte the: 'Rabbi-ghfir-li Khati'ati Wa Jahli Wa Israfi Fi Amri Kullihi, Wa Ma Anta A'lamu Bihi Minni. Allahumma Ighfirli Khatayaya Wa Amdi, Wa Jahli Wa Jiddi, Wa Kullu Dhalika Indi. Allahumma Ighfirli Ma Qaddamtu Wa Ma Akhkhartu Wa Ma Asrartu Wa Ma A'lantu. Antal-Muqaddimu Wa Antal-Mu'akhkhiru, Wa Anta Ala Kulli Shai'in Qadir.' (Aye mere Rab! Meri galtiyaan, meri nasamajhi, aur mere har maamle mein zyaadti maaf kar de, aur jo tu mujhse zyaada jaanta hai. Aye Allah! Mere jaan-boojh kar kiye aur be-samajh kiye gunaah maaf kar de, aur ye sab mujhme hai. Aye Allah! Mere aage-peeche ke, mere chhupe aur zaahir gunaah maaf kar de. Tu hi aage badhaane wala hai, aur Tu hi peeche karne wala hai, aur Tu har cheez par qaadir hai.)

e: Narrated Abu Musa Al-Ash`ari:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to invoke Allah, saying, "Allahumma ighfirli khati'ati wa jahli wa israfi fi `Amri, wa ma anta a-'lamu bihi minni. Allahumma ighfirli hazali wa jiddi wa khata'i wa amdi, wa kullu dhalika 'indi
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ashari bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) Allah se ye dua kiya karte the, 'Allahumma Ighfirli Khati'ati Wa Jahli Wa Israfi Fi Amri, Wa Ma Anta A'lamu Bihi Minni. Allahumma Ighfirli Hazali Wa Jiddi Wa Khata'i Wa Amdi, Wa Kullu Dhalika Indi.' (Aye Allah! Meri galtiyaan, meri nasamajhi, aur mere maamle mein zyaadti maaf kar de, aur jo tu mujhse zyaada jaanta hai. Aye Allah! Mere mazaak aur sanginta mein, mere galti aur jaan-boojh kar kiye gunaah maaf kar de, aur ye sab mujhme hai.)

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Abu-l-Qasim (the Prophet) said, "On Friday there is a particular time. If a Muslim happens to be praying and invoking Allah for something good during that time, Allah will surely fulfill his request." The Prophet (ﷺ) pointed out with his hand. We thought that he wanted to illustrate how short that time was
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu-l-Qasim (Nabi) ne kaha, 'Jumme ke din ek khaas waqt hota hai. Agar koi Musalmaan us waqt namaz mein ho aur Allah se kisi achhi cheez ki dua kare, to Allah zaroor uski darkhwaast poori karega.' Nabi (SAW) ne apne haath se ishara kiya. Hamne socha wo dikhaana chahte the ke wo waqt kitna chhota hai.

e: Narrated Ibn Abi Mulaika:`Aisha said, "The Jews came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said to him, "As-Samu 'Alaika (i.e., Death be upon you)." He replied, 'The same on you.' " `Aisha said to them, "Death be upon you, and may Allah curse you and shower His wrath upon you!" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Be gentle and calm, O `Aisha! Be gentle and beware of being harsh and of saying evil things." She said, "Didn't you hear what they said?" He said, "Didn't you hear what I replied (to them)? have returned their statement to them, and my invocation against them will be accepted but theirs against me will not be accepted
hi: Ibn Abi Mulaika bataate hain: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha, 'Yahudi Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unse kaha, "As-Samu Alaika" (yaani tumpar maut ho). Unhone jawab diya, "Tumpar bhi."' Aisha ne unse kaha, 'Tumpar maut ho, aur Allah tumpar laanat kare aur apna gazab naazil kare!' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Naram aur shaant raho, Aye Aisha! Naram raho aur sakhti karne aur buri baatein kehne se bacho.' Unhone kaha, 'Kya aapne nahi suna unhone kya kaha?' Unhone kaha, 'Kya tumne nahi suna maine kya jawab diya (unhein)? Maine unki baat unhein wapas laut aa di hai, aur unke khilaaf meri dua qubool hogi jabke mere khilaaf unki dua qubool nahi hogi.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When the Imam says 'Amin', then you should all say 'Amin', for the angels say 'Amin' at that time, and he whose 'Amin' coincides with the 'Amin' of the angels, all his past sins will be forgiven
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab Imam "Ameen" kahe, to tum sabko "Ameen" kehna chaahiye, kyunke us waqt farishte "Ameen" kehte hain, aur jiska "Ameen" farishton ke "Ameen" ke saath mel khaaye, uske sab pichhle gunaah maaf kar diye jaayenge.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said," Whoever says: "La ilaha illal-lah wahdahu la sharika lahu, lahu-l-mulk wa lahul- hamd wa huwa 'ala kulli shai'in qadir," one hundred times will get the same reward as given for manumitting ten slaves; and one hundred good deeds will be written in his accounts, and one hundred sins will be deducted from his accounts, and it (his saying) will be a shield for him from Satan on that day till night, and nobody will be able to do a better deed except the one who does more than he
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi "La Ilaha Illal-lahu Wahdahu La Sharika Lahu, Lahul-Mulku Wa Lahul-Hamdu Wa Huwa Ala Kulli Shai'in Qadir" sau baar kahe, use das ghulaam azaad karne jitna hi ajr milega; aur sau nek amaal uske hisaab mein likh diye jaayenge, aur sau gunaah uske hisaab se ghata diye jaayenge, aur ye (uska kehna) usi din raat tak Shaitaan se uske liye ek dhaal ban jaayega, aur koi bhi is se behtar amal nahi kar payega siwaaye us shaks ke jo isse zyaada kare.'

e: Narrated `Amr bin Maimun:Whoever recites it (i.e., the invocation in the above Hadith (412) ten times will be as if he manumitted one of Ishmael's descendants. Abu Aiyub narrated the same Hadith from the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "(Whoever recites it ten times) will be as if he had manumitted one of Ishmael's descendants
hi: Amr bin Maimun bataate hain: Jo koi ise (upar wali hadees mein di gayi dua) das baar padhe, ye aisa hoga jaise usne Ismail ki aulaad mein se ek ghulaam azaad kiya ho. Abu Aiyub ne bhi Nabi (SAW) se isi hadees ki riwaayat ki, kehte hue, 'Jo (ise das baar padhe), aisa hoga jaise usne Ismail ki aulaad mein se ek ghulaam azaad kiya ho.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever says, 'Subhan Allah wa bihamdihi,' one hundred times a day, will be forgiven all his sins even if they were as much as the foam of the sea
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi "Subhan Allah Wa Bihamdihi" din mein sau baar kahe, uske sab gunaah maaf kar diye jaayenge, chaahe wo samundar ke jhaag jitne kyun na hon.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There are two expressions which are very easy for the tongue to say, but they are very heavy in the balance and are very dear to The Beneficent (Allah), and they are, 'Subhan Allah Al- `Azim and 'Subhan Allah wa bihamdihi
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Do aise jumle hain jo zubaan ke liye bahut aasaan hain, magar tarazu mein bahut bhaari hain aur Rahman (Allah) ko bahut aziz hain, aur wo hain, "Subhan Allahil-Azim" aur "Subhan Allahi Wa Bihamdihi."'

e: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The example of the one who celebrates the Praises of his Lord (Allah) in comparison to the one who does not celebrate the Praises of his Lord, is that of a living creature compared to a dead one
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo apne Rab (Allah) ki Tasbeeh karta hai, uski misaal us shaks se, jo nahi karta, aisi hai jaise ek zinda jaanwar ki misaal ek murda jaanwar se.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Apostle said, "Allah has some angels who look for those who celebrate the Praises of Allah on the roads and paths. And when they find some people celebrating the Praises of Allah, they call each other, saying, "Come to the object of your pursuit.' " He added, "Then the angels encircle them with their wings up to the sky of the world." He added. "(after those people celebrated the Praises of Allah, and the angels go back), their Lord, asks them (those angels)----though He knows better than them----'What do My slaves say?' The angels reply, 'They say: Subhan Allah, Allahu Akbar, and Alham-du-li l-lah, Allah then says 'Did they see Me?' The angels reply, 'No! By Allah, they didn't see You.' Allah says, How it would have been if they saw Me?' The angels reply, 'If they saw You, they would worship You more devoutly and celebrate Your Glory more deeply, and declare Your freedom from any resemblance to anything more often.' Allah says (to the angels), 'What do they ask Me for?' The angels reply, 'They ask You for Paradise.' Allah says (to the angels), 'Did they see it?' The angels say, 'No! By Allah, O Lord! They did not see it.' Allah says, How it would have been if they saw it?' The angels say, 'If they saw it, they would have greater covetousness for it and would seek It with greater zeal and would have greater desire for it.' Allah says, 'From what do they seek refuge?' The angels reply, 'They seek refuge from the (Hell) Fire.' Allah says, 'Did they see it?' The angels say, 'No By Allah, O Lord! They did not see it.' Allah says, How it would have been if they saw it?' The angels say, 'If they saw it they would flee from it with the extreme fleeing and would have extreme fear from it.' Then Allah says, 'I make you witnesses that I have forgiven them."' Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) added, "One of the angels would say, 'There was so-and-so amongst them, and he was not one of them, but he had just come for some need.' Allah would say, 'These are those people whose companions will not be reduced to misery
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah ke kuch farishte hain jo raaston aur galiyon par un logon ko dhoondhte hain jo Allah ki tasbeeh karte hain. Aur jab wo kuch logon ko Allah ki tasbeeh karte paate hain, wo ek doosre ko pukaarte hain, "Apni khoj ki cheez ki taraf aao."' Unhone izaafa kiya, 'Phir farishte unhein apne paron se aasman-e-duniya tak ghera dete hain.' Unhone aage kaha, '(Un logon ke Allah ki tasbeeh karne ke baad, aur farishte wapas jaate hain,) unka Rab unse (in farishton se) poochta hai - halaanke wo unse behtar jaanta hai - "Mere bande kya kehte hain?" Farishte jawab dete hain, "Wo kehte hain: Subhan Allah, Allahu Akbar, aur Alhamdulillah." Allah phir kehta hai, "Kya unhone mujhe dekha hai?" Farishte jawab dete hain, "Nahi! Allah ki qasam, unhone tujhe nahi dekha." Allah kehta hai, "Agar wo mujhe dekhte to kaisa hota?" Farishte jawab dete hain, "Agar wo tujhe dekhte, to wo tujhe aur zyaada shiddat se parastish karte aur teri buzurgi ka aur zyaada gehra izhaar karte, aur teri paakeezgi ka aur zyaada elaan karte." Allah kehta hai, "Wo mujhse kya maangte hain?" Farishte jawab dete hain, "Wo tujhse Jannat maangte hain." Allah kehta hai, "Kya unhone use dekha hai?" Farishte kehte hain, "Nahi! Allah ki qasam, Aye Rab! Unhone use nahi dekha." Allah kehta hai, "Agar wo use dekhte to kaisa hota?" Farishte kehte hain, "Agar wo use dekhte, to unka ishtiyaaq aur zyaada hota aur wo aur zyaada koshish se use talaash karte aur unme uski aur zyaada khwaahish hoti." Allah kehta hai, "Wo kis cheez se panaah maangte hain?" Farishte jawab dete hain, "Wo (Jahannam ki) Aag se panaah maangte hain." Allah kehta hai, "Kya unhone use dekha hai?" Farishte kehte hain, "Nahi Allah ki qasam, Aye Rab! Unhone use nahi dekha." Allah kehta hai, "Agar wo use dekhte to kaisa hota?" Farishte kehte hain, "Agar wo use dekhte, to wo ussey shiddat se bhaagte aur ussey shiddat se darte." Phir Allah kehta hai, "Main tumhein gawaah banaata hoon ke maine unhein maaf kar diya."' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne izaafa kiya, 'Ek farishta kahega, "Unmein falaan shaks bhi tha, aur wo unmein se nahi tha, wo bas kisi zaroorat ke liye aaya tha." Allah kahega, "Ye wo log hain jinke saathi badnaseeb nahi honge."'

e: Narrated Abu Musa Al-Ash`ari:The Prophet (ﷺ) started ascending a high place or hill. A man (amongst his companions) ascended it and shouted in a loud voice, "La ilaha illal-lahu wallahu Akbar." (At that time) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was riding his mule. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "You are not calling upon a deaf or an absent one." and added, "O Abu Musa (or, O `Abdullah)! Shall I tell you a sentence from the treasure of Paradise?" I said, "Yes." He said, "La haul a wala quwwata illa billah
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ashari bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ek oonchi jagah ya pahaadi par chadhne lage. Ek aadmi (unke sahaaba mein se) uspar chadha aur oonchi aawaaz mein chillaaya, 'La Ilaha Illal-lahu Wallahu Akbar.' (Us waqt) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apni khachchar par sawaar the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Tum kisi bahre ya gair-haazir ko nahi bula rahe,' aur izaafa kiya, 'Aye Abu Musa (ya, Aye Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ))! Kya main tumhein Jannat ke khazaanon mein se ek baat na bataun?' Maine kaha, 'Haan.' Unhone kaha, 'La Haula Wala Quwwata Illa Billah.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah has ninety-nine Names, i.e., one hundred minus one, and whoever believes in their meanings and acts accordingly, will enter Paradise; and Allah is witr (one) and loves 'the witr' (i.e., odd numbers)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke ninety-nine (99) naam hain, yaani sau mein se ek kam, aur jo koi inke maanon par yaqeen rakhe aur unke mutaabik amal kare, Jannat mein daakhil hoga; aur Allah Witr (taak) hai aur Witr (taak) ko pasand karta hai.

e: Narrated Shaqiq:While we were waiting for `Abdullah (bin Mas`ud). Yazid bin Muawiya came. I said (to him), "Will you sit down?" He said, "No, but I will go into the house (of Ibn Mas`ud) and let your companion (Ibn Mas`ud) come out to you; and if he should not (come out), I will come out and sit (with you)." Then `Abdullah came out, holding the hand of Yazid, addressed us, saying, "I know that you are assembled here, but the reason that prevents me from coming out to you, is that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to preach to us at intervals during the days, lest we should become bored
hi: Shaqiq bataate hain: Jab hum Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) (bin Masud) ka intezaar kar rahe the, Yazid bin Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) aaye. Maine (unse) kaha, 'Kya aap baithenge?' Unhone kaha, 'Nahi, magar main (Ibn Masud ke) ghar jaunga aur aapke saathi (Ibn Masud) ko aapke paas baahar aane doonga; aur agar wo nahi aaye, to main baahar aakar (aapke saath) baithunga.' Phir Abdullah, Yazid ka haath pakde hue, baahar aaye aur humse khitaab karte hue kaha, 'Mujhe pata hai tum log yahaan jama ho, magar jo cheez mujhe tumhare paas baahar aane se rokti hai wo ye hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) humein alag-alag dinon mein waqfe se naseehat kiya karte the, taake hum ub na jaayein.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said: "There are two blessings that many people are deceived into losing: health and free time
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Do niyamaten hain jinme bahut se log dhoke mein padkar zaaya kar dete hain: sehat aur khaali waqt.'

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! There is no life worth living except the life of the Hereafter, so (please) make righteous the Ansar and the Emigrants
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Aye Allah! Aakhirat ki zindagi ke siwa koi zindagi jeene ke laayak nahi, isliye barah-e-meharbaani Ansaar aur Muhaajireen ko neik bana.'

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d As-Sa`idi:We were in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in (the battle of) Al-Khandaq, and he was digging the trench while we were carrying the earth away. He looked at us and said, "O Allah! There is no life worth living except the life of the Hereafter, so (please) forgive the Ansar and the Emigrants
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) As-Sa'idi bataate hain: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein Khandaq (khaai) khodne ke waqt the, aur wo khaai khod rahe the jabke hum mitti utha kar le ja rahe the. Unhone hamari taraf dekha aur kaha, 'Aye Allah! Aakhirat ki zindagi ke siwa koi zindagi jeene ke laayak nahi, isliye barah-e-meharbaani Ansaar aur Muhaajireen ko maaf kar.'

e: Narrated Sahl:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "A (small) place equal to an area occupied by a whip in Paradise is better than the (whole) world and whatever is in it; and an undertaking (journey) in the forenoon or in the afternoon for Allah's Cause, is better than the whole world and whatever is in it
hi: Sahl bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Jannat mein ek koda jitni jagah bhi (poori) duniya aur usmein jo kuch hai usse behtar hai; aur subah ya shaam Allah ki raah mein safar karna (poori) duniya aur usmein jo kuch hai usse behtar hai.'

e: Narrated Mujahid:`Abdullah bin `Umar said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took hold of my shoulder and said, 'Be in this world as if you were a stranger or a traveler." The sub-narrator added: Ibn `Umar used to say, "If you survive till the evening, do not expect to be alive in the morning, and if you survive till the morning, do not expect to be alive in the evening, and take from your health for your sickness, and (take) from your life for your death
hi: Mujahid bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mera kandha pakda aur kaha, "Is duniya mein aise raho jaise tum ek ajnabi ya musaafir ho."' (Ravi ne izaafa kiya: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) kaha karte the, 'Agar tum shaam tak zinda raho, to subah tak zinda rehne ki ummeed mat karo, aur agar tum subah tak zinda raho, to shaam tak zinda rehne ki ummeed mat karo, aur apni sehat se apni bimaari ke liye lo, aur apni zindagi se apni maut ke liye lo.')

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) drew a square and then drew a line in the middle of it and let it extend outside the square and then drew several small lines attached to that central line, and said, "This is the human being, and this, (the square) in his lease of life, encircles him from all sides (or has encircled him), and this (line), which is outside (the square), is his hope, and these small lines are the calamities and troubles (which may befall him), and if one misses him, an-other will snap (i.e. overtake) him, and if the other misses him, a third will snap (i.e. overtake) him
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne ek chaukor banaayi, phir uske beech mein ek lakeer khainchi jo chaukor se baahar tak nikal gayi, phir us beech waali lakeer se judi kayi chhoti lakeerein khainchi, aur kaha, 'Ye insaan hai, aur ye (chaukor) uski zindagi ki muddat hai jo use har taraf se ghere hue hai (ya ghere gi), aur ye (lakeer) jo baahar hai, uski ummeed hai, aur ye chhoti lakeerein museebaten aur mushkilein hain (jo usko pesh aa sakti hain), aur agar ek use chhod de, to doosri use pakad legi, aur agar wo use chhod de, to teesri use pakad legi.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) drew a few lines and said, "This is (man's) hope, and this is the instant of his death, and while he is in this state (of hope), the nearer line (death) comes to Him
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne kuch lakeerein khainchi aur kaha, 'Ye (insaan ki) ummeed hai, aur ye uski maut ka waqt hai, aur jabke wo is haalat (ummeed) mein hota hai, nazdeeki lakeer (maut) uske paas aa jaati hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah will not accept the excuse of any person whose instant of death is delayed till he is sixty years of age
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah kisi bhi aise shaks ka bahaana qubool nahi karega jiski maut sath (60) saal ki umar tak taal di gayi ho.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "The heart of an old man remains young in two respects, i.e., his love for the world (its wealth, amusements and luxuries) and his incessant hope
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Budhe aadmi ka dil do baaton mein jawaan rehta hai: duniya se uski mohabbat (uski daulat, aish-o-ishrat aur luxury) aur uski musalsal ummeed.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The son of Adam (i.e. man) grows old and so also two (desires) grow old with him, i.e., love for wealth and (a wish for) a long life
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Aadam ka beta (yaani insaan) boodha hota hai, aur uske saath do (khwaahishein) bhi boodhi hoti hain: daulat se mohabbat aur (lambi umar ki) khwaahish.'

e: Narrated Mahmud bin Ar-Rabi'a:I remember that the Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took water from a bucket (which was in our home used for getting water out of well) with his mouth (and threw it on my face)
hi: Mahmud bin Ar-Rabi'a bataate hain: Mujhe yaad hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek bucket (jo hamare ghar mein kuen se paani nikaalne ke liye tha) se apne munh se paani liya (aur mere chehre par phenka).

e: Narrated `Utban bin Malik Al-Ansari:who was one of the men of the tribe of Bani Salim: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to me and said, "If anybody comes on the Day of Resurrection who has said: La ilaha illal-lah, sincerely, with the intention to win Allah's Pleasure, Allah will make the Hell-Fire forbidden for him
hi: Utban bin Malik Al-Ansari, jo Banu Salim qabeele ke logon mein se the, bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mere paas aaye aur kaha, 'Agar Qayamat ke din koi aisa aaye jisne "La Ilaha Illal-lah" khulusi se, Allah ki khushi jeetne ki niyat se kaha ho, to Allah uspar Jahannam ki Aag haraam kar dega.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah says, 'I have nothing to give but Paradise as a reward to my believer slave, who, if I cause his dear friend (or relative) to die, remains patient (and hopes for Allah's Reward)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah farmaata hai, "Mere paas apne Momin bande ke liye Jannat ke siwa koi aur badla nahi jise, agar main uske aziz dost (ya rishtedaar) ko maut deta hoon, wo sabra karta hai (aur Allah ke ajr ki ummeed rakhta hai)."'

e: Narrated `Amr bin `Auf:(An ally of the tribe of Bani 'Amir bin Lu'ai and one of those who had witnessed the battle of Badr with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent Abu 'Ubaida bin AlJarrah to Bahrain to collect the Jizya tax. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had concluded a peace treaty with the people of Bahrain and appointed Al 'Ala bin Al-Hadrami as their chief; Abu Ubaida arrived from Bahrain with the money. The Ansar heard of Abu 'Ubaida's arrival which coincided with the Fajr (morning) prayer led by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). When the Prophet (ﷺ) finished the prayer, they came to him. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) smiled when he saw them and said, "I think you have heard of the arrival of Abu 'Ubaida and that he has brought something." They replied, "Yes, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! " He said, "Have the good news, and hope for what will please you. By Allah, I am not afraid that you will become poor, but I am afraid that worldly wealth will be given to you in abundance as it was given to those (nations) before you, and you will start competing each other for it as the previous nations competed for it, and then it will divert you (from good) as it diverted them
hi: Amr bin Auf (Banu Aamir bin Luwaiy qabeele ke saathi aur jang-e-Badr mein Allah ke Rasool SAW ke saath maujood logon mein se) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Abu Ubaida bin Al-Jarrah ko Bahrain jaziya (tax) jama karne bheja. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Bahrain ke logon se sulah kar li thi aur Al-Ala bin Al-Hadrami ko unka sardaar bana diya tha; Abu Ubaida Bahrain se paise lekar aaye. Ansaar ne Abu Ubaida ke aane ki khabar suni jo Nabi (SAW) ki imaamat mein Fajr ki namaz ke waqt se mel khaati thi. Jab Nabi (SAW) ne namaz khatam ki, wo unke paas aaye. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhein dekhkar muskuraaye aur kaha, 'Mujhe lagta hai tumne Abu Ubaida ke aane ki khabar suni hai aur ke wo kuch laaye hain.' Unhone jawab diya, 'Haan, Aye Allah ke Rasool!' Unhone kaha, 'Khush-khabri lo, aur us cheez ki ummeed rakho jo tumhein khush karegi. Allah ki qasam, mujhe dar nahi ke tum gareeb ho jaoge, magar mujhe dar hai ke duniya ki daulat tumhein itni zyaada di jaayegi jitni pehle logon (ummaton) ko di gayi thi, aur tum ek doosre se uske liye pratispardha (muqaabla) karoge jaisa pehle logon ne kiya, aur phir wo tumhein (achhaai se) bhataka degi jaisa unhein bhataka diya tha.'

e: Narrated `Uqba bin 'Amir:The Prophet (ﷺ) went out and offered the funeral prayer for the martyrs of the (battle of) Uhud and then ascended the pulpit and said, "I am your predecessor and I am a witness against you. By Allah, I am now looking at my Tank-lake (Al-Kauthar) and I have been given the keys of the treasures of the earth (or the keys of the earth). By Allah! I am not afraid that after me you will worship others besides Allah, but I am afraid that you will start competing for (the pleasures of) this world
hi: Uqba bin Aamir bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) baahar gaye aur Uhud ke shaheedon ki namaz-e-janaza padhaayi, phir mimbar par chadhe aur kaha, 'Main tumhaara pehle jaane wala hoon aur main tumhaare khilaaf gawaah hoon. Allah ki qasam, main is waqt apne Hauz (Al-Kauthar) ko dekh raha hoon aur mujhe zameen ke khazaanon ki (ya zameen ki) chaabiyaan di gayi hain. Allah ki qasam! Mujhe dar nahi ke mere baad tum Allah ke ilaawa doosron ki ibaadat karoge, magar mujhe dar hai ke tum is duniya (ki khushiyon) ke liye pratispardha (muqaabla) karoge.'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The thing I am afraid of most for your sake, is the worldly blessings which Allah will bring forth to you." It was said, "What are the blessings of this world?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The pleasures of the world." A man said, "Can the good bring forth evil?" The Prophet (ﷺ) kept quiet for a while till we thought that he was being inspired divinely. Then he started removing the sweat from his forehead and said," Where is the questioner?" That man said, "I (am present)." Abu Sa`id added: We thanked the man when the result (of his question) was such. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Good never brings forth but good. This wealth (of the world) is (like) green and sweet (fruit), and all the vegetation which grows on the bank of a stream either kills or nearly kills the animal that eats too much of it, except the animal that eats the Khadira (a kind of vegetation). Such an animal eats till its stomach is full and then it faces the sun and starts ruminating and then it passes out dung and urine and goes to eat again. This worldly wealth is (like) sweet (fruit), and if a person earns it (the wealth) in a legal way and spends it properly, then it is an excellent helper, and whoever earns it in an illegal way, he will be like the one who eats but is never satisfied
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jis cheez se main tumhaari khaatir sabse zyaada darta hoon, wo duniya ki niyaamaten hain jo Allah tumhaare liye zaahir karega.' Kisi ne pucha, 'Duniya ki niyaamaten kya hain?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Duniya ki khushiyaan.' Ek shaks ne kaha, 'Kya achhaai buraai la sakti hai?' Nabi (SAW) kuch der khaamosh rahe yahaan tak ke humein laga wo Ilaahi wahi paa rahe hain. Phir unhone apni peshaani se pasina saaf karna shuru kiya aur kaha, 'Sawaal karne wala kahaan hai?' Us shaks ne kaha, 'Main (haazir hoon).' Abu Saeed ne aage kaha: Humne us shaks ka shukriya adaa kiya jab uske sawaal ka natija aisa nikla. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Achhaai sirf achhaai laati hai. Ye (duniya ki) daulat hari aur meethi (phal) hai, aur jo bhi paudhein nadi ke kinaare ugte hain, wo jaanwar ko marta hai ya lagbhag marta hai jo unmein se bahut zyaada khaata hai, siwaaye us jaanwar ke jo Khadira (ek qism ka paudha) khaata hai. Aisa jaanwar tab tak khaata hai jab tak uska pet bhar na jaaye, phir wo suraj ki taraf muh karta hai aur jugaali karne lagta hai, phir wo mal aur peshaab karta hai aur phir khaane jaata hai. Ye duniya ki daulat meethi (phal) hai, aur agar koi shaks ise (daulat ko) jaayez tareeke se kamaaye aur sahi tareeke se kharch kare, to wo ek behtareen madadgaar hai, aur jo ise gair-jaayez tareeke se kamaaye, wo us jaisa hoga jo khaata hai magar kabhi santusht nahi hota.'

e: Narrated Zahdam bin Mudarrib:`Imran bin Husain said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The best people are my contemporaries (i.e., the present (my) generation) and then those who come after them (i.e., the next generation)." `Imran added: I am not sure whether the Prophet (ﷺ) repeated the statement twice after his first saying. The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "And after them there will come people who will bear witness, though they will not be asked to give their witness; and they will be treacherous and nobody will trust them, and they will make vows, but will not fulfill them, and fatness will appear among them
hi: Zahdam bin Mudarrib bataate hain: Imran bin Husain (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Sabse behtareen log mere (waqt ke) log hain, aur phir wo jo unke baad aayenge.' Imran ne izaafa kiya, 'Mujhe yaqeen nahi ke Nabi (SAW) ne apni pehli baat ke baad ise do baar dohraaya ya nahi.' Nabi (SAW) ne aage kaha, 'Aur unke baad aise log aayenge jo gawaahi denge, halaanke unse gawaahi maangi nahi jaayegi; aur wo dhoke-baaz honge aur koi unpar bharosa nahi karega, aur wo mannatein maanenge magar unhein poora nahi karenge, aur unmein motaapa zaahir hoga.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The best people are those of my generation, and then those who will come after them (the next generation), and then those who will come after them (i.e. the next generation), and then after them, there will come people whose witness will precede their oaths, and whose oaths will precede their witness
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Sabse behtareen log mere daur ke log hain, phir wo jo unke baad aayenge, phir wo jo unke baad aayenge (yaani agla daur), aur unke baad, aise log aayenge jinki gawaahi unki qasam se pehle hogi, aur jinki qasam unki gawaahi se pehle hogi.'

e: Narrated Qais:I heard Khabbab, who had branded his `Abdomen with seven brands, saying, "Had Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) not forbidden us to invoke Allah for death, I would have invoked Allah for death. The companions of Muhammad have left this world without taking anything of their reward in it (i.e., they will have perfect reward in the Hereafter), but we have collected of the worldly wealth what we cannot spend but on earth (i.e. on building houses)
hi: Qais bataate hain: Maine Khabbab (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko, jinhone apne pet par saat daagh lagaaye the, ye kehte suna, 'Agar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein maut ki dua maangne se mana na kiya hota, to main maut ki dua maangta. Muhammad (SAW) ke sahaaba is duniya se bina apna ajr yahaan liye chale gaye (yaani unhein Aakhirat mein poora ajr milega), magar humne duniya ki itni daulat jama kar li hai jise hum zameen ke ilaawa (yaani ghar banaane ke ilaawa) kahin kharch nahi kar sakte.'

e: Narrated Qais:I came to Khabbab while he was building a wall, and he (Khabbab) said, "Our companions who have left this world, did not enjoy anything of their reward therein, while we have collected after them, much wealth that we cannot spend but on earth (i.e., on building)
hi: Qais bataate hain: Main Khabbab (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas aaya jab wo ek deewaar bana rahe the, aur unhone kaha, 'Hamare saathi jo is duniya se guzar gaye, unhone yahaan apne ajr ka koi hissa nahi bhoga, jabke humne unke baad itni daulat jama kar li hai ke use hum sirf zameen par (yaani imaarat par) kharch kar sakte hain.'

e: Narrated Khabbab:We migrated with the Prophet..(This narration is related in the chapter of migration)
hi: Khabbab (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Nabi (SAW) ke saath hijrat karke aaye... (Ye riwaayat hijrat ke chapter mein bayaan ki gayi hai.)

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I brought water to `Uthman bin `Affan to perform the ablution while he was sitting on his seat. He performed the ablution in a perfect way and said, "I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) performing the ablution in this place and he performed it in a perfect way and said, "Whoever performs the ablution as I have done this time and then proceeds to the mosque and offers a two-rak`at prayer and then sits there (waiting for the compulsory congregational prayers), then all his past sins will be forgiven." The Prophet (ﷺ) further added, "Do not be conceited (thinking that your sins will be forgiven because of your prayer)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Affan ke paas paani laaya taake wo wuzu karein jabke wo apni jagah baithe the. Unhone bahut achhe tareeke se wuzu kiya aur kaha, 'Maine Nabi (SAW) ko is jagah wuzu karte dekha, aur unhone use bahut achhe tareeke se kiya aur kaha, "Jo koi is tarah wuzu kare jaise maine is baar kiya, phir Masjid ki taraf jaaye aur do rakat namaz padhe aur phir wahaan baithe (farz jamaat namaz ka intezaar karte hue), to uske sab pichhle gunaah maaf kar diye jaayenge."' Nabi (SAW) ne aage kaha, 'Ghamand mat karo (ye sochkar ke tumhaare gunaah tumhaari namaz ki wajah se maaf ho jaayenge).'

e: Narrated Mirdas Al-Aslami:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The righteous (pious people will depart (die) in succession one after the other, and there will remain (on the earth) useless people like the useless husk of barley seeds or bad dates
hi: Mirdas Al-Aslami bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Neik (parhezgaar) log ek ke baad ek (zameen se) uthaye jaate rahenge, aur (zameen par) bekaar log reh jaayenge jaise jau ke chhilkon ya buri khajooron ka bekaar hissa.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Perish the slave of Dinar, Dirham, Qatifa (thick soft cloth), and Khamisa (a garment), for if he is given, he is pleased; otherwise he is dissatisfied
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Barbaad ho Dinar, Dirham, Qatifa (mota naram kapda), aur Khamisa (ek kapda) ka ghulaam, kyunke agar use kuch diya jaaye, to wo khush hota hai, warna wo napasandidagi zaahir karta hai.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "If the son of Adam (the human being) had two valleys of money, he would wish for a third, for nothing can fill the belly of Adam's son except dust, and Allah forgives him who repents to Him
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Agar Aadam ke bete (yaani insaan) ke paas paise ki do wadiyaan hon, to wo teesri ki tamanna karega, kyunke Aadam ke bete ka pet mitti ke siwa kisi cheez se nahi bharta, aur Allah use maaf karta hai jo uski taraf tauba karta hai.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "If the son of Adam had money equal to a valley, then he will wish for another similar to it, for nothing can satisfy the eye of Adam's son except dust. And Allah forgives him who repents to Him." Ibn `Abbas said: I do not know whether this saying was quoted from the Qur'an or not. `Ata' said, "I heard Ibn Az-Zubair saying this narration while he was on the pulpit
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Agar Aadam ke bete ke paas ek wadi jitna paisa ho, to wo doosri usi jaisi ki tamanna karega, kyunke Aadam ke bete ki aankh mitti ke siwa kisi cheez se santusht nahi hoti. Aur Allah use maaf karta hai jo uski taraf tauba karta hai.' Ibn Abbas ne kaha, 'Mujhe nahi pata ye baat Quran se li gayi hai ya nahi.' Ata kehte hain, 'Maine Ibn Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko ye riwaayat mimbar par kehte suna.'

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:I heard Ibn Az-Zubair who was on the pulpit at Mecca, delivering a sermon, saying, "O men! The Prophet used to say, "If the son of Adam were given a valley full of gold, he would love to have a second one; and if he were given the second one, he would love to have a third, for nothing fills the belly of Adam's son except dust. And Allah forgives he who repents to Him." Ubai said, "We considered this as a saying from the Qur'an till the Sura (beginning with) 'The mutual rivalry for piling up of worldly things diverts you..' (102.1) was revealed
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Ibn Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko, jo Makkah mein mimbar par khutba de rahe the, ye kehte suna, 'Aye logo! Nabi (SAW) kaha karte the, "Agar Aadam ke bete ko sone se bhari ek wadi di jaaye, to wo doosri paane ki khwaahish karega; aur agar use doosri di jaaye, to wo teesri paane ki khwaahish karega, kyunke Aadam ke bete ka pet mitti ke siwa kisi cheez se nahi bharta. Aur Allah use maaf karta hai jo uski taraf tauba karta hai."' Ubai ne kaha, 'Humne ise Quran ki baat samjha yahaan tak ke Surah "Duniya ki cheezein jama karne ki hod tumhein bhataati hai..." (102:1) naazil hui.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If Adam's son had a valley full of gold, he would like to have two valleys, for nothing fills his mouth except dust. And Allah forgives him who repents to Him
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar Aadam ke bete ke paas sone se bhari ek wadi ho, to wo do wadiyaan chaahega, kyunke uska munh mitti ke siwa kisi cheez se nahi bharta. Aur Allah use maaf karta hai jo uski taraf tauba karta hai.'

e: Ubayy said (referring to the hadith above), "We considered this as a saying from the Qur'an till the Surah (beginning with):"The mutual rivalry (for piling up of worldly things) diverts you' (102:1) was revealed
hi: Ubai ne (upar wali hadees ke baare mein) kaha, 'Humne ise Quran ki baat samjha yahaan tak ke Surah "Duniya ki cheezein jama karne ki hod tumhein bhataati hai..." (102:1) naazil hui.'

e: Narrated Hakim bin Hizam:I asked the Prophet (for some money) and he gave me, and then again I asked him and he gave me, and then again I asked him and he gave me and he then said, "This wealth is (like) green and sweet (fruit), and whoever takes it without greed, Allah will bless it for him, but whoever takes it with greed, Allah will not bless it for him, and he will be like the one who eats but is never satisfied. And the upper (giving) hand is better than the lower (taking) hand
hi: Hakim bin Hizam (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) se (kuch paisa) maanga aur unhone mujhe diya, phir maine dobara maanga aur unhone mujhe diya, phir maine phir maanga aur unhone mujhe diya, aur phir unhone kaha, 'Ye daulat hari aur meethi (phal) hai, aur jo koi ise bina lalach ke le, Allah use uske liye barkat dega, magar jo ise lalach se le, Allah use uske liye barkat nahi dega, aur wo us jaisa hoga jo khaata hai magar kabhi santusht nahi hota. Aur oopar wala (dene wala) haath neeche wale (lene wale) haath se behtar hai.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Who among you considers the wealth of his heirs dearer to him than his own wealth?" They replied, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! There is none among us but loves his own wealth more." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "So his wealth is whatever he spends (in Allah's Cause) during his life (on good deeds) while the wealth of his heirs is whatever he leaves after his death
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Tum mein se kaunsa shaks apne waarison ki daulat ko apni khud ki daulat se zyaada aziz samajhta hai?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Hum mein se koi aisa nahi jo apni khud ki daulat se zyaada mohabbat na karta ho.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'To uski daulat wo hai jo wo apni zindagi mein (Allah ki raah mein, nek amaal mein) kharch karta hai, jabke uske waarison ki daulat wo hai jo wo apni maut ke baad chhodta hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Dhar:Once I went out at night and found Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) walking all alone accompanied by nobody, and I thought that perhaps he disliked that someone should accompany him. So I walked in the shade, away from the moonlight, but the Prophet (ﷺ) looked behind and saw me and said, "Who is that?" I replied, "Abu Dhar, let Allah get me sacrificed for you!" He said, "O Abu Dhar, come here!" So I accompanied him for a while and then he said, "The rich are in fact the poor (little rewarded) on the Day of Resurrection except him whom Allah gives wealth which he gives (in charity) to his right, left, front and back, and does good deeds with it. I walked with him a little longer. Then he said to me, "Sit down here." So he made me sit in an open space surrounded by rocks, and said to me, "Sit here till I come back to you." He went towards Al-Harra till I could not see him, and he stayed away for a long period, and then I heard him saying, while he was coming, "Even if he had committed theft, and even if he had committed illegal sexual intercourse?" When he came, I could not remain patient and asked him, "O Allah's Prophet! Let Allah get me sacrificed for you! Whom were you speaking to by the side of Al-Harra? I did not hear anybody responding to your talk." He said, "It was Gabriel who appeared to me beside Al-Harra and said, 'Give the good news to your followers that whoever dies without having worshipped anything besides Allah, will enter Paradise.' I said, 'O Gabriel! Even if he had committed theft or committed illegal sexual intercourse?' He said, 'Yes.' I said, 'Even if he has committed theft or committed illegal sexual intercourse?' He said, 'Yes.' I said, 'Even if he has committed theft or committed illegal sexual intercourse?' He said, 'Yes
hi: Abu Dharr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar main raat ko baahar gaya aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko akele chalte paaya, koi unke saath nahi tha, aur maine socha shaayad unhein pasand nahi ke koi unke saath chale. To main chaandni se door, saaye mein chalne laga, magar Nabi (SAW) ne peeche mudkar mujhe dekha aur kaha, 'Ye kaun hai?' Maine jawab diya, 'Abu Dharr, Allah mujhe aap par qurbaan kare!' Unhone kaha, 'Aye Abu Dharr, idhar aao!' To main kuch der unke saath chala, phir unhone kaha, 'Ameer log dar-asal Qayamat ke din gareeb (kam ajr paane wale) honge, siwaaye us shaks ke jise Allah daulat de aur wo use apne daaen, baaen, saamne aur peeche sadqe mein de, aur usse nek amaal kare.' Main unke saath thodi door aur chala. Phir unhone kaha, 'Yahaan baith jao.' To unhone mujhe ek khule maidan mein, pattharon se ghire hue, bithaaya, aur mujhse kaha, 'Yahaan baitho jab tak main tumhaare paas wapas na aaun.' Wo Al-Harra ki taraf gaye yahaan tak ke main unhein dekh na saka, aur wo lambi muddat tak door rahe, phir maine unhein aate hue kehte suna, 'Chaahe usne chori ki ho, aur chaahe usne zina kiya ho?' Jab wo aaye, main sabra na kar saka aur unse pucha, 'Aye Allah ke Nabi! Allah mujhe aap par qurbaan kare! Aap Al-Harra ke paas kisse baat kar rahe the? Maine kisi ko aapki baat ka jawab dete nahi suna.' Unhone kaha, 'Ye Jibrael the jo Al-Harra ke paas mere saamne aaye aur kaha, "Apne maanne walon ko khush-khabri do ke jo koi Allah ke siwa kisi aur ki ibaadat kiye bagair mare, wo Jannat mein daakhil hoga." Maine kaha, "Aye Jibrael! Chaahe usne chori ki ho ya zina kiya ho?" Unhone kaha, "Haan." Maine kaha, "Chaahe usne chori ki ho ya zina kiya ho?" Unhone kaha, "Haan." Maine kaha, "Chaahe usne chori ki ho ya zina kiya ho?" Unhone kaha, "Haan."'

e: Narrated Abu Dhar:While I was walking with the Prophet (ﷺ) in the Harra of Medina, Uhud came in sight. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Abu Dhar!" I said, "Labbaik, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" He said, "I would not like to have gold equal to this mountain of Uhud, unless nothing of it, not even a single Dinar of it remains with me for more than three days, except something which I will keep for repaying debts. I would have spent all of it (distributed it) amongst Allah's Slaves like this, and like this, and like this." The Prophet (ﷺ) pointed out with his hand towards his right, his left and his back (while illustrating it). He proceeded with his walk and said, "The rich are in fact the poor (little rewarded) on the Day of Resurrection except those who spend their wealth like this, and like this, and like this, to their right, left and back, but such people are few in number." Then he said to me, "Stay at your place and do not leave it till I come back." Then he proceeded in the darkness of the night till he went out of sight, and then I heard a loud voice, and was afraid that something might have happened to the Prophet (ﷺ) .1 intended to go to him, but I remembered what he had said to me, i.e. 'Don't leave your place till I come back to you,' so I remained at my place till he came back to me. I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I heard a voice and I was afraid." So I mentioned the whole story to him. He said, "Did you hear it?" I replied, "Yes." He said, "It was Gabriel who came to me and said, 'Whoever died without joining others in worship with Allah, will enter Paradise.' I asked (Gabriel), 'Even if he had committed theft or committed illegal sexual intercourse? Gabriel said, 'Yes, even if he had committed theft or committed illegal sexual intercourse
hi: Abu Dharr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab main Madina ki Harra mein Nabi (SAW) ke saath chal raha tha, Uhud nazar aaya. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Aye Abu Dharr!' Maine kaha, 'Labbaik, Aye Allah ke Rasool!' Unhone kaha, 'Mujhe pasand nahi ke mere paas is Uhud pahaad jitna sona ho, jab tak isse ek bhi Dinar mere paas teen din se zyaada na rahe, siwaaye us cheez ke jo main qarz chukaane ke liye rakhunga. Main ise (poori raqam) Allah ke bandon mein aise, aur aise, aur aise baant dunga.' Nabi (SAW) ne apne haath se apni daayin, baayin aur peechhe ki taraf ishara kiya (ye samjhaane ke liye). Wo apne chalne mein aage badhe aur kaha, 'Ameer log dar-asal Qayamat ke din gareeb (kam ajr paane wale) honge, siwaaye un logon ke jo apni daulat ko aise, aur aise, aur aise, apne daaen, baaen aur peeche kharch karein, magar aise log kam hain.' Phir unhone mujhse kaha, 'Apni jagah rehna aur wahaan se mat hilna jab tak main wapas na aaun.' Phir wo raat ke andhere mein aage badhe yahaan tak ke wo ojhal ho gaye, aur phir maine ek zordaar aawaaz suni, aur mujhe dar tha ke kahin Nabi (SAW) ko kuch ho na gaya ho. Main unke paas jaana chahta tha, magar mujhe unki baat yaad aayi, 'Apni jagah mat chhodna jab tak main wapas na aaun,' isliye main apni jagah raha jab tak wo mere paas wapas nahi aaye. Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Maine ek aawaaz suni aur mujhe dar laga.' To maine unhein poori kahaani bataayi. Unhone kaha, 'Kya tumne use suna?' Maine jawab diya, 'Haan.' Unhone kaha, 'Ye Jibrael the jo mere paas aaye aur kaha, "Jo koi Allah ke saath kisi aur ki ibaadat kiye bagair mara, wo Jannat mein daakhil hoga." Maine (Jibrael se) pucha, "Chaahe usne chori ki ho ya zina kiya ho?" Jibrael ne kaha, "Haan, chaahe usne chori ki ho ya zina kiya ho."'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Apostle said, "If I had gold equal to the mountain of Uhud, it would not please me that anything of it should remain with me after three nights (i.e., I would spend all of it in Allah's Cause) except what I would keep for repaying debts
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar mere paas Uhud pahaad jitna sona ho, mujhe pasand nahi ke isme se kuch bhi teen raaton ke baad mere paas rahe (yaani main ise sab Allah ki raah mein kharch kar dunga), siwaaye us cheez ke jo main qarz chukaane ke liye rakhunga.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Wealth is not in having many possessions, but rather (true) wealth is feeling sufficiency in the soul
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Daulat maal ki kasrat mein nahi, balke (asli) daulat dil ki qanaa'at (santushti) mein hai.'

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d As-Sa`id:A man passed by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and the Prophet (ﷺ) asked a man sitting beside him, "What is your opinion about this (passer-by)?" He replied, "This (passer-by) is from the noble class of people. By Allah, if he should ask for a lady's hand in marriage, he ought to be given her in marriage, and if he intercedes for somebody, his intercession will be accepted. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) kept quiet, and then another man passed by and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked the same man (his companion) again, "What is your opinion about this (second) one?" He said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! This person is one of the poor Muslims. If he should ask a lady's hand in marriage, no-one will accept him, and if he intercedes for somebody, no one will accept his intercession, and if he talks, no-one will listen to his talk." Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "This (poor man) is better than such a large number of the first type (i.e. rich men) as to fill the earth
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) As-Sa'idi bataate hain: Ek shaks Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas se guzra, aur Nabi (SAW) ne apne paas baithe ek shaks se pucha, 'Is (guzarne wale) ke baare mein aapki kya raay hai?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Ye (guzarne wala) izzatdaar logon mein se hai. Allah ki qasam, agar wo kisi khaatoon ka haath maange nikaah ke liye, to use di jaani chaahiye, aur agar wo kisi ke liye sifaarish kare, to uski sifaarish qubool ki jaayegi.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khaamosh rahe, phir ek aur shaks guzra aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne usi shaks (apne saathi) se dobara pucha, 'Is (doosre) ke baare mein aapki kya raay hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Ye gareeb Musalmaanon mein se ek hai. Agar wo kisi khaatoon ka haath maange, to koi use nahi dega, aur agar wo kisi ke liye sifaarish kare, to koi uski sifaarish qubool nahi karega, aur agar wo baat kare, to koi uski baat nahi sunega.' Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Ye (gareeb aadmi) pehli qism (ameer aadmiyon) ke zameen bhar itne aadmiyon se behtar hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Wail:We paid a visit to Khabbab who was sick, and he said, "We migrated with the Prophet (ﷺ) for Allah's Sake and our wages became due on Allah. Some of us died without having received anything of the wages, and one of them was Mus`ab bin `Umair, who was martyred on the day of the battle of Uhud, leaving only one sheet (to shroud him in). If we covered his head with it, his feet became uncovered, and if we covered his feet with it, his head became uncovered. So the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered us to cover his head with it and put some Idhkhir (a kind of grass) over his feet. On the other hand, some of us have had the fruits (of our good deed) and are plucking them (in this world)
hi: Abu Wail bataate hain: Hum Khabbab (رضی اللہ عنہ) se milne gaye jo bimar the, aur unhone kaha, 'Hum Allah ki khaatir Nabi (SAW) ke saath hijrat karke aaye, aur hamaari mazdoori Allah par vaajib ho gayi. Hum mein se kuch aisa mar gaye bina apni mazdoori ka kuch bhi paaye, aur unmein se ek Mus'ab bin Umair the, jo jang-e-Uhud ke din shaheed hue, sirf ek chaadar chhod kar (unhein kafan dene ke liye). Agar hum unka sar usse dhaankte, unke pair khul jaate, aur agar hum unke pair dhaankte, unka sar khul jaata. To Nabi (SAW) ne humein hukm diya ke unka sar usse dhaankein aur unke pairon par kuch Idhkhir (ek qism ki ghaas) rakhein. Doosri taraf, humein se kuch ko (hamare nek amaal ke) phal mile hain aur hum unhein (is duniya mein) chun rahe hain.'

e: Narrated `Imran bin Husain:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I looked into Paradise and found that the majority of its dwellers were the poor people, and I looked into the (Hell) Fire and found that the majority of its dwellers were women
hi: Imran bin Husain (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Maine Jannat mein jhaanka aur paaya ke uske zyaadatar rehne wale gareeb log the, aur maine (Jahannam ki) Aag mein jhaanka aur paaya ke uske zyaadatar rehne wale auraten thin.'

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) did not eat at a table till he died, and he did not eat a thin nicely baked wheat bread till he died
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne apni wafat tak kabhi mez par khaana nahi khaaya, aur unhone apni maut tak kabhi patli, achhi tarah pakaayi hui gehun ki roti nahi khaayi.

e: Narrated `Aisha:When the Prophet (ﷺ) died, nothing which can be eaten by a living creature was left on my shelf except some barley grain. I ate of it for a period and when I measured it, it finished
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab Nabi (SAW) ka intekaal hua, meri almari mein kisi bhi zinda jaanwar ke khaane ke laayak kuch nahi bacha tha siwaaye kuch jau ke daanon ke. Maine kuch waqt tak isme se khaaya, aur jab maine naapa, to wo khatam ho gaya.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:By Allah except Whom none has the right to- be worshipped, (sometimes) I used to lay (sleep) on the ground on my liver (abdomen) because of hunger, and (sometimes) I used to bind a stone over my belly because of hunger. One day I sat by the way from where they (the Prophet (ﷺ) and his companions) used to come out. When Abu Bakr passed by, I asked him about a Verse from Allah's Book and I asked him only that he might satisfy my hunger, but he passed by and did not do so. Then `Umar passed by me and I asked him about a Verse from Allah's Book, and I asked him only that he might satisfy my hunger, but he passed by without doing so. Finally Abu-l-Qasim (the Prophet (ﷺ) ) passed by me and he smiled when he saw me, for he knew what was in my heart and on my face. He said, "O Aba Hirr (Abu Huraira)!" I replied, "Labbaik, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" He said to me, "Follow me." He left and I followed him. Then he entered the house and I asked permission to enter and was admitted. He found milk in a bowl and said, "From where is this milk?" They said, "It has been presented to you by such-and-such man (or by such and such woman)." He said, "O Aba Hirr!" I said, "Labbaik, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" He said, "Go and call the people of Suffa to me." These people of Suffa were the guests of Islam who had no families, nor money, nor anybody to depend upon, and whenever an object of charity was brought to the Prophet, he would send it to them and would not take anything from it, and whenever any present was given to him, he used to send some for them and take some of it for himself. The order of the Prophet upset me, and I said to myself, "How will this little milk be enough for the people of As- Suffa? though I was more entitled to drink from that milk in order to strengthen myself", but behold! The Prophet (ﷺ) came to order me to give that milk to them. I wondered what will remain of that milk for me, but anyway, I could not but obey Allah and His Apostle so I went to the people of As-Suffa and called them, and they came and asked the Prophet's permission to enter. They were admitted and took their seats in the house. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Aba-Hirr!" I said, "Labbaik, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" He said, "Take it and give it to them." So I took the bowl (of milk) and started giving it to one man who would drink his fill and return it to me, whereupon I would give it to another man who, in his turn, would drink his fill and return it to me, and I would then offer it to another man who would drink his fill and return it to me. Finally, after the whole group had drunk their fill, I reached the Prophet (ﷺ) who took the bowl and put it on his hand, looked at me and smiled and said. "O Aba Hirr!" I replied, "Labbaik, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" He said, "There remain you and I." I said, "You have said the truth, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" He said, "Sit down and drink." I sat down and drank. He said, "Drink," and I drank. He kept on telling me repeatedly to drink, till I said, "No. by Allah Who sent you with the Truth, I have no space for it (in my stomach)." He said, "Hand it over to me." When I gave him the bowl, he praised Allah and pronounced Allah's Name on it and drank the remaining milk
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Us Zaat ki qasam jiske siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi, (kabhi kabhi) main bhookh ki wajah se apne pet ke bal zameen par letā tha, aur (kabhi kabhi) main bhookh ki wajah se apne pet par patthar baandhta tha. Ek din main us raaste par baitha jahaan se wo (Nabi SAW aur unke sahaaba) nikala karte the. Jab Abu Bakr guzre, maine unse Allah ki Kitaab ki ek Aayat ke baare mein pucha, aur maine sirf isliye pucha taake wo meri bhookh mita sakein, magar wo guzar gaye aur aisa nahi kiya. Phir Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) mere paas se guzre aur maine unse Allah ki Kitaab ki ek Aayat ke baare mein pucha, aur maine sirf isliye pucha taake wo meri bhookh mita sakein, magar wo bhi bina aisa kiye guzar gaye. Aakhir mein Abu-l-Qasim (Nabi) guzre aur mujhe dekhkar muskuraaye, kyunke unhein pata tha mere dil mein aur mere chehre par kya tha. Unhone kaha, 'Aye Aba Hirr!' Maine jawab diya, 'Labbaik, Aye Allah ke Rasool!' Unhone mujhse kaha, 'Mere peeche aao.' Wo chale gaye aur main unke peechhe gaya. Phir wo ghar mein daakhil hue aur maine andar aane ki ijaazat maangi aur mujhe ijaazat mil gayi. Unhone ek katore mein doodh paaya aur kaha, 'Ye doodh kahaan se aaya?' Unhone (logon ne) kaha, 'Ye aapko falaan aadmi (ya falaan aurat) ne diya hai.' Unhone kaha, 'Aye Aba Hirr!' Maine kaha, 'Labbaik, Aye Allah ke Rasool!' Unhone kaha, 'Jaao aur Suffa ke logon ko mere paas bulaao.' Ye Suffa ke log Islam ke mehmaan the jinke na koi khaandaan tha, na paisa, na koi sahaara, aur jab bhi Nabi (SAW) ke paas sadqe ki koi cheez laayi jaati, wo use unke paas bhej dete aur khud usmein se kuch na lete, aur jab bhi unhein koi tohfa diya jaata, wo usmein se kuch unke liye bhejte aur kuch khud rakh lete. Nabi (SAW) ke hukm ne mujhe pareshaan kiya, aur maine apne aap se kaha, 'Ye thoda sa doodh Suffa ke logon ke liye kaise kaafi hoga?' - halaanke mujhe khud is doodh ko piikar taaqat paane ka zyaada haq tha - magar dekha! Nabi (SAW) mujhe hukm dene aaye ke main wo doodh unhein doon. Maine socha mere liye us doodh mein se kya bachega, magar khair, main Allah aur uske Rasool ki nafarmaani nahi kar sakta tha, isliye main Suffa ke logon ke paas gaya aur unhein bulaaya, aur wo aaye aur Nabi (SAW) se andar aane ki ijaazat maangi. Unhein ijaazat mili aur wo ghar mein apni jagah baithe. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Aye Aba Hirr!' Maine kaha, 'Labbaik, Aye Allah ke Rasool!' Unhone kaha, 'Ise lo aur unhein do.' To maine katora liya aur ek aadmi ko dena shuru kiya jo apna pet bhar kar peeta aur wapas kar deta, isper main use doosre aadmi ko deta jo apna pet bhar kar peeta aur wapas kar deta, aur main phir use ek aur aadmi ko deta jo apna pet bhar kar peeta aur wapas kar deta. Aakhir, sab logon ke pet bhar kar peene ke baad, main Nabi (SAW) ke paas pahuncha, unhone katora liya aur apne haath mein rakha, mujhe dekha aur muskuraaye aur kaha, 'Aye Aba Hirr!' Maine jawab diya, 'Labbaik, Aye Allah ke Rasool!' Unhone kaha, 'Sirf tum aur main bache hain.' Maine kaha, 'Aapne sach kaha, Aye Allah ke Rasool!' Unhone kaha, 'Baitho aur piyo.' Main baitha aur piya. Unhone kaha, 'Piyo,' aur maine piya. Wo mujhse baar-baar peene ko kehte rahe, yahaan tak ke maine kaha, 'Nahi, Us Zaat ki qasam jisne aapko Haq ke saath bheja, mere paas isse (peene ki) jagah nahi hai.' Unhone kaha, 'Mujhe de do.' Jab maine unhein katora diya, unhone Allah ki tareef ki aur uska naam liya aur baacha hua doodh piya.

e: Narrated Sa`d:I was the first man among the Arabs to throw an arrow for Allah's Cause. We used to fight in Allah's Cause while we had nothing to eat except the leaves of the Hubla and the Sumur trees (desert trees) so that we discharged excrement like that of sheep (i.e. unmixed droppings). Today the (people of the) tribe of Bani Asad teach me the laws of Islam. If so, then I am lost, and all my efforts of that hard time had gone in vain
hi: Sa'd bataate hain: Main Arabon mein pehla shaks tha jisne Allah ki raah mein teer chalaaya. Hum Allah ki raah mein ladte the jabke hamare paas Hubla aur Sumur darakhton (registaani darakht) ke patton ke siwa khaane ko kuch nahi hota tha, itna ke hum bakriyon ki tarah (khushk) mal karte the. Aaj Banu Asad qabeele ke log mujhe Islam ke qawaanin sikha rahe hain. Agar aisa hai, to main to barbaad ho gaya, aur us mushkil daur ki meri saari koshishein bekaar gayi.

e: Narrated `Aisha:The family of Muhammad had never eaten their fill of wheat bread for three successive days since they had migrated to Medina till the death of the Prophet
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Muhammad (SAW) ke khaandaan ne kabhi Madina hijrat karne ke baad se lekar Nabi (SAW) ki wafat tak lagataar teen dinon tak gehun ki roti pet bhar kar nahi khaayi.

e: Narrated `Aisha:The family of Muhammad did not eat two meals on one day, but one of the two was of dates
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Muhammad (SAW) ke khaandaan ne ek din mein do khaane nahi khaaye, balke unmein se ek khajoor ka hota tha.

e: Narrated `Aisha:The bed mattress of the Prophet (ﷺ) was made of a leather case stuffed with palm fibres
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ka bistar chamde ka ek khaol tha jo khajoor ke reshon se bhara hua tha.

e: Narrated Qatada:We used to go to Anas bin Malik and see his baker standing (preparing the bread). Anas said, "Eat. I have not known that the Prophet (ﷺ) ever saw a thin well-baked loaf of bread till he died, and he never saw a roasted sheep with his eyes
hi: Qatada bataate hain: Hum Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas jaaya karte the aur unke rotiwaale (baker) ko khaana taiyaar karte dekhte. Anas ne kaha, 'Khaao. Mujhe nahi maaloom ke Nabi (SAW) ne kabhi apni wafat tak ek patli, achhi tarah pakaayi hui roti dekhi ho, aur unhone kabhi apni aankhon se bhuni hui bakri nahi dekhi.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:A complete month would pass by during which we would not make a fire (for cooking), and our food used to be only dates and water unless we were given a present of some meat
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ek poora mahina guzar jaata jismein hum aag (khaana pakaane ke liye) nahi jalaate the, aur hamara khaana sirf khajoor aur paani hota tha, siwaaye is ke ke humein kisi ne gosht ka tohfa diya ho.

e: Narrated `Aisha:that she said to `Urwa, "O, the son of my sister! We used to see three crescents in two months, and no fire used to be made in the houses of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (i.e. nothing used to be cooked)." `Urwa said, "What used to sustain you?" `Aisha said, "The two black things i.e. dates and water, except that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had neighbors from the Ansar who had some milch she-camels, and they used to give the Prophet (ﷺ) some milk from their house, and he used to make us drink it
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne Urwa se kaha, 'Aye mere behen ke bete! Hum do maheenon mein teen chaand dekha karte the, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke gharon mein aag nahi jalti thi (yaani kuch nahi pakaaya jaata tha).' Urwa ne pucha, 'To phir aap logon ka guzara kaise hota tha?' Aisha ne kaha, 'Do kaali cheezein: khajoor aur paani, siwaaye is ke ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke Ansaar mein se kuch padosi the jinke paas doodh dene wali oontniyaan thin, aur wo Nabi (SAW) ko apne ghar se kuch doodh dete, aur wo humein wo doodh pilaate.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! Give food to the family of Muhammad
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Aye Allah! Muhammad ke khaandaan ko khaana de.'

e: Narrated Masruq:I asked `Aisha "What deed was the most beloved to the Prophet?" She said, "The regular constant one." I said, "At what time did he use to get up at night (for the Tahajjud night prayer)?' She said, "He used to get up on hearing (the crowing of) the cock (the last third of the night)
hi: Masruq bataate hain: Maine Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se pucha, 'Nabi (SAW) ko kaunsa amal sabse zyaada aziz tha?' Unhone kaha, 'Wo jo lagataar aur mustaqil (regular) kiya jaata ho.' Maine pucha, 'Wo raat mein kis waqt uthte the (Tahajjud namaz ke liye)?' Unhone kaha, 'Wo murgi ki bang (raat ke aakhri hisse mein) sunkar uth jaate the.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The most beloved action to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was that whose doer did it continuously and regularly
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko sabse aziz amal wo tha jise karne wala ise musalsal aur mustaqil (regular) karta.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The deeds of anyone of you will not save you (from the (Hell) Fire)." They said, "Even you (will not be saved by your deeds), O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" He said, "No, even I (will not be saved) unless and until Allah bestows His Mercy on me. Therefore, do good deeds properly, sincerely and moderately, and worship Allah in the forenoon and in the afternoon and during a part of the night, and always adopt a middle, moderate, regular course whereby you will reach your target (Paradise)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Tum mein se kisi ke amaal use (Jahannam ki Aag se) nahi bachaayenge.' Unhone kaha, 'Kya aap bhi nahi, Aye Allah ke Rasool?' Unhone kaha, 'Nahi, main bhi nahi, jab tak Allah mujhpar apni rehmat naazil na kare. Isliye nek amaal sahi tareeke se, khulusi se, aur mautadili (moderate) tareeke se karo, aur Allah ki ibaadat subah, dophar, aur raat ke ek hisse mein karo, aur hamesha ek darmiyaani, mautadil, mustaqil raasta apnaao jisse tum apne manzil (Jannat) tak pahunchoge.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Do good deeds properly, sincerely and moderately and know that your deeds will not make you enter Paradise, and that the most beloved deed to Allah is the most regular and constant even if it were little
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Nek amaal sahi tareeke se, khulusi se, aur mautadili se karo, aur jaan lo ke tumhaare amaal tumhein Jannat mein daakhil nahi karenge, aur Allah ke nazdeek sabse aziz amal wo hai jo sabse zyaada mustaqil aur lagataar ho, chaahe wo kam hi kyun na ho.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) was asked, "What deeds are loved most by Allah?" He said, "The most regular constant deeds even though they may be few." He added, 'Don't take upon yourselves, except the deeds which are within your ability
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) se pucha gaya, 'Allah ko kaunsa amal sabse zyaada aziz hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Sabse mustaqil aur lagataar amal, chaahe wo kam hi ho.' Unhone izaafa kiya, 'Apne oopar sirf wahi amaal lo jo tumhaari taaqat mein hain.'

e: Narrated 'Alqama:I asked `Aisha, mother of the believers, "O mother of the believers! How were the deeds of the Prophet? Did he use to do extra deeds of worship on special days?" She said, "No, but his deeds were regular and constant, and who among you is able to do what the Prophet (ﷺ) was able to do (i.e. in worshipping Allah)?
hi: Alqama bataate hain: Maine Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا), Ummul-Momineen, se pucha, 'Aye Ummul-Momineen! Nabi (SAW) ke amaal kaise the? Kya wo khaas dinon mein ibaadat ka izaafa karte the?' Unhone kaha, 'Nahi, balke unke amaal mustaqil aur lagataar the, aur tum mein se kaun wo kar sakta hai jo Nabi (SAW) kar sakte the (yaani Allah ki ibaadat mein)?'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do good deeds properly, sincerely and moderately, and receive good news because one's good deeds will not make him enter Paradise." They asked, "Even you, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" He said, "Even I, unless and until Allah bestows His pardon and Mercy on me
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Nek amaal sahi tareeke se, khulusi se, aur mautadili se karo, aur khush-khabri lo, kyunke kisi ka nek amaal use Jannat mein daakhil nahi karega.' Unhone pucha, 'Aap bhi nahi, Aye Allah ke Rasool?' Unhone kaha, 'Main bhi nahi, jab tak Allah mujhpar apni maafi aur rehmat naazil na kare.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) led us in prayer and then (after finishing it) ascended the pulpit and pointed with his hand towards the Qibla of the mosque and said, "While I was leading you in prayer, both Paradise and Hell were displayed in front of me in the direction of this wall. I had never seen a better thing (than Paradise) and a worse thing (than Hell) as I have seen today, I had never seen a better thing and a worse thing as I have seen today
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein namaz padhaayi, phir (namaz khatam karne ke baad) mimbar par chadhe aur apne haath se Masjid ke Qibla ki taraf ishara karte hue kaha, 'Jab main tumhein namaz padha raha tha, Jannat aur Jahannam dono mere saamne is deewaar ki taraf pesh kiye gaye. Maine kabhi (Jannat se) achhi cheez aur (Jahannam se) buri cheez nahi dekhi jaisi aaj dekhi, maine kabhi achhi aur buri cheez nahi dekhi jaisi aaj dekhi.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, Verily Allah created Mercy. The day He created it, He made it into one hundred parts. He withheld with Him ninety-nine parts, and sent its one part to all His creatures. Had the non-believer known of all the Mercy which is in the Hands of Allah, he would not lose hope of entering Paradise, and had the believer known of all the punishment which is present with Allah, he would not consider himself safe from the Hell-Fire
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Beshak Allah ne Rehmat ko banaaya. Jis din usne ise banaaya, usne ise sau hisson mein baanta. Usne apne paas ninety-nine hisse rakhe, aur uska ek hissa apni sab makhlooqaat ko bheja. Agar kaafir ko us saari Rehmat ka pata hota jo Allah ke haath mein hai, wo Jannat mein daakhil hone ki ummeed nahi chodta, aur agar Momin ko us saare azaab ka pata hota jo Allah ke paas hai, wo khud ko Jahannam ki Aag se mehfooz nahi samajhta.'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id:Some people from the Ansar asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (to give them something) and he gave to everyone of them, who asked him, until all that he had was finished. When everything was finished and he had spent all that was in his hand, he said to them, '"(Know) that if I have any wealth, I will not withhold it from you (to keep for somebody else); And (know) that he who refrains from begging others (or doing prohibited deeds), Allah will make him contented and not in need of others; and he who remains patient, Allah will bestow patience upon him, and he who is satisfied with what he has, Allah will make him self-sufficient. And there is no gift better and vast (you may be given) than patience
hi: Abu Saeed bataate hain: Kuch Ansaar logon ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se (kuch maangte hue) darkhwaast ki, aur unhone har us shaks ko diya jisne unse maanga, yahaan tak ke unke paas jo kuch tha wo khatam ho gaya. Jab sab kuch khatam ho gaya aur unhone apne haath mein jo tha wo sab kharch kar diya, unhone unse kaha, '(Jaan lo ke) agar mere paas koi daulat ho, to main use tumse rokunga nahi; aur (jaan lo ke) jo koi doosron se maangne se bachta hai (ya mana kaamon se bachta hai), Allah use santusht aur be-niyaaz bana dega; aur jo sabra karta hai, Allah use sabra ata karega, aur jo apne paas jo hai usse santusht hai, Allah use khud-kifaayat bana dega.
