Aur sabra se behtar aur vasee koi tohfa nahi (jo tumhein diya jaa sakta hai).'

e: Narrated Al-Mughira bin Shu`ba:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to pray so much that his feet used to become edematous or swollen, and when he was asked as to why he prays so much, he would say, "Shall I not be a thankful slave (to Allah)?
hi: Al-Mughira bin Shu'ba (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) itni zyaada namaz padhte the ke unke pair soojh jaate, aur jab unse pucha jaata ke wo itni zyaada namaz kyun padhte hain, wo kehte, 'Kya main ek shukr-guzaar bandaa na banoon (Allah ka)?'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Seventy thousand people of my followers will enter Paradise without accounts, and they are those who do not practice Ar-Ruqya and do not see an evil omen in things, and put their trust in their Lord
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Mere maanne walon mein se sattar hazaar log bina hisaab-kitaab ke Jannat mein daakhil honge, aur wo wo log honge jo Ruqya (jhaad-phoonk) nahi karwaate, na cheezon mein bad-shagun maante hain, aur apne Rab par bharosa karte hain.'

e: Narrated Warrad:(the clerk of Al-Mughira bin Shu`ba) Muawiya wrote to Al-Mughira: "Write to me a narration you have heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." So Al-Mughira wrote to him, "I heard him saying the following after each prayer: 'La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la sharika lahu, lahu-l-mulk wa lahuI-hamd, wa huwa 'ala kulli Shai-in qadir.' He also used to forbid idle talk, asking too many questions (in religion), wasting money, preventing what should be given, and asking others for something (except in great need), being undutiful to mothers, and burying one's little daughters (alive)
hi: Warrad (Al-Mughira bin Shu'ba (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke munshi) bataate hain: Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Al-Mughira ko likha, 'Mujhe ek riwaayat likhkar bhejo jo aapne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suni ho.' To Al-Mughira ne unhein likha, 'Maine unhein har namaz ke baad ye kehte suna: "La Ilaha Illal-lahu Wahdahu La Sharika Lahu, Lahul-Mulku Wa Lahul-Hamdu, Wa Huwa Ala Kulli Shai'in Qadir."' Wo bekaar baaton, bahut zyaada sawaal poochne (deen mein), daulat zaaya karne, jo dena chaahiye use rokne, aur (bina zaroorat ke) doosron se maangne se bhi mana kiya karte the, aur maaon ke saath badsuluki karne se, aur apni chhoti betiyon ko zinda dafan karne se bhi mana karte the.

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever can guarantee (the chastity of) what is between his two jaw-bones and what is between his two legs (i.e. his tongue and his private parts), I guarantee Paradise for him
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi apne do jabdon (yaani zubaan) aur apni do taangon (yaani sharmgaah) ke beech ki cheez ki zimmedaari (paakeezgi) le, main uske liye Jannat ki zimmedaari leta hoon.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should talk what is good or keep quiet, and whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should not hurt (or insult) his neighbor; and whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, should entertain his guest generously
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par Iman rakhta hai, use achhi baat kehni chaahiye ya khaamosh rehna chaahiye, aur jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par Iman rakhta hai, use apne padosi ko takleef nahi deni chaahiye; aur jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par Iman rakhta hai, use apne mehmaan ki achhi khidmat karni chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Abu Shuraih Al-Khuza`i:My ears heard and my heart grasped (the statement which) the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The period for keeping one's guest is three days (and don't forget) his reward." It was asked, "What is his reward?" He said, "In the first night and the day he should be given a high class quality of meals; and whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, should entertain his guest generously; and whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should talk what is good (sense) or keep quiet
hi: Abu Shuraih (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Khuzai bataate hain: Meri kaanon ne suna aur mere dil ne samjha jab Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Mehmaan ki khidmat karne ki muddat teen din hai (aur uska ajr mat bhoolo).' Pucha gaya, 'Uska ajr kya hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Pehli raat aur din unhein behtareen khaana diya jaana chaahiye; aur jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par Iman rakhta hai, use apne mehmaan ki achhi khidmat karni chaahiye; aur jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par Iman rakhta hai, use achhi baat kehni chaahiye ya khaamosh rehna chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:That he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "A slave of Allah may utter a word without thinking whether it is right or wrong, he may slip down in the Fire as far away a distance equal to that between the east
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Allah ka bandaa kabhi bina soche-samjhe ek aisa lafz keh deta hai (ke wo sahi hai ya galat), ke wo Aag mein itni door tak phisal jaata hai jitna Poorab (aur Paschim ke beech ki doori).

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet; said, "A slave (of Allah) may utter a word which pleases Allah without giving it much importance, and because of that Allah will raise him to degrees (of reward): a slave (of Allah) may utter a word (carelessly) which displeases Allah without thinking of its gravity and because of that he will be thrown into the Hell-Fire
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Allah ka bandaa ek aisa lafz keh sakta hai jo Allah ko khush kare bina uski ahmiyat samajhe, aur isse Allah use (ajr ke) darjon tak uthaa dega; aur Allah ka bandaa (be-parwaahi se) ek aisa lafz keh sakta hai jo Allah ko naaraaz kare bina uski sanginta soche, aur isse wo Jahannam ki Aag mein daal diya jaayega.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said Allah will give shade to seven (types of people) under His Shade (on the Day of Resurrection). (one of them will be) a person who remembers Allah and his eyes are then flooded with tears
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Allah saat (qism ke logon) ko apni chhaaon mein (Qayamat ke din) chhaaon dega. (Unmein se ek hoga) wo shaks jo Allah ko yaad karta hai aur uski aankhein (Allah ke khauf se) aansuon se bhar jaati hain.'

e: Narrated Hudhaifa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There was a man amongst the people who had suspicion as to the righteousness of his deeds. Therefore he said to his family, 'If I die, take me and burn my corpse and throw my ashes into the sea on a hot (or windy) day.' They did so, but Allah, collected his particles and asked (him), What made you do what you did?' He replied, 'The only thing that made me do it, was that I was afraid of You.' So Allah forgave him
hi: Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Logon mein ek aadmi tha jise apne amaal ki neki mein shak tha. Isliye usne apne khaandaan se kaha, "Agar main mar jaaun, to mujhe le jaakar jala dena aur meri raakh ko ek garam (ya hawa waale) din samundar mein bikhera dena." Unhone waisa hi kiya, magar Allah ne uske zarron ko jama kiya aur (usse) pucha, "Tumne aisa kyun kiya?" Usne jawab diya, "Sirf isliye kyunke mujhe tera dar tha." To Allah ne use maaf kar diya.'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id:The Prophet (ﷺ) mentioned a man from the previous generation or from the people preceding your age whom Allah had given both wealth and children. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When the time of his death approached, he asked his children, 'What type of father have I been to you?' They replied: You have been a good father. He said, 'But he (i.e. your father) has not stored any good deeds with Allah (for the Hereafter): if he should face Allah, Allah will punish him. So listen, (O my children), when I die, burn my body till I become mere coal and then grind it into powder, and when there is a stormy wind, throw me (my ashes) in it.' So he took a firm promise from his children (to follow his instructions). And by Allah they (his sons) did accordingly(fulfilled their promise.) Then Allah said, "Be"' and behold! That man was standing there! Allah then said. "O my slave! What made you do what you did?" That man said, "Fear of You." So Allah forgave him
hi: Abu Saeed bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne pichhle daur ke ya tumhaare daur se pehle ke ek aadmi ka zikr kiya jise Allah ne daulat aur bacche dono diye the. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Jab uski maut ka waqt nazdeek aaya, usne apne bachon se pucha, "Main tumhaare liye kaisa baap tha?" Unhone jawab diya, "Aap ek achhe baap the." Usne kaha, "Magar usne (yaani tumhaare baap ne) Allah ke paas koi nek amaal jama nahi kiye hain: agar wo Allah ke saamne aaye, to Allah use saza dega. Isliye suno, (Aye mere bacchon), jab main mar jaaun, mujhe jala dena yahaan tak ke main sirf koyla ban jaaun, phir use pees kar powder banaana, aur jab tez aandhi chale, mujhe (meri raakh ko) usmein bikher dena." To usne apne bachon se pakka waada le liya (uski hidaayaton par amal karne ke liye). Aur Allah ki qasam, unhone (uske beton ne) waisa hi kiya (apna waada poora kiya). Phir Allah ne kaha, "Ban jaa!" aur dekha! Wo aadmi wahaan khada tha! Allah ne phir pucha, "Aye mere bande! Tumne aisa kyun kiya?" Us aadmi ne kaha, "Tera dar." To Allah ne use maaf kar diya.'

e: Narrated Abu Musa:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said. "My example and the example of the message with which Allah has sent me is like that of a man who came to some people and said, "I have seen with my own eyes the enemy forces, and I am a naked warner (to you) so save yourself, save yourself! A group of them obeyed him and went out at night, slowly and stealthily and were safe, while another group did not believe him and thus the army took them in the morning and destroyed them
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Meri misaal aur us paighaam ki misaal jiske saath Allah ne mujhe bheja hai, ek aise aadmi jaisi hai jo kuch logon ke paas aaya aur kaha, "Maine apni khud ki aankhon se dushman ki fauj dekhi hai, aur main ek nangi talwaar liye chetaawani dene wala hoon, isliye apne aap ko bachao, apne aap ko bachao!" Unmein se ek giroh ne uski baat maani aur raat ko chupke se, dheere-dheere nikal gaye aur mehfooz raha, jabke doosra giroh ne uski baat par yaqeen nahi kiya, isliye fauj ne unhein subah pakad liya aur unhein tabaah kar diya.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "My example and the example of the people is that of a man who made a fire, and when it lighted what was around it, Moths and other insects started falling into the fire. The man tried (his best) to prevent them, (from falling in the fire) but they overpowered him and rushed into the fire. The Prophet (ﷺ) added: Now, similarly, I take hold of the knots at your waist (belts) to prevent you from falling into the Fire, but you insist on falling into it
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Meri aur logon ki misaal us aadmi jaisi hai jisne aag jalaayi, aur jab isne apne aas-paas ki cheezein roshan kar di, patange aur doosre keede is aag mein girne lage. Aadmi ne (apni poori koshish se) unhein rokne ki koshish ki, magar unhone use majboor kar diya aur aag mein ghus gaye.' Nabi (SAW) ne aage kaha, 'Ab, isi tarah, main tumhaari kamar ki gaanth (belt) pakadta hoon taake tumhein Aag mein girne se bachaaun, magar tum usmein girne par zid karte ho.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A Muslim is the one who avoids harming Muslims with his tongue or his hands. And a Muhajir (an emigrant) is the one who gives up (abandons) all what Allah has forbidden
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Musalmaan wo hai jo apni zubaan ya apne haathon se doosre Musalmaanon ko takleef pahunchane se bachta hai. Aur Muhajir (hijrat karne wala) wo hai jo un sab cheezon ko chhod de jinhe Allah ne haraam kiya hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If you knew that which I know you would laugh little and weep much
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar tumhein wo maloom hota jo mujhe maloom hai, to tum kam hansate aur zyaada rote.'

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If you knew that which I know, you would laugh little and weep much
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar tumhein wo maloom hota jo mujhe maloom hai, to tum kam hansate aur zyaada rote.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The (Hell) Fire is surrounded by all kinds of desires and passions, while Paradise is surrounded by all kinds of disliked undesirable things
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, '(Jahannam ki) Aag har qism ki khwaahishon aur jazbaaton se ghiri hui hai, jabke Jannat har qism ki napasandidaa cheezon se ghiri hui hai.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Paradise is nearer to any of you than the Shirak (leather strap) of his shoe, and so is the (Hell) Fire
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jannat tum mein se kisi ke bhi apni jooti ke fite se zyaada qareeb hai, aur Aag bhi (utni hi qareeb hai).'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The truest poetic verse ever said by a poet, is: Indeed! Everything except Allah, is perishable
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Sabse sachi shairi ki baat jo kabhi kisi shaayar ne kahi wo ye hai: "Beshak! Allah ke siwa har cheez faani hai."'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If anyone of you looked at a person who was made superior to him in property and (in good) appearance, then he should also look at the one who is inferior to him
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar tum mein se koi kisi aise shaks ki taraf dekhe jo daulat aur (achhi) soorat mein usse behtar ho, to use us shaks ki taraf bhi dekhna chaahiye jo usse kam ho.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) narrating about his Lord I'm and said, "Allah ordered (the appointed angels over you) that the good and the bad deeds be written, and He then showed (the way) how (to write). If somebody intends to do a good deed and he does not do it, then Allah will write for him a full good deed (in his account with Him); and if he intends to do a good deed and actually did it, then Allah will write for him (in his account) with Him (its reward equal) from ten to seven hundred times to many more times: and if somebody intended to do a bad deed and he does not do it, then Allah will write a full good deed (in his account) with Him, and if he intended to do it (a bad deed) and actually did it, then Allah will write one bad deed (in his account)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) apne Rab ke baare mein bayaan karte hue kehte hain ke usne farmaaya, unhone kaha, 'Allah ne hukm diya (muqarrar kiye gaye farishton ko) ke nek aur bure amaal likhe jaayein, phir usne dikhaaya (ke kaise likhna hai). Agar koi nek amal ka iraada kare aur wo use na kare, to Allah uske liye ek poora nek amal likhta hai (uske hisaab mein), aur agar wo nek amal ka iraada kare aur waaqai use kare, to Allah uske liye das se sat sau tak ya usse bhi zyaada (ajr) likhta hai; aur agar koi bura amal karne ka iraada kare aur use na kare, to Allah uske liye ek poora nek amal likhta hai (uske hisaab mein), aur agar wo use (bura amal) karne ka iraada kare aur waaqai use kare, to Allah ek bura amal likhta hai (uske hisaab mein).'

e: Narrated Ghailan:Anas said "You people do (bad) deeds (commit sins) which seem in your eyes as tiny (minute) than hair while we used to consider those (very deeds) during the life-time of the Prophet (ﷺ) as destructive sins
hi: Ghailan bataate hain: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Tum log (bure) amaal (gunaah) karte ho jo tumhaari nazar mein baal se bhi zyaada mamooli (chhote) lagte hain, jabke hum Nabi (SAW) ki zindagi mein unhein tabaahkun gunaah samajhte the.'

e: Narrated Sa`d bin Sahl As-Sa`idi:The Prophet (ﷺ) looked at a man fighting against the pagans and he was one of the most competent persons fighting on behalf of the Muslims. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Let him who wants to look at a man from the dwellers of the (Hell) Fire, look at this (man)." Another man followed him and kept on following him till he (the fighter) was injured and, seeking to die quickly, he placed the blade tip of his sword between his breasts and leaned over it till it passed through his shoulders (i.e., committed suicide)." The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "A person may do deeds that seem to the people as the deeds of the people of Paradise while in fact, he is from the dwellers of the (Hell) Fire: and similarly a person may do deeds that seem to the people as the deeds of the people of the (Hell) Fire while in fact, he is from the dwellers of Paradise. Verily, the (results of) deeds done, depend upon the last actions
hi: Sa'd bin Sahl As-Sa'idi bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne ek aisi shaks ki taraf dekha jo mushrikon ke khilaaf ladh raha tha aur wo Musalmaanon ki taraf se ladne wale sabse mahir logon mein se ek tha. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Jo koi Jahannam ke ek rehne wale ko dekhna chaahe, wo isse (is aadmi ko) dekhe.' Ek aur shaks uske peechhe gaya aur uska peecha karta raha yahaan tak ke wo (jaanbaaz) zakhmi ho gaya, aur jaldi marne ki chaahat mein, usne apni talwaar ki nok apni chhaati ke beech rakhi aur uspar jhuk gaya yahaan tak ke wo uske kandhon se paar ho gayi (yaani usne khudkushi kar li).' Nabi (SAW) ne aage kaha, 'Ek shaks aise amaal karta hai jo logon ko Jannat waalon ke amaal jaise lagte hain jabke wo haqeeqat mein Jahannam waalon mein se hota hai; aur isi tarah ek shaks aise amaal karta hai jo logon ko Jahannam waalon ke amaal jaise lagte hain jabke wo haqeeqat mein Jannat waalon mein se hota hai. Beshak, amaal ka natija aakhri karyon (amalon) par nirbhar karta hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:A bedouin came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Who is the best of mankind!" The Prophet said, "A man who strives for Allah's Cause with his life and property, and also a man who lives (all alone) in a mountain path among the mountain paths to worship his Lord and save the people from his evil
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek badawi Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Insaanon mein sabse behtareen kaun hai?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Wo shaks jo apni jaan aur apni jaayadaad se Allah ki raah mein koshish karta hai, aur wo shaks jo (akela) kisi pahaadi raaste mein rehta hai apne Rab ki ibaadat karne aur logon ko apni buraai se bachaane ke liye.'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id:I heard from the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "There will come a time upon the people when the best property of a Muslim will be sheep which he will take to the tops of mountains and to the places of rainfall, run away with his religion (in order to save it) from afflictions
hi: Abu Saeed bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Aisa waqt aayega jab Musalmaan ki sabse behtareen daulat bakriyaan hongi jinhein wo pahaadon ki chotiyon aur baarish ki jagahon par le jaayega, apne deen ke saath (fitno se) bhaag kar (use bachaane ke liye).'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When honesty is lost, then wait for the Hour." It was asked, "How will honesty be lost, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" He said, "When authority is given to those who do not deserve it, then wait for the Hour
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab amaanat (imaandaari) kho jaaye, to Qayamat ka intezaar karo.' Pucha gaya, 'Amaanat kaise kho jaayegi, Aye Allah ke Rasool?' Unhone kaha, 'Jab authority (zimmedaari) un logon ko di jaaye jo iske laayak nahi, to Qayamat ka intezaar karo.'

e: Narrated Hudhaifa:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) narrated to us two narrations, one of which I have seen (happening) and I am waiting for the other. He narrated that honesty was preserved in the roots of the hearts of men (in the beginning) and then they learnt it (honesty) from the Qur'an, and then they learnt it from the (Prophet's) Sunna (tradition). He also told us about its disappearance, saying, "A man will go to sleep whereupon honesty will be taken away from his heart, and only its trace will remain, resembling the traces of fire. He then will sleep whereupon the remainder of the honesty will also be taken away (from his heart) and its trace will resemble a blister which is raised over the surface of skin, when an ember touches one's foot; and in fact, this blister does not contain anything. So there will come a day when people will deal in business with each other but there will hardly be any trustworthy persons among them. Then it will be said that in such-and-such a tribe there is such-and-such person who is honest, and a man will be admired for his intelligence, good manners and strength, though indeed he will not have belief equal to a mustard seed in his heart." The narrator added: There came upon me a time when I did not mind dealing with anyone of you, for if he was a Muslim, his religion would prevent him from cheating; and if he was a Christian, his Muslim ruler would prevent him from cheating; but today I cannot deal except with so-and-so and so-and-so. (See Hadith No. 208, Vol)
hi: Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein do riwaayaten sunaayi, jinmein se ek maine dekhi hai (hote hue) aur main doosri ka intezaar kar raha hoon. Unhone bataaya ke amaanat (shuru mein) logon ke dilon ki jadon mein mehfooz thi, phir unhone use Quran se seekha, phir unhone use (Nabi ki) Sunnat se seekha. Unhone humein iske ghayab hone ke baare mein bhi bataya, kehte hue, 'Ek aadmi so-ega, aur amaanat uske dil se le li jaayegi, aur sirf uska nishaan bachega, aag ke nishaan jaisa. Phir wo dobara so-ega aur amaanat ka baacha hissa bhi le liya jaayega, aur uska nishaan ek chhaale jaisa bacha rahega jo tvacha ki satah par oobhar aata hai jab ek angaara kisi ke pair ko chhu jaaye; aur haqeeqat mein, us chhaale mein kuch nahi hota. To ek din aayega jab log aapas mein tijaarat (khareed-farokht) karenge, magar unmein shaayad hi koi imaandaar shaks hoga. Phir kaha jaayega ke falaan qabeele mein falaan shaks hai jo imaandaar hai, aur ek aadmi ki taarif uski hikmat, achhe akhlaaq aur taaqat ke liye ki jaayegi, jabke haqeeqat mein uske dil mein sarson ke daane jitna bhi Iman nahi hoga.' Ravi (Hudhaifa) ne aage kaha: Ek waqt tha jab mujhe parwaah nahi thi tum mein se kisi ke saath vyavahaar karne mein, kyunke agar wo Musalmaan hota, uska deen use dhoka dene se rokta; aur agar wo Isaai hota, uska Musalmaan hukmraan use dhoka dene se rokta; magar aaj main sirf falaan-falaan ke saath hi vyavahaar kar sakta hoon.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "People are just like camels, out of one hundred, one can hardly find a single camel suitable to ride
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Log oonton jaise hain: sau mein se shaayad hi koi ek oont sawaari ke laayak mile.'

e: Narrated Jundub:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who lets the people hear of his good deeds intentionally, to win their praise, Allah will let the people know his real intention (on the Day of Resurrection), and he who does good things in public to show off and win the praise of the people, Allah will disclose his real intention (and humiliate him)
hi: Jundub bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi jaan-boojh kar apne nek amaal logon ko sunata hai (unki taarif jeetne ke liye), Allah logon ko uska asli iraada bata dega (Qayamat ke din); aur jo koi khule aam achhe kaam karta hai logon ko dikhaane aur unki taarif jeetne ke liye, Allah uska asli iraada zaahir kar dega (aur use zaleel karega).'

e: Narrated Mu`adh bin Jabal:While I was riding behind the Prophet (ﷺ) as a companion rider and there was nothing between me and him except the back of the saddle, he said, "O Mu`adh!" I replied, "Labbaik O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! And Sa`daik!" He proceeded for a while and then said, "O Mu`adh!" I said, "Labbaik and Sa`daik, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" He then proceeded for another while and said, "O Mu`adh bin Jabal!" I replied, "Labbaik, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and Sa`daik!" He said, "Do you know what is Allah's right on His slaves?" I replied, "Allah and His Apostle know better." He said, "Allah's right on his slaves is that they should worship Him and not worship anything besides Him." He then proceeded for a while, and again said, "O Mu`adh bin Jabal!" I replied. "Labbaik, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and Sa`daik." He said, "Do you know what is (Allah's) slaves' (people's) right on Allah if they did that?" I replied, "Allah and His Apostle know better." He said, "The right of (Allah's) slaves on Allah is that He should not punish them (if they did that)
hi: Mu'adh bin Jabal (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab main Nabi (SAW) ke peechhe ek saathi sawaar ke taur par sawaar tha aur mere aur unke beech sirf zeen ki peeth thi, unhone kaha, 'Aye Mu'adh!' Maine jawab diya, 'Labbaik, Aye Allah ke Rasool! Aur Sa'daik!' Wo kuch der aage badhe, phir kaha, 'Aye Mu'adh!' Maine kaha, 'Labbaik aur Sa'daik, Aye Allah ke Rasool!' Wo phir kuch der aur aage badhe aur kaha, 'Aye Mu'adh bin Jabal!' Maine jawab diya, 'Labbaik, Aye Allah ke Rasool, aur Sa'daik!' Unhone kaha, 'Kya tumhein pata hai Allah ka apne bandon par kya haq hai?' Maine jawab diya, 'Allah aur uska Rasool behtar jaante hain.' Unhone kaha, 'Allah ka apne bandon par haq ye hai ke wo sirf uski ibaadat karein aur uske siwa kisi aur ki ibaadat na karein.' Wo phir kuch der aage badhe, aur dobara kaha, 'Aye Mu'adh bin Jabal!' Maine jawab diya, 'Labbaik, Aye Allah ke Rasool, aur Sa'daik.' Unhone kaha, 'Kya tumhein pata hai (Allah ke) bandon (logon) ka Allah par kya haq hai agar wo aisa karein?' Maine jawab diya, 'Allah aur uska Rasool behtar jaante hain.' Unhone kaha, '(Allah ke) bandon ka Allah par haq ye hai ke wo unhein saza nahi dega (agar wo aisa karein).'

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) had a she-camel called Al-`Adba' and it was too fast to surpass in speed. There came a bedouin riding a camel of his, and that camel outstripped it (i.e. Al-Aqba'). That result was hard on the Muslims who said sorrowfully, "Al- Adba has been outstripped." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "It is due from Allah that nothing would be raised high in this world except that He lowers or puts it down
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ke paas ek oontni thi jise Al-Adba kaha jaata tha, aur wo raftaar mein bahut tez thi, koi usse aage nahi nikal sakta tha. Ek badawi apne oont par sawaar hokar aaya, aur us oont ne Al-Adba se aage nikal diya. Ye baat Musalmaanon ke liye mushkil thi aur unhone gam se kaha, 'Al-Adba ko peechhe chhoda gaya (haraa diya gaya)!' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Ye Allah ki taraf se muqarrar hai ke is duniya mein kuch bhi oopar nahi uthaya jaata jise wo neeche na kare ya gira na de.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah said, 'I will declare war against him who shows hostility to a pious worshipper of Mine. And the most beloved things with which My slave comes nearer to Me, is what I have enjoined upon him; and My slave keeps on coming closer to Me through performing Nawafil (praying or doing extra deeds besides what is obligatory) till I love him, so I become his sense of hearing with which he hears, and his sense of sight with which he sees, and his hand with which he grips, and his leg with which he walks; and if he asks Me, I will give him, and if he asks My protection (Refuge), I will protect him; (i.e. give him My Refuge) and I do not hesitate to do anything as I hesitate to take the soul of the believer, for he hates death, and I hate to disappoint him
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah ne farmaaya, "Jo koi Mere kisi neik bande se dushmani rakhega, Main uske khilaaf jang ka elaan karunga. Aur Mera bandaa jis cheez se Mere sabse zyaada qareeb aata hai wo hai jo Maine uspar farz kiya hai; aur Mera bandaa Nafl (Nawafil, jaayez amaal ke ilaawa extra ibaadat) karke Mere aur zyaada qareeb aata rehta hai, yahaan tak ke Main use muhabbat karne lagta hoon, to Main uski sunne ki taaqat ban jaata hoon jisse wo sunta hai, aur uski dekhne ki taaqat jisse wo dekhta hai, aur uska haath jisse wo pakadta hai, aur uski taang jisse wo chalta hai; aur agar wo Mujhse maange, to Main use dunga, aur agar wo Meri panaah maange, to Main use panaah dunga; aur Main kisi bhi kaam ke baare mein utna sochta nahi jitna Momin ki jaan lene mein sochta hoon, kyunke wo maut ko napasand karta hai, aur Mujhe use naaraaz karna napasand hai."'

e: Narrated Sahl:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I have been sent and the Hour (is at hand) as these two," showing his two fingers and sticking (separating) them out
hi: Sahl bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Mujhe (Nabi banaakar) bheja gaya hai, aur Qayamat ka waqt itna hi qareeb hai jitni ye dono (ungliyaan),' apni do ungliyaan dikhaate hue aur unhein alag karte hue.

e: Narrated Anas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I have been sent and the Hour (is at hand) as these two (fingers)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Mujhe (Nabi banaakar) bheja gaya hai, aur Qayamat ka waqt itna hi qareeb hai jitni ye dono (ungliyaan).'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I have been sent and the Hour (is at hand) as these two (fingers)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Mujhe (Nabi banaakar) bheja gaya hai, aur Qayamat ka waqt itna hi qareeb hai jitni ye dono (ungliyaan).'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The Hour will not be established till the sun rises from the west, and when it rises (from the west) and the people see it, then all of them will believe (in Allah). But that will be the time when 'No good it will do to a soul to believe then. If it believed not before.."' (6.158) The Hour will be established (so suddenly) that two persons spreading a garment between them will not be able to finish their bargain, nor will they be able to fold it up. The Hour will be established while a man is carrying the milk of his she-camel, but cannot drink it; and the Hour will be established when someone is not able to prepare the tank to water his livestock from it; and the Hour will be established when some of you has raised his food to his mouth but cannot eat it
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Qayamat tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak suraj Paschim se nahi nikalega, aur jab wo (Paschim se) nikalega aur log use dekhenge, to sab log Iman le aayenge (Allah par), magar wo waqt aisa hoga jab "kisi jaan ka Iman laana usse kuch faayda nahi dega agar wo pehle Iman nahi laayi thi" (6:158). Qayamat (itni achaanak) aayegi ke do log jo aapas mein kapda phaila rahe honge, wo apni khareed-farokht poori nahi kar payenge, na hi use samet paayenge. Qayamat tab aayegi jab ek aadmi apni oontni ka doodh lekar chal raha hoga, magar wo use pi nahi payega; aur Qayamat tab aayegi jab koi apna hauz apne maweshiyon ko paani pilaane ke liye taiyaar nahi kar paayega; aur Qayamat tab aayegi jab tum mein se kisi ne apna khaana apne munh tak uthaaya ho magar wo use khaa nahi paayega.'

e: Narrated 'Ubada bin As-Samit:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Who-ever loves to meet Allah, Allah (too) loves to meet him and who-ever hates to meet Allah, Allah (too) hates to meet him". `Aisha, or some of the wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "But we dislike death." He said: It is not like this, but it is meant that when the time of the death of a believer approaches, he receives the good news of Allah's pleasure with him and His blessings upon him, and so at that time nothing is dearer to him than what is in front of him. He therefore loves the meeting with Allah, and Allah (too) loves the meeting with him. But when the time of the death of a disbeliever approaches, he receives the evil news of Allah's torment and His Requital, whereupon nothing is more hateful to him than what is before him. Therefore, he hates the meeting with Allah, and Allah too, hates the meeting with him
hi: Ubada bin As-Samit bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi Allah se milna pasand karta hai, Allah bhi usse milna pasand karta hai, aur jo koi Allah se milna napasand karta hai, Allah bhi usse milna napasand karta hai.' Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا), ya Nabi ki kisi aur biwi ne kaha, 'Magar humein maut napasand hai.' Unhone kaha, 'Aisi baat nahi hai, balke iska matlab ye hai ke jab Momin ki maut ka waqt nazdeek aata hai, use Allah ki khushi aur uski barkaton ki khush-khabri di jaati hai, isliye us waqt use apne saamne jo hai usse zyaada aziz koi cheez nahi lagti. Isliye wo Allah se milna pasand karta hai, aur Allah bhi usse milna pasand karta hai. Magar jab kaafir ki maut ka waqt nazdeek aata hai, use Allah ke azaab aur uski saza ki buri khabar di jaati hai, isliye use apne saamne jo hai usse zyaada napasandidaa koi cheez nahi lagti. Isliye wo Allah se milna napasand karta hai, aur Allah bhi usse milna napasand karta hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Whoever loves to meet Allah, Allah loves to meet him; and whoever hates to meet Allah, Allah hates to meet him
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi Allah se milna pasand karta hai, Allah bhi usse milna pasand karta hai; aur jo koi Allah se milna napasand karta hai, Allah bhi usse milna napasand karta hai.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was in good health, he used to say, "No prophet's soul is ever captured unless he is shown his place in Paradise and given the option (to die or survive)." So when the death of the Prophet (ﷺ) approached and his head was on my thigh, he became unconscious for a while and then he came to his senses and fixed his eyes on the ceiling and said, "O Allah (with) the highest companions." (See Qur'an 4:69). I said' "Hence he is not going to choose us." And I came to know that it was the application of the narration which he (the Prophet) used to narrate to us. And that was the last statement of the Prophet (before his death) i.e., "O Allah! With the highest companions." (See Qur'an 4:)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki zawja) bataati hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) sehatmand the, wo kehte, 'Koi bhi Nabi tab tak nahi marta jab tak use Jannat mein uski jagah na dikhaayi jaaye, aur use ikhtiyaar na diya jaaye (jeene ya marne ka).' To jab Nabi (SAW) ki wafat nazdeek aayi aur unka sar meri jaangh par tha, wo kuch der ke liye behosh ho gaye, phir hosh mein aaye aur apni nazrein chhat par gaad di aur kaha, 'Aye Allah! Sabse Uche Saathiyon (ke saath).' (Quran 4:69 dekhein). Maine kaha, 'To wo humein nahi chunte.' Aur mujhe pata chal gaya ke ye wahi riwaayat thi jo wo humein bataaya karte the. Aur ye Nabi (SAW) ka aakhri jumla tha (unki wafat se pehle), yaani 'Aye Allah! Sabse Uche Saathiyon (ke saath).'

e: Narrated `Aisha:There was a leather or wood container full of water in front of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (at the time of his death). He would put his hand into the water and rub his face with it, saying, "None has the right to be worshipped but Allah! No doubt, death has its stupors." Then he raised his hand and started saying, "(O Allah!) with the highest companions." (See Qur'an 4:69) (and kept on saying it) till he expired and his hand dropped
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saamne (unki wafat ke waqt) chamde ya lakdi ka ek bartan paani se bhara hua tha. Wo apna haath paani mein daalte aur apne chehre par malte, kehte hue, 'Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi! Beshak, maut ki apni sakhtiyaan hain.' Phir unhone apna haath uthaaya aur kehna shuru kiya, '(Aye Allah!) Sabse Uche Saathiyon (ke saath)' (Quran 4:69 dekhein), (aur ye kehte rahe) yahaan tak ke unka intekaal ho gaya aur unka haath gir gaya.

e: Narrated `Aisha:Some rough bedouins used to visit the Prophet (ﷺ) and ask him, "When will the Hour be?" He would look at the youngest of all of them and say, "If this should live till he is very old, your Hour (the death of the people addressed) will take place." Hisham said that he meant (by the Hour), their death
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Kuch registaani badawi Nabi (SAW) se milne aate aur unse pucha karte, 'Qayamat kab aayegi?' Wo unmein se sabse chhote (bacche) ki taraf dekhte aur kehte, 'Agar ye bahut boodha hone tak zinda raha, to tumhaari Qayamat (yaani jinse ye baat kahi jaa rahi hai, unki maut) aa jaayegi.' Hisham kehte hain ke unka matlab (Qayamat se) unki maut se tha.

e: Narrated Abu Qatada bin Rib'i Al-Ansari:A funeral procession passed by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who said, "Relieved or relieving?" The people asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What is relieved and relieving?" He said, "A believer is relieved (by death) from the troubles and hardships of the world and leaves for the Mercy of Allah, while (the death of) a wicked person relieves the people, the land, the trees, (and) the animals from him
hi: Abu Qatada (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Rib'i Al-Ansari bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas se ek janaaze ka jaloos guzra, aur unhone kaha, 'Raahat pa gaya, ya (doosron ko) raahat de gaya?' Logon ne pucha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Raahat pana aur raahat dena kya hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Ek Momin (maut se) is duniya ki takleefon aur museebaton se raahat pa jaata hai aur Allah ki Rehmat ki taraf chala jaata hai, jabke (ek) badkaar shaks (ki maut se) log, zameen, darakht, (aur) jaanwar usse raahat paate hain.'

e: Narrated Abu Qatada:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Relieved or relieving. And a believer is relieved (by death)
hi: Abu Qatada (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Raahat pana ya raahat dena. Aur ek Momin (maut se) raahat pa jaata hai.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When carried to his grave, a dead person is followed by three, two of which return (after his burial) and one remains with him: his relative, his property, and his deeds follow him; relatives and his property go back while his deeds remain with him
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab kisi murda ko uski qabar tak le jaaya jaata hai, uske saath teen cheezein jaati hain, jinmein se do wapas laut aati hain (uski tadfeen ke baad) aur ek uske saath rehti hai: uska rishtedaar, uski jaayadaad, aur uske amaal uske saath jaate hain; rishtedaar aur uski jaayadaad wapas laut aate hain jabke uske amaal uske saath rehte hain.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When anyone of you dies, his destination is displayed before him in the forenoon and in the afternoon, either in the (Hell) Fire or in Paradise, and it is said to him, "That is your place till you are resurrected and sent to it
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab tum mein se koi marta hai, uski manzil (jagah) uske saamne subah aur shaam pesh ki jaati hai, ya to (Jahannam ki) Aag mein ya Jannat mein, aur usse kaha jaata hai, "Ye tumhaari jagah hai jab tak tum wapas uthaaye jaakar wahaan na bheje jao."'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not abuse the dead, for they have reached the result of what they have done
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Murdon ko bura-bhala mat kaho, kyunke wo apne amaal ka natija paa chuke hain.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Two men, a Muslim and a Jew, abused each other. The Muslim said, "By Him Who gave superiority to Muhammad over all the people." On that, the Jew said, "By Him Who gave superiority to Moses over all the people." The Muslim became furious at that and slapped the Jew in the face. The Jew went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and informed him of what had happened between him and the Muslim. Allah's Apostle said, "Don't give me superiority over Moses, for the people will fall unconscious on the Day of Resurrection and I will be the first to gain consciousness, and behold ! Moses will be there holding the side of Allah's Throne. I will not know whether Moses has been among those people who have become unconscious and then has regained consciousness before me, or has been among those exempted by Allah from falling unconscious
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Do aadmi, ek Musalmaan aur ek Yahudi, ek doosre ko bura-bhala kehne lage. Musalmaan ne kaha, 'Us Zaat ki qasam jisne Muhammad ko sab logon par oonchaai di.' Isper Yahudi ne kaha, 'Us Zaat ki qasam jisne Musa ko sab logon par oonchaai di.' Musalmaan isper bahut gussa hua aur usne Yahudi ke chehre par taap-thok maara. Yahudi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaya aur unhein bataaya ke uske aur Musalmaan ke beech kya hua. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Mujhe Musa se oonchaai mat do, kyunke Qayamat ke din log behosh ho jaayenge, aur main sabse pehle hosh mein aaunga, aur dekho! Musa Allah ke Arsh ke ek konay ko pakde hue waheen honge. Mujhe nahi pata Musa un logon mein the jo behosh hue aur phir mujhse pehle hosh mein aaye, ya un logon mein the jinhein Allah ne behosh hone se azaad kar diya.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The people will fall down unconscious at the time when they should fall down (i.e., on the Day of Resurrection), and then I will be the first man to get up, and behold, Moses will be there holding (Allah's) Throne. I will not know whether he has been amongst those who have fallen unconscious
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Log us waqt behosh ho jaayenge jab unhein hona chaahiye (yaani Qayamat ke din), aur phir main sabse pehle uthne wala aadmi hunga, aur dekho, Musa Allah ke Arsh ko pakde hue waheen honge. Mujhe nahi pata ke wo un logon mein the jo behosh hue.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah will take the whole earth (in His Hand) and will roll up the Heaven in His right Hand, and then He will say, "I am King! Where are the kings of the earth ?
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah poori zameen ko (apne haath mein) lega aur aasman ko apne daaen haath mein lapetega, aur phir kahega, "Main Baadshah hoon! Zameen ke baadshah kahaan hain?"'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The (planet of) earth will be a bread on the Day of Resurrection, and The resistible (Allah) will topple turn it with His Hand like anyone of you topple turns a bread with his hands while (preparing the bread) for a journey, and that bread will be the entertainment for the people of Paradise." A man from the Jews came (to the Prophet) and said, "May The Beneficent (Allah) bless you, O Abul Qasim! Shall I tell you of the entertainment of the people of Paradise on the Day of Resurrection?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Yes." The Jew said, "The earth will be a bread," as the Prophet (ﷺ) had said. Thereupon the Prophet (ﷺ) looked at us and smiled till his premolar tooth became visible. Then the Jew further said, "Shall I tell you of the udm (additional food taken with bread) they will have with the bread?" He added, "That will be Balam and Nun." The people asked, "What is that?" He said, "It is an ox and a fish, and seventy thousand people will eat of the caudate lobe (i.e. extra lobe) of their livers
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Zameen Qayamat ke din ek roti hogi, aur Qaadir (Allah) use apne haath se aise ulteega jaise tum mein se koi safar ke liye roti taiyaar karte waqt use ulaTta hai, aur wo roti Jannat waalon ki mehmaan-nawaazi hogi.' Yahudiyon mein se ek shaks aaya aur kaha, 'Allah tumhein barkat de, Aye Abul-Qasim! Kya main aapko Qayamat ke din Jannat waalon ki mehmaan-nawaazi ke baare mein na bataun?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Haan.' Yahudi ne kaha, 'Zameen ek roti hogi,' jaisa Nabi (SAW) ne kaha tha. Isper Nabi (SAW) ne hamari taraf dekha aur muskuraaye yahaan tak ke unka daadh nazar aaya. Phir Yahudi ne aage kaha, 'Kya main aapko wo saalan (extra khaana roti ke saath) bataun jo unhein roti ke saath milega?' Usne izaafa kiya, 'Wo Balam aur Nun hoga.' Logon ne pucha, 'Wo kya hai?' Usne kaha, 'Ye ek bail aur ek machhli hai, aur sattar hazaar log unke jigar ke extra hisse (lobe) se khaayenge.'

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "The people will be gathered on the Day of Resurrection on reddish white land like a pure loaf of bread (made of pure fine flour)." Sahl added: That land will have no landmarks for anybody (to make use of)
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Log Qayamat ke din laalimayel-safed zameen par jama honge jaise ek shudh (aata) roti ho.' Sahl ne izaafa kiya: Us zameen par kisi ke liye koi nishaan (landmark) nahi hoga.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The people will be gathered in three ways: (The first way will be of) those who will wish or have a hope (for Paradise) and will have a fear (of punishment), (The second batch will be those who will gather) riding two on a camel or three on a camel or ten on a camel. (The third batch) the rest of the people will be urged to gather by the Fire which will accompany them at the time of their afternoon nap and stay with them where they will spend the night, and will be with them in the morning wherever they may be then, and will be with them in the afternoon wherever they may be then
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Log teen tareekon se jama kiye jaayenge: (Pehla giroh) wo jo ummeed rakhte hain (Jannat ki) aur dar rakhte hain (azaab ka), (Doosra giroh wo jo jama honge) ek oont par do ya teen sawaar, ya das sawaar. (Teesra giroh) baaki log Aag ke zariye jama hone ke liye majboor kiye jaayenge jo unke dophar ki neend ke waqt unke saath rahegi aur wahaan unke saath rahegi jahaan wo raat guzaarenge, aur unke saath subah unhein jahaan bhi hon rahegi, aur unke saath dophar unhein jahaan bhi hon rahegi.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:A man said, "O Allah's Prophet! Will a Kafir (disbeliever) be gathered (driven prone) on his face?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Is not He Who made him walk with his legs in this world, able to make him walk on his face on the Day of Resurrection?" (Qatada, a sub-narrator said: Yes, (He can), by the Power of Our Lord
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks ne pucha, 'Aye Allah ke Nabi! Kya ek kaafir apne chehre ke bal (girate hue) jama kiya jaayega?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Kya wo (Allah), jisne use is duniya mein apni taangon se chalne diya, use Qayamat ke din apne chehre par chalaane ke laayak nahi?' (Ravi Qatada kehte hain: 'Haan, (Wo kar sakta hai), hamare Rab ki qudrat se.')

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You will meet Allah barefooted, naked, walking on feet, and uncircumcised
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Tum Allah se milogey nange pair, nange badan, apne pairon par chalte hue, aur bina khatna kiye hue.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while he was delivering a sermon on a pulpit, saying, "You will meet Allah barefooted, naked, and uncircumcised
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko mimbar par khutba dete hue ye kehte suna, 'Tum Allah se milogey nange pair, nange badan, aur bina khatna kiye hue.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) stood up among us and addressed (saying) "You will be gathered, barefooted, naked, and uncircumcised (as Allah says): 'As We began the first creation, We shall repeat it..' (21.104) And the first human being to be dressed on the Day of Resurrection will be (the Prophet) Abraham Al-Khalil. Then will be brought some men of my followers who will be taken towards the left (i.e., to the Fire), and I will say: 'O Lord! My companions whereupon Allah will say: You do not know what they did after you left them. I will then say as the pious slave, Jesus said, And I was witness over them while I dwelt amongst them..........(up to) ...the All-Wise.' (5.117-118). The narrator added: Then it will be said that those people (relegated from Islam, that is) kept on turning on their heels (deserted Islam)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) hamare beech khade hue aur khitaab kiya (kehte hue), 'Tum jama kiye jaaoge, nange pair, nange badan, aur bina khatna kiye hue (jaisa Allah farmaata hai): "Jaisa humne pehli baar takhleeq shuru ki thi, waise hi hum ise dohraayenge..." (21:104) Aur Qayamat ke din sabse pehle kapde pehnaaya jaane wala insaan Ibrahim Al-Khalil honge. Phir mere maanne walon mein se kuch aadmi laaye jaayenge jinhein baayi taraf (yaani Jahannam ki taraf) le jaaya jaayega, aur main kahunga, "Aye Rab! Mere saathi." Isper Allah kahega, "Tumhein nahi pata unhone tumhaare jaane ke baad kya kiya." Phir main aisa hi kahunga jaisa neik bandaa Isa (Jesus) ne kaha, "Aur main unpar gawaah tha jab tak main unke beech raha......." (Aayat ke aakhir tak) "...Hikmat waala." (5:117-118).' Ravi ne izaafa kiya: Phir kaha jaayega ke wo log (jo Islam se hate huye the) apni edi par ghoomte rahe (yaani Islam chhod diya).

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The people will be gathered barefooted, naked, and uncircumcised." I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Will the men and the women look at each other?" He said, "The situation will be too hard for them to pay attention to that
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Log nange pair, nange badan, aur bina khatna kiye hue jama kiye jaayenge.' Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya mard aur auraten ek doosre ko dekhenge?' Unhone kaha, 'Us waqt haalat itni sakht hogi ke unhein isper dhyaan dene ki fursat nahi hogi.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:While we were in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) in a tent he said, ''Would it please you to be one fourth of the people of Paradise?" We said, "Yes." He said, "Would It please you to be one-third of the people of Paradise?" We said, "Yes." He said, "Would it please you to be half of the people of Paradise?" We said, "Yes." Thereupon he said, "I hope that you will be one half of the people of Paradise, for none will enter Paradise but a Muslim soul, and you people, in comparison to the people who associate others in worship with Allah, are like a white hair on the skin of a black ox, or a black hair on the skin of a red ox
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab hum Nabi (SAW) ki sohbat mein ek khaime mein the, unhone kaha, 'Kya tumhein khushi hogi agar tum Jannat waalon ka ek-chauthai hisso?' Humne kaha, 'Haan.' Unhone kaha, 'Kya tumhein khushi hogi agar tum Jannat waalon ka ek-tihaai hisso?' Humne kaha, 'Haan.' Unhone kaha, 'Kya tumhein khushi hogi agar tum Jannat waalon ka aadha hisso?' Humne kaha, 'Haan.' Isper unhone kaha, 'Mujhe ummeed hai tum Jannat waalon ka aadha hissa hoge, kyunke Jannat mein koi bhi Musalmaan jaan ke siwa daakhil nahi hoga, aur tum log, un logon ke muqaable mein jo Allah ke saath doosron ko shareek karte hain (mushrik), aise ho jaise kaale bail ki khaal par ek safed baal, ya laal bail ki khaal par ek kaala baal.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The first man to be called on the Day of Resurrection will be Adam who will be shown his offspring, and it will be said to them, 'This is your father, Adam.' Adam will say (responding to the call), 'Labbaik and Sa`daik' Then Allah will say (to Adam), 'Take out of your offspring, the people of Hell.' Adam will say, 'O Lord, how many should I take out?' Allah will say, 'Take out ninety-nine out of every hundred." They (the Prophet's companions) said, "O Allah's Apostle! If ninety-nine out of every one hundred of us are taken away, what will remain out of us?" He said, "My followers in comparison to the other nations are like a white hair on a black ox
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Qayamat ke din pukaare jaane wale pehle insaan Aadam honge, jinhein unki aulaad dikhaayi jaayegi, aur unse kaha jaayega, "Ye tumhaara baap Aadam hai." Aadam (pukaar ka jawab dete hue) kahenge, "Labbaik wa Sa'daik." Phir Allah (Aadam se) kahega, "Apni aulaad mein se Jahannam waalon ko nikaalo." Aadam kahenge, "Aye Rab, main kitne nikaalun?" Allah kahega, "Har sau mein se ninety-nine nikaalo."' Unhone (Nabi ke sahaaba ne) kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Nabi! Agar hum mein se har sau mein se ninety-nine ko nikaal liya jaaye, to hum mein se kya bachega?' Unhone kaha, 'Mere maanne wale doosri ummaton ke muqaable mein aise hain jaise kaale bail par ek safed baal.'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah will say, 'O Adam!. Adam will reply, 'Labbaik and Sa`daik (I respond to Your Calls, I am obedient to Your orders), wal Khair fi Yadaik (and all the good is in Your Hands)!' Then Allah will say (to Adam), Bring out the people of the Fire.' Adam will say, 'What (how many) are the people of the Fire?' Allah will say, 'Out of every thousand (take out) nine hundred and ninety-nine (persons).' At that time children will become hoary-headed and every pregnant female will drop her load (have an abortion) and you will see the people as if they were drunk, yet not drunk; But Allah's punishment will be very severe." That news distressed the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) too much, and they said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Who amongst us will be that man (the lucky one out of one-thousand who will be saved from the Fire)?" He said, "Have the good news that one-thousand will be from Gog and Magog, and the one (to be saved will be) from you." The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "By Him in Whose Hand my soul is, I Hope that you (Muslims) will be one third of the people of Paradise." On that, we glorified and praised Allah and said, "Allahu Akbar." The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "By Him in Whose Hand my soul is, I hope that you will be one half of the people of Paradise, as your (Muslims) example in comparison to the other people (non-Muslims), is like that of a white hair on the skin of a black ox, or a round hairless spot on the foreleg of a donkey
hi: Abu Saeed bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah kahega, "Aye Aadam!" Aadam jawab denge, "Labbaik wa Sa'daik (Main tere pukaar ka jawab deta hoon, main tere hukmon ka farmaanbardaar hoon), Wal-Khair fi Yadaik (aur saari achhaai tere haathon mein hai)!" Phir Allah (Aadam se) kahega, "Jahannam waalon ko nikaalo." Aadam kahenge, "Jahannam waale kitne hain (kya matra)?" Allah kahega, "Har ek hazaar mein se (nikaalo) nau sau nintanave (999)." Us waqt bachche budhe ho jaayenge aur har hamila khaatoon ka garbh gir jaayega, aur tum logon ko dekhoge jaise wo nashe mein hon, magar wo nashe mein nahi honge; magar Allah ka azaab bahut sakht hoga.' Ye khabar Nabi (SAW) ke sahaaba ke liye bahut takleefdeh thi, aur unhone kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Hum mein se wo (khush-naseeb) aadmi kaun hoga (jo Aag se bachaaya jaayega)?' Unhone kaha, 'Khush-khabri lo ke ek hazaar Yajooj-Majooj mein se honge, aur ek (jo bachega) tum mein se hoga.' Nabi (SAW) ne izaafa kiya, 'Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, mujhe ummeed hai ke tum (Musalmaan) Jannat waalon ka ek-tihaai hoge.' Isper humne Allah ki tasbeeh aur hamd ki aur kaha, 'Allahu Akbar.' Nabi (SAW) ne phir kaha, 'Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, mujhe ummeed hai ke tum Jannat waalon ka aadha hoge, kyunke tumhaari (Musalmaanon ki) misaal doosron (gair-Musalmaanon) ke muqaable mein aisi hai jaise kaale bail ki khaal par ek safed baal, ya gadhe ki agli taang par ek gol, baal-rahit dhabba.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said (regarding the Verse), "A Day when all mankind will stand before the Lord of the Worlds,' (that day) they will stand, drowned in their sweat up to the middle of their ears
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne (is Aayat ke baare mein) farmaya, '"Us din jab saari insaaniyat sab jahaanon ke Rab ke saamne khadi hogi" (uss din) log apne pasine mein doobe hue, apne kaanon ke beech tak, khade honge.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The people will sweat so profusely on the Day of Resurrection that their sweat will sink seventy cubits deep into the earth, and it will rise up till it reaches the people's mouths and ears
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Log Qayamat ke din itna pasina bahayenge ke unka pasina zameen mein sattar haath (taqreeban 35 meter) gehra doob jaayega, aur wo oopar utheega yahaan tak ke logon ke munh aur kaanon tak pahunch jaayega.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The cases which will be decided first (on the Day of Resurrection) will be the cases of blood-shedding
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Sabse pehle jo maamle faisla kiye jaayenge (Qayamat ke din) wo khoon-khaarabi ke maamle honge.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever has wronged his brother, should ask for his pardon (before his death), as (in the Hereafter) there will be neither a Dinar nor a Dirham. (He should secure pardon in this life) before some of his good deeds are taken and paid to his brother, or, if he has done no good deeds, some of the bad deeds of his brother are taken to be loaded on him (in the Hereafter)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jisne bhi apne bhai par zulm kiya ho, use uski maafi maang leni chaahiye (apni maut se pehle), kyunke (Aakhirat mein) na koi Dinar hoga na Dirham. (Use is duniya mein hi maafi le leni chaahiye) isse pehle ke uske kuch nek amaal liye jaayein aur uske bhai ko diye jaayein, ya, agar usne koi nek amaal nahi kiye, to uske bhai ke kuch bure amaal liye jaayein aur uspar laad diye jaayein (Aakhirat mein).'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The believers, after being saved from the (Hell) Fire, will be stopped at a bridge between Paradise and Hell and mutual retaliation will be established among them regarding wrongs they have committed in the world against one another. After they are cleansed and purified (through the retaliation), they will be admitted into Paradise; and by Him in Whose Hand Muhammad's soul is, everyone of them will know his dwelling in Paradise better than he knew his dwelling in this world
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Momineen, (Jahannam ki) Aag se bacha liye jaane ke baad, Jannat aur Jahannam ke beech ek pul par rokey jaayenge, aur unke beech aapas mein badla liya jaayega un galtiyon ke liye jo unhone is duniya mein ek doosre ke khilaaf ki thin. Jab wo saaf ho jaayenge (badle ke zariye), unhein Jannat mein daakhil kiya jaayega; aur us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein Muhammad ki jaan hai, unmein se har koi Jannat mein apni jagah is duniya mein apni jagah se zyaada achhi tarah jaanega.'

e: Narrated Ibn Abi Mulaika:`Aisha said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Anybody whose account (record) is questioned will surely be punished.' I said, 'Doesn't Allah say: 'He surely will receive an easy reckoning?' (84.8) The Prophet (ﷺ) replied. 'This means only the presentation of the account."' Narrated `Aisha: The Prophet (ﷺ) said (as above)
hi: Ibn Abi Mulaika bataate hain: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha, 'Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, "Jiska bhi hisaab (record) poocha jaayega, use zaroor saza milegi." Maine kaha, "Kya Allah nahi farmaata: 'Use zaroor aasaan hisaab milega' (84:8)?" Nabi (SAW) ne jawab diya, "Iska matlab sirf hisaab pesh karna hai."' Aisha ne (yahi baat) riwaayat ki.

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), said, "None will be called to account on the Day of Resurrection, but will be ruined." I said "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Hasn't Allah said: 'Then as for him who will be given his record in his right hand, he surely will receive an easy reckoning? (84.7-8) -- Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "That (Verse) means only the presentation of the accounts, but anybody whose account (record) is questioned on the Day of Resurrection, will surely be punished
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Koi bhi Qayamat ke din hisaab liye jaane par barbaad ho jaayega.' Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya Allah ne nahi farmaaya: "Phir jise uska record uske daaen haath mein diya jaayega, use zaroor aasaan hisaab milega" (84:7-8)?' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Us (Aayat) ka matlab sirf hisaab pesh karna hai, magar jiska bhi Qayamat ke din hisaab poocha jaayega, use zaroor saza milegi.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Prophet used to say, "A disbeliever will be brought on the Day of Resurrection and will be asked. "Suppose you had as much gold as to fill the earth, would you offer it to ransom yourself?" He will reply, "Yes." Then it will be said to him, "You were asked for something easier than that (to join none in worship with Allah (i.e. to accept Islam, but you refused)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Nabi (SAW) kaha karte the, 'Qayamat ke din ek kaafir laaya jaayega aur usse pucha jaayega, "Agar tere paas zameen bhar sona hota, kya tu khud ko chhudaane ke liye use pesh karta?" Wo jawab dega, "Haan." Isper usse kaha jaayega, "Tujhse usse aasaan cheez maangi gayi thi (yaani Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek na karna, yaani Islam qubool karna, magar tune inkaar kiya)."'

e: Narrated `Adi bin Hatim:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There will be none among you but will be talked to by Allah on the Day of Resurrection, without there being an interpreter between him and Him (Allah) . He will look and see nothing ahead of him, and then he will look (again for the second time) in front of him, and the (Hell) Fire will confront him. So, whoever among you can save himself from the Fire, should do so even with one half of a date (to give in charity)
hi: Adi bin Hatim (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Tum mein se koi bhi aisa nahi hoga jisse Allah Qayamat ke din baat nahi karega, bina kisi tarjumaan (dubhaashiye) ke uske aur Allah ke beech. Wo dekhega aur apne aage kuch nahi paayega, phir wo (dobara) apne saamne dekhega, aur (Jahannam ki) Aag uske saamne aa jaayegi. Isliye tum mein se jo bhi khud ko Aag se bacha sake, use aisa karna chaahiye, chaahe wo ek khajoor ke aadhe tukde (ka sadqa) hi de kar ho.'

e: Narrated `Adi bin Hatim:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Protect yourself from the Fire." He then turned his face aside (as if he were looking at it) and said again, "Protect yourself from the Fire," and then turned his face aside (as if he were looking at it), and he said so for the third time till we thought he was looking at it. He then said, "Protect yourselves from the Fire, even if with one half of a date and he who hasn't got even this, (should do so) by (saying) a good, pleasant word
hi: Adi bin Hatim (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Apne aap ko Aag se bachaao.' Phir unhone apna chehra ek taraf mod liya (jaise wo use dekh rahe hon) aur dobara kaha, 'Apne aap ko Aag se bachaao,' aur phir apna chehra ek taraf mod liya (jaise wo use dekh rahe hon), aur unhone ye teesri baar bhi kaha yahaan tak ke humein laga wo waaqai use dekh rahe hain. Phir unhone kaha, 'Apne aap ko Aag se bachaao, chaahe khajoor ke aadhe tukde se hi ho, aur jiske paas ye bhi na ho, wo ek achhi, khushnuma baat kehkar (bachaaye).'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The people were displayed in front of me and I saw one prophet passing by with a large group of his followers, and another prophet passing by with only a small group of people, and another prophet passing by with only ten (persons), and another prophet passing by with only five (persons), and another prophet passed by alone. And then I looked and saw a large multitude of people, so I asked Gabriel, "Are these people my followers?' He said, 'No, but look towards the horizon.' I looked and saw a very large multitude of people. Gabriel said. 'Those are your followers, and those are seventy thousand (persons) in front of them who will neither have any reckoning of their accounts nor will receive any punishment.' I asked, 'Why?' He said, 'For they used not to treat themselves with branding (cauterization) nor with Ruqya (get oneself treated by the recitation of some Verses of the Qur'an) and not to see evil omen in things, and they used to put their trust (only) in their Lord." On hearing that, 'Ukasha bin Mihsan got up and said (to the Prophet), "Invoke Allah to make me one of them." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Allah, make him one of them." Then another man got up and said (to the Prophet), "Invoke Allah to make me one of them." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Ukasha has preceded you
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Logon ko mere saamne pesh kiya gaya aur maine ek Nabi ko dekha jo apne bahut se maanne walon ke saath guzar rahe the, aur doosre Nabi ko sirf kuch logon ke saath guzarte dekha, aur ek aur Nabi ko sirf das (logon) ke saath guzarte dekha, aur ek aur Nabi ko sirf paanch (logon) ke saath guzarte dekha, aur ek Nabi akele guzre. Phir maine dekha aur ek badi bheed dekhi, isliye maine Jibrael se pucha, "Kya ye log mere maanne wale hain?" Unhone kaha, "Nahi, magar ufuq (kshitij) ki taraf dekho." Maine dekha aur ek bahut badi bheed dekhi. Jibrael ne kaha, "Ye tumhaare maanne wale hain, aur unke saamne sattar hazaar (log) hain jinka na koi hisaab hoga na koi saza." Maine pucha, "Kyun?" Unhone kaha, "Kyunke wo khud ko daagh (cauterization) se ilaaj nahi karte the, na Ruqya se (yaani Quran ki kuch Aayaton ke recitation se apna ilaaj karwaate the), na cheezon mein bad-shagun maante the, aur wo sirf apne Rab par bharosa karte the."' Ye sunkar Ukasha bin Mihsan khade hue aur (Nabi se) kaha, 'Allah se dua kijiye ke wo mujhe unmein se banaaye.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Aye Allah, ise unmein se banaa.' Phir ek aur shaks khada hua aur (Nabi se) kaha, 'Allah se dua kijiye ke wo mujhe unmein se banaaye.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Ukasha tumse pehle ye keh chuke.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "From my followers there will enter Paradise a crowd, seventy thousand in number, whose faces will glitter as the moon does when it is full." On hearing that, 'Ukasha bin Mihsan Al-Asdi got up, lifting his covering sheet, and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Invoke Allah that He may make me one of them." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Allah, make him one of them." Another man from the Ansar got up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Invoke Allah to make me one of them. "The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to him), "'Ukasha has preceded you
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Mere maanne walon mein se ek giroh, sattar hazaar ki tadaad mein, Jannat mein daakhil hoga, jinke chehre chaand jaise chamkeele honge jaise wo chaudhvin ka chaand hota hai.' Ye sunkar Ukasha bin Mihsan Al-Asdi apni chaadar utha kar khade hue aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Allah se dua kijiye ke wo mujhe unmein se banaaye.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Aye Allah, ise unmein se banaa.' Ansaar mein se ek aur shaks khada hua aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Allah se dua kijiye ke wo mujhe unmein se banaaye.' Nabi (SAW) ne (unse) kaha, 'Ukasha tumse pehle ye keh chuke.'

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Seventy-thousand or seven-hundred thousand of my followers (the narrator is in doubt as to the correct number) will enter Paradise holding each other till the first and the last of them enter Paradise at the same time, and their faces will have a glitter like that of the moon at night when it is full
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Mere maanne walon mein se sattar-hazaar ya sattar-lakh (ravi ko sahi tadaad mein shak hai) ek doosre ka haath pakde hue Jannat mein daakhil honge, itna ke unmein se pehla aur aakhri ek hi waqt mein Jannat mein daakhil honge, aur unke chehre raat ke chaudhvin ke chaand jaise chamkenge.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet; said, "The people of Paradise will enter Paradise, and the people of the (Hell) Fire will enter the (Hell) Fire: then a call-maker will get up (and make an announcement) among them, 'O the people of the (Hell) Fire! No death anymore ! And O people of Paradise! No death (anymore) but Eternity
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jannat waale Jannat mein daakhil honge, aur (Jahannam ki) Aag waale Aag mein daakhil honge, phir ek elaan karne wala unke beech uthega (aur elaan karega), "Aye Aag waalo! Ab koi maut nahi! Aur Aye Jannat waalo! Ab koi maut nahi, balke hamesha (Eternity)!"'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, " It will be said to the people of Paradise, 'O people of Paradise! Eternity (for you) and no death,' and to the people of the Fire, 'O people of the Fire, eternity (for you) and no death
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jannat waalon se kaha jaayega, "Aye Jannat waalo! (Tumhare liye) Hamesha rehna hai aur koi maut nahi," aur Aag waalon se kaha jaayega, "Aye Aag waalo, (tumhaare liye) Hamesha rehna hai aur koi maut nahi."'

e: Narrated `Imran:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I looked into paradise and saw that the majority of its people were the poor, and I looked into the Fire and found that the majority of its people were women
hi: Imran bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Maine Jannat mein jhaanka aur paaya ke uske zyaadatar log gareeb the, aur maine Aag mein jhaanka aur paaya ke uske zyaadatar log auraten thin.'

e: Narrated Usama:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I stood at the gate of Paradise and saw that the majority of the people who had entered it were poor people, while the rich were forbidden (to enter along with the poor, because they were waiting the reckoning of their accounts), but the people of the Fire had been ordered to be driven to the Fire. And I stood at the gate of the Fire and found that the majority of the people entering it were women
hi: Usama bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Main Jannat ke darwaaze par khada hua aur dekha ke usmein daakhil hone wale zyaadatar log gareeb the, jabke ameeron ko (unke saath daakhil hone se) roka gaya tha (kyunke unka hisaab-kitaab baaki tha), aur (Jahannam ki) Aag waalon ko Aag ki taraf hankaane ka hukm diya gaya tha. Aur main Aag ke darwaaze par khada hua aur paaya ke usmein daakhil hone waale zyaadatar log auraten thin.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When the people of Paradise have entered Paradise and the people of the Fire have entered the Fire, death will be brought and will be placed between the Fire and Paradise, and then it will be slaughtered, and a call will be made (that), 'O people of Paradise, no more death ! O people of the Fire, no more death ! ' So the people of Paradise will have happiness added to their previous happiness, and the people of the Fire will have sorrow added to their previous sorrow
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab Jannat waale Jannat mein daakhil ho jaayenge aur Aag waale Aag mein daakhil ho jaayenge, maut ko laaya jaayega aur Aag aur Jannat ke beech rakha jaayega, phir use zibah kiya jaayega, aur elaan kiya jaayega, "Aye Jannat waalo! Ab koi maut nahi! Aye Aag waalo! Ab koi maut nahi!" To Jannat waalon ki khushi unki pehle ki khushi mein aur badh jaayegi, aur Aag waalon ka gam unke pehle ke gam mein aur badh jaayega.'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah will say to the people of Paradise, 'O the people of Paradise!' They will say, 'Labbaik, O our Lord, and Sa`daik!' Allah will say, 'Are you pleased?" They will say, 'Why should we not be pleased since You have given us what You have not given to anyone of Your creation?' Allah will say, 'I will give you something better than that.' They will reply, 'O our Lord! And what is better than that?' Allah will say, 'I will bestow My pleasure and contentment upon you so that I will never be angry with you after for-ever
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah Jannat waalon se kahega, "Aye Jannat waalo!" Wo kahenge, "Labbaik, Aye hamare Rab, aur Sa'daik!" Allah kahega, "Kya tum khush ho?" Wo kahenge, "Hum khush kyun na hon jabke tune humein wo diya jo tune apni makhlooq mein se kisi ko nahi diya?" Allah kahega, "Main tumhein isse behtar cheez dunga." Wo jawab denge, "Aye hamare Rab! Aur usse behtar kya hai?" Allah kahega, "Main tumpar apni khushi aur santushti naazil karunga, taake main tumse kabhi hamesha ke liye naaraaz na hoon."'

e: Narrated Anas: Haritha was martyred on the day (of the battle) of Badr while he was young. His mother came to the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! You know the relation of Haritha to me (how fond of him I was); so, if he is in Paradise, I will remain patient and wish for Allah's reward, but if he is not there, then you will see what I will do." The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "May Allah be merciful upon you! Have you gone mad? (Do you think) it is one Paradise? There are many Paradises and he is in the (most superior) Paradise of Al-Firdaus
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Haritha jang-e-Badr ke din shaheed hue jabke wo jawaan the. Unki maa Nabi (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Aap jaante hain Haritha ka mujhse kya rishta tha (main unse kitna muhabbat karti thi); isliye, agar wo Jannat mein hain, to main sabra karungi aur Allah ke ajr ki ummeed rakhungi, magar agar wo wahaan nahi hain, to aap dekhenge main kya karti hoon.' Nabi (SAW) ne jawab diya, 'Allah tumpar reham kare! Kya tum paagal ho gayi ho? (Kya tumhein lagta hai) ki ye ek hi Jannat hai? Kayi Jannaten hain, aur wo (sabse ooncha) Firdaus ki Jannat mein hain.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The width between the two shoulders of a Kafir (disbeliever) will be equal to the distance covered by a fast rider in three days
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kaafir ke do kandhon ke beech ki chaudaai itni hogi jitni ek tez sawaar teen din mein tay karta hai.'

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa'd: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "In Paradise there is a tree so big that in its shade a rider may travel for one hundred years without being able to cross it
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jannat mein ek darakht itna bada hai ke uski chhaaon mein ek sawaar sau saal safar kar sakta hai bina use paar kiye.'

e: Narrated Abu Sa'id: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: There is a tree in Paradise (so huge) that a fast (or a trained) rider may travel: for one hundred years without being able to cross it
hi: Abu Saeed bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jannat mein ek darakht hai (itna bada ke) ek tez (ya taalim-yaafta) sawaar sau saal tak safar kar sakta hai bina use paar kiye.'

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Seventy thousand or seven hundred thousand of my followers will enter Paradise. (Abu Hazim, the sub-narrator, is not sure as to which of the two numbers is correct.) They will be holding on to each other, the first will not entering the last one does, their faces like the moon on a full moon night
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Mere maanne walon mein se sattar hazaar ya sattar lakh (ravi Abu Hazim ko sahi tadaad mein shak hai) Jannat mein daakhil honge. Wo ek doosre ka haath thaame honge, pehla tab tak daakhil nahi hoga jab tak aakhri daakhil na ho jaaye, unke chehre chaudhvin raat ki raat ke chaand jaise honge.'

e: Narrated Sahl:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The people of Paradise will see the Ghuraf (special abodes) in Paradise as you see a star in the sky
hi: Sahl bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jannat waale Jannat mein Ghuraf (khaas mahalon) ko waise dekhenge jaise tum aasman mein taare dekhte ho.'

e: Abu Sa`id added:"As you see a glittering star remaining in the eastern horizon and the western horizon
hi: Abu Saeed ne izaafa kiya: 'Jaise tum ek chamakta hua taara Poorab ke ufuq (kshitij) mein ya Paschim ke ufuq mein dekhte ho.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah will say to the person who will have the minimum punishment in the Fire on the Day of Resurrection, 'If you had things equal to whatever is on the earth, would you ransom yourself (from the punishment) with it?' He will reply, Yes. Allah will say, 'I asked you a much easier thing than this while you were in the backbone of Adam, that is, not to worship others besides Me, but you refused and insisted to worship others besides Me
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah us shaks se kahega jise Qayamat ke din Aag mein sabse kam saza milegi, "Agar tere paas zameen par jo bhi hai wo (sab) hota, kya tu us se apni jaan chhudaane ke liye dega?" Wo jawab dega, "Haan." Allah kahega, "Maine tujhse isse bhi zyaada aasaan cheez maangi thi jab tu Aadam ki peeth mein tha, yaani ye ke Mere siwa doosron ki ibaadat na kare, magar tune inkaar kiya aur Mere siwa doosron ki ibaadat karne par zid ki."'

e: Narrated Hammad from `Amr from Jabir:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Some people will come out of the Fire through intercession looking like The Thaarir." I asked `Amr, "What is the Thaarir?" He said, Ad Dagh`Abis, and at that time he was toothless. Hammad added: I said to `Amr bin Dinar, "O Abu Muhammad! Did you hear Jabir bin `Abdullah saying, 'I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying: 'Some people will come out of the Fire through intercession?" He said, "Yes
hi: Hammad, Amr ke hawaale se, Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) se: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kuch log shifaa'at (sifaarish) ke zariye Aag se nikaale jaayenge, Ath-Thaarir jaise dikhte hue.' Maine Amr se pucha, 'Ath-Thaarir kya hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Ad-Dagh'Abis,' aur us waqt wo (Amr) daant-viheen the. Hammad ne izaafa kiya: Maine Amr bin Dinar se kaha, 'Aye Abu Muhammad! Kya aapne Jabir bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko ye kehte suna, "Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Kuch log shifaa'at ke zariye Aag se nikaale jaayenge"?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Some people will come out of the Fire after they have received a touch of the Fire, changing their color, and they will enter Paradise, and the people of Paradise will name them 'Al- Jahannamiyin' the (Hell) Fire people
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kuch log Aag se nikaale jaayenge Aag ka thoda sa asar unpar ho jaane ke baad, unka rang badal jaayega, aur wo Jannat mein daakhil honge, aur Jannat waale unhein "Al-Jahannamiyin" (Jahannam ke log) kahenge.'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When the people of Paradise have entered Paradise, and the people of the Fire have entered the Fire, Allah will say. 'Take out (of the Fire) whoever has got faith equal to a mustard seed in his heart.' They will come out, and by that time they would have burnt and became like coal, and then they will be thrown into the river of Al-Hayyat (life) and they will spring up just as a seed grows on the bank of a rainwater stream." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Don't you see that the germinating seed comes out yellow and twisted?
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab Jannat waale Jannat mein daakhil ho jaayenge, aur Aag waale Aag mein daakhil ho jaayenge, Allah kahega, "Jiske dil mein sarson ke daane jitna bhi Iman ho, use (Aag se) nikaal do." Wo nikaale jaayenge, aur us waqt tak wo jal chuke honge aur koyle jaise ho chuke honge, phir unhein Al-Hayyat (zindagi) ki nadi mein daala jaayega aur wo aise ubhrenge jaise ek beej baarish ke naale ke kinaare ugta hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Kya tumne nahi dekha ke ugta hua beej peela aur muda hua nikalta hai?'
