e: Narrated An-Nu`man:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "The person who will have the least punishment from amongst the Hell Fire people on the Day of Resurrection, will be a man under whose arch of the feet a smoldering ember will be placed so that his brain will boil because of it
hi: An-Nu'man bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Jise Qayamat ke din Jahannam waalon mein se sabse kam saza milegi, wo ek aisa aadmi hoga jiske paaon ke talwe ke neeche ek dahakta hua angaara rakha jaayega, itna ke uska dimaag isse ubalne lagega.'

e: Narrated An-Nu`man bin Bashir:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "The least punished person of the (Hell) Fire people on the Day of Resurrection will be a man under whose arch of the feet two smoldering embers will be placed, because of which his brain will boil just like Al-Mirjal (copper vessel) or a Qum-qum (narrow-necked vessel) is boiling with water
hi: An-Nu'man bin Bashir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Jahannam waalon mein se sabse kam saza paane wala shaks wo hoga jiske paaon ke talwon ke neeche do dahakte angaare rakhe jaayenge, jinki wajah se uska dimaag Al-Mirjal (taambe ka bartan) ya Qum-qum (patli gardan wale bartan) mein ubaalte paani jaisa ubalega.'

e: Narrated `Adi bin Hatim:The Prophet (ﷺ) mentioned the Fire and turned his face aside and asked for Allah's protection from it, and then again he mentioned the Fire and turned his face aside and asked for Allah's protection from it and said, "Protect yourselves from the Hell-Fire, even if with one half of a date, and he who cannot afford that, then (let him do so) by (saying) a good, pleasant word
hi: Adi bin Hatim (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne Aag ka zikr kiya aur apna chehra doosri taraf mod liya aur usse Allah ki panaah maangi, phir dobara Aag ka zikr kiya aur apna chehra doosri taraf mod liya aur usse Allah ki panaah maangi, aur kaha, 'Apne aap ko Jahannam ki Aag se bachao, chaahe khajoor ke aadhe tukde se hi kyun na ho, aur jo aisa nahi kar sakta, (use aisa karna chaahiye) ek achhi, khushnuma baat kehkar.'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) when his uncle, Abu Talib had been mentioned in his presence, saying, "May be my intercession will help him (Abu Talib) on the Day of Resurrection so that he may be put in a shallow place in the Fire, with fire reaching his ankles and causing his brain to boil
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko, jab unke chacha, Abu Talib, ka zikr unke saamne hua, ye kehte suna, 'Shaayad meri shifaa'at Qayamat ke din unki (Abu Talib ki) madad kare taake unhein Aag ke ek uthle hisse mein rakha jaaye, Aag unke takhnon tak pahunchte hue aur unke dimaag ko ubaalte hue.'

e: Narrated Anas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah will gather all the people on the Day of Resurrection and they will say, 'Let us request someone to intercede for us with our Lord so that He may relieve us from this place of ours.' Then they will go to Adam and say, 'You are the one whom Allah created with His Own Hands, and breathed in you of His soul, and ordered the angels to prostrate to you; so please intercede for us with our Lord.' Adam will reply, 'I am not fit for this undertaking, and will remember his sin, and will say, 'Go to Noah, the first Apostle sent by Allah' They will go to him and he will say, 'I am not fit for this undertaking', and will remember his sin and say, 'Go to Abraham whom Allah took as a Khalil. They will go to him (and request similarly). He will reply, 'I am not fit for this undertaking,' and will remember his sin and say, 'Go to Moses to whom Allah spoke directly.' They will go to Moses and he will say, 'I am not fit for this undertaking,' and will remember his sin and say, 'Go to Jesus.' They will go to him, and he will say, 'I am not fit for this undertaking, go to Muhammad as Allah has forgiven his past and future sins.' They will come to me and I will ask my Lord's permission, and when I see Him, I will fall down in prostration to Him, and He will leave me in that state as long as (He) Allah will, and then I will be addressed. 'Raise up your head (O Muhammad)! Ask, and your request will be granted, and say, and your saying will be listened to; intercede, and your intercession will be accepted.' Then I will raise my head, and I will glorify and praise my Lord with a saying(i.e. invocation) He will teach me, and then I will intercede, Allah will fix a limit for me (i.e., certain type of people for whom I may intercede), and I will take them out of the (Hell) Fire and let them enter Paradise. Then I will come back (to Allah) and fall in prostration, and will do the same for the third and fourth times till no-one remains in the (Hell) Fire except those whom the Qur'an has imprisoned therein." (The sub-narrator, Qatada used to say at that point, "...those upon whom eternity (in Hell) has been imposed.") (See Hadith No. 3, Vol)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah Qayamat ke din sab logon ko jama karega, aur wo kahenge, "Chalo hum kisi se darkhwaast karein ke wo hamare Rab se hamaari sifaarish kare taake wo humein is jagah se raahat de." Phir wo Aadam ke paas jaayenge aur kahenge, "Aap wo hain jinhein Allah ne apne haathon se banaaya, aur apni Rooh unmein phoonki, aur farishton ko aapke saamne sajda karne ka hukm diya; isliye barah-e-meharbaani hamaare Rab se hamaari sifaarish kijiye." Aadam jawab denge, "Main is kaam ke laayak nahi," aur unhein apna gunaah yaad aayega, aur wo kahenge, "Nuh ke paas jaao, Allah ke pehle bheje gaye Rasool." Wo unke paas jaayenge aur wo kahenge, "Main is kaam ke laayak nahi," aur unhein apna gunaah yaad aayega aur wo kahenge, "Ibrahim ke paas jaao jinhein Allah ne apna Khalil (dost) banaaya." Wo unke paas jaayenge (aur isi tarah darkhwaast karenge). Wo jawab denge, "Main is kaam ke laayak nahi," aur unhein apna gunaah yaad aayega aur wo kahenge, "Musa ke paas jaao jinse Allah ne seedhe baat ki." Wo Musa ke paas jaayenge aur wo kahenge, "Main is kaam ke laayak nahi," aur unhein apna gunaah yaad aayega aur wo kahenge, "Isa ke paas jaao." Wo unke paas jaayenge, aur wo kahenge, "Main is kaam ke laayak nahi, Muhammad ke paas jaao kyunke Allah ne unke agle-piche ke sab gunaah maaf kar diye hain." Wo mere paas aayenge aur main apne Rab se ijaazat maangunga, aur jab main unhein dekhoonga, main sajde mein gir jaunga, aur wo mujhe us haalat mein rehne dega jab tak Allah chaahega, phir mujhse kaha jaayega, "Apna sar uthaao (Aye Muhammad)! Maango, aur tumhaari darkhwaast qubool ki jaayegi, aur kaho, aur tumhaari baat suni jaayegi; sifaarish karo, aur tumhaari sifaarish qubool ki jaayegi." Phir main apna sar uthaaunga, aur main apne Rab ki tasbeeh aur tareef karunga ek baat (dua) ke saath jo wo mujhe sikhaayega, phir main sifaarish karunga, Allah mere liye ek hadd muqarrar karega (yaani un logon ki qism jinke liye main sifaarish kar sakoon), aur main unhein (Jahannam ki) Aag se nikaal kar Jannat mein daakhil karunga. Phir main wapas aaunga aur sajde mein girunga, aur teesri aur chauthi baar bhi yahi karunga yahaan tak ke Aag mein sirf wahi log bacheinge jinhein Quran ne wahaan qaid kiya hai.' (Ravi Qatada is jagah kehte the, '...wo log jinpar hamesha ke liye (Jahannam mein) rehna muqarrar kiya gaya hai.') (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 3, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated `Imran bin Husain:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Some people will be taken out of the Fire through the intercession of Muhammad they will enter Paradise and will be called Al-Jahannamiyin (the Hell Fire people)
hi: Imran bin Husain (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kuch log Muhammad ki shifaa'at se Aag se nikaale jaayenge, wo Jannat mein daakhil honge aur unhein "Al-Jahannamiyin" (Jahannam waale) kaha jaayega.'

e: Narrated Anas:Um (the mother of) Haritha came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) after Haritha had been martyred on the Day (of the battle) of Badr by an arrow thrown by an unknown person. She said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! You know the position of Haritha in my heart (i.e. how dear to me he was), so if he is in Paradise, I will not weep for him, or otherwise, you will see what I will do." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Are you mad? Is there only one Paradise? There are many Paradises, and he is in the highest Paradise of Firdaus." The Prophet added, "A forenoon journey or an after noon journey in Allah's Cause is better than the whole world and whatever is in it; and a place equal to an arrow bow of anyone of you, or a place equal to a foot in Paradise is better than the whole world and whatever is in it; and if one of the women of Paradise looked at the earth, she would fill the whole space between them (the earth and the heaven) with light, and would fill whatever is in between them, with perfume, and the veil of her face is better than the whole world and whatever is in it
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Umm (Haritha ki maa) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi jab Haritha jang-e-Badr ke din ek anjaan shaks ke chalaaye hue teer se shaheed ho gaye the. Usne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Aapko pata hai Haritha ka mere dil mein kya darja hai (mujhe unse kitna muhabbat tha), isliye agar wo Jannat mein hain, to main unke liye nahi roungi, warna aap dekhenge main kya karti hoon.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Kya tum paagal ho? Kya sirf ek hi Jannat hai? Bahut si Jannaten hain, aur wo Al-Firdaus ki sabse ooche Jannat mein hain.' Nabi (SAW) ne izaafa kiya, 'Allah ki raah mein subah ka safar ya dophar ka safar poori duniya aur usmein jo kuch hai usse behtar hai; aur tum mein se kisi ki kamaan ke barabar jagah, ya Jannat mein pair rakhne jitni jagah, poori duniya aur usmein jo kuch hai usse behtar hai; aur agar Jannat ki auraton mein se koi zameen ki taraf dekhe, to wo zameen aur aasman ke beech ki poori jagah roshni se bhar degi, aur unke beech jo kuch hai usse khushbu se bhar degi; aur uske chehre ka parda poori duniya aur usmein jo kuch hai usse behtar hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "None will enter Paradise but will be shown the place he would have occupied in the (Hell) Fire if he had rejected faith, so that he may be more thankful; and none will enter the (Hell) Fire but will be shown the place he would have occupied in Paradise if he had faith, so that may be a cause of sorrow for him
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Koi bhi Jannat mein daakhil nahi hoga jise wo jagah na dikhaayi jaaye jo agar usne Iman rad kiya hota to wo Aag mein le leta, taake wo aur zyaada shukr-guzaar ho; aur koi bhi Aag mein daakhil nahi hoga jise wo jagah na dikhaayi jaaye jo agar usne Iman rakha hota to wo Jannat mein le leta, taake ye uske liye gam ki wajah ban jaaye.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Who will be the luckiest person who will gain your intercession on the Day of Resurrection?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Abu Huraira! I have thought that none will ask me about this Hadith before you, as I know your longing for the (learning of) Hadiths. The luckiest person who will have my intercession on the Day of Resurrection will be the one who said, 'None has the right to be worshipped but Allah,' sincerely from the bottom of his heart
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Qayamat ke din aapki shifaa'at (sifaarish) paane wala sabse khush-naseeb shaks kaun hoga?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Aye Abu Huraira! Mujhe laga tumse pehle mujhse koi is hadees ke baare mein nahi poochega, kyunke mujhe pata hai hadeeson (seekhne) ke liye tumhaari betaabi. Qayamat ke din meri shifaa'at paane wala sabse khush-naseeb shaks wo hoga jisne apne dil ki gehraai se khulusi se kaha, "Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi."'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I know the person who will be the last to come out of the (Hell) Fire, and the last to enter Paradise. He will be a man who will come out of the (Hell) Fire crawling, and Allah will say to him, 'Go and enter Paradise.' He will go to it, but he will imagine that it had been filled, and then he will return and say, 'O Lord, I have found it full.' Allah will say, 'Go and enter Paradise, and you will have what equals the world and ten times as much (or, you will have as much as ten times the like of the world).' On that, the man will say, 'Do you mock at me (or laugh at me) though You are the King?" I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (while saying that) smiling that his premolar teeth became visible. It is said that will be the lowest in degree amongst the people of Paradise
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Main us shaks ko jaanta hoon jo sabse aakhri mein (Jahannam ki) Aag se nikalega, aur sabse aakhri mein Jannat mein daakhil hoga. Wo ek aadmi hoga jo Aag se rengte hue nikalega, aur Allah usse kahega, "Jaao aur Jannat mein daakhil ho jao." Wo wahaan jaayega, magar use lagega ke wo bhar chuki hai, phir wo wapas aayega aur kahega, "Aye Rab, maine ise bhari hui paayi." Allah kahega, "Jaao aur Jannat mein daakhil ho jao, aur tumhein poori duniya jitna aur uska das guna milega (ya, tumhein poori duniya jitne das ke barabar milega)." Isper aadmi kahega, "Kya tu mera mazaak udaata hai (ya mujhpar hansta hai) jabke Tu Baadshah hai?" Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko (ye kehte hue) itna muskuraate dekha ke unke damla waale daant zaahir ho gaye. Kaha jaata hai ke ye shaks Jannat waalon mein darje mein sabse neeche hoga.'

e: Narrated `Abbas:that he said to the Prophet (ﷺ) "Did you benefit Abu Talib with anything?
hi: Abbas bataate hain ke unhone Nabi (SAW) se kaha, 'Kya aapne Abu Talib ko kisi cheez se faayda pahunchaya?'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Some people said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shall we see our Lord on the Day of Resurrection?" He said, "Do you crowd and squeeze each other on looking at the sun when it is not hidden by clouds?" They replied, "No, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." He said, "Do you crowd and squeeze each other on looking at the moon when it is full and not hidden by clouds?" They replied, No, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" He said, "So you will see Him (your Lord) on the Day of Resurrection similarly Allah will gather all the people and say, 'Whoever used to worship anything should follow that thing. 'So, he who used to worship the sun, will follow it, and he who used to worship the moon will follow it, and he who used to worship false deities will follow them; and then only this nation (i.e., Muslims) will remain, including their hypocrites. Allah will come to them in a shape other than they know and will say, 'I am your Lord.' They will say, 'We seek refuge with Allah from you. This is our place; (we will not follow you) till our Lord comes to us, and when our Lord comes to us, we will recognize Him. Then Allah will come to then in a shape they know and will say, "I am your Lord.' They will say, '(No doubt) You are our Lord,' and they will follow Him. Then a bridge will be laid over the (Hell) Fire." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) added, "I will be the first to cross it. And the invocation of the Apostles on that Day, will be 'Allahumma Sallim, Sallim (O Allah, save us, save us!),' and over that bridge there will be hooks Similar to the thorns of As Sa'dan (a thorny tree). Didn't you see the thorns of As-Sa'dan?" The companions said, "Yes, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." He added, "So the hooks over that bridge will be like the thorns of As-Sa-dan except that their greatness in size is only known to Allah. These hooks will snatch the people according to their deeds. Some people will be ruined because of their evil deeds, and some will be cut into pieces and fall down in Hell, but will be saved afterwards, when Allah has finished the judgments among His slaves, and intends to take out of the Fire whoever He wishes to take out from among those who used to testify that none had the right to be worshipped but Allah. We will order the angels to take them out and the angels will know them by the mark of the traces of prostration (on their foreheads) for Allah banned the f ire to consume the traces of prostration on the body of Adam's son. So they will take them out, and by then they would have burnt (as coal), and then water, called Ma'ul Hayat (water of life) will be poured on them, and they will spring out like a seed springs out on the bank of a rainwater stream, and there will remain one man who will be facing the (Hell) Fire and will say, 'O Lord! It's (Hell's) vapor has Poisoned and smoked me and its flame has burnt me; please turn my face away from the Fire.' He will keep on invoking Allah till Allah says, 'Perhaps, if I give you what you want), you will ask for another thing?' The man will say, 'No, by Your Power, I will not ask You for anything else.' Then Allah will turn his face away from the Fire. The man will say after that, 'O Lord, bring me near the gate of Paradise.' Allah will say (to him), 'Didn't you promise not to ask for anything else? Woe to you, O son of Adam ! How treacherous you are!' The man will keep on invoking Allah till Allah will say, 'But if I give you that, you may ask me for something else.' The man will say, 'No, by Your Power. I will not ask for anything else.' He will give Allah his covenant and promise not to ask for anything else after that. So Allah will bring him near to the gate of Paradise, and when he sees what is in it, he will remain silent as long as Allah will, and then he will say, 'O Lord! Let me enter Paradise.' Allah will say, 'Didn't you promise that you would not ask Me for anything other than that? Woe to you, O son of Adam ! How treacherous you are!' On that, the man will say, 'O Lord! Do not make me the most wretched of Your creation,' and will keep on invoking Allah till Allah will smile and when Allah will smile because of him, then He will allow him to enter Paradise, and when he will enter Paradise, he will be addressed, 'Wish from so-and-so.' He will wish till all his wishes will be fulfilled, then Allah will say, All this (i.e. what you have wished for) and as much again therewith are for you.' " Abu Huraira added: That man will be the last of the people of Paradise to enter (Paradise)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Kuch logon ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya hum Qayamat ke din apne Rab ko dekhenge?' Unhone kaha, 'Kya tum suraj ko dekhte waqt aapas mein dhakka-mukki karte ho jab wo baadalon se dhaka na ho?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Nahi, Aye Allah ke Rasool.' Unhone kaha, 'Kya tum chaand ko dekhte waqt aapas mein dhakka-mukki karte ho jab wo poora ho aur baadalon se dhaka na ho?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Nahi, Aye Allah ke Rasool!' Unhone kaha, 'To tum use (apne Rab ko) Qayamat ke din isi tarah dekhoge. Allah sab logon ko jama karega aur kahega, "Jo koi kisi cheez ki ibaadat karta tha, use uska peecha karna chaahiye." To jo suraj ki ibaadat karta tha, wo uska peecha karega, aur jo chaand ki ibaadat karta tha, wo uska peecha karega, aur jo jhoothe ma'boodon ki ibaadat karta tha, wo unka peecha karega; aur phir sirf ye ummat (yaani Musalmaan) bachegi, unke munaafiqon samet. Allah unke paas ek aisi soorat mein aayega jise wo nahi pehchaante, aur kahega, "Main tumhaara Rab hoon." Wo kahenge, "Hum tujhse Allah ki panaah maangte hain. Ye hamaari jagah hai; (hum tera peecha nahi karenge) jab tak hamaara Rab hamaare paas na aaye, aur jab hamaara Rab hamaare paas aayega, hum use pehchaan lenge." Phir Allah unke paas ek aisi soorat mein aayega jise wo pehchaante hain, aur kahega, "Main tumhaara Rab hoon." Wo kahenge, "(Beshak) Tu hamaara Rab hai," aur wo uska peecha karenge. Phir Aag par ek pul rakh diya jaayega.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne izaafa kiya, 'Main pehla shaks hounga jo use paar karega. Aur us din Rasoolon ki dua hogi, "Allahumma Sallim, Sallim (Aye Allah, hamein bacha, hamein bacha!)," aur us pul par As-Sa'dan (ek kaante waala darakht) ke kaanton jaise ankushe (hooks) honge. Kya tumne As-Sa'dan ke kaante nahi dekhe?' Sahaaba ne kaha, 'Haan, Aye Allah ke Rasool!' Unhone izaafa kiya, 'To us pul par ke ankushe As-Sa'dan ke kaanton jaise honge, siwaaye is ke ke unke size ki azmat sirf Allah jaanta hai. Ye ankushe logon ko unke amaal ke mutaabik pakadenge. Kuch log apne bure amaal ki wajah se barbaad ho jaayenge, aur kuch tukdon mein kaat diye jaayenge aur Jahannam mein gir jaayenge, magar baad mein bacha liye jaayenge, jab Allah apne bandon ke beech faisla poora kar chuka hoga aur jise chaahega use Aag se nikaalne ka iraada karega un logon mein se jo gawaahi diya karte the ke Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi. Hum farishton ko unhein nikaalne ka hukm denge aur farishte unhein sajde ke nishaanon se pehchaan lenge (unki peshaaniyon par), kyunke Allah ne Aag ko Aadam ke bete ke jism par sajde ke nishaanon ko jalaane se mana kiya hai. To wo unhein nikaalenge, aur is waqt tak wo (koyle jaise) jal chuke honge, phir unpar Ma'ul-Hayat (zindagi ka paani) daala jaayega, aur wo aise ug aayenge jaise ek daana baarish ke naale ke kinaare ugta hai, aur ek aadmi bacha rahega jo Aag ki taraf muh kiye hoga aur kahega, "Aye Rab! Iski (Jahannam ki) bhaap ne mujhe zeher aur dhuaan diya hai aur iski lau ne mujhe jala diya hai; barah-e-meharbaani mera chehra Aag se hataa dijiye." Wo Allah se dua karta rahega yahaan tak ke Allah kahega, "Shaayad, agar main tumhein wo doon jo tum chahte ho, tum kuch aur maangoge?" Aadmi kahega, "Nahi, teri Izzat ki qasam, main tujhse kuch aur nahi maangunga." Phir Allah uska chehra Aag se hata dega. Aadmi uske baad kahega, "Aye Rab, mujhe Jannat ke darwaaze ke qareeb le aa." Allah (usse) kahega, "Kya tumne waada nahi kiya tha ke tum kuch aur nahi maangoge? Afsos hai tumpar, Aye Aadam ke bete! Tum kitne bewafaa ho!" Aadmi Allah se dua karta rahega yahaan tak ke Allah kahega, "Magar agar main tumhein wo doon, to tum mujhse kuch aur maang sakte ho." Aadmi kahega, "Nahi, teri Izzat ki qasam, main kuch aur nahi maangunga." Wo Allah ko apna waada dega ke wo iske baad kuch aur nahi maangega. To Allah use Jannat ke darwaaze ke qareeb le aayega, aur jab wo dekhega usmein kya hai, wo khaamosh rahega jab tak Allah chaahega, phir wo kahega, "Aye Rab! Mujhe Jannat mein daakhil hone de." Allah kahega, "Kya tumne waada nahi kiya tha ke tum mujhse iske ilaawa kuch nahi maangoge? Afsos hai tumpar, Aye Aadam ke bete! Tum kitne bewafaa ho!" Isper aadmi kahega, "Aye Rab! Mujhe apni makhlooq mein sabse zyaada badnaseeb mat bana," aur wo Allah se dua karta rahega yahaan tak ke Allah muskuraayega, aur jab Allah uski wajah se muskuraayega, to wo use Jannat mein daakhil hone dega, aur jab wo Jannat mein daakhil hoga, use kaha jaayega, "Falaan-falaan cheez ki tamanna karo." Wo tamanna karega yahaan tak ke uski sab tamannaayein poori ho jaayengi, phir Allah kahega, "Ye sab (jo tumne tamanna ki) aur isi jitna aur bhi tumhaare liye hai."'" Abu Huraira ne izaafa kiya: Wo aadmi Jannat waalon mein sabse aakhri mein daakhil hone wala hoga.

e: Narrated 'Ata (while Abu Huraira was narrating (see previous hadith)):Abu Sa`id was sitting in the company of Abu Huraira and he did not deny anything of his narration till he reached his saying: "All this and as much again therewith are for you." Then Abu Sa`id said, "I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, 'This is for you and ten times as much.' " Abu Huraira said, "In my memory it is 'as much again therewith
hi: Ata bataate hain (jabke Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) upar wali riwaayat bayaan kar rahe the): Abu Saeed, Abu Huraira ki majlis mein baithe the, aur unhone unki riwaayat mein kuch inkaar nahi kiya yahaan tak ke wo apne is kahne tak pahunche: 'Ye sab aur isi jitna aur bhi tumhaare liye hai.' Phir Abu Saeed ne kaha, 'Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, "Ye tumhaare liye hai aur das guna aur."' Abu Huraira ne kaha, 'Mujhe yaad hai ye "isi jitna aur bhi" tha.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I am your predecessor at the Lake-Fount
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Main Hauz (Lake-Fount) par tumse pehle jaane wala hoon.'

e: Abdullah added:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I am your predecessor at the Lake-Fount, and some of you will be brought in front of me till I will see them and then they will be taken away from me and I will say, 'O Lord, my companions!' It will be said, 'You do not know what they did after you had left
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne izaafa kiya: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Main Hauz par tumse pehle jaane wala hoon, aur tum mein se kuch mere saamne laaye jaayenge yahaan tak ke main unhein dekhoonga, phir unhein mujhse door kar diya jaayega aur main kahoonga, "Aye Rab, mere saathi!" Kaha jaayega, "Tumhein nahi pata unhone tumhaare jaane ke baad kya kiya."'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There will be a tank (Lake-Fount) in front of you as large as the distance between Jarba and Adhruh (two towns in Sham)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Tumhaare saamne ek hauz (Lake-Fount) hoga jitni doori Jarba aur Adhruh (Sham ke do shehron) ke beech hai.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The word 'Al-Kauthar' means the abundant good which Allah gave to him (the Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ)). Abu Bishr said: I said to Sa`id, "Some people claim that it (Al-Kauthar) is a river in Paradise." Sa`id replied, "The river which is in Paradise is one item of that good which Allah has bestowed upon him (Muhammad)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: 'Al-Kauthar' ka matlab hai wafeer bhalaai jo Allah ne unhein (Nabi Muhammad SAW ko) di. Abu Bishr kehte hain: Maine Saeed se kaha, 'Kuch log dawa karte hain ke ye (Al-Kauthar) Jannat mein ek nadi hai.' Saeed ne jawab diya, 'Jannat mein jo nadi hai wo us bhalaai ka ek hissa hai jo Allah ne unhein (Muhammad ko) di hai.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "My Lake-Fount is (so large that it takes) a month's journey to cross it. Its water is whiter than milk, and its smell is nicer than musk (a kind of Perfume), and its drinking cups are (as numerous) as the (number of) stars of the sky; and whoever drinks from it, will never be thirsty
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Mera Hauz (itna bada hai ke) use paar karne mein ek mahine ka safar lagta hai. Iska paani doodh se zyaada safed hai, aur iski khushbu kasturi se zyaada achhi hai; aur iske peene ke pyaale aasman ke sitaaron jitne (bahut se) hain; aur jo koi ismein se piyega, wo kabhi pyaasa nahi hoga.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The width of my Lake-Fount is equal to the distance between Aila (a town in Sham) and Sana' (the capital of Yemen) and it has as many (numerous) jugs as the number of stars of the sky
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Mere Hauz ki chaudai Aila (Sham ke ek shehar) aur Sana (Yemen ki raajdhaani) ke beech ki doori jitni hai, aur isme utne hi (bahut se) jag hain jitne aasman ke sitaare.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said: "While I was walking in Paradise (on the night of Mi'raj), I saw a river, on the two banks of which there were tents made of hollow pearls. I asked, "What is this, O Gabriel?' He said, 'That is the Kauthar which Your Lord has given to you.' Behold! Its scent or its mud was sharp smelling musk!" (The sub-narrator, Hudba is in doubt as to the correct expression)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab main Jannat mein (Miraj ki raat) chal raha tha, maine ek nadi dekhi, jiske dono kinaaron par khokhle moti ke khaime the. Maine pucha, "Ye kya hai, Aye Jibrael?" Unhone kaha, "Ye Al-Kauthar hai jo tumhaare Rab ne tumhein diya hai." Dekho! Iski khushbu ya iski mitti tez khushbu wali kasturi thi!' (Ravi Hudba ko sahi lafz mein shak hai.)

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Some of my companions will come to me at my Lake Fount, and after I recognize them, they will then be taken away from me, whereupon I will say, 'My companions!' Then it will be said, 'You do not know what they innovated (new things) in the religion after you
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Mere kuch sahaaba mere Hauz par mere paas aayenge, aur unhein pehchaanne ke baad, unhein mujhse door kar diya jaayega, isper main kahoonga, "Mere saathi!" Phir kaha jaayega, "Tumhein nahi pata unhone tumhaare baad deen mein kya naye kaam (bidaat) shuru kiye."'

e: Narrated Abu Hazim from Sahl bin Sa`d:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I am your predecessor (forerunner) at the Lake-Fount, and whoever will pass by there, he will drink from it and whoever will drink from it, he will never be thirsty. There will come to me some people whom I will recognize, and they will recognize me, but a barrier will be placed between me and them
hi: Abu Hazim, Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke hawaale se, bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Main Hauz par tumse pehle jaane wala hoon, aur jo koi wahaan se guzrega, wo usmein se piyega, aur jo koi usmein se piyega, wo kabhi pyaasa nahi hoga. Kuch log mere paas aayenge jinhein main pehchaanunga, aur wo mujhe pehchaanenge, magar mere aur unke beech ek rukaawat rakh di jaayegi.'

e: Abu Hazim added:An-Nu`man bin Abi `Aiyash, on hearing me, said. "Did you hear this from Sahl?" I said, "Yes." He said, " I bear witness that I heard Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri saying the same, adding that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: 'I will say: They are of me (i.e. my followers). It will be said, 'You do not know what they innovated (new things) in the religion after you left'. I will say, 'Far removed, far removed (from mercy), those who changed (their religion) after me
hi: Abu Hazim ne izaafa kiya: An-Nu'man bin Abi Aiyash ne, mujhe sunkar, kaha, 'Kya tumne ye Sahl se suna?' Maine kaha, 'Haan.' Unhone kaha, 'Main gawaahi deta hoon ke maine Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko bhi yahi kehte suna, izaafa karte hue ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, "Main kahoonga: Wo mere hi hain (yaani mere maanne wale). Kaha jaayega, ‘Tumhein nahi pata unhone tumhaare jaane ke baad deen mein kya naye kaam shuru kiye.’ Main kahoonga, ‘Door ho, door ho (rehmat se), wo log jinhone mere baad (apna deen) badla.’"'

e: Abu Huraira narrated that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:"On the Day of Resurrection a group of companions will come to me, but will be driven away from the Lake-Fount, and I will say, 'O Lord (those are) my companions!' It will be said, 'You have no knowledge as to what they innovated after you left; they turned apostate as renegades (reverted from Islam)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne bataaya ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Qayamat ke din mere sahaabon ka ek giroh mere paas aayega, magar unhein Hauz se dhakel diya jaayega, aur main kahoonga, "Aye Rab! (Wo) mere saathi hain!" Kaha jaayega, "Tumhein nahi pata unhone tumhaare jaane ke baad kya naye kaam shuru kiye; wo murtad (Islam se peechhe hatne wale) ban gaye (Islam se peechhe hat gaye)."'

e: Narrated Ibn Al-Musaiyab:The companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Some men from my companions will come to my Lake-Fount and they will be driven away from it, and I will say, 'O Lord, my companions!' It will be said, 'You have no knowledge of what they innovated after you left: they turned apostate as renegades (reverted from Islam)
hi: Ibn Al-Musaiyab bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ke sahaaba ne kaha, 'Mere kuch sahaaba mere Hauz par aayenge aur unhein wahaan se dhakel diya jaayega, aur main kahoonga, "Aye Rab, mere saathi!" Kaha jaayega, "Tumhein nahi pata unhone tumhaare jaane ke baad kya naye kaam shuru kiye; wo murtad ban gaye (Islam se peechhe hat gaye)."'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "While I was sleeping, a group (of my followers were brought close to me), and when I recognized them, a man (an angel) came out from amongst (us) me and them, he said (to them), 'Come along.' I asked, 'Where?' He said, 'To the (Hell) Fire, by Allah' I asked, 'what is wrong with them' He said, 'They turned apostate as renegades after you left.' Then behold! (Another) group (of my followers) were brought close to me, and when I recognized them, a man (an angel) came out from (me and them) he said (to them); Come along.' I asked, "Where?' He said, 'To the (Hell) Fire, by Allah.' I asked, What is wrong with them?' He said, 'They turned apostate as renegades after you left. So I did not see anyone of them escaping except a few who were like camels without a shepherd
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab main so raha tha, ek giroh (mere maanne walon ka) mere qareeb laaya gaya, aur jab maine unhein pehchaana, ek aadmi (farishta) mere aur unke beech se nikla aur kaha (unse), "Chalo saath."' Maine pucha, 'Kahaan?' Usne kaha, 'Aag ki taraf, Allah ki qasam.' Maine pucha, 'Unhein kya hua?' Usne kaha, 'Wo tumhaare jaane ke baad murtad ban gaye (Islam se peechhe hat gaye).' Phir dekho! Ek aur (mere maanne walon ka) giroh mere qareeb laaya gaya, aur jab maine unhein pehchaana, ek aadmi (farishta) (mere aur unke beech se) nikla aur kaha (unse), "Chalo saath." Maine pucha, "Kahaan?" Usne kaha, "Aag ki taraf, Allah ki qasam." Maine pucha, "Unhein kya hua?" Usne kaha, "Wo tumhaare jaane ke baad murtad ban gaye." To maine unmein se kisi ko bhi bachte hue nahi dekha siwaaye kuch ke jo bina charwaahe ke oonton jaise the.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Between my house and my pulpit there is a garden from amongst the gardens of Paradise, and my pulpit is over my Lake-Fount
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Mere ghar aur mere mimbar ke beech Jannat ke baaghon mein se ek baagh hai, aur mera mimbar mere Hauz par hai.'

e: Narrated Jundab:I heard the Prophet, saying, "I am your predecessor at the Lake-Fount. (Al-Kauthar)
hi: Jundab bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Main Hauz (Al-Kauthar) par tumse pehle jaane wala hoon.'

e: Narrated `Uqba bin 'Amir:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) went out and offered the funeral prayers for the martyrs of Uhud, and then went to the pulpit and said, "I am a predecessor for you and I am a witness for you: and by Allah, I am looking at my Fount just now, and the keys of the treasures of the earth (or the keys of the earth) have been given to me: and by Allah, I am not afraid that you will worship others besides Allah after me, but I am afraid that you will strive and struggle against each other over these treasures of the world
hi: Uqba bin Aamir bataate hain: Ek baar Nabi (SAW) baahar gaye aur Uhud ke shaheedon ki janaaza namaz padhaayi, phir mimbar par gaye aur kaha, 'Main tumhaara pehle jaane wala hoon aur main tumhaare khilaaf gawaah hoon; aur Allah ki qasam, main is waqt apne Hauz ko dekh raha hoon, aur zameen ke khazaanon (ya zameen) ki chaabiyaan mujhe di gayi hain; aur Allah ki qasam, mujhe dar nahi ke tum mere baad Allah ke siwa doosron ki ibaadat karoge, magar mujhe dar hai ke tum in duniya ke khazaanon ke liye ek doosre se pratispardha (muqaabla) aur jhagda karoge.'

e: Narrated Haritha bin Wahb:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) mentioning the Lake-Fount (Al-Kauthar), saying, "(The width of the Lake-Fount) is equal to the distance between Medina and Sana' (capital of Yemen)
hi: Haritha bin Wahb bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko Hauz (Al-Kauthar) ka zikr karte suna, kehte hue, '(Hauz ki chaudai) Madina aur Sana (Yemen ki raajdhaani) ke beech ki doori jitni hai.'

e: Haritha said that he heard the Prophet saying that his Lake-Fount would be as large as the distance between Sana' and Medina. Al- Mustaurid said to Haritha, "Didn't you hear him talking about the vessels?" He said, "No." Al- Mustaurid said, "The vessels are seen in it as (numberless as) the stars
hi: Haritha kehte hain ke unhone Nabi (SAW) ko ye kehte suna ke unka Hauz Sana aur Madina ke beech ki doori jitna bada hoga. Al-Mustaurid ne Haritha se kaha, 'Kya aapne unhein bartanon ke baare mein baat karte nahi suna?' Unhone kaha, 'Nahi.' Al-Mustaurid ne kaha, 'Usmein bartan sitaaron jitne (be-shumaar) dikhte hain.'

e: Narrated Asma 'bint Abu Bakr:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I will be standing at the Lake-Fount so that I will see whom among you will come to me; and some people will be taken away from me, and I will say, 'O Lord, (they are) from me and from my followers.' Then it will be said, 'Did you notice what they did after you? By Allah, they kept on turning on their heels (turned as renegades).' " The sub-narrator, Ibn Abi Mulaika said, "O Allah, we seek refuge with You from turning on our heels, or being put to trial in our religion
hi: Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Abu Bakr (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Main Hauz par khada hounga taake main dekh sakoon tum mein se kaun mere paas aata hai; aur kuch logon ko mujhse door kar diya jaayega, aur main kahoonga, "Aye Rab, (wo) mujhse aur mere maanne walon mein se hain." Phir kaha jaayega, "Kya tumhein pata hai unhone tumhaare baad kya kiya? Allah ki qasam, wo apni edi par ghoomte rahe (murtad ban gaye)."' Ravi Ibn Abi Mulaika kehte hain, 'Aye Allah! Hum apni edi par ghoomne se, ya apne deen mein azmaaish mein padne se teri panaah maangte hain.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), the truthful and truly-inspired, said, "Each one of you collected in the womb of his mother for forty days, and then turns into a clot for an equal period (of forty days) and turns into a piece of flesh for a similar period (of forty days) and then Allah sends an angel and orders him to write four things, i.e., his provision, his age, and whether he will be of the wretched or the blessed (in the Hereafter). Then the soul is breathed into him. And by Allah, a person among you (or a man) may do deeds of the people of the Fire till there is only a cubit or an arm-breadth distance between him and the Fire, but then that writing (which Allah has ordered the angel to write) precedes, and he does the deeds of the people of Paradise and enters it; and a man may do the deeds of the people of Paradise till there is only a cubit or two between him and Paradise, and then that writing precedes and he does the deeds of the people of the Fire and enters it
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW), jo sachche aur waaqai wahi paane wale the, ne farmaya, 'Tum mein se har ek apni maa ke garbh mein chaalis (40) din tak jama hota hai, phir usi muddat ke liye ek jama-shuda khoon (clot) mein badal jaata hai, aur phir usi muddat ke liye gosht ke ek tukde mein badal jaata hai, aur phir Allah ek farishta bhejta hai aur use hukm deta hai chaar cheezein likhne ka, yaani uska rizq, uski umar, aur wo badnaseeb hoga ya khush-naseeb (Aakhirat mein). Phir uske andar rooh phoonki jaati hai. Aur Allah ki qasam, tum mein se koi (ya ek aadmi) Aag waalon ke amaal kar sakta hai yahaan tak ke uske aur Aag ke beech sirf ek haath ya baazu jitni doori reh jaaye, magar phir wo likhaawat (jo Allah ne farishte ko likhne ka hukm diya tha) aage aa jaati hai, aur wo Jannat waalon ke amaal karta hai aur usmein daakhil ho jaata hai; aur ek aadmi Jannat waalon ke amaal kar sakta hai yahaan tak ke uske aur Jannat ke beech sirf ek ya do haath ki doori reh jaaye, aur phir wo likhaawat aage aa jaati hai aur wo Aag waalon ke amaal karta hai aur usmein daakhil ho jaata hai.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah puts an angel in charge of the uterus and the angel says, 'O Lord, (it is) semen! O Lord, (it is now ) a clot! O Lord, (it is now) a piece of flesh.' And then, if Allah wishes to complete its creation, the angel asks, 'O Lord, (will it be) a male or a female? A wretched (an evil doer) or a blessed (doer of good)? How much will his provisions be? What will his age be?' So all that is written while the creature is still in the mother's womb
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah garbh (uterus) par ek farishte ko muqarrar karta hai, aur farishta kehta hai, "Aye Rab, (ye) veerya hai! Aye Rab, (ab ye) jama-shuda khoon hai! Aye Rab, (ab ye) gosht ka tukda hai!" Aur phir, agar Allah iski takhleeq poori karna chaahta hai, farishta poochta hai, "Aye Rab, (kya ye) ladka hoga ya ladki? Badnaseeb (buraai karne wala) hoga ya khush-naseeb (achhaai karne wala)? Iska rizq kitna hoga? Iski umar kya hogi?" To ye sab likh diya jaata hai jabke jeev abhi maa ke garbh mein hi hota hai.'

e: Narrated `Imran bin Husain:A man said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Can the people of Paradise be known (differentiated) from the people of the Fire; The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Yes." The man said, "Why do people (try to) do (good) deeds?" The Prophet said, "Everyone will do the deeds for which he has been created to do or he will do those deeds which will be made easy for him to do." (i.e. everybody will find easy to do such deeds as will lead him to his destined place for which he has been created)
hi: Imran bin Husain (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks ne pucha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya Jannat waalon ko Aag waalon se alag pehchaana jaa sakta hai?' Nabi (SAW) ne jawab diya, 'Haan.' Us shaks ne pucha, 'To log (nek) amaal kyun karte hain?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Har koi wahi amaal karega jiske liye use banaaya gaya hai, ya wahi amaal karega jo uske liye aasaan banaaya jaayega.' (Yaani har kisi ko wahi amaal aasaan lagenge jo use uski muqarrar jagah tak le jaayenge jiske liye use banaaya gaya hai.)

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) ; was asked about the offspring of the pagans. He said, "Allah knows what they would have done (were they to live)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) se mushrikon ki aulaad (jo chhoti umar mein mar jaayein) ke baare mein pucha gaya. Unhone kaha, 'Allah jaanta hai wo kya karte (agar wo zinda rehte).'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked about the offspring of the pagans. He said, "Allah knows what they would have done (were they to live)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se mushrikon ki aulaad ke baare mein pucha gaya. Unhone kaha, 'Allah jaanta hai wo kya karte (agar wo zinda rehte).'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "No child is born but has the Islamic Faith, but its parents turn it into a Jew or a Christian. It is as you help the animals give birth. Do you find among their offspring a mutilated one before you mutilate them yourself?" The people said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What do you think about those (of them) who die young?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah knows what they would have done (were they to live)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Koi bhi bacha aisa paida nahi hota jo Islami fitrat par na ho, magar uske maa-baap use Yahudi ya Isaai bana dete hain. Ye aisa hai jaise tum jaanwaron ko bacche janam dilwaane mein madad karte ho. Kya tumhein unki aulaad mein koi apang (mutilated) jaanwar milta hai isse pehle ke tum khud use apang karo?' Logon ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Aap unke baare mein kya sochte hain jo chhoti umar mein mar jaate hain?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Allah jaanta hai wo kya karte (agar wo zinda rehte).'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "No woman should ask for the divorce of her sister (Muslim) so as to take her place, but she should marry the man (without compelling him to divorce his other wife), for she will have nothing but what Allah has written for her
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Koi bhi aurat apni (Musalmaan) behen ki talaaq na maange taake wo uski jagah le sake, balke use us aadmi se nikaah karna chaahiye (uski doosri biwi ko talaaq dilwaaye bagair), kyunke usse wahi milega jo Allah ne uske liye likha hai.'

e: Narrated Usama:Once while I was with the Prophet (ﷺ) and Sa`d, Ubai bin Ka`b and Mu`adh were also sitting with him, there came to him a messenger from one of his daughters, telling him that her child was on the verge of death. The Prophet (ﷺ) told the messenger to tell her, "It is for Allah what He takes, and it is for Allah what He gives, and everything has its fixed time (limit). So (she should) be patient and look for Allah's reward
hi: Usama bataate hain: Ek baar jab main Nabi (SAW) ke saath tha aur Sa'd, Ubai bin Ka'b (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Mu'adh bhi unke saath baithe the, unki ek beti ki taraf se ek qaasid aaya, unhein bataate hue ke uska bacha maut ke kagaar par hai. Nabi (SAW) ne qaasid se kaha unhein bataayein, 'Jo Allah leta hai wo uska hai, aur jo Allah deta hai wo uska hai, aur har cheez ka apna muqarrar waqt (limit) hai. Isliye (usse kaho ke wo) sabra kare aur Allah ke ajr ki ummeed rakhe.'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:That while he was sitting with the Prophet (ﷺ) a man from the Ansar came and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We get slave girls from the war captives and we love property; what do you think about coitus interruptus?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Do you do that? It is better for you not to do it, for there is no soul which Allah has ordained to come into existence but will be created
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke jab wo Nabi (SAW) ke saath baithe the, Ansaar mein se ek shaks aaya aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Humein jang ke qaidiyon mein se launDiyaan milti hain aur hum jaayadaad se mohabbat karte hain; aap Azl (bahar nikaalne, coitus interruptus) ke baare mein kya sochte hain?' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Kya tum aisa karte ho? Behtar hai tum aisa na karo, kyunke koi bhi jaan aisi nahi hai jise Allah ne wajood mein aane ka faisla kiya ho, magar wo banaayi jaayegi.'

e: Narrated Hudhaifa:The Prophet (ﷺ) once delivered a speech in front of us wherein he left nothing but mentioned (about) everything that would happen till the Hour. Some of us stored that our minds and some forgot it. (After that speech) I used to see events taking place (which had been referred to in that speech) but I had forgotten them (before their occurrence). Then I would recognize such events as a man recognizes another man who has been absent and then sees and recognizes him
hi: Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne ek baar hamare saamne ek khutba diya jismein unhone Qayamat tak hone waali har cheez ka zikr kiya, kuch bhi chhoda nahi. Hum mein se kuch ne use apne dimaag mein rakha aur kuch bhool gaye. (Us khutba ke baad) main un waaqiaat ko hote dekhta, jinke baare mein khutba mein bataaya gaya tha, magar unke hone se pehle main unhein bhool chuka hota. Phir main aise waaqiaat ko pehchaanta jaise koi ek gair-haazir shaks ko pehchaanta hai jise wo dekhta aur pehchaanta hai.

e: Narrated `Ali:While we were sitting with the Prophet (ﷺ) who had a stick with which he was scraping the earth, he lowered his head and said, "There is none of you but has his place assigned either in the Fire or in Paradise." Thereupon a man from the people said, "Shall we not depend upon this, O Allah's Apostle?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No, but carry on and do your deeds, for everybody finds it easy to do such deeds (as will lead him to his place)." The Prophet (ﷺ) then recited the Verse: 'As for him who gives (in charity) and keeps his duty to Allah
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Jab hum Nabi (SAW) ke saath baithe the aur unke paas ek lakdi thi jisse wo zameen khurach rahe the, unhone apna sar neeche kiya aur kaha, 'Tum mein se koi bhi aisa nahi hai jiski jagah muqarrar na ki gayi ho, ya to Aag mein ya Jannat mein.' Isper logon mein se ek shaks ne kaha, 'To kya hum isi par bharosa na karein, Aye Allah ke Rasool?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Nahi, balke amaal karte raho, kyunke har kisi ko wo amaal aasaan lagenge (jo use uski muqarrar jagah tak le jaayenge).' Phir Nabi (SAW) ne ye Aayat padhi: 'Jo koi (sadqe mein) deta hai aur Allah se darta hai...'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:We witnessed along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) the Khaibar (campaign). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) told his companions about a man who claimed to be a Muslim, "This man is from the people of the Fire." When the battle started, the man fought very bravely and received a great number of wounds and got crippled. On that, a man from among the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) came and said, "O Allah's Apostle! Do you know what the man you described as of the people of the Fire has done? He has fought very bravely for Allah's Cause and he has received many wounds." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "But he is indeed one of the people of the Fire." Some of the Muslims were about to have some doubt about that statement. So while the man was in that state, the pain caused by the wounds troubled him so much that he put his hand into his quiver and took out an arrow and committed suicide with it. Off went some men from among the Muslims to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Allah has made your statement true. So-and-so has committed suicide." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O Bilal! Get up and announce in public: None will enter Paradise but a believer, and Allah may support this religion (Islam) with a wicked man
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Khaibar (jang) mein maujood the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne sahaaba ko ek aise aadmi ke baare mein bataaya jo Musalmaan hone ka dawa karta tha, 'Ye aadmi Aag waalon mein se hai.' Jab jang shuru hui, wo aadmi bahut bahaduri se lada aur usne bahut se zakhm khaaye aur langda ho gaya. Isper Nabi (SAW) ke sahaaba mein se ek aadmi aaya aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya aapko pata hai jise aapne Aag waalon mein se kaha tha usne kya kiya hai? Usne Allah ki raah mein bahut bahaduri se jang ki hai aur bahut se zakhm khaaye hain.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Magar wo waaqai Aag waalon mein se ek hai.' Kuch Musalmaanon ko is baat par thoda shak hone laga. Isi haalat mein, zakhmon ki takleef ne use itna pareshaan kiya ke usne apne teerdaan mein haath daala aur ek teer nikaal kar usse khudkushi kar li. Kuch Musalmaan jaldi se Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaye aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Allah ne aapki baat sach saabit kar di. Falaan ne khudkushi kar li hai.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Aye Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ)! Utho aur logon mein elaan karo: Jannat mein sirf Momin daakhil hoga, aur Allah is deen (Islam) ko ek badkaar aadmi se bhi madad de sakta hai.'

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:There was a man who fought most bravely of all the Muslims on behalf of the Muslims in a battle (Ghazwa) in the company of the Prophet. The Prophet (ﷺ) looked at him and said. "If anyone would like to see a man from the people of the Fire, let him look at this (brave man)." On that, a man from the People (Muslims) followed him, and he was in that state i.e., fighting fiercely against the pagans till he was wounded, and then he hastened to end his life by placing his sword between his breasts (and pressed it with great force) till it came out between his shoulders. Then the man (who was watching that person) went quickly to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "I testify that you are Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" The Prophet (ﷺ) asked him, "Why do you say that?" He said, "You said about so-and-so, 'If anyone would like to see a man from the people of the Fire, he should look at him.' He fought most bravely of all of us on behalf of the Muslims and I knew that he would not die as a Muslim (Martyr). So when he got wounded, he hastened to die and committed suicide." There-upon the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A man may do the deeds of the people of the Fire while in fact he is one of the people of Paradise, and he may do the deeds of the people of Paradise while in fact he belongs to the people of Fire, and verily, (the rewards of) the deeds are decided by the last actions (deeds)
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek aisa aadmi tha jo ek jang mein Nabi (SAW) ke saath Musalmaanon ki taraf se sabse zyaada bahaduri se ladha. Nabi (SAW) ne uski taraf dekha aur kaha, 'Agar koi Aag waalon mein se ek aadmi dekhna chaahe, to wo isse (is bahaadur aadmi ko) dekhe.' Isper Musalmaanon mein se ek shaks uske peechhe gaya, aur wo isi haalat mein tha, yaani mushrikon ke khilaaf shiddat se ladta hua, yahaan tak ke wo zakhmi ho gaya, aur phir usne jaldi se apni zindagi khatm karne ke liye apni talwaar apni chhaati ke beech rakhi (aur zor se dabaayi) yahaan tak ke wo uske kandhon se paar ho gayi. Phir wo aadmi (jo use dekh raha tha) jaldi se Nabi (SAW) ke paas gaya aur kaha, 'Main gawaahi deta hoon ke aap Allah ke Rasool hain!' Nabi (SAW) ne unse pucha, 'Tum aisa kyun keh rahe ho?' Usne kaha, 'Aapne falaan aadmi ke baare mein kaha tha, "Agar koi Aag waalon mein se ek aadmi dekhna chaahe, use isse dekhna chaahiye." Wo hum sab mein Musalmaanon ki taraf se sabse zyaada bahaduri se lada, aur mujhe pata tha ke wo Musalmaan (shaheed) ki tarah nahi marega. To jab wo zakhmi hua, usne jaldi marne ki koshish ki aur khudkushi kar li.' Isper Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Ek shaks Aag waalon ke amaal kar sakta hai jabke haqeeqat mein wo Jannat waalon mein se ek hai, aur wo Jannat waalon ke amaal kar sakta hai jabke haqeeqat mein wo Aag waalon mein se hai, aur beshak, (amaal ke ajr ka) faisla aakhri karyon (amalon) se hota hai.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade vowing and said, "In fact, vowing does not prevent anything, but it makes a miser to spend his property
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne mannat (nazar) maangne se mana kiya aur kaha, 'Asal mein, mannat kuch nahi rokti, magar ye ek kanjoos ko apni jaayadaad kharch karwaati hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said (that Allah said), "Vowing does not bring to the son of Adam anything I have not already written in his fate, but vowing is imposed on him by way of fore ordainment. Through vowing I make a miser spend of his wealth
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne (Allah ka farmaan) kaha, 'Mannat Aadam ke bete ke liye koi aisi cheez nahi laati jo Maine pehle se uski taqdeer mein na likhi ho, magar mannat use taqdeer ke zariye majboor karti hai. Mannat ke zariye Main ek kanjoos ko apni daulat kharch karwaata hoon.'

e: Narrated Abu Musa:While we were with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in a holy battle, we never went up a hill or reached its peak or went down a valley but raised our voices with Takbir. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came close to us and said, "O people! Don't exert yourselves, for you do not call a deaf or an absent one, but you call the All- Listener, the All-Seer." The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "O `Abdullah bin Qais! Shall I teach you a sentence which is from the treasures of Paradise? ( It is): 'La haula wala quwata illa billah. (There is neither might nor power except with Allah)
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath ek jehaad mein the, hum jab bhi kisi pahaad par chadhte ya uski chotii tak pahunchte ya kisi wadi mein utarte, hum oonchi aawaaz mein Takbeer kehte. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) hamare qareeb aaye aur kaha, 'Aye logo! Apne aap par jyaada zor mat daalo, kyunke tum kisi bahre ya gair-haazir ko nahi pukaar rahe, balke tum us Zaat ko pukaar rahe ho jo sab kuch sunta hai, sab kuch dekhta hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne phir kaha, 'Aye Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Qais! Kya main tumhein ek jumla sikhaun jo Jannat ke khazaanon mein se hai? (Wo hai): "La Haula Wala Quwwata Illa Billah" (na koi taaqat hai na koi qudrat siwaaye Allah ke).'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:That the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No Caliph is appointed but has two groups of advisors: One group advises him to do good and urges him to adopt it, and the other group advises him to do bad and urges him to adopt it; and the protected is the one whom Allah protects
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Koi bhi Khalifa muqarrar nahi hota jiske do giroh salaahkaar na hon: ek giroh use achhaai karne aur usse apnaane ki taakeed karta hai, aur doosra giroh use buraai karne aur usse apnaane ki taakeed karta hai; aur mehfooz wo hai jise Allah mehfooz rakhe.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I did not see anything so resembling minor sins as what Abu Huraira said from the Prophet, who said, "Allah has written for the son of Adam his inevitable share of adultery whether he is aware of it or not: The adultery of the eye is the looking (at something which is sinful to look at), and the adultery of the tongue is to utter (what it is unlawful to utter), and the innerself wishes and longs for (adultery) and the private parts turn that into reality or refrain from submitting to the temptation
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine 'Lamam' (chhote gunaah) se milti-julti koi baat nahi dekhi jaisa Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Nabi (SAW) se riwaayat ki ke unhone farmaaya, 'Allah ne Aadam ke bete ke liye zina mein uska hissa likha hai jo wo laazimi taur par karta hai, chaahe use pata ho ya na ho: aankhon ka zina dekhna hai (haraam cheez ko taktna), aur zubaan ka zina baat karna hai (jo kehna gair-jaayez hai wo kehna), aur dil chaahat aur khwaahish rakhta hai, aur sharmgaah in sabki tasdeeq karti hai ya inkaar karti hai (khwaahish ko haqeeqat mein badalne se rukti hai).'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:(regarding the Verse) "And We granted the vision (Ascension to the heavens "Miraj") which We showed you (O Muhammad as an actual eye witness) but as a trial for mankind.' (17.60): Allah's Apostle actually saw with his own eyes the vision (all the things which were shown to him) on the night of his Night Journey to Jerusalem (and then to the heavens). The cursed tree which is mentioned in the Qur'an is the tree of Az-Zaqqum
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain (is Aayat ke baare mein): 'Aur humne ye khwaab (Miraj ka nazaara, aasmaano tak ki chadhaayi) jo humne tumhein (Aye Muhammad) dikhaaya, sirf logon ke liye ek azmaaish banaayi' (17:60): Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne waaqai apni khud ki aankhon se ye khwaab (jo cheezein unhein dikhaayi gayi thin) unki Yerusalem tak ki raat ki safar (aur phir aasmaanon tak) ki raat dekha. Woh mala'un darakht jiska zikr Quran mein hai wo Az-Zaqqum ka darakht hai.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Adam and Moses argued with each other. Moses said to Adam. 'O Adam! You are our father who disappointed us and turned us out of Paradise.' Then Adam said to him, 'O Moses! Allah favored you with His talk (talked to you directly) and He wrote (the Torah) for you with His Own Hand. Do you blame me for action which Allah had written in my fate forty years before my creation?' So Adam confuted Moses, Adam confuted Moses," the Prophet (ﷺ) added, repeating the Statement three times
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Aadam aur Musa ne aapas mein behas ki. Musa ne Aadam se kaha, "Aye Aadam! Aap hamare waalid hain jinhone humein maayus kiya aur Jannat se nikaal diya." Phir Aadam ne unse kaha, "Aye Musa! Allah ne aapko apni baat se khaas kiya (aapse seedhe baat ki) aur usne (Taurat) apne haath se aapke liye likhi. Kya aap mujhe us kaam ke liye qusoorwaar thehraate hain jo Allah ne mere naseeb mein meri takhleeq se chaalis saal pehle hi likh diya tha?" To Aadam ne Musa ko laa-jawaab kar diya, Aadam ne Musa ko laa-jawaab kar diya,' Nabi (SAW) ne is baat ko teen baar dohraaya.

e: Narrated Warrad:(the freed slave of Al-Mughira bin Shu`ba) Muawiya wrote to Mughira. 'Write to me what you heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying after his prayer.' So Al-Mughira dictated to me and said, "I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying after the prayer, 'None has the right to be worshipped but Allah Alone Who has no partner. O Allah! No-one can withhold what You give, and none can give what You withhold, and the fortune of a man of means is useless before You (i.e., only good deeds are of value)
hi: Warrad (Al-Mughira bin Shu'ba (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke azaad kiye ghulaam) bataate hain: Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Mughira ko likha, 'Mujhe likho jo aapne Nabi (SAW) ko namaz ke baad kehte suna.' To Al-Mughira ne mujhe likhwaaya aur kaha, 'Maine Nabi (SAW) ko namaz ke baad ye kehte suna, "Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi, akela, jiska koi shareek nahi. Aye Allah! Koi tera diya hua rok nahi sakta, aur koi tera roka hua de nahi sakta, aur kisi daulatmand aadmi ki daulat tere saamne be-kaar hai (yaani sirf nek amaal hi keemat rakhte hain)."'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Take refuge with Allah from the difficulties of severe calamities, from having an evil end and a bad fate and from the malicious joy of your enemies
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Sakht museebaton ki mushkilon se, aur bure anjaam aur buri taqdeer se, aur apne dushmanon ki badnaseeb khushi se Allah ki panaah maango.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:When taking an oath, the Prophet (ﷺ) very often used to say, "No, by Him Who turns the hearts
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Qasam khaate waqt, Nabi (SAW) aksar kehte the, 'Nahi, us Zaat ki qasam jo dilon ko phera deti hai.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said to Ibn Saiyad, "I have kept for you a secret." Ibn Saiyad said, "Ad-Dukh." The Prophet said, "Keep quiet, for you cannot go beyond your limits (or you cannot exceed what has been foreordained for you)." On that, `Umar said (to the Prophet (ﷺ) ), "Allow me to chop off his neck!" The Prophet said, "Leave him, for if he is he (i.e., Ad-Dajjal), then you will not be able to overcome him, and if he is not, then you gain no good by killing him
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne Ibn Saiyad se kaha, 'Maine tumhaare liye ek raaz chhupaa rakha hai.' Ibn Saiyad ne kaha, 'Ad-Dukh.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Chup raho, kyunke tum apni hadd se aage nahi badh sakte (ya, tum jo tumhaare liye muqarrar hai usse aage nahi badh sakte).' Isper, Umar ne (Nabi se) kaha, 'Mujhe ijaazat dijiye ke main iski gardan kaat doon!' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Ise chhod do, kyunke agar ye wahi hai (yaani Ad-Dajjal), to tum use haraa nahi paaoge, aur agar ye nahi hai, to ise qatl karne se tumhein koi faayda nahi.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about the plague. He said, "That was a means of torture which Allah used to send upon whom-so-ever He wished, but He made it a source of mercy for the believers, for anyone who is residing in a town in which this disease is present, and remains there and does not leave that town, but has patience and hopes for Allah's reward, and knows that nothing will befall him except what Allah has written for him, then he will get such reward as that of a martyr
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se mahamaari (plague) ke baare mein pucha. Unhone kaha, 'Ye ek azaab ka zariya thi jise Allah jispar chaahe bhejta tha, magar usne ise Momineen ke liye ek Rehmat ka zariya bana diya, ke jo koi kisi aise shehar mein rehta hai jahaan ye bimaari maujood ho, aur wahaan raheta hai aur us shehar ko nahi chhodta, magar sabra karta hai aur Allah ke ajr ki ummeed rakhta hai, aur jaanta hai ke usse sirf wahi hoga jo Allah ne uske liye likha hai, to use ek shaheed jitna ajr milega.'

e: Narrated Al-Bara' bin `Azib:I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) on the Day of (the battle of) Al-Khandaq, carrying earth with us and saying, "By Allah, without Allah we would not have been guided, neither would we have fasted, nor would we have prayed. O Allah! Send down Sakina (calmness) upon us and make our feet firm when we meet (the enemy). The pagans have rebelled against us, but if they want to put us in affliction (i.e., fight us) we refuse (to flee)." (See Hadith No. 430, Vol)
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko jang-e-Khandaq ke din, hamare saath mitti uthaate hue dekha, kehte hue, 'Allah ki qasam, Allah ke bagair hum hidaayat na paate, na roza rakhte, na namaz padhte. Aye Allah! Hampar sukoon (Sakina) naazil kar aur jab hum dushman se milein hamare qadam mazboot kar. Mushrikon ne hamare khilaaf baghaawat ki hai, magar agar wo humein museebat mein daalna chaahein (yaani hamare khilaaf ladna chaahein), to hum inkaar karte hain (bhaagne se).' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 430, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated `Aisha:Abu Bakr As-Siddiq had never broken his oaths till Allah revealed the expiation for the oaths. Then he said, "If I take an oath to do something and later on I find something else better than the first one, then I do what is better and make expiation for my oath
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Abu Bakr As-Siddiq ne kabhi apni qasam nahi todi jab tak Allah ne qasam ke kaffare ki Aayat naazil nahi ki. Phir unhone kaha, 'Agar main kisi kaam ke liye qasam khaaun aur baad mein mujhe usse behtar koi cheez mile, to main wahi karta hoon jo behtar hai aur apni qasam ka kaffara adaa karta hoon.'

e: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin Samura:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O `Abdur-Rahman bin Samura! Do not seek to be a ruler, because if you are given authority for it, then you will be held responsible for it, but if you are given it without asking for it, then you will be helped in it (by Allah): and whenever you take an oath to do something and later you find that something else is better than the first, then do the better one and make expiation for your oath
hi: Abdur Rahman bin Samura bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Aye Abdur Rahman bin Samura! Hukmraan banne ki koshish mat karo, kyunke agar tumhein ye zimmedaari maang kar di jaaye, to tumhein iske liye zimmedaar thehraaya jaayega, magar agar tumhein ye bina maange di jaaye, to tumhein isme (Allah ki taraf se) madad milegi; aur jab bhi tum kisi kaam ke liye qasam khaao aur baad mein tumhein pehle se behtar koi cheez mile, to behtar wali karo aur apni qasam ka kaffara adaa karo.'

e: Narrated Abu Musa:I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) along with a group of Al-Ash`ariyin in order to request him to provide us with mounts. He said, "By Allah, I will not provide you with mounts and I haven't got anything to mount you on." Then we stayed there as long as Allah wished us to stay, and then three very nice looking she-camels were brought to him and he made us ride them. When we left, we, or some of us, said, "By Allah, we will not be blessed, as we came to the Prophet (ﷺ) asking him for mounts, and he swore that he would not give us any mounts but then he did give us. So let us go back to the Prophet (ﷺ) and remind him (of his oath)." When we returned to him (and reminded him of the fact), he said, "I did not give you mounts, but it is Allah Who gave you. By Allah, Allah willing, if I ever take an oath to do something and then I find something else than the first, I will make expiation for my oath and do the thing which is better (or do something which is better and give the expiation for my oath)
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Nabi (SAW) ke paas Al-Ashariyin ke ek giroh ke saath gaya taake unse sawaari maang saken. Unhone kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, main tumhein sawaari nahi dunga aur mere paas tumhein sawaari dene ke liye kuch nahi hai.' Phir hum jitni der Allah chaahta tha wahaan rehte, aur phir teen bahut achhi dikhne wali oontniyaan unke paas laayi gayi aur unhone humein unpar sawaar karwaaya. Jab hum wahaan se gaye, humne, ya hum mein se kisi ne, kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, humein barkat nahi milegi, kyunke hum Nabi (SAW) ke paas unse sawaari maangne gaye the, aur unhone qasam khaayi thi ke wo humein koi sawaari nahi denge, magar phir unhone di. To chalo hum Nabi (SAW) ke paas wapas jaayein aur unhein (unki qasam ki) yaad dilaayein.' Jab hum unke paas wapas gaye (aur unhein ye baat yaad dilaayi), unhone kaha, 'Maine tumhein sawaari nahi di, balke Allah ne tumhein di. Allah ki qasam, Allah ne chaaha to, agar main kabhi kisi kaam ke liye qasam khaaun aur phir mujhe pehle se behtar koi cheez mile, to main apni qasam ka kaffara adaa karunga aur wahi karunga jo behtar hai (ya, jo behtar hai wo karunga aur apni qasam ka kaffara adaa karunga).'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "We (Muslims) are the last in the world, but will be foremost on the Day of Resurrection
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Hum (Musalmaan) duniya mein sabse aakhri hain, magar Qayamat ke din sabse aage honge.'

e: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) also said:"By Allah, if anyone of you insists on fulfilling an oath by which he may harm his family, he commits a greater sin in Allah's sight than that of dissolving his oath and making expiation for it
hi: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ye bhi farmaaya: 'Allah ki qasam, agar tum mein se koi ek aisi qasam poori karne par zid kare jisse uske khaandaan ko nuqsaan ho, to wo Allah ke nazdeek us gunaah se bhi bada gunaah karta hai jo qasam todne aur uska kaffara adaa karne se hota hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Anyone who takes an oath through which his family may be harmed, and insists on keeping it, he surely commits a sin greater (than that of dissolving his oath). He should rather compensate for that oath by making expiation
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi aisi qasam khaaye jisse uske khaandaan ko nuqsaan ho sakta hai, aur wo ise poora karne par zid kare, to wo zaroor (usse bhi bada) gunaah karta hai. Use is qasam ke liye kaffara adaa karna chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent an army detachment and made Usama bin Zaid its commander. Some people criticized (spoke badly of) Usama's leadership. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got up saying, "If you people are criticizing Usama's leadership, you have already criticized the leadership of his father before. But Waaimullah (i.e., By Allah), he (i.e. Zaid) deserved the leadership, and he was one of the most beloved persons to me; and now this (his son Usama) is one of the dearest persons to me after him." (See Hadith No. 765, Vol)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek fauji dasta bheja aur Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko uska sardaar banaaya. Kuch logon ne Usama ki sardaari ki aalochana ki (bura-bhala kaha). To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khade hue aur kaha, 'Agar tum log Usama ki sardaari ki aalochana kar rahe ho, to tumne pehle unke waalid ki sardaari ki bhi aalochana ki thi. Magar Wallahi (Allah ki qasam), wo (yaani Zaid) sardaari ke laayak the, aur wo mere sabse aziz logon mein se ek the; aur ab ye (unka beta Usama) unke baad mujhe sabse aziz logon mein se ek hai.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 765, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The oath of the Prophet (ﷺ) used to be: "No, by Him who turns the hearts
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ki qasam yeh hoti thi, 'Nahi, us Zaat ki qasam jo dilon ko phera deti hai.'

e: Narrated Jabir bin Samura:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If Caesar is ruined, there will be no Caesar after him; and if Khosrau is ruined, there will be no Khosrau, after him; and, by Him in Whose Hand my soul is, surely you will spend their treasures in Allah's Cause
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Samura bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar Caesar tabaah ho jaaye, to uske baad koi Caesar nahi hoga; aur agar Khosrau tabaah ho jaaye, to uske baad koi Khosrau nahi hoga; aur us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, tum zaroor unke khazaane Allah ki raah mein kharch karoge.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If Khosrau is ruined, there will be no Khosrau after him; and if Caesar is ruined, there will be no Caesar after him. By Him in Whose Hand Muhammad's soul is, surely you will spend their treasures in Allah's Cause
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar Khosrau tabaah ho jaaye, to uske baad koi Khosrau nahi hoga; aur agar Caesar tabaah ho jaaye, to uske baad koi Caesar nahi hoga. Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein Muhammad ki jaan hai, tum zaroor unke khazaane Allah ki raah mein kharch karoge.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O followers of Muhammad! By Allah, if you knew what I know, you would weep much and laugh little
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Aye Muhammad ke maanne walon! Allah ki qasam, agar tumhein pata hota jo mujhe pata hai, to tum bahut rote aur kam hansate.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Hisham:We were with the Prophet (ﷺ) and he was holding the hand of `Umar bin Al-Khattab. `Umar said to Him, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! You are dearer to me than everything except my own self." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No, by Him in Whose Hand my soul is, (you will not have complete faith) till I am dearer to you than your own self." Then `Umar said to him, "However, now, by Allah, you are dearer to me than my own self." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Now, O `Umar, (now you are a believer)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Hisham (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Nabi (SAW) ke saath the aur wo Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab ka haath thaame hue the. Umar ne unse kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Aap mujhe sabse aziz hain, apni jaan ke siwa har cheez se.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Nahi, us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, (tumhaara Iman poora nahi hoga) jab tak main tumhein tumhaari khud ki jaan se bhi zyaada aziz na lagoon.' Isper Umar ne unse kaha, 'Magar, ab, Allah ki qasam, aap mujhe meri khud ki jaan se bhi zyaada aziz hain.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Ab, Aye Umar, (ab tum Momin ho).'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira and Zaid bin Khalid:Two men had a dispute in the presence of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). One of them said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Judge between us according to Allah's Laws." The other who was wiser, said, "Yes, O Allah's Apostle! Judge between us according to Allah's Laws and allow me to speak. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Speak." He said, "My son was a laborer serving this (person) and he committed illegal sexual intercourse with his wife, The people said that my son is to be stoned to death, but I ransomed him with one-hundred sheep and a slave girl. Then I asked the learned people, who informed me that my son should receive one hundred lashes and will be exiled for one year, and stoning will be the lot for the man's wife." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Indeed, by Him in Whose Hand my soul is, I will judge between you according to Allah's Laws: As for your sheep and slave girl, they are to be returned to you." Then he scourged his son one hundred lashes and exiled him for one year. Then Unais Al- Aslami was ordered to go to the wife of the second man, and if she confessed (the crime), then stone her to death. She did confess, so he stoned her to death
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Zaid bin Khalid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Do aadmiyon ka jhagda Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saamne aaya. Unmein se ek ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Hamare beech Allah ke Qawaanin ke mutaabik faisla kijiye.' Doosre, jo zyaada aqlmand the, unhone kaha, 'Haan, Aye Allah ke Nabi! Hamare beech Allah ke Qawaanin ke mutaabik faisla kijiye, aur mujhe bolne ki ijaazat dijiye.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Bolo.' Usne kaha, 'Mera beta is (shaks) ka mazdoor tha aur usne iski biwi ke saath zina kiya. Logon ne kaha ke mere bete ko sangsaar (patthar maar-maar kar maara jaana) chaahiye, magar maine use sau bakriyon aur ek launDi dekar fidye mein le liya. Phir maine aalimon se pucha, aur unhone mujhe bataaya ke mere bete ko sau kode maarne chaahiye aur ek saal ke liye jila-watan (nikaal diya jaana) chaahiye, aur us aadmi ki biwi ko sangsaar karna chaahiye.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Beshak, us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, main tumhaare beech Allah ke Qawaanin ke mutaabik faisla dunga: tumhaari bakriyaan aur launDi tumhein wapas ki jaayengi.' Phir unhone uske bete ko sau kode maare aur use ek saal ke liye jila-watan kiya. Phir Unais Al-Aslami ko doosre aadmi ki biwi ke paas jaane ka hukm diya gaya, aur agar wo (gunaah) qubool kare, to use sangsaar kar dena. Usne qubool kiya, isliye unhone use sangsaar kar diya.

e: Narrated Abu Bakra:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do you think if the tribes of Aslam, Ghifar, Muzaina and Juhaina are better than the tribes of Tamim, 'Amir bin Sa'sa'a, Ghatfan and Asad, they (the second group) are despairing and losing?" They (the Prophet's companions) said, "Yes, (they are)." He said, "By Him in Whose Hand my soul is, they (the first group) are better than them (the second group)
hi: Abu Bakra (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kya tumhein lagta hai agar Aslam, Ghifar, Muzaina aur Juhaina (qabeele) Tamim, Aamir bin Sa'sa'a, Ghatfan aur Asad qabeelon se behtar hain, to wo (doosre giroh) nirash aur ghaate mein hain?' Unhone (Nabi ke sahaaba ne) kaha, 'Haan, (wo hain).' Unhone kaha, 'Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, wo (pehla giroh) inse (doosre giroh se) behtar hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Humaid As-Sa`idi:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) employed an employee (to collect Zakat). The employee returned after completing his job and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! This (amount of Zakat) is for you, and this (other amount) was given to me as a present." The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "Why didn't you stay at your father's or mother's house and see if you would be given presents or not?" Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got up in the evening after the prayer, and having testified that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah and praised and glorified Allah as He deserved, he said, "Now then ! What about an employee whom we employ and then he comes and says, 'This amount (of Zakat) is for you, and this (amount) was given to me as a present'? Why didn't he stay at the house of his father and mother to see if he would be given presents or not? By Him in Whose Hand Muhammad's soul is, none of you will steal anything of it (i.e. Zakat) but will bring it by carrying it over his neck on the Day of Resurrection. If it has been a camel, he will bring it (over his neck) while it will be grunting, and if it has been a cow, he will bring it (over his neck), while it will be mooing; and if it has been a sheep, he will bring it (over his neck) while it will be bleeding." The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "I have preached you (Allah's Message)." Abu Humaid said, "Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) raised his hands so high that we saw the whiteness of his armpits
hi: Abu Humaid As-Sa'idi bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek mulaazim (Zakat jama karne ke liye) rakha. Wo mulaazim apna kaam poora karke wapas aaya aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Ye (Zakat ki raqam) aapke liye hai, aur ye (doosri raqam) mujhe tohfe mein di gayi.' Nabi (SAW) ne unse kaha, 'Tum apne waalid ya apni maa ke ghar kyun nahi baithe rahe aur dekha ke tumhein tohfe milte hain ya nahi?' Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) shaam ko namaz ke baad uthe aur ye gawaahi dekar ke Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi, aur Allah ki jaisi tareef aur hamd ki jaani chaahiye waisi ki, unhone kaha, 'Ab, aage! Us mulaazim ka kya jo hum use rakhte hain aur phir wo aakar kehta hai, "Ye (Zakat ki raqam) aapke liye hai, aur ye (doosri raqam) mujhe tohfe mein di gayi"? Wo apne waalid ya apni maa ke ghar kyun nahi raha ye dekhne ke liye ke wo tohfe paata hai ya nahi? Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein Muhammad ki jaan hai, tum mein se koi bhi isme se (Zakat mein se) kuch chura kar nahi le jaayega magar wo use Qayamat ke din apni gardan par uthaakar laayega. Agar wo oont raha hoga, to wo use (apni gardan par) laayega jabke wo bulbulaa raha hoga, aur agar wo gaay rahi hogi, to wo use (apni gardan par) laayega jabke wo raambhati hogi; aur agar wo bakri rahi hogi, to wo use (apni gardan par) laayega jabke wo bhen-bhena rahi hogi.' Nabi (SAW) ne izaafa kiya, 'Maine tumhein (Allah ka paighaam) pahunchaa diya hai.' Abu Humaid ne kaha, 'Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne haath itne ooncha uthaaye ke humne unki baaghal ki safedi dekhi.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Abu-l-Qasim (the Prophet) said, "By Him in Whose Hand Muhammad's soul is, if you know that which I know, you would weep much and laugh little
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu-l-Qasim (Nabi) ne kaha, 'Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein Muhammad ki jaan hai, agar tumhein pata hota jo mujhe pata hai, to tum bahut rote aur kam hansate.'
