e: Narrated Abu Dhar:I reached him (the Prophet (ﷺ) ) while in the shade of the Ka`ba; he was saying, "They are the losers, by the Lord of the Ka`ba! They are the losers, by the Lord of the Ka`ba!" I said (to myself ), "What is wrong with me? Is anything improper detected in me? What is wrong with me? Then I sat beside him and he kept on saying his statement. I could not remain quiet, and Allah knows in what sorrowful state I was at that time. So I said, ' Who are they (the losers)? Let My father and mother be sacrificed for you, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" He said, "They are the wealthy people, except the one who does like this and like this and like this (i.e., spends of his wealth in Allah's Cause)
hi: Abu Dharr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main unke (Nabi ke) paas pahuncha jab wo Kaaba ke saaye mein baithe hue the; wo kah rahe the, 'Wo barbaad ho gaye, Kaaba ke Rab ki qasam! Wo barbaad ho gaye, Kaaba ke Rab ki qasam!' Maine (apne aap se) kaha, 'Mujhe kya hua? Kya mujhme koi kharaabi paayi gayi? Mujhe kya hua?' Phir main unke paas baitha aur wo apni baat dohraate rahe. Main khaamosh nahi reh saka, aur Allah jaanta hai us waqt main kitni pareshaani mein tha. To maine kaha, 'Wo kaun hain (barbaad hone wale)? Mere maa-baap aap par qurbaan hon, Aye Allah ke Rasool!' Unhone kaha, 'Wo ameer log hain, siwaaye us shaks ke jo aisa aur aisa aur aisa kare (yaani apni daulat Allah ki raah mein kharch kare).'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "(The Prophet) Solomon once said, 'Tonight I will sleep with ninety women, each of whom will bring forth a (would-be) cavalier who will fight in Allah's Cause." On this, his companion said to him, "Say: Allah willing!" But he did not say Allah willing. Solomon then slept with all the women, but none of them became pregnant but one woman who later delivered a halfman. By Him in Whose Hand Muhammad's soul is, if he (Solomon) had said, 'Allah willing' (all his wives would have brought forth boys) and they would have fought in Allah's Cause as cavaliers
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, '(Nabi) Sulaiman ne ek baar kaha, "Aaj raat main ninety khawaateen ke saath so-unga, jinmein se har ek Allah ki raah mein ladne wale ek (bhaavi) jaanbaaz ko paida karegi." Isper unke saathi ne unse kaha, "Kaho: Agar Allah chaahe!" Magar unhone 'Agar Allah chaahe' nahi kaha. Sulaiman phir sab khawaateen ke saath soye, magar unmein se koi hamila nahi hui siwaaye ek khaatoon ke jisne baad mein ek aadha-aadmi paidaish diya. Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein Muhammad ki jaan hai, agar unhone (Sulaiman ne) "Agar Allah chaahe" kaha hota (to unki sab biwiyaan ladke janamti) aur wo Allah ki raah mein jaanbaaz banke ladte.'

e: Narrated Al-Bara 'bin `Azib:A piece of silken cloth was given to the Prophet (ﷺ) as a present and the people handed it over amongst themselves and were astonished at its beauty and softness. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Are you astonished at it?" They said, "Yes, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" He said, "By Him in Whose Hand my soul is, the handkerchiefs of Sa`d in Paradise are better than it
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ko resham ka ek kapda tohfe mein diya gaya aur log ise aapas mein dete-lete rahe, uski khoobsoorati aur naramaayi par hairaan hote hue. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Kya tum ispar hairaan ho?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan, Aye Allah ke Rasool!' Unhone kaha, 'Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, Sa'd ke Jannat mein rumaal isse behtar hain.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:Hind bint `Utba bin Rabi`a said, "O Allah's Apostle! (Before I embraced Islam), there was no family on the surface of the earth, I wish to have degraded more than I did your family. But today there is no family whom I wish to have honored more than I did yours." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I thought similarly, by Him in Whose Hand Muhammad's soul is!" Hind said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! (My husband) Abu Sufyan is a miser. Is it sinful of me to feed my children from his property?" The Prophet said, "No, unless you take it for your needs what is just and reasonable
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Hind bint Utba bin Rabi'a ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! (Islam qubool karne se pehle), zameen ki satah par koi aisa khaandaan nahi tha jise main zaleel dekhna chahti thi jitna aapke khaandaan ko chahti thi. Magar aaj koi aisa khaandaan nahi hai jise main aapke khaandaan se zyaada izzat dena chaahti hoon.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Mujhe bhi aisa hi laga, us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein Muhammad ki jaan hai!' Hind ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! (Mera shohar) Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ) kanjoos hai. Kya mujhpar gunaah hoga agar main unki jaayadaad se apne bachon ko khilaaun?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Nahi, jab tak tum apni zarooriyaton ke mutaabik, jo munaasib aur waajib hai wahi lo.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Masud:While Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was sitting, reclining his back against a Yemenite leather tent he said to his companions, "Will you be pleased to be one-fourth of the people of Paradise?" They said, 'Yes.' He said "Won't you be pleased to be one-third of the people of Paradise" They said, "Yes." He said, "By Him in Whose Hand Muhammad's soul is, I hope that you will be one-half of the people of Paradise
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Masud bataate hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) baithe the, ek Yemeni chamde ke tambu par tek lagaaye hue, unhone apne sahaaba se kaha, 'Kya tumhein khushi hogi agar tum Jannat waalon ka ek-chauthai bano?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan.' Unhone kaha, 'Kya tumhein khushi nahi hogi agar tum Jannat waalon ka ek-tihaai bano?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan.' Unhone kaha, 'Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein Muhammad ki jaan hai, mujhe ummeed hai tum Jannat waalon ka aadha hoge.'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:A man heard another man reciting: Surat-ul-Ikhlas (The Unity) 'Say: He is Allah, the One (112) and he was repeating it. The next morning he came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and mentioned the whole story to him as if he regarded the recitation of that Sura as insufficient On that, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "By Him in Whose Hand my soul is! That (Sura No. 112) equals one-third of the Qur'an
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks ne doosre shaks ko Surah Al-Ikhlas (Allah ki Wahdaaniyat) padhte suna: 'Kaho: Wo Allah hai, ek (112)' aur wo ise dohraa raha tha. Agli subah wo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur poori kahaani unhein bataayi jaise ke wo us Surah ki tilaawat ko kaafi na samajhta ho. Isper, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai! Wo (Surah No. 112) Quran ke ek-tihaai ke barabar hai.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Perform the bowing and the prostration properly (with peace of mind), for, by Him in Whose Hand my soul is, I see you from behind my back when you bow and when you prostrate
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Ruku aur sajda sahi tareeke se (sukoon ke saath) karo, kyunke, us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, main tumhein apni peeth ke peechhe se dekhta hoon jab tum ruku karte ho aur jab tum sajda karte ho.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:An Ansari woman came to the Prophet (ﷺ) in the company of her children, and the Prophet (ﷺ) said to her, "By Him in Whose Hand my soul is, you are the most beloved people to me!" And he repeated the statement thrice
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek Ansaari khaatoon apne bachon ke saath Nabi (SAW) ke paas aayi, aur Nabi (SAW) ne unse kaha, 'Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, tum log mere sabse aziz log ho!' Aur unhone ye baat teen baar dohraayi.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) met `Umar bin Al-Khattab while the latter was going with a group of camel-riders, and he was swearing by his father. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Lo! Allah forbids you to swear by your fathers, so whoever has to take an oath, he should swear by Allah or keep quiet
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Umar bin Al-Khattab se mile jabke wo oont-sawaaron ke ek giroh ke saath jaa rahe the, aur wo apne waalid ki qasam khaa rahe the. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Suno! Allah tumhein apne baapon ki qasam khaane se mana karta hai, isliye jise bhi qasam khaani ho, use Allah ki qasam khaani chaahiye ya khaamosh rehna chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:I heard `Umar saying, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me, 'Allah forbids you to swear by your fathers." `Umar said, "By Allah! Since I heard that from the Prophet (ﷺ) , I have not taken such an oath, neither intentionally, nor by reporting the oath of someone else
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Umar ko ye kehte suna, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse kaha, "Allah tumhein apne baapon ki qasam khaane se mana karta hai."' Umar ne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam! Jab se maine ye Nabi (SAW) se suna, maine kabhi aisi qasam nahi khaayi, na jaan-boojh kar, na kisi aur ki qasam ka hawaala dekar.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Do not swear by your fathers
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Apne baapon ki qasam mat khaao.'

e: Narrated Zahdam:There was a relation of love and brotherhood between this tribe of Jarm and Al-Ash`ariyin. Once we were with Abu Musa Al-Ash`ari, and then a meal containing chicken was brought to Abu Musa, and there was present, a man from the tribe of Taimillah who was of red complexion as if he were from non-Arab freed slaves. Abu Musa invited him to the meal. He said, "I have seen chickens eating dirty things, so I deemed it filthy and took an oath that I would never eat chicken." On that, Abu Musa said, "Get up, I will narrate to you about that. Once a group of the Ash`ariyin and I went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and asked him to provide us with mounts; he said, 'By Allah, I will never give you any mounts nor do I have anything to mount you on.' Then a few camels of war booty were brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) , and he asked about us, saying, 'Where are the Ash-'ariyin?' He then ordered five nice camels to be given to us, and when we had departed, we said, 'What have we done? Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had taken the oath not to give us any mounts, and that he had nothing to mount us on, and later he gave us that we might ride? Did we take advantage of the fact that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had forgotten his oath? By Allah, we will never succeed.' So we went back to him and said to him, 'We came to you to give us mounts, and you took an oath that you would not give us any mounts and that you had nothing to mount us on.' On that he said, 'I did not provide you with mounts, but Allah did. By Allah, if I take an oath to do something, and then find something else better than it, I do that which is better and make expiation for the dissolution of the oath
hi: Zahdam bataate hain: Jarm qabeele aur Al-Ashariyin ke beech mohabbat aur bhaichaare ka rishta tha. Ek baar hum Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ashari ke saath the, aur unke paas murgi ka khaana laaya gaya, aur wahaan Taimillah qabeele ka ek shaks bhi maujood tha jo laal rangat ka tha jaise wo azaad kiye gaye gair-Arab ghulaam ho. Abu Musa ne use khaane ki dawat di. Usne kaha, 'Maine murgiyon ko ganda khaate dekha hai, isliye maine ise napaak samjha aur qasam khaayi ke main kabhi murgi ka gosht nahi khaunga.' Isper Abu Musa ne kaha, 'Utho, main tumhein iske baare mein bataata hoon. Ek baar main aur Al-Ashariyin ka ek giroh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaye aur humne unse sawaari maangi; unhone kaha, "Allah ki qasam, main tumhein koi sawaari nahi dunga, aur mere paas tumhein sawaari dene ke liye kuch nahi hai." Phir jang ke maal-e-ganimat mein se kuch oont Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laaye gaye, aur unhone humaare baare mein pucha, kehte hue, "Al-Ashariyin kahaan hain?" Unhone hukm diya ke humein paanch achhe oont diye jaayein, aur jab hum wahaan se gaye, humne kaha, "Humne kya kiya? Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne qasam khaayi thi ke wo humein koi sawaari nahi denge, aur unke paas kuch nahi hai humein sawaari dene ke liye, aur baad mein unhone humein di taake hum sawaari kar sakein? Kya humne is baat ka faayda uthaaya ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apni qasam bhool gaye? Allah ki qasam, hum kabhi kaamyaab nahi honge." To hum unke paas wapas gaye aur unse kaha, "Hum aapke paas sawaari maangne aaye the, aur aapne qasam khaayi thi ke aap humein koi sawaari nahi denge aur aapke paas kuch nahi hai." Isper unhone kaha, "Maine tumhein sawaari nahi di, balke Allah ne di. Allah ki qasam, agar main kisi kaam ke liye qasam khaaun, aur phir mujhe usse behtar koi cheez mile, to main wahi karta hoon jo behtar hai aur qasam todne ka kaffara adaa karta hoon."'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever swears saying in his oath. 'By Al-Lat and Al-`Uzza,' should say, 'None has the right to be worshipped but Allah; and whoever says to his friend, 'Come, let me gamble with you,' should give something in charity
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi apni qasam mein kahe, "Al-Lat aur Al-Uzza ki qasam," use kehna chaahiye, "Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi"; aur jo koi apne dost se kahe, "Aao, main tumse jua khelun," use kuch sadqa dena chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had a gold ring made for himself, and he used to wear it with the stone towards the inner part of his hand. Consequently, the people had similar rings made for themselves. Afterwards the Prophet; sat on the pulpit and took it off, saying, "I used to wear this ring and keep its stone towards the palm of my hand." He then threw it away and said, "By Allah, I will never wear it." Therefore all the people threw away their rings as well
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne liye sone ki ek anguthi banwaayi, aur unhone use is tarah pehna ke uska patthar apne haath ke andar ki taraf ho. Isper, logon ne bhi apne liye waisi hi anguthiyaan banwaayi. Baad mein Nabi (SAW) mimbar par baithe aur ise utaar diya, kehte hue, 'Main ye anguthi pehanta tha aur iska patthar apni hatheli ki taraf rakhta tha.' Phir unhone use phenk diya aur kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, main ise kabhi nahi pehanunga.' Isper sab logon ne bhi apni anguthiyaan phenk di.

e: Narrated Thabit bin Ad-Dahhak:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever swears by a religion other than Islam, is, as he says; and whoever commits suicide with something, will be punished with the same thing in the (Hell) Fire; and cursing a believer is like murdering him; and whoever accuses a believer of disbelief, then it is as if he had killed him
hi: Thabit bin Ad-Dahhak bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi Islam ke ilaawa kisi aur deen ki qasam khaaye, wo waisa hi hai jaisa wo kehta hai; aur jo koi kisi cheez se khudkushi kare, use Jahannam mein usi cheez se saza di jaayegi; aur kisi Momin par laanat bhejna aisa hai jaise use qatl karna; aur jo koi kisi Momin par Kufr ka ilzaam lagaaye, to ye aisa hai jaise usne use qatl kiya.'

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah that he heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Allah decided to test three people from Bani Isra'il. So, He sent an angel who came first to the leper and said, '(I am a traveller) who has run short of all means of living, and I have nobody to help me except Allah, and then with your help.'" Abu Hurairah then mentioned the complete narration
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke unhone Nabi (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, 'Allah ne Bani Israel ke teen logon ki azmaaish lene ka faisla kiya. To usne ek farishta bheja jo pehle kodhi (kushth rog ke mareez) ke paas aaya aur kaha, "(Main ek musaafir hoon) jiske paas jeene ke saare zaraaye khatam ho gaye hain, aur mera Allah ke siwa koi madadgar nahi hai, aur phir aapki madad se."' Abu Huraira ne phir poori riwaayat sunaayi.

e: Narrated Al-Bara:The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered us to help others to fulfill the oaths
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne humein hukm diya ke hum doosron ki qasmein poori karne mein madad karein.

e: Narrated Usama:Once a daughter of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent a message to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while Usama, Sa`d, and my father or Ubai were (sitting there) with him. She said, (in the message); My child is going to die; please come to us." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) returned the messenger and told him to convey his greetings to her, and say, "Whatever Allah takes, is for Him and whatever He gives is for Him, and everything with Him has a limited fixed term (in this world): so she should be patient and hope for Allah's reward." Then she again sent for him swearing that he should come; so The Prophet (ﷺ) got up, and so did we. When he sat there (at the house of his daughter), the child was brought to him, and he took him into his lap while the child's breath was disturbed in his chest. The eyes of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) started shedding tears. Sa`d said, "What is this, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "This is the mercy which Allah has lodged in the hearts of whoever He wants of His slaves, and verily Allah is merciful only to those of His slaves who are merciful (to others)
hi: Usama bataate hain: Ek baar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki ek beti ne unke paas paighaam bheja jabke Usama, Sa'd aur mere waalid ya Ubai unke saath (baithe) the. Usne kaha (paighaam mein), 'Mera bacha marne wala hai; barah-e-meharbaani humaare paas aayiye.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne paighaam-baar ko wapas bheja aur usse kaha ke wo unhein salaam pahunchaaye aur kahe, 'Jo bhi Allah leta hai, wo uska hai, aur jo bhi wo deta hai, wo uska hai, aur uske paas har cheez ki (is duniya mein) muqarrar muddat hai: isliye use sabra karna chaahiye aur Allah ke ajr ki ummeed rakhni chaahiye.' Phir usne dobara unke paas paighaam bheja, qasam dete hue ke wo aayein; to Nabi (SAW) uthe, aur hum bhi uthe. Jab wo wahaan (apni beti ke ghar) baithe, bacha unke paas laaya gaya, aur unhone use apni god mein liya jabke bacche ki saans uski chhaati mein ulajh rahi thi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki aankhon se aansu behne lage. Sa'd ne kaha, 'Ye kya hai, Aye Allah ke Rasool?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Ye wo rehmat hai jo Allah ne apne un bandon ke dilon mein daali hai jinke liye wo chaahta hai, aur beshak Allah apne un bandon par hi reham karta hai jo (doosron par) reham karte hain.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Any Muslim who has lost three of his children will not be touched by the Fire except that which will render Allah's oath fulfilled
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Koi bhi Musalmaan jisne apne teen bacche khoye hon, use Aag nahi chhuegi siwaaye us hadd tak jo Allah ki qasam poori karne ke liye zaroori ho (yaani qasam poori karne ke liye maamooli sa asar).'

e: Narrated Haritha bin Wahb:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Shall I tell you of the people of Paradise? They comprise every poor humble person, and if he swears by Allah to do something, Allah will fulfill it; while the people of the fire comprise every violent, cruel arrogant person
hi: Haritha bin Wahb bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Kya main tumhein Jannat waalon ke baare mein na bataun? Wo har gareeb, aajiz (namrat) shaks hote hain, aur agar wo Allah ki qasam khaaye ke wo kuch karega, to Allah use poora karega; jabke Aag waale har zaalim, sakht-dil, aur ghamandi shaks hote hain.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) was asked, "Who are the best people?" He replied: The people of my generation, and then those who will follow (come after) them, and then those who will come after the later; after that there will come some people whose witness will precede their oaths and their oaths will go ahead of their witness." Ibrahim (a sub-narrator) said, "When we were young, our elder friends used to prohibit us from taking oaths by saying, 'I bear witness swearing by Allah, or by Allah's Covenant
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) se pucha gaya, 'Sabse behtareen log kaun hain?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Mere daur ke log, phir wo jo unke baad aayenge, phir wo jo unke baad aayenge; uske baad kuch log aayenge jinki gawaahi unki qasam se pehle hogi aur unki qasam unki gawaahi se pehle hogi.' Ibrahim (ek ravi) kehte hain, 'Jab hum jawaan the, hamare bade dost humein qasam khaane se mana karte the ye kehte hue, "Main Allah ki qasam khaate hue gawaahi deta hoon, ya Allah ke ahad ki qasam khaate hue."'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever swears falsely in order to grab the property of a Muslim (or of his brother), Allah will be angry with him when he meets Him." Allah then revealed in confirmation of the above statement:--'Verily those who purchase a small gain at the cost of Allah's Covenant and their own oaths.' (3.77) Al-Ash'ath said, "This Verse was revealed regarding me and a companion of mine when we had a dispute about a well
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi jhoothi qasam khaaye taake kisi Musalmaan (ya apne bhai) ki jaayadaad hadap le, Allah usse gussa hoga jab wo usse milega.' Isper Allah ne is baat ki tasdeeq mein naazil kiya: 'Beshak wo log jo Allah ke ahad aur apni qasmon ke badle mein thodi cheez khareedte hain...' (3:77). Al-Ash'ath ne kaha, 'Ye Aayat mere aur mere ek saathi ke baare mein naazil hui thi jab hamara ek kuen ke baare mein jhagda hua tha.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The Hell Fire will keep on saying: 'Are there anymore (people to come)?' Till the Lord of Power and Honor will put His Foot over it and then it will say, 'Qat! Qat! (sufficient! sufficient!) by Your Power and Honor. And its various sides will come close to each other (i.e., it will contract)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jahannam ki Aag ye kehti rahegi, "Kya aur koi (log aane wale) hain?" yahaan tak ke Qudrat aur Izzat ka Rab apna Qadam uspar rakhega, aur phir wo kahegi, "Qat! Qat! (bas! bas!) teri Qudrat aur Izzat ki qasam." Aur uske alag-alag hisse ek doosre ke qareeb aa jaayenge (yaani wo simat jaayegi).'

e: Narrated Az-Zuhri:I heard `Urwa bin Az-Zubair, Sa`id bin Al-Musaiyab, 'Alqama bin Waqqas and 'Ubaidullah bin `Abdullah narrating from `Aisha, the wife of the Prophet, the story about the liars who said what they said about her and how Allah revealed her innocence afterwards. Each one of the above four narrators narrated to me a portion of her narration. (It was said in it), "The Prophet (ﷺ) stood up, saying, 'Is there anyone who can relieve me from `Abdullah bin Ubai?' On that, Usaid bin Hudair got up and said to Sa`d bin 'Ubada, La`Amrullahi (By the Eternity of Allah), we will kill him
hi: Az-Zuhri bataate hain: Maine Urwa bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ), Saeed bin Al-Musaiyab, Alqama bin Waqqas aur Ubaidullah bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا), Nabi ki zawja, ke hawaale se un jhoote logon ki kahaani riwaayat karte suna jinhone unke baare mein wo baatein kahi jo unhone kahi, aur kaise Allah ne baad mein unki paakeezgi zaahir ki. In char ravioon mein se har ek ne mujhe unki riwaayat ka ek hissa sunaaya. (Ismein kaha gaya tha,) 'Nabi (SAW) khade hue aur kaha, "Koi hai jo mujhe Abdullah bin Ubai se raahat de sake?" Isper Usaid bin Hudair khade hue aur Sa'd bin Ubada (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kaha, "La'Amrullahi (Allah ki hamesha rehne wali zaat ki qasam), hum use qatl kar denge."'

e: Narrated `Aisha:regarding: 'Allah will not call you to account for that which is unintentional in your oaths...' (2.225) This Verse was revealed concerning such oath formulas as: 'No, by Allah!' and 'Yes, by Allah!' something against his oath due to forgetfulness should he make expiation?). And the Statement of Allah: 'And there is no blame on you if you make a mistake therein.' (33.5) And Allah said:-- '(Moses said to Khadir): Call me not to account for what I forgot
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain (is Aayat ke baare mein): 'Allah tumhein tumhaari be-iraade ki gayi qasmon ke liye jawaabdeh nahi thehraayega...' (2:225). Ye Aayat aisi qasmon ke alfaazon ke baare mein naazil hui thi jaise: 'Nahi, Allah ki qasam!' aur 'Haan, Allah ki qasam!' (kya koi apni qasam ke khilaaf bhoolne ki wajah se kuch kare to use kaffara adaa karna chaahiye?). Aur Allah ka farmaan: 'Aur tumpar koi ilzaam nahi agar tum ismein galti karo' (33:5). Aur Allah ne farmaaya: (Musa ne Khizr se kaha:) 'Mujhe jawaabdeh mat thehraao jo main bhool gaya.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah forgives my followers those (evil deeds) their souls may whisper or suggest to them as long as they do not act (on it) or speak
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah mere maanne walon ko un (bure) khayaalon ke liye maaf karta hai jo unki jaanein unhein chupke se bataayein ya suzaayein, jab tak wo unpar amal na karein ya unhein zubaan se na kahein.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr bin Al-As:While the Prophet (ﷺ) was delivering a sermon on the Day of Nahr (i.e., 10th Dhul-Hijja-Day of slaughtering the sacrifice), a man got up saying, "I thought, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), such-and-such a thing was to be done before such-and-such a thing." Another man got up, saying, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! As regards these three (acts of Hajj), thought so-and-so." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do, and there is no harm," concerning all those matters on that day. And so, on that day, whatever question he was asked, he said, "Do it, do it, and there is no harm therein
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-As bataate hain: Jab Nabi (SAW) Nahr ke din (10 Zul-Hijja, qurbaani zibah karne ka din) khutba de rahe the, ek shaks khade hokar bola, 'Mujhe laga, Aye Allah ke Rasool, ke falaan cheez falaan cheez se pehle honi chaahiye thi.' Ek aur shaks khade hue aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! In teen (Hajj ke amaal) ke baare mein, mujhe laga falaan-falaan.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Karo, koi harj nahi,' un sab maamlon ke baare mein us din. To us din, unse jo bhi sawaal poocha gaya, unhone kaha, 'Karo, karo, ismein koi harj nahi.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:A man said to the Prophet (while he was delivering a sermon on the Day of Nahr), "I have performed the Tawaf round the Ka`ba before the Rami (throwing pebbles) at the Jamra." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There is no harm (therein)." Another man said, "I had my head shaved before slaughtering (the sacrifice)." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There is no harm." A third said, "I have slaughtered (the sacrifice) before the Rami (throwing pebbles) at the Jamra." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There is no harm
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks ne Nabi (SAW) se kaha (jab wo Nahr ke din khutba de rahe the), 'Maine Jamra par pathhar maarne se pehle Kaaba ka Tawaf kiya.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, '(Ismein) koi harj nahi.' Ek aur shaks ne kaha, 'Maine qurbaani zibah karne se pehle apna sar mundwaaya.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Koi harj nahi.' Ek teesre ne kaha, 'Maine Jamra par pathhar maarne se pehle (qurbaani) zibah ki.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Koi harj nahi.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:A man entered the mosque and started praying while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was sitting somewhere in the mosque. Then (after finishing the prayer) the man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and greeted him. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "Go back and pray, for you have not prayed. The man went back, and having prayed, he came and greeted the Prophet. The Prophet (ﷺ) after returning his greetings said, "Go back and pray, for you did not pray." On the third time the man said, "(O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!) teach me (how to pray)." The Prophet said, "When you get up for the prayer, perform the ablution properly and then face the Qibla and say Takbir (Allahu Akbar), and then recite of what you know of the Qur'an, and then bow, and remain in this state till you feel at rest in bowing, and then raise your head and stand straight; and then prostrate till you feel at rest in prostration, and then sit up till you feel at rest while sitting; and then prostrate again till you feel at rest in prostration; and then get up and stand straight, and do all this in all your prayers
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks Masjid mein daakhil hua aur namaz padhne laga jabke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Masjid mein kahin baithe the. Phir (namaz khatam karne ke baad) wo shaks Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unhein salaam kiya. Nabi (SAW) ne unse kaha, 'Wapas jao aur namaz padho, kyunke tumne namaz nahi padhi.' Wo shaks wapas gaya, aur namaz padhkar wo aaya aur Nabi (SAW) ko salaam kiya. Nabi (SAW) ne unka salaam laut-aate hue kaha, 'Wapas jao aur namaz padho, kyunke tumne namaz nahi padhi.' Teesri baar us shaks ne kaha, '(Aye Allah ke Rasool!) mujhe (namaz padhna) sikhaiye.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Jab tum namaz ke liye khade ho, sahi tareeke se wuzu karo aur phir Qibla ki taraf muh karo aur Takbeer kaho (Allahu Akbar), phir Quran mein se jo tumhein aata hai wo padho, phir ruku karo aur is haalat mein raho jab tak tumhein ruku mein aaraam mehsoos na ho, phir apna sar uthaao aur seedhe khade ho jao; phir sajda karo jab tak tumhein sajde mein aaraam mehsoos na ho, phir baitho jab tak tumhein baithe hue aaraam mehsoos na ho; aur phir dobara sajda karo jab tak tumhein sajde mein aaraam mehsoos na ho; phir uthkar seedhe khade ho jao, aur apni poori namaz mein aisa hi karo.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:When the pagans were defeated during the (first stage) of the battle of Uhud, Satan shouted, "O Allah's slaves! Beware of what is behind you!" So the front files of the Muslims attacked their own back files. Hudhaifa bin Al-Yaman looked and on seeing his father he shouted: "My father! My father!" By Allah! The people did not stop till they killed his father. Hudhaifa then said, "May Allah forgive you." `Urwa (the sub-narrator) added, "Hudhaifa continued asking Allah forgiveness for the killers of his father till he met Allah (till he died)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab mushrik jang-e-Uhud ke (pehle marhale) mein haraa diye gaye, Shaitaan ne chillaaya, 'Aye Allah ke bandon! Apne peechhe se khabardaar raho!' To Musalmaanon ki agli qataarein apni hi peechhe waali qataaron par hamla karne lagi. Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Yaman ne dekha aur jab unhone apne waalid ko dekha, unhone chillaaya, 'Mere waalid! Mere waalid!' Allah ki qasam! Log nahi ruke jab tak unhone unke waalid ko qatl nahi kar diya. Hudhaifa ne phir kaha, 'Allah tumhein maaf kare.' Ravi Urwa ne izaafa kiya, 'Hudhaifa apne waalid ke qaatilon ke liye Allah se maafi maangte rahe yahaan tak ke wo Allah se mile (yaani unka intekaal ho gaya).'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If somebody eats something forgetfully while he is fasting, then he should complete his fast, for Allah has made him eat and drink
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar koi roze ki haalat mein bhool kar kuch khaa le, to use apna roza poora karna chaahiye, kyunke Allah ne use khilaaya aur pilaaya hai.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Buhaina:Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) led us in prayer, and after finishing the first two rak`at, got up (instead of sitting for at-Tahiyyat) and then carried on with the prayer. When he had finished his prayer, the people were waiting for him to say Taslim, but before saying Tasiim, he said Takbir and prostrated; then he raised his head, and saying Takbir, he prostrated (SAHU) and then raised his head and finished his prayer with Taslim
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Buhaina (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein namaz padhaayi, aur pehli do rakat khatam karne ke baad, wo (Tahiyyat ke liye baithne ke bajaaye) uthe aur namaz jaari rakhi. Jab unhone apni namaz khatam ki, log Taslim (salaam pherne) ka intezaar kar rahe the, magar Taslim se pehle, unhone Takbeer kahi aur sajda kiya; phir unhone apna sar uthaaya, aur Takbeer kehte hue, unhone sajda kiya (Sahu, yaani sahv, bhool ka sajda); phir unhone apna sar uthaaya aur Taslim se apni namaz khatam ki.

e: Narrated Ibn Mas`ud:that Allah's Prophet led them in the Zuhr prayer and he offered either more or less rak`at, and it was said to him, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ! Has the prayer been reduced, or have you forgotten?" He asked, "What is that?" They said, "You have prayed so many rak`at." So he performed with them two more prostrations and said, "These two prostrations are to be performed by the person who does not know whether he has prayed more or less (rak`at) in which case he should seek to follow what is right. And then complete the rest (of the prayer) and perform two extra prostrations
hi: Ibn Masud bataate hain ke Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne unhein Zuhr ki namaz padhaayi aur ya to zyaada ya kam rakat padhi, aur unse kaha gaya, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya namaz kam kar di gayi hai, ya aap bhool gaye?' Unhone pucha, 'Wo kya hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Aapne itni rakat padhi.' To unhone unke saath do aur sajde kiye aur kaha, 'Ye do sajde us shaks ko karne chaahiye jise pata na ho ke usne zyaada ya kam rakat padhi hai, jismein use sahi cheez ka pata lagaana chaahiye. Aur phir baaki (namaz) poori karni chaahiye aur do izaafi sajde karne chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Ubai bin Ka'b: that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "(Moses) said, 'Call me not to account for what I forget and be not hard upon me for my affair (with you)' (18.73) the first excuse of Moses was his forgetfulness
hi: Ubai bin Ka'b (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, '(Musa ne) kaha, "Mujhe jawaabdeh mat thehraao jo main bhool gaya, aur mere is maamle mein mujhpar sakhti mat karo (aapke saath)" (18:73), Musa ka pehla bahaana unka bhoolna tha.'

e: Narrated Al-Bara bin Azib that once he had a guest, so he told his family (on the Day of Id-ul-Adha) that they should slaughter the animal for sacrifice before he returned from the ('Id) prayer in order that their guest could take his meal. So his family slaughtered (the animal ) before the prayer. Then they mentioned that event to the Prophet who ordered Al-Bara to slaughter another sacrifice. Al-Bara' said to the Prophet (ﷺ) , "I have a young milch she-goat which is better than two sheep for slaughtering." (The sub-narrator, Ibn 'Aun used to say, "I don't know whether the permission (to slaughter a she-goat as a sacrifice) was especially given to Al-Bara' or if it was in general for all the Muslims.") (See Hadith No. 99, Vol)
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke ek baar unke paas ek mehmaan aaya, isliye unhone apne khaandaan se (Eid-ul-Adha ke din) kaha ke wo namaz se wapas aane se pehle qurbaani ka jaanwar zibah kar dein taake unka mehmaan apna khaana kha sake. To unke khaandaan ne namaz se pehle (jaanwar) zibah kar diya. Phir unhone Nabi (SAW) ko ye baat bataayi, jinhone Al-Bara ko doosri qurbaani zibah karne ka hukm diya. Al-Bara ne Nabi (SAW) se kaha, 'Mere paas ek jawaan doodh-waali bakri hai jo do bakriyon se behtar hai zibah karne ke liye.' (Ravi Ibn Aun kehte the, 'Mujhe nahi pata ye ijaazat khaas taur par Al-Bara ke liye di gayi thi ya sab Musalmaanon ke liye.') (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 99, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated Jundub:I witnessed the Prophet (ﷺ) offering the `Id prayer (and after finishing it) he delivered a sermon and said, "Whoever has slaughtered his sacrifice (before the prayer) should make up for it (i.e. slaughter another animal) and whoever has not slaughtered his sacrifice yet, should slaughter it by mentioning Allah's Name over it
hi: Jundab bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko Eid ki namaz padhaate dekha (aur namaz khatam karne ke baad) unhone khutba diya aur kaha, 'Jisne bhi apni qurbaani (namaz se pehle) zibah ki hai, use uski bhar-paayi karni chaahiye (yaani ek aur jaanwar zibah karna chaahiye), aur jisne abhi tak apni qurbaani zibah nahi ki, use Allah ka naam lekar zibah karni chaahiye.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The biggest sins are: To join others in worship with Allah; to be undutiful to one's parents; to kill somebody unlawfully; and to take an oath Al-Ghamus
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, '(Ye) sabse bade gunaah hain: Allah ke saath doosron ko shareek karna; maa-baap ke saath badsuluki karna; kisi ko na-jaayez taur par qatl karna; aur Al-Ghamus (jhoothi qasam) khaana.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If somebody is ordered (by the ruler or the judge) to take an oath, and he takes a false oath in order to grab the property of a Muslim, then he will incur Allah's Wrath when he will meet Him." And Allah revealed in its confirmation: 'Verily! Those who purchase a small gain at the cost of Allah's covenants and their own oaths.' (3.77) (The sub-narrator added:) Al-Ash'ath bin Qais entered, saying, "What did Abu `Abdur-Rahman narrate to you?" They said, "So-and-so," Al-Ash'ath said, "This verse was revealed in my connection. I had a well on the land of my cousin (and we had a dispute about it). I reported him to Allah's Apostle who said (to me). "You should give evidence (i.e. witness) otherwise the oath of your opponent will render your claim invalid." I said, "Then he (my opponent) will take the oath, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever is ordered (by the ruler or the judge) to give an oath, and he takes a false oath in order to grab the property of a Muslim, then he will incur Allah's Wrath when he meets Him on the Day of Resurrection
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar kisi ko (hukmraan ya qaazi ke) hukm par qasam khaani pade, aur wo kisi Musalmaan ki jaayadaad hadapne ke liye jhoothi qasam khaaye, to wo Allah ke gazab ka shikaar hoga jab wo usse milega.' Aur Allah ne is baat ki tasdeeq mein naazil kiya: 'Beshak wo log jo Allah ke ahad aur apni qasmon ke badle mein thodi cheez khareedte hain...' (3:77). (Ravi ne izaafa kiya:) Al-Ash'ath bin Qais andar aaye, kehte hue, 'Abu Abdur Rahman ne tumhein kya bataya?' Unhone kaha, 'Falaan-falaan.' Al-Ash'ath ne kaha, 'Ye Aayat mere silsile mein naazil hui thi. Mera apne chachazaad ki zameen par ek kuen tha (aur hamara isper jhagda tha). Maine unki shikaayat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ki, jinhone (mujhse) kaha, "Tumhein gawaahi deni chaahiye (yaani zaroori saboot dena chaahiye), warna tumhaare mukhaalif ki qasam tumhaare dawe ko na-jaayez kar degi." Maine kaha, "Phir wo (mera mukhaalif) qasam khaayega, Aye Allah ke Rasool?" Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, "Jise bhi (hukmraan ya qaazi ke) hukm par qasam khaane ko kaha jaaye, aur wo kisi Musalmaan ki jaayadaad hadapne ke liye jhoothi qasam khaaye, to wo Allah ke gazab ka shikaar hoga jab wo Qayamat ke din usse milega."'

e: Narrated Abu Musa:My companions sent me to the Prophet (ﷺ) to ask him for some mounts. He said, "By Allah! I will not mount you on anything!" When I met him, he was in an angry mood, but when I met him (again), he said, "Tell your companions that Allah or Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) will provide you with mounts
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Mere saathiyon ne mujhe Nabi (SAW) ke paas bheja unse kuch sawaari maangne ke liye. Unhone kaha, 'Allah ki qasam! Main tumhein kisi bhi cheez par sawaar nahi karunga!' Jab main unse mila, wo gusse mein the, magar jab main dobara unse mila, unhone kaha, 'Apne saathiyon ko bataao ke Allah ya Allah ka Rasool tumhein sawaari dega.'

e: Narrated Az-Zuhri:I heard `Urwa bin Az-Zubair, Sa`id bin Al-Musaiyab, 'Alqama bin Waqqas and 'Ubaidullah bin `Abdullah bin `Uqba relating from `Aisha, the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ) the narration of the people (i.e. the liars) who spread the slander against her and they said what they said, and how Allah revealed her innocence. Each of them related to me a portion of that narration. (They said that `Aisha said), ''Then Allah revealed the ten Verses starting with:--'Verily! Those who spread the slander..' (24.11-21) All these verses were in proof of my innocence. Abu Bakr As-Siddiq who used to provide for Mistah some financial aid because of his relation to him, said, "By Allah, I will never give anything (in charity) to Mistah, after what he has said about `Aisha" Then Allah revealed:-- 'And let not those among you who are good and are wealthy swear not to give (any sort of help) to their kins men....' (24.22) On that, Abu Bakr said, "Yes, by Allah, I like that Allah should forgive me." and then resumed giving Mistah the aid he used to give him and said, "By Allah! I will never withhold it from him
hi: Az-Zuhri bataate hain: Maine Urwa bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ), Saeed bin Al-Musaiyab, Alqama bin Waqqas aur Ubaidullah bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Uqba ko Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا), Nabi ki zawja, ke hawaale se un logon (jhoote) ki riwaayat karte suna jinhone unke khilaaf bohtaan phailaaya aur unhone jo kaha wo kaha, aur kaise Allah ne unki paakeezgi zaahir ki. In sab ne mujhe us riwaayat ka ek-ek hissa sunaaya. (Unhone kaha ke Aisha ne kaha,) 'Phir Allah ne das Aayaton ko naazil kiya jo isse shuru hoti hain: "Beshak, wo log jo bohtaan phailaate hain..." (24:11-21). Ye sab Aayaten meri paakeezgi ke saboot mein thin. Abu Bakr As-Siddiq, jo Mistah ko unke rishte ki wajah se kuch maali madad diya karte the, unhone kaha, "Allah ki qasam, main Mistah ko kabhi kuch nahi doonga (sadqe mein), unhone Aisha ke baare mein jo kaha uske baad."' Phir Allah ne naazil kiya: 'Aur tum mein se jo neik aur daulatmand hain, unhein qasam nahi khaani chaahiye ke wo apne rishtedaaron ki (kisi bhi tarah ki) madad na karein...' (24:22). Isper Abu Bakr ne kaha, 'Haan, Allah ki qasam, mujhe pasand hai ke Allah mujhe maaf kare,' aur phir unhone Mistah ko wapas wahi madad dena shuru ki jo wo pehle dete the, aur kaha, 'Allah ki qasam! Main use kabhi rokunga nahi.'

e: Narrated Abu Musa Al-Ash`ari:I went along with some men from the Ash-ariyin to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and it happened that I met him while he was in an angry mood. We asked him to provide us with mounts, but he swore that he would not give us any. Later on he said, "By Allah, Allah willing, if ever I take an oath (to do something) and later on I find something else better than the first, then I do the better one and give expiation for the dissolution of my oath
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ashari bataate hain: Main Al-Ashariyin mein se kuch logon ke saath Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaya aur mujhe wo waqt mila jab wo gusse mein the. Humne unse sawaari maangi, magar unhone qasam khaayi ke wo humein koi nahi denge. Baad mein, unhone kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, Allah ne chaaha to, agar main kabhi kisi kaam ke liye qasam khaaun aur baad mein mujhe usse behtar koi cheez mile, to main jo behtar hai wo karta hoon aur apni qasam todne ka kaffara adaa karta hoon.'

e: Narrated Al-Musaiyab:When the death of Abu Talib approached, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to him and said, "Say: La ilaha illallah, a word with which I will be able to defend you before Allah
hi: Al-Musaiyab bataate hain: Jab Abu Talib ki maut nazdeek aayi, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unke paas aaye aur kaha, 'Kaho: La Ilaha Illallah, ek aisa lafz jiske zariye main aapka Allah ke saamne bachaao kar sakoonga.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "(The following are) two words (sentences or utterances) that are very easy for the tongue to say, and very heavy in the balance (of reward), and most beloved to the Gracious Almighty (And they are): Subhan Allahi wa bi-hamdihi; Subhan Allahi-l-'Adhim
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, '(Ye) do jumle (vaakya ya bol) hain jo zubaan ke liye bahut aasaan hain, aur (ajr ki) tarazu mein bahut bhaari hain, aur Rehman-o-Kareem (Allah) ko sabse aziz hain (aur wo hain): Subhan Allahi Wa Bihamdihi; Subhan Allahil-Azeem.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said a sentence and I said another. He said, "Whoever dies while he is setting up rivals along with Allah (i.e. worshipping others along with Allah) shall be admitted into the (Hell) Fire." And I said the other: "Whoever dies while he is not setting up rivals along with Allah (i.e. worshipping none except Allah) shall be admitted into Paradise
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek baat kahi aur maine doosri kahi. Unhone kaha, 'Jo koi is haalat mein mare ke wo Allah ke saath shareek thehraata ho (yaani Allah ke ilaawa doosron ki bhi ibaadat karta ho), wo Jahannam ki Aag mein daakhil kiya jaayega.' Aur maine doosri baat kahi: 'Jo koi is haalat mein mare ke wo Allah ke saath koi shareek na thehraata ho (yaani sirf Allah ki ibaadat karta ho), wo Jannat mein daakhil kiya jaayega.'

e: Narrated Anas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took an oath for abstention from his wives (for one month), and during those days he had a sprain in his foot. He stayed in a Mashrubah (an upper room) for twenty-nine nights and then came down. Then the people said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! You took an oath for abstention (from your wives) for one month." On that he said, "A (lunar) month can be of twenty-nine days
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apni biwiyon se (ek mahine ke liye) door rehne ki qasam khaayi, aur us dauraan unke pair mein moch aa gayi. Wo ekunatees raaton ke liye Mashruba (ek ooparli manzil ka kamra) mein rahe aur phir neeche aaye. Log ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Aapne ek mahine (apni biwiyon se) door rehne ki qasam khaayi thi.' Isper unhone kaha, '(Chaandi) mahina ekunatees dinon ka bhi ho sakta hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Hazim:Sahl bin Sa`d said, "Abu Usaid, the companion of the Prophet, got married, so he invited the Prophet (ﷺ) to his wedding party, and the bride herself served them. Sahl said to the People, 'Do you know what drink she served him with? She infused some dates in a pot at night and the next morning she served him with the infusion
hi: Abu Hazim bataate hain: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Abu Usaid, Nabi (SAW) ke sahaabi, ki shaadi hui, isliye unhone Nabi (SAW) ko apni shaadi ki dawat par bulaaya, aur dulhan ne khud unhein khidmat di.' Sahl ne logon se kaha, 'Kya tumhein pata hai usne unhein kya sharbat pilaaya? Usne raat ko ek bartan mein khajoor bhigo di aur agli subah usne unhein wahi sharbat pesh kiya.'

e: Narrated Sauda:(the wife of the Prophet) One of our sheep died and we tanned its skin and kept on infusing dates in it till it was a worn out water skin
hi: Sauda (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki zawja) bataati hain: Hamaari ek bakri mar gayi aur humne uski khaal ko tan (charma-shodhan) kiya aur usmein khajoor bhigote rahe yahaan tak ke wo ek ghisi hui mashk (paani ki thaili) ban gayi.

e: Narrated `Aisha:The family of (the Prophet) Muhammad never ate wheat-bread with meat for three consecutive days to their fill, till he met Allah
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Muhammad (SAW) ke khaandaan ne lagataar teen dinon tak kabhi gehun ki roti gosht ke saath pet bhar kar nahi khaayi, yahaan tak ke unhone Allah se mulaaqaat ki (yaani intekaal ho gaya).

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Abu Talha said to Um Sulaim, "I heard the voice of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) rather weak, and I knew that it was because of hunger. Have you anything (to present to the Prophet)?" She said, "Yes." Then she took out a few loaves of barley bread and took a veil of hers and wrapped the bread with a part of it and sent me to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). I went and found Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sitting in the mosque with some people. I stood up before him. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me, "Has Abu Talha sent you?" I said, ' Yes. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to those who were with him. "Get up and proceed." I went ahead of them (as their forerunner) and came to Abu Talha and informed him about it. Abu Talha said, "O Um Sulaim! Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has come and we have no food to feed them." Um Sulaim said, "Allah and His Apostle know best." So Abu Talha went out (to receive them) till he met Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came in company with Abu Talha and they entered the house. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O Um Sulaim! Bring whatever you have." So she brought that (barley) bread and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered that bread to be broken into small pieces, and then Um Sulaim poured over it some butter from a leather butter container, and then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said what Allah wanted him to say, (i.e. blessing the food). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then said, "Admit ten men." Abu Talha admitted them and they ate to their fill and went out. He again said, "Admit ten men." He admitted them, and in this way all the people ate to their fill, and they were seventy or eighty men
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Umm Sulaim (رضی اللہ عنہا) se kaha, 'Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki aawaaz kuch kamzor si suni, aur mujhe pata tha ye bhookh ki wajah se hai. Kya tumhaare paas (Nabi ko pesh karne ke liye) kuch hai?' Usne kaha, 'Haan.' Phir usne jau ki kuch rotiyaan nikaali aur apna ek naqaab (dupatta) lekar usse rotiyon ko lapeta aur mujhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas bheja. Main gaya aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Masjid mein kuch logon ke saath baithe paaya. Main unke saamne khada hua. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse kaha, 'Kya Abu Talha ne tumhein bheja hai?' Maine kaha, 'Haan.' Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne saath baithe logon se kaha, 'Utho aur chalo.' Main unse aage nikla (unhein raasta dikhaane ke liye) aur Abu Talha ke paas aaya aur unhein ye baat bataayi. Abu Talha ne kaha, 'Aye Umm Sulaim! Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aa rahe hain aur hamare paas unhein khilaane ke liye khaana nahi hai.' Umm Sulaim ne kaha, 'Allah aur uska Rasool behtar jaante hain.' To Abu Talha (unhein leyne) baahar gaye yahaan tak ke wo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se mile. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Abu Talha ke saath aaye aur wo ghar mein daakhil hue. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Aye Umm Sulaim! Jo bhi tumhaare paas hai wo laao.' To usne wo (jau ki) roti laayi aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne hukm diya ke roti ko chhote-chhote tukdon mein tod diya jaaye, aur phir Umm Sulaim ne usmein ghee ki thaili se kuch ghee daala, aur phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne wo kaha jo Allah ne unhein kehna chaaha (yaani khaane ko barkat di). Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne phir kaha, 'Das aadmiyon ko andar bulaao.' Abu Talha ne unhein andar bulaaya aur unhone pet bhar kar khaana khaaya aur chale gaye. Unhone dobara kaha, 'Das aadmiyon ko andar bulaao.' Unhone unhein andar bulaaya, aur isi tarah, sab logon ne pet bhar kar khaana khaaya, aur wo sattar ya assi log the.

e: Narrated `Umar bin Al-Khattab:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "The (reward of) deeds, depend upon the intentions and every person will get the reward according to what he has intended. So whoever emigrated for the sake of Allah and His Apostle, then his emigration will be considered to be for Allah and His Apostle, and whoever emigrated for the sake of worldly gain or for a woman to marry, then his emigration will be considered to be for what he emigrated for
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, '(Amaal ka) ajr niyaton par nirbhar karta hai, aur har shaks ko wo milega jo usne iraada kiya. Isliye jo koi Allah aur uske Rasool ke liye hijrat kare, uski hijrat Allah aur uske Rasool ke liye maani jaayegi, aur jo koi duniya ke faayde ke liye ya kisi khaatoon se shaadi karne ke liye hijrat kare, uski hijrat usi cheez ke liye maani jaayegi jiske liye usne hijrat ki.'

e: Narrated Ka`b bin Malik:In the last part of his narration about the three who remained behind (from the battle of Tabuk). (I said) "As a proof of my true repentance (for not joining the Holy battle of Tabuk), I shall give up all my property for the sake of Allah and His Apostle (as an expiation for that sin)." The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to me), "Keep some of your wealth, for that is better for you
hi: Ka'b bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) apni un teen logon ke baare mein riwaayat ke aakhri hisse mein bataate hain jo (Tabuk ki jang mein) piche reh gaye the. (Maine kaha,) 'Meri sacchi tauba ke saboot ke taur par (Tabuk ki muqaddas jang mein shaamil na hone ke gunaah ki), main apni saari jaayadaad Allah aur uske Rasool ki raah mein de dunga (uss gunaah ke kaffare ke taur par).' Nabi (SAW) ne (mujhse) kaha, 'Apni kuch daulat rakh lo, kyunke ye tumhaare liye behtar hai.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to stay (for a period) in the house of Zainab bint Jahsh (one of the wives of the Prophet ) and he used to drink honey in her house. Hafsa and I decided that when the Prophet (ﷺ) entered upon either of us, she would say, "I smell in you the bad smell of Maghafir (a bad smelling raisin). Have you eaten Maghafir?" When he entered upon one of us, she said that to him. He replied (to her), "No, but I have drunk honey in the house of Zainab bint Jahsh, and I will never drink it again." Then the following verse was revealed: 'O Prophet ! Why do you ban (for you) that which Allah has made lawful for you?. ..(up to) If you two (wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) turn in repentance to Allah.' (66.1-4) The two were `Aisha and Hafsa And also the Statement of Allah: 'And (Remember) when the Prophet (ﷺ) disclosed a matter in confidence to one of his wives!' (66.3) i.e., his saying, "But I have drunk honey." Hisham said: It also meant his saying, "I will not drink anymore, and I have taken an oath, so do not inform anybody of that
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Jahsh (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki ek zawja) ke ghar mein (kuch waqt tak) rehte the, aur wo unke ghar mein shehad piya karte the. Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) aur maine tay kiya ke jab Nabi (SAW) hum mein se kisi ke paas aayen, wo (khaatoon) kahegi, 'Mujhe aapmein Maghafir (ek badbudaar kishmish jaisi cheez) ki buri khushbu aa rahi hai. Kya aapne Maghafir khaayi hai?' Jab wo hum mein se ek ke paas aaye, usne unse aisa hi kaha. Unhone (usse) jawab diya, 'Nahi, magar maine Zainab bint Jahsh ke ghar shehad piya, aur main isse kabhi phir nahi piyunga.' Phir ye Aayat naazil hui: 'Aye Nabi! Tum kyun mana karte ho (apne liye) jo Allah ne tumhaare liye jaayez kiya hai?... (jab tak) Agar tum dono (Nabi ki biwiyaan) Allah ki taraf tauba karti ho.' (66:1-4) Ye do (khawaateen) Aisha aur Hafsa thi. Aur Allah ka farmaan bhi: 'Aur (yaad karo) jab Nabi (SAW) ne apni ek biwi ko ek raaz chupke se bataaya!' (66:3) yaani unka kehna, 'Magar maine shehad piya.' Hisham kehte hain: Iska matlab ye bhi tha ke unhone kaha, 'Main phir nahi piyunga, aur maine qasam khaayi hai, isliye kisi ko na bataao.'

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Al-Harith:that he heard Ibn `Umar saying, "Weren't people forbidden to make vows?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'A vow neither hastens nor delays anything, but by the making of vows, some of the wealth of a miser is taken out
hi: Saeed bin Al-Harith bataate hain ke unhone Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko ye kehte suna, 'Kya logon ko mannat maangne se mana nahi kiya gaya tha?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Mannat na kisi cheez ko tez karti hai na der, magar mannat maangne se ek kanjoos ki kuch daulat nikaal li jaati hai.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the making of vows and said, "It (a vow) does not prevent anything (that has to take place), but the property of a miser is spent (taken out) with it
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne mannat maangne se mana kiya aur kaha, 'Ye (mannat) kisi bhi cheez ko rokti nahi (jo hona hi hai), magar isse ek kanjoos ki jaayadaad kharch (nikaal) di jaati hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah says, 'The vow, does not bring about for the son of Adam anything I have not decreed for him, but his vow may coincide with what has been decided for him, and by this way I cause a miser to spend of his wealth. So he gives Me (spends in charity) for the fulfillment of what has been decreed for him what he would not give Me before but for his vow
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah farmaata hai, "Mannat Aadam ke bete ke liye kuch bhi nahi laati jo maine uske liye tay na kiya ho, magar uski mannat usse mel kha sakti hai jo pehle se uske liye tay hai, aur isi tarah main ek kanjoos ko apni daulat kharch karne par majboor karta hoon. To wo mujhe (sadqe mein) deta hai us cheez ki poorti ke liye jo uske liye pehle se tay hai, jo wo pehle mujhe nahi deta magar apni mannat ki wajah se."'

e: Narrated Zahdam bin Mudarrab:`Imran bin Hussain said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'The best of you (people) are my generation, and the second best will be those who will follow them, and then those who will follow the second generation." `Imran added, "I do not remember whether he mentioned two or three (generations) after his generation. He added, 'Then will come some people who will make vows but will not fulfill them; and they will be dishonest and will not be trustworthy, and they will give their witness without being asked to give their witness, and fatness will appear among them
hi: Zahdam bin Mudarrab bataate hain: Imran bin Husain (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, "Sabse behtareen log mere (waqt ke) log hain, aur doosre behtareen wo honge jo unke baad aayenge, aur phir wo jo doosri peedhi ke baad aayenge."' Imran ne izaafa kiya, 'Mujhe yaad nahi ke unhone apne daur ke baad do ya teen (peediyon) ka zikr kiya. Unhone izaafa kiya, "Phir kuch aise log aayenge jo mannatein maanenge magar unhein poora nahi karenge; aur wo be-imaan aur na-qaabil-e-bharosa honge, aur wo bina poochhe gawaahi denge, aur unmein motaapa zaahir hoga."'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever vows that he will be obedient to Allah, should remain obedient to Him; and whoever made a vow that he will disobey Allah, should not disobey Him
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi mannat maane ke wo Allah ki farmaanbardaari karega, use uski farmaanbardaari karni chaahiye; aur jo koi mannat maane ke wo Allah ki nafarmaani karega, use uski nafarmaani nahi karni chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:`Umar said "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I vowed to perform I`tikaf for one night in Al-Masjid-al-Haram, during the Pre-Islamic Period of ignorance (before embracing Islam). "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Fulfill your vow." Ibn `Umar said to the lady, "Pray on her behalf." Ibn `Abbas said the same
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Umar ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Maine Islam se pehle Jaahiliyat ke daur mein Masjid-al-Haram mein ek raat ke liye Itikaf ki mannat maani thi.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Apni mannat poori karo.' Ibn Umar ne khaatoon se kaha, 'Uski taraf se namaz padho.' Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne bhi yahi kaha.

e: Narrated Sa`id bin 'Ubada Al-Ansari:that he consulted the Prophet (ﷺ) about a vow that had been made by his mother who died without fulfilling it. The Prophet (ﷺ) gave his verdict that he should fulfill it on her behalf. The verdict became Sunna (i.e. the Prophet's tradition)
hi: Saeed bin Ubada Al-Ansari bataate hain ke unhone Nabi (SAW) se apni maa ki ek mannat ke baare mein salaah li jo unki maut ke waqt poori nahi hui thi. Nabi (SAW) ne faisla diya ke unhein apni maa ki taraf se wo mannat poori karni chaahiye. Ye faisla Sunnat ban gaya (yaani Nabi ki riwaayat).

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said to him, "My sister vowed to perform the Hajj, but she died (before fulfilling it)." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Would you not have paid her debts if she had any?" The man said, "Yes." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "So pay Allah's Rights, as He is more entitled to receive His rights
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unse kaha, 'Meri behen ne Hajj karne ki mannat maani thi, magar wo (poori karne se pehle) mar gayi.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Kya tum uska qarz nahi chukaate agar uspar koi hota?' Us shaks ne kaha, 'Haan.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'To Allah ke haq ada karo, kyunke wo apna haq lene ka sabse zyaada haqdaar hai.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever vowed to be obedient to Allah, must be obedient to Him; and whoever vowed to be disobedient to Allah, should not be disobedient to Him
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi mannat maane ke wo Allah ki farmaanbardaari karega, use uski farmaanbardaari karni chaahiye; aur jo koi mannat maane ke wo Allah ki nafarmaani karega, use uski nafarmaani nahi karni chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah is not in need of this man) torturing himself," when he saw the man walking between his two sons (who were supporting him)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Allah ko is aadmi ke khud ko azaab dene ki koi zaroorat nahi hai,' jab unhone ek aadmi ko apne do beton ke beech chalte hue dekha (jo use sahaara de rahe the).

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) saw a man performing Tawaf around the Ka`ba, tied with a rope or something else (while another person was holding him). The Prophet (ﷺ) cut that rope off
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne ek aadmi ko Kaaba ka Tawaf karte dekha, jo ek rassi ya kisi aur cheez se baandha hua tha (jabke ek doosra shaks use pakde hue tha). Nabi (SAW) ne wo rassi kaat di.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:While performing the Tawaf around the Ka`ba, the Prophet (ﷺ) passed by a person leading another person by a hair-rope nose-ring in his nose. The Prophet (ﷺ) cut the hair-rope nose-ring off with his hand and ordered the man to lead him by the hand
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Kaaba ka Tawaf karte waqt, Nabi (SAW) ek aise shaks ke paas se guzre jo doosre shaks ko baal ki rassi se, jo uski naak mein pehni hui thi, khaench raha tha. Nabi (SAW) ne apne haath se wo baal ki naak ki rassi kaat di aur us aadmi ko hukm diya ke wo use haath se le jaaye.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:While the Prophet (ﷺ) was delivering a sermon, he saw a man standing, so he asked about that man. They (the people) said, "It is Abu Israil who has vowed that he will stand and never sit down, and he will never come in the shade, nor speak to anybody, and will fast.'' The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Order him to speak and let him come in the shade, and make him sit down, but let him complete his fast
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Nabi (SAW) khutba de rahe the, unhone ek aadmi ko khada dekha, isliye unhone us aadmi ke baare mein pucha. Unhone (logon ne) kaha, 'Ye Abu Israil hain jinhone mannat maani hai ke wo khade rahenge aur kabhi baithenge nahi, aur kabhi saaye mein nahi aayenge, na kisi se baat karenge, aur roza rakhenge.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Unhein hukm do ke wo baat karein aur saaye mein aayein, aur unhein bithaao, magar unhein apna roza poora karne dein.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:that he was asked about a man who had vowed that he would fast all the days of his life then the day of `Id al Adha or `Id-al-Fitr came. `Abdullah bin `Umar said: You have indeed a good example in Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He did not fast on the day of `Id al Adha or the day of `Id-al-Fitr, and we do not intend fasting on these two days
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha gaya ek aise aadmi ke baare mein jisne apni poori zindagi roza rakhne ki mannat maani thi, phir Eid-ul-Adha ya Eid-ul-Fitr ka din aaya. Abdullah bin Umar ne kaha, 'Beshak, tumhaare paas Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mein ek achhi misaal hai. Unhone Eid-ul-Adha ya Eid-ul-Fitr ke din roza nahi rakha, aur hum bhi in do dinon mein roza rakhne ka iraada nahi karte.'

e: Narrated Ziyad bin Jubair:I was with Ibn `Umar when a man asked him, "I have vowed to fast every Tuesday or Wednesday throughout my life and if the day of my fasting coincided with the day of Nahr (the first day of `Id-al- Adha), (What shall I do?)" Ibn `Umar said, "Allah has ordered the vows to be fulfilled, and we are forbidden to fast on the day of Nahr." The man repeated his question and Ibn `Umar repeated his former answer, adding nothing more
hi: Ziyad bin Jubair bataate hain: Main Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath tha jab ek shaks ne unse pucha, 'Maine apni poori zindagi har Mangalvaar ya Budhvaar ko roza rakhne ki mannat maani hai, aur agar mere roze ka din Nahr (Eid-ul-Adha ke pehle din) se mil jaaye, (mujhe kya karna chaahiye?)' Ibn Umar ne kaha, 'Allah ne mannaten poori karne ka hukm diya hai, aur humein Nahr ke din roza rakhne se mana kiya gaya hai.' Us shaks ne apna sawaal dohraaya aur Ibn Umar ne apna pehla jawab dohraaya, kuch izaafa kiye bagair.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:We went out in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the day of (the battle of) Khaibar, and we did not get any gold or silver as war booty, but we got property in the form of things and clothes. Then a man called Rifa`a bin Zaid, from the tribe of Bani Ad-Dubaib, presented a slave named Mid`am to Allah's Apostle. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) headed towards the valley of Al-Qura, and when he was in the valley of Al- Qura an arrow was thrown by an unidentified person, struck and killed Mid`am who was making a she-camel of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) kneel down. The people said, "Congratulations to him (the slave) for gaining Paradise." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "No! By Him in Whose Hand my soul is, for the sheet which he stole from the war booty before its distribution on the day of Khaibar, is now burning over him." When the people heard that, a man brought one or two Shiraks (leather straps of shoes) to the Prophet. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A Shirak of fire, or two Shiraks of fire
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein Khaibar ki jang ke din nikle, aur humein maal-e-ganimat mein koi sona ya chaandi nahi mili, balke humein jaayadaad, cheezein aur kapdon ki shakl mein mili. Phir Rifa'a bin Zaid naami ek shaks, jo Banu Ad-Dubaib qabeele ke the, ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Mid'am naami ek ghulaam tohfe mein diya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Al-Qura wadi ki taraf badhe, aur jab wo Al-Qura wadi mein the, ek anjaan shaks ne ek teer chalaaya jo Mid'am ko lagaa aur unhein qatl kar diya, jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki oontni ko bithaa rahe the. Logon ne kaha, 'Mubarak ho use (ghulaam ko), use Jannat mil gayi.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Nahi! Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, us chaadar ke liye jo usne Khaibar ke din, maal-e-ganimat ke baante jaane se pehle, maal-e-ganimat mein se chura li thi, ab uspar jal rahi hai.' Jab logon ne ye suna, ek shaks Nabi (SAW) ke paas ek ya do Shirak (jooton ke chamde ke fite) le aaya. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Aag ka ek Shirak, ya Aag ke do Shirak.'

e: Narrated Ka`b bin 'Ujra:I came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he said to me, "Come near." So I went near to him and he said, "Are your lice troubling you?" I replied, "Yes." He said, "(Shave your head and) make expiation in the form of fasting, Sadaqa (giving in charity), or offering a sacrifice." (The sub-narrator) Aiyub said, "Fasting should be for three days, and the Nusuk (sacrifice) is to be a sheep, and the Sadaqa is to be given to six poor persons
hi: Ka'b bin Ujra bataate hain: Main Nabi (SAW) ke paas gaya aur unhone mujhse kaha, 'Qareeb aao.' To main unke qareeb gaya aur unhone kaha, 'Kya jooein tumhein pareshaan kar rahi hain?' Maine kaha, 'Haan.' Unhone kaha, '(Apna sar mundwaao aur) roza, Sadqa (khairaat), ya qurbaani ke zariye kaffara adaa karo.' (Ravi) Aiyub kehte hain, 'Roza teen din ka hona chaahiye, aur Nusuk (qurbaani) ek bakri ki honi chaahiye, aur Sadqa chhe gareeb logon ko diya jaana chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "I am ruined!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "What is the matter with you?" He said, "I had sexual relation with my wife (while I was fasting) in Ramadan." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Have you got enough to manumit a slave?" He said, "No." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Can you fast for two successive months?" The man said, "No." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Can you feed sixty poor persons?" The man said, "No." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "Sit down," and he sat down. Afterwards an 'Irq, i.e., a big basket containing dates was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) and the Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "Take this and give it in charity." The man said, "To poorer people than we?" On that, the Prophet (ﷺ) smiled till his premolar teeth became visible, and then told him, "Feed your family with it." (See Hadith No. 157, Vol)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Main barbaad ho gaya!' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Tumhein kya hua?' Usne kaha, 'Maine (roze ki haalat mein) Ramzan mein apni biwi ke saath humbistari kar li.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Kya tumhaare paas ek ghulaam azaad karne jitna hai?' Usne kaha, 'Nahi.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Kya tum do mahine lagataar roza rakh sakte ho?' Us shaks ne kaha, 'Nahi.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Kya tum sath gareebon ko khaana khila sakte ho?' Us shaks ne kaha, 'Nahi.' Phir Nabi (SAW) ne unse kaha, 'Baitho,' aur wo baith gaya. Baad mein ek Irq, yaani khajooron se bhari ek badi tokri, Nabi (SAW) ke paas laayi gayi aur Nabi (SAW) ne unse kaha, 'Ise lo aur sadqe mein de do.' Us shaks ne kaha, 'Kya humse zyaada gareeb logon ko?' Isper, Nabi (SAW) itne muskuraaye ke unke agle daant zaahir ho gaye, aur phir unhein bataaya, 'Ise apne khaandaan ko khilaao.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 157, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:A man came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "I am ruined!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "What is the matter?" He said, "I have done a sexual relation with my wife (while fasting) in Ramadan." The Prophet said to him?" "Can you afford to manumit a slave?" He said, "No." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Can you fast for two successive months?" He said, "No." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Can you feed sixty poor persons?" He said, "No." Then an Ansari man came with an Irq (a big basket full of dates). The Prophet said (to the man), "Take this (basket) and give it in charity." That man said, "To poorer people than we, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? By Him Who has sent you with the Truth! There is no house in between the two mountains (of the city of Medina) poorer than we." So the Prophet (ﷺ) said (to him), "Go and feed it to your family
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Main barbaad ho gaya!' Nabi (SAW) ne unse kaha, 'Tumhein kya hua?' Usne kaha, 'Maine (roze ki haalat mein) Ramzan mein apni biwi ke saath humbistari kar li.' Nabi (SAW) ne unse kaha, 'Kya tum ek ghulaam azaad karne ki hasiyat rakhte ho?' Usne kaha, 'Nahi.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Kya tum do mahine lagataar roza rakh sakte ho?' Usne kaha, 'Nahi.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Kya tum sath gareebon ko khaana khila sakte ho?' Usne kaha, 'Nahi.' Phir ek Ansaari aadmi Irq (khajooron se bhari ek badi tokri) lekar aaya. Nabi (SAW) ne (us shaks se) kaha, 'Ise (tokri ko) lo aur sadqe mein de do.' Us shaks ne kaha, 'Humse zyaada gareeb logon ko, Aye Allah ke Rasool? Us Zaat ki qasam jisne aapko Haq ke saath bheja! In do pahaadon (Madina shehar ke) ke beech koi ghar hamse zyaada gareeb nahi hai.' To Nabi (SAW) ne (usse) kaha, 'Jaao aur ise apne khaandaan ko khilaao.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:A man came to the Prophets and said, "I am ruined!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "What is the matter with you?" He said, "I have done a sexual relation with my wife (while fasting) in Ramadan" The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "Can you afford to manumit a slave?" He said, "No." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Can you fast for two successive months?" He said, "No." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Can you feed sixty poor persons?" He said, "I have nothing." Later on an Irq (big basket) containing dates was given to the Prophet, and the Prophet (ﷺ) said (to him), "Take this basket and give it in charity." The man said, "To poorer people than we? Indeed, there is nobody between its (i.e., Medina's) two mountains who is poorer than we." The Prophet then said, "Take it and feed your family with it
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Main barbaad ho gaya!' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Tumhein kya hua?' Usne kaha, 'Maine (roze ki haalat mein) Ramzan mein apni biwi ke saath humbistari kar li.' Nabi (SAW) ne unse kaha, 'Kya tum ek ghulaam azaad karne ki hasiyat rakhte ho?' Usne kaha, 'Nahi.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Kya tum do mahine lagataar roza rakh sakte ho?' Usne kaha, 'Nahi.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Kya tum sath gareebon ko khaana khila sakte ho?' Usne kaha, 'Mere paas kuch nahi hai.' Baad mein ek Irq (badi tokri) khajooron se bhari Nabi (SAW) ko di gayi, aur Nabi (SAW) ne (usse) kaha, 'Ise (tokri ko) lo aur sadqe mein de do.' Us shaks ne kaha, 'Humse zyaada gareeb logon ko? Beshak, iske (Madina ke) do pahaadon ke beech koi hamse zyaada gareeb nahi hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne phir kaha, 'Ise lo aur apne khaandaan ko khilaao.'

e: Narrated Al-Ju'aid bin `Abdur-Rahman:As-Sa'ib bin Yazid said, "The Sa' at the time of the Prophet (ﷺ) was equal to one Mudd plus one-third of a Mudd of your time, and then it was increased in the time of Caliph `Umar bin `Abdul `Aziz
hi: Al-Ju'aid bin Abdur Rahman bataate hain: As-Sa'ib bin Yazid (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Nabi (SAW) ke daur mein Sa' (ek naapne ki ikaai) tumhaare zamaane ke ek Mudd aur ek-tihaai Mudd ke barabar tha, aur phir ise Khalifa Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdul Aziz ke daur mein badha diya gaya.'

e: Narrated Nafi`:Ibn `Umar used to give the Zakat of Ramadan (Zakat-al-Fitr) according to the Mudd of the Prophet, the first Mudd, and he also used to give things for expiation for oaths according to the Mudd of the Prophet. Abu Qutaiba said, "Malik said to us, 'Our Mudd (i.e., of Medina) is better than yours and we do not see any superiority except in the Mudd of the Prophet!' Malik further said, to me, 'If a ruler came to you and fixed a Mudd smaller than the one of the Prophet, by what Mudd would you measure what you give (for expiation or Zakat-al-Fitr?' I replied, 'We would give it according to the Mudd of the Prophet' On that, Malik said, 'Then, don't you see that we have to revert to the Mudd of the Prophet ultimately?)
hi: Nafi' bataate hain: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) Ramzan ki Zakat (Zakat-al-Fitr) Nabi ke Mudd ke mutaabik, yaani pehle Mudd ke mutaabik, dete the, aur wo qasmon ke kaffare ki cheezein bhi Nabi ke Mudd ke mutaabik dete the. Abu Qutaiba kehte hain, 'Malik ne humse kaha, "Hamara Mudd (yaani Madina ka) tumhaare Mudd se behtar hai, aur hum sirf Nabi ke Mudd mein hi koi bartari dekhte hain!" Malik ne mujhse aage kaha, "Agar tumhaare paas koi hukmraan aaye aur Nabi ke Mudd se chhota Mudd tay kare, to tum kaunse Mudd se naapoge jo tum (kaffare ya Zakat-al-Fitr ke liye) dete ho?" Maine jawab diya, "Hum ise Nabi ke Mudd ke mutaabik denge." Isper Malik ne kaha, "To kya tumhein nahi lagta ke aakhirkar humein Nabi ke Mudd ki taraf hi laut-na hai?"'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! Bestow Your Blessings on their measures, Sa' and Mudd (i.e., of the people of Medina)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Aye Allah! Inke (Madina waalon ke) naapne ke paimaanon, Sa' aur Mudd, par apni barkat naazil kar.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If somebody manumits a Muslim slave, Allah will save from the Fire every part of his body for freeing the corresponding parts of the slave's body, even his private parts will be saved from the Fire) because of freeing the slave's private parts
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar koi kisi Musalmaan ghulaam ko azaad kare, Allah uske jism ke har hisse ko Aag se bachaayega ghulaam ke jism ke barabar hisse ko azaad karne ke badle mein, yahaan tak ke uski sharmgaah bhi Aag se bach jaayegi ghulaam ki sharmgaah ko azaad karne ke badle mein.'

e: Narrated `Amr:Jabir said: An Ansari man made his slave a Mudabbar and he had no other property than him. When the Prophet (ﷺ) heard of that, he said (to his companions), "Who wants to buy him (i.e., the slave) for me?" Nu'aim bin An-Nahham bought him for eight hundred Dirhams. I heard Jabir saying, "That was a coptic slave who died in the same year
hi: Amr bataate hain: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: Ek Ansaari aadmi ne apne ghulaam ko Mudabbar (yaani uski maut ke baad azaad hone waala) banaaya, aur uske paas iske siwa koi aur jaayadaad nahi thi. Jab Nabi (SAW) ko ye pata chala, unhone (apne sahaaba se) kaha, 'Kaun mere liye ise (yaani ghulaam ko) khareedna chaahega?' Nu'aim bin An-Nahham ne use aath sau Dirham mein khareeda. Maine Jabir ko kehte suna, 'Wo ek Qibti (Misri) ghulaam tha jo usi saal mar gaya.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:that she intended to buy Barira (a slave girl) and her masters stipulated that they would have her Wala'. When `Aisha mentioned that to the Prophet (ﷺ) ; he said, "Buy her, for the Wala' is for the one who manumits
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain ke unhone Barira (رضی اللہ عنہا) (ek launDi) ko khareedne ka iraada kiya aur uske maalikon ne shart rakhi ke Wala' (azaad kiye jaane ke rishte ka haq) unke paas rahega. Jab Aisha ne ye baat Nabi (SAW) ko bataayi, unhone kaha, 'Use khareed lo, kyunke Wala' us shaks ke liye hai jo azaad karta hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Musa Al-Ash`ari:I went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) along with a group of people from (the tribe of) Al-Ash`ari, asking for mounts. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "By Allah, I will not give you anything to ride, and I have nothing to mount you on." We stayed there as long as Allah wished, and after that, some camels were brought to the Prophet and he ordered that we be given three camels. When we set out, some of us said to others, "Allah will not bless us, as we all went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asking him for mounts, and although he had sworn that he would not give us mounts, he did give us." So we returned to the Prophet; and mentioned that to him. He said, "I have not provided you with mounts, but Allah has. By Allah, Allah willing, if I ever take an oath, and then see that another is better than the first, I make expiation for my (dissolved) oath, and do what is better and make expiation
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ashari bataate hain: Main Al-Ashari qabeele ke kuch logon ke saath Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaya, unse sawaari maangte hue. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, main tumhein sawaari ke liye kuch nahi dunga, aur mere paas tumhein sawaari dene ke liye kuch nahi hai.' Hum jitni der Allah chaahta tha wahaan rahe, aur uske baad, kuch oont Nabi (SAW) ke paas laaye gaye aur unhone hukm diya ke humein teen oont diye jaayein. Jab hum nikle, humme se kuch ne doosron se kaha, 'Allah humein barkat nahi dega, kyunke hum sab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaye the unse sawaari maangne, aur unhone qasam khaayi thi ke wo humein sawaari nahi denge, phir bhi unhone hamein di.' To hum Nabi (SAW) ke paas wapas gaye aur unhein ye baat bataayi. Unhone kaha, 'Maine tumhein sawaari nahi di, balke Allah ne di. Allah ki qasam, Allah ne chaaha to, agar main kabhi qasam khaaun, aur phir dekhoon ke koi doosri cheez pehli se behtar hai, to main apni qasam ka kaffara adaa karta hoon, aur jo behtar hai wahi karta hoon aur kaffara adaa karta hoon.'

e: Narrated Hammad:the same narration above (i.e. 709), "I make expiation for my dissolved oath, and I do what is better, or do what is better and make expiation
hi: Hammad (ravi) bataate hain (upar wali hadees No. 709 jaisi hi riwaayat): 'Main apni todi hui qasam ka kaffara adaa karta hoon, aur jo behtar hai wahi karta hoon, ya jo behtar hai wahi karta hoon aur kaffara adaa karta hoon.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:(The Prophet) Solomon said, "Tonight I will sleep with (my) ninety wives, each of whom will get a male child who will fight for Allah's Cause." On that, his companion (Sufyan said that his companion was an angel) said to him, "Say, "If Allah will (Allah willing)." But Solomon forgot (to say it).
