He slept with all his wives, but none of the women gave birth to a child, except one who gave birth to a halfboy. Abu Huraira added: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If Solomon had said, "If Allah will" (Allah willing), he would not have been unsuccessful in his action, and would have attained what he had desired." Once Abu Huraira added: Allah's Apostle said, "If he had accepted
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: (Nabi) Sulaiman ne kaha, 'Aaj raat main apni ninety biwiyon ke saath so-unga, jinmein se har ek ek ladka paida karegi jo Allah ki raah mein ladega.' Isper unke saathi (Sufyan kehte hain ke unka saathi ek farishta tha) ne unse kaha, 'Kaho, "Agar Allah chaahe" (Allah ki marzi ho to).' Magar Sulaiman ye kehna bhool gaye. Wo sab apni biwiyon ke saath soye, magar unmein se koi khaatoon hamila nahi hui siwaaye ek ke jisne ek aadha-ladka paidaish diya. Abu Huraira ne izaafa kiya: Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Agar Sulaiman ne "Agar Allah chaahe" kaha hota, to wo apne kaam mein nakaam na hote, aur unhein wahi milta jiski wo tamanna kar rahe the.' Ek baar Abu Huraira ne izaafa kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Agar unhone qubool kiya hota...'

e: Narrated Zahdam al-Jarmi:We were sitting with Abu Musa Al-Ash'sari, and as there were ties of friendship and mutual favors between us and his tribe. His meal was presented before him and there was chicken meat in it. Among those who were present there was a man from Bani Taimillah having a red complexion as a non-Arab freed slave, and that man did not approach the meal. Abu Musa said to him, "Come along! I have seen Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) eating of that (i.e., chicken)." The man said, "I have seen it (chickens) eating something I regarded as dirty, and so I have taken an oath that I shall not eat (its meat) chicken." Abu Musa said, "Come along! I will inform you about it (i.e., your oath). Once we went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in company with a group of Ash'airiyin, asking him for mounts while he was distributing some camels from the camels of Zakat. (Aiyub said, "I think he said that the Prophet was in an angry mood at the time.") The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'By Allah! I will not give you mounts, and I have nothing to mount you on.' After we had left, some camels of booty were brought to Allah's Apostle and he said, "Where are those Ash`ariyin? Where are those Ash`ariyin?" So we went (to him) and he gave us five very fat good-looking camels. We mounted them and went away, and then I said to my companions, 'We went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to give us mounts, but he took an oath that he would not give us mounts, and then later on he sent for us and gave us mounts, perhaps Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forgot his oath. By Allah, we will never be successful, for we have taken advantage of the fact that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forgot to fulfill his oath. So let us return to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to remind him of his oath.' We returned and said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We came to you and asked you for mounts, but you took an oath that you would not give us mounts) but later on you gave us mounts, and we thought or considered that you have forgotten your oath.' The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Depart, for Allah has given you Mounts. By Allah, Allah willing, if I take an oath and then later find another thing better than that, I do what is better, and make expiation for the oath.' " (two other narrations through Zahdam as above)
hi: Zahdam Al-Jarmi bataate hain: Hum Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ashari ke saath baithe the, aur humaare aur unke qabeele ke beech dosti aur ehsaanaat ka rishta tha. Unka khaana unke saamne laaya gaya jismein murgi ka gosht tha. Wahaan maujood logon mein Banu Taimillah qabeele ka ek shaks tha jo laal rangat ka tha jaise wo gair-Arab azaad kiye gaye ghulaam ho, aur wo aadmi khaane ke paas nahi gaya. Abu Musa ne unse kaha, 'Aao! Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko usse (yaani murgi ka gosht) khaate dekha hai.' Us aadmi ne kaha, 'Maine unhein (murgiyon ko) kuch aisi cheez khaate dekha hai jise main ganda samajhta hoon, isliye maine qasam khaayi hai ke main murgi (ka gosht) nahi khaunga.' Abu Musa ne kaha, 'Aao! Main tumhein iske baare mein bataata hoon. Ek baar hum Al-Ashariyin ke ek giroh ke saath Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaye, unse sawaari maangte hue, jabke wo Zakat ke oonton mein se kuch baant rahe the. (Aiyub kehte hain, "Mujhe lagta hai unhone kaha ke us waqt Nabi gusse mein the.") Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, "Allah ki qasam! Main tumhein sawaari nahi dunga, aur mere paas tumhein sawaari dene ke liye kuch nahi hai." Jab hum chale gaye, kuch maal-e-ganimat ke oont Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laaye gaye aur unhone kaha, "Wo Ashariyin kahaan hain? Wo Ashariyin kahaan hain?" To hum (unke paas) gaye aur unhone humein paanch bahut mote, achhe dikhne wale oont diye. Humne unpar sawaar hokar unhein chalaaya, aur phir maine apne saathiyon se kaha, "Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas sawaari maangne gaye the, magar unhone qasam khaayi thi ke wo humein sawaari nahi denge, aur baad mein unhone humein di; shaayad Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apni qasam bhool gaye. Allah ki qasam, hum kabhi kaamyaab nahi honge, kyunke humne is baat ka faayda uthaaya ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apni qasam poori karna bhool gaye. Isliye chalo hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas wapas jaayein aur unhein unki qasam yaad dilaayein." Hum wapas gaye aur kaha, "Aye Allah ke Rasool! Hum aapke paas sawaari maangne aaye the, magar aapne qasam khaayi thi ke aap humein sawaari nahi denge, magar baad mein aapne humein di, aur humein laga aap apni qasam bhool gaye." Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, "Jaao, kyunke Allah ne tumhein sawaari di hai. Allah ki qasam, Allah ne chaaha to, agar main qasam khaaun aur baad mein mujhe koi cheez usse behtar mile, to main jo behtar hai wo karta hoon aur qasam ka kaffara adaa karta hoon."' (Zahdam se do aur riwaayaten upar jaisi hi hain.)

e: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin Samura:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "(O `Abdur-Rahman!) Do not seek to be a ruler, for, if you are given the authority of ruling without your asking for it, then Allah will help you; but if you are given it by your asking, then you will be held responsible for it (i.e. Allah will not help you ) . And if you take an oath to do something and later on find another thing, better than that, then do what is better and make expiation for (the dissolution of) your oath
hi: Abdur Rahman bin Samura bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, '(Aye Abdur Rahman!) Hukmraan banne ki koshish mat karo, kyunke agar tumhein bina maange hukmraani di jaaye, to Allah tumhaari madad karega; magar agar tumhein maangne par di jaaye, to tumhein iske liye zimmedaar thehraaya jaayega (yaani Allah madad nahi karega). Aur agar tum kisi kaam ke liye qasam khaao aur baad mein tumhein usse behtar koi cheez mile, to jo behtar hai wo karo aur apni qasam ka kaffara adaa karo.'

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:I became sick so Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr came on foot to pay me a visit. When they came, I was unconscious. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) performed ablution and he poured over me the water (of his ablution) and I came to my senses and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What shall I do regarding my property? How shall I distribute it?" The Prophet (ﷺ) did not reply till the Divine Verses of inheritance were revealed
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main bimar ho gaya, isliye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur Abu Bakr paidal mujhse milne aaye. Jab wo aaye, main behosh tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne wuzu kiya aur wo (wuzu ka) paani mujhpar daala aur mujhe hosh aa gaya, aur maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Main apni jaayadaad ke baare mein kya karoon? Main use kaise baantoon?' Nabi (SAW) ne koi jawab nahi diya jab tak Miraas (waraasat) ki Ilaahi Aayaten naazil nahi hui.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Beware of suspicion, for it is the worst of false tales and don't look for the other's faults and don't spy and don't hate each other, and don't desert (cut your relations with) one another O Allah's slaves, be brothers!" (See Hadith No)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Shak-o-shubha se bacho, kyunke wo sabse bada jhoot hai; aur ek doosre ke aib mat dhoondho, aur ek doosre ki jaasoosi mat karo, aur ek doosre se hasad mat karo, aur ek doosre se rishta mat todo (kata-kati mat karo). Aye Allah ke bandon! Bhai bano!' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees dekhein.)

e: Narrated `Aisha:Fatima and Al `Abbas came to Abu Bakr, seeking their share from the property of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and at that time, they were asking for their land at Fadak and their share from Khaibar. Abu Bakr said to them, " I have heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, 'Our property cannot be inherited, and whatever we leave is to be spent in charity, but the family of Muhammad may take their provisions from this property." Abu Bakr added, "By Allah, I will not leave the procedure I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) following during his lifetime concerning this property." Therefore Fatima left Abu Bakr and did not speak to him till she died
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Fatima (Alayhas Salam) aur Al-Abbas Abu Bakr ke paas gaye, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki jaayadaad mein se apna hissa maangne, aur us waqt, wo Fadak mein apni zameen aur Khaibar se apna hissa maang rahe the. Abu Bakr ne unse kaha, 'Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, "Humaari (Nabiyon ki) jaayadaad waarison mein nahi baanti jaati, aur jo bhi hum chhodte hain, wo sadqe mein kharch kiya jaata hai, magar Muhammad ka khaandaan is jaayadaad se apna khaana-peena le sakta hai."' Abu Bakr ne izaafa kiya, 'Allah ki qasam, main us tareeke ko nahi chhodunga jise maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko apni zindagi mein is jaayadaad ke baare mein amal karte dekha hai.' Isliye Fatima (Alayhas Salam) Abu Bakr ko chhod kar chali gayi aur apni maut tak unse baat nahi ki.

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Our (Apostles') property should not be inherited, and whatever we leave, is to be spent in charity
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Humaari (Rasoolon ki) jaayadaad waarison mein nahi baanti jaani chaahiye, aur jo bhi hum chhodte hain, wo sadqe mein kharch kiya jaana chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Malik bin Aus:'I went and entered upon `Umar, his doorman, Yarfa came saying `Uthman, `Abdur-Rahman, Az-Zubair and Sa`d are asking your permission (to see you). May I admit them? `Umar said, 'Yes.' So he admitted them Then he came again and said, 'May I admit `Ali and `Abbas?' He said, 'Yes.' `Abbas said, 'O, chief of the believers! Judge between me and this man (Ali ). `Umar said, 'I beseech you by Allah by Whose permission both the heaven and the earth exist, do you know that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Our (the Apostles') property will not be inherited, and whatever we leave (after our death) is to be spent in charity?' And by that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) meant himself.' The group said, '(No doubt), he said so.' `Umar then faced `Ali and `Abbas and said, 'Do you both know that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said that?' They replied, '(No doubt), he said so.' `Umar said, 'So let me talk to you about this matter. Allah favored His Apostle with something of this Fai' (i.e. booty won by the Muslims at war without fighting) which He did not give to anybody else; Allah said:-- 'And what Allah gave to His Apostle ( Fai' Booty) .........to do all things....(59.6) And so that property was only for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . Yet, by Allah, he neither gathered that property for himself nor withheld it from you, but he gave its income to you, and distributed it among you till there remained the present property out of which the Prophet (ﷺ) used to spend the yearly maintenance for his family, and whatever used to remain, he used to spend it where Allah's property is spent (i.e. in charity etc.). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) followed that throughout his life. Now I beseech you by Allah, do you know all that?' They said, 'Yes.' `Umar then said to `Ali and `Abbas, 'I beseech you by Allah, do you know that?' Both of them said, 'Yes.' `Umar added, 'And when the Prophet (ﷺ) died, Abu Bakr said, ' I am the successor of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and took charge of that property and managed it in the same way as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did. Then I took charge of this property for two years during which I managed it as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr did. Then you both (`Ali and `Abbas) came to talk to me, bearing the same claim and presenting the same case. (O `Abbas!) You came to me asking for your share from the property of your nephew, and this man (Ali) came to me, asking for the share of h is wife from the property of her father. I said, 'If you both wish, I will give that to you on that condition (i.e. that you would follow the way of the Prophet (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr and as I (`Umar) have done in man aging it).' Now both of you seek of me a verdict other than that? Lo! By Allah, by Whose permission both the heaven and the earth exist, I will not give any verdict other than that till the Hour is established. If you are unable to manage it, then return it to me, and I will be sufficient to manage it on your behalf
hi: Malik bin Aus bataate hain: 'Main Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas gaya, aur unke darwaan Yarfa aaye aur kaha, "Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ), Abdur Rahman, Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Sa'd aapse milne ki ijaazat maang rahe hain. Kya main unhein andar aane doon?" Umar ne kaha, "Haan." To unhone unhein andar aane diya. Phir wo dobara aaye aur kaha, "Kya main Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Abbas ko andar aane doon?" Unhone kaha, "Haan." Abbas ne kaha, "Aye Momineen ke Ameer! Mere aur is aadmi (Ali (Alayhis Salam)) ke beech faisla kijiye." Umar ne kaha, "Main tumhein us Allah ki qasam deta hoon jiski ijaazat se aasman aur zameen dono qaayam hain, kya tumhein pata hai Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha tha, 'Humaari (Rasoolon ki) jaayadaad miraas mein nahi baanti jaayegi, aur jo bhi hum (apni maut ke baad) chhodte hain wo sadqe mein kharch kiya jaayega?' Aur isse Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka matlab khud unse tha." Us giroh ne kaha, "(Beshak), unhone aisa kaha." Umar phir Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Abbas ki taraf mudhe aur kaha, "Kya tum dono jaante ho ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne aisa kaha?" Unhone jawab diya, "(Beshak), unhone aisa kaha." Umar ne kaha, "To mujhe tumse is maamle ke baare mein baat karne do. Allah ne apne Rasool (SAW) ko is Fai' (yaani jang mein bina larai ke jeete gaye maal-e-ganimat) mein se kuch cheez di jo usne kisi aur ko nahi di; Allah ne farmaaya: 'Aur jo Allah ne apne Rasool ko diya (Fai' maal-e-ganimat).........sab cheezein karne ke liye....' (59:6) To wo jaayadaad sirf Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke liye thi. Phir bhi, Allah ki qasam, unhone na to us jaayadaad ko apne liye jama kiya, na tumse roka, balke unhone uski aamdani tumhein di, aur ise tum mein baanta yahaan tak ke jo abhi jaayadaad bachi hai wo reh gayi, jismein se Nabi (SAW) apne khaandaan ke liye saalana kharcha nikaalte the, aur jo bhi bachta, wo wahaan kharch karte jahaan Allah ki jaayadaad kharch ki jaati hai (yaani sadqe waghera mein). Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apni poori zindagi isi tareeke par amal kiya. Ab, main tumhein Allah ki qasam deta hoon, kya tumhein ye sab pata hai?" Unhone kaha, "Haan." Umar ne phir Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Abbas se kaha, "Main tumhein Allah ki qasam deta hoon, kya tumhein ye pata hai?" Unhone dono ne kaha, "Haan." Umar ne izaafa kiya, "Aur jab Nabi (SAW) ka intekaal hua, Abu Bakr ne kaha, 'Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka jaanashin (successor) hoon,' aur unhone us jaayadaad ki zimmedaari li aur use waise hi sambhaala jaise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kiya tha. Phir maine do saal tak is jaayadaad ki zimmedaari li, jismein maine ise waise hi sambhaala jaise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur Abu Bakr ne kiya tha. Phir tum dono (Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Abbas) mere paas isi dawe aur isi maamle ke saath baat karne aaye. (Aye Abbas!) Tum mere paas apne bhatije ki jaayadaad se apna hissa maangne aaye, aur ye shaks (Ali (Alayhis Salam)) mere paas apni biwi ke waalid ki jaayadaad se unka hissa maangne aaya. Maine kaha, 'Agar tum dono chaho, to main tumhein ye is shart par dunga (yaani ke tum Nabi (SAW) aur Abu Bakr ke tareeke ki, aur jaisa main (Umar) ise sambhaal raha hoon, pairvi karoge).' Ab tum dono mujhse iske ilaawa koi aur faisla chahte ho? Suno! Us Allah ki qasam jiski ijaazat se aasman aur zameen dono qaayam hain, main iske ilaawa koi aur faisla nahi doonga jab tak Qayamat na ho. Agar tum ise sambhaal nahi paate, to ise mujhe wapas kar do, aur main tumhaari taraf se ise sambhaalne ke liye kaafi hounga."'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Not even a single Dinar of my property should be distributed (after my deaths to my inheritors, but whatever I leave excluding the provision for my wives and my servants, should be spent in charity)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Meri jaayadaad ka ek Dinar bhi (mere intekaal ke baad) mere waarison mein na baanta jaaye, balke jo bhi main apni biwiyon aur khaadimon ke kharche ke ilaawa chhodun, use sadqe mein kharch kiya jaaye.'

e: Narrated `Urwa:`Aisha said, "When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died, his wives intended to send `Uthman to Abu Bakr asking him for their share of the inheritance." Then `Aisha said to them, "Didn't Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say, 'Our (Apostles') property is not to be inherited, and whatever we leave is to be spent in charity?
hi: Urwa bataate hain: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha, 'Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka intekaal hua, unki biwiyon ne Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko Abu Bakr ke paas bhejne ka iraada kiya taake wo miraas mein apna hissa maangein.' Phir Aisha ne unse kaha, 'Kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne nahi kaha tha, "Humaari (Rasoolon ki) jaayadaad miraas mein nahi baanti jaati, aur jo bhi hum chhodte hain, wo sadqe mein kharch kiya jaata hai"?'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I am more closer to the believers than their own selves, so whoever (of them) dies while being in debt and leaves nothing for its repayment, then we are to pay his debts on his behalf and whoever (among the believers) dies leaving some property, then that property is for his heirs
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Main Momineen ke unse bhi zyaada qareeb hoon jitne wo khud apne aap se hain, isliye jo bhi (unmein se) qarzdaar hokar mare aur kuch bhi apna qarz chukaane ke liye na chhode, to us qarz ko chukaana hamaari zimmedaari hai; aur jo bhi (Momineen mein se) kuch jaayadaad chhod kar mare, to wo jaayadaad uske waarison ke liye hai.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Give the Fara'id (the shares of the inheritance that are prescribed in the Qur'an) to those who are entitled to receive it. Then whatever remains, should be given to the closest male relative of the deceased
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Faraaidh (miraas ke wo hisse jo Quran mein muqarrar hain) unhein do jo unke haqdaar hain. Phir jo bacha rahe, wo mayyat ke sabse qareebi mard rishtedaar ko diya jaana chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas:I was stricken by an ailment that led me to the verge of death. The Prophet (ﷺ) came to pay me a visit. I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have much property and no heir except my single daughter. Shall I give two-thirds of my property in charity?" He said, "No." I said, "Half of it?" He said, "No." I said, "Onethird of it?" He said, "You may do so) though one-third is also to a much, for it is better for you to leave your off-spring wealthy than to leave them poor, asking others for help. And whatever you spend (for Allah's sake) you will be rewarded for it, even for a morsel of food which you may put in the mouth of your wife." I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Will I remain behind and fail to complete my emigration?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If you are left behind after me, whatever good deeds you will do for Allah's sake, that will upgrade you and raise you high. May be you will have long life so that some people may benefit by you and others (the enemies) be harmed by you." But Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) felt sorry for Sa`d bin Khaula as he died in Mecca. (Sufyan, a sub-narrator said that Sa`d bin Khaula was a man from the tribe of Bani 'Amir bin Lu'ai)
hi: Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Mujhe ek bimaari ne jakad liya jisne mujhe maut ke kagaar par pahuncha diya. Nabi (SAW) mujhse milne aaye. Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mere paas bahut jaayadaad hai, aur mera koi waaris nahi siwaaye meri ek beti ke. Kya main apni jaayadaad ka do-tihaai sadqe mein doon?' Unhone kaha, 'Nahi.' Maine kaha, 'Aadha?' Unhone kaha, 'Nahi.' Maine kaha, 'Ek-tihaai?' Unhone kaha, '(Tum kar sakte ho) halaanke ek-tihaai bhi bahut zyaada hai, kyunke apni aulaad ko ameer chhodna behtar hai unhein gareeb chhodne se, jo logon se bheekh maangte phirein. Aur jo bhi tum (Allah ki khaatir) kharch karoge, uska ajr tumhein milega, chaahe wo ek nawaala hi kyun na ho jo tum apni biwi ke munh mein daalo.' Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya main peechhe reh jaunga aur apni hijrat poori nahi kar paunga?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Agar tum mere baad peechhe reh jaate ho, to jo bhi nek amal tum Allah ki khaatir karoge, wo tumhein oonchaai aur bulandi dega. Shaayad tum lambi umar jio taake kuch log tumse faayda uthaayein aur doosre (dushman) tumhaari wajah se nuqsaan uthaayein.' Magar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Sa'd bin Khaula ke liye afsos hua kyunke unka intekaal Makkah mein hua. (Ravi Sufyan kehte hain ke Sa'd bin Khaula Banu Aamir bin Luwaiy qabeele ke ek shaks the.)

e: Narrated Al-Aswad bin Yazid:Mu`adh bin Jabal came to us in Yemen as a tutor and a ruler, and we (the people of Yemen) asked him about (the distribution of the property of ) a man who had died leaving a daughter and a sister. Mu`adh gave the daughter one-half of the property and gave the sister the other half
hi: Al-Aswad bin Yazid bataate hain: Mu'adh bin Jabal (رضی اللہ عنہ) humare paas Yemen mein ek Ustaad aur hukmraan ke taur par aaye, aur hum (Yemen ke logon) ne unse ek aise aadmi ki jaayadaad ki taqseem ke baare mein pucha jo apni ek beti aur ek behen chhod kar mar gaya tha. Mu'adh ne beti ko jaayadaad ka aadha diya aur behen ko doosra aadha diya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Give the Fara'id (shares prescribed in the Qur'an) to those who are entitled to receive it; and whatever remains, should be given to the closest male relative of the deceased
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Faraaidh (Quran mein muqarrar hisse) unhein do jo unke haqdaar hain; aur jo bhi bacha rahe, wo mayyat ke sabse qareebi mard rishtedaar ko diya jaana chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Huzail bin Shirahbil:Abu Musa was asked regarding (the inheritance of) a daughter, a son's daughter, and a sister. He said, "The daughter will take one-half and the sister will take one-half. If you go to Ibn Mas`ud, he will tell you the same." Ibn Mas`ud was asked and was told of Abu Musa's verdict. Ibn Mas`ud then said, "If I give the same verdict, I would stray and would not be of the rightly-guided. The verdict I will give in this case, will be the same as the Prophet (ﷺ) did, i.e. one-half is for daughter, and one-sixth for the son's daughter, i.e. both shares make two-thirds of the total property; and the rest is for the sister." Afterwards we cams to Abu Musa and informed him of Ibn Mas`ud's verdict, whereupon he said, "So, do not ask me for verdicts, as long as this learned man is among you
hi: Huzail bin Shirahbil bataate hain: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) se ek beti, ek bete ki beti, aur ek behen ki (miraas mein hisse ke) baare mein pucha gaya. Unhone kaha, 'Beti ko aadha milega aur behen ko aadha milega. Agar tum Ibn Masud ke paas jaao, to wo tumhein yahi bataayenge.' Ibn Masud se pucha gaya aur unhein Abu Musa ka faisla bataya gaya. Ibn Masud ne kaha, 'Agar main bhi wahi faisla dun, to main bhatak jaunga aur seedhe raah walon mein se nahi rahoonga. Jo faisla main is maamle mein dunga, wo wahi hoga jo Nabi (SAW) ne diya tha, yaani beti ko aadha, aur bete ki beti ko chhathvaan hissa, yaani dono hisse mil kar poori jaayadaad ka do-tihaai; aur baaki behen ke liye.' Baad mein hum Abu Musa ke paas aaye aur unhein Ibn Masud ka faisla bataaya, isper unhone kaha, 'To, mujhse faisle mat maango, jab tak ye aalim aadmi tumhare beech hai.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Give the Fara'id, (the shares prescribed in the Qur'an) to those who are entitled to receive it, and then whatever remains, should be given to the closest male relative of the deceased
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Faraaidh (Quran mein muqarrar hisse) unhein do jo unke haqdaar hain, aur phir jo bhi bacha rahe, wo mayyat ke sabse qareebi mard rishtedaar ko diya jaana chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The person about whom Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If I were to take a Khalil from this nation (my followers), then I would have taken him (i.e., Abu Bakr), but the Islamic Brotherhood is better (or said: good)," regarded a grandfather as the father himself (in inheritance)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Wo shaks jinke baare mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha tha, 'Agar main is ummat mein se kisi ko apna Khalil (khaas dost) banaata, to main use (yaani Abu Bakr ko) banaata, magar Islami bhaichaara behtar hai (ya kaha: achha hai),' wo daada ko waalid jaisa hi maante the (miraas mein).

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:(During the early days of Islam), the inheritance used to be given to one's offspring and legacy used to be bequeathed to the parents, then Allah cancelled what He wished from that order and decreed that the male should be given the equivalent of the portion of two females, and for the parents one-sixth for each of them, and for one's wife one-eighth (if the deceased has children) and one-fourth (if he has no children), for one's husband one-half (if the deceased has no children) and one-fourth (if she has children)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: (Islam ke shuruaati dinon mein), miraas (waraasat) apni aulaad ko di jaati thi aur wasiyat maa-baap ko chhodi jaati thi, phir Allah ne us hukm mein se jo chaaha, use rad kar diya aur faisla diya ke mard ko do khawaateen ke barabar hissa milega, aur maa-baap ke liye har ek ko chhathvaan hissa, aur biwi ke liye aathvaan hissa (agar mayyat ki aulaad ho) aur chauthaai hissa (agar aulaad na ho), shohar ke liye aadha hissa (agar mayyat ki aulaad na ho) aur chauthaai hissa (agar uski aulaad ho).

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave the judgment that a male or female slave should be given in Qisas for an abortion case of a woman from the tribe of Bani Lihyan (as blood money for the fetus) but the lady on whom the penalty had been imposed died, so the Prophets ordered that her property be inherited by her offspring and her husband and that the penalty be paid by her Asaba
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne faisla diya ke ek ghulaam ya launDi Qisas mein dee jaaye Banu Lihyan qabeele ki ek khaatoon ke garbh-paat (miscarriage) ke maamle mein (jaanin ke khoon-bahe ke taur par), magar jispar ye saza lagaayi gayi thi wo khud mar gayi, isliye Nabi (SAW) ne hukm diya ke uski jaayadaad uski aulaad aur shohar ko miraas mein mile, aur ye saza uske Asaba (baap ki taraf ke rishtedaar) ko adaa karni chaahiye.

e: Narrated Al-Aswad:Mu`adh bin Jabal gave this verdict for us in the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). One-half of the inheritance is to be given to the daughter and the other half to the sister. Sulaiman said: Mu`adh gave a verdict for us, but he did not mention that it was so in the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
hi: Al-Aswad bataate hain: Mu'adh bin Jabal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zindagi mein humein ye faisla diya. Miraas ka aadha hissa beti ko diya jaayega aur doosra aadha behen ko. Ravi Sulaiman kehte hain: Mu'adh ne humein faisla diya, magar unhone zikr nahi kiya ke ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zindagi mein tha.

e: Narrated Huzail:`Abdullah said, "The judgment I will give in this matter will be like the judgment of the Prophet, i.e. one-half is for the daughter and one-sixth for the son's daughter and the rest of the inheritance for the sister
hi: Huzail bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Jo faisla main is maamle mein doonga, wo Nabi (SAW) ke faisle jaisa hoga, yaani beti ke liye aadha aur bete ki beti ke liye chhathvaan hissa, aur baaki miraas behen ke liye.'

e: Narrated Jabir:While I was sick, the Prophet (ﷺ) entered upon me and asked for some water to perform ablution, and after he had finished his ablution, he sprinkled some water of his ablution over me, whereupon I became conscious and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have sisters." Then the Divine Verses regarding the laws of inheritance were revealed
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab main bimar tha, Nabi (SAW) mere paas aaye aur wuzu karne ke liye kuch paani maangaya, aur wuzu khatam karne ke baad, unhone wuzu ka kuch paani mujhpar chhidka, isper mujhe hosh aa gaya aur maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Meri kuch behnein hain.' Phir miraas ke qawaanin ke baare mein Ilaahi Aayaten naazil hui.

e: Narrated Al-Bara:The last Qur'anic Verse that was revealed (to the Prophet) was the final Verse of Surat-an-Nisa, i.e., 'They ask you for a legal verdict Say: Allah directs (thus) About those who leave No descendants or ascendants as heirs
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: (Nabi par) naazil ki gayi aakhri Quran ki Aayat, Surah An-Nisa ki aakhri Aayat thi, yaani 'Wo tumse Fatwa (kanooni faisla) maangte hain. Kaho: Allah ye faisla deta hai (in logon ke baare mein) jo waaris nahi chhodte na aulaad na ma-baap...'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I am more closer to the believers than their ownselves, so whoever (among them) dies leaving some inheritance, his inheritance will be given to his 'Asaba, and whoever dies leaving a debt or dependants or destitute children, then I am their supporter
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Main Momineen ke unse bhi zyaada qareeb hoon jitne wo khud apne aap se hain, isliye jo bhi (unmein se) kuch miraas chhod kar mare, uski miraas uske Asaba (baap ki taraf ke rishtedaaron) ko di jaayegi, aur jo bhi qarz ya laachaar bacche chhod kar mare, to main unka sahaara hoon.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Give the Fara'id (the shares of the inheritance that are prescribed in the Qur'an) to those who are entitled to receive it; and whatever is left should be given to the closest male relative of the deceased
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Faraaidh (miraas ke wo hisse jo Quran mein muqarrar hain) unhein do jo unke haqdaar hain; aur jo bhi bacha rahe, wo mayyat ke sabse qareebi mard rishtedaar ko diya jaana chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Regarding the Holy Verse:--'And to everyone, We have appointed heirs..' And:-- (4.33) 'To those also to Whom your right hands have pledged.' (4.33) When the emigrants came to Medina, the Ansar used to be the heir of the emigrants (and vice versa) instead of their own kindred by blood (Dhawl-l-arham), and that was because of the bond of brotherhood which the Prophet (ﷺ) had established between them, i.e. the Ansar and the emigrants. But when the Divine Verse:-- 'And to everyone We have appointed heirs,' (4.33) was revealed, it cancelled the other, order i.e. 'To those also, to whom Your right hands have pledged
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain (is paak Aayat ke baare mein): 'Aur har kisi ke liye, humne waaris muqarrar kiye hain...' aur: (4:33) 'Un logon ke liye bhi jinse tumhaare daaen haathon ne ahad kiya hai.' (4:33) Jab Muhaajireen Madina aaye, Ansaar Muhaajireen ke waaris huaa karte the (aur ulta bhi) unke khoon ke rishtedaaron (Dhawil-arham) ki jagah, aur ye us bhaichaare ke rishte ki wajah se tha jo Nabi (SAW) ne unke beech qaayam kiya tha, yaani Ansaar aur Muhaajireen ke beech. Magar jab paak Aayat: 'Aur har kisi ke liye humne waaris muqarrar kiye hain,' (4:33) naazil hui, usne doosri wyavastha (yaani 'un logon ke liye bhi jinse tumhaare daaen haathon ne ahad kiya hai') ko rad kar diya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:A man and his wife had a case of Lian (or Mula'ana) during the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) and the man denied the paternity of her child. The Prophet (ﷺ) gave his verdict for their separation (divorce) and then the child was regarded as belonging to the wife only
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek aadmi aur uski biwi ke beech Nabi (SAW) ki zindagi mein Li'an (ya Mula'ana, dono taraf se qasam khaakar zina ka ilzaam) ka maamla hua, aur us aadmi ne uske bacche ki apni sant-aan hone se inkaar kiya. Nabi (SAW) ne unki judaai (talaaq) ka faisla diya, aur phir bacha sirf maa (biwi) ka maana gaya.

e: Narrated `Aisha:`Utba (bin Abi Waqqas) said to his brother Sa`d, "The son of the slave girl of Zam`a is my son, so be his custodian." So when it was the year of the Conquest of Mecca, Sa`d took that child and said, "He is my nephew, and my brother told me to be his custodian." On that, 'Abu bin Zam`a got up and said, 'but the child is my brother, and the son of my father's slave girl as he was born on his bed." So they both went to the Prophet. Sa`d said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! (This is) the son of my brother and he told me to be his custodian." Then 'Abu bin Zam`a said, "(But he is) my brother and the son of the slave girl of my father, born on his bed." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "This child is for you. O 'Abu bin Zam`a, as the child is for the owner of the bed, and the adulterer receives the stones." He then ordered (his wife) Sauda bint Zam`a to cover herself before that boy as he noticed the boy's resemblance to `Utba. Since then the boy had never seen Sauda till he died
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Utba (bin Abi Waqqas) ne apne bhai Sa'd se kaha, 'Zam'a ki launDi ka beta mera beta hai, isliye uska sarparast bano.' To jab Fatah-e-Makkah ka saal aaya, Sa'd ne us bacche ko liya aur kaha, 'Ye mera bhatija hai, aur mere bhai ne mujhse kaha ke main uska sarparast banun.' Isper, Abd bin Zam'a khade hue aur kaha, 'Magar ye bacha mera bhai hai, aur mere waalid ki launDi ka beta hai, kyunke wo unke bistar par paida hua tha.' To dono Nabi (SAW) ke paas gaye. Sa'd ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! (Ye) mere bhai ka beta hai aur unhone mujhse kaha ke main uska sarparast banun.' Phir Abd bin Zam'a ne kaha, '(Magar wo) mera bhai hai aur mere waalid ki launDi ka beta, unke bistar par paida hua.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Ye bacha tumhaara hai, Aye Abd bin Zam'a, kyunke bacha bistar ke maalik ka hota hai, aur zina karne wale ko pathhar milte hain.' Phir unhone (apni biwi) Sauda (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Zam'a ko hukm diya ke wo us ladke ke saamne parda kare, kyunke unhone bacche mein Utba ki jhalak dekhi thi. Us waqt se, us ladke ne apni maut tak Sauda ko kabhi nahi dekha.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The boy is for the owner of the bed
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ladka bistar ke maalik ka hota hai.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:I bought Barira (a female slave). The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to me), "Buy her as the Wala' is for the manumitted." Once she was given a sheep (in charity). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It (the sheep) is a charitable gift for her (Barira) and a gift for us." Al-Hakam said, "Barira's husband was a free man." Ibn `Abbas said, 'When I saw him, he was a slave
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine Barira (رضی اللہ عنہا) (ek launDi) ko khareeda. Nabi (SAW) ne (mujhse) kaha, 'Use khareedo, kyunke Wala' azaad karne wale ke liye hai.' Ek baar unhein ek bakri (sadqe mein) di gayi. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Ye (bakri) unke (Barira ke) liye ek sadqa hai aur hamare liye ek tohfa hai.' Al-Hakam ne kaha, 'Barira ke shohar ek azaad aadmi the.' Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Jab maine unhein dekha, wo ek ghulaam the.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The Wala' is for the manumitted (of the slave)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Wala' ghulaam ko azaad karne wale ke liye hai.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Muslims did not free slaves as Sa'iba, but the People of the Pre-Islamic Period of Ignorance used to do so
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Musalmaan apne ghulaamon ko Sa'iba (poori tarah azaad, bina kisi zimmedaari ke) ke taur par azaad nahi karte the, magar Jaahiliyat (Islam se pehle) ke daur ke log aisa karte the.

e: Narrated Al-Aswad:`Aisha bought Barira in order to manumit her, but her masters stipulated that her Wala' (after her death) would be for them. `Aisha said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have bought Barira in order to manumit her, but her masters stipulated that her Wala' will be for them." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Manumit her as the Wala is for the one who manumits (the slave)," or said, "The one who pays her price." Then `Aisha bought and manumitted her. After that, Barira was given the choice (by the Prophet) (to stay with her husband or leave him). She said, "If he gave me so much and so much (money) I would not stay with him." (Al-Aswad added: Her husband was a free man.) The sub-narrator added: The series of the narrators of Al-Aswad's statement is incomplete. The statement of Ibn `Abbas, i.e., when I saw him he was a slave, is more authentic
hi: Al-Aswad bataate hain: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne Barira (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko khareeda taake unhein azaad kar sakein, magar unke maalikon ne shart rakhi ke unka Wala' (unki maut ke baad) unke paas rahega. Aisha ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Maine Barira ko azaad karne ke liye khareeda hai, magar unke maalikon ne shart rakhi hai ke unka Wala' unke paas rahega.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Unhein azaad kar do, kyunke Wala' us shaks ke liye hai jo azaad karta hai,' ya kaha, 'jo unki keemat adaa karta hai.' Phir Aisha ne unhein khareeda aur azaad kar diya. Iske baad, Barira ko (Nabi ke zariye) ikhtiyaar diya gaya (apne shohar ke saath rehne ya use chhod dene ka). Unhone kaha, 'Agar wo mujhe itna aur itna (paisa) de, main uske saath nahi rahoongi.' (Al-Aswad ne izaafa kiya: Unka shohar ek azaad aadmi tha.) Ravi ne izaafa kiya: Al-Aswad ke bayaan ke raviyon ki silsila poori nahi hai. Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ka bayaan, yaani 'jab maine unhein dekha wo ek ghulaam the,' zyaada mustanad hai.

e: Narrated `Ali:We have no Book to recite except the Book of Allah (Qur'an) and this paper. Then `Ali took out the paper, and behold ! There was written in it, legal verdicts about the retaliation for wounds, the ages of the camels (to be paid as Zakat or as blood money). In it was also written: 'Medina is a sanctuary from Air (mountain) to Thaur (mountain). So whoever innovates in it an heresy (something new in religion) or commits a crime in it or gives shelter to such an innovator, will incur the curse of Allah, the angels and all the people, and none of his compulsory or optional good deeds will be accepted on the Day of Resurrection. And whoever (a freed slave) takes as his master (i.e. be-friends) some people other than hi real masters without the permission of his real masters, will incur the curse of Allah, the angels and all the people, and none of his compulsory, or optional good deeds will be accepted on the Day of Resurrection. And the asylum granted by any Muslim is to be secured by all the Muslims, even if it is granted by one of the lowest social status among them; and whoever betrays a Muslim, in this respect will incur the curse of Allah, the angels, and all the people, and none of his Compulsory or optional good deeds will be accepted on the Day of Resurrection
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Humare paas Allah ki Kitaab (Quran) aur is kaagaz ke ilaawa padhne ke liye koi Kitaab nahi hai. Phir Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne wo kaagaz nikaala, aur dekho! Usmein likha tha zakhmon ke badle ki qanooni faisle, oonton ki umrein (jo Zakat ya khoon-bahe ke taur par di jaayein). Usmein ye bhi likha tha: 'Madina ek panaah-gah hai Air (pahaad) se Thaur (pahaad) tak. Isliye jo koi ismein bidaat (deen mein koi nayi cheez) daakhil kare ya jurm kare, ya aise bidaat karne wale ko panaah de, uspar Allah, farishton aur sab logon ki laanat hogi, aur Qayamat ke din uska koi farz ya nafl nek amal qubool nahi hoga. Aur jo koi (azaad kiya gaya ghulaam) apne asal maalikon ke ilaawa kisi aur ko apna aaqa (dost) banaaye, unki ijaazat ke bagair, uspar Allah, farishton aur sab logon ki laanat hogi, aur Qayamat ke din uska koi farz ya nafl nek amal qubool nahi hoga. Aur kisi bhi Musalmaan ka diya hua panaah (asylum) sab Musalmaanon ko mehfooz rakhna chaahiye, chaahe ye unmein se kisi sabse nichle darje ke shaks ne diya ho; aur jo koi kisi Musalmaan ko is silsile mein dhoka de, uspar Allah, farishton aur sab logon ki laanat hogi, aur Qayamat ke din uska koi farz ya nafl nek amal qubool nahi hoga.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the selling of the Wala' (of slaves) or giving it as a present
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne (ghulaamon ke) Wala' ko bechne ya tohfe mein dene se mana kiya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:That Aisha, the mother of the Believers, intended to buy a slave girl in order to manumit her. The slave girl's master said, "We are ready to sell her to you on the condition that her Wala should be for us." Aisha mentioned that to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who said, "This (condition) should not prevent you from buying her, for the Wala is for the one who manumits (the slave)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا), Ummul-Momineen, ne ek launDi ko azaad karne ke liye khareedne ka iraada kiya. LaunDi ke maalik ne kaha, 'Hum ise aapko bechne ke liye taiyaar hain is shart par ke uska Wala' hamare paas rahega.' Aisha ne ye baat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko bataayi, jinhone kaha, 'Ye (shart) tumhein use khareedne se rokna nahi chaahiye, kyunke Wala' us shaks ke liye hai jo azaad karta hai.'

e: Narrated Al-Aswad:Aisha said, "I bought Barira and her masters stipulated that the Wala would be for them." Aisha mentioned that to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he said, "Manumit her, as the Wala is for the one who gives the silver (i.e. pays the price for freeing the slave)." Aisha added, "So I manumitted her. After that, the Prophet caller her (Barira) and gave her the choice to go back to her husband or not. She said, "If he gave me so much and so much (money) I would not stay with him." So she selected her ownself (i.e. refused to go back to her husband)
hi: Al-Aswad bataate hain: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha, 'Maine Barira (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko khareeda aur unke maalikon ne shart rakhi ke Wala' unke paas rahega.' Aisha ne ye baat Nabi (SAW) ko bataayi aur unhone kaha, 'Unhein azaad kar do, kyunke Wala' us shaks ke liye hai jo chaandi deta hai (yaani ghulaam ko azaad karne ke liye keemat adaa karta hai).' Aisha ne izaafa kiya, 'To maine unhein azaad kar diya. Iske baad, Nabi (SAW) ne unhein (Barira ko) bulaaya aur unhein apne shohar ke paas wapas jaane ya na jaane ka ikhtiyaar diya. Unhone kaha, "Agar wo mujhe itna aur itna (paisa) de, main uske saath nahi rahoongi." To unhone apna faisla khud liya (yaani apne shohar ke paas wapas jaane se inkaar kiya).'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:When Aisha intended to buy Barira, she said to the Prophet, "Barira's masters stipulated that they will have the Wala." The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to Aisha), "Buy her, as the Wala is for the one who manumits
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne Barira (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko khareedne ka iraada kiya, unhone Nabi (SAW) se kaha, 'Barira ke maalikon ne shart rakhi hai ke unke paas Wala' rahega.' Nabi (SAW) ne (Aisha se) kaha, 'Use khareedo, kyunke Wala' us shaks ke liye hai jo azaad karta hai.'

e: Narrated Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The wala is for the one who gives the silver (pays the price) and does the favor (of manumission after paying the price)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Wala' us shaks ke liye hai jo chaandi deta hai (keemat adaa karta hai) aur (azaad karne ka) ehsaan karta hai.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The freed slave belongs to the people who have freed him," or said something similar
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Azaad kiya gaya ghulaam unhi logon ka hota hai jinhone use azaad kiya,' ya isi jaisa kuch kaha.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The son of the sister of some people is from them or from their own selves
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kisi qaum ki behen ka beta un logon mein se hi (maana jaata) hai, ya un logon mein se hi maana jaata hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, " If somebody dies (among the Muslims) leaving some property, the property will go to his heirs; and if he leaves a debt or dependants, we will take care of them
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar koi (Musalmaanon mein se) kuch jaayadaad chhod kar mare, to wo jaayadaad uske waarison ko jaayegi; aur agar wo qarz ya laachaar log chhod jaaye, to hum unka khayaal rakhenge.'

e: Narrated Usama bin Zaid:the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A Muslim cannot be the heir of a disbeliever, nor can a disbeliever be the heir of a Muslim
hi: Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Musalmaan kaafir ka waaris nahi ho sakta, na hi kaafir Musalmaan ka waaris ho sakta hai.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas and 'Abu bin Zam`a had a dispute over a boy. Sa`d said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! This (boy) is the son of my brother, `Utba bin Abi Waqqas who told me to be his custodian as he was his son. Please notice to whom he bears affinity." And 'Abu bin Zam`a said, "This is my brother, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! He was born on my father's bed by his slave girl." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) looked at the boy and noticed evident resemblance between him and `Utba, so he said, "He (the toy) is for you, O 'Abu bin Zam`a, for the boy is for the owner of the bed, and the stone is for the adulterer. Screen yourself before the boy, O Sauda bint Zam`a." `Aisha added: Since then he had never seen Sauda
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Abd bin Zam'a ke beech ek ladke ko lekar jhagda hua. Sa'd ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Ye (ladka) mere bhai, Utba bin Abi Waqqas, ka beta hai jisne mujhse kaha tha ke main uska sarparast banun kyunke wo unka beta tha. Barah-e-meharbaani dekhiye wo kis se milta-julta hai.' Aur Abd bin Zam'a ne kaha, 'Ye mera bhai hai, Aye Allah ke Rasool! Wo mere waalid ke bistar par unki launDi se paida hua tha.' Phir Nabi (SAW) ne ladke ko dekha aur Utba se uski saaf jhalak paayi, isliye unhone kaha, 'Ye (ladka) tumhaara hai, Aye Abd bin Zam'a, kyunke ladka bistar ke maalik ka hota hai, aur pathhar zina karne wale ke liye hai. Ladke ke saamne apne aap ko dhaanko, Aye Sauda (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Zam'a.' Aisha ne izaafa kiya: Us waqt se, unhone (ladke ne) Sauda ko kabhi nahi dekha.

e: Narrated Sa`d:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Whoever claims to be the son of a person other than his father, and he knows that person is not his father, then Paradise will be forbidden for him." I mentioned that to Abu Bakra, and he said, "My ears heard that and my heart memorized it from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
hi: Sa'd bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Jo koi apne baap ke ilaawa kisi aur ka beta hone ka dawa kare, aur use pata ho ke wo shaks uska baap nahi hai, to uspar Jannat haraam kar di jaayegi.' Maine ye baat Abu Bakra (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko bataayi, aur unhone kaha, 'Mere kaanon ne wo suna aur mere dil ne use Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se yaad kar liya.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not deny your fathers (i.e. claim to be the sons of persons other than your fathers), and whoever denies his father, is charged with disbelief
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Apne baapon ka inkaar mat karo (yaani apne asal baap ke ilaawa kisi aur ka beta hone ka dawa mat karo), aur jo koi apne baap ka inkaar kare, use Kufr ka ilzaam lagaaya jaata hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "There were two women with whom there were their two sons. A wolf came and took away the son of one of them. That lady said to her companion, 'The wolf has taken your son.' The other said, 'But it has taken your son.' So both of them sought the judgment of (the Prophet) David who judged that the boy should be given to the older lady. Then both of them went to (the Prophet) Solomon, son of David and informed him of the case. Solomon said, 'Give me a knife so that I may cut the child into two portions and give one half to each of you.' The younger lady said, 'Do not do so; may Allah bless you ! He is her child.' On that, he gave the child to the younger lady." Abu Huraira added: By Allah! I had never heard the word 'Sakkin' as meaning knife, except on that day, for we used to call it "Mudya
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Do khawaateen thin jinke saath unke do bete the. Ek bhediya aaya aur unmein se ek ke bete ko le gaya. Us khaatoon ne apni saathi se kaha, "Bhediya tumhaare bete ko le gaya." Doosri ne kaha, "Nahi, wo tumhaare bete ko le gaya." To dono ne (Nabi) Dawood se faisla maanga, jinhone faisla diya ke bacha badi khaatoon ko diya jaaye. Phir dono (Nabi) Sulaiman, Dawood ke bete, ke paas gaye aur unhein poora maamla bataaya. Sulaiman ne kaha, "Mujhe ek chhuri do taake main bacche ke do tukde kaat sakoon aur tum dono ko aadha-aadha de sakoon." Chhoti khaatoon ne kaha, "Aisa mat kijiye; Allah aapko barkat de! Wo uska bacha hai." Isper, unhone bacha chhoti khaatoon ko de diya.' Abu Huraira ne izaafa kiya: Allah ki qasam! Maine 'Sakkin' lafz ka matlab chhuri kabhi nahi suna tha, us din ke siwa, kyunke hum ise usually 'Mudya' kaha karte the.

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) once entered upon me in a very happy mood, with his features glittering with joy, and said, "O `Aisha! won't you see that Mujazziz (a Qa'if) looked just now at Zaid bin Haritha and Usama bin Zaid and said, 'These feet (of Usama and his father) belong to each other." (See Hadith No. 755, Vol)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ek baar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mere paas bahut khush mizaaj se daakhil hue, unke chehre khushi se chamak rahe the, aur unhone kaha, 'Aye Aisha! Kya tumne nahi dekha Mujazziz (ek Qa'if, yaani jism ke ansho se rishta pehchaanne wala) ne abhi Zaid bin Haritha aur Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko dekha aur kaha, "Ye pair (Usama aur unke waalid ke) ek doosre ke jaise hain."' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 755, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated `Aisha:Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered upon me and he was in a very happy mood and said, "O `Aisha: Don't you know that Mujazziz Al-Mudliji entered and saw Usama and Zaid with a velvet covering on them and their heads were covered while their feet were uncovered. He said, 'These feet belong to each other
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ek baar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mere paas daakhil hue aur wo bahut khush mizaaj mein the aur unhone kaha, 'Aye Aisha! Kya tumhein pata nahi ke Mujazziz Al-Mudliji andar aaye aur Usama aur Zaid ko ek makhmal ki chaadar mein dekha jismein unke sar dhake hue the jabke unke pair khule hue the. Unhone kaha, "Ye pair ek doosre ke jaise hain."'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When an adulterer commits illegal sexual intercourse, then he is not a believer at the time he is doing it; and when somebody drinks an alcoholic drink, then he is not believer at the time of drinking, and when a thief steals, he is not a believer at the time when he is stealing; and when a robber robs and the people look at him, then he is not a believer at the time of doing it." Abu Huraira in another narration, narrated the same from the Prophet (ﷺ) with the exclusion of robbery
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab koi zaani (zina karne wala) zina karta hai, to us waqt wo Momin nahi hota; aur jab koi sharaab peeta hai, to us waqt wo Momin nahi hota; aur jab koi chor chori karta hai, to us waqt wo Momin nahi hota; aur jab koi lootera loot-maar karta hai jabke log use dekh rahe hote hain, to us waqt wo Momin nahi hota.' Abu Huraira ne ek doosri riwaayat mein Nabi (SAW) se yahi bataaya, siwaaye loot-maar ke.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) beat a drunk with palm-leaf stalks and shoes. And Abu Bakr gave (such a sinner) forty lashes
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne ek nashe mein dhut shaks ko khajoor ke patton ki dandiyon aur jootiyon se maara. Aur Abu Bakr ne (aise gunahgaar ko) chaalis kode maare.

e: Narrated `Uqba bin Al-Harith:An-Nu`man or the son of An-Nu`man was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) on a charge of drunkenness. So the Prophet ordered all the men present in the house, to beat him. So all of them beat him, and I was also one of them who beat him with shoes
hi: Uqba bin Al-Harith bataate hain: An-Nu'man ya An-Nu'man ke bete ko Nabi (SAW) ke paas nashe ke ilzaam mein laaya gaya. To Nabi (SAW) ne ghar mein maujood sab logon ko hukm diya ke use maarein. To sab ne use maara, aur main bhi unmein se ek tha jisne use jootiyon se maara.

e: Narrated' `Uqba bin Al-Harith:An-Nu`man or the son of An-Nu`man was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) in a state of intoxication. The Prophet felt it hard (was angry) and ordered all those who were present in the house, to beat him. And they beat him, using palm-leaf stalks and shoes, and I was among those who beat him
hi: Uqba bin Al-Harith bataate hain: An-Nu'man ya An-Nu'man ke bete ko Nabi (SAW) ke paas nashe ki haalat mein laaya gaya. Nabi (SAW) ko ye sakht laga (wo gusse mein aaye) aur unhone ghar mein maujood sab logon ko hukm diya ke use maarein. To unhone use khajoor ke patton ki dandiyon aur jootiyon se maara, aur main un logon mein se ek tha jinhone use maara.

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) lashed a drunk with dateleaf stalks and shoes. And Abu Bakr gave a drunk forty lashes
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne ek nashe mein dhut shaks ko khajoor ke patton ki dandiyon aur jootiyon se kode maare. Aur Abu Bakr ne ek nashe mein dhut shaks ko chaalis kode maare.

e: Narrated Abu Salama:Abu Huraira said, "A man who drank wine was brought to the Prophet. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Beat him!" Abu Huraira added, "So some of us beat him with our hands, and some with their shoes, and some with their garments (by twisting it) like a lash, and then when we finished, someone said to him, 'May Allah disgrace you!' On that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Do not say so, for you are helping Satan to overpower him
hi: Abu Salama bataate hain: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Ek shaks jisne sharaab pee thi, use Nabi (SAW) ke paas laaya gaya. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, "Ise maaro!"' Abu Huraira ne izaafa kiya, 'To humme se kuch logon ne use apne haathon se maara, aur kuch ne apni jootiyon se, aur kuch ne apne kapdon se (kode jaisa bata kar), aur jab hum khatam kar chuke, kisi ne usse kaha, "Allah tumhein zaleel kare!" Isper Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, "Aisa mat kaho, kyunke tum Shaitaan ki isper haawi hone mein madad kar rahe ho."'

e: Narrated `Ali bin Abi Talib:I would not feel sorry for one who dies because of receiving a legal punishment, except the drunk, for if he should die (when being punished), I would give blood money to his family because no fixed punishment has been ordered by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for the drunk
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bin Abi Talib bataate hain: Main us shaks ke liye afsos mehsoos nahi karta jo kanooni saza paate hue mar jaaye, siwaaye us nashe mein dhut shaks ke, kyunke agar wo (saza paate hue) mar jaaye, to main uske khaandaan ko khoon-bahaa (diyat) dunga, kyunke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne nashe mein dhut shaks ke liye koi muqarrar (fix) saza nahi di.

e: Narrated As-Sa'ib bin Yazid:We used to strike the drunks with our hands, shoes, clothes (by twisting it into the shape of lashes) during the lifetime of the Prophet, Abu Bakr and the early part of `Umar's caliphate. But during the last period of `Umar's caliphate, he used to give the drunk forty lashes; and when drunks became mischievous and disobedient, he used to scourge them eighty lashes
hi: As-Sa'ib bin Yazid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Nabi (SAW), Abu Bakr aur Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki khilaafat ke shuruaati daur mein, nashe mein dhut logon ko apne haathon, jootiyon, aur kapdon se maara karte the (unhein kode jaisi shakl deke). Magar Umar ki khilaafat ke aakhri daur mein, wo nashe mein dhut shaks ko chaalis kode maara karte the; aur jab nashe mein dhut log shararat aur nafarmaani karte, to wo unhein assi kode maara karte the.

e: Narrated `Umar bin Al-Khattab:During the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) there was a man called `Abdullah whose nickname was Donkey, and he used to make Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) laugh. The Prophet (ﷺ) lashed him because of drinking (alcohol). And one-day he was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) on the same charge and was lashed. On that, a man among the people said, "O Allah, curse him ! How frequently he has been brought (to the Prophet (ﷺ) on such a charge)!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not curse him, for by Allah, I know for he loves Allah and His Apostle
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ki zindagi mein Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) naami ek shaks the jinka laqab Gadha (Donkey) tha, aur wo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko hansaaya karte the. Nabi (SAW) ne unhein (sharaab peene ki wajah se) kode maare. Ek din unhein Nabi (SAW) ke paas usi ilzaam mein laaya gaya aur unhein kode maare gaye. Isper, logon mein se ek shaks ne kaha, 'Aye Allah, isko laanat de! Ye kitni baar (isi ilzaam mein) laaya jaa chuka hai!' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Use laanat mat do, kyunke Allah ki qasam, mujhe pata hai wo Allah aur uske Rasool se mohabbat karta hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:A drunk was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he ordered him to be beaten (lashed). Some of us beat him with our hands, and some with their shoes, and some with their garments (twisted in the form of a lash). When that drunk had left, a man said, "What is wrong with him? May Allah disgrace him!" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Do not help Satan against your (Muslim) brother
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek nashe mein dhut shaks ko Nabi (SAW) ke paas laaya gaya aur unhone hukm diya ke use maara jaaye (kode lagaaye jaayein). Humme se kuch logon ne use apne haathon se maara, aur kuch ne apni jootiyon se, aur kuch ne apne kapdon se (kode jaisi shakl mein). Jab wo nashe mein dhut shaks chala gaya, ek shaks ne kaha, 'Isko kya hua hai? Allah use zaleel kare!' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Apne (Musalmaan) bhai ke khilaaf Shaitaan ki madad mat karo.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When (a person) an adulterer commits illegal sexual intercourse then he is not a believer at the time he is doing it; and when somebody steals, then he is not a believer at the time he is stealing
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab (koi shaks) zaani zina karta hai, to us waqt wo Momin nahi hota; aur jab koi chori karta hai, to us waqt wo Momin nahi hota.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah curses a man who steals an egg and gets his hand cut off, or steals a rope and gets his hands cut off." Al-A`mash said, "People used to interpret the Baida as an iron helmet, and they used to think that the rope may cost a few dirhams
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah us aadmi par laanat bhejta hai jo ek anda chura kar apna haath katwaata hai, ya ek rassi chura kar apna haath katwaata hai.' Al-A'mash ne kaha, 'Log Al-Baida (anda) ka matlab loha ka khod (helmet) samajhte the, aur unhein lagta tha ke rassi ki keemat kuch Dirham ho sakti hai.'

e: Narrated 'Ubada bin As-Samit:We were with the Prophet (ﷺ) in a gathering and he said, 'Swear allegiance to me that you will not worship anything besides Allah, Will not steal, and will not commit illegal sexual intercourse." And then (the Prophet) recited the whole Verse (i.e. 60:12). The Prophet (ﷺ) added, 'And whoever among you fulfills his pledge, his reward is with Allah; and whoever commits something of such sins and receives the legal punishment for it, that will be considered as the expiation for that sin, and whoever commits something of such sins and Allah screens him, it is up to Allah whether to excuse or punish him
hi: Ubada bin As-Samit bataate hain: Hum Nabi (SAW) ke saath ek majlis mein the aur unhone kaha, 'Mujhse baiyat karo (ahad karo) ke tum Allah ke siwa kisi aur ki ibaadat nahi karoge, chori nahi karoge, aur zina nahi karoge.' Phir (Nabi ne) poori Aayat (yaani 60:12) padhi. Nabi (SAW) ne izaafa kiya, 'Aur jo koi tum mein se apna ahad poora karega, uska ajr Allah ke paas hai; aur jo koi aisi kisi gunaah mein se kuch kare aur uski kanooni saza pa le, to wo us gunaah ka kaffara maana jaayega, aur jo koi aisi kisi gunaah mein se kuch kare aur Allah use dhaank de, to ye Allah par hai chaahe wo use maaf kare ya saza de.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:Allah's Apostle said in Hajjat-al-Wada`, "Which month (of the year) do you think is most sacred?" The people said, "This current month of ours (the month of Dhull-Hijja)." He said, "Which town (country) do you think is the most sacred?" They said, "This city of ours (Mecca)." He said, "Which day do you think is the most sacred?" The people said, "This day of ours." He then said, "Allah, the Blessed, the Supreme, has made your blood, your property and your honor as sacred as this day of yours in this town of yours, in this month of yours (and such protection cannot be slighted) except rightfully." He then said thrice, "Have I conveyed Allah's Message (to you)?" The people answered him each time saying, 'Yes." The Prophet (ﷺ) added, 'May Allah be merciful to you (or, woe on you)! Do not revert to disbelief after me by cutting the necks of each other
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Hajjat-ul-Wada mein kaha, 'Tumhein kaunsa mahina (saal ka) sabse muqaddas lagta hai?' Logon ne kaha, 'Ye hamara moujooda mahina (Zul-Hijja).' Unhone kaha, 'Tumhein kaunsa shehar (mulk) sabse muqaddas lagta hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Ye hamara shehar (Makkah).' Unhone kaha, 'Tumhein kaunsa din sabse muqaddas lagta hai?' Logon ne kaha, 'Ye hamaara aaj ka din.' Phir unhone kaha, 'Allah, jo Mubarak aur Aala hai, ne tumhaara khoon, tumhaari jaayadaad, aur tumhaari izzat utni hi muqaddas banaayi hai jitna aaj ka ye din, is shehar mein, is mahine mein (aur is hifaazat ko halke mein nahi lena chaahiye) siwaaye jaayez tareeke ke.' Phir unhone teen baar kaha, 'Kya maine Allah ka paighaam (tumhein) pahuncha diya?' Logon ne har baar unhein jawab diya, 'Haan.' Nabi (SAW) ne izaafa kiya, 'Allah tumpar reham kare (ya, afsos hai tumpar)! Mere baad ek doosre ki gardanein kaat kar kaafir mat ban jaana.'

e: Narrated Aisha:Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) was given an option between two things, he used to select the easier of the tow as long as it was not sinful; but if it was sinful, he would remain far from it. By Allah, he never took revenge for himself concerning any matter that was presented to him, but when Allah's Limits were transgressed, he would take revenge for Allah's Sake
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab bhi Nabi (SAW) ko do cheezon ke beech ek chunne ka mauka diya jaata, wo hamesha aasaan waali chunte, jab tak wo gunaah na ho; magar agar wo gunaah hoti, to wo uske paas bhi nahi jaate. Allah ki qasam, unhone kabhi apni khaatir kisi bhi maamle mein badla nahi liya, magar jab Allah ki hadd todi jaati, to wo Allah ki khaatir badla lete.

e: Narrated `Aisha:Usama approached the Prophet (ﷺ) on behalf of a woman (who had committed theft). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The people before you were destroyed because they used to inflict the legal punishments on the poor and forgive the rich. By Him in Whose Hand my soul is! If Fatima (the daughter of the Prophet (ﷺ) ) did that (i.e. stole), I would cut off her hand
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Usama ek khaatoon (jisne chori ki thi) ki taraf se Nabi (SAW) se guhaar lagaane aaye. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Tumse pehle ke log tabaah ho gaye kyunke wo gareebon ko qanooni saza dete the aur ameeron ko maaf kar dete the. Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai! Agar Fatima (Alayhas Salam) (Nabi ki beti) ne aisa (yaani chori) kiya hota, to main uska haath kaat deta.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Quraish people became very worried about the Makhzumiya lady who had committed theft. They said, "Nobody can speak (in favor of the lady) to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and nobody dares do that except Usama who is the favorite of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). " When Usama spoke to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about that matter, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Do you intercede (with me) to violate one of the legal punishment of Allah?" Then he got up and addressed the people, saying, "O people! The nations before you went astray because if a noble person committed theft, they used to leave him, but if a weak person among them committed theft, they used to inflict the legal punishment on him. By Allah, if Fatima, the daughter of Muhammad committed theft, Muhammad will cut off her hand
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Quraish qabeele ke log Makhzumiya khaatoon (jisne chori ki thi) ke baare mein bahut pareshaan the. Unhone kaha, 'Koi bhi (khaatoon ke haq mein) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se baat nahi kar sakta, aur koi bhi aisa karne ki himmat nahi karta siwaaye Usama ke jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke sabse aziz hain.' Jab Usama ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se is baare mein baat ki, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Kya tum Allah ki muqarrar kanooni saza torvaane ki sifaarish karte ho (mujhse)?' Phir wo uthe aur logon se khitaab karte hue kaha, 'Aye logo! Tumse pehle ki qaumein isliye bhatak gayin kyunke agar koi izzatdaar aadmi chori karta, wo use chhod dete, magar agar koi kamzor aadmi unmein se chori karta, wo use qanooni saza dete. Allah ki qasam, agar Muhammad ki beti Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ne chori ki hoti, to Muhammad uska haath kaat dete.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The hand should be cut off for stealing something that is worth a quarter of a Dinar or more
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Haath kaata jaana chaahiye agar koi cheez chori ki jaaye jiski keemat ek-chauthai Dinar ya usse zyaada ho.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The hand of a thief should be cut off for stealing a quarter of a Dinar
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Chor ka haath ek-chauthai Dinar chori karne par kaata jaana chaahiye.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The hand should be cut off for stealing a quarter of a Dinar
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Haath ek-chauthai Dinar chori karne par kaata jaana chaahiye.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The hand of a thief was not cut off during the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) except for stealing something equal to a shield in value. A similar hadith is narrated from `Aisha through another chain
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ki zindagi mein kisi chor ka haath tab tak nahi kaata gaya jab tak wo dhaal ke barabar keemat ki koi cheez chori na kare. Isi tarah ki ek hadees Aisha se ek doosri silsile se bhi riwaayat ki gayi hai.

e: Narrated `Aisha:A thief's hand was not cut off for stealing something cheaper than a Hajafa or a Turs (two kinds of shields), each of which was worth a (respectable) price
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Chor ka haath koi aisi cheez chori karne par nahi kaata gaya jo Hajafa ya Turs (do qism ki dhaalon) se sasti ho, jinmein se har ek ki ek (izzatdaar) keemat thi.

e: Narrated `Aisha:A thief's hand was not cut off for stealing something worth less than the price of a shield, whether a Turs or Hajafa (two kinds of shields), each of which was worth a (respectable) price
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Chor ka haath kisi aisi cheez ke chori karne par nahi kaata gaya jiski keemat ek dhaal, chaahe wo Turs ho ya Hajafa (do qism ki dhaalein), se kam ho, jinmein se har ek ki ek (izzatdaar) keemat thi.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) cut off the hand of a thief for stealing a shield that was worth three Dirhams
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek chor ka haath ek dhaal chori karne par kaata jiski keemat teen Dirham thi.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) cut off the hand of a thief for stealing a shield that was worth three Dirhams
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne ek chor ka haath ek dhaal chori karne par kaata jiski keemat teen Dirham thi.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) cut off the hand of a thief for stealing a shield that was worth three Dirhams
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne ek chor ka haath ek dhaal chori karne par kaata jiski keemat teen Dirham thi.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) cutoff the hand of a thief for stealing a shield that was worth three Dirhams
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne ek chor ka haath ek dhaal chori karne par kaata jiski keemat teen Dirham thi.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Apostle said, "Allah curses the thief who steals an egg (or a helmet) for which his hand is to be cut off, or steals a rope, for which his hand is to be cut off
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah us chor par laanat bhejta hai jo ek anda (ya ek khod) chura kar apna haath katwaata hai, ya ek rassi chura kar apna haath katwaata hai.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) cut off the hand of a lady, and that lady used to come to me, and I used to convey her message to the Prophet (ﷺ) and she repented, and her repentance was sincere
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ne ek khaatoon ka haath kaata, aur wo khaatoon mere paas aaya karti thi, aur main unka paighaam Nabi (SAW) tak pahunchaaya karti thi, aur unhone tauba ki, aur unki tauba khulusi se thi.

e: Narrated Ubada bin As-Samit:I gave the pledge of allegiance to the Prophet (ﷺ) with a group of people, and he said, "I take your pledge that you will not worship anything besides Allah, will not steal, will not commit infanticide, will not slander others by forging false statements and spreading it, and will not disobey me in anything good. And whoever among you fulfill all these (obligations of the pledge), his reward is with Allah. And whoever commits any of the above crimes and receives his legal punishment in this world, that will be his expiation and purification. But if Allah screens his sin, it will be up to Allah, Who will either punish or forgive him according to His wish." Abu `Abdullah said: "If a thief repents after his hand has been cut off, the his witness well be accepted. Similarly, if any person upon whom any legal punishment has been inflicted, repents, his witness will be accepted
hi: Ubada bin As-Samit bataate hain: Maine logon ke ek giroh ke saath Nabi (SAW) se baiyat (ahad) ki, aur unhone kaha, 'Main tumse ahad leta hoon ke tum Allah ke siwa kisi aur ki ibaadat nahi karoge, chori nahi karoge, bachon ki hatya (infanticide) nahi karoge, jhoothe bayaan bandhkar aur unhein failaakar doosron par bohtaan nahi lagaaoge, aur kisi bhi achhi baat mein meri nafarmaani nahi karoge. Aur jo koi tum mein se in sab (ahad ki zimmedaariyon) ko poora karega, uska ajr Allah ke paas hai. Aur jo koi upar zikr kiye gunaahon mein se koi karta hai aur is duniya mein uski qanooni saza pa leta hai, to wo uska kaffara aur paakeezgi maani jaayegi. Magar agar Allah uske gunaah ko dhaank de, to ye Allah par hai, chaahe wo use saza de ya maaf kare jaisa wo chaahe.' Abu Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) kehte hain: 'Agar ek chor apna haath katne ke baad tauba kare, to uski gawaahi qubool ki jaayegi. Isi tarah, agar kisi bhi shaks ko qanooni saza di gayi ho aur wo tauba kare, to uski gawaahi qubool ki jaayegi.'

e: Narrated Anas:Some people from the tribe of `Ukl came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and embraced Islam. The climate of Medina did not suit them, so the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered them to go to the (herd of milch) camels of charity and to drink, their milk and urine (as a medicine). They did so, and after they had recovered from their ailment (became healthy) they turned renegades (reverted from Islam) and killed the shepherd of the camels and took the camels away. The Prophet (ﷺ) sent (some people) in their pursuit and so they were (caught and) brought, and the Prophets ordered that their hands and legs should be cut off and that their eyes should be branded with heated pieces of iron, and that their cut hands and legs should not be cauterized, till they die
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ukl qabeele ke kuch log Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye aur Islam qubool kiya. Madina ki aabo-hawa unhein raas nahi aayi, isliye Nabi (SAW) ne unhein hukm diya ke wo Zakat ke oonton (doodh dene wali) ke paas jaayein aur unka doodh aur peshaab piyein (dawa ke taur par). Unhone waisa hi kiya, aur apni bimaari se theek hone ke baad, wo murtad ho gaye (Islam se peechhe hat gaye) aur oonton ke charwaahe ko qatl karke oont le gaye. Nabi (SAW) ne unke peechhe (kuch logon ko) bheja, isliye unhein (pakadkar) laaya gaya, aur Nabi (SAW) ne hukm diya ke unke haath aur pair kaat diye jaayein aur unki aankhon ko garam loha se daagh diya jaaye, aur unke kaate hue haath aur pair ko dagh na diya jaaye (cauterize na kiya jaaye), yahaan tak ke wo mar jaayein.

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) cut off the hands and feet of the men belonging to the tribe of `Uraina and did not cauterise (their bleeding limbs) till they died
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne Uraina qabeele ke logon ke haath aur pair kaate aur unke (bahte hue khoon ko) dagh nahi diya (cauterize nahi kiya) yahaan tak ke wo mar gaye.

e: Narrated Anas:A group of people from `Ukl (tribe) came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and they were living with the people of As- Suffa, but they became ill as the climate of Medina did not suit them, so they said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Provide us with milk." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, I see no other way for you than to use the camels of Allah's Apostle." So they went and drank the milk and urine of the camels, (as medicine) and became healthy and fat. Then they killed the shepherd and took the camels away. When a help-seeker came to Allah's Apostle, he sent some men in their pursuit, and they were captured and brought before mid day. The Prophet ordered for some iron pieces to be made red hot, and their eyes were branded with them and their hands and feet were cut off and were not cauterized. Then they were put at a place called Al- Harra, and when they asked for water to drink they were not given till they died. (Abu Qilaba said, "Those people committed theft and murder and fought against Allah and His Apostle)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ukl qabeele ke logon ka ek giroh Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur wo Suffa ke logon ke saath rehte the, magar wo bimar ho gaye kyunke Madina ki aabo-hawa unhein raas nahi aayi, isliye unhone kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Humein doodh dijiye.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Mujhe tumhaare liye Allah ke Rasool ke oonton ke istemaal ke ilaawa koi doosra raasta nazar nahi aata.' To wo gaye aur oonton ka doodh aur peshaab piya (dawa ke taur par) aur sehatmand aur mote ho gaye. Phir unhone charwaahe ko qatl kiya aur oont le gaye. Jab ek madad maangne wala Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya, unhone unke peechhe kuch aadmi bheje, aur unhein pakad kar dophar se pehle laaya gaya. Nabi (SAW) ne hukm diya ke kuch lohe ke tukdon ko garam kiya jaaye, aur unse unki aankhein daagh di gayin aur unke haath aur pair kaate gaye aur unhein daagh nahi diya gaya (cauterize nahi kiya gaya). Phir unhein Al-Harra naami jagah par le jaaya gaya, aur jab unhone paani maangaya peene ke liye, unhein nahi diya gaya yahaan tak ke wo mar gaye. (Abu Qilaba ne kaha, 'Un logon ne chori aur qatl kiya aur Allah aur uske Rasool ke khilaaf jang ki.')

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:A group of people from `Ukl (or `Uraina) tribe ----but I think he said that they were from `Ukl came to Medina and (they became ill, so) the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered them to go to the herd of (Milch) she-camels and told them to go out and drink the camels' urine and milk (as a medicine). So they went and drank it, and when they became healthy, they killed the shepherd and drove away the camels. This news reached the Prophet (ﷺ) early in the morning, so he sent (some) men in their pursuit and they were captured and brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) before midday. He ordered to cut off their hands and legs and their eyes to be branded with heated iron pieces and they were thrown at Al-Harra, and when they asked for water to drink, they were not given water. (Abu Qilaba said, "Those were the people who committed theft and murder and reverted to disbelief after being believers (Muslims), and fought against Allah and His Apostle
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ukl (ya Uraina) qabeele ke logon ka ek giroh -- magar mera khayaal hai unhone kaha ke wo Ukl qabeele se the -- Madina aaye (aur wo bimar ho gaye), isliye Nabi (SAW) ne unhein hukm diya ke wo doodh dene wale oonton ke jhund ke paas jaayein aur baahar jaakar oonton ka peshaab aur doodh piyein (dawa ke taur par). To wo gaye aur usse piya, aur jab wo sehatmand ho gaye, unhone charwaahe ko qatl kiya aur oont haank kar le gaye. Ye khabar Nabi (SAW) tak subah-savere pahunchi, isliye unhone unke peechhe (kuch) aadmi bheje aur unhein pakad kar dophar se pehle Nabi (SAW) ke paas laaya gaya. Unhone hukm diya ke unke haath aur pair kaat diye jaayein aur unki aankhein garam lohe se daagh di jaayein, aur unhein Al-Harra mein phenka gaya, aur jab unhone paani maangaya peene ke liye, unhein paani nahi diya gaya. (Abu Qilaba ne kaha, 'Ye wo log the jinhone chori aur qatl kiya aur Momin hone ke baad Kufr ki taraf laut gaye, aur Allah aur uske Rasool ke khilaaf jang ki.')

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Seven (people) will be shaded by Allah by His Shade on the Day of Resurrection when there will be no shade except His Shade. (They will be), a just ruler, a young man who has been brought up in the worship of Allah, a man who remembers Allah in seclusion and his eyes are then flooded with tears, a man whose heart is attached to mosques (offers his compulsory congregational prayers in the mosque), two men who love each other for Allah's Sake, a man who is called by a charming lady of noble birth to commit illegal sexual intercourse with her, and he says, 'I am afraid of Allah,' and (finally), a man who gives in charity so secretly that his left hand does not know what his right hand has given
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Saat (log) Allah ki chhaaon mein Qayamat ke din chhaaon paayenge jab Allah ki chhaaon ke siwa koi chhaaon nahi hogi.
