(Wo hain,) ek insaaf-pasand hukmraan, ek jawaan shaks jo Allah ki ibaadat mein pala-badha ho, ek shaks jo tanhaayi mein Allah ko yaad kare aur uski aankhein aansuon se bhar jaayein, ek shaks jiska dil Masjid se juda ho (yaani wo apni farz jamaat namazein Masjid mein padhta hai), do log jo Allah ki khaatir ek doosre se mohabbat karte hon, ek shaks jise ek khoobsoorat, izzatdaar khaandaan ki khaatoon zina karne ke liye bulaaye, aur wo kahe, "Mujhe Allah ka dar hai," aur (aakhir mein,) ek shaks jo itni chupke se sadqa deta hai ke uske baaen haath ko pata nahi chalta uske daaen haath ne kya diya.'

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever guarantees me (the chastity of) what is between his legs (i.e. his private parts), and what is between his jaws (i.e., his tongue), I guarantee him Paradise
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi mujhe (apni) taangon ke beech ki cheez (yaani sharmgaah) aur (apne) jabdon ke beech ki cheez (yaani zubaan) ki zimmedaari le, main uske liye Jannat ki zimmedaari leta hoon.'

e: Narrated Anas: I will narrate to you a narration which nobody will narrate to you after me. I heard that from the Prophet. I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "The Hour will not be established" or said: "From among the portents of the Hour is that the religious knowledge will betaken away (by the death of religious Scholars) and general ignorance (of religion) will appear; and the drinking of alcoholic drinks will be very common, and (open) illegal sexual intercourse will prevail, and men will decrease in number while women will increase so much so that, for fifty women there will only be one man to look after them
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main tumhein ek aisi riwaayat sunaunga jo mere baad koi tumhein nahi sunaayega. Maine ye Nabi (SAW) se suna. Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Qayamat tab tak nahi aayegi' ya kaha, 'Qayamat ki nishaaniyon mein se ye hai ke deeni ilm uthaaya jaayega (aalimon ki maut ke zariye) aur aam jahaalat (deen ki) zaahir hogi; aur sharaab peena bahut aam ho jaayega, aur (khula) zina failega, aur mard kam ho jaayenge jabke auraten itni badh jaayengi ke pachaas auraton ke liye sirf ek hi mard hoga unhein sambhaalne ke liye.'

e: Narrated 'Ikrima from Ibn 'Abbas: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When a slave (of Allah) commits illegal sexual intercourse, he is not a believer at the time of committing it; and if he steals, he is not a believer at the time of stealing; and if he drinks an alcoholic drink, when he is not a believer at the time of drinking it; and he is not a believer when he commits a murder," 'Ikrima said: I asked Ibn Abbas, "How is faith taken away from him?" He said, Like this," by clasping his hands and then separating them, and added, "But if he repents, faith returns to him like this, by clasping his hands again
hi: Ikrima, Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke hawaale se, bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab (Allah ka) bandaa zina karta hai, to us waqt wo Momin nahi hota; aur agar wo chori karta hai, to us waqt wo Momin nahi hota; aur agar wo sharaab peeta hai, to us waqt wo Momin nahi hota; aur jab wo qatl karta hai, to us waqt bhi wo Momin nahi hota.' Ikrima kehte hain: Maine Ibn Abbas se pucha, 'Iman usse kaise le liya jaata hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Aise,' apne haath jodh kar aur phir unhein alag karte hue, aur izaafa kiya, 'Magar agar wo tauba kare, to Iman usme wapas aa jaata hai aise,' apne haath dobara jodhte hue.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The one who commits an illegal sexual intercourse is not a believer at the time of committing illegal sexual intercourse and a thief is not a believer at the time of committing theft and a drinker of alcoholic drink is not a believer at the time of drinking. Yet, (the gate of) repentance is open thereafter
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi zina karta hai wo us waqt Momin nahi hota jab wo zina kar raha hota hai, aur ek chor us waqt Momin nahi hota jab wo chori kar raha hota hai, aur sharaab peene wala us waqt Momin nahi hota jab wo peeta hai. Phir bhi, (tauba ka darwaaza) uske baad khula hota hai.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Mas`ud:I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Which is the biggest sin?" He said, "To set up rivals to Allah by worshipping others though He alone has created you." I asked, "What is next?" He said, "To kill your child lest it should share your food." I asked, "What is next?" He said, "To commit illegal sexual intercourse with the wife of your neighbor
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Masud bataate hain: Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Sabse bada gunaah kaunsa hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Allah ke saath shareek thehraana jabke usne akele tumhein banaaya.' Maine pucha, 'Uske baad kya?' Unhone kaha, 'Apne bachon ko is dar se qatl karna ke wo tumhaara khaana baantenge.' Maine pucha, 'Uske baad kya?' Unhone kaha, 'Apne padosi ki biwi ke saath zina karna.'

e: Narrated Ash-Shu`bi:from `Ali when the latter stoned a lady to death on a Friday. `Ali said, "I have stoned her according to the tradition of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
hi: Ash-Shu'bi, Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke hawaale se, bataate hain: Jab unhone (Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne) ek khaatoon ko Jumme ke din sangsaar kiya (patthar maar-maar kar maara). Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha, 'Maine unhein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki riwaayat ke mutaabik sangsaar kiya hai.'

e: Narrated Ash Shaibani:I asked `Abdullah bin Abi `Aufa, 'Did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) carry out the Rajam penalty ( i.e., stoning to death)?' He said, "Yes." I said, "Before the revelation of Surat-an-Nur or after it?" He replied, "I don't Know
hi: Ash-Shaibani bataate hain: Maine Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Aufa se pucha, 'Kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Rajam ki saza (yaani patthar maar-maar kar maut) di?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan.' Maine pucha, 'Surah An-Nur ki naazil hone se pehle ya baad mein?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Mujhe nahi pata.'

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah Al-Ansari:A man from the tribe of Bani Aslam came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Informed him that he had committed illegal sexual intercourse and bore witness four times against himself. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered him to be stoned to death as he was a married Person
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ansari bataate hain: Banu Aslam qabeele ka ek shaks Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unhein bataaya ke usne zina kiya hai aur apne khilaaf chaar baar gawaahi di. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne hukm diya ke use sangsaar kiya jaaye kyunke wo shaadi-shuda tha.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:A man came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while he was in the mosque, and he called him, saying, "O Allah's Apostle! I have committed illegal sexual intercourse.'" The Prophet (ﷺ) turned his face to the other side, but that man repeated his statement four times, and after he bore witness against himself four times, the Prophet (ﷺ) called him, saying, "Are you mad?" The man said, "No." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Are you married?" The man said, "Yes." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Take him away and stone him to death." Jabir bin `Abdullah said: I was among the ones who participated in stoning him and we stoned him at the Musalla. When the stones troubled him, he fled, but we over took him at Al-Harra and stoned him to death
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya jabke wo Masjid mein the, aur usne unhein pukaara, kehte hue, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Maine zina kiya hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne apna chehra doosri taraf mod liya, magar us shaks ne apni baat chaar baar dohraayi, aur apne khilaaf chaar baar gawaahi dene ke baad, Nabi (SAW) ne use bulaaya, kehte hue, 'Kya tum paagal ho?' Us shaks ne kaha, 'Nahi.' Nabi (SAW) ne pucha, 'Kya tum shaadi-shuda ho?' Us shaks ne kaha, 'Haan.' Phir Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Use le jaao aur sangsaar karo.' Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: Main un logon mein se tha jinhone usse sangsaar karne mein hissa liya, aur humne use Musalla par sangsaar kiya. Jab pathhar usse pareshaan karne lage, wo bhaaga, magar humne use Al-Harra mein pakad liya aur usse sangsaar kar diya.

e: Narrated `Aisha:Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas and `Abd bin Zam`a quarrelled with each other (regarding a child). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The boy is for you, O `Abd bin Zam`a, for the boy is for (the owner) of the bed. O Sauda ! Screen yourself from the boy." The sub-narrator, Al-Laith added (that the Prophet (ﷺ) also said), "And the stone is for the person who commits an illegal sexual intercourse
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Abd bin Zam'a ek bacche ko lekar aapas mein jhagad rahe the. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Ladka tumhaara hai, Aye Abd bin Zam'a, kyunke ladka bistar ke (maalik) ke liye hota hai. Aye Sauda (رضی اللہ عنہا)! Ladke ke saamne apne aap ko dhaanko.' Ravi Al-Laith ne izaafa kiya (ke Nabi ne bhi kaha), 'Aur pathhar us shaks ke liye hai jo zina karta hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The boy is for (the owner of) the bed and the stone is for the person who commits illegal sexual intercourse
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ladka bistar ke (maalik) ke liye hota hai, aur pathhar us shaks ke liye hai jo zina karta hai.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:A Jew and a Jewess were brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on a charge of committing an illegal sexual intercourse. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked them. "What is the legal punishment (for this sin) in your Book (Torah)?" They replied, "Our priests have innovated the punishment of blackening the faces with charcoal and Tajbiya." `Abdullah bin Salam said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), tell them to bring the Torah." The Torah was brought, and then one of the Jews put his hand over the Divine Verse of the Rajam (stoning to death) and started reading what preceded and what followed it. On that, Ibn Salam said to the Jew, "Lift up your hand." Behold! The Divine Verse of the Rajam was under his hand. So Allah's Apostle ordered that the two (sinners) be stoned to death, and so they were stoned. Ibn `Umar added: So both of them were stoned at the Balat and I saw the Jew sheltering the Jewess
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek Yahudi aur ek Yahudi khaatoon Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas zina ke ilzaam mein laaye gaye. Nabi (SAW) ne unse pucha, 'Tumhaari Kitaab (Taurat) mein iski kanooni saza kya hai?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Hamare paadriyon ne chehre ko koyle se kaala karne aur Tajbiya (be-izzati ka ek amal) ki saza banaayi hai.' Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Salam (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool, unhein Taurat laane ko kahiye.' Taurat laayi gayi, aur phir ek Yahudi ne apna haath Rajam (sangsaar) ki Ilaahi Aayat par rakha aur uske pehle aur baad ki cheezein padhne laga. Isper, Ibn Salam ne us Yahudi se kaha, 'Apna haath uthaao.' Dekho! Rajam ki Ilaahi Aayat uske haath ke neeche thi. To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne hukm diya ke dono (gunahgaaron) ko sangsaar kiya jaaye, aur unhein sangsaar kiya gaya. Ibn Umar ne izaafa kiya: To dono ko Al-Balat mein sangsaar kiya gaya aur maine dekha Yahudi Yahudi khaatoon ko (pattharon se) bachaane ki koshish kar raha tha.

e: Narrated Jabir:A man from the tribe of Aslam came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and confessed that he had committed an illegal sexual intercourse. The Prophet (ﷺ) turned his face away from him till the man bore witness against himself four times. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "Are you mad?" He said "No." He said, "Are you married?" He said, "Yes." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered that he be stoned to death, and he was stoned to death at the Musalla. When the stones troubled him, he fled, but he was caught and was stoned till he died. The Prophet (ﷺ) spoke well of him and offered his funeral prayer
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Aslam qabeele ka ek shaks Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur zina karne ka iqbaal kiya. Nabi (SAW) ne apna chehra usse doosri taraf mod liya yahaan tak ke us shaks ne apne khilaaf chaar baar gawaahi di. Nabi (SAW) ne usse kaha, 'Kya tum paagal ho?' Usne kaha, 'Nahi.' Unhone kaha, 'Kya tum shaadi-shuda ho?' Usne kaha, 'Haan.' Phir Nabi (SAW) ne hukm diya ke use sangsaar kiya jaaye, aur use Musalla par sangsaar kiya gaya. Jab pathhar usse pareshaan karne lage, wo bhaaga, magar use pakad liya gaya aur maut tak sangsaar kiya gaya. Nabi (SAW) ne uske baare mein achhi baaten kahin aur uski namaz-e-janaza padhaayi.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira: A person had sexual relation with his wife in the month of Ramadan (while he was fasting), and he came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) seeking his verdict concerning that action. The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to him), "Can you afford to manumit a slave?" The man said, "No." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Can you fast for two successive months?" He said, "No." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Then feed sixty poor persons
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks ne apni biwi se Ramzan ke mahine mein (roze ki haalat mein) humbistari ki, aur wo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas is amal ke baare mein faisla lene aaya. Nabi (SAW) ne (usse) kaha, 'Kya tum ek ghulaam azaad karne ka intezaam kar sakte ho?' Us shaks ne kaha, 'Nahi.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Kya tum lagataar do maheene roza rakh sakte ho?' Usne kaha, 'Nahi.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'To sath gareebon ko khaana khilaao.'

e: Narrated 'Aisha: A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) in the mosque and said, "I am burnt (ruined)!" The Prophet (ﷺ) asked him, "With what (what have you done)?" He said, "I have had sexual relation with my wife in the month of Ramadan (while fasting)." The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "Give in charity." He said, "I have nothing." The man sat down, and in the meantime there came a person driving a donkey carrying food to the Prophet (ﷺ) ..... (The sub-narrator, 'Abdur Rahman added: I do not know what kind of food it was). On that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Where is the burnt person?" The man said, "Here I am." The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "Take this (food) and give it in charity (to someone)." The man said, "To a poorer person than l? My family has nothing to eat." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "Then eat it yourselves
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ek shaks Nabi (SAW) ke paas Masjid mein aaya aur kaha, 'Main jal gaya hoon (barbaad ho gaya hoon)!' Nabi (SAW) ne unse pucha, 'Kaise (tumne kya kiya)?' Usne kaha, 'Maine Ramzan ke mahine mein (roze ki haalat mein) apni biwi se humbistari ki.' Nabi (SAW) ne unse kaha, 'Sadqe mein do.' Usne kaha, 'Mere paas kuch nahi hai.' Wo shaks baith gaya, aur isi dauraan, koi shaks ek gadha haank kar Nabi (SAW) ke paas khaana laaya... (Ravi Abdur Rahman ne izaafa kiya: Mujhe nahi pata wo kaunsa khaana tha). Isper Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Wo jala hua shaks kahaan hai?' Us shaks ne kaha, 'Main yahaan hoon.' Nabi (SAW) ne unse kaha, 'Ise (khaana) lo aur (kisi ko) sadqe mein do.' Us shaks ne kaha, 'Kisi aur gareeb ko jo mujhse bhi zyaada gareeb ho? Mere khaandaan ke paas khaane ko kuch nahi hai.' Isper Nabi (SAW) ne unse kaha, 'To ise khud khaao.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:While I was with the Prophet (ﷺ) a man came and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have committed a legally punishable sin; please inflict the legal punishment on me'.' The Prophet (ﷺ) did not ask him what he had done. Then the time for the prayer became due and the man offered prayer along with the Prophet (ﷺ) , and when the Prophet (ﷺ) had finished his prayer, the man again got up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have committed a legally punishable sin; please inflict the punishment on me according to Allah's Laws." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Haven't you prayed with us?' He said, "Yes." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah has forgiven your sin." or said, "....your legally punishable sin
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab main Nabi (SAW) ke saath tha, ek shaks aaya aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Maine ek aisa gunaah kiya hai jiski kanooni saza hai; barah-e-meharbaani mujhpar wo saza lagaayiye.' Nabi (SAW) ne unse nahi pucha ke unhone kya kiya. Phir namaz ka waqt aaya aur us shaks ne Nabi (SAW) ke saath namaz padhi, aur jab Nabi (SAW) ne apni namaz khatam ki, wo shaks phir uthkar khada hua aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Maine ek aisa gunaah kiya hai jiski kanooni saza hai; barah-e-meharbaani mujhpar Allah ke Qawaanin ke mutaabik saza lagaayiye.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Kya tumne humaare saath namaz nahi padhi?' Usne kaha, 'Haan.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Allah ne tumhaara gunaah maaf kar diya hai,' ya kaha, '...tumhaara kanooni saza ka gunaah.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When Ma'iz bin Malik came to the Prophet (in order to confess), the Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "Probably you have only kissed (the lady), or winked, or looked at her?" He said, "No, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" The Prophet said, using no euphemism, "Did you have sexual intercourse with her?" The narrator added: At that, (i.e. after his confession) the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered that he be stoned (to death)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Ma'iz bin Malik Nabi (SAW) ke paas (iqbaal karne) aaye, Nabi (SAW) ne unse kaha, 'Shaayad tumne sirf (khaatoon ko) chooma ho, ya aankh maari ho, ya use dekha ho?' Unhone kaha, 'Nahi, Aye Allah ke Rasool!' Nabi (SAW) ne, bina koi lag-lapet ke, pucha, 'Kya tumne uske saath humbistari ki?' Ravi ne izaafa kiya: Isper (yaani unki iqbaal ke baad), Nabi (SAW) ne hukm diya ke unhein sangsaar kiya jaaye.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:A man from among the people, came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was sitting in the mosque, and addressed him, saying, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have committed an illegal sexual intercourse." The Prophet (ﷺ) turned his face away from him. The man came to that side to which the Prophet had turned his face, and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have committed an illegal intercourse." The Prophet (ﷺ) turned his face to the other side, and the man came to that side, and when he confessed four times, the Prophet (ﷺ) called him and said, "Are you mad?" He said, "No, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" The Prophet said, "Are you married?" He said, "Yes, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to the people), "Take him away and stone him to death." Ibn Shihab added, "I was told by one who heard Jabir, that Jabir said, 'I was among those who stoned the man, and we stoned him at the Musalla (`Id praying Place), and when the stones troubled him, he jumped quickly and ran away, but we overtook him at Al-Harra and stoned him to death (there)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Logon mein se ek shaks Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya jabke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Masjid mein baithe hue the, aur usne unse khitaab karte hue kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Maine zina kiya hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne apna chehra usse doosri taraf mod liya. Wo shaks us taraf aaya jispar Nabi (SAW) ne apna chehra mod liya tha aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Maine zina kiya hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne apna chehra doosri taraf mod liya, aur wo shaks us taraf aaya, aur jab usne chaar baar iqbaal kiya, Nabi (SAW) ne use bulaaya aur kaha, 'Kya tum paagal ho?' Usne kaha, 'Nahi, Aye Allah ke Rasool!' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Kya tum shaadi-shuda ho?' Usne kaha, 'Haan, Aye Allah ke Rasool.' Nabi (SAW) ne (logon se) kaha, 'Ise le jaao aur sangsaar karo.' Ibn Shihab ne izaafa kiya, 'Mujhe kisi ne bataaya jisne Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko sunaa, ke Jabir ne kaha, "Main un logon mein se tha jinhone us shaks ko sangsaar kiya, aur humne use Musalla (Eid ki namaz ki jagah) mein sangsaar kiya, aur jab pathhar usse pareshaan karne lage, wo jaldi se kood kar bhaaga, magar humne use Al-Harra mein pakad liya aur wahaan usse sangsaar kar diya."'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira and Zaid bin Khalid:While we were with the Prophet (ﷺ) , a man stood up and said (to the Prophet (ﷺ) ), "I beseech you by Allah, that you should judge us according to Allah's Laws." Then the man's opponent who was wiser than him, got up saying (to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)) "Judge us according to Allah's Law and kindly allow me (to speak)." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "'Speak." He said, "My son was a laborer working for this man and he committed an illegal sexual intercourse with his wife, and I gave one-hundred sheep and a slave as a ransom for my son's sin. Then I asked a learned man about this case and he informed me that my son should receive one hundred lashes and be exiled for one year, and the man's wife should be stoned to death." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "By Him in Whose Hand my soul is, I will judge you according to the Laws of Allah. Your one-hundred sheep and the slave are to be returned to you, and your son has to receive one-hundred lashes and be exiled for one year. O Unais! Go to the wife of this man, and if she confesses, then stone her to death." Unais went to her and she confessed. He then stoned her to death
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Zaid bin Khalid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab hum Nabi (SAW) ke saath the, ek shaks khada hua aur kaha (Nabi se), 'Main aapko Allah ki qasam deta hoon, humaare beech Allah ke Qawaanin ke mutaabik faisla kijiye.' Phir us aadmi ka mukhaalif, jo usse zyaada aqlmand tha, khade hokar bola, 'Humaare beech Allah ke Qawaanin ke mutaabik faisla kijiye aur mujhe (bolne ki) ijaazat dijiye.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Bolo.' Usne kaha, 'Mera beta is shaks ka mazdoor tha aur usne iski biwi ke saath zina kiya, aur maine apne bete ke gunaah ke fidye mein sau bakriyaan aur ek launDi di. Phir maine ek aalim shaks se is maamle ke baare mein pucha aur usne mujhe bataaya ke mere bete ko sau kode maare jaayein aur ek saal ke liye jila-watan kiya jaaye, aur us aadmi ki biwi ko sangsaar kiya jaaye.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, main tumhaare beech Allah ke Qawaanin ke mutaabik faisla dunga. Tumhaari sau bakriyaan aur launDi tumhein wapas ki jaayengi, aur tumhaare bete ko sau kode maare jaayenge aur ek saal ke liye jila-watan kiya jaayega. Aye Unais! Is aadmi ki biwi ke paas jaao, aur agar wo iqbaal kare, to use sangsaar kar do.' Unais unke paas gaye aur unhone iqbaal kiya. Phir unhone unhein sangsaar kar diya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:`Umar said, "I am afraid that after a long time has passed, people may say, "We do not find the Verses of the Rajam (stoning to death) in the Holy Book," and consequently they may go astray by leaving an obligation that Allah has revealed. Lo! I confirm that the penalty of Rajam be inflicted on him who commits illegal sexual intercourse, if he is already married and the crime is proved by witnesses or pregnancy or confession." Sufyan added, "I have memorized this narration in this way." `Umar added, "Surely Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) carried out the penalty of Rajam, and so did we after him
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Mujhe dar hai ke lambi muddat guzarne ke baad, log kahenge, "Humein Rajam (sangsaar) ki Aayaten paak Kitaab mein nahi milti," aur isse wo bhatak jaayenge is farz ko chhod kar jo Allah ne naazil kiya hai. Suno! Main tasdeeq karta hoon ke Rajam ki saza us shaks par lagaayi jaaye jo zina kare, agar wo pehle se shaadi-shuda ho aur jurm gawaahon, ya hamal, ya iqbaal se saabit ho.' Sufyan ne izaafa kiya, 'Maine ye riwaayat isi tarah yaad ki hai.' Umar ne izaafa kiya, 'Beshak, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Rajam ki saza di, aur humne bhi unke baad di.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I used to teach (the Qur'an to) some people of the Muhajirln (emigrants), among whom there was `Abdur Rahman bin `Auf. While I was in his house at Mina, and he was with `Umar bin Al-Khattab during `Umar's last Hajj, `Abdur-Rahman came to me and said, "Would that you had seen the man who came today to the Chief of the Believers (`Umar), saying, 'O Chief of the Believers! What do you think about so-and-so who says, 'If `Umar should die, I will give the pledge of allegiance to such-andsuch person, as by Allah, the pledge of allegiance to Abu Bakr was nothing but a prompt sudden action which got established afterwards.' `Umar became angry and then said, 'Allah willing, I will stand before the people tonight and warn them against those people who want to deprive the others of their rights (the question of rulership). `Abdur-Rahman said, "I said, 'O Chief of the believers! Do not do that, for the season of Hajj gathers the riff-raff and the rubble, and it will be they who will gather around you when you stand to address the people. And I am afraid that you will get up and say something, and some people will spread your statement and may not say what you have actually said and may not understand its meaning, and may interpret it incorrectly, so you should wait till you reach Medina, as it is the place of emigration and the place of Prophet's Traditions, and there you can come in touch with the learned and noble people, and tell them your ideas with confidence; and the learned people will understand your statement and put it in its proper place.' On that, `Umar said, 'By Allah! Allah willing, I will do this in the first speech I will deliver before the people in Medina." Ibn `Abbas added: We reached Medina by the end of the month of Dhul-Hijja, and when it was Friday, we went quickly (to the mosque) as soon as the sun had declined, and I saw Sa`id bin Zaid bin `Amr bin Nufail sitting at the corner of the pulpit, and I too sat close to him so that my knee was touching his knee, and after a short while `Umar bin Al-Khattab came out, and when I saw him coming towards us, I said to Sa`id bin Zaid bin `Amr bin Nufail "Today `Umar will say such a thing as he has never said since he was chosen as Caliph." Sa`id denied my statement with astonishment and said, "What thing do you expect `Umar to say the like of which he has never said before?" In the meantime, `Umar sat on the pulpit and when the callmakers for the prayer had finished their call, `Umar stood up, and having glorified and praised Allah as He deserved, he said, "Now then, I am going to tell you something which (Allah) has written for me to say. I do not know; perhaps it portends my death, so whoever understands and remembers it, must narrate it to the others wherever his mount takes him, but if somebody is afraid that he does not understand it, then it is unlawful for him to tell lies about me. Allah sent Muhammad with the Truth and revealed the Holy Book to him, and among what Allah revealed, was the Verse of the Rajam (the stoning of married person (male & female) who commits illegal sexual intercourse, and we did recite this Verse and understood and memorized it. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did carry out the punishment of stoning and so did we after him. I am afraid that after a long time has passed, somebody will say, 'By Allah, we do not find the Verse of the Rajam in Allah's Book,' and thus they will go astray by leaving an obligation which Allah has revealed. And the punishment of the Rajam is to be inflicted to any married person (male & female), who commits illegal sexual intercourse, if the required evidence is available or there is conception or confession. And then we used to recite among the Verses in Allah's Book: 'O people! Do not claim to be the offspring of other than your fathers, as it is disbelief (unthankfulness) on your part that you claim to be the offspring of other than your real father.' Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Do not praise me excessively as Jesus, son of Marry was praised, but call me Allah's Slave and His Apostles.' (O people!) I have been informed that a speaker amongst you says, 'By Allah, if `Umar should die, I will give the pledge of allegiance to such-and-such person.' One should not deceive oneself by saying that the pledge of allegiance given to Abu Bakr was given suddenly and it was successful. No doubt, it was like that, but Allah saved (the people) from its evil, and there is none among you who has the qualities of Abu Bakr. Remember that whoever gives the pledge of allegiance to anybody among you without consulting the other Muslims, neither that person, nor the person to whom the pledge of allegiance was given, are to be supported, lest they both should be killed. And no doubt after the death of the Prophet (ﷺ) we were informed that the Ansar disagreed with us and gathered in the shed of Bani Sa`da. `Ali and Zubair and whoever was with them, opposed us, while the emigrants gathered with Abu Bakr. I said to Abu Bakr, 'Let's go to these Ansari brothers of ours.' So we set out seeking them, and when we approached them, two pious men of theirs met us and informed us of the final decision of the Ansar, and said, 'O group of Muhajirin (emigrants) ! Where are you going?' We replied, 'We are going to these Ansari brothers of ours.' They said to us, 'You shouldn't go near them. Carry out whatever we have already decided.' I said, 'By Allah, we will go to them.' And so we proceeded until we reached them at the shed of Bani Sa`da. Behold! There was a man sitting amongst them and wrapped in something. I asked, 'Who is that man?' They said, 'He is Sa`d bin 'Ubada.' I asked, 'What is wrong with him?' They said, 'He is sick.' After we sat for a while, the Ansar's speaker said, 'None has the right to be worshipped but Allah,' and praising Allah as He deserved, he added, 'To proceed, we are Allah's Ansar (helpers) and the majority of the Muslim army, while you, the emigrants, are a small group and some people among you came with the intention of preventing us from practicing this matter (of caliphate) and depriving us of it.' When the speaker had finished, I intended to speak as I had prepared a speech which I liked and which I wanted to deliver in the presence of Abu Bakr, and I used to avoid provoking him. So, when I wanted to speak, Abu Bakr said, 'Wait a while.' I disliked to make him angry. So Abu Bakr himself gave a speech, and he was wiser and more patient than I. By Allah, he never missed a sentence that I liked in my own prepared speech, but he said the like of it or better than it spontaneously. After a pause he said, 'O Ansar! You deserve all (the qualities that you have attributed to yourselves, but this question (of Caliphate) is only for the Quraish as they are the best of the Arabs as regards descent and home, and I am pleased to suggest that you choose either of these two men, so take the oath of allegiance to either of them as you wish. And then Abu Bakr held my hand and Abu Ubaida bin al-Jarrah's hand who was sitting amongst us. I hated nothing of what he had said except that proposal, for by Allah, I would rather have my neck chopped off as expiator for a sin than become the ruler of a nation, one of whose members is Abu Bakr, unless at the time of my death my own-self suggests something I don't feel at present.' And then one of the Ansar said, 'I am the pillar on which the camel with a skin disease (eczema) rubs itself to satisfy the itching (i.e., I am a noble), and I am as a high class palm tree! O Quraish. There should be one ruler from us and one from you.' Then there was a hue and cry among the gathering and their voices rose so that I was afraid there might be great disagreement, so I said, 'O Abu Bakr! Hold your hand out.' He held his hand out and I pledged allegiance to him, and then all the emigrants gave the Pledge of allegiance and so did the Ansar afterwards. And so we became victorious over Sa`d bin Ubada (whom Al-Ansar wanted to make a ruler). One of the Ansar said, 'You have killed Sa`d bin Ubada.' I replied, 'Allah has killed Sa`d bin Ubada.' `Umar added, "By Allah, apart from the great tragedy that had happened to us (i.e. the death of the Prophet), there was no greater problem than the allegiance pledged to Abu Bakr because we were afraid that if we left the people, they might give the Pledge of allegiance after us to one of their men, in which case we would have given them our consent for something against our real wish, or would have opposed them and caused great trouble. So if any person gives the Pledge of allegiance to somebody (to become a Caliph) without consulting the other Muslims, then the one he has selected should not be granted allegiance, lest both of them should be killed
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Muhaajireen ke kuch logon ko (Quran) padhaaya karta tha, jinmein Abdur Rahman bin Auf (رضی اللہ عنہ) bhi the. Jab main unke Mina ke ghar mein tha, aur wo Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab ke saath Umar ke aakhri Hajj mein the, Abdur Rahman mere paas aaye aur kaha, 'Kaash tumne us aadmi ko dekha hota jo aaj Momineen ke Ameer (Umar) ke paas aaya aur kaha, "Aye Momineen ke Ameer! Aap us shaks ke baare mein kya sochte hain jo kehta hai, 'Agar Umar mar jaayein, to main falaan-falaan shaks se baiyat karunga, kyunke Allah ki qasam, Abu Bakr ki baiyat sirf ek jaldi ka, achaanak amal thi jo baad mein sthaapit ho gayi.'" Umar gussa ho gaye aur phir kaha, "Agar Allah ne chaaha, to main aaj raat logon ke saamne khada hokar unhein un logon se khabardaar karunga jo doosron se unke haq (yaani hukmraani ka maamla) chheenna chahte hain."' Abdur Rahman ne kaha, 'Maine kaha, "Aye Momineen ke Ameer! Aisa mat kijiye, kyunke Hajj ka mausam bekaar aur be-fikri log jama karta hai, aur jab aap logon se khitaab karne khade honge to wahi log aapke aas-paas jama honge. Aur mujhe dar hai ke aap khade hokar kuch kahenge, aur kuch log aapki baat failaayenge aur shaayad wahi na kahein jo aapne asal mein kaha, aur uska matlab na samjhein, aur use ghalat tareeke se samjhaayein, isliye aapko tab tak intezaar karna chaahiye jab tak aap Madina na pahunch jaayein, kyunke wahi hijrat ki jagah aur Nabi ki riwaayat ki jagah hai, aur wahaan aap aalim aur izzatdaar logon se mil sakte hain, aur unhein bharosemand tareeke se apne khayaal bata sakte hain; aur aalim log aapki baat samjhenge aur use sahi jagah rakhenge." Isper, Umar ne kaha, "Allah ki qasam! Allah ne chaaha, to main Madina mein logon ke saamne apni pehli taqreer mein ye zaroor karunga."' Ibn Abbas ne izaafa kiya: Hum Zul-Hijja ke aakhir mein Madina pahunche, aur jab Jumma tha, hum jaldi se (Masjid ki taraf) gaye jaise hi suraj dhala, aur maine Saeed bin Zaid bin Amr bin Nufail ko mimbar ke ek kone mein baithe dekha, aur main bhi unke qareeb baitha itna ke mera ghutna unke ghutne se chhu raha tha, aur thodi der baad Umar bin Al-Khattab baahar aaye, aur jab maine unhein hamaari taraf aate dekha, maine Saeed bin Zaid bin Amr bin Nufail se kaha, 'Aaj Umar kuch aisa kahenge jaisa unhone Khalifa chune jaane ke baad kabhi nahi kaha.' Saeed ne mere bayaan ko hairaani se rad kiya aur kaha, 'Tumhein kya lagta hai Umar aisa kya kahenge jo unhone pehle kabhi nahi kaha?' Isi dauraan, Umar mimbar par baithe, aur jab Azaan dene walon ne apni Azaan khatam ki, Umar khade hue, aur Allah ki tareef aur hamd karne ke baad jaisi wo laayak hai, unhone kaha, 'Ab, aage, main tumhein kuch aisa bataane ja raha hoon jo (Allah ne) mere kehne ke liye likha hai. Mujhe nahi pata; shaayad ye meri maut ki nishaani hai, isliye jo koi ise samjhe aur yaad rakhe, use ye doosron ko sunaana chaahiye jahaan bhi uski sawaari le jaaye, magar agar kisi ko dar ho ke wo ise sahi tarah nahi samjhega, to uske liye mere baare mein jhoot bolna na-jaayez hai. Allah ne Muhammad ko Haq ke saath bheja aur unhein paak Kitaab naazil ki, aur jo kuch Allah ne naazil kiya usmein Rajam ki Aayat bhi thi (shaadi-shuda mard aur aurat, jo zina karein, ke sangsaar ke baare mein), aur humne ye Aayat padhi, samjhi aur yaad ki. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Rajam ki saza di, aur humne bhi unke baad di. Mujhe dar hai ke lambi muddat guzarne ke baad, koi kahega, "Allah ki qasam, humein Rajam ki Aayat Allah ki Kitaab mein nahi milti," aur isse wo bhatak jaayenge is farz ko chhod kar jo Allah ne naazil kiya hai. Aur Rajam ki saza kisi bhi shaadi-shuda shaks (mard ya aurat) par lagaayi jaani chaahiye, jo zina kare, agar zaroori saboot maujood ho ya hamal ho ya iqbaal ho. Aur phir hum Allah ki Kitaab ki Aayaton mein ye bhi padha karte the: "Aye logo! Apne asli baap ke ilaawa kisi aur ki aulaad hone ka dawa mat karo, kyunke ye tumhaari taraf se na-shukri (Kufr) hai ke tum apne asli baap ke ilaawa kisi aur ki aulaad hone ka dawa karo." Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, "Meri zaroorat se zyaada tareef mat karo jaise Isa, Maryam ke bete, ki (zyaada) tareef ki gayi thi, balke mujhe Allah ka bandaa aur uska Rasool kaho." (Aye logo!) Mujhe bataya gaya hai ke tum mein se ek bolne wala kehta hai, "Allah ki qasam, agar Umar mar jaayein, to main falaan-falaan shaks se baiyat karunga." Koi khud ko ye kehkar dhoka na de ke Abu Bakr ki baiyat achaanak di gayi thi aur wo kaamyaab thi. Beshak, ye waisa hi tha, magar Allah ne (logon ko) uski buraai se bachaaya, aur tum mein se koi Abu Bakr jaisi khoobiyaan nahi rakhta. Yaad rakho, jo koi bhi doosre Musalmaanon se salaah liye bagair kisi ko baiyat de (Khalifa banaane ke liye), to na wo shaks aur na jise baiyat di gayi thi, unka koi himaayat nahi kiya jaayega, kahin dono qatl na kar diye jaayein. Aur beshak, Nabi (SAW) ki wafat ke baad, humein pata chala ke Ansaar humse ikhtelaaf rakhte the aur Banu Sa'da ke chhappar mein jama hue. Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur jo unke saath the, unhone hamaari mukhaalifat ki, jabke Muhaajireen Abu Bakr ke saath jama hue. Maine Abu Bakr se kaha, "Chaliye hum apne in Ansaari bhaiyon ke paas chalte hain." To hum unhein dhoondte hue nikle, aur jab hum unke qareeb pahunche, unke do neik log humse mile aur humein Ansaar ke aakhri faisle ke baare mein bataaya, aur kaha, "Aye Muhaajireen ke giroh! Tum kahaan jaa rahe ho?" Humne jawab diya, "Hum apne in Ansaari bhaiyon ke paas jaa rahe hain." Unhone humse kaha, "Tumhein unke qareeb nahi jaana chaahiye. Jo humne pehle hi tay kar liya hai wahi karo." Maine kaha, "Allah ki qasam, hum unke paas jaayenge." Aur hum aage badhe yahaan tak ke hum Banu Sa'da ke chhappar mein unke paas pahunche. Dekho! Unke beech ek aadmi baitha tha kisi cheez mein lipta hua. Maine pucha, "Ye kaun aadmi hai?" Unhone kaha, "Ye Sa'd bin Ubada (رضی اللہ عنہ) hain." Maine pucha, "Unhein kya hua?" Unhone kaha, "Wo bimar hain." Kuch der baithne ke baad, Ansaar ke bolne wale ne kaha, "Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi," aur Allah ki tareef karne ke baad jaisi wo laayak hai, unhone izaafa kiya, "Aage, hum Allah ke Ansaar (madadgaar) hain aur Musalmaan fauj ka zyaada hissa hain, jabke tum, Muhaajireen, ek chhota giroh ho, aur tum mein se kuch log iss iraade se aaye ke wo humein ye maamla (yaani khilaafat) karne se rokein aur ise humse chheen lein." Jab bolne wale ne apni baat khatam ki, mujhe bolna tha kyunke maine ek taqreer taiyaar ki thi jo mujhe pasand thi aur main use Abu Bakr ki maujoodgi mein dena chahta tha, aur main unhein naaraaz karne se bachta tha. To jab maine bolna chaaha, Abu Bakr ne kaha, "Thoda ruko." Mujhe unhein gussa dilaana napasand tha. To Abu Bakr ne khud taqreer di, aur wo mujhse zyaada aqlmand aur sabra karne wale the. Allah ki qasam, unhone koi jumla nahi chhoda jo mujhe pasand tha apni khud ki taiyaar ki gayi taqreer se, magar unhone usi jaisa ya usse behtar khud-bakhud kaha. Thodi der baad unhone kaha, "Aye Ansaar! Tum sab (khoobiyon) ke haqdaar ho jo tumne apne baare mein bataayi hain, magar ye maamla (khilaafat) sirf Quraish ke liye hai kyunke wo Arabon mein sab se behtar hain vansh aur ghar ke lihaaz se, aur mujhe khushi hai ye sujhaav dena ke tum in do aadmiyon mein se kisi ek ko chuno, isliye tum jise chaaho use baiyat do." Aur phir Abu Bakr ne mera haath thaama aur Abu Ubaida bin Al-Jarrah ka haath thaama jo humare beech baithe the. Mujhe unki kisi baat se nafrat nahi thi siwaaye us tajweez ke, kyunke Allah ki qasam, main apni gardan katwaana behtar samajhta ek gunaah ke kaffare ke taur par is se ke main ek aisi qaum ka hukmraan banoon jismein Abu Bakr shaamil hon, jab tak ke meri maut ke waqt mera khud ka nafs kuch aisa na suzaaye jo abhi mujhe mehsoos nahi hota." Phir Ansaar mein se ek shaks ne kaha, "Main wo khambha hoon jispar khaarish-zada oont apni khujli mitaane ke liye rangadta hai (yaani main ek izzatdaar shaks hoon), aur main ek badi khajoor ke darakht jaisa hoon! Aye Quraish. Ek hukmraan hamaari taraf se hona chaahiye aur ek tumhaari taraf se." Phir majlis mein shor-o-gul macha aur unki aawaazein itni oonchi ho gayin ke mujhe dar laga koi bada ikhtelaaf ho jaayega, isliye maine kaha, "Aye Abu Bakr! Apna haath badhaao." Unhone apna haath badhaaya aur maine unhein baiyat di, phir sab Muhaajireen ne baiyat di aur baad mein Ansaar ne bhi di. Aur isi tarah hum Sa'd bin Ubada (jinhein Ansaar hukmraan banaana chahte the) par kaamyaab hue. Ansaar mein se ek shaks ne kaha, "Tumne Sa'd bin Ubada ko qatl kar diya." Maine jawab diya, "Allah ne Sa'd bin Ubada ko qatl kiya."' Umar ne izaafa kiya, "Allah ki qasam, us badi museebat (yaani Nabi ki maut) ke ilaawa, jo hampar aayi, Abu Bakr ko di gayi baiyat se bada koi maamla nahi tha, kyunke hamein dar tha ke agar hum logon ko chhod dete, to wo hamare baad apne mein se kisi shaks ko baiyat de dete, aur is soorat mein hum ya to unhein apni raazamandi de dete jo hamari asli khwaahish ke khilaaf hoti, ya hum unki mukhaalifat karte aur bada fasaad hota. Isliye agar koi kisi ko (Khalifa banaane ke liye) baiyat de doosre Musalmaanon se salaah liye bagair, to jise usne chuna hai use baiyat nahi di jaani chaahiye, kahin dono qatl na kar diye jaayein."'

e: Narrated Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) ordering that an unmarried person guilty of illegal sexual intercourse be flogged one-hundred stripes and be exiled for one year. `Umar bin Al-Khattab also exiled such a person, and this tradition is still valid
hi: Zaid bin Khalid (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Juhani (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye hukm dete suna ke ek kunwaara shaks jo zina ka gunahgaar ho, use sau kode maare jaayein aur ek saal ke liye jila-watan kiya jaaye. Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab ne bhi aise shaks ko jila-watan kiya, aur ye riwaayat aaj bhi jaari hai.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) judged that the unmarried person who was guilty of illegal sexual intercourse be exiled for one year and receive the legal punishment (i.e., be flogged with one-hundred stripes)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne faisla diya ke kunwaara shaks jo zina ka gunahgaar ho, use ek saal ke liye jila-watan kiya jaaye aur kanooni saza (yaani sau kode) di jaaye.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) cursed the effeminate men and those women who assume the similitude (manners) of men. He also said, "Turn them out of your houses." He turned such-and-such person out, and `Umar also turned out such-and-such person
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne un mardon par laanat bheji jo auraton jaisi hai-shaili apnaate the, aur un auraton par bhi jo mardon jaisi hai-shaili apnaati thin. Unhone ye bhi kaha, 'Unhein apne gharon se nikaal do.' Unhone falaan shaks ko nikaala, aur Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne bhi falaan shaks ko nikaala.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira and Zaid bin Khalid:A bedouin came to the Prophet (ﷺ) while he (the Prophet) was sitting, and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Give your verdict according to Allah's Laws (in our case)." Then his opponent got up and said, "He has told the truth, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Decide his case according to Allah's Laws. My son was a laborer working for this person, and he committed illegal sexual intercourse with his wife, and the people told me that my son should be stoned to death, but I offered one-hundred sheep and a slave girl as a ransom for him. Then I asked the religious learned people, and they told me that my son should be flogged with one-hundred stripes and be exiled for one year." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "By Him in Whose Hand my soul is, I will judge you according to Allah's Laws. The sheep and the slave girl will be returned to you and your son will be flogged one-hundred stripes and be exiled for one year. And you, O Unais! Go to the wife of this man (and if she confesses), stone her to death." So Unais went in the morning and stoned her to death (after she had confessed)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Zaid bin Khalid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek badawi Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya jabke wo baithe hue the, aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Humein Allah ke Qawaanin ke mutaabik faisla dijiye.' Phir uska mukhaalif khada hua aur kaha, 'Unhone sach kaha, Aye Allah ke Rasool! Unke maamle ka faisla Allah ke Qawaanin ke mutaabik kijiye. Mera beta is shaks ka mazdoor tha, aur usne iski biwi ke saath zina kiya, aur logon ne mujhse kaha mere bete ko sangsaar kiya jaana chaahiye, magar maine sau bakriyaan aur ek launDi uske fidye mein di. Phir maine deeni aalimon se pucha, aur unhone mujhe bataaya ke mere bete ko sau kode maare jaayein aur ek saal ke liye jila-watan kiya jaaye.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, main tumhaare beech Allah ke Qawaanin ke mutaabik faisla dunga. Bakriyaan aur launDi tumhein wapas ki jaayengi aur tumhaare bete ko sau kode maare jaayenge aur ek saal ke liye jila-watan kiya jaayega. Aur tum, Aye Unais! Is aadmi ki biwi ke paas jaao, (aur agar wo iqbaal kare), to use sangsaar kar do.' To Unais subah gaye aur (unke iqbaal karne ke baad) use sangsaar kar diya.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira and Zaid bin Khalid:The verdict of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was sought about an unmarried slave girl guilty of illegal intercourse. He replied, "If she commits illegal sexual intercourse, then flog her (fifty stripes), and if she commits illegal sexual intercourse (after that for the second time), then flog her (fifty stripes), and if she commits illegal sexual intercourse (for the third time), then flog her (fifty stripes) and sell her for even a hair rope." Ibn Shihab said, "I am not sure whether the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered that she be sold after the third or fourth time of committing illegal intercourse
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Zaid bin Khalid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ek kunwaari launDi (jisne zina kiya tha) ke baare mein faisla poocha gaya. Unhone jawab diya, 'Agar wo zina kare, to use kode maaro (pachaas kode), aur agar wo zina kare (doosri baar), to use kode maaro (pachaas kode), aur agar wo zina kare (teesri baar), to use kode maaro (pachaas kode) aur use bech do, chaahe baalon ki rassi ke badle hi kyun na ho.' Ibn Shihab kehte hain, 'Mujhe yaqeen nahi ke Nabi (SAW) ne teesri ya chauthi baar zina karne ke baad use bechne ka hukm diya tha.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If a lady slave commits illegal sexual intercourse and she is proved guilty of illegal sexual intercourse, then she should be flogged (fifty stripes) but she should not be admonished; and if she commits illegal sexual intercourse again, then she should be flogged again but should not be admonished; and if she commits illegal sexual intercourse for the third time, then she should be sold even for a hair rope
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar ek launDi zina kare aur use zina ka mujrim saabit kiya jaaye, to use kode maare jaayein (pachaas), magar use daantaa na jaaye; aur agar wo dobara zina kare, to use phir kode maare jaayein magar daantaa na jaaye; aur agar wo teesri baar zina kare, to use bech diya jaaye, chaahe baalon ki rassi ke badle hi kyun na ho.'

e: Narrated Ash-Shaibani:I asked `Abdullah bin Abi `Aufa about the Rajam (stoning somebody to death for committing illegal sexual intercourse). He replied, "The Prophet (ﷺ) carried out the penalty of Rajam," I asked, "Was that before or after the revelation of Surat-an-Nur?" He replied, "I do not know
hi: Ash-Shaibani bataate hain: Maine Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Aufa se Rajam (zina ki saza ke taur par sangsaar) ke baare mein pucha. Unhone jawab diya, 'Nabi (SAW) ne Rajam ki saza di.' Maine pucha, 'Surah An-Nur ki naazil hone se pehle ya baad mein?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Mujhe nahi pata.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The jews came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and mentioned to him that a man and a lady among them had committed illegal sexual intercourse. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to them, "What do you find in the Torah regarding the Rajam?" They replied, "We only disgrace and flog them with stripes." `Abdullah bin Salam said to them, 'You have told a lie the penalty of Rajam is in the Torah.' They brought the Torah and opened it. One of them put his hand over the verse of the Rajam and read what was before and after it. `Abdullah bin Salam said to him, "Lift up your hand." Where he lifted it there appeared the verse of the Rajam. So they said, "O Muhammad! He has said the truth, the verse of the Rajam is in it (Torah)." Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered that the two persons (guilty of illegal sexual intercourse) be stoned to death, and so they were stoned, and I saw the man bending over the woman so as to protect her from the stones
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Yahudi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unhein bataaya ke unmein se ek aadmi aur ek khaatoon ne zina kiya hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha, 'Taurat mein Rajam ke baare mein tumhein kya milta hai?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Hum sirf unhein be-izzat karte hain aur kodon se maarte hain.' Abdullah bin Salam (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne unse kaha, 'Tumne jhoot bola; Rajam ki saza Taurat mein hai.' Wo Taurat le aaye aur use khola. Unmein se ek ne apna haath Rajam ki Aayat par rakha aur uske pehle aur baad ki cheezein padhne laga. Abdullah bin Salam ne usse kaha, 'Apna haath uthaao.' Jahaan usne uthaaya, wahaan Rajam ki Aayat zaahir hui. To unhone kaha, 'Aye Muhammad! Unhone sach kaha, Rajam ki Aayat isme (Taurat mein) hai.' Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne hukm diya ke dono (zina karne walon) ko sangsaar kiya jaaye, aur unhein sangsaar kiya gaya, aur maine dekha wo aadmi khaatoon par jhuka hua tha use pattharon se bachaane ke liye.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira and Zaid bin Khalid:Two men had a dispute in the presence of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). One of them said, "Judge us according to Allah's Laws." The other who was more wise said, "Yes, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), judge us according to Allah's Laws and allow me to speak (first)" The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, 'Speak " He said, "My son was a laborer for this man, and he committed illegal sexual intercourse with his wife, and the people told me that my son should be stoned to death, but I have given one-hundred sheep and a slave girl as a ransom (expiation) for my son's sin. Then I asked the religious learned people (about It), and they told me that my son should he flogged one-hundred stripes and should be exiled for one year, and only the wife of this man should be stoned to death " Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "By Him in Whose Hand my soul is, I will judge you according to Allah's Laws: O man, as for your sheep and slave girl, they are to be returned to you." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) had the man's son flogged one hundred stripes and exiled for one year, and ordered Unais Al-Aslami to go to the wife of the other man, and if she confessed, stone her to death. She confessed and was stoned to death
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Zaid bin Khalid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Do aadmiyon ka Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki maujoodgi mein jhagda hua. Unmein se ek ne kaha, 'Humaare beech Allah ke Qawaanin ke mutaabik faisla kijiye.' Doosra, jo zyaada aqlmand tha, khada hua aur kaha, 'Haan, Aye Allah ke Rasool, humaare beech Allah ke Qawaanin ke mutaabik faisla kijiye aur mujhe (pehle) bolne dijiye.' Nabi (SAW) ne unse kaha, 'Bolo.' Usne kaha, 'Mera beta is aadmi ka mazdoor tha, aur usne iski biwi ke saath zina kiya, aur logon ne mujhse kaha ke mere bete ko sangsaar kiya jaana chaahiye, magar maine apne bete ke gunaah ke fidye mein sau bakriyaan aur ek launDi di. Phir maine deeni aalimon se (iske baare mein) pucha, aur unhone mujhe bataaya ke mere bete ko sau kode maare jaayein aur ek saal ke liye jila-watan kiya jaaye, aur sirf is aadmi ki biwi ko sangsaar kiya jaana chaahiye.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, main tumhaare beech Allah ke Qawaanin ke mutaabik faisla dunga: Aye aadmi, tumhaari bakriyaan aur launDi tumhein wapas ki jaayengi.' Phir Nabi (SAW) ne aadmi ke bete ko sau kode maare aur ek saal ke liye jila-watan kiya, aur Unais Al-Aslami ko hukm diya ke wo doosre aadmi ki biwi ke paas jaayein, aur agar wo iqbaal kare, to use sangsaar kar dein. Usne iqbaal kiya aur usse sangsaar kar diya gaya.

e: Narrated `Aisha:Abu Bakr came to me while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was sleeping with his head on my thigh. Abu Bakr said (to me), "You have detained Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and the people, and there is no water in this place." So he admonished me and struck my flanks with his hand, and nothing could stop me from moving except the reclining of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (on my thigh), and then Allah revealed the Divine Verse of Tayammum
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Abu Bakr mere paas aaye jabke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) so rahe the, apna sar meri jaangh par rakhkar. Abu Bakr ne (mujhse) kaha, 'Tumne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur logon ko rok liya hai, aur is jagah paani nahi hai.' To unhone mujhe daantaa aur apne haath se mere pehlu par maara, aur kuch bhi mujhe hilne se nahi rok saka siwaaye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke tek lagaaye hue (meri jaangh par) hone ke, aur phir Allah ne Tayammum ki Ilaahi Aayat naazil ki.

e: Narrated Aisha:Abu Bakr came to towards me and struck me violently with his fist and said, "You have detained the people because of your necklace." But I remained motionless as if I was dead lest I should awake Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) although that hit was very painful
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Abu Bakr mere paas aaye aur apni mutthi se mujhe zor se maara aur kaha, 'Tumne apne haar ki wajah se logon ko rok liya hai.' Magar main bilkul bekhauf rahi jaise main mari hui hoon taake Allah ke Rasool (SAW) na jaagen, chaahe wo chot bahut dard-naak thi.

e: Narrated Al-Mughira:Sa`d bin Ubada said, "If I found a man with my wife, I would kill him with the sharp side of my sword." When the Prophet (ﷺ) heard that he said, "Do you wonder at Sa`d's sense of ghira (self-respect)? Verily, I have more sense of ghira than Sa`d, and Allah has more sense of ghira than I
hi: Al-Mughira bataate hain: Sa'd bin Ubada (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Agar main apni biwi ke saath kisi aadmi ko paaun, main use apni talwaar ki dhaar se qatl kar doonga.' Jab Nabi (SAW) ne ye suna, unhone kaha, 'Kya tum Sa'd ki Ghira (izzat/ghairat ki bhaavna) par hairaan ho? Beshak, mujhe Sa'd se bhi zyaada Ghira hai, aur Allah ko mujhse bhi zyaada Ghira hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:A bedouin came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "My wife has delivered a black child." The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "Have you camels?" He replied, "Yes." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "What color are they?" He replied, "They are red." The Prophet (ﷺ) further asked, "Are any of them gray in color?" He replied, "Yes." The Prophet asked him, "Whence did that grayness come?" He said, "I thing it descended from the camel's ancestors." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said (to him), "Therefore, this child of yours has most probably inherited the color from his ancestors
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek badawi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Meri biwi ne ek kaale bacche ko paidaish diya hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne unse kaha, 'Kya tumhaare paas oont hain?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Haan.' Nabi (SAW) ne pucha, 'Unka rang kaisa hai?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Wo laal hain.' Nabi (SAW) ne aage pucha, 'Kya unmein se koi khaakastari rang ka bhi hai?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Haan.' Nabi (SAW) ne unse pucha, 'Wo khaakastari rang kahaan se aaya?' Unhone kaha, 'Mujhe lagta hai wo oont ke poorvajon se aaya hai.' Phir Nabi (SAW) ne (unse) kaha, 'Isliye, tumhaara ye bacha shaayad apne poorvajon se rang wirasat mein le gaya hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Burda:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to say, "Nobody should be flogged more than ten stripes except if he is guilty of a crime, the legal punishment of which is assigned by Allah
hi: Abu Burda bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) kaha karte the, 'Kisi ko das kode se zyaada nahi maara jaana chaahiye, siwaaye is ke ke wo kisi aise gunaah ka gunahgaar ho jiski kanooni saza Allah ne muqarrar ki hai.'

e: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin Jabir:On the authority of others, that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No Punishment exceeds the flogging of the ten stripes, except if one is guilty of a crime necessitating a legal punishment prescribed by Allah
hi: Abdur Rahman bin Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ), doosron ke hawaale se, bataate hain ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Das kode se zyaada koi saza nahi hai, siwaaye is ke ke koi aise gunaah ka gunahgaar ho jiski kanooni saza Allah ne muqarrar ki hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Burda Al-Ansari:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Do not flog anyone more than ten stripes except if he is involved in a crime necessitating Allah's legal Punishment
hi: Abu Burda Al-Ansari bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Kisi ko das kode se zyaada mat maaro, siwaaye is ke ke wo kisi aise gunaah mein shaamil ho jiski kanooni saza Allah ne muqarrar ki hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade Al-Wisal (fasting continuously for more than one day without taking any meals). A man from the Muslims said, "But you do Al-Wisal, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Who among you is similar to me? I sleep and my Lord makes me eat and drink." When the people refused to give up Al-Wisal, the Prophet (ﷺ) fasted along with them for one day, and did not break his fast but continued his fast for another day, and when they saw the crescent, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If the crescent had not appeared, I would have made you continue your fast (for a third day)," as if he wanted to punish them for they had refused to give up Al-Wisal
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Al-Wisal (bina khaana khaaye ek se zyaada din lagataar roza rakhna) se mana kiya. Musalmaanon mein se ek shaks ne kaha, 'Magar aap to Al-Wisal karte hain, Aye Allah ke Rasool!' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Tum mein se kaun mere jaisa hai? Main so-ta hoon aur mera Rab mujhe khilaata aur pilaata hai.' Jab logon ne Al-Wisal chhodne se inkaar kiya, Nabi (SAW) ne unke saath ek din roza rakha, aur apna roza nahi tod, balke doosre din tak apna roza jaari rakha, aur jab unhone chaand dekha, Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Agar chaand nazar na aata, to main tumhein aur (ek teesre din tak) roza jaari rakhwaata,' jaise wo unhein saza dena chahte hon kyunke unhone Al-Wisal chhodne se inkaar kiya tha.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Those people who used to buy foodstuff at random (without weighing or measuring it) were beaten in the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) if they sold it at the very place where they had bought it, till they carried it to their dwelling places
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jo log khaane-peene ki cheezein bina tolne ya naapne ke andaaza se khareedte the, unhein Nabi (SAW) ki zindagi mein maara jaata tha agar wo use usi jagah bech dete jahaan se khareeda tha, jab tak wo use apne rehne ki jagah tak le na jaate.

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) never took revenge for his own self in any matter presented to him till Allah's limits were exceeded, in which case he would take revenge for Allah's sake
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kabhi apni khaatir kisi bhi maamle mein badla nahi liya jo unke saamne pesh kiya gaya, jab tak Allah ki hadd na todi jaaye, jismein wo Allah ki khaatir badla lete.

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:I witnessed the case of Lian (the case of a man who charged his wife for committing illegal sexual intercourse when I was fifteen years old. The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered that they be divorced, and the husband said, "If I kept her, I would be a liar." I remember that Az-Zubair also said, "(It was said) that if that woman brought forth the child with such-and-such description, her husband would prove truthful, but if she brought it with such-and-such description looking like a Wahra (a red insect), he would prove untruthful." I heard Az-Zubair also saying, "Finally she gave birth to a child of description which her husband disliked
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Li'an (jab ek aadmi ne apni biwi par zina ka ilzaam lagaaya) ka maamla dekha jab main pandrah saal ka tha. Nabi (SAW) ne unki talaaq ka hukm diya, aur shohar ne kaha, 'Agar main use rakhun, to main jhoota hounga.' Mujhe yaad hai Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne bhi kaha, '(Kaha gaya tha) ke agar wo khaatoon aisi-aisi soorat ka bacha paida kare, to uska shohar sacha saabit hoga, magar agar wo aisi-aisi soorat ka bacha paida kare jo Wahra (ek laal keeda) jaisa dikhe, to wo jhoota saabit hoga.' Maine Az-Zubair ko ye bhi kehte suna, 'Aakhir mein, unhone aisi soorat ka bacha paidaish diya jo uske shohar ko napasand thi.'

e: Narrated Al-Qasim bin Muhammad:Ibn `Abbas mentioned the couple who had taken the oath of Lian. `Abdullah bin Shaddad said (to him), "Was this woman about whom Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'If I were ever to stone to death any woman without witnesses. (I would have stoned that woman to death)?' Ibn `Abbas replied," No, that lady exposed herself (by her suspicious behavior)
hi: Al-Qasim bin Muhammad bataate hain: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne us jodi ka zikr kiya jinhone Li'an ki qasam li thi. Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Shaddad ne (unse) kaha, 'Kya ye wahi khaatoon thi jinke baare mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha tha, "Agar main kabhi kisi khaatoon ko bina gawaahon ke sangsaar karta (to main us khaatoon ko sangsaar karta)"?' Ibn Abbas ne jawab diya, 'Nahi, wo khaatoon apne aap ko zaahir kar chuki thi (apne shakki suluk se).'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Lian was mentioned in the presence of the Prophet, `Asim bin Adi said a statement about it, and when he left, a man from his tribe came to him complaining that he had seen a man with his wife. `Asim said, "I have been put to trial only because of my statement." So he took the man to the Prophet (ﷺ) and the man told him about the incident. The man (husband) was of yellow complexion, thin, and of lank hair, while the man whom he had accused of having been with his wife, was reddish brown with fat thick legs and fat body. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! Reveal the truth." Later on the lady delivered a child resembling the man whom the husband had accused of having been with her. So the Prophet (ﷺ) made them take the oath of Lian. A man said to Ibn `Abbas in the gathering, "Was that the same lady about whom the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If I were to stone any lady (for committing illegal sexual intercourse) to death without witnesses, I would have stoned that lade to death?" Ibn `Abbas said, "No, that was another lady who used to behave in such a suspicious way among the Muslims that one might accuse her of committing illegal sexual intercourse
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Li'an ka zikr Nabi (SAW) ki maujoodgi mein hua, Aasim bin Adi ne uske baare mein ek baat kahi, aur jab wo chale gaye, unke qabeele ka ek shaks unke paas shikaayat lekar aaya ke usne apni biwi ke saath ek aadmi ko dekha hai. Aasim ne kaha, 'Mujhe sirf apni baat ki wajah se azmaaish mein daala gaya hai.' To wo aadmi ko Nabi (SAW) ke paas le gaye aur us aadmi ne unhein waaqia bataaya. Wo aadmi (shohar) peela rang, patla, aur seedhe baalon wala tha, jabke jis aadmi par usne apni biwi ke saath hone ka ilzaam lagaaya tha, wo laali maayel bhoora, mote patte pairon aur mote jism wala tha. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Aye Allah! Haqeeqat zaahir kar.' Baad mein khaatoon ne ek bacha paidaish diya jo us aadmi se milta-julta tha jispar shohar ne ilzaam lagaaya tha. To Nabi (SAW) ne unhein Li'an ki qasam lene ko kaha. Majlis mein ek shaks ne Ibn Abbas se kaha, 'Kya ye wahi khaatoon thi jinke baare mein Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, "Agar main kisi khaatoon ko (zina karne ke liye) bina gawaahon ke sangsaar karta, to main us khaatoon ko sangsaar karta"?' Ibn Abbas ne kaha, 'Nahi, wo ek doosri khaatoon thi jo Musalmaanon ke beech aisi shakki tareeke se suluk karti thi ke koi bhi uspar zina ka ilzaam laga sakta tha.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Avoid the seven great destructive sins." They (the people!) asked, "O Allah's Apostle! What are they?" He said, "To join partners in worship with Allah; to practice sorcery; to kill the life which Allah has forbidden except for a just cause (according to Islamic law); to eat up usury (Riba), to eat up the property of an orphan; to give one's back to the enemy and fleeing from the battle-field at the time of fighting and to accuse chaste women who never even think of anything touching chastity and are good believers
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Saat tabaahkun gunaahon se bacho.' Unhone (logon ne) pucha, 'Aye Allah ke Nabi! Wo kya hain?' Unhone kaha, 'Allah ke saath doosron ko shareek karna; jaadu karna; kisi jaan ko qatl karna jise Allah ne haraam kiya hai, siwaaye jaayez wajah ke (Islami qanoon ke mutaabik); sood (Riba) khaana; yateem ki jaayadaad khaana; jang ke maidan mein ladte waqt dushman se peeth dikhaakar bhaagna; aur paakdaaman auraton par ilzaam lagaana jo kabhi kisi paakdaamani se juda khayaal bhi nahi rakhtin aur achhi Momin hain.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard Abu-l-Qasim (the Prophet) saying, "If somebody slanders his slave and the slave is free from what he says, he will be flogged on the Day of Resurrection unless the slave is really as he has described him
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Abu-l-Qasim (Nabi) ko ye kehte suna, 'Agar koi apne ghulaam par bohtaan lagaaye aur ghulaam uski baat se paak ho, to use Qayamat ke din kode maare jaayenge, siwaaye is ke ke ghulaam waaqai waisa ho jaisa usne bataaya.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira and Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani:A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "I beseech you to judge us according to Allah's Laws." Then his opponent who was wiser than he, got up and said, "He has spoken the truth. So judge us according to Allah's Laws and please allow me (to speak), O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Speak." He said, "My son was a laborer for the family of this man and he committed illegal sexual intercourse with his wife, and I gave one-hundred sheep and a slave as a ransom (for my son), but I asked the religious learned people (regarding this case), and they informed me that my son should be flogged onehundred stripes, and be exiled for one year, and the wife of this man should be stoned (to death)."The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "By Him in Whose Hand my soul is, I will Judge you (in this case) according to Allah's Laws. The one-hundred (sheep) and the slave shall be returned to you and your son shall be flogged one-hundred stripes and be exiled for one year. And O Unais! Go in the morning to the wife of this man and ask her, and if she confesses, stone her to death." She confessed and he stoned her to death
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Zaid bin Khalid (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Juhani (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Main aapko qasam deta hoon, humaare beech Allah ke Qawaanin ke mutaabik faisla kijiye.' Phir uska mukhaalif, jo usse zyaada aqlmand tha, khade hokar bola, 'Unhone sach kaha. Isliye humaare beech Allah ke Qawaanin ke mutaabik faisla kijiye aur barah-e-meharbaani mujhe (bolne ki) ijaazat dijiye, Aye Allah ke Rasool.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Bolo.' Usne kaha, 'Mera beta is shaks ke khaandaan ka mazdoor tha aur usne iski biwi ke saath zina kiya, aur maine (apne bete ke fidye mein) sau bakriyaan aur ek ghulaam diya, magar maine deeni aalimon se (is maamle ke baare mein) pucha, aur unhone mujhe bataaya ke mere bete ko sau kode maare jaayein aur ek saal ke liye jila-watan kiya jaaye, aur is aadmi ki biwi ko sangsaar kiya jaaye.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, main tumhaare (is maamle mein) beech Allah ke Qawaanin ke mutaabik faisla dunga. Sau (bakriyaan) aur ghulaam tumhein wapas kiye jaayenge aur tumhaare bete ko sau kode maare jaayenge aur ek saal ke liye jila-watan kiya jaayega. Aur Aye Unais! Subah is aadmi ki biwi ke paas jaao aur usse pucho, aur agar wo iqbaal kare, to use sangsaar kar do.' Usne iqbaal kiya aur unhone use sangsaar kar diya.

e: Narrated `Abdullah:A man said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Which sin is the greatest in Allah's Sight?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "To set up a rival unto Allah though He Alone created you . " The man said, "What is next?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "To kill your son lest he should share your food with you." The man said, "What is next?" The Prophet said, "To commit illegal sexual intercourse with the wife of your neighbor." So Allah revealed in confirmation of this narration:-- 'And those who invoke not with Allah, any other god. Nor kill, such life as Allah has forbidden except for just cause nor commit illegal sexual intercourse. And whoever does this shall receive the punishment
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Allah ki nazar mein sabse bada gunaah kaunsa hai?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Allah ka koi shareek thehraana jabke usne akele tumhein banaaya.' Us shaks ne kaha, 'Uske baad kya?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Apne bete ko is dar se qatl karna ke wo tumhaare saath tumhaara khaana baantega.' Us shaks ne kaha, 'Uske baad kya?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Apne padosi ki biwi ke saath zina karna.' To Allah ne is riwaayat ki tasdeeq mein naazil kiya: '...Aur wo jo Allah ke saath kisi doosre khuda ko nahi pukaarte, na aisi jaan ko qatl karte hain jise Allah ne haraam kiya hai, siwaaye jaayez wajah ke, na zina karte hain. Aur jo koi aisa kare use saza milegi...'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "A faithful believer remains at liberty regarding his religion unless he kills somebody unlawfully
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ek imandaar Momin apne deen ke maamle mein aazaad rehta hai jab tak wo kisi ko na-jaayez taur par qatl na kare.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:One of the evil deeds with bad consequence from which there is no escape for the one who is involved in it is to kill someone unlawfully
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: In buri harkaton mein se, jinke bure natije hote hain, aur jinse bachne ka koi raasta nahi hota jo isme mubtala ho jaaye, wo hai kisi ko na-jaayez taur par qatl karna.

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The first cases to be decided among the people (on the Day of Resurrection) will be those of blood-shed
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Logon ke beech (Qayamat ke din) tay ki jaane wali sabse pehli baaten khoon-kharaabe (qatl) ke maamle honge.'

e: Narrated Al-Miqdad bin `Amr Al-Kindi:An ally of Bani Zuhra who took part in the battle of Badr with the Prophet, that he said, "O Allah's Apostle! If I meet an unbeliever and we have a fight, and he strikes my hand with the sword and cuts it off, and then takes refuge from me under a tree, and says, 'I have surrendered to Allah (i.e. embraced Islam),' may I kill him after he has said so?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Do not kill him." Al- Miqdad said, "But O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! He had chopped off one of my hands and he said that after he had cut it off. May I kill him?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said. "Do not kill him for if you kill him, he would be in the position in which you had been before you kill him, and you would be in the position in which he was before he said the sentence." The Prophet (ﷺ) also said to Al-Miqdad, "If a faithful believer conceals his faith (Islam) from the disbelievers, and then when he declares his Islam, you kill him, (you will be sinful). Remember that you were also concealing your faith (Islam) at Mecca before
hi: Al-Miqdad (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr Al-Kindi, jo Banu Zuhra ke saathi the aur jinhone Nabi (SAW) ke saath jang-e-Badr mein hissa liya, bataate hain: Unhone kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Agar main ek kaafir se milun aur hamaari ladai ho, aur wo apni talwaar se mera haath maare aur use kaat de, phir wo mujhse ek darakht ke neeche panaah le, aur kahe, "Maine Allah ke saamne apne aap ko saup diya hai (yaani Islam qubool kar liya)," kya main use uske aisa kehne ke baad qatl kar sakta hoon?' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Use qatl mat karo.' Al-Miqdad ne kaha, 'Magar Aye Allah ke Rasool! Usne mera ek haath kaat diya tha aur phir usne wo baat kahi apne haath kaatne ke baad. Kya main use qatl kar sakta hoon?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Use qatl mat karo, kyunke agar tum use qatl karoge, to wo us jagah hoga jismein tum use qatl karne se pehle the, aur tum us jagah hoge jismein wo us jumla kehne se pehle tha.' Nabi (SAW) ne Al-Miqdad se ye bhi kaha, 'Agar ek imandaar Momin apna Iman (Islam) kaafiron se chhupaaye, aur phir jab wo apna Islam zaahir kare, tum use qatl kar do, (tum gunahgaar hoge). Yaad rakho ke tum bhi Makkah mein apna Iman (Islam) pehle chhupaaya karte the.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No human being is killed unjustly, but a part of responsibility for the crime is laid on the first son of Adam who invented the tradition of killing (murdering) on the earth. (It is said that he was Qabil)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Koi bhi insaan na-jaayez taur par qatl nahi kiya jaata, magar iske gunaah ka kuch hissa Aadam ke pehle bete par bhi hota hai jisne zameen par qatl (hatya) ki riwaayat shuru ki. (Kaha jaata hai ke wo Qabil the.)'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "After me (i.e. after my death), do not become disbelievers, by striking (cutting) the necks of one another
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Mere baad (yaani meri wafat ke baad), ek doosre ki gardanein kaat kar kaafir mat ban jaana.'

e: Narrated Abu Zur'a bin `Amr bin Jarir:The Prophet (ﷺ) said during Hajjat-al-Wada`, "Let the people be quiet and listen to me. After me, do not become disbelievers, by striking (cutting) the necks of one another
hi: Abu Zur'a bin Amr bin Jarir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne Hajjat-ul-Wada ke dauraan kaha, 'Log khaamosh ho jaayein aur meri baat sunein. Mere baad, ek doosre ki gardanein kaat kar kaafir mat ban jaana.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Al-Ka`ba'ir (the biggest sins) are: To join others (as partners) in worship with Allah, to be undutiful to one's parents," or said, "to take a false oath." (The sub-narrator, Shu`ba is not sure) Mu`adh said: Shu`ba said, "Al-Ka`ba'ir (the biggest sins) are: (1) Joining others as partners in worship with Allah, (2) to take a false oath (3) and to be undutiful to one's parents," or said, "to murder (someone unlawfully)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Al-Kaba'ir (sabse bade gunaah) hain: Allah ke saath doosron ko shareek thehraana, maa-baap ke saath badsuluki karna,' ya kaha, 'jhoothi qasam khaana.' (Ravi Shu'ba ko yaqeen nahi.) Mu'adh kehte hain: Shu'ba ne kaha, 'Al-Kaba'ir (sabse bade gunaah) hain: (1) Allah ke saath doosron ko shareek thehraana, (2) jhoothi qasam khaana, (3) aur maa-baap ke saath badsuluki karna,' ya kaha, 'kisi ko na-jaayez taur par qatl karna.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The biggest of Al-Ka`ba'ir (the great sins) are (1) to join others as partners in worship with Allah, (2) to murder a human being, (3) to be undutiful to one's parents (4) and to make a false statement," or said, "to give a false witness
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Al-Kaba'ir (sabse bade gunaahon) mein sabse bade hain: (1) Allah ke saath doosron ko shareek thehraana, (2) kisi insaan ki hatya karna, (3) maa-baap ke saath badsuluki karna, (4) aur jhooti baat kehna,' ya kaha, 'jhooti gawaahi dena.'

e: Narrated Usama bin Zaid bin Haritha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent us (to fight) against Al-Huraqa (one of the sub-tribes) of Juhaina. We reached those people in the morning and defeated them. A man from the Ansar and I chased one of their men and when we attacked him, he said, "None has the right to be worshipped but Allah." The Ansari refrained from killing him but I stabbed him with my spear till I killed him. When we reached (Medina), this news reached the Prophet. He said to me, "O Usama! You killed him after he had said, 'None has the right to be worshipped but Allah?"' I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! He said so in order to save himself." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You killed him after he had said, 'None has the right to be worshipped but Allah." The Prophet (ﷺ) kept on repeating that statement till I wished I had not been a Muslim before that day
hi: Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Haritha bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein Juhaina qabeele ki ek shaakha, Al-Huraqa, ke khilaaf (ladne) bheja. Hum un logon tak subah pahunche aur unhein haraa diya. Ansaar mein se ek shaks aur main unke ek aadmi ka peecha kar rahe the, aur jab humne use pakda, usne kaha, 'La Ilaha Illallah (Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi).' Ansaari ne use qatl karne se apne aap ko roka, magar maine use apne bhaale se maar kar qatl kar diya. Jab hum (Madina) pahunche, ye khabar Nabi (SAW) tak pahunchi. Unhone mujhse kaha, 'Aye Usama! Tumne use qatl kar diya iske baad ke usne kaha, "La Ilaha Illallah"?' Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Usne aisa apni jaan bachaane ke liye kaha.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Tumne use qatl kar diya iske baad ke usne kaha, "La Ilaha Illallah."' Nabi (SAW) ne ye baat baar-baar dohraayi yahaan tak ke mujhe khwaahish hui ke kaash main us din se pehle Musalmaan na hota.

e: Narrated 'Ubada bin As-Samat:I was among those Naqibs (selected leaders) who gave the Pledge of allegiance to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). We gave the oath of allegiance, that we would not join partners in worship besides Allah, would not steal, would not commit illegal sexual intercourse, would not kill a life which Allah has forbidden, would not commit robbery, would not disobey (Allah and His Apostle), and if we fulfilled this pledge we would have Paradise, but if we committed any one of these (sins), then our case will be decided by Allah
hi: Ubada bin As-Samat bataate hain: Main un Naqibon (chune gaye rehnumaaon) mein se tha jinhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se baiyat ki. Humne ye qasam khaayi ke hum Allah ke siwa kisi ko shareek nahi thehraayenge, chori nahi karenge, zina nahi karenge, kisi jaan ko qatl nahi karenge jise Allah ne haraam kiya hai, loot-maar nahi karenge, aur (Allah aur uske Rasool ki) nafarmaani nahi karenge, aur agar hum ye ahad poora karte hain, to hamein Jannat milegi, magar agar humne inmein se koi ek (gunaah) kiya, to hamaara maamla Allah ke haath mein hoga.

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever carries arms against us, is not from us
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi hamare khilaaf hathiyaar uthaata hai, wo humme se nahi hai.'

e: Narrated Al-Ahnaf bin Qais:I went to help that man (i.e., `Ali), and on the way I met Abu Bakra who asked me, "Where are you going?" I replied, "I am going to help that man." He said, "Go back, for I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, 'If two Muslims meet each other with their swords then (both) the killer and the killed one are in the (Hell) Fire.' I said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! It is alright for the killer, but what about the killed one?' He said, 'The killed one was eager to kill his opponent
hi: Al-Ahnaf bin Qais bataate hain: Main us aadmi (yaani Ali (Alayhis Salam)) ki madad karne gaya, aur raaste mein maine Abu Bakra (رضی اللہ عنہ) se mulaakaat ki jinhone mujhse pucha, 'Tum kahaan jaa rahe ho?' Maine jawab diya, 'Main us aadmi ki madad karne jaa raha hoon.'
