Unhone kaha, 'Wapas jao, kyunke maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, "Agar do Musalmaan apni talwaaron ke saath ek doosre se milte hain, to (dono) qaatil aur maara gaya shaks Jahannam ki Aag mein hote hain." Maine kaha, "Aye Allah ke Rasool! Ye qaatil ke liye theek hai, magar maare gaye shaks ke baare mein kya?" Unhone kaha, "Maara gaya shaks bhi apne mukhaalif ko qatl karne ke liye betaab tha."'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:A Jew crushed the head of a girl between two stones, and the girl was asked, "Who has done that to you, so-and-so or so and so?" (Some names were mentioned for her) till the name of that Jew was mentioned (whereupon she agreed). The Jew was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) and the Prophet (ﷺ) kept on questioning him till he confessed, whereupon his head was crushed with stones
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek Yahudi ne ek ladki ka sar do pattharon ke beech kuchal diya, aur ladki se pucha gaya, 'Tumhaare saath aisa kisne kiya, falaan ne ya falaan ne?' (kuch naam unhein bataaye gaye) yahaan tak ke us Yahudi ka naam liya gaya (isper usne is naam par sahmati zaahir ki). Yahudi ko Nabi (SAW) ke paas laaya gaya, aur Nabi (SAW) ne usse sawaal poochte rahe jab tak usne iqbaal nahi kiya, isper uska sar pattharon se kuchal diya gaya.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:A girl wearing ornaments, went out at Medina. Somebody struck her with a stone. She was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) while she was still alive. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked her, "Did such-and-such a person strike you?" She raised her head, denying that. He asked her a second time, saying, "Did so-and-so strike you?" She raised her head, denying that. He said for the third time, "Did so-and-so strike you?" She lowered her head, agreeing. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then sent for the killer and killed him between two stones
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Zewar pehne ek ladki Madina mein baahar nikli. Kisi ne use ek pathhar se maara. Use Nabi (SAW) ke paas laaya gaya jabke wo abhi zinda thi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne usse pucha, 'Kya falaan shaks ne tumhein maara?' Usne apna sar uthaaya, inkaar karte hue. Unhone dobara pucha, 'Kya falaan ne tumhein maara?' Usne apna sar uthaaya, inkaar karte hue. Unhone teesri baar pucha, 'Kya falaan ne tumhein maara?' Usne apna sar neecha kiya, sahmati zaahir karte hue. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne phir qaatil ko bulaaya aur use do pattharon ke beech qatl kar diya.

e: Narrated `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The blood of a Muslim who confesses that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah and that I am His Apostle, cannot be shed except in three cases: In Qisas for murder, a married person who commits illegal sexual intercourse and the one who reverts from Islam (apostate) and leaves the Muslims
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ek Musalmaan jo iqbaal karta hai ke Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi aur main uska Rasool hoon, uska khoon sirf teen soorton mein baha sakta hai: Qisas (badla) mein qatl ke liye, ek shaadi-shuda shaks jo zina karta hai, aur wo shaks jo Islam se peechhe hat kar (murtad hokar) Musalmaanon ko chhod deta hai.'

e: Narrated Anas:A Jew killed a girl so that he may steal her ornaments. He struck her with a stone, and she was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) while she was still alive. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked her, "Did such-and-such person strike you?" She gestured with her head, expressing denial. He asked her for the second time, and she again gestured with her head, expressing denial. When he asked her for the third time, she beckoned, "Yes." So the Prophet (ﷺ) killed him (the Jew) with two stones
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek Yahudi ne ek ladki ko qatl kiya taake uske zewar chura sake. Usne use ek pathhar se maara, aur use Nabi (SAW) ke paas laaya gaya jabke wo abhi zinda thi. Nabi (SAW) ne usse pucha, 'Kya falaan shaks ne tumhein maara?' Usne apne sar se ishara kiya, inkaar karte hue. Unhone dobara pucha, aur usne phir apne sar se inkaar kiya. Jab unhone teesri baar pucha, usne ishara kiya, 'Haan.' To Nabi (SAW) ne use (Yahudi ko) do pattharon se qatl kar diya.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:In the year of the Conquest of Mecca, the tribe of Khuza`a killed a man from the tribe of Bani Laith in revenge for a killed person belonging to them in the Pre-Islamic Period of Ignorance. So Allah's Apostle got up saying, "Allah held back the (army having) elephants from Mecca, but He let His Apostle and the believers overpower the infidels (of Mecca). Beware! (Mecca is a sanctuary)! Verily! Fighting in Mecca was not permitted for anybody before me, nor will it be permitted for anybody after me; It was permitted for me only for a while (an hour or so) of that day. No doubt! It is at this moment a sanctuary; its thorny shrubs should not be uprooted; its trees should not be cut down; and its Luqata (fallen things) should not be picked up except by the one who would look for its owner. And if somebody is killed, his closest relative has the right to choose one of two things, i.e., either the Blood money or retaliation by having the killer killed." Then a man from Yemen, called Abu Shah, stood up and said, "Write that) for me, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said (to his companions), "Write that for Abu Shah." Then another man from Quraish got up, saying, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Except Al- Idhkhir (a special kind of grass) as we use it in our houses and for graves." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Except Al-idhkkir
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Fatah-e-Makkah ke saal, Khuza'a qabeele ne Banu Laith qabeele ke ek shaks ko qatl kiya, apne ek shaks ke badle jo Jaahiliyat (Islam se pehle) ke daur mein maara gaya tha. To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khade hue aur kaha, 'Allah ne haathiyon waali fauj ko Makkah se roka, magar usne apne Rasool aur Momineen ko kaafiron (Makkah waalon) par ghaalib kiya. Khabardaar! (Makkah ek panaah-gah hai!) Beshak! Makkah mein jang karna mujhse pehle kisi ke liye jaayez nahi thi, na mere baad kisi ke liye jaayez hogi; ye sirf mere liye jaayez ki gayi (ek ghante ya isi tarah) us din ke liye. Koi shak nahi! Ye is waqt bhi ek panaah-gah hai; iske kaante waale paudhe ukhaade nahi jaane chaahiye; iske darakht kaate nahi jaane chaahiye; aur iski Luqata (giri hui cheezein) sirf wahi le sakta hai jo uske maalik ko dhoondhega. Aur agar koi qatl ho jaaye, to uske sabse qareebi rishtedaar ko do cheezon mein se ek chunne ka haq hai, yaani khoon-bahaa ya qaatil ko qatl karke badla lena.' Phir Yemen se ek shaks, jise Abu Shah kaha jaata tha, khade hue aur kaha, 'Ise mere liye likhiye, Aye Allah ke Rasool!' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (apne sahaaba se) kaha, 'Abu Shah ke liye ye likh do.' Phir Quraish se ek aur shaks khade hue, kehte hue, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Siwaaye Al-Idhkhir (ek khaas qism ki ghaas) ke, jise hum apne gharon aur qabron ke liye istemaal karte hain.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Siwaaye Al-Idhkhir ke.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:For the children of Israel the punishment for crime was Al-Qisas only (i.e., the law of equality in punishment) and the payment of Blood money was not permitted as an alternate. But Allah said to this nation (Muslims): 'O you who believe! Qisas is prescribed for you in case of murder, .....(up to) ...end of the Verse. (2.178) Ibn `Abbas added: Remission (forgiveness) in this Verse, means to accept the Blood-money in an intentional murder. Ibn `Abbas added: The Verse: 'Then the relatives should demand Blood-money in a reasonable manner.' (2.178) means that the demand should be reasonable and it is to be compensated with handsome gratitude
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Bani Israel ke liye jurm ki saza sirf Qisas (badla lene ki barabar saza ka qanoon) thi, aur khoon-bahaa (Blood money) ki adaayagi ek ikhtiyar ke taur par jaayez nahi thi. Magar Allah ne is ummat (Musalmaanon) se kaha: 'Aye Iman waalon! Qisas tumhaare liye muqarrar kiya gaya hai qatl ke maamle mein.... (jab tak) ...Aayat ke aakhir tak.' (2:178) Ibn Abbas ne izaafa kiya: Is Aayat mein Remission (maafi) ka matlab hai jaan-boojh kar kiye gaye qatl mein khoon-bahaa qubool karna. Ibn Abbas ne izaafa kiya: Aayat: 'Phir rishtedaaron ko munaasib tareeke se khoon-bahaa maangna chaahiye' (2:178) ka matlab hai ke maangna munaasib hona chaahiye aur ise izzat ke saath chukaana chaahiye.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The most hated persons to Allah are three: (1) A person who deviates from the right conduct, i.e., an evil doer, in the Haram (sanctuaries of Mecca and Medina); (2) a person who seeks that the traditions of the Pre-Islamic Period of Ignorance, should remain in Islam (3) and a person who seeks to shed somebody's blood without any right
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah ke nazdeek sabse zyaada napasandidaa teen log hain: (1) wo shaks jo Haram (Makkah aur Madina ki panaah-gaahon) mein seedhe raaste se bhatak jaaye, yaani ek badkaar shaks; (2) wo shaks jo chaahe ke Jaahiliyat (Islam se pehle) ke daur ki riwaayaten Islam mein bani rahein; (3) aur wo shaks jo bina kisi haq ke kisi ka khoon bahaana chaahe.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The pagans were defeated on the day (of the battle) of Uhud. Satan shouted among the people on the day of Uhud, "O Allah's worshippers! Beware of what is behind you!" So the front file of the army attacked the back files (mistaking them for the enemy) till they killed Al-Yaman. Hudhaifa (bin Al- Yaman) shouted, "My father!" My father! But they killed him. Hudhaifa said, "May Allah forgive you." (The narrator added: Some of the defeated pagans fled till they reached Taif)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jang-e-Uhud ke din, mushrik haraa diye gaye. Shaitaan ne Uhud ke din logon ke beech chillaaya, 'Aye Allah ke bandon! Apne peechhe se khabardaar raho!' To fauj ki agli qataar ne peechhe waali qataaron par hamla kiya (dushman samajh kar) yahaan tak ke unhone Al-Yaman ko qatl kar diya. Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) (bin Al-Yaman) ne chillaaya, 'Mere waalid! Mere waalid!' Magar unhone unhein qatl kar diya. Hudhaifa ne kaha, 'Allah tumhein maaf kare.' (Ravi ne izaafa kiya: Kuch haare hue mushrik bhaage yahaan tak ke wo Taif pahunch gaye.)

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:A Jew crushed the head of a girl between two stones. It was said to her. "Who has done this to you, such-and-such person, such-and-such person?" When the name of the Jew was mentioned, she nodded with her head, agreeing. So the Jew was brought and he confessed. The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered that his head be crushed with the stones. (Hammam said, "with two stones)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek Yahudi ne ek ladki ka sar do pattharon ke beech kuchal diya. Usse pucha gaya, 'Tumhaare saath aisa kisne kiya, falaan ya falaan?' Jab us Yahudi ka naam liya gaya, usne apne sar se sahmati zaahir ki. To Yahudi ko laaya gaya aur usne iqbaal kiya. Nabi (SAW) ne hukm diya ke uska sar pattharon se kuchal diya jaaye. (Hammam ne kaha, 'do pattharon se.')

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) killed a Jew for killing a girl in order to take her ornaments
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne ek Yahudi ko qatl kiya ek ladki ko qatl karne ke liye, taake uske zewar le sake.

e: Narrated `Aisha:We poured medicine into the mouth of the Prophet (ﷺ) during his ailment. He said, "Don't pour medicine into my mouth." (We thought he said that) out of the aversion a patient usually has for medicines. When he improved and felt better he said, "There is none of you but will be forced to drink medicine, except Al-`Abbas, for he did not witness your deed
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Humne Nabi (SAW) ki bimaari ke dauraan unke munh mein dawa daali. Unhone kaha, 'Mere munh mein dawa mat daalo.' (Humne socha unhone aisa kaha kyunke ek mareez ko dawa se aksar nafrat hoti hai). Jab unki tabiyat behtar hui aur unhein achha mehsoos hua, unhone kaha, 'Tum mein se koi bhi nahi bachega jise dawa peene par majboor na kiya gaya ho, siwaaye Al-Abbas ke, kyunke wo tumhaare (dawa daalne ke) amal ke gawaah nahi the.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:That he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "We (Muslims) are the last (to come) but (will be) the foremost (on the Day of Resurrection)." And added, "If someone is peeping (looking secretly) into your house without your permission, and you throw a stone at him and destroy his eyes, there will be no blame on you
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, 'Hum (Musalmaan) aakhir mein aane wale hain magar (Qayamat ke din) sabse aage hone wale honge.' Aur izaafa kiya, 'Agar koi tumhaari ijaazat ke bagair tumhaare ghar mein chupke se jhaank raha ho, aur tum uspar pathhar phenko aur uski aankhein zaaya kar do, to tumpar koi ilzaam nahi hoga.'

e: Narrated Yahya:Humaid said, "A man peeped into the house of the Prophet (ﷺ) and the Prophet (ﷺ) aimed an arrow head at him to hit him." I asked, "Who told you that?" He said, "Anas bin Malik" (See Hadith No. 258 and 259, Vol)
hi: Yahya bataate hain: Humaid ne kaha, 'Ek shaks ne Nabi (SAW) ke ghar mein jhaanka, aur Nabi (SAW) ne ek teer ka phal uspar taan diya use maarne ke liye.' Maine pucha, 'Ye aapko kisne bataaya?' Unhone kaha, 'Anas bin Malik.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 258 aur 259, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated `Aisha:"When it was the day of (the battle of) Uhud, the pagans were defeated. Then Satan shouted, "O Allah's worshipers! Beware of what is behind you!" So the front files attacked the back files of the army. Hudhaifa looked, and behold, there was his father, Al-Yaman (being attacked) ! He shouted (to his companions), "O Allah's worshipers, my father, my father!" But by Allah, they did not stop till they killed him (i.e., Hudhaifa's father). Hudhaifa said, "May Allah forgive you." (`Urwa said, Hudhaifa continued asking Allah's Forgiveness for the killer of his father till he died)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: 'Jab jang-e-Uhud ka din tha, mushrik haraa diye gaye. Phir Shaitaan ne chillaaya, "Aye Allah ke bandon! Apne peechhe se khabardaar raho!" To agli qataaron ne fauj ki peechhe waali qataaron par hamla kiya. Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne dekha, aur dekho, wahaan unke waalid, Al-Yaman, the (hamle ka shikaar ho rahe the)! Unhone chillaaya (apne saathiyon se), "Aye Allah ke bandon, mere waalid, mere waalid!" Magar Allah ki qasam, wo tab tak nahi ruke jab tak unhone unhein (yaani Hudhaifa ke waalid ko) qatl nahi kar diya. Hudhaifa ne kaha, "Allah tumhein maaf kare."' (Urwa ne kaha, Hudhaifa apne waalid ke qaatil ke liye Allah se maafi maangte rahe yahaan tak ke unka intekaal ho gaya.)

e: Narrated Salama:We went out with the Prophet (ﷺ) to Khaibar. A man (from the companions) said, "O 'Amir! Let us hear some of your Huda (camel-driving songs.)" So he sang some of them (i.e. a lyric in harmony with the camels walk). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Who is the driver (of these camels)?" They said, "Amir." The Prophet said, "May Allah bestow His Mercy on him !" The people said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Would that you let us enjoy his company longer!" Then 'Amir was killed the following morning. The people said, "The good deeds of 'Amir are lost as he has killed himself." I returned at the time while they were talking about that. I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Prophet! Let my father be sacrificed for you! The people claim that 'Amir's good deeds are lost." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever says so is a liar, for 'Amir will have a double reward as he exerted himself to obey Allah and fought in Allah's Cause. No other way of killing would have granted him greater reward
hi: Salama bataate hain: Hum Nabi (SAW) ke saath Khaibar ki taraf nikle. Ek shaks (sahaaba mein se) ne kaha, 'Aye Aamir! Humein apni Huda (oont-haankne wali) kuch sunaao.' To unhone kuch (oont ki chaal ke saath taal milaate) shairi sunaayi. Nabi (SAW) ne pucha, 'Ye (oonton ka) haankne wala kaun hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Aamir.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Allah unpar reham kare!' Logon ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kaash aap humein unki sohbat aur lambi der tak dete!' Phir Aamir agli subah maare gaye (shaheed hue). Logon ne kaha, 'Aamir ke nek amaal barbaad ho gaye kyunke unhone khud ko qatl kar liya (khudkushi ki).' Main us waqt wapas aaya jab wo isi ke baare mein baat kar rahe the. Main Nabi (SAW) ke paas gaya aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Nabi! Mere waalid aap par qurbaan hon! Log dawa karte hain ke Aamir ke nek amaal barbaad ho gaye.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Jo koi aisa kahe wo jhoot bol raha hai, kyunke Aamir ko dohra ajr milega, kyunke unhone Allah ki farmaanbardaari mein khud ko mehnat mein daala aur Allah ki raah mein jang ladi. Koi doosra maut ka tareeka unhein isse zyaada ajr nahi deta.'

e: Narrated `Imran bin Husain:A man bit another man's hand and the latter pulled his hand out of his mouth by force, causing two of his incisors (teeth) to fall out. They submitted their case to the Prophet, who said, "One of you bit his brother as a male camel bites. (Go away), there is no Diya (Blood-money) for you
hi: Imran bin Husain (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks ne doosre shaks ka haath kaata, aur doosre ne apna haath uske munh se zor se khaincha, jisse uske do daant (incisors) toot gaye. Unhone apna maamla Nabi (SAW) ke saamne pesh kiya, jinhone kaha, 'Tum mein se ek ne apne bhai ko aise kaata jaise nar oont kaatta hai. (Chale jao), tumhein koi Diya (khoon-bahaa) nahi milega.'

e: Narrated Ya`la:I went out in one of the Ghazwa and a man bit another man and as a result, an incisor tooth of the former was pulled out. The Prophet (ﷺ) cancelled the case
hi: Ya'la bataate hain: Main ek jang mein gaya aur ek aadmi ne doosre aadmi ko kaata, aur natije mein, pehle wale ka ek daant nikal gaya. Nabi (SAW) ne is maamle ko rad kar diya.

e: Narrated Anas:The daughter of An-Nadr slapped a girl and broke her incisor tooth. They (the relatives of that girl), came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he gave the order of Qisas (equality in punishment)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: An-Nadr ki beti ne ek ladki ke munh par thappad maara aur uska daant tod diya. Wo (us ladki ke rishtedaar) Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye, aur unhone Qisas (barabar ki saza) ka hukm diya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "This and this are the same." He meant the little finger and the thumb
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ye aur ye barabar hain.' Unka ishara chhoti ungli aur angoothe ki taraf tha.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I heard the Prophet (saying the same as above Hadith)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko (upar wali baat) kehte suna.

e: Ibn 'Umar said:A boy was assassinated. 'Umar said, "If all the people of San'a took part in the assassination I would kill them all." Al-Mughira bin Hakim said that his father said, "Four persons killed a boy, and 'Umar said (as above)." Abu Bakr, Ibn Az-Zubair, 'Ali and Suwaid bin Muqarrin gave the judgement of Al-Qisas (equality in punishment) in cases of slapping. And 'Umar carried out Al-Qisas for a strike with a stick. And 'Ali carried out Al-Qisas for three lashes with a whip. And Shuraih carried out for one last and for scratching
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: Ek ladke ki hatya kar di gayi. Umar ne kaha, 'Agar San'a (Yemen) ke sab log is hatya mein shaamil hote, main unhein sab ko qatl kar deta.' Al-Mughira bin Hakim ne kaha ke unke waalid ne kaha, 'Chaar logon ne ek ladke ko qatl kiya, aur Umar ne (upar wali baat) kahi.' Abu Bakr, Ibn Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ), Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Suwaid bin Muqarrin ne thappad maarne ke maamlon mein Al-Qisas (barabar ki saza) ka faisla diya. Aur Umar ne lakdi se maarne par Al-Qisas laagu kiya. Aur Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne teen kode maarne par Al-Qisas laagu kiya. Aur Shuraih ne ek kode aur khurchne (scratching) par bhi laagu kiya.

e: Narrated `Aisha:We poured medicine into the mouth of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) during his illness, and he pointed out to us intending to say, "Don't pour medicine into my mouth." We thought that his refusal was out of the aversion a patient usually has for medicine. When he improved and felt a bit better he said (to us.) "Didn't I forbid you to pour medicine into my mouth?" We said, "We thought (you did so) because of the aversion, one usually have for medicine." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "There is none of you but will be forced to drink medicine, and I will watch you, except Al-`Abbas, for he did not witness this act of yours
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Humne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki bimaari ke dauraan unke munh mein dawaai daali, aur unhone humein ishara kiya, kehna chahte hue, 'Mere munh mein dawaai mat daalo.' Humne socha unka inkaar bimaar ki dawaai se aam tor par hone waali napasandidagi ki wajah se tha. Jab unki tabiyat kuch behtar hui aur wo achha mehsoos karne lage, unhone (humse) kaha, 'Kya maine tumhein mere munh mein dawaai daalne se mana nahi kiya tha?' Humne kaha, 'Humne socha (aapne aisa kiya) kyunke ek bimaar aadmi ko usually dawaai se nafrat hoti hai.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Tum mein se koi bhi aisa nahi hai jise dawaai peene par majboor na kiya jaaye, aur main tumhein dekhunga, siwaaye Al-Abbas ke, kyunke wo tumhaare is amal ke waqt maujood nahi the.'

e: Narrated Sahl bin Abi Hathma:(a man from the Ansar) that a number of people from his tribe went to Khaibar and dispersed, and then they found one of them murdered. They said to the people with whom the corpse had been found, "You have killed our companion!" Those people said, "Neither have we killed him, nor do we know his killer." The bereaved group went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We went to Khaibar and found one of us murdered." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Let the older among you come forward and speak." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said, to them, "Bring your proof against the killer." They said "We have no proof." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Then they (the defendants) will take an oath." They said, "We do not accept the oaths of the Jews." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not like that the Blood-money of the killed one be lost without compensation, so he paid one-hundred camels out of the camels of Zakat (to the relatives of the deceased) as Diya (Blood-money)
hi: Sahl bin Abi Hathma (Ansaar ke ek shaks) bataate hain: Unke qabeele ke kuch log Khaibar gaye aur bikhar gaye, aur phir unhone unmein se ek ko qatl kiya hua paaya. Unhone un logon se kaha jinke paas laash mili thi, 'Tumne hamare saathi ko qatl kiya!' Un logon ne kaha, 'Na to humne use qatl kiya, na hi humein uske qaatil ka pata hai.' Gam-zada giroh Nabi (SAW) ke paas gaya aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Hum Khaibar gaye aur hamme se ek ko qatl kiya hua paaya.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Tum mein se boodha shaks aage aakar bole.' Phir Nabi (SAW) ne unse kaha, 'Qaatil ke khilaaf apna saboot laao.' Unhone kaha, 'Hamare paas koi saboot nahi hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'To wo (jawaabdehi mein aaye log) qasam khaayenge.' Unhone kaha, 'Hum Yahudiyon ki qasmein qubool nahi karte.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye pasand nahi tha ke maare gaye shaks ka khoon-bahaa bina kisi muawaje ke zaaya ho, isliye unhone Zakat ke oonton mein se sau oont (marne wale ke rishtedaaron ko) Diya (khoon-bahaa) ke taur par diye.

e: Narrated Abu Qilaba:Once `Umar bin `Abdul `Aziz sat on his throne in the courtyard of his house so that the people might gather before him. Then he admitted them and (when they came in), he said, "What do you think of Al-Qasama?" They said, "We say that it is lawful to depend on Al-Qasama in Qisas, as the previous Muslim Caliphs carried out Qisas depending on it." Then he said to me, "O Abu Qilaba! What do you say about it?" He let me appear before the people and I said, "O Chief of the Believers! You have the chiefs of the army staff and the nobles of the Arabs. If fifty of them testified that a married man had committed illegal sexual intercourse in Damascus but they had not seen him (doing so), would you stone him?" He said, "No." I said, "If fifty of them testified that a man had committed theft in Hums, would you cut off his hand though they did not see him?" He replied, "No." I said, "By Allah, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) never killed anyone except in one of the following three situations: (1) A person who killed somebody unjustly, was killed (in Qisas,) (2) a married person who committed illegal sexual intercourse and (3) a man who fought against Allah and His Apostle and deserted Islam and became an apostate." Then the people said, "Didn't Anas bin Malik narrate that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) cut off the hands of the thieves, branded their eyes and then, threw them in the sun?" I said, "I shall tell you the narration of Anas. Anas said: "Eight persons from the tribe of `Ukl came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and gave the Pledge of allegiance for Islam (became Muslim). The climate of the place (Medina) did not suit them, so they became sick and complained about that to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He said (to them ), "Won't you go out with the shepherd of our camels and drink of the camels' milk and urine (as medicine)?" They said, "Yes." So they went out and drank the camels' milk and urine, and after they became healthy, they killed the shepherd of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and took away all the camels. This news reached Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) , so he sent (men) to follow their traces and they were captured and brought (to the Prophet). He then ordered to cut their hands and feet, and their eyes were branded with heated pieces of iron, and then he threw them in the sun till they died." I said, "What can be worse than what those people did? They deserted Islam, committed murder and theft." Then 'Anbasa bin Sa`id said, "By Allah, I never heard a narration like this of today." I said, "O 'Anbasa! You deny my narration?" 'Anbasa said, "No, but you have related the narration in the way it should be related. By Allah, these people are in welfare as long as this Sheikh (Abu Qilaba) is among them." I added, "Indeed in this event there has been a tradition set by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). The narrator added: Some Ansari people came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and discussed some matters with him, a man from amongst them went out and was murdered. Those people went out after him, and behold, their companion was swimming in blood. They returned to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said to him, "O Allah's Apostle, we have found our companion who had talked with us and gone out before us, swimming in blood (killed)." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went out and asked them, "Whom do you suspect or whom do you think has killed him?" They said, "We think that the Jews have killed him." The Prophet (ﷺ) sent for the Jews and asked them, "Did you kill this (person)?" They replied, "No." He asked the Al-Ansars, "Do you agree that I let fifty Jews take an oath that they have not killed him?" They said, "It matters little for the Jews to kill us all and then take false oaths." He said, "Then would you like to receive the Diya after fifty of you have taken an oath (that the Jews have killed your man)?" They said, "We will not take the oath." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) himself paid them the Diya (Blood-money)." The narrator added, "The tribe of Hudhail repudiated one of their men (for his evil conduct) in the Pre-Islamic period of Ignorance. Then, at a place called Al-Batha' (near Mecca), the man attacked a Yemenite family at night to steal from them, but a. man from the family noticed him and struck him with his sword and killed him. The tribe of Hudhail came and captured the Yemenite and brought him to `Umar during the Hajj season and said, "He has killed our companion." The Yemenite said, "But these people had repudiated him (i.e., their companion)." `Umar said, "Let fifty persons of Hudhail swear that they had not repudiated him." So forty-nine of them took the oath and then a person belonging to them, came from Sham and they requested him to swear similarly, but he paid one-thousand Dirhams instead of taking the oath. They called another man instead of him and the new man shook hands with the brother of the deceased. Some people said, "We and those fifty men who had taken false oaths (Al-Qasama) set out, and when they reached a place called Nakhlah, it started raining so they entered a cave in the mountain, and the cave collapsed on those fifty men who took the false oath, and all of them died except the two persons who had shaken hands with each other. They escaped death but a stone fell on the leg of the brother of the deceased and broke it, whereupon he survived for one year and then died." I further said, "`Abdul Malik bin Marwan sentenced a man to death in Qisas (equality in punishment) for murder, basing his judgment on Al-Qasama, but later on he regretted that judgment and ordered that the names of the fifty persons who had taken the oath (Al-Qasama), be erased from the register, and he exiled them in Sham
hi: Abu Qilaba bataate hain: Ek baar Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdul Aziz apne ghar ke aangan mein apne takht par baithe taake log unke saamne jama ho sakein. Phir unhone unhein andar aane diya, aur (jab wo aaye), unhone kaha, 'Tum log Al-Qasama (qasam ka silsila) ke baare mein kya sochte ho?' Unhone kaha, 'Hum kehte hain ke Al-Qasama par Qisas mein bharosa karna jaayez hai, jaisa pichhle Musalmaan Khulafa ne isi ke aadhaar par Qisas laagu kiya.' Phir unhone mujhse kaha, 'Aye Abu Qilaba! Aap iske baare mein kya kehte hain?' Unhone mujhe logon ke saamne pesh hone diya aur maine kaha, 'Aye Momineen ke Ameer! Aapke paas fauj ke afsar aur Arabon ke izzatdaar log hain. Agar unmein se pachaas log gawaahi dein ke ek shaadi-shuda aadmi ne Damishq mein zina kiya, magar unhone use (khud) nahi dekha, kya aap use sangsaar karenge?' Unhone kaha, 'Nahi.' Maine kaha, 'Agar unmein se pachaas log gawaahi dein ke ek shaks ne Hums mein chori ki, kya aap uska haath kaatenge halaanke unhone use nahi dekha?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Nahi.' Maine kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kabhi kisi ko qatl nahi kiya siwaaye in teen sooraton mein se ek mein: (1) Wo shaks jisne kisi ko na-jaayez taur par qatl kiya, use (Qisas mein) qatl kiya gaya, (2) ek shaadi-shuda shaks jisne zina kiya, aur (3) ek aadmi jisne Allah aur uske Rasool ke khilaaf jang ki aur Islam chhod diya aur murtad ban gaya.' Phir logon ne kaha, 'Kya Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne riwaayat nahi ki ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne choron ke haath kaate, unki aankhein daaghi, aur phir unhein dhoop mein phenka?' Maine kaha, 'Main tumhein Anas ki riwaayat sunaunga. Anas ne kaha: "Ukl qabeele ke aath log Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur Islam ki baiyat li (Musalmaan bane). Us jagah (Madina) ki aab-o-hawaa unhein raast nahi aayi, isliye wo bimar pad gaye aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se iski shikaayat ki. Unhone (unse) kaha, "Kya tum hamare oonton ke charwaahe ke saath baahar jaakar oonton ka doodh aur peshaab (dawaai ke taur par) nahi piyoge?" Unhone kaha, "Haan." To wo baahar gaye aur oonton ka doodh aur peshaab piya, aur jab wo sehatmand ho gaye, unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke charwaahe ko qatl kar diya aur sab oont le gaye. Ye khabar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) tak pahunchi, isliye unhone (kuch logon ko) unke nishaanon ka peecha karne bheja aur unhein pakadkar laaya gaya. Phir unhone hukm diya ke unke haath-pair kaate jaayein, aur unki aankhon ko garam loha ke tukdon se daagha gaya, aur phir unhein dhoop mein phenka gaya jab tak wo mar nahi gaye."' Maine kaha, 'In logon ne jo kiya usse bura kya ho sakta hai? Unhone Islam chhoda, qatl kiya aur chori ki.' Phir Anbasa bin Saeed ne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, maine aaj jaisi riwaayat pehle kabhi nahi suni.' Maine kaha, 'Aye Anbasa! Kya aap meri riwaayat ka inkaar karte hain?' Anbasa ne kaha, 'Nahi, magar aapne riwaayat ko usi tareeke se bayaan kiya jaisi ki jaani chaahiye. Allah ki qasam, ye log tab tak bhalaai mein rahenge jab tak ye Shaikh (Abu Qilaba) unke beech hain.' Maine izaafa kiya, 'Beshak is waaqia mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki ek riwaayat (Sunnat) hai.' Ravi ne izaafa kiya: Kuch Ansaari log Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unse kuch maamlon par baat ki, unmein se ek shaks baahar gaya aur qatl kar diya gaya. Wo log uska peecha karne baahar gaye, aur dekho! Unka saathi khoon mein tairte hue mila. Wo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas wapas gaye aur unse kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool, humne apne saathi ko, jisne humse baat ki thi aur humse pehle baahar gaya tha, khoon mein tairte hue paaya (qatl hua).' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) baahar gaye aur unse pucha, 'Tum kisko shak karte ho ya sochte ho ke usne use qatl kiya?' Unhone kaha, 'Humein lagta hai Yahudiyon ne use qatl kiya.' Nabi (SAW) ne Yahudiyon ko bulwaaya aur unse pucha, 'Kya tumne isko (is shaks ko) qatl kiya?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Nahi.' Unhone Ansaaron se pucha, 'Kya tum raazi ho ke main pachaas Yahudiyon ko qasam khilaaun ke unhone use qatl nahi kiya?' Unhone kaha, 'Yahudiyon ke liye hum sabko qatl karke jhoothi qasmein khaana maamooli baat hai.' Unhone kaha, 'To kya tum khud pachaas log qasam khaakar Diya (khoon-bahaa) lena pasand karoge (ke Yahudiyon ne tumhaare aadmi ko qatl kiya)?' Unhone kaha, 'Hum qasam nahi khaayenge.' Phir Nabi (SAW) ne khud unhein Diya adaa kiya.' Ravi ne izaafa kiya, 'Hudhail qabeele ne apne ek shaks ko (uske bure suluk ki wajah se) Jaahiliyat ke daur mein tyaag diya tha. Phir, Al-Batha (Makkah ke qareeb ek jagah) naami jagah par, us aadmi ne raat ko chori karne ke iraade se Yemen ke ek khaandaan par hamla kiya, magar khaandaan ke ek shaks ne use dekh liya aur apni talwaar se maar kar use qatl kar diya. Hudhail qabeela aaya aur us Yemeni shaks ko pakad liya aur use Hajj ke mausam mein Umar ke paas laaye aur kaha, 'Usne hamare saathi ko qatl kiya.' Yemeni shaks ne kaha, 'Magar in logon ne use tyaag diya tha (unka saathi maana hi nahi jaata tha).' Umar ne kaha, 'Hudhail ke pachaas log qasam khaayein ke unhone use tyaag nahi kiya tha.' To unmein se untaalis (49) logon ne qasam khaayi, aur phir unmein se ek shaks Sham se aaya aur unhone usse bhi isi tarah qasam khaane ko kaha, magar usne qasam khaane ke bajaaye ek hazaar Dirham diye. Unhone uski jagah ek aur shaks bulaaya, aur naye shaks ne mayyat ke bhai se haath milaaya. Kuch logon ne kaha, 'Hum aur wo pachaas log jinhone jhoothi qasam khaayi thi (Al-Qasama), nikle, aur jab hum Nakhla naami jagah pahunche, baarish shuru ho gayi isliye hum pahaad ki ek gufaa mein daakhil hue, aur wo gufaa un pachaas logon par gir padi jinhone jhoothi qasam khaayi thi, aur wo sab mar gaye siwaaye do logon ke jinhone ek doosre se haath milaaya tha. Wo maut se bach gaye magar ek patthar mayyat ke bhai ke pair par gira aur use tod diya, isper wo ek saal tak zinda rahe aur phir mar gaye.'" Maine aage kaha, 'Abdul Malik bin Marwan ne ek shaks ko qatl ki saza mein Qisas ki maut ki saza sunaayi, apna faisla Al-Qasama par aadhaar rakhte hue, magar baad mein unhein apne faisle par afsos hua aur unhone hukm diya ke un pachaas logon ke naam jinhone qasam khaayi thi (Al-Qasama), register mein se mita diye jaayein, aur unhein Sham mein jila-watan kiya jaaye.'

e: Narrated Anas: A man peeped into one of the dwelling places of the Prophet. The Prophet got up and aimed a sharp-edged arrow head (or wooden stick) at him to poke him stealthily
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks ne Nabi (SAW) ke ek rehne ki jagah mein jhaanka. Nabi (SAW) khade hue aur ek teez teer ka phal (ya lakdi ki chhadi) uski taraf ishara kiya use chupke se chubhone ke liye.

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa'd As-Sa'idi: A man peeped through a hole in the door of Allah's Messenger's (ﷺ) house, and at that time, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had a Midri (an iron comb or bar) with which he was rubbing his head. So when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw him, he said (to him), "If I had been sure that you were looking at me (through the door), I would have poked your eye with this (sharp iron bar)." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) added, "The asking for permission to enter has been enjoined so that one may not look unlawfully (at what there is in the house without the permission of its people)
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) As-Sa'idi bataate hain: Ek shaks ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke ghar ke darwaaze mein ek chhed se jhaanka, aur us waqt, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas ek Midri (loha ka kanghi ya danda) tha jisse wo apna sar khujla rahe the. To jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne use dekha, unhone (usse) kaha, 'Agar mujhe pata hota ke tum mujhe (darwaaze se) dekh rahe ho, to main iss (teez loha ke danda) se tumhaari aankh chubho deta.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne izaafa kiya, 'Andar aane ki ijaazat maangna isliye zaroori kiya gaya hai taake koi na-jaayez tareeke se (ghar mein jo hai use) na dekhe bina wahaan ke logon ki ijaazat ke.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Abul Qasim said, "If any person peeps at you without your permission and you poke him with a stick and injure his eye, you will not be blamed
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abul-Qasim ne kaha, 'Agar koi tumhein bina tumhaari ijaazat ke jhaanke aur tum use lakdi se maaro aur uski aankh mein chot lag jaaye, to tumpar koi ilzaam nahi hoga.'

e: Narrated Ash-Shu`bi:I heard Abu Juhaifa saying, "I asked `Ali 'Have you got any Divine literature apart from the Qur'an?' (Once he said...apart from what the people have?) `Ali replied, 'By Him Who made the grain split (germinate) and created the soul, we have nothing except what is in the Qur'an and the ability (gift) of understanding Allah's Book which He may endow a man with and we have what is written in this paper.' I asked, 'What is written in this paper?' He replied, 'Al-`Aql (the regulation of Diya), about the ransom of captives, and the Judgment that a Muslim should not be killed in Qisas (equality in punishment) for killing a disbeliever." (See Hadith No. 283,Vol)
hi: Ash-Shu'bi bataate hain: Maine Abu Juhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko ye kehte suna, 'Maine Ali (Alayhis Salam) se pucha, "Kya aapke paas Quran ke ilaawa koi aur Ilaahi Kitaab hai?" (Ya kabhi unhone kaha ...jo logon ke paas hai uske ilaawa?) Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne jawab diya, "Us Zaat ki qasam jisne daana phatvaaya (ugne diya) aur Rooh ko banaaya, hamare paas Quran ke ilaawa aur wo samajh (tohfa) ke siwa kuch nahi jo Allah kisi shaks ko apni Kitaab samajhne mein de sakta hai, aur hamare paas jo is kaagaz mein likha hai wo hai." Maine pucha, "Is kaagaz mein kya likha hai?" Unhone jawab diya, "Al-Aql (Diya ka zaabta), qaidiyon ke fidye ke baare mein, aur ye faisla ke koi Musalmaan kisi kaafir ko qatl karne ke Qisas mein qatl nahi kiya jaana chaahiye."' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 283, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Two women from the tribe of Hudhail (fought with each other) and one of them threw (a stone at) the other, causing her to have a miscarriage and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave his verdict that the killer (of the fetus) should give a male or female slave (as a Diya)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hudhail qabeele ki do khawaateen (aapas mein ladi) aur unmein se ek ne doosri par (patthar) phenka, jisse uska garbh-paat ho gaya, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne faisla diya ke qaatil (bhrun ka) ek ghulaam ya launDi de (Diya ke taur par).

e: Narrated Hisham's father from Al-Mughira bin Shu'ba: 'Umar consulted the companions about the case of a woman's abortion (caused by somebody else). Al-Mughira said: The Prophet (ﷺ) gave the verdict that a male or female slave should be given (as a Diya). Then Muhammad bin Maslama testified that he had witnessed the Prophet (ﷺ) giving such a verdict
hi: Hisham ke waalid, Al-Mughira bin Shu'ba (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke hawaale se, bataate hain: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne ek khaatoon ke garbh-paat (kisi doosre ke zariye hue) ke maamle mein sahaaba se salaah li. Al-Mughira ne kaha: Nabi (SAW) ne faisla diya ke ek ghulaam ya launDi di jaani chaahiye (Diya ke taur par). Phir Muhammad bin Maslama ne gawaahi di ke unhone Nabi (SAW) ko aisa faisla dete dekha tha.

e: Narrated Hisham's father: 'Umar asked the people, "Who heard the Prophet (ﷺ) giving his verdict regarding abortions?" Al-Mughira said, "I heard him judging that a male or female slave should be given (as a Diya)." 'Umar said, "Present a witness to testify your statement." Muhammad bin Maslama said, "I testify that the Prophet (ﷺ) gave such a judgment
hi: Hisham ke waalid bataate hain: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne logon se pucha, 'Kisne Nabi (SAW) ko garbh-paat ke baare mein faisla dete suna?' Al-Mughira ne kaha, 'Maine unhein faisla dete suna ke ek ghulaam ya launDi di jaani chaahiye (Diya ke taur par).' Umar ne kaha, 'Apni baat ki tasdeeq ke liye ek gawaah pesh karo.' Muhammad bin Maslama ne kaha, 'Main gawaahi deta hoon ke Nabi (SAW) ne aisa faisla diya tha.'

e: Narrated `Urwa:I heard Al-Maghira bin Shu`ba narrating that `Umar had consulted them about the case of abortion (similarly as narrated in No)
hi: Urwa bataate hain: Maine Al-Mughira bin Shu'ba (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko ye riwaayat karte suna ke Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne unse garbh-paat ke maamle mein salaah li thi (upar wali hadees jaisi).

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave a verdict regarding an aborted fetus of a woman from Bani Lihyan that the killer (of the fetus) should give a male or female slave (as a Diya) but the woman who was required to give the slave, died, so Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave the verdict that her inheritance be given to her children and her husband and the Diya be paid by her 'Asaba
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Banu Lihyan qabeele ki ek khaatoon ke garbh-paat waale hue bhrun ke baare mein faisla diya ke qaatil (bhrun ka) ek ghulaam ya launDi de (Diya ke taur par), magar jispar ye saza thi wo khaatoon khud mar gayi, isliye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne faisla diya ke uski miraas uske bacchon aur shohar ko di jaaye aur Diya uske Asaba (baap ki taraf ke rishtedaaron) ko adaa karni chaahiye.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Two women from Hudhail fought with each other and one of them hit the other with a stone that killed her and what was in her womb. The relatives of the killer and the relatives of the victim submitted their case to the Prophet (ﷺ) who judged that the Diya for the fetus was a male or female slave, and the Diya for the killed woman was to be paid by the 'Asaba (near relatives) of the killer
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hudhail qabeele ki do khawaateen aapas mein ladi aur unmein se ek ne doosri ko patthar se maara jisne use aur uske pet mein pale bacche ko qatl kar diya. Qaatil ke rishtedaar aur maare gaye ke rishtedaar apna maamla Nabi (SAW) ke paas laaye, jinhone faisla diya ke bhrun ka Diya ek ghulaam ya launDi hai, aur maari gayi khaatoon ka Diya qaatil ke Asaba (qareebi rishtedaaron) ko adaa karna chaahiye.

e: Narrated `Abdul-`Aziz:Anas said, "When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) arrived at Medina, Abu Talha took hold of my hand and brought me to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Anas is an intelligent boy, so let him serve you." Anas added, "So I served the Prophet (ﷺ) L at home and on journeys; by Allah, he never said to me for anything which I did: Why have you done this like this or, for anything which I did not do: 'Why have you not done this like this?
hi: Abdul-Aziz bataate hain: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Madina pahunche, Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne mera haath thaama aur mujhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas le gaye aur kaha, "Aye Allah ke Rasool! Anas ek aqlmand ladka hai, isliye use apni khidmat mein rakhiye."' Anas ne izaafa kiya, 'To maine Nabi (SAW) ki khidmat ghar mein aur safar mein ki; Allah ki qasam, unhone kabhi mujhse kisi kaam ke baare mein jo maine kiya, ye nahi kaha: "Tumne ye aisa kyun kiya?" ya kisi kaam ke baare mein jo maine nahi kiya, "Tumne ye aisa kyun nahi kiya?"'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "There is no Diya for persons killed by animals or for the one who has been killed accidentally by falling into a well or for the one killed in a mine. And one-fifth of Rikaz (treasures buried before the Islamic era) is to be given to the state
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jaanwaron se maare gaye logon ke liye koi Diya nahi hai, na uske liye jo achaanak kuen mein girkar mara ho, na uske liye jo khaan (mine) mein mara ho. Aur Rikaz (Islam se pehle chhupaaye gaye khazaanon) ka ek-panchvaan hissa Baitul-Maal (sarkaari khazaane) ko diya jaana chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There is no Diya for a person injured or killed by an animal (going about without somebody to control it) and similarly, there is no Diya for the one who falls and dies in a well, and also the one who dies in a mine. As regards the Ar-Rikaz (buried wealth), one-fifth thereof is for the state
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kisi jaanwar (jo bina kisi ke qaboo mein ghoom raha ho) se zakhmi ya maare gaye shaks ke liye koi Diya nahi hai, aur isi tarah, uske liye bhi koi Diya nahi hai jo kuen mein gir kar mar jaaye, aur na hi uske liye jo khaan mein mare. Jahaan tak Ar-Rikaz (dabaa hua khazaana) ki baat hai, uska ek-panchvaan hissa Baitul-Maal ko diya jaata hai.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever killed a Mu'ahid (a person who is granted the pledge of protection by the Muslims) shall not smell the fragrance of Paradise though its fragrance can be smelt at a distance of forty years (of traveling)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi kisi Mu'ahid (jise Musalmaanon ne panaah aur hifaazat di ho) ko qatl kare, use Jannat ki khushbu bhi nahi milegi, halaanke Jannat ki khushbu chaalis saal ki doori se mehsoos ki jaa sakti hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Juhaifa:I asked `Ali "Do you have anything Divine literature besides what is in the Qur'an?" Or, as Uyaina once said, "Apart from what the people have?" `Ali said, "By Him Who made the grain split (germinate) and created the soul, we have nothing except what is in the Qur'an and the ability (gift) of understanding Allah's Book which He may endow a man, with and what is written in this sheet of paper." I asked, "What is on this paper?" He replied, "The legal regulations of Diya (Blood-money) and the (ransom for) releasing of the captives, and the judgment that no Muslim should be killed in Qisas (equality in punishment) for killing a Kafir (disbeliever)
hi: Abu Juhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Ali (Alayhis Salam) se pucha, 'Kya aapke paas Quran ke ilaawa koi aur Ilaahi Kitaab hai?' Ya, jaisa Uyaina ne ek baar kaha, '...jo logon ke paas hai uske ilaawa?' Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha, 'Us Zaat ki qasam jisne daana phatvaaya aur Rooh ko banaaya, hamare paas Quran ke ilaawa aur wo samajh (tohfa) ke siwa kuch nahi jo Allah kisi shaks ko apni Kitaab samajhne mein de sakta hai, aur jo is kaagaz ke tukde mein likha hai.' Maine pucha, 'Is kaagaz mein kya hai?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Diya (khoon-bahaa) ke kanooni qawaanin, aur qaidiyon ko riha karne (ka fidya), aur ye faisla ke koi Musalmaan kisi kaafir ko qatl karne ke Qisas mein qatl nahi kiya jaana chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not prefer some prophets to others
hi: Abu Saeed bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kisi Nabi ko doosre Nabi se behtar mat samjho.'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:A Jew whose face had been slapped (by someone), came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Muhammad! A man from your Ansari companions slapped me. " The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Call him". They called him and the Prophet (ﷺ) asked him, "Why did you slap his face?" He said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! While I was passing by the Jews, I heard him saying, 'By Him Who chose Moses above all the human beings.' I said (protestingly), 'Even above Muhammad?' So I became furious and slapped him." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not give me preference to other prophets, for the people will become unconscious on the Day of Resurrection and I will be the first to gain conscious, and behold, I will Find Moses holding one of the pillars of the Throne (of Allah). Then I will not know whether he has become conscious before me or he has been exempted because of his unconsciousness at the mountain (during his worldly life) which he received
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek Yahudi jiske munh par thappad maara gaya tha, Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Aye Muhammad! Aapke Ansaari saathiyon mein se ek ne mujhe thappad maara.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Use bulao.' Unhone use bulaaya aur Nabi (SAW) ne usse pucha, 'Tumne uske munh par thappad kyun maara?' Usne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Jab main Yahudiyon ke paas se guzar raha tha, maine usse kehte suna, "Us Zaat ki qasam jisne Musa ko sab insaanon se oopar chuna." Maine (protest karte hue) kaha, "Kya Muhammad se bhi oopar?" To mujhe gussa aaya aur maine use thappad maara.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Mujhe doosre Nabiyon se oopar mat rakho, kyunke log Qayamat ke din behosh ho jaayenge aur main pehla shaks hounga jo hosh mein aayega, aur dekho! Main Musa ko dekhunga, Allah ke Arsh (Takht) ke kisi ek khambhe ko thaame hue. Phir mujhe nahi pata hoga ke wo mujhse pehle hosh mein aaye the ya unhein (Tur pahaad par) apni behoshi ki wajah se maaf kar diya gaya tha jo unhein us waqt mili thi (jab unhone duniya mein Allah ka deedar maanga tha).'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:When the Verse: 'It is those who believe and confuse not their belief with wrong (i.e., worshipping others besides Allah): (6.82) was revealed, it became very hard on the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) and they said, "Who among us has not confused his belief with wrong (oppression)?" On that, Allah's Apostle said, "This is not meant (by the Verse). Don't you listen to Luqman's statement: 'Verily! Joining others in worship with Allah is a great wrong indeed
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Aayat, 'Wo log jo Iman laate hain aur apne Iman ko zulm (yaani Allah ke ilaawa doosron ki ibaadat karne) se aludaa nahi karte...' (6:82) naazil hui, ye Nabi (SAW) ke sahaaba ke liye bahut mushkil ho gayi, aur unhone kaha, 'Hum mein se kaun aisa hai jisne apne aap par zulm na kiya ho?' Isper, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Iska matlab wo nahi hai jo tum sochte ho. Kya tumne Luqman ki ye baat nahi suni: "Beshak, Allah ke saath doosron ko shareek karna waaqai bahut bada zulm hai" (31:13)?'

e: Narrated Abu Bakra:The Prophet. said, "The biggest of the great sins are: To join others in worship with Allah, to be undutiful to one's parents, and to give a false witness." He repeated it thrice, or said, "....a false statement," and kept on repeating that warning till we wished he would stop saying it. (See Hadith No.7, Vol)
hi: Abu Bakra (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Sabse bade gunaahon mein sabse bade hain: Allah ke saath doosron ko shareek karna, maa-baap ke saath badsuluki karna, aur jhooti gawaahi dena.' Unhone ye teen baar dohraaya, ya kaha, '...jhooti baat kehna,' aur wo ye chetaawani dohraate rahe yahaan tak ke humne chaaha wo ruk jaayein. (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 7, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:A bedouin came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What are the biggest sins?: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "To join others in worship with Allah." The bedouin said, "What is next?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "To be undutiful to one's parents." The bedouin said "What is next?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said "To take an oath 'Al-Ghamus." The bedouin said, "What is an oath 'Al-Ghamus'?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The false oath through which one deprives a Muslim of his property (unjustly)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek badawi Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Sabse bade gunaah kaunse hain?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Allah ke saath doosron ko shareek karna.' Badawi ne kaha, 'Uske baad kya?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Maa-baap ke saath badsuluki karna.' Badawi ne kaha, 'Uske baad kya?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Al-Ghamus qasam khaana.' Badawi ne pucha, 'Al-Ghamus qasam kya hai?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Wo jhoothi qasam jiske zariye koi kisi Musalmaan ki jaayadaad (na-jaayez taur par) chheenta hai.'

e: Narrated Ibn Mas`ud:A man said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shall we be punished for what we did in the pre-Islamic Period of ignorance?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever does good in Islam will not be punished for what he did in the Pre-Islamic Period of ignorance and whoever does evil in Islam will be punished for his former and later (bad deeds)
hi: Ibn Masud bataate hain: Ek shaks ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya humein Jaahiliyat (Islam se pehle) ke daur mein jo humne kiya uski saza milegi?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Jo koi Islam mein achhaai kare, use Jaahiliyat ke daur mein kiye gunaahon ki saza nahi milegi, aur jo koi Islam mein buraai kare, use apne pehle aur baad ke (bure amaal) ki saza milegi.'

e: Narrated `Ikrima:Some Zanadiqa (atheists) were brought to `Ali and he burnt them. The news of this event, reached Ibn `Abbas who said, "If I had been in his place, I would not have burnt them, as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade it, saying, 'Do not punish anybody with Allah's punishment (fire).' I would have killed them according to the statement of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), 'Whoever changed his Islamic religion, then kill him
hi: Ikrima bataate hain: Kuch Zanadiqa (mulhid, deen chhodne wale) Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke paas laaye gaye aur unhone unhein jala diya. Ye khabar Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) tak pahunchi, jinhone kaha, 'Agar main unki jagah hota, to main unhein jalata nahi, kyunke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mana kiya tha, kehte hue, "Kisi ko bhi Allah ki saza (aag) se saza mat do." Main unhein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki is baat ke mutaabik qatl kar deta: "Jo koi apna Islami deen badle, use qatl kar do."'

e: Narrated Abu Burda:Abu Musa said, "I came to the Prophet (ﷺ) along with two men (from the tribe) of Ash`ariyin, one on my right and the other on my left, while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was brushing his teeth (with a Siwak), and both men asked him for some employment. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'O Abu Musa (O `Abdullah bin Qais!).' I said, 'By Him Who sent you with the Truth, these two men did not tell me what was in their hearts and I did not feel (realize) that they were seeking employment.' As if I were looking now at his Siwak being drawn to a corner under his lips, and he said, 'We never (or, we do not) appoint for our affairs anyone who seeks to be employed. But O Abu Musa! (or `Abdullah bin Qais!) Go to Yemen.'" The Prophet then sent Mu`adh bin Jabal after him and when Mu`adh reached him, he spread out a cushion for him and requested him to get down (and sit on the cushion). Behold: There was a fettered man beside Abu Muisa. Mu`adh asked, "Who is this (man)?" Abu Muisa said, "He was a Jew and became a Muslim and then reverted back to Judaism." Then Abu Muisa requested Mu`adh to sit down but Mu`adh said, "I will not sit down till he has been killed. This is the judgment of Allah and His Apostle (for such cases) and repeated it thrice. Then Abu Musa ordered that the man be killed, and he was killed. Abu Musa added, "Then we discussed the night prayers and one of us said, 'I pray and sleep, and I hope that Allah will reward me for my sleep as well as for my prayers
hi: Abu Burda bataate hain: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Main Ash'ariyin qabeele ke do aadmiyon ke saath Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya, ek mere daaen aur doosra mere baaen, jabke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apne daant Siwak se saaf kar rahe the, aur dono aadmiyon ne unse kisi naukri ke liye kaha. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, "Aye Abu Musa (Aye Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Qais!)." Maine kaha, "Us Zaat ki qasam jisne aapko Haq ke saath bheja, in dono aadmiyon ne mujhe apne dil ki baat nahi bataayi, aur mujhe ehsaas nahi tha (realize nahi kiya) ke wo naukri maang rahe hain." Jaise ke main abhi unka Siwak apni honthon ke neeche ek kone mein khinchte dekh raha hoon, aur unhone kaha, "Hum kabhi (ya, hum nahi) apne kaam ke liye us shaks ko muqarrar karte jo naukri maangta hai. Magar Aye Abu Musa! (ya Abdullah bin Qais!) Yemen jaao." Nabi (SAW) ne phir Mu'adh bin Jabal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko unke peechhe bheja, aur jab Mu'adh unke paas pahunche, unhone unke liye ek gaddi bichhaayi aur unse baithne ki darkhwaast ki (gaddi par). Dekho! Abu Musa ke paas ek zanjeer mein bandhi shaks tha. Mu'adh ne pucha, "Ye (aadmi) kaun hai?" Abu Musa ne kaha, "Ye ek Yahudi tha aur Musalmaan ban gaya tha, phir wapas Yahudi mazhab mein laut aaya." Phir Abu Musa ne Mu'adh se baithne ki darkhwaast ki magar Mu'adh ne kaha, "Main tab tak nahi baithunga jab tak use qatl na kar diya jaaye. Ye Allah aur uske Rasool ka faisla hai (aise maamlon ke liye)," aur unhone ye teen baar dohraaya. Phir Abu Musa ne hukm diya ke us aadmi ko qatl kiya jaaye, aur use qatl kar diya gaya.' Abu Musa ne izaafa kiya, 'Phir humne raat ki namaz ke baare mein charcha ki, aur hum mein se ek ne kaha, "Main namaz padhta hoon aur so jaata hoon, aur mujhe ummeed hai Allah mujhe meri neend ke liye bhi ajr dega jaise meri namaz ke liye."'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:When the Prophet (ﷺ) died and Abu Bakr became his successor and some of the Arabs reverted to disbelief, `Umar said, "O Abu Bakr! How can you fight these people although Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'I have been ordered to fight the people till they say: 'None has the right to be worshipped but Allah, 'and whoever said, 'None has the right to be worshipped but Allah', Allah will save his property and his life from me, unless (he does something for which he receives legal punishment) justly, and his account will be with Allah?' "Abu Bakr said, "By Allah! I will fight whoever differentiates between prayers and Zakat as Zakat is the right to be taken from property (according to Allah's Orders). By Allah! If they refused to pay me even a kid they used to pay to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), I would fight with them for withholding it." `Umar said, "By Allah: It was nothing, but I noticed that Allah opened Abu Bakr's chest towards the decision to fight, therefore I realized that his decision was right
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Nabi (SAW) ka intekaal hua aur Abu Bakr unke jaanashin (successor) bane, aur kuch Arab murtad ho gaye (Islam se peechhe hat gaye), Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Aye Abu Bakr! Aap in logon se kaise ladh sakte hain jabke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, "Mujhe hukm diya gaya hai ke main logon se tab tak ladhun jab tak wo na kahein: 'Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi,' aur jo koi kahega 'Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi,' Allah uski jaayadaad aur uski jaan mujhse bachaayega, siwaaye (jab wo kuch aisa kare jiski wajah se use kanooni saza mile) jaayez tareeke se, aur uska hisaab Allah ke paas hoga"?' Abu Bakr ne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam! Main us har shaks se ladunga jo namaz aur Zakat ke beech farq karta hai, kyunke Zakat jaayadaad se liya jaane wala haq hai (Allah ke hukm ke mutaabik). Allah ki qasam! Agar wo mujhe ek bhi bakri ka bachcha na dein jo wo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko diya karte the, to main unse iske rokne ke liye ladunga.' Umar ne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam: Ye kuch nahi tha, magar maine dekha ke Allah ne Abu Bakr ka seena jang ke faisle ki taraf khol diya, isliye mujhe ehsaas hua ke unka faisla sahi tha.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:A Jew passed by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "As-Samu 'Alaika." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said in reply, "We 'Alaika." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then said to his companions, "Do you know what he (the Jew) has said? He said, 'As-Samu 'Alaika.'" They said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shall we kill him?" The Prophet, said, "No. When the people of the Book greet you, say: 'Wa 'Alaikum
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek Yahudi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas se guzra aur kaha, 'As-Samu Alaika.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne jawab mein kaha, 'Wa Alaika.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne phir apne sahaaba se kaha, 'Kya tumhein pata hai usne (Yahudi ne) kya kaha? Usne kaha, "As-Samu Alaika" (tumpar maut ho).' Unhone kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya hum use qatl kar dein?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Nahi. Jab Ahl-e-Kitaab tumhein salaam karein, kaho: "Wa Alaikum" (aur tumpar bhi).'

e: Narrated `Aisha:A group of Jews asked permission to visit the Prophet (and when they were admitted) they said, "As- Samu 'Alaika (Death be upon you)." I said (to them), "But death and the curse of Allah be upon you!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O `Aisha! Allah is kind and lenient and likes that one should be kind and lenient in all matters." I said, "Haven't you heard what they said?" He said, "I said (to them), 'Wa 'Alaikum (and upon you)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Yahudiyon ka ek giroh Nabi (SAW) se milne ki ijaazat maangi aur (jab unhein andar aane diya gaya) unhone kaha, 'As-Samu Alaika (tumpar maut ho).' Maine (unse) kaha, 'Balke tumpar maut aur Allah ki laanat ho!' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Aye Aisha! Allah meharbaan aur naram hai aur pasand karta hai ke insaan har maamle mein meharbaan aur naram rahe.' Maine kaha, 'Kya aapne unki baat nahi suni?' Unhone kaha, 'Maine (unhein) kaha, "Wa Alaikum" (aur tumpar bhi).'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When the Jews greet anyone of you they say: 'Sam'Alaika (death be upon you); so you should say; 'Wa 'Alaika (and upon you)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab Yahudi tum mein se kisi ko salaam karein, wo kehte hain: "Sam Alaika" (tumpar maut ho); isliye tumhein kehna chaahiye, "Wa Alaika" (aur tumpar bhi).'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:As if I am looking at the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was speaking about one of the prophets whose people have beaten and wounded him, and he was wiping the blood off his face and saying, "O Lord! Forgive my, people as they do not know
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jaise ke main abhi Nabi (SAW) ko dekh raha hoon jab wo ek Nabi ke baare mein baat kar rahe the jinki qaum ne unhein maara aur zakhmi kiya tha, aur wo apne chehre se khoon saaf kar rahe the aur keh rahe the, 'Aye Rab! Meri qaum ko maaf kar de kyunke unhein pata nahi.'

e: Narrated `Ali:Whenever I tell you a narration from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), by Allah, I would rather fall down from the sky than ascribe a false statement to him, but if I tell you something between me and you (not a Hadith) then it was indeed a trick (i.e., I may say things just to cheat my enemy). No doubt I heard Allah's Apostle saying, "During the last days there will appear some young foolish people who will say the best words but their faith will not go beyond their throats (i.e. they will have no faith) and will go out from (leave) their religion as an arrow goes out of the game. So, where-ever you find them, kill them, for who-ever kills them shall have reward on the Day of Resurrection
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Jab bhi main tumhein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki koi riwaayat sunaata hoon, Allah ki qasam, main aasman se girna zyaada pasand karunga is se ke main unke naam koi jhooti baat gadhun, magar agar main tumhein apni aur tumhaari beech ki koi baat kahoon (jo hadees na ho), to wo waaqai ek chaal ho sakti hai (yaani main apne dushman ko dhoka dene ke liye kuch keh sakta hoon). Shak nahi, maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, 'Aakhri dinon mein kuch jawaan naadaan log zaahir honge jo sabse achhi baaten kahenge magar unka Iman unke galay se aage nahi jaayega (yaani unmein Iman nahi hoga), aur wo apne deen se aise nikal jaayenge jaise ek teer shikaar se guzar jaata hai. Isliye jahaan bhi tum unhein pao, unhein qatl karo, kyunke jo koi unhein qatl karega, use Qayamat ke din uska ajr milega.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr bin Yasar:That they visited Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri and asked him about Al-Harauriyya, a special unorthodox religious sect, "Did you hear the Prophet (ﷺ) saying anything about them?" Abu Sa`id said, "I do not know what Al-Harauriyya is, but I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "There will appear in this nation---- he did not say: From this nation ---- a group of people so pious apparently that you will consider your prayers inferior to their prayers, but they will recite the Qur'an, the teachings of which will not go beyond their throats and will go out of their religion as an arrow darts through the game, whereupon the archer may look at his arrow, its Nasl at its Risaf and its Fuqa to see whether it is blood-stained or not (i.e. they will have not even a trace of Islam in them)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Yasar bataate hain: Wo Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) se milne gaye aur unse Al-Harauriyya (ek khaas gair-parampragat deeni firqa) ke baare mein pucha, 'Kya aapne Nabi (SAW) ko unke baare mein kuch kehte suna?' Abu Saeed ne kaha, 'Mujhe nahi pata Al-Harauriyya kya hai, magar maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, "Is ummat mein -- unhone nahi kaha: is ummat se -- kuch log zaahir honge jo apni ibaadat mein itne parhezgaar dikhenge ke tum apni namaz ko unki namaz ke saamne kam samjhoge, magar wo Quran padhenge jiski taleem unke galay se aage nahi jaayegi aur wo apne deen se aise nikal jaayenge jaise ek teer shikaar se guzar jaata hai, jispar teer chalaane wala apne teer ko dekhega, uske Nasl, Risaf aur Fuqa ko, ye dekhne ke liye ke ismein khoon ka nishaan hai ya nahi (yaani unmein Islam ka koi bhi asar nahi hoga)."'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Regarding Al-Harauriyya: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "They will go out of Islam as an arrow darts out of the game's body
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain, Al-Harauriyya ke baare mein: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Wo Islam se aise nikal jaayenge jaise ek teer shikaar ke jism se guzar jaata hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id:While the Prophet (ﷺ) was distributing (something, `Abdullah bin Dhil Khawaisira at-Tamimi came and said, "Be just, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Woe to you ! Who would be just if I were not?" `Umar bin Al-Khattab said, "Allow me to cut off his neck ! " The Prophet (ﷺ) said, " Leave him, for he has companions, and if you compare your prayers with their prayers and your fasting with theirs, you will look down upon your prayers and fasting, in comparison to theirs. Yet they will go out of the religion as an arrow darts through the game's body in which case, if the Qudhadh of the arrow is examined, nothing will be found on it, and when its Nasl is examined, nothing will be found on it; and then its Nadiyi is examined, nothing will be found on it. The arrow has been too fast to be smeared by dung and blood. The sign by which these people will be recognized will be a man whose one hand (or breast) will be like the breast of a woman (or like a moving piece of flesh). These people will appear when there will be differences among the people (Muslims)." Abu Sa`id added: I testify that I heard this from the Prophet (ﷺ) and also testify that `Ali killed those people while I was with him. The man with the description given by the Prophet (ﷺ) was brought to `Ali. The following Verses were revealed in connection with that very person (i.e., `Abdullah bin Dhil-Khawaisira at-Tarnimi): 'And among them are men who accuse you (O Muhammad) in the matter of (the distribution of) the alms
hi: Abu Saeed bataate hain: Jab Nabi (SAW) (kuch cheez) baant rahe the, Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Dhil-Khawaisira At-Tamimi aaye aur kaha, 'Insaaf se kaam lijiye, Aye Allah ke Rasool!' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Afsos hai tumpar! Agar main insaaf nahi karunga, to kaun karega?' Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab ne kaha, 'Mujhe ijaazat dijiye ke main iski gardan kaat doon!' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Ise chhod do, kyunke uske saathi hain, aur agar tum apni namaz unki namaz se, aur apna roza unke roze se tulna karo, to tum apni namaz aur roza unke saamne kam samjhoge. Phir bhi wo deen se aise nikal jaayenge jaise ek teer shikaar ke jism se guzar jaata hai, jismein, agar teer ka Qudhadh (peechhe ka hissa) dekha jaaye, kuch nazar nahi aayega, aur jab uska Nasl (agla hissa) dekha jaaye, kuch nazar nahi aayega; aur phir uska Nadiyi (beech ka hissa) dekha jaaye, kuch nazar nahi aayega. Teer itni tezi se nikla ke uspar mal ya khoon lagne ka waqt hi nahi mila. In logon ki pehchaan ka nishaan ek aisa aadmi hoga jiska ek haath (ya seena) aurat ki chhaati jaisa (ya gosht ke ek chalta tukda jaisa) hoga. Ye log tab zaahir honge jab logon (Musalmaanon) ke beech ikhtelaaf hoga.' Abu Saeed ne izaafa kiya: Main gawaahi deta hoon ke maine ye Nabi (SAW) se suna, aur ye bhi gawaahi deta hoon ke Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne un logon ko qatl kiya jab main unke saath tha. Jis aadmi ka Nabi (SAW) ne zikr kiya tha, use Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke paas laaya gaya. Ye Aayaten usi shaks (yaani Abdullah bin Dhil-Khawaisira At-Tamimi) ke silsile mein naazil hui thi: 'Aur unmein se kuch log hain jo aapki (Aye Muhammad) alochana karte hain (sadqe ki taqseem ke maamle mein)...'

e: Narrated Yusair bin `Amr:I asked Sahl bin Hunaif, "Did you hear the Prophet (ﷺ) saying anything about Al-Khawarij?" He said, "I heard him saying while pointing his hand towards Iraq. "There will appear in it (i.e, Iraq) some people who will recite the Qur'an but it will not go beyond their throats, and they will go out from (leave) Islam as an arrow darts through the game's body
hi: Yusair bin Amr bataate hain: Maine Sahl bin Hunaif se pucha, 'Kya aapne Nabi (SAW) ko Al-Khawarij ke baare mein kuch kehte suna?' Unhone kaha, 'Maine unhein apna haath Iraq ki taraf ishara karte hue kehte suna, "Wahaan (yaani Iraq mein) kuch log zaahir honge jo Quran padhenge magar wo unke galay se aage nahi jaayega, aur wo Islam se aise nikal jaayenge jaise ek teer shikaar ke jism se guzar jaata hai."'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The Hour will not be established till two (huge) groups fight against each other, their claim being one and the same
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Qayamat tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak do (bade) giroh aapas mein na ladein, jinka dawa ek hi hoga.'

e: Umar bin Al-Khattab said:I heard Hisham bin Al-Hakim reciting Surat Al-Furqan during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). I listened to his recitation and noticed that he recited it in several different ways which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had not taught me. So I was about to jump over him during his Salat (prayer) but I waited till he finished his Salat (prayer) whereupon I put, either his upper garment or my upper garment around his neck and seized him by it and asked him, "Who has taught you this Surah?" He replied: "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has taught it to me." I said (to him), "You have told a lie! By Allah, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has taught me this Surah which I have heard you reciting." So I dragged him to the Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). I said: "O Allah's Messenger I have heard this man reciting Surat Al-Furqan in a way in which you have not taught me, and you did teach me Surah Al-Furqan." On that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O 'Umar, release him! Recite, O Hisham". So Hisham recited before him in the way as I heard him reciting. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "It has been revealed like this." Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Recite, O 'Umar" So recited it. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It has been revealed like this." And then he added, "This Qur'an has been revealed to be recited in seven different ways, so recite it whichever way is easier for you
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab ne kaha: Maine Hisham bin Al-Hakim ko Nabi (SAW) ki zindagi mein Surah Al-Furqan padhte suna. Maine unki tilaawat suni aur notice kiya ke wo ise kayi tareekon se padh rahe the jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe nahi sikhaaye the. Isliye main unki namaz ke dauraan unpar kood parne wala hi tha, magar maine unke namaz khatam karne tak intezaar kiya, phir maine unka oopari kapda (ya apna oopari kapda) unki gardan ke gird lapeta aur unhein pakad kar poocha, 'Tumhein ye Surah kisne sikhaayi?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe ye sikhaayi.' Maine (unse) kaha, 'Tumne jhoot kaha! Allah ki qasam, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe ye Surah sikhaayi hai jo maine tumhein padhte suna hai.' To main unhein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas khainch kar laaya. Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Maine is aadmi ko Surah Al-Furqan aisi tarah padhte suna jaisa aapne mujhe nahi sikhaaya, aur aapne mujhe Surah Al-Furqan sikhaayi thi.' Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Aye Umar, use chhodo! Padho, Aye Hisham.' To Hisham ne unke saamne usi tarah padha jaisa maine unhein padhte suna tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Ye isi tarah naazil hua hai.' Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Padho, Aye Umar.' To maine ise padha. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Ye isi tarah naazil hua hai.' Aur phir unhone izaafa kiya, 'Ye Quran saat alag-alag tareekon mein padhne ke liye naazil hua hai, isliye ise jis tarah bhi tumhare liye aasaan ho, padho.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:When the Verse:--'Those who believe and did not confuse their belief with wrong (worshipping others besides Allah).' (6.82) was revealed, it was hard on the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) and they said, "Who among us has not wronged (oppressed) himself?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The meaning of the Verse is not as you think, but it is as Luqman said to his son, 'O my son! Join not in worship others with Allah, Verily! Joining others in worship with Allah is a great wrong indeed
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Aayat: 'Wo log jo Iman laate hain aur apne Iman ko zulm (yaani Allah ke ilaawa doosron ki ibaadat karne) se aludaa nahi karte...' (6:82) naazil hui, ye Nabi (SAW) ke sahaaba ke liye bahut mushkil hui aur unhone kaha, 'Hum mein se kaun aisa hai jisne apne aap par zulm na kiya ho?' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Is Aayat ka matlab wo nahi hai jo tum sochte ho, balke ye wahi hai jo Luqman ne apne bete se kaha tha, "Aye mere bete! Allah ke saath doosron ko shareek mat karo, beshak, Allah ke saath doosron ko shareek karna waaqai bahut bada zulm hai" (31:13).'

e: Narrated `Itban bin Malik:Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to me in the morning, and a man among us said, "Where is Malik bin Ad- Dukhshun?" Another man from us replied, "He is a hypocrite who does not love Allah and His Apostle." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Don't you think that he says: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah, only for Allah's sake?" They replied, "Yes" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Nobody will meet Allah with that saying on the Day of Resurrection, but Allah will save him from the Fire
hi: Itban bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) subah mere paas aaye, aur humme se ek shaks ne kaha, 'Malik bin Ad-Dukhshun kahaan hain?' Humme se ek aur shaks ne jawab diya, 'Wo ek munaafiq hai jo Allah aur uske Rasool se mohabbat nahi karta.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Kya tumhein nahi lagta ke wo "Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi" sirf Allah ki khaatir kehta hai?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Haan.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Koi bhi Qayamat ke din ye baat kehte hue Allah se nahi milega, magar Allah use Aag se bachaayega.'

e: Narrated:Abu `Abdur-Rahman and Hibban bin 'Atiyya had a dispute. Abu `Abdur-Rahman said to Hibban, "You know what made your companions (i.e. `Ali) dare to shed blood." Hibban said, "Come on! What is that?" `Abdur-Rahman said, "Something I heard him saying." The other said, "What was it?" `AbdurRahman said, "`Ali said, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent for me, Az-Zubair and Abu Marthad, and all of us were cavalry men, and said, 'Proceed to Raudat-Hajj (Abu Salama said that Abu 'Awana called it like this, i.e., Hajj where there is a woman carrying a letter from Hatib bin Abi Balta'a to the pagans (of Mecca). So bring that letter to me.' So we proceeded riding on our horses till we overtook her at the same place of which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had told us. She was traveling on her camel. In that letter Hatib had written to the Meccans about the proposed attached of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) against them. We asked her, "Where is the letter which is with you?' She replied, 'I haven't got any letter.' So we made her camel kneel down and searched her luggage, but we did not find anything. My two companions said, 'We do not think that she has got a letter.' I said, 'We know that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has not told a lie.'" Then `Ali took an oath saying, "By Him by Whom one should swear! You shall either bring out the letter or we shall strip off your clothes." She then stretched out her hand for her girdle (round her waist) and brought out the paper (letter). They took the letter to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). `Umar said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! (Hatib) has betrayed Allah, His Apostle and the believers; let me chop off his neck!" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O Hatib! What obliged you to do what you have done?" Hatib replied, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Why (for what reason) should I not believe in Allah and His Apostle? But I intended to do the (Mecca) people a favor by virtue of which my family and property may be protected as there is none of your companions but has some of his people (relatives) whom Allah urges to protect his family and property." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He has said the truth; therefore, do not say anything to him except good." `Umar again said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! He has betrayed Allah, His Apostle and the believers; let me chop his neck off!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Isn't he from those who fought the battle of Badr? And what do you know, Allah might have looked at them (Badr warriors) and said (to them), 'Do what you like, for I have granted you Paradise?' " On that, `Umar's eyes became flooded with tears and he said, "Allah and His Apostle know best
hi: Abu Abdur Rahman aur Hibban bin Atiyya ke beech jhagda hua. Abu Abdur Rahman ne Hibban se kaha, 'Aapko pata hai kis cheez ne aapke saathi (Ali (Alayhis Salam)) ko khoon bahaane ki himmat di.' Hibban ne kaha, 'Aao! Wo kya hai?' Abdur Rahman ne kaha, 'Kuch jo maine unhein kehte suna.' Doosre ne kaha, 'Wo kya tha?' Abdur Rahman ne kaha, 'Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha, "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe, Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Abu Marthad ko bulwaaya, aur hum sab ghudsawaar the, aur kaha, 'Raudat-Hajj ki taraf jaao' (Abu Salama ne kaha ke Abu Awana ne ise aisa kaha, yaani Hajj jahaan ek khaatoon hai jo Hatib bin Abi Balta'a ka mushrikeen (Makkah waalon) ke naam bheja hua khat le jaa rahi hai. To wo khat mere paas laao.' To hum apne ghodon par sawaar hokar chale gaye yahaan tak ke hum unhein usi jagah paaya jismein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein bataya tha. Wo apni oontni par safar kar rahi thi. Us khat mein Hatib ne Makkah waalon ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke unke khilaaf mansoobit hamle ke baare mein likha tha. Humne unse pucha, 'Wo khat kahaan hai jo tumhaare paas hai?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Mere paas koi khat nahi hai.' To humne unki oontni ko bithaaya aur unke saamaan ki talaashi li, magar humein kuch nahi mila. Mere do saathiyon ne kaha, 'Humein nahi lagta unke paas koi khat hai.' Maine kaha, 'Humein pata hai Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne jhoot nahi kaha.'" Phir Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne qasam khaayi, kehte hue, "Us Zaat ki qasam jiski qasam khaani chaahiye! Tum ya to khat nikaaloge ya hum tumhaare kapde utaar denge." Phir unhone apna haath apni kamarband (kamar ke gird) ki taraf badhaaya aur kaagaz (khat) nikaala. Wo khat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laaye. Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! (Hatib) ne Allah, uske Rasool aur Momineen ke saath dhoka kiya hai; mujhe ijaazat dijiye ke main iski gardan kaat doon!' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Aye Hatib! Tumne jo kiya uske liye tumhein kis cheez ne majboor kiya?' Hatib ne jawab diya, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Main Allah aur uske Rasool par Iman kyun na laaun (kis wajah se)?
