Magar main Makkah waalon ko ek ehsaan karna chahta tha jiske zariye mera khaandaan aur meri jaayadaad mehfooz rahe, kyunke aapke sahaaba mein se koi bhi aisa nahi hai jiska Makkah mein koi rishtedaar na ho jinke zariye Allah unki jaayadaad aur khaandaan ki hifaazat kare.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Unhone sach kaha; isliye unhein (kuch bhi) mat kaho siwaaye achhi baat ke.' Umar ne dobara kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Unhone Allah, uske Rasool aur Momineen ke saath dhoka kiya hai; mujhe ijaazat dijiye ke main iski gardan kaat doon!' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Kya wo jang-e-Badr mein shaamil nahi the? Aur tumhein kya pata, shaayad Allah ne unhein (Badr ke jaanbaazon ko) dekha ho aur unse (unse) kaha ho, "Jo chaaho karo, kyunke maine tumhaare liye Jannat muqarrar kar di hai"?' Isper, Umar ki aankhon mein aansu bhar aaye aur unhone kaha, 'Allah aur uska Rasool behtar jaante hain.'

e: Narrated Abi Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to invoke Allah in his prayer, "O Allah! Save `Aiyash bin Abi Rabi`a and Salama bin Hisham and Al-Walid bin Al-Walid; O Allah! Save the weak among the believers; O Allah! Be hard upon the tribe of Mudar and inflict years (of famine) upon them like the (famine) years of Joseph
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) apni namaz mein Allah se ye dua kiya karte the, 'Aye Allah! Aiyash bin Abi Rabi'a aur Salama bin Hisham aur Al-Walid bin Al-Walid ko bacha! Aye Allah! Momineen mein se kamzoron ko bacha! Aye Allah! Mudar qabeele par sakhti kar aur unpar Yusuf (Nabi) ke daur jaise (qehat ke) saal bhej.'

e: Narrated Anas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever possesses the (following) three qualities will have the sweetness of faith (1): The one to whom Allah and His Apostle becomes dearer than anything else; (2) Who loves a person and he loves him only for Allah's Sake; (3) who hates to revert to atheism (disbelief) as he hates to be thrown into the Fire
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi (in) teen gunon ka maalik ho, use Iman ki meethaas mehsoos hogi: (1) Jise Allah aur uska Rasool har cheez se zyaada aziz hon; (2) jo kisi shaks se sirf Allah ki khaatir mohabbat kare; (3) jo Islam chhodkar wapas Kufr (na-shukri) mein jaane ko utna hi napasand kare jitna Aag mein daale jaane ko napasand karta hai.'

e: Narrated Qais:I heard Sa`id bin Zaid saying, "I have seen myself tied and forced by `Umar to leave Islam (Before `Umar himself embraced Islam). And if the mountain of Uhud were to collapse for the evil which you people had done to `Uthman, then Uhud would have the right to do so." (See Hadith No. 202, Vol)
hi: Qais bataate hain: Maine Saeed bin Zaid ko ye kehte suna, 'Maine khud ko baandha hua aur Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke zariye Islam chhodne par majboor kiya hua dekha hai (Umar ke Islam qubool karne se pehle). Aur agar Uhud pahaad us buraai ki wajah se dhah jaaye jo tum logon ne Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath ki, to Uhud ko aisa karne ka haq hoga.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 202, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated Khabbab bin Al-Art:We complained to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (about our state) while he was leaning against his sheet cloak in the shade of the Ka`ba. We said, "Will you ask Allah to help us? Will you invoke Allah for us?" He said, "Among those who were before you a (believer) used to be seized and, a pit used to be dug for him and then he used to be placed in it. Then a saw used to be brought and put on his head which would be split into two halves. His flesh might be combed with iron combs and removed from his bones, yet, all that did not cause him to revert from his religion. By Allah! This religion (Islam) will be completed (and triumph) till a rider (traveler) goes from San`a' (the capital of Yemen) to Hadramout fearing nobody except Allah and the wolf lest it should trouble his sheep, but you are impatient." (See Hadith No. 191, Vol)
hi: Khabbab (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Art bataate hain: Humne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se (hamaari haalat ke baare mein) shikaayat ki jabke wo Kaaba ki chhaaon mein apni chaadar par tek lagaaye hue the. Humne kaha, 'Kya aap Allah se madad maangenge? Kya aap hamare liye dua karenge?' Unhone kaha, 'Tumse pehle logon mein se ek (Momin) ko pakda jaata tha, uske liye ek gaddha khodha jaata, aur phir use usmein daala jaata. Phir ek aara laaya jaata aur uske sar par rakha jaata jo use do hisson mein baant deta. Uska gosht loha ke kanghon se noch-noch kar uski haddiyon se hataaya jaata, phir bhi, ye sab kuch use apne deen se peechhe hatane par majboor nahi karta. Allah ki qasam! Ye deen (Islam) poora (aur kaamyaab) hoga jab tak ek sawaar (musaafir) San'a (Yemen ki raajdhaani) se Hadramout tak jaayega bina kisi se dare siwaaye Allah ke, aur bhediye se bhi nahi darega magar apni bakriyon ki takleef ke dar se, magar tum log betaab ho.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 191, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:While we were in the mosque, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came out to us and said, "Let us proceed to the Jews." So we went along with him till we reached Bait-al-Midras (a place where the Torah used to be recited and all the Jews of the town used to gather). The Prophet (ﷺ) stood up and addressed them, "O Assembly of Jews! Embrace Islam and you will be safe!" The Jews replied, "O Aba-l-Qasim! You have conveyed Allah's message to us." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "That is what I want (from you)." He repeated his first statement for the second time, and they said, "You have conveyed Allah's message, O Aba-l- Qasim." Then he said it for the third time and added, "You should Know that the earth belongs to Allah and His Apostle, and I want to exile you fro,,, this land, so whoever among you owns some property, can sell it, otherwise you should know that the Earth belongs to Allah and His Apostle." (See Hadith No. 392, Vol)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab hum Masjid mein the, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) hamare paas aaye aur kaha, 'Chalo hum Yahudiyon ke paas chalein.' To hum unke saath chale yahaan tak ke hum Bait-al-Midras (jagah jahaan Taurat padhi jaati thi aur shehar ke sab Yahudi jama hote the) pahunche. Nabi (SAW) khade hue aur unhein khitaab kiya, 'Aye Yahudiyon ke giroh! Islam qubool karo aur hifaazat mein raho!' Yahudiyon ne jawab diya, 'Aye Abu-l-Qasim! Aapne humein Allah ka paighaam pahuncha diya hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Yahi main (tumse) chahta hoon.' Unhone apni pehli baat doosri baar dohraayi, aur unhone kaha, 'Aapne Allah ka paighaam pahuncha diya, Aye Abu-l-Qasim.' Phir unhone ise teesri baar kaha aur izaafa kiya, 'Tumhein pata hona chaahiye ke zameen Allah aur uske Rasool ki hai, aur main tumhein is zameen se jila-watan karna chahta hoon, isliye jo bhi tum mein se koi jaayadaad rakhta hai, wo use bech sakta hai, warna tumhein pata hona chaahiye ke zameen Allah aur uske Rasool ki hai.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 392, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated Khansa' bint Khidam Al-Ansariya:That her father gave her in marriage when she was a matron and she disliked that marriage. So she came and (complained) to the Prophets and he declared that marriage invalid. (See Hadith No. 69, Vol)
hi: Khansa bint Khidam Al-Ansariya bataati hain ke unke waalid ne unki shaadi kar di jabke wo ek biwaa (matron) thin aur unhein ye shaadi napasand thi. To wo Nabi (SAW) ke paas gayi (shikaayat karne), aur unhone us shaadi ko na-jaayez (invalid) qaraar diya. (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 69, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated `Aisha:I asked the Prophet, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Should the women be asked for their consent to their marriage?" He said, "Yes." I said, "A virgin, if asked, feels shy and keeps quiet." He said, "Her silence means her consent
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) se pucha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya khawaateen se unki shaadi ke liye unki raazamandi maangi jaani chaahiye?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan.' Maine kaha, 'Ek kunwaari, agar poochi jaaye, sharma jaati hai aur khaamosh rehti hai.' Unhone kaha, 'Uski khaamoshi hi uski raazamandi hai.'

e: Narrated Jabir:A man from the Ansar made his slave, a Mudabbar. And apart from that slave he did not have any other property. This news reached Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he said, "Who will buy that slave from me?" So Nu'aim bin An-Nahham bought him for 800 Dirham. Jabir added: It was a coptic (Egyptian) slave who died that year
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek Ansaari shaks ne apne ghulaam ko Mudabbar (yaani apni maut ke baad azaad hone waala) banaaya. Us ghulaam ke ilaawa, unke paas koi aur jaayadaad nahi thi. Ye khabar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) tak pahunchi aur unhone kaha, 'Kaun mujhse ye ghulaam khareedega?' Nu'aim bin An-Nahham ne use aath sau Dirham mein khareed liya. Jabir ne izaafa kiya: Ye ek Qibti (Misri) ghulaam tha jo usi saal mar gaya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Regarding the Qur'anic Verse: 'O you who believe! You are forbidden to inherit women against their will.' (4.19) The custom (in the Pre-Islamic Period) was that if a man died, his relatives used to have the right to inherit his wife, and if one of them wished, he could marry her, or they could marry her to somebody else, or prevent her from marrying if they wished, for they had more right to dispose of her than her own relatives. Therefore this Verse was revealed concerning this matter
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain (Quran ki is Aayat ke baare mein): 'Aye Iman waalon! Tumhein khawaateen ko unki marzi ke khilaaf miraas mein lene se mana kiya gaya hai.' (4:19) Jaahiliyat ke daur mein riwaayat thi ke agar koi aadmi mar jaaye, uske rishtedaaron ko uski biwi ko miraas mein lene ka haq hota tha, aur agar unmein se koi chaahe, wo use shaadi kar sakta tha, ya wo use kisi aur se shaadi karwaa sakte the, ya agar wo chaahein to use shaadi karne se rok sakte the, kyunke unhein uske apne khud ke rishtedaaron se zyaada haq tha use hidayat karne ka. Isliye ye Aayat is maamle ke baare mein naazil hui thi.

e: And Safiyya bint 'Ubaid said:"A governmental male-slave tried to seduce a slave-girl from the Khumus of the war booty till he deflowered her by force against her will; therefore 'Umar flogged him according to the law, and exiled him, but he did not flog the female slave because the male-slave had committed illegal sexual intercourse by force, against her will." Az-Zuhri said regarding a virgin slave-girl raped by a free man: The judge has to fine the adulterer as much money as is equal to the price of the female slave and the adulterer has to be flogged (according to the Islamic Law); but if the slave woman is a matron, then, according to the verdict of the Imam, the adulterer is not fined but he has to receive the legal punishment (according to the Islamic Law)
hi: Safiyya bint Ubaid ne kaha: 'Ek sarkaari (naukri par) ghulaam ne jang ke maal-e-ganimat ke Khumus (paanchwaan hissa) mein se ek launDi ko phuslaane ki koshish ki yahaan tak ke usne zabardasti uski marzi ke khilaaf use bhog liya; isliye Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne use kanooni saza ke mutaabik kode maare aur use jila-watan kiya, magar unhone launDi ko kode nahi maare kyunke ghulaam ne zabardasti, uski marzi ke khilaaf zina kiya tha.' Az-Zuhri ne ek kunwaari launDi ke baare mein, jise ek azaad aadmi ne zabardasti bhoga tha, kaha: Qaazi ko zani (zina karne wale) par utna hi jurmaana laagu karna chaahiye jitni launDi ki keemat ho, aur zani ko (Islami qanoon ke mutaabik) kode maare jaane chaahiye; magar agar launDi biwaa (matron) ho, to Imam ke faisle ke mutaabik, zani par jurmaana nahi laagu hota magar use (Islami qanoon ke mutaabik) kanooni saza milni chaahiye.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "(The Prophet) Abraham migrated with his wife Sarah till he reached a town where there was a king or a tyrant who sent a message, to Abraham, ordering him to send Sarah to him. So when Abraham had sent Sarah, the tyrant got up, intending to do evil with her, but she got up and performed ablution and prayed and said, 'O Allah ! If I have believed in You and in Your Apostle, then do not empower this oppressor over me.' So he (the king) had an epileptic fit and started moving his legs violently
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, '(Nabi) Ibrahim apni biwi Sarah ke saath hijrat karke ek shehar tak pahunche jahaan ek raja ya zaalim hukmraan tha jisne Ibrahim ke paas ek paighaam bheja, unhein hukm dete hue ke Sarah ko unke paas bhej diya jaaye. To jab Ibrahim ne Sarah ko bheja, us zaalim ne khade hokar unke saath buraai karne ka iraada kiya, magar wo (Sarah) uthi aur wuzu karke namaz padhi aur kaha, "Aye Allah! Agar main tujhpar aur tere Rasool par Iman rakhti hoon, to is zaalim ko mujhpar qaboo mat de." To use (raja ko) mirgi (epileptic) ka daura pada aur wo apni taangein zor-zor se hilaane laga.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "A Muslim is a brother of another Muslim. So he should neither oppress him nor hand him over to an oppressor. And whoever fulfilled the needs of his brother, Allah will fulfill his needs
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Musalmaan doosre Musalmaan ka bhai hai. Isliye use na to uspar zulm karna chaahiye na hi use kisi zaalim ke hawaale karna chaahiye. Aur jo koi apne bhai ki zarooriyaton ko poora kare, Allah uski zarooriyaton ko poora karega.'

e: Narrated Anas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Help your brother whether he is an oppressor or an oppressed," A man said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I will help him if he is oppressed, but if he is an oppressor, how shall I help him?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "By preventing him from oppressing (others), for that is how to help him
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Apne bhai ki madad karo, chaahe wo zaalim ho ya mazloom.' Ek shaks ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Main uski madad karunga agar wo mazloom hai, magar agar wo zaalim hai, to main uski madad kaise karun?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Use zulm karne se rok kar, kyunke yahi uski madad karne ka tareeka hai.'

e: Narrated `Umar bin Al-Khattab:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'O people! The reward of deeds depends upon the intentions, and every person will get the reward according to what he has intended. So, whoever emigrated for Allah and His Apostle, then his emigration was for Allah and His Apostle, and whoever emigrated to take worldly benefit or for a woman to marry, then his emigration was for what he emigrated for
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Aye logo! Amaal ka ajr niyaton par nirbhar karta hai, aur har shaks ko wo milega jo usne iraada kiya. Isliye jo koi Allah aur uske Rasool ke liye hijrat kare, uski hijrat Allah aur uske Rasool ke liye maani jaayegi, aur jo koi duniya ke faayde ke liye ya kisi khaatoon se shaadi karne ke liye hijrat kare, uski hijrat usi cheez ke liye maani jaayegi jiske liye usne hijrat ki.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah does not accept prayer of anyone of you if he does Hadath (passes wind) till he performs the ablution (anew)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah tum mein se kisi ki namaz qubool nahi karta agar usne Hadath (wuzu todne wala amal) kiya ho, jab tak wo (naya) wuzu na kare.'

e: Narrated Anas:That Abu Bakr wrote for him, Zakat regulations which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had made compulsory, and wrote that one should neither collect various portions (of the property) nor divide the property into various portions in order to avoid paying Zakat
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Abu Bakr ne unke liye Zakat ke wo qawaanin likhe jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farz kiye the, aur likha ke koi bhi apne (jaanwaron ke) hisson ko na to jama kare na alag-alag kare taake Zakat dene se bache.

e: Narrated Talha bin 'Ubaidullah:A bedouin with unkempt hair came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Tell me what Allah has enjoined on me as regards prayers." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You have to offer perfectly the five (compulsory) prayers in a day and a night (24 hrs.), except if you want to perform some extra optional prayers." The bedouin said, "Tell me what Allah has enjoined on me as regards fasting." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You have to observe fast during the month of Ramadan except if you fast some extra optional fast." The bedouin said, "Tell me what Allah has enjoined on me as regard Zakat." The Prophet (ﷺ) then told him the Islamic laws and regulations whereupon the bedouin said, "By Him Who has honored you, I will not perform any optional deeds of worship and I will not leave anything of what Allah has enjoined on me." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "He will be successful if he has told the truth (or he will enter Paradise if he said the truth)." And some people said, "The Zakat for one-hundred and twenty camels is two Hiqqas, and if the Zakat payer slaughters the camels intentionally or gives them as a present or plays some other trick in order to avoid the Zakat, then there is no harm (in it) for him
hi: Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ubaidullah bataate hain: Ek badawi, uljhe hue baalon waala, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe bataiye Allah ne mujhpar namaz ke silsile mein kya farz kiya hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Tumhein din-raat (24 ghanton) mein paanch (farz) namazein sahi tareeke se padhni chaahiye, siwaaye is ke ke tum kuch nafl namaz aur padhna chaho.' Badawi ne kaha, 'Mujhe bataiye Allah ne mujhpar roze ke silsile mein kya farz kiya hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Tumhein Ramzan ke mahine mein roza rakhna chaahiye, siwaaye is ke ke tum kuch nafl roze aur rakhna chaho.' Badawi ne kaha, 'Mujhe bataiye Allah ne mujhpar Zakat ke silsile mein kya farz kiya hai.' Phir Nabi (SAW) ne unhein Islami qawaanin aur zaabte bataye, isper badawi ne kaha, 'Us Zaat ki qasam jisne aapko izzat di hai, main koi nafl ibaadat nahi karunga aur jo bhi Allah ne mujhpar farz kiya hai usmein se kuch nahi chhodunga.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Wo kaamyaab hoga agar usne sach kaha,' (ya, 'wo Jannat mein daakhil hoga agar usne sach kaha'). Aur kuch logon ne kaha, '120 oonton ki Zakat do Hiqqas (do saal ke maada oont) hai, aur agar Zakat dene wala jaan-boojh kar oonton ko zibah kar de, ya unhein tohfe mein de de, ya Zakat se bachne ke liye koi aur chaal chale, to usmein uske liye koi harj nahi hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "On the Day of Resurrection the Kanz (Treasure or wealth of which, Zakat has not been paid) of anyone of you will appear in the shape of a huge bald headed poisonous male snake and its owner will run away from it, but it will follow him and say, 'I am your Kanz.'" The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "By Allah, that snake will keep on following him until he stretches out his hand and let the snake swallow it." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) added, "If the owner of camels does not pay their Zakat, then, on the Day of Resurrection those camels will come to him and will strike his face with their hooves." Some people said: Concerning a man who has camels, and is afraid that Zakat will be due so he sells those camels for similar camels or for sheep or cows or money one day before Zakat becomes due in order to avoid payment of their Zakat cunningly! "He has not to pay anything." The same scholar said, "If one pays Zakat of his camels one day or one year prior to the end of the year (by the end of which Zakat becomes due), his Zakat will be valid
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Qayamat ke din tum mein se kisi ka Kanz (khazaana ya daulat jispar Zakat nahi di gayi) ek bada, gunja-sar, zeharili nar saanp ki shakl mein zaahir hoga, aur uska maalik uske se bhaagega, magar wo uska peecha karega aur kahega, "Main tera Kanz hoon."' Nabi (SAW) ne izaafa kiya, 'Allah ki qasam, wo saanp uska peecha karta rahega yahaan tak ke wo apna haath badhaayega aur saanp use nigal lega.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne izaafa kiya, 'Agar oonton ka maalik unki Zakat na de, to Qayamat ke din wo oont uske paas aayenge aur apne khuron se uske chehre par maarenge.' Kuch logon ne kaha ke agar kisi ke paas oont hain aur use dar hai ke Zakat ka waqt aa raha hai, to wo Zakat se bachne ki chaal ke taur par Zakat ka waqt aane se ek din pehle un oonton ko waise hi doosre oonton, ya bakriyon, ya gaayon, ya paisa se badal le, 'To use kuch adaa nahi karna padega.' Isi aalim ne kaha, 'Agar koi apni oonton ki Zakat saal poora hone se ek din ya ek saal pehle de deta hai (jiske aakhir mein Zakat farz hoti hai), to uski Zakat sahi (valid) hogi.'

e: Narrated Ibn Abbas: Sa'd bin 'Ubada Al-Ansari sought the verdict of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) regarding a vow made by his mother who had died before fulfilling it. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Fulfill it on her behalf." Some people said, "If the number of camels reaches twenty, then their owner has to pay four sheep as Zakat; and if their owner gives them as a gift or sells them in order to escape the payment of Zakat cunningly before the completion of a year, then he is not to pay anything, and if he slaughters them and then dies, then no Zakat is to be taken from his property
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Sa'd bin Ubada (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ansari ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se apni maa ki ek mannat ke baare mein faisla maanga jo unki maut se pehle poori nahi hui thi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Uski taraf se ise poora karo.' Kuch logon ne kaha, 'Agar oonton ki tadaad bees tak pahunch jaaye, to unke maalik ko chaar bakriyaan Zakat ke taur par deni chaahiye; aur agar unka maalik unhein saal poora hone se pehle (Zakat se bachne ki chaal ke taur par) tohfe mein de de ya bech de, to use kuch adaa nahi karna padega, aur agar wo unhein zibah kare aur phir mar jaaye, to uski jaayadaad se koi Zakat nahi li jaayegi.'

e: Narrated 'Abdullah: Nafi narrated to me that 'Abdullah said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the Shighar. I asked Nafi', "What is the Shighar?" He said, "It is to marry the daughter of a man and marry one's daughter to that man (at the same time) without Mahr (in both cases); or to marry the sister of a man and marry one's own sister to that man without Mahr." Some people said, "If one, by a trick, marries on the basis of Shighar, the marriage is valid but its condition is illegal." The same scholar said regarding Al-Mut'a, "The marriage is invalid and its condition is illegal." Some others said, "The Mut'a and the Shighar are permissible but the condition is illegal
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nafi' ne mujhe bataaya ke Abdullah ne kaha ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Shighar se mana kiya. Maine Nafi' se pucha, 'Shighar kya hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Ye ek aadmi ki beti se shaadi karna aur apni beti ki us aadmi se shaadi karna hai (usi waqt), bina Mahr ke (dono maamlon mein); ya ek aadmi ki behen se shaadi karna aur apni behen ki us aadmi se shaadi karna hai bina Mahr ke.' Kuch logon ne kaha, 'Agar koi chaal se Shighar ke aadhaar par shaadi kare, to shaadi valid hai magar uski shart na-jaayez hai.' Isi aalim ne Al-Mut'a (kuch waqt ke liye shaadi) ke baare mein kaha, 'Shaadi na-jaayez hai aur uski shart bhi na-jaayez hai.' Kuch aur logon ne kaha, 'Mut'a aur Shighar dono jaayez hain magar shart na-jaayez hai.'

e: Narrated Muhammad bin `Ali:`Ali was told that Ibn `Abbas did not see any harm in the Mut'a marriage. `Ali said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the Mut'a marriage on the Day of the battle of Khaibar and he forbade the eating of donkey's meat." Some people said, "If one, by a tricky way, marries temporarily, his marriage is illegal." Others said, "The marriage is valid but its condition is illegal
hi: Muhammad bin Ali (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko bataya gaya ke Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko Mut'a shaadi mein koi harj nazar nahi aata. Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Mut'a shaadi ko jang-e-Khaibar ke din mana kiya, aur unhone gadhe ka gosht khaane se bhi mana kiya.' Kuch logon ne kaha, 'Agar koi chaal se, kuch waqt ke liye shaadi kare, to uski shaadi na-jaayez hai.' Doosron ne kaha, 'Shaadi valid hai magar uski shart na-jaayez hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "One should not prevent others from watering their animals with the surplus of his water in order to prevent them from benefiting by the surplus of grass
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Koi bhi doosron ko apne bache hue paani se apne jaanwaron ko paani pilaane se na roke taake unhein bache hue ghaas se faayda uthaane se roka jaa sake.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the practice of An-Najsh
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne An-Najsh (jhoothi bolí lagaana, keemat badhaane ke liye) se mana kiya.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:A man mentioned to the Prophet (ﷺ) that he had always been cheated in bargains. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whenever you do bargain, say, 'No cheating
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks ne Nabi (SAW) ko bataya ke unhein hamesha khareed-farokht mein dhoka diya jaata hai. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Jab bhi tum khareed-farokht karo, kaho, "Koi dhoka nahi."'

e: Narrated `Urwa:That he asked `Aisha regarding the Verse: 'If you fear that you shall not be able to deal justly with the orphan girls, marry (other) women of your choice.' (4.3) `Aisha said, "It is about an orphan girl under the custody of her guardian who being attracted by her wealth and beauty wants to marry her with Mahr less than other women of her status. So such guardians were forbidden to marry them unless they treat them justly by giving them their full Mahr. Then the people sought the verdict of Allah's Apostle for such cases, whereupon Allah revealed: 'They ask your instruction concerning women..' (4.127) (The sub-narrator then mentioned the Hadith)
hi: Urwa bataate hain ke unhone Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se is Aayat ke baare mein pucha: 'Agar tumhein dar ho ke tum yateem ladkiyon ke saath insaaf nahi kar paoge, to (doosri) khawaateen se, jinhein tum pasand karo, shaadi karo' (4:3). Aisha ne kaha, 'Ye ek aise yateem ladki ke baare mein hai jo apne sarparast (guardian) ki dekhbhaal mein ho, aur wo uski daulat aur khoobsoorati se aakarshit hokar use uske darje ki doosri khawaateen se kam Mahr par shaadi karna chahta hai. To aise sarparaston ko unse shaadi karne se mana kiya gaya, jab tak wo unke saath insaaf na karein, unhein unka poora Mahr dekar. Phir logon ne aise maamlon ke liye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se faisla maanga, isper Allah ne naazil kiya: "Wo tumse khawaateen ke baare mein hukm maangte hain..." (4:127).' (Doosre ravi ne aage Hadees ka zikr kiya.)

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "For every betrayer there will be a flag by which he will be recognized on the Day of Resurrection
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Har dhoke-baaz ke liye Qayamat ke din ek jhanda hoga jisse use pehchaana jaayega.'

e: Narrated Um Salama:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I am only a human being, and you people have disputes. May be some one amongst you can present his case in a more eloquent and convincing manner than the other, and I give my judgment in his favor according to what I hear. Beware! If ever I give (by error) somebody something of his brother's right then he should not take it as I have only, given him a piece of Fire." (See Hadith No. 638. Vol)
hi: Umm Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Main bhi ek insaan hoon, aur tum logon ke aapas mein jhagde hote hain. Shaayad tum mein se koi apna maamla doosre se zyaada khoobsoorat aur qaayil karne wale andaaz mein pesh kare, aur main jo sunta hoon uske mutaabik uske haq mein faisla dun. Khabardaar! Agar main kabhi (galti se) kisi ko uske bhai ke haq mein se kuch de doon, to use wo lena nahi chaahiye, kyunke maine use sirf Aag ka ek tukda diya hai.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 638, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A virgin should not be married till she is asked for her consent; and the matron should not be married till she is asked whether she agrees to marry or not." It was asked, "O Allah's Apostle! How will she (the virgin) express her consent?" He said, "By keeping silent." Some people said that if a virgin is not asked for her consent and she is not married, and then a man, by playing a trick presents two false witnesses that he has married her with her consent and the judge confirms his marriage as a true one, and the husband knows that the witnesses were false ones, then there is no harm for him to consummate his marriage with her and the marriage is regarded as valid
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ek kunwaari ki shaadi tab tak nahi honi chaahiye jab tak uski raazamandi na maangi jaaye; aur biwaa ki shaadi tab tak nahi honi chaahiye jab tak usse na poocha jaaye ke wo shaadi ke liye raazi hai ya nahi.' Pucha gaya, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Wo (kunwaari) apni raazamandi kaise zaahir karegi?' Unhone kaha, 'Khaamosh rehkar.' Kuch logon ne kaha ke agar ek kunwaari se uski raazamandi na maangi jaaye aur uski shaadi na ki jaaye, aur phir ek aadmi, chaal khelte hue, do jhoothe gawaah pesh kare ke usne uski raazamandi se shaadi ki hai aur qaazi uski shaadi ko sachi maankar tasdeeq kar de, aur shohar ko pata ho ke gawaah jhoote the, to unke liye us shaadi ko poora karne mein koi harj nahi, aur shaadi valid maani jaayegi.

e: Narrated Al-Qasim:A woman from the offspring of Ja`far was afraid lest her guardian marry her (to somebody) against her will. So she sent for two elderly men from the Ansar, `AbdurRahman and Mujammi', the two sons of Jariya, and they said to her, "Don't be afraid, for Khansa' bint Khidam was given by her father in marriage against her will, then the Prophet (ﷺ) cancelled that marriage." (See Hadith No)
hi: Al-Qasim bataate hain: Ja'far ki aulaad mein se ek khaatoon ko dar tha ke unka sarparast unki marzi ke khilaaf unki shaadi kara dega. To unhone Ansaar ke do boodhe aadmiyon, Abdur Rahman aur Mujammi', jo Jariya ke bete the, ko bulwaaya, aur unhone unse kaha, 'Dar mat lo, kyunke Khansa bint Khidam ko unke waalid ne unki marzi ke khilaaf shaadi kara di thi, magar phir Nabi (SAW) ne wo shaadi rad kar di.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees dekhein.)

e: Narrated Abu Haraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "A lady slave should not be given in marriage until she is consulted, and a virgin should not be given in marriage until her permission is granted." The people said, "How will she express her permission?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "By keeping silent (when asked her consent)." Some people said, "If a man, by playing a trick, presents two false witnesses before the judge to testify that he has married a matron with her consent and the judge confirms his marriage, and the husband is sure that he has never married her (before), then such a marriage will be considered as a legal one and he may live with her as husband
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ek launDi ki shaadi tab tak nahi honi chaahiye jab tak unse salaah na li jaaye, aur ek kunwaari ki shaadi tab tak nahi honi chaahiye jab tak unki ijaazat na li jaaye.' Logon ne kaha, 'Wo apni ijaazat kaise zaahir karegi?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Khaamosh rehkar (jab unse raazamandi poochi jaaye).' Kuch logon ne kaha, 'Agar koi aadmi, chaal se, qaazi ke saamne do jhoote gawaah pesh kare ye gawaahi dene ke liye ke usne kisi biwaa khaatoon se uski raazamandi se shaadi ki hai aur qaazi uski shaadi ko sacha maan le, aur shohar ko yaqeen ho ke usne (unse) kabhi shaadi nahi ki thi (pehle), to aisi shaadi jaayez maani jaayegi aur wo unke saath shauhar ki tarah reh sakta hai.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "It is essential to have the consent of a virgin (for the marriage). I said, "A virgin feels shy." The Prophet; said, "Her silence means her consent." Some people said, "If a man falls in love with an orphan slave girl or a virgin and she refuses (him) and then he makes a trick by bringing two false witnesses to testify that he has married her, and then she attains the age of puberty and agrees to marry him and the judge accepts the false witness and the husband knows that the witnesses were false ones, he may consummate his marriage
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ek kunwaari ki raazamandi lena zaroori hai (shaadi ke liye).' Maine kaha, 'Ek kunwaari sharmindaa ho jaati hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Uski khaamoshi hi uski raazamandi hai.' Kuch logon ne kaha, 'Agar koi aadmi kisi yateem launDi ya kunwaari se mohabbat kar baithe aur wo inkaar kare, aur phir wo chaal se do jhoote gawaah laaye gawaahi dene ke liye ke usne unse shaadi ki hai, aur phir wo baaligh ho jaaye aur usse shaadi karne ke liye raazi ho jaaye aur qaazi jhooti gawaahi qubool kar le aur shohar ko pata ho ke gawaah jhoote the, to wo shaadi mukammal kar sakta hai.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to like sweets and also used to like honey, and whenever he finished the `Asr prayer, he used to visit his wives and stay with them. Once he visited Hafsa and remained with her longer than the period he used to stay, so I enquired about it. It was said to me, "A woman from her tribe gave her a leather skin containing honey as a present, and she gave some of it to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to drink." I said, "By Allah, we will play a trick on him." So I mentioned the story to Sauda (the wife of the Prophet) and said to her, "When he enters upon you, he will come near to you whereupon you should say to him, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Have you eaten Maghafir?' He will say, 'No.' Then you say to him, 'What is this bad smell? ' And it would be very hard on Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that a bad smell should be found on his body. He will say, 'Hafsa has given me a drink of honey.' Then you should say to him, 'Its bees must have sucked from the Al-`Urfut (a foul smelling flower).' I too, will tell him the same. And you, O Saifya, say the same." So when the Prophet (ﷺ) entered upon Sauda (the following happened). Sauda said, "By Him except Whom none has the right to be worshipped, I was about to say to him what you had told me to say while he was still at the gate because of fear from you. But when Allah's Apostle came near to me, I said to him, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Have you eaten Maghafir?' He replied, 'No.' I said, 'What about this smell?' He said, 'Hafsa has given me a drink of honey.' I said, 'Its bees must have sucked Al-`Urfut.' " When he entered upon me, I told him the same as that, and when he entered upon Safiya, she too told him the same. So when he visited Hafsa again, she said to him, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shall I give you a drink of it (honey)?" He said, "I have no desire for it." Sauda said, Subhan Allah! We have deprived him of it (honey)." I said to her, "Be quiet
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko meethi cheezein pasand thin aur unhein shehad bhi pasand tha, aur jab bhi wo Asr ki namaz khatam karte, wo apni biwiyon se milne jaate aur unke saath waqt guzaarte. Ek baar wo Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas gaye aur wahaan apne aam waqt se zyaada der reh gaye, isliye maine iske baare mein pucha. Mujhe bataya gaya, 'Unke qabeele ki ek khaatoon ne unhein shehad se bhari ek chamde ki thaili tohfe mein di, aur unhone usme se kuch Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko peene ko diya.' Maine kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, hum unke saath ek chaal khelenge.' To maine ye kahaani Sauda (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki biwi) ko bataayi aur unse kaha, 'Jab wo tumhaare paas aayenge, wo tumhaare qareeb aayenge, isper tumhein unse kehna chaahiye, "Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya aapne Maghafir khaayi?" Wo kahenge, "Nahi." Phir tum unse kehna, "Ye kaisi buri khushbu hai?" Aur ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko bahut naagawaar guzrega ke unke jism par koi buri khushbu ho. Wo kahenge, "Hafsa ne mujhe shehad ka sharbat diya." Phir tum kehna, "Iski makhiyon ne zaroor Al-Urfut (ek badbudaar khushbu wala phool) chusaa hoga." Main bhi unhein yahi kahungi. Aur tum, Aye Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا), tum bhi yahi kehna.' To jab Nabi (SAW) Sauda ke paas gaye (ye hua): Sauda ne kaha, 'Us Zaat ki qasam jiske siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi, main unhein wahi kehne wali thi jo tumne mujhse kehne ko kaha tha jab wo abhi darwaaze par the, tumhaare dar ki wajah se. Magar jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mere qareeb aaye, maine unse kaha, "Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya aapne Maghafir khaayi?" Unhone jawab diya, "Nahi." Maine kaha, "Ye khushbu kaisi hai?" Unhone kaha, "Hafsa ne mujhe shehad ka sharbat diya." Maine kaha, "Iski makhiyon ne zaroor Al-Urfut chusaa hoga."' Jab wo mere paas aaye, maine unhein wahi bataaya, aur jab wo Safiya ke paas gaye, unhone bhi unhein wahi bataaya. To jab wo dobara Hafsa se milne gaye, unhone unse kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya main aapko isme se (shehad) sharbat pilaaun?' Unhone kaha, 'Mujhe uski khwaahish nahi.' Sauda ne kaha, 'Subhan Allah! Humne unhein isse mehroom kar diya.' Maine unse kaha, 'Chup raho.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin 'Amir bin Rabi`a:`Umar bin Al-Khattab left for Sham, and when he reached a placed called Sargh, he came to know that there was an outbreak of an epidemic (of plague) in Sham. Then `AbdurRahman bin `Auf told him that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If you hear the news of an outbreak of an epidemic (plague) in a certain place, do not enter that place: and if the epidemic falls in a place while you are present in it, do not leave that place to escape from the epidemic." So `Umar returned from Sargh
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amir bin Rabi'a bataate hain: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab Sham ki taraf nikle, aur jab wo Sargh naami jagah pahunche, unhein pata chala ke Sham mein ek mahamaari (plague) phaili hui hai. Phir Abdur Rahman bin Auf (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne unhein bataaya ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha tha, 'Agar tum kisi jagah mein mahamaari phailne ki khabar suno, to us jagah mein daakhil mat ho; aur agar mahamaari kisi jagah mein phail jaaye jabke tum wahaan maujood ho, to us jagah ko chhodkar mahamaari se bhaagne ke liye mat jaao.' To Umar Sargh se wapas laut aaye.

e: Narrated 'Amir bin Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas:That he heard Usama bin Zaid speaking to Sa`d, saying, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) mentioned the plague and said, 'It is a means of punishment with which some nations were punished and some of it has remained, and it appears now and then. So whoever hears that there is an outbreak of plague in some land, he should not go to that land, and if the plague breaks out in the land where one is already present, one should not run away from that land, escaping from the plague
hi: Amir bin Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke unhone Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko Sa'd se ye baat karte suna: 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mahamaari (plague) ka zikr kiya aur kaha, "Ye ek saza ka zariya hai jise Allah ne kuch ummaton ko saza dene ke liye bheja, aur uska kuch hissa baaqi rehta hai, aur wo kabhi-kabhi zaahir hota hai. Isliye jo koi sune ke kisi zameen mein mahamaari phail rahi hai, use us zameen mein nahi jaana chaahiye, aur agar mahamaari us zameen mein phail jaaye jahaan koi pehle se maujood ho, use us zameen ko chhod kar mahamaari se bhaagna nahi chaahiye."'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The one who takes back his gift is like a dog swallowing its own vomit, and we (believers) should not act according to this bad example
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi apna diya hua tohfa wapas leta hai, wo us kutte jaisa hai jo apni khud ki qai nigal leta hai, aur hum (Momineen) ko is bure misaal ke mutaabik amal nahi karna chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) has decreed that preemption is valid in all cases where the real estate concerned has not been divided, but if the boundaries are established and the ways are made, then there is no preemption. A man said, "Preemption is only for the neighbor," and then he makes invalid what he has confirmed. He said, "If someone wants to buy a house and being afraid that the neighbor (of the house) may buy it through preemption, he buys one share out of one hundred shares of the house and then buys the rest of the house, then the neighbor can only have the right of preemption for the first share but not for the rest of the house; and the buyer may play such a trick in this case
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne faisla diya ke Shufa'a (preemption ka haq) sab maamlon mein jaayez hai jahaan asal jaayadaad taqseem nahi hui hai, magar agar seemaayen (boundaries) muqarrar ho chuki hain aur raaste bana diye gaye hain, to phir Shufa'a nahi hai. Ek shaks ne kaha, 'Shufa'a sirf padosi ke liye hai,' aur phir unhone jo tasdeeq ki thi use na-jaayez qaraar de diya. Unhone kaha, 'Agar koi ghar khareedna chahta hai aur use dar hai ke padosi Shufa'a ke zariye use khareed lega, to wo ghar ke sau hisson mein se ek hissa khareedta hai, aur phir baaki ghar khareedta hai; to padosi ko sirf pehle hisse ke liye Shufa'a ka haq hoga, baaki ghar ke liye nahi; aur khareedar aisi chaal is maamle mein chal sakta hai.'

e: Narrated 'Amr bin Ash-Sharid: Al-Miswar bin Makhrama came and put his hand on my shoulder and I accompanied him to Sa'd. Abu Rafi' said to Al-Miswar, "Won't you order this (i.e. Sa'd) to buy my house which is in my yard?" Sa'd said, "I will not offer more than four hundred in installments over a fixed period." Abu Rafi said, "I was offered five hundred cash but I refused. Had I not heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, 'A neighbor is more entitled to receive the care of his neighbor,' I would not have sold it to you." The narrator said, to Sufyan: Ma'mar did not say so. Sufyan said, "But he did say so to me." Some people said, "If someone wants to sell a house and deprived somebody of the right of preemption, he has the right to play a trick to render the preemption invalid. And that is by giving the house to the buyer as a present and marking its boundaries and giving it to him. The buyer then gives the seller one-thousand Dirham as compensation in which case the preemptor loses his right of preemption
hi: Amr bin Ash-Sharid bataate hain: Al-Miswar bin Makhrama (رضی اللہ عنہ) aaye aur unhone apna haath mere kandhe par rakha aur main unke saath Sa'd ke paas gaya. Abu Rafi (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Al-Miswar se kaha, 'Kya aap ise (Sa'd ko) hukm nahi denge ke wo mera ghar khareed le jo mere aangan mein hai?' Sa'd ne kaha, 'Main isse zyaada nahi doonga chaar sau (Dirham) qiston mein, ek muqarrar muddat mein.' Abu Rafi ne kaha, 'Mujhe paanch sau naqad (cash) diye ja rahe the magar maine inkaar kiya. Agar maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye kehte na suna hota, "Padosi apne padosi ki dekhbhaal paane ka zyaada haqdaar hai," to main ise aapko na becha hota.' Ravi ne Sufyan se kaha: Ma'mar ne aisa nahi kaha. Sufyan ne kaha, 'Magar unhone mujhse aisa kaha.' Kuch logon ne kaha, 'Agar koi ghar bechna chahta hai aur kisi ko Shufa'a ke haq se mehroom karna chahta hai, use ye haq hai ke wo chaal chale Shufa'a ko na-jaayez banane ke liye. Aur ye ghar khareedar ko tohfe mein dekar aur uski seemaayen nishaan-zad karke aur use dekar kiya jaata hai. Phir khareedar bechne wale ko ek hazaar Dirham muawaje mein deta hai, jisper Shufa'a ka haqdaar apna haq kho deta hai.'

e: Narrated 'Amr bin Ash-Sharid: Abu Rafi' said that Sa'd offered him four hundred Mithqal of gold for a house. Abu Rafi ' said, "If I had not heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, 'A neighbor has more right to be taken care of by his neighbor,' then I would not have given it to you." Some people said, "If one has bought a portion of a house and wants to cancel the right of preemption, he may give it as a present to his little son and he will not be obliged to take an oath
hi: Amr bin Ash-Sharid bataate hain: Abu Rafi (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha ke Sa'd ne unhein ek ghar ke liye chaar sau Mithqal sona pesh kiya. Abu Rafi ne kaha, 'Agar maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte na suna hota, "Padosi apne padosi ki dekhbhaal paane ka zyaada haqdaar hai," to main ye aapko na deta.' Kuch logon ne kaha, 'Agar kisi ne ghar ka ek hissa khareeda hai aur Shufa'a ke haq ko rad karna chahta hai, wo ise apne chhote bete ko tohfe mein de sakta hai aur use qasam khaane ki zaroorat nahi hogi.'

e: Narrated Abu Humaid As-Sa`idi:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) appointed a man called Ibn Al-Lutabiyya to collect the Zakat from Bani Sulaim's tribe. When he returned, the Prophet (ﷺ) called him to account. He said (to the Prophet, 'This is your money, and this has been given to me as a gift." On that, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Why didn't you stay in your father's and mother's house to see whether you will be given gifts or not if you are telling the truth?" Then the Prophet (ﷺ) addressed us, and after praising and glorifying Allah, he said: "Amma Ba'du", I employ a man from among you to manage some affair of what Allah has put under my custody, and then he comes to me and says, 'This is your money and this has been given to me as a gift. Why didn't he stay in his father's and mother's home to see whether he will be given gifts or not? By Allah, not anyone of you takes a thing unlawfully but he will meet Allah on the Day of Resurrection, carrying that thing. I do not want to see any of you carrying a grunting camel or a mooing cow or a bleating sheep on meeting Allah." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) raised both his hands till the whiteness of his armpits became visible, and he said, "O Allah! Haven't I have conveyed (Your Message)?" The narrator added: My eyes witnessed and my ears heard (that Hadith)
hi: Abu Humaid As-Sa'idi bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ibn Al-Lutabiyya naami ek shaks ko Banu Sulaim qabeele se Zakat jama karne ke liye muqarrar kiya. Jab wo wapas aaya, Nabi (SAW) ne unse hisaab maanga. Usne (Nabi se) kaha, 'Ye aapka paisa hai, aur ye mujhe tohfe mein diya gaya hai.' Isper, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Tum apne waalid ya apni maa ke ghar kyun nahi rahe ye dekhne ke liye ke tumhein tohfe milte hain ya nahi, agar tum sach kehte ho?' Phir Nabi (SAW) ne humse khitaab kiya, aur Allah ki tareef aur hamd karne ke baad, unhone kaha: 'Amma Ba'du,' 'Main tum mein se ek aadmi ko kisi kaam ki zimmedaari deta hoon jo Allah ne mere sapurd kiya hai, aur phir wo mere paas aakar kehta hai, "Ye aapka paisa hai aur ye mujhe tohfe mein diya gaya hai." Wo apne waalid ya apni maa ke ghar kyun nahi raha ye dekhne ke liye ke use tohfe milte hain ya nahi? Allah ki qasam, tum mein se koi bhi koi cheez na-jaayez taur par nahi leta magar wo use Qayamat ke din Allah ke saamne uthaakar laayega. Main nahi chaahta ke tum mein se koi bhi Allah se mulaaqaat karte waqt ek bulbulaata hua oont, ya raambhati hui gaay, ya bhen-bhenaati bakri uthaaye ho.' Phir Nabi (SAW) ne apne dono haath itne ooncha uthaaye ke unki baaghal ki safedi zaahir ho gayi, aur unhone kaha, 'Aye Allah! Kya maine (tera paighaam) pahuncha diya?' Ravi ne izaafa kiya: Meri aankhon ne dekha aur mere kaanon ne suna (ye Hadees).

e: Narrated Abu Rafi`:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The neighbor has more right to be taken care of by his neighbor (than anyone else)." Some men said, "If one wants to buy a house for 20,000 Dirhams then there is no harm to play a trick to deprive somebody of preemption by buying it (just on paper) with 20,000 Dirhams but paying to the seller only 9,999 Dirhams in cash and then agree with the seller to pay only one Dinar in cash for the rest of the price (i.e. 10,001 Dirhams). If the preemptor offers 20,000 Dirhams for the house, he can buy it otherwise he has no right to buy it (by this trick he got out of preemption). If the house proves to belong to somebody else other than the seller, the buyer should take back from the seller what he has paid, i.e., 9,999 Dirhams and one Dinar, because if the house proves to belong to somebody else, so the whole bargain (deal) is unlawful. If the buyer finds a defect in the house and it does not belong to somebody other than the seller, the buyer may return it and receive 20,000 Dirhams (instead of 9999 Dirham plus one Dinar) which he actually paid.' Abu `Abdullah said, "So that man allows (some people) the playing of tricks amongst the Muslims (although) the Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'In dealing with Muslims one should not sell them sick (animals) or bad things or stolen things
hi: Abu Rafi (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Padosi apne padosi ki dekhbhaal paane ka (kisi aur se zyaada) haqdaar hai.' Kuch logon ne kaha, 'Agar koi bees hazaar Dirham mein ghar khareedna chahta hai, to Shufa'a ke haqdaar ko is haq se mehroom karne ke liye chaal chalne mein koi harj nahi, use bees hazaar Dirham mein (kaagaz par) khareedkar magar bechne wale ko sirf nau hazaar nau sau ninety-nine Dirham naqad dekar, aur phir bechne wale ke saath tay karke ke baaqi keemat (yaani das hazaar ek Dirham) ke liye sirf ek Dinar naqad diya jaaye. Agar Shufa'a ka haqdaar bees hazaar Dirham pesh karta hai us ghar ke liye, to wo use khareed sakta hai, warna use (is chaal se) khareedne ka haq nahi hoga. Agar ghar kisi aur ka nikle bechne wale ke ilaawa, to khareedar ko bechne wale se apna diya hua wapas lena chaahiye, yaani nau hazaar nau sau ninety-nine Dirham aur ek Dinar, kyunke agar ghar kisi aur ka nikla, to poora sauda na-jaayez hai. Agar khareedar ko ghar mein koi kami mile aur ghar bechne wale ke ilaawa kisi aur ka na ho, to khareedar use wapas kar sakta hai aur bees hazaar Dirham (nau hazaar nau sau ninety-nine Dirham aur ek Dinar ki bajaaye) wapas le sakta hai jo usne asal mein diye the.' Abu Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'To ye aadmi Musalmaanon ke beech aisi chaalon ki ijaazat deta hai, (halaanke) Nabi (SAW) ne kaha tha, "Musalmaanon ke saath vyavahaar mein, unhein bimar (jaanwar) ya buri cheezein ya chori ki hui cheezein nahi bechni chaahiye."'

e: Narrated `Amr bin Ash-Sharid:Abu Rafi` sold a house to Sa`d bin Malik for four-hundred Mithqal of gold, and said, "If I had not heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, 'The neighbor has more right to be taken care of by his neighbor (than anyone else),' then I would not have sold it to you
hi: Amr bin Ash-Sharid bataate hain: Abu Rafi (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Sa'd bin Malik ko ek ghar chaar sau Mithqal sona mein becha, aur kaha, 'Agar maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye kehte na suna hota, "Padosi apne padosi ki dekhbhaal paane ka zyaada haqdaar hai," to main ye aapko na becha hota.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The commencement of the Divine Inspiration to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was in the form of good righteous (true) dreams in his sleep. He never had a dream but that it came true like bright day light. He used to go in seclusion (the cave of) Hira where he used to worship(Allah Alone) continuously for many (days) nights. He used to take with him the journey food for that (stay) and then come back to (his wife) Khadija to take his food like-wise again for another period to stay, till suddenly the Truth descended upon him while he was in the cave of Hira. The angel came to him in it and asked him to read. The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "I do not know how to read." (The Prophet (ﷺ) added), "The angel caught me (forcefully) and pressed me so hard that I could not bear it anymore. He then released me and again asked me to read, and I replied, "I do not know how to read," whereupon he caught me again and pressed me a second time till I could not bear it anymore. He then released me and asked me again to read, but again I replied, "I do not know how to read (or, what shall I read?)." Thereupon he caught me for the third time and pressed me and then released me and said, "Read: In the Name of your Lord, Who has created (all that exists). Has created man from a clot. Read and Your Lord is Most Generous...up to..... ..that which he knew not." (96.15) Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) returned with the Inspiration, his neck muscles twitching with terror till he entered upon Khadija and said, "Cover me! Cover me!" They covered him till his fear was over and then he said, "O Khadija, what is wrong with me?" Then he told her everything that had happened and said, 'I fear that something may happen to me." Khadija said, 'Never! But have the glad tidings, for by Allah, Allah will never disgrace you as you keep good reactions with your Kith and kin, speak the truth, help the poor and the destitute, serve your guest generously and assist the deserving, calamityafflicted ones." Khadija then accompanied him to (her cousin) Waraqa bin Naufal bin Asad bin `Abdul `Uzza bin Qusai. Waraqa was the son of her paternal uncle, i.e., her father's brother, who during the Pre-Islamic Period became a Christian and used to write the Arabic writing and used to write of the Gospels in Arabic as much as Allah wished him to write. He was an old man and had lost his eyesight. Khadija said to him, "O my cousin! Listen to the story of your nephew." Waraqa asked, "O my nephew! What have you seen?" The Prophet (ﷺ) described whatever he had seen. Waraqa said, "This is the same Namus (i.e., Gabriel, the Angel who keeps the secrets) whom Allah had sent to Moses. I wish I were young and could live up to the time when your people would turn you out." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked, "Will they turn me out?" Waraqa replied in the affirmative and said: "Never did a man come with something similar to what you have brought but was treated with hostility. If I should remain alive till the day when you will be turned out then I would support you strongly." But after a few days Waraqa died and the Divine Inspiration was also paused for a while and the Prophet (ﷺ) became so sad as we have heard that he intended several times to throw himself from the tops of high mountains and every time he went up the top of a mountain in order to throw himself down, Gabriel would appear before him and say, "O Muhammad! You are indeed Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in truth" whereupon his heart would become quiet and he would calm down and would return home. And whenever the period of the coming of the inspiration used to become long, he would do as before, but when he used to reach the top of a mountain, Gabriel would appear before him and say to him what he had said before. (Ibn `Abbas said regarding the meaning of: 'He it is that Cleaves the daybreak (from the darkness)' (6.96) that Al-Asbah. means the light of the sun during the day and the light of the moon at night
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) par Ilaahi Wahi ki shuruaat neik, sacche khwaabon ki shakl mein hui unki neend mein. Unhein kabhi koi khwaab nahi aaya jo sach na nikla ho, waise hi jaise din ki roshni saaf hoti hai. Wo Hira (ki gufaa) mein tanhaai mein jaate the jahaan wo kayi raaton tak (akele) Allah ki ibaadat karte the. Wo apne saath us waqt ke liye khaana le jaate the aur phir Khadija (رضی اللہ عنہا) (apni biwi) ke paas wapas aate isi tarah ka khaana dobara lene doosri baar rukne ke liye, yahaan tak ke achaanak, jab wo Hira ki gufaa mein the, unpar Haqq utra. Farishta unke paas aaya aur unhein padhne ko kaha. Nabi (SAW) ne jawab diya, 'Mujhe padhna nahi aata.' (Nabi SAW ne izaafa kiya:) 'Farishte ne mujhe (zabardasti) pakda aur mujhe itni zoro se daba diya ke main aur bardaasht nahi kar saka. Phir usne mujhe chhoda aur dobara padhne ko kaha, aur maine jawab diya, "Mujhe padhna nahi aata," isper usne mujhe dobara pakda aur mujhe doosri baar daba diya yahaan tak ke main aur bardaasht nahi kar saka. Phir usne mujhe chhoda aur dobara padhne ko kaha, magar dobara maine jawab diya, "Mujhe padhna nahi aata (ya, main kya padhun?)." Isper usne mujhe teesri baar pakda aur daba diya aur phir chhoda aur kaha, "Padho: Apne Rab ke naam se jisne (har cheez) banaayi. Insaan ko ek juda hue khoon (clot) se banaaya. Padho! Aur tera Rab bahut Karam waala hai...(jab tak)...jo wo nahi jaanta tha." (96:1-5) Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) is Wahi ke saath wapas aaye, unki gardan ki maasapeshiyaan dahshat se kaanp rahi thin yahaan tak ke wo Khadija ke paas pahunche aur kaha, "Mujhe dhaanko! Mujhe dhaanko!" Unhone unhein dhaanka jab tak unka khauf khatam nahi hua, aur phir unhone kaha, "Aye Khadija, mujhe kya hua hai?" Phir unhone use sab kuch bataaya jo hua tha aur kaha, "Mujhe dar hai ke mujhe kuch ho na jaaye." Khadija ne kaha, "Kabhi nahi! Balke khush-khabri lijiye, kyunke Allah ki qasam, Allah aapko kabhi zaleel nahi karega, kyunke aap apne rishtedaaron ke saath achhe rishte rakhte hain, sach bolte hain, gareebon aur be-sahaaron ki madad karte hain, apne mehmaan ki fraakh-dili se khidmat karte hain, aur haqdaar, museebat-zada logon ki madad karte hain." Khadija phir unhein apne chachazaad Waraqa bin Naufal bin Asad bin Abdul Uzza bin Qusai ke paas le gayi. Waraqa unke chacha (waalid ke bhai) ke bete the, jo Jaahiliyat (Islam se pehle) ke daur mein Isaai ban gaye the aur Arabi likhaai likhte the aur Injeel ka jitna Allah chahta utna Arabi mein likhte the. Wo ek boodhe aadmi the jinki nazar chali gayi thi. Khadija ne unse kaha, "Aye mere chachazaad! Apne bhatije ki kahaani suniye." Waraqa ne pucha, "Aye mere bhatije! Aapne kya dekha?" Nabi (SAW) ne jo bhi unhone dekha tha wo bataaya. Waraqa ne kaha, "Ye wahi Namus (yaani Jibrael, raazon ka rakhwaala farishta) hai jise Allah ne Musa ke paas bheja tha. Kaash main jawaan hota aur us waqt tak zinda rehta jab aapki qaum aapko nikaal degi." Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne pucha, "Kya wo mujhe nikaalenge?" Waraqa ne haan mein jawab diya aur kaha: "Koi bhi aadmi kabhi wo laaya nahi jo aap laaye hain magar usse dushmani ki gayi. Agar main us din tak zinda rahoon jab aapko nikaala jaayega, to main aapki poori madad karunga." Magar kuch dinon baad Waraqa ka intekaal ho gaya aur Ilaahi Wahi bhi kuch waqt ke liye thami rahi aur Nabi (SAW) itne gamgeen ho gaye ke, jaisa humne suna hai, unhone kayi baar khud ko ooche pahaadon ki chotiyon se phenkne ka iraada kiya, aur har baar jab wo pahaad ki chotii par jaate khud ko neeche phenkne ke liye, Jibrael unke saamne aate aur kehte, "Aye Muhammad! Aap waaqai Allah ke sacche Rasool hain," isper unka dil sukoon paata aur wo shaant ho jaate aur ghar wapas laut aate. Aur jab bhi Wahi aane ka waqfa lamba ho jaata, wo wahi karte jo pehle karte the, magar jab wo pahaad ki chotii par pahunchte, Jibrael unke saamne aate aur unhein wahi kehte jo pehle kaha tha. (Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne is Aayat ke matlab ke baare mein kaha: 'Wo hai jo pau (subah) ko andhere se juda karta hai' (6:96) ke Al-Asbah ka matlab hai din mein suraj ki roshni aur raat mein chaand ki roshni.)

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "A good dream (that comes true) of a righteous man is one of forty-six parts of prophetism
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ek neik shaks ka achha khwaab (jo sach nikle) Nabuwwat ke chaalis-chhe (46) hisson mein se ek hissa hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Qatada:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A true good dream is from Allah, and a bad dream is from Satan
hi: Abu Qatada (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ek sachcha achha khwaab Allah ki taraf se hota hai, aur ek bura khwaab Shaitaan ki taraf se hota hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If anyone of you sees a dream that he likes, then it is from Allah, and he should thank Allah for it and narrate it to others; but if he sees something else, i.e., a dream that he dislikes, then it is from Satan, and he should seek refuge with Allah from its evil, and he should not mention it to anybody, for it will not harm him
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar tum mein se koi aisa khwaab dekhe jo use pasand aaye, to wo Allah ki taraf se hai, aur use Allah ka shukr adaa karna chaahiye aur doosron ko sunaana chaahiye; magar agar wo kuch aur dekhe, yaani ek aisa khwaab jo use napasand ho, to wo Shaitaan ki taraf se hai, aur use uski buraai se Allah ki panaah maangni chaahiye, aur use kisi ko nahi bataana chaahiye, kyunke isse use koi nuqsaan nahi hoga.'

e: Narrated Abu Qatada:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A good dream that comes true is from Allah, and a bad dream is from Satan, so if anyone of you sees a bad dream, he should seek refuge with Allah from Satan and should spit on the left, for the bad dream will not harm him
hi: Abu Qatada (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ek sachcha achha khwaab Allah ki taraf se hai, aur ek bura khwaab Shaitaan ki taraf se hai, isliye agar tum mein se koi bura khwaab dekhe, use Shaitaan se Allah ki panaah maangni chaahiye aur apni baayi taraf thookna chaahiye, kyunke bura khwaab use nuqsaan nahi pahunchaayega.'

e: Narrated 'Ubada bin As-Samit:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The (good) dreams of a faithful believer is a part of the forty-six parts of prophetism:
hi: Ubada bin As-Samit bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ek sacche Momin ke (achhe) khwaab Nabuwwat ke chaalis-chhe hisson mein se ek hissa hain.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The (good) dream of a faithful believer is a part of the forty-six parts of prophetism
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ek sacche Momin ka (achha) khwaab Nabuwwat ke chaalis-chhe hisson mein se ek hissa hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "A good dream is a part of the forty six parts of prophetism
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, 'Ek achha khwaab Nabuwwat ke chaalis-chhe hisson mein se ek hissa hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "Nothing is left of the prophetism except Al-Mubashshirat." They asked, "What are Al-Mubashshirat?" He replied, "The true good dreams (that conveys glad tidings)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, 'Nabuwwat mein se kuch bhi baaqi nahi bacha siwaaye Al-Mubashshirat ke.' Unhone (logon ne) pucha, 'Al-Mubashshirat kya hain?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Sacche achhe khwaab (jo khush-khabri dete hain).'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Some people were shown the Night of Qadr as being in the last seven days (of the month of Ramadan). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Seek it in the last seven days (of Ramadan)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Kuch logon ko Lailat-ul-Qadr Ramzan ke aakhri saat dinon mein dikhaayi gayi (khwaab mein). Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Ise Ramzan ke aakhri saat dinon mein dhoondho.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If I stayed in prison as long as Joseph stayed and then the messenger came, I would respond to his call (to go out of the prison)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar main utni der jail mein rehta jitni Yusuf (Nabi) rahe the, aur phir qaasid aata, to main uski pukaar ka jawab deta (aur jail se baahar nikal jaata).'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Whoever sees me in a dream will see me in his wakefulness, and Satan cannot imitate me in shape." Abu `Abdullah said, "Ibn Seereen said, 'Only if he sees the Prophet (ﷺ) in his (real) shape
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, 'Jo koi mujhe khwaab mein dekhe, wo mujhe apni jaagti aankhon mein bhi dekhega, aur Shaitaan meri shakl nahi le sakta.' Abu Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) kehte hain, 'Ibn Seereen ne kaha, "Sirf tab jab wo Nabi (SAW) ko unki asal shakl mein dekhe."'

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever has seen me in a dream, then no doubt, he has seen me, for Satan cannot imitate my shape
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi mujhe khwaab mein dekh chuka ho, use beshak, mujhe hi dekha hai, kyunke Shaitaan meri shakl nahi le sakta.'

e: Narrated Abu Qatada:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A good dream is from Allah, and a bad dream is from Satan. So whoever has seen (in a dream) something he dislikes, then he should spit without saliva, thrice on his left and seek refuge with Allah from Satan, for it will not harm him, and Satan cannot appear in my shape
hi: Abu Qatada (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ek achha khwaab Allah ki taraf se hai, aur ek bura khwaab Shaitaan ki taraf se hai. Isliye jo koi (khwaab mein) kuch aisa dekhe jo use napasand ho, use bina thook ke, teen baar apni baayi taraf thookna chaahiye aur Shaitaan se Allah ki panaah maangni chaahiye, kyunke isse use koi nuqsaan nahi hoga, aur Shaitaan meri shakl mein zaahir nahi ho sakta.'

e: Narrated Abu Qatada:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever sees me (in a dream) then he indeed has seen the truth
hi: Abu Qatada (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi mujhe (khwaab mein) dekhe, wo waaqai Haq dekh chuka hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Who ever sees me (in a dream) then he indeed has seen the truth, as Satan cannot appear in my shape
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi mujhe (khwaab mein) dekhe, wo waaqai Haq dekh chuka hai, kyunke Shaitaan meri shakl mein zaahir nahi ho sakta.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I have been given the keys of eloquent speech and given victory with awe (cast into the hearts of the enemy), and while I was sleeping last night, the keys of the treasures of the earth were brought to me till they were put in my hand." Abu Huraira added: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) left (this world) and now you people are carrying those treasures from place to place
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Mujhe fasaahat (khubsoorat baat karne) ki chaabiyaan di gayi hain, aur mujhe jeet di gayi hai dahshat (dushman ke dilon mein daali gayi khauf) ke saath, aur kal raat jab main so raha tha, zameen ke khazaanon ki chaabiyaan mere paas laayi gayi yahaan tak ke unhein mere haath mein rakh diya gaya.' Abu Huraira ne izaafa kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) (is duniya se) chale gaye aur ab tum log un khazaanon ko ek jagah se doosri jagah le jaa rahe ho.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I saw myself (in a dream) near the Ka`ba last night, and I saw a man with whitish red complexion, the best you may see amongst men of that complexion having long hair reaching his earlobes which was the best hair of its sort, and he had combed his hair and water was dropping from it, and he was performing the Tawaf around the Ka`ba while he was leaning on two men or on the shoulders of two men. I asked, 'Who is this man?' Somebody replied, '(He is) Messiah, son of Mary.' Then I saw another man with very curly hair, blind in the right eye which looked like a protruding out grape. I asked, 'Who is this?' Somebody replied, '(He is) Messiah, Ad-Dajjal
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kal raat maine apne aap ko (khwaab mein) Kaaba ke qareeb dekha, aur maine ek aisi shakl waale aadmi ko dekha jinki rangat safed aur laal thi, is rangat waale mardon mein sabse behtareen, jinke lambe baal unke kaan ki laav tak pahunchte the, jo apni tarah ke sabse behtareen baal the, aur unhone apne baal kanghi kiye the, aur unse paani tapak raha tha, aur wo Kaaba ka Tawaf kar rahe the jabke wo do aadmiyon par ya do aadmiyon ke kandhon par tek lagaaye hue the. Maine pucha, "Ye kaun hai?" Kisi ne jawab diya, "(Ye) Maseeh, Maryam ke bete, hain." Phir maine ek doosre aadmi ko dekha, jinke baal bahut ghungrale the, aur unki daayi aankh andhi thi jo ek uphari hui angoor jaisi dikhti thi. Maine pucha, "Ye kaun hai?" Kisi ne jawab diya, "(Ye) Maseeh, Ad-Dajjal, hain."'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:About a man who came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "I was shown in a dream last night..." Then Ibn `Abbas mentioned the narration
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain (ek aadmi ke baare mein jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Kal raat mujhe ek khwaab dikhaaya gaya...'). Phir Ibn Abbas ne poori riwaayat bayaan ki.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to visit Um Haram bint Milhan she was the wife of 'Ubada bin As-Samit. One day the Prophet (ﷺ) visited her and she provided him with food and started looking for lice in his head. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) slept and afterwards woke up smiling. Um Haram asked, "What makes you smile, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" He said, "Some of my followers were presented before me in my dream as fighters in Allah's Cause, sailing in the middle of the seas like kings on the thrones or like kings sitting on their thrones." (The narrator 'Is-haq is not sure as to which expression was correct). Um Haram added, 'I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Invoke Allah, to make me one of them;" So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) invoked Allah for her and then laid his head down (and slept). Then he woke up smiling (again). (Um Haram added): I said, "What makes you smile, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" He said, "Some people of my followers were presented before me (in a dream) as fighters in Allah's Cause." He said the same as he had said before. I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Invoke Allah to make me from them." He said, "You are among the first ones." Then Um Haram sailed over the sea during the Caliphate of Muawiya bin Abu Sufyan, and she fell down from her riding animal after coming ashore, and died
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Umm Haram (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Milhan se milne jaate the, jo Ubada bin As-Samit ki biwi thin. Ek din Nabi (SAW) unke paas gaye aur unhone unhein khaana pesh kiya aur unke sar mein jooen dhoondhne lagi. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) so gaye aur baad mein muskuraate hue jaage. Umm Haram ne pucha, 'Aapko kis baat par hansi aayi, Aye Allah ke Rasool?' Unhone kaha, 'Mere maanne walon mein se kuch log mere saamne pesh kiye gaye Allah ki raah mein jaanbaaz banke, samundar ke beech mein safar karte hue, takhton par baithe baadshaahon jaise, ya jaise takhton par baithe baadshaah.' (Ravi Is-haq ko yaqeen nahi kaunsa alfaaz sahi tha.) Umm Haram ne izaafa kiya, 'Maine kaha, "Aye Allah ke Rasool! Allah se dua kijiye ke wo mujhe unmein se ek banaaye." To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unke liye dua ki aur phir apna sar rakh diya (aur so gaye). Phir wo dobara muskuraate hue jaage.' (Umm Haram ne izaafa kiya): Maine kaha, 'Aapko kis baat par hansi aayi, Aye Allah ke Rasool?' Unhone kaha, 'Mere maanne walon mein se kuch log mere saamne pesh kiye gaye (khwaab mein) Allah ki raah mein jaanbaaz banke.' Unhone wahi kaha jo pehle kaha tha. Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Allah se dua kijiye ke wo mujhe unmein se banaaye.' Unhone kaha, 'Tum pehlon mein se ho.' Phir Umm Haram ne Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Sufyan ki khilaafat ke dauraan samundar paar kiya, aur kinaare pahunchne ke baad wo apni sawaari se gir gayi aur unka intekaal ho gaya.

e: Narrated Kharija bin Zaid bin Thabit:Um Al-`Ala an Ansari woman who had given a pledge of allegiance to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) told me:, "The Muhajirln (emigrants) were distributed amongst us by drawing lots, and we got `Uthman bin Maz'un in our share. We made him stay with us in our house. Then he suffered from a disease which proved fatal. When he died and was given a bath and was shrouded in his clothes. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came, I said, (addressing the dead body), 'O Aba As-Sa'ib! May Allah be Merciful to you! I testify that Allah has honored you.' Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'How do you know that Allah has honored him?" I replied, 'Let my father be sacrificed for you, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! On whom else shall Allah bestow. His honor?' Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'As for him, by Allah, death has come to him. By Allah, I wish him all good (from Allah). By Allah, in spite of the fact that I am Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), I do not know what Allah will do to me.", Um Al-`Ala added, "By Allah, I will never attest the righteousness of anybody after that
hi: Kharija bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Thabit (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Umm Al-Ala, ek Ansaari khaatoon jinhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se baiyat li thi, unhone mujhe bataaya: 'Muhaajireen ko chitthi daalkar hamare beech baanta gaya, aur humein Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Maz'un mile. Humne unhein apne ghar mein rehne diya. Phir wo ek bimaari se peedit hue jo aakhir mein jaan-leva saabit hui. Jab unka intekaal hua aur unhein gusl dekar kafan diya gaya, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aaye. Maine kaha (murda jism se khitaab karte hue), "Aye Aba As-Saib! Allah aap par reham kare! Main gawaahi deti hoon ke Allah ne aapko izzat di hai." Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, "Tumhein kaise pata Allah ne unhein izzat di hai?" Maine jawab diya, "Mere waalid aap par qurbaan hon, Aye Allah ke Rasool! Aur kisko Allah apni izzat dega?" Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, "Unke liye, Allah ki qasam, maut aa chuki hai. Allah ki qasam, main unke liye har achhaai chahta hoon (Allah ki taraf se). Allah ki qasam, is baat ke bawajood ke main Allah ka Rasool hoon, mujhe nahi pata Allah mere saath kya karega."' Umm Al-Ala ne izaafa kiya, 'Allah ki qasam, main iske baad kabhi kisi ki neki ki tasdeeq nahi karungi.'

e: Narrated Az-Zuhri:Regarding the above narration, The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I do not know what Allah will do to him (Uthman bin Maz'un)." Um Al-`Ala said, "I felt very sorry for that, and then I slept and saw in a dream a flowing spring for `Uthman bin Maz'un, and told Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) of that, and he said, "That flowing spring symbolizes his good deeds
hi: Az-Zuhri bataate hain (upar wali riwayat ke baare mein): Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Mujhe nahi pata Allah unke (Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Maz'un ke) saath kya karega.' Umm Al-Ala ko bahut afsos hua, aur phir wo so gayi aur khwaab mein Uthman bin Maz'un ke liye ek bahta hua chashma dekha, aur unhone ye baat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko bataayi, jinhone kaha, 'Wo bahta hua chashma unke nek amaal ka pratik hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Qatada Al-Ansari:(a companion of the Prophet (ﷺ) and one of his cavalry men) "I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "A good dream is from Allah, and a bad dream is from Satan; so, if anyone of you had a bad dream which he disliked, then he should spit on his left and seek refuge with Allah from it, for it will not harm him
hi: Abu Qatada (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ansari (Nabi ke sahaabi aur unke ghudsawaaron mein se ek) bataate hain: 'Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, "Ek achha khwaab Allah ki taraf se hai, aur ek bura khwaab Shaitaan ki taraf se hai; isliye, agar tum mein se koi bura khwaab dekhe jo use napasand ho, to use apni baayi taraf thookna chaahiye aur isse Allah ki panaah maangni chaahiye, kyunke isse use koi nuqsaan nahi hoga."'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "While I was sleeping, I was given a bowl full of milk (in a dream), and I drank of it to my fill until I noticed its wetness coming out of my nails, and then I gave the rest of it to `Umar." They (the people) asked, "What have you interpreted (about the dream)? O Allah's Apostle?" He said, "(It is Religious) knowledge
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, 'Jab main so raha tha, mujhe (khwaab mein) doodh se bhara ek katora diya gaya, aur maine usme se pet bhar kar piya yahaan tak ke maine notice kiya uski nami mere naakhoonon se nikal rahi hai, aur phir maine baaki Umar ko de diya.' Unhone (logon ne) pucha, 'Aapne (khwaab ka) kya matlab nikaala, Aye Allah ke Rasool?' Unhone kaha, '(Ye) Ilm (deeni ilm) hai.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "While I was sleeping, I was given a bowl full of milk (in the dream) and I drank from it (to my fill) till I noticed its wetness coming out of my limbs. Then I gave the rest of it to `Umar bin Al-Khattab." The persons sitting around him, asked, "What have you interpreted (about the dream) O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" He said, "(It is religious) knowledge
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab main so raha tha, mujhe (khwaab mein) doodh se bhara ek katora diya gaya aur maine usme se piya (pet bhar kar) yahaan tak ke maine notice kiya uski nami mere jism ke hisson se nikal rahi hai. Phir maine baaki Umar bin Al-Khattab ko de diya.' Unke gird baithe logon ne pucha, 'Aapne (khwaab ka) kya matlab nikaala, Aye Allah ke Rasool?' Unhone kaha, '(Ye) Ilm hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "While I was sleeping, some people were displayed before me (in a dream). They were wearing shirts, some of which were merely covering their breasts, and some a bit longer. Then there passed before me, `Umar bin Al-Khattab wearing a shirt he was dragging it (on the ground behind him.)" They (the people) asked, "What have you interpreted (about the dream) O Allah's Apostle?" He said, "The Religion
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab main so raha tha, kuch log mere saamne (khwaab mein) pesh kiye gaye. Wo qamize pehne the, jinmein se kuch sirf unki chhaati tak the, aur kuch thodi lambi. Phir mere saamne se Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab guzre, ek qamiz pehne hue jise wo (zameen par apne peechhe) ghaseet rahe the.' Unhone (logon ne) pucha, 'Aapne (khwaab ka) kya matlab nikaala, Aye Allah ke Rasool?' Unhone kaha, '(Ye) Deen hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "While I was sleeping, I saw (in a dream) the people being displayed before me, wearing shirts, some of which (were so short that it) reached as far as their breasts and some reached below that. Then `Umar bin Al-Khattab was shown to me and he was wearing a shirt which he was dragging (behind him)." They asked. What have you interpreted (about the dream)? O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" He said, "The religion
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, 'Jab main so raha tha, maine (khwaab mein) log mere saamne pesh kiye jaate dekhe, qamize pehne hue, jinmein se kuch (itni chhoti thin ke) unki chhaati tak pahunchti thin aur kuch usse neeche. Phir mujhe Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab dikhaaye gaye aur wo ek qamiz pehne the jise wo ghaseet rahe the (apne peechhe).' Unhone pucha, 'Aapne (khwaab ka) kya matlab nikaala, Aye Allah ke Rasool?' Unhone kaha, '(Ye) Deen hai.'

e: Narrated Qais bin 'Ubada:I was sitting in a gathering in which there was Sa`d bin Malik and Ibn `Umar. `Abdullah bin Salam passed in front of them and they said, "This man is from the people of Paradise." I said to `Abdullah bin Salam, "They said so-and-so." He replied, "Subhan Allah! They ought not to have said things of which they have no knowledge, but I saw (in a dream) that a post was fixed in a green garden. At the top of the post there was a handhold and below it there was a servant. I was asked to climb (the post). So I climbed it till I got hold of the handhold." Then I narrated this dream to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Allah's Apostle said, "`Abdullah will die while still holding the firm reliable handhold (i.e., Islam)
hi: Qais bin Ubada bataate hain: Main ek majlis mein baitha tha jismein Sa'd bin Malik aur Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) the. Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Salam (رضی اللہ عنہ) unke saamne se guzre aur unhone kaha, 'Ye aadmi Jannat waalon mein se hai.' Maine Abdullah bin Salam se kaha, 'Unhone falaan-falaan kaha.' Unhone jawab diya, 'Subhan Allah! Unhein aisi baaten nahi kehni chaahiye thi jinka unhein pata nahi, magar maine (khwaab mein) dekha ke ek khambha ek hare-bhare baagh mein gaada gaya hai. Khambhe ke oopar ek pakda hua hatha tha aur uske neeche ek khaadim tha. Mujhse (khambhe par) chadhne ko kaha gaya. To main uspar chadha yahaan tak ke maine wo hatha pakad liya.' Phir maine ye khwaab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko sunaaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Abdullah maut paayenge jabke wo mazboot, bharosemand hatha (yaani Islam) thaame hue honge.'
