e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said (to me), "You were shown to me twice in (my) dream. Behold, a man was carrying you in a silken piece of cloth and said to me, "She is your wife, so uncover her,' and behold, it was you. I would then say (to myself), 'If this is from Allah, then it must happen
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (mujhse) kaha, 'Tum mujhe (mere) khwaab mein do baar dikhaayi gayi. Dekho, ek aadmi tumhein resham ke kapde mein lekar aa raha tha aur mujhse kaha, "Ye tumhaari biwi hai, isliye ise be-parda karo," aur dekho, wo tum thi. Main (khud se) kehta, "Agar ye Allah ki taraf se hai, to ye zaroor hoga."'

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me, "You were shown to me twice (in my dream) before I married you. I saw an angel carrying you in a silken piece of cloth, and I said to him, 'Uncover (her),' and behold, it was you. I said (to myself), 'If this is from Allah, then it must happen.' Then you were shown to me, the angel carrying you in a silken piece of cloth, and I said (to him), 'Uncover (her), and behold, it was you. I said (to myself), 'If this is from Allah, then it must happen
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse kaha, 'Tum mujhe (mere khwaab mein) do baar dikhaayi gayi thi mere aapse shaadi karne se pehle. Maine ek farishte ko tumhein resham ke kapde mein lekar aate dekha, aur maine unse kaha, "(Ise) be-parda karo," aur dekho, wo tum thi. Maine (khud se) kaha, "Agar ye Allah ki taraf se hai, to ye zaroor hoga." Phir tum mujhe dikhaayi gayi, farishta tumhein resham ke kapde mein lekar aa raha tha, aur maine (unse) kaha, "(Ise) be-parda karo," aur dekho, wo tum thi. Maine (khud se) kaha, "Agar ye Allah ki taraf se hai, to ye zaroor hoga."'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "I have been sent with Jawami al-Kalim (i.e., the shortest expression carrying the widest meanings), and I was made victorious with awe (cast into the hearts of the enemy), and while I was sleeping, the keys of the treasures of the earth were brought to me and were put in my hand." Muhammad said, Jawami'-al-Kalim means that Allah expresses in one or two statements or thereabouts the numerous matters that used to be written in the books revealed before (the coming of) the Prophet
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, 'Mujhe Jawami-al-Kalim (yaani sabse chhoti baat jo sabse zyaada mafhoom rakhti hai) ke saath bheja gaya hai, aur mujhe khauf ke saath fatah di gayi (dushman ke dil mein daala gaya), aur jab main so raha tha, zameen ke khazaanon ki chaabiyaan mere paas laayi gayi aur mere haath mein rakh di gayi.' Muhammad ne kaha, 'Jawami-al-Kalim ka matlab hai ke Allah ek ya do baaton mein wo bahut se maamle bayaan karta hai jo pehle naazil hui Kitaabon mein (Nabi ke aane se pehle) likhi jaati thi.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Salam:(In a dream) I saw myself in a garden, and there was a pillar in the middle of the garden, and there was a handhold at the top of the pillar. I was asked to climb it. I said, "I cannot." Then a servant came and lifted up my clothes and I climbed (the pillar), and then got hold of the handhold, and I woke up while still holding it. I narrated that to the Prophet (ﷺ) who said, "The garden symbolizes the garden of Islam, and the handhold is the firm Islamic handhold which indicates that you will be adhering firmly to Islam until you die
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Salam (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: (Khwaab mein) maine khud ko ek baag mein dekha, aur baag ke beech mein ek khambha tha, aur khambhe ke oopar ek pakad (handhold) thi. Mujhse (isper) chadhne ko kaha gaya. Maine kaha, 'Main nahi kar sakta.' Phir ek khaadim aaya aur mere kapde uthaaye aur main (khambhe par) chadha, aur phir maine pakad thaam li, aur main use thaame hue jaaga. Maine ye Nabi (SAW) ko sunaaya, jinhone kaha, 'Baag Islam ke baag ka pratik hai, aur pakad mazboot Islami pakad hai jo dikhaata hai ke tum apni maut tak Islam par mazbooti se qaayam rahoge.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:I saw in a dream a piece of silken cloth in my hand, and in whatever direction in Paradise I waved it, it flew, carrying me there. I narrated this (dream) to (my sister) Hafsa and she told it to the Prophet (ﷺ) who said, (to Hafsa), "Indeed, your brother is a righteous man," or, "Indeed, `Abdullah is a righteous man
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine khwaab mein apne haath mein resham ke ek tukde ko dekha, aur jis bhi taraf main use Jannat mein hilaata, wo udd jaata, mujhe wahaan le jaate hue. Maine ye (khwaab) apni behen Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko sunaaya aur unhone Nabi (SAW) ko bataaya, jinhone (Hafsa se) kaha, 'Beshak, tumhaara bhai ek neik aadmi hai,' ya, 'Beshak, Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ek neik aadmi hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When the Day of Resurrection approaches, the dreams of a believer will hardly fail to come true, and a dream of a believer is one of forty-six parts of prophetism, and whatever belongs to prothetism can never be false." Muhammad bin Seereen said, "But I say this." He said, "It used to be said, 'There are three types of dreams: The reflection of one's thoughts and experiences one has during wakefulness, what is suggested by Satan to frighten the dreamer, or glad tidings from Allah. So, if someone has a dream which he dislikes, he should not tell it to others, but get up and offer a prayer." He added, "He (Abu Huraira) hated to see a Ghul (i.e., iron collar around his neck in a dream) and people liked to see fetters (on their feet in a dream). The fetters on the feet symbolizes one's constant and firm adherence to religion." And Abu `Abdullah said, "Ghuls (iron collars) are used only for necks
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab Qayamat ka din qareeb aayega, Momin ke khwaab mushkil se sach hone se rah jaayenge, aur Momin ka khwaab Nabuwwat ke chhiyalis (46) hisson mein se ek hai, aur Nabuwwat se juda koi bhi cheez kabhi jhooti nahi ho sakti.' Muhammad bin Seereen ne kaha, 'Magar main ye kehta hoon.' Unhone kaha, 'Ye kaha jaata tha, "Teen qism ke khwaab hote hain: apne khayaalaat aur jaagte waqt ke tajurbon ka pratibimb, jo Shaitaan khwaab dekhne wale ko darane ke liye suzaata hai, ya Allah ki taraf se khush-khabri. Isliye, agar kisi ko koi aisa khwaab aaye jo use napasand ho, to use doosron ko nahi batana chaahiye, balke uthkar namaz padhni chaahiye."' Unhone izaafa kiya, 'Wo (Abu Huraira) khud ko Ghul (yaani apni gardan ke gird loha ka patta) khwaab mein dekhna napasand karte the, aur log apne pairon mein bediyaan (fetters) dekhna pasand karte the. Pairon ki bediyaan insaan ki apne deen mein pakke aur mazboot rehne ki nishaani hain.' Aur Abu Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Ghul (loha ke patte) sirf gardanon ke liye istemaal hote hain.'

e: Narrated Kharija bin Zaid bin Thabit:Um Al-`Ala an Ansari woman who had given the Pledge of allegiance to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "`Uthman bin Maz'un came in our share when the Ansars drew lots to distribute the emigrants (to dwell) among themselves, He became sick and we looked after (nursed) him till he died. Then we shrouded him in his clothes. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to us, I (addressing the dead body) said, "May Allah's Mercy be on you, O Aba As-Sa'ib! I testify that Allah has honored you." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'How do you know that?' I replied, 'I do not know, by Allah.' He said, 'As for him, death has come to him and I wish him all good from Allah. By Allah, though I am Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), I neither know what will happen to me, nor to you.'" Um Al-`Ala said, "By Allah, I will never attest the righteousness of anybody after that." She added, "Later I saw in a dream, a flowing spring for `Uthman. So I went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and mentioned that to him. He said, 'That is (the symbol of) his good deeds (the reward for) which is going on for him
hi: Kharija bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Thabit (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Umm Al-Ala, ek Ansaari khaatoon jinhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se baiyat li thi, ne kaha, 'Uthman bin Maz'un hamare hisse mein aaye jab Ansaaron ne Muhaajireen ko apne beech baantne ke liye qur'a nikaala. Wo bimar pad gaye aur humne unki dekhbhaal ki (unki bimaari mein) yahaan tak ke unka intekaal ho gaya. Phir humne unhein unke kapdon mein kafan diya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) hamare paas aaye, maine (murda jism se khitaab karte hue) kaha, "Allah ki rehmat aap par ho, Aye Aba As-Sa'ib! Main gawaahi deta hoon ke Allah ne aapko izzat di hai." Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, "Tumhein kaise pata?" Maine jawab diya, "Mujhe nahi pata, Allah ki qasam." Unhone kaha, "Jahaan tak unki baat hai, unhein maut aa gayi hai aur main unke liye Allah ki taraf se har bhalaai chaahta hoon. Allah ki qasam, iske bawajood ke main Allah ka Rasool hoon, mujhe nahi pata mera kya hoga, na hi tumhaara."' Umm Al-Ala ne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, main iske baad kabhi kisi ki nekii ki gawaahi nahi doongi.' Unhone izaafa kiya, 'Baad mein maine khwaab mein Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke liye ek behta chashma dekha. To main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gayi aur unhein iske baare mein bataaya. Unhone kaha, "Ye unke nek amaal (ka pratik hai) jinka ajr unke liye jaari hai."'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "(I saw in a dream that) while I was standing at a well and drawing water therefrom, suddenly Abu Bakr and `Umar came to me. Abu Bakr took the bucket and drew one or two buckets (full of water), but there was weakness in his pulling, but Allah forgave him. Then Ibn Al- Khattab took the bucket from Abu Bakr's hand and the bucket turned into a very large one in his hand. I have never seen any strong man among the people doing such a hard job as `Umar did, till (the people drank to their satisfaction) and water their camels to their fill and they sat near the water
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, '(Maine khwaab mein dekha ke) main ek kuen par khada tha aur usse paani nikaal raha tha, achaanak Abu Bakr aur Umar mere paas aaye. Abu Bakr ne bucket liya aur ek ya do bucket (bhare) paani nikaale, magar unke kheenchne mein kamzori thi, lekin Allah ne unhein maaf kar diya. Phir Ibn Al-Khattab ne Abu Bakr ke haath se bucket liya aur unke haath mein wo bucket ek bahut bada bucket ban gaya. Maine kabhi kisi mazboot aadmi ko itni sakht mehnat karte nahi dekha jitni Umar ne ki, yahaan tak ke (log peene se santusht ho gaye) aur unhone apne oonton ko jee bhar kar paani pilaaya aur wo paani ke qareeb baith gaye.'

e: Narrated Salim's father:about the Prophet's dream in which he has seen Abu Bakr and `Umar: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I saw (in a dream) that the people had gathered. Then Abu Bakr stood up and pulled out one or two buckets full of water (from a well) and there was weakness in his pulling -- may Allah forgive him. Then Ibn Al- Khattab stood up, and the bucket turned into a very large one and I have never seen any strong man among the people doing such a hard job. He pulled out so much water that the people (drank to their satisfaction) and watered their camels to their fill, (and then after quenching their thirst) they sat beside the water
hi: Salim ke waalid bataate hain, Nabi (SAW) ke khwaab ke baare mein jismein unhone Abu Bakr aur Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko dekha: Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Maine (khwaab mein) dekha ke log jama the. Phir Abu Bakr khade hue aur ek ya do bucket (bhare) paani nikaale, aur unke kheenchne mein kamzori thi -- Allah unhein maaf kare. Phir Ibn Al-Khattab khade hue, aur bucket ek bahut bada bucket ban gaya aur maine kabhi kisi mazboot aadmi ko aisi sakht mehnat karte nahi dekha. Unhone itna paani nikaala ke log (jee bhar kar piye) aur unhone apne oonton ko jee bhar kar paani pilaaya, (aur phir apni pyaas bujhaane ke baad) wo paani ke kinaare baith gaye.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "While I was sleeping, I saw myself standing at a well over which there was a bucket. I pulled out from it as many buckets of water as Allah wished, and then Ibn Abi Quhafa (Abu Bakr) took the bucket from me and pulled out one or two full buckets, and there was weakness in his pull--may Allah forgive him. Then the bucket turned into a very large one and `Umar bin Al-Khattab took it. I have never seen any strong man among the people, drawing water with such strength as `Umar did, till the people (drank to their satisfaction and) watered their camels to their fill; whereupon the camels sat beside the water
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab main so raha tha, maine khud ko ek kuen par khada dekha jispar ek bucket tha. Maine usmein se jitna Allah ne chaaha utne bucket paani nikaale, aur phir Ibn Abi Quhafa (Abu Bakr) ne mujhse bucket liya aur ek ya do bhare bucket nikaale, aur unke kheenchne mein kamzori thi -- Allah unhein maaf kare. Phir bucket ek bahut bada bucket ban gaya aur Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab ne use liya. Maine kabhi kisi mazboot aadmi ko itni taaqat se paani kheenchte nahi dekha jitni Umar ne ki, yahaan tak ke log (jee bhar kar piye) aur unhone apne oonton ko jee bhar kar paani pilaaya; isper oont paani ke kinaare baith gaye.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "While I was sleeping, I saw myself standing over a tank (well) giving water to the people to drink. Then Abu Bakr came to me and took the bucket from me in order to relieve me and he pulled out one or two full buckets, and there was weakness in his pulling --may Allah forgive him. Then Ibn Al-Khattab took it from him and went on drawing water till the people left (after being satisfied) while the tank was over flowing with water
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab main so raha tha, maine khud ko ek hauz (kuen) par khada dekha, logon ko peene ke liye paani de raha tha. Phir Abu Bakr mere paas aaye aur mujhse bucket liya mujhe raahat dene ke liye aur unhone ek ya do bhare bucket nikaale, aur unke kheenchne mein kamzori thi -- Allah unhein maaf kare. Phir Ibn Al-Khattab ne unse bucket liya aur paani nikaalte rahe yahaan tak ke log chale gaye (santusht hokar) jabke hauz paani se lab-a-lab bhar gaya tha.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:We were sitting with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), he said, "While I was sleeping, I saw myself in Paradise. Suddenly I saw a woman performing ablution beside a palace. I asked, "For whom is this palace?" They (the angels) replied, "It is for `Umar bin Al-Khattab." Then I remembered `Umar's ghira and went back hurriedly." On hearing that, `Umar started weeping and said, " Let my father and mother be sacrificed for you. O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! How dare I think of my Ghira being offended by you?
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath baithe the, unhone kaha, 'Jab main so raha tha, maine khud ko Jannat mein dekha. Achaanak maine ek khaatoon ko ek mahal ke paas wuzu karte dekha. Maine pucha, "Ye mahal kiske liye hai?" Unhone (farishtwon ne) jawab diya, "Ye Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab ke liye hai." Phir mujhe Umar ki ghairat (izzat ki khaatir gairat) yaad aayi aur main jaldi se wapas chala gaya.' Ye sunkar, Umar rone lage aur kaha, 'Mere maa-baap aap par qurbaan hon. Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya main aapke saamne apni ghairat ke naaraaz hone ka khayaal bhi kar sakta hoon?'

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: (I saw in a dream that) I entered Paradise, and behold, there was a palace built of gold! I asked, 'For whom is this palace?' They (the angels) replied, 'For a man from the Quraish.' " The Prophet added, "O Ibn Al-Khattab! Nothing stopped me from entering it except your Ghira." `Umar said, "How dare I think of my Ghira being offended by you, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, '(Maine khwaab mein dekha ke) main Jannat mein daakhil hua, aur dekho, wahaan sone se bana ek mahal tha! Maine pucha, "Ye mahal kiske liye hai?" Unhone (farishtwon ne) jawab diya, "Quraish ke ek shaks ke liye."' Nabi (SAW) ne izaafa kiya, 'Aye Ibn Al-Khattab! Mujhe usmein daakhil hone se kisi cheez ne nahi roka siwaaye tumhaari ghairat ke.' Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Kya main aapke saamne apni ghairat ke naaraaz hone ka khayaal bhi kar sakta hoon, Aye Allah ke Rasool?'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:We were sitting with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) he said, "While I was sleeping, I saw myself in Paradise, and behold, a woman was performing ablution by the side of a palace. I asked, 'For whom is this palace?' They replied, 'For `Umar' Then I remembered the Ghira of `Umar and returned immediately." `Umar wept (on hearing that) and said, " Let my father and mother be sacrificed for you, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! How dare I think of my Ghira being offended by you
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath baithe the, unhone kaha, 'Jab main so raha tha, maine khud ko Jannat mein dekha, aur dekho, ek khaatoon ek mahal ke paas wuzu kar rahi thi. Maine pucha, "Ye mahal kiske liye hai?" Unhone jawab diya, "Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke liye." Phir mujhe Umar ki ghairat yaad aayi aur main jaldi se wapas chala gaya.' Umar ne (ye sunkar) rote hue kaha, 'Mere maa-baap aap par qurbaan hon, Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya main aapke saamne apni ghairat ke naaraaz hone ka khayaal bhi kar sakta hoon?'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "While I was sleeping, I saw myself performing the Tawaf of the Ka`ba. Behold, there I saw a whitish-red lank-haired man (holding himself) between two men with water dropping from his hair. I asked, 'Who is this?' The people replied, 'He is the son of Mary.' Then I turned my face to see another man with red complexion, big body, curly hair, and blind in the right eye which looked like a protruding out grape. I asked, 'Who is he?' They replied, 'He is Ad-Dajjal.' Ibn Qatan resembles him more than anybody else among the people and Ibn Qatan was a man from Bani Al-Mustaliq from Khuza`a
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab main so raha tha, maine khud ko Kaaba ka Tawaf karte dekha. Dekho, wahaan maine ek surkh-safed, seedhe baalon waale aadmi ko (do aadmiyon ke beech khada) dekha, jinke baal se paani tapak raha tha. Maine pucha, "Ye kaun hai?" Logon ne jawab diya, "Wo Maryam ke bete hain." Phir maine apna chehra doosri taraf mudkar ek aur aadmi ko dekha, laal rangat ka, bada jism, ghungraale baal, aur daayin aankh se andha jo ek uthhe hue angoor jaisi dikh rahi thi. Maine pucha, "Ye kaun hai?" Unhone jawab diya, "Wo Ad-Dajjal hai." Ibn Qatan sab logon mein se unse sabse zyaada milte-julte hain, aur Ibn Qatan Banu Al-Mustaliq qabeele se the, jo Khuza'a qabeele ka hissa the.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "While I was sleeping, I saw a bowl full of milk was brought to me and I drank of it (to my fill) till I noticed its wetness flowing (in my body). Then I gave the remaining of it to `Umar." They asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What have you interpreted (about the dream)? He said, "(It is Religious) knowledge." (See Hadith No)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, 'Jab main so raha tha, maine dekha ke doodh se bhara ek katora mere paas laaya gaya aur maine usmein se (jee bhar kar) piya yahaan tak ke maine uski nami apne jism mein bahte mehsoos ki. Phir maine baaki doodh Umar ko de diya.' Unhone (logon ne) pucha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Aapne (khwaab ki) kya tashreeh ki hai?' Unhone kaha, '(Ye deeni) ilm hai.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees dekhein.)

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Men from the companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to see dreams during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and they used to narrate those dreams to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) would interpret them as Allah wished. I was a young man and used to stay in the mosque before my wedlock. I said to myself, "If there were any good in myself, I too would see what these people see." So when I went to bed one night, I said, "O Allah! If you see any good in me, show me a good dream." So while I was in that state, there came to me (in a dream) two angels. In the hand of each of them, there was a mace of iron, and both of them were taking me to Hell, and I was between them, invoking Allah, "O Allah! I seek refuge with You from Hell." Then I saw myself being confronted by another angel holding a mace of iron in his hand. He said to me, "Do not be afraid, you will be an excellent man if you only pray more often." So they took me till they stopped me at the edge of Hell, and behold, it was built inside like a well and it had side posts like those of a well, and beside each post there was an angel carrying an iron mace. I saw therein many people hanging upside down with iron chains, and I recognized therein some men from the Quraish. Then (the angels) took me to the right side. I narrated this dream to (my sister) Hafsa and she told it to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "No doubt, `Abdullah is a good man." (Nafi` said, "Since then `Abdullah bin `Umar used to pray much)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke sahaaba mein se log Nabi (SAW) ki zindagi mein khwaab dekha karte the aur wo apne khwaab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko sunaate the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unki tashreeh karte jaisa Allah chahta. Main ek jawaan tha aur apni shaadi se pehle Masjid mein rehta tha. Maine apne aap se kaha, 'Agar mujhme koi bhalaai hai, to main bhi wahi dekhoonga jo ye log dekhte hain.' To jab main ek raat bistar par gaya, maine kaha, 'Aye Allah! Agar tujhe mujhme koi bhalaai nazar aati hai, to mujhe ek achha khwaab dikha.' Isi haalat mein, do farishte (khwaab mein) mere paas aaye. Unmein se har ek ke haath mein loha ka ek gada (mace) tha, aur dono mujhe Jahannam ki taraf le jaa rahe the, aur main unke beech tha, Allah se dua kar raha tha, 'Aye Allah! Main tujhse Jahannam se panaah maangta hoon.' Phir maine khud ko ek aur farishte ke saamne dekha jiske haath mein loha ka ek gada tha. Usne mujhse kaha, 'Dar mat, tum ek behtareen aadmi hoge agar tum sirf zyaada namaz padho.' To wo mujhe le gaye yahaan tak ke unhone mujhe Jahannam ke kinaare rok liya, aur dekho, ye andar se ek kuen jaisi banaayi gayi thi, aur uske pasandi khambhe the jaise ek kuen ke hote hain, aur har khambhe ke paas loha ka gada liye ek farishta tha. Maine wahaan bahut se logon ko loha ki zanjeeron se ulte latke dekha, aur maine wahaan Quraish mein se kuch logon ko pehchaana. Phir (farishton ne) mujhe daayin taraf le jaaya. Maine ye khwaab apni behen Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko sunaaya aur unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko bataaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Shak nahi, Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ek achha aadmi hai.' (Nafi' ne kaha, 'Tab se Abdullah bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bahut zyaada namaz padhne lage.')

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:I was a young unmarried man during the lifetime of the Prophet. I used to sleep in the mosque. Anyone who had a dream, would narrate it to the Prophet. I said, "O Allah! If there is any good for me with You, then show me a dream so that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) may interpret it for me." So I slept and saw (in a dream) two angels came to me and took me along with them, and they met another angel who said to me, "Don't be afraid, you are a good man." They took me towards the Fire, and behold, it was built inside like a well, and therein I saw people some of whom I recognized, and then the angels took me to the right side. In the morning, I mentioned that dream to Hafsa. Hafsa told me that she had mentioned it to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he said, "`Abdullah is a righteous man if he only prays more at night." (Az-Zuhri said, "After that, `Abdullah used to pray more at night)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Nabi (SAW) ki zindagi mein ek jawaan, gair-shaadi-shuda aadmi tha. Main Masjid mein sota tha. Jise bhi koi khwaab aata, wo use Nabi (SAW) ko sunaata. Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah! Agar mujhme koi bhalaai tere paas hai, to mujhe ek khwaab dikha taake Allah ke Rasool (SAW) meri taraf se uski tashreeh kar sakein.' To main soya aur (khwaab mein) do farishton ko dekha jo mere paas aaye aur mujhe apne saath le gaye, aur unhone ek aur farishte se mulaakaat ki jisne mujhse kaha, 'Dar mat, tum ek achhe aadmi ho.' Wo mujhe Aag ki taraf le gaye, aur dekho, ye andar se ek kuen jaisi banaayi gayi thi, aur usmein maine kuch logon ko dekha jinhein main pehchaanta tha, aur phir farishte mujhe daayin taraf le gaye. Subah, maine ye khwaab Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko sunaaya. Hafsa ne mujhe bataaya ke unhone ye Nabi (SAW) ko sunaaya aur unhone kaha, 'Abdullah ek neik aadmi hai agar wo sirf raat mein zyaada namaz padhe.' (Az-Zuhri ne kaha, 'Iske baad, Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) raat mein zyaada namaz padhne lage.')

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "While I was sleeping, I saw that a cup full of milk was brought to me and I drank of it and gave the remaining of it to `Umar bin Al-Khattab." They asked. What have you interpreted (about the dream)? O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said. "(It is Religious) knowledge
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, 'Jab main so raha tha, maine dekha ke doodh se bhara ek pyaala mere paas laaya gaya aur maine usmein se piya aur baaki Umar bin Al-Khattab ko de diya.' Unhone (logon ne) pucha, 'Aapne (khwaab ki) kya tashreeh ki hai, Aye Allah ke Rasool?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, '(Ye deeni) ilm hai.'

e: Narated Ubaidullah bin Abdullah:I asked Ibn Abbas about the dream of Allah's Messenger which he mentioned. (see following hadith)
hi: Ubaidullah bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke us khwaab ke baare mein pucha jiska unhone zikr kiya tha. (Agli hadees dekhein.)

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "While I was sleeping, two golden bangles were put in my two hands, so I got scared (frightened) and disliked it, but I was given permission to blow them off, and they flew away. I interpret it as a symbol of two liars who will appear." 'Ubaidullah said, "One of them was Al-`Ansi who was killed by Fairuz at Yemen and the other was Musailama (at Najd)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab main so raha tha, mere dono haathon mein sone ke do kangan pehnaaye gaye, isliye main dar gaya (khauf-zada hua) aur mujhe napasand aaya, magar mujhe unhein phoonk maar kar hataane ki ijaazat mili, aur wo udd gaye. Maine iski tashreeh do jhoote logon ke pratik ke taur par ki jo zaahir honge.' Ubaidullah ne kaha, 'Unmein se ek Al-Ansi tha jinhein Yemen mein Fairuz ne qatl kiya, aur doosra Musailama tha (Najd mein).'

e: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I saw in a dream that I was migrating from Mecca to a land where there were date palm trees. I thought that it might be the land of Al-Yamama or Hajar, but behold, it turned out to be Yathrib (i.e. Medina). And I saw cows (being slaughtered) there, but the reward given by Allah is better (than worldly benefits). Behold, those cows proved to symbolize the believers (who were killed) on the Day (of the battle) of Uhud, and the good (which I saw in the dream) was the good and the reward and the truth which Allah bestowed upon us after the Badr battle. (or the Battle of Uhud) and that was the victory bestowed by Allah in the Battle of Khaibar and the conquest of Mecca
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Maine khwaab mein dekha ke main Makkah se ek aisi zameen ki taraf hijrat kar raha hoon jahaan khajoor ke darakht the. Mujhe laga ye Al-Yamama ya Hajar ki zameen hogi, magar dekho, wo Yathrib (yaani Madina) nikli. Aur maine wahaan gaayein (zibah hote) dekhi, magar Allah ka diya hua ajr behtar hai (duniya ke faaydon se). Dekho, un gaayon ne Momineen ka pratik nikla (jo jang-e-Uhud ke din shaheed hue), aur wo bhalaai (jo maine khwaab mein dekhi) wo bhalaai, ajr aur haqeeqat thi jo Allah ne humein Badr ki jang ke baad ata ki (ya Uhud ki jang ke baad), aur wo Khaibar ki jang mein Allah ki ata ki hui fatah aur Makkah ki fatah thi.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "We (Muslims) are the last (to come) but (will be) the foremost (on the Day of Resurrection)." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) further said, ''While sleeping, I was given the treasures of the world and two golden bangles were put in my hands, but I felt much annoyed, and those two bangles distressed me very much, but I was inspired that I should blow them off, so I blew them and they flew away. Then I interpreted that those two bangles were the liars between whom I was (i.e., the one of San`a' and the one of Yamama)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Hum (Musalmaan) sabse aakhri (aane wale) hain magar sabse aage honge (Qayamat ke din).' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne aage kaha, 'Jab main so raha tha, mujhe duniya ke khazaane diye gaye aur mere haathon mein sone ke do kangan pehnaaye gaye, magar mujhe bahut pareshaani hui, aur un do kangan ne mujhe bahut takleef di, magar mujhe ilhaam hua ke mujhe unhein phoonk maar kar hataana chaahiye, isliye maine unhein phoonka aur wo udd gaye. Phir maine iski tashreeh ki ke wo do kangan wo do jhoote log the jinke beech main tha (yaani San'a ka aur Yamama ka).'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I saw (in a dream) a black woman with unkempt hair going out of Medina and settling at Mahai'a, i.e., Al-Juhfa. I interpreted that as a symbol of epidemic of Medina being transferred to that place (Al-Juhfa)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Maine (khwaab mein) ek kaali khaatoon dekhi, uljhe baalon waali, Madina se baahar jaate hue aur Mahai'a, yaani Al-Juhfa, mein basne hue. Maine iski tashreeh Madina ki mahamaari (epidemic) ke us jagah (Al-Juhfa) mein transfer hone ke pratik ke taur par ki.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:concerning the dream of the Prophet (ﷺ) in Medina: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I saw (in a dream) a black woman with unkempt hair going out of Medina and settling at Mahai'a. I interpreted that as (a symbol of) the epidemic of Medina being transferred to Mahai'a, namely, Al-Juhfa
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain, Nabi (SAW) ke khwaab ke baare mein Madina mein: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Maine (khwaab mein) ek kaali khaatoon dekhi, uljhe baalon waali, Madina se baahar jaate hue aur Mahai'a mein basne hue. Maine iski tashreeh (Madina ki mahamaari ke) Mahai'a mein, yaani Al-Juhfa mein, transfer hone ke pratik ke taur par ki.'

e: Narrated Salim's father:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I saw (in a dream) a black woman with unkempt hair going out of Medina and settling in Mahai'a. I interpreted that as (a symbol of) epidemic of Medina being transferred to Mahai'a, namely, Al-Juhfa
hi: Salim ke waalid bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Maine (khwaab mein) ek kaali khaatoon dekhi, uljhe baalon waali, Madina se baahar jaate hue aur Mahai'a mein basne hue. Maine iski tashreeh Madina ki mahamaari ke Mahai'a mein, yaani Al-Juhfa mein, transfer hone ke pratik ke taur par ki.'

e: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I saw in a dream that I waved a sword and it broke in the middle, and behold, that symbolized the casualties the believers suffered on the Day (of the battle) of Uhud. Then I waved the sword again, and it became better than it had ever been before, and behold, that symbolized the Conquest (of Mecca) which Allah brought about and the gathering of the believers
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Maine khwaab mein dekha ke maine ek talwaar hilaayi aur wo beech mein toot gayi, aur dekho, ye jang-e-Uhud ke din Momineen ke nuqsaan ka pratik tha. Phir maine talwaar dobara hilaayi, aur wo pehle se bhi behtar ho gayi, aur dekho, ye us Fatah (Makkah ki) ka pratik tha jo Allah ne ki aur Momineen ka jama hona.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever claims to have seen a dream which he did not see, will be ordered to make a knot between two barley grains which he will not be able to do; and if somebody listens to the talk of some people who do not like him (to listen) or they run away from him, then molten lead will be poured into his ears on the Day of Resurrection; and whoever makes a picture, will be punished on the Day of Resurrection and will be ordered to put a soul in that picture, which he will not be able to do." Ibn `Abbas also narrated a similar hadith
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi ye dawa kare ke usne aisa khwaab dekha jo usne nahi dekha, use jau ke do daanon ke beech gaanth baandhne ka hukm diya jaayega, jo wo nahi kar payega; aur agar koi aise logon ki baaton ko sune jo use napasand karte hon (unhein sunte hue), ya wo usse door bhaagte hon, to Qayamat ke din uske kaanon mein pighla hua seesa daala jaayega; aur jo koi tasveer banaaye, use Qayamat ke din saza di jaayegi aur use us tasveer mein jaan daalne ka hukm diya jaayega, jo wo nahi kar paayega.' Ibn Abbas ne bhi isi jaisi ek hadees riwaayat ki.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The worst lie is that a person claims to have seen a dream which he has not seen
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Sabse bura jhoot ye hai ke koi ye dawa kare ke usne aisa khwaab dekha jo usne nahi dekha.'

e: Narrated Abu Salama:I used to see a dream which would make me sick till I heard Abu Qatada saying, "I too, used to see a dream which would make me sick till I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "A good dream is from Allah, so if anyone of you saw a dream which he liked, he should not tell it to anybody except to the one whom he loves, and if he saw a dream which he disliked, then he should seek refuge with Allah from its evil and from the evil of Satan, and spit three times (on his left) and should not tell it to anybody, for it will not harm him
hi: Abu Salama bataate hain: Main aksar aisa khwaab dekhta jo mujhe bimar kar deta tha yahaan tak ke maine Abu Qatada (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko ye kehte suna, 'Main bhi aisa khwaab dekha karta tha jo mujhe bimar kar deta tha yahaan tak ke maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, "Achha khwaab Allah ki taraf se hota hai, isliye agar tum mein se koi aisa khwaab dekhe jo use pasand ho, to use kisi ko nahi batana chaahiye siwaaye us shaks ke jise wo muhabbat karta hai, aur agar wo aisa khwaab dekhe jo use napasand ho, to use Allah ki panaah maangni chaahiye uski buraai se aur Shaitaan ki buraai se, aur teen baar thookna chaahiye (apni baayin taraf), aur ise kisi ko nahi batana chaahiye, kyunke isse use nuqsaan nahi hoga."'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "If anyone of you saw a dream which he liked, then that was from Allah, and he should thank Allah for it and tell it to others; but if he saw something else, i.e, a dream which he did not like, then that is from Satan and he should seek refuge with Allah from it and should not tell it to anybody for it will not harm him
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, 'Agar tum mein se koi aisa khwaab dekhe jo use pasand ho, to wo Allah ki taraf se hai, aur use iske liye Allah ka shukriya adaa karna chaahiye aur ise doosron ko batana chaahiye; magar agar wo kuch aur dekhe, yaani aisa khwaab jo use napasand ho, to wo Shaitaan ki taraf se hai aur use isse Allah ki panaah maangni chaahiye aur ise kisi ko nahi batana chaahiye, kyunke isse use nuqsaan nahi hoga.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:A man came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "I saw in a dream, a cloud having shade. Butter and honey were dropping from it and I saw the people gathering it in their hands, some gathering much and some a little. And behold, there was a rope extending from the earth to the sky, and I saw that you (the Prophet) held it and went up, and then another man held it and went up and (after that) another (third) held it and went up, and then after another (fourth) man held it, but it broke and then got connected again." Abu Bakr said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Let my father be sacrificed for you! Allow me to interpret this dream." The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "Interpret it." Abu Bakr said, "The cloud with shade symbolizes Islam, and the butter and honey dropping from it, symbolizes the Qur'an, its sweetness dropping and some people learning much of the Qur'an and some a little. The rope which is extended from the sky to the earth is the Truth which you (the Prophet) are following. You follow it and Allah will raise you high with it, and then another man will follow it and will rise up with it and another person will follow it and then another man will follow it but it will break and then it will be connected for him and he will rise up with it. O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Let my father be sacrificed for you! Am I right or wrong?" The Prophet replied, "You are right in some of it and wrong in some." Abu Bakr said, "O Allah's Prophet! By Allah, you must tell me in what I was wrong." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not swear
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Maine khwaab mein ek saaya-daar baadal dekha. Usmein se makkhan aur shehad tapak raha tha aur maine logon ko use apne haathon mein jama karte dekha, kuch zyaada jama karte aur kuch kam. Aur dekho, wahaan zameen se aasman tak ek rassi thi, aur maine dekha ke aap (Nabi) usse thaamkar oopar chadhe, phir ek aur aadmi ne use thaamkar oopar chadha, aur (uske baad) ek aur (teesra) aadmi ne thaamkar chadha, aur phir ek aur (chautha) aadmi ne thaama, magar wo toot gayi aur phir dobara jud gayi.' Abu Bakr ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mere waalid aap par qurbaan hon! Mujhe is khwaab ki tashreeh karne dijiye.' Nabi (SAW) ne unse kaha, 'Iski tashreeh karo.' Abu Bakr ne kaha, 'Saaya-daar baadal Islam ka pratik hai, aur usmein se tapakta makkhan aur shehad Quran ka pratik hai, uski meethaas tapakti hai aur kuch log Quran ka zyaada seekhte hain aur kuch kam. Wo rassi jo aasman se zameen tak jaati hai wo Haq hai jiski aap (Nabi) pairvi kar rahe hain. Aap iski pairvi karte hain aur Allah aapko isse oopar uthaayega, aur phir ek aur aadmi iski pairvi karega aur isse oopar uthega, aur ek aur shaks iski pairvi karega, aur phir ek aur aadmi iski pairvi karega magar wo toot jaayegi aur phir uske liye jud jaayegi aur wo isse oopar uthega.' 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mere waalid aap par qurbaan hon! Kya main sahi hoon ya galat?' Nabi (SAW) ne jawab diya, 'Tum kuch mein sahi ho aur kuch mein galat.' Abu Bakr ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Nabi! Allah ki qasam, aapko mujhe batana hoga main kahaan galat tha.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Qasam mat khaao.'

e: Narrated Samura bin Jundub:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) very often used to ask his companions, "Did anyone of you see a dream?" So dreams would be narrated to him by those whom Allah wished to tell. One morning the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Last night two persons came to me (in a dream) and woke me up and said to me, 'Proceed!' I set out with them and we came across a man lying down, and behold, another man was standing over his head, holding a big rock. Behold, he was throwing the rock at the man's head, injuring it. The rock rolled away and the thrower followed it and took it back. By the time he reached the man, his head returned to the normal state. The thrower then did the same as he had done before. I said to my two companions, 'Subhan Allah! Who are these two persons?' They said, 'Proceed!' So we proceeded and came to a man lying flat on his back and another man standing over his head with an iron hook, and behold, he would put the hook in one side of the man's mouth and tear off that side of his face to the back (of the neck) and similarly tear his nose from front to back and his eye from front to back. Then he turned to the other side of the man's face and did just as he had done with the other side. He hardly completed this side when the other side returned to its normal state. Then he returned to it to repeat what he had done before. I said to my two companions, 'Subhan Allah! Who are these two persons?' They said to me, 'Proceed!' So we proceeded and came across something like a Tannur (a kind of baking oven, a pit usually clay-lined for baking bread)." I think the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "In that oven there was much noise and voices." The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "We looked into it and found naked men and women, and behold, a flame of fire was reaching to them from underneath, and when it reached them, they cried loudly. I asked them, 'Who are these?' They said to me, 'Proceed!' And so we proceeded and came across a river." I think he said, ".... red like blood." The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "And behold, in the river there was a man swimming, and on the bank there was a man who had collected many stones. Behold, while the other man was swimming, he went near him. The former opened his mouth and the latter (on the bank) threw a stone into his mouth whereupon he went swimming again. He returned and every time the performance was repeated. I asked my two companions, 'Who are these (two) persons?' They replied, 'Proceed! Proceed!' And we proceeded till we came to a man with a repulsive appearance, the most repulsive appearance, you ever saw a man having! Beside him there was a fire and he was kindling it and running around it. I asked my companions, 'Who is this (man)?' They said to me, 'Proceed! Proceed!' So we proceeded till we reached a garden of deep green dense vegetation, having all sorts of spring colors. In the midst of the garden there was a very tall man and I could hardly see his head because of his great height, and around him there were children in such a large number as I have never seen. I said to my companions, 'Who is this?' They replied, 'Proceed! Proceed!' So we proceeded till we came to a majestic huge garden, greater and better than I have ever seen! My two companions said to me, 'Go up' and I went up. The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "So we ascended till we reached a city built of gold and silver bricks and we went to its gate and asked (the gatekeeper) to open the gate, and it was opened and we entered the city and found in it, men with one side of their bodies as handsome as the handsomest person you have ever seen, and the other side as ugly as the ugliest person you have ever seen. My two companions ordered those men to throw themselves into the river. Behold, there was a river flowing across (the city), and its water was like milk in whiteness. Those men went and threw themselves in it and then returned to us after the ugliness (of their bodies) had disappeared and they became in the best shape." The Prophet (ﷺ) further added, "My two companions (angels) said to me, 'This place is the Eden Paradise, and that is your place.' I raised up my sight, and behold, there I saw a palace like a white cloud! My two companions said to me, 'That (palace) is your place.' I said to them, 'May Allah bless you both! Let me enter it.' They replied, 'As for now, you will not enter it, but you shall enter it (one day). I said to them, 'I have seen many wonders tonight. What does all that mean which I have seen?' They replied, 'We will inform you: As for the first man you came upon whose head was being injured with the rock, he is the symbol of the one who studies the Qur'an and then neither recites it nor acts on its orders, and sleeps, neglecting the enjoined prayers. As for the man you came upon whose sides of mouth, nostrils and eyes were torn off from front to back, he is the symbol of the man who goes out of his house in the morning and tells so many lies that it spreads all over the world. And those naked men and women whom you saw in a construction resembling an oven, they are the adulterers and the adulteresses. And the man whom you saw swimming in the river and given a stone to swallow, is the eater of usury (Riba). And the bad looking man whom you saw near the fire kindling it and going round it, is Malik, the gatekeeper of Hell. And the tall man whom you saw in the garden, is Abraham and the children around him are those children who die with Al-Fitra (the Islamic Faith). The narrator added: Some Muslims asked the Prophet, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What about the children of pagans?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "And also the children of pagans." The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "My two companions added, 'The men you saw half handsome and half ugly were those persons who had mixed an act that was good with another that was bad, but Allah forgave them
hi: Samura bin Jundub (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aksar apne sahaaba se poochte, 'Kya tum mein se kisi ne koi khwaab dekha?' To khwaab unhein sunaaye jaate jinhein Allah chahta ke wo sunaayein. Ek subah Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Pichhli raat do log mere paas aaye (khwaab mein) aur mujhe jagaya aur mujhse kaha, "Chalo!" Main unke saath nikla aur humein ek aadmi mila jo leta hua tha, aur dekho, ek aur aadmi uske sar ke paas khada tha, ek bada patthar liye hue. Dekho, wo us patthar ko us aadmi ke sar par maar raha tha, use zakhmi kar raha tha. Patthar lud-kar door chala jaata aur maarne wala uska peecha karke use wapas le aata. Jab tak wo aadmi (leta hua) tak pahunchta, uska sar normal haalat mein wapas aa jaata. Phir maarne wala waisa hi karta jaisa usne pehle kiya tha. Maine apne do saathiyon se kaha, "Subhan Allah! Ye do log kaun hain?" Unhone kaha, "Chalo!" To hum aage badhe aur humein ek aadmi mila jo peeth ke bal leta hua tha aur ek aur aadmi uske sar ke paas khada tha, loha ke ek kaante ke saath, aur dekho, wo kaanta us aadmi ke munh ke ek taraf daalta aur us taraf ke chehre ko peechhe (gardan tak) faad deta, aur isi tarah uski naak ko aage se peeche tak aur uski aankh ko aage se peeche tak faad deta. Phir wo us aadmi ke chehre ki doosri taraf mudta aur waisa hi karta jaisa usne doosri taraf kiya tha. Wo isi taraf khatam bhi na karta ke doosri taraf normal haalat mein wapas aa jaati. Phir wo isi taraf wapas jaata taake usse dohraaye jo usne pehle kiya tha. Maine apne do saathiyon se kaha, "Subhan Allah! Ye do log kaun hain?" Unhone mujhse kaha, "Chalo!" To hum aage badhe aur humein kuch aisa mila jaise Tannur (ek qism ka roti pakaane ka bhatta, jo aksar mitti se lipa gadha hota hai).' Mujhe lagta hai Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Us bhatte mein bahut shor aur aawazein thi.' Nabi (SAW) ne izaafa kiya, 'Humne usmein jhaanka aur nange mard aur auratein paayi, aur dekho, aag ki ek lau neeche se unki taraf pahunch rahi thi, aur jab wo unhein chhoo-ti, wo zor se cheekhte. Maine pucha, "Ye kaun hain?" Unhone mujhse kaha, "Chalo!" Aur hum aage badhe aur humein ek nadi mili.' Mujhe lagta hai unhone kaha, '...khoon jaisi laal.' Nabi (SAW) ne izaafa kiya, 'Aur dekho, nadi mein ek aadmi tair raha tha, aur kinaare par ek aadmi tha jisne bahut se patthar jama kiye the. Dekho, jab doosra aadmi tair raha tha, wo (pehla) uske paas gaya. Us tairne wale ne apna munh khola aur (kinaare wale) ne uske munh mein ek patthar phenka jispar wo dobara tairne laga. Wo wapas aata aur har baar ye silsila dohraaya jaata. Maine apne do saathiyon se pucha, "Ye (do) log kaun hain?" Unhone jawab diya, "Chalo! Chalo!" Aur hum aage badhe yahaan tak ke hum ek aise aadmi ke paas pahunche jiski shakl bahut ghinauni thi, sabse ghinauni shakl jo tumne kabhi kisi aadmi ki dekhi ho! Uske paas ek aag thi aur wo use sulga raha tha aur uske gird daud raha tha. Maine apne saathiyon se pucha, "Ye (aadmi) kaun hai?" Unhone mujhse kaha, "Chalo! Chalo!" To hum aage badhe yahaan tak ke hum ek gehre hare-bhare paudho waale baag mein pahunche, jahaan bahaar ke sab rangon ki bharmaar thi. Baag ke beech mein ek bahut lambaa aadmi tha aur main uska sar uski itni oonchaai ki wajah se mushkil se dekh paa raha tha, aur uske aas-paas itne zyaada bacche the ke maine kabhi aise nahi dekhe. Maine kaha, "Ye kaun hai?" Unhone jawab diya, "Chalo! Chalo!" To hum aage badhe yahaan tak ke hum ek shaandaar bade baag tak pahunche, jo maine kabhi dekhe hue baagon se bhi bada aur behtar tha! Mere do saathiyon ne mujhse kaha, "Oopar jao," aur main oopar gaya.' Nabi (SAW) ne izaafa kiya, 'To hum chadhte gaye yahaan tak ke hum sone aur chaandi ki eenton se banaaya hua ek shehar pahunche aur uske darwaaze tak gaye aur (darwaaze khole jaane ki) darkhwaast ki, aur wo khola gaya, aur hum shehar mein daakhil hue aur wahaan aise log paaye jinke jism ka ek taraf itna khoobsoorat tha jitna sabse khoobsoorat aadmi jo tumne kabhi dekha ho, aur doosri taraf itni ghinauni jitna sabse ghinauna aadmi jo tumne kabhi dekha ho. Mere do saathiyon ne un logon ko nadi mein kudne ka hukm diya. Dekho, wahaan (shehar ke) beech se ek nadi bahti thi, aur uska paani doodh jaisa safed tha. Wo log gaye aur usmein kud gaye aur phir hamare paas wapas aaye baad mein unki ghinaunapan (unke jismon ki) gaayab ho gayi thi aur wo sabse achhe soorat mein aa gaye the.' Nabi (SAW) ne aage izaafa kiya, 'Mere do saathiyon (farishtwon) ne mujhse kaha, "Ye jagah Eden ki Jannat hai, aur wo aapki jagah hai." Maine apni nazar oopar uthaayi, aur dekho, wahaan maine ek mahal dekha jo ek safed baadal jaisa tha! Mere do saathiyon ne mujhse kaha, "Wo (mahal) aapki jagah hai." Maine unse kaha, "Allah tumhein barkat de! Mujhe usmein daakhil hone do." Unhone jawab diya, "Abhi, aap usmein daakhil nahi honge, magar aap (ek din) usmein zaroor daakhil honge." Maine unse kaha, "Maine aaj raat bahut si ajooba cheezein dekhi. In sab ka kya matlab hai jo maine dekha?" Unhone jawab diya, "Hum aapko bataayenge: Jahaan tak us pehle aadmi ki baat hai jisse aap mile jiska sar patthar se zakhmi kiya jaa raha tha, wo us aadmi ka pratik hai jo Quran padhta hai aur phir na ise (roz) padhta hai na iske hukmon par amal karta hai, aur farz namaz ko nazar-andaaz karke sota hai. Jahaan tak us aadmi ki baat hai jisse aap mile jiske munh, naak aur aankhon ke hisse aage se peeche tak faade jaa rahe the, wo us aadmi ka pratik hai jo subah apne ghar se nikalta hai aur itne jhoot bolta hai ke wo poori duniya mein phail jaate hain. Aur wo nange mard aur auraten jo aapne ek bhatte jaisi banaawat mein dekhe, wo zaani mard aur zaani auraten hain. Aur wo aadmi jise aapne nadi mein tairte aur ek patthar nigalte dekha, wo sood (Riba) khaane wala hai. Aur wo bura dikhne wala aadmi jise aapne aag ke paas sulgaate aur uske gird ghoomte dekha, wo Malik hai, Jahannam ka darwaan. Aur wo lambaa aadmi jise aapne baag mein dekha, wo Ibrahim hain aur unke aas-paas ke bacche wo bacche hain jo Al-Fitra (Islami Iman) mein mare."' Ravi ne izaafa kiya: Kuch Musalmaanon ne Nabi (SAW) se pucha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mushrikon ke bachon ka kya?' Nabi (SAW) ne jawab diya, 'Aur mushrikon ke bachon ka bhi.' Nabi (SAW) ne izaafa kiya, 'Mere do saathiyon ne izaafa kiya, "Wo log jo aapne aadha khoobsoorat aur aadha ghinauna dekhe, wo wo log the jinhone ek achhe amal ko ek bure amal ke saath mila diya tha, magar Allah ne unhein maaf kar diya."'

e: Narrated Asma':The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I will be at my Lake-Fount (Kauthar) waiting for whoever will come to me. Then some people will be taken away from me whereupon I will say, 'My followers!' It will be said, 'You do not know they turned Apostates as renegades (deserted their religion).'" (Ibn Abi Mulaika said, "Allah, we seek refuge with You from turning on our heels from the (Islamic) religion and from being put to trial
hi: Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Main apne Hauz (Al-Kauthar) par intezaar karunga jo bhi mere paas aayega. Phir kuch logon ko mujhse door kar diya jaayega, isper main kahoonga, "Mere maanne wale!" Kaha jaayega, "Aapko nahi pata wo murtad ho gaye (Islam se peechhe hat gaye)."' (Ibn Abi Mulaika ne kaha, 'Aye Allah, hum apne (Islami) deen se ulat jaane se aur azmaaish mein daale jaane se teri panaah maangte hain.')

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I am your predecessor at the Lake-Fount (Kauthar) and some men amongst you will be brought to me, and when I will try to hand them some water, they will be pulled away from me by force whereupon I will say, 'O Lord, my companions!' Then the Almighty will say, 'You do not know what they did after you left, they introduced new things into the religion after you
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Main Hauz (Al-Kauthar) par tumse pehle jaane wala hoon aur tum mein se kuch logon ko mere paas laaya jaayega, aur jab main unhein paani dene ki koshish karunga, unhein zabardasti mujhse dhakel diya jaayega, isper main kahoonga, "Aye Rab, mere saathi!" Phir Qaadir-e-Mutlaq kahega, "Tumhein nahi pata unhone tumhaare jaane ke baad kya kiya, unhone deen mein naye kaam (bidaat) shuru kiye."'

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "I am your predecessor at the Lake-Fount (Kauthar), and whoever will come to it, will drink from it, and whoever will drink from it, will never become thirsty after that. There will come to me some people whom I know and they know me, and then a barrier will be set up between me and them
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, 'Main Hauz (Al-Kauthar) par tumse pehle jaane wala hoon, aur jo koi bhi wahaan aayega, wo usmein se piyega, aur jo koi usmein se piyega, wo phir kabhi pyaasa nahi hoga. Kuch log mere paas aayenge jinhein main jaanta hoon aur wo mujhe jaante hain, aur phir mere aur unke beech ek rukaawat khadi ki jaayegi.'

e: Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri added that the Prophet (ﷺ) further said:"I will say those people are from me. It will be said, 'You do not know what changes and new things they did after you.' Then I will say, 'Far removed (from mercy), far removed (from mercy), those who changed (the religion) after me
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne izaafa kiya ke Nabi (SAW) ne aage farmaya, 'Main kahoonga wo log mere hain. Kaha jaayega, "Aapko nahi pata unhone tumhaare jaane ke baad kya badlaav aur naye kaam kiye." Phir main kahoonga, "Door ho jaao (rehmat se), door ho jaao (rehmat se), wo log jinhone mere baad (deen) badal diya."'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to us, "You will see after me, selfishness (on the part of other people) and other matters that you will disapprove of." They asked, "What do you order us to do, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? (under such circumstances)?" He said, "Pay their rights to them (to the rulers) and ask your right from Allah
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humse kaha, 'Tum mere baad khud-garzi (khudgharzi) dekhoge (doosre logon ki taraf se) aur aisi baaten dekhoge jinhein tum napasand karoge.' Unhone (logon ne) pucha, 'Aap humein kya hukm dete hain, Aye Allah ke Rasool? (aise haalaat mein)' Unhone kaha, 'Unke (hukmraan ke) haq unhein ada karo, aur apna haq Allah se maango.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever disapproves of something done by his ruler then he should be patient, for whoever disobeys the ruler even a little (little = a span) will die as those who died in the Pre-Islamic Period of Ignorance. (i.e. as rebellious Sinners)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi apne hukmraan ki kisi baat ko napasand kare, use sabra karna chaahiye, kyunke jo koi hukmraan ki thodi si bhi nafarmaani kare (thodi si = ek bitta) aur mar jaaye, wo usi tarah marega jaise Jaahiliyat (Islam se pehle) ke daur mein log marte the (yaani baaghi gunahgaar ke taur par).'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever notices something which he dislikes done by his ruler, then he should be patient, for whoever becomes separate from the company of the Muslims even for a span and then dies, he will die as those who died in the Pre-Islamic period of Ignorance (as rebellious sinners). (Fath-ul-Bari page 112, Vol)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi apne hukmraan ki taraf se koi aisi baat notice kare jo use napasand ho, to use sabra karna chaahiye, kyunke jo koi Musalmaanon ki jamaat se ek bitta (span) bhi alag ho jaaye aur phir mar jaaye, wo usi tarah marega jaise Jaahiliyat (Islam se pehle) ke daur mein log marte the (baaghi gunahgaar ke taur par).' (Poori tafseel ke liye Fath-ul-Bari, Page 112, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated Junada bin Abi Umaiya:We entered upon 'Ubada bin As-Samit while he was sick. We said, "May Allah make you healthy. Will you tell us a Hadith you heard from the Prophet (ﷺ) and by which Allah may make you benefit?" He said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) called us and we gave him the Pledge of allegiance for Islam, and among the conditions on which he took the Pledge from us, was that we were to listen and obey (the orders) both at the time when we were active and at the time when we were tired, and at our difficult time and at our ease and to be obedient to the ruler and give him his right even if he did not give us our right, and not to fight against him unless we noticed him having open Kufr (disbelief) for which we would have a proof with us from Allah
hi: Junada bin Abi Umaiya bataate hain: Hum Ubada bin As-Samit se milne gaye jabke wo bimar the. Humne kaha, 'Allah aapko sehatmand kare. Kya aap humein koi hadees sunaayenge jo aapne Nabi (SAW) se suni ho aur jisse Allah humein faayda pahunchaaye?' Unhone kaha, 'Nabi (SAW) ne humein bulaaya aur humne unhein Islam ki baiyat di, aur un shartein mein se jo unhone humse ahad liya, ye bhi tha ke hum sunenge aur (hukmon ko) maanenge, chaahe hum betaab hon ya thake hue, aur hamare mushkil waqt mein aur aasaan waqt mein, aur hukmraan ki farmaanbardaari karenge aur use uska haq denge chaahe wo hamein hamara haq na de, aur uske khilaaf tab tak nahi ladenge jab tak hum unmein khula Kufr (na-shukri) na dekhein, jiske liye hamare paas Allah ki taraf se saboot ho.'

e: Narrated Usaid bin Hudair:A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! You appointed such-and-such person and you did not appoint me?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "After me you will see rulers not giving you your right (but you should give them their right) and be patient till you meet me
hi: Usaid bin Hudair bataate hain: Ek shaks Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Aapne falaan-falaan shaks ko (kisi ohde par) muqarrar kiya aur mujhe nahi kiya?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Mere baad tum aise hukmraan dekhoge jo tumhein tumhaara haq nahi denge (magar tumhein unhein unka haq dena chaahiye), aur sabra karo jab tak tum mujhse mulaakaat nahi karte.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard the truthful and trusted by Allah (i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ) ) saying, "The destruction of my followers will be through the hands of young men from Quraish
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine sacche aur Allah ke bharosemand (yaani Nabi SAW) ko ye kehte suna, 'Mere maanne walon ki barbaadi Quraish ke jawaan logon ke haathon hogi.'

e: Narrated Zainab bint Jahsh:The Prophet (ﷺ) got up from his sleep with a flushed red face and said, "None has the right to be worshipped but Allah. Woe to the Arabs, from the Great evil that is nearly approaching them. Today a gap has been made in the wall of Gog and Magog like this." (Sufyan illustrated by this forming the number 90 or 100 with his fingers.) It was asked, "Shall we be destroyed though there are righteous people among us?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Yes, if evil increased
hi: Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Jahsh (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) apni neend se laal-laal chehre ke saath uthe aur kaha, 'Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi. Afsos hai Arabon par, us bade fasaad ki wajah se jo unke qareeb aa raha hai. Aaj Yajuj aur Majuj ki deewaar mein itna bada rakhna khul gaya hai.' (Sufyan ne apni ungliyon se ninety ya sau ka nishaan bana kar ise samjhaaya.) Pucha gaya, 'Kya hum barbaad ho jaayenge halaanke hamare beech neik log hain?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Haan, agar buraai badh jaaye.'

e: Narrated Usama bin Zaid:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) stood over one of the high buildings of Medina and then said (to the people), "Do you see what I see?" They said, "No." He said, "I see afflictions falling among your houses as rain drops fall
hi: Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Nabi (SAW) Madina ki ek ooncha imaarat par khade hue aur (logon se) kaha, 'Kya tum wo dekhte ho jo main dekhta hoon?' Unhone kaha, 'Nahi.' Unhone kaha, 'Main tumhaare gharon ke beech museebaten (fitne) aise girte dekh raha hoon jaise baarish ki boondein girti hain.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Time will pass rapidly, good deeds will decrease, miserliness will be thrown (in the hearts of the people) afflictions will appear and there will be much 'Al-Harj." They said, "O Allah's Apostle! What is "Al-Harj?" He said, "Killing! Killing!" (See Hadith No. 63, Vol)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Waqt tezi se guzrega, nek amaal kam ho jaayenge, kanjoosi (logon ke dilon mein) daali jaayegi, museebaten (fitne) zaahir honge aur bahut zyaada Al-Harj hoga.' Unhone (logon ne) pucha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Al-Harj kya hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Qatl! Qatl!' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 63, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated `Abdullah and Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Near the establishment of the Hour there will be days during which Religious ignorance will spread, knowledge will be taken away (vanish) and there will be much Al-Harj, and Al- Harj means killing
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Qayamat ke qareeb aise din aayenge jinmein deeni jahaalat phailegi, ilm (uthaa liya jaayega) gaayab ho jaayega, aur bahut zyaada Al-Harj hoga, aur Al-Harj ka matlab hai qatl.'

e: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Near the establishment of the Hour there will be days during which (religious) knowledge will be taken away (vanish) and general ignorance will spread, and there will be Al-Harj in abundance, and Al-Harj means killing
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Qayamat ke qareeb aise din aayenge jinmein (deeni) ilm uthaa liya jaayega (gaayab ho jaayega) aur aam jahaalat phailegi, aur Al-Harj bahut zyaada hoga, aur Al-Harj ka matlab hai qatl.'

e: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said...(as above, 185). And Harj, in the Ethiopian language, means killing
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya... (jaisa upar zikr hua)... aur Harj, Habshi (Ethiopian) zubaan mein, qatl ka matlab hai.

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Near the establishment of the Hour, there will be the days of Al-Harj, and the religious knowledge will be taken away (vanish i.e. by the death of Religious scholars) and general ignorance will spread." Abu Musa said, "Al-Harj, in the Ethiopian language, means killing
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Qayamat ke qareeb, Al-Harj ke din aayenge, aur deeni ilm uthaa liya jaayega (yaani aalimon ki maut se gaayab ho jaayega) aur aam jahaalat phailegi.' Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Al-Harj, Habshi (Ethiopian) zubaan mein, qatl ka matlab hai.'

e: Ibn Mas`ud added: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying; (It will be) from among the most wicked people who will be living at the time when the Hour will be established
hi: Ibn Masud ne izaafa kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: '(Wo) sabse buraayi karne wale logon mein se honge jo us waqt zinda honge jab Qayamat aayegi.'

e: Narrated Az-Zubair bin `Adi:We went to Anas bin Malik and complained about the wrong we were suffering at the hand of Al- Hajjaj. Anas bin Malik said, "Be patient till you meet your Lord, for no time will come upon you but the time following it will be worse than it. I heard that from the Prophet
hi: Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Adi bataate hain: Hum Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas gaye aur Al-Hajjaj ke haathon jo zulm hum bhugat rahe the uski shikaayat ki. Anas bin Malik ne kaha, 'Sabra karo jab tak tum apne Rab se mulaakaat nahi karte, kyunke koi bhi waqt aisa nahi aayega jiske baad ka waqt usse aur bura na ho. Maine ye Nabi (SAW) se suna.'

e: Narrated Um Salama:(the wife of the Prophet) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) woke up one night in a state of terror and said, "Subhan Allah, How many treasures Allah has sent down! And how many afflictions have been sent down! Who will go and wake the lady dwellers (wives of the Prophet) up of these rooms (for prayers)?" He meant his wives, so that they might pray. He added, "A well-dressed (soul) in this world may be naked in the Hereafter
hi: Umm Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki zawja) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek raat khauf ki haalat mein neend se uthe aur kaha, 'Subhan Allah! Kitne khazaane Allah ne naazil kiye hain! Aur kitni museebaten naazil hui hain! Kaun jaakar in kamron mein rehne wali khawaateen ko jagayega (namaz ke liye)?' Unka ishara apni biwiyon ki taraf tha, taake wo namaz padh sakein. Unhone izaafa kiya, 'Is duniya mein achhe kapde pehne ek jaan Aakhirat mein nangi ho sakti hai.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever takes up arms against us, is not from us
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi hamare khilaaf hathiyaar uthaata hai, wo humme se nahi hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever takes up arms against us, is not from us
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi hamare khilaaf hathiyaar uthaata hai, wo humme se nahi hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "None of you should point out towards his Muslim brother with a weapon, for he does not know, Satan may tempt him to hit him and thus he would fall into a pit of fire (Hell)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Tum mein se koi bhi apne Musalmaan bhai ki taraf hathiyaar se ishara na kare, kyunke use nahi pata, shaayad Shaitaan use usse maarne ke liye uksaaye aur wo (natije mein) Aag ke gaddhe mein gir jaaye (Jahannam mein).'

e: Narrated Sufyan:I said to `Amr, "O Abu Muhammad! Did you hear Jabir bin `Abdullah saying, 'A man carrying arrows passed through the mosque and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him, 'Hold the arrows by their heads! "`Amr replied, "Yes
hi: Sufyan bataate hain: Maine Amr se kaha, 'Aye Abu Muhammad! Kya aapne Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko ye kehte suna, "Ek shaks teer le kar Masjid se guzra aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne usse kaha, 'Teeron ke sar (nokdaar hisse) pakdo!'"?' Amr ne jawab diya, 'Haan.'

e: Narrated Jabir:A man passed through the mosque and he was carrying arrows, the heads of which were exposed (protruding). The man was ordered (by the Prophet) to hold the iron heads so that it might not scratch (injure) any Muslim
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks Masjid se guzra aur wo teer le kar chal raha tha, jinke sar (nokdaar hisse) khule hue the. Us shaks ko (Nabi ne) hukm diya ke wo loha ke sar pakde taake wo kisi Musalmaan ko khaanch (chubho) na de.

e: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If anyone of you passed through our mosque or through our market while carrying arrows, he should hold the iron heads," or said, "..... he should hold (their heads) firmly with his hand lest he should injure one of the Muslims with it
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar tum mein se koi hamari Masjid ya hamare bazaar se guzre jabke wo teer le kar chal raha ho, use loha ke sar pakadne chaahiye,' ya kaha, '...use unhein apne haath se mazbooti se pakadna chaahiye taake wo kisi Musalmaan ko chot na pahunchaaye.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet, said, "Abusing a Muslim is Fusuq (evil doing) and killing him is Kufr (disbelief)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kisi Musalmaan ko bura-bhala kehna Fusuq (badkaari) hai, aur use qatl karna Kufr (na-shukri) hai.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Do not revert to disbelief after me by striking (cutting) the necks of one another
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, 'Mere baad ek doosre ki gardanein kaat kar Kufr ki taraf mat laut jaana.'

e: Narrated Abu Bakra:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) addressed the people saying, "Don't you know what is the day today?" They replied, "Allah and His Apostle know better." We thought that he might give that day another name. The Prophet said, "Isn't it the day of An-Nahr?" We replied, "Yes. O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." He then said, "What town is this? Isn't it the forbidden (Sacred) Town (Mecca)?" We replied, "Yes, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." He then said, "Your blood, your properties, your honors and your skins (i.e., bodies) are as sacred to one another like the sanctity of this day of yours in this month of yours in this town of yours. (Listen) Haven't I conveyed Allah's message to you?" We replied, "Yes" He said, "O Allah! Be witness (for it). So it is incumbent upon those who are present to convey it (this message of mine) to those who are absent because the informed one might comprehend what I have said better than the present audience who will convey it to him.)" The narrator added: In fact, it was like that. The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "Beware! Do not renegade as disbelievers after me by striking (cutting) the necks of one another
hi: Abu Bakra (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne logon se khitaab karte hue kaha, 'Kya tumhein pata hai aaj kaunsa din hai?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Allah aur uska Rasool behtar jaante hain.' Humein laga wo ise koi aur naam denge. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Kya ye An-Nahr ka din nahi hai?' Humne jawab diya, 'Haan, Aye Allah ke Rasool.' Phir unhone kaha, 'Ye kaunsa shehar hai? Kya ye muqaddas (Sacred) shehar (Makkah) nahi hai?' Humne jawab diya, 'Haan, Aye Allah ke Rasool.' Phir unhone kaha, 'Tumhaara khoon, tumhaari jaayadaad, tumhaari izzat, aur tumhaari khaal (jism) ek doosre ke liye utne hi muqaddas hain jitna aaj ka ye din, is mahine mein, is shehar mein, muqaddas hai. (Suno) Kya maine tumhein Allah ka paighaam pahuncha diya?' Humne jawab diya, 'Haan.' Unhone kaha, 'Aye Allah! Iska gawaah reh. Isliye jo bhi yahaan maujood hain unhein chaahiye ke wo ye (mera paighaam) unhein pahunchaayein jo gair-haazir hain, kyunke shaayad jise ye khabar milegi wo isse behtar samjhega us maujood shrota (sunne wale) se jo use aage pahunchaayega.' Ravi ne izaafa kiya: Haqeeqat mein aisa hi hua. Nabi (SAW) ne izaafa kiya, 'Khabardaar! Mere baad ek doosre ki gardanein kaat kar kaafir ban jaana mat.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Beware! Do not renegade as (disbelievers) after me by striking (cutting) the necks of one another
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Khabardaar! Mere baad ek doosre ki gardanein kaat kar (kaafir) ban jaana mat.'

e: Narrated Jarir:The Prophet (ﷺ) said to me during Hajjat-al-Wada`, "Let the people keep quiet and listen." Then he said (addressing the people), "Beware! Do not renegade as disbelievers after me by striking (cutting) the necks of one another
hi: Jarir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne mujhse Hajjat-ul-Wada ke dauraan kaha, 'Logon ko khaamosh rehne do aur suno.' Phir unhone (logon se khitaab karte hue) kaha, 'Khabardaar! Mere baad kaafir mat ban jaana (murtad hokar), ek doosre ki gardanein kaat kar.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "There will be afflictions (in the near future) during which a sitting person will be better than a standing one, and the standing one will be better than the walking one, and the walking one will be better than the running one, and whoever will expose himself to these afflictions, they will destroy him. So whoever can find a place of protection or refuge from them, should take shelter in it
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, '(Aane wale waqt mein) museebaten (fitne) aayenge jinke dauraan baitha hua shaks khade hue shaks se behtar hoga, aur khada shaks chalne wale se behtar hoga, aur chalne wala daudne wale se behtar hoga, aur jo koi khud ko in museebaton ke saamne pesh karega, wo use tabaah kar denge. Isliye jo koi bhi inse bachaao ya panaah ki jagah paaye, use wahaan panaah lena chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "There will be afflictions (in the near future) during which a sitting person will be better than a standing one, and the standing one will be better than a walking one, and the walking one will be better than a running one, and whoever will expose himself to these afflictions, they will destroy him. So whoever can find a place of protection or refuge from them, should take shelter in it
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, '(Aane wale waqt mein) museebaten (fitne) aayenge jinke dauraan baitha hua shaks khade hue shaks se behtar hoga, aur khada shaks chalne wale se behtar hoga, aur chalne wala daudne wale se behtar hoga, aur jo koi khud ko in museebaton ke saamne pesh karega, wo use tabaah kar denge. Isliye jo koi bhi inse bachaao ya panaah ki jagah paaye, use wahaan panaah lena chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Al-Hasan:(Al-Ahnaf said:) I went out carrying my arms during the nights of the affliction (i.e. the war between `Ali and `Aisha) and Abu Bakra met me and asked, "Where are you going?" I replied, "I intend to help the cousin of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (i.e.,`Ali)." Abu Bakra said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'If two Muslims take out their swords to fight each other, then both of them will be from amongst the people of the Hell- Fire.' It was said to the Prophet, 'It is alright for the killer but what about the killed one?' He replied, 'The killed one had the intention to kill his opponent.'" (See Hadith No. 30, Vol. 1) Narrated Al-Ahnaf: Abu Bakra said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said (as above)
hi: Al-Hasan bataate hain: (Al-Ahnaf ne kaha:) Main museebat (yaani Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke beech jang) ki raaton mein apne hathiyaar lekar nikla, aur Abu Bakra (رضی اللہ عنہ) mujhse mile aur pucha, 'Tum kahaan jaa rahe ho?' Maine jawab diya, 'Mera iraada Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke chachazaad (yaani Ali (Alayhis Salam)) ki madad karna hai.' Abu Bakra ne kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, "Agar do Musalmaan apni talwaaron ke saath ek doosre se ladne ke liye nikalte hain, to (dono) Jahannam ke logon mein se honge." Nabi se pucha gaya, "Qaatil ke liye to theek hai, magar maqtool ka kya?" Unhone jawab diya, "Maqtool ka bhi apne mukhaalif ko qatl karne ka iraada tha."' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 30, Jild 1 dekhein.) Al-Ahnaf bataate hain: Abu Bakra ne kaha: Nabi (SAW) ne (upar wali baat) kahi.

e: Narrated Hudhaifa bin Al-Yaman:The people used to ask Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about the good but I used to ask him about the evil lest I should be overtaken by them. So I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We were living in ignorance and in an (extremely) worst atmosphere, then Allah brought to us this good (i.e., Islam); will there be any evil after this good?" He said, "Yes." I said, 'Will there be any good after that evil?" He replied, "Yes, but it will be tainted (not pure.)'' I asked, "What will be its taint?" He replied, "(There will be) some people who will guide others not according to my tradition? You will approve of some of their deeds and disapprove of some others." I asked, "Will there be any evil after that good?" He replied, "Yes, (there will be) some people calling at the gates of the (Hell) Fire, and whoever will respond to their call, will be thrown by them into the (Hell) Fire." I said, "O Allah's Apostle! Will you describe them to us?" He said, "They will be from our own people and will speak our language." I said, "What do you order me to do if such a state should take place in my life?" He said, "Stick to the group of Muslims and their Imam (ruler)." I said, "If there is neither a group of Muslims nor an Imam (ruler)?" He said, "Then turn away from all those sects even if you were to bite (eat) the roots of a tree till death overtakes you while you are in that state
hi: Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Yaman bataate hain: Log Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se achhaai ke baare mein poochte the, magar main unse buraai ke baare mein poochta tha is dar se ke wo mujhpar bhaari na pad jaaye. To maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Hum jahaalat aur (bahut) buri fizaa mein rehte the, phir Allah ne hamare paas ye bhalaai (yaani Islam) laayi; kya is bhalaai ke baad koi buraai hogi?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan.' Maine kaha, 'Kya us buraai ke baad koi bhalaai hogi?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Haan, magar wo aludaa (na-shuddh) hogi.' Maine pucha, 'Uski aludaagi kya hogi?' Unhone jawab diya, '(Kuch log honge) jo doosron ko meri riwaayat ke mutaabik hidaayat nahi denge? Tum unke kuch amaalon ko sahi maanoge aur kuch ko galat.' Maine pucha, 'Kya us bhalaai ke baad koi buraai hogi?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Haan, (kuch log) Jahannam ki Aag ke darwaazon par bulaayenge, aur jo koi bhi unki pukaar ka jawab dega, wo unhein (Jahannam ki) Aag mein phenk denge.' Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya aap humein unki tashreeh karenge?' Unhone kaha, 'Wo hamare hi log honge aur hamari zubaan bolenge.' Maine pucha, 'Aap mujhe kya hukm dete hain agar meri zindagi mein aisi haalat aa jaaye?' Unhone kaha, 'Musalmaanon ki jamaat aur unke Imam (hukmraan) se juda raho.' Maine pucha, 'Agar na koi Musalmaanon ki jamaat ho aur na Imam (hukmraan)?' Unhone kaha, 'Phir un sab firqon se door raho, chaahe tumhein maut aane tak kisi darakht ki jadein hi kyun na kaatni (khaani) padein.'

e: Narrated Abu Al-Aswad:An army unit was being recruited from the people of Medina and my name was written among them. Then I met `Ikrima, and when I informed him about it, he discouraged me very strongly and said, "Ibn `Abbas told me that there were some Muslims who were with the pagans to increase their number against Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (and the Muslim army) so arrows (from the Muslim army) would hit one of them and kill him or a Muslim would strike him (with his sword) and kill him. So Allah revealed:-- 'Verily! As for those whom the angels take (in death) while they are wronging themselves (by staying among the disbelievers)
hi: Abu Al-Aswad bataate hain: Ek fauji dasta Madina ke logon mein se bharti kiya jaa raha tha aur mera naam bhi unmein likha gaya. Phir main Ikrima se mila, aur jab maine unhein iske baare mein bataaya, unhone mujhe bahut sakhti se rokne ki koshish ki aur kaha, 'Ibn Abbas ne mujhe bataaya ke kuch Musalmaan mushrikon ke saath the taake unki tadaad Allah ke Rasool (SAW) (aur Musalmaan fauj) ke khilaaf badh sake, isliye (Musalmaan fauj ke) teer unmein se kisi ko lagte aur use qatl kar dete, ya koi Musalmaan use (apni talwaar se) maar kar qatl kar deta. To Allah ne naazil kiya: "Beshak! Un logon ke baare mein jinhein farishte (maut mein) uthaate hain jabke wo khud par zulm kar rahe hote hain (kaafiron ke beech rehkar)..." (4:97)'

e: Narrated Hudhaifa:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) related to us, two prophetic narrations one of which I have seen fulfilled and I am waiting for the fulfillment of the other. The Prophet (ﷺ) told us that the virtue of honesty descended in the roots of men's hearts (from Allah) and then they learned it from the Qur'an and then they learned it from the Sunna (the Prophet's traditions).
