The Prophet (ﷺ) further told us how that honesty will be taken away: He said: "Man will go to sleep during which honesty will be taken away from his heart and only its trace will remain in his heart like the trace of a dark spot; then man will go to sleep, during which honesty will decrease further still, so that its trace will resemble the trace of blister as when an ember is dropped on one's foot which would make it swell, and one would see it swollen but there would be nothing inside. People would be carrying out their trade but hardly will there be a trustworthy person. It will be said, 'in such-and-such tribe there is an honest man,' and later it will be said about some man, 'What a wise, polite and strong man he is!' Though he will not have faith equal even to a mustard seed in his heart." No doubt, there came upon me a time when I did not mind dealing (bargaining) with anyone of you, for if he was a Muslim his Islam would compel him to pay me what is due to me, and if he was a Christian, the Muslim official would compel him to pay me what is due to me, but today I do not deal except with such-and-such person
hi: Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein do Nabuwwati riwaayaten sunaayi jinmein se ek ko maine poora hote dekha hai aur main doosri ke poora hone ka intezaar kar raha hoon. Nabi (SAW) ne humein bataya ke amaanat (imaandaari) ki khoobi (Allah ki taraf se) logon ke dilon ki jadon mein utri, aur phir unhone use Quran se seekha, phir unhone use Sunnat (Nabi ki riwaayaton) se seekha. Nabi (SAW) ne aage humein bataya ke kaise wo amaanat cheeni jaayegi: Unhone kaha, 'Aadmi so-ega jiske dauraan amaanat uske dil se le li jaayegi, aur sirf uska nishaan bachega, ek dhundhle daagh ke nishaan jaisa; phir aadmi so-ega, jiske dauraan amaanat aur kam ho jaayegi, isliye uska nishaan aise chhaale jaisa ho jaayega jaise jab ek angaara kisi ke pair par gire jisse wo phool jaata hai, aur koi use phoola hua dekhta hai magar usmein kuch nahi hota. Log tijaarat karte rahenge magar shaayad hi koi bharosemand shaks hoga. Kaha jaayega, "Falaan qabeele mein ek imaandaar aadmi hai," aur baad mein kisi shaks ke baare mein kaha jaayega, "Wo kitna aqlmand, shaista aur mazboot aadmi hai!" Halaanke uske dil mein sarson ke daane jitna bhi Iman nahi hoga.' Beshak, mujhpar ek waqt aaya jab mujhe tum mein se kisi ke saath vyavahaar (khareed-farokht) karne mein koi harj nahi hota tha, kyunke agar wo Musalmaan hota, uska Islam use majboor karta ke wo mujhe mera haq de, aur agar wo Isaai hota, Musalmaan afsar use majboor karte ke wo mujhe mera haq de, magar aaj main sirf falaan-falaan shaks ke saath hi vyavahaar karta hoon.

e: Narrated Salama bin Al-Akwa`:That he visited Al-Hajjaj (bin Yusuf). Al-Hajjaj said, "O son of Al-Akwa`! You have turned on your heels (i.e., deserted Islam) by staying (in the desert) with the bedouins." Salama replied, "No, but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) allowed me to stay with the bedouin in the desert." Narrated Yazid bin Abi Ubaid: When `Uthman bin `Affan was killed (martyred), Salama bin Al-Akwa` went out to a place called Ar- Rabadha and married there and begot children, and he stayed there till a few nights before his death when he came to Medina
hi: Salama bin Al-Akwa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke unhone Al-Hajjaj (bin Yusuf) se mulaakaat ki. Al-Hajjaj ne kaha, 'Aye Al-Akwa ke bete! Tum badawiyon ke saath (registaan mein) rehkar apni edi par ghoom gaye ho (yaani Islam chhod diya hai).' Salama ne jawab diya, 'Nahi, magar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe badawiyon ke saath registaan mein rehne ki ijaazat di thi.' Yazid bin Abi Ubaid bataate hain: Jab Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Affan shaheed hue, Salama bin Al-Akwa Ar-Rabadha naami jagah gaye aur wahaan shaadi ki aur bacche paida kiye, aur wo wahaan apni maut se kuch raatein pehle tak rahe jab wo Madina wapas aaye.

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "There will come a time when the best property of a Muslim will be sheep which he will take to the tops of mountains and the places of rainfall so as to flee with his religion from the afflictions
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Aisa waqt aayega jab Musalmaan ki sabse behtareen daulat bakriyaan hongi jinhein wo pahaadon ki chotiyon aur baarish ki jagahon par le jaayega, apne deen ke saath museebaton (fitno) se bhaag kar.'

e: Narrated Anas:The people started asking the Prophet (ﷺ) too many questions importunately. So one day he ascended the pulpit and said, "You will not ask me any question but I will explain it to you." I looked right and left, and behold, every man was covering his head with his garment and weeping. Then got up a man who, whenever quarreling with somebody, used to be accused of not being the son of his father. He said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Who is my father?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Your father is Hudhaifa." Then `Umar got up and said, "We accept Allah as our Lord, Islam as our religion and Muhammad as our Apostle and we seek refuge with Allah from the evil of afflictions." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, " I have never seen the good and bad like on this day. No doubt, Paradise and Hell was displayed in front of me till I saw them in front of that wall," Qatada said: This Hadith used to be mentioned as an explanation of this Verse:-- 'O you who believe! Ask not questions about things which, if made plain to you, may cause you trouble
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Log Nabi (SAW) se bahut zyaada sawaal poochne lage, be-adabi se. To ek din Nabi (SAW) mimbar par chadhe aur kaha, 'Tum jo bhi sawaal poochoge, main tumhein uska jawab dunga.' Maine daaen aur baaen dekha, aur dekho, har aadmi apna sar apne kapde se dhaanke ro raha tha. Phir ek shaks khada hua jo jab bhi kisi se jhagda karta, use us baat ka ilzaam lagaaya jaata ke wo apne waalid ka beta nahi hai. Usne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mera baap kaun hai?' Nabi (SAW) ne jawab diya, 'Tumhaara baap Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) hai.' Phir Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) khade hue aur kaha, 'Hum Allah ko apna Rab, Islam ko apna deen, aur Muhammad ko apna Rasool maante hain, aur hum museebaton (fitno) ki buraai se Allah ki panaah maangte hain.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Maine aaj jaisi achhaai aur buraai kabhi nahi dekhi. Beshak, Jannat aur Jahannam mere saamne pesh kiye gaye yahaan tak ke maine unhein is deewaar ke bilkul aage dekha.' Qatada ne kaha: Ye hadees is Aayat ki tafseer ke taur par zikr ki jaati thi: 'Aye Iman waalon! Aisi baaton ke baare mein sawaal mat poochho jo, agar tumpar zaahir ki jaayein, to tumhein museebat mein daal sakti hain...'

e: The the above hadith was narrated by Anas through another chain and said (with the wording) "and every man had his head wrapped in his garment and weeping". And he said (with the wording) "seeking refuge with Allah from the evil of afflictions" or he said "I seek refuge with Allah from the evil of afflictions
hi: Upar wali hadees ka Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke zariye ek doosri sanad se bayaan hua hai, kehte hue, 'aur har aadmi ne apna sar apne kapde mein lapeta hua tha aur ro raha tha.' Aur unhone kaha, '...museebaton ki buraai se Allah ki panaah maangte hue,' ya unhone kaha, 'main museebaton ki buraai se Allah ki panaah maangta hoon.'

e: Narrated Anas:The above hadith is narrated on the authority of Anas thorugh another chain and he said (with the wording) "seeking refuge with Allah from the evil of afflictions
hi: Upar wali hadees Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke hawaale se ek doosri sanad se bhi riwaayat ki gayi hai aur unhone kaha, '...museebaton ki buraai se Allah ki panaah maangte hue.'

e: Narrated Salim's father:The Prophet (ﷺ) stood up beside the pulpit (and pointed with his finger towards the East) and said, "Afflictions are there! Afflictions are there, from where the side of the head of Satan comes out," or said, "..the side of the sun
hi: Salim ke waalid bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) mimbar ke paas khade hue (aur apni ungli se Poorab ki taraf ishara kiya) aur kaha, 'Museebaten wahaan hain! Museebaten wahaan hain, jahaan se Shaitaan ke sar ka hissa nikalta hai,' ya kaha, '...suraj ki taraf.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while he was facing the East, saying, "Verily! Afflictions are there, from where the side of the head of Satan comes out
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko, jab wo Poorab ki taraf muh kiye hue the, ye kehte suna, 'Beshak! Museebaten wahaan hain, jahaan se Shaitaan ke sar ka hissa nikalta hai.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! Bestow Your blessings on our Sham! O Allah! Bestow Your blessings on our Yemen." The People said, "And also on our Najd." He said, "O Allah! Bestow Your blessings on our Sham (north)! O Allah! Bestow Your blessings on our Yemen." The people said, "O Allah's Apostle! And also on our Najd." I think the third time the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There (in Najd) is the place of earthquakes and afflictions and from there comes out the side of the head of Satan
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Aye Allah! Hamare Sham par apni barkaten naazil kar! Aye Allah! Hamare Yemen par apni barkaten naazil kar.' Logon ne kaha, 'Aur hamare Najd par bhi.' Unhone kaha, 'Aye Allah! Hamare Sham (uttar) par apni barkaten naazil kar! Aye Allah! Hamare Yemen par apni barkaten naazil kar.' Logon ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Aur hamare Najd par bhi.' Mujhe lagta hai teesri baar Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Wahaan (Najd mein) zalzalon aur museebaton ki jagah hai aur wahaan se Shaitaan ke sar ka hissa nikalta hai.'

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:`Abdullah bin `Umar came to us and we hoped that he would narrate to us a good Hadith. But before we asked him, a man got up and said to him, "O Abu `Abdur-Rahman! Narrate to us about the battles during the time of the afflictions, as Allah says:-- 'And fight them until there is no more afflictions (i.e. no more worshipping of others besides Allah).'" (2.193) Ibn `Umar said (to the man), "Do you know what is meant by afflictions? Let your mother bereave you! Muhammad used to fight against the pagans, for a Muslim was put to trial in his religion (The pagans will either kill him or chain him as a captive). His fighting was not like your fighting which is carried on for the sake of ruling
hi: Saeed bin Jubair bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) humare paas aaye aur humne ummeed ki ke wo humein ek achhi hadees sunaayenge. Magar humaare unse poochne se pehle, ek shaks khada hua aur unse kaha, 'Aye Abu Abdur Rahman! Humein museebaton (fitno) ke daur ki jangon ke baare mein bataaiye, jaisa ke Allah farmaata hai: "Aur unse tab tak lado jab tak koi museebat (fitna) na rahe (yaani doosron ki ibaadat na ki jaaye)." (2:193).' Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne (us shaks se) kaha, 'Kya tumhein pata hai museebat (fitna) se kya murad hai? Teri maa tujhe khoye! Muhammad (SAW) mushrikon ke khilaaf ladte the, kyunke ek Musalmaan apne deen mein azmaaish mein daala jaata tha (mushrik use ya to qatl karte ya qaidi banaakar zanjeer se baandhte). Unki jang hukmraan bane ke liye ki jaane wali tumhaari jang jaisi nahi thi.'

e: Narrated Shaqiq:I heard Hudhaifa saying, "While we were sitting with `Umar, he said, 'Who among you remembers the statement of the Prophet (ﷺ) about the afflictions?' Hudhaifa said, "The affliction of a man in his family, his property, his children and his neighbors are expiated by his prayers, Zakat (and alms) and enjoining good and forbidding evil." `Umar said, "I do not ask you about these afflictions, but about those afflictions which will move like the waves of the sea." Hudhaifa said, "Don't worry about it, O chief of the believers, for there is a closed door between you and them." `Umar said, "Will that door be broken or opened?" I said, "No. it will be broken." `Umar said, "Then it will never be closed," I said, "Yes." We asked Hudhaifa, "Did `Umar know what that door meant?" He replied, "Yes, as I know that there will be night before tomorrow morning, that is because I narrated to him a true narration free from errors." We dared not ask Hudhaifa as to whom the door represented so we ordered Masruq to ask him what does the door stand for? He replied, "`Umar
hi: Shaqiq bataate hain: Maine Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko ye kehte suna, 'Jab hum Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath baithe the, unhone kaha, "Tum mein se kaun museebaton ke baare mein Nabi (SAW) ki baat yaad rakhta hai?"' Hudhaifa ne kaha, 'Ek aadmi ki museebat uske khaandaan, uski jaayadaad, uske bacchon aur uske padosiyon mein uski namaz, Zakat (aur sadqe), aur achhaai ka hukm dene aur buraai se rokne se maaf (kaffaraa) ho jaati hai.' Umar ne kaha, 'Main tumse in museebaton ke baare mein nahi poochta, balke un museebaton ke baare mein jo samundar ki lehron jaisi chalengi.' Hudhaifa ne kaha, 'Iski fikr mat kijiye, Aye Momineen ke Ameer, kyunke aapke aur unke beech ek band darwaaza hai.' Umar ne pucha, 'Kya wo darwaaza tootega ya khulega?' Maine kaha, 'Nahi, wo tootega.' Umar ne kaha, 'To wo kabhi band nahi hoga,' Maine kaha, 'Haan.' Humne Hudhaifa se pucha, 'Kya Umar ko pata tha wo darwaaza kya tha?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Haan, jaisa mujhe pata hai ke kal subah se pehle raat aayegi, kyunke maine unhein ek sachi riwaayat sunaayi thi jo galtiyon se paak thi.' Humme itni himmat nahi hui ke hum Hudhaifa se poochein ke wo darwaaza kaun tha, isliye humne Masruq ko hukm diya ke wo unse poochein ke wo darwaaza kis cheez ka pratik hai. Unhone jawab diya, 'Umar.'

e: Narrated Abu Musa Al-Ash`ari:The Prophet (ﷺ) went out to one of the gardens of Medina for some business and I went out to follow him. When he entered the garden, I sat at its gate and said to myself, "To day I will be the gatekeeper of the Prophet though he has not ordered me." The Prophet (ﷺ) went and finished his need and went to sit on the constructed edge of the well and uncovered his legs and hung them in the well. In the meantime Abu Bakr came and asked permission to enter. I said (to him), "Wait till I get you permission." Abu Bakr waited outside and I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Prophet! Abu Bakr asks your permission to enter." He said, "Admit him, and give him the glad tidings of entering Paradise." So Abu Bakr entered and sat on the right side of the Prophet (ﷺ) and uncovered his legs and hung them in the well. Then `Umar came and I said (to him), "Wait till I get you permission." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Admit him and give him the glad tidings of entering Paradise." So `Umar entered and sat on the left side of the Prophet and uncovered his legs and hung them in the well so that one side of the well became fully occupied and there remained no place for any-one to sit. Then `Uthman came and I said (to him), "Wait till I get permission for you." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Admit him and give him the glad tidings of entering Paradise with a calamity which will befall him." When he entered, he could not find any place to sit with them so he went to the other edge of the well opposite them and uncovered his legs and hung them in the well. I wished that a brother of mine would come, so I invoked Allah for his coming. (Ibn Al-Musaiyab said, "I interpreted that (narration) as indicating their graves. The first three are together and the grave of `Uthman is separate from theirs
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ashari bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) Madina ke baagon mein se ek mein kisi kaam se gaye aur main unke peechhe gaya. Jab wo baag mein daakhil hue, main uske darwaaze par baitha aur khud se kaha, 'Aaj main Nabi (SAW) ka darwaan hounga, halaanke unhone mujhe aisa hukm nahi diya.' Nabi (SAW) gaye aur apni zaroorat poori ki aur kuen ki bani hui deewaar par baithne gaye aur apni taangein khol kar kuen mein latka diya. Isi dauraan Abu Bakr aaye aur andar aane ki ijaazat maangi. Maine (unse) kaha, 'Ruko jab tak main aapke liye ijaazat lein.' Abu Bakr baahar rahe aur main Nabi (SAW) ke paas gaya aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Nabi! Abu Bakr aapse andar aane ki ijaazat maangte hain.' Unhone kaha, 'Unhein andar aane do, aur unhein Jannat mein daakhil hone ki khush-khabri do.' To Abu Bakr andar aaye aur Nabi (SAW) ke daaen taraf baithe aur apni taangein khol kar kuen mein latka di. Phir Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) aaye aur maine (unse) kaha, 'Ruko jab tak main aapke liye ijaazat lein.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Unhein andar aane do aur unhein Jannat mein daakhil hone ki khush-khabri do.' To Umar andar aaye aur Nabi ke baaen taraf baithe aur apni taangein khol kar kuen mein latka di, isliye kuen ki ek taraf poori tarah bhar gayi aur kisi ke baithne ki jagah nahi bachi. Phir Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) aaye aur maine (unse) kaha, 'Ruko jab tak main aapke liye ijaazat lein.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Unhein andar aane do aur unhein Jannat mein daakhil hone ki khush-khabri do saath ek museebat ke jo unpar aayegi.' Jab wo daakhil hue, unhein unke saath baithne ki jagah nahi mili, isliye wo kuen ke doosre kinaare unke saamne gaye aur apni taangein khol kar kuen mein latka di. Main chaahta tha mera koi bhai bhi aaye, isliye maine Allah se unke aane ki dua ki. (Ibn Al-Musaiyab ne kaha, 'Maine iski tashreeh unki qabron ke pratik ke taur par ki. Pehle teen ek saath hain, aur Uthman ki qabar unse alag hai.')

e: Narrated Abu Wail:Someone said to Usama, "Will you not talk to this (Uthman)?" Usama said, "I talked to him (secretly) without being the first man to open an evil door. I will never tell a ruler who rules over two men or more that he is good after I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, 'A man will be brought and put in Hell (Fire) and he will circumambulate (go around and round) in Hell (Fire) like a donkey of a (flour) grinding mill, and all the people of Hell (Fire) will gather around him and will say to him, O so-and-so! Didn't you use to order others for good and forbid them from evil?' That man will say, 'I used to order others to do good but I myself never used to do it, and I used to forbid others from evil while I myself used to do evil
hi: Abu Wail bataate hain: Kisi ne Usama se kaha, 'Kya aap is (Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ)) se baat nahi karenge?' Usama ne kaha, 'Maine unse (chupke se) baat ki, bina buraai ka darwaaza kholne wala pehla aadmi bane. Main kabhi kisi hukmraan ko jo do ya zyaada logon par hukmraani karta ho ye nahi kahoonga ke wo achha hai, jab se maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, "Ek aadmi laaya jaayega aur Jahannam ki Aag mein daala jaayega, aur wo Jahannam mein aise chakkar lagaayega jaise ek gadhaa (aata pisai ki) chakki ka gadhaa, aur sab Jahannam waale uske gird jama honge aur usse kahenge, 'Aye falaan! Kya tum doosron ko achhaai ka hukm nahi dete the aur unhein buraai se nahi rokte the?' Wo aadmi kahega, 'Main doosron ko achhaai karne ka hukm deta tha magar khud kabhi nahi karta tha, aur main doosron ko buraai se rokta tha jabke khud buraai karta tha.'"'

e: Narrated Abu Bakra:During the battle of Al-Jamal, Allah benefited me with a Word (I heard from the Prophet). When the Prophet heard the news that the people of the Persia had made the daughter of Khosrau their Queen (ruler), he said, "Never will succeed such a nation as makes a woman their ruler
hi: Abu Bakra (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jang-e-Al-Jamal ke dauraan, Allah ne mujhe ek baat (jo maine Nabi SAW se suni) se faayda pahunchaaya. Jab Nabi (SAW) ne suna ke Faaris (Persia) ke logon ne Khosrau ki beti ko apni raani (hukmraan) banaaya hai, unhone kaha, 'Wo qaum kabhi kaamyaab nahi hogi jo ek aurat ko apna hukmraan banaaye.'

e: Narrated Abu Maryam `Abdullah bin Ziyad Al-Aasadi:When Talha, Az-Zubair and `Aisha moved to Basra, `Ali sent `Ammar bin Yasir and Hasan bin `Ali who came to us at Kufa and ascended the pulpit. Al-Hasan bin `Ali was at the top of the pulpit and `Ammar was below Al-Hasan. We all gathered before him. I heard `Ammar saying, "`Aisha has moved to Al-Busra. By Allah! She is the wife of your Prophet in this world and in the Hereafter. But Allah has put you to test whether you obey Him (Allah) or her (`Aisha)
hi: Abu Maryam Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ziyad Al-Aasadi bataate hain: Jab Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ), Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) Basra ki taraf gaye, Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne Ammar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Yasir aur Hasan bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko bheja jo humare paas Kufa mein aaye aur mimbar par chadhe. Al-Hasan bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) mimbar ke sabse oopar the aur Ammar Al-Hasan (Alayhis Salam) se neeche the. Hum sab unke saamne jama hue. Maine Ammar ko ye kehte suna, 'Aisha Al-Busra ki taraf gayi hain. Allah ki qasam! Wo tumhaare Nabi ki biwi hain is duniya mein aur Aakhirat mein. Magar Allah ne tumhein azmaaish mein daala hai (ye dekhne ke liye) ke kya tum Allah ki farmaanbardaari karoge ya Aisha ki.'

e: Narrated Abu Wail:`Ammar stood on the pulpit at Kufa and mentioned `Aisha and her coming (to Busra) and said, "She is the wife of your Prophet in this world and in the Hereafter, but you people are being put to test in this issue
hi: Abu Wail bataate hain: Ammar (رضی اللہ عنہ) Kufa mein mimbar par khade hue aur Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) aur unke (Basra) aane ka zikr kiya aur kaha, 'Wo tumhaare Nabi ki biwi hain is duniya mein aur Aakhirat mein, magar tum logon ko is maamle mein azmaaish mein daala jaa raha hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Wail:Abu Musa and Abu Mas`ud went to `Ammar when `Ali had sent him to Kufa to exhort them to fight (on `Ali's side). They said to him, "Since you have become a Muslim, we have never seen you doing a deed more criticizable to us than your haste in this matter." `Ammar said, "Since you (both) became Muslims, I have never seen you doing a deed more criticizable to me than your keeping away from this matter." Then Abu Mas`ud provided `Ammar and Abu Musa with two-piece outfits to wear, and one of them went to the mosque (of Kufa)
hi: Abu Wail bataate hain: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Abu Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) Ammar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas gaye jab Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne unhein Kufa (jang mein Ali (Alayhis Salam) ka saath dene ki logon ko taakeed karne) bheja tha. Unhone unse kaha, 'Jab se aap Musalmaan bane hain, humne aapko kabhi is maamle mein aapki jaldi se zyaada koi aisa amal karte nahi dekha jise hum galat samajhein.' Ammar ne kaha, 'Jab se tum dono Musalmaan bane ho, maine tumhein kabhi is maamle se door rehne se zyaada koi aisa amal karte nahi dekha jise main galat samajhoon.' Phir Abu Mas'ud ne Ammar aur Abu Musa ko pehne jaane ke liye do-tukda kapde diye, aur unmein se ek Masjid (Kufa ki) mein gaya.

e: Narrated Shaqiq bin Salama:I was sitting with Abu Mas`ud and Abu Musa and `Ammar. Abu Mas`ud said (to `Ammar), "There is none of your companions but, if I wish, I could find fault with him except with you. Since you joined the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) I have never seen anything done by you more criticizable by me than your haste in this issue." `Ammar said, O Abu Mas`ud ! I have never seen anything done by you or by this companion of yours (i.e., Abu Musa) more criticizable by me than your keeping away from this issue since the time you both joined the company of the Prophet." Then Abu Mas`ud who was a rich man, said (to his servant), "O boy! Bring two suits." Then he gave one to Abu Musa and the other to `Ammar and said (to them), "Put on these suits before going for the Friday prayer
hi: Shaqiq bin Salama bataate hain: Main Abu Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ), Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Ammar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath baitha tha. Abu Mas'ud ne (Ammar se) kaha, 'Aapke koi bhi saathi nahi jismein, agar main chaahta, main koi kami nikaal sakta, siwaaye aapke. Jab se aap Nabi (SAW) ke saathi bane hain, maine kabhi aapke kisi kaam ko is maamle mein aapki jaldi se zyaada koi buri baat nahi paayi.' Ammar ne kaha, 'Aye Abu Mas'ud! Maine kabhi aapka ya aapke is saathi (yaani Abu Musa) ka koi kaam is maamle se door rehne se zyaada koi buri baat nahi paayi, jab se aap dono Nabi (SAW) ke sahaaba mein shaamil hue.' Phir Abu Mas'ud, jo ek ameer aadmi the, ne (apne khaadim se) kaha, 'Aye ladke! Do jode kapde laao.' Phir unhone ek Abu Musa ko aur doosra Ammar ko diya aur (unse) kaha, 'Jumme ki namaz ke liye jaane se pehle ye kapde pehno.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If Allah sends punishment upon a nation then it befalls upon the whole population indiscriminately and then they will be resurrected (and judged) according to their deeds
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar Allah kisi qaum par saza bhejta hai, to wo poori qaum par bina bhed-bhaav ke padti hai, aur phir wo apne-apne amaalon ke mutaabik dobara utthaaye jaayenge (aur unka faisla hoga).'

e: Narrated Al-Hasan Al-Basri:When Al-Hasan bin `Ali moved with army units against Muawiya, `Amr bin AL-As said to Muawiya, "I see an army that will not retreat unless and until the opposing army retreats." Muawiya said, "(If the Muslims are killed) who will look after their children?" `Amr bin Al-As said: I (will look after them). On that, `Abdullah bin 'Amir and `Abdur-Rahman bin Samura said, "Let us meet Muawiya and suggest peace." Al-Hasan Al-Basri added: No doubt, I heard that Abu Bakra said, "Once while the Prophet was addressing (the people), Al-Hasan (bin `Ali) came and the Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'This son of mine is a chief, and Allah may make peace between two groups of Muslims through him
hi: Al-Hasan Al-Basri bataate hain: Jab Al-Hasan bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) apni fauj ke saath Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke khilaaf badhe, Amr bin Al-As (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Muawiya se kaha, 'Main aisi fauj dekh raha hoon jo peechhe nahi hategi jab tak mukhaalif fauj peechhe na hate.' Muawiya ne kaha, '(Agar Musalmaan qatl kiye jaayein) to unke bachon ki dekhbhaal kaun karega?' Amr bin Al-As ne kaha, 'Main (unki dekhbhaal karunga).' Isper, Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Aamir aur Abdur Rahman bin Samura ne kaha, 'Chalo hum Muawiya se milein aur sulah ki tajweez dein.' Al-Hasan Al-Basri ne izaafa kiya: Shak nahi, maine suna ke Abu Bakra (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Ek baar jab Nabi (SAW) (logon se) khitaab kar rahe the, Al-Hasan (Alayhis Salam) (bin Ali) aaye aur Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, "Mera ye beta ek sardaar hai, aur Allah shaayad iske zariye Musalmaanon ke do giroh ke beech sulah karwaaye."'

e: Narrated Harmala:(Usama's Maula) Usama (bin Zaid) sent me to `Ali (at Kufa) and said, "`Ali will ask you, 'What has prevented your companion from joining me?' You then should say to him, 'If you (`Ali) were in the mouth of a lion, I would like to be with you, but in this matter I won't take any part.' " Harmala added: "`Ali didn't give me anything (when I conveyed the message to him) so I went to Hasan, Hussain and Ibn Ja`far and they loaded my camels with much (wealth)
hi: Harmala (Usama ke Maula) bataate hain: Usama (bin Zaid) ne mujhe Ali (Alayhis Salam) (Kufa mein) ke paas bheja aur kaha, 'Ali (Alayhis Salam) tumse poochenge, "Tumhaare saathi (Usama) ko mere saath shaamil hone se kis cheez ne roka?" Tumhein tab unse kehna chaahiye, "Agar aap (Ali (Alayhis Salam)) sher ke munh mein hote, to main aapke saath rehna pasand karta, magar is maamle mein main koi hissa nahi loonga."' Harmala ne izaafa kiya: 'Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne mujhe (jab maine unhein paighaam pahunchaaya) kuch nahi diya, isliye main Hasan, Hussain aur Ibn Ja'far ke paas gaya aur unhone mere oonton par bahut si (daulat) load kar di.'

e: Narrated Nafi`:When the people of Medina dethroned Yazid bin Muawiya, Ibn `Umar gathered his special friends and children and said, "I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, 'A flag will be fixed for every betrayer on the Day of Resurrection,' and we have given the oath of allegiance to this person (Yazid) in accordance with the conditions enjoined by Allah and His Apostle and I do not know of anything more faithless than fighting a person who has been given the oath of allegiance in accordance with the conditions enjoined by Allah and His Apostle , and if ever I learn that any person among you has agreed to dethrone Yazid, by giving the oath of allegiance (to somebody else) then there will be separation between him and me
hi: Nafi' bataate hain: Jab Madina ke logon ne Yazid bin Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko takht se hataaya, Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne apne khaas dost aur bacchon ko jama kiya aur kaha, 'Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, "Har dhoke-baaz ke liye Qayamat ke din ek jhanda gaada jaayega," aur humne is shaks (Yazid) ko Allah aur uske Rasool ki muqarrar kardaa shartoon ke mutaabik baiyat di hai, aur mujhe iske ilaawa koi aur cheez itni be-imaani ki nahi lagti jitni us shaks se ladna jise Allah aur uske Rasool ki shartoon ke mutaabik baiyat di gayi ho, aur agar mujhe kabhi pata chale ke tum mein se kisi ne Yazid ko hataane ka (kisi aur ko baiyat dekar) faisla kiya hai, to uske aur mere beech alag-hat ho jaayegi.'

e: Narrated Abu Al-Minhal:When Ibn Ziyad and Marwan were in Sham and Ibn Az-Zubair took over the authority in Mecca and Qurra' (the Kharijites) revolted in Basra, I went out with my father to Abu Barza Al-Aslami till we entered upon him in his house while he was sitting in the shade of a room built of cane. So we sat with him and my father started talking to him saying, "O Abu Barza! Don't you see in what dilemma the people has fallen?" The first thing heard him saying "I seek reward from Allah for myself because of being angry and scornful at the Quraish tribe. O you Arabs! You know very well that you were in misery and were few in number and misguided, and that Allah has brought you out of all that with Islam and with Muhammad till He brought you to this state (of prosperity and happiness) which you see now; and it is this worldly wealth and pleasures which has caused mischief to appear among you. The one who is in Sham (i.e., Marwan), by Allah, is not fighting except for the sake of worldly gain: and those who are among you, by Allah, are not fighting except for the sake of worldly gain; and that one who is in Mecca (i.e., Ibn Az-Zubair) by Allah, is not fighting except for the sake of worldly gain
hi: Abu Al-Minhal bataate hain: Jab Ibn Ziyad aur Marwan Sham mein the aur Ibn Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Makkah mein hukumat sambhaal li aur Qurra' (Khawarij) ne Basra mein baghaawat ki, main apne waalid ke saath Abu Barza (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Aslami (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas gaya, yahaan tak ke hum unke ghar mein unke paas pahunche jabke wo bans se banaaye gaye ek kamre ke saaye mein baithe the. To hum unke saath baithe aur mere waalid ne unse baat karni shuru ki, kehte hue, 'Aye Abu Barza! Kya aap nahi dekhte log kis mushkil mein pad gaye hain?' Sabse pehli baat jo maine unse suni wo ye thi, 'Main apne liye Allah se ajr chaahta hoon Quraish qabeele ke khilaaf apne gusse aur nafrat ki wajah se. Aye Arabon! Tumhein achhi tarah maloom hai ke tum museebat mein the aur tumhaari tadaad kam thi aur tum bhatke hue the, aur Allah ne tumhein Islam aur Muhammad ke zariye is sab se nikaala yahaan tak ke usne tumhein is haalat (khushhaali aur khushi) tak pahunchaaya jo tum ab dekhte ho; aur yahi duniya ki daulat aur khushiyaan hain jinhone tum mein fasaad paida kiya hai. Jo shaks Sham mein hai (yaani Marwan), Allah ki qasam, wo duniya ki daulat ke ilaawa kisi aur wajah se nahi ladh raha; aur wo log jo tum mein se hain, Allah ki qasam, wo duniya ki daulat ke ilaawa kisi aur wajah se nahi ladh rahe; aur wo shaks jo Makkah mein hai (yaani Ibn Az-Zubair), Allah ki qasam, wo duniya ki daulat ke ilaawa kisi aur wajah se nahi ladh raha.'

e: Narrated Abi Waih:Hudhaifa bin Al-Yaman said, 'The hypocrites of today are worse than those of the lifetime of the Prophet, because in those days they used to do evil deeds secretly but today they do such deeds openly
hi: Abi Waih bataate hain: Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Yaman ne kaha, 'Aaj ke munaafiq Nabi (SAW) ke daur ke munaafiqon se bhi bure hain, kyunke us daur mein wo apne bure amaal chupke se karte the magar aaj wo aise amaal khule aam karte hain.'

e: Narrated Abi Asha'sha:Hudhaifa said, 'In fact, it was hypocrisy that existed in the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) but today it is Kufr (disbelief) after belief
hi: Abi Asha'sha bataate hain: Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Haqeeqat mein, Nabi (SAW) ke daur mein munaafiqat thi, magar aaj ye Iman ke baad Kufr (na-shukri) hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The Hour will not be established till a man passes by a grave of somebody and says, 'Would that I were in his place
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Qayamat tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak ek aadmi kisi ki qabar se guzarte hue kahe, "Kaash main uski jagah hota."'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The Hour will not be established till the buttocks of the women of the tribe of Daus move while going round Dhi-al-Khalasa." Dhi-al-Khalasa was the idol of the Daus tribe which they used to worship in the Pre Islamic Period of ignorance
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Qayamat tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak Daus qabeele ki auraton ke chootad Dhi-al-Khalasa ke gird ghoomte waqt hilne na lagein.' Dhi-al-Khalasa Daus qabeele ka ek but tha jise wo Jaahiliyat (Islam se pehle) ke daur mein parastish karte the.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The Hour will not be established till a man from Qahtan appears, driving the people with his stick
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Qayamat tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak Qahtan (qabeele) se ek aadmi zaahir na ho, jo logon ko apni lakdi se haankega.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The Hour will not be established till a fire will come out of the land of Hijaz, and it will throw light on the necks of the camels at Busra
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Qayamat tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak Hijaz ki zameen se ek aag na nikle, aur wo Busra mein oonton ki gardanon par roshni na daale.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Soon the river "Euphrates" will disclose the treasure (the mountain) of gold, so whoever will be present at that time should not take anything of it." Al-A'raj narrated from Abu Huraira that the Prophet (ﷺ) said the same but he said, "It (Euphrates) will uncover a mountain of gold (under it)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jald hi darya Farat (Euphrates) sone ka khazaana (pahaad) zaahir karega, isliye jo koi bhi us waqt wahaan maujood ho, use usmein se kuch bhi na le.' Al-Araj ne Abu Huraira ke hawaale se riwaayat ki ke Nabi (SAW) ne yahi kaha, magar unhone kaha, 'Wo (Euphrates) sone ka ek pahaad (uske neeche se) zaahir karega.'

e: Narrated Haritha bin Wahb:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "Give in charity because there will come a time on the people when a person will go out with his alms from place to place but will not find anybody to accept it
hi: Haritha bin Wahb bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, 'Sadqa do, kyunke aisa waqt aayega jab koi apna sadqa lekar jagah-jagah jaayega magar use qubool karne wala koi nahi milega.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The Hour will not be established (1) till two big groups fight each other whereupon there will be a great number of casualties on both sides and they will be following one and the same religious doctrine, (2) till about thirty Dajjals (liars) appear, and each one of them will claim that he is Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), (3) till the religious knowledge is taken away (by the death of Religious scholars) (4) earthquakes will increase in number (5) time will pass quickly, (6) afflictions will appear, (7) Al-Harj, (i.e., killing) will increase, (8) till wealth will be in abundance ---- so abundant that a wealthy person will worry lest nobody should accept his Zakat, and whenever he will present it to someone, that person (to whom it will be offered) will say, 'I am not in need of it, (9) till the people compete with one another in constructing high buildings, (10) till a man when passing by a grave of someone will say, 'Would that I were in his place (11) and till the sun rises from the West. So when the sun will rise and the people will see it (rising from the West) they will all believe (embrace Islam) but that will be the time when: (As Allah said,) 'No good will it do to a soul to believe then, if it believed not before, nor earned good (by deeds of righteousness) through its Faith.' (6.158) And the Hour will be established while two men spreading a garment in front of them but they will not be able to sell it, nor fold it up; and the Hour will be established when a man has milked his she-camel and has taken away the milk but he will not be able to drink it; and the Hour will be established before a man repairing a tank (for his livestock) is able to water (his animals) in it; and the Hour will be established when a person has raised a morsel (of food) to his mouth but will not be able to eat it
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Qayamat tab tak nahi aayegi (1) jab tak do bade giroh aapas mein na ladein, jispar donon taraf bahut zyaada nuqsaan hoga aur wo ek hi deen ke pairvi karne wale honge, (2) jab tak taqreeban tees Dajjal (jhoote) zaahir na hon, aur unmein se har ek ye dawa na kare ke wo Allah ka Rasool hai, (3) jab tak deeni ilm uthaa (deeni aalimon ki maut se gaayab) na ho jaaye, (4) zalzale tadaad mein na badhein, (5) waqt tezi se guzarne na lage, (6) museebaten (fitne) zaahir na hon, (7) Al-Harj (yaani qatl) badh na jaaye, (8) jab tak daulat itni zyaada na ho -- itni zyaada ke ek daulatmand shaks isse pareshaan ho ke koi uski Zakat qubool na kare, aur jab bhi wo use kisi ko pesh kare, wo shaks (jise pesh ki jaaye) kahe, "Mujhe iski zaroorat nahi," (9) jab tak log oonchi imaaraten banaane mein ek doosre se pratispardha na karein, (10) jab tak koi kisi ki qabar se guzarte waqt na kahe, "Kaash main uski jagah hota" (11) aur jab tak suraj Paschim se na nikle. To jab suraj (Paschim se) nikalega aur log use dekhenge, sab log Iman le aayenge (Islam qubool karenge) magar wo waqt aisa hoga jab: (jaisa Allah ne farmaaya,) "Kisi jaan ka Iman laana usse tab koi faayda nahi dega, agar wo pehle Iman nahi laayi thi, na hi usne apne Iman ke zariye koi nek amal kamaaya." (6:158) Aur Qayamat aisi (achaanak) aayegi ke do log jo apne saamne ek kapda phaila rahe honge, wo na to use bech paayenge, na hi use samet paayenge; aur Qayamat aisi (achaanak) aayegi jab ek aadmi ne apni oontni ka doodh nikaala ho aur wo doodh lekar gaya ho magar wo use pi nahi paayega; aur Qayamat aisi (achaanak) aayegi isse pehle ke ek aadmi apna hauz (apne maweshiyon ke liye) taiyaar karke usmein unhein paani pila sake; aur Qayamat aisi (achaanak) aayegi jab ek shaks ne apna nawaala (khaana) apne munh tak uthaaya ho magar wo use khaa nahi paayega.'

e: Narrated Al-Mughira bin Shu`ba:Nobody asked the Prophet (ﷺ) as many questions as I asked regarding Ad-Dajjal. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to me, "What worries you about him?" I said, "Because the people say that he will have a mountain of bread and a river of water with him (i.e. he will have abundance of food and water)" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Nay, he is too mean to be allowed such a thing by Allah"' (but it is only to test mankind whether they believe in Allah or in Ad-Dajjal)
hi: Al-Mughira bin Shu'ba (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Kisi ne Nabi (SAW) se itne sawaal Ad-Dajjal ke baare mein nahi poochhe jitne maine poochhe. Nabi (SAW) ne mujhse kaha, 'Tumhein uske baare mein kis baat ki fikr hai?' Maine kaha, 'Kyunke log kehte hain ke uske saath roti ka ek pahaad aur paani ki ek nadi hogi (yaani uske paas bahut zyaada khaana aur paani hoga).' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Nahi, wo Allah ki taraf se aisi cheez paane ke laayak nahi hai' (magar ye sirf insaaniyat ki azmaaish ke liye hai ke wo Allah par Iman rakhte hain ya Ad-Dajjal par).

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar (ra) :The Prophet (ﷺ) said (about Ad-Dajjal) that he is one eyed, his right eye is as if a protruding out grape
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne (Ad-Dajjal ke baare mein) kaha ke wo ek-aankha (kaana) hai, uski daayin aankh ek uthhe hue angoor jaisi hai.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Ad-Dajjal will come and encamp at a place close to Medina and then Medina will shake thrice whereupon every Kafir (disbeliever) and hypocrite will go out (of Medina) towards him
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ad-Dajjal aayega aur Madina ke qareeb ek jagah pad-aao daalega aur phir Madina teen baar hilega, isper har Kaafir aur munaafiq (Madina se) baahar uski taraf jaayega.'

e: Narrated Abu Bakra:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The terror caused by Al-Masih Ad-Dajjal will not enter Medina and at that time Medina will have seven gates and there will be two angels at each gate (guarding them)
hi: Abu Bakra (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Al-Maseeh Ad-Dajjal ka khauf Madina mein daakhil nahi hoga, aur us waqt Madina ke saat darwaaze honge aur har darwaaze par do farishte (pahra dete hue) honge.'

e: Narrated Abu Bakra:[as above]
hi: Abu Bakra (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain (upar wali riwaayat jaisi).

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up amongst the people and then praised and glorified Allah as He deserved and then he mentioned Ad-Dajjal, saying, "I warn you of him, and there was no prophet but warned his followers of him; but I will tell you something about him which no prophet has told his followers: Ad- Dajjal is one-eyed whereas Allah is not
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) logon ke beech khade hue, aur phir Allah ki jaisi hamd aur tareef ki jaani chaahiye waisi ki, aur phir unhone Ad-Dajjal ka zikr kiya, kehte hue, 'Main tumhein usse khabardaar karta hoon, aur koi bhi Nabi aisa nahi tha jisne apne maanne walon ko usse khabardaar na kiya ho; magar main tumhein uske baare mein aisi baat bataunga jo kisi bhi Nabi ne apne maanne walon ko nahi bataayi: Ad-Dajjal ek-aankha hai jabke Allah aisa nahi hai.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said. "While I was sleeping, I saw myself (in a dream) performing Tawaf around the Ka`ba. Behold, I saw a reddish-white man with lank hair, and water was dropping from his head. I asked, "Who is this?' They replied, 'The son of Mary.' Then I turned my face to see another man with a huge body, red complexion and curly hair and blind in one eye. His eye looked like a protruding out grape. They said (to me), He is Ad-Dajjal." The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "The man he resembled most is Ibn Qatan, a man from the tribe of Khuza`a
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab main so raha tha, maine khud ko (khwaab mein) Kaaba ka Tawaf karte dekha. Dekho, maine ek surkh-safed, seedhe baalon waale aadmi ko dekha, jiske sar se paani tapak raha tha. Maine pucha, "Ye kaun hai?" Unhone jawab diya, "Maryam ke bete." Phir maine apna chehra doosri taraf mudkar ek aur aadmi ko dekha, bade jism, laal rangat, ghungraale baal, aur ek aankh se andha waala. Uski aankh ek uthhe hue angoor jaisi dikhti thi. Unhone (mujhse) kaha, "Wo Ad-Dajjal hai." Nabi (SAW) ne izaafa kiya, 'Wo aadmi jisse wo (Ad-Dajjal) sabse zyaada milte-julte hain wo Ibn Qatan hain, Khuza'a qabeele ke ek shaks.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in his prayer, seeking refuge with Allah from the afflictions of Ad-Dajjal
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko apni namaz mein, Ad-Dajjal ki museebaton se Allah ki panaah maangte suna.

e: Narrated Hudhaifa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said about Ad-Dajjal that he would have water and fire with him: (what would seem to be) fire, would be cold water and (what would seem to be) water, would be fire
hi: Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne Ad-Dajjal ke baare mein kaha ke uske saath paani aur aag hogi: (jo aag jaisi dikhegi), wo thanda paani hogi, aur (jo paani jaisa dikhega), wo aag hogi.

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No prophet was sent but that he warned his followers against the one-eyed liar (Ad-Dajjal). Beware! He is blind in one eye, and your Lord is not so, and there will be written between his (Ad-Dajjal's) eyes (the word) Kafir (i.e., disbeliever)." (This Hadith is also quoted by Abu Huraira and Ibn `Abbas)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Koi bhi Nabi nahi bheja gaya jisne apne maanne walon ko us ek-aankhe jhoothe (Ad-Dajjal) se khabardaar na kiya ho. Khabardaar! Wo ek aankh se andha hai, aur tumhaara Rab aisa nahi hai, aur uski (Ad-Dajjal ki) dono aankhon ke beech "Kafir" (yaani kaafir) lafz likha hoga.' (Ye hadees Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke hawaale se bhi bayaan ki gayi hai.)

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id:One day Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) narrated to us a long narration about Ad-Dajjal and among the things he narrated to us, was: "Ad-Dajjal will come, and he will be forbidden to enter the mountain passes of Medina. He will encamp in one of the salt areas neighboring Medina and there will appear to him a man who will be the best or one of the best of the people. He will say 'I testify that you are Ad-Dajjal whose story Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has told us.' Ad-Dajjal will say (to his audience), 'Look, if I kill this man and then give him life, will you have any doubt about my claim?' They will reply, 'No,' Then Ad- Dajjal will kill that man and then will make him alive. The man will say, 'By Allah, now I recognize you more than ever!' Ad-Dajjal will then try to kill him (again) but he will not be given the power to do so
hi: Abu Saeed bataate hain: Ek din Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein Ad-Dajjal ke baare mein ek lambi riwaayat sunaayi, aur unmein se ek baat jo unhone humein sunaayi wo ye thi: 'Ad-Dajjal aayega, aur use Madina ke pahaadi raaston mein daakhil hone se mana kiya jaayega. Wo Madina ke qareeb ek namkeen (kharaab) ilaake mein pad-aao daalega, aur uske paas ek aadmi aayega jo logon mein sabse behtareen ya behtareen logon mein se ek hoga. Wo kahega, "Main gawaahi deta hoon ke tum Ad-Dajjal ho jinki kahaani Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein sunaayi hai." Ad-Dajjal (apne saamne baithe logon se) kahega, "Dekho, agar main is aadmi ko qatl kar doon aur phir use zinda kar doon, kya tumhein mere dawe mein koi shak rahega?" Wo jawab denge, "Nahi." Phir Ad-Dajjal us aadmi ko qatl karega aur phir use zinda kar dega. Wo aadmi kahega, "Allah ki qasam, ab mujhe pehle se bhi zyaada pata hai ke tum kaun ho!" Ad-Dajjal phir (dobara) use qatl karne ki koshish karega magar use aisa karne ki qudrat nahi di jaayegi.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "There are angels at the mountain passes of Medina (so that) neither plague nor Ad-Dajjal can enter it
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Madina ke pahaadi raaston par farishte hain (taake) na to mahamaari (plague) aur na Ad-Dajjal usmein daakhil ho sake.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Ad-Dajjal will come to Medina and find the angels guarding it. So Allah willing, neither Ad-Dajjal, nor plague will be able to come near it
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ad-Dajjal Madina aayega aur wahaan farishton ko uski pehredaari karte paayega. To Allah ne chaaha to, na Ad-Dajjal aur na mahamaari usmein qareeb aa payenge.'

e: Narrated Zainab bint Jahsh:That one day Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered upon her in a state of fear and said, "None has the right to be worshipped but Allah! Woe to the Arabs from the Great evil that has approached (them). Today a hole has been opened in the dam of Gog and Magog like this." The Prophet (ﷺ) made a circle with his index finger and thumb. Zainab bint Jahsh added: I said, "O Allah's Apostle! Shall we be destroyed though there will be righteous people among us?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Yes, if the (number) of evil (persons) increased
hi: Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Jahsh (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain ke ek din Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unke paas khauf ki haalat mein aaye aur kaha, 'Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi! Afsos hai Arabon par us bade fasaad se jo unke qareeb aa gaya hai. Aaj Yajuj aur Majuj ki deewaar mein itna bada rakhna khul gaya hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne apni pehli ungli aur angoothe se ek chakkar banaaya. Zainab bint Jahsh ne izaafa kiya: Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya hum barbaad ho jaayenge halaanke hamare beech neik log honge?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Haan, agar buraai (waalon ki tadaad) badh jaaye.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A hole has been opened in the dam of Gog and Magog." Wuhaib (the sub-narrator) made the number 90 (with his index finger and thumb)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Yajuj aur Majuj ki deewaar mein ek rakhna khul gaya hai.' Wuhaib (ravi) ne apni pehli ungli aur angoothe se ninety ka nishaan banaaya.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever obeys me, obeys Allah, and whoever disobeys me, disobeys Allah, and whoever obeys the ruler I appoint, obeys me, and whoever disobeys him, disobeys me
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi meri farmaanbardaari kare, wo Allah ki farmaanbardaari karta hai, aur jo koi meri nafarmaani kare, wo Allah ki nafarmaani karta hai, aur jo koi us hukmraan ki farmaanbardaari kare jise main muqarrar karta hoon, wo meri farmaanbardaari karta hai, aur jo koi uski nafarmaani kare, wo meri nafarmaani karta hai.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Surely! Everyone of you is a guardian and is responsible for his charges: The Imam (ruler) of the people is a guardian and is responsible for his subjects; a man is the guardian of his family (household) and is responsible for his subjects; a woman is the guardian of her husband's home and of his children and is responsible for them; and the slave of a man is a guardian of his master's property and is responsible for it. Surely, everyone of you is a guardian and responsible for his charges
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Beshak! Tum mein se har koi ek nigheban (guardian) hai aur apne zimme waalon ke liye zimmedaar hai: Logon ka Imam (hukmraan) ek nigheban hai aur apni raiya ke liye zimmedaar hai; ek aadmi apne khaandaan (ghar) ka nigheban hai aur apni raiya ke liye zimmedaar hai; ek khaatoon apne shohar ke ghar aur uske bacchon ki nigheban hai aur unke liye zimmedaar hai; aur ek aadmi ka ghulaam apne maalik ki jaayadaad ka nigheban hai aur uske liye zimmedaar hai. Beshak, tum mein se har koi ek nigheban hai aur apne zimme waalon ke liye zimmedaar hai.'

e: Narrated Muhammad bin Jubair bin Mut`im:That while he was included in a delegation of Quraish staying with Muawiya, Muawiya heard that `Abdullah bin `Amr had said that there would be a king from Qahtan tribe, whereupon he became very angry. He stood up, and after glorifying and praising Allah as He deserved, said, "To proceed, I have come to know that some of you men are narrating things which are neither in Allah's Book, nor has been mentioned by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . Such people are the ignorant among you. Beware of such vain desires that mislead those who have them. I have heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, 'This matter (of the caliphate) will remain with the Quraish, and none will rebel against them, but Allah will throw him down on his face as long as they stick to the rules and regulations of the religion (Islam)
hi: Muhammad bin Jubair bin Mut'im bataate hain ke jab wo Quraish ke ek wafd (delegation) mein shaamil the jo Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath thehre hue the, Muawiya ne suna ke Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha ke Qahtan qabeele se ek baadshah hoga, isper wo bahut gussa hue. Wo khade hue, aur Allah ki jaisi hamd aur tareef ki jaani chaahiye waisi karke, kaha, 'Ab aage, mujhe pata chala hai ke tum mein se kuch log aisi baaten bayaan kar rahe hain jo na to Allah ki Kitaab mein hain, na hi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne inka zikr kiya hai. Aise log tum mein se jaahil hain. Aisi bekaar khwaahishon se bacho jo unhein bhataati hain jo unhein rakhte hain. Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, "Ye maamla (Khilaafat) Quraish ke paas hi rahega, aur koi bhi unke khilaaf baghaawat nahi karega, magar Allah use uske muh ke bal gira dega, jab tak wo deen (Islam) ke qawaanin aur zaabton par qaayam rahein."'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "This matter (caliphate) will remain with the Quraish even if only two of them were still existing
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ye maamla (Khilaafat) Quraish ke paas hi rahega chaahe unmein se sirf do hi bache hon.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Do not wish to be like anyone, except in two cases: (1) A man whom Allah has given wealth and he spends it righteously. (2) A man whom Allah has given wisdom (knowledge of the Qur'an and the Hadith) and he acts according to it and teaches it to others
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kisi jaisa banne ki khwaahish mat karo, siwaaye do maamlon mein: (1) Ek aadmi jise Allah ne daulat di aur wo use haq ke raaste mein kharch karta hai. (2) Ek aadmi jise Allah ne hikmat (Quran aur Hadees ka ilm) di aur wo iske mutaabik amal karta hai aur doosron ko sikhaata hai.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "You should listen to and obey, your ruler even if he was an Ethiopian (black) slave whose head looks like a raisin
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Tumhein apne hukmraan ki baat sunni aur uski farmaanbardaari karni chaahiye, chaahe wo ek Habashi (kaale) ghulaam ho jiska sar kishmish jaisa dikhta ho.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If somebody sees his Muslim ruler doing something he disapproves of, he should be patient, for whoever becomes separate from the Muslim group even for a span and then dies, he will die as those who died in the Pre-Islamic period of ignorance (as rebellious sinners). (See Hadith No. 176 and)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar koi apne Musalmaan hukmraan ki koi aisi baat dekhe jo use napasand ho, use sabra karna chaahiye, kyunke jo koi Musalmaanon ki jamaat se ek bitta bhi alag ho jaaye aur phir mar jaaye, wo usi tarah marega jaise Jaahiliyat (Islam se pehle) ke daur mein log marte the (baaghi gunahgaar ke taur par).' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 176 aur dekhein.)

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A Muslim has to listen to and obey (the order of his ruler) whether he likes it or not, as long as his orders involve not one in disobedience (to Allah), but if an act of disobedience (to Allah) is imposed one should not listen to it or obey it. (See Hadith No. 203, Vol)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Musalmaan ko apne hukmraan ki (hukm) sunni aur maanni chaahiye chaahe wo use pasand ho ya na ho, jab tak uske hukm mein Allah ki nafarmaani shaamil na ho, magar agar Allah ki nafarmaani ka koi hukm diya jaaye, to use na sunna chaahiye na maanna chaahiye.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 203, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated `Ali:The Prophet (ﷺ) sent an army unit (for some campaign) and appointed a man from the Ansar as its commander and ordered them (the soldiers) to obey him. (During the campaign) he became angry with them and said, "Didn't the Prophet (ﷺ) order you to obey me?" They said, "Yes." He said, "I order you to collect wood and make a fire and then throw yourselves into it." So they collected wood and made a fire, but when they were about to throw themselves into, it they started looking at each other, and some of them said, "We followed the Prophet (ﷺ) to escape from the fire. How should we enter it now?" So while they were in that state, the fire extinguished and their commander's anger abated. The event was mentioned to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he said, "If they had entered it (the fire) they would never have come out of it, for obedience is required only in what is good." (See Hadith No. 629. Vol)
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne ek fauji dasta (kisi mission ke liye) bheja aur Ansaar mein se ek shaks ko uska sardaar muqarrar kiya aur unhein (fauji dasta ko) uski farmaanbardaari karne ka hukm diya. (Mission ke dauraan) sardaar unse gussa ho gaya aur kaha, 'Kya Nabi (SAW) ne tumhein meri farmaanbardaari karne ka hukm nahi diya tha?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan.' Sardaar ne kaha, 'Main tumhein hukm deta hoon ke lakdi jama karo aur aag jalaao aur phir khud ko usmein daal do.' To unhone lakdi jama ki aur aag jalaayi, magar jab wo khud ko usmein daalne wale the, wo ek doosre ko dekhne lage, aur unmein se kuch ne kaha, 'Humne Nabi (SAW) ki pairvi Aag se bachne ke liye ki. Ab hum usmein kaise daakhil hon?' To jabke wo isi haalat mein the, aag bujh gayi aur unke sardaar ka gussa thanda pad gaya. Ye waaqia Nabi (SAW) ko bataaya gaya aur unhone kaha, 'Agar wo usmein (aag mein) daakhil ho jaate, to wo kabhi usse baahar na nikal paate, kyunke farmaanbardaari sirf achhaai mein zaroori hai.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 629, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin Samura:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O `Abdur-Rahman! Do not seek to be a ruler, for if you are given authority on your demand then you will be held responsible for it, but if you are given it without asking (for it), then you will be helped (by Allah) in it. If you ever take an oath to do something and later on you find that something else is better, then you should expiate your oath and do what is better
hi: Abdur Rahman bin Samura bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Aye Abdur Rahman! Hukmraan banne ki koshish mat karo, kyunke agar tumhein ye zimmedaari maang kar di jaaye, to tum iske liye zimmedaar thehraaye jaaoge, magar agar tumhein ye bina maange di jaaye, to tumhein isme (Allah ki taraf se) madad milegi. Agar tum kabhi kisi kaam ke liye qasam khaao aur baad mein tumhein pata chale ke koi doosri cheez behtar hai, to tumhein apni qasam ka kaffara adaa karke jo behtar hai wo karna chaahiye.'

e: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin Samura:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O `Abdur-Rahman bin Samura! Do not seek to be a ruler, for if you are given authority on your demand, you will be held responsible for it, but if you are given it without asking for it, then you will be helped (by Allah) in it. If you ever take an oath to do something and later on you find that something else is better, then do what is better and make expiation for your oath
hi: Abdur Rahman bin Samura bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Aye Abdur Rahman bin Samura! Hukmraan banne ki koshish mat karo, kyunke agar tumhein ye zimmedaari maang kar di jaaye, to tum iske liye zimmedaar thehraaye jaaoge, magar agar tumhein ye bina maange di jaaye, to tumhein isme (Allah ki taraf se) madad milegi. Agar tum kabhi kisi kaam ke liye qasam khaao aur baad mein tumhein pata chale ke koi doosri cheez behtar hai, to jo behtar hai wo karo aur apni qasam ka kaffara adaa karo.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You people will be keen to have the authority of ruling which will be a thing of regret for you on the Day of Resurrection. What an excellent wet nurse it is, yet what a bad weaning one it is
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Tum log hukmraani ki zimmedaari paane ke liye betaab hoge, jo Qayamat ke din tumhaare liye pachhtaawe ki wajah banegi. Kya khoob doodh pilaane wali hai ye, phir bhi kya buri doodh chhudaane wali hai!'

e: Narrated Abu Musa:Two men from my tribe and I entered upon the Prophet. One of the two men said to the Prophet, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Appoint me as a governor," and so did the second. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "We do not assign the authority of ruling to those who ask for it, nor to those who are keen to have it
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Mere qabeele ke do log aur main Nabi (SAW) ke paas gaye. Unmein se ek shaks ne Nabi (SAW) se kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe hukmraan banaiye,' aur doosre ne bhi yahi kaha. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Hum hukmraani ki zimmedaari un logon ko nahi dete jo ise maangte hain, na hi un logon ko jo ise paane ke liye betaab hain.'

e: Narrated Ma'qil:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Any man whom Allah has given the authority of ruling some people and he does not look after them in an honest manner, will never feel even the smell of Paradise
hi: Ma'qil bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, 'Koi bhi aadmi jise Allah ne kuch logon par hukmraani ki zimmedaari di ho, aur wo unki imaandaari se dekhbhaal na kare, use Jannat ki khushbu bhi kabhi mehsoos nahi hogi.'

e: Narrated Ma'qil:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If any ruler having the authority to rule Muslim subjects dies while he is deceiving them, Allah will forbid Paradise for him
hi: Ma'qil bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar koi bhi hukmraan jiske paas Musalmaan raiya par hukmraani karne ki zimmedaari ho, unhein dhoka dete hue mar jaaye, to Allah uspar Jannat haraam kar dega.'

e: Narrated Tarif Abi Tamima:I saw Safwan and Jundab and Safwan's companions when Jundab was advising. They said, "Did you hear something from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" Jundab said, "I heard him saying, 'Whoever does a good deed in order to show off, Allah will expose his intentions on the Day of Resurrection (before the people), and whoever puts the people into difficulties, Allah will put him into difficulties on the Day of Resurrection.'" The people said (to Jundab), "Advise us." He said, "The first thing of the human body to purify is the `Abdomen, so he who can eat nothing but good food (Halal and earned lawfully) should do so, and he who does as much as he can that nothing intervene between him and Paradise by not shedding even a handful of blood, (i.e. murdering) should do so
hi: Tarif Abi Tamima bataate hain: Maine Safwan aur Jundab aur Safwan ke saathiyon ko dekha jab Jundab naseehat kar rahe the. Unhone kaha, 'Kya aapne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kuch suna?' Jundab ne kaha, 'Maine unhein ye kehte suna, "Jo koi dikhaawe ke liye nek amal kare, Allah Qayamat ke din uske iraade ko (logon ke saamne) zaahir kar dega, aur jo koi logon ko mushkil mein daale, Allah use Qayamat ke din mushkil mein daalega."' Logon ne (Jundab se) kaha, 'Humein naseehat dijiye.' Unhone kaha, 'Insaani jism ka sabse pehla hissa jo paak-saaf hona chaahiye wo Al-Batn (pet) hai, isliye jo koi sirf achha (Halal aur jaayez taur par kamaaya hua) khaana khaa sakta hai, use aisa hi karna chaahiye, aur jo koi apni poori koshish kare ke uske aur Jannat ke beech kuch bhi (rukaawat) na aaye, chaahe ek muthhi khoon bhi na bahaaye (yaani qatl na kare), use aisa hi karna chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:While the Prophet (ﷺ) and I were coming out of the mosque, a man met us outside the gate. The man said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! When will be the Hour?" The Prophet (ﷺ) asked him, "What have you prepared for it?" The man became afraid and ashamed and then said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I haven't prepared for it much of fasts, prayers or charitable gifts but I love Allah and His Apostle." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You will be with the one whom you love
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Nabi (SAW) aur main Masjid se baahar aa rahe the, ek shaks darwaaze ke baahar humse mila. Us shaks ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Qayamat kab aayegi?' Nabi (SAW) ne unse pucha, 'Tumne iske liye kya taiyaari ki hai?' Wo shaks dar gaya aur sharminda hua aur phir kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Maine iske liye zyaada roze, namaz ya sadqe taiyaar nahi kiye hain, magar main Allah aur uske Rasool se mohabbat karta hoon.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Tum unhi ke saath hoge jinse tum mohabbat karte ho.'

e: Narrated Thabit Al-Bunani:Anas bin Malik said to a woman of his family, "Do you know such-and-such a woman?" She replied, "Yes." He said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) passed by her while she was weeping over a grave, and he said to her, 'Be afraid of Allah and be patient.' The woman said (to the Prophet). 'Go away from me, for you do not know my calamity.'" Anas added, "The Prophet (ﷺ) left her and proceeded. A man passed by her and asked her, 'What has Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to you?' She replied, 'I did not recognize him.' The man said, 'He was Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)."' Anas added, "So that woman came to the gate of the Prophet (ﷺ) and she did not find a gate-keeper there, and she said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! By Allah. I did not recognize you!' The Prophet said, 'No doubt, patience is at the first stroke of a calamity
hi: Thabit Al-Bunani bataate hain: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne apne khaandaan ki ek khaatoon se kaha, 'Kya tum falaan-falaan khaatoon ko jaanti ho?' Usne jawab diya, 'Haan.' Unhone kaha, 'Nabi (SAW) unke paas se guzre jabke wo ek qabar par ro rahi thi, aur unhone unse kaha, "Allah se daro aur sabra karo." Khaatoon ne (Nabi se) kaha, "Mujhse door ho jaao, kyunke aapko meri museebat ka pata nahi."' Anas ne izaafa kiya, 'Nabi (SAW) unhein chhod kar aage badhe. Ek shaks unke paas se guzra aur unse pucha, "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne tumse kya kaha?" Usne jawab diya, "Maine unhein pehchaana nahi." Us shaks ne kaha, "Wo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) the."' Anas ne izaafa kiya, 'To wo khaatoon Nabi (SAW) ke darwaaze par gayi aur wahaan koi darwaan nahi paaya, aur unhone kaha, "Aye Allah ke Rasool! Allah ki qasam, maine aapko pehchaana nahi!" Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, "Shak nahi, sabra museebat ki pehli chot par hi (mayne rakhta) hai."'

e: Narrated Anas:Qais bin Sa`d was to the Prophet (ﷺ) like a chief police officer to an Amir (chief)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Qais bin Sa'd Nabi (SAW) ke liye waisa hi tha jaisa ek Amir (hukmraan) ke liye police afsar hota hai.

e: Narrated Abu Musa:that the Prophet (ﷺ) sent him and sent Mu`adh after him (as rulers to Yemen)
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Nabi (SAW) ne unhein bheja aur unke baad Mu'adh ko bheja (Yemen mein hukmraan banaakar).

e: Narrated Abu Musa:A man embraced Islam and then reverted back to Judaism. Mu`adh bin Jabal came and saw the man with Abu Musa. Mu`adh asked, "What is wrong with this (man)?" Abu Musa replied, "He embraced Islam and then reverted back to Judaism." Mu`adh said, "I will not sit down unless you kill him (as it is) the verdict of Allah and His Apostle
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks ne Islam qubool kiya aur phir wapas Yahudi mazhab mein laut aaya. Mu'adh bin Jabal (رضی اللہ عنہ) aaye aur us aadmi ko Abu Musa ke saath dekha. Mu'adh ne pucha, 'Ise kya hua hai?' Abu Musa ne jawab diya, 'Isne Islam qubool kiya aur phir wapas Yahudi mazhab mein laut aaya.' Mu'adh ne kaha, 'Main tab tak nahi baithunga jab tak tum ise qatl nahi karte (kyunke ye) Allah aur uske Rasool ka faisla hai.'

e: Narrated `Abdur Rahman bin Abi Bakra:Abu Bakra wrote to his son who was in Sijistan: 'Do not judge between two persons when you are angry, for I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "A judge should not judge between two persons while he is in an angry mood
hi: Abdur Rahman bin Abi Bakra bataate hain: Abu Bakra (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne apne bete ko, jo Sijistan mein the, likha: 'Do logon ke beech faisla mat karo jab tum gusse mein ho, kyunke maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, "Ek qaazi ko do logon ke beech faisla nahi karna chaahiye jab wo gusse ke mizaaj mein ho."'

e: Narrated Abu Mas`ud Al-Ansari:A man came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! By Allah, I fail to attend the morning congregational prayer because so-and-so (i.e., Mu`adh bin Jabal) prolongs the prayer when he leads us for it." I had never seen the Prophet (ﷺ) more furious in giving advice than he was on that day. He then said, "O people! some of you make others dislike (good deeds, i.e. prayers etc). So whoever among you leads the people in prayer, he should shorten it because among them there are the old, the weak and the busy (needy having some jobs to do). (See Hadith No. 90, Vol)
hi: Abu Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ansari (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Allah ki qasam, main subah ki jamaat ki namaz mein shaamil nahi ho paata kyunke falaan-falaan (yaani Mu'adh bin Jabal (رضی اللہ عنہ)) namaz lambi kar dete hain jab wo hamein padhaate hain.' Maine Nabi (SAW) ko naseehat dete waqt is din se zyaada kabhi gusse mein nahi dekha. Unhone kaha, 'Aye logo! Tum mein se kuch log doosron ko (nek amaal, yaani namaz waghera) napasand karwaate hain. Isliye jo bhi tum mein se logon ko namaz padhaaye, use use chhota karna chaahiye kyunke unmein boodhe, kamzor, aur mashghool (kaam-kaaji) log hote hain.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 90, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:That he had divorced his wife during her menses. `Umar mentioned that to the Prophet. Allah's Apostle became angry and said, "He must take her back (his wife) and keep her with him till she becomes clean from her menses and then to wait till she gets her next period and becomes clean again from it and only then, if he wants to divorce her, he may do so
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke unhone apni biwi ko unki haiz (mahwaari) ke dauraan talaaq de di. Umar ne ye baat Nabi (SAW) ko bataayi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) gusse ho gaye aur kaha, 'Unhein use (apni biwi ko) wapas lena chaahiye aur use apne saath rakhna chaahiye jab tak wo apni haiz se paak na ho jaaye, aur phir intezaar karna chaahiye jab tak wo apna agla haiz na paaye aur usse phir paak na ho, aur sirf tab, agar wo use talaaq dena chaahe, to wo aisa kar sakta hai.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:Hind bint `Utba bin Rabi`a came and said. "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! By Allah, there was no family on the surface of the earth, I like to see in degradation more than I did your family, but today there is no family on the surface of the earth whom I like to see honored more than yours." Hind added, "Abu Sufyan is a miser. Is it sinful of me to feed our children from his property?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There is no blame on you if you feed them (thereof) in a just and reasonable manner
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Hind bint Utba bin Rabi'a aayi aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Allah ki qasam, zameen ki satah par koi aisa khaandaan nahi tha jise main aapke khaandaan se zyaada zaleel dekhna chahti thi, magar aaj zameen ki satah par koi aisa khaandaan nahi hai jise main aapke khaandaan se zyaada izzat wala dekhna chahti hoon.' Hind ne izaafa kiya, 'Abu Sufyan kanjoos hain. Kya ye mera gunaah hoga agar main unki jaayadaad se hamare bachon ko khilaaun?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Tumpar koi ilzaam nahi agar tum unhein (usmein se) munaasib aur jaayez tareeke se khilaao.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:When the Prophet (ﷺ) intended to write to the Byzantines, the people said, "They do not read a letter unless it is sealed (stamped)." Therefore the Prophet (ﷺ) took a silver ring----as if I am looking at its glitter now----and its engraving was: 'Muhammad, Apostle of Allah
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Nabi (SAW) ne Byzantines (Rome ke hukmraan) ko khat likhne ka iraada kiya, logon ne kaha, 'Wo koi khat tab tak nahi padhte jab tak wo mohar-band na ho.' Isliye Nabi (SAW) ne ek chaandi ki anguthi banwaayi -- jaise ke main abhi uski chamak dekh raha hoon -- aur uspar khudaayi thi: 'Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool.'

e: Narrated 'Abdullah bin As-Sa'di: That when he went to 'Umar during his Caliphate. 'Umar said to him, "Haven't I been told that you do certain jobs for the people but when you are given payment you refuse to take it?" 'Abdullah added: I said, "Yes." 'Umar said, "Why do you do so?" I said, "I have horses and slaves and I am living in prosperity and I wish that my payment should be kept as a charitable gift for the Muslims." 'Umar said, "Do not do so, for I intended to do the same as you do. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to give me gifts and I used to say to him, 'Give it to a more needy one than me.' Once he gave me some money and I said, 'Give it to a more needy person than me,' whereupon the Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Take it and keep it in your possession and then give it in charity. Take what ever comes to you of this money if you are not keen to have it and not asking for it; otherwise (i.e., if it does not come to you) do not seek to have it yourself
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin As-Sa'di bataate hain ke jab wo Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas unki Khilaafat ke daur mein gaye. Umar ne unse kaha, 'Kya mujhe nahi bataya gaya ke tum logon ke liye kuch kaam karte ho magar jab tumhein payment di jaati hai, tum use lene se inkaar karte ho?' Abdullah ne izaafa kiya: Maine kaha, 'Haan.' Umar ne kaha, 'Tum aisa kyun karte ho?' Maine kaha, 'Mere paas ghode aur ghulaam hain aur main khushhaali mein reh raha hoon aur main chahta hoon ke meri payment Musalmaanon ke liye sadqa ban jaaye.' Umar ne kaha, 'Aisa mat karo, kyunke main bhi wahi karna chahta tha jo tum karte ho. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mujhe tohfe dete the aur main unse kehta, "Ise mujhse zyaada zaroortmand ko dijiye." Ek baar unhone mujhe kuch paisa diya aur maine kaha, "Ise mujhse zyaada zaroortmand ko dijiye," isper Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, "Ise le lo aur apne paas rakh lo aur phir sadqe mein de do. Jo bhi is paise mein se tumhein mile, use le lo agar tum ise pane ke liye betaab nahi ho aur tum ise maang nahi rahe ho; warna (yaani agar wo tumhein na mile) khud ise paane ki koshish mat karo."'

e: Narrated 'Abdullah bin 'Umar:I have heard 'Umar saying, "The Prophet (ﷺ) used to give me some money (grant) and I would say (to him), 'Give it to a more needy one than me.' Once he gave me some money and I said, 'Give it to a more needy one than me.' The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to me), 'Take it and keep it in your possession and then give it in charity. Take whatever comes to you of this money while you are not keen to have it and not asking for it; take it, but you should not seek to have what you are not given
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Umar ko ye kehte suna, 'Nabi (SAW) mujhe kuch paisa (grant) dete the aur main (unse) kehta, "Ise mujhse zyaada zaroortmand ko dijiye." Ek baar unhone mujhe kuch paisa diya aur maine kaha, "Ise mujhse zyaada zaroortmand ko dijiye." Nabi (SAW) ne (mujhse) kaha, "Ise le lo aur apne paas rakh lo aur phir sadqe mein de do. Jo bhi is paise mein se tumhein mile jabke tum ise pane ke liye betaab nahi ho aur ise maang nahi rahe ho; use le lo, magar tumhein wo paane ki koshish nahi karni chaahiye jo tumhein diya nahi gaya."'

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:I witnessed a husband and a wife who were involved in a case of Lian. Then (the judgment of) divorce was passed. I was fifteen years of age, at that time
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine ek shohar aur biwi ko Li'an ke ek maamle mein shaamil dekha. Phir (talaaq ka) faisla diya gaya. Main us waqt pandrah saal ka tha.

e: Narrated Sahl:(the brother of Bani Sa`ida) A man from the Ansar came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "If a man finds another man sleeping with his wife, should he kill him?" That man and his wife then did Lian in the mosque while I was present
hi: Sahl (Banu Sa'ida qabeele ke bhai) bataate hain: Ansaar mein se ek shaks Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Agar koi aadmi kisi doosre aadmi ko apni biwi ke saath sote hue paaye, to kya use use qatl kar dena chaahiye?' Us aadmi aur uski biwi ne phir Masjid mein Li'an kiya jabke main wahaan maujood tha.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:A man came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while he was in the mosque, and called him, saying, "O Allah's Apostle! I have committed illegal sexual intercourse." The Prophet (ﷺ) turned his face to the other side, but when the man gave four witnesses against himself, the Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "Are you mad?" The man said, "No." So the Prophet (ﷺ) said (to his companions), "Take him away and stone him to death
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya jabke wo Masjid mein the, aur usne unhein pukaara, kehte hue, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Maine zina kiya hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne apna chehra doosri taraf mod liya, magar jab us shaks ne apne khilaaf chaar gawaah pesh kiye, Nabi (SAW) ne unse kaha, 'Kya tum paagal ho?' Us shaks ne kaha, 'Nahi.' To Nabi (SAW) ne (apne sahaaba se) kaha, 'Ise le jaao aur sangsaar karo.'

e: (continued from above) Narrated Jabir bin Abdullah:I was one of those who stoned him at the Musalla in Al-Madina (See Hadith)
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main un logon mein se tha jinhone Musalla mein, Al-Madina mein, use sangsaar kiya.

e: Narrated Um Salama:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I am only a human being, and you people (opponents) come to me with your cases; and it may be that one of you can present his case eloquently in a more convincing way than the other, and I give my verdict according to what I hear. So if ever I judge (by error) and give the right of a brother to his other (brother) then he (the latter) should not take it, for I am giving him only a piece of Fire." (See Hadith No. 638, Vol)
hi: Umm Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Main bhi ek insaan hoon, aur tum log (mukhaalif) apne maamlon ke saath mere paas aate ho; aur shaayad tum mein se koi apna maamla doosre se zyaada khoobsoorat andaaz mein pesh kare, jispar main sochoon ke wo sacha hai aur uske haq mein faisla dun. Isliye agar main kisi ke haq mein faisla doon jispar wo kisi (Musalmaan) bhai ka haq na-jaayez tareeke se le le, to jo bhi wo lega wo sirf Aag ka ek tukda hoga, aur ab uske upar hai ke wo ise le ya chhod de.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 638, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated Abu Qatada:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said on the Day of (the battle of) Hunain, "Whoever has killed an infidel and has a proof or a witness for it, then the salb (arms and belongings of that deceased) will be for him." I stood up to seek a witness to testify that I had killed an infidel but I could not find any witness and then sat down. Then I thought that I should mention the case to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (and when I did so) a man from those who were sitting with him said, "The arms of the killed person he has mentioned, are with me, so please satisfy him on my behalf." Abu Bakr said, "No, he will not give the arms to a bird of Quraish and deprive one of Allah's lions of it who fights for the cause of Allah and His Apostle." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up and gave it to me, and I bought a garden with its price, and that was my first property which I owned through the war booty. The people of Hijaz said, "A judge should not pass a judgment according to his knowledge, whether he was a witness at the time he was the judge or before that" And if a litigant gives a confession in favor of his opponent in the court, in the opinion of some scholars, the judge should not pass a judgment against him till the latter calls two witnesses to witness his confession. And some people of Iraq said, "A judge can pass a judgement according to what he hears or witnesses (the litigant's confession) in the court itself, but if the confession takes place outside the court, he should not pass the judgment unless two witnesses witness the confession." Some of them said, "A judge can pass a judgement depending on his knowledge of the case as he is trust-worthy, and that a witness is Required just to reveal the truth.
