The judge's knowledge is more than the witness." Some said, "A judge can judge according to his knowledge only in cases involving property, but in other cases he cannot." Al-Qasim said, "A judge ought not to pass a judgment depending on his knowledge if other people do not know what he knows, although his knowledge is more than the witness of somebody else because he might expose himself to suspicion by the Muslims and cause the Muslims to have unreasonable doubt
hi: Abu Qatada (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne jang-e-Hunain ke din farmaya, 'Jo koi bhi ek kaafir ko qatl kare aur uske paas iska saboot ya gawaah ho, to us (marne wale) ka Salb (hathiyaar aur saamaan) usi ka hoga.' Main khada hua ye pata karne ke liye ke koi gawaah mil sakta hai jo tasdeeq kare ke maine ek kaafir ko qatl kiya, magar mujhe koi gawaah nahi mila aur main baith gaya. Phir maine socha ke mujhe ye maamla Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko bataana chaahiye (aur jab maine aisa kiya) unke saath baithe logon mein se ek shaks ne kaha, 'Us maare gaye shaks ke hathiyaar jinka unhone zikr kiya wo mere paas hain, isliye barah-e-meharbaani meri taraf se use santusht kijiye.' Abu Bakr ne kaha, 'Nahi, wo (hathiyaar) kisi Quraishi parinde ko nahi denge aur Allah ke sheron mein se ek ko is se mehroom nahi karenge jo Allah aur uske Rasool ki khaatir ladta hai.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khade hue aur wo mujhe de diya, aur maine uski keemat se ek baag khareeda, aur wo meri pehli jaayadaad thi jo maine jang ke maal-e-ganimat se haasil ki. Hijaz ke logon ne kaha, 'Ek qaazi ko apne (khud ke) ilm ke mutaabik faisla nahi dena chaahiye, chaahe wo qaazi banne se pehle ya baad mein gawaah tha.' Aur agar koi mukhaalif adaalat mein apne mukhaalif ke haq mein iqraar kare, kuch aalimon ki raay mein, qaazi ko uske khilaaf faisla tab tak nahi dena chaahiye jab tak dusra shaks do gawaah unke iqraar ki gawaahi dene ke liye na bulaaye. Aur kuch Iraqi logon ne kaha, 'Ek qaazi wahi faisla de sakta hai jo wo adaalat mein hi sune ya dekhe (mukhaalif ka iqraar), magar agar iqraar adaalat ke baahar hota hai, to use faisla tab tak nahi dena chaahiye jab tak do gawaah iqraar ki gawaahi na dein.' Kuch ne kaha, 'Ek qaazi apne maamle ke ilm ke aadhaar par faisla de sakta hai kyunke wo bharosemand hai, aur gawaah ki zaroorat sirf sach zaahir karne ke liye hoti hai. Qaazi ka ilm gawaah se zyaada hota hai.' Kuch ne kaha, 'Ek qaazi apne ilm ke mutaabik sirf jaayadaad se juda maamlon mein faisla de sakta hai, magar doosre maamlon mein nahi kar sakta.' Al-Qasim ne kaha, 'Ek qaazi ko apne ilm ke aadhaar par faisla nahi dena chaahiye agar doosre logon ko wo nahi pata jo usse pata hai, chaahe uska ilm doosre kisi gawaah ke gawaahi se zyaada ho, kyunke wo Musalmaanon ke shak mein khud ko daal sakta hai aur Musalmaanon ko na-vaajib shak mein daal sakta hai.'

e: Narrated `Ali bin Husain:Safiya bint (daughter of) Huyai came to the Prophet (in the mosque), and when she returned (home), the Prophet (ﷺ) accompanied her. It happened that two men from the Ansar passed by them and the Prophet called them saying, "She is Safiya!" those two men said, "Subhan Allah!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Satan circulates in the human body as blood does
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bin Husain bataate hain: Safiya (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Huyai Nabi (SAW) ke paas (Masjid mein) aayi, aur jab wo wapas gayi, Nabi (SAW) unke saath gaye. Uss dauraan do Ansaari log unke paas se guzre, aur Nabi (SAW) ne unhein pukaara, kehte hue, 'Ye Safiya hain!' Un dono aadmiyon ne kaha, 'Subhan Allah!' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Shaitaan insaan ke jism mein aise daudta hai jaise uska khoon daudta hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Burda:The Prophet (ﷺ) sent my father and Mu`adh bin Jabal to Yemen and said (to them), "Make things easy for the people and do not put hurdles in their way, and give them glad tiding, and don't let them have aversion (i.e. to make people to hate good deeds) and you both should work in cooperation and mutual understanding" Abu Musa said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), "In our country a special alcoholic drink called Al- Bit', is prepared (for drinking)." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Every intoxicant is prohibited
hi: Abu Burda bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne mere waalid aur Mu'adh bin Jabal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko Yemen bheja aur (unse) kaha, 'Logon ke liye cheezein aasaan karo aur unke raaste mein mushkilein mat daalo, aur unhein khush-khabri do, aur unhein nafrat mat karwaao (nek amaal se), aur tum dono milkar aur ek doosre ki samajh se kaam karo.' Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kaha, 'Hamare ilaake mein Al-Bit' naami ek khaas sharaab (peene ke liye) taiyaar ki jaati hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Har nasha-aawar cheez haraam hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Set free the captives and accept invitations
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Qaidiyon ko azaad karo aur dawaton ko qubool karo.'

e: Narrated Abu Humaid Al-Sa`idi:The Prophet (ﷺ) appointed a man from the tribe of Bani Asad, called Ibn Al-Utabiyya to collect the Zakat. When he returned (with the money) he said (to the Prophet), "This is for you and this has been given to me as a gift." The Prophet (ﷺ) stood up on the pulpit (Sufyan said he ascended the pulpit), and after glorifying and praising Allah, he said, "What is wrong with the employee whom we send (to collect Zakat from the public) that he returns to say, 'This is for you and that is for me?' Why didn't he stay at his father's and mother's house to see whether he will be given gifts or not? By Him in Whose Hand my life is, whoever takes anything illegally will bring it on the Day of Resurrection by carrying it over his neck: if it is a camel, it will be grunting: if it is a cow, it will be mooing: and if it is a sheep it will be bleating!" The Prophet (ﷺ) then raised both his hands till we saw the whiteness of his armpits (and he said), "No doubt! Haven't I conveyed Allah's Message?" And he repeated it three times
hi: Abu Humaid Al-Saidi bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne Banu Asad qabeele ke ek shaks, jinka naam Ibn Al-Utabiyya tha, ko Zakat jama karne muqarrar kiya. Jab wo (paise lekar) wapas aaye, unhone (Nabi se) kaha, 'Ye aapke liye hai aur ye mujhe tohfe mein di gayi hai.' Nabi (SAW) mimbar par khade hue (Sufyan kehte hain wo mimbar par chadhe), aur Allah ki hamd aur tareef karne ke baad, unhone kaha, 'Us mulaazim ko kya hua jise hum (logon se Zakat jama karne) bhejte hain aur wo wapas kehte hue aata hai, "Ye aapke liye hai aur wo mere liye hai"? Kyun na wo apne waalid ya maa ke ghar reh kar dekhta ke usse tohfe milte hain ya nahi? Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, jo koi na-jaayez cheez le lega, wo use Qayamat ke din apni gardan par uthaakar laayega: agar wo oont hoga, to wo bulbulaayega; agar wo gaay hogi, to wo raambhaayegi; aur agar wo bakri hogi, to wo bhen-bhenaayegi!' Nabi (SAW) ne phir apne dono haath itne oopar uthaaye ke humne unki baaghal ki safedi dekhi (aur kaha), 'Kya maine Allah ka paighaam pahuncha nahi diya?' Aur unhone ise teen baar dohraaya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Salim, the freed salve of Abu Hudhaifa used to lead in prayer the early Muhajirin (emigrants) and the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) in the Quba mosque. Among those (who used to pray behind him) were Abu Bakr, `Umar, Abu Salama, and Amir bin Rabi`a
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Salim, Abu Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke azaad kiye ghulaam, Quba ki Masjid mein pehle Muhaajireen aur Nabi (SAW) ke sahaaba ki namaz padhaate the. Unmein se (jo unke peechhe namaz padhte) Abu Bakr, Umar, Abu Salama, aur Aamir bin Rabi'a the.

e: Narrated `Urwa bin Az-Zubair:Marwan bin Al-Hakam and Al-Miswar bin Makhrama told him that when the Muslims were permitted to set free the captives of Hawazin, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I do not know who amongst you has agreed (to it) and who has not. Go back so that your 'Urafa' may submit your decision to us." So the people returned and their 'Urafa' talked to them and then came back to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and told him that the people had given their consent happily and permitted (their captives to be freed)
hi: Urwa bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Marwan bin Al-Hakam aur Al-Miswar bin Makhrama (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne unhein bataaya ke jab Musalmaanon ko Hawazin ke qaidiyon ko azaad karne ki ijaazat di gayi, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Mujhe nahi pata tum mein se kisne (isse) raazi hokar aur kisne nahi. Wapas jaao taake tumhaare Urafa (namaindé) hamare paas tumhaara faisla pesh kar sakein.' To log wapas gaye aur unke Urafa unse baat karke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas wapas aaye aur unhein bataaya ke logon ne khushi se apni raazamandi di hai aur (apne qaidiyon ko) azaad karne ki ijaazat di.

e: Narrated Muhammad bin Zaid bin `Abdullah bin `Umar:Some people said to Ibn `Umar, "When we enter upon our ruler(s) we say in their praise what is contrary to what we say when we leave them." Ibn `Umar said, "We used to consider this as hypocrisy
hi: Muhammad bin Zaid bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Kuch logon ne Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kaha, 'Jab hum apne hukmraan ke paas jaate hain, hum unki tareef mein wo baaten kehte hain jo hum unse door hote waqt kehte hain uske ulat hain.' Ibn Umar ne kaha, 'Hum ise munaafiqat samajhte the.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The worst of all mankind is the double-faced one, who comes to some people with one face and to others, with another face
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Sab insaanon mein sabse buraa dohra-chehra waala shaks hai, jo kuch logon ke paas ek chehra lekar aata hai aur doosron ke paas ek doosra chehra.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:Hind (bint `Utba) said to the Prophet (ﷺ) "Abu Sufyan is a miserly man and I need to take some money of his wealth." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Take reasonably what is sufficient for you and your children
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Hind (bint Utba) ne Nabi (SAW) se kaha, 'Abu Sufyan kanjoos hain aur mujhe unki jaayadaad se kuch paisa lena zaroori hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Jo munaasib ho aur tumhaare aur tumhaare bachon ke liye kaafi ho, wahi lo.'

e: Narrated Um Salama:(the wife of the Prophet) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) heard some people quarreling at the door of his dwelling, so he went out to them and said, "I am only a human being, and litigants with cases of dispute come to me, and someone of you may happen to be more eloquent (in presenting his case) than the other, whereby I may consider that he is truthful and pass a judgment in his favor. If ever I pass a judgment in favor of somebody whereby he takes a Muslim's right unjustly, then whatever he takes is nothing but a piece of Fire, and it is up to him to take or leave
hi: Umm Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki zawja) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kuch logon ko apne ghar ke darwaaze par jhagda karte suna, isliye wo unke paas gaye aur kaha, 'Main bhi ek insaan hoon, aur mukhaalif apne maamlon ke saath mere paas aate hain, aur shaayad tum mein se koi doosre se zyaada khoobsoorat andaaz mein baat kare, jispar main sochoon ke wo sacha hai aur uske haq mein faisla dun. Agar main kabhi kisi ke haq mein faisla doon jispar wo kisi Musalmaan ka haq na-jaayez tareeke se le le, to jo bhi wo lega wo sirf Aag ka ek tukda hoga, aur ab uske upar hai ke wo ise le ya chhod de.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) `Utba bin Abi Waqqas said to his brother Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas, "The son of the slave girl of Zam`a is from me, so take him into your custody." So in the year of Conquest of Mecca, Sa`d took him and said. (This is) my brother's son whom my brother has asked me to take into my custody." `Abd bin Zam`a got up before him and said, (He is) my brother and the son of the slave girl of my father, and was born on my father's bed." So they both submitted their case before Allah's Apostle. Sa`d said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! This boy is the son of my brother and he entrusted him to me." `Abd bin Zam`a said, "This boy is my brother and the son of the slave girl of my father, and was born on the bed of my father." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The boy is for you, O `Abd bin Zam`a!" Then Allah's Apostle further said, "The child is for the owner of the bed, and the stone is for the adulterer," He then said to Sauda bint Zam`a, "Veil (screen) yourself before him," when he saw the child's resemblance to `Utba. The boy did not see her again till he met Allah
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki zawja) bataati hain: Utba bin Abi Waqqas ne apne bhai Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kaha, 'Zam'a ki launDi ka beta mera hai, isliye use apni zimmedaari mein le lo.' To Fatah-e-Makkah ke saal, Sa'd ne use liya aur kaha, '(Ye) mere bhai ka beta hai jise mere bhai ne mujhse zimmedaari lene ko kaha.' Abd bin Zam'a unke saamne khade hue aur kaha, '(Wo) mera bhai hai aur mere waalid ki launDi ka beta, aur mere waalid ke bistar par paida hua.' To dono apna maamla Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laaye. Sa'd ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Ye ladka mere bhai ka beta hai aur unhone mujhe use apni zimmedaari mein lene ko kaha.' Abd bin Zam'a ne kaha, 'Ye ladka mera bhai hai aur mere waalid ki launDi ka beta, aur mere waalid ke bistar par paida hua.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Ladka tumhaara hai, Aye Abd bin Zam'a!' Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne aage kaha, 'Bacha bistar ke maalik ka hota hai, aur pathhar zina karne wale ke liye hai.' Phir unhone Sauda (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Zam'a se kaha, 'Iske saamne apne aap ko dhaanko,' jab unhone bacche mein Utba ki jhalak dekhi. Us ladke ne unhein (Sauda ko) phir kabhi nahi dekha jab tak wo Allah se nahi mila (yaani mar gaya).

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If somebody on the demand of a judge takes an oath to grab (a Muslim's) property and he is liar in it, he will meet Allah Who will be angry with him". So Allah revealed,:-- 'Verily! those who purchase a small gain at the cost of Allah's Covenant and their oaths..' (3.77) 'Al- Ashath came while `Abdullah was narrating (this) to the people. Al-Ashath said, "This verse was revealed regarding me and another man with whom I had a quarrel about a well. The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to me), "Do you have any evidence?' I replied, 'No.' He said, 'Let your opponent take an oath.' I said: I am sure he would take a (false) oath." Thereupon it was revealed: 'Verily! those who purchase a small gain at the cost of Allah's Covenant....' (3.77) (See Hadith No. 72, Vol)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar koi qaazi ke hukm par (kisi ka) jaayadaad hadapne ke liye qasam khaaye aur wo isme jhoota ho, to wo Allah se milega jo usse gussa hoga.' To Allah ne naazil kiya: 'Beshak! Wo log jo Allah ke ahad aur apni qasmon ke badle mein thodi cheez khareedte hain...' (3:77). Al-Ashath aaye jab Abdullah ye (baat) logon ko sunaa rahe the. Al-Ashath ne kaha, 'Ye Aayat mere aur ek doosre aadmi ke silsile mein naazil hui thi jinke saath mera ek kuen ke baare mein jhagda tha. Nabi (SAW) ne (mujhse) kaha, "Kya tumhaare paas koi saboot hai?" Maine jawab diya, "Nahi." Unhone kaha, "To apne mukhaalif ko qasam khaane do." Maine kaha, "Mujhe yaqeen hai wo (jhoothi) qasam khaayenge."' Isper naazil hua: 'Beshak! Wo log jo Allah ke ahad aur apni qasmon ke badle mein thodi cheez khareedte hain...' (3:77). (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 72, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated Um Salama:The Prophet (ﷺ) heard the voices of some people quarreling near his gate, so he went to them and said, "I am only a human being and litigants with cases of disputes come to me, and maybe one of them presents his case eloquently in a more convincing and impressive way than the other, and I give my verdict in his favor thinking he is truthful. So if I give a Muslim's right to another (by mistake), then that (property) is a piece of Fire, which is up to him to take it or leave it." (See Hadith No)
hi: Umm Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ne kuch logon ki apne darwaaze ke qareeb jhagda karne ki aawazein sunin, isliye wo unke paas gaye aur kaha, 'Main bhi ek insaan hoon aur mukhaalif apne maamlon ke saath mere paas aate hain, aur shaayad unmein se koi apna maamla doosre se zyaada khoobsoorat aur qaayil karne wale andaaz mein pesh kare, aur main sochoon ke wo sacha hai aur uske haq mein faisla dun. Isliye agar main kisi Musalmaan ka haq (galti se) doosre ko de doon, to wo (jaayadaad) Aag ka ek tukda hai, jise wo le sakta hai ya chhod sakta hai.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees dekhein.)

e: Narrated Jabir:The Prophet (ﷺ) came to know that one of his companions had given the promise of freeing his slave after his death, but as he had no other property than that slave, the Prophet (ﷺ) sold that slave for 800 dirhams and sent the price to him
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ko pata chala ke unke ek sahaabi ne apni maut ke baad apne ghulaam ko azaad karne ka waada diya tha, magar unke paas us ghulaam ke ilaawa koi doosri jaayadaad nahi thi, isliye Nabi (SAW) ne us ghulaam ko aath sau Dirham mein becha aur wo raqam unhein bhej di.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent an army unit headed by Usama bin Zaid and the people criticized his leadership. The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to the people), "If you are criticizing his leadership now, then you used to criticize his father's leadership before. By Allah, he (Usama's father) deserved the leadership and used to be one of the most beloved persons to me, and now his son (Usama) is one of the most beloved persons to me after him. " (See Hadith No. 745, Vol)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki sardaari mein ek fauji dasta bheja, aur logon ne unki sardaari ki aalochana ki. Nabi (SAW) ne (logon se) kaha, 'Agar tum ab inki sardaari ki aalochana kar rahe ho, to tumne pehle unke waalid ki sardaari ki bhi aalochana ki thi. Allah ki qasam, wo (Usama ke waalid) sardaari ke laayak the, aur wo mere sabse aziz logon mein se ek the, aur ab unka beta (Usama) unke baad mere sabse aziz logon mein se ek hai.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 745, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The most hated person in the sight of Allah, is the most quarrelsome person
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah ke nazdeek sabse napasandidaa shaks wo hai jo sabse zyaada jhagdaalu ho.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) sent (an army unit under the command of) Khalid bin Al-Walid to fight against the tribe of Bani Jadhima and those people could not express themselves by saying, "Aslamna," but they said, "Saba'na! Saba'na! " Khalid kept on killing some of them and taking some others as captives, and he gave a captive to everyone of us and ordered everyone of us to kill his captive. I said, "By Allah, I shall not kill my captive and none of my companions shall kill his captive!" Then we mentioned that to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he said, "O Allah! I am free from what Khalid bin Al-Walid has done," and repeated it twice
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne Khalid bin Al-Walid ki sardaari mein (ek fauji dasta) Banu Jadhima qabeele ke khilaaf ladne bheja, aur wo log khud ko "Aslamna" (yaani hum Musalmaan ban gaye) nahi keh paaye, balke unhone kaha, "Saba'na! Saba'na!" (hum apna deen chhod chuke!). Khalid unmein se kuch ko qatl karte gaye aur kuch ko qaidi banaate gaye, aur unhone hum mein se har ek ko ek qaidi diya aur hukm diya ke har koi apna qaidi qatl kare. Maine kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, na main apna qaidi qatl karunga, na hi mera koi saathi apna qaidi qatl karega!' Phir humne ye baat Nabi (SAW) ko bataayi, aur unhone kaha, 'Aye Allah! Main us amal se azaad hoon jo Khalid bin Al-Walid ne kiya,' aur unhone ise do baar dohraaya.

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d As-Saidi:There was some quarrel (sighting) among Bani `Amr, and when this news reached the Prophet, he offered the Zuhr prayer and went to establish peace among them. In the meantime the time of `Asr prayer was due, Bilal pronounced the Adhan and then the Iqama for the prayer and requested Abu Bakr (to lead the prayer) and Abu Bakr went forward. The Prophet (ﷺ) arrived while Abu Bakr was still praying. He entered the rows of praying people till he stood behind Abu Bakr in the (first) row. The people started clapping, and it was the habit of Abu Bakr that whenever he stood for prayer, he never glanced side-ways till he had finished it, but when Abu Bakr observed that the clapping was not coming to an end, he looked and saw the Prophet (ﷺ) standing behind him. The Prophet (ﷺ) beckoned him to carry on by waving his hand. Abu Bakr stood there for a while, thanking Allah for the saying of the Prophet (ﷺ) and then he retreated, taking his steps backwards. When the Prophet saw that, he went ahead and led the people in prayer. When he finished the prayer, he said, "O Abu Bakr! What prevented you from carrying on with the prayer after I beckoned you to do so?" Abu Bakr replied, "It does not befit the son of Abi Quhafa to lead the Prophet (ﷺ) in prayer." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said to the people, "If some problem arises during prayers, then the men should say, Subhan Allah!; and the women should clap." (See Hadith No. 652, Vol)
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) As-Sa'idi bataate hain: Banu Amr qabeele mein kuch jhagda (matbhed) hua, aur jab ye khabar Nabi (SAW) tak pahunchi, unhone Zuhr ki namaz padhi aur unke beech sulah karwaane gaye. Isi dauraan Asr ki namaz ka waqt aa gaya, Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Azaan aur phir Iqama kahi aur Abu Bakr se (namaz padhaane ki) darkhwaast ki, aur Abu Bakr aage badhe. Nabi (SAW) pahunche jabke Abu Bakr abhi namaz padha rahe the. Wo namaz padh rahe logon ki qataaron mein daakhil hue yahaan tak ke wo pehli qataar mein Abu Bakr ke peechhe khade hue. Logon ne taaliyaan bajaani shuru ki, aur Abu Bakr ki aadat thi ke jab bhi wo namaz mein khade hote, wo kabhi bagal mein nahi dekhte the jab tak namaz khatam na kar lein, magar jab Abu Bakr ne dekha ke taaliyaan rukne ka naam nahi le rahi, unhone dekha aur apne peechhe Nabi (SAW) ko khade dekha. Nabi (SAW) ne apne haath se ishara kiya ke wo namaz jaari rakhein. Abu Bakr thodi der wahaan khade rahe, Allah ka Nabi (SAW) ke is farmaan ke liye shukriya adaa karte hue, phir wo peechhe hate, apne qadam peeche khinchte hue. Jab Nabi (SAW) ne ye dekha, wo aage badhe aur logon ko namaz padhaayi. Jab unhone namaz khatam ki, unhone kaha, 'Aye Abu Bakr! Jab maine tumhein ishara kiya (namaz jaari rakhne ke liye), tumhein aisa karne se kis cheez ne roka?' Abu Bakr ne jawab diya, 'Abi Quhafa ke bete ke liye ye shaayaan nahi ke wo Nabi (SAW) ko namaz padhaaye.' Phir Nabi (SAW) ne logon se kaha, 'Agar namaz ke dauraan koi mushkil aaye, to mardon ko "Subhan Allah" kehna chaahiye; aur khawaateen ko taaliyaan bajaani chaahiye.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 652, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated Zaid bin Thabit:Abu Bakr sent for me owing to the large number of casualties in the battle of Al-Yamama, while `Umar was sitting with him. Abu Bakr said (to me), `Umar has come to my and said, 'A great number of Qaris of the Holy Qur'an were killed on the day of the battle of Al-Yamama, and I am afraid that the casualties among the Qaris of the Qur'an may increase on other battle-fields whereby a large part of the Qur'an may be lost. Therefore I consider it advisable that you (Abu Bakr) should have the Qur'an collected.' I said, 'How dare I do something which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not do?' `Umar said, By Allah, it is something beneficial.' `Umar kept on pressing me for that till Allah opened my chest for that for which He had opened the chest of `Umar and I had in that matter, the same opinion as `Umar had." Abu Bakr then said to me (Zaid), "You are a wise young man and we do not have any suspicion about you, and you used to write the Divine Inspiration for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). So you should search for the fragmentary scripts of the Qur'an and collect it (in one Book)." Zaid further said: By Allah, if Abu Bakr had ordered me to shift a mountain among the mountains from one place to another it would not have been heavier for me than this ordering me to collect the Qur'an. Then I said (to `Umar and Abu Bakr), "How can you do something which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not do?" Abu Bakr said, "By Allah, it is something beneficial." Zaid added: So he (Abu Bakr) kept on pressing me for that until Allah opened my chest for that for which He had opened the chests of Abu Bakr and `Umar, and I had in that matter, the same opinion as theirs. So I started compiling the Qur'an by collecting it from the leafless stalks of the date-palm tree and from the pieces of leather and hides and from the stones, and from the chests of men (who had memorized the Qur'an). I found the last verses of Surat-at-Tauba: ("Verily there has come unto you an Apostle (Muhammad) from amongst yourselves--' (9.128-129) ) from Khuza`ima or Abi Khuza`ima and I added to it the rest of the Sura. The manuscripts of the Qur'an remained with Abu Bakr till Allah took him unto Him. Then it remained with `Umar till Allah took him unto Him, and then with Hafsa bint `Umar
hi: Zaid bin Thabit (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Al-Yamama ki jang mein bahut zyaada nuqsaan ki wajah se Abu Bakr ne mujhe bulwaaya, jabke Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) unke paas baithe hue the. Abu Bakr ne (mujhse) kaha, 'Umar mere paas aaye aur kaha, "Al-Yamama ki jang ke din bahut se Quran ke Qaris (haafiz) qatl kiye gaye, aur mujhe dar hai ke doosre jang ke maidaanon mein Quran ke Qaris ka nuqsaan aur badh sakta hai, jispar Quran ka ek bada hissa kho sakta hai. Isliye main ye salaah deta hoon ke aap (Abu Bakr) Quran ko jama karwaayein." Maine kaha, "Main aisi cheez kaise kar sakta hoon jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne nahi ki?" Umar ne kaha, "Allah ki qasam, ye ek faayde-mand kaam hai." Umar mujhpar isi baat ka zor daalte rahe yahaan tak ke Allah ne mera seena us baat ke liye khol diya jiske liye usne Umar ka seena khola tha, aur mujhe is maamle mein wahi raay thi jo Umar ki thi.' Abu Bakr ne phir mujhse (Zaid se) kaha, 'Tum ek aqlmand jawaan aadmi ho aur humein tumpar koi shak nahi, aur tum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke liye Ilaahi Wahi likha karte the. Isliye tumhein Quran ke bikhre hue hisson ko dhoondhna chaahiye aur use (ek Kitaab mein) jama karna chaahiye.' Zaid ne aage kaha: Allah ki qasam, agar Abu Bakr mujhe kisi pahaad ko ek jagah se doosri jagah hilaane ka hukm dete, to wo mujhe Quran jama karne ke is hukm se kam bhaari nahi lagta. Phir maine (Umar aur Abu Bakr se) kaha, 'Aap kaise wo cheez kar sakte hain jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne nahi ki?' Abu Bakr ne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, ye ek faayde-mand kaam hai.' Zaid ne izaafa kiya: To wo (Abu Bakr) mujhpar isi baat ka zor daalte rahe yahaan tak ke Allah ne mera seena us baat ke liye khol diya jiske liye usne Abu Bakr aur Umar ka seena khola tha, aur mujhe is maamle mein unki hi raay thi. To maine Quran ko jama karna shuru kiya, khajoor ke bina-patton ke danthal se, chamde aur khaal ke tukdon se, aur pattharon se, aur un logon ke seenon se (jinhone Quran yaad kiya hua tha). Maine Surah At-Tauba ki aakhri Aayaten ("Beshak, tumhaare paas ek Rasool (Muhammad) aaye hain tum mein se..." (9:128-129)) Khuzaima ya Abi Khuzaima ke paas payi aur maine ise Surah ke baaki hisse mein jod diya. Quran ke naskhe Abu Bakr ke paas rahe jab tak Allah ne unhein apne paas nahi bulaaya. Phir wo Umar ke paas rahe jab tak Allah ne unhein apne paas nahi bulaaya, aur phir wo Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Umar ke paas rahe.

e: Narrated Abu Laila bin `Abdullah bin `Abdur-Rahman bin Sahl:Sahl bin Abi Hathma and some great men of his tribe said, `Abdullah bin 'Sahl and Muhaiyisa went out to Khaibar as they were struck with poverty and difficult living conditions. Then Muhaiyisa was informed that `Abdullah had been killed and thrown in a pit or a spring. Muhaiyisa went to the Jews and said, "By Allah, you have killed my companion." The Jews said, "By Allah, we have not killed him." Muhaiyisa then came back to his people and told them the story. He, his elder brother Huwaiyisa and `Abdur-Rahman bin Sahl came (to the Prophet) and he who had been at Khaibar, proceeded to speak, but the Prophet (ﷺ) said to Muhaiyisa, "The eldest! The eldest!" meaning, "Let the eldest of you speak." So Huwaiyisa spoke first and then Muhaiyisa. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The Jews should either pay the blood money of your (deceased) companion or be ready for war." After that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) wrote a letter to the Jews in that respect, and they wrote that they had not killed him. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to Huwaiyisa, Muhaiyisa and `Abdur-Rahman, "Can you take an oath by which you will be entitled to take the blood money?" They said, "No." He said (to them), "Shall we ask the Jews to take an oath before you?" They replied, "But the Jews are not Muslims." So Allah's Apostle gave them one-hundred she-camels as blood money from himself. Sahl added: When those she-camels were made to enter the house, one of them kicked me with its leg
hi: Abu Laila bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdur Rahman bin Sahl bataate hain: Sahl bin Abi Hathma aur unke qabeele ke kuch bade logon ne kaha, 'Abdullah bin Sahl aur Muhaiyisa Khaibar gaye kyunke wo gareebi aur mushkil zindagi mein the. Phir Muhaiyisa ko bataaya gaya ke Abdullah ko qatl karke ek gaddhe ya chashme mein phenk diya gaya hai. Muhaiyisa Yahudiyon ke paas gaye aur kaha, "Allah ki qasam, tumne mere saathi ko qatl kiya hai." Yahudiyon ne kaha, "Allah ki qasam, humne unhein qatl nahi kiya." Phir Muhaiyisa apne log ke paas wapas aaye aur unhein poori kahaani bataayi. Wo, unke bade bhai Huwaiyisa, aur Abdur Rahman bin Sahl (Nabi ke paas) aaye, aur jo Khaibar mein maujood the (yaani Muhaiyisa) bolne lage, magar Nabi (SAW) ne Muhaiyisa se kaha, "Bade! Bade!" yaani "Tum mein se sabse bade ko bolna chaahiye." To Huwaiyisa ne pehle baat ki, phir Muhaiyisa ne. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, "Yahudiyon ko ya to tumhaare (murda) saathi ka khoon-bahaa dena chaahiye ya jang ke liye taiyaar rehna chaahiye." Uske baad Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Yahudiyon ko is baare mein ek khat likha, aur unhone jawab diya ke unhone unhein qatl nahi kiya. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Huwaiyisa, Muhaiyisa, aur Abdur Rahman se kaha, "Kya tum aisi qasam khaa sakte ho jiske zariye tumhein khoon-bahaa lene ka haq mile?" Unhone kaha, "Nahi." Unhone (unse) kaha, "Kya hum Yahudiyon se tumhaare saamne qasam khilaayein?" Unhone jawab diya, "Magar Yahudi Musalmaan nahi hain." To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne khud apni taraf se unhein sau oont khoon-bahaa mein diye.' Sahl ne izaafa kiya: Jab wo oont ghar mein le jaaye gaye, unmein se ek ne mujhe apne pair se maara.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira and Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani:A bedouin came and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Judge between us according to Allah's Book (Laws)." His opponent stood up and said, "He has said the truth, so judge between us according to Allah's Laws." The bedouin said, "My son was a laborer for this man and committed illegal sexual intercourse with his wife. The people said to me, 'Your son is to be stoned to death,' so I ransomed my son for one hundred sheep and a slave girl. Then I asked the religious learned men and they said to me, 'Your son has to receive one hundred lashes plus one year of exile.' " The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I shall judge between you according to Allah's Book (Laws)! As for the slave girl and the sheep, it shall be returned to you, and your son shall receive one-hundred lashes and be exiled for one year. O you, Unais!" The Prophet (ﷺ) addressed some man, "Go in the morning to the wife of this man and stone her to death." So Unais went to her the next morning and stoned her to death
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Zaid bin Khalid (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Juhani (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek badawi aaye aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Allah ki Kitaab (Qawaanin) ke mutaabik hamare beech faisla kijiye.' Uske mukhaalif khade hue aur kaha, 'Unhone sach kaha, isliye Allah ke Qawaanin ke mutaabik hamare beech faisla kijiye.' Badawi ne kaha, 'Mera beta is aadmi ka mazdoor tha aur usne iski biwi ke saath zina kiya. Logon ne mujhse kaha, "Tumhaare bete ko sangsaar kiya jaana chaahiye," isliye maine apne bete ke fidye mein sau bakriyaan aur ek launDi di. Phir maine deeni aalimon se pucha aur unhone mujhe bataaya, "Tumhaare bete ko sau kode maare jaane chaahiye aur ek saal ke liye jila-watan kiya jaana chaahiye."' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Main tumhaare beech Allah ki Kitaab (Qawaanin) ke mutaabik faisla dunga! Jahaan tak launDi aur bakriyon ki baat hai, wo tumhein wapas ki jaayengi, aur tumhaare bete ko sau kode maare jaayenge aur ek saal ke liye jila-watan kiya jaayega. Aye Unais!' Nabi (SAW) ne kisi shaks se khitaab kiya, 'Subah is aadmi ki biwi ke paas jaao aur use sangsaar karo.' To Unais agli subah unke paas gaye aur unhein sangsaar kar diya.

e: Kharija bin Zaid bin Thabit said that Zaid bin Thabit said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered me to learn the writing of the Jews. I even wrote letters for the Prophet (ﷺ) (to the Jews) and also read their letters when they wrote to him." And 'Umar said in the presence of 'Ali, 'Abdur-Rahman, and 'Uthman, "What is this woman saying?" (the woman was non-Arab) 'Abdur-Rahman bin Hatib said:"She is informing you about her companion who has committed illegal sexual intercourse with her." Abu Jamra said, "I was an interpreter between Ibn 'Abbas and the people." Some people said, "A ruler should have two interpreters
hi: Kharija bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Thabit (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Zaid bin Thabit ne kaha, 'Nabi (SAW) ne mujhe Yahudiyon ki likhaawat seekhne ka hukm diya. Maine Nabi (SAW) ke liye khat bhi likhe (Yahudiyon ke naam), aur jab wo unhein khat likhte, main unhein padh kar sunaata.' Aur Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Ali (Alayhis Salam), Abdur Rahman, aur Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki maujoodgi mein kaha, 'Ye khaatoon kya keh rahi hai?' (khaatoon gair-Arab thi). Abdur Rahman bin Hatib ne kaha, 'Wo aapko apne saathi ke baare mein bata rahi hai jisne uske saath zina kiya.' Abu Jamra ne kaha, 'Main Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur logon ke beech tarjuman (mutarjim) tha.' Kuch logon ne kaha, 'Ek hukmraan ke paas do mutarjim hone chaahiye.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abbas:That Abu Sufyan bin Harb told him that Heraclius had called him along with the members of a Quraish caravan and then said to his interpreter, "Tell them that I want to ask this (Abu Sufyan) a question, and if he tries to tell me a lie, they should contradict him." Then Abu Sufyan mentioned the whole narration and said that Heraclius said to the inter Peter, "Say to him (Abu Sufyan), 'If what you say is true, then he (the Prophet) will take over the place underneath my two feet
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Harb ne unhein bataya ke Heraclius ne unhein Quraish qafile ke sadasyon ke saath bulwaaya aur phir apne mutarjim se kaha, 'Unhein bataao ke main isse (Abu Sufyan se) ek sawaal poochna chahta hoon, aur agar wo mujhse jhoot bolne ki koshish kare, to unhein unki tardeed karni chaahiye.' Phir Abu Sufyan ne poori riwaayat sunaayi aur kaha ke Heraclius ne mutarjim se kaha, 'Usse (Abu Sufyan se) kaho, "Agar jo tum kehte ho wo sach hai, to wo (Nabi) mere dono pairon ke neeche ki jagah bhi le lenge."'

e: Narrated Abu Humaid As-Sa`idi:The Prophet (ﷺ) employed Ibn Al-Utbiyya to collect Zakat from Bani Sulaim, and when he returned (with the money) to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) the Prophet (ﷺ) called him to account, and he said, "This (amount) is for you, and this was given to me as a present." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Why don't you stay at your father's house or your mother's house to see whether you will be given gifts or not, if you are telling the truth?" Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up and addressed the people, and after glorifying and praising Allah, he said: Amma Ba'du (then after) I employ some men from among you for some job which Allah has placed in my charge, and then one of you comes to me and says, 'This (amount) is for you and this is a gift given to me.' Why doesn't he stay at the house of his father or the house of his mother and see whether he will be given gifts or not if he was telling the truth by Allah, none of you takes anything of it (i.e., Zakat) for himself (Hisham added: unlawfully) but he will meet Allah on the Day of Resurrection carrying it on his neck! I do not want to see any of you carrying a grunting camel or a mooing cow or a bleating sheep on meeting Allah." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) raised both his hands till I saw the whiteness of his armpits, and said, "(No doubt)! Haven't I conveyed Allah's Message
hi: Abu Humaid As-Sa'idi bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne Ibn Al-Utbiyya ko Banu Sulaim se Zakat jama karne ke liye muqarrar kiya, aur jab wo (paise lekar) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas wapas aaye, Nabi (SAW) ne unse hisaab liya, aur unhone kaha, 'Ye (raqam) aapke liye hai, aur ye mujhe tohfe mein di gayi hai.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Tum apne waalid ya maa ke ghar kyun nahi raha, ye dekhne ke liye ke tumhein tohfe milte hain ya nahi, agar tum sach bol rahe ho?' Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khade hue aur logon se khitaab kiya, aur Allah ki hamd aur tareef karne ke baad, unhone kaha: 'Amma Ba'du (aage) main tum mein se kuch logon ko kaam par lagaata hoon jo Allah ne meri zimmedaari mein rakha hai, aur phir tum mein se koi mere paas aakar kehta hai, "Ye (raqam) aapke liye hai, aur ye mujhe tohfe mein di gayi hai." Wo apne waalid ya apni maa ke ghar kyun nahi raha, ye dekhne ke liye ke use tohfe milte hain ya nahi, agar wo sach bol raha ho? Allah ki qasam, tum mein se koi bhi isme se (yaani Zakat mein se) apne liye kuch nahi lega magar wo use Qayamat ke din apni gardan par uthaakar Allah se milega! Main tum mein se kisi ko bhi Allah se milte waqt ek bulbulaata oont, ya raambhati gaay, ya bhen-bhenati bakri apni gardan par uthaaye hue nahi dekhna chahta.' Phir Nabi (SAW) ne apne dono haath itne oopar uthaaye ke maine unki baaghal ki safedi dekhi, aur kaha, '(Beshak)! Kya maine Allah ka paighaam pahuncha nahi diya?'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah never sends a prophet or gives the Caliphate to a Caliph but that he (the prophet or the Caliph) has two groups of advisors: A group advising him to do good and exhorts him to do it, and the other group advising him to do evil and exhorts him to do it. But the protected person (against such evil advisors) is the one protected by Allah
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah kabhi kisi Nabi ko nahi bhejta ya kisi Khalifa ko Khilaafat nahi deta magar uske (Nabi ya Khalifa ke) do giroh salaahkaar hote hain: ek giroh use achhaai karne ki taakeed karta hai, aur doosra giroh use buraai karne ki taakeed karta hai. Magar mehfooz (bura kaam se bacha hua) wahi hai jise Allah mehfooz rakhe.'

e: Narrated 'Ubada bin As-Samit:We gave the oath of allegiance to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that we would listen to and obey him both at the time when we were active and at the time when we were tired and that we would not fight against the ruler or disobey him, and would stand firm for the truth or say the truth wherever we might be, and in the Way of Allah we would not be afraid of the blame of the blamers. (See Hadith No. 178 and)
hi: Ubada bin As-Samit bataate hain: Humne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se baiyat li ke hum unhein sunenge aur maanenge, chaahe hum betaab hon ya thake hue, aur hum hukmraan ke khilaaf nahi ladhenge ya uski nafarmaani nahi karenge, aur hum sach ke liye mazbooti se khade rahenge ya sach kahenge jahaan bhi hum hon, aur Allah ki raah mein hum aalochana karne walon ki aalochana se nahi darenge. (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 178 dekhein.)

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) went out on a cold morning while the Muhajirin (emigrants) and the Ansar were digging the trench. The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "O Allah! The real goodness is the goodness of the Here after, so please forgive the Ansar and the Muhajirin." They replied, "We are those who have given the Pledge of allegiance to Muhammad for to observe Jihad as long as we remain alive
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ek thandi subah baahar gaye jabke Muhaajireen aur Ansaar khaai (khandaq) khod rahe the. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Aye Allah! Asli bhalaai to Aakhirat ki bhalaai hai, isliye barah-e-meharbaani Ansaar aur Muhaajireen ko maaf kar de.' Unhone jawab diya, 'Hum wo hain jinhone Muhammad se Jihad ki baiyat li hai jab tak hum zinda hain.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Whenever we gave the Pledge of allegiance to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for to listen to and obey, he used to say to us, for as much as you can
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab bhi hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se sunne aur maanne ki baiyat lete, wo humse kehte, 'Jitni tumhaari taaqat mein ho.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Dinar:I witnessed Ibn `Umar when the people gathered around `Abdul Malik. Ibn `Umar wrote: I gave the Pledge of allegiance that I will listen to and obey Allah's Slave, `Abdul Malik, Chief of the believers according to Allah's Laws and the Traditions of His Apostle as much as I can; and my sons too, give the same pledge
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Dinar bataate hain: Maine Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko dekha jab log Abdul Malik ke gird jama hue. Ibn Umar ne likha: 'Maine baiyat li hai ke main Allah ke bande, Abdul Malik, Momineen ke Ameer, ki baat sununga aur maanunga, Allah ke Qawaanin aur uske Rasool ki riwaayaton ke mutaabik, jitni meri taaqat mein ho; aur mere bete bhi yahi baiyat lete hain.'

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:I gave the Pledge of allegiance to the Prophet (ﷺ) that I would listen and obey, and he told me to add: 'As much as I can, and will give good advice to every Muslim
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) se sunne aur maanne ki baiyat li, aur unhone mujhe izaafa karne ko kaha: 'Jitni meri taaqat mein ho, aur har Musalmaan ko achhi salaah deta rahunga.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Dinar:When the people took the oath of allegiance to `Abdul Malik, `Abdullah bin `Umar wrote to him: "To Allah's Slave, `Abdul Malik, Chief of the believers, I give the Pledge of allegiance that I will listen to and obey Allah's Slave, `Abdul Malik, Chief of the believers, according to Allah's Laws and the Traditions of His Apostle in whatever is within my ability; and my sons too, give the same pledge
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Dinar bataate hain: Jab logon ne Abdul Malik se baiyat li, Abdullah bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne unhein likha: 'Allah ke bande, Abdul Malik, Momineen ke Ameer, ke naam, main baiyat leta hoon ke main Allah ke bande, Abdul Malik, Momineen ke Ameer, ki baat sununga aur maanunga, Allah ke Qawaanin aur uske Rasool ki riwaayaton ke mutaabik, jitni meri taaqat mein ho; aur mere bete bhi yahi baiyat lete hain.'

e: Narrated Yazid:I said to Salama, "For what did you give the Pledge of allegiance to the Prophet (ﷺ) on the Day of Hudaibiya?" He replied, "For death
hi: Yazid bataate hain: Maine Salama se kaha, 'Aapne Hudaibiya ke din Nabi (SAW) se kis cheez ke liye baiyat li?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Maut ke liye.'

e: Narrated Al-Miswar bin Makhrama:The group of people whom `Umar had selected as candidates for the Caliphate gathered and consulted each other. `Abdur-Rahman said to them, "I am not going to compete with you in this matter, but if you wish, I would select for you a caliph from among you." So all of them agreed to let `Abdur-Rahman decide the case. So when the candidates placed the case in the hands of `Abdur-Rahman, the people went towards him and nobody followed the rest of the group nor obeyed any after him. So the people followed `Abdur-Rahman and consulted him all those nights till there came the night we gave the oath of allegiance to `Uthman. Al-Miswar (bin Makhrama) added: `Abdur-Rahman called on me after a portion of the night had passed and knocked on my door till I got up, and he said to me, "I see you have been sleeping! By Allah, during the last three nights I have not slept enough. Go and call Az-Zubair and Sa`d.' So I called them for him and he consulted them and then called me saying, 'Call `Ali for me." I called `Ali and he held a private talk with him till very late at night, and then 'Al, got up to leave having had much hope (to be chosen as a Caliph) but `Abdur-Rahman was afraid of something concerning `Ali. `Abdur-Rahman then said to me, "Call `Uthman for me." I called him and he kept on speaking to him privately till the Mu'adh-dhin put an end to their talk by announcing the Adhan for the Fajr prayer. When the people finished their morning prayer and that (six men) group gathered near the pulpit, `Abdur-Rahman sent for all the Muhajirin (emigrants) and the Ansar present there and sent for the army chief who had performed the Hajj with `Umar that year. When all of them had gathered, `Abdur- Rahman said, "None has the right to be worshipped but Allah," and added, "Now then, O `Ali, I have looked at the people's tendencies and noticed that they do not consider anybody equal to `Uthman, so you should not incur blame (by disagreeing)." Then `Abdur-Rahman said (to `Uthman), "I gave the oath of allegiance to you on condition that you will follow Allah's Laws and the traditions of Allah's Apostle and the traditions of the two Caliphs after him." So `Abdur-Rahman gave the oath of allegiance to him, and so did the people including the Muhajirin (emigrants) and the Ansar and the chiefs of the army staff and all the Muslims
hi: Al-Miswar bin Makhrama (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Wo giroh jinhein Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Khilaafat ke liye ummeedwaar chuna tha, jama hue aur aapas mein salaah-mashwara kiya. Abdur Rahman ne unse kaha, 'Main is maamle mein tumse pratispardha nahi karunga, magar agar tum chaho, to main tumhaare liye tum mein se ek Khalifa chununga.' To sabne raazi hoke ye faisla Abdur Rahman ke haath mein de diya. To jab ummeedwaaron ne ye maamla Abdur Rahman ke haath mein diya, log unki taraf gaye aur kisi ne baaki giroh ka pichha nahi kiya na unke baad kisi ki baat maani. Isliye log Abdur Rahman ke pichha karne lage aur unhi raaton unse salaah-mashwara karte rahe yahaan tak ke wo raat aayi jab humne Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko baiyat di. Al-Miswar (bin Makhrama) ne izaafa kiya: Abdur Rahman raat ka kuch hissa guzarne ke baad mere paas aaye aur mere darwaaze par khatkhataaya yahaan tak ke main uth gaya, aur unhone mujhse kaha, 'Mujhe lagta hai tum so rahe the! Allah ki qasam, pichhli teen raaton mein maine bhar-poor neend nahi li hai. Jaao aur Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Sa'd ko bulaao.' To maine unhein bulwaaya, aur unhone unse salaah-mashwara kiya, phir mujhe bulaaya, kehte hue, 'Mere liye Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko bulao.' Maine Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko bulwaaya aur unhone raat der tak unse chupke se baat ki, phir Ali (Alayhis Salam) bahut ummeed leke jaane ke liye uthhe, magar Abdur Rahman ko Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke baare mein kisi baat ka khauf tha. Abdur Rahman ne phir mujhse kaha, 'Mere liye Uthman ko bulao.' Maine unhein bulwaaya aur wo unse chupke se baat karte rahe yahaan tak ke Muazzin ne Fajr ki namaz ki Azaan dekar unki baat khatam ki. Jab logon ne apni subah ki namaz khatam ki aur wo (chhe log) mimbar ke qareeb jama hue, Abdur Rahman ne wahaan maujood sab Muhaajireen aur Ansaar ke paas aadmi bheja, aur us saal Umar ke saath Hajj karne wale fauj ke sardaar ko bhi bulwaaya. Jab sab jama ho gaye, Abdur Rahman ne kaha, 'Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi,' aur izaafa kiya, 'Ab, aage, Aye Ali (Alayhis Salam), maine logon ka rujhaan dekha hai aur notice kiya hai ke wo kisi ko Uthman ke barabar nahi maante, isliye tumhein (asahmat hokar) ilzaam nahi lena chaahiye.' Phir Abdur Rahman ne (Uthman se) kaha, 'Maine tumhein is shart par baiyat di hai ke tum Allah ke Qawaanin, Allah ke Rasool ki riwaayaton, aur unke baad ke do Khulafa ki riwaayaton ki pairvi karoge.' To Abdur Rahman ne unhein baiyat di, aur logon ne bhi, Muhaajireen, Ansaar, fauj ke afsaron aur sab Musalmaanon samet, baiyat di.

e: Narrated Salama:We gave the oath of allegiance to the Prophet (ﷺ) under the tree. He said to me, "O Salama! Will you not give the oath of allegiance?" I replied, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have already given the oath of allegiance for the first time." He said, (Give it again) for the second time
hi: Salama bataate hain: Humne Nabi (SAW) se darakht ke neeche baiyat li. Unhone mujhse kaha, 'Aye Salama! Kya tum baiyat nahi loge?' Maine jawab diya, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Maine pehli baar hi baiyat le li hai.' Unhone kaha, '(Isse dobara le lo) doosri baar ke liye.'

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:A bedouin gave the Pledge of allegiance to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for Islam and the bedouin got a fever where upon he said to the Prophet (ﷺ) "Cancel my Pledge." But the Prophet (ﷺ) refused. He came to him (again) saying, "Cancel my Pledge.' But the Prophet (ﷺ) refused. Then (the bedouin) left (Medina). Allah's Apostle said: "Medina is like a pair of bellows (furnace): It expels its impurities and brightens and clears its good
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek badawi ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se Islam ki baiyat li, aur badawi ko bukhaar aaya, isper usne Nabi (SAW) se kaha, 'Meri baiyat rad kar do.' Magar Nabi (SAW) ne inkaar kiya. Wo dobara aaya, kehte hue, 'Meri baiyat rad kar do.' Magar Nabi (SAW) ne inkaar kiya. Phir (badawi) chala gaya (Madina se). Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Madina ek dhoonkni (bhatti) jaisa hai: Ye apni napaakiyon ko baahar nikaal deti hai aur apni achhaai ko chamkaati aur saaf karti hai.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Hisham:who was born during the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) that his mother, Zainab bint Humaid had taken him to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Take his Pledge of allegiance (for Islam)." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He (`Abdullah bin Hisham) is a little child," and passed his hand over his head and invoked Allah for him. `Abdullah bin Hisham used to slaughter one sheep as a sacrifice on behalf of all of his family
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Hisham (رضی اللہ عنہ), jo Nabi (SAW) ki zindagi mein paida hue the, bataate hain ke unki maa, Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Humaid, unhein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas le gayi aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Iski (Islam ki) baiyat lijiye.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Ye (Abdullah bin Hisham) ek chhota bachcha hai,' aur unka haath unke sar par phera aur unke liye Allah se dua ki. Abdullah bin Hisham apne poore khaandaan ki taraf se ek bakri qurbaani ke taur par zibah kiya karte the.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:A bedouin gave the Pledge of allegiance to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for Islam. Then the bedouin got fever at Medina, came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Cancel my Pledge," But Allah's Apostle refused. Then he came to him (again) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Cancel my Pledge." But the Prophet (ﷺ) refused Then he came to him (again) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Cancel my Pledge." But the Prophet (ﷺ) refused. The bedouin finally went out (of Medina) whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Medina is like a pair of bellows (furnace): It expels its impurities and brightens and clears its good
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek badawi ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se Islam ki baiyat li. Phir badawi ko Madina mein bukhaar aaya, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Meri baiyat rad kar do.' Magar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne inkaar kiya. Phir wo dobara aaya aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Meri baiyat rad kar do.' Magar Nabi (SAW) ne inkaar kiya. Phir wo dobara aaya aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Meri baiyat rad kar do.' Magar Nabi (SAW) ne inkaar kiya. Aakhirkar badawi (Madina se) chala gaya, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Madina ek dhoonkni (bhatti) jaisa hai: Ye apni napaakiyon ko baahar nikaal deti hai aur apni achhaai ko chamkaati aur saaf karti hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "There will be three types of people whom Allah will neither speak to them on the Day of Resurrection nor will purify them from sins, and they will have a painful punishment: They are, (1) a man possessed superfluous water (more than he needs) on a way and he withholds it from the travelers. (2) a man who gives a pledge of allegiance to an Imam (ruler) and gives it only for worldly benefits, if the Imam gives him what he wants, he abides by his pledge, otherwise he does not fulfill his pledge; (3) and a man who sells something to another man after the `Asr prayer and swears by Allah (a false oath) that he has been offered so much for it whereupon the buyer believes him and buys it although in fact, the seller has not been offered such a price." (See Hadith No. 838, Vol)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Teen qism ke log honge jinse Allah Qayamat ke din baat nahi karega, na unhein gunaahon se paak karega, aur unhein dardnaak saza milegi: (1) wo aadmi jiske paas raaste par apni zaroorat se zyaada paani ho aur wo use musaafiron se rokta ho, (2) wo aadmi jo kisi Imam (hukmraan) se baiyat leta hai sirf duniya ke faayde ke liye, agar Imam use wo de jo wo chahta hai, to wo apni baiyat par qaayam rehta hai, warna wo apni baiyat poori nahi karta; (3) aur wo aadmi jo Asr ki namaz ke baad kisi doosre aadmi ko kuch bechta hai aur Allah ki (jhoothi) qasam khaata hai ke usse iske badle itna diya gaya hai, isper khareedar uski baat maan leta hai aur use khareed leta hai halaanke asal mein bechne wale ko wo keemat nahi mili thi.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 838, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated 'Ubada bin As-Samit:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to us while we were in a gathering, "Give me the oath (Pledge of allegiance for: (1) Not to join anything in worship along with Allah, (2) Not to steal, (3) Not to commit illegal sexual intercourse, (4) Not to kill your children, (5) Not to accuse an innocent person (to spread such an accusation among people), (6) Not to be disobedient (when ordered) to do good deeds. The Prophet (ﷺ) added: Whoever amongst you fulfill his pledge, his reward will be with Allah, and whoever commits any of those sins and receives the legal punishment in this world for that sin, then that punishment will be an expiation for that sin, and whoever commits any of those sins and Allah does not expose him, then it is up to Allah if He wishes He will punish him or if He wishes, He will forgive him." So we gave the Pledge for that. (See Hadith No. 17, Vol)
hi: Ubada bin As-Samit bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humse kaha jabke hum ek majlis mein the, 'Mujhse baiyat karo: (1) Allah ke saath kisi ki ibaadat mein shareek na karna, (2) chori na karna, (3) zina na karna, (4) apne bacchon ko qatl na karna, (5) kisi bekasoor shaks par ilzaam na lagaana (aur use logon mein na phailaana), (6) achhe amaal karne ke hukm ki nafarmaani na karna.' Nabi (SAW) ne izaafa kiya: Jo koi tum mein se ye ahad poora kare, uska ajr Allah ke paas hai, aur jo koi in gunaahon mein se koi kare aur isme duniya mein apni kanooni saza pa le, to wo saza uska kaffara hogi, aur jo koi in gunaahon mein se koi kare aur Allah use dhaank de, to ye Allah par hai, chaahe wo use saza de ya maaf kare, jaisi uski marzi ho. To humne isper baiyat li. (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 17, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to take the Pledge of allegiance from the women by words only after reciting this Holy Verse:--(60.12) "..that they will not associate anything in worship with Allah." (60.12) And the hand of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not touch any woman's hand except the hand of that woman his right hand possessed. (i.e. his captives or his lady slaves)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) khawaateen se sirf alfaazon (zubaan) se baiyat liya karte the, is paak Aayat ki tilaawat karne ke baad: '...ke wo Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek nahi karengi.' (60:12) Aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka haath kisi bhi khaatoon ke haath ko nahi chhoota siwaaye us khaatoon ke jiski maalikiyat unke daaen haath ke paas thi (yaani unki qaidi ya launDi).

e: Narrated Um Atiyya:We gave the Pledge of allegiance to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he recited to me the verse (60.12). That they will not associate anything in worship with Allah (60.12). And he also prevented us from wailing and lamenting over the dead. A woman from us held her hand out and said, "Such-and-such a woman cried over a dead person belonging to my family and I want to compensate her for that crying" The Prophet did not say anything in reply and she left and returned. None of those women abided by her pledge except Um Sulaim, Um Al-`Ala', and the daughter of Abi Sabra, the wife of Al-Mu`adh or the daughter of Abi Sabra, and the wife of Mu`adh
hi: Umm Atiyya bataati hain: Humne Nabi (SAW) se baiyat li aur unhone humein ye Aayat padhi (60:12): 'Ke wo Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek nahi karengi.' (60:12) Aur unhone humein murdon par matam aur vilaap karne se bhi mana kiya. Hum mein se ek khaatoon ne apna haath badhaaya aur kaha, 'Falaan-falaan khaatoon ne mere khaandaan ke ek murda par matam kiya tha aur main use uska badla dena chahti hoon.' Nabi (SAW) ne koi jawab nahi diya aur wo chali gayi aur phir wapas aayi. Un khawaateen mein se koi bhi apni baiyat par qaayam nahi rahi siwaaye Umm Sulaim (رضی اللہ عنہا), Umm Al-Ala, aur Abi Sabra ki beti, Al-Mu'adh ki biwi ya Abi Sabra ki beti, aur Mu'adh ki biwi ke.

e: Narrated Jabir:A bedouin came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "Please take my Pledge of allegiance for Islam." So the Prophet took from him the Pledge of allegiance for Islam. He came the next day with a fever and said to the Prophet (ﷺ) "Cancel my pledge." But the Prophet (ﷺ) refused and when the bedouin went away, the Prophet said, "Medina is like a pair of bellows (furnace): It expels its impurities and brightens and clears its good
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek badawi Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Barah-e-meharbaani meri Islam ki baiyat le lijiye.' To Nabi (SAW) ne unse Islam ki baiyat li. Wo agle din bukhaar ke saath aaya aur Nabi (SAW) se kaha, 'Meri baiyat rad kar dijiye.' Magar Nabi (SAW) ne inkaar kiya, aur jab badawi chala gaya, Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Madina ek dhoonkni (bhatti) jaisa hai: Ye apni napaakiyon ko baahar nikaal deti hai aur apni achhaai ko chamkaati aur saaf karti hai.'

e: Narrated Al-Qasim bin Muhammad:`Aisha said, "O my head!" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If that (i.e., your death) should happen while I am still alive, I would ask Allah to forgive you and would invoke Allah for you." `Aisha said, "O my life which is going to be lost! By Allah, I think that you wish for my death, and if that should happen then you would be busy enjoying the company of one of your wives in the last part of that day." The Prophet said, "But I should say, 'O my head!' I feel like calling Abu Bakr and his son and appoint (the former as my successors lest people should say something or wish for something. Allah will insist (on Abu Bakr becoming a Caliph) and the believers will prevent (anyone else from claiming the Caliphate)," or "..Allah will prevent (anyone else from claiming the Caliphate) and the believers will insist (on Abu Bakr becoming the Caliph)
hi: Al-Qasim bin Muhammad bataate hain: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha, 'Aye mera sar!' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Agar aisa ho (yaani tumhaari maut) jabke main abhi zinda hounga, main Allah se tumhein maaf karne ki dua karunga aur tumhaare liye dua karunga.' Aisha ne kaha, 'Aye meri zindagi jo khatam hone ja rahi hai! Allah ki qasam, mujhe lagta hai aap meri maut chahte hain, aur agar aisa ho, to aap us din ke aakhri hisse mein apni kisi biwi ki sohbat mein masroof honge.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Magar mujhe kehna chaahiye, "Aye mera sar!" Mera dil chahta hai ke main Abu Bakr aur unke bete ko bulaaun aur (Abu Bakr ko apna jaanashin) muqarrar karun, is dar se ke log kuch kahein ya kuch chahein. Allah zid karega (Abu Bakr ke Khalifa banne par) aur Momineen (kisi aur ke Khalifa banne ka dawa) rokenge,' ya kaha, '...Allah rokega aur Momin zid karenge (Abu Bakr ke Khalifa banne par).'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:It was said to `Umar, "Will you appoint your successor?" `Umar said, "If I appoint a Caliph (as my successor) it is true that somebody who was better than I (i.e., Abu Bakr) did so, and if I leave the matter undecided, it is true that somebody who was better than I (i.e., Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)) did so." On this, the people praised him. `Umar said, "People are of two kinds: Either one who is keen to take over the Caliphate or one who is afraid of assuming such a responsibility. I wish I could be free from its responsibility in that I would receive neither reward nor retribution I won't bear the burden of the caliphate in my death as I do in my life
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Umar se kaha gaya, 'Kya aap apna jaanashin muqarrar karenge?' Umar ne kaha, 'Agar main ek Khalifa (apna jaanashin) muqarrar karta hoon, to sach hai ke kisi ne jo mujhse behtar tha (yaani Abu Bakr) aisa kiya; aur agar main ye maamla bina faisla kiye chhod deta hoon, to sach hai ke kisi ne jo mujhse behtar tha (yaani Allah ke Rasool SAW) aisa kiya.' Isper, logon ne unki tareef ki. Umar ne kaha, 'Log do qism ke hote hain: ya to wo jo Khilaafat lene ke liye betaab ho ya wo jo aisi zimmedaari uthaane se darta ho. Kaash main is zimmedaari se azaad ho jaata jismein mujhe na ajr milega na saza. Main apni maut mein Khilaafat ka bojh nahi uthaunga jaisa main apni zindagi mein uthaata hoon.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:That he heard `Umar's second speech he delivered when he sat on the pulpit on the day following the death of the Prophet (ﷺ) `Umar recited the Tashahhud while Abu Bakr was silent. `Umar said, "I wish that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had outlived all of us, i.e., had been the last (to die). But if Muhammad is dead, Allah nevertheless has kept the light amongst you from which you can receive the same guidance as Allah guided Muhammad with that. And Abu Bakr is the companion of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) He is the second of the two in the cave. He is the most entitled person among the Muslims to manage your affairs. Therefore get up and swear allegiance to him." Some people had already taken the oath of allegiance to him in the shed of Bani Sa`ida but the oath of allegiance taken by the public was taken at the pulpit. I heard `Umar saying to Abu Bakr on that day. "Please ascend the pulpit," and kept on urging him till he ascended the pulpit whereupon, all the people swore allegiance to him
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke unhone Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki doosri taqreer suni jo unhone mimbar par baithkar di, agle din jab Nabi (SAW) ka intekaal hua. Umar ne Tashahhud padha jabke Abu Bakr khaamosh the. Umar ne kaha, 'Mujhe kaash Allah ke Rasool (SAW) hum sabse zyaada jeete, yaani sabse aakhri mein guzarte. Magar agar Muhammad guzar gaye hain, to Allah ne phir bhi tumhaare beech roshni chhod di hai jisse tum wahi hidaayat pa sakte ho jaisi Allah ne Muhammad ko di thi. Aur Abu Bakr Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saathi hain. Wo do logon mein se doosre hain jo gufaa mein the. Wo Musalmaanon mein sabse zyaada haqdaar hain tumhaare maamlon ko sambhaalne ka. Isliye utho aur unhein baiyat do.' Kuch logon ne pehle hi unhein Banu Sa'da ke shed (chappar) mein baiyat de di thi magar aam logon ki baiyat mimbar par li gayi. Maine Umar ko us din Abu Bakr se ye kehte suna, 'Barah-e-meharbaani mimbar par chadhiye,' aur wo unhein taakeed karte rahe yahaan tak ke wo mimbar par chadhe, isper sab logon ne unhein baiyat di.

e: Narrated Jubair bin Mut`im:A woman came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and spoke to him about something and he told her to return to him. She said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! If I come and do not find you?" (As if she meant, "...if you die?") The Prophet said, "If you should not find me, then go to Abu Bakr
hi: Jubair bin Mut'im bataate hain: Ek khaatoon Nabi (SAW) ke paas aayi aur unse kisi baare mein baat ki, aur unhone use wapas aane ko kaha. Usne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Agar main aaun aur aapko na paaun to?' (Yaani, agar aapka intekaal ho jaaye?) Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Agar tumhein main na milun, to Abu Bakr ke paas jaana.'

e: Narrated Tariq bin Shihab:Abu Bakr said to the delegate of Buzakha. "Follow the tails of the camels till Allah shows the Caliph (successor) of His Prophet and Al-Muhajirin (emigrants) something because of which you may excuse yourselves
hi: Tariq bin Shihab bataate hain: Abu Bakr ne Buzakha ke wafd (delegation) se kaha, 'Oonton ki dumon ka peecha karo (yaani registaan mein bhaag jaao) jab tak Allah apne Nabi ke Khalifa (jaanashin) aur Muhaajireen ko kuch aisa na dikhaaye jispar tum khud ko bekasoor thehraa sako.'

e: Narrated Jabir bin Samura:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "There will be twelve Muslim rulers (who will rule all the Islamic world)." He then said a sentence which I did not hear. My father said, "All of them (those rulers) will be from Quraish
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Samura bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, 'Barah Musalmaan hukmraan honge (jo poori Islami duniya par hukmraani karenge).' Phir unhone ek jumla kaha jo maine nahi suna. Mere waalid ne kaha, 'Wo sab (hukmraan) Quraish se honge.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "By Him in Whose Hands my life is, I was about to order for collecting fire wood and then order someone to pronounce the Adhan for the prayer and then order someone to lead the people in prayer and then I would go from behind and burn the houses of men who did not present themselves for the (compulsory congregational) prayer. By Him in Whose Hands my life is, if anyone of you had known that he would receive a bone covered with meat or two (small) pieces of meat present in between two ribs, he would come for `Isha' prayer." (See Hadith No. 617, Vol)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, main lakdiyaan jama karne ka hukm dene wala tha, phir kisi ko Azaan dene ka hukm deta, phir kisi ko logon ko namaz padhaane ka hukm deta, aur phir main peechhe jaakar un logon ke gharon ko jala deta jo (jamaat ki farz) namaz mein haazir nahi hote. Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, agar tum mein se kisi ko pata hota ke use gosht se dhaki hui ek haddi milegi, ya do (chhoti) haddiyon ke beech ka gosht, to wo Isha ki namaz ke liye aata.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 617, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Ka`b bin Malik:Who was Ka`b's guide from among his sons when Ka`b became blind: I heard Ka`b bin Malik saying, "When some people remained behind and did not join Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the battle of Tabuk.." and then he described the whole narration and said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the Muslims to speak to us, and so we (I and my companions) stayed fifty nights in that state, and then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) announced Allah's acceptance of our repentance
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ka'b bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ), jo Ka'b ke rehnumaa the unke beton mein se jab Ka'b andhe ho gaye, bataate hain: Maine Ka'b bin Malik ko ye kehte suna, 'Jab kuch log jang-e-Tabuk mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath shaamil nahi hue...' aur phir unhone poori riwaayat bayaan ki aur kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Musalmaanon ko humse baat karne se mana kiya, aur hum (main aur mere saathi) pachaas raaton tak isi haalat mein rahe, aur phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humaari tauba ki Allah ki taraf se qubooliyat ka elaan kiya.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "By Him in Whose Hands my life is! Were it not for some men who dislike to be left behind and for whom I do not have means of conveyance, I would not stay away (from any Holy Battle). I would love to be martyred in Allah's Cause and come to life and then get, martyred and then come to life and then get martyred and then get resurrected and then get martyred
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, 'Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai! Agar kuch log aise na hote jo peechhe reh jaane se napasand karte aur jinke liye mere paas sawaari ka intezaam nahi, to main kabhi bhi (kisi Muqaddas Jang se) door na rehta. Mujhe pasand aata ke main Allah ki raah mein shaheed hota, phir zinda kiya jaata, phir shaheed hota, phir zinda kiya jaata, phir shaheed hota, aur phir dobara utthaaya jaata, aur phir shaheed hota.'

e: Narrated Al-A'raj:Abu Huraira said, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "By Him in Whose Hand my life is, I would love to fight in Allah's Cause and then get martyred and then resurrected (come to life) and then get martyred and then resurrected (come to life) and then get martyred, and then resurrected (come to life) and then get martyred and then resurrected (come to life)." Abu Huraira used to repeat those words three times and I testify to it with Allah's Oath
hi: Al-A'raj bataate hain: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, mujhe pasand aata ke main Allah ki raah mein ladta aur phir shaheed hota, phir dobara zinda kiya jaata, aur phir shaheed hota, phir dobara zinda kiya jaata (aur phir shaheed hota), phir dobara zinda kiya jaata aur phir shaheed hota, aur phir dobara zinda kiya jaata.' Abu Huraira ye alfaaz teen baar dohraaya karte the, aur main Allah ki qasam khaakar iski gawaahi deta hoon.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If I had gold equal to the mountain of Uhud, I would love that, before three days had passed, not a single Dinar thereof remained with me if I found somebody to accept it excluding some amount that I would keep for the payment of my debts
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar mere paas Uhud pahaad jitna sona ho, mujhe pasand aata ke teen din guzarne se pehle, mere paas usmein se ek bhi Dinar na bache, agar mujhe koi use qubool karne wala mile, siwaaye us thodi si raqam ke jo main apna qarz chukaane ke liye rakhunga.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If I had formerly known what I came to know recently, I would not have driven the Hadi with me and would have finished the state of Ihram along with the people when they finished it
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar mujhe pehle wo pata hota jo mujhe abhi (haal hi mein) pata chala hai, to main apne saath Hadi (qurbaani ka jaanwar) na lataata aur logon ke saath hi apna Ihram khatam kar deta jab unhone apna khatam kiya.'

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:We were in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and we assumed the state of Ihram of Hajj and arrived at Mecca on the fourth of Dhul-Hijja. The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered us to perform the Tawaf around the Ka`ba and (Sa`i) between As-Safa and Al-Marwa and use our Ihram just for `Umra, and finish the state of Ihram unless we had our Hadi with us. None of us had the Hadi with him except the Prophet (ﷺ) and Talha. `Ali came from Yemen and brought the Hadi with him. `Ali said, 'I had assumed the state of Ihram with the same intention as that with which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had assumed it. The people said, "How can we proceed to Mina and our male organs are dribbling?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If I had formerly known what I came to know latterly, I would not have brought the Hadi, and had there been no Hadi with me, I would have finished my Ihram." Suraqa (bin Malik) met the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was throwing pebbles at the Jamrat-Al-`Aqaba, and asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Is this (permitted) for us only?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied. "No, it is forever" `Aisha had arrived at Mecca while she was menstruating, therefore the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered her to perform all the ceremonies of Hajj except the Tawaf around the Ka`ba, and not to perform her prayers unless and until she became clean . When they encamped at Al-Batha, `Aisha said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! You are proceeding after performing both Hajj and `Umra while I am proceeding with Hajj only?" So the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered `Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Bakr As-Siddiq to go with her to at-Tan`im, and so she performed the `Umra in Dhul-Hijja after the days of the Hajj
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein the aur humne Hajj ka Ihram baandha aur Zul-Hijja ki chauthi taareekh ko Makkah pahunche. Nabi (SAW) ne humein hukm diya ke hum Kaaba ka Tawaf karein aur Safa aur Marwa ke beech Sa'i karein aur apne Ihram ko sirf Umra ke liye maanein aur apna Ihram khatam kar dein, siwaaye un logon ke jinke paas Hadi ho. Hum mein se kisi ke paas Hadi nahi tha siwaaye Nabi (SAW) aur Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke. Ali (Alayhis Salam) Yemen se aaye aur apne saath Hadi laaye. Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha, 'Maine wahi niyat leke Ihram baandha jaisi niyat se Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne bandha tha.' Logon ne kaha, 'Hum Mina kaise jaayein jabke hamare mardana ansho se abhi tapak rahi hai (yaani hum abhi Ihram khatam kar chuke hain)?' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Agar mujhe pehle wo pata hota jo mujhe baad mein pata chala, to main Hadi na laata, aur agar mere saath Hadi na hota, to main bhi apna Ihram khatam kar deta.' Suraqa (bin Malik) Nabi (SAW) se mile jabke wo Jamrat-ul-Aqaba par kankar maar rahe the, aur pucha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya ye (ijaazat) sirf hamare liye hai?' Nabi (SAW) ne jawab diya, 'Nahi, ye hamesha ke liye hai.' Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) Makkah pahunchi thi jabke wo haiz (mahwaari) mein thi, isliye Nabi (SAW) ne unhein hukm diya ke wo Hajj ke sab amaal karein siwaaye Kaaba ke Tawaf ke, aur apni namaz na padhein jab tak wo paak na ho jaayein. Jab wo Al-Batha mein pad-aao daale, Aisha ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Aap Hajj aur Umra dono karke jaa rahe hain jabke main sirf Hajj karke jaa rahi hoon?' To Nabi (SAW) ne Abdur Rahman bin Abu Bakr As-Siddiq ko hukm diya ke wo unke saath At-Tan'im jaayein, aur unhone Zul-Hijja mein, Hajj ke dinon ke baad, Umra ki.

e: Narrated Aisha:One night the Prophet (ﷺ) was unable to sleep and said, "Would that a righteous man from my companions guarded me tonight." Suddenly we heard the clatter of arms, whereupon the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Who is it?" It was said, "I am Sa`d, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have come to guard you." The Prophet (ﷺ) then slept so soundly that we heard him snoring. Abu `Abdullah said: `Aisha said: Bilal said, "Would that I but stayed overnight in a valley with Idhkhir and Jalil (two kinds of grass) around me (i.e., in Mecca)." Then I told that to the Prophet (ﷺ)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ek raat Nabi (SAW) so nahi paaye aur kaha, 'Kaash mere sahaaba mein se koi neik shaks aaj raat meri hifaazat karta.' Achaanak humne hathiyaaron ki jhankaar suni, isper Nabi (SAW) ne pucha, 'Ye kaun hai?' Kaha gaya, 'Main Sa'd hoon, Aye Allah ke Rasool! Main aapki hifaazat karne aaya hoon.' Nabi (SAW) phir itni gehri neend so gaye ke humne unhein kharraate lete suna. Abu Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: Aisha ne kaha: Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Kaash main ek raat aisi wadi mein guzaarta jahaan Idhkhir aur Jalil (do qism ki ghaasein) mere aas-paas hon (yaani Makkah mein).' Phir maine ye baat Nabi (SAW) ko bataayi.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Not to wish to be the like except of two men. A man whom Allah has given the (knowledge of the) Qur'an and he recites it during the hours of night and day and the one who wishes says: If I were given the same as this (man) has been given, I would do what he does, and a man whom Allah has given wealth and he spends it in the just and right way, in which case the one who wishes says, 'If I were given the same as he has been given, I would do what he does.' " (See Hadith 5025 and)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kisi jaisa banne ki tamanna mat karo siwaaye do logon ke: ek wo aadmi jise Allah ne Quran (ka ilm) diya hai aur wo use raat-din padhta hai, aur tamanna karne wala kehta hai, "Agar mujhe bhi wahi milta jo isko mila hai, to main wahi karta jo ye karta hai," aur ek wo aadmi jise Allah ne daulat di hai aur wo use jaayez aur sahi tareeke se kharch karta hai, jispar tamanna karne wala kehta hai, "Agar mujhe bhi wahi milta jo isko mila hai, to main wahi karta jo ye karta hai."' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 5025 dekhein.)

e: Narrated Anas:If I had not heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "You should not long for death," I would have longed (for it)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Agar maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye kehte na suna hota, 'Tumhein maut ki tamanna nahi karni chaahiye,' to main iski tamanna karta.

e: Narrated Qais:We went to pay a visit to Khabbab bin Al-Art and he had got himself branded at seven spots over his body. He said, "If Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had not forbidden us to invoke Allah for death, I would have invoked for it
hi: Qais bataate hain: Hum Khabbab (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Art se milne gaye aur unke jism par saat jagah daagh lagaaye gaye the. Unhone kaha, 'Agar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein maut ki dua maangne se mana na kiya hota, to main iski dua maangta.'

e: Narrated Sa`d bin Ubaid:(the Maula of `Abdur-Rahman bin Azhar) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "None of you should long for death, for if he is a good man, he may increase his good deeds, and if he is an evil-doer, he may stop the evil deeds and repent
hi: Sa'd bin Ubaid (Abdur Rahman bin Azhar ke Maula) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Tum mein se koi bhi maut ki tamanna na kare, kyunke agar wo neik aadmi hai, to wo apne nek amaal aur badha sakta hai, aur agar wo badkaar hai, to shaayad wo apne bure amaal chhod kar tauba kar le.'

e: Narrated Al-Bara' bin `Azib:The Prophet (ﷺ) was carrying earth with us on the day of the battle of Al-Ahzab (confederates) and I saw that the dust was covering the whiteness of his `Abdomen, and he (the Prophet (ﷺ) ) was saying, "(O Allah) ! Without You, we would not have been guided, nor would we have given in charity, nor would we have prayed. So (O Allah!) please send tranquility (Sakina) upon us as they, (the chiefs of the enemy tribes) have rebelled against us. And if they intend affliction (i.e. want to frighten us and fight against us) then we would not (flee but withstand them). And the Prophet (ﷺ) used to raise his voice with it. (See Hadith No. 430 and 432, Vol)
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) hamare saath jang-e-Ahzab (khaai) ke din mitti utha rahe the, aur maine dekha ke dhool unke pet ki safedi ko dhaank rahi thi, aur wo (Nabi SAW) keh rahe the, '(Aye Allah)! Tere bagair, hum hidaayat na paate, na sadqa dete, na namaz padhte. Isliye (Aye Allah!) barah-e-meharbaani hampar sukoon (Sakina) naazil kar, kyunke wo (dushman qabeelon ke sardaar) hamare khilaaf baghaawat kar chuke hain. Aur agar wo museebat chahte hain (yaani humein dara-dhamka kar humse ladna chahte hain), to hum (bhaagenge nahi balke unka saamna karenge).' Aur Nabi (SAW) apni aawaaz iske saath oonchi kiya karte the. (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 430 aur 432, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abi `Aufa:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Do not long for meeting your enemy, and ask Allah for safety (from all sorts of evil)." (See Hadith No. 266, Vol)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Aufa bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Apne dushman se milne ki tamanna mat karo, aur Allah se salaamati maango (har qism ki buraai se).' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 266, Jild dekhein.)
