e: Narrated Al-Qasim bin Muhammad:Ibn `Abbas mentioned the case of a couple on whom the judgment of Lian has been passed. `Abdullah bin Shaddad said, "Was that the lady in whose case the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If I were to stone a lady to death without a proof (against her)?' "Ibn `Abbas said, "No! That was concerned with a woman who though being a Muslim used to arouse suspicion by her outright misbehavior." (See Hadith No. 230, Vol)
hi: Al-Qasim bin Muhammad bataate hain: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne un logon ka zikr kiya jinke baare mein Li'an ka faisla diya gaya tha. Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Shaddad ne kaha, 'Kya wo wahi khaatoon thi jinke baare mein Nabi (SAW) ne kaha tha, "Agar main kisi khaatoon ko bina saboot ke sangsaar karta"?' Ibn Abbas ne kaha, 'Nahi! Wo ek aisi khaatoon ke baare mein tha jo Musalmaan hote hue bhi apne khule bure vyavahaar se shak paida karti thi.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 230, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated 'Ata:One night the Prophet (ﷺ) delayed the `Isha' prayer whereupon `Umar went to him and said, "The prayer, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! The women and children had slept." The Prophet (ﷺ) came out with water dropping from his head, and said, "Were I not afraid that it would be hard for my followers (or for the people), I would order them to pray `Isha prayer at this time." (Various versions of this Hadith are given by the narrators with slight differences in expression but not in content)
hi: Ata bataate hain: Ek raat Nabi (SAW) ne Isha ki namaz mein der ki, isper Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) unke paas gaye aur kaha, 'Namaz ka waqt hai, Aye Allah ke Rasool! Auraten aur bacche so gaye hain.' Nabi (SAW) baahar aaye, unke sar se paani tapak raha tha, aur unhone kaha, 'Agar mujhe dar na hota ke ye mere maanne walon (ya logon) ke liye mushkil hoga, to main unhein Isha ki namaz isi waqt padhne ka hukm deta.' (Is hadees ki alag-alag riwaayaten alag-alag raviyon ne di hain, thodi si farq zubaan mein magar matlab mein nahi.)

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Were I not afraid that it would be hard on my followers, I would order them to use the siwak (as obligatory, for cleaning the teeth)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar mujhe dar na hota ke ye mere maanne walon ke liye mushkil hoga, to main unhein Siwak (daant saaf karne ke liye) istemaal karne ka hukm deta (farz ke taur par).'

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) fasted Al-Wisal on the last days of the month. Some people did the same, and when the news reached the Prophet (ﷺ) he said, "If the month had been prolonged for me, then I would have fasted Wisal for such a long time that the most exaggerating ones among you would have given up their exaggeration. I am not like you; my Lord always makes me eat and drink
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne mahine ke aakhri dinon mein Al-Wisal ka roza rakha. Kuch logon ne bhi waisa hi kiya, aur jab ye khabar Nabi (SAW) tak pahunchi, unhone kaha, 'Agar mahina mere liye lamba ho jaata, to main itni lambi muddat tak Wisal ka roza rakhta ke tum mein se sabse zyaada mubaalgha karne wale bhi apni zid chhod dete. Main tum jaisa nahi hoon; mera Rab hamesha mujhe khilaata aur pilaata hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade Al-Wisal. The people said (to him), "But you fast Al-`Wisal," He said, "Who among you is like me? When I sleep (at night), my Lord makes me eat and drink. But when the people refused to give up Al-Wisal, he fasted Al-Wisal along with them for two days and then they saw the crescent whereupon the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If the crescent had not appeared I would have fasted for a longer period," as if he intended to punish them herewith
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Al-Wisal se mana kiya. Logon ne (unse) kaha, 'Magar aap khud Al-Wisal ka roza rakhte hain.' Unhone kaha, 'Tum mein se kaun mere jaisa hai? Jab main (raat ko) sota hoon, mera Rab mujhe khilaata aur pilaata hai.' Magar jab logon ne Al-Wisal chhodne se inkaar kiya, unhone unke saath do din tak Al-Wisal ka roza rakha, aur phir unhone chaand dekha, isper Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Agar chaand nazar na aata, to main isse bhi lambi muddat tak roza rakhta,' jaise wo unhein isse saza dena chahte the.

e: Narrated `Aisha:I asked the Prophet (ﷺ) about the wall (outside the Ka`ba). "Is it regarded as part of the Ka`ba?" He replied, "Yes." I said, "Then why didn't the people include it in the Ka`ba?" He said, "(Because) your people ran short of money." I asked, "Then why is its gate so high?" He replied, ''Your people did so in order to admit to it whom they would and forbid whom they would. Were your people not still close to the period of ignorance, and were I not afraid that their hearts might deny my action, then surely I would include the wall in the Ka`ba and make its gate touch the ground
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) se us deewaar (Kaaba ke baahar) ke baare mein pucha. 'Kya ye Kaaba ka hissa maani jaati hai?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Haan.' Maine kaha, 'To logon ne ise Kaaba mein kyun shaamil nahi kiya?' Unhone kaha, '(Kyunke) tumhaari qaum ke paas paise kam pad gaye.' Maine pucha, 'Phir iska darwaaza itna ooncha kyun hai?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Tumhaari qaum ne aisa isliye kiya taake wo jise chahein andar aane dein aur jise chahein rokein. Agar tumhaari qaum Jaahiliyat (Islam se pehle) ke daur se itni door na hoti, aur agar mujhe dar na hota ke unke dil mera ye amal qubool na karein, to main zaroor us deewaar ko Kaaba mein shaamil kar deta aur uska darwaaza zameen ke barabar bana deta.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "But for the emigration, I would have been one of the Ansar: and if the people took their way in a valley (or a mountain pass), I would take the Ansar's valley or the mountain pass
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar hijrat na hoti, to main Ansaar mein se ek hota, aur agar log kisi wadi (ya pahaadi raaste) se guzarte, to main Ansaar ki wadi ya pahaadi raaste se guzarta.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Zaid:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "But for the emigration, I would have been one of the Ansar; and if the people took their way in a valley (or a mountain pass), I would take Ansar's valley or their mountain pass
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar hijrat na hoti, to main Ansaar mein se ek hota, aur agar log kisi wadi (ya pahaadi raaste) se guzarte, to main Ansaar ki wadi ya unke pahaadi raaste se guzarta.'

e: Narrated Malik:We came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and we were young men nearly of equal ages and we stayed with him for twenty nights. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was a very kind man and when he realized our longing for our families, he asked us about those whom we had left behind. When we informed him, he said, "Go back to your families and stay with them and teach them (religion) and order them (to do good deeds). The Prophet (ﷺ) mentioned things some of which I remembered and some I did not. Then he said, "Pray as you have seen me praying, and when it is the time of prayer, one of you should pronounce the call (Adhan) for the prayer and the eldest of you should lead the prayer
hi: Malik bataate hain: Hum Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye, aur hum sab taqreeban ek hi umar ke jawaan log the, aur hum unke saath bees raaton tak rahe. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) bahut meharbaan aadmi the, aur jab unhein ehsaas hua ke humein apne khaandaanon ki yaad aa rahi hai, unhone hamse humaare peechhe chhode gaye logon ke baare mein pucha. Jab humne unhein bataya, unhone kaha, 'Apne khaandaanon ke paas wapas jaao aur unke saath raho aur unhein (deen) sikhaao aur unhein (nek amaal ka) hukm do.' Nabi (SAW) ne kuch baaten kahin jinmein se kuch mujhe yaad hain aur kuch nahi. Phir unhone kaha, 'Namaz waisi padho jaisi tumne mujhe padhte dekha, aur jab namaz ka waqt ho, tum mein se ek ko Azaan deni chaahiye aur tum mein se sabse bade ko namaz padhaani chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Ibn Mas`ud:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The (call for prayer) Adhan of Bilal should not stop anyone of you from taking his Suhur for he pronounces the Adhan in order that whoever among you is praying the night prayer, may return (to eat his Suhur) and whoever among you is sleeping, may get up, for it is not yet dawn (when it is like this)." (Yahya, the sub-narrator stretched his two index fingers side ways)
hi: Ibn Masud bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Bilal ki Azaan tum mein se kisi ko apna Suhur (roze se pehle khaana) khaane se na roke, kyunke wo isliye Azaan dete hain taake tum mein se jo koi raat ki namaz padh raha ho, wo laut aaye (Suhur khaane ke liye), aur jo koi so raha ho, wo uth jaaye, kyunke abhi subah nahi hui hai (jab aisa ho).' (Yahya, sub-narrator ne apni do pehli ungliyaan bagal mein phailaayi.)

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Bilal pronounces the Adhan at night so that you may eat and drink till Ibn Um Maktum pronounces the Adhan (for the Fajr prayer)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Bilal raat mein Azaan dete hain taake tum khaa-pi sako yahaan tak ke Ibn Umm Maktum (Fajr ki namaz ki) Azaan de.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) led us in Zuhr prayer and prayer five rak`at. Somebody asked him whether the prayer had been increased." He (the Prophet (ﷺ) ) said, "And what is that?" They (the people) replied, "You have prayed five rak`at." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) offered two prostrations (of Sahu) after he had finished his prayer with the Taslim
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne humein Zuhr ki namaz padhaayi aur paanch rakat padhi. Kisi ne unse pucha ke kya namaz badha di gayi hai. Unhone (Nabi SAW ne) kaha, 'Wo kya hai?' Unhone (logon ne) jawab diya, 'Aapne paanch rakat padhi.' Phir Nabi (SAW) ne Taslim se apni namaz khatam karne ke baad do (Sahu) sajde kiye.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) finished his prayer after offerings two rak`at only. Dhul-Yaddain asked him whether the prayer had been reduced, or you had forgotten?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Is Dhul-Yaddain speaking the truth?" The people said, "Yes." Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up and performed another two rak`at and then finished prayer with Taslim, and then said the Takbir and performed a prostration similar to or longer than his ordinary prostrations; then he raised his head, said Takbir and prostrated and then raised his head (Sahu prostrations)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne sirf do rakat ke baad apni namaz khatam ki. Dhul-Yaddain ne unse pucha ke kya namaz kam kar di gayi hai, ya aap bhool gaye? Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Kya Dhul-Yaddain sach kah rahe hain?' Logon ne kaha, 'Haan.' Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khade hue aur do aur rakat padhi aur Taslim se apni namaz khatam ki, phir Takbeer kahi aur ek sajda kiya jo unke aam sajdon jaisa tha ya usse lamba, phir unhone apna sar uthaaya, Takbeer kahi aur sajda kiya, phir apna sar uthaaya (ye do sajde Sahu ke the).

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:While the people were at Quba offering the morning prayer, suddenly a person came to them saying, "Tonight Divine Inspiration has been revealed to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he has been ordered to face the Ka`ba (in prayers): therefore you people should face it." There faces were towards Sham, so they turned their faces towards the Ka`ba (at Mecca)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab log Quba mein subah ki namaz padh rahe the, achaanak ek shaks unke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Aaj raat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) par Ilaahi Wahi naazil hui hai aur unhein hukm diya gaya hai ke wo Kaaba ki taraf muh karein (namaz mein): isliye tum logon ko bhi uski taraf muh karna chaahiye.' Unke chehre Sham (uttar) ki taraf the, isliye unhone apne chehre Kaaba (Makkah) ki taraf modh liye.

e: Narrated Al-Bara':When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) arrived at Medina, he prayed facing Jerusalem for sixteen or seventeen months but he wished that he would be ordered to face the Ka`ba. So Allah revealed: -- 'Verily! We have seen the turning of your face towards the heaven; surely we shall turn you to a prayer direction (Qibla) that shall please you.' (2.144) Thus he was directed towards the Ka`ba. A man prayed the `Asr prayer with the Prophet (ﷺ) and then went out, and passing by some people from the Ansar, he said, "I testify. that I have prayed with the Prophet (ﷺ) and he (the Prophet) has prayed facing the Ka`ba." Thereupon they, who were bowing in the `Asr prayer, turned towards the Ka`ba
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Madina pahunche, wo solah ya satraah maheenon tak Yerusalem ki taraf muh karke namaz padhte rahe, magar wo chahte the ke unhein Kaaba ki taraf hukm diya jaaye. To Allah ne naazil kiya: 'Beshak! Humne dekha tumhaara chehra baar-baar aasman ki taraf uthta; isliye hum tumhein zaroor ek Qibla ki taraf modenge jo tumhein pasand aayega.' (2:144) Isi tarah unhein Kaaba ki taraf mod diya gaya. Ek shaks ne Nabi (SAW) ke saath Asr ki namaz padhi aur phir baahar gaya, aur Ansaar ke kuch logon ke paas se guzarte hue, usne kaha, 'Main gawaahi deta hoon ke maine Nabi (SAW) ke saath namaz padhi hai aur unhone Kaaba ki taraf muh karke namaz padhi.' Isper, wo log jo Asr ki namaz mein ruku kar rahe the, unhone bhi Kaaba ki taraf apna rukh modh liya.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:I used to offer drinks prepared from infused dates to Abu Talha Al-Ansari, Abu 'Ubada bin Al Jarrah and Ubai bin Ka`b. Then a person came to them and said, "All alcoholic drinks have been prohibited." Abu Talha then said, "O Anas! Get up and break all these jars." So I got up and took a mortar belonging to us, and hit the jars with its lower part till they broke
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Abu Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ansari, Abu Ubaida bin Al-Jarrah, aur Ubai bin Ka'b (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko khajoor bhigaakar taiyaar ki gayi sharbat pilaaya karta tha. Phir ek shaks unke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Sab nasha-aawar sharbat haraam kar diye gaye hain.' Abu Talha ne phir kaha, 'Aye Anas! Utho aur ye sab bartan tod do.' To main uthhaa aur hamare paas jo ek okhli thi wo li aur uske neeche waale hisse se bartan tode yahaan tak ke wo toot gaye.

e: Narrated Hudhaifa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said to the people of Najran, "I will send to you an honest person who is really trustworthy." The Companion, of the Prophet (ﷺ) each desired to be that person, but the Prophet (ﷺ) sent Abu 'Ubaida
hi: Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne Najran ke logon se kaha, 'Main tumhaare paas ek imaandaar shaks bhejunga jo waaqai bharosemand hai.' Nabi (SAW) ke sahaaba mein se har ek wo shaks banna chahta tha, magar Nabi (SAW) ne Abu Ubaida ko bheja.

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "For every nation there is an Amin (honest, trustworthy person) and the Amin of this nation is Abu 'Ubaida
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Har ummat ke liye ek Amin (imaandaar, bharosemand shaks) hota hai, aur is ummat ka Amin Abu Ubaida hain.'

e: Narrated `Umar:There was a man from the Ansar (who was a friend of mine). If he was not present in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) I used to be present with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), I would tell him what I used to hear from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and when I was absent from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) he used to be present with him, and he would tell me what he used to hear from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ansaar mein se ek shaks tha (jo mera dost tha). Agar wo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki majlis mein maujood nahi hota, jabke main hota, main unhein wo baat bataata jo maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suni thi, aur jab main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki majlis mein maujood nahi hota jabke wo hote, wo mujhe wo baat bataate jo unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suni hoti.

e: Narrated `Ali:The Prophet (ﷺ) , sent an army and appointed some man their commander The man made a fire and then said (to the soldiers), "Enter it." Some of them intended to enter it while some others said, 'We have run away from it (i.e., embraced Islam to save ourselves from the 'fire')." They mentioned that to the Prophet, and he said about people who had intended to enter the fire. ''If they had entered it, they would have remained In it till the Day of Resurrection.'' Then he said to others, "No obedience for evil deeds, obedience is required only in what is good
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne ek fauji dasta bheja aur ek shaks ko unka afsar muqarrar kiya. Us shaks ne aag jalaayi aur phir (sipahiyon se) kaha, 'Isme daakhil ho jaao.' Kuch logon ne isme daakhil hone ka iraada kiya jabke kuch ne kaha, 'Hum isse (yaani Aag se) bhaag chuke hain (yaani humne khud ko is Aag se bachaane ke liye Islam qubool kiya hai).' Unhone ye baat Nabi (SAW) ko bataayi, aur unhone un logon ke baare mein jinhone usmein daakhil hone ka iraada kiya tha, kaha, 'Agar wo usmein daakhil hote, to wo Qayamat ke din tak usmein rehte.' Phir unhone doosron se kaha, 'Bure amaal ki farmaanbardaari nahi honi chaahiye, farmaanbardaari sirf achhaai ki honi chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira and Zaid bin Khalid:Two men sued each other before the Prophet
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Zaid bin Khalid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Do aadmiyon ne Nabi (SAW) ke saamne ek doosre ke khilaaf shikaayat ki.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:While we were with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) a bedouin got up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Settle my case according to Allah's Book (Laws)." Then his opponent got up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! He has said the truth! Settle his case according to Allah's Book (Laws.) and allow me to speak," He said, "My son was a laborer for this man and he committed illegal sexual intercourse with his wife. The people told me that my son should be stoned to death but I ransomed him with one-hundred sheep and a slave girl. Then I asked the religious learned people and they told me that his wife should be stoned to death and my son should receive one-hundred lashes and be sentenced to one year of exile.' The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "By Him in Whose Hands my life is, I will judge between you according to Allah's Book (Laws): As for the slave girl and the sheep, they are to be returned; and as for your son, he shall receive onehundred lashes and will be exiled for one year. You, O Unais!" addressing a man from Bani Aslam, "Go tomorrow morning to the wife of this (man) and if she confesses, then stone her to death." The next morning Unais went to the wife and she confessed, and he stoned her to death
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath the, ek badawi khade hue aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Allah ki Kitaab (Qawaanin) ke mutaabik mera maamla tay kijiye.' Phir unke mukhaalif khade hue aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Unhone sach kaha! Allah ki Kitaab (Qawaanin) ke mutaabik unka maamla tay kijiye aur mujhe bolne dijiye.' Unhone kaha, 'Mera beta is aadmi ka mazdoor tha aur usne iski biwi ke saath zina kiya. Logon ne mujhse kaha mere bete ko sangsaar kiya jaana chaahiye, magar maine use sau bakriyon aur ek launDi se fidye mein le liya. Phir maine deeni aalimon se pucha aur unhone mujhe bataaya ke uski biwi ko sangsaar kiya jaana chaahiye aur mere bete ko sau kode maare jaane chaahiye aur ek saal ke liye jila-watan kiya jaana chaahiye.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, main tumhaare beech Allah ki Kitaab (Qawaanin) ke mutaabik faisla dunga: launDi aur bakriyaan, unhein wapas kiya jaayega; aur tumhaare bete ko sau kode maare jaayenge aur ek saal ke liye jila-watan kiya jaayega. Aye Unais!' Ek Banu Aslam qabeele ke shaks se khitaab karte hue, 'Subah is (aadmi) ki biwi ke paas jaao, aur agar wo iqraar kare, to use sangsaar kar do.' Agli subah Unais unki biwi ke paas gaye aur usne iqraar kiya, aur unhone use sangsaar kar diya.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:On the day of (the battle of) the Trench, the Prophet (ﷺ) called the people (to bring news about the enemy). Az-Zubair responded to his call. He called them again and Az-Zubair responded to his call again; then he called them for the third time and again Az-Zubair responded to his call whereupon the Prophet said, "Every prophet has his Hawairi (helper), and Az-Zubair is my Hawari
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jang-e-Khandaq (khaai) ke din, Nabi (SAW) ne logon ko bulaaya (dushman ki khabar laane ke liye). Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne unke bulaawe ka jawab diya. Unhone dobara bulaaya aur Az-Zubair ne phir jawab diya; phir unhone teesri baar bulaaya aur Az-Zubair ne phir jawab diya, isper Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Har Nabi ka apna Hawari (khaas madadgaar) hota hai, aur Az-Zubair mera Hawari hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) entered a garden and told me to guard its gate. Then a man came and asked permission to enter. The Prophet, said, "Permit him and give him the good news that he will enter Paradise." Behold! It was Abu Bakr. Then `Umar came, and the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Admit him and give him the good news that he will enter Paradise." Then `Uthman came and the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Admit him and give him the good news that he will enter Paradise
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ek baag mein daakhil hue aur mujhse uske darwaaze ki hifaazat karne ko kaha. Phir ek shaks aaya aur andar aane ki ijaazat maangi. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Unhein ijaazat do aur unhein Jannat mein daakhil hone ki khush-khabri do.' Dekho! Wo Abu Bakr the. Phir Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) aaye, aur Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Unhein andar aane do aur unhein Jannat mein daakhil hone ki khush-khabri do.' Phir Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) aaye aur Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Unhein andar aane do aur unhein Jannat mein daakhil hone ki khush-khabri do.'

e: Narrated `Umar:I came and behold, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was staying on a Mashroba (attic room) and a black slave of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was at the top if its stairs. I said to him, "(Tell the Prophet) that here is `Umar bin Al- Khattab (asking for permission to enter)." Then he admitted me
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main aaya aur dekha, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek Mashruba (ooparli manzil ke kamre) mein reh rahe the, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka ek kaala ghulaam uski seedhiyon ke sabse oopar tha. Maine unse kaha, '(Nabi ko bataao ke) yahaan Umar bin Al-Khattab (andar aane ki ijaazat maang rahe) hain.' Phir unhone mujhe andar aane diya.

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent a letter to Khosrau and told his messenger to give it first to the ruler of Bahrain, and tell him to deliver it to Khosrau. When Khosrau had read it, he tore it into pieces. (Az-Zuhri said: I think Ibn Al-Musaiyab said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) invoked Allah to tear them (Khosrau and his followers) into pieces
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Khosrau ko ek khat bheja aur apne qaasid se kaha ke pehle use Bahrain ke hukmraan ko dein, aur unse kaha ke wo ise Khosrau tak pahunchaayein. Jab Khosrau ne use padha, usne ise tukde-tukde kar diya. (Az-Zuhri ne kaha: Mujhe lagta hai Ibn Al-Musaiyab ne kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhein (Khosrau aur uske pairvi karne walon ko) tukde-tukde karne ki Allah se dua ki.')

e: Narrated Salama bin Al-Akwa`:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to a man from the tribe of Al-Aslam, "Proclaim among your people (or the people) on the day of 'Ashura' (tenth of Muharram), 'Whosoever has eaten anything should fast for the rest of the day; and whoever has not eaten anything, should complete his fast
hi: Salama bin Al-Akwa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Al-Aslam qabeele ke ek shaks se kaha, 'Apni qaum (ya logon) ke beech Ashura (10 Muharram) ke din ye elaan karo: "Jisne kuch khaaya hai, use baaki din roza rakhna chaahiye; aur jisne kuch nahi khaaya, use apna roza poora karna chaahiye."'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When the delegate of `Abd Al-Qais came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), he said, "Who are the delegate?" They said, "The delegate are from the tribe of Rabi`a." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Welcome, O the delegate, and welcome! O people! Neither you will have any disgrace nor will you regret." They said, "O Allah's Apostle! Between you and us there are the infidels of the tribe of Mudar, so please order us to do something good (religious deeds) that by acting on them we may enter Paradise, and that we may inform (our people) whom we have left behind, about it." They also asked (the Prophet) about drinks. He forbade them from four things and ordered them to do four things. He ordered them to believe in Allah, and asked them, "Do you know what is meant by belief in Allah?" They said, "Allah and His Apostle know best." He said, ''To testify that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, the One, Who has no partners with Him, and that Muhammad is Allah's Messenger (ﷺ); and to offer prayers perfectly and to pay Zakat." (the narrator thinks that fasting in Ramadan is included), "and to give one-fifth of the war booty (to the state)." Then he forbade four (drinking utensils): Ad-Duba', Al56 Hantam, Al-Mazaffat and An-Naqir, or probably, Al-Muqaiyar. And then the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Remember all these things by heart and preach it to those whom you have left behind
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Abd Al-Qais qabeele ka wafd (delegation) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya, unhone pucha, 'Kaun se wafd hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Wafd Rabi'a qabeele se hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Khush-aamdeed, Aye wafd, aur khush-aamdeed! Aye logo! Na tumhein zillat hogi na pachhtaawa.' Unhone kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Hamare aur aapke beech Mudar qabeele ke kaafir hain, isliye barah-e-meharbaani humein kuch achhi (deeni) cheezein karne ka hukm dijiye taake unpar amal karke hum Jannat mein daakhil ho sakein, aur taake hum apne piche chhode logon ko bhi iske baare mein bataa sakein.' Unhone (Nabi ke sahaaba ne bhi) sharbaton ke baare mein pucha. Nabi (SAW) ne unhein chaar cheezon se mana kiya aur unhein chaar cheezon ka hukm diya. Unhone unhein Allah par Iman laane ka hukm diya, aur pucha, 'Kya tumhein pata hai Allah par Iman laane ka matlab kya hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Allah aur uska Rasool behtar jaante hain.' Unhone kaha, 'Gawaahi dena ke Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi, akela, jiska koi shareek nahi, aur Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain; aur namaz sahi tareeke se padhna aur Zakat dena.' (Ravi ko lagta hai Ramzan ke roze bhi shaamil hain,) 'aur jang ke maal-e-ganimat ka paanchwaan hissa (sarkaar ko) dena.' Phir unhone chaar (bartanon) se mana kiya: Ad-Duba', Al-Hantam, Al-Muzaffat aur An-Naqir, ya shaayad, Al-Muqaiyar. Aur phir Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'In sab baaton ko dil se yaad rakho aur apne peechhe chhode logon ko ye sikhaao.'

e: Narrated Tauba Al-`Anbari:Ash-'Shu`bi asked me, "Did you notice how Al-Hasan used to narrate Hadiths from the Prophets? I stayed with Ibn `Umar for about two or one-and-half years and I did not hear him narrating any thing from the Prophet (ﷺ) except his (Hadith): He (Ibn `Umar) said, "Some of the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) including Sa`d, were going to eat meat, but one of the wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) called them, saying, 'It is the meat of a Mastigure.' The people then stopped eating it. On that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Carry on eating, for it is lawful.' Or said, 'There is no harm in eating it, but it is not from my meals
hi: Tauba Al-Anbari bataate hain: Ash-Shu'bi ne mujhse pucha, 'Kya tumne notice kiya Al-Hasan Prophets se kaise hadeesein bayaan karte the? Main Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath do saal ya dedh saal reha aur maine unhein Nabi (SAW) se koi bhi hadees riwaayat karte nahi suna siwaaye is (hadees) ke: Unhone kaha, "Nabi (SAW) ke sahaaba mein se kuch, jinmein Sa'd bhi the, gosht khaane wale the, magar Nabi (SAW) ki ek biwi ne unhein bulaakar kaha, 'Ye Mastigure (chhipkali jaisi jaanwar) ka gosht hai.' Log ye khaane se ruk gaye. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Khaate raho, kyunke ye jaayez hai,' ya kaha, 'Ise khaane mein koi harj nahi, magar ye mera khaana nahi hai.'"'

e: Narrated Tariq bin Shihab:A Jew said to `Umar, "O Chief of the Believers, if this verse: 'This day I have perfected your religion for you, completed My favors upon you, and have chosen for you, Islam as your religion.' (5.3) had been revealed upon us, we would have taken that day as an `Id (festival) day." `Umar said, "I know definitely on what day this Verse was revealed; it was revealed on the day of `Arafat, on a Friday
hi: Tariq bin Shihab bataate hain: Ek Yahudi ne Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kaha, 'Aye Momineen ke Ameer! Agar ye Aayat: "Aaj mainne tumhaare liye tumhaara deen mukammal kar diya, tumpar apni niyaamaten poori kar di, aur tumhaare liye Islam ko deen ke taur par pasand kar liya" (5:3), humpar naazil hoti, to hum us din ko Eid (jashn) ka din maante.' Umar ne kaha, 'Mujhe pooki tarah pata hai ye Aayat kis din naazil hui thi; ye Arafat ke din naazil hui thi, Jumme ke din.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:That he heard `Umar speaking while standing on the pulpit of the Prophet (ﷺ) in the morning (following the death of the Prophet), when the people had sworn allegiance to Abu Bakr. He said the Tashah-hud before Abu Bakr, and said, "Amma Ba'du (then after) Allah has chosen for his Apostle what is with Him (Paradise) rather than what is with you (the world). This is that Book (Qur'an) with which Allah guided your Apostle, so stick to it, for then you will be guided on the right path as Allah guided His Apostle with it
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke unhone Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko subah Nabi (SAW) ke mimbar par khade hokar baat karte suna, jab logon ne (Nabi SAW ki maut ke baad) Abu Bakr se baiyat li thi. Unhone Tashahhud padha Abu Bakr se pehle, aur kaha, 'Amma Ba'du (aage), Allah ne apne Rasool ke liye wo cheez chuni jo uske paas hai (yaani Jannat) na ke wo jo tumhaare paas hai (yaani duniya). Ye wahi Kitaab (Quran) hai jiske zariye Allah ne tumhaare Rasool ko hidaayat di, isliye isse mazbooti se pakde raho, kyunke phir tum sahi raah par hidaayat paaoge jaisi Allah ne apne Rasool ko usi ke zariye di thi.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) embraced me and said, "O Allah! Teach him (the knowledge of) the Book (Qur'an)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne mujhe apne gale lagaaya aur kaha, 'Aye Allah! Ise Kitaab (Quran) ka ilm sikha.'

e: Narrated Abal Minhal:Abu Barza said, "(O people!) Allah makes you self-sufficient or has raised you high with Islam and with Muhammad
hi: Abal Minhal bataate hain: Abu Barza (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, '(Aye logo!) Allah ne tumhein khud-kifaayat banaaya hai, ya tumhein Islam aur Muhammad ke zariye ooncha uthaaya hai.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Dinar:`Abdullah Bin `Umar wrote to `Abdul Malik bin Marwan, swearing allegiance to him: 'I swear allegiance to you in that I will listen and obey what is in accordance with the Laws of Allah and the Tradition of His Apostle as much as I can
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Dinar bataate hain: Abdullah bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Abdul Malik bin Marwan ko baiyat lete hue likha: 'Main aapko baiyat deta hoon ke main sununga aur maanunga Allah ke Qawaanin aur uske Rasool ki Sunnat ke mutaabik, jitni meri taaqat mein ho.'

e: Narrated Sa`id bin Al-Musaiyab:Abu Huraira said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I have been sent with 'Jawami-al-Kalim ' (the shortest expression with the widest meaning) and have been made victorious with awe (cast in my enemy's hearts), and while I was sleeping, I saw that the keys of the treasures of the world were placed in my hand." Abu Huraira added: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has gone, and you people are utilizing those treasures, or digging those treasures out." or said a similar sentence
hi: Saeed bin Al-Musaiyab bataate hain: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Mujhe Jawami-al-Kalim (sabse chhoti baat jo sabse zyaada mafhoom rakhti hai) ke saath bheja gaya hai, aur mujhe khauf ke saath fatah di gayi hai (dushman ke dil mein daala gaya), aur jab main so raha tha, maine dekha ke duniya ke khazaanon ki chaabiyaan mere haath mein rakh di gayi.' Abu Huraira ne izaafa kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) chale gaye hain, aur ab tum log un khazaanon ka istemaal kar rahe ho, ya unhein khod kar nikaal rahe ho, ya isi jaisa kuch kaha.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There was no prophet among the prophets but was given miracles because of which people had security or had belief, but what I was given was the Divine Inspiration which Allah revealed to me. So I hope that my followers will be more than those of any other prophet on the Day of Resurrection
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Har Nabi ko koi na koi mojiza diya gaya jisse logon mein hifaazat ya Iman paida hota tha, magar jo mujhe diya gaya wo Ilaahi Wahi thi jo Allah ne mujhpar naazil ki. Isliye mujhe ummeed hai ke mere maanne wale Qayamat ke din kisi bhi doosre Nabi ke maanne walon se zyaada honge.'

e: Narrated Abu Wail:I sat with Shaiba in this Mosque (Al-Masjid-Al-Haram), and he said, "`Umar once sat beside me here as you are now sitting, and said, 'I feel like distributing all the gold and silver that are in it (i.e., the Ka`ba) among the Muslims'. I said, 'You cannot do that.' `Umar said, 'Why?' I said, 'Your two (previous) companions (the Prophet (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr) did not do it. `Umar said, 'They are the two persons whom one must follow.'" (See Hadith No. 664, Vol)
hi: Abu Wail bataate hain: Main Shaiba ke saath is Masjid (Al-Masjid-Al-Haram) mein baitha, aur unhone kaha, 'Ek baar Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) mere paas baithe the jaise tum abhi baithe ho, aur unhone kaha, "Mera dil chahta hai ke main iske andar (yaani Kaaba mein) jitna bhi sona aur chaandi hai wo Musalmaanon mein baant doon." Maine kaha, "Aap aisa nahi kar sakte." Umar ne pucha, "Kyun?" Maine jawab diya, "Aapke do (pehle) saathiyon (yaani Nabi SAW aur Abu Bakr) ne aisa nahi kiya." Umar ne kaha, "Wo do log hain jinki pairvi honi chaahiye."' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 664, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated Hudhaifa:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to us, "Honesty descended from the Heavens and settled in the roots of the hearts of men (faithful believers), and then the Qur'an was revealed and the people read the Qur'an, (and learnt it from it) and also learnt it from the Sunna." Both Qur'an and Sunna strengthened their (the faithful believers') honesty. (See Hadith No)
hi: Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humse kaha, 'Amaanat (imaandaari) aasman se utri aur logon (sacche Momineen) ke dilon ki jadon mein baithi, aur phir Quran naazil hua aur log Quran padhne lage, (aur usse seekha) aur Sunnat se bhi seekha.' Quran aur Sunnat, dono ne unki (Momineen ki) amaanat ko mazboot kiya. (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. dekhein.)

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The best talk (speech) is Allah's Book 'Qur'an), and the best way is the way of Muhammad, and the worst matters are the heresies (those new things which are introduced into the religion); and whatever you have been promised will surely come to pass, and you cannot escape (it)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Sabse behtareen baat Allah ki Kitaab (Quran) hai, aur sabse behtareen raasta Muhammad ka raasta hai; aur sabse buri baaten deen mein nayi laayi gayi cheezein hain (bidaat); aur jo bhi tumse waada kiya gaya hai wo zaroor hoga, aur tum ise (yaani Qayamat) taal nahi sakte.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira and Zaid bin Khalid:We were with the Prophet (ﷺ) when he said (to two men), "I shall judge between you according to Allah's Book (Laws)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Zaid bin Khalid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Nabi (SAW) ke saath the jab unhone (do aadmiyon se) kaha, 'Main tumhaare beech Allah ki Kitaab (Qawaanin) ke mutaabik faisla dunga.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "All my followers will enter Paradise except those who refuse." They said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Who will refuse?" He said, "Whoever obeys me will enter Paradise, and whoever disobeys me is the one who refuses (to enter it)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Mere sab maanne wale Jannat mein daakhil honge siwaaye un logon ke jo inkaar karein.' Unhone (logon ne) pucha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kaun inkaar karega?' Unhone kaha, 'Jo koi meri baat maanega, wo Jannat mein daakhil hoga, aur jo koi meri nafarmaani karega, wo hi hai jo inkaar karta hai (Jannat mein daakhil hone se).'

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:Some angels came to the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was sleeping. Some of them said, "He is sleeping." Others said, "His eyes are sleeping but his heart is awake." Then they said, "There is an example for this companion of yours." One of them said, "Then set forth an example for him." Some of them said, "He is sleeping." The others said, "His eyes are sleeping but his heart is awake." Then they said, "His example is that of a man who has built a house and then offered therein a banquet and sent an inviter (messenger) to invite the people. So whoever accepted the invitation of the inviter, entered the house and ate of the banquet, and whoever did not accept the invitation of the inviter, did not enter the house, nor did he eat of the banquet." Then the angels said, "Interpret this example to him so that he may understand it." Some of them said, "He is sleeping.'' The others said, "His eyes are sleeping but his heart is awake." And then they said, "The houses stands for Paradise and the call maker is Muhammad; and whoever obeys Muhammad, obeys Allah; and whoever disobeys Muhammad, disobeys Allah. Muhammad separated the people (i.e., through his message, the good is distinguished from the bad, and the believers from the disbelievers)
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Kuch farishte Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye jabke wo so rahe the. Unmein se kuch ne kaha, 'Wo so rahe hain.' Doosron ne kaha, 'Unki aankhein so rahi hain magar unka dil jaaga hua hai.' Phir unhone kaha, 'Tumhaare is saathi ke liye ek misaal hai.' Unmein se ek ne kaha, 'To unke liye ek misaal do.' Kuch ne kaha, 'Wo so rahe hain.' Doosron ne kaha, 'Unki aankhein so rahi hain magar unka dil jaaga hua hai.' Phir unhone kaha, 'Unki misaal aise aadmi ki hai jisne ek ghar banaaya aur phir usmein ek daawat di aur logon ko bulaane ke liye ek bulaanewaala bheja. To jo koi bulaanewaale ki dawat qubool karta, wo ghar mein daakhil hokar daawat ka khaana khaata, aur jo koi bulaanewaale ki dawat qubool nahi karta, wo na ghar mein daakhil hota na daawat ka khaana khaata.' Phir farishton ne kaha, 'Isse unhein iski tashreeh do taake wo isse samajh sakein.' Kuch ne kaha, 'Wo so rahe hain.' Doosron ne kaha, 'Unki aankhein so rahi hain magar unka dil jaaga hua hai.' Aur phir unhone kaha, 'Ghar Jannat ka pratik hai, aur bulaanewaala Muhammad hain; aur jo koi Muhammad ki farmaanbardaari kare, wo Allah ki farmaanbardaari karta hai; aur jo koi Muhammad ki nafarmaani kare, wo Allah ki nafarmaani karta hai. Muhammad ne logon ko alag kar diya (yaani unke paighaam ke zariye, achhaai buraai se, aur Momineen kaafiron se alag ho gaye).'

e: Narrated Hammam:Hudhaifa said, "O the Group of Al-Qurra! Follow the straight path, for then you have taken a great lead (and will be the leaders), but if you divert right or left, then you will go astray far away
hi: Hammam bataate hain: Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Aye Al-Qurra (Quran ke haafizon) ke giroh! Seedhe raaste par chalo, kyunke phir tumhaari bahut badi barhat hogi (aur tum agua honge), magar agar tum daaen ya baaen mudo, to tum bahut door bhatak jaaoge.'

e: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "My example and the example of what I have been sent with is that of a man who came to some people and said, 'O people! I have seen the enemy's army with my own eyes, and I am the naked warner; so protect yourselves!' Then a group of his people obeyed him and fled at night proceeding stealthily till they were safe, while another group of them disbelieved him and stayed at their places till morning when the army came upon them, and killed and ruined them completely So this is the example of that person who obeys me and follows what I have brought (the Qur'an and the Sunna), and the example of the one who disobeys me and disbelieves the truth I have brought
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Meri misaal aur us paighaam ki misaal jiske saath mujhe bheja gaya hai, aise aadmi jaisi hai jo kuch logon ke paas aaya aur kaha, "Aye logo! Maine apni khud ki aankhon se dushman ki fauj dekhi hai, aur main ek nangi talwaar liye chetaawani dene wala hoon; isliye khud ko bachaao!" Phir unke ek giroh ne uski baat maani aur raat ko chupke se, dheere-dheere nikal gaye yahaan tak ke wo mehfooz ho gaye, jabke doosre giroh ne uski baat par yaqeen nahi kiya aur apni jagah rukk gaye jab tak subah fauj ne unhein pakad na liya, aur unhein qatl karke poori tarah tabaah kar diya. To ye misaal hai us shaks ki jo meri baat maanta hai aur jo main laaya hoon (Quran aur Sunnat) uski pairvi karta hai, aur us shaks ki misaal jo meri nafarmaani karta hai aur jo Haq main laaya hoon usse inkaar karta hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died and Abu Bakr was elected as a Caliph after him, some of the Arabs reverted to disbelief, `Umar said to Abu Bakr, "How dare you fight the people while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, I have been ordered to fight the people till they say 'None has the right to be worshipped but Allah' And whoever says: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah.' waves his wealth and his life from me unless he deserves a legal punishment lusty, and his account will be with Allah! Abu Bakr said, "By Allah, I will fight him who discriminates between Zakat and prayers, for Zakat is the Compulsory right to be taken from the wealth By Allah, if they refuse to give me even a tying rope which they use to give to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), I would fight them for withholding it." `Umar said, 'By Allah, It was nothing, except I saw that Allah had opened the chest of Abu Bakr to the fight, and I came to know for certain that was the truth
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka intekaal hua aur Abu Bakr unke baad Khalifa chune gaye, kuch Arab murtad ho gaye (Islam se peechhe hat gaye), Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Abu Bakr se kaha, 'Aap kaise logon se ladh sakte hain jabke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, "Mujhe hukm diya gaya hai ke main logon se tab tak ladhun jab tak wo na kahein 'Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi.' Aur jo koi kahega, 'Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi,' wo apni jaayadaad aur apni jaan mujhse bachaayega, siwaaye jaayez wajah ke, aur uska hisaab Allah ke paas hoga"?' Abu Bakr ne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, main us har shaks se ladunga jo namaz aur Zakat ke beech farq karta hai, kyunke Zakat jaayadaad se liya jaane wala farz haq hai. Allah ki qasam, agar wo mujhe ek bhi rassi na dein jo wo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko diya karte the, to main unse iske rokne ke liye ladunga.' Umar ne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, ye kuch nahi tha, siwaaye is ke ke maine dekha Allah ne Abu Bakr ka seena jang ke faisle ki taraf khol diya, aur mujhe yaqeen ho gaya ke wahi sach tha.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abbas:Uyaina bin Hisn bin Hudhaifa bin Badr came and stayed (at Medina) with his nephew Al-Hurr bin Qais bin Hisn who was one of those whom `Umar used to keep near him, as the Qurra' (learned men knowing Qur'an by heart) were the people of `Umar's meetings and his advisors whether they were old or young. 'Uyaina said to his nephew, "O my nephew! Have you an approach to this chief so as to get for me the permission to see him?" His nephew said, "I will get the permission for you to see him." (Ibn `Abbas added: ) So he took the permission for 'Uyaina, and when the latter entered, he said, "O the son of Al-Khattab! By Allah, you neither give us sufficient provision nor judge among us with justice." On that `Umar became so furious that he intended to harm him. Al-Hurr, said, "O Chief of the Believers!" Allah said to His Apostle 'Hold to forgiveness, command what is good (right), and leave the foolish (i.e. do not punish them).' (7.199) and this person is among the foolish." By Allah, `Umar did not overlook that Verse when Al-Hurr recited it before him, and `Umar said to observe (the orders of) Allah's Book strictly." (See Hadith No. 166, Vol)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Uyaina bin Hisn bin Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Badr aaye aur apne bhatije Al-Hurr bin Qais bin Hisn ke paas thehre, jo un logon mein se the jinhein Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) apne qareeb rakhte the, kyunke Al-Qurra (Quran ke haafiz) Umar ki majlison ke log aur unke salaahkaar hote the, chaahe wo boodhe hon ya jawaan. Uyaina ne apne bhatije se kaha, 'Aye mere bhatije! Kya tumhaari is sardaar tak pahunch hai ke main unse mil sakoon isliye tum mujhe ijaazat dilwaa sako?' Bhatije ne kaha, 'Main aapke liye ijaazat le loonga.' (Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne izaafa kiya:) To unhone Uyaina ke liye ijaazat li, aur jab wo andar daakhil hue, unhone kaha, 'Aye Khattab ke bete! Allah ki qasam, na aap humein kaafi rasad dete hain aur na hi hamare beech insaaf se faisla karte hain.' Isper, Umar itne gusse mein aa gaye ke unhein nuqsaan pahunchaane ka iraada kiya. Al-Hurr ne kaha, 'Aye Momineen ke Ameer! Allah ne apne Rasool se kaha, "Maafi ko apnao, achhaai (sahi baat) ka hukm do, aur naadaanon se munh mod lo (yaani unhein saza mat do)." (7:199) aur ye shaks naadaanon mein se hain.' Allah ki qasam, Umar ne is Aayat ko nazar-andaaz nahi kiya jab Al-Hurr ne unke saamne isse padha, aur Umar ne (hamesha) Allah ki Kitaab ki hidaayaton par sakhti se amal kiya. (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 166, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated Asma' bint Abu Bakr:I came to `Aisha during the solar eclipse. The people were standing (offering prayer) and she too, was standing and offering prayer. I asked, "What is wrong with the people?" She pointed towards the sky with her hand and said, Subhan Allah!'' I asked her, "Is there a sign?" She nodded with her head meaning, yes. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) finished (the prayer), he glorified and praised Allah and said, "There is not anything that I have not seen before but I have seen now at this place of mine, even Paradise and Hell. It has been revealed to me that you people will be put to trial nearly like the trial of Ad-Dajjal, in your graves. As for the true believer or a Muslim (the sub-narrator is not sure as to which of the two (words Asma' had said) he will say, 'Muhammad came with clear signs from Allah, and we responded to him (accepted his teachings) and believed (what he said)' It will be said (to him) 'Sleep in peace; we have known that you were a true believer who believed with certainty.' As for a hypocrite or a doubtful person, (the sub-narrator is not sure as to which word Asma' said) he will say, 'I do not know, but I heard the people saying something and so I said the same
hi: Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Abu Bakr (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Main Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas suraj grahan ke waqt gayi. Log khade (namaz padh rahe) the, aur wo bhi khadi hokar namaz padh rahi thin. Maine pucha, 'Logon ko kya hua hai?' Unhone apne haath se aasman ki taraf ishara kiya aur kaha, 'Subhan Allah!' Maine unse pucha, 'Kya koi nishaan hai?' Unhone apna sar hilaaya, matlab 'haan.' Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (namaz) khatam ki, unhone Allah ki tasbeeh aur tareef ki aur kaha, 'Aisi koi cheez nahi jo maine pehle na dekhi ho magar maine ab isi jagah dekhi hai, yahaan tak ke Jannat aur Jahannam bhi. Mujhpar Wahi naazil hui hai ke tum log apni qabron mein taqreeban Ad-Dajjal ki azmaaish jaisi azmaaish mein daale jaaoge. Sacchi Momin ya Musalmaan (ravi ko yaqeen nahi Asma ne kaunsa lafz kaha) kahega, "Muhammad Allah ki taraf se saaf nishaaniyaan lekar aaye, aur humne unhein qubool kiya (unki taalim maani) aur unpar Iman laaye." Usse kaha jaayega, "Sukoon se so jao; hum jaante the ke tum ek sachche Momin the jinhein yaqeen ke saath Iman tha." Jahaan tak munaafiq ya shak karne wale ki baat hai (ravi ko yaqeen nahi Asma ne kaunsa lafz kaha), wo kahega, "Mujhe nahi pata, magar maine logon ko kuch kehte suna, isliye maine bhi wahi kaha."'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Leave me as I leave you, for the people who were before you were ruined because of their questions and their differences over their prophets. So, if I forbid you to do something, then keep away from it. And if I order you to do something, then do of it as much as you can
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Mujhe chhod do jaisa main tumhein chhod deta hoon, kyunke tumse pehle ke log apne sawaalon aur apne Nabiyon ke baare mein apni behas ki wajah se barbaad hue. Isliye, agar main tumhein kisi cheez se mana karoon, to usse door raho. Aur agar main tumhein kisi cheez ka hukm doon, to jitni tumhaari taaqat mein ho utna karo.'

e: Narrated Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The most sinful person among the Muslims is the one who asked about something which had not been prohibited, but was prohibited because of his asking
hi: Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Musalmaanon mein sabse zyaada gunahgaar wo shaks hai jisne kisi aisi cheez ke baare mein poocha jo haraam nahi thi, magar uske poochne ki wajah se haraam kar di gayi.'

e: Narrated Zaid bin Thabit:The Prophet (ﷺ) took a room made of date palm leaves mats in the mosque. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prayed in it for a few nights till the people gathered (to pray the night prayer (Tarawih) (behind him.) Then on the 4th night the people did not hear his voice and they thought he had slept, so some of them started humming in order that he might come out. The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "You continued doing what I saw you doing till I was afraid that this (Tarawih prayer) might be enjoined on you, and if it were enjoined on you, you would not continue performing it. Therefore, O people! Perform your prayers at your homes, for the best prayer of a person is what is performed at his home except the compulsory congregational) prayer." (See Hadith No. 229,Vol. 3) (See Hadith No. 134, Vol)
hi: Zaid bin Thabit (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne khajoor ke patton se bani chataayi ka ek kamra Masjid mein liya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kuch raaton tak usmein namaz padhi yahaan tak ke log (unke peechhe raat ki namaz -- Tarawih -- padhne) jama ho gaye. Phir chauthi raat ko, logon ne unki aawaaz nahi suni aur unhone socha wo so gaye hain, isliye kuch logon ne gungunaana shuru kiya taake wo baahar aayein. Nabi (SAW) ne phir kaha, 'Tum aisa karte rahe jaisa maine tumhein karte dekha yahaan tak ke mujhe dar hua ke kahin ye (Tarawih ki namaz) tumpar farz na kar di jaaye, aur agar ye tumpar farz kar di jaati, to tum ise jaari nahi rakh paate. Isliye, Aye logo! Apni namazein apne gharon mein padho, kyunke kisi shaks ki sabse behtareen namaz wo hai jo wo apne ghar mein padhta hai, siwaaye farz (jamaat ki) namaz ke.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 229, Jild 3, aur Hadees No. 134, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated Abu Musa Al-Ash`ari:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked about things which he disliked, and when the people asked too many questions, he became angry and said, "Ask me (any question)." A man got up and said, "O Allah's Apostle! Who is my father?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Your father is Hudhaifa." Then another man got up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Who is my father?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Your father is Salim, Maula Shaiba." When `Umar saw the signs of anger on the face of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), he said, "We repent to Allah
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ashari bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kuch cheezon ke baare mein sawaal poocha gaya jo unhein napasand thi, aur jab logon ne bahut zyaada sawaal poochne shuru kiye, wo gusse ho gaye aur kaha, 'Mujhse (koi bhi sawaal) poochho.' Ek shaks khada hua aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mera baap kaun hai?' Nabi (SAW) ne jawab diya, 'Tumhaara baap Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) hai.' Phir ek aur shaks khada hua aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mera baap kaun hai?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Tumhaara baap Salim hai, Shaiba ke Maula.' Jab Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke chehre par gusse ke nishaan dekhe, unhone kaha, 'Hum Allah ki taraf tauba karte hain.'

e: Narrated Warrad:(The clerk of Al-Mughira) Muawiya wrote to Al-Mughira 'Write to me what you have heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).' So he (Al-Mughira) wrote to him: Allah's Prophet used to say at the end of each prayer: "La ilaha illalla-h wahdahu la sharika lahu, lahul Mulku, wa lahul Hamdu wa hula ala kulli shai'in qadir. 'Allahumma la mani' a lima a'taita, wala mu'tiya lima mana'ta, wala yanfa'u dhuljadd minkal-jadd." He also wrote to him that the Prophet (ﷺ) used to forbid (1) Qil and Qal (idle useless talk or that you talk too much about others), (2) Asking too many questions (in disputed Religious matters); (3) And wasting one's wealth by extravagance; (4) and to be undutiful to one's mother (5) and to bury the daughters alive (6) and to prevent your favors (benevolence to others (i.e. not to pay the rights of others (7) And asking others for something (except when it is unavoidable)
hi: Warrad (Al-Mughira ke munshi) bataate hain: Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Al-Mughira ko likha, 'Mujhe likho jo aapne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna.' To unhone (Al-Mughira ne) unhein likha: Allah ke Nabi har namaz ke aakhir mein kaha karte the: 'La Ilaha Illallahu Wahdahu La Sharika Lahu, Lahul-Mulku, Wa Lahul-Hamdu Wa Huwa Ala Kulli Shai'in Qadir. Allahumma La Mani'a Lima A'taita, Wala Mu'tiya Lima Mana'ta, Wala Yanfa'u Dhul-Jaddi Minkal-Jadd.' Unhone unhein ye bhi likha ke Nabi (SAW) mana karte the: (1) Qil-o-Qaal (be-maani baaton mein masroof hona ya doosron ke baare mein zyaada baaten karna); (2) bahut zyaada sawaal poochhna (jhagade waale deeni maamlon mein); (3) apni daulat ko fizool-kharchi mein zaaya karna; (4) apni maa ke saath badsuluki karna; (5) apni betiyon ko zinda dafan karna; (6) apni (doosron par kiye gaye) ehsaanaat ko rokna (yaani doosron ke haq ada na karna); (7) aur doosron se kuch maangna (siwaaye jab wo aparihaarya ho).

e: Narrated Anas:We were with `Umar and he said, "We have been forbidden to undertake a difficult task beyond our capability (i.e. to exceed the religious limits e.g., to clean the inside of the eyes while doing ablution)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath the aur unhone kaha, 'Humein apni taaqat se zyaada mushkil kaam karne se mana kiya gaya hai (yaani deeni hadd paar karne se, jaise wuzu karte waqt aankhon ke andar ka hissa saaf karna).'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) came out after the sun had declined and offered the Zuhr prayer (in congregation). After finishing it with Taslim, he stood on the pulpit and mentioned the Hour and mentioned there would happen great events before it. Then he said, "Whoever wants to ask me any question, may do so, for by Allah, you will not ask me about anything but I will inform you of its answer as long as I am at this place of mine." On this, the Ansar wept violently, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) kept on saying, "Ask Me! " Then a man got up and asked, ''Where will my entrance be, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "(You will go to) the Fire." Then `Abdullah bin Hudhaifa got up and asked, "Who is my father, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Your father is Hudhaifa." The Prophet (ﷺ) then kept on saying (angrily), "Ask me! Ask me!" `Umar then knelt on his knees and said, "We have accepted Allah as our Lord and Islam as our religion and Muhammad as an Apostle." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) became quiet when `Umar said that. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "By Him in Whose Hand my life is, Paradise and Hell were displayed before me across this wall while I was praying, and I never saw such good and evil as I have seen today
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) suraj dhalne ke baad baahar aaye aur Zuhr ki namaz (jamaat mein) padhi. Taslim se ise khatam karne ke baad, wo mimbar par khade hue aur Qayamat ka zikr kiya aur bataaya ke uske pehle bade waaqiye honge. Phir unhone kaha, 'Jo koi bhi mujhse koi sawaal poochna chahe, wo poochh sakta hai, kyunke Allah ki qasam, tum mujhse jo bhi poochoge, main tumhein uska jawab dunga jab tak main is jagah hounga.' Isper, Ansaar bahut zyaada rone lage, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) baar-baar kehte rahe, 'Mujhse poochho!' Phir ek shaks khada hua aur pucha, 'Mera daakhil hone ki jagah kahaan hogi, Aye Allah ke Rasool?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, '(Tum) Aag (mein jaaoge).' Phir Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) khade hue aur pucha, 'Mera baap kaun hai, Aye Allah ke Rasool?' Nabi (SAW) ne jawab diya, 'Tumhaara baap Hudhaifa hai.' Nabi (SAW) phir (gusse mein) kehte rahe, 'Mujhse poochho! Mujhse poochho!' Isper, Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ghutnon ke bal jhuke aur kaha, 'Humne Allah ko apna Rab, aur Islam ko apna deen, aur Muhammad ko apna Rasool maan liya hai.' Jab Umar ne aisa kaha, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khaamosh ho gaye. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, Jannat aur Jahannam mere saamne is deewaar ke paar pesh kiye gaye jabke main namaz padh raha tha, aur maine kabhi aisi achhaai aur buraai nahi dekhi jaisi aaj dekhi.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:A man said, "O Allah's Prophet! Who is my father?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Your father is so-and-so." And then the Divine Verse:-- 'O you who believe! Ask not questions about things
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Nabi! Mera baap kaun hai?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Tumhaara baap falaan hai.' Aur phir Ilaahi Aayat naazil hui: 'Aye Iman waalon! Aisi baaton ke baare mein sawaal mat poochho jo (agar tumpar zaahir ki jaayein, to tumhein museebat mein daal sakti hain)...'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "People will not stop asking questions till they say, 'This is Allah, the Creator of everything, then who created Allah?
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Log sawaal poochhna nahi rokenge jab tak wo kahein, "Ye Allah hai, har cheez ka Khaaliq, to Allah ko kisne banaaya?"'

e: Narrated Ibn Masud:I was with the Prophet (ﷺ) at one of the farms of Medina while he was leaning on a date palm leaf-stalk. He passed by a group of Jews and some of them said to the other, Ask him (the Prophet) about the spirit. Some others said, "Do not ask him, lest he should tell you what you dislike" But they went up to him and said, "O Abal Qasim! Inform us bout the spirit." The Prophet (ﷺ) stood up for a while, waiting. I realized that he was being Divinely Inspired, so I kept away from him till the inspiration was over. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "(O Muhammad) they ask you regarding the spirit, Say: The spirit its knowledge is with my Lord (i.e., nobody has its knowledge except Allah)" (17.85) (This is a miracle of the Qur'an that all the scientists up till now do not know about the spirit, i.e, how life comes to a body and how it goes away at its death) (See Hadith No. 245, Vol)
hi: Ibn Masud bataate hain: Main Nabi (SAW) ke saath Madina ke ek kheton mein tha jabke wo khajoor ke patton ki ek dandi par tek lagaaye hue the. Wo Yahudiyon ke ek giroh ke paas se guzre, aur unmein se kuch ne doosron se kaha, 'Unse (Nabi se) Rooh ke baare mein poochho.' Kuch aur ne kaha, 'Unse mat poochho, kahin wo tumhein aisi baat na bataayein jo tumhein napasand ho.' Magar wo unke paas gaye aur kaha, 'Aye Abal-Qasim! Humein Rooh ke baare mein bataaiye.' Nabi (SAW) kuch der khade rahe, intezaar karte hue. Mujhe ehsaas hua ke unhein Ilaahi Wahi mil rahi hai, isliye main unse door raha jab tak wahi khatam nahi hui. Phir Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, '(Aye Muhammad) wo tumse Rooh ke baare mein poochte hain. Kaho: Rooh ka ilm mere Rab ke paas hai (yaani Allah ke siwa iska ilm kisi ko nahi)' (17:85). (Ye Quran ka ek mojiza hai ke aaj tak sab vaigyanik ye nahi jaante ke Rooh kya hai, yaani zindagi kaise ek jism mein aati hai aur maut par kaise chali jaati hai.) (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 245, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) wore a gold ring and then the people followed him and wore gold rings too. Then the Prophet said, "I had this golden ring made for myself. He then threw it away and said, "I shall never put it on." Thereupon the people also threw their rings away
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne sone ki ek anguthi pehni, aur phir logon ne unki pairvi karte hue sone ki anguthiyaan pehni. Phir Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Maine ye sone ki anguthi apne liye banwaayi thi.' Phir unhone use phenk diya aur kaha, 'Main ise kabhi nahi pehnunga.' Isper, logon ne bhi apni anguthiyaan phenk di.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to his companions), "Do not fast Al-Wisal." They said, "But you fast Al-Wisail." He said, "I am not like you, for at night my Lord feeds me and makes me drink." But the people did not give up Al-Wisal, so the Prophet (ﷺ) fasted Al-Wisal with them for two days or two nights, and then they saw the crescent whereupon the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If the crescent had delayed, I would have continued fasting (because of you)," as if he wanted to vanquish them completely (because they had refused to give up Al Wisal)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne (apne sahaaba se) kaha, 'Al-Wisal ka roza mat rakho.' Unhone kaha, 'Magar aap khud Al-Wisal ka roza rakhte hain.' Unhone kaha, 'Main tum jaisa nahi hoon, kyunke raat ko mera Rab mujhe khilaata aur pilaata hai.' Magar log Al-Wisal chhodne se inkaar karte rahe, isliye Nabi (SAW) ne unke saath do din ya do raaton tak Al-Wisal ka roza rakha, aur phir unhone chaand dekha, isper Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Agar chaand thoda der se aata, to main isse aur jaari rakhta,' jaise wo unhein poori tarah haraana chahte the (kyunke unhone Al-Wisal chhodne se inkaar kiya tha).

e: Narrated Ibrahim At Taimi's father:`Ali addressed us while he was standing on a brick pulpit and carrying a sword from which was hanging a scroll He said "By Allah, we have no book to read except Allah's Book and whatever is on this scroll," And then he unrolled it, and behold, in it was written what sort of camels were to be given as blood money, and there was also written in it: 'Medina is a sanctuary form 'Air (mountain) to such and such place so whoever innovates in it an heresy or commits a sin therein, he will incur the curse of Allah, the angels, and all the people and Allah will not accept his compulsory or optional good deeds.' There was also written in it: 'The asylum (pledge of protection) granted by any Muslims is one and the same, (even a Muslim of the lowest status is to be secured and respected by all the other Muslims, and whoever betrays a Muslim in this respect (by violating the pledge) will incur the curse of Allah, the angels, and all the people, and Allah will not accept his compulsory or optional good deeds.' There was also written in it: 'Whoever (freed slave) befriends (takes as masters) other than his real masters (manumitters) without their permission will incur the curse of Allah, the angels, and all the people, and Allah will not accept his compulsory or optional good deeds. ' (See Hadith No. 94, Vol)
hi: Ibrahim At-Taimi ke waalid bataate hain: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne hamse khitaab kiya jabke wo eentein se bane mimbar par khade the aur ek talwaar liye hue the jispar ek kaagaz (scroll) latak raha tha. Unhone kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, hamare paas padhne ke liye Allah ki Kitaab (Quran) ke ilaawa aur kuch nahi hai siwaaye jo is scroll par likha hai.' Aur phir unhone use khola, aur dekho, usmein khoon-bahe ke liye deye jaane wale oonton ka zaabta likha tha, aur ye bhi likha tha: 'Madina ek panaah-gah hai Air (pahaad) se falaan jagah tak, isliye jo koi ismein bidaat (deen mein koi nayi cheez) daakhil kare ya jurm kare, uspar Allah, farishton aur sab logon ki laanat hogi, aur Allah uska koi farz ya nafl nek amal qubool nahi karega.' Usmein ye bhi likha tha: 'Kisi bhi Musalmaan ka diya hua panaah (asylum) sab Musalmaanon ke liye ek jaisa hai (chaahe wo sabse nichle darje ke Musalmaan ne diya ho, use sab doosre Musalmaanon dwara hifaazat aur izzat di jaani chaahiye), aur jo koi is silsile mein kisi Musalmaan ke saath dhoka kare (waade ko tod kar), uspar Allah, farishton aur sab logon ki laanat hogi, aur Allah uska koi farz ya nafl nek amal qubool nahi karega.' Usmein ye bhi likha tha: 'Jo koi (azaad kiya gaya ghulaam) apne asal maalikon ke ilaawa kisi aur ko apna aaqa (dost) banaaye, unki ijaazat ke bagair, uspar Allah, farishton aur sab logon ki laanat hogi, aur Allah uska koi farz ya nafl nek amal qubool nahi karega.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 94, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) did something as it was allowed from the religious point of view but some people refrained from it. When the Prophet (ﷺ) heard of that, he, after glorifying and praising Allah, said, "Why do some people refrain from doing something which I do? By Allah, I know Allah more than they
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ne kuch aisa kiya jo deeni nazariye se jaayez tha, magar kuch logon ne isse karne se parhez kiya. Jab Nabi (SAW) ne ye suna, unhone Allah ki tasbeeh aur tareef karne ke baad kaha, 'Kuch log wo cheez karne se kyun parhez karte hain jo main karta hoon? Allah ki qasam, main unse zyaada Allah ko jaanta hoon.'

e: Narrated Ibn Abi Mulaika:Once the two righteous men, i.e., Abu Bakr and `Umar were on the verge of destruction (and that was because): When the delegate of Bani Tamim came to the Prophet, one of them (either Abu Bakr or `Umar) recommended Al-Aqra' bin H`Abis at-Tamimi Al-Hanzali, the brother of Bani Majashi (to be appointed as their chief), while the other recommended somebody else. Abu Bakr said to `Umar, "You intended only to oppose me." `Umar said, "I did not intend to oppose you!" Then their voices grew louder in front of the Prophet (ﷺ) whereupon there was revealed: 'O you who believe! Do not raise your voices above the voice of the Prophet..a great reward.' (49.2-3) Ibn Az-Zubair said, 'Thence forward when `Umar talked to the Prophet, he would talk like one who whispered a secret and would even fail to make the Prophet (ﷺ) hear him, in which case the Prophet (ﷺ) would ask him (to repeat his words)
hi: Ibn Abi Mulaika bataate hain: Ek baar do neik log, yaani Abu Bakr aur Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ), tabaahi ke kagaar par aa gaye the (aur ye isliye tha ke): Jab Banu Tamim ka wafd (delegation) Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya, unmein se ek (Abu Bakr ya Umar) ne Al-Aqra' bin Habis At-Tamimi Al-Hanzali, Banu Majashi ke bhai, ko (unka sardaar muqarrar karne ki) sifaarish ki, jabke doosre ne kisi aur ki sifaarish ki. Abu Bakr ne Umar se kaha, 'Aapka iraada sirf mera mukhaalif hona hai.' Umar ne kaha, 'Mera iraada aapka mukhaalif hona nahi tha!' Phir unki aawazein Nabi (SAW) ke saamne oonchi hoti gayi, isper naazil hui: 'Aye Iman waalon! Nabi ki aawaaz se apni aawazein oonchi mat karo... ek bada ajr.' (49:2-3) Ibn Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Us waqt se, jab Umar Nabi (SAW) se baat karte, wo aise baat karte jaise koi chupke se koi raaz kah raha ho, aur wo Nabi (SAW) ko sunaane mein bhi kaamyaab nahi hote, jispar Nabi (SAW) unhein (apne alfaaz dohraane ko) kehte.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:(the mother of believers) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) during his fatal ailment said, "Order Abu Bakr to lead the people in prayer." I said, "If Abu Bakr stood at your place (in prayers, the people will not be able to hear him because of his weeping, so order `Umar to lead the people in prayer." He again said, "Order Abu Bakr to lead the people in prayer " Then I said to Hafsa, "Will you say (to the Prophet), 'If Abu Bakr stood at your place, the people will not be able to hear him be cause of his weeping, so order `Umar to lead the people in prayer?" Hafsa did so, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "You are like the companions of Joseph (See Qur'an, 12:30-32). Order Abu Bakr to lead the people in prayer." Hafsa then said to me, "I have never received any good from you
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Momineen ki maa) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apni aakhri bimaari mein kaha, 'Abu Bakr ko hukm do ke wo logon ko namaz padhaayein.' Maine kaha, 'Agar Abu Bakr aapki jagah khade hote (namaz mein), log unhein unke rone ki wajah se sun nahi paayenge, isliye barah-e-meharbaani Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko namaz padhaane ka hukm dijiye.' Unhone phir kaha, 'Abu Bakr ko hukm do ke wo logon ko namaz padhaayein.' Phir maine Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) se kaha, 'Kya aap (Nabi se) kahengi, "Agar Abu Bakr aapki jagah khade hote, log unhein unke rone ki wajah se sun nahi paayenge, isliye barah-e-meharbaani Umar ko namaz padhaane ka hukm dijiye"?' Hafsa ne aisa kiya, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Tum log Yusuf (ki kahaani mein aaye) saathiyon (khawaateen) jaisi ho. (Quran, 12:30-32 dekhein). Abu Bakr ko hukm do ke wo logon ko namaz padhaayein.' Hafsa ne phir mujhse kaha, 'Mujhe tumse kabhi koi bhalaai nahi mili.'

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d As-Sa`idi:'Uwaimir Al-`Ajlani came to `Asim bin `Adi and said, "If a man found another man with his wife and killed him, would you sentence the husband to death (in Qisas,) i.e., equality in punishment)? O `Asim! Please ask Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about this matter on my behalf." `Asim asked the Prophet (ﷺ) but the Prophet disliked the question and disapproved of it. `Asim returned and informed 'Uwaimir that the Prophet disliked that type of question. 'Uwaimir said, "By Allah, I will go (personally) to the Prophet." 'Uwaimir came to the Prophet (ﷺ) when Allah had already revealed Qur'anic Verses (in that respect), after `Asim had left (the Prophet (ﷺ) ). So the Prophet (ﷺ) said to 'Uwaimir, "Allah has revealed Qur'anic Verses regarding you and your wife." The Prophet (ﷺ) then called for them, and they came and carried out the order of Lian. Then 'Uwaimir said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Now if I kept her with me, I would be accused of telling a lie." So 'Uwaimir divorced her although the Prophet (ﷺ) did not order him to do so. Later on this practice of divorcing became the tradition of couples involved in a case of Li'an. The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to the people). "Wait for her! If she delivers a red short (small) child like a Wahra (a short red animal). then I will be of the opinion that he ('Uwaimir) has told a lie but if she delivered a black big-eyed one with big buttocks, then I will be of the opinion that he has told the truth about her." 'Ultimately she gave birth to a child that proved the accusation. (See Hadith No. 269, Vol)
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) As-Sa'idi bataate hain: Uwaimir Al-Ajlani Aasim bin Adi ke paas aaye aur kaha, 'Agar koi aadmi kisi doosre aadmi ko apni biwi ke saath paaye aur use qatl kar de, kya aap shohar ko maut ki saza sunaayenge (Qisas mein, yaani barabar ki saza)? Aye Aasim! Barah-e-meharbaani mere taraf se Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se is baare mein pucho.' Aasim ne Nabi (SAW) se pucha magar Nabi (SAW) ko ye sawaal napasand aaya. Aasim wapas gaye aur Uwaimir ko bataaya ke Nabi (SAW) ne aisi qism ke sawaal ko napasand kiya. Uwaimir ne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, main khud Nabi (SAW) ke paas jaunga.' Uwaimir Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye jab Allah ne pehle hi Quran ki Aayaten (is silsile mein) naazil kar di thi, Aasim ke wahaan se jaane ke baad. To Nabi (SAW) ne Uwaimir se kaha, 'Allah ne tumhaare aur tumhaari biwi ke baare mein Quran ki Aayaten naazil ki hain.' Nabi (SAW) ne phir unhein bulaaya, aur wo aaye aur Li'an ka hukm poora kiya. Phir Uwaimir ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Ab agar main unhein apne paas rakhun, to mujhpar jhoot bolne ka ilzaam lagega.' To Uwaimir ne unhein talaaq de di, halaanke Nabi (SAW) ne unhein aisa karne ka hukm nahi diya tha. Baad mein ye amal (talaaq dena) Li'an ke maamlon mein shaamil jodon ke liye ek riwaayat ban gayi. Nabi (SAW) ne (logon se) kaha, 'Uska intezaar karo! Agar wo Wahra (ek chhoti laal jaanwar) jaisa laal, chhota bacha paida kare, to main manunga ke usne (Uwaimir ne) jhoot bola hai, magar agar wo kaala, badi aankhon aur bade chootadon waala bacha paida kare, to main manunga ke usne unke baare mein sach kaha.' Aakhirkaar unhone aisa bacha paidaish diya jisne ilzaam saabit kar diya. (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 269, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated Malik bin Aus An-Nasri:I proceeded till I entered upon `Umar (and while I was sitting there), his gate-keeper Yarfa came to him and said, " `Uthman, `Abdur-Rahman, Az-Zubair and Sa`d ask your permission to come in." `Umar allowed them. So they entered, greeted, and sat down. (After a while the gatekeeper came) and said, "Shall I admit `Ali and `Abbas?'' `Umar allowed them to enter. Al-`Abbas said "O Chief of the believers! Judge between me and the oppressor (`Ali)." Then there was a dispute (regarding the property of Bani Nadir) between them (`Abbas and `Ali). `Uthman and his companions said, "O Chief of the Believers! Judge between them and relieve one from the other." `Umar said, "Be patient! beseech you by Allah, with Whose permission the Heaven and the Earth Exist! Do you know that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Our property is not to be inherited, and whatever we leave is to be given in charity,' and by this Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) meant himself?" On that the group said, "He verily said so." `Umar then faced `Ali and `Abbas and said, "I beseech you both by Allah, do you both know that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said so?" They both replied, "Yes". `Umar then said, "Now I am talking to you about this matter (in detail) . Allah favored Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with some of this wealth which He did not give to anybody else, as Allah said: 'What Allah bestowed as Fai (Booty on His Apostle for which you made no expedition... ' (59.6) So that property was totally meant for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), yet he did not collect it and ignore you, nor did he withhold it with your exclusion, but he gave it to you and distributed it among you till this much of it was left behind, and the Prophet, used to spend of this as the yearly expenditures of his family and then take what remained of it and spent it as he did with (other) Allah's wealth. The Prophet (ﷺ) did so during all his lifetime, and I beseech you by Allah, do you know that?" They replied, "Yes." `Umar then addressed `Ali and `Abbas, saying, "I beseech you both by Allah, do you know that?" Both of them replied, "Yes." `Umar added, "Then Allah took His Apostle unto Him. Abu Bakr then said 'I am the successor of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)' and took over all the Prophet's property and disposed of it in the same way as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to do, and you were present then." Then he turned to `Ali and `Abbas and said, "You both claim that Abu Bakr did so-and-so in managing the property, but Allah knows that Abu Bakr was honest, righteous, intelligent, and a follower of what is right in managing it. Then Allah took Abu Bakr unto Him, 'I said: I am the successor of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr.' So I took over the property for two years and managed it in the same way as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and Abu Bakr used to do. Then you both (`Ali and `Abbas) came to me and asked for the same thing! (O `Abbas! You came to me to ask me for your share from nephew's property; and this (`Ali) came to me asking for his wives share from her father's property, and I said to you both, 'If you wish, I will place it in your custody on condition that you both will manage it in the same way as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr did and as I have been doing since I took charge of managing it; otherwise, do not speak to me anymore about it.' Then you both said, 'Give it to us on that (condition).' So I gave it to you on that condition. Now I beseech you by Allah, did I not give it to them on that condition?" The group (whom he had been addressing) replied, "Yes." `Umar then addressed `Abbas and `Ali saying, "I beseech you both by Allah, didn't I give you all that property on that condition?" They said, "Yes." `Umar then said, "Are you now seeking a verdict from me other than that? By Him with Whose Permission the Heaven and the Earth exists I will not give any verdict other than that till the Hour is established; and if you both are unable to manage this property, then you can hand it back to me, and I will be sufficient for it on your behalf." (See, Hadith No. 326, Vol)
hi: Malik bin Aus An-Nasri bataate hain: Main aage badha yahaan tak ke Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas pahuncha (aur jab main wahaan baitha tha), unke darwaan Yarfa aaye aur kaha, 'Uthman, Abdur Rahman, Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Sa'd aapse andar aane ki ijaazat maang rahe hain.' Umar ne unhein ijaazat di. To wo andar aaye, salaam kiya, aur baith gaye. (Kuch der baad darwaan aaye) aur kaha, 'Kya main Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Abbas ko andar aane doon?' Umar ne unhein ijaazat di. Al-Abbas ne kaha, 'Aye Momineen ke Ameer! Mere aur zaalim (Ali (Alayhis Salam)) ke beech faisla kijiye.' Phir unke (Abbas aur Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke) beech Banu Nadir ki jaayadaad ka jhagda hua. Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur unke saathiyon ne kaha, 'Aye Momineen ke Ameer! Unke beech faisla kijiye aur ek ko doosre se raahat dijiye.' Umar ne kaha, 'Sabra rakho! Main tumhein us Allah ki qasam deta hoon jiski ijaazat se aasman aur zameen dono qaayam hain! Kya tumhein pata hai Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, "Hamaari jaayadaad miraas mein nahi baanti jaati, aur jo bhi hum chhodte hain wo sadqe mein diya jaata hai," aur isse Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka matlab khud unse tha?' Isper us giroh ne kaha, 'Unhone waaqai aisa kaha.' Umar phir Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Abbas ki taraf mudhe aur kaha, 'Main tumhein Allah ki qasam deta hoon, kya tum dono jaante ho ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne aisa kaha?' Unhone dono ne jawab diya, 'Haan.' Umar ne phir kaha, 'Ab main tumse is maamle ke baare mein (tafseel se) baat karta hoon. Allah ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko is daulat (Fai) mein se kuch aisa diya jo usne kisi aur ko nahi diya, jaisa Allah ne farmaaya: "Jo Allah ne apne Rasool ko diya (Fai maal-e-ganimat) jiske liye tumne koi jang nahi ladi..." (59:6) To wo jaayadaad sirf Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke liye thi, phir bhi unhone use jama karke tumse door nahi rakha, na hi ise tumse rokkar apne liye rakha, balke unhone ise tumhein diya aur tum mein baanta yahaan tak ke itni jaayadaad reh gayi, aur Nabi (SAW) usmein se apne khaandaan ka saalana kharcha nikaalte the, aur jo bachta, wo Allah ki jaayadaad ki tarah kharch karte. Nabi (SAW) ne apni poori zindagi isi tarah amal kiya, aur main tumhein Allah ki qasam deta hoon, kya tumhein ye pata hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan.' Umar phir Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Abbas se khitaab karte hue kaha, 'Main tumhein Allah ki qasam deta hoon, kya tumhein ye pata hai?' Dono ne jawab diya, 'Haan.' Umar ne izaafa kiya, 'Phir Allah ne apne Rasool ko apne paas bula liya. Abu Bakr ne kaha, "Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka jaanashin hoon," aur unhone jaayadaad ki poori zimmedaari li aur ise waise hi sambhaala jaise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) karte the, aur tum us waqt maujood the.' Phir wo Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Abbas ki taraf mudhe aur kaha, 'Tum dono dawa karte ho ke Abu Bakr ne jaayadaad ki dekhbhaal mein aisa-aisa kiya, magar Allah jaanta hai ke Abu Bakr imaandaar, neik, aqlmand, aur is mein sahi cheez ki pairvi karne wale the. Phir Allah ne Abu Bakr ko apne paas bula liya, aur maine kaha: main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur Abu Bakr ka jaanashin hoon.
