To maine do saal is jaayadaad ki zimmedaari li aur ise waise hi sambhaala jaise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur Abu Bakr karte the. Phir tum dono (Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Abbas) mere paas isi cheez ki maang leke aaye! (Aye Abbas! Tum mere paas apne bhatije ki jaayadaad se apna hissa maangne aaye; aur ye (Ali (Alayhis Salam)) mere paas apni biwi ka hissa unke waalid ki jaayadaad se maangne aaya, aur maine tum dono se kaha, "Agar tum chaho, to main ise tumhaari zimmedaari mein de doonga is shart par ke tum dono ise waise hi sambhaaloge jaise Allah ke Rasool (SAW), Abu Bakr, aur main isse sambhaalta rahaa hoon jab se maine iski zimmedaari li; warna, ab is baare mein mujhse baat mat karo." Phir tum dono ne kaha, "Ise humein us shart par dedo." To maine ise tumhein us shart par diya. Ab main tumhein Allah ki qasam deta hoon, kya maine ise unhein us shart par nahi diya tha?' Us giroh (jinse wo khitaab kar rahe the) ne jawab diya, 'Haan.' Umar phir Abbas aur Ali (Alayhis Salam) se khitaab karte hue kaha, 'Main tumhein Allah ki qasam deta hoon, kya maine tumhein wo sab jaayadaad us shart par nahi di?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan.' Umar ne phir kaha, 'Kya tum ab mujhse iske ilaawa koi doosra faisla maangte ho? Us Zaat ki qasam jiski ijaazat se aasman aur zameen qaayam hain, main iske ilaawa koi aur faisla nahi doonga jab tak Qayamat na ho; aur agar tum dono is jaayadaad ki dekhbhaal karne mein kamzor ho, to tum ise mujhe wapas kar sakte ho, aur main tumhaari taraf se iske liye kaafi hounga.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 326, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated `Asim:I said to Anas, "Did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) make Medina a sanctuary?" He replied, "Yes, (Medina is a sanctuary from such-and-such place to such-and-such place. It is forbidden to cut its trees, and whoever innovates an heresy in it or commits a sin therein, will incur the curse of Allah, the angels, and all the people." Then Musa bin Anas told me that Anas added, "..... or gives refuge to such an heretic or a sinner)
hi: Aasim bataate hain: Maine Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kaha, 'Kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Madina ko ek panaah-gah banaaya tha?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Haan, (Madina ek panaah-gah hai) falaan jagah se falaan jagah tak. Iske darakht kaatna mana hai, aur jo koi ismein bidaat daakhil kare ya jurm kare, uspar Allah, farishton aur sab logon ki laanat hogi.' Phir Musa bin Anas ne mujhe bataya ke Anas ne izaafa kiya, '...ya aise bidaat karne wale ya gunaahgaar ko panaah de.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Allah will not deprive you of knowledge after he has given it to you, but it will be taken away through the death of the religious learned men with their knowledge. Then there will remain ignorant people who, when consulted, will give verdicts according to their opinions whereby they will mislead others and go astray
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, 'Allah tumhein ilm dene ke baad usse mehroom nahi karega, magar ye deeni aalimon ki maut se, unke ilm ke saath, uthaa liya jaayega. Phir jaahil log reh jaayenge jo, jab unse salaah li jaayegi, apni raay ke mutaabik faisla denge, jispar wo doosron ko bhataayenge aur khud bhi bhatak jaayenge.'

e: Narrated Al-A`mash:I asked Abu Wail, "Did you witness the battle of Siffin between `Ali and Muawiya?" He said, "Yes," and added, "Then I heard Sahl bin Hunaif saying, 'O people! Blame your personal opinions in your religion. No doubt, I remember myself on the day of Abi Jandal; if I had the power to refuse the order of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), I would have refused it. We have never put our swords on our shoulders to get involved in a situation that might have been horrible for us, but those swords brought us to victory and peace, except this present situation.' " Abu Wail said, "I witnessed the battle of Siffin, and how nasty Siffin was
hi: Al-A'mash bataate hain: Maine Abu Wail se pucha, 'Kya aap Siffin ki jang mein maujood the jo Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke beech hui?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan,' aur izaafa kiya, 'Phir maine Sahl bin Hunaif ko ye kehte suna, "Aye logo! Apni deen ke maamlon mein apni khud ki raay par ilzaam lagaao. Shak nahi, mujhe Abi Jandal ke din ka waqia yaad hai; agar mere paas Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke hukm ko rad karne ki taaqat hoti, to main use rad karta. Humne apni talwaarein kabhi apne kandhon par kisi aisi haalat mein daalne ke liye nahi uthaayi jo hamare liye khaufnaak hoti, magar wo talwaarein humein jeet aur amn tak le gayi, siwaaye is moujooda haalat ke." Abu Wail ne kaha, "Main Siffin ki jang mein maujood tha, aur Siffin kitni buri thi."'

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:I fell ill, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr came to visit me on foot. The Prophet (ﷺ) came to me while I was unconscious. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) performed ablution and poured the Remaining water of his ablution over me whereupon I became conscious and said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! How should I spend my wealth? Or how should I deal with my wealth?" But the Prophet (ﷺ) did not give me any reply till the Verse of the laws of inheritance was revealed
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main bimar pad gaya, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur Abu Bakr mujhse paidal milne aaye. Nabi (SAW) mere paas aaye jabke main behosh tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne wuzu kiya aur wuzu ka baaki paani mujhpar daala, isper main hosh mein aaya aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Main apni daulat kaise kharch karoon? Ya, main apni daulat ke saath kaise vyavahaar karoon?' Magar Nabi (SAW) ne mujhe koi jawab nahi diya jab tak Miraas (waraasat) ke qawaanin ki Ilaahi Aayat naazil nahi hui.

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id:A woman came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Men (only) benefit by your teachings, so please devote to us from (some of) your time, a day on which we may come to you so that you may teach us of what Allah has taught you." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Gather on such-and-such a day at suchand- such a place." They gathered and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to them and taught them of what Allah had taught him. He then said, "No woman among you who has lost her three children (died) but that they will screen her from the Fire." A woman among them said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! If she lost two children?" She repeated her question twice, whereupon the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Even two, even two, even two!" (See Hadith No. 341, Vol)
hi: Abu Saeed bataate hain: Ek khaatoon Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Sirf mard hi aapki taalim se faayda uthaate hain, isliye barah-e-meharbaani apne waqt se hamare liye bhi kuch (waqt) taye kariye, ek din jab hum aapke paas aa sakein taake aap humein wo sikha sakein jo Allah ne aapko sikhaaya hai.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Falaan din falaan jagah jama ho jaao.' Wo jama hui aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unke paas aaye aur unhein wo sikhaaya jo Allah ne unhein sikhaaya tha. Phir unhone kaha, 'Tum mein se koi bhi aisi aurat nahi jisne apne teen bacche khoye hon (jo mar gaye) magar wo bacche use Aag se bachaayenge.' Unmein se ek khaatoon ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Agar usne do bacche khoye hon?' Usne apna sawaal do baar dohraaya, isper Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Do bhi, do bhi, do bhi!' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 341, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated Al-Mughira bin Shu`ba:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A group of my follower swill remain predominant (victorious) till Allah's Order (the Hour) comes upon them while they are still predominant (victorious)
hi: Al-Mughira bin Shu'ba (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Mere maanne walon ka ek giroh hamesha ghaalib (vijay-shil) rahega jab tak Allah ka hukm (Qayamat) unpar na aa jaaye jabke wo abhi bhi ghaalib hi hon.'

e: Narrated Humaid:I heard Muawiya bin Abi Sufyan delivering a sermon. He said, "I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "If Allah wants to do a favor to somebody, He bestows on him, the gift of understanding the Qur'an and Sunna. I am but a distributor, and Allah is the Giver. The state of this nation will remain good till the Hour is established, or till Allah's Order comes
hi: Humaid bataate hain: Maine Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Sufyan ko khutba dete suna. Unhone kaha, 'Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, "Agar Allah kisi par meharbaani karna chahta hai, to wo use Quran aur Sunnat ki samajh ka tohfa deta hai. Main sirf ek baantne wala hoon, aur Allah hi dene wala hai. Is ummat ki haalat achhi rahegi jab tak Qayamat na aa jaaye, ya Allah ka hukm na aa jaaye."'

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:When the (following) Verse was revealed to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ): 'Say: He has power to send torment on you from above,'..(6.65) he said, "O Allah! I seek refuge with Your Face (from that punishment)." And when this was revealed: '..or from beneath your feet.' (6.65) he said, "O Allah! I seek refuge with Your Face (from that)." And when this Verse was revealed: '..or to cover you with confusion in partystrife, and make you to taste the violence of one another,'...(6.65) he said: "These two warnings are easier (than the previous ones)
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) par ye Aayat naazil hui: 'Kaho: Wo tumpar oopar se azaab bhejne ki qudrat rakhta hai,' (6:65) unhone kaha, 'Aye Allah! Main tere Chehre ki panaah leta hoon (is azaab se).' Aur jab ye naazil hui: '...ya tumhaare pairon ke neeche se.' (6:65) unhone kaha, 'Aye Allah! Main tere Chehre ki panaah leta hoon (isse).' Aur jab ye Aayat naazil hui: '...ya tumhein giroh-baazi mein uljhaakar tumhein ek doosre ki ladaai ka mazaa chakhaaye,' (6:65) unhone kaha, 'Ye do chetaawaniyaan pehle wali se aasaan hain.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:A bedouin came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "My wife has delivered a black boy, and I suspect that he is not my child." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him, "Have you got camels?" The bedouin said, "Yes." The Prophet said, "What color are they?" The bedouin said, "They are red." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Are any of them Grey?" He said, "There are Grey ones among them." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whence do you think this color came to them?" The bedouin said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! It resulted from hereditary disposition." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "And this (i.e., your child) has inherited his color from his ancestors." The Prophet (ﷺ) did not allow him to deny his paternity of the child
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek badawi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Meri biwi ne ek kaala ladka paidaish diya hai, aur mujhe shak hai ke ye mera bacha nahi hai.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne usse kaha, 'Kya tumhaare paas oont hain?' Badawi ne kaha, 'Haan.' Nabi (SAW) ne pucha, 'Unka rang kaisa hai?' Badawi ne kaha, 'Wo laal hain.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Kya unmein se koi khaakstari (grey) rangat ka bhi hai?' Usne kaha, 'Unmein khaakstari rangat ke bhi hain.' Nabi (SAW) ne pucha, 'To tumhein kya lagta hai ye rangat unmein kahaan se aayi?' Badawi ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Ye virasat (poorvajon se) mili hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Aur ye (yaani tumhaara bacha) bhi apni rangat apne poorvajon se pai hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne unhein bacche ki apni sant-aan hone se inkaar karne ki ijaazat nahi di.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:A woman came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "My mother vowed to perform the Hajj but she died before performing it. Should I perform the Hajj on her behalf?" He said, "Yes! Perform the Hajj on her behalf. See, if your mother had been in debt, would you have paid her debt?" She said, "Yes." He said, "So you should pay what is for Him as Allah has more right that one should fulfill one's obligations to Him
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek khaatoon Nabi (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha, 'Meri maa ne Hajj karne ki mannat maani thi magar wo (poori karne se pehle) mar gayi. Kya main unki taraf se Hajj kar sakti hoon?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan! Unki taraf se Hajj karo. Dekho, agar tumhaari maa par qarz hota, kya tum unka qarz nahi chukaate?' Usne kaha, 'Haan.' Unhone kaha, 'To wo bhi ada karo jo Allah ka haq hai, kyunke Allah ka haq isse zyaada hai ke koi apne farz poore kare.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Do not wish to be like anybody except in two cases: The case of a man whom Allah has given wealth and he spends it in the right way, and that of a man whom Allah has given religious wisdom (i.e., Qur'an and Sunna) and he gives his verdicts according to it and teaches it." (to others i.e., religious knowledge of Qur'an and Sunna (Prophet's Traditions)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kisi jaisa banne ki tamanna mat karo siwaaye do maamlon mein: ek us aadmi ki jise Allah ne daulat di hai aur wo use sahi tareeke se kharch karta hai, aur doosra us aadmi ki jise Allah ne deeni hikmat (yaani Quran aur Sunnat) di hai aur wo usi ke mutaabik faisla deta hai aur ise (doosron ko) sikhaata hai.'

e: Narrated Al-Mughira bin Shu`ba:`Umar bin Al-Khattab asked (the people) about the Imlas of a woman, i.e., a woman who has an abortion because of having been beaten on her `Abdomen, saying, "Who among you has heard anything about it from the Prophet?" I said, "I did.'' He said, "What is that?" I said, "I heard the Prophet saying, "Its Diya (blood money) is either a male or a female slave.' " `Umar said, "Do not leave till you present witness in support of your statement." So I went out, and found Muhammad bin Maslama. I brought him, and he bore witness with me that he had heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Its Diya (blood money) is either a male slave or a female slave
hi: Al-Mughira bin Shu'ba (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab ne (logon se) Imlas (garbh-paat, jo peeche par maar khaane se hota hai) ke baare mein pucha, 'Tum mein se kisne Nabi (SAW) se iske baare mein kuch suna hai?' Maine kaha, 'Maine suna hai.' Unhone pucha, 'Wo kya hai?' Maine kaha, 'Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, "Iska Diya (khoon-bahaa) ek ghulaam ya ek launDi hai."' Umar ne kaha, 'Jab tak tum apni baat ki tasdeeq ke liye gawaah na pesh karo, mat jaana.' To main baahar gaya aur Muhammad bin Maslama ko dhoondh liya. Main unhein le aaya, aur unhone mere saath gawaahi di ke unhone bhi Nabi (SAW) ko ye kehte suna tha, 'Iska Diya ek ghulaam ya ek launDi hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The Hour will not be established till my followers copy the deeds of the previous nations and follow them very closely, span by span, and cubit by cubit (i.e., inch by inch)." It was said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Do you mean by those (nations) the Persians and the Byzantines?" The Prophet said, "Who can it be other than they?
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Qayamat tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak mere maanne wale pichhli ummaton ke amaal ki nakal na karein aur unki bahut nazdeeki pairvi na karein, bitta bitta, aur haath haath (yaani inch inch).' Pucha gaya, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya aapka matlab Farsi aur Byzantine hai?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Aur kaun ho sakta hai unke ilaawa?'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You will follow the ways of those nations who were before you, span by span and cubit by cubit (i.e., inch by inch) so much so that even if they entered a hole of a mastigure, you would follow them." We said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! (Do you mean) the Jews and the Christians?" He said, "Whom else?
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Tum unse pehle ki ummaton ke raaston ki pairvi karoge, bitta bitta, aur haath haath (yaani inch inch), yahaan tak ke agar wo kisi Mastigure (chhipkali jaisi jaanwar) ke bill mein daakhil hote, to tum bhi unki pairvi karte.' Humne pucha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! (Kya aap kehte hain) Yahudi aur Isaai?' Unhone kaha, 'Aur kaun?'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "None is killed unjustly, but the first son of Adam will have a part of its burden." Sufyan said, "..a part of its blood because he was the first to establish the tradition of murdering
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Koi bhi na-jaayez taur par qatl nahi kiya jaata, magar Aadam ke pehle bete par is jurm ki kuch zimmedaari padti hai.' Sufyan ne kaha, '...yaani uske khoon ka kuch bojh, kyunke wo pehle shaks the jinhone qatl ki riwaayat qaayam ki.'

e: Narrated Jabir bin 'Abdullah As-Salami: A bedouin gave the Pledge of allegiance for embracing Islam to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and then he got an attack of fever in Medina and came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ): and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Cancel my pledge." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) refused to do so. The bedouin came to him again and said, "Cancel my pledge," but he refused again, and then again, the bedouin came to him and said, "Cancel my pledge," and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) refused. The bedouin finally went away, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Medina is like a pair of bellows (furnace), it expels its impurities while it brightens and clears its good
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) As-Salami bataate hain: Ek badawi ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se Islam ki baiyat li, aur phir usse Madina mein bukhaar aaya, isliye wo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Meri baiyat rad kar do.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne inkaar kiya. Badawi phir unke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Meri baiyat rad kar do,' magar unhone phir inkaar kiya, aur phir dobara, badawi unke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Meri baiyat rad kar do,' aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne inkaar kiya. Aakhirkaar badawi chala gaya, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Madina ek dhoonkni (bhatti) jaisa hai, ye apni napaakiyon ko baahar nikaal deti hai jabke ye apni achhaai ko roshan aur saaf karti hai.'

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas: I used to teach Qur'an to 'Abdur-Rahman bin Auf. When Umar performed his last Hajj, 'Abdur-Rahman said (to me) at Mina, "Would that you had seen Chief of the believers today! A man came to him and said, "So-and-so has said, "If Chief of the Believers died, we will give the oath of allegiance to such-and-such person,' 'Umar said, 'I will get up tonight and warn those who want to usurp the people's rights.' I said, 'Do not do so, for the season (of Hajj) gathers the riffraff mob who will form the majority of your audience, and I am afraid that they will not understand (the meaning of) your saying properly and may spread (an incorrect statement) everywhere. You should wait till we reach Medina, the place of migration and the place of the Sunna (the Prophet's Traditions). There you will meet the companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) from the Muhajirin and the Ansar who will understand your statement and place it in its proper position' 'Umar said, 'By Allah, I shall do so the first time I stand (to address the people) in Medina.' When we reached Medina, 'Umar (in a Friday Khutba-sermon) said, "No doubt, Allah sent Muhammad with the Truth and revealed to him the Book (Quran), and among what was revealed, was the Verse of Ar-Rajm (stoning adulterers to death).'" (See Hadith No. 817,Vol)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Abdur Rahman bin Auf (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko Quran padhaaya karta tha. Jab Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne apna aakhri Hajj kiya, Abdur Rahman ne Mina mein (mujhse) kaha, 'Kaash aapne aaj Momineen ke Ameer ko dekha hota! Ek shaks unke paas aaya aur kaha, "Falaan shaks ne kaha hai, 'Agar Momineen ke Ameer ka intekaal ho jaaye, to hum falaan-falaan shaks ko baiyat de denge.'" Umar ne kaha, "Main aaj raat khada hounga aur unhein khabardaar karunga jo logon ke haq chheenna chahte hain."' Maine kaha, 'Aisa mat kijiye, kyunke Hajj ka mausam har tarah ke logon (majma) ko jama karta hai, jo aapke sunneval majma ka bada hissa honge, aur mujhe dar hai ke wo aapki baat ka sahi matlab nahi samjhenge aur usse har jagah (galat tareeke se) failaayenge. Aapko Madina pahunchne tak intezaar karna chaahiye, jo hijrat ki jagah aur Sunnat (Nabi ki riwaayaton) ki jagah hai. Wahaan aap Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke Muhaajireen aur Ansaar sahaaba se mil sakenge, jo aapki baat samajhenge aur use uski sahi jagah rakhenge.' Umar ne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, main aisa hi karunga, jaise hi main Madina mein pehli baar (logon ke saamne) khada hounga.' Jab hum Madina pahunche, Umar ne (Jumme ke khutbe mein) kaha, 'Beshak, Allah ne Muhammad ko Haq ke saath bheja aur unhein paak Kitaab (Quran) naazil ki, aur jo kuch naazil hua usmein Ar-Rajm (zina karne walon ko sangsaar karne) ki Aayat bhi thi.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 817, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated Muhammad:We were with Abu Huraira while he was wearing two linen garments dyed with red clay. He cleaned his nose with his garment, saying, "Bravo! Bravo! Abu Huraira is cleaning his nose with linen! There came a time when I would fall senseless between the pulpit of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and `Aisha's dwelling whereupon a passerby would come and put his foot on my neck, considering me a mad man, but in fact, I had no madness, I suffered nothing but hunger
hi: Muhammad bataate hain: Hum Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saath the jabke wo mitti ke rang mein ranga hua do sooti kapde pehne hue the. Unhone apni naak apne kapde se saaf ki, kehte hue, 'Shaabaash! Shaabaash! Abu Huraira apni naak sooti kapde se saaf kar raha hai! Ek waqt tha jab main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke mimbar aur Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke rehne ki jagah ke beech behosh gir jaata tha, aur koi raah-chalta shaks aakar apna pair mere gale par rakh deta, mujhe paagal samajhkar, magar haqeeqat mein main paagal nahi tha, main sirf bhookh se pareshaan tha.'

e: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin `Abis:Ibn `Abbas was asked, "Did you offer the Id prayer with the Prophet?" He said, "Yes, had it not been for my close relation to the Prophet, I would not have performed it (with him) because of my being too young The Prophet (ﷺ) came to the mark which is near the home of Kathir bin As-Salt and offered the Id prayer and then delivered the sermon. I do not remember if any Adhan or Iqama were pronounced for the prayer. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered (the women) to give alms, and they started stretching out their hands towards their ears and throats (giving their ornaments in charity), and the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered Bilal to go to them (to collect the alms), and then Bilal returned to the Prophet
hi: Abdur Rahman bin Abis bataate hain: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha gaya, 'Kya aapne Nabi (SAW) ke saath Eid ki namaz padhi thi?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan, agar mera Nabi ke saath khaas rishta na hota, to main isse (unke saath) nahi padhta kyunke main bahut jawaan tha. Nabi (SAW) us nishaan tak aaye jo Kathir bin As-Salt ke ghar ke qareeb hai, aur Eid ki namaz padhaayi aur phir khutba diya. Mujhe yaad nahi ke namaz ke liye koi Azaan ya Iqama kahi gayi thi ya nahi. Phir Nabi (SAW) ne (khawaateen ko) sadqa dene ka hukm diya, aur wo apne haath apne kaanon aur galon ki taraf badhaane lagi (apne zewar sadqe mein dete hue), aur Nabi (SAW) ne Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko unke paas jaane ka hukm diya (sadqa jama karne ke liye), aur phir Bilal Nabi (SAW) ke paas wapas aaye.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to go to the Quba' mosque, sometimes walking, sometimes riding
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) Quba ki Masjid mein jaaya karte the, kabhi paidal aur kabhi sawaari par.

e: Narrated Hisham's father:`Aisha said to `Abdullah bin Az-Zubair, "Bury me with my female companions (i.e. the wives of the Prophet) and do not bury me with the Prophet (ﷺ) in the house, for I do not like to be regarded as sanctified (just for being buried there).'' Narrated Hisham's father: `Umar sent a message to `Aisha, saying, "Will you allow me to be buried with my two companions (the Prophet (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr) ?" She said, "Yes, by Allah." though it was her habit that if a man from among the companions (of the Prophet (ﷺ) ) sent her a message asking her to allow him to be buried there, she would say, "No, by Allah, I will never give permission to anyone to be buried with them
hi: Hisham ke waalid bataate hain: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kaha, 'Mujhe meri saheliyon (yaani Nabi ki biwiyon) ke saath dafn karo, aur mujhe Nabi (SAW) ke saath ghar mein mat dafnaana, kyunke mujhe pasand nahi ke mujhe muqaddas maana jaaye (sirf isliye ke mujhe wahaan dafn kiya gaya).' Hisham ke waalid bataate hain: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Aisha ke paas ek paighaam bheja, kehte hue, 'Kya aap mujhe apne do saathiyon (Nabi SAW aur Abu Bakr) ke saath dafn hone ki ijaazat denge?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan, Allah ki qasam.' Halaanke unki aadat thi ke agar Nabi (SAW) ke sahaaba mein se koi shaks unhein paighaam bhejta unhein wahaan dafn hone ki ijaazat maangte hue, wo kehti, 'Nahi, Allah ki qasam, main kisi ko bhi unke saath dafn hone ki ijaazat nahi doongi.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to perform the `Asr prayer and then one could reach the `Awali (a place in the outskirts of Medina) while the sun was still quite high. Narrated Yunus: The distance of the `Awali (from Medina) was four or three miles
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Asr ki namaz padhte the aur phir koi shaks Al-Awali (Madina ke bahaari ilaake mein ek jagah) tak pahunch sakta tha jabke suraj abhi kaafi ooncha hota. (Yunus bataate hain: Al-Awali ki (Madina se) doori chaar ya teen meel thi.)

e: Narrated As-Sa'ib bin Yazid:The Sa' (a kind of measure) during the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) used to be equal to the one Mudd (another kind of measure) and one third of a Mudd which we use today, but the Sa' of today has become large
hi: As-Sa'ib bin Yazid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ke daur mein Sa' (naapne ki ikaai) aaj ke ek Mudd aur ek-tihaai Mudd ke barabar thi jo hum aajkal istemaal karte hain, magar aaj ka Sa' bada ho gaya hai.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! Bestow Your Blessings on their measures, and bestow Your Blessings on their Sa' and Mudd." He meant those of the people of Medina
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Aye Allah! Inki (Madina waalon ki) naapne ki ikaaiyon par apni barkaten naazil kar, aur inke Sa' aur Mudd par apni barkaten naazil kar.' Unka ishara Madina ke logon ki taraf tha.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Jews brought a man and a woman who had committed illegal sexual intercourse, to the Prophet (ﷺ) and the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered them to be stoned to death, and they were stoned to death near the mosque where the biers used to be placed
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Yahudi ek mard aur ek khaatoon ko, jinhone zina kiya tha, Nabi (SAW) ke paas laaye, aur Nabi (SAW) ne hukm diya ke unhein sangsaar kiya jaaye, aur unhein Masjid ke qareeb sangsaar kiya gaya jahaan janaaze ki taboote rakhi jaati thi.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Mountain of Uhud came in sight of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who then said, "This is a mountain that loves us and is loved by us. O Allah! Abraham made Mecca a sanctuary and I make the area between its (Medina's) two mountains a sanctuary
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Uhud pahaad Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saamne aaya jinhone kaha, 'Ye ek pahaad hai jo humse mohabbat karti hai aur jise hum muhabbat karte hain. Aye Allah! Ibrahim ne Makkah ko panaah-gah banaaya, aur main iske (Madina ke) do pahaadon ke beech ki jagah ko panaah-gah banaata hoon.'

e: Narrated Sahl:The distance between the pulpit and the wall of the mosque on the side of the Qibla was just sufficient for a sheep to pass through
hi: Sahl bataate hain: Mimbar aur Masjid ki Qibla waali deewaar ke beech ki doori itni thi ke usmein se ek bakri guzar sakti thi.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Between my house and my pulpit there is a garden from one of the gardens of Paradise, and my pulpit is over my Lake-Tank. (Kauthar);
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Mere ghar aur mere mimbar ke beech Jannat ke baaghon mein se ek baagh hai, aur mera mimbar mere Hauz (Al-Kauthar) par hai.'

e: Narrated Nafi`:`Abdullah said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) arranged for a horse race, and the prepared horses were given less food for a few days before the race to win the race, and were allowed to run from Al-Hafya to Thaniyat-al- Wada`, and the unprepared horses were allowed to run between Thaniyat-al-Wada` and the mosque of Bani Zuraiq," `Abdullah was one of those who participated in the race
hi: Nafi' bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Nabi (SAW) ne ghudsawaari (ghodon ki daud) ka intezaam kiya, aur taiyaar ghodon ko daud jeetne ke liye kuch dinon tak kam khaana diya gaya, aur unhein Al-Hafya se Thaniyat-al-Wada tak daudne diya gaya, aur bin-taiyaar ghodon ko Thaniyat-al-Wada aur Banu Zuraiq ki Masjid ke beech daudne diya gaya.' Abdullah bhi un logon mein se ek the jinhone is daud mein hissa liya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:I heard `Umar (delivering a sermon) on the pulpit of the Prophet
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Umar ko (khutba dete) Nabi (SAW) ke mimbar par (khade hokar) sunaa.

e: Narrated As-Sa'ib bin Yazid:That he heard `Uthman bin `Affan delivering a sermon on the pulpit of the Prophet
hi: As-Sa'ib bin Yazid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke unhone Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Affan ko Nabi (SAW) ke mimbar par khutba dete suna.

e: Narrated `Aisha:This big copper vessel used to be put for me and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and we would take water from it together (on taking a bath)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ye bada taambe ka bartan mere aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke liye rakha jaata tha aur hum usmein se paani lete the ek saath (nahaate waqt).

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) brought the Ansar and the Quraish people into alliance in my house at Medina, and he invoked Allah for one month against the tribe of Bani Sulaim in (the last rak`a of each compulsory) prayer
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne mere ghar mein, Madina mein, Ansaar aur Quraish ke logon ke beech bhaichaare ka rishta qaayam kiya, aur unhone ek mahine tak Banu Sulaim qabeele ke khilaaf Allah se dua ki (har farz namaz ki aakhri rakat mein).

e: Narrated Abu Burda:When I arrived at Medina, `Abdullah bin Salam met me and said to me, "Accompany me to my house so that I may make you drink from a bowl from which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to drink, and that you may offer prayer in the mosque in which the Prophet (ﷺ) used to pray." I accompanied him, and he made me drink Sawiq and gave me dates to eat, and then I prayed in his mosque
hi: Abu Burda bataate hain: Jab main Madina pahuncha, Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Salam (رضی اللہ عنہ) mujhse mile aur mujhse kaha, 'Mere saath mere ghar chaliye taake main aapko us pyaale se piyla sakoon jismein se Allah ke Rasool (SAW) piya karte the, aur taake aap us Masjid mein namaz padh sakein jismein Nabi (SAW) namaz padha karte the.' Main unke saath gaya, aur unhone mujhe Sawiq (bhuni hui gehun ya jau ka sharbat) piya aur mujhe khajoor khaane diye, aur phir maine unki Masjid mein namaz padhi.

e: Narrated `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said to me, "Someone came to me tonight from my Lord while I was in the 'Aqiq (valley), and said to me, "Offer prayer in this blessed valley and say: 'Labbaik' for the (performance of) `Umra and Hajj
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne mujhse kaha, 'Aaj raat koi mere paas mere Rab se aaya jabke main Al-Aqiq (wadi) mein tha, aur mujhse kaha, "Is mubaarak wadi mein namaz padho aur kaho: ‘Labbaik’ Umra aur Hajj ke (ada karne ke) liye."'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Dinar:Ibn `Umar said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) fixed Qarn as the Miqat (for assuming the Ihram) for the people of Najd, and Al-Juhfa for the people of Sham, and Dhul-Hulaifa for the people of Medina." Ibn `Umar added, "I heard this from the Prophet, and I have been informed that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'The Miqat for the Yemenites is Yalamlam.' "When Iraq was mentioned, he said, "At that time it was not a Muslim country
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Dinar bataate hain: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Nabi (SAW) ne Najd ke logon ke liye Qarn ko Miqat (Ihram baandhne ki jagah) muqarrar kiya, aur Sham ke logon ke liye Al-Juhfa, aur Madina ke logon ke liye Dhul-Hulaifa.' Ibn Umar ne izaafa kiya, 'Maine ye Nabi (SAW) se suna, aur mujhe bataya gaya ke Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, "Yemen waalon ke liye Miqat Yalamlam hai."' Jab Iraq ka zikr hua, unhone kaha, 'Us waqt wo koi Musalmaan mulk nahi tha.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) had a dream in the last portion of the night when he was sleeping at Dhul-Hulaifa. (I n the dream) it was said to him, "You are in a blessed Batha' (i.e., valley)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne raat ke aakhri hisse mein ek khwaab dekha jabke wo Dhul-Hulaifa mein so rahe the. (Khwaab mein) unse kaha gaya, 'Tum ek mubaarak Batha (wadi) mein ho.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:That he heard the Prophet, after raising his head from the bowing in morning prayer, saying, "O Allah, our Lord! All the praises are for you." And in the last (rak`a) he said, "O Allah! Curse so-and-so and so--and-so." And then Allah revealed:-- 'Not for you (O Muhammad) is the decision, (but for Allah), whether He turns in mercy to them or punish them, for they are indeed wrongdoers
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke unhone Nabi (SAW) ko, Fajr ki namaz mein ruku se apna sar uthaane ke baad, ye kehte suna, 'Aye Allah, hamare Rab! Sab tareef tere liye hai.' Aur aakhri (rakat) mein unhone kaha, 'Aye Allah! Falaan-falaan par laanat bhej.' Aur phir Allah ne naazil kiya: 'Tumhaare liye (Aye Muhammad) koi ikhtiyaar nahi (balke Allah ke liye), chaahe wo unpar reham kare ya unhein saza de, kyunke wo waaqai zaalim hain...'

e: Narrated `Ali bin Abi Talib:That Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to him and Fatima the daughter of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) at their house at night and said, "Won't you pray?" `Ali replied, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Our souls are in the Hands of Allah and when he wants us to get up, He makes us get up." When `Ali said that to him, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) left without saying anything to him. While the Prophet (ﷺ) was leaving, `Ali heard him striking his thigh (with his hand) and saying, "But man is quarrelsome more than anything else
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bin Abi Talib bataate hain ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unke aur Fatima (Alayhas Salam), Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki beti, ke ghar raat ko aaye aur kaha, 'Kya tum namaz nahi padhte?' Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne jawab diya, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Hamaari jaanein Allah ke haathon mein hain, aur jab wo chahega hamein uthaayega, hum uthenge.' Jab Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne unse ye kaha, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unhein kuch kahe bagair chale gaye. Jab Nabi (SAW) jaa rahe the, Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne unhein apni jaangh par (haath se) thapthapaate aur ye kehte suna, 'Magar insaan sabse zyaada jhagdaalu hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:While we were in the mosque, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came out and said, "Let us proceed to the Jews." So we went out with him till we came to Bait-al-Midras. The Prophet (ﷺ) stood up there and called them, saying, "O assembly of Jews! Surrender to Allah (embrace Islam) and you will be safe!" They said, "You have conveyed Allah's message, O Aba-al-Qasim" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then said to them, "That is what I want; embrace Islam and you will be safe." They said, "You have conveyed the message, O Aba-al- Qasim." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then said to them, "That is what I want," and repeated his words for the third time and added, "Know that the earth is for Allah and I want to exile you from this land, so whoever among you has property he should sell it, otherwise, know that the land is for Allah and His Apostle
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab hum Masjid mein the, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) baahar aaye aur kaha, 'Chalo hum Yahudiyon ke paas chalein.' To hum unke saath chale yahaan tak ke hum Bait-al-Midras pahunche. Nabi (SAW) wahaan khade hue aur unhein bulaaya, kehte hue, 'Aye Yahudiyon ke giroh! Allah ke saamne surrender karo (Islam qubool karo) aur hifaazat mein raho!' Unhone kaha, 'Aapne Allah ka paighaam pahuncha diya, Aye Abal-Qasim.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne phir unse kaha, 'Yahi main chahta hoon; Islam qubool karo aur hifaazat mein raho.' Unhone kaha, 'Aapne paighaam pahuncha diya, Aye Abal-Qasim.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne phir unse kaha, 'Yahi main chahta hoon,' aur apne alfaaz teesri baar dohraaye aur izaafa kiya, 'Jaan lo ke zameen Allah ki hai aur main tumhein is zameen se jila-watan karna chahta hoon, isliye jo bhi tum mein se koi jaayadaad rakhta hai, wo use bech sakta hai, warna jaan lo ke zameen Allah aur uske Rasool ki hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Noah will be brought (before Allah) on the Day of Resurrection, and will be asked, 'Did you convey the message of Allah?" He will reply, 'Yes, O Lord.' And then Noah's nation will be asked, 'Did he (Noah) convey Allah's message to you?' They will reply, 'No warner came to us.' Then Noah will be asked, 'Who are your witnesses?' He will reply. '(My witnesses are) Muhammad and his followers.' Thereupon you (Muslims) will be brought and you will bear witness." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) recited: 'And thus We have made of you (Muslims) a just and the best nation, that you might be witness over the nations, and the Apostle a witness over you
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Nuh (Qayamat ke din Allah ke saamne) laaye jaayenge, aur unse pucha jaayega, "Kya tumne Allah ka paighaam pahuncha diya?" Wo jawab denge, "Haan, Aye Rab." Phir Nuh ki qaum se poocha jaayega, "Kya unhone (Nuh ne) tumhein Allah ka paighaam pahunchaaya?" Wo jawab denge, "Humaare paas koi chetaawani dene wala nahi aaya." Phir Nuh se pucha jaayega, "Tumhaare gawaah kaun hain?" Wo jawab denge, "(Mere gawaah) Muhammad aur unke maanne wale hain." Isper tumhein (Musalmaanon ko) laaya jaayega aur tum gawaahi doge.' Phir Nabi (SAW) ne padha: 'Aur isi tarah humne tumhein (Musalmaanon ko) ek insaaf-pasand aur behtareen ummat banaaya, taake tum doosri ummaton par gawaah bano, aur Rasool tumpar gawaah bane.'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri and Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent the brother of the tribe of Bani Adi Al-Ansari as governor of Khaibar. Then the man returned, bringing Janib (a good kind of date). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked him, "Are all the dates of Khaibar like that?" He replied, "No, by Allah, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We take one Sa' of these (good) dates for two Sas of mixed dates." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then said, "Do not do so. You should either take one Sa of this (kind) for one Sa' of the other; or sell one kind and then buy with its price the other kind (of dates), and you should do the same in weighing
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Banu Adi Al-Ansari qabeele ke ek bhai ko Khaibar ka hukmraan bhejwaaya. Phir wo shaks Janib (ek achhi qism ke khajoor) lekar wapas aaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse pucha, 'Kya Khaibar ke sab khajoor aise hi hain?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Nahi, Allah ki qasam, Aye Allah ke Rasool! Hum in (achhe) khajooron ka ek Sa' mile-jule khajooron ke do Sa' ke badle lete hain.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Aisa mat karo. Tumhein ya to ek qism ke ek Sa' ko doosri qism ke ek Sa' ke badle lena chaahiye; ya ek qism bech kar uski keemat se doosri qism khareedni chaahiye, aur wazan karte waqt bhi tumhein isi tarah karna chaahiye.'

e: Narrated `Amr bin Al-`As:That he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "If a judge gives a verdict according to the best of his knowledge and his verdict is correct (i.e. agrees with Allah and His Apostle's verdict) he will receive a double reward, and if he gives a verdict according to the best of his knowledge and his verdict is wrong, (i.e. against that of Allah and His Apostle) even then he will get a reward
hi: Amr bin Al-As (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, 'Agar koi qaazi apne poore ilm ke mutaabik faisla de aur uska faisla sahi ho (yaani Allah aur uske Rasool ke faisle se milta ho), to use dohra ajr milega, aur agar wo apne poore ilm ke mutaabik faisla de aur uska faisla galat ho (yaani Allah aur uske Rasool ke faisle ke khilaaf ho), to bhi use ek ajr milega.'

e: Narrated 'Ubai bin `Umar:Abu Musa asked permission to enter upon `Umar, but seeing that he was busy, he went away. `Umar then said, "Didn't I hear the voice of `Abdullah bin Qais? Allow him to come in." He was called in and `Umar said to him, "What made you do what you did." He replied, "We have been instructed thus by the Prophet" `Umar said, "Bring proof (witness) for this, other wise I will do so-and-so to you." Then `Abdullah bin Qais went to a gathering of the Ansar who then said, "None but the youngest of us will give the witness for it." So Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri got up and said, "We used to be instructed thus (by the Prophet)." `Umar said, "This tradition of the Prophet (ﷺ) remained hidden from me. Business in the market kept me busy
hi: Ubai bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Umar ke paas andar aane ki ijaazat maangi, magar unhein masroof dekh kar wo chale gaye. Umar ne phir kaha, 'Kya maine Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Qais ki aawaaz nahi suni? Unhein andar aane do.' Unhein bulwaaya gaya aur Umar ne unse kaha, 'Tumne jo kiya wo tumhein kis cheez ne karwaaya?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Humein Nabi (SAW) ne isi tarah hukm diya tha.' Umar ne kaha, 'Iska saboot (gawaah) laao, warna main tumhaare saath falaan-falaan karunga.' To Abdullah bin Qais Ansaar ki ek majlis mein gaye jinhone kaha, 'Hum mein se sabse jawaan hi iski gawaahi dega.' To Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) khade hue aur kaha, 'Humein isi tarah (Nabi SAW ke zariye) hukm diya jaata tha.' Umar ne kaha, 'Nabi (SAW) ki ye riwaayat mujhse chhupi rahi. Bazaar ka kaam-kaaj mujhe masroof rakhta tha.'

e: Narrated Al-A'raj:Abu Huraira said, "You people claim that Abu Huraira narrates many narrations of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). (Anyhow) with Allah will be our appointment. I was a poor man, and used to stick to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) contented with what will fill my stomach, and the Muhajirin (emigrants) used to be busy trading in the markets, and the Ansar used to be busy looking after their properties. One-day I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, 'Who will spread his Rida' (a garment covering the upper part of the body) till I finished my speech and then fold it, (i.e. wrap it over your body), in which case he will never forget anything he had heard from me." So I spread my garment which I was wearing; and by Him Who sent Muhammad with the Truth, ever since, I have never forgotten whatever I heard from him (the Prophet)" (See, Hadith No. 119, Vol)
hi: Al-A'raj bataate hain: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Tum log kehte ho ke Abu Huraira Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki bahut si riwaayaten bayaan karta hai. Beshak, hamaari mulaakaat Allah ke saath hogi. Main ek gareeb aadmi tha, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath rehta tha, apna pet bharne se santusht hokar, jabke Muhaajireen bazaaron mein tijaarat mein masroof rehte the aur Ansaar apni jaayadaadon ki dekhbhaal mein masroof rehte the. Ek din maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, "Kaun apni Rida (oopar odhne wala kapda) failaayega jab tak main apni baat khatam na kar loon, aur phir usse samet lega (yaani apne jism ke gird lapet lega), (aise shaks ke saath ye hoga ke) wo kabhi kuch nahi bhoolega jo usne mujhse suna."' To maine wo kapda failaaya jo main pehne hue tha; aur us Zaat ki qasam jisne Muhammad ko Haq ke saath bheja, tab se, maine kabhi wo nahi bhoola jo maine unse suna.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 119, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated Muhammad bin Al-Munkadir:I saw Jabir bin `Abdullah swearing by Allah that Ibn Sayyad was the Dajjal. I said to Jabir, "How can you swear by Allah?" Jabir said, "I have heard `Umar swearing by Allah regarding this matter in the presence of the Prophet (ﷺ) and the Prophet (ﷺ) did not disapprove of it
hi: Muhammad bin Al-Munkadir bataate hain: Maine Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko Allah ki qasam khaate hue sunaa ke Ibn Sayyad Ad-Dajjal hai. Maine Jabir se kaha, 'Aap Allah ki qasam kaise khaa sakte hain?' Jabir ne kaha, 'Maine Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko is maamle mein Allah ki qasam khaate hue Nabi (SAW) ki maujoodgi mein suna, aur Nabi (SAW) ne isse mana nahi kiya.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Horses may be used for three purposes: For a man they may be a source of reward (in the Hereafter); for another, a means of protection; and for another, a source of sin. The man for whom they are a source of reward, is the one who keeps them for Allah's Cause and ties them with long ropes and lets them graze in a pasture or garden. Whatever those long ropes allow them to eat of that pasture or garden, will be written as good deeds for him and if they break their ropes and run one or two rounds, then all their footsteps and dung will be written as good deeds for him, and if they pass a river and drink from it though he has had no intention of watering them, even then, that will be written as good deeds for him. So such horses are a source of reward for that man. For the man who keeps horses for his livelihood in order not to ask others for help or beg his bread, and at the same time he does not forget Allah's right of what he earns through them and of their backs (that he presents it to be used in Allah's Cause), such horses are a shelter for him (from poverty). For the man who keeps them just out of pride and for showing off, they are a source of sin." Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked about donkeys. He said, "Allah has not revealed anything to me regarding them except this comprehensive Verse: "Then anyone who has done good, equal to the weight of an atom (or a small ant) shall see it, and any one who has done evil, equal to the weight of an atom (or a small ant) shall see it
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ghode teen maqsad ke liye istemaal ho sakte hain: ek aadmi ke liye wo ajr ka zariya (Aakhirat mein) hote hain; doosre ke liye wo hifaazat ka zariya hote hain; aur teesre ke liye wo gunaah ka zariya hote hain. Jis aadmi ke liye wo ajr ka zariya hote hain, wo hai jo unhein Allah ki raah mein rakhta hai aur unhein lambi rassion se baandhta hai aur unhein charne ke liye ek chaargaah ya baag mein chhod deta hai. Wo lambi rassiyaan unhein chaargaah ya baag mein se jitna bhi khaane deti hain, wo sab uske liye nek amaal ke taur par likha jaayega, aur agar wo apni rassiyaan tod kar ek ya do chakkar bhaag lein, to unke sab qadmon ke nishaan aur unka gobar uske liye nek amaal ke taur par likha jaayega, aur agar wo kisi nadi se guzarein aur usme se peein, halaanke uska iraada unhein paani pilaane ka nahi tha, tab bhi ye uske liye nek amaal ke taur par likha jaayega. To aise ghode us aadmi ke liye ajr ka zariya hote hain. Jis aadmi ke liye wo apni rozi-roti ka zariya hote hain taake wo doosron se madad na maange ya bhikh na maange, aur us waqt wo unse kamaayi hui daulat mein Allah ka haq nahi bhoolta na unki peeth ka haq (yaani unhein Allah ki raah mein istemaal karne ke liye pesh karta hai), aise ghode uske liye ek panaah-gah hain (gareebi se). Jis aadmi ke liye wo sirf ghamand aur dikhaawe ke liye hote hain, wo uske liye gunaah ka zariya hain.' Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se gadhon ke baare mein pucha gaya. Unhone kaha, 'Allah ne mujhpar unke baare mein kuch naazil nahi kiya siwaaye is jaame Aayat ke: "Phir jo koi bhi ek zarre (ya chhoti chionti) jitna bhi achha amal karega, wo use dekhega, aur jo koi ek zarre jitna bura amal karega, wo bhi use dekhega."'

e: Narrated `Aisha:A woman asked the Prophet (Hadith 456). Narrated `Aisha: A woman asked the Prophet (ﷺ) about the periods: How to take a bath after the periods. He said, "Take a perfumed piece of cloth and clean yourself with it." She said,' "How shall I clean myself with it, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Clean yourself" She said again, "How shall I clean myself, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Clean yourself with it." Then I knew what Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) meant. So I pulled her aside and explained it to her
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ek khaatoon ne Nabi (SAW) se haiz (mahwaari) ke baare mein pucha: kaise haiz ke baad nahaya jaaye. Unhone kaha, 'Ek khushbudaar kapda lo aur usse apne aap ko saaf karo.' Usne pucha, 'Main usse kaise saaf karoon, Aye Allah ke Rasool?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Apne aap ko saaf karo.' Usne phir pucha, 'Main usse kaise saaf karoon, Aye Allah ke Rasool?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Usse apne aap ko saaf karo.' Phir mujhe pata chala Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka kya matlab tha. To maine usse ek taraf khainch liya aur usse tafseel se samjhaaya.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Um Hufaid bint Al-Harith bin Hazn presented the Prophet (ﷺ) with some butter, dried yoghurt (curd milk) and mastigures as a gift. The Prophet (ﷺ) then asked for a meal (mastigures etc. to be put) and it was eaten over his table cloth, but the Prophet (ﷺ) did not eat of it, as he had aversion to it. But if it had been illegal to eat, it would not have been eaten over his table cloth nor would he have ordered that (mastigures meat) to be eaten
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Umm Hufaid bint Al-Harith bin Hazn ne Nabi (SAW) ko kuch makkhan, sukhi hui dahi (curd), aur Mastigure (chhipkali jaisi jaanwar) tohfe mein diye. Nabi (SAW) ne phir khaana maangaa (Mastigure waghera taiyaar rakhe jaane ke liye) aur ye unke dastar-khwaan par khaaya gaya, magar Nabi (SAW) ne khud usmein se nahi khaaya kyunke unhein isse nafrat thi. Magar agar ye khaana na-jaayez hota, to na to unke dastar-khwaan par khaaya jaata na hi wo (Mastigure ka gosht) khaane ka hukm dete.

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever has eaten garlic or onion, should keep away from us, or should keep away from our mosque and should stay at home." Ibn Wahb said, "Once a plate full of cooked vegetables was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) at Badr. Detecting a bad smell from it, he asked about the dish and was informed of the kinds of vegetables in contained. He then said, "Bring it near," and so it was brought near to one of his companions who was with him. When the Prophet (ﷺ) saw it, he disliked eating it and said (to his companion), "Eat, for I talk in secret to ones whom you do not talk to
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi lehsun ya pyaaz khaaye, use hamse door rehna chaahiye, ya hamaari Masjid se door rehna chaahiye aur apne ghar mein rehna chaahiye.' Ibn Wahb ne kaha, 'Ek baar pakayi hui sabziyon se bhari ek thaali Nabi (SAW) ke paas Badr mein laayi gayi. Usmein se buri khushbu paate hue, unhone dish ke baare mein pucha aur unhein bataaya gaya ke isme kaunsi sabziyaan hain. Unhone phir kaha, "Ise qareeb laao," aur wo apne ek saathi ke paas laayi gayi jo unke saath tha. Jab Nabi (SAW) ne use dekha, unhein isse khaana napasand aaya aur unhone (apne saathi se) kaha, "Khaao, kyunke main un logon se chupke se baat karta hoon jinse tum baat nahi karte."'

e: Narrated Jubair bin Mut`im:A lady came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and she talked to him about something, and he gave her some order. She said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! If I should not find you?" He said, "If you should not find me, then go to Abu Bakr." Ibrahim bin Sa`d said, "As if she meant the death (of the Prophet)
hi: Jubair bin Mut'im bataate hain: Ek khaatoon Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur unse kisi baare mein baat ki, aur unhone use ek hukm diya. Usne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Agar main aapko na paaun to?' Unhone kaha, 'Agar tumhein main na milun, to Abu Bakr ke paas jaana.' Ibrahim bin Sa'd ne kaha, 'Jaise ke uska matlab Nabi (SAW) ki wafat se tha.'

e: Narrated Humaid bin 'Abdur-Rahman that he heard Mu'awiya talking to a group of people from Quraish at Al-Madina, and on mentioning Ka'b Al-Ashbar, he said, "He was one of the most truthful of those who used to talk about the people of the Scripture, yet we used to detect certain faults in his information
hi: Humaid bin Abdur Rahman bataate hain ke unhone Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko Quraish qabeele ke ek giroh se Madina mein baat karte suna, aur Ka'b Al-Ashbar ka zikr karte hue, unhone kaha, 'Wo un sabse sachche logon mein se ek the jo Ahl-e-Kitaab ke baare mein baat karte the, phir bhi hum unki maloomaat mein kuch khaamiyaan paate the.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The people of the Book used to read the Torah in Hebrew and then explain it in Arabic to the Muslims. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said (to the Muslims). "Do not believe the people of the Book, nor disbelieve them, but say, 'We believe in Allah and whatever is revealed to us, and whatever is revealed to you
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ahl-e-Kitaab Taurat Ibrani zubaan mein padhte the aur phir use Arbi mein Musalmaanon ko samjhaate the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (Musalmaanon se) kaha, 'Ahl-e-Kitaab ko na maano, na unhein jhutlaao, balke kaho, "Hum Allah par Iman rakhte hain aur jo bhi humpar naazil kiya gaya, aur jo bhi tumpar naazil kiya gaya."'

e: Narrated Ubaidullah:Ibn `Abbas said, "Why do you ask the people of the scripture about anything while your Book (Qur'an) which has been revealed to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) is newer and the latest? You read it pure, undistorted and unchanged, and Allah has told you that the people of the scripture (Jews and Christians) changed their scripture and distorted it, and wrote the scripture with their own hands and said, 'It is from Allah,' to sell it for a little gain. Does not the knowledge which has come to you prevent you from asking them about anything? No, by Allah, we have never seen any man from them asking you regarding what has been revealed to you
hi: Ubaidullah bataate hain: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Tum Ahl-e-Kitaab se kisi bhi baat ke baare mein kyun poochte ho jabke tumhaari khud ki Kitaab (Quran), jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) par naazil hui hai, sabse nayi aur sabse aakhri hai? Tum ise saaf, gair-tehrif-shuda, aur badal na jaane wali padhte ho, aur Allah ne tumhein bataya hai ke Ahl-e-Kitaab (Yahudi aur Isaai) ne apni Kitaab badal di aur use tehrif kiya, aur apne haathon se Kitaab likhi aur kaha, "Ye Allah ki taraf se hai," taake thodi si kamaayi ke badle ise bech sakein. Kya jo ilm tumhaare paas aa gaya hai wo tumhein unse kuch bhi poochne se nahi rokta? Nahi, Allah ki qasam, humne kabhi unmein se kisi ko tumse ye poochte nahi dekha jo tumpar naazil hua hai.'

e: Narrated Jundab bin `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Recite (and study) the Qur'an as long as you are in agreement as to its interpretation and meanings, but when you have differences regarding its interpretation and meanings, then you should stop reciting it (for the time being.) (See Hadith No 581, Vol)
hi: Jundab bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Quran padho (aur padhaao) jab tak tum uski tafseer aur maanon par raazi ho, magar jab tumhaare beech uski tafseer aur maanon par ikhtelaaf ho, to (kuch waqt ke liye) padhna band kar do.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 581, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated Jundab bin `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Recite (and study) the Qur'an as long as your hearts are in agreement as to its meanings, but if you have differences as regards its meaning, stop reading it then
hi: Jundab bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Quran padho (aur padhaao) jab tak tumhaare dil uske maanon par raazi hon, magar agar tumhaare beech uske maani mein ikhtelaaf ho, to tab padhna band kar do.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When the time of the death of the Prophet (ﷺ) approached while there were some men in the house, and among them was `Umar bin Al-Khatttab, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Come near let me write for you a writing after which you will never go astray." `Umar said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) is seriously ill, and you have the Qur'an, so Allah's Book is sufficient for us." The people in the house differed and disputed. Some of them said, "Come near so that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) may write for you a writing after which you will not go astray," while some of them said what `Umar said. When they made much noise and differed greatly before the Prophet, he said to them, "Go away and leave me." Ibn `Abbas used to say, "It was a great disaster that their difference and noise prevented Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) from writing that writing for them
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Nabi (SAW) ki wafat ka waqt qareeb aaya jabke ghar mein kuch log the, jinmein Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab bhi the, Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Qareeb aao taake main tumhaare liye ek likhawat likhoon jiske baad tum kabhi bhatakoge nahi.' Umar ne kaha, 'Nabi (SAW) sakht bimar hain, aur tumhaare paas Quran hai, isliye Allah ki Kitaab hamare liye kaafi hai.' Ghar mein logon mein ikhtelaaf hua aur wo behas karne lage. Kuch ne kaha, 'Qareeb aao taake Allah ke Rasool (SAW) tumhaare liye ek likhawat likhein jiske baad tum bhatakoge nahi,' jabke kuch ne wahi kaha jo Umar ne kaha. Jab unhone Nabi (SAW) ke saamne bahut shor aur ikhtelaaf kiya, unhone unse kaha, 'Chale jaao aur mujhe akela chhod do.' Ibn Abbas kaha karte the, 'Ye ek bada haadsa tha ke unke ikhtelaaf aur shor ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko wo likhawat likhne se roka.'

e: Narrated Ata:I heard Jabir bin `Abdullah in a gathering saying, "We, the companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) assumed the state of Ihram to perform only Hajj without `Umra." Jabir added, "The Prophet (ﷺ) arrived (at Mecca) on the fourth of Dhul-Hijja. And when we arrived (in Mecca) the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered us to finish the state of Ihram, saying, "Finish your Ihram and go to your wives (for sexual relation)." Jabir added, "The Prophet did not oblige us (to go to our wives) but he only made that legal for us. Then he heard that we were saying, "When there remains only five days between us and the Day of `Arafat he orders us to finish our Ihram by sleeping with our wives in which case we will proceed to `Arafat with our male organs dribbling with semen?' (Jabir pointed out with his hand illustrating what he was saying). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up and said, 'You (People) know that I am the most Allah-fearing, the most truthful and the best doer of good deeds (pious) from among you. If I had not brought the Hadi with me, I would have finished my Ihram as you will do, so finish your Ihram. If I had formerly known what I came to know lately, I would not have brought the Hadi with me.' So we finished our Ihram and listened to the Prophet (ﷺ) and obeyed him." (See Hadith No. 713, Vol)
hi: Ata bataate hain: Maine Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko ek majlis mein ye kehte suna, 'Hum, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke sahaaba, sirf Hajj ke liye Ihram baandhte, Umra ke bina.' Jabir ne izaafa kiya, 'Nabi (SAW) Zul-Hijja ki chauthi taareekh ko (Makkah) pahunche. Aur jab hum pahunche, Nabi (SAW) ne humein hukm diya ke hum apna Ihram khatam karein, kehte hue, "Apna Ihram khatam karo aur apni biwiyon ke paas jaao (unke saath humbistari karne ke liye)."' Jabir ne izaafa kiya, 'Nabi (SAW) ne humein aisa karna majboor nahi kiya, balke unhone sirf humein iski ijaazat di. Phir unhone suna ke hum keh rahe the, "Jab hamare aur Arafat ke din ke beech sirf paanch din bache hain, wo humein apni biwiyon ke saath sokar apna Ihram khatam karne ka hukm dete hain, jispar hum Arafat ki taraf badhenge jabke hamaare aang se meni tapak rahi hogi?" (Jabir ne apne haath se ishara kiya ke wo kya keh rahe the.) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khade hue aur kaha, "Tum (log) jaante ho ke main tum mein sabse zyaada Allah se darne wala, sabse sachcha, aur sabse behtareen nek amaal karne wala (parhezgaar) hoon. Agar mere saath Hadi (qurbaani ka jaanwar) na hota, to main apna Ihram tumhaare jaisa khatam karta, isliye apna Ihram khatam karo. Agar mujhe pehle wo pata hota jo mujhe baad mein pata chala, to main apne saath Hadi na laata." To humne apna Ihram khatam kiya aur Nabi (SAW) ki baat suni aur unki farmaanbardaari ki.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 713, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated `Abdullah Al Muzam:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Perform (an optional) prayer before Maghrib prayer." (He repeated it thrice) and the third time he said, "Whoever wants to offer it can do so," lest the people should take it as a Sunna (tradition). (See Hadith No. 277, Vol)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Muzam bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Maghrib ki namaz se pehle (nafl) namaz padho.' (Unhone ise teen baar dohraaya) aur teesri baar unhone kaha, 'Jo koi chaahe wo padh sakta hai,' is dar se ke log isse Sunnat (zaroori riwaayat) na samajh lein. (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 277, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated `Aisha:After the slanderers had given a forged statement against her, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) called `Ali bin Abi Talib and Usama bin Zaid when the Divine Inspiration was delayed. He wanted to ask them and consult them about the question of divorcing me. Usama gave his evidence that was based on what he knew about my innocence, but `Ali said, "Allah has not put restrictions on you and there are many women other than her. Furthermore you may ask the slave girl who will tell you the truth." So the Prophet (ﷺ) asked Barira (my salve girl), "Have you seen anything that may arouse your suspicion?" She replied, "I have not seen anything more than that she is a little girl who sleeps, leaving the dough of her family (unguarded) that the domestic goats come and eat it." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) stood on the pulpit and said, "O Muslims! Who will help me against the man who has harmed me by slandering my wife? By Allah, I know nothing about my family except good." The narrator added: Then the Prophet (ﷺ) mentioned the innocence of `Aisha. (See Hadith No. 274, Vol)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab bohtaan lagaane walon ne unke khilaaf jhoota ilzaam lagaaya, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ali (Alayhis Salam) bin Abi Talib aur Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko bulwaaya jab Ilaahi Wahi der se aa rahi thi. Wo unse mashwara karna chahte the, mujhe talaaq dene ke sawaal ke baare mein. Usama ne apni gawaahi di jo unhein meri paakeezgi ke baare mein pata tha uske aadhaar par, magar Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha, 'Allah ne aappar koi rukaawat nahi lagaayi hai, aur unke ilaawa bhi bahut si khawaateen hain. Isse zyaada, aap launDi se poochh sakte hain jo aapko sach batayegi.' To Nabi (SAW) ne Barira (رضی اللہ عنہا) (meri launDi) se pucha, 'Kya tumne kuch aisa dekha hai jo tumhein shakki bana de?' Usne jawab diya, 'Maine kuch nahi dekha siwaaye is ke ke wo ek chhoti ladki hai jo apne khaandaan ka aata (unrakshit) chhodkar so jaati hai jise ghareli bakriyaan aakar khaa leti hain.' Phir Nabi (SAW) mimbar par khade hue aur kaha, 'Aye Musalmaano! Kaun mere saath us aadmi ke khilaaf khada hoga jisne mere biwi par bohtaan lagaakar mujhe takleef pahunchaayi hai? Allah ki qasam, main apne khaandaan ke baare mein achhaai ke ilaawa kuch nahi jaanta.' Ravi ne izaafa kiya: Phir Nabi (SAW) ne Aisha ki paakeezgi ka zikr kiya. (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 274, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) addressed the people, and after praising and glorifying Allah, he said, "What do you suggest me regarding those people who are abusing my wife? I have never known anything bad about her." The sub-narrator, `Urwa, said: When `Aisha was told of the slander, she said, "O Allah's Apostle! Will you allow me to go to my parents' home?" He allowed her and sent a slave along with her. An Ansari man said, "Subhanaka! It is not right for us to speak about this. Subhanaka! This is a great lie
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne logon se khitaab kiya, aur Allah ki tareef aur tasbeeh karne ke baad, unhone kaha, 'Un logon ke baare mein tumhaari kya raay hai jo meri biwi par bohtaan lagaa rahe hain? Maine kabhi unke baare mein koi buri baat nahi jaani.' Urwa (doosre ravi) ne kaha: Jab Aisha ko is bohtaan ke baare mein bataaya gaya, unhone kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya aap mujhe apne maa-baap ke ghar jaane ki ijaazat denge?' Unhone unhein ijaazat di aur unke saath ek ghulaam bheja. Ek Ansaari shaks ne kaha, 'Subhanaka! Humein iske baare mein baat karna theek nahi. Subhanaka! Ye ek bada jhoot hai.'

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas (ra):The Prophet (ﷺ) sent Mu'adh to Yemen
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne Mu'adh ko Yemen bheja.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When the Prophet (ﷺ) sent Mu`adh to Yemen, he said to him, "You are going to a nation from the people of the Scripture, so let the first thing to which you will invite them, be the Tauhid of Allah. If they learn that, tell them that Allah has enjoined on them, five prayers to be offered in one day and one night. And if they pray, tell them that Allah has enjoined on them Zakat of their properties and it is to be taken from the rich among them and given to the poor. And if they agree to that, then take from them Zakat but avoid the best property of the people
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Nabi (SAW) ne Mu'adh ko Yemen bheja, unhone unse kaha, 'Tum Ahl-e-Kitaab ki ek qaum ke paas jaa rahe ho, isliye sabse pehli cheez jiski taraf tum unhein bulaao, Allah ka Tauheed (ekeshvarwaad) honi chaahiye. Agar wo ye seekh lein, to unhein bataao ke Allah ne unpar din-raat mein paanch namazein farz ki hain. Aur agar wo namaz padhne lagein, to unhein bataao ke Allah ne unki jaayadaad par Zakat farz ki hai jo unmein se daulatmandon se li jaayegi aur gareebon ko di jaayegi. Aur agar wo isper raazi ho jaayein, to unse Zakat lo magar unki behtareen jaayadaad lene se bacho.'

e: Narrated Mu`adh bin Jabal:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Mu`adh! Do you know what Allah's Right upon His slaves is?" I said, "Allah and His Apostle know best." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "To worship Him (Allah) Alone and to join none in worship with Him (Allah). Do you know what their right upon Him is?" I replied, "Allah and His Apostle know best." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Not to punish them (if they do so)
hi: Mu'adh bin Jabal (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Aye Mu'adh! Kya tumhein pata hai Allah ka apne bandon par kya haq hai?' Maine kaha, 'Allah aur uska Rasool behtar jaante hain.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Uski (yaani Allah ki) akele ibaadat karna aur uske saath kisi ko shareek na karna. Kya tumhein pata hai unka (bandon ka) uspar (Allah par) kya haq hai?' Maine jawab diya, 'Allah aur uska Rasool behtar jaante hain.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Unhein saza na dena (agar wo aisa karein).'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:A man heard another man reciting (in the prayers): 'Say (O Muhammad): "He is Allah, the One." (112.1) And he recited it repeatedly. When it was morning, he went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and informed him about that as if he considered that the recitation of that Sura by itself was not enough. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "By Him in Whose Hand my life is, it is equal to one-third of the Qur'an
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks ne doosre shaks ko namaz mein padhte suna: 'Kaho (Aye Muhammad): "Wo Allah hai, Akela."' (112:1) Aur wo isse baar-baar padh raha tha. Jab subah hui, wo Nabi (SAW) ke paas gaya aur unhein iske baare mein bataya jaise wo samajh raha ho ke sirf isi Surah ki tilaawat kaafi nahi hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, ye Quran ke ek-tihaai hisse ke barabar hai.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) sent (an army unit) under the command of a man who used to lead his companions in the prayers and would finish his recitation with (the Sura 112): 'Say (O Muhammad): "He is Allah, the One." ' (112.1) When they returned (from the battle), they mentioned that to the Prophet. He said (to them), "Ask him why he does so." They asked him and he said, "I do so because it mentions the qualities of the Beneficent and I love to recite it (in my prayer)." The Prophet; said (to them), "Tell him that Allah loves him
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ne (ek fauji dasta) ek shaks ki sardaari mein bheja jo apne saathiyon ko namaz padhaate the aur apni tilaawat (112:1) 'Kaho (Aye Muhammad): "Wo Allah hai, Akela"' padhkar khatam karte the. Jab wo wapas aaye (jang se), unhone ye baat Nabi (SAW) ko bataayi. Nabi (SAW) ne (unse) kaha, 'Unse pucho wo aisa kyun karte hain.' Unhone unse pucha aur usne kaha, 'Main aisa isliye karta hoon kyunke isme Rehmaan (Allah) ki khoobiyon ka zikr hai aur mujhe isse (apni namaz mein) padhna pasand hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne (unse) kaha, 'Unhein bataao ke Allah unse mohabbat karta hai.'

e: Narrated Jarir bin `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah will not be merciful to those who are not merciful to mankind
hi: Jarir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah unpar reham nahi karega jo insaaniyat par reham nahi karte.'

e: Narrated Usama bin Zaid:We were with the Prophet (ﷺ) when suddenly there came to him a messenger from one of his daughters who was asking him to come and see her son who was dying. The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to the messenger), "Go back and tell her that whatever Allah takes is His, and whatever He gives is His, and everything with Him has a limited fixed term (in this world). So order her to be patient and hope for Allah's reward." But she sent the messenger to the Prophet (ﷺ) again, swearing that he should come to her. So the Prophet got up, and so did Sa`d bin 'Ubada and Mu`adh bin Jabal (and went to her). When the child was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) his breath was disturbed in his chest as if it were in a water skin. On that the eyes of the Prophet (ﷺ) became flooded with tears, whereupon Sa`d said to him, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What is this?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "This is mercy which Allah has put in the heart of His slaves, and Allah bestows His mercy only on those of His slaves who are merciful (to others)
hi: Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Nabi (SAW) ke saath the jab achaanak unki ek beti se ek qaasid aaya, unse ye kehne ke liye ke wo aakar unke bete ko dekhein jo mar raha tha. Nabi (SAW) ne (qaasid se) kaha, 'Wapas jaao aur unhein bataao ke jo bhi Allah leta hai wo uska hai, aur jo bhi wo deta hai wo uska hai, aur Allah ke paas har cheez ka ek muqarrar waqt hai (is duniya mein). Isliye unhein sabra rakhne aur Allah ke ajr ki ummeed rakhne ka hukm do.' Magar unhone phir qaasid ko Nabi (SAW) ke paas bheja, qasam khaate hue ke unhein aana hi hoga. To Nabi (SAW) uthe, aur unke saath Sa'd bin Ubada (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Mu'adh bin Jabal (رضی اللہ عنہ) bhi (unke paas gaye). Jab bacche ko Nabi (SAW) ke paas laaya gaya, uski saans uske seene mein aise bhatak rahi thi jaise wo ek mashk (paani ka thaila) ho. Isper Nabi (SAW) ki aankhein aansuon se bhar gayi, jispar Sa'd ne unse kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Ye kya hai?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Ye reham hai jo Allah ne apne bandon ke dilon mein daala hai, aur Allah apni ye rehmat sirf un bandon par karta hai jo (doosron par) reham karte hain.'

e: Narrated Abu Musa Al-Ash`ari:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "None is more patient than Allah against the harmful and annoying words He hears (from the people): They ascribe children to Him, yet He bestows upon them health and provision
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ashari bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Koi bhi Allah se zyaada sabra karne wala nahi hai un dukhad aur takleef-deh baaton par jo wo (logon se) sunta hai: Wo Allah ki taraf bacche mansub karte hain, phir bhi wo unhein sehat aur rozi ata karta hai.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The keys of the unseen are five and none knows them but Allah: (1) None knows (the sex) what is in the womb, but Allah: (2) None knows what will happen tomorrow, but Allah; (3) None knows when it will rain, but Allah; (4) None knows where he will die, but Allah (knows that); (5) and none knows when the Hour will be established, but Allah
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ghaib ki chaabiyaan paanch hain, aur unhein Allah ke siwa koi nahi jaanta: (1) Koi nahi jaanta (jins) jo garbh mein hai, siwaaye Allah ke; (2) koi nahi jaanta kal kya hoga, siwaaye Allah ke; (3) koi nahi jaanta kab baarish hogi, siwaaye Allah ke; (4) koi nahi jaanta wo kahaan marega, siwaaye Allah ke (jo ye jaanta hai); (5) aur koi nahi jaanta Qayamat kab aayegi, siwaaye Allah ke.'

e: Narrated Masruq:`Aisha said, "If anyone tells you that Muhammad has seen his Lord, he is a liar, for Allah says: 'No vision can grasp Him.' (6.103) And if anyone tells you that Muhammad has seen the Unseen, he is a liar, for Allah says: "None has the knowledge of the Unseen but Allah
hi: Masruq bataate hain: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha, 'Agar koi tumse kahe ke Muhammad ne apne Rab ko dekha hai, to wo jhoot bolta hai, kyunke Allah farmaata hai: "Koi bhi drishti usse pakad nahi sakti."' (6:103) 'Aur agar koi tumse kahe ke Muhammad ne Ghaib dekha hai, to wo jhoot bolta hai, kyunke Allah farmaata hai: "Ghaib ka ilm Allah ke siwa kisi ko nahi."'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:We used to pray behind the Prophet (ﷺ) and used to say: "As-Salamu 'Al-Allah. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah himself is As-Salam (Name of Allah), so you should say: 'at-Tahiyatu lil-lahi was-sala-watu wattaiyibatu, as-salamu `alaika aiyyuha-n-nabiyyu wa rahmatu-l-lahi wa barakatuhu, as-salamu `alaina wa `ala `ibadi-l-lahi as-salihin. Ashhadu an la ilaha il-lallah, wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan `abduhu wa rasuluhu
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Nabi (SAW) ke peechhe namaz padha karte the aur kehte the: 'As-Salamu Al-Allah (salaam Allah par ho).' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Allah khud As-Salam hai (Allah ka ek naam), isliye tumhein kehna chaahiye: "At-Tahiyatu lil-lahi was-sala-watu wattaiyibatu, as-salamu Alaika aiyyuha-n-nabiyyu wa rahmatu-l-lahi wa barakatuhu, as-salamu Alaina wa Ala ibadi-l-lahi as-salihin. Ashhadu an la ilaha il-lallah, wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan Abduhu wa rasuluhu."'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "On the Day of Resurrection Allah will hold the whole earth and fold the heaven with His right hand and say, 'I am the King: where are the kings of the earth?
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Qayamat ke din Allah poori zameen ko pakdega aur aasman ko apne daaen haath se lapetega aur kahega, "Main Baadshah hoon, zameen ke baadshaah kahaan hain?"'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to say, "I seek refuge (with YOU) by Your 'Izzat, None has the right to be worshipped but You Who does not die while the Jinns and the human beings die
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) kaha karte the, 'Main teri izzat (mahaanata, buzurgi) ki panaah leta hoon, jiske siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi, jo kabhi nahi marta, jabke Jinn aur insaan marte hain.'

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "(The people will be thrown into Hell ( Fire) and it will keep on saying, 'Is there any more?' till the Lord of the worlds puts His Foot over it, whereupon its different sides will come close to each other, and it will say, 'Qad! Qad! (enough! enough!) By Your 'Izzat (Honor and Power) and YOUR KARAM (Generosity)!' Paradise will remain spacious enough to accommodate more people until Allah will create some more people and let them dwell in the superfluous space of Paradise
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, '(Logon ko Jahannam ki Aag mein daala jaayega aur wo kehti rahegi, "Kya aur bhi hai?" jab tak Rab-ul-Aalameen apna Qadam usmein na rakhe, jispar uske alag-alag hisse ek doosre ke qareeb aa jaayenge, aur wo kahegi, "Bas! Bas! Teri izzat (buzurgi) aur teri fayaazi ki qasam!" Jannat itni khuli-khuli rahegi ke usme aur logon ki gunjaaish rahegi jab tak Allah kuch aur log paida na kare aur unhein Jannat ki bachi jagah mein na basaaye.'

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to invoke Allah at night, saying, "O Allah: All the Praises are for You: You are the Lord of the Heavens and the Earth. All the Praises are for You; You are the Maintainer of the Heaven and the Earth and whatever is in them. All the Praises are for You; You are the Light of the Heavens and the Earth. Your Word is the Truth, and Your Promise is the Truth, and the Meeting with You is the Truth, and Paradise is the Truth, and the (Hell) Fire is the Truth, and the Hour is the Truth. O Allah! I surrender myself to You, and I believe in You and I depend upon You, and I repent to You and with You (Your evidences) I stand against my opponents, and to you I leave the judgment (for those who refuse my message). O Allah! Forgive me my sins that I did in the past or will do in the future, and also the sins I did in secret or in public. You are my only God (Whom I worship) and there is no other God for me (i.e. I worship none but You)." Narrated Sufyan: (regarding the above narration) that the Prophet (ﷺ) added, "You are the Truth, and Your Word is the Truth
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) raat mein Allah se ye dua kiya karte the, 'Aye Allah! Sab tareef tere liye hai; Tu Aasmaan aur Zameen ka Rab hai. Sab tareef tere liye hai; Tu Aasmaan aur Zameen aur unmein jo kuch hai uska Sambhaalne wala hai. Sab tareef tere liye hai; Tu Aasmaan aur Zameen ka Noor hai. Tera Farmaan Haq hai, aur Tera Waada Haq hai, aur Tujhse Mulaqaat Haq hai, aur Jannat Haq hai, aur (Jahannam ki) Aag Haq hai, aur Qayamat Haq hai. Aye Allah! Main tere saamne khud ko supurd karta hoon, aur main tujhpar Iman rakhta hoon aur tujhpar bharosa karta hoon, aur tere paas tauba karta hoon aur tere saath (teri daleelon ke zariye) apne mukhaalifon ke khilaaf khada hota hoon, aur tere hi paas main faisla chhodta hoon (unke liye jo mera paighaam thukraate hain). Aye Allah! Mujhe mere gunaah maaf kar de jo maine ateet mein kiye ya mustaqbil mein karunga, aur wo bhi jo maine chupke se ya khule aam kiye. Tu hi mera akela Ma'bood hai (jiski main ibaadat karta hoon) aur mere liye koi doosra Khuda nahi hai (yaani main tere siwa kisi ki ibaadat nahi karta).' Sufyan bataate hain (upar wali riwaayat ke baare mein) ke Nabi (SAW) ne izaafa kiya, 'Tu Haq hai, aur Tera Farmaan Haq hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Musa:We were with the Prophet (ﷺ) on a journey, and whenever we ascended a high place, we used to say, "Allahu Akbar." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Don't trouble yourselves too much! You are not calling a deaf or an absent person, but you are calling One Who Hears, Sees, and is very near." Then he came to me while I was saying in my heart, "La hawla wala quwwatta illa billah (There is neither might nor power but with Allah)." He said, to me, "O `Abdullah bin Qais! Say, 'La hawla wala quwwata illa billah (There is neither might nor power but with Allah), for it is one of the treasures of Paradise." Or said, "Shall I tell you of it?
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Nabi (SAW) ke saath ek safar mein the, aur jab bhi hum ek oonchi jagah chadhte, hum 'Allahu Akbar' kehte the. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Apne aap ko itni takleef mat do! Tum kisi bahre ya door hue shaks ko nahi pukaar rahe, balke tum Us Zaat ko pukaar rahe ho jo Sunta hai, Dekhta hai, aur bahut qareeb hai.' Phir wo mere paas aaye jabke main apne dil mein keh raha tha, 'La hawla wala quwwata illa billah (Koi taaqat aur qudrat nahi siwaaye Allah ke).' Unhone mujhse kaha, 'Aye Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Qais! Kaho, "La hawla wala quwwata illa billah," kyunke ye Jannat ke khazaanon mein se ek hai,' ya kaha, 'Kya main tumhein iske baare mein bataun?'
