e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:Abu Bakr As-Siddiq said to the Prophet (ﷺ) "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Teach me an invocation with which I may invoke Allah in my prayers." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Say: O Allah! I have wronged my soul very much (oppressed myself), and none forgives the sins but You; so please bestow Your Forgiveness upon me. No doubt, You are the Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Bakr As-Siddiq ne Nabi (SAW) se kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe koi dua sikhaiye jise main apni namaz mein Allah se maang sakoon.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Kaho: Aye Allah! Maine apni jaan par bahut zulm kiya hai, aur gunaahon ko sirf Tu hi maaf karta hai; isliye barah-e-meharbaani mujhpar apni maafi ata kar. Beshak, Tu bahut zyaada maaf karne wala, bahut meharbaan hai.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Gabriel called me and said, 'Allah has heard the statement of your people and what they replied to you
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Jibrael ne mujhe pukaara aur kaha, "Allah ne teri qaum ki baat suni hai aur jo unhone tumhein jawab diya hai."'

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:As-Salami: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to teach his companions to perform the prayer of Istikhara for each and every matter just as he used to teach them the Suras from the Qur'an He used to say, "If anyone of you intends to do something, he should offer a two rak`at prayer other than the compulsory prayers, and after finishing it, he should say: O Allah! I consult You, for You have all knowledge, and appeal to You to support me with Your Power and ask for Your Bounty, for You are able to do things while I am not, and You know while I do not; and You are the Knower of the Unseen. O Allah If You know It this matter (name your matter) is good for me both at present and in the future, (or in my religion), in my this life and in the Hereafter, then fulfill it for me and make it easy for me, and then bestow Your Blessings on me in that matter. O Allah! If You know that this matter is not good for me in my religion, in my this life and in my coming Hereafter (or at present or in the future), then divert me from it and choose for me what is good wherever it may be, and make me be pleased with it." (See Hadith No. 391, Vol)
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) As-Salami bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apne sahaaba ko har maamle mein Istikhara ki namaz padhna sikhaate the, jaise wo unhein Quran ki Surahen sikhaate the. Wo kaha karte the, 'Agar tum mein se koi kuch karne ka iraada rakhta hai, to use farz namaz ke ilaawa do rakat namaz padhni chaahiye, aur use khatam karne ke baad, use kehna chaahiye: "Aye Allah! Main tujhse mashwara maangta hoon, kyunke tujhe har ilm hai, aur main tujhse apni madad ki apeal karta hoon apni taaqat se, aur tujhse apni fayaazi maangta hoon, kyunke tu sab kuch kar sakta hai jabke main nahi kar sakta, aur tu jaanta hai jabke main nahi jaanta; aur tu Ghaib ka Jaanne wala hai. Aye Allah! Agar tu jaanta hai ke ye maamla (apne maamle ka naam lo) mere liye achha hai, mere is duniya aur Aakhirat mein (ya mere deen mein), is zindagi mein aur Aakhirat mein, to ise mere liye poora kar aur mere liye aasaan bana, aur phir usme mujhpar apni barkaten naazil kar. Aye Allah! Agar tu jaanta hai ke ye maamla mere deen ke liye achha nahi hai, is duniya aur aane wali Aakhirat mein (ya abhi ya mustaqbil mein), to mujhe isse door kar aur mere liye jo bhi achha ho use chun le, jahaan bhi wo ho, aur mujhe usse raazi kar de."' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 391, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) frequently used to swear, "No, by the One Who turns the hearts
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) aksar qasam khaaya karte the, 'Nahi, Us Zaat ki qasam jo dilon ko phera deta hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah has ninety-nine Names, one-hundred less one; and he who memorized them all by heart will enter Paradise." To count something means to know it by heart
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah ke ninety-nine (nirninav) naam hain, sau mein se ek kam; aur jo koi unhein poora dil se yaad kare, wo Jannat mein daakhil hoga.' (Kisi cheez ko 'girna' ka matlab hai use dil se jaanana.)

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When anyone of you goes to bed, he should dust it off thrice with the edge of his garment, and say: Bismika Rabbi Wada`tu janbi, wa bika arfa'hu. In amsakta nafsi faghfir laha, wa in arsaltaha fahfazha bima tahfaz bihi 'ibadaka-s-salihin
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab tum mein se koi bistar par jaaye, use apne kapde ke kinaare se teen baar bistar ki dhool jhaadni chaahiye, aur kehna chaahiye: "Bismika Rabbi Wada'tu Janbi, Wa Bika Arfa'hu. In Amsakta Nafsi Faghfir Laha, Wa In Arsaltaha Fahfazha Bima Tahfaz Bihi Ibadaka-s-Salihin."'

e: Narrated Hudhaifah:When the Prophet (ﷺ) went to bed, he used to say, "Allahumma bismika ahya wa amut." And when he woke up in the mornings he used to say, "Al-hamdu li l-lahi al-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilaihi-nnushur
hi: Hudhaifah bataate hain: Jab Nabi (SAW) bistar par jaate, wo kehte, 'Allahumma Bismika Ahya Wa Amut.' Aur jab wo subah jaagte, wo kehte, 'Al-hamdu Lillahi-Lladhi Ahyana Ba'da Ma Amatana Wa Ilaihin-Nushur.'

e: Narrated Abu Dharr:When the Prophet (ﷺ) went to bed at night, he used to say: "Bismika namutu wa nahya." And when he got up in the morning, he used to say, "Al hamdu li l-lahi al-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana, wa ilaihi-nnushur
hi: Abu Dharr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Nabi (SAW) raat ko bistar par jaate, wo kehte: 'Bismika Namutu Wa Nahya.' Aur jab wo subah uthte, wo kehte, 'Al-hamdu Lillahi-Lladhi Ahyana Ba'da Ma Amatana, Wa Ilaihin-Nushur.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If anyone of you, when intending to have a sexual relation (sleep) with his wife, says: Bismillah, Allahumma jannibna ashShaitan, wa Jannib ash-Shaitana ma razaqtana, Satan would never harm that child, should it be ordained that they will have one. (Because of that sleep)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar tum mein se koi apni biwi ke saath humbistari karne ka iraada karte waqt kahe: "Bismillah, Allahumma Jannibna Ash-Shaitan, Wa Jannib Ash-Shaitana Ma Razaqtana," Shaitaan us bacche ko kabhi nuqsaan nahi pahunchaayega, agar ye taye ho ke unhein ek bacha hoga (usi milap ki wajah se).'

e: Narrated `Adi bin Hatim:I asked the Prophet, "I send off (for a game) my trained hunting dogs; (what is your verdict concerning the game they hunt?" He said, "If you send off your trained hunting dogs and mention the Name of Allah, then, if they catch some game, eat (thereof). And if you hit the game with a mi'rad (a hunting tool) and it wounds it, you can eat (it)
hi: Adi bin Hatim (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) se pucha, 'Main apne sikhaaye hue shikaari kutte (shikaar ke liye) chhodta hoon; (aapka kya faisla hai us shikaar ke baare mein jo wo pakadte hain)?' Unhone kaha, 'Agar tum apne sikhaaye hue shikaari kutte chhodo aur Allah ka naam lo, to agar wo koi shikaar pakde, to (usmein se) khaao. Aur agar tum shikaar ko Mi'rad (ek shikaar ka aujaar) se maaro aur wo use zakhmi kar de, to tum use bhi khaa sakte ho.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The people said to the Prophet (ﷺ) , "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Here are people who have recently embraced Islam and they bring meat, and we do not know whether they had mentioned Allah's Name while slaughtering the animals or not." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You should mention Allah's Name and eat
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Logon ne Nabi (SAW) se kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Yahaan kuch log hain jinhone haal hi mein Islam qubool kiya hai aur wo gosht laate hain, aur humein nahi pata unhone zibah karte waqt Allah ka naam liya ya nahi.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Tumhein Allah ka naam lekar khaana chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) slaughtered two rams as sacrifice and mentioned Allah's Name and said, "Allahu-Akbar" while slaughtering
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne do menDhe qurbaani ke taur par zibah kiye aur Allah ka naam liya aur zibah karte waqt 'Allahu Akbar' kaha.

e: Narrated Jundab:That he witnessed the Prophet (ﷺ) on the Day of Nahr. The Prophet (ﷺ) offered prayer and then delivered a sermon saying, "Whoever slaughtered his sacrifice before offering prayer, should slaughter another animal in place of the first; and whoever has not yet slaughtered any, should slaughter a sacrifice and mention Allah's Name while doing so
hi: Jundab bataate hain ke unhone Nabi (SAW) ko Nahr (Eid-ul-Adha) ke din dekha. Nabi (SAW) ne namaz padhi aur phir khutba diya, kehte hue, 'Jisne bhi apni qurbaani namaz se pehle zibah ki, use uski jagah doosra jaanwar zibah karna chaahiye; aur jisne abhi tak zibah nahi kiya, use ek qurbaani zibah karni chaahiye aur aisa karte waqt Allah ka naam lena chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not swear by your fathers; and whoever wants to swear should swear by Allah
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Apne baap-daada ki qasam mat khaao; aur jo koi qasam khaana chahe, use Allah ki qasam khaani chaahiye.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent ten persons to bring the enemy's secrets and Khubaib Al-Ansari was one of them. 'Ubaidullah bin 'Iyad told me that the daughter of Al-Harith told him that when they gathered (to kill Khubaib Al Ansari) he asked for a razor to clean his pubic region, and when they had taken him outside the sanctuary of Mecca in order to kill him, he said in verse, "I don't care if I am killed as a Muslim, on any side (of my body) I may be killed in Allah's Cause; for that is for the sake of Allah's very Self; and if He will, He will bestow His Blessings upon the torn pieces of my body." Then Ibn Al-Harith killed him, and the Prophet (ﷺ) informed his companions of the death of those (ten men) on the very day they were killed
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne das logon ko dushman ke raazon ko laane ke liye bheja, aur Khubaib Al-Ansari unmein se ek the. Ubaidullah bin Iyad ne mujhe bataaya ke Al-Harith ki beti ne unhein bataaya ke jab wo (Khubaib Al-Ansari ko qatl karne) jama hue, unhone apne naazuk hisse saaf karne ke liye ek ustra maangaa, aur jab wo unhein Makkah ki panaah-gah se baahar le gaye unhein qatl karne, unhone she'r mein kaha, 'Mujhe koi parwaah nahi agar main Musalmaan hote hue qatl kiya jaaun, kisi bhi taraf se (mere jism ki) jaan chali jaaye Allah ki raah mein; kyunke ye Allah ki khud ki khaatir hai; aur agar wo chahega, to wo mere jism ke tukdon par apni barkaten naazil karega.' Phir Ibn Al-Harith ne unhein qatl kar diya, aur Nabi (SAW) ne apne sahaaba ko un (das aadmiyon) ki maut ke baare mein usi din bata diya jis din unhein qatl kiya gaya.

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There is none having a greater sense of Ghira than Allah, and for that reason He has forbidden shameful deeds and sins (illegal sexual intercourse etc.) And there is none who likes to be praised more than Allah does." (See Hadith No. 147, Vol)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Koi bhi Allah se zyaada Ghira (izzat ki khaatir gairat) nahi rakhta, aur isi wajah se usne sharm-naak amaal aur gunaah (zina waghera) mana kiye hain. Aur koi bhi tareef aur pasand kiye jaane ka utna khwaahishmand nahi hai jitna Allah hai.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 147, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When Allah created the Creation, He wrote in His Book--and He wrote (that) about Himself, and it is placed with Him on the Throne--'Verily My Mercy overcomes My Anger
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab Allah ne Makhlooq banaayi, usne apni Kitaab mein likha -- aur usne apne baare mein likha, aur wo uske Arsh (Takht) par uske paas rakhi hai -- "Beshak, Meri Rehmat Meri Naaraazgi par ghaalib hai."'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah says: 'I am just as My slave thinks I am, (i.e. I am able to do for him what he thinks I can do for him) and I am with him if He remembers Me. If he remembers Me in himself, I too, remember him in Myself; and if he remembers Me in a group of people, I remember him in a group that is better than they; and if he comes one span nearer to Me, I go one cubit nearer to him; and if he comes one cubit nearer to Me, I go a distance of two outstretched arms nearer to him; and if he comes to Me walking, I go to him running
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah farmaata hai: "Main waisa hi hoon jaisa mera bandaa mujhe samajhta hai (yaani main uske liye wo kar sakta hoon jo wo sochta hai main kar sakta hoon), aur main uske saath hoon agar wo mujhe yaad kare. Agar wo mujhe apne dil mein yaad kare, main bhi use apne mein yaad karta hoon; aur agar wo mujhe logon ke ek giroh mein yaad kare, main use ek behtareen giroh mein yaad karta hoon; aur agar wo ek bitta mere qareeb aaye, main ek haath uske qareeb jaata hoon; aur agar wo ek haath mere qareeb aaye, main do phaile hue baazuon jitni doori uske qareeb jaata hoon; aur agar wo mere paas chalte hue aaye, main daudkar uske paas jaata hoon."'

e: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:when this Verse:--'Say (O Muhammad!): He has Power to send torments on you from above,' (6.65) was revealed; The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I take refuge with Your Face." Allah revealed:-- '..or from underneath your feet.' (6.65) The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "I seek refuge with Your Face!" Then Allah revealed:--'...or confuse you in party-strife.' (6.65) Oh that, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "This is easier
hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab ye Aayat naazil hui: 'Kaho (Aye Muhammad!): Usme oopar se tumpar azaab bhejne ki qudrat hai,' (6:65) Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Main tere Chehre ki panaah leta hoon.' Allah ne naazil kiya: '...ya tumhaare pairon ke neeche se.' (6:65) Nabi (SAW) ne phir kaha, 'Main tere Chehre ki panaah leta hoon!' Phir Allah ne naazil kiya: '...ya tumhein giroh-baazi mein uljhaakar.' (6:65) Isper, Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Ye zyaada aasaan hai.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:Ad-Dajjal was mentioned in the presence of the Prophet. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah is not hidden from you; He is not one-eyed," and pointed with his hand towards his eye, adding, "While Al-Masih Ad- Dajjal is blind in the right eye and his eye looks like a protruding grape
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ad-Dajjal ka zikr Nabi (SAW) ki maujoodgi mein hua. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Allah tumse chhupa hua nahi hai; wo ek-aankha nahi hai,' aur apne haath se apni aankh ki taraf ishara kiya, aur izaafa kiya, 'Jabke Al-Maseeh Ad-Dajjal daayin aankh se andha hai aur uski aankh ek uthhe hue angoor jaisi dikhti hai.'

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah did not send any prophet but that he warned his nation of the one-eyed liar (Ad-Dajjal). He is one-eyed while your Lord is not one-eyed, The word 'Kafir' (unbeliever) is written between his two eyes
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah ne kisi bhi Nabi ko nahi bheja jisne apni qaum ko us ek-aankhe jhoote (Ad-Dajjal) se khabardaar na kiya ho. Wo ek-aankha hai jabke tumhaara Rab ek-aankha nahi hai. "Kafir" (yaani kaafir) lafz uski dono aankhon ke beech likha hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:That during the battle with Bani Al-Mustaliq they (Muslims) captured some females and intended to have sexual relation with them without impregnating them. So they asked the Prophet (ﷺ) about coitus interruptus. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It is better that you should not do it, for Allah has written whom He is going to create till the Day of Resurrection." Qaza'a said, "I heard Abu Sa`id saying that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'No soul is ordained to be created but Allah will create it
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jang-e-Banu Al-Mustaliq ke dauraan, Musalmaanon ne kuch khawaateen ko qaidi banaaya aur unke saath humbistari ka iraada kiya bina unhein garbhvati kiye. To unhone Nabi (SAW) se Azl (coitus interruptus) ke baare mein pucha. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Behtar hai ke tum aisa na karo, kyunke Allah ne pehle hi likh diya hai kise wo Qayamat tak paida karega.' Qaza'a ne kaha, 'Maine Abu Saeed ko ye kehte suna ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, "Koi bhi jaan paida hone ke liye taye nahi hai magar Allah use paida karega."'

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah will gather the believers on the Day of Resurrection in the same way (as they are gathered in this life), and they will say, 'Let us ask someone to intercede for us with our Lord that He may relieve us from this place of ours.' Then they will go to Adam and say, 'O Adam! Don't you see the people (people's condition)? Allah created you with His Own Hands and ordered His angels to prostrate before you, and taught you the names of all the things. Please intercede for us with our Lord so that He may relieve us from this place of ours.' Adam will say, 'I am not fit for this undertaking' and mention to them the mistakes he had committed, and add, "But you d better go to Noah as he was the first Apostle sent by Allah to the people of the Earth.' They will go to Noah who will reply, 'I am not fit for this undertaking,' and mention the mistake which he made, and add, 'But you'd better go to Abraham, Khalil Ar-Rahman.' They will go to Abraham who will reply, 'I am not fit for this undertaking,' and mention to them the mistakes he made, and add, 'But you'd better go to Moses, a slave whom Allah gave the Torah and to whom He spoke directly' They will go to Moses who will reply, 'I am not fit for this undertaking,' and mention to them the mistakes he made, and add, 'You'd better go to Jesus, Allah's slave and His Apostle and His Word (Be: And it was) and a soul created by Him.' They will go to Jesus who will say, 'I am not fit for this undertaking, but you'd better go to Muhammad whose sins of the past and the future had been forgiven (by Allah).' So they will come to me and I will ask the permission of my Lord, and I will be permitted (to present myself) before Him. When I see my Lord, I will fall down in (prostration) before Him and He will leave me (in prostration) as long as He wishes, and then it will be said to me, 'O Muhammad! Raise your head and speak, for you will be listened to; and ask, for you will be granted (your request); and intercede, for your intercession will be accepted.' I will then raise my head and praise my Lord with certain praises which He has taught me, and then I will intercede. Allah will allow me to intercede (for a certain kind of people) and will fix a limit whom I will admit into Paradise. I will come back again, and when I see my Lord (again), I will fall down in prostration before Him, and He will leave me (in prostration) as long as He wishes, and then He will say, 'O Muhammad! Raise your head and speak, for you will be listened to; and ask, for you will be granted (your request); and intercede, for your intercession will be accepted.' I will then praise my Lord with certain praises which He has taught me, and then I will intercede. Allah will allow me to intercede (for a certain kind of people) and will fix a limit to whom I will admit into Paradise, I will return again, and when I see my Lord, I will fall down (in prostration) and He will leave me (in prostration) as long as He wishes, and then He will say, 'O Muhammad! Raise your head and speak, for you will be listened to, and ask, for you will be granted (your request); and intercede, for your intercession will be accepted.' I will then praise my Lord with certain praises which He has taught me, and then I will intercede. Allah will allow me to intercede (for a certain kind of people) and will fix a limit to whom I will admit into Paradise. I will come back and say, 'O my Lord! None remains in Hell (Fire) but those whom Qur'an has imprisoned therein and for whom eternity in Hell (Fire) has become inevitable.' " The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "There will come out of Hell (Fire) everyone who says: 'La ilaha illal-lah,' and has in his heart good equal to the weight of a barley grain. Then there will come out of Hell (Fire) everyone who says: ' La ilaha illal-lah,' and has in his heart good equal to the weight of a wheat grain. Then there will come out of Hell (Fire) everyone who says: 'La ilaha illal-lah,' and has in his heart good equal to the weight of an atom (or a smallest ant)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah Qayamat ke din Momineen ko usi tarah jama karega jaise wo (is duniya mein) jama kiye jaate hain, aur wo kahenge, "Chalo hum kisi se guzaarish karein hamare Rab ke paas sifaarish karne ke liye taake wo humein is jagah se raahat de." Phir wo Aadam ke paas jaayenge aur kahenge, "Aye Aadam! Kya aap logon ko (unki haalat) nahi dekhte? Allah ne aapko apne haathon se banaaya aur apne farishton ko aapke saamne sajda karne ka hukm diya, aur aapko sab cheezon ke naam sikhaaye. Barah-e-meharbaani hamare Rab se hamaare liye sifaarish kijiye taake wo humein is jagah se raahat de." Aadam kahenge, "Main is kaam ke laayak nahi," aur unhein wo galtiyaan yaad dilaayenge jo unhone ki thi, aur izaafa karenge, "Magar tumhein Nuh ke paas jaana chaahiye kyunke wo pehle Rasool the jo Allah ne zameen ke logon ke paas bheje." Wo Nuh ke paas jaayenge jo jawab denge, "Main is kaam ke laayak nahi," aur unhein wo galti yaad dilaayenge jo unhone ki thi, aur izaafa karenge, "Magar tumhein Ibrahim, Khalil Ar-Rahman, ke paas jaana chaahiye." Wo Ibrahim ke paas jaayenge jo jawab denge, "Main is kaam ke laayak nahi," aur unhein wo galtiyaan yaad dilaayenge jo unhone ki thi, aur izaafa karenge, "Magar tumhein Musa ke paas jaana chaahiye, ek bandaa jise Allah ne Taurat di aur jisse usne seedhe baat ki." Wo Musa ke paas jaayenge jo jawab denge, "Main is kaam ke laayak nahi," aur unhein wo galtiyaan yaad dilaayenge jo unhone ki thi, aur izaafa karenge, "Tumhein Isa ke paas jaana chaahiye, Allah ke bandaa aur uske Rasool aur uski Kalima (Ho: aur wo hua) aur uski taraf se paida ki gayi ek Rooh." Wo Isa ke paas jaayenge jo kahenge, "Main is kaam ke laayak nahi, magar tumhein Muhammad ke paas jaana chaahiye jinke pichhle aur aane wale gunaah (Allah dwara) maaf kar diye gaye hain." To wo mere paas aayenge aur main apne Rab se ijaazat maangunga, aur mujhe (unke saamne pesh hone ki) ijaazat mil jaayegi. Jab main apne Rab ko dekhunga, main uske saamne sajda mein gir jaunga, aur wo mujhe (sajde mein) jitni der chaahega chhod dega, aur phir mujhse kaha jaayega, "Aye Muhammad! Apna sar uthaao aur bolo, kyunke tumhaari baat suni jaayegi; aur maango, kyunke tumhaari (darkhwaast) di jaayegi; aur sifaarish karo, kyunke tumhaari sifaarish qubool ki jaayegi." Phir main apna sar uthaunga aur apne Rab ki wo tareef karunga jo usne mujhe sikhaayi hai, aur phir main sifaarish karunga. Allah mujhe sifaarish karne ki ijaazat dega (kuch qism ke logon ke liye) aur ek hadd taye karega jitne mein Jannat mein daakhil kar sakoon. Main dobara aaunga, aur jab main apne Rab ko (dobara) dekhunga, main uske saamne sajda mein gir jaunga, aur wo mujhe (sajde mein) jitni der chaahega chhod dega, aur phir kahega, "Aye Muhammad! Apna sar uthaao aur bolo, kyunke tumhaari baat suni jaayegi; aur maango, kyunke tumhaari darkhwaast di jaayegi; aur sifaarish karo, kyunke tumhaari sifaarish qubool ki jaayegi." Main phir apne Rab ki wo tareef karunga jo usne mujhe sikhaayi hai, aur phir main sifaarish karunga. Allah mujhe sifaarish karne ki ijaazat dega (kuch qism ke logon ke liye) aur ek hadd taye karega jitne mein Jannat mein daakhil kar sakoon. Main dobara wapas aaunga, aur jab main apne Rab ko dekhunga, main gir jaunga (sajde mein), aur wo mujhe (sajde mein) jitni der chaahega chhod dega, aur phir kahega, "Aye Muhammad! Apna sar uthaao aur bolo, kyunke tumhaari baat suni jaayegi, aur maango, kyunke tumhaari darkhwaast di jaayegi; aur sifaarish karo, kyunke tumhaari sifaarish qubool ki jaayegi." Main phir apne Rab ki wo tareef karunga jo usne mujhe sikhaayi hai, aur phir main sifaarish karunga. Allah mujhe sifaarish karne ki ijaazat dega (kuch qism ke logon ke liye) aur ek hadd taye karega jitne mein main Jannat mein daakhil kar sakoon. Main wapas aaunga aur kahoonga, "Aye mere Rab! Jahannam ki Aag mein sirf wahi log bache hain jinhein Quran ne wahaan qaid kiya hai aur jinke liye Jahannam ki Aag mein hamesha rehna zaroori ho gaya hai."' Nabi (SAW) ne izaafa kiya, 'Jahannam ki Aag se har wo shaks nikaala jaayega jo kahe: "La Ilaha Illallah," aur uske dil mein jau ke daane jitni bhalaai ho. Phir Jahannam ki Aag se har wo shaks nikaala jaayega jo kahe: "La Ilaha Illallah," aur uske dil mein gehun ke daane jitni bhalaai ho. Phir Jahannam ki Aag se har wo shaks nikaala jaayega jo kahe: "La Ilaha Illallah," aur uske dil mein ek zarre (ya sabse chhoti chionti) jitni bhalaai ho.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah's Hand is full, and (its fullness) is not affected by the continuous spending, day and night." He also said, "Do you see what He has spent since He created the Heavens and the Earth? Yet all that has not decreased what is in His Hand." He also said, "His Throne is over the water and in His other Hand is the balance (of Justice) and He raises and lowers (whomever He will)." (See Hadith No. 206, Vol)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah ka Haath bhara hua hai, aur (uski bharpoori) lagataar kharch hone se, din aur raat, mutassir nahi hoti.' Unhone ye bhi kaha, 'Kya tum dekhte ho usne kya kharch kiya hai jab se usne Aasmaan aur Zameen banaayi? Phir bhi wo sab kuch usne jo uske Haath mein hai use kam nahi kiya.' Unhone ye bhi kaha, 'Uska Arsh (Takht) paani ke oopar hai, aur uske doosre Haath mein insaaf ka taraazu hai, aur wo (jise chahe) ooncha aur (jise chahe) neecha karta hai.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 206, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "On the Day of Resurrection, Allah will grasp the whole Earth by His Hand, and all the Heavens in His right, and then He will say, 'I am the King." Abu Huraira said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said," Allah will grasp the Earth
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Qayamat ke din, Allah poori Zameen ko apne Haath se pakdega, aur sab Aasmaan apne daaen Haath mein, aur phir kahega, "Main Baadshah hoon."' Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, "Allah Zameen ko pakdega..."'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:A Jew came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Muhammad! Allah will hold the heavens on a Finger, and the mountains on a Finger, and the trees on a Finger, and all the creation on a Finger, and then He will say, 'I am the King.' " On that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) smiled till his premolar teeth became visible, and then recited:-- 'No just estimate have they made of Allah such as due to him....(39.67) `Abdullah added: Allah's Apostle smiled (at the Jew's statement) expressing his wonder and belief in what was said
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek Yahudi Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Aye Muhammad! Allah aasmaanon ko ek Ungli par pakdega, aur pahaadon ko ek Ungli par, aur darakhton ko ek Ungli par, aur sab makhlooq ko ek Ungli par, aur phir kahega, "Main Baadshah hoon."' Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) muskuraaye yahaan tak ke unke ande waale daant (premolar) dikhne lage, aur phir unhone padha: 'Unhone Allah ka jaisa haq hai waisa andaaza nahi lagaaya...' (39:67) Abdullah ne izaafa kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) (Yahudi ki baat par) muskuraaye, apni hairaani aur us baat par apna Iman zaahir karte hue jo kahi gayi thi.

e: Narrated `Abdullah:A man from the people of the scripture came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Abal-Qasim! Allah will hold the Heavens upon a Finger, and the Earth on a Finger and the land on a Finger, and all the creation on a Finger, and will say, 'I am the King! I am the King!' " I saw the Prophet (after hearing that), smiling till his premolar teeth became visible, and he then recited: -- 'No just estimate have they made of Allah such as due to him
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ahl-e-Kitaab ka ek shaks Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Aye Abal-Qasim! Allah Aasmaanon ko ek Ungli par pakdega, aur Zameen ko ek Ungli par aur zameen (ki taraf ki cheezein) ek Ungli par, aur sab makhlooq ko ek Ungli par, aur kahega, "Main Baadshah hoon! Main Baadshah hoon!"' Maine Nabi (SAW) ko (ye sunkar) muskuraate dekha yahaan tak ke unke ande waale daant dikhne lage, aur phir unhone padha: 'Unhone Allah ka jaisa haq hai waisa andaaza nahi lagaaya...'

e: Narrated Al-Mughira:Sa`d bin 'Ubada said, "If I saw a man with my wife, I would strike him (behead him) with the blade of my sword." This news reached Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who then said, "You people are astonished at Sa`d's Ghira. By Allah, I have more Ghira than he, and Allah has more Ghira than I, and because of Allah's Ghira, He has made unlawful Shameful deeds and sins (illegal sexual intercourse etc.) done in open and in secret. And there is none who likes that the people should repent to Him and beg His pardon than Allah, and for this reason He sent the warners and the givers of good news. And there is none who likes to be praised more than Allah does, and for this reason, Allah promised to grant Paradise (to the doers of good)." `Abdul Malik said, "No person has more Ghira than Allah
hi: Al-Mughira bataate hain: Sa'd bin Ubada (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Agar main kisi aadmi ko apni biwi ke saath dekhoon, main use apni talwaar ki dhaar se maar dunga (sar kaatunga).' Ye baat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) tak pahunchi jinhone kaha, 'Tum log Sa'd ki Ghira (izzat ki khaatir gairat) par hairaan ho. Allah ki qasam, mujhme unse bhi zyaada Ghira hai, aur Allah mujhse bhi zyaada Ghira rakhta hai, aur Allah ki Ghira ki wajah se, usne sharm-naak amaal aur gunaah (zina waghera) khule aam aur chupke se dono mein haraam kiye hain. Aur koi bhi is baat ka utna khwaahishmand nahi hai ke log uski taraf tauba karein aur uski maafi maangein jitna Allah hai, aur isi wajah se usne chetaawani dene walon aur khush-khabri dene walon ko bheja. Aur koi bhi tareef aur pasand kiye jaane ka utna khwaahishmand nahi hai jitna Allah hai, aur isi wajah se, Allah ne (nek amaal karne walon ko) Jannat dene ka waada kiya.' Abdul Malik ne kaha, 'Koi bhi Allah se zyaada Ghira nahi rakhta.'

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:The Prophet (ﷺ) said to a man, "Have you got anything of the Qur'an?" The man said, "Yes, such-andsuch Sura, and such-and-such Sura," naming the Suras
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne ek shaks se kaha, 'Kya tumhein Quran mein se kuch aata hai?' Shaks ne kaha, 'Haan, falaan-falaan Surah, aur falaan-falaan Surah,' Surahon ke naam lete hue.

e: Narrated `Imran bin Hussain:While I was with the Prophet (ﷺ) , some people from Bani Tamim came to him. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Bani Tamim! Accept the good news!" They said, "You have given us the good news; now give us (something)." (After a while) some Yemenites entered, and he said to them, "O the people of Yemen! Accept the good news, as Bani Tamim have refused it. " They said, "We accept it, for we have come to you to learn the Religion. So we ask you what the beginning of this universe was." The Prophet (ﷺ) said "There was Allah and nothing else before Him and His Throne was over the water, and He then created the Heavens and the Earth and wrote everything in the Book." Then a man came to me and said, 'O `Imran! Follow your she-camel for it has run away!" So I set out seeking it, and behold, it was beyond the mirage! By Allah, I wished that it (my she-camel) had gone but that I had not left (the gathering)
hi: Imran bin Hussain bataate hain: Jab main Nabi (SAW) ke saath tha, Banu Tamim qabeele ke kuch log unke paas aaye. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Aye Banu Tamim! Achhi khabar qubool karo!' Unhone kaha, 'Aapne humein achhi khabar de di hai; ab humein (kuch aur) dijiye.' (Kuch der baad) kuch Yemen waale andar aaye, aur unhone unse kaha, 'Aye Yemen ke logo! Achhi khabar qubool karo, kyunke Banu Tamim ne ise thukra diya hai.' Unhone kaha, 'Hum ise qubool karte hain, kyunke hum aapke paas deen seekhne aaye hain. Isliye hum aapse poochte hain ke is kaayanaat ki shuruaat kya thi.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Allah tha aur uske pehle kuch bhi nahi tha, aur uska Arsh (Takht) paani ke oopar tha, aur phir usne Aasmaan aur Zameen banaayi aur har cheez Kitaab mein likhi.' Phir ek shaks mere paas aaya aur kaha, 'Aye Imran! Apni oontni ka peecha karo kyunke wo bhaag gayi hai!' To main use dhoondhne nikla, aur dekho, wo mrigmarichika (mirage) ke us paar thi! Allah ki qasam, mujhe kaash meri oontni chali gayi hoti magar main (us majlis se) na gaya hota.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The Right (Hand) of Allah Is full, and (Its fullness) is not affected by the continuous spending night and day. Do you see what He has spent since He created the Heavens and the Earth? Yet all that has not decreased what is in His Right Hand. His Throne is over the water and in His other Hand is the Bounty or the Power to bring about death, and He raises some people and brings others down." (See Hadith No)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah ka Daaya (Haath) bhara hua hai, aur (uski bharpoori) lagataar kharch hone se, raat aur din, mutassir nahi hoti. Kya tum dekhte ho usne kya kharch kiya hai jab se usne Aasmaan aur Zameen banaayi? Phir bhi wo sab kuch usne jo uske Daaen Haath mein hai use kam nahi kiya. Uska Arsh (Takht) paani ke oopar hai, aur uske doosre Haath mein Fayaazi ya Maut laane ki Qudrat hai, aur wo kuch logon ko ooncha uthaata hai aur kuch ko neecha karta hai.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees dekhein.)

e: Narrated Anas:Zaid bin Haritha came to the Prophet (ﷺ) complaining about his wife. The Prophet (ﷺ) kept on saying (to him), "Be afraid of Allah and keep your wife." Aisha said, "If Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) were to conceal anything (of the Qur'an he would have concealed this Verse." Zainab used to boast before the wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) and used to say, "You were given in marriage by your families, while I was married (to the Prophet) by Allah from over seven Heavens." And Thabit recited, "The Verse:-- 'But (O Muhammad) you did hide in your heart that which Allah was about to make manifest, you did fear the people,' (33.37) was revealed in connection with Zainab and Zaid bin Haritha
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Zaid bin Haritha Nabi (SAW) ke paas apni biwi ki shikaayat lekar aaye. Nabi (SAW) unse kehte rahe, 'Allah se daro aur apni biwi ko rakho.' Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha, 'Agar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Quran mein se kuch chhupana hota, to wo ye Aayat chhupaate.' Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا), Nabi (SAW) ki doosri biwiyon ke saamne apni izzat jataati thi aur kehti thi, 'Tumhaari shaadi tumhaare khaandaan ne karayi, jabke meri shaadi (Nabi se) khud Allah ne saat Aasmaanon ke oopar se karayi.' Aur Thabit ne padha, 'Aayat: "Magar (Aye Muhammad) aapne apne dil mein wo baat chhupaayi jise Allah zaahir karne wala tha, aapko logon ka dar tha" (33:37) Zainab aur Zaid bin Haritha ke silsile mein naazil hui thi.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Verse of Al-Hijab (veiling of women) was revealed in connection with Zainab bint Jahsh. (On the day of her marriage with him) the Prophet (ﷺ) gave a wedding banquet with bread and meat; and she used to boast before other wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) and used to say, "Allah married me (to the Prophet (ﷺ) in the Heavens
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Al-Hijab (khawaateen ke pardhe) ki Aayat Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Jahsh (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke silsile mein naazil hui thi. (Unki shaadi ke din) Nabi (SAW) ne roti aur gosht ka shaadi ka daawat-e-walima diya; aur wo Nabi (SAW) ki doosri biwiyon ke saamne apni izzat jataati thi aur kehti thi, 'Allah ne meri shaadi (Nabi SAW se) Aasmaanon mein karayi.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When Allah had finished His creation, He wrote over his Throne: 'My Mercy preceded My Anger
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab Allah ne apni takhleeq mukammal ki, usne apne Arsh (Takht) par likha: "Meri Rehmat Meri Naaraazgi se pehle hai."'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever believes in Allah and His Apostle offers prayers perfectly and fasts (the month of) Ramadan then it is incumbent upon Allah to admit him into Paradise, whether he emigrates for Allah's cause or stays in the land where he was born." They (the companions of the Prophet) said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Should we not inform the people of that?" He said, "There are one-hundred degrees in Paradise which Allah has prepared for those who carry on Jihad in His Cause. The distance between every two degrees is like the distance between the sky and the Earth, so if you ask Allah for anything, ask Him for the Firdaus, for it is the last part of Paradise and the highest part of Paradise, and at its top there is the Throne of Beneficent, and from it gush forth the rivers of Paradise
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi Allah aur uske Rasool par Iman rakhta hai, sahi tareeke se namaz padhta hai, aur Ramzan (ka mahina) roza rakhta hai, to Allah par ye zaroori ho jaata hai ke wo use Jannat mein daakhil kare, chaahe wo Allah ki khaatir hijrat kare ya jahaan wo paida hua us zameen mein hi rahe.' Unhone (sahaaba ne) pucha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya humein logon ko iske baare mein na bataana chaahiye?' Unhone kaha, 'Jannat mein sau (100) darje hain jo Allah ne unke liye taiyaar kiye hain jo uski raah mein Jihad karte hain. Har do darjon ke beech ki doori aasmaan aur zameen ke beech ki doori jaisi hai, isliye agar tum Allah se kuch maango, to Firdaus maango, kyunke ye Jannat ka aakhri aur sabse ooncha hissa hai, aur uske sabse oopar Rehmaan ka Arsh (Takht) hai, aur usse Jannat ki nadiyaan bahti hain.'

e: Narrated Abu Dharr:I entered the mosque while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was sitting there. When the sun had set, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Abu Dharr! Do you know where this (sun) goes?" I said, "Allah and His Apostle know best." He said, "It goes and asks permission to prostrate, and it is allowed, and (one day) it, as if being ordered to return whence it came, then it will rise from the west." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) recited, "That: "And the sun runs on its fixed course (for a term decreed)," (36.38) as it is recited by `Abdullah
hi: Abu Dharr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Masjid mein daakhil hua jabke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) wahaan baithe hue the. Jab suraj dhala, Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Aye Abu Dharr! Kya tumhein pata hai ye (suraj) kahaan jaata hai?' Maine kaha, 'Allah aur uska Rasool behtar jaante hain.' Unhone kaha, 'Wo jaata hai aur sajda karne ki ijaazat maangta hai, aur ise ijaazat mil jaati hai, aur (ek din) use hukm diya jaayega ke wo wapas usi jagah jaaye jahaan se aaya tha, phir wo Paschim se nikalega.' Phir Nabi (SAW) ne padha, 'Aur suraj apni muqarrar rah par chalta hai (ek nishchit muddat ke liye),' (36:38) jaisa Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ise padhte the.

e: Narrated Zaid bin Thabit:Abu Bakr sent for me, so I collected the Qur'an till I found the last part of Surat-at-Tauba with Abi Khuza`ima Al-Ansari and did not find it with anybody else. (The Verses are): -- 'Verily, there has come to you an Apostle (Muhammad) from amongst yourselves..(till the end of Surat Bara'a) (i.e., at- Tauba).' (9.128-129) Yunus also narrated as above
hi: Zaid bin Thabit (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Bakr ne mujhe bulwaaya, isliye maine Quran jama kiya yahaan tak ke maine Surat-at-Tauba ka aakhri hissa Abi Khuza'ima Al-Ansari ke paas paaya aur kisi aur ke paas nahi. (Wo Aayaten hain): 'Beshak, tumhaare paas ek Rasool (Muhammad) aaye hain tum mein se (Surat Bara'a yaani at-Tauba ke aakhir tak).' (9:128-129) Yunus ne bhi isi tarah riwaayat ki.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to say at the time of difficulty, 'La ilaha il-lallah Al-`Alimul-Halim. La-ilaha illallah Rabul- Arsh-al-Azim, La ilaha-il-lallah Rabus-Samawati Rab-ul-Ard; wa Rab-ul-Arsh Al- Karim.' (See Hadith No. 356 and 357, Vol)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) mushkil ke waqt kaha karte the, 'La ilaha il-lallah Al-Alimul-Halim. La-ilaha illallah Rabul-Arsh-al-Azim, La ilaha-il-lallah Rabus-Samawati Rab-ul-Ard; wa Rab-ul-Arsh Al-Karim.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 356 aur 357, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The people will fall unconscious on the Day of Resurrection, then suddenly I will see Moses holding one of the pillars of the Throne." Abu Huraira said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I will be the first person to be resurrected and will see Moses holding the Throne
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Log Qayamat ke din behosh gir jaayenge, phir achaanak main Musa ko Arsh ke ek khambhe ko thaame hue dekhunga.' Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Main sabse pehla shaks hounga jo dobara zinda hoga aur Musa ko Arsh thaame hue dekhunga.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "(A group of) angels stay with you at night and (another group of) angels by daytime, and both groups gather at the time of the 'Asr and Fajr prayers. Then those angels who have stayed with you overnight, ascend (to Heaven) and Allah asks them (about you) ---- and He knows everything about you. "In what state did you leave My slaves?' The angels reply, 'When we left them, they were praying, and when we reached them they were praying
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, '(Ek giroh) farishte tumhaare saath raat ko rehte hain aur (doosra giroh) farishte din mein, aur dono giroh Asr aur Fajr ki namaz ke waqt jama hote hain. Phir wo farishte jo raat bhar tumhaare saath rahe, oopar (aasmaan ki taraf) jaate hain aur Allah unse (tumhaare baare mein) poochta hai -- aur wo tumhaare baare mein har cheez jaanta hai -- "Tumne mere bandon ko kis haalat mein chhoda?" Farishte jawab dete hain, "Jab humne unhein chhoda, wo namaz padh rahe the, aur jab hum unke paas pahunche, wo namaz padh rahe the."'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If somebody gives in charity something equal to a date from his honestly earned money ----for nothing ascends to Allah except good---- then Allah will take it in His Right (Hand) and bring it up for its owner as anyone of you brings up a baby horse, till it becomes like a mountain." Abu Huraira said: The Prophet. said, "Nothing ascends to Allah except good
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar koi apni imaandaari se kamaayi hui daulat se sadqe mein khajoor jitna bhi de -- kyunke Allah ke paas sirf achhaai hi pahunchti hai -- to Allah use apne Daaen Haath mein le lega aur ise uske maalik ke liye badhaayega jaise tum mein se koi ghode ke bachche ko badhaata hai, yahaan tak ke ye ek pahaad jitna ban jaaye.' Abu Huraira ne kaha: Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Allah ke paas kuch nahi pahunchta siwaaye achhaai ke.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to say at the time of difficulty, "None has the right to be worshipped but Allah, the Majestic, the Most Forbearing. None has the right to be worshipped but Allah, the Lord of the Tremendous Throne. None has the right to be worshipped but Allah, the Lord of the Heavens and the Lord of the Honourable Throne. (See Hadith No. 357, Vol)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mushkil ke waqt kaha karte the, 'Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi, wo Buzurg, Bardaasht karne wala hai. Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi, wo Azeem Arsh (Takht) ka Rab hai. Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi, wo Aasmaanon ka Rab hai aur Izzat-daar Arsh ka Rab hai.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 357, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:When `Ali was in Yemen, he sent some gold in its ore to the Prophet. The Prophet (ﷺ) distributed it among Al-Aqra' bin H`Abis Al-Hanzali who belonged to Bani Mujashi, 'Uyaina bin Badr Al-Fazari, 'Alqama bin 'Ulatha Al-`Amiri, who belonged to the Bani Kilab tribe and Zaid AI-Khail at-Ta'i who belonged to Bani Nabhan. So the Quraish and the Ansar became angry and said, "He gives to the chiefs of Najd and leaves us!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I just wanted to attract and unite their hearts (make them firm in Islam)." Then there came a man with sunken eyes, bulging forehead, thick beard, fat raised cheeks, and clean-shaven head, and said, "O Muhammad! Be afraid of Allah! " The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Who would obey Allah if I disobeyed Him? (Allah). He trusts me over the people of the earth, but you do not trust me?" A man from the people (present then), who, I think, was Khalid bin Al- Walid, asked for permission to kill him, but the Prophet (ﷺ) prevented him. When the man went away, the Prophet said, "Out of the offspring of this man, there will be people who will recite the Qur'an but it will not go beyond their throats, and they will go out of Islam as an arrow goes out through the game, and they will kill the Muslims and leave the idolators. Should I live till they appear, I would kill them as the Killing of the nation of 'Ad
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Ali (Alayhis Salam) Yemen mein the, unhone sona uski dhaat ke saath Nabi (SAW) ko bheja. Nabi (SAW) ne use Al-Aqra' bin Habis Al-Hanzali, jo Banu Mujashi qabeele se the, Uyaina bin Badr Al-Fazari, Alqama bin Ulatha Al-Amiri, jo Banu Kilab qabeele se the, aur Zaid Al-Khail At-Ta'i, jo Banu Nabhan qabeele se the, mein baanta. To Quraish aur Ansaar gusse ho gaye aur kaha, 'Wo Najd ke sardaaron ko dete hain aur humein chhod dete hain!' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Main sirf unke dilon ko aakarshit aur ekjut karna chahta tha (unhein Islam mein mazbooti se rakhne ke liye).' Phir ek shaks aaya, dhansi hui aankhon, uthhe hue mathe, ghani daadi, mote uthhe gaalon, aur mundhe hue sar ke saath, aur kaha, 'Aye Muhammad! Allah se daro!' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Agar main Allah ki nafarmaani karoon, to Allah ki farmaanbardaari kaun karega? (Allah) mujhpar zameen ke sab logon se zyaada bharosa karta hai, magar tum mujhpar bharosa nahi karte?' Waha maujood logon mein se ek shaks -- mujhe lagta hai wo Khalid bin Al-Walid the -- ne unhein qatl karne ki ijaazat maangi, magar Nabi (SAW) ne unhein roka. Jab wo shaks chala gaya, Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Is aadmi ki nasl mein se, aise log honge jo Quran padhenge magar wo unke galay se aage nahi jaayega, aur wo Islam se aise nikal jaayenge jaise ek teer shikaar se guzar jaata hai, aur wo Musalmaanon ko qatl karenge aur mushrikon ko chhod denge. Agar main unke zaahir hone tak zinda raha, to main unhein Aad qaum ko qatl karne jaisa qatl karunga.'

e: Narrated Abu Dharr:I asked the Prophet (ﷺ) regarding the Verse:--'And the sun runs on its fixed course for a term decreed for it.' (36.28) He said, "Its fixed course is underneath Allah's Throne
hi: Abu Dharr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) se is Aayat ke baare mein pucha: 'Aur suraj apni muqarrar rah par chalta hai (ek nishchit muddat ke liye).' (36:38) Unhone kaha, 'Uski muqarrar raah Allah ke Arsh (Takht) ke neeche hai.'

e: Narrated Jarir:We were sitting with the Prophet (ﷺ) and he looked at the moon on the night of the full-moon and said, "You people will see your Lord as you see this full moon, and you will have no trouble in seeing Him, so if you can avoid missing (through sleep or business, etc.) a prayer before sunrise (Fajr) and a prayer before sunset (`Asr) you must do so." (See Hadith No. 529, Vol)
hi: Jarir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Nabi (SAW) ke saath baithe the aur unhone chaudhvin raat ki raat ko chaand ki taraf dekha aur kaha, 'Tum log apne Rab ko waise hi dekhoge jaise tum is poore chaand ko dekhte ho, aur tumhein use dekhne mein koi mushkil nahi hogi, isliye agar tum suraj nikalne se pehle ki namaz (Fajr) aur suraj doobne se pehle ki namaz (Asr) chhootne se bach sako, to zaroor bacho.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 529, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated Jarir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You will definitely see your Lord with your own eyes
hi: Jarir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Tum apne Rab ko zaroor apni khud ki aankhon se dekhoge.'

e: Narrated Jarir:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came out to us on the night of the full moon and said, "You will see your Lord on the Day of Resurrection as you see this (full moon) and you will have no difficulty in seeing Him
hi: Jarir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) chaudhvin raat ki raat humaare paas aaye aur kaha, 'Tum apne Rab ko Qayamat ke din waise hi dekhoge jaise tum is (poore chaand) ko dekhte ho, aur tumhein use dekhne mein koi mushkil nahi hogi.'

e: Narrated 'Ata' bin Yazid Al-Laithi: On the authority of Abu Huraira: The people said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shall we see our Lord on the Day of Resurrection?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do you have any difficulty in seeing the moon on a full moon night?" They said, "No, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." He said, "Do you have any difficulty in seeing the sun when there are no clouds?" They said, "No, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." He said, "So you will see Him, like that. Allah will gather all the people on the Day of Resurrection, and say, 'Whoever worshipped something (in the world) should follow (that thing),' so, whoever worshipped the sun will follow the sun, and whoever worshiped the moon will follow the moon, and whoever used to worship certain (other false) deities, he will follow those deities. And there will remain only this nation with its good people (or its hypocrites). (The sub-narrator, Ibrahim is in doubt.) Allah will come to them and say, 'I am your Lord.' They will (deny Him and) say, 'We will stay here till our Lord comes, for when our Lord comes, we will recognize Him.' So Allah will come to them in His appearance which they know, and will say, 'I am your Lord.' They will say, 'You are our Lord,' so they will follow Him. Then a bridge will be laid across Hell (Fire)' I and my followers will be the first ones to go across it and none will speak on that Day except the Apostles. And the invocation of the Apostles on that Day will be, 'O Allah, save! Save!' In Hell (or over The Bridge) there will be hooks like the thorns of As-Sa'dan (thorny plant). Have you seen As-Sa'dan? " They replied, "Yes, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" He said, "So those hooks look like the thorns of As-Sa'dan, but none knows how big they are except Allah. Those hooks will snap the people away according to their deeds. Some of the people will stay in Hell (be destroyed) because of their (evil) deeds, and some will be cut or torn by the hooks (and fall into Hell) and some will be punished and then relieved. When Allah has finished His Judgments among the people, He will take whomever He will out of Hell through His Mercy. He will then order the angels to take out of the Fire all those who used to worship none but Allah from among those whom Allah wanted to be merciful to and those who testified (in the world) that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah. The angels will recognize them in the Fire by the marks of prostration (on their foreheads), for the Fire will eat up all the human body except the mark caused by prostration as Allah has forbidden the Fire to eat the mark of prostration. They will come out of the (Hell) Fire, completely burnt and then the water of life will be poured over them and they will grow under it as does a seed that comes in the mud of the torrent. Then Allah will finish the judgments among the people, and there will remain one man facing the (Hell) Fire and he will be the last person among the people of Hell to enter Paradise. He will say, 'O my Lord! Please turn my face away from the fire because its air has hurt me and its severe heat has burnt me.' So he will invoke Allah in the way Allah will wish him to invoke, and then Allah will say to him, 'If I grant you that, will you then ask for anything else?' He will reply, 'No, by Your Power, (Honor) I will not ask You for anything else.' He will give his Lord whatever promises and covenants Allah will demand. So Allah will turn his face away from Hell (Fire). When he will face Paradise and will see it, he will remain quiet for as long as Allah will wish him to remain quiet, then he will say, 'O my Lord! Bring me near to the gate of Paradise.' Allah will say to him, 'Didn't you give your promises and covenants that you would never ask for anything more than what you had been given? Woe on you, O Adam's son! How treacherous you are!' He will say, 'O my lord,' and will keep on invoking Allah till He says to him, 'If I give what you are asking, will you then ask for anything else?' He will reply, 'No, by Your (Honor) Power, I will not ask for anything else.' Then he will give covenants and promises to Allah and then Allah will bring him near to the gate of Paradise. When he stands at the gate of Paradise, Paradise will be opened and spread before him, and he will see its splendor and pleasures whereupon he will remain quiet as long as Allah will wish him to remain quiet, and then he will say, O my Lord! Admit me into Paradise.' Allah will say, 'Didn't you give your covenants and promises that you would not ask for anything more than what you had been given?' Allah will say, 'Woe on you, O Adam's son! How treacherous you are! ' The man will say, 'O my Lord! Do not make me the most miserable of Your creation,' and he will keep on invoking Allah till Allah will laugh because of his sayings, and when Allah will laugh because of him, He will say to him, 'Enter Paradise,' and when he will enter it, Allah will say to him, 'Wish for anything.' So he will ask his Lord, and he will wish for a great number of things, for Allah Himself will remind him to wish for certain things by saying, '(Wish for) so-and-so.' When there is nothing more to wish for, Allah will say, 'This is for you, and its equal (is for you) as well." 'Ata' bin Yazid added: Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri who was present with Abu Huraira, did not deny whatever the latter said, but when Abu Huraira said that Allah had said, "That is for you and its equal as well," Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri said, "And ten times as much, O Abu Huraira!" Abu Huraira said, "I do not remember, except his saying, 'That is for you and its equal as well.'" Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri then said, "I testify that I remember the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, 'That is for you, and ten times as much.' ' Abu Huraira then added, "That man will be the last person of the people of Paradise to enter Paradise
hi: Ata bin Yazid Al-Laithi, Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke hawaale se, bataate hain: Logon ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya hum Qayamat ke din apne Rab ko dekhenge?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Kya tumhein chaudhvin raat ki raat mein chaand dekhne mein koi mushkil hoti hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Nahi, Aye Allah ke Rasool.' Unhone kaha, 'Kya tumhein baadal na hone par suraj dekhne mein koi mushkil hoti hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Nahi, Aye Allah ke Rasool.' Unhone kaha, 'To tum use waise hi dekhoge. Allah Qayamat ke din sab logon ko jama karega, aur kahega, "Jisne bhi kisi cheez ki ibaadat ki (duniya mein), use uski pairvi karni chaahiye," isliye, jisne suraj ki ibaadat ki, wo suraj ki pairvi karega, aur jisne chaand ki ibaadat ki, wo chaand ki pairvi karega, aur jisne kisi doosri (jhoothi) devi-but ki ibaadat ki, wo unki pairvi karega. Aur sirf yahi ummat apne neik logon (ya munaafiqon) ke saath rahegi. (Ravi Ibrahim ko shak hai.) Allah unke paas aayega aur kahega, "Main tumhaara Rab hoon." Wo (inkaar karke) kahenge, "Hum yahaan tab tak rahenge jab tak hamaara Rab na aaye, kyunke jab hamaara Rab aayega, hum use pehchaan lenge." To Allah unke paas apni us shakl mein aayega jise wo jaante hain, aur kahega, "Main tumhaara Rab hoon." Wo kahenge, "Tu hamaara Rab hai," isliye wo uski pairvi karenge. Phir Jahannam par ek pul bichhaaya jaayega. Main aur mere maanne wale isse paar hone wale sabse pehle log honge, aur us din koi bhi baat nahi karega siwaaye Rasoolon ke. Aur us din Rasoolon ki dua hogi, "Aye Allah, bacha! Bacha!" Jahannam mein (ya pul ke oopar) kaante honge jaise As-Sa'dan (kaantedaar paudhe) ke kaante. Kya tumne As-Sa'dan dekha hai?" Unhone jawab diya, "Haan, Aye Allah ke Rasool!" Unhone kaha, "To wo kaante As-Sa'dan ke kaanton jaise dikhenge, magar unki lambaai ka andaaza sirf Allah ko hi hai. Wo kaante logon ko unke amaal ke mutaabik khainch lenge. Kuch log apne (bure) amaal ki wajah se Jahannam mein reh jaayenge (barbaad ho jaayenge), aur kuch kaanton se kaate ya phaad diye jaayenge (aur Jahannam mein girenge) aur kuch ko saza dee jaayegi aur phir raahat di jaayegi. Jab Allah logon ke beech apna faisla poora kar lega, wo apni rehmat se jise chaahega Jahannam se nikaal lega. Phir wo farishton ko hukm dega ke wo un sab logon ko Aag se nikaalein jo sirf Allah ki ibaadat karte the, un logon mein se jinpar Allah reham karna chahega aur jinhone gawaahi di (duniya mein) ke Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi. Farishte unhein Aag mein sajde ke nishaanon (unke maathon par) se pehchaanenge, kyunke Aag insaani jism ke sab hissa jala degi siwaaye sajde ke nishaan ke, kyunke Allah ne Aag ko sajde ke nishaan jalaane se mana kiya hai. Wo (Jahannam ki) Aag se poori tarah jale hue nikalenge aur phir unpar zindagi ka paani daala jaayega aur wo uske neeche aise ugenge jaise seelaab ki mitti mein ek beej ugta hai. Phir Allah logon ke beech apna faisla poora karega, aur ek shaks bacha rahega jo Jahannam ki Aag ka saamna kar raha hoga aur wo Jahannam ke logon mein se sabse aakhri shaks hoga jo Jannat mein daakhil hoga. Wo kahega, "Aye mere Rab! Barah-e-meharbaani mera chehra aag se door kar do kyunke iski hawa ne mujhe takleef pahunchaayi hai aur iski sakht garmi ne mujhe jala diya hai." To wo Allah se usi tareeke se dua karega jaisa Allah chahega, aur phir Allah usse kahega, "Agar main tumhein ye de doon, to kya tum kisi aur cheez ke liye maangoge?" Wo jawab dega, "Nahi, teri Qudrat (Izzat) ki qasam, main tujhse kuch aur nahi maangunga." Wo apne Rab ko jitne bhi waade aur ahad chaahiye denge. To Allah uska chehra Jahannam se door kar dega. Jab wo Jannat ki taraf muh karega aur use dekhega, wo utni der khaamosh rahega jitna Allah chahega, phir wo kahega, "Aye mere Rab! Mujhe Jannat ke darwaaze ke qareeb le jaao." Allah usse kahega, "Kya tumne waade aur ahad nahi diye the ke tum jo tumhein diya gaya hai usse zyaada kabhi kuch nahi maangoge? Afsos hai tumpar, Aye Aadam ke bete! Tum kitne be-imaan ho!" Wo kahega, "Aye mere Rab," aur Allah se dua karta rahega yahaan tak ke Allah usse kahega, "Agar main jo tum maang rahe ho de doon, to kya tum kisi aur cheez ke liye maangoge?" Wo jawab dega, "Nahi, teri (Izzat) Qudrat ki qasam, main kisi aur cheez ke liye nahi maangunga." Phir wo Allah ko waade aur ahad dega aur phir Allah use Jannat ke darwaaze ke qareeb le jaayega. Jab wo Jannat ke darwaaze par khada hoga, Jannat khol di jaayegi aur uske saamne phaila di jaayegi, aur wo uski shaan-o-shaukat aur khushiyaan dekhega jispar wo utni der khaamosh rahega jitna Allah chahega, aur phir wo kahega, "Aye mere Rab! Mujhe Jannat mein daakhil kar." Allah kahega, "Kya tumne waade aur ahad nahi diye the ke tum jo tumhein diya gaya hai usse zyaada kabhi kuch nahi maangoge?" Allah kahega, "Afsos hai tumpar, Aye Aadam ke bete! Tum kitne be-imaan ho!" Wo shaks kahega, "Aye mere Rab! Mujhe apni makhlooq mein sabse zyaada badnaseeb mat bana," aur wo Allah se dua karta rahega jab tak Allah uski baaton par hans na de, aur jab Allah uspar hansega, wo usse kahega, "Jannat mein daakhil ho jaao," aur jab wo isme daakhil hoga, Allah usse kahega, "Kisi bhi cheez ki tamanna karo." To wo apne Rab se maangaega, aur wo bahut si cheezon ki tamanna karega, kyunke Allah khud use kuch cheezon ki tamanna karna yaad dilaayega, kehte hue, "(Tamanna karo) falaan-falaan." Jab tamanna karne ke liye kuch aur nahi bacha, Allah kahega, "Ye tumhaare liye hai, aur uska barabar (bhi tumhaare liye) hai."' Ata bin Yazid ne izaafa kiya: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ), jo Abu Huraira ke saath maujood the, unhone jo bhi Abu Huraira ne kaha usse inkaar nahi kiya, magar jab Abu Huraira ne kaha ke Allah ne kaha, 'Ye tumhaare liye hai aur uska barabar bhi,' Abu Saeed Al-Khudri ne kaha, 'Aur dus guna zyaada bhi, Aye Abu Huraira!' Abu Huraira ne kaha, 'Mujhe yaad nahi, siwaaye unke kehne ke, "Ye tumhaare liye hai aur uska barabar bhi."' Abu Saeed Al-Khudri ne phir kaha, 'Main gawaahi deta hoon ke mujhe yaad hai Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, "Ye tumhaare liye hai, aur dus guna zyaada bhi."' Abu Huraira ne phir izaafa kiya, 'Wo shaks Jannat ke logon mein sabse aakhri hoga jo Jannat mein daakhil hoga.'

e: Narrated Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri: We said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shall we see our Lord on the Day of Resurrection?" He said, "Do you have any difficulty in seeing the sun and the moon when the sky is clear?" We said, "No." He said, "So you will have no difficulty in seeing your Lord on that Day as you have no difficulty in seeing the sun and the moon (in a clear sky)." The Prophet then said, "Somebody will then announce, 'Let every nation follow what they used to worship.' So the companions of the cross will go with their cross, and the idolators (will go) with their idols, and the companions of every god (false deities) (will go) with their god, till there remain those who used to worship Allah, both the obedient ones and the mischievous ones, and some of the people of the Scripture. Then Hell will be presented to them as if it were a mirage. Then it will be said to the Jews, "What did you use to worship?' They will reply, 'We used to worship Ezra, the son of Allah.' It will be said to them, 'You are liars, for Allah has neither a wife nor a son. What do you want (now)?' They will reply, 'We want You to provide us with water.' Then it will be said to them 'Drink,' and they will fall down in Hell (instead). Then it will be said to the Christians, 'What did you use to worship?' They will reply, 'We used to worship Messiah, the son of Allah.' It will be said, 'You are liars, for Allah has neither a wife nor a son. What: do you want (now)?' They will say, 'We want You to provide us with water.' It will be said to them, 'Drink,' and they will fall down in Hell (instead). When there remain only those who used to worship Allah (Alone), both the obedient ones and the mischievous ones, it will be said to them, 'What keeps you here when all the people have gone?' They will say, 'We parted with them (in the world) when we were in greater need of them than we are today, we heard the call of one proclaiming, 'Let every nation follow what they used to worship,' and now we are waiting for our Lord.' Then the Almighty will come to them in a shape other than the one which they saw the first time, and He will say, 'I am your Lord,' and they will say, 'You are not our Lord.' And none will speak: to Him then but the Prophets, and then it will be said to them, 'Do you know any sign by which you can recognize Him?' They will say. 'The Shin,' and so Allah will then uncover His Shin whereupon every believer will prostrate before Him and there will remain those who used to prostrate before Him just for showing off and for gaining good reputation. These people will try to prostrate but their backs will be rigid like one piece of a wood (and they will not be able to prostrate). Then the bridge will be laid across Hell." We, the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What is the bridge?' He said, "It is a slippery (bridge) on which there are clamps and (Hooks like) a thorny seed that is wide at one side and narrow at the other and has thorns with bent ends. Such a thorny seed is found in Najd and is called As-Sa'dan. Some of the believers will cross the bridge as quickly as the wink of an eye, some others as quick as lightning, a strong wind, fast horses or she-camels. So some will be safe without any harm; some will be safe after receiving some scratches, and some will fall down into Hell (Fire). The last person will cross by being dragged (over the bridge)." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You (Muslims) cannot be more pressing in claiming from me a right that has been clearly proved to be yours than the believers in interceding with Almighty for their (Muslim) brothers on that Day, when they see themselves safe. They will say, 'O Allah! (Save) our brothers (for they) used to pray with us, fast with us and also do good deeds with us.' Allah will say, 'Go and take out (of Hell) anyone in whose heart you find faith equal to the weight of one (gold) Dinar.' Allah will forbid the Fire to burn the faces of those sinners. They will go to them and find some of them in Hell (Fire) up to their feet, and some up to the middle of their legs. So they will take out those whom they will recognize and then they will return, and Allah will say (to them), 'Go and take out (of Hell) anyone in whose heart you find faith equal to the weight of one half Dinar.' They will take out whomever they will recognize and return, and then Allah will say, 'Go and take out (of Hell) anyone in whose heart you find faith equal to the weight of an atom (or a smallest ant), and so they will take out all those whom they will recognize." Abu Sa'id said: If you do not believe me then read the Holy Verse:-- 'Surely! Allah wrongs not even of the weight of an atom (or a smallest ant) but if there is any good (done) He doubles it.' (4.40) The Prophet added, "Then the prophets and Angels and the believers will intercede, and (last of all) the Almighty (Allah) will say, 'Now remains My Intercession. He will then hold a handful of the Fire from which He will take out some people whose bodies have been burnt, and they will be thrown into a river at the entrance of Paradise, called the water of life. They will grow on its banks, as a seed carried by the torrent grows. You have noticed how it grows beside a rock or beside a tree, and how the side facing the sun is usually green while the side facing the shade is white. Those people will come out (of the River of Life) like pearls, and they will have (golden) necklaces, and then they will enter Paradise whereupon the people of Paradise will say, 'These are the people emancipated by the Beneficent. He has admitted them into Paradise without them having done any good deeds and without sending forth any good (for themselves).' Then it will be said to them, 'For you is what you have seen and its equivalent as well
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Humne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya hum Qayamat ke din apne Rab ko dekhenge?' Unhone kaha, 'Kya tumhein saaf aasmaan mein suraj aur chaand dekhne mein koi mushkil hoti hai?' Humne kaha, 'Nahi.' Unhone kaha, 'To tumhein us din apne Rab ko dekhne mein bhi koi mushkil nahi hogi jaisi tumhein suraj aur chaand ko (saaf aasmaan mein) dekhne mein nahi hoti.' Phir Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Phir koi elaan karega, "Har ummat jiski ibaadat karti thi uski pairvi kare." To salib waale apni salib le kar jaayenge, aur but-parast apne buton ke saath, aur har (jhoothe) but ke pujaari apne but ke saath, yahaan tak ke sirf wahi bache jo Allah ki ibaadat karte the, farmaanbardaar bhi aur badkaar bhi, aur Ahl-e-Kitaab mein se kuch log. Phir Jahannam unke saamne pesh ki jaayegi jaise ek mrigmarichika ho. Phir Yahudiyon se kaha jaayega, "Tum kya ibaadat karte the?" Wo jawab denge, "Hum Uzair ki ibaadat karte the, Allah ke bete ki." Unse kaha jaayega, "Tum jhoote ho, kyunke Allah ki na biwi hai na beta. Tum ab kya chahte ho?" Wo kahenge, "Hum chahte hain ke tu humein paani de." Unhein kaha jaayega, "Piyo," aur (Jahannam mein) gir jaayenge. Phir Isaaiyon se kaha jaayega, "Tum kya ibaadat karte the?" Wo jawab denge, "Hum Maseeh, Allah ke bete, ki ibaadat karte the." Unse kaha jaayega, "Tum jhoote ho, kyunke Allah ki na biwi hai na beta. Tum ab kya chahte ho?" Wo kahenge, "Hum chahte hain ke tu humein paani de." Unhein kaha jaayega, "Piyo," aur wo (Jahannam mein) gir jaayenge. Jab sirf wahi log bachenge jo (akele) Allah ki ibaadat karte the, farmaanbardaar bhi aur badkaar bhi, unse kaha jaayega, "Jab sab log chale gaye hain, tum yahaan kis liye ruke ho?" Wo kahenge, "Hum unse (duniya mein) alag ho gaye the jab humein unki zaroorat aaj se zyaada thi, aur humne ek awaaz suni jo ye elaan kar rahi thi, 'Har ummat jiski wo ibaadat karti thi uski pairvi kare,' aur ab hum apne Rab ka intezaar kar rahe hain." Phir Qaadir-e-Mutlaq unke paas kisi aur soorat mein aayega jise unhone pehli baar dekha tha, aur wo kahega, "Main tumhaara Rab hoon," aur wo kahenge, "Tu hamaara Rab nahi hai." Aur us waqt koi bhi unse baat nahi karega siwaaye Rasoolon ke, aur phir unse kaha jaayega, "Kya tumhein koi nishaani pata hai jisse tum use pehchaan sako?" Wo kahenge, "Pindli," aur Allah apni Pindli zaahir karega, jispar har Momin uske saamne sajda karega aur wo log jo dikhaawe aur naam ke liye sajda karte the, wo bhi rah jaayenge. Ye log sajda karne ki koshish karenge magar unki peeth ek lakdi ke tukde jaisi sakht ho jaayegi (aur wo sajda nahi kar paayenge). Phir Jahannam par ek pul bichhaaya jaayega.' Hum, Nabi (SAW) ke sahaaba, ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Ye pul kya hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Ye ek phisalne wala pul hai jispar clamp (aankte) hain aur (As-Sa'dan ke kaanton jaise) ek kaantedaar beej hai jo ek taraf se chauda aur doosri taraf se sankra hai aur jiske kaante mude hue hain. Aisa kaantedaar beej Najd mein milta hai aur use As-Sa'dan kehte hain. Kuch Momin pul ko itni tezi se paar karenge jitni ek palak jhapakne mein hoti hai, kuch aur bijli jitni tezi se, kuch tez hawa jitni tezi se, kuch tez ghode ya oontniyon jitni tezi se. To kuch bina kisi nuqsaan ke mehfooz honge; kuch kuch khursanche paate hue mehfooz honge, aur kuch Jahannam ki Aag mein gir jaayenge. Aakhri shaks (pul par se) ghaseeta jaayega.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Tum (Musalmaan) mujhse apna wo haq maangne mein utne zor se dabaao nahi daal sakte jitna Momin us din Qaadir-e-Mutlaq se apne (Musalmaan) bhaiyon ke liye sifaarish karte hue dabaao daalenge, jab wo apne aap ko mehfooz dekhenge. Wo kahenge, "Aye Allah! (Bachao) hamare bhaiyon ko (kyunke wo) hamare saath namaz padhte the, hamare saath roza rakhte the aur hamare saath nek amaal karte the." Allah kahega, "Jaao aur (Jahannam se) us har shaks ko nikaalo jiske dil mein tum ek (sone ka) Dinar jitna Iman paao." Allah gunahgaaron ke chehron ko Aag se jalne se rokega. Wo unke paas jaayenge aur unmein se kuch ko Jahannam mein apne pairon tak paayenge, aur kuch ko unki taango ke beech tak. To wo unhein nikaalenge jinhein wo pehchaanenge aur phir wapas aayenge, aur Allah kahega (unse), "Jaao aur (Jahannam se) har us shaks ko nikaalo jiske dil mein tum aadha Dinar jitna Iman paao." Wo unhein nikaalenge jinhein wo pehchaanenge aur wapas aayenge, aur phir Allah kahega, "Jaao aur (Jahannam se) har us shaks ko nikaalo jiske dil mein tum ek zarre (ya sabse chhoti chionti) jitna Iman paao," aur isi tarah wo un sabko nikaalenge jinhein wo pehchaanenge.' Abu Saeed ne kaha: Agar tum mujhpar bharosa nahi karte, to ye Muqaddas Aayat padho: 'Beshak! Allah zulm nahi karta, ek zarre (ya chhoti chionti) jitna bhi, magar agar koi achhaai (ki gayi) hai, to wo use dogaana kar deta hai.' (4:40) Nabi (SAW) ne izaafa kiya, 'Phir Nabi log, Farishte, aur Momin sifaarish karenge, aur (sabse aakhir mein) Qaadir-e-Mutlaq (Allah) kahega, "Ab meri Sifaarish baaki hai." Phir wo Aag ki ek muthhi pakdega jismein se wo kuch aise logon ko nikaalega jinke jism jal gaye hain, aur unhein Jannat ke daakhil hone waale raaste par ek nadi mein phenka jaayega, jise Zindagi ka Paani kehte hain. Wo uske kinaaron par ugenge, jaise seelaab dwara laaya gaya ek beej ugta hai. Tumne notice kiya hai kaise ye ek chattaan ya darakht ke qareeb ugta hai, aur kaise suraj ki taraf waali janib usually hari hoti hai jabke saaye ki taraf waali janib safed hoti hai. Wo log (Zindagi ki Nadi se) motiyon jaisa nikalenge, aur unke gale mein (sone ke) haar honge, aur phir wo Jannat mein daakhil honge jispar Jannat waale kahenge, "Ye wo log hain jinhein Rehmaan ne azaad kiya hai. Usne unhein bina koi nek amal kiye ya koi bhalaai aage bheje (apne liye) Jannat mein daakhil kiya hai." Phir unse kaha jaayega, "Tumhaare liye wo hai jo tumne dekha hai aur uska barabar bhi."'

e: Narrated Anas: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The believers will be kept (waiting) on the Day of Resurrection so long that they will become worried and say, "Let us ask somebody to intercede far us with our Lord so that He may relieve us from our place. Then they will go to Adam and say, 'You are Adam, the father of the people. Allah created you with His Own Hand and made you reside in His Paradise and ordered His angels to prostrate before you, and taught you the names of all things will you intercede for us with your Lord so that He may relieve us from this place of ours? Adam will say, 'I am not fit for this undertaking.' He will mention his mistakes he had committed, i.e., his eating off the tree though he had been forbidden to do so. He will add, 'Go to Noah, the first prophet sent by Allah to the people of the Earth.' The people will go to Noah who will say, 'I am not fit for this undertaking' He will mention his mistake which he had done, i.e., his asking his Lord without knowledge.' He will say (to them), 'Go to Abraham, Khalil Ar-Rahman.' They will go to Abraham who will say, 'I am not fit for this undertaking. He would mention three words by which he told a lie, and say (to them). 'Go to Moses, a slave whom Allah gave the Torah and spoke to, directly and brought near Him, for conversation.' They will go to Moses who will say, 'I am not fit for this undertaking. He will mention his mistake he made, i.e., killing a person, and will say (to them), 'Go to Jesus, Allah's slave and His Apostle, and a soul created by Him and His Word.' (Be: And it was.) They will go to Jesus who will say, 'I am not fit for this undertaking but you'd better go to Muhammad the slave whose past and future sins have been forgiven by Allah.' So they will come to me, and I will ask my Lord's permission to enter His House and then I will be permitted. When I see Him I will fall down in prostration before Him, and He will leave me (in prostration) as long as He will, and then He will say, 'O Muhammad, lift up your head and speak, for you will be listened to, and intercede, for your intercession will be accepted, and ask (for anything) for it will be granted:' Then I will raise my head and glorify my Lord with certain praises which He has taught me. Allah will put a limit for me (to intercede for a certain type of people) I will take them out and make them enter Paradise." (Qatada said: I heard Anas saying that), the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I will go out and take them out of Hell (Fire) and let them enter Paradise, and then I will return and ask my Lord for permission to enter His House and I will be permitted. When I will see Him I will fall down in prostration before Him and He will leave me in prostration as long as He will let me (in that state), and then He will say, 'O Muhammad, raise your head and speak, for you will be listened to, and intercede, for your intercession will be accepted, and ask, your request will be granted.' " The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "So I will raise my head and glorify and praise Him as He has taught me. Then I will intercede and He will put a limit for me (to intercede for a certain type of people). I will take them out and let them enter Paradise." (Qatada added: I heard Anas saying that) the Prophet said, 'I will go out and take them out of Hell (Fire) and let them enter Paradise, and I will return for the third time and will ask my Lord for permission to enter His house, and I will be allowed to enter. When I see Him, I will fall down in prostration before Him, and will remain in prostration as long as He will, and then He will say, 'Raise your head, O Muhammad, and speak, for you will be listened to, and intercede, for your intercession will be accepted, and ask, for your request will be granted.' So I will raise my head and praise Allah as He has taught me and then I will intercede and He will put a limit for me (to intercede for a certain type of people). I will take them out and let them enter Paradise." (Qatada said: I heard Anas saying that) the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "So I will go out and take them out of Hell (Fire) and let them enter Paradise, till none will remain in the Fire except those whom Quran will imprison (i.e., those who are destined for eternal life in the fire)." The narrator then recited the Verse:-- "It may be that your Lord will raise you to a Station of Praise and Glory.' (17.79) The narrator added: This is the Station of Praise and Glory which Allah has promised to your Prophet
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Momineen ko Qayamat ke din itni der tak intezaar mein rakha jaayega ke wo pareshaan ho jaayenge aur kahenge, "Chalo hum kisi se guzaarish karein hamare Rab ke saamne sifaarish karne ke liye taake wo humein hamaari is jagah se raahat de." Phir wo Aadam ke paas jaayenge aur kahenge, "Aap Aadam hain, logon ke baap. Allah ne aapko apne khud ke Haath se banaaya aur aapko apni Jannat mein rehne diya aur apne farishton ko aapke saamne sajda karne ka hukm diya, aur aapko sab cheezon ke naam sikhaaye; kya aap hamaare Rab se hamaari sifaarish karenge taake wo humein hamaari is jagah se raahat de?" Aadam kahenge, "Main is kaam ke laayak nahi." Wo apni galtiyaan yaad karenge jo unhone ki thi, yaani darakht se khaana halaanke unhein mana kiya gaya tha. Wo izaafa karenge, "Nuh ke paas jaao, pehle Rasool jo Allah ne zameen ke logon ke paas bheje." Log Nuh ke paas jaayenge jo kahenge, "Main is kaam ke laayak nahi." Wo apni galti yaad karenge jo unhone ki thi, yaani apne Rab se bina ilm ke sawaal poochna. Wo kahenge (unse), "Ibrahim ke paas jaao, Khalil Ar-Rahman." Wo Ibrahim ke paas jaayenge jo kahenge, "Main is kaam ke laayak nahi." Wo teen baaton ka zikr karenge jinse unhone jhoot bola, aur kahenge (unse), "Musa ke paas jaao, ek bandaa jise Allah ne Taurat di aur jisse usne seedhe baat ki, aur baat-cheet ke liye apne qareeb bulaaya." Wo Musa ke paas jaayenge jo kahenge, "Main is kaam ke laayak nahi." Wo apni galti yaad karenge jo unhone ki thi, yaani ek shaks ko qatl karna, aur kahenge (unse), "Isa ke paas jaao, Allah ke bandaa aur uske Rasool aur uski taraf se paida ki gayi ek Rooh aur uski Kalima (Ho: aur wo hua)." Wo Isa ke paas jaayenge jo kahenge, "Main is kaam ke laayak nahi, magar tumhein Muhammad ke paas jaana chaahiye, wo bandaa jiske pichhle aur aane wale gunaah Allah dwara maaf kar diye gaye hain." To wo mere paas aayenge, aur main apne Rab ke Ghar mein daakhil hone ki ijaazat maangunga aur phir mujhe ijaazat mil jaayegi. Jab main use dekhunga main uske saamne sajda mein gir jaunga, aur wo mujhe (sajde mein) jitni der chaahega chhod dega, aur phir wo kahega, "Aye Muhammad, apna sar uthaao aur bolo, kyunke tumhaari baat suni jaayegi, aur sifaarish karo, kyunke tumhaari sifaarish qubool ki jaayegi, aur maango (kisi bhi cheez ke liye) kyunke tumhaari (darkhwaast) di jaayegi." Phir main apna sar uthaunga aur apne Rab ki wo tareef karunga jo usne mujhe sikhaayi hai. Allah mere liye ek hadd taye karega (kuch qism ke logon ke liye sifaarish karne ke liye). Main unhein nikaalunga aur unhein Jannat mein daakhil karwaaunga.'
