(Qatada ne kaha: Maine Anas ko kehte suna ke) Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Main baahar jaunga aur unhein Jahannam ki Aag se nikaalunga aur unhein Jannat mein daakhil karwaaunga, aur phir main wapas aaunga aur apne Rab ke Ghar mein daakhil hone ki ijaazat maangunga aur mujhe ijaazat mil jaayegi. Jab main use dekhunga main uske saamne sajda mein gir jaunga aur wo mujhe (us haalat mein) jitni der chaahega sajde mein chhod dega, aur phir wo kahega, "Aye Muhammad, apna sar uthaao aur bolo, kyunke tumhaari baat suni jaayegi, aur sifaarish karo, kyunke tumhaari sifaarish qubool ki jaayegi, aur maango, tumhaari darkhwaast di jaayegi."' Nabi (SAW) ne izaafa kiya, 'To main apna sar uthaunga aur usse waise hi Tareef aur Tasbeeh karunga jaisa usne mujhe sikhaaya hai. Phir main sifaarish karunga aur wo mere liye ek hadd taye karega (kuch qism ke logon ke liye sifaarish karne ke liye). Main unhein nikaalunga aur unhein Jannat mein daakhil karwaaunga.' (Qatada ne izaafa kiya: Maine Anas ko kehte suna ke) Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Main baahar jaunga aur unhein Jahannam ki Aag se nikaalunga aur unhein Jannat mein daakhil karwaaunga, aur main teesri baar wapas aaunga aur apne Rab ke Ghar mein daakhil hone ki ijaazat maangunga, aur mujhe daakhil hone ki ijaazat di jaayegi. Jab main use dekhunga, main uske saamne sajda mein gir jaunga, aur wo mujhe (usi haalat mein) jitni der chaahega chhod dega, aur phir wo kahega, "Apna sar uthaao, Aye Muhammad, aur bolo, kyunke tumhaari baat suni jaayegi, aur sifaarish karo, kyunke tumhaari sifaarish qubool ki jaayegi, aur maango, kyunke tumhaari darkhwaast di jaayegi." To main apna sar uthaunga aur Allah ki tareef karunga jaisa usne mujhe sikhaaya hai aur phir main sifaarish karunga aur wo mere liye ek hadd taye karega (kuch qism ke logon ke liye sifaarish karne ke liye). Main unhein nikaalunga aur unhein Jannat mein daakhil karwaaunga.' (Qatada ne kaha: Maine Anas ko kehte suna ke) Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'To main baahar jaunga aur unhein Jahannam ki Aag se nikaalunga aur unhein Jannat mein daakhil karwaaunga, yahaan tak ke Aag mein sirf wahi log rahenge jinhein Quran ne qaid kar rakha hoga (yaani wo log jo hamesha ke liye Aag mein rehne ke liye taye hain).' Ravi ne phir ye Aayat padhi: 'Ho sakta hai ke aapka Rab aapko ek Prashansit aur Buland jagah tak uthaaye.' (17:79) Ravi ne izaafa kiya: Ye wahi Prashansit aur Buland jagah hai jiska Allah ne aapke Nabi se waada kiya hai.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent for the Ansar and gathered them in a tent and said to them, "Be patient till you meet Allah and His Apostle, and I will be on the lake-Tank (Al-Kauthar)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ansaar ko bulwaaya aur unhein ek tambu mein jama kiya aur unse kaha, 'Sabra rakho jab tak tum Allah aur uske Rasool se mulaakaat na karo, aur main Hauz (Al-Kauthar) par hounga.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) offered his Tahajjud prayer, he would say, "O Allah, our Lord! All the praises are for You; You are the Keeper (Establisher or the One Who looks after) of the Heavens and the Earth. All the Praises are for You; You are the Light of the Heavens and the Earth and whatever is therein. You are the Truth, and Your saying is the Truth, and Your promise is the Truth, and the meeting with You is the Truth, and Paradise is the Truth, and the (Hell) Fire is the Truth. O Allah! I surrender myself to You, and believe in You, and I put my trust in You (solely depend upon). And to You I complain of my opponents and with Your Evidence I argue. So please forgive the sins which I have done in the past or I will do in the future, and also those (sins) which I did in secret or in public, and that which You know better than I. None has the right to be worshipped but You
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab bhi Nabi (SAW) apni Tahajjud namaz padhte, wo kehte, 'Aye Allah, hamare Rab! Sab tareef tere liye hai; Tu Aasmaanon aur Zameen ka Sambhaalne wala (Sthapak, ya Dekhne wala) hai. Sab tareef tere liye hai; Tu Aasmaanon aur Zameen ka Noor hai aur jo bhi unmein hai uska. Tu Haq hai, aur Tera Farmaan Haq hai, aur Tera Waada Haq hai, aur Tujhse mulaqaat Haq hai, aur Jannat Haq hai, aur (Jahannam ki) Aag Haq hai. Aye Allah! Main tere saamne khud ko supurd karta hoon, aur tujhpar Iman rakhta hoon, aur tujhpar bharosa (poori tarah nirbharta) karta hoon. Aur tujhse main apne mukhaalifon ki shikaayat karta hoon aur teri daleelon ke saath main jhagda karta hoon. Isliye barah-e-meharbaani mujhe wo gunaah maaf kar de jo maine ateet mein kiye ya mustaqbil mein karunga, aur wo bhi jo maine chupke se ya khule aam kiye, aur wo bhi jo tu mujhse zyaada jaanta hai. Tu hi mera akela Ma'bood hai (jiski main ibaadat karta hoon).'

e: Narrated `Adi bin Hatim:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "There will be none among you but his Lord will speak to him, and there will be no interpreter between them nor a screen to screen Him
hi: Adi bin Hatim (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Tum mein se koi bhi aisa nahi hoga jiske saath uska Rab baat na karega, aur unke beech koi mutarjim nahi hoga na koi parda jo Use chhupaaye.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Qais:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "(There will be) two Paradises of silver and all the utensils and whatever is therein (will be of silver); and two Paradises of gold, and its utensils and whatever therein (will be of gold), and there will be nothing to prevent the people from seeing their Lord except the Cover of Majesty over His Face in the Paradise of Eden (eternal bliss)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Qais bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, '(Wahaan) do Jannaten hongi chaandi ki aur unke sab bartan aur jo bhi unmein hai (chaandi ka hoga); aur do Jannaten sone ki, aur unke bartan aur jo bhi unmein hai (sone ka hoga), aur logon ko apne Rab ko dekhne se kuch bhi nahi rokega siwaaye Uski Buzurgi ka Parda Uske Chehre par, Aden ki (hamesha ki khushi ki) Jannat mein.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever takes the property of a Muslim by taking a false oath, will meet Allah Who will be angry with him." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) recited the Verse:-- 'Verily those who purchase a small gain at the cost of Allah's Covenant and their oaths, they shall have no portion in the Hereafter, neither will Allah speak to them, nor look at them
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi kisi Musalmaan ki jaayadaad jhoothi qasam khaakar le, wo Allah se milega jo usse gussa hoga.' Phir Nabi (SAW) ne ye Aayat padhi: 'Beshak wo log jo Allah ke ahad aur apni qasmon ke badle mein thodi cheez khareedte hain, unhein Aakhirat mein koi hissa nahi milega, na hi Allah unse baat karega, na hi unhein dekhega...'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "(There are) three (types of persons to whom) Allah will neither speak to them on the Day of Resurrections, nor look at them (They are):--(1) a man who takes a false oath that he has been offered for a commodity a price greater than what he has actually been offered; (2) and a man who takes a false oath after the `Asr (prayer) in order to grab the property of a Muslim through it; (3) and a man who forbids others to use the remaining superfluous water. To such a man Allah will say on the Day of Resurrection, 'Today I withhold My Blessings from you as you withheld the superfluous part of that (water) which your hands did not create
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, '(Teen qism ke log honge jinse) Allah Qayamat ke din baat nahi karega, na unhein dekhega (ye hain):-- (1) wo aadmi jo jhoothi qasam khaata hai ke usse kisi maal ke badle usse zyaada keemat di gayi thi jitni asal mein di gayi thi; (2) aur wo aadmi jo Asr ki namaz ke baad jhoothi qasam khaata hai kisi Musalmaan ki jaayadaad hadapne ke liye; (3) aur wo aadmi jo doosron ko bachi hui zaroorat se zyaada paani istemaal karne se rokta hai. Aise aadmi se Allah Qayamat ke din kahega, "Aaj main tumse apni barkaten rokta hoon jaise tumne us (paani) ka bacha hua hissa rokha jo tumhaare haathon ne nahi banaaya tha."'

e: Narrated Abu Bakra:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Time has come back to its original state which it had when Allah created the Heavens and the Earth, the year is twelve months, of which four are sacred; (and out of these four) three are in succession, namely, Dhul-Qa'da, Dhul-Hijja and Muharram, and (the fourth one) Rajab Mudar which is between Jumad (Ath-Tham) and Sha'ban." The Prophet (ﷺ) then asked us, "Which month is this?" We said, "Allah and His Apostle know (it) better." He kept quiet so long that we thought he might call it by another name. Then he said, "Isn't it Dhul-Hijja?" We said, "Yes." He asked "What town is this?" We said, "Allah and His Apostle know (it) better.' Then he kept quiet so long that we thought he might call it by another name. He then said, "Isn't it the (forbidden) town (Mecca)?" We said, "Yes." He asked, "What is the day today?" We said, "Allah and His Apostle know (it) better. Then he kept quiet so long that we thought that he might call it by another name. Then he said, "Isn't it the Day of An-Nahr (slaughtering of sacrifices)?" We said, "Yes." Then he said, "Your blood (lives), your properties," (the sub narrator Muhammad, said: I think he also said): "..and your honor) are as sacred to one another like the sanctity of this Day of yours, in this town of yours, in this month of yours. You shall meet your Lord and He will ask you about your deeds. Beware! Don't go astray after me by striking the necks of one another. Lo! It is incumbent upon those who are present to inform it to those who are absent for perhaps the informed one might comprehend it (understand it) better than some of the present audience." Whenever the sub-narrator Muhammad mentioned that statement, he would say, "The Prophet (ﷺ) said the truth.") And then the Prophet (ﷺ) added, "No doubt! Haven't I conveyed Allah's Message to you! No doubt! Haven't I conveyed Allah's Message to you?
hi: Abu Bakra (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Waqt apni asal haalat mein wapas aa gaya hai jaisa ye Allah ke Aasmaan aur Zameen banaane ke waqt tha, saal barah mahine ka hota hai, jinmein se chaar muqaddas hain; (aur in chaar mein se) teen lagataar hain, yaani Zul-Qa'da, Zul-Hijja, aur Muharram, aur (chautha) Rajab Mudar hai jo Jumaad (Ath-Thaani) aur Sha'baan ke beech hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne phir humse pucha, 'Ye kaunsa mahina hai?' Humne kaha, 'Allah aur uska Rasool behtar jaante hain.' Wo itni der khaamosh rahe ke humne socha wo shaayad isse koi doosra naam denge. Phir unhone kaha, 'Kya ye Zul-Hijja nahi hai?' Humne kaha, 'Haan.' Unhone pucha, 'Ye kaunsa shehar hai?' Humne kaha, 'Allah aur uska Rasool behtar jaante hain.' Phir wo itni der khaamosh rahe ke humne socha wo shaayad isse koi doosra naam denge. Phir unhone kaha, 'Kya ye (mana kiya hua) shehar nahi hai (Makkah)?' Humne kaha, 'Haan.' Unhone pucha, 'Aaj kaunsa din hai?' Humne kaha, 'Allah aur uska Rasool behtar jaante hain.' Phir wo itni der khaamosh rahe ke humne socha wo shaayad isse koi doosra naam denge. Phir unhone kaha, 'Kya ye Nahr ka din nahi hai?' Humne kaha, 'Haan.' Phir unhone kaha, 'Tumhaara khoon (jaan), tumhaari jaayadaad,' (Ravi Muhammad ne kaha: mujhe lagta hai unhone ye bhi kaha:) '...aur tumhaari izzat, ek doosre ke liye utni hi muqaddas hain jitni is din ki, is shehar mein, is mahine mein, hurmat hai. Tum apne Rab se miloge aur wo tumse tumhaare amaal ke baare mein poochega. Khabardaar! Mere baad bhatak mat jaana, ek doosre ki gardanein kaat kar. Suno! Jo bhi yahaan haazir hain unhein ye un logon tak pahunchaana chaahiye jo yahaan gair-haazir hain, kyunke shaayad jise ye baat pahunchaayi jaaye wo ise kuch haazireen se behtar samjhe.' Jab bhi ravi Muhammad ye baat zikr karte, wo kehte, 'Nabi (SAW) ne sach kaha.' Aur phir Nabi (SAW) ne izaafa kiya, 'Beshak! Kya maine tumhein Allah ka paighaam pahuncha nahi diya? Beshak! Kya maine tumhein Allah ka paighaam pahuncha nahi diya?'

e: Narrated Usama:A son of one of the daughters of the Prophet (ﷺ) was dying, so she sent a person to call the Prophet. He sent (her a message), "What ever Allah takes is for Him, and whatever He gives is for Him, and everything has a limited fixed term (in this world) so she should be patient and hope for Allah's reward." She then sent for him again, swearing that he should come. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got up, and so did Mu`adh bin Jabal, Ubai bin Ka`b and 'Ubada bin As-Samit. When he entered (the house), they gave the child to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while its breath was disturbed in his chest. (The sub-narrator said: I think he said, "...as if it was a water skin.") Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) started weeping whereupon Sa`d bin 'Ubada said, "Do you weep?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah is merciful only to those of His slaves who are merciful (to others)
hi: Usama bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ki ek beti ka beta mar raha tha, isliye unhone kisi ko Nabi (SAW) ko bulaane bheja. Unhone (usse) kaha, 'Jo bhi Allah leta hai wo uska hai, aur jo bhi wo deta hai wo uska hai, aur har cheez ka ek muqarrar waqt hai (is duniya mein) isliye use sabra rakhna chaahiye aur Allah ke ajr ki ummeed rakhni chaahiye.' Unhone phir usse dobara bulaaya, qasam khaate hue ke unhein aana hi hoga. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) uthe, aur unke saath Mu'adh bin Jabal (رضی اللہ عنہ), Ubai bin Ka'b (رضی اللہ عنہ), aur Ubada bin As-Samit bhi (uthe). Jab wo (ghar mein) daakhil hue, unhone bacche ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko diya jabke uski saans uske seene mein bhatak rahi thi. (Ravi ne kaha: Mujhe lagta hai unhone kaha, '...jaise wo ek mashk (paani ka thaila) ho.') Allah ke Rasool (SAW) rone lage, jispar Sa'd bin Ubada (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Kya aap rote hain?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Allah sirf un bandon par reham karta hai jo (doosron par) reham karte hain.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Paradise and Hell (Fire) quarrelled in the presence of their Lord. Paradise said, 'O Lord! What is wrong with me that only the poor and humble people enter me ?' Hell (Fire) said, I have been favored with the arrogant people.' So Allah said to Paradise, 'You are My Mercy,' and said to Hell, 'You are My Punishment which I inflict upon whom I wish, and I shall fill both of you.'" The Prophet added, "As for Paradise, (it will be filled with good people) because Allah does not wrong any of His created things, and He creates for Hell (Fire) whomever He will, and they will be thrown into it, and it will say thrice, 'Is there any more, till Allah (will put) His Foot over it and it will become full and its sides will come close to each other and it will say, 'Qat! Qat! Qat! (Enough! Enough! Enough)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jannat aur Jahannam (Aag) ne apne Rab ke saamne jhagda kiya. Jannat ne kaha, "Aye Rab! Mujhe kya hua hai ke sirf gareeb aur namrat log hi mujhme daakhil hote hain?" Jahannam ne kaha, "Mujhe ghamandi logon se nawaaza gaya hai." To Allah ne Jannat se kaha, "Tu Meri Rehmat hai," aur Jahannam se kaha, "Tu Meri Saza hai jo main jise chaahun uspar daalta hoon, aur main tum dono ko bhar dunga."' Nabi (SAW) ne izaafa kiya, 'Jahaan tak Jannat ki baat hai, (ise achhe logon se bhara jaayega) kyunke Allah apni banaayi hui kisi bhi cheez ke saath zulm nahi karta, aur wo Jahannam ke liye jise chaahega paida karega, aur unhein usme phenka jaayega, aur ye teen baar kahegi, "Kya aur bhi hai?" jab tak Allah (apna) Qadam usmein na rakhe aur ye bhar jaaye aur iske hisse ek doosre ke qareeb aa jaayein aur ye kahe, "Qat! Qat! Qat! (Bas! Bas! Bas!)"'

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Some people will be scorched by Hell (Fire) as a punishment for sins they have committed, and then Allah will admit them into Paradise by the grant of His Mercy. These people will be called, 'Al-Jahannamiyyin' (the people of Hell)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kuch log Jahannam ki Aag mein jhulasenge unke gunaahon ki saza ke taur par, aur phir Allah unhein apni Rehmat ki wajah se Jannat mein daakhil karega. Ye log "Al-Jahannamiyyin" (Jahannam ke log) kehlaayenge.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:A Jewish Rabbi came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Muhammad! Allah will put the Heavens on one finger and the earth on one finger, and the trees and the rivers on one finger, and the rest of the creation on one finger, and then will say, pointing out with His Hand, 'I am the King.' "On that Allah's Apostle smiled and said, "No just estimate have they made of Allah such as due to Him
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek Yahudi Rabbi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Aye Muhammad! Allah Aasmaanon ko ek Ungli par rakhega, aur zameen ko ek Ungli par, aur darakhton aur nadiyon ko ek Ungli par, aur baaki sab makhlooq ko ek Ungli par, aur phir apne Haath se ishara karte hue kahega, "Main Baadshah hoon."' Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) muskuraaye aur kaha, 'Unhone Allah ka jaisa haq hai waisa andaaza nahi lagaaya.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Once I stayed overnight at the house of (my aunt ) Maimuna while the Prophet (ﷺ) was with her, to see how was the night prayer of Allah's Apostle Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) talked to his wife for a while and then slept. When it was the last third of the night (or part of it), the Prophet (ﷺ) got up and looked towards the sky and recited the Verse:-- 'Verily! In the creation of the Heavens and the Earth....there are indeed signs for the men of understanding.' (3.190) Then He got up and performed the ablution, brushed his teeth and offered eleven rak`at. Then Bilal pronounced the Adhan whereupon the Prophet (ﷺ) offered a two-rak`at (Sunna) prayer and went out to lead the people in Fajr (morning compulsory congregational prayer)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar main apni khaala Maimuna (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke ghar raat guzaari jabke Nabi (SAW) unke saath the, ye dekhne ke liye ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki raat ki namaz kaisi hoti hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apni biwi se thodi der baat ki aur phir so gaye. Jab raat ka aakhri tihaai hissa (ya uska kuch hissa) aaya, Nabi (SAW) uthe aur aasmaan ki taraf dekha aur ye Aayat padhi: 'Beshak! Aasmaanon aur Zameen ki takhleeq mein...beshak aqlmand logon ke liye nishaaniyaan hain.' (3:190) Phir wo uthe aur wuzu kiya, apne daant saaf kiye, aur gyaarah rakat padhi. Phir Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Azaan di, jispar Nabi (SAW) ne do rakat (Sunnat) namaz padhi aur logon ko Fajr (farz jamaat ki subah ki namaz) padhaane baahar gaye.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When Allah created the creations, He wrote with Him on His Throne: 'My Mercy has preceded My Anger
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab Allah ne makhlooqaat banaayi, usne apne paas apne Arsh (Takht) par likha: "Meri Rehmat Meri Naaraazgi se pehle hai."'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Mas`ud:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) the true and truly inspired, narrated to us, "The creation of everyone of you starts with the process of collecting the material for his body within forty days and forty nights in the womb of his mother. Then he becomes a clot of thick blood for a similar period (40 days) and then he becomes like a piece of flesh for a similar period. Then an angel is sent to him (by Allah) and the angel is allowed (ordered) to write four things; his livelihood, his (date of) death, his deeds, and whether he will be a wretched one or a blessed one (in the Hereafter) and then the soul is breathed into him. So one of you may do (good) deeds characteristic of the people of Paradise so much that there is nothing except a cubit between him and Paradise but then what has been written for him decides his behavior and he starts doing (evil) deeds characteristic of the people of Hell (Fire) and (ultimately) enters Hell (Fire); and one of you may do (evil) deeds characteristic of the people of Hell (Fire) so much so that there is nothing except a cubit between him and Hell (Fire), then what has been written for him decides his behavior and he starts doing (good) deeds characteristic of the people of Paradise and ultimately) enters Paradise." (See Hadith No. 430, Vol)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Masud bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW), jo sachche aur waaqai Ilaahi Wahi paane wale hain, ne humein bataya, 'Tum mein se har ek ki takhleeq iske jism ke maadde ko jama karne se shuru hoti hai, chaalis din aur chaalis raaton tak apni maa ke garbh mein. Phir wo utni hi muddat (40 din) ke liye gaadhe khoon ka thakka ban jaata hai, aur phir wo utni hi muddat ke liye gosht ka ek tukda ban jaata hai. Phir ek farishta uske paas bheja jaata hai (Allah dwara) aur farishte ko chaar cheezein likhne ki ijaazat (hukm) di jaati hai: uski rozi, uski (maut ki) taareekh, uske amaal, aur wo badnaseeb hoga ya khushnaseeb (Aakhirat mein) hoga, aur phir usmein Rooh phoonki jaati hai. Isliye tum mein se koi Jannat ke logon jaise (achhe) amaal karta rahega yahaan tak ke uske aur Jannat ke beech sirf ek haath ki doori reh jaaye, magar phir jo uske liye likha ja chuka hai wo uske vyavahaar ka faisla karta hai aur wo Jahannam ke logon jaise (bure) amaal karne lagta hai aur (aakhirkaar) Jahannam mein daakhil hota hai; aur tum mein se koi Jahannam ke logon jaise (bure) amaal karta rahega yahaan tak ke uske aur Jahannam ke beech sirf ek haath ki doori reh jaaye, phir jo uske liye likha ja chuka hai wo uske vyavahaar ka faisla karta hai aur wo Jannat ke logon jaise (achhe) amaal karne lagta hai aur (aakhirkaar) Jannat mein daakhil hota hai.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 430, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Gabriel, what prevents you. from visiting us more often than you do?" Then this Verse was revealed:--'And we angels descend not but by Command of your Lord. To Him belongs what is before us and what is behind us..' (19.64) So this was the answer to Muhammad
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Aye Jibrael, tumhein humse zyaada milne aane se kya rokta hai?' Phir ye Aayat naazil hui: 'Aur hum (farishte) sirf tumhaare Rab ke hukm se hi utarte hain. Jo humaare saamne hai aur jo humaare peechhe hai uska maalik wahi hai...' (19:64) To ye Muhammad ka jawab tha.

e: Narrated `Abdullah:While I was walking with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in one of the fields of Medina and he was walking leaning on a stick, he passed a group of Jews. Some of them said to the others, "Ask him (the Prophet) about the spirit." Others said, "Do not ask him." But they asked him and he stood leaning on the stick and I was standing behind him and I thought that he was being divinely inspired. Then he said, "They ask you concerning the spirit say: The spirit, its knowledge is with My Lord. And of knowledge you (O men!) have been given only a little." ...(17.85) On that some of the Jews said to the others, "Didn't we tell you not to ask?
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Madina ke ek khet mein chal raha tha aur wo ek lakdi par tek lagaate hue chal rahe the, wo kuch Yahudiyon ke paas se guzre. Unmein se kuch ne doosron se kaha, 'Unse (Nabi se) Rooh ke baare mein poochho.' Doosron ne kaha, 'Unse mat poochho.' Magar unhone unse pucha, aur wo lakdi par tek lagaaye khade rahe, aur main unke peechhe khada tha, aur maine socha unhein Ilaahi Wahi mil rahi hai. Phir unhone kaha, 'Wo tumse Rooh ke baare mein poochte hain. Kaho: Rooh, iska ilm mere Rab ke paas hai. Aur tumhein (Aye insaano!) ilm mein se sirf thoda sa diya gaya hai.' (17:85) Isper kuch Yahudiyon ne doosron se kaha, 'Kya humne tumhein nahi kaha tha ke mat poochho?'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah guarantees to the person who carries out Jihad for His Cause and nothing compelled him to go out but the Jihad in His Cause, and belief in His Words, that He will either admit him into Paradise or return him with his reward or the booty he has earned to his residence from where he went out." (See Hadith No)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah us shaks ki zimmedaari leta hai jo uski raah mein Jihad karta hai, aur jisse Jihad ke ilaawa uski raah mein aur uski Kalima par Iman ke ilaawa kisi aur cheez ne baahar nikalne ke liye majboor nahi kiya, ke wo use ya to Jannat mein daakhil karega ya use uske ajr ya maal-e-ganimat ke saath uske ghar wapas laayega jahaan se wo nikla tha.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees dekhein.)

e: Narrated Abu Musa:A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "A man fights for pride and haughtiness another fights for bravery, and another fights for showing off; which of these (cases) is in Allah's Cause?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The one who fights that Allah's Word (Islam) should be superior, fights in Allah's Cause." (See Hadith No. 65, Vol)
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha, 'Ek aadmi ghamand aur takabbur ke liye ladta hai, aur doosra bahaduri ke liye, aur ek aur dikhaawe ke liye ladta hai; in mein se kaunsa Allah ki raah mein hai?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Jo ladta hai taake Allah ka Kalima (Islam) sarvocch rahe, wo Allah ki raah mein ladta hai.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 65, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated Al-Mughira bin Shu`ba:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Some people from my followers will continue to be victorious over others till Allah's Order (The Hour) is established." (See Hadith No)
hi: Al-Mughira bin Shu'ba (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, 'Mere maanne walon mein se kuch log doosron par ghaalib rahenge jab tak Allah ka hukm (Qayamat) na aa jaaye.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees dekhein.)

e: Narrated Muawiya:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "A group of my followers will keep on following Allah's Laws strictly and they will not be harmed by those who will disbelieve them or stand against them till Allah's Order (The Hour) will come while they will be in that state
hi: Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, 'Mere maanne walon ka ek giroh Allah ke Qawaanin par mazbooti se amal karta rahega aur unhein wo log nuqsaan nahi pahunchaayenge jo unhein jhutlaayenge ya unke khilaaf khade honge, jab tak Allah ka hukm (Qayamat) na aa jaaye jabke wo abhi bhi usi haalat mein hon.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) stood before Musailama (the liar) who was sitting with his companions then, and said to him, "If you ask me for this piece (of palm-leaf stalk), even then I would not give it to you. You cannot avoid what Allah has ordained for you, and if you turn away from Islam, Allah will surely ruin you
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) Musailama (jhoote) ke saamne khade hue jo us waqt apne saathiyon ke saath baithe the, aur unse kaha, 'Agar tum mujhse ye khajoor ke patton ka ek tukda bhi maangoge, tab bhi main tumhein wo nahi dunga. Tum Allah ki taye ki hui baat se bach nahi sakte, aur agar tum Islam se munh mod loge, to Allah zaroor tumhein tabaah kar dega.'

e: Narrated Ibn Mas`ud:While I was walking in company with the Prophet (ﷺ) in one of the fields of Medina, the Prophet (ﷺ) was reclining on a palm leave stalk which he carried with him. We passed by a group of Jews. Some of them said to the others, "Ask him about the spirit." The others said, "Do not ask him, lest he would say something that you hate." Some of them said, "We will ask him." So a man from among them stood up and said, 'O Abal-Qasim! What is the spirit?" The Prophet (ﷺ) kept quiet and I knew that he was being divinely inspired. Then he said: "They ask you concerning the Spirit, Say: The Spirit; its knowledge is with my Lord. And of knowledge you (mankind) have been given only a little
hi: Ibn Masud bataate hain: Jab main Nabi (SAW) ke saath Madina ke ek khet mein chal raha tha, Nabi (SAW) ek khajoor ke patton ki dandi par tek lagaaye hue the jise wo apne saath le jaate the. Hum kuch Yahudiyon ke ek giroh se guzre. Unmein se kuch ne doosron se kaha, 'Unse Rooh ke baare mein poochho.' Doosron ne kaha, 'Unse mat poochho, kahin wo aisi baat na kahein jo tumhein napasand ho.' Kuch ne kaha, 'Hum poochenge.' To unmein se ek shaks khada hua aur kaha, 'Aye Abal-Qasim! Rooh kya hai?' Nabi (SAW) khaamosh rahe aur mujhe pata chala unhein Ilaahi Wahi mil rahi hai. Phir unhone kaha, 'Wo tumse Rooh ke baare mein poochte hain. Kaho: Rooh, iska ilm mere Rab ke paas hai. Aur tumhein (Aye insaano!) ilm mein se sirf thoda sa diya gaya hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah guarantees (the person who carries out Jihad in His Cause and nothing compelled him to go out but Jihad in His Cause and the belief in His Word) that He will either admit him into Paradise (Martyrdom) or return him with reward or booty he has earned to his residence from where he went out
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah us shaks ki zimmedaari leta hai jo uski raah mein Jihad karta hai, aur jisse Jihad ke ilaawa uski raah mein aur uski Kalima par Iman ke ilaawa kisi aur cheez ne baahar nikalne ke liye majboor nahi kiya, ke wo use ya to Jannat mein daakhil karega (Shahaadat) ya use uske ajr ya maal-e-ganimat ke saath uske ghar wapas laayega jahaan se wo nikla tha.'

e: Narrated Anas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whenever anyone of you invoke Allah for something, he should be firm in his asking, and he should not say: 'If You wish, give me...' for none can compel Allah to do something against His Will
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab bhi tum mein se koi Allah se kuch maange, use apni maang mein mazboot rehna chaahiye, aur usse ye nahi kehna chaahiye, "Agar tu chaahe, to mujhe de..." kyunke koi bhi Allah ko uski Marzi ke khilaaf kuch karne par majboor nahi kar sakta.'

e: Narrated `Ali bin Abi Talib:That one night Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) visited him and Fatima, the daughter of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said to them, "Won 't you offer (night) prayer?.. `Ali added: I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Our souls are in the Hand of Allah and when He Wishes to bring us to life, He does." Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went away when I said so and he did not give any reply. Then I heard him on leaving while he was striking his thighs, saying, 'But man is, more quarrelsome than anything
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bin Abi Talib bataate hain ke ek raat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unke aur Fatima (Alayhas Salam), Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki beti, ke paas aaye aur unse kaha, 'Kya tum (raat ki) namaz nahi padhoge?' Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne izaafa kiya: Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Hamaari jaanein Allah ke Haath mein hain, aur jab wo humein zinda karna chahega, wo karega.' Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mere aisa kehne par chale gaye aur unhone koi jawab nahi diya. Phir maine unhein jaate waqt apni jaanghon par (haath se) thapthapaate suna, kehte hue, 'Magar insaan sabse zyaada jhagdaalu hai.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The example of a believer is that of a fresh green plant the leaves of which move in whatever direction the wind forces them to move and when the wind becomes still, it stand straight. Such is the similitude of the believer: He is disturbed by calamities (but is like the fresh plant he regains his normal state soon). And the example of a disbeliever is that of a pine tree (which remains) hard and straight till Allah cuts it down when He will." (See Hadith No. 546 and 547, Vol)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ek Momin ki misaal ek taaza hare paudhe jaisi hai jiske patte jis bhi taraf hawa unhein le jaaye, hilte hain, aur jab hawa ruk jaati hai, to wo seedha khada rehta hai. Aisi hi misaal Momin ki hai: Wo museebaton se pareshaan hota hai (magar taaze paudhe ki tarah jaldi apni asal haalat mein wapas aa jaata hai). Aur ek kaafir ki misaal ek chir ke darakht (pine) jaisi hai (jo) sakht aur seedha (rehta hai) jab tak Allah use kaat na de jab wo chaahega.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 546 aur 547, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while he was standing on the pulpit, saying, "The remaining period of your stay (on the earth) in comparison to the nations before you, is like the period between the `Asr prayer and sunset. The people of the Torah were given the Torah and they acted upon it till midday, and then they were worn out and were given for their labor, one Qirat each. Then the people of the Gospel were given the Gospel and they acted upon it till the time of the `Asr prayer, and then they were worn out and were given (for their labor), one Qirat each. Then you people were given the Qur'an and you acted upon it till sunset and so you were given two Qirats each (double the reward of the previous nations)." Then the people of the Torah said, 'O our Lord! These people have done a little labor (much less than we) but have taken a greater reward.' Allah said, 'Have I withheld anything from your reward?' They said, 'No.' Then Allah said, 'That is My Favor which I bestow on whom I wish
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko, jabke wo mimbar par khade the, ye kehte suna, 'Tumhaari (zameen par) reh ne ki baaki muddat, tumse pehle ki ummaton ke muqaable mein, Asr ki namaz aur suraj doobne ke beech ki muddat jaisi hai. Taurat waalon ko Taurat di gayi aur unhone dophar tak uspar amal kiya, aur phir wo thak gaye aur unhein apni mehnat ke liye ek Qirat mila. Phir Injeel waalon ko Injeel di gayi aur unhone Asr ki namaz ke waqt tak uspar amal kiya, aur phir wo thak gaye aur unhein (apni mehnat ke liye) ek Qirat mila. Phir tumhein Quran diya gaya aur tumne suraj doobne tak uspar amal kiya aur isliye tumhein do Qirat mile (pichhli ummaton ke ajr se dogaana).' Phir Taurat waalon ne kaha, 'Aye hamare Rab! In logon ne bahut kam kaam kiya hai (hamse bahut kam) magar zyaada ajr liya hai.' Allah ne kaha, 'Kya maine tumhaare ajr mein se kuch rokha?' Unhone kaha, 'Nahi.' Phir Allah ne kaha, 'Ye Mera Ehsaan hai jo main jise chaahun deta hoon.'

e: Narrated 'Ubada bin As-Samit:I, along with a group of people, gave the pledge of allegiance to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He said, "I take your Pledge on the condition that you (1) will not join partners in worship with Allah, (2) will not steal, (3) will not commit illegal sexual intercourse, (4) will not kill your offspring, (5) will not slander, (6) and will not disobey me when I order you to do good. Whoever among you will abide by his pledge, his reward will be with Allah, and whoever commits any of those sins and receives the punishment in this world, that punishment will be an expiation for his sins and purification; but if Allah screens him, then it will be up to Allah to punish him if He will or excuse Him, if He will
hi: Ubada bin As-Samit bataate hain: Main, kuch logon ke ek giroh ke saath, ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se baiyat li. Unhone kaha, 'Main tumse is shart par baiyat leta hoon ke tum (1) Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek nahi karoge, (2) chori nahi karoge, (3) zina nahi karoge, (4) apni aulaad ko qatl nahi karoge, (5) bohtaan nahi lagaaoge, (6) aur mere kisi achhe hukm ki nafarmaani nahi karoge. Tum mein se jo koi apni baiyat par qaayam rahega, uska ajr Allah ke paas hoga, aur jo koi in gunaahon mein se koi kare aur isme duniya mein apni saza pa le, to wo saza uska kaffara aur paakeezgi hogi; magar agar Allah use dhaank de, to phir ye Allah par hai chaahe wo use saza de ya maaf kare, jaisi uski marzi ho.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Prophet Solomon who had sixty wives, once said, "Tonight I will have sexual relation (sleep) with all my wives so that each of them will become pregnant and bring forth (a boy who will grow into) a cavalier and will fight in Allah's Cause." So he slept with his wives and none of them (conceived and) delivered (a child) except one who brought a half (body) boy (deformed). Allah's Prophet said, "If Solomon had said; 'If Allah Will,' then each of those women would have delivered a (would-be) cavalier to fight in Allah's Cause." (See Hadith No. 74 A, Vol)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Nabi Suleman, jinki sath biwiyaan thi, ne ek baar kaha, 'Aaj raat main apni sab biwiyon ke saath humbistari karunga taake unmein se har ek garbhvati ho aur (aise bete ko) paida kare jo bada hokar ek ghudsawaar banega aur Allah ki raah mein ladega.' To wo apni biwiyon ke saath soye, aur unmein se koi bhi (garbhvati hokar) bacha paidaish nahi diya siwaaye ek ke jisne aadha (jism waala) ladka (vikrit) paidaish diya. Allah ke Nabi ne kaha, 'Agar Suleman ne kaha hota, "Agar Allah chaahe," to un khawaateen mein se har ek Allah ki raah mein ladne wale ek ghudsawaar ko paidaish deti.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 74 A, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered upon a sick bedouin in whom he went to visit and said to him, "Don't worry, Tahur (i.e., your illness will be a means of cleansing of your sins), if Allah Will." The bedouin said, "Tahur! No, but it is a fever that is burning in the body of an old man and it will make him visit his grave." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Then it is so
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek bimar badawi se milne unke paas gaye jinki wo mulaakaat kar rahe the, aur unse kaha, 'Chinta mat karo, Tahur hai (yaani tumhaari bimaari tumhaare gunaahon ki paakeezgi ka zariya hogi), Allah ne chaaha to.' Badawi ne kaha, 'Tahur! Nahi, balke ye ek bukhaar hai jo ek boodhe aadmi ke jism mein jal raha hai aur ye use uski qabar tak pahunchaayega.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'To phir aisa hi ho.'

e: Narrated Abu Qatada:When the people slept till so late that they did not offer the (morning) prayer, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah captured your souls (made you sleep) when He willed, and returned them (to your bodies) when He willed." So the people got up and went to answer the call of nature, performed ablution, till the sun had risen and it had become white, then the Prophet (ﷺ) got up and offered the prayer
hi: Abu Qatada (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab log itni der so gaye ke unhone (subah ki) namaz nahi padhi, Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Allah ne tumhaari jaanein pakad li (tumhein sula diya) jab usne chaaha, aur unhein wapas kiya (tumhaare jismon mein) jab usne chaaha.' To log uthhe aur qaza-e-hajat ke liye gaye, wuzu kiya, yahaan tak ke suraj oopar aa gaya aur wo safed ho gaya, phir Nabi (SAW) uthhe aur namaz padhi.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:"A man from the Muslims and a man from the Jews quarrelled, and the Muslim said, "By Him Who gave superiority to Muhammad over all the people!" The Jew said, "By Him Who gave superiority to Moses over all the people!' On that the Muslim lifted his hand and slapped the Jew. The Jew went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and informed him of all that had happened between him and the Muslim. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not give me superiority over Moses, for the people will fall unconscious on the Day of Resurrection, I will be the first to regain consciousness and behold, Moses will be standing there, holding the side of the Throne. I will not know whether he has been one of those who have fallen unconscious and then regained consciousness before me, or if he has been one of those exempted by Allah (from falling unconscious)." (See Hadith No. 524, Vol)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Musalmaanon mein se ek shaks aur Yahudiyon mein se ek shaks ka jhagda hua, aur Musalmaan ne kaha, 'Us Zaat ki qasam jisne Muhammad ko sab logon se oopar chuna!' Yahudi ne kaha, 'Us Zaat ki qasam jisne Musa ko sab logon se oopar chuna!' Isper, Musalmaan ne apna haath uthaaya aur Yahudi ko thappad maara. Yahudi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaya aur unhein Musalmaan ke saath hue poore waaqia ke baare mein bataaya. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Mujhe Musa se oopar mat rakho, kyunke log Qayamat ke din behosh gir jaayenge, main sabse pehla shaks hounga jo hosh mein aayega, aur dekho! Musa wahaan khade honge, Arsh (Takht) ke ek kone ko thaame hue. Mujhe nahi pata hoga ke kya wo un logon mein se hain jo behosh hokar mujhse pehle hosh mein aa gaye, ya wo un logon mein se hain jinhein Allah ne (behosh hone se) mustasna kiya hai.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 524, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Ad-Dajjal will come to Medina and find the angels guarding it. If Allah will, neither Ad-Dajjal nor plague will be able to come near it
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ad-Dajjal Madina aayega aur wahaan farishton ko uski pehredaari karte paayega. Allah ne chaaha to, na Ad-Dajjal aur na mahamaari usmein qareeb aa payenge.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "For every Prophet there is one invocation which is definitely fulfilled by Allah, and I wish, if Allah will, to keep my that (special) invocation as to be the intercession for my followers on the Day of Resurrection
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Har Nabi ke paas ek dua hoti hai jo Allah dwara zaroor poori ki jaati hai, aur main chahta hoon, Allah ne chaaha to, apni us (khaas) dua ko Qayamat ke din apne maanne walon ki sifaarish ke taur par bachaakar rakhoon.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "While I was sleeping, I saw myself (in a dream) standing by a well. I drew from it as much water as Allah wished me to draw, and then Ibn Quhafa (Abu Bakr) took the bucket from me and drew one or two buckets, and there was weakness in his drawing----may Allah forgive him! Then `Umar took the bucket which turned into something like a big drum. I had never seen a powerful man among the people working as perfectly and vigorously as he did. (He drew so much water that) the people drank to their satisfaction and watered their camels that knelt down there. (See Hadith No. 16, Vol)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab main so raha tha, maine khud ko (khwaab mein) ek kuen ke paas khada dekha. Maine usmein se jitna Allah ne chaaha utna paani nikaala, aur phir Ibn Quhafa (Abu Bakr) ne mujhse bucket liya aur ek ya do bucket paani nikaale, aur unke kheenchne mein kamzori thi -- Allah unhein maaf kare! Phir Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne bucket liya jo ek bade dhol jaisa ban gaya. Maine kabhi kisi mazboot aadmi ko logon mein aisi bharpoor aur zordaar mehnat karte nahi dekha jaisi unhone ki. (Unhone itna paani nikaala ke) log jee bhar kar piye aur apne baithe hue oonton ko bhi jee bhar kar paani pilaaya.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 16, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated Abu Musa:Whenever a beggar or a person in need of something came to the Prophet (ﷺ) , he used to say (to his companions), "Intercede (for him) and you will be rewarded for that, and Allah will fulfill what He will through His Apostle's tongue
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab bhi koi bhikhaari ya zaroortmand shaks Nabi (SAW) ke paas aata, wo (apne sahaaba se) kehte, 'Sifaarish karo (uske liye) aur tumhein iska ajr milega, aur Allah apne Rasool ki zubaan se jo chaahega poora karega.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "None of you should say: 'O Allah! Forgive me if You wish,' or 'Bestow Your Mercy on me if You wish,' or 'Provide me with means of subsistence if You wish,' but he should be firm in his request, for Allah does what He will and nobody can force Him (to do anything)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Tum mein se koi bhi ye na kahe: "Aye Allah! Mujhe maaf kar de agar tu chaahe," ya "Mujhpar apni Rehmat ata kar agar tu chaahe," ya "Mujhe rozi de agar tu chaahe," balke use apni maang mein mazboot rehna chaahiye, kyunke Allah jo chaahta hai wo karta hai aur koi bhi Use majboor nahi kar sakta.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:That he differed with Al-Hurr bin Qais bin Hisn Al-Fazari about the companion of Moses, (i.e., whether he was Kha,dir or not). Ubai bin Ka`b Al-Ansari passed by them and Ibn `Abbas called him saying, 'My friend (Hur) and I have differed about Moses' Companion whom Moses asked the way to meet. Did you hear Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) mentioning anything about him?" Ubai said, "Yes, I heard Allah's Apostle saying, "While Moses was sitting in the company of some Israelites a man came to him and asked, 'Do you know Someone who is more learned than you (Moses)?' Moses said, 'No.' So Allah sent the Divine inspiration to Moses:-- 'Yes, Our Slave Khadir is more learned than you' Moses asked Allah how to meet him ( Khadir) So Allah made the fish as a sign for him and it was said to him, 'When you lose the fish, go back (to the place where you lose it) and you will meet him.' So Moses went on looking for the sign of the fish in the sea. The boy servant of Moses (who was accompanying him) said to him, 'Do you remember (what happened) when we betook ourselves to the rock? I did indeed forget to tell you (about) the fish. None but Satan made me forget to tell you about it' (18.63) Moses said: 'That is what we have been seeking." Sa they went back retracing their footsteps. (18.64). So they both found Kadir (there) and then happened what Allah mentioned about them (in the Qur'an)!' (See)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke unka Al-Hurr bin Qais bin Hisn Al-Fazari se Musa ke saathi (yaani Khadir the ya nahi) ke baare mein matbhed hua. Ubai bin Ka'b (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ansari unke paas se guzre aur Ibn Abbas ne unhein bulaaya, kehte hue, 'Mere dost (Hurr) aur mera Musa ke us saathi ke baare mein matbhed hai jinse Musa ne raasta poocha tha. Kya aapne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko unke baare mein kuch kehte suna?' Ubai ne kaha, 'Haan, maine Allah ke Rasool ko ye kehte suna: "Jab Musa Bani Israel ke logon ke ek giroh ke saath baithe the, ek shaks unke paas aaya aur pucha, 'Kya aap kisi aise shaks ko jaante hain jo aapse zyaada ilm rakhta ho (Aye Musa)?' Musa ne kaha, 'Nahi.' To Allah ne Musa ko Ilaahi Wahi bheji: 'Haan, Hamaara bandaa Khadir tumse zyaada ilm rakhta hai.' Musa ne Allah se pucha unse (Khadir se) kaise mile. To Allah ne machhli ko unke liye nishaani banaayi aur unse kaha gaya, 'Jab tum machhli khoye, wapas jaao (us jagah jahaan tumne use khoya) aur tum unse mil jaaoge.' To Musa samundar mein machhli ki nishaani dhoondhte gaye. Musa ke naukar ladke (jo unke saath tha) ne unse kaha, 'Kya aapko yaad hai (kya hua) jab hum us chattaan par gaye? Main sach mein aapko machhli ke baare mein batana bhool gaya. Sirf Shaitaan ne mujhe ye batana bhulaaya.' (18:63) Musa ne kaha: 'Yahi hai jo hum dhoondh rahe the.' To wo apne kadmon ki taraf wapas gaye.' (18:64) To dono ne Khadir ko (wahaan) paaya aur phir wahi hua jo Allah ne unke baare mein zikr kiya (Quran mein)!"' (Poori tafseel ke liye dekhein.)

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If Allah wills, tomorrow we will encamp in Khaif Bani Kinana, the place where the pagans took the oath of Kufr (disbelief) against the Prophet. He meant Al-Muhassab. (See Hadith)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah ne chaaha to, kal hum Khaif Banu Kinana mein pad-aao daalenge, wahi jagah jahaan mushrikon ne Nabi (SAW) ke khilaaf Kufr (na-shukri) ki qasam khaayi thi.' Unka ishara Al-Muhassab ki taraf tha. (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees dekhein.)

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) besieged the people of Ta'if, but he did not conquer it. He said, "Tomorrow, if Allah will, we will return home. On this the Muslims said, "Then we return without conquering it?" He said, 'Then carry on fighting tomorrow." The next day many of them were injured. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If Allah will, we will return home tomorrow." It seemed that statement pleased them whereupon Allah's Apostle smiled
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne Ta'if ke logon ko gher liya, magar wo use fatah nahi kar paaye. Unhone kaha, 'Kal, Allah ne chaaha to, hum ghar wapas jaayenge.' Isper Musalmaanon ne kaha, 'To hum ise fatah kiye bagair wapas jaayein?' Unhone kaha, 'To kal jang jaari rakho.' Agli din unmein se bahut se log zakhmi hue. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Allah ne chaaha to, kal hum ghar wapas jaayenge.' Ye baat unhein khush karne wali lagi, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) muskuraaye.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When Allah ordains something on the Heaven the angels beat with their wings in obedience to His Statement which sounds like that of a chain dragged over a rock. His Statement: "Until when the fear is banished from their hearts, the Angels say, 'What was it that your Lord said?' 'They reply, '(He has said) the Truth. And He is the Most High, The Great
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab Allah aasmaan mein kuch farmaata hai, farishte apni pankhon se maarte hain uske Farmaan ki farmaanbardaari mein, jispar aisi aawaaz aati hai jaisi zanjeer chattaan par ghaseeti jaa rahi ho. Uska Farmaan: "Yahaan tak ke jab unke dilon se khauf dur ho jaata hai, Farishte kehte hain, 'Tumhaare Rab ne kya kaha?' Wo jawab dete hain, '(Usne kaha) Haq, aur Wo Sarvocch, Mahaan hai.'"'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah never listens to anything as He listens to the Prophet (ﷺ) reciting Qur'an in a pleasant sweet sounding voice." A companion of Abu Huraira said, "He means, reciting the Qur'an aloud
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah kisi bhi cheez ko utne dhyaan se nahi sunta jitne dhyaan se wo Nabi (SAW) ko Quran ko khushnuma aur meethi awaaz mein padhte sunta hai.' Abu Huraira ke ek saathi ne kaha, 'Unka matlab tha, Quran ko oonchi awaaz mein padhna.'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah will say (on the Day of Resurrection), 'O Adam!' Adam will reply, 'Labbaik wa Sa`daik! ' Then a loud Voice will be heard (Saying) 'Allah Commands you to take out the mission of the Hell Fire from your offspring
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah (Qayamat ke din) kahega, "Aye Aadam!" Aadam jawab denge, "Labbaik wa Sa'daik! (Main haazir hoon aur tumhaari farmaanbardaari karta hoon!)" Phir ek oonchi Aawaaz sunaayi degi (kehte hue), "Allah tumhein hukm deta hai ke apni nasl mein se Jahannam ki tolii nikaalo."'

e: Narrated `Aisha:I never felt so jealous of any woman as I felt of Khadija, for Allah ordered him (the Prophet (ﷺ) ) to give Khadija the glad tidings of a palace in Paradise (for her)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine kisi khaatoon se itni jalan mehsoos nahi ki jitni Khadija (رضی اللہ عنہا) se ki, kyunke Allah ne unhein (Nabi SAW ko) hukm diya ke Khadija ko Jannat mein ek mahal ki khush-khabri dein.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If Allah loves a person, He calls Gabriel, saying, 'Allah loves so and so, O Gabriel love him' So Gabriel would love him and then would make an announcement in the Heavens: 'Allah has loved so and-so therefore you should love him also.' So all the dwellers of the Heavens would love him, and then he is granted the pleasure of the people on the earth." (See Hadith No. 66, Vol)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar Allah kisi shaks se mohabbat karta hai, wo Jibrael ko bulwaata hai, kehte hue, "Allah falaan-falaan shaks se mohabbat karta hai, Aye Jibrael, tum bhi usse mohabbat karo." To Jibrael bhi usse mohabbat karte hain aur phir Aasmaanon mein elaan karte hain: "Allah ne falaan-falaan se mohabbat ki hai, isliye tumhein bhi usse mohabbat karni chaahiye." Isliye sab Aasmaan ke rehne wale usse mohabbat karte hain, aur phir usse zameen ke logon ki bhi pasandidgi mil jaati hai.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 66, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "There are angels coming to you in succession at night, and others during the day, and they all gather at the time of `Asr and Fajr prayers. Then the angels who have stayed with you overnight ascend (to the heaven) and He (Allah) asks them though He perfectly knows their affairs. 'In what state have you left my slaves?' They say, 'When we left them, they were praying and when we came to them they were praying
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kuch farishte tumhaare paas raat mein baari-baari se aate hain, aur doosre din mein, aur wo sab Asr aur Fajr ki namaz ke waqt jama hote hain. Phir wo farishte jo raat bhar tumhaare saath rahe, oopar (Aasmaan ki taraf) jaate hain aur Wo (Allah) unse poochta hai halaanke wo unke maamlon ko achhi tarah jaanta hai, "Tumne mere bandon ko kis haalat mein chhoda?" Wo kehte hain, "Jab humne unhein chhoda, wo namaz padh rahe the, aur jab hum unke paas pahunche, wo namaz padh rahe the."'

e: Narrated Abu Dharr:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, Gabriel came to me and gave me the glad tidings that anyone who died without worshipping anything besides Allah, would enter Paradise. I asked (Gabriel), 'Even if he committed theft, and even if he committed illegal sexual intercourse?' He said, '(Yes), even if he committed theft, and even if he Committed illegal sexual intercourse
hi: Abu Dharr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jibrael mere paas aaye aur mujhe khush-khabri di ke jo koi bhi Allah ke siwa kisi aur cheez ki ibaadat kiye bagair mare, wo Jannat mein daakhil hoga.' Maine (Jibrael se) pucha, 'Chaahe usne chori ki ho, aur chaahe usne zina kiya ho?' Unhone kaha, '(Haan), chaahe usne chori ki ho, aur chaahe usne zina kiya ho.'

e: Narrated Al-Bara' bin `Azib:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O so-and-so, whenever you go to your bed (for sleeping) say, 'O Allah! I have surrendered myself over to you and have turned my face towards You, and leave all my affairs to You and depend on You and put my trust in You expecting Your reward and fearing Your punishment. There is neither fleeing from You nor refuge but with You. I believe in the Book (Qur'an) which You have revealed and in Your Prophet (Muhammad) whom You have sent.' If you then die on that night, then you will die as a Muslim, and if you wake alive in the morning then you will receive the reward." (See Hadith No. 323, Vol)
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Aye falaan! Jab bhi tum apne bistar par (sone ke liye) jaao, kaho, "Aye Allah! Maine khud ko tere saamne supurd kar diya hai aur apna chehra teri taraf mod diya hai, aur apne sab maamle tujhpar chhod diye hain aur tujhpar nirbhar karta hoon aur teri raham ki ummeed aur teri saza ka khauf rakhte hue tujhpar bharosa karta hoon. Tujhse na bhaagna hai na koi panaah hai siwaaye teri hi taraf. Main us Kitaab (Quran) par Iman rakhta hoon jise tune naazil kiya hai aur tere Nabi (Muhammad) par jise tune bheja hai." Agar phir tum usi raat mar jaao, to tum Musalmaan hokar maroge, aur agar tum subah zinda uthho, to tumhein ajr milega.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 323, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abi `Aufa:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said on the Day of (the battle of) the Clans, "O Allah! The Revealer of the Holy Book, The Quick Taker of Accounts! Defeat the clans and shake them
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Aufa bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ahzab (Qabaayaili giroh) ki jang ke din farmaya, 'Aye Allah! Muqaddas Kitaab (Quran) ko Naazil Karne wale, Hisaab Jaldi Lene wale! Qabaayaili girohon ko haraa de aur unhein hila de.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:(regarding the Verse):-- 'Neither say your prayer aloud, nor say it in a low tone.' (17.110) This Verse was revealed while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was hiding himself in Mecca, and when he raised his voice while reciting the Qur'an, the pagans would hear him and abuse the Qur'an and its Revealer and to the one who brought it. So Allah said:-- 'Neither say your prayer aloud, nor say it in a low tone.' (17.110) That is, 'Do not say your prayer so loudly that the pagans can hear you, nor say it in such a low tone that your companions do not hear you.' But seek a middle course between those (extremes), i.e., let your companions hear, but do not relate the Qur'an loudly, so that they may learn it from you
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain (is Aayat ke baare mein): 'Na to apni namaz oonchi awaaz mein padho, na hi use dhime lehje mein padho.' (17:110) Ye Aayat tab naazil hui thi jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khud ko Makkah mein chhupaaye hue the, aur jab wo Quran ki tilaawat karte waqt apni awaaz oonchi karte, mushrik unhein sunte aur Quran, uske Naazil karne wale, aur use laane wale ki bura-bhala kehte. To Allah ne kaha: 'Na to apni namaz oonchi awaaz mein padho, na hi use dhime lehje mein padho.' (17:110) Yaani, 'Apni namaz itni oonchi awaaz mein mat padho ke mushrik tumhein sun sakein, na hi ise itne dhime lehje mein padho ke tumhaare saathi tumhein na sun sakein.' Balke in dono (intiha) ke beech ka raasta talaash karo, yaani apne saathiyon ko sunne do, magar Quran itni oonchi awaaz mein na sunaao (ke mushrik sunein), taake wo tumse ise seekh sakein.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah said: "The son of Adam hurts Me by abusing Time, for I am Time; in My Hands are all things and I cause the revolution of night and day.' " (See Hadith No. 351, Vol)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah ne farmaaya: "Aadam ka beta mujhe waqt (zamaana) ko bura-bhala kehkar takleef pahunchaata hai, kyunke main hi Waqt hoon; sab cheezein mere Haathon mein hain aur main hi raat aur din ka badalna karta hoon."' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 351, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah said: The Fast is for Me and I will give the reward for it, as he (the one who observes the fast) leaves his sexual desire, food and drink for My Sake. Fasting is a screen (from Hell) and there are two pleasures for a fasting person, one at the time of breaking his fast, and the other at the time when he will meet his Lord. And the smell of the mouth of a fasting person is better in Allah's Sight than the smell of musk." (See Hadith No. 128, Vol)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah ne farmaaya: Roza Mere liye hai aur Main hi iska ajr dunga, kyunke wo (roza rakhne wala) apni jinsi khwaahish, khaana, aur peena Meri khaatir chhodta hai. Roza ek parda hai (Jahannam se) aur ek roza rakhne wale ke liye do khushiyaan hain, ek roza kholte waqt, aur doosri jab wo apne Rab se milega. Aur roza rakhne wale ke munh ki khushbu Allah ke nazdeek mushk ki khushbu se bhi behtar hai.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 128, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Once while Job (Aiyub) was taking a bath in a naked state. Suddenly a great number of gold locusts started falling upon him and he started collecting them in his clothes. His Lord called him, 'O Job! Didn't I make you rich enough to dispense with what you see now?' Job said, 'Yes, O Lord! But I cannot dispense with Your Blessings
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ek baar jab Ayub (Job) nange badan nahaa rahe the, achaanak sone ki tiddiyon (locusts) ki ek badi tadaad unpar girni shuru ho gayi aur wo unhein apne kapdon mein jama karne lage. Unke Rab ne unhein pukaara, "Aye Ayub! Kya maine tumhein itna ameer nahi banaaya ke tumhein jo tum abhi dekh rahe ho uski zaroorat na ho?" Ayub ne kaha, "Haan, Aye Rab! Magar main tere Ashirvaad (barkaton) se bagair nahi reh sakta."'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Every night when it is the last third of the night, our Lord, the Superior, the Blessed, descends to the nearest heaven and says: Is there anyone to invoke Me that I may respond to his invocation? Is there anyone to ask Me so that I may grant him his request? Is there anyone asking My forgiveness so that I may forgive him?. " (See Hadith No. 246,Vol)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Har raat jab raat ka aakhri tihaai hissa aata hai, hamaara Rab, Sarvocch, Mubaarak, sabse qareebi aasmaan par utarta hai aur kehta hai: Kya koi hai jo Mujhse dua kare taake Main uski dua qubool karun? Kya koi hai jo Mujhse maange taake Main uski darkhwaast poori karun? Kya koi hai jo Meri maafi maange taake Main use maaf karun?' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 246, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "We (Muslims) are the last (to come) but will be the foremost on the Day of Resurrection." The narrators of this Hadith said: Allah said (to man), 'Spend (in charity), for then I will compensate you (generously)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Hum (Musalmaan) sabse aakhri (aane wale) hain magar sabse aage honge (Qayamat ke din).' Is hadees ke raviyon ne kaha: Allah ne (insaan se) kaha, 'Kharch karo (sadqa mein), phir Main tumhein (bharpoor) badla dunga.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said that Gabriel said, "Here is Khadija coming to you with a dish of food or a tumbler containing something to drink. Convey to her a greeting from her Lord (Allah) and give her the glad tidings that she will have a palace in Paradise built of Qasab wherein there will be neither any noise nor any fatigue (trouble)." (See Hadith No. 168, Vol)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne kaha ke Jibrael ne kaha, 'Ye Khadija (رضی اللہ عنہا) aapke paas khaane ka ek bartan ya kisi peene ki cheez ka ek pyaala lekar aa rahi hain. Unhein unke Rab (Allah) ki taraf se salaam pahunchaiye aur unhein Jannat mein Qasab (moti ya achha bans) se banaaye gaye ek mahal ki khush-khabri dijiye, jismein na koi shor hoga na koi thakaan (mushkil).' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 168, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah said, "I have prepared for My righteous slaves (such excellent things) as no eye has ever seen, nor an ear has ever heard nor a human heart can ever think of
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Allah ne farmaaya, "Maine apne neik bandon ke liye (aisi behtareen cheezein) taiyaar ki hain jo na kisi aankh ne kabhi dekhi, na kisi kaan ne kabhi suni, na kisi insaani dil mein kabhi socha."'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) offered the night (Tahajjud) prayer, he used to say, "O Allah! All the Praises are for You; You are the Light of the Heavens and the Earth. And all the Praises are for You; You are the Keeper of the Heavens and the Earth. All the Praises are for You; You are the Lord of the Heavens and the Earth and whatever is therein. You are the Truth, and Your Promise is the Truth, and Your Speech is the Truth, and meeting You is the Truth, and Paradise is the Truth and Hell (Fire) is the Truth and all the prophets are the Truth and the Hour is the Truth. O Allah! I surrender to You, and believe in You, and depend upon You, and repent to You, and in Your cause I fight and with Your orders I rule. So please forgive my past and future sins and those sins which I did in secret or in public. It is You Whom I worship, None has the right to be worshipped except You ." (See Hadith No. 329,Vol)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab bhi Nabi (SAW) Tahajjud ki namaz padhte, wo kehte, 'Aye Allah! Sab tareef tere liye hai; Tu Aasmaanon aur Zameen ka Noor hai. Aur sab tareef tere liye hai; Tu Aasmaanon aur Zameen ka Sambhaalne wala hai. Sab tareef tere liye hai; Tu Aasmaanon aur Zameen aur jo bhi unmein hai uska Rab hai. Tu Haq hai, aur Tera Waada Haq hai, aur Tera Farmaan Haq hai, aur Tujhse Mulaqaat Haq hai, aur Jannat Haq hai aur (Jahannam ki) Aag Haq hai aur sab Nabi Haq hain aur Qayamat Haq hai. Aye Allah! Main tere saamne khud ko supurd karta hoon, aur tujhpar Iman rakhta hoon, aur tujhpar bharosa karta hoon, aur tere paas tauba karta hoon, aur teri hi khaatir ladta hoon aur tere hukmon ke mutaabik faisla deta hoon. Isliye barah-e-meharbaani mujhe mere pichhle aur aane wale gunaah maaf kar de, aur wo bhi jo maine chupke se ya khule aam kiye. Tu hi wo hai jiski main ibaadat karta hoon, Tere siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 329, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated `Urwa bin Az-Zubair:Sa`id bin Al-Musaiyab, 'Alqama bin Waqqas and 'Ubaidullah bin `Abdullah regarding the narrating of the forged statement against `Aisha, the wife of the Prophet, when the slanderers said what they said and Allah revealed her innocence. `Aisha said, "But by Allah, I did not think that Allah, (to confirm my innocence), would reveal Divine Inspiration which would be recited, for I consider myself too unimportant to be talked about by Allah through Divine Inspiration revealed for recitation, but I hoped that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) might have a dream in which Allah would reveal my innocence. So Allah revealed:-- 'Verily! Those who spread the slander are a gang among you...' (The ten Verses in Suratan- Nur)
hi: Urwa bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ), Sa'id bin Al-Musaiyab, Alqama bin Waqqas aur Ubaidullah bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke hawaale se, Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا), Nabi (SAW) ki biwi, ke khilaaf jhoothe ilzaam ke bare mein bataate hain, jab bohtaan lagaane walon ne wo baat kahi jo unhone kahi aur Allah ne unki (Aisha ki) paakeezgi zaahir ki. Aisha ne kaha, 'Magar Allah ki qasam, mujhe ye khayaal nahi tha ke Allah (meri paakeezgi ki pushti ke liye) aisi Ilaahi Wahi naazil karega jo (namaz mein) padhi jaayegi, kyunke main khud ko itna maamooli samajhti thi ke Allah mere baare mein Ilaahi Wahi ke zariye baat kare jo padhne ke liye naazil ki jaaye, magar mujhe ummeed thi ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko koi khwaab aayega jismein Allah meri paakeezgi zaahir karega. To Allah ne naazil kiya: 'Beshak! Jo log ye bohtaan phailaate hain wo tum mein se ek giroh hain...' (das Aayaten Surat An-Nur mein).

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah says, 'If My slave intends to do a bad deed then (O Angels) do not write it unless he does it; if he does it, then write it as it is, but if he refrains from doing it for My Sake, then write it as a good deed (in his account). (On the other hand) if he intends to do a good deed, but does not do it, then write a good deed (in his account), and if he does it, then write it for him (in his account) as ten good deeds up to seven-hundred times
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah kehta hai, "Agar mera bandaa koi bura amal karne ka iraada rakhta hai to (Aye Farishton) use tab tak mat likho jab tak wo use kare; agar wo use kare, to use waisa hi likho jaisa wo hai, magar agar wo Meri khaatir isse rukk jaaye, to use ek achha amal (uske khaate mein) likho. (Doosri taraf) agar wo koi achha amal karne ka iraada rakhta hai, magar use nahi karta, to ek achha amal (uske khaate mein) likho, aur agar wo ise kare, to use uske liye (uske khaate mein) das achhe amaal ke barabar likho, saat-sau guna tak."'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah created the creation, and when He finished from His creation the Rahm (womb) got up, and Allah said (to it). "Stop! What do you want? It said; "At this place I seek refuge with You from all those who sever me (i.e. sever the ties of Kinship.)" Allah said: "Would you be pleased that I will keep good relation with the one who will keep good relation with you, and I will sever the relation with the one who will sever the relation with you. It said: 'Yes, 'O my Lord.' Allah said (to it), 'That is for you.'' And then Abu Huraira recited the Verse:-- "Would you then if you were given the authority, do mischief in the land, and sever your ties of kinship
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah ne makhlooq banaayi, aur jab wo apni takhleeq se faarigh hua, Ar-Rahm (kokh) uthhi, aur Allah ne (usse) kaha, "Ruk jaao! Tumhein kya chaahiye?" Usne kaha, "Is jagah, main teri panaah maangti hoon un sab logon se jo mujhe (yaani rishtedaari ke rishton ko) tod dete hain." Allah ne kaha, "Kya tumhein ye pasand hoga ke Main us shaks se achha rishta banaaun jo tumse achha rishta banaaye, aur us shaks se rishta todun jo tumse rishta tode?" Usne kaha, "Haan, Aye mere Rab." Allah ne (usse) kaha, "Ye tumhaare liye hai."' Phir Abu Huraira ne ye Aayat padhi: 'Kya tum, agar tumhein ikhtiyaar diya jaaye, zameen mein fasaad karoge aur apne rishtedaari ke rishte todoge?'

e: Narrated Zaid bin Khalid:It rained (because of the Prophet's invocation for rain) and the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah said, 'Some of My slaves have become disbelievers in Me, and some others, believers in Me
hi: Zaid bin Khalid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Baarish hui (Nabi ki dua ke zariye) aur Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Allah ne farmaaya, "Mere kuch bande mujh mein kaafir (na-shukra) ban gaye hain, aur kuch aur mujh mein Momin ban gaye hain."'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah said, 'If My slaves loves the meeting with Me, I too love the meeting with him; and if he dislikes the meeting with Me, I too dislike the meeting with him.' " (See Hadith No. 514, Vol)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah ne farmaaya, "Agar mera bandaa Mujhse milna pasand karta hai, to Main bhi usse milna pasand karta hoon; aur agar wo Mujhse milna napasand karta hai, to Main bhi usse milna napasand karta hoon."' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 514, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah said, 'I am to my slave as he thinks of Me, (i.e. I am able to do for him what he thinks I can do for him). (See Hadith No)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah ne farmaaya, "Main apne bande ke saath waisa hi hoon jaisa wo Mujhe samajhta hai (yaani main uske liye wo kar sakta hoon jo wo sochta hai ke main kar sakta hoon)."' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees dekhein.)

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "A man who never did any good deed, said that if he died, his family should burn him and throw half the ashes of his burnt body in the earth and the other half in the sea, for by Allah, if Allah should get hold of him, He would inflict such punishment on him as He would not inflict on anybody among the people. But Allah ordered the sea to collect what was in it (of his ashes) and similarly ordered the earth to collect what was in it (of his ashes). Then Allah said (to the recreated man ), 'Why did you do so?' The man replied, 'For being afraid of You, and You know it (very well).' So Allah forgave him
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ek aadmi jisne kabhi koi nek amal nahi kiya, usne kaha ke agar wo mar jaaye, to uska khaandaan use jala de aur uske jale hue jism ki aadhi raakh zameen mein aur aadhi samundar mein daale, kyunke Allah ki qasam, agar Allah use pakad le, to wo use aisi saza dega jo wo doosron ko nahi dega. Magar Allah ne samundar ko hukm diya ke wo apne andar ki (raakh) jama kare, aur isi tarah zameen ko bhi hukm diya ke wo apne andar ki (raakh) jama kare. Phir Allah ne (dobara banaaye gaye aadmi se) kaha, "Tumne aisa kyun kiya?" Us aadmi ne jawab diya, "Tere khauf se, aur tu ye (bahut achhe se) jaanta hai." To Allah ne use maaf kar diya.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "If somebody commits a sin and then says, 'O my Lord! I have sinned, please forgive me!' and his Lord says, 'My slave has known that he has a Lord who forgives sins and punishes for it, I therefore have forgiven my slave (his sins).' Then he remains without committing any sin for a while and then again commits another sin and says, 'O my Lord, I have committed another sin, please forgive me,' and Allah says, 'My slave has known that he has a Lord who forgives sins and punishes for it, I therefore have forgiven my slave (his sin). Then he remains without Committing any another sin for a while and then commits another sin (for the third time) and says, 'O my Lord, I have committed another sin, please forgive me,' and Allah says, 'My slave has known that he has a Lord Who forgives sins and punishes for it I therefore have forgiven My slave (his sin), he can do whatever he likes
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, 'Agar koi gunaah kare aur phir kahe, "Aye mere Rab! Maine gunaah kiya hai, barah-e-meharbaani mujhe maaf kar de!" aur uska Rab kahe, "Mere bande ko pata chal gaya hai ke uska ek Rab hai jo gunaah maaf karta hai aur unke liye saza deta hai, isliye maine apne bande ko maaf kar diya." Phir wo kuch waqt bina koi gunaah kiye rehta hai aur phir dobara koi aur gunaah karta hai aur kehta hai, "Aye mere Rab, maine ek aur gunaah kiya hai, barah-e-meharbaani mujhe maaf kar de," aur Allah kehta hai, "Mere bande ko pata chal gaya hai ke uska ek Rab hai jo gunaah maaf karta hai aur unke liye saza deta hai, isliye maine apne bande ko maaf kar diya." Phir wo kuch waqt bina koi aur gunaah kiye rehta hai aur phir teesri baar koi aur gunaah karta hai aur kehta hai, "Aye mere Rab, maine ek aur gunaah kiya hai, barah-e-meharbaani mujhe maaf kar de," aur Allah kehta hai, "Mere bande ko pata chal gaya hai ke uska ek Rab hai jo gunaah maaf karta hai aur unke liye saza deta hai, isliye maine apne bande ko maaf kar diya, wo jo chaahe kare."'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id:The Prophet (ﷺ) mentioned a man from the people of the past or those who preceded you. The Prophet (ﷺ) said a sentence meaning: Allah had given him wealth and children. When his death approached, he said to his sons, "What kind of father have I been to you?" They replied, "You have been a good father." He told them that he had not presented any good deed before Allah, and if Allah should get hold of him He would punish him.' "So look!" he added, "When I die, burn me, and when I turn into coal, crush me, and when there comes a windy day, scatter my ashes in the wind." The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "Then by Allah, he took a firm promise from his children to do so, and they did so. (They burnt him after his death) and threw his ashes on a windy day. Then Allah commanded to his ashes. "Be," and behold! He became a man standing! Allah said, "O My slave! What made you do what you did?" He replied, "For fear of You." Nothing saved him then but Allah's Mercy (So Allah forgave him)
hi: Abu Saeed bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne aglon logon mein se ya tumse pehle guzre logon mein se ek shaks ka zikr kiya. Nabi (SAW) ne ek jumla kaha jiska matlab tha: Allah ne use daulat aur bacche diye the. Jab uski maut qareeb aayi, usne apne beton se kaha, 'Main tumhaare liye kaisa baap tha?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Aap ek achhe baap the.' Usne unhein bataaya ke usne Allah ke saamne koi nek amal pesh nahi kiya, aur agar Allah use pakad le to wo use saza dega.' 'Isliye dekho!' usne izaafa kiya, 'Jab main mar jaaun, mujhe jala dena, aur jab main koyla ban jaaun, mujhe kuchal dena, aur jab hawa waala din aaye, meri raakh hawa mein bikher dena.' Nabi (SAW) ne izaafa kiya, 'Phir, Allah ki qasam, usne apne bachchon se aisa karne ka pakka waada le liya, aur unhone waisa hi kiya. (Unki maut ke baad unhein jalaaya) aur unki raakh ek hawa waale din bikher di. Phir Allah ne uski raakh ko hukm diya, "Ban jao," aur dekho! Wo ek khada shaks ban gaya! Allah ne kaha, "Aye mere bande! Tumne aisa kyun kiya?" Usne jawab diya, "Tere khauf se." Kuch bhi usse nahi bachaa siwaaye Allah ki Rehmat ke (isliye Allah ne use maaf kar diya).'

e: Narrated Anas:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "On the Day of Resurrection I will intercede and say, "O my Lord! Admit into Paradise (even) those who have faith equal to a mustard seed in their hearts." Such people will enter Paradise, and then I will say, 'O (Allah) admit into Paradise (even) those who have the least amount of faith in their hearts." Anas then said: As if I were just now looking at the fingers of Allah's Apostle
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, 'Qayamat ke din main sifaarish karunga aur kahoonga, "Aye mere Rab! Un logon ko bhi Jannat mein daakhil kar jinke dilon mein sarson ke daane jitna Iman ho (bhi)." Aise log Jannat mein daakhil honge, aur phir main kahoonga, "Aye Allah! Un logon ko bhi Jannat mein daakhil kar jinke dilon mein sabse kam Iman ho (bhi)."' Anas ne phir kaha: Jaise ke main abhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki ungliyaan dekh raha hoon.

e: Narrated Ma`bad bin Hilal Al-`Anzi:We, i.e., some people from Basra gathered and went to Anas bin Malik, and we went in company with Thabit Al-Bunnani so that he might ask him about the Hadith of Intercession on our behalf. Behold, Anas was in his palace, and our arrival coincided with his Duha prayer. We asked permission to enter and he admitted us while he was sitting on his bed. We said to Thabit, "Do not ask him about anything else first but the Hadith of Intercession." He said, "O Abu Hamza! There are your brethren from Basra coming to ask you about the Hadith of Intercession." Anas then said, "Muhammad talked to us saying, 'On the Day of Resurrection the people will surge with each other like waves, and then they will come to Adam and say, 'Please intercede for us with your Lord.' He will say, 'I am not fit for that but you'd better go to Abraham as he is the Khalil of the Beneficent.' They will go to Abraham and he will say, 'I am not fit for that, but you'd better go to Moses as he is the one to whom Allah spoke directly.' So they will go to Moses and he will say, 'I am not fit for that, but you'd better go to Jesus as he is a soul created by Allah and His Word.' (Be: And it was) they will go to Jesus and he will say, 'I am not fit for that, but you'd better go to Muhammad.' They would come to me and I would say, 'I am for that.' Then I will ask for my Lord's permission, and it will be given, and then He will inspire me to praise Him with such praises as I do not know now. So I will praise Him with those praises and will fall down, prostrate before Him. Then it will be said, 'O Muhammad, raise your head and speak, for you will be listened to; and ask, for your will be granted (your request); and intercede, for your intercession will be accepted.' I will say, 'O Lord, my followers! My followers!' And then it will be said, 'Go and take out of Hell (Fire) all those who have faith in their hearts, equal to the weight of a barley grain.' I will go and do so and return to praise Him with the same praises, and fall down (prostrate) before Him. Then it will be said, 'O Muhammad, raise your head and speak, for you will be listened to, and ask, for you will be granted (your request); and intercede, for your intercession will be accepted.' I will say, 'O Lord, my followers! My followers!' It will be said, 'Go and take out of it all those who have faith in their hearts equal to the weight of a small ant or a mustard seed.' I will go and do so and return to praise Him with the same praises, and fall down in prostration before Him. It will be said, 'O, Muhammad, raise your head and speak, for you will be listened to, and ask, for you will be granted (your request); and intercede, for your intercession will be accepted.' I will say, 'O Lord, my followers!' Then He will say, 'Go and take out (all those) in whose hearts there is faith even to the lightest, lightest mustard seed. (Take them) out of the Fire.' I will go and do so."' When we left Anas, I said to some of my companions, "Let's pass by Al-Hasan who is hiding himself in the house of Abi Khalifa and request him to tell us what Anas bin Malik has told us." So we went to him and we greeted him and he admitted us. We said to him, "O Abu Sa`id! We came to you from your brother Anas Bin Malik and he related to us a Hadith about the intercession the like of which I have never heard." He said, "What is that?"
