Then we told him of the Hadith and said, "He stopped at this point (of the Hadith)." He said, "What then?" We said, "He did not add anything to that." He said, Anas related the Hadith to me twenty years ago when he was a young fellow. I don't know whether he forgot or if he did not like to let you depend on what he might have said." We said, "O Abu Sa`id ! Let us know that." He smiled and said, "Man was created hasty. I did not mention that, but that I wanted to inform you of it. Anas told me the same as he told you and said that the Prophet (ﷺ) added, 'I then return for a fourth time and praise Him similarly and prostrate before Him me the same as he 'O Muhammad, raise your head and speak, for you will be listened to; and ask, for you will be granted (your request): and intercede, for your intercession will be accepted .' I will say, 'O Lord, allow me to intercede for whoever said, 'None has the right to be worshiped except Allah.' Then Allah will say, 'By my Power, and my Majesty, and by My Supremacy, and by My Greatness, I will take out of Hell (Fire) whoever said: 'None has the right to be worshipped except Allah
hi: Ma'bad bin Hilal Al-Anzi bataate hain: Hum, yaani Basra ke kuch log, jama hue aur Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas gaye, aur hum Thabit Al-Bunnani ke saath gaye taake wo hamaari taraf se unse Sifaarish ki hadees ke baare mein poochh sakein. Dekho, Anas apne mahal mein the, aur hamaara pahunchna unki Duha ki namaz ke waqt hua. Humne andar aane ki ijaazat maangi aur unhone humein andar aane diya jabke wo apne bistar par baithe the. Humne Thabit se kaha, 'Pehle unse kisi aur baare mein mat poochho siwaaye Sifaarish ki hadees ke.' Unhone kaha, 'Aye Abu Hamza! Yahaan aapke Basra ke bhai hain jo aapse Sifaarish ki hadees ke baare mein poochhne aaye hain.' Anas ne phir kaha, 'Muhammad ne humse baat karte hue kaha, "Qayamat ke din, log ek doosre se lehron ki tarah takraayenge, aur phir wo Aadam ke paas jaayenge aur kahenge, 'Barah-e-meharbaani hamare Rab se hamaari sifaarish kijiye.' Wo kahenge, 'Main is kaam ke laayak nahi, magar tumhein Ibrahim ke paas jaana chaahiye kyunke wo Rehmaan ke Khalil hain.' Wo Ibrahim ke paas jaayenge aur wo kahenge, 'Main is kaam ke laayak nahi, magar tumhein Musa ke paas jaana chaahiye kyunke wo hain jinse Allah ne seedhe baat ki.' To wo Musa ke paas jaayenge aur wo kahenge, 'Main is kaam ke laayak nahi, magar tumhein Isa ke paas jaana chaahiye kyunke wo Allah ki taraf se paida ki gayi ek Rooh hai aur uski Kalima hai.' (Ho: aur wo hua) Wo Isa ke paas jaayenge aur wo kahenge, 'Main is kaam ke laayak nahi, magar tumhein Muhammad ke paas jaana chaahiye.' Wo mere paas aayenge aur main kahoonga, 'Main iske liye hoon.' Phir main apne Rab se ijaazat maangunga, aur mujhe di jaayegi, aur phir wo mujhe ilhaam dega ke main Usse aisi tareef karoon jo mujhe abhi nahi pata. Isliye main Usse un tareefon se tareef karunga aur Uske saamne sajda mein gir jaunga. Phir kaha jaayega, 'Aye Muhammad, apna sar uthaao aur bolo, kyunke tumhaari baat suni jaayegi; aur maango, kyunke tumhaari (darkhwaast) di jaayegi; aur sifaarish karo, kyunke tumhaari sifaarish qubool ki jaayegi.' Main kahoonga, 'Aye Rab, mere maanne wale! Mere maanne wale!' Aur phir kaha jaayega, 'Jaao aur Jahannam (ki Aag) se un sabko nikaalo jinke dilon mein jau ke daane ke barabar Iman hai.' Main jaunga aur aisa karunga aur wapas Usski tareef unhi tareefon se karunga, aur Uske saamne sajda (mein) gir jaunga. Phir kaha jaayega, 'Aye Muhammad, apna sar uthaao aur bolo, kyunke tumhaari baat suni jaayegi, aur maango, kyunke tumhaari (darkhwaast) di jaayegi; aur sifaarish karo, kyunke tumhaari sifaarish qubool ki jaayegi.' Main kahoonga, 'Aye Rab, mere maanne wale! Mere maanne wale!' Kaha jaayega, 'Jaao aur usmein se un sabko nikaalo jinke dilon mein ek chhoti chionti ya raai ke daane ke barabar Iman hai.' Main jaunga aur aisa karunga aur wapas Usski tareef unhi tareefon se karunga, aur Uske saamne sajde mein gir jaunga. Kaha jaayega, 'Aye, Muhammad, apna sar uthaao aur bolo, kyunke tumhaari baat suni jaayegi, aur maango, kyunke tumhaari (darkhwaast) di jaayegi; aur sifaarish karo, kyunke tumhaari sifaarish qubool ki jaayegi.' Main kahoonga, 'Aye Rab, mere maanne wale!' Phir Wo kahega, 'Jaao aur (un sabko) nikaalo jinke dilon mein sabse halka, sabse halka raai ke daane jitna bhi Iman hai. (Unhein) Aag se (nikaalo).' Main jaunga aur aisa karunga."' Jab humne Anas ko chhoda, maine apne kuch saathiyon se kaha, 'Chalo hum Al-Hasan ke paas se guzarein jo Abi Khalifa ke ghar mein chhupe hue hain aur unse guzaarish karein wo humein bataayein jo Anas bin Malik ne humein bataaya hai.' To hum unke paas gaye aur humne unhein salaam kiya aur unhone humein andar aane diya. Humne unse kaha, 'Aye Abu Saeed! Hum aapke bhai Anas bin Malik se aapke paas aaye hain aur unhone humein sifaarish ke baare mein ek aisi hadees sunaayi jaisi maine kabhi nahi suni.' Unhone kaha, 'Wo kya hai?' Phir humne unhein hadees bataayi aur kaha, 'Wo is jagah (hadees mein) ruk gaye.' Unhone kaha, 'Phir kya?' Humne kaha, 'Unhone usmein kuch aur izaafa nahi kiya.' Unhone kaha, 'Anas ne mujhe ye hadees bees saal pehle sunaayi thi jab wo ek jawaan aadmi the. Mujhe nahi pata unhein ye bhool gayi ya unhein pasand nahi tha ke tum unki kahi hui baat par bharosa karo.' Humne kaha, 'Aye Abu Saeed! Humein wo bataaiye.' Wo muskuraaye aur kaha, 'Insaan ko jaldbaazi karne wala banaaya gaya hai. Maine iska zikr nahi kiya, magar main tumhein iske baare mein bataana chahta tha. Anas ne mujhe wahi bataya jo unhone tumhein bataya aur kaha ke Nabi (SAW) ne izaafa kiya, "Main phir chauthi baar wapas jaunga aur usi tarah Usski tareef karunga aur Uske saamne sajda mein gir jaunga. (Kaha jaayega) usi tarah, 'Aye Muhammad, apna sar uthaao aur bolo, kyunke tumhaari baat suni jaayegi; aur maango, kyunke tumhaari (darkhwaast) di jaayegi; aur sifaarish karo, kyunke tumhaari sifaarish qubool ki jaayegi.' Main kahoonga, 'Aye Rab, mujhe ijaazat do sifaarish karne ki us har shaks ke liye jisne kaha, 'Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi.'' Phir Allah kahega, 'Meri Qudrat, aur Meri Buzurgi, aur Meri Sarvocchta, aur Meri Mahaanata ki qasam, main Jahannam (ki Aag) se har us shaks ko nikaaloonga jisne kaha: 'Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi.''"

e: Narrated `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The person who will be the last one to enter Paradise and the last to come out of Hell (Fire) will be a man who will come out crawling, and his Lord will say to him, 'Enter Paradise.' He will reply, 'O Lord, Paradise is full.' Allah will give him the same order thrice, and each time the man will give Him the same reply, i.e., 'Paradise is full.' Thereupon Allah will say (to him), 'Ten times of the world is for you
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Wo shaks jo sabse aakhri hoga Jannat mein daakhil hone wala aur sabse aakhri Jahannam ki Aag se nikalne wala, wo ek aisa aadmi hoga jo ghaseetta hua nikalega, aur uska Rab usse kahega, "Jannat mein daakhil ho jaao." Wo jawab dega, "Aye Rab, Jannat to bhari hui hai." Allah use teen baar yahi hukm dega, aur har baar wo aadmi usse wahi jawab dega, yaani "Jannat bhari hui hai." Isper Allah kahega (usse), "Duniya jitna dus guna tumhaare liye hai."'

e: Narrated `Adi bin Hatim:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "There will be none among you but his Lord will talk to him, and there will be no interpreter between him and Allah. He will look to his right and see nothing but his deeds which he has sent forward, and will look to his left and see nothing but his deeds which he has sent forward, and will look in front of him and see nothing but the (Hell) Fire facing him. So save yourself from the (Hell) Fire even with half a date (given in charity)." Al-A`mash said: `Amr bin Murra said, Khaithama narrated the same and added, '..even with a good word
hi: Adi bin Hatim (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Tum mein se koi bhi nahi hoga jiske saath uska Rab baat na karega, aur unke beech koi mutarjim nahi hoga. Wo apni daayin taraf dekhega aur usmein sirf apne aage bheje hue amaal dekhega, aur apni baayin taraf dekhega aur usmein sirf apne aage bheje hue amaal dekhega, aur apne saamne dekhega aur (Jahannam ki) Aag ko apne saamne aata dekhega. Isliye khud ko Aag se bachaao, chaahe aadhe khajoor ke saath (sadqe mein diye gaye) hi kyun na ho.' Al-A'mash ne kaha: Amr bin Murra ne kaha, Khaithama ne yahi riwaayat ki aur izaafa kiya, '...ya ek achhi baat se hi bacho.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:A priest from the Jews came (to the Prophet) and said, "On the Day of Resurrection, Allah will place all the heavens on one finger, and the Earth on one finger, and the waters and the land on one finger, and all the creation on one finger, and then He will shake them and say. 'I am the King! I am the King!'" I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) smiling till his premolar teeth became visible expressing his amazement and his belief in what he had said. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) recited: 'No just estimate have they made of Allah such as due to Him (up to)...; High is He above the partners they attribute to Him
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Yahudiyon ka ek padri aaya (Nabi ke paas) aur kaha, 'Qayamat ke din, Allah sab aasmaanon ko ek Ungli par rakhega, aur Zameen ko ek Ungli par, aur paani aur zameen ko ek Ungli par, aur sab makhlooq ko ek Ungli par, aur phir wo unhein hilaayega aur kahega, "Main Baadshah hoon! Main Baadshah hoon!"' Maine Nabi (SAW) ko muskuraate dekha yahaan tak ke unke ande waale daant dikhne lage, apni hairaani aur us baat par apna Iman zaahir karte hue jo kahi gayi thi. Phir Nabi (SAW) ne padha: 'Unhone Allah ka jaisa haq hai waisa andaaza nahi lagaaya... (jab tak)...; Wo Buland hai un shareekon se jo wo Use manate hain.'

e: Narrated Safwan bin Muhriz:A man asked Ibn `Umar, "What have you heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) regarding An-Najwa?" He said, "Everyone of you will come close to His Lord Who will screen him from the people and say to him, 'Did you do so-and-so?' He will reply, 'Yes.' Then Allah will say, 'Did you do so-and-so?' He will reply, 'Yes.' So Allah will question him and make him confess, and then Allah will say, 'I screened your sins in the world and forgive them for you today
hi: Safwan bin Muhriz bataate hain: Ek shaks ne Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha, 'Aapne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se An-Najwa (chupke se baat karna) ke baare mein kya suna hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Tum mein se har ek apne Rab ke qareeb aayega Jo use logon se parde mein rakhega aur usse kahega, "Kya tumne aisa-aisa kiya tha?" Wo jawab dega, "Haan." Phir Allah kahega, "Kya tumne aisa-aisa kiya tha?" Wo jawab dega, "Haan." To Allah usse sawaal poochta rahega aur use iqraar karwaayega, aur phir Allah kahega, "Maine duniya mein tumhaare gunaah chhupaaye the aur aaj main tumhein wo maaf kar deta hoon."'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Adam and Moses debated with each other and Moses said, 'You are Adam who turned out your offspring from Paradise.' Adam said, "You are Moses whom Allah chose for His Message and for His direct talk, yet you blame me for a matter which had been ordained for me even before my creation?' Thus Adam overcame Moses
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Aadam aur Musa ne ek doosre se behas ki aur Musa ne kaha, "Tum Aadam ho jinhone apni nasl ko Jannat se baahar nikaalwaaya." Aadam ne kaha, "Tum Musa ho jinhein Allah ne apne Paighaam aur apni seedhi baat-cheet ke liye chuna, phir bhi tum mujhe ek aise maamle ke liye ilzaam dete ho jo mere paida hone se bhi pehle mere liye taye kiya ja chuka tha?" Isi tarah Aadam ne Musa ko haraa diya.'

e: Narrated Anas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The believers will be assembled on the Day of Resurrection and they will say, 'Let us look for someone to intercede for us with our Lord so that He may relieve us from this place of ours.' So they will go to Adam and say, 'You are Adam, the father of mankind, and Allah created you with His Own Hands and ordered the Angels to prostrate before you, and He taught you the names of all things; so please intercede for us with our Lord so that He may relieve us.' Adam will say, to them, 'I am not fit for that,' and then he will mention to them his mistake which he has committed
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Momineen Qayamat ke din jama kiye jaayenge aur wo kahenge, "Chalo hum kisi ko dhoondhein jo hamare Rab se hamaari sifaarish kare taake wo humein hamaari is jagah se raahat de." To wo Aadam ke paas jaayenge aur kahenge, "Aap Aadam hain, insaaniyat ke baap, aur Allah ne aapko apne khud ke Haathon se banaaya aur farishton ko aapke saamne sajda karne ka hukm diya, aur aapko sab cheezon ke naam sikhaaye; isliye barah-e-meharbaani hamare Rab se hamaari sifaarish kijiye taake wo humein raahat de." Aadam kahenge (unse), "Main is kaam ke laayak nahi," aur phir wo unhein apni galti yaad dilaayenge jo unhone ki thi.'

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The night Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was taken for a journey from the sacred mosque (of Mecca) Al-Ka`ba: Three persons came to him (in a dreamy while he was sleeping in the Sacred Mosque before the Divine Inspiration was revealed to Him. One of them said, "Which of them is he?" The middle (second) angel said, "He is the best of them." The last (third) angle said, "Take the best of them." Only that much happened on that night and he did not see them till they came on another night, i.e. after The Divine Inspiration was revealed to him. (Fath-ul-Bari Page 258, Vol. 17) and he saw them, his eyes were asleep but his heart was not----and so is the case with the prophets: their eyes sleep while their hearts do not sleep. So those angels did not talk to him till they carried him and placed him beside the well of Zamzam. From among them Gabriel took charge of him. Gabriel cut open (the part of his body) between his throat and the middle of his chest (heart) and took all the material out of his chest and `Abdomen and then washed it with Zamzam water with his own hands till he cleansed the inside of his body, and then a gold tray containing a gold bowl full of belief and wisdom was brought and then Gabriel stuffed his chest and throat blood vessels with it and then closed it (the chest). He then ascended with him to the heaven of the world and knocked on one of its doors. The dwellers of the Heaven asked, 'Who is it?' He said, "Gabriel." They said, "Who is accompanying you?" He said, "Muhammad." They said, "Has he been called?" He said, "Yes" They said, "He is welcomed." So the dwellers of the Heaven became pleased with his arrival, and they did not know what Allah would do to the Prophet (ﷺ) on earth unless Allah informed them. The Prophet (ﷺ) met Adam over the nearest Heaven. Gabriel said to the Prophet, "He is your father; greet him." The Prophet (ﷺ) greeted him and Adam returned his greeting and said, "Welcome, O my Son! O what a good son you are!" Behold, he saw two flowing rivers, while he was in the nearest sky. He asked, "What are these two rivers, O Gabriel?" Gabriel said, "These are the sources of the Nile and the Euphrates." Then Gabriel took him around that Heaven and behold, he saw another river at the bank of which there was a palace built of pearls and emerald. He put his hand into the river and found its mud like musk Adhfar. He asked, "What is this, O Gabriel?" Gabriel said, "This is the Kauthar which your Lord has kept for you." Then Gabriel ascended (with him) to the second Heaven and the angels asked the same questions as those on the first Heaven, i.e., "Who is it?" Gabriel replied, "Gabriel". They asked, "Who is accompanying you?" He said, "Muhammad." They asked, "Has he been sent for?" He said, "Yes." Then they said, "He is welcomed.'' Then he (Gabriel) ascended with the Prophet (ﷺ) to the third Heaven, and the angels said the same as the angels of the first and the second Heavens had said. Then he ascended with him to the fourth Heaven and they said the same; and then he ascended with him to the fifth Heaven and they said the same; and then he ascended with him to the sixth Heaven and they said the same; then he ascended with him to the seventh Heaven and they said the same. On each Heaven there were prophets whose names he had mentioned and of whom I remember Idris on the second Heaven, Aaron on the fourth Heavens another prophet whose name I don't remember, on the fifth Heaven, Abraham on the sixth Heaven, and Moses on the seventh Heaven because of his privilege of talking to Allah directly. Moses said (to Allah), "O Lord! I thought that none would be raised up above me." But Gabriel ascended with him (the Prophet) for a distance above that, the distance of which only Allah knows, till he reached the Lote Tree (beyond which none may pass) and then the Irresistible, the Lord of Honor and Majesty approached and came closer till he (Gabriel) was about two bow lengths or (even) nearer. (It is said that it was Gabriel who approached and came closer to the Prophet. (Fate Al-Bari Page 263, 264, Vol. 17). Among the things which Allah revealed to him then, was: "Fifty prayers were enjoined on his followers in a day and a night." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) descended till he met Moses, and then Moses stopped him and asked, "O Muhammad ! What did your Lord en join upon you?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied," He enjoined upon me to perform fifty prayers in a day and a night." Moses said, "Your followers cannot do that; Go back so that your Lord may reduce it for you and for them." So the Prophet (ﷺ) turned to Gabriel as if he wanted to consult him about that issue. Gabriel told him of his opinion, saying, "Yes, if you wish." So Gabriel ascended with him to the Irresistible and said while he was in his place, "O Lord, please lighten our burden as my followers cannot do that." So Allah deducted for him ten prayers where upon he returned to Moses who stopped him again and kept on sending him back to his Lord till the enjoined prayers were reduced to only five prayers. Then Moses stopped him when the prayers had been reduced to five and said, "O Muhammad! By Allah, I tried to persuade my nation, Bani Israel to do less than this, but they could not do it and gave it up. However, your followers are weaker in body, heart, sight and hearing, so return to your Lord so that He may lighten your burden." The Prophet (ﷺ) turned towards Gabriel for advice and Gabriel did not disapprove of that. So he ascended with him for the fifth time. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Lord, my followers are weak in their bodies, hearts, hearing and constitution, so lighten our burden." On that the Irresistible said, "O Muhammad!" the Prophet replied, "Labbaik and Sa`daik." Allah said, "The Word that comes from Me does not change, so it will be as I enjoined on you in the Mother of the Book." Allah added, "Every good deed will be rewarded as ten times so it is fifty (prayers) in the Mother of the Book (in reward) but you are to perform only five (in practice)." The Prophet (ﷺ) returned to Moses who asked, "What have you done?" He said, "He has lightened our burden: He has given us for every good deed a tenfold reward." Moses said, "By Allah! I tried to make Bani Israel observe less than that, but they gave it up. So go back to your Lord that He may lighten your burden further." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O Moses! By Allah, I feel shy of returning too many times to my Lord." On that Gabriel said, "Descend in Allah's Name." The Prophet (ﷺ) then woke while he was in the Sacred Mosque (at Mecca)
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Us raat jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Sacred Mosque (Makkah ke) Al-Kaaba se safar (Isra) ke liye le jaaya gaya: Teen log unke paas aaye (khwaab jaisi haalat mein jabke wo Sacred Mosque mein so rahe the, Ilaahi Wahi unpar naazil hone se pehle). Unmein se ek ne kaha, 'In mein se kaun hain wo?' Beech waale (doosre) farishte ne kaha, 'Wo un mein sabse behtar hain.' Aakhri (teesre) farishte ne kaha, 'Un mein sabse behtar ko le lo.' Us raat sirf itna hi hua aur unhone unhein tab tak nahi dekha jab tak wo doosri raat nahi aaye, yaani Ilaahi Wahi unpar naazil hone ke baad. (Fath-ul-Bari Page 258, Jild 17) Aur unhone unhein dekha, unki aankhein so rahi thi magar unka dil nahi -- aur yahi haal Nabiyon ka hota hai: unki aankhein sooti hain jabke unke dil nahi sote. Isliye un farishton ne unse baat nahi ki jab tak unhone unhein uthaakar Zamzam ke kuen ke paas nahi rakha. Unmein se Jibrael ne unki zimmedaari li. Jibrael ne (unke jism ka hissa) unke gale aur unke seene (dil) ke beech chir diya aur unke seene aur pet se sab maadda nikaal liya aur phir use apne haathon se Zamzam ke paani se dhoya yahaan tak ke unhone unke jism ke andar ko saaf kar diya, aur phir sone ki ek thaali laayi gayi jismein Iman aur hikmat se bhari sone ki ek katori thi aur phir Jibrael ne unke seene aur gale ki nason ko usse bhar diya aur phir use (seene ko) band kar diya. Phir wo unke saath duniya ke aasmaan tak chadhe aur uske ek darwaaze par dastak di. Aasmaan ke rehne walon ne pucha, 'Kaun hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Jibrael.' Unhone kaha, 'Aapke saath kaun hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Muhammad.' Unhone kaha, 'Kya unhein bulaaya gaya hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan.' Unhone kaha, 'Unka swaagat hai.' To Aasmaan ke rehne wale unke aane se khush hue, aur unhein nahi pata tha ke Allah zameen par Nabi (SAW) ke saath kya karega jab tak Allah ne unhein bataaya nahi. Nabi (SAW) sabse qareebi Aasmaan par Aadam se mile. Jibrael ne Nabi (SAW) se kaha, 'Ye aapke waalid hain; unhein salaam kijiye.' Nabi (SAW) ne unhein salaam kiya aur Aadam ne unka salaam wapas kiya aur kaha, 'Khush-aamdeed, Aye mere bete! Aye tum kitne achhe bete ho!' Dekho, unhone do behti hui nadiyaan dekhi, jabke wo sabse qareebi aasmaan mein the. Unhone pucha, 'Ye do nadiyaan kya hain, Aye Jibrael?' Jibrael ne kaha, 'Ye Nile aur Euphrates ke srot hain.' Phir Jibrael unhein us Aasmaan mein le gaye aur dekho, unhone ek aur nadi dekhi jiske kinaare motiyon aur zamurrad se bana ek mahal tha. Unhone apna haath us nadi mein daala aur uski mitti mushk Adhfar jaisi paayi. Unhone pucha, 'Ye kya hai, Aye Jibrael?' Jibrael ne kaha, 'Ye Al-Kauthar hai jo tumhaare Rab ne tumhaare liye rakha hai.' Phir Jibrael unke saath doosre Aasmaan par chadhe aur farishton ne wahi sawaal pucha jo pehle Aasmaan waalon ne pucha tha, yaani, 'Kaun hai?' Jibrael ne jawab diya, 'Jibrael.' Unhone pucha, 'Aapke saath kaun hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Muhammad.' Unhone pucha, 'Kya unhein bulaaya gaya hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan.' Phir unhone kaha, 'Unka swaagat hai.' Phir wo (Jibrael) Nabi (SAW) ke saath teesre Aasmaan par chadhe, aur farishton ne wahi kaha jo pehle aur doosre Aasmaan ke farishton ne kaha tha. Phir wo unke saath chauthe Aasmaan par chadhe aur unhone wahi kaha; aur phir wo unke saath paanchve Aasmaan par chadhe aur unhone wahi kaha; aur phir wo unke saath chhathe Aasmaan par chadhe aur unhone wahi kaha; phir wo unke saath saatve Aasmaan par chadhe aur unhone wahi kaha. Har Aasmaan par Nabi log the jinke naam unhone zikr kiye jinmein se mujhe yaad hai Idris doosre Aasmaan par, Haroon chauthe Aasmaan par, ek aur Nabi jinka naam mujhe yaad nahi, paanchve Aasmaan par, Ibrahim chhathe Aasmaan par, aur Musa saatve Aasmaan par unke Allah se seedhe baat karne ke sammaan ki wajah se. Musa ne (Allah se) kaha, 'Aye Rab! Mujhe laga tha ke koi bhi mujhse oopar nahi utthaaya jaayega.' Magar Jibrael unke (Nabi ke) saath us doori se bhi oopar chadhe, jiska andaaza sirf Allah ko hi hai, yahaan tak ke wo Sidrat-al-Muntaha (Lote Tree) tak pahunche aur phir Ghaalib, Izzat aur Buzurgi ka Malik, qareeb aaya aur itna qareeb aaya ke wo (Jibrael) do kamaanon ki doori ya usse bhi kam par the. (Kaha jaata hai ke Jibrael the jo Nabi (SAW) ke qareeb aaye. Fath Al-Bari Page 263, 264, Jild 17.) Un cheezon mein se jo Allah ne unhein us waqt naazil ki, ek ye thi: 'Unke maanne walon par ek din aur ek raat mein pachaas namazein farz ki gayi.' Phir Nabi (SAW) neeche aaye yahaan tak ke wo Musa se mile, aur phir Musa ne unhein roka aur pucha, 'Aye Muhammad! Aapke Rab ne aappar kya farz kiya?' Nabi (SAW) ne jawab diya, 'Unhone mujhpar ek din aur ek raat mein pachaas namazein padhne ka hukm diya.' Musa ne kaha, 'Aapke maanne wale ye nahi kar sakte; wapas jaao taake aapka Rab isse aapke aur unke liye kam kare.' To Nabi (SAW) Jibrael ki taraf mudhe jaise wo is maamle mein unse mashwara lena chahte hon. Jibrael ne unhein apni raay bataayi, kehte hue, 'Haan, agar aap chahein.' To Jibrael unke saath Ghaalib ke paas chadhe aur apni jagah par khade hokar kaha, 'Aye Rab, barah-e-meharbaani hamaara bojh halka kariye kyunke mere maanne wale ye nahi kar sakte.' To Allah ne unke liye dus namazein kam kar di, isper wo Musa ke paas wapas gaye jinhone unhein phir roka aur unhein baar-baar apne Rab ke paas wapas bhejte rahe yahaan tak ke farz namaazon ki tadaad sirf paanch reh gayi. Phir Musa ne unhein roka jab namazein paanch reh gayi thi aur kaha, 'Aye Muhammad! Allah ki qasam, maine apni qaum, Bani Israel, ko isse kam karne ki koshish ki thi, magar wo ye nahi kar sake aur isse chhod diya. Magar, aapke maanne wale jism, dil, drishti aur sunne mein kamzor hain, isliye apne Rab ke paas wapas jaaiye taake wo aapka bojh halka kare.' Nabi (SAW) Jibrael ki taraf mashware ke liye mudhe aur Jibrael ne isse naapasand nahi kiya. Isliye wo unke saath paanchvi baar chadhe. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Aye Rab, mere maanne wale apne jismon, dilon, sunne aur takat mein kamzor hain, isliye hamaara bojh halka kariye.' Isper Ghaalib ne kaha, 'Aye Muhammad!' Nabi ne jawab diya, 'Labbaik aur Sa'daik.' Allah ne kaha, 'Jo Baat Mujhse aati hai wo badalti nahi, isliye ye waisi hi hogi jaisi maine Ummul-Kitaab (Maa Kitaab) mein aappar farz ki thi.' Allah ne izaafa kiya, 'Har nek amal ka das guna ajr milega, isliye Ummul-Kitaab mein (ajr ke hisaab se) ye pachaas (namazein) hain magar aapko sirf paanch (amal mein) padhni hain.' Nabi (SAW) Musa ke paas wapas gaye jinhone pucha, 'Aapne kya kiya?' Unhone kaha, 'Usne hamaara bojh halka kar diya hai: Usne humein har nek amal ke liye das guna ajr diya hai.' Musa ne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam! Maine Bani Israel ko isse kam par amal karne ki koshish ki thi, magar unhone ise chhod diya. Isliye apne Rab ke paas wapas jaaiye taake wo aapka bojh aur halka kare.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Aye Musa! Allah ki qasam, mujhe apne Rab ke paas baar-baar wapas jaane mein sharm mehsoos hoti hai.' Isper Jibrael ne kaha, 'Allah ke Naam se neeche utro.' Nabi (SAW) phir jaage jabke wo Sacred Mosque (Makkah mein) mein the.

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah will say to the people of Paradise, "O the people of Paradise!" They will say, 'Labbaik, O our Lord, and Sa`daik, and all the good is in Your Hands!' Allah will say, "Are you satisfied?' They will say, 'Why shouldn't we be satisfied, O our Lord as You have given us what You have not given to any of Your created beings?' He will say, 'Shall I not give you something better than that?' They will say, 'O our Lord! What else could be better than that?' He will say, 'I bestow My Pleasure on you and will never be angry with you after that
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah Jannat ke logon se kahega, "Aye Jannat ke logo!" Wo kahenge, "Labbaik, Aye hamare Rab, aur Sa'daik, aur sab bhalaai Tere Haathon mein hai!" Allah kahega, "Kya tum santusht ho?" Wo kahenge, "Hum kyun na santusht hon, Aye hamare Rab, jabke tune humein wo diya hai jo tune apni kisi bhi banaayi hui makhlooq ko nahi diya?" Wo kahega, "Kya main tumhein isse behtar kuch na doon?" Wo kahenge, "Aye hamare Rab! Isse behtar aur kya ho sakta hai?" Wo kahega, "Main tumpar apni Khushi (Pleasure) naazil karta hoon aur uske baad kabhi tumse naaraaz nahi hounga."'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) was preaching while a bedouin was sitting there. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A man from among the people of Paradise will request Allah to allow him to cultivate the land Allah will say to him, 'Haven't you got whatever you desire?' He will reply, 'yes, but I like to cultivate the land (Allah will permit him and) he will sow the seeds, and within seconds the plants will grow and ripen and (the yield) will be harvested and piled in heaps like mountains. On that Allah will say (to him), "Take, here you are, O son of Adam, for nothing satisfies you.' "On that the bedouin said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Such man must be either from Quraish or from Ansar, for they are farmers while we are not." On that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) smiled
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Nabi (SAW) waaz de rahe the jabke wahaan ek badawi baitha tha. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Jannat ke logon mein se ek shaks Allah se kheti karne ki ijaazat maangega. Allah usse kahega, "Kya tumhein jo chaahiye wo nahi mila?" Wo jawab dega, "Haan, magar mujhe kheti karna pasand hai." (Allah use ijaazat dega aur) wo beej boyega, aur seconds mein paudhe ugenge aur paken lagenge aur (fasal) kaati jaayegi aur pahaadon jaisi dher lagegi. Isper Allah kahega (usse), "Le lo, ye rahi, Aye Aadam ke bete, kyunke kuch bhi tumhein santusht nahi karta."' Isper badawi ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Aisa shaks Quraish ya Ansaar mein se hi hoga, kyunke wo kheti-baadi karte hain jabke hum nahi karte.' Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) muskuraaye.

e: Narrated `Abdullah:I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) "What is the biggest sin in the sight of Allah?" He said, "To set up rivals unto Allah though He alone created you." I said, "In fact, that is a tremendous sin," and added, "What next?" He said, "To kill your son being afraid that he may share your food with you." I further asked, "What next?" He said, "To commit illegal sexual intercourse with the wife of your neighbor
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se pucha, 'Allah ke nazdeek sabse bada gunaah kaunsa hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Allah ke saath doosron ko shareek karna, jabke usne akele tumhein banaaya.' Maine kaha, 'Ye waaqai ek bahut bada gunaah hai,' aur izaafa kiya, 'Uske baad kaunsa?' Unhone kaha, 'Apne bete ko qatl karna is dar se ke wo tumhaare saath tumhaara khaana baantega.' Maine aage pucha, 'Uske baad kaunsa?' Unhone kaha, 'Apne padosi ki biwi ke saath zina karna.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:Two person of Bani Thaqif and one from Quraish (or two persons from Quraish and one from Bani Thaqif) who had fat bellies but little wisdom, met near the Ka`ba. One of them said, "Did you see that Allah hears what we say? " The other said, "He hears us if we speak aloud, but He does not hear if we speak in stealthy quietness (softly)." The third fellow said, "If He hears when we speak aloud, then He surely hears us if we speak in stealthy quietness (softly)." So Allah revealed the Verse:-- 'And you have not been screening against yourselves, lest your ears, and your eyes and your skins should testify against you
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Banu Thaqif ke do log aur Quraish ka ek shaks (ya Quraish ke do log aur Banu Thaqif ka ek shaks), jinke motay pet the magar kam samajh, Kaaba ke qareeb mile. Unmein se ek ne kaha, 'Kya tumne dekha ke Allah wo sunta hai jo hum kehte hain?' Doosre ne kaha, 'Wo humein sunta hai agar hum oonchi awaaz mein bolein, magar wo nahi sunta agar hum chupke se dheeme (aahista) bolein.' Teesre shaks ne kaha, 'Agar wo oonchi awaaz mein bolne par sunta hai, to wo zaroor humein dheeme bolne par bhi sunega.' To Allah ne ye Aayat naazil ki: 'Aur tum apne aap ko chhupaate (parde mein rakhte) nahi the, is dar se ke tumhaare kaan, tumhaari aankhein, aur tumhaari khaal tumhaare khilaaf gawaahi de sakti hain...'

e: Narrated `Ikrima:Ibn `Abbas said, "How can you ask the people of the Scriptures about their Books while you have Allah's Book (the Qur'an) which is the most recent of the Books revealed by Allah, and you read it in its pure undistorted form?
hi: Ikrima bataate hain: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Tum Ahl-e-Kitaab se unki Kitaabon ke baare mein kaise poochh sakte ho jabke tumhaare paas Allah ki Kitaab (Quran) hai jo Allah ki naazil ki hui sab Kitaabon mein sabse nayi hai, aur tum ise uski saaf, gair-tehrif-shuda shakl mein padhte ho?'

e: Narrated 'Ubaidullah bin `Abdullah:`Abdullah bin `Abbas said, "O the group of Muslims! How can you ask the people of the Scriptures about anything while your Book which Allah has revealed to your Prophet contains the most recent news from Allah and is pure and not distorted? Allah has told you that the people of the Scriptures have changed some of Allah's Books and distorted it and wrote something with their own hands and said, 'This is from Allah, so as to have a minor gain for it. Won't the knowledge that has come to you stop you from asking them? No, by Allah, we have never seen a man from them asking you about that (the Book Al-Qur'an ) which has been revealed to you
hi: Ubaidullah bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abdullah bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Aye Musalmaanon ke giroh! Tum Ahl-e-Kitaab se kisi bhi baat ke baare mein kaise poochh sakte ho jabke tumhaari khud ki Kitaab, jo Allah ne tumhaare Nabi par naazil ki hai, sabse taazi khabar rakhti hai Allah ki taraf se aur saaf hai, tehrif-shuda nahi? Allah ne tumhein bataya hai ke Ahl-e-Kitaab ne Allah ki kuch Kitaabon mein badlaav kiya aur tehrif ki aur apne khud ke haathon se kuch likha aur kaha, "Ye Allah ki taraf se hai," taake isse ek chhota faayda ho sake. Kya jo ilm tumhaare paas aa gaya hai, wo tumhein unse kuch poochne se nahi rokta? Nahi, Allah ki qasam, humne kabhi unmein se kisi ko tumse ye poochte nahi dekha jo tumpar naazil hua hai (yaani Quran).'

e: Narrated Musa bin Abi `Aisha:Sa`id bin Jubair reported from Ibn `Abbas (regarding the explanation of the Verse: 'Do not move your tongue concerning (the Qur'an) to make haste therewith) . He said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) used to undergo great difficulty in receiving the Divine Inspiration and used to move his lips.' Ibn `Abbas said (to Sa`id), "I move them (my lips) as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to move his lips." And Sa`id said (to me), "I move my lips as I saw Ibn `Abbas moving his lips," and then he moved his lips. So Allah revealed:-- '(O Muhammad!) Do not move your tongue concerning (the Qur'an) to make haste therewith. It is for Us to collect it and give you (O Muhammad) the ability to recite it. (i.e., to collect it in your chest and then you recite it).' (75.16-17) But when We have recited it, to you (O Muhammad through Gabriel) then follow you its recital.' (75.18) This means, "You should listen to it and keep quiet and then it is upon Us to make you recite it." The narrator added, "So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to listen whenever Gabriel came to him, and when Gabriel left, the Prophet (ﷺ) would recite the Qur'an as Gabriel had recited it to him
hi: Musa bin Abi Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataate hain: Saeed bin Jubair ne Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se riwaayat ki (is Aayat ki tashreeh ke baare mein: 'Apni zubaan (Quran ke baare mein) jaldi se mat hilaao'). Unhone kaha, 'Nabi (SAW) ko Ilaahi Wahi paane mein bahut mushkil hoti thi aur wo apne honth hilaate the.' Ibn Abbas ne (Saeed se) kaha, 'Main unhein (apne honth) waise hi hilaata hoon jaise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apne honth hilaate the.' Aur Saeed ne (mujhse) kaha, 'Main apne honth waise hi hilaata hoon jaise maine Ibn Abbas ko apne honth hilaate dekha,' aur phir unhone apne honth hilaaye. To Allah ne naazil kiya: '(Aye Muhammad!) Apni zubaan (Quran ke baare mein) jaldi se mat hilaao. Ise jama karna aur tumhein (Aye Muhammad) ise padhne ki qudrat dena Hamaari zimmedaari hai.' (75:16-17) (yaani, ise tumhaare seene mein jama karna aur phir tumhein ise padhwaana.) 'Magar jab Hum ise tumhaare (Aye Muhammad, Jibrael ke zariye) padh chuke hon, to tum uski tilaawat ki pairvi karo.' (75:18) Iska matlab hai, 'Tumhein ise sunna chaahiye aur khaamosh rehna chaahiye aur phir Hamaari zimmedaari hai tumhein ise padhwaana.' Ravi ne izaafa kiya, 'To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) sunte the jab bhi Jibrael unke paas aate, aur jab Jibrael chale jaate, Nabi (SAW) Quran waise hi padhte jaise Jibrael ne unhein padha tha.'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:regarding the explanation of the Verse:-- '(O Muhammad!) Neither say your prayer aloud, nor say it in a low tone.' (17.110) This Verse was revealed while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was hiding himself at Mecca. At that time, when he led his companions in prayer, he used to raise his voice while reciting the Qur'an; and if the pagans heard him, they would abuse the Qur'an, its Revealer, and the one who brought it. So Allah said to His Prophet: "Neither say your prayer aloud. i.e., your recitation (of Qur'an) lest the pagans should hear (it) and abuse the Qur'an" nor say it in a low tone, "lest your voice should fail to reach your companions, "but follow a way between
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain (is Aayat ki tashreeh ke baare mein): '(Aye Muhammad!) Na to apni namaz oonchi awaaz mein padho, na hi use dhime lehje mein padho.' (17:110) Ye Aayat tab naazil hui thi jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khud ko Makkah mein chhupaaye hue the. Us waqt, jab wo apne sahaaba ko namaz padhaate, wo Quran ki tilaawat karte waqt apni awaaz oonchi karte; aur agar mushrik unhein sunte, wo Quran, uske Naazil karne wale, aur use laane wale ki bura-bhala kehte. To Allah ne apne Nabi se kaha: 'Na to apni namaz oonchi awaaz mein padho,' yaani, 'apni tilaawat (Quran ki) is dar se mat oonchi karo ke mushrik ise sun sakein aur Quran ka bura-bhala kahein,' 'na hi use dhime lehje mein padho,' 'is dar se ke tumhaari awaaz tumhaare saathiyon tak na pahunche,' 'balke in dono ke beech ka raasta apnao.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Verse:-- '(O Muhammad!) Neither say your prayer aloud nor say it in a low tone.' (17.110) was revealed in connection with the invocations
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Aayat: '(Aye Muhammad!) Na to apni namaz oonchi awaaz mein padho, na hi use dhime lehje mein padho.' (17:110) Duaon ke silsile mein naazil hui thi.

e: Narrated Abu Salama:Abu Huraira said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Whoever does not recite Qur'an in a nice voice is not from us,' and others said extra," (that means) to recite it aloud
hi: Abu Salama bataate hain: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, "Jo koi Quran ko achhi awaaz mein nahi padhta, wo hamme se nahi hai,"' aur doosron ne izaafa kiya, '(iska matlab hai) ise oonchi awaaz mein padhna.'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Not to wish to be the like of except the like of two men: a man whom Allah has given the Qur'an and he recites it during the hours of the night and the hours of the day, in which case one may say, "If I were given the same as this man has been given, I would do the same as he is doing.' The other is a man whom Allah has given wealth and he spends it in the right way, in which case one may say, 'If I were given the same as he has been given, I would do the same as he is doing
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kisi jaisa banne ki tamanna mat karo siwaaye do logon jaisa banne ke: ek wo aadmi jise Allah ne Quran diya hai aur wo use raat aur din ke ghanton mein padhta hai, jispar koi kahe, "Agar mujhe bhi wahi milta jo isko mila hai, to main wahi karta jo ye kar raha hai." Doosra wo aadmi hai jise Allah ne daulat di hai aur wo use sahi tareeke se kharch karta hai, jispar koi kahe, "Agar mujhe bhi wahi milta jo isko mila hai, to main wahi karta jo ye kar raha hai."'

e: Narrated Salim's father:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Not to wish to be the like of except the like of two (persons): a man whom Allah has given the knowledge of the Qur'an and he recites it during the hours of the night and the hours of the day; and a man whom Allah has given wealth and he spends it (in Allah's Cause) during the hours of the night and during the hours of the day
hi: Salim ke waalid bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Kisi jaisa banne ki tamanna mat karo siwaaye do (logon) jaisa banne ke: ek wo aadmi jise Allah ne Quran ka ilm diya hai aur wo use raat aur din ke ghanton mein padhta hai; aur doosra wo aadmi jise Allah ne daulat di hai aur wo use (Allah ki raah mein) raat aur din ke ghanton mein kharch karta hai.'

e: Narrated Al-Mughira:Our Prophet has informed us our Lord's Message that whoever of us is martyred, will go to Paradise
hi: Al-Mughira bataate hain: Hamare Nabi ne humein hamare Rab ka paighaam bataya ke hum mein se jo koi shaheed ho, wo Jannat mein jaayega.

e: Narrated `Aisha:Whoever tells you that the Prophet (ﷺ) concealed something of the Divine Inspiration, do not believe him, for Allah said: 'O Apostle Muhammad! Proclaim (the Message) which has been sent down to you from your Lord, and if you do it not, then you have not conveyed His Message
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jo koi tumhein kahe ke Nabi (SAW) ne Ilaahi Wahi ki kuch baat chhupaayi, uspar yaqeen mat karna, kyunke Allah ne kaha: 'Aye Rasool Muhammad! Wo Paighaam pahunchaao jo tumhaare Rab se tumpar naazil kiya gaya hai, aur agar tum aisa nahi karte, to tumne Uska Paighaam pahuncha nahi diya.'

e: Narrated `Abdullah:A man said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Which sin is the biggest in Allah's Sight?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "To set up rivals unto Allah though He Alone created you." That man said, "What is next?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "To kill your son lest he should share your food with you.'' The man said, "What is next?" The Prophet said, "To commit illegal sexual intercourse with the wife of your neighbor." Then Allah revealed in confirmation of that: "And those who invoke not with Allah any other god, nor kill such life as Allah has made sacred except for just cause, nor commit illegal sexual intercourse and whoever does this shall receive the punishment
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Allah ke nazdeek sabse bada gunaah kaunsa hai?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Allah ke saath doosron ko shareek karna, jabke usne akele tumhein banaaya.' Us shaks ne kaha, 'Uske baad kaunsa?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Apne bete ko qatl karna is dar se ke wo tumhaare saath tumhaara khaana baantega.' Us shaks ne kaha, 'Uske baad kaunsa?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Apne padosi ki biwi ke saath zina karna.' Phir Allah ne is baat ki tasdeeq mein naazil kiya: 'Aur wo log jo Allah ke saath kisi aur khuda ki dua nahi karte, na aisi jaan ko qatl karte hain jise Allah ne haraam kiya hai siwaaye jaayez wajah ke, na zina karte hain. Aur jo koi aisa kare, use saza milegi...'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Your stay (in this world) in comparison to the stay of the nations preceding you, is like the period between `Asr prayer and the sun set (in comparison to a whole day). The people of the Torah were given the Torah and they acted on it till midday and then they were unable to carry on. And they were given (a reward equal to) one Qirat each. Then the people of the Gospel were given the Gospel and they acted on it till `Asr Prayer and then they were unable to carry on, so they were given la reward equal to) one Qirat each. Then you were given the Qur'an and you acted on it till sunset, therefore you were given (a reward equal to) two Qirats each. On that, the people of the Scriptures said, 'These people (Muslims) did less work than we but they took a bigger reward.' Allah said (to them). 'Have I done any oppression to you as regards your rights?' They said, "No." Then Allah said, 'That is My Blessing which I grant to whomsoever I will
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Tumhaari (is duniya mein) reh ne ki muddat, tumse pehle ki ummaton ke muqaable mein, Asr ki namaz aur suraj doobne ke beech ki muddat jaisi hai (poore din ke muqaable mein). Taurat waalon ko Taurat di gayi aur unhone dophar tak uspar amal kiya aur phir wo aage jaari nahi rakh paaye. Aur unhein har ek ko (ajr mein) ek Qirat mila. Phir Injeel waalon ko Injeel di gayi aur unhone Asr ki namaz tak uspar amal kiya aur phir wo aage jaari nahi rakh paaye, isliye unhein har ek ko (ajr mein) ek Qirat mila. Phir tumhein Quran diya gaya aur tumne suraj doobne tak uspar amal kiya, isliye tumhein har ek ko (ajr mein) do Qirat mile.' Isper Ahl-e-Kitaab ne kaha, 'In logon (Musalmaanon) ne humse kam kaam kiya magar zyaada ajr liya.' Allah ne (unse) kaha, 'Kya maine tumhaare haqon mein koi zulm kiya hai?' Unhone kaha, 'Nahi.' Phir Allah ne kaha, 'Ye Mera Ashirvaad hai jo main jise chaahun deta hoon.'

e: Narrated Ibn Mas`ud:A man asked the Prophet (ﷺ) "What deeds are the best?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said: "(1) To perform the (daily compulsory) prayers at their (early) stated fixed times, (2) to be good and dutiful to one's own parents, (3) and to participate in Jihad in Allah's Cause
hi: Ibn Masud bataate hain: Ek shaks ne Nabi (SAW) se pucha, 'Kaunse amaal sabse behtareen hain?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, '(1) Farz namazein apne (mukarrar) muqarrar waqt par padhna, (2) apne maa-baap ke saath achha aur farmaanbardaar rehna, (3) aur Allah ki raah mein Jihad karna.'

e: Narrated Al-Hasan:`Amr bin Taghlib said, "Some property was given to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he gave it to some people and withheld it from some others. Then he came to know that they (the latter) were dissatisfied. So the Prophet said, 'I give to one man and leave (do not give) another, and the one to whom I do not give is dearer to me than the one to whom I give. I give to some people because of the impatience and discontent present in their hearts, and leave other people because of the content and goodness Allah has bestowed on them, and one of them is `Amr bin Taghlib." `Amr bin Taghlib said, "The sentence which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said in my favor is dearer to me than the possession of nice red camels
hi: Al-Hasan bataate hain: Amr bin Taghlib (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Nabi (SAW) ko kuch jaayadaad di gayi aur unhone use kuch logon ko diya aur kuch se rok liya. Phir unhein pata chala ke wo (baad wale) asantusht hain. Isper Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, "Main ek aadmi ko deta hoon aur doosre ko nahi deta (rokta hoon), aur jise main nahi deta wo mujhe us se zyaada aziz hai jise main deta hoon. Main kuch logon ko unke dilon mein maujood betaabi aur asantosh ki wajah se deta hoon, aur kuch logon ko iski wajah se rokta hoon ke Allah ne unhein santosh aur bhalaai se nawaaza hai, aur unmein se ek Amr bin Taghlib hai."' Amr bin Taghlib ne kaha, 'Wo jumla jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mere haq mein kaha, wo mujhe laal-laal khoobsoorat oonton ke maalik hone se bhi zyaada aziz hai.'

e: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "My Lord says, 'If My slave comes nearer to me for a span, I go nearer to him for a cubit; and if he comes nearer to Me for a cubit, I go nearer to him for the span of outstretched arms; and if he comes to Me walking, I go to him running
hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Mera Rab farmaata hai, "Agar mera bandaa ek bitta mere qareeb aaye, main ek haath uske qareeb jaata hoon; aur agar wo ek haath mere qareeb aaye, main do phaile hue baazuon jitni doori uske qareeb jaata hoon; aur agar wo mere paas chalte hue aaye, main daudkar uske paas jaata hoon."'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:Perhaps the Prophet (ﷺ) mentioned the following (as Allah's Saying): "If My slave comes nearer to Me for a span, I go nearer to him for a cubit; and if he comes nearer to Me for a cubit; I go nearer to him for the span of outstretched arms. (See Hadith No)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Shaayad Nabi (SAW) ne ye zikr kiya (Allah ki baat ke taur par): 'Agar mera bandaa ek bitta mere qareeb aaye, main ek haath uske qareeb jaata hoon; aur agar wo ek haath mere qareeb aaye, main do phaile hue baazuon jitni doori uske qareeb jaata hoon.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees dekhein.)

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said that your Lord said, "Every (sinful) deed can be expiated; and the fast is for Me, so I will give the reward for it; and the smell which comes out of the mouth of a fasting person, is better in Allah's Sight than the smell of musk." (See Hadith No)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne kaha ke tumhaare Rab ne kaha, 'Har (gunahgaar) amal ka kaffara diya jaa sakta hai; aur roza Mere liye hai, isliye main hi iska ajr dunga; aur roza rakhne wale ke munh se aane wali khushbu Allah ke nazdeek mushk ki khushbu se bhi behtar hai.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees dekhein.)

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said that his Lord said: "It does not befit a slave that he should say that he is better than Jonah (Yunus) bin Matta
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne kaha ke unke Rab ne kaha: 'Kisi bande ko ye kehna shobha nahi deta ke wo Yunus bin Matta se behtar hai.'

e: Narrated Shu`ba:Mu'awiya bin Qurra reported that `Abdullah bin Al-Maghaffal Al-Muzani said, "I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the day of the Conquest of Mecca, riding his she-camel and reciting Surat-al-Fath (48) or part of Surat-al-Fath. He recited it in a vibrating and pleasant voice. Then Mu'awiya recited as `Abdullah bin Mughaffal had done and said, "Were I not afraid that the people would crowd around me, I would surely recite in a vibrating pleasant voice as Ibn Mughaffal did, imitating the Prophet." I asked Muawiya, "How did he recite in that tone?" He said thrice, "A, A , A
hi: Shu'ba bataate hain: Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Qurra ne bataaya ke Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Maghaffal Al-Muzani ne kaha, 'Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Fatah-e-Makkah ke din dekha, apni oontni par sawaar, Surat-al-Fath (48) ya uska kuch hissa padhte hue. Unhone ise ek lehrati aur khushnuma awaaz mein padha.' Phir Muawiya ne waise hi padha jaisa Abdullah bin Mughaffal ne kiya tha aur kaha, 'Agar mujhe dar na hota ke log mere gird bheed lagaayenge, main zaroor ek lehrati khushnuma awaaz mein padhta jaisa Ibn Mughaffal ne kiya, Nabi (SAW) ki nakal karte hue.' Maine Muawiya se pucha, 'Wo us lehje mein kaise padhte the?' Unhone teen baar kaha, 'A, A, A.'

e: And Ibn 'Abbas narrated:Abu Sufyan bin Harb told me that Heraclius called for his translator and then asked for the letter of the Prophet (ﷺ), and the former read it (thus): "In the Name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Merciful. (This letter is) from Muhammad bin 'Abdullah, to Heraclius. "...O people of the Scripture (Jews and Christians): Come to a word that is just between us and you that we worship none but Allah..." (V.3:)
hi: Aur Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne riwaayat ki: Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Harb ne mujhe bataya ke Heraclius ne apne mutarjim ko bulwaaya aur phir Nabi (SAW) ka khat maangaa, aur unhone (mutarjim ne) use padha (isi tarah): 'Allah ke Naam se, jo bahut Meharbaan, bahut Reham Karne wala hai. (Ye khat) Muhammad bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki taraf se hai, Heraclius ke naam. ...Aye Ahl-e-Kitaab (Yahudi aur Isaai): Aao ek aisi baat ki taraf jo hamare aur tumhaare beech barabar hai ke hum Allah ke siwa kisi ki ibaadat na karein...' (3:64)

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The people of the Scripture used to read the Torah in Hebrew and explain it to the Muslims in Arabic. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Do not believe the people of the Scripture, and do not disbelieve them, but say, 'We believe in Allah and whatever has been revealed
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ahl-e-Kitaab Taurat Ibrani zubaan mein padhte the aur ise Musalmaanon ko Arbi mein samjhaate the. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Ahl-e-Kitaab ko na maano, aur na unhein jhutlaao, balke kaho, "Hum Allah par Iman rakhte hain aur jo bhi naazil kiya gaya hai."'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:A Jew and Jewess were brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) on a charge of committing an illegal sexual intercourse. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked the Jews, "What do you (usually) do with them?" They said, "We blacken their faces and disgrace them." He said, "Bring here the Torah and recite it, if you are truthful." They (fetched it and) came and asked a one-eyed man to recite. He went on reciting till he reached a portion on which he put his hand. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Lift up your hand!" He lifted his hand up and behold, there appeared the verse of Ar-Rajm (stoning of the adulterers to death). Then he said, "O Muhammad! They should be stoned to death but we conceal this Divine Law among ourselves." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered that the two sinners be stoned to death and, and they were stoned to death, and I saw the man protecting the woman from the stones. (See Hadith No. 809, Vol)
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek Yahudi mard aur ek Yahudi khaatoon ko Nabi (SAW) ke paas zina ke ilzaam mein laaya gaya. Nabi (SAW) ne Yahudiyon se pucha, 'Tum (aam taur par) unke saath kya karte ho?' Unhone kaha, 'Hum unke chehre kaale karte hain aur unhein zaleel karte hain.' Unhone kaha, 'Taurat yahaan laao aur ise padho, agar tum sachche ho.' Wo (use lekar) aaye aur ek aankh se andhe shaks se padhne ko kaha. Wo padhta gaya yahaan tak ke wo us hisse par pahuncha jispar usne apna haath rakh diya. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Apna haath uthaao!' Usne apna haath uthaaya, aur dekho, wahaan Ar-Rajm (zina karne walon ko sangsaar karne) ki Aayat zaahir hui. Phir usne kaha, 'Aye Muhammad! Unhein sangsaar kiya jaana chaahiye, magar hum is Ilaahi Qanoon ko apne beech chhupaate hain.' Phir Nabi (SAW) ne hukm diya ke dono gunahgaaron ko sangsaar kiya jaaye, aur unhein sangsaar kiya gaya, aur maine us aadmi ko khaatoon ko pattharon se bachaate dekha. (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 809, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:that he heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Allah does not listen to anything as He listens to the recitation of the Qur'an by a Prophet who recites it in attractive audible sweet sounding voice
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke unhone Nabi (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, 'Allah kisi bhi cheez ko utne dhyaan se nahi sunta jitne dhyaan se wo ek Nabi ko Quran khoobsoorat, sunne mein aane wali, meethi awaaz mein padhte sunta hai.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:(when the slanderers said what they said about her): I went to my bed knowing at that time that I was innocent and that Allah would reveal my innocence, but by Allah, I never thought that Allah would reveal in my favor a revelation which would be recited, for I considered myself too unimportant to be talked about by Allah in the Divine Revelation that was to be recited. So Allah revealed the ten Verses (of Surat-an-Nur). 'Those who brought a false charge
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain (jab bohtaan lagaane walon ne unke baare mein wo kaha jo unhone kaha): Main apne bistar par gayi ye jaante hue ke us waqt main bekasoor thi aur ke Allah meri paakeezgi zaahir karega, magar Allah ki qasam, mujhe kabhi khayaal nahi tha ke Allah mere haq mein aisi Wahi naazil karega jo padhi jaayegi, kyunke main khud ko itna maamooli samajhti thi ke Allah mere baare mein Ilaahi Wahi mein baat kare jo padhne ke liye naazil ki jaaye. To Allah ne das Aayaten naazil ki (Surat An-Nur ki). 'Jo log jhoota ilzaam laaye...'

e: Narrated Al-Bara':I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) reciting Surat at-Tin waz Zaitun (By the Fig and the Olive) in the `Isha' prayer and I have never heard anybody with a better voice or recitation than his
hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko Isha ki namaz mein Surat At-Tin waz-Zaitun (Anjeer aur Zaitun ki qasam) padhte suna, aur maine kabhi kisi ko unse behtar awaaz aur tilaawat mein nahi suna.

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) was hiding himself in Mecca and used to recite the (Qur'an) in a loud voice. When the pagans heard him they would abuse the Qur'an and the one who brought it, so Allah said to His Prophet: 'Neither say your prayer aloud, nor say it in a low tone
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) khud ko Makkah mein chhupaaye hue the aur oonchi awaaz mein (Quran ki) tilaawat karte the. Jab mushrik unhein sunte, wo Quran aur use laane wale ki bura-bhala kehte, isliye Allah ne apne Nabi se kaha: 'Na to apni namaz oonchi awaaz mein padho, na hi use dhime lehje mein padho...'

e: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abdur-Rahman:that Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri said to him, "I see that you like sheep and the desert, so when you are looking after your sheep or when you are in the desert and want to pronounce the Adhan, raise your voice, for no Jinn, human being or any other things hear the Mu`adh-dhin's voice but will be a witness for him on the Day of Resurrection." Abu Sa`id added, "I heard this from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdur Rahman bataate hain ke Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne unse kaha, 'Main dekhta hoon aapko bakriyaan aur registaan pasand hain, isliye jab aap apni bakriyon ki dekhbhaal kar rahe hon ya registaan mein hon aur Azaan dena chahte hon, apni awaaz oonchi karo, kyunke koi bhi Jinn, insaan, ya koi aur cheez Muazzin ki awaaz nahi sunti magar wo Qayamat ke din uske haq mein gawaahi degi.' Abu Saeed ne izaafa kiya, 'Maine ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to recite the Qur'an with his head in my lap while I used to be in my periods (having menses)
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) Quran padha karte the apna sar mere godi mein rakhkar jabke main apni haiz (mahwaari) mein hoti thi.

e: Narrated `Umar bin Al-Khattab:I heard Hisham bin Hakim reciting Surat-al-Furqan during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), I listened to his recitation and noticed that he was reciting in a way that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had not taught me. I was about to jump over him while He was still in prayer, but I waited patiently and when he finished his prayer, I put my sheet round his neck (and pulled him) and said, "Who has taught you this Sura which I have heard you reciting?" Hisham said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) taught it to me." I said, "You are telling a lie, for he taught it to me in a way different from the way you have recited it!" Then I started leading (dragged) him to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said (to the Prophet), " I have heard this man reciting Surat-al- Furqan in a way that you have not taught me." The Prophet (ﷺ) said: "(O `Umar) release him! Recite, O Hisham." Hisham recited in the way I heard him reciting. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "It was revealed like this." Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Recite, O `Umar!" I recited in the way he had taught me, whereupon he said, "It was revealed like this," and added, "The Qur'an has been revealed to be recited in seven different ways, so recite of it whichever is easy for you ." (See Hadith No. 514, Vol)
hi: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab bataate hain: Maine Hisham bin Hakim ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zindagi mein Surah Al-Furqan padhte suna. Maine unki tilaawat suni aur notice kiya ke wo ise us tareeke se padh rahe the jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe nahi sikhaaya tha. Main unpar kood padne wala tha jabke wo abhi namaz mein the, magar maine sabra kiya, aur jab unhone apni namaz khatam ki, maine apna chaadar unki gardan ke gird lapeta (aur unhein khainchte hue) aur kaha, 'Ye Surah tumhein kisne sikhaayi jo maine tumhein padhte suna?' Hisham ne kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe ye sikhaayi.' Maine kaha, 'Tum jhoot bol rahe ho, kyunke unhone mujhe ye ek alag tareeke se sikhaayi hai jaisa tumne padha!' Phir main unhein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas le gaya (ghaseette hue) aur kaha (Nabi se), 'Maine is aadmi ko Surah Al-Furqan aisi tarah padhte suna jaisa aapne mujhe nahi sikhaaya.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: '(Aye Umar) unhein chhod do! Padho, Aye Hisham.' Hisham ne usi tarah padha jaisa maine unhein padhte suna tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Ye isi tarah naazil hua hai.' Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Padho, Aye Umar!' Maine usi tarah padha jaisa unhone mujhe sikhaaya tha, jispar unhone kaha, 'Ye isi tarah naazil hua hai,' aur izaafa kiya, 'Ye Quran saat alag-alag tareekon mein padhne ke liye naazil hua hai, isliye ise jis tarah bhi tumhare liye aasaan ho, padho.' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 514, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated `Imran:I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Why should a doer (people) try to do good deeds?' The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Everybody will find easy to do such deeds as will lead him to his destined place for which he has been created
hi: Imran bataate hain: Maine kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Amal karne wala (log) achhe amaal karne ki koshish kyun karein?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Har shaks ke liye wo amaal karna aasaan hoga jo use uski taye ki hui jagah tak le jaayenge jiske liye use banaaya gaya hai.'

e: Narrated `Ali:While the Prophet (ﷺ) was in a funeral procession, he took a stick and started scraping the earth with it and said, "There is none of you but has his place assigned either in Hell or in Paradise." They (the people) said, "Shall we not depend upon that (and give up doing any deeds)?' He said, " Carry on doing (good deeds) for everybody will find it easy to do such deeds as will lead him to his destined place for which he has been created ." (And then the Prophet (ﷺ) recited the Verse):-- 'As for him who gives (in charity) and keeps his duty to Allah
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) bataate hain: Jabke Nabi (SAW) ek janaaze ke jaluus mein the, unhone ek lakdi li aur usse zameen khurachni shuru ki aur kaha, 'Tum mein se koi bhi aisa nahi hai jiski jagah Jahannam ya Jannat mein pehle se taye na ho.' Logon ne kaha, 'To kya hum isi par bharosa na karein (aur nek amaal karna chhod dein)?' Unhone kaha, 'Nahi, (achhe) amaal karte raho, kyunke har shaks ke liye wo amaal karna aasaan hoga jo use uski taye ki hui jagah tak le jaayenge jiske liye use banaaya gaya hai.' (Aur phir Nabi (SAW) ne ye Aayat padhi:) 'Jo koi (sadqe mein) deta hai aur Allah ki farmaanbardaari karta hai...'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "Before Allah created the creations, He wrote a Book (wherein He has written): My Mercy has preceded my Anger." and that (Book) is written with Him over the Throne
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, 'Allah ne makhlooqaat banaane se pehle, usne ek Kitaab likhi (jismein usne likha): "Meri Rehmat Meri Naaraazgi se pehle hai."' Aur wo (Kitaab) uske paas Arsh (Takht) par likhi hui hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah (ra):I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying: "Before Allah created the creations, He wrote a Book (wherein He has written): "My Mercy has preceded my Anger.' And that is written with Him over the Throne." (see Hadith)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, 'Allah ne makhlooqaat banaane se pehle, usne ek Kitaab likhi (jismein usne likha): "Meri Rehmat Meri Naaraazgi se pehle hai."' Aur wo (Kitaab) uske paas Arsh (Takht) par likhi hui hai. (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees dekhein.)

e: Narrated Zahdam:There were good relations and brotherhood between this tribe of Jurm and the Ash`ariyyin. Once, while we were sitting with Abu Musa Al-Ash`ari, there was brought to him a meal which contained chicken meat, and there was sitting beside him, a man from the tribe of Bani Taimul-lah who looked like one of the Mawali. Abu Musa invited the man to eat but the man said, "I have seen chicken eating some dirty things, and I have taken an oath not to eat chicken." Abu Musa said to him, "Come along, let me tell you something in this regard. Once I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) with a few men from Ash`ariyyin and we asked him for mounts. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, By Allah, I will not mount you on anything; besides I do not have anything to mount you on.' Then a few camels from the war booty were brought to the Prophet, and he asked about us, saying, 'Where are the group of Ash`ariyyin?' So he ordered for five fat camels to be given to us and then we set out. We said, 'What have we done? Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took an oath that he would not give us anything to ride and that he had nothing for us to ride, yet he provided us with mounts. We made Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forget his oath! By Allah, we will never be successful.' So we returned to him and reminded him of his oath. He said, 'I have not provided you with the mount, but Allah has done so. By Allah, I may take an oath to do something, but on finding something else which is better, I do that which is better and make the expiation for my oath
hi: Zahdam bataate hain: Jurm qabeele aur Ash'ariyyin ke beech achhe rishte aur bhaichaara tha. Ek baar, jab hum Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ashari ke saath baithe the, unke paas ek khaana laaya gaya jismein murgi ka gosht tha, aur unke paas Banu Taimullah qabeele ka ek shaks baitha tha jo ek Maula (azaad kiye ghulaam) jaisa dikhta tha. Abu Musa ne us shaks ko khaane ki dawat di magar usne kaha, 'Maine murgi ko kuch gandi cheezein khaate dekha hai, aur maine murgi na khaane ki qasam khaayi hai.' Abu Musa ne usse kaha, 'Aao, main tumhein is baare mein kuch bataata hoon. Ek baar main Ashariyyin qabeele ke kuch logon ke saath Nabi (SAW) ke paas gaya aur humne unse sawaariyaan maangi. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, "Allah ki qasam, main tumhein kisi bhi cheez par sawaar nahi karunga; iske ilaawa mere paas tumhein sawaar karaane ke liye kuch bhi nahi hai." Phir jang ke maal-e-ganimat mein se kuch oont Nabi ke paas laaye gaye, aur unhone hamare baare mein pucha, kehte hue, "Ashariyyin ka giroh kahaan hai?" To unhone humein paanch mote-taaze oont dene ka hukm diya aur hum chal pade. Humne kaha, "Humne ye kya kiya? Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne qasam khaayi thi ke wo humein sawaar karaane ke liye kuch nahi denge aur unke paas humein sawaar karaane ke liye kuch nahi hai, phir bhi unhone humein sawaariyaan de di. Humne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko unki qasam bhula di! Allah ki qasam, hum kabhi kaamyaab nahi honge." To hum unke paas wapas gaye aur unhein unki qasam yaad dilaayi. Unhone kaha, "Maine tumhein sawaariyaan nahi di, balke Allah ne di hain. Allah ki qasam, main kisi baat ki qasam khaa sakta hoon, magar agar mujhe kuch aur behtar mile, to main wo behtar cheez karta hoon aur apni qasam ka kaffara ada karta hoon."'

e: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The delegates of `Abdul Qais came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "The pagans of the tribe of Mudar intervene between you and us therefore we cannot come to you except in the Holy months. So please order us to do something good (Religious deeds) by which we may enter Paradise (by acting on them) and we may inform our people whom we have left behind to observe it." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I order you to do four things and forbid you from four things: I order you to believe in Allah. Do you know what is meant by belief in Allah? It is to testify that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, to offer prayers perfectly, to give Zakat, and to give Al-Khumus (one-fifth of the war booty) (in Allah's Cause). And I forbid you four things, (i.e., Do not drink alcoholic drinks) Ad-Dubba, An- Naqir, (pitched water skins), Az-Zuruf, Al-Muzaffat and Al--Hantam (names of utensils used for the preparation of alcoholic drinks)." (See Hadith No. 50, Vol)
hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abd Al-Qais qabeele ke namaindé (delegates) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha, 'Mudar qabeele ke mushrik hamare aur aapke beech aate hain, isliye hum sirf muqaddas maheenon mein hi aap tak pahunch paate hain. Isliye barah-e-meharbaani humein kuch achhi (deeni) cheezein karne ka hukm dijiye (taake amal karke hum Jannat mein daakhil ho sakein) aur taake hum apne piche chhode logon ko bhi iske baare mein bataa sakein.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Main tumhein chaar cheezon ka hukm deta hoon aur chaar cheezon se mana karta hoon: Main tumhein Allah par Iman laane ka hukm deta hoon. Kya tumhein pata hai Allah par Iman laane ka matlab kya hai? Ye hai ke gawaahi do ke Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi, sahi tareeke se namaz padho, Zakat do, aur Al-Khumus (jang ke maal-e-ganimat ka paanchwaan hissa) do (Allah ki raah mein). Aur main tumhein chaar cheezon se mana karta hoon, (yaani nasha-aawar sharbat na piyo) Ad-Dubba, An-Naqir, (chamde ke thaile), Az-Zuruf, Al-Muzaffat, aur Al-Hantam (nasha-aawar sharbat taiyaar karne ke liye istemaal hone waale bartanon ke naam).' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 50, Jild dekhein.)

e: Narrated Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The painter of these pictures will be punished on the Day of Resurrection, and it will be said to them, Make alive what you have created
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'In tasveeron ka chitrakaar Qayamat ke din saza paayega, aur unse kaha jaayega, "Zinda karo jo tumne banaaya."'

e: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The painters of these pictures will be punished on the Day of Resurrection, and it will be said to them, 'Make alive what you have created
hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Un tasveeron ke chitrakaar Qayamat ke din saza paayenge, aur unse kaha jaayega, "Zinda karo jo tumne banaaya."'

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Allah said, 'Who are most unjust than those who try to create something like My creation? I challenge them to create even a smallest ant, a wheat grain or a barley grain
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, 'Allah ne farmaaya, "Kaun us shaks se zyaada zaalim ho sakta hai jo Meri takhleeq jaisi koi cheez banaane ki koshish kare? Main unhein challenge (chunauti) deta hoon ke wo ek sabse chhoti chionti, gehun ka daana, ya jau ka daana bhi banaayein."'

e: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'The example of a believer who recites the Qur'an is that of a citron (a citrus fruit) which is good in taste and good in smell. And the believer who does not recite the Qur'an is like a date which has a good taste but no smell. And the example of an impious person who recites the Qur'an is that of Ar-Rihana (an aromatic plant) which smells good but is bitter in taste. And the example of an impious person who does not recite the Qur'an is that of a colocynth which is bitter in taste and has no smell
hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ek aise Momin ki misaal jo Quran padhta hai, ek Utrujj (khatte phal) jaisi hai jiska zaayka bhi achha hai aur khushbu bhi achhi hai. Aur wo Momin jo Quran nahi padhta, wo khajoor jaisa hai jiska zaayka achha hai magar khushbu nahi hai. Aur ek badkaar shaks ki misaal jo Quran padhta hai, Ar-Rihana (ek khushbudaar paudha) jaisi hai jiski khushbu achhi hai magar zaayka kadwa hai. Aur ek badkaar shaks jo Quran nahi padhta, uski misaal Handh (ek kadwe swaad waala phal) jaisi hai jiska zaayka kadwa hai aur khushbu bhi nahi hai.'

e: Narrated `Aisha:Some people asked the Prophet (ﷺ) regarding the soothsayers. He said, "They are nothing." They said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Some of their talks come true." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "That word which happens to be true is what a Jinn snatches away by stealth (from the Heaven) and pours it in the ears of his friend (the foreteller) with a sound like the cackling of a hen. The soothsayers then mix with that word, one hundred lies
hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Kuch logon ne Nabi (SAW) se ganitagaar (jyotishiyon/soothsayers) ke baare mein pucha. Unhone kaha, 'Wo kuch nahi hain.' Unhone kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Unki kuch baaten sach nikalti hain.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Wo baat jo sach nikalti hai wo Jinn dwara chupke se (Aasman se) chhini gayi hoti hai aur wo apne dost (jyotishi) ke kaan mein aisi aawaaz ke saath daalta hai jaisi murgi ki kudkudaahat. Phir jyotishi us baat mein sau jhoot mila dete hain.'

e: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There will emerge from the East some people who will recite the Qur'an but it will not exceed their throats and who will go out of (renounce) the religion (Islam) as an arrow passes through the game, and they will never come back to it unless the arrow, comes back to the middle of the bow (by itself) (i.e., impossible). The people asked, "What will their signs be?" He said, "Their sign will be the habit of shaving (of their beards and their heads). (Fath-ul-Bari, Page 322, Vol. 17th)
hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Poorab se kuch log zaahir honge jo Quran padhenge magar wo unke galay se aage nahi jaayega, aur wo deen (Islam) chhod denge (tyaag denge) jaise ek teer shikaar se guzar jaata hai, aur wo kabhi ismein wapas nahi aayenge jab tak teer khud (apne aap) kamaan ke beech tak wapas na aa jaaye (yaani asambhav).' Logon ne pucha, 'Unki nishaani kya hogi?' Unhone kaha, 'Unki nishaani (unki daadi aur sar) mundhwaane ki aadat hogi.' (Fath-ul-Bari, Page 322, Jild 17.)

e: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "(There are) two words which are dear to the Beneficent (Allah) and very light (easy) for the tongue (to say), but very heavy in weight in the balance. They are: ''Subhan Allah wa-bi hamdihi'' and ''Subhan Allah Al-`Azim." (see Hadith)
hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, '(Do jumle hain) jo Rehmaan (Allah) ko aziz hain aur zubaan ke liye bahut halke (aasaan) hain, magar (Amaal ke) taraazu mein bahut bhaari hain. Wo hain: "Subhan Allah wa-bi Hamdihi" aur "Subhan Allah Al-Azim."' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees dekhein.)

e:
In the Name of Allah, the Merciful, the Beneficent - All praise is due to Allah, Lord of the worlds, and the [praiseworthy] end is for those who fear Him; and may Allah send blessings upon Muhammad, seal of the Prophets, and upon all the Prophets and Messengers.

As for what follows:

Indeed you mentioned, may Allah have mercy on you, by the guidance of your Creator, that you were interested in an examination of what is known of all the transmitted reports on authority of the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings upon him, regarding traditions of the Dīn, its rulings, and everything from it regarding rewards, punishments, motivations, admonishments, and other descriptive topics through chains of narration which were related by and circulated between Ahl ul-Ilm.

Thus you wished, may Allah guide you aright, to be informed about all of [the transmitted reports] in the form of a calculated composition and you asked me to abridge [it] for you in writing without a great amount of repetition. You allege that [much repetition] would distract you from what you intended in terms of understanding and deriving rulings from [the reports].

And because of that which you have asked, may Allah be generous with you, when I am attributed to its successful management and whatever condition can be construed by it, if Allah wills, (it will lead to) a praiseworthy ending and obtainable benefit.

I thought at the time you asked me to undertake that [task]- if it was determined for me to do so, and preordained for me to complete it- that the first to benefit from that would be me specifically before anyone else and this is due to a great number of reasons which are too lengthy to describe except [to say] that in summary, having precision regarding a select few [narrations], and accuracy in them, is easier for a person than to undertake of a great number of them, and especially for one who is indistinguishable in it from the common people [in this matter] unless someone else informs him of the distinction.

If the matter is just as we described, then focusing on the few authentic narrations is worthier for them than seeking an abundance of weak narrations. Although indeed it is hoped for that some benefit is attained by seeking after a large number [of Ḥadīth] of this type, and gathering the repetitions for them, but only for the elite who are endowed with some awareness and knowledge in their means [of ascertaining authenticity] and defects.

Thus that, if Allah wills, will happen through whatever will be brought to bear of that [awareness, distinction, knowledge of the means, and defects] on the advantage in seeking large numbers of [the various categories of Ḥadīth]. And as for the common people who are different from the elite in terms of awareness and knowledge, then it is senseless for them to seek large numbers [of various categories of Ḥadīth], while they are unaware of the few [Sahīh].

Then we, if Allah wills, will begin to extract and compose what you have asked upon conditions which we shall mention to you. We set ourselves upon the entirety of what is transmitted from the reports on authority of the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings upon him. Then we divided it up into three sections and three levels of people without repetition except:

1) When coming to a point where it was essential to repeat a narration in which there is an addition that clarifies the meaning of the first one; or


2) When there is a second chain that supports the first one in some hidden defect present since the additional significance in the second Ḥadīth assumes the position of a complete Ḥadīth.

Repeating narrations which have the kind of ‘addition’ we described is inevitable [since it eliminates the perceived hidden defect of the first narration]; or that significance [of the addition] is separated from the entire narration by abbreviating it when it is possible [to understand the significance from a small part of the narration], however separating the relevant part of the narration from the rest might make it difficult to understand the link between them, so repeating it in its original form when that proves difficult is safest.

Thus when we find that it is avoidable to repeat the narrations in their entirety we take care not to do so, if Allah wills.

As for the first category, we aspired to advance the report which is safer from defects than any others, and is purified due to being related by people of integrity in Ḥadīth, and certitude for what they relate; there are no strong disputes found [compared to the reports of other Thiqāt] regarding their transmissions, and no excessive inconsistencies [in their own reports] - just as is the case regarding a great number of Muhaddithīn and which appears in their narrations.

Thus when we examined reports of this description from the people, we also came across reports in whose chains there fell some of those who are not described with memorization and precision, like those of the previous description before them. Although they fell below what we described [from the first group], they still have the designation of protection [from ill-repute] and truthfulness; and they acquired knowledge, included among them are the likes of Atā’ bin is-Sā’ib, and Yazīd bin Abī Ziyād, and Layth bin Abī Sulaym, from among the carriers of Āthār and the relaters of Akhbār.

So even though they possessed what we described of knowledge, protection and being known as scholars among Ahl ul-Ilm, their contemporaries who we mentioned as precise and sound in transmission were above them in status and rank because this [the first category] is a high rank and sublime characteristic according to Ahl ul-Ilm.

Do you not see that when you weigh these three people we mentioned- Atā’, Yazīd, and Layth- with Mansūr bin il-Mu’tamir, Sulaymān al-A’mash and Ismā’īl bin Abī Khālid in regards to precision in Ḥadīth and soundness in it, you will find them distinct from others and not near them [in rank?]- there is no doubt regarding that among the people knowledgeable in Ḥadīth since the soundness of the memorization of Mansūr, al-A’mash, and Ismā’īl, and their precision in Ḥadīth was well-known among [the people knowledgeable in Ḥadīth] and they were not aware of examples of that from Atā’, Yazīd, and Layth.

Upon the same course as the above, when you weigh between the two levels like Ibn Awn and Ayyūb as-Sakhtiyānī with Awf ibn Abī Jamīlah and Ash’ath al-Humrānī- and all 4 are companions of al-Hasan and Ibn Sīrīn- there is disparity between the two groups.
