Between these two groups is a distance in terms of perfection of virtue and soundness of reporting even though Awf and Ash’ath are not repelled from [the status] of truthfulness and honesty according to Ahl ul-Ilm, rather the situation is as we described regarding their position.

We only mentioned these examples by way of naming them specifically so that their examples might be an indication for whoever is ignorant of the path to return to understanding of Ahl ul-Ilm regarding the ranking of its people. Thus there is no shortchanging the men of elevated rank any amount of what is due his level, and there is no elevation of those who are lower any amount of knowledge above his position- and each who possesses the right is given his right and is settled in his rank.

It has been mentioned on authority of Ā’ishah, may Allah be pleased with her, that she said: ‘The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah upon him, ordered us to afford people their (rightful) positions according to what the Qur’ān states: {And above all who possess knowledge is another who is knowledgeable}[Yūsuf: 76] . Thus based on the example of what we mentioned [regarding the narrators of Hifẓ and Itqān, and narrations which lack excessive inconsistency or strong contradiction], we compiled what you asked for of [those kind] of reports on authority of the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah upon him.

As for anything of that wherein the people were charged [with some criticism] by the people of Ḥadīth, or by the majority of [the people of Ḥadīth], then we did not preoccupy ourselves with bringing forward their narrations, such as Abd Allah ibn Miswar Abī Ja’far il-Madā’inī, Amr bin Khālid, Abd il-Quddūs ash-Shāmī, Muhammad ibn Sa’īd il-Maslūb, Ghiyāth ibn Ibrāhīm, Sulaymān bin Amr Abī Dāwud an-Nakha’ī, and those like them whereof they were accused of fabricating narrations and manufacturing reports; and like that are those whose narrations are dominated with Munkar, or mistakes- we withheld from their narrations as well.

An indication of Munkar in the narration of a Muhaddith is when his transmission differs with the transmission of a Muhaddith from the people of memorization and acceptance, or does not agree with it when the two are compared. When the majority of a person’s narrations are like that, he is abandoned [Mahjūr] in Ḥadīth, and not accepted in it, and his narrations are not acted upon. The following are those Muhaddithīn who are among this group: Abd Allah ibn Muharrar, Yahyā bin Abī Unaysah, Al-Jarrāh bin ul-Minhāl Abūl-Atūf, Abbād bin Kathīr, Husayn bin Abd Illah ibn Ḍumayrah, Umar bin Suhbān, and those of the same type in terms of transmission of Munkar Ḥadīth. We did not pause upon their narrations or preoccupy ourselves with them due to the ruling of Ahl ul-Ilm.

That which we are aware of from their school of thought in accepting what is singularly reported by a Muhaddith from the narrations is that (the Muhaddith) took part along with the trustworthy narrators from Ahl ul-Ilm wal-Hifẓ in transmitting some of what they transmitted, and [the Muhaddith] is predominantly in agreement with them; when one is found like that, then if he adds to [the transmission] anything not found with his companions, then his addition is accepted.

As for those who you see resorting to the likes of az-Zuhrī due to his greatness, and due to the great number of his companions being among the precise Huffāẓ, [resorting to] his Ḥadīth and the Ḥadīth of those like him, or to the likes of Hishām ibn Urwah, then their Ḥadīth are extensively shared among Ahl ul-Ilm. The greater majority of their companions related their Ḥadīth in agreement with one another [with few having contradictions]. Thus to transmit from [Urwah and az-Zuhrī], or one of them, from among the multitude of Ḥadīth, what is not known among any of their companions, and [the Rāwī] is not of those who share in the Sahīh narrations [found] among them, then it is not allowed to accept the narrations of this category of people, and Allah knows best.

We have explained from the school of Ḥadīth and its people some of what those who wish to traverse the path of [the Muhaddithīn] should aim for, and be guided towards. We will, if Allah wills, add to the explanation and clarification in another place in this book upon the mention of defective reports [Mu’allalah] when we come to it, in the places where explanation and clarification are appropriate, if Allah wills.

And what follows:

May Allah have mercy on you, if not for that which we saw of an evil act, largely from those who claim to be Muhaddithīn, in what they were supposed to adhere to when putting forward weak narrations and abominable transmissions and their neglect for the investigation of famous Sahīh narrations related by the trustworthy narrators, well-known for their truthfulness and honesty, after knowledge of them and affirmation with their tongues, that a great many of [weak and abominable narrations] which were cast towards heedless people are denounced and spoken of as not acceptable whereof the A’immah of the people of Ḥadīth criticized their transmissions- A’immah like Mālik ibn Anas, Shu’bat bin al-Hajjāj, Sufyān bin Uyaynah, Yahyā bin Sa’īd al-Qattān, Abd ir-Rahman ibn Mahdī, and other A’immah- then the establishment of what you asked for of distinction [between the types of Ḥadīth] and collection [of those which were Sahīh] would be easy for us. However on account of what we informed you of regarding the people’s circulation of abominable reports with weak, unknown chains, and their casting them towards the common people who are not aware of their defects, responding to what you asked became lighter upon our hearts.
hi:
Allah ke naam se, jo Rehmaan aur Raheem hai - Har tarah ki tareef Allah ke liye hai, jo saari duniyaon ka Rab hai, aur (sabse) achha anjaam un logon ke liye hai jo Usse darte hain; aur Allah, Muhammad (SAW) par - jo Nabiyon ki mohar hain - aur sab Nabiyon aur Rasoolon par apni rehmatein nazil kare.

Aage ki baat ye hai:

Beshak aapne zikr kiya, Allah aap par rehem kare, apne Paida karne wale ki hidaayat se, ki aapko un tamaam riwaayaton ka jaayza lene mein dilchaspi hai jo Rasoolullah (SAW) ki sanad se, deen ki riwaayaton, uske ahkaam, aur usse mutaalliq har cheez - sawaab, saza, tahreek, naseehat, aur baaki tafseeli mauzuaat ke baare mein - un sanadon ke zariye maloom hain jo Ahl-ul-Ilm mein riwayat aur maroof rahi hain.

Is liye aapne chaaha, Allah aapko sahi raah dikhaye, ki aapko ek soch-samajhkar tarteeb di gayi kitaab ki soorat mein (in tamaam riwaayaton ke baare mein) bataaya jaaye, aur aapne mujhse guzaarish ki ki main aapke liye ise likhkar mukhtasar kar dun, bagair zyada takraar ke. Aapka kehna hai ki (bahut zyada takraar) aapko us maqsad se hata degi jo aap samajhne aur (riwaayaton se) ahkaam nikaalne mein rakhte hain.

Aur jo aapne poocha uski wajah se, Allah aap par sakhi ho, jab main iski kaamyaab tarteeb aur is se jo bhi haalat mutaassir ho sakti hai uski zimmedaari lunga, Allah chaahe to (iska anjaam) qaabil-e-tareef aur faayda-mand hoga.

Jab aapne mujhse ye kaam sonpne ko kaha, to mujhe khayaal aaya - agar ye mere liye muqarrar ho gaya aur mera use poora karna pehle se likha gaya - ki iska sabse pehla faayda mujhe khud hoga, kisi aur se pehle, aur iski bahut saari wajuhaat hain jo bayan karna lamba ho jaayega, sivaay iske ki (mukhtasar mein) chand riwaayaton ke baare mein sateek hona aur unmein durustagi rakhna, kisi shaks ke liye zyada tadaad ki riwaayaton ko sambhaalne se aasaan hai, khaaskar us shaks ke liye jo ismein aam logon se koi farq nahi rakhta jab tak koi doosra use ye farq na bataaye.

Agar maamla waisa hi hai jaisa humne bayan kiya, to chand sahih riwaayaton par tawajjo dena unke liye kamzor riwaayaton ki bahutaayat dhoondhne se zyada qeemti hai. Halaanki ummeed hai ki is qism ki bahut saari (Hadees) dhoondhne aur unki takraar jama karne se kuch faayda haasil hoga, lekin sirf un khaas logon ke liye jinke paas thodi bahut samajh aur ilm ho unke zaraaye (sacchayi ko parkhne ke) aur khaamiyon ke baare mein.

Is liye ye, Allah chaahe to, tab hoga jab (ye samajh, farq karna, zaraaye ka ilm, aur khaamiyon ka ilm) us faayde par laagu kiya jaaye jo tarah-tarah ki Hadeeson ki bahutaayat dhoondhne mein hai. Aur jahan tak aam logon ka taalluq hai jo (is) samajh aur ilm mein khaas logon se farq rakhte hain, to unke liye ye bemaani hai ki wo tarah-tarah ki Hadeeson ki bahutaayat dhoondhein, jabki wo chand (Sahih) se bhi anjaan hain.

Phir hum, Allah chaahe to, aapki farmaayish nikaalna aur likhna shuru karenge un shartion ke saath jo hum aapko bataayenge. Humne apne aap ko un tamaam riwaayaton par muqarrar kiya jo Rasoolullah (SAW) ki sanad se pahunchi hain. Phir humne unhein teen hisson aur logon ke teen darjon mein taqseem kiya, bagair takraar ke, sivaay:

1) Jab ek aisi jagah aaye jahan kisi riwayat ko dohraana zaroori tha kyunki usmein ek izafa tha jo pehli ke matlab ko waazeh karta ho; ya

2) Jab ek doosri sanad ho jo pehli ki kisi chhupi hui khaami mein uski tasdeeq karti ho, kyunki doosri Hadees mein izaafi ahmiyat ek poori Hadees ki hasiyat rakhti ho.

Aisi riwaayaton ko dohraana jinmein humne bayan ki gayi qism ka 'izafa' ho, laazmi hai (kyunki ye pehli riwayat ki mehsoos hui chhupi hui khaami ko khatam karta hai); ya wo ahmiyat (izafe ki) poori riwayat se alag karke mukhtasar kar di jaaye jab mumkin ho (uske ek chhote hisse se ahmiyat samajhna), lekin riwayat ke us mutaalliq hisse ko baaki se alag karna unke aapasi taalluq ko samajhna mushkil bana sakta hai, is liye jab aisa mushkil ho, to use uski asal shakl mein dohraana zyada mehfooz hai.

Is liye jab hum paate hain ki riwaayaton ko unki poori shakl mein dohraane se bacha ja sakta hai, to hum aisa na karne ki koshish karte hain, Allah chaahe to.

Pehli qism ke baare mein, humne ye koshish ki ki hum wo riwayat pehle laayein jo khaamiyon se sabse zyada mahfooz ho, aur jo Hadees mein diyaanatdaar logon ki riwayat hone ki wajah se pak ho, aur jinki bayaan ki gayi baaton ke liye yaqeen ho; jinki riwaayaton mein koi sakht ikhtelaaf na paaya jaaye (doosre Thiqaat ki riwaayaton ke muqaable mein), aur jinmein koi zyada be-mel na ho (khud unki apni riwaayaton mein) - jaisa ki bahut saare Muhaddithon ke maamle mein hota hai aur jo unki riwaayaton mein zaahir hota hai.

Is liye jab humne is qism ki riwaayaton ka jaayza logon mein liya, to humein aisi riwaayaten bhi mili jinki sanad mein kuch aise log the jo yaadaasht aur sateekta ke liye us tarah maroof nahi the jis tarah pehle bayan ki gayi qism ke log. Halaanki wo humari bayan ki gayi (pehli qism ki) sift se neeche the, phir bhi unhein hifazat (bad-naami se) aur sachchaayi ka darja haasil tha; aur unhone ilm haasil kiya, unmein Ata bin as-Saib, Yazid bin Abi Ziyad, aur Laith bin Abi Sulaim jaise log shaamil hain, Aasaar aur Akhbar ke naqilon mein se.

Is liye halaanki unke paas jo humne bayan kiya wo ilm, hifazat, aur Ahl-ul-Ilm mein aalim maane jaane ka maqaam tha, unke hamasar jinka humne pehle zikr kiya sateek aur sahih riwayat mein unse zyada oonche darje aur maqaam ke the, kyunki ye (pehli qism) Ahl-ul-Ilm ke nazdeek ek uncha darja aur baland sift hai.

Kya aap nahi dekhte ki jab aap in teen logon ka - Ata, Yazid, aur Laith - Mansoor bin al-Mu'tamir, Sulaiman al-A'mash, aur Ismail bin Abi Khalid se Hadees mein sateekta aur uski sehat ke lihaaz se muqaabla karte hain, to aap paayenge ki wo (Mansoor, A'mash, Ismail) doosron se alag hain aur unke (Ata, Yazid, Laith ke) qareeb nahi hain? - is baare mein Hadees ke jaankaar logon mein koi shaq nahi hai, kyunki Mansoor, A'mash, aur Ismail ki yaadaasht ki sehat, aur unki Hadees mein sateekta unke (jaankaaron ke) darmiyaan maroof thi, aur unhein Ata, Yazid, aur Laith se aisi misaalon ka ilm nahi tha.

Isi tarah, jab aap Ibn Aun aur Ayyub as-Sakhtiyani jaise do darjon ko Auf bin Abi Jamila aur Ash'ath al-Humrani se muqaabla karte hain - aur ye chaaron Hasan aur Ibn Sirin ke saathi hain - to in do giroh ke darmiyaan farq hai. In do giroh ke darmiyaan kamaal aur sehat ki riwayat mein ek doori hai, halaanki Auf aur Ash'ath ko Ahl-ul-Ilm ke nazdeek sachchaayi aur diyaanat ke (darje) se hataaya nahi jaata, balki maamla waisa hi hai jaisa humne unke maqaam ke baare mein bayan kiya.

Humne ye misaalein sirf inhein khaas taur par naam lekar bayan karne ke tareeq se zikr ki hain, taaki inki misaalein us shaks ke liye ek ishaara ban sakein jo Ahl-ul-Ilm ki samajh se anjaan hai iski logon ki darjabandi ke baare mein wapas laane ke liye. Is liye kisi oonche darje ke shaks ko uski hasiyat se kam nahi diya jaata, aur na hi kisi neeche waale ko uski hasiyat se zyada koi ilm ka darja diya jaata - aur jise jo haq hai wo use diya jaata hai aur uske darje mein rakha jaata hai.

Aisha (Allah unse raazi ho) se riwayat hai ki unhone kaha: 'Rasoolullah (SAW) ne humein hukum diya ki hum logon ko unke (haqdaar) maqaam dein, jaisa ki Quran mein bayan hua hai: {Aur ilm rakhne waalon ke oopar ek aur ilm waala hai} [Yusuf: 76]. Is liye humne, jo humne bayan kiya uski misaal par (yaani Hifz aur Itqaan waale raawiyon ki, aur un riwaayaton ki jinmein zyada be-mel ya sakht ikhtelaaf na ho), Rasoolullah (SAW) ki sanad se aapki farmaayish ke mutaabiq riwaayaten jama ki hain.

Jahan tak un logon ka taalluq hai jinpar Hadees ke jaankaaron ne, ya unmein se aksar ne, koi ilzaam lagaya, to humne unki riwaayaten laane mein apne aap ko masroof nahi kiya, jaise Abdullah bin Miswar Abu Ja'far al-Madaini, Amr bin Khalid, Abdul-Quddus ash-Shami, Muhammad bin Sa'id al-Maslub, Ghiyath bin Ibrahim, Sulaiman bin Amr Abu Dawud an-Nakha'i, aur unke jaise log jinpar riwaayaten gadhne aur khud se banaane ka ilzaam tha; aur isi tarah wo log jinki riwaayaton mein Munkar ya ghaltiyon ka ghalba ho - humne unki riwaayaton se bhi parhez kiya.

Kisi Muhaddith ki riwayat mein Munkar hone ki nishaani ye hai ki uski riwayat, yaadaasht aur qubooliyat waale logon mein se kisi Muhaddith ki riwayat se farq rakhti ho, ya jab dono ka muqaabla kiya jaaye to uske saath match na ho. Jab kisi shaks ki aksar riwaayaten aisi hon, to use Hadees mein chhod diya jaata hai (Mahjoor), aur usmein qubool nahi kiya jaata, aur uski riwaayaton par amal nahi kiya jaata. In Muhaddithon mein se jo is giroh mein shaamil hain: Abdullah bin Muharrar, Yahya bin Abi Unaisah, al-Jarrah bin al-Minhal Abul-Atuf, Abbad bin Kathir, Husain bin Abdullah bin Dumaira, Umar bin Suhban, aur unke jaise log jo Munkar Hadees ki riwayat mein isi tarah ke hain. Humne unki riwaayaton par tawajjo nahi di ya unmein apne aap ko masroof nahi kiya, Ahl-ul-Ilm ke faisle ki wajah se.

Jo humein unke maslak ke baare mein pata hai ki wo kisi Muhaddith ki akeli riwayat ki gayi baat ko qubool karte hain, wo ye hai ki (wo Muhaddith) bharosemand raawiyon, Ahl-ul-Ilm wal-Hifz, ke saath unki kuch riwaayaton mein shareek raha ho, aur (wo Muhaddith) unse aksar mutabiq raha ho; jab koi aisa paaya jaaye, to agar wo (riwayat mein) kuch aisa izafa kare jo uske saathiyon mein nahi paaya jaata, to uska izafa qubool kiya jaata hai.

Jahan tak un logon ka taalluq hai jo Zuhri jaise logon ki taraf, unki azmat ki wajah se, aur unke saathiyon ki bahutaayat Huffaz-e-sateek mein hone ki wajah se, rujoo karte hain - unki Hadees aur unke jaise logon ki Hadees ki taraf, ya Hisham bin Urwah jaise logon ki taraf, to unki Hadees Ahl-ul-Ilm mein bahut zyada faili hui hain. Unke aksar saathiyon ne unki Hadees ek doosre se mutaabiq riwayat ki (bahut kam ikhtelaaf ke saath). Is liye (Urwah aur Zuhri) se, ya unmein se kisi ek se, unki bahut saari Hadeeson mein se aisi kisi baat ki riwayat karna jo unke kisi bhi saathi mein maloom na ho, aur (raawi) un logon mein se na ho jo unke saath Sahih riwaayaton mein shareek hain, to is qism ke logon ki riwaayaten qubool karna jaayez nahi hai, aur Allah behtar jaanta hai.

Humne Hadees ke maslak aur uske logon ke baare mein kuch wo baatein waazeh ki hain jinka maqsad un logon ke liye hai jo (Muhaddithon ki) raah par chalna chaahte hain, taaki unhein rehnumaai mile. Hum, Allah chaahe to, is kitaab mein kisi aur jagah, khaamiyon waali riwaayaton (Mu'allalah) ka zikr aane par, waazeh aur tafseel mein aur izafa karenge, jahan waazeh karna munasib ho, Allah chaahe to.

Aur aage ki baat ye hai:

Allah aap par rehem kare, agar humne wo buri harkat na dekhi hoti - zyaadatar un logon se jo Muhaddith hone ka dawa karte hain - jo unhein kamzor riwaayaton aur ghinaoni riwaayaton ko aage laane mein karna chahiye tha uski paabandi na karna, aur mash'hoor Sahih riwaayaton ki chaan-been mein kotaahi karna jo bharosemand raawiyon se riwayat ki gayin, jo apni sachchaayi aur diyaanat ke liye maroof hain, in cheezon ki jaankaari aur apni zubaan se tasdeeq karne ke baad; ki (kamzor aur ghinaoni riwaayaton mein se) bahut saari jo be-khabar logon ki taraf phenki gayin unhein bura kaha jaata aur naaqaabil-e-qubool kaha jaata jinke baare mein Hadees ke A'immah ne unki riwaayaton par tanqeed ki - A'immah jaise Malik bin Anas, Shu'batu bin al-Hajjaj, Sufyan bin Uyaynah, Yahya bin Sa'id al-Qattan, Abdur Rahman bin Mahdi, aur doosre A'immah - to jo aapne poocha tha, farq karna (Hadees ki qismon mein) aur jama karna (jo Sahih thi), hamare liye aasaan hota. Lekin jo humne aapko bataaya un logon ke ghinaoni riwaayaton ko kamzor, anjaan sanadon ke saath phailaane ke baare mein, aur unhein aam logon ki taraf phenkna jinhein unki khaamiyon ka ilm nahi, jo aapne poocha uska jawaab dena hamare dilon par halka ho gaya.

e:
Know - may Allah, exalted is He, grant you success – that what is obligatory upon everyone who is aware of the distinction between the Sahīh transmissions and their weak, the trustworthy narrators from those who stand accused, is to not transmit from them except what is known for the soundness of its emergence and the protection of its narrators; and that they fear what may be from those accused (of deficiency in narrating) and the stubborn people of innovation.

The proof that what we have said is required above what opposes it is in the verse: {Oh you who believe! If a sinful person comes to you with news, then verify it lest you afflict people through ignorance then you become sorry about what you did}[al-Hujurāt: 6]; and the verse: {… from whom you are pleased with from the witnesses}[al-Baqarah: 282] and the verse: {And let two who possess integrity among you bare witness}[at-Talāq: 2]. Thus it demonstrates what we mentioned from these two verses that the report of the sinful is dropped and not accepted, and that the testimony [Shahādah] of one who does not possess integrity is rejected, and the report [Khabar] as well- even though its significance is separated from the meaning of testimony in some respects, they are in agreement regarding the overall conditions they share since the report of the sinful is not acceptable according to Ahl ul-Ilm just as his testimony is rejected according to all of them . The Sunnah demonstrates the prohibition of transmitting abominable transmissions just as in the example from the Qur’ān regarding the prohibition of the report of the sinful.

There is a famous narration on authority of the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah upon him, that: ‘Whoever relates on my authority a narration while aware that it is a lie, then he is one of the liars’ . Abū Bakr ibn Abī Shaybah narrated it to us that Wakī narrated to us, on authority of Shu’bah, on authority of al-Hakam, on authority of Abd ir-Rahman ibn Abī Laylā, on authority of Samurah bin Jundab. And also Abū Bakr ibn Abī Shaybah narrated to us, that Wakī narrated to us, on authority of Shu’bah and Sufyān, on authority of Habīb, on authority of Maymūn ibn Abī Shabīb, on authority of al-Mughīrat ibn Shu’bah, they both said that the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah upon him, said the same thing.
hi:
Jaan lo - Allah, jo buland hai, aapko kaamyaabi de - ki har us shaks par jo Sahih riwaayaton aur unki kamzor riwaayaton ke darmiyaan farq ko samajhta hai, farz hai ki bharosemand raawiyon se, un logon se jinpar ilzaam hai, sirf wo cheez riwayat kare jiski sehat aur uske raawiyon ki hifazat maloom ho; aur ki wo un logon se dare jinpar (kami ka) ilzaam ho aur jo hath-dharmi wale bid'ati log hon.

Iska saboot ki jo humne kaha wo uske khilaaf se zyada zaroori hai, is aayat mein hai: {Aye imaan waalo! Agar koi gunahgaar shaks tumhare paas koi khabar leke aaye, to uski tehqeeq karo, kahin tum anjaane mein logon ko nuqsaan pahuncha do phir jo tumne kiya uspar pachtaao} [al-Hujurat: 6]; aur ye aayat: {...jinse tum gawahon mein khush ho} [al-Baqarah: 282] aur ye aayat: {Aur tum mein se do diyaanatdaar log gawahi dein} [at-Talaq: 2]. Is liye ye in dono aayaton se saabit hota hai jo humne zikr kiya ki gunahgaar ki khabar chhod di jaati hai aur qubool nahi ki jaati, aur jo diyaanatdaar nahi uski gawahi (Shahaadah) radd kar di jaati hai, aur khabar bhi - halaanki iski ahmiyat gawahi ke matlab se kuch pehluon mein alag hai, wo (dono) un aam shartion mein muttafiq hain jo wo saath rakhte hain, kyunki gunahgaar ki khabar Ahl-ul-Ilm ke nazdeek qubool nahi ki jaati jaisi uski gawahi sab ke nazdeek radd hoti hai. Sunnah ghinaoni riwaayaton ki riwayat ki mumaana'at ko saabit karti hai jaise Quran mein gunahgaar ki khabar ki mumaana'at ki misaal.

Rasoolullah (SAW) se ek maroof riwayat hai ki: 'Jisne mujhpar koi riwayat is haal mein bayan ki ki use pata tha wo jhoot hai, to wo jhooton mein se ek hai.' Abu Bakr bin Abi Shaibah ne humein ye bataayi ki Waki ne humein bataaya, Shu'bah ki sanad se, al-Hakam ki sanad se, Abdur Rahman bin Abi Laila ki sanad se, Samurah bin Jundab ki sanad se. Aur Abu Bakr bin Abi Shaibah ne bhi humein bataaya, ki Waki ne humein bataaya, Shu'bah aur Sufyan ki sanad se, Habib ki sanad se, Maimun bin Abi Shabib ki sanad se, al-Mughirat bin Shu'bah ki sanad se, un dono ne kaha ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne yahi baat farmaayi.

e: Abū Bakr ibn Abī Shaybah narrated to us that Ghundar narrated to us, on authority of Shu’bah; and Muhammad bin ul-Muthannā and Ibn Bashār both narrated to us, they said: Muhammad bin Ja’far narrated to us, Shu’bah narrated to us, on authority of Mansūr, on authority of Rab’iy ibn Hirāsh, that he heard Alī, may Allah be pleased with him, giving a Khutbah and he said that the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah upon him, said: ‘Do not lie upon me; indeed whoever lies upon me will enter the Fire’.
hi: Abu Bakr bin Abi Shaybah ne humein bataaya ki Ghundar ne humein Shu'bah ki sanad se bataaya; aur Muhammad bin al-Muthanna aur Ibn Bashaar dono ne humein bataaya, unhone kaha: Muhammad bin Ja'far ne humein bataaya, Shu'bah ne humein Mansoor ki sanad se, Rabi' bin Hiraash ki sanad se bataaya, ki unhone Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko khutba dete hue suna aur unhone kaha ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Mujh par jhoot mat bolo; jo bhi mujh par jhoot bolega wo Jahannam mein daakhil hoga.

e: Zuhayr bin Harb narrated to me, Ismā’īl, rather, Ibn Ulayyah narrated to us, on authority of Abd il-Azīz ibn Suhayb, on authority of Anas bin Mālik, that he said: ‘Indeed what prevents me from relating to you a great number of Ḥadīth is that the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah upon him, said: ‘Whoever intends to lie upon me, then let him take his seat in the Fire.’
hi: Zuhayr bin Harb ne mujhe bataaya, Ismail, balki Ibn Ulayyah ne humein Abdul Aziz bin Suhayb ki sanad se, Anas bin Malik ki sanad se bataaya, ki unhone kaha: Beshak jo cheez mujhe tumhein bahut saari Ahadith bayan karne se rokti hai wo ye hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jo mujh par jhoot bolne ka iraada rakhe, wo apni jagah Jahannam mein banaale.

e: Muhammad bin Ubayd il-Ghubarī narrated to us, Abū Awānah narrated to us, on authority of Abī Hasīn, on authority of Abī Sālih, on authority of Abū Hurayrah, he said, the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah upon him, said: ‘Whoever lies upon me intentionally, then let him take his seat in the Fire’.
hi: Muhammad bin Ubaid al-Ghubari ne humein bataaya, Abu Awana ne humein Abu Hasin ki sanad se, Abu Salih ki sanad se, Abu Huraira ki sanad se bataaya, unhone kaha, Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jo bhi jaan-boojh kar mujh par jhoot bole, wo apni jagah Jahannam mein banaale.

e: Muhammad bin Abd Allah ibn Numayr narrated to us, my father narrated to us, Sa’īd bin Ubayd narrated to us, Alī bin Rabī’ah narrated to us, he said: ‘I arrived at the Masjid and al-Mughīrah, the Amīr of al-Kūfah said: ‘I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah upon him, saying, ‘Indeed a lie upon me is not like a lie upon anyone else, for whoever lies upon me intentionally, then he shall take his seat in the Fire’.’
hi: Muhammad bin Abdullah ibn Numair ne humein bataaya, mere waalid ne humein bataaya, Sa'id bin Ubaid ne humein bataaya, Ali bin Rabi'ah ne humein bataaya, unhone kaha: Main masjid mein pahuncha aur Kufa ke Ameer al-Mughira ne kaha: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Beshak mujh par jhoot bolna kisi aur par jhoot bolne jaisa nahi hai, jo bhi jaan-boojh kar mujh par jhoot bole, wo apni jagah Jahannam mein banaale.

e: ’ Alī bin Hujr as-Sa’dī narrated to us, Alī bin Mushir narrated to us, Muhammad bin Qays il-Asadī informed us, on authority of Alī ibn Rabī’at al-Asadī, on authority of al-Mughīrat ibn Shu’bah, on authority of the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah upon him a similar narration, however he did not mention the words ‘Indeed a lie upon me is not like a lie upon anyone else’.
hi: Ali bin Hujr as-Sa'di ne humein bataaya, Ali bin Mushir ne humein bataaya, Muhammad bin Qais al-Asadi ne humein Ali bin Rabi'at al-Asadi ki sanad se, al-Mughirat ibn Shu'bah ki sanad se, Nabi (SAW) ki sanad se ek jaisi hi riwayat bataayi, sivaay iske ki unhone ye alfaaz zikr nahi kiye ki 'Beshak mujh par jhoot bolna kisi aur par jhoot bolne jaisa nahi hai'.

e: Ubayd Allah bin Mu’ādh al-Anbarī narrated to us, my father narrated to us; and Muhammad bin ul-Muthannā narrated to us, Abd ur-Rahman bin Mahdī both narrated to us: Shu’bah narrated to us, on authority of Khubayb bin Abd ir-Rahman, on authority of Hafs bin Āsim, on authority of Abī Hurayrah, he said, the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah upon him, said: ‘It is enough of a lie for a man to narrate everything he hears’.
hi: Ubaidullah bin Mu'adh al-Anbari ne humein bataaya, mere waalid ne humein bataaya; aur Muhammad bin al-Muthanna ne humein bataaya, Abdur Rahman bin Mahdi dono ne humein Shu'bah ki sanad se, Khubaib bin Abdur Rahman ki sanad se, Hafs bin Aasim ki sanad se, Abu Huraira ki sanad se bataaya, unhone kaha, Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Kisi shaks ke jhooti hone ke liye itna hi kaafi hai ki wo jo kuch bhi sune wo (bina taasdeeq kiye) sab bayan kar de.

e: Abū Bakr bin Abī Shaybah narrated to us, Alī bin Hafs narrated to us, Shu’bah narrated to us, on authority of Khubayb bin Abd ir-Rahman, on authority of Hafs bin Āsim, on authority of Abī Hurayrah, on authority of the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah upon him, the same as that.
hi: Abu Bakr bin Abi Shaybah ne humein bataaya, Ali bin Hafs ne humein bataaya, Shu'bah ne humein Khubaib bin Abdur Rahman ki sanad se, Hafs bin Aasim ki sanad se, Abu Huraira ki sanad se bataaya, jo unhone Nabi (SAW) se aisi hi riwayat ki.

e: Yahyā bin Yahyā narrated to us, Hushaym informed us, on authority of Sulaymān at-Taymī, on authority of Abī Uthmān an-Nahdī, he said, Umar bin ul-Khattāb, may Allah be pleased with him, said: ‘It is enough of a lie for a man that he narrates everything he hears’.
hi: Yahya bin Yahya ne humein bataaya, Hushaim ne humein Sulaiman at-Taymi ki sanad se, Abu Uthman an-Nahdi ki sanad se khabar di, unhone kaha, Umar bin al-Khattab (RA) ne kaha: Kisi shaks ke jhooti hone ke liye itna hi kaafi hai ki wo jo kuch bhi sune wo sab bayan kar de.

e: Abūt-Tāhir Ahmad bin Amr bin Sarh narrated to me, he said, Ibn Wahb narrated to us, he said, Mālik said to me: ‘Know that a man who relates everything he hears is not safe, and he can never be an Imām, as long as he narrates everything he hears’.
hi: Abu Tahir Ahmad bin Amr bin Sarh ne mujhe bataaya, unhone kaha, Ibn Wahb ne humein bataaya, unhone kaha, Malik ne mujhse kaha: Jaan lo ki jo shaks jo kuch bhi sune wo sab bayan kar de, wo mahfooz (bharosemand) nahi ho sakta, aur wo kabhi Imam nahi ban sakta jab tak wo jo kuch sune usmein se kuch rok kar na rakhe.

e: Muhammad bin ul-Muthannā narrated to us, he said Abd ur-Rahman narrated to us, he said Sufyān narrated to us, on authority of Abī Ishāq, on authority of Abīl-Ahwas, on authority of Abd Illah, he said: ‘It is enough of a lie for a man that he narrates everything he hears’.
hi: Muhammad bin al-Muthanna ne humein bataaya, unhone kaha Abdur Rahman ne humein bataaya, unhone kaha Sufyan ne humein Abu Ishaq ki sanad se, Abul Ahwas ki sanad se, Abdullah ki sanad se bataaya, unhone kaha: Kisi shaks ke jhooti hone ke liye itna hi kaafi hai ki wo jo kuch bhi sune wo sab bayan kar de.

e: Muhammad bin ul-Muthannā narrated to us, he said I heard Abd ar-Rahman bin Mahdī saying: ‘A man cannot be an Imām whose example is followed until he withholds from some of what he hears’.
hi: Muhammad bin al-Muthanna ne humein bataaya, unhone kaha maine Abdur Rahman bin Mahdi ko ye kehte suna: Koi shaks aisa Imam nahi ban sakta jiski peirvi ki jaaye jab tak wo apni sunta hui kuch baaton ko rok kar na rakhe.

e: Yahyā bin Yahyā narrated to us, Umar bin Alī bin Muqaddam informed us, on authority of Sufyān bin Husayn, he said: ‘Iyās bin Mu’āwiyah asked me saying: ‘Indeed I see that you love knowledge of the Qur’ān, so recite for me a Sūrah and explain it until I can reflect on what you know’.  said to me: ‘Memorize from me what I am about to say to you- Beware of abominations in Ḥadīth for indeed rarely does anyone convey them except he lowers himself and his Ḥadīth are denied’.’
hi: Yahya bin Yahya ne humein bataaya, Umar bin Ali bin Muqaddam ne Sufyan bin Husain ki sanad se khabar di, unhone kaha: Iyas bin Muawiyah ne mujhse poocha aur kaha: Beshak main dekh raha hoon ki tumhein Quran ke ilm se mohabbat hai, is liye mere liye ek Surah padho aur uski tafseer karo taaki main ye jaan sakoon ki tum kya jaante ho. Unhone mujhse kaha: Mujhse jo main kehne wala hoon wo yaad rakho - Hadees mein ghatiya (buri) baaton se bacho, kyunki bahut kam log unhein bayan karte hain sivaay iske ki wo khud ko zaleel karein aur unki Hadees rad kar di jaaye.

e: Abūt-Tāhir and Harmalah bin Yahyā narrated to me, they said Ibn Wahb narrated to us, he said Yūnus informed me, on authority of Ibn Shihāb, on authority of Ubayd Allah bin Abd Allah bin Utbah, that Abd Allah bin Mas’ūd said: ‘It is the case that you do not relate to the people a narration which their minds cannot grasp except that it becomes a Fitnah for some of them’.
hi: Abu Tahir aur Harmalah bin Yahya ne mujhe bataaya, unhone kaha Ibn Wahb ne humein bataaya, unhone kaha Yunus ne mujhe Ibn Shihab ki sanad se khabar di, Ubaidullah bin Abdullah bin Utbah ki sanad se, ki Abdullah bin Mas'ood ne kaha: Aisa nahi hota ki tum logon ko koi aisi riwayat sunao jise unki aqal na samajh sake, sivaay iske ki wo unmein se kuch ke liye fitna ban jaaye.

e: Muhammad bin Abd Allah bin Numayr and Zuhayr bin Harb narrated to me, they said Abd Allah bin Yazīd narrated to us, he said Sa’īd bin Abī Ayyūb narrated to me, he said Abū Hāni’ narrated to me, on authority of Uthmān Muslim bin Yasār, on authority of Abī Hurayrah, on authority of the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah upon him, he said: ‘There will be in the last of my nation a people narrating to you what you nor your fathers heard, so beware of them’.
hi: Muhammad bin Abdullah bin Numair aur Zuhayr bin Harb ne mujhe bataaya, unhone kaha Abdullah bin Yazid ne humein bataaya, unhone kaha Sa'id bin Abi Ayyub ne mujhe bataaya, unhone kaha Abu Hani ne mujhe Uthman Muslim bin Yasar ki sanad se, Abu Huraira ki sanad se, Rasoolullah (SAW) ki sanad se bataaya, unhone farmaya: Mere ummat ke aakhri daur mein aise log honge jo tumhein aisi baatein bayan karenge jo na tumne suni hongi na tumhare baap-dada ne, is liye unse bacho.

e: Harmalah bin Yahyā bin Abd Allah bin Harmalah bin Imrān at-Tujībī narrated to me, he said Ibn Wahb narrated to us, he said Abū Shurayh narrated to me that he heard Sharāhīl bin Yazīd saying ‘Muslim bin Yasār informed me that he heard Abā Hurayrah saying, the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah upon him, said: ‘There will be in the end of time charlatan liars coming to you with narrations that you nor your fathers heard, so beware of them lest they misguide you and cause you tribulations’.’
hi: Harmalah bin Yahya bin Abdullah bin Harmalah bin Imran at-Tujibi ne mujhe bataaya, unhone kaha Ibn Wahb ne humein bataaya, unhone kaha Abu Shuraih ne mujhe bataaya ki unhone Sharaheel bin Yazid ko ye kehte suna ki Muslim bin Yasar ne mujhe khabar di ki unhone Abu Huraira ko ye kehte suna, Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Zamane ke aakhir mein dhokebaaz jhoote aayenge jo tumhare paas aisi riwayaton ke saath aayenge jo na tumne suni hongi na tumhare baap-dada ne, is liye unse bacho, kahin wo tumhein gumrah na kar dein aur tumhein museebat mein na daal dein.

e: Abū Sa’īd al-Ashajj narrated to me, Wakī’ narrated to us, al-A’mash narrated to us, on authority of al-Musayyab bin Rāfi’, on authority of Āmir bin Abdah, he said, Abd Allah  said: ‘Indeed Satan will appear in the form of a man and he will come to the people, narrating to them false Ḥadīth, and they will then depart. Then a man among them will say: ‘I heard a man whose face I recognize but I do not know his name narrating …’
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Ashajj ne mujhe bataaya, Waki' ne humein bataaya, A'mash ne humein Musayyab bin Rafi' ki sanad se, Aamir bin Abdah ki sanad se bataaya, unhone kaha, Abdullah ne kaha: Beshak Shaitan ek aadmi ki shakal mein zaahir hoga aur logon ke paas aayega, unhein jhooti Ahadees sunaayega, aur phir wo chala jaayega. Phir unmein se koi shaks kahega: Maine ek aadmi ko suna jiska chehra main pehchanta hoon lekin naam nahi jaanta, wo bayan kar raha tha...

e: Muhammad bin Rāfi’ narrated to me, Abd ur-Razzāq narrated to us, Ma’mar informed us, on authority of Ibn Tāwus, on authority of his father, on authority Abd Allah bin Amr bin al-Ās, he said: ‘Indeed in the sea are devils chained up, whom Sulaymān shackled and they are at the point of emerging. Then they will recite a Qur’ān upon the people.’
hi: Muhammad bin Rafi' ne mujhe bataaya, Abdur Razzaq ne humein bataaya, Ma'mar ne humein Ibn Tawus ki sanad se, unke waalid ki sanad se, Abdullah bin Amr bin al-Aas ki sanad se khabar di, unhone kaha: Beshak samundar mein Shayateen zanjeeron mein jakde huye hain, jinhein Sulaiman ne bandi banaya tha aur wo bahar nikalne hi wale hain. Phir wo logon ke saamne Quran padhenge.

e: Muhammad bin Abbād and Sa’īd bin Amr al-Ash’athī narrated to me on authority of Ibn Uyaynah; Sa’īd said Sufyān informed us on authority of Hishām bin Hujayr, on authority of Tāwus, he said (Bushayr bin Ka’b) came to Ibn Abbās so he set about narrating to him. Ibn Abbās said to him: ‘Go back to such-and-such narration‘. Then , we abandoned listening to Ḥadīth from them’.
hi: Muhammad bin Abbad aur Sa'id bin Amr al-Ash'athi ne mujhe Ibn Uyaynah ki sanad se bataaya; Sa'id ne kaha Sufyan ne humein Hisham bin Hujair ki sanad se, Tawus ki sanad se khabar di, unhone kaha (Bushair bin Ka'b) Ibn Abbas ke paas aaye aur unse riwayat bayan karna shuru kar diya. Ibn Abbas ne unse kaha: Falaan-falaan riwayat par wapas jao. Phir humne unse Hadees sunna chhod diya.

e: Muhammad bin Rāfi’ narrated to me, Abd ur-Razzāq narrated to us, Ma’mar informed us, on authority of Ibn Tāwus, on authority of his father, on authority of Ibn Abbās, he said: ‘Indeed we would take Ḥadīth and they would be taken on authority of the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah upon him. However if you take every difficult and docile !
hi: Muhammad bin Rafi' ne mujhe bataaya, Abdur Razzaq ne humein bataaya, Ma'mar ne humein Ibn Tawus ki sanad se, unke waalid ki sanad se, Ibn Abbas ki sanad se khabar di, unhone kaha: Beshak hum Hadees liya karte the aur wo Rasoolullah (SAW) ki sanad se li jaati thi. Lekin agar tum har mushkil aur aasaan (riwayat) le lo...!

e: Abū Ayyūb Sulaymān bin Ubayd Allah al-Ghaylānī narrated to us, Abū Āmir, meaning al-Aqadī, narrated to us, Rabāh narrated to us, on authority of Qays bin Sa’d, on authority of Mujāhid, he said Bushayr ul-Adawī came to Ibn Abbās then he set about narrating to him, saying: ‘The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah upon him, said…’, ‘the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah upon him, said…’. Then it seemed that Ibn Abbās was not listening to his Ḥadīth and not reflecting on them, so  said: ‘Oh Ibn Abbās, why is it that I see you not listening to my Ḥadīth? I narrate to you on authority of the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah upon him, however you are not listening’. Ibn Abbās said: ‘Indeed once upon a time we would listen to a man saying, ‘the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah upon him, said…’ rushing towards him with our eyes and harkening towards him with our ears; then when the people took the difficult and the docile we no longer took from people except those whom we knew’.
hi: Abu Ayyub Sulaiman bin Ubaidullah al-Ghailani ne humein bataaya, Abu Aamir, yaani al-Aqadi, ne humein bataaya, Rabaah ne humein Qais bin Sa'd ki sanad se, Mujahid ki sanad se bataaya, unhone kaha Bushair al-Adawi Ibn Abbas ke paas aaye aur unse riwayat bayan karna shuru kar diya, ye kehte hue: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya..., Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya... Phir aisa lagne laga ki Ibn Abbas unki Hadees nahi sun rahe aur na unpar ghaur kar rahe hain, is liye unhone (Bushair ne) kaha: Aye Ibn Abbas, kya baat hai ki main dekh raha hoon ki aap meri Hadees nahi sun rahe? Main aapko Rasoolullah (SAW) ki sanad se riwayat bata raha hoon, lekin aap sun hi nahi rahe. Ibn Abbas ne kaha: Beshak pehle zamaane mein hum ek aadmi ko ye kehte hue sunte the ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya..., to hum apni aankhon se uski taraf lapakte the aur apne kaanon se uski taraf tawajjo dete the; phir jab logon ne mushkil aur aasaan (dono tarah ki riwayaat) lena shuru kar diya, to humne sirf unhi logon se lena shuru kiya jinhein hum jaante the.

e: Dāwud bin Amr aḍ-Ḍabbī narrated to us, Nāfi’ bin Umar narrated to us, on authority of Ibn Abī Mulaykah, he said: ‘I wrote to Ibn Abbās asking him to write something  said: ‘By Allah, Alī did not give judgment according to this unless he was astray’.’
hi: Dawud bin Amr ad-Dabbi ne humein bataaya, Nafi' bin Umar ne humein Ibn Abi Mulaikah ki sanad se bataaya, unhone kaha: Maine Ibn Abbas ko likha aur unse kuch likhne ki darkhwaast ki, unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne is (baat) ke mutaabiq faisla nahi diya sivaay iske ki wo bhatak gaye hon.

e: Amr an-Nāqid narrated to us, Sufyān bin Uyaynah narrated to us, on authority of Hishām bin Hujayr, on authority of Tāwus, he said: ‘A book was brought to Ibn Abbās which contained the verdicts of Alī, may Allah be pleased with him, and he effaced but a small amount,’ and Sufyān bin Uyaynah indicated with his arm .
hi: Amr an-Naqid ne humein bataaya, Sufyan bin Uyaynah ne humein Hisham bin Hujair ki sanad se, Tawus ki sanad se bataaya, unhone kaha: Ibn Abbas ke paas ek kitab laayi gayi jismein Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke faisle darj the, aur unhone usmein se sirf thoda sa hissa mitaaya, aur Sufyan bin Uyaynah ne apni baazu se ishaara kiya.

e: Hasan bin Alī al-Hulwānī narrated to us, Yahyā bin Ādam narrated to us, Ibn Idrīs narrated to us, on authority of al-A’mash, on authority of Abī Ishāq who said: ‘When they narrated these things after Alī, may Allah be pleased with him, a man from the companions of Alī said: ‘May Allah curse them. Did they corrupt every  knowledge!?’
hi: Hasan bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) al-Hulwani ne humein bataaya, Yahya bin Aadam ne humein bataaya, Ibn Idris ne humein A'mash ki sanad se, Abu Ishaq ki sanad se bataaya, unhone kaha: Jab Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke baad ye baatein bayan ki gayin, to Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke ek saathi ne kaha: Allah unpar laanat kare. Kya unhone poori ilm ko hi bigaad diya?

e: Alī bin Khashram narrated to us, Abū Bakr, meaning Ibn Ayyāsh, informed us, he said ‘I heard al-Mughīrah saying: ‘There are no Ḥadīth on authority of Alī, may Allah be pleased with him, that are confirmed except from the companions of Abd Allah bin Mas’ūd.’
hi: Ali bin Khashram ne humein bataaya, Abu Bakr, yaani Ibn Ayyash, ne humein khabar di, unhone kaha maine Mughira ko ye kehte suna: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki sanad se koi bhi Hadees pukhta saabit nahi hai sivaay Abdullah bin Mas'ood ke saathiyon (ki riwayat) ke.

e: Hasan bin ur-Rabī’ narrated to us, Hammād bin Zayd narrated to us, on authority of Ayyūb and Hishām , on authority of Muhammad bin Sīrīn , that he said: ‘Indeed this knowledge is faith, so carefully consider from whom you take your faith’.
hi: Hasan bin ar-Rabi' ne humein bataaya, Hammad bin Zaid ne humein Ayyub aur Hisham ki sanad se, Muhammad bin Sirin ki sanad se bataaya, unhone kaha: Beshak ye ilm deen hai, is liye ache se dekh lo ki tum apna deen kisse le rahe ho.

e: Abū Ja’far Muhammad bin us-Sabbāh narrated to us, Ismā’īl bin Zakariyyā’ narrated to us, on authority of Āsim il-Ahwal, on authority of Ibn Sīrīn that he said: ‘They would not ask about the chains of narration, and when the Fitnah occurred, they said: ‘Name for us your men’. So Ahl us-Sunnah would be regarded, and their Ḥadīth were then taken, and Ahl ul-Bi’dah would be regarded, and their Ḥadīth were not taken’.
hi: Abu Ja'far Muhammad bin as-Sabbah ne humein bataaya, Ismail bin Zakariyya ne humein Aasim al-Ahwal ki sanad se, Ibn Sirin ki sanad se bataaya, unhone kaha: Wo log sanad ke baare mein nahi poochte the, aur jab Fitna paida hua, to unhone kaha: Humein apne raawiyon ke naam bataao. Is liye Ahl-e-Sunnat ko dekha jaata tha, aur unki Hadees le li jaati thi, aur Ahl-e-Bid'ah ko dekha jaata tha, aur unki Hadees nahi li jaati thi.

e: Ishāq bin Ibrāhīm al-Hanthalī narrated to us, Īsā, and he is Ibn Yūnus, informed us, al-Awzā’ī narrated to us, on authority of Sulyamān bin Mūsā, he said: ‘I came across Tāwus and said: ‘So-and-so narrated to me such-and-such’. Then he said: ‘If your companion is trustworthy, then take from him.’
hi: Ishaq bin Ibrahim al-Hanthali ne humein bataaya, Isa, yaani Ibn Yunus, ne humein khabar di, Awza'i ne humein Sulaiman bin Musa ki sanad se bataaya, unhone kaha: Main Tawus se mila aur maine kaha: Falaan-falaan ne mujhe ye-ye bataaya. Is par unhone kaha: Agar tumhara saathi bharosemand hai, to us se le lo.

e: Abd Allah bin Abd ir-Rahman ad-Dārimī narrated to us, Marwān, meaning Ibn Muhammad ad-Dimashqī informed us, Sa’īd bin Abd il-Azīz narrated to us, on authority of Sulaymān bin Mūsā, he said, I said to Tāwus: ‘So-and-so narrated to me like this-and-that’. He said: ‘If your companion is trustworthy, then take from him.’
hi: Abdullah bin Abdur Rahman ad-Darimi ne humein bataaya, Marwan, yaani Ibn Muhammad ad-Dimashqi ne humein khabar di, Sa'id bin Abdul Aziz ne humein Sulaiman bin Musa ki sanad se bataaya, unhone kaha, maine Tawus se kaha: Falaan ne mujhe is-is tarah bataaya. Unhone kaha: Agar tumhara saathi bharosemand hai, to us se le lo.

e: Nasr bin Alī al-Jahdhamī narrated to us, al-Asma’ī narrated to us, on authority of Ibn Abī-Zinād, on authority of his father, he said: ‘I met one hundred  in al-Madīnah, each of whom were reliable. Narrations were not taken from one about who it was said, ‘he is not from its people’.’
hi: Nasr bin Ali al-Jahdhami ne humein bataaya, Asma'i ne humein Ibn Abi Zinad ki sanad se, unke waalid ki sanad se bataaya, unhone kaha: Main Madina mein sau (100) logon se mila, jinmein se har ek bharosemand tha. Kisi shaks se riwayat nahi li jaati thi jiske baare mein kaha jaata ki 'wo (Ahl-e-Hadees ke) log mein se nahi hai'.

e: Muhammad bin Abī Umar al-Makkī narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us; and Abū Bakr bin Khallād al-Bāhilī narrated to us – and the wording is his, he said, I heard Sufyān bin Uyaynah, on authority of Mis’ar, he said, I heard Sa’d bin Ibrāhīm saying: ‘There is to be no narrating on authority of the Messenger of Allah, may Allah send blessings and peace upon him, except by trustworthy narrators (Thiqāt)’.
hi: Muhammad bin Abi Umar al-Makki ne humein bataaya, Sufyan ne humein bataaya; aur Abu Bakr bin Khallad al-Bahili ne humein bataaya - aur alfaaz unke hain, unhone kaha, maine Sufyan bin Uyaynah ko Misar ki sanad se ye kehte suna, unhone kaha maine Sa'd bin Ibrahim ko ye kehte suna: Rasoolullah (SAW) ki sanad se riwayat sirf bharosemand raawiyon (Siqaat) ke zariye honi chahiye.

e:
Muhammad bin Abd Allah bin Quhzādh from the people of Marw narrated to us, he said I heard Abdān bin Uthmān saying, I heard Abd Allah bin al-Mubārak saying: ‘The chain of narration is from the Dīn, and were it not for the chain of narration whoever wished could say what he wanted’.

Muhammad bin Abd Allah said, al-Abbās bin Abī Rizmah narrated to me, he said I heard Abd Allah  saying: ‘Between us and the people are ‘the legs’ (meaning the chain of narration, i.e. if a Ḥadīth was like a creature)’.

Muhammad said, I heard Abā Ishāq Ibrāhīm bin Īsā at-Tālqānī say, I said to Abd Allah bin al-Mubārak: ‘Oh Abā Abd ir-Rahman! How is the Ḥadīth which goes ‘Indeed from al-Birr after al-Birr is that you pray for your parents after you pray for yourself and you fast for them both after you fast for yourself’? So ’.

Muhammad said, I heard Alī bin Shaqīq saying, I heard Abd Allah bin al-Mubārak saying in front of the people: ‘Abandon the Ḥadīth of Amr bin Thābit for indeed he would curse the Salaf ’.
hi:
Muhammad bin Abdullah bin Quhzadh, Marw ke logon mein se, ne humein bataaya, unhone kaha maine Abdan bin Uthman ko ye kehte suna, maine Abdullah bin al-Mubarak ko ye kehte suna: Sanad deen ka hissa hai, aur agar sanad na hoti, to jo chaahta wo jo chaahe keh sakta.

Muhammad bin Abdullah ne kaha, al-Abbas bin Abi Rizmah ne mujhe bataaya, unhone kaha maine Abdullah ko ye kehte suna: Humare aur logon ke darmiyaan 'taangein' hain (yaani sanad, jaise ki agar Hadees koi jaandar cheez ho).

Muhammad ne kaha, maine Aba Ishaq Ibrahim bin Isa at-Talqani ko ye kehte suna, maine Abdullah bin al-Mubarak se kaha: Aye Aba Abdur Rahman! Wo hadees kaisi hai jismein aata hai ki 'Beshak Birr ke baad Birr ye hai ki tum apne waalidain ke liye dua karo apni khud ki dua ke baad aur unke liye roze rakho apne khud ke roze ke baad'? To...

Muhammad ne kaha, maine Ali bin Shaqiq ko ye kehte suna, maine Abdullah bin al-Mubarak ko logon ke saamne ye kehte suna: Amr bin Thabit ki Hadees chhod do, kyunki wo Salaf (agle log) par laanat bheja karta tha.

e: Abū Bakr ibn in-Naḍr bin Abīn-Naḍr narrated to me, he said Abūn-Naḍr Hāshim bin ul-Qāsim narrated to me, Abū Aqīl, companion of Buhayyah, narrated to us, he said: ‘I was sitting near al-Qāsim bin Ubayd Allah and Yahyā bin Sa’īd  was quiet and did not respond to him’.
hi: Abu Bakr ibn an-Nadr bin Abin-Nadr ne mujhe bataaya, unhone kaha Abun-Nadr Hashim bin al-Qasim ne mujhe bataaya, Abu Aqil, Buhayyah ke saathi, ne humein bataaya, unhone kaha: Main al-Qasim bin Ubaidullah ke paas baitha tha aur Yahya bin Sa'id khaamosh rahe aur unhein jawaab nahi diya.

e: Bishr bin ul-Hakam al-Abdī narrated to me, he said, I heard Sufyān bin Uyaynah saying, they informed me on authority of Abī Aqīl, companion of Buhayyah, that a descendent of Abd Allah bin Umar was asked about something that he did not have knowledge about, so Yahyā bin Sa’īd said to him: ‘By Allah, indeed it is a grave matter that the likes of you, a descendent of two Imāms of guidance – meaning Umar and Ibn Umar – is asked about a matter and you have no knowledge of it’. So  said that Abū Aqīl Yahyā bin al-Mutawakkil witnessed them both when they said that.
hi: Bishr bin al-Hakam al-Abdi ne mujhe bataaya, unhone kaha, maine Sufyan bin Uyaynah ko ye kehte suna, unhone humein Abu Aqil, Buhayyah ke saathi, ki sanad se khabar di ki Abdullah bin Umar ki aulaad mein se ek shaks se kisi cheez ke baare mein poocha gaya jiska use ilm nahi tha, is liye Yahya bin Sa'id ne unse kaha: Allah ki qasam, ye badi baat hai ki tum jaise, hidaayat ke do Imamon ki aulaad - yaani Umar aur Ibn Umar - se ek maamle ke baare mein poocha jaaye aur tumhein uska ilm hi na ho. Is liye Abu Aqil Yahya bin al-Mutawakkil ne un dono ko gawah banaya jab unhone ye kaha.

e: Amr bin Alī Abū Hafs narrated to us, he said I heard Yahyā bin Sa’īd, he said: ‘I asked Sufyān ath-Thawrī , Shu’bah, Mālik, and Ibn Uyaynah about a man who is not reliable (Thabt) in Ḥadīth, and someone comes and asks me about him, and they said: ‘Inform  against him that he is not reliable’.’
hi: Amr bin Ali Abu Hafs ne humein bataaya, unhone kaha maine Yahya bin Sa'id ko ye kehte suna, unhone kaha: Maine Sufyan ath-Thawri, Shu'bah, Malik, aur Ibn Uyaynah se ek aise shaks ke baare mein poocha jo Hadees mein bharosemand (Thabt) nahi hai, aur koi aakar mujhse uske baare mein poochta hai, aur unhone kaha: Uske khilaaf bata do ki wo bharosemand nahi hai.

e: Ubayd Allah bin Sa’īd narrated to us, he said, I heard an-Naḍr saying: ‘Ibn Awn was asked about the Ḥadīth of Shahr and he was standing at the threshold of the door, so  said: ‘Indeed they criticized Shahr, indeed they criticized Shahr’. Muslim, may Allah have mercy on him, said ‘He means- the tongues of men were busy criticizing him’.’
hi: Ubaidullah bin Sa'id ne humein bataaya, unhone kaha, maine an-Nadr ko ye kehte suna: Ibn Aun se Shahr ki Hadees ke baare mein poocha gaya jabki wo darwaze ki chaukhat par khade the, is liye unhone kaha: Beshak unhone Shahr ki tanqeed ki, beshak unhone Shahr ki tanqeed ki. Muslim (Allah unpar rahem kare) ne kaha: Unka matlab hai - logon ki zubaanein unki tanqeed karne mein masroof thi.

e: Hajjāj bin ush-Shā’ir narrated to me, Shabābah narrated to us, he said, Shu’bah said: ‘I had met Shahr then abandoned transmitting from him’.
hi: Hajjaj bin ash-Sha'ir ne mujhe bataaya, Shababah ne humein bataaya, unhone kaha, Shu'bah ne kaha: Main Shahr se mila tha phir maine unse riwayat lena chhod diya.

e:
Muhammad bin Abd Allah bin Quhzādh, from the people of Marw, narrated to me, he said Alī bin Husayn bin Wāqid informed me, he said Abd Allah bin al-Mubārak said, I said to Sufyān ath-Thawrī: ‘Indeed Abbād bin Kathīr, about whose condition you are aware, when he related  said: ‘So when I was in an assembly and Abbād was mentioned there, I praised him regarding his Dīn and said: ‘Do not take from him.’ 

Muhammad said, Abd Allah bin Uthmān narrated to us, he said, my father said, Abd Allah bin al-Mubārak said: ‘I ended up in an assembly of Shu’bah, and he said: ‘This is Abbād bin Kathīr so be warned against him.’
hi:
Muhammad bin Abdullah bin Quhzadh, Marw ke logon mein se, ne mujhe bataaya, unhone kaha Ali bin Husain bin Waqid ne mujhe khabar di, unhone kaha Abdullah bin al-Mubarak ne kaha, maine Sufyan ath-Thawri se kaha: Beshak Abbad bin Kathir, jiske haalaat se aap waaqif hain, jab unhone riwayat ki... unhone kaha: Is liye jab main ek majlis mein tha aur Abbad ka zikr wahan hua, to maine unke deen ke baare mein taareef ki aur kaha: Unse mat lo.

Muhammad ne kaha, Abdullah bin Uthman ne humein bataaya, unhone kaha, mere waalid ne kaha, Abdullah bin al-Mubarak ne kaha: Main Shu'bah ki ek majlis mein pahuncha, aur unhone kaha: Ye Abbad bin Kathir hain, is liye inse khabardaar raho.

e: Al-Faḍl bin Sahl narrated to me, he said, I asked Mu’allā ar-Rāzī about Muhammad bin Sa’īd whom Abbād transmitted from, so he informed me about what Īsā bin Yūnus said: ‘I was at his door and Sufyān was with  about him. So he informed me that he was a liar.’
hi: Al-Fadl bin Sahl ne mujhe bataaya, unhone kaha, maine Mu'alla ar-Razi se Muhammad bin Sa'id ke baare mein poocha jinse Abbad ne riwayat li thi, to unhone mujhe wo bataaya jo Isa bin Yunus ne kaha tha: Main uske darwaze par tha aur Sufyan unke saath the... unke baare mein. Is liye unhone mujhe bataaya ki wo jhoota tha.

e:
Muhammad bin Abī Attāb narrated to me, he said Affān narrated to me, on authority of Muhammad bin Yahyā bin Sa’īd al-Qattān, on authority of his father, he said: ‘We do not see the righteous more false in anything than they are regarding Ḥadīth’. 

Ibn Abī Attāb said: ‘So Muhammad bin Yahyā bin Sa’īd al-Qattān and I met and I asked him about it and he said on authority of his father: ‘You will not see the people of good (Ahl ul-Khayr) more false in anything than they are regarding Ḥadīth.’ Muslim said: ‘He was saying that falsehood flows upon their tongues although they do not intend to lie’.
hi:
Muhammad bin Abi Attab ne mujhe bataaya, unhone kaha Affan ne mujhe bataaya, Muhammad bin Yahya bin Sa'id al-Qattan ki sanad se, unke waalid ki sanad se, unhone kaha: Hum neksharon ko kisi aur cheez mein itna jhoota nahi paate jitna Hadees ke maamle mein.

Ibn Abi Attab ne kaha: Is liye Muhammad bin Yahya bin Sa'id al-Qattan aur main mile aur maine unse iske baare mein poocha aur unhone apne waalid ki sanad se kaha: Tum bhalaai wale logon (Ahl-ul-Khayr) ko kisi aur cheez mein itna jhoota nahi paaoge jitna Hadees ke maamle mein. Muslim ne kaha: Unka matlab tha ki jhoot unki zubaano par baha karta hai halaanki unka jhoot bolne ka koi iraada nahi hota.

e:
Al-Faḍl bin Sahl narrated to me, he said Yazīd bin Hārūn narrated to us, he said Khalīfah bin Mūsā informed me, he said: ‘I entered upon Ghālib bin Ubayd Allah so he began dictating to me ‘Mak’hūl narrated to me this’ and ‘Mak’hūl narrated to me that’. So he prepared to answer the call of nature and stood up, then I looked in his notebook and in it was ‘Abān narrated to me, on authority of Anas’ and ‘Abān on authority of so-and-so’. So I abandoned ’.

I heard al-Hasan bin Alī al-Hulwānī saying: ‘I saw in one of the books of Affān a Ḥadīth of Hishām Abīl-Miqdām meaning a Ḥadīth of Umar bin Abd il-Azīz. ’.’
hi:
Al-Fadl bin Sahl ne mujhe bataaya, unhone kaha Yazid bin Harun ne humein bataaya, unhone kaha Khalifah bin Musa ne mujhe khabar di, unhone kaha: Main Ghalib bin Ubaidullah ke paas gaya to unhone mujhe likhwaana shuru kiya 'Mak'hool ne mujhe ye bataaya' aur 'Mak'hool ne mujhe wo bataaya'. Phir wo qaza-e-haajat ke liye taiyaar hue aur khade ho gaye, phir maine unki kaapi mein dekha aur usmein likha tha 'Aban ne mujhe bataaya, Anas ki sanad se' aur 'Aban ne falaan ki sanad se'. Is liye maine (unse lena) chhod diya.

Maine Hasan bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) al-Hulwani ko ye kehte suna: Maine Affan ki kitabon mein se ek mein Hisham Abul-Miqdam ki ek Hadees dekhi, yaani Umar bin Abdul Aziz ki ek Hadees.

e:
Muhammad bin Abd Allah bin Quhzādh narrated to me, he said I heard Abd Allah bin Uthmān bin Jabalah saying, I said to Abd Allah bin al-Mubārak: ‘Who is this man from whom you transmit the Ḥadīth of Abd Allah bin Amr, ‘The day of Fitr is the day of prizes…’?’  about him’.

Ibn Quhzādh said I heard Wahb bin Zam’ah mentioning about Sufyān bin Abd il-Mālik, he said, Abd Allah –meaning Ibn al-Mubārak- said: ‘I saw Rawh bin Ghutayf, the companion of blood the amount of a Dirham , and I took a seat in one of his audiences. Then I began to become ashamed for my companions to see me sitting with him while his Ḥadīth are disapproved of.’
hi:
Muhammad bin Abdullah bin Quhzadh ne mujhe bataaya, unhone kaha maine Abdullah bin Uthman bin Jabalah ko ye kehte suna, maine Abdullah bin al-Mubarak se kaha: Ye kaunsa shaks hai jisse aap Abdullah bin Amr ki Hadees riwayat karte hain, 'Fitr ka din inaamon ka din hai...'? ...unke baare mein.

Ibn Quhzadh ne kaha maine Wahb bin Zam'ah ko Sufyan bin Abdul Malik ke baare mein zikr karte suna, unhone kaha, Abdullah - yaani Ibn al-Mubarak - ne kaha: Maine Rawh bin Ghutaif ko dekha, ek Dirham jitne khoon ke saathi, aur main unki ek majlis mein baith gaya. Phir main sharminda hone laga ki mere saathi mujhe unke saath baitha hua dekhein jabki unki Hadees naapasand ki jaati hai.

e: Ibn Quhzādh narrated to me, he said, I heard Wahb , on authority of Ibn al-Mubārak, he said: ‘Baqiyyah ’.
hi: Ibn Quhzadh ne mujhe bataaya, unhone kaha, maine Wahb ko Ibn al-Mubarak ki sanad se ye kehte suna: Baqiyyah...

e: Qutaybah bin Sa’īd narrated to us, Jarīr narrated to us, on authority of Mughīrah, on authority of ash-Sha’bī, he said: ‘al-Hārith al-A’war ul-Hamdānī narrated to me, and he is a liar’.
hi: Qutaiba bin Sa'id ne humein bataaya, Jarir ne humein Mughira ki sanad se, ash-Sha'bi ki sanad se bataaya, unhone kaha: Al-Harith al-A'war al-Hamdani ne mujhe bataaya, aur wo jhoota tha.

e: Abū Āmir Abd Allah bin Barrād al-Ash’arī narrated to us, Abū Usāmah narrated to us, on authority of Mufaḍḍal, on authority of Mughīrah, he said I heard ash-Sha’bī saying: ‘al-Hārith al-A’war narrated to me,’ and he  was testifying that he was one of the liars’.
hi: Abu Aamir Abdullah bin Barrad al-Ash'ari ne humein bataaya, Abu Usama ne humein Mufaddal ki sanad se, Mughira ki sanad se bataaya, unhone kaha maine ash-Sha'bi ko ye kehte suna: Al-Harith al-A'war ne mujhe bataaya, aur wo gawahi de rahe the ki wo jhooton mein se ek tha.

e: Qutaybah bin Sa’īd narrated to us, Jarīr narrated to us, on authority of Mughīrah, on authority of Ibrāhīm , he said, Alqamah said: ‘I memorized the Qur’ān in two years’. Al-Hārith said: ‘The Qur’ān is easy; the revelation  is more difficult ’.
hi: Qutaiba bin Sa'id ne humein bataaya, Jarir ne humein Mughira ki sanad se, Ibrahim ki sanad se bataaya, unhone kaha, Alqamah ne kaha: Maine do saal mein Quran yaad kar liya. Al-Harith ne kaha: Quran aasaan hai; wahi (jo isse bhi zyada mushkil kaam hai) zyada mushkil hai.

e: Hajjāj bin ash-Shā’ir narrated to me, Ahmad- meaning Ibn Yūnus- narrated to us, Zā’idah narrated to us, on authority of al-A’mash, on authority of Ibrāhīm that al-Hārith said: ‘I studied the Qur’ān for three years and the revelation for two years’; or he said: ‘…the revelation in three years and the Qur’ān in two years ’.
hi: Hajjaj bin ash-Sha'ir ne mujhe bataaya, Ahmad - yaani Ibn Yunus - ne humein bataaya, Zaidah ne humein A'mash ki sanad se, Ibrahim ki sanad se bataaya ki al-Harith ne kaha: Maine teen saal Quran padha aur do saal wahi (ka ilm haasil kiya); ya unhone kaha: ...do saal wahi aur teen saal Quran.

e: Hajjāj narrated to me, he said Ahmad- and he is Ibn Yūnus- narrated to me, Zā’idah narrated to us, on authority of Mansūr and al-Mughīrah, on authority of Ibrāhīm that al-Hārith was imputed.
hi: Hajjaj ne mujhe bataaya, unhone kaha Ahmad - yaani Ibn Yunus - ne mujhe bataaya, Zaidah ne humein Mansoor aur al-Mughira ki sanad se, Ibrahim ki sanad se bataaya ki al-Harith par ilzaam lagaya gaya tha.

e: Qutaybah bin Sa’īd narrated to us, Jarīr narrated to us, on authority of Hamzah az-Zayyāt, he said: ‘Murrah al-Hamdānī heard something from al-Hārith and said to him: ‘sit by the door’.  said: ‘So Murrah went inside and took his sword and al-Hārith sensed evil and left’.
hi: Qutaiba bin Sa'id ne humein bataaya, Jarir ne humein Hamzah az-Zayyat ki sanad se bataaya, unhone kaha: Murrah al-Hamdani ne al-Harith se kuch suna aur unse kaha: darwaze ke paas baitho. Unhone kaha: Is liye Murrah andar gaya aur apni talwaar uthaayi aur al-Harith ne bura andesha karke wahan se chale gaye.

e: Ubayd Allah bin Sa’īd narrated to me, Abd ur-Rahman- meaning Ibn Mahdī- narrated to us, Hammād bin Zayd narrated to us, on authority of Ibn Awn, he said, Ibrāhīm said to us: ‘Beware of al-Mughīrah bin Sa’īd and Abū Abd ar-Rahīm for they are both liars’.
hi: Ubaidullah bin Sa'id ne mujhe bataaya, Abdur Rahman - yaani Ibn Mahdi - ne humein bataaya, Hammad bin Zaid ne humein Ibn Aun ki sanad se bataaya, unhone kaha, Ibrahim ne humse kaha: al-Mughira bin Sa'id aur Abu Abdur Raheem se bacho, kyunki dono jhoote hain.

e: Abū Kāmil al-Jahdarī narrated to us, Hammād- and he is Ibn Zayd- narrated to us, he said Āsim  narrated to us, he said: ‘We would catch up with Abū Abd ar-Rahman as-Sulamī and at the time we were young men, so he would say to us: ‘Do not sit with story-tellers other than Abūl-Ahwas and beware of Shaqīq ’.
hi: Abu Kaamil al-Jahdari ne humein bataaya, Hammad - yaani Ibn Zaid - ne humein bataaya, unhone kaha Aasim ne humein bataaya, unhone kaha: Hum Abu Abdur Rahman as-Sulami se milte the aur us waqt hum jawaan the, to wo humse kehte the: Abul-Ahwas ke alaawa kisi aur kissa-go ke saath mat baitho aur Shaqiq se bacho.

e: Abū Ghassān Muhammad bin Amr ar-Rāzī narrated to us, he said, I heard Jarīr  saying: ‘I met Jābir bin Yazīd al-Ju’fī and did not write .
hi: Abu Ghassan Muhammad bin Amr ar-Razi ne humein bataaya, unhone kaha, maine Jarir ko ye kehte suna: Main Jabir bin Yazid al-Ju'fi se mila lekin unse (kuch) likha nahi.

e: Al-Hasan al-Hulwānī narrated to us, Yahyā bin Ādam narrated to us, Mis’ar narrated to us, he said: ‘Jābir bin Yazīd narrated to us before there took place what happened  ’.
hi: Al-Hasan al-Hulwani ne humein bataaya, Yahya bin Aadam ne humein bataaya, Misar ne humein bataaya, unhone kaha: Jabir bin Yazid ne humein us se pehle riwayat bataayi thi jo baad mein hua...

e: Salamah bin Shabīb narrated to me, al-Humaydī narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, he said: ‘The people would transmit from Jābir before there appeared what appeared, then when there appeared what appeared, the people imputed him in his Ḥadīth and some of the people abandoned him’. So it was said to  said: ‘Belief in ar-Raj’ah’.
hi: Salamah bin Shabib ne mujhe bataaya, al-Humaidi ne humein bataaya, Sufyan ne humein bataaya, unhone kaha: Log Jabir se riwayat liya karte the us waqt se pehle jab wo (waaqiya) zaahir hua, phir jab wo (waaqiya) zaahir ho gaya, to logon ne unpar (unki) Hadees mein ilzaam lagaaya aur kuch logon ne unse lena chhod diya. Is liye poocha gaya... unhone kaha: (Wo waaqiya) Raj'ah (dobara duniya mein wapas aane) par imaan tha.

e: Hasan al-Hulwānī narrated to us, Abū Yahyā al-Himmānī narrated to us, Qabīsah and his brother  narrated to us, that they heard al-Jarrāh bin Malīh saying, I heard Jābir say: ‘I have 70,000 Ḥadīth all of which are on authority of Abū Ja’far on authority of the Prophet, peace and blessings upon him’.
hi: Hasan al-Hulwani ne humein bataaya, Abu Yahya al-Himmani ne humein bataaya, Qabisah aur unke bhai ne humein bataaya, ki unhone al-Jarrah bin Malih ko ye kehte suna, maine Jabir ko ye kehte suna: Mere paas 70,000 Ahadees hain, sab ki sab Abu Ja'far ki sanad se, Nabi (SAW) se.

e: Hajjāj bin ash-Shā’ir narrated to me, Ahmad bin Yūnus narrated to us, he said, I heard Zuhayr saying, Jābir said, or, I heard Jābir saying: ‘Indeed I have fifty thousand Ḥadīth that I have not narrated from at all’.  said: ‘Then that day he related a Ḥadīth and said, ‘This is from the fifty thousand’.
hi: Hajjaj bin ash-Sha'ir ne mujhe bataaya, Ahmad bin Yunus ne humein bataaya, unhone kaha, maine Zuhair ko ye kehte suna, Jabir ne kaha, ya, maine Jabir ko ye kehte suna: Beshak mere paas pachaas hazaar (50,000) Ahadees hain jinmein se maine kisi ki bhi riwayat nahi ki. Unhone kaha: Phir usi din unhone ek hadees riwayat ki aur kaha: Ye un pachaas hazaar mein se hai.

e: Ibrāhīm bin Khālid al-Yashkurī narrated to me, he said, I heard Abūl-Walīd saying, I heard Sallām bin Abī Mutī’ saying, I heard Jābir al-Ju’fī saying: ‘I have fifty thousand Ḥadīth on authority of the Prophet, peace and blessings upon him’.
hi: Ibrahim bin Khalid al-Yashkuri ne mujhe bataaya, unhone kaha, maine Abul-Walid ko ye kehte suna, maine Sallam bin Abi Muti' ko ye kehte suna, maine Jabir al-Ju'fi ko ye kehte suna: Mere paas Nabi (SAW) ki sanad se pachaas hazaar (50,000) Ahadees hain.

e: Salamah bin Shabīb narrated to me, al-Humaydī narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, he said, I heard a man ask Jābir about the verse: {Thus I will never depart from the land until my father permits me or Allah decides for me, and He is the best of Judges}’. Jābir said, ‘that is an interpretation for these verses’, and he would lie as they were regarding the brothers of Yūsuf, peace be upon him’.
hi: Salamah bin Shabib ne mujhe bataaya, al-Humaidi ne humein bataaya, Sufyan ne humein bataaya, unhone kaha, maine ek shaks ko Jabir se is aayat ke baare mein poochte suna: {Is liye main is zameen se kabhi nahi jaaunga jab tak mere waalid mujhe ijaazat na dein ya Allah mere haq mein faisla na kare, aur wo sabse behtar Faisla karne wala hai}. Jabir ne kaha, ye in aayaton ki ek tafseer hai, aur wo jhoot bolte the jaise ki wo Yusuf (AS) ke bhaiyon ke baare mein thi.

e:
Salamah narrated to me, al-Humaydī narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, he said: ‘I heard Jābir talking about something like 30,000 Ḥadīth .’

Muslim said, I heard Abū Ghassān Muhammad bin Amr ar-Rāzī say, ‘I asked Jarīr bin Abd il-Hamīd: ‘Did you meet al-Hārith bin Hasīrah? He said: ‘Yes,  Shaykh of lengthy silence; he persisted in a grave matter.’
hi:
Salamah ne mujhe bataaya, al-Humaidi ne humein bataaya, Sufyan ne humein bataaya, unhone kaha: Maine Jabir ko takreeban 30,000 Ahadees ke baare mein baat karte suna.

Muslim ne kaha, maine Abu Ghassan Muhammad bin Amr ar-Razi ko ye kehte suna, maine Jarir bin Abdul Hameed se poocha: Kya aap al-Harith bin Hasira se mile? Unhone kaha: Haan, ek lambi khaamoshi wale Shaikh; wo ek sangeen maamle par ada the.

e: Ahmad bin Ibrāhīm ad-Dawraqī narrated to me, he said Abd ur-Rahman bin Mahdī narrated to me, on authority Hammād bin Zayd, he said, Ayyūb mentioned a man one day and said : ‘He is not upright in speech ’.
hi: Ahmad bin Ibrahim ad-Dawraqi ne mujhe bataaya, unhone kaha Abdur Rahman bin Mahdi ne mujhe bataaya, Hammad bin Zaid ki sanad se, unhone kaha, Ayyub ne ek din ek shaks ka zikr kiya aur kaha: Wo apni baat mein seedha (sachcha) nahi hai.

e: Hajjāj bin ash-Shā’ir narrated to me, Sulaymān bin Harb narrated to us, Hammād bin Zayd narrated to us, he said, Ayyūb said: ‘Indeed I have a neighbor’ and he mentioned some of his virtues,  ‘…even if he testified to me about two dates I would not see his testimony as permissible’.
hi: Hajjaj bin ash-Sha'ir ne mujhe bataaya, Sulaiman bin Harb ne humein bataaya, Hammad bin Zaid ne humein bataaya, unhone kaha, Ayyub ne kaha: Beshak mera ek padosi hai, aur unhone uski kuch khoobiyaan bataayin, ...agar wo mere baare mein do khajooron ki gawahi bhi de, to main uski gawahi ko jaayaz nahi maanunga.

e: Muhammad bin Rāfi’ and Hajjāj bin ash-Shā’ir narrated to me, they said Abd ur-Razzāq narrated to us, he said Ma’mar said: ‘I did not see Ayyūb speaking ill of anyone, ever, except for Abd al-Karīm- meaning Abū Umayyah’. So he mentioned him and said, may Allah have mercy on him ‘He is not trustworthy- he had asked me about a Ḥadīth of Ikrimah then said ‘I heard from Ikrimah’ .’
hi: Muhammad bin Rafi' aur Hajjaj bin ash-Sha'ir ne mujhe bataaya, unhone kaha Abdur Razzaq ne humein bataaya, unhone kaha Ma'mar ne kaha: Maine Ayyub ko kabhi kisi ki burayi karte nahi dekha, sivaay Abdul Karim - yaani Abu Umayya - ke. Is liye unhone unka zikr kiya aur kaha, Allah unpar rahem kare: 'Wo bharosemand nahi hai - usne mujhse Ikrimah ki ek Hadees ke baare mein poocha tha phir kaha maine Ikrimah se suna.'

e: Al-Faḍl bin Sahl narrated to me, he said Affān bin Muslim narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, he said, Abū Dāwud al-A’mā came to us and began saying: ‘Al-Barā’ .
hi: Al-Fadl bin Sahl ne mujhe bataaya, unhone kaha Affan bin Muslim ne humein bataaya, Hammam ne humein bataaya, unhone kaha, Abu Dawud al-A'ma humare paas aaye aur kehne lage: Al-Bara...

e: Hasan bin Alī al-Hulwānī narrated to me, he said Yazīd bin Hārūn narrated to us, Hammām informed us, he said ‘Abū Dāwud al-A’mā entered upon Qatādah and when he stood, they said: ‘Indeed this one alleges he has met eighteen of the warriors of the battle of Badr’. Qatādah said: ‘This one was barely asking  regarding it. By Allah, al-Hasan did not narrate to us from a witness of the battle of Badr without an intermediary; and Sa’īd bin al-Musayyib did not narrate to us from a witness of the battle of Badr without an intermediary except from Sa’d bin Mālik’.
hi: Hasan bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) al-Hulwani ne mujhe bataaya, unhone kaha Yazid bin Harun ne humein bataaya, Hammam ne humein khabar di, unhone kaha 'Abu Dawud al-A'ma Qatada ke paas aaye aur jab wo khade hue, to logon ne kaha: Beshak ye shaks dawa karta hai ki wo Badr ki jung ke atthaaraah (18) jangju sahaba se mila hai.' Qatada ne kaha: 'Ye shaks iske baare mein mushkil se hi poochta tha. Allah ki qasam, Hasan ne humein kabhi bhi kisi Badr ki jung ke gawah se bina waaste ke riwayat nahi ki; aur Sa'id bin al-Musayyib ne humein kabhi bhi kisi Badr ki jung ke gawah se bina waaste ke riwayat nahi ki, sivaay Sa'd bin Malik ke.'

e: Uthmān bin Abī Shaybah narrated to us, Jarīr narrated to us, on authority of Raqabah that ‘Abū Ja’far al-Hāshimī al-Madanī was fabricating narrations with words of truth, and they were not from the narrations of the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah upon him, though he was transmitting them on authority of the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah upon him.’
hi: Uthman bin Abi Shaybah ne humein bataaya, Jarir ne humein Raqabah ki sanad se bataaya ki 'Abu Ja'far al-Hashimi al-Madani sach ke alfaaz mein riwayaat gadhta tha, aur wo Nabi (SAW) ki riwayaat nahi thin, halaanki wo unhein Nabi (SAW) ki sanad se riwayat karta tha.'

e: Al-Hasan al-Hulwānī narrated to us, he said Nu’aym bin Hammād narrated to us, he said Abū Ishāq Ibrāhīm bin Muhammad bin Sufyān said; and Muhammad bin Yahyā narrated to us, he said, Nu’aym bin Hammād narrated to us, Abū Dāwud at-Tayālisī narrated to us, on authority of Shu’bah, on authority of Yūnus bin Ubayd, he said: ‘Amr bin Ubayd would lie regarding Ḥadīth’.
hi: Al-Hasan al-Hulwani ne humein bataaya, unhone kaha Nu'aim bin Hammad ne humein bataaya, unhone kaha Abu Ishaq Ibrahim bin Muhammad bin Sufyan ne kaha; aur Muhammad bin Yahya ne humein bataaya, unhone kaha, Nu'aim bin Hammad ne humein bataaya, Abu Dawud at-Tayalisi ne humein Shu'bah ki sanad se, Yunus bin Ubaid ki sanad se bataaya, unhone kaha: 'Amr bin Ubaid Hadees ke maamle mein jhoot bola karte the.'

e: Amr bin Alī Abū Hafs narrated to me, he said I heard Mu’ādh bin Mu’ādh saying, I said to Awf bin Abī Jamīlah ‘Indeed Amr bin Ubayd narrated to us on authority of al-Hasan that the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah upon him, said: ‘Whoever carries arms against us then he is not from us’.  said ‘Amr lied, by Allah. Rather he intended it as a way to permit his filthy opinion.’
hi: Amr bin Ali Abu Hafs ne mujhe bataaya, unhone kaha maine Mu'adh bin Mu'adh ko ye kehte suna, maine Auf bin Abi Jamila se kaha 'Beshak Amr bin Ubaid ne humein Hasan ki sanad se bataaya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jo humare khilaaf hathiyaar uthaaye wo humme se nahi hai.' Unhone kaha 'Amr ne jhoot bola, Allah ki qasam. Balki unka iraada apni gandi raay ko jaayaz thehraane ka ek tareeqa tha.'

e: Ubayd Allah bin Umar al-Qawārīrī narrated to us, Hammād bin Zayd narrated to us, he said: ‘A man kept company with Ayyūb and listened ’.
hi: Ubaidullah bin Umar al-Qawariri ne humein bataaya, Hammad bin Zaid ne humein bataaya, unhone kaha: 'Ek shaks Ayyub ki sohbat mein raha aur sunta raha...'

e: Hajjāj bin ash-Shā’ir narrated to me, Sulaymān bin Harb narrated to us, Ibn Zayd, rather Hammād, narrated to us, he said, it was said to Ayyūb, ‘Indeed Amr bin Ubayd transmitted on authority of al-Hasan that he said: ‘There is no flogging the one who gets drunk from Nabīdh’.’  said: ‘He lied, for I heard al-Hasan saying, ‘Flog the one who gets drunk from Nabīdh’.’
hi: Hajjaj bin ash-Sha'ir ne mujhe bataaya, Sulaiman bin Harb ne humein bataaya, Ibn Zaid, balki Hammad, ne humein bataaya, unhone kaha, Ayyub se kaha gaya, 'Beshak Amr bin Ubaid ne Hasan ki sanad se riwayat ki ki unhone kaha: Nabidh se nashe mein aane wale par koda nahi lagaaya jaayega.' Unhone (Ayyub ne) kaha: 'Usne jhoot bola, kyunki maine Hasan ko ye kehte suna: Nabidh se nashe mein aane wale par koda lagaao.'

e: Hajjāj narrated to me, Sulaymān bin Harb narrated to us, he said, I heard Sallām bin Abī Mutī’ saying, it reached Ayyūb that I would go to Amr so he turned to me and said: ‘Have you seen a man whose Dīn you do not trust- how do you trust him regarding Ḥadīth?’
hi: Hajjaj ne mujhe bataaya, Sulaiman bin Harb ne humein bataaya, unhone kaha, maine Sallam bin Abi Muti' ko ye kehte suna, Ayyub tak khabar pahunchi ki main Amr ke paas jaata hoon, is liye unhone mujhse mukhaatib hokar kaha: 'Kya tumne aisa shaks dekha hai jiske deen par tumhein bharosa nahi, phir tum Hadees ke maamle mein uspar kaise bharosa karte ho?'

e: Salamah bin Shabīb narrated to me, al-Humaydī narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, he said I heard Abū Mūsā  saying: ‘Amr bin Ubayd narrated to us before what happened’ .
hi: Salamah bin Shabib ne mujhe bataaya, al-Humaidi ne humein bataaya, Sufyan ne humein bataaya, unhone kaha maine Abu Musa ko ye kehte suna: 'Amr bin Ubaid ne humein us se pehle riwayat ki thi jo baad mein hua...'

e: Ubayd Allah bin Mu’ādh al-Anbarī narrated to me, my father narrated to us, he said: ‘I wrote to Shu’bah asking him about Abū Shaybah , a judge of Wāsit, so he wrote to me: ‘Do not write anything from him ’.
hi: Ubaidullah bin Mu'adh al-Anbari ne mujhe bataaya, mere waalid ne humein bataaya, unhone kaha: 'Maine Shu'bah ko likha aur unse Abu Shaybah ke baare mein poocha, Wasit ke qaazi, to unhone mujhe likha: Unse kuch bhi mat likho...'

e: Al-Hulwānī narrated to us, he said, I heard Affān  say: ‘I narrated to Hammād bin Salamah  lied’.
hi: Al-Hulwani ne humein bataaya, unhone kaha, maine Affan ko ye kehte suna: 'Maine Hammad bin Salamah se riwayat ki... unhone jhoot bola.'

e: Mahmūd bin Ghaylān narrated to us, Abū Dāwud narrated to us, he said, Shu’bah said to me: ‘Go to Jarīr bin Hāzim and say to him, ‘It is not allowed for you to transmit from al-Hasan bin Umārah for indeed he lies’.’ Abū Dāwud said, I said to Shu’bah: ‘And how do you know that?’ So  said: ‘It is transmitted on authority of al-Hasan al-Basrī’.’ Al-Hasan bin Umārah said: ‘Al-Hakam narrated to us, on authority of Yahyā bin al-Jazzār, on authority of Alī.
hi: Mahmud bin Ghailan ne humein bataaya, Abu Dawud ne humein bataaya, unhone kaha, Shu'bah ne mujhse kaha: 'Jarir bin Hazim ke paas jao aur unse kaho, tumhare liye Hasan bin Umarah se riwayat lena jaayez nahi hai kyunki wo jhoot bolta hai.' Abu Dawud ne kaha, maine Shu'bah se kaha: 'Aur aapko ye kaise pata?' Is par unhone kaha: 'Ye Hasan al-Basri ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.' Hasan bin Umarah ne kaha: 'Al-Hakam ne humein Yahya bin al-Jazzar ki sanad se, Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki sanad se bataaya...'

e:
Al-Hasan al-Hulwānī narrated to us, he said, I heard Yazīd bin Hārūn mention Ziyād bin Maymūn, and he said: ‘I swore that I would not transmit anything from him or Khālid bin Mahdūj’. .’
Al-Hulwānī said: ‘I heard  from Abd as-Samad and I mentioned Ziyād bin Maymūn near him and he charged him with lying’.
hi:
Al-Hasan al-Hulwani ne humein bataaya, unhone kaha, maine Yazid bin Harun ko Ziyad bin Maimun ka zikr karte suna, aur unhone kaha: 'Maine qasam khaayi ki main na unse aur na Khalid bin Mahdooj se koi riwayat lunga...'

Al-Hulwani ne kaha: 'Maine Abd as-Samad se suna aur maine unke saamne Ziyad bin Maimun ka zikr kiya aur unhone unpar jhoot bolne ka ilzaam lagaaya.'

e: Mahmūd bin Ghaylān narrated to us, he said, I said to Abū Dāwud at-Tayālisī: ‘You transmit a great deal on authority of Abbād bin Mansūr - so how is it that you did not hear the Ḥadīth of ‘the lady perfume seller’ from him which an-Naḍr bin Shumayl transmitted to us?’  so we abandoned him ’.
hi: Mahmud bin Ghailan ne humein bataaya, unhone kaha, maine Abu Dawud at-Tayalisi se kaha: 'Aap Abbad bin Mansoor ki sanad se bahut kuch riwayat karte hain - to aisa kaise hai ki aapne unse khushbu bechne wali aurat ki Hadees nahi suni jo an-Nadr bin Shumail ne humein riwayat ki?' ...is liye humne unse (riwayat lena) chhod diya.

e:
Hasan al-Hulwānī narrated to us, he said, I heard Shabābah say: ‘Abd ul-Quddūs was narrating to us saying,‘Suwayd bin Aqalah said…’ 

Muslim said, I heard Ubayd Allah bin Umar al-Qawārīrī saying, I heard Hammād bin Zayd saying to a man after he sat with Mahdī bin Hilāl for days: ‘What is this salty well ’.
hi:
Al-Hasan al-Hulwani ne humein bataaya, unhone kaha, maine Shababah ko ye kehte suna: Abdul-Quddus humein bata rahe the aur keh rahe the, 'Suwaid bin Aqalah ne kaha...'

Muslim ne kaha, maine Ubaidullah bin Umar al-Qawariri ko ye kehte suna, maine Hammad bin Zaid ko ek shaks se ye kehte suna, jab wo kai dinon tak Mahdi bin Hilal ke saath baitha tha: 'Ye kaisa khaara kuaan hai...'

e: Al-Hasan al-Hulwānī narrated to us, he said, I heard Affān say, I heard Abū Awānah say: ‘A Ḥadīth did not reach me on authority of al-Hasan except I presented it to Abān bin Abī Ayyāsh , then he read it to me ’.
hi: Al-Hasan al-Hulwani ne humein bataaya, unhone kaha, maine Affan ko ye kehte suna, maine Abu Awana ko ye kehte suna: 'Mujhe Hasan ki sanad se koi Hadees nahi pahunchi jise maine Aban bin Abi Ayyash ke saamne pesh na kiya ho, phir unhone wo mujhe padh kar sunaayi.'

e: Suwayd bin Sa’īd narrated to us, Alī bin Mus’hir narrated to us, he said: ‘Hamzah az-Zayyāt and I heard from Abān bin Abī Ayyāsh something like one thousand Ḥadīth’. Alī said: ‘So I met Hamzah then he informed me that he saw the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah upon him, ’.
hi: Suwaid bin Sa'id ne humein bataaya, Ali bin Mus'hir ne humein bataaya, unhone kaha: 'Hamzah az-Zayyat aur maine Aban bin Abi Ayyash se takreeban ek hazaar Hadees suni.' Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: 'Is liye main Hamzah se mila, phir unhone mujhe bataaya ki unhone Nabi (SAW) ko dekha tha...'

e: Abd Allah bin Abd ar-Rahman ad-Dārimī narrated to us, Zakariyyā’ bin Adī informed us, he said, Abū Ishāq al-Fazarī said to me: ‘Write from Baqiyyah what he transmits on authority of those who are well-known, and do not write from him what he transmits on authority of those who are not; do not write from Ismā’īl bin Ayyāsh what he transmits on authority of those who are well-known or otherwise ’.
hi: Abdullah bin Abdur Rahman ad-Darimi ne humein bataaya, Zakariyya bin Adi ne humein khabar di, unhone kaha, Abu Ishaq al-Fazari ne mujhse kaha: 'Baqiyyah se wo riwayat likho jo wo maroof (mash'hoor) logon ki sanad se riwayat karte hain, aur unse wo mat likho jo wo ghair-maroof logon ki sanad se riwayat karte hain; Ismail bin Ayyash se kuch mat likho, chaahe wo maroof logon ki sanad se ho ya nahi...'

e: Ishāq bin Ibrāhīm al-Hanthalī  say, Ibn al-Mubārak said: ‘What an excellent man is Baqiyyah, if it were not for the fact that he would provide a nickname for  he was Abd ul-Quddūs ’.
hi: Ishaq bin Ibrahim al-Hanthali ne kaha, Ibn al-Mubarak ne kaha: 'Baqiyyah kitne behtareen shaks hain, agar ye baat na hoti ki wo (kisi ko) laqab de dete... wo Abdul-Quddus the.'

e: Ahmad bin Yūsuf al-Azdī narrated to me, he said, I heard Abd ar-Razzāq saying: ‘I did not see Ibn al-Mubārak express so plainly the charge of ‘lying’ except towards Abd ul-Quddūs; for indeed I heard him saying to him ‘ a liar’.’
hi: Ahmad bin Yusuf al-Azdi ne mujhe bataaya, unhone kaha, maine Abdur Razzaq ko ye kehte suna: 'Maine Ibn al-Mubarak ko kabhi itni saaf-saaf jhoote hone ka ilzaam lagaate nahi dekha sivaay Abdul-Quddus ke maamle mein; kyunki maine unhein khud unse ye kehte suna: jhoota.'

e: Abd Allah bin Abd ar-Rahman ad-Dārimī narrated to me, he said: ‘I heard Abū Nu’aym and he mentioned al-Mu’allā bin Urfān, so
hi: Abdullah bin Abdur Rahman ad-Darimi ne mujhe bataaya, unhone kaha: 'Maine Abu Nu'aim ko suna aur unhone al-Mu'alla bin Urfan ka zikr kiya, is liye...'
