e: Amr bin Alī and Hasan al-Hulwānī narrated to me, both of them on authority of Affān bin Muslim, he said: ‘We were near Ismā’īl bin Ulayyah, and a man narrated on authority of another man, so I said: ‘Indeed this is not reliable (Thabt)’. So the man said: ‘Are you backbiting him?’ Ismā’īl said: ‘He is not backbiting him; rather he is judging him unreliable’.
hi: Amr bin Ali aur Hasan al-Hulwani ne mujhe bataaya, dono ne Affan bin Muslim ki sanad se, unhone kaha: 'Hum Ismail bin Ulayyah ke paas the, aur ek shaks ne doosre shaks ki sanad se riwayat ki, is liye maine kaha: Beshak ye bharosemand (Thabt) nahi hai. Is liye us shaks ne kaha: Kya aap uski gheebat kar rahe hain? Ismail ne kaha: Wo uski gheebat nahi kar raha; balki wo uska (raawi ke taur par) faisla kar raha hai ki wo qaabil-e-etemaad nahi hai.'

e: Abū Ja’far ad-Dārimī narrated to us, Bishr bin Umar narrated to us, he said: ‘I asked Mālik bin Anas about Muhammad bin Abd ar-Rahman who transmits on authority of Sa’īd bin al-Musayyib, so he said: ‘He is not trustworthy ‘. I asked him about Sālih, a freed slave of at-Taw’amah, then he said: ‘He is not trustworthy’. I asked him about Abūl-Huwayrith , and he said: ‘He is not trustworthy’. I asked him about Shu’bah on whose authority Ibn Abī Dhi’b transmitted, and he said: ‘He is not trustworthy’. I asked him about Harām bin Uthmān , and he said ‘He is not trustworthy’. I asked Mālik about these five and he said: ‘They are not trustworthy in terms of their Ḥadīth’. I asked him about another man whose name I forget just now, and he said: ‘Did you see him in my book?’ I said: ‘No’.  he said: ‘If he was trustworthy you would see him in my book’.
hi: Abu Ja'far ad-Darimi ne humein bataaya, Bishr bin Umar ne humein bataaya, unhone kaha: 'Maine Malik bin Anas se Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman ke baare mein poocha jo Sa'id bin al-Musayyib ki sanad se riwayat karte hain, is liye unhone kaha: Wo bharosemand nahi hai. Maine unse Saalih ke baare mein poocha, at-Taw'amah ke aazaad kiye gulaam, phir unhone kaha: Wo bharosemand nahi hai. Maine unse Abul-Huwairith ke baare mein poocha, aur unhone kaha: Wo bharosemand nahi hai. Maine unse Shu'bah ke baare mein poocha jinki sanad se Ibn Abi Dhi'b riwayat karte the, aur unhone kaha: Wo bharosemand nahi hai. Maine unse Haram bin Uthman ke baare mein poocha, aur unhone kaha: Wo bharosemand nahi hai. Maine Malik se in paanchon ke baare mein poocha aur unhone kaha: Ye apni Hadees ke maamle mein bharosemand nahi hain. Maine unse ek aur shaks ke baare mein poocha jiska naam mujhe abhi yaad nahi, aur unhone kaha: Kya tumne use meri kitab mein dekha? Maine kaha: Nahi. Unhone kaha: Agar wo bharosemand hota to tum use meri kitab mein dekhte.'

e: Al-Faḍl bin Sahl narrated to me, he said: ‘Yahyā bin Ma’īn narrated to me, Hajjāj narrated to us, Ibn Abī Dhi’b narrated to us on authority of Shurahbīl bin Sa’d , and he was imputed ’.
hi: Al-Fadl bin Sahl ne mujhe bataaya, unhone kaha: 'Yahya bin Ma'in ne mujhe bataaya, Hajjaj ne humein bataaya, Ibn Abi Dhi'b ne humein Shurahbeel bin Sa'd ki sanad se bataaya, aur unpar ilzaam lagaya gaya tha...'

e: Muhammad bin Abd Allah bin Quhzādh narrated to me, he said, I heard Abū Ishāq at-Tālqānī saying, I heard Ibn al-Mubārak saying: ‘If I had to choose between entering Paradise and meeting Abd Allah bin Muharrar, I would have chosen to meet him, then enter Paradise. Then when I saw him, dung was more preferred to me than him’.
hi: Muhammad bin Abdullah bin Quhzadh ne mujhe bataaya, unhone kaha, maine Abu Ishaq at-Talqani ko ye kehte suna, maine Ibn al-Mubarak ko ye kehte suna: 'Agar mujhe Jannat mein daakhil hone aur Abdullah bin Muharrar se milne ke darmiyaan chunna hota, to main unse milna chunta, phir Jannat mein daakhil hota. Phir jab maine unhein dekha, to gobar bhi mujhe unse zyada pasand tha.'

e: Al-Faḍl bin Sahl narrated to me, Walīd bin Sālih narrated to us, he said, Ubayd Allah bin Amr said, Zayd- meaning Ibn Abī Unaysah – said: ‘Do not take  from my brother ’.
hi: Al-Fadl bin Sahl ne mujhe bataaya, Walid bin Saalih ne humein bataaya, unhone kaha, Ubaidullah bin Amr ne kaha, Zaid - yaani Ibn Abi Unaisah - ne kaha: 'Mere bhai se (kuch bhi) mat lo...'

e: Ahmad bin Ibrāhīm ad-Dawraqī narrated to me, he said, Abd us-Salām al-Wābisī narrated to me, he said, Abd Allah bin Ja’far ar-Raqqī narrated to me, on authority of Ubayd Allah bin Amr, he said: ‘Yahyā bin Abī Unaysah was a liar’.
hi: Ahmad bin Ibrahim ad-Dawraqi ne mujhe bataaya, unhone kaha, Abdus Salam al-Wabisi ne mujhe bataaya, unhone kaha, Abdullah bin Ja'far ar-Raqqi ne mujhe Ubaidullah bin Amr ki sanad se bataaya, unhone kaha: 'Yahya bin Abi Unaisah jhoote the.'

e: Ahmad bin Ibrāhīm narrated to me, he said, Sulaymān bin Harb narrated to me, on authority of Hammād bin Zayd, he said, Farqad was mentioned near Ayyūb, so he said: ‘Indeed Farqad is not a companion of Ḥadīth’.
hi: Ahmad bin Ibrahim ne mujhe bataaya, unhone kaha, Sulaiman bin Harb ne mujhe Hammad bin Zaid ki sanad se bataaya, unhone kaha, Farqad ka zikr Ayyub ke saamne hua, is liye unhone kaha: 'Beshak Farqad Hadees ke asaal (saathi) nahi hain.'

e: Abd ur-Rahman bin Bishr al-Abdī narrated to me, he said, I heard Muhammad bin Abd Allah bin Ubayd bin Umayr al-Laythī was mentioned near Yahyā bin Sa’īd al-Qattān, so he weakened him severely. Then it was said to Yahyā: ‘More weak than Ya’qūb bin Atā ’?’ He said: ‘Yes’. Then he said: ‘I did not see anyone transmitting on authority of Muhammad bin Abd Allah bin Ubayd bin Umayr’.
hi: Abdur Rahman bin Bishr al-Abdi ne mujhe bataaya, unhone kaha, maine suna ki Muhammad bin Abdullah bin Ubaid bin Umair al-Laythi ka zikr Yahya bin Sa'id al-Qattan ke saamne hua, is liye unhone unhein sakht kamzor qaraar diya. Phir Yahya se kaha gaya: 'Ya'qub bin Ata se bhi zyada kamzor?' Unhone kaha: 'Haan.' Phir unhone kaha: 'Maine kisi ko Muhammad bin Abdullah bin Ubaid bin Umair ki sanad se riwayat karte nahi dekha.'

e: Bishr bin al-Hakam narrated to me, he said, I heard Yahyā bin Sa’īd al-Qattān weaken Hakīm bin Jubayr and Abd al-A’lā; and he weakened Yahyā Mūsā bin Dīnār  said: ‘His Ḥadīth are Rīh or ‘wind’  - do not write the Ḥadīth of Ubaydah bin Mu’attib, as-Sarī bin Ismā’īl, or Muhammad bin Sālim’.’
hi: Bishr bin al-Hakam ne mujhe bataaya, unhone kaha, maine Yahya bin Sa'id al-Qattan ko Hakim bin Jubair aur Abdul-A'la ko kamzor qaraar dete suna; aur unhone Yahya Musa bin Dinar ko bhi kamzor qaraar diya, aur kaha: 'Unki Hadees Reeh (hawa) hai' - Ubaidah bin Mu'attib, as-Sari bin Ismail, ya Muhammad bin Salim ki Hadees mat likho.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Yahya b. Ya'mur that the first man who discussed qadr (Divine Decree) in Basra was Ma'bad al-Juhani. I along with Humaid b. 'Abdur-Rahman Himyari set out for pilgrimage or for 'Umrah and said: Should it so happen that we come into contact with one of the Companions of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) we shall ask him about what is talked about taqdir (Divine Decree). Accidentally we came across Abdullah ibn Umar ibn al-Khattab, while he was entering the mosque. My companion and I surrounded him. One of us (stood) on his right and the other stood on his left. I expected that my companion would authorize me to speak. I therefore said: Abu Abdur Rahman! There have appeared some people in our land who recite the Qur'an and pursue knowledge. And then after talking about their affairs, added: They (such people) claim that there is no such thing as Divine Decree and events are not predestined. He (Abdullah ibn Umar) said: When you happen to meet such people tell them that I have nothing to do with them and they have nothing to do with me. And verily they are in no way responsible for my (belief). Abdullah ibn Umar swore by Him (the Lord) (and said): If any one of them (who does not believe in the Divine Decree) had with him gold equal to the bulk of (the mountain) Uhud and spent it (in the way of Allah), Allah would not accept it unless he affirmed his faith in Divine Decree. He further said: My father, Umar ibn al-Khattab, told me: One day we were sitting in the company of Allah's Apostle (peace be upon him) when there appeared before us a man dressed in pure white clothes, his hair extraordinarily black. There were no signs of travel on him. None amongst us recognized him. At last he sat with the Apostle (peace be upon him) He knelt before him placed his palms on his thighs and said: Muhammad, inform me about al-Islam. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Al-Islam implies that you testify that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the messenger of Allah, and you establish prayer, pay Zakat, observe the fast of Ramadan, and perform pilgrimage to the (House) if you are solvent enough (to bear the expense of) the journey. He (the inquirer) said: You have told the truth. He (Umar ibn al-Khattab) said: It amazed us that he would put the question and then he would himself verify the truth. He (the inquirer) said: Inform me about Iman (faith). He (the Holy Prophet) replied: That you affirm your faith in Allah, in His angels, in His Books, in His Apostles, in the Day of Judgment, and you affirm your faith in the Divine Decree about good and evil. He (the inquirer) said: You have told the truth. He (the inquirer) again said: Inform me about al-Ihsan (performance of good deeds). He (the Holy Prophet) said: That you worship Allah as if you are seeing Him, for though you don't see Him, He, verily, sees you. He (the enquirer) again said: Inform me about the hour (of the Doom). He (the Holy Prophet) remarked: One who is asked knows no more than the one who is inquiring (about it). He (the inquirer) said: Tell me some of its indications. He (the Holy Prophet) said: That the slave-girl will give birth to her mistress and master, that you will find barefooted, destitute goat-herds vying with one another in the construction of magnificent buildings. He (the narrator, Umar ibn al-Khattab) said: Then he (the inquirer) went on his way but I stayed with him (the Holy Prophet) for a long while. He then, said to me: Umar, do you know who this inquirer was? I replied: Allah and His Apostle knows best. He (the Holy Prophet) remarked: He was Gabriel (the angel). He came to you in order to instruct you in matters of religion.
hi: Yahya bin Ya'mur ki riwayat hai ki Basra mein qadr (taqdeer) par sabse pehle baat karne wala Ma'bad al-Juhani tha. Main aur Humaid bin Abdur-Rahman Himyari hajj ya umrah ke liye nikle aur kaha: Agar hamari mulaqat Rasoolullah (SAW) ke kisi Sahabi se ho jaaye to hum unse taqdeer ke baare mein poochenge jo ye log kehte hain. Ittefaqan hamari mulaqat Abdullah bin Umar bin al-Khattab se ho gayi jab wo masjid mein daakhil ho rahe the. Maine aur mere saathi ne unhe gher liya, ek unke daayein taraf aur doosra baayein taraf khada ho gaya. Mujhe laga ki mera saathi baat karne ki zimmedari mujhe de dega, is liye maine kaha: Abu Abdur Rahman! Hamare ilaake mein kuch log paida ho gaye hain jo Quran padhte hain aur ilm haasil karte hain - aur unke maamlon ka zikr karte hue ye bhi kaha ki wo log dawa karte hain ki taqdeer jaisi koi cheez nahi hai aur waqiyaat pehle se muqarrar nahi hain. Unhone (Abdullah bin Umar ne) kaha: Jab tumhari mulaqat aise logon se ho to unhe bata dena ki mera unse koi taalluq nahi hai aur unka mujhse koi taalluq nahi hai. Aur yaqinan wo mere (imaan) ke zimmedar nahi hain. Abdullah bin Umar ne Allah ki qasam khaate hue kaha: Agar in mein se kisi ke paas (jo taqdeer par imaan nahi rakhta) Uhud pahaad ke barabar sona ho aur wo use Allah ki raah mein kharch kar de, to Allah use tab tak qubool nahi karega jab tak wo taqdeer par imaan na laaye. Unhone aage kaha: Mere waalid, Umar bin al-Khattab ne mujhse kaha: Ek din hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ki majlis mein baithe the ki achanak hamare saamne ek shaks aaya jo bilkul safed kapde pehne hue tha, uske baal bahut kaale the. Uspar safar ke koi aasar nahi the. Hummein se koi bhi use nahi pehchanta tha. Aakhir mein wo Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas baith gaya, apne ghutne unke ghutnon se milaaye, apni hatheliyaan apni raanon par rakhi aur kaha: Muhammad, mujhe Islam ke baare mein bataiye. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Islam ye hai ki tum gawahi do ki Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi aur Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain, aur tum namaz qaayam karo, Zakat do, Ramzan ke roze rakho, aur agar taaqat ho to Baitullah ka Hajj karo. Unhone kaha: Aapne sach kaha. Unhone (Umar ne) kaha: Hamein ta'ajjub hua ki wo khud sawaal bhi karta hai aur khud hi uski tasdeeq bhi karta hai. Unhone kaha: Mujhe Imaan ke baare mein bataiye. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Ye ki tum Allah par, Uske Farishton par, Uski Kitabon par, Uske Rasoolon par, Qayamat ke Din par imaan lao, aur achi-buri taqdeer par bhi imaan lao. Unhone kaha: Aapne sach kaha. Unhone kaha: Mujhe Ihsaan ke baare mein bataiye. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Ye ki tum Allah ki ibaadat is tarah karo goya tum use dekh rahe ho, aur agar tum use nahi dekh rahe to wo tumhein zaroor dekh raha hai. Unhone kaha: Mujhe Qayamat ki ghadi ke baare mein bataiye. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Jisse poocha ja raha hai wo poochne wale se zyada nahi jaanta. Unhone kaha: To mujhe uski kuch nishaniyan bataiye. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Ye ki laundi apni malkin ko janam degi, aur tum dekhoge ki nange paanv, muflis bakri charane wale log oonchi-oonchi imaarat banane mein ek doosre se aage badhne ki koshish karenge. Unhone (raawi Umar bin al-Khattab ne) kaha: Phir wo shaks chala gaya aur main kuch der tak wahin (Nabi SAW ke paas) raha. Phir aap (SAW) ne mujhse kaha: Umar, kya tum jaante ho ye sawaal karne wala kaun tha? Maine kaha: Allah aur Uske Rasool behtar jaante hain. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Ye Jibrael (Farishta) the. Wo tumhare paas tumhein deen ki taleem dene aaye the.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Yahya b. Ya'mur that when Ma'bad discussed the problem pertaining to Divine Decree, we refuted that. He (the narrator) said: I and Humaid b. Abdur-Rahman Himyari argued. And they carried on the conversation about the purport of the hadith related by Kahmas and its chain of transmission too, and there is some variation of words.
hi: Yahya bin Ya'mur se riwayat hai ki jab Ma'bad ne taqdeer ke maamle mein baat ki, to humne uska khandan kiya. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Maine aur Humaid bin Abdur-Rahman Himyari ne is baat par bahas ki. Aur unhone Kahmas ki riwayat aur uski sanad ke mutaabiq hi hadees bayan ki, jismein alfaaz ka thoda farq hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Yahya b. Ya'mur and Humaid b. 'Abdur-Rahman that they said: We met Abdullah b. 'Umar and we discussed about the Divine Decree, and what they talked about it and he narrated the hadith that has been transmitted by 'Umar (may Allah be pleased with him) from the Apostle (ﷺ). There is a slight variation in that.
hi: Yahya bin Ya'mur aur Humaid bin Abdur-Rahman se riwayat hai ki unhone kaha: Hamari mulaqat Abdullah bin Umar se hui aur humne taqdeer ka zikr kiya aur ye bhi ki log iske baare mein kya kehte hain. To unhone wahi hadees bayan ki jo Umar (Allah unse raazi ho) ne Rasool (SAW) se riwayat ki hai, jismein thoda izafa hai.

e: The same hadith is mentioned through a different chain.
hi: Yahi hadees ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki gayi hai.

e:
Abu Huraira reported: One day the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) appeared before the public so a man came to him and then said: Prophet of Allah, what is Iman? Upon this he (the Holy Prophet) replied: That you affirm your faith in Allah, His angels, His Books, His meeting, His Messengers and that you affirm your faith in the Resurrection hereafter. He said: Messenger of Allah, what is al-Islam? He replied: Al-Islam is that you worship Allah and do not associate anything with Him and you establish obligatory prayer and you pay the obligatory alms (Zakat) and you observe the fast of Ramadan. He said: Messenger of Allah, what is al-Ihsan? He replied: That you worship Allah as if you are seeing Him, and for if you fail to see Him. He said: Messenger of Allah, when is the Hour (of Doom)? He replied: The one who is asked about it is no better informed than the inquirer, however I will narrate some of its signs to you. When the slave-girl will give birth to her master, then that is from its signs. When the naked, barefooted would become the chiefs of the people, then that is from its signs. When the shepherds of the black (camels) would exult themselves in buildings, then that is from its signs. (The Hour is) Among one of the five which no one knows but Allah. Then he recited (the verse): "Verily Allah! with Him alone is the knowledge of the Hour and He it is Who sends down the rain and knows that which is in the wombs. And no soul knows what it shall earn tomorrow, and a soul knows not in what land it shall die. Verily Allah is Knowing, Aware." 
He (Abu Huraira) said: Then the person turned back and went away. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Bring that man back to me. They went to bring him back, but they saw nothing there. Upon this the Messenger of Allah remarked: he was Gabriel, who came to teach the people their religion.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai: Ek din Rasoolullah (SAW) logon ke saamne tashreef laaye to ek shaks aaya aur kaha: Allah ke Nabi, Imaan kya hai? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Ye ki tum Allah par, Uske Farishton par, Uski Kitabon par, Uski mulaqat par, Uske Rasoolon par imaan lao aur Qayamat ke baad dobara uthaye jaane par imaan lao. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Islam kya hai? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Islam ye hai ki tum Allah ki ibaadat karo aur uske saath kisi ko shareek na karo, farz namaz qaayam karo, farz Zakat ada karo aur Ramzan ke roze rakho. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Ihsaan kya hai? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Ye ki tum Allah ki ibaadat is tarah karo goya tum use dekh rahe ho, aur agar tum use nahi dekhte to wo tumhein dekh raha hai. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Qayamat kab aayegi? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Jisse poocha ja raha hai wo poochne wale se zyada nahi jaanta, lekin main tumhein iski kuch nishaniyan bataata hoon. Jab laundi apne aaqa ko janam degi, to ye uski nishani hai. Jab nange paanv, muflis log logon ke sardar ban jayenge, to ye uski nishani hai. Jab kaale (oonton) ke charwaahe imaaraton mein fakhr karne lagenge, to ye uski nishani hai. (Qayamat ki ghadi) un paanch cheezon mein se hai jinhe Allah ke siwa koi nahi jaanta. Phir aap (SAW) ne (ye aayat) tilaawat farmaayi: "Beshak Allah hi ke paas Qayamat ka ilm hai, aur wahi baarish barsaata hai aur jaanta hai jo kuch rahmon (kokhon) mein hai. Aur koi jaan nahi jaanti ki kal wo kya kamaayegi, aur koi jaan nahi jaanti ki wo kis zameen mein marega. Beshak Allah sab jaanne wala, khabar rakhne wala hai." Unhone (Abu Huraira ne) kaha: Phir wo shaks palatkar chala gaya. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Us aadmi ko mere paas wapas le aao. Log use dhoondhne gaye lekin unhein kuch nazar nahi aaya. Is par Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Wo Jibrael the, jo logon ko unka deen sikhaane aaye the.

e: This hadith is narrated to us on the authority of Muhammad b. 'Abdullah b. Numair, on the authority of Muhammad b. Bishr, on the authority of Abd Hayyan al-Taymi with the exception that in this narration (instead of the words (Iza Waladat al'amah rabbaha), the words are (Iza Waladat al'amah Ba'laha), i, e, when slave-girl gives birth to her master.
hi: Ye hadees hamein Muhammad bin Abdullah bin Numair ki sanad se, Muhammad bin Bishr ki sanad se, Abd Hayyan al-Taymi ki sanad se bayan ki gayi hai, sivaay iske ki is riwayat mein (Iza waladat al'amah rabbaha) ke bajaaye (Iza waladat al'amah ba'laha) ke alfaaz hain, yaani jab laundi apne aaqa ko janam de.

e:
It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Ask me (about religious matters), but they (the Companions) were in awe of asking him. Then came 
a man, and sat near his knees and said: O Messenger of Allah, what is al-Islam? So he (the Holy Prophet) replied:  of its signs. The (Hour) is one of the five things of the unseen. No one knows them except Allah. Then (the Holy Prophet) recited (the folowing verse):" Verily Allah! with Him alone is the knowledge of the Hour and He it is Who sends down the rain and knows that which is in the wombs. And no soul knows what it shall earn on the morrow and a soul knows not in what land it shall die. Verily Allah is Knowing, Aware." 

He (Abu Huraira) said: Then the person stood up (and made his way). Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Bring him back to me. He was searched for, but they could not find him. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) thereupon said: He was Gabriel and he wanted to teach you when you did not ask.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Mujhse (deen ki baaton ke baare mein) poocho, lekin Sahaba (RA) aap se poochne mein hichkichaate the. Phir ek shaks aaya aur aap (SAW) ke ghutnon ke paas baith gaya aur kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, Islam kya hai? To aap (SAW) ne farmaya: uski nishaniyon mein se hai. (Qayamat ki ghadi) un paanch ghaib ki cheezon mein se ek hai jinhe Allah ke siwa koi nahi jaanta. Phir aap (SAW) ne (ye) aayat tilaawat farmaayi: "Beshak Allah hi ke paas Qayamat ka ilm hai, aur wahi baarish barsaata hai aur jaanta hai jo kuch rahmon mein hai. Aur koi jaan nahi jaanti ki kal wo kya kamaayegi, aur koi jaan nahi jaanti ki wo kis zameen mein marega. Beshak Allah sab jaanne wala, khabar rakhne wala hai." Unhone (Abu Huraira ne) kaha: Phir wo shaks khada hokar chala gaya. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Use mere paas wapas le aao. Use dhoondha gaya lekin wo nahi mila. Is par Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Wo Jibrael the aur jab tumne nahi poocha tab bhi wo tumhein sikhaana chahte the.

e: It is reported on the authority of Talha b. 'Ubaidullah that a person with dishevelled hair, one of the people of Nejd, came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). We heard the humming of his voice but could not fully discern what he had been saying, till he came nigh to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). It was then (disclosed to us) that he was asking questions pertaining to Islam. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Five prayers during the day and the night. (Upon this he said: Am I obliged to say any other (prayer) besides these? He (the Holy Prophet, ) said: No, but whatever you observe voluntarily, out of your own free will, and the fasts of Ramadan. The inquirer said: Am I obliged to do anything else besides this? He (the Holy Prophet) said: No, but whatever you do out of your own free will. And the Messenger of Allah told him about the Zakat (poor-rate). The inquirer said: Am I obliged to pay anything else besides this? He (the Holy Prophet) said: No, but whatever you pay voluntarily out of your own free will. The man turned back and was saying: I would neither make any addition to this, nor will decrease anything out of it. The Prophet remarked: He is successful, if he is true to what he affirms.
hi: Talha bin Ubaidullah se riwayat hai ki Najd ke ilaake ka ek pareshan-baal shaks Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aaya. Hamein uski awaaz ki goonj sunayi di lekin ye samajh nahi aaya ki wo kya keh raha hai, yahan tak ki wo Rasoolullah (SAW) ke kareeb aa gaya. Tab hum par zaahir hua ki wo Islam ke baare mein sawaal kar raha tha. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Din aur raat mein paanch namazein. Is par usne kaha: Kya inke alaawa mujh par aur kuch farz hai? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Nahi, sivaay iske ki tum apni marzi se nafl ada karo, aur Ramzan ke roze. Sawaal karne wale ne kaha: Kya inke alaawa aur kuch mujh par farz hai? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Nahi, sivaay iske ki tum apni marzi se kuch aur karo. Aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ne use Zakat ke baare mein bataaya. Sawaal karne wale ne kaha: Kya iske alaawa aur kuch mujh par farz hai? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Nahi, sivaay iske ki tum apni marzi se kuch aur do. Wo shaks wapas jaate hue keh raha tha: Khuda ki qasam, main na is mein kuch izafa karunga na kami. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Wo kaamyaab ho gaya, agar usne sach kaha.

e: Another hadith, the like of which has been narrated by Malik (b. Anas) (and mentioned above) is also reported by Talha b. 'Ubaidullah, with the only variation that the Prophet remarked: By his father, he shall succeed if he were true (to what he professed), or: By his father, he would enter heaven if he were true (to what he professed).
hi: Ek aur hadees, jo Malik bin Anas ki bayan ki gayi hadees jaisi hi hai (jiska zikr upar hua), Talha bin Ubaidullah se bhi riwayat hai, sirf itna farq hai ki Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Uske waalid ki qasam, wo kaamyaab ho jaayega agar usne sach kaha, ya: Uske waalid ki qasam, wo Jannat mein daakhil ho jaayega agar usne sach kaha.

e: It is reported on the authority of Anas b. Malik that he said: We were forbidden that we should ask anything (without the genuine need) from the Holy Prophet. It, therefore, pleased us that an intelligent person from the dwellers of the desert should come and asked him (the Holy Prophet) and we should listen to it. A man from the dwellers of the desert came (to the Holy Prophet) and said: Muhammad, your messenger came to us and told us your assertion that verily Allah had sent you (as a prophet). He (the Holy Prophet) remarked: He told the truth. He (the bedouin) said: Who created the heaven? He (the Holy Prophet) replied: Allah. He (the bedouin again) said: Who created the earth? He (the Holy Prophet) replied: Allah. He (the bedouin again) said: Who raised these mountains and who created in them whatever is created there? He (the Holy Prophet) replied: Allah. Upon this he (the bedouin) remarked: By Him Who created the heaven and created the earth and raised mountains thereupon, has Allah (in fact) sent you? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Yes. He (the bedouin) said: Your messenger also told us that five prayers (had been made) obligatory for us during the day and the night. He (the Holy Prophet) remarked: He told you the truth. He (the bedouin) said: By Him Who sent you, is it Allah Who ordered you about this (i. e. prayers)? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Yes. He (the bedouin) said: Your messenger told us that Zakat had been made obligatory in our riches. He (the Holy Prophet) said. He has told the truth. He (the bedouin) said: By Him Who sent you (as a prophet), is it Allah Who ordered you about it (Zakat)? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Yes. He (the bedouin) said: Your messenger told us that it had been made obligatory for us to fast every year during the month of Ramadan. He (the Holy Prophet) said: He has told the truth. He (the bedouin) said: By Him Who sent you (as a prophet), is it Allah Who ordered you about it (the fasts of Ramadan)? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Yes. He (the bedouin) said: Your messenger also told us that pilgrimage (Hajj) to the House (of Ka'bah) had been made obligatory for him who is able to undertake the journey to it. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Yes. The narrator said that he (the bedouin) set off (at the conclusion of this answer, but at the time of his departure) remarked: 'By Him Who sent you with the Truth, I would neither make any addition to them nor would I diminish anything out of them. Upon this the Prophet remarked: If he were true (to what he said) he must enter Paradise.
hi: Anas bin Malik se riwayat hai, unhone kaha: Hamein mana kiya gaya tha ki hum Rasoolullah (SAW) se (bina kisi zaroorat ke) kuch bhi na poochein. Is liye hamein achha lagta tha ki registaan ke rehne walon mein se koi aqlmand shaks aaye aur aap (SAW) se sawaal kare aur hum sunein. Registaan ke rehne walon mein se ek shaks aaya aur kaha: Muhammad, aapke qaasid hamare paas aaye aur hamein bataaya ki aap dawa karte hain ki Allah ne aapko bheja hai. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Usne sach kaha. Usne kaha: Aasman kisne banaaya? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Allah ne. Usne kaha: Zameen kisne banaayi? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Allah ne. Usne kaha: In pahaadon ko kisne khada kiya aur inmein jo kuch hai wo kisne banaaya? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Allah ne. Is par usne kaha: Us Zaat ki qasam jisne aasman banaaya aur zameen banaayi aur ye pahaad khade kiye, kya Allah ne (waaqai) aapko bheja hai? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Haan. Usne kaha: Aapke qaasid ne hamein ye bhi bataaya ki din aur raat mein hum par paanch namazein farz hain. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Usne sach kaha. Usne kaha: Us Zaat ki qasam jisne aapko bheja, kya Allah ne hi aapko iska hukum diya (yaani namazon ka)? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Haan. Usne kaha: Aapke qaasid ne hamein bataaya ki hamare maal mein Zakat farz ki gayi hai. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Usne sach kaha. Usne kaha: Us Zaat ki qasam jisne aapko bheja, kya Allah ne hi aapko iska hukum diya (yaani Zakat ka)? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Haan. Usne kaha: Aapke qaasid ne hamein bataaya ki har saal Ramzan ke mahine mein roze farz kiye gaye hain. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Usne sach kaha. Usne kaha: Us Zaat ki qasam jisne aapko bheja, kya Allah ne hi aapko iska hukum diya (yaani rozon ka)? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Haan. Usne kaha: Aapke qaasid ne hamein bataaya ki Baitullah ka Hajj us shaks par farz hai jo wahan tak jaane ki taaqat rakhta ho. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Haan. Raawi ne kaha ki wo shaks (is jawaab ke baad) chal diya, lekin jaate-jaate keh gaya: Us Zaat ki qasam jisne aapko Haq deker bheja, main na inmein koi izafa karunga na kuch kam karunga. Is par Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Agar usne sach kaha to wo zaroor Jannat mein daakhil hoga.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Thabit that Anas said: We were forbidden in the Holy Qur'an that we should ask about anything from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and then Anas reported the hadith in similar words.
hi: Thabit se riwayat hai ki Anas ne kaha: Hamein Quran-e-Kareem mein mana kiya gaya tha ki hum Rasoolullah (SAW) se kuch na poochein, phir Anas ne isi tarah ki hadees bayan ki.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Ayyub Ansari that once during the journey of the Prophet (may peace of Allah be upon him) a bedouin appeared before him and caught hold of the nosestring of his she-camel and then said, Messenger of Allah (or Muhammad), inform me about that which takes me near to Paradise and draws me away from the Fire (of Hell). He (the narrator) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) stopped for a while and cast a glance upon his companions and then said: He was afforded a good opportunity (or he had been guided well). He (the Holy Prophet) addressing the bedouin said: (Repeat) whatever you have uttered. He (the bedouin) repeated that. Upon this the Apostle (ﷺ) remarked: The deed which can draw you near to Paradise and take you away from Hell is, that you worship Allah and associate none with Him, and you establish prayer and pay Zakat, and do good to your kin. After having uttered these words, the Prophet asked the bedouin to release the nosestring of his she-camel.
hi: Abu Ayyub Ansari se riwayat hai ki ek baar Nabi (SAW) ke safar ke dauraan ek badawi (registaani) aaya aur unki oontni ki naath thaam li aur kaha: Ya Rasoolullah (ya: Muhammad), mujhe wo (amal) bataiye jo mujhe Jannat ke kareeb le jaaye aur Jahannam ki aag se door kare. Raawi ne kaha: Nabi (SAW) thodi der ruke, apne saathiyon par ek nazar daali aur farmaya: Isko achhi tawfeeq mili hai (ya: isko sahi raah dikhaayi gayi hai). Aap (SAW) ne us badawi se kaha: (Dobara kaho) jo tumne kaha. Usne wahi baat dohraayi. Is par Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Wo amal jo tumhein Jannat ke kareeb le jaaye aur Jahannam se door kare, wo ye hai ki tum Allah ki ibaadat karo aur uske saath kisi ko shareek na karo, aur namaz qaayam karo aur Zakat do, aur apne rishtedaaron ke saath achha sulook karo. Ye alfaaz kehne ke baad, Nabi (SAW) ne badawi se oontni ki naath chhod dene ko kaha.

e: This hadith is transmitted by Muhammad b. Hatim on the authority of Abu Ayyub Ansari.
hi: Ye hadees Muhammad bin Hatim ne Abu Ayyub Ansari ki sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Ayyub that a man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said: Direct me to a deed which draws me near to Paradise and takes me away from the Fire (of Hell). Upon this he (the Holy Prophet) said: You worship Allah and never associate anything with Him, establish prayer, and pay Zakat, and do good to your kin. When he turned his back, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) remarked: If he adheres to what he has been ordered to do, he would enter Paradise.
hi: Abu Ayyub se riwayat hai ki ek shaks Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Mujhe koi aisa amal bataiye jo mujhe Jannat ke kareeb le jaaye aur Jahannam ki aag se door kare. Is par aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Tum Allah ki ibaadat karo aur kabhi uske saath kisi ko shareek na karo, namaz qaayam karo, Zakat do, aur apne rishtedaaron ke saath achha sulook karo. Jab wo shaks palatkar chala, to Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Agar usne jo hukum diya gaya use us par amal kiya, to wo Jannat mein daakhil hoga.

e: It is reported on the authority of Abu Huraira that a bedouin came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: Messenger of Allah, direct me to a deed by which I may be entitled to enter Paradise. Upon this he (the Holy Prophet) remarked: You worship Allah and never associate anything with Him, establish the obligatory prayer, and pay the Zakat which is incumbent upon you, and observe the fast of Ramadan. He (the bedouin) said: By Him in Whose hand is my life, I will never add anything to it, nor will I diminish anything from it. When he (the bedouin) turned his back, the Prophet (ﷺ) said: He who is pleased to see a man from the dwellers of Paradise should catch a glimpse of him.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki ek badawi Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, mujhe koi aisa amal bataiye jiski wajah se main Jannat mein daakhil hone ka haqdaar bann jaaun. Is par aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Tum Allah ki ibaadat karo aur kabhi uske saath kisi ko shareek na karo, farz namaz qaayam karo, aur jo Zakat tum par farz hai wo ada karo, aur Ramzan ke roze rakho. Us badawi ne kaha: Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, main na kabhi ismein kuch izafa karunga na kabhi kuch kam karunga. Jab wo badawi palatkar chala, to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Jise Jannatiyon mein se kisi ko dekhkar khushi ho, use is shaks ko dekh lena chahiye.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Jabir that Nu'man b. Qaufal came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said: Would I enter Paradise if I say the obligatory prayers and deny myself that which is forbidden and treat that as lawful what has been made permissible (by the Shari'ah)? The Prophet (ﷺ) replied in the affirmative.
hi: Jabir se riwayat hai ki Nu'man bin Qaufal Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: Kya main Jannat mein daakhil hounga agar main farz namazein padhun aur haram cheezon se bachun aur jo halal (Shari'ah ne) kar diya hai use halal maanun? Nabi (SAW) ne haan mein jawaab diya.

e: A similar hadith is narrated on Jabir's authority in which the following words are added: I will do nothing more.
hi: Isi jaisi ek hadees Jabir ki sanad se bayan ki gayi hai jismein ye alfaaz izafa kiye gaye hain: Main aur kuch nahi karunga.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Jabir that a man once said to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): Shall I enter Paradise in case I say the obligatory prayers, observe the (fasts) of Ramadan and treat that as lawful which has been made permissible (by the Shari'ah) and deny myself that what is forbidden, and make no addition to it? He (the Holy Prophet) replied in the affirmative. He (the inquirer) said: By Allah, I would add nothing to it.
hi: Jabir se riwayat hai ki ek shaks ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se kaha: Kya main Jannat mein daakhil ho jaaunga agar main farz namazein padhun, Ramzan ke roze rakhun, aur jo halal kiya gaya hai use halal maanun aur jo haram hai usse bachun, aur ismein koi izafa na karun? Nabi (SAW) ne haan mein jawaab diya. Sawaal karne wale ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, main ismein kuch izafa nahi karunga.

e:
It is narrated on the authority of ('Abdullah) son of Umar (may Allah be pleased with them) that the Prophet (may peace of Allah be upon him) said: (The superstructure of) al-Islam is raised on five (pillars), i. e. the oneness of Allah, the establishment of prayer, payment of Zakat, the, fast of Ramadan, Pilgrimage (to Mecca). 
A person said (to 'Abdullah b. Umar the narrator): Which of the two precedes the other-Pilgrimage or the fasts of Rarnadan? Upon this he (the narrator) replied: No (it is not the Pilgrimage first) but the fasts of Ramadan precede the Pilgrimage.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (Allah unse aur unke waalid se raazi ho) se riwayat hai ki Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Islam (ki imaarat) paanch (bunyaadon) par khadi ki gayi hai, yaani Allah ki wahdaniyat, namaz qaayam karna, Zakat ada karna, Ramzan ke roze, aur (Makkah ka) Hajj. Ek shaks ne (raawi Abdullah bin Umar se) kaha: In dono mein pehle kya aata hai - Hajj ya Ramzan ke roze? Is par unhone (raawi ne) jawaab diya: Nahi, (Hajj pehle nahi hai) balki Ramzan ke roze Hajj se pehle aate hain.

e: It is narrated on the authority of ('Abdullah) son of 'Umar, that the Prophet (may peace of Allah be upon him) said: (The superstructure of) al-Islam is raised on five (pillars), i. e. Allah (alone) should be worshipped, and (all other gods) beside Him should be (categorically) denied. Establishment of prayer, the payment of Zakat, Pilgrimage to the House, and the fast of Ramadan (are the other obligatory acts besides the belief in the oneness of Allah and denial of all other gods).
hi: Abdullah bin Umar se riwayat hai ki Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Islam (ki imaarat) paanch (bunyaadon) par khadi ki gayi hai, yaani sirf Allah ki ibaadat ki jaaye, aur uske alaawa (sab mabudon) ka inkaar kiya jaaye. Namaz qaayam karna, Zakat ada karna, Baitullah ka Hajj, aur Ramzan ke roze (baaki farz amal hain, Allah ki wahdaniyat par imaan aur baaki mabudon ke inkaar ke alaawa).

e: It is narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah son of 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: (The superstructure of) al-Islam is raised on five (pillars), testifying (the fact) that there is no god but Allah, that Muhammad is His bondsman and messenger, and the establishment of prayer, payment of Zakat, Pilgrimage to the House (Ka'ba) and the fast of Ramadan.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Islam (ki imaarat) paanch (bunyaadon) par khadi ki gayi hai, gawahi dena ki Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi aur Muhammad Uske bande aur Rasool hain, aur namaz qaayam karna, Zakat ada karna, Baitullah (Ka'ba) ka Hajj, aur Ramzan ke roze.

e: It is reported on the authority of Ta'us that a man said to 'Abdullah son of 'Umar (may Allah be pleased with him). Why don't you carry out a military expedition? Upon which he replied: I heard the messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: Verily, al-Islam is founded on five (pillars): testifying the fact that there is no god but Allah, establishment of prayer, payment of Zakat, fast of Ramadan and Pilgrimage to the House.
hi: Ta'us se riwayat hai ki ek shaks ne Abdullah bin Umar (Allah unse raazi ho) se kaha: Tum jihaad par kyun nahi jaate? Is par unhone jawaab diya: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Beshak Islam paanch (bunyaadon) par khada kiya gaya hai: gawahi dena ki Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, namaz qaayam karna, Zakat ada karna, Ramzan ke roze aur Baitullah ka Hajj.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that a delegation of Abdul Qais came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: Messenger of Allah, verily ours is a tribe of Rabi'a and there stand between you and us the unbelievers of Mudar and we find no freedom to come to you except in the sacred month. Direct us to an act which we should ourselves perform and invite those who live beside us. Upon this the Prophet remarked: I command you to do four things and prohibit you against four acts. (The four deeds which you are commanded to do are): Faith in Allah, and then he explained it for them and said: Testifying the fact. that there is no god but Allah, that Muhammad is the messenger of Allah, performance of prayer, payment of Zakat, that you pay Khums (one-fifth) of the booty fallen to your lot, and I prohibit you to use round gourd, wine jars, wooden pots or skins for wine. Khalaf b. Hisham has made this addition in his narration: Testifying the fact that there is no god but Allah, and then he with his finger pointed out the oneness of the Lord.
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ki Abdul Qais ka ek wafd (qaafila) Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, hum Rabi'a qabile se hain aur hamare aur aapke darmiyaan Mudar qabile ke kaafir hain, is liye hum sirf muharram (mahine) mein hi aapke paas aa paate hain. Humein wo amal bataiye jispar hum khud amal karein aur jo log hamare peeche hain unhein bhi bulaayein. Is par Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Main tumhein chaar cheezon ka hukum deta hoon aur chaar cheezon se mana karta hoon. (Jin chaar cheezon ka hukum diya gaya wo ye hain): Allah par Imaan, aur phir aap (SAW) ne isko waazeh kiya aur farmaya: Gawahi dena ki Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain, namaz ada karna, Zakat dena, aur ganeemat ka paanchwan hissa (Khums) ada karna, aur main tumhein gol tumbe (kaddu), sharaab ke matke, lakdi ke bartan ya sharaab ki mashkein istemaal karne se mana karta hoon. Khalaf bin Hisham ne apni riwayat mein ye izafa kiya hai: Gawahi dena ki Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, aur phir aap (SAW) ne apni ungli se Allah ki wahdaniyat ki taraf ishaara kiya.

e: Abu Jamra reported: I was an interpreter between Ibn Abbas and the people, that a woman happened to come there and asked about nabidh or the pitcher of wine. He replied: A delegation of the people of 'Abdul-Qais came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He (the Holy Prophet) asked the delegation or the people (of the delegation about their identity). They replied that they belonged to the tribe of Rabi'a. He (the Holy Prophet) welcomed the people or the delegation which were neither humiliated nor put to shame. They (the members of the delegation) said: Messenger of Allah, we come to you from a far-off distance and there lives between you and us a tribe of the unbelievers of Mudar and, therefore, it is not possible for us to come to you except in the sacred months. Thus direct us to a clear command, about which we should inform people beside us and by which we may enter heaven. He (the Holy Prophet) replied: I command you to do four deeds and forbid you to do four (acts), and added: I direct you to affirm belief in Allah alone, and then asked them: Do you know what belief in Allah really implies? They said: Allah and His Messenger know best. The Prophet said: It implies testimony to the fact that there is no god but Allah, and that Muhammad is the messenger of Allah, establishment of prayer, payment of Zakat, fast of Ramadan, that you pay one-fifth of the booty (fallen to your lot) and I forbid you to use gourd, wine jar, or a receptacle for wine. Shu'ba sometimes narrated the word naqir (wooden pot) and sometimes narrated it as muqayyar. The Prophet also said: Keep it in your mind and inform those who have been left behind.
hi: Abu Jamra ne bayan kiya: Main Ibn Abbas aur logon ke darmiyaan tarjuma karta tha, ki ek aurat aayi aur nabidh ya sharaab ke matke ke baare mein poocha. Unhone jawaab diya: Abdul-Qais qabile ka ek wafd Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aaya. Nabi (SAW) ne wafd ya un logon se unki pehchaan poochi. Unhone jawaab diya ki wo Rabi'a qabile se hain. Nabi (SAW) ne un logon ya us wafd ka khair-maqdam kiya jo na sharminda the na be-izzat. Unhone (wafd ke logon ne) kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, hum aapke paas ek lambi doori se aaye hain aur hamare aur aapke darmiyaan Mudar qabile ke kaafir rehte hain, is liye hum haram (muharram) mahinon ke alaawa aapke paas nahi aa sakte. Is liye humein koi saaf hukum dijiye, jiske baare mein hum apne peeche waalon ko bataayein aur jispar amal karke hum Jannat mein daakhil ho sakein. Aap (SAW) ne jawaab diya: Main tumhein chaar amal karne ka hukum deta hoon aur chaar cheezon se mana karta hoon, aur farmaya: Main tumhein sirf Allah par imaan laane ka hukum deta hoon, aur phir unse poocha: Kya tumhein pata hai Allah par imaan ka kya matlab hai? Unhone kaha: Allah aur Uske Rasool behtar jaante hain. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Iska matlab hai ye gawahi dena ki Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, aur Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain, namaz qaayam karna, Zakat ada karna, Ramzan ke roze rakhna, ganeemat ka paanchwan hissa (jo tumhein mile) ada karna, aur main tumhein kaddu, sharaab ke matke, ya sharaab ke bartan istemaal karne se mana karta hoon. Shu'ba kabhi 'naqir' (lakdi ka bartan) lafz istemaal karte the aur kabhi 'muqayyar'. Nabi (SAW) ne ye bhi farmaya: Ise yaad rakho aur jo peeche reh gaye hain unhein bataana.

e: There is another hadith narrated on the authority of Ibn Abbas (the contents of which are similar to the one) narrated by Shu'ba in which the Prophet (ﷺ) said: I forbid you to prepare nabidh in a gourd, hollowed block of wood, a varnished jar or receptacle. Ibn Mu'adh made this addition on the authority of his father that the Messenger of Allah said to Ashajj, of the tribe of 'Abdul-Qais: You possess two qualities which are liked by Allah: insight and deliberateness.
hi: Ibn Abbas se ek aur hadees riwayat hai (jiske mazmoon Shu'ba ki bayan ki gayi hadees jaisi hain) jismein Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Main tumhein kaddu, khokhle lakdi ke tukde, sharaab ke rangeen matke ya bartan mein nabidh banaane se mana karta hoon. Ibn Mu'adh ne apne waalid ki sanad se ye izafa kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Abdul-Qais ke Ashajj se kaha: Tummein do aisi khoobiyaan hain jo Allah ko pasand hain: hikmat aur sabr (dheeraj).

e: It is reported on the authority of Qatada that one among the delegates of the 'Abdul-Qais tribe narrated this tradition to him. Sa'id said that Qatada had mentioned the name of Abu Nadra on the authority of Abu Sa'id Khudri who narrated this tradition: That people from the- tribe of 'Abdul-Qais came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: Messenger of Allah, we belong to the tribe of Rabi'a and there live between you and us the unbelievers of the Mudar tribe and we find it impossible to come to you except in the sacred months; direct us to a deed which we must communicate to those who have been left behind us and by doing which we may enter heaven. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: I enjoin upon you four (things) and forbid you to do four (things): worship Allah and associate none with Him, establish prayer, pay Zakat, and observe the fast of Ramadan, and pay the fifth part out of the booty. And I prohibit you from four (things): dry gourds, green-coloured jars, hollowed stumps of palm-trees, and receptacles. They (the members of the delegation) said: Do you know what al-naqir is? He replied: Yes, it is a stump which you hollow out and in which you throw small dates. Sa'id said: He (the Holy Prophet) used the word tamar (dates). (The Prophet then added): Then you sprinkle water over it and when its ebullition subsides, you drink it (and you are so intoxicated) that one amongst you, or one amongst them (the other members of your tribe, who were not present there) strikes his cousin with the sword. He (the narrator) said: There was a man amongst us who had sustained injury on this very account due to (intoxication), and he told that he tried to conceal it out of shame from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). I, however, inquired from the Messenger of Allah (it we discard those utensils which you have forbidden us to use), then what type of vessels should be used for drink? He (the Holy Prophet) replied: In the waterskin the mouths of which are tied (with a string). They (again) said: Prophet of Allah, our land abounds in rats and water-skins cannot remain preserved. The holy Prophet of Allah (ﷺ) said: (Drink in water-skins) even if these arenibbled by rats. And then (addressing) al-Ashajj of 'Abdul-Qais he said: Verily, you possess two such qualities which Allah loves: insight and deliberateness.
hi: Qatada se riwayat hai ki Abdul-Qais qabile ke wafd mein se ek ne unhein ye riwayat sunayi. Sa'id ne kaha ki Qatada ne is hadees mein Abu Nadra ka naam liya jo Abu Sa'id Khudri ki sanad se hai jinhone ye riwayat bayan ki: Ki Abdul-Qais qabile ke kuch log Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, hum Rabi'a qabile se hain aur hamare aur aapke darmiyaan Mudar qabile ke kaafir rehte hain aur hum haram mahinon ke alaawa aapke paas nahi aa sakte; humein wo amal bataiye jo hum apne peeche walon tak pahunchayein aur jispar amal karke hum Jannat mein daakhil ho sakein. Is par Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Main tumhein chaar cheezon ka hukum deta hoon aur chaar cheezon se mana karta hoon: Allah ki ibaadat karo aur uske saath kisi ko shareek na karo, namaz qaayam karo, Zakat do, Ramzan ke roze rakho, aur ganeemat ka paanchwan hissa ada karo. Aur main tumhein in chaar cheezon se mana karta hoon: sookhe kaddu, hare rang ke matke, khajoor ke khokhle tanon (se bane bartan), aur (rangeen/lipe hue) bartan. Unhone (wafd ke logon ne) kaha: Kya aapko pata hai al-naqir kya hai? Aap (SAW) ne jawaab diya: Haan, ye khajoor ke tane ka wo hissa hai jise khokhla kiya jaata hai aur usmein chhoti khajoorein daali jaati hain. Sa'id ne kaha ki Nabi (SAW) ne 'tamar' (khajoorein) lafz istemaal kiya. (Phir Nabi SAW ne farmaya): Phir tum usmein paani dalte ho aur jab uska ubaal (josh) kam ho jaata hai to tum use peete ho (aur itne nashe mein aa jaate ho) ki tum mein se koi, ya tumhare qabile ka koi (jo wahan maujood nahi tha) apne chachere bhai ko talwaar se maar deta hai. Raawi ne kaha ki hamare beech ek shaks tha jise isi wajah se (nashe ki halat mein) chot lagi thi, aur usne bataaya ki wo Rasoolullah (SAW) se sharminda hokar ise chhupaata tha. Maine phir Rasoolullah (SAW) se poocha (agar hum in bartanon ko chhod dein jinke istemaal se aapne mana kiya hai), to hum kin bartanon mein piyein? Aap (SAW) ne jawaab diya: Aisi mashk mein jiska muh (dori se) bandha ho. Unhone (phir) kaha: Ya Nabiullah, hamari zameen mein bahut chuhe hain aur mashkein zyada dair tak nahi tikti. Is par Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: (Isi mein piyo) chaahe chuhe ise kaatein bhi. Aur phir (Abdul-Qais ke) Ashajj se mukhaatib hokar aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Beshak tummein do aisi khoobiyaan hain jo Allah ko pasand hain: hikmat aur sabr (dheeraj).

e: The above hadith has been mentioned with a different chain and slightly different wording.
hi: Upar wali hadees ek doosri sanad se aur thode alag alfaaz mein bhi bayan ki gayi hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Said al-Khudri that when the delegation of the tribe of Abdul-Qais came to the Prophet of Allah (ﷺ), (its members) said: Apostle of Allah, may God enable us to lay down our lives for you, which beverage is good for us? He (the Prophet) said: (Not to speak of beverages, I would lay stress) that you should not drink in the wine jars. They said: Apostle of Allah, may God enable us to lay down our lives for you, do you know what al-naqir is? He (the Holy Prophet) replied: Yes, it is a stump which you hollow out in the middle, and added: Do not use gourd or receptacle (for drink). Use water-skin the mouth of which is tied with a thong (for this purpose).
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri se riwayat hai ki jab Abdul-Qais qabile ka wafd Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya, (uske logon ne) kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, Allah hamari jaanein aapke liye qurbaan kare, hamare liye kaunsa mashroob theek hai? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: (Mashroobaat ki baat chhodo, main is par zor doonga) ki tum sharaab ke matkon mein na piyo. Unhone kaha: Ya Nabiullah, Allah hamari jaanein aapke liye qurbaan kare, kya aapko pata hai al-naqir kya hai? Aap (SAW) ne jawaab diya: Haan, ye khajoor ke tane ka wo hissa hai jise beech se khokhla kiya jaata hai, aur farmaya: Kaddu ya bartan istemaal na karo. Iske liye mashk istemaal karo jiska muh dori se bandha ho.

e: It is reported on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that Mu'adh said: The Messenger of Allah sent me (as a governor of Yemen) and (at the time of departure) instructed me thus: You will soon find yourself in a community one among the people of the Book, so first call them to testify that there is no god but Allah, that I (Muhammad) am the messenger of Allah, and if they accept this, then tell them Allah has enjoined upon them five prayers during the day and the night and if they accept it, then tell them that Allah has made Zakat obligatory for them that it should be collected from the rich and distributed among the poor, and if they agree to it don't pick up (as a share of Zakat) the best of their wealths. Beware of the supplication of the oppressed for there is no barrier between him and Allah.
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ki Mu'adh ne kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne mujhe (Yemen ka governor bana kar) bheja aur (rawaana hote waqt) ye hidaayat di: Tum jald hi ek aisi qaum ke paas jaoge jo Ahl-e-Kitaab mein se hai, is liye sabse pehle unhein iski gawahi dene ki dawat do ki Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, aur main (Muhammad) Allah ka Rasool hoon, aur agar wo isko qubool kar lein, to unhein bataana ki Allah ne unpar din aur raat mein paanch namazein farz ki hain, aur agar wo isko qubool kar lein, to unhein bataana ki Allah ne unpar Zakat farz ki hai jo unke maal-daaron se li jaayegi aur unke gareebon mein baanti jaayegi, aur agar wo is par raazi ho jaayein, to unke behtareen maal ko (Zakat ke hisse mein) mat lena. Mazloom ki dua se bacho, kyunki uske aur Allah ke darmiyaan koi parda nahi hota.

e: The above hadith has been mentioned with a different chain with a slightly different wording at the beginning, then follows the same.
hi: Upar wali hadees ek doosri sanad se aur shuru mein thode alag alfaaz ke saath bhi bayan ki gayi hai, phir wahi (mazmoon) chalta hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent Mu'adh towards Yemen (as governor) he said to him: Verily you would reach a community of the people of the Book, the very first thing to which you should call them is the worship of Allah, may His Glory be Magnificent, and when they become fully aware of Allah, instruct them that He has enjoined five prayers on them during the day and the night, and when they begin observing it, then instruct them that verily Allah has made Zakat obligatory for them which would be collected from the wealthy amongst them and distributed to their needy ones, and when they submit to it, then collect it from them and avoid (the temptation) of selecting the best (items) of their riches.
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ki jab Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Mu'adh ko Yemen (governor bana kar) bheja to unse farmaya: Tum Ahl-e-Kitaab ki ek qaum tak pahunchoge, sabse pehli cheez jiski taraf tum unhein bulaao wo Allah Azza wa Jal ki ibaadat hai, aur jab wo Allah ko poori tarah pehchaan lein, to unhein bataana ki Allah ne unpar din aur raat mein paanch namazein farz ki hain, aur jab wo isko qaayam karna shuru kar dein, to unhein bataana ki Allah ne unpar Zakat farz ki hai jo unke maal-daaron se li jaayegi aur unke zaroormandon mein baanti jaayegi, aur jab wo isko qubool kar lein, to unse Zakat wusool karo aur unke behtareen maal chunne ke lalach se bacho.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) breathed his last and Abu Bakr was appointed as his successor (Caliph), those amongst the Arabs who wanted to become apostates became apostates. 'Umar b. Khattab said to Abu Bakr: Why would you fight against the people, when the Messenger of Allah declared: I have been directed to fight against people so long as they do not say: There is no god but Allah, and he who professed it was granted full protection of his property and life on my behalf except for a right? His (other) affairs rest with Allah. Upon this Abu Bakr said: By Allah, I would definitely fight against him who severed prayer from Zakat, for it is the obligation upon the rich. By Allah, I would fight against them even to secure the cord (used for hobbling the feet of a camel) which they used to give to the Messenger of Allah (as zakat) but now they have withheld it. Umar b. Khattab remarked: By Allah, I found nothing but the fact that Allah had opened the heart of Abu Bakr for (perceiving the justification of) fighting (against those who refused to pay Zakat) and I fully recognized that the (stand of Abu Bakr) was right.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki jab Rasoolullah (SAW) ka wisaal ho gaya aur Abu Bakr (RA) khalifa bana diye gaye, to Arabon mein se jo log murtad hona chahte the wo murtad ho gaye. Umar bin Khattab (RA) ne Abu Bakr (RA) se kaha: Aap logon se kaise ladenge, jabki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya tha: Mujhe hukum diya gaya hai ki main logon se tab tak ladun jab tak wo ye na kahein ki Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, aur jisne ye kaha, uski jaan aur maal ki hifazat meri taraf se ho gayi, sivaay uske haq ke? Uske baaki maamlaat Allah par hain. Is par Abu Bakr (RA) ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, main zaroor us shaks se ladunga jo namaz aur Zakat ke darmiyaan farq karega, kyunki Zakat maal ka haq hai. Allah ki qasam, agar wo log mujhe wo rassi (jo oont ke pair baandhne ke liye istemaal hoti thi) bhi dene se inkaar karein jo wo Rasoolullah (SAW) ko Zakat mein diya karte the lekin ab rok rahe hain, to main unse zaroor ladunga. Umar bin Khattab (RA) ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, mujhe yahi samajh aaya ki Allah ne Abu Bakr (RA) ka seena is ladaai (ke jaayaz hone) ke liye khol diya tha, aur main poori tarah samajh gaya ki Abu Bakr (RA) ka mauqif haq par tha.

e: It is reported on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah said: I have been commanded to fight against people so long as they do not declare that there is no god but Allah, and he who professed it was guaranteed the protection of his property and life on my behalf except for the right affairs rest with Allah.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Mujhe hukum diya gaya hai ki main logon se tab tak ladun jab tak wo ye elaan na karein ki Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, aur jisne ye kaha, uske maal aur jaan ki hifazat meri taraf se guarantee kar di gayi, sivaay haq ke - baaki maamlaat Allah par hain.

e: It is reported on the authority of Abu Huraira that he heard the Messenger of Allah say: I have been commanded to fight against people, till they testify to the fact that there is no god but Allah, and believe in me (that) I am the messenger (from the Lord) and in all that I have brought. And when they do it, their blood and riches are guaranteed protection on my behalf except where it is justified by law, and their affairs rest with Allah.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Mujhe hukum diya gaya hai ki main logon se tab tak ladun, jab tak wo ye gawahi na dein ki Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, aur mujh par (ye) imaan na laayein ki main (Allah ki taraf se) Rasool hoon aur jo kuch main laaya hoon uspar bhi. Aur jab wo aisa kar lein, to unka khoon aur maal meri taraf se guarantee shuda hoga, sivaay uske jo haq ke tehat ho, aur unke maamlaat Allah par hain.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Jabir that the Messenger of Allah said: I have been commanded that I should fight against people till they declare that there is no god but Allah, and when they profess it that there is no god but Allah, their blood and riches are guaranteed protection on my behalf except where it is justified by law, and their affairs rest with Allah, and then he (the Holy Prophet) recited (this verse of the Holy Qur'an):" Thou art not over them a warden" (lxxxviii, 22).
hi: Jabir se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Mujhe hukum diya gaya hai ki main logon se tab tak ladun jab tak wo ye elaan na karein ki Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, aur jab wo elaan kar dein ki Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, to unka khoon aur maal meri taraf se guarantee shuda hoga, sivaay uske jo haq ke tehat ho, aur unke maamlaat Allah par hain, phir aap (SAW) ne (Quran ki) ye aayat tilaawat farmaayi: "Tum unpar daroga (nigraan) nahi ho" (88:22).

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abdullah b. 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah said: I have been commanded to fight against people till they testify that there is no god but Allah, that Muhammad is the messenger of Allah, and they establish prayer, and pay Zakat and if they do it, their blood and property are guaranteed protection on my behalf except when justified by law, and their affairs rest with Allah.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Mujhe hukum diya gaya hai ki main logon se tab tak ladun jab tak wo ye gawahi na dein ki Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, ki Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain, aur wo namaz qaayam karein, aur Zakat ada karein, aur agar wo aisa kar lein, to unka khoon aur maal meri taraf se guarantee shuda hoga, sivaay uske jo haq ke tehat ho, aur unke maamlaat Allah par hain.

e: It Is narrated on the authority of Abu Malik: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: He who professed that there is no god but Allah and made a denial of everything which the people worship beside Allah, his property and blood became inviolable, an their affairs rest with Allah.
hi: Abu Malik se riwayat hai: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jisne ye elaan kiya ki Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi aur us har cheez ka inkaar kiya jiski ibaadat log Allah ke siwa karte hain, uska maal aur khoon mahfooz ho gaya, aur unke maamlaat Allah par hain.

e: Abu Malik narrated on the authority of his father that he heard the Apostle (ﷺ) say: He who held belief in the unity of Allah, and then narrated what has been stated above.
hi: Abu Malik ne apne waalid ki sanad se bayan kiya ki unhone Nabi (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jisne Allah ki wahdaniyat par imaan rakha, phir usne wahi bayan kiya jo upar bayan hua hai.

e:
It is reported by Sa'id b. Musayyib who narrated it on the authority of his father (Musayyib b. Hazm) that when Abu Talib was about to die, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to him and found with him Abu Jahl ('Amr b. Hisham) and 'Abdullah b. Abi Umayya ibn al-Mughirah. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: My uncle, you just make a profession that there is no god but Allah, and I will bear testimony before Allah (of your being a believer), Abu Jahl and 'Abdullah b. Abi Umayya addressing him said: Abu Talib, would you abandon the religion of 'Abdul-Muttalib? The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) constantly requested him (to accept his offer), and (on the other hand) was repeated the same statement (of Abu Jahl and 'Abdullah b. Abi Umayya) till Abu Talib gave his final decision and be stuck to the religion of 'Abdul-Muttalib and refused to profess that there is no god but Allah. Upon this the Messenger of Allah remarked: By Allah, I will persistently beg pardon for you till I am forbidden to do so (by God), It was then that Allah, the Magnificent and the Glorious, revealed this verse: 
" It is not meet for the Prophet and for those who believe that they should beg pardon for the polytheists, even though they were their kith and kin, after it had been made known to them that they were the denizens of Hell" (ix. 113) 
And it was said to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): 
" Verily thou canst not guide to the right path whom thou lovest. And it is Allah Who guideth whom He will, and He knoweth best who are the guided" (xxviii, 56).
hi: Sa'id bin Musayyib apne waalid (Musayyib bin Hazm) ki sanad se bayan karte hain ki jab Abu Talib marne ke kareeb the, to Rasoolullah (SAW) unke paas tashreef laaye aur unke paas Abu Jahl (Amr bin Hisham) aur Abdullah bin Abi Umayya bin al-Mughirah ko paaya. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Chacha jaan, aap sirf ye kalima keh dijiye ki Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, aur main Allah ke saamne aapke haq mein gawahi dunga (ki aap momin hain). Abu Jahl aur Abdullah bin Abi Umayya ne unse mukhaatib hokar kaha: Abu Talib, kya aap Abdul-Muttalib ke deen se munh mod loge? Rasoolullah (SAW) barabar unhein ye pesh karte rahe (unse ye qubool karne ki darkhwaast karte rahe), aur doosri taraf wo (Abu Jahl aur Abdullah bin Abi Umayya) baar-baar wahi baat dohraate rahe, yahan tak ki Abu Talib ne apna aakhri faisla sunaa diya ki wo Abdul-Muttalib ke deen par hi rahenge, aur ye kehne se inkaar kar diya ki Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi. Is par Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Allah ki qasam, main tumhare liye tab tak istighfaar karta rahunga jab tak mujhe (Allah ki taraf se) mana na kar diya jaaye. Isi mauqe par Allah Azza wa Jal ne ye aayat nazil ki: "Nabi aur imaan waalon ke liye ye jaayaz nahi ki wo mushrikeen ke liye maghfirat ki dua karein, chaahe wo unke rishtedaar hi kyun na hon, jab unpar ye zaahir ho chuka ho ki wo jahannami hain" (9:113). Aur Rasoolullah (SAW) se kaha gaya: "Beshak tum jise chaho use hidaayat nahi de sakte, balki Allah jise chaahta hai use hidaayat deta hai, aur wo hidaayat paane walon ko khoob jaanta hai" (28:56).

e: The same hadith is mentioned through a different chain except it ends where it mentions that Allah revealed the verses and it does not mention the verses.  There is also a slight variation in words.
hi: Yahi hadees ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki gayi hai, sivaay iske ki wo wahin khatam ho jaati hai jahan Allah ke aayat nazil karne ka zikr hai, aur usmein aayaton ka zikr nahi hai. Alfaaz mein bhi thoda farq hai.

e:
It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah said to his uncle at the time of his death: Make a profession of it that there is no god but Allah and I will bear testimony (of your being a Muslim) on the Day of judgment. But he (Abu Talib) refused to do so. Then Allah revealed this verse: 
" Verily thou canst not guide to the right path whom thou lovest. And it is Allah Who guideth whom He will and He knoweth best who are the guided" (xxviii. 56).
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne apne chacha se unki maut ke waqt kaha: Ye kalima keh dijiye ki Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, aur main Qayamat ke Din aapke haq mein gawahi dunga (ki aap Musalman the). Lekin unhone (Abu Talib ne) aisa karne se inkaar kar diya. Tab Allah ne ye aayat nazil ki: "Beshak tum jise chaho use hidaayat nahi de sakte, balki Allah jise chaahta hai use hidaayat deta hai, aur wo hidaayat paane walon ko khoob jaanta hai" (28:56).

e:
It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah said to his uncle (at the time of his death): Make a profession of it that there is no god but Allah and I will bear testimony (of your being a Muslim) on the Day of judgment. He (Abu Talib) said: Were it not the fear of the Quraysh blaming me (and) saying that it was the fear of (approaching death) that induced me to do so, I would have certainly delighted your eyes. It was then that Allah revealed: 
" Verily thou canst not guide to the right path whom thou lovest. And it is Allah Who guideth whom He will and He knoweth best who are the guided" (xxviii-56).
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne apne chacha se (unki maut ke waqt) kaha: Ye kalima keh dijiye ki Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, aur main Qayamat ke Din aapke haq mein gawahi dunga (ki aap Musalman the). Unhone (Abu Talib ne) kaha: Agar mujhe Quraish ke taane ka dar na hota ki wo kahenge ki maut ke khauf ne mujhe aisa karne par majboor kiya, to main zaroor ye kehkar tumhari aankhein thanda karta. Tab Allah ne ye nazil farmaaya: "Beshak tum jise chaho use hidaayat nahi de sakte, balki Allah jise chaahta hai use hidaayat deta hai, aur wo hidaayat paane walon ko khoob jaanta hai" (28:56).

e: It is narrated on the authority of 'Uthman that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said. He who died knowing (fully well) that there is no god but Allah entered Paradise.
hi: Uthman se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jo shaks ye poori tarah jaante hue mara ki Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, wo Jannat mein daakhil ho gaya.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Humran that he heard Uthman saying this: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) uttering these words (as stated above).
hi: Humran se riwayat hai ki unhone Uthman ko ye kehte suna: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye alfaaz kehte suna (jaisa upar bayan hua).

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira: We were accompanying the Apostle (ﷺ) in a march (towards Tabuk). He (the narrator) said: The provisions with the people were almost depleted. He (the narrator) said: (And the situation became so critical) that they (the men of the army) decided to slaughter some of their camels. He (the narrator) said: Upon this Umar said: Messenger of Allah, I wish that you should pool together what has been left out of the provisions with the people and then invoke (the blessings of) Allah upon it. He (the narrator) said: He (the Holy Prophet) did it accordingly. He (the narrator) said: The one who had wheat in his possession came there with wheat. He who had dates with him came there with dates. And Mujahid said: He who possessed stones of dates came there with stones. I (the narrator) said: What did they do with the date-stones. They said: They (the people) sucked them and then drank water over them. He (the narrator said): He (the Holy Prophet) invoked the blessings (of Allah) upon them (provisions). He (the narrator) said: (And there was such a miraculous increase in the stocks) that the people replenished their provisions fully. He (the narrator) said: At that time he (the Holy Prophet) said: I bear testimony to the fact that there is no god but Allah, and I am His messenger. The bondsman who would meet Allah without entertaining any doubt about these (two fundamentals) would enter heaven.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai: Hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath (Tabuk ki taraf) ek march mein saath the. Raawi ne kaha: Logon ka sazo-saamaan taqreeban khatam ho chuka tha. Raawi ne kaha: (Aur halaat itne mushkil ho gaye) ki fauj ke logon ne apne kuch oont zibah karne ka faisla kar liya. Raawi ne kaha: Is par Umar (RA) ne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, main chaahta hoon ki aap logon ke paas jo bacha hua sazo-saamaan hai use ikattha kar lein aur phir us par Allah ki barkat ki dua karein. Raawi ne kaha: Aap (SAW) ne aisa hi kiya. Raawi ne kaha: Jiske paas gehun tha wo gehun le aaya. Jiske paas khajoorein thi wo khajoorein le aaya. Aur Mujahid ne kaha: Jiske paas khajoor ki gutliyaan thi wo gutliyaan le aaya. Maine (raawi ne) poocha: Log gutliyon ka kya karte the. Unhone kaha: Log unhein chooste the aur upar se paani pee lete the. Raawi ne kaha: Aap (SAW) ne un (cheezon) par barkat ki dua ki. Raawi ne kaha: (Aur is qadar mojiza-numa izafa hua) ki logon ne apna sazo-saamaan poori tarah bhar liya. Raawi ne kaha: Us waqt aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Main gawahi deta hoon ki Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, aur main Uska Rasool hoon. Jo banda in do (bunyaadi baaton) mein koi shaq kiye bagair Allah se milega, wo zaroor Jannat mein daakhil hoga.

e: It is narrated either on the authority of Abu Huraira or that of Abu Sa'id Khudri. The narrator A'mash has narrated this hadith with a little bit of doubt (about the name of the very first narrator who was in direct contact with the Holy Prophet. He was either Abu Huraira or Abu Sa'id Khudri. Both are equally reliable transmitters of the traditions). He (the narrator) said: During the time of Tabuk expedition, the (provisions) ran short and the men (of the army) suffered starvation; they said: Messenger of Allah, would you permit us to slay our camels? We would eat them and use their fat. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Do as you please. He (the narrator) said: Then 'Umar came there and said: Messenger of Allah, if you do that (if you give your consent and the men begin to slay their camels), the riding animals would become short. But (I would suggest you to) summon them along with the provisions left with them Then invoke Allah's blessings on them (different items of the provisions) It is hoped Allah shall bless them. The Messenger of Allah replied in the affirmative. (the narrator) said: He called for a leather mat to be used as a table cloth and spread it out. Then he called people along with the remaining portions of their provisions. He (the narrator) said: Someone was coming with handful of mote, another was coming with a handful of dates, still another was coming with a portion of bread, till small quantities of these things were collected on the table cloth. He (the narrator said): Then the messenger of Allah invoked blessing (on them) and said: Fill your utensils with these provisions. He (the narrator) said: They filled their vessel to the brim with them, and no one amongst the army (which comprised of 30,000 persons) was left even with a single empty vessel. He (the narrator) aid: They ate to their fill, and there was still a surplus. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) remarked: I bear testimony that there is no god but Allah and I am the messenger of Allah. The man who meets his Lord without harboring any doubt about these two (truths) would never be kept away from Paradise.
hi: Ya to Abu Huraira ya Abu Sa'id Khudri se riwayat hai. Raawi A'mash ne is hadees ko thodi si shak (pehle raawi ke naam mein, jo seedha Nabi SAW se mila tha, wo ya Abu Huraira thay ya Abu Sa'id Khudri - dono hi ekaan-etbaar riwayat karne wale hain) ke saath bayan kiya hai. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Tabuk ke safar ke dauraan, (sazo-saamaan) kam ho gaya aur fauj ke logon ko bhookh ka saamna karna pada; unhone kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, kya aap humein apne oont zibah karne ki ijaazat denge? Hum unhein khaayenge aur unki charbi istemaal karenge. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jo tumhein achha lage karo. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Phir Umar (RA) wahan aaye aur kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, agar aap aisa karte hain (agar aap ijaazat de dein aur log apne oont zibah karna shuru kar dein), to sawaari ke jaanwar kam ho jayenge. Lekin (main mashwara deta hoon ki) unhein unke bache hue sazo-saamaan ke saath bulaao. Phir un (sazo-saamaan ki alag-alag cheezon) par Allah ki barkat ki dua karo. Ummeed hai Allah unhein barkat dega. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne haan mein jawaab diya. Raawi ne kaha: Aap (SAW) ne dastarkhwaan bichane ke liye ek chamda mangwaaya aur use bicha diya. Phir aap (SAW) ne logon ko unke bache hue sazo-saamaan ke saath bulaaya. Raawi ne kaha: Koi mutthi bhar chana leke aa raha tha, koi mutthi bhar khajoorein le aa raha tha, koi roti ka tukda le aa raha tha, yahan tak ki thodi-thodi maqdaar mein ye cheezein dastarkhwaan par jama ho gayi. Raawi ne kaha: Phir Rasoolullah (SAW) ne (in par) barkat ki dua ki aur farmaya: Apne bartan in cheezon se bhar lo. Raawi ne kaha: Unhone apne bartan lab-alab bhar liye, aur fauj (jismein 30,000 log the) mein se koi bhi khaali bartan ke saath nahi raha. Raawi ne kaha: Unhone pet bhar kar khaaya, aur phir bhi (kuch) bach gaya. Is par Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Main gawahi deta hoon ki Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi aur main Allah ka Rasool hoon. Jo shaks apne Rab se milega aur in dono (haqeeqaton) mein koi shaq na rakhta ho, use kabhi Jannat se door nahi rakha jaayega.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Ubadah b. Samit that the messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed: He who said:" There is no god but Allah, He is One and there is no associate with Him, that Muhammad is his servant and His messenger, that Christ is servant and the son of His slave-girl and he (Christ) His word which He communicated to Mary and is His Spirit, that Paradise is a fact and Hell is a fact," Allah would make him (he who affirms these truths enter Paradise through any one of its eight doors which he would like.
hi: Ubadah bin Samit se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jisne kaha: "Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, wo akela hai aur uska koi shareek nahi, Muhammad uske bande aur uske Rasool hain, Isa uske bande hain aur uski laundi (Maryam) ke bete hain, aur uska Kalima hai jo usne Maryam tak pahunchaya, aur uski taraf se ek Rooh hai, ki Jannat haq hai aur Jahannam haq hai," Allah use (jisne ye haqaaiq tasleem kiye) Jannat ke aath darwazon mein se jis se chaahe daakhil kar dega.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Umar b. Hani with the same chain of transmitters with the exception of these words: Allah would make him (he who affirms these truths) enter Paradise through one of the eight doors which he would like.
hi: Umar bin Hani ki sanad se ek jaisi hi hadees riwayat ki gayi hai, sivaay in alfaaz ke: Allah use (jisne ye haqaaiq tasleem kiye) Jannat ke aath darwazon mein se jis se chaahe daakhil kar dega.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Sunabihi that he went to Ubada b. Samit when he was about to die. I burst into tears. Upon this he said to me: Allow me some time (so that I may talk with you). Why do you weep? By Allah, if I am asked to bear witness, I would certainly testify for you (that you are a believer). Should I be asked to intercede, I would certainly intercede for you, and if I have the power, I would certainly do good to you, and then observed: By Allah, never did I hear anything from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) which could have been a source of benefit to you and then not conveyed it to you except this single hadith. That I intend to narrate to you today, since I am going to breathe my last. I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: He who testifies that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the messenger of Allah, Allah would prohibit the fire of Hell for him.
hi: Sunabihi se riwayat hai ki wo Ubadah bin Samit ke paas gaye jab wo marne ke kareeb the. Main ro pada. Is par unhone (Ubadah ne) mujhse kaha: Mujhe thoda waqt do (taaki main tumse baat kar sakoon). Tum kyun ro rahe ho? Allah ki qasam, agar mujhse gawahi maangi jaaye, to main zaroor tumhare haq mein gawahi dunga (ki tum momin ho). Agar mujhse sifaarish karne ko kaha jaaye, to main zaroor tumhari sifaarish karunga, aur agar mujhme taaqat ho, to main zaroor tumhare saath bhalaai karunga, phir unhone farmaya: Allah ki qasam, maine kabhi Rasoolullah (SAW) se koi aisi baat nahi suni jo tumhare liye faaydemand ho aur maine wo tumhein na pahunchayi ho, sivaay is ek hadees ke. Jo main aaj tumhein sunane ja raha hoon, kyunki main apni aakhri saans lene wala hoon. Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jisne gawahi di ki Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi aur Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain, Allah uspar Jahannam ki aag haraam kar dega.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Mu'adh b. Jabal: I was riding behind the Prophet (ﷺ) and there was nothing between him and me but the rear part of the saddle, when he said: Mu'adh b. Jabal: To which I replied: At your beck and call, and at your pleasure, Messenger of Allah! He moved along for a few minutes, when again he said: Mu'adh b. Jabal: To which I replied: At your beck and call, and at your pleasure, Messenger of Allah! He then again moved along for a few minutes and said: Mu'adh b. Jabal: To which I replied. At your beck and call, and at your pleasure. Messenger of Allah He, (the Holy Prophet) said: Do you know what right has Allah upon His servants? I said: Allah and His Messenger know best. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Verily the right of Allah over His servants is that they should worship Him, not associating anything with Him. He (the Holy Prophet) with Mu'adh behind him, moved along for a few minutes and said: Mu'adh b. Jabal: To which I replied: At your beck and call, and at your pleasure, Messenger of Allah! He (the Holy Prophet) said: Do you know what rights have servants upon Allah in case they do it (i. e. they worship Allah without associating anything with Him)? I (Mu'adh b. Jabal) replied: Allah and His Messenger know best. (Upon this) he (the Holy Prophet) remarked: That He would not torment them (with the fire of Hell).
hi: Mu'adh bin Jabal se riwayat hai: Main Nabi (SAW) ke peeche sawaar tha aur unke aur mere darmiyaan pichhle zeen ke alaawa kuch nahi tha, jab unhone kaha: Mu'adh bin Jabal! Maine jawaab diya: Haazir hoon aur aapki khushi ke liye, Ya Rasoolullah! Aap kuch der chalte rahe, phir dobara kaha: Mu'adh bin Jabal! Maine jawaab diya: Haazir hoon aur aapki khushi ke liye, Ya Rasoolullah! Phir aap kuch der aur chalte rahe aur kaha: Mu'adh bin Jabal!
