Maine jawaab diya: Haazir hoon aur aapki khushi ke liye, Ya Rasoolullah! Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Kya tumhein pata hai Allah ka apne bandon par kya haq hai? Maine kaha: Allah aur Uske Rasool behtar jaante hain. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Beshak Allah ka apne bandon par haq ye hai ki wo uski ibaadat karein, uske saath kisi ko shareek na karein. Aap (SAW), Mu'adh ko apne peeche liye, kuch der aur chale aur kaha: Mu'adh bin Jabal! Maine jawaab diya: Haazir hoon aur aapki khushi ke liye, Ya Rasoolullah! Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Kya tumhein pata hai bandon ka Allah par kya haq hai agar wo aisa karein (yaani Allah ki ibaadat karein aur uske saath kisi ko shareek na karein)? Maine (Mu'adh bin Jabal ne) jawaab diya: Allah aur Uske Rasool behtar jaante hain. (Is par) aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Ye ki wo unhein (Jahannam ki aag se) azaab nahi dega.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Mu'adh b. Jabal that he observed: I was riding behind the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on an ass known as 'Ufair. He (Mu'adh) observed: He (the Holy Prophet) said: Mu'adh, do you know what right has Allah over His bondsmen and what right have His bondsmen over Him? Mu'adh added: I replied: Allah and his Messenger know best. Upon this he (the Prophet remarked: The right of Allah over His bondsmen is that they should worship Allah and should not associate anything with Him, and the right of His bondsmen over Allah, Glorious and Sublime, is that He does not punish him who associates not anything with Him. He (Mu'adh) added: I said to the Messenger of Allah: Should I then give the tidings to the people? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Do not tell them this good news, for they would trust in it alone.
hi: Mu'adh bin Jabal se riwayat hai ki unhone kaha: Main Rasoolullah (SAW) ke peeche ek gadhe par sawaar tha jise 'Ufair' kaha jaata tha. Unhone (Mu'adh ne) kaha: Aap (SAW) ne kaha: Mu'adh, kya tumhein pata hai Allah ka apne bandon par kya haq hai aur bandon ka Allah par kya haq hai? Mu'adh ne kaha: Maine jawaab diya: Allah aur Uske Rasool behtar jaante hain. Is par aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Allah ka apne bandon par haq ye hai ki wo Allah ki ibaadat karein aur uske saath kisi ko shareek na karein, aur uske bandon ka Allah, Jalle Jalaaluhu, par haq ye hai ki wo us shaks ko azaab na de jo uske saath kisi ko shareek na kare. Unhone (Mu'adh ne) kaha: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) se kaha: To kya main logon ko ye khushkhabri de doon? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Unhe ye khushkhabri mat do, kyunki wo sirf isi par bharosa kar baithenge.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Mu'adh b. Jabal that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Mu'adh, do you know the right of Allah over His bondsmen? He (Mu'adh) said: Allah and His Apostle know best. He (the Messenger of Allah) said: That Allah alone should be worshipped and nothing should be associated with Him. He (the Holy Prophet) said: What right have they (bondsmen) upon Him in case they do it? He (Mu'adh) said: Allah and His Apostle know best. He (the Holy Prophet) said: That He would not punish them.
hi: Mu'adh bin Jabal se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Mu'adh, kya tumhein Allah ka apne bandon par haq maloom hai? Unhone (Mu'adh ne) kaha: Allah aur Uske Rasool behtar jaante hain. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Ye ki sirf Allah ki ibaadat ki jaaye aur uske saath kisi ko shareek na kiya jaaye. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Aur agar wo (bande) aisa karein, to unka Allah par kya haq hai? Unhone (Mu'adh ne) kaha: Allah aur Uske Rasool behtar jaante hain. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Ye ki wo unhein azaab nahi dega.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Aswad b. Hilal that he heard Mu'adh say this: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) called, me and I replied to him. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Do you know the right of Allah upon the people? and then followed the hadith (mentioned above).
hi: Aswad bin Hilal se riwayat hai ki unhone Mu'adh ko ye kehte suna: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne mujhe bulaaya aur maine unhein jawaab diya. Aap (SAW) ne kaha: Kya tumhein Allah ka logon par haq maloom hai? aur phir (upar bayan ki gayi) hadees dohraayi.

e: It is reported on the authority of Abu Huraira: We were sitting around the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him). Abu Bakr and Umar were also there among the audience. In the meanwhile the Messenger of Allah got up and left us, He delayed in coming back to us, which caused anxiety that he might be attacked by some enemy when we were not with him; so being alarmed we got up. I was the first to be alarmed. I, therefore, went out to look for the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) and came to a garden belonging to the Banu an-Najjar, a section of the Ansar went round it looking for a gate but failed to find one. Seeing a rabi' (i. e. streamlet) flowing into the garden from a well outside, drew myself together, like a fox, and slinked into (the place) where God's Messenger was. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Is it Abu Huraira? I (Abu Huraira) replied: Yes, Messenger of Allah. He (the Holy Prophet) said: What is the matter with you? replied: You were amongst us but got up and went away and delayed for a time, so fearing that you might be attacked by some enemy when we were not with you, we became alarmed. I was the first to be alarmed. So when I came to this garden, I drew myself together as a fox does, and these people are following me. He addressed me as Abu Huraira and gave me his sandals and said: Take away these sandals of mine, and when you meet anyone outside this garden who testifies that there is no god but Allah, being assured of it in his heart, gladden him by announcing that he shall go to Paradise. Now the first one I met was Umar. He asked: What are these sandals, Abu Huraira? I replied: These are the sandals of the Messenger of Allah with which he has sent me to gladden anyone I meet who testifies that there is no god but Allah, being assured of it in his heart, with the announcement that he would go to Paradise. Thereupon 'Umar struck me on the breast and I fell on my back. He then said: Go back, Abu Huraira, So I returned to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and was about to break into tears. 'Umar followed me closely and there he was behind me. The Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be on him) said: What is the matter with you, Abu Huraira? I said: I happened to meet 'Umar and conveyed to him the message with which you sent me. He struck me on my breast which made me fall down upon my back and ordered me to go back. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: What prompted you to do this, 'Umar? He said: Messenger of Allah, my mother and father be sacrificed to thee, did you send Abu Huraira with your sandals to gladden anyone he met and who testified that there is no god but Allah, and being assured of it in his heart, with the tidings that he would go to Paradise? He said: Yes. Umar said: Please do it not, for I am afraid that people will trust in it alone; let them go on doing (good) deeds. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Well, let them.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai: Hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke ird-gird baithe the. Abu Bakr aur Umar (RA) bhi majma mein maujood the. Isi dauraan Rasoolullah (SAW) uthe aur humein chhodkar chale gaye. Unhein wapas aane mein der ho gayi, jiski wajah se ye pareshaani hui ki kahin unpar koi dushman hamla na kar de jab hum unke saath na hon; is liye ghabra kar hum uth khade hue. Sabse pehle main ghabraaya. Is liye main Rasoolullah (SAW) ko dhoondhne nikla aur Banu an-Najjar (Ansaar ka ek qabila) ke ek baagh tak pahuncha, uske ird-gird chakkar lagaya darwaza dhoondhte hue lekin koi darwaza nahi mila. Ek rabi' (yaani nehar) ko baagh mein ek kuen se aata dekha, main lomdi ki tarah simat kar us jagah tak rengta chala gaya jahan Allah ke Rasool the. Aap (SAW) ne kaha: Kya ye Abu Huraira hai? Maine (Abu Huraira ne) jawaab diya: Haan, Ya Rasoolullah. Aap (SAW) ne kaha: Tumhein kya hua? Maine jawaab diya: Aap hamare beech the lekin uthe aur chale gaye aur der ho gayi, is liye is dar se ki kahin aap par koi dushman hamla na kar de jab hum aapke saath na hon, hum ghabra gaye. Sabse pehle main ghabraaya. Is liye jab main is baagh mein pahuncha, to main lomdi ki tarah simat gaya, aur ye log mere peeche aa rahe hain. Aap (SAW) ne mujhe Abu Huraira kehkar pukaara aur mujhe apni jootiyaan dein aur farmaya: Meri ye jootiyaan le jao, aur is baagh ke bahar tumhein jo bhi shaks mile jo dil se yaqeen ke saath gawahi de ki Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, use ye khushkhabri sunakar khush kar dena ki wo Jannat mein jaayega. Ab sabse pehle jinse mera saamna hua wo Umar (RA) the. Unhone poocha: Ye jootiyaan kya hain, Abu Huraira? Maine jawaab diya: Ye Rasoolullah (SAW) ki jootiyaan hain jinke saath unhone mujhe bheja hai taaki jo bhi shaks mujhe mile jo dil se yaqeen ke saath gawahi de ki Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, use ye khushkhabri sunakar khush karoon ki wo Jannat mein jaayega. Is par Umar (RA) ne mujhe seene par maara aur main peeth ke bal gir gaya. Phir unhone kaha: Wapas jao, Abu Huraira. Is liye main Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas wapas laut aaya, aur rone hi wala tha. Umar (RA) mere peeche-peeche the aur wahin mere peeche the. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Tumhein kya hua, Abu Huraira? Maine kaha: Mera saamna Umar (RA) se hua aur maine unhein wo paighaam pahunchaya jiske saath aapne mujhe bheja tha. Unhone mujhe seene par maara jiski wajah se main peeth ke bal gir gaya aur unhone mujhe wapas jaane ka hukum diya. Is par Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Tumne aisa kyun kiya, Umar? Unhone kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, mere maa-baap aap par qurbaan hon, kya aapne waaqai Abu Huraira ko apni jootiyon ke saath is liye bheja tha ki wo jis kisi se mile jo gawahi de ki Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, dil se is par yaqeen rakhte hue, use ye khushkhabri sunaaye ki wo Jannat mein jaayega? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Haan. Umar (RA) ne kaha: Aisa mat kijiye, kyunki mujhe dar hai ki log sirf isi par bharosa kar baithenge; unhein amal karte rehne dijiye. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Theek hai, unhein aisa hi karne dein.

e: It is reported on the authority of Anas b. Malik that the Prophet of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) addressed Mu'adh b. Jabal as he was riding behind him to which he replied: At thy beck and call, and at thy pleasure, Messenger of Allah. He again called out: Mu'adh, to which he (again) replied: At thy beck and call, and at thy pleasure. He (the Holy Prophet) addressed him (again): Mu'adh, to which he replied: At thy beck and call, and at thy pleasure, Messenger of Allah. Upon this he (the Holy Prophet) observed: If anyone testifies (sincerely from his heart) that there is no god but Allah, and that Muhammad is His bondsman and His messenger, Allah immuned him from Hell. He (Mu'adh) said: Messenger of Allah, should I not then inform people of it, so that they may be of good cheer? He replied: Then they would trust in it alone. Mu'adh told about it at the time of his death, to avoid sinning.
hi: Anas bin Malik se riwayat hai ki Nabi (SAW) ne Mu'adh bin Jabal ko mukhaatib kiya jab wo unke peeche sawaar the, jispar unhone jawaab diya: Haazir hoon aur aapki khushi ke liye, Ya Rasoolullah. Aap (SAW) ne dobara pukaara: Mu'adh, jispar unhone (dobara) jawaab diya: Haazir hoon aur aapki khushi ke liye. Aap (SAW) ne unhein (phir) mukhaatib kiya: Mu'adh, jispar unhone jawaab diya: Haazir hoon aur aapki khushi ke liye, Ya Rasoolullah. Is par aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Agar koi shaks (dil se sacchayi ke saath) gawahi de ki Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi aur Muhammad uske bande aur uske Rasool hain, to Allah use Jahannam se mahfooz kar dega. Unhone (Mu'adh ne) kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, kya main is baare mein logon ko na bata doon, taaki wo khush ho jaayein? Aap (SAW) ne jawaab diya: Phir wo sirf isi par bharosa karne lagenge. Mu'adh ne apni maut ke waqt ye baat bataayi, gunah se bachne ke liye.

e: It is narrated on the authority of 'Itban b. Malik that he came to Medina and said: Something had gone wrong with my eyesight. I, therefore, sent (a message to the Holy Prophet): Verily it is my ardent desire that you should kindly grace my house with your presence and observe prayer there so, that I should make that corner a place of worship. He said: The Prophet (ﷺ) came there, and those amongst the Companions whom Allah willed also accompanied him. He entered (my place) and offered prayer at my residence and his Companions began to talk amongst themselves (and this conversation centered round hypocrites), and then the conspicuous one, Malik b. Dukhshum was made the target and they wished that he (the Holy Prophet) should curse him and he should die or he should meet some calamity. In the meanwhile the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) completed his prayer and said: Does Malik b. Dukhshum not testify the fact that there is no god but Allah and verily I am the messenger of Allah. They replied: He makes a profession of it (no doubt) but does not do it out of (sincere) heart. He (the Holy Prophet) said: He who testifies that there is no god but Allah and I am the messenger of Allah would not enter Hell or its (flames) would not consume him. Anas said: This hadith impressed me very much and I told my son to write it down.
hi: Itban bin Malik se riwayat hai ki wo Madina aaye aur kaha: Meri aankhon ki roshni mein kuch kharaabi aa gayi thi. Is liye maine (Nabi SAW ko ye paighaam) bheja: Beshak meri shiddat se khwahish hai ki aap meri makaan ko apni hazri se ronaq baksh dein aur wahan namaz padhein, taaki main us kone ko ibaadatgah bana lun. Unhone kaha: Nabi (SAW) wahan tashreef laaye, aur Sahaba mein se jinhein Allah ne chaaha wo bhi unke saath aaye. Aap (mere ghar) daakhil hue aur mere ghar mein namaz ada ki, aur unke Sahaba aapas mein baatein karne lage (aur ye baatein munafiqon ke ird-gird thi), phir mash'hoor shaks, Malik bin Dukhshum ka nishaana banaaya gaya aur unhone ye chaaha ki aap (SAW) unpar laanat karein aur wo mar jaayen ya unpar koi museebat aaye. Isi dauraan Rasoolullah (SAW) ne apni namaz mukammal ki aur farmaya: Kya Malik bin Dukhshum ye gawahi nahi deta ki Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi aur beshak main Allah ka Rasool hoon? Unhone jawaab diya: Wo (bila shak) ye kalima keh deta hai lekin (khaalis) dil se nahi karta. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Jo gawahi de ki Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi aur main Allah ka Rasool hoon, wo Jahannam mein daakhil nahi hoga ya usko (Jahannam ki aag) nahi jalayegi. Anas ne kaha: Is hadees ne mujh par bahut asar dala aur maine apne bete se kaha ki ise likh lo.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Anas that 'Itban b. Malik told him that he became blind. He sent a message to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that he should come and mark a place of worship for him. Thereupon came the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and his people and then there was a discussion among them about a man who was known as Malik b. Dukhshum, and subsequently the narrator described the hadith of Sulaiman b. Mughira as stated above.
hi: Anas se riwayat hai ki Itban bin Malik ne unhein bataaya ki wo andha ho gaye the. Unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) ko paighaam bheja ki wo aayein aur unke liye ibaadat ki jagah muqarrar karein. Is par Rasoolullah (SAW) aur unke log aaye, aur phir unke darmiyaan ek shaks ke baare mein baat hui jise Malik bin Dukhshum kaha jaata tha, aur phir raawi ne Sulaiman bin Mughira ki hadees ka wahi bayaan kiya jo upar zikr hua hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of 'Abbas b. 'Abdul-Muttalib that he heard the Messenger of Allah saying: He has found the taste of faith (iman) who is content with Allah as his Lord, with Islam as his religion (code of life) and with Muhammad (ﷺ) as his Prophet.
hi: Abbas bin Abdul-Muttalib se riwayat hai ki unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Us shaks ne imaan ka mazaa chakh liya jo Allah ko apna Rab maankar, Islam ko apna deen (zindagi ka tareeqa) maankar, aur Muhammad (SAW) ko apna Nabi maankar khush hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: Iman has over seventy branches, and modesty is a branch of Iman.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Imaan ki sattar (70) se zyada shaakhein hain, aur haya (sharm) imaan ki ek shaakh hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) said: Faith has over seventy branches or over sixty branches, the most excellent of which is the declaration that there is no god but Allah, and the humblest of which is the, removal of what is injurious from the path: and modesty is a branch of faith.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Imaan ki sattar (70) se zyada ya sath (60) se zyada shaakhein hain, jinmein sabse behtareen ye elaan karna hai ki Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, aur sabse maamooli shaakh raaste se takleefdeh cheez hataana hai: aur haya imaan ki ek shaakh hai.

e: Salim reported on the authority of his father that the Prophet (may peace and blessings be upon him) heard a man censuring his brother regarding modesty. Upon this the Prophet remarked: Modesty is part of Iman (faith).
hi: Salim ne apne waalid ki sanad se riwayat kiya ki Nabi (SAW) ne ek shaks ko apne bhai ko haya (sharm) ke maamle mein taane maarte hue suna. Is par Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Haya imaan ka hissa hai.

e: Zuhri has narrated this hadith with the addition of these words: He (the Holy Prophet) happened to pass by a mass of Ansar who was instructing his brother (about modesty).
hi: Zuhri ne is hadees ko in alfaaz ke izafe ke saath riwayat kiya hai: Aap (SAW) ka guzar Ansaar ke ek shaks ke paas se hua jo apne bhai ko (haya ke baare mein) samjha raha tha.

e: It is narrated on the authority of 'Imran b. Husain that the Prophet (may peace and blessings be upon him) said: Modesty brings forth nothing but goodness. Bushair b. Ka'b said: It is recorded in the books of wisdom, there lies sobriety in it and calmness of mind in it, Imran said: I am narrating to you the tradition of the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) and you talk of your books.
hi: Imran bin Husain se riwayat hai ki Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Haya sirf bhalaai hi laati hai. Bushair bin Ka'b ne kaha: Ye hikmat ki kitabon mein likha hai, ismein sanjeedgi hai aur zehn ka sukoon hai. Imran ne kaha: Main tumhein Rasoolullah (SAW) ki hadees bata raha hoon aur tum apni kitabon ki baat kar rahe ho.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Qatada. We were sitting with 'Imran b. Husain in a company and Bushair ibn Ka'b was also amongst us. 'Imran narrated to us that on a certain occasion the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) said: Modesty is a virtue through and through, or said: Modesty is a goodness complete. Upon this Bushair ibn Ka'b said: Verily we find in certain books or books of (wisdom) that it is God-inspired peace of mind or sobriety for the sake of Allah and there is also a weakness in it. Imran was so much enraged that his eyes became red and he said: I am narrating to you the hadith of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and you are contradicting it. He (the narrator) said: Imran reported the hadith, He (the narrator) said: Bushair repeated, (the same thing). Imran was enraged. He (the narrator) said: We asserted: Verily Bushair is one amongst us. Abu Nujaid! There is nothing wrong, with him (Bushair).
hi: Qatada se riwayat hai. Hum ek majlis mein Imran bin Husain ke saath baithe the aur Bushair bin Ka'b bhi humare saath maujood the. Imran ne humein bataaya ki ek dafa Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Haya sarasar khoobi hai, ya kaha: Haya poori tarah bhalaai hai. Is par Bushair bin Ka'b ne kaha: Hum kuch kitabon ya hikmat ki kitabon mein paate hain ki ye Allah ki taraf se dee gayi zehn ki sukoon ya sanjeedgi hai, aur ismein kamzori bhi hai. Imran itna gussa hue ki unki aankhein laal ho gayin aur unhone kaha: Main tumhein Rasoolullah (SAW) ki hadees bata raha hoon aur tum uski mukhaalfat kar rahe ho. Raawi ne kaha: Imran ne hadees dohraayi. Raawi ne kaha: Bushair ne (wahi baat) dohraayi. Imran gusse mein aa gaye. Raawi ne kaha: Humne kaha: Beshak Bushair humare hi darmiyaan ka ek shaks hai, Abu Nujaid! Unmein koi burayi nahi hai.

e: Ishaq b. Ibrahim narrates this hadith of the Prophet on the authority of Imran b. Husain, like the one narrated by Hammad b. Zaid.
hi: Ishaq bin Ibrahim ne is Nabi (SAW) ki hadees ko Imran bin Husain ki sanad se, Hammad bin Zaid ki riwayat ki tarah bayan kiya hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Sufyan b. 'Abdulla al-Thaqafi that he said: I asked the Messenger of Allah to tell me about Islam a thing which might dispense with the necessity of my asking anybody after you. In the hadith of Abu Usama the (words) are: other than you. He (the Holy Prophet) remarked: Say I affirm my faith in Allah and then remain steadfast to it.
hi: Sufyan bin Abdullah al-Thaqafi se riwayat hai ki unhone kaha: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) se kaha ki mujhe Islam ke baare mein aisi baat bataiye jo mujhe aapke baad kisi aur se poochne ki zaroorat na chhode. Abu Usama ki hadees mein (alfaaz hain): aapke alaawa kisi aur se. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Kaho: Main Allah par imaan laaya, phir usi par qaayam raho.

e: It is narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah b. 'Amr that a man asked the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) which of the merits (is superior) in Islam. He (the Holy Prophet) remarked: That you provide food and extend greetings to one whom you know or do not know.
hi: Abdullah bin Amr se riwayat hai ki ek shaks ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se poocha ki Islam mein kaunsi khoobi behtareen hai. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Ye ki tum khaana khilaao aur salaam kaho, chaahe tum us shaks ko jaante ho ya nahi.

e: 'Abdullah b. Amr b. al-As is reported to have said: Verily a person asked the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) who amongst the Muslims was better. Upon this (the Holy Prophet) remarked: From whose hand and tongue the Muslims are safe.
hi: Abdullah bin Amr bin al-Aas se riwayat hai: Beshak ek shaks ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se poocha ki Musalmanon mein sabse behtar kaun hai. Is par aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Jiske haath aur zubaan se Musalman mahfooz hon.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Jabir that he heard the (Holy Prophet) say: A Muslim is he from whose hand and tongue the Muslims are safe.
hi: Jabir se riwayat hai ki unhone Nabi (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Musalman wo hai jiske haath aur zubaan se Musalman mahfooz hon.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Musa Ash'ari: I asked the Messenger of Allah which (attribute) of Islam is more excellent. Upon this he remarked: One in which the Muslims are safe, protected from the tongue and hand of (other Muslims).
hi: Abu Musa Ash'ari se riwayat hai: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) se poocha ki Islam ki kaunsi khoobi sabse behtar hai. Is par aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Wo jismein Musalman (doosre Musalmanon ki) zubaan aur haath se mahfooz, mahfooz rahein.

e: Ibrahim b. Sa'id al-Jauhari has narrated this hadith with the same words in addition to these. The Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) was asked as to who amongst the Muslims is better, and the rest of the hadith was narrated like this.
hi: Ibrahim bin Sa'id al-Jauhari ne is hadees ko inhi alfaaz ke saath riwayat kiya hai, is izafe ke saath: Rasoolullah (SAW) se poocha gaya ki Musalmanon mein sabse behtar kaun hai, aur baaki hadees isi tarah bayan ki gayi.

e: It is reported on the authority of Anas that the Prophet of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him ) said: There are three qualities for which anyone who is characterised by them will relish the sweetness of faith: he to whom Allah and His Messenger are dearer than all else; he who loves a man for Allah's sake alone; and he who has as great an abhorrence of returning to unbelief after Allah has rescued him from it as he has of being cast into Hell.
hi: Anas se riwayat hai ki Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Teen khoobiyaan hain, jo shaks inse muttasif ho wo imaan ki mithaas mehsoos karega: jiske liye Allah aur Uske Rasool har cheez se zyada aziz hon; jo kisi shaks se sirf Allah ke liye mohabbat kare; aur jise kufr ki taraf laut jaane se utni hi nafrat ho jitni ki aag mein daale jaane se, uske baad ki Allah ne use usse bacha liya ho.

e: It is reported on the authority of Anas that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: There are three qualities for which any one who is characterised by them will relish the savour of faith: that he loves man and he does not love him but for Allah's sake alone; he is to whom Allah and His Messenger are dearer than all else; he who prefers to be thrown into fire than to return to unbelief after Allah has rescued him out of it.
hi: Anas se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Teen khoobiyaan hain, jo shaks inse muttasif ho wo imaan ka mazaa mehsoos karega: ki wo kisi shaks se mohabbat kare aur sirf Allah ke liye mohabbat kare; jiske liye Allah aur Uske Rasool har cheez se zyada aziz hon; jo aag mein phenke jaane ko is baat par tarjeeh de ki wo kufr ki taraf laute, uske baad ki Allah ne use usse bacha liya ho.

e: A similar hadith has been reported on the authority of Anas (with another chain of transmitters) with the exception of these words: that he again becomes a Jew or a Christian.
hi: Anas se ek jaisi hi hadees ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai, sivaay in alfaaz ke: ki wo dobara Yahudi ya Isaai ban jaaye.

e: It is reported on the authority of Anas that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: No bondsman believes, and, in the hadith narrated by Abdul Warith, no person believes, till I am dearer to him than the members of his household, his wealth and the whole of mankind.
hi: Anas se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Koi banda (us waqt tak) imaan nahi laata, aur Abdul Warith ki riwayat mein, koi shaks (us waqt tak) imaan nahi laata, jab tak main use uske ghar walon, uske maal, aur poori insaaniyat se zyada aziz na ho jaaun.

e: It is reported on the authority of Anas b. Malik that the Messenger of Allah said: None of you is a believer until I am dearer to him than his child, his father, and the whole of mankind.
hi: Anas bin Malik se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Tum mein se koi bhi (us waqt tak) momin nahi jab tak main use uski aulaad, uske waalid, aur poori insaaniyat se zyada aziz na ho jaaun.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik that the Prophet (may peace and blessings be upon him) observed: "None amongst you believes (truly) until he loves for his brother" - or he said "for his neighbour" - "that which he loves for himself."
hi: Anas bin Malik se riwayat hai ki Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Tum mein se koi bhi (sacche maayno mein) imaan nahi laata jab tak wo apne bhai' - ya kaha 'apne padosi' ke liye - 'wahi na chaahe jo wo apne liye chaahta hai.'

e: It is narrated on the authority of Anas that the Prophet (may peace blessings be upon him) observed: By Him in whose Hand is my life, no, bondsman (truly) believes till he likes for his neighbour, or he (the Holy Prophet) said: for his brother, whatever he likes for himself.
hi: Anas se riwayat hai ki Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, koi banda (sacche maayno mein) imaan nahi laata jab tak wo apne padosi ke liye, ya aap (SAW) ne kaha: apne bhai ke liye, wahi pasand na kare jo wo apne liye pasand karta hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessing be upon him) observed: He will not enter Paradise whose neighbour is not secure from his wrongful conduct.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Wo shaks Jannat mein daakhil nahi hoga jiska padosi uski takleef-dahi harkaton se mahfooz na ho.

e: It is reported on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed: He who believes in Allah and the Last Day should either utter good words or better keep silence; and he who believes in Allah and the Last Day should treat his neighbour with kindness and he who believes in Allah and the Last Day should show hospitality to his guest.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke Din par imaan rakhta hai use ya to achhi baat kehni chahiye ya behtar hai ki khaamosh rahe; aur jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke Din par imaan rakhta hai use apne padosi ke saath nekbaani ka sulook karna chahiye aur jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke Din par imaan rakhta hai use apne mehmaan ki izzat-afzaayi karni chahiye.

e: It is reported on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) observed: He who believes in Allah and the Last Day does not harm is neighbour, and he who believes in Allah and the Last Day shows hospitality to his guest and he who believes in Allah and the Last Day speaks good or remains silent.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke Din par imaan rakhta hai wo apne padosi ko takleef nahi deta, aur jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke Din par imaan rakhta hai wo apne mehmaan ki izzat-afzaayi karta hai aur jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke Din par imaan rakhta hai wo achhi baat karta hai ya khaamosh rehta hai.

e: Another hadith similar to one narrated (above) by Abu Husain is also reported by Abu Huraira with the exception of these words: He (the Prophet) said: He should do good to the neighbour.
hi: Abu Huraira se ek aur hadees, jo upar Abu Husain ki riwayat ki gayi hadees jaisi hai, bhi riwayat ki gayi hai, sivaay in alfaaz ke: Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Use apne padosi ke saath nekbaani karni chahiye.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Shuraih al-Khuzai' that the Prophet (may peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) observed: He who believes in Allah and the Last Day should do good to his neighbour and he who believes in Allah and the Last Day should show hospitality to the guest and he who believes in Allah and the Last Day should either speak good or better remain silent.
hi: Abu Shuraih al-Khuzai se riwayat hai ki Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke Din par imaan rakhta hai use apne padosi ke saath nekbaani karni chahiye aur jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke Din par imaan rakhta hai use apne mehmaan ki izzat-afzaayi karni chahiye aur jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke Din par imaan rakhta hai use ya to achhi baat kehni chahiye ya behtar hai ki khaamosh rahe.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Tariq b. Shihab: It was Marwan who initiated (the practice) of delivering khutbah (address) before the prayer on the 'Id day. A man stood up and said: Prayer should precede khutbah. He (Marwan) remarked, This (practice) has been done away with. Upon this Abu Sa'id remarked: This man has performed (his duty) laid on him. I heard the Messenger of Allah as saying: He who amongst you sees something abominable should modify it with the help of his hand; and if he has not strength enough to do it, then he should do it with his tongue, and if he has not strength enough to do it, (even) then he should (abhor it) from his heart, and that is the least of faith.
hi: Tariq bin Shihab se riwayat hai: Marwan hi the jinhone Eid ke din namaz se pehle khutba dene ki (riwayat) shuru ki. Ek shaks khada hua aur kaha: Namaz khutbe se pehle honi chahiye. Unhone (Marwan ne) kaha: Ye (tareeqa) khatam kar diya gaya hai. Is par Abu Sa'id ne kaha: Is shaks ne apna farz nibha diya hai. Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo tum mein se koi buri baat dekhe, use chahiye ki wo use apne haath se badal de; aur agar usmein itni himmat na ho, to apni zubaan se; aur agar usmein itni himmat na ho, to (kam se kam) apne dil se (isko bura jaane), aur ye imaan ka sabse kamzor (aakhri) darja hai.

e: The same hadith of the Prophet (may peace and blessings be upon him) has been reported by Abu Sa'id al-Khudri in connection with the story of Marwan.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ki yahi hadees Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne Marwan ke waaqiye ke silsile mein riwayat ki hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud that the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) observed: Never a Prophet had been sent before me by Allah towards his nation who had not among his people (his) disciples and companions who followed his ways and obeyed his command. Then there came after them their successors who said whatever they did not practise, and practised whatever they were not commanded to do. He who strove against them with his hand was a believer: he who strove against them with his tongue was a believer, and he who strove against them with his heart was a believer and beyond that there is no faith even to the extent of a mustard seed. Abu Rafi' said: I narrated this hadith to 'Abdullah b. 'Umar; he contradicted me. There happened to come 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud who stayed at Qanat, and 'Abdullah b 'Umar wanted me to accompany him for visiting him (as 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud was ailing), so I went along with him and as we sat (before him) I asked Ibn Mas'ud about this hadith. He narrated it in the same way as I narrated it to Ibn 'Umar.
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ood se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Mujhse pehle Allah ne apni ummat ki taraf koi Nabi nahi bheja jiske log mein us Nabi ke saathi aur murid na hon jo unke tareeqe par chalte hon aur unke hukum ki taameel karte hon. Phir unke baad aise jaanasheen aaye jo wo kehte the jo wo khud nahi karte the, aur wo karte the jiska unhein hukum nahi diya gaya tha. Jisne unke khilaaf apne haath se koshish ki wo momin tha: jisne unke khilaaf apni zubaan se koshish ki wo momin tha, aur jisne unke khilaaf apne dil se koshish ki wo momin tha, aur iske aage imaan ka rai bhar bhi (hissa) nahi bacha. Abu Rafi' ne kaha: Maine ye hadees Abdullah bin Umar ko sunaayi; unhone meri mukhaalfat ki. Isi dauraan Abdullah bin Mas'ood aa gaye jo Qanat mein thehre hue the, aur Abdullah bin Umar chaahte the ki main unke saath unse milne chalun (kyunki Abdullah bin Mas'ood bimaar the), is liye main unke saath chala gaya aur jab hum (unke saamne) baithe, to maine Ibn Mas'ood se ye hadees poochi. Unhone use waise hi bayan kiya jaise maine Ibn Umar ko bataayi thi.

e: The same hadith has been transmitted by another chain of narrators on the authority of 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud who observed: Never was there one among the prophets who had had not disciples who followed his direction and followed his ways. The remaining part of the hadith is like that as narrated by Salih but the arrival of Ibn Mas'ud and the meeting of Ibn 'Umar with him is not mentioned.
hi: Yahi hadees ek doosri sanad se bhi Abdullah bin Mas'ood ki riwayat se bayan ki gayi hai, unhone kaha: Anbiya mein se koi bhi aisa nahi tha jiske saathi na hon jo unki hidaayat par chale aur unke tareeqe ki peirvi karein. Baaki hadees waise hi hai jaisi Saalih ne bayan ki, lekin Ibn Mas'ood ka aana aur Ibn Umar ki unse mulaqaat ka zikr nahi hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Ibn Mas'ud that the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) pointed towards Yemen with his hand and said: Verily Iman is towards this side, and harshness and callousness of the hearts is found amongst the rude owners of the camels who drive them behind their tails (to the direction) where emerge the two horns of Satan, they are the tribes of Rabi'a and Mudar.
hi: Ibn Mas'ood se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne apne haath se Yemen ki taraf ishaara kiya aur farmaya: Beshak Imaan is taraf hai, aur dilon ki sakhti aur be-rehmi ganwaar oont waalon mein paayi jaati hai jo unhein unki dumon ke peeche hankate hain (us taraf) jahan Shaitan ke do seeng nikalte hain, yaani Rabi'a aur Mudar ke qabile.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah observed: There have come the people of Yemen; they are tender of hearts, the belief is that of the Yemenites, the understanding (of the faith) is that of the Yemenites and sagacity is that of the Yemenites.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Yemen ke log aaye hain; unke dil narm hain, imaan Yemen waalon ka hai, (deen ki) samajh Yemen waalon ki hai aur hikmat Yemen waalon ki hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported the same hadith which is transmitted to us by another chain of transmitters, e. g. Muhammad b. al-Muthanna, Ishaq b. Yusuf Azraq, Ibn 'Aun, etc.
hi: Abu Huraira ne yahi hadees riwayat ki jo humein ek doosri sanad se bhi pahunchi hai, misaal ke taur par Muhammad bin al-Muthanna, Ishaq bin Yusuf Azraq, Ibn Aun, waghaira ki sanad se.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) observed: There came to you the people from Yemen; they are tender of hearts and mild of feelings, the understanding is Yemenite, the sagacity is Yemenite.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Yemen ke log tumhare paas aaye hain; unke dil narm aur jazbaat naram hain, samajh Yemen waalon ki hai, hikmat Yemen waalon ki hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) remarked: The summit of unbelief is towards the East and the pride and conceitedness is found among the owners of horses and camels who are rude and uncivil, people of the tents, and tranquillity is found among those who rear goats and sheep.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Kufr ki chotti Purab (East) ki taraf hai aur ghamand aur takabbur ganwaar aur be-tehzeeb ghode aur oont waalon mein paaya jaata hai, khaimon ke rehne wale log, aur sukoon un logon mein hota hai jo bakriyan aur bhedein paalte hain.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) observed: The belief is among the Yemenites, and the unbelief is towards the East, and tranquillity is among those who rear goats and sheep, and pride and simulation is among the uncivil and rude owners of horses and camels.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Imaan Yemen waalon mein hai, aur kufr Purab ki taraf hai, aur sukoon un logon mein hai jo bakriyan aur bhedein paalte hain, aur ghamand aur dikhaawa be-tehzeeb aur ganwaar ghode aur oont waalon mein hai.

e: It is reported on the authority of Abu Huraira: I heard the Messenger of Allah saying this: Pride and conceitedness is found among the uncivil owners of the camels and tranquillity is found among the owners of sheep and goats.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Ghamand aur takabbur be-tehzeeb oont waalon mein paaya jaata hai aur sukoon bhed aur bakri waalon mein paaya jaata hai.

e: The same hadith has been narrated by Zuhri with the same chain of authorities with the addition: The belief is among the Yemenites, the sagacity is that of the Yemenites.
hi: Zuhri ne yahi hadees usi sanad ke saath, is izafe ke saath riwayat ki hai: Imaan Yemen waalon mein hai, hikmat Yemen waalon ki hai.

e: Abu Huraira said: I heard the Prophet (may peace and blessings be upon him) saying: There came the people of Yemen, they are tender of feelings and meek of hearts. The belief is that of the Yemenites, the sagacity is that of the Yemenites, the tranquillity is among the owners of goats and sheep, and pride and conceitedness is among the uncivil owners of the camels, the people of the tents in the direction of sunrise.
hi: Abu Huraira ne kaha: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Yemen ke log aaye, unke jazbaat naram aur dil naram hain. Imaan Yemen waalon ka hai, hikmat Yemen waalon ki hai, sukoon bakri aur bhed waalon mein hai, aur ghamand aur takabbur be-tehzeeb oont waalon mein hai, khaimon ke log jo suraj nikalne ki taraf hain.

e: It is reporter on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) observed: There came the people of Yemen who are soft of hearts, tender in feelings: the belief is that of the Yemenites, the sagacity is that of the Yemenites and the summit of unbelief is towards the East.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Yemen ke log aaye jinke dil narm aur jazbaat naram hain: imaan Yemen waalon ka hai, hikmat Yemen waalon ki hai aur kufr ki chotti Purab ki taraf hai.

e: Qutaiba b. Sa'id and Zubair b. Harb say: Jarir narrated this on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of narrators (as mentioned above).
hi: Qutaiba bin Sa'id aur Zubair bin Harb kehte hain: Jarir ne ise A'mash ki sanad se usi (upar bayan ki gayi) sanad ke saath riwayat kiya.

e: Shu'ba narrated the hadith as reported by Jarir with the same chain of narrators with this addition: Pride and conceitedness is among the owners of the camels and tranquillity and sobriety is found amongst the owners of sheep.
hi: Shu'ba ne is hadees ko Jarir ki riwayat ki tarah usi sanad ke saath is izafe ke saath bayan kiya: Ghamand aur takabbur oont waalon mein hai aur sukoon aur sanjeedgi bhed waalon mein paayi jaati hai.

e: It is reported on the authority of Jabir b. Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah (may peace and, blessings be upon him) observed: The callousness of heart and sternness is in the East and faith is among the people of the Hijaz.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Dilon ki sakhti aur be-rehmi Purab mein hai aur imaan Hijaz ke logon mein hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessing be upon him) observed: You shall not enter Paradise so long as you do not affirm belief (in all those things which are the articles of faith) and you will not believe as long as you do not love one another. Should I not direct you to a thing which, if you do, will foster love amongst you: (i. e.) give currency to (the practice of paying salutation to one another by saying) as-salamu alaikum.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Tum Jannat mein daakhil nahi hoge jab tak imaan na laao (un sab cheezon par jo imaan ke rukn hain) aur tum imaan nahi laaoge jab tak ek doosre se mohabbat na karo. Kya main tumhein wo cheez na bataaun jise agar tum karo, to tumhare darmiyaan mohabbat paida ho jaayegi: (yaani) ek doosre ko 'as-salamu alaikum' kehne ka aam riwaaj daal do.

e: Zuhair b. Harb said: Jarir reported on the authority of A'mash with this chain of transmitters that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed: By him in Whose hand is my life, you shall not enter Paradise unless you believe. The rest of the hadith is the same as narrated by Abd Mu'awiya and Waki'.
hi: Zuhair bin Harb ne kaha: Jarir ne A'mash ki sanad se, isi silsile ke saath riwayat ki ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, tum Jannat mein daakhil nahi hoge jab tak imaan na laao. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai jaisi Abd Mu'awiya aur Waki' ne bayan ki.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Tamim ad-Dari that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "The Religion is sincerity." We said, "To whom?" He said "To Allah, to His Book, To His Messenger, and to the leaders of the Muslims and their masses."
hi: Tamim ad-Dari se riwayat hai ki Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Deen khairkhwaahi (nasihat) hai.' Humne poocha, 'Kiske liye?' Aap (SAW) ne farmaya 'Allah ke liye, Uski Kitab ke liye, Uske Rasool ke liye, aur Musalmanon ke rehnumaon aur unki aam janta ke liye.'

e: Muhammad b. Hatim and others narrate the same hadith of the Apostle (may peace and blessings be upon him) on the authority of Tamim ad-Dari.
hi: Muhammad bin Hatim aur doosre logon ne Nabi (SAW) ki yahi hadees Tamim ad-Dari ki sanad se riwayat ki hai.

e: Umayya b. Bistam narrates the same hadith of the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) on the authority of Tamim ad-Dari.
hi: Umayya bin Bistam ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ki yahi hadees Tamim ad-Dari ki sanad se riwayat ki hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Jarir that he observed I gave pledge of allegiance to the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) on the observance of prayer, payment of Zakat, and sincerity and well-wishing for every Muslim.
hi: Jarir se riwayat hai ki unhone kaha: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) se namaz qaayam karne, Zakat ada karne, aur har Musalman ke liye khairkhwaahi aur nek-niyati par bay'at (ehed) ki.

e: Sufyan narrated on the authority of Ziyad b. 'Ilaqa that he heard Jarir b. 'Abdullah saying: I pledged allegiance to the Messenger of Allah may peace and blessings be upon him) on sincerity and well-wishing for every Muslim.
hi: Sufyan ne Ziyad bin Ilaqah ki sanad se riwayat ki ki unhone Jarir bin Abdullah ko ye kehte suna: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) se har Musalman ke liye khairkhwaahi aur nek-niyati par bay'at ki.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Jarir that he observed: I owed allegiance to the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) on hearing ( is commands) and obeying (them) and the Prophet) instructed me (to act) as lay in my power, and sincerity and goodwill for every Muslim.
hi: Jarir se riwayat hai ki unhone kaha: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) se (unke) hukum sunne aur (unki) itaa'at karne par bay'at ki, aur Nabi (SAW) ne mujhe ye hidaayat di ki jitni meri taaqat ho utna karoon, aur har Musalman ke liye khairkhwaahi aur nek-niyati (bhi shaamil thi).

e: Abu Huraira reported that the Messenger of Allah observed: The fornicator who fornicates is not a believer so long as he commits it and no thief who steals is a believer as long as he commits theft, and no drunkard who drinks wine is a believer as long as he drinks it. 'Abdul-Malik b. Abi Bakr' narrated this on the authority of Abu Bakr b. Abdur-Rahman b. Harith and then said: Abu Huraira made this addition: No plunderer who plunders a valuable thing that attracts the attention of people is a believer so long as he commits this act.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Zaani jab zina karta hai to wo momin nahi rehta jab tak wo aisa karta rahe, aur chor jab chori karta hai to wo momin nahi rehta jab tak wo chori karta rahe, aur sharaabi jab sharaab peeta hai to wo momin nahi rehta jab tak wo peeta rahe. Abdul Malik bin Abi Bakr ne ise Abu Bakr bin Abdur Rahman bin Harith ki sanad se riwayat ki aur phir kaha: Abu Huraira ne ye izafa kiya: Loot-maar karne wala jab koi qeemti cheez loot leta hai jo logon ki tawajjo kheenchti hai, to wo momin nahi rehta jab tak wo aisa karta rahe.

e: 'Abdul-Malik b. Shu'aib narrated this hadith on the authority of Abu Huraira that he observed: The Messenger of Allah said that a fornicator does not fornicate, and then narrated the hadith like this, and he also made mention of plundering too, but did not mention of a thin having value. Ibn Shihab said: Sa'id b. al-Musayyib and Abu Salama narrated this hadith on the authority of Abu Huraira a hadith like that of Abu Bakr with the exception of (the mention) of plundering.
hi: Abdul Malik bin Shu'aib ne ye hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se riwayat ki ki unhone kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya ki zaani zina nahi karta (imaan ki halat mein), phir isi tarah hadees bayan ki, aur unhone loot-maar ka bhi zikr kiya, lekin qeemti cheez ka zikr nahi kiya. Ibn Shihab ne kaha: Sa'id bin al-Musayyib aur Abu Salama ne ye hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se, Abu Bakr ki riwayat jaisi hi bayan ki, sivaay loot-maar ke zikr ke (bagair).

e: Muhammad b. Mihran narrates this hadith on the authority of Abu Huraira and made mention of plundering but did not talk of (a thing) having value.
hi: Muhammad bin Mihran ne ye hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se riwayat ki aur loot-maar ka zikr kiya lekin (kisi cheez ke) qeemti hone ki baat nahi ki.

e: Imam Muslim has reported this hadith by Hasan b. 'Ali al-Halwani and other traditions.
hi: Imam Muslim ne ye hadees Hasan bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) al-Halwani aur doosri riwaayaton ke zariye bayan ki hai.

e: It is reported on the authority of Qutaiba b. Sa'id who reported on the authority of Abu Huraira the hadith like that narrated from Zuhri with this exception that in the hadith narrated by 'Ala ' and Safwan b. Sulaim there is no mention of: People raise there eyes towards him, and in the hadith narrated by Hammam: The believers raise their eyes towards him, and such like words, so long as he plunders (is not) a believer, and these words were added: And no exploiter who makes an exploitation is a believer as long as he exploits It; therefore avoid and shun (these evils).
hi: Qutaiba bin Sa'id ki sanad se riwayat hai jinhone Abu Huraira se Zuhri ki riwayat jaisi hi hadees riwayat ki, is farq ke saath ki Ala' aur Safwan bin Sulaim ki riwayat ki gayi hadees mein ye zikr nahi hai: 'Log apni nazrein uski taraf uthaate hain,' aur Hammam ki riwayat ki gayi hadees mein: 'Momin apni nazrein uski taraf uthaate hain,' aur isi tarah ke alfaaz, jab tak wo loot-maar karta rahe (wo momin nahi), aur ye alfaaz izafa kiye gaye: Aur zulm karne wala jab tak zulm karta rahe wo momin nahi hai; is liye in (buraiyon) se bacho aur inhein chhodo.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira: A fornicator who fornicates is not a believer as long as he commits fornication, and no one who steals is a believer as long as he commits theft, and no one who drinks wine is a believer as long as he drinks it, and repentance may be accepted after that.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai: Zaani jab zina karta hai to wo momin nahi rehta jab tak wo zina karta rahe, aur koi chori karne wala jab tak chori karta rahe wo momin nahi, aur koi sharaab peene wala jab tak sharaab peeta rahe wo momin nahi, aur uske baad tauba qubool ki jaa sakti hai.

e: Muhammad b. Rafi', Abdur-Razzaq, Sufyan, A'mash narrated this hadith like one narrated by Shu'ba, on the authority of Abu Huraira tracing, it (right to the Holy Prophet).
hi: Muhammad bin Rafi', Abdur Razzaq, Sufyan, A'mash ne ye hadees Shu'ba ki riwayat jaisi hi bayan ki, Abu Huraira ki sanad se ise (seedha) Nabi (SAW) tak pahunchaate hue.

e:
It is narrated on the authority of Abdullah b. 'Amr that the Prophet observed: "There are four characteristics, whoever has them all is a pure hypocrite, and whoever has one of its characteristics, he has one of the characteristics of hypocrisy, until he gives it up: When he speaks he lies, when he makes a covenant he betrays it, when he makes a promise he breaks it, and when he disputes he resorts to obscene speech."

In the narration of Sufyan (one of the narrators) it is: "And if he has one of them, he has one of the characteristics of hypocrisy."
hi:
Abdullah bin Amr se riwayat hai ki Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Chaar khaslatein hain, jiske andar ye sab hon wo pukka munafiq hai, aur jiske andar inmein se ek bhi ho, uske andar munafiqat ki ek khaslat hai, jab tak wo use chhod na de: Jab wo baat kare to jhoot bole, jab wahda kare to usse muqar jaaye, jab wa'ada kare to tode, aur jab jhagda kare to gaali-galoch par utar aaye.'

Sufyan ki riwayat mein (ek raawi ne kaha) hai: 'Aur agar uske andar inmein se ek bhi ho, to uske andar munafiqat ki ek khaslat hai.'

e: It is reported on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) said: Three are the signs of a hypocrite: when he spoke he told a lie, when he made a promise he acted treacherously against it, when he was trusted he betrayed.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Munafiq ki teen nishaaniyan hain: jab baat kare to jhoot bole, jab wa'ada kare to usse muqar jaaye, jab uspar bharosa kiya jaaye to khayanat kare.

e: Abu Huraira reported that the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) observed: There are three characteristics of a hypocrite: when he spoke he told a lie, when he made promise he acted treacherously, and when he was trusted he betrayed.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Munafiq ki teen khaslatein hain: jab baat kare to jhoot bole, jab wa'ada kare to usse muqar jaaye, aur jab uspar bharosa kiya jaaye to khayanat kare.

e: 'Uqba b. Mukarram al-'Ami reported that he heard 'Ala' b. 'Abdur-Rahman narrating this hadith with this chain of transmitters and he said: Three are the signs of a hypocrite, even if he observed fast and prayed and asserted that he was a Muslim.
hi: Uqba bin Mukarram al-Ami ne bataaya ki unhone Ala' bin Abdur Rahman ko isi sanad ke saath ye hadees riwayat karte suna aur unhone kaha: Munafiq ki teen nishaaniyan hain, chaahe wo roze rakhe aur namaz padhe aur dawa kare ki wo Musalman hai.

e: It is reported on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) made observations like them embodied in the hadith narrated by Yahya b. Muhammad on the authority of 'Ala', and added to it: even if he observed fast and prayed and asserted that he was a Muslim.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne (upar bayan ki gayi baaton jaisi hi) baatein kahin, jaisa ki Yahya bin Muhammad ne Ala' ki sanad se riwayat ki hai, aur usmein ye izafa kiya: chaahe wo roze rakhe aur namaz padhe aur dawa kare ki wo Musalman hai.

e: It is reported on the authority of Ibn 'Umar that the Apostle (may peace and blessings be upon him) observed: When a man calls his brother an unbeliever, it returns (at least) to one of them.
hi: Ibn Umar se riwayat hai ki Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab ek shaks apne bhai ko kaafir kehta hai, to ye (baat) unmein se ek par lautti hai.

e: It is reported on the authority of Ibn 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) said: Any person who called his brother: "O unbeliever" (has in fact done an act by which this unbelief) would return to one of them. If it were so, as he asserted (then the unbelief of man was confirmed but if it was not true), then it returned to him (to the man who labeled it on his brother Muslim).
hi: Ibn Umar se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jis shaks ne apne bhai ko 'Aye kaafir' kaha (usne asal mein aisa amal kiya jiski wajah se ye kufr) unmein se ek par lautega. Agar aisa hi tha jaisa usne dawa kiya (to us shaks ka kufr saabit ho gaya, lekin agar aisa nahi tha), to wo (kaafir kehne waale) shaks par laut jaayega.

e: It is reported on the authority of Abu Dharr that he heard the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) saying: No person who claimed knowingly anyone else as his father besides (his own) committed nothing but infidelity, and he who made a claim of anything, which (in fact) did not belong to him, is not amongst us; he should make his abode in Fire, and he who labeled anyone with unbelief or called him the enemy of Allah, and he was in fact not so, it rebounded on him.
hi: Abu Dharr se riwayat hai ki unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jis shaks ne jaan-boojh kar apne asal waalid ke alaawa kisi aur ko apna waalid maana, usne kufr ke siwa kuch nahi kiya, aur jis shaks ne kisi aisi cheez ka dawa kiya jo (haqeeqat mein) uski nahi thi, wo humme se nahi hai; use aag mein apna thikaana banaana chahiye, aur jisne kisi ko kufr ka ilzaam lagaya ya use Allah ka dushman kaha, jabki wo asal mein aisa nahi tha, to ye baat usi shaks par lautegi.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) observed: Do not detest your fathers; he who detested his father committed infidelity.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Apne waalidain se nafrat mat karo; jo apne waalid se nafrat kare usne kufr kiya.

e: It is reported on the authority of Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas: Both of my ears heard the Messenger of Allah saying this: He who claimed the fatherhood of anyone else besides his real father knowingly (committed a great sin) ;Paradise is forbidden to him. Abu Bakra asserted that he too heard it from the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him ).
hi: Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas se riwayat hai: Meri dono kaanon ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jisne jaan-boojh kar apne asal waalid ke alaawa kisi aur ko apna waalid maana (usne bada gunah kiya); uspar Jannat haraam hai. Abu Bakra ne bhi dawa kiya ki unhone bhi ye Rasoolullah (SAW) se suna hai.

e: Sa'd and Abu Bakra each one of them said: My ears heard and my hearing preserved it that Muhammad (peace and blessings be upon him) observed: He who claimed for another one his fatherhood besides his own father knowingly that he was not his father-to him Paradise is forbidden.
hi: Sa'd aur Abu Bakra dono mein se har ek ne kaha: Meri kaanon ne suna aur meri sunwaayi ne ise mahfooz rakha ki Muhammad (SAW) ne farmaya: Jisne jaan-boojh kar apne asal waalid ke alaawa kisi aur ko apna waalid maana, jabki wo uska waalid nahi tha - uspar Jannat haraam hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud that the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) observed: Abusing a Muslim is an outrage and fighting against him is unbelief. Zubaid said: I asked Abu Wa'il: Did you hear it from Abdullah narrating if from the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him)? He replied: Yes. But there is mention of the talk between Zubaid and Abu Wa'il in the hadith narrated by Shu'ba.
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ood se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Kisi Musalman ko gaali dena badi bad-akhlaaqi hai aur uske khilaaf ladna kufr hai. Zubaid ne kaha: Maine Abu Wa'il se poocha: Kya aapne ye Abdullah se seedhe Rasoolullah (SAW) ki riwayat mein suna? Unhone jawaab diya: Haan. Lekin Shu'ba ki riwayat ki gayi hadees mein Zubaid aur Abu Wa'il ke darmiyaan hui baatcheet ka zikr hai.

e: Abu Bakr b. Abu Shaiba narrated a hadith like this from the Apostle (may peace and blessings be upon him) on the authority of Abdullah.
hi: Abu Bakr bin Abi Shaiba ne bhi is jaisi hadees Nabi (SAW) se, Abdullah ki sanad se riwayat ki hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Jarir b. 'Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) asked him on the occasion of the Farewell Pilgrimage to make the people silent and then said: Do not return to unbelief after me by striking the necks of one another.
hi: Jarir bin Abdullah se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Hajjatul-Wida (Farewell Pilgrimage) ke mauqe par unse logon ko khaamosh karaane ko kaha aur phir farmaya: Mere baad kufr ki taraf laut kar ek doosre ki gardanein mat maaro.

e: Abdullah b. Mu'adh narrated from the Apostle (may peace and blessings be upon him) a hadith like this on the authority on Ibn Umar.
hi: Abdullah bin Mu'adh ne Nabi (SAW) ki aisi hi hadees Ibn Umar ki sanad se riwayat ki.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abdullah b. Umar that the Apostle (may peace and blessings be upon him) observed on the occasion of the Farewell Pilgrimage Woe unto you distress unto you! Don't turn back as unbelievers after me by striking the necks of one another.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Hajjatul-Wida ke mauqe par farmaya: Tumpar afsos! Tumpar museebat! Mere baad kaafir bankar wapas na palato ki ek doosre ki gardanein maaro.

e: Harmala b. Yahya, Abdullah b. Wahb, Umar b. Muhammad, Ibn Umar narrated like the hadith reported by Shu'ba on the authority of Waqid.
hi: Harmalah bin Yahya, Abdullah bin Wahb, Umar bin Muhammad, Ibn Umar ne isi tarah ki hadees riwayat ki jaisi Shu'ba ne Waqid ki sanad se riwayat ki hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) observed: Two (things) are found among men which are tantamount to unbelief: slandering one's lineage and lamentation on the dead.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Do (baatein) logon mein paayi jaati hain jo kufr ke barabar hain: kisi ke nasab (khaandaan) par ta'na karna aur mayyat par naala-o-fariyaad (bain) karna.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Jarir that he heard (the Holy Prophet) saying, The slave who fled from his master committed an act of infidelity as long as he would not return to him. Mansur observed: By God, this hadith was narrated from the Apostle (may peace and blessings be upon him), but I do not like that this should be narrated on my authority here in Basra.
hi: Jarir se riwayat hai ki unhone (Nabi SAW ko) ye kehte suna: Wo ghulaam jo apne maalik se faraar ho jaaye, usne kufr ka amal kiya jab tak wo unke paas wapas na laut aaye. Mansoor ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, ye hadees Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki gayi thi, lekin mujhe pasand nahi ki ye hadees yahan Basra mein meri sanad se riwayat ki jaaye.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Jarir that the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) observed: The slave who fled from his master, responsibility with regard to him was absolved.
hi: Jarir se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Wo ghulaam jo apne maalik se faraar ho jaaye, uske haq mein zimmedari (Allah ki hifazat) khatam ho jaati hai.

e: Jarir b. Abdullah reported it from the Holy Prophet: When the slave runs away from his master, his prayer is not accepted.
hi: Jarir bin Abdullah ne ise Nabi (SAW) se riwayat kiya: Jab ghulaam apne maalik se bhaag jaaye, to uski namaz qubool nahi hoti.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Zaid b. Khalid al-Juhani: The Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) led the morning prayer at Hudaybiya. There were some marks of the rainfall during the night. At the conclusion of prayer he turned towards people and observed: Do you know what your Lord has said? They replied: Allah and His Messenger know best. Upon this he (the Holy Prophet) remarked: He (Allah) said: Some of My bondsmen entered the morning as My believers and some as unbelievers. He who said: We have had a rainfall due to the Blessing and Mercy of Allah, he is My believer and a disbeliever of stars, and who said: We have had a rainfall due to the rising of such and such (star) disbelieved Me and affirmed his faith in the stars.
hi: Zaid bin Khalid al-Juhani se riwayat hai: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Hudaybiya mein fajar ki namaz padhaayi. Raat ko baarish ke kuch aasaar the. Namaz khatam hone par aap (SAW) logon ki taraf mudte hue farmaya: Kya tumhein pata hai tumhare Rab ne kya farmaya hai? Unhone jawaab diya: Allah aur Uske Rasool behtar jaante hain. Is par aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Usne (Allah ne) farmaya: Mere kuch bande momin ban kar aur kuch kaafir ban kar subah karte hain. Jisne kaha: Hum par Allah ke fazl aur rehmat se baarish hui, wo mera momin hai aur sitaaron ka munkir hai, aur jisne kaha: Hum par falaan (sitare) ke uthne ki wajah se baarish hui, usne mera inkaar kiya aur sitaaron par apna imaan zaahir kiya.

e: It is reported on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) said: Don't you know what your Lord said? He observed: I have never endowed My bondsmen with a favor, but a section amongst them disbelieved it and said: Stars, it was due to the stars.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Kya tumhein pata nahi ki tumhare Rab ne kya kaha? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Maine kabhi apne bandon par koi ehsaan nahi kiya, jiska unmein se ek giroh inkaar na kare aur kahe: Sitaare, ye sitaaron ki wajah se hua.

e: It is reported on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessing be upon him) observed: Allah does not shower His blessings from the heaven that in the morning a group of men disbelieve it (to be a blessing from Allah). Allah sends down rain, but they (the disbelievers) say: Such and such star (is responsible for that).
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Allah aasman se apni koi bhi barkat nahi barsaata jiska subah logon ka ek giroh inkaar na kar de (ki ye Allah ki taraf se barkat hai). Allah baarish bhejta hai, lekin wo (munkir log) kehte hain: Falaan-falaan sitara (iska zimmedar hai).

e:
It is reported on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that there was (once) a downpour during the life of the Apostle (may peace and blessings be upon him Upon this the Apostle (may peace and blessings be upon him) observed: Some people entered the morning with gratitude and some with ingratitude (to Allah). Those who entered with gratitude said: This is the blessing of Allah, and those who entered with ingratitude said: Such and such asterism was right. It was upon this that the verse was revealed: 
I swear by the setting of the stars to the end and make your provision that you should disbelieve it.
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ki Nabi (SAW) ke zamaane mein (ek baar) zoron ki baarish hui. Is par Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Kuch log shukrguzaari ke saath subah ko pahunche aur kuch nashukri ke saath (Allah ke prati). Jinhone shukrguzaari ke saath subah ki, unhone kaha: Ye Allah ki barkat hai, aur jinhone nashukri ke saath subah ki, unhone kaha: Falaan-falaan taara (nakshatra) sahi tha. Isi mauqe par ye aayat nazil hui: Main sitaaron ke ghurub hone ki qasam khaata hoon... (aakhir tak) aur tum apni rozi ko is baat mein lagaate ho ki tum (Allah ka) inkaar karo.

e: It is reported on the authority of Anas that the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings Be upon him) observed: The sign of a hypocrite is the hatred against the Ansar and the sign of a believer is the love for the Ansar.
hi: Anas se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Munafiq ki nishaani Ansaar se nafrat karna hai aur momin ki nishaani Ansaar se mohabbat karna hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Anas that the Apostle (may peace and blessings be upon him) said: The love of the Ansar is the sign of faith and hatred against them is the sign of dissemblance.
hi: Anas se riwayat hai ki Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Ansaar se mohabbat imaan ki nishaani hai aur unse nafrat munafiqat ki nishaani hai.

e: Al-Bara reported from the Messenger (may peace and blessing be upon him) that he remarked with regard to the Ansar: "None but the believer loves them, none but the hypocrite hates them. He who loves them loves Allah and he who hates them hates Allah." I (the narrator) said: Did you hear this hadith from al-Bara'? He said: He narrated it to me.
hi: Bara' se riwayat hai ki Rasool (SAW) ne Ansaar ke baare mein farmaya: 'Sirf momin hi unse mohabbat karta hai, sirf munafiq hi unse nafrat karta hai. Jo unse mohabbat kare, wo Allah se mohabbat karta hai, aur jo unse nafrat kare, wo Allah se nafrat karta hai.' Maine (raawi ne) poocha: Kya aapne ye hadees Bara' se khud suni? Unhone kaha: Unhone ye mujhe bayan ki.

e: It is reported on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) said: A person who believes in Allah and the Last Day never nurses a grudge against the Ansar.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jo shaks Allah aur Aakhirat ke Din par imaan rakhta hai wo kabhi Ansaar ke khilaaf koi kina (dushmani) nahi paalta.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Sa'id Khudri that the Messenger of Allah observed: The person who believes in Allah and the Last Day never nurses a grudge against the Ansar.
hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jo shaks Allah aur Aakhirat ke Din par imaan rakhta hai wo kabhi Ansaar ke khilaaf koi kina nahi paalta.

e: Zirr reported: 'Ali observed: By Him Who split up the seed and created something living, the Apostle (may peace and blessings be upon him) gave me a promise that no one but a believer would love me, and none but a hypocrite would nurse grudge against me.
hi: Zirr ne bayan kiya: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: Us Zaat ki qasam jisne beej ko phaada aur jaandaar cheez banaayi, Nabi (SAW) ne mujhse ye wa'ada kiya tha ki sirf momin hi mujhse mohabbat karega, aur sirf munafiq hi mujhse kina rakhega.

e: It is narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah b. Umar that the Messenger of Allah observed: O womenfolk, you should give charity and ask much forgiveness for I saw you in bulk amongst the dwellers of Hell. A wise lady among them said: Why is it, Messenger of Allah, that our folk is in bulk in Hell? Upon this the Prophet observed: You curse too much and are ungrateful to your spouses. I have seen none lacking in common sense and failing in religion but (at the same time) robbing the wisdom of the wise, besides you. Upon this the woman remarked: What is wrong with our common sense and with religion? He (the Holy Prophet) observed: Your lack of common sense (can be well judged from the fact) that the evidence of two women is equal to one man, that is a proof of the lack of common sense, and you spend some nights (and days) in which you do not offer prayer and in the month of Ramadan (during the days) you do not observe fast, that is a failing in religion.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Aye auraton ki jamaat, sadqa do aur zyada se zyada istighfaar karo, kyunki maine tumhein Jahannam ke rehne walon mein sabse zyada (tadaad mein) dekha. Unmein se ek aqlmand aurat ne poocha: Ya Rasoolullah, aisa kyun hai ki hamari jamaat Jahannam mein sabse zyada hai? Is par Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Tum bahut laanat-malaamat karti ho aur apne shohar ke saath naa-shukri karti ho. Maine tum se zyada aql mein kami aur deen mein kamzori waali koi qaum nahi dekhi (iske baawajood ki tum) aqlmand shaks ki samajh cheen leti ho. Is par us aurat ne kaha: Hamari aql aur hamare deen mein kya kharaabi hai? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Tumhari aql ki kami (isse achhi tarah samjhi ja sakti hai) ki do auraton ki gawahi ek mard ke barabar hai, ye aql ki kami ka saboot hai, aur tum kayi raatein (aur din) aisi guzaarti ho jismein namaz nahi padhti aur Ramzan ke mahine mein (dinon mein) roze nahi rakhti, ye deen mein kami hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Tahir with this chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Tahir ki isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: A hadith like this as narrated by Ibn 'Umar has also been transmitted by Abu Sa'id al-Khudri.
hi: Ibn Umar ki bayan ki gayi is jaisi hadees Abu Sa'id al-Khudri se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: A hadith like this as narrated by Ibn 'Umar has also been transmitted by Abu Huraira.
hi: Ibn Umar ki bayan ki gayi is jaisi hadees Abu Huraira se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that when, the son of Adam recites the Ayat of Sajdah (prostration) and then falls down in prostration, the Satan goes into seclusion and weeps and says: Alas, and in the narration of Abu Kuraib the words are: Woe unto me, the son of Adam was commanded to prostrate, and he prostrated and Paradise was entitled to him and I was commanded to prostrate, but I refused and am doomed to Hell.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki jab Aadam ki aulaad Sajdah ki aayat padhti hai aur phir Sajdah mein gir jaati hai, to Shaitan alag ho jaata hai aur rota hai aur kehta hai: Haaye afsos, aur Abu Kuraib ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: Mujh par afsos, Aadam ki aulaad ko Sajdah karne ka hukum diya gaya, aur usne Sajdah kiya to usko Jannat mil gayi, aur mujhe Sajdah karne ka hukum diya gaya, lekin maine inkaar kar diya to main Jahannam ke liye muqarrar ho gaya.

e: A'mash narrated this hadith with the same chain of transmitters, with this change of words that he (the Satan) said: I disobeyed and I am doomed to Hell.
hi: A'mash ne is hadees ko usi sanad ke saath riwayat kiya, is alfaaz ke farq ke saath ki unhone (Shaitan ne) kaha: Maine nafarmaani ki aur main Jahannam ke liye muqarrar ho gaya.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Jabir that he heard the Apostle (may peace and blessings be upon him) saying. Verily between man and between polytheism and unbelief is the negligence of prayer.
hi: Jabir se riwayat hai ki unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Beshak insaan aur shirk aur kufr ke darmiyaan namaz ka tark hi (faraq) hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Zubair that he heard Jabir b. 'Abdullah saying. I heard the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) observing this: Between man and polytheism and unbelief is the abandonment of salat.
hi: Abu Zubair se riwayat hai ki unhone Jabir bin Abdullah ko ye kehte suna: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Insaan aur shirk aur kufr ke darmiyaan namaz chhodna hi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah was asked about the best of deeds. He observed: Belief in Allah. He (the inquirer) said: What next? He (the Holy Prophet) replied: Jihad (struggle to the utmost) in the cause of Allah. He (the inquirer) again said: What next? He (the Holy Prophet) replied: Pilgrimage accepted into the grace of the Lord. In the. tradition narrated on the authority of Muhammad b. Ja'far (the words are) that he (the Holy Prophet) said: Belief in Allah and His Messenger. Muhammad b. Rafi and 'Abd b. Humaid, 'Abdur-Razzaq and Ma'mar and Zuhri have narrated a hadith like this on the authority of the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Rasoolullah (SAW) se sabse behtareen amal ke baare mein poocha gaya. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Allah par imaan. Unhone (poochne wale ne) kaha: Phir kya? Aap (SAW) ne jawaab diya: Allah ki raah mein jihad (poori koshish ke saath). Unhone dobara kaha: Phir kya? Aap (SAW) ne jawaab diya: Wo Hajj jo Allah ki rehmat mein qubool ho jaaye. Muhammad bin Ja'far ki riwayat ki gayi hadees mein (alfaaz hain) ki aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Allah aur Uske Rasool par imaan. Muhammad bin Rafi' aur Abd bin Humaid, Abdur Razzaq aur Ma'mar aur Zuhri ne isi sanad se isi jaisi hadees riwayat ki hai.

e: Abu Dharr reported: I said: Messenger of Allah, which of the deeds is the best? He (the Holy Prophet) replied: Belief in Allah and Jihad in His cause. I again asked: Who is the slave whose emancipation is the best? He (the Holy Prophet) replied: One who is valuable for his master and whose price is high. I said: If I can't afford to do it? He (the Holy Prophet) replied: Help an artisan or make anything for the unskilled (labourer). I (Abu Dharr) said: Messenger of Allah, you see that I am helpless in doing some of these deeds. He (the Holy Prophet) replied: Desist from doing mischief to the people. That is the charity of your person on your behalf.
hi: Abu Dharr ne bataaya: Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, sabse behtareen amal kaunsa hai? Aap (SAW) ne jawaab diya: Allah par imaan aur Uski raah mein jihad. Maine dobara poocha: Sabse behtareen gulaam kaunsa hai jise aazaad karna chahiye? Aap (SAW) ne jawaab diya: Wo jo apne maalik ke liye qeemti ho aur jiski qeemat zyada ho. Maine kaha: Agar mujhme aisa karne ki taaqat na ho? Aap (SAW) ne jawaab diya: Kisi kaarigar ki madad karo ya kisi ghair-hunarmand (mazdoor) ke liye kuch banaao. Maine (Abu Dharr ne) kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, aap dekh rahe hain ki main inmein se kuch amal karne mein bebas hoon. Aap (SAW) ne jawaab diya: Logon ko takleef pahunchaana chhod do. Ye tumhari taraf se tumhare apne liye sadqa hai.

e: Muhammad b. Abu Rafi' narrated the hadith on the authority of Abu Dharr with a slight difference.
hi: Muhammad bin Abu Rafi' ne ye hadees Abu Dharr ki sanad se thode farq ke saath riwayat ki hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud that he observed. I asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) which deed was the best. He (the Holy Prophet) replied: Prayer at its appointed hour. I (again) said: Then what? He (the Holy Prophet) replied: Kindness to the parents. I (again) said: Then what? He replied: Earnest endeavour (Jihad) in the cause of Allah. And I would have not ceased asking more questions but out of regard (for his feelings).
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ood se riwayat hai ki unhone kaha: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) se poocha ki sabse behtareen amal kaunsa hai. Aap (SAW) ne jawaab diya: Namaz apne muqarrar waqt par. Maine (dobara) poocha: Phir kya? Aap (SAW) ne jawaab diya: Waalidain ke saath nekbaani. Maine (dobara) poocha: Phir kya? Aap (SAW) ne jawaab diya: Allah ki raah mein koshish (Jihad). Aur main aur sawaal poochta rehta lekin (unke jazbaat ka khayaal karte hue) rok diya.

e: 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud reported: I said: Messenger of Allah, which of the deeds (takes one) nearer to Paradise? He (the Holy Prophet) replied: Prayer at its proper time, I said: What next, Messenger of Allah? He replied: Kindness to the parents. I said: What next? He replied: Jihad in the cause of Allah.
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ood ne bataaya: Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, kaunsa amal (insaan ko) Jannat ke sabse kareeb le jaata hai? Aap (SAW) ne jawaab diya: Namaz apne muqarrar waqt par. Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, phir kya? Aap (SAW) ne jawaab diya: Waalidain ke saath nekbaani. Maine kaha: Phir kya? Aap (SAW) ne jawaab diya: Allah ki raah mein Jihad.

e: It was heard from Abu 'Amr Shaibani that, pointing towards the house of Abdullah, he said: The owner of this house told me that he asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): Which of the deeds are liked by Allah? He (the Holy Prophet) observed: Prayer at its proper time. I (again) said: What next? He replied: Then goodness to the parents. I (again) said: What then? He replied: Then Jihad in the cause of Allah. He ('Abdullah) said: This is what I was told (by the Holy Prophet). Had I questioned further, he would have made additions for me.
hi: Abu Amr Shaibani se suna gaya ki, Abdullah ke ghar ki taraf ishaara karte hue, unhone kaha: Is ghar ke maalik ne mujhe bataaya ki unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) se poocha: Kaunse amal Allah ko pasand hain? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Namaz apne muqarrar waqt par. Maine (dobara) kaha: Phir kya? Aap (SAW) ne jawaab diya: Phir waalidain ke saath nekbaani. Maine (dobara) kaha: Phir kya? Aap (SAW) ne jawaab diya: Phir Allah ki raah mein Jihad. Unhone (Abdullah ne) kaha: Ye mujhe (Nabi SAW ne) bataaya tha. Agar main aur sawaal poochta, to unhone mere liye aur izafa kiya hota.

e: This hadith has been transmitted by Muhammad b. Bashshar, Muhammad b. Ja'far Shu'ba with this chain of narrators, with the addition that he pointed towards the house of 'Abdullah, but he did not mention his name for us.
hi: Ye hadees Muhammad bin Bashshaar, Muhammad bin Ja'far Shu'ba ne isi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai, is izafe ke saath ki unhone Abdullah ke ghar ki taraf ishaara kiya, lekin unhone humein unka naam nahi bataaya.

e: It is reported on the authority of 'Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah observed: The best of' the deeds or deed is the (observance of) prayer at its proper time and kindness to the parents.
hi: Abdullah se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Sabse behtareen amal ya amal hai (namaz ki) muqarrar waqt par ada karna aur waalidain ke saath nekbaani.

e: 'Abdullah reported: I asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): Which sin is the gravest in the eye of Allah? He (the Holy Prophet) replied: That you associate a partner with Allah (despite the fact) that He has created you. He (the reporter) said: I told him (the, Holy Prophet): Verily it is indeed grave. He (the reporter) said: I asked him what the next (gravest sin) was. He (the Holy Prophet) replied: That you kill your child out of fear that he shall join you in food. He (the reporter) said: I asked (him) what the next (gravest sin) was. He (the Holy Prophet) observed: Then (the next gravest sin) is that you commit adultery with the wife of your neighbour.
hi: Abdullah ne bataaya: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) se poocha: Allah ki nazar mein sabse bada gunah kaunsa hai? Aap (SAW) ne jawaab diya: Ye ki tum Allah ke saath (kisi ko) shareek thehraao jabki usne tumhein paida kiya. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Maine unse (Nabi SAW se) kaha: Beshak ye waaqai bada gunah hai. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Maine unse poocha (ki) uske baad kaunsa (gunah) hai. Aap (SAW) ne jawaab diya: Ye ki tum apne bachche ko is dar se maar do ki wo tumhare saath khaana khaayega. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Maine poocha (ki) uske baad kaunsa (gunah) hai. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Phir (agla bada gunah) ye hai ki tum apne padosi ki biwi ke saath zina karo.

e:
It is narrated on the authority of Abdullah b. Mas'ud that a man said: Messenger of Allah, which offence is the most grievous in the eye of Allah? He (the Holy Prophet) replied: That you associate a partner with Allah (despite the fact) that He created you. He (the man) said: What next?
