He (the Holy Prophet) replied: That you kill your child out of fear that he would join you in food. He (the inquirer) said (again): What next? He (the Holy Prophet) replied: That you commit adultery with the wife of your neighbour. And the Almighty and Exalted Lord testified it (with this verse): 
All those who call not unto another god along with Allah, and slay not any soul which Allah has forbidden, except in the cause of justice, nor commit fornication, and he who does this shall meet a requital of sin (xxv. 68).
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ood se riwayat hai ki ek shaks ne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, Allah ki nazar mein sabse ghinaona gunah kaunsa hai? Aap (SAW) ne jawaab diya: Ye ki tum Allah ke saath (kisi ko) shareek thehraao jabki usne tumhein paida kiya. Unhone (us shaks ne) kaha: Phir kya? Aap (SAW) ne jawaab diya: Ye ki tum apne bachche ko is dar se maar do ki wo tumhare saath khaana khaayega. Poochne waale ne (dobara) kaha: Phir kya? Aap (SAW) ne jawaab diya: Ye ki tum apne padosi ki biwi ke saath zina karo. Aur Allah, Jalle wa Aala, ne is (aayat) ke saath iski tasdeeq ki: 'Aur jo log Allah ke saath kisi doosre ma'bood ko nahi pukaarte, aur us jaan ko qatl nahi karte jise Allah ne haraam kiya hai, sivaay haq ke saath, aur na hi zina karte hain, aur jo aisa kare wo apne gunah ka badla paayega' (25:68).

e: It is narrated on the authority of 'Abdur-Rahman b. Abu Bakra that his father said: We were in the company of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that he observed: Should I not inform you about the most grievous of the grave sins? (The Holy Prophet) repeated it three times, and then said: Associating anyone with Allah, disobedience to parents, false testimony or false utterance. The Prophet was reclining, then he sat up, and he repeated it so many times that we wished that he should become silent.
hi: Abdur Rahman bin Abu Bakra se riwayat hai ki unke waalid ne kaha: Hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ki sohbat mein the ki aap (SAW) ne kaha: Kya main tumhein sabse ghinaone kabeera gunahon ke baare mein na bataaun? (Nabi SAW ne) ise teen baar dohraaya, aur phir farmaya: Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek karna, waalidain ki nafarmaani, jhooti gawahi ya jhooti baat. Nabi (SAW) takiya lagaaye baithe the, phir aap seedhe baith gaye, aur aap ise itni baar dohraate rahe ki humne chaaha ki aap khaamosh ho jaayein.

e: Anas narrated from the Apostle (ﷺ) about the major sins. He (the Holy Prophet) observed: Associating anyone with Allah, disobedience to parents, killing a person and false utterance.
hi: Anas se riwayat hai ki Nabi (SAW) ne bade gunahon ke baare mein bataaya. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Allah ke saath shirk karna, waalidain ki nafarmaani karna, kisi shaks ko qatl karna aur jhooti gawahi dena.

e: Ubaidullah b. Abu Bakr said: I heard Anas b. Malik saying: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) talked about the major sins, or he was asked about the major sins. Upon this he observed: Associating anyone with Allah, killing of a person, disobedience to parents. He (the Prophet further) said: Should I not inform you about the gravest of the major sins, and (in this connection) observed: False utterance or false testimony. Shu'ba said. It was most probably" false testimony".
hi: Ubaidullah bin Abu Bakr ne kaha: Maine Anas bin Malik ko ye kehte suna: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne bade gunahon ke baare mein baat ki, ya unse bade gunahon ke baare mein poocha gaya. Is par aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Allah ke saath shirk karna, kisi shaks ko qatl karna, waalidain ki nafarmaani karna. Aap (SAW) ne (aage) farmaya: Kya main tumhein sabse bade gunahon mein se sabse bada gunah na bataaun, aur (is silsile mein) farmaya: Jhooti baat ya jhooti gawahi. Shu'ba ne kaha: Ye 'jhooti gawahi' hi thi (zyada imkaan).

e: It is reported on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed: Avoid the seven noxious things. It was said (by the hearers): What are they, Messenger of Allah? He (the Holy Prophet) replied: Associating anything with Allah, magic, killing of one whom God has declared inviolate without a just cause, consuming the property of an orphan, and consuming of usury, turning back when the army advances, and slandering chaste women who are believers, but unwary.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Saat halaakat-khez (tabaahkun) cheezon se bacho. (Sunne walon ne) poocha: Ya Rasoolullah, wo kya hain? Aap (SAW) ne jawaab diya: Allah ke saath shirk karna, jaadu karna, kisi jaan ko qatl karna jise Allah ne haram qaraar diya hai, bina kisi jaayaz wajah ke, yateem ka maal khaana, sood khaana, jung ke maidan se peeth dikhaakar bhaagna, aur pakdaaman, ghaafil momin auraton par tohmat lagaana.

e: It is narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah b. Amr b. al-'As that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed: Abusing one's parents is one of the major sins. They (the hearers) said: Messenger of Allah, does a man abuse his parents too? He (the Holy Prophet) replied: Yes, one abuses the father of another man, who in turn abuses his father. One abuses his mother and he in turn abuses his (the former's) mother.
hi: Abdullah bin Amr bin al-Aas se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Apne waalidain ko gaali dena bade gunahon mein se ek hai. (Sunne walon ne) kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, kya koi shaks apne waalidain ko bhi gaali deta hai? Aap (SAW) ne jawaab diya: Haan, koi shaks kisi doosre shaks ke waalid ko gaali deta hai, jo badle mein uske waalid ko gaali deta hai. Koi shaks kisi doosre ki maa ko gaali deta hai, jo badle mein uski (pehle waale ki) maa ko gaali deta hai.

e: This hadith has also been transmitted on the authority of Sa'd b. Ibrahim with this chain of narrators.
hi: Ye hadees Sa'd bin Ibrahim ki isi sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It Is narrated on the authority of Abdullah b. Mas'ud that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), observed: He who has in his heart the weight of a mustard seed of pride shall not enter Paradise. A person (amongst his hearers) said: Verily a person loves that his dress should be fine, and his shoes should be fine. He (the Holy Prophet) remarked: Verily, Allah is Graceful and He loves Grace. Pride is disdaining the truth (out of self-conceit) and contempt for the people.
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ood se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jiske dil mein rai bhar bhi ghamand ho, wo Jannat mein daakhil nahi hoga. (Sunne walon mein se) ek shaks ne kaha: Beshak koi shaks chaahta hai ki uske kapde achhe hon aur uski jootiyaan achhi hon. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Beshak Allah khoobsoorat hai aur khoobsoorati ko pasand karta hai. Ghamand ye hai ki (khud-pasandi mein) haq ko thukra diya jaaye aur logon ko hakeer samjha jaaye.

e: It is narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed: None shall enter the Fire (of Hell) who has in his heart the weight of a mustard seed of Iman and none shall enter Paradise who has in his heart the weight of a mustard seed of pride.
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ood se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jiske dil mein rai bhar bhi imaan ho, wo Jahannam mein daakhil nahi hoga, aur jiske dil mein rai bhar bhi ghamand ho, wo Jannat mein daakhil nahi hoga.

e: It is narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed: He who has in his heart the weight of a mustard seed of pride shall not enter Paradise.
hi: Abdullah se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jiske dil mein rai bhar bhi ghamand ho, wo Jannat mein daakhil nahi hoga.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abdullah b. Mas'ud that Waki told (him) that the Messenger of Allah had observed and Ibn Numair asserted: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: He who dies associating anything with Allah would enter the Fire (of Hell). 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud said: I say that he who died without associating anything with Allah entered Paradise.
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ood se riwayat hai ki Waki' ne (unse) bataaya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya, aur Ibn Numair ne dawa kiya: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo shaks Allah ke saath shirk karte hue mare, wo Jahannam mein daakhil hoga. Abdullah bin Mas'ood ne kaha: Main kehta hoon ki jo bina Allah ke saath shirk kiye mara, wo Jannat mein daakhil hua.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Jabir that a man came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: Messenger of Allah, what are the two things quite unavoidable? He replied: He who dies without associating anyone with Allah would (necessarily) enter Paradise and he who dies associating anything with Allah would enter the (Fire of) Hell.
hi: Jabir se riwayat hai ki ek shaks Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, wo do cheezein kya hain jo bilkul zaroori (aakhri anjaam wali) hain? Aap (SAW) ne jawaab diya: Jo shaks bina Allah ke saath shirk kiye mare, wo (zaroor) Jannat mein daakhil hoga aur jo Allah ke saath shirk karte hue mare, wo Jahannam mein daakhil hoga.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Jabir b. Abdullah: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: He who met Allah without associating anything with Allah entered Paradise and he who met Him associating (anything) with Him entered Fire.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah se riwayat hai: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo bina Allah ke saath shirk kiye Allah se mila, wo Jannat mein daakhil hua, aur jo shirk karte hue Allah se mila, wo Jahannam mein daakhil hua.

e: The same hadith has been narrated by Ishaq b. Mansur on the authority of Jabir with another chain of transmitters.
hi: Yahi hadees Ishaq bin Mansoor ne Jabir ki sanad se, ek doosri sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai.

e: I heard Abu Dharr narrating it from the Apostle (ﷺ) that he observed: Gabriel came to me and gave me the tidings: Verily he who died amongst your Ummah without associating anything with Allah would enter Paradise. I (the narrator) said: Even if he committed adultery and theft. He (the Holy Prophet) said: (Yes), even if he committed adultery and theft.
hi: Maine Abu Dharr ko ye Nabi (SAW) se riwayat karte suna ki aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Jibrael mere paas aaye aur mujhe khushkhabri di: Beshak jo tumhari ummat mein se bina Allah ke saath shirk kiye mara, wo Jannat mein daakhil hoga. Maine (raawi ne) poocha: Chaahe usne zina aur chori bhi ki ho? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: (Haan), chaahe usne zina aur chori bhi ki ho.

e: Abu Dharr reported,: I came to the Apostle (may peace be upon him ) and he was asleep with a white mantle over him. I again came, he was still asleep, I came again and he had awakened. I sat by his side and (the Holy Prophet) observed: There is none among the bondsmen who affirmed his faith in La illaha ill-Allah there is no God but Allah) and died in this state and did not enter Paradise. I (Abu Dharr) said: Even if he committed adultery and theft? He (the Holy Prophet) replied: (Yes) even though he committed adultery and theft. I (again said): Even if he committed adultery and theft? He replied: (Yes) even though he committed adultery and theft. (Th Holy Prophet repeated it three times) and said for the fourth time: In defiance of Abu Dharr. Abu Dharr then went out and he repeated (these words): In defiance of Abu Dharr.
hi: Abu Dharr ne bataaya: Main Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur wo so rahe the, unpar ek safed chaadar thi. Main phir aaya, wo abhi bhi so rahe the, main phir aaya aur wo jaag chuke the. Main unke paas baith gaya aur (Nabi SAW ne) farmaya: Koi banda aisa nahi jo 'La ilaha illallah' (Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi) par imaan laaya ho aur isi haalat mein mara ho aur wo Jannat mein daakhil na ho. Maine (Abu Dharr ne) kaha: Chaahe usne zina aur chori bhi ki ho? Aap (SAW) ne jawaab diya: (Haan) chaahe usne zina aur chori bhi ki ho. Maine (phir poocha): Chaahe usne zina aur chori bhi ki ho? Aap (SAW) ne jawaab diya: (Haan) chaahe usne zina aur chori bhi ki ho. (Nabi SAW ne ise teen baar dohraaya) aur chauthi baar kaha: Abu Dharr ki marzi ke khilaaf hi sahi. Abu Dharr phir baahar nikle aur (ye alfaaz) dohraate rahe: Abu Dharr ki marzi ke khilaaf hi sahi.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Miqdad b. Aswad that he said. Messenger of Allah, you just see (here is a point): If I encountered a person amongst the infidels (in the battlefield) and he attacked me and struck me and cut off one of my hands with the sword. Then he (in order to protect himself from me) took shelter of a tree and said: I become Muslim for Allah's sake. Messenger of Allah, can I kill him after he had uttered this? The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Do not kill him. I (the narrator) said: Messenger of Allah, he cut off my hand and uttered this after amputating it; should I then kill him? The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Don't kill him, for I you kill him, verily he would be in a position where you had been before killing him and verily you would be in a position where he had been before uttering (kalima).
hi: Miqdad bin Aswad se riwayat hai ki unhone kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, zara dekhiye (ye ek maamla hai): Agar maidan-e-jung mein mera saamna kaafiron mein se kisi shaks se ho jaaye aur wo mujhpar hamla kare aur mujhe maare aur talwaar se mera ek haath kaat de. Phir wo (khud ko mujhse bachaane ke liye) ek darakht ki panaah le aur kahe: Main Allah ke liye Musalman ho gaya. Ya Rasoolullah, kya main ye kalima kehne ke baad use qatl kar sakta hoon? Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Use qatl mat karo. Maine (raawi ne) kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, usne mera haath kaata aur ise kaatne ke baad ye kalima kaha; to kya mujhe use qatl kar dena chahiye? Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Use qatl mat karo, kyunki agar tum use qatl karoge, to beshak wo us maqaam par hoga jahan qatl se pehle tum the, aur tum us maqaam par hoge jahan (kalima kehne se pehle) wo tha.

e: The same hadith has been transmitted by the same chain of narrators. The hadith transmitted by Auza'i and Ibn Juraij contains these words: I embraced Islam for Allah's sake. and in the hadith narrated by Ma'mar the words are: I knelt down to kill him, that he said; There is no god but Allah.
hi: Yahi hadees usi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai. Auza'i aur Ibn Juraij ki riwayat ki gayi hadees mein ye alfaaz hain: Maine Allah ke liye Islam qubool kiya. Aur Ma'mar ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: Maine use maarne ke liye ghutne ke bal baithaya tha, tab usne kaha: Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi.

e: It is narrated by Miqdad, and he was an ally of B. Zuhra and was of those who participated in the Battle of Badr along with the Messenger of Allah, that he said: Messenger of Allah, here is a point: If I happened to encounter a person amongst the infidels (in the battle). Then he narrated a hadith similar to the one transmitted by Laith.
hi: Miqdad se riwayat hai, aur wo Bani Zuhra ke hulafa (ittehaadi) mein se the aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath Badr ki jung mein shareek honay walon mein se the, unhone kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, ye ek nukta hai: Agar mera saamna kaafiron mein se kisi (jung mein) se ho jaaye. Phir unhone Laith ki riwayat jaisi hi hadees bayan ki.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Usama b. Zaid that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent us in a raiding party. We raided Huraqat of Juhaina in the morning. I caught hold of a man and he said: There is no god but Allah, I attacked him with a spear. It once occurred to me and I talked about it to the Apostle (ﷺ). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Did he profess" There is no god but Allah," and even then you killed him? I said: Messenger of Allah, he made a profession of it out of the fear of the weapon. He (the Holy Prophet) observed: Did you tear his heart in order to find out whether it had professed or not? And he went on repeating it to me till I wished I had embraced Islam that day. Sa'd said: By Allah, I would never kill any Muslim so long as a person with a heavy belly, i. e., Usama, would not kill. Upon this a person remarked: Did Allah not say this: And fight them until there is no more mischief and religion is wholly for Allah? Sa'd said: We fought so that there should be no mischief, but you and your companions wish to fight so that there should be mischief.
hi: Usama bin Zaid se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne humein ek dasta (chhapa maarne wale) mein bheja. Humne subah Juhaina qabile ke Huraqat par hamla kiya. Maine ek shaks ko pakda aur usne kaha: Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi. Maine use bhaale se maar diya. Ye baat baad mein mujhe khatakti rahi aur maine iske baare mein Rasool (SAW) se baat ki. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Kya usne 'Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi' ka elaan kiya aur phir bhi tumne use maar diya? Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, usne hathiyaar ke dar se ye elaan kiya tha. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Kya tumne uska dil chaak kiya taaki pata chale ki usne sacchayi se ye elaan kiya ya nahi? Aur aap ye baat mujhse baar-baar dohraate rahe yahan tak ki main chaahne laga ki kaash maine us din Islam qubool kiya hota. Sa'd ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, main kisi Musalman ko kabhi nahi maarunga jab tak ek bhaari pet wala shaks, yaani Usama, na maare. Is par ek shaks ne kaha: Kya Allah ne ye nahi farmaya: 'Aur unse lado jab tak fitna khatam na ho jaaye aur deen poori tarah Allah ke liye na ho jaaye'? Sa'd ne kaha: Hum is liye ladte the taaki fitna na rahe, lekin tum aur tumhare saathi chaahte ho ki fitna paida ho.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Usama b. Zaid: The Messenger of Allah may peace be upon him) sent us to Huraqat, a tribe of Juhaina. We attacked that tribe early in the morning and defeated them and I and a man from the Ansar caught hold of a person (of the defeated tribe). When we overcame him, he said: There is no god but Allah. At that moment the Ansari spared him, but I attacked him with my spear and killed him. The news had already reached the Apostle (peace be upon him), so when we came back he (the Apostle) said to me: Usama, did you kill him after he had made the profession: There is no god but Allah? I said. Messenger of Allah, he did it only as a shelter. The Prophet observed: Did you kill him after he had made the profession that there is no god but Allah? He (the Holy Prophet) went on repeating this to me till I wished I had not embraced Islam before that day.
hi: Usama bin Zaid se riwayat hai: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne humein Huraqat, Juhaina ka ek qabila, ki taraf bheja. Humne subah subah us qabile par hamla kiya aur unhein shikast di aur main aur Ansaar ka ek shaks ne (haare hue qabile ke) ek shaks ko pakad liya. Jab hum uspar ghaalib aa gaye, to usne kaha: Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi. Us waqt Ansaari ne use chhod diya, lekin maine use apne bhaale se maar diya aur qatl kar diya. Ye khabar Rasoolullah (SAW) tak pehle hi pahunch chuki thi, is liye jab hum wapas aaye to unhone mujhse kaha: Usama, kya tumne use uska 'Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi' ka elaan karne ke baad maara? Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, usne aisa sirf panaah lene ke liye kiya tha. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Kya tumne use uska 'Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi' ka elaan karne ke baad maara? Aap (SAW) mujhse ye baar-baar dohraate rahe yahan tak ki main chaahne laga ki kaash main us din se pehle Islam qubool na kiya hota.

e: It is narrated by Safwan b. Muhriz that Jundab b. 'Abdullah al-Bajali during the stormy days of Ibn Zubair sent a message to 'As'as b. Salama: Gather some men of your family so that I should talk to them. He ('As'as) sent a messenger to them (to the members of his family). When they had assembled, Jundab came there with a yellow hooded cloak on him, He said: Talk what you were busy in talking. The talk went on by turns, till there came his (Jundab's) turn. He took off the hooded cloak from his head and said: I have come to you with no other intention but to narrate to you a hadith of your Apostle: Verily the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent a squad of the Muslims to a tribe of the polytheists. Both the armies confronted one another. There was a man among the army of polytheists who (was so dashing that), whenever he intended to kill a man from among the Muslims, he killed him. Amongst the Muslims too was a man looking forward to (an opportunity of) his (the polytheist's) unmindfulness. He (the narrator) said: We talked that he was Usama b, Zaid. When he raised his sword, he (the soldier of the polytheists) uttered:" There is no god but Allah," but he (Usama b. Zaid) killed him. When the messenger of the glad tidings came to the Apostle (ﷺ) he asked him (about the events of the battle) and he informed him about the man (Usama) and what he had done He (the Prophet of Allah) called for him and asked him why he had killed him. He (Usama) said: Messenger of Allah, he struck the Muslims and killed such and such of them. And he even named some of them. (He continued): I attacked him and when he saw the sword he said: There is no god but Allah. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Did you kill him? He (Usama) replied in the affirmative. He (the Holy Prophet) remarked: What would you do with:" There is no god but Allah," when he would come (before you) on the Day of Judgment? He (Usama) said: Messenger of Allah, beg pardon for me (from your Lord). He (the Holy Prophet) said: What would you do with:" There is no god but Allah" when he would come (before you) on the Day of Judgment? He (the Holy Prophet) added nothing to it but kept saying: What would you do with:" There is no god but Allah," when he would come (before you) on the Day of Judgment?
hi: Safwan bin Muhriz se riwayat hai ki Ibn Zubair ke pur-hangaama dinon mein Jundab bin Abdullah al-Bajali ne As'as bin Salama ko paighaam bheja: Apne khaandan ke kuch logon ko jama karo taaki main unse baat kar sakoon. Unhone (As'as ne) unke paas ek qaasid bheja. Jab wo jama ho gaye, to Jundab wahan ek peeli hooded (kapde ki) chaadar pehne aaye. Unhone kaha: Jo baat kar rahe the wo karo. Baari-baari se baatein hoti rahin, yahan tak ki unki (Jundab ki) baari aayi. Unhone apne sar se chaadar ka hood utaara aur kaha: Main tumhare paas kisi aur maqsad se nahi aaya sivaay iske ki tumhein tumhare Rasool ki ek hadees sunaaun: Beshak Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Musalmanon ka ek dasta mushrikeen ke ek qabile ki taraf bheja. Dono fauje aamne-saamne aa gayin. Mushrikeen ki fauj mein ek shaks tha jo (itna tez tha ki) jab bhi wo Musalmanon mein se kisi ko maarne ka iraada karta, use maar deta. Musalmanon mein bhi ek shaks tha jo uski (mushrik ki) ghaflat ke mauqe ka intezaar kar raha tha. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Humne baat ki ki wo Usama bin Zaid the. Jab usne (Usama ne) apni talwaar uthaayi, to usne (mushrik ne) 'Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi' kaha, lekin usne (Usama bin Zaid ne) use maar diya. Jab khushkhabri dene wala Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya, to aap (SAW) ne unse poocha aur usne unhein us shaks (Usama) aur usne jo kiya uske baare mein bataaya. Aap ne unhein bulaaya aur poocha ki unhone use kyun maara. Unhone (Usama ne) kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, usne Musalmanon par hamla kiya aur unmein se falaan-falaan ko maar daala. Aur unhone kuch ke naam bhi liye. (Unhone aage kaha:) Maine uspar hamla kiya aur jab usne talwaar dekhi to usne kaha: Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Kya tumne use maar diya? Unhone (Usama ne) haan mein jawaab diya. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Tum 'Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi' ka kya karoge jab wo Qayamat ke Din (tumhare saamne) aayega? Unhone (Usama ne) kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, mere liye (apne Rab se) maghfirat ki dua kijiye. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Tum 'Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi' ka kya karoge jab wo Qayamat ke Din (tumhare saamne) aayega? Aap (SAW) ne iske alaawa kuch nahi kaha, balki yahi dohraate rahe: Tum 'Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi' ka kya karoge jab wo Qayamat ke Din (tumhare saamne) aayega?

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abdullah b. Umar who narrates from the Prophet of Allah (ﷺ) who said: He who took up arms against us is not of us.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar se riwayat hai, jo Allah ke Nabi (SAW) se riwayat karte hain, unhone farmaya: Jisne humare khilaaf hathiyaar uthaaya wo humme se nahi hai.

e: Iyas b. Salama narrated from his father that the Apostle (ﷺ) observed: He who draws the sword against us is not of us.
hi: Iyas bin Salama ne apne waalid ki sanad se riwayat ki ki Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Jo humare khilaaf talwaar khenche wo humme se nahi hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Musa Ash'ari: He who took up arms against us is not of us.
hi: Abu Musa Ash'ari se riwayat hai: Jisne humare khilaaf hathiyaar uthaaya wo humme se nahi hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed: He who took up arms against us is not of us and he who acted dishonestly towards us is not of us.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jisne humare khilaaf hathiyaar uthaaya wo humme se nahi hai aur jisne humare saath dhoka kiya wo humme se nahi hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) happened to pass by a heap of eatables (corn). He thrust his hand in that (heap) and his fingers were moistened. He said to the owner of that heap of eatables (corn): What is this? He replied: Messenger of Allah, these have been drenched by rainfall. He (the Holy Prophet) remarked: Why did you not place this (the drenched part of the heap) over other eatables so that the people could see it? He who deceives is not of me (is not my follower).
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ka guzar (anaaj) khaane ki cheezon ke ek dher ke paas se hua. Aap (SAW) ne apna haath usmein daala aur unki ungliyan geeli ho gayin. Aap (SAW) ne un khaane ki cheezon ke dher ke maalik se poocha: Ye kya hai? Usne jawaab diya: Ya Rasoolullah, ye baarish ki wajah se bheeg gaya hai. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Tumne isko (bheegi hui hissa) baaki khaane ki cheezon ke upar kyun nahi rakha taaki log ise dekh sakein? Jo dhoka kare wo mujhse nahi hai (mera peirokaar nahi hai).

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abdullah b. Mas'ud that the Prophet observed: He is not one of us (one among the Ummah of Islam) who beat the cheeks or tore the front opening of the shirt or uttered the slogans of (the days of) Jahiliya (ignorance). Ibn Numair and Abu Bakr said (instead of the word" au" (or) it is" wa"  the words are) and tore and uttered (the slogans) of Jahiliya without" alif".
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ood se riwayat hai ki Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Wo humme se (Islam ki ummat mein se) nahi hai jo gaal peete ya qamees ka aagla hissa phaade ya Jahiliyat (kufr ke zamaane) ke naare lagaaye. Ibn Numair aur Abu Bakr ne kaha (lafz 'au' yaani 'ya' ke bajaaye 'wa' yaani 'aur' alfaaz hain) aur phaada aur bagair 'alif' ke (jaahiliyat) ka naara lagaaya.

e: This hadith has been narrated by A'mash with the same chain of narrators and the transmitters said: He tore and called.
hi: Ye hadees A'mash ne isi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai aur raawiyon ne kaha: Usne phaada aur pukaara.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Burda b. Abu Musa that Abu Musa was afflicted with grave pain and he became unconscious and his head was in the lap of a lady of his household. One of the women of his household walled. He (Abu Musa) was unable (because of weakness) to say anything to her. But when he was a bit recovered he said: I have no concern with one with whom the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) has no concern, Verily the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) has no concern with that woman who wails loudly, shaves her hair and tears (her garment in grief).
hi: Abu Burda bin Abu Musa se riwayat hai ki Abu Musa ko sakht dard ne ghere liya aur wo behosh ho gaye aur unka sar unke ghar ki ek aurat ki god mein tha. Unke ghar ki ek aurat ne bain (naala-o-fariyaad) shuru kar diya. Wo (Abu Musa, kamzori ki wajah se) usse kuch keh nahi paaye. Lekin jab unhein thodi hosh aayi, to unhone kaha: Mera koi taalluq us shaks se nahi jiska Rasoolullah (SAW) se koi taalluq nahi. Beshak Rasoolullah (SAW) ka us aurat se koi taalluq nahi jo zor se bain karti hai, apne baal mundwaati hai, aur (gham mein apne kapde) phaadti hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Burda that Abu Musa fell unconscious and his wife Umm Abdullah came there and wailed loudly. When he felt relief he said: Don't you know? -and narrated to her: Verily the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: I have no concern with one who shaved her hair, lamented loudly and tore (her clothes in grief).
hi: Abu Burda se riwayat hai ki Abu Musa behosh ho gaye aur unki biwi Umm Abdullah wahan aayin aur zor se bain karne lagi. Jab unhein aaraam mehsoos hua, to unhone kaha: Kya tumhein nahi pata? - aur unhone use bataaya: Beshak Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Mera us se koi taalluq nahi jo apne baal mundwaaye, zor se naala-o-fariyaad kare, aur (gham mein apne kapde) phaade.

e: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Abu Musa with this change only: That (the Holy Prophet) did not say that he had no concern but said: He is not one of us.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Musa ki sanad se bayan ki gayi hai, sirf is farq ke saath: ki aap (SAW) ne 'mera taalluq nahi' nahi kaha balki farmaya: Wo humme se nahi hai.

e: It is reported from Hudhaifa that news reached him (the Holy Prophet) that a certain man carried tales. Upon this Hudhaifa remarked: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying: The tale-bearer shall not enter Paradise.
hi: Huzaifa se riwayat hai ki unhein khabar mili ki fulaan shaks chughli karta hai. Is par Huzaifa ne kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Chughlkhor Jannat mein daakhil nahi hoga.

e: It is reported on the authority of Hammam b, al-Harith that a man used to carry tales to the governor. We were sitting in the mosque. the people said: He is one who carries tales to the governor. He (the narrator) said: Then he came and sat with us. Thereupon Hudhaifa remarked: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: The beater of false tales would never enter heaven.
hi: Hammam bin al-Harith se riwayat hai ki ek shaks governor ke paas chughliyaan le jaya karta tha. Hum masjid mein baithe the. Logon ne kaha: Ye wahi hai jo governor ke paas chughliyaan le jaata hai. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Phir wo aaya aur hamare saath baith gaya. Is par Huzaifa ne kaha: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jhooti chughliyaan phailaane wala kabhi Jannat mein daakhil nahi hoga.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Hammam b. al-Harith: We were sitting with Hudhaifa in the mosque. A man came and sat along with us. It was said to Hudhaifa that he was the man who carried tales to the ruler. Hudhaifa remarked with the intention of conveying to him: I have heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: The tale-bearer will not enter Paradise.
hi: Hammam bin al-Harith se riwayat hai: Hum Huzaifa ke saath masjid mein baithe the. Ek shaks aaya aur hamare saath baith gaya. Huzaifa se kaha gaya ki ye wahi shaks hai jo hukumraan ke paas chughliyaan le jaata hai. Huzaifa ne, use sunane ki niyyat se, kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Chughlkhor Jannat mein daakhil nahi hoga.

e: It is narrated o the authority of Abu Dharr that the Messenger of Allah (may ace he upon him) observed: Three are the (persons) with whom Allah would neither speak on the Day of Resurrection, nor would look at them nor would absolve the and there is a painful chastisement for them. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) repeated it three times. Abu Dharr remarked: They failed and they lost; who are these persons, Messenger of Allah? Upon this he (the Holy) Prophet) observed: They are: the dragger of lower garment, the recounter of obligation the seller of goods by false oath.
hi: Abu Dharr se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Teen (log) hain jinse Allah Qayamat ke Din na baat karega, na unki taraf dekhega aur na unhein paak karega, aur unke liye dardnaak azaab hai. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne ise teen baar dohraaya. Abu Dharr ne kaha: Wo naakaam ho gaye aur unka nuqsaan hua; ye kaun log hain, Ya Rasoolullah? Is par Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Wo hain: apna izaar (kapda) ghaseetne wala, ehsaan jataane wala, aur jhooti qasam khaakar apna maal bechne wala.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Dharr who narrates that the Prophet (ﷺ) observed: Three are the persons with whom Allah would not speak on the Day of Resurrection: the bestower of gift who does not give anything but by laying obligation on him, the seller of goods who sells them by taking false oath and one who hangs low his lower garment.
hi: Abu Dharr se riwayat hai ki Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Teen log hain jinse Allah Qayamat ke Din baat nahi karega: aisa tohfa dene wala jo bina ehsaan jataaye kuch nahi deta, jhooti qasam khaakar apna maal bechne wala, aur apna izaar neeche latkaane wala.

e: Bishr b. Khalid has narrated this hadith on the authority of Sulaiman with the same chain of transmitters with this addition: Allah shall neither speak nor look at nor absolve then, and there is a tormenting punishment for them.
hi: Bishr bin Khalid ne is hadees ko Sulaiman ki isi sanad se, is izafe ke saath riwayat kiya hai: Allah na unse baat karega, na unki taraf dekhega, aur na unhein paak karega, aur unke liye azaab-e-aleem hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed: Three (are the persons) with whom Allah would neither speak, nor would He absolve them on the Day of Resurrection. Abu Mu'awiya added: He would not look at them and there is grievous torment for them: the aged adulterer, the liar king and the proud destitute.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Teen (log) hain jinse Allah Qayamat ke Din na baat karega, na unhein paak karega. Abu Mu'awiya ne izafa kiya: Na unki taraf dekhega, aur unke liye dardnaak azaab hai: budha zaani, jhoota badshah, aur takabbur karne wala muflis.

e: Abu Huraira narrated on the authority of Abu Bakr that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Three are the persons with whom Allah would neither speak on the Day of Resurrection, nor would He look towards them, nor would purify them (from sins), and there would be a tormenting chastisement for them: a person who in the waterless desert has more water (than his need) and he refuses to give it to the traveller and a person who sold a commodity to another person in the afternoon and took an oath of Allah that he had bought it at such and such price and he (the buyer) accepted it to be true though it was not a fact, and a person who pledged allegiance to the Imam but for the sake of the world (material gains). And if the Imam bestowed on him (something) out of that (worldly riches) he stood by his allegiance and if he did not give him, he did not fulfil the allegiance.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Abu Bakr ki sanad se riwayat ki ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Teen log hain jinse Allah Qayamat ke Din na baat karega, na unki taraf dekhega, aur na unhein (gunahon se) paak karega, aur unke liye dardnaak azaab hai: wo shaks jiske paas registaan mein (apni zaroorat se) zyada paani ho aur wo musaafir ko dene se inkaar kare; aur wo shaks jisne doosre shaks ko dopahar ke baad koi cheez bechi aur Allah ki qasam khaakar kaha ki usne fulaan-fulaan keemat par ye khareeda tha, aur (khareedaar ne) us baat ko sach maan liya jabki wo haqeeqat nahi thi; aur wo shaks jisne Imam se bay'at ki sirf duniyaawi (maddi) faayde ke liye. Aur agar Imam ne usmein se kuch use diya to wo apni bay'at par qaayam raha aur agar usne nahi diya to usne bay'at poori nahi ki.

e: The same hadith has been transmitted by another chain of transmitters with the exception of these words: He offered for sale a commodity to another person.
hi: Yahi hadees ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai, sivaay in alfaaz ke: Usne doosre shaks ko koi cheez bikri ke liye pesh ki.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that he (the Messenger of Allah) observed: Three are the persons with whom Allah would neither speak (on the Day of Resurrection) nor would He look at them, and there would be a painful chastisement for them, a person who took an oath on the goods of a Muslim in the afternoon and then broke it. The rest of the hadith is the same as narrated by A'mash.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai ki (Rasoolullah SAW ne) farmaya: Teen log hain jinse Allah (Qayamat ke Din) na baat karega na unki taraf dekhega, aur unke liye dardnaak azaab hoga, wo shaks jisne dopahar ke baad kisi Musalman ke maal par qasam khaayi aur phir use tod diya. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai jaisi A'mash ne bayan ki.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed: He who killed himself with steel (weapon) would be the eternal denizen of the Fire of Hell and he would have that weapon in his hand and would be thrusting that in his stomach for ever and ever, he who drank poison and killed himself would sip that in the Fire of Hell where he is doomed for ever and ever; and he who killed himself by falling from (the top of) a mountain would constantly fall in the Fire of Hell and would live there for ever and ever.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jisne apne aap ko lohe (hathiyaar) se qatl kiya, wo hamesha ke liye Jahannam ki aag mein rahega aur wahi hathiyaar uske haath mein hoga aur wo use hamesha apne pet mein maarta rahega; jisne zeher peekar khudkushi ki, wo usi zeher ko Jahannam ki aag mein hamesha ke liye ghoont-ghoont peeta rahega, jahan wo hamesha ke liye rahega; aur jisne pahaad se gir kar khudkushi ki, wo hamesha Jahannam ki aag mein girta rahega aur wahin hamesha ke liye rahega.

e: This hadith has been narrated by another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Thabit b. Dahhak reported that he pledged allegiance to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) under the Tree, and verily the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed: He who took an oath of a religion other than Islam, in the state of being a liar, would became so, as he professed. He who killed himself with a thing would be tormented on the Day of Resurrection with that very thing. One is not obliged to offer votive offering of a thing which is not in his possession.
hi: Thabit bin Dahhaak se riwayat hai ki unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) se darakht ke neeche bay'at ki, aur beshak Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jisne jhoota hote hue Islam ke alaawa kisi aur deen ki qasam khaayi, wo waisa hi ho jaayega jaisa usne dawa kiya. Jisne khud ko kisi cheez se qatl kiya, use Qayamat ke Din usi cheez se azaab diya jaayega. Koi shaks aisi cheez ki mannat (nazar) maanne ka pabund nahi hai jo uske paas nahi hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Thabit b. al-Dahhak that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observes: None is obliged to give votive offering (of a thing) which is not in his possession and the cursing of a believer is tantamount to killing him, and he who killed himself with a thing in this world would be tormented with that (very thing) on the Day of Resurrection, and he who made a false claim to increase (his wealth), Allah would make no addition but that of paucity, and he who perjured would earn the wrath of God
hi: Thabit bin al-Dahhaak se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Koi shaks aisi cheez ki mannat maanne ka pabund nahi hai jo uske paas nahi hai, aur kisi momin par laanat karna uske qatl karne ke barabar hai, aur jisne is duniya mein khud ko kisi cheez se qatl kiya, use Qayamat ke Din usi cheez se azaab diya jaayega, aur jisne apne maal mein izaafa karne ke liye jhooti nasab ka dawa kiya, Allah use sirf kami (nuqsaan) hi dega, aur jisne jhooti gawahi di wo Allah ka gussa kamaayega.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Thabit b. Dahhak that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed: He who took deliberately a false oath on a religion other than Islam would become that which he had professed. And he who killed himself with anything Allah would torment him with that in the Fire of Hell.
hi: Thabit bin Dahhaak se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jisne jaan-boojh kar Islam ke alaawa kisi aur deen par jhooti qasam khaayi, wo waisa hi ban jaayega jaisa usne dawa kiya. Aur jisne khud ko kisi cheez se qatl kiya, Allah use usi cheez se Jahannam ki aag mein azaab dega.

e: In the hadith narrated by Shu'ba the words are: Verily the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: He who took an oath on a religion other than Islam as a liar would become so as he said, and he who slaughtered himself with a thing would be slaughtered with that on the Day of Resurrection.
hi: Shu'ba ki riwayat ki gayi hadees mein alfaaz hain: Beshak Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jisne Islam ke alaawa kisi aur deen ki qasam khaayi aur jhoot bola, wo waisa hi ban jaayega jaisa usne kaha, aur jisne khud ko kisi cheez se qatl kiya, wo Qayamat ke Din usi (cheez) se qatl kiya jaayega.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira: We participated in the Battle of Hunain along with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He (the Holy Prophet) said about a man who claimed to be a Muslim that he was one of the denizens of the Fire (of Hell). When we were in the thick of the battle that man fought desperately and was wounded. It was said: Messenger of Allah, the person whom you at first called as the denizen of Fire fought desperately and died. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) remarked: He was doomed to the Fire (of Hell). Some men were on the verge of doubt (about his fate) when it was said that he was not dead but fatally wounded. When it was night he could not stand the (pain of his) wound and killed himself. The Apostle (ﷺ) was informed of that. He (the Holy Prophet) observed: Allah is Great, I bear testimony to the fact that I am the servant of Allah and His messenger. He then commanded Bilal to announce to the people that none but a Muslim would enter Paradise. Verily Allah helps this faith even by a sinful person.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai: Hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath Hunain ki jung mein shareek the. Aap (SAW) ne ek shaks ke baare mein, jo Musalman hone ka dawa karta tha, farmaya ki wo Jahannami hai. Jab hum jung ke ainn beech mein the, to us shaks ne bahaduri se jung ki aur zakhmi ho gaya. Kaha gaya: Ya Rasoolullah, jis shaks ko aapne pehle Jahannami kaha tha, usne bahaduri se jung ki aur mar gaya. Is par Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Wo Jahannam ke liye muqarrar ho gaya tha. Kuch log (uske anjaam ke baare mein) shaq mein padne lage jab bataaya gaya ki wo mara nahi balki bahut zakhmi hai. Jab raat hui to wo (apne zakham ke dard ki) taab na laa saka aur khud ko maar diya. Rasool (SAW) ko iski khabar di gayi. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Allah sabse bada hai, main gawahi deta hoon ki main Allah ka banda aur Uska Rasool hoon. Phir aap (SAW) ne Bilal (RA) ko hukum diya ki wo logon ko elaan kar dein ki Jannat mein sirf Momin hi daakhil hoga. Beshak Allah is deen ki madad ek gunahgaar shaks ke zariye bhi karta hai.

e: It is reported on the authority of Sahl b. Sa'd al-Sa'idi that there was an encounter between the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and the polytheists, and they fought (against one another). At the conclusion of the battle the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) bent his steps towards his army and they (the enemies) bent their steps towards their army. And there was a person (his name was Quzman and he was one of the hypocrites) among the Companions of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) who did not spare a detached (fighter of the enemy) but pursued and killed him with the sword. They (the Companions of the Holy Prophet) said: None served us better today than this man Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) remarked: Verily he is one of the denizens of Fire. One of the people (Muslims) said: I will constantly shadow him. Then this man went out along with him. He halted whenever he halted, and ran along with him whenever he ran. He (the narrator) said: The man was seriously injured. He (could not stand the pain) and hastened his own death. He placed the blade of the sword on the ground with the tip between his chest and then pressed himself against the sword and killed himself. Then the man (following him) went to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: I bear testimony that verily thou art the Messenger of Allah, He (the Holy Prophet) said: What is the matter? He replied: The person about whom you just mentioned that he was one among the denizens of Fire and the people were surprised (at this) and I said to them that I would bring (the news about him) and consequently I went out in search of him till I (found him ) to be very seriously injured. He hastened his death. He placed the blade of the sword upon the ground and its tip between his chest and then pressed himself against that and killed himself. Thereupon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) remarked: A person performs the deeds which to the people appear to be the deeds befitting the dweller of Paradise, but he is in fact one of the denizens of Hell. And verily a person does an act which in the eyes of public is one which is done by the denizens of Hell, but the person is one among the dwellers of Paradise.
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd al-Sa'idi se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) aur mushrikeen ke darmiyaan ek muqaabla hua, aur unhone ek doosre se jung ki. Jung ke aakhir mein Rasoolullah (SAW) apni fauj ki taraf mud gaye aur wo (dushman) apni fauj ki taraf mud gaye. Aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ke Sahaba mein ek shaks tha (uska naam Quzman tha aur wo munafiqeen mein se tha) jo dushman ke kisi alag-thalag shaks ko bhi nahi chhodta tha balki uska peecha karke use talwaar se maar deta tha. Unhone (Sahaba ne) kaha: Aaj hummein se kisi ne humari itni behtar khidmat nahi ki jitni ye shaks. Is par Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Beshak wo Jahannamiyon mein se hai. Logon mein se ek ne kaha: Main lagataar uske peeche rahunga. Phir ye shaks uske saath nikla. Jab wo (Quzman) rukta, to ye bhi rukta, aur jab wo daudta, to ye bhi uske saath daudta. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Wo shaks (Quzman) bahut zakhmi ho gaya tha. Wo (dard ki taab na laate hue) apni maut jaldi lena chaahta tha. Usne talwaar ki dhaar zameen par rakhi, uski nok apne seene ke beech rakhi, aur phir apne aap ko talwaar par dabaaya aur khud ko maar liya. Phir wo shaks (peecha karne wala) Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas gaya aur kaha: Main gawahi deta hoon ki aap waaqai Allah ke Rasool hain. Aap (SAW) ne kaha: Kya baat hai? Usne jawaab diya: Jis shaks ke baare mein aapne abhi zikr kiya tha ki wo Jahannamiyon mein se hai aur log (is par) hairaan ho gaye the aur maine unse kaha tha ki main (iski khabar) le kar aaunga, is liye main uski talaash mein nikla yahan tak ki main use bahut hi zakhmi paaya. Usne apni maut jaldi le li. Usne talwaar ki dhaar zameen par rakhi thi aur uski nok apne seene ke beech, phir usne apne aap ko uske khilaaf dabaaya aur khud ko maar diya. Is par Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Ek shaks aise amal karta hai jo logon ko Jannatiyon ke amal jaise lagte hain, lekin haqeeqat mein wo Jahannamiyon mein se hota hai. Aur beshak ek shaks aisa amal karta hai jo aam logon ki nazar mein Jahannamiyon ke amal jaise hote hain, lekin wo shaks Jannatiyon mein se hota hai.

e: It is reported on the authority of Hasan: A person belonging to the people of the past suffered from a boil, when it pained him, he drew out an arrow from the quiver and pierced it. And the bleeding did not stop till he died. Your Lord said: I forbade his entrance into Paradise. Then he (Hasan) stretched his hand towards the mosque and said: By God, Jundab transmitted this hadith to me from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in this very mosque.
hi: Hasan se riwayat hai: Guzashta logon mein se ek shaks ko phoda nikla tha, jab wo dard karne laga, to usne apne teerdaan se ek teer nikaala aur use chubho diya. Aur khoon bahna band nahi hua yahan tak ki wo mar gaya. Tumhaare Rab ne farmaya: Maine uska Jannat mein daakhila mana kar diya. Phir unhone (Hasan ne) masjid ki taraf apna haath badhaaya aur kaha: Allah ki qasam, Jundab ne mujhe ye hadees isi masjid mein Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki thi.

e: It is reported on the authority of Hasan: Jundab b. 'Abdullah al-Bajali narrated this hadith in this mosque which we can neither forget and at the same time we have no apprehension that Jundab could attribute a lie to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He (the Holy Prophet) observed: A person belonging to the people of the past suffered from a boil, and then the rest of the hadith was narrated.
hi: Hasan se riwayat hai: Jundab bin Abdullah al-Bajali ne ye hadees isi masjid mein bayan ki jise hum na bhool sakte hain aur na hi humein ye khadsha hai ki Jundab Rasoolullah (SAW) par jhoot mad sakte hain. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Guzashta logon mein se ek shaks ko phoda nikla tha, phir baaki hadees bayan ki gayi.

e: It is narrated on the authority of 'Umar b. Khattab that when it was the day of Khaibar a party of Companions of the Apostle (ﷺ) came there and said: So and so is a martyr, till they happened to pass by a man and said: So and so is a martyr. Upon this the Messenger of Allah remarked: Nay, not so verily I have seen him in the Fire for the garment or cloak that he had stolen from the booty, Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Umar son of Khattab, go and announce to the people that none but the believers shall enter Paradise. He ('Umar b. Khattab) narrated: I went out and proclaimed: Verily none but the believers would enter Paradise.
hi: Umar bin Khattab se riwayat hai ki jab Khaibar ka din tha, Rasoolullah (SAW) ke Sahaba ka ek giroh wahan aaya aur kaha: Falaan shaheed hai, yahan tak ki unka guzar ek shaks ke paas se hua aur unhone kaha: Falaan shaheed hai. Is par Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Nahi, aisa nahi hai, beshak maine use us kapde ya chaadar ki wajah se aag mein dekha hai jo usne ganeemat mein se chura liya tha. Phir Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Umar bin Khattab, jao aur logon ko elaan kar do ki sirf Momin hi Jannat mein daakhil honge. Unhone (Umar bin Khattab ne) bayan kiya: Main nikla aur elaan kiya: Beshak sirf Momin hi Jannat mein daakhil honge.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira: We went to Khaibar along with the Apostle (ﷺ) and Allah granted us victory. We plundered neither gold nor silver but laid our hands on goods, corn and clothes, and then bent our stops to a valley; along with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) there was a slave who was presented to him by one Rifa'a b. Zaid of the family of Judham, a tribe of Dubayb. When we got down into the valley the slave of the Messenger of Allah stood up and began to unpack the saddle-bag and was suddenly struck by a (stray) arrow which proved fatal. We said: There is a greeting for him, Messenger of Allah, as he is a martyr. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) remarked: Nay, not so. By Him in Whose hand is the life of Muhammad, the small garment which he stole from the booty on the day of Khaibar but which did not (legitimately) fall to his lot is burning like the Fire (of Hell) on him. The people were greatly perturbed (on hearing this). A person came there with a lace or two laces and said: Messenger of Allah, I found (them) on the day of Khaibar. He (the Holy Prophet) remarked: This is a lace of fire or two laces of fire.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai: Hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath Khaibar gaye aur Allah ne humein fatah di. Humne na sona lootaa na chaandi balki humne saamaan, anaaj aur kapdon par haath rakha, phir hum ek waadi ki taraf mud gaye; Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath ek ghulaam tha jo unhein Rifa'a bin Zaid, Judham qabile ke Dubaib khaandan mein se, ne peish kiya tha. Jab hum waadi mein utre, to Rasoolullah (SAW) ka wo ghulaam khada hua aur zeen ka thaila kholna shuru kiya to achanak ek (bhatakte hue) teer se maara gaya jo jaan-leva saabit hua. Humne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, uske liye Jannat ki mubaarakbaad ho, kyunki wo shaheed hai. Is par Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Nahi, aisa nahi hai. Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein Muhammad ki jaan hai, wo choti si chaadar jo usne Khaibar ke din ganeemat se churayi thi lekin jo (jaayez tareeqe se) uske hisse mein nahi aayi thi, us par (Jahannam ki) aag ki tarah jal rahi hai. Log (ye sunkar) bahut pareshaan hue. Ek shaks ek ya do jootiyon ke fite lekar aaya aur kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, mujhe (ye) Khaibar ke din mile the. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Ye aag ka ek fita hai ya aag ke do fite hain.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Jabir that Tufail son of Amr al-Dausi came to the Apostle (ﷺ) and said: Do you need strong, fortified protection? The tribe of Daus had a fort in the pre-Islamic days. The Apostle (ﷺ) declined this offer, since it (the privilege of protecting the Holy Prophet) had already been reserved for the Ansar. When the Apostle (ﷺ) migrated to Medina, Tufail son of Amr also migrated to that place, and there also migrated along with him a man of his tribe. But the climate of Medina did not suit him, and he fell sick. He felt very uneasy. So he took hold of an iron head of an arrow and cut his finger-joints. The blood streamed forth from his hands, till he died. Tufail son of Amr saw him in a dream. His state was good and he saw him with his hands wrapped. He (Tufail) said to him: What treatment did your Allah accord to you? He replied. Allah granted me pardon for my migration to the Apostle (ﷺ): He (Tufail) again said: What is this that I see you wrapping up your hands? He replied: I was told (by Allah): We would not set right anything of yours which you damaged yourself. Tufail narrated this (dream) to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). Upon this he prayed: O Allah I grant pardon even to his hands.
hi: Jabir se riwayat hai ki Tufail bin Amr al-Dausi Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: Kya aapko koi mazboot, qile jaisi panaah chaahiye? Daus qabile ka Islam se pehle ek qila tha. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne is peshkash ko mana kar diya, kyunki ye (aapki hifazat ka sharaf) pehle hi Ansaar ke liye mahfooz ho chuka tha. Jab Rasoolullah (SAW) Madina hijrat kar gaye, to Tufail bin Amr bhi wahan hijrat kar gaye, aur unke saath unke qabile ka ek shaks bhi hijrat kar gaya. Lekin Madina ki aab-o-hawa unhein raas nahi aayi, aur wo bimaar pad gaye. Wo bahut behchain ho gaye. Is liye unhone ek teer ka lohe ka phal liya aur apne ungliyon ke jodon ko kaat diya. Unke haathon se khoon behta raha, yahan tak ki wo mar gaye. Tufail bin Amr ne unhein khwaab mein dekha. Unki haalat achhi thi aur unhone unhein apne haath lapete hue dekha. Unhone (Tufail ne) unse kaha: Tumhare Allah ne tumhare saath kaisa sulook kiya? Unhone jawaab diya: Allah ne mujhe Rasool (SAW) ki taraf hijrat karne ki wajah se maghfirat di. Unhone (Tufail ne) phir kaha: Ye kya hai ki main dekh raha hoon ki tum apne haath lapete hue ho? Unhone jawaab diya: Mujhse (Allah ki taraf se) kaha gaya: Hum tumhari us cheez ko theek nahi karenge jise tumne khud nuqsaan pahunchaya. Tufail ne ye (khwaab) Rasoolullah (SAW) ko sunaaya. Is par aap (SAW) ne dua ki: Aye Allah, uske haathon ko bhi maghfirat de.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Verily Allah would make a wind to blow from the side of the Yemen more delicate than silk and would spare none but cause him to die who, in the words of Abu 'Alqama, has faith equal to the weight of a grain; while Abdul-'Aziz said: having faith equal to the weight of a dust particle.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Beshak Allah Yemen ki taraf se ek hawa chalaayega jo resham se bhi zyada narm hogi, aur wo har us shaks ko mara degi jiske dil mein - jaisa ki Abu Alqama ke alfaaz hain - ek daane ke barabar bhi imaan hoga; jabki Abdul Aziz ne kaha: gard ke ek zarre ke barabar imaan.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed: Be prompt in doing good deeds (before you are overtaken) by turbulence which would be like a part of the dark night. During (that stormy period) a man would be a Muslim in the morning and an unbeliever in the evening or he would be a believer in the evening and an unbeliever in the morning, and would sell his faith for worldly goods.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Nek amal karne mein jaldi karo (is se pehle ki tumhein) aisi hangaame ne aa gher liya jo andheri raat ke ek hisse jaisa hoga. Us dauraan ek shaks subah Musalman aur shaam kaafir hoga, ya shaam ko momin aur subah kaafir hoga, aur duniyawi cheezon ke badle apna imaan bech dega.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik that when this verse: " O ye who believe I raise not your voices above the voice of the Prophet, nor shout loud unto him in discourse, as ye shout loud unto one another, lest your deeds should become null and void, while you perceive not" (xlix. 2-5), was revealed. Thabit b. Qais confined himself in his house and said: I am one of the denizens of Fire, and he deliberately avoided coming to the Apostle (ﷺ). The Apostle (ﷺ) asked Sa'd b, Mu'adh about him and said, Abu Amr, how is Thabit? Has he fallen sick? Sa'd said: He is my neighbour, but I do not know of his illness. Sa'd came to him (Thabit), and conveyed to him the message of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). Upon this Thabit said: This verse was revealed, and you are well aware of the fact that, amongst all of you, mine is the voice louder than that of the Messenger of Allah, and so I am one amongst the denizens of Fire, Sa'd Informed the Prophet about it. Upon this the Messenger of Allah observed: (Nay, not so) but he (Thabit) is one of the dwellers of Paradise.
hi: Anas bin Malik se riwayat hai ki jab ye aayat nazil hui: 'Aye imaan waalo! Apni aawazein Nabi ki aawaz se oonchi mat karo, na hi unse itni zor se baat karo jitni tum ek doosre se karte ho, kahin tumhare a'maal zaaya na ho jaayein aur tumhein khabar bhi na ho' (49:2-5), to Thabit bin Qais apne ghar mein band ho gaye aur kaha: Main Jahannamiyon mein se hoon, aur unhone jaan-boojh kar Rasool (SAW) ke paas aana chhod diya. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Sa'd bin Mu'adh se unke baare mein poocha aur farmaya: Abu Amr, Thabit kaise hain? Kya wo bimaar hain? Sa'd ne kaha: Wo mera padosi hai, lekin mujhe uski bimaari ke baare mein pata nahi. Sa'd unke (Thabit ke) paas aaye, aur unhein Rasoolullah (SAW) ka paighaam pahunchaya. Is par Thabit ne kaha: Ye aayat nazil hui, aur tumhein pata hai ki tum sabme se meri aawaz Rasoolullah (SAW) ki aawaz se zyada oonchi hai, is liye main Jahannamiyon mein se hoon. Sa'd ne ye baat Nabi (SAW) ko bataayi. Is par Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: (Nahi, aisa nahi hai) balki wo (Thabit) Jannatiyon mein se hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik by another chain of transmitters in which these words are found: Thabit b. Qais was the orator of the Ansar, when this verse was revealed: the rest of the hadith is the same with the exception that there is no mention of Sa'd b. Mu'adh in it.
hi: Ye hadees Anas bin Malik ki ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai jismein ye alfaaz hain: Thabit bin Qais Ansaar ke khatib the, jab ye aayat nazil hui: baaki hadees waisi hi hai, sivaay iske ki usmein Sa'd bin Mu'adh ka zikr nahi hai.

e: This hadith is also transmitted by Ahmad b. Sa'id, Habban, Sulaiman b. Mughira on the authority of Anas who said: When the verse was revealed:" Do not raise your voice louder than the voice of the Apostle," no mention was made of Sa'd b, Mu'adh in it.
hi: Ye hadees Ahmad bin Sa'id, Habban, Sulaiman bin Mughira ne bhi Anas ki sanad se riwayat ki hai jinhone kaha: Jab ye aayat nazil hui: 'Apni aawaz Rasool (SAW) ki aawaz se oonchi mat karo,' to usmein Sa'd bin Mu'adh ka koi zikr nahi kiya gaya.

e: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Anas by another chain of transmitters in which there is no mention of Sa'd b. Mu'adh, but the following words are there: We observed a man, one of the dwellers of Paradise, walking about amongst us.
hi: Ye hadees Anas ki ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai jismein Sa'd bin Mu'adh ka koi zikr nahi hai, lekin ye alfaaz hain: Humne ek shaks ko dekha, Jannatiyon mein se ek, humare beech chalte hue.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abdullah b. Mas'ud that some people said to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): Messenger of Allah, would we be held responsible for our deeds committed in the state of ignorance (before embracing Islam)? Upon his he (the Holy Prophet) remarked: He who amongst you performed good deeds in Islam, He would not be held responsible for them (misdeeds which he committed in ignorance) and he who committed evil (even after embracing Islam) would be held responsible or his misdeeds that he committed in the state of ignorance as well as in that of Islam.
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ood se riwayat hai ki kuch logon ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, kya humein jaahiliyat ke zamaane mein kiye gaye (gunahon ke) amal ke liye zimmedaar theharaya jaayega? Is par aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Jisne tum mein se Islam mein achhe amal kiye, use unke (jaahiliyat ke gunahon ke) liye zimmedaar nahi theharaya jaayega, aur jisne (Islam qubool karne ke baad bhi) burayi ki, use jaahiliyat aur Islam dono ke amal ke liye zimmedaar theharaya jaayega.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abdullah b. Mas'ud: We once said: Messenger of Allah, would we be held responsible for our deeds committed in the state of ignorance? He (the Holy Prophet) observed: He who did good deeds in Islam would not be held responsible for what he did in the state of ignorance, but he who committed evil (after having come within the fold of Islam) would be held responsible for his previous and later deeds.
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ood se riwayat hai: Humne ek baar kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, kya humein jaahiliyat ke zamaane mein kiye gaye amal ke liye zimmedaar theharaya jaayega? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Jisne Islam mein achhe amal kiye, use jaahiliyat ke zamaane ke amal ke liye zimmedaar nahi theharaya jaayega, lekin jisne (Islam ke daayre mein aane ke baad) burayi ki, use uske pehle aur baad dono ke amal ke liye zimmedaar theharaya jaayega.

e: This hadith has been transmitted by Minjab b. al-Harith Tamimi with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Minjab bin al-Harith Tamimi ne isi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Ibn Shamasa Mahri that he said: We went to Amr b. al-As and he was about to die. He wept for a long time and turned his face towards the wall. His son said: Did the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him not give you tidings of this? Did the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) not give you tidings of this? He (the narrator) said: He turned his face (towards the audience) and said: The best thing which we can count upon is the testimony that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. Verily I have passed through three phases. (The first one) in which I found myself averse to none else more than I was averse to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and there was no other desire stronger in me than the one that I should overpower him and kill him. Had I died in this state, I would have been definitely one of the denizens of Fire. When Allah instilled the love of Islam in my heart, I came to the Apostle (ﷺ) and said: Stretch out your right hand so that may pledge my allegiance to you. He stretched out his right hand, I withdrew my hand, He (the Holy Prophet) said: What has happened to you, O 'Amr? replied: I intend to lay down some condition. He asked: What condition do you intend to put forward? I said: should be granted pardon. He (the Holy Prophet) observed: Are you not aware of the fact that Islam wipes out all the previous (misdeeds)? Verily migration wipes out all the previous (misdeeds), and verily the pilgrimage wipes out all the (previous) misdeeds. And then no one as or dear to me than the Messenger of Allah and none was more sublime in my eyes than he, Never could I, pluck courage to catch a full glimpse of his face due to its splendour. So if I am asked to describe his features, I cannot do that for I have not eyed him fully. Had I died in this state had every reason to hope that I would have bee among the dwellers of Paradise. Then we were responsible for certain things (in the light of which) I am unable to know what is in store for me. When I die, let neither female mourner nor fire accompany me. When you bury me, fill my grave well with earth, then stand around it for the time within which a camel is slaughtered and its meat is distributed so that I may enjoy your intimacy and (in your company) ascertain what answer I can give to the messengers (angels) of Allah.
hi: Ibn Shamasa Mahri se riwayat hai ki unhone kaha: Hum Amr bin al-As ke paas gaye aur wo marne hi waale the. Wo bahut der tak rote rahe aur apna chehra deewaar ki taraf mod liya. Unke bete ne kaha: Kya Rasoolullah (SAW) ne aapko iski khushkhabri nahi di thi? Kya Rasoolullah (SAW) ne aapko iski khushkhabri nahi di thi? Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Unhone apna chehra mod liya aur kaha: Sabse behtareen cheez jispar hum bharosa kar sakte hain wo gawahi hai ki Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi aur Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain. Beshak main teen daur se guzra hoon. (Pehla daur wo tha) jismein maine khud ko kisi aur cheez se zyada Rasoolullah (SAW) se naaraaz paaya, aur mujhme kisi aur khwaahish se zyada is baat ki khwaahish thi ki main unpar ghaalib aakar unhein maar daalun. Agar main is halat mein mar jaata, to yaqeenan main Jahannamiyon mein se hota. Jab Allah ne mere dil mein Islam ki mohabbat daali, to main Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Apna daayaan haath badhaiye taaki main aapse bay'at kar sakoon. Unhone apna daayaan haath badhaaya, maine apna haath kheench liya. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Amr, tumhein kya hua? Maine jawaab diya: Main kuch shart rakhna chaahta hoon. Unhone poocha: Tum kaunsi shart rakhna chaahte ho? Maine kaha: Ki mujhe maaf kar diya jaaye. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Kya tumhein nahi pata ki Islam pehle ki tamaam badkariyon ko mita deta hai? Beshak hijrat pehle ki tamaam badkariyon ko mita deti hai, aur beshak Hajj pehle ki tamaam badkariyon ko mita deta hai. Aur phir mujhe Rasoolullah (SAW) se zyada koi aziz aur aziz na tha, aur unse zyada mere nazron mein koi baland na tha. Main kabhi bhi himmat na jutaa saka ki unke chehre ko poori tarah nihaar sakun, uski shaan ki wajah se. Is liye agar mujhse unki khoobiyon ka bayaan karne ko kaha jaaye, to main aisa nahi kar sakta, kyunki maine unhein poori tarah dekha hi nahi. Agar main is halat mein mar jaata, to mujhe poori ummeed hoti ki main Jannatiyon mein se hota. Phir hum kuch cheezon ke zimmedaar the jinki roshni mein main nahi jaanta ki mere liye kya muqarrar hai. Jab main mar jaaun, to na koi roone waali aurat aur na aag mere saath jaaye. Jab tum mujhe dafnao, to meri qabr par achhi tarah mitti daalo, phir uske ird-gird itni der khade raho jitni der mein ek oont zibah karke uska gosht baanta jaata hai, taaki main tumhari qurbat se mahzooz ho sakoon aur tumhari sohbat mein ye pata laga sakoon ki main Allah ke qaasidon (farishton) ko kya jawaab de sakta hoon.

e:
It is narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that some persons amongst the polytheist had committed a large number of murders and had excessively indulged in fornication. Then they came to Muhammad (ﷺ) and said: Whatever you assert and whatever you call to is indeed good. But if you inform us that there is atonement of our past deeds (then we would embrace Islam). Then it was revealed: 
And those who call not unto another god along with Allah and slay not any soul which Allah has forbidden except in the cause of justice, nor commit fornication; and he who does this shall meet the requital of sin. Multiplied for him shall be the torment on the Day of Resurrection, and he shall therein abide disgraced, except him who repents a believes and does good deeds. Then these! for the Allah shall change their vices into virtues. Verily Allah is Ever Forgiving, Merciful (xxv. 68-70). 
Say thou: O my bondsmen woo have committed extravagance against themselves despair not of the Mercy of Allah I Verily Allah will forgive the sins altogether. He is indeed the Forgiving, the Merciful (xxxix. 53).
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ki mushrikeen mein se kuch logon ne bahut saare qatl kiye the aur zina mein bhi had se zyada mubtala rahe the. Phir wo Muhammad (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: Jo bhi aap kehte hain aur jiski taraf aap bulaate hain wo waaqai achha hai. Lekin agar aap humein bataayein ki humare pichhle amal ka koi kaffaara hai (to hum Islam qubool kar lenge). Is par ye (aayaten) nazil hui: 'Aur wo log jo Allah ke saath kisi doosre ma'bood ko nahi pukaarte aur us jaan ko qatl nahi karte jise Allah ne haraam kiya hai sivaay haq ke, aur na zina karte hain; aur jo aisa karta hai wo gunah ki saza paayega. Qayamat ke Din uske liye azaab dugna kar diya jaayega, aur wo usmein zaleel hoke hamesha rahega, sivaay us shaks ke jo tauba kare, imaan laaye, aur nek amal kare. To in logon ke, Allah unki badkariyon ko nekiyon mein badal dega. Aur Allah beshak Bahut Maaf Karne Wala, Meherbaan hai' (25:68-70). 'Kaho: Aye mere bandon jinhone apne haq mein zyaadti ki hai, Allah ki rehmat se maayoos mat ho! Beshak Allah tamaam gunahon ko maaf kar dega. Wo waaqai Maaf Karne Wala, Meherbaan hai' (39:53).

e: Hakim b. Hizam reported to 'Urwa b. Zubair that he said to the Messenger of Allah: Do you think that there is any thing for me (of he reward with the Lord) for the deed of religious purification that I did in the state of ignorance? Upon this he (the Messenger of Allah) said to him: You accepted Islam with all the previous virtues that you practised.
hi: Hakim bin Hizam ne Urwah bin Zubair ko bataaya ki unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) se kaha: Kya aapki raay hai ki jaahiliyat ke zamaane mein maine jo tahaarat (yaani sadqa, achhi baatein) kiye the unke liye mere liye (Allah ke paas) koi ajr hai? Is par unhone (Rasoolullah SAW ne) unse kaha: Tumne Islam qubool kiya us tamaam achhaai ke saath jo tumne pehle amal ki thi.

e: Hakim b. Hizam reported to 'Urwa b. Zubair that he said to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): Messenger of Allah, do you think if there is any reward (of the Lord with me on the Day of Resurrection) for the deeds of religious purification that I performed in the state of ignorance, such as charity, freeing a slave, cementing of blood-relations? Upon this he (the Messenger of Allah) said to him: You have accepted Islam with all the previous virtues that you had practised.
hi: Hakim bin Hizam ne Urwah bin Zubair ko bataaya ki unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) se kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, kya aapki raay hai ki agar Qayamat ke Din Allah ki taraf se mere liye koi ajr hai un tahaarat ke amaal ke liye jo maine jaahiliyat ke zamaane mein kiye, jaise sadqa, ghulaam aazaad karna, rishtedaaron se talluq jodna? Is par unhone (Rasoolullah SAW ne) unse kaha: Tumne Islam qubool kiya us tamaam achhaai ke saath jo tumne pehle amal ki thi.

e: It is narrate on the authority of Hakim b. Hizam: I said: Messenger of Allah, I did so some of the deeds in the state of ignorance. (One of the transmitters Hisham b. Urwa explained them as acts of piety. Upon this the Messenger, of Allah remarked: You have embraced Islam with all the previous acts of virtue. I said: By God, I would leave nothing undone in Islam the like of which I did in the state of ignorance.
hi: Hakim bin Hizam se riwayat hai: Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, maine jaahiliyat ke zamaane mein kuch amal kiye the. (Ek raawi Hisham bin Urwah ne unhein neki ke amal ke taur par tashreeh ki.) Is par Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Tumne Islam qubool kiya us tamaam achhaai ke saath jo tumne pehle amal ki thi. Maine kaha: Allah ki qasam, main Islam mein waisa hi achha amal karna nahi chhodunga jaisa maine jaahiliyat mein kiya tha.

e: Hisham b. Urwa narrated it on the authority of his father: Hakim b. Hizam freed one hundred slave and donated one hundred camels (for the sake of Allah) during the state of ignorance. Then he freed one hundred slaves and donated one hundred camel (for the sake of Allah) after) he had embraced Islam. He subsequently came to the Apostle (ﷺ). The rest of the hadith is the same as narrated above.
hi: Hisham bin Urwah ne apne waalid ki sanad se riwayat ki: Hakim bin Hizam ne jaahiliyat ke zamaane mein sau (100) ghulaam aazaad kiye aur sau (100) oont sadqa kiye (Allah ki raah mein). Phir unhone Islam qubool karne ke baad bhi sau ghulaam aazaad kiye aur sau oont sadqa kiye. Phir wo Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai jaisi upar bayan hui.

e: It is narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah (b. Mas'ud) that when this verse was revealed: " It is those who believe and confound not their belief with wrongdoing" (vi. 82), the Companions of the Messenger of Allah wore greatly perturbed. They said: Who amongst us (is so fortunate) that he does not wrong himself? Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) remarked: It does not mean that which you presume It implies that which Luqman said to his son: O my son, do not associate anything with Allah, for indeed it is the gravest wrongdoing (xxxi. 13).
hi: Abdullah (bin Mas'ood) se riwayat hai ki jab ye aayat nazil hui: 'Jo log imaan laaye aur apne imaan ko zulm ke saath mila nahi dete' (6:82), to Rasoolullah (SAW) ke Sahaba bahut pareshaan ho gaye. Unhone kaha: Hummein se kaun hai jo apne aap par zulm nahi karta? Is par Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Iska wo matlab nahi jo tum samajh rahe ho. Iska matlab wahi hai jo Luqman ne apne bete se kaha: Aye mere bete, Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek na karo, kyunki beshak ye sabse bada zulm hai (31:13).

e: This hadith is narrated by another chain of transmitters, (namely) lshaq b. Ibrahim. Ibn Idris says: My father transmitted it from Aban b. Taghlib who heard it from A'mash; then I heard it also from him (A'mash).
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai, (yaani) Ishaq bin Ibrahim. Ibn Idris kehte hain: Mere waalid ne ise Aban bin Taghlib se riwayat kiya jinhone ise A'mash se suna; phir maine bhi ise unse (A'mash se) suna.

e: It is reported on the authority of Abu Huraira that when it was revealed to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): To Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth and whether you disclose that which is in your mind or conceal it, Allah will call you to account according to it. Then He forgives whom He pleases and chastises whom He Pleases; and Allah is over everything Potent" (ii. 284). the Companions of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) felt it hard and severe and they came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and sat down on their knees and said: Messenger of Allah, we were assigned some duties which were within our power to perform, such as prayer, fasting, struggling (in the cause of Allah), charity. Then this (the above-mentioned) verse was revealed unto you and it is beyond our power to live up to it. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Do you intend to say what the people of two books (Jews and Christians) said before you:" We hear and disobey"? You should rather say:" We hear and we obey, (we seek) Thy forgiveness, our Lord! and unto Thee is the return." And they said:" We hear and we obey, (we seek) Thy forgiveness, Our Lord! and unto Thee is the return." When the people recited it and it smoothly flowed on their tongues, then Allah revealed immediately afterwards:" The Apostle believes in that which is sent down unto him from his Lord, and so do the believers. Each one believes in Allah and His Angels and His Books and His Apostles, saying: We differentiate not between any of His Apostles and they say: We hearken and we obey: (we seek) Thy forgiveness, our Lord! and unto Thee is the return" (ii. 285). When they did that, Allah abrogated this (verse) and the Great, Majestic Allah revealed:" Allah burdens not a soul beyond its capacity. It gets every good that it earns and it suffers every ill that it earns. Our Lord, punish us not if we forget or make a mistake." (The Prophet said: ) Yes, our Lord! do not lay on us a burden as Thou didst lay on those before us. (The Prophet said: ) Yes, our Lord, impose not on us (burdens) which we have not the strength to bear (The Prophet said: ) Yes, and pardon us and grant us protection! and have mercy on us. Thou art our Patron, so grant us victory over the disbelieving people" (ii. 286). He (the Lord) said: Yes.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki jab Rasoolullah (SAW) par ye nazil hua: 'Allah hi ka hai jo aasmaanon mein hai aur jo zameen mein hai, aur chaahe tum apne dil ki baat zaahir karo ya chhupaao, Allah tumse iska hisaab lega. Phir wo jise chaahega maaf karega aur jise chaahega azaab dega; aur Allah har cheez par qaadir hai' (2:284), to Rasoolullah (SAW) ke Sahaba ko ye bahut mushkil aur sakht lagi aur wo Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aaye aur apne ghutnon ke bal baith gaye aur kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, humein kuch zimmedaariyan di gayi thi jo humari taaqat mein thi, jaise namaz, roza, jung (Allah ki raah mein), sadqa. Phir ye aayat aap par nazil hui aur ismein aana humari taaqat se baahar hai. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Kya tum wahi kehna chaahte ho jo tumse pehle do kitaabon waalon (Yahudi aur Isaaiyon) ne kaha: 'Humne suna aur nafarmaani ki'? Balki tumhein kehna chahiye: 'Humne suna aur hum itaa'at karte hain, hum maangte hain Teri maghfirat, hamaare Rab! aur Teri hi taraf laut kar jaana hai.' Aur unhone (Sahaba ne) kaha: 'Humne suna aur hum itaa'at karte hain, hum maangte hain Teri maghfirat, hamaare Rab! aur Teri hi taraf laut kar jaana hai.' Jab logon ne ise padha aur ye unki zubaano par rawaan ho gaya, to Allah ne foran uske baad ye nazil kiya: 'Rasool imaan laaya us par jo unke Rab ki taraf se unpar nazil kiya gaya, aur imaan waale bhi. Har koi Allah, Uske Farishton, Uski Kitabon, aur Uske Rasoolon par imaan laata hai, yeh kehte hue: Hum Uske Rasoolon mein se kisi mein farq nahi karte, aur wo kehte hain: Hum sunte hain aur itaa'at karte hain: hum maangte hain Teri maghfirat, hamaare Rab! aur Teri hi taraf laut kar jaana hai' (2:285). Jab unhone aisa kiya, to Allah ne ise mansookh kar diya (yaani mushkil hukum ko nirasit kiya), aur Buzurg, Baa-Azmat Allah ne nazil kiya: 'Allah kisi jaan par uski taaqat se zyada bojh nahi daalta. Usko wahi milta hai jo usne kamaaya, aur usko wahi bhugatna padta hai jo usne kamaaya. Hamaare Rab, humein saza mat de agar hum bhool jaayein ya galti kar baithein.' (Nabi (SAW) ne kaha:) Haan, hamaare Rab! Hampar utna bojh mat daal jitna Tune humse pehle logon par daala. (Nabi (SAW) ne kaha:) Haan, hamaare Rab, humpar aisa bojh mat daal jise uthaane ki humari taaqat nahi. (Nabi (SAW) ne kaha:) Haan, aur humein maaf kar aur humein hifazat de! Aur hampar reham kar. Tu hamaara Sarparast hai, is liye humein kaafir logon par fatah de' (2:286). Unhone (Allah ne) kaha: Haan.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas: When this verse:" Whether you disclose that which is in your mind or conceal it, Allah will call you to account according to it" (ii 284), there entered in their minds something (of that fear) such as had never entered their hearts (before). The Apostle (ﷺ) observed: Say: We have heard and obeyed and submitted ourselves. He (the reporter) said: Allah instilled faith in their hearts and He revealed this verse:" Allah burdens not a soul beyond its capacity. It gets every good that it earns and it suffers every ill that it earns. Our Lord, call us not to account if we forget or make a mistake. He the (Lord) said: I indeed did it. Our Lord! do not lay on us a burden as Thou didst lay on those before us. He (our Lord) said: I indeed did it. And pardon us, have mercy on us. Thou art our Protector" (ii. 286). He said: I indeed did it.
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai: Jab ye aayat (nazil hui): 'Chaahe tum apne dil ki baat zaahir karo ya chhupaao, Allah tumse iska hisaab lega' (2:284), to unke dilon mein aisa dar daakhil hua jaisa pehle kabhi unke dilon mein daakhil nahi hua tha. Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Kaho: Humne suna aur itaa'at ki aur apne aap ko supurd kar diya. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Allah ne unke dilon mein imaan daala aur ye aayat nazil ki: 'Allah kisi jaan par uski taaqat se zyada bojh nahi daalta. Usko wahi milta hai jo usne kamaaya, aur usko wahi bhugatna padta hai jo usne kamaaya. Hamaare Rab, humein saza mat de agar hum bhool jaayein ya galti kar baithein.'
