Unhone (Rab ne) kaha: Maine ye kar diya hai. 'Hamaare Rab, hampar utna bojh mat daal jitna Tune humse pehle logon par daala.' Unhone (hamaare Rab ne) kaha: Maine ye kar diya hai. 'Aur humein maaf kar, hampar reham kar. Tu hamaara Sarparast hai.' Unhone kaha: Maine ye kar diya hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed: Verily Allah forgave my people the evil promptings which arise within their hearts as long as they did not speak about them or did not act upon them.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Beshak Allah ne meri ummat ko un buri baaton ke liye maaf kar diya jo unke dilon mein zaahir hoti hain, jab tak wo unke baare mein baat na karein ya unpar amal na karein.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed: Verily the Great and Mighty Allah forgave my people the evil promptings arising in their minds, but they neither talked about them nor acted upon them.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Beshak Buzurg aur Baa-Azmat Allah ne meri ummat ko un buri baaton ke liye maaf kar diya jo unke zehnon mein paida hoti hain, lekin unhone na to unke baare mein baat ki aur na unpar amal kiya.

e: The same hadith has been narrated by Zuhair b. Harb, Waki, Ishaq b. Mansur, Husain b. 'Ali.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhair bin Harb, Waki, Ishaq bin Mansoor, Husain bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne riwayat ki hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The Great and the Glorious Lord said (to angels): Whenever My servant intends to commit an evil, do not record it against him, but if he actually commits it, then write it as one evil. And when he intends to do good but does not do it, then take it down is one act of goodness, but if he does it, then write down ten good deeds (in his record).
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Buzurg aur Baa-Azmat Rab ne (farishton se) farmaya: Jab bhi mera banda koi burayi karne ka iraada kare, use uske khilaaf mat likho, lekin agar wo waaqai kar de, to use ek burayi ke taur par likh do. Aur jab wo achhaai karne ka iraada kare lekin na kare, to use ek achhe amal ke taur par likh do, lekin agar wo kare, to use das nekiyan (uske record mein) likh do.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed: Allah, the Great and Glorious, said: Whenever my bondsman intends to do good, but does not do it, I write one good act for him, but if he puts it into practice I wrote from ten to seven hundred good deeds in favour of him. When he intends to commit an evil, but does not actually do it, do not record it. But if he does it, I write only one evil.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Allah, Buzurg aur Baa-Azmat, ne farmaya: Jab bhi mera banda achhaai karne ka iraada kare lekin na kare, main uske liye ek achha amal likh deta hoon, lekin agar wo use amal mein laaye, to main uske haq mein das se saat sau (700) tak nekiyan likh deta hoon. Jab wo koi burayi karne ka iraada kare, lekin waaqai na kare, to main use nahi likhta. Lekin agar wo kare, to main sirf ek burayi likhta hoon.

e: Abu Huraira reported that Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), said: When it occurs to my bondsman that he should do a good deed but he actually does not do it, record one good to him, but if he puts it into practice, I make an entry of ten good acts in his favour. When it occurs to him to do evil, but he does not commit it, I forgive that. But if he commits it, I record one evil against his name. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed. The angels said: That bondsman of Yours intends to commit evil. though His Lord is more Vigilant than he. Upon this He (the Lord) said: Watch him; if he commits (evil), write it against his name but if he refrains from doing it, write one good deed or him, for he desisted from doing it for My sake. The Messenger of Allah said: He who amongst you is good of faith, all his good acts are multiplied from ten to seven hundred times (and are recorded in his name) and all the evils that he commits are recorded as such (i, e. without increase) till he meets Allah.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya ki Muhammad, Rasoolullah (SAW), ne farmaya: Jab mere bande ke dil mein aaye ki wo koi achha amal kare lekin wo waaqai na kare, to uske liye ek achhai darj karo, lekin agar wo use amal mein laaye, to main uske haq mein das achhe amal darj karta hoon. Jab uske dil mein burayi karne ka khayaal aaye, lekin wo use na kare, to main use maaf kar deta hoon. Lekin agar wo kare, to main uske naam ke saamne ek burayi darj karta hoon. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Farishton ne kaha: Tera wo banda burayi karne ka iraada rakhta hai, halaanki uska Rab usse zyada khabardaar hai. Is par unhone (Rab ne) farmaya: Uspar nazar rakho; agar wo burayi kare, to use uske naam ke saamne likh do, lekin agar wo isse baaz aa jaaye, to uske liye ek achhai likh do, kyunki usne mere waaste isse parhez kiya. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Tum mein se jiska imaan achha hai, uske sab achhe amal das se saat sau (700) guna kar diye jaate hain (aur uske naam par darj kiye jaate hain) aur wo tamaam burayiyan jo wo karta hai unhein waisa hi (yaani bagair izafe ke) darj kiya jaata hai, yahan tak ki wo Allah se milta hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed: He who intended to do good, but did not do it, one good was recorded for him, and he who intended to do good and also did it, ten to seven hundred good deeds were recorded for him. And he who intended evil, but did not commit it, no entry was made against his name, but if he committed that, it was recorded.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jisne achhaai karne ka iraada kiya lekin use na kiya, uske liye ek achhai darj ki gayi, aur jisne achhaai ka iraada kiya aur use kiya bhi, uske liye das se saat sau (700) tak nekiyan darj ki gayin. Aur jisne burayi ka iraada kiya, lekin use na kiya, uske naam ke saamne koi entry darj nahi ki gayi, lekin agar usne wo kiya, to use darj kar liya gaya.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Ibn Abbas that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) transmitted it from the Blessed and Great Lord: Verily Allah recorded the good and the evil and then made it clear that he who intended good but did not do it, Allah recorded one complete good in his favour, but if he intended it and also did it, the Glorious and Great Allah recorded ten to seven hundred virtues and even more to his credit. But it he intended evil, but did not commit it, Allah wrote down full one good in his favour. If he intended that and also committed it, Allah made an entry of one evil against him.
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne ise Mubarak, Buzurg Rab se riwayat kiya: Beshak Allah ne achhaai aur burayi darj ki aur phir ye waazeh kiya ki jisne achhaai ka iraada kiya lekin use na kiya, Allah ne uske haq mein ek poori achhai darj ki, lekin agar usne iska iraada kiya aur use kiya bhi, to Baa-Azmat aur Buzurg Allah ne das se saat sau (700) ya usse bhi zyada nekiyan uske naam par darj ki. Lekin agar usne burayi ka iraada kiya, lekin use na kiya, Allah ne uske haq mein poori ek achhai likh di. Agar usne iska iraada kiya aur use bhi kiya, to Allah ne uske khilaaf ek burayi darj ki.

e: This hadith has been narrated with another chain of transmitters with the addition of these words: Allah would even wipe out (the evil committed by a man) and Allah does not put to destruction anyone except he who is doomed to destruction.
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai, is izafe ke saath: Allah (kisi shaks ke kiye hue) gunah ko mita bhi deta hai, aur Allah kisi ko tabaah nahi karta sivaay us shaks ke jiski tabaahi muqarrar ho.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that some people from amongst the Companions of the Apostle (ﷺ) came to him and said: Verily we perceive in our minds that which every one of us considers it too grave to express. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Do you really perceive it? They said: Yes. Upon this he remarked: That is the faith manifest.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ke Sahaba mein se kuch log unke paas aaye aur kaha: Beshak hum apne zehnon mein aisi cheezein mehsoos karte hain jinhein hum mein se har koi zubaan se kehna bahut bada gunah samajhta hai. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Kya tum waaqai isko mehsoos karte ho? Unhone kaha: Haan. Is par aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Yehi zaahir imaan hai.

e: The same hadith has been transmitted by Muhammad b. 'Amr, Abu Baker b. Ishaq, Abu'l-Jawwab, A'mash and Abu Huraira.
hi: Ye hadees Muhammad bin Amr, Abu Bakr bin Ishaq, Abul-Jawwab, A'mash aur Abu Huraira ne riwayat ki hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud that the Apostle (ﷺ) was asked about evil prompting, to which he replied: It is pure faith.
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ood se riwayat hai ki Rasool (SAW) se buri wasoosaon ke baare mein poocha gaya, is par aap (SAW) ne jawaab diya: Ye khaalis imaan hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Men will continue to question one another till this is propounded: Allah created all things but who created Allah? He who found himself confronted with such a situation should say: I affirm my faith in Allah.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Log ek doosre se sawaal poochte rahenge yahan tak ki ye poocha jaayega: Allah ne har cheez paida ki, lekin Allah ko kisne paida kiya? Jo shaks khud ko is halat mein paaye, use kehna chahiye: Main Allah par imaan laata hoon.

e: This hadith has been transmitted by Mahmud b. Ghailan by another chain of transmitters (and the words are): The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The Satan will come to everyone of you and say: Who created the heaven, who created the earth? (And the man) replies: It is Allah, Then the remaining part of the hadith was narrated as mentioned above and the words 'His prophets" were added to it.
hi: Ye hadees Mahmud bin Ghailan ne ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki hai (aur alfaaz ye hain): Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Shaitan tum mein se har ek ke paas aayega aur kahega: Aasman kisne banaaya, zameen kisne banaayi? (Aur wo shaks) jawaab dega: Allah ne. Phir baaki hadees waisi hi bayan ki gayi jaisi upar zikr hui, aur ismein 'uske Nabiyon' ke alfaaz ka izafa kiya gaya.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah may peace be upon him) observed: The Satan comes to everyone. of you and says: Who created this and that? till he questions: Who created your Lord? When he comes to that, one should seek refuge in Allah and keep away (from such idle thoughts).
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Shaitan tum mein se har ek ke paas aata hai aur kahta hai: Ye kisne banaaya, wo kisne banaaya? yahan tak ki wo poochta hai: Tumhaare Rab ko kisne banaaya? Jab wo is (sawaal) tak pahunche, to use Allah ki panaah maangni chahiye aur (aise khyaalon se) door reh jaana chahiye.

e: This hadith is transmitted by Urwa b. Zubair on the authority of Abu Huraira (and the words are): The Satan comes to the bondsman (of Allah) and says: Who created this and that? The remaining part of the hadith is the same.
hi: Ye hadees Urwah bin Zubair ne Abu Huraira ki sanad se riwayat ki hai (aur alfaaz ye hain): Shaitan (Allah ke) bande ke paas aata hai aur kehta hai: Ye kisne banaaya, wo kisne banaaya? Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed: People will constantly ask you questions pertaining to knowledge till they would say: Allah created us, but who created Allah? he (the narrator) says: he (Abu Huraira) was (at the time of narrating this hadith) catching hold of the hand of a man and he said: Allah and the Messenger told the truth. Two persons have already put me this question, and this is the third one, or he said: One man has put me this question and he is the second one.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Log tumse lagataar ilm se mutaalliq sawaal poochte rahenge yahan tak ki wo kahenge: Allah ne humein paida kiya, lekin Allah ko kisne paida kiya? Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Wo (Abu Huraira, ye hadees riwayat karte waqt) ek shaks ka haath thaame hue the aur unhone kaha: Allah aur Rasool ne sach kaha. Do log mujhse ye sawaal pehle bhi poochh chuke hain, aur ye teesra hai, ya unhone kaha: Ek shaks ne mujhse ye sawaal poocha hai aur ye doosra hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that he said: The people will constantly, and the rest of the hadith is the same as that transmitted by 'Abdul-Warith with the exception that there is no mention of the Messenger of Allah in that, but he observed at the end of the hadith: Allah and His Messenger told the truth.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki unhone kaha: Log lagataar (poochte rahenge), aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai jaisi Abdul Warith ne riwayat ki, sivaay iske ki usmein Rasoolullah (SAW) ka zikr nahi hai, lekin unhone hadees ke aakhir mein kaha: Allah aur Uske Rasool ne sach kaha.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me: they (the people) till constantly ask you, Abu Huraira, (about different things pertaining to religion) the they would say: Well, there is Allah, but after all who created Allah? He (Abu Huraira) narrated: Once we were in the mosque that some of the Bedouins came there and said: Well, there is Allah, but who created Allah? He (the narrator) said: I took hold of the pebbles in my fist and flung at them and remarked: Stand up, stand up (go away) my friend (the Holy Prophet) told the truth.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne mujhse kaha: Wo log tumse lagataar sawaal poochte rahenge, Abu Huraira, yahan tak ki wo kahenge: Achha, Allah hai, lekin aakhir Allah ko kisne banaaya? Unhone (Abu Huraira ne) bayan kiya: Ek baar hum masjid mein the ki kuch badawi wahan aaye aur kaha: Achha, Allah hai, lekin Allah ko kisne banaaya? Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Maine apni mutthi mein kankariyan uthaayin aur unpar phenkin aur kaha: Khade ho jao, khade ho jao (yahan se chale jao) mere dost (Nabi SAW) ne sach kaha.

e: Yazid b. al-Asamm said: I heard Abu Huraira saying that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed: people will certainly ask you about everything till they will propound: Allah created every thing, but who created Allah?
hi: Yazid bin al-Asamm ne kaha: Maine Abu Huraira ko ye kehte suna ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Log yaqeenan tumse har cheez ke baare mein sawaal poochenge yahan tak ki wo kahenge: Allah ne har cheez paida ki, lekin Allah ko kisne banaaya?

e: Anas b. Malik transmitted it from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that the Great and Glorious Allah said: Verily your people would constantly question about this and that till they would say: Well, it is Allah Who created the creation, but who created Allah?
hi: Anas bin Malik ne ise Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat kiya ki Buzurg aur Baa-Azmat Allah ne farmaya: Beshak tumhaari qaum is-us baat ke baare mein lagataar sawaal poochti rahegi yahan tak ki wo kahenge: Achha, Allah hi hai jisne makhlooq paida ki, lekin Allah ko kisne paida kiya?

e: This hadith has been narrated by another chain of transmitters with the exception that Ishaq made no mention of this: Allah said: Verily your people.
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai, sivaay iske ki Ishaq ne ismein 'Allah ne farmaya: Beshak tumhaari qaum' ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Umama that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed: He who appropriated the right of a Muslim by (swearing a false) oath, Allah would make Hell-fire necessary for him and would declare Paradise forbidden for him. A person said to him: Messenger of Allah, even if it is something insignificant? He (the Holy Prophet) replied: (Yes) even if it is the twig of the arak tree.
hi: Abu Umama se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jisne (jhooti qasam khaakar) kisi Musalman ka haq hadap liya, Allah uspar Jahannam ki aag laazim kar dega aur uske liye Jannat haraam kar dega. Ek shaks ne unse kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, chaahe wo koi maamooli si cheez hi kyun na ho? Aap (SAW) ne jawaab diya: (Haan) chaahe wo araak (peesh) ke ped ki ek chhoti si daali hi kyun na ho.

e: This hadith has been transmitted by another chain of narrators: Abu Bakr b. Abi Shaiba, Ishaq b. Ibrahim, Harun b. Abdullah, Abi Usama, Walid b. Kathir, Muhammad b. Ka'b, his brother Abdullah b. Ka'b and Abi Usama.
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai: Abu Bakr bin Abi Shaiba, Ishaq bin Ibrahim, Haroon bin Abdullah, Abi Usama, Walid bin Kathir, Muhammad bin Ka'b, unke bhai Abdullah bin Ka'b aur Abi Usama.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abdullah (b. Umar) that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed: He who perjured with a view to appropriating the property of a Muslim, and he is in fact a liar and would meet Allah in a state that He would be angry with him. He (the narrator) said: There came Ash'ath b. Qais and said (to the people): What does Abu Abdur-Rahman (the Kunya of Abdullah b. Umar) narrate to you? They replied: So and so. Upon this he remarked: Abu Abdur-Rahman told the truth. This (command) has been revealed in my case. There was a piece of land in Yemen over which I and another person had a claim. I brought the dispute with him to the Messenger of Allah (to decide) He (the Holy Prophet) said: Can you produce an evidence (in your support)? I said: No. He (the Holy Prophet) observed: (Then the decision would be made) on his oath. I said: He would readily take an oath. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) remarked: He who perjured for appropriating the wealth of a Muslim, whereas he is a liar, would meet Allah while He would be angry with him. This verse was then revealed:" Verily those who barter Allah's covenant and their oaths at a small price..." (iii 77).
hi: Abdullah (bin Umar) se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jisne kisi Musalman ki jaidaad hadapne ke liye jhooti qasam khaayi, jabki wo haqeeqat mein jhoota hai, wo Allah se aisi haalat mein milega ki Allah usse naaraaz honge. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Ash'ath bin Qais aaye aur (logon se) kaha: Abu Abdur-Rahman (yaani Abdullah bin Umar ki kunniyat) tumhein kya bayan kar rahe the? Unhone jawaab diya: Falaan-falaan. Is par unhone kaha: Abu Abdur-Rahman ne sach kaha. Ye hukum mere maamle mein nazil hua tha. Yemen mein ek zameen ka tukda tha jispar mera aur ek doosre shaks ka dawa tha. Main us jhagde ko Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas faisla karwaane le gaya. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Kya tum koi saboot pesh kar sakte ho? Maine kaha: Nahi. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: To faisla uski qasam par hoga. Maine kaha: Wo aasaani se qasam kha lega. Is par Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jisne kisi Musalman ki daulat hadapne ke liye jhooti qasam khaayi, jabki wo jhoota hai, wo Allah se aisi haalat mein milega ki Allah usse bahut naaraaz honge. Phir ye aayat nazil hui: 'Beshak jo log Allah ke ehad aur apni qasamon ko thodi si qeemat par bechte hain...' (3:77).

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abdullah that he heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying: He who took an oath in order to entitle himself (to the possession) of a property, whereas he is a liar, would meet Allah in a state that He would be very much angry with him. Then the remaining part of the hadith was narrated as transmitted by A'mash but with the exception of these words: There was a dispute between me and another person in regard to a well. We referred this dispute to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). Upon this he remarked: Either (you should produce) two witnesses (to support your contention) or his oath (would be accepted as valid).
hi: Abdullah se riwayat hai ki unhone Nabi (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jisne kisi jaidaad par apna haq jataane ke liye jhooti qasam khaayi, jabki wo jhoota hai, wo Allah se aisi haalat mein milega ki Allah usse bahut naaraaz honge. Phir baaki hadees waisi hi bayan ki gayi jaisi A'mash ne riwayat ki, sivaay in alfaaz ke: Mere aur ek doosre shaks ke darmiyaan ek kuen ke baare mein jhagda tha. Humne ye jhagda Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas peish kiya. Is par unhone farmaya: Ya to do gawah pesh karo ya uski qasam qubool ki jaayegi.

e: Ibn Mas'ud says: I heard the Messenger of Allah observing: He who took an oath on the property of a Muslim without legitimate right would meet Allah and He would be angry, with him. Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in support of his contention recited the verse:" Verily those who barter Allah's covenant and their oaths at a small price.
hi: Ibn Mas'ood kehte hain: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jisne kisi Musalman ki jaidaad par bagair kisi jaayez haq ke qasam khaayi, wo Allah se milega aur Allah usse naaraaz honge. Phir Rasoolullah (SAW) ne apni baat ki taaeed mein ye aayat tilaawat farmaayi: 'Beshak jo log Allah ke ehad aur apni qasamon ko thodi si qeemat par bechte hain.'

e: It is narrated on the authority of Wa'il that there came a person from Hadramaut and another one from Kinda to the Apostle (ﷺ). One who had come from Hadramaut said: Messenger of Allah, only this man has appropriated my land which belonged to my father. The one who had came from Kinda contended. This is my land and is in my possession: I cultivate it. There is no right for him in it. The Messenger of Allah said to the Hadramite: Have you any evidence (to support you)? He replied in the negative. He (the Messenger of Allah) said: Then your case is to be decided on his oath. He (the Hadramite) said: Messenger of Allah, he is a liar and cares not what he swears and has no regard for anything. Upon this he (the Messenger of Allah) remarked: For you then there is no other help to it. He (the man from Kinda) set out to take an oath. When he turned his back the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed: If he took an oath on his property with a view to usurping it, he would certainly meet his Lord in a state that He would turn away from him.
hi: Wa'il se riwayat hai ki Hadramaut se ek shaks aur Kinda se doosra shaks Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye. Jo Hadramaut se aaya tha usne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, sirf is shaks ne meri zameen hadap li hai jo mere waalid ki thi. Jo Kinda se aaya tha usne dawa kiya: Ye meri zameen hai aur mere qabze mein hai: Main ise jotta hoon. Ismein iska koi haq nahi. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Hadrami se kaha: Kya tumhaare paas koi saboot hai? Usne inkaar mein jawaab diya. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: To tumhaara maamla uski qasam par faisla hoga. Usne (Hadrami ne) kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, wo jhoota hai aur use iski parwaah nahi ki wo kya qasam khaata hai aur usko kisi cheez ki koi izzat nahi. Is par aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Tumhaare liye phir aur koi madad nahi. Wo (Kinda ka shaks) qasam khaane ke liye chal pada. Jab wo peeth pher kar chala, to Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Agar usne kisi ki zameen hadapne ke liye jhooti qasam khaayi, to wo apne Rab se aisi haalat mein zaroor milega ki Allah usse munh mod lenge.

e: Wa'il reported it on the authority of his father Hujr: I was with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that two men came there disputing over a piece of land. One of them said: Messenger of Allah, this man appropriated my land without justification in the days of ignorance. The (claimant) was Imru'l-Qais b. 'Abis al-Kindi and his opponent was Rabi'a b. 'Iban He (the Holy Prophet) said (to the claimant): Have you evidence (to substantiate your claim)? He replied: I have no evidence. Upon this he (the Messenger of Allah) remarked: Then his (that is of the defendant) is the oath. He (the claimant) said: In this case he (the defendant) would appropriate this (the property). He (the Holy Prophet) said: There is than no other way left for you but this. He (the narrator) said: When he (the defendant) stood up to take oath, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: He who appropriated the land wrongfully would meet Allah in a state that He would be angry with him. Ishaq in his narration mentions Rabi'a b. 'Aidan (instead of Rabi'a b. 'Ibdan).
hi: Wa'il ne apne waalid Hujr ki sanad se riwayat ki: Main Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath tha ki wahan do log ek zameen ke tukde ke baare mein jhagda karte hue aaye. Unmein se ek ne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, is shaks ne jaahiliyat ke zamaane mein meri zameen bagair kisi jawaaz ke hadap li. Dawa karne wala Imru'l-Qais bin Abis al-Kindi tha aur uska mukhaalif Rabi'a bin Ibdan tha. Aap (SAW) ne (dawedaar se) kaha: Kya tumhaare paas saboot hai? Usne jawaab diya: Mere paas koi saboot nahi. Is par aap (SAW) ne farmaya: To faisla uski, yaani mudda-alaih ki, qasam par hai. Usne (dawedaar ne) kaha: Is soorat mein to wo mudda-alaih ise hadap lega. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Tumhaare paas iske alaawa aur koi raasta nahi bacha. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Jab wo (mudda-alaih) qasam khaane ke liye khada hua, to Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jisne zameen ko naa-jaayez tareeqe se hadapa, wo Allah se aisi haalat mein milega ki Allah usse naaraaz honge. Ishaq ne apni riwayat mein Rabi'a bin Aidan (Rabi'a bin Ibdan ki jagah) ka zikr kiya hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: A person came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: Messenger of Allah, what do you think if a man comes to me in order to appropriate my possession? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Don't surrender your possession to him. He (the inquirer) said: If he fights me? He (the Holy Prophet) remarked: Then fight (with him). He (the inquirer) again said: What do you think if I am killed? He (the Holy Prophet) observed: You would be a martyr. He (the inquirer) said: What do you think of him (Messenger of Allah) If I kill him. He (the Holy Prophet) said: he would be in the Fire.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Ek shaks Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, aapki kya raay hai agar koi shaks mera saamaan hadapne ke liye mere paas aaye? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Apna saamaan usko mat do. Usne (sawaal karne wale ne) kaha: Agar wo mujhse lade? Aap (SAW) ne jawaab diya: To tum bhi uske saath lado. Usne dobara poocha: Aapki kya raay hai agar main maara jaaun? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Tum shaheed hoge. Usne kaha: Aapki kya raay hai agar main usko maar dun. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Wo Jahannam mein hoga.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Thabit, that when 'Abdullah b. 'Amr and 'Anbasa b. Abi Sufyan were about to fight against each other, Khalid b. 'As rode to 'Abdullah b. 'Amr and persuaded him (not to do so). Upon this Abdullah b. 'Amr said: Are you not aware that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had observed:" He who died in protecting his property is a martyr."
hi: Thabit se riwayat hai ki jab Abdullah bin Amr aur Anbasa bin Abi Sufyan ek doosre se ladne wale the, to Khalid bin al-As sawaar hokar Abdullah bin Amr ke paas gaye aur unhein (na ladne ke liye) samjhaaya. Is par Abdullah bin Amr ne kaha: Kya tumhein pata nahi ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya tha: 'Jo apni jaidaad ki hifazat karte hue mara wo shaheed hai.'

e: This hadith has been narrated by Muhammad b. Hatim, Muhammad b. Bakr, Ahmad b. 'Uthman Naufali, Abu 'Asim, Ibn Juraij.
hi: Ye hadees Muhammad bin Hatim, Muhammad bin Bakr, Ahmad bin Uthman Naufali, Abu Aasim, Ibn Juraij ne riwayat ki hai.

e: Hasan reported: 'Ubaidullah b. Ziyad paid a visit to Ma'qil b. Yasar Muzani in his illness of which he (later on) died. (At this juncture) Ma'qil said: I am going to narrate to you a hadith which I have heard from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and which I would not have transmitted if I knew that I would survive. Verily I have heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: There is none amongst the bondsmen who was entrusted with the affairs of his subjects and he died in such a state that he was dishonest in his dealings with those over whom he ruled except that Paradise is forbidden for him.
hi: Hasan ne bataaya: Ubaidullah bin Ziyad Ma'qil bin Yasar Muzani se unki bimaari mein milne gaye jismein baad mein unka intiqaal ho gaya. Us waqt Ma'qil ne kaha: Main tumhein ek hadees sunaane ja raha hoon jo maine Rasoolullah (SAW) se suni hai aur jise main riwayat na karta agar mujhe ye pata hota ki main zinda rahunga. Beshak maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Bandon mein koi bhi aisa nahi hai jise apni ra'iyat ke maamlaat sonpe gaye hon aur wo mar jaaye is haal mein ki wo unke saath jinpar usne hukumat ki, be-imaan raha ho, sivaay iske ki uspar Jannat haraam kar di jaayegi.

e: Hasan reported: Ubaidullah b. Ziyad went to see Ma'qil b. Yasir and he was ailing. He ('Ubaidullah) inquired (about his health) to which he (Ma'qil) replied: I am narrating to you a hadith which I avoided narrating to you (before). Verily the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed: Allah does not entrust to his bondsman the responsibility of managing the affairs of his subjects and he dies as a dishonest (ruler) but Paradise is forbidden by Allah for such a (ruler). He (Ibn Ziyad) said: Why did you not narrate it to me before this day? He replied: I (in fact) did not narrate it to you as it was not (fit) for me to narrate that to you.
hi: Hasan se riwayat hai: Ubaidullah bin Ziyad Ma'qil bin Yasir ko dekhne gaye jo bimaar the. Unhone (Ubaidullah ne) unse haal poocha, is par unhone (Ma'qil ne) jawaab diya: Main tumhein ek hadees bata raha hoon jo main pehle tumhein bataane se bachta raha. Beshak Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Allah kisi bande ko apni ra'iyat ke maamlaat sambhaalne ki zimmedaari nahi deta jabki wo be-imaan hokar mare, magar Jannat uspar Allah ki taraf se haraam kar di jaati hai. Unhone (Ibn Ziyad ne) kaha: Aapne ye mujhe pehle kyun nahi bataayi? Unhone jawaab diya: Maine haqeeqat mein tumhein ye is liye nahi bataayi kyunki mere liye ye tumhein bataana munaasib nahi tha.

e: Hasan reported: We were with Ma'qil b. Yasar inquiring about his health that Ubaidullah b. Ziyad came there. Ma'qil said to him: Verily I am going to narrate to you a hadith which I heard from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). Then he narrated the hadith like those two (mentioned above).
hi: Hasan se riwayat hai: Hum Ma'qil bin Yasar ke paas the unka haal poochte hue ki Ubaidullah bin Ziyad wahan aa gaye. Ma'qil ne unse kaha: Main tumhein ek hadees bataane ja raha hoon jo maine Rasoolullah (SAW) se suni thi. Phir unhone hadees bayan ki jaisi upar do ki bayan ki gayi hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Malih that Ubaidullah b. Ziyad visited Ma'qil b. Yasar in his illness. Ma'qil said to him: I am narrating to you a hadith which I would have never narrated to you had I not been in death-bed. I heard Allah's apostle (ﷺ) say: A ruler who has been entrusted with the affairs of the Muslims but he makes no endeavors ( for the material and moral uplift) and does not sincerely mean (their welfare) would not enter Paradise along with them.
hi: Abu Malih se riwayat hai ki Ubaidullah bin Ziyad Ma'qil bin Yasar se unki bimaari mein milne gaye. Ma'qil ne unse kaha: Main tumhein ek hadees bataa raha hoon jo main kabhi tumhein na bataata agar main marne ke bistar par na hota. Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Wo hukmuran jise Musalmanon ke maamlaat ki zimmedaari di gayi ho lekin wo unki maadi aur akhlaaqi behtari ki koshish na kare aur khalis niyat se unki bhalaai na chaahe, wo unke saath Jannat mein daakhil nahi hoga.

e: Hudhaifa reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) narrated to us two ahadith. I have seen one (crystallized into reality), and I am waiting for the other. He told us: Trustworthiness descended in the innermost (root) of the hearts of people. Then the Qur'an was revealed and they learnt from the Qur'an and they learnt from the Sunnah. Then he (the Holy Prophet) told us about the removal of trustworthiness. He said: The man would have a wink of sleep and trustworthiness would be taken away from his heart leaving the impression of a faint mark. He would again sleep and trustworthiness would be taken away from his heart leaving an impression of a blister, as if you rolled down an ember on your foot and it was vesicled. He would see a swelling having nothing in it. He (the Holy Prophet) then took up a pebble and rolled it down over his foot and (said): The people would enter into transactions amongst one another and hardly a person would be left who would return (things) entrusted to him. (And there would be so much paucity of honest persons) till it would be said: There in such a such tribe is a trustworthy man. And they would also say about a person: How prudent he is, how broad-minded he is and how intelligent he is, whereas in his heart there would not be faith even to the weight of a mustard seed. I have passed through a time in which I did not care with whom amongst you I entered into a transaction, for if he were a Muslim his faith would compel him to discharge his obligations to me and it he were a Christian or a Jew, the ruler would compel him to discharge his obligations to me. But today I would not enter into a transaction with you except so and so.
hi: Hudhaifa se riwayat hai: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne humein do Ahadees bayan ki. Maine ek ko haqeeqat bante hue dekh liya hai, aur main doosri ka intezaar kar raha hoon. Aap (SAW) ne humein bataaya: Amaanatdaari logon ke dilon ke sabse gehre hisse mein utri. Phir Quran nazil hua aur unhone Quran se seekha aur Sunnat se seekha. Phir aap (SAW) ne humein amaanatdaari ke uthaaye jaane ke baare mein bataaya. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Ek shaks ko neend ki jhapki aayegi aur amaanatdaari uske dil se le li jaayegi, ek halke se nishaan ka asar chhodte hue. Wo dobara so jaayega aur amaanatdaari uske dil se le li jaayegi, ek phaphole jaisa nishaan chhodte hue, goya tumne apne pair par angaara loodhka diya ho aur wo phool gaya ho. Wo ek ubhaar dekhega jismein kuch nahi hoga. Aap (SAW) ne phir ek kankad uthaaya aur use apne pair par loodhkaaya aur farmaya: Log ek doosre se len-den karenge lekin shaayad hi koi shaks bacha hoga jo amaanatein wapas lautaaye. Aur imandaar logon ki itni kami ho jaayegi yahan tak ki kaha jaayega: Falaan qabile mein ek amaanatdaar shaks hai. Aur log ye bhi kahenge kisi shaks ke baare mein: Wo kitna hoshiyaar hai, kitna wasee-ul-nazar hai aur kitna zaheen hai, jabki uske dil mein rai ke daane barabar bhi imaan nahi hoga. Main aisa zamaana dekh chuka hoon jismein mujhe iski parwaah nahi hoti thi ki tum mein se kisse main len-den kar raha hoon, kyunki agar wo Musalman hota, to uska imaan use mere haq ada karne par majboor karta, aur agar wo Isaai ya Yahudi hota, to hukmuran use mere haq ada karne par majboor karta. Lekin aaj main falaan-falaan ke siwa kisi se len-den nahi karunga.

e: This hadith has been transmitted by another chain of transmitters: Ibn Numair, Waki', Ishaq b. Ibrahim, 'Isa b. Yunus on the authority of A'mash.
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai: Ibn Numair, Waki, Ishaq bin Ibrahim, Isa bin Yunus, A'mash ki sanad se.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Hudhaifa: We were sitting in the company of Umar and he said: Who amongst you has heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) talking about the turmoil? Some people said: It is we who heard it. Upon this be remarked: Perhaps by turmoil you presume the unrest of man in regard to his household or neighbour, they replied: Yes. He ('Umar) observed: Such (an unrest) would be done away with by prayer, fasting and charity. But who amongst you has heard from the Apostle (ﷺ) describing that turmoil which would come like the wave of the ocean. Hudhaifa said: The people hushed into silence, I replied: It is I. He ('Umar) said: Ye, well, your father was also very pious. Hudhaifa said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (may peace be, upon him ) observing: Temptations will be presented to men's hearts as reed mat is woven stick by stick and any heart which is impregnated by them will have a black mark put into it, but any heart which rejects them will have a white mark put in it. The result is that there will become two types of hearts: one white like a white stone which will not be harmed by any turmoil or temptation, so long as the heavens and the earth endure; and the other black and dust-coloured like a vessel which is upset, not recognizing what is good or rejecting what is abominable, but being impregnated with passion. Hudhaifa said: I narrated to him ('Umar): There is between you and that (turmoil) a closed door, but there is every likelihood of its being broken. 'Umar said: Would it be broken? You have, been rendered fatherless. Had it been opened, it would have been perhaps closed also. I said: No, it would be broken, and I narrated to him: Verily that door implies a person who would be killed or die. There is no mistake in this hadith. Abu Khalid narrated: I said to Sa'd, O Abu Malik, what do you mean by the term" Aswad Murbadda"? He replied: High degree of whiteness in blackness. I said: What is meant by" Alkoozu Mujakhiyyan"? He replied: A vessel turned upside down.
hi: Hudhaifa se riwayat hai: Hum Umar (RA) ki majlis mein baithe the aur unhone kaha: Tum mein se kisne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko fitne ke baare mein baat karte suna hai? Kuch logon ne kaha: Humne suna hai. Is par unhone (Umar ne) kaha: Shaayad fitne se tumhara matlab ek insaan ki apne ghar walon ya padosi ke maamle mein pareshaani se hai. Unhone jawaab diya: Haan. Unhone (Umar ne) farmaya: Aisi pareshaani namaz, roze, aur sadqe se door ki ja sakti hai. Lekin tum mein se kisne Rasool (SAW) se us fitne ka zikr suna hai jo samundar ki lehron ki tarah aayegi? Hudhaifa ne kaha: Log khaamosh ho gaye. Maine jawaab diya: Main. Unhone (Umar ne) kaha: Achha, tumhare waalid bhi bahut nek insaan the. Hudhaifa ne kaha: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Fitne logon ke dilon par is tarah pesh ki jaayengi jaise chatai ek-ek teeli se buni jaati hai, aur jo bhi dil unse mutaassir ho jaayega, uspar ek kaala nishaan lagaya jaayega, lekin jo dil unhein radd kar dega, uspar ek safed nishaan lagaya jaayega. Nateeja ye hoga ki do tarah ke dil ban jaayenge: ek safed patthar ki tarah safed hoga jise koi fitna nuqsaan nahi pahunchayega, jab tak aasman aur zameen qaayam hain; aur doosra kaala aur gard jaisa rang liye hoga, ulti hui ek bartan ki tarah, na achhaai ko pehchaanega na burayi ko naapasand karega, balki khwahishaat se bhara hoga. Hudhaifa ne kaha: Maine unse (Umar se) kaha: Tumhare aur us fitne ke darmiyaan ek band darwaza hai, lekin uske toote jaane ka poora imkaan hai. Umar (RA) ne kaha: Kya wo tootega? Tumhaare waalid ka intiqaal ho jaaye! Agar wo khula hota, to shaayad wo dobara band bhi ho sakta. Maine kaha: Nahi, wo tootega, aur maine unse kaha: Beshak wo darwaza ek aise shaks ki taraf ishaara karta hai jo maara jaayega ya mar jaayega. Is hadees mein koi ghalti nahi hai. Abu Khalid ne riwayat kiya: Maine Sa'd se kaha, Aye Abu Malik, 'Aswad Murbadda' se aapka kya matlab hai? Unhone jawaab diya: Kaalapan mein safedi ka bada darja. Maine kaha: 'Alkoozu Mujakhiyyan' se kya murad hai? Unhone jawaab diya: Ek bartan jo ulta rakha ho.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Rib'i (b. Hirash). When Hudhaifa came from 'Umar he sat down to narrate to us and said: Verily yesterday when I was sitting with the Commander of the believers he asked his companions: When amongst you retains in his memory the utterance of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) with regard to the turmoil? -and he cited the hadith like the hadith narrated on the authority of Abu Khalid, but he did not mention the exposition of his words (Murbaddan) and (Mujakhiyyan).
hi: Rib'i (bin Hiraash) se riwayat hai. Jab Hudhaifa Umar (RA) ke paas se aaye to wo humein sunane ke liye baith gaye aur kaha: Beshak kal jab main Amir-ul-Momineen ke saath baitha tha, to unhone apne saathiyon se poocha: Tum mein se kisne apni yaadaasht mein Rasoolullah (SAW) ki fitne ke baare mein kahi hui baat rakhi hai? - aur unhone hadees waisi hi bayan ki jaisi Abu Khalid ki riwayat ki gayi hadees hai, lekin unhone (Murbaddan) aur (Mujakhiyyan) ke alfaaz ki tashreeh ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: It is transmitted by Rib'i b. Hirash. who narrated it on the authority of Hudhaifa that verily 'Umar said: Who would narrate to us or who amongst you would narrate to us (and Hudhaifa was one amongst them) what the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had said about the turmoil? Hudhaifa said: I will, and recited the hadith like that transmitted by Abu Malik on the authority of Rib'i and he observed in connection with this hadith that Hudhaifa remarked: I am narrating to you a hadith and it has no mistake, and said: That it is transmitted from he Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).
hi: Ye Rib'i bin Hiraash se riwayat ki gayi hai, jinhone ise Hudhaifa ki sanad se riwayat ki ki beshak Umar (RA) ne kaha: Kaun humein bataayega ya tum mein se kaun humein bataayega (aur Hudhaifa unmein se ek the) ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne fitne ke baare mein kya farmaaya tha? Hudhaifa ne kaha: Main bataaunga, aur unhone hadees waisi hi bayan ki jaisi Abu Malik ne Rib'i ki sanad se riwayat ki, aur unhone is hadees ke silsile mein zikr kiya ki Hudhaifa ne kaha: Main tumhein ek hadees bata raha hoon aur ismein koi ghalti nahi hai, aur kaha: Ki ye Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Islam initiated as something strange, and it would revert to its (old position) of being strange. so good tidings for the stranger.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Islam ki shuruaat ek ajnabi cheez ki tarah hui, aur ye phir apni purani haalat mein ajnabi ban jaayega, is liye ajnabiyon ke liye khushkhabri ho.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Umar ('Abdullah b. 'Umar) that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed: Verily Islam started as something strange and it would again revert (to its old position) of being strange just as it started, and it would recede between the two mosques just as the serpent crawls back into its hole.
hi: Ibn Umar (Abdullah bin Umar) se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Beshak Islam ki shuruaat ek ajnabi cheez ki tarah hui aur ye phir apni purani haalat mein ajnabi ban jaayega jaise ye shuru hua tha, aur ye do masjidon (Makkah aur Madina) ke darmiyaan simat jaayega jaise saanp apne bill mein wapas rengta hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Verily the faith would recede to Medina just as the serpent crawls back into its hole.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Beshak imaan Madina ki taraf simat jaayega jaise saanp apne bill mein wapas rengta hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Anas that verily the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "The Hour (Resurrection) will not occur until 'Allah, Allah' is not said on earth."
hi: Anas se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Qayamat ki ghadi us waqt tak qaayam nahi hogi jab tak zameen par Allah, Allah kaha jaata rahega.'

e: It is narrated on the authority of Anas that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "The Hour (Resurrection) will not occur as long as anyone says: 'Allah, Allah.'"
hi: Anas se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Qayamat ki ghadi tab tak qaayam nahi hogi jab tak koi bhi shaks Allah, Allah kehta rahega.'

e: Hudhaifa reported: We were in the company of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) when he said. Count for me those who profess al-Islam. We said: Messenger of Allah, do you entertain any fear concerning us and we are (at this time) between six hundred and seven hundred (in strength). He (the Holy Prophet) remarked: You don't perceive; you may be put to some trial, He (the narrator) said: We actually suffered trial so much so that some of our men were constrained to offer their prayers in concealment.
hi: Hudhaifa se riwayat hai: Hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ki sohbat mein the jab aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Mere liye un logon ko gino jo Islam ka izhaar karte hain. Humne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, kya aapko humare baare mein koi khauf hai jabki hum is waqt chhe sau se saat sau (600-700) ke darmiyaan tadaad mein hain? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Tumhein andaaza nahi; tumhein kisi aazmaish mein daala jaa sakta hai. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Hum waaqai aisi aazmaish mein pade ki humare kuch logon ko chhup kar apni namaz padhni padi.

e: Sa'd narrated it on the authority of his father (Abi Waqqas) that he observed: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) distributed shares (of booty among his Companions). I said: Messenger of Allah! Give it to so and so, for verily he is a believer. Upon this the Messenger of Allah remarked: Or a Muslim. I (the narrator) repeated it (the word" believer" ) thrice and he (the Holy Prophet) turned his back upon me (and substituted the word)" Muslim," and then observed: I bestow it (this share) to a man out of apprehension lest Allah should throw him prostrate into the fire (of Hell) whereas in fact the other man is dearer to me than he.
hi: Sa'd ne apne waalid (Abi Waqqas) ki sanad se riwayat ki ki unhone kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne ganeemat ka hissa taqseem kiya. Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah! Falaan ko dijiye, kyunki wo momin hai. Is par Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Ya Musalman. Maine (raawi ne) ye baat teen baar dohraayi aur aap (SAW) ne mujhse munh mod liya aur lafz 'Musalman' ka istemaal kiya, phir farmaya: Main ye hissa is dar se ek shaks ko deta hoon ki kahin Allah use aag mein muh ke bal na daal de, jabki haqeeqat mein doosra shaks mujhe usse zyada aziz hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Sa'd that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) bestowed upon a group of persons (things), and Sa'd was sitting amongst them. Sa'd said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ignored some of them. And he who was ignored seemed to be more deserving in my eyes (as compared with others). I (Sa'd) said: Messenger of Allah I why is it that you did not give to such and such (man)? Verily I see him a believer. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed: Or a Muslim? I kept quiet for some time but I was again impelled (to express) what I knew about him. I said: Messenger of Allah why is it that you did not give it to such and such? Verily, by Allah, see him a believer. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) remarked: (Nay, not a believer) but a Muslim. He (Sa'd) said: I again kept quite for some time but what I knew about him again impelled me (to express my opinion) and I said: Why is it that you did not give (the share) to so and so: By Allah, verily I see him a believer. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) remarked; (Nay, not so) but a Muslim. Verily (at times) I give (a share) to a certain man apprehending that he may not be thrown prostrate in the Fire, whereas the other man (who is not given) is dearer to me (as compared with him).
hi: Sa'd se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kuch logon ke ek giroh ko (cheezein) inaam mein dein, aur Sa'd bhi unke saath baithe the. Sa'd ne kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unmein se kuch logon ko nazar-andaaz kar diya. Aur jise nazar-andaaz kiya gaya wo mujhe (doosron ke muqaable) zyada haqdaar lag raha tha. Maine (Sa'd ne) kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, aisa kyun hai ki aapne falaan shaks ko kuch nahi diya? Beshak main unhein momin samajhta hoon. Is par Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Ya Musalman? Main kuch der khaamosh raha lekin phir mujhe majboor kiya gaya jo main uske baare mein jaanta tha. Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, aisa kyun hai ki aapne falaan shaks ko nahi diya? Allah ki qasam, beshak main unhein momin samajhta hoon. Is par Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: (Nahi, momin nahi) balki Musalman. Unhone (Sa'd ne) kaha: Main phir kuch der khaamosh raha lekin jo main uske baare mein jaanta tha usne mujhe phir majboor kiya, aur maine kaha: Aisa kyun hai ki aapne falaan-falaan ko hissa nahi diya: Allah ki qasam, beshak main unhein momin samajhta hoon. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: (Nahi, aisa nahi) balki Musalman. Beshak kabhi-kabhi main ek shaks ko hissa is dar se deta hoon ki kahin use Jahannam mein munh ke bal na phenk diya jaaye, jabki doosra shaks jise nahi diya jaata mujhe uske muqaable zyada aziz hai.

e: Sa'd reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) bestowed upon a group of persons (booty) and I was sitting with them. The remaining part of the hadith is the same as mentioned (above) with the additionI stood up and went to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and whispered to him: Why did you omit such and such a man?
hi: Sa'd ne bataaya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kuch logon ke ek giroh ko ganeemat diya aur main unke saath baitha tha. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai jaisi upar bayan hui, is izafe ke saath: Main khada hua aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas gaya aur unke kaan mein dheere se kaha: Aapne falaan shaks ko kyun chhod diya?

e: The same hadith has been narrated on the authority of Muhammad b Sa'd and these words (are also there): The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) gave a stroke on my neck or between my two shoulders and said: Sa'd, do you fight with me simply because I gave (a share) to a man?
hi: Yahi hadees Muhammad bin Sa'd ki sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai aur ye alfaaz bhi hain: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne meri gardan par ya mere dono kandhon ke beech mein ek dhakka diya aur kaha: Sa'd, kya tum mujhse sirf is liye lad rahe ho ki maine ek shaks ko hissa diya?

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed: We have more claim to doubt than Ibrahim (ﷺ) when he said: My Lord! Show me how Thou wilt quicken the dead. He said: Believeth thou not? He said: Yes! But that my heart may rest at ease. He (the Holy Prophet) observed: May Lord take mercy on Lot, that he wanted a strong support, and had I stayed (in the prison) as long as Yusuf stayed, I would have responded to him who invited me.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Humein Ibrahim (AS) se zyada shaq karne ka haq hai jab unhone kaha tha: Mere Rab! Mujhe dikha ki Tu murdon ko kaise zinda karega. Allah ne kaha: Kya tum imaan nahi rakhte? Unhone kaha: Kyun nahi! Lekin taaki mera dil sukoon paaye. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Allah Lut (AS) par rehem kare, ki unhone ek mazboot sahaara chaaha, aur agar main utni der (qaid mein) rehta jitni der Yusuf (AS) rahe, to main us bulaane wale ki dawat qubool kar leta jisne mujhe bulaaya.

e:
'Abdullah b. Muhammad narrated the same hadith on the authority of Abu Huraira and in the transmission by Malik the words are that he (the Holy Prophet) recited the verse: " but that my heart may rest at ease" and completed it.

This hadith has also been narrated by Abd b. Humaid Ya'qub, i. e. son of Ibrahim b. Sa'd, Abu Uwais, Zuhri, like the one narrated by Malik with the same chain of transmission and said: He recited this verse till he completed it.
hi:
Abdullah bin Muhammad ne yahi hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se riwayat ki hai aur Malik ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain ki aap (SAW) ne aayat tilaawat ki: 'Lekin taaki mera dil sukoon paaye' aur use poora kiya.

Ye hadees Abd bin Humaid Ya'qub, yaani Ibrahim bin Sa'd ke bete, Abu Uwais, Zuhri, ne bhi Malik ki riwayat jaisi isi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai aur kaha: Unhone ye aayat tilaawat ki yahan tak ki use poora kar diya.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed: There has never been a Prophet amongst the prophets who was not bestowed with a sign amongst the signs which were bestowed (on the earlier prophets). Human beings believed in it and verily I have been conferred upon revelation (the Holy Qur'an) which Allah revealed to me. I hope that I will have the greatest following on the Day of Resurrection.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Aisa koi Nabi Anbiya mein nahi guzra jise koi nishaani na di gayi ho un nishaaniyon mein se jo pehle Anbiya ko di gayin. Insaanon ne uspar imaan laaya aur beshak mujhe wahi (Quran-e-Kareem) di gayi hai jo Allah ne mujh par nazil ki. Mujhe ummeed hai ki Qayamat ke Din mera sabse zyada peirokaar honge.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed: By Him in Whose hand is the life of Muhammad, he who amongst the community of Jews or Christians hears about me, but does not affirm his belief in that with which I have been sent and dies in this state (of disbelief), he shall be but one of the denizens of Hell-Fire.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein Muhammad ki jaan hai, Yahudi ya Isaai ummat mein se jo bhi shaks mere baare mein sunta hai, lekin us cheez par imaan nahi laata jiske saath mujhe bheja gaya hai aur usi (kufr ki) halat mein marta hai, wo sirf Jahannamiyon mein se hoga.

e:
It is narrated on the authority of Sha'bi that one among the citizens of Khurasan asked him: 0 Abu! some of the people amongst us who belong to Khurasan say that a person who freed his bondswoman and then married her is like one who rode over a sacrificial animal. Sha'bi said: Abu Burda b. Abi Musa narrated it to me on the authority of his father that verily the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: There are three (classes of persons) who would be given a double reward. One who is amongst the People of the Book and believed in his apostle and (lived) to see the time of Apostle Muhammad (ﷺ) and affirmed his faith in him and followed him and attested his truth, for him is the double reward; and the slave of the master who discharges all those obligations that he owes to Allah and discharges his duties that he owes to his master, for him there is a double reward. And a man who had a bondswoman and fed her and fed her well, then taught her good manners, and did that well and later on granted her freedom and married her, for him is the double reward. Then Sha'bi said: Accept this hadith without (giving) anything. Formerly a man was (obliged) to travel to Medina even for a smaller hadith than this.

This hadith has been narrated by another chain of transmitters like Abu Bakr b. Abi Shaiba, 'Abda b. Sulaiman Ibn Abi 'Umar Sufyan, 'Ubaidullah b. Mu'adh, Shu'ba; all of them heard it from Salih b. Salih.
hi:
Sha'bi se riwayat hai ki Khurasan ke ek shehri ne unse poocha: Aye Abu! Humaare kuch log jo Khurasan se hain kehte hain ki jis shaks ne apni laundi ko aazaad kiya aur phir usse shaadi kar li, wo us shaks jaisa hai jo qurbaani ke jaanwar par sawaar ho gaya. Sha'bi ne kaha: Abu Burda bin Abi Musa ne apne waalid ki sanad se mujhe bataaya ki beshak Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Teen qismon ke log hain jinhein dohra ajr diya jaayega. Ek wo shaks jo Ahl-e-Kitaab mein se hai aur apne Nabi par imaan laaya aur Nabi Muhammad (SAW) ka zamaana bhi dekha aur unpar bhi imaan laaya aur unki peirvi ki aur unki sacchayi ki tasdeeq ki, uske liye dohra ajr hai; aur wo ghulaam jo apne maalik ke haq mein Allah ke saare farz poore karta hai aur apne maalik ke prati apne farz bhi poore karta hai, uske liye dohra ajr hai. Aur ek shaks jiske paas ek laundi thi, aur usne use khilaaya-pilaaya aur achhi tarah khilaaya-pilaaya, phir usse achhe akhlaaq sikhaaye aur achhi tarah sikhaaye, aur baad mein use aazaad kiya aur usse shaadi kar li, uske liye dohra ajr hai. Phir Sha'bi ne kaha: Ye hadees bagair kuch diye qubool karo. Pehle zamaane mein log Madina tak isse bhi chhoti hadees ke liye safar kiya karte the.

Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai jaise Abu Bakr bin Abi Shaiba, Abda bin Sulaiman Ibn Abi Umar Sufyan, Ubaidullah bin Mu'adh, Shu'ba; in sabne ise Salih bin Salih se suna.

e: Abu Huraira reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: By Him in Whose hand is my life, the son of Mary (ﷺ) will soon descend among you as a just judge. He will break crosses, kill swine and abolish Jizya and the wealth will pour forth to such an extent that no one will accept it.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, Maryam ke bete (Isa AS) jald hi tum mein ek insaaf-pasand qaazi ki haisiyat se utrenge. Wo saleeben todenge, sooar maarenge aur Jizya khatam kar denge aur maal itni bahutaayat mein barsega ki koi use qubool nahi karega.

e: The same hadith is transmitted from Zuhri with the same chain of transmission. But in the tradition narrated by Ibn 'Uyaina the words are: " impartial leader and just judge" and in the tradition narrated by Yunus: the" judge judging with justice" and" impartial leader" are not mentioned. And in the hadith narrated by Salih like the one transmitted by Laith the words are:" impartial judge". And in the hadith transmitted by Ziyad the words are:" Till one sajda is better than the worldand what it contains. Then Abu Huraira used to say," recite" if you like: Not one of the People of the Book will fail to believe in him before his death.
hi: Yahi hadees Zuhri se isi sanad ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai. Lekin Ibn Uyaynah ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: 'Insaaf-pasand rehnuma aur adl karne wala qaazi' aur Yunus ki riwayat mein 'adl karne wala qaazi' aur 'insaaf-pasand rehnuma' ka zikr nahi hai. Aur Salih ki riwayat mein, Laith ki riwayat jaisi, alfaaz hain: 'insaaf-pasand qaazi'. Aur Ziyad ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: 'Yahan tak ki ek sajda duniya aur usmein jo kuch hai usse behtar hoga.' Phir Abu Huraira kaha karte the: 'Agar tum chaaho to padho: Ahl-e-Kitaab mein se koi bhi aisa nahi hoga jo unki maut se pehle unpar imaan na laaye.'

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger or Allah (ﷺ) observed: I swear by Allah that the son of Mary will certainly descend as a just judge and he would definitely break the cross, and kill swine and abolish Jizya and would leave the young she-camel and no one would endeavour to (collect Zakat on it). Spite, mutual hatred and jealousy against one another will certainly disappear and when he summons people to accept wealth, not even one would do so.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Main Allah ki qasam khaata hoon ki Maryam ke bete zaroor ek insaaf-pasand qaazi ki haisiyat se utrenge aur wo zaroor saleeb todenge, aur sooar maarenge aur Jizya khatam karenge aur jawaan oontni ko chhod denge aur koi use (Zakat wusool karne ke liye) haasil karne ki koshish nahi karega. Dushmani, aapasi nafrat aur ek doosre ke khilaaf jalan zaroor khatam ho jaayegi aur jab wo logon ko maal qubool karne ki dawat denge, to koi ek bhi aisa nahi karega.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed: What will be your state when the son of Mary descends amongst you and there will be an Imam amongst you?
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Tumhaari kya haalat hogi jab Maryam ke bete tum mein utrenge aur tum mein se hi ek Imam hoga?

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that he heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: What would you do when the son of Mary would descend and lead you?
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Tum kya karoge jab Maryam ke bete utrenge aur tumhaari imaamat karenge?

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed: What would you do when the son of Mary would descend amongst you and would lead you as one amongst you? Ibn Abi Dhi'b on the authority of Abu Huraira narrated: Your leader amongst you. Ibn Abi Dhi'b said: Do you know what the words:" He would lead as one amongst you" mean? I said: Explain these to me. He said: He would lead you according to the Book of your: Lord (hallowed be He and most exalted) and the Sunnah of your Apostle (ﷺ).
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Tum kya karoge jab Maryam ke bete tum mein utrenge aur tum mein se ek ki tarah tumhaari imaamat karenge? Ibn Abi Dhi'b ne Abu Huraira ki sanad se riwayat ki: Tum mein se tumhaara rehnuma. Ibn Abi Dhi'b ne kaha: Kya tumhein pata hai in alfaaz ka matlab: 'Wo tum mein se ek ki tarah imaamat karenge'? Maine kaha: Mujhe samjhaiye. Unhone kaha: Wo tumhaari imaamat tumhaare Rab (jo mahaan aur baland hai) ki Kitaab aur tumhaare Rasool (SAW) ki Sunnat ke mutaabiq karenge.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: A section of my people will not cease fighting for the Truth and will prevail till the Day of Resurrection. He said: Jesus son of Mary would then descend and their (Muslims') commander would invite him to come and lead them in prayer, but he would say: No, some amongst you are commanders over some (amongst you). This is the honour from Allah for this Ummah.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bataaya: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Meri ummat ka ek giroh Haq ke liye ladna nahi chhodega aur Qayamat ke Din tak ghaalib rahega. Unhone (Nabi SAW ne) kaha: Phir Isa Maryam ke bete utrenge aur unka (Musalmanon ka) senapati unhein aage badhkar unki imaamat karne ki dawat dega, lekin wo kahenge: Nahi, tum mein se kuch tum mein se kuch ke senapati hain. Ye Allah ki taraf se is Ummat ke liye ek izzat hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The (Last) Hour shall not came till the sun rises from the place of its setting And on the day when it rises from the place of its setting even if all the people together affirmed their faith, it would not be of any avail to one who did not believe previously and derived no good out of his belief.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Qayamat ki ghadi tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak suraj apni doobne ki jagah se na nikle. Aur jis din wo apni doobne ki jagah se nikle, agar us waqt saare log mil kar imaan bhi le aayein, to jo shaks pehle se imaan nahi laaya tha ya jisne apne imaan se koi bhalaai haasil nahi ki thi, uske liye koi faayda nahi hoga.

e:
This hadith has been narrated by another chain of transmitters, Abu Bakr b. Abi Shaiba, Ibn Numair, Abu Kuraib, Ibn Fudail.

This hadith has also been narrated through several other chains on the authority of Abu Huraira.
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai: Abu Bakr bin Abi Shaiba, Ibn Numair, Abu Kuraib, Ibn Fudail. Ye hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se kayi aur sanadon se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed: When three things appear faith will not benefit one who has not previously believed or has derived no good from his faith: the rising of the sun in its place of setting, the Dajjal, and the beast of the earth.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab teen cheezein zaahir hongi, to imaan us shaks ke kaam nahi aayega jisne pehle se imaan nahi laaya tha ya jisne apne imaan se koi bhalaai haasil nahi ki: suraj ka apni doobne ki jagah se nikalna, Dajjal, aur zameen ka jaanwar.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Dharr that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) one day said: Do you know where the sun goes? They replied: Allah and His Apostle know best. He (the Holy Prophet) observed: Verily it (the sun) glides till it reaches its resting place under the Throne. Then it falls prostrate and remains there until it is asked: Rise up and go to the place whence you came, and it goes back and continues emerging out from its rising place and then glides till it reaches its place of rest under the Throne and falls prostrate and remains in that state until it is asked: Rise up and return to the place whence you came, and it returns and emerges out from it rising place and the it glides (in such a normal way) that the people do not discern anything ( unusual in it) till it reaches its resting place under the Throne. Then it would be said to it: Rise up and emerge out from the place of your setting, and it will rise from the place of its setting. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said. Do you know when it would happen? It would happen at the time when faith will not benefit one who has not previously believed or has derived no good from the faith.
hi: Abu Dharr se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne ek din farmaya: Kya tumhein pata hai suraj kahan jaata hai? Unhone jawaab diya: Allah aur Uske Rasool behtar jaante hain. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Beshak wo suraj chalta rahta hai yahan tak ki Arsh ke neeche apni aaraam-gaah tak pahunch jaata hai. Phir wo sajde mein gir jaata hai aur wahin rehta hai jab tak use kaha jaata hai: Utho aur jahan se aaye ho wahan jaao, aur wo wapas jaata hai aur apni nikalne ki jagah se dobara nikalna jaari rakhta hai aur phir chalta hai yahan tak ki wo Arsh ke neeche apni aaraam-gaah tak pahunch jaata hai aur sajde mein gir jaata hai aur us halat mein rehta hai jab tak use kaha jaata hai: Utho aur jahan se aaye ho wahan wapas jaao, aur wo wapas jaata hai aur apni nikalne ki jagah se nikalta hai aur phir aise aam tareeqe se chalta hai ki log ismein koi ghair-mamooli farq mehsoos nahi karte yahan tak ki wo Arsh ke neeche apni aaraam-gaah tak pahunch jaata hai. Phir usse kaha jaayega: Utho aur apni doobne ki jagah se nikal aao, aur wo apni doobne ki jagah se nikal aayega. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Kya tumhein pata hai ye kab hoga? Ye us waqt hoga jab imaan us shaks ke kaam nahi aayega jisne pehle se imaan nahi laaya tha ya jisne apne imaan se koi bhalaai haasil nahi ki.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Dharr that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) one day said: Do you know where the sun goes? The remaining part of the hadith is the same.
hi: Abu Dharr se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne ek din farmaya: Kya tumhein pata hai suraj kahan jaata hai? Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Abu Dharr reported: I entered the mosque and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was sitting there. When the sun disappeared (from the sight) he said: O Abu Dharr! Do you know where it goes? He (the narrator) said: Allah and His Apostle know best. He (the Holy Prophet) said. Verily it goes and begs permission, for prostration (to Allah) and the permission is granted to it. Once it would be said: Return to the place whence you came, and then it would rise from its setting place. Then he, after the recitation of 'Abdullah recited it: And that is its appointed term.
hi: Abu Dharr ne bataaya: Main masjid mein daakhil hua aur Rasoolullah (SAW) wahan baithe the. Jab suraj (nazron se) ojhal ho gaya, to aap (SAW) ne kaha: Aye Abu Dharr! Kya tumhein pata hai wo kahan jaata hai? Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Allah aur Uske Rasool behtar jaante hain. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Beshak wo jaata hai aur Allah ke saamne sajda karne ki ijaazat maangta hai, aur use ijaazat de di jaati hai. Ek waqt aayega jab usse kaha jaayega: Jahan se aaye ho wahan wapas jaao, aur tab wo apni doobne ki jagah se nikalega. Phir Abdullah ki tilaawat ke baad, unhone ise tilaawat kiya: 'Aur ye uska muqarrar waqt hai.'

e: Abu Dharr reported: I asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) the (implication of the) words of Allah, the Exalted: The sun glides to its appointed resting place. He replied: Its appointed resting place is under the Throne.
hi: Abu Dharr ne bataaya: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) se Allah Ta'ala ke in alfaaz ke matlab ke baare mein poocha: 'Suraj apni muqarrar aaraam-gaah ki taraf chalta hai.' Aap (SAW) ne jawaab diya: Uski muqarrar aaraam-gaah Arsh ke neeche hai.

e: A'isha, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), reported: The first (form) with which was started the revelation to the Messenger of Allah was the true vision in sleep. And he did not see any vision but it came like the bright gleam of dawn. Thenceforth solitude became dear to him and he used to seclude himself in the cave of Hira', where he would engage in tahannuth (and that is a worship for a number of nights) before returning to his family and getting provisions again for this purpose. He would then return to Khadija and take provisions for a like period, till Truth came upon him while he was in the cave of Hira'. There came to him the angel and said: Recite, to which he replied: I am not lettered. He took hold of me  and pressed me, till I was hard pressed; thereafter he let me off and said: Recite. I said: I am not lettered. He then again took hold of me and pressed me for the second time till I was hard pressed and then let me off and said: Recite, to which I replied: I am not lettered. He took hold of me and pressed me for the third time, till I was hard pressed and then let me go and said: Recite in the name of your Lord Who created, created man from a clot of blood. Recite. And your most bountiful Lord is He Who taught the use of pen, taught man what he knew not (al-Qur'an, xcvi. 1-4). Then the Prophet returned therewith, his heart was trembling, and he went to Khadija and said: Wrap me up, wrap me up! So they wrapped him till the fear had left him. He then said to Khadija: O Khadija! what has happened to me? and he informed her of the happening, saying: I fear for myself. She replied: It can't be. Be happy. I swear by Allah that He shall never humiliate you. By Allah, you join ties of relationship, you speak the truth, you bear people's burden, you help the destitute, you entertain guests, and you help against the vicissitudes which affect people. Khadija then took him to Waraqa b. Naufal b. Asad b. 'Abd al-'Uzza, and he was the son of Khadija's uncle, i. e., the brother of her father. And he was the man who had embraced Christianity in the Days of Ignorance (i. e. before Islam) and he used to write books in Arabic and, therefore, wrote Injil in Arabic as God willed that he should write. He was very old and had become blind Khadija said to him: O uncle! listen to the son of your brother. Waraqa b. Naufal said: O my nephew! what did you see? The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), then, informed him what he had seen, and Waraqa said to him: It is namus that God sent down to Musa. Would that I were then (during your prophetic career) a young man. Would that I might be alive when your people would expel you! The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Will they drive me out? Waraqa said: Yes. Never came a man with a like of what you have brought but met hostilities. If I see your day I shall help you wholeheartedly.
hi: Aisha, Rasoolullah (SAW) ki biwi, se riwayat hai: Rasoolullah (SAW) par wahi ki shuruaat sachche khwaab se hui thi. Aur unhone koi khwaab nahi dekha jo subah ki roshan raushni ki tarah pura na hua ho. Iske baad tanhaai unhein aziz lagne lagi, aur wo Hira ki gufa mein akele reh kar kayi raaton tak tahannuth (ibaadat) karte the, phir apne ghar walon ke paas laut aate aur ussi maqsad ke liye dobara sazo-saamaan le jaate. Phir wo Khadija ke paas laut kar phir usi muddat ke liye sazo-saamaan lete, yahan tak ki wahan Haq unpar utar aaya jabki wo Hira ki gufa mein the. Farishta unke paas aaya aur kaha: Padho. Is par unhone jawaab diya: Main padha-likha nahi hoon. Farishte ne unhein pakda aur bhinch diya, yahan tak ki wo mushkil mein aa gaye; phir usne unhein chhod diya aur kaha: Padho. Unhone kaha: Main padha-likha nahi hoon. Farishte ne dobara unhein pakda aur doosri baar bhinch diya yahan tak ki wo mushkil mein aa gaye aur phir unhein chhod diya aur kaha: Padho, is par unhone jawaab diya: Main padha-likha nahi hoon. Farishte ne unhein pakda aur teesri baar bhinch diya, yahan tak ki wo mushkil mein aa gaye aur phir unhein chhod diya aur kaha: Apne Rab ke naam se padho jisne sab kuch paida kiya, jisne insaan ko khoon ke ek lothde se paida kiya. Padho. Aur tumhaara sabse zyada karam karne wala Rab wo hai jisne kalam ka istemaal sikhaaya, insaan ko wo sikhaaya jo wo nahi jaanta tha (Quran 96:1-4). Phir Nabi (SAW) is haalat mein wapas laute, unka dil kaanp raha tha, aur wo Khadija ke paas gaye aur kaha: Mujhe lapet do, mujhe lapet do! To unhone unhein lapet diya yahan tak ki khauf unse door ho gaya. Phir unhone Khadija se kaha: Aye Khadija! Mujhe kya ho gaya hai? aur unhone use waaqiye ke baare mein bataaya, ye kehte hue: Mujhe apni jaan ka khauf hai. Unhone jawaab diya: Aisa nahi ho sakta. Khush ho jaaiye. Main Allah ki qasam khaake kehti hoon ki wo aapko kabhi zaleel nahi karega. Allah ki qasam, aap rishtedaari ka lihaaz rakhte hain, aap sach bolte hain, aap logon ka bojh uthaate hain, aap muflison ki madad karte hain, aap mehmaanon ki izzat-afzaayi karte hain, aur aap logon par aane wale musibaton mein unki madad karte hain. Phir Khadija unhein Waraqa bin Naufal bin Asad bin Abdul-Uzza ke paas le gayin, aur wo Khadija ke chacha ke bete the, yaani unke waalid ke bhai. Aur wo wo shaks the jinhone jaahiliyat ke zamaane mein Isaaiyat qubool ki thi aur wo Arabi mein kitaabein likha karte the, aur is liye unhone Injeel ko bhi Arabi mein likha jaisa Allah ne chaaha ki wo likhein. Wo bahut budhe ho chuke the aur andhe ho gaye the. Khadija ne unse kaha: Aye Chacha! Apne bhatije ki baat suno. Waraqa bin Naufal ne kaha: Aye mere bhatije! Tumne kya dekha? Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unhein bataaya ki unhone kya dekha tha, aur Waraqa ne unse kaha: Ye Namoos (Farishta) hai jise Allah ne Musa (AS) par nazil kiya tha. Kaash main is waqt jawaan hota. Kaash main zinda hota jab aapki qaum aapko nikaal degi! Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Kya wo mujhe nikaal denge? Waraqa ne kaha: Haan. Aajtak koi shaks aisa nahi laaya jaisa tum laaye ho jismein usko dushmani ka saamna na karna pada ho. Agar main tumhaara wo din dekh sakoon, to main poori dil se tumhaari madad karunga.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'A'isha with another chain of narrators like one transmitted by Yunus, i. e. the first thing with which the revelation was initiated with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) except the words: By Allah, Allah would never humiliate you, and Khadija said: O son of my uncle! Listen to the son of your brother.
hi: Ye hadees Aisha ki sanad se ek doosri sanad ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai jaisi Yunus ki riwayat ki gayi hadees hai, yaani wo pehli cheez jisse Rasoolullah (SAW) par wahi ki shuruaat hui, sivaay in alfaaz ke: Allah ki qasam, Allah aapko kabhi zaleel nahi karega, aur Khadija ne kaha: Aye mere chacha ke bete! Apne bhatije ki baat suno.

e: This hadith has been reported from 'A'isha by another chain of transmitters and the words are: He (the Holy Prophet) came to Khadija an his heart was trembling. The rest of the hadith has been narrated like one transmitted by Yunus and Ma'mar, but the first part is not mentioned, i. e. the first thing with which was started the revelation to the Prophet was the true vision. And these words like those transmitted by Yunus are mentioned thus: By Allah, Allah would never humiliate you. And there is also a mention of the words of Khadija: O son of my uncle! Listen to the son of your brother.
hi: Ye hadees Aisha se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur alfaaz ye hain: Wo Khadija ke paas aaye aur unka dil kaanp raha tha. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai jaisi Yunus aur Ma'mar ki riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin pehla hissa zikr nahi hua, yaani wo pehli cheez jisse Nabi (SAW) par wahi ki shuruaat hui wo sachcha khwaab tha. Aur ye alfaaz jaise Yunus ki riwayat mein hain, waise hi zikr kiye gaye hain: Allah ki qasam, Allah aapko kabhi zaleel nahi karega. Aur Khadija ke alfaaz ka bhi zikr hai: Aye mere chacha ke bete! Apne bhatije ki baat suno.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah al-Ansari who was one of the Companions of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) reportedThe Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) told about the intermission of revelation and narrated While I was walking I heard a voice from the sky, and raising my head I saw the angel who had come to me in Hira', sitting on a Throne between heaven and earth I was terror-stricken on that account and came back (to my family) and said: Wrap me up, wrap me up! So they wrapped me up, and the Blessed and Most Exalted Allah sent down:" You who are shrouded, arise and deliver warning, your Lord magnify, your clothes cleanse, and defilement shun," and" defilement" means idols; and then the revelation was followed continuously.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah al-Ansari, jo Rasoolullah (SAW) ke Sahaba mein se the, ne riwayat ki: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne wahi ke rukne ke baare mein bataaya aur riwayat ki: Jab main chal raha tha, maine aasman se ek awaaz suni, aur apna sar uthaakar maine wahi Farishta dekha jo Hira mein mere paas aaya tha, ek Arsh par baitha hua zameen aur aasman ke darmiyaan. Main iski wajah se dahshat mein aa gaya aur apne ghar walon ke paas wapas aaya aur kaha: Mujhe lapet do, mujhe lapet do! To unhone mujhe lapet diya, aur Mubarak aur Sabse Buland Allah ne nazil kiya: 'Aye lipatne wale! Utho aur khabardaar karo, apne Rab ki azmat bayan karo, apne kapde saaf rakho, aur gandagi se door raho,' aur 'gandagi' ka matlab hai but-parasti; aur phir wahi lagataar aati rahi.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Jabir b. Abdullah that he heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) says: The wahi was intermitted for me for a small span of time and while I was walking, and then the hadith like the one narrated by Yunus was transmitted but with the exception of these words: I was terror-stricken till I fell on the ground. Abu Salama said: Defilement means idols. After this the revelation was speeded up and followed rapidly.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah se riwayat hai ki unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Wahi mere liye ek chhote se waqt ke liye ruk gayi thi aur jab main chal raha tha, tab unhone Yunus ki riwayat jaisi hadees bayan ki, sivaay in alfaaz ke: main dahshat mein aa gaya yahan tak ki main zameen par gir gaya. Abu Salama ne kaha: Gandagi ka matlab hai but-parasti. Iske baad wahi tezi se aur lagataar aane lagi.

e: This hadith, the like of one narrated by Yunus has also been transmitted by Ma'mar on the authority of al-Zuhri who narrated: Allah the Most Glorious and Exalted revealed this:" You who are shrouded, arise and deliver warning, your Lord magnify, your clothes cleanse and defilement shun," before making the prayer obligatory. I felt terror-stricken as narrated by Uqail.
hi: Ye hadees, Yunus ki riwayat ki gayi hadees jaisi, Ma'mar ne bhi Zuhri ki sanad se riwayat ki hai jinhone kaha: Sabse Baa-Azmat aur Buland Allah ne ye nazil kiya: 'Aye lipatne wale! Utho aur khabardaar karo, apne Rab ki azmat bayan karo, apne kapde saaf rakho, aur gandagi se door raho,' namaz farz hone se pehle. Main dahshat mein aa gaya jaisa ki Uqail ne riwayat kiya hai.

e: Yahya reported: I asked Abu Salama what was revealed first from the Qur'an. He said:" 0, the shrouded one." I said: Or" Recite." Jabir said: I am narrating to you what was narrated to us by the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He said: I stayed in Hira' for one month and when my stay was completed, I come down and went into the heart of the valley. Somebody called me aloud. I looked in front of me, behind me, on the right of my side and on my left, but I did not see any body. I was again called and I looked about but saw nothing. I was called again and raised my head, and there on the Throne in the open atmosphere he, i. e. Gabriel (peace be upon him) was sitting. I began to tremble on account of fear. I came to Khadija and said: Wrap me up. They wrapped me up and threw water on me and Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, sent down this: you who are shrouded! arise and deliver warning, your Lord magnify, your clothes cleanse."
hi: Yahya ne bataaya: Maine Abu Salama se poocha ki Quran mein sabse pehle kya nazil hua tha. Unhone kaha: 'Aye lipatne wale.' Maine kaha: Ya 'Padho.' Jabir ne kaha: Main tumhein wahi bata raha hoon jo humein Rasoolullah (SAW) ne bataayi thi. Unhone kaha: Main Hira mein ek mahine reha aur jab meri muddat poori ho gayi, to main neeche utara aur waadi ke beechon-beech gaya. Kisi ne mujhe zor se pukaara. Maine apne saamne, apne peeche, apni daayin taraf aur apni baayin taraf dekha, lekin mujhe koi nazar nahi aaya. Mujhe dobara pukaara gaya aur maine dobara dekha lekin kuch nazar nahi aaya. Mujhe phir pukaara gaya aur maine apna sar uthaaya, aur wahan khule aasman mein Arsh par - yaani Jibrael (AS) - baithe hue the. Main dar ke maare kaanpne laga. Main Khadija ke paas aaya aur kaha: Mujhe lapet do. Unhone mujhe lapeta aur mujh par paani daala, aur Allah, Sabse Baa-Azmat aur Buland, ne ye nazil kiya: 'Aye lipatne wale! Utho aur khabardaar karo, apne Rab ki azmat bayan karo, apne kapde saaf rakho.'
