e: Yahya b Abi Kathir has reported this hadith with the same chain of transmitters and narrated: And there he was sitting on the Throne between the heaven and the earth.
hi: Yahya bin Abi Kathir ne ye hadees usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai aur bayan kiya: Aur wahan wo Arsh par baithe hue the, aasman aur zameen ke darmiyaan.

e:
It is narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: I was brought al-Buraq Who is an animal white and long, larger than a donkey but smaller than a mule, who would place his hoof a distance equal to the range of version. I mounted it and came to the Temple (Bait Maqdis in Jerusalem), then tethered it to the ring used by the prophets. I entered the mosque and prayed two rak'ahs in it, and then came out and Gabriel brought me a vessel of wine and a vessel of milk. I chose the milk, and Gabriel said: You have chosen the natural thing. Then he took me to heaven. Gabriel then asked the (gate of heaven) to be opened and he was asked who he was. He replied: Gabriel. He was again asked: Who is with you? He (Gabriel) said: Muhammad. It was said: Has he been sent for? Gabriel replied: He has indeed been sent for. And (the door of the heaven) was opened for us and lo! we saw Adam. He welcomed me and prayed for my good. Then we ascended to the second heaven. Gabriel (peace be upon him) (asked the door of heaven to be opened), and he was asked who he was. He answered: Gabriel; and was again asked: Who is with you? He replied: Muhammad. It was said: Has he been sent for? He replied: He has indeed been sent for. The gate was opened. When I entered 'Isa b. Maryam and Yahya b. Zakariya (peace be upon both of them), cousins from the maternal side. welcomed me and prayed for my good Then I was taken to the third heaven and Gabriel asked for the opening (of the door). He was asked: Who are you? He replied: Gabriel. He was (again) asked: Who is with you? He replied Muhammad (ﷺ). It was said: Has he been sent for? He replied He has indeed been sent for. (The gate) was opened for us and I saw Yusuf (peace of Allah be upon him) who had been given half of (world) beauty. He welcomed me prayed for my well-being. Then he ascended with us to the fourth heaven. Gabriel (peace be upon him) asked for the (gate) to be opened, and it was said: Who is he? He replied: Gabriel. It was (again) said: Who is with you? He said: Muhammad. It was said: Has he been sent for? He replied: He has indeed been sent for. The (gate) was opened for us, and lo! Idris was there. He welcomed me and prayed for my well-being (About him) Allah, the Exalted and the Glorious, has said:" We elevated him (Idris) to the exalted position" (Qur'an xix. 57). Then he ascended with us to the fifth heaven and Gabriel asked for the (gate) to be opened. It was said: Who is he? He replied Gabriel. It was (again) said: Who is with thee? He replied: Muhammad. It was said Has he been sent for? He replied: He has indeed been sent for. (The gate) was opened for us and then I was with Harun (Aaron-peace of Allah be upon him). He welcomed me prayed for my well-being. Then I was taken to the sixth heaven. Gabriel (peace be upon him) asked for the door to be opened. It was said: Who is he? He replied: Gabriel. It was said: Who is with thee? He replied: Muhammad. It was said: Has he been sent for? He replied: He has indeed been sent for. (The gate) was opened for us and there I was with Musa (Moses peace be upon him) He welcomed me and prayed for my well-being. Then I was taken up to the seventh heaven. Gabriel asked the (gate) to be opened. It was said: Who is he? He said: Gabriel It was said. Who is with thee? He replied: Muhammad (may peace be upon him.) It was said: Has he been sent for? He replied: He has indeed been sent for. (The gate) was opened for us and there I found Ibrahim (Abraham peace be upon him) reclining against the Bait-ul-Ma'mur and there enter into it seventy thousand angels every day, never to visit (this place) again. Then I was taken to Sidrat-ul-Muntaha whose leaves were like elephant ears and its fruit like big earthenware vessels. And when it was covered by the Command of Allah, it underwent such a change that none amongst the creation has the power to praise its beauty. 
Then Allah revealed to me a revelation and He made obligatory for me fifty prayers every day and night. Then I went down to Moses (peace be upon him) and he said: What has your Lord enjoined upon your Ummah? I said: Fifty prayers. He said: Return to thy Lord and beg for reduction (in the number of prayers), for your community shallnot be able to bear this burden. as I have put to test the children of Isra'il and tried them (and found them too weak to bear such a heavy burden). He (the Holy Prophet) said: I went back to my Lord and said: My Lord, make things lighter for my Ummah. (The Lord) reduced five prayers for me. I went down to Moses and said. (The Lord) reduced five (prayers) for me, He said: Verily thy Ummah shall not be able to bear this burden; return to thy Lord and ask Him to make things lighter. I then kept going back and forth between my Lord Blessed and Exalted and Moses, till He said: There are five prayers every day and night. O Muhammad, each being credited as ten, so that makes fifty prayers. He who intends to do a good deed and does not do it will have a good deed recorded for him; and if he does it, it will be recorded for him as ten; whereas he who intends to do an evil deed and does not do, it will not be recorded for him; and if he does it, only one evil deed will be recorded. I then came down and when I came to Moses and informed him, he said: Go back to thy Lord and ask Him to make things lighter. Upon this the Messenger of Allah remarked: I returned to my Lord until I felt ashamed before Him.
hi: Anas bin Malik se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Mere paas al-Buraq laaya gaya jo ek safed aur lambaa jaanwar hai, gadhe se bada lekin khachchar se chhota, jo apna khur itni doori par rakhta tha jitni door tak nazar jaati thi. Main uspar sawaar hua aur Baitul Maqdis pahuncha, phir use us kadi (ring) se baandh diya jo Ambiya istemaal karte the. Main masjid mein daakhil hua aur wahan do rak'aat namaz padhi, phir bahar aaya aur Jibrael mere paas sharaab ka ek bartan aur doodh ka ek bartan le aaye. Maine doodh choona, aur Jibrael ne kaha: Aap ne fitrat (fitrah) ki cheez chuni hai. Phir wo mujhe aasman ki taraf le gaye. Jibrael ne aasman ke darwaze ko kholne ki darkhwaast ki aur unse poocha gaya wo kaun hain. Unhone jawaab diya: Jibrael. Unse phir poocha gaya: Tumhaare saath kaun hai? Unhone (Jibrael ne) kaha: Muhammad. Kaha gaya: Kya unhein bulaaya gaya hai? Jibrael ne jawaab diya: Unhein waaqai bulaaya gaya hai. Aur aasman ka darwaza humare liye khol diya gaya aur dekho! humne Aadam (AS) ko dekha. Unhone mera khair-maqdam kiya aur meri bhalaai ke liye dua ki. Phir hum doosre aasman ki taraf chadhe. Jibrael (AS) ne darwaza kholne ki darkhwaast ki, aur unse poocha gaya wo kaun hain. Unhone jawaab diya: Jibrael; aur unse phir poocha gaya: Tumhaare saath kaun hai? Unhone jawaab diya: Muhammad. Kaha gaya: Kya unhein bulaaya gaya hai? Unhone jawaab diya: Unhein waaqai bulaaya gaya hai. Darwaza khol diya gaya. Jab main daakhil hua to Isa bin Maryam aur Yahya bin Zakariya (dono par salaamati ho), jo maasi ke rishte se chachere bhai the, ne mera khair-maqdam kiya aur meri bhalaai ke liye dua ki. Phir mujhe teesre aasman ki taraf le jaaya gaya aur Jibrael ne darwaza kholne ki darkhwaast ki. Unse poocha gaya: Tum kaun ho? Unhone jawaab diya: Jibrael. Unse phir poocha gaya: Tumhaare saath kaun hai? Unhone jawaab diya: Muhammad (SAW). Kaha gaya: Kya unhein bulaaya gaya hai? Unhone jawaab diya: Unhein waaqai bulaaya gaya hai. Darwaza humare liye khola gaya aur maine Yusuf (AS) ko dekha jinhein aadhi duniya ki khoobsurati di gayi thi. Unhone mera khair-maqdam kiya aur meri bhalaai ke liye dua ki. Phir wo humare saath chauthe aasman tak chadhe. Jibrael (AS) ne darwaza kholne ki darkhwaast ki, aur kaha gaya: Ye kaun hai? Unhone jawaab diya: Jibrael. Phir kaha gaya: Tumhaare saath kaun hai? Unhone kaha: Muhammad. Kaha gaya: Kya unhein bulaaya gaya hai? Unhone jawaab diya: Unhein waaqai bulaaya gaya hai. Darwaza humare liye khola gaya, aur dekho! Idris (AS) wahan the. Unhone mera khair-maqdam kiya aur meri bhalaai ke liye dua ki. Unke baare mein Allah, Sabse Baa-Azmat aur Buland, ne farmaya hai: 'Humne unhein Idris ko ek baland maqaam par utha diya' (19:57). Phir wo humare saath paanchwe aasman tak chadhe aur Jibrael ne darwaza kholne ki darkhwaast ki. Kaha gaya: Ye kaun hai? Unhone jawaab diya: Jibrael. Phir kaha gaya: Tumhaare saath kaun hai? Unhone jawaab diya: Muhammad. Kaha gaya: Kya unhein bulaaya gaya hai? Unhone jawaab diya: Unhein waaqai bulaaya gaya hai. Darwaza humare liye khola gaya aur phir main Harun (AS) ke saath tha. Unhone mera khair-maqdam kiya aur meri bhalaai ke liye dua ki. Phir mujhe chhathe aasman ki taraf le jaaya gaya. Jibrael (AS) ne darwaza kholne ki darkhwaast ki. Kaha gaya: Ye kaun hai? Unhone jawaab diya: Jibrael. Kaha gaya: Tumhaare saath kaun hai? Unhone jawaab diya: Muhammad. Kaha gaya: Kya unhein bulaaya gaya hai? Unhone jawaab diya: Unhein waaqai bulaaya gaya hai. Darwaza humare liye khola gaya aur wahan main Musa (AS) ke saath tha. Unhone mera khair-maqdam kiya aur meri bhalaai ke liye dua ki. Phir mujhe saatvein aasman tak le jaaya gaya. Jibrael ne darwaza kholne ki darkhwaast ki. Kaha gaya: Ye kaun hai? Unhone kaha: Jibrael. Kaha gaya: Tumhaare saath kaun hai? Unhone jawaab diya: Muhammad (SAW). Kaha gaya: Kya unhein bulaaya gaya hai? Unhone jawaab diya: Unhein waaqai bulaaya gaya hai. Darwaza humare liye khola gaya aur wahan maine Ibrahim (AS) ko Baitul-Ma'mur par tekiya lagaaye paaya, aur usmein har roz sattar hazaar (70,000) Farishte daakhil hote hain, jo dobara kabhi wahan wapas nahi aate. Phir mujhe Sidrat-ul-Muntaha tak le jaaya gaya jiske pattay haathi ke kaanon jaise the aur iske phal bade mitti ke bartanon jaise the. Aur jab ise Allah ke hukum se dhaanp diya gaya, to ismein aisa badlaav aa gaya ki koi bhi makhlooq iski khoobsurati ki tareef karne ki taaqat nahi rakhti. Phir Allah ne mujh par ek wahi nazil ki aur mujh par din aur raat mein pachaas (50) namazein farz kar dein. Phir main Musa (AS) ke paas neeche gaya aur unhone kaha: Tumhaare Rab ne tumhaari ummat par kya farz kiya? Maine kaha: Pachaas namazein. Unhone kaha: Apne Rab ke paas wapas jao aur namazon ki tadaad mein kami ki darkhwaast karo, kyunki tumhaari ummat is bojh ko nahi utha payegi, jaisa maine Bani Israel ko aazmaaya aur parkha aur unhein isse bahut kamzor paaya. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Main apne Rab ke paas wapas gaya aur kaha: Mere Rab, meri ummat ke liye cheezein aasaan kar dijiye. Rab ne mujhse paanch namazein kam kar din. Main Musa ke paas neeche gaya aur kaha: Rab ne mujhse paanch namazein kam ki hain. Unhone kaha: Beshak tumhaari ummat is bojh ko nahi uthaa payegi; apne Rab ke paas wapas jao aur unse cheezein aasaan karne ko kaho. Phir main lagataar apne Buzurg aur Baa-Azmat Rab aur Musa ke darmiyaan aata-jaata raha, yahan tak ki unhone farmaaya: Din aur raat mein paanch namazein hain, Aye Muhammad, har ek ko das ke barabar samjha jaayega, is liye ye asal mein pachaas namazein ke barabar hain. Jisne achha amal karne ka iraada kiya lekin usne wo na kiya, uske liye ek achha amal darj kiya jaayega; aur agar usne kiya, to uske liye das darj kiye jaayenge; jabki jisne burayi karne ka iraada kiya lekin usne wo na ki, to uske liye kuch darj nahi kiya jaayega; aur agar usne kiya, to sirf ek burayi darj ki jaayegi. Phir main neeche aaya aur jab main Musa ke paas aaya aur unhein bataaya, to unhone kaha: Apne Rab ke paas wapas jao aur unse cheezein aasaan karne ko kaho. Is par Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Main apne Rab ke paas wapas gaya yahan tak ki mujhe unke saamne sharam mehsoos hone lagi.

e: It is narrated on the the outhority of Anas b. Malik that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: (the angels) came to me and took me to the Zamzam and my heart was opened and washed with the water of Zamzam and then I was left (at my place).
hi: Anas bin Malik se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Farishte mere paas aaye aur mujhe Zamzam ke paas le gaye aur mera seena khola gaya aur Zamzam ke paani se dhoya gaya, phir mujhe mere jagah par chhod diya gaya.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Gabriel came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) while he was playing with his playmates. He took hold of him and lay him prostrate on the ground and tore open his breast and took out the heart from it and then extracted a blood-clot out of it and said: That was the part of Satan in thee. And then he washed it with the water of Zamzam in a golden basin and then it was joined together and restored to it place. The boys came running to his mother, i. e. his nurse, and said: Verily Muhammad has been murdered. They all rushed toward him (and found him all right) His color was changed, Anas said. I myself saw the marks of needle on his breast.
hi: Anas bin Malik se riwayat hai ki Jibrael Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aaye jab wo apne saathiyon ke saath khel rahe the. Unhone unhein pakda aur zameen par lita diya aur unka seena chaak kiya aur usmein se dil nikala aur phir usmein se ek khoon ka lotha nikaala aur kaha: Ye tere andar Shaitan ka hissa tha. Aur phir unhone use ek sone ke bartan mein Zamzam ke paani se dhoya aur phir use jodkar wapas apni jagah par rakh diya. Bache daudte hue unki ma, yaani unki dhaatri, ke paas gaye aur kaha: Beshak Muhammad ko qatl kar diya gaya hai. Wo sab unki taraf daude aur unhein theek-thaak paaya. Unka rang badla hua tha. Anas ne kaha: Maine khud unke seene par sui ke nishaan dekhe the.

e: Anas b. Malik, while recounting the Night journey of the Prophet (ﷺ), from the mosque of Ka'bah, reported: Three beings (angels) came to him in the mosque of the Ka'bah, while he was sleeping in the sacred mosque before it (the Command of Night Journey and Accension) was revealed to him. The rest of the hadith is narrated like that of Thabit. However, some portions have occurred before and some of them have occurred after; some have been added and some deleted.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne, Nabi (SAW) ke Shab-e-Isra (Raat ki Musaafirat) ka zikr karte hue, Ka'ba ki masjid se, riwayat ki: Teen hastiyaan (Farishte) unke paas Ka'ba ki masjid mein aayin, jab wo Masjid-e-Haraam mein so rahe the isse pehle ki ye hukum unpar nazil kiya jaaye. Baaki hadees waisi hi riwayat ki gayi hai jaisi Thabit ki riwayat ki gayi hai. Halaanki kuch hisse pehle aaye hain aur kuch baad mein aaye hain; kuch izafa kiye gaye hain aur kuch hataaye gaye hain.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: Abu Dharr used to relate that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The roof of my house was cleft when I was in Mecca and Gabriel descended and opened my heart and then washed it with the water of Zamzam. He then brought a gold basin full of wisdom and faith and after emptying it into my breast, he closed it up. Then taking me by he hand, he ascended with me to th heaven, and when we came to the lowest heaven, Gabriel said to the guardian of the lowest heaven: Open. He asked who was there? He replied. It is Gabriel. He again asked whe he there was someone with him. He replied: Yes, it is Muhammad with me. He was asked if he had been sent for, He (Gabriel) said: Yes. Then he opened (the gate). When we ascended the lowest heaven (I saw) a man seated with parties on his right side and parties on his left side. When he looked up to his right, he laughed and when he looked to his left, he wept. He said: Welcome to the righteous apostle and the righteous son. I asked Gabriel who he was and he replied: He is Adam (peace be upon him) and these parties on his right and on his left are the souls of his descendants. Those of them on his right are the inmates of Paradise and the parties which are on his left side are the inmates of Hell; so when he looked towards his right side, he laughed, and when he looked towards his left side, he wept. Then Gabriel ascended with me to the second heaven. He asked its guardian to open (its gate), and its guardian replied in the same way as the guardian of the lowest heaven had said. He (opened it). Anas b. Malik said: He (the Holy Prophet) mentioned that he found in the heavens Adam, Idris, Jesus, Moses and Abraham (may peace be on all of them), but he did not ascertain as to the nature of their abodes except that he had found Adam in the lowest heaven and Abraham in the sixth heaven. When Gabriel and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) passed by Idris (peace be upon him) he said: Welcome to the righteous apostle and righteous brother. He (the narrator) said: He then proceeded and said: Who is he? Gabriel replied: It is Idris. Then I passed by Moses (peace be upon him) and he said: Welcome tothe righteous apostle and righteous brother. I said to (Gabriel): Who is he? He replied: It is Moses. Then I passed by Jesus and he said: Welcome to the righteous apostle and righteous brother. I said (to Gabriel): Who is he? He replied: Jesus, son of Mary. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Then I went to Ibrahim (peace be upon him). He said: Welcome to the righteous apostle and righteous son. I asked: Who is he? He (Gabriel) replied: It is Abraham. Ibn Shihab said: Ibn Hazm told me that Ibn 'Abbas and Abd Habba al-Ansari used to say that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Thereafter he ascended with me till I was taken to such a height where I heard the scraping of the pens. Ibn Hazm and Anas told that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Allah then made fifty prayers obligatory for my Ummah and I returned with that and passed by Moses. Moses, (peace be upon him) said: What has thy Lord enjoined on thy people? I said: Fifty prayers have been made obligatory on them. Moses (peace be upon him) said: Return to thy Lord, for thy Ummah would not be able to bear this burden. Then I came back to my Lord and He remitted a portion out of thut. I then again went to Moses (peace be upon him) and informed him about it He said: Return to thy Lord, for thy Ummah shall not be able to bear this burden. I then went back to my Lord and He said: They are five and at the same time fifty, and what has been said will not be changed. I then returned to Moses and he said: Go back to thy Lord. whereupon I said: I feel ashamed of my Lord. Gabriel then travelled with me till we came to the farthest lote-tree Many a colour had covered it which I do not know. Then I was admitted to Paradise and saw in it domes of pearls, and its soil of musk.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya: Abu Dharr riwayat kiya karte the ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Mere ghar ki chhat phaad di gayi jab main Makkah mein tha aur Jibrael utre aur mera seena khola aur phir use Zamzam ke paani se dhoya. Phir wo hikmat aur imaan se bhara ek sone ka bartan le aaye aur use mere seene mein daalne ke baad, unhone use band kar diya. Phir mera haath thaamkar, wo mere saath aasman ki taraf chadhe, aur jab hum sabse neeche waale aasman tak pahunche, to Jibrael ne neeche waale aasman ke nigehbaan se kaha: Kholo. Usne poocha kaun hai? Unhone jawaab diya: Ye Jibrael hai. Usne phir poocha ki kya unke saath koi hai. Unhone jawaab diya: Haan, mere saath Muhammad hain. Usse poocha gaya ki kya unhein bulaaya gaya hai. Unhone (Jibrael ne) kaha: Haan. Phir usne darwaza khol diya. Jab hum sabse neeche waale aasman par chadhe to maine dekha ek shaks baitha hua tha jiske daayin taraf giroh the aur baayin taraf bhi giroh the. Jab wo apni daayin taraf dekhta, to hansta, aur jab apni baayin taraf dekhta, to rota. Usne kaha: Nek Rasool aur nek bete ka khair-maqdam ho. Maine Jibrael se poocha ki wo kaun hai aur unhone jawaab diya: Wo Aadam (AS) hain, aur ye giroh unke daayin aur baayin taraf unki aulaad ki roohein hain. Unmein se jo daayin taraf hain wo Jannati hain, aur jo giroh baayin taraf hai wo Jahannami hain; is liye jab wo apni daayin taraf dekhte hain, to hanste hain, aur jab apni baayin taraf dekhte hain, to rote hain. Phir Jibrael mere saath doosre aasman tak chadhe. Unhone iske nigehbaan se darwaza kholne ko kaha, aur uske nigehbaan ne bhi wahi jawaab diya jo sabse neeche waale aasman ke nigehbaan ne diya tha. Usne khol diya. Anas bin Malik ne kaha: Unhone zikr kiya ki unhone aasmanon mein Aadam, Idris, Isa, Musa aur Ibrahim (sab par salaamati ho) ko paaya, lekin unhone ye tay nahi kiya ki unke thikaane ki nau'iyat kya thi, sivaay iske ki unhone Aadam ko sabse neeche waale aasman mein aur Ibrahim ko chhathe aasman mein paaya. Jab Jibrael aur Rasoolullah (SAW) Idris (AS) ke paas se guzre, to unhone kaha: Nek Rasool aur nek bhai ka khair-maqdam ho. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Phir wo aage badhe aur poocha: Ye kaun hai? Jibrael ne jawaab diya: Ye Idris hain. Phir main Musa (AS) ke paas se guzra aur unhone kaha: Nek Rasool aur nek bhai ka khair-maqdam ho. Maine (Jibrael se) poocha: Ye kaun hai? Unhone jawaab diya: Ye Musa hain. Phir main Isa ke paas se guzra aur unhone kaha: Nek Rasool aur nek bhai ka khair-maqdam ho. Maine poocha: Ye kaun hain? Unhone jawaab diya: Isa bin Maryam. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Phir main Ibrahim (AS) ke paas gaya. Unhone kaha: Nek Rasool aur nek bete ka khair-maqdam ho. Maine poocha: Ye kaun hain? Unhone (Jibrael ne) jawaab diya: Ye Ibrahim hain. Ibn Shihab ne kaha: Ibn Hazm ne mujhe bataaya ki Ibn Abbas aur Abd Habba al-Ansari kaha karte the ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Iske baad wo mere saath itni baland jagah tak chadhe ki maine qalamon ki kharaash suni. Ibn Hazm aur Anas ne bataaya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Phir Allah ne meri ummat par pachaas namazein farz kar din aur main unhein leke wapas aaya aur Musa ke paas se guzra. Musa (AS) ne kaha: Tumhaare Rab ne tumhaari ummat par kya farz kiya hai? Maine kaha: Unpar pachaas namazein farz ki gayin hain. Musa (AS) ne kaha: Apne Rab ke paas wapas jao, kyunki tumhaari ummat is bojh ko nahi uthaa payegi. Phir main apne Rab ke paas wapas gaya aur unhone usmein se kuch hissa maaf kar diya. Phir main dobara Musa (AS) ke paas gaya aur unhein iske baare mein bataaya. Unhone kaha: Apne Rab ke paas wapas jao, kyunki tumhaari ummat is bojh ko nahi uthaa payegi. Phir main apne Rab ke paas wapas gaya aur unhone farmaaya: Ye paanch hain, aur sawaab mein usi waqt pachaas bhi hain, aur jo kaha ja chuka hai wo badla nahi jaayega. Phir main Musa ke paas wapas gaya aur unhone kaha: Apne Rab ke paas wapas jao, is par maine kaha: Mujhe apne Rab se sharam mehsoos ho rahi hai. Phir Jibrael mere saath tab tak chalte rahe jab tak hum sabse door waale Sidrat (bair ke ped) tak nahi pahunch gaye. Bahut saare rang usko dhaanke hue the jinhein main nahi jaanta. Phir mujhe Jannat mein daakhil kiya gaya aur maine usmein moti ke gumbad dekhe, aur uski mitti kasturi thi.

e: Anas b. Malik reported on the authority of Malik b. Sa sa', perhaps a person of his tribe, that the Prophet of Allah (ﷺ) said: I was near the House (i. e. Ka'bah) in a state between sleep and wakefulness when I heard someone say: He is the third among the two persons. Then he came to me and took me with him. Then a golden basin containing the water of Zamzam was brought to me and my heart was opened up to such and such (part). Qatada said: I asked him who was with me (i e. the narrator) and what he meant by such and such (part). He replied: (It means that it was opened) up to the lower part of his abdomen (Then the hadith continues): My heart was extracted and it was washed with the water of Zamzam and then it was restored in its original position, after which it was filled with faith and wisdom. I was then brought a white beast which is called al-Buraq, bigger than a donkey and smaller than a mule. Its stride was as long as the eye could reach. I was mounted on it, and then we went forth till we reached the lowest heaven. Gabriel asked for the (gate) to be opened, and it was said: Who is he? He replied: Gabriel. It was again said: Who is with thee? He replied: Muhammad (ﷺ). It was said: Has he been sent for? He (Gabriel) said: Yes. He (the Prophet) said: Then (the gate) was opened for us (and it was said): Welcome unto him! His is a blessed arrival. Then we came to Adam (peace be upon him). And he (the narrator) narrated the whole account of the hadith. (The Holy Prophet) observed that he met Jesus in the second heaven, Yahya (peace be on both of them) in the third heaven, Yusuf in the third, Idris in the fourth, Harun in the fifth (peace and blessings of Allah be upon them). Then we travelled on till we reached the sixth heaven and came to Moses (peace be upon him) and I greeted him and he said: Welcome unto righteous brother and righteous prophet. And when I passed (by him) he wept, and a voice was heard saying: What makes thee weep? He said: My Lord, he is a young man whom Thou hast sent after me (as a prophet) and his followers will enter Paradise in greater numbers than my followers. Then we travelled on till we reached the seventh heaven and I came to Ibrahim. He (the narrator) narrat- ed in this hadith that the Prophet of Allah (ﷺ) told that he saw four rivers which flowed from (the root of the lote-tree of the farthest limits): two manifest rivers and two hidden rivers. I said: ' Gabriel! what are these rivers? He replied: The two hidden rivers are the rivers of Paradise, and as regards the two manifest ones, they are the Nile and the Euphrates. Then the Bait-ul-Ma'mur was raised up to me. I said: O Gabriel! what is this? He replied: It is the Bait-ul-Ma'mur. Seventy thousand angels enter into it daily and, after they come out, they never return again. Two vessels were then brought to me. The first one contained wine and the second one contained milk, and both of them were placed before me. I chose milk. It was said: You did right. Allah will guide rightly through you your Ummah on the natural course. Then fifty prayers daily were made obligatory for me. And then he narrated the rest of the hadith to the end.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne Malik bin Sa'sa ki sanad se riwayat ki, shaayad unke qabile ka koi shaks, ki Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Main Ghar (yaani Ka'ba) ke qareeb neend aur jaagne ke darmiyaan ki halat mein tha jab maine kisi ko kehte suna: Wo teen mein se doosra hai in do logon ke darmiyaan. Phir wo mere paas aaye aur mujhe apne saath le gaye. Phir mere paas Zamzam ke paani se bhara sone ka bartan laaya gaya aur mera seena kholkar itna nikaala gaya jitna zaroorat thi. Qatada ne kaha: Maine unse poocha ki mere saath kaun tha aur unka 'itna' se kya matlab tha. Unhone jawaab diya: Iska matlab hai ki ye unke pet ke neeche waale hisse tak khola gaya. Phir hadees jaari rehti hai: Mera dil nikaala gaya aur use Zamzam ke paani se dhoya gaya aur phir use uski asal jagah par wapas rakh diya gaya, jiske baad use imaan aur hikmat se bhar diya gaya. Phir mere paas ek safed jaanwar laaya gaya jise al-Buraq kaha jaata hai, gadhe se bada aur khachchar se chhota. Uska kadam itna lamba tha jitni door tak nazar jaa sakti thi. Mujhe uspar sawaar kiya gaya, aur phir hum chal pade yahan tak ki hum sabse neeche waale aasman tak pahunche. Jibrael ne darwaza kholne ki darkhwaast ki, aur kaha gaya: Ye kaun hai? Unhone jawaab diya: Jibrael. Phir poocha gaya: Tumhaare saath kaun hai? Unhone jawaab diya: Muhammad (SAW). Kaha gaya: Kya unhein bulaaya gaya hai? Unhone (Jibrael ne) kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha: Phir darwaza humare liye khola gaya aur kaha gaya: Unka khair-maqdam ho! Unka aana mubarak hai. Phir hum Aadam (AS) ke paas aaye. Aur unhone poori hadees bayan ki. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne bataaya ki unki mulaqat Isa se doosre aasman mein hui, Yahya (dono par salaamati ho) teesre aasman mein, Yusuf teesre mein, Idris chauthe mein, Harun paanchwe mein. Phir hum safar karte rahe yahan tak ki hum chhathe aasman tak pahunche aur Musa (AS) ke paas aaye aur maine unhein salaam kiya aur unhone kaha: Nek bhai aur nek Nabi ka khair-maqdam ho. Aur jab main aage badha, to wo rone lage, aur ek awaaz sunayi di jo poochh rahi thi: Tumhein kis cheez ne rulaaya? Unhone kaha: Mere Rab, ye ek jawaan shaks hain jinhein Tune mere baad Nabi banaakar bheja hai, aur inki ummat mere ummat se zyada tadaad mein Jannat mein daakhil hogi. Phir hum safar karte rahe yahan tak ki hum saatvein aasman tak pahunche aur main Ibrahim (AS) ke paas aaya. Unhone is hadees mein bataaya ki Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne bataaya ki unhone chaar nadiyaan behte dekhi: do zaahiri nadiyaan aur do chhupi hui nadiyaan. Maine kaha: Jibrael! Ye nadiyaan kya hain? Unhone jawaab diya: Do chhupi hui nadiyaan Jannat ki nadiyaan hain, aur jahan tak do zaahir nadiyon ka taalluq hai, wo Nile aur Furat hain. Phir Baitul-Ma'mur ko mere saamne oopar uthaaya gaya. Maine kaha: Aye Jibrael! Ye kya hai? Unhone jawaab diya: Ye Baitul-Ma'mur hai. Sattar hazaar (70,000) Farishte har roz ismein daakhil hote hain aur baahar aane ke baad, wo kabhi dobara wapas nahi aate. Phir mere paas do bartan laaye gaye. Pehle mein sharaab thi aur doosre mein doodh, aur dono mere saamne rakh diye gaye. Maine doodh chuna. Kaha gaya: Aap ne theek kiya. Allah aapke zariye aapki ummat ko fitrat (fitrah) ki raah par sahi tareeke se rehnumaai karega. Phir mujh par din mein pachaas namazein farz ki gayin. Aur phir unhone hadees ke aakhir tak baaki bayan ki.

e: It is reported on the authority of Malik b. Sa'sa' that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) narrated the hadith (mentioned above) and added to it: I was brought a gold basin full of wisdom and faith, and then the (part of the body) right from the upper end of the chest to the lower part of the abdomen was opened and it was washed with the water of Zamzam and then flled with wisdom and faith.
hi: Malik bin Sa'sa ki sanad se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne upar bayan ki gayi hadees riwayat ki aur usmein izafa kiya: Mere paas hikmat aur imaan se bhara ek sone ka bartan laaya gaya, aur phir jism ka wo hissa seene ke oopari sire se pet ke neeche waale hisse tak khola gaya aur ise Zamzam ke paani se dhoya gaya aur phir hikmat aur imaan se bhar diya gaya.

e: Qatada reported that he heard Abu al-'Aliya saying that the cousin of your Prophet (ﷺ), i. e. Ibn Abbas, told him: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), while narrating his night journey observed: Musa (peace be upon him) was a man of high stature as if he was of the people of the Shanu'a (tribe), and Jesus was a well-built person having curly hair. He also mentioned Malik, the guardian of Hell, and Dajjal.
hi: Qatada ne bataaya ki unhone Abul-Aaliya ko ye kehte suna ki tumhaare Nabi (SAW) ke chachere bhai, yaani Ibn Abbas, ne unhein bataaya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne, apni Shab-e-Isra ka bayaan karte hue, farmaya: Musa (AS) ek lambe qad ke shaks the, goya wo Shanu'a qabile ke logon mein se the, aur Isa ek mazboot jism ke, ghungrale baalon wale shaks the. Aap (SAW) ne Jahannam ke nigehbaan Malik aur Dajjal ka bhi zikr kiya.

e: Abu al-'Aliya reported: Ibn Abbas, the son of your Prophet's uncle, told us that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had observed: On the night of my night journey I passed by Moses b. 'Imran (peace be upon him), a man light brown in complexion, tall. well-built as if he was one of the men of the Shanu'a, and saw Jesus son of Mary as a medium-statured man with white and red complexion and crisp hair, and I was shown Malik the guardian of Fire, and Dajjal amongst the signs which were shown to me by Allah. He (the narrator) observed: Then do not doubt his (i. e. of the Holy Prophet) meeting with him (Moses). Qatada elucidated it thus: Verily the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), met Moses (peace be upon him).
hi: Abul-Aaliya ne bataaya: Ibn Abbas, tumhaare Nabi (SAW) ke chacha ke bete, ne humein bataaya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Meri Shab-e-Isra ki raat mujhe Musa bin Imran (AS) ke paas se guzarne ka mauqa mila, ek halke bhoore rang ke, lambe, mazboot jism wale shaks jaise wo Shanu'a ke logon mein se the, aur maine Isa bin Maryam ko darmiyaane qad ke, safed-surkh rang aur ghungrale baalon wale shaks ke soorat mein dekha, aur mujhe Malik dikhaaya gaya, aag ka nigehbaan, aur Dajjal, un nishaaniyon mein se jo Allah ne mujhe dikhaayin. Unhone kaha: Phir unki Musa se mulaqaat mein shak mat karo. Qatada ne ise waazeh karte hue kaha: Beshak Rasoolullah (SAW) ki Musa (AS) se mulaqaat hui.

e: Abu al-'Aliya narrated it on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) passed through the valley of Azraq, and he asked: Which valley is this? They said: This is the valley of Azraq, and he observed: (I perceive) as if I am seeing Moses (peace be upon him) coming down from the mountain track, and he is calling upon Allah loudly (saying: Here I am! at your service! ). Then he came to the mountain track of Harsha. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Which is this mountain track? They said: It is the mountain track of Harsha. He observed (I feel) as If I am seeing Yunus (Jonah-peace be upon him) son of Matta on a well- built red dromedary, with a cloak of wool around him and the rein of his dromedary is made of the fibres of date-palm, and he is calling upon Allah (saying: Here I am! at your service, my Lord! ). Ibn Hanbal said in the hadith narrated by him: Hushaim said that the meaning of khulba was fibre of date-palm.
hi: Abul-Aaliya ne ise Ibn Abbas ki sanad se riwayat kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) Azraq ki waadi se guzre, aur unhone poocha: Ye kaunsi waadi hai? Unhone kaha: Ye Azraq ki waadi hai, aur aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Mujhe aisa lagta hai goya main Musa (AS) ko pahaadi raste se neeche aate dekh raha hoon, aur wo zor se Allah ko pukaar rahe hain kehte hue: Main haazir hoon! Aapki khidmat mein. Phir wo Harsha ke pahaadi raste par pahunche. Aap (SAW) ne kaha: Ye kaunsa pahaadi raasta hai? Unhone kaha: Ye Harsha ka pahaadi raasta hai. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Mujhe mehsoos hota hai goya main Yunus (AS) bin Matta ko ek mazboot laal oontni par dekh raha hoon, unke ird-gird oon ki chaadar hai aur unki oontni ki naath khajoor ke reshon se bani hai, aur wo Allah ko pukaar rahe hain kehte hue: Main haazir hoon! Mere Rab, Aapki khidmat mein. Ibn Hanbal ne apni riwayat ki gayi hadees mein kaha: Hushaim ne kaha ki khulba ka matlab khajoor ka resha hai.

e: Abu al-'Aliya narrated it on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said: We travelled with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) between Mecca and Medina and we passed by a valley. He (the Holy Prophet) asked: Which valley is this? They said: This is the valley of Azraq Upon this he (the Holy Prophet) remarked: (I feel) as if I am seeing Moses (peace be upon him), and then he described something about his complexion and hair, which Diwud (the narrator) could not remember. He (Moses, as described by the Holy Prophet) was keeping his fingers in his ears and was responding loudly to Allah (saying: I am as Thy service, my Lord) while passing through that valley. We then travelled (further) till we came to the mountain trail. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Which mountain trail is this? They said: It is the Harsha or Lift. He (the Holy Prophet) said: (I perceive) as if I am seeing Yunus on a red camel, with a cloak of wool around him. The halter of his camel was that of the fibre of date-palm, and he was passing through the valley saying: I am at Thy service! my Lord.
hi: Abul-Aaliya ne ise Ibn Abbas ki sanad se riwayat kiya ki unhone kaha: Hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath Makkah aur Madina ke darmiyaan safar kar rahe the aur ek waadi se guzre. Aap (SAW) ne poocha: Ye kaunsi waadi hai? Unhone kaha: Ye Azraq ki waadi hai. Is par aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Mujhe mehsoos hota hai goya main Musa (AS) ko dekh raha hoon, aur phir unhone unke rang aur baalon ke baare mein kuch bayan kiya, jo Dawud yaad nahi rakh paaye. Wo Musa apni ungliyaan apne kaanon mein rakhe hue the aur zor se Allah ko jawaab de rahe the kehte hue: Main Aapki khidmat mein hoon, mere Rab, us waadi se guzarte hue. Phir hum aage safar karte rahe yahan tak ki hum pahaadi rastay tak pahunche. Aap (SAW) ne kaha: Ye kaunsa pahaadi raasta hai? Unhone kaha: Ye Harsha ya Lift hai. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Mujhe aisa lagta hai goya main Yunus (AS) ko ek laal oont par dekh raha hoon, unke ird-gird oon ki chaadar hai. Unke oont ki naath khajoor ke reshon ki thi, aur wo us waadi se guzarte hue keh rahe the: Main Aapki khidmat mein hoon! Mere Rab.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Mujahid that he said: We were with Ibn 'Abbas and (the people) talked about al-Dajjal. (One of them remarked. There is written between his eyes (the word) Kafir (infidel). The narrator said: Ibn 'Abbas remarked: I did not hear him (the Holy Prophet) say it, but he said: So far as Ibrahim is concerned. you may see your companion and so far as Moses is concerned, he is a well-built man with wheat complexion (riding) on a red camel with its halter made of the fibre of date-palm (and I perceive) as if I am seeing towards him as he is going down in the valley saying: I am at Thy service! my Lord.
hi: Mujahid se riwayat hai ki unhone kaha: Hum Ibn Abbas ke saath the aur logon ne Dajjal ke baare mein baat ki. Unmein se ek ne kaha: Uski dono aankhon ke beech 'Kaafir' likha hoga. Raawi ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ne kaha: Maine unhein ye kehte nahi suna, lekin unhone kaha: Jahan tak Ibrahim ka taalluq hai, tum apne saathi ko dekh sakte ho, aur jahan tak Musa ka taalluq hai, wo ek mazboot jism wale, gehun jaise rang ke shaks hain, ek laal oont par sawaar, jiski naath khajoor ke reshon se bani hai aur mujhe mehsoos hota hai goya main unhein waadi mein utarte dekh raha hoon, ye kehte hue: Main Aapki khidmat mein hoon! Mere Rab.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Jabir that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: There appeared before me the apostles, and Moses was among men as if he was one of the people of Shanu'a, and I saw Jesus son of Mary (peace be upon him) and I saw nearest in resemblance with him was 'Urwa b. Mas'ud, and I saw Ibrahim (blessings of Allah be upon him) and I see your companions much in resemblance with him, i. e. his personality, and I saw Gabriel (peace be upon him) and I saw Dihya nearest in resemblance to him; but in the narration of Ibn Rumh it is Dihya b. Khalifa.
hi: Jabir se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Mere saamne Rasool zaahir hue, aur Musa logon mein aisi shakl ke the goya wo Shanu'a qabile ke ek shaks the, aur maine Isa bin Maryam (AS) ko dekha aur maine paaya ki unse sabse zyada mushaabahat rakhne wale Urwah bin Mas'ood the, aur maine Ibrahim ko dekha aur maine paaya ki tumhaare saathi, yaani khud Rasoolullah (SAW), unse sabse zyada mushaabahat rakhte hain, yaani unki shakhsiyat mein, aur maine Jibrael (AS) ko dekha aur maine paaya ki Dihya unse sabse zyada mushaabahat rakhte hain; lekin Ibn Rumh ki riwayat mein Dihya bin Khalifa hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When I was taken for the night journey I met Moses peace be upon him). The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) gave his description thus: He was a man, I suppose-and he (the narrator) was somewhat doubtful (that the Prophet observed): (Moses) was a man erect in stature with straight hair on his head as it he was one of the men of the Shanu'a; and I met Jesus and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) described him as one having a medium stature and a red complexion as if he had (just) come out of the bath He observed: I saw Ibrahim (peace be upon him) and amongst his children I have the greatest resemblance with him. He said: There were brought to me two vessels. In one of them was milk and in the other one there was wine. And it was said to me: Select any one you like. So I selected the vessel containing milk and drank it. He (the angel) said: You have been guided on al-fitra or you have attained al-fitra. Had you selected wine, your Ummah would have been misled.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab mujhe Shab-e-Isra ke liye le jaaya gaya, to meri mulaqat Musa (AS) se hui. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unki shakl-o-soorat kuch is tarah bayan ki: Wo ek shaks the, mera khayaal hai - aur wo raawi kuch shak mein the ki Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Musa seedhe qad ke shaks the seedhe baalon ke saath jaise wo Shanu'a qabile ke logon mein se the; aur meri mulaqat Isa se bhi hui aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unhein darmiyaane qad ka aur surkh rang ka bataaya jaise wo abhi-abhi nahaakar aaye hon. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Maine Ibrahim (AS) ko dekha aur unki aulaad mein mujhe unse sabse zyada mushaabahat hai. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Mere paas do bartan laaye gaye. Ek mein doodh tha aur doosre mein sharaab. Aur mujhse kaha gaya: Jo bhi aapko pasand ho use chun lijiye. Is liye maine doodh waala bartan chuna aur use piya. Unhone kaha: Aapko fitrat (fitrah) ki raah dikhaayi gayi hai, ya aap fitrat ko paa chuke hain. Agar aap sharaab chunte, to aapki ummat gumrah ho jaati.

e: It is narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah b. Umar that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: I found myself one night near the Ka'bah, and I saw a man with wheat complexion amongst the fair-complexioned men that you ever saw. He had a lock of hair the most beautiful of the locks that you ever saw. He had combed it. Water was trickling out of them. He was leaning on two men, or on the shoulders of two men, and he was circumscribing the Ka'bah. I asked, What is he? It was said: He is al-Masih son of Mary. Then I saw another person, stout and having too much curly hair, and blind in his right eye as if it was a full swollen grape. I asked Who is he? It was said: He is al-Masih al-Dajjal.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Main ek raat Ka'ba ke qareeb tha aur maine gora-chitta logon mein se gehun jaise rang ka ek shaks dekha jo sabse khoobsurat gora shaks tha jise tumne kabhi dekha ho. Unke baal ghunghraale the, sabse khoobsurat ghunghraale baal jo tumne kabhi dekhe hon. Unhone use kanghi ki thi. Paani unse tapak raha tha. Wo do logon par, ya do logon ke kandhon par tekiya lagaaye hue the, aur wo Ka'ba ka tawaaf kar rahe the. Maine poocha: Ye kaun hain? Kaha gaya: Ye Maryam ke bete al-Masih hain. Phir maine ek aur shaks dekha, mote aur bahut ghunghraale baalon wale, aur apni daayin aankh se andhe, goya wo phooli hui angoor ki tarah thi. Maine poocha: Ye kaun hain? Kaha gaya: Ye al-Masih ad-Dajjal hain.

e: It is narrated on the authority of 'Abdulldh b. Umar that one day the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) mentioned in the presence of people about al-Masih al-Dajjal. He said: Verily Allah (hallowed be He and High) is not blind of one eye. Behold, but the Masih al-Dajjal is blind of right eye as if his eye is like a swollen grape, and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: I was shown in a dream in the night that near the Ka'bah there was a man fair-complexioned, fine amongst the white-complexioned men that you ever saw, his locks of hair were falling on his shoulders. He was a man whose hair were neither too curly nor too straight, and water trickled down from his head. He was placing his bands on the shoulders of two persons and amidst them was making a circuit around the Ka'bah. I said: Who is he? They replied: Al-Masih son of Mary. And I saw behind him a man with intensely curly hair, blind of right eye. Amongst the persons I have ever seen Ibn Qatan has the greatest resemblance with him. He was making a circuit around the Ka'bah by placing both his hands on the shoulders of two persons. I said: Who is he? They said; It is al-Masih al-Dajjal.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar se riwayat hai ki ek din Rasoolullah (SAW) ne logon ke saamne al-Masih ad-Dajjal ka zikr kiya. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Beshak Allah (Paak aur Buland) kaani (ek aankh se andha) nahi hai. Suno, lekin Masih ad-Dajjal daayin aankh se kaana hai goya uski aankh phooli hui angoor ki tarah hai, aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Mujhe raat ke ek khwaab mein dikhaaya gaya ki Ka'ba ke qareeb ek gora shaks tha, gore logon mein sabse achha jise tumne kabhi dekha ho, uski zulfein uske kandhon par gir rahi thi. Wo ek aisa shaks tha jiske baal na zyada ghunghraale the na bilkul seedhe, aur uske sar se paani tapak raha tha. Wo apne haath do logon ke kandhon par rakhe hue tha aur unke beech Ka'ba ka tawaaf kar raha tha. Maine kaha: Ye kaun hai? Unhone jawaab diya: Al-Masih, Maryam ke bete. Aur maine unke peeche ek shaks dekha ghane ghunghraale baalon wala, daayin aankh se kaana. Jitne log maine dekhe hain unmein se Ibn Qatan unse sabse zyada milta-julta tha. Wo apne dono haath do logon ke kandhon par rakhkar Ka'ba ka tawaaf kar raha tha. Maine kaha: Ye kaun hai? Unhone kaha: Ye al-Masih ad-Dajjal hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: I saw near the Ka'bah a man of fair complexion with straight hair, placing his hands on two persons. Water was flowing from his head or it was trickling from his head. I asked: Who is he? They said: He is Jesus son of Mary or al-Masih son of Mary. The narrator) says: I do not remember which word it was. He (the Holy Prophet) said: And I saw behind him a man with red complexion and thick curly hair, blind in the right eye. I saw in him the greatest resemblance with Ibn Qitan I asked: Who is he? They replied: It is al-Masih al-Dajjal.
hi: Ibn Umar se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Maine Ka'ba ke qareeb ek gore rang ke, seedhe baalon waale shaks ko dekha, apne haath do logon par rakhe hue. Paani uske sar se bah raha tha ya tapak raha tha. Maine poocha: Ye kaun hai? Unhone kaha: Ye Isa bin Maryam hain ya al-Masih bin Maryam. Raawi ne kaha: Mujhe yaad nahi kaunsa lafz tha. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Aur maine unke peeche ek surkh rang ka, ghane ghunghraale baalon waala shaks dekha, daayin aankh se kaana. Maine unmein Ibn Qitan se sabse zyada mushaabahat dekhi. Maine poocha: Ye kaun hai? Unhone jawaab diya: Ye al-Masih ad-Dajjal hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Jabir b. 'Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When the Quraish belied me, I was staying in Hatim and Allah lifted before me Bait-ul-Maqdis and I began to narrate to them (the Quraish of Mecca) its signs while I was in fact looking at it.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab Quraish ne mujhe jhoothlaaya, to main Hatim mein khada tha aur Allah ne mere saamne Baitul-Maqdis ko utha diya aur main unhein Makkah ke Quraish ko iski nishaaniyaan bataane laga jabki main haqeeqat mein use dekh raha tha.

e: 'Abdullah reported on the authority of his father 'Umar b. Khattab that he heard from the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) say: I was sleeping when I saw myself making circuit around the Ka'bah, and I saw there a man of fair complexion with straight hair between two men. Water was flowing from his head or water was falling from his head. I said: Who is he? They answered: He is the son of Mary. Then I moved forward and cast a glance and there was a bulky man of red complexion with thick locks of hair on his head, blind of one eye as it his eye was a swollen grape. I asked: Who is he? They said: He is Dajjal. He had close resemblance with Ibn Qatan amongst men.
hi: Abdullah ne apne waalid Umar bin Khattab ki sanad se riwayat ki ki unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) se suna: Main so raha tha jab maine khud ko Ka'ba ka tawaaf karte dekha, aur maine wahan ek gore rang ke, seedhe baalon waale shaks ko do logon ke beech dekha. Paani uske sar se bah raha tha ya uske sar se gir raha tha. Maine kaha: Ye kaun hai? Unhone jawaab diya: Ye Maryam ke bete hain. Phir main aage badha aur nazar daali aur wahan ek mota, surkh rang ka shaks tha, uske sar par ghane baalon ki lattein, ek aankh se kaana goya uski aankh phooli hui angoor ki tarah thi. Maine poocha: Ye kaun hai? Unhone kaha: Ye Dajjal hai. Logon mein se Ibn Qatan se uski sabse zyada mushaabahat thi.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: I found myself in Hijr and the Quraish were asking me about my might journey. I was asked about things pertaining to Bait-ul-Maqdis which I could not preserve (in my mind). I was very much vexed, so vexed as I had never been before. Then Allah raised it (Bait-ul-Maqdis) before my eyes. I looked towards it, and I gave them the information about whatever they questioned me I also saw myself among the group of apostles. I saw Moses saying prayer and found him to be a well-built man as if he was a man of the tribe of Shanu'a. I saw Jesus son of Mary (peace be upon him) offering prayer, of all of men he had the closest resemblance with 'Urwa b. Masu'd al-Thaqafi. I saw Ibrahim (peace be upon him) offering prayer; he had the closest resemblance with your companion (the Prophet himself) amongst people. When the time of prayer came I led them. When I completed the prayer, someone said: Here is Malik, the keeper of the Hell; pay him salutations. I turned to him, but he preceded me in salutation.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Main Hijr mein tha aur Quraish mujhse meri Shab-e-Isra ke baare mein poochh rahe the. Mujhse Baitul-Maqdis se mutaalliq aisi cheezon ke baare mein poocha gaya jinhein main apne zehen mein sambhaal nahi paaya tha. Main bahut pareshaan ho gaya, itna pareshaan jitna kabhi nahi hua tha. Phir Allah ne Baitul-Maqdis mere saamne uthaaya. Maine uski taraf dekha, aur maine unhein har us cheez ke baare mein bataaya jo unhone mujhse poochi thi. Maine apne aap ko Rasoolon ke giroh mein bhi dekha. Maine Musa ko namaz padhte dekha aur unhein ek mazboot jism waale shaks paaya goya wo Shanu'a qabile ke shaks the. Maine Isa bin Maryam (AS) ko namaz padhte dekha, saare logon mein se Urwah bin Mas'ood ath-Thaqafi se unki sabse zyada mushaabahat thi. Maine Ibrahim (AS) ko namaz padhte dekha; unki sabse zyada mushaabahat tumhaare saathi (khud Nabi SAW) se thi. Jab namaz ka waqt aaya, to maine unki imaamat ki. Jab maine namaz mukammal ki, to kisi ne kaha: Ye Malik hain, Jahannam ke nigehbaan; unhein salaam kariye. Main unki taraf muda, lekin unhone mujhse pehle hi salaam kar diya.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abdullah (b. Umar) that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was taken for the Night journey, he was taken to Sidrat-ul-Muntaha, which is situated on the sixth heaven, where terminates everything that ascends from the earth and is held there, and where terminates every- thing that descends from above it and is held there. (It is with reference to this that) Allah said: " When that which covers covered the lote-tree" (al-Qur'an, Iiii. 16). He (the narrator) said: (It was) gold moths. He (the narrator further) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was given three (things): he was given five prayers, be was given the concluding verses of Sura al-Baqara, and remission of serious Sins for those among his Ummah who associate not anything with Allah
hi: Abdullah (bin Umar) se riwayat hai ki jab Rasoolullah (SAW) ko Shab-e-Isra ke liye le jaaya gaya, to unhein Sidrat-ul-Muntaha tak le jaaya gaya, jo chhathe aasman par sthit hai, jahan zameen se chadhne waali har cheez khatam hokar rukh jaati hai, aur jahan oopar se utarne waali har cheez khatam hokar rukh jaati hai. Isi silsile mein Allah ne farmaya: 'Jab jo cheez Sidrat ko dhaanp rahi thi usne dhaank liya' (53:16). Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Wo the sone ke patange. Unhone aage kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) ko teen cheezein di gayin: unhein paanch namazein di gayin, unhein Surah al-Baqarah ki aakhri aayaten di gayin, aur unki ummat ke un logon ke bade gunahon ki maafi di gayi jo Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek nahi karte.

e: Al-Shaibini reported to us: I asked Zirr b. Hubaish about the words of Allah (the Mighty and Great):" So he was (at a distance) of two bows or nearer" (al-Qur'an, Iiii 8). He said: Ibn Mas'ud informed me that, verily, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saw Gabriel and he had six hundred wings.
hi: Al-Shaibani ne humein bataaya: Maine Zirr bin Hubaish se Allah (Qaadir aur Buzurg) ke in alfaaz ke baare mein poocha: 'To wo do kamaanon ki doori par tha ya usse bhi kareeb' (53:8). Unhone kaha: Ibn Mas'ood ne mujhe bataaya ki, beshak, Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Jibrael ko dekha aur unke chhe sau (600) par the.

e: Al-Shaibani narrated on the authority of Zirr who narrated it on this authority of Abdullah that the (words of Allah): " The heart belied not what he saw" (al Qur'an, Iiii. 11) imply that he saw Gabriel (peace be upon him) and he had six hundred wings.
hi: Al-Shaibani ne Zirr ki sanad se riwayat ki jinhone Abdullah ki sanad se riwayat ki ki Allah ke alfaaz: 'Dil ne jhoot nahi kaha jo usne dekha' (53:11) ka matlab hai ki unhone Jibrael (AS) ko dekha aur unke chhe sau (600) par the.

e: Zirr b. Hubaish narrated it on the authority of 'Abdullah (that the words of Allah): " Certainly he saw of the greatest signs of Allah" (al-Qur'an, liii. 18) imply that he saw Gabriel in his (original) form and he had six hundred wings.
hi: Zirr bin Hubaish ne ise Abdullah ki sanad se riwayat ki ki Allah ke alfaaz: 'Yaqeenan usne Allah ki sabse badi nishaaniyon mein se ek dekhi' (53:18) ka matlab hai ki unhone Jibrael ko unki asal shakl mein dekha aur unke chhe sau (600) par the.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the (words of Allah): " And certainly he saw him in another descent" (al-Qur'an, Iiii. 13) imply that he saw Gabriel.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Allah ke alfaaz: 'Aur yaqeenan usne use ek aur utraai mein dekha' (53:13) ka matlab hai ki unhone Jibrael ko dekha.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he (the Holy Prophet) saw (Allah) with, his heart.
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ki unhone (Nabi SAW ne) Allah ko apne dil se dekha.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Ibn Abbas that the words: " The heart belied not what he saw" (al-Qur'an, Iiii. 11) and" Certainly he saw Him in another descent" (al-Qur'an, Iiii. 13) imply that he saw him twice with his heart.
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ki alfaaz: 'Dil ne jhoot nahi kaha jo usne dekha' (53:11) aur 'Yaqeenan usne use ek aur utraai mein dekha' (53:13) ka matlab hai ki unhone use apne dil se do baar dekha.

e: Abu Bakr b. Abi Shaiba narrated it on the same authorities.
hi: Abu Bakr bin Abi Shaiba ne ise usi sanad se riwayat ki hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Masruq that he said: I was resting at (the house of) 'A'isha that she said: O Abu 'A'isha (kunya of Masruq), there are three things, and he who affirmed even one of them fabricated the greatest lie against Allah. I asked that they were. She said: He who presumed that Muhammad (ﷺ) saw his Lord (with his ocular vision) fabricated the greatest lie against Allah. I was reclining but then sat up and said: Mother of the Faithful, wait a bit and do not be in a haste. Has not Allah (Mighty and Majestic) said:" And truly he saw him on the clear horizon" (Al-Qur'an, Surat at-Takwir, 81:23) and" he saw Him in another descent" (Al-Qur'an, Surat Najm 53:13)? She said: I am the first of this Ummah who asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about it, and he said: Verily he is Gabriel. I have never seen him in his original form in which he was created except on those two occasions (to which these verses refer); I saw him descending from the heaven and filling (the space) from the sky to the earth with the greatness of his bodily structure. She said: Have you not heard Allah saying: "Eyes comprehend Him not, but He comprehends (all) vision. and He is Subtle, and All-Aware" (Al-Qur'an, Surat al-An`am 6:103)? (She, i.e. 'A'isha, further said): Have you not heard that, verily, Allah says: "And it is not for any human being that Allah should speak to him except by revelation or from behind a partition or that He sends a messenger to reveal, by His permission, what He wills. Indeed, He is Most High and Wise." (Al-Qur'an, Surat ash-Shura, 42:51) She said: He who presumes that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) concealed anything from the Book of Allah fabricates the greatest lie against Allah. Allah says: "O Messenger, announce that which has been revealed to you from your Lord, and if you do not, then you have not conveyed His message. And Allah will protect you from the people. Indeed, Allah does not guide the disbelieving people." (Al-Qur'an, Surat al-Ma'idah, 5:67). She said: He who presumes that he would inform about what was going to happen tomorrow fabricates the greatest lie against Allah. And Allah says "Say, 'None in the heavens and earth knows the unseen except Allah , and they do not perceive when they will be resurrected.'" (Al-Qur'an, Surat an-Naml, 27:65).
hi: Masruq se riwayat hai ki unhone kaha: Main Aisha (RA) ke ghar aaram kar raha tha ki unhone kaha: Aye Abu Aisha, teen baatein hain, aur jisne inmein se ek ko bhi tasleem kiya usne Allah par sabse bada jhoot bandha. Maine poocha ki wo kya hain. Unhone kaha: Jisne ye samjha ki Muhammad (SAW) ne apni aankhon se apne Rab ko dekha, usne Allah par sabse bada jhoot bandha. Main tekiya lagaaye tha lekin phir uthkar baith gaya aur kaha: Ummul-Momineen, thoda ruko aur jaldbaazi mat karo. Kya Allah (Qaadir aur Sarbuland) ne nahi farmaaya: 'Aur yaqeenan usne use saaf ufuq par dekha' (81:23) aur 'usne use ek aur utraai mein dekha' (53:13)? Unhone kaha: Main is ummat mein sabse pehle thi jisne Rasoolullah (SAW) se iske baare mein poocha, aur unhone farmaaya: Beshak wo Jibrael hain. Maine unhein unki asal shakl mein, jismein wo paida kiye gaye the, kabhi nahi dekha sivaay in do mauqon ke jinka in aayaton mein zikr hai; maine unhein aasman se utarte dekha aur wo apne jism ke azmat se aasman se zameen tak poori jagah bhar rahe the. Unhone kaha: Kya tumne nahi suna Allah ye farmaate hue: 'Aankhein Use nahi dekh sakti, lekin Wo sab nazar ko dekhta hai. Aur Wo Baareek-been, Sab Khabar Rakhne Wala hai' (6:103)? Unhone (yaani Aisha ne) aage kaha: Kya tumne nahi suna ki, beshak, Allah kehta hai: 'Aur kisi insaan ke liye ye mumkin nahi ki Allah usse baat kare sivaay wahi ke zariye ya parde ke peeche se ya wo koi Rasool bheje jo Uski ijaazat se jo Wo chaahe wahi kare. Beshak, Wo Sabse Buland, Hikmat Waala hai' (42:51)? Unhone kaha: Jisne ye samjha ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Allah ki Kitab se kuch chhupaaya, usne Allah par sabse bada jhoot bandha. Allah farmaata hai: 'Aye Rasool, jo kuch aapke Rab ki taraf se aap par nazil kiya gaya hai use pahuncha do, aur agar aap aisa nahi karte, to aapne Uska paighaam nahi pahunchaaya. Aur Allah aapko logon se bachaayega. Beshak, Allah kaafir logon ko hidaayat nahi deta' (5:67). Unhone kaha: Jisne ye samjha ki wo Nabi (SAW) kal kya hoga uski khabar de sakte the, usne Allah par sabse bada jhoot bandha. Aur Allah kehta hai: 'Kaho, Aasmaanon aur zameen mein Allah ke siwa koi ghaib nahi jaanta, aur unhein pata nahi ki wo kab dobara uthaaye jaayenge' (27:65).

e: Dawud reported on the same authorities the hadith as narrated above by Ibn 'Uliyya and added: She ('A'isha) said: If Muhammad were to conceal anything which was sent to him, he would have certainly concealed this verse:" And when thou saidst to him on whom Allah had conferred favour and thou too had conferred favour: Keep thy wife to thyself and fear Allah, and thou wast concealing in thy heart that which Allah was going to disclose, and thou wast fearing men while Allah has a better right that thou shouldst fear Him."
hi: Dawud ne usi sanad se ye hadees riwayat ki jaisi Ibn Ulayyah ne upar bayan ki, aur izafa kiya: Unhone (Aisha ne) kaha: Agar Muhammad (SAW) ne kuch bhi chhupaaya hota jo unpar nazil kiya gaya tha, to unhone zaroor ye aayat chhupaayi hoti: 'Aur yaad karo jab tumne us shaks se kaha jispar Allah ne ehsaan kiya tha aur tumne bhi ehsaan kiya tha: Apni biwi ko apne paas rakho aur Allah se daro, aur tum apne dil mein wo baat chhupa rahe the jo Allah zaahir karne waala tha, aur tum logon se darte the jabki Allah iska zyada haqdaar hai ki tum Usse daro.'

e: Masruq reported: I asked 'A'isha if Muhammad (ﷺ) had seen his Lord. She replied: Hallowed be Allah, my hair stood on end when you said this, and he (Masruq) narrated the hadith as narrated above. The hadith reported by Diwud is more complete and longer.
hi: Masruq ne bataaya: Maine Aisha se poocha ki kya Muhammad (SAW) ne apne Rab ko dekha tha. Unhone jawaab diya: Allah paak hai, mere baal khade ho gaye jab tumne ye kaha, aur unhone hadees waisi hi riwayat ki jaisi upar bayan hui. Dawud ki riwayat ki gayi hadees zyada mukammal aur lambi hai.

e: Masruq reported: I said to 'A'isha: What about the words of Allah:" Then he drew nigh and came down, so he was at a distance of two bows or closer still: so He revealed to His servant what He revealed" (al-Qur'an, liii. 8-10)? She said: It implies Gabriel. He used to come to him (the Holy Prophet) in the shape of men; but he came at this time in his true form and blocked up the horizon of the sky.
hi: Masruq ne bataaya: Maine Aisha se kaha: Allah ke in alfaaz ke baare mein kya khayaal hai: 'Phir wo nazdeek aaya aur neeche utra, is liye wo do kamaanon ki doori par tha ya usse bhi kareeb tha: to usne apne bande par wahi ki jo usne wahi ki' (53:8-10)? Unhone kaha: Iska matlab Jibrael hai. Wo Nabi (SAW) ke paas aadmiyon ki shakl mein aaya karte the; lekin is baar wo apni asal shakl mein aaye aur aasman ke ufuq ko bhar diya.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Dharr: I asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): Did you see thy Lord? He said: (He is) Light; how could I see Him?
hi: Abu Dharr se riwayat hai: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) se poocha: Kya aapne apne Rab ko dekha? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Wo Noor hai; main use kaise dekh sakta hoon?

e: Abdullah b. Shaqiq reported: I said to Abu Dharr: Had I seen the Messenger of Allah, I would have asked him. He (Abu Dharr) said: What is that thing that you wanted to inquire of him? He said: I wanted to ask him whether he had seen his Lord. Abu Dharr said: I, in fact, inquired of him, and he replied: I saw Light.
hi: Abdullah bin Shaqiq ne bataaya: Maine Abu Dharr se kaha: Agar maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko dekha hota, to main unse poochta. Unhone kaha: Wo kya cheez thi jo tum unse poochna chaahte the? Unhone kaha: Main unse poochna chaahta tha ki kya unhone apne Rab ko dekha tha. Abu Dharr ne kaha: Maine haqeeqat mein unse poocha, aur unhone jawaab diya: Maine Noor dekha.

e: Abu Musa reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was standing amongst us and he told us five things. He said: Verily the Exalted and Mighty God does not sleep, and it does not befit Him to sleep. He lowers the scale and lifts it. The deeds in the night are taken up to Him before the deeds of the day, and the deeds of the day before the deeds of the night. His veil is the light. In the hadith narrated by Abu Bakr (instead of the word "light" ) it is fire. If he withdraws it (the veil), the splendour of His countenance would consume His creation so far as His sight reaches.
hi: Abu Musa ne bataaya: Rasoolullah (SAW) humare beech khade the aur unhone humein paanch baatein bataayin. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Beshak Buland aur Qaadir Allah sota nahi hai, aur usko sona munaasib nahi. Wo tarazu ko neeche karta hai aur oopar uthaata hai. Raat ke amal Uske saamne din ke amal se pehle uthaaye jaate hain, aur din ke amal raat ke amal se pehle. Uska parda noor hai. Abu Bakr ki riwayat ki gayi hadees mein lafz noor ke bajaaye aag hai. Agar Wo ise hataa de, to Uske chehre ki chamak, jahan tak Uski nazar pahunche, Uski makhlooq ko bhasm kar de.

e: A'mash has narrated this hadith on the same authority and said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was standing amongst us and he told us four things. He then narrated the hadith like the one reported by Abu Mua'wiya, but did not mention the words" His creation" and said: His veil is the light.
hi: A'mash ne ye hadees usi sanad se riwayat ki hai aur kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) humare beech khade the aur unhone humein chaar baatein bataayin. Phir unhone hadees Abu Mua'wiya ki riwayat jaisi bayan ki, lekin 'Uski makhlooq' ke alfaaz zikr nahi kiye aur kaha: Uska parda noor hai.

e: Abu Musa reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was standing amongst us and (he said) four (things): Verily Allah does not sleep and it does not befit Him to sleep. He raises the scale and lowers it. The deeds of the day are presented to Him in the night and the deeds of the night in the day.
hi: Abu Musa ne bataaya: Rasoolullah (SAW) humare beech khade the aur chaar baatein bataayin: Beshak Allah sota nahi hai aur usko sona munaasib nahi. Wo tarazu ko oopar uthaata hai aur neeche karta hai. Din ke amal Uske saamne raat mein pesh kiye jaate hain aur raat ke amal din mein.

e: 'Abdullah b. Qais transmitted on the authority of his father (Abu Musa Ash'ari) that the Apostle (ﷺ) said: There would be two gardens (in Paradise) the vessels and contents of which would be of silver, and two gardens whose vessels and contents would be of gold. The only thing intervening to hinder the people from looking at their Lord will be the mantle of Grandeur over His face in the Garden of Eden.
hi: Abdullah bin Qais ne apne waalid (Abu Musa Ash'ari) ki sanad se riwayat ki ki Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Jannat mein do baagh honge jinke bartan aur cheezein chaandi ki hongi, aur do baagh jinke bartan aur cheezein sone ki hongi. Logon ko unke Rab ko dekhne se sirf ek cheez rokegi, wo hai unke chehre par Azmat ki chaadar, Jannat-ul-Adn mein.

e: Suhaib reported the Apostle (ﷺ) saying: When those deserving of Paradise would enter Paradise, the Blessed and the Exalted would ask: Do you wish Me to give you anything more? They would say: Hast Thou not brightened our faces? Hast Thou not made us enter Paradise and saved us from Fire? He (the narrator) said: He (God) would lift the veil, and of things given to them nothing would he dearer to them than the sight of their Lord, the Mighty and the Glorious.
hi: Suhaib ne Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat kiya: Jab Jannat ke haqdaar Jannat mein daakhil honge, to Mubarak aur Buland Allah poochenge: Kya tum chaahte ho ki Main tumhein aur kuch dun? Wo kahenge: Kya Tune humare chehron ko roshan nahi kiya? Kya Tune humein Jannat mein daakhil nahi kiya aur humein Aag se nahi bachaaya? Unhone kaha: Wo Allah parda hataayega, aur unhein di gayi cheezon mein se koi bhi cheez unhein apne Rab, Qaadir aur Buzurg, ke deedaar se zyada aziz nahi hogi.

e: Hammad b. Salama narrated it on the same authority and added: He then recited the verse:" Those who do good will have the best reward and even more" (x. 26)
hi: Hammad bin Salama ne ise usi sanad se riwayat ki aur izafa kiya: Phir unhone ye aayat tilaawat ki: 'Jo log nekiyaan karte hain unke liye behtareen sawaab hai aur usse bhi zyada' (10:26).

e:
Abu Haraira reported: The people said to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): Messenger of Allah, shall we see our Lord on the Day of Resurrection? The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Do you feel any trouble in seeing the moon on the night when it is full? They said: Messenger of Allah, no. He (the Messenger) further said: Do you feel any trouble in seeing the sun, when there is no cloud over it? They said: Messenger of Allah. no. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Verily you would see Him like this (as you see the sun and the moon). God will gather people on the Day of Resurrection and say: Let every people follow what they worshipped. Those who worshipped the sun would follow the sun, and those who worshipped the moon would follow the moon, and those who worshipped the devils would follow the devils. This Ummah (of Islam) alone would be left behind and there would be hypocrites too amongst it. Allah would then come to them in a form other than His own Form, recognisable to them, and would say: I am your Lord. They would say: We take refuge with Allah from thee. We will stay here till our Lord comes to us. and when our Lord would come we would recognise Him. Subsequently Allah would come to them in His own Form, recognisable to them, and say: I am your Lord. They would say: Thou art our Lord. And they would follow Him, and a bridge would be set over the Hell; and I (the Holy Prophet) and my Ummah would be the first to pass over it; and none but the messengers would speak on that day, and the prayer of the messengers on that day would be: O Allah! grant safety, grant safety. In Hell, there would be long spits like the thorns of Sa'dan He (the Holy Prophet) said: Have you seen Sa'dan? They replied: Yes, Messenger of Allah. He said: Verily those (hooks) would be like the thorns of Sa'dan, but no one knows their size except Allah. These would seize people for their misdeeds. Some of them would escape for their (good) deeds, and some would be rewarded for their deeds till they get salvation. When Allah would finish judging His bondsmen and because of His mercy decide to take out of Hell such people as He pleases. He would command the angels to bring out those who had not associated anything with Allah; to whom Allah decided to show mercy. those who would say: There is no god but Allah. They (the angels) would recognise them in the Fire by the marks of prostration, for Hell-fire will devour everything (limb) of the sons of Adam except the marks of prostration. Allah has forbidden the fire to consume the marks of prostration. They will be taken out of the Fire having been burnt, and the water of life would be poured over them, and they will sprout as seed does In the silt carried by flood. 
Then Allah would finish judging amongst His bondsmen; but a man who will be the last to enter Paradise will remain facing Hell and will say: O my Lord I turn my face away from Hell, for its air has poisoned me ard its blaze has burnt me. He will then call to Allah as long as Allah would wish that he should call to Him. Then Allah, Blessed and Exalted, would say: If I did that, perhaps you would ask for more than that. He would say: I would not ask You more than this, and he would give his Lord covenants and agreements as Allah wished, and so He would turn his face away from the Fire When he turns towards the Paradise and sees it, he will remain silent as long as Allah wishes him to remain so. He will then say: O my Lord I bring me forward to the gate of the Paradise. Allah would say to him: Did you not give covenants and agreements that you would not ask for anything besides what I had given you. Woe to thee! O son of Adam, how treacherous you are! He would say: O my Lord! and would continue calling to Allah till He would say to him: If I grant you that, perhaps you will ask for more. He will reply: No, by Thy greatness, and he will give His Lord promises and covenants as Allah had wished. He would then bring him to the gate of the Paradise, and when he would stand at the gate of the Paradise, it would lay open before him. and he would see the bounty and the joy that there is in it. He would remain quiet as long as Allah would desire him to remain silent. He would then say: O my Lord, admit me to Paradise. Allah. Blessed and Exalted, would say: Did you not give covenants and agreements that you would not ask for anything more than what I had granted you? Woe to you! son of Adam, how treacherous you are! And he would say: O my Lord, I do not wish to be the most miserable of Thy creatures. He would continue calling upon Allah till Allah, Blessed and Exalted, would laugh. When Allah would laugh at him, He would say: Enter the Paradise. When he would enter, Allah would say: State your wish. He would express his wishes till Allah would remind him (the desire of) such and such (things). When his desires would be exhausted Allah would say: That is for thee and, besides it, the like of it also. 'Ata' b. Yazid said: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri was with Abu Huraira and be did not reject anything from the hadith narrated by him, but when Abu Huraira narrated:" Allah said to that man; ind its like along with it," Abu Sa'id said:" Ten like it along with it," O Abu Huraira. Abu Huraira said: I do not remember except the words:" That is for you and a similar one along with it." Abu Sa'id said: I bear witness to the fact that I remembered from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) his words:" That is for thee and ten like it." Abu Huraira said: That man was the last of those deserving of Paradise to enter Paradise.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Logon ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, kya hum Qayamat ke Din apne Rab ko dekhenge? Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Kya tumhein poore chaand ki raat mein chaand ko dekhne mein koi mushkil hoti hai? Unhone kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, nahi. Aap (SAW) ne aage kaha: Kya tumhein suraj ko dekhne mein koi mushkil hoti hai jab uspar koi baadal na ho? Unhone kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, nahi. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Beshak tum Use isi tarah dekhoge jaise tum suraj aur chaand dekhte ho. Allah Qayamat ke Din logon ko jama karega aur kahega: Har qaum apne ma'bood ke peeche jaaye. Jo log suraj ki parastish karte the wo suraj ke peeche jaayenge, aur jo chaand ki parastish karte the wo chaand ke peeche jaayenge, aur jo Shaitaano ki parastish karte the wo Shaitaano ke peeche jaayenge. Sirf ye ummat Islam ki peeche reh jaayegi aur ismein munafiqeen bhi honge. Phir Allah unke paas apni asal Zaat ke alaawa ek aisi shakl mein aayega jise wo pehchaan nahi paayenge, aur kahega: Main tumhaara Rab hoon. Wo kahenge: Hum Tujhse Allah ki panaah maangte hain. Hum yahin thehrenge jab tak humaara Rab humaare paas na aa jaaye, aur jab humaara Rab aayega to hum Use pehchaan lenge. Phir Allah unke paas apni asal Zaat mein aayega, jise wo pehchaan sakenge, aur kahega: Main tumhaara Rab hoon. Wo kahenge: Tu humaara Rab hai. Aur wo Uske peeche chalenge, aur Jahannam par ek pul rakha jaayega; aur main aur meri ummat sabse pehle usse guzarne wale honge; aur us din Rasoolon ke siwa koi baat nahi karega; aur us din Rasoolon ki dua hogi: Aye Allah! Salaamati de, salaamati de. Jahannam mein lambe kaante honge jaise Sa'sadqa ke kaante. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Kya tumne Sa'sadqa dekhe hain? Unhone jawaab diya: Haan, Ya Rasoolullah. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Beshak wo kaante Sa'sadqa ke kaanton jaise honge, lekin unka size sirf Allah hi jaanta hai. Wo log unhein unke gunahon ki wajah se pakdenge. Unmein se kuch apne nek amal ki wajah se bach jaayenge, aur kuch apne amal ka badla paayenge yahan tak ki unhein nijaat mil jaaye. Jab Allah apne bandon ka faisla khatam kar lega aur apni rehmat ki wajah se Jahannam se aise logon ko nikaalne ka faisla karega jinhein Wo chaahega, to Wo Farishton ko un logon ko nikaalne ka hukum dega jinhone Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek nahi kiya tha; jinpar Allah ne rehmat karne ka faisla kiya, un logon ko jo kahenge: Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi. Wo Farishte unhein aag mein Sajde ke nishaanon se pehchaanenge, kyunki Jahannam ki aag Aadam ki aulaad ki har cheez ko khaa jaayegi sivaay Sajde ke nishaanon ke. Allah ne aag par Sajde ke nishaanon ko khaane se mumana'at ki hai. Unhein jal jaane ki halat mein aag se nikaala jaayega, aur unpar zindagi ka paani daala jaayega, aur wo aise ugenge jaise seylaab ki laayi hui mitti mein daana ugta hai. Phir Allah apne bandon ke darmiyaan faisla khatam karega; lekin ek shaks jo Jannat mein sabse aakhri mein daakhil hoga wo Jahannam ki taraf mooh kiye reh jaayega aur kahega: Aye mere Rab, main apna mooh Jahannam se hataata hoon, kyunki iski hawa ne mujhe zeher de diya hai aur iski aag ne mujhe jala diya hai. Phir wo Allah ko tab tak pukaarta rahega jab tak Allah chaahega ki wo Use pukaare. Phir Allah, Mubarak aur Buland, kahega: Agar Maine aisa kiya, to shaayad tum usse zyada maangoge. Wo kahega: Main Tujhse isse zyada nahi maangunga, aur wo apne Rab se aisa waada aur ehad karega jaisa Allah chaahega, is liye Wo uska mooh Aag se hata dega. Jab wo Jannat ki taraf mudega aur use dekhega, to wo khaamosh rahega jab tak Allah chaahega ki wo khaamosh rahe. Phir wo kahega: Aye mere Rab, mujhe Jannat ke darwaze tak le chalo. Allah usse kahega: Kya tumne waada aur ehad nahi kiya tha ki tum kuch nahi maangoge sivaay uske jo Maine tumhein diya? Tumpar afsos! Aye Aadam ki aulaad, tum kitne dhokebaaz ho! Wo kahega: Aye mere Rab! aur Allah ko pukaarte rahega yahan tak ki Wo usse kahega: Agar Maine tumhein wo de diya, to shaayad tum aur maangoge. Wo jawaab dega: Nahi, Teri azmat ki qasam, aur wo apne Rab se waade aur ehad karega jaise Allah chaahega. Phir Wo use Jannat ke darwaze tak le jaayega, aur jab wo Jannat ke darwaze par khada hoga, to wo uske saamne khul jaayegi, aur wo Jannat ki khushiyaan aur nemat dekhega jo usmein hain. Wo khaamosh rahega jab tak Allah chaahega ki wo khaamosh rahe. Phir wo kahega: Aye mere Rab, mujhe Jannat mein daakhil kar de. Allah, Mubarak aur Buland, kahega: Kya tumne waada aur ehad nahi kiya tha ki tum kuch aur nahi maangoge sivaay uske jo Maine tumhein pehle diya tha? Tumpar afsos! Aye Aadam ki aulaad, tum kitne dhokebaaz ho! Aur wo kahega: Aye mere Rab, main Teri makhlooq mein sabse badnaseeb nahi rehna chaahta. Wo Allah ko pukaarta rahega yahan tak ki Allah, Mubarak aur Buland, hansega. Jab Allah uspar hansega, to Wo kahega: Jannat mein daakhil ho jao. Jab wo daakhil hoga, to Allah kahega: Apni khwaahish bayan karo. Wo apni khwaahishaat bayan karega yahan tak ki Allah use in-in cheezon ki yaad dilaayega. Jab uski khwaahishaat khatam ho jaayengi, to Allah kahega: Ye teri hai, aur iske saath iske barabar aur bhi. Ata bin Yazid ne kaha: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri Abu Huraira ke saath the aur unhone unki riwayat ki gayi hadees se kisi cheez ko radd nahi kiya, lekin jab Abu Huraira ne riwayat ki: Allah ne us shaks se kaha: Aur iske saath iske barabar, to Abu Sa'id ne kaha: Iske saath iske das guna, aye Abu Huraira. Abu Huraira ne kaha: Mujhe sirf ye alfaaz yaad hain: Ye teri hai aur ek aisi hi cheez iske saath. Abu Sa'id ne kaha: Main gawahi deta hoon ki mujhe Rasoolullah (SAW) ke ye alfaaz yaad hain: Ye teri hai aur iske das guna. Abu Huraira ne kaha: Wo shaks Jannat mein daakhil hone waale sabse aakhri Jannati tha.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The people said to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): Messenger of Allah I shall we see our Lord on the Day of Resurrection? The rest of the hadith was narrated according to the narration of Ibrahim b. Sa'd.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Logon ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, kya hum Qayamat ke Din apne Rab ko dekhenge? Baaki hadees waisi hi riwayat ki gayi jaisi Ibrahim bin Sa'd ki riwayat hai.

e: Hammam b. Munabbih said: This is what Abu Huraira transmitted to us from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and he narrated many of them;- one of them was: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The lowest in rank among you in Paradise would be asked: Desire (whatever you like). And he would express his desire and again and again express a desire. tHe would be asked: Have you expressed your desire? He would say: Yes. Then He (Allah) would say: For thee is (granted) what thou desirest, and the like of it along with it.
hi: Hammam bin Munabbih ne kaha: Ye wo hai jo Abu Huraira ne humein Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat kiya, aur unhone inmein se bahut si riwayat ki; unmein se ek ye thi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jannat mein tum mein se sabse neeche darje wale shaks se kaha jaayega: Khwaahish karo. Wo apni khwaahish bataayega aur baar-baar khwaahish bataayega. Usse poocha jaayega: Kya tumne apni khwaahish bata di? Wo kahega: Haan. Phir Wo Allah kahega: Tere liye wahi hai jo tune khwaahish ki, aur iske saath iske barabar aur bhi.

e:
Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported: Some people during the lifetime of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Messenger of Allah! shall we see our Lord on the Day of Resurrection? The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Yes, and added: Do you feel any trouble in seeing the sun at noon with no cloud over it, and do you feel trouble in seeing the moon (open) in the full moonlit night with no cloud over it? They said: No, Messenger of Allah! He (the Holy Prophet) said: You will not feel any trouble in seeing Allah on the Day of Resurrection any more than you do in seeing any one of them. When the Day of Resurrection comes a Mu'adhdhin (a proclaimer) would proclaim: Let every people follow what they used to worship. Then all who worshipped idols and stones besides Allah would fall into the Fire, till only the righteous and the vicious and some of the people of the Book who worshipped Allah are left.
