Then the Jews would be summoned, and it would be said to them: What did you worship? They will say: We worshipped 'Uzair, son of Allah. It would be said to them: You tell a lie; Allah had never had a spouse or a son. What do you want now? They would say: We feel thirsty, O our Lord! Quench our thirst. They would be directed (to a certain direction) and asked: Why don't you go there to drink water? Then they would be pushed towards the Fire (and they would find to their great dismay that) it was but a mirage (and the raging flames of fire) would be consuming one another, and they would fall into the Fire. Then the Christians would be summoned and it would be said to them: What did you worship? They would say: We worshipped Jesus, son of Allah. It would be said to them: You tell a lie; Allah did not take for Himself either a spouse or a son. Then it would be said to them: What do you want? They would say: Thirsty we are, O our Lord! Quench our thirst. They would be directed (to a certain direction) and asked: Why don't you go there to get water? But they would be pushed and gathered together towards the Hell, which was like a mirage to them, and the flames would consume one another. They would fall Into the Fire, till no one is left except he who worshipped Allah, be he pious or sinful. The Lord of the Universe, Glorified and Exalted, would come to them in a form recognisable to them and say; What are you looking for? Every people follow that which they worshipped. They would say: Our Lord, we kept ourselves separate from the people in the world, though we felt great need of them; we, however, did not associate ourselves with them. He would say: I am your Lord. They would say: We take refuge with Allah from thee and do not associate anything with Allah. They would repeat it twice or thrice, till some of them would be about to return. It would be said: Is there any sign between you and Him by which you will recognise Him? They would say: Yes. and the things would be laid bare. Those who used to prostrate themselves before God of their own accord would be permitted by God to prostrate themselves. But there would remain none who used to prostrate out of fear (of people) and ostentation but Allah would make his back as one piece, and whenever he would attempt to prostrate he would fall on his back. Then they would raise their heads and He would assume the Form in which they had seen Him the first time and would say: I am your Lord. They would say: Thou art our Lord. Then the bridge would be set up over the Hell and intercession would be allowed and they will say: O God, keep safe, keep safe. 
It was asked: Messenger of Allah, what is this bridge? He said: The void in which one Is likely to slip. There would be hooks, tongs, spits like the thorn that is found in Najd and is known as Sa'dan. The believers would then pass over within the twinkling of an eye, like lightning, like wind, like a bird, like the finest horses and camels. Some will escape and be safe, some will be lacerated and let go, and some will be pushed into the fire of Hell till the believers will find rescue from the Fire. By One in Whose hand is my life, there will be none among you more eager to claim a right than the believers on the Day of Resurrection for (saying their) brethren in the Fire who would say: O our Lord, they were fasting along with us, and praying and performing pilgrimage. It will be said to them: Take out those whom you recognise. Then their persons would be forbidden to the Fire; and they would take out a large number of people who had been overtaken by Fire up to the middle of the shank or up to the knees. They would then say: O our Lord I not one of those about whom Thou didst give us command remains in it. He will then say: Go back and bring out those in whose hearts you find good of the weight of a dinar Then they will take out a large number of people. Then they would say: O our Lord! we have not left anyone about whom You commanded us. He will then say: Go back and bring out those in whose hearts you find as much as half a dinar of good. Then they will take out a large number of people, and would say: O our Lord! not one of those about whom Thou commanded us we have left in it. Then He would say: Go back and in whose heart you find good to the weight of a particle bring him out. They would bring out a large number of people, and would then say: O our Lord, now we have not left anyone in it (Hell) having any good in him. 
Abu Sa'id Khudri said: If you don't testify me in this hadith, then recite if you like:" Surely Allah wrongs not the weight of an atom; and if it is a good deed. He multiplies it and gives from Himself a great reward" (al-Qur'an, iv. 40). Then Allah, Exalted and Great, would say: The angels have interceded, the apostles have interceded and the believers have interceded, and no one remains (to grant pardon) but the Most Merciful of the mercifuls. He will then take a handful from Fire and bring out from it people who never did any good and who had been turned into charcoal, and will cast them into a river called the river of life, on the outskirts of Paradise. They will come out as a seed comes cut from the silt carried by flood. You see it near the stone or near the tree. That which is exposed to the sun is yellowish or greenish and which is under the shade is white. They said: Messenger of Allah! it seems as if you had been tending a flock in the jungle. He (the Holy Prophet) said: They will come forth like pearls with seals on their necks. The inhabitants of Paradise would recognise them (and say): Those are who have been set free by the Compassionate One. Who has admitted them into Paradise without any (good) deed that they did or any good that they sent in advance Then He would say: Enter the Paradise; whatever you see in it is yours. They would say: O Lord, Thou hast bestowed upon us (favours) which Thou didst not bestow upon anyone else in the world. He would say: There is with Me (a favour) for you better than this. They would say: O our Lord! which thing is better than this? He would say: It is My pleasure. I will never be angry with you after this
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne bataaya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ki zindagi mein kuch logon ne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah! Kya hum Qayamat ke Din apne Rab ko dekhenge? Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Haan, aur izafa kiya: Kya tumhein dopahar ke waqt bagair kisi baadal ke suraj ko dekhne mein koi mushkil hoti hai, aur kya tumhein poore chaand ki raat mein bagair kisi baadal ke chaand ko dekhne mein koi mushkil hoti hai? Unhone kaha: Nahi, Ya Rasoolullah! Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Tumhein Qayamat ke Din Allah ko dekhne mein unhein dekhne se zyada koi mushkil nahi hogi. Jab Qayamat ka Din aayega, to ek Mu'azzin elaan karega: Har qaum apne pujaari maabudon ke peeche jaaye. Phir jitne bhi log Allah ke siwa buton aur patthron ki parastish karte the wo Aag mein gir jaayenge, yahan tak ki sirf nek log, gunahgaar log, aur Ahl-e-Kitaab mein se kuch log jo Allah ki parastish karte the reh jaayenge. Phir Yahudiyon ko bulaaya jaayega, aur unse kaha jaayega: Tum kya parastish karte the? Wo kahenge: Hum Uzair, Allah ke bete ki parastish karte the. Unse kaha jaayega: Tum jhoot bolte ho; Allah ka kabhi koi biwi ya beta nahi raha. Ab tum kya chaahte ho? Wo kahenge: Humein pyaas lagi hai, Aye humaare Rab! Humari pyaas bujhaa dijiye. Unhein kisi khaas taraf ishaara diya jaayega aur poocha jaayega: Tum wahan paani peene kyun nahi jaate? Phir unhein Aag ki taraf dhakela jaayega aur wo bahut hairaan hokar paayenge ki wo sirf ek sarab thi aur aag ke bhadakte hue sholay ek doosre ko khaa rahe honge, aur wo Aag mein gir jaayenge. Phir Isaaiyon ko bulaaya jaayega aur unse kaha jaayega: Tum kya parastish karte the? Wo kahenge: Hum Isa, Allah ke bete ki parastish karte the. Unse kaha jaayega: Tum jhoot bolte ho; Allah ne apne liye na koi biwi banaayi na koi beta. Phir unse kaha jaayega: Tum kya chaahte ho? Wo kahenge: Humein pyaas lagi hai, Aye humaare Rab! Humari pyaas bujhaa dijiye. Unhein ishaara diya jaayega aur poocha jaayega: Tum wahan paani lene kyun nahi jaate? Lekin unhein dhakela jaayega aur Jahannam ki taraf jama kiya jaayega, jo unke liye sarab jaisi thi, aur sholay ek doosre ko khaa rahe honge. Wo Aag mein gir jaayenge, yahan tak ki koi bhi baaki nahi bachega sivaay us shaks ke jo Allah ki parastish karta tha, chaahe wo nek ho ya gunahgaar. Kaayenaat ka Rab, Sabse Baa-Izzat aur Buland, unke paas ek aisi shakl mein aayega jise wo pehchaan sakte hain aur kahega: Tum kya dhoondh rahe ho? Har qaum apne pujaari maabud ke peeche jaati hai. Wo kahenge: Humaare Rab, hum duniya mein logon se alag rahe, halaanki humein unki bahut zaroorat thi; lekin hum unse unki parastish mein shareek nahi hue. Wo kahega: Main tumhaara Rab hoon. Wo kahenge: Hum Tujhse Allah ki panaah maangte hain aur Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek nahi karte. Wo isko do ya teen baar dohraayenge, yahan tak ki unmein se kuch log wapas jaane hi wale honge. Kaha jaayega: Kya tumhaare aur Uske darmiyaan koi nishaani hai jisse tum Use pehchaanoge? Wo kahenge: Haan, aur cheezein zaahir kar di jaayengi. Jo log apni marzi se Allah ke saamne sajda kiya karte the unhein Allah sajda karne ki ijaazat dega. Lekin jo log logon ke darr se aur dikhaawe ke liye sajda karte the, unmein se koi bhi baaki nahi rahega, kyunki Allah uski peeth ko ek hi tukda bana dega, aur jab bhi wo sajda karne ki koshish karega, wo apni peeth ke bal gir jaayega. Phir wo apne sar uthaayenge aur Wo wahi shakl ikhtiyaar karega jismein unhone use pehli baar dekha tha aur kahega: Main tumhaara Rab hoon. Wo kahenge: Tu humaara Rab hai. Phir Jahannam par pul lagaaya jaayega aur shafaa'at ki ijaazat di jaayegi aur wo kahenge: Aye Allah, salaamati de, salaamati de. Poocha gaya: Ya Rasoolullah, ye pul kya hai? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Ye khaali jagah hai jahan phisalne ka khatra hai. Ismein ankude, chimtiyaan, aur Najd mein paaye jaane wale kaante jaise nokeele kaante honge jinhein Sa'sadqa kaha jaata hai. Momin isse ek aankh jhapakne mein, bijli ki tarah, hawa ki tarah, parinde ki tarah, sabse behtareen ghodon aur oonton ki tarah guzar jaayenge. Kuch bach jaayenge aur mahfooz rahenge, kuch zakhmi hokar chhod diye jaayenge, aur kuch ko Jahannam ki aag mein dhakel diya jaayega yahan tak ki momin Aag se bach nikalenge. Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, tum mein se koi bhi Qayamat ke Din haq ka daawa karne mein utna beqaraar nahi hoga jitna momin apne Aag mein pade bhaiyon ke liye honge, jo kahenge: Aye humaare Rab, wo humaare saath roze rakhte the, namaz padhte the aur Hajj karte the. Unse kaha jaayega: Un logon ko nikaalo jinhein tum pehchaante ho. Phir unke jism Aag ke liye mana kar diye jaayenge; aur wo bahut saare logon ko nikaalenge jo Aag mein pindli tak ya ghutnon tak jal chuke honge. Phir wo kahenge: Aye humaare Rab! Un logon mein se koi bhi baaki nahi bacha jinke baare mein Tu ne humein hukum diya tha. Wo phir kahega: Wapas jao aur un logon ko nikaalo jinke dilon mein tumhein ek Dinar ke barabar bhalaai mile. Phir wo bahut saare logon ko nikaalenge. Phir wo kahenge: Aye humaare Rab! Humne kisi ko nahi chhoda jiske baare mein Tune humein hukum diya. Wo phir kahega: Wapas jao aur un logon ko nikaalo jinke dilon mein tumhein aadha Dinar ke barabar bhalaai mile. Phir wo bahut saare logon ko nikaalenge, aur kahenge: Aye humaare Rab! Un logon mein se koi bhi baaki nahi bacha jinke baare mein Tu ne humein hukum diya tha. Phir Wo kahega: Wapas jao aur jiske dil mein ek zarre ke barabar bhalaai mile use nikaalo. Wo bahut saare logon ko nikaalenge, aur phir kahenge: Aye humaare Rab, ab humne usmein kisi ko bhalaai ke saath nahi chhoda. Abu Sa'id Khudri ne kaha: Agar tum is hadees mein meri gawahi na maano, to agar chaho to ye tilaawat karo: 'Beshak Allah ek zarre ke barabar bhi zulm nahi karta; aur agar wo ek nek amal ho, to Wo use badha deta hai aur Apni taraf se ek bada sawaab bhi deta hai' (4:40). Phir Allah, Buland aur Baa-Azmat, kahega: Farishton ne shafaa'at ki hai, Rasoolon ne shafaa'at ki hai, aur momineen ne shafaa'at ki hai, aur ab koi baaki nahi bacha sivaay Sabse Rahem karne wale ke. Phir Wo ek mutthi Aag se uthaayega aur usmein se un logon ko nikaalega jinhone kabhi koi nek amal nahi kiya tha aur jo koyle ban chuke the, aur unhein ek nadi mein daal dega jise 'hayaat ka darya' kaha jaata hai, Jannat ke kinaare par. Wo waise hi nikalenge jaise seylaab ki laayi hui mitti mein daana ugta hai. Tumne ise patthar ke qareeb ya ped ke qareeb dekha hoga. Jo suraj mein hai wo peela ya hara hoga aur jo chhaanv mein hai wo safed hoga. Unhone kaha: Ya Rasoolullah! Aisa lagta hai goya aap jungle mein bakriyaan chara rahe the. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Wo motiyon ki tarah nikalenge, unki gardanon par muhrein hongi. Jannat ke rehne wale unhein pehchaanenge aur kahenge: Ye wo log hain jinhein Rahem Karne Wale ne aazaad kiya hai, Jisne unhein bina kisi nek amal ke jo unhone kiya ho ya koi bhalaai jo unhone aage bheji ho, Jannat mein daakhil kiya. Phir Wo kahega: Jannat mein daakhil ho jao; jo bhi tum usmein dekho wo tumhaara hai. Wo kahenge: Aye Rab, Tune humpar wo nawaazishein ki hain jo Tune duniya mein kisi aur par nahi kin. Wo kahega: Mere paas tumhaare liye isse behtar nawaazish hai. Wo kahenge: Aye humaare Rab! Kaunsi cheez isse behtar hai? Wo kahega: Ye Meri raza hai. Main iske baad tumse kabhi naaraaz nahi hounga.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Sa'id al-Khudri: We said: Messenger of Allah, shall we see our Lord? The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Do you feel any trouble in seeing the sun on a cloudless day? We said: No. And the remaining part of the hadith has been narrated to the end like the hadith transmitted by Hafs b. Maisara with the addition of these words: Without the deed that they did or any good that they had sent before. It would be said to them: For you is whatever you see (in it) and with it the like of it. Abu Sa'id said: I have come to know that the bridge would be thinner even than the hair and sharper than the sword; and in the hadith narrated by Laith these words are not found: They would say, O our Lord! Thou hast bestowed upon us (favours) which thou didst not bestow on anyone else in the world.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri se riwayat hai: Humne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, kya hum apne Rab ko dekhenge? Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Kya tumhein bagair baadal ke din mein suraj ko dekhne mein koi mushkil hoti hai? Humne kaha: Nahi. Aur baaki hadees waisi hi bayan ki gayi hai jaisi Hafs bin Maisara ki riwayat ki gayi hadees hai, is izafe ke saath: Bagair kisi nek amal ke jo unhone kiya ho ya koi bhalaai jo unhone aage bheji ho. Unse kaha jaayega: Tumhaare liye wahi hai jo tum dekh rahe ho aur uske saath iske barabar aur bhi. Abu Sa'id ne kaha: Mujhe pata chala hai ki pul baal se bhi patla aur talwaar se bhi tez hoga; aur Laith ki riwayat ki gayi hadees mein ye alfaaz nahi hain: Wo kahenge, Aye humaare Rab! Tune humpar nawaazishein ki hain jo Tune duniya mein kisi aur par nahi kin.

e: Abu Bakr b. Abi Shaiba, Ja'far b. 'Aun, Hisham b. Sa'd, Zaid b. Aslam narrated the hadith as transmitted by Hafs b. Maisara, with certain additions and omissions.
hi: Abu Bakr bin Abi Shaiba, Ja'far bin Aun, Hisham bin Sa'd, Zaid bin Aslam ne ye hadees Hafs bin Maisara ki riwayat jaisi bayan ki hai, kuch izafon aur chhod diye gaye hisson ke saath.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported: Verily the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Allah will admit into Paradise those deserving of Paradise, and He will admit whom He wishes out of His Mercy, and admit those condemned to Hell into the Fire (of Hell). He would then say: See, he whom you find having as much faith in his heart as a grain of mustard, bring him out. They will then be brought out burned and turned to charcoal, and would be cast into the river of life, and they would sprout aj does a seed in the silt carried away by flood. Have you not seen that it comes out yellow (fresh) and intertwined?
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne bataaya: Beshak Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Allah Jannat ke haqdaaron ko Jannat mein daakhil karega, aur Wo apni rehmat se jise chaahega daakhil karega, aur Jahannam ke muqarrar logon ko Aag mein daakhil karega. Phir Wo kahega: Dekho, jise tum apne dil mein sarson ke daane jitna bhi imaan rakhte paao, use nikaalo. Phir unhein jala hua aur koyla bana hua nikaala jaayega, aur unhein zindagi ki nadi mein daala jaayega, aur wo aise ugenge jaise seylaab ki laayi hui mitti mein daana ugta hai. Kya tumne nahi dekha ki wo peela aur gunthaa hua nikalta hai?

e: This hadith is transmitted by 'Amr b. Yahya with the same chain of transmitters who narrated: They would be cast into the river which is called (the river of) life, and (both the narrators) did not doubt the hadith. The text transmitted by Khalid is: just as seeds sprout beside the flood water; and in the hadith of Wuhaib it is: Just as the seed sprouts in the silt or deposit left by flood.
hi: Ye hadees Amr bin Yahya ne usi sanad se riwayat ki hai jinhone riwayat ki: Unhein us nadi mein daala jaayega jise zindagi ki nadi kaha jaata hai, aur dono raawiyon ne hadees mein koi shak zaahir nahi kiya. Khalid ki riwayat ki gayi ibaarat hai: Jaise daane seylaab ke paani ke kinaare ugte hain; aur Wuhaib ki hadees mein ye hai: Jaise daana seylaab ki laayi hui mitti ya jamaav mein ugta hai.

e: It is reported by Abu Sa'id that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The (permanent) inhabitants of the Fire are those who are doomed to it, and verily they would neither die nor live in it (al-Qur'an, xx. 47; lxxxvii. 13). But the people whom the Fire would afflict (temporarily) on account of their sins, or so said (the narrator)" on account of their misdeeds," He would cause them to die till they would be turned into charcoal. Then they would be granted intercession and would be brought in groups and would be spread on the rivers of Paradise and then it would be said: O inhabitants of Paradise, pour water over them; then they would sprout forth like the sprouting of seed in the silt carried by flood. A man among the people said: (It appears) as if the Messenger of Allah lived in the steppe.
hi: Abu Sa'id se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Aag ke hamesha ke liye rehne wale wo log hain jinke liye ye muqarrar hai, aur beshak wo na usmein marenge na jiyenge (Quran 20:47; 87:13). Lekin jin logon ko Aag unke gunahon ki wajah se aazmaayegi, ya kaha unki badkariyon ki wajah se, Wo unhein maut de dega yahan tak ki wo koyla ban jaayenge. Phir unhein shafaa'at di jaayegi aur unhein giroh-giroh laaya jaayega aur Jannat ki nadiyon par phaila diya jaayega aur phir kaha jaayega: Aye Jannat ke rehne walo, unpar paani daalo; phir wo aise ugenge jaise seylaab ki laayi hui mitti mein daana ugta hai. Logon mein se ek shaks ne kaha: Aisa lagta hai goya Rasoolullah (SAW) registaan mein rehte the.

e: Abu Nadra narrated it from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri who reported it from the Apostle (ﷺ) a similar (hadith) up to the words: " in the mud of the flood," and he did not mention (the words narrated) after it.
hi: Abu Nadra ne ise Abu Sa'id al-Khudri se riwayat ki jinhone ise Rasool (SAW) se isi jaisi hadees ki riwayat ki, 'seylaab ki laayi hui mitti mein' ke alfaaz tak, aur unhone iske baad kahi gayi baat ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: Abdullah b. Mas'ud reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: I know the last of the inhabitants of Fire to be taken out therefrom, and the last of the inhabitants of Paradise to enter it. A man will come out of the Fire crawling. Then Allah, the Blessed and Exalted will say to him: Go and enter Paradise. So he would come to it and it would appear to him as if it were full. He would go back and say: O my Lord! I found it full. Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, would say to him: Go and enter Paradise. He would come and perceive as if it were full. He would return and say: O my Lord! I found it full. Allah would say to him: Go and enter Paradise, for there is for you the like of the world and ten times like it, or for you is ten times the like of this world. He (the narrator) said. He (that man) would say: Art Thou making a fun of me? or Art Thou laughing at me. though Thou art the King? He (the narrator) said: I saw the Messenger of Allah laugh till his front teeth were visible. And it was said: That would be the lowest rank among the inhabitants of Paradise.
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ood ne bataaya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Main Jahannam ke us aakhri rehne wale ko jaanta hoon jise wahan se nikaala jaayega, aur Jannat ke us aakhri rehne wale ko jo ismein daakhil hoga. Ek shaks Aag se rengte hue nikalega. Phir Allah, Mubarak aur Buland, usse kahega: Jao aur Jannat mein daakhil ho jao. Is liye wo wahan jaayega aur usko aisa lagega goya wo bhari hui hai. Wo wapas jaayega aur kahega: Aye mere Rab! Maine use bhara paaya. Allah, Mubarak aur Buland, usse kahega: Jao aur Jannat mein daakhil ho jao. Wo jaayega aur mehsoos karega goya wo bhari hui hai. Wo wapas jaayega aur kahega: Aye mere Rab! Maine use bhara paaya. Allah usse kahega: Jao aur Jannat mein daakhil ho jao, kyunki tumhaare liye duniya jaisi cheez hai aur usse das guna bhi, ya tumhaare liye is duniya ki das guna cheez hai. Unhone kaha: Wo shaks kahega: Kya Tu mujhpar hans raha hai? ya: Kya Tu mujhpar mazaak kar raha hai, halaanki Tu Baadshaah hai? Unhone kaha: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko itna hanste dekha ki unke aage ke daant nazar aane lage. Aur kaha gaya: Ye Jannat ke rehne walon mein sabse neeche ka darja hoga.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abdullah b. Mas'ud that the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him said: I recognise the last of the inhabitants of Fire to be taken out thereof. A man will come out of it crawling. It will be said to him: Go and enter Paradise. He (the Holy Prophet) said: He would go there to enter Paradise, but would find persons who have already occupied all its apartments. It would be said to him: Do you recall the time when you were in it (in the Hell)? He would say: Yes. It would be said to him: Express any desire. And he would express the desire. It would be said to him: For thee is that which thou desireth and ten times the world (worldly resources). He (the Holy Prophet) said: He would say: Art Thou making a fun of me, though Thou art the King? I saw the Messenger of Allah laugh till his front teeth were visible.
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ood se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Main us aakhri shaks ko pehchaanta hoon jo Aag se nikaala jaayega. Ek shaks ismein se rengte hue nikalega. Usse kaha jaayega: Jao aur Jannat mein daakhil ho jao. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Wo Jannat mein daakhil hone jaayega, lekin usko aise log milenge jinhone pehle hi iske sab kamre le liye hain. Usse kaha jaayega: Kya tumhein wo waqt yaad hai jab tum ismein the? Wo kahega: Haan. Usse kaha jaayega: Koi khwaahish zaahir karo. Aur wo khwaahish zaahir karega. Usse kaha jaayega: Tere liye wahi hai jo tu chaahta hai aur is duniya ke das guna. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Wo kahega: Kya Tu mujhpar hans raha hai, halaanki Tu Baadshaah hai? Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko itna hanste dekha ki unke aage ke daant nazar aane lage.

e: Ibn Mas'ud reported: Verily the Messenger of Allah said: The last to enter Paradise would be a man who would walk once and stumble once and be burnt by the Fire once. Then when he gets beyond it, he will turn to it and say: Blessed is He Who has saved me from thee. Allah has given me something He has not given to any one of those in earlier or later times. Then a tree would be raised up for him and he will say: O my Lord I bring me near this tree so that I may take shelter in its shade and drink of its water. Allah, the Exalted and Great, would say: O son of Adam, if I grant you this, you will ask Me for something else. He would say: No. my Lord. And he would promise Him that he would not ask for anything else. His Lord would excuse him because He sees what he cannot help desiring; so He would bring him near it, and he would take shelter in its shade and drink of its water. Afterwards a tree more beautiful than the first would be raised up before him and he would say: O my Lord! bring me near this tree in order that I may drink of its water and take shelter in its shade and I shall not ask Thee for anything else. He (Allah) would say: O son of Adam, if I bring you near it you may ask me for something else. He would promise Him that he would not ask for anything else. His Lord will excuse him because He would see something he cannot help desiring. So He would bring him near it and he would enjoy its shade and drink its water. Then a tree would be raised up for him at the gate of the Paradise, more beautiful than the first two. He would say: O my Lord! bring me near this (tree) so that I may enjoy its shade and drink from its water. I shall not ask Thee for anything else. He (Allah) would say: O son of Adam! did you not promise Me that you would not ask Me anything else? He would say: Yes, my Lord, but I shall not ask Thee for anything else. His Lord would excuse him for He sees something the temptation of which he could not resist. He (Allah) would bring him near to it, and when He would bring him near it he would hear the voices of the inhabitants of the Paradise. He would say: O my Lord! admit me to it. He (Allah) would say: O son of Adam, what will bring an end to your requests to Me? Will it please you if I give you the whole world and a like one along with it? He will say: O my Lord! art Thou mocking at me, though Thou art the Lord of the worlds? Ibn Mas'ud laughed and asked (the hearers): Why don't you ask me what I am laughing at. They (then) said: Why do you laugh? He said: It is in this way that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) laughed. They (the companions of the Holy Prophet) asked: Why do you laugh. Messenger of Allah? He said: On account of the laugh of the Lord of the universe, when he ldesirer of Paradise) sai Thou mocking at me though Thou art the Lord of the worlds? He would say: I am not mocking at you, but I have power to do whatever I will.
hi: Ibn Mas'ood ne bataaya: Beshak Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jannat mein sabse aakhri daakhil hone waala ek aisa shaks hoga jo ek baar chalega aur ek baar thokar khaayega aur ek baar Aag se jal jaayega. Phir jab wo isse aage nikal jaayega, to wo iski taraf mudega aur kahega: Mubarak hai Wo Jisne mujhe tujhse bacha liya. Allah ne mujhe wo cheez di hai jo Usne pehle ya baad ke logon mein se kisi ko nahi di. Phir uske liye ek ped uthaaya jaayega aur wo kahega: Aye mere Rab! mujhe is ped ke qareeb kar de taaki main iski chhaanv mein panaah loon aur iske paani se peeoon. Allah, Buland aur Baa-Azmat, kahega: Aye Aadam ki aulaad, agar Maine tumhein ye de diya, to tum Mujhse kuch aur maangoge. Wo kahega: Nahi, mere Rab. Aur wo Usse waada karega ki wo kuch aur nahi maangega. Uska Rab usse mu'aaf kar dega, kyunki Wo dekhta hai ki wo khwaahish karne se khud ko rok nahi paayega; is liye Wo use uske qareeb le jaayega, aur wo iski chhaanv mein panaah lega aur iske paani se peeyega. Iske baad ek aur ped, pehle se zyada khoobsurat, uske saamne uthaaya jaayega aur wo kahega: Aye mere Rab! mujhe is ped ke qareeb kar de taaki main iske paani se peeoon aur iski chhaanv mein panaah loon aur main Tujhse kuch aur nahi maangunga. Wo Allah kahega: Aye Aadam ki aulaad, agar Main tumhein iske qareeb kar dun, to tum Mujhse kuch aur maangoge. Wo Usse waada karega ki wo kuch aur nahi maangega. Uska Rab use mu'aaf kar dega kyunki Wo aisi cheez dekhega jise wo naapasand nahi kar payega. Is liye Wo use uske qareeb le jaayega aur wo iski chhaanv ka mazaa lega aur iska paani peeyega. Phir uske liye Jannat ke darwaze par ek ped uthaaya jaayega, pehle dono se zyada khoobsurat. Wo kahega: Aye mere Rab! mujhe is ped ke qareeb kar de taaki main iski chhaanv ka mazaa lun aur iska paani peeoon. Main Tujhse kuch aur nahi maangunga. Wo Allah kahega: Aye Aadam ki aulaad! kya tumne Mujhse waada nahi kiya tha ki tum Mujhse kuch aur nahi maangoge? Wo kahega: Haan, mere Rab, lekin main Tujhse kuch aur nahi maangunga. Uska Rab use mu'aaf kar dega kyunki Wo aisi cheez dekhta hai jiski lalach ka wo muqaabla nahi kar sakta. Wo Allah use uske qareeb le jaayega, aur jab Wo use uske qareeb le jaayega, to wo Jannat ke rehne walon ki aawazein sunega. Wo kahega: Aye mere Rab! mujhe ismein daakhil kar de. Wo Allah kahega: Aye Aadam ki aulaad, tumhaari Mujhse maangon ka ant kya hoga? Kya tumhein khushi hogi agar Main tumhein poori duniya de dun aur uske saath ek aur bhi? Wo kahega: Aye mere Rab! Kya Tu mera mazaak uda raha hai, halaanki Tu duniyaon ka Rab hai? Ibn Mas'ood ne hansi aur poocha: Tum mujhse poochte kyun nahi ho ki main kis baat par hans raha hoon. Unhone kaha: Aap kyun hans rahe hain? Unhone kaha: Isi tarah Rasoolullah (SAW) hanse the. Unhone poocha: Aap kyun hans rahe hain, Ya Rasoolullah? Aap (SAW) ne kaha: Kaayenaat ke Rab ki hansi ki wajah se, jab usne kaha: Kya Tu mera mazaak uda raha hai halaanki Tu duniyaon ka Rab hai? Wo Allah kahega: Main tumhaara mazaak nahi uda raha, lekin Mujhme jo chaahoon wo karne ki taaqat hai.

e: It is transmitted from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri that, verily, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Amongst the inhabitants of Paradise the lowest in rank will be the person whose face Allah would turn away from the Fire towards the Paradise, and make a shady tree appear before him. He would say: O my Lord! direct my steps to this tree so that I (should enjoy) its shade; and the rest of the hadith is like that narrated by Ibn Mas'ud, but he did not mention:" He (Allah) would say: O son of Adam! what will bring an end to your making requests to Me" to the end of the tradition. In it, he added: Allah will remind him: Ask such and such, and when his expectations would be realised, Allah would say: That is for you, and ten times as much. He said that he would then enter his house and his two wives with large and dark eyes would enter after him. They will say: Praise be to Allah, Who has created you for us and us for you. He will say: No one has been given the like of what I have been given.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri se riwayat hai ki beshak Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jannat ke rehne walon mein sabse neeche darje ka shaks wo hoga jiska mooh Allah Aag se hataakar Jannat ki taraf karega, aur uske saamne ek saayedaar ped zaahir karega. Wo kahega: Aye mere Rab! mere kadamon ko is ped ki taraf mod de taaki main iski chhaanv ka mazaa lun; aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai jaisi Ibn Mas'ood ne riwayat ki, lekin unhone ye zikr nahi kiya: Wo Allah kahega: Aye Aadam ki aulaad! tumhaari Mujhse maangon ka ant kya hoga, hadees ke aakhir tak. Ismein, unhone izafa kiya: Allah use yaad dilaayega: Falaan-falaan cheez maango, aur jab uski ummeedein poori ho jaayengi, to Allah kahega: Ye tere liye hai, aur das guna bhi. Unhone kaha ki phir wo apne ghar mein daakhil hoga aur uski do biwiyaan, bade aur kaale khoobsurat aankhon waali, uske peeche daakhil hongi. Wo kahengi: Sab tareef Allah ke liye hai, Jisne aapko humaare liye aur humein aapke liye banaaya. Wo kahega: Kisi ko bhi wo nahi diya gaya jo mujhe diya gaya hai.

e: The same hadith has been by AlMughirah bin Shu’bah attributing it to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).
hi: Ye hadees al-Mughira bin Shu'ba ne bhi Rasoolullah (SAW) ki taraf mansoob karte hue riwayat ki hai.

e: It is reported on the authority of al-Mughira b. Shu'ba that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Moses asked his Lord: Who amongst the inhabitants of Paradise is the lowest to rank? He (Allah) said: The person who would be admitted into Paradise last of all among those deserving of Paradise who are admitted to it. I would be said to him: Enter Paradise. He would say: O my Lord! how (should I enter) while the people have settled in their apartments and taken the shares (portions)? It would be said to him: Would you be pleased if there be for you like the kingdom of a king amongst the kings of the world? He would say: I am pleased my Lord. He (Allah) would say: For you is that, and like that, and like that, and like that, and that. He would say at the fifth (point): I am well pleased. My Lord. He (Allah) would say: It is for you and, ten times like it, and for you is what your self desires and your eye enjoys. He would say: I am well pleased, my Lord. He (Moses) said: (Which is) the highest of their (inhabitants of Paradise) ranks? He (Allah) said: They are those whom I choose. I establish their honour with My own hand and then set a seal over it (and they would be blessed with Bounties) which no eye has seen, no ear has heard and no human mind has perceived: and this is sub- stantiated by the Book of Allah, Exalted and Great:" So no soul knows what delight of the eye is hidden for them; a reward for what they did" (xxxii. 17).
hi: Al-Mughira bin Shu'ba se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Musa ne apne Rab se poocha: Jannat ke rehne walon mein sabse neeche darje ka kaun hoga? Unhone Allah ne farmaya: Wo shaks jo Jannat ke haqdaaron mein se sabse aakhir mein Jannat mein daakhil kiya jaayega. Usse kaha jaayega: Jannat mein daakhil ho jao. Wo kahega: Aye mere Rab! kaise main daakhil hoon jabki log apne kamron mein bas chuke hain aur apne hisse le chuke hain? Usse kaha jaayega: Kya tumhein khushi hogi agar tumhaare liye duniya ke baadshahon mein se kisi baadshah ki saltanat jaisi cheez ho? Wo kahega: Main khush hoon, mere Rab. Wo Allah kahega: Ye tere liye hai, aur waisi hi, aur waisi hi, aur waisi hi, aur wo bhi. Wo paanchvi baar kahega: Main bahut khush hoon, mere Rab. Wo Allah kahega: Ye tere liye hai, aur iske das guna, aur tere liye wo bhi hai jo tera nafs chaahe aur teri aankh khush ho. Wo kahega: Main bahut khush hoon, mere Rab. Unhone Musa ne poocha: Unmein se sabse baland darja kiska hoga? Unhone Allah ne farmaya: Wo log jinhein Main chunta hoon. Main apne haath se unki izzat qaayam karta hoon aur phir uspar mohar laga deta hoon aur unhein aisi nematon se nawaaza jaata hai jo na kisi aankh ne dekhi, na kisi kaan ne suni, aur na kisi insaani zehen ne socha; aur ye baat Allah, Buland aur Baa-Azmat, ki Kitab se saabit hai: 'Is liye koi jaan nahi jaanti ki unke liye aankhon ki kaunsi khushi chhupaayi gayi hai; unke amal ka badla' (32:17).

e: Sha'bi reported he had heard al-Mughira b. Shu'ba say on the pulpit that Moses (peace be upon him) had asked Allah, Exalted and Great, about the reward of the lowest of the inhabitants of Paradise, and the remaining part of hadith is the same (as narrated) above.
hi: Sha'bi ne bataaya ki unhone al-Mughira bin Shu'ba ko mimbar par ye kehte suna ki Musa (AS) ne Allah, Buland aur Baa-Azmat se Jannat ke sabse neeche darje waalon ke sawaab ke baare mein poocha, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai jaisi upar bayan hui.

e: Abu Dharr reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I know the last of the inhabitants of Paradise to enter it and the last of the inhabitants of Hell to come out of it. He is a man who would be brought on the Day of Resurrection and it will be said: Present his minor sins to him, and withhold from him his serious sins. Then the minor sins would be placed before him, and it would be said: On such and such a day you did so and so and on such and such a day you did so and so. He would say: Yes. It will not be possible for him to deny, while he would be afraid lest serious sins should be presented before him. It would be said to him: In place of every evil deed you will have a good deed. He will say: My Lord! I have done things I do not see here. I indeed saw the Messenger of Allah laugh till his front teeth were exposed.
hi: Abu Dharr ne bataaya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Main Jannat mein daakhil hone waale aakhri shaks ko jaanta hoon aur Jahannam se nikalne waale aakhri shaks ko bhi. Wo ek shaks hai jise Qayamat ke Din laaya jaayega aur kaha jaayega: Uske chhote gunah uske saamne pesh karo, aur uske bade gunah usse chhupaao. Phir chhote gunah uske saamne rakhe jaayenge aur kaha jaayega: Falaan-falaan din tumne ye-ye kiya aur falaan-falaan din tumne ye-ye kiya. Wo kahega: Haan. Uske liye inkaar karna mumkin nahi hoga, jabki wo darta rahega ki kahin bade gunah bhi saamne na pesh kar diye jaayein. Usse kaha jaayega: Har buraayi ke badle tumhein ek neki di jaayegi. Wo kahega: Mere Rab! Maine aisi cheezein bhi ki hain jo mujhe yahan nazar nahi aa rahin. Maine khud Rasoolullah (SAW) ko itna hanste dekha ki unke aage ke daant nazar aane lage.

e: This hadith is also narrated by another chain of narrators, i. e. Ibn Numair, Abu Mu'awiya, Waki', Abu Bakr b. Abi Shaiba, Abu Kuraib, A'mash.
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai, yaani: Ibn Numair, Abu Mua'wiya, Waki, Abu Bakr bin Abi Shaiba, Abu Kuraib, A'mash.

e: It is reported on the authority of Abu Zubair that he heard from Jabir b 'Abdullah, who was asked about the arrival (of people on the Day of Resurrection). He said. We would come on the Day of Resurrection like this, like this, and see. carefully. that which concerns" elevated people". He (the narrator) said: Then the people would be summoned along with their idols whom they worshipped, one after another. Then our Lord would come to us and say: Whom are you waiting for? They would say: We are waiting for our Lord. He would say: I am your Lord. They would say: (We are not sure) till we gaze at Thee, and He would manifest Himself to them smilingly, and would go along with them and they would follow Him; and every person, whether a hypocrite or a believer, would be endowed with a light, and there would be spikes and hooks on the bridge of the Hell, which would catch hold of those whom Allah willed. Then the light of the hypocrites would be extinguished, and the believers would secure salvation. and the first group to achieve it would comprise seventy thousand men who would have the brightness of full moon on their faces, and they would not be called to account. Then the people immediately following them would have their faces as the brightest stars in the heaven. This is how (the groups would follow one after another). Then the stage of intercession would come, and they (who are permitted to intercede) would intercede, till he who had declared:" There is no god but Allah" and had in his heart virtue of the weight of a barley grain would come out of the Fire. They would be then brought in the courtyard of Paradise and the inhabitants of Paradise would begin to sprinkle water over them till they would sprout like the sprouting of a thing in flood water, and their burns would disappear. They would ask their Lord till they would be granted (the bounties) of the world and with it ten more besides it.
hi: Abu Zubair se riwayat hai ki unhone Jabir bin Abdullah se suna, jinse logon ke Qayamat ke Din aane ki tarteeb ke baare mein poocha gaya. Unhone kaha: Hum Qayamat ke Din is-is tarah aayenge, aur dekho, wo cheez jo 'baland logon' se mutaalliq hai. Unhone kaha: Phir logon ko unke buton ke saath bulaaya jaayega jinki wo parastish karte the, ek ke baad ek. Phir humaara Rab humaare paas aayega aur kahega: Tum kiska intezaar kar rahe ho? Wo kahenge: Hum apne Rab ka intezaar kar rahe hain. Wo kahega: Main tumhaara Rab hoon. Wo kahenge: Hum yaqeen se nahi keh sakte jab tak hum Tujhe na dekh lein, aur Wo unke saamne muskuraate hue zaahir hoga, aur unke saath chalega aur wo Uski peirvi karenge; aur har shaks, chaahe munafiq ho ya momin, use ek noor diya jaayega, aur Jahannam ke pul par kaante aur ankude honge, jo un logon ko pakadenge jinhein Allah chaahega. Phir munafiqeen ka noor bujh jaayega, aur momineen nijaat paa jaayenge. Aur pehla giroh jo isko haasil karega usmein sattar hazaar (70,000) log honge jinke chehre poore chaand ki chamak jaise honge, aur unse koi hisaab nahi liya jaayega. Phir unke turant baad aane wale logon ke chehre aasman ke sabse chamakdaar sitaaron jaise honge. Isi tarah giroh ek ke baad ek aayenge. Phir shafaa'at ka daur aayega, aur wo jinhein shafaa'at karne ki ijaazat di gayi hai shafaa'at karenge, yahan tak ki wo shaks jisne 'Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi' ka elaan kiya tha aur uske dil mein jau ke daane barabar bhi neki thi, Aag se nikal aayega. Unhein phir Jannat ke aangan mein laaya jaayega aur Jannat ke rehne wale unpar paani chhidakna shuru kar denge yahan tak ki wo aise ugenge jaise seylaab ke paani mein koi cheez ugti hai, aur unke jalne ke nishaan mit jaayenge. Wo apne Rab se maangenge yahan tak ki unhein duniya jitni cheezein di jaayengi aur uske saath das aur bhi.

e: Jabir reported that he had heard with his ears the Apostle (ﷺ) saying: Allah will bring out people from the Fire and admit them into Paradise.
hi: Jabir se riwayat hai ki unhone apne kaanon se Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Allah logon ko Aag se nikaalega aur unhein Jannat mein daakhil karega.

e: Hammad b. Zaid, reported: I said to 'Amr b. Dinar: Did you hear Jabir b. 'Abdullah narrating from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that Allah would bring out people from the Fire through intercession. He said: Yes.
hi: Hammad bin Zaid ne bataaya: Maine Amr bin Dinar se poocha: Kya aap ne Jabir bin Abdullah ko Rasoolullah (SAW) se ye riwayat karte suna ki Allah shafaa'at ke zariye logon ko Aag se nikaalega? Unhone kaha: Haan.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah repotted: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Verily people would be brought out from the Fire, and they would be burnt except the exterior (surfaces, fronts) of their faces; and they would enter Paradise.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bataaya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Beshak logon ko Aag se nikaala jaayega, aur wo jal chuke honge sivaay unke chehron ke bahari hisson ke; aur wo Jannat mein daakhil honge.

e: Yazid al-Faqir said: This view of the Khawarij (i.e. those who commit major sins and would be eternally doomed to Hell) had obsessed me, and we set out in a large group intending to perform the Hajj and then going to the people (for the propagation of the views of the Khawarij). He (the narrator) said: We happened to past by Medina and found there Jabir b. 'Abdullah sitting near a column narrating to the people (the ahadith of) the Prophet (ﷺ). When he mentioned the inhabitants of Hell, I said: O companion of the Messenger of Allah what is this that you narrate, whereas Allah says: "Verily whomsoever Thou shall commit to the Fire, Thou indeed humiliateth him" (al-Qur'an, iii. 192); and All those who endeavored to get out of that would be thrown back into it" (al-Qur'an, xxxi i. 20)? So what is it that you say? He said: Have you read the Qur'an? I said: Yes. He said: Have you heard about the (exalted) position of Muhammad (ﷺ), i.e. to which Allah would raise, him? I said: Yes. He said: Verily the position of Muhammad (ﷺ) is that of great glory and that is by which Allah would bring out whomsoever He would wish to bring out. He then described the Path (the Bridge) and the passing of the people over it, and said: I am afraid I may not have remembered (other things) but this much is still in my memory that people would come out of the Hell after having gone into it, and he said: They would come out of it as if they were the wood of the ebony tree. He (the narrator said: They would enter a river, one or the rivers of Paradise, and would bathe in it, and then come out as if they were (white like) paper. We then turned back and said: Woe be upon you! How can this old man tell a lie against the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)? We turned back (from the views of the Khawarij), and by God every one of us abandoned this (band of Khawarij) except one man. A similar statement has been made by Abu Nu'aim.
hi: Yazid al-Faqir ne kaha: Khawarij ka ye khayaal mujhpar chhaya hua tha, aur hum ek bade giroh mein Hajj karne ke iraade se nikle aur phir logon ke paas Khawarij ke khayaalaat phailaane jaane ka iraada rakhte the. Unhone kaha: Humaara guzar Madina se hua aur humne Jabir bin Abdullah ko ek satoon ke qareeb baithe hue paaya, logon ko Nabi (SAW) ki Ahadees sunaate hue. Jab unhone Jahannam ke rehne walon ka zikr kiya, to maine kaha: Aye Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saathi, ye aap kya bayan kar rahe hain, jabki Allah farmaata hai: 'Beshak jisko Tu Aag mein daale, use Tu zaleel kar deta hai' (3:192); aur 'Aur jitni bhi baar wo isse nikalne ki koshish karenge, unhein wapas usmein daal diya jaayega' (32:20)? To ye kya hai jo aap keh rahe hain? Unhone kaha: Kya tumne Quran padha hai? Maine kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha: Kya tumne Muhammad (SAW) ke baland maqaam ke baare mein suna hai, jispar Allah unhein uthaayega? Maine kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha: Beshak Muhammad (SAW) ka maqaam bade sharaf ka hai aur usi ke zariye Allah jise chaahega use nikaalega. Phir unhone Pul aur logon ka usse guzarne ka bayaan kiya, aur kaha: Mujhe dar hai ki main baaki cheezein yaad na rakh paaya hoon lekin itni baat abhi bhi meri yaadaasht mein hai ki log Jahannam mein jaane ke baad usse nikalte hue aayenge, aur unhone kaha: Wo isse aise nikalenge goya wo aabnoos ki lakdi ki tarah ho. Unhone kaha: Wo Jannat ki nadiyon mein se ek mein daakhil honge, aur usmein nahayenge, aur phir aise nikalenge goya wo safed kaagaz jaise hon. Phir hum wapas mud gaye aur kaha: Tumpar afsos! Ye budhe shaks Rasoolullah (SAW) par jhoot kaise bol sakte hain? Hum Khawarij ke khayaalaat se palat gaye, aur Allah ki qasam, hummein se har ek ne is giroh ko chhod diya sivaay ek shaks ke. Isi tarah ki baat Abu Nu'aim ne bhi kahi hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Four persons would be brought out from the Fire and would be presented to Allah. One of them would turn (towards the He) ) ) and say: O my Lord, when Thou hast brought me out from it, do not throw me back into it, and Allah would rescue him from it.
hi: Anas bin Malik se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Chaar logon ko Aag se nikaala jaayega aur Allah ke saamne pesh kiya jaayega. Unmein se ek Jahannam ki taraf mudega aur kahega: Aye mere Rab, jab Tune mujhe usse nikaal diya, to mujhe dobara usmein mat daalna, aur Allah use usse bacha lega.

e: Anas b Malik reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Allah would gather people on the Day of Resurrection and they would be concerned about it, and Ibn Ubaid said. They would get a Divine inspiration about it, and would say: If we could seek intercession with our Lord, we may be relieved from this predicament of ours. He (the Holy Prophet) said: They would come to Adam andsay, Thou art Adam, the father of mankind. Allah created thee with His own hand and breathed unto thee of His Spirit and commanded the angels and they prostrated before thee. So intercede for us with thy Lords, that He may relieve us from this position of ours. He would say: I am not in a position to do this, and would recall his error, and would fight shy of his Lord on account of that; go to Noah the first messenger (after me) sent by Allah. He (the Holy Prophet) said: So they would come to Noah (peace be upon him). He would say: I am not in a position to do that for you, and recall his fault which he had committed, and would fight shy of his Lord on account of that, (and would say): You better go to Ibrahim (peace be upon him) whom Allah took for a friend. They would come to Ibrahim (peace be upon him) and he would say: I am not in a position to do that for you, and would recall his fault that he had committed and would, therefore, fight shy of his Lord on that account (and would say): You better go to Moses (peace be upon him) with whom Allah conversed and con- ferred Torah upon him. He (the Holy Prophet) said: So they would come to Moses (peace be upon him) He would say: I am not in a position to do that for you, and would recall his fault that he had committed and would fight shy of his Lord on account of that (and would say): You better go to Jesus, the Spirit of Allah and His word He would say: I am not in a position to do that for you; you better go to Muhammad (ﷺ), a servant whose former and later sins have been forgiven. He (the narrator) said: The Messenger or Allah (ﷺ) observed: So they would come to me and I would ask the permission of my Lord and it would be granted to me, and when I would see Him, I would fall down in prostration, and He (Allah) would leave me thus as long as He would wish, and then it would be said: O Muhammad, raise your head, say and you would be heard; ask and it would be granted; intercede and intercession would be accepted. Then I would raise my head and extrol my Lord with the praise which my Lord would teach me. I shall then inter- cede, but a limit would be set for me I would bring them out from the Fire and make them enter Paradise (according to the limit). I shall return then ard fall down in pros- tration and Allah would leave me (in that position) as long as He would wish to leave me it would be said: Rise, O Muhammad, say and you would be heard; ask and it would be conferred; intercede and intercession would be granted. I would raise my head and extrol my Lord with praise that He would teach me. I would theft intercede and a limit would be set for me. I would bring them out of the Fire (of Hell) and make them enter Paradise. He (the narrator) said: I do not remember whether he (the Holy Prophet) said at tLe third time or at the fourth time: O my Lord, none has been left in the Fire, but thise restrained by the Holy Qur'an, i e. those who were eternally doomed. Ibn Ubaid said in a narration: Qatada observed: whose everlasting stay was imperative".
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bataaya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Allah Qayamat ke Din logon ko jama karega aur wo iske baare mein pareshaan honge, aur Ibn Ubaid ne kaha: Unhein Allah ki taraf se is baare mein ilhaam milega, aur wo kahenge: Agar hum apne Rab se shafaa'at ki darkhwaast kar sakein, to shaayad hum apni is museebat se raahat paa sakte hain. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: To wo Aadam (AS) ke paas aayenge aur kahenge: Tum Aadam ho, insaaniyat ke waalid. Allah ne tumhein apne haath se paida kiya aur tummein apni Rooh phoonki aur Farishton ko hukum diya aur unhone tumhein sajda kiya. Is liye humaare liye apne Rab se shafaa'at karo, taaki Wo humein is halat se nijaat de. Unhone kaha: Main ye karne ki halat mein nahi hoon, aur unhein apni khataa yaad aayegi, aur wo iski wajah se apne Rab se sharminda ho jaayenge; jaao Nooh ke paas, pehle Rasool jo Allah ne mere baad bheje. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: To wo Nooh (AS) ke paas aayenge. Unhone kaha: Main tumhaare liye ye karne ki halat mein nahi hoon, aur unhein apni woh galti yaad aayegi jo unhone ki thi, aur wo iski wajah se apne Rab se sharminda ho jaayenge, aur kahenge: Behtar hoga tum Ibrahim (AS) ke paas jao jinhein Allah ne apna dost banaaya. Wo Ibrahim (AS) ke paas aayenge aur wo kahenge: Main tumhaare liye ye karne ki halat mein nahi hoon, aur unhein apni woh galti yaad aayegi jo unhone ki thi, is liye wo apne Rab se sharminda ho jaayenge aur kahenge: Behtar hoga tum Musa (AS) ke paas jao jinse Allah ne baat ki aur unhein Tawrat di. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: To wo Musa (AS) ke paas aayenge. Unhone kaha: Main tumhaare liye ye karne ki halat mein nahi hoon, aur unhein apni woh galti yaad aayegi jo unhone ki thi aur wo iski wajah se apne Rab se sharminda ho jaayenge aur kahenge: Behtar hoga tum Isa, Allah ki Rooh aur Uske Kalime ke paas jao. Unhone kaha: Main tumhaare liye ye karne ki halat mein nahi hoon; behtar hoga tum Muhammad (SAW) ke paas jao, aisa banda jiske pehle aur baad ke gunah maaf kar diye gaye hain. Unhone kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: To wo mere paas aayenge aur main apne Rab se ijaazat maangunga aur mujhe di jaayegi, aur jab main Use dekhunga, to main sajde mein gir jaaunga, aur Wo mujhe utni der usi halat mein rehne dega jitni Wo chaahega, phir kaha jaayega: Aye Muhammad, apna sar uthaao, kaho aur tumhaari baat suni jaayegi; maango aur tumhein diya jaayega; shafaa'at karo aur shafaa'at qubool ki jaayegi. Phir main apna sar uthaaunga aur apne Rab ki us tareef ke saath tareef karunga jo mera Rab mujhe sikhaayega. Phir main shafaa'at karunga, lekin meri ek had muqarrar ki jaayegi. Main unhein Aag se nikaalunga aur Jannat mein daakhil karunga. Phir main wapas jaaunga aur sajde mein gir jaaunga aur Allah mujhe utni der rehne dega jitni Wo chaahega, phir kaha jaayega: Utho, Aye Muhammad, kaho aur tumhaari baat suni jaayegi; maango aur tumhein diya jaayega; shafaa'at karo aur shafaa'at qubool ki jaayegi. Main apna sar uthaaunga aur apne Rab ki us tareef ke saath tareef karunga jo Wo mujhe sikhaayega. Phir main shafaa'at karunga aur meri ek had muqarrar ki jaayegi. Main unhein Aag se nikaalunga aur Jannat mein daakhil karunga. Unhone kaha: Mujhe yaad nahi ki unhone teesri baar kaha ya chauthi baar: Aye mere Rab, Aag mein koi baaki nahi bacha sivaay unke jinhein Quran-e-Kareem ne rok rakha hai, yaani jinke liye hamesha rehna zaroori tha. Ibn Ubaid ne ek riwayat mein kaha: Qatada ne bayan kiya: jinka hamesha rehna zaroori tha.

e: Anas reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The believers would gather on the Day of Resurrection, and they would be concerned about it, or would be made mindful of it (i. e. the trjuble for it), (and the remaining part of the hadith w, ) uld be narrated) like the one transmitted by Abu Uwana, and he said in the hadith: Then I would come for the fourth time, or I would return the fourth time, and would say: O my Lord, no one has been left but he whom the Holy Qur'an has restrained.
hi: Anas ne bataaya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Momineen Qayamat ke Din jama honge, aur wo iske baare mein pareshaan honge, ya unhein iski museebat ki yaad dilaayi jaayegi aur baaki hadees waisi hi bayan ki jaayegi jaisi Abu Uwana ki riwayat ki gayi hai, aur unhone hadees mein kaha: Phir main chauthi baar aaunga, ya main chauthi baar wapas jaaunga, aur kahunga: Aye mere Rab, koi baaki nahi bacha sivaay uske jise Quran-e-Kareem ne rok rakha hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: The Prophet of Allah (may peace be, upon him) said: Allah will gather the believers on the Day of Resurrection and they would be made mindful of it; and the rest (of the hadith) is like the one narrated above; and then he mentioned the fourth time: And I (the Holy Prophet) would say: O my Lord, no one is left in the Fire except he whom the Qur'an has restrained, i e. eternally doomed.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bataaya: Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Allah Qayamat ke Din momineen ko jama karega aur unhein iski yaad dilaayi jaayegi; aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai jaisi upar bayan hui; aur phir unhone chauthi baar ka zikr kiya: Aur main kahunga: Aye mere Rab, Aag mein koi baaki nahi bacha sivaay uske jise Quran ne rok rakha hai, yaani jo hamesha ke liye muqarrar tha.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: Verily the Apostle (ﷺ) said: He who professed: There is no god but Allah, would be brought out of the Fire even though he has in his heart virtue equal to the weight of a barley grain. Then he who professed: There is no god but Allah, would come out of the Fire, even though he has in his heart virtue equal to the weight of a wheat grain. He would then bring out from the Fire he who professed: There is no god but Allah, even though he has in his heart virtue equal to the weight of an atom. Ibn Minhal has made an addition (of these words) in his narration: Yazid said: I met Shu'ba and narrated to him this hadith. Shu'ba said: Qatada transmitted to us this hadith from Anas b. Malik who heard it from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) with this alteration that he substituted the word Zurra (grain) in place of Zarra (atom). Yazid said: Abu Bistam has made a change in it.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bataaya: Beshak Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Jisne 'Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi' ka elaan kiya, use Aag se nikaal liya jaayega chaahe uske dil mein jau ke daane barabar bhi neki ho. Phir jisne 'Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi' ka elaan kiya, wo Aag se nikal aayega, chaahe uske dil mein gehun ke daane barabar bhi neki ho. Phir Wo Aag se us shaks ko nikaalega jisne 'Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi' ka elaan kiya, chaahe uske dil mein ek zarre ke barabar bhi neki ho. Ibn Minhal ne apni riwayat mein in alfaaz ka izafa kiya hai: Yazid ne kaha: Main Shu'ba se mila aur unhein ye hadees sunaayi. Shu'ba ne kaha: Qatada ne humein ye hadees Anas bin Malik se riwayat ki jinhone ise Rasoolullah (SAW) se suna, is farq ke saath ki unhone lafz 'Zurra' daana ko 'Zarra' zarra ki jagah istemaal kiya. Yazid ne kaha: Abu Bistam ne ismein tabdeeli ki hai.

e:
Ma'bad b. Hilal al 'Anazi reported: We went to Anas b. Malik through Thabit and reached there (his house) while he was offering the forenoon prayer. Thabit sought permission for us and we entered, and he seated Thabit with him on his bedstead. He (Thabit) said to him (Anas b. Malik): O Abu Hamza (kunya of Anas b. Malik), your brothers from among the inhabitants of Basra ask you to narrate to them the hadith of intercession. He said: Muhammad (ﷺ) narrated to us: When it would be the Day of Resurrection, some of the people would rush to one another in bewilderment. They would come to Adam and say: Intercede (with your Lord) for your progeny. He would say: I am not fit to do this, but go to Ibrahim (peace be upon him) for he is the Friend of Allah. They would come to Ibrahim, but he would say: I am not fit to do this, but go to Moses, for he is Allah's Interlocutor. They would come to Moses, but he would say: I am not fit to do this, but you should go to Jesus, for he is the Spirit of Allah and His word. They would come to Jesus, and he would say, I am not fit to do this; you better go to Muhammad (ﷺ). They would come to me, and I would say: I am in a position to do that, I would go and ask the permission of my Lord and it would be granted to me. I would then stand before Him and would extol Him with praises which I am not able to do now, but with which Allah would inspire me, then I would fall in prostration and it would be said to me: O Muhammad, raise thy head, and say and it would be listened to; ask and it would be granted, intercede and it would be accepted. I shall say: My Lord, my people, my people It would be said: Go, and bring forth from it (Hell) him who has in his heart faith equal to the weight of a wheat grain or a barley seed. I would go and do that; then I would return to my Lord and extol Him with those praises (taught to me by Allah), then I would fall in prostration. It would be said to me: O Muhammad, raise your head, and say and it would be heard; ask and it would be granted; intercede and intercession would be accepted. So I would say: My people. my people. It would be said to me: Go and take out from it (Hell) him who has in his heart faith equal to the weight of a mustard seed. I would go and do that. I would again return to my Lord and extol Him with those praises. I would then fall in prostration. It would be said to me: O Muhammad, raise your head: say, and you would be listened to; ask and it would be granted; intercede and intercession would be accepted. I would say: My Lord, my people, my people. It would be said to me: Go, and bring out of the Fire him who has in his heart as much faith as the smallest, smallest, smallest grain of mustard seed. I would go and do that. 
This is the hadith which Anas narrated to us. We went out of his (house) and when we reached the upper part of Jabban (graveyard) we said: Would that we meet Hasan and salute him and he was hiding in the house of Abu Khalifa. He (Ma'bad b. Hilal, the narrator) said: We went to him and greeted him and we said: O Abu Sa'id, we come from your brother Abu Hamza (kunya of Anas), and we have never heard a hadith like this relating to intercession, which he has narrated to us. He said: Narrate it, we narrated the hadith. He said: Narrate it (still further). We said: He did not (narrate it) before us more than this. He said: He (Anas) had narrated it to us twenty years back, when he was strong and healthy. He has in fact missed something. I cannot make out whether the old man has forgotten or he has (intentionally) avoided to narrate it to you lest you should rely (absolutely) upon it (and abandon doing good deeds). We said to him: Relate that to us, and he laughed and said: There is haste in the nature of man. I did not make mention of it to you but for the fact that I wanted to narrate that to you (and added that the Prophet said): I would then return to my Lord for the fourth time and extol Him with these praises. I would then fall in prostration. It would be said to me: O Muhammad, raise your head: say and it will be listened to; ask and it will be granted; intercede and intercession would be accepted. I would say: O my Lord, permit me regarding him who professed: There is no god but Allah. He (the Lord) would say: That is not for thee or that is not what lies with thee, but by My Honour, Glory, Greatness and Might, I would certainly take him out who professed it: There is no god but Allah. He (the narrator, Ma'bad) said: I hear testimony to the fact that the hadith transmitted to us-by Hasan was heard by him from Anas b. Malik and I can see that he reported it twenty years back, when he was hale and hearty.
hi:
Ma'bad bin Hilal al-Anazi ne bataaya: Hum Thabit ke zariye Anas bin Malik ke paas gaye aur unke ghar pahunche jab wo chaasht ki namaz padh rahe the. Thabit ne humaare liye ijaazat maangi aur hum daakhil hue, aur unhone Thabit ko apne saath apne palang par bithaaya. Unhone unse kaha: Aye Abu Hamza, aapke Basra ke rehne wale bhaai chaahte hain ki aap unhein shafaa'at ki hadees sunaayein. Unhone kaha: Muhammad (SAW) ne humein bataaya: Jab Qayamat ka Din hoga, to kuch log ghabraahat mein ek doosre ke paas daudenge. Wo Aadam ke paas aayenge aur kahenge: Apne Rab se apni aulaad ke liye shafaa'at karo. Wo kahenge: Main ye karne ke laayak nahi hoon, lekin Ibrahim (AS) ke paas jao, kyunki wo Allah ke Dost hain. Wo Ibrahim ke paas aayenge, lekin wo kahenge: Main ye karne ke laayak nahi hoon, lekin Musa ke paas jao, kyunki wo Allah ke Hum-Kalaam hain. Wo Musa ke paas aayenge, lekin wo kahenge: Main ye karne ke laayak nahi hoon, lekin tumhein Isa ke paas jaana chahiye, kyunki wo Allah ki Rooh aur Uska Kalima hain. Wo Isa ke paas aayenge, aur wo kahenge: Main ye karne ke laayak nahi hoon; behtar hoga tum Muhammad (SAW) ke paas jao. Wo mere paas aayenge, aur main kahunga: Main ye karne ke laayak hoon. Main jaaunga aur apne Rab se ijaazat maangunga aur mujhe di jaayegi. Phir main Uske saamne khada hounga aur Uski aisi tareef karunga jo main abhi nahi kar sakta, lekin jismein Allah mujhe ilhaam dega, phir main sajde mein gir jaaunga aur mujhse kaha jaayega: Aye Muhammad, apna sar uthaao, aur kaho aur suna jaayega; maango aur tumhein diya jaayega; shafaa'at karo aur qubool ki jaayegi. Main kahunga: Mere Rab, meri ummat, meri ummat. Kaha jaayega: Jao, aur usmein se us shaks ko nikaalo jiske dil mein gehun ya jau ke daane barabar imaan hai. Main jaaunga aur aisa karunga; phir main apne Rab ke paas wapas jaaunga aur Uski un tareefon ke saath tareef karunga, phir main sajde mein gir jaaunga. Mujhse kaha jaayega: Aye Muhammad, apna sar uthaao, aur kaho aur suna jaayega; maango aur tumhein diya jaayega; shafaa'at karo aur shafaa'at qubool ki jaayegi. Is liye main kahunga: Meri ummat, meri ummat. Mujhse kaha jaayega: Jao, aur usmein se us shaks ko nikaalo jiske dil mein sarson ke daane barabar imaan hai. Main jaaunga aur aisa karunga. Main dobara apne Rab ke paas wapas jaaunga aur Uski un tareefon ke saath tareef karunga. Phir main sajde mein gir jaaunga. Mujhse kaha jaayega: Aye Muhammad, apna sar uthaao: kaho, aur tumhaari baat suni jaayegi; maango, aur tumhein diya jaayega; shafaa'at karo, aur shafaa'at qubool ki jaayegi. Main kahunga: Mere Rab, meri ummat, meri ummat. Mujhse kaha jaayega: Jao, aur Aag mein se us shaks ko nikaalo jiske dil mein sarson ke daane se bhi choti, choti, choti maqdaar mein imaan hai. Main jaaunga aur aisa karunga.

Ye wo hadees hai jo Anas ne humein bayan ki. Hum unke ghar se nikle aur jab hum Jabban ke oopari hisse tak pahunche, to humne kaha: Kaash hum Hasan se milte aur unhein salaam karte, aur wo Abu Khalifa ke ghar mein chhupe hue the. Unhone kaha: Hum unke paas gaye aur unhein salaam kiya aur humne kaha: Aye Abu Sa'id, hum aapke bhai Abu Hamza ke paas se aa rahe hain, aur humne shafaa'at ke baare mein kabhi is jaisi hadees nahi suni jo unhone humein sunaayi. Unhone kaha: Ise sunaao, humne hadees sunaayi. Unhone kaha: Aur sunaao. Humne kaha: Unhone humaare saamne isse zyada kuch nahi kaha. Unhone kaha: Unhone ise humein bees saal pehle sunaaya tha, jab wo mazboot aur tandurust the. Unhone haqeeqat mein kuch chhod diya hai. Main tay nahi kar sakta ki kya budhe shaks bhool gaye hain ya unhone jaan-boojh kar tumhein ye batana taala hai iske khauf se ki tum is par poori tarah bharosa kar loge aur nek amal karna chhod doge. Humne unse kaha: Ye humein bataiye, aur wo hanse aur kaha: Insaan ki fitrat mein jaldbaazi hoti hai. Maine ye tumhein is liye zikr nahi kiya sivaay iske ki main tumhein ye bataana chaahta tha aur izafa kiya ki Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Phir main apne Rab ke paas chauthi baar wapas jaaunga aur in tareefon ke saath Uski tareef karunga. Phir main sajde mein gir jaaunga. Mujhse kaha jaayega: Aye Muhammad, apna sar uthaao: kaho aur suna jaayega; maango aur diya jaayega; shafaa'at karo aur qubool ki jaayegi. Main kahunga: Aye mere Rab, mujhe us shaks ke baare mein ijaazat dijiye jisne 'Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi' ka elaan kiya. Wo kahega: Ye tumhaare liye nahi hai, ya ye wo nahi hai jo tumhaare paas hai, lekin Meri Izzat, Shaan, Azmat aur Qudrat ki qasam, Main zaroor us shaks ko nikaal loonga jisne iska elaan kiya: 'Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi'. Unhone kaha: Main is baat ki gawahi deta hoon ki Hasan ne humein jo hadees sunaayi wo unhone Anas bin Malik se suni thi aur main dekh sakta hoon ki unhone ise bees saal pehle bayan kiya tha, jab wo hattaa-kattaa the.

e:
Abu Huraira reported: Meat was one day brought to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and a foreleg was offered to him, a part which he liked. He sliced with his teeth a piece out of it and said: I shall be the leader of mankind on the Day of Resurrection. Do you know why? Allah would gather in one plain the earlier and the later (of the human race) on the Day of Resurrection. Then the voice of the proclaimer would be heard by all of them and the eyesight would penetrate through all of them and the sun would come near. People would then experience a degree of anguish, anxiety and agony which they shall not be able to bear and they shall not be able to stand. Some people would say to the others: Don you see in which trouble you are? Don't you see what (misfortune) has overtaken you? Why don't you find one who should intercede for you with your Lord? Some would say to the others: Go to Adam. And they would go to Adam and say: O Adam, thou art the father of mankind. Allah created thee by His own Hand and breathed in thee of His spirit and ordered the angels to prostrate before thee. Intercede for us with thy Lord Don't you see in what (trouble) we are? Don't you see what (misfortune) has overtaken us? Adam would say: Verily, my Lord is angry, to an extent to which He had never been angry before nor would He be angry afterward. Verily, He forbade me (to go near) that tree and I disobeyed Him. I am concerned with my own self. Go to someone else; go to Noah. They would come to Noah and would say: O Noah, thou art the first of the Messengers (sent) on the earth (after Adam), and Allah named thee as a" Grateful Servant," intercede for us with thy Lord. Don't you see in what (trouble) we are? Don't you see what (misfortune) has overtaken us? He would say: Verily, my Lord is angry today as He had never been angry before, and would never be angry afterwards. There had emanated a curse from me with which I cursed my people. I am concerned with only myself, I am concerned only with myself; you better go to Ibrahim (peace be upon him). They would go to Ibrahim and say: Thou art the apostle of Allah and His Friend amongst the inhabitants of the earth; intercede for us with thy Lord. Don't you see in which (trouble) we are? Don't you see what (misfortune) has overtaken us? Ibrahim would say to them: Verily, my Lord is today angry as He had never been angry before and would never be angry afterwards. and (Ibrahim) would mention his lies (and then say): I am concerned only with myself, I am concerned only with myself. You better go to someone else: go to Moses. They would come to Moses (peace be upon him) and say: O Moses, thou art Allah's messenger, Allah blessed thee with His messengership and His conversation amongst people. Intercede for us with thy Lord. Don't you see in what (trouble) we are? Don't you see what (misfortune) has overtaken us? Moses (peace be upon him) would say to them: Verily. my Lord is angry as He had never been angry before and would never be angry afterwards. I, in fact, killed a person whom I had not been ordered to kill. I am concerned with myself, I am concerned with myself. You better go to Jesus (peace be upon him). They would come to Jesus and would say: O Jesus, thou art the messenger of Allah and thou conversed with people in the cradle, (thou art) His Word which I-Ie sent down upon Mary. and (thou art) the Spirit from Him; so intercede for us with thy Lord. Don't you see (the trouble) in which we are? Don't you see (the misfortune) that has overtaken us? Jesus (peace be upon him) would say: Verily, my Lord is angry today as He had never been angry before or would ever be angry afterwards. He mentioned no sin of his. (He simply said: ) I am concerned with myself, I am concerned with myself; you go to someone else: better go to Muhammad (ﷺ). 
They would come to me and say: O Mahammad, thou art the messenger of Allah and the last of the apostles. Allah has pardoned thee all thy previous and later sins. Intercede for us with thy Lord; don't you see in which (trouble) we are? Don't you see what (misfortune) has overtaken us? I shall then set off and come below the Throne and fall down prostrate before my Lord; then Allah would reveal to me and inspire me with some of His Praises and Glorifications which He had not revealed to anyone before me. He would then say: Muhammad, raise thy head; ask and it would be granted; intercede and intercession would be accepted I would then raise my head and say: O my Lord, my people, my people. It would be said: O Muhammad, bring in by the right gate of Paradise those of your people who would have no account to render. They would share with the people some other door besides this door. The Prophet then said: By Him in Whose Hand is the life of Muhammad, verify the distance between two door leaves of the Paradise is as great as between Mecca and Hajar, or as between Mecca and Busra.
hi:
Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Ek din Rasoolullah (SAW) ko gosht laaya gaya aur unhein ek agli taang di gayi, wo hissa jo unhein pasand tha. Unhone apne daanton se usmein se ek tukda kaata aur kaha: Main Qayamat ke Din insaaniyat ka rehnuma hounga. Kya tumhein pata hai kyun? Allah Qayamat ke Din agle aur pichhle poori insaaniyat ko ek maidan mein jama karega. Phir elaan karne wale ki awaaz sab tak pahunchegi aur nazar sab tak pahunchegi aur suraj qareeb aa jaayega. Log itni pareshaani, betaabi aur takleef mehsoos karenge ki jise wo bardaasht nahi kar payenge aur khade nahi reh payenge. Kuch log doosron se kahenge: Kya tum nahi dekhte ki tum kis museebat mein ho? Kya tum nahi dekhte ki tumpar kya afat aa padi hai? Tum kisi aise shaks ko kyun nahi dhoondte jo tumhaare liye apne Rab se shafaa'at kare? Kuch log doosron se kahenge: Aadam ke paas jao. Aur wo Aadam ke paas jaayenge aur kahenge: Aye Aadam, tum insaaniyat ke waalid ho. Allah ne tumhein apne haath se paida kiya aur tummein apni Rooh phoonki aur Farishton ko hukum diya ki tumhein sajda karein. Humaare liye apne Rab se shafaa'at karo. Kya tum nahi dekhte ki hum kis museebat mein hain? Kya tum nahi dekhte ki humpar kya afat aa padi hai? Aadam kahenge: Beshak, mera Rab itna naaraaz hai jitna Wo kabhi nahi hua aur kabhi hoga bhi nahi. Beshak, Usne mujhe us ped ke qareeb jaane se mana kiya tha aur maine Uski nafarmaani ki. Mujhe apni fikr hai. Kisi aur ke paas jao; Nooh ke paas jao. Wo Nooh ke paas aayenge aur kahenge: Aye Nooh, tum zameen par Allah ke bheje gaye pehle Rasool ho, aur Allah ne tumhein 'Shukr Guzaar Banda' kaha, humaare liye apne Rab se shafaa'at karo. Kya tum nahi dekhte ki hum kis museebat mein hain? Kya tum nahi dekhte ki humpar kya afat aa padi hai? Wo kahenge: Beshak, mera Rab aaj itna naaraaz hai jitna Wo kabhi nahi hua aur kabhi hoga bhi nahi. Mujhse ek laanat nikli thi jisse maine apni qaum par laanat bheji thi. Mujhe sirf apni fikr hai, mujhe sirf apni fikr hai; behtar hoga tum Ibrahim (AS) ke paas jao. Wo Ibrahim ke paas jaayenge aur kahenge: Tum Allah ke Rasool ho aur zameen ke logon mein Uske Dost ho; humaare liye apne Rab se shafaa'at karo. Kya tum nahi dekhte ki hum kis museebat mein hain? Kya tum nahi dekhte ki humpar kya afat aa padi hai? Ibrahim unse kahenge: Beshak, mera Rab aaj itna naaraaz hai jitna Wo kabhi nahi hua aur kabhi hoga bhi nahi, aur apne jhoot yaad karenge aur phir kahenge: Mujhe sirf apni fikr hai, mujhe sirf apni fikr hai. Behtar hoga tum kisi aur ke paas jao: Musa ke paas jao. Wo Musa (AS) ke paas aayenge aur kahenge: Aye Musa, tum Allah ke Rasool ho, Allah ne tumhein apni Risaalat aur logon se apni baatcheet se nawaaza. Humaare liye apne Rab se shafaa'at karo. Kya tum nahi dekhte ki hum kis museebat mein hain? Kya tum nahi dekhte ki humpar kya afat aa padi hai? Musa (AS) unse kahenge: Beshak, mera Rab itna naaraaz hai jitna Wo kabhi nahi hua aur kabhi hoga bhi nahi. Maine haqeeqat mein ek shaks ko maar diya tha jise maarne ka mujhe hukum nahi diya gaya tha. Mujhe apni fikr hai, mujhe apni fikr hai. Behtar hoga tum Isa (AS) ke paas jao. Wo Isa ke paas aayenge aur kahenge: Aye Isa, tum Allah ke Rasool ho aur tumne jhoole mein logon se baat ki, tum Uska Kalima ho jise Usne Maryam par nazil kiya, aur tum Uski taraf se Rooh ho; is liye humaare liye apne Rab se shafaa'at karo. Kya tum nahi dekhte ki hum kis museebat mein hain? Kya tum nahi dekhte ki humpar kya afat aa padi hai? Isa (AS) kahenge: Beshak, mera Rab aaj itna naaraaz hai jitna Wo kabhi nahi hua ya kabhi hoga bhi nahi. Unhone apna koi gunah zikr nahi kiya. Unhone bas itna kaha: Mujhe apni fikr hai, mujhe apni fikr hai; tum kisi aur ke paas jao: behtar hoga Muhammad (SAW) ke paas jao.

Wo mere paas aayenge aur kahenge: Aye Muhammad, tum Allah ke Rasool ho aur Rasoolon mein sabse aakhri. Allah ne tumhaare pehle aur baad ke sab gunah maaf kar diye hain. Humaare liye apne Rab se shafaa'at karo; kya tum nahi dekhte ki hum kis museebat mein hain? Kya tum nahi dekhte ki humpar kya afat aa padi hai? Main phir chal padunga aur Arsh ke neeche aaunga aur apne Rab ke saamne sajde mein gir jaaunga; phir Allah mujhpar wahi nazil karega aur mujhe Apni kuch aisi Tareefein aur Buzurgi ki baatein ilhaam karega jo Usne mujhse pehle kisi par zaahir nahi ki thi. Phir Wo kahega: Muhammad, apna sar uthaao; maango aur diya jaayega; shafaa'at karo aur shafaa'at qubool ki jaayegi. Phir main apna sar uthaaunga aur kahunga: Aye mere Rab, meri ummat, meri ummat. Kaha jaayega: Aye Muhammad, apni ummat ke un logon ko jinka koi hisaab nahi liya jaayega Jannat ke daayen darwaze se andar le jaao. Wo iske alaawa doosre darwaazon se bhi logon ke saath Jannat mein daakhil honge. Nabi (SAW) ne phir farmaya: Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein Muhammad ki jaan hai, beshak Jannat ke do darwaazon ke kivaadon ke darmiyaan itni doori hai jitni Makkah aur Hajar ke darmiyaan, ya jitni Makkah aur Busra ke darmiyaan.

e: It is reported on the authority of Abu Huraira that there was placed before the Messenger of Allah a cup of soft bread, soup and meat. He took part of the foreleg which he liked most. He sliced (with his teeth) a slice (out of that) and said: I would be the leader of mankind on the Day of Resurrection. He then sliced (that meat) for the second time and said: I am the leader of mankind on the Day of Resurrection. When he saw that his companions did not ask him (about this assertion) he said: Why don't you say: How would that be? They said: How would be it, Messenger of Allah? He said: People would stand before the Lord of the worlds. And the rest of the hadith was narrated like the one transmitted by Abu Hayyan, on the authority of Abu Zur'a, and in the story of Ibrahim, this addition was made. He said and made mention of his words with regard to the star: This is my Lord. And his words with regard to their gods: But the big among them has done that. And his words: I am ailing. He (the Holy Prophet) said: By Him in Whose Hand is the life of Muhammad, the distance between two leaves of the door from their supporting frames is as the distance between Mecca and Hajar or Hajar and Mecca. I do not remember how he said it (whether Mecca and Hajar or Hajar and Mecca).
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saamne narm roti, shorba aur gosht ka ek pyaala rakha gaya. Unhone agli taang ka hissa liya jo unhein sabse zyada pasand tha. Unhone apne daanton se usmein se ek tukda kaata aur kaha: Main Qayamat ke Din insaaniyat ka rehnuma hounga. Phir unhone us gosht ko doosri baar kaata aur kaha: Main Qayamat ke Din insaaniyat ka rehnuma hoon. Jab unhone dekha ki unke saathi unse is dawe ke baare mein nahi poochh rahe, to unhone kaha: Tum ye kyun nahi poochte: Ye kaise hoga? Unhone kaha: Ye kaise hoga, Ya Rasoolullah? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Log duniyaon ke Rab ke saamne khade honge. Aur baaki hadees waisi hi riwayat ki gayi jaisi Abu Hayyan ne Abu Zur'a ki sanad se riwayat ki, aur Ibrahim ke qisse mein, ye izafa kiya gaya. Unhone kaha aur sitaare ke baare mein unke alfaaz ka zikr kiya: Ye mera Rab hai. Aur unke maabudon ke baare mein unke alfaaz: Balki unmein se bade ne aisa kiya. Aur unke alfaaz: Main bimaar hoon. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein Muhammad ki jaan hai, do darwaaze ke kivaadon ke unke chaukhaton se doori itni hai jitni Makkah aur Hajar ke darmiyaan ya Hajar aur Makkah ke darmiyaan. Mujhe yaad nahi ki unhone ye kaise kaha.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira and Hudhaifa that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, would gather people. The believers would stand till the Paradise would be brought near them. They would come to Adam and say: O our father, open for us the Paradise. He would say: What turned ye out from the Paradise was the sin of your father Adam. I am not in a position to do that; better go to my son Ibrahim, the Friend of Allah. He (the Holy Prophet) said: He (Ibrahim) would say: I am not in a position to do that. Verily I had been the Friend (of Allah) from beyond, beyond; you better approach Moses (peace be upon him) with whom Allah conversed. They would come to Moses (peace be upon him), but he would say: I am not in a position to do that; you better go to Jesus, the Word of Allah and His Spirit. Jesus (peace be upon him) would say: I am not in a position to do that. So they would come to Muhammad (ﷺ). He would then be permitted (to open the door of Paradise). Trustworthiness and kinship would be despatched, and these would stand on the right and left of the Path and the first of you would pass with (the swiftness) of lightning. He (the narrator) said: I said, O thou who art far dearer to me than my father and my mother I which thing is like the passing of lightning? He said: Have you not seen lightning, how it passes and then comes back within the twinkling of an eye? Then (they would pass) like the passing of the wind, then like the passing of a bird, and the hastening of persons would be according to their deeds, and your Apostle would be standing on the Path saying: Save, O my Lord, save. (The people would go on passing) till the deeds of the servants would be failing in strength, till a man would come who would find it hard to go along (that Path) but crawlingly.
