He (the narrator) said: And on the sides of the Path hooks would be suspended ready to catch anyone whom these would be required (to catch). There would be those who would somehow or other succeed in trasversing that Path and some would be piled up in Hell. By Him in Whose Hand is the life of Abu Huraira it would take one seventy years to fathom the depth of Hell.
hi: Abu Huraira aur Hudhaifa se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Allah, Mubarak aur Buland, logon ko jama karega. Momineen khade rahenge yahan tak ki Jannat unke qareeb laayi jaayegi. Wo Aadam ke paas aayenge aur kahenge: Aye humaare waalid, humaare liye Jannat kholo. Wo kahenge: Jis cheez ne tumhein Jannat se nikaala wo tumhaare waalid Aadam ka gunah tha. Main ye karne ki halat mein nahi hoon; behtar hoga mere bete Ibrahim, Allah ke Dost, ke paas jao. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Wo kahenge: Main ye karne ki halat mein nahi hoon. Beshak main door-door tak Allah ka Dost tha; behtar hoga tum Musa (AS) ke paas jao jinse Allah ne baat ki. Wo Musa (AS) ke paas aayenge, lekin wo kahenge: Main ye karne ki halat mein nahi hoon; behtar hoga tum Isa, Allah ke Kalime aur Uski Rooh ke paas jao. Isa (AS) kahenge: Main ye karne ki halat mein nahi hoon. Is liye wo Muhammad (SAW) ke paas aayenge. Phir unhein Jannat ka darwaza kholne ki ijaazat di jaayegi. Amaanatdaari aur rishtedaari ko bheja jaayega, aur wo Raste ke daayin aur baayin taraf khade honge, aur tum mein se pehla shaks bijli ki raftaar ki tarah guzrega. Unhone kaha: Maine kaha, Aye Wo Jo mujhe mere maa-baap se zyada aziz hain! kaunsi cheez bijli ke guzarne jaisi hoti hai? Unhone kaha: Kya tumne bijli nahi dekhi, kaise wo guzarti hai aur phir palak jhapakte hi wapas aa jaati hai? Phir wo log guzrenge hawa ke guzarne ki tarah, phir parinde ke guzarne ki tarah, aur logon ki tezi unke amal ke mutaabiq hogi, aur tumhaare Rasool Raste par khade hokar kahenge: Bacha, Aye mere Rab, bacha. Log guzarte rahenge yahan tak ki bandon ke amal kamzor padne lagenge, yahan tak ki ek shaks aayega jiske liye wahan se rengte hue guzarna hi mumkin hoga. Unhone kaha: Aur Raste ke kinaaron par ankude latakte honge, jo taiyaar honge kisi ko bhi pakadne ke liye jise unhein pakadne ki zaroorat ho. Kuch log kisi tarah is Raste ko paar karne mein kaamyaab ho jaayenge aur kuch Jahannam mein dher ho jaayenge. Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein Abu Huraira ki jaan hai, Jahannam ki gehraayi tak pahunchne mein sattar (70) saal lag jaayenge.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: I would be the first among people to intercede in the Paradise and amongst the apostles I would have the largest following (on the Day of Resurrection).
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bataaya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Main logon mein sabse pehla hounga jo Jannat mein shafaa'at karega aur Rasoolon mein mera sabse zyada peirokaar hoga.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Amongst the apostles I would have the largest following on the Day of Resurrec tion, and I would be the first to knock at the door of Paradise.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bataaya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Rasoolon mein Qayamat ke Din mera sabse zyada peirokaar hoga, aur main sabse pehla hounga jo Jannat ke darwaze par dastak dega.

e: Anas b. Malik said: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) said: I would be the first intercessor in the Paradise and no apostle amongst the apostles has been testified (by such a large number of people) as I have been testified. And verily there woald be an apostle among the apostles who would be testified to by only one man from his people.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Main Jannat mein sabse pehla shafaa'at karne waala hounga, aur Rasoolon mein se kisi bhi Rasool ko itni badi tadaad mein logon ne sach nahi maana jitna mujhe maana gaya hai. Aur beshak Rasoolon mein se ek Rasool aisa hoga jinhein unki qaum mein se sirf ek shaks ne sach maana hoga.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: I will come to the gate of Paradise on the Day of Resurrection. and would seek its opening. and the keeper would say: Who art thou? I would say: Muhammad. He would then say: It is for thee that I have been ordered, and not to open it for anyone before thee.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bataaya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Main Qayamat ke Din Jannat ke darwaze par aaunga, aur ise kholne ki darkhwaast karunga, aur nigehbaan poochega: Tum kaun ho? Main kahunga: Muhammad. Wo phir kahega: Mujhe tumhaare liye hi hukum diya gaya tha, aur tumse pehle kisi ke liye ise na kholne ka.

e: Abu Huraira reported: Verity the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: There is for every apostle a (special) prayer with which he would pray. I wish I could reserve, my prayer for intercession of my Ummah on the Day of Resurrection.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Beshak Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Har Rasool ke liye ek khaas dua hai jiske saath wo dua karega. Kaash main apni dua Qayamat ke Din apni Ummat ki shafaa'at ke liye mahfooz rakh sakoon.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: There is for every apostle a prayer, and I intend (if Allah so willed) that I would reserve my prayer for the intercession of my Ummah on the Day of Resurrection.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Har Rasool ke liye ek dua hai, aur main iraada rakhta hoon, Allah chaahe to, ki main apni dua Qayamat ke Din apni Ummat ki shafaa'at ke liye mahfooz rakhunga.

e: 'Amr b. Abu Sufyan transmitted a hadith like this from Abu Huraira who narrated it from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).
hi: Amr bin Abu Sufyan ne isi tarah ki hadees Abu Huraira se riwayat ki jinhone ise Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat kiya.

e: Amr b. Abu Sufyan reported: Abu Huraira said to Ka'b al-Ahbar that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had said: For every apostle there Is a (special) prayer by which he would pray (to his Lord). I, however, intend (if Allah so willed) that I would reserve my prayer for the intercession of my Ummah on the Day of Resurrection. Ka'b said to Abu Huraira: Did you hear this from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)? Abu Huraira said: Yes.
hi: Amr bin Abu Sufyan ne bataaya: Abu Huraira ne Ka'b al-Ahbar se kaha ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya tha: Har Rasool ke liye ek khaas dua hai jiske saath wo apne Rab se dua karega. Main, phir bhi, iraada rakhta hoon, Allah chaahe to, ki main apni dua Qayamat ke Din apni Ummat ki shafaa'at ke liye mahfooz rakhunga. Ka'b ne Abu Huraira se kaha: Kya aap ne ye Rasoolullah (SAW) se suna? Abu Huraira ne kaha: Haan.

e: Abu Huraira said: The Prophet of Allah (ﷺ) said: There is for every apostle a prayer which is granted, but every prophet showed haste in his prayer. I have, however, reserved my prayer for the intercession of my Ummah on the Day of Resurrection, and it would be granted, if Allah so willed, in case of everyone amongst my Ummah provided he dies without associating anything with Allah.
hi: Abu Huraira ne kaha: Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Har Rasool ke liye ek dua hai jo qubool ki jaati hai, lekin har Nabi ne apni dua mein jaldbaazi dikhaayi. Maine, phir bhi, apni dua Qayamat ke Din apni Ummat ki shafaa'at ke liye mahfooz rakhi hai, aur ye, Allah chaahe to, meri Ummat mein se har us shaks ke haq mein qubool hogi jo Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek kiye bagair mare.

e: Abu Huraira said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Every Messenger is endowed with a prayer which is granted and by which he would (pray to his Lord) and it would he granted for him. I have, however, reserved my prayer for the intercession of my Ummab on the Day of Resurrection.
hi: Abu Huraira ne kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Har Rasool ko ek dua di gayi hai jo qubool ki jaati hai aur jiske zariye wo apne Rab se dua karega aur wo uske liye qubool ki jaayegi. Main, phir bhi, apni dua Qayamat ke Din apni Ummat ki shafaa'at ke liye mahfooz rakhi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: There was for every apostle a prayer with which he prayed for his Ummah and it was granted to him; but I wish, if Allah so wills, to defer my prayer for the intercession of my Ummah on the Day of Resurrection.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Har Rasool ke liye ek dua thi jiske saath usne apni Ummat ke liye dua ki aur wo unke liye qubool ki gayi; lekin main chaahta hoon, Allah chaahe to, ki main apni dua Qayamat ke Din apni Ummat ki shafaa'at ke liye taal doon.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: Verily the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: There is for every apostle a prayer with which he prays (to Allah) for his Ummah. I have reserved my prayer for the intercession of my Ummah on the Day of Resurrection.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bataaya: Beshak Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Har Rasool ke liye ek dua hai jiske saath wo apni Ummat ke liye Allah se dua karta hai. Maine apni dua Qayamat ke Din apni Ummat ki shafaa'at ke liye mahfooz rakhi hai.

e: This hadith is narrated with the same chain of narrators by Qatada.
hi: Ye hadees Qatada ne usi sanad se riwayat ki hai.

e: Mis'ar transmitted it with the same chain of narrators from Qatada except that in the hadith narrated by Waki' (the Prophet) said: " He was endowed," and in the hadith reported by Abu Usama (the words are):" It is reported from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)."
hi: Mis'ar ne ise Qatada se usi sanad se riwayat ki hai, sivaay iske ki Waki ki riwayat ki gayi hadees mein Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: 'Unhein di gayi thi,' aur Abu Usama ki riwayat ki gayi hadees mein alfaaz hain: 'Ye Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki gayi hai.'

e: Muhammad b. 'Abd al-A'la reported it to me: Mu'tamir narrated to us on the authority of his father who transmitted it liom Anas that verity the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, and then narrated the hadith like the one transmitted by Qatada on the authority of Anas.
hi: Muhammad bin Abdul-A'la ne mujhe ye bataayi: Mu'tamir ne humein apne waalid ki sanad se bataayi jinhone ise Anas se riwayat kiya ki beshak Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya, aur phir hadees Qatada ki Anas se riwayat ki gayi hadees jaisi bayan ki.

e: Abu Zubair heard Jabir b. Abdullah reporting it from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): For every apostle was a prayer with which he prayed (to his Lord) for his Ummah, but I have reserved my prayer for the intercession of my Ummah on the Day of Resurrection.
hi: Abu Zubair ne Jabir bin Abdullah ko Rasoolullah (SAW) se ye riwayat karte suna: Har Rasool ke liye ek dua thi jiske saath usne apni Ummat ke liye apne Rab se dua ki, lekin maine apni dua Qayamat ke Din apni Ummat ki shafaa'at ke liye mahfooz rakhi hai.

e: 'Abdullah b. Amr b. al-'As reported: Verily the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) recited the words of Allah, the Great and Glorious, that Ibrahim uttered. My Lord! lo! they have led many of mankind astray:" But whoso followeth me, he verily is of me" (al-Qur'an, xiv. 35) and Jesus (peace be upon him) said:" If thou punisheth them, lo! they are Thy slaves, and if Thou forgiveth them-verily Thou art the Mighty, the Wise" (al-Qur'an, v 117). Then he raised his hands and said: O Lord, my Ummah, my Ummah, and wept; so Allah the High and the Exalted said: O Gabriel, go to Muhammad (though your Lord knows it fully well) and ask him: What makes thee weep? So Gabriel (peace be upon him) came to him and asked him, and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) informed him what he had said (though Allah knew it fully well). Upon this Allah said: O Gabriel, go to Muhammad and say: Verily We will please thee with regard to your Ummah and would not displease thee.
hi: Abdullah bin Amr bin al-Aas ne bataaya: Beshak Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Allah, Buland aur Baa-Azmat, ke wo alfaaz tilaawat kiye jo Ibrahim ne kahe the: 'Mere Rab! Beshak inhone bahut se logon ko gumrah kar diya hai: lekin jo mera peirokaar bane, wo mujhse hai' (14:35) aur Isa (AS) ne kaha: 'Agar Tu inhein saza de, to beshak wo Tere bande hain, aur agar Tu inhein maaf kar de - to beshak Tu Zabardast, Hikmat Waala hai' (5:118). Phir aap (SAW) ne apne haath uthaaye aur kaha: Aye Rab, meri Ummat, meri Ummat, aur rone lage; is liye Allah, Buland aur Baa-Azmat, ne kaha: Aye Jibrael, Muhammad ke paas jao, halaanki tumhaara Rab ye poori tarah jaanta hai, aur unse poocho: Tumhein kis cheez ne rulaaya? Is liye Jibrael (AS) unke paas aaye aur unse poocha, aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unhein bataaya ki unhone kya kaha tha, halaanki Allah ye poori tarah jaanta tha. Is par Allah ne kaha: Aye Jibrael, Muhammad ke paas jao aur kaho: Beshak Hum tumhein tumhaari Ummat ke maamle mein khush kar denge aur tumhein naaraaz nahi karenge.

e: Anas reported: Verily, a person said: Messenger of Allah, where is my father? He said: (He) is in the Fire. When he turned away, he (the Holy Prophet) called him and said: Verily my father and your father are in the Fire.
hi: Anas ne bataaya: Beshak ek shaks ne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, mere waalid kahan hain? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Wo Aag mein hain. Jab wo shaks mudkar jaane laga, to aap (SAW) ne use bulaaya aur kaha: Beshak mere waalid aur tumhaare waalid Aag mein hain.

e: Abu Huraira reported: When this verse was revealed:" And warn thy nearest kindred (al-Qur'an, xxvi. 214), the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) called the Quraish; so they gathered and he gave them a general warning. Then he made a particular (reference to certain tribes) and said: O sons of Ka'b b. Luwayy, rescue yourselves from the Fire; O sons of Murra b. Ka'b, rescue yourselves from the Fire: O sons of Abd Shams, rescue yourselves from the Fire; 0 sons of Abd Manaf rescue yourselves from the Fire; O sons of Hashim, rescue yourselves from the Fire; 0 sons of Abd al-Muttalib, rescue yourselves from the Fire; O Fatimah, rescue thyself from the Fire, for I have no power (to protect you) from Allah in anything except this that I would sustain relationship with you.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Jab ye aayat nazil hui: 'Aur apne qareebi rishtedaaron ko khabardaar karo' (26:214), to Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Quraish ko bulaaya; is liye wo jama ho gaye aur aap (SAW) ne unhein aam khabardaari di. Phir aap (SAW) ne kuch khaas qabilon ka zikr kiya aur kaha: Aye Bani Ka'b bin Luwayy, apne aap ko Aag se bachaao; Aye Bani Murra bin Ka'b, apne aap ko Aag se bachaao; Aye Bani Abd Shams, apne aap ko Aag se bachaao; Aye Bani Abd Manaf, apne aap ko Aag se bachaao; Aye Bani Hashim, apne aap ko Aag se bachaao; Aye Bani Abdul-Muttalib, apne aap ko Aag se bachaao; Aye Fatima (Alayhas Salam), apne aap ko Aag se bachaao, kyunki mujhme Allah ke saamne tumhaare liye kisi cheez ki taaqat nahi hai sivaay iske ki main tumhaare saath rishtedaari ka taalluq banaaye rakhunga.

e: The same hadith is narrated by Ubaidallah b. Umar al-Qawariri from Abu 'Uwana, who transmitted it to 'Abd al-Malik b. 'Umair on the same chain of transmitter and the hadith of Jarir is more perfect and comprehensive.
hi: Ye hadees Ubaidullah bin Umar al-Qawariri ne Abu Uwana se riwayat ki, jinhone ise Abdul Malik bin Umair ko usi sanad se riwayat kiya, aur Jarir ki riwayat ki gayi hadees zyada mukammal aur vistaarit hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of 'A'isha that when this verse was revealed: " And warn thy nearest kindred," the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stood up on Safa' and said: O Fatima, daughter of Muhammad. O Safiya, daughter of 'Abd al-Muttalib, O sons of 'Abd al-Muttalib. I have nothing which can avail you against Allah; you may ask me what you want of my worldly belongings.
hi: Aisha se riwayat hai ki jab ye aayat nazil hui: 'Aur apne qareebi rishtedaaron ko khabardaar karo,' to Rasoolullah (SAW) Safa par khade hue aur kaha: Aye Fatima (Alayhas Salam), Muhammad ki beti. Aye Safiya, Abdul-Muttalib ki beti. Aye Bani Abdul-Muttalib. Mere paas aisa kuch nahi jo Allah ke saamne tumhaare kaam aa sake; tum mujhse mere duniyaawi maal mein se jo chaaho maang sakte ho.

e: Abu Huraira reported: When (this verse) was revealed to him:" Warn your nearest kinsmen." the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: O people of Quraish, buy yourselves from Allah, I cannot avail you at all against Allah; O sons of Abd al-Muttalib. I cannot avail you at all against Allah; 0 Abbas b. 'Abd al- Muttalib, I cannot avail you at all against Allah; O Safiya (aunt of the Messenger of Allah), I cannot avail you at all against Allah; 0 Fatima, daughter of Muhammad, ask me whatever you like, but I cannot avail you at all against Allah.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Jab ye aayat unpar nazil hui: 'Apne qareebi rishtedaaron ko khabardaar karo,' to Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Aye Quraish ke logo, khud ko Allah se khareed lo, main Allah ke saamne tumhaare liye kuch nahi kar sakta; Aye Bani Abdul-Muttalib, main Allah ke saamne tumhaare liye kuch nahi kar sakta; Aye Abbas bin Abdul-Muttalib, main Allah ke saamne tumhaare liye kuch nahi kar sakta; Aye Safiya, main Allah ke saamne tumhaare liye kuch nahi kar sakta; Aye Fatima (Alayhas Salam), Muhammad ki beti, mujhse jo chaaho maango, lekin main Allah ke saamne tumhaare liye kuch nahi kar sakta.

e: This hadith is narrated from the Apostle (ﷺ) by another chain of narrators, 'Amr al-Naqid, Mu'awiya b. 'Amr, Abdullah b. Dhakwan, A'raj on the authority of Abu Huraira.
hi: Ye hadees Rasool (SAW) se ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai: Amr an-Naqid, Mu'awiya bin Amr, Abdullah bin Dhakwan, A'raj ki sanad se, Abu Huraira ki riwayat se.

e: Qabisa b. al-Mukhariq and Zuhair b. 'Amr reported: When this verse was revealed:" And warn thy nearest kindred," the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) set off towards a rock of the hill and ascended the highest of the rocks and then called: 0 sons of 'Abd Manaf! I am a warner; my similitude and your similitude is like a man who saw the enemy and went to guard his people, but, being afraid they might get there before him, he shouted: Be on your guard!
hi: Qabisa bin al-Mukhariq aur Zuhair bin Amr ne bataaya: Jab ye aayat nazil hui: 'Aur apne qareebi rishtedaaron ko khabardaar karo,' to Rasoolullah (SAW) pahaad ki ek chattaan ki taraf chal pade aur sabse oonchi chattaan par chadh gaye aur phir pukaara: Aye Bani Abd Manaf! Main khabardaar karne wala hoon; meri aur tumhaari misaal us shaks jaisi hai jisne dushman dekha aur apni qaum ko bachaane ke liye gaya, lekin ye dar tha ki wo dushman usse pehle wahan pahunch jaayenge, is liye usne chillaakar kaha: Khabardaar raho!

e: This hadith is narrated from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) by another chain of narrators, Muhammad b. Abd al-A'la, Mu'tamir, Abu 'Uthman, Zuhair b. 'Amr, Qabisa b. Mukhariq.
hi: Ye hadees Rasoolullah (SAW) se ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai: Muhammad bin Abdul-A'la, Mu'tamir, Abu Uthman, Zuhair bin Amr, Qabisa bin Mukhariq ki sanad se.

e: It is reported on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that when this verse was revealed: " And warn thy nearest kindred" (and thy group of selected people among them) the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) set off till he climbed Safa' and called loudly: Be on your guard! They said: Who is it calling aloud? They said: Muhammad. They gathered round him, and he said: O sons of so and so, O sons of so and so, O sons of 'Abd Manaf, O sons of 'Abd al-Muttalib, and they gathered around him. He (the Apostle) said: If I were to inform you that there were horsemen emerging out of the foot of this mountain, would you believe me? They said: We have not experienced any lie from you. He said: Well, I am a warner to you before a severe torment. He (the narrator) said that Abu Lahab then said: Destruction to you! Is it for this you have gathered us? He (the Holy Prophet) then stood up, and this verse was revealed:" Perish the hands of Abu Lahab, and he indeed perished" (cxi. 1). A'mash recited this to the end of the Sura.
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ki jab ye aayat nazil hui: 'Aur apne qareebi rishtedaaron ko khabardaar karo,' to Rasoolullah (SAW) chal pade yahan tak ki Safa par chadh gaye aur zor se pukaara: Khabardaar raho! Unhone kaha: Ye zor se pukaarne wala kaun hai? Unhone kaha: Muhammad. Wo unke ird-gird jama ho gaye, aur aap (SAW) ne kaha: Aye falaan ke bete, Aye falaan ke bete, Aye Bani Abd Manaf, Aye Bani Abdul-Muttalib, aur wo unke ird-gird jama ho gaye. Aap (SAW) ne kaha: Agar main tumhein bataaun ki is pahaad ke daaman se ghudsawaar nikal rahe hain, to kya tum mera yaqeen karoge? Unhone kaha: Humne aapse kabhi jhoot nahi suna. Aap (SAW) ne kaha: Achha, main tumhein ek sakht azaab se pehle khabardaar karne wala hoon. Unhone kaha ki phir Abu Lahab ne kaha: Tumhaari tabaahi ho! Kya is liye tumne humein jama kiya? Phir aap (SAW) khade ho gaye, aur ye aayat nazil hui: 'Abu Lahab ke haath tabaah hon, aur wo waaqai tabaah ho gaya' (111:1). A'mash ne ise poori Surah ke aakhir tak tilaawat kiya.

e: This hadith was narrated by A'mash on the authority of the same chain of narrators and he said: One day the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) climbed the hill of Safa' and said: Be on your guard, and the rest of the hadith was narrated like the hadith transmitted by Usama; he made no mention of the revelation of the verse:" Warn thy nearest kindred."
hi: Ye hadees A'mash ne usi sanad se riwayat ki hai aur unhone kaha: Ek din Rasoolullah (SAW) Safa pahaad par chadhe aur kaha: Khabardaar raho, aur baaki hadees waisi hi bayan ki gayi jaisi Usama ki riwayat ki gayi hai; unhone 'apne qareebi rishtedaaron ko khabardaar karo' aayat ke nazil hone ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: It is reported on the authority of 'Abbas b. Abd al-Muttalib that he said: Messenger of Allah, have you benefited Abu Talib in any way for he defended you and was fervent in your defence? The Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) said: Yes; he would be in the most shallow part of the Fire and were not for me, he would have been in the bottom-most depth of Hell.
hi: Abbas bin Abdul-Muttalib ne kaha: Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, kya aap ne Abu Talib ko kisi tarah faayda pahunchaaya hai, kyunki unhone aapki hifazat ki aur aapke difaa mein josh dikhaaya? Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Haan; wo Aag ke sabse chhichhle hisse mein honge, aur agar main na hota, to wo Jahannam ki sabse gehri gehraayi mein hote.

e: Abdullah b. al-Harith reported: I heard Abbas say: I said: Messenger of Allah, verily Abu Talib defended you and helped you; would it be beneficial for him? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Yes; I found him in the lowest part of the Fire and I brought him to the shallow part.
hi: Abdullah bin al-Harith ne bataaya: Maine Abbas ko ye kehte suna: Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, beshak Abu Talib ne aapki hifazat ki aur aapki madad ki; kya ye unke liye faaydemand hoga? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Haan; maine unhein Aag ke sabse neeche hisse mein paaya aur main unhein chhichhle hisse mein le aaya.

e: This hadith is narrated from the Apostle (ﷺ) like one narrated by Abu 'Uwana on the authority of the chain of transmitters like Muhammad b. Hatim, Yahya b. Sa'id, Abu Sufyan, 'Abbas b. 'Abd al-Muttalib and others.
hi: Ye hadees Rasool (SAW) se, Abu Uwana ki riwayat ki gayi hadees jaisi, ek aur sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai: Muhammad bin Hatim, Yahya bin Sa'id, Abu Sufyan, Abbas bin Abdul-Muttalib aur doosron ki sanad se.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported: A mention was made of his uncle Abu Talib before the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) He said: My intercession may benefit him on the Day of Resurrection and he may be placed in the shallow part of the Fire which would reach his ankles and his brain would be boiling.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne bataaya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saamne unke chacha Abu Talib ka zikr kiya gaya. Aap (SAW) ne kaha: Meri shafaa'at Qayamat ke Din unhein faayda pahuncha sakti hai aur unhein Aag ke aise chhichhle hisse mein rakha jaa sakta hai jo unke takhno tak pahunche aur jismein unka dimaag ubalta rahe.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported: Verily, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The least tormented of the inhabitants of the Fire would be he who would wear two shoes of Fire and his brain would boil on account of the heat of the shoes.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne bataaya: Beshak Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jahannam ke rehne walon mein sabse kam azaab paane waala wo hoga jo Aag ki do jootiyaan pehnega aur jinki garmi se uska dimaag ubalta rahega.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: Among the inhabitants of the Fire Abu Talib would have the least suffering, and he would be wearing two shoes (of Fire) which would boil his brain.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bataaya: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Jahannam ke rehne walon mein Abu Talib ka azaab sabse kam hoga, aur wo Aag ki do jootiyaan pehne honge jinse unka dimaag ubalta rahega.

e: Nu'man b. Bashir was delivering an address and saying: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: the least suffering for the inhabitants of Hell on the Day of Resurrection would be for the man under whose soles would be placed two embers and his brain would boil on account of them.
hi: Nu'man bin Bashir khutba de rahe the aur keh rahe the: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Qayamat ke Din Jahannam ke rehne walon ke liye sabse kam azaab us shaks ke liye hoga jiske talwon ke neeche do angaare rakhe jaayenge aur unse uska dimaag ubalta rahega.

e: Nu'man b. Bashir reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Verily the least suffering for the inhabitants of Fire would be for him who would have two shoes and two laces of Fire (on his feet), and with these would boil his brain as boils the cooking vessel, and he would think that he would not see anyone in a more grievous torment than him, whereas he would be in the least torment.
hi: Nu'man bin Bashir ne bataaya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Beshak Jahannam ke rehne walon mein sabse kam azaab us shaks ke liye hoga jiske paaon mein Aag ki do jootiyaan aur do fite honge, aur inse uska dimaag aise ubalega jaise khaana pakane ka bartan ubalta hai, aur wo sochega ki usse zyada takleefdeh azaab mein aur koi nahi hoga, jabki wo sabse kam azaab mein hoga.

e: 'A'isha reported: I said: Messenger of Allah, the son of Jud'an established ties of relationship, fed the poor. Would that be of any avail to him? He said: It would be of no avail to him as he did not ever say: O my Lord, pardon my sins on the Day of Resurrection.
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, Ibn Jud'an ne rishtedaari ka lihaaz rakha, gareebon ko khaana khilaaya. Kya iska use koi faayda hoga? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Iska use koi faayda nahi hoga kyunki usne kabhi ye nahi kaha: Aye mere Rab, Qayamat ke Din mere gunah maaf kar de.

e: 'Amr b. 'As reported: I heard it from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) quite audibly and not secretly: Behold! the posterity of my fathers, that is, so and so, are not my friends. Verily Allah and the pious believers are my friends.
hi: Amr bin al-As ne bataaya: Maine ye Rasoolullah (SAW) se bilkul saaf aur khuli tarah suna, chhupa kar nahi: Sun lo! Mere baap-daada ki aulaad, yaani falaan-falaan, mere dost nahi hain. Beshak Allah aur nek momineen hi mere dost hain.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Seventy thousand (persons) of my Ummah would enter Paradise without rendering an account. Upon this a person said: Messenger of Allah. pray to Allah that He make me one of them. He (the Holy Prophet) said: O Allah! make him one of them. Then another stood up and said: Messenger of Allah, pray to Allah that He make me one of them. He (the Holy Prophet) said: 'Ukkasha has preceded you in this matter.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Meri Ummat mein se sattar hazaar (70,000) log bagair kisi hisaab ke Jannat mein daakhil honge. Is par ek shaks ne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, Allah se dua kijiye ki Wo mujhe unmein se ek banaaye. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Aye Allah, use unmein se ek banaa de. Phir ek aur shaks khada hua aur kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, Allah se dua kijiye ki Wo mujhe unmein se ek banaaye. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Ukkasha is maamle mein tumse aage nikal gaye.

e: Muhammad b. Ziyad reported: I heard Abu Huraira narrate this: I heard it from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying a hadith like one narrated by al-Rabi'.
hi: Muhammad bin Ziyad ne bataaya: Maine Abu Huraira ko ye riwayat karte suna: Maine ye Rasoolullah (SAW) se suna, al-Rabi ki riwayat ki gayi hadees jaisi.

e: Abu Huraira reported: I heard it from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: A group of my Ummah consisting of seventy thousand persons would enter Paradise; their faces would be as bright as the brightness of the full moon. Abd Huraira said: 'Ukkasha b. Mihsan al-Asadi then stood up wrapping the blanket around him and said: Messenger of Allah, supplicate (before) Allah that He should make me one among them. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: O Allah, make him among them. Then stood up a man from the Ansa and said: Messenger of Allah, pray to Allah that He should make me one among them. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Ukkasha has preceded you in this matter.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Maine ye Rasoolullah (SAW) se suna, unhone farmaya: Meri Ummat ka ek giroh, sattar hazaar (70,000) logon par mushtamil, Jannat mein daakhil hoga; unke chehre poore chaand ki chamak jaise roshan honge. Abu Huraira ne kaha: Ukkasha bin Mihsan al-Asadi phir apni chaadar lapete khade hue aur kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, Allah se dua kijiye ki Wo mujhe unmein se ek banaaye. Is par Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Aye Allah, use unmein se ek banaa de. Phir Ansaar mein se ek shaks khada hua aur kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, Allah se dua kijiye ki Wo mujhe unmein se ek banaaye. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Ukkasha is maamle mein tumse aage nikal gaye.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Seventy thousand (persons) would enter Paradise as one group and among them (there would be people) whom faces would be bright like the moon.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Sattar hazaar (70,000) log ek giroh ke soorat mein Jannat mein daakhil honge aur unmein aise log bhi honge jinke chehre chaand ki tarah roshan honge.

e: It is reported on the authority of 'Imran that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Seventy thousand people of my Ummah would be admitted into Paradise without rendering any account. They (the companions) said: Who would be of those (fortunate persons)? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Those who do not cauterise and practise charm, but repose trust in their Lord, 'Ukkasha then stood up and said: Supplicate (before) Allah that He should make me one among them. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Thou art one among them He (the narrator) said: A man stood up and said: Apostle of Allah, supplicate (before) Allah that He should make me one among them. He (the Prophet said: 'Ukkasha has preceded you (in this matter).
hi: Imran se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Meri Ummat ke sattar hazaar (70,000) log bagair kisi hisaab ke Jannat mein daakhil kiye jaayenge. Unhone kaha: Wo kaun honge? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Wo jo na daagh lagaate hain na jhaad-phoonk karwaate hain, balki apne Rab par bharosa rakhte hain. Ukkasha phir khade hue aur kaha: Dua kijiye ki Wo mujhe unmein se ek banaaye. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Tum unmein se ek ho. Unhone kaha: Ek shaks khada hua aur kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, Allah se dua kijiye ki Wo mujhe unmein se ek banaaye. Aap (SAW) ne kaha: Ukkasha is maamle mein tumse aage nikal gaye.

e: 'Imran b. Husain reported: Verily the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Seventy thousand men of my Ummah would enter Paradise without rendering account. They (the companions of the Holy Prophet) said: Who would be those, Messenger of Allah? He (the Holy Prophet) said: They would be those who neither practise charm, not take omens, nor do they cauterise, but they repose their trust in their Lord.
hi: Imran bin Husain ne bataaya: Beshak Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Meri Ummat ke sattar hazaar (70,000) log bagair kisi hisaab ke Jannat mein daakhil honge. Unhone kaha: Wo kaun honge, Ya Rasoolullah? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Wo honge jo na jhaad-phoonk karwaate hain, na shaguni lete hain, na daagh lagaate hain, balki apne Rab par bharosa rakhte hain.

e: Abu Hazim narrated it on the authority of Ibn Sa'd that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Seventy thousand persons or seven hundred thousand persons (Abu Hazim does not remember the exact number) would enter Paradise holding and supporting one another, and the first among them would not enter till the last among them would enter (therein) ; (they would enter simultaneously) and their faces would be bright like the full moon.
hi: Abu Hazim ne ise Ibn Sa'd ki sanad se riwayat kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Sattar hazaar (70,000) log ya saat lakh (700,000) log (Abu Hazim ko sahi tadaad yaad nahi) ek doosre ko thaamte aur sahaara dete hue Jannat mein daakhil honge, aur unmein se pehla tab tak daakhil nahi hoga jab tak aakhri wala daakhil na ho jaaye; aur unke chehre poore chaand ki tarah roshan honge.

e: Husain b. 'Abd al-Rahman reported: I was with Sa'id b. Jubair when he said: Who amongst you saw a star shooting last night? I said: It was I; then I said: I was in fact not (busy) in prayer, but was stung by a scorpion (and that is the reason why I was awake and had a glimpse of the shooting star). He said: Then what did you do? I said: I practised charm. He said: What urged you to do this? I said: (I did this according to the implied suggestion) of the hadith which al-Shu'ba narrated. He said: What did al-Shu'ba narrate to you? I said: Buraida b. Husaib al-Aslami narrated to us. The charm is of no avail except in case of the (evil influence) of an eye or the sting of a scorpion. He said: He who acted according to what he had heard (from the Holy Prophet) acted rightly, but Ibn 'Abbas narrated to us from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that he said: There were brought before me the peoples and I saw an apostle and a small group (of his followers) along with him, another (apostle) and one or two persons (along with him) and (still another) apostle having no one with him. When a very large group was brought to me I conceived as if it were my Ummah. Then it was said to me: It is Moses and his people. You should look at the horizon, and I saw a very huge group. It was again said to me: See the other side of the horizon, and there was (also) a very huge group. It was said to me: This is your Ummah, and amongst them there were seventy thousand persons who would be made to enter Paradise without rendering any account and without (suffering) any torment. He then stood up and went to his house. Then the people began to talk about the people who would be admitted to Paradise without rendering any account and without (suffering) any torment. Some of them said: They may be those who (have had the good fortune of living) in the company of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and some of them said: They be those who were born in Islam and did not associate anything with Allah. Some people mentioned other things. Thereupon came forth the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) before them and he said: What was that which you were talking about? They informed him. He said: They are those persons who neither practise charm, nor ask others to practise it, nor do they take omens, and repose their trust in their Lord. Upon this 'Ukkasha b. Mihsan stood up and said: Supplicate for me that He should make me one among them. Upon this he (Messenger of Allah) said: Thou are one among them. Then another man stood up and said: Supplicate before Allah that He should make me one among them. Upon this he said: 'Ukkisha has preceded you.
hi: Husain bin Abdur Rahman ne bataaya: Main Sa'id bin Jubair ke saath tha jab unhone poocha: Tum mein se kisne kal raat toota hua taara dekha? Maine kaha: Maine dekha; phir maine kaha: Main haqeeqat mein namaz mein masroof nahi tha, balki mujhe bicchoo ne kaata tha aur is liye main jaag raha tha aur toote hue taare ko dekh liya. Unhone kaha: Phir tumne kya kiya? Maine kaha: Maine jhaad-phoonk karwaayi. Unhone kaha: Iske liye tumhein kis cheez ne ubhaara? Maine kaha: Maine ye us hadees ke mutaabiq kiya jo Shu'ba ne riwayat ki thi. Unhone kaha: Shu'ba ne tumhein kya riwayat ki? Maine kaha: Buraida bin Husaib al-Aslami ne humein riwayat ki: Jhaad-phoonk sirf nazar ya bicchoo ke daank ke maamle mein faaydemand hai. Unhone kaha: Jisne jo suna uske mutaabiq amal kiya, usne theek kiya, lekin Ibn Abbas ne humein Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Mere saamne qaumein laayi gayin aur maine ek Rasool ko unke saath ek chhota sa giroh dekha, doosre Rasool ko unke saath ek ya do log dekhe, aur ek aur Rasool ko unke saath koi nahi. Jab mujhe ek bahut bada giroh dikhaaya gaya, to mujhe laga ki ye meri Ummat hai. Phir mujhse kaha gaya: Ye Musa aur unki qaum hai. Tumhein ufuq ki taraf dekhna chahiye, aur maine ek bahut bada giroh dekha. Mujhse phir kaha gaya: Ufuq ki doosri taraf dekho, aur wahan bhi ek bahut bada giroh tha. Mujhse kaha gaya: Ye tumhaari Ummat hai, aur unmein se sattar hazaar (70,000) log bagair kisi hisaab ke aur bagair kisi azaab ke Jannat mein daakhil kiye jaayenge. Phir aap khade hue aur apne ghar chale gaye. Phir log un logon ke baare mein baat karne lage jo bagair kisi hisaab ke aur bagair kisi azaab ke Jannat mein daakhil kiye jaayenge. Unmein se kuch ne kaha: Shaayad wo log hon jo Rasoolullah (SAW) ki sohbat mein rahe, aur kuch ne kaha: Shaayad wo log hon jo Islam mein paida hue aur Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek nahi kiya. Kuch logon ne aur baatein zikr kin. Is par Rasoolullah (SAW) unke saamne aaye aur farmaya: Tum log kis baare mein baat kar rahe the? Unhone unhein bataaya. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Wo log hain jo na jhaad-phoonk karwaate hain, na doosron se jhaad-phoonk karwaane ko kehte hain, na shaguni lete hain, aur apne Rab par bharosa rakhte hain. Is par Ukkasha bin Mihsan khade hue aur kaha: Mere liye dua kijiye ki Wo mujhe unmein se ek banaaye. Is par aap ne farmaya: Tum unmein se ek ho. Phir ek aur shaks khada hua aur kaha: Allah ke saamne dua kijiye ki Wo mujhe unmein se ek banaaye. Is par aap (SAW) ne kaha: Ukkasha tumse aage nikal gaye.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Peoples would be presented to me (on the Day of Resurrection), and then the remaining part of the hadith was narrated like the one transmitted by Hushaim, but he made no mention of the first portion.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bataaya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Mere saamne qaumein pesh ki jaayengi, aur phir baaki hadees waisi hi riwayat ki gayi jaisi Hushaim ki riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin unhone pehle hisse ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: Abdullah b. Mas'ud reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) addressing us said: Aren't you pleased that you should constitute one-fourth of the inhabitants of Paradise? He (the narrator) said: We glorified (our Lord, i. e. we called aloud Allah-o Akbar, Allah is the Greatest). He, then, again said: Aren't you pleased that you should constitute one-third of the inhabitants of Paradise? He (the narrator) said: We glorified (our Lord) and he (the Holy Prophet) then again said: I hope that you would constitute half of the inhabitants of Paradise and I shall explain to you its (reason). The believers among the unbelievers would not be more than a white hair on (the body of a) black ox or a black hair on (the body of a) white ox.
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ood ne bataaya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne humse mukhaatib hokar farmaya: Kya tumhein khushi nahi hogi ki tum Jannat ke rehne walon ka chauthaai hissa bano? Unhone kaha: Humne Allahu Akbar kehte hue apne Rab ki tasbeeh ki. Aap (SAW) ne phir kaha: Kya tumhein khushi nahi hogi ki tum Jannat ke rehne walon ka tihaayi hissa bano? Unhone kaha: Humne tasbeeh ki, aur aap (SAW) ne phir kaha: Mujhe ummeed hai ki tum Jannat ke rehne walon ka aadha hissa banoge aur main tumhein iski wajah samjhaunga. Kaafiron mein se momineen kaale bael par safed baal ya safed bael par kaale baal se zyada nahi honge.

e: 'Abdullah (b. Mas'ud) reported: We, about forty men, were with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in a camp when he said: Aren't you pleased that they should constitute one-fourth of the inhabitants of Paradise? He (the narrator) said: Yes. He (the Holy Prophet) again said: Aren't you pleased that you should constitute one-third of the inhabitants of Paradise? They said: Yes. Upon this he again said: By Him in Whose Hand is my life, I hope that you would constitute one-half of the inhabitants of Paradise and the reason is that no one would be admitted into Paradise but a believer and you are no more among the polytheists than as a white hair on the skin of a black ox or a black hair on the skin of a red ox.
hi: Abdullah (bin Mas'ood) ne bataaya: Hum, takreeban chaalis (40) log, Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath ek khaimebandi mein the jab aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Kya tumhein khushi nahi hogi ki wo Jannat ke rehne walon ka chauthaai hissa banein? Unhone kaha: Haan. Aap (SAW) ne phir kaha: Kya tumhein khushi nahi hogi ki tum Jannat ke rehne walon ka tihaayi hissa banoge? Unhone kaha: Haan. Is par aap (SAW) ne phir kaha: Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, mujhe ummeed hai ki tum Jannat ke rehne walon ka aadha hissa banoge, aur iski wajah ye hai ki Jannat mein sirf momin hi daakhil kiya jaayega aur tum mushrikeen ke muqaable mein kaale bael ki khaal par safed baal ya laal bael ki khaal par kaale baal se zyada nahi ho.

e: Abdullah b Mas'ud reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) addressed us and then supported his back (by reclining) against a leather tent and said: Behold, no one but a believing person would enter Paradise. O Allah, (see) have I conveyed (it not)? 0 Allah, be witness (to it that I have conveyed it). (Then addressing the companions) he said: Don't you like that you should constitute one-fourth of the inhabitants of Paradise? We said: Yes, Messenger of Allah. He again said: Don't you like that you should constitute one-third of the inhabitants of Paradise? They said: Yes, Messenger of Allah. He said: I hope that you would constitute one- half of the inhabitants of Paradise and you would be among the peoples of the world, like a black hair on (the body of) a white ox or like a white hair on the body of a black ox.
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ood ne bataaya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne humse khitaab kiya aur phir apni peeth ek chamde ke tambu ke sahaare tekiya lagaayi aur farmaya: Sun lo, koi bhi Jannat mein daakhil nahi hoga sivaay momin shaks ke. Aye Allah, kya maine ye pahuncha diya? Aye Allah, gawah reh ki maine ye pahuncha diya. Phir Sahaba se mukhaatib hokar aap (SAW) ne kaha: Kya tumhein pasand nahi ki tum Jannat ke rehne walon ka chauthaai hissa bano? Humne kaha: Haan, Ya Rasoolullah. Aap (SAW) ne phir kaha: Kya tumhein pasand nahi ki tum Jannat ke rehne walon ka tihaayi hissa bano? Unhone kaha: Haan, Ya Rasoolullah. Aap (SAW) ne kaha: Mujhe ummeed hai ki tum Jannat ke rehne walon ka aadha hissa banoge aur tum duniya waalon mein aise hoge jaise safed bael par kaala baal ya kaale bael par safed baal.

e: Abu Sa'id reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Allah, the High and Glorious, would say: O Adam I and he would say: At Thy service, at thy beck and call, O Lord, and the good is in Thy Hand. Allah would say: Bring forth the group of (the denizens of) Fire. He (Adam) would say: Who are the denizens of Hell? It would be said: They are out of every thousand nine hundred and ninety-nine. He (the Holy Prophet) said: It is at this juncture that every child would become white-haired and every pregnant woman would abort and you would see people in a state of intoxication, and they would not be in fact intoxicated but grievous will be the torment of Allah. He (the narrator) said: This had a very depressing effect upon them (upon the companions of the Holy Prophet) and they said: Messenger of Allah, who amongst us would be (that unfortunate) person (who would be doomed to Hell)? He said: Good tidings for you, Yajuj Majuj would be those thousands (who would be the denizens of Hell) and a person (selected for Paradise) would be amongst you. He (the narrator) further reported that he (the Messenger of Allah) again said: By Him in Whose Hand is thy life, I hope that you would constitute one-fourth of the inhabitants of Paradise. We extolled Allah and we glorified (Him). He (the Holy Prophet) again said: BY Him in Whose Hand is my life, I wish you would constitute one-third of the inhabitants of Paradise. We extolled Allah and Glorified (Him). He (the Holy Prophet) again said: By Him in Whose Hand is my life, I hope that you would constitute half of the inhabitants of Paradise. Your likeness among the people is the likeness of a white hair on the skin of a black ox or a strip on the foreleg of an ass.
hi: Abu Sa'id ne bataaya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Allah, Buland aur Baa-Azmat, kahega: Aye Aadam! Aur wo kahenge: Main haazir hoon, Teri khidmat mein, Aye Rab, aur bhalaai Tere haath mein hai. Allah kahega: Aag ke jaane waalon ke giroh ko nikaal la. Wo kahenge: Jahannam ke rehne wale kaun hain? Kaha jaayega: Har hazaar mein se nau sau ninyaanve (999). Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Isi waqt har bachcha budha ho jaayega aur har hamila aurat ka hamal gir jaayega aur tum logon ko nashe ki halat mein dekhoge, jabki wo haqeeqat mein nashe mein nahi honge balki Allah ka azaab hi bahut sakht hoga. Unhone kaha: Iska Sahaba par bahut gehra asar hua aur unhone kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, hum se kaun hoga? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Tumhaare liye khushkhabri ho, Yajuj Majuj un hazaaron mein se honge aur ek shaks tum mein se hoga. Unhone aage bataaya ki aap (SAW) ne phir kaha: Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein teri jaan hai, mujhe ummeed hai ki tum Jannat ke rehne walon ka chauthaai hissa banoge. Humne Allah ki tareef aur tasbeeh ki. Aap (SAW) ne phir kaha: Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, mujhe ummeed hai ki tum Jannat ke rehne walon ka tihaayi hissa banoge. Humne Allah ki tareef aur tasbeeh ki. Aap (SAW) ne phir kaha: Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, mujhe ummeed hai ki tum Jannat ke rehne walon ka aadha hissa banoge. Tumhaari misaal logon mein aisi hai jaise kaale bael ki khaal par safed baal ya gadhe ke agle pair par ek dhaari.

e: The same hadith has been narrated from A'mash on the authority of the same chain of transmitters with the exception of these words: You would be no more among men (on the Day of Resurrection) but like a white hair on (the body of) a black ox, or like a black hair on (the body of) a white ox, and he made no mention of: a strip on the foreleg of an ass.
hi: Ye hadees A'mash se usi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, sivaay in alfaaz ke: Tum log logon mein aise nahi honge sivaay safed baal jaise kaale bael par, ya kaale baal jaise safed bael par, aur unhone gadhe ke agle pair ki dhaari ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: Abu Malik at-Ash'ari reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Cleanliness is half of faith and al-Hamdu Lillah (all praise and gratitude is for Allah alone) fills the scale, and Subhan Allah (Glory be to Allah) and al-Hamdu Lillah fill up what is between the heavens and the earth, and prayer is a light, and charity is proof (of one's faith) and endurance is a brightness and the Holy Qur'an is a proof on your behalf or against you. All men go out early in the morning and sell themselves, thereby setting themselves free or destroying themselves.
hi: Abu Malik al-Ash'ari ne bataaya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Safaayi imaan ka aadha hissa hai aur Al-Hamdu Lillah (tamaam tareef aur shukr Allah ke liye hai) tarazu ko bhar deta hai, aur Subhan Allah (Allah paak hai) aur Al-Hamdu Lillah aasman aur zameen ke darmiyaan ki jagah ko bhar dete hain, aur namaz ek noor hai, aur sadqa imaan ka saboot hai aur sabr ek chamak hai aur Quran-e-Kareem tumhaare haq mein ya tumhaare khilaaf ek daleel hai. Har insaan subah jald uthta hai aur khud ko bechta hai, isse ya to khud ko aazaad kar leta hai ya khud ko barbaad kar deta hai.

e:
It was narrated from Simak bin Harb, that Mus'ab bin Sa'd said: '" 'Abdullah bin 'Umar came to visit Ibn 'Amir when he was sick and he said: 'Won't you supplicate to Allah for me, O Ibn 'Umar ?' He said: 'I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: "No Salat is accepted without Wudu' (purification), and no charity (is accepted) that comes from Ghulul  " and you were the governor of Al-Basrah.' "

 Goods pilfered from the spoils of war prior to their authorized distribution.
hi: Simak bin Harb se riwayat hai ki Mus'ab bin Sa'd ne bataaya: Abdullah bin Umar Ibn Aamir ko dekhne gaye jab wo bimaar the aur unhone kaha: Kya aap mere liye Allah se dua nahi karenge, Aye Ibn Umar? Unhone kaha: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Bagair Wuzu ke koi namaz qubool nahi hoti, aur Ghulul se aayi hui koi sadqa qubool nahi hoti - aur aap Basra ke Hukmuran the.

e: A hadith like this is narrated from the Apostle (ﷺ) with the same chain of transmitters by Muhammad b. Muthanna, Ibn Bashshar, Muhammad b. Ja'far, Shu'ba.
hi: Ye hadees Rasool (SAW) se usi sanad ke saath Muhammad bin Muthanna, Ibn Bashshar, Muhammad bin Ja'far, Shu'ba ne bhi riwayat ki hai.

e: Hammam b. Munabbih who is the brother of Wahb b. Munabbih said: This is what has been transmitted to us by Abu Huraira from Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and then narrated a hadith out of them and observed that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The prayer of none amongst you would be accepted in a state of impurity until he performs ablution.
hi: Hammam bin Munabbih, jo Wahb bin Munabbih ke bhai hain, ne bataaya: Ye wo hai jo humein Abu Huraira ne Muhammad, Rasoolullah (SAW), se riwayat ki, aur phir unmein se ek hadees bayan ki aur kaha ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Tum mein se kisi ki bhi namaz na-paaki ki halat mein qubool nahi hoti jab tak wo wuzu na kare.

e: Humran, the freed slave of 'Uthman, said: Uthman b. 'Affan called for ablution water and this is how he performed the ablution. He washed his hands thrice. He then rinsed his mouth and cleaned his nose with water (three times). He then washed his face three times, then washed his right arm up to the elbow three times, then washed his left arm like that, then wiped his head; then washed his right foot up to the ankle three times, then washed his left foot like that, and then said: I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) perform ablution like this ablution of mine. Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: He who performs ablution like this ablution of mine and then stood up (for prayer) and offered two rak'ahs of prayer without allowing his thoughts to be distracted, all his previous sins are expiated. Ibn Shihab said: Our scholars remarked: This is the most complete of the ablutions performed for prayer.
hi: Humran, Uthman ke aazaad kiye gulaam, ne bataaya: Uthman bin Affan ne wuzu ka paani mangwaaya aur isi tarah unhone wuzu kiya. Unhone apne haath teen baar dhoye. Phir unhone kulli ki aur paani se apni naak saaf ki, teen baar. Phir unhone apna chehra teen baar dhoya, phir apni daayin baazu kohni tak teen baar dhoyi, phir isi tarah apni baayin baazu dhoyi, phir apna sar masah kiya; phir apna daayaan paanv takhne tak teen baar dhoya, phir isi tarah apna baayaan paanv dhoya, aur phir kaha: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko isi tarah wuzu karte dekha jaisa maine abhi kiya. Phir Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jisne mere is wuzu jaisa wuzu kiya aur phir namaz ke liye khada hua aur do rak'aat namaz padhi bagair apne zehen ko bhatakne diye, uske pichhle sab gunah maaf ho jaate hain. Ibn Shihab ne kaha: Humaare ulama kaha karte the: Ye namaz ke liye kiya gaya sabse mukammal wuzu hai.

e: Humran, the freed slave of 'Uthman said: I saw Uthman call for a vessel (of water) and poured water over his hands three times and then washed them. Then he put his right hand in the vessel and rinsed his mouth and cleaned his nose. Then he washed his face three times and his hands up to the elbow three times; then wiped his head, then washed his feet three times. Then he said that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had said: He who performed ablution like this ablution of mine and offered two raka`ahs of prayer without allowing his thoughts to be distracted, all his previous sins would be expiated.
hi: Humran, Uthman ke aazaad kiye gulaam, ne bataaya: Maine Uthman ko ek bartan mangwaate dekha aur unhone apne haathon par teen baar paani daala aur phir unhein dhoya. Phir unhone apna daayaan haath bartan mein daala aur kulli ki aur naak saaf ki. Phir unhone apna chehra teen baar dhoya aur apni baazuein kohni tak teen baar; phir sar masah kiya, phir apne paanv teen baar dhoye. Phir unhone kaha ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya tha: Jisne mere is wuzu jaisa wuzu kiya aur do rakaat namaz padhi bagair apne zehen ko bhatakne diye, uske pichhle sab gunah maaf kar diye jaayenge.

e: Humran. the freed slave of 'Uthman. said: I heard from 'Uthman b. 'Affan and he was in the courtyard of the mosque, when the Mu'adhdhin (announcer of the prayer) came to him at the time of afternoon prayer. So the ('Uthman) called for the ablution water and performed ablution and then said: By Allah, I am narrating to you a hadith. If there were not a verse in the Book of Allah, I would have never narrated it to you. I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say: If a Muslim performs ablution and does it well and offers prayer, all his (sins) daring the period from one prayer to another would be pardoned by Allah.
hi: Humran, Uthman ke aazaad kiye gulaam, ne bataaya: Maine Uthman bin Affan se suna, aur wo masjid ke aangan mein the, jab Mu'azzin unke paas asr ki namaz ke waqt aaye. Is liye Uthman ne wuzu ka paani mangwaaya aur wuzu kiya aur phir kaha: Allah ki qasam, main tumhein ek hadees sunaa raha hoon. Agar Allah ki Kitab mein ek aayat na hoti, to main tumhein kabhi ye na sunaata. Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Agar koi Musalman wuzu kare aur use achhi tarah kare aur namaz padhe, to uske sab gunah ek namaz aur doosri namaz ke darmiyaan ke waqt ke liye Allah ki taraf se maaf kar diye jaate hain.

e: This hadith is also narrated on the authority with the same chain of transmitters and in the hadith of Abu Usama the words are: " He who performed the ablution well and then offered the obligatory prayer."
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai aur Abu Usama ki riwayat ki gayi hadees mein alfaaz hain: 'Jisne achhi tarah wuzu kiya aur phir farz namaz padhi.'

e: Humran reported when 'Uthman performed ablution he said: By Allah, I am narrating to you a hadith had there not been this verse in the Book of Allah. I would not have narrated it to you. Verily I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: Not a person is there who performed ablution, and did it well, then offered prayer, but his sins (which he committed) were not pardoned between the prayer that he offered and the next one. 'Urwa said: The verse is this:" Those who suppress the clear proofs and the guidance which We have sent down"... to His words:" the Cursers" (ii. 15).
hi: Humran ne bataaya ki jab Uthman ne wuzu kiya to unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, main tumhein ek hadees sunaa raha hoon agar Allah ki Kitab mein ye aayat na hoti, to main tumhein ye na sunaata. Beshak maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Koi bhi shaks aisa nahi jisne wuzu kiya, aur use achhi tarah kiya, phir namaz padhi, jiske gunah us namaz aur agli namaz ke darmiyaan maaf na kiye gaye hon. Urwah ne kaha: Wo aayat ye hai: 'Jo log un saaf saboot aur hidaayat ko chhupaate hain jo humne nazil ki hai'... 'laanat karne walon tak' (2:15).

e: 'Amr b Sa'id b al-As reported: I was with Uthman, and he called for ablution water and said: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say: When the time for a prescribed prayer comes, if any Muslim performs ablution well and offers his prayer with humility and bowing, it will be an expiation for his past sins, so long as he has not committed a major sin; and this applies for all times.
hi: Amr bin Sa'id bin al-As ne bataaya: Main Uthman ke saath tha, aur unhone wuzu ka paani mangwaaya aur kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab kisi farz namaz ka waqt aaye, agar koi Musalman achhi tarah wuzu kare aur khushu aur ruku ke saath apni namaz ada kare, to ye uske pichhle gunahon ke liye kaffaara hoga, jab tak usne koi bada gunah na kiya ho; aur ye har waqt ke liye laagu hota hai.

e: Humran, the freed slave of 'Uthman reported: I brought for Uthman b. 'Affan the ablution water. He performed ablution and then said: Verily the people narrate from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) a hadith. I do not know what these are. but (I know this fact) that I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) perform ablution like this ablution of mine and then he said: He who performed ablution like this, all his previous sins would be expiated and his prayer and going towards the mosque would have an extra reward. In the tradition narrated by Ibn 'Abda (the words are):" I came to Uthman and he performed ablution."
hi: Humran, Uthman ke aazaad kiye gulaam, ne bataaya: Main Uthman bin Affan ke liye wuzu ka paani laaya. Unhone wuzu kiya aur phir kaha: Beshak log Rasoolullah (SAW) se ek hadees riwayat karte hain. Mujhe nahi pata ye kya hain, lekin mujhe itna pata hai ki maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko isi tarah wuzu karte dekha jaisa maine abhi kiya, aur phir unhone kaha: Jisne isi tarah wuzu kiya, uske pichhle sab gunah maaf ho jaayenge aur uski namaz aur masjid ki taraf jaana ek izaafi ajr rakhega. Ibn Abda ki riwayat ki gayi hadees mein alfaaz hain: 'Main Uthman ke paas aaya aur unhone wuzu kiya.'

e: Abu Anas reported that Uthman performed ablution at Maqi'aid and said: Should I not show you the ablution performed by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? And he then washed (the different parts of the body) three times. 4" Qutaiba has added in his narration the words:" There were with him (with Uthman) Companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)."
hi: Abu Anas ne bataaya ki Uthman ne Maqai'd mein wuzu kiya aur kaha: Kya main tumhein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka kiya hua wuzu na dikhaaun? Aur phir unhone jism ke alag-alag hisson ko teen baar dhoya. Qutaiba ne apni riwayat mein ye alfaaz izafa kiye: Unke saath Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke Sahaba maujood the.

e: Humran b. Aban reported: I used to fetch water for 'Uthman for his purification. Never was there a day that he did not take a bath with a small quantity of water. And Uthman said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) at the time of our returning from our prayer told us (certain things pertaining to purification). Mis'ar said: I find that it was afternoon prayer. He said: I do not know whether I should tell you a thing or keep quiet. We said: Messenger of Allah, tell us if it is good and if it is otherwise, Allah and His Apostle know better. Upon this he said: A Muslim who purifies (himself) and completes purification as enjoined upon him by Allah and then offers the prayers, that will be expiation (of his sins he committed) between these (prayers).
hi: Humran bin Aban ne bataaya: Main Uthman ke liye unki tahaarat ke waaste paani laaya karta tha. Aisa koi din nahi tha jab unhone thode se paani se nahaaya na ho. Aur Uthman ne kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne jab hum namaz se wapas aa rahe the tab humein tahaarat se mutaalliq kuch baatein bataayin. Mis'ar ne kaha: Mujhe lagta hai ki ye asr ki namaz thi. Unhone kaha: Mujhe nahi pata ki main tumhein ye baat bataaun ya khaamosh rahoon. Humne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, humein bataiye agar ye achhi baat hai, aur agar aisa nahi hai, to Allah aur Uske Rasool behtar jaante hain. Is par aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Jo Musalman apni safaayi kare aur use isi tarah mukammal kare jaisa Allah ne use hukum diya hai, aur phir namaz padhe, to ye uske gunahon ka un namazon ke darmiyaan kaffaara ban jaayega.

e: Jami' b. Shaddad reported: I heard Humran b. Aban narrate to Abu Burda in this very mosque during the governorship of Bishr that 'Uthman b. Alfan said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed: He who completed ablution as Allah, the Exalted, enjoined upon him, his obligatory prayers would be explatious (for his minor sins that he would commit) during (the interval) between them. This hadith is transmitted by Ibn Mu'adh, and in the hadith narrated by Ghundar, the words" during the governorship of Bishr" are omitted and there is no mention of the obligatory prayers.
hi: Jami bin Shaddad ne bataaya: Maine Humran bin Aban ko isi masjid mein Bishr ke daur-e-hukumat mein Abu Burda se ye riwayat karte suna ki Uthman bin Affan ne kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jisne wuzu ko usi tarah mukammal kiya jaisa Allah, Buland-o-Baala, ne use hukum diya, uski farz namazein un namazon ke darmiyaan chhote gunahon ke liye kaffaara ban jaayengi. Ye hadees Ibn Mu'adh ne riwayat ki hai, aur Ghundar ki riwayat ki gayi hadees mein 'Bishr ke daur-e-hukumat mein' ke alfaaz chhod diye gaye hain aur farz namazon ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: Humran, the freed slave of Uthman reported: One day Uthman b. Affan performed the ablution well, and then said: I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) perform ablution, the best ablution, and then observed: He who performed ablution like this and then went towards the mosque and nothing (but the love of) prayer urged him (to do so), all his previous (minor) sins would be expiated.
hi: Humran, Uthman ke aazaad kiye gulaam, ne bataaya: Ek din Uthman bin Affan ne achhi tarah wuzu kiya, aur phir kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko wuzu karte dekha, behtareen wuzu, aur phir farmaya: Jisne isi tarah wuzu kiya aur phir masjid ki taraf gaya aur namaz ke muhabbat ke siwa kisi cheez ne use aisa karne par majboor nahi kiya, uske pichhle chhote gunah maaf ho jaayenge.

e: Humran, the freed slave of 'Uthman b. 'Affan, reported on the authority of 'Uthman b. 'Affan that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say: He who performed ablution for prayer and performed it properly and then went (to observe) obligatory prayer and offered it along with people or with the congregation or in the mosque, Allah would pardon his sins.
hi: Humran, Uthman bin Affan ke aazaad kiye gulaam, ne Uthman bin Affan ki sanad se riwayat ki ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jisne namaz ke liye wuzu kiya aur use theek se kiya aur phir farz namaz ke liye gaya aur use logon ke saath ya jamaat mein ya masjid mein ada kiya, Allah uske gunah maaf kar dega.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Five prayers and from one Friday prayer to (the next) Friday prayer is an expiation (of the sins committed in between their intervals) if major sins are not committed.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Paanch namazein aur ek Jumme se doosre Jumme tak ka waqt kaffaara hai, agar bade gunah na kiye gaye hon.

e: Abu Huraira reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The five (daily) prayers and one Friday prayer to (the next) Friday prayer are expiations (for the sins committed in the intervals) between them.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Paanch roz ki namazein aur ek Jumme se agle Jumme tak ka waqt unke darmiyaan kiye gaye gunahon ke liye kaffaara hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: Verily the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The five (daily) prayers and from one Friday prayer to the (next) Friday prayer, and from Ramadhan to Ramadhan are expiations for the (sins) committed in between (their intervals) provided one shuns the major sins.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Beshak Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Paanch roz ki namazein aur ek Jumme se agle Jumme tak, aur ek Ramzan se agle Ramzan tak, unke darmiyaan kiye gaye gunahon ke liye kaffaara hain, bashart ye ki insaan bade gunahon se bacha rahe.

e: 'Uqba b. 'Amir reported: We were entrusted with the task of tending the camels. On my turn when I came back in the evening after grazing them in the pastures, I found Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stand and address the people. I heard these words of his: If any Muslim performs ablution well, then stands and prays two rak'ahs setting about them with his heart as well as his face, Paradise would be guaranteed to him. I said: What a fine thing is this! And a narrator who was before me said: The first was better than even this. When I cast a glance, I saw that it was 'Umar who said: I see that you have just come and observed: If anyone amongst you performs the ablution, and then completes the ablution well and then says: I testify that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the servant of Allah and His Messenger, the eight gates of Paradise would be opened for him and he may enter by whichever of them he wishes.
hi: Uqba bin Aamir ne bataaya: Humein oonton ki dekhbhaal ki zimmedaari di gayi thi. Meri baari mein jab main unhein charaakar shaam ko wapas aaya, to maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko khade hokar logon se khitaab karte paaya. Maine unhein ye kehte suna: Agar koi Musalman achhi tarah wuzu kare, phir khada hokar do rak'aat namaz padhe apne dil aur apne chehre ke saath poori tawajjo se, to uske liye Jannat ki zamaanat di jaayegi. Maine kaha: Ye kitni achhi baat hai! Aur mere se pehle ek raawi ne kaha: Pehli baat isse bhi behtar thi. Jab maine nazar daali, to maine dekha ki wo Umar the jinhone kaha: Main dekh raha hoon ki tum abhi aaye ho aur aap ne kaha: Agar tum mein se koi wuzu kare, aur phir wuzu ko achhi tarah mukammal kare aur phir kahe: Main gawahi deta hoon ki Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi aur Muhammad Allah ke bande aur Uske Rasool hain, to Jannat ke aath darwaze uske liye khol diye jaayenge aur wo jis darwaze se chaahe daakhil ho sakta hai.

e: Uqba b. 'Amir al-Juhani reported: Verily the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said and then narrated (the hadith) like one (mentioned above) except (this) that he said: He who performed ablution and said: I testify that there is no god but Allah, the One, there is no associate with Him and I testify that Muhammad is His servant and His Messenger.
hi: Uqba bin Aamir al-Juhani ne bataaya: Beshak Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha aur phir upar bayan ki gayi hadees jaisi hi riwayat ki, sivaay iske ki unhone kaha: Jisne wuzu kiya aur kaha: Main gawahi deta hoon ki Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, Wo akela hai, Uska koi shareek nahi, aur main gawahi deta hoon ki Muhammad Uske bande aur Uske Rasool hain.

e: 'Abdullah b. Zaid b. 'Asim al-Ansari, who was a Companion (of the Holy Prophet), reported: It was said to him (by people): Perform for us the ablution (as it was performed) by the Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him). He ('Abdullah b. Zaid) called for a vessel (of water), and poured water from it on his hands and washed them three times. Then he inserted his hand (in the vessel) and brought it (water) out, rinsed his mouth and snuffed up water from the palm of one hand doing that three times, He again inserted his hand and brought it out and washed his face three times, then inserted his hand and brought it out and washed each arm up to the elbow twice, then inserted his hand and brought it out and wiped his head both front and back with his hands. He then washed his feet up to the ankles, and then said: This is how God's Messenger (peace be upon him) performed ablution.
hi: Abdullah bin Zaid bin Aasim al-Ansari, jo Sahaba mein se the, ne bataaya: Unse logon ne kaha: Humein Rasoolullah (SAW) ka kiya hua wuzu dikhaaiye. Abdullah bin Zaid ne ek bartan mangwaaya, aur usmein se apne haathon par paani daala aur unhein teen baar dhoya. Phir unhone apna haath bartan mein daala aur nikaala, kulli ki aur ek haath ki hatheli se naak mein paani cheencha, ise teen baar kiya. Unhone dobara haath daala aur nikaala aur apna chehra teen baar dhoya, phir haath daala aur nikaala aur har baazu kohni tak do baar dhoyi, phir haath daala aur nikaala aur apna sar apne haathon se aage aur peeche masah kiya. Phir unhone apne paanv takhno tak dhoye, aur phir kaha: Isi tarah Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne wuzu kiya tha.

e: This hadith is narrated by Amr b. Yahya with the same chain of transmitters, but there is no mention of ankles.
hi: Ye hadees Amr bin Yahya ne usi sanad se riwayat ki hai, lekin ismein takhno ka zikr nahi hai.

e: Malik b. Anas narrated it from 'Amr b. Yahya with the same chain of transmitters, transmitters and mentioned the rinsing (of mouth) and snuffing (of water into the nostrils) three times, but he did not mention" from one palm," and made this addition: He moved them (his hands) for wiping to the front of his head and then the nape of his neck, then bringing them back till he reached the place from which he had begun, after which he washed his feet.
hi: Malik bin Anas ne ise Amr bin Yahya se usi sanad se riwayat ki aur teen baar kulli aur naak mein paani daalne ka zikr kiya, lekin unhone 'ek hatheli se' ka zikr nahi kiya, aur ye izafa kiya: Unhone masah karne ke liye apne haath sar ke aage tak le gaye aur phir gardan ke peeche tak, phir unhein wapas laaye yahan tak ki wo wahin pahunche jahan se unhone shuru kiya tha, jiske baad unhone apne paanv dhoye.

e: Babz reported: This hadith has been narrated by Wuwb on the authority of 'Amr b. Yahyi with the same chain of transmitters and it has been mentioned therein: He rinsed his mouth. snuffed up water in nostrils and cleaned the nose with three handfuls and wiped his head moving (his hand) in front and then back once. Bahz said: Wuhaib narrated this hadith to me and Wuhaib said: Amr b. Yahya narrated to me this hadith twice.
hi: Bahz ne bataaya: Ye hadees Wuhaib ne Amr bin Yahya se usi sanad se riwayat ki hai aur ismein zikr hua hai: Unhone kulli ki, naak mein paani daala aur teen mutthi paani se naak saaf ki aur apna sar aage aur phir peeche ek baar le jaate hue masah kiya. Bahz ne kaha: Wuhaib ne mujhe ye hadees sunaayi aur Wuhaib ne kaha: Amr bin Yahya ne mujhe ye hadees do baar sunaayi.

e: 'Abdullah b. Zaid b. 'Asim al-Mazini reported: He saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) perform the ablution. He rinsed his mouth then cleaned his nose, then washed his face three times, then washed his right hand thrice and then the other one, thrice. He then took fresh water and wiped his head and then washed his feet till he cleaned them.
hi: Abdullah bin Zaid bin Aasim al-Mazini ne bataaya: Unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko wuzu karte dekha. Unhone kulli ki phir naak saaf ki, phir apna chehra teen baar dhoya, phir apna daayaan haath teen baar dhoya aur phir doosra, teen baar. Phir unhone taaza paani liya aur apna sar masah kiya aur phir apne paanv saaf hone tak dhoye.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: When anyone wipes himself with pebbles (after answering the call of nature) he must make use of an odd number and when any one of you performs ablution he must snuff in his nose water and then clean it.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab koi qaza-e-haajat ke baad kankariyon se safaayi kare, to use taaq tadaad istemaal karni chaahiye, aur jab tum mein se koi wuzu kare, to use apni naak mein paani cheenchna chahiye aur phir use saaf karna chahiye.

e: Hammam b. Munabbih reported: This is what Abu Huraira transmitted to us from Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and he mentioned a number of a hadith, of which this is one: that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When anyone amongst you (performs ablution) he must snuff his nostrils with water and then clean them.
hi: Hammam bin Munabbih ne bataaya: Ye wo hai jo Abu Huraira ne humein Muhammad, Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki, aur unhone kayi Ahadees ka zikr kiya, jinmein se ye ek hai: ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab tum mein se koi wuzu kare, to use apni naak mein paani cheenchna chahiye aur phir use saaf karna chahiye.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (way peace he upon him) said: When anyone performs ablution he must clean his nose and when anyone wipes himself with pebbles (after answering the call of nature) he must do that odd number of times.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab koi wuzu kare, to use apni naak saaf karni chaahiye aur jab koi kankariyon se safaayi kare, to use taaq tadaad mein aisa karna chaahiye.

e: It has been transmitted by Abu Huraira and Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (both of them the reputed Companions of the Holy Prophet) that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said like that.
hi: Ye Abu Huraira aur Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, dono maroof Sahaba, se riwayat ki gayi hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne isi tarah farmaya.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) said. When any one of you awakes up from sleep and performs ablution, he must clean his nose three times, for the devil spends the night in the interior of his nose.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab tum mein se koi neend se jaage aur wuzu kare, to use apni naak teen baar saaf karni chahiye, kyunki Shaitan raat uski naak ke andar guzaarta hai.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that he heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: When anyone wipes himself with pebbles (after answering the call of nature) he should do this odd number of times.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bataaya ki unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab koi kankariyon se safaayi kare, to use ye taaq tadaad mein karna chaahiye.

e: Salim, the freed slave of Shaddad, said: I came to 'A'isha, the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ), on the day when Sa'db. Abi Waqqas died. 'Abd al-Rahman b. Abu Bakr also came there and he performed ablution in her presence. She (Hadrat 'A'isha) said: Abd al-Rahman, complete the ablution as I heard the Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say: Woe to the heels because of hell-fire.
hi: Salim, Shaddad ke aazaad kiye gulaam, ne bataaya: Main Aisha ke paas gaya, jo Nabi (SAW) ki biwi thi, us din jab Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas ka intiqaal hua. Abdur Rahman bin Abu Bakr bhi wahan aaye aur unke saamne wuzu kiya. Unhone kaha: Abdur Rahman, wuzu poora karo, kyunki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Afsos hai un aediyon par jo sookhi rah jaayein, Jahannam ki aag ki wajah se.

e: Abdullah, the freed slave of Shahddad, came to 'A'isha and transmitted from her a hadith like this (which she narrated) from the Prophet (ﷺ).
hi: Abdullah, Shaddad ke aazaad kiye gulaam, Aisha ke paas aaye aur unse ye jaisi hi hadees riwayat ki jo unhone Nabi (SAW) se bayan ki thi.

e: Salim, the freed slave of Mahri, reported: I and 'Abd al-Rahman b. Abu Bakr went out (in order to join) the funeral procession of Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas and passed by the door of the residence of 'A'isha, and then he transmitted a hadith like this from her who (narrated it) from the Prophet (ﷺ).
hi: Salim, Mahri ke aazaad kiye gulaam, ne bataaya: Main aur Abdur Rahman bin Abu Bakr Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas ke janaaze mein shaamil hone ke liye nikle aur Aisha ke ghar ke darwaze se guzre, aur phir unhone unse ye jaisi hi hadees riwayat ki jo unhone Nabi (SAW) se bayan ki thi.

e: Salim, the freed slave of Shaddad b. al-Had said: I was in the presence of 'A'isha, and then narrated on her authority a hadith like this from the Prophet (way peace be upon him).
hi: Salim, Shaddad bin al-Had ke aazaad kiye gulaam, ne bataaya: Main Aisha ki hazri mein tha, aur phir unhone unki sanad se ye jaisi hi hadees riwayat ki jo Nabi (SAW) se aayi thi.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Amr reported: We returned from Mecca to Medina with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and when we came to some water on the way, some of the people were in a hurry at the time of the afternoon prayer and performed ablution hurriedly; and when we reached them, their heels were dry, no water had touched them. The Prophet (ﷺ) said: Woe to (dry) heels, because of Hell-fire. Make your ablution thorough.
hi: Abdullah bin Amr ne bataaya: Hum Makkah se Madina Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath wapas aa rahe the, aur jab hum raaste mein kisi paani ke paas pahunche, to kuch log asr ki namaz ke waqt jaldi mein the aur jaldbaazi mein wuzu kiya; aur jab hum unke paas pahunche, to unki aediyaan sookhi thi, unpar paani nahi laga tha. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Afsos hai sookhi aediyon par, Jahannam ki aag ki wajah se. Apna wuzu mukammal karo.

e: In the hadith transmitted by Shu'ba these words are not there: " Complete the Wudu," and there is the name of Abu Yahya al-A'raj (a narrator).
hi: Shu'ba ki riwayat ki gayi hadees mein 'Wuzu mukammal karo' alfaaz nahi hain, aur usmein Abu Yahya al-A'raj ka naam hai.

e: 'Abdullah b. Amr reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) lagged behind us on a journey. We travelled (back) and be took him; and then came the time of the afternoon prayer, and as we were going to wipe our feet he (the Holy Prophet) called out: Woe to the heels because of Hell-fire.
hi: Abdullah bin Amr ne bataaya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ek safar mein humse peeche reh gaye. Hum wapas aaye aur unhein le aaye; aur phir asr ki namaz ka waqt aaya, aur jab hum apne paanv masah karne wale the, to aap (SAW) ne pukaara: Afsos hai aediyon par, Jahannam ki aag ki wajah se.

e: Abu Huraira reported: Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) saw a man who did not wash his heel and he remarked: Woe to the heels because of hell-fire.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek shaks ko dekha jisne apni aedi nahi dhoyi thi aur unhone kaha: Afsos hai aediyon par, Jahannam ki aag ki wajah se.

e: Abu Huraira reported: He saw people perform ablution with the help of a water jar and he said: Complete the Wudu for i heard Abu al-Qasim (ﷺ) say: Woe to the hamstrings because of hell-fire.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Unhone logon ko ek paani ke ghade ki madad se wuzu karte dekha aur unhone kaha: Wuzu mukammal karo, kyunki maine Abu al-Qasim (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Afsos hai na-dhuli pindliyon par, Jahannam ki aag ki wajah se.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Woe to the heels because of hell-fire.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Afsos hai aediyon par, Jahannam ki aag ki wajah se.

e: Jabir reported: 'Umar b. Khattab said that a person performed ablution and left a small part equal to the space of a nail (unwashed). The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) saw that and said: Go back and perform ablution well. He then went back (performed ablution well) and offered the prayer.
hi: Jabir ne bataaya: Umar bin Khattab ne kaha ki ek shaks ne wuzu kiya aur naakhun jitni jagah chhod di, bina dhoye. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne ye dekha aur kaha: Wapas jaao aur achhi tarah wuzu karo. Wo phir wapas gaya aur achhi tarah wuzu kiya aur namaz ada ki.

e: Abu Huraira reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: When a bondsman-a Muslim or a believer-washes his face (in course of ablution), every sin he contemplated with his eyes, will be washed away from his face along with water, or with the last drop of water; when he washes his hands, every sin they wrought will be effaced from his hands with the water, or with the last drop of water; and when he washes his feet, every sin towards which his feet have walked will be washed away with the water or with the last drop of water with the result that he comes out pure from all sins.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab koi banda - Musalman ya momin - wuzu mein apna chehra dhota hai, to har wo gunah jo usne apni aankhon se socha, uske chehre se paani ke saath dhul jaata hai, ya paani ke aakhri katre ke saath; jab wo apne haath dhota hai, to har wo gunah jo unhone kiya, uske haathon se paani ke saath mit jaata hai, ya paani ke aakhri katre ke saath; aur jab wo apne paanv dhota hai, to har wo gunah jiski taraf uske paanv chale hain, paani ke saath, ya paani ke aakhri katre ke saath dhul jaata hai, jiske nateeje mein wo tamaam gunahon se paak hokar nikalta hai.

e: Uthman b. 'Affan reported: The Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him) said: He who performed ablution well, his sins would come out from his body, even coming out from under his nails.
hi: Uthman bin Affan ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Jisne achhi tarah wuzu kiya, uske gunah uske jism se, yahan tak ki uske naakhunon ke neeche se bhi, nikal jaayenge.

e: Nu'aim b. 'Abdullah al-Mujmir reported: I saw Abu Huraira perform ablution. He washed his face and washed it well. He then washed his right hand including a portion of his arm. He then washed his left hand including a portion of his arm. He then wiped his head. He then washed his right foot including his shank, and then washed his left foot including shank, and then said: This is how I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) perform his ablution.
