And (Abu Huraira) added that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had observed: You shall have your faces hands and feet bright on the Day of Resurrection because of your perfect ablution. He who can afford among you, let him increase the brightness of his forehead and that of hands and legs.
hi: Nu'aim bin Abdullah al-Mujmir ne bataaya: Maine Abu Huraira ko wuzu karte dekha. Unhone apna chehra dhoya aur ise achhi tarah dhoya. Phir unhone apna daayaan haath, baazu ka kuch hissa saamil karte hue, dhoya. Phir unhone apna baayaan haath, baazu ka kuch hissa saamil karte hue, dhoya. Phir unhone apna sar masah kiya. Phir unhone apna daayaan paanv, pindli saamil karte hue, dhoya, aur phir apna baayaan paanv, pindli saamil karte hue, dhoya, aur phir kaha: Isi tarah maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko unka wuzu karte dekha tha. Aur Abu Huraira ne izafa kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha tha: Tumhaare chehre, haath aur paanv Qayamat ke Din tumhaare mukammal wuzu ki wajah se chamak rahe honge. Jo tum mein se aisa kar sake, use apni peshaani ki chamak aur apne haathon aur paanvon ki chamak badhaani chahiye.

e: Nu'aim b. 'Abdallah reported: He saw Abu Huraira perform ablution. He washed his face and washed his hands up to the arms. He then washed his feet and reached up to the shanks and then said: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say: My people would come with bright faces and bright hands and feet on account of the marks of ablution, so he who can increase the lustre of his forehead (and that of his hands and legs) should do so.
hi: Nu'aim bin Abdullah ne bataaya: Unhone Abu Huraira ko wuzu karte dekha. Unhone apna chehra dhoya aur apne haath baazuon tak dhoye. Phir unhone apne paanv dhoye aur pindliyon tak pahunche aur phir kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Meri Ummat wuzu ke nishaanon ki wajah se roshan chehron, roshan haathon aur paanvon ke saath aayegi, is liye jo apni peshaani aur apne haathon aur paanvon ki chamak badha sake, use aisa karna chahiye.

e: Abu Huraira reported: Verily Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: My Cistern has its dimensions wider than the distance between Aila and Aden, and its water is whiter than ice and sweeter than the honey diluted with milk, and its cups are more numerous than the numbers of the stars. Verily I shall prevent the (faithless) people therefrom just as a man prevents the camels of the people from his fountain. They said: Messenger of Allah, will you recognise us on that day? He said: Yes, you will have distinctive marks which nobody among the peoples (except you) will have; you would come to me with blazing forehead and bright hands and feet on account of the traces of ablution.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Beshak Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Mera Hauz Aila aur Aden ke darmiyaan ki doori se bhi zyada chauda hai, aur uska paani barf se zyada safed aur doodh mile shahad se zyada meetha hai, aur uske pyaale sitaaron ki tadaad se bhi zyada hain. Beshak main bhatke hue logon ko usse aise rok doonga jaise koi shaks apne chashme se logon ke oonton ko rokta hai. Unhone kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, kya aap us din humein pehchaanenge? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Haan, tumhaare paas aise khaas nishaan honge jo tumhaare siwa kisi aur qaum ke logon ke paas nahi honge; tum mere paas chamakti hui peshaani aur roshan haath aur paanv ke saath aaoge, wuzu ke asaraat ki wajah se.

e: Abu Huraira reported the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: My people would come to me on the Cistern and I would drive away persons (from it) just as a person drives away other people's camels from his camels. They (the hearers) said: Apostle of Allah, would you recognize us? He replied: Yea, you would have a mark which other people will not have. You would come to me with a white blaze on your foreheads and white marks on your feet because of the traces of ablution. A group among you would be prevented from coming to me, and they would not meet me, and I would say: O my Lord, they are my companions. Upon this an angel would reply to me saying: Do you know what these people did after you.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Meri Ummat Hauz par mere paas aayegi aur main logon ko waise hataaunga jaise koi shaks doosron ke oont apne oonton se hatata hai. Unhone kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, kya aap humein pehchaanenge? Aap (SAW) ne jawaab diya: Haan, tumhaare paas ek aisa nishaan hoga jo doosre logon ke paas nahi hoga. Tum mere paas apni peshaaniyon par safed chamak aur apne paanvon par safed nishaanon ke saath aaoge, wuzu ke asaraat ki wajah se. Tum mein se ek giroh ko mere paas aane se roka jaayega, aur wo mujhse nahi milenge, aur main kahunga: Aye mere Rab, ye mere saathi hain. Is par ek Farishta mujhse jawaab dega: Kya aapko pata hai unhone aapke baad kya kiya.

e: Hudhaifa reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: My Cistern is bigger than the space between Aila and Aden. By Him in Whose Hand is my life, I will drive away persons (from it) just as a person drives away unknown camels from his cistern. They (the companions) said: Messenger of Allah, would you recognise us? He said: Yes, you would come to me with white faces, and white hands and feet on account of the traces of ablution. None but you would have (this mark).
hi: Hudhaifa ne bataaya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Mera Hauz Aila aur Aden ke darmiyaan ki jagah se bhi bada hai. Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, main logon ko waise hataaunga jaise koi shaks anjaan oonton ko apne hauz se hataata hai. Unhone kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, kya aap humein pehchaanenge? Aap (SAW) ne kaha: Haan, tum mere paas safed chehron, safed haathon aur paanvon ke saath aaoge, wuzu ke asaraat ki wajah se. Tumhaare siwa kisi ke paas ye nishaan nahi hoga.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to the graveyard and said: "Peace be upon you! The abode of the believing people and we, if God so wills, are about to join you. I love to see my brothers." They (the hearers) said: Aren't we your brothers, O Messenger of Allah? He said: You are my companions, and our brothers are those who have, so far, not come into the world. They said: Messenger of Allah, how would you recognise those persons of your Ummah who have not yet been born? He said: Supposing a man had horses with white blazes on foreheads and legs among horses which were all black, tell me, would he not recognise his own horses? They said: Certainly, O Messenger of Allah. He said: They would come with white faces and arms and legs owing to ablution, and I would arrive at the Cistern before them. Some people would be driven away from my Cistern as the stray camel is driven away. I would call out: Come, come. Then it would be said (to me): These people changed themselves after you, and I would say: Be off, be off.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) qabristan mein aaye aur kaha: Tumpar salaamati ho, imaan waale logon ka thikaana, aur hum, Allah chaahe to, tumse jald milne waale hain. Mujhe apne bhaiyon ko dekhne ki khwaahish hai. Unhone kaha: Kya hum aapke bhai nahi hain, Aye Allah ke Rasool? Aap (SAW) ne kaha: Tum mere saathi ho, aur humaare bhai wo hain jo abhi tak duniya mein nahi aaye. Unhone kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, aap apni Ummat ke un logon ko kaise pehchaanenge jo abhi paida nahi hue? Aap (SAW) ne kaha: Maano ki kisi shaks ke paas safed peshaani aur safed pairon waale ghode hon, kaale ghodon ke jhund mein; bataao, kya wo apne khud ke ghode pehchaan nahi lega? Unhone kaha: Zaroor, Aye Allah ke Rasool. Aap (SAW) ne kaha: Wo safed chehron, haathon aur paanvon ke saath aayenge wuzu ki wajah se, aur main unse pehle Hauz par pahunch jaaunga. Kuch logon ko mere Hauz se aise hataaya jaayega jaise bhatka hua oont hataaya jaata hai. Main pukaarunga: Aao, aao. Phir kaha jaayega: In logon ne aapke baad khud ko badal diya, aur main kahunga: Chale jaao, chale jaao.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (may peace The upon him) went out to the graveyard and said: Peace be upon you, the abode of the believing people. and If Allah so wills we shall join you.... (and so on and so forth) like the hadith narrated by Isma'il b. Ja'far except the words of Malik: Then some persons would be driven away from my Cistern.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) qabristan gaye aur kaha: Tumpar salaamati ho, imaan waale logon ka thikaana, aur agar Allah chaahe to hum tumse mil jaayenge, aur aage waisi hi hadees hai jaisi Ismail bin Ja'far ki riwayat ki gayi hai, sivaay Malik ke alfaaz ke: Phir kuch logon ko mere Hauz se hataaya jaayega.

e: Abu Hazim reported: I was (standing) behind Abu Huraira and he was performing the ablution for prayer. He extended the (washing) of his hand that it went up to his armpit. I said to him: O Abu Huraira, what is this ablution? He said: O of the tribe of Faruukh, you are here; if I knew that you were here, I would have never performed ablution like this; I have heard my Friend (ﷺ) say. In a believer adornment would reach the places where ablution reaches.
hi: Abu Hazim ne bataaya: Main Abu Huraira ke peeche tha aur wo namaz ke liye wuzu kar rahe the. Unhone apna haath dhone ka silsila apni bagal tak badha diya. Maine unse kaha: Aye Abu Huraira, ye kaisa wuzu hai? Unhone kaha: Aye Faruukh qabile ke shaks, tum yahan ho; agar mujhe pata hota ki tum yahan ho, to main kabhi isi tarah wuzu na karta; maine apne Dost (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Momin ki Qayamat ke Din zeenat wahan tak pahunchegi jahan tak wuzu pahunchta hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Should I not suggest to you that by which Allah obliterates the sins and elevates the ranks (of a man). They (the hearers) said: Yes, Messenger of Allah. He said: Performing the ablution thoroughly despite odds, tranverside of more paces towards the mosque, and waiting for the next prayer after observing a prayer, and that is mindfulness.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Kya main tumhein na bataaun wo cheez jiske zariye Allah gunah mita deta hai aur insaan ke darje buland karta hai? Unhone kaha: Haan, Ya Rasoolullah. Aap (SAW) ne kaha: Mushkilaton ke bawajood achhi tarah wuzu karna, masjid ki taraf zyada kadam chalna, aur ek namaz ke baad doosri namaz ka intezaar karna, aur yehi Ribat hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of `Ali b. `Abd al-Rahman with the same chain of transmitters and there is no mention of the word of al-Ribat in the hadith transmitted by Shu`ba and in the hadith narrated by Malik "Ribat" has been mentioned twice. This is the "Ribat" for you, this is the "Ribat" for you.
hi: Ye hadees Ali bin Abdur Rahman ki sanad se usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai aur Shu'ba ki riwayat ki gayi hadees mein 'Ribat' lafz ka koi zikr nahi hai aur Malik ki riwayat ki gayi hadees mein 'Ribat' do baar zikr hua hai. Ye tumhaare liye Ribat hai, ye tumhaare liye Ribat hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Apostle (ﷺ) said: Were it not that I might over-burden the believers-and in the hadith transmitted by Zuhair" people" -I would have ordered them to use toothstick at every time of prayer.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Agar mujhe momineen par bojh daalne ka khauf na hota - aur Zuhair ki riwayat ki gayi hadees mein 'logon' ka lafz hai - to main unhein har namaz ke waqt miswaak istemaal karne ka hukum deta.

e: Miqdam b. Shuraih narrated it from his father who said: I asked A'isha what Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) did first when he entered his house, and she replied: He used tooth-stick (first of all).
hi: Miqdam bin Shuraih ne apne waalid ki sanad se riwayat ki jinhone kaha: Maine Aisha se poocha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) jab apne ghar mein daakhil hote the to sabse pehle kya karte the, aur unhone jawaab diya: Wo sabse pehle miswaak istemaal karte the.

e: 'A'isha reported: Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered his house, he used tooth-stick first of all.
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Jab bhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apne ghar mein daakhil hote, to sabse pehle miswaak istemaal karte.

e: Abu Musa reported: I went to the Apostle (ﷺ) and found one end of the tooth-stick upon his tongue (i. e. he was rinsing his mouth).
hi: Abu Musa ne bataaya: Main Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaya aur maine paaya ki miswaak ka ek sira unki zubaan par tha, yaani wo apna munh saaf kar rahe the.

e: Huddaifa reported: Whenever the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) got up for Tahajjud prayer, he cleansed his mouth with the tooth-stick.
hi: Hudhaifa ne bataaya: Jab bhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Tahajjud ki namaz ke liye uthte, to apna munh miswaak se saaf karte.

e: This hadith is reported from Hudaifa by another chain of transmitters. Whenever he (the Holy Prophet) got up in the night, they (the transmitters) have not mentioned the words: for offering Tahajjud prayer.
hi: Ye hadees Hudhaifa se ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai. Jab bhi wo Nabi (SAW) raat mein uthte, raawiyon ne 'Tahajjud padhne ke liye' ke alfaaz zikr nahi kiye.

e: (493) Hudaifa reported: Whenever he (the Holy Prophet) got up for prayer during the night, he cleansed his mouth with the tooth-stick.
hi: Hudhaifa ne bataaya: Jab bhi wo Nabi (SAW) raat mein namaz ke liye uthte, apna munh miswaak se saaf karte.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported that he spent a night at the house of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), The Apostle of Allah (way peace be upon him) got up for prayer in the latter part of the night. He went out and looked towards the sky and then recited this verse (190th) of AI-i-'Imran: " Verily in the creation of the heavens and the earth and the alternation of night and day." up to the (words)" save us from the torment of Hell." He then returned to his house, used the tooth-stick, performed the ablution, and then got up and offered the prayer. He than lay down on the bed. and again got up and went out and looked towards the sky and recited this verse (mentioned above), then returned, used the tooth-stick, performed ablution and again offered the prayer.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bataaya ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke ghar mein ek raat guzaari. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) raat ke aakhri hisse mein namaz ke liye uthe. Wo bahar gaye aur aasman ki taraf dekha aur phir Aal-e-Imran ki aayat number 190 ki tilaawat ki: 'Beshak aasmaanon aur zameen ki paidaayish mein, aur raat aur din ke badalte rehne mein'... 'humein Jahannam ke azaab se bacha' tak. Phir wo apne ghar wapas aaye, miswaak istemaal ki, wuzu kiya, aur phir uthe aur namaz padhi. Phir wo bistar par let gaye, aur dobara uthe aur bahar gaye aur aasman ki taraf dekha aur upar zikr ki gayi aayat tilaawat ki, phir wapas aaye, miswaak istemaal ki, wuzu kiya aur dobara namaz padhi.

e: Abu Huraira reported: Five are the acts quite akin to the Fitra, or five are the acts of Fitra: circumcision, shaving the pubes, cutting the nails, plucking the hair under the armpits and clipping the moustache.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Paanch cheezein Fitrat ke bahut kareeb hain, ya paanch cheezein Fitrat ke amal hain: khatna karana, zair-e-naaf baal saaf karna, naakhun kaatna, bagal ke baal saaf karna, aur mooch chhoti karna.

e: Abu Huraira reported: Five are the acts of fitra: circumcision, removing the pubes, clipping the moustache, cutting the nails, plucking the hair under the armpits.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Paanch cheezein Fitrat ke amal hain: khatna karana, zair-e-naaf baal saaf karna, mooch chhoti karna, naakhun kaatna, bagal ke baal saaf karna.

e: Anas reported: A time limit has been prescribed for us for clipping the moustache, cutting the nails, plucking hair under the armpits, shaving the pubes, that it should not be neglected far more than forty nights.
hi: Anas ne bataaya: Humaare liye mooch chhoti karne, naakhun kaatne, bagal ke baal saaf karne, zair-e-naaf baal saaf karne ke liye ek muddat muqarrar ki gayi thi, ki ise chaalis raaton se zyada tak na chhoda jaaye.

e: Ibn Umar said: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) said: Trim closely the moustache, and let the beard grow.
hi: Ibn Umar ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Mooch achhi tarah chhoti karo, aur daadhi ko badhne do.

e: Ibn Umar said: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) ordered us to trim the moustache closely and spare the beard.
hi: Ibn Umar ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein hukum diya ki hum mooch achhi tarah chhoti karein aur daadhi ko chhod dein.

e: Ibn Umar said: The Messenger of Allah (may peace be opon him) said: Act against the polytheists, trim closely the moustache and grow beard.
hi: Ibn Umar ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Mushrikeen ke khilaaf amal karo, mooch achhi tarah chhoti karo aur daadhi badhaao.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Trim closely the moustache, and grow beard, and thus act against the fire-worshippers.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Mooch achhi tarah chhoti karo, aur daadhi badhaao, aur isi tarah aatish-parasto ke khilaaf amal karo.

e: 'A'isha reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Ten are the acts according to fitra: clipping the moustache, letting the beard grow, using the tooth-stick, snuffing water in the nose, cutting the nails, washing the finger joints, plucking the hair under the armpits, shaving the pubes and cleaning one's private parts with water. The narrator said: I have forgotten the tenth, but it may have been rinsing the mouth.
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Das cheezein Fitrat ke mutaabiq hain: mooch chhoti karna, daadhi ko badhne dena, miswaak istemaal karna, naak mein paani cheenchna, naakhun kaatna, ungliyon ke jodon ko dhona, bagal ke baal saaf karna, zair-e-naaf baal saaf karna, aur paani se apni sharmgaah saaf karna. Raawi ne kaha: Mujhe dasvi cheez yaad nahi, lekin shaayad wo kulli karna thi.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Mus'ab b. Shaiba with the same chain of transmitters except for these words: " His father said: I forgot the tenth one."
hi: Ye hadees Mus'ab bin Shaiba ne usi sanad se riwayat ki hai, sivaay in alfaaz ke: 'Unke waalid ne kaha: Main dasvi cheez bhool gaya.'

e: Salman reported that it was said to him: Your Apostle (ﷺ) teaches you about everything, even about excrement. He replied: Yes, he has forbidden us to face the Qibla at the time of excretion or urination, or cleansing with right hand or with less than three pebbles, or with dung or bone.
hi: Salman se riwayat hai ki unse kaha gaya: Tumhaare Rasool (SAW) tumhein har cheez ke baare mein sikhaate hain, yahan tak ki paakhaana ke baare mein bhi. Unhone jawaab diya: Haan, unhone humein qaza-e-haajat ya peshaab ke waqt Qibla ki taraf mooh karne se mana kiya, ya daayen haath se safaayi karne se, ya teen se kam kankariyon se safaayi karne se, ya gober ya haddi se.

e: Salman said that (one among) the polytheists remarked: I see that your friend even teaches you about the excrement. He replied; Yes, he has in fact forbidden us that anyone amongst us should cleanse himself with his right hand, or face the Qibla. He has forbidden the use of dung or bone for it, and he has also instructed us not to use less than three pebbles (for this purpose).
hi: Salman ne bataaya ki mushrikeen mein se ek shaks ne kaha: Main dekh raha hoon ki tumhaara dost tumhein paakhaana ke baare mein bhi sikhaata hai. Unhone jawaab diya: Haan, beshak unhone humein mana kiya hai ki hum mein se koi apne daayen haath se safaayi kare, ya Qibla ki taraf mooh kare. Unhone iske liye gober ya haddi ka istemaal karne se bhi mana kiya hai, aur unhone humein ye bhi hidaayat di hai ki hum iske liye teen se kam kankariyan istemaal na karein.

e: Jabir reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade the use of bone or the droppings of camels for wiping (after excretion).
hi: Jabir ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne safaayi ke liye haddi ya oonton ki lidd ka istemaal karne se mana kiya.

e: Abu Ayyub reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) said: Whenever you go to the desert, neither turn your face nor turn your back towards the Qibla while answering the call of nature, but face towards the east or the west. Abu Ayyub said: When we came to Syria we found that the latrines already built there were facing towards the Qibla. We turned our faces away from them and begged forgiveness of the Lord. He said: Yes.
hi: Abu Ayyub ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab bhi tum registaan ki taraf jaao, to na apna chehra aur na apni peeth Qibla ki taraf karo jab tum qaza-e-haajat kar rahe ho, balki poorab ya paschim ki taraf mooh karo. Abu Ayyub ne kaha: Jab hum Sham pahunche, to humne dekha ki wahan pehle se bane latrine Qibla ki taraf the. Humne unse apne chehre pher liye aur Allah se maghfirat maangi. Unhone kaha: Haan, isi ka hukum diya gaya tha.

e: Abu Huraira said: When any one amongst you squats for answering the call of nature, he should neither turn his face towards the Qibla nor turn his back towards it.
hi: Abu Huraira ne kaha: Jab tum mein se koi qaza-e-haajat ke liye baithe, to na apna chehra Qibla ki taraf kare, na apni peeth uski taraf kare.

e: Wasi' b. Habban reported: I was offering my prayer in the mosque and Abdullah b. Umar was sitting there reclining with his back towards the Qibla. After completing my prayer. I went to him from one side. Abdullah said: People say when you go to the latrine, you should neither turn your face towards the Qibla nor towards Bait-ul-Maqdis. 'Abdullah said (farther): I went up to the roof of the house and saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) squatting on two bricks for relieving himself with his face towards Bait-al-Maqdis.
hi: Wasi bin Habban ne bataaya: Main masjid mein namaz padh raha tha aur Abdullah bin Umar wahan apni peeth Qibla ki taraf karke tekiya lagaaye baithe the. Namaz mukammal karne ke baad, main ek taraf se unke paas gaya. Abdullah ne kaha: Log kehte hain ki jab tum latrine jaao, to na apna chehra Qibla ki taraf karo na Baitul-Maqdis ki taraf. Abdullah ne aage kaha: Main ghar ki chhat par gaya aur maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko do eenton par baithe hue, apna chehra Baitul-Maqdis ki taraf karke, qaza-e-haajat karte dekha.

e: Abdullah b. Umar said: I went up to the roof of the house of my sister Hafsa and saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) relieving himself facing Syria. with his back to the Qibla.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar ne kaha: Main apni bahen Hafsa ke ghar ki chhat par gaya aur maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko qaza-e-haajat karte dekha, Sham ki taraf mooh kiye, apni peeth Qibla ki taraf karke.

e: Abu Qatada reported it from his father: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: None of you should hold penis with his right hand while urinating, or wipe himself with his right hand in privy and should not breathe into the vessel (from which he drinks).
hi: Abu Qatada ne apne waalid ki sanad se riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Tum mein se koi apne daayen haath se apna aala-e-tanaasul peshaab karte waqt na pakde, ya paakhaana mein apne daayen haath se safaayi na kare aur peene ke bartan mein saans na le.

e: Abu Qatada reported it from his father that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When anyone amongst you enters the privy he should not touch his penis with his right hand.
hi: Abu Qatada ne apne waalid ki sanad se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab tum mein se koi paakhaana mein daakhil ho, to use apne aala-e-tanaasul ko apne daayen haath se nahi choona chaahiye.

e: Aba Qatada reported: The Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him) forbade (us) to breathe into the venel, to touch the penis with the right hand and to wipe after relieving with right hand.
hi: Abu Qatada ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne bartan mein saans lene, aala-e-tanaasul ko daayen haath se chhoone, aur qaza-e-haajat ke baad daayen haath se safaayi karne se mana kiya.

e: 'A'isha reported: The Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him) loved to start from the right-hand side for performing ablution, for combing (the hair) and wearing the shoes.
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko wuzu karne, baal kanghi karne aur jootiyaan pehnne mein daayin taraf se shuru karna pasand tha.

e: 'A'isha reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) loved to start from the right-hand side in his every act i. e. in wearing shoes, in combing (his hair) and in performing ablution.
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko apne har amal mein, yaani jootiyaan pehnne, baal kanghi karne aur wuzu karne mein, daayin taraf se shuru karna pasand tha.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Be on your guard against two things which provoke cursing. They (the companions present there) said: Messenger of Allah, what are those things which provoke cursing? He said: Easing on the thoroughfares or under the shades (where they take shelter and rest).
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Do cheezon se bacho jo laanat ko bhadkaati hain. Unhone kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, wo cheezein kya hain jo laanat ko bhadkaati hain? Aap (SAW) ne kaha: Raaston par ya saayedaar jaghon mein jahan log panaah lete aur aaram karte hain, qaza-e-haajat karna.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) entered an enclosure while a servant was following him with a jar of water and he was the youngest amongst us and he placed it by the side of a lote-tree. When the Messenger of Allah, (ﷺ) relieved himself, he came out and had cleansed himself with water.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek gher hui jagah mein daakhil hue jabki ek naukar unke peeche paani ka ek ghada leke chal raha tha aur wo hum mein sabse chhota tha, aur usne use ek bair ke ped ke paas rakh diya. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) qaza-e-haajat se faarigh hue, to wo bahar aaye aur unhone paani se safaayi ki thi.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) entered the privy, a servant and I used to carry a skin of water, and a pointed staff, and he would cleanse himself with water.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bataaya: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) paakhaana mein daakhil hote, to ek naukar aur main paani ki ek mashk aur ek nokdaar chhadi le jaate the, aur wo paani se safaayi karte the.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went to a far-off place in the desert (hidden from the sight of human beings) for relieving himself. Then I brought water for him and he cleansed himself.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) registaan mein ek door ki jagah gaye, logon ki nazron se ojhal, qaza-e-haajat ke liye. Phir main unke liye paani laaya aur unhone safaayi ki.

e: Hummam reported: Jarir urinated, then performed ablution and wiped over the socks. It was said to him: Do you do like this? He said: Yes, I saw that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) urinated, then performed ablution and then wiped over his shoes. A'mash said: Ibrahim had observed that this hadith was a surprise for them (the people) because Jarir had embraced Islam after the revelation of Surat al-Ma'ida.
hi: Hummam ne bataaya: Jarir ne peshaab kiya, phir wuzu kiya aur mozon par masah kiya. Unse kaha gaya: Kya aap isi tarah karte hain? Unhone kaha: Haan, maine dekha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne peshaab kiya, phir wuzu kiya aur phir apni jootiyon par masah kiya. A'mash ne kaha: Ibrahim ne kaha tha ki ye hadees logon ke liye hairaani ka baais thi kyunki Jarir ne Islam Surat al-Ma'ida ki nazool ke baad qubool kiya tha.

e: This hadith is narrated on the same authority from A'mash by another chain of transmitters like one transmitted by Abu Mu'awyia. The hadith reported by 'Isa and Sufyan has these words also: " This hadith surprised the friends of Abdullab'" for Jarir had embraced Islam after the revelation of al-Ma'ida.
hi: Ye hadees A'mash se usi sanad ke saath, ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai, Abu Mu'awiya ki riwayat jaisi. Isa aur Sufyan ki riwayat ki gayi hadees mein ye alfaaz bhi hain: 'Ye hadees Abdullah ke doston ke liye hairaani ka baais thi' kyunki Jarir ne al-Ma'ida ki nazool ke baad Islam qubool kiya tha.

e: Hudhaifa reported: I was with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) when he came to the dumping ground of filth belonging to a particular tribe. He urinated while standing, and I went aside. He (the Holy Prophet) asked me to come near him and I went so near to him that I stood behind his heels. He then performed ablution and wiped over his socks.
hi: Hudhaifa ne bataaya: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath tha jab wo ek qabile ki kachra-daalne ki jagah par pahunche. Unhone khade hokar peshaab kiya, aur main alag ho gaya. Unhone mujhe apne paas bulaaya aur main itna kareeb gaya ki unki aediyon ke peeche khada ho gaya. Phir unhone wuzu kiya aur apne mozon par masah kiya.

e: Abu Wa'il reported: Abu Musa inflicted extreme rigour upon himself in the matter of urination and urinated in a bottle and said: When the skin of anyone amongst the people of Israel was besmeared with urine, he cut that portion with a cutter. Hudhaifa said: I wish that'your friend should not inflict such an extreme rigour. I and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) were going together till we reached the dumping ground of filth behind an enclosure. He stood up as one among you would stand up. and he urinated, I tried to turn away from him, but he beckoned to me, so I went to him and I stood behind him, till he had relieved himself.
hi: Abu Wa'il ne bataaya: Abu Musa peshaab ke maamle mein khud par bahut sakhti karte the aur ek botal mein peshaab karte the aur kehte the: Jab Bani Israel ke kisi shaks ki khaal peshaab se lipat jaati thi, to wo us hisse ko chaakoo se kaat deta tha. Hudhaifa ne kaha: Kaash tumhaara dost itni sakhti na kare. Main aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) saath saath ja rahe the yahan tak ki hum ek gher hui jagah ke peeche kachre ki dher tak pahunche. Wo khade ho gaye jaise tum mein se koi khada hota hai, aur unhone peshaab kiya. Maine unse door mudne ki koshish ki, lekin unhone mujhe ishaara kiya, is liye main unke paas gaya aur unki peeth ke peeche khada raha, yahan tak ki unhone khud ko halka kar liya.

e: The son of Mughira b. Shu'ba reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went out for relieving himself. Mughira went with him carrying a jug full of water. When he (the Holy Prophet) came back after relieving himself, he poured water over him and he performed ablution and wiped over his socks; and in the narration of Ibn Rumh there is" till" instead of" when".
hi: Mughira bin Shu'ba ke bete ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) qaza-e-haajat ke liye bahar gaye. Mughira paani se bhara ek ghada leke unke saath gaye. Jab wo qaza-e-haajat se wapas aaye, to unhone unpar paani daala aur unhone wuzu kiya aur apne mozon par masah kiya; aur Ibn Rumh ki riwayat mein 'jab' ke bajaaye 'jab tak' hai.

e: This hadith has been transmitted with the same chain of transmitters by Yahya b. Sa'id with the addition of these words: " He washed his face and hands, and wiped his head and then wiped his socks."
hi: Ye hadees usi sanad ke saath Yahya bin Sa'id ne bhi riwayat ki hai, is izafe ke saath: 'Unhone apna chehra aur haath dhoye, aur apna sar masah kiya aur phir apne mozon par masah kiya.'

e: Mughira b. Shu'ba reported: I was with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) one night. He came down (from the ride) and relieved himself. He then came and I poured water upon him from the jar that I carried with me. He performed ablution and wiped over his socks.
hi: Mughira bin Shu'ba ne bataaya: Main ek raat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath tha. Wo sawaari se utre aur qaza-e-haajat ki. Phir wo aaye aur maine unpar us ghade se paani daala jo main apne saath le jaa raha tha. Unhone wuzu kiya aur apne mozon par masah kiya.

e: Mughira b. Shu'ba reported: I was in the company of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on a journey when he said: Mughira take hold of this jar (of water). I took hold of it and I went out with him. (I stopped but) the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) proceeded on till he was out of my sight. He relieved himself and then came back and he was wearing a tight-sleeved Syrian gown. He tried to get his forearms out. but the sleeve of the gown was very narrow, so he brought his hands out from under the gown. I poured water over (his hands) and he performed ablution for prayer, then wiped over his socks and prayed.
hi: Mughira bin Shu'ba ne bataaya: Main ek safar mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath tha jab unhone kaha: Mughira, is ghade ko pakdo. Maine use pakda aur main unke saath nikla. Main ruk gaya lekin Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aage badhe yahan tak ki wo meri nazron se ojhal ho gaye. Unhone qaza-e-haajat ki aur phir wapas aaye aur unhone tang-aastin ka Shaami jubba pehna hua tha. Unhone apni baazuein bahar nikaalne ki koshish ki, lekin jubbe ki aastin bahut tang thi, is liye unhone apne haath jubbe ke neeche se nikaale. Maine unpar paani daala aur unhone namaz ke liye wuzu kiya, phir apne mozon par masah kiya aur namaz padhi.

e: Mughira b. Shu'ba reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went out for relieving himself. When he came back I brought for him a jar (of water) and poured water upon his hands and He washed his face. He tried to wash his forearms, but as the (sleeves of the) gown were tight. He, therefore, brought them out from under the gown. He then washed them, wiped his head, and wiped his socks and then prayed.
hi: Mughira bin Shu'ba ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) qaza-e-haajat ke liye bahar gaye. Jab wo wapas aaye, to main unke liye ek ghada laaya aur unke haathon par paani daala aur unhone apna chehra dhoya. Unhone apni baazuein dhone ki koshish ki, lekin jubbe ki aastin tang thi. Is liye unhone unhein jubbe ke neeche se nikaala. Phir unhone unhein dhoya, apna sar masah kiya, aur apne mozon par masah kiya aur phir namaz padhi.

e: 'Urwa b. Mughira reported his father having said: I was one night with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on a journey. He said to me: Have you any water with you? I said: Yes. He (the Holy Prophet) came down from his ride and went on till he disappeared in the darkness of night. He then came back and I poured water for him from the jar. He washed his face, He had a woollen gown on him and he could not bring out his forearms from it (i. e. from its sleeves) and consequently he brought them out from under his gown. He washed his forearms, wiped over his head. I then bent down to take off his socks. But he said: Leave them, for my feet were clean when I put them in, and he only wiped over them.
hi: Urwah bin Mughira ne apne waalid ki sanad se riwayat ki jinhone kaha: Main ek raat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath ek safar mein tha. Unhone mujhse kaha: Kya tumhaare paas paani hai? Maine kaha: Haan. Wo apni sawaari se utre aur chal pade yahan tak ki wo raat ke andhere mein ojhal ho gaye. Phir wo wapas aaye aur maine unke liye ghade se paani daala. Unhone apna chehra dhoya. Unhone oon ka jubba pehna hua tha aur wo ismein se apni baazuein bahar nahi nikaal paaye, is liye unhone unhein jubbe ke neeche se nikaala. Unhone apni baazuein dhoyi, apne sar par masah kiya. Main phir unke mozey utaarne ke liye jhuka. Lekin unhone kaha: Unhein rehne do, kyunki jab maine unhein pehna tha to mere paanv paak the, aur unhone sirf unpar masah kiya.

e: 'Urwah al Mughira reported it from his father: He (Mughira) helped the Apostle (ﷺ) in performing the ablution, and he performed it and wiped over his shoes. He (Mughira) said to him (about the washing of the feet after putting them off), but he (the Holy Prophet) said: I put them (feet) in when these were clean.
hi: Urwah al-Mughira ne apne waalid ki sanad se riwayat ki: Unhone Rasool (SAW) ki wuzu karne mein madad ki, aur unhone wuzu kiya aur apni jootiyon par masah kiya. Unhone unse kuch kaha, lekin unhone kaha: Maine inhein tab pehna tha jab ye paak the.

e: 'Urwa b. al Mughira b. Shu'ba reported it on the authority of his father that he said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) lagged behind (in a journey) and I also lagged behind along with him. After having relieved himself he said: Have you any water with you? I brought to him a jar of water; he washed his palms, and face, and when he tried to get his forearms out (he could not) for the sleeve of the gown was tight. He, therefore, brought them out from under the gown and, throwing it over his shoulders, he washed his forearm. He then wiped his forelock and his turban and his socks. He then mounted and I also mounted (the ride) and came to the people. They had begun the prayer with 'Abd ar-Rabmin b. 'Anf leading them and had completed a rak'a. When he perceived the presence of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) he began to retire. He (the Holy Prophet) signed to him to continue and offered prayer along with them. Then when he had pronounced the salutation, the Apostle (ﷺ) got up and I also got up with him, and we offered the rak'a which had been finished before we came.
hi: Urwah bin Mughira bin Shu'ba ne apne waalid ki sanad se riwayat ki ki unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek safar mein peeche reh gaye aur main bhi unke saath peeche reh gaya. Qaza-e-haajat se faarigh hone ke baad unhone kaha: Kya tumhaare paas paani hai? Main unke liye paani ka ek ghada laaya; unhone apni hatheliyaan aur chehra dhoya, aur jab unhone apni baazuein bahar nikaalne ki koshish ki to na nikal payein kyunki jubbe ki aastin tang thi. Is liye unhone unhein jubbe ke neeche se nikaala aur use apne kandhon par daalkar apni baazuein dhoyi. Phir unhone apni peshaani aur apni pagdi aur apne mozon par masah kiya. Phir wo sawaar hue aur main bhi sawaar hua aur hum logon ke paas pahunche. Unhone Abdur Rahman bin Auf ki imaamat mein namaz shuru kar di thi aur ek rak'aat mukammal kar chuke the. Jab unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki maujoodgi mehsoos ki, to wo peeche hatne lage. Aap (SAW) ne unhein ishaara kiya ki wo jaari rakhein aur unke saath namaz ada ki. Phir jab unhone salaam pheri, to Rasool (SAW) khade ho gaye aur main bhi unke saath khada hua, aur humne wo rak'aat ada ki jo humaare aane se pehle mukammal ho chuki thi.

e: Ibn Mughira narrated it from his father: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) wiped over his socks and over his forehead and over his turban.
hi: Ibn Mughira ne apne waalid ki sanad se riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne mozon par, apni peshaani par aur apni pagdi par masah kiya.

e: This hadith has been transmitted by Ibn Mughira on the authority of his father by another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Mughira ne apne waalid ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki hai.

e: Bakr reported that he had heard from the son of Mughira that verily the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) performed ablution and wiped over his forehead and wiped over his turban and over his socks.
hi: Bakr ne bataaya ki unhone Mughira ke bete se suna ki beshak Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne wuzu kiya aur apni peshaani par masah kiya aur apni pagdi par aur apne mozon par masah kiya.

e:
It is narrated from Bilal that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) wiped over the socks and turban, and in the hadith transmitted by 'Isa b. Yaunus the words are: " Bilal narrated it to me."
This tradition is transmitted by A'mash with this addition;, I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)."
hi: Bilal se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mozon aur pagdi par masah kiya, aur Isa bin Yunus ki riwayat ki gayi hadees mein alfaaz hain: 'Bilal ne ye mujhe riwayat ki.' Ye hadees A'mash ne is izafe ke saath riwayat ki hai: 'Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko dekha.'

e: Shuraih b. Hani said: I came to 'A'isha to ask her about wiping over the socks. She said: You better ask ('Ali) son of Abu Talib for he used to travel with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). We asked him and he said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stipulated (the upper limit) of three days and three nights for a traveller and one day and one night for the resident.
hi: Shuraih bin Hani ne kaha: Main Aisha ke paas mozon par masah karne ke baare mein poochne gaya. Unhone kaha: Behtar hoga tum Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) se poocho kyunki wo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath safar kiya karte the. Humne unse poocha aur unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne musaafir ke liye teen din aur teen raat ki had aur muqeem ke liye ek din aur ek raat ki had muqarrar ki.

e: This hadith is narrated by Ubaidullah b. 'Amr and Zaid b. Abu Unaisa with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ubaidullah bin Amr aur Zaid bin Abu Unaisa ne usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai.

e: Shuraib b. Hani reported: I asked 'A'isha about wiping over the shoes. She said: You better go to 'Ali, for he knows more about this than I. I, therefore, came to 'Ali and he narrated from the Apostle (ﷺ) like this.
hi: Shuraib bin Hani ne bataaya: Maine Aisha se jootiyon par masah karne ke baare mein poocha. Unhone kaha: Behtar hoga tum Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke paas jaao, kyunki wo iske baare mein mujhse zyada jaante hain. Is liye main Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke paas gaya aur unhone Rasool (SAW) se isi tarah ki riwayat ki.

e: Sulaiman b. Buraida narrated it from his father that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) offered prayers with one ablution on the day of the Conquest (of Mecca) and wiped over the socks. 'Umar said to him: You have today done something that you have not been accustomed to before. He (the Holy Prophet) said: 0 'Umar, I have done that on purpose.
hi: Sulaiman bin Buraida ne apne waalid ki sanad se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Fatah ke din ek hi wuzu se kayi namazein padhi thi aur mozon par masah kiya tha. Umar ne unse kaha: Aap ne aaj kuch aisa kiya jiske aap aadi nahi the. Unhone kaha: Aye Umar, maine ye jaan-boojh kar kiya hai.

e: Abu Huraira said: When anyone amongst you wakes up from sleep, he must not put his hand in the utensil till he has washed it three times, for he does not know where his hand was during the night.
hi: Abu Huraira ne kaha: Jab tum mein se koi neend se jaage, to use apna haath bartan mein nahi daalna chahiye jab tak wo use teen baar dho na le, kyunki use nahi pata ki raat bhar uska haath kahan raha.

e: This hadith is transmitted from Abu Huraira by another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira se ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Zahri and Ibn Musayyab have both transmitted a hadith like this from Abu Huraira who narrated it from the Apostle (ﷺ).
hi: Zuhri aur Ibn Musayyab, dono ne Abu Huraira se isi jaisi hadees riwayat ki hai jinhone ise Rasool (SAW) se riwayat kiya.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) said: When anyone amongst you wakes up from sleep, he should wash his hands three times before putting it in the utensil, for he does not know where his hand was during the night.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab tum mein se koi neend se jaage, to use bartan mein haath daalne se pehle apna haath teen baar dhona chahiye, kyunki use nahi pata ki raat bhar uska haath kahan raha.

e: This hadith has been transmitted through other chains of transmitters on the authority of Abu Huraira in which it is reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) made a mention of washing the hand, and did not instruct to wash it three times. But the hadith narrated from Jabir and Ibn Musayyab. Abu Salama, and Abdullah b. Shaqiq, Abu Salih, Abla Razin, there is a mention of" three times".
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se doosri sanadon se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai jismein bataaya gaya hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne haath dhone ka zikr kiya, lekin use teen baar dhone ka hukum nahi diya. Lekin Jabir aur Ibn Musayyab, Abu Salama, Abdullah bin Shaqiq, Abu Salih, Abu Razin ki riwayat ki gayi hadees mein 'teen baar' ka zikr hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) to have said: When a dog licks a utensil belonging to any one of you, (the thing contained in it) should be thrown away and then (the utensil) should be washed seven times.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab kutta tum mein se kisi ke bartan ko chaate, to usmein maujood cheez phenk deni chaahiye aur phir bartan saat baar dhona chahiye.

e: This hadith has been transmitted by another chain of transmitters in which there is no mention of" throwing away".
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai jismein 'phenkne' ka zikr nahi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When a dog drinks out of a vessel belonging to any one of you, he must wash it seven times.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab kutta tum mein se kisi ke bartan se peeye, to use saat baar dhona chaahiye.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The purification of the utensil belonging to any one of you, after it is licked by a dog, lies in washing it seven times, using sand for the first time.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Tum mein se kisi ke bartan ki tahaarat, jise kutte ne chaata ho, ye hai ki use saat baar dhoya jaaye, pehli baar mitti ka istemaal karte hue.

e: Hammam b. Munabbih reported: Of the a hadith narrated by Abu Huraira from Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), one is this: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The purification of the utensil belonging to one amongst you, after it is licked by a dog, lies in washing it seven times.
hi: Hammam bin Munabbih ne bataaya: Abu Huraira ne humein Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool (SAW), se jo Ahadees riwayat ki unmein se ek ye hai: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Tum mein se kisi ke bartan ki tahaarat, jise kutte ne chaata ho, ye hai ki use saat baar dhoya jaaye.

e: Ibn Mughaffal reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ordered killing of the dogs, and then said: What about them, i. e. about other dogs? and then granted concession (to keep) the dog for hunting and the dog for (the security) of the herd, and said: When the dog licks the utensil, wash it seven times, and rub it with earth the eighth time.
hi: Ibn Mughaffal ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kutton ko maarne ka hukum diya, aur phir kaha: Baaki kutton ka kya matlab hai? Aur phir shikaar ke kutte aur galle ki hifaazat karne wale kutte ke liye chhoot di, aur kaha: Jab kutta bartan chaate, to use saat baar dhoo, aur aathvi baar mitti se ragdo.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated from Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters except for the fact that in the hadith transmitted by Yahya those words are: " He (the Holy Prophet) gave concession in the case of the dog for looking after the herd, for hunting and for watching the cultivated land," and there is no mention of this addition (i. e. concession in case of watching the cultivated lands) except in the hadith transmitted by Yahya.
hi: Ye jaisi hadees Shu'ba ne usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai, sivaay iske ki Yahya ki riwayat ki gayi hadees mein alfaaz hain: 'Unhone galle ki dekhbhaal, shikaar aur khet ki nigraani ke liye kutte mein chhoot di,' aur is izafe ka zikr sirf Yahya ki riwayat mein hai.

e: Jabir reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade to urinate in stagnant water.
hi: Jabir ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne khade paani mein peshaab karne se mana kiya.

e: Abu Huraira reported: the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: None amongst you should urinate in standing water, and then wash in it.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Tum mein se koi bhi khade paani mein peshaab na kare, aur phir usmein nahaaye.

e: Hammam b. Munabbih said: Of the ahadith narrated to us by Abfi Huraira from Muhammad the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) one is this: The Messenger or Allah (ﷺ) said: You should not urinate in standing water, that is not flowing, then wash in it.
hi: Hammam bin Munabbih ne kaha: Un Ahadees mein se jo Abu Huraira ne humein Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat ki, ek ye hai: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Tumhein khade paani mein, jo bah nahi raha, peshaab nahi karna chahiye, aur phir usmein nahaana.

e: Abu Huraira reported the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: None of you must wash in standing water when he is in a state of Junub. And Abu Huraira was asked how it was to be done; he said: It was to be taken out in handfuls.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Tum mein se koi bhi khade paani mein na nahaaye jab wo janaabat ki halat mein ho. Aur Abu Huraira se poocha gaya ki phir ye kaise kiya jaaye; unhone kaha: Ise mutthi bhar-bhar kar nikaala jaaye.

e: Anas reported: A Bedouin urinated in the mosque. Some of the persons stood up (to reprimand him or to check him from doing so), but the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Leave him alone; don't interrupt him. He (the narrator) said: And when he had finished, he called for a bucket of water and poured it over.
hi: Anas ne bataaya: Ek badawi ne masjid mein peshaab kiya. Kuch log khade ho gaye use daantne ya rokne ke liye, lekin Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Use akela chhod do; use na roko. Unhone kaha: Aur jab wo faarigh ho gaya, to unhone paani ki ek balti mangwaayi aur uspar dala.

e: Anas b. Malik narrated that a desert Arab (Bedouin) stood in a corner of the mosque and urinated there. The people (the Companions of the Prophet who were present there) shouted, but the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Leave him alone. When he had finished, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ordered that a bucket (of water) should be brought and poured over it.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bataaya ki ek registaani Arab masjid ke ek kone mein khada hua aur wahan peshaab kiya. Logon ne shor macha diya, lekin Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Use chhod do. Jab wo faarigh ho gaya, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne hukum diya ki paani ki ek balti laayi jaaye aur uspar daali jaaye.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: While we were in the mosque with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), a desert Arab came and stood up and began to urinate in the mosque. The Companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Stop, stop, but the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Don't interrupt him; leave him alone. They left him alone, and when he finished urinating, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) called him and said to him: These mosques are not the places meant for urine and filth, but are only for the remembrance of Allah, prayer and the recitation of the Qur'an, or Allah's Messenger said something like that. He (the narrator) said that he (the Holy Prophet) then gave orders to one of the people who brought a bucket of water and poured It over.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bataaya: Jab hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath masjid mein the, ek registaani Arab aaya aur khada hokar masjid mein peshaab karna shuru kar diya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke Sahaba ne kaha: Ruko, ruko, lekin Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Use mat roko; use akela chhod do. Unhone use akela chhod diya, aur jab wo peshaab karke faarigh hua, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne use bulaaya aur usse kaha: Ye masjidein peshaab aur gandagi ke liye nahi hain, balki sirf Allah ke zikr, namaz aur Quran ki tilaawat ke liye hain, ya Allah ke Rasool ne isi jaisi koi baat kahi. Unhone kaha ki phir aap (SAW) ne logon mein se ek ko hukum diya jo paani ki balti le aaye aur uspar daal di.

e: A'isha, the wife of the Apostle (ﷺ) said: Babies were brought to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he blessed them, and after having chewed (something, e. g. dates or any other sweet thing) he rubbed there with their soft palates. A baby was brought to him and he passed water over him (over his garment), so he asked water to be brought and sprinkled it, but he did not wash it.
hi: Aisha, Rasool (SAW) ki biwi, ne bataaya: Bacchon ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laaya jaata tha aur wo unhein barkat dete the, aur kuch cheez, jaise khajoorein ya koi meethi cheez, chabaane ke baad wo ise unke naram taaluon par mal dete the. Ek bacche ko unke paas laaya gaya aur usne unpar peshaab kar diya, is liye unhone paani mangwaaya aur chhinta diya, lekin unhone use dhoya nahi.

e: A'isha reported: A suckling babe was brought to the Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him) and he urinated in his tap. He (the Holy Prophet) sent for water and poured it over.
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Doodh peete ek bacche ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laaya gaya aur usne unki god mein peshaab kar diya. Unhone paani mangwaaya aur use us par daala.

e: Hisham narrated the hadith like one transmitted by Ibn Numair (the above mentioned one) with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Hisham ne ye hadees Ibn Numair ki tarah usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai.

e: Umm Qais daughter of Mihsan reported that she came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) with her child. who was not yet weaned, and she placed him in his lap; and he urinated in his (Holy Prophet's) lap. He (the Holy Prophet) did nothing more than spraying water over it.
hi: Umm Qais, Mihsan ki beti, ne bataaya ki wo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas apne bacche ke saath aayi, jiska abhi doodh chhudaya nahi gaya tha, aur usne use unki god mein rakh diya; aur usne unki god mein peshaab kar diya. Unhone is par paani ka chhinta dene ke alaawa aur kuch nahi kiya.

e: This hadith has also been narrated from al-Zuhri with the same chain of narrators. (but for the words): " He (the Holy Prophet) sent for water and sprinkled it over."
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri se bhi usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai, sivaay in alfaaz ke: 'Unhone paani mangwaaya aur use chhinta diya.'

e: Ubaidullah b. Abdullah b. 'Utba b. Mas'ud said: Umm Qais, daughter of Mihsan, was among the earliest female emigrants who took the oath of allegiance to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and she was the sister of 'Ukkasha b. Mihsan, one amongst the sons of Asad b. Khuzaima. He (the narrator) said: She (Umm Qais) told me that she came to the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) with her son and he had not attained the age of eating food. He (the narrator, 'Ubaidullah), said: She told me that her son passed urine in the lap of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent for water and sprayed it over his garment (over that part which was contaminated with the urine of the child) and he did not wash it thoroughly.
hi: Ubaidullah bin Abdullah bin Utba bin Mas'ood ne kaha: Umm Qais, Mihsan ki beti, un sabse pehli aurton mein se thi jinhone hijrat ki aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se bay'at ki, aur wo Ukkasha bin Mihsan ki bahen thi, jo Asad bin Khuzaimah ke betoon mein se ek the. Unhone kaha: Unhone mujhe bataaya ki wo apne bete ke saath Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi thi aur usne abhi khaana khaane ki umr paar nahi ki thi. Unhone kaha: Unhone mujhe bataaya ki unke bete ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki god mein peshaab kar diya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne paani mangwaaya aur use apne kapde par, us hisse par jo bacche ke peshaab se ganda hua tha, chhinta diya aur use achhi tarah dhoya nahi.

e: Alqama and Aswad reported: A person stayed in the house of A'isha and in the morning began to wash his garment. A'isha said: In case you saw it (i. e. drop of semen), it would have served the purpose (of purifying the garment) if you had simply washed that spot; and in case you did not see it, it would have been enough to sprinkle water around it, for when I saw that on the garment of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). I simply scraped it off and he offered prayer, while putting that on.
hi: Alqama aur Aswad ne bataaya: Ek shaks Aisha ke ghar mein thehra aur subah apna kapda dhone laga. Aisha ne kaha: Agar tumne ise, yaani mani ka qatra, dekha ho, to sirf us jagah ko dhona hi kaafi hota kapde ko paak karne ke liye; aur agar tumne ise na dekha ho, to sirf uske ird-gird paani chhidak dena kaafi hota, kyunki jab maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke kapde par ye dekha, to maine sirf use khurach diya aur unhone wo pehnkar namaz padhi.

e: Al-Aawad and Hammam reported A'isha as saying: I used to scrape off the (drop of) semen from the garment of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).
hi: Al-Aswad aur Hammam ne Aisha se bataaya ki unhone kaha: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke kapde se mani ke qatre ko khurach diya karti thi.

e: Qutaiba b. Sa'id, Ishaq b. Ibrahim, Ibn Abi 'Aruba, Abu Ma'shar, Abu Bakr b. Abu Shaiba, Mansur and Mughira have all transmitted from Ibrahim, who transmitted it on the authority of A'isha's narration pertaining to the scraping off of the (drop) of semen from the garment of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) like the hadith of Khalid on the authority of Abu Ma'shar.
hi: Qutaiba bin Sa'id, Ishaq bin Ibrahim, Ibn Abi Aruba, Abu Ma'shar, Abu Bakr bin Abi Shaiba, Mansoor aur Mughira, in sabne Ibrahim se riwayat ki hai, jinhone ise Aisha ki riwayat ki, jismein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke kapde se mani ke qatre ko khurachne ka zikr hai, jaise Khalid ne Abu Ma'shar ki sanad se riwayat ki thi.

e: Hammam narrated the hadith from A'isha like the (above-mentioned) traditions.
hi: Hammam ne ye hadees Aisha se upar zikr ki gayi riwaayaton jaisi hi bayan ki hai.

e: 'Amr b. Maimun said: I asked Sulaiman b. Yasar whether the semen that gets on to the garment of a person should be washed or not. He replied: A'isha told me: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) washed the semen, and then went out for prayer in that very garment and I saw the mark of washing on it.
hi: Amr bin Maimun ne bataaya: Maine Sulaiman bin Yasar se poocha ki agar mani kisi shaks ke kapde par lag jaaye, to use dhona chahiye ya nahi. Unhone jawaab diya: Aisha ne mujhe bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mani ko dhoya, aur phir usi kapde mein namaz ke liye bahar gaye aur maine uspar dhoye jaane ka nishaan dekha.

e: Abu Kuraib, Ibn al-Mubarak, Ibn Abu Za'ida all of them narrated from Amr b. Maimun with the same chain of transmitters. Ibn Abu Za'ida narrated as was transmitted from Ibn Bishr that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) washed semen, and in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Ibn Mabarak and Abdul Wahid the words are: " She (A'isha) reported: I used to wash it from the garment of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)."
hi: Abu Kuraib, Ibn al-Mubarak, Ibn Abi Zaida, in sabne Amr bin Maimun se usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai. Ibn Abi Zaida ne riwayat ki jaisi Ibn Bishr se aayi thi ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mani ko dhoya, aur Ibn Mubarak aur Abdul Wahid ki riwayat ki gayi hadees mein alfaaz hain: 'Unhone bataaya: Main ise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke kapde se dhoya karti thi.'

e: Abdullah b. Shihab al-Khaulani reported: I stayed in the house of 'A'isha and had a wet dream (and perceived its effect on my garment), so (in the morning) I dipped both (the clothes) in water. This (act of mine) was watched by a maid-servant of A'isha and she informed her. She (Hadrat A'isha) sent me a message: Whatprompted you to act like this with your clothes? He (the narrator) said: I told that I saw in a dream what a sleeper sees. She said: Did you find (any mark of the fluid) on your clothes? I said: No. She said: Had you found anything you should have washed it. Incase I found that (semen) on the garment of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) dried up, I scraped it off with my nails.
hi: Abdullah bin Shihab al-Khaulani ne bataaya: Main Aisha ke ghar mein thehra hua tha aur mujhe ehtelaam hua aur maine apne kapde par iska asar dekha, is liye subah maine dono kapdon ko paani mein dubo diya. Aisha ki ek naukraani ne ye mera amal dekh liya aur unhein bataaya. Unhone mujhe paighaam bheja: Tumhein apne kapdon ke saath aisa karne par kis cheez ne ubhaara? Unhone kaha: Maine bataaya ki maine khwaab mein wo dekha jo koi sone wala dekhta hai. Unhone kaha: Kya tumhein apne kapdon par koi nishaan mila? Maine kaha: Nahi. Unhone kaha: Agar tumhein kuch milta, to tumhein use dhona chaahiye tha. Jahan tak mera taalluq hai, agar main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke kapde par mani sookhi hui paati thi, to main use apne naakhunon se khurach deti thi.

e: Asma (daughter of Abu Bakr) reported: A woman came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: What should one do if the blood of menses smears the garment of one amongst us? He (the Holy Prophet) replied: She should scrape it, then rub it with water, then pour water over it and then offer prayer in it.
hi: Asma (Abu Bakr ki beti) ne bataaya: Ek aurat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha: Agar humme se kisi ke kapde par haiz ka khoon lag jaaye, to use kya karna chaahiye? Aap (SAW) ne jawaab diya: Use khurach dena chahiye, phir paani se ragadna chahiye, phir uspar paani daalna chahiye aur phir usmein namaz padhni chahiye.

e: This tradition is narrated by Abu Kuraib, Ibn Numair, Abu Tahir, Ibn Wahb, Yahya b. 'Abdullah b. Salim, Malik b. Anas, 'Amr b. Harith on the authority of Hisham b. 'Urwa, with the same chain of transmitters like one transmitted by Yahya b. Sa'id like the above-mentioned.
hi: Ye riwayat Abu Kuraib, Ibn Numair, Abu Tahir, Ibn Wahb, Yahya bin Abdullah bin Salim, Malik bin Anas, Amr bin Harith ne Hisham bin Urwah ki sanad se, usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai jaisi Yahya bin Sa'id ki riwayat ki gayi upar zikr ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn Abbas reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) happened to pass by two graves and said: They (their occupants) are being tormented, but they are not tormented for a grievous sin. One of them carried tales and the other did not keep himself safe from being defiled by urine. He then called for a fresh twig and split it into two parts, and planted them on each grave and then said: Perhaps, their punishment way be mitigated as long as these twigs remain fresh.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka guzar do qabron ke paas se hua aur unhone kaha: Inhein azaab diya ja raha hai, lekin unhein kisi bade gunah ke liye azaab nahi diya ja raha. Unmein se ek chughli khaata tha aur doosra peshaab se apne aap ko bachaakar nahi rakhta tha. Phir unhone ek taazi taal mangwaayi aur use do hisson mein baant diya, aur unhein har qabr par gaad diya, aur phir kaha: Shaayad jab tak ye taaliyaan taazi rahengi, unka azaab kuch halka ho jaaye.

e: This hadith is transmitted from A'mash by Abmad b. Yusuf al-Azdi, Mu'alla b. Asad, Abd al-Wahid, Sulaiman with the same chain of transmitters but for the words: " The other did not keep himself safe from being defiled by urine."
hi: Ye hadees A'mash se Ahmad bin Yusuf al-Azdi, Mu'alla bin Asad, Abdul Wahid, Sulaiman ne usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai, sivaay in alfaaz ke: 'Doosra peshaab se apne aap ko bachaakar nahi rakhta tha.'

e: 'A'isha reported: When anyone amongst us (amongst the wives of the Holy Prophet) menstruated, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) asked her to tie a waist-wrapper over her (body) and then embraced her.
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Jab hum mein se koi Nabi (SAW) ki biwiyon mein se haiz mein hoti, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) usse kamar par kapda lapetne ko kehte aur phir use gale lagaate.

e: 'A'isha reported: When anyone amongst us was menstruating the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) asked her to tie waist-wrapper daring the time when the menstrual blood profusely flowed and then embraced her; and she ('A'isha) observed: And who amongst you can have control over his desires as the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had over his desires.
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Jab hum mein se koi haiz mein hoti, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) haiz ka khoon zyada behne ke daur mein bhi use kamar par kapda lapetne ko kehte aur phir use gale lagaate; aur unhone kaha: Aur tum mein se kaun apni khwaahishaat par utna qaabu rakh sakta hai jitna Allah ke Rasool (SAW) rakhte the.

e: Maimuna (the wife of the Holy Prophet) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) contacted and embraced his wives over the waist-wrapper when they were menstruating.
hi: Maimuna, Nabi (SAW) ki biwi, ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apni biwiyon ko chhoote aur gale lagaate the kamar ke kapde ke oopar se jab wo haiz mein hoti.

e: Kuraibthe freed slave of Ibn Abbas, reported: I heard it from Maimuna, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him): The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to lie with me when I menstruated, and there was a cloth between me and him.
hi: Kuraib, Ibn Abbas ke aazaad kiye gulaam, ne bataaya: Maine Maimuna, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki biwi se ye suna: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mere saath lete the jab main haiz mein hoti thi, aur mere aur unke darmiyaan ek kapda hota tha.

e: Umm Salama reported: While I was lying with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in a bed cover I menstruated, so I slipped away and I took up the clothes (which I wore) in menses. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Have you menstruated? I said: Yes. He called me and I lay down
hi: Umm Salama ne bataaya: Jab main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath ek chaadar mein leti hui thi, to mujhe haiz aa gaya, is liye main chupke se hat gayi aur maine wo kapde le liye jo main haiz ke dauraan pehnti thi. Is par Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Kya tumhein haiz aa gaya? Maine kaha: Haan. Unhone mujhe bulaaya aur main phir let gayi.

e: It is reported from 'A'isha that she observed: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was in I'tikaf, he inclined his head towards me and I combedhis hair, and he did not enter the house but for the natural calls (for relieving himself).
hi: Aisha se riwayat hai ki unhone kaha: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) I'tikaf mein hote, to wo apna sar mere taraf jhukaate aur main unke baal kanghi karti, aur wo ghar mein daakhil nahi hote sivaay qaza-e-haajat ke liye.

e: 'Amra daughter of 'Abd al-Rahman reported: 'A'isha, wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed: When I was (in I'tikaf), I entered the house for the call of nature, and while passing I inquired after the health of the sick (in the. family), and when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was (in I'tikaf), he put out his head towards me, while he himself was in the mosque, and I combed his hair; and he did not enter the house except for the call of nature so long as he was In I'tikaf; and Ibn Rumh stated: As long as they (the Prophet and his wives) were among the observers of I'tikaf.
hi: Amra, Abdur Rahman ki beti, ne bataaya: Aisha, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki biwi, ne kaha: Jab main I'tikaf mein hoti, to main qaza-e-haajat ke liye ghar mein daakhil hoti, aur guzarte hue main bimaar khandan ke logon ki khairiyat poochti, aur jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) I'tikaf mein hote, to wo apna sar mere taraf badhaate, jabki wo khud masjid mein hote, aur main unke baal kanghi karti; aur wo ghar mein daakhil nahi hote sivaay qaza-e-haajat ke jab tak wo I'tikaf mein rehte; aur Ibn Rumh ne kaha: Jab tak wo I'tikaf karne walon mein shaamil rehte.

e: 'A'isha, the wife of the Apostle (may peace he upon him), reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) put out from the mosque his head for me as he was in I'tikaf, and I washed it in the state that I was menstruating.
hi: Aisha, Rasool (SAW) ki biwi, ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne masjid se apna sar mere liye baahar nikaala jabki wo I'tikaf mein the, aur maine use dhoya jabki main haiz mein thi.

e: 'Urwa reported it from 'A'isha that she observed: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) inclined his head towards me (from the mosque) while I was in my apartment and I combed it in a state of menstruation.
hi: Urwah ne ise Aisha se riwayat ki ki unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apna sar mere taraf jhukaaya jabki main apne kamre mein thi aur maine haiz ki halat mein use kanghi ki.

e: Al-Aswad narrated it from 'A'isha that she observed: I used to wash the head of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), while I was in a state of menstruation.
hi: Al-Aswad ne ise Aisha se riwayat ki ki unhone kaha: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka sar dhoya karti thi jabki main haiz ki halat mein hoti.

e: 'A'isha reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me: Get me the mat from the mosque. I said: I am menstruating. Upon this he remarked: Your menstruation is not in your hand.
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse kaha: Masjid se mujhe chatai le aao. Maine kaha: Main haiz mein hoon. Is par unhone kaha: Tumhaara haiz tumhaare haath mein nahi hai.

e: 'A'isha reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ordered me that I should get him the mat from the mosque. I said: I am menstruating. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Do get me that, for menstruation is not in your hand.
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe hukum diya ki main unke liye masjid se chatai le aaun. Maine kaha: Main haiz mein hoon. Unhone kaha: Wo le aao, kyunki haiz tumhaare haath mein nahi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: While the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was in the mosque, he said: O 'A'isha, get me that garment. She said: I am menstruating. Upon this he remarked: Your menstruation is not in your hand, and she, therefore, got him that.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) masjid mein the, to unhone kaha: Aye Aisha, mujhe wo kapda de do. Unhone kaha: Main haiz mein hoon. Is par unhone kaha: Tumhaara haiz tumhaare haath mein nahi hai, is liye unhone wo unhein de diya.

e: 'A'isha reported: I would drink when I was menstruating, then I would hand it (the vessel) to the Apostle (ﷺ) and he would put his mouth where mine had been, and drink, and I would eat flesh from a bone when I was menstruating, then hand it over to the Apostle (ﷺ) and he would put his mouth where mine had been. Zuhair made no mention of (the Holy Prophet's) drinking.
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Main haiz ki halat mein peeti thi, phir bartan Rasool (SAW) ko de deti, aur wo apna mooh wahin rakhte jahan mera mooh laga hota, aur peete; aur main haiz ki halat mein haddi se gosht khaati, phir use Rasool (SAW) ko de deti, aur wo apna mooh wahin rakhte jahan mera mooh laga hota. Zuhair ne Nabi (SAW) ke peene ka koi zikr nahi kiya.

e: 'A'isha reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would recline in my lap when I was menstruating, and recite the Qur'an.
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) meri god mein tekiya lagaate the jab main haiz mein hoti, aur Quran padhte.

e: Thabit narrated it from Anas: Among the Jews, when a woman menstruated, they did not dine with her, nor did they live with them in their houses; so the Companions of the Apostle (ﷺ) asked The Apostle (ﷺ), and Allah, the Exalted revealed:" And they ask you about menstruation; say it is a pollution, so keep away from woman during menstruation" to the end (Qur'an, ii. 222). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Do everything except intercourse. The Jews heard of that and said: This man does not want to leave anything we do without opposing us in it. Usaid b. Hudair and Abbad b. Bishr came and said: Messenger of Allah, the Jews say such and such thing. We should not have, therefore, any contactwith them (as the Jews do). The face of the Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him) underwent such a change that we thought he was angry with them, but when they went out, they happened to receive a gift of milk which was sent to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He (the Holy Prophet) called for them and gave them drink, whereby they knew that he was not angry with them.
hi: Thabit ne ise Anas se riwayat ki: Yahudiyon mein, jab koi aurat haiz mein hoti, to wo uske saath khaana nahi khaate the, na uske saath ghar mein rehte the; is liye Rasool (SAW) ke Sahaba ne Rasool (SAW) se poocha, aur Allah, Sarbuland, ne nazil kiya: 'Aur wo aapse haiz ke baare mein poochte hain; kaho ye ek gandagi hai, is liye haiz ke dauraan aurat se door raho' aakhir tak (Quran 2:222). Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Sambhog ke alaawa sab kuch karo. Yahudiyon ne ye sunkar kaha: Ye shaks kuch bhi aisa nahi chhodna chaahta jo hum karte hain, bina humse ikhtelaaf kiye. Usaid bin Hudair aur Abbad bin Bishr aaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Yahudi aisi-aisi baat kehte hain. Is liye humein unse koi bhi taalluq nahi rakhna chaahiye. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka chehra itna badla ki humein laga ki wo unse naaraaz hain, lekin jab wo bahar nikle, to unhein doodh ka ek tohfa mila jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke liye bheja gaya tha. Unhone unhein bulaaya aur unhein peene ko diya, jisse unhein pata chala ki wo unse naaraaz nahi hain.

e: 'Ali reported: I was one whose prostatic fluid flowed readily and I was ashamed to ask the Apostle (ﷺ) about it, because of the position of his daughter. I, therefore, asked Miqdad. b. al-Asad and he inquired of him (the Holy Prophet). He (the Holy Prophet) said: He should wash his male organ and perform ablution.
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne bataaya: Main aisa shaks tha jiska Mazi aasaani se nikal jaata tha aur mujhe Rasool (SAW) se iske baare mein poochne mein sharam aati thi, unki beti Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ke rishte ki wajah se. Is liye maine Miqdad bin al-Asad se poocha aur unhone unse poocha. Unhone kaha: Use apni sharmgaah dhoni chaahiye aur wuzu karna chaahiye.

e: 'Ali reported: I felt shy of asking about prostatic fluid from the Apostle (ﷺ) because of Fatimah. I, therefore, asked al-Miqdad (to ask on my behalf) and he asked. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Ablution is obligatory in such a case.
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne bataaya: Mujhe Mazi ke baare mein Rasool (SAW) se poochne mein sharam aati thi Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ki wajah se. Is liye maine Miqdad se poocha mere taraf se poochne ke liye aur unhone poocha. Unhone kaha: Aise maamle mein wuzu farz hai.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported it from 'Ali: We sent al-Miqdad b. al-Aswad to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) to ask him what must be done about prostatic fluid which flows from (the private part of) a person. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Perform ablution and wash your sexual organ.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne ise Ali (Alayhis Salam) se riwayat ki: Humne Miqdad bin al-Aswad ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas bheja ki wo unse poochein ki Mazi ke baare mein kya karna chahiye jo kisi shaks ki sharmgaah se nikalta hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Wuzu karo aur apni sharmgaah dho lo.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported: The Apostle (ﷺ) woke up at night; relieved himself, and then washed his face and hands and then again slept.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bataaya: Rasool (SAW) raat mein uthe; khud ko halka kiya, aur phir apna chehra aur haath dhoye aur phir dobara so gaye.

e: 'A'isha reported: Whenever the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) intended to sleep after having sexual intercourse, he performed ablution as for the prayer before going to sleep.
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Jab bhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) sambhog ke baad sone ka iraada karte, to sone se pehle wo namaz jaisa wuzu karte the.

e: 'A'isha reported: Whenever the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had sexual intercourse and intended to eat or sleep, he performed the ablution of prayer.
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Jab bhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) sambhog karte aur khaana ya sone ka iraada rakhte, to wo namaz ka wuzu karte.

e: This hadith has been transmitted by Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters. Ibn at-Muthanna said in his narration: AI-Hakam narrated to us who heard from Ibrahim narrating that.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ne usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai. Ibn al-Muthanna ne apni riwayat mein kaha: Al-Hakam ne humein riwayat ki jinhone Ibrahim se suna ki wo ye riwayat karte the.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported: Umar said: Is one amongst us permitted to sleep in a state of impurity (i. e. after having sexual intercourse)? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Yes, after performing ablution.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bataaya: Umar ne kaha: Kya humme se kisi ko ye ijaazat hai ki wo napaaki ki halat mein so sake? Unhone kaha: Haan, wuzu karne ke baad.

e: Ibn 'Umar said: 'Umar asked the verdict of the Shari'ah from the Apostle (ﷺ) thus: Is it permissible for any one of us to sleep in a state of impurity? He (the Prophet said: Yes, he must perform ablution and then sleep and take a bath when he desires.
hi: Ibn Umar ne kaha: Umar ne Rasool (SAW) se Shariat ka faisla poocha is tarah: Kya humme se kisi ke liye ye jaayez hai ki wo napaaki ki halat mein soye? Unhone kaha: Haan, use wuzu karke sona chaahiye aur jab chaahe ghusl karna chaahiye.

e: Ibn Umar reported: Umar b. al-Khattab said to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), that he became Junbi during the night. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to him: Perform ablution, wash your sexual organ and then go to sleep.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bataaya: Umar bin Khattab ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kaha ki wo raat mein Junubi ho gaye. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha: Wuzu karo, apni sharmgaah dho lo, aur phir so jaao.

e: 'Abdullah b. Abu'l-Qais reported: I asked 'A'isha about the Witr (prayer) of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and made mention of a hadith, then I said: What did he do after having sexual intercourse? Did he take a bath before going to sleep or did he sleep before taking a bath? She said: He did all these. Some- times he took a bath and then slept, and sometimes he performed ablution only and went to sleep. I (the narrator) said: Praise be to Allah Who has made things easy (for human beings).
hi: Abdullah bin Abul-Qais ne bataaya: Maine Aisha se Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke Witr namaz ke baare mein poocha aur ek hadees ka zikr kiya, phir maine kaha: Sambhog ke baad wo kya karte the? Kya wo sone se pehle ghusl karte the ya ghusl se pehle sote the? Unhone kaha: Wo ye sab karte the. Kabhi wo ghusl karte aur phir sote, aur kabhi sirf wuzu karte aur so jaate. Maine kaha: Allah ki tareef, Jisne cheezon ko insaanon ke liye aasaan kiya.

e: This hadith has been transmitted with the same chain of transmitters from Mu'awyia b. Salih by Zuhair b. Harb, 'Abd al-Rahman b. Mahdi, Harun b. Sa'id al-'Aili and Ibn Wahb.
hi: Ye hadees Mu'awiya bin Salih se usi sanad ke saath Zuhair bin Harb, Abdur Rahman bin Mahdi, Harun bin Sa'id al-Aili aur Ibn Wahb ne bhi riwayat ki hai.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When anyone amongst you has sexual intercourse with his wife and then he intends to repeat it, he should perform ablution. In the hadith transmitted by Abu Bakr. (the words are):" Between the two (acts) there should be an ablution," or he (the narrator) said:" Then he intended that it should be repeated."
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab tum mein se koi apni biwi se sambhog kare aur phir use dohraane ka iraada rakhe, to use wuzu karna chaahiye. Abu Bakr ki riwayat ki gayi hadees mein alfaaz hain: 'In dono ke darmiyaan wuzu hona chaahiye,' ya unhone kaha: 'Phir usne isko dohraane ka iraada kiya.'

e: Anas reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to have sexual intercourse with his wives with a single bath.
hi: Anas ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apni biwiyon ke saath ek hi ghusl se sambhog kiya karte the.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: Umm Sulaim who was the grandmother of Ishaq came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in the presence of 'A'isha and said to him: Messenger of Allah, in case or woman sees what a man sees in dream and she experiences in dream what a man experiences (i. e. experiences orgasm)? Upon this 'A'isha remarked: O Umm Sulaim, you brought humiliation to women;may your right hand be covered with dust. He (the Holy Prophet) said to 'A'isha: Let your hand be covered with dust, and (addressing Umm Sulaim) said: Well, O Umm Sulaim, she should take a bath if she sees that (i. e. she experiences orgasm in dream).
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bataaya: Umm Sulaim, jo Ishaq ki dadi thi, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas Aisha ki maujoodgi mein aayi aur unse kaha: Allah ke Rasool, agar koi aurat khwaab mein wo dekhe jo mard dekhta hai aur usko wo mehsoos ho jo mard mehsoos karta hai, yaani wo bhi khwaab mein orgasm mehsoos kare? Is par Aisha ne kaha: Aye Umm Sulaim, tumne auraton ko sharminda kar diya; tumhaara daayaan haath mitti se dhak jaaye. Aap (SAW) ne Aisha se kaha: Tumhaara haath mitti se dhak jaaye, aur Umm Sulaim se mukhaatib hokar kaha: Achha, Aye Umm Sulaim, agar aisa dekhe, to use ghusl karna chahiye.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Umm Sulaim narrated it that she asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about a woman who sees in a dream what a man sees (sexual dream). The Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon bi m) said: In case a woman sees that, she must take a bath. Umm Sulaim said: I was bashful on account of that and said: Does it happen? Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Yes (it does happen), otherwise how can (a child) resemble her? Man's discharge (i. e. sperm) is thick and white and the discharge of woman is thin and yellow; so the resemblance comes from the one whose genes prevail or dominate.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bataaya ki Umm Sulaim ne riwayat ki ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ek aisi aurat ke baare mein poocha jo khwaab mein wo dekhti hai jo mard dekhta hai, jinsi khwaab. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Agar aurat aisa dekhe, to use ghusl karna zaroori hai. Umm Sulaim ne kaha: Mujhe iski wajah se sharam aayi aur maine kaha: Kya aisa hota hai? Is par Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Haan, aisa hota hai, warna bachhe ka uske saath mushaabahat kaise hoti?
