Mard ka afraaz gaadha aur safed hota hai, aur aurat ka afraaz patla aur peela hota hai; is liye mushaabahat us shaks ki taraf hoti hai jiske jeen ghaalib ya haawi hon.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: A woman asked the Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him) about a woman who sees in her dream what a man sees in his dream (sexual dream). He (the Holy Prophet) said: If she experiences what a man experiences, she should take a bath.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bataaya: Ek aurat ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ek aisi aurat ke baare mein poocha jo apne khwaab mein wo dekhti hai jo mard apne khwaab mein dekhta hai, jinsi khwaab. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Agar wo wo mehsoos kare jo mard mehsoos karta hai, to use ghusl karna chaahiye.

e: Umm Salama reported: Umm Sulaim went to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: Apostle of Allah, Allah is not ashamed of the truth. Is bathing necessary for a woman when she has a sexual dream? Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Yes, when she sees the liquid (vaginal secretion). Umm Salama said: Messenger of Allah, does a woman have sexual dream? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Let your hand be covered with dust, in what way does her child resemble her?
hi: Umm Salama ne bataaya: Umm Sulaim Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gayi aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Allah haq baat se sharminda nahi hota. Kya aurat ke liye ghusl zaroori hai jab use jinsi khwaab aaye? Is par Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Haan, jab wo paani, yoni ka srav, dekhe. Umm Salama ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya aurat ko jinsi khwaab aata hai? Aap (SAW) ne kaha: Tumhaara haath mitti se dhak jaaye, warna uska bachcha uske saath kaise mushaabahat rakhta?

e: This hadith with the same sense (as narrated above) bus been transmitted from Hisham b. 'Urwa with the same chain of narrators but with this addition that she (Umm Salama) said: " You humiliated the women.
hi: Ye hadees isi mazmoon ke saath jaisi upar bayan hui Hisham bin Urwah se usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai, is izafe ke saath ki unhone kaha: 'Aap ne auraton ko sharminda kiya.'

e: 'A'isha the wife of the Apostle (ﷺ) narrated: Umm Sulaim, the mother of Bani Abu Talha, came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and a hadith (like that) narrated by Hisham was narrated but for these words. A'isha said: I expressed disapproval to her, saying: Does a woman see a sexual dream?
hi: Aisha, Rasool (SAW) ki biwi, ne bataaya: Umm Sulaim, Bani Abu Talha ki ma, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi, aur ek hadees jaisi Hisham ne bayan ki, riwayat ki gayi, sivaay in alfaaz ke. Aisha ne kaha: Maine unse naapasandi zaahir ki, ye kehte hue: Kya aurat ko jinsi khwaab aata hai?

e: It is reported on the authority of 'A'isha that a woman came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and inquired: Should a woman wash herself when she sees a sexual dream and sees (the marks) of liquid? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Yes. 'A'isha said to her: May your hand be covered with dust and injured. She narrated: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Leave her alone. In what way does the child resemble her but for the fact that when the genes contributed by woman prevail upon those of man, the child resembles the maternal family, and when the genes of man prevail upon those of woman the child resembles the paternal family.
hi: Aisha se riwayat hai ki ek aurat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur poocha: Kya aurat ko khud ko dhona chaahiye jab use jinsi khwaab aaye aur wo srav ke nishaan dekhe? Aap (SAW) ne kaha: Haan. Aisha ne usse kaha: Tumhaara haath mitti se dhak jaaye aur zakhmi ho jaaye. Unhone riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Use akela chhodo. Uska bachcha uske saath kaise mushaabahat rakhta agar aisa na ho ki jab aurat ke jeen mard ke jeenon par ghaalib aayein, to bachche mein ma ke khaandaan ki mushaabahat hoti hai, aur jab mard ke jeen aurat ke jeenon par ghaalib aayein, to bachche mein baap ke khaandaan ki mushaabahat hoti hai.

e: Thauban, the freed slave of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), said: While I was standing beside the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) one of the rabbis of the Jews came and said: Peace be upon you, O Muhammad. I pushed him backwith a push that he was going to fall. Upon this he said: Why do you push me? I said: Why don't you say: O Messenger of Allah? The Jew said: We call him by the name by which he was named by his family. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: My name is Muhammad with which I was named by my family. The Jew said: I have come to ask you (something). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Should that thing be of any benefit to you, if I tell you that? He (the Jew) said: I will lend my ears to it. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) drew a line with the help of the stick that he had with him and then said: Ask (whatever you like). Thereupon the Jew said: Where would the human beings be on the Daywhen the earth would change into another earth and the heavens too (would change into other heavens)? The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: They would be in darkness beside the Bridge. He (the Jew) again said: Who amongst people would be the first to cross (this bridge).? He said: They would be the poor amongst the refugees. The Jew said: What would constitute their breakfast when they would enter Paradise? He (the Holy Prophet) replied: A caul of the fish-liver. He (the Jew) said. What would be their food alter this? He (the Holy Prophet) said: A bullockwhich was fed in the different quarters of Paradise would be slaughtered for them. He (the Jew) said: What would be their drink? He (the Holy Prophet) said: They would be given drink from the fountain which is named" Salsabil". He (the Jew) said: I have come to ask you about a thing which no one amongst the people on the earth knows except an apostle or one or two men besides him. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Would it benefit you if I tell you that? He (the Jew) said: I would lend ears to that. He then said: I have come to ask you about the child. He (the Holy Prophet) said: The reproductive substance of man is white and that of woman (i. e. ovum central portion) yellow, and when they have sexual intercourse and the male's substance (chromosomes and genes) prevails upon the female's substance (chromosomes and genes), it is the male child that is created by Allah's Decree, and when the substance of the female prevails upon the substance contributed by the male, a female child is formed by the Decree of Allah. The Jew said: What you have said is true; verily you are an Apostle. He then returned and went away. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: He asked me about such and such things of which I have had no knowledge till Allah gave me that.
hi: Thauban, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke aazaad kiye gulaam, ne kaha: Jab main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas khada tha, Yahudiyon ke ek rabbi ne aakar kaha: Tumpar salaamati ho, Aye Muhammad. Maine use itni zor se dhakela ki wo gir jaate-jaate bacha. Is par usne kaha: Tum mujhe kyun dhakel rahe ho? Maine kaha: Tum 'Aye Allah ke Rasool' kyun nahi kehte? Yahudi ne kaha: Hum use us naam se pukaarte hain jo uske khaandaan ne rakha tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Mera naam Muhammad hai jo mere khaandaan ne rakha tha. Yahudi ne kaha: Main kuch poochne aaya hoon. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Kya isse tumhein koi faayda hoga, agar main tumhein bataaun? Usne kaha: Main dhyaan se sununga. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne paas maujood chhadi se ek lakeer kheenchi aur phir kaha: Poocho. Is par Yahudi ne kaha: Log kahan honge us Din jab zameen doosri zameen mein badal jaayegi aur aasman bhi doosre aasmanon mein badal jaayenge? Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Wo Pul-e-Siraat ke qareeb andhere mein honge. Usne dobara kaha: Log mein sabse pehle kaun ye pul paar karega? Unhone kaha: Wo muhaajireen mein se gareeb log honge. Yahudi ne kaha: Jab wo Jannat mein daakhil honge, to unka naashta kya hoga? Aap (SAW) ne jawaab diya: Machhli ke jigar ka ek tukda. Usne kaha: Iske baad unka khaana kya hoga? Aap (SAW) ne kaha: Jannat ke alag-alag hisson mein chara hua ek bael zibah kiya jaayega unke liye. Usne kaha: Unka mashroob kya hoga? Aap (SAW) ne kaha: Unhein us chashme se peene ko diya jaayega jise 'Salsabil' kaha jaata hai. Usne kaha: Main tumse ek aisi cheez ke baare mein poochne aaya hoon jise zameen par koi nahi jaanta sivaay ek Rasool ke ya uske alaawa ek ya do logon ke. Aap (SAW) ne kaha: Kya isse tumhein faayda hoga agar main tumhein bataaun? Usne kaha: Main dhyaan se sununga. Phir usne kaha: Main tumse bachche ke baare mein poochne aaya hoon. Aap (SAW) ne kaha: Mard ka paida karne wala maadda safed hota hai aur aurat ka, yaani beeja ka markazi hissa, peela hota hai, aur jab wo sambhog karte hain aur mard ka maadda aurat ke maadde par ghaalib aata hai, to Allah ke hukum se ladka paida hota hai, aur jab aurat ka maadda mard ke maadde par ghaalib hota hai, to Allah ke hukum se ladki paida hoti hai. Yahudi ne kaha: Jo aap ne kaha wo sach hai; yaqeenan aap ek Rasool hain. Phir wo wapas mudkar chala gaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Usne mujhse aisi-aisi baaton ke baare mein poocha jinka mujhe koi ilm nahi tha yahan tak ki Allah ne mujhe wo ata kiya.

e: This tradition has been narrated by Mu'awyia b. Salim with the same chain of transmitters except for the words: I was sitting beside the Messenger of Allah" and some other minor alterations.
hi: Ye riwayat Mu'awiya bin Salim ne usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai, sivaay in alfaaz ke: 'Main Allah ke Rasool ke paas baitha hua tha' aur kuch aur chhoti tabdeeliyaan.

e: 'A'isha reported: When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) bathed because of sexual intercourse, he first washed his hands: he then poured water with his right hand on his left hand and washed his private parts. He then performed ablution as is done for prayer'. He then took some water and put his fingers and moved them through the roots of his hair. And when he found that these had been properly mois- tened, then poured three handfuls on his head and then poured water over his body and subsequently washed his feet.
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) sambhog ki wajah se ghusl karte, to pehle apne haath dhote; phir wo apne daaye haath se apne baaye haath par paani daalte aur apni sharmgaah dhote. Phir wo namaz jaisa wuzu karte. Phir wo thoda paani lete aur apni ungliyon ko apne baalon ki jadon mein le jaate. Aur jab unhein laga ki wo achhi tarah bheeg gaye hain, to wo apne sar par teen mutthi paani daalte aur phir apne poore jism par paani daalte, aur phir apne paanv dhote.

e: This hadith is narrated by Abu Kuraib. Ibn Numair and others, all on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters, but in their narration these words are not there: " washed his feet."
hi: Ye hadees Abu Kuraib, Ibn Numair aur doosron ne Hisham ki sanad se, usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai, lekin unki riwayat mein ye alfaaz nahi hain: 'apne paanv dhoye.'

e: Hisham narrated it from his father, who narrated it on the authority of 'A'isha that when the Apostle (ﷺ) took a bath because of sexual inter-course, he first washed the palms of his hands three times, and then the whole hadith was transmitted like that based on the authority of Abu Mu'awyia, but no mention is made of the washing of feet.
hi: Hisham ne ise apne waalid se riwayat ki jinhone Aisha ki sanad se riwayat ki ki jab Rasool (SAW) sambhog ki wajah se ghusl karte, to pehle apni hatheliyaan teen baar dhote, aur phir poori hadees usi tarah riwayat ki gayi jaisi Abu Mu'awiya ki sanad se, lekin paanv dhone ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: 'Urwa has narrated it on the authority of 'A'isha that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took a bath because of sexual intercourse, he first washed his hands before dipping one of them into the basin, and then performed ablu- tion as is done for prayer.
hi: Urwah ne ise Aisha ki sanad se riwayat ki ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) sambhog ki wajah se ghusl karte, to pehle apne haath dhote isse pehle ki unhein bartan mein daalein, aur phir namaz jaisa wuzu karte.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported it on the authority of Maimuna, his mother's sister, that she said: I placed water near the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) to take a bath because of sexual intercourse. He washed the palms of his bands twice or thrice and then put his hand In the basin and poured water over his private parts and washed them with his left hand. He then struck his hand against the earth and rubbed it with force and then performed ablution for the prayer and then poured three handfuls of water on his head and then washed his whole body after which he moved aside from that place and washed his feet, and then I brought a towel (so that he may wipe his body). but he returned it.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne ise Maimuna, apni khaala, ki sanad se riwayat ki ki unhone kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas sambhog ki wajah se ghusl karne ke liye paani rakha. Unhone apni hatheliyaan do ya teen baar dhoyi aur phir apna haath bartan mein daala aur apni sharmgaah par paani daala aur unhein apne baaye haath se dhoya. Phir unhone apna haath zameen par maara aur zor se ragda aur phir namaz ke liye wuzu kiya aur phir apne sar par teen mutthi paani daale aur phir apna poora jism dhoya, jiske baad wo us jagah se hat gaye aur apne paanv dhoye, aur phir main ek taulia le aayi taaki wo apna jism ponchh sakein, lekin unhone use wapas kar diya.

e: This hadith is narrated by A'mash with the same chain of transmitters, but in the hadith narrated by Yahya b. Yahya and Abu Kuraib there is no mention of: " Pouring of three handfuls of water on the head." and in the hadith narrated by Waki' all the features of ablution have been recorded: rinsing (of mouth), snuffing of water (in the nostrils) ; and in the hadith transmitted by Abu Mu'awyia, there is no mention of a towel.
hi: Ye hadees A'mash ne usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai, lekin Yahya bin Yahya aur Abu Kuraib ki riwayat ki gayi hadees mein 'sar par teen mutthi paani daalne' ka zikr nahi hai, aur Waki ki riwayat ki gayi hadees mein wuzu ke sab hisson ka zikr hai: kulli karna, naak mein paani cheenchna; aur Abu Mu'awiya ki riwayat ki gayi hadees mein taulia ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated It on the authority of Maimuna that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was given a towel, but he did not rub (his body) with it, but he did like this with water, i. e. he shook it off.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne ise Maimuna se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ek tauliya diya gaya, lekin unhone use apne jism par istemaal nahi kiya, balki wo paani ke saath aisa kuch karte the, yaani wo use jhaad dete the.

e: 'A'isha reported: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took a bath because of sexual intercourse, he called for a vessel and took a handful of water from it and first (washed) the right side of his head, then left, and then took a handful (of water) and poured it on his head.
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) sambhog ki wajah se ghusl karte, to wo ek bartan mangwaate aur usmein se ek mutthi paani lete aur pehle apne sar ke daayin taraf dhote, phir baayin taraf, aur phir ek mutthi paani lete aur use apne sar par undel dete.

e: 'A'isha reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) washed himself with water from a vessel (measuring seven to eight seers) because of sexual intercourse.
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) sambhog ki wajah se ek bartan, jismein saat se aath seer paani hota tha, ke paani se khud ko dhote the.

e: 'A'isha reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took a bath from the vessel (which contained seven to eight seers, i. e. fifteen to sixteen pounds) of water And I and he (the Holy Prophet) took a bath from the same vessel. And in the hadith narrated by Sufyan the words are:" from one vessel". Qutaiba said: Al-Faraq is three Sa' (a cubic measuring of varying magnitude).
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek bartan, jismein saat se aath seer, yaani pandrah se solah pound paani tha, se ghusl kiya. Aur main aur wo usi bartan se ghusl karte the. Aur Sufyan ki riwayat ki gayi hadees mein alfaaz hain: 'ek hi bartan se.' Qutaiba ne kaha: Al-Faraq teen Sa' ke barabar ek paimana hai jiski maatra alag-alag hoti hai.

e: Abu Salamab. 'Abd al-Rahman reported: I along with the foster brother of 'A'isha went to her and he asked about the bath of the Apostle (ﷺ) because of sexual intercourse. She called for a vessel equal to a Sa' and she took a bath. and there was a curtain between us and her. She poured water on her head thrice and he (Abu Salama) said: The wives of the Apostle (ﷺ) collectedhair on their heads and these lopped up to ears (and did rot go beyond that).
hi: Abu Salama bin Abdur Rahman ne bataaya: Main Aisha ke doodh-shareek bhai ke saath unke paas gaya aur unhone Rasool (SAW) ke sambhog ke baad ghusl ke baare mein poocha. Unhone ek Sa' ke barabar bartan mangwaaya aur ghusl kiya, aur humaare aur unke darmiyaan ek parda tha. Unhone apne sar par teen baar paani daala aur unhone kaha: Rasool (SAW) ki biwiyaan apne sar ke baalon ko ikattha bandh leti thi aur wo kaanon tak katte hue hote the aur usse aage nahi badhte the.

e: Salama b. Abd al-Rahman narrated it on the authority of A'isha that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took a bath, he started from the right hand and poured water over it and washed it, and then poured water on the impurity with the right band and washed it away with the help of the left hand. and after having removed it, he poured water on his head. A'isha said: I and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took a bath from the same vessel, after sexual intercourse.
hi: Salama bin Abdur Rahman ne ise Aisha se riwayat ki ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ghusl karte, to wo daaye haath se shuru karte aur uspar paani daalte aur use dhote, phir napaaki waali jagah par daaye haath se paani daalte aur baaye haath ki madad se use dho dete, aur use hataane ke baad, wo apne sar par paani daalte. Aisha ne kaha: Main aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) sambhog ke baad ek hi bartan se ghusl karte the.

e: Hafsa, daughter of 'Abd al-Rahman b. Abu Bakr, reported that 'A'isha narrated to her that she and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took a bath from the same vessel which contained water equal to three Mudds or thereabout.
hi: Hafsa, Abdur Rahman bin Abu Bakr ki beti, ne bataaya ki Aisha ne unse kaha ki wo aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek hi bartan se ghusl karte the jismein teen Mudd ke barabar ya uske kareeb paani hota tha.

e: 'A'isha reported: I and the Messenger (ﷺ) took a bath from the same vessel and our hands alternated into it in the state that we had had sexual intercourse.
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Main aur Rasool (SAW) ek hi bartan se ghusl karte the aur humaare haath usmein baari-baari se jaate the jab hum sambhog kar chuke hote the.

e: 'A'isha reported: I and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took a bath from one vessel which was placed between me and him and he would get ahead of me, so that I would say: Spare (some water for) me, spare (some water for) me; and she said that they had had sexual intercourse.
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Main aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek hi bartan se ghusl karte the jo mere aur unke darmiyaan rakha jaata, aur wo mujhse aage nikal jaate, is liye main kehti: Mere liye bhi thoda paani bacha do, mere liye bhi bacha do; aur unhone bataaya ki unhone sambhog kiya tha.

e: Ibn Abbas said: Maimuna (the wife of the Holy Prophet) reported to me that she and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took a bath from one vessel.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne kaha: Maimuna, Nabi (SAW) ki biwi, ne mujhe bataaya ki wo aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek hi bartan se ghusl karte the.

e: Ibn Abbas reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took a bath with the water left over by Maimuna.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bataaya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Maimuna ke bache hue paani se ghusl kiya.

e: Zainab bint Umm Salama (the wife of the Holy Prophet) reported that Umm Salama and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took a bath from the same vessel.
hi: Zainab bint Umm Salama, Nabi (SAW) ki biwi, ne bataaya ki Umm Salama aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek hi bartan se ghusl karte the.

e: Anas reported that the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) took a bath with five Makkuks of water and performed ablution with one Makkuk. Ibn Muthanna has used the words five Makakiyya, and Ibn Mu'adh narrated it from 'Abdullah b. 'Abdullah and he made no mention of Ibn Jabr.
hi: Anas ne bataaya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne paanch Makkuk paani se ghusl kiya aur ek Makkuk se wuzu kiya. Ibn Muthanna ne 'paanch Makakiyya' alfaaz istemaal kiye hain, aur Ibn Mu'adh ne ise Abdullah bin Abdullah se riwayat ki aur Ibn Jabr ka koi zikr nahi kiya.

e: Anas said: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) performed ablution with one Mudd and took bath with a Sa' up to five Mudds.
hi: Anas ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek Mudd se wuzu kiya aur ek Sa' se paanch Mudd tak paani se ghusl kiya.

e: Safina reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took a bath with one Sa` of water because of sexual intercourse and performed ablution with one Mudd.
hi: Safina ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne sambhog ki wajah se ek Sa' paani se ghusl kiya aur ek Mudd se wuzu kiya.

e: Safina reported that Abu Bakr, the Companion of the Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him), observed: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took a bath with one Sa' of water and performed ablution with one Mudd (of water) ; and in the hadith narrated by Ibn Hujr the words are: One Mudd sufficed for his (Holy Prophet's) ablution. And Ibn Hujr said that (his Shaikh) Isma'il was much advanced in age, and it was because of this that he could not fully rely on him for this tradition.
hi: Safina ne bataaya ki Abu Bakr, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saathi, ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek Sa' paani se ghusl kiya aur ek Mudd paani se wuzu kiya; aur Ibn Hujr ki riwayat ki gayi hadees mein alfaaz hain: Ek Mudd unke wuzu ke liye kaafi tha. Aur Ibn Hujr ne kaha ki unke ustaad Ismail bahut zyada umr rasida the, aur isi wajah se wo is riwayat ke liye poori tarah unpar bharosa nahi kar sakte the.

e: Jubair b. Mut'im reported: The people contended amongst themselves in the presence of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) with regard to bathing. Some of them said: We wash our heads like this and this. Upon this the Messenger (ﷺ) said: As for me I pour three handfuls of water upon my head.
hi: Jubair bin Mut'im ne bataaya: Log Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki maujoodgi mein ghusl ke baare mein aapas mein bahas karne lage. Unmein se kuch ne kaha: Hum apne sar is-is tarah dhote hain. Is par Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jahan tak mera taalluq hai, main apne sar par teen mutthi paani daalta hoon.

e: Jubair b. Mut'im reported it from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that a mention was made before him about bathing because of sexual intercourse and he said: I pour water over my head thrice.
hi: Jubair bin Mut'im ne ise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unke saamne sambhog ki wajah se ghusl ka zikr hua aur unhone kaha: Main apne sar par teen baar paani daalta hoon.

e:
Jabir b. Abdullah reported: A delegation of the Thaqif said to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): Our land is cold; what about our bathing then? He (the Holy Prophet) said: I pour water thrice over my head.
Ibn Salim in his narration reported:" The delegation of the Thaqif said: Messenger of Allah."
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bataaya: Thaqif ke ek wafd ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kaha: Hamaari zameen thandi hai; to humaare ghusl ke baare mein kya hukum hai? Unhone kaha: Main apne sar par teen baar paani daalta hoon. Ibn Salim ne apni riwayat mein bataaya: 'Thaqif ke wafd ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool.'

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took a bath because of sexual intercourse, he poured three handfuls of water upon his head. Hasan b. Muhammad said to him (the narrator): My hair is thick. Upon this Jabir observed. I said to him: O son of my brother, the hair of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was thicker than your hair and these were more fine (than yours).
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bataaya: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) sambhog ki wajah se ghusl karte, to wo apne sar par teen mutthi paani daalte. Hasan bin Muhammad ne unse kaha: Mere baal ghane hain. Is par Jabir ne kaha: Maine unse kaha: Aye mere bhatije, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke baal tumhaare baalon se zyada ghane the aur wo tumhaare baalon se zyada mulaayam the.

e: Umm Salama reported: I said: Messenger of Allah, I am a woman who has closely plaited hair on my head; should I undo it for taking a bath, because of sexual intercourse? He (the Holy Prophet) said: No, it is enough for you to throw three handfuls of water on your head and then pour water over yourself, and you shall be purified.
hi: Umm Salama ne bataaya: Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, main ek aisi aurat hoon jiske sar par kaste hue baal bunte hain; kya mujhe sambhog ki wajah se ghusl ke liye unhein khol dena chahiye? Unhone kaha: Nahi, tumhaare liye itna hi kaafi hai ki tum apne sar par teen mutthi paani daalo aur phir apne oopar paani daalo, aur tum paak ho jaogi.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Amr al-Naqid, Yazid b. Harun, 'Abd b. Humaid, Abd al-Razzaq, Thauri, Ayyub b. Musa, with the same chain of transmitters. In hadith narrated by Abd al-Razzaq there is a mention of the menstruation and of the sexual intercourse. The rest of the hadith has been transmitted like that of Ibn 'Uyaina.
hi: Ye hadees Amr an-Naqid, Yazid bin Harun, Abd bin Humaid, Abdur Razzaq, Thauri, Ayyub bin Musa ne usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai. Abdur Razzaq ki riwayat ki gayi hadees mein haiz aur sambhog dono ka zikr hai. Baaki hadees Ibn Uyaina ki riwayat jaisi hi hai.

e: This hadith is narrated by the same chain of transmitters by Ahmad al. Darimi, Zakariya b. 'Adi, Yazid, i. e. ' Ibn Zurai', Rauh b. al-Qasim, Ayyub b. Musa with the same chain of transmitters, and there is a mention of these words: " Should I undo the plait and wash it, because of sexual intercourse?" and there is no mention of menstruation.
hi: Ye hadees isi sanad ke saath Ahmad al-Darimi, Zakariya bin Adi, Yazid (yaani Ibn Zurai), Rauh bin al-Qasim, Ayyub bin Musa ne bhi riwayat ki hai, aur ismein ye alfaaz hain: 'Kya mujhe baalon ki chuti khol kar dhoni chahiye, sambhog ki wajah se?' aur haiz ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: 'Ubaid b. Umair reported: It was conveyed to 'A'isha that 'Abdullah b. 'Amr ordered the women to undo the (plaits) of hair on their heads. She said: How strange it is for Ibn 'Amr that he orders the women to undo the plaits of their head while taking a bath; why does he not order them to shave their beads? I and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took bath from one vessel. I did no more than this that I poured three handfuls of water over my head.
hi: Ubaid bin Umair ne bataaya: Aisha ko bataaya gaya ki Abdullah bin Amr ne auraton ko apne sar ke baalon ki chutiyaan khol dene ka hukum diya. Unhone kaha: Kitni ajeeb baat hai Ibn Amr ki, ki wo auraton ko ghusl karte waqt apne baalon ki chutiyaan kholne ka hukum dete hain; wo unhein apne sar mundwaane ka hukum kyun nahi dete? Main aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek hi bartan se ghusl karte the. Maine sirf itna hi kiya ki maine apne sar par teen mutthi paani daala.

e: 'A'isha reported: A woman asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) how to wash herself after menstruation. She mentioned that he taught her how to take bath and then told her to take a piece of cotton with musk and purify herself. She said: How should I purify myself with that? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Praise be to Allah, purify yourself with it, and covered his face, Sufyan b. 'Uyaina gave a demonstration by covering his face (as the Prophet had done). 'A'isha reported: I dragged her to my side for I had understood what the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) intended and, therefore, said: Apply this cotton with musk to the trace of blood. Ibn 'Umar in his hadith (has mentioned the words of 'A'isha thus): Apply it to the marks of blood.
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Ek aurat ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se poocha ki haiz ke baad khud ko kaise dhoye. Unhone zikr kiya ki unhone use ghusl karna sikhaaya aur phir usse kaha ki wo kasturi lage hue rooi ka ek tukda le aur apne aap ko paak kare. Usne kaha: Main usse khud ko kaise paak karoon? Unhone kaha: Allah ki tareef, apne aap ko usse paak karo, aur apna chehra dhaank liya. Sufyan bin Uyaina ne apna chehra dhaank kar is amal ka muzaahara kiya. Aisha ne bataaya: Maine use apni taraf khinch liya kyunki main samajh gayi thi ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka kya matlab tha, is liye maine kaha: Is kasturi lage rooi ko khoon ke nishaan par lagaao. Ibn Umar ne apni hadees mein Aisha ke alfaaz ka zikr is tarah kiya hai: Ise khoon ke nishaanon par lagaao.

e: 'A'isha reported: A woman asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) how he should wash herself after the menstrual period. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Take a cotton with musk and purity yourself, and the rest of the hadith was narrated like that of Sufyan.
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Ek aurat ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se poocha ki haiz ki muddat ke baad wo khud ko kaise dhoye. Unhone kaha: Kasturi lagi hui rooi lo aur khud ko paak karo, aur baaki hadees Sufyan ki riwayat jaisi hi bayan ki gayi.

e: 'A'isha reported: Asma (daughter of Shakal) asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about washing after menstruation. He said: Everyone amongst you should use water (mixed with the leaves of) the lote-tree and cleanse herself well, and then pour water on her head and rub it vigorously till it reaches the roots of the hair. Then she should pour water on it. Afterwards she should take a piece of cotton smeared with musk and cleanse herself with it. Asma' said: How should she cleanse herself with the help of that? Upon this he (the Messenger of Allah) observed: Praise be to Allah, she should cleanse herself. 'A'isha said in a subdued tone that she should apply it to the trace of blood. She (Asma) then further asked about bathing after sexual intercourse. He (the Holy Prophet) said: She should take water and cleanse herself well or complete the ablution and then (pour water) on her head and rub it till it reaches the roots of the hair (of her) head and then pour water on her. 'A'isha said: How good are the women of Ansar (helpers) that their shyness does not prevent them from learning religion.
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Asma (Shakal ki beti) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se haiz ke baad ghusl ke baare mein poocha. Unhone kaha: Tum mein se har aurat ko bair ke ped ki pattiyon mile paani ka istemaal karna chahiye aur achhi tarah safaayi karni chahiye, aur phir apne sar par paani daalna chahiye aur ise itni sakhti se ragadna chahiye ki wo baalon ki jadon tak pahunche. Phir use uspar paani daalna chahiye. Iske baad use kasturi lagi hui rooi ka ek tukda lena chahiye aur usse khud ko saaf karna chahiye. Asma ne kaha: Wo usse khud ko kaise saaf kare? Is par unhone kaha: Allah ki tareef, wo khud ko saaf kare. Aisha ne halke se lehje mein kaha ki use khoon ke nishaan par lagaana chahiye. Unhone phir sambhog ke baad ghusl ke baare mein poocha. Unhone kaha: Use paani lena chahiye aur khud ko achhi tarah saaf karna chahiye ya wuzu mukammal karna chahiye aur phir apne sar par paani daalna chahiye aur use itni sakhti se ragadna chahiye ki wo sar ke baalon ki jadon tak pahunche aur phir apne oopar paani daalna chahiye. Aisha ne kaha: Ansaar ki auraten kitni achhi hain ki unki sharm unhein deen seekhne se nahi rokti.

e: This hadith is narrated by 'Ubaidullah b. Mu'adh with the same chain of transmitters (but for the words) that he (the Holy Prophet) said: Cleanse yourself with it, and he covered (his face on account of shyness).
hi: Ye hadees Ubaidullah bin Mu'adh ne usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai, sivaay in alfaaz ke, ki unhone kaha: Usse khud ko saaf karo, aur unhone sharm ki wajah se apna chehra dhaank liya.

e: 'A'isha reported: Asma' b. Shakal came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: Messenger of Allah, how one amongst us should take a bath after the menstruation, and the rest of the hadith is the same and there is no mention of bathing because of sexual intercourse.
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Asma bint Shakal Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, humme se koi haiz ke baad ghusl kaise kare? Aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai aur sambhog ki wajah se ghusl ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: 'A'isha reported: Fatimah b. Abu Hubaish came to the Apostle (ﷺ) and said: I am a woman whose blood keeps flowing (even after the menstruation period). I am never purified; should I, therefore, abandon prayer? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Not at all, for that is only a vein, and is not a menstruation, so when menstruation comes, abandon prayer, and when it ends wash the blood from yourself and then pray.
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Fatima bint Abu Hubaish Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha: Main ek aisi aurat hoon jiska khoon lagataar behta rehta hai, haiz ki muddat ke baad bhi. Main kabhi paak nahi hoti; kya mujhe namaz chhod deni chahiye? Unhone kaha: Bilkul nahi, kyunki ye sirf ek rag hai, haiz nahi hai, is liye jab haiz aaye, to namaz chhod do, aur jab wo khatam ho jaaye, to khud se khoon dho lo aur phir namaz padho.

e: The hadith narrated by Waki' and with its chain of narrators has been transmitted on the authority of Hisham b. 'Urwa, but in the hadith narrated by Qutaiba on the authority of Jarir, the words are: " There came Fatimah b. Abu Hubaish, b. 'Abd al-Muttalib b. Asad, and she was a woman amongst us," and in the hadith of Hammid b. Zaid there is an addition of these words:" We abandoned mentioning him."
hi: Waki ki riwayat ki gayi hadees, apni sanad ke saath, Hisham bin Urwah se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin Qutaiba ki riwayat mein, Jarir ki sanad se, alfaaz hain: 'Fatima bint Abu Hubaish bin Abdul-Muttalib bin Asad aayi, aur wo humaare beech ki ek aurat thi,' aur Hammad bin Zaid ki hadees mein in alfaaz ka izafa hai: 'Humne unka zikr karna chhod diya.'

e: 'A'isha reported: Umm Habiba b. Jahsh thus asked for a verdict from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): I am a woman whose blood keeps flowing (after the menstrual period). He (the Holy Prophet) said: That is only a vein, so take a bath and offer prayer; and she took a bath at the time of every prayer. Laith b. Sa'd said: Ibn Shihab made no mention that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had ordered her to take a bath at the time of every prayer, but she did it of her own accord. And in the tradition transmitted by Ibn Rumh there is no mention of Umm Habiba (and there is mention of the daughter of Jahsh only.)
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Umm Habiba bint Jahsh ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se is tarah faisla poocha: Main ek aisi aurat hoon jiska khoon haiz ki muddat ke baad bhi behta rehta hai. Unhone kaha: Ye sirf ek rag hai, is liye ghusl karo aur namaz padho; aur wo har namaz ke waqt ghusl karti thi. Laith bin Sa'd ne kaha: Ibn Shihab ne ye zikr nahi kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhein har namaz ke waqt ghusl karne ka hukum diya tha, balki unhone khud apni marzi se aisa kiya. Aur Ibn Rumh ki riwayat mein Umm Habiba ka koi zikr nahi hai aur sirf Jahsh ki beti ka zikr hai.

e: 'A'isha, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) reported: Umm Habiba b. Jahsh who was the sister-in-law of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and the wife of 'Abd al-Rahman b. Auf, remained mustahada for seven years, and she, therefore, asked for the verdict of Shari'ah from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about it The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: This is not menstruation, but (blood from) a vein: so bathe yourself and offer prayer. 'A'isha said: She took a bath in the wash-tub placed in the apartment of her sister Zainab b. Jahsh, till the redness of the blood came over the water. Ibn Shihab said: I narrated it to Abu Bakr b. 'Abd al-Rahman b. al-Harith b. Hisham about it who observed: May Allah have mercy on Hinda! would that she listened to this verdict. By Lord, she wept for not offering prayer.
hi: Aisha, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki biwi, ne bataaya: Umm Habiba bint Jahsh, jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki saali thi aur Abdur Rahman bin Auf ki biwi thi, saat saal tak Mustahaada rahi, is liye unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se is baare mein Shariat ka faisla poocha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ye haiz nahi hai, balki ek rag ka khoon hai: is liye khud ko dho lo aur namaz padho. Aisha ne kaha: Wo apni bahen Zainab bint Jahsh ke kamre mein rakhe kunde mein ghusl karti thi, yahan tak ki khoon ki surkhi paani ke oopar aa jaati thi. Ibn Shihab ne kaha: Maine ye Abu Bakr bin Abdur Rahman bin al-Harith bin Hisham ko sunaayi jinhone kaha: Allah Hinda par rehem kare! Kaash unhone ye faisla suna hota. Allah ki qasam, wo namaz na padh paane ki wajah se roti thi.

e: This hadith has been thus reported by another chain of transmitters: Umm Habiba b. Jahsh came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and she had been a mustahada for seven years, and the rest of the hadith was narrated like that of 'Amr b. al-Harith up to the words:" There came the redness of the blood over water." and nothing was narrated beyond it.
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad ke saath is tarah riwayat ki gayi hai: Umm Habiba bint Jahsh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur wo saat saal se Mustahaada thi, aur baaki hadees Amr bin al-Harith ki riwayat jaisi bayan ki gayi hai in alfaaz tak: 'Khoon ki surkhi paani ke oopar aa gayi,' aur uske aage kuch riwayat nahi ki gayi.

e: The hadith has been narrated by 'A'isha through another chain of transmitters (in these words): I The daughter of jahsh had been mustabida for seven years," and the rest of the hadith is the same (as mentioned above).
hi: Ye hadees Aisha se ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai in alfaaz mein: 'Jahsh ki beti saat saal se Mustahaada thi,' aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai jaisa upar zikr hua.

e: On the authority of 'A'isha: Umm Habiba asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about the blood (which flows beyond the period of menstruation). 'A'isha said: I saw her wash-tub full of blood. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Remain away (from prayer) equal (to the length of time) that your menses prevented you. After this (after the period of usual courses) bathe yourself and offer prayer.
hi: Aisha ki sanad se: Umm Habiba ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se haiz ki muddat se aage behne wale khoon ke baare mein poocha. Aisha ne kaha: Maine unka kunda khoon se bhara dekha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Utni der namaz se door raho jitni der tumhaara haiz tumhein rokta tha. Iske baad khud ko dho lo aur namaz padho.

e: 'A'isha, the wife of the Apostle (ﷺ), said: Umm Habiba b. Jahsh who was the spouse of Abd al- Rahman b. Auf made a complaint to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about blood (which flows beyond the menstrual period). He said to her: Remain away (from prayer) equal (to the length of time) that your menstruation holds you back. After this, bathe yourself. And she washed herself before every prayer.
hi: Aisha, Rasool (SAW) ki biwi, ne kaha: Umm Habiba bint Jahsh, jo Abdur Rahman bin Auf ki biwi thi, ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se haiz ki muddat se aage behne wale khoon ki shikaayat ki. Unhone unse kaha: Utni der namaz se door raho jitni der tumhaara haiz tumhein rokta hai. Iske baad, khud ko dho lo. Aur wo har namaz se pehle khud ko dhoti thi.

e: Mu'adha reported: A woman asked 'A'isha: Should one amongst us complete prayers abandoned during the period of menses? 'A'isha said: Are you a Haruriya? When any one of us during the time of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was in her menses (and abandoned prayer) she was not required to complete them.
hi: Mu'adha ne bataaya: Ek aurat ne Aisha se poocha: Kya hum mein se kisi ko haiz ke daur mein chhodi hui namazein poori karni chaahiye? Aisha ne kaha: Kya tum Haruriya ho? Jab hum mein se koi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke daur mein haiz mein hoti thi, to use unhein poora karne ki zaroorat nahi hoti thi.

e: It is reported from Mu'adha that she asked 'A'isha: Should a menstruating woman complete the prayer (abandoned during the menstrual period)? 'A'isha said: Are you a Hurariya? The wives of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) have had their monthly courses, (but) did he order them to make compensation (for the abandoned prayers)? Muhammad b. Ja'far said: (Compensation) denotes their completion.
hi: Mu'adha se riwayat hai ki unhone Aisha se poocha: Kya haiz waali aurat ko namaz jo haiz ke daur mein chhodi ho poori karni chaahiye? Aisha ne kaha: Kya tum Haruriya ho? Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki biwiyon ko haiz aata tha, lekin kya unhone unhein badla karne ka hukum diya? Muhammad bin Ja'far ne kaha: Badla ka matlab hai unhein poora karna.

e: Mu'adha said: I asked 'A'isha: What is the reason that a menstruating woman completes the fasts (that she abandons during her monthly course). but she does not complete the prayers? She (Hadrat 'A'isha) said: Are you a Haruriya? I said: I am not a Haruriya, but I simply want to inquire. She said: We passed through this (period of menstruation), and we were ordered to complete the fasts, but were not ordered to complete the prayers.
hi: Mu'adha ne kaha: Maine Aisha se poocha: Iski kya wajah hai ki haiz waali aurat roze poore karti hai jo usne apni maasik muddat mein chhode lekin namazein poori nahi karti? Unhone kaha: Kya tum Haruriya ho? Maine kaha: Main Haruriya nahi hoon, lekin main sirf poochna chaahti hoon. Unhone kaha: Hum is haiz ki muddat se guzarte the, aur humein roze poore karne ka hukum diya jaata tha, lekin namazein poori karne ka hukum nahi diya jaata tha.

e: Umm Hani b. Abu Talib reported: I went to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the day of the conquest (of Mecca) and found him take a bath. while his daughter Fatimah was holding a curtain around him.
hi: Umm Hani bint Abu Talib ne bataaya: Main Fatah ke din Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gayi aur maine paaya ki wo ghusl kar rahe hain, jabki unki beti Fatima (Alayhas Salam) unke ird-gird parda pakde hue thi.

e: Umm Hani b. Abu Talib reported: It was the day of the conquest (of Mecca) that she went to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he was staying at a higher part (of that city). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) got up for his bath. Fatimah held a curtain around him (in order to provide him privacy). He then put on his garments and wrapped himself with that and then offered eight rak'ahs of the forenoon prayer.
hi: Umm Hani bint Abu Talib ne bataaya: Ye Fatah ka din tha jab wo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gayi aur wo shahar ke ek oonche hisse mein thehre hue the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apne ghusl ke liye uthe. Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ne unke ird-gird parda pakda, unhein parda dene ke liye. Phir unhone apne kapde pehne aur usse khud ko lapeta aur phir chaasht ki namaz ki aath rakaatein padhi.

e: This hadith is narrated by Sa'id b. Abu Hind with the same chain of transmitters and said: His (the Holy Prophet's) daughter Fatimah provided him privacy with the help of his cloth, and when he had taken a bath he took it up and wrapped it around him and then stood and offered eight rak'ahs of the forenoon prayer.
hi: Ye hadees Sa'id bin Abu Hind ne usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai aur kaha: Unki beti Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ne unhein apne kapde se parda diya, aur jab unhone ghusl kar liya, to unhone use utha liya aur apne ird-gird lapet liya aur phir khade hokar chaasht ki namaz ki aath rakaatein padhi.

e: Maimuna reported: I placed water for the Apostle (ﷺ) and provided privacy for him, and he took a bath.
hi: Maimuna ne bataaya: Maine Rasool (SAW) ke liye paani rakha aur unhein parda diya, aur unhone ghusl kiya.

e: 'Abd al-Rahman, the son of Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, reported from his father: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: A man should not see the private parts of another man, and a woman should not see the private parts of another woman, and a man should not lie with another man under one covering, and a woman should not lie with another woman under one covering.
hi: Abdur Rahman, Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ke bete, ne apne waalid se riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Koi mard doosre mard ki sharmgaah na dekhe, aur koi aurat doosri aurat ki sharmgaah na dekhe, aur koi mard doosre mard ke saath ek hi chaadar mein na soye, aur koi aurat doosri aurat ke saath ek hi chaadar mein na soye.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Ibn Abu Fudaik and Dabbik b. 'Uthman with the same chain of transmitters and they observed: Private parts of man are the nakedness (which is concealed).
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Abu Fudaik aur Dabbik bin Uthman ne usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai aur unhone kaha: Mard ki sharmgaah wo bepardagi hai jo chhupaayi jaani chaahiye.

e: Amongst the traditions narrated from Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the authority of Abu Huraira, the one is that Banu Isra'il used to take a bath naked, and they looked at the private parts of one another. Moses (peace be upon him), however, took a bath alone (in privacy) ; and they said (tauntingly): By Allah, nothing prohibits Moses to take a bath along with us, but sacrotal hernia. He (Moses) once went for a bath and placed his clothes on a stone and the stone moved on with his clothes. Moses ran after it saying: 0 stone, my clothes,0 stone, my clothes, and Banu Isra'il had the chance to see the private parts of Moses, and said: By Allah, Moses does not suffer from any ailment. The stone then stopped, till Moses had been seen by them, and he then took hold of his clothes and struck the stone. Abu Huraira said: By Allah, there are the marks of six or seven strokes made by Moses on the stone.
hi: Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se Abu Huraira ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi Ahadees mein se ek ye hai ki Bani Israel nange hokar nahaate the, aur wo ek doosre ki sharmgaah ko dekhte the. Musa (AS), phir bhi, akele nahaate the tanhaai mein; aur unhone taane maarte hue kaha: Allah ki qasam, Musa ko humaare saath nahaane se kuch bhi nahi rokta, sivaay unke andkoshon ki ghaanth ke. Ek baar Musa nahaane gaye aur apne kapde ek patthar par rakh diye aur patthar unke kapdon ke saath aage chalne laga. Musa uske peeche daude, ye kehte hue: Aye patthar, mere kapde, Aye patthar, mere kapde, aur Bani Israel ko Musa ki sharmgaah dekhne ka mauqa mil gaya, aur unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, Musa ko koi bimaari nahi hai. Patthar phir ruk gaya, yahan tak ki Musa unhein nazar aa gaye, aur phir unhone apne kapde uthaaye aur patthar par maara. Abu Huraira ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, us patthar par Musa ke maare hue chhe ya saat nishaan hain.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported: When the Ka'ba was constructed the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and Abbas went and lifted stones. Abbas said to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): Place your lower garment on your shoulder (so that you may protect yourself from the roughness and hardness of stones). He (the Holy Prophet) did this, but fell down upon the ground in a state of unconciousness and his eyes were turned towards the sky. He then stood up and said: My lower garment, my lower garment; and this wrapper was tied around him. In the hadith transmitted by Ibn Rafi', there is the word:" On his neck" and he did not say:" Upon his shoulder."
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bataaya: Jab Ka'ba banaayi gayi, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur Abbas gaye aur patthar uthaaye. Abbas ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kaha: Apna neeche ka kapda apne kandhe par rakh lijiye. Unhone aisa kiya, lekin behosh hokar zameen par gir gaye aur unki aankhein aasman ki taraf ho gayin. Phir wo khade hue aur kaha: Mera neeche ka kapda, mera neeche ka kapda; aur ye chaadar unke ird-gird baandh di gayi. Ibn Rafi ki riwayat ki gayi hadees mein 'unki gardan par' lafz hai, aur unhone 'unke kandhe par' nahi kaha.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was carrying along with them (his people) stones for the Ka'ba and there was a waist wrapper around him. His uncle," Abbas, said to him: 0 son of my brother! if you take off the lower garment and place it on the shoulders underneath the stones, it would be better. He (the Holy Prophet) took it off and placed it on his shoulder and fell down unconscious. He (the narrator) said: Never was he seen naked after that day.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apne logon ke saath Ka'ba ke liye patthar dho rahe the aur unke ird-gird kamar ka kapda tha. Unke chacha Abbas ne unse kaha: Aye mere bhatije! Agar tum neeche ka kapda utaar kar patthron ke neeche apne kandhon par rakh lo, to ye behtar hoga. Unhone use utaara aur apne kandhe par rakha aur behosh hokar gir gaye. Unhone kaha: Us din ke baad wo kabhi nange nahi dekhe gaye.

e: Al-Miswar b. Makhrama reported: I was carrying a heavy stone and my lower garment was loose, and it, therefore, slipped off (so soon) that I could not place the stone (on the ground) and carry to its proper place. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Return to your cloth (lower garment), take it (and tie it around your waist) and do not walk naked.
hi: Al-Miswar bin Makhrama ne bataaya: Main ek bhaari patthar utha raha tha aur mera neeche ka kapda dheela tha, is liye wo itni jaldi phisal gaya ki main patthar zameen par na rakh saka aur na hi use uski sahi jagah tak le ja saka. Is par Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Apne kapde ki taraf wapas jao, use uthaao aur apni kamar par baandh lo, aur nanga mat chalo.

e: 'Abdullah b. Ja'far reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) one day made me mount behind him and he confided to me something secret which I would not disclose to anybody; and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) liked the concealment provided by a lofty place or cluster of dates (while answering the call of nature), Ibn Asma' said in his narration: It implied an enclosure of the date-trees.
hi: Abdullah bin Ja'far ne bataaya: Ek din Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe apne peeche sawaar karaya aur mujhe ek raaz bataaya jo main kisi ko nahi bataaunga; aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko qaza-e-haajat ke waqt kisi oonchi jagah ya khajoor ke jhund ki aad pasand thi. Ibn Asma ne apni riwayat mein kaha: Iska matlab khajoor ke pedon ka gher tha.

e: Sa'id al-Khudri narrated it from his father: I went to Quba' with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on Monday till we reached (the habitation) of Banu Salim. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stood at the door of 'Itban and called him loudly. So he came out dragging his lower garnment. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: We have made this man to make haste 'Itban said: Messenger of Allah, if a man parts with his wife suddenly without seminal emission, what is he required to do (with regard to bath)? The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: It is with the seminal emission that bath becomes obligatory.
hi: Sa'id al-Khudri ne apne waalid se riwayat ki: Main somvaar ke din Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Quba gaya, yahan tak ki hum Bani Salim ke ilaake tak pahunche. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Itban ke darwaze par khade hue aur unhein zor se pukaara. Is liye wo apna neeche ka kapda ghaseette hue bahar aaye. Is par Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Humne is shaks ko jaldbaazi mein daal diya. Itban ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, agar koi shaks apni biwi se achaanak bina inzaal ke alag ho jaaye, to use ghusl ke baare mein kya karna chahiye? Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ghusl inzaal se hi farz hota hai.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) observed: Bathing is obligatory in case of seminal emission.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Inzaal ki soorat mein ghusl farz hai.

e: Abu al. 'Ala' b. al-Shikhkhir said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) abrogated some of his commands by others, just as the Qur'an abrogates some part with the other.
hi: Abu al-Ala bin al-Shikhkhir ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne kuch hukmon ko doosron se mansookh kiya, bilkul jaise Quran ka ek hissa doosre hisse ko mansookh karta hai.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) happened to pass by (the house) of a man amongst the Ansar, and he sent for him. He came out and water was trickling down from his head. Upon this he (the Holy Prophet) said: Perhaps we put you to haste. He said: Yes. Messenger of Allah. He (the Holy Prophet) said: When you made haste or semen is not emitted, bathing is not obligatory for you, but ablution is binding. Ibn Bashshir has narrated it with a minor alteration.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka guzar Ansaar mein se ek shaks ke ghar ke paas se hua, aur unhone use bulaaya. Wo bahar aaya aur uske sar se paani tapak raha tha. Is par unhone kaha: Shaayad humne tumhein jaldi mein daal diya. Usne kaha: Haan, Allah ke Rasool. Unhone kaha: Jab tumhein jaldi ho ya mani na nikle, to ghusl tumpar farz nahi, lekin wuzu zaroori hai. Ibn Bashshir ne ise thode se badlaav ke saath riwayat kiya hai.

e: Ubayy Ibn Ka'b reported: I arked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about a man who has sexual intercourse with his wife, but leaves her before orgasm. Upon this he (the Holy Prophet) said: He should wash the secretion of his wife, and then perform ablution and ofier prayer.
hi: Ubayy bin Ka'b ne bataaya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ek aise shaks ke baare mein poocha jo apni biwi se sambhog karta hai, lekin orgasm se pehle hi use chhod deta hai. Is par unhone kaha: Use apni biwi ka rassa dhona chaahiye aur phir wuzu karke namaz padhni chaahiye.

e: Ubayy ibn Ka'b narrated it from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that he said: If a person has sexual intercourse with his wife, but does not experience orgasm, he should wash his organ and perform an ablution.
hi: Ubayy bin Ka'b ne ise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone kaha: Agar koi shaks apni biwi se sambhog kare, lekin orgasm mehsoos na kare, to use apni sharmgaah dhoni chaahiye aur wuzu karna chaahiye.

e: Zaid b. Khalid al-Jubani reported that he askad Uthman b. 'Affan: What is your opinion about the man who has sexual intercourse with his wife, but does not experience orgasm? Uthman said: He should perform ablution as he does for prayer, and wash his organ. 'Uthmin also said: I have heard it from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).
hi: Zaid bin Khalid al-Jubani ne bataaya ki unhone Uthman bin Affan se poocha: Us shaks ke baare mein aapki kya raay hai jo apni biwi se sambhog kare lekin orgasm mehsoos na kare? Uthman ne kaha: Use namaz jaisa wuzu karna chaahiye, aur apni sharmgaah dhoni chaahiye. Uthman ne ye bhi kaha: Maine ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna hai.

e: Abu Ayyub reported that he had heard like this from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).
hi: Abu Ayyub ne bataaya ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se isi tarah ki baat suni thi.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) said: When a man has sexual intercourse, bathing becomes obligatory (both for the male and the female). In the hadith of Matar the words are: Even if there is no orgasm. Zuhair has narrated it with a minor alteration of words.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab koi mard sambhog kare, to ghusl farz ho jaata hai, mard aur aurat dono par. Matar ki hadees mein alfaaz hain: Chaahe inzaal na ho. Zuhair ne ise thode se alfaaz ke badlaav ke saath riwayat kiya hai.

e: This hadith is narrated by Qatida with the same chain of transmitters, but with minor alterations. Here instead of the word - (jahada, (ijtahada) has been used, and the words;" Even if there is no orgasm" have been omitted.
hi: Ye hadees Qatada ne usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai, lekin thode se badlaav ke saath. Yahan 'jahada' ke bajaaye 'ijtahada' lafz istemaal hua hai, aur 'chaahe inzaal na ho' alfaaz chhod diye gaye hain.

e: Abu Musa reported: There cropped up a difference of opinion between a group of Muhajirs (Emigrants and a group of Ansar (Helpers) (and the point of dispute was) that the Ansar said: The bath (because of sexual intercourse) becomes obligatory only-when the semen spurts out or ejaculates. But the Muhajirs said: When a man has sexual intercourse (with the woman), a bath becomes obligatory (no matter whether or not there is seminal emission or ejaculation). Abu Musa said: Well, I satisfy you on this (issue). He (Abu Musa, the narrator) said: I got up (and went) to 'A'isha and sought her permission and it was granted, and I said to her: 0 Mother, or Mother of the Faithful, I want to ask you about a matter on which I feel shy. She said: Don't feel shy of asking me about a thing which you can ask your mother, who gave you birth, for I am too your mother. Upon this I said: What makes a bath obligatory for a person? She replied: You have come across one well informed! The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When anyone sits amidst four parts (of the woman) and the circumcised parts touch each other a bath becomes obligatory.
hi: Abu Musa ne bataaya: Muhaajireen ke ek giroh aur Ansaar ke ek giroh ke darmiyaan ikhtelaaf paida hua. Ansaar ne kaha: Ghusl sambhog ki wajah se sirf tab farz hota hai jab mani nikle ya inzaal ho. Lekin Muhaajireen ne kaha: Jab koi mard aurat se sambhog kare, to ghusl farz ho jaata hai, chaahe mani nikle ya na nikle. Abu Musa ne kaha: Achha, main is maamle mein tumhein santusht kar dunga. Unhone kaha: Main uthkar Aisha ke paas gaya aur unse ijaazat maangi aur mujhe di gayi, aur maine unse kaha: Aye Ma, ya Momineen ki Ma, main aapse ek aisi baat poochna chaahta hoon jispar mujhe sharam aati hai. Unhone kaha: Mujhse wo cheez poochne mein sharam mat karo jo tum apni us ma se poochh sakte ho jisne tumhein janam diya, kyunki main bhi tumhaari ma hoon. Is par maine kaha: Kaunsi cheez kisi shaks par ghusl farz karti hai? Unhone jawaab diya: Tumhaari mulaqat ek achhi tarah jaanne waali se ho gayi! Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab koi aurat ke chaar hisson ke beech baithe aur khatna kiye hue hisse ek doosre ko chhue, to ghusl farz ho jaata hai.

e: 'A'isha the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) reported. A person asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about one who has sexual intercourse with his wife and parts away (without orgasm) whether bathing is obligatory for him. 'A'isha was sitting by him. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: I and she (the Mother of the Faithful) do it and then take a bath.
hi: Aisha, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki biwi, ne bataaya. Ek shaks ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se poocha ki jo apni biwi se sambhog karke bina inzaal ke alag ho jaaye, kya uspar ghusl farz hai. Aisha unke paas baithi thi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Main aur wo aisa karte hain aur phir ghusl karte hain.

e: Zaid b Thabit reported: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say this: Ablution is obligatory (for one who takes anything) touched by fire.
hi: Zaid bin Thabit ne bataaya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Aag se chhuyi hui cheez khaane ke baad wuzu farz hai.

e: 'Abdullah b. Ibrahim b. Qariz reported that he found Abu Huraira performing ablution in the mosque, who said: I am performing ablution because of having eaten pieces of cheese, for I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: Perform ablution (after eating anything) touched by fire.
hi: Abdullah bin Ibrahim bin Qariz ne bataaya ki unhone Abu Huraira ko masjid mein wuzu karte paaya, jinhone kaha: Main paneer ke tukdon khaane ki wajah se wuzu kar raha hoon, kyunki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Aag se chhuyi hui koi bhi cheez khaane ke baad wuzu karo.

e: 'Urwa reported on the authority of'A'isha, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), saying this: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said. Perform ablution (after eating) anything touched by fire.
hi: Urwah ne ise Aisha, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki biwi, se riwayat ki jinhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Aag se chhuyi hui koi bhi cheez khaane ke baad wuzu karo.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took (meat of) goat's shoulder and offered prayer and did not perform ablution.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne bakri ke kandhe ka gosht liya aur namaz padhi aur wuzu nahi kiya.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took flesh from the bone or meat, and then offered prayer and did not perform ablution, and (in fact) he did not touch water.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne haddi se ya gosht se maans liya, aur phir namaz padhi aur wuzu nahi kiya, aur haqeeqat mein unhone paani ko chhua bhi nahi.

e: Ja'far b. Amr b. Umayya al-Damari reported on the authority of his father who said: I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) take slices from goat's shoulder, and then eat them, and then offer prayer without having performed ablution.
hi: Ja'far bin Amr bin Umayya al-Damari ne apne waalid se riwayat ki jinhone kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko bakri ke kandhe se tukde kaatte dekha, aur phir unhein khaate, aur phir bagair wuzu kiye namaz padhte dekha.

e: Ja'far b. 'Amr b. Umayya al-Damari reported on the authority of his father who said: I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) take slices from goat's shoulder and then eat them. He was called for prayer and he got'up, leaving aside the knife, and offered prayer but did not perform ablution.
hi: Ja'far bin Amr bin Umayya al-Damari ne apne waalid se riwayat ki jinhone kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko bakri ke kandhe se tukde kaatte aur phir unhein khaate dekha. Unhein namaz ke liye bulaaya gaya aur wo chaakoo chhod kar khade ho gaye, aur namaz padhi lekin wuzu nahi kiya.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported it on the authority of Maimuana, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took (a piece of goat's) shoulder at her place, and then offered prayer but did not perform ablution.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne ise Maimuna, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki biwi, se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unke ghar mein bakri ka kandha liya, aur phir namaz padhi lekin wuzu nahi kiya.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Ibn 'Abbas on the authority of Maimuna. the wife of the Apostle (ﷺ), by another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Abbas ne Maimuna, Rasool (SAW) ki biwi, se ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki hai.

e: Abu Rafi' reported: I testify that I used to roast the liver of the goat for the Messenger of Allah (may peace be tipcn him) and then he offered praver but did not perform ablution.
hi: Abu Rafi ne bataaya: Main gawahi deta hoon ki main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke liye bakri ka kaleja bhoona karta tha, aur phir unhone namaz padhi lekin wuzu nahi kiya.

e: Ibn Abbas reported: The Apostle (ﷺ) took milk and then called for water and rinsed (his mouth) and said: It contains greasiness.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bataaya: Rasool (SAW) ne doodh liya aur phir paani mangwaaya aur kulli ki aur kaha: Ismein charbi hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated by another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn Abbas reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) dressed himself, and then went out for prayer, when he was presented with bread and meat. He took three morsels out of that, and then offered prayer along with other people and did not touch water.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kapde pehne aur phir namaz ke liye bahar gaye jab unhein roti aur gosht pesh kiya gaya. Unhone usmein se teen niwale liye aur phir doosre logon ke saath namaz padhi aur paani ko chhua tak nahi.

e: This hadith is narrated by Muhammad b. 'Amr b. Ata' with these words: I was with Ibn 'Abbas, and Ibn 'Abbas saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) doing like this, and it is also said that the words are: He (the Holy Prophet) offered prayer; and the word" people" is not mentioned.
hi: Ye hadees Muhammad bin Amr bin Ata ne in alfaaz mein riwayat ki hai: Main Ibn Abbas ke saath tha, aur Ibn Abbas ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko isi tarah karte dekha, aur ye bhi kaha jaata hai ki alfaaz hain: Unhone namaz padhi; aur 'logon' lafz ka zikr nahi hai.

e: Jabir b. Samura reported: A man asked the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) whether he should perform ablution after (eating) mutton. He (the Messenger of Allah) said: Perform ablution it you so desire, and if you do not wish, do not perform it. He (again) asked: Should I perform ablution (after eating) camel's flesh? He said: Yes, perform ablution (after eating) camel's flesh. He (again) said: May I say prayer in the sheepfolds? He (the Messenger of Allah) said: Yes. He (the narrator) again said: May I say prayer where camels lie down? He (the Holy Prophet) said: No.
hi: Jabir bin Samura ne bataaya: Ek shaks ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se poocha ki kya use mutton khaane ke baad wuzu karna chahiye. Unhone kaha: Agar tum chaaho to wuzu karo, aur agar na chaaho, to mat karo. Unhone dobara poocha: Kya mujhe oont ka gosht khaane ke baad wuzu karna chaahiye? Unhone kaha: Haan, oont ka gosht khaane ke baad wuzu karo. Unhone phir poocha: Kya main bhed-bakriyon ke bade mein namaz padh sakta hoon? Unhone kaha: Haan. Unhone phir poocha: Kya main wahan namaz padh sakta hoon jahan oont baithte hain? Unhone kaha: Nahi.

e: This hadith is also narrated by another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'Abbad b. Tamim reported from his uncle that a person made a complaint to the Apostle (ﷺ) that he entertained (doubt) as it something had happened to him breaking his ablution. He (the Holy Prophet) said: He should not return (from prayer) unless he hears a sound or perceives a smell (of passing wind). Abu Bakr and Zuhair b. Harb have pointed out in their narrations that it was 'Abdullah b. Zaid.
hi: Abbad bin Tamim ne apne chacha se riwayat ki ki ek shaks ne Rasool (SAW) se shikaayat ki ki use shaq hota hai ki uske saath kuch aisa hua hai jisne uska wuzu tod diya ho. Unhone kaha: Use namaz se wapas nahi jaana chahiye jab tak wo koi aawaz na sune ya koi badboo mehsoos na kare. Abu Bakr aur Zuhair bin Harb ne apni riwaayaton mein bataaya ki ye Abdullah bin Zaid the.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: If any one of you has pain in his abdomen, but is doubtful whether or not anything has issued from him, be should not leave the mosque unless he hears a sound or perceives a smell.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Agar tum mein se kisi ke pet mein dard ho, lekin use shaq ho ki usse kuch nikla hai ya nahi, to use masjid nahi chhodni chahiye jab tak wo koi aawaz na sune ya koi badboo mehsoos na kare.

e: The freed slave-girl of Maimuna was given a goat in charity but it died. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) happened to pass by that (carcass). Upon this be said: Why did you not take off its skin? You could put it to use, after tanning it. They (the Companions) said: It was dead. Upon, this he (the Messenger of Allah) said: Only its eating is prohibited. Abu bakr and Ibn Umar in their narrations said: It is narrated from Maimuna (may Allah be pleased with her).
hi: Maimuna ki aazaad ki hui laundi ko sadqe mein ek bakri di gayi thi lekin wo mar gayi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka guzar us lash ke paas se hua. Is par unhone kaha: Tumne iski khaal kyun nahi utaari? Tum ise, ise tan karne ke baad, istemaal kar sakte the. Unhone kaha: Wo mari hui thi. Is par unhone kaha: Sirf iska khaana haram hai. Abu Bakr aur Ibn Umar ne apni riwaayaton mein kaha: Ye Maimuna se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn 'Abbas said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saw a dead goat, which had been given in charity to the freed slave-girl of Maimuna. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Why don't you make use of its skin? They (the Companions around the Holy Prophet) said: It is dead. Upon this he said: It is the eating (of the dead animal) which is prohibited.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek mari hui bakri dekhi, jo Maimuna ki aazaad ki hui laundi ko sadqe mein di gayi thi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Tum log iski khaal ka istemaal kyun nahi karte? Unhone kaha: Wo mari hui hai. Is par unhone kaha: Mari hui jaanwar ka khaana hi haram hai.

e: This hadith is narrated by Ibn Shihab with the same chain of transmitters as transmitted by Yunus.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Shihab ne usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai jaisi Yunus ki riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn Abbas reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) happened to pass by a goat thrown (away) which had been in fact given to the freed slave-girl of Maimuna as charity. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (way peace he upon him) said: Why did they not get its skin? They had better tan it and make use of it.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka guzar ek phenki gayi bakri ke paas se hua jo haqeeqat mein Maimuna ki aazaad ki hui laundi ko sadqe mein di gayi thi. Is par Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Unhone iski khaal kyun nahi li? Behtar hota agar wo ise tan karte aur istemaal karte.

e: Ibn'Abbas reported on the authority of Maimuna that someone amongst the wives of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had a domestic animal and it died. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Why did you not take off its skin and make use of that?
hi: Ibn Abbas ne ise Maimuna se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki kisi biwi ke paas ek paala hua jaanwar tha aur wo mar gaya. Is par Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Tumne iski khaal kyun nahi utaari aur use istemaal nahi kiya?

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) happened to pass by (the dead body) of the goat which belonged to the freed slave-girl of Maimuna and said: Why did you not make use of its skin?
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka guzar us bakri ki lash ke paas se hua jo Maimuna ki aazaad ki hui laundi ki thi aur kaha: Tumne iski khaal ka istemaal kyun nahi kiya?

e: Abdullah b. Abbas said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: When the skin is tanned it becomes purified.
hi: Abdullah bin Abbas ne kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab khaal tan ki jaati hai, to wo paak ho jaati hai.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas by another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Abbas se ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu al-Khair reported: I saw Ibn Wa'la al-Saba'i wear a fur. I touched it. He said: Why do you touch it? I asked Ibn 'Abbas saying: We are the inhabitants of the western regions, and there (live) with us Berbers and Magians. They bring with them rams and slaughter them, but we do not eat (the meat of the animals) slaughtered by them, and they come with skins full of fat. Upon this Ibn 'Abbas said: We asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about this and he said: Its tanning makes it pure.
hi: Abu al-Khair ne bataaya: Maine Ibn Wa'la al-Saba'i ko ek fur pehne dekha. Maine ise chhua. Unhone kaha: Tum ise kyun chhoo rahe ho? Maine Ibn Abbas se poocha aur kaha: Hum maghrib ilaaqon ke rehne wale hain, aur humaare saath Berber aur Majoosi log rehte hain. Wo apne saath mendhe laate hain aur unhein zibah karte hain, lekin hum unke zibah kiye hue jaanwaron ka gosht nahi khaate, aur wo charbi se bhare hue khaal ke mashk le kar aate hain. Is par Ibn Abbas ne kaha: Humne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se iske baare mein poocha aur unhone kaha: Iska tan hona ise paak bana deta hai.

e: Ibn Wa'la al-Saba'i reported: I asked 'Abdullah b. 'Abbas saying: We are the inhabitants of the western regions. The Magians come to us with skins full of water and fat. He said: Drink. I said to him: Is it your own opinion? Ibn Abbas said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: Tanning purifies it (the skin).
hi: Ibn Wa'la al-Saba'i ne bataaya: Maine Abdullah bin Abbas se poocha: Hum maghrib ilaaqon ke rehne wale hain. Majoosi log paani aur charbi se bhare hue khaal ke mashk lekar humaare paas aate hain. Unhone kaha: Piyo. Maine unse kaha: Kya ye aapki khud ki raay hai? Ibn Abbas ne kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Tan hona ise khaal ko paak kar deta hai.

e: 'A'isha reported: We went with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on one of his journeys and when we reached the place Baida' or Dhat al-jaish, my necklace was broken (and fell somewhere). The Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him) along with other people stayed there for searching it. There was neither any water at that place nor was there any water with them (the Companions of the Holy Prophet). Some persons came to my father Abu Bakr and said: Do you see what 'A'isha has done? She has detained the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and persons accompanying him, and there is neither any water here or with them. So Abu Bakr came there and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was sleeping with his head on my thigh. He (Abu Bakr) said: You have detained the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and other persons and there is neither water here nor with them. She ('A'isha) said: Abu Bakr scolded me and uttered what Allah wanted him to utter and nudged my hips with his hand. And there was nothing to prevent me from stirring but for the fact that the messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was lying upon my thigh. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) slept till it was dawn at a waterless place. So Allah revealed the verses pertaining to tayammum and they (the Prophet and his Companions) performed tayammum. Usaid b. al-Hudair who was one of the leaders said: This is not the first of your blessings,0 Family to Abu Bakr. 'A'isha said: We made the came) stand which was my mount and found the necklace under it.
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath unke ek safar mein gaye aur jab hum Baida ya Dhat al-Jaish jagah par pahunche, to mera haar toot gaya aur kahin gir gaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) doosre logon ke saath wahan iski talaash mein ruk gaye. Us jagah na koi paani tha aur na hi unke paas koi paani tha. Kuch log mere waalid Abu Bakr ke paas aaye aur kaha: Kya aap dekh rahe hain Aisha ne kya kiya? Unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur unke saath waale logon ko rok liya hai, aur na yahan koi paani hai na unke paas. Is liye Abu Bakr wahan aaye aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) meri jaangh par apna sar rakhkar so rahe the. Unhone kaha: Tumne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur doosre logon ko rok liya hai aur na yahan paani hai na unke paas. Unhone kaha: Abu Bakr ne mujhe daanta aur wo bola jo Allah unse bulwaana chaahta tha, aur apne haath se mere kolhon ko kochka. Aur mujhe hilne-julne se sirf isi cheez ne roka ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) meri jaangh par lete hue the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) subah tak us paani-rahit jagah mein sote rahe. Is liye Allah ne Tayammum se mutaalliq aayaten nazil kin aur unhone Tayammum kiya. Usaid bin al-Hudair, jo ek sardaar the, ne kaha: Ye tumhaari barkaton mein sabse pehli nahi hai, Aye Abu Bakr ke khaandan! Aisha ne kaha: Humne oont ko khada kiya jo meri sawaari tha aur haar uske neeche paaya.

e: 'A'isha reported she had borrowed from Asma' (her sister) a necklace and it was lost. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent men to search for it. As it was the time for prayer, they offered prayer without ablution (as water was not available there). When they came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), they made a complaint about it, and the verses pertaining to tayammum were revealed. Upon this Usaid b. Hadair said (to 'A'isha): May Allah grant you a good reward! Never has been there an occasion when you were beset with difficulty and Allah did not make you come out of that and made it an occasion of blessing for the Muslims.
hi: Aisha ne bataaya ki unhone Asma se ek haar udhaar liya tha aur wo kho gaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne logon ko use dhoondhne bheja. Chunki namaz ka waqt ho gaya tha, unhone bagair wuzu ke namaz padhi kyunki wahan paani nahi tha. Jab wo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye, to unhone iski shikaayat ki, aur Tayammum se mutaalliq aayaten nazil hui. Is par Usaid bin Hadair ne Aisha se kaha: Allah aapko achha badla de! Aisa kabhi nahi hua ki aap kisi mushkil mein padi hon aur Allah ne aapko usse na nikaala ho aur ise Musalmanon ke liye barkat ka zariya na banaaya ho.

e: Shaqiq reported: I was sitting in the company of Abdullah and Abu Musa when Abu Musa said: 0 'Abd al-Rahman (kunya of 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud), what would you like a man to do about the prayer if he experiences a seminal emission or has sexual intercourse but does not find water for a month? 'Abdullah said: He should not perform tayammum even if he does not find water for a month. 'Abdullah said: Then what about the verse in Sura Ma'ida:" If you do not find water, betake yourself to clean dust"? 'Abdullah said: If they were granted concession on the basis of this verse, there is a possibility that they would perform tayammum with dust on finding water very cold for themselves. Abu Musa said to Abdullah: You have not heard the words of 'Ammar: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent me on an errand and I had a seminal emission, but could find no water, and rolled myself in dust just as a beast rolls itself. I came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) then and made a mention of that to him and he (the Holy Prophet) said: It would have been enough for you to do thus. Then he struck the ground with his hands once and wiped his right hand with the help of his left hand and the exterior of his palms and his face. 'Abdullah said: Didn't you see that Umar was not fully satisfied with the words of 'Ammar only?
hi: Shaqiq ne bataaya: Main Abdullah aur Abu Musa ki sohbat mein baitha tha jab Abu Musa ne kaha: Aye Abdur Rahman, agar kisi shaks ko ehtelaam ho jaaye ya wo sambhog kare lekin ek mahine tak paani na mile, to aapki raay mein use namaz ke baare mein kya karna chaahiye? Abdullah ne kaha: Use Tayammum nahi karna chaahiye, chaahe use ek mahine tak paani na mile. Abdullah ne kaha: Phir Surah al-Ma'ida ki us aayat ka kya matlab hai: 'Agar tumhein paani na mile, to paak mitti ka sahaara lo'? Abdullah ne kaha: Agar unhein is aayat ke bunyad par ye chhoot di jaati, to iska imkaan hai ki wo bahut thanda paani paake bhi mitti se Tayammum karna shuru kar dete. Abu Musa ne Abdullah se kaha: Kya aapne Ammar ke alfaaz nahi sune: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe ek kaam ke liye bheja aur mujhe ehtelaam ho gaya, lekin mujhe paani nahi mila, aur main mitti mein aise luda jaise koi jaanwar ludhakta hai. Phir main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unse iska zikr kiya aur unhone kaha: Tumhaare liye itna hi kaafi hota. Phir unhone ek baar apne haathon se zameen par maara aur apne daaye haath ko apne baaye haath se poonchha, apni hatheliyon ke bahari hisse aur apne chehre ka bhi. Abdullah ne kaha: Kya tumne nahi dekha ki Umar sirf Ammar ke alfaaz se poori tarah santusht nahi the?

e: This hadith is narrated by Shaqiq with the same chain of transmitters but with the alteration of these words: He (the Holy Prophet) struck hands upon the earth, and then shook them and then wiped his face and palm.
hi: Ye hadees Shaqiq ne usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai lekin in alfaaz ke badlaav ke saath: Unhone zameen par haath maare, aur phir unhein jhaadha aur phir apna chehra aur hatheli poonchhi.

e:
Abd al-Rabmin b. Abza narrated It on the authority of his father that a man came to 'Umar and said: I am (at times) affected by seminal emission but find no water. He ('Umar) told him not to say prayer. 'Ammar then said. Do you remember,0 Commander of the Faithful, when I and you were in a military detachment and we had had a seminal emission and did not find water (for taking bath) and you did not say prayer, but as for myself I rolled in dust and said prayer, and (when it was mentioned before) the Apostle (ﷺ) said: It was enough for you to strike the ground with your hands and then blow (the dust) and then wipe your face and palms. Umar said: 'Ammar, fear Allah. He said: If you so like, I would not narrate it. 
A hadith like this has been transmitted with the same chain of transmitters but for the words: 'Umar said: We hold you responsible for what you claim."
hi:
Abdur Rahman bin Abza ne ise apne waalid se riwayat ki ki ek shaks Umar ke paas aaya aur kaha: Mujhe kabhi kabhi ehtelaam ho jaata hai lekin mujhe paani nahi milta. Umar ne unse kaha ki wo namaz na padhein. Ammar ne phir kaha: Kya aapko yaad hai, Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen, jab main aur aap ek fauji dastay mein the aur humein ehtelaam ho gaya tha aur humein paani nahi mila tha aur aapne namaz nahi padhi, lekin jahan tak mera taalluq hai, main mitti mein luda aur maine namaz padhi, aur jab ye Rasool (SAW) ke saamne zikr hua, Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Tumhaare liye itna hi kaafi tha ki tum apne haathon se zameen par maarte aur phir mitti phoonk dete aur phir apna chehra aur hatheliyaan poonchh lete. Umar ne kaha: Ammar, Allah se daro. Unhone kaha: Agar aap chaahein, to main ise riwayat nahi karunga.

Isi jaisi ek hadees usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai, sivaay in alfaaz ke: 'Umar ne kaha: Hum tumhein us baat ke liye zimmedaar thehraate hain jiska tum dawa karte ho.'

e: 'Abd al-Rahman b.
