Abza mnated it on the authority of his father that a man came to Umar and said: I have had a seminal emission but I found no water, and the rest of the hadith is the same but with this addition: 'Amr said: 0 Commander of the Faithful, because of the right given to you by Allah over me, if you desire, I would not narrate this hadith to anyone.
hi: Abdur Rahman bin Abza ne ise apne waalid se riwayat ki ki ek shaks Umar ke paas aaya aur kaha: Mujhe ehtelaam ho gaya lekin mujhe paani nahi mila, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai lekin is izafe ke saath: Ammar ne kaha: Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen, us haq ki wajah se jo Allah ne aapko mujhpar diya hai, agar aap chaahein, to main ye hadees kisi ko nahi sunaaunga.

e: Umair, the freed slave of Ibn 'Abbas, reported: I and 'Abd al-Rahmin b. Yasir, the freed slave of Maimuna, the wife of the Apostle (way peace be upon him). came to the house of Abu'l-Jahm b. al-Harith al-Simma Ansari and he said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came from the direction of Bi'r Jamal and a man met him; he saluted him but the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) made no response, till he (the Holy Prophet) came to the wall, wiped his face and hands and then returned his salutations.
hi: Umair, Ibn Abbas ke aazaad kiye gulaam, ne bataaya: Main aur Abdur Rahman bin Yasar, Maimuna ke aazaad kiye gulaam, Abu'l-Jahm bin al-Harith al-Simma Ansari ke ghar aaye aur unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Bir Jamal ki taraf se aa rahe the aur ek shaks unse mila; usne unhein salaam kiya lekin Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne koi jawaab nahi diya, yahan tak ki wo deewaar tak pahunche, apna chehra aur haath poonchhe, aur phir unke salaam ka jawaab diya.

e: Ibn Umar reported: A person happened to pass by the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) when he was making water and saluted him, but he did not respond to his salutation.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bataaya: Ek shaks ka guzar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas se hua jab wo peshaab kar rahe the aur usne unhein salaam kiya, lekin unhone uske salaam ka jawaab nahi diya.

e: Abu Huraira reported that he met the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on one of the paths leading to Medina in a state of (sexual) defilement and he slipped away and took a bath. The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) searched for him and when he came, he said to him: 0 Abu Huraira, where were you? He said: Messenger of Allah, you met when I was (sexually) defiled and I did not like to sit in your company before taking a bath. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Hallowed be Allah, verily a believer is never defiled.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya ki unki mulaqat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se Madina ki galiyon mein se ek mein hui jabki wo sambhog ki napaaki ki halat mein the, aur wo chupke se hat gaye aur ghusl kiya. Rasool (SAW) ne unhein dhoondha aur jab wo aaye, to unse kaha: Aye Abu Huraira, tum kahan the? Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aap mujhse tab mile jab main napaak tha aur mujhe achha nahi laga ki main ghusl kiye bagair aapki sohbat mein baithun. Is par Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Subhan Allah, beshak koi momin kabhi napaak nahi hota.

e: Hudhaifa reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) happened to meet him and he was (sexually) defiled, and he slipped away and took a bath and then came and said: I was (sexually) defiled. Upon this he (the Holy Prophet) remarked: A Muslim is never defiled.
hi: Hudhaifa ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unse mile jabki wo sambhog ki napaaki ki halat mein the, aur wo chupke se hat gaye aur ghusl kiya aur phir aaye aur kaha: Main napaak tha. Is par unhone kaha: Musalman kabhi napaak nahi hota.

e: 'A'isha said: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) used to remember Allah at all moments.
hi: Aisha ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) har lamha Allah ka zikr karte the.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) came out of the privy, and he was presented with some food, and the people reminded him about ablution, but he said: Am I to say prayer that I should perform ablution?
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) latrine se bahar aaye, aur unhein kuch khaana pesh kiya gaya, aur logon ne unhein wuzu ki yaad dilaayi, lekin unhone kaha: Kya main namaz padhne wala hoon ki mujhe wuzu karna chaahiye?

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported: We were with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he had come out of the privy. Food was presented to him. It was said to him (by the Companions around him): Wouldn't you perform ablution? Upon this he said: Why, am I to say prayer that I should perform ablution?
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bataaya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath the aur wo latrine se bahar aaye the. Unhein khaana pesh kiya gaya. Unse kaha: Kya aap wuzu nahi karenge? Is par unhone kaha: Kyun, kya main namaz padhne wala hoon ki mujhe wuzu karna chaahiye?

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went to the privy and when he came back, he was presented with food. It was said to him; Messenger of Allah, wouldn't you perform ablution. He said: Why, am I to say prayer?
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) latrine gaye aur jab wo wapas aaye, to unhein khaana pesh kiya gaya. Unse kaha gaya: Allah ke Rasool, kya aap wuzu nahi karenge? Unhone kaha: Kyun, kya main namaz padhne wala hoon?

e: Ibn Abbas, reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) came out of the privy after relieving himself, and food was brought to him and he took it, and did not touch water. In another narration transmitted by Sa'id b. al-Huwairith it is like this: It was said to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) You have not performed ablution. He said: I do not intend to say prayer that I should perform ablution.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khud ko halka karne ke baad latrine se bahar aaye, aur unhein khaana laaya gaya aur unhone use liya, aur paani ko chhua nahi. Sa'id bin al-Huwairith ki riwayat ki gayi ek doosri riwayat mein is tarah hai: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kaha gaya: Aap ne wuzu nahi kiya. Unhone kaha: Mera namaz padhne ka iraada nahi hai ki mujhe wuzu karna chaahiye.

e: Anas reported: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) entered the privy, and in the hadith transmitted by Hushaim (the words are): When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) entered the lavatory, be used to say: O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from wicked and noxious things.
hi: Anas ne bataaya: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) latrine mein daakhil hote, aur Hushaim ki riwayat ki gayi hadees mein alfaaz hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) latrine mein daakhil hote, to wo kehte the: Aye Allah, main buri aur nuqsaandeh cheezon se Teri panaah maangta hoon.

e: This hadith is also transmitted by 'Abd al-'Aziz with the same chain of transmitters, and the words are: I seek refuge with Allah from the wicked and noxious things.
hi: Ye hadees Abdul Aziz ne bhi usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai, aur alfaaz hain: Main buri aur nuqsaandeh cheezon se Allah ki panaah maangta hoon.

e: Anas reported: (The people) stood up for prayer and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was whispering to a man, and in the narration of 'Abd al-Warith (the words are): The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) was having a private conversation with a man, and did not start the prayer till the people dozed off.
hi: Anas ne bataaya: Log namaz ke liye khade ho gaye aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek shaks se dheeme swar mein baat kar rahe the, aur Abdul Warith ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek shaks se niji baatcheet kar rahe the, aur unhone namaz shuru nahi ki jab tak log oonghne nahi lage.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: (The people) stood up for prayer and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was talking in whispers with a man, and he did not discontinue the conversation till his Companions dozed off; he then came and led the prayer.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bataaya: Log namaz ke liye khade ho gaye aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek shaks se dheeme swar mein baat kar rahe the, aur unhone baatcheet band nahi ki jab tak unke Sahaba oonghne nahi lage; phir wo aaye aur namaz ki imaamat ki.

e: Qatida reported: I heard Anas as saying that the Companion of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) dozed off and then offered prayer and did not perform ablution. He (the narrator) said: I asked him if he had actually heard it from Anas. He said: By Allah. yes.
hi: Qatada ne bataaya: Maine Anas ko ye kehte suna ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka ek saathi oonghne laga aur phir usne namaz padhi aur wuzu nahi kiya. Unhone kaha: Maine unse poocha ki kya unhone waaqai ye Anas se suna tha. Unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, haan.

e: Anas reported: (The people) stood up for the night prayer when a man spoke forth: I need to say something. The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) entered into secret conversation with him, till the people dozed off or some of the people (dozed off), and then they said the prayer.
hi: Anas ne bataaya: Log raat ki namaz ke liye khade ho gaye jab ek shaks bola: Mujhe kuch kehna hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse niji baatcheet shuru kar di, yahan tak ki log oonghne lage ya kuch log oonghne lage, aur phir unhone namaz padhi.

e: Ibn Umar reported: When the Muslims came to Medina, they gathered and sought to know the time of prayer but no one summoned them. One day they discussed the matter, and some of them said: Use something like the bell of the Christians and some of them said: Use horn like that of the Jews. Umar said: Why may not a be appointed who should call (people) to prayer? The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: O Bilal, get up and summon (the people) to prayer.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bataaya: Jab Musalman Madina aaye, to wo jama hote aur namaz ka waqt jaanne ki koshish karte, lekin koi unhein bulaata nahi tha. Ek din unhone is baare mein baat ki, aur unmein se kuch ne kaha: Isaaiyon ki ghanti jaisa kuch istemaal karo, aur kuch ne kaha: Yahudiyon ke seenge jaisa kuch istemaal karo. Umar ne kaha: Logon ko namaz ke liye bulaane waala koi shaks muqarrar kyun na kiya jaaye? Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Aye Bilal, utho aur logon ko namaz ke liye bulaao.

e: Anas reported: Bilal was commanded (by the Messenger of Allah) to repeat (the phrases of) Adhan twice and once in Iqama. The narrator said: I made a mention of it before Ayyub who said: Except for saying: Qamat-is-Salat .
hi: Anas ne bataaya: Bilal ko hukum diya gaya ki wo Azaan ke jumlon ko do baar aur Iqaamat mein ek baar dohraayein. Raawi ne kaha: Maine iska zikr Ayyub ke saamne kiya jinhone kaha: Sivaay 'Qad Qaamat is-Salat' kehne ke.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: They (the Companions) discussed that they should know the timings of prayer by means of something recognized by all. Some of them said that fire should be lighted or a bell should be rung. But Bilal was ordered to repeat the phrases twice in Adhan, and once in Iqama.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bataaya: Unhone baat ki ki unhein kisi aisi cheez ke zariye namaz ke waqt ka pata chalna chahiye jise sab pehchaan sakein. Unmein se kuch ne kaha ki aag jalaayi jaaye ya ghanti bajaayi jaaye. Lekin Bilal ko hukum diya gaya ki wo Azaan ke jumle do baar aur Iqaamat mein ek baar dohraayein.

e: This hadith is transmitted by Khalid Hadhdha with the same chain of transmitters (and the words are): When the majority of the people discussed they should know, like the hadith narrated by al-Thaqafi (mentioned above) except for the words:" They (the people) should kindle fire."
hi: Ye hadees Khalid Hadhdha ne usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai aur alfaaz hain: Jab aksar log is baare mein baat kar rahe the ki unhein kaise pata chale, jaisi Thaqafi ki riwayat ki gayi hadees hai, sivaay in alfaaz ke: 'Unhein aag jalaani chaahiye.'

e: Anas reported: Bilal was commanded (by the Holy Prophet) to repeat the phrases twice in Adhan, and once in lqama.
hi: Anas ne bataaya: Bilal ko hukum diya gaya ki wo Azaan ke jumle do baar aur Iqaamat mein ek baar dohraayein.

e: Abu Mahdhura said that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) taught him Adhan like this: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest; I testify that there is no god but Allah, I testify that there is no god but Allah; I testify that Muhammad Is the Messenger of Allah, I testify that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, and it should be again repeated: I testify that there is no god but Allah, I testify that there is no god but Allah; I testify that Muhammad Is the Messenger of Allah, I testify that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. Come to the prayer (twice). Come to success (twice). Ishaq added: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest; there Is no god but Allah.
hi: Abu Mahdhura ne bataaya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhein is tarah Azaan sikhaayi: Allah Sabse Bada Hai, Allah Sabse Bada Hai; Main gawahi deta hoon ki Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, Main gawahi deta hoon ki Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi; Main gawahi deta hoon ki Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain, Main gawahi deta hoon ki Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain, aur ise dobara dohraaya jaana chahiye: Main gawahi deta hoon ki Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, Main gawahi deta hoon ki Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi; Main gawahi deta hoon ki Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain, Main gawahi deta hoon ki Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain. Namaz ki taraf aao, do baar. Kaamyaabi ki taraf aao, do baar. Ishaq ne izafa kiya: Allah Sabse Bada Hai, Allah Sabse Bada Hai; Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi.

e: Ibn Umar reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had two Mu'adhdhins, Bilal and 'Abdullah b. Umm Maktum, who (latter) was blind.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke do Mu'azzin the, Bilal aur Abdullah bin Umm Maktum, jo aakhri waale andhe the.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'A'isha by another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Aisha se ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: A'isha reported: Ibn Umm Maktum used to pronounce Adhan at the behest of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) (despite the fact) that he was blind.
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Ibn Umm Maktum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke kehne par Azaan diya karte the, iske bawajood ki wo andhe the.

e: A hadith like this has been transmitted by Hisham.
hi: Ye jaisi hadees Hisham ne bhi riwayat ki hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to attack the enemy when it was dawn. He would listen to the Adhan; so if he heard an Adhan, he stopped, otherwise made an attack. Once on hearing a man say: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) remarked: He is following al-Fitra (al-Islam). Then hearing him say: I testify that there is no god but Allah. there is no god but Allah, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: You have come out of the Fire (of Hell). They looked at him and found that he was a goat herd.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) subah sube dushman par hamla kiya karte the. Wo Azaan sunte; agar unhein Azaan sunayi deti, to wo ruk jaate, warna hamla kar dete. Ek baar ek shaks ko ye kehte suna: Allah Sabse Bada Hai, Allah Sabse Bada Hai, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ye Fitrat par hai. Phir use ye kehte suna: Main gawahi deta hoon ki Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Tum Aag se bach gaye. Unhone uski taraf dekha aur paaya ki wo bakriyaan charaane wala tha.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported: When you hear the call (to prayer), repeat what the Mu'adhdhin pronounces.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne bataaya: Jab tum Azaan suno, to wahi dohraao jo Mu'azzin kehta hai.

e: 'Abdullah b. Amr b. al-As reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When you hear the Mu'adhdhin, repeat what he says, then invoke a blessing on me, for everyone who invokes a blessing on me will receive ten blessings from Allah; then beg from Allah al-Wasila for me, which is a rank in Paradise fitting for only one of Allah's servants, and I hope that I may be that one. If anyone who asks that I be given the Wasila, he will be assured of my intercession.
hi: Abdullah bin Amr bin al-As ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Jab tum Mu'azzin ko suno, to wahi dohraao jo wo kehta hai, phir mujhpar durood bhejo, kyunki jo bhi mujhpar durood bhejega, Allah usse das barakatein dega; phir Allah se mere liye Al-Wasila maango, jo Jannat mein ek darja hai jo sirf Allah ke ek bande ke liye munaasib hai, aur mujhe ummeed hai ki wo main hi hoon. Jo bhi Allah se ye maange ki mujhe Wasila di jaaye, use meri shafaa'at ka yaqeen ho jaayega.

e: 'Umar b. al-Khattab reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When the Mu'adhdhin says: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, and one of you should make this response: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest; (and when the Mu'adhdhin) says: I testify that there is no god but Allah, one should respond: I testify that there is no god but Allah, and when he says: I testify that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, one should make a response: I testify that Muhammad is Allah's Messenger. When he (the Mu'adhdhin) says: Come to prayer, one should make a response: There is no might and no power except with Allah. When he (the Mu'adhdhin) says: Come to salvation, one should respond: There is no might and no power except with Allah, and when he (the Mu'adhdhin) says: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, then make a response: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest. When he (the Mu'adhdhin) says: There is no god but Allah, and he who makes a re- sponse from the heart: There is no god but Allah, he will enter Paradise.
hi: Umar bin Khattab ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab Mu'azzin kahe: Allah Sabse Bada Hai, Allah Sabse Bada Hai, to tum mein se koi ye jawaab de: Allah Sabse Bada Hai, Allah Sabse Bada Hai; aur jab Mu'azzin kahe: Main gawahi deta hoon ki Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, to jawaab dena chaahiye: Main gawahi deta hoon ki Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, aur jab wo kahe: Main gawahi deta hoon ki Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain, to jawaab dena chaahiye: Main gawahi deta hoon ki Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain. Jab wo kahe: Namaz ki taraf aao, to jawaab dena chaahiye: Koi taaqat aur koi qudrat nahi sivaay Allah ki madad ke. Jab wo kahe: Kaamyaabi ki taraf aao, to jawaab dena chaahiye: Koi taaqat aur koi qudrat nahi sivaay Allah ki madad ke, aur jab wo kahe: Allah Sabse Bada Hai, Allah Sabse Bada Hai, to jawaab do: Allah Sabse Bada Hai, Allah Sabse Bada Hai. Jab wo kahe: Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, aur jo koi apne dil se ye jawaab de: Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, wo Jannat mein daakhil hoga.

e: Sa'd b. Abu Waqqas reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: If anyone says on hearing the Mu'adhdhin: I testify that there is no god but Allah alone. Who has no partner, and that Muhammad is His servant and His Messenger, (and that) I am satisfied with Allah as my Lord, with Muhammad as Messenger. and with Islam as din (code of life), his sins would be forgiven. In the narration transmitted by Ibn Rumh the words are:" He who said on hearing the Mu'adhdhin and verity I testify." ' Qutaiba has not mentioned his words:" And I."
hi: Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Jo koi Mu'azzin ko sunkar kahe: Main gawahi deta hoon ki Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, akela, jiska koi shareek nahi, aur ki Muhammad Uske bande aur Uske Rasool hain, aur ki main Allah ko apna Rab, Muhammad ko Rasool, aur Islam ko apna deen maankar khush hoon, uske gunah maaf kar diye jaayenge. Ibn Rumh ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: 'Jisne Mu'azzin ko sunkar kaha aur waaqai main gawahi deta hoon.' Qutaiba ne unke 'aur main' alfaaz ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: Yahya narrated it on the authority of his uncle that he had been sitting in the company of Mu'awiya b. Abu Sufyan when the Mu'adhdhin called (Muslims) to prayer. Mu'awiya said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying The Mu'adhdhins will have the longest necks on the Day of Resurrection.
hi: Yahya ne ise apne chacha se riwayat ki ki wo Mu'awiya bin Abu Sufyan ki sohbat mein baithe hue the jab Mu'azzin ne namaz ke liye pukaara. Mu'awiya ne kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Mu'azzinon ki Qayamat ke Din sabse lambi gardanein hongi.

e: Abu Sufyan reported it on the authority of Jabir that he had heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: When Satan hears the call to prayer, he runs away to a distance like that of Rauha. Sulaimin said: I asked him about Rauha. He replied: It is at a distance of thirty-six miles from Medina.
hi: Abu Sufyan ne ise Jabir se riwayat ki ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab Shaitan namaz ki pukaar sunta hai, to wo Rauha jitni doori tak bhaag jaata hai. Sulaiman ne kaha: Maine unse Rauha ke baare mein poocha. Unhone jawaab diya: Ye Madina se chhattis (36) meel ki doori par hai.

e: Abu Mu'awiya narrated it on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Abu Mu'awiya ne ise A'mash se usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: When Satan hears the call to prayer, he turns back and breaks the wind so as not to hear the call being made, but when the call is finished he turns round and distracts (the minds of those who pray), and when he hears the Iqama, he again runs away so as not to hear its voice and when it subsides, he comes back and distracts (the minds of those who stand for prayer).
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Jab Shaitan Azaan sunta hai, to wo mudta hai aur aawaz na sunne ke liye hawa nikaalta hai, lekin jab Azaan khatam ho jaati hai, to wo wapas mudta hai aur namaz padhne walon ka dhyaan bhataka deta hai, aur jab wo Iqaamat sunta hai, to wo phir se bhaag jaata hai taaki uski aawaz na sune, aur jab wo khatam ho jaati hai, to wo wapas aata hai aur namaz ke liye khade logon ka dhyaan bhataka deta hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When the Mu'adhdhin calls to prayer, Satan runs back vehemently.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jab Mu'azzin namaz ke liye pukaarta hai, to Shaitan zor se bhaag jaata hai.

e: Suhail reported that his father sent him to Banu Haritha along with a boy or a man. Someone called him by his name from an enclosure. He (thenarrator) said: The person with me looked towards the enclosure, but saw nothing. I made a mention of that to my father. He said: If I knew that you would meet such a situation I would have never sent you (there), but (bear in wind) whenever you hear such a call (from the evil spirits) pronounce the Adhan. for I have heard Abu Huraira say that the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upbn him) said: Whenever Adhan is proclaimed, Satan runs back vehemently.
hi: Suhail ne bataaya ki unke waalid ne unhein ek ladke ya mard ke saath Banu Haritha bheja. Kisi ne ek gher hui jagah se unka naam lekar unhein bulaaya. Unhone kaha: Mere saath ke shaks ne us gher hui jagah ki taraf dekha, lekin kuch nazar nahi aaya. Maine iska zikr apne waalid se kiya. Unhone kaha: Agar mujhe pata hota ki tumhein aisi soorat-e-haal ka saamna karna padega, to main tumhein kabhi na bhejta, lekin yaad rakho, jab bhi tumhein aisi pukaar sunayi de, to Azaan do, kyunki maine Abu Huraira ko ye kehte suna ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab bhi Azaan di jaati hai, Shaitan zor se bhaag jaata hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Apostle (ﷺ) said When the call to prayer is made, Satan runs back and breaks wind so as not to hear the call being made, and when the call is finished. he turns round. When Iqama is proclaimed he turns his back, and when it is finished he turns round to distract a man, saying: Re- member such and such; remember such and such, referring to something the man did not have in his mind, with the result that he does not know how much he has prayed.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jab namaz ki pukaar ki jaati hai, to Shaitan mudta hai aur hawa nikaalta hai taaki wo pukaar na sun sake, aur jab pukaar khatam ho jaati hai, to wo wapas mudta hai. Jab Iqaamat ki jaati hai, to wo peeth pher leta hai, aur jab wo khatam ho jaati hai, to wo wapas mudta hai aur aadmi ka dhyaan bhataane ke liye kehta hai: Falaan-falaan baat yaad karo; falaan-falaan baat yaad karo, aisi cheez ka zikr karte hue jo aadmi ke zehen mein nahi thi, jiske nateeje mein use pata nahi chalta ki usne kitni namaz padhi hai.

e: A hadith like it has been narrated by Abu Huraira but for these words: " He (the man saying the prayer) does not know how much he has prayed.
hi: Ye jaisi hadees Abu Huraira ne riwayat ki hai lekin in alfaaz ke bagair: 'Use pata nahi chalta ki usne kitni namaz padhi hai.'

e: Salim narrated it on the authority of his father who reported: I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) raising his hands apposite the shoulders at the time of beginning the prayer and before bowing down and after coming back to the position after bowing. but he did not raise them between two prostrations.
hi: Salim ne ise apne waalid se riwayat ki jinhone bataaya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko namaz shuru karte waqt aur ruku mein jaane se pehle aur ruku se wapas aane ke baad apne haath kandhon ke barabar uthaate dekha, lekin unhone do sajdon ke darmiyaan unhein nahi uthaaya.

e: Ibn Umar reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), when he stood up for prayer, used to raise his hands apposite the shoulders and then recited takbir (Allah-o-Akbar), and when he was about to bow he again did like it and when he raised himself from the ruku' (bowing posture) he again did like it, but he did not do it at the time of raising his head from prostration.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bataaya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW), jab wo namaz ke liye khade hote, to apne haath kandhon ke barabar uthaate aur phir Takbeer kehte, Allah-o-Akbar, aur jab wo jhukne waale hote, to wo phir aisa karte aur jab wo ruku ki halat se uthte, to wo phir aisa karte, lekin sajde se apna sar uthaate waqt aisa nahi karte the.

e: This hadith has been transmitted with the same chain of transmitters by al. Zuhri as narrated by Ibn Juraij (who) said. When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stood up for prayer, he raised hands (to the height) apposite the shoulders and then recited takbir.
hi: Ye hadees usi sanad ke saath al-Zuhri ne bhi riwayat ki hai jaisi Ibn Juraij ne bayan ki, jinhone kaha: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) namaz ke liye khade hote, to wo apne haath kandhon ke barabar uthaate aur phir Takbeer kehte.

e: Abu Qilaba reported that he saw Malik b. Huwairith raising his hands at the beginning of prayer and raising his hands before kneeling down, and raising his hands after lifting his head from the state of kneeling, and he narrated that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to do like this.
hi: Abu Qilaba ne bataaya ki unhone Malik bin Huwairith ko namaz ki shuruaat mein apne haath uthaate, aur jhukne se pehle apne haath uthaate, aur jhukne ki halat se sar uthaane ke baad apne haath uthaate dekha, aur unhone bataaya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) isi tarah kiya karte the.

e: Malik b. Huwairith reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) raised his hands apposite his ears at the time of reciting the takbir (i. e. at the time of beginning the prayer) and then again raised his hands apposite the ears at the time of bowing and when he lifted his head after bowing he said: Allah listened to him who praised Him, and did like it (raised his hands up to the ears).
hi: Malik bin Huwairith ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Takbeer padhte waqt apne haath kaanon ke barabar uthaate the aur phir jhukte waqt bhi apne haath kaanon ke barabar uthaate the aur jab wo jhukne ke baad apna sar uthaate, to wo kehte: Allah ne uski suni jisne Uski tareef ki, aur waise hi karte, apne haath kaanon tak uthaate.

e: This hadith has been transmitted by Qatada with the same chain of transmitters that he saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) doing this (i.e. raising his hands) till they were opposite the lobes of ears.
hi: Ye hadees Qatada ne usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye karte dekha, yaani apne haath uthaate, yahan tak ki wo kaanon ke lower hisson ke barabar ho jaate.

e: Abu Salama reported: Abu Huraira led prayer for them and recited takbir when he bent and raised himself (in ruku' and sujud) and after completing (the prayer) he said: By Allah I say prayer which has the best resemblance with the prayer of the Prophet (ﷺ) amongst you.
hi: Abu Salama ne bataaya: Abu Huraira ne unke liye namaz ki imaamat ki aur jhukte aur uthte waqt Takbeer kaha, ruku aur sajde mein, aur namaz mukammal karne ke baad kaha: Allah ki qasam, main tum mein se sabse zyada Nabi (SAW) ki namaz se milti-julti namaz padhta hoon.

e: Abu Huraira reported: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) got up for prayer, he would say the takbir (Allah-o-Akbar) when standing, then say the takbir when bowing. then say:" Allah listened to him who praised him," when coming to the erect position after bowing, then say while standing:" To Thee, our Lord, be the praise", then recite the takbir when getting down for prostration, then say the takbir on raising his head, then say the takbir on prostrating himself, then say the takbir on raising his head. He would do that throughout the whole prayer till he would complete it, and he would say the takbir when he would get up at the end of two rak'as after adopting the sitting posture. Abu Huraira said: My prayer has the best resemblance amongst you with the prayer of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) namaz ke liye uthte, to wo khade hote hue Takbeer kehte, phir ruku mein jaate hue Takbeer kehte, phir 'Allah ne uski suni jisne Uski tareef ki' kehte jab wo ruku se seedhe hote, phir khade hote hue kehte 'Aye humaare Rab, sirf Teri hi tareef hai', phir sajde mein jaate hue Takbeer padhte, phir sar uthaate hue Takbeer kehte, phir sajda karte hue Takbeer kehte, phir sar uthaate hue Takbeer kehte. Wo poori namaz mein aisa hi karte the jab tak use mukammal na kar lete, aur do rakaaton ke baad baithne ki halat apnaane ke baad khade hote hue bhi Takbeer kehte. Abu Huraira ne kaha: Meri namaz tum mein se sabse zyada Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki namaz se milti-julti hai.

e: Ibn al-Harith reported: He had heard Abu Huraira say: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) recited takbir on standing for prayer, and the rest of the hadith is like that transmitted by Ibn Juraij (recorded above), but he did not mention Abu Huraira as saying:" My prayer has the best resemblance amongst you with the prayer of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)."
hi: Ibn al-Harith ne bataaya ki unhone Abu Huraira ko ye kehte suna: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) namaz ke liye khade hote waqt Takbeer padhte, aur baaki hadees Ibn Juraij ki riwayat ki gayi jaisi hai, lekin unhone Abu Huraira ke ye alfaaz zikr nahi kiye: 'Meri namaz tum mein se sabse zyada Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki namaz se milti-julti hai.'

e: Abu Salama b. 'Abd al-Rahman reported.. When Marwan appointed Abu Huraira as his deputy in Medina, he recited takbir whenever he got up for obligatory prayer, and the rest of the hadith is the same as transmitted by Ibn Juraij (but with the addition of these words): On completing the prayer with salutation, and he turned to the people in the mosque and said....
hi: Abu Salama bin Abdur Rahman ne bataaya: Jab Marwan ne Abu Huraira ko Madina mein apna naayab muqarrar kiya, to wo jab bhi farz namaz ke liye uthte, Takbeer padhte, aur baaki hadees Ibn Juraij ki riwayat jaisi hai, is alfaaz ke izafe ke saath: Salaam ke saath namaz mukammal karne par, unhone masjid mein logon ki taraf mudkar kaha...

e: Abu Salama reported that Abu Huraira recited takbir in prayer on all occasions of rising and kneeling. We said: O Abu Huraira, what is this takbir? He said: Verily it is the prayer of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).
hi: Abu Salama ne bataaya ki Abu Huraira namaz mein har baar uthte aur jhukte waqt Takbeer padhte the. Humne kaha: Aye Abu Huraira, ye Takbeer kya hai? Unhone kaha: Beshak ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki namaz hai.

e: Suhail reported on the authority of his father that Abu Huraira used to recite takbir on all occasions of rising and bending (in prayer) and narrated that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to do like that.
hi: Suhail ne apne waalid se riwayat ki ki Abu Huraira namaz mein har baar uthte aur jhukte waqt Takbeer padha karte the, aur bataaya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) isi tarah kiya karte the.

e: Mutarrif reported: I and 'Imran b. Husain said prayer behind 'Ali b. Abu, Talib. He recited takbir when he prostrated, and he recited takbir when he raised his head and he recited takbir while rising up (from the sitting position at the end of two rak'ahs). When we had finished our prayer, 'Imran caught hold of my hand and said: He (Hadrat Ali) has led prayer like Muhammad (ﷺ) or he said: He in fact recalled to my mind the prayer of Muhammad (may peace be upon him.)
hi: Mutarrif ne bataaya: Main aur Imran bin Husain ne Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ke peeche namaz padhi. Unhone sajda karte waqt Takbeer padhi, aur jab unhone apna sar uthaaya to Takbeer padhi aur do rakaaton ke baad uthte waqt bhi Takbeer padhi. Jab humne apni namaz mukammal ki, to Imran ne mera haath thaama aur kaha: Unhone Muhammad (SAW) ki tarah namaz padhi hai, ya unhone kaha: Unhone waaqai mujhe Muhammad (SAW) ki namaz yaad dila di.

e: 'Ubada b. as-Samit reported from the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him ): He who does not recite Fatihat al-Kitab is not credited with having observed the prayer.
hi: Ubada bin as-Samit ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat ki: Jo Fatiha al-Kitab nahi padhta, uski namaz nahi hoti.

e: Ubada b. as-Samit reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: He who does not recite Umm al-Qur'an is not credited with having observed the prayer.
hi: Ubada bin as-Samit ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Jo Umm al-Quran nahi padhta, uski namaz nahi hoti.

e: Mahmud b. al-Rabi', on whose face the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) squirted water from the well, reported on the authority of 'Ubada b. as- Samit that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: He who does not recite Umm al-Qur'an is not credited with having observed prayer.
hi: Mahmud bin al-Rabi', jinke chehre par Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kuen ka paani chhidka tha, ne Ubada bin as-Samit se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Jo Umm al-Quran nahi padhta, uski namaz nahi hoti.

e: This hadith has also been transmitted by Ma'mar from al-Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters with the addition of these words: " and something more".
hi: Ye hadees Ma'mar ne bhi al-Zuhri se usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai, is izafe ke saath: 'aur kuch aur bhi.'

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) said: If anyone observes prayer in which he does not recite Umm al-Qur'an, It is deficient  and not complete. It was said to Abu Huraira: At times we are behind the Imam. He said: Recite it inwardly, for he had heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) declare that Allah the Exalted had said: I have divided the prayer into two halves between Me and My servant, and My servant will receive what he asks. When the servant says: Praise be to Allah, the Lord of the universe, Allah the Most High says: My servant has praised Me. And when he (the servant) says: The Most Compassionate, the Merciful, Allah the Most High says: My servant has lauded Me. And when he (the servant) says: Master of the Day of judg- ment, He remarks: My servant has glorified Me. and sometimes He would say: My servant entrusted (his affairs) to Me. And when he (the worshipper) says: Thee do we worship and of Thee do we ask help, He (Allah) says: This is between Me and My servant, and My servant will receive what he asks for. Then, when he (the worshipper) says: Guide us to the straight path, the path of those to whom Thou hast been Gracious not of those who have incurred Thy displeasure, nor of those who have gone astray, He (Allah) says: This is for My servant, and My servant will receive what he asks for. Sufyan said: 'Ala b. 'Abd al-Rahman b. Ya'qub narrated it to me when I went to him and he was confined to his home on account of illness, and I asked him about it.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Agar koi namaz padhta hai jismein wo Umm al-Quran nahi padhta, to wo namaz adhoori hai, mukammal nahi. Abu Huraira se kaha gaya: Kabhi-kabhi hum Imam ke peeche hote hain. Unhone kaha: Ise apne dil mein padho, kyunki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye elaan karte suna tha ki Buland Allah ne farmaya: Maine namaz ko apne aur apne bande ke darmiyaan do hisson mein baanta hai, aur mere bande ko wahi milega jo wo maangega. Jab banda kehta hai: 'Sab tareef Allah ke liye hai, jo saari duniyaon ka Rab hai,' Allah, Buland, kehta hai: 'Mere bande ne Meri tareef ki.' Aur jab wo kehta hai: 'Sabse Rahem Karne Wala, Meherbaan,' Allah, Buland, kehta hai: 'Mere bande ne Meri tareef ki.' Aur jab wo kehta hai: 'Qayamat ke Din ka Maalik,' to Wo kehta hai: 'Mere bande ne Meri azmat bayan ki,' aur kabhi Wo kehta: 'Mere bande ne apne maamlaat Mujhe saup diye.' Aur jab wo kehta hai: 'Hum sirf Teri hi ibaadat karte hain aur sirf Tujhse hi madad maangte hain,' Wo kehta hai: 'Ye Mere aur Mere bande ke darmiyaan hai, aur mere bande ko wahi milega jo wo maangega.' Phir, jab wo kehta hai: 'Humein seedhi raah dikha, un logon ki raah jinpar Tu ne inaam kiya hai, na un logon ki jinpar Teri naaraazgi hui, na un logon ki jo bhatak gaye,' Wo kehta hai: 'Ye Mere bande ke liye hai, aur mere bande ko wahi milega jo wo maangega.' Sufyan ne kaha: Ala bin Abdur Rahman bin Ya'qub ne mujhe ye us waqt bataayi jab main unke paas gaya aur wo bimaari ki wajah se ghar tak seemit the, aur maine unse iske baare mein poocha.

e: It is naratted on the authority of Abu Huraira that he had heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: He who observed prayer but he did not recite the Umm al-Qur'an in it, and the rest of the hadith is the same as transmitted by Sufyan, and in this hadith the words are:" Allah the Most High said: the prayer is divided into two halves between Me and My servant. The half of it is for Me and the half of it is for My servant."
hi: Ye Abu Huraira ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jisne namaz padhi lekin usmein Umm al-Quran nahi padhi, aur baaki hadees Sufyan ki riwayat jaisi hi hai, aur is hadees mein alfaaz hain: 'Allah, Buland, ne farmaya: Namaz Mere aur Mere bande ke darmiyaan do hisson mein baanti gayi hai. Iska aadha hissa Mere liye hai aur aadha Mere bande ke liye.'

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: He who said his prayer, but did not recite the opening chapter of al-Kitab, his prayer is incomplete. He repeated it thrice.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Jisne apni namaz padhi, lekin al-Kitab ka pehla baab, yaani Surah Fatiha, nahi padha, uski namaz adhoori hai. Unhone ise teen baar dohraaya.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: One is not credited with having observed the prayer without the recitation (of al-Fatiha). So said Abu Huraira: (The prayer in which) the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) recited in a loud voice, we also recited that loudly for you (and the prayer in which) he recited inwardly we also recited inwardly for you (to give you a practical example of the prayer of the Holy Prophet).
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Fatiha ki tilaawat ke bagair namaz nahi hoti. Is liye Abu Huraira ne kaha: Us namaz mein jismein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) zor se padhte the, hum bhi tumhaare liye zor se padhte the, aur jis namaz mein unhone chupke se padha, hum bhi tumhaare liye chupke se padhte the, taaki tumhein Nabi (SAW) ki namaz ki ek amali misaal mil sake.

e: 'Ata' narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira who said that one should recite (al-Fatiha) in every (rak'ah of) prayer. What we heard (i. e. recitation) from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), we made you listen to that. And that which he (recited) inwardly, we (recited) inwardly for you. A person said to him: If I add nothing to the (recitation) of the Umm al Qur'an (Surat al-Fatiha), would it make the prayer incomplete? He (AbuHuraira) said: If you add to that (if you recite some of verses of the Qur'an along with Surat at-Fatiha) that is better for you. But if you are contented with it (Surat al-Fatiha) only, it is sufficient for you.
hi: Ata ne Abu Huraira se riwayat ki ki unhone kaha ki har rakaat namaz mein al-Fatiha padhni chaahiye. Jo humne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna, yaani tilaawat, wo humne tumhein sunwaaya. Aur jo unhone chupke se padha, wo humne tumhaare liye chupke se padha. Ek shaks ne unse kaha: Agar main Umm al-Quran ki tilaawat mein kuch bhi izafa na karun, to kya namaz adhoori ho jaayegi? Unhone kaha: Agar tum usmein izafa karo, yaani Surah al-Fatiha ke saath Quran ki kuch aur aayaten padho, to ye tumhaare liye behtar hai. Lekin agar tum sirf isi par, Surah al-Fatiha par, santusht ho, to ye tumhaare liye kaafi hai.

e: 'Ata' reported it on the authority of Abu Huraira who said: Recitation (of Surat al-Fatiha) in every (rak'ah) of prayer in essential. (The recitation) that we listened to from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) we made you listen to it. And that which he recited inwardly to us, we recited it inwardly for you. And he who recites Umm al-Qur'an, it is enough for him (to complete the prayer), and he who adds to it (recites some other verses of the Holy Qur'an along with Surat al-Fatiha), it is preferable for him.
hi: Ata ne ise Abu Huraira se riwayat ki jinhone kaha: Har rakaat namaz mein Surah al-Fatiha ki tilaawat zaroori hai. Jo tilaawat humne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna, wo humne tumhein sunwaya. Aur jo unhone chupke se humein padha, wo humne tumhaare liye chupke se padha. Aur jo Umm al-Quran padhta hai, uske liye itna hi kaafi hai namaz mukammal karne ke liye, aur jo ismein izafa karta hai, Surah al-Fatiha ke saath Quran ki kuch aur aayaten padhta hai, ye uske liye behtar hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) entered the mosque and a person also entered therein and offered prayer, and then came and paid salutation to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). The Mes- senger of Allah (ﷺ) returned his salutation and said: Go back and pray, for you have not offered the prayer. He again prayed as he had prayed before, and came to the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon. him) and saluted him. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) returned the salutation and said: Go back and say prayer, for you have not offered the prayer. This (act of repeating the prayer) was done three times. Upon this the person said: By Him Who hast sent you with Truth, whatever better I can do than this, please teach me. He (the Holy Prophet) said: When you get up to pray, recite takbir, and then recite whatever you conveniently can from the Qur'an, then bow down and remain quietly in that position, then raise your- self and stand erect; then prostrate yourself and remain quietly in that attitude; then raise yourself and sit quietly; and do that throughout all your prayers.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) masjid mein daakhil hue aur ek shaks bhi wahan daakhil hua aur namaz padhi, aur phir aakar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko salaam kiya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne uske salaam ka jawaab diya aur kaha: Wapas jao aur namaz padho, kyunki tumne namaz nahi padhi. Usne dobara namaz padhi jaisi usne pehle padhi thi, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unhein salaam kiya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne salaam ka jawaab diya aur kaha: Wapas jao aur namaz padho, kyunki tumne namaz nahi padhi. Ye namaz dohraane ka amal teen baar hua. Is par us shaks ne kaha: Us Zaat ki qasam Jisne aapko Haq ke saath bheja, isse behtar main aur kuch nahi kar sakta, meherbaani karke mujhe sikhaiye. Unhone kaha: Jab tum namaz ke liye khade ho, to Takbeer padho, aur phir jo bhi tumhein Quran se aasaani se yaad ho wo padho, phir jhuko aur us halat mein khaamosh raho, phir apne aap ko uthaao aur seedhe khade ho jaao; phir sajda karo aur us halat mein khaamosh raho; phir apne aap ko uthaao aur khaamoshi se baitho; aur apni saari namazon mein aisa hi karo.

e: Abu Huraira reported: A person entered the mosque and said prayer while the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was sitting in a nook (of the mosque), and the rest of the hadith is the same as mentioned above, but with this addition:" When you get up to pray, perform the ablution completely, and then turn towards the Qibla and recite takbir (Allah o Akbar =Allah is the Most Great)."
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Ek shaks masjid mein daakhil hua aur namaz padhi jabki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) masjid ke ek kone mein baithe the, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai jaisi upar zikr hui, lekin is izafe ke saath: 'Jab tum namaz ke liye khade ho, to poora wuzu karo, aur phir Qibla ki taraf mudo aur Takbeer padho, Allah-o-Akbar.'

e: lmrin b. Husain reported: The Messenger of Allah (may peace beupon him) led us In Zuhr or 'Asr prayer (noon or the afternoon prayer). (On concluding it) he said: Who recited behind me (the verses): Sabbih Isma Rabbik al-a'la (Glorify the name of thy Lord, the Most High)? There upon a person said: It was I, but I in- tended nothing but goodness. I felt that some one of you was disputing with me in it (or he was taking out from my tongue what I was reciting), said the Prophet (ﷺ).
hi: Imran bin Husain ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein Zuhr ya Asr ki namaz padhaayi. Ise mukammal karne ke baad unhone kaha: Mere peeche kisne ye aayaten padhi: 'Sabbih Isma Rabbik al-A'la' Apne Rab ke buland naam ki tasbeeh karo? Is par ek shaks ne kaha: Wo main tha, lekin mera bhalaai ke siwa koi aur iraada nahi tha. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Mujhe laga ki tum mein se koi mujhse ismein ikhtelaaf kar raha tha, ya wo meri zubaan se wo nikaal raha tha jo main padh raha tha.

e: 'Imran b. Husain reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed the Zuhr prayer and a person recited Sabbih Isma Rabbik al-a'la (Glorify the name of thy Lord, the Most High) behind him. When he (the Holy Pro- phet) concluded the prayer he said: Who amongst you recited (the above-mentioned verse) or who amongst you was the reciter? A person said: It was I. Upon this he (the Holy Prophet) observed: I thought as if someone amongst you was disputing with me (in what I was reciting).
hi: Imran bin Husain ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Zuhr ki namaz padhi aur ek shaks ne unke peeche 'Sabbih Isma Rabbik al-A'la' padha. Jab unhone namaz mukammal ki, to unhone kaha: Tum mein se kisne upar zikr ki gayi aayat padhi ya tum mein se kaun padhne wala tha? Ek shaks ne kaha: Wo main tha. Is par unhone kaha: Mujhe laga goya tum mein se koi mujhse, jo main padh raha tha usmein, ikhtelaaf kar raha tha.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Qatada with the same chain of transmitters that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed Zuhr prayer and said: I felt that someone amongst you was disputing with me (in what I was reciting).
hi: Ye hadees Qatada ne usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Zuhr ki namaz padhi aur kaha: Mujhe laga ki tum mein se koi mujhse ikhtelaaf kar raha tha.

e: Anas reported: I observed prayer along with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and with Abu Bakr, Umar and Uthman (may Allah be pleased with all of them), but I never heard any one of them reciting Bismillah-ir-Rahman-ir-Rahim loudly.
hi: Anas ne bataaya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath, aur Abu Bakr, Umar aur Uthman ke saath namaz padhi, lekin maine kabhi unmein se kisi ko 'Bismillah-ir-Rahman-ir-Raheem' zor se padhte nahi suna.

e: Shu'ba reported it with the same chain of transmitters. with she addition of these words: " I said to Qatada: Did you hear it from Anas? He replied in the affir- mative and added: We had inquired of him about it."
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ne usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai, is izafe ke saath: 'Maine Qatada se kaha: Kya aapne ye Anas se suna? Unhone haan mein jawaab diya aur izafa kiya: Humne unse iske baare mein poocha tha.'

e: 'Abda reported: 'Umar b. al-Khattab used to recite loudly these words: Subhanak Allahumma wa bi hamdika wa tabarakasmuka wa ta'ala jadduka wa la ilaha ghairuka  and did not recite Bismillah ir- Rahman-ir-Rahim (loudly) at the beginning of the recitation or at the end of it.
hi: Abda ne bataaya: Umar bin Khattab zor se ye alfaaz padha karte the: 'Subhanaka Allahumma wa bi hamdika wa tabarakasmuka wa ta'ala jadduka wa la ilaha ghairuka,' aur wo 'Bismillah-ir-Rahman-ir-Raheem' tilaawat ki shuruaat mein ya uske aakhir mein zor se nahi padhte the.

e: It is reported on the authority of Abu Talha that he had heard Anas b. Malik narrating this.
hi: Ye Abu Talha se riwayat hai ki unhone Anas bin Malik ko ye riwayat karte suna.

e: Anas reported: One day the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was sitting amongst us that he dozed off. He then raised his head smilingly. We said: What makes you smile. Messenger of Allah? He said: A Sura has just been revealed to me, and then recited: In the name of Allah, the Compassionate, the Merciful. Verily We have given thee Kauthar (fount of abundance). Therefore turn to thy Lord for prayer and offer sacrifice, and surely thy enemy is cut off (from the good). Then he (the Holy Prophet) said: Do you know what Kauthar is? We said: Allah and His Messenger know best. The Prophet (ﷺ) said: It (Kauthar) is a canal which my Lord, the Exalted and Glorious has promised me, and there is an abundance of good in it. It is a cistern and my people would come to it on the Day of Resurrection, and tumblers there would be equal to the number of stars. A servant would be turned away from (among the people gathered there). Upon this I would say: My Lord, he is one of my people, and He (the Lord) would say: You do not know that he innovated new things (in Islam) after you. Ibn Hujr made this addition in the hadith:" He (the Holy Prophet) was sitting amongst us in the mosque, and He (Allah) said: (You don't know) what he innovated after you"
hi: Anas ne bataaya: Ek din Allah ke Rasool (SAW) humaare beech baithe hue the ki unhein oonghi aa gayi. Phir unhone muskuraate hue apna sar uthaaya. Humne kaha: Aapko kis cheez ne muskuraaya, Allah ke Rasool? Unhone kaha: Mujhpar abhi-abhi ek Surah nazil hui hai, aur phir tilaawat ki: 'Allah ke naam se, jo Rehmaan aur Raheem hai. Beshak Humne tumhein Kausar diya hai. Is liye apne Rab ki taraf namaz ke liye rukh karo aur qurbaani do, aur beshak tumhaara dushman hi bhalaai se kata hua hai.' Phir unhone kaha: Kya tumhein pata hai Kausar kya hai? Humne kaha: Allah aur Uske Rasool behtar jaante hain. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Ye Kausar ek nahar hai jiska waada mere Rab, Buland aur Baa-Azmat, ne mujhse kiya hai, aur ismein bahut zyada bhalaai hai. Ye ek hauz hai aur meri ummat Qayamat ke Din wahan aayegi, aur wahan pyaale sitaaron ki tadaad ke barabar honge. Ek banda wahan jama logon mein se wapas hataaya jaayega. Is par main kahunga: Mere Rab, wo meri ummat mein se hai, aur Wo kahega: Tumhein nahi pata ki usne tumhaare baad nayi cheezein Islam mein ijaad ki thi. Ibn Hujr ne hadees mein ye izafa kiya: Wo Nabi (SAW) masjid mein humaare beech baithe hue the, aur Wo Allah ne kaha: Tumhein nahi pata usne tumhaare baad kya ijaad kiya.

e: Mukhtar b. Fulful reported that he had heard Anas b. Malik say that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) dozed off, and the rest of the hadith is the same as transmitted by Mus-hir except for the words that he (the Holy Prophet) said: It (Kauthar) is a canal which my Lord the Exalted and the Glorious has promised me in Paradise. There is a tank over it, but he made no mention of the tumblers like the number of the stars.
hi: Mukhtar bin Fulful ne bataaya ki unhone Anas bin Malik ko ye kehte suna ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko oonghi aa gayi, aur baaki hadees Mus'hir ki riwayat jaisi hi hai, sivaay in alfaaz ke ki unhone kaha: Ye Kausar ek nahar hai jiska waada mere Rab, Buland aur Baa-Azmat, ne mujhse Jannat mein kiya hai. Iske oopar ek talaab hai, lekin unhone sitaaron ki tadaad jaise pyaalon ka koi zikr nahi kiya.

e: Wa'il b. Hujr reported: He saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) raising his hands at the time of beginning the prayer and reciting takbir, and according to Hammam (the narrator), the hands were lifted opposite to ears. He (the Holy Prophet) then wrapped his hands in his cloth and placed his right hand over his left hand. And when he was about to bow down, he brought out his hands from the cloth, and then lifted them, and then recited takbir and bowed down, and when (he came back to the erect position) he recited:" Allah listened to him who praised Him." And when he prostrated, he prostrated between his two palms.
hi: Wail bin Hujr ne bataaya: Unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko namaz ki shuruaat mein apne haath uthaate aur Takbeer padhte dekha, aur Hammam ke mutaabiq, haath kaanon ke barabar uthaaye jaate the. Phir unhone apne haath apne kapde mein lapete aur apna daaya haath apne baaye haath par rakha. Aur jab wo jhukne waale hote, to wo apne haath kapde se bahar nikaalte, aur phir unhein uthaate, aur phir Takbeer padhte aur jhukte, aur jab wo seedhe hote to kehte: 'Allah ne uski suni jisne Uski tareef ki.' Aur jab wo sajda karte, to wo apni dono hatheliyon ke beech sajda karte.

e: `Abdullah (b. Mas`ud) said: While observing prayer behind the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) we used to recite: Peace be upon Allah, peace be upon so and so. One day the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to us: Verily Allah is Himself Peace. When any one of you sits during the prayer, he should say: All services rendered by words, by acts of worship, and all good things are due to Allah. Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and Allah's mercy and blessings. Peace be upon us and upon Allah's upright servants, for when he says this it reaches every upright servant in the heavens and the earth. (And say further): I testify that there is no god but Allah and I testify that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger. Then he may choose any supplication which pleases him and offer it.
hi: Abdullah (bin Mas'ood) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke peeche namaz padhte waqt hum kaha karte the: 'Salaam ho Allah par, salaam ho falaan-falaan par.' Ek din Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humse kaha: Beshak Allah khud hi Salaam hai. Jab tum mein se koi namaz mein baithe, to use kehna chahiye: 'Tamaam ehteraam alfaaz se, ibaadat ke amal se, aur tamaam achhi cheezein Allah ke liye hain. Salaam ho aap par, Aye Nabi, aur Allah ki rehmat aur barakatein. Salaam ho humpar aur Allah ke nek bandon par,' kyunki jab wo ye kehta hai, to ye aasmaanon aur zameen ke har nek bande tak pahunchta hai. Aur aage kaho: 'Main gawahi deta hoon ki Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi aur main gawahi deta hoon ki Muhammad Uske bande aur Rasool hain.' Phir wo koi bhi dua chun sakta hai jo use pasand ho aur use pesh kar sakta hai.

e: Shu'ba has narrated this on the authority of Mansur with the same chain of transmitters, but he made no mention of this: " Then he may choose any supplication which pleases him."
hi: Shu'ba ne ise Mansoor se usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai, lekin unhone iska zikr nahi kiya: 'Phir wo koi bhi dua chun sakta hai jo use pasand ho.'

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Mansur with the same chain of transmitters and he made a mention of this: " Then he may choose any supplication which pleases him or which he likes."
hi: Ye hadees Mansoor se usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai aur unhone iska zikr kiya: 'Phir wo koi bhi dua chun sakta hai jo use pasand ho ya jo use achhi lage.'

e: Abdullah b. Mas'ud reported: We were sitting with the Apostle (ﷺ) in prayer, and the rest of the hadith is the same as narrated by Mansur He (also said): After (reciting tashahud) he may choose any prayer.
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ood ne bataaya: Hum Rasool (SAW) ke saath namaz mein baithe the, aur baaki hadees Mansoor ki riwayat jaisi hi hai. Unhone ye bhi kaha: Tashahhud padhne ke baad wo koi bhi dua chun sakta hai.

e: Ibn Mas'ud is reported to have said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) taught me tashahhud taking my hand within his palms, in the same way as he taught me a Sura of the Qur'an, and he narrated it as narrated above.
hi: Ibn Mas'ood ne bataaya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhein Tashahhud sikhaaya, unka haath apni hatheliyon ke beech lete hue, jaise wo unhein Quran ki koi Surah sikhaate the, aur unhone ise upar bayan ki gayi tarah riwayat kiya.

e: Ibn `Abbas reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to teach us tashahhud just as he used to teach us a Surah of the Qur'an, and he would say: All services rendered by words, acts of worship, and all good things are due to Allah. Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and Allah's mercy and blessings. Peace be upon us and upon Allah's upright servants. I testify that there is no god but Allah, and I testify that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. In the narration of Ibn Rumh (the words are): "As he would teach us the Qur'an."
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) humein Tashahhud isi tarah sikhaate the jaise wo humein Quran ki koi Surah sikhaate, aur wo kehte: Tamaam ehteraam alfaaz se, ibaadat ke amal se, aur tamaam achhi cheezein Allah ke liye hain. Salaam ho aap par, Aye Nabi, aur Allah ki rehmat aur barakatein. Salaam ho humpar aur Allah ke nek bandon par. Main gawahi deta hoon ki Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, aur main gawahi deta hoon ki Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain. Ibn Rumh ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: 'Jaise wo humein Quran sikhaate.'

e: Tawus narrated it on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to teach us tashahhud as he would teach us a Sura of the Qur'an.
hi: Tawus ne ise Ibn Abbas se riwayat ki jinhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) humein Tashahhud isi tarah sikhaate jaise wo humein Quran ki koi Surah sikhaate.

e: Hattan b. `Abdullah al-Raqashi reported: I observed prayer with Abu Musa al-Ash`ari and when he was in the qa`dah, one among the people said: The prayer has been made obligatory along with piety and Zakat. He (the narrator) said: When Abu Musa had finished the prayer after salutation he turned (towards the people) and said: Who amongst you said such and such a thing? A hush fell on the people. He again said: Who amongst you has said such and such a thing? A hush fell on the people. He (Abu Musa) said: Hattan, it is perhaps you that have uttered it. He (Hattan) said No. I have not uttered it. I was afraid that you might be annoyed with me on account of this. A person amongst the people said: It was I who said it, and in this I intended nothing but good. Abu Musa said: Don't you know what you have to recite in your prayers? Verily the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) addressed us and explained to us all its aspects and taught us how to observe prayer (properly). He (the Holy Prophet) said: When you pray make your rows straight and let anyone amongst you act as your Imam. Recite the takbir when he recites it and when he recites: Not of those with whom Thou art angry, nor of those who go astray, say: Amin. Allah would respond you. And when he (the Imam) recites the takbir, you may also recite the takbir, for the Imam bows before you and raises himself before you. Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The one is equivalent to the other. And when he says: Allah listens to him who praises Him, you should say: O Allah, our Lord, to Thee be the praise, for Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, has vouchsafed (us) through the tongue of His Apostle (ﷺ) that Allah listens to him who praises Him. And when he (the Imam) recites the takbir and prostrates, you should also recite the takbir and prostrate, for the Imam prostrates before you and raises himself before you. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The one is equivalent to the other. And when he (the Imam) sits for Qa`da (for tashahhud) the first words of every one amongst you should be: All services rendered by words, acts of worship and all good things are due to Allah. Peace be upon you, O Apostle, and Allah's mercy and blessings. Peace be upon us and upon the upright servants of Allah. I testify that there is no god but Allah, and I testify that Muhammad is His servant and His Messenger.
hi: Hattan bin Abdullah al-Raqashi ne bataaya: Maine Abu Musa al-Ash'ari ke saath namaz padhi, aur jab wo Qa'dah mein the, to logon mein se ek ne kaha: Namaz ko taqwa aur Zakat ke saath farz kiya gaya hai. Unhone kaha: Jab Abu Musa ne salaam ke baad namaz mukammal ki, to unhone mudkar kaha: Tum mein se kisne is-is tarah kaha? Logon par khaamoshi chha gayi. Unhone dobara kaha: Tum mein se kisne is-is tarah kaha? Logon par phir khaamoshi chha gayi. Unhone kaha: Hattan, shaayad tumne hi ye kaha ho. Unhone kaha: Nahi, maine ye nahi kaha. Mujhe dar tha ki aap mujhse iski wajah se naaraaz ho jaayenge. Logon mein se ek shaks ne kaha: Ye main tha jisne ye kaha, aur ismein mera bhalaai ke siwa koi aur iraada nahi tha. Abu Musa ne kaha: Kya tumhein nahi maloom ki tumhein apni namazon mein kya padhna chaahiye? Beshak Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humse khitaab kiya aur humein iske sab pehluon ki tafseel batayi aur humein namaz sahi tareeke se padhna sikhaaya. Unhone kaha: Jab tum namaz padho, to apni saffein seedhi karo aur tum mein se koi imaamat kare. Jab wo Takbeer kahe, to tum Takbeer kaho, aur jab wo kahe: 'Un logon ki nahi jinpar Teri naaraazgi hui, aur na un logon ki jo bhatak gaye,' to kaho: 'Ameen.' Allah tumhaari dua qubool karega. Aur jab wo Takbeer kahe, to tum bhi Takbeer kaho, kyunki Imam tumse pehle jhukta hai aur tumse pehle uthta hai. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ye dono ek doosre ke barabar hain. Aur jab wo kahe: 'Allah ne uski suni jisne Uski tareef ki,' to tumhein kehna chaahiye: 'Aye Allah, humaare Rab, Teri hi tareef hai,' kyunki Allah, Buland aur Baa-Azmat, ne Apne Rasool (SAW) ki zubaan se ye zaahir kiya hai ki Allah uski sunta hai jo Uski tareef karta hai. Aur jab wo Takbeer kahe aur sajda kare, to tumhein bhi Takbeer kehni chaahiye aur sajda karna chaahiye, kyunki Imam tumse pehle sajda karta hai aur tumse pehle uthta hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ye dono ek doosre ke barabar hain. Aur jab wo Qa'da ke liye baithe, to tum mein se har ek ke pehle alfaaz honi chaahiye: Tamaam ehteraam alfaaz se, ibaadat ke amal se aur tamaam achhi cheezein Allah ke liye hain. Salaam ho aap par, Aye Rasool, aur Allah ki rehmat aur barakatein. Salaam ho humpar aur Allah ke nek bandon par. Main gawahi deta hoon ki Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, aur main gawahi deta hoon ki Muhammad Uske bande aur Uske Rasool hain.

e: Qatada has narrated a hadith like this with another chain of transmitters. In the hadith transmitted by Jarir on the authority of Sulaiman, Qatada's further words are: When (the Qur'an) is recited (in prayer), you should observe silence, and (the following words are) not found in the hadith narrated by anyone except by Abu Kamil who heard it from Abu 'Awina (and the words are): Verily Allah vouchsafed through the tongue of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) this: Allah listens to him who praises Him. Abu Ishaq (a student of Imam Muslim) said: Abu Bakr the son of Abu Nadr's sister has (critically) discussed this hadith. Imam Muslim said: Whom can you find a more authentic transmitter of hadith than Sulaiman? Abu Bakr said to him (Imam Muslim): What about the hadith narrated by Abu Huraira, i.e. the hadith that when the Qur'an is recited (in prayer) observe silence? He (Abu Bakr again) said: Then, why have you not included it (in your compilation)? He (Imam Muslim) said: I have not included in this every hadith which I deem authentic; I have recorded only such ahadith on which there is an agreement (amongst the Muhaddithin apart from their being authentic).
hi: Qatada ne is jaisi hadees ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki hai. Jarir ki riwayat mein, Sulaiman ki sanad se, Qatada ke aage ye alfaaz hain: Jab Quran tilaawat ki jaaye, to khaamosh raho, aur ye alfaaz kisi aur ki riwayat mein nahi milte sivaay Abu Kamil ke jinhone ise Abu Awana se suna, aur alfaaz hain: Beshak Allah ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zubaan se ye zaahir kiya: 'Allah uski sunta hai jo Uski tareef karta hai.' Abu Ishaq ne kaha: Abu Bakr, Abu Nadr ki bahen ke bete, ne is hadees par tanqeedi baat ki hai. Imam Muslim ne kaha: Aapko Sulaiman se zyada mo'tabar raawi kahan milega? Abu Bakr ne unse kaha: Us hadees ka kya jo Abu Huraira ne riwayat ki, yaani wo hadees ki jab Quran tilaawat ho, to khaamosh raho? Unhone phir kaha: To phir aap ne ise apni kitab mein kyun shaamil nahi kiya? Unhone kaha: Maine har wo hadees ismein shaamil nahi ki jise main sahi maanta hoon; maine sirf wahi Ahadees darj ki hain jinpar Muhaddithon ke darmiyaan ittefaaq hai, unki sehat ke alaawa.

e: This hadith has been transmitted by Qatida with the same chain of transmitters (and the words are): " Allah, the Exalted and the Glorious, commanded it through the tongue of His Apostle (may peace be upon-him): Allah listens to him who praises Him."
hi: Ye hadees Qatada ne usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai aur alfaaz hain: 'Allah, Buland aur Baa-Azmat, ne apne Rasool (SAW) ki zubaan se iska hukum diya: Allah uski sunta hai jo Uski tareef karta hai.'

e: Abdullah b. Zaid-he who was shown the call (for prayer in a dream) narrated it on the authority of Abu Mas'ud al-Ansari who said: We were sitting in the company of Sa'id b. 'Ubida when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to us. Bashir b. S'ad said: Allah has commanded us to bless you. Messenger of Allah! But how should we bless you? He (the narrator) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) kept quiet (and we were so much perturbed over his silence) that we wished we had not asked him. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) then said: (For blessing me) say:" 0 Allah, bless Muhammad and the members of his household as Thou didst bless the mernbers of Ibrahim's household. Grant favours to Muhammad and the members of his household as Thou didst grant favours to the members of the household of Ibrahim in the world. Thou art indeed Praiseworthy and Glorious" ; and salutation as you know.
hi: Abdullah bin Zaid, jinhein khwaab mein Azaan dikhaayi gayi thi, ne ise Abu Mas'ood al-Ansari se riwayat ki jinhone kaha: Hum Sa'id bin Ubaida ki sohbat mein baithe the jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) humaare paas aaye. Bashir bin Sa'd ne kaha: Allah ne humein aap par durood bhejne ka hukum diya hai, Ya Rasoolullah! Lekin hum aap par durood kaise bhejein? Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khaamosh ho gaye, aur hum unki khaamoshi se itne pareshaan hue ki humein afsos hua ki humne ye sawaal kyun poocha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne phir kaha: Mujhpar durood bhejne ke liye kaho: 'Aye Allah, Muhammad aur unke ghar walon par rehmat naazil kar, jaise Tune Ibrahim ke ghar walon par ki thi. Muhammad aur unke ghar walon par ehsaan kar, jaise Tune Ibrahim ke ghar walon par duniya mein kiya tha. Beshak Tu tareef ke laayak aur azmat waala hai'; aur salaam wo jo tum jaante ho.

e: Ibn Abi Laila reported: Ka'b b. 'Ujra met me and said: Should I not offer you a present (and added): The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to us and we said: We have learnt how to invoke peace upon you; (kindly tell us) how we should bless you. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Say:" O Allah: bless Muhammad and his family as Thou didst bless the family of Ibrahim. Verily Thou art Praiseworthy and Glorious, O Allah."
hi: Ibn Abi Laila ne bataaya: Ka'b bin Ujra mujhse mile aur kaha: Kya main tumhein ek tohfa na dun, aur izafa kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) humaare paas aaye aur humne kaha: Humne aap par salaam bhejna seekh liya hai; meherbaani karke humein bataiye hum aap par durood kaise bhejein. Unhone kaha: Kaho: 'Aye Allah, Muhammad aur unke ghar walon par rehmat naazil kar, jaise Tune Ibrahim ke ghar walon par ki thi. Beshak Tu tareef ke laayak aur azmat waala hai, Aye Allah.'

e: A hadith like this has been narrated by Mis'ar on the authority of al-Hakam, but in the hadith transmitted by Mis'ar these words are not found: " Should I not offer you a present?"
hi: Isi jaisi ek hadees Mis'ar ne al-Hakam se riwayat ki hai, lekin Mis'ar ki riwayat ki gayi hadees mein ye alfaaz nahi milte: 'Kya main tumhein ek tohfa na dun?'

e: A hadith like this has been narrated by al-Hakam except that he said: " Bless Muhammad (ﷺ)" and he did not say:" O Allah I
hi: Isi jaisi ek hadees al-Hakam ne riwayat ki hai, sivaay iske ki unhone kaha: 'Muhammad par durood bhej,' aur unhone 'Aye Allah' nahi kaha.

e: Abu Humaid as-Sa'idi reported: They (the Companions of the Holy Prophet) said: Apostle of Allah, how should we bless you? He (the Holy Prophet) observed: Say:" O Allah! bless Muhammad, his wives and his offspring as Thou didst bless Ibrahim, and grant favours to Muhammad, and his wives and his offspring as Thou didst grant favours to the family of Ibrahim; Thou art Praiseworthy and Glorious."
hi: Abu Humaid as-Sa'idi ne bataaya: Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, hum aap par durood kaise bhejein? Unhone kaha: Kaho: 'Aye Allah, Muhammad, unki biwiyon aur unki aulaad par rehmat naazil kar, jaise Tune Ibrahim par ki thi, aur Muhammad, unki biwiyon aur unki aulaad par ehsaan kar, jaise Tune Ibrahim ke khaandan par kiya tha; beshak Tu tareef ke laayak aur azmat waala hai.'

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: He who blesses me once, Allah would bless him ten times.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Jo mujhpar ek baar durood bhejta hai, Allah uspar das baar rehmat naazil karta hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When the Imam says:" Allah listens to him who praises Him." you should say:" O Allah, our Lord for Thee is the praise." for if what anyone says synchronises with what the angels say, his past sins will be forgiven.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab Imam kahe: 'Allah ne uski suni jisne Uski tareef ki,' to tumhein kehna chaahiye: 'Aye Allah, humaare Rab, Teri hi tareef hai,' kyunki agar koi ye kahe aur wo uske alfaaz Farishton ke kahe hue alfaaz se mel khaa jaayein, to uske pichhle gunah maaf kar diye jaayenge.

e: A hadith like this is narrated by Abu Huraira by another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye jaisi ek hadees Abu Huraira ne ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: SayAmin when the Imam says Amin, for it anyone's utterance of Amin synchronises with that of the angels, he will be forgiven his past sins.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab Imam Ameen kahe, to Ameen kaho, kyunki agar kisi shaks ka Ameen kehna Farishton ke saath mel khaaye, to uske pichhle sab gunah maaf kar diye jaayenge.

e: Abu Huraira said: I heard from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) the hadith like one transmitted by Malik, but he made no mention of the words of Shihab.
hi: Abu Huraira ne kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye hadees suni jaisi Malik ne riwayat ki hai, lekin unhone Shihab ke alfaaz ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When anyone amongst you utters Amin in prayer and the angels in the sky also utter Amin, and this (utterance of the one) synchronises with (that of) the other, all his previous sins are pardoned.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab tum mein se koi namaz mein Ameen kahe aur aasman mein Farishte bhi Ameen kahein, aur ye ek ka kehna doosre se mel khaaye, to uske pichhle sab gunah maaf kar diye jaate hain.

e: Abu Harare reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When anyone amongst you utters Amin and the angels In the heaven also utter Amin and (the Amin) of the one synchronises with (that of) the other, all his previous sins are pardoned.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab tum mein se koi Ameen kahe aur aasman mein Farishte bhi Ameen kahein aur Ameen ek ki doosre se mel khaaye, to uske pichhle sab gunah maaf kar diye jaate hain.

e: 'A hadith like this is transmitted by Ma'mar from Hammam b. Munabbih on the authority of Abu Huraira who reported it from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).
hi: Ye jaisi ek hadees Ma'mar ne Hammam bin Munabbih se, Abu Huraira ki sanad se riwayat ki hai jinhone ise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat kiya.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When the reciter (Imam) utters:" Not of those on whom (is Thine) wrath and not the erring ones," and (the person) behind him utters Amin and his utterance synchronises with that of the dwellers of heavens, all his previous sins would be pardoned.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab qaari, yaani Imam, kahe: 'Un logon ki raah nahi jinpar Teri naaraazgi hui aur na bhatakne walon ki,' aur uske peeche wala Ameen kahe aur uska kehna aasmaan waalon ke kehne se mel khaaye, to uske pichhle sab gunah maaf kar diye jaayenge.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) fell down from a horse and his right side was grazed. We went to him to inquire after his health when the time of prayer came. He led us in prayer in a sitting posture and we said prayer behind him sitting, and when he finished the prayer hesaid: The Imam is appointed only to be followed; so when he recites takbir, you should also recite that; when he prostrates, you should also prostrate; when he rises up, you should also rise up, and when he said" God listens to him who praises Him," you should say:" Our Lord, to Thee be the praise," and when he prays sitting, all of you should pray sitting.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ghode se gir gaye aur unka daaya hissa chhil gaya. Hum unke paas unka haal-chaal poochne gaye jab namaz ka waqt hua. Unhone humaari baithi hui halat mein imaamat ki aur humne unke peeche baithkar namaz padhi, aur jab unhone namaz mukammal ki, to unhone kaha: Imam ki taqarruri sirf is liye ki jaati hai ki uski peirvi ki jaaye; is liye jab wo Takbeer padhe, to tum bhi wo padho; jab wo sajda kare, to tum bhi sajda karo; jab wo sajde se uthe, to tum bhi utho, aur jab wo kahe 'Allah ne uski suni jisne Uski tareef ki', to tum kaho 'Humaare Rab, sirf Teri hi tareef hai,' aur jab wo baithkar namaz padhe, to tum sab bhi baithkar namaz padho.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) fell down from a horse and he was grazed and he led the prayer for us sitting, and the rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ghode se gir gaye aur wo chhil gaye aur unhone humaari baithi hui halat mein imaamat ki, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) fell down from a horse and his right side was grazed, and the rest of the hadith is the same with the addition of these words:" When he (the Imam) says prayer standing, you should also do so."
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ghode se gir gaye aur unka daaya hissa chhil gaya, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai, is izafe ke saath: 'Jab wo Imam khade hokar namaz padhe, to tum bhi aisa hi karo.'

e: Anas reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) rode a horse and fell down from it and his right side was grazed, and the rest of the hadith is the same, and (these words) are found in it:" When he (the Imam) says prayer in an erect posture, you should also say it in an erect posture."
hi: Anas ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ghode par sawaar hue aur usse gir gaye aur unka daaya hissa chhil gaya, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai, aur ismein ye alfaaz hain: 'Jab wo khadi halat mein namaz padhe, to tum bhi khadi halat mein padho.'

e: Anas b. Malik reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) fell down from his horse and his right side was grazed, and the rest of the hadith is the same. In this hadith there are no additions (of words) as transmitted by Yunus and Malik.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apne ghode se gir gaye aur unka daaya hissa chhil gaya, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai. Is hadees mein Yunus aur Malik ki riwayat ki gayi koi izafa nahi hai.

e: 'A'isha reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) fell ill and some of his Companions came to inquire after his health. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said prayer sitting, while (his Companions) said it (behind him) standing. He (the Holy Prophet) directed them by his gesture to sit down, and they sat down (in prayer). After finishing the (prayer) he (the Holy Prophet) said: The Imam is appointed so that he should be followed, so bow down when he bows down, and rise upp when he rises up and say (prayer) sitting when he (the Imam) says (it) sitting.
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) bimaar pad gaye aur kuch Sahaba unka haal-chaal poochne aaye. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne baithkar namaz padhi, jabki Sahaba ne unke peeche khadi halat mein padhi. Unhone ishaare se unhein baithne ka hukum diya, aur wo baith gaye. Namaz mukammal karne ke baad unhone kaha: Imam is liye muqarrar kiya jaata hai ki uski peirvi ki jaaye, is liye jab wo jhuke to tum bhi jhuko, aur jab wo uthe to tum bhi utho, aur jab wo baithkar namaz padhe to tum bhi baithkar padho.

e: This hadith is narrated with the same chain of transmitters by Hisham b. 'Urwa.
hi: Ye hadees usi sanad ke saath Hisham bin Urwah ne bhi riwayat ki hai.

e: Jabir reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was ill and we said prayer behind him and he was sitting. And Abu Bakr was making audible to the people his takbir. As he paid his attention towards us he saw us standing and (directed us to sit down) with a gesture. So we sat down and said our prayer with his prayer in a sitting posture. After uttering salutation he said: You were at this time about to do an act like that of the Persians and the Romans. They stand before their kings while they sit, so don't do that; follow your Imams. If they say prayer standing, you should also do so, and if they say prayer sitting, you should also say prayer sitting.
hi: Jabir ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) bimaar the aur humne unke peeche namaz padhi jabki wo baithe hue the. Aur Abu Bakr logon tak unki Takbeer pahunchaa rahe the. Jab unhone humaari taraf dekha to unhein humein khada paaya, aur unhone ishaare se humein baithne ko kaha. Is liye hum baith gaye aur humne unki namaz ke saath baithkar apni namaz padhi. Salaam pherne ke baad unhone kaha: Tum us waqt Iraaniyon aur Roomiyon jaisa amal karne wale the. Wo apne baadshaahon ke saamne khade hote hain jabki wo baadshaah baithe hote hain. Aisa mat karo; apne Imamon ki peirvi karo. Agar wo khadi halat mein namaz padhein, to tum bhi aisa karo, aur agar wo baithkar namaz padhein, to tum bhi baithkar namaz padho.

e: Jabir said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led the prayer and Abu Bakr was behind him. When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) recited the takbir, Abu Bakr also recited (it) in order to make it audible to us. And the rest of the hadith is like one transmitted by Laith.
hi: Jabir ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne namaz ki imaamat ki aur Abu Bakr unke peeche the. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Takbeer padhi, to Abu Bakr ne bhi ise padha taaki wo humein sunaayi de. Aur baaki hadees Laith ki riwayat jaisi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The Imam is appointed, so that he should be followed, so don't be at variance with him. Recite takbir when he recites it; bow down when he bows down and when he says:" Allah listens to him who praises Him," say:" O Allah, our Lord, to Thee be the Praise." And when he (the Imam) prostrates, you should also prostrate, and when he says prayer sitting, you should all observe prayer sitting.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Imam is liye muqarrar kiya jaata hai ki uski peirvi ki jaaye, is liye uski mukhaalfat mat karo. Jab wo Takbeer padhe, to tum bhi padho; jab wo jhuke, to tum bhi jhuko aur jab wo kahe 'Allah ne uski suni jisne Uski tareef ki,' to kaho 'Aye Allah, humaare Rab, sirf Teri hi tareef hai.' Aur jab wo Imam sajda kare, to tum bhi sajda karo, aur jab wo baithkar namaz padhe, to tum sab baithkar namaz padho.

e: A hadith like this has been transmitted by Hammam b. Munabbih from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the authority of Abu Huraira.
hi: Ye jaisi ek hadees Hammam bin Munabbih ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se, Abu Huraira ki sanad se riwayat ki hai.
