e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) while teaching us (the principles of faith), said: Do not try to go ahead of the Imam, recite takbir when he recites it, and when he says: "Nor of those who err" you should say Amin, bow down when he bows down, and when he says: "Allah listens to him who praises Him" say: "O Allah, our Lord, to Thee be the praise".
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein imaan ke usoolon ki taleem dete hue kaha: Imam se aage jaane ki koshish mat karo, jab wo Takbeer padhe to tum bhi padho, aur jab wo kahe: 'Na un logon ki jo bhatak gaye,' to tum Ameen kaho, jab wo jhuke to tum bhi jhuko, aur jab wo kahe: 'Allah ne uski suni jisne Uski tareef ki,' to kaho: 'Aye Allah, humaare Rab, sirf Teri hi tareef hai.'

e: Abu Huraira reported from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) (a hadith) like it, except the words: " Nor of those who err, say Amin" and added:" And don't rise up ahead of him."
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se isi jaisi hadees riwayat ki, sivaay in alfaaz ke: 'Na un logon ki jo bhatak gaye, Ameen kaho,' aur unhone izafa kiya: 'Aur uske aage mat utho.'

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Verily the Imam is a shield, say prayer sitting when he says prayer sitting. And when he says:" Allah listens to him who praises Him," say:" O Allah, our Lord, to Thee be the praise." and when the utterance of the people of the earth synchronises with that of the beings of heaven (angels), all the previous sins would be pardoned.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Beshak Imam ek dhaal hai, jab wo baithkar namaz padhe to tum bhi baithkar namaz padho. Aur jab wo kahe: 'Allah ne uski suni jisne Uski tareef ki,' to kaho: 'Aye Allah, humaare Rab, sirf Teri hi tareef hai,' aur jab zameen waalon ki awaaz aasman waalon, yaani farishton, ki awaaz se mel khaaye, to pichhle sab gunah maaf kar diye jaayenge.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying: The Imam is appointed to be followed. So recite takbir when he recites it, and bow down when he bows down and when he utters:" Allah listens to him who praises Him," say" O Allah, our Lord, for Thee be the praise." And when he prays, standing, you should pray standing. And when he prays sitting, all of you should pray sitting.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Imam is liye muqarrar kiya jaata hai ki uski peirvi ki jaaye. Is liye jab wo Takbeer padhe, to tum bhi padho, aur jab wo jhuke, to tum bhi jhuko, aur jab wo kahe 'Allah ne uski suni jisne Uski tareef ki,' to kaho 'Aye Allah, humaare Rab, sirf Teri hi tareef hai.' Aur jab wo khadi halat mein namaz padhe, to tum bhi khadi halat mein padho, aur jab wo baithkar namaz padhe, to tum sab baithkar namaz padho.

e: Ubaidullah b. Abdullah reported: I visited 'A'isha and asked her to tell about the illness of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). She agreed and said: The Apostle (ﷺ) was seriously ill and he asked whether the people had prayed. We said: No, they are waiting for you, Messenger of Allah. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Put some water in the tub for me. We did accordingly and he (the Holy Prophet) took a bath;and, when he was about to move with difficulty, he fainted. When he came round, he again said: Have the people said prayer? We said: No, they are waiting for you, Messenger of Allah. He (the Holy Prophet) again said: Put some water for me in the tub. We did accordingly and he took a bag, but when he was about to move with difficultyhe fainted. When he came round, he asked whether the people had prayed. We said: No, they are waiting for you, Messenger of Allah. He said: Put some water for me in the tub. We did accordingly and he took a bath and he was about to move with difficulty when he fainted. When he came roundhe said: Have the people saidprayer? We said: No, they are waiting for you, Messenger of Allah. She ('A'isha) said: The people were staying in the mosque and waiting for the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) to lead the last (night) prayer. She ('A'isha) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent (instructions) to Abu Bakr to lead the people in prayer. When the messenger came, he told him (Abd Bakr): The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) has ordered you to lead the people in prayer. Abu Bakr who was a man of very tenderly feelings asked Umar to lead the prayer. 'Umar said: You are more entitled to that. Abu Bakr led the prayers during those days. Afterwards the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) felt some relief and he went out supported by two men, one of them was al-'Abbas, to the noon prayer. Abu Bakr was leading the people in prayer. When Abu Bakr saw him. he began to withdraw, but the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) told him not to withdraw. He told his two (companions) to seat him down beside him (Abu Bakr). They seated him by the side of Abu Bakr. Abu Bakr said the prayer standing while following the prayer of the Apostle (ﷺ) and the people Bald prayer (standing) while following the prayer of Abu Bakr. The Apostle (ﷺ) was seated. Ubaidullah said: I visited 'Abdullah b. 'Abbas, and said: Should I submit to you what 'A'isha had told about the illness of the Apostle (ﷺ)? He said: Go ahead. I submitted to him what had been transmitted by her ('A'isha). He objected to none of it, only asking whether she had named to him the man who accompanied al-'Abbas. I said: No. He said: It was 'Ali.
hi: Ubaidullah bin Abdullah ne bataaya: Main Aisha se milne gaya aur unse guzaarish ki ki wo mujhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki bimaari ke baare mein bataayein. Unhone maan liya aur kaha: Rasool (SAW) sakht bimaar the aur unhone poocha ki kya logon ne namaz padh li hai. Humne kaha: Nahi, wo aapka intezaar kar rahe hain, Allah ke Rasool. Unhone kaha: Mere liye tashtari mein thoda paani daalo. Humne aisa hi kiya aur unhone ghusl kiya; aur jab wo mushkil se hilne lage, to behosh ho gaye. Jab unhein hosh aaya, to unhone dobara poocha: Kya logon ne namaz padh li? Humne kaha: Nahi, wo aapka intezaar kar rahe hain, Allah ke Rasool. Unhone dobara kaha: Mere liye tashtari mein thoda paani daalo. Humne aisa hi kiya aur unhone dobara ghusl kiya, lekin jab wo mushkil se hilne lage, to phir behosh ho gaye. Jab unhein hosh aaya, to unhone poocha ki kya logon ne namaz padhi. Humne kaha: Nahi, wo aapka intezaar kar rahe hain, Allah ke Rasool. Unhone kaha: Mere liye tashtari mein thoda paani daalo. Humne aisa hi kiya aur unhone ghusl kiya aur wo mushkil se hilne hi wale the ki wo behosh ho gaye. Jab unhein hosh aaya, to unhone kaha: Kya logon ne namaz padh li? Humne kaha: Nahi, wo aapka intezaar kar rahe hain, Allah ke Rasool. Unhone kaha: Log masjid mein thehre hue the aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka intezaar kar rahe the taaki wo Isha ki namaz ki imaamat karein. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Abu Bakr ko paighaam bheja ki wo logon ki namaz ki imaamat karein. Jab qaasid aaya, to usne unhein bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne aapko hukum diya hai ki aap logon ki imaamat karein. Abu Bakr, jo bahut hi narm-dil insaan the, ne Umar se namaz ki imaamat karne ko kaha. Umar ne kaha: Aap iske zyada haqdaar hain. Abu Bakr ne un dinon namazon ki imaamat ki. Iske baad Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko thodi rahat mehsoos hui aur wo do logon ke sahaare bahar gaye, jinmein se ek Abbas the, Zuhr ki namaz ke liye. Abu Bakr logon ki imaamat kar rahe the. Jab Abu Bakr ne unhein dekha, to wo peeche hatne lage, lekin Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhein na hatne ko kaha. Unhone apne dono saathiyon se kaha ki wo unhein Abu Bakr ke bagal mein bithaayein. Unhone unhein Abu Bakr ke bagal mein bithaaya. Abu Bakr ne khadi halat mein namaz padhi, Rasool (SAW) ki namaz ki peirvi karte hue, aur logon ne khadi halat mein namaz padhi, Abu Bakr ki namaz ki peirvi karte hue. Rasool (SAW) baithe hue the. Ubaidullah ne kaha: Main Abdullah bin Abbas ke paas gaya aur kaha: Kya main aapko wo bataaun jo Aisha ne mujhe Rasool (SAW) ki bimaari ke baare mein bataaya? Unhone kaha: Bataao. Maine unhein wo bataaya jo unhone riwayat kiya tha. Unhone ismein se kisi cheez par aitraaz nahi kiya, sirf ye poocha ki kya unhone us shaks ka naam liya jo Abbas ke saath tha. Maine kaha: Nahi. Unhone kaha: Wo Ali (Alayhis Salam) the.

e: 'A'isha reported: It was in the house ofMaimuna that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) first fell ill. He asked permission from his wives to stay in her ('A'isha's) house during his illness. They granted him permission. She ('A'isha) narrated: He (the Holy Prophet) went out (for prayer) with his hand over al-Fadl b. 'Abbas and on the other hand there was another person and (due to weakness) his feet dragged on the earth. 'Ubaidullah said: I narrated this hadith to the son of 'Abbas ('Abdullah b. 'Abbas) and he said: Do you know who the man was whose name 'A'isha did not mention? It was 'Ali.
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Maimuna ke ghar mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) pehli baar bimaar pade. Unhone apni bimaari ke daur mein unke ghar mein rehne ki apni biwiyon se ijaazat maangi. Unhone unhein ijaazat de di. Unhone riwayat ki: Wo namaz ke liye bahar gaye, apna haath Fadl bin Abbas ke oopar rakhe hue, aur doosre haath par koi aur shaks tha, aur kamzori ki wajah se unke paanv zameen par ghisat rahe the. Ubaidullah ne kaha: Maine ye hadees Ibn Abbas ko sunaayi aur unhone kaha: Kya tumhein pata hai wo kaun shaks tha jiska naam Aisha ne nahi liya? Wo Ali (Alayhis Salam) the.

e: 'A'isha, the wife of the Apostle (ﷺ), said: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) fell ill and his illness became serious, he asked permission from his wives to stay in my house during his illness. They gave him permission to do so. He stepped out (of'A'isha's apartment for prayer) supported by two persons. (He was so much weak) that his feet dragged on the ground and he was being supported by 'Abbas b. 'Abd al-Muttalib and another person. 'Ubaidullah said: I informed 'Abdullah (b. 'Abbas) about that which 'A'isha had said. 'Abdullah b. 'Abbas said: Do you know the man whose name 'A'isha did not mention? He said: No. Ibn 'Abbas said: It was 'Ali.
hi: Aisha, Rasool (SAW) ki biwi, ne kaha: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) bimaar pade aur unki bimaari sakht ho gayi, to unhone apni bimaari ke daur mein mere ghar mein rehne ki apni biwiyon se ijaazat maangi. Unhone unhein aisa karne ki ijaazat de di. Wo do logon ke sahaare bahar nikle. Wo itne kamzor the ki unke paanv zameen par ghisat rahe the aur unhein Abbas bin Abdul-Muttalib aur ek aur shaks ka sahaara tha. Ubaidullah ne kaha: Maine Abdullah bin Abbas ko wo bataaya jo Aisha ne kaha tha. Abdullah bin Abbas ne kaha: Kya tumhein pata hai wo shaks kaun tha jiska naam Aisha ne nahi liya? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Ibn Abbas ne kaha: Wo Ali (Alayhis Salam) the.

e: 'A'isha, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), said: I tried to dissuade the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) from it (i. e. from appointing Abu Bakr as the Imam.) and my insistence upon it was not due to the fact that I entertained any apprehension in my mind that the people would not love the man who would occupy his (Prophet's) place (i. e. who would be appointed as his caliph) and I feared that the people would be superstitious about one who would occupy his place. I, therefore, desired that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) should leave Abu Bakr aside in this matter.
hi: Aisha, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki biwi, ne kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko is se, yaani Abu Bakr ko Imam muqarrar karne se, rokne ki koshish ki, aur meri is par zid is liye nahi thi ki mujhe ye khadsha tha ki log us shaks se mohabbat nahi karenge jo unki jagah lega, yaani jo unka khalifa muqarrar hoga, aur mujhe dar tha ki log us shaks ke baare mein badshugooni sochenge jo unki jagah lega. Is liye main chaahti thi ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) is maamle mein Abu Bakr ko alag rakhein.

e: 'A'isha reported: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to my house, he said: Ask Abu Bakr to lead people in prayer. 'A'isha narrated: I said, Messenger of Allah, Abu Bakr is a man of tenderly feelings; as he recites the Qur'an, he cannot help shedding tears: so better command anyone else to lead the prayer. By Allah, there is nothing disturbing in it for me but the idea that the people may not takeevil omen with regard to one who is the first to occupy the place of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). I tried to dissuade him (the Holy Prophet) twice or thrice (from appointing my father as an Imam in prayer), but he ordered Abu Bakr to lead the people in prayer and said: You women are like those (who had) surrounded Yusuf.
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mere ghar aaye, to unhone kaha: Abu Bakr se kaho ki wo logon ki namaz ki imaamat karein. Aisha ne riwayat ki: Maine kaha, Allah ke Rasool, Abu Bakr bahut narm-dil insaan hain; jab wo Quran ki tilaawat karte hain, to unke aansoo rukte nahi; is liye behtar hoga ki aap kisi aur ko namaz ki imaamat karne ka hukum dein. Allah ki qasam, mujhe ismein koi pareshaani nahi sivaay is khayaal ke ki log us shaks ke baare mein bad-fal na maan lein jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki jagah lene wala sabse pehla shaks ho. Maine unhein do ya teen baar rokne ki koshish ki, lekin unhone Abu Bakr ko logon ki namaz ki imaamat karne ka hukum diya aur kaha: Tum auratein waisi ho jaise wo auraten jinhone Yusuf ko gher liya tha.

e: 'A'isha reported: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was confined to bed, Bilal came to him to summon him to prayer. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Ask Abu Bakr to lead the people in prayer. She ('A'isha) reported: I said: Messenger of Allah, Abu Bakr is a tenderhearted man, when he would stand at your place (he would be so overwhelmed by feelings) that he would not be able to make the people hear anything (his recitation would not be audible to the followers in prayer). You should better order Umar (to lead the prayer). He (the Holy Prophet) said: Ask Abu Bakr to lead people in prayer. She ('A'isha) said: I asked Hafsa to (convey) my impression to him (the Holy Prophet) that Abu Bakr was a tenderhearted man, so when he would stand at his place, he would not be able to make the people bear anything. He better order Umar. Hafsa conveyed this (message of Hadrat 'A'isha) to him (the Holy Prophet). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: (You are behaving) as if you are the females who had gathered around Yusuf. Order Abu Bakr to lead the people in prayer. She ('A'isha) reported: So Abu Bakr was ordered to lead the people in prayer. As the prayer began, the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) felt some relief; he got up and moved supported by two persons and his feet dragged on earth (due to excessive weakness). 'A'isha reported: As he (the Holy Prophet) entered the mosque. Abu Bakr perceived his (arrival). He was about to withdraw, but the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) by the gesture (of his hand) told him to keep standing at his place. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came and seated himself on the left side of Abu Bakr. She ('A'isha) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was leading people in prayer sitting. Abu Bakr was following the prayer of the Apostle (ﷺ) in a standing posture and the people were following the prayer of Abu Bakr.
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) bistar tak seemit ho gaye, to Bilal namaz ke liye bulaane aaye. Unhone kaha: Abu Bakr se kaho ki wo logon ki namaz ki imaamat karein. Unhone kaha: Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Abu Bakr narm-dil insaan hain, jab wo aapki jagah khade honge, to wo itne jazbaati ho jaayenge ki wo logon ko kuch bhi sunaane mein saksham nahi honge. Aap behtar hoga Umar ko imaamat ka hukum dein. Unhone kaha: Abu Bakr se kaho ki wo logon ki namaz ki imaamat karein. Unhone kaha: Maine Hafsa se kaha ki wo unhein mera ye khayaal pahunchaayein ki Abu Bakr narm-dil insaan hain, is liye jab wo unki jagah khade honge, to wo logon ko kuch bhi sunaane mein saksham nahi honge. Behtar hoga wo Umar ko hukum dein. Hafsa ne unhein ye paighaam pahunchaaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Tum aisa bartaav kar rahi ho jaise tum wo auraten ho jo Yusuf ke ird-gird jama hui thi. Abu Bakr se kaho ki wo logon ki namaz ki imaamat karein. Unhone kaha: Is liye Abu Bakr ko logon ki namaz ki imaamat karne ka hukum diya gaya. Jaise hi namaz shuru hui, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kuchh rahat mehsoos ki; wo uthe aur do logon ke sahaare chale aur unke paanv zameen par ghisat rahe the, had darje ki kamzori ki wajah se. Aisha ne bataaya: Jaise hi wo masjid mein daakhil hue, Abu Bakr ne unke aane ko mehsoos kiya. Wo peeche hatne hi wale the, lekin Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ishaare se unhein apni jagah khade rehne ko kaha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aaye aur Abu Bakr ke baayin taraf baith gaye. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) baithkar logon ki namaz ki imaamat kar rahe the. Abu Bakr khadi halat mein Rasool (SAW) ki namaz ki peirvi kar rahe the aur log Abu Bakr ki namaz ki peirvi kar rahe the.

e: A'mash reported: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) suffered from illness of which he died, and in the hadith transmitted by Ibn Mus-hir, the words are: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was brought till he was seated by his (Abu Bakr's) side and the Apostle (ﷺ) led the people in prayer and Abu Bakr was making takbir audible to them, and in the hadith transmitted by 'Isa the (words are):" The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sat and led the people in prayer and Abu Bakr was by his side and he was making (takbir) audible to the people."
hi: A'mash ne bataaya: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) us bimaari se dochaar hue jismein unka intiqaal hua, aur Ibn Mus'hir ki riwayat ki gayi hadees mein alfaaz hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko laaya gaya yahan tak ki wo unke bagal mein bithaaye gaye aur Rasool (SAW) ne logon ki namaz ki imaamat ki aur Abu Bakr unki Takbeer logon tak pahunchaa rahe the, aur Isa ki riwayat ki gayi hadees mein alfaaz hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) baithe aur logon ki namaz ki imaamat ki aur Abu Bakr unke bagal mein the aur wo Takbeer logon tak pahunchaa rahe the.

e: `A'isha reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ordered Abu Bakr that he should lead people in prayer during his illness, and he led them in prayer. `Urwa said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) felt relief and went (to the mosque) and Abu Bakr was leading the people in prayer. When Abu Bakr saw him he began to withdraw, but the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) signaled him to remain where he was. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sat opposite to Abu Bakr by his side. Abu Bakr said prayer following the prayer of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and the people said prayer following the prayer of Abu Bakr.
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Abu Bakr ko hukum diya ki wo apni bimaari ke daur mein logon ki namaz ki imaamat karein, aur unhone imaamat ki. Urwah ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kuchh rahat mehsoos ki aur masjid ki taraf gaye aur Abu Bakr logon ki namaz ki imaamat kar rahe the. Jab Abu Bakr ne unhein dekha, to wo peeche hatne lage, lekin Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ishaare se unhein apni jagah rehne ko kaha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Abu Bakr ke saamne, unke bagal mein baith gaye. Abu Bakr ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki namaz ki peirvi karte hue namaz padhi, aur logon ne Abu Bakr ki namaz ki peirvi karte hue namaz padhi.

e: Anas b. Malik reported, Abu Bakr led them in prayer due to the illness of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) of which be died. It was a Monday and they stood in rows for prayer. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) drew aside the curtain of ('A'isha's) apartment and looked at us while he was standing, and his (Prophet's) face was (as bright) as the paper of the Holy Book. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) felt happy and smiled. And we were confounded with joy while in prayer due to the arrival (among our midst) of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), Abu Bakr stepped back upon his heels to say prayer in a row perceiving that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had come out for prayer. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) with the help of his hand signed to them to complete their prayer. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went back (to his apartment) and drew the curtain. He (the narrator) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) breathed his last on that very day.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bataaya: Abu Bakr ne unki imaamat ki, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki bimaari ki wajah se jismein unka intiqaal hua. Ye somvaar ka din tha aur wo namaz ke liye safon mein khade the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Aisha ke kamre ka parda hataaya aur humein dekha jabki wo khade the, aur unka chehra itna roshan tha jaise Quran-e-Kareem ka safha ho. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khush hue aur muskuraaye. Aur hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke humaare beech aane ki khushi se namaz mein hi bekaraar ho gaye. Abu Bakr apni aediyon par peeche hatne lage taaki wo saf mein namaz padh sakein, ye mehsoos karte hue ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) namaz ke liye bahar aa gaye hain. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne haath ke ishaare se unhein apni namaz mukammal karne ko kaha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) wapas apne kamre mein gaye aur parda gira diya. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne usi din apni aakhri saans li.

e: Anas reported: The last glance that I have had of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) (before his death) was that when he on Monday drew the curtain aside. The hadith transmitted by Salih is perfect and complete.
hi: Anas ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki, unki wafat se pehle, meri aakhri jhalak wo thi jab unhone somvaar ke din parda hataaya. Salih ki riwayat ki gayi hadees mukammal aur poori hai.

e: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik by another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Anas bin Malik se ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) did not come to us for three days. When the prayer was about to start. Abu Bakr stepped forward (to lead the prayer), and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) lifted the curtain. When the face of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) became visible to us, we (found) that no sight was more endearing to us than the face of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as it appeared to us. The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) with the gesture of his hand directed Abu Bakr to step forward (and lead the prayer). The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) then drew the curtain, and we could not see him till he died.
hi: Anas ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) teen din tak humaare paas nahi aaye. Jab namaz shuru hone waali thi, to Abu Bakr aage badhe imaamat karne ke liye, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne parda uthaaya. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka chehra humein nazar aaya, to humein laga ki koi bhi nazaara Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke chehre se zyada aziz nahi hai jaisa wo humein us waqt nazar aa raha tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne haath ke ishaare se Abu Bakr ko aage badhne aur imaamat karne ko kaha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne phir parda gira diya, aur hum unhein unki wafat tak nahi dekh sake.

e: Abu Musa reported: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) became ill and illness became serious he ordered Abu Bakr to lead the people in prayer. Upon this 'A'isha said: Messenger of Allah, Abd Bakr is a man of tenderly feelings: when he would stand in your place (he would be so much overwhelmed -by grief that) he would not be able to lead the people in prayer. He (the Holy Prophet) said: You order Abu Bakr to lead the people in prayer, and added: You are like the female companions of Yusuf. So Abu Bakr led the prayer (during this period of illness) in the life of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).
hi: Abu Musa ne bataaya: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) bimaar pade aur unki bimaari sakht ho gayi, to unhone Abu Bakr ko logon ki namaz ki imaamat karne ka hukum diya. Is par Aisha ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Abu Bakr bahut narm-dil insaan hain: jab wo aapki jagah khade honge to wo itne gham se maghloob ho jaayenge ki wo logon ki imaamat nahi kar payenge. Unhone kaha: Tum Abu Bakr ko hi logon ki namaz ki imaamat karne ka hukum do, aur izafa kiya: Tum Yusuf ki saathi auraton jaisi ho. Is liye Abu Bakr ne, bimaari ke is daur mein, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zindagi mein namaz ki imaamat ki.

e: Sahl b. Sa'd al-Sa'idi reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went to the tribe of Bani Amr b. Auf in order to bring reconciliation amongst (its members), and It was a time of prayer. The Mu'adhdhin came to Abu Bakr and said: Would you lead the prayer in case I recite takbir (tahrima, with which the prayer begins)? He (Abu Bakr) said: Yes. He (the narrator) said: He (Abu Bakr) started (leading) the prayer. The people were engaged in observing prayer when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) happened to come there and made his way (through the people) till he stood in a row. The people began to clap (their hands), but Abu Bakr paid no heed (to it) in prayer. When the people clapped more vigorously, he (Abu Bakr) then paid heed and saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) there. (He was about to withdraw when) the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) signed to him to keep standing at his place. Abu Bakr lifted his hands and praised Allah for what the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had commanded him and then Abu Bakr withdrew himself till he stood in the midst of the row and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stepped forward and led the prayer. When (the prayer) was over, he (the Holy Prophet) said: 0 Abu Bakr, what prevented you from standing (at that place) as I ordered you to do? Abu Bakr said: It does not become the son of Abu Quhafa to lead prayer before the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said (to the people) around him: What is it that I saw you clapping so vigorously? (Behold) when anything happens in prayer, say: Subha Allah, for when you would utter it, it would attract the attention, while clapping of hands is meant for women.
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd al-Sa'idi ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Bani Amr bin Auf ke qabile mein gaye taaki unke sadasyon ke darmiyaan sulah karwa sakein, aur ye namaz ka waqt tha. Mu'azzin Abu Bakr ke paas aaya aur kaha: Kya aap namaz padhaayenge agar main Takbeer, Tahrima, jisse namaz shuru hoti hai, padhun? Unhone kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha: Unhone namaz padhaana shuru ki. Log namaz mein masroof the jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) wahan aa gaye aur logon ke beech se raasta banaate hue ek saf mein khade ho gaye. Log taaliyaan bajaane lage, lekin Abu Bakr ne is par namaz mein koi tawajjo nahi di. Jab log aur zor se taaliyaan bajaane lage, to unhone tawajjo di aur wahan Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko dekha. Wo peeche hatne hi wale the ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhein apni jagah khade rehne ka ishaara kiya. Abu Bakr ne apne haath uthaaye aur Allah ki tareef ki us baat ke liye jiska Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhein hukum diya tha, aur phir Abu Bakr peeche hate yahan tak ki wo saf ke beechon-beech khade ho gaye aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aage badhe aur namaz ki imaamat ki. Jab namaz khatam hui, to unhone kaha: Aye Abu Bakr, tumhein us jagah khade rehne se kisne roka jaisa maine tumhein hukum diya tha? Abu Bakr ne kaha: Abu Quhafa ke bete ko ye zeb nahi deta ki wo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se pehle namaz ki imaamat kare. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne ird-gird logon se kaha: Ye kya hai ki maine tumhein itni zor se taaliyaan bajaate dekha? Dekho, jab namaz mein kuch ho jaaye, to kaho: 'Subhan Allah,' kyunki jab tum ye kahoge, to is par tawajjo di jaayegi, jabki taaliyan bajaana auraton ke liye hai.

e: This hadith is transmitted by Sahl b. Sa'd in the same way as narrated by Malik, with the exception of these words: " Abu Bakr lifted his hands and praised Allah and retraced his (steps) till he stood in a row."
hi: Ye hadees Sahl bin Sa'd ne usi tarah riwayat ki hai jaisi Malik ne riwayat ki, sivaay in alfaaz ke: 'Abu Bakr ne apne haath uthaaye aur Allah ki tareef ki aur apne kadam wapas liye yahan tak ki wo saf mein khade ho gaye.'

e: Sahl b. Sa'd al-Sa'idi reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) went to Bani Amr b. 'Auf in order to bring about reconciliation amongst them. The rest of the hadith is the same but with (the addition of these words):" The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came and made his way through the rows till he came to the first row and Abu Bakr retraced his steps."
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd al-Sa'idi ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Bani Amr bin Auf ke paas gaye taaki unke darmiyaan sulah karwaayein. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai lekin is izafe ke saath: 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aaye aur safon ke beech se raasta banaate hue pehli saf tak pahunche aur Abu Bakr peeche hat gaye.'

e: Mughira b. Shu'ba reported that he participated In the expedition of Tabuk along with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went out to answer the call of nature before the morning prayer. and I carried along with him a jar (full of water). When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came back to me (after relieving himself). I began to pour water upon his hands out of the jar and he washed his hands three times, then washed his face three times. He then tried to tuck up the sleeves of his cloak upon his forearms but since the sleeves were tight he inserted his hands in the cloak and then brought out his forearms up to the elbow below the cloak, and then wiped over his shoes and then moved on. Mughira said: I also moved along with him till he came to the people and (he found) that they had been saying their prayer under the Imamah of 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Auf. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) could get one rak ah out of two and said (this) last rak'ah along with the people. When Abd al-Rahman b. 'Auf pronounced the salutation, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) got up to complete the prayer. This made the Muslims terrified and most of them began to recite the glory of the Lord. When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) finished his prayer, he turned towards them and then said: You did well, or said with a sense of joy: You did the right thing that you said prayer at the appointed hour.
hi: Mughira bin Shu'ba ne bataaya ki wo Tabuk ke safar mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath shaamil the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) subah ki namaz se pehle qaza-e-haajat ke liye bahar gaye, aur main unke saath paani se bhara ek ghada le gaya. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mere paas wapas aaye, khud ko halka karne ke baad, to main unke haathon par ghade se paani daalne laga aur unhone apne haath teen baar dhoye, phir apna chehra teen baar dhoya. Phir unhone apni cheekh ki aastinein apni baazuon par chadhaane ki koshish ki lekin chunki aastinein tang thi, unhone apne haath jubbe ke andar daale aur phir apni kohni tak apni baazuein jubbe ke neeche se nikaali, aur phir apne mozon par masah kiya aur phir chal pade. Mughira ne kaha: Main bhi unke saath chala yahan tak ki wo logon ke paas pahunche aur unhone paaya ki wo Abdur Rahman bin Auf ki imaamat mein namaz padh rahe the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko do rak'aaton mein se ek mil saki aur unhone logon ke saath ye aakhri rak'aat padhi. Jab Abdur Rahman bin Auf ne salaam phera, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apni namaz mukammal karne ke liye khade ho gaye. Isse Musalmaan dehshat mein aa gaye aur unmein se aksar Allah ki tasbeeh karne lage. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apni namaz mukammal ki, to wo unki taraf mude aur kaha: Tumne achha kiya, ya khushi ke andaaz mein kaha: Tumne sahi kiya ki tumne muqarrar waqt par namaz padhi.

e: This hadith is narrated by Hamza b. Mughira by another chain of trans- mitters (but with the addition of these words): I made up my mind to hold Abd al-Rahman b. 'Auf back, but the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Leave him."
hi: Ye hadees Hamza bin Mughira ne ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki hai, is izafe ke saath: Maine Abdur Rahman bin Auf ko rokne ka iraada kiya, lekin Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Use chhod do.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Glorification of Allah is for men and clapping of hands is meant for women (if something happens in prayer). Harmala added in his narration that Ibn Shihab told him: I saw some of the scholars glorifying Allah and making a gesture.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Allah ki tasbeeh mardon ke liye hai aur taali bajaana, agar namaz mein kuch ho jaaye, auraton ke liye hai. Harmala ne apni riwayat mein izafa kiya ki Ibn Shihab ne unhein bataaya: Maine kuch ulama ko Allah ki tasbeeh karte aur ishaara karte dekha.

e: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira by another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira se ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith is transmitted by Muhammad b. Rafi', Abu'I-Razzaq. Ma'mar, Hammam on the authority of Abu Huraira with the addition of (the word)" prayer".
hi: Ye hadees Muhammad bin Rafi, Abdur Razzaq, Ma'mar, Hammam ne Abu Huraira ki sanad se riwayat ki hai, lafz 'namaz' ke izafe ke saath.

e: Abu Huraira reported: One day the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led the prayer. Then turning (towards his Companions) he said: O you man, why don't you say your prayer well? Does the observer of prayer not see how he is performing the prayer, for he performs it for himself? By Allah, I see behind me as I see in front of me.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Ek din Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne namaz ki imaamat ki. Phir apne Sahaba ki taraf mudkar unhone kaha: Aye logo, tum apni namaz achhi tarah kyun nahi padhte? Kya namaz padhne wala nahi dekhta ki wo namaz kaise ada kar raha hai, kyunki wo ise apne hi liye ada karta hai? Allah ki qasam, main peeche bhi waise hi dekhta hoon jaise aage dekhta hoon.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Do you find me seeing towards the Qibla only? By Allah, your bowing and your prostrating are not hidden from my view. Verily I see them behind my back.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Kya tumhein lagta hai ki main sirf Qibla ki taraf dekhta hoon? Allah ki qasam, tumhaara ruku aur tumhaara sajda mujhse chhupa nahi hai. Beshak main unhein apni peeth ke peeche bhi dekhta hoon.

e: Anas b. Malik reported. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Perform bowing and prostration well. By Allah, I see you even if you are behind me, or he said: (I see you) behind my back when you bow or prostrate.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Ruku aur sajda achhi tarah karo. Allah ki qasam, main tumhein dekhta hoon chaahe tum mere peeche ho, ya unhone kaha: main tumhein apni peeth ke peeche dekhta hoon jab tum ruku ya sajda karte ho.

e: Anas reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) said: Complete the bowing and prostration well. By Allah, I see you behind my back as to how you bow and prostrate or when you bow and prostrate.
hi: Anas ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Ruku aur sajda achhi tarah mukammal karo. Allah ki qasam, main tumhein apni peeth ke peeche dekhta hoon ki tum kaise ruku aur sajda karte ho ya jab tum ruku aur sajda karte ho.

e: Anas reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) one day led us in the prayer. and when he completed the Prayer he turned his face towards us and said: 0 People, I am your Imam, so do not precede me in bowing and prostration and in standing and turning (faces, i. e. In pronouncing salutation), for I see you in front of me and behind me, and then said: By Him in Whose hand Is the life of Muhammad, if you could see what I see, you would have laughed little and wept much more. They said: What did you see, Messenger of Allah? He replied: (I saw) Paradise and Hell.
hi: Anas ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek din humaari imaamat ki, aur jab unhone namaz mukammal ki to unhone apna chehra humaari taraf mudkar kaha: Aye logo, main tumhaara Imam hoon, is liye ruku, sajda, khade hone aur chehre modne mein, yaani salaam pherne mein, mujhse aage mat badho, kyunki main tumhein apne aage aur peeche dekhta hoon, aur phir kaha: Us Zaat ki qasam Jiske haath mein Muhammad ki zindagi hai, agar tum wo dekh lete jo main dekhta hoon, to tum bahut kam hanste aur bahut zyada rote. Unhone kaha: Aap ne kya dekha, Allah ke Rasool? Unhone jawaab diya: Maine dekha Jannat aur Jahannam.

e: This hadith is narrated by Anas with another chain of transmitters, and in the hadith transmitted by Jarir there is no mention of" turning (faces)".
hi: Ye hadees Anas se ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai, aur Jarir ki riwayat ki gayi hadees mein modne, yaani salaam, ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Does the man who lifts his head ahead of the Imam (from prostration) not fear that Allah may change his head into the head of an ass?
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Kya wo shaks jo Imam se pehle sajde se apna sar uthaata hai, ye khauf nahi rakhta ki Allah uske sar ko gadhe ke sar mein badal de?

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Does the man who lifts his head before the Imam not fear that Allah may change his face into that of an ass?
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Kya wo shaks jo Imam se pehle apna sar uthaata hai, ye khauf nahi rakhta ki Allah uske chehre ko gadhe ke chehre mein badal de?

e: This hadith has been narrated by Abu Huraira by another chain of transmitters except for the words narrated by Rabi' b. Muslim: " Allah may make his face like the face of an ass."
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira se ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai, sivaay in alfaaz ke jo Rabi bin Muslim ne riwayat kiye: 'Allah uske chehre ko gadhe ke chehre jaisa bana de.'

e: Jabir b. Samura reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The people who lift their eyes towards the sky in Prayer should avoid it or they would lose their eyesight.
hi: Jabir bin Samura ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Namaz mein jo log apni nazrein aasman ki taraf uthaate hain, unhein isse bachna chahiye, warna unki nazar chhin jaayegi.

e: Abu Huraira reported: People should avoid lifting their eyes towards the sky while supplicating in prayer, otherwise their eyes would be snatched away.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Logon ko namaz mein dua karte waqt apni nazrein aasman ki taraf uthaane se bachna chahiye, warna unki aankhein cheen li jaayengi.

e: Jabir b. Samura reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to us and said: "How is it that I see you lifting your hands like the tails of headstrong horses? Be calm in prayer." He (the narrator) said: He then again came to us and saw us (sitting) in circles. He said: "How is it that I see you in separate groups?" He (the narrator) said: He again came to us and said: "Why don't you draw yourselves up in rows as angels do in the presence of their Lord?" We said: Messenger of Allah, how do the angels draw themselves up in rows in the presence of their Lord? He (the Holy Prophet) said: "They make the first rows complete and keep close together in the row."
hi: Jabir bin Samura ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) humaare paas aaye aur kaha: 'Ye kya hai ki main tumhein apne haath, sarkash ghodon ki dumon jaise, uthaate dekh raha hoon? Namaz mein sukoon rakho.' Unhone kaha: Phir wo dobara humaare paas aaye aur humein goloon mein baithe dekha. Unhone kaha: 'Ye kya hai ki main tumhein alag-alag giroh mein baithe dekh raha hoon?' Unhone kaha: Wo phir humaare paas aaye aur kaha: 'Tum apni safein kyun nahi seedhi karte jaise Farishte apne Rab ke saamne karte hain?' Humne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Farishte apne Rab ke saamne apni safein kaise seedhi karte hain? Unhone kaha: 'Wo pehli safon ko mukammal karte hain aur saf mein ek doosre ke qareeb khade hote hain.'

e: This hadith has been narrated by A'mash with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees A'mash ne usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai.

e: Jabir b. Samura reported: When we said prayer with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), we pronounced: Peace be upon you and Mercy of Allah, peace be upon you and Mercy of Allah, and made gesture with the hand on both the sides. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him said: What do you point out with your hands as if they are the tails of headstrong horses? This is enough for you that one should place one's hand on one's thigh and then pronounce salutation upon one's brother on the right side and then on the left.
hi: Jabir bin Samura ne bataaya: Jab hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath namaz padhte, to hum kehte: Aap par salaamati aur Allah ki rehmat ho, aap par salaamati aur Allah ki rehmat ho, aur dono taraf haath se ishaara karte. Is par Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Tum apne haathon se kya ishaara kar rahe ho jaise ki wo sarkash ghodon ki dumein hon? Tumhaare liye itna hi kaafi hai ki tum apna haath apni jaangh par rakho aur phir apne bhai ko daayin taraf aur phir baayin taraf salaam kaho.

e: Jabir b. Samura reported: We said our prayer with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and, while pronouncing salutations, we made gestures with our hands (indicating)" Peace be upon you, peace be upon you." The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) looked towards us and said: Why is it that you make gestures with your hands like the tails of headstrong horses? When any one of you pro- nounces salutation (in prayer) he should only turn his face towards his companion and should not make a gesture with his hand.
hi: Jabir bin Samura ne bataaya: Humne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath namaz padhi aur, salaam pherne waqt, hum apne haathon se ishaara karte hue kehte: 'Aap par salaamati ho, aap par salaamati ho.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humaari taraf dekha aur kaha: Ye kya hai ki tum apne haathon se aise ishaara karte ho jaise wo sarkash ghodon ki dumein hon? Jab tum mein se koi salaam phere namaz mein, to use sirf apne saathi ki taraf apna chehra modna chaahiye aur apne haath se ishaara nahi karna chaahiye.

e: Abu Mas'ud reported: The Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) used to touch our shoulders in prayer and say: Keep straight, don't be irregular, for there would be dissension in your hearts. Let those of you who are sedate and prudent be near me, then those who are next to them, then those who are next to them. Abu Mas'ud said: Now-a-days there is much dissension amongst you.
hi: Abu Mas'ood ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) namaz mein humaare kandhon ko chhuaate aur kehte: Seedhe raho, be-tarteeb mat khade ho, warna tumhaare dilon mein ikhtelaaf paida ho jaayega. Tum mein se jo aqlmand aur sanjeeda hain wo mere qareeb khade hon, phir wo jo unke qareeb hain, phir wo jo unke qareeb hain. Abu Mas'ood ne kaha: Aajkal tum mein bahut zyada ikhtelaaf hai.

e: This hadith is narrated by Ibn Uyaina with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Uyaina ne usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai.

e: Abdullah b. Mas'ud reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Let those who are sedate and prudent be near me, then those who are next to them (saying it tliree tinies), and beware of the tumult of the markets.
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ood ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Jo aqlmand aur sanjeeda hain wo mere qareeb khade hon, phir wo jo unke qareeb hain, ise teen baar kehte hue, aur bazaaron ke shor-o-gul se bacho.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Straighten your rows. for the straightening of a row is a part of the perfection of prayer.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Apni safein seedhi karo, kyunki saf ki seedhaayi namaz ki mukammaliyat ka hissa hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Complete the rows, for I can see you behind my back.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Safein mukammal karo, kyunki main tumhein apni peeth ke peeche dekh sakta hoon.

e: Hammam b. Munabbih reported: This is what was transmitted to us by Abu Huraira from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and, while making a mention of a few ahadith, said: (The Messengerof Allah directed us thus): Establish rows in prayer, for the making of a row (straight) is one of the merits of prayer.
hi: Hammam bin Munabbih ne bataaya: Ye wo hai jo humein Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat ki, aur kuch Ahadees ka zikr karte hue kaha: Allah ke Rasool ne humein ye hidaayat di: Namaz mein safein qaayam karo, kyunki saf seedhi banaana namaz ki khoobiyon mein se ek hai.

e: Nu'man b. Bashir reported: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: Straighten your rows, or Allah would create dissension amongst you.
hi: Nu'man bin Bashir ne bataaya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Apni safein seedhi karo, warna Allah tumhaare darmiyaan ikhtelaaf paida kar dega.

e: Nu'man b. Bashir reported: The Messenger of Allah (may peace-be upon him) used to straighten our rows as it lie were straightening an arrow with their help until be saw that we had learnt it from him. One day he came out, stood up (for prayer) and was about to say: Allah is the Greatest, when he saw a man, whose chest was bulging out from the row, so he said: Servants of Allah, you hint straighten your rows or Allah would create dissension amongst you.
hi: Nu'man bin Bashir ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) humaari safein isi tarah seedhi karte the jaise koi teer seedha karta hai, yahan tak ki unhein laga ki humne ye unse seekh liya hai. Ek din wo bahar aaye, khade hue namaz ke liye aur Takbeer kehne hi wale the ki unhone ek shaks ko dekha jiska seena saf se aage nikla hua tha, is liye unhone kaha: Allah ke bando, apni safein seedhi karo warna Allah tumhaare darmiyaan ikhtelaaf paida kar dega.

e: Abu 'Awana reported this hadith with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Awana ne usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: If the people were to know what excellence is there in the Adhan and in the first row, and they could not (get these opportunities) except by drawing lots, they would have definitely done that. And if they were to know what excellence lies in joining the prayer in the first takbir (prayer), they would have vied with one another. And if they were to know what excellence lies in the night prayer and morning prayer, they would have definitely come even if crawling (on their knees).
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Agar logon ko pata hota ki Azaan aur pehli saf mein kya khoobi hai, aur wo ise sirf qura andaazi se hi haasil kar sakte, to wo zaroor aisa karte. Aur agar unhein pata hota ki pehli Takbeer ke saath namaz mein shaamil hone mein kya khoobi hai, to wo ek doosre se aage nikalne ki koshish karte. Aur agar unhein pata hota ki raat ki namaz aur subah ki namaz mein kya khoobi hai, to wo zaroor aate, chaahe unhein ghutnon ke bal rengna pade.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saw (a tendency ) among his Companions to go to the back, so he said to them: Come forward and follow my lead, and let those who come after you follow your lead. People will continue to keep back till Allah will put them at the back.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne Sahaba mein namaz mein peeche jaane ka rujhaan dekha, is liye unhone unse kaha: Aage aao aur meri peirvi karo, aur jo tumhaare baad aayein, wo tumhaari peirvi karein. Log peeche rehte rahenge yahan tak ki Allah unhein aakhirat mein bhi darjaat mein peeche daal dega.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saw people at the end of the mosque, and then the (above-mentioned hadith) was narrated.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne logon ko masjid ke pichhle hisse mein dekha, aur phir upar zikr ki gayi hadees riwayat ki gayi.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: If you were to know, or if they were to know, what (excellence) lies in the first rows, there would have been drawing of lots (for filling them) ; and Ibn Harb said: For (occupying) the first row there would have been drawing of lots.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Agar tumhein pata hota, ya agar unhein pata hota, ki pehli safon mein kya khoobi hai, to unhein bharne ke liye qura andaazi hoti; aur Ibn Harb ne kaha: Pehli saf mein jagah paane ke liye qura andaazi hoti.

e: It was narrated from Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The best rows for men are the first rows, and the worst ones the last ones, and the best rows for women are the last ones and the worst ones for them are the first ones.
hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Mardon ke liye behtareen safein pehli safein hain, aur sabse buri safein aakhri hain, aur auraton ke liye behtareen safein aakhri hain aur unke liye sabse buri safein pehli hain.

e: This hadith is narrated by Suhail with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Suhail ne usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai.

e: Sahl b. Sa'd reported: I saw men having tied (the ends) of their lower garments around their necks, like children, due to shortage of cloth and offering their prayers behind the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). One of the proclaimers said: O womenfolk, do not lift your heads till men raise (them).
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd ne bataaya: Maine dekha ki kapdon ki kami ki wajah se mard apne neeche ke kapdon ke sire apni gardanon ke ird-gird bandhe hue the, bachchon ki tarah, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke peeche namaz ada kar rahe the. Ailaan karne walon mein se ek ne kaha: Aye auraton, apne sar tab tak mat uthaao jab tak mard na uthaayein.

e: Salim narrated it from his father ('Abdullah b. Umar) that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When women ask permission for going to the mosque, do not prevent them.
hi: Salim ne ise apne waalid, Abdullah bin Umar, se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab auraten masjid jaane ki ijaazat maangein, to unhein mat roko.

e: Abdullah b. Umar reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say: Don't prevent your women from going to the mosque when they seek your permission. Bilal b. 'Abdullah said: By Allah, we shall certainly prevent them. On this'Abdullah b. Umar turned towards him and reprimanded him to harshly as I had never heard him do before. He ('Abdullah b. Umar) said: I am narrating to you that which comes from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and you (have the audicity) to say: By Allah, we shall certainly prevent them.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar ne bataaya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab tumhaari auraten masjid jaane ki ijaazat maangein, to unhein mat roko. Bilal bin Abdullah ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, hum unhein zaroor rokenge. Is par Abdullah bin Umar unki taraf mude aur unhein itni sakhti se daanta jitna maine unhein kabhi pehle nahi dekha. Unhone kaha: Main tumhein wo bata raha hoon jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se aaya hai aur tum keh rahe ho: Allah ki qasam, hum unhein zaroor rokenge.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported: 'The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Do not prevent the maid-servants of Allah from going to the mosque.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Allah ki laundiyon ko masjid jaane se mat roko.

e: lbn Umar reported: I heard the Messeinger of Allah (ﷺ) say: When your women seek your permission for going to the mosque, you grant them (permission).
hi: Ibn Umar ne bataaya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab tumhaari auraten masjid jaane ki ijaazat maangein, to unhein ijaazat do.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Do not prevent women from going to the mosque at night. A boy said to 'Abdullah b. Umar: We would never let them go out, that they may not be caught in evil. He (the narrator) said: Ibn Umar reprimanded him and said.. I am saying that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said this, but you say: We would not allow!
hi: Ibn Umar ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Auraton ko raat mein masjid jaane se mat roko. Ek larke ne Abdullah bin Umar se kaha: Hum unhein kabhi bahar nahi jaane denge, taaki wo kisi burayi mein na pad jaayein. Unhone kaha: Ibn Umar ne use daanta aur kaha: Main keh raha hoon ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ye kaha, aur tum kehte ho: Hum unhein ijaazat nahi denge!

e: A hadith like this has been narrated by A'mash with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye jaisi ek hadees A'mash ne usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported: Grant permission to women for going to the mosque in the night. His son who was called Waqid said: Then they would make mischief. He (the narrator) said: He thumped his (son's) chest and said: I am narrating to you the hadith of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and you say: No!
hi: Ibn Umar ne bataaya: Auraton ko raat mein masjid jaane ki ijaazat do. Unke bete, jinka naam Waqid tha, ne kaha: Phir wo fasaad karengi. Unhone kaha: Unhone unke seene par maara aur kaha: Main tumhein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki hadees bata raha hoon, aur tum kehte ho: Nahi!

e: Ibn Umar reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Do not deprive women of their share of the mosques, when they seek permission from you. Bilal said: By Allah, we would certainly prevent them. 'Abdullah said: I say that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said it and you say: We would certainly prevent them!
hi: Ibn Umar ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab auraten tumse ijaazat maangein, to unhein masjidon mein unka hissa lene se mahroom mat karo. Bilal ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, hum unhein zaroor rokenge. Abdullah ne kaha: Main keh raha hoon ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ye kaha aur tum kehte ho: Hum unhein zaroor rokenge!

e: Zainab Thaqafiya reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When any one of you (women) participates in the 'Isha' prayer, she should not perfume herself that night.
hi: Zainab Thaqafiya ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab tum mein se koi aurat Isha ki namaz mein shaamil ho, to use us raat khushbu nahi lagaani chaahiye.

e: Zainab, the wife of Abdullah (b. 'Umar), reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to us: When any one of you comes to the mosque, she should not apply perfume.
hi: Zainab, Abdullah bin Umar ki biwi, ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humse kaha: Jab tum mein se koi aurat masjid aaye, to use khushbu nahi lagaani chaahiye.

e: Abu Huraira said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Whoever (woman) fumigates herself with perfume should not join us in the 'Isha' prayer.
hi: Abu Huraira ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Jo aurat khud ko khushbu se mahkaaye, use humaare saath Isha ki namaz mein shaamil nahi hona chahiye.

e: 'Amra, daughter of Abd al-Rahmin, reported: I heard 'A'isha, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). say: If the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had seen what new things the women have introduced (in their way of life) he would have definitely prevented them from going to the mosque, as the women of BaniIsra'il were prevented.
hi: Amra, Abdur Rahman ki beti, ne bataaya: Maine Aisha, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki biwi, ko ye kehte suna: Agar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne wo nayi baatein dekhi hoti jo auraton ne apne rehan-sehan mein shuru kar di hain, to wo unhein masjid jaane se zaroor rokte, jaise Bani Israel ki auraton ko roka gaya tha.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Yahya b. Sa'id with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Yahya bin Sa'id ne usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported: The word of (Allah) Great and Glorious: 'And utter not thy prayer loudly, nor be low in it" (xvii. 110) was revealed as the Messenger of Allah (may peace beupon him) was hiding himself in Mecca. When he led his Companions in prayer he raised his voice (while reciting the) Qur'an. And when the polytheists heard that, they reviled the Qur'an and Him Who revealed it and him who brought it. Upon this Allah, the Exalted, said to His Apostle (ﷺ): Utter not thy prayer so loudly that the polytheists may hear thy recitation and (recite it) not so low that it may be inaudible to your Companions. Make them hear the Qur'an, but do not recite it loudly and seek a (middle) way between these. Recite between loud and low tone.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bataaya: Allah, Buland aur Baa-Azmat, ke ye alfaaz: 'Aur apni namaz zor se mat padho aur na hi use aahista rakho' (17:110), tab nazil hue jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Makkah mein chhupe hue the. Jab wo apne Sahaba ki imaamat karte, to wo Quran zor se padhte. Aur jab mushrikeen ye sunte, to wo Quran ki aur Use jo ise nazil karta hai aur us shaks ki jisne ise laaya, buraayi karte. Is par Allah, Buland, ne apne Rasool (SAW) se kaha: Apni namaz itni zor se mat padho ki mushrikeen tumhaari tilaawat sun sakein, aur na itni aahista ki ye tumhaare Sahaba ke liye na sunayi de. Unhein Quran sunaao, lekin ise zor se mat padho aur in dono halaton ke beech ek raasta dhoondho. Buland aur aahista aawaz ke beech, darmiyani awaaz mein, padho.

e: 'A'isha reported that so far as these words of (Allah) Glorious and High are concerned: " And utter not thy prayer loudly, not be low in it" (xvii. 110) relate to supplication (du'a').
hi: Aisha ne bataaya ki jahan tak Allah, Baa-Azmat aur Buland, ke in alfaaz ka taalluq hai: 'Aur apni namaz zor se mat padho aur na hi use aahista rakho' (17:110), ye dua se mutaalliq hai.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated by Hisham with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye jaisi hadees Hisham ne usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported with regard to the words of Allah, Great and Glorious: " Move not thy tongue therewith" (Ixxv. 16) that when Gabriel brought revelation to him (the Holy Prophet) he moved his tongue and lips (with a view to committing it to memory instantly). This was something hard for him and it was visible (from his face). Then Allah, the Exalted. revealed this a" Move not thy tongue therewith to make haste (in memorising it). Surely on us rests the collecting of it and the reciting of it" (ixxv. 16), i. e. Verily it rests with Us that We would preserve it in your heart and (enable you) to recite it You would recite it when We would recite it and so follow its recitation, and He (Allah) said:" We revealed it, so listen to it attentively. Verily its exposition rests with Us. i. e. We would make it deliver by your tongue." So when Gabriel came to him (to the Holy Prophet), he kept silence, and when he went away he recited as Allah had promised him.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne Allah, Buland aur Baa-Azmat, ke in alfaaz ke baare mein bataaya: 'Apni zubaan use jaldi haasil karne ke liye mat hilaao' (75:16), ki jab Jibrael unke paas wahi laate the, to wo apni zubaan aur honth hilaate the taaki wo use foran yaad kar lein. Ye unke liye mushkil tha aur ye unke chehre se zaahir hota tha. Phir Allah, Buland, ne ye nazil kiya: 'Apni zubaan ise jaldi haasil karne ke liye mat hilaao. Beshak isko jama karna aur padhaana Hamaari zimmedaari hai' (75:16-17), yaani, Beshak ye Hamaari zimmedaari hai ki Hum ise tumhaare dil mein mahfooz rakhein aur tumhein padhne mein saksham banaayein. Tum use tab padhoge jab Hum ise padhenge aur is liye iski tilaawat ki peirvi karo, aur Wo Allah ne kaha: 'Humne ise nazil kiya, is liye poori tawajjo se ise suno. Beshak iski tafseer Hamaari zimmedaari hai,' yaani, Hum tumhaari zubaan se ise pahunchaayenge. Is liye jab Jibrael unke paas aate, to wo khaamosh rehte, aur jab wo chale jaate, to wo usi tarah tilaawat karte jaisa Allah ne unse waada kiya tha.

e: Ibn Abbas reported with regard to the words: " Do not move thy tongue there with to make haste," that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) felt it hard and he moved his lips. Ibn 'Abbas said to me (Sa'id b. Jubair): I move them just as the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) moved them. Then said Sa'id: I move them just as Ibn 'Abbas moved them, and he moved his lips. Allah, the Exalted, revealed this:" Do not move your tongue therewith to make haste. It is with US that its collection rests and its recital" (al-Qur'an, ixxv. 16). He said: Its preservation in your heart and then your recital. So when We recite it, follow its recital. He said: Listen to it, and be silent and then it rests with Us that you recite it. So when Gabriel came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), he listened to him attentively, and when Gabriel went away, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) recited as he (Gabriel) had recited it.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne in alfaaz ke baare mein bataaya: 'Apni zubaan ise jaldi haasil karne ke liye mat hilaao,' ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye mushkil laga aur unhone apne honth hilaaye. Ibn Abbas ne mujhse kaha: Main unhein waise hi hilaata hoon jaise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unhein hilaate the. Phir Sa'id ne kaha: Main unhein waise hi hilaata hoon jaise Ibn Abbas unhein hilaate the, aur unhone apne honth hilaaye. Allah, Buland, ne ye nazil kiya: 'Apni zubaan ise jaldi haasil karne ke liye mat hilaao. Iska jama karna aur iski tilaawat Hamaari zimmedaari hai' (75:16). Unhone kaha: Iska tumhaare dil mein mahfooz hona aur phir tumhaari tilaawat. Is liye jab Hum ise padhein, to iski tilaawat ki peirvi karo. Unhone kaha: Ise suno, aur khaamosh raho, aur phir ye Hamaari zimmedaari hai ki tum ise padho. Is liye jab Jibrael Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye, to unhone poori tawajjo se unhein suna, aur jab Jibrael chale gaye, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne waisi hi tilaawat ki jaisi Jibrael ne ki thi.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) neither recited the Qur'an to the Jinn nor did he see them. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went out with some of his Companions with the intention of going to the bazaar of 'Ukaz And there had been (at that time) obstructions between satans and the news from the Heaven, and there were flung flames upon them. So satan went back to their people and they said: What has happened to you? They said: There have been created obstructions between us and the news from the Heaven. And there have been flung upon us flames. They said: It cannot happen but for some (important) event. So traverse the eastern parts of the earth and the western parts and find out why is it that there have been created obstructions between us and the news from the Heaven. So they went forth and traversed the easts of the earth and its wests. Some of them proceeded towards Tihama and that is a nakhl towards the bazaar of 'Ukaz and he (the Holy Prophet) was leading his Companions in the morning prayer. So when they heard the Qur'an. they listened to it attentively and said: It is this which has caused obstruction between us and news from the Heaven. They went back to their people and said: O our people, we have heard a strange Qur'an which directs us to the right path; so we affirm our faith in it and we would never associate anyone with our Lord. And Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, revealed to His Apostle Muhammad (ﷺ):" It has been revealed to me that a party of Jinn listened to it" (Qur'an, lxxii. 1).
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne na to Jinnon ko Quran padha, na hi unhein dekha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apne kuch Sahaba ke saath Ukaz ke bazaar jaane ke iraade se nikle. Aur us waqt Shayateen aur aasman ki khabar ke darmiyaan rukaawatein khadi kar di gayi thi, aur unpar shole phenke ja rahe the. Is liye Shaitan apni qaum ke paas wapas gaye aur unhone kaha: Tumhein kya hua? Unhone kaha: Hamaare aur aasman ki khabar ke darmiyaan rukaawatein khadi kar di gayi hain. Aur humpar shole phenke gaye hain. Unhone kaha: Ye kisi ahem waaqiye ke bina nahi ho sakta. Is liye zameen ke poorabi aur paschimi hisson mein jaao aur pata lagaao ki aisa kyun hai ki hamaare aur aasman ki khabar ke darmiyaan rukaawatein khadi kar di gayi hain. Is liye wo nikle aur zameen ke poorab aur paschim mein phail gaye. Unmein se kuch Tihama ki taraf gaye aur wo ek khajoor ka ilaaka hai Ukaz ke bazaar ki taraf, aur wo subah ki namaz mein apne Sahaba ki imaamat kar rahe the. Is liye jab unhone Quran suna, to unhone poori tawajjo se suna aur kaha: Ye wahi hai jisne hamaare aur aasman ki khabar ke darmiyaan rukaawat khadi ki hai. Wo apni qaum ke paas wapas gaye aur kaha: Aye hamaari qaum, humne ek ajeeb-o-gareeb Quran suna hai jo humein seedhi raah dikhaata hai; is liye hum ismein imaan laate hain aur hum kabhi apne Rab ke saath kisi ko shareek nahi karenge. Aur Allah, Buland aur Baa-Azmat, ne apne Rasool Muhammad (SAW) par nazil kiya: 'Mujhpar wahi nazil hui hai ki Jinnon ke ek giroh ne ise suna' (72:1).

e: Dawud reported from 'Amir who said: I asked 'Alqama if Ibn Mas'ud was present with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the night of the Jinn (the night when the Prophet met them). He (Ibn Mas'uad) said: No, but we were in the company of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) one night and we missed him. We searched for him in the valleys and the hills and said. He has either been taken away (by jinn) or has been secretly killed. He (the narrator) said. We spent the worst night which people could ever spend. When it was dawn we saw him coming from the side of Hiri'. He (the narrator) reported. We said: Messenger of Allah, we missed you and searched for you, but we could not find you and we spent the worst night which people could ever spend. He (the Holy Prophet) said: There came to me an inviter on behalf of the Jinn and I went along with him and recited to them the Qur'an. He (the narrator) said: He then went along with us and showed us their traces and traces of their embers. They (the Jinn) asked him (the Holy Prophet) about their provision and he said: Every bone on which the name of Allah is recited is your provision. The time it will fall in your hand it would be covered with flesh, and the dung of (the camels) is fodder for your animals. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Don't perform istinja with these (things) for these are the food of your brothers (Jinn).
hi: Dawud ne Aamir se riwayat ki jinhone kaha: Maine Alqama se poocha ki kya Ibn Mas'ood Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Jinnon ki raat, jab Nabi (SAW) unse mile, ko maujood the. Unhone kaha: Nahi, lekin hum ek raat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein the aur humne unhein achaanak gum paaya. Humne unhein waadiyon aur pahaadon mein dhoondha aur kaha: Ya to unhein Jinnon ne le liya hai ya chupke se maar diya gaya hai. Unhone kaha: Humne waisi bad-tareen raat guzaari jo log kabhi guzaar sakte hain. Jab subah hui, to humne unhein Hira ki taraf se aate dekha. Unhone bataaya: Humne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, hum aapko na paakar aapki talaash mein nikle, lekin hum aapko dhoondh nahi paaye aur humne bad-tareen raat guzaari jo log kabhi guzaar sakte hain. Unhone kaha: Jinnon ki taraf se ek bulaane wala mere paas aaya aur main unke saath gaya aur unhein Quran sunaaya. Unhone kaha: Phir wo humaare saath gaye aur humein unke nishaan aur unke angaaron ke nishaan dikhaaye. Unhone apni khuraak ke baare mein poocha aur unhone kaha: Har haddi jispar Allah ka naam liya gaya ho wo tumhaari khuraak hai. Jab wo tumhaare haath mein giregi, to wo gosht se dhaki hui hogi, aur oonton ki lidd tumhaare jaanwaron ke liye chaara hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: In cheezon se istinja mat karo, kyunki ye tumhaare bhaiyon ka khaana hai.

e: This hadith has been reported by Dawud with the same chain of transmitters up to the word (s): " The traces of their embers." Sha'bi said: They (the Jinn) asked about their provision, and they were the Jinn of al-jazira, up to the end of the hadith, and the words of Sha'bi have been directly transmitted from the hadith of Abdullah.
hi: Ye hadees Dawud ne usi sanad ke saath, 'unke angaaron ke nishaan' tak, riwayat ki hai. Sha'bi ne kaha: Unhone apni khuraak ke baare mein poocha, aur wo al-Jazira ke Jinn the, hadees ke aakhir tak, aur Sha'bi ke alfaaz Abdullah ki hadees se seedhe liye gaye hain.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah from the Apostle (ﷺ) up to the words: " The traces of the embers," but he made no mention of what followed afterward.
hi: Ye hadees Abdullah se Rasool (SAW) tak 'angaaron ke nishaan' ke alfaaz tak riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin unhone iske baad jo hua uska zikr nahi kiya.

e: Abdullah (b. Mas'ud) said: I was not with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) but I wish I were with him.
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ood ne kaha: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath nahi tha lekin kaash main hota.

e: Ma'n reported.. I heard it from my father who said: I asked Masruq who informed the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about the night when they heard the Qur'an. He said: Your father, Ibn Mas'ud, narrated it to me that a tree informed him about that.
hi: Ma'n ne bataaya: Maine ise apne waalid se suna jinhone kaha: Maine Masruq se poocha ki kisne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko us raat ke baare mein bataaya jab Jinnon ne Quran suna. Unhone kaha: Tumhaare waalid, Ibn Mas'ood, ne mujhe bataaya ki ek ped ne unhein iske baare mein bataaya.

e: Abu Qatada reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led us in prayer and recited in the first two rak'ahs of the noon and afternoon prayers Surat al-Fitiha and two (other) surahs. And he would sometimes recite loud enough for us the verses. He would prolong the first rak'ah more than the second. And he acted similarly in the morning prayer.
hi: Abu Qatada ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humaari namaz ki imaamat ki aur Zuhr aur Asr ki namaz ki pehli do rak'aaton mein Surah al-Fatiha aur do aur Surahein padhi. Aur kabhi-kabhi wo humein sunane ke liye kaafi zor se padhte. Wo pehli rak'aat ko doosri se lambi kar dete. Aur wo subah ki namaz mein bhi isi tarah karte the.

e: Abu Qatada reported it on the authority of his father: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would recite in the first two rak'ahs of the noon and afternoon prayers the opening chapter of the Book and another surah. He would sometimes recite loud enough to make audible to us the verse and would recite in the last two rak'ahs Surat al-Faitiha (only).
hi: Abu Qatada ne apne waalid ki sanad se riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Zuhr aur Asr ki namaz ki pehli do rak'aaton mein Kitab ka pehla adhyaay aur ek aur Surah padhte the. Wo kabhi-kabhi humein sunane ke liye kaafi zor se padhte the aur aakhri do rak'aaton mein sirf Surah al-Fatiha padhte the.

e:
Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported: We used to estimate how long Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood in the noon and afternoon prayers, and we estimated hat he stood in the first two rak'ahs of the noon prayer as long as it takes to recite Alif Lam Mim, Tanzil, i. e. as-Sajda. We estimated that he stood half that time in the last two rak'ahs; that he stood in the first two of the afternoon as long as he did in the last two at noon; and in the last two of the afternoon prayer about half that time. 
Abu Bakr in his narration has made no mention of Alif Lam Mim, Tanzil, but said: As long as it takes to recite thirty verses.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne bataaya: Hum andaaza lagaya karte the ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Zuhr aur Asr ki namaz mein kitni der khade rehte the, aur humne andaaza lagaya ki wo Zuhr ki pehli do rak'aaton mein utni der khade rahte the jitni der mein 'Alif Lam Meem, Tanzeel,' yaani as-Sajda, padhi ja sake. Humne andaaza lagaya ki wo aakhri do rak'aaton mein isse aadhi der khade rehte the; ki wo Asr ki pehli do rak'aaton mein utni hi der khade rehte the jitni Zuhr ki aakhri do mein; aur Asr ki aakhri do rak'aaton mein takreeban aadhi der. Abu Bakr ne apni riwayat mein 'Alif Lam Meem, Tanzeel' ka zikr nahi kiya, balki kaha: Jitni der mein tees (30) aayaten padhi ja sakein.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) used to recite in every rak'ah of the first two rak'ahs of the noon prayer about thirty verses and in the last two about fifteen verses or half (of the first rak'ah) and in every rak'ah of the 'Asr prayer of the first two rak'ahs about fifteen verses and in the last two verses half (of the first ones).
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Zuhr ki pehli do rak'aaton mein har rak'aat mein takreeban tees aayaten aur aakhri do mein takreeban pandrah aayaten ya pehli rak'aat ki aadhi padhte the, aur Asr ki pehli do rak'aaton mein har rak'aat mein takreeban pandrah aayaten aur aakhri do mein pehli ki aadhi aayaten padhte the.

e: Jabir b. Samura reported: The people of Kufa complained to Umar b. Khattab about Sa'd and they made a mention of his prayer. 'Umar sent for him. He came to him. He ('Umar) told him that the people had found fault with his prayer. He said: I lead them in prayer in accorance with the prayer of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). I make no decrease in it. I make them stand for a longer time in the first two (rak'ahs) and shorten it in the last two. Upon this 'Umar remarked: This is what I deemed of thee, O Abu Ishaq.
hi: Jabir bin Samura ne bataaya: Kufa ke logon ne Umar bin Khattab se Sa'd ki shikaayat ki aur unki namaz ka zikr kiya. Umar ne unhein bulwaaya. Wo unke paas aaye. Unhone unse kaha ki logon ne unki namaz mein khaami paayi hai. Unhone kaha: Main unki imaamat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki namaz ke mutaabiq karta hoon. Main ismein koi kami nahi karta. Main unhein pehli do rak'aaton mein zyada der khade rakhta hoon aur aakhri do mein use chota kar deta hoon. Is par Umar ne kaha: Yehi mujhe tumhaare baare mein guman tha, Aye Abu Ishaq.

e: This hadith his been narrated by 'Abu al-Malik with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu al-Malik ne usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai.

e: Jabir b. Samura reported: 'Umar said to Sa'd: They complain against you in every matter, even in prayer. He (Sa'd) said: I prolong (standing) in the first two (rak'ahs) and shorten it in the last two, and I make no negligence in following the prayer of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He ('Umar) remarked: This is what is expected of you, or, that is what I deemed of you.
hi: Jabir bin Samura ne bataaya: Umar ne Sa'd se kaha: Wo har maamle mein tumhaari shikaayat karte hain, namaz mein bhi. Unhone kaha: Main pehli do rak'aaton mein khade hone ko lamba karta hoon aur aakhri do mein chota karta hoon, aur main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki namaz ki peirvi karne mein koi kotaahi nahi karta. Unhone kaha: Yehi tumse tawaqqo ki jaati hai, ya, yehi mera tumhaare baare mein guman tha.

e: This hadith is narrated by Jabir b. Samura but with the addition of these words: " (Sa'd said): These bedouins presume to teach me prayer."
hi: Ye hadees Jabir bin Samura ne bhi riwayat ki hai, lekin in alfaaz ka izafa karte hue: 'Sa'd ne kaha: Ye badawi mujhe namaz sikhaane ka daawa karte hain.'

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported: The noon prayer would start and one would go to al-Baqi' and after having relieved himself he would perform ablution and then come, while the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would be in the first rak'ah, because he would prolong it so much.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne bataaya: Zuhr ki namaz shuru ho jaati thi aur koi shakhs al-Baqi' jaata, aur khud ko halka karne ke baad wo wuzu karta aur phir aata, jabki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) pehli rak'aat mein hi hote, kyunki wo ise itni lambi kar dete the.

e: Qaz'a reported: I came to Abu Sa'id al-Khudri and he was surrounded by people. When the people departed from him I said: I am not going to ask you what these people have been asking you. I want to ask you about the prayer of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He (Abu Sa'id) said: There is no good for you in this. He (Qaz'a), however, repeated (his demand). He then said: The noon prayer would start and one of us would go to Baqi' and, having relieved himself, would come to his home, then perform ablution and go to the mosque, and (he would find) The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in the first rak'ah.
hi: Qaz'a ne bataaya: Main Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ke paas aaya aur wo logon se gher hue the. Jab log unse chale gaye, to maine kaha: Main aapse wahi sawaal nahi poochunga jo ye log poochte rahe hain. Main aapse Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki namaz ke baare mein poochna chaahta hoon. Unhone kaha: Ismein tumhaare liye koi bhalaai nahi hai. Unhone, phir bhi, apni maang dohraayi. Phir unhone kaha: Zuhr ki namaz shuru ho jaati thi aur hum mein se koi Baqi' jaata, aur khud ko halka karne ke baad, apne ghar aata, phir wuzu karta aur masjid jaata, aur paata ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) pehli rak'aat mein hote.

e: Abdullah b. Sa'id reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) led us in the morning prayer in Mecca and began Sarat al-Mu'minin (xxiii ) but when he came to the mention of Moses and Aaron (verse. 45) or to the mention of Jesus (verse 50), a cough got the better of him, and he bowed. 'Abdullah b. Sa'ib was present there, and in the hadith narrated by Abd al-Razzaq (the words are): He cut short (the recitation) and bowed.
hi: Abdullah bin Sa'id ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Makkah mein humaari subah ki namaz ki imaamat ki aur Surah al-Mu'minoon shuru ki, lekin jab wo Musa aur Harun ka zikr, aayat 45, ya Isa ka zikr, aayat 50, tak pahunche, to unhein khaansi aane lagi aur wo ruku mein chale gaye. Abdullah bin Sa'ib wahan maujood the, aur Abdur Razzaq ki riwayat ki gayi hadees mein alfaaz hain: Unhone tilaawat mukhtasar kar di aur ruku mein chale gaye.

e: 'Amr b. Huwairith reported: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) recite in the morning prayer" Wa'l-lail-i-idhd 'As'asa" (ixxxi. 17).
hi: Amr bin Huwairith ne bataaya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko subah ki namaz mein 'Wal-Laili idha As'asa' (81:17) padhte suna.

e: Qutba b. Malik reported: I said prayer and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led it and he recited" Qaf. (I.). By the Glorious Qur'an," till he recited" and the tall palm trees" (l. 10). I wanted to repeat it but I could not follow its significance.
hi: Qutba bin Malik ne bataaya: Maine namaz padhi aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne uski imaamat ki aur unhone 'Qaf. Baa-Izzat Quran ki qasam' padha, yahan tak ki unhone 'Aur oonchi khajoor ke ped' (50:10) padha. Main ise dohraana chaahta tha lekin main iski ahmiyat samajh nahi paaya.

e: Qutba b. Malik reported that he had heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) reciting in the morning prayer this: " And the tall palm trees having flower spikes piled one above another" (Al-Qur'an 50:10).
hi: Qutba bin Malik ne bataaya ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko subah ki namaz mein ye padhte suna: 'Aur oonchi khajoor ke ped jinke gucchhe ek doosre par tahe hue hain' (50:10).

e: Ziyad b. 'Ilaqa reported it on the authority of his uncle that he said the morning prayer with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he recited in the first rak'ah: "And the tall palm trees having flower spikes piled one above another (l. 10) or perhaps Surah Qaf."
hi: Ziyad bin Ilaqa ne apne chacha ki sanad se riwayat ki ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath subah ki namaz padhi aur unhone pehli rak'aat mein padha: 'Aur oonchi khajoor ke ped jinke gucchhe ek doosre par tahe hue hain' (50:10), ya shaayad Surah Qaf.

e: Jabir b. Samura reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) used to recite in the morning prayer" Qaf. By the Glorious Quran." and his prayer afterward shortened.
hi: Jabir bin Samura ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) subah ki namaz mein 'Qaf. Baa-Izzat Quran ki qasam' padha karte the, aur uske baad unki namaz mukhtasar hoti thi.

e: Simak asked Jabir b. Samura about the prayer of the Apostle (ﷺ). He said: He (the Holy Prophet) shortened the prayer and he did not pray like these people then, and he informed me that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to recite" Qaf. By the (Glorious) Qur'an," and a passage of similar length.
hi: Simak ne Jabir bin Samura se Nabi (SAW) ki namaz ke baare mein poocha. Unhone kaha: Wo namaz mukhtasar karte the aur wo un logon jaisi namaz nahi padhte the jaisi aajkal ke ye log padhte hain, aur unhone mujhe bataaya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) 'Qaf. Baa-Izzat Quran ki qasam' aur isi tarah ki lambaai ka ek aur tukda padha karte the.

e: Jabir b. Samura reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) used to recite in the noon prayer:" By the night when it envelopes" (xcii.), and in the afternoon like this, but he prolonged the morning prayer as compared to that (noon and afternoon prayers).
hi: Jabir bin Samura ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Zuhr ki namaz mein 'Us raat ki qasam jab wo chhaa jaaye' (92) padha karte the, aur Asr mein isi tarah, lekin unhone subah ki namaz ko in namazon ke muqaable mein lamba rakha.

e: Jabir b. Samura reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) used to recite in the noon prayer:" Glorify the name of thy Most High Lord in the morning prayer longer than this" (lxxxvii.)
hi: Jabir bin Samura ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Zuhr ki namaz mein 'Apne Rab, Sabse Buland ke naam ki tasbeeh karo' (87) padha karte the, subah ki namaz mein isse bhi lambi.

e: Abu Barza reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to recite in the morning prayer from sixty to one hundred verses.
hi: Abu Barza ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) subah ki namaz mein saath (60) se sau (100) aayaton tak padha karte the.

e: Abu Barza Aslami reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to recite from sixty to one hundred verses in the morning prayer.
