hi: Abu Barza Aslami ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) subah ki namaz mein saath se sau aayaton tak padha karte the.

e: Ibn Abbas reported: Umm al-Fadl daughter of al-Harith heard him reciting:" By those sent forth to spread goodness" (lxxvii.). (Upon this) she remarked: O my son, you reminded me by the recitation of this surah (the fact) that it was the last surah that I heard from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he recited it in the evening prayer.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bataaya: Umm al-Fadl, al-Harith ki beti, ne unhein ye padhte suna: 'Un logon ki qasam jo bhalaai phailaane ke liye bheje gaye' (77). Is par unhone kaha: Aye mere bete, tumne is Surah ki tilaawat se mujhe yaad dilaaya ki ye wo aakhri Surah thi jo maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suni thi aur unhone ise Maghrib ki namaz mein padha tha.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters but with this addition: " And he did not lead the player after this till his death."
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ne usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai, is izafe ke saath: 'Aur unhone iske baad apni maut tak namaz ki imaamat nahi ki.'

e: Jubair b. Mut'im reported: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) reciting Surat al-Tur (Mountain) (lii) in the evening prayer.
hi: Jubair bin Mut'im ne bataaya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Maghrib ki namaz mein Surah at-Tur (52) padhte suna.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ne usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai.

e: 'Adi reported: I heard al-Bara' narrating it from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that while in a journey he said the night prayer and recited in one of the two rak'ahs:" By the Fig and the Olive" (Su'rah xcv.).
hi: Adi ne bataaya: Maine al-Bara se, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke hawaale se, ye riwayat ki suni ki ek safar ke dauraan unhone Isha ki namaz padhi aur do rak'aaton mein se ek mein padha: 'Anjeer aur Zaitoon ki qasam' (Surah 95).

e: Al-Bara' b. 'Azib reported that he said prayer with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he recited: " By the Fig and the Olive."
hi: Al-Bara bin Aazib ne bataaya ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath namaz padhi aur unhone padha: 'Anjeer aur Zaitoon ki qasam.'

e: Al-Bara' b. 'Azib reported: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) reciting in the night prayer:" By the Fig and the Olive," and I have never heard anyone with a sweeter voice than he.
hi: Al-Bara bin Aazib ne bataaya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Isha ki namaz mein 'Anjeer aur Zaitoon ki qasam' padhte suna, aur maine kabhi kisi ki aawaz unse zyada meethi nahi suni.

e: Jabir reported that Mu'adh b. Jabal used to pray with the Apostle (ﷺ), then came and led his people in prayer. One night he said the night prayer with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He then came to his people and led them in prayer beginning with Surat al-Baqara. A man turned aside, pronounced the taslim (salutation for concluding the prayer), then prayed alone and departed. The people said to him: Have you become a hypocrite, so and so? He said: I swear by Allah that I have not, but I will certainly go to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and will inform (him) about this. He then came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: Messenger of Allah, we look after camels used for watering and work by day. Mu'adh said the night prayer with you. He then came and began with Surat al-Baqara. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then turned to Mu'adh and said: Are you there to (put the people) to trial? Recite such and recite such (and such a surah). It is transmitted on the authority of Jabir, as told by Sufyan, that he (the Holy Prophet) had said: "By the sun and its morning brightness" (Surah xci), "By brightness" (Surah xciii), "By the night when it spreads" (Surah xcii), and "Glorify the name of thy most high Lord" (Surah lxxxii).
hi: Jabir ne bataaya ki Mu'adh bin Jabal Rasool (SAW) ke saath namaz padha karte the, phir aakar apni qaum ki namaz ki imaamat karte the. Ek raat unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Isha ki namaz padhi. Phir wo apni qaum ke paas aaye aur unki imaamat ki, Surah al-Baqara se shuru karte hue. Ek shaks alag ho gaya, taslim padhi aur phir akele namaz padhkar chala gaya. Logon ne usse kaha: Kya tum munafiq ban gaye ho, falaan? Usne kaha: Main Allah ki qasam khaakar kehta hoon ki main aisa nahi hoon, lekin main zaroor Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas jaakar unhein iski khabar dunga. Wo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, hum oonton se paani nikaalne aur din bhar kaam karne wale log hain. Mu'adh ne aapke saath Isha ki namaz padhi. Phir wo aaye aur Surah al-Baqara se shuru kiya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Mu'adh ki taraf mudkar kaha: Kya tum logon ko fitne mein daalne aaye ho? Falaan Surah padho aur falaan Surah padho. Jabir ki sanad se ye riwayat ki gayi hai, jaisa Sufyan ne bataaya, ki unhone kaha: 'Suraj aur uski subah ki chamak ki qasam' (Surah 91), 'Roshni ki qasam' (Surah 93), 'Us raat ki qasam jab wo phail jaaye' (Surah 92), aur 'Apne Rab, Sabse Buland, ke naam ki tasbeeh karo' (Surah 87).

e: Jabir reported: 'Mu'adh b. Jabal al-Ansari led his companions in the night prayer and prolonged it for them. A person amongst us said prayer (after having separated himself from the congregation). Mu'adh was informed of this, and he remarked that he was a hypocrite. When it (the remark) was conveyed to the man, he went to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and informed him of what Mu'adh had said. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to him: Mu'adh, do you want to become a person putting (people) to trial? When you lead people in prayer, recite:" By the Sun and its morning brightness" (Surat ash-Shams)," Glorify the name of thy most high Lord" (Surat al-A`la) and" Read in the name of Lord" (Surat al-`Alaq), and" By the night when it spreads" (Surat al-Lail).
hi: Jabir ne bataaya: Mu'adh bin Jabal al-Ansari ne apne saathiyon ki Isha ki namaz ki imaamat ki aur ise unke liye lamba kar diya. Humein se ek shaks ne, jamaat se alag hokar, namaz padhi. Mu'adh ko iski khabar di gayi, aur unhone kaha ki wo munafiq hai. Jab ye baat us shaks tak pahunchi, to wo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaya aur unhein bataaya ki Mu'adh ne kya kaha tha. Is par Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne usse kaha: Mu'adh, kya tum logon ko fitne mein daalne wale banna chaahte ho? Jab tum logon ki namaz ki imaamat karo, to padho: 'Suraj aur uski subah ki chamak ki qasam' (Surah ash-Shams), 'Apne Rab, Sabse Buland, ke naam ki tasbeeh karo' (Surah al-A'la), 'Padho apne Rab ke naam se' (Surah al-Alaq), aur 'Us raat ki qasam jab wo phail jaaye' (Surah al-Lail).

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported: Mu'adh b. Jabal said the night prayer with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and then returned to his people and then led them in this prayer.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bataaya: Mu'adh bin Jabal ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Isha ki namaz padhi aur phir apni qaum ke paas wapas gaye aur unki imaamat is namaz mein ki.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah reported: Mu'adh said the night prayer with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He then came to the mosque of his people and led them in prayer.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bataaya: Mu'adh ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Isha ki namaz padhi. Wo phir apni qaum ki masjid mein aaye aur unki namaz ki imaamat ki.

e: Abu Mas'ud al-Ainsari reported: A person came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: I keep away from the morning prayer on account of such and such (a man), because; he keeps us so long. I never saw God's Messenger (ﷺ) more angry when giving an exhortation than he was that day. He said: 0 people, some of you are scaring people away. So whoever of you leads the people in prayer he must be brief, for behind him are the weak, the aged, and the people who have (argent) business to attend.
hi: Abu Mas'ood al-Ansari ne bataaya: Ek shaks Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Main subah ki namaz se falaan-falaan Imam ki wajah se door rehta hoon, kyunki wo humein bahut der tak namaz mein rakhte hain. Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kabhi bhi nasihat dete waqt itna gussa mein nahi dekha jitna us din. Unhone kaha: Aye logo, tum mein se kuch log logon ko deen se door bhagaate hain. Is liye tum mein se jo bhi logon ki namaz ki imaamat kare, use mukhtasar karna chaahiye, kyunki unke peeche kamzor, budhe aur wo log hain jinhein zaroori kaam nipatana hai.

e: This hadith like one narrated by Hashalm has been narrated from Isma'il with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Hasham ki riwayat jaisi Ismail se usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) said: When any one of you leads the people in prayer, he should be brief for among them are the young and the aged, the weak and the sick. But when one of you prays by himself, he may (prolong) as he likes.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab tum mein se koi logon ki namaz ki imaamat kare, to use mukhtasar karni chahiye, kyunki unmein jawaan aur budhe, kamzor aur bimaar log hote hain. Lekin jab tum mein se koi akela namaz padhe, to wo jitni chaahe lamba kar sakta hai.

e: Hammam b. Munabbih reported: This is what Abu Huraira transmitted to us from Muhammad the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and he narrated (some) ahadith out of (these narrations and one of them is this): The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When any one of you stands to lead people In prayer, he should shorten it, for amongst them are the aged, and amongst them are the weak, but when he prays by himself, he may prolong his prayer as he likes.
hi: Hammam bin Munabbih ne bataaya: Ye wo hai jo Abu Huraira ne humein Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool (SAW), se riwayat ki, aur unhone kuch Ahadees bayan ki, jinmein se ek ye hai: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab tum mein se koi logon ki namaz ki imaamat karne ke liye khada ho, to use ise mukhtasar karna chaahiye, kyunki unmein budhe log hote hain aur unmein kamzor log hote hain, lekin jab wo akele namaz padhe, to wo jitni chaahe apni namaz lamba kar sakta hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When any one of you leads people in prayer, he must shorten it for among them are the weak, the infirm and those who have business to attend.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab tum mein se koi logon ki namaz ki imaamat kare, to use ise mukhtasar karna chaahiye, kyunki unmein kamzor, bimaar aur wo log hote hain jinhein zaroori kaam nipatana hota hai.

e: Abu Bakr b. 'Abd al-Rahman reported that he had heard Abu Huraira say that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said like it, but he substituted" the aged" for 'the infirm".
hi: Abu Bakr bin Abdur Rahman ne bataaya ki unhone Abu Huraira ko ye kehte suna ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne isi jaisi baat kahi, lekin unhone 'kamzor' ki jagah 'budhe' lafz istemaal kiya.

e: Uthman b. Abu'l-'As at-Thaqafi reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) said to him: Lead your people in prayer. I said: Messenger of Allah. I perceive something (disturbing) in my soul. He (the Holy Prophet) asked me to draw near him and making me sit down in front of him he placed his hand on my breast between my nipples. and then, telling me to turn round, he placed it on my back between my shoulders. He then said: Act as an Imam for your people. He who acts as Imam of the people, he must be brief, for among them are the aged, among them are the sick, among them are the weak, and among them are the people who have business to attend. But when any of you prays alone, he may pray as he likes.
hi: Uthman bin Abul-As ath-Thaqafi ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha: Apni qaum ki namaz ki imaamat karo. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, main apni jaan mein kuch pareshaan karne wali cheez mehsoos karta hoon. Unhone mujhe apne qareeb bulaaya aur apne saamne bithaakar apna haath meri chhati par, mere dono nipplon ke beech, rakha. Phir, mujhe ghoomne ko kehte hue, unhone use meri peeth par, mere kandhon ke beech, rakha. Phir unhone kaha: Apni qaum ke liye Imam ka kaam karo. Jo bhi logon ke liye Imam ka kaam kare, use mukhtasar karna chaahiye, kyunki unmein budhe hain, unmein bimaar hain, unmein kamzor hain, aur unmein wo log hain jinhein kaam nipatana hai. Lekin jab tum mein se koi akela namaz padhe, to wo jaisa chaahe padh sakta hai.

e: Uthman b. Abu'l-'As reported: The last thing which the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) instructed me was: When you lead the people in prayer, be brief.
hi: Uthman bin Abul-As ne bataaya: Aakhri baat jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe hidaayat di wo thi: Jab tum logon ki namaz ki imaamat karo, to mukhtasar karo.

e: Anas reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) used to be brief and perfect in prayer.
hi: Anas ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) namaz mein mukhtasar aur mukammal hote the.

e: Anas reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was among those whose prayers was brief and perfect.
hi: Anas ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) un logon mein se the jinki namaz mukhtasar aur mukammal thi.

e: Anas reported: I never prayed behind an Imam who was more brief and more perfect in prayer than the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).
hi: Anas ne bataaya: Maine kabhi kisi Imam ke peeche namaz nahi padhi jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se zyada mukhtasar aur mukammal ho.

e: Anas reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would listen to the crying of a lad in the company of his mother, in prayer, and he would recite a short surah or a small surah.
hi: Anas ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) namaz mein apni ma ki god mein bache ke rone ki aawaz sunte, aur wo ek chhoti Surah ya ek chhoti Surah padhte.

e: Anas b. Malik reported the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) having said: When I begin the prayer I Intend to make it long, but I hear a boy cry. ing; I then shorten it because of his mother's feelings.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bataaya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jab main namaz shuru karta hoon, to iraada karta hoon ki ise lamba karun, lekin main kisi bache ko rote hue sunta hoon; phir main uski maa ke jazbaat ki wajah se ise mukhtasar kar deta hoon.

e: Al-Bara' b. 'Azib reported: I noticed the prayer of Muhammad (ﷺ) and saw his Qiyam (standing), his bowing, and then going back to the standing posture after bowing, his prostration, his sitting between the two prostrations, and his prostration and sitting between salutation and going away, all these were nearly equal to one another.
hi: Al-Bara bin Aazib ne bataaya: Maine Muhammad (SAW) ki namaz ka mushaahida kiya aur unka qiyam, unka ruku, aur phir ruku ke baad khade hone ki halat mein wapas jaana, unka sajda, do sajdon ke darmiyaan unka baithna, aur unka sajda aur salaam aur chale jaane ke beech baithna dekha, ye sab lagbhag ek doosre ke barabar the.

e: Hakam reported: There dominated in Kufa a man whose name was men- tioned as Zaman b. al-Ash'ath, who ordered Abu 'Ubaidah b. 'Abdullah to lead people in prayer and he accordingly used to lead them. Whenever he raised his head after bowing, he stood up equal to the time that I can recite (this supplication): O Allah! our Lord! unto Thee be the praise which would fill the heavens and the earth, and that which will please Thee besides them I Worthy art Thou of all praise and glory. None can prevent that which Thou bestowest, and none can bestow that whichthou preventest. And the greatness of the great will not avail him against Thee. Hakam (the narrator) said: I made a mention of that to Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Laila who reported: I heard al-Bara' b. 'Azib say that the prayer of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and his bowing, and when he lifted his head from bowing, and his prostration, and between the two prostrations (all these acts) were nearly proportionate. I made a mention of that to 'Ar b. Murrah and he said: I saw Ibn Abi Laili (saying the prayer), but his prayer was not like this.
hi: Hakam ne bataaya: Kufa mein ek shaks ka raaj tha jiska naam Zaman bin al-Ash'ath bataaya jaata hai, jisne Abu Ubaida bin Abdullah ko logon ki namaz ki imaamat karne ka hukum diya aur wo iske mutaabiq imaamat karte the. Jab bhi wo ruku ke baad apna sar uthaate, wo itni der khade rehte ki main ye dua padh sakta: Aye Allah! Hamaare Rab! Tere liye wo tareef ho jo aasmaanon aur zameen ko bhar de, aur wo jo Tujhe unke alaawa pasand ho! Tu tamaam tareef aur azmat ke laayak hai. Koi bhi Tere diye hue ko rok nahi sakta, aur koi bhi Tere roke hue ko de nahi sakta. Aur bade se bade ki azmat Tere saamne uska koi kaam nahi aayegi. Hakam ne kaha: Maine iska zikr Abdur Rahman ibn Abi Laila se kiya jinhone bataaya: Maine al-Bara bin Aazib ko ye kehte suna ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki namaz, unka ruku, aur jab wo ruku se apna sar uthaate, aur unka sajda, aur do sajdon ke darmiyaan ka waqt, ye sab lagbhag mutanaasib the. Maine iska zikr Amr bin Murrah se kiya aur unhone kaha: Maine Ibn Abi Laila ko namaz padhte dekha, lekin unki namaz isi tarah ki nahi thi.

e: Hakam reported: When Matar b. Najiya dominated Kufa he ordered Abu Ubaida to lead people in prayer, and the rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Hakam ne bataaya: Jab Matar bin Najiya ne Kufa par raaj kiya, to unhone Abu Ubaida ko logon ki namaz ki imaamat karne ka hukum diya, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Thabit reported it on the authority of Anas: While leading you in prayer I do not shorten anything in the prayer. I pray as I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) leading us. He (Thabit) said: Anas used to do that which I do not see you doing; when he lifted his head from bowing he stood up (so long) that one would say: He has forgotten (to baw down in prostration). And when he lifted his head from prostration, he stayed in that position, till someone would say: He has forgotten (to bow down in prostration for the second sajda).
hi: Thabit ne ise Anas ki sanad se riwayat ki: Tumhaari namaz ki imaamat karte waqt main namaz mein kuch bhi mukhtasar nahi karta. Main waisi hi namaz padhta hoon jaisi maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko humaari imaamat karte dekha tha. Unhone kaha: Anas aisa karte the jo main tumhein karte hue nahi dekhta; jab wo ruku se apna sar uthaate, to wo itni der khade rahte ki koi keh deta: Wo bhool gaye hain. Aur jab wo sajde se apna sar uthaate, to wo us halat mein rehte, yahan tak ki koi keh deta: Wo bhool gaye hain.

e: Thabit reported it on the authority of Anas: I have never said such a light and perfect prayer as I said behind the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). The prayer of the Messenger. of Allah (ﷺ) was well balanced. And so too was the prayer of Abu Bakr well balanced. When it was the time of 'Umar b. al-Khattab he prolonged the morning prayer. When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Allah listened to him who praised Him, he stood erect till we said: He has forgotten. He then prostrated and sat between two prostration till we said: He has forgotten.
hi: Thabit ne ise Anas ki sanad se riwayat ki: Maine kabhi bhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke peeche jaisi halki aur mukammal namaz padhi, waisi kabhi nahi padhi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki namaz achhi tarah santulit thi. Aur isi tarah Abu Bakr ki namaz bhi achhi tarah santulit thi. Jab Umar bin Khattab ka daur aaya, to unhone subah ki namaz lambi kar di. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) kehte: 'Allah ne uski suni jisne Uski tareef ki,' to wo itni der seedhe khade rahte ki hum kahte: Wo bhool gaye hain. Phir wo sajda karte aur do sajdon ke darmiyaan itni der baithte ki hum kahte: Wo bhool gaye hain.

e: Al-Bara' (b. 'Azib), and he was no liar (but a truthful Companion of the Holy Prophet), reported: They used to say prayer behind the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). I never saw anyone bending his back at the time when he (the Holy Prophet) raised his head, till the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) placed his forehead on the ground. They then fell in prostration after him.
hi: Al-Bara bin Aazib, aur wo koi jhoote nahi the, balki Nabi (SAW) ke ek sacche Sahabi, ne bataaya: Wo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke peeche namaz padha karte the. Maine kabhi kisi ko apni peeth jhukaate nahi dekha us waqt jab unhone apna sar uthaaya, yahan tak ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apni peshaani zameen par rakh dete. Phir wo unke baad sajde mein jaate.

e: Al-Bara' reported, and he was no liar: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Allah listened to him who praised Him, none of us bent his back till he (the Holy Prophet) prostrated; we then, afterwards, went down in prostration.
hi: Al-Bara ne bataaya, aur wo koi jhoote nahi the: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) kehte: 'Allah ne uski suni jisne Uski tareef ki,' to humme se koi apni peeth nahi jhukaata tha jab tak wo sajda na kar lete; hum phir uske baad sajde mein jaate.

e: Al-Bara' reported: They (the Companions) said prayer with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and they bowed when he (the Holy Prophet) bowed. and when he raised his head after bowing, he pronounced:" Allah listened to him who praised Him," and we kept standing till we saw him placing his face on the ground and then we followed him.
hi: Al-Bara ne bataaya: Unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath namaz padhi, aur jab wo jhukte the, to wo bhi jhukte the, aur jab wo apna sar jhukne ke baad uthaate, to wo kehte: 'Allah ne uski suni jisne Uski tareef ki,' aur hum khade rehte yahan tak ki humein wo apna chehra zameen par rakhte hue nazar aate, phir hum unki peirvi karte.

e: Al-Bara' reported: When we were (in prayer) with the Messenger of Allah Allah (ﷺ) none of us benfft his back till we saw he prostrated. Zuhair and others reported:" till we saw him prostrating".
hi: Al-Bara ne bataaya: Jab hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath namaz mein hote, to hum mein se koi bhi apni peeth nahi jhukaata tha jab tak humein wo sajda karte hue nazar na aate. Zuhair aur doosron ne bataaya: 'Jab tak humein wo sajda karte hue nazar na aate.'

e: 'Amr b. Huraith reported: I said the dawn prayer behind the Apostle of (ﷺ) and heard him reciting: 'Nay. I call to witness the stars, running their courses and setting" (al-Qur'an, lxxxi. 15-16) and Done of us bent his back till he completed prostration.
hi: Amr bin Huraith ne bataaya: Maine Rasool (SAW) ke peeche subah ki namaz padhi aur unhein padhte suna: 'Nahi! Main gawahi deta hoon un sitaaron ki jo apni chaal chalte aur chhup jaate hain' (81:15-16), aur humme se koi bhi apni peeth nahi jhukaata tha jab tak wo sajda mukammal na kar lete.

e: ('Abdullah b ) Ibn Abi Aufa reported: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) raised his back from the rukd' he pronounced: Allah listened to him who praised Him. O Allah! our Lord! unto Thee be praise that would fill the heavens and the earth and fill that which will please Thee besides them.
hi: Abdullah bin Abi Aufa ne bataaya: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ruku se apni peeth uthaate, to wo kehte: Allah ne uski suni jisne Uski tareef ki. Aye Allah! Humaare Rab! Tere liye itni tareef ho jo aasmaanon aur zameen ko bhar de aur, in dono ke alaawa, jo bhi cheez Tujhe pasand ho use bhar de.

e: 'Abdullah b. Aufa reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to recite this supplication: O Allah! our Lord, unto Thee be praise that would fill the heavens and the earth and fill that which will please Thee besides them.
hi: Abdullah bin Abi Aufa ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ye dua padha karte the: Aye Allah! Humaare Rab, Tere liye itni tareef ho jo aasmaanon aur zameen ko bhar de aur, in dono ke alaawa, jo bhi cheez Tujhe pasand ho use bhar de.

e: Abdullah b. Abu Aufa reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to recite (this supplication): O Allah! our Lord, unto Thee be praise that would fill the heavens and the earth and fill that which will please Thee besides (them). O Allah! purify me with snow, (water of) hail and with cold water; O Allah. cleanse me from the sins and errors just as a white garment is cleansed from dirt.
hi: Abdullah bin Abi Aufa ne bataaya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ye dua padha karte the: Aye Allah! Humaare Rab, Tere liye itni tareef ho jo aasmaanon aur zameen ko bhar de aur, in dono ke alaawa, jo bhi cheez Tujhe pasand ho use bhar de. Aye Allah, mujhe barf, ole ke paani aur thande paani se paak kar de; Aye Allah, mujhe gunahon aur galtiyon se aise saaf kar jaise ek safed kapda gandagi se saaf kiya jaata hai.

e: This hadith with the same chain of transmitters has been narrated by Shu'ba, and in the narration of Mu'adh the words are: " just as the white garment is cleansed from filth," and in the narration of Yazid:" from dirt".
hi: Ye hadees usi sanad ke saath Shu'ba ne riwayat ki hai, aur Mu'adh ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: 'jaise safed kapda gandagi se saaf kiya jaata hai,' aur Yazid ki riwayat mein: 'gandagi se.'

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) raised his head after bowing, he said: O Allah! our Lord, to Thee be the praise that would fill all the heavens and the earth, and all that it pleases Thee besides (them). O, thou art worthy of praise and glory, most worthy of what a servant says, and we all are Thy servants, no one can withhold what Thou givest or give what Thou withholdest, and riches cannot avail a wealthy person against Thee.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne bataaya: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) jhukne ke baad apna sar uthaate, to wo kehte: Aye Allah! Humaare Rab, Tujhe wo tareef ho jo saare aasmaanon aur zameen ko bhar de, aur wo sab kuch jo, in dono ke alaawa, Tujhe pasand ho. Aye, Tu tareef aur azmat ke laayak hai, us baat ka sabse zyada mustahiq hai jo koi banda kehta hai, aur hum sab Tere hi bande hain, koi bhi wo cheez nahi rok sakta jo Tu de, aur na wo cheez de sakta hai jo Tu roke, aur maal-daari kisi maal-daar shaks ko Tere muqaable mein koi faayda nahi de sakti.

e: Ibn Abbas reported: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) raised his head after bowing, he said: Allah! our Lord, to Thee be the praise that would fill the heavens and the earth and that which is between them, and that which will please Thee besides (them). Worthy art Thou of all praise and glory. No one can withhold what Thou givest, or give what Thou withholdest. And the greatness O! the great availeth not against Thee.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bataaya: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) jhukne ke baad apna sar uthaate, to wo kehte: Allah! Humaare Rab, Tujhe wo tareef ho jo aasmaanon aur zameen ko aur in dono ke darmiyaan ki cheezon ko bhar de, aur jo, in dono ke alaawa, Tujhe pasand ho. Tu tamaam tareef aur azmat ke laayak hai. Koi bhi wo cheez nahi rok sakta jo Tu de, ya wo cheez de sakta hai jo Tu roke. Aur kisi ki azmat, Aye Buzurg, Tere muqaable mein kuch kaam nahi aati.

e: Ibn Abbas reported from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) the words: " And that would fill that which will please Thee besides (them)!" and he did not mention the subsequent (portion of supplication).
hi: Ibn Abbas ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye alfaaz riwayat kiye: 'Aur wo bhar de jo in dono ke alaawa Tujhe pasand ho!' aur unhone dua ke baaki hisse ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) drew aside the curtain (of his apartment) and (he saw) people in rows (saying prayer) behind Aba Bakr. And he said: Nothing remains of the glad tidings of apostlehood, except good visions which a Muslim sees or someone is made to see for him. And see that I have been forbidden to recite the Qur'an in the state of bowing and prostration. So far as Ruk'u is concerned, extol in it the Great and Glorious Lord, and while prostrating yourselves be earnest in supplication, for it is fitting that your supplications should be answered.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne kamre ka parda hataaya aur unhone dekha logon ko Abu Bakr ke peeche safon mein namaz padhte hue. Unhone kaha: Nabuwwat ki khushkhabriyon mein se ab kuch nahi bacha, sivaay achhe khwaabon ke jo koi Musalman dekhta hai ya jo kisi ko dikhaaye jaate hain. Aur dekho, mujhe ruku aur sajde ki halat mein Quran padhne se mana kiya gaya hai. Jahan tak Ruku ka taalluq hai, ismein Buzurg aur Baa-Azmat Rab ki azmat bayan karo, aur sajda karte waqt dil se dua karo, kyunki iske qubool hone ki poori sambhaavna hai.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Abbas reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) drew aside the curtain and his head was bandaged on account of illness in which he died. He said: O Allah, have I not delivered (Thy Message)? (He repeated it) three times. Nothing has been left out of the glad tidings of apostlebood, but good vision. which a pious servant (of Allah) sees or someone else is made to see for him. He then narrated like the hadith transmitted by Sufyan.
hi: Abdullah bin Abbas ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne parda hataaya, aur us bimaari ki wajah se jismein unka intiqaal hua, unke sar par patti bandhi hui thi. Unhone kaha: Aye Allah, kya maine Tera paighaam pahuncha nahi diya? Unhone ye teen baar dohraaya. Nabuwwat ki khushkhabriyon mein se kuch nahi bacha sivaay achhe khwaabon ke jo koi nek banda dekhta hai ya jo kisi aur ko dikhaaye jaate hain. Phir unhone Sufyan ki riwayat ki gayi hadees jaisi hi riwayat ki.

e: 'Ali b. Abi Talib reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade me to recite (the Qur'an) in a state of bowing and prostration.
hi: Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe ruku aur sajde ki halat mein Quran padhne se mana kiya.

e: 'Ali b. Abi Talib reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade to recite the Qur'an, while I am in the state of bowing and prostration.
hi: Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe Quran padhne se mana kiya jab main ruku aur sajde ki halat mein hoon.

e: 'Ali b. Abi Talib reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade me from the recitation (of the Qur'an) in bowing and prostration and I do not say that he forbade you.
hi: Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe ruku aur sajde mein Quran ki tilaawat se mana kiya, aur main ye nahi kehta ki unhone tumhein mana kiya.

e: 'Ali reported: My loved one (the Holy Prophet) forbade me that I should recite (the Qur'an) in a state of bowing and prostration.
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne bataaya: Mere aziz (Nabi SAW) ne mujhe ruku aur sajde ki halat mein Quran padhne se mana kiya.

e: This hadith has been narrated by some other narrators, Ibn 'Abbas and others, and they all reported that 'Ali said: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) forbade me to recite the Qur'an while I am in a state of bowing and prostration, and in their narration (there is a mention of) forbiddance from that (recital) in the state of prostration as it has been transmitted by Zuhri, Zaid b. Aslam, al-Wahid b. Kathir, and Dawud b. Qais.
hi: Ye hadees kuch aur raawiyon, Ibn Abbas aur doosron, ne bhi riwayat ki hai, aur unhone sab ne bataaya ki Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe ruku aur sajde ki halat mein Quran padhne se mana kiya, aur unki riwayat mein sajde ki halat mein ismein se mumana'at ka zikr hai jaisa Zuhri, Zaid bin Aslam, al-Wahid bin Kathir, aur Dawud bin Qais ne riwayat kiya.

e: This hadith is transmitted on the authority of 'Ali, but he made no mention of" while in prostration".
hi: Ye hadees Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin unhone 'sajde mein' ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported: I was forbidden to recite (the Qur'an) while I was bowing, and there is no mention of 'Ali in the chain of transmitters.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bataaya: Mujhe jhukte waqt Quran padhne se mana kiya gaya, aur sanad mein Ali (Alayhis Salam) ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The nearest a servant comes to his Lord is when he is prostrating himself, so make supplication (in this state).
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Banda apne Rab ke sabse zyada kareeb tab hota hai jab wo sajde mein hota hai, is liye is halat mein dua karo.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to say while prostrating himself: O Lord, forgive me all my sins, small and great, first and last, open and secret.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) sajde ki halat mein ye kaha karte the: Aye Rab, mere sab gunah maaf kar de, chhote aur bade, pehle aur baad ke, zaahiri aur chhupe hue.

e: 'A'isha reported: The Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him') often said while bowing and prostrating himself:" Glory be to Thee, O Allah, our Lord, and praise be to Thee, O Allah, forgive me," thus complying with the (command in) the Qur'an.
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aksar ruku aur sajde ki halat mein kehte: 'Tu paak hai, Aye Allah, humaare Rab, aur tareef Tere hi liye hai, Aye Allah, mujhe maaf kar de,' Quran ke hukum ki peirvi karte hue.

e: 'A'isha reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) before his death recited often: Hallowed be Thou, and with Thy praise, I seek forgiveness from Thee and return to Thee. She reported: I said: Messenger of Allah, what are these words that I find you reciting? He said: There has been made a sign for me in my Ummah; when I saw that, I uttered them (these words of glorification for Allah), and the sign is:" When Allah's help and victory..... to the end of the surah.
hi: Aisha ne bataaya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apni wafat se pehle aksar ye padha karte the: Tu paak hai, aur Teri tareef ke saath, main Tujhse maghfirat maangta hoon aur Teri hi taraf laut kar aata hoon. Unhone bataaya: Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ye kaunse alfaaz hain jo main aapko padhte paati hoon? Unhone kaha: Meri Ummat mein mere liye ek nishaan muqarrar kiya gaya hai; jab maine use dekha, to maine ye alfaaz kahe, aur wo nishaan hai: 'Jab Allah ki madad aur fatah aaye'... Surah ke aakhir tak.

e: 'A'isha reported: Never did I, see the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) after the revelation (of these verses):" When Allah's help and victory came." observin- his prayer without making (this supplication) or he said in it (supplication): Hallowed be Thee, my Lord, and with Thy praise, O Allah, forgive me.
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Maine kabhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko in aayaton ke nazil hone ke baad: 'Jab Allah ki madad aur fatah aayi,' apni namaz ada karte hue nahi dekha bagair ye dua kiye, ya unhone kaha ismein dua: Tu paak hai, mere Rab, aur Teri tareef ke saath, Aye Allah, mujhe maaf kar de.

e: 'A'isha reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) recited often these words: Hallowed be Allah and with His praise, I seek the forgiveness of Allah and return to Him. She said: I asked: Messenger of Allah, I see that you often repeat the saying" subhan allahi bihamdihi astag firullahi watubuilaih" whereupon he said: My Lord informed me that I would soon see a sign in my Ummah, so when I see it I often recite (these) words: Hallowed be Allah and with His Praise, I seek forgiveness of Allah and return to Him. Indeed I saw it (when this verse) was revealed:" When Allah's help and victory came, it marked the victory of Mecca, and you see people entering into Allah's religion in troops, celebrate the praise of Thy Lord and ask His forgiveness. Surely He is ever returning to Mercy."
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aksar ye alfaaz padha karte the: Allah paak hai aur Uski tareef ke saath, main Allah se maghfirat maangta hoon aur Uski hi taraf laut kar aata hoon. Unhone kaha: Maine poocha: Allah ke Rasool, main dekhti hoon ki aap aksar 'Subhan Allahi bihamdihi astaghfirullaha wa atubu ilaih' dohraate hain, is par unhone kaha: Mere Rab ne mujhe bataaya ki main jald hi apni Ummat mein ek nishaan dekhunga, is liye jab main use dekhoon, to main aksar ye alfaaz padhta hoon: Allah paak hai aur Uski tareef ke saath, main Allah se maghfirat maangta hoon aur Uski hi taraf laut kar aata hoon. Beshak maine use dekha jab ye aayat nazil hui: 'Jab Allah ki madad aur fatah aayi,' ismein Makkah ki fatah ki nishaandehi thi, aur tum dekhte ho ki log Allah ke deen mein giroh-dar-giroh daakhil ho rahe hain, apne Rab ki tareef ki tasbeeh karo aur Usse maghfirat maango. Beshak Wo hamesha rehmat ki taraf laut ne wala hai.

e: Ibn Juraij reported: I asked 'Ata': What do you recite when you are in a state of bowing (in prayer)? He said:" Hallowed be Thou, and with Thy praise, there is no god but Thou." Son of Abd Mulaika narrated to me on the anthority of 'A'isha (who reported): I missed one night the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) (from his bed). I thought that he might have gone to one of his other wives. I searched for him and then came back and (found him) in a state of bowing, or prostration, saying: Hallowed be Thou and with Thy praise; there is no god but Thou. I said: With my father mayest thou be ransomed and with my mother. I was thinking of (another) affair, whereas you are (occupied) in another one.
hi: Ibn Juraij ne bataaya: Maine Ata se poocha: Namaz mein jhukte waqt aap kya padhte hain? Unhone kaha: 'Tu paak hai, aur Teri tareef ke saath, Tere siwa koi ma'bood nahi.' Abdul Mulaika ke bete ne mujhe Aisha se riwayat ki ki unhone kaha: Ek raat maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko unke bistar se gum paaya. Mujhe laga ki wo shaayad apni kisi aur biwi ke paas gaye honge. Maine unhein dhoondha aur phir wapas aayi aur unhein jhukte ya sajde ki halat mein paaya, ye kehte hue: Tu paak hai aur Teri tareef ke saath; Tere siwa koi ma'bood nahi. Maine kaha: Mere maa-baap aap par qurbaan hon, main ek aur maamle ke baare mein soch rahi thi, jabki aap ibaadat ke ek aur maamle mein masroof hain.

e: 'A'isha reported: One night I missed Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) from the bed, and when I sought him my hand touched the soles of his feet while he was in the state of prostration; they (feet) were raised and he was saying:" O Allah, I seek refuge in Thy pleasure from Thy anger, and in Thy forgiveness from Thy punishment, and I seek refuge in Thee from Thee (Thy anger). I cannot reckon Thy praise. Thou art as Thou hast lauded Thyself."
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Ek raat maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko bistar par na paaya, aur jab maine unhein dhoondha, to mera haath unke paanvon ke talwon se takraaya jabki wo sajde ki halat mein the; wo talwe uthe hue the aur wo keh rahe the: Aye Allah, main Teri naaraazgi se Teri raza mein panaah maangta hoon, aur Teri saza se Teri maghfirat mein, aur main Tujhse Teri hi panaah maangta hoon. Main Teri tareef ka poora hisaab nahi rakh sakta. Tu waisa hi hai jaisa Tune khud apni tareef ki hai.

e: 'A'isha reported that the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) used to pronounce while bowing and prostrating himself: All Glorious, All Holy, Lord of the Angels and the Spirit.
hi: Aisha ne bataaya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ruku aur sajde ki halat mein ye padha karte the: Sabse Zyada Jalaal Waala, Sabse Paak, Farishton aur Rooh ka Rab.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'A'isha by another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Aisha se ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ma'dan b. Talha reported: I met Thauban, the freed slave. of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and asked him to tell me about an act for which, if I do it, Allah will admit me to Paradise, or I asked about the act which was loved most by Allah. He gave no reply. I again asked and he gave no reply. I asked him for the third time, and he said: I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about that and he said: Make frequent prostrations before Allah, for you will not make one prostration without raising you a degree because of it, and removing a sin from you, because of it. Ma'dan said that then lie met Abu al-Darda' and when he asked him, he received a reply similar to that given by Thauban.
hi: Ma'dan bin Talha ne bataaya: Meri mulaqat Thauban, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke aazaad kiye gulaam, se hui aur maine unse ek aisa amal bataane ko kaha jise agar main karoon, to Allah mujhe Jannat mein daakhil kar de, ya maine poocha ki wo kaunsa amal hai jise Allah sabse zyada pasand karta hai. Unhone koi jawaab nahi diya. Maine dobara poocha aur unhone koi jawaab nahi diya. Maine unse teesri baar poocha, aur unhone kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye poocha tha aur unhone kaha tha: Allah ke saamne bar-bar sajda karo, kyunki tum koi bhi sajda nahi karoge jiske badle mein Allah tumhaara darja na buland kare aur tumhaare ek gunah ko na mita de. Ma'dan ne bataaya ki phir unki mulaqat Abu ad-Darda se hui aur jab unhone unse poocha, to unhein Thauban jaisa hi jawaab mila.

e: Rabi'a b. Ka'b said: I was with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) one night. and I brought him water and what he required. He said to me: Ask (anything you like). I said: I ask your company in Paradise. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Or anything else besides it. I said: That is all (what I require). He said: Then help me to achieve this for you by devoting yourself often to prostration.
hi: Rabi'a bin Ka'b ne bataaya: Main ek raat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath tha, aur main unke liye paani aur jo unhein zaroorat thi wo laaya. Unhone mujhse kaha: Maango jo bhi chaho. Maine kaha: Main Jannat mein aapki sohbat maangta hoon. Aap (SAW) ne kaha: Ya ismein iske alaawa kuch aur bhi? Maine kaha: Yehi hai jo main chaahta hoon. Aap (SAW) ne kaha: To sajde ki kasrat karke ismein mujhe apne aap ki madad karo.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) had been commanded that he should prostrate on the seven (bones) and he was forbidden to fold back the hair and clothing. And in the narration transmitted by Abu Rabi' (the words are):" on the seven bones and I was forbidden to fold back the hair and clothing". According to Abu'l-Rabi' (the seven bones are): The hands, the knees, and the (extremities) of the feet and the forehead.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko hukum diya gaya tha ki wo saat hadiyon par sajda karein, aur unhein baal aur kapde sametne se mana kiya gaya tha. Aur Abu Rabi ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: 'saat hadiyon par aur mujhe baal aur kapde sametne se mana kiya gaya.' Abu Rabi ke mutaabiq ye saat hadiyan hain: Haath, ghutne, aur paanvon ke agle hisse aur peshaani.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): I was commanded to prostrate myself on seven bones and not to fold back clothing or hair.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat ki: Mujhe saat hadiyon par sajda karne ka hukum diya gaya aur kapde ya baal na sametne ka.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had been commanded to prostrate on seven (bones) and forbidden to fold back hair and clothing.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko saat hadiyon par sajda karne ka hukum diya gaya tha aur baal aur kapde sametne se mana kiya gaya tha.

e: Ibn Abbas reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: I have been commanded to prostrate myself on seven bones:" forehead," and then pointed with his hand towards his nose, hands, feet, and the extremities of the feet; and we were forbidden to fold back clothing and hair.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bataaya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Mujhe saat hadiyon par sajda karne ka hukum diya gaya hai: peshaani, aur phir apne haath se apni naak, haath, paanv, aur paanvon ke agle hisson ki taraf ishaara kiya; aur humein baal aur kapde sametne se mana kiya gaya tha.

e: Ibn Abbas reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: I was commanded to prostrate myself on the seven (bones) and forbidden to fold back hair and clothing. (The seven bones are): forehead, nose, hands, knees and feet.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Mujhe saat hadiyon par sajda karne ka hukum diya gaya aur baal aur kapde sametne se mana kiya gaya. Saat hadiyan ye hain: peshaani, naak, haath, ghutne aur paanv.

e: It was narrated from Al-'Abbas bin 'Abdul Muttalib that he heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: "When a person prostates, he prostates on seven part of the body: His face, his hands, his knees and his feet."
hi: Al-Abbas bin Abdul-Muttalib se riwayat hai ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab koi shaks sajda karta hai, to wo jism ke saat hisson par sajda karta hai: Uska chehra, uske haath, uske ghutne aur uske paanv.

e: Abdullah b. Abbas reported that he saw 'Abdullah b. al-Harith observing the prayer and (his hair) was plaited behind his head. He ('Abdullah b. 'Abbas) stood up and unfolded them. While going back (from the prayer) he met Ibn 'Abbas and said to him: Why is it that you touched my head? He (Ibn 'Abbas) replied: (The man who observes prayer with plaited hair) is like one who prays with his hands tied behind.
hi: Abdullah bin Abbas ne bataaya ki unhone Abdullah bin al-Harith ko namaz padhte dekha aur unke baal unke sar ke peeche gunthe hue the. Wo khade hue aur unhein khol diya. Wapas jaate hue namaz se unhone Ibn Abbas se mulaqaat ki aur unse kaha: Aap ne mera sar kyun chhua? Unhone jawaab diya: Jo shaks gunthe hue baalon ke saath namaz padhta hai wo us shaks jaisa hai jo apne haath peeth ke peeche bandhe hue namaz padhta hai.

e: Anas reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Observe moderation in prostration, and let none of you stretch out his forearms (on the ground) like a dog.
hi: Anas ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Sajde mein maiyaari rakho, aur tum mein se koi apni baazuein kutte ki tarah zameen par na phailaaye.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters. And in the hidith transmitted by Ibn Ja'far (the words are): " None of you should stretch out his forearms like the stretching out of a dog."
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ne usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai. Aur Ibn Ja'far ki riwayat ki gayi hadees mein alfaaz hain: 'Tum mein se koi apni baazuein kutte ke phailaane ki tarah na phailaaye.'

e: Al-Bira' (b. 'Azib) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said. When you prostrate yourself, place the palms of your hands on the ground and raise your elbows.
hi: Al-Bara, bin Aazib, ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab tum sajda karo, to apni hatheliyaan zameen par rakho aur apni kohniyaan oopar uthaao.

e: 'Abdullah b. Malik ibn Bujainah reported: When the Prophet (ﷺ) prostrated, lie spread out his arms so that the whiteness of his armpits was visible.
hi: Abdullah bin Malik ibn Bujainah ne bataaya: Jab Nabi (SAW) sajda karte, to wo apni baazuein itni phailaate ki unki bagalon ki safedi nazar aane lagti.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Ja'far b. Rabi' with the same chain of transmitters. And in the narration transmitted by 'Amr b. al-Harith (the words are): " When the Messenger of Allah (rtiay peace be upon him) prostrated, he spread out his arms so that the whiteness of his armpits was visible." And in the narration transmitted by al-Laith (the words are:" When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prostrated. he spread his hands from the armpits so that I saw their whiteness."
hi: Ye hadees Ja'far bin Rabi ne usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai. Aur Amr bin al-Harith ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: 'Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) sajda karte, to wo apni baazuein itni phailaate ki unki bagalon ki safedi nazar aane lagti.' Aur al-Laith ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: 'Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) sajda karte, to wo apne haath bagalon se itna phailaate ki main unki safedi dekhta.'

e: Maimuna reported: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prostrated himself, if a lamb wanted to pass between his arms, it could pass.
hi: Maimuna ne bataaya: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) sajda karte, agar koi bhed ka bachcha unki baazuon ke beech se guzarna chaahta, to wo guzar sakta tha.

e: Maimuna, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), reported: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prostrated himself, he spread his arms, i. e. he separated them so much that the whiteness of his armpits became visible from behind and when he sat (for Jalsa) he rested on his left thigh.
hi: Maimuna, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki biwi, ne bataaya: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) sajda karte, to wo apni baazuein phailaate, yaani unhein itna alag rakhte ki unki bagalon ki safedi peeche se bhi nazar aati, aur jab wo Jalsa ke liye baithte, to wo apni baayin jaangh par tekiya lagaate.

e: Maimuna daughter of Harith reported: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prostrated, he kept his hands so much apart from each other that when it was seen from behind the armpits became visible. Waki' said: That is their whiteness.
hi: Maimuna, al-Harith ki beti, ne bataaya: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) sajda karte, to wo apne haathon ko itna alag rakhte ki jab peeche se dekha jaata to bagalein nazar aati thin. Waki ne kaha: Yaani unki safedi.

e: 'A'isha reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to begin prayer with takbir (saying Allahu Akbar) and the recitation: "Praise be to Allah, the Lord of the Universe." When he bowed he neither kept his head up nor bent it down, but kept it between these extremes; when he raised his head after bowing he did not prostrate himself till he had stood erect; when he raised his head after prostration he did not prostrate himself again till he sat up. At the end of every two rak'ahs he recited the tahiyya; and he used to place his left foot flat (on the ground) and raise up the right; he prohibited the devil's way of sitting on the heels, and he forbade people to spread out their arms like a wild beast. And he used to finish the prayer with the taslim.
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) namaz ki shuruaat Takbeer, Allahu Akbar kehte hue, aur tilaawat 'Sab tareef Allah ke liye hai, jo saari duniyaon ka Rab hai' se karte the. Jab wo jhukte, to wo na apna sar oopar rakhte na neeche jhukaate, balki in dono ke beech rakhte; jab wo jhukne ke baad apna sar uthaate, to wo sajda mein tab tak nahi jaate jab tak wo poori tarah seedhe khade na ho jaate; jab wo sajde ke baad apna sar uthaate, to wo dobara sajda mein tab tak nahi jaate jab tak wo baith na jaate. Har do rak'aaton ke baad wo Tahiyya padhte; aur wo apna baayaan paanv zameen par chapta rakhte aur daayaan paanv khada rakhte; unhone Shaitan ki tarah aediyon par baithne se mana kiya, aur unhone logon ko apni baazuein jangli jaanwar ki tarah phailaane se mana kiya. Aur wo taslim ke saath namaz mukammal karte.

e: Musa b. Talha reported it on the authority of his father: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When one of you places in front of him so me. thing such as the back of a saddle, he should pray without caring who passes on the other side of it.
hi: Musa bin Talha ne apne waalid ki sanad se riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab tum mein se koi apne saamne koi cheez rakh de, jaise zeen ka peechla hissa, to use is baat ki parwaah kiye bagair namaz padhni chaahiye ki uske doosri taraf se kaun guzarta hai.

e: Musa b. Talha reported on the authority of his father: We used to say prayer and the animals moved in front of us. We mentioned it to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he said: If anything equal to the back of a saddle is in front of you, then what walks in front, no harm would come to him. Ibn Numair said: No harm would come whosoever walks in front.
hi: Musa bin Talha ne apne waalid ki sanad se riwayat ki: Hum namaz padha karte the aur jaanwar humaare saamne se guzarte the. Humne iska zikr Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kiya aur unhone kaha: Agar zeen ke peechle hisse jitni koi cheez tumhaare saamne ho, to phir jo bhi uske aage chalta hai, use koi nuqsaan nahi hoga. Ibn Numair ne kaha: Jo bhi aage chale, use koi nuqsaan nahi hoga.

e: 'A'isha reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was asked about sutra of a worshipper; he said: Equal to the back of the saddle.
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se namaz padhne waale ke sutre ke baare mein poocha gaya; unhone kaha: Zeen ke peechle hisse ke barabar.

e: 'A'isha reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was asked in the expedition of Tabuk about the sutra the worshipper; he said: Like the back of the saddle.
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se Tabuk ke safar mein namaz padhne waale ke sutre ke baare mein poocha gaya; unhone kaha: Zeen ke peechle hisse jaisa.

e: Ibn Umar reported: When the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) went out on the 'Id day, he ordered to carry a spear-and it was fixed in front of him, and he said prayer towards its (direction), and the people were behind him. And he did it in the journey, and that is the reason why the Amirs carried it.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bataaya: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Eid ke din bahar nikalte, to wo ek nezaa le jaane ka hukum dete aur use apne saamne gaad diya jaata, aur wo iski taraf mooh karke namaz padhte, aur log unke peeche hote. Aur wo safar mein bhi aisa hi karte the, aur isi wajah se Ameer log ise saath le jaya karte the.

e: Ibn Umar reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) set up (sutra), and Abu Bakr said: He implanted iron-tipped spear and said prayer towards its direction. Ibn Abu Shaiba made this addition to it:" Ubaidullah said that it was a spear."
hi: Ibn Umar ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne sutra qaayam kiya, aur Abu Bakr ne kaha: Unhone lohe ki nok waala nezaa gaada aur uski taraf mooh karke namaz padhi. Ibn Abu Shaiba ne ismein ye izafa kiya: 'Ubaidullah ne kaha ki ye ek nezaa tha.'

e: Ibn 'Umar said: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) used to place his camel (towards the Ka'ba) and said prayer in its direction.
hi: Ibn Umar ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apne oont ko Ka'ba ki taraf rakhte aur uski taraf mooh karke namaz padha karte the.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) used to say prayer towards his camel. Ibn Numair said: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) said prayer towards the camel.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apne oont ki taraf mooh karke namaz padha karte the. Ibn Numair ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne oont ki taraf mooh karke namaz padhi.

e: Abu Juhaifa reported it on the authority of his father: I came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in Mecca and he was (at that time) at al- Abtah in a red leather tent. And Bilal stepped out with ablution water for him. (And what was left out of that water) some of them got it (whereas others could not get it) and (those who got it) rubbed themselves with it. Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stepped out with a red mantle on him and I was catching a glimpse of the whiteness of his shanks. The narrator said: He (the Holy Prophet) performed the ablution. and Bilal pronounced Adhan and I followed his mouth (as he turned) this side and that as he said on the right and the left:" Come to prayer, come to success." ' A spear was then fixed for him (on the ground). He stepped forward and said two rak'ahs of Zuhr, while there passed in front of him a donkey and a dog, and these were not checked. He then said two rak'ahs of the 'Asr prayer, and he then continued saying two rak'ahs till he came back to Medina.
hi: Abu Juhaifa ne apne waalid ki sanad se riwayat ki: Main Makkah mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaya aur wo us waqt al-Abtah mein ek laal chamde ke khaime mein the. Aur Bilal wuzu ke paani ke saath bahar nikle. Aur jo us paani mein se bacha, kuch logon ko wo mila, jabki doosron ko nahi mila, aur jinhein mila unhone khud par mala. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek laal chaadar odhe bahar aaye aur main unki pindliyon ki safedi dekh raha tha. Raawi ne kaha: Unhone wuzu kiya, aur Bilal ne Azaan di aur main unke munh ki harkat ki peirvi kar raha tha jab wo daayin aur baayin taraf modte hue kehte: 'Namaz ki taraf aao, kaamyaabi ki taraf aao.' Phir unke liye ek nezaa gaada gaya. Wo aage badhe aur Zuhr ki do rak'aaten padhi, jabki unke saamne ek gadha aur ek kutta guzre, aur unhein roka nahi gaya. Phir unhone Asr ki namaz ki do rak'aaten padhi, aur phir do-do rak'aaten padhte rahe yahan tak ki wo Madina wapas aaye.

e: Abu Juhaifa reported on the authority of his father: I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) (in Mecca at al-Abtah) in a red leather tent. and I saw Bilal take the ablution water (left by Allah's Messenger), and I saw the people racing, with one another to get that ablution water. If anyone got some of it, he rubbed himself with it, and anyone who did not get any got some of the moisture from his companion's hand. I then saw Bilal take a staff and fix it in the ground, after which the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came out quickly in a red mantle and led the people in two rak'ahs facing the staff, and I saw people and animals passing in front of the staff.
hi: Abu Juhaifa ne apne waalid ki sanad se riwayat ki: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Makkah mein al-Abtah mein ek laal chamde ke khaime mein dekha. Aur maine Bilal ko wuzu ka paani, jo Allah ke Rasool ne chhoda tha, uthaate dekha, aur maine logon ko us wuzu ke paani ke liye ek doosre se aage nikalne ki daud lagaate dekha. Agar kisi ko usmein se kuch mil jaata, to wo khud par mal leta, aur jise kuch nahi milta, use apne saathi ke haath ki namee mil jaati. Phir maine Bilal ko ek chhadi lete aur use zameen mein gaadte dekha, jiske baad Allah ke Rasool (SAW) jaldi se ek laal chaadar mein bahar aaye aur logon ki us chhadi ki taraf mooh karke do rak'aaton mein imaamat ki, aur maine logon aur jaanwaron ko us chhadi ke saamne se guzarte dekha.

e: 'Aun b. Abu Juhaifa narrated from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the authority of his father a hadith like that of Sufyan, and 'Umar b. Abu Za'ida made this addition: Some of them tried to excel the others (in obtaining water), and in the hadith transmitted by Malik b. Mighwal (the words are): When it was noon, Bilal came out and summoned (people) to (noon) prayer.
hi: Aun bin Abu Juhaifa ne apne waalid ki sanad se, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se, ek hadees riwayat ki jaisi Sufyan ki hai, aur Umar bin Abu Zaida ne ismein ye izafa kiya: Unmein se kuch logon ne doosron se aage nikalne ki koshish ki, aur Malik bin Mighwal ki riwayat ki gayi hadees mein alfaaz hain: 'Jab dopahar ho gayi, to Bilal bahar aaye aur Zuhr ki namaz ke liye bulaaya.'

e: Abu Juhaifa reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went at noon towards al-Batha', he performed ablution, and said two rak'ahs of the Zuhr prayer and two of the 'Asr prayer, and there was a spear in front of him. Shu'ba said and Aun made this addition to it on the authority of his father Abu Juhaifa: And the woman and the donkey passed behind it.
hi: Abu Juhaifa ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) dopahar ke waqt al-Batha ki taraf gaye, unhone wuzu kiya, aur Zuhr ki do rak'aaten aur Asr ki do rak'aaten padhi, aur unke saamne ek nezaa tha. Shu'ba ne kaha aur Aun ne apne waalid Abu Juhaifa ki sanad se ye izafa kiya: Aur ek aurat aur ek gadha uske peeche se guzre.

e: Shu'ba narrated the same on the basis of two authorities and in the hadith transmitted by Hakam (the words are): The people began to get water that was left out of his (the Prophet's) ablution.
hi: Shu'ba ne ye do sanadon ke bunyad par riwayat ki hai aur Hakam ki riwayat ki gayi hadees mein alfaaz hain: Log unke wuzu se bache hue paani ko lene lage.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported: I came riding on a she-ass, and I was on the threshold of maturity, and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was leading people in prayer at Mina. I passed in front of the row and got down, and sent the she-ass for grazing and joined the row, and nobody made any objection to it.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bataaya: Main ek gadhi par sawaar hokar aaya, aur main balig hone ke qareeb tha, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Mina mein logon ki namaz ki imaamat kar rahe the. Main saf ke saamne se guzra aur utar gaya, aur gadhi ko charne ke liye chhod diya, aur saf mein shaamil ho gaya, aur kisi ne bhi is par koi aitraaz nahi kiya.

e: Abdullah b. Abbas reported that he came riding on a donkey, and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was leading the people in prayer at Mina on the occasion of the Farewell Pilgrimage and (the narrator) reported: The donkey passed in front of the row and then he got down from it And joined the row along with the people.
hi: Abdullah bin Abbas ne bataaya ki wo ek gadhe par sawaar hokar aaya, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Hajjatul-Wida ke mauqe par Mina mein logon ki namaz ki imaamat kar rahe the aur bataaya: Gadha saf ke saamne se guzra, aur phir wo Ibn Abbas usse utar gaye aur logon ke saath saf mein shaamil ho gaye.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Ibn 'Uyaina on the authority of al-Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters and he reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) was leading prayer at 'Arafa.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Uyaina ne Zuhri ki sanad se usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai aur unhone bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Arafa mein namaz ki imaamat kar rahe the.

e: This hadith has been reported by Ma'mar on the authority of al-Zuhri with the came chain of transmitters, but here no mention has been made of Mina or 'Arafa, and he said: It was in the Farewell Pilgrimage or on the Day of Victory.
hi: Ye hadees Ma'mar ne Zuhri ki sanad se usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai, lekin ismein Mina ya Arafa ka koi zikr nahi hai, aur unhone kaha: Ye Hajjatul-Wida ke mauqe par ya Fatah ke din tha.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When any one of you prays he should not let anyone pass in front of him (if there is no sutra), and should try to turn him away as far as possible, but if he refuses to go, he should turn him away forcibly for he is a devil.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne bataaya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab tum mein se koi namaz padhe, to use kisi ko apne saamne se guzarne nahi dena chaahiye, agar saamne koi sutra na ho, aur use jahan tak ho sake use rokne ki koshish karni chahiye, lekin agar wo guzarne wala jaane se inkaar kare, to use zabardasti roka jaana chaahiye, kyunki wo ek Shaitan hai.

e: Abu Salih al-Samman reported: I narrate to you what I heard and saw from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri: One day I was with Abu Sa'id and he was saying prayer on Friday turning to a thing which concealed him from the people when a young man from Banu Mu'ait came there and he tried to pass in front of him; he turned him back by striking his chest. He looked about but finding no other way to pass except in front of Abu Sa'id, made a second attempt. He (Abu Sa'id) turned him away by Striking his chest more vigorously than the first stroke. He stood up and had a scuffle with Abu Sa'id. Then the people gathered there He came out and went to Marwan and complained to him what had happened to him. Abu Sa'id too came to Marwan. Marwin said to him: What has happened to you and the son of your brother that he came to complain against you? Abu Sa'id said: I heard from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: When any one of you prays facing something which conceals him from people and anyone tries to pass in front of him, he should be turned away, but if he refuses, he should be forcibly restrained from it, for he is a devil.
hi: Abu Salih al-Samman ne bataaya: Main tumhein wo bataata hoon jo maine Abu Sa'id al-Khudri se suna aur dekha: Ek din main Abu Sa'id ke saath tha aur wo Jumme ke din namaz padh rahe the, aisi cheez ki taraf mudkar jo unhein logon se chhupaati thi, jab Banu Mu'ait ka ek jawaan shaks wahan aaya aur usne unke saamne se guzarne ki koshish ki; unhone uske seene par maarkar use peeche kar diya. Usne aage dekha lekin Abu Sa'id ke saamne se guzarne ke alaawa koi aur raasta na paakar, dobara koshish ki. Unhone use pehli baar se zyada zor se seene par maarkar hataa diya. Wo khada hua aur Abu Sa'id se jhagda kiya. Phir wahan log jama ho gaye. Wo bahar nikla aur Marwan ke paas gaya aur unse shikaayat ki ki uske saath kya hua. Abu Sa'id bhi Marwan ke paas aaye. Marwan ne unse kaha: Tumhaare aur tumhaare bhatije ke beech kya hua ki wo tumhaari shikaayat karne aaya? Abu Sa'id ne kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab tum mein se koi kisi aisi cheez ki taraf mudkar namaz padhe jo use logon se chhupaati ho aur koi uske saamne se guzarne ki koshish kare, to use hataa dena chaahiye, lekin agar wo inkaar kare, to use zabardasti roka jaana chaahiye, kyunki wo ek Shaitan hai.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Umar reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When any one of you prays, he should not allow anyone to pass before him, and if he refuses, he should be then forcibly resisted, for there is a devil with him.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar ne bataaya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab tum mein se koi namaz padhe, to use kisi ko apne saamne se guzarne nahi dena chaahiye, aur agar wo inkaar kare, to use zabardasti roka jaana chaahiye, kyunki uske saath ek Shaitan hota hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Ibn Umar by another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Umar ne ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki hai.

e: Busr b Sa'id reported that Zaid b Khalid al-Juhani sent him to Abu Juhaim in order to ask him what he had heard from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) with regard to the passer in front of the worshipper. Abu Juhaim reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: If anyone who passes in front of a man who is praying knew the responsibility he incurs, he would stand still forty (years) rather than to pass in front of him Abu Nadr said: I do not know whether he said forty days or months or years.
hi: Busr bin Sa'id ne bataaya ki Zaid bin Khalid al-Juhani ne unhein Abu Juhaim ke paas ye poochhne bheja ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se namaz padhne waale ke saamne se guzarne waale ke baare mein kya suna hai. Abu Juhaim ne bataaya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Agar koi shaks, jo kisi namaz padhne waale ke saamne se guzarta hai, use ye pata hota ki iski kya zimmedaari hai, to wo saamne se guzarne ke bajaaye chaalis (40) tak wahin khada rehna behtar samajhta. Abu Nadr ne kaha: Mujhe nahi pata ki unhone chaalis din kaha, ya mahine, ya saal.

e: This hadith has been narrated from Abu Juhaim Ansari by another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Juhaim Ansari se ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Sahl b. Sa'd al-Si'idi reported: Between the place of worship where the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prayed and the wall, there was a gap through which a goat could pass.
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd al-Sa'idi ne bataaya: Us jagah ke beech jahan Allah ke Rasool (SAW) namaz padhte the aur deewaar ke beech, itni jagah thi ki ek bakri guzar sakti thi.

e: Salama b. Akwa' reported: He sought the place (in the mosque) where the copies of the Qur'an were kept and glorified Allah there, and the narrator made a mention that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sought that place and that was between the pulpit and the qibla-a place where a goat could pass.
hi: Salama bin Akwa ne bataaya: Unhone us jagah ki talaash ki jahan Quran ki kaapiyaan rakhi jaati thi aur wahan Allah ki tasbeeh ki, aur raawi ne zikr kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne us jagah ki talaash ki, aur wo mimbar aur Qibla ke darmiyaan ek jagah thi, jahan se ek bakri guzar sakti thi.

e: Yazid reported: Salama sought to say prayer near the pillar which was by that place where copies of the Qur'an were kept. I said to him: Abu Muslim. I see you striving to offer your prayer by this pillar. He said: I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) seeking to pray by its side.
hi: Yazid ne bataaya: Salama us satoon ke paas namaz padhne ki koshish karte the jo us jagah ke paas tha jahan Quran ki kaapiyaan rakhi jaati thi. Maine unse kaha: Abu Muslim, main dekh raha hoon ki aap is satoon ke paas namaz padhne ki koshish karte hain. Unhone kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko iske paas namaz padhne ki koshish karte dekha.

e: Abu Dharr reported: The Messenger of 'Allah (ﷺ) said: When any one of you stands for prayer and there is a thing before him equal to the back of the saddle that covers him and in case there is not before him (a thing) equal to the back of the saddle, his prayer would be cut off by (passing of an) ass, woman, and black Dog. I said: O Abu Dharr, what feature is there in a black dog which distinguish it from the red dog and the yellow dog? He said: O, son of my brother, I asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as you are asking me, and he said: The black dog is a devil.
hi: Abu Dharr ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab tum mein se koi namaz ke liye khada ho aur uske saamne kaathi ke pichhle hisse jitni koi cheez ho jo use dhaanpe, to koi baat nahi, lekin agar uske saamne kaathi ke pichhle hisse jitni koi cheez na ho, to uski namaz gadha, aurat, aur kaale kutte ke guzarne se toot jaayegi. Maine kaha: Aye Abu Dharr, kaale kutte mein aisi kya khaas baat hai jo use laal kutte aur peele kutte se alag karti hai? Unhone kaha: Aye mere bhatije, maine bhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se yehi sawaal poocha tha jo tum mujhse poochh rahe ho, aur unhone farmaya: Kaala kutta Shaitan hai.

e: This hadith has been transmitted by Humaid b. Hilal on the authority of Yunus.
hi: Ye hadees Humaid bin Hilal ne Yunus ki sanad se riwayat ki hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: A woman, an ass and a dog disrupt the prayer, but something like the back of a saddle guards against that.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Ek aurat, ek gadha aur ek kutta namaz mein khalal daalte hain, lekin kaathi ke pichhle hisse jaisi koi cheez uske khilaaf hifaazat karti hai.

e: 'A'isha reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to pray at night while I lay interposed between him and the Qibla like a corpse on the bier.
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Nabi (SAW) raat mein namaz padha karte the jabki main unke aur Qibla ke beech laash ki tarah leti hoti thi.

e: 'A'isha reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) said his whole prayer (Tahajjud prayer) during the night while I lay between him and the Qibla. When he intended to say Witr (prayer) he awakened me and I too said witr (prayer).
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) raat mein apni poori Tahajjud namaz padha karte the jabki main unke aur Qibla ke beech leti hoti thi. Jab wo Witr padhne ka iraada karte, to mujhe jagaate aur main bhi Witr padh leti.

e: 'Urwa b. Zubair reported: 'A'isha asked: What disrupts the prayer? We said: The woman and the ass. Upon this she remarked: Is the woman an ugly animal? I lay in front of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) like the bier of a corpse and he said prayer.
hi: Urwah bin Zubair ne bataaya: Aisha se poocha gaya: Namaz mein khalal kya cheez daalti hai? Humne kaha: Aurat aur gadha. Is par unhone kaha: Kya aurat koi badsoorat jaanwar hai? Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saamne laash ki tarah leti hoti thi aur wo namaz padha karte the.

e: Masruq reported: It was mentioned before'A'isha that prayer is invalidated (in case of passing) of a dog, an ass and a woman (before the worshipper, when he is not screened). Upon this 'A'isha said: You likened us to the asses and the dogs. By Allah I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying prayer while I lay on the bedstead interposing between him and the Qibla. When I felt the need, I did not like to wit to front (of the Holy Prophet) and perturb the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and quietly moved out from under its (i. e. of the bedstead) legs.
hi: Masruq ne bataaya: Aisha ke saamne ye zikr hua ki namaz guzarne se toot jaati hai jab kutte, gadhe aur aurat namaz padhne wale ke saamne guzrein, jab wo pardaadaar na ho. Is par Aisha ne kaha: Tumne humein gadhon aur kutton ke barabar kar diya. Allah ki qasam, maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko namaz padhte dekha hai jabki main takht par leti hoti thi, unke aur Qibla ke darmiyaan. Jab mujhe zaroorat mehsoos hoti, to mujhe unke saamne baithna pasand nahi tha aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko pareshaan karna pasand nahi tha, is liye main chupke se uski takht ki taango se nikal jaati thi.

e: Al-Aswad reported that 'A'isha said: You have made us equal to the dogs and the asses, whereas I lay on the bedstead and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came there and stood in the middle of the bedstead and said prayer. I did not like to take off the quilt from me (in that state), so I moved away quietly from the front legs of the bedstead and thus came out of the quilt.
hi: Al-Aswad ne bataaya ki Aisha ne kaha: Tumne humein kutton aur gadhon ke barabar bana diya, jabki main takht par leti hoti thi aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) wahan aate aur takht ke beechon-beech khade hokar namaz padhte the. Mujhe us halat mein apne oopar se razaai hataana pasand nahi tha, is liye main chupke se takht ke agle paaayon se hat jaati thi aur is tarah razaai se bahar aa jaati thi.

e: 'A'isha reported: I was sleeping in front of the Mcsseinger ef Allah (ﷺ) with my legs between him and the Qibla. When he prostrated himself he pinched me and I drew up my legs, and when be stood up, I stretched them out. She said: At that time there were no lamps in the houses.
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saamne apni taangon ko unke aur Qibla ke beech rakhkar soti thi. Jab wo sajda karte, to wo mujhe chikoti kaatte aur main apni taangein samet leti, aur jab wo khade hote, to main unhein phaila deti. Unhone kaha: Us waqt gharon mein diye nahi hote the.

e: Maimuna, the wife of the Apostle (ﷺ), reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said prayer and I (lay) opposite to him while I was in menses. Sometimes his clothes touched me when he prostrated.
hi: Maimuna, Rasool (SAW) ki biwi, ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne namaz padhi aur main unke saamne thi jabki main haiz mein thi. Kabhi-kabhi unke kapde mujhse chhoo jaate jab wo sajda karte.

e: 'A'isha reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) said prayer at night and I was by his side in a state of meanses and I had a sheet pulled over me a portion of which was on his side.
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne raat mein namaz padhi aur main unke bagal mein thi, haiz ki halat mein, aur mere oopar ek chaadar khinchi hui thi jiska ek hissa unki taraf bhi tha.

e: Abu Huraira reported: An inquirer asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about the prayer in a single garment. He (the Holy Prophet) add: Has everyone of you two garments?
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Ek poochne waale ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ek hi kapde mein namaz padhne ke baare mein poocha. Unhone jawaab diya: Kya tum mein se har ek ke paas do kapde hain?

e: A hadith like this has been narrated by Abu Huraira with another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye jaisi ek hadees Abu Huraira ne ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: A person addressed the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said to him: Can any one of us say prayer in one garment? He said: Do all of you possess two garments?
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Ek shaks ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se mukhaatib hokar unse kaha: Kya hum mein se koi ek hi kapde mein namaz padh sakta hai? Unhone kaha: Kya tum sab ke paas do-do kapde hain?

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: None of you must pray in a single garment of which no part comes over his shoulders.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Tum mein se koi bhi ek aise kapde mein namaz na padhe jiska koi hissa uske kandhon par na aata ho.

e: Umar b. Abu Salama reported: I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) praying in Umm Salama's house in a single garment, placing its two ends over his shoulders.
hi: Umar bin Abu Salama ne bataaya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Umm Salama ke ghar mein ek hi kapde mein namaz padhte dekha, uske dono sire apne kandhon par rakhe hue.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Hisham b. 'Urwa with the same chain of transmitters except (with this difference) that the word mutawashshihan was used and not the word mushtamilan.
hi: Ye hadees Hisham bin Urwah ne usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai, sivaay iske ki is riwayat mein lafz 'mutawashshihan' istemaal hua hai, na ki 'mushtamilan.'

e: 'Umar b. Abu Salama reported: I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying prayer in the house of Umm Salama in a single garment with its extremities crossing each other.
hi: Umar bin Abu Salama ne bataaya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Umm Salama ke ghar mein ek hi kapde mein namaz padhte dekha, jiske sire ek doosre ko paar kar rahe the.

e: Umar b. Abu Salama reported: I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) praying in a single garment with its ends crossing each other. 'Isa b. Hammad added:" placing on his shoulders".
hi: Umar bin Abu Salama ne bataaya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ek hi kapde mein namaz padhte dekha, jiske sire ek doosre ko paar kar rahe the. Isa bin Hammad ne izafa kiya: 'apne kandhon par rakhte hue.'

e: Jabir reported: I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) praying in a single garment crossing the two ends.
hi: Jabir ne bataaya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ek hi kapde mein namaz padhte dekha, dono sire ek doosre ko paar karte hue.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Sufyan with the same chain of transmitters and in the hadith transmitted by Numair the words are: I called upon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)."
hi: Ye hadees Sufyan ne usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai aur Numair ki riwayat ki gayi hadees mein alfaaz hain: 'Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaya.'

e: Abu Zubair reported that he saw Jabir b. 'Abdullah praying in a single garment crossing Its ends even though he had the garments, and Jabir said: He saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) doing like this.
hi: Abu Zubair ne bataaya ki unhone Jabir bin Abdullah ko ek hi kapde mein namaz padhte dekha, jiske sire ek doosre ko paar kar rahe the, halaanki unke paas aur kapde the, aur Jabir ne kaha: Unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko isi tarah karte dekha tha.

e: Abu Sa'id al Khudri reported: I visited the Apostle (ﷺ) and saw him praying on a reed mat on which he was prostrating himself. And I saw him praying in a single garment with ends crossed with each other.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne bataaya: Main Rasool (SAW) se milne gaya aur unhein ek chatai par namaz padhte dekha jispar wo sajda kar rahe the. Aur maine unhein ek hi kapde mein namaz padhte dekha, jiske sire ek doosre ko paar kar rahe the.

e: This hadith has been narrated by A'mash with the came chain of transmitters, and in the narration of Abu Karaib the words are: " Placing its (mantle's) ends on his shoulders" ; and the narration transmitted by Abu Bakr and Suwaid (the words are):" the ends crossing with each other".
hi: Ye hadees A'mash ne usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai, aur Abu Kuraib ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: 'Chaadar ke sire apne kandhon par rakhte hue'; aur Abu Bakr aur Suwaid ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: 'sire ek doosre ko paar karte hue.'

e: Abu Dharr reported: I said: Messenger of Allah, which mosque was set up first on the earth? He said: Al-Masjid al-Haram (the sacred). I (again) said: Then which next? He said: It was the Masjid Aqsa. I (again) said: How long the space of time (between their setting up)? He (the Holy Prophet) said: It was forty years. And whenever the time comes for prayer, pray there, for that is a mosque; and in the hadith transmitted by Abu Kamil (the words are):" Whenever time comes for prayer, pray, for that is a mosque (for you)."
hi: Abu Dharr ne bataaya: Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, sabse pehle kaunsi masjid zameen par banayi gayi? Unhone kaha: Al-Masjid al-Haram. Maine phir kaha: Uske baad kaunsi? Unhone kaha: Wo Masjid Aqsa thi. Maine phir poocha: In dono ke darmiyaan kitna waqt guzara? Unhone farmaya: Chaalis (40) saal. Aur jab bhi namaz ka waqt aaye, wahin namaz padho, kyunki wo poori zameen ek masjid hai; aur Abu Kamil ki riwayat ki gayi hadees mein alfaaz hain: 'Jab bhi namaz ka waqt aaye, namaz padho, kyunki wo tumhaare liye ek masjid hai.'

e: Ibrahim b. Yazid al-Tayml reported: I used to read the Qur'an with my father in the vestibule (before the door of the mosque). When I recited the ayat (verses) concerning prostration, he prostrated himself. I said to him: Father, do you prostrate yourself in the path? He said: I heard Abu Dharr saying: I asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about the mosque that was first set up on the earth. He said: Masjid Harim. I said: Then which next? He said: The Masjid al-Aqsa. I said: How long is the space of time between the two? He said: Forty years. He (then) further said: The earth is a mosque for you, so wherever you are at the time of prayer, pray there.
hi: Ibrahim bin Yazid al-Taymi ne bataaya: Main apne waalid ke saath dahleez mein, masjid ke darwaze ke saamne, Quran padha karta tha. Jab maine sajde waali aayat ki tilaawat ki, to unhone sajda kiya. Maine unse kaha: Waalid saahab, kya aap raaste mein sajda karte hain? Unhone kaha: Maine Abu Dharr ko ye kehte suna: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se us masjid ke baare mein poocha jo sabse pehle zameen par banayi gayi thi. Unhone kaha: Masjid al-Haram. Maine kaha: Uske baad kaunsi? Unhone kaha: Al-Masjid al-Aqsa. Maine poocha: In dono ke darmiyaan kitna waqt hai? Unhone kaha: Chaalis saal. Unhone phir aage kaha: Zameen tumhaare liye ek masjid hai, is liye jahan bhi tum ho, namaz ke waqt, wahin namaz padho.

e: Jabir b.
