'Abdullah al-Ansari reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: I have been conferred upon five (things) which were not granted to anyone before me (and these are): Every apostle wassent particularly to his own people, whereas I have been sent to all the red and the black the spoils of war have been made lawful for me, and these were never made lawful to anyone before me, and the earth has been made sacred and pure and mosque for me, so whenever the time of prayer comes for any one of you he should pray whenever he is, and I have been supported by awe (by which the enemy is overwhelmed) from the distance (which one takes) one month to cover and I have been granted intercession.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah al-Ansari ne bataaya: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Mujhe paanch khoobiyaan di gayi hain jo mujhse pehle kisi ko nahi di gayin: Har Rasool khaas taur par apni hi qaum ki taraf bheja gaya tha, jabki mujhe poore gore aur kaale logon ki taraf bheja gaya hai; jung ka maal-e-ganeemat mere liye halaal kar diya gaya hai, aur ye mujhse pehle kisi ke liye halaal nahi kiya gaya tha; zameen ko mere liye paak aur masjid banaaya gaya hai, is liye jab bhi tum mein se kisi ke liye namaz ka waqt aaye, wo jahan bhi ho wahin namaz padhe; aur ek mahine ki doori jitni jagah tak mujhe dahshat, yaani dushman ke dilon mein khauf, ke zariye madad di gayi hai; aur mujhe shafaa'at di gayi hai.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah related that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, and he related like this.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bataaya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, aur unhone isi tarah riwayat ki.

e: Hudhaifa reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: We have been made to excel (other) people in three (things): Our rows have been made like the rows of the angels and the whole earth has been made a mosque for us, and its dust has been made a purifier for us in case water is not available. And he mentioned another characteristic too
hi: Hudhaifa ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Humein doosre logon par teen cheezon mein fazilat di gayi hai: Humaari safein Farishton ki safon jaisi banaayi gayi hain, aur poori zameen humaare liye masjid banaayi gayi hai, aur uski mitti humaare liye paak karne wali cheez banaayi gayi hai, agar paani na mile. Aur unhone ek aur khaasiyat ka bhi zikr kiya.

e: Hudhaifa reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said like this.
hi: Hudhaifa ne bataaya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne isi tarah farmaya.

e: Abu Huraira reported that the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon hlmg) said: I have been given superiority over the other prophets in six respects: I have been given words which are concise but comprehensive in meaning; I have been helped by terror (in the hearts of enemies): spoils have been made lawful to me: the earth has been made for me clean and a place of worship; I have been sent to all mankind and the line of prophets is closed with me.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Mujhe doosre Nabiyon par chhe baaton mein fazilat di gayi hai: Mujhe aise alfaaz diye gaye hain jo mukhtasar hain lekin mani mein jaame; mujhe dushmanon ke dilon mein khauf ke zariye madad di gayi hai; maal-e-ganeemat mere liye halaal kiya gaya hai; zameen mere liye paak aur ibaadatgaah banaayi gayi hai; mujhe poori insaaniyat ki taraf bheja gaya hai; aur Nabiyon ka silsila mujhpar mukammal kar diya gaya hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: I have been commissioned with words which are concise but comprehensive in meaning; I have been helped by terror (in the hearts of enemies): and while I was asleep I was brought the keys of the treasures of the earth which were placed in my hand. And Abfi Huraira added: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) has left (for his heavenly home) and you are now busy in getting them.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Mujhe aise alfaaz ke saath bheja gaya hai jo mukhtasar hain lekin mani mein jaame; mujhe dushmanon ke dilon mein khauf ke zariye madad di gayi hai; aur jab main so raha tha, to mere paas zameen ke khazaanon ki chaabiyaan laayi gayin aur wo mere haath mein rakh di gayin. Aur Abu Huraira ne izafa kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apne asmaani ghar ki taraf rukhsat ho chuke hain aur ab tum unhein khazaanon ko nikaalne mein masroof ho.

e: Abu Huraira reported: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying a hadith like that of Yunus.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Yunus ki riwayat jaisi hi ek hadees kehte suna.

e: This hadith has been narratted by Abu Huraira by another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira se ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: I have been helped by terror (in the heart of the enemy) ; I have been given words which are concise but comprehensive in meaning; and while I was asleep I was brought the keys of the treasures of the earth which were placed in my hand.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Mujhe dushman ke dilon mein khauf ke zariye madad di gayi hai; mujhe aise alfaaz diye gaye hain jo mukhtasar hain lekin mani mein jaame; aur jab main so raha tha, to mere paas zameen ke khazaanon ki chaabiyaan laayi gayin aur wo mere haath mein rakh di gayin.

e: Hammam b. Munabbih reported: That is what Abu Huraira reported to us from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he narrated (some) ahadith one of which is that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: I have been helped by terror (in the hearts of enemies) and I have been given words which are concise but comprehensive in meaning.
hi: Hammam bin Munabbih ne bataaya: Ye wo hai jo Abu Huraira ne humein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat ki aur unhone kuch Ahadees bayan ki, jinmein se ek ye hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Mujhe dushman ke dilon mein khauf ke zariye madad di gayi hai aur mujhe aise alfaaz diye gaye hain jo mukhtasar hain lekin mani mein jaame.

e:
Anas b. Malik reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to Medina and stayed in the upper part of Medina for fourteen nights with a tribe called Banu 'Amr b 'Auf. He then sent for the chiefs of Banu al-Najir, and they came with swords around their inecks. He (the narrator) said: I perceive as if I am seeing the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on his ride with Abu Bakr behind him and the chiefs of Banu al-Najjar around him till he alighted in the courtyard of Abu Ayyub. He (the narrator) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said prayer when the time came for prayer, and he prayed in the fold of goats and sheep. He then ordered mosques to be built and sent for the chiefs of Banu al-Najjar, and they came (to him). He (the Holy Prophet) said to them: O Banu al-Najjar, sell these lands of yours to me. They said: No, by Allah. we would not demand their price, but (reward) from the Lord. Anas said: There (in these lands) were trees and graves of the polytheists, and ruins. The Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) ordered that the trees should be cut, and the graves should be dug out, and the ruins should be levelled. The trees (were thus) placed in rows towards the qibla and the stones were set on both sides of the door, and (while building the mosque) they (the Companions) sang rajaz verses along with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): 
O Allah: there is no good but the good of the next world, So help the Ansar and the Muhajirin.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Madina aaye aur Madina ke oonche hisse mein Banu Amr bin Auf naami qabile ke saath chaudah (14) raatein thehre. Phir unhone Banu al-Najjar ke sardaaron ko bulaawa bheja, aur wo apni talwaaren apni gardanon mein latkaaye aa gaye. Unhone kaha: Mujhe aisa lagta hai goya main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko apni sawaari par dekh raha hoon, Abu Bakr unke peeche baithe hue aur Banu al-Najjar ke sardaar unke ird-gird, yahan tak ki wo Abu Ayyub ke aangan mein utre. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne namaz padhi jab namaz ka waqt aaya, aur unhone bakriyon aur bhedon ke bade mein namaz padhi. Phir unhone masjidon ko banaane ka hukum diya aur Banu al-Najjar ke sardaaron ko bulaawa bheja, aur wo unke paas aaye. Unhone unse kaha: Aye Banu al-Najjar, apni ye zameenein mujhe bech do. Unhone kaha: Nahi, Allah ki qasam, hum inki qeemat nahi maangenge, sivaay apne Rab se sawaab ke. Anas ne kaha: In zameenon mein kuch ped aur mushrikeen ki qabrein aur khandhar the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne hukum diya ki ped kaate jaayein, aur qabrein khod nikaali jaayein, aur khandhar barabar kiye jaayein. Ped Qibla ki taraf safon mein rakhe gaye aur patthar darwaze ke dono taraf rakhe gaye, aur masjid banaate hue unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath rajaz ashaar gaaye: Aye Allah! Aakhirat ki bhalaai ke siwa koi bhalaai nahi, is liye Ansaar aur Muhaajireen ki madad kar.

e: Anas reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to pray in the folds of the sheep and goats before the mosque was built.
hi: Anas ne bataaya: Masjid banne se pehle Allah ke Rasool (SAW) bakriyon aur bhedon ke badon mein namaz padha karte the.

e: Abu al-Tiyyah reported: I heard from Anas a narration like this from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).
hi: Abu al-Tiyyah ne bataaya: Maine Anas se Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki taraf se isi tarah ki ek riwayat suni.

e: Al-Bara' b. 'Azib reported: I said prayer with the Apostle (ﷺ) turning towards Bait-ul-Maqdis for sixteen months till this verse of Surah Baqara wis revealed:" And wherever you are turn your faces towards it" (ii. 144). This verse was revealed when the Apostle (ﷺ) had said prayer. A person amongst his people passed by the people of Ansar as they were engaged in prayer. He narrated to them (this command of Allah) and they turned their faces towards the Ka'ba.
hi: Al-Bara bin Aazib ne bataaya: Maine solah mahine tak Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Bait-ul-Maqdis ki taraf mudkar namaz padhi, yahan tak ki Surah Baqara ki ye aayat nazil hui: 'Aur jahan bhi tum ho, apne chehron ko uski taraf mudo' (2:144). Ye aayat tab nazil hui jab Rasool (SAW) namaz padh chuke the. Unki qaum ka ek shaks Ansaar ke logon ke paas se guzra jab wo namaz mein masroof the. Usne unhein ye hukum bataaya aur unhone apne chehre Ka'ba ki taraf mod liye.

e: Abu Ishaq reported: I heard al-Bara' saying: We prayed with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) (with our faces) towards Bait-ul-Maqdis for sixteen months or seventeen months. Then we were made to change (our direction) towards the Ka'ba.
hi: Abu Ishaq ne bataaya: Maine al-Bara ko ye kehte suna: Humne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Bait-ul-Maqdis ki taraf mooh karke solah ya satrah mahine namaz padhi. Phir humein apni simt Ka'ba ki taraf badalne ko kaha gaya.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported: As the people were praying at Quba' a man came to them and said: It has been revealed to file Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) during the night and he has been directed to turn towards the Ka'ba. So turn towards it. Their faces were towards Syria and they turned round towards Ka'ba.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bataaya: Jab log Quba mein namaz padh rahe the, to ek shaks unke paas aaya aur kaha: Rasool (SAW) par raat mein wahi nazil hui hai aur unhein hukum diya gaya hai ki wo Ka'ba ki taraf mudein. Is liye tum bhi uski taraf mudo. Unke chehre Sham ki taraf the aur unhone Ka'ba ki taraf apna mooh mod liya.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported: As the people were engaged in the morning prayer a man came to them. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bataaya: Jab log subah ki namaz mein masroof the, to ek shaks unke paas aaya. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Anas reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to pray towards Bait-ul-Maqdis, that it was revealed (to him):" Indeed We see the turning of the face to heaven, wherefore We shall assuredly cause thee to turn towards Qibla which shall please thee. So turn thy face towards the sacred Mosque (Ka'ba)" (ii. 144). A person from Banu Salama was going; (he found the people) in ruk'u (while) praying the dawn prayer and they had said one rak'ah. He said in a loud voice: Listen! the Qibla has been changed and they turned towards (the new) Qibla (Ka'ba) in that very state.
hi: Anas ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Bait-ul-Maqdis ki taraf mudkar namaz padha karte the, ki unpar ye aayat nazil hui: 'Beshak Hum tumhaare chehre ka baar-baar aasman ki taraf mudna dekh rahe hain, is liye Hum zaroor tumhein aisi Qibla ki taraf mudvaayenge jo tumhein pasand aaye. Is liye apna chehra Masjid al-Haram, Ka'ba, ki taraf mod lo' (2:144). Banu Salama ka ek shaks jaa raha tha; usne logon ko ruku mein paaya subah ki namaz padhte hue aur unhone ek rak'aat mukammal kar li thi. Usne zor se pukaara: Suno! Qibla badal diya gaya hai aur unhone usi haalat mein naye Qibla, Ka'ba, ki taraf mooh mod liya.

e: 'A'isha reported: Umm Habiba and Umm Salama made a mention before the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) of a church which they had seen in Abyssinia and which had pictures in it. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When a pious person amongst them (among the religious groups) dies they build a place of worship on his grave, and then decorate it with such pictures. They would be the worst of creatures on the Day of judgment in the sight of Allah.
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Umm Habiba aur Umm Salama ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saamne ek girjaghar ka zikr kiya jo unhone Habsha mein dekha tha aur jismein tasveerein thi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jab unmein se koi nek banda gujar jaata hai, to wo uski qabr par ibaadatgaah bana lete hain, aur phir use aisi tasveeron se sajaate hain. Wo Qayamat ke Din Allah ki nazar mein makhlooqaat mein sabse buri honge.

e: 'A'isha reported: They (some Companions of the Holy Prophet) were conversing with one another in the presence of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) (during his last) illness. Umm Salama and Umm Habiba made a mention of the church and then (the hadith was) narrated.
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Wo, Nabi (SAW) ke kuch Sahaba, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki maujoodgi mein aapas mein baatein kar rahe the, unki aakhri bimaari ke dauraan. Umm Salama aur Umm Habiba ne girjaghar ka zikr kiya aur phir hadees riwayat ki gayi.

e: 'A'isha reported: The wives of the Messenger of Allah (may peace be Upon him) made a mention of the church which they had seen in Abyssinia which was called Marya, and the rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki biwiyon ne us girjaghar ka zikr kiya jo unhone Habsha mein dekha tha, jise Marya kaha jaata tha, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: 'A'isha reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said during his illness from which he never recovered: Allah cursed the Jews and the Christians that they took the graves of their prophets as mosques. She ('A'isha) reported: Had it not been so, his (Prophet's) grave would have been in an open place, but it could not be due to the fear that it may not be taken as a mosque.
hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apni us bimaari ke dauraan farmaya jisse wo kabhi theek na hue: Allah ne Yahudiyon aur Isaaiyon par laanat ki kyunki unhone apne Nabiyon ki qabron ko ibaadatgaah bana liya. Unhone bataaya: Agar aisa na hota, to unki qabr khuli jagah mein hoti, lekin ye is dar se nahi kiya gaya ki kahin ise masjid na bana liya jaaye.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Let Allah destroy the Jews for they have taken the graves of their apostles as places of worship.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Allah Yahudiyon ko tabaah kare kyunki unhone apne Rasoolon ki qabron ko ibaadat ki jagah bana liya.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Let there be curse of Allah upon the Jews and the Christians for they have taken the graves of their apostles as places of worship.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Allah ki laanat ho Yahudiyon aur Isaaiyon par kyunki unhone apne Rasoolon ki qabron ko ibaadat ki jagah bana liya.

e: 'A'isha and Abdullah reported: As the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was about to breathe his last, he drew his sheet upon his face and when he felt uneasy, he uncovered his face and said in that very state: Let there be curse upon the Jews and the Christians that they have taken the graves of their apostles as places of worship. He in fact warned (his men) against what they (the Jews and the Christians) did.
hi: Aisha aur Abdullah ne bataaya: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apni aakhri saans lene hi wale the, to unhone apna kapda apne chehre par khinch liya, aur jab unhein bechaini mehsoos hui, to unhone apna chehra khola aur usi halat mein kaha: Yahudiyon aur Isaaiyon par laanat ho kyunki unhone apne Rasoolon ki qabron ko ibaadat ki jagah bana liya. Aap (SAW) ne haqeeqat mein apne logon ko us baat se khabardaar kiya jo unhone, Yahudiyon aur Isaaiyon ne, kiya tha.

e: Jundub reported: I heard from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) five days before his death and he said: I stand acquitted before Allah that I took any one of you as friend, for Allah has taken me as His friend, as he took Ibrahim as His friend. Had I taken any one of my Ummah as a friend, I would have taken Abu Bakr as a friend. Beware of those who preceded you and used to take the graves of their prophets and righteous men as places of worship, but you must not take graves as mosques; I forbid you to do that.
hi: Jundub ne bataaya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko unki wafat se paanch din pehle ye kehte suna: Main Allah ke saamne is baat se bari hoon ki maine tum mein se kisi ko dost banaaya ho, kyunki Allah ne mujhe apna dost banaaya hai, jaise Usne Ibrahim ko apna dost banaaya. Agar maine apni Ummat mein se kisi ko dost banaaya hota, to main zaroor Abu Bakr ko dost banaata. Khabardaar raho un logon se jo tumse pehle guzre aur apne Nabiyon aur nek logon ki qabron ko ibaadat ki jagah banaate the, lekin tumhein qabron ko masjid nahi banaana chaahiye; main tumhein aisa karne se mana karta hoon.

e: Ubaidullah al-Khaulini reported: 'Uthman b. 'Affan listened to the opinion of the people (which was not favourable) when he rebuilt the mosque of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). Thereupon he said: You have not been fair to me for I have heard from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: He who built a mosque for Allah, the Exalted, Allah would build for him a house in Paradise. Bukair said: I think he (the Holy Prophet) said: While he seeks the pleasure of Allah (by building the mosque). And in the narration of Ibn 'Isa (the words are):" (a house) like that (mosque) in Paradise."
hi: Ubaidullah al-Khaulani ne bataaya: Uthman bin Affan ne logon ki raay suni, jo unke favour mein nahi thi, jab unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki masjid dobara banaayi. Is par unhone kaha: Tumne mere saath insaaf nahi kiya, kyunki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna hai: Jo Allah, Buland, ke liye masjid banaaye, Allah uske liye Jannat mein ek ghar banaayega. Bukair ne kaha: Mera khayaal hai unhone kaha: Jabki wo masjid banaate hue Allah ki khushnoodi chaahta ho. Aur Ibn Isa ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: 'ek ghar uske jaisa Jannat mein.'

e: Mahmud b. Labid reported: When 'Uthman b. 'Affan intended to build the mosque (of the Prophet) the people did not approve of it. They liked that it should be kept in the same state. Thereupon he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: He who built a mosque for Allah, Allah would build a house for him like it in Paradise.
hi: Mahmud bin Labid ne bataaya: Jab Uthman bin Affan ne Nabi (SAW) ki masjid banaane ka iraada kiya, to logon ne ise pasand nahi kiya. Wo chaahte the ki ise usi haalat mein rehne diya jaaye. Is par unhone kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo Allah ke liye masjid banaaye, Allah uske liye uske jaisa ek ghar Jannat mein banaayega.

e: Al-Aswad and 'Alqama reported: We came to the house of 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud. He said: Have these people said prayer behind you? We said: No. He said: Then stand up and say prayer. He neither ordered us to say Adhan nor Iqama. We went to stand behind him. He caught hold of our hands and mode one of us stand on his right hand and the other on his left side. When we bowed, we placed our hands on our knees. He struck our hands and put his hands together, palm to palm, then put them between his thighs. When he completed the prayer he said. There would soon come your Amirs, who would defer prayers from their appointed time and would make such delay that a little time is left before sunset. So when you see them doing so, say prayer at its appointed time and then say prayer along with them as (Nafl), and when you are three, pray together (standing in one row), and when you are more than three, appoint one amongst you as your Imam. And when any one of you bows he must place his hands upon hie thighs and kneel down. and putting his palms together place (them within his thighs). I perceive as if I am seeing the gap between the fingers of the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him).
hi: Al-Aswad aur Alqama ne bataaya: Hum Abdullah bin Mas'ood ke ghar aaye. Unhone poocha: Kya in logon ne tumhaare peeche namaz padhi hai? Humne kaha: Nahi. Unhone kaha: To phir khade ho jaao aur namaz padho. Unhone humein na to Azaan dene ka hukum diya na Iqaamat ka. Hum unke peeche khade hone gaye. Unhone humaare haath pakde aur ek ko apne daaye haath aur doosre ko baaye haath par khada kiya. Jab humne ruku kiya, to humne apne haath apne ghutnon par rakhe. Unhone humaare haath hataakar apne haathon ko ek doosre se milaakar, hatheli se hatheli, apni raanon ke beech rakh liya. Jab unhone namaz mukammal ki, to unhone kaha: Jald hi tumhaare Ameer aayenge, jo namaz ko uske muqarrar waqt se der karenge aur itni der karenge ki suraj doobne se pehle bahut kam waqt bacha rahega. Is liye jab tum unhein aisa karte dekho, to namaz apne muqarrar waqt par padho aur phir unke saath bhi Nafl ki tarah namaz padho, aur jab tum teen ho, to ek saf mein khade hokar saath namaz padho, aur jab tum teen se zyada ho, to tum mein se ek ko Imam muqarrar karo. Aur jab tum mein se koi jhuke, to use apne haath apni raanon par rakhne chaahiye aur ghutnon tak jhukna chahiye, aur apni hatheliyaan milaakar unhein apni raanon ke beech rakhna chahiye. Mujhe aisa lagta hai goya main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki ungliyon ke darmiyaan ki khaali jagah dekh raha hoon.

e: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Alqama and Aswad by another chain of transmitters and in the hadith transmitted by Ibn Mus-hir and Jabir the words are: " I perceive as if I am seeing the gap between the fingers of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as he was bowing."
hi: Ye hadees Alqama aur Aswad ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai aur Ibn Mus'hir aur Jabir ki riwayat ki gayi hadees mein alfaaz hain: 'Mujhe aisa lagta hai goya main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki ungliyon ke darmiyaan ki khaali jagah dekh raha hoon jab wo jhuk rahe the.'

e: 'Alqama and Aswad reported that they went to 'Abdullah. He said: Have (people) behind you said prayer? They said: Yes. He stood between them ('Alqama and Aswad). One was on his right aide and the other was on his left. We then bowed and placed our hands on our knees. He struck our hands and then putting his hands together, palm to palm, placed them between his thighs. When he completed the prayer he said: This is how the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to do.
hi: Alqama aur Aswad ne bataaya ki wo Abdullah ke paas gaye. Unhone poocha: Kya logon ne tumhaare peeche namaz padhi hai? Unhone kaha: Haan. Wo unke, Alqama aur Aswad ke, beech khade ho gaye. Ek unke daaye taraf tha aur doosra baaye taraf. Phir humne ruku kiya aur apne haath apne ghutnon par rakhe. Unhone humaare haath hataakar apne haathon ko ek doosre se milaakar, hatheli se hatheli, apni raanon ke beech rakh liya. Jab unhone namaz mukammal ki, to unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) isi tarah kiya karte the.

e: Mus'ab b. Sa'd reported: I said prayer by the side of my father and placed my hands between my knees. My father said to me: Place your hands on your knees. I repeated that (the previous act) for the second time, and he struck at my hands and said: We have been forbidden to do so and have been commanded to place our palms on the knees.
hi: Mus'ab bin Sa'd ne bataaya: Maine apne waalid ke bagal mein namaz padhi aur apne haath apne ghutnon ke beech rakhe. Mere waalid ne mujhse kaha: Apne haath apne ghutnon par rakho. Maine dobara aisa kiya, pehle jaisa amal, aur unhone mere haathon par maara aur kaha: Humein isse mana kiya gaya hai aur humein hukum diya gaya hai ki hum apni hatheliyaan apne ghutnon par rakhein.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Abu Ya'fur with the same chain of transmitters up to these words: We have been forbidden from it and no mention of that has been made what follows it.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Ya'fur ne usi sanad ke saath in alfaaz tak riwayat ki hai: 'Humein isse mana kiya gaya hai,' aur uske aage ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: Ibn Sa'd reported: I bowed and my hands were in this state, i. e. they were put together, palm to palm, and were placed between his thighs. My father said: We used to do like this but were later on commanded to place them on the knees.
hi: Ibn Sa'd ne bataaya: Maine ruku kiya aur mere haath is halat mein the, yaani wo ek doosre se milaaye hue the, hatheli se hatheli, aur uski raanon ke beech rakhe hue the. Mere waalid ne kaha: Hum isi tarah kiya karte the lekin baad mein humein hukum diya gaya ki hum unhein ghutnon tak uthaayein.

e: Mus'ab b. Sa'd b. Abu Waqqas reported: I said prayer by the side of my father. When I bowed I intertwined my fingers and placed them between my knees. He struck my hands. When he completed the prayer he said: We used to do that but then were commanded to lift (our palms) to the knees.
hi: Mus'ab bin Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas ne bataaya: Maine apne waalid ke bagal mein namaz padhi. Jab maine ruku kiya, to maine apni ungliyaan aapas mein pirona kar apne ghutnon ke beech rakhi. Unhone mere haathon par maara. Jab unhone namaz mukammal ki, to unhone kaha: Hum aisa kiya karte the lekin phir humein hukum diya gaya ki hum apni hatheliyaan ghutnon tak uthaayein.

e: Tawus reported: We asked Ibn Abbas about sitting on one's buttocks (in prayer). (ala alqad mein) He said: It is sunnah. We said to him: We find it a sort of cruelty to the foot. Ibn 'Abbas said: It is the sunnah of your Apostle (ﷺ).
hi: Tawus ne bataaya: Humne Ibn Abbas se namaz mein baithne, yaani Iq'a, ke baare mein poocha. Unhone kaha: Ye Sunnat hai. Humne unse kaha: Humein ye paanv ke liye ek tarah ki sakhti lagti hai. Ibn Abbas ne kaha: Ye tumhaare Rasool (SAW) ki Sunnat hai.

e: Mu'awiya b. al-Hakam said: While I was praying with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), a man in the company sneezed. I said: Allah have mercy on you! The people stared at me with disapproving looks, so I said: Woe be upon me, why is it that you stare at me? They began to strike their hands on their thighs, and when I saw them urging me to observe silence (I became angry) but I said nothing. When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had said the prayer (and I declare that neither before him nor after him have I seen a leader who gave better instruction than he for whom I would give my father and mother as ransom). I swear that he did not scold, beat or revile me but said: Talking to persons is not fitting during the prayer, for it consists of glorifying Allah, declaring his Greatness. and recitation of the Qur'an or words to that effect. I said: Messenger of Allah. I was till recently a pagan, but Allah has brought Islam to us; among us there are men who have recourse to Kahins. He said, Do not have recourse to them. I said. There are men who take omens. That is something which they find in their breasts, but let it not turn their way (from freedom of action). I said: Among us there are men who draw lines. He said: There was a prophet who drew lines, so if they do it as they did, that is allowable. I had a maid-servant who tended goats by the side of Uhud and Jawwaniya. One day I happened to pass that way and found that a wolf had carried a goat from her flock. I am after all a man from the posterity of Adam. I felt sorry as they (human beings) feel sorry. So I slapped her. I came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and felt (this act of mine) as something grievous I said: Messenger of Allah, should I not grant her freedom? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Bring her to me. So I brought her to him. He said to her: Where is Allah? She said: He is in the heaven. He said: Who am I? She said: Thou art the Messenger of Allah. He said: Grant her freedom, she is a believing woman.
hi: Mu'awiya bin al-Hakam ne bataaya: Jab main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath namaz padh raha tha, to giroh mein se ek shaks ko chheenk aayi. Maine kaha: Allah tumpar rehem kare! Logon ne mujhe naaraazgi se ghoorna shuru kar diya, is liye maine kaha: Mujhpar afsos, tum log mujhe kyun ghoor rahe ho? Wo apne haath apni raanon par maarne lage, aur jab maine dekha ki wo mujhe khaamosh rehne ke liye kah rahe hain, mujhe gussa aaya, lekin maine kuch nahi kaha. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne namaz mukammal ki, aur main kehta hoon ki na unse pehle na unke baad maine koi aisa rehnuma dekha jo unse behtar taleem deta, jinke liye main apne maa-baap qurbaan karta hoon, maine qasam khaakar kehta hoon ki unhone mujhe na daanta, na maara, na bura-bhala kaha, balki kaha: Namaz mein logon se baat karna theek nahi hai, kyunki ismein Allah ki tasbeeh, Uski azmat bayan karna, aur Quran ki tilaawat shaamil hai, ya isi jaise alfaaz. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, main abhi haal hi mein mushrik tha, lekin Allah humein Islam laaya hai; humaare beech aise log hain jo kaahinon ke paas jaate hain. Unhone kaha: Unke paas mat jaao. Maine kaha: Kuch log shagun lete hain. Unhone kaha: Ye aisi cheez hai jo unhein apne seenon mein milti hai, lekin ye unhein apne amal ki azaadi se na hataaye. Maine kaha: Humaare beech aise log hain jo zameen par lakeerein khinchte hain. Unhone kaha: Ek Nabi the jo lakeeren khinchte the, is liye agar wo waisa hi karein jaisa unhone kiya, to ye jaayez hai. Meri ek laundi thi jo Uhud aur Jawwaniya ke paas bakriyaan charaati thi. Ek din mera guzar wahan se hua aur maine paaya ki ek bhediya uske jhund se ek bakri le gaya tha. Main aakhirkaar Aadam ki aulaad mein se ek shaks hoon. Mujhe utna hi afsos hua jitna insaano ko hota hai. Is liye maine use thappad maara. Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaya aur mujhe apne is amal par bahut afsos hua. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya main use aazaad nahi kar dun? Unhone kaha: Use mere paas laao. Is liye main use unke paas le gaya. Unhone usse poocha: Allah kahan hai? Usne kaha: Wo aasman mein hai. Unhone poocha: Main kaun hoon? Usne kaha: Aap Allah ke Rasool hain. Unhone kaha: Ise aazaad kar do, ye ek momin aurat hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Yahya b. Abu Kathir with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Yahya bin Abu Kathir ne usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai.

e: Abdullah (b. Masu'd) reported: We used to greet the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) while he was engaged in prayer and he would respond to our greeting. But when we returned from the Negus we greeted him and he did not respond to us; so we said: Messenger of Allah. we used to greet you when you were engaged in prayer and you would respond to us. He replied: Prayer demands whole attention.
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ood ne bataaya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko salaam kiya karte the jab wo namaz mein masroof hote aur wo humaare salaam ka jawaab dete the. Lekin jab hum Najashi se wapas aaye, to humne unhein salaam kiya aur unhone humein jawaab nahi diya; is liye humne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, hum aapko salaam kiya karte the jab aap namaz mein hote the aur aap humein jawaab dete the. Unhone jawaab diya: Namaz mein poori tawajjo ki zaroorat hoti hai.

e: This hadith has been reported by A'mash with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees A'mash ne usi sanad ke saath riwayat ki hai.

e: Zaid b. Arqam reported: We used to talk while engaged in prayer and a person talked with a companion on his side in prayer till (this verse) was revealed:" And stand before Allah in devout obedience" (ii, 238) and we were commanded to observe silence (in prayer) and were forbidden to speak.
hi: Zaid bin Arqam ne bataaya: Hum namaz mein baat kiya karte the aur koi shaks namaz mein apne bagal wale saathi se baat kar leta tha, yahan tak ki ye aayat nazil hui: 'Aur Allah ke saamne poori itaa'at ke saath khade raho' (2:238), aur humein khaamosh rehne ka hukum diya gaya aur baat karne se mana kiya gaya.

e: A hadith like this has been transmitted by Isma'il b. Abu Khalid.
hi: Isi jaisi ek hadees Ismail bin Abi Khalid ne riwayat ki hai.

e: Jabir reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent me on an errand. I (having done the business assigned to me came back and) joined him as he was going (on a ride). Qutaiba said that he was saying prayer while he rode. I greeted him. He gestured to me. When he completed the prayer. he called me and said: You greeted me just now while I was engaged in prayer. (Qutaiba said): His (Prophet's face) was towards the east, as he was praying.
hi: Jabir ne bataaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe ek kaam se bheja. Wo kaam poora karke wapas laut aaya aur unse mila jab wo kisi sawaari par chal rahe the. Qutaiba ne kaha ki wo sawaari par namaz padh rahe the. Maine unhein salaam kiya. Unhone ishaare se jawaab diya. Jab unhone namaz mukammal ki, to unhone mujhe bulaaya aur kaha: Tumne mujhe abhi salaam kiya jabki main namaz mein masroof tha. Qutaiba ne kaha: Unka chehra poorab ki taraf tha, jab wo namaz padh rahe the.

e: Jabir reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent me (on an errand) while he was going to Banu Mustaliq. I came to him and he was engaged in prayer on the back of his camel. I talked to him and he gestured to me With his hand, and Zuhair gestured with his hand. I then again talked and he again (gestured to me with his hand). Zuhair pointed with his hand towards the ground. I heard him (the Holy Prophet) reciting the Qur'an and making a sign with his head. When he com- pleted the prayer he sa'id: What have you done (with regard to that business) for which I sent you? I could not talk with you but for the fact that I was engaged in prayer. Zuhair told that Abu Zubair was sitting with his face turned towards Qibla (as he transmitted this hadith). Abu Zuhair pointed towards Banu Mustaliq with his hand and the direction to which he pointed with his hand was not towards the Ka'ba.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne mujhe (ek kaam ke liye) bheja jab woh Banu Mustaliq ki taraf ja rahe the. Main unke paas aaya to woh apne oont par sawar hokar namaz padh rahe the. Maine unse baat ki to unhone apne haath se ishara kiya, aur Zuhair ne (bhi) haath se ishara kiya. Maine phir dobara baat ki to unhone phir ishara kiya. Zuhair ne apne haath se zameen ki taraf ishara kiya. Maine unhe Quran padhte aur sar se ishara karte hue suna. Jab unhone namaz mukammal ki to farmaya: Jis kaam ke liye maine tumhe bheja tha, uska kya hua? Main tumse baat nahi kar saka kyunki main namaz mein tha. Zuhair ne bataya ki Abu Zubair Qibla ki taraf mooh kiye baithe the (jab unhone ye hadees bayan ki). Abu Zuhair ne Banu Mustaliq ki taraf haath se ishara kiya, aur jis taraf unhone ishara kiya woh Kaaba ki taraf nahi thi.

e: Jabir reported: We were in the company of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and he sent me on an errand, and when I came back (I saw him) saying prayer on his ride and his face was not turned towards Qibla. I greeted him but he did not respond to me. As he completed the prayer, he said: Nothing prevented me from responding to your greeting but the fact that I was praying.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath the, aur unhone mujhe ek kaam ke liye bheja. Jab main wapas aaya to maine dekha ki woh apni sawari par namaz padh rahe the aur unka rukh Qibla ki taraf nahi tha. Maine unhe salaam kiya lekin unhone jawab nahi diya. Jab unhone namaz mukammal ki to farmaya: Mujhe tumhare salaam ka jawab dene se sirf is liye roka gaya kyunki main namaz mein tha.

e: This hadith that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent Jabir on an errand has been reported by him through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Jabir ko ek kaam ke liye bheja, ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported that he heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: A highly wicked one amongst the Jinn escaped yesternight to interrupt my prayer, but Allah gave me power over him, so I seized him and intended to tie him to one of the pillars of the mosque in order that you, all together or all, might look at him, but I remembered the supplication of my brother Sulaiman:" My Lord, forgive me, give me such a kingdom as will not be possible for anyone after me" (Qur'an, xxxvii. 35).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: Kal raat jinnon mein se ek sakht sarkash jinn mujhe meri namaz mein khalal dalne ke liye bhaag kar aaya, lekin Allah ne mujhe usper qaboo diya, to maine use pakad liya aur socha ki use masjid ke kisi khambe se baandh doon taaki tum sab ise dekh sako, lekin mujhe apne bhai Sulaiman (AS) ki dua yaad aa gayi: "Aye mere Rab, mujhe maaf farma, aur mujhe aisi baadshahat ata farma jo mere baad kisi ke liye mumkin na ho" (Quran, 38:35).

e: This hadith has been transmitted by Ibn Abi Shaiba.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Abi Shaiba ne bhi bayan ki hai.

e: Abu Darda' reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up (to pray) and we heard him say:" I seek refuge in Allah from thee." Then said:" curse thee with Allah's curse" three times, then he stretched out his hand as though he was taking hold of something. When he finished the prayer, we said: Messenger of Allah, we heard you say something during the prayer which we have not heard you say before, and we saw you stretch out your hand. He replied: Allah's enemy Iblis came with a flame of fire to put it in my face, so I said three times:" I Seek refuge in Allah from thee." Then I said three times:" I curse thee with Allah's full curse." But he did not retreat (on any one of these) three occasions. Thereafter I meant to seize him. I swear by Allah that had it not been for the supplication of my brother Sulaiman he would have been bound, and made an object of sport for the children of Medina.
hi: Abu Darda (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) khade hue namaz padhne aur humne unhe kehte suna: "Main tujhse Allah ki panah maangta hoon." Phir farmaya: "Main tujhpar Allah ki laanat bhejta hoon" - teen baar, phir unhone apna haath aage badhaya jaise woh kuch pakad rahe hon. Jab unhone namaz mukammal ki to humne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, humne aapko namaz ke dauran kuch aisa kehte suna jo humne pehle kabhi nahi suna tha, aur humne dekha ki aapne apna haath bhi aage badhaya. Unhone farmaya: Allah ka dushman Iblees aag ka shola lekar aaya taaki mere chehre par daale, to maine teen baar kaha: "Main tujhse Allah ki panah maangta hoon." Phir maine teen baar kaha: "Main tujhpar Allah ki poori laanat bhejta hoon." Lekin woh in teenon mauqon par peeche nahi hata. Iske baad maine use pakadne ka irada kiya. Allah ki qasam, agar mere bhai Sulaiman (AS) ki dua na hoti to woh bandh diya jaata aur Madina ke bacchon ka khilona ban jaata.

e: Abu Qatadi reported: I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying the prayer while he was carrying Umama, daughter of Zainab, daughter of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). and Abu'l-'As b. al-Rabi'. When he stood up, he took her up and when he prostrated he put her down, Yahya said: Malik replied in the affirmative.
hi: Abu Qatada (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko namaz padhte dekha jabki woh Umama - Zainab (Rasoolullah SAW ki beti) aur Abu'l-As bin Rabi ki beti - ko utha rahe the. Jab woh khade hote to use utha lete, aur jab sajda karte to use zameen par rakh dete. Yahya ne kaha: Malik ne haan mein jawab diya.

e: Abu Qatada al-Ansari reported: I saw the Apostle (ﷺ) leading the people in prayer with Umima, daughter of Abu'l-'As and Zainab, daughter of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), on his shoulder. When he bowed, he put her down, and when he got up after prostration, he lifted her again.
hi: Abu Qatada al-Ansari (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Rasool (SAW) ko logon ki imamat karte hue dekha jabki Umama - Abu'l-As ki beti aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ki beti Zainab ki beti - unke kandhe par thi. Jab woh ruku mein jaate to use utaar dete, aur jab sajde ke baad khade hote to use dobara utha lete.

e: Abu Qatada reported: I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) leading the people in prayer with Umama daughter of Abu'l-'As on his neck; and when he prostrated he put her down.
hi: Abu Qatada (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko logon ki imamat karte dekha jabki Umama - Abu'l-As ki beti - unki gardan par thi; aur jab woh sajda karte to use zameen par rakh dete.

e: Abu Qatada reported: As we were sitting in the mosque, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to us, and the rest of the hadith is the same except that he made no mention that he led people in this prayer.
hi: Abu Qatada (RA) ne bayan kiya: Jab hum masjid mein baithe the, Rasoolullah (SAW) hamare paas aaye, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai, siwaay iske ki isme ye zikr nahi ki unhone is namaz mein imamat ki.

e: Abu Hazim is reported on the authority of his father: Some people came to Sahl b. Sa'd and began to differ about the wood of which the (Prophet's pulpit was made. He (Sahl b. Sa'd) said: By Allah, I know of which wood it is made and who made it, and the day when I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) seated himself on it on the first day. I said to him: O Abu Abbas (kunyah of Sabl b. Sa'd), narrate to us (all these facts), He said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent a person to a woman asking her to allow her slave, a carpenter, to work on woods (to prepare a pulpit) so that I should talk to the people (sitting on it). Abu Hazim said: He (Sahl b. Sa'd) pointed out the name of (that lady) that day. So he (the carpenter) made (a pulpit) with these three steps. Then the Messengerof Allah (ﷺ) commanded it to be placed here (where it is lying now). It was fashioned out of the wood of al-Ghaba. And I saw the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) standing upon it and glorifying Allah and the people also glorified Allah after him, while he was on the pulpit. He then raised (his head from prostration) and stepped back (on his heels) till he prostrated himself at the base of pulpit, and then returned (to the former place and this movement of one or two steps continued) till the prayer was complete. He then turned towards the people and said: O people, I have done it so that you should follow me and learn (my mode of) prayer.
hi: Abu Hazim apne walid ke hawale se bayan karte hain: Kuch log Sahl bin Sa'd ke paas aaye aur us lakdi ke baare mein ikhtilaf karne lage jisse Nabi (SAW) ka mimbar banaya gaya tha. Unhone (Sahl bin Sa'd ne) kaha: Allah ki qasam, mujhe pata hai ki ye kis lakdi se bana hai aur kisne banaya, aur woh din bhi jab maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko pehli baar usper baithte dekha tha. Maine unse kaha: Aye Abu Abbas, humein ye sab bataiye. Unhone kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne ek shakhs ko ek aurat ke paas bheja taaki woh apne ghulam, jo ek badhai tha, ko lakdi par kaam karne ki ijazat de taaki main usper baithkar logon se baat kar sakoon. Abu Hazim ne kaha: Unhone us din us aurat ka naam bataya tha. To usne teen seedhiyon wala mimbar banaya. Phir Rasoolullah (SAW) ne hukum diya ki ise yahin rakha jaye jahan woh abhi rakha hai. Ye Ghaba ki lakdi se bana tha. Aur maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko usper khade hokar Allah ki tasbeeh karte dekha, aur log bhi unke peeche tasbeeh karte the jab woh mimbar par the. Phir woh peeche kadam lete jab tak mimbar ke neeche sajda na kar len, phir wapas apni jagah lautte, aur ye ek-do kadam ka amal chalta raha jab tak namaz mukammal na ho jaye. Phir woh logon ki taraf mudkar farmaya: Aye logon, maine ye is liye kiya taaki tum meri pairavi karo aur mera namaz padhne ka tareeqa seekho.

e: Abu Hazim reported: They (the people) came to Sahl b. Sa'd and they asked him of what thing the pulpit of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was made, and the rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Abu Hazim ne bayan kiya: Log Sahl bin Sa'd ke paas aaye aur unse poocha ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ka mimbar kis cheez se bana tha, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that he forbade keeping one's hand on one's waist while praying, and in the narration of Abu Bakr (the words are): The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade to do so.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone namaz mein haath kamar par rakhne se mana kiya, aur Abu Bakr ki riwayat mein (alfaaz hain): Rasoolullah (SAW) ne aisa karne se mana farmaya.

e: Mu'aiqib quoted the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) mentioning the removal of pebbles from the ground where he prostrated himself. He (the Prophet) said: It you must do so, do it only once.
hi: Mu'aiqib (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ka zikr kiya jab unhone sajde ki jagah se kankariyan hataane ka zikr kiya. Unhone farmaya: Agar tumhe aisa karna hi hai, to sirf ek baar karo.

e: Mu'aiqib said: They asked the Apostle (ﷺ) about the removal of (pebbles) in prayer, whereupon he said: If you do it, do it only once.
hi: Mu'aiqib (RA) ne kaha: Logon ne Rasool (SAW) se namaz mein kankariyan hataane ke baare mein poocha, to unhone farmaya: Agar tum aisa karo, to sirf ek baar karo.

e: Abdullah b. Umar reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saw spittle on the wall towards Qibla, and scratched it away and then turning to the people said: When any one of you prays, he must not spit in front of him, for Allah is in front of him when he is engaged in prayer.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Qibla ki deewar par thook dekha, aur use khurach kar hataya, phir logon ki taraf mudkar farmaya: Jab tum mein se koi namaz padhe, to apne saamne na thooke, kyunki jab woh namaz mein hota hai to Allah uske saamne hota hai.

e: Ibn Umar reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saw sputum sticking to the Qibla wall of the mosque, the rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne masjid ki Qibla wali deewar par balgham chipka dekha, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) saw sputum sticking to the Qibla of the mosque. He scratched it off with a pebble and then forbade spitting on the right side or in front, but (it is permissible) to spit on the left side or under the left foot.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne masjid ke Qibla par balgham chipka dekha. Unhone use ek kankar se khurach diya, phir daayi taraf ya saamne thookne se mana kiya, lekin baayi taraf ya baaye paon ke neeche thookne ki ijazat di.

e: Abu Huraira and Abu Sa'id narrated that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saw sputum, and the rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Abu Huraira aur Abu Sa'id (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne balgham dekha, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: 'A'isha reported: The Apostle of Allah (may, peace be upon him) saw spittle or snot or sputum, sticking to the wall towards Qibla and scratched it off.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Qibla ki deewar par thook ya nazla ya balgham chipka dekha aur use khurach diya.

e: Abu Huraira reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saw some sputum in the direction of the Qibla of the mosque. He turned towards people and said: How Is it that someone amongst you stands before his Lord and then spits out in front of Him? Does any one of you like that he should be made to stand in front of someone and then spit at his face? So when any one of you spits, he must spit on his left side under his foot. But if he does not find (space to spit) he should do like this. Qasim (one of the narrators) spat in his cloth and then folded it and rubbed it.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne masjid ke Qibla ki taraf kuch balgham dekha. Unhone logon ki taraf mudkar farmaya: Ye kaisa hai ki tum mein se koi apne Rab ke saamne khada hota hai aur phir uske saamne thookta hai? Kya tum mein se koi ye pasand karega ki use kisi ke saamne khada kiya jaye aur woh uske chehre par thook de? Is liye jab tum mein se koi thooke, to apni baayi taraf, paon ke neeche thooke. Lekin agar jagah na mile to aise kare. Qasim (raawiyon mein se ek) ne apne kapde mein thooka phir use mod kar mal diya.

e: Abu Huraira reported: I perceive as if I am looking at the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) folding up a part of his cloth with another one.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Mujhe aisa lagta hai jaise main Rasoolullah (SAW) ko apne kapde ke ek hisse ko doosre se mod te hue dekh raha hoon.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When any one of you is engaged in prayer, he is holding intimate conversation with his Lord, so none of you must spit in front of him, or towards his right side, but towards his left side under his foot.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab tum mein se koi namaz mein hota hai, to woh apne Rab se khufiya guftagu kar raha hota hai, is liye koi bhi apne saamne ya daayi taraf na thooke, balki apni baayi taraf, paon ke neeche thooke.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Spitting in a mosque is a sin, and its expiation is that it should be buried.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Masjid mein thookna gunah hai, aur iska kaffara ye hai ki use dafan kar diya jaye.

e: Shu'ba reported: I asked Qatada about spitting, in the mosque. He said: I heard Anas b. Malik say: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: Spitting in the mosque is a sin, and its expiation is that it should be buried.
hi: Shu'ba ne bayan kiya: Maine Qatada se masjid mein thookne ke baare mein poocha. Unhone kaha: Maine Anas bin Malik ko kehte suna: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: Masjid mein thookna gunah hai, aur iska kaffara ye hai ki use dafan kar diya jaye.

e: Abu Dharr reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) said: The deeds of my people, good and bad, were presented before me, and I found the removal of something objectionable from the road among their good deeds, and the sputum mucus left unburied in the mosque among their evil deeds.
hi: Abu Dharr (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Meri ummat ke aamaal, ache aur bure, mere saamne pesh kiye gaye, aur maine unke achhe aamaal mein raste se takleefdeh cheez hataana paaya, aur unke bure aamaal mein masjid mein bina dafan kiya thook ya balgham chhod dena paaya.

e: Abdullah b. Shakhkhir reported on the authority of his father that he said: I said prayer with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and saw him spitting and rubbing it off with his shoe.
hi: Abdullah bin Shakhkhir (RA) ne apne walid ke hawale se bayan kiya ki unhone kaha: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath namaz padhi aur unhe thookte aur apne joote se use mal te hue dekha.

e: 'Abdullah b. Shakhkhir narrated it on the authority of his father that he said prayer with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and he spat and then rubbed it off with his left shoe.
hi: Abdullah bin Shakhkhir ne apne walid ke hawale se ye riwayat ki ki unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath namaz padhi, aur unhone thooka aur phir apne baaye joote se use mal diya.

e: Sa'd b. Yazid reported: I said to Anas b. Malik: Did the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) pray while putting on the shoes? He said: Yes.
hi: Sa'd bin Yazid ne bayan kiya: Maine Anas bin Malik se poocha: Kya Rasoolullah (SAW) joote pehen kar namaz padhte the? Unhone kaha: Haan.

e: Sa'd b. Yazid Abu Mas'ama reported: I said to Anas like (that mentioned above).
hi: Sa'd bin Yazid Abu Mas'ama ne bayan kiya: Maine Anas se ye upar jaisa hi poocha.

e: 'A'isha reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) prayed in a garment which had designs over it, so he (the Holy Prophet) said: Take it to Abu Jahm and bring me a plain blanket from him, because its designs have distracted me.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne ek aise kapde mein namaz padhi jispar naqsh (design) bane the, to unhone farmaya: Ise Abu Jahm ke paas le jao aur unse ek sada kambal le aao, kyunki iske naqshon ne mera dhyan bhatka diya.

e: 'A'isha reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stood for prayer with a garment which had designs over it. He looked at these designs and after completing the prayer said: Take this garment to Abu Jahm b. Hudhaifa and bring me a blanket for it has distracted me just now.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) namaz ke liye khade hue ek aise kapde mein jispar naqsh the. Unhone in naqshon ko dekha aur namaz mukammal karne ke baad farmaya: Ye kapda Abu Jahm bin Hudhaifa ke paas le jao aur mujhe iske badle ek kambal le aao, kyunki isne abhi mera dhyan bhatka diya.

e: 'A'isha reported: The Apostle of Allah (way peace be upon him) had a garment which had designs upon it and this distracted him in prayer. He gave it to Abu Jahm and took a plain garment in its place which is known anbijaniya.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas ek aisa kapda tha jispar naqsh the aur isne namaz mein unka dhyan bhatka diya. Unhone use Abu Jahm ko de diya aur uske badle ek sada kapda le liya jise "anbijaniya" kaha jata hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: When the supper is brought and the prayer begins, one, should first take food.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Jab khana laaya jaye aur namaz bhi shuru ho jaye, to pehle khana khaana chahiye.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When the supper is brought before you, and it is also the time to say prayer, first take food before saying evening prayer and do not hasten (to prayer, leaving aside the food).
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab tumhare saamne khana laaya jaye aur namaz ka bhi waqt ho jaye, to maghrib ki namaz se pehle khana khao aur jaldi na karo, khana chhodkar namaz ke liye.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Anas by another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Anas (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When the supper is served to any one of you and the prayer also begins. (in such a case) first take supper, and do not make haste (for prayer) till you have (taken the food).
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab tum mein se kisi ke saamne khana pesh kiya jaye aur namaz bhi shuru ho jaye, to pehle khana khao aur jab tak khana na kha lo, jaldi na karo.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the authority of Ibn 'Umar with another chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Rasoolullah (SAW) se Ibn Umar (RA) ki sanad se, ek doosri sanad ke zariye bhi bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn Atiq reported: Al-Qasim was in the presence of 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) that I narrated a hadith and Qasim was a man who committed errors in (pronouncing words) and his mother was a freed slave-girl. 'A'isha said to him: What is the matter with you that you do not narrate as this son of my brother narrated (the ahaditb)? Well I know from where you picked it up. This is how his mother brought him up and how your mother brought you up. Qasim felt angry (on this remark of Hadrat 'A'isha) and showed bitterness towards her. When he saw that the table had been spread for 'A'isha, he stood up, 'A'isha, said: Where are you going? He said: (I am going) to say prayer. She said: Sit down (to take the food). He said: I must say prayer. She said: Sit down, ) faithless, for I have heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: No prayer can be (rightly said) when the food is there (before the worshipper), or when he is prompted by the call of nature.
hi: Ibn Atiq ne bayan kiya: Qasim Aisha (RA) ke paas maujood the ki maine ek hadees bayan ki aur Qasim ek aise shakhs the jo alfaaz ke uchcharan mein galtiyan karte the aur unki maa ek azaad ki hui laundi thi. Aisha ne unse kaha: Tumhe kya hua hai ki tum waise hadees bayan nahi karte jaise mere bhatije ne bayan ki? Mujhe pata hai tumne ye kahan se seekha. Aisi hi tumhari maa ne tumhari parvarish ki aur waisi hi is larke ki maa ne uski parvarish ki. Qasim ko is baat par gussa aaya aur unhone Aisha ke prati naraazgi zahir ki. Jab unhone dekha ki Aisha ke liye dastarkhwan bicha diya gaya hai, to woh khade ho gaye. Aisha ne kaha: Kahan ja rahe ho? Unhone kaha: Namaz padhne. Unhone kaha: Baith jao, khana khane ke liye. Unhone kaha: Mujhe namaz padhni hai. Unhone kaha: Baith jao, aye kam-aitqaad! Kyunki maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko farmate suna hai: Koi namaz sahih nahi hoti jab khana namazi ke saamne ho, ya jab use paishaab-paakhana ki hajat ho.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Atiq narrated from the Apostle (ﷺ) on the authority of 'A'isha, but he made no mention of the account of Qasim.
hi: Abdullah bin Atiq ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se Aisha (RA) ki sanad se ye riwayat ki, lekin unhone Qasim ke waaqiye ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said during the battle of Khaybar: He who ate of this plant, i. e. garlic, should not come to the mosques. In the narration of Zubair, there is only a mention of" battle" and not of Khaybar.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Khaybar ki jung ke dauran farmaya: Jo koi is paudhe, yaani lehsun, ko khaye, use masjidon mein nahi aana chahiye. Zubair ki riwayat mein sirf "jung" ka zikr hai, "Khaybar" ka nahi.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: He who eats of this (offensive) plant must not approach our mosque, till its odor dies: (plant signifies) garlic.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jo is badbudaar paudhe ko khaye, use hamari masjid ke paas tab tak nahi aana chahiye jab tak iski badboo khatam na ho jaye: paudha matlab lehsun.

e: Ibn Suhaib reported: Anas was asked about the garlic; he stated that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had said: He who eats of this plant (garlic) should not approach us and pray along with us.
hi: Ibn Suhaib ne bayan kiya: Anas (RA) se lehsun ke baare mein poocha gaya; unhone bataya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya tha: Jo is paudhe (lehsun) ko khaye, use hamare paas nahi aana chahiye aur hamare saath namaz nahi padhni chahiye.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: He who eats of this plant (garlic) should not approach our mosque and should not harm us with the odour of garlic.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jo is paudhe (lehsun) ko khaye, use hamari masjid ke paas nahi aana chahiye aur lehsun ki badboo se hamein taklif nahi deni chahiye.

e: Jabir reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade eating of onions and leek. When we were overpowered by a desire (to eat) we ate them. Upon this he (the Holy Prophet) said: He who eats of this offensive plant must not approach our mosque, for the angels are harmed by the same things as men.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne pyaaz aur gandana (leek) khane se mana kiya tha. Jab humpar khane ki khwahish ghalib aa gayi to humne unhe kha liya. Isper unhone farmaya: Jo is badbudaar paudhe ko khaye, use hamari masjid ke paas nahi aana chahiye, kyunki farishton ko bhi unhi cheezon se taklif hoti hai jinse insaanon ko hoti hai.

e: Jabir reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: He who eats garlic or onion should remain away from us or from our mosque and stay in his house. A kettle was brought to him which had (cooked) vegetables in it, He smelt (offensive) odour in it. On asking he was informed of the vegetables (cooked in it). He said: Take it to such and such Companion. When he saw it, he also disliked eating it. (Upon this). he (the Holy Prophet) said: You may eat it, for I converse wkh one with whom you do not converse.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jo lehsun ya pyaaz khaye, use hamse ya hamari masjid se door rehna chahiye aur apne ghar mein baithna chahiye. Unke paas ek deg laayi gayi jismein sabziyan pakayi hui thi. Unhone usmein badboo mahsoos ki. Poochne par unhe usmein pakayi gayi sabziyon ke baare mein bataya gaya. Unhone farmaya: Ise falan sahabi ke paas le jao. Jab unhone use dekha, to unhe bhi use khana pasand nahi aaya. Isper Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Tum ise kha sakte ho, kyunki main us hasti se guftagu karta hoon jisse tum guftagu nahi karte.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) mying: He who eats of this (offensive) plant, i. e garlic, and sometirres he said: He who eats onion and garlic and leek, should not approach our mosque for the angels are harmed by the same things as the children of Adam.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Jo is badbudaar paudhe, yaani lehsun ko khaye - aur kabhi kabhi unhone kaha: Jo pyaaz, lehsun aur gandana khaye - use hamari masjid ke paas nahi aana chahiye kyunki farishton ko bhi unhi cheezon se taklif hoti hai jinse Aadam ki aulaad ko hoti hai.

e: Ibn Juraij has narrated it with the same chain of transmitters: He who eats of this plant, i. e. garlic, should not come to us in our mosque, and he made no mention of onions or leek.
hi: Ibn Juraij ne isi sanad se ye riwayat ki hai: Jo is paudhe, yaani lehsun ko khaye, use hamari masjid mein hamare paas nahi aana chahiye, aur unhone pyaaz ya gandane ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: Abu Sa'id reported: We made no transgression but Khaybar was conquered. We, the Companions of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), fell upon this plant. i e. garlic. because the people were hungry. We ate it to our heart's content and then made our way towards the mosque. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sensed its odour and he said: He who takes anything of this offensive plant must not approach us in the mosque. The people said: Its (use) has been forbidden; its (use) bu been forbidden. This reached the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he said: O people, I cannot forbid (the use of a thing) which Allah has made lawful, but (this garlic) is a plant the odour of which is repugnant to me.
hi: Abu Sa'id (RA) ne bayan kiya: Humne koi ziyadti nahi ki, balki Khaybar fatah ho gaya tha. Hum, Rasoolullah (SAW) ke sahaba, is paudhe yaani lehsun par toot pade kyunki log bhookhe the. Humne ise jee bhar kar khaya aur phir masjid ki taraf chal diye. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne iski badboo mahsoos ki aur farmaya: Jo is badbudaar paudhe mein se kuch bhi khaye, use masjid mein hamare paas nahi aana chahiye. Logon ne kaha: Iska istemal mana kar diya gaya hai, iska istemal mana kar diya gaya hai. Ye baat Rasoolullah (SAW) tak pahunchi aur unhone farmaya: Aye logo, main us cheez ko haram nahi kar sakta jise Allah ne halal kiya hai, lekin ye lehsun aisa paudha hai jiski badboo mujhe naapasand hai.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) along with his Companions happened to pass by a field in which onions were sown. The people stopped there and ate out of that, but some of them did not eat. Then they (Propbet's Companions) went to him. He (first) called those who had not eaten the onions and kept the others (who had taken onions) waiting till its odour vanished.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) apne sahaba ke saath ek aise khet ke paas se guzre jismein pyaaz boya gaya tha. Log wahan ruke aur usmein se khaya, lekin unmein se kuch ne nahi khaya. Phir woh sahaba unke paas gaye. Unhone pehle un logon ko bulaya jinhone pyaaz nahi khaya tha, aur baaki jinhone pyaaz khaya tha unko intezaar karwaya jab tak uski badboo khatam na ho gayi.

e: Ma'dan b. Talha reported: 'Umar b. Khattab, delivered the Friday sermon and he made a mention of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr. He (further) said: I saw in a dream that a cock pecked me twice, and I perceive that my death is near. Some people have suggested me to appoint my successor. And Allah would not destroy His religion. His caliphate and that with which He sent His Apostle (ﷺ) If death approaches me soon, the (issue) of Caliphate (would be decided) by the consent of these six men with whom the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) remained well pleased till his death. And I know fully well that some people would blame me that I killed with these very hands of mine some persons who apparently professed (Islam). And if they do this (blame me) they are the enemies of Allah, and are non-believers and have gone astray. And I leave not after me anything which to my mind seems more important than Kalala. And I never turned towards the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) (for guidance) more often than this Kalala, and he (the Holy Prophet) was not annoyed with me on any other (issue) than this: (And he was so perturbed) that he struck his fingers on my chest and said: Does this verse. that is at the end of Surat al-Nisa'. which was revealed in the hot season not suffice you? And if I live longer I would decide this (problem so clearly) that one who reads the Qur'an, or one who does not read it, would be able to take (correct), decisions (under its light). He ('Umar) further said: Allah! I call You witness on these governors of lands, that I sent them to (the peoples of these lands) so that they should administer justice amongst them, teach them their religion and the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and distribute amongst them the spoils of war and refer to me that which they find difficult to perform. O people. you eat 'these two plants and these are onions and garlic. and I find them nothing but repugnant for I saw that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sensed the odour of these two from a person in a mosque, he was made to go to al-Baqi'. So he who eats it should (make its odour) die by cooking it well.
hi: Ma'dan bin Talha ne bayan kiya: Umar bin Khattab (RA) ne jumma ka khutba diya aur unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) aur Abu Bakr (RA) ka zikr kiya. Unhone aage kaha: Maine khwaab mein dekha ki ek murgha mujhe do baar chonch maar raha hai, aur mujhe lagta hai ki meri maut qareeb hai. Kuch logon ne mujhe apna jaanshin muqarrar karne ka mashwara diya hai. Aur Allah apne deen, apni khilafat, aur us cheez ko jiske saath Usne apne Rasool (SAW) ko bheja, zaya nahi karega. Agar meri maut jald aa gayi, to khilafat ka faisla un chhe logon ki raza-mandi se hoga jinse Rasoolullah (SAW) apni maut tak khush rahe. Aur mujhe achhi tarah pata hai ki kuch log mujhpar ilzaam lagayenge ki maine apne hi haathon se un logon ko qatal kiya jo zaahiri taur par Islam ka izhaar karte the. Aur agar woh aisa ilzaam lagate hain, to woh Allah ke dushman hain, kaafir hain aur gumraah hain. Aur main apne peeche is se zyada ahem koi masla nahi chhod raha jitna "kalala" ka masla hai. Aur maine Rasoolullah (SAW) se is kalala ke baare mein jitni baar hidayat maangi utni kisi aur cheez ke baare mein nahi maangi, aur woh mujhse kisi aur maamle par utne naraaz nahi hue jitna is par hue - itna ki unhone apni ungliyan mere seene par maar kar farmaya: Kya Surah An-Nisa ke aakhir mein utri ye aayat, jo garmi ke mausam mein nazil hui, tumhare liye kaafi nahi hai? Aur agar main aur jeeyunga to is masle ka aisa saaf faisla karunga ki jo Quran padhta ho ya na padhta ho, dono is roshni mein sahi faisla le sakenge. Unhone aage kaha: Aye Allah! Main tujhe in mulkon ke gavarnaron par gawaah banata hoon ki maine unhe is liye bheja taaki woh logon ke darmiyan insaaf karein, unhe unka deen aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ki Sunnat sikhayein, aur maal-e-ganimat unmein baant dein, aur jo cheez unhe mushkil lage woh mujhse rujoo karein. Aye logo, tum in do paudhon ko khate ho - yaani pyaaz aur lehsun - aur mujhe ye sirf naapasand lagte hain, kyunki maine dekha ki jab Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kisi shakhs mein masjid ke andar in dono ki badboo mahsoos ki, to use Baqi qabristan bhejwa diya gaya. Is liye jo ise khaye use pakakar iski badboo khatam kar deni chahiye.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Qatada with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Qatada ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: If anyone hears a man crying out in the mosque about something he has lost, he should say: May Allah not restore it to you, for the mosques were not built for this.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Agar koi kisi shakhs ko masjid mein apni khoyi hui cheez ke baare mein pukarte hue sune, to use kehna chahiye: Allah tumhe ye wapas na de, kyunki masjid iske liye nahi banayi gayi.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying like this.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko isi tarah farmate hue riwayat kiya.

e: Sulaiman b. Buraida narrated it on the authority of his father that a man cried out in the mosque saying: Who had called out for the red camel? Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: May it not be restored to you! The mosques are built for what they are meant.
hi: Sulaiman bin Buraida ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki ek shakhs ne masjid mein pukar kar kaha: Kisne laal oont ke liye awaaz lagayi thi? Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Tumhe wapas na mile! Masjid usi kaam ke liye banayi gayi hai jiske liye woh banayi gayi.

e: Sulaiman b. Buraida reported on the authority of his father that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had said prayer a man stood up and said: Who called for a red camel? (Upon this) the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: May it not be restored to you! The mosques are built for what they are meant.
hi: Sulaiman bin Buraida ne apne walid ke hawale se bayan kiya ki jab Rasoolullah (SAW) ne namaz padh li to ek shakhs khada hua aur kaha: Kisne laal oont ke liye pukara tha? Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Tumhe wapas na mile! Masjid usi kaam ke liye banayi gayi hai jiske liye woh banayi gayi.

e:
Ibn Buraida narrated it on the authority of his father that a Bedouin came when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had completed the morning prayer. He thrust his head in the door of the mosque, and then the hadith (as narrated above) was narrated.
This hadith has been reported by another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ibn Buraida ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki ek badawi us waqt aaya jab Rasoolullah (SAW) fajr ki namaz mukammal kar chuke the. Usne masjid ke darwaze se apna sar andar dala, aur phir wahi hadees bayan ki gayi jaisa upar bayan hui. Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When any one of you stands up to pray, the devil comes to him and confuses him to that he does not know how much he has prayed. If any one of you has such an experience he should perform two prostrations while sitting down (in qa'da).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab tum mein se koi namaz ke liye khada hota hai, to shaitaan uske paas aata hai aur use uljha deta hai taaki use pata na chale ki usne kitni namaz padhi hai. Agar tum mein se kisi ke saath aisa ho, to use baithe-baithe qaada mein do sajde karne chahiye.

e: This hadith has been narrated by al-Zubri with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees al-Zuhri ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When there is a call to prayer the devil runs back breaking the wind so that he may not hear the call, and when the call is complete he comes back. And when the takbir is pronounced he again runs back, and when takbir is over he comes back and distracts a man saying: Remember such and such, remember such and such, referring to something the man did not have in his mind. with the result that he does not know how much he has prayed; so when any one of you is not sure how much he has prayed. he should perform two prostrations while sitting (qa'da).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab azaan hoti hai to shaitaan hawa kharij karte hue peeche bhaag jata hai taaki azaan na sune, aur jab azaan khatam ho jaati hai to woh wapas aa jata hai. Aur jab takbeer kahi jaati hai to woh phir bhaag jata hai, aur jab takbeer khatam ho jaati hai to woh wapas aakar aadmi ko uljhata hai aur kehta hai: Fulan cheez yaad karo, fulan cheez yaad karo - un cheezon ka zikr karke jo us shakhs ke dimaag mein pehle se nahi thi, jiske natije mein use pata nahi chalta ki usne kitni namaz padhi. Is liye jab tum mein se koi ye na jaan sake ki usne kitni namaz padhi hai, to use baithe-baithe qaada mein do sajde karne chahiye.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The devil takes to his heels breaking wind when the prayer begins. and the rest is the same but with this addition:" He (the devil) makes him think of pleasant things (or things productive of enjoyment) and of the things wished for, and reminds him of such needs which he had forgotten."
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Shaitaan hawa kharij karte hue bhaag jata hai jab namaz shuru hoti hai, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai lekin is izafe ke saath: "Woh shaitaan use pasandeeda cheezon (ya lutf-andoz karne wali cheezon) ke baare mein sochne par majboor karta hai aur un khwahishon ki yaad dilata hai jo aadmi bhool chuka tha."

e: 'Abdullah b. Buhaina reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led us two rak'ahs of prayer in one of the (obligatory) prayers and then got up and did not sit. and the people stood up along with him. When he finished the prayer and we expected him to pronounce salutation. he said:" Allah is Most Great" while sitting and made two prostrations before salutation and then pronounced (the, final) salutation.
hi: Abdullah bin Buhaina (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne humein kisi farz namaz mein do rakat padhayin aur phir khade ho gaye aur baithe nahi, aur log bhi unke saath khade ho gaye. Jab unhone namaz mukammal ki aur hum ummeed kar rahe the ki woh salaam pheerenge, to unhone baithe-baithe "Allahu Akbar" kaha aur salaam se pehle do sajde kiye, phir aakhri salaam pheera.

e: 'Abdullah b. Buhaina al-Asadi, the ally of Abual-Muttalib, reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stood up in the noon prayer (though) he hadith sit (after the two rak'ahs). When he completed the prayer he performed two prostrations and said," Allah is the Most Great" in each prostration, while he was sitting before pronouncing salutation, and the people performed prostration along with him. That was a compensation for he had forgotten to observe jalsa (after two rak'ahs).
hi: Abdullah bin Buhaina al-Asadi, Abu'l-Muttalib ke halif, ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) zohar ki namaz mein khade ho gaye halanki unhe do rakaton ke baad baithna chahiye tha. Jab unhone namaz mukammal ki to do sajde kiye aur har sajde mein "Allahu Akbar" kaha, jabki woh salaam pheerne se pehle baithe hue the, aur log bhi unke saath sajda karne lage. Ye is baat ki bharpayi thi ki woh jalsa - do rakaton ke baad baithna - bhool gaye the.

e: 'Abdullah b. Malik ibn Buhaina al-Asadi reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stood up (at the end of two rak'ahs) when he had to sit and proceeded on with the prayer. But when he was at the end of the prayer, he performed a prostration before the salutation and then pronounced the salutation.
hi: Abdullah bin Malik ibn Buhaina al-Asadi (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) khade ho gaye, do rakaton ke akhir mein, jab unhe baithna chahiye tha, aur namaz jaari rakhi. Lekin jab woh namaz ke akhir mein pahunche, to unhone salaam se pehle ek sajda kiya aur phir salaam pheera.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When any one of you is in doubt about his prayer and he does Dot know how much he has prayed, three or four (rak'ahs). he should cast aside his doubt and base his prayer on what he is sure of. then perform two prostrations before giving salutations. If he has prayed five rak'ahs, they will make his prayer an even number for him, and if he has prayed exactly four, they will be humiliation for the devil.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab tum mein se koi apni namaz ke baare mein shaq mein pad jaye aur use pata na chale ki usne kitni namaz padhi hai, teen ya chaar rakat, to use apna shaq chhod dena chahiye aur us baat par apni namaz ki buniyaad rakhni chahiye jispar use yaqeen ho, phir salaam se pehle do sajde karne chahiye. Agar usne paanch rakat padhi hai, to ye sajde uski namaz ko juft bana denge, aur agar usne theek chaar padhi hai, to ye shaitaan ke liye zillat hoga.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Zaid b. Aslam with the same chain of transmitters and he said: He should perform two prostrations before the salutation, as it was mentioned by Sulaiman b. Bilal.
hi: Ye hadees Zaid bin Aslam ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai aur unhone kaha: Use salaam se pehle do sajde karne chahiye, jaisa Sulaiman bin Bilal ne zikr kiya.

e: 'Alqama narrated It on the authority of 'Abdullah (b. Mas'ud) who said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said the prayer; (the narrator added): He made some act of omission or commission when he pronounced salutation; it was said to him: Messenger of Allah, is there something new about the prayer? He (the Holy Prophet) said: What is it? They said: You said prayer in such and such away. He (the narrator) said: He (the Holy Prophet) turned his feet and faced the Qibla and performed two prostrations and then pronounced salutations, and then turned his face towards us and said: If there is anything new about prayer (new command from the Lord) I informed you of that. But I am a human being and I forget as you for. get, so when I forget, remind me, and when any one of you is in doubt about his prayer. he should aim at what Is correct. and complete his prayer in that respect and then make two prostrations.
hi: Alqama ne Abdullah (bin Mas'ud) ke hawale se ye riwayat ki ki unhone kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne namaz padhi; raawi ne izafa kiya: Unse salaam pheerte waqt kuch chhoot gaya ya ziyada ho gaya; unse kaha gaya: Ya Rasoolullah, kya namaz mein koi nayi baat hui hai? Unhone farmaya: Kya baat hai? Unhone kaha: Aapne is-is tarah namaz padhi. Raawi ne kaha: Unhone apne paon mode aur Qibla ki taraf rukh kiya aur do sajde kiye, phir salaam pheera, aur phir hamari taraf mudkar farmaya: Agar namaz ke baare mein koi nayi baat hoti, to main tumhe zaroor bata deta. Lekin main bhi ek insaan hoon aur tumhari tarah bhoolta hoon, is liye jab main bhoolun, to mujhe yaad dilao, aur jab tum mein se koi apni namaz ke baare mein shaq mein ho, to use us baat ko apnana chahiye jo sahih ho, aur usi hisaab se apni namaz mukammal karni chahiye, phir do sajde karne chahiye.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Mansur with the same chain of transmitters, with a slight modification of words.
hi: Ye hadees Mansur ne isi sanad se, thodi si alfaaz ki tabdeeli ke saath bayan ki hai.

e: This hadith is reported by Mansur with the same chain of transmitters, but with these words: " He should aim at correct (prayer) and it is advisable."
hi: Ye hadees Mansur ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai, lekin in alfaaz ke saath: "Use sahih namaz ka irada karna chahiye aur ye mustahsan hai."

e: This hadith has been narrated by Mansur with the same chain of transmitters with the words: He should aim at what is correct and complete."
hi: Ye hadees Mansur ne isi sanad se in alfaaz ke saath bayan ki hai: Use us baat ka irada karna chahiye jo sahih ho aur mukammal ho.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Mansur with the same chain of transmitters and said: " He should aim at correctness and that is right."
hi: Ye hadees Mansur ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai aur kaha: "Use sahih hone ka irada karna chahiye aur yehi durust hai."

e: This hadith has been reported by Mansur with the same chain of transwitters and he said: " He should aim at what is according to him correct."
hi: Ye hadees Mansur ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai aur unhone kaha: "Use us baat ka irada karna chahiye jo uske nazdeek sahih ho."

e: This hadith has been narrated by Mansur and he said: " He should aim at correctness."
hi: Ye hadees Mansur ne bayan ki hai aur unhone kaha: "Use sahih hone ka irada karna chahiye."
