e: 'Abdullah (b. Mas'ud) reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) said five rak'ahs of the noon prayer and when he completed the prayer, It was said to him: Has there been (commanded) an addition In prayer? He said: What is it? They said: You have said five rak'ahs, so he performed two prostrations.
hi: Abdullah (bin Mas'ud) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne zohar ki namaz paanch rakat padhi aur jab unhone namaz mukammal ki, to unse kaha gaya: Kya namaz mein koi izafa hua hai? Unhone farmaya: Kya baat hai? Unhone kaha: Aapne paanch rakat padhi hain, to unhone do sajde kiye.

e: Alqama reported: He (the Holy Prophet) had led them five rak'ahs in prayer.
hi: Alqama ne bayan kiya: Unhone Nabi (SAW) ne unhe paanch rakat namaz padhayi thi.

e: Ibrahim b. Suwaid-reported: 'Alqama led us in the noon prayer and be offered five rak'ahs; when the prayer was complete, the people said to him: Abu Shibl, you have offered five rak'ahs. He said: No, I have not done that. They said: Yes (you said five rak'ahs). He (the narrator) said: And I was sitting in a corner among people and I was just a boy. I (also) said: Yes, you have offered five (rak'ahs). He said to me: O, one-eyed, do you say the same thing? I said: Yes. Upon this he turned (his face) and performed two prostrations and then gave salutations, and then reported 'Abdullah as saying: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led us in prayer and offered five rak'ahs. And as he turned away the people began to whisper amongst themselves. He (the Holy Prophet) said: What is the matter with you? They said: Has the prayer been extended? He said: No. They said: You have in fact said five rak'ahs. He (the Holy Prophet) then turned his back (and faced the Qibla) and performed two prostrations and then gave salutations and further said: Verily I am a human being like you, I forget just as you forget. Ibn Numair made this addition:" When any one of you forgets, he must perform two prostrations."
hi: Ibrahim bin Suwaid ne bayan kiya: Alqama ne humein zohar ki namaz padhayi aur unhone paanch rakat padhayin; jab namaz mukammal ho gayi, to logon ne unse kaha: Aye Abu Shibl, aapne paanch rakat padhi hain. Unhone kaha: Nahi, maine aisa nahi kiya. Unhone kaha: Haan, aapne paanch rakat padhi. Raawi ne kaha: Aur main ek konay mein logon ke beech baitha tha aur sirf ek larka tha. Maine bhi kaha: Haan, aapne paanch rakat padhi hain. Unhone mujhse kaha: Aye kaane! Kya tum bhi yehi kehte ho? Maine kaha: Haan. Isper unhone rukh mudkar do sajde kiye aur phir salaam pheera, aur phir Abdullah bin Mas'ud se ye riwayat ki: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne humein namaz padhayi aur paanch rakat padhi. Aur jab woh mude to log aapas mein khusar-phusar karne lage. Unhone farmaya: Tumhe kya hua hai? Unhone kaha: Kya namaz badha di gayi hai? Unhone farmaya: Nahi. Unhone kaha: Aapne to paanch rakat padhi hain. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne rukh mudkar, Qibla ki taraf, do sajde kiye aur phir salaam pheera, aur aage farmaya: Yaqeenan main bhi tumhari tarah ek insaan hoon, main bhoolta hoon jaise tum bhoolte ho. Ibn Numair ne ye izafa kiya: "Jab tum mein se koi bhoole, to use do sajde karne chahiye."

e: 'Abdullah (b. Mas'ud) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led us five (rak'ahs in prayer). We said: Messenger of Allah, has the prayer been extended? He said: What is the matter? They said: You have said five (rak'ahs). He (the Holy Prophet) said: Verily I am a human being like you. I remember as you remember and I forget just as you forget. He then performed two prostrations as (compensation of) forgetfulness.
hi: Abdullah (bin Mas'ud) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne humein paanch rakat namaz padhayi. Humne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, kya namaz badha di gayi hai? Unhone farmaya: Kya baat hai? Unhone kaha: Aapne paanch rakat padhi hain. Unhone farmaya: Yaqeenan main bhi tumhari tarah ek insaan hoon. Main yaad rakhta hoon jaise tum yaad rakhte ho aur bhoolta hoon jaise tum bhoolte ho. Phir unhone bhool ki bharpayi ke taur par do sajde kiye.

e: 'Abdullah (b. Mas'ud) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said prayer and he omitted or committed (something). Ibrahim (one of the narrators of this hadith) said: It is my doubt, and it was said: Messenger of Allah, has there been any addition to the prayer? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Verily I am a human being like you. I forget just as you forget so when any one of you forgets, he must perform two prostrations, and he (the Holy Prophet) was sitting and then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) turned (his face towards the Qibla) and performed two prostrations.
hi: Abdullah (bin Mas'ud) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne namaz padhi aur unse kuch chhoot gaya ya ziyada ho gaya. Ibrahim, is hadees ke ek raawi, ne kaha: Ye mera hi shaq hai, aur kaha gaya: Ya Rasoolullah, kya namaz mein koi izafa hua hai? Unhone farmaya: Yaqeenan main bhi tumhari tarah ek insaan hoon. Main bhoolta hoon jaise tum bhoolte ho, is liye jab tum mein se koi bhoole, to use do sajde karne chahiye, aur woh Nabi (SAW) baithe hue the aur phir Rasoolullah (SAW) ne rukh mudkar do sajde kiye.

e: 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) performed two prostrations for forgetfulness after salutation and talking.
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne salaam pheerne aur baat karne ke baad bhool ki wajah se do sajde kiye.

e: Abdullah reported: We prayed along with the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) and he committed or omitted (something). Ibrahim said: By Allah, this is a misgiving of mine only. We said: Messenger of Allah, is there something new about the prayer? He (the Holy Prophet) said: No. We told him about what he had done. He (the Holy Prophet) said: When a man commits or omits (something in prayer), he should perform two prostrations, and he then himself performed two prostrations.
hi: Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Humne Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath namaz padhi aur unse kuch ziyada ho gaya ya chhoot gaya. Ibrahim ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, ye sirf mera hi shaq hai. Humne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, kya namaz mein koi nayi baat hai? Unhone farmaya: Nahi. Humne unhe bataya ki unhone kya kiya tha. Unhone farmaya: Jab koi shakhs namaz mein kuch ziyada ya kam kar de, to use do sajde karne chahiye, aur phir unhone khud do sajde kiye.

e: Ibn Sirin reported Abu Huraira as saying: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led us in one of the two evening prayers, Zuhr or `Asr, and gave salutations after two rak`ahs and going towards a piece of wood which was placed to the direction of the Qibla in the mosque, leaned on it looking as if he were angry. Abu Bakr and `Umar were among the people and they were too afraid to speak to him and the people came out in haste (saying): The prayer has been shortened. But among them was a man called Dhul-Yadain who said: Messenger of Allah, has the prayer been shortened or have you forgotten? The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) looked to the right and left and said: What was Dhul-Yadain saying? They said: He is right. You (the Holy Prophet) offered but two rak`ahs. He offered two (more) rak`ahs and gave salutation, then said takbir and prostrated and lifted (his head) and then said takbir and prostrated, then said takbir and lifted (his head). He (the narrator) says: It has been reported to me by `Imran b. Husain that he said: He (then) gave salutation.
hi: Ibn Sirin ne Abu Huraira (RA) ke hawale se bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne humein do namazon mein se ek, zohar ya asr, padhayi aur do rakaton ke baad salaam pheer diya aur ek lakdi ke tukde ki taraf gaye jo masjid mein Qibla ki taraf rakhi thi, uspar takiya lagaya, aisa lagta tha jaise woh naraaz hon. Abu Bakr aur Umar log mein maujood the aur unse baat karne se dar rahe the aur log jaldi mein bahar nikal gaye kehte hue: Namaz kam kar di gayi hai. Lekin unmein Dhul-Yadain naam ka ek shakhs tha jisne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, kya namaz kam ho gayi ya aap bhool gaye? Rasoolullah (SAW) ne daayen aur baayen dekha aur farmaya: Dhul-Yadain kya keh rahe the? Unhone kaha: Woh theek keh rahe hain. Aapne sirf do rakat padhi hain. Unhone do aur rakat padhi aur salaam pheera, phir takbeer kahi aur sajda kiya aur sar utha liya, phir takbeer kahi aur sajda kiya, phir takbeer kahi aur sar utha liya. Raawi kehte hain: Mujhe Imran bin Husain ne bataya ki unhone kaha: Phir unhone salaam pheera.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led us in one of the evening prayers. And this hadith was narrated like one transmitted by Sufyan.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne humein sham ki namazon mein se ek padhayi. Aur ye hadees Sufyan ki bayan ki hui hadees jaisi hi bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led us in the 'Asr prayer and gave salutation after two rak'ahs. Dhu'l-Yadain (the possessor of long arms) stood up and said: Messenger of Allah, has the prayer been shortened or have you forgotten? The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Nothing like this has happened (neither the prayer has been shortened nor have I forgotten). He (Dhu'l-Yadain) said: Messenger of Allah, something has definitely happened. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) turned towards people and said: Is Dhu'l-Yadain true (in his assertion)? They said: Messenger of Allah, he is true. Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) completed the rest of the prayer. and then performed two prostrations while he was sitting after salutation.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne humein asr ki namaz padhayi aur do rakaton ke baad salaam pheer diya. Dhul-Yadain khade hue aur kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, kya namaz kam kar di gayi ya aap bhool gaye? Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Aisa kuch nahi hua hai. Unhone kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, zaroor kuch hua hai. Rasoolullah (SAW) logon ki taraf mude aur farmaya: Kya Dhul-Yadain sach keh rahe hain? Unhone kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, woh sach keh rahe hain. Phir Rasoolullah (SAW) ne baaki namaz mukammal ki, aur phir salaam ke baad baithe-baithe do sajde kiye.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said two rak'ahs of the noon prayer and then gave salutation when a man from Band Sulaim came to him and said: Messenger of Allah. has the prayer been shortened, or have you forgotten? -and the rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne zohar ki namaz ke do rakat padhe aur salaam pheer diya jab Banu Sulaim ke ek shakhs unke paas aaya aur kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, kya namaz kam kar di gayi hai, ya aap bhool gaye? - aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: I offered with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) the noon prayer and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) gave salutation after two rak'ahs. A person from Bani Sulaim stood up, and the rest of the hadith was narrated as mentioned above.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath zohar ki namaz padhi aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ne do rakaton ke baad salaam pheer diya. Banu Sulaim ka ek shakhs khada hua, aur baaki hadees waisi hi bayan ki gayi jaisi upar zikr hui.

e: 'Imran b. Husain reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said the afternoon prayer and gave the salutation. at the end of three rak'ahs and then went into his house. A man called al-Khirbaq, who bad long aims, got up and went to him, and addressed him as Messenger of Allah and mentioned to him what he had done. He came out angrily trailing his mantle, and when he came to the people he said: Is this man telling the truth? They said: Yes. He then said one rak'ah and then gave salutation and then performed two prostrations and then gave salutation.
hi: Imran bin Husain (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne asr ki namaz padhi aur teen rakaton ke akhir mein salaam pheer diya aur phir apne ghar chale gaye. Al-Khirbaq naam ka ek shakhs, jinke haath lambe the, khade hue aur unke paas gaye, aur unhe "Ya Rasoolullah" kehkar mukhatib kiya aur unhe bataya ki unhone kya kiya tha. Woh gusse mein apni chadar ghaseette hue bahar aaye, aur jab woh logon ke paas pahunche to unhone kaha: Kya ye shakhs sach keh raha hai? Unhone kaha: Haan. Phir unhone ek rakat padhi aur salaam pheera, phir do sajde kiye aur phir salaam pheera.

e: Imran b. Husain reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said three rak'ahs of the 'Asr prayer and then got up and went to his apartment. A man possessing large arms stood up and said: Messenger of Allah, bias the player been shortened? He came out angrily, and said the rak'ah which he had omitted and then gave salutation. then performed two prostrations of forgetfulness and then gave salutation.
hi: Imran bin Husain (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne asr ki namaz teen rakat padhi aur phir khade hokar apne kamre ki taraf chale gaye. Lambe haathon wale ek shakhs khade hue aur kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, kya namaz kam kar di gayi hai? Woh gusse mein bahar aaye, aur woh rakat padhi jo unse chhoot gayi thi, phir salaam pheera, phir bhool ki wajah se do sajde kiye, phir salaam pheera.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) while reciting the Qur'an recited its surah containing sajda, and he performed prostration and we also prostrated along with him (but we were so overcrowded) that some of us could not find a place for our forehead (when prostrating ourselves).
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) Quran padhte hue ek aisi surah padhi jismein sajda tha, to unhone sajda kiya aur hum bhi unke saath sajda karne lage, lekin itni bheed thi ki humme se kuch ko apni peshani rakhne ke liye jagah nahi mil saki.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported: Sometimes the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) recited the Qur'an, and would pass by (recite) the verse of sajda and performed prostration and he did this along with us, but we were so crowded in his company that none of us could find a place for performing prostration. (and it was done on occasions) other than prayer.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya: Kabhi kabhi Rasoolullah (SAW) Quran padhte the, aur sajde ki aayat se guzarte hue sajda karte the aur ye humare saath karte the, lekin hum itni bheed mein hote the ki humme se koi bhi sajda karne ki jagah nahi paata tha, aur ye namaz ke ilawa bhi hota tha.

e: Abdullah (b. 'Umar) reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) recited (Surat) al Najm and performed prostration during its recital and all those who were along with him also prostrated themselves except one old man who took a handful of pebbles or dust in his palm and lifted it to his forehead and said: This is sufficient for me. 'Abdullah said: I saw that he was later killed in a state of unbelief.
hi: Abdullah (bin Umar) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Surah An-Najm padhi aur uski tilawat ke dauran sajda kiya aur unke saath maujood sabhi logon ne bhi sajda kiya, siwaay ek boodhe shakhs ke jisne apni hatheli mein kankariyan ya mitti li aur use apni peshani tak uthaya aur kaha: Ye mere liye kaafi hai. Abdullah ne kaha: Maine baad mein use kufr ki halat mein maara gaya dekha.

e: 'ta' b. Yasar reported that he had asked Zaid b. Thabit about recital along with the Imam, to which he said: There should be no recital along with the Imam in anything, and alleged that he recited:" By the star when it sets" (Surah Najm) before the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he did not prostrate himself.
hi: Ta' bin Yasar ne bayan kiya ki unhone Zaid bin Thabit se Imam ke saath Quran padhne ke maslay ke baare mein poocha, to unhone kaha: Imam ke saath kisi bhi cheez mein qiraat nahi honi chahiye, aur dawa kiya ki unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saamne "Wan-Najmi izaa hawaa" (Surah Najm) padhi thi aur unhone sajda nahi kiya.

e: Abu Salama b. 'Abual-Rahman reported: Abu Huraira recited before them:" hen the heaven burst asunder" (al-Qur'an, lxxxiv. 1) and performed prostration. After completing (the prayer) he informed them that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) has prostrated himself at it (this verse).
hi: Abu Salama bin Abdur-Rahman ne bayan kiya: Abu Huraira (RA) ne unke saamne "Izas-samaa-un shaqqat" (Surah al-Inshiqaq, 84:1) padhi aur sajda kiya. Namaz mukammal karne ke baad unhone unhe bataya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne bhi is aayat par sajda kiya tha.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated by AbuSalama on the authority of Abu Huraira.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Abu Salama ne Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: We performed prostration along with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) (as he recited these verses: )" When the heaven burst asunder" and" Read in the name of Thy Lord" (al-Qur'an, xcvi. 1).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Humne Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath sajda kiya, jab unhone ye aayaten padhin: "Izas-samaa-un shaqqat" aur "Iqra bismi Rabbika" (Surah al-Alaq, 96:1).

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prostrated himself (while reciting these verses)." When the heaven burst asunder" ;" Read in the name of Thy Lord".
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne sajda kiya, ye aayaten padhte hue: "Izas-samaa-un shaqqat"; "Iqra bismi Rabbika."

e: A hadith like this has been transmitted by Abual-Rahman al-Araj on the authority of Abu Huraira.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Abdur-Rahman al-A'raj ne Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: Abu Rafi' reported: I said the night prayer along with Abu Huraira and -as he recited:" When the heaven burst asunder," he performed prostration. Isaid to him: What prostration is this? He said: I prostrated myself (on this occasion of recital) behind Abu'I-Qasim (Muhammad. may peace be upon him), and Iwould go on doing this till I meet him (in the next world). Ibn 'Abu al-A'la said: (Abu Huraira uttered this: ) I would not abandon performing prostration.
hi: Abu Rafi' ne bayan kiya: Maine Abu Huraira (RA) ke saath isha ki namaz padhi aur jab unhone "Izas-samaa-un shaqqat" padhi, to unhone sajda kiya. Maine unse kaha: Ye kaisa sajda hai? Unhone kaha: Maine Abu'l-Qasim (Muhammad SAW) ke peeche is tilawat par sajda kiya tha, aur main aisa tab tak karta rahunga jab tak unse agli duniya mein mulaqat na ho. Ibn Abi al-A'la ne kaha: Abu Huraira ne ye kaha: Main sajda karna nahi chhodunga.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Tamimi with the same chain of transmitters except for this that they made no mention of: " Behind Abu'l-Qasim" (ﷺ).
hi: Ye hadees Tamimi ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai siwaay is baat ke ki unhone "Abu'l-Qasim (SAW) ke peeche" ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: Abu Rafi' reported: I saw Abu Huraira performing prostration (while reciting this verse: )" When the heaven burst asunder." I said to him: Do you prostrate yourself (while reciting) i? He said: Yes, I saw my best Friend (ﷺ) prostrating himself on (the recital of this verse) and I shall continue prostrating till I meet him. Shu'ba asked: Do you mean (by Friend) the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)? He said: Yes.
hi: Abu Rafi' ne bayan kiya: Maine Abu Huraira (RA) ko sajda karte dekha, jab woh ye aayat padh rahe the: "Izas-samaa-un shaqqat." Maine unse kaha: Kya aap iski tilawat par sajda karte hain? Unhone kaha: Haan, maine apne behtareen dost (SAW) ko is aayat ki tilawat par sajda karte dekha aur main sajda karta rahunga jab tak unse mulaqat na ho. Shu'ba ne poocha: Kya aapka matlab dost se Rasoolullah (SAW) hai? Unhone kaha: Haan.

e: Abdullah b. Zubair narrated on the authority of his father: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sat in prayer. he placed the left foot between his thigh and shank and stretched the right foot and placed his left hand on his left knee and placed his right hand on his right thigh, and raised his finger.
hi: Abdullah bin Zubair ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki: Jab Rasoolullah (SAW) namaz mein baithte, to apna baayan paon apni raan aur pindli ke beech rakhte aur daayan paon phaila dete, aur apna baayan haath apne baaye ghutne par rakhte aur apna daayan haath apni daayi raan par rakhte, aur apni ungli utha dete.

e: 'Abdullah b. Zubair narrated on the authority of his father that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sat for supplication, i. e. tashahhud (blessing and supplication), he placed his right hand on his right thigh and his left hand on his left thigh, and pointed with his forefinger, and placed his thumb on his (milddle) finger, and covered his knee with the palm of his left hand..
hi: Abdullah bin Zubair ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki jab Rasoolullah (SAW) dua ke liye, yaani tashahhud ke liye baithte, to apna daayan haath apni daayi raan par aur baayan haath apni baayi raan par rakhte, aur apni shahadat ki ungli se ishara karte, aur apna angootha apni beech ki ungli par rakhte, aur apne baaye haath ki hatheli se apne ghutne ko dhak lete.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sat for tashahhud he placed his left hand on his left knee. and his right hand on his right knee. and he raised his right finger, which is next to the thumb, making supplication in this way, and he stretched his left hand on his left knee.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab Rasoolullah (SAW) tashahhud ke liye baithte to apna baayan haath apne baaye ghutne par aur daayan haath apne daaye ghutne par rakhte, aur apni daayi ungli, jo angoothe ke bagal mein hai, utha dete, isi tarah dua karte, aur apna baayan haath apne baaye ghutne par phaila dete.

e: Another version on the authority of Ibn Umar says: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sat for tashahhud, he placed his left hand on his left knee and placed his right hand on his right knee, and he formed a ring like (fifty-three) and pointed with his finger of attestation.
hi: Ibn Umar ki riwayat ki ek doosri version mein hai: Jab Rasoolullah (SAW) tashahhud ke liye baithte, to apna baayan haath apne baaye ghutne par rakhte aur apna daayan haath apne daaye ghutne par rakhte, aur ek halqa banate aur shahadat ki ungli se ishara karte.

e: 'Ali b. 'Abual-Rahman al-Mu'awi reported: 'Abdullah b. Umar saw me playing with pebbles during prayer. After finishing the prayer he forbade me (to do it) and said: Do as the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to do. I said: How did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) do? He said that he (the Messenger of Allah) sat at tashahhud, placed his right palm on the right thigh and closed all his fingers and pointed with the help of finger next to the thumb, and placed his left palm on his left thigh.
hi: Ali bin Abdur-Rahman al-Mu'awi ne bayan kiya: Abdullah bin Umar ne mujhe namaz ke dauran kankariyon se khelte dekha. Namaz mukammal karne ke baad unhone mujhe aisa karne se mana kiya aur kaha: Waisa karo jaisa Rasoolullah (SAW) kiya karte the. Maine kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) kaise karte the? Unhone bataya ki woh tashahhud mein baithte, apni daayi hatheli apni daayi raan par rakhte aur apni saari ungliyan band kar lete aur angoothe ke bagal wali ungli se ishara karte, aur apni baayi hatheli apni baayi raan par rakhte.

e: This hadith has been narrated by another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Ma'mar reported: There was an Amir in Mecca who pronounced taslim twice. Abdullah said: Where did he get this sunnah? Al-Hakam said: There is a hadith to the effect that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did like It.
hi: Abu Ma'mar ne bayan kiya: Makkah mein ek Amir the jo do baar salaam pheerte the. Abdullah ne kaha: Unhe ye Sunnat kahan se mili? Al-Hakam ne kaha: Ek hadees hai jismein hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne bhi aisa kiya tha.

e: 'Abdullah reported: An Amir or a person pronounced taslim twice. 'Abdullah said: Where did he get this sunnah?
hi: Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Ek Amir ya ek shakhs ne do baar salaam pheera. Abdullah ne kaha: Unhe ye Sunnat kahan se mili?

e: 'Amir b. Sa'd reported: I saw the Messenger of Allah (may peace be open him) pronouncing taslim on his right and on his left till I saw the whiteness of his cheek.
hi: Aamir bin Sa'd ne bayan kiya: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko apni daayi aur baayi taraf salaam pheerte dekha yahan tak ki maine unke gaal ki safedi dekhi.

e: Ibn 'Abbas said: We used to know that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had finished his prayer when we heard the takbir (Allah-O-Akbar).
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: Humein pata chal jaata tha ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne apni namaz mukammal kar li hai jab hum takbeer, Allahu Akbar, sunte the.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported: We knew the finishing of the prayer of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) through takbir. 'Amr (b. Dinar) said: I made a mention of it to Abu Mas'ud. hue he rejected it and said: I never narrated it to you. 'Amr said: He did narrate it before this.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Humein Rasoolullah (SAW) ki namaz ke khatam hone ka pata takbeer se chalta tha. Amr (bin Dinar) ne kaha: Maine iska zikr Abu Mas'ud se kiya. Unhone ise radd kar diya aur kaha: Maine tumse aisi koi baat kabhi bayan nahi ki. Amr ne kaha: Unhone isse pehle ye zaroor bayan ki thi.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported: Dhikr (mentioning the name of Allah) in a loud voice after obligatory prayers was (a common practice) during the lifetime of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ; and when I heard that I came to knew that they (the people) had finished the prayer.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Farz namazon ke baad zor se zikr karna Rasoolullah (SAW) ke daur mein ek aam amal tha; aur jab main ise sunta, to mujhe pata chal jaata ki logon ne namaz mukammal kar li hai.

e: 'A'isha reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) entered my house when a Jewess was with me and she was saying: Do you know that you would be put to trial in the grave? The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) trembled (on hearing this) and said: It is the Jews only who would-be put to trial. 'A'isha said: We passed some nights and then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Do you know that it has been revealed to me:" You would be put to trial in the grave"? 'A'isha said: 1 heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) seeking refuge from the torment of the grave after this.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Nabi (SAW) mere ghar aaye jab mere paas ek Yahudi aurat thi aur woh keh rahi thi: Kya tumhe pata hai ki tumhe qabr mein azmaaya jayega? Rasoolullah (SAW) ye sunkar kaanp gaye aur farmaya: Sirf Yahudiyon ko hi qabr mein azmaaya jayega. Aisha ne kaha: Kuch raatein guzareen aur phir Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Kya tumhe pata hai ki mujhpar wahi utaari gayi hai: "Tumhe qabr mein azmaaya jayega"? Aisha ne kaha: Maine iske baad Rasoolullah (SAW) ko qabr ke azaab se panah maangte hue suna.

e: Abu Huraira reported. I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) seeking refuge from the torment of the grave after this (after the revelation).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko iske baad, wahi ke baad, qabr ke azaab se panah maangte hue suna.

e: 'A'isha reported: There came to me two old women from the old Jewesses of Medina and said: The people of the grave are tormented in their graves. I contradicted them and I did not deem it proper to testify them. They went away and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to me and I said to him: Messenger of Allah I there came to me two old women from the old Jewesses of Medina and asserted that the people of the graves would be tormented therein. He (the Prophet) said: They told the truth; they would be tormented (so much) that the animals would listen to it. She ('A'isha) said: Never did I see him (the Holy Prophet) afterwards but seeking refuge from the torment of the grave in prayer.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Mere paas Madina ki do budhi Yahudi auraten aayin aur kaha: Qabr walon ko unki qabron mein azaab diya jaata hai. Maine unki baat ko jhutlaya aur unki tasdeeq karna munaasib nahi samjha. Woh chali gayin aur Rasoolullah (SAW) mere paas aaye aur maine unse kaha: Ya Rasoolullah! Mere paas Madina ki do budhi Yahudi auraten aayin aur unhone dawa kiya ki qabr walon ko unki qabron mein azaab diya jayega. Unhone farmaya: Unhone sach kaha; unhe itna azaab diya jayega ki jaanwar bhi ise sun sakenge. Aisha ne kaha: Iske baad maine unhe hamesha namaz mein qabr ke azaab se panah maangte hue dekha.

e: Masruq reported this hadith on the authority of 'A'isha who said: Never did he (the Holy Prophet) say prayer after this in which I did not hear him seeking refuge from the torment of the grave.
hi: Masruq ne ye hadees Aisha (RA) ki sanad se bayan ki jinhone kaha: Iske baad unhone koi bhi namaz aisi nahi padhi jismein maine unhe qabr ke azaab se panah maangte na suna ho.

e: 'A'isha reported: 1 heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) seeking refuge from the trial of Dajjal (Antichrist) in prayer.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko namaz mein Dajjal ke fitne se panah maangte hue suna.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him) said: When any one of you utters tashahhud (in prayer) he must seek refuge with Allah from four (trials) and should thus say:" O Allah! I seek refuge with Thee from the torment of the Hell, from the torment of the grave, from the trial of life and death and from the evil of the trial of Masih al-Dajjal" (Antichrist).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab tum mein se koi tashahhud padhe, to use chaar cheezon se Allah ki panah maangni chahiye aur ye kehna chahiye: "Aye Allah! Main jahannam ke azaab se, qabr ke azaab se, zindagi aur maut ke fitne se, aur Masih Dajjal ke fitne ki buraai se Teri panah maangta hoon."

e: 'A'isha, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) used to supplicate in prayer thus:" O Allah! I seek refuge with Thee from the torment of the grave, and I seek refuge with Thee from the trial of the Masih al-Dajjal (Antichrist) and I seek refuge with Thee from the trial of life and death. O Allah! I seek refuge with Thee from sin and debt." She ('A'isha) reported: Someone said to him - (the Holy Prophet): Messenger of Allah! why is it that you so often seek refuge from debt? He said: When a (person) incurs debt, (he is obliged) to tell lies and break promise.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ki zauja Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) namaz mein aise dua kiya karte the: "Aye Allah! Main qabr ke azaab se Teri panah maangta hoon, aur Masih Dajjal ke fitne se Teri panah maangta hoon, aur zindagi aur maut ke fitne se Teri panah maangta hoon. Aye Allah! Main gunah aur qarz se Teri panah maangta hoon." Aisha ne bayan kiya: Kisi ne unse kaha: Ya Rasoolullah! Aap itni baar qarz se panah kyun maangte hain? Unhone farmaya: Jab koi shakhs qarzdaar hota hai, to woh majboor hokar jhoot bolta hai aur wada tod deta hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When any one of you completes the last tashahhud. he should seek refuge with Allah from four (trials). I.e. from the torment of Hell, from the torment of grave, from the trial of life and death, and from the mischief of Masih at-Dajjal (Antichrist). This hadith has been narrated by al-Auza'i with the same chain of transmitters but with these words:" When any one of you completes the tashahhud" and he made no mention of the words" the last".
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab tum mein se koi aakhri tashahhud mukammal kare, to use chaar cheezon se Allah ki panah maangni chahiye, yaani jahannam ke azaab se, qabr ke azaab se, zindagi aur maut ke fitne se, aur Masih Dajjal ke fitne se. Ye hadees al-Auza'i ne isi sanad se in alfaaz ke saath bayan ki hai: "Jab tum mein se koi tashahhud mukammal kare" aur unhone "aakhri" lafz ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) said: O Allah! I seek refuge with Thee from the torment of the grave, and the torment of Hell, and the trial of life and death and the mischief of Masih al-Dajjal.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Aye Allah! Main qabr ke azaab se, aur jahannam ke azaab se, aur zindagi aur maut ke fitne se, aur Masih Dajjal ke fitne se Teri panah maangta hoon.

e: Abu Huraira reported the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: Seek refuge with Allah from the torment of Hell, seek refuge with Allah from the torment of the grave, and seek refuge with Allah from the trial of Masih al-Dajjal and seek refuge with Allah from the trial of life and death.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se ye riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Jahannam ke azaab se Allah ki panah maango, qabr ke azaab se Allah ki panah maango, aur Masih Dajjal ke fitne se Allah ki panah maango, aur zindagi aur maut ke fitne se Allah ki panah maango.

e: A hadith like this has been transmitted by Ibn Tawus from his father on the authority of AbuHuraira.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Ibn Tawus ne apne walid ke hawale se Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: A hadith like this has been transmitted by A'raj on the authority of Abu Huraira.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees A'raj ne Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to seek refuge from the torment of the grave, torment of Hell and the trial of Dajjal.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) qabr ke azaab, jahannam ke azaab aur Dajjal ke fitne se panah maanga karte the.

e:
Ibn 'Abbas reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to teach them this supplication (in the same spirit) with which he used to teach them a surah of the Qur'an. He would thus instruct us: "Say, O Allah, we seek refuge with Thee from the torment of Hell. And I seek refuge with Thee from the torment of the grave, and I seek refuge with Thee from the trial of al-Masih ad-Dajjal, and I seek refuge with Thee from the trial of life and death." 

Muslim b. Hajjaj said: It has reached me that Tawus said to his son: Did you make this supplication in prayer? He said: No. (Upon this) he (Tawus) said: Repeat the prayer. Tawus has narrated this hadith through three or four (transmitters) with words to the same effect.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) unhe ye dua isi ehtimaam ke saath sikhaya karte the jaise woh unhe Quran ki koi surah sikhate. Woh humein isi tarah hidayat dete: "Kaho, Aye Allah, hum jahannam ke azaab se Teri panah maangte hain. Aur main qabr ke azaab se Teri panah maangta hoon, aur main Masih Dajjal ke fitne se Teri panah maangta hoon, aur main zindagi aur maut ke fitne se Teri panah maangta hoon." Muslim bin Hajjaj ne kaha: Mujhe pata chala ki Tawus ne apne bete se kaha: Kya tumne namaz mein ye dua padhi? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Isper unhone kaha: Namaz dobara padho. Tawus ne ye hadees teen ya chaar raawiyon ke zariye isi mafhoom ke alfaaz mein bayan ki hai.

e: Thauban reported: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) finished his prayer. He begged forgiveness three times and said: O Allah! Thou art Peace, and peace comes from Thee; Blessed art Thou, O Possessor of Glory and Honour. Walid reported: I said to Auza'i: How is the seeking of forgiveness? He replied: You should say: I beg forgiveness from Allah, I beg forgiveness from Allah."
hi: Thauban (RA) ne bayan kiya: Jab Rasoolullah (SAW) apni namaz mukammal karte, to teen baar istighfaar karte aur kehte: "Aye Allah! Tu Salaam hai, aur salaamati Tujhi se aati hai; Tu Barakat wala hai, Aye Izzat aur Ikraam wale." Waleed ne bayan kiya: Maine Auza'i se kaha: Istighfaar kaise kiya jaata hai? Unhone jawab diya: Tumhe kehna chahiye: "Astaghfirullah, Astaghfirullah."

e: 'A'isha reported: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) pronounced salutation, he salutation longer than it took him to say: O Allah: Thou art Peace, and peace comes from Thee, blessed art Thou, Possessor of Glory and ]Honour; and in the narration of Ibn Numair the words are:" O Possessor of Glory and Honour."
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Jab Rasoolullah (SAW) salaam pheerte, to woh utni der tak nahi baithte the jitni der ye kehne mein lagti: "Aye Allah! Tu Salaam hai, aur salaamati Tujhi se aati hai, Tu Barakat wala hai, Izzat aur Ikraam wale"; aur Ibn Numair ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: "Aye Izzat aur Ikraam wale."

e: Ibn Numair narrated it with the same chain of transmitters and said: O Possessor of Glory and Honour.
hi: Ibn Numair ne isi sanad se ye riwayat ki aur kaha: "Aye Izzat aur Ikraam wale."

e: A hadith like this has been transmitted by Abdullah b. Harith on the authority of A'isha except for the words that he (the Holy Prophet) used to say: " 0 Possessor of Glory and Honour."
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Abdullah bin Harith ne Aisha (RA) ki sanad se bayan ki hai siwaay in alfaaz ke ki woh Nabi (SAW) kaha karte the: "Aye Izzat aur Ikraam wale."

e: Mughira b. Shu'ba wrote to Mu'awiya: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) finished the prayer and pronounced salutation he uttered (this supplication):" There is no god but Allah. He is alone, Who has no partner. To Him belongs the sovereignty and to Him praise is due and He is Potent over every. thing. O Allah! no one can withhold what Thou givest, or give what Thou withholdest, and the riches cannot avail a wealthy person with Thee."
hi: Mughira bin Shu'ba ne Muawiya ko likha: Jab Rasoolullah (SAW) namaz mukammal karte aur salaam pheer dete, to ye dua padhte: "Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi hai. Woh akela hai, uska koi shareek nahi. Baadshahat usi ki hai aur hamd usi ke liye hai aur woh har cheez par qaadir hai. Aye Allah! Jo Tu de use koi rok nahi sakta, aur jo Tu roke use koi de nahi sakta, aur kisi maaldaar ka maal Tere saamne kaam nahi aata."

e: A hadith like this has been narrated by Mughira b. Shu'ba with another chain of transmitters. Abu Bakr and Abu Kuraib narrated in their narration (that Warrad reported): Mughira gave me dictation of it and 1 wrote it to Mu'awiya.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Mughira bin Shu'ba ne ek doosri sanad se bayan ki hai. Abu Bakr aur Abu Kuraib ne apni riwayat mein bataya ki Warrad ne bayan kiya: Mughira ne mujhe ye likhwaya aur maine ise Muawiya ko likh diya.

e: Warrad, the freed slave of Mughira b. Shu'ba, reported: Mughira b. Shu'ba wrote to Mu'awiya (it was Warrad who wrote this letter for him, i. e. Mughira): I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying:" When the salutation is pronounced." and the rest of the hadith is the same except this that he made no mention of:" He is Potent over everything."
hi: Warrad, Mughira bin Shu'ba ke aazad kiye hue ghulam, ne bayan kiya: Mughira bin Shu'ba ne Muawiya ko likha - ye khat Warrad ne unke liye likha, yaani Mughira ke liye: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Jab salaam pheera jaye," aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai siwaay is baat ke ki unhone "Woh har cheez par qaadir hai" ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: Warrad, the scribe of Mughira b. Shu'ba, reported: Mu'awiya wrote to Mughira (the contents) of the hadith as transmitted by Mansur and A'mash.
hi: Warrad, Mughira bin Shu'ba ke munshi, ne bayan kiya: Muawiya ne Mughira ko woh hadees likhi jo Mansur aur A'mash ne bayan ki thi.

e: Warrad, the scribe of Mughira b. Shu'ba, reported: Mu'awiya wrote to Mughira: Write to me anything which you heard from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). So he (Mughira) wrote to him (Mu'awiya): I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) uttering (these words) at the completion of prayer:" There is no god but Allah. He is alone and there is no partner with Him. Sovereignty belongs to Him and to Him is praise due and He is Potent over everything. O Allah! no one can withhold what Thou givest, or give what Thou withholdest, and riches cannot avail a wealthy person with Thee."
hi: Warrad, Mughira bin Shu'ba ke munshi, ne bayan kiya: Muawiya ne Mughira ko likha: Mujhe woh kuch likho jo tumne Rasoolullah (SAW) se suna hai. To unhone Mughira ne unhe Muawiya ko likha: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko namaz ke akhir mein ye kehte suna: "Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi hai. Woh akela hai aur uska koi shareek nahi. Baadshahat usi ki hai aur hamd usi ke liye hai aur woh har cheez par qaadir hai. Aye Allah! Jo Tu de use koi rok nahi sakta, aur jo Tu roke use koi de nahi sakta, aur kisi maaldaar ka maal Tere saamne kaam nahi aata."

e: Abu Zubair reported: Ibn Zubair uttered at the end of every prayer after pronouncing salutation (these words):" There is no god but Allah. He is alone. There is no partner with Him. Sovereignty belongs to Him and He is Potent over everything. There is no might or power except with Allah. There is no god but Allah and we do not worship but Him alone. To Him belong all bounties, to Him belongs all Grace, and to Him is worthy praise accorded. There is no god but Allah, to Whom we are sincere in devotion, even though the unbelievers should disapprove it." (The narrator said): He (the Holy Prophet) uttered it at the end of every (obligatory) prayer.
hi: Abu Zubair ne bayan kiya: Ibn Zubair har namaz ke akhir mein, salaam pheerne ke baad, ye alfaaz kaha karte the: "Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi hai. Woh akela hai. Uska koi shareek nahi. Baadshahat usi ki hai aur woh har cheez par qaadir hai. Koi taaqat ya qudrat Allah ke siwa nahi hai. Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi hai aur hum sirf usi ki ibadat karte hain. Sari naimaten usi ki hain, sara fazl usi ka hai, aur khoobsurat tareef usi ke liye sazaawaar hai. Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi hai, jiske liye hum apni ibadat khaalis karte hain, chahe kaafir isse naapasand karein." Raawi ne kaha: Woh Nabi (SAW) ise har farz namaz ke akhir mein kehte the.

e: Abu Zubair reported: Abdullah b Zubair used to say La ilaha il-Allah at the end of every prayer like the hadith narrated by Ibn Numair and he reported it in the end, and then reported Ibn Zubair saying: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) uttered La ilaha il-Allah at the end of every prayer.
hi: Abu Zubair ne bayan kiya: Abdullah bin Zubair har namaz ke akhir mein "La ilaha illallah" kaha karte the, jaisi hadees Ibn Numair ne bayan ki, aur unhone ise akhir mein bayan kiya, aur phir Ibn Zubair se ye riwayat ki: Rasoolullah (SAW) har namaz ke akhir mein "La ilaha illallah" kaha karte the.

e: Abu Zubair reported: I heard Abdullah b. Zubair addressing (people) on the pulpit and saying: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) pronounced salutation at the end of the prayer or prayers, and then he made a mention of the hadith as transmitted by Hisham b. 'Urwa.
hi: Abu Zubair ne bayan kiya: Maine Abdullah bin Zubair ko mimbar par logon se khitaab karte hue suna, ki woh keh rahe the: Jab Rasoolullah (SAW) namaz ya namazon ke akhir mein salaam pheerte, aur phir unhone Hisham bin Urwa ki bayan ki hui hadees ka zikr kiya.

e: Abu Zubair al-Makki reported that he had heard 'Abdullah b. Zubair uttering (the words) like that of the hadith (narrated above) at the end of the prayer after pronouncing salutation. He at the conclusion also said that he was making a mention of that from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).
hi: Abu Zubair al-Makki ne bayan kiya ki unhone Abdullah bin Zubair ko namaz ke akhir mein, salaam pheerne ke baad, upar bayan hui hadees jaise alfaaz kehte suna. Unhone akhir mein ye bhi kaha ki woh ye Rasoolullah (SAW) se bayan kar rahe hain.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The poor amongst the emigrants came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: The possessors of great wealth have obtained the highest ranks and the lasting bliss. He (the Holy Prophet) said: How is that? They said: They pray as we pray, and they observe fast as we observe fast, and they give charity but we do not give charity, and they set slaves free but we do not set slaves free. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Shall I not teach you something by which you will catch upon those who have preceded you, and get ahead of those who come after you, only those who do as you do being more excellent than you? They said: Yes, Messenger of Allah. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Extol Allah, declare His Greatness, and Praise Him thirty-three times after every prayer. Abu Salih said: The poor amongst the emigrants returned to the Messenger of Allah (may peace upon him) saying: Our brethren, the possessors, of property have heard what we have done and they did the same. So the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: This is Allah's Grace which He gives to whom He wishes. Sumayy reported: I made a mention of this hadith to some members of my family (and one of them) said: You have forgotten; he (the Holy Prophet) had said (like this): "Extol Allah thirty-three time, praise Allah thirty-three times and declare His Greatness thirty-three times." Ibn `Ajlan said: I made a mention of this hadith to Raja' b. Haiwa and he narrated to me a hadith like this from Abu Salih from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the authority of Abu Huraira.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Muhajireen mein se gareeb log Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: Bade maal walon ne sabse buland darje aur hamesha rehne wali khushi paa li hai. Unhone farmaya: Woh kaise? Unhone kaha: Woh waise hi namaz padhte hain jaise hum padhte hain, aur woh waise hi roze rakhte hain jaise hum rakhte hain, aur woh sadaqa dete hain lekin hum nahi de sakte, aur woh ghulam azaad karte hain lekin hum nahi kar sakte. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Kya main tumhe kuch aisa na sikhaun jiske zariye tum unhe jo tumse aage nikal gaye pakad loge, aur unse aage badh jaoge jo tumhare baad aayenge, siwaay unke jo waisa hi karein jaisa tum karoge, aur woh tumse behtar honge? Unhone kaha: Zaroor, Ya Rasoolullah. Unhone farmaya: Har namaz ke baad Subhanallah, Alhamdulillah aur Allahu Akbar taintees-taintees baar kaho. Abu Salih ne bataya: Muhajireen mein se gareeb log dobara Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aakar kehne lage: Hamare maaldaar bhaiyon ne suna ki humne kya kiya to unhone bhi waisa hi kiya. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Ye Allah ka fazl hai jo Woh jise chahe ata karta hai. Sumayy ne bayan kiya: Maine ye hadees apne kuch gharwalon ko sunayi aur unmein se ek ne kaha: Tum bhool gaye ho; unhone Nabi (SAW) ne yun kaha tha: "Subhanallah taintees baar, Alhamdulillah taintees baar aur Allahu Akbar taintees baar kaho." Ibn Ajlan ne kaha: Maine ye hadees Raja bin Haiwa ko sunayi aur unhone mujhe Abu Salih se, Rasoolullah (SAW) se, Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se, isi tarah ki ek hadees bayan ki.

e: Abu Huraira narrated it from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that they (the poor among the emigrants) said: Messenger of Allah, the possessors of great wealth have obtained the highest ranks and lasting bliss, and the rest of the hadith is the same as transmitted by Qutaiba on the authority of Laith except that he inserted the words of Abu Salih in the narration of Abu Huraira that" the poor of the emigrants came back," to the end of the hadith,, but this addition was made that Suhail said (that every part of the supplication, i. e. Glorification of Allah, His Praise and declaration of His Greatness) should be uttered eleven times making the total as thirty-three.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se ye riwayat ki ki unhone, Muhajireen ke gareebon ne, kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, bade maal walon ne sabse buland darje aur hamesha rehne wali khushi paa li hai, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai jaisi Qutaiba ne Laith ki sanad se bayan ki hai, siwaay is baat ke ki unhone Abu Salih ke alfaaz Abu Huraira ki riwayat mein dale ki "Muhajireen ke gareeb log wapas aaye," hadees ke aakhir tak, lekin ye izafa kiya gaya ki Suhail ne kaha ki dua ka har hissa, yaani Allah ki tasbeeh, uski hamd aur uski takbeer, gyarah-gyarah baar kahi jaani chahiye, jisse kul taintees hoti hai.

e: Ka'b b. 'Ujra reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There are certain remembrances, the repeaters of which or the performers of which after every prescribed prayer will never be caused disappointment:" Glory be to Allah" thirty-three times." Praise be to Allah" thirty-three times, and" Allah is most Great" thirty-four times.
hi: Ka'b bin Ujra (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Kuch aise zikr hain, jinhe har farz namaz ke baad dohrane ya karne wale kabhi mayoos nahi honge: "Subhanallah" taintees baar, "Alhamdulillah" taintees baar, aur "Allahu Akbar" chauntees baar.

e: Ka'b b. 'Ujra reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There are certain remembrances, the repeaters of which or the performers of which at the end of every prayer will never be caused disappointment:" Glory be to Allah" thirty-three times," Praise be to Allah" thirty-three times, and" Allah is most Great" thirty-four times.
hi: Ka'b bin Ujra (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Kuch aise zikr hain, jinhe har namaz ke akhir mein dohrane ya karne wale kabhi mayoos nahi honge: "Subhanallah" taintees baar, "Alhamdulillah" taintees baar, aur "Allahu Akbar" chauntees baar.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If anyone extols Allah after every prayer thirty-three times, and praises Allah thirty-three times, and declares His Greatness thirty-three times, ninety-nine times in all, and says to complete a hundred:" There is no god but Allah, having no partner with Him, to Him belongs sovereignty and to Him is praise due, and He is Potent over everything," his sins will be forgiven even If these are as abundant as the foam of the sea.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Agar koi har namaz ke baad Allah ki tasbeeh taintees baar kare, aur uski hamd taintees baar kare, aur uski takbeer taintees baar kare - kul ninyaanve baar - aur sau poore karne ke liye kahe: "Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi hai, uska koi shareek nahi, baadshahat usi ki hai aur hamd usi ke liye hai, aur woh har cheez par qaadir hai," to uske gunah maaf kar diye jayenge chahe woh samundar ke jhaag jitne zyada hi kyun na hon.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Abu Huraira by another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ne ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to observe, silence for a short while between the takbir (at the time of opening the prayer) and the recitation of the Qur'an. I said to him: Messenger of Allah, for whom I would give my father and mother in ransom, what do you recite during your period of silence between the takbir and the recitation? He said: I say (these words):" O Allah, remove my sins from me as Thou hast removed the East from the West. O Allah purify me from sins as a white garment is purified from filth. O Allah! wash away my sins with snow, water, and ice."
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) takbeer-e-tahreema aur Quran ki tilawat ke darmiyan thodi der khamoshi ikhtiyar karte the. Maine unse kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, jinpar mere maa-baap qurbaan hon, aap takbeer aur qiraat ke darmiyan apni khamoshi mein kya padhte hain? Unhone farmaya: Main ye kehta hoon: "Aye Allah, mujhse mere gunah aise door kar de jaise Tune poorab ko pashchim se door kiya hai. Aye Allah, mujhe gunahon se aise paak kar jaise ek safed kapda gandagi se paak kiya jaata hai. Aye Allah, mere gunahon ko baraf, paani aur olon se dho de."

e: Abu Huraira reported that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stood up for the second rak'ah he opened it with the recitation of the praise of Allah, the Lord of universe (al-Fatiha), and he did not observe silence (before the recitation of al-Fatiha).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab Rasoolullah (SAW) doosri rakat ke liye khade hote, to woh use Alhamdulillahi Rabbil Aalameen, al-Fatiha, ki tilawat se shuru karte, aur al-Fatiha ki tilawat se pehle khamoshi ikhtiyar nahi karte the.

e: Anas reported: A man came panting and entered the row of worshippers and said: Praise be to Allah, much praised and blessed. When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) finished the prayer he said: Who amongst you uttered these words? The people remained silent. He (the Prophet again said) -: Who amongst you uttered these words? He said nothing wrong. Then a man said: I came and had a difficulty in breathing, so I uttered them. He replied: I saw twelve angels facing one another as to who will take them up (to Allah).
hi: Anas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Ek shakhs hanphta hua aaya aur namazion ki saf mein shaamil ho gaya aur kaha: Alhamdulillah, hamdan katheeran mubarakan feehi. Jab Rasoolullah (SAW) ne namaz mukammal ki to unhone farmaya: Tum mein se kisne ye alfaaz kahe? Log khamosh rahe. Unhone dobara farmaya: Tum mein se kisne ye alfaaz kahe? Usne kuch bhi ghalat nahi kaha tha. Phir ek shakhs ne kaha: Main aaya aur mujhe saans lene mein dikkat ho rahi thi, is liye maine ye kaha. Unhone farmaya: Maine baarah farishton ko ek doosre ki taraf mudte dekha ki kaun inhe Allah ki taraf le jaye.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported: While we said prayer with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), one among the people said: Allah is truly Great, praise be to Allah in abundance. Glory be to Allah in the morning and the evening. The Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon, him) said: Who uttered such and such a word? A person among the people said: It is I, Messenger of Allah (who have recited these words). He (the Holy Prophet) said: It (its utterance) surprised me, for the doors of heaven were opened for It. Ibn 'Umar said: I have not abandoned them (these words) since I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying this.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya: Jab hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath namaz padh rahe the, to logon mein se ek ne kaha: Allah waaqai bahut bada hai, Allah ki tareef bahut zyada ki jaaye. Subah aur shaam Allah ki tasbeeh ki jaaye. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Ye alfaaz kisne kahe? Logon mein se ek shakhs ne kaha: Ye main hoon, Ya Rasoolullah, jisne ye alfaaz padhe. Unhone Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Ye alfaaz kehna mujhe hairaan kar gaya, kyunki iske liye aasman ke darwaze khol diye gaye. Ibn Umar ne kaha: Maine jab se Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna hai, tab se maine inhe kabhi chhoda nahi.

e: Abu Huraira reported: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: When the Iqama has been pronounced for prayer, do not go running to it, but go walking in tranquillity and pray what you are in time for, and complete what you have missed.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: Jab namaz ke liye iqaamat ho jaye, to us taraf daudte hue mat jao, balki sukoon se chalte hue jao aur jo rakat mil jaye woh padho, aur jo chhoot gayi ho use poori karo.

e: Abu Huraira reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When the words of Iqama are pronounced, do not come to (prayer) running, but go with tranquillity, and pray what you are in time for, and complete (what you have missed) for when one of you is preparing for prayer he is in fact engaged in prayer.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab iqaamat ke alfaaz kahe jayein, to namaz ki taraf daudte hue mat aao, balki sukoon se aao, aur jo rakat mil jaye woh padho, aur jo chhoot gayi ho use poori karo, kyunki jab tum mein se koi namaz ki taiyaari kar raha hota hai, to dar-asal woh namaz mein hi hota hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported ahadith from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and one of them is that the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon), said: When the call is made for prayer come to it walking with tranquillity, and pray what you are in time for, and complete what you have missed.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se kai hadeesein bayan ki hain, aur unmein se ek ye hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab namaz ki azaan ho, to sukoon se chalte hue us taraf aao, aur jo rakat mil jaye woh padho, aur jo chhoot gayi ho use poori karo.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When the words of Iqama are pronounced, none of you should run to it (to join the prayer) but walk with tranquillity and dignity, and pray what you are in time for and complete what has gone before (what the Imam has completed).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab iqaamat ke alfaaz kahe jayein, to tum mein se koi bhi namaz mein shaamil hone ke liye daude nahi, balki sukoon aur waqar se chale, aur jo rakat mil jaye woh padho, aur jo pehle guzar chuka ho, jo Imam mukammal kar chuka ho, use poora karo.

e: Abdullah b. Abu Qatada reported on the authority of his father: While we said our prayer with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) he heard tumult. (At the end of the prayer) he (the Holy Prophet) said: What is the matter with you? They said: We hastened to prayer. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Don't do that; when you come for prayer, there should be tranquillity upon you. Pray (along with the Imam) what you can find and complete what preceded you.
hi: Abdullah bin Abu Qatada ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki: Jab hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath namaz padh rahe the to unhone shor suna. Namaz ke akhir mein unhone farmaya: Tumhe kya hua tha? Unhone kaha: Hum namaz ke liye jaldi kar rahe the. Unhone farmaya: Aisa mat karo; jab tum namaz ke liye aao, to tumpar sukoon hona chahiye. Imam ke saath jo mil jaye woh padho, aur jo tumse pehle guzar chuka hai use poora karo.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Shaiban with the same chain of transmitters
hi: Ye hadees Shaiban ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: Abu Qatada reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When the Iqama is pronounced do not get up till you see me Ibn Hatim was in doubt whether it was said:" When the Iqama is pronounced" or" When call is made".
hi: Abu Qatada (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab iqaamat kahi jaye to jab tak tum mujhe aate na dekh lo, khade mat ho. Ibn Hatim ko shaq tha ki kaha gaya "Jab iqaamat kahi jaye" ya "Jab azaan di jaye".

e: Abu Salama son of Abd al-Rahman b. Auf reported Abu Huraira as saying: Iqama was pronounced and we stood up and made rows straight till he (the Holy Prophet) stood at his place of worship (the place ahead of the rows where he stood to lead the prayer) before takbir tahrima. He reminded to (himself something) and went back saying that we should stand at our places and not leave them. We waited, till he came back to us and he had taken a bath and water trickled out of his head and then led us in prayer.
hi: Abu Salama bin Abdur-Rahman bin Auf ne Abu Huraira (RA) se ye bayan kiya: Iqaamat kahi gayi aur hum khade ho gaye aur safen seedhi kar leen yahan tak ki woh Nabi (SAW) apni namaz ki jagah par khade huye, takbeer-e-tahreema se pehle. Unhe kuch yaad aaya aur woh wapas ye kehte hue gaye ki hum apni jagah par khade rahein aur unhe na chhode. Hum intezaar karte rahe, yahan tak ki woh hamare paas wapas aaye aur unhone ghusl kiya tha aur unke sar se paani tapak raha tha, aur phir unhone humein namaz padhayi.

e: Abu Salama reported Abu Huraira as saying: Iqama was pronounced. ant the people had formed themselves into rows. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came out and stood at his place, and then pointed out with his hand that we should stand at our places. He then went away and took a bath and water trickled from his head and then led them in prayer.
hi: Abu Salama ne Abu Huraira (RA) se ye bayan kiya: Iqaamat kahi gayi. Aur log safon mein khade ho gaye. Rasoolullah (SAW) bahar aaye aur apni jagah par khade huye, aur phir apne haath se ishara kiya ki hum apni jagah par khade rahein. Phir woh chale gaye aur ghusl kiya aur unke sar se paani tapak raha tha aur phir unhone unhe namaz padhayi.

e: Abu Salama reported on the authority of Abu Huraira that when Iqama was pronounced for the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), the people occupied their places in the rows before the Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him) stood up at his place.
hi: Abu Salama ne Abu Huraira (RA) ke hawale se bayan kiya ki jab Rasoolullah (SAW) ke liye iqaamat kahi jaati, to log Rasoolullah (SAW) ke apni jagah khade hone se pehle hi safon mein apni-apni jagah le lete the.

e: Jabir b. Samura reported: Bilal summoned to prayer as the sun declined but did not pronounce Iqama till the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came out and the Iqama was pronounced on seeing him.
hi: Jabir bin Samura (RA) ne bayan kiya: Bilal ne suraj dhalte hi azaan di lekin iqaamat tab tak nahi kahi jab tak Rasoolullah (SAW) bahar nahi aa gaye, aur unhe dekhkar iqaamat kahi gayi.

e: Abu Huraira reported the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: He who finds a rak'ah of the prayer, he in fact finds the prayer.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Jo namaz ki ek rakat pa le, usne dar-asal poori namaz pa li.

e: Abu Huraira reported the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: He who finds one rak'ah of the prayer with the Imam, he in fact finds the prayer.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Jo Imam ke saath namaz ki ek rakat pa le, usne dar-asal poori namaz pa li.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Malik and there is no mention of" along with the Imam" and In the hadith transmitted by Abdullah the words are: " he in fact finds the entire prayer".
hi: Ye hadees Malik ki sanad se bhi bayan ki gayi hai aur ismein "Imam ke saath" ka zikr nahi hai, aur Abdullah ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: "usne dar-asal poori namaz pa li."

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: He who finds one rak'ah at dawn before the rising of the sun, he in fact finds the dawn prayer. and he who finds one rak'ah of the afternoon prayer before sunset, he in fact finds the afternoon prayer.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jo suraj nikalne se pehle fajr ki ek rakat pa le, usne dar-asal fajr ki namaz pa li, aur jo suraj doobne se pehle asr ki ek rakat pa le, usne dar-asal asr ki namaz pa li.

e: This hadith is narrated by Abu Huraira with another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ne ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki hai.

e: A'isha reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: He who finds a prostration before sunset or at dawn (prayer) before the rising (of the sun) he in fact finds that (prayer), and prostration implies a rak'ah.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jo suraj doobne se pehle ya fajr mein suraj nikalne se pehle ek sajda pa le, usne dar-asal woh namaz pa li, aur sajde se murad ek rakat hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: He who finds (gets) a rak'ah of the afternoon (prayer) before the setting of the sun, he in fact gets (the full prayer), and he who gets a rak'ah of the morning (prayer) before the rising of the sun he in fact gets (the full prayer).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jo suraj doobne se pehle asr ki ek rakat pa le, usne dar-asal poori namaz pa li, aur jo suraj nikalne se pehle subah ki ek rakat pa le, usne dar-asal poori namaz pa li.

e: This hadith has been reported by Ma'mar with another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ma'mar ne ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki hai.

e: Ibn Shibab reported: 'Umar b. 'Abd al-'Aziz deferred the afternoon prayer somewhat and 'Urwa said to him: Gabriel came down and he led the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in prayer. 'Umar said to him: O 'Urwa, are you aware of what you are saying? Upon this he ('Urwa) said: I heard Bashir b. Abu Mas'ud say that he heard Abu Mas'ud say that he heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: Gabriel came down and acted as my Imam, then I prayed with him, then I prayed with him, then I prayed with him. then I prayed with him. then I prayed with him. reckoning with his fingers five times of prayer.
hi: Ibn Shihab ne bayan kiya: Umar bin Abdul Aziz ne asr ki namaz ko thoda der se padha, to Urwa ne unse kaha: Jibra'eel (AS) utre aur unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) ki imamat ki. Umar ne unse kaha: Aye Urwa, kya tumhe pata hai tum kya keh rahe ho? Isper unhone kaha: Maine Bashir bin Abu Mas'ud ko kehte suna ki unhone Abu Mas'ud ko kehte suna ki unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jibra'eel (AS) utre aur mere Imam bane, phir maine unke saath namaz padhi, phir maine unke saath namaz padhi, phir maine unke saath namaz padhi, phir maine unke saath namaz padhi, phir maine unke saath namaz padhi - apni ungliyon par paanch namazein ginte hue.

e: Ibn Shihab reported: Umar b. 'Abd al-'Aziz one day deferred the prayer. 'Urwa b. Zubair came to him and informed him that one day as Mughira b. Shu'ba was in Kufa (as its governor), he deferred the prayer, Abu Mas'ud al-Ansari came to him and said: What is this, O Mughira? Did you know that it was Gabriel who came and said prayer and (then) the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said the prayer (along with him), then (Gabriel) prayed and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) also prayed, then (Gabriel) prayed and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) also prayed, then (Gabriel) prayed and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prayed (along with him). then Gabriel prayed and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) also prayed (along with him) and then said: This is how I have been ordered to do. 'Umar (b. 'Abd al-'Aziz) said. O 'Urwa be mindful of what you are saying that Gabriel (peace be upon him) taught the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) the times of prayer. Upon this 'Urwa said: This is how Bashir b. Abu Mas'ud narrated on the authority of his father
hi: Ibn Shihab ne bayan kiya: Umar bin Abdul Aziz ne ek din namaz der se padhi. Urwa bin Zubair unke paas aaye aur unhe bataya ki ek din jab Mughira bin Shu'ba Kufa mein uske gavarnar ke taur par the, to unhone namaz der se padhi thi. Abu Mas'ud al-Ansari unke paas aaye aur kaha: Ye kya hai, Aye Mughira? Kya tumhe pata tha ki ye Jibra'eel (AS) the jo aaye aur namaz padhi, aur phir Rasoolullah (SAW) ne namaz padhi unke saath, phir Jibra'eel ne namaz padhi aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ne bhi namaz padhi, phir Jibra'eel ne namaz padhi aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ne bhi namaz padhi, phir Jibra'eel ne namaz padhi aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ne namaz padhi unke saath, phir Jibra'eel ne namaz padhi aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ne bhi namaz padhi unke saath aur phir farmaya: Mujhe isi tarah hukum diya gaya hai. Umar bin Abdul Aziz ne kaha: Aye Urwa, khayal rakho ki tum kya keh rahe ho ki Jibra'eel (AS) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko namaz ke waqt sikhaye. Isper Urwa ne kaha: Isi tarah Bashir bin Abu Mas'ud ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki.

e: 'Urwah (also) said: 'A'isha?, the wife of the Apostle (ﷺ) narrated it to me that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to say the afternoon prayer, when the light of the sun was there in her apartment before it went out (of it).
hi: Urwah ne bhi kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) ki zauja Aisha (RA) ne mujhe ye bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) asr ki namaz tab padhte the jab dhoop unke, Aisha ke, kamre mein maujood hoti thi, uske nikal jaane se pehle.

e: A'isha reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) said the afternoon" prayer as the sun shone in my apartment, and the afternoon shadow did not extend further. Abu Bakr said: The afternoon shadow did not appear to extend further.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne asr ki namaz tab padhi jab suraj mere kamre mein chamak raha tha, aur asr ka saaya uske aage nahi phailta tha. Abu Bakr ne kaha: Asr ka saaya aage phailta hua nahi dikhta tha.

e: 'A'isha, the wife of the Apostle (ﷺ), said that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said the afternoon prayer (at the time) when the sun shone in her apartment and its shadow did not extend beyond her apartment.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ki zauja Aisha (RA) ne kaha ki Rasoolullah (SAW) asr ki namaz us waqt padhte the jab suraj unke kamre mein chamakta tha aur uska saaya unke kamre se aage nahi phailta tha.

e: A'isha reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said the afternoon prayer (at a time) when the (light) of the sun was there in my apartment.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne asr ki namaz us waqt padhi jab suraj ki roshni mere kamre mein maujood thi.

e: It was narrated from 'Abdullah bin 'Amr that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "When you pray Fajr, its time is until the first part of the sun appears. When you pray Zuhr, its time is until 'Asr comes. When you pray 'Asr, its time is until the sun turns yellow. When you pray Maghrib, its time is until the twilight has disappeared. When you pray 'Isha, its time is until half of the night has passed."
hi: Abdullah bin Amr (RA) se riwayat hai ki Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum fajr padho, uska waqt tab tak hai jab tak suraj ka pehla hissa nazar na aane lage. Jab tum zohar padho, uska waqt tab tak hai jab tak asr ka waqt na aa jaye. Jab tum asr padho, uska waqt tab tak hai jab tak suraj peela na pad jaye. Jab tum maghrib padho, uska waqt tab tak hai jab tak shafaq, laali, khatam na ho jaye. Jab tum isha padho, uska waqt aadhi raat tak hai."

e: Abdullah b. 'Amr reported the Apostle (ﷺ) saying: The time of the noon prayer (lasts) as long as it is not afternoon, and the time of the afternoon prayer (lasts) as long as the sun does not turn pale and the time of the evening prayer (lasts) as long as the spreading appearance of the redness above the horizon after sunset does not sink down, and the, time of the night prayer (lasts) by midnight and the time of the morning prayer (lasts) as long as the sun dots not rise.
hi: Abdullah bin Amr (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Zohar ki namaz ka waqt tab tak rehta hai jab tak asr nahi ho jaata, aur asr ki namaz ka waqt tab tak rehta hai jab tak suraj peela na pad jaye, aur maghrib ki namaz ka waqt tab tak rehta hai jab tak suraj doobne ke baad ufaq ke upar phaili hui laali dab na jaye, aur isha ki namaz ka waqt aadhi raat tak rehta hai, aur fajr ki namaz ka waqt tab tak rehta hai jab tak suraj nahi nikalta.

e: Abu Bakr b Abu Shaiban and Yahya b Abu Bukair both of them narrated this hadith with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Abu Bakr bin Abu Shaiba aur Yahya bin Abu Bukair, dono ne ye hadees isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Amr reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The time of the noon prayer is when the sun passes the meridian and a man's shadow is the same (length) as his height, (and it lasts) as long as the time for the afternoon prayer has not come; the time for the afternoon prayer is as long as the sun has not become pale; the time of the evening prayer is as long as the twilight has not ended; the time of the night prayer is up to the middle of the average night and the time of the morning prayer is from the appearance of dawn, as long as the sun has not risen; but when the sun rises, refrain from prayer for it rises between the horns of the devil.
hi: Abdullah bin Amr (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Zohar ki namaz ka waqt tab hai jab suraj apne darmiyan-bindu se guzar jaye aur aadmi ka saaya uski lambai jitna ho jaye, aur ye waqt tab tak rehta hai jab tak asr ka waqt na aa jaye; asr ki namaz ka waqt tab tak hai jab tak suraj peela na pad jaye; maghrib ki namaz ka waqt tab tak hai jab tak shafaq khatam na ho jaye; isha ki namaz ka waqt aadhi raat ke ausat tak hai aur fajr ki namaz ka waqt subah sadiq ke shuru hone se lekar suraj nikalne tak hai; lekin jab suraj nikal aaye, to namaz se ruk jao, kyunki woh shaitaan ke seengon ke beech se nikalta hai.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Amr b. al-'As reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was asked about the times of prayers. He said: The time for the morning prayer (lasts) as long as the first visible part of the rising sun does not appear and the time of the noon prayer is when the sun declines from the zenith and there is not a time for the afternoon prayer and the time for the afternoon prayer is so long as the sun does not become pale and its first visible part does not set, and the time for the evening prayer is that when the sun disappears and (it lasts) till the twilight is no more and the time for the night prayer is up to the midnight.
hi: Abdullah bin Amr bin al-As (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) se namazon ke auqaat ke baare mein poocha gaya. Unhone farmaya: Subah ki namaz ka waqt tab tak hai jab tak suraj ka pehla hissa nazar na aane lage aur zohar ki namaz ka waqt tab hai jab suraj darmiyan-bindu se dhalta hai aur asr ka waqt shuru nahi hota, aur asr ki namaz ka waqt tab tak hai jab tak suraj peela na pad jaye aur uska pehla hissa doob na jaye, aur maghrib ki namaz ka waqt woh hai jab suraj gaayab ho jaye aur ye waqt shafaq khatam hone tak rehta hai, aur isha ki namaz ka waqt aadhi raat tak hai.

e: 'Abdullah narrated it on the authority of his father Yahya: Knowledge cannot be acquired with sloth.
hi: Abdullah ne apne walid Yahya ke hawale se ye riwayat ki: Ilm sustee se hasil nahi kiya ja sakta.

e: Sulaiman b. Buraida narrated it on the authority of his father that a person asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about the time of prayer. Upon this he said: Pray with us these two, meaning two days. When the sun passed the meridian, he gave command to Bilal who uttered the call to prayer. Then he commanded him and pronounced Iqama for noon prayer (Then at the time of the afternoon prayer) he again commanded and Iqama for the afternoon prayer was pronounced when the sun was high, white and clear. He then commanded and Iqama for the evening prayer was pronounced, when the sun had set. He then commanded him and the Iqama for the night prayer was pronounced when the twilight had disappeared. He then commanded him and the Iqama for the morning prayer was pronounced, when the dawn had appeared. When it was the next day, he commanded him to delay the noon prayer till the extreme heat had passed and he did so, and he allowed it to be delayed till the extreme heat had passed. He observed the afternoon prayer when the sun was high, delaying it beyond the time he had previously observed it. He observed the evening prayer before the twilight had vanished; he observed the night prayer when a third of the night had passed; and he observed the dawn prayer when there was clear daylight. He (the Holy Prophet) then said: Where is the man who inquired about the time of prayer? He (the inquirer) said: Messenger of Allah, here I am. He (the Holy Prophet) said: The time for your prayer is within the limits of what you have seen.
hi: Sulaiman bin Buraida ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki ek shakhs ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se namaz ke waqt ke baare mein poocha. Isper unhone farmaya: Humare saath ye do, yaani do din, namaz padho. Jab suraj apne darmiyan-bindu se dhal gaya, to unhone Bilal ko hukum diya jinhone azaan di. Phir unhone unhe hukum diya aur zohar ki namaz ke liye iqaamat kahi gayi. Phir, asr ki namaz ke waqt, unhone dobara hukum diya aur asr ki namaz ke liye iqaamat kahi gayi jab suraj buland, safed aur saaf tha. Phir unhone hukum diya aur maghrib ki namaz ke liye iqaamat kahi gayi jab suraj doob gaya tha. Phir unhone unhe hukum diya aur isha ki namaz ke liye iqaamat kahi gayi jab shafaq khatam ho gayi thi. Phir unhone unhe hukum diya aur fajr ki namaz ke liye iqaamat kahi gayi jab subah sadiq numaayan ho gayi thi. Jab agla din aaya, to unhone unhe hukum diya ki zohar ki namaz ko tab tak der karein jab tak shadeed garmi guzar na jaye, aur unhone aisa kiya, aur unhe der karne di jab tak shadeed garmi guzar na jaye. Unhone asr ki namaz tab padhi jab suraj buland tha, aur pehle wale waqt se der karte hue. Unhone maghrib ki namaz shafaq gaayab hone se pehle padhi; unhone isha ki namaz tab padhi jab raat ka ek-tihai hissa guzar gaya tha; aur unhone fajr ki namaz tab padhi jab saaf ujaala ho chuka tha. Unhone phir farmaya: Woh shakhs kahan hai jisne namaz ke waqt ke baare mein poocha tha? Unhone kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, main yahan hoon. Unhone farmaya: Tumhari namaz ka waqt un hadon ke andar hai jo tumne dekhi hain.

e: Buraida narrated on the authority of his father that a man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and asked about the times of prayer. He said: You observe with us the prayer. He commanded Bilal, and he uttered the call to prayer in the darkness of night preceding daybreak and he said the morning prayer till dawn had appeared. He then commanded him (Bilal) to call for the noon prayer when the sun had declined from the zenith. He then commanded him (Bilal) to call for the afternoon prayer when the sun was high. He then commanded him for the evening prayer when the sun had set. He then commanded him for the night prayer when the twilight had disappeared. Then on the next day he commanded him (to call for prayer) when there was light in the morning. He then commanded him (to call) for the noon prayer when the extreme heat was no more. He then commanded him for the afternoon prayer when the sun was bright and clear and yellowness did not blend with it. He then commanded him to observe the sunset prayer. He then commanded him for the night prayer when a third part of the night bad passed or a bit less than that. Harami (the narrator of this hadith) was in doubt about that part of the mentioned hadith which concerned the portion of the night. When it was dawn, he (the Holy Prophet) said: Where is the inquirer (who inquired about the times of prayer and added): Between (these two extremes) is the time for prayer.
hi: Buraida ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki ek shakhs Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur namaz ke auqaat ke baare mein poocha. Unhone farmaya: Humare saath namaz mein shaamil ho. Unhone Bilal ko hukum diya, aur unhone raat ke andhere mein, subah sadiq se pehle azaan di aur unhone subah ki namaz tab tak padhi jab tak subah numaayan na ho gayi. Phir unhone unhe zohar ki azaan dene ka hukum diya jab suraj apne darmiyan-bindu se dhal gaya. Phir unhone unhe asr ki azaan dene ka hukum diya jab suraj buland tha. Phir unhone unhe maghrib ke liye hukum diya jab suraj doob gaya. Phir unhone unhe isha ke liye hukum diya jab shafaq khatam ho gayi. Phir agle din unhone unhe azaan dene ka hukum diya jab subah ki roshni thi. Phir unhone unhe zohar ki namaz ke liye hukum diya jab shadeed garmi khatam ho gayi thi. Phir unhone unhe asr ke liye hukum diya jab suraj chamakdar aur saaf tha aur usmein peelaapan nahi mila hua tha. Phir unhone unhe suraj doobne ki namaz ke liye hukum diya. Phir unhone unhe isha ke liye hukum diya jab raat ka ek-tihai hissa guzar chuka tha ya usse thoda kam. Harami, is hadees ke raawi, ko us hisse ke baare mein shaq tha jo raat ke hisse se mutalliq tha. Jab subah hui, to unhone farmaya: Poochne wala kahan hai, aur farmaya: In do inteha'on ke darmiyan namaz ka waqt hai.

e: Abu Musa narrated on the authority of his father that a person came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) for inquiring about the times of prayers. He (the Holy Prophet) gave him no reply (because he wanted to explain to him the times by practically observing these prayers). He then said the morning player when it was daybreak, but the people could hardly recognise one another. He then commanded and the Iqama for the noon prayer was pronounced when the tan had passed the meridian and one would say that it was midday but he (the Holy Prophet) knew batter than them. He then again commanded and the Iqama for the afternoon prayer was pronounced when the sun was high. He then commanded and Iqama for the evening prayer was pronounced when the sun had sunk. He then commanded and Iqama for the night prayer was pronounced when the twilight had disappeared. He then delayed the morning prayer on the next day (so much so) that after returning from it one would say that the sun had risen or it was about to rise. He then delayed the noon prayer till it was near the time of afternoon prayer (as it was observed yesterday). He then delayed the afternoon prayer till one after returning from it would say that the sun had become red. He then delayed the evening prayer till the twilight was about to disappear. He then delayed the night prayer till it was one-third of the night. He then called the inquirer in the morning and said: The time for prayers is between these two (extremes).
hi: Abu Musa ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki ek shakhs Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas namaz ke auqaat ke baare mein poochne aaya. Unhone use koi jawab nahi diya, kyunki woh use amal mein karke dikhana chahte the. Phir unhone subah ki namaz tab padhi jab subah ho chuki thi, lekin log ek doosre ko mushkil se pehchaan pa rahe the. Phir unhone hukum diya aur zohar ki namaz ke liye iqaamat kahi gayi jab suraj darmiyan-bindu se dhal chuka tha aur koi keh sakta tha ki dopahar ho gayi hai lekin unhe inse behtar pata tha. Phir unhone dobara hukum diya aur asr ki namaz ke liye iqaamat kahi gayi jab suraj buland tha. Phir unhone hukum diya aur maghrib ki namaz ke liye iqaamat kahi gayi jab suraj doob gaya tha. Phir unhone hukum diya aur isha ki namaz ke liye iqaamat kahi gayi jab shafaq khatam ho gayi thi. Phir agle din unhone subah ki namaz ko itni der kar di ki namaz se lautte huye koi keh sakta tha ki suraj nikal aaya hai ya nikalne wala hai.
