Phir unhone zohar ki namaz ko is waqt tak der kiya jab tak ki woh asr ki namaz ke waqt, jo kal padhi gayi thi, ke qareeb na aa gaya. Phir unhone asr ki namaz ko itni der ki ki namaz se lautte huye koi keh sakta tha ki suraj laal ho gaya hai. Phir unhone maghrib ki namaz ko itni der ki ki shafaq khatam hone wali thi. Phir unhone isha ki namaz ko raat ke ek-tihai hisse tak der kiya. Phir unhone subah poochne wale ko bulaya aur kaha: Namazon ka waqt in do inteha'on ke darmiyan hai.

e: Abu Musa reported on the authority of his father that an Inquirer came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and asked him about the times of prayers, and the rest of the hadith is the same (as narrated above) but for these words: " On the second day he (the Holy Prophet) observed the evening prayer before the disappearance of the twilight."
hi: Abu Musa ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki ek poochne wala Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unse namazon ke auqaat ke baare mein poocha, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai jaisi upar bayan hui siwaay in alfaaz ke: "Doosre din unhone maghrib ki namaz shafaq khatam hone se pehle padhi."

e: Abu Huraira reported that the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) said: When it is very hot, say (the noon prayer) when the extreme heat passes away, for intensity of heat is from the exhalation of Hell.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab bahut garmi ho, to zohar ki namaz tab padho jab shadeed garmi khatam ho jaye, kyunki garmi ki shiddat jahannam ki saans se hoti hai.

e: Another hadith like this has been transmitted by Abu Huraira.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek doosri hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan ki hai.

e:
Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When it is a hot day, (delay) the prayer till the extreme heat passes away, for the intensity of heat is from the exhalation of Hell.

Abu Huraira reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Refrain from saying (the noon prayer) till the extreme heat passes away, for the Intensity of heat is from the exhalation of Hell.

Abu Huraira narrated this hadith from the Messenger of Allah (may peace be up on him) by another chain of transmitters.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab garmi ka din ho, to namaz ko der karo jab tak shadeed garmi khatam na ho jaye, kyunki garmi ki shiddat jahannam ki saans se hoti hai. Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Zohar ki namaz padhne se tab tak ruko jab tak shadeed garmi khatam na ho jaye, kyunki garmi ki shiddat jahannam ki saans se hoti hai. Abu Huraira (RA) ne ye hadees Rasoolullah (SAW) se ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: This heat is from the exhalation of Hell-fire, so delay the prayer till it is cool.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Ye garmi jahannam ki aag ki saans se hoti hai, is liye namaz ko der karo jab tak thandak na ho jaye.

e: Hammam b. Munabbih reported: This is what Abu Huraira narrated to us from the Prophet and he transmitted some ahadith-one of them was that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Let the heat become less severe before prayer, for the intensity of heat is from the exhalation of Hell.
hi: Hammam bin Munabbih ne bayan kiya: Ye woh hai jo Abu Huraira ne humein Nabi (SAW) se bayan kiya, aur unhone kayi hadeesein bayan ki - unmein se ek ye thi ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Namaz se pehle garmi ki shiddat ko kam hone do, kyunki garmi ki shiddat jahannam ki saans se hoti hai.

e: Abu Dharr reported: The Mu'adhdbin (the announcer of the hour of prayer) of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) called for the noon prayer. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Let it cool down, let it cool down, or he said: Wait, wait for the intensity of heat is from the exhalation of Hell. When the heat is intense, delay the prayer till it becomes cooler. Abu Dharr said: (We waited) till we saw the shadow of the mounds.
hi: Abu Dharr (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ke muazzin ne zohar ki azaan di. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Ise thanda hone do, ise thanda hone do, ya unhone kaha: Intezaar karo, intezaar karo, kyunki garmi ki shiddat jahannam ki saans se hoti hai. Jab garmi shadeed ho, to namaz ko der karo jab tak thandak na ho jaye. Abu Dharr ne kaha: Hum intezaar karte rahe yahan tak ki humne teelon ka saaya dekh liya.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The Fire made a complaint before the Lord saying." O Lord, some parts of mine have consumed the others." So it was allowed to take two exhalations, one exhalation in winter and the other exhalation in summer. That is why you find extreme heat (in summer) and extreme cold (in winter).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jahannam ne apne Rab se shikaayat ki aur kaha: "Aye Rab, mere kuch hisson ne doosre hisson ko kha liya hai." To use do saansein lene ki ijazat di gayi, ek saans sardi mein aur doosri saans garmi mein. Isi liye tum garmi mein shadeed garmi aur sardi mein shadeed thand paate ho.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When it is hot, make delay (in the noon prayer) till it cools down, for the intensity of beat is from the Exhalation of Hell; and he also mentioned that Hellfire complained to the Lord (about the congested atmosphere) and so it was permitted to take two exhalations during the whole year, one exhalation during the winter and one exhalation during the summer.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab garmi ho, to zohar ki namaz tab tak der karo jab tak thandak na ho jaye, kyunki garmi ki shiddat jahannam ki saans se hoti hai; aur unhone ye bhi zikr kiya ki jahannam ne apne Rab se tangi ke mahaul ke baare mein shikaayat ki aur is liye use saal bhar mein do saansein lene ki ijazat di gayi, ek saans sardi mein aur ek saans garmi mein.

e: Abu Huraira reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The Fire said to the Lord: O Lord! some parts of mine have consumed the others, so allow me to exhale (in order to find some relief from this congestion). It was granted permission to take two exhalations, one exhalation during the winter and the other exhalation during the summer So whatever you perceive in the form of intense cold or hurting cold is from the exhalation of Hell. And whatever you perceive in the form of extreme heat or intense beat is from the exhalation of Hell.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jahannam ne apne Rab se kaha: Aye Rab! Mere kuch hisson ne doosre hisson ko kha liya hai, is liye mujhe saans lene ki ijazat de, taaki mujhe is tangi se kuch aaraam mile. Use do saansein lene ki ijazat di gayi, ek saans sardi mein aur doosri saans garmi mein. Is liye tum jo bhi shadeed sardi ya takleefdeh thand mahsoos karte ho, woh jahannam ki saans se hai. Aur jo bhi shadeed garmi ya taiz garmi mahsoos karte ho, woh bhi jahannam ki saans se hai.

e: Jabir b. Samura reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) used to offer the noon prayer when the sun declined.
hi: Jabir bin Samura (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) zohar ki namaz us waqt padha karte the jab suraj dhalta.

e: Khabbab reported: We complained to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) (the difficulty of) saying prayer on the intensely heated (ground or sand), but he paid no heed to our complaint.
hi: Khabbab (RA) ne bayan kiya: Humne Rasoolullah (SAW) se shadeed garam zameen ya ret par namaz padhne ki mushkil ki shikaayat ki, lekin unhone hamari shikaayat par tawajjo nahi di.

e: Khabbab reported: We came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and we complained to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about (saying prayer) on the extremely heated ground (or sand), but he paid no heed to us. Zuhair said: I asked Abu Ishaq whether it was about the noon prayer. He said: Yes. I again said whether it concerned the (offering) of the noon (prayer) in earlier hours. He said: Yes. I said: Did it concern expediting it? He said: Yes.
hi: Khabbab (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aaye aur humne Rasoolullah (SAW) se shadeed garam zameen ya ret par namaz padhne ki shikaayat ki, lekin unhone hamari taraf tawajjo nahi di. Zuhair ne kaha: Maine Abu Ishaq se poocha ki kya ye zohar ki namaz ke baare mein tha. Unhone kaha: Haan. Maine phir poocha ki kya ye zohar ki namaz jaldi padhne ke baare mein tha. Unhone kaha: Haan. Maine kaha: Kya ye ise jaldi karne ke baare mein tha? Unhone kaha: Haan.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: We used to say (the noonprayer) with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in the intense heat, but when someone amongst us found it hard to place his forehead on the ground, he spread his cloth and prostrated on it.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath shadeed garmi mein zohar ki namaz padha karte the, lekin jab humme se kisi ke liye apni peshani zameen par rakhna mushkil ho jaata, to woh apna kapda bichha kar uspar sajda karta.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to pray the afternoon prayer when the sun was high and bright, then one would go off to al-'Awali and get there while the sun was still high. Ibn Qutaiba made no mention of" one would go off to al-'Awali".
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) asr ki namaz us waqt padha karte the jab suraj buland aur roshan hota, phir koi al-Awali jaata aur wahan pahunchta jab suraj abhi bhi buland hota. Ibn Qutaiba ne "koi al-Awali jaata" ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: This hadith that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to offer the afternoon prayer like the one narrated above has been transmitted by Anas b. Malik by another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees ki Rasoolullah (SAW) asr ki namaz upar bayan hui hadees jaisi padha karte the, Anas bin Malik (RA) ne ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: We used to offer the 'Asr prayer, then one would go to Quba' and reach there and the sun would be still high.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum asr ki namaz padha karte the, phir koi Quba jaata aur wahan pahunchta aur suraj abhi bhi buland hota.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: We used to offer the afternoon prayer (at such a time) that a person would go to Bani 'Amr b. Auf and he would find them busy offering the afternoon prayer.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum asr ki namaz aise waqt par padha karte the ki koi shakhs Banu Amr bin Auf ke paas jaata aur unhe asr ki namaz padhne mein masroof paata.

e: 'Ala' b. 'Abd al-Rahman reported that they came to the house of Anas b. Malik in Basra after saying the noon prayer. His (Anas) house was situated by the side of the mosque. As revisited him he (Anas) said: Have you said the afternoon prayer? We said to him: It is just a few minutes before that we finished the noon prayer. He said: Offer the afternoon prayer. So we stood up and said our prayer. And when we completed it, he said: I have heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: This is how the hypocrite prays: he sits watching the sun, and when it is between the horns of devil, he rises and strikes the ground four times (in haste) mentioning Allah a little during it.
hi: Ala bin Abdur-Rahman ne bayan kiya ki woh Basra mein Anas bin Malik ke ghar zohar ki namaz padhne ke baad aaye. Unka ghar masjid ke bagal mein tha. Jab woh unse milne gaye to unhone kaha: Kya tumne asr ki namaz padh li hai? Humne unse kaha: Abhi to hamein zohar ki namaz mukammal kiye kuch hi minat hue hain. Unhone kaha: Asr ki namaz padho. To hum khade ho gaye aur apni namaz padhi. Aur jab humne use mukammal kiya, to unhone kaha: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: Munaafiq isi tarah namaz padhta hai: woh suraj ko dekhte hue baithta hai, aur jab woh shaitaan ke seengon ke beech aa jaata hai, to woh jaldi mein khada hota hai aur chaar baar jaldi jaldi zameen par sajde ki tarah chonchein maarta hai, uske dauran bahut kam Allah ka zikr karte hue.

e: Abu Umama b. Sahl reported: We offered the noon prayer with Umar b. 'Abd al-'Aziz. We then set out till we came to Anas b. Malik and found him busy in saying the afternoon prayer. I said to him: O uncle! which is this prayer that you are offering? He said: It is the afternoon prayer and this is the prayer of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that we offered along with him.
hi: Abu Umama bin Sahl ne bayan kiya: Humne Umar bin Abdul Aziz ke saath zohar ki namaz padhi. Phir hum chal pade yahan tak ki hum Anas bin Malik ke paas pahunche aur unhe asr ki namaz padhne mein masroof paaya. Maine unse kaha: Aye chacha! Ye kaunsi namaz hai jo aap padh rahe hain? Unhone kaha: Ye asr ki namaz hai aur ye woh namaz hai jo hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath padha karte the.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led us in the afternoon prayer. When he completed it, a person from Bani Salama came to him and said: Messenger of Allah, we intend to slaughter our came and we are desirous that you should also be present there (on this occasion). He (the Holy Prophet) said: Yes. He (the person) went and we also went along with him and we found that the camel had not been slaughtered yet. Then it was slaughtered, and it was cut into pieces and then some of those were cooked, and then we ate (them) before the setting of the sun. This hadith has also been narrated by another chain of transmitters.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne humein asr ki namaz padhayi. Jab unhone use mukammal kiya, to Banu Salama ka ek shakhs unke paas aaya aur kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, hum apna oont zibah karne ka irada rakhte hain aur hum chahte hain ki aap bhi wahan maujood hon. Unhone farmaya: Theek hai. Woh shakhs gaya aur hum bhi unke saath gaye aur humne paaya ki oont abhi zibah nahi hua tha. Phir use zibah kiya gaya, aur use tukdon mein kaata gaya aur phir kuch hisson ko pakaya gaya, aur humne suraj doobne se pehle unhe khaya. Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Rafi' b. Khadij reported: We used to say the afternoon prayer with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and then the camel was slaughtered and ten parts of it were distributed; then it was cooked and then we ate this cooked meat before the sinking of the sun.
hi: Rafi' bin Khadij (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath asr ki namaz padha karte the, aur phir oont zibah kiya jaata aur uske das hisse baante jaate; phir use pakaya jaata aur hum ye pakaya hua gosht suraj doobne se pehle kha lete the.

e: This hadith has been reported by 'Auza'i with the same chain of transmitters: We used to slaughter the camel during the lifetime of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) after the 'Asr prayer, but he made no mention of:" We used to pray along with him."
hi: Ye hadees Auza'i ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai: Hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke daur mein asr ki namaz ke baad oont zibah kiya karte the, lekin unhone "Hum unke saath namaz padha karte the" ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: Ibn Umar reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: He who misses the afternoon prayer, it is as though he has been deprived of his family and his property.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jo asr ki namaz chhod de, jaise usse uske ghar-waale aur uska maal chheen liya gaya ho.

e: This hadith has been narrated as Marfu by another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se Marfu, yaani Nabi (SAW) tak pahunchne wali, riwayat ke taur par bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Abdullah relates on the authority of his father. He who missed his afternoon prayer it is as though he was deprived of his family and property.
hi: Abdullah apne walid ke hawale se bayan karte hain: Jo apni asr ki namaz chhod de, jaise usse uske ghar-waale aur maal chheen liye gaye hon.

e: 'Ali reported: When it was the day (of the Battle) of Ahzab, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: May Allah fill their graves and houses with fire, as they detained us and diverted us from the middle prayer, till the sun set.
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne bayan kiya: Ahzab ki jung ke din, Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Allah unki qabron aur gharon ko aag se bhar de, kyunki unhone humein rok kar rakha aur humein beech ki namaz, salat-e-wusta, se, suraj doobne tak, bhatka diya.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Hisham with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Hisham ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: 'Ali reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: On the day (of the Battle) of Ahzab we were diverted from the middle prayer, till the sun set. May Allah fill their graves or their houses, or their stomachs with fire. The narrator is in doubt about" houses" and" stomachs".
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Ahzab ki jung ke din humein beech ki namaz se, suraj doobne tak, bhatka diya gaya. Allah unki qabron, ya unke gharon, ya unke pet ko aag se bhar de. Raawi ko "gharon" aur "pet" ke alfaaz mein shaq hai.

e: This hadith has heed narrated by Qatada with the same chain of transmitters. And he said: Their houses and their graves (be filled with fire), and did not express doubt over the words," houses" and" graves".
hi: Ye hadees Qatada ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai. Aur unhone kaha: Unke ghar aur unki qabren aag se bhar di jayein, aur "ghar" aur "qabr" ke alfaaz mein koi shaq zaahir nahi kiya.

e: Yahya heard 'Ali saying that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said on the day (of the Battle) of Ahzab, while sitting in one of the openings of the ditch: They (the enemies) have diverted us from the middle prayer till the sun set. May Allah fill their graves and their houses with fire, or their graves and stomachs with fire.
hi: Yahya ne Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko ye kehte suna ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Ahzab ki jung ke din, khandaq ke ek darze mein baithe hue, farmaya: Unhone dushmanon ne humein beech ki namaz se, suraj doobne tak, bhatka diya. Allah unki qabron aur gharon ko aag se bhar de, ya unki qabron aur pet ko aag se bhar de.

e: 'Ali reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said on the day (of the Battle) of Ahzab: They diverted us from saying the middle prayer, i. e. the 'Asr prayer. May Allah fill their houses and graves with fire; he then observed this prayer between the evening prayer and the night prayer.
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Ahzab ki jung ke din farmaya: Unhone humein beech ki namaz, yaani asr ki namaz, padhne se bhatka diya. Allah unke ghar aur qabren aag se bhar de; phir unhone ye namaz maghrib aur isha ke darmiyan padhi.

e: 'Abdullah (b. Mas'ud) reported that the polytheists detained the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) from observing the afternoon prayer till the sun became red or it became yellow. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: They have diverted us from (offering) the middle prayer. i. e. the 'Asr prayer. May Allah fill their bellies and their graves with fire, or he said: May Allah stuff their bellies and their graves with fire.
hi: Abdullah (bin Mas'ud) ne bayan kiya ki mushrikeen ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko asr ki namaz padhne se roka yahan tak ki suraj laal ho gaya ya peela ho gaya. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Unhone humein beech ki namaz, yaani asr ki namaz, se bhatka diya. Allah unke peton aur qabron ko aag se bhar de, ya unhone kaha: Allah unke peton aur qabron ko aag se thoons de.

e: Abu Yunus, the freed slave of 'A'isha said: 'A'isha ordered me to transcribe a copy of the Qur'an for her and said: When you reach this verse:" Guard the prayers and the middle prayer" (ii. 238), inform me; so when I reached it, I informed her and she gave me dictation (like this): Guard the prayers and the middle prayer and the afternoon prayer, and stand up truly obedient to Allah. 'A'isha said: This is how I have heard from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).
hi: Abu Yunus, Aisha (RA) ke aazad kiye hue ghulam, ne kaha: Aisha ne mujhe unke liye Quran ki ek copy likhne ka hukum diya aur kaha: Jab tum is aayat par pahuncho: "Namazon ki, aur beech ki namaz ki, hifazat karo" (2:238), to mujhe bataana; to jab main wahan pahuncha, maine unhe bataya aur unhone mujhe aise likhwaya: Namazon ki, aur beech ki namaz ki, aur asr ki namaz ki hifazat karo, aur sacchai se Allah ke saamne tabedaar khade raho. Aisha ne kaha: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) se isi tarah suna hai.

e:
Al-Bara' b. 'Azib reported: This verse was revealed (in this way):" Guard the prayers and the 'Asr prayer." We recited it (in this very way) so long as Allah desired. Allah, then, abrogated it and it was revealed:" Guard the prayers, and the middle prayer." A person who was sitting with Shaqiq (one of the narrators in the chain of transmitters) said: Now it implies the 'Asr prayer. Upon this al-Bara' said: I have already informed you how this (verse) was revealed and how Allah abrogated it, and Allah knows best.

Imam Muslim said: Ashja'i narrated it from Sufyan al-Thauri, who narrated it from al-Aswad b. Qais, who narrated it from 'Uqba, who narrated it from al-Bara' b. 'Azib who said: We recited with the Prophet (ﷺ) (the above-mentioned verse like this, i. e. instead of Salat al- Wusta, Salat al-'Asr) for a certain period. as It has been mentioned (in the above-quoted hadith).
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (RA) ne bayan kiya: Ye aayat isi tarah nazil hui thi: "Namazon ki, aur asr ki namaz ki, hifazat karo." Humne ise isi tarah tab tak padha jab tak Allah ne chaha. Phir Allah ne ise mansookh kar diya aur ye nazil hua: "Namazon ki, aur beech ki namaz ki, hifazat karo." Ek shakhs jo Shaqiq, raawiyon mein se ek, ke saath baitha tha, ne kaha: Ab iska matlab asr ki namaz hai. Isper Al-Bara ne kaha: Maine tumhe pehle hi bata diya hai ki ye aayat kaise nazil hui aur Allah ne ise kaise mansookh kiya, aur Allah behtar jaanta hai. Imam Muslim ne kaha: Ashja'i ne ise Sufyan al-Thauri se riwayat ki, jinhone al-Aswad bin Qais se, jinhone Uqba se, jinhone Al-Bara bin Azib se riwayat ki jinhone kaha: Humne Nabi (SAW) ke saath upar zikr ki gayi aayat isi tarah padhi, yaani Salat al-Wusta ki jagah Salat al-Asr, ek khaas arse tak, jaisa upar bayan ki gayi hadees mein zikr hua hai.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that Umar b. al-Khattab had been cursing the pagans of the Quraish an the day (of the Battle) of Khandaq (Ditch). (He came to the Holy Prophet) and said: Messenger of Allah, by God, I could not say. the 'Asr prayer till the sun set. Upon this the Messenger (ﷺ) said: By Allah I, too, have not observed it. So we went to a valley. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) performed ablution and we too performed ablution, and then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said the 'Asr prayer after the sun had set. and then said the evening prayer after it.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya ki Umar bin Khattab (RA) Khandaq ki jung ke din Quraish ke mushrikon par laanat bhej rahe the. Woh Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, Allah ki qasam, main asr ki namaz suraj doobne tak nahi padh saka. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Allah ki qasam, main bhi nahi padh saka. To hum ek wadi ki taraf gaye. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne wuzu kiya aur humne bhi wuzu kiya, aur phir Rasoolullah (SAW) ne suraj doobne ke baad asr ki namaz padhi, aur phir uske baad maghrib ki namaz padhi.

e: This hadith has been reported by Yahya b. Abd Kathir with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Yahya bin Abd Kathir ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Angels take turns among you by night and by day, and they all assemble at the dawn and afternoon prayers. Those (of the angels) who spend the night among you, then, ascend, and their Lord asks them, though He is the best informed about them: How did you leave My servants? -they say: We left them while they were praying and we came to them while they were praying.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Farishte tum mein raat aur din mein baari-baari aate hain, aur woh sab fajr aur asr ki namazon mein ikattha hote hain. Woh farishte jo tumhare beech raat guzarte hain, phir upar chadhte hain, aur unka Rab, jise unke baare mein sabse zyada khabar hai, unse poochta hai: Tumne mere bandon ko kaise chhoda? Woh kehte hain: Humne unhe is haal mein chhoda ki woh namaz padh rahe the aur hum unke paas is haal mein aaye the ki woh namaz padh rahe the.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Angels take turns among you by night and by day, and the rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Farishte tum mein raat aur din mein baari-baari aate hain, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Jarir b. Abdullah is reported to have said: We were sitting with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that he looked at the full moon and observed: You shall see your Lord as you are seeing this moon, and you will not be harmed by seeing Him. So if you can, do not let -yourselves be overpowered in case of prayer observed before the rising of the sun and its setting, i. e. the 'Asr prayer and the morning prayer. Jarir then recited it:" Celebrate the praise of thy Lord before the rising of the sun and before Its setting" (xx. 130).
hi: Jarir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath baithe the ki unhone chaudhvin ke chaand ko dekha aur farmaya: Tum apne Rab ko waise hi dekhoge jaise tum is chaand ko dekh rahe ho, aur tumhe use dekhne mein koi taklif nahi hogi. Is liye agar tum kar sako, to apne aap ko namaz padhne mein, jo suraj nikalne aur doobne se pehle hoti hai, yaani asr aur fajr ki namaz, kamzor mat padne do. Jarir ne phir ye padha: "Apne Rab ki hamd ki tasbeeh karo suraj nikalne se pehle aur uske doobne se pehle" (20:130).

e: Waki' reported (this hadith) with the same chain of transmitters (that the Holy Prophet) said: You will be soon presented before your Lord, and you will see Him as you are seeing this moon, and then recited (the above-mentioned verse). But (in this hadith) no mention is made of Jarir.
hi: Waki' ne isi sanad se ye hadees bayan ki ki Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Jald hi tumhe apne Rab ke saamne pesh kiya jayega, aur tum use waise hi dekhoge jaise tum is chaand ko dekh rahe ho, aur phir upar zikr ki gayi aayat padhi. Lekin is hadees mein Jarir ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: 'Umara b. Ruwaiba is reported to have said on the authority of his father: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: He who observes prayer before the rising of the sun and its setting, i.e. the dawn prayer and the afternoon prayer, would not enter the (Hell) fire. A person belonging to Basra said to him: Did you yourself hear it from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)? He said: Yes. The person (from Basra) said: I bear witness that I heard it from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ); my ears heard it and my heart retained it.
hi: Umara bin Ruwaiba ne apne walid ke hawale se bayan kiya: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: Jo suraj nikalne aur doobne se pehle namaz padhe, yaani fajr aur asr ki namaz, woh jahannam ki aag mein nahi jayega. Basra ke ek shakhs ne unse kaha: Kya aapne khud ise Rasoolullah (SAW) se suna? Unhone kaha: Haan. Us shakhs ne kaha: Main gawaahi deta hoon ki maine ise Rasoolullah (SAW) se suna; mere kaanon ne ise suna aur mere dil ne ise sambhal kar rakha.

e: Umara b. Ruwaiba reported on the authority of his father that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: He who said prayer before the rising of the sun and its setting would not enter the fire (of Hell), and there was a man from Basra (sitting) beside him who said: Did you hear it from the Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him)? He said: Yes, I bear witness to it. The man from Basra said: I bear witness that I did hear from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying it from the place that you heard from him.
hi: Umara bin Ruwaiba ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jo suraj nikalne aur doobne se pehle namaz padhe, woh jahannam ki aag mein nahi jayega, aur unke paas Basra ka ek shakhs baitha tha jisne kaha: Kya aapne ise Rasoolullah (SAW) se suna? Unhone kaha: Haan, main iski gawaahi deta hoon. Basra wale shakhs ne kaha: Main gawaahi deta hoon ki maine bhi ise Rasoolullah (SAW) se, usi jagah se jahan aapne suna, kehte suna hai.

e: Abu Bakr reported on the authority of his father that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: He who observed two prayers at two cool (hours) would enter Paradise.
hi: Abu Bakr ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jo do namazein do thandi ghadiyon mein padhe, woh Jannat mein jayega.

e: This hadith has been narrated by the same chain of transmitters by Hammam, and said about Abu Bakr that he was Ibn Abu Musa.
hi: Ye hadees Hammam ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai, aur Abu Bakr ke baare mein bataya ki woh Ibn Abu Musa the.

e: Salama b. al-Akwa' reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to pray the evening prayer when the sun had set and disappeared (behind the horizon).
hi: Salama bin al-Akwa (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) maghrib ki namaz tab padha karte the jab suraj doob kar ufaq ke peeche gaayab ho jaata.

e: Rafi' b. Khadij reported: We used to observe the evening prayer with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and then one of us would go away and he could see the (distant) place where his arrow would fall.
hi: Rafi' bin Khadij (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath maghrib ki namaz padha karte the aur phir humme se koi chala jaata aur door tak us jagah ko dekh sakta jahan uska teer girta.

e: A hadith like this, i. e." We used to observe evening prayer...." so on and so forth, has been narrated by Rafi' b. Khadij by another chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees, yaani "Hum maghrib ki namaz padha karte the...", Rafi' bin Khadij ne ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki hai.

e: 'A'isha. the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) deferred one night the 'Isya' prayer. And this is called 'Atama. And the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not come out till Umar b. Khattab told (him) that the women and children had gone to sleep. So the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came out towards them and said to the people of the mosque: None except you from the people of the earth waits for it (for the night prayer at this late hour), and it was before Islam had spread amongst people. And in the narration transmitted by Ibn Shihab the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) is reported to have said: It is not meant that you should compel the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) for prayer. And (this he said) when 'Umar b. Khattab called (the Holy Prophet) in a loud voice.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ki zauja Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne ek raat isha ki namaz der se padhi. Aur ise "Atama" kaha jaata hai. Aur Rasoolullah (SAW) tab tak bahar nahi aaye jab tak Umar bin Khattab ne unhe bataya ki auraten aur bacche so gaye hain. To Rasoolullah (SAW) unki taraf aaye aur masjid mein maujood logon se kaha: Zameen walon mein se tumhare siwa koi bhi isha ki namaz ke is der wale waqt ka intezaar nahi karta, aur ye us waqt tha jab Islam abhi logon mein poori tarah phaila nahi tha. Aur Ibn Shihab ki riwayat mein Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya bataya gaya hai: Iska matlab ye nahi ki tum Rasoolullah (SAW) ko namaz ke liye majboor karo. Aur ye unhone tab kaha jab Umar bin Khattab ne Nabi (SAW) ko zor se pukara.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated by Ibn Shihab with the same chain of transmitters, but therein no mention has been made of the words of al-Zuhri: It was narrated to me, and that which followed.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Ibn Shihab ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai, lekin usmein al-Zuhri ke ye alfaaz "Mujhe bataya gaya" aur uske baad ki baat ka zikr nahi hai.

e: 'A'isha reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) one night delayed (observing the 'Isya' prayer) till a great part of the night was over and the people in the mosque had gone to sleep. He (the Holy Prophet) then came out and observed prayer and said: This is the proper time for it; were it not that I would impose a burden on my people (I would normally pray at this time). In the hadith transmitters by 'Abd al-Razzaq (the words are):" Were it not that it would impose burden on my people."
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne ek raat isha ki namaz padhne mein itni der ki ki raat ka bada hissa guzar gaya aur masjid mein maujood log so gaye. Phir woh bahar aaye aur namaz padhayi aur farmaya: Ye iska sahih waqt hai; agar mujhe apni ummat par bojh dalne ka khauf na hota to main hamesha isi waqt namaz padhta. Abdur-Razzaq ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: "Agar mujhe apni ummat par bojh dalne ka khauf na hota."

e: Abdullah b. Umar reported: We waited one night in expectation of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) for the last prayer of the night, and he came out to us when a third of the night had passed even after that. We do not know whether he had been occupied with family business or something else. When he came cut he said: You are waiting for prayer, for which the followers of no other religion wait. except you. Were it not a burden for my Ummah, I would have led them (in the 'Isya' prayer) at this hour. He then ordered the Mu'adhdbin (to call for prayer) and then stood up for prayer and observed prayer.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum ek raat Rasoolullah (SAW) ka isha ki aakhri namaz ke liye intezaar karte rahe, aur woh humare paas raat ka ek-tihai hissa guzarne ke baad bhi bahar aaye. Humein nahi pata tha ki woh ghar ke kisi kaam mein masroof the ya kisi aur cheez mein. Jab woh bahar aaye to unhone kaha: Tum namaz ka intezaar kar rahe ho, jiska intezaar tumhare siwa kisi aur mazhab ke maanne wale nahi karte. Agar ye meri ummat par bojh na hota, to main unhe isi waqt isha ki namaz padhata. Phir unhone muazzin ko hukum diya azaan dene ka aur phir namaz ke liye khade hue aur namaz padhi.

e: Abdullah b. 'Umar reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was one night occupied (in some work) and he delayed it ('Isya' prayer) till we went to sleep in the mosque. We then woke up and again went to sleep and again woke up. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) then came to us and said: None among the people of the earth except you waits for prayer in the night.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ek raat kisi kaam mein masroof the aur unhone use isha ki namaz der se padhi yahan tak ki hum masjid mein so gaye. Phir hum jaage aur dobara so gaye aur phir jaage. Phir Rasoolullah (SAW) hamare paas aaye aur farmaya: Zameen walon mein se tumhare siwa koi bhi raat mein namaz ka intezaar nahi karta.

e: Thabit reported: They (the believers) asked Anas about the ring of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he said: One night the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) delayed (observing) the 'Isya' prayer up to the midnight or midnight was about to be over. He then came and said: (Other) people have offered prayers and slept, but you are constantly in prayer as long as you wait for prayer. Anas said: I perceive as if I am seeing the lustre of his silver ring, and lifted his, small left finger (in order to show how the Prophet had lifted it).
hi: Thabit ne bayan kiya: Unhone imaandaron ne Anas se Rasoolullah (SAW) ki angoothi ke baare mein poocha aur unhone kaha: Ek raat Rasoolullah (SAW) ne isha ki namaz aadhi raat tak, ya aadhi raat khatam hone ke qareeb, der ki. Phir woh aaye aur farmaya: Doosre log namaz padhkar so chuke hain, lekin tum musalsal namaz mein ho jab tak tum namaz ka intezaar karte ho. Anas ne kaha: Mujhe aisa lagta hai jaise main unki chandi ki angoothi ki chamak dekh raha hoon, aur unhone apni chhoti si baayi ungli uthayi ye dikhane ke liye ki Nabi (SAW) ne use kaise uthaya tha.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: We waited for the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon hi n) one night, till it was about midnight. He (the Holy Prophet) came and observed prayer and then turned his face towards us, as it I was seeing the lustre of the silver ring on his finger.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ka ek raat intezaar karte rahe, yahan tak ki aadhi raat ho gayi. Woh Nabi (SAW) aaye aur namaz padhayi aur phir hamari taraf mudkar dekha, jaise main unki ungli mein chandi ki angoothi ki chamak dekh raha hoon.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Qurra with the same chain of transmitters, but therein he did not mention: " He turned his face towards us."
hi: Ye hadees Qurra ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai, lekin usmein unhone "unhone hamari taraf mudkar dekha" ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: Abu Musa reported: I and my companions who had sailed along with me in the boat landed with me in the valley of Buthan while the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was staying in Medina. A party of people amongst them went to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) every night at the time of the 'Isya' prayer turn by turn. Abu Musa said: (One night) we (I and my companions) went to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he was occupied in some matter till there was a delay in prayer so much so that it was the middle of the night. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) then came out and led them (Musa's companions) in prayer. And when he had observed his prayer he said to the audience present: Take it easy, I am going to give you information and glad tidings that it is the blessing of Allah upon you for there is none among the people, except you, who prays at this hour (of the night), or he said: None except you observed prayer at this. (late) hour. He (i. e. the narrator) said: I am not sure which of these two sentences he actually uttered. Abu Musa, said: We came back happy for what we heard from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).
hi: Abu Musa (RA) ne bayan kiya: Main aur mere saathi, jo mere saath kashti mein safar karke aaye the, Buthan ki wadi mein utre jabki Rasoolullah (SAW) Madina mein maujood the. Unmein se logon ka ek giroh har raat isha ki namaz ke waqt Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas baari-baari jaata tha. Abu Musa ne kaha: Ek raat hum, main aur mere saathi, Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas gaye aur woh kisi maamle mein masroof the yahan tak ki namaz mein itni der ho gayi ki raat aadhi ho gayi. Phir Rasoolullah (SAW) bahar aaye aur unhe Musa ke saathiyon ko namaz padhayi. Aur jab unhone apni namaz mukammal ki to maujood logon se kaha: Sukoon rakho, main tumhe khabar aur khushkhabri dene wala hoon ki ye tumpar Allah ka fazl hai kyunki tumhare siwa koi bhi is waqt namaz nahi padhta, ya unhone kaha: Tumhare siwa koi bhi is der wale waqt mein namaz nahi padhta. Raawi ne kaha: Mujhe yaqeen nahi ki unhone in do jumlon mein se kaunsa asal mein kaha tha. Abu Musa ne kaha: Hum jo kuch Rasoolullah (SAW) se suna tha usse khush hokar wapas aaye.

e: Ibn Juraij reported: I said to Ata': Which time do you deem fit for me to say the 'Isya' prayer, -as an Imam or alone, -that time which is called by people 'Atama? He said: I heard Ibn 'Abbas saying: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) one night delayed the 'Isya' prayer till the people went to sleep. They woke up and again went to sleep and again woke up. Then 'Umar b. Khattab stood up and said (loudly)" Prayer." Ata' further reported that Ibn 'Abbas said: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) came out, and as if I am still seeing him with water trickling from his head, and with his hand placed on one side of the head, and he said: Were it not hard for my Ummah, I would have ordered them to observe this prayer like this (i. e. at late hours). I inquired from 'Ata' how the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) placed his hand upon his head as Ibn Abbas had informed. So Ata' spread his fingers a little and then placed the ends of his fingers on the side of his head. He then moved them like this over his head till the thumb touched that part of the ear which is near the face and then it (went) to the earlock and the part of the heard. It (the bind) neither held nor caught anything but this is how (it moved oil). I said to Ata': Was it mentioned to you (by Ibn Abbas) how long did the Apostle (ﷺ) delay it (the prayer) during that eight? He said: I do not know (I cannot give you the exact time). Ali' said: I love that I should say prayer, whether as an Imam or alone at delayed hours as the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said that night, but if It is hard upon you in your individual capacity or upon people in the congregation and you are their Imam, then say prayer ('Isha') at the middle hours neither too early nor too late.
hi: Ibn Juraij ne bayan kiya: Maine Ata se kaha: Aap mere liye isha ki namaz, chahe Imam ke taur par ya akele, kaunsa waqt munaasib samajhte hain - woh waqt jise log "Atama" kehte hain? Unhone kaha: Maine Ibn Abbas ko kehte suna: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne ek raat isha ki namaz itni der ki ki log so gaye. Woh jaage aur dobara so gaye aur phir jaage. Phir Umar bin Khattab khade hue aur zor se kaha "Namaz." Ata ne aage bataya ki Ibn Abbas ne kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) bahar aaye, aur aisa lagta hai jaise main abhi bhi unhe dekh raha hoon jinke sar se paani tapak raha tha, aur unka haath sar ke ek taraf rakha hua tha, aur unhone farmaya: Agar meri ummat par ye mushkil na hota, to main unhe hukum deta ki woh ye namaz isi tarah, yaani der se, padha karein. Maine Ata se poocha ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne apna haath apne sar par kaise rakha tha jaisa Ibn Abbas ne bataya. To Ata ne apni ungliyan thodi si phailaayi aur phir apni ungliyon ke sire apne sar ke ek taraf rakhe. Phir unhone unhe apne sar par isi tarah chalaya jab tak angootha kaan ke us hisse ko chhoo na le jo chehre ke qareeb hai aur phir kanpati aur dadhi ke hisse tak le gaye. Ye haath na kisi cheez ko pakadta tha na koi cheez uthaata tha, balki bas isi tarah chalta tha. Maine Ata se kaha: Kya aapko bataya gaya ki us raat Rasoolullah (SAW) ne ise namaz ko kitni der kiya tha? Unhone kaha: Mujhe nahi pata, main aapko sahi waqt nahi bata sakta. Ata ne kaha: Mujhe pasand hai ki main namaz, chahe Imam ke taur par ya akele, der wale waqt mein padhun jaise Rasoolullah (SAW) ne us raat padhi thi, lekin agar ye tumhare liye akele ya logon ke liye jamaat mein, jiske tum Imam ho, mushkil ho, to isha ki namaz beech ke waqt mein padho, na bahut jaldi na bahut der se.

e: Jabir b. Samura reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) postponed the last 'Isha' prayer.
hi: Jabir bin Samura (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne aakhri isha ki namaz ko der kiya.

e: Jabir b. Samura reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to observe prayers like your prayers, but he would delay the prayer after nightfall to a little after the time you observed it, and he would shorten the prayer.
hi: Jabir bin Samura (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) namaz tumhari namazon jaisi hi padha karte the, lekin woh isha ki namaz ko raat hone ke baad tumhare padhne ke waqt se thodi der se padhte the, aur woh namaz ko mukhtasar rakhte the.

e: Abdullah b. 'Umar reported: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: Let the bedouin not gain upper hand over you in regard to the name of your prayer. See I (The night prayer should be called) 'Isya' (and the bedouins call it Atama (because) they milk their camels late.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: Dehaati tum par apni namaz ke naam ke maamle mein haawi na hone paayein. Dekho! Raat ki namaz ko "Isha" kaha jaana chahiye, aur dehaati ise "Atama" kehte hain kyunki woh apne oont der se doodhte hain.

e: Ibn 'Umar said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Let the bedouin not gain upper band over you In regard to the name of your prayer, i. e. night prayer, for it is mentioned 'Isya' in the Book of Allah (i. e. the Qur'an). (The bedouin call it 'Atama because) they make delay in milling their she-camels.
hi: Ibn Umar ne kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Dehaati tum par apni namaz ke naam ke maamle mein haawi na hone paayein, yaani raat ki namaz, kyunki iska zikr Allah ki Kitaab, yaani Quran, mein "Isha" ke naam se hai. Dehaati ise "Atama" kehte hain kyunki woh apni oontniyon ko doodhne mein der karte hain.

e: 'A'isha reported: The believing women used to pray the morning prayer with the Messenger of Allah and then return wrapped in their mantles. No one could recognise them.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Momin auraten Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath subah ki namaz padha karti thin aur phir apni chadron mein lipti hui wapas jaati thin. Koi bhi unhe pehchaan nahi pata tha.

e: 'A'isha, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), reported: The believing women observed the morning prayer with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) wrapped in their mantles. They then went back to their houses and were unrecognisable, because of the Messenger of Allah's (ﷺ) praying in the darkness before dawn.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ki zauja Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Momin auraten Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath subah ki namaz apni chadron mein lipat kar padha karti thin. Phir woh apne gharon ko wapas jaatin aur unhein pehchaana nahi ja sakta tha, kyunki Rasoolullah (SAW) namaz subah sadiq ke andhere mein padhte the.

e: 'A'isha reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to observe the morning prayer, and the women would go back wrapped in their mantles being unrecognisable because of the darkness before dawn. (Ishaq b. Musa) al-Ansari (one of the transmitters in this chain of narration) narrated" wrapped" (only) in his narration. (No mention was made of mantles.)
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) subah ki namaz padha karte the, aur auraten apni chadron mein lipti hui wapas jaatin aur subah se pehle ke andhere ki wajah se unhe pehchaana nahi ja sakta tha. Ishaq bin Musa al-Ansari, is sanad ke ek raawi, ne apni riwayat mein sirf "lipti hui" ka zikr kiya, chadron ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: Muhammad b. 'Amr b. al-Hasan b. 'All reported: When Hajjaj came to Medina we asked Jabir b. Abdullah (about the timings of prayer as observed by the Holy Prophet). He said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to pray afternoon prayer in the midday heat; the afternoon prayer when the sun was bright; the evening prayer when the sun had completely set; and as for the night prayer, he sometimes delayed and sometimes (observed it) at earlier hours. When he found them (his Companions) assembled (at earlier hours) he (prayed) early. and when he saw them coming late, he delayed the (prayer). and the morning prayer the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed in the darkness before dawn.
hi: Muhammad bin Amr bin al-Hasan bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne bayan kiya: Jab Hajjaj Madina aaye to humne Jabir bin Abdullah se Nabi (SAW) ki namaz padhne ke auqaat ke baare mein poocha. Unhone kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) zohar ki namaz dopahar ki garmi mein padha karte the; asr ki namaz jab suraj chamakdar hota; maghrib ki namaz jab suraj poori tarah doob jaata; aur jahan tak isha ki namaz ka sawal hai, kabhi woh use der karte aur kabhi jaldi padhte. Jab unhe apne sahaba jama hote jaldi dikhte, to woh jaldi padhte, aur jab dekhte ki woh der se aa rahe hain, to woh der karte, aur subah ki namaz Rasoolullah (SAW) subah se pehle ke andhere mein padha karte the.

e: Muhammad b. 'Amr al-Hasan b. 'All reported: Hajjaj used to delay the prayers, and so we asked Jabir b. 'Abdullah, and the rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Muhammad bin Amr bin al-Hasan bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne bayan kiya: Hajjaj namazon ko der se padha karta tha, is liye humne Jabir bin Abdullah se poocha, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Sayyar b. Salama reported: I heard my father asking Abu Barza (al- Aslami) about the prayer of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) I (Shu'ba, one of the narrators) said: Did you hear it (from Abu Barza)? He said: 1 feel as if I am bearing you at this very time. He said: I heard my father asking about the prayer of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he (Abu Barza) making this reply: He (the Holy Prophet) did not mind delaying-some (prayer) i. e. 'Isya' prayer, even up to the midnight and did not like sleeping before observing it, and talking after it. Shu'ba said: I met him subsequently and asked him (about the prayers of the Holy Prophet) and he said: He observed the noon prayer when the sun was past the meridian, he would pray the afternoon prayer, after which a person would o to the outskirts of Medina and the sun was still bright; (I forgot what he said about the evening prayer) ; I then met him on a subsequent occasion and asked him (about the prayers of the Holy Prophet; and he said: He would observe the morning prayer (at such a time) so that a man would go back and would recognise his neighbour by casting a glance at his face, and he would recite from sixty to one hundred verses in it.
hi: Sayyar bin Salama ne bayan kiya: Maine apne walid ko Abu Barza al-Aslami se Rasoolullah (SAW) ki namaz ke baare mein poochte suna. Shu'ba, raawiyon mein se ek, ne kaha: Kya aapne ise Abu Barza se suna? Unhone kaha: Mujhe aisa lagta hai jaise main tumhe abhi is waqt sun raha hoon. Unhone kaha: Maine apne walid ko Rasoolullah (SAW) ki namaz ke baare mein poochte suna aur unhone Abu Barza ne ye jawab diya: Unhe Nabi (SAW) ko kuch namazon ko, yaani isha ki namaz ko, aadhi raat tak der karne mein koi aitraaz nahi tha, aur woh use padhne se pehle sona aur uske baad baat karna pasand nahi karte the. Shu'ba ne kaha: Baad mein main unse mila aur unse Nabi (SAW) ki namazon ke baare mein poocha aur unhone kaha: Woh zohar ki namaz padhte the jab suraj darmiyan-bindu se dhal chuka hota, woh asr ki namaz padhte, jiske baad koi shakhs Madina ke bahri kinaron tak ja sakta tha aur suraj abhi bhi chamakdar hota; mujhe yaad nahi ki unhone maghrib ki namaz ke baare mein kya kaha; phir main unse ek aur mauqe par mila aur unse Nabi (SAW) ki namazon ke baare mein poocha; aur unhone kaha: Woh subah ki namaz aise waqt padhte the ki koi aadmi wapas jaakar apne padosi ke chehre ki taraf ek nazar daal kar use pehchaan lekar sakta, aur woh usmein sath se sau ayaten padhte the.

e: Sayyar b. Salama reported: I heard Abu Barza saying that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not mind some delay in the 'Isha' prayer even up to midnight and he did not like sleeping before (observing it) and talking after it. Shu'ba said: I again met him (Sayyar b. Salama) for the second time and he said: Even up to the third (part) of the night.
hi: Sayyar bin Salama ne bayan kiya: Maine Abu Barza ko kehte suna ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ko isha ki namaz mein kuch der ho jaane mein koi aitraaz nahi tha, yahan tak ki aadhi raat tak, aur woh use padhne se pehle sona aur uske baad baat karna pasand nahi karte the. Shu'ba ne kaha: Main unse, Sayyar bin Salama se, doosri baar phir mila aur unhone kaha: Yahan tak ki raat ke teesre hisse tak.

e: Abu Barza b. Aslami is reported to have said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) delayed the night prayer till a third of the night had passed and he did not approve of sleeping before it, and talking after it, and he used to recite in the morning prayer from one hundred to sixty verses (and completed the prayer at such hours) when we recognised the faces of one another.
hi: Abu Barza al-Aslami (RA) ne kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne raat ki namaz ko raat ka ek-tihai hissa guzarne tak der ki aur woh use padhne se pehle sona aur uske baad baat karna pasand nahi karte the, aur woh subah ki namaz mein sau se sath ayaten padha karte the aur namaz aise waqt mukammal karte jab hum ek doosre ke chehre pehchaan lete the.

e: Abu Dharr reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me: How would you act when you are under the rulers who would delay the prayer beyond its prescribed time, or they would make prayer a dead thing as far as its proper time is concerned? I said: What do you command? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Observe the prayer at Its proper time, and if you can say it along with them do so, for it would be a superetogatory prayer for you. Khalaf (one of the narrators in the above hadith) has not mentioned" beyond their (prescribed) time".
hi: Abu Dharr (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne mujhse kaha: Tum kya karoge jab tum aise hukmaraanon ke maatehat hoge jo namaz ko uske muqarrar waqt se der karenge, ya jo namaz ko uske sahi waqt ke lihaaz se ek murda cheez bana denge? Maine kaha: Aap kya hukum dete hain? Unhone farmaya: Namaz ko uske sahi waqt par ada karo, aur agar tum use unke saath bhi padh sako, to padho, kyunki ye tumhare liye nafil namaz hogi. Khalaf, upar zikr hui hadees ke ek raawi, ne "unke muqarrar waqt se" ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: Abu Dharr reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me: O Abu Dharr, you would soon find after me rulers who would make their prayers dead. You should say prayer at its prescribed time. If you say prayer at its prescribed time that would be a supererogatory prayer for you, otherwise you saved your prayer.
hi: Abu Dharr (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne mujhse kaha: Aye Abu Dharr, jald hi tum mere baad aise hukmaraan paoge jo apni namazon ko murda kar denge. Tumhe namaz uske muqarrar waqt par ada karni chahiye. Agar tum namaz uske muqarrar waqt par ada karte ho, to ye tumhare liye nafil hogi, warna tumne apni farz namaz bacha li.

e: Abu Dharr reported: My friend (the Holy Prophet) bade me to hear and obey (the ruler) even if he is a slave having his feet and arms cut off, and observe prayer at its prescribed time. (And further said): It you find people having observed the prayer, you in fact saved your prayer, otherwise (if you join with them) that would be a Nafl prayer for you.
hi: Abu Dharr (RA) ne bayan kiya: Mere dost, Nabi (SAW), ne mujhe hukum diya ki main hukmaraan ki baat sunun aur uski itaat karoon, chahe woh ek aisa ghulam ho jiske haath-paon kaate ja chuke hon, aur namaz uske muqarrar waqt par ada karoon. Aur aage kaha: Agar tumhe log namaz padh chuke hue milen, to tumne dar-asal apni namaz bacha li, warna, agar tum unke saath shaamil ho jao, to ye tumhare liye Nafil namaz hogi.

e: Abu Dharr reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) struck my thigh and said: How would you act if you survive among the people who would delay prayers beyond their (prescribed) time? He (Abu Dharr) said: What do you command (under this situation)? He (the Holy Prophet) slid: Observe prayer at its prescribed time, then go (to meet) your needs, and if the Iqama is pronounced, and you are present in the mosque, then observe prayer (along with the Jama'at).
hi: Abu Dharr (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne meri raan par haath se maara aur kaha: Agar tum un logon mein zinda raho jo namazon ko unke muqarrar waqt se der karenge, to tum kya karoge? Unhone kaha: Aap is haalat mein kya hukum dete hain? Unhone farmaya: Namaz uske muqarrar waqt par ada karo, phir apni zarooraton ke kaam ke liye chale jao, aur agar iqaamat kahi jaye aur tum masjid mein maujood ho, to jamaat ke saath namaz padho.

e: 'Abu'l-'Aliyat al-Bara reported: Ibn Ziyad delayed the prayer. 'Abdullah b. Samit came to me and I placed a chair for him and he sat in it and I made a mention of whit Ibn Ziyad had done. He bit hit lips (as a sign of extreme anger and annoyance) and struck at my thigh and said: I asked Abu Dharr as you have asked me, and he struck my thigh just as I have struck your thigh, and said: I asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as you have asked me and he struck my thigh just as I have struck your thigh, and he (the Holy Prophet) said: Observe prayer at its prescribed time, and if you can say prayer along with them. do so, and do not say." I have observed prayer and so I shall not pray."
hi: Abu'l-Aliyat al-Bara ne bayan kiya: Ibn Ziyad ne namaz der se padhi. Abdullah bin Samit mere paas aaye aur maine unke liye ek kursi rakhi aur woh usmein baith gaye aur maine unhe bataya ki Ibn Ziyad ne kya kiya tha. Unhone apna hoth kaata, shadeed gusse aur naraazgi ki nishaani ke taur par, aur meri raan par maara aur kaha: Maine Abu Dharr se waisa hi poocha tha jaisa tumne mujhse poocha, aur unhone meri raan par waisa hi maara jaisa maine tumhari raan par maara, aur kaha: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) se waisa hi poocha tha jaisa tumne mujhse poocha, aur unhone meri raan par waisa hi maara jaisa maine tumhari raan par maara, aur unhone farmaya: Namaz uske muqarrar waqt par ada karo, aur agar tum unke saath bhi namaz padh sako, to padho, aur ye mat kaho ki "Maine namaz padh li hai is liye ab main nahi padhunga."

e: Abu Dharr reported: (The Messenger of Allah) said: How would you, or how would thou, act if you survive to live among people who defer prayer beyond the (prescribed) time? (The narrator said: Allah and His Messenger know best). whereupon he said: Observe prayer at its prescribed time, but if the Iqama is pronounced for (congregational) prayer, then observe prayer along with them. for herein is an excess of virtue.
hi: Abu Dharr (RA) ne bayan kiya: Unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Tum kya karoge, ya tum kya karoge, agar tum aise logon ke beech zinda raho jo namaz ko uske muqarrar waqt se der karte hain? Raawi ne kaha: Allah aur uske Rasool behtar jaante hain, isper unhone farmaya: Namaz uske muqarrar waqt par ada karo, lekin agar jamaat ke liye iqaamat kahi jaye, to unke saath namaz padho, kyunki ismein ziyada sawaab hai.

e: Abu'l-'Aliyat al-Bara' reported: I said to 'Abdullah b. Samit: We say our Jumu'a prayer behind those rulers who defer the prayer. He ('Abdullah b. Samit), struck. my thigh that I felt pain and said: I asked Abu Dharr about it, he struck my thigh and said: I asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about it. Upon this he said: Observe prayer at its prescribed time, and treat prayer along with them (along with those Imams who deter prayer) as Nafl. 'Abdullah said: It was narrated to me that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) struck the thigh of Abd Dharr.
hi: Abu'l-Aliyat al-Bara ne bayan kiya: Maine Abdullah bin Samit se kaha: Hum un hukmaraanon ke peeche jumma ki namaz padhte hain jo namaz der karte hain. Unhone, Abdullah bin Samit ne, meri raan par itni zor se maara ki mujhe dard hua aur kaha: Maine Abu Dharr se iske baare mein poocha, unhone meri raan par maara aur kaha: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) se iske baare mein poocha. Isper unhone farmaya: Namaz uske muqarrar waqt par ada karo, aur unke saath padhi gayi namaz ko, un Imamon ke saath jo namaz der karte hain, Nafil samjho. Abdullah ne kaha: Mujhe bataya gaya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Abu Dharr ki raan par maara tha.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Prayer said in a congregation is twenty-five degrees more excellent than prayer said by a single person.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Jamaat mein padhi gayi namaz akele padhi gayi namaz se paccis darje behtar hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Prayer said in a congregation is twenty-five degrees more excellent than prayer said by a single person. He (Abu Huraira further) said: The angels of the night and the angels of the day meet together. Abu Huraira said: Recite it you like:" Surely the recital of the Qur'an at dawn is witnessed" (al-Qur'an, xvii. 78).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Jamaat mein padhi gayi namaz akele padhi gayi namaz se paccis darje behtar hai. Unhone aage kaha: Raat ke farishte aur din ke farishte ikattha milte hain. Abu Huraira ne kaha: Agar tum chaho to ye padho: "Yaqeenan fajr ke waqt Quran ki tilawat hazir farishton ke saamne hoti hai" (17:78).

e: A hadith like this has been narrated by Abu Huraira with another chain of transmitters with a very slight change of words.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ne ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki hai, alfaaz mein bahut halki tabdeeli ke saath.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Prayer said in a congregation is equivalent to twenty-five (prayers) as compared with the prayer said by a single person.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Jamaat mein padhi gayi namaz, akele padhi gayi namaz ke muqable mein, paccis namazon ke barabar hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him) said: Prayer along with the Imam is twenty-five times more excellent than prayer said by a single person.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Imam ke saath namaz akele padhi gayi namaz se paccis guna behtar hai.

e: Ibn Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) assaying: Prayer said in a congregation is twenty-seven degrees more excellent than prayer said by a single person.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Jamaat mein padhi gayi namaz akele padhi gayi namaz se sattais darje behtar hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: The prayer of a person in congregation is twenty-seven times in excess to the prayer said alone.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Kisi shakhs ki jamaat mein namaz akele padhi gayi namaz se sattais guna zyada behtar hai.

e: Ibn Numair reported it on the authority of his father (a preference of) more than twenty (degrees) and Abu Bakr in his narration (has narrated it) twenty- seven degrees.
hi: Ibn Numair ne apne walid ke hawale se ise "bees se ziyada" darjon ki tarjeeh ke taur par riwayat ki hai, aur Abu Bakr ne apni riwayat mein sattais darje bayan kiye hain.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as some and twenty (degrees).
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se ye "kuch bees" darje ke taur par riwayat ki hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) found some people absenting from certain prayers and he said: I intend that I order (a) person to lead people in prayer, and then go to the persons who do not join the (congregational prayer) and then order their houses to be burnt by the bundles of fuel. If one amongst them were to know that he would find a fat fleshy bone he would attend the night prayer.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne dekha ki kuch log kuch namazon se ghayab rehte hain, aur unhone farmaya: Mera irada hai ki main kisi shakhs ko hukum doon ki woh logon ki imamat kare, aur phir main un logon ke paas jaun jo jamaat mein shaamil nahi hote aur unke gharon ko lakdi ke gattharon se jalwa doon. Agar unmein se kisi ko pata chal jaye ki use ek moti-taazi haddi milegi, to woh isha ki namaz mein zaroor haazir hoga.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The most burdensome prayers for the hypocrites are the night prayer and the morning prayer. If they were to know the blessings they have in store, they would have come to them, even though crawling, and I thought that I should order the prayer to be commenced and command a person to lead people in prayer, and I should then go along with some persons having a fagot of fuel with them to the people who have not attended the prayer (in congregation) and would burn their houses with fire.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Munaafiqon ke liye sabse bhaari namazein isha aur fajr ki namazein hain. Agar unhe pata hota ki inmein unke liye kya barkatein hain, to woh in namazon mein zaroor aate, chahe rengte hue hi kyun na aana pade, aur maine socha ki main namaz shuru karne ka hukum doon aur kisi shakhs ko logon ki imamat karne ka hukum doon, aur phir main kuch logon ke saath, jinke paas lakdi ke gatthe hon, un logon ke paas jaun jo jamaat mein shaamil nahi hue hain aur unke gharon ko aag se jala doon.

e: Hammam b. Munabbih reported: This is what Abu Huraira reported to us from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and (in this connection) he narrated some ahadith, one of them is: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: I intend that I should command my young men to gather bundles fuel for me, and then order a person to lead people in prayer, and then burn the houses with their inmates (who have not joined the congregation).
hi: Hammam bin Munabbih ne bayan kiya: Ye woh hai jo Abu Huraira ne humein Nabi (SAW) se bayan kiya aur is silsile mein kayi hadeesein bayan ki - unmein se ek ye hai: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Mera irada hai ki main apne jawan aadmiyon ko hukum doon ki woh mere liye lakdi ke gattharay ikattha karein, phir kisi shakhs ko hukum doon ki woh logon ki imamat kare, aur phir un logon ke gharon ko unke rehne walon, jo jamaat mein shaamil nahi hue, ke saath jala doon.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated by Abu Huraira.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan ki hai.

e: 'Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying about people who are absent from Jumu'a prayer: I intend that I should command a person to lead people in prayer, and then burn those persons who absent themselves from Jumu'a prayer in their houses.
hi: Abdullah (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se un logon ke baare mein riwayat ki jo jumma ki namaz mein ghaayab rehte hain: Mera irada hai ki main kisi shakhs ko hukum doon ki woh logon ki imamat kare, aur phir un logon ko jo jumma ki namaz se ghaayab rehte hain unke gharon mein jala doon.

e: Abu Huraira reported: There came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) a blind man and said: Messenger of Allah, I have no one to guide me to the mosque. He, therefore, asked. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) permission to say prayer in his house. He (tee Holy Prophet) granted him permission. Then when the man turned away he called him and said: Do you hear the call to prayer? He said: Yes. He (the Prophet then) said: Respond to it.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas ek nabina shakhs aaya aur kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, mere paas koi nahi hai jo mujhe masjid tak raasta dikhaye. Is liye usne Rasoolullah (SAW) se apne ghar mein namaz padhne ki ijazat maangi. Unhone use ijazat de di. Phir jab woh shakhs mudkar jaane laga to unhone use bulaya aur kaha: Kya tum namaz ki azaan sunte ho? Usne kaha: Haan. Unhone farmaya: To uska jawab do, yaani masjid aao.

e: 'Abdullah (b. Mas'ud) reported: I have seen the time when no one stayed away from prayer except a hypocrite, whose hypocrisy was well known, or a sick man, but if a sick man could walk between two persons (i.e. with the help of two persons with one on each side) he would come to prayer. And (further) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) taught us the paths of right guidance, among which is prayer in the mosque in which the Adhan is called.
hi: Abdullah (bin Mas'ud) ne bayan kiya: Maine woh waqt dekha hai jab namaz se koi bhi door nahi rehta tha siwaay ek munaafiq ke, jiska nifaaq sabko pata hota tha, ya ek beemar shakhs ke, lekin agar koi beemar shakhs do logon ke darmiyan chal sakta, yaani do logon ki madad se, to woh namaz mein zaroor aata. Aur aage kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne humein hidayat ke raaste sikhaye, jinmein se ek us masjid mein namaz padhna hai jismein azaan di jaati hai.

e: Abdullah (b. Mas'ud) reported: He who likes to meet Allah tomorrow as Muslim, he should persevere in observing these prayers, when a call is announced for them, for Allah has laid down for your Prophet the paths of right guidance, and these (prayers) are among the paths of right guidance. If you were to pray in your houses as this man why stays away (from the mosque) prays in his house, you would abandon the practice of your Prophet, and if you were to abandon the practice of your Prophet, you would go astray. No man purifies himself, doing it well, then makes for one of those mosques without Allah recording a blessing for him for every step he takes raising him a degree for it, and effacing a sin from him for it. I have seen the time when no one stayed away from it, except a hypocrite, who was well known for his hypocrisy, whereas a man would be brought swaying (due to weakness) between two men till he was set up in a row.
hi: Abdullah (bin Mas'ud) ne bayan kiya: Jo kal Allah se Musalman ki haisiyat se milna chahta hai, use in namazon ki paabandi karni chahiye, jab inke liye azaan di jaye, kyunki Allah ne tumhare Nabi (SAW) ke liye hidayat ke raaste muqarrar kiye hain, aur ye namazein hidayat ke raaston mein se hain. Agar tum apne gharon mein waise hi namaz padho jaise ye shakhs, jo door rehta hai, apne ghar mein namaz padhta hai, to tum apne Nabi (SAW) ke tareeqe ko chhod dete, aur agar tum apne Nabi (SAW) ke tareeqe ko chhod dete, to tum gumraah ho jaate. Koi bhi aadmi apne aap ko achhi tarah paak nahi karta, phir un masjidon mein se kisi ek ki taraf nahi jaata, jismein Allah har kadam ke liye jo woh uthata hai uske liye barkat na likhta ho, uski wajah se uska ek darja na badhaata ho, aur uski wajah se uska ek gunah na mitaata ho. Maine woh waqt dekha hai jab koi bhi isse door nahi rehta tha, siwaay ek munaafiq ke, jo apne nifaaq ke liye mashhoor tha, jabki ek shakhs ko do logon ke darmiyan, kamzori ki wajah se, jhoolte hue laaya jaata yahan tak ki use saf mein khada kar diya jaata.

e: Abu Sha'tha' reported: While we were sitting with Abu Huraira in a mosque a man went out of the mosque after the call to prayer had been announced. (A man stood up in the mosque and set off.) Abu Huraira's eyes followed him till he went out of the mosque. Upon this Abu Huraira said: This man has disobeyed Abu'l- Qasim (Muhammad) (ﷺ).
hi: Abu Sha'tha ne bayan kiya: Jab hum Abu Huraira (RA) ke saath masjid mein baithe the, azaan hone ke baad ek shakhs masjid se bahar chala gaya. Abu Huraira ki nazrein uska peecha karti rahin yahan tak ki woh masjid se bahar chala gaya. Isper Abu Huraira ne kaha: Is shakhs ne Abu'l-Qasim, Muhammad (SAW), ki naafarmani ki hai.

e: Abu Sha'tha' al-Muharibi reported on the authority of his father, who said: I heard it from Abu Huraira that he saw a person getting out of the mosque after the call to prayer had been announced. Upon this he remarked: This (man) disobeyed Abu'l-Qasim (ﷺ).
hi: Abu Sha'tha al-Muharibi ne apne walid ke hawale se ye riwayat ki, jinhone kaha: Maine ye Abu Huraira se suna ki unhone ek shakhs ko azaan hone ke baad masjid se nikalte dekha. Isper unhone kaha: Is shakhs ne Abu'l-Qasim (SAW) ki naafarmani ki.

e: 'Abd al-Rahman b. Abd 'Amr reported: 'Uthman b. 'Affan (narrated the mosque after evening prayer and sat alone. I also sat alone with him, so he said: 0, son of my brother, I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: He who observed the 'Isha' prayer in congregation, it was as if he prayed up to midnight, and he who prayed the morning prayer in congregation, it was as if he prayed the whole night.
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Abd Amr ne bayan kiya: Uthman bin Affan (RA) maghrib ki namaz ke baad masjid mein akele baithe. Main bhi unke saath akele baitha, to unhone kaha: Aye mere bhatije, maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: Jo isha ki namaz jamaat mein padhe, jaise usne aadhi raat tak namaz padhi ho, aur jo subah ki namaz jamaat mein padhe, jaise usne poori raat namaz padhi ho.

e: This hadith has been narrated by the chain of transmitters by Abu Sahl 'Uthman b. Hakim.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Sahl Uthman bin Hakim ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: Jundab b. 'Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who prayed the morning prayer (in congregation) he is in fact under the protection of Allah. And it can never happen that Allah should demand anything from you in connection with the protection (that He guarantees) and one should not get it. He would then throw him in the fire of Hell.
hi: Jundab bin Abdullah (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Jo subah ki namaz jamaat mein padhe, woh dar-asal Allah ki hifazat mein hota hai. Aur ye kabhi nahi ho sakta ki Allah tumse uski di gayi hifazat ke baare mein kuch maang kare aur woh na mile. Warna Woh use jahannam ki aag mein daal dega.

e: Anas b. Sirin reported: I heard Jundab b. Qasri saying that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: He who observed the morning prayer (in congregation), he is in fact under the protection of Allah and it never happens that Allah should make a demand in connection with the protection (that He guarantees and should not get it) for when he asks for anything in relation to His protection, he definitely secures it. He then throws him flatly in the Hell-fire.
hi: Anas bin Sirin ne bayan kiya: Maine Jundab bin Qasri ko kehte suna ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jo subah ki namaz jamaat mein padhe, woh dar-asal Allah ki hifazat mein hota hai, aur ye kabhi nahi hota ki Allah uski hifazat ke talluq mein kuch maang kare aur na mile, kyunki jab woh Uski hifazat se mutalliq kuch maangta hai, to use zaroor mil jaata hai. Warna Woh use seedha jahannam ki aag mein daal dega.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Jundab b. Sufyan in from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) with the same chain of transmitters, but this has not been mentioned: " He would throw him in fire."
hi: Ye hadees Jundab bin Sufyan ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se isi sanad se bayan ki hai, lekin ismein "Woh use aag mein daal dega" ka zikr nahi kiya gaya hai.

e: Mahmud b. al-Rabi' reported that 'Ibn b. Malik, who was one of the Companions of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and who participated in the (Battle of) Badr and was among the Ansar (of Medina), told that he came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: Messenger of Allah, I have lost my eyesight and I lead my people in prayer. When there is a downpour there is then a current (of water) in the valley that stands between me and them and I find it impossible to go to their mosque and lead them in prayer. Messenger of Allah, I earnestly beg of you that you should come and observe prayer at a place of worship (in my house) so that I should then use it as a place of worship. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Well, it God so wills. I would soon do so. 'Itban said: On the following day when the day dawned, the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) came along with Abu Bakr at-Siddiq, and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) asked permission (to get into the house). I gave him the permission, and be did not sit after entering the house, when he said: At what place in your house you desire me to say prayer? I ('Itban b. Malik) said: I pointed to a corner in the house, The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stood (at that place for prayer) and pronounced Allah-o-Akbar (Allah is the Greatest) (as an expression for the commencement of prayer). We too stood behind him, and he said two rak'ahs and then pronounced salutation (marking the end of the prayer). We detained him (the Holy Prophet) for the meat curry we had prepared for, him. The people of the neighbouring houses came and thus there was a good gathering in (our house). One of them said: Where is Malik b. Dukhshun? Upon this one of them remarked: He is a hypocrite; he does not love Allah and His Messenger. Thereupon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Do not say so about him. Don't you see that he utters La ilaha ill-Allah (There is no god but Allah) and seeks the pleasure of Allah through it? They said: Allah and His Messenger know beet. One (among the audience) said: We see his inclination and wellwishing for hypocrites only. Upon this the Messenger of Allah' (ﷺ) again said: Verily Allah has forbidden the Fire for one who says: There is no god but Allah, thereby seeking Allah's pleasure. Ibn Shihab said: I asked Husain b. Muhammad al-Ansar (he was one of the leaders of Banu Salim) about the hadith transmitted by Mahmud b. Rabi' and he testified it.
hi: Mahmud bin al-Rabi' ne bayan kiya ki Itban bin Malik, jo Rasoolullah (SAW) ke sahaba mein se the aur Badr ki jung mein shareek hue the aur Ansar, Madina ke, mein shumaar hote the, ne bataya ki woh Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, meri nazar ja chuki hai aur main apni qaum ki imamat karta hoon. Jab baarish hoti hai to us wadi mein paani ka behaav ho jaata hai jo mere aur unke darmiyan hai aur mujhe unki masjid tak jaakar unki imamat karna namumkin lagta hai. Ya Rasoolullah, main aapse guzarish karta hoon ki aap aayein aur mere ghar mein ek jagah namaz padhein taaki main use namaz ki jagah bana sakoon. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Theek hai, agar Allah ne chaha to main jald hi aisa karunga. Itban ne kaha: Agle din jab subah hui, Rasoolullah (SAW) Abu Bakr Siddiq ke saath aaye, aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ne ghar mein aane ki ijazat maangi. Maine unhe ijazat de di, aur woh ghar mein daakhil hone ke baad baithe nahi, jab unhone kaha: Tumhare ghar mein kis jagah tum chahte ho ki main namaz padhun? Maine ghar ke ek konay ki taraf ishara kiya. Rasoolullah (SAW) us jagah namaz ke liye khade huye aur Allahu Akbar kaha. Hum bhi unke peeche khade ho gaye, aur unhone do rakat padhi aur phir salaam pheera. Humne unhe us gosht ke saalan ke liye rok liya jo humne unke liye taiyaar kiya tha. Padosi gharon ke log aa gaye aur is tarah hamare ghar mein ek achhi mehfil ho gayi. Unmein se ek ne kaha: Malik bin Dukhshun kahan hai? Isper unmein se ek ne kaha: Woh munaafiq hai; woh Allah aur uske Rasool se mohabbat nahi karta. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Uske baare mein aisa mat kaho. Kya tum nahi dekhte ki woh "La ilaha illallah" kehta hai aur isse Allah ki raza chahta hai? Unhone kaha: Allah aur uske Rasool behtar jaante hain. Maujood logon mein se ek ne kaha: Hum unka rujhaan aur bhalaai chaahna sirf munaafiqon ke liye dekhte hain. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne dobara farmaya: Yaqeenan Allah ne us shakhs ke liye jahannam ko haram kar diya hai jo "La ilaha illallah" kehta hai, is se Allah ki raza chahte hue. Ibn Shihab ne kaha: Maine Husain bin Muhammad al-Ansari, jo Banu Salim ke sardaron mein se ek the, se Mahmud bin Rabi' ki bayan ki hui hadees ke baare mein poocha aur unhone iski tasdeeq ki.

e: 'Itban b. Malik reported: I came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and the rest of the hadith is the same as narrated (above) except this that a man said: Where is Malik b. Dukhshun or Dukhaishin, and also made this addition that Mahmud said: I narrated this ver hadith to many people and among them was Abu Ayyub al-Ansari who said: I cannot think that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) could have said so as you say. He (the narrator) said: I took an oath that if I ever go to 'Itban. I would ask him about it. So I went to him and found him to be a very aged man, having lost his eyesight, but he was the Imam of the people. I sat by his side and asked about this hadith and he narrated it In the same way as he had narrated it for the first time. Then so many other obligatory acts and commands were revealed which we see having been completed. So he who wants that he should not be deceived would not be deceived.
hi: Itban bin Malik ne bayan kiya: Main Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aaya, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai jaisi upar bayan hui, siwaay is baat ke ki ek shakhs ne kaha: Malik bin Dukhshun ya Dukhaishin kahan hai, aur ye izafa bhi kiya ki Mahmud ne kaha: Maine ye hadees kayi logon ko sunayi aur unmein Abu Ayyub al-Ansari bhi the jinhone kaha: Mujhe nahi lagta ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne waisa kaha hoga jaisa tum keh rahe ho. Unhone kaha: Maine qasam khayi ki agar main kabhi Itban ke paas jaun to unse iske baare mein poochunga. To main unke paas gaya aur unhe ek bahut boodha shakhs paaya, jinki nazar ja chuki thi, lekin woh log ke Imam the. Main unke bagal mein baitha aur is hadees ke baare mein poocha aur unhone ise waise hi bayan kiya jaise unhone pehli baar bayan ki thi. Phir itne saare aur farz amal aur hukum nazil hue jinhe hum mukammal hote dekh rahe hain. To jo dhoka nahi khaana chahta woh dhoka nahi khayega.

e: Mahmud b. Rabi' reported: I well remember the disgorge of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that he did (with water) from a bucket of our house. Mahmud said: 'Itban b. Malik narrated it to me that he had said: Messenger of Allah, I have lost my eyesight, and the rest of the hadith is the same up to these words:" He led us in two rak'ahs of prayer and we detained the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) for serving him the pudding that we had prepared for him," and no mention has been made of what follows next from the addition made by Yunus and Ma'mar.
hi: Mahmud bin Rabi' ne bayan kiya: Mujhe achhi tarah yaad hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne humare ghar ki ek balti se paani muh mein bharkar kulli ki thi. Mahmud ne kaha: Itban bin Malik ne mujhe ye bayan ki ki unhone kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, meri nazar ja chuki hai, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai in alfaaz tak: "Unhone humein do rakat namaz padhayi aur humne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko us pudding ke liye rok liya jo humne unke liye banayi thi," aur uske aage Yunus aur Ma'mar ne jo izafa kiya hai uska koi zikr nahi hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that his grandmother, Mulaika, invited the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) to a dinner which she had prepared.
