He (the Holy Prophet) ate out of that and then said: Stand up so that I should observe prayer (in order to bless) you Anas b. Malik said: I stood up on a mat (belonging to us) which had turned dark on account of its long use. I sprinkled water over it (in order to soften it), and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stood upon it, and I and an orphan formed a row behind him (the Holy Prophet) and the old woman was behind us, and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led us in two rak'ahs of prayer and then went back.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unki dadi, Mulaika, ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ek khaane par bulaya jo unhone taiyaar kiya tha. Unhone usmein se khaya aur phir kaha: Khade ho jao taaki main namaz padhun, taaki tumhe barkat mile. Anas bin Malik ne kaha: Main ek chataayi, hamari, par khada hua jo lambe istemal ki wajah se kaali pad gayi thi. Maine uspar paani chhirka, use narm karne ke liye, aur Rasoolullah (SAW) uspar khade huye, aur main aur ek yateem unke peeche saf mein khade huye, aur woh boodhi aurat hamare peeche thi, aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ne humein do rakat namaz padhayi aur phir wapas chale gaye.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) wits the best among people in character. On occasions, the time of prayer would come while he was in our house. He would then order to spread the mat lying under him. That was dusted and then water was sprinkled over it. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) then led the prayer and we stood behind him, and that mat was made of the leaves of date-palm.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) logon mein kirdaar ke lihaaz se sabse behtar the. Kabhi kabhi, namaz ka waqt aata jab woh humare ghar mein hote. Woh unke neeche padi hui chataayi bichhaane ka hukum dete. Use jhaad kar saaf kiya jaata aur phir uspar paani chhirka jaata. Rasoolullah (SAW) phir namaz padhate aur hum unke peeche khade hote, aur woh chataayi khajoor ke pattoon se bani thi.

e: Thabit reported on the authority of Anas: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) came to us and there was none in our house but I, my mother and my aunt Umm Haram. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Stand up so that I may lead you in prayer (and there was no time for prescribed prayer). He led us in prayer. A person said to Thabit: Where stood Anas with him (the Holy Prophet)? He replied: He was on the right side. He then blessed us, the members of the household with every good of this world and of the Hereafter. My mother said: Messenger of Allah (and then, pointing towards Anas, said), here is your little servant, invoke the blessing of Allah upon him too. He then blessed me with every good, and he concluded his blessings for me (with these words): Allah! increase his wealth, and his children and make (them the source of) blessing for him.
hi: Thabit ne Anas (RA) ke hawale se bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) hamare paas aaye aur hamare ghar mein sirf main, meri maa aur meri khala Umm Haram mojood thin. Unhone kaha: Khade ho jao taaki main tumhe namaz padhaun, aur ye farz namaz ka waqt nahi tha. Unhone humein namaz padhayi. Ek shakhs ne Thabit se poocha: Anas unke saath kahan khade the? Unhone jawab diya: Woh daayi taraf the. Phir unhone humein, ghar walon ko, is duniya aur aakhirat ki har bhalaai ki dua di. Meri maa ne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, aur phir Anas ki taraf ishara karte hue kaha, ye aapka chhota khaadim hai, ispar bhi Allah ki barkat ki dua kariye. Phir unhone mujhe har bhalaai ki dua di, aur meri dua in alfaaz ke saath mukammal ki: Aye Allah! Iska maal aur iski aulaad badha de aur unhein iske liye barkat bana de.

e: Abdullah b. al-Mukhtar heard Musa b. Anas narrating on the authority of Anas b. Malik that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led him, his mother or his aunt in prayer. He made me, stand on his right side and made the woman stand, behind us.
hi: Abdullah bin al-Mukhtar ne Musa bin Anas ko Anas bin Malik (RA) ke hawale se riwayat karte suna ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unhe, unki maa ko ya unki khala ko namaz padhayi. Unhone mujhe apni daayi taraf khada kiya aur aurat ko hamare peeche khada kiya.

e: This hadith has also been narrated by Shu'ba with this chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ne bhi isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: Maimuna, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said prayer while I was by his side, and at times when he prostrated his cloth touched me, and he prayed on a small mat.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ki zauja Maimuna (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne namaz padhi jab main unke bagal mein thi, aur kabhi kabhi jab woh sajda karte to unka kapda mujhe chhoo jaata, aur woh ek chhoti si chataayi par namaz padhte the.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported that he went to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and found him observing prayer on a mat and prostrating on that.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ne bayan kiya ki woh Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas gaye aur unhe ek chataayi par namaz padhte aur uspar sajda karte paaya.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: A man's prayer in congregation is more valuable than twenty degrees and some above them as compared with his prayer in his house and his market, for when he performs ablution doing it well, then goes out to the mosque, and he is impelled (to do so) only by (the love of congregational) prayer, he has no other objective before him but prayer. He does not take a step without being raised a degree for it and having a sin remitted for it, till he enters the mosque, and when he is busy in prayer after having entered the mosque. the angels continue to invoke blessing on him as long as he is in his place of worship. saying: O Allah, show him mercy, and pardon him! Accept his repentance (and the angels continue this supplication for him) so long as he does not do any harm in it, or as long as his ablution is not broken.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Kisi aadmi ki jamaat mein namaz uski apne ghar aur apne bazaar mein padhi gayi namaz se, bees darjon se zyada aur usse thoda upar, zyada qeemti hai, kyunki jab woh achhi tarah wuzu karke masjid ki taraf nikalta hai, aur usse aisa karne par sirf jamaat ki namaz ka shauk hi majboor karta hai, to uske saamne namaz ke siwaay koi aur maqsad nahi hota. Woh koi kadam nahi uthaata jiske badle uska ek darja na badhta ho aur ek gunah maaf na hota ho, yahan tak ki woh masjid mein daakhil hota hai, aur jab woh masjid mein daakhil hokar namaz mein masroof hota hai, to farishte lagataar uske liye dua karte rehte hain jab tak woh apni namaz ki jagah par hai, ye kehte hue: Aye Allah, ispar rahem farma, aur ise maaf farma! Iski tauba qubool farma - aur farishte uske liye ye dua tab tak karte rehte hain jab tak woh usmein koi galat kaam nahi karta, ya jab tak uska wuzu nahi tootta.

e: A hadith having the same meaning (as mentioned above) has been transmitted by A'mash.
hi: Isi mafhoom ki ek hadees, jaisa upar zikr hua, A'mash ne bhi bayan ki hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The angels invoke blessings on everyone among you so long as he is in a place of worship with these words: O Allah! pardon him, O Allah, have mercy upon him, (and they continue to do so) as long as, he ablution (of the worshipper) is not broken, and one among you is in prayer and so long as he is detained for the prayer.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Farishte tum mein se har ek ke liye dua karte hain jab tak woh namaz ki jagah par hai, in alfaaz ke saath: Aye Allah! Ise maaf farma, Aye Allah, ispar rahem farma - aur woh aisa tab tak karte rehte hain jab tak namazi ka wuzu nahi tootta, aur tum mein se koi namaz mein hota hai aur jab tak woh namaz ke liye rok kar rakha jaata hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The servant is constantly in prayer so long as he is in a place of worship waiting for the prayer (to be observed in congregation), and the angels invoke (blessings upon him in these words): O Allah! pardon him. O Allah! show mercy to him, (and they continue to do so) till he returns (from the mosque having completed the prayer) or his ablution breaks. I said: How is the ablution broken? He said: By breaking of the wind noiselessly or with noise.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Banda musalsal namaz mein hota hai jab tak woh namaz, jamaat mein padhi jaane wali, ka intezaar karta hua namaz ki jagah par hai, aur farishte in alfaaz mein uske liye dua karte hain: Aye Allah! Ise maaf farma. Aye Allah! Ispar rahem farma - aur woh aisa tab tak karte rehte hain jab tak woh masjid se namaz mukammal karke wapas nahi jaata ya uska wuzu nahi tootta. Maine poocha: Wuzu kaise tootta hai? Unhone kaha: Bina awaaz ke ya awaaz ke saath hawa kharij hone se.

e: Abu Huraira reported the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: Everyone among you is constantly in prayer so long as the prayer detains him (for this noble objective) and nothing prevents him to return to his family but the prayer.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Tum mein se har ek musalsal namaz mein hota hai jab tak namaz use is nek maqsad ke liye roke rakhti hai, aur namaz ke siwaay kuch bhi use apne gharwalon ke paas wapas jaane se nahi rokta.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Anyone amongst you who sat in a place of worship waiting for the prayer is in prayer and his ablution is not broken, the angels invoke blessing upon him (in these words): O Allah! pardon him. O Allah! have mercy upon him.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Tum mein se koi bhi jo namaz ki jagah par namaz ka intezaar karte hue baitha hai, woh namaz mein hi hai aur uska wuzu nahi toota hai, farishte uske liye dua karte hain in alfaaz mein: Aye Allah! Ise maaf farma. Aye Allah! Ispar rahem farma.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated by Hammam b. Munabbih on the authority of Abu Huraira.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Hammam bin Munabbih ne Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: Abu Musa reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The most eminent among human beings (as a recipient of) reward (is one) who lives farthest away, and who has to walk the farthest distance, and he who waits for the prayer to observe it along with the Imam, his reward is greater than one who prays (alone) and then goes to sleep. In the narration of Abu Kuraib (the words are):" (He waits) till he prays along with the Imam in congregation."
hi: Abu Musa (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Insaanon mein sawaab paane wala sabse buland shakhs woh hai jo sabse door rehta hai, aur jise sabse zyada faasla tay karke chalna padta hai, aur jo namaz ka intezaar karta hai taaki use Imam ke saath ada kare, uska sawaab us shakhs se zyada hai jo akele namaz padhkar so jaata hai. Abu Kuraib ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: "Woh intezaar karta hai jab tak woh jamaat mein Imam ke saath namaz nahi padhta."

e: Ubayy b. Ka'b reported: There was a man, and I do not know of any other man, whose house was farther than his from the mosque and he never missed the prayer (in congregation). It was said to him or I said to him: It you were to buy a donkey you could ride upon it In the dark nights and in the burning sand. He said: I do not like my house to be situated by the side of the mosque, for I (eagerly) desire that my steps towards the mosque and back from it, should be recorded when I return to my family. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Allah has gathered all (rewards) for you.
hi: Ubayy bin Ka'b (RA) ne bayan kiya: Ek shakhs the, aur mujhe kisi aur shakhs ke baare mein pata nahi jiska ghar masjid se unse zyada door ho, aur woh kabhi bhi jamaat mein namaz nahi chhodte the. Unse kaha gaya, ya maine unse kaha: Agar aap ek gadha khareed lete to andheri raaton aur jalti hui ret mein uspar sawaar ho sakte. Unhone kaha: Mujhe pasand nahi ki mera ghar masjid ke bagal mein ho, kyunki main bahut chahta hoon ki masjid ki taraf mere kadam aur wahan se wapasi ke kadam likhe jayein jab main apne gharwalon ke paas lautun. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Allah ne ye sab sawaab tumhare liye ikattha kar diya hai.

e: This hadith has been transmitted by Taimi with the same chain of narrators.
hi: Ye hadees Taimi ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: Ubayy b. Ka'b reported: There was a person among the Ansar whose house was situated at the farthest end of Medina, but he never in missed any prayer along with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). We felt pity for him and said to him: O, so and so, had you bought a donkey it would have saved you from the burning sand and would have saved you from the reptiles of the earth. He said: Listen I by Allah, I do not like my house to be situated by the side of Muhammad (ﷺ). I took (these words of his) ill and came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and informed him about (these words). He (the Holy Prophet) called him and he said exactly like that (which he had mentioned to Ubbay b. Ka'b), but made a mention of this (also) that he wanted a reward for his steps. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: In fact for you is the reward which you expect.
hi: Ubayy bin Ka'b (RA) ne bayan kiya: Ansar mein ek shakhs the jinka ghar Madina ke sabse door kinaray mein tha, lekin unhone kabhi bhi Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath koi namaz nahi chhodi. Humne unpar tars khaya aur unse kaha: Aye falan, agar aap ek gadha khareed lete to ye aapko jalti hui ret se aur zameen ke keede-makodon se bacha leta. Unhone kaha: Suno! Allah ki qasam, mujhe pasand nahi ki mera ghar Muhammad (SAW) ke bagal mein ho. Maine unke ye alfaaz bura mana aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unhe ye alfaaz bataye. Unhone use bulaya aur usne bilkul waisa hi kaha jo usne Ubayy bin Ka'b se kaha tha, lekin ye bhi zikr kiya ki woh apne kadmon ke liye sawaab chahta hai. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Dar-asal tumhare liye woh sawaab hai jiski tum ummeed karte ho.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated by 'Asim with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Asim ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah narrated: Our houses were situated far away from the mosque; we, therefore, decided to sell our houses so that we may be able to come near the mosque. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade us (to do so) and said: There is for every step (towards the mosque) a degree (of reward) for you.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hamare ghar masjid se door the; humne is liye faisla kiya ki hum apne ghar bech dein taaki masjid ke qareeb aa sakein. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne humein aisa karne se mana kiya aur farmaya: Har kadam masjid ki taraf ke liye tumhare liye ek darja sawaab ka hai.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah reported: There were some plots vacant around the mosque. Banu Salama decided to shift (to this land) and come near the mosque. This (news) reached the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he said to them (Banu Salama): I have received (information) that you intend to shift near the mosque. They said: Yes, Messenger of Allah, we have taken this decision. Upon this he (the Holy Prophet) said: O Banu Salama, live in your houses, for your steps are recorded; live in your houses, for your steps are recorded.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Masjid ke aas-paas kuch khaali zameen ke tukde the. Banu Salama ne is zameen ki taraf sthanaantarit hone aur masjid ke qareeb aane ka faisla kiya. Ye khabar Rasoolullah (SAW) tak pahunchi aur unhone unse kaha: Mujhe maloom hua hai ki tum masjid ke qareeb sthanaantarit hone ka irada rakhte ho. Unhone kaha: Haan, Ya Rasoolullah, humne ye faisla kar liya hai. Isper unhone farmaya: Aye Banu Salama, apne gharon mein raho, kyunki tumhare kadam likhe jaate hain; apne gharon mein raho, kyunki tumhare kadam likhe jaate hain.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah reported that Banu Salama decided to shift near the mosque (as there were) some plots vacant. This (news) reached the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), whereupon he said: O people of the Salama tribe, you better stay in your houses (where you are living), for your footsteps are recorded They said. We could not be more delighted even by shifting (near the mosque) as we were delighted (on hearing these words from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Banu Salama ne masjid ke qareeb sthanaantarit hone ka faisla kiya kyunki wahan kuch khaali zameen ke tukde the. Ye khabar Rasoolullah (SAW) tak pahunchi, isper unhone farmaya: Aye Salama qabile ke logo, tumhe apne gharon mein hi rehna chahiye jahan tum abhi rehte ho, kyunki tumhare kadam likhe jaate hain. Unhone kaha: Hum sthanaantarit hone se bhi utne khush nahi hote jitne khush hum ye alfaaz sunkar Rasoolullah (SAW) se hue.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (may peace be' upon him) said: He who purified himself in his house, and then he walked to one of the houses of Allah for the sake of performing a Fard (obligatory act) out of the Fara'id (obligatory acts) of Allah, both his steps (would be significant) as one of them would obliterate his sin and the second one would raise his status.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jo apne ghar mein khud ko paak kare, aur phir Allah ke gharon mein se kisi ek ki taraf, Allah ke farz kamon mein se koi farz ada karne ke liye chale, to uske dono kadam ahem honge, ek kadam uska gunah mitaayega aur doosra kadam uska darja badhaayega.

e: In the hadith narrated of the authority of Abd Huraira the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) is reported to have said. while in the hadith narrated by Bakr (the words are like this): He heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: just see, can anything of his filthiness remain (on the body of) any one of you if there were a river at his door in which he washed himself five times daily? They, said: Nothing of his filthiness will remain (on his body). He said: That is like the five prayers by which Allah obliterates sins.
hi: Abu Huraira ki riwayat wali hadees mein Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya bataya gaya hai, jabki Bakr ki riwayat wali hadees mein alfaaz kuchh yun hain: Unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Zara sochke dekho, kya tum mein se kisi ke badan par koi bhi gandagi baaki reh sakti hai agar uske darwaze par ek nadi ho jismein woh din mein paanch baar nahaaye? Unhone kaha: Uski koi bhi gandagi baaki nahi rahegi. Unhone farmaya: Yehi haal paanch namazon ka hai jinse Allah gunahon ko mita deta hai.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The similitude of five prayers is like an overflowing river passing by the gate of one of you in which he washes five times daily Hasan said: No filthiness can remain on him.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Paanch namazon ki misaal ek behti hui nadi jaisi hai jo tum mein se kisi ke darwaze se guzarti ho jismein woh din mein paanch baar nahaata ho. Hasan ne kaha: Uspar koi bhi gandagi baaki nahi reh sakti.

e: Ata' b. Yasar reported, on the authority of Abu Huraira, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: He who went towards the mosque in the morning or evening, Allah would arrange a feast for him morning or evening in Paradise.
hi: Ata bin Yasar ne Abu Huraira (RA) ke hawale se Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Jo subah ya shaam masjid ki taraf gaya, Allah uske liye Jannat mein subah ya shaam ki ek dawat ka intezaam karega.

e: Simak b. Harb reported: I said to Jabir b. Samura: Did you sit in the company of the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him)? He said: Yes, very often. He (the Holy Prophet) used to sit at the place where he observed the morning or dawn prayer till the sun rose or when it had risen; he would stand, and they (his Companions) would talk about matters (pertaining to the days) of ignorance, and they would laugh (on these matters) while (the Holy Prophet) only smiled.
hi: Simak bin Harb ne bayan kiya: Maine Jabir bin Samura se kaha: Kya aap Rasoolullah (SAW) ki sohbat mein baithte the? Unhone kaha: Haan, aksar. Woh us jagah baithte the jahan unhone fajr ki namaz padhi hoti, yahan tak ki suraj nikal jaata ya nikal chuka hota; woh phir khade hote, aur woh, unke sahaba, jaahiliyat ke zamaane ki baaton par baaten kiya karte the, aur woh baaton par hasa karte the jabki Nabi (SAW) sirf muskuraate the.

e: Simak narrated on the authority of Jabir b. Samura that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed the dawn prayer, he sat at the place of worship till the sun had risen enough.
hi: Simak ne Jabir bin Samura ke hawale se riwayat ki ki jab Rasoolullah (SAW) fajr ki namaz padh lete, to woh apni namaz ki jagah par tab tak baithe rehte jab tak suraj kaafi nikal na aata.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Simak with the same chain of transmitters, but no mention has been made of, enough".
hi: Ye hadees Simak ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai, lekin ismein "kaafi" ka zikr nahi kiya gaya hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The parts of land dearest to Allah are its mosques, and the parts most hateful to Allah are markets.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Zameen ke woh hisse jo Allah ko sabse pyare hain woh iski masjiden hain, aur woh hisse jo Allah ko sabse zyada napasand hain woh bazaar hain.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When there are three persons, one of them should lead them. The one among them most worthy to act as Imam is one who is best versed in the Qur'an.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Jab teen log hon, to unmein se ek unki imamat kare. Unmein se Imam banne ke sabse zyada haqdaar woh hai jo Quran ka sabse zyada ilm rakhta ho.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated by Qatida with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Qatada ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Abu Sa'id al-Khudri by another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ne ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki hai.

e: Abu Mas'ud al-Ansari reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The one who is most versed in Allah's Book should act as Imam for the people, but If they are equally versed in reciting it, then the one who has most knowledge regarding Sunnah if they are equal regarding the Sunnah, then the earliest one to emigrate; it they emigrated at the same time, then the earliest one to embrace Islam. No man must lead another in prayer where (the latter) has authority, or sit in his place of honour in his house, without his permission. Ashajj in his narration used the word," age" in place of" Islam".
hi: Abu Mas'ud al-Ansari (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Jo Allah ki Kitaab ka sabse zyada ilm rakhta ho, use logon ki imamat karni chahiye, lekin agar woh usko padhne mein barabar hon, to jise Sunnat ka sabse zyada ilm ho; agar woh Sunnat mein barabar hon, to jo sabse pehle hijrat karne wala ho; agar unhone ek hi waqt hijrat ki ho, to jo sabse pehle Islam laaya ho. Koi bhi shakhs kisi doosre ki imamat na kare jahan doosre ka ikhtiyar ho, ya uske ghar mein uski izzat ki jagah par uski ijazat ke bagair na baithe. Ashajj ne apni riwayat mein "Islam" ki jagah "umar" lafz istemal kiya hai.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated by A'mash by the same chain of transmitters
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees A'mash ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: Abu Mas'ud al-Ansari reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to us: The one who is well grounded in Allah's Book and is distinguished among them in recitation should act as; Imam for the people. and if they are equally versed in reciting it, then the one who has most knowledge regarding Sunnah; if they are equal regarding the Sunnah, then the earliest one to emigrate; If they emigrated at the same time, then the oldest one in age. No man must lead another in prayer in latter's house or where (the latter) has authority, or sit in his place of honour in his house, except that he gives you permission or with his permission.
hi: Abu Mas'ud al-Ansari (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne humse kaha: Jo Allah ki Kitaab mein achhi taalim rakhta ho aur qiraat mein unmein mumtaz ho, use logon ki imamat karni chahiye. Aur agar woh usko padhne mein barabar hon, to jise Sunnat ka sabse zyada ilm ho; agar woh Sunnat mein barabar hon, to jo sabse pehle hijrat karne wala ho; agar unhone ek hi waqt hijrat ki ho, to jo umar mein sabse bada ho. Koi bhi shakhs kisi doosre ki, uske ghar mein ya jahan uska ikhtiyar ho, imamat na kare, ya uske ghar mein uski izzat ki jagah par na baithe, siwaay iske ki woh use ijazat de ya uski ijazat se.

e: Malik b. Huwairith reported: We came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and we were all young men of nearly equal age. We stayed with him (the Holy Prophet) for twenty nights, and as the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was extremely kind and tender of heart, he therefore, thought that we were eager (to see) our family (we felt homesick). So he asked us about the members of the family that we had left behind and when we informed him, he said: Go back to your family, stay with them, and teach them (beliefs and practices of Islam) and exhort them to good, and when the time for prayer comes, one amongst you should announce Adhan and then the oldest among you should lead the prayer.
hi: Malik bin Huwairith (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aaye aur hum sab taqreeban ek hi umar ke jawan the. Hum unke saath bees raaten thehre, aur chunki Rasoolullah (SAW) bahut hi meherbaan aur narm-dil the, is liye unhone socha ki hum apne gharwalon ke liye betaab hain. To unhone humse humare peeche chhode gaye gharwalon ke baare mein poocha aur jab humne unhe bataya, to unhone farmaya: Apne gharwalon ke paas wapas jao, unke saath raho, aur unhe sikhao aur unhe achhaai ki hidayat do, aur jab namaz ka waqt aaye, to tum mein se ek azaan de aur phir tum mein se sabse bada namaz padhaye.

e: This hadith has been transmitted by Ayyub with the same chain of narrator.
hi: Ye hadees Ayyub ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: Malik b. Huwairith Abu Sulaiman reported: I came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) along with other persons and we were young men of nearly equal age, and the rest of the hadith was transmitted like the hadith narrated before.
hi: Malik bin Huwairith Abu Sulaiman ne bayan kiya: Main aur kuch aur log Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aaye aur hum taqreeban ek hi umar ke jawan the, aur baaki hadees pehle bayan hui hadees jaisi hi bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Malik b Huwairith reported: I came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) along with a companion of mine, and when we intended to return from him, he said: When there is time for prayer, announce prayer, pronounce Iqama, and the oldest amongst you should lead the prayer.
hi: Malik bin Huwairith ne bayan kiya: Main apne ek saathi ke saath Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aaya, aur jab humne unse wapas jaane ka irada kiya, to unhone farmaya: Jab namaz ka waqt ho, to namaz ki azaan do, iqaamat kaho, aur tum mein se sabse bada namaz padhaye.

e: This hadith has been narrated with the same chain of transmitters, but al-Hadra' made this addition: " They both were equal in recitation."
hi: Ye hadees isi sanad se bayan ki gayi hai, lekin al-Hadra ne ye izafa kiya: "Woh dono qiraat mein barabar the."

e: Abu Salama b. Abd al-Rahman b. 'Auf heard Abu Huraira say: (When) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (wished to invoke curse or blessing on someone, he would do so at the end) of the recitation in the dawn prayer, when he had pronounced Allah-o-Akbar (for bending) and then lifted his head (saying):" Allah listened to him who praised Him; our Lord! to Thee is all praise" ; he would then stand up and say:" Rescue al-Walid b. Walid, Salama b. Hisham, and 'Ayyash b. Abd Rabi'a, and the helpless among the Muslims. O Allah! trample severely Mudar and cause them a famine (which broke out at the time) of Joseph. O Allah! curse Lihyan, Ri'l, Dhakwan, 'Usayya, for they disobeyed Allah and His Messenger." (The narrator then adds): The news reached us that he abandoned (this) when this verse was revealed:" Thou but no concern in the matter whether He turns to them (mercifully) or chastises them; surely they are wrongdoers" (ill. 127)
hi: Abu Salama bin Abdur-Rahman bin Auf ne Abu Huraira (RA) ko ye kehte suna: Jab Rasoolullah (SAW) kisi par laanat ya barkat ki dua karna chahte, to woh aisa fajr ki namaz ki qiraat ke akhir mein karte, jab unhone ruku ke liye Allahu Akbar kaha hota aur phir apna sar utha kar kehte: "Allah ne uski suni jisne uski hamd ki; Aye hamare Rab! Sari tareef Teri hi hai"; phir woh khade hokar kehte: "Al-Walid bin Walid, Salama bin Hisham, aur Ayyash bin Abi Rabi'a ko bacha, aur musalmaanon mein se kamzoron ko bhi. Aye Allah! Mudar qabile ko sakht rond de aur unpar aisa qaht bhej jaisa Yusuf (AS) ke zamaane mein aaya tha. Aye Allah! Lihyan, Ri'l, Dhakwan aur Usayya par laanat bhej, kyunki unhone Allah aur uske Rasool ki naafarmani ki." Raawi ne aage kaha: Humein khabar mili ki unhone ye dua karna tab chhod diya jab ye aayat nazil hui: "Tumhe is baat mein koi ikhtiyaar nahi ki Allah unki taraf rujoo kare ya unhe azaab de; yaqeenan woh zaalim hain" (3:127).

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira by another chain of transmitters up to the words: " And cause them a famine like that (which broke out at the time) of Joseph," but the subsequent portion was not mentioned.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se bhi in alfaaz tak bayan ki gayi hai: "Aur unpar aisa qaht bhej jaisa Yusuf (AS) ke zamaane mein aaya tha," lekin uske baad ka hissa zikr nahi kiya gaya.

e: Abu Salama reported it on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) recited Qunut after ruku' in prayer for one mouth at the time of reciting (these words): " Allah listened to him who praised Him," and he said in Qunut:" 0 Allah! rescue al-Walid b. al-Walid; O Allah! rescue Salama b. Hisham; O Allah! rescue 'Ayyash b. Abu Rabi'a; O Allah! rescue the helpless amongst the Muslims; O Allah! trample Mudar severely; O Allah! cause them a famine like that (which was caused at the time) of Joseph." Abu Huraira (further) said: I saw that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) afterwards abandoned this supplication. I, therefore said: I see the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) abandoning this blessing upon them. It was raid to him (Abu Huraira): Don't you see that (those for whom was blessing invoked by the Holy Prophet) have come (i. e. they have been rescued)?
hi: Abu Salama ne ye Abu Huraira (RA) ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ek mahine tak namaz mein ruku ke baad, "Allah ne uski suni jisne uski hamd ki" kehte waqt, Qunut padhte the, aur Qunut mein woh kehte: "Aye Allah! Al-Walid bin al-Walid ko bacha; Aye Allah! Salama bin Hisham ko bacha; Aye Allah! Ayyash bin Abi Rabi'a ko bacha; Aye Allah! Musalmaanon mein se kamzoron ko bacha; Aye Allah! Mudar ko sakht rond de; Aye Allah! Unpar aisa qaht bhej jaisa Yusuf (AS) ke zamaane mein aaya tha." Abu Huraira ne aage kaha: Maine dekha ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne baad mein ye dua karna chhod diya. Is liye maine kaha: Main dekh raha hoon ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unke liye ye dua karna chhod diya. Unse kaha gaya: Kya tumhe nahi lagta ki jinke liye Nabi (SAW) dua kar rahe the woh aa chuke hain, yaani unhe bacha liya gaya hai?

e: Abu Salama narrated that Abu Huraira told him that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) pronounced: " Allah listened to him who praised Him." and before prostration, he would recite this in the 'Isya' prayer: O Allah! rescue 'Ayyash b. Abu Rabi'a, and the rest of the hadith is the same as narrated by Auza'i to the words:" Like the famine (at the time) if Joseph." but he made no mention of that which follows afterwards.
hi: Abu Salama ne bayan kiya ki Abu Huraira ne unhe bataya ki jab Rasoolullah (SAW) "Allah ne uski suni jisne uski hamd ki" kehte aur sajde se pehle, to woh isha ki namaz mein ye padhte: Aye Allah! Ayyash bin Abi Rabi'a ko bacha, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai jaisi Auza'i ne in alfaaz tak bayan ki hai: "Yusuf (AS) ke zamaane jaisa qaht," lekin unhone uske baad ka koi zikr nahi kiya.

e: Abu Salama b. 'Abd al-Rahman is reported to have said that he had heard Abu Huraira saying: I would say prayer along with you which is near to the prayer of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). and Abu Huraira recited Qunut in the noon and in the 'Isya' and in the morning prayer, and invoked blessing (of Allah) upon Muslims-and curse upon the unbelievers.
hi: Abu Salama bin Abdur-Rahman ne bataya ki unhone Abu Huraira (RA) ko ye kehte suna: Main tumhare saath woh namaz padhunga jo Rasoolullah (SAW) ki namaz ke sabse qareeb hai. Aur Abu Huraira ne zohar, isha aur fajr ki namaz mein Qunut padha, aur Musalmaanon ke liye barkat ki aur kaafiron ke liye laanat ki dua ki.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) invoked curse in the morning (prayer) for thirty days upon those who killed the Companions (of the Holy Prophet) at Bi'r Ma'una. He cursed (the tribes) of Ri'l, Dhakwan, Lihyan, and Usayya, who had disobeyed Allah and His Messenger (ﷺ). Anas said: Allah the Exalted and Great revealed (a verse) regarding those who were killed at Bi'r Ma'una, and we recited it, till it was abrogated later on (and the verse was like this):, convey to it our people the tidings that we have met our Lord, and He was pleased with us and we were pleased with Him".
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Bir Ma'una mein sahaba ko qatal karne walon par tees din tak fajr ki namaz mein laanat ki dua ki. Unhone Ri'l, Dhakwan, Lihyan aur Usayya qabilon par laanat bheji, jinhone Allah aur uske Rasool (SAW) ki naafarmani ki thi. Anas ne kaha: Allah Ta'ala ne Bir Ma'una mein qatal hue logon ke baare mein ek aayat nazil ki, aur humne use padha, yahan tak ki baad mein ye mansookh ho gayi aur aayat kuch is tarah thi: "Hamari qaum ko ye khushkhabri pahuncha do ki humne apne Rab se mulaqat kar li hai, aur Woh hamse raazi hai aur hum Usse raazi hain."

e: Muhammad reported: I asked Anas whether the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed Qunut in the dawn prayer. He said: Yes, (he did so) after the ruku', for a short while.
hi: Muhammad ne bayan kiya: Maine Anas se poocha ki kya Rasoolullah (SAW) fajr ki namaz mein Qunut padhte the. Unhone kaha: Haan, aisa karte the ruku ke baad, thodi der ke liye.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed Qunut for a month in the dawn prayer after ruku' and invoked curse upon Ri'l, Dhakwan, and said that 'Usayya had disobeyed Allah and His Apostle (ﷺ).
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne ek mahine tak fajr ki namaz mein ruku ke baad Qunut padha aur Ri'l aur Dhakwan par laanat ki dua ki, aur kaha ki Usayya ne Allah aur uske Rasool (SAW) ki naafarmani ki thi.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed Qunut for a month in the dawn prayer after ruku' and invoked curse upon Bani Usayya.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne ek mahine tak fajr ki namaz mein ruku ke baad Qunut padha aur Banu Usayya par laanat ki dua ki.

e: Asim reported: I asked Anas whether Qunut was observed (by the Holy prophet) before ruku' or after ruku'. He replied: Before ruku'. I said: People conceive that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed Qunut after the ruku'. He said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed Qunut (after the ruku' as the people conceive it) for a mouth invoking curse upon those persons who had killed men among his Companions who were called the reciter (of the Qur'an).
hi: Asim ne bayan kiya: Maine Anas se poocha ki kya Qunut ruku se pehle padhi jaati thi ya ruku ke baad. Unhone jawab diya: Ruku se pehle. Maine kaha: Log samajhte hain ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ruku ke baad Qunut padhte the. Unhone kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne ek mahine tak Qunut padhi, ruku ke baad, jaisa log samajhte hain, un logon par laanat ki dua karte hue jinhone unke sahaba mein se un logon ko qatal kiya jinhe "qaari" kaha jaata tha.

e: 'Asim reported - I heard Anas saying: Never did I ace the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) so much grieved (at the loss of a) small army as I saw him grieved at those seventy men who were called" reciters" (and were killed) at Bi'r Ma'una; and he invoked curse for full one month upon their murderers.
hi: Asim ne bayan kiya: Maine Anas ko kehte suna: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko kabhi kisi choti fauj ke nuksaan par itna gam-zada nahi dekha jitna maine unhe un sattar logon par, jinhe "qaari" kaha jaata tha aur Bir Ma'una mein maare gaye, gam-zada dekha; aur unhone poore ek mahine tak unke qaatilon par laanat ki dua ki.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Anas with another chain of transmitters and with minor additions.
hi: Ye hadees Anas ne ek doosri sanad se, chhote izafon ke saath, bayan ki hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed Qunut for one month Invoking curse upon Ri'l, Dhakwan, 'Usayya. those who disobeyed Allah and His Messenger (ﷺ).
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne ek mahine tak Qunut padhi, Ri'l, Dhakwan, Usayya - jinhone Allah aur uske Rasool (SAW) ki naafarmani ki thi - par laanat ki dua karte hue.

e: A hadith like this has been transmitted by Anas from the Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him).
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Anas ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se bayan ki hai.

e: Anas reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed Qunut for one month invoking curse upon some tribes of Arabia (those who were responsible for the murders in Bi'r Ma'una and Raji'), but then abandoned it.
hi: Anas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne ek mahine tak Qunut padhi, Arab ke kuch qabilon par laanat ki dua karte hue, jo Bir Ma'una aur Raji' ke qatal ke zimmedaar the, lekin phir isse chhod diya.

e: Al-Bari' b. 'Azib reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed Qunut in the morning and evening (prayers).
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) fajr aur maghrib ki namazon mein Qunut padhte the.

e: Al-Bari' reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed Qunut in the dawn and evening (prayers).
hi: Al-Bara (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) fajr aur maghrib ki namazon mein Qunut padhte the.

e: Khufaf b. Ima' al-Ghifari reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) aid in prayer: 0 Allah I curse the tribes of Lihyan, Ri'l, Dhakwan, and 'Usayya for they disobeyed Allah and His Messenger (ﷺ). Allah pardoned (the tribe of) Ghifar and Allah granted protection to (the tribe of) Aslam
hi: Khufaf bin Ima al-Ghifari (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne namaz mein kaha: Aye Allah! Lihyan, Ri'l, Dhakwan aur Usayya qabilon par laanat bhej kyunki unhone Allah aur uske Rasool (SAW) ki naafarmani ki. Allah ne Ghifar qabile ko maaf kar diya aur Allah ne Aslam qabile ko panah di.

e: Khufaf b. Ima' reported that the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him), bowed (in prayer) and then lifted his head and then said: So far as the tribe of Ghifar is concerned, Allah had pardoned it, and Allah had granted protection to the tribe of Aslam, and as for the tribe of Usayya, It had disobeyed Allah and His Messenger, (and further said): O Allah! curse the tribe of Lihyan curse Ri'l, and Dhakwan, and then fell in prostration. It is after this that the cursing of the unbelievers got a sanction.
hi: Khufaf bin Ima (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne namaz mein ruku kiya aur phir apna sar utha kar farmaya: Jahan tak Ghifar qabile ka sawal hai, Allah ne use maaf kar diya hai, aur Allah ne Aslam qabile ko panah di hai, aur jahan tak Usayya qabile ka sawal hai, usne Allah aur uske Rasool ki naafarmani ki, aur aage kaha: Aye Allah! Lihyan qabile par laanat bhej, Ri'l aur Dhakwan par laanat bhej, aur phir sajde mein chale gaye. Isi ke baad kaafiron par laanat karne ki ijazat mili.

e: A hadith like this has been transmitted by Khufaf b. Ima' except this that he did not mention (these words): " cursing of unbelievers got a sanctions.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Khufaf bin Ima ne bayan ki hai siwaay is baat ke ki unhone "kaafiron par laanat karne ki ijazat mili" ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: Abu Huraira reported that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) returned from the expedition to Khaibar, he travelled one night, and stopped for rest when he became sleepy. He told Bilal to remain on guard during the night and he (Bilal) prayed as much as he could, while the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and his Companions slept. When the time for dawn approached Bilal leaned against his camel facing the direction from which the dawn would appear but he was overcome by sleep while he was leaning against his camel, and neither the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) nor Bilal, nor anyone else among his Companions got up, till the sun shone on them. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was the first of them to awake and, being startled, he called to Bilal who said: Messenger of Allah I may my father and mother be offered as ransom for thee, the same thing overpowered me which overpowered you. He (the Holy Prophet, then) said: Lead the beasts on: so they led their camels to some distance. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) then performed ablution and gave orders to Bilal who pronounced the Iqama and then led them in the morning prayer. When he finished the prayer he said: When anyone forgets the prayer, he should observe it when he remembers it, for Allah has said:" And observe the prayer for remembrance of Me" (Qur'an. xx. 14). Yunus said: Ibn Shilab used to recite it like this:" (And observe the prayer) for remembrance."
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab Rasoolullah (SAW) Khaibar ki muhim se wapas lautte, to unhone ek raat safar kiya, aur jab unhe neend aane lagi to woh aaraam ke liye ruk gaye. Unhone Bilal ko raat bhar pehra dene ko kaha aur woh Bilal jitni ho sake namaz padhte rahe, jabki Rasoolullah (SAW) aur unke sahaba so gaye. Jab subah hone ka waqt qareeb aaya to Bilal apne oont par takiya lagakar us taraf mudkar baithe jahan se subah numaayan hoti, lekin neend ne unhe apne oont pe takiya lagaye hue hi dabocha liya, aur na Rasoolullah (SAW), na Bilal, na hi unke sahaba mein se koi aur uthe, yahan tak ki suraj unpar chamakne laga. Rasoolullah (SAW) unmein sabse pehle jaage aur, ghabraakar, unhone Bilal ko pukara jinhone kaha: Ya Rasoolullah! Mere maa-baap aap par qurbaan hon, mujhpar bhi wahi cheez haawi hui jo aap par hui. Unhone kaha: Jaanwaron ko aage badhao: to unhone apne oont thodi door le gaye. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne phir wuzu kiya aur Bilal ko hukum diya jinhone iqaamat kahi aur phir unhe fajr ki namaz padhayi. Jab unhone namaz mukammal ki to unhone farmaya: Jab bhi koi namaz bhool jaye, use tab padhna chahiye jab use yaad aaye, kyunki Allah ne farmaya hai: "Aur mujhe yaad karne ke liye namaz qaayam karo" (20:14). Yunus ne kaha: Ibn Shihab ise isi tarah padha karte the: "Aur namaz qaayam karo yaad ke liye."

e: Abu Huraira reported: We stopped for rest along with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and did not awake till the sun rose. The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) then told us that everybody should take hold of his camel's nosestring (get out of this ground) for it was the place where devil had visited us. We did accordingly. He then called for water and performed ablution and then performed two prostrations. Ya'qub said: Then he prayed (performed) two prostrations. then takbir was pronounced for prayer and then he offered the morning prayer (in congregation).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath aaraam ke liye ruke aur tab tak nahi jaage jab tak suraj nikal na aaya. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne phir humein kaha ki sabko apne oont ki naath pakadni chahiye aur is jagah se nikalna chahiye kyunki ye woh jagah thi jahan shaitaan humse mila tha. Humne aisa hi kiya. Phir unhone paani mangwaya aur wuzu kiya aur phir do sajde kiye. Ya'qub ne kaha: Phir unhone do sajde namaz padhi, phir namaz ke liye takbeer kahi gayi aur unhone fajr ki namaz jamaat mein padhayi.

e:
Abu Qatida reported: The Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him) addressed us and said: You would travel In the evening and the might till (God willing) you would come in the morning to a place of water. So the people travelled (self absorbed) without paying any heed to one another, and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) also travelled till It was midnight. I was by his side. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) began to doze and leaned (to one side) of his camel. I came to him and I lent him support without awaking him till he sat poised on his ride. He went on travelling till a major part of the night was over and (he again) leaned (to one side) of his camel. I supported him without awaking him till he sat" bed on his ride. and then travelled till it was near dawn. He (again) leaned which was far more inclined than the two earlier leanings and he was about to fall down. So I came to him and supported him and he lifted his head and said; Who is this? I said: it is Abu Qatida. He (the Prophet again) said: Since how long have you been travelling along with me like this? I said: I have been travelling in this very state since the night. He said: May Allah protect you, as you have protected His Apostle (from falling down), and again said: Do you see that we are hidden from the people? - and again said: Do you see anyone? I said: Here is a rider. I again said: Here Is another rider till we gathered together and we were seven riders. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stepped aside of the highway and placed his head (for sleep and said): Guard for us our prayers. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was the first to wake up and the rays of the sun were falling on his back. We got up startled He (the Holy Prophet) said: Ride on So we rode on till the sun had (sufficiently) risen. He then came down from his camel and called for a jug of water which I had with me. There was a little water in that. He performed ablution with that which was less thorough as compared with his usual ablutions and some water of that had been left. He (the Holy Prophet) said to Abu Qatida: Keep a watch over your jug of water; it would have (a miraculous) condition about it. Then Bilal summoned (people) to prayer and then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed two rak'ahs and then said the morning prayer as he said every day. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) (then) rode on and we rode along with him and some of us whispered to the others saying: How would there be compensation for omission in our prayers? Upon this he (the Messenger of Allah) said: Is there not in me (my life) a model for you? There is no omission in sleeping. The (cognizable) emission is that one should not say prayer (intentionally) till the time of the other prayer comes. So he who did like it (omitted prayer in sleep or due to other unavoidable circumstances) should say prayer when he becomes aware of it and on the next day he should observe it at its prescribed time. 
He (the Holy Prophet) said: What do you think the people would have done (at this hour)? They would have in the morning found their Apostle missing from amongst them and then Abu Bakr and 'Umar would have told them that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) must be behind you, he cannot leave you behind (him), but the people said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) is ahead of you. So if you had obeyed Abu Bakr and Umar, you would have gone on the right path. So we proceeded on till we came up to the people (from whom we had lagged behind) and the day had considerably risen and everything became hot, and they (the Companions of the Holy Prophet) said: Messenger of Allah, we are dying of thirst. Upon this he (the Holy Prophet) remarked: There is no destruction for you. And again said: Bring that small cup of mine and he then asked for the jug of water to be brought to him. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) began to pour water (in that small cup) and Abu Qatida gave them to drink. And when the people saw that there was (a little) water in the jug, they fell upon it. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Behave well; the water (is enough) to satiate all of you. Then they (the Companions) began to receive (their share of) water with calmness (without showing any anxiety) and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) began to fill (the cap), and I began to serve them till no one was left except me and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He then filled (the cup) with water and said to me: Drink it. I said: Messenger of Allah, I would not drink till you drink. Upon this he said: The server of the people Is the last among them to drink. So I drank and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) also drank and the people came to the place of water quite happy and satiated. 'Abdullah b. Rabah said: I am going to narrate this hadith in the great mosque, when 'Imran b. Husain said: See, O young man, how will you narrate for I was also one of the riders on that night? I said: So you must be knowing this hadith well. He said: Who are you? I said: I am one of the Ansar. Upon this he said: You narrate, for you know your hadith better. I, therefore, narrated it to the people. 'Imran said: I was also present that night, but I know not anyone else who learnt it so well as you have learnt.
hi: Abu Qatada (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne humse khitaab kiya aur kaha: Tum shaam aur raat safar karoge yahan tak ki, Allah chahe to, tum subah paani ki jagah pahunch jaoge. To log apne aap mein masroof chal pade bina ek doosre ki taraf tawajjo diye, aur Rasoolullah (SAW) bhi chalte rahe yahan tak ki aadhi raat ho gayi. Main unke bagal mein tha. Rasoolullah (SAW) ko unghayi aane lagi aur woh apne oont ki ek taraf jhukne lage. Main unke paas aaya aur unhe jagaaye bagair sahara diya yahan tak ki woh apni sawari par seedhe baith gaye. Woh aage chalte rahe yahan tak ki raat ka bada hissa guzar gaya aur woh dobara apne oont ki ek taraf jhukne lage. Maine unhe bina jagaaye sahara diya yahan tak ki woh apni sawari par seedhe baith gaye, aur phir woh chalte rahe yahan tak ki subah hone ke qareeb aa gaye. Woh dobara jhuke jo pehle do baar jhukne se kahin zyada tha aur woh gir-gir jaane wale the. To main unke paas aaya aur unhe sahara diya aur unhone apna sar utha kar kaha: Ye kaun hai? Maine kaha: Ye Abu Qatada hai. Unhone dobara kaha: Tum kab se mere saath is tarah safar kar rahe ho? Maine kaha: Main raat se hi is haal mein safar kar raha hoon. Unhone kaha: Allah tumhari hifazat kare, jaise tumne uske Rasool ki hifazat ki, aur unhone phir kaha: Kya tumhe lagta hai ki hum logon se chhup gaye hain? - aur phir kaha: Kya tumhe koi dikh raha hai? Maine kaha: Ye ek sawaar hai. Maine phir kaha: Ye ek aur sawaar hai, yahan tak ki hum sab ikattha ho gaye aur hum saat sawaar the. Rasoolullah (SAW) raaste se hatkar apna sar rakhkar sone ke liye letne lage aur kaha: Hamari namaz ki hifazat karo. Rasoolullah (SAW) sabse pehle jaage aur suraj ki kirnein unki peeth par pad rahi thin. Hum ghabraakar utthe. Unhone kaha: Chalo. To hum chal pade yahan tak ki suraj kaafi upar aa gaya. Phir woh apne oont se utre aur paani ke ghade ki maang ki jo mere paas tha. Usmein thoda paani tha. Unhone usse wuzu kiya jo unke aam wuzu se kam mukammal tha aur usme se kuch paani bach gaya. Unhone Abu Qatada se kaha: Apne paani ke ghade ki hifazat karo; iske saath kuch khaas baat hogi. Phir Bilal ne namaz ki azaan di aur phir Rasoolullah (SAW) ne do rakat padhi aur phir fajr ki namaz waise hi padhi jaise woh har din padhte the. Rasoolullah (SAW) phir apni sawari par chale aur hum bhi unke saath chale aur humme se kuch logon ne ek doosre se khusar-phusar karke kaha: Hamari namazon mein hui chhoot ki bharpayi kaise hogi? Isper unhone kaha: Kya mere zindagi mein tumhare liye koi namoona nahi hai? Sone mein koi chhoot nahi hoti. Qaabil-e-nazar chhoot to ye hai ki koi jaan boojh kar namaz na padhe yahan tak ki agli namaz ka waqt aa jaye. Is liye jisne aisa kiya ho, neend ya kisi aur laachaari ki wajah se namaz chhooti ho, use jab yaad aaye tab padh leni chahiye aur agle din use uske muqarrar waqt par ada karna chahiye. Unhone kaha: Tum kya sochte ho log is waqt kya karte? Woh subah apne Rasool ko apne beech gayab paate aur phir Abu Bakr aur Umar unhe batate ki Rasoolullah (SAW) zaroor tumhare peeche honge, woh tumhe peeche nahi chhodenge, lekin log kehte: Rasoolullah (SAW) tumse aage hain. To agar tum Abu Bakr aur Umar ki baat maante, to tum sahi raaste par ho jaate. To hum aage badhte rahe yahan tak ki hum un logon tak pahunche jinse hum peeche reh gaye the aur din kaafi chadh chuka tha aur sab kuch garam ho gaya tha, aur unhone kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, hum pyaas se marne wale hain. Isper unhone kaha: Tumhari koi tabaahi nahi hai. Aur phir kaha: Mera woh chhota pyaala le aao aur phir unhone paani ka ghada mangwaya. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne us chhote pyaale mein paani dalna shuru kiya aur Abu Qatada ne unhe pilaya. Aur jab logon ne dekha ki ghade mein thoda paani hai, to woh usper toot pade. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Sabar se kaam lo; paani tum sabko seer karne ke liye kaafi hai. Phir woh sukoon se apna paani lene lage aur Rasoolullah (SAW) pyaala bharne lage, aur main unhe pilaane laga yahan tak ki koi baaki nahi bacha siwaay mere aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ke. Unhone phir pyaala paani se bhara aur mujhse kaha: Ise piyo. Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, main tab tak nahi peeunga jab tak aap na piyein. Isper unhone kaha: Logon ko pilaane wala unmein sabse aakhri peene wala hota hai. To maine piya aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ne bhi piya aur log paani ki jagah par bahut khush aur seer hokar pahunche. Abdullah bin Rabah ne kaha: Main ye hadees badi masjid mein bayan karne wala hoon, jab Imran bin Husain ne kaha: Dekho, aye jawan, tum kaise bayan karoge kyunki main bhi us raat ke sawaaron mein se ek tha? Maine kaha: To aapko ye hadees achhi tarah pata honi chahiye. Unhone kaha: Tum kaun ho? Maine kaha: Main Ansar mein se ek hoon. Isper unhone kaha: Tum bayan karo, kyunki tum apni hadees behtar jaante ho. To maine ye logon ko bayan ki. Imran ne kaha: Main bhi us raat maujood tha, lekin main kisi aur ko nahi jaanta jisne ise itni achhi tarah seekha ho jitna tumne seekha hai.

e: 'Imran b. Husain reported: I was with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in a journey. We travelled the whole of the night, and when it was about to dawn, we got down for rest, and were overpowered (by sleep) till the sun shone. Abu Bakr was the first to awake amongst us. and we did not awake the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) from his sleep allowing him to wake up (of his own accord). It was 'Umar who then woke up. He stood by the side of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and recited takbir in a loud voice till the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) woke up. When he lifted his head, he saw that the sun had arisen; he then said: Proceed on. He travelled along with us till the sun shone brightly. He came down (from his camel) and led us in the morning prayer. A person, however, remained away from the people and did not say, prayer along with us. After having completed the prayer, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to him: O, so and so, what prevented you from observing prayer with us? He said: Apostle of Allah! I was not in a state of purity. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ordered him arid lie performed Tayammum with dust and said prayer. He then urged me to go ahead immediately along with other riders to find out water, for we felt very thirsty. We were traveling when we came across a woman who was sitting (on a camel) with her feet hanging over two leathern water bags. We said to her: How far is water available? She, said: Far, very far, very far. You cannot get water. We (again) said: How much distance is there between (the residence of) your family and water? She said: It is a day and night journey. We said to her: You go to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). She said: Who is the Messenger of Allah? We somehow or the other managed to bring her to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he asked about her, and she informed him as she had informed us that she was a widow having orphan children. He ordered that her camel should be made to kneal down and he gargled in the opening (of her leathern water-bag). The camel was then raised up and we forty thirsty men drank water till we were completely satiated, and we filled up all leathern water-bags and water-skins that we had with us and we washed our companions, but we did not make any camel drink, and (the leathern water-bags) were about to burst (on account of excess of water). He then said: Bring whatever you have with you. So we collected the bits (of estable things) and dates and packed them up in a bundle, and said to her: Take it away. This is meant for your children, and know that we have not its any way done any loss to your water. W hen she came to her family she said: I have met the greatest magician amongst human beings, or he is an apostle, as he claims to be, and she then narrated what had happened and Allah guided aright those people through that woman. She affirmed her faith in Islam and so did the people embrace Islam.
hi: Imran bin Husain (RA) ne bayan kiya: Main Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath ek safar mein tha. Humne poori raat safar kiya, aur jab subah hone hi wali thi, to hum aaraam ke liye utar gaye, aur neend ne humpar itna qaboo paa liya ki suraj chamakne laga. Abu Bakr humme se sabse pehle jaage. Aur humne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko unki neend se nahi jagaaya, unhe apne aap jaagne diya. Phir Umar jaage. Woh Rasoolullah (SAW) ke bagal mein khade hue aur zor se takbeer kahi yahan tak ki Rasoolullah (SAW) jaag gaye. Jab unhone apna sar utha kar dekha ki suraj nikal chuka hai; to unhone kaha: Aage badho. Woh humare saath tab tak chalte rahe jab tak suraj achhi tarah chamak na gaya. Woh apne oont se utre aur humein fajr ki namaz padhayi. Ek shakhs, halaanki, logon se door raha aur humare saath namaz nahi padhi. Namaz mukammal karne ke baad, Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unse kaha: Aye falan, kis cheez ne tumhe hamare saath namaz padhne se roka? Unhone kaha: Ya Rasoolullah! Main paak halat mein nahi tha. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unhe hukum diya aur unhone mitti se tayammum kiya aur namaz padhi. Unhone phir mujhe aur kuch sawaaron ko turant paani doondhne ke liye aage jaane ko kaha, kyunki humein bahut pyaas lagi thi. Hum safar kar rahe the jab humne ek aurat ko dekha jo ek oont par baithi hui thi aur uske paon do chamde ke masakon ke beech latak rahe the. Humne unse kaha: Paani kitni door milega? Unhone kaha: Door, bahut door, bahut door. Tumhe paani nahi milega. Humne phir kaha: Tumhare gharwalon aur paani ke beech kitna faasla hai? Unhone kaha: Ek din aur raat ka safar hai. Humne unse kaha: Tum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas chalo. Unhone kaha: Rasoolullah kaun hain? Humne kisi tarah unhe Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas laaya aur unhone unke baare mein poocha, aur unhone unhe wahi bataya jo unhone humein bataya tha ki woh ek bewa hain jinke yateem bachche hain. Unhone unke oont ko baithane ka hukum diya aur unhone mashk ke munh mein kulli ki. Oont ko phir uthaya gaya aur hum chaalis pyaase logon ne paani piya yahan tak ki hum poori tarah seer ho gaye, aur humne apne saath maujood saare mashk aur mashkezi bhar liye aur humne apne saathiyon ko dhoya, lekin humne kisi oont ko paani nahi pilaaya, aur mashken paani ki zyaadti ki wajah se phatne ke qareeb thin. Unhone phir kaha: Jo bhi tumhare paas ho le aao. To humne kuch khaane ki cheezein aur khajoorein ikattha ki aur unhe ek gattharay mein baandh diya, aur unse kaha: Ise le jao. Ye tumhare bacchon ke liye hai, aur jaan lo ki humne tumhare paani ka koi bhi nuksaan nahi kiya. Jab woh apne gharwalon ke paas pahunchi to unhone kaha: Mujhe insaanon mein sabse bada jaadugar mila hai, ya woh ek Rasool hain, jaisa woh dawa karte hain, aur unhone phir jo hua woh sunaya aur Allah ne un logon ko us aurat ke zariye hidayat di. Usne Islam par apna imaan zaahir kiya aur logon ne bhi Islam qubool kar liya.

e: 'Imran b. Husain reported: We were with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in a journey and we travelled throughout the night till at the end, just before dawn, we lay down (for rest), and nothing is sweeter for a traveller than this and none awakened us but the heat of the sun, and the rest of the hadith is the same (as mentioned above) except this additien:" When 'Umar b. Khattab woke up, he saw what had happened to the people. And he was a man having a big belly and strongly built; he recited takbir in a loud voice till the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) woke up by the loudness of his voice in takbir. When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) got up, the people told him what had happened. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: There is no harm; you better proceed further," and (the rest of the hadith) was narrated.
hi: Imran bin Husain (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath ek safar mein the aur humne poori raat safar kiya yahan tak ki, subah se thodi der pehle, hum let gaye aaraam ke liye, aur musafir ke liye isse mithi koi cheez nahi hoti, aur humein suraj ki garmi ke siwaay kisi ne nahi jagaaya, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai jaisa upar zikr hua siwaay is izafe ke: "Jab Umar bin Khattab jaage, to unhone dekha ki logon ke saath kya hua tha. Aur woh ek bade pet wale aur mazboot jism wale aadmi the; unhone zor se takbeer kahi yahan tak ki Rasoolullah (SAW) unki takbeer ki awaaz se jaag gaye. Jab Rasoolullah (SAW) uthe, to logon ne unhe bataya ki kya hua tha. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Koi nuksaan nahi hai; tum behtar hoga ki aage badho," aur baaki hadees bayan ki gayi.

e: Abu Qatada reported that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was in a journey he got down for rest at night, and he used to lie down on his right side, and when he lay down for rest before the dawn, he used to stretch his forearm and place his head over his palm.
hi: Abu Qatada (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab Rasoolullah (SAW) safar mein hote, to woh raat ko aaraam ke liye utarte, aur woh apni daayi karvat let jaate, aur jab woh subah se pehle aaraam ke liye letate, to woh apna baazu phaila kar apna sar apni hatheli par rakhte.

e: Qatada reported from Anas b. Malik that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: He who forgets the prayer should say it when he remembers it, there is no explation for it, except this. Qatada said: (Allah says)" And observe prayer for remembrance of Me"
hi: Qatada ne Anas bin Malik (RA) ke hawale se ye riwayat ki ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jo namaz bhool jaye, use padh leni chahiye jab use yaad aaye, iska koi aur kaffara nahi hai siwaay isi ke. Qatada ne kaha: Allah farmata hai: "Aur mujhe yaad karne ke liye namaz qaayam karo."

e: This hadith has been narrated by Qatada, but here no mention has been made of" There is no explation for it except this."
hi: Ye hadees Qatada ne bayan ki hai, lekin ismein "Iska koi aur kaffara nahi hai siwaay isi ke" ka zikr nahi kiya gaya.

e: Qatada narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: He who forgets the prayer, or he slept (and it was omitted), its expiation is (only) that he should observe it when he remembers it.
hi: Qatada ne Anas bin Malik (RA) ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jo namaz bhool jaye, ya woh so gaya ho aur namaz chhoot gayi ho, uska kaffara sirf ye hai ki woh use padh le jab use yaad aaye.

e: Qatada reported it on the authority of Anas b. Malik that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When any one of you omits the prayer due to sleep or he forgets it, he should observe it when he remembers it, for Allah has said:" Observe prayer for remembrance of Me."
hi: Qatada ne ise Anas bin Malik (RA) ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab tum mein se koi neend ki wajah se namaz chhod de ya use bhool jaye, to use padh lena chahiye jab use yaad aaye, kyunki Allah ne farmaya hai: "Mujhe yaad karne ke liye namaz qaayam karo."

e: 'A'isha, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), reported: The prayer was prescribed as two rak'ahs, two rak'ahs both in journey and at the place of residence. The prayer while travelling remained as it was (originally prescribed), but an addition was made in the prayer (observed) at the place of residence.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ki zauja Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Namaz do rakat, do rakat farz ki gayi thi, chahe safar mein ho ya ghar par. Safar ki namaz waisi hi rahi jaisi shuru mein muqarrar hui thi, lekin ghar par padhi jaane wali namaz mein izafa kar diya gaya.

e: 'A'isha, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), said Allah prescribed the prayer as two rak'ahs, then it was completed (to four rak'ahs) at the place of residence, but was retained in the same position in journey as it was first made obligatory.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ki zauja Aisha (RA) ne kaha: Allah ne namaz ko do rakat farz kiya, phir ghar mein rehte hue ise char rakat tak mukammal kiya gaya, lekin safar mein ye usi soorat mein rahi jaisi pehli baar farz ki gayi thi.

e: 'A'isha reported: The prayer was prescribed as consisting of two rak'ahs, the prayer in travelling remained the same, but the prayer at the place of residence was completed. (Zuhri said he asked 'Urwa why 'A'isha said prayer in the complete form during journey, and he replied that she interpreted the matter herself as 'Uthman did.)
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Namaz do rakat farz ki gayi thi, safar ki namaz waisi hi rahi, lekin ghar par padhi jaane wali namaz mukammal kar di gayi. Zuhri ne kaha ki unhone Urwa se poocha ki Aisha safar mein poori namaz kyun padhti thin, aur unhone jawab diya ki unhone is maamle ki tashreeh khud ki, jaisa Uthman ne ki thi.

e: Yahya b. Umayya said: I told 'Umar b. al-Khattab that Allah had said:" You may shorten the prayer only if you fear that those who are unbelievers may afflict you" (Qur'an, iv. 101), whereas the people are now safe. He replied: I wondered about it in the same way as you wonder about it, so I asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about it and he said: It is an act of charity which Allah has done to you, so accept His charity.
hi: Yahya bin Umayya ne kaha: Maine Umar bin Khattab (RA) se kaha ki Allah ne farmaya hai: "Tum namaz sirf tab kam kar sakte ho jab tumhe khauf ho ki kaafir tumhe nuksaan pahunchayenge" (4:101), jabki log ab mahfooz hain. Unhone jawab diya: Mujhe bhi waisi hi hairaani hui thi jaisi tumhe ho rahi hai, is liye maine Rasoolullah (SAW) se iske baare mein poocha aur unhone farmaya: Ye ek sadaqa hai jo Allah ne tumhe diya hai, is liye Uski sadaqe ko qubool karo.

e: Ya'la b. Umayya reported: I said to 'Umar b. al-Khattab, and the rest of the hadlth is the same.
hi: Ya'la bin Umayya ne bayan kiya: Maine Umar bin Khattab (RA) se kaha, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported: Allah has prescribed the prayer through the word of your Prophet (ﷺ) as four rak'ahs when resident, two when travelling, and one when danger is present.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ne tumhare Nabi (SAW) ke alfaaz ke zariye namaz ko char rakat farz kiya hai jab tum ghar par ho, do rakat jab tum safar mein ho, aur ek rakat jab khatra maujood ho.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported: Allah has prescribed the prayer by the tongue of your Apostle (ﷺ) as two rak'ahs for the traveller, four for the resident, and one in danger.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ne tumhare Rasool (SAW) ki zubaan ke zariye namaz ko musafir ke liye do rakat, ghar par rehne wale ke liye char rakat, aur khatre ke waqt ek rakat farz kiya hai.

e: Musa b. Salama Hudhali said: I asked Ibn 'Abbas: How should I say prayer when I am in Mecca, and when I do not pray along with the Imam? He said: Two rak'ahs (of prayer) is the Sunnah of Abu'l-Qasim (ﷺ).
hi: Musa bin Salama Hudhali ne kaha: Maine Ibn Abbas se poocha: Jab main Makkah mein hoon, aur jab main Imam ke saath namaz nahi padhta, to mujhe kaise namaz padhni chahiye? Unhone kaha: Do rakat namaz Abu'l-Qasim (SAW) ki Sunnat hai.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated by Abu Qatada with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Abu Qatada ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: Hafs b. 'Asim said: I accompanied Ibn 'Umar on the road to Mecca and he led us in two rak'ahs at the noon prayer, then he went forward and we too went along with him to a place where he alighted, and he sat and we sat along with him, and he cast a glance to the side where he said prayer and he saw people standing and asked: What are they doing? I said: They are engaged in glorifying Allah, offering Sunnah prayer. He said: If I had done so I would have perfected my prayer; O my nephew! I accompanied the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on a journey, and he made no addittion to two rak'ahs, till Allah called him. I accompanied Abu Bakr and he made no addition to two rak'ahs till Allah caused him to die. I accompanied 'Umar and he made no addition to two rak'ahs till Allah caused him to die. I accompanied 'Uthman and he made no addition to two rak'ahs, till Allah caused him to die, and Allah has said:" There is a model pattern for you in the Messenger of Allah" (al-Qur'an, xxxiii. 21).
hi: Hafs bin Asim ne kaha: Main Ibn Umar (RA) ke saath Makkah ke raaste par tha aur unhone humein zohar ki namaz mein do rakat padhayin, phir woh aage badhe aur hum bhi unke saath ek jagah gaye jahan woh utre, aur woh baithe aur hum bhi unke saath baithe, aur unhone us taraf nazar daali jahan unhone namaz padhi thi aur unhone dekha ki log khade hain aur poocha: Ye kya kar rahe hain? Maine kaha: Woh Allah ki tasbeeh kar rahe hain, Sunnat namaz padh rahe hain. Unhone kaha: Agar maine aisa kiya hota to maine apni namaz mukammal kar li hoti; Aye mere bhatije! Main Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath ek safar mein tha, aur unhone do rakat mein koi izafa nahi kiya, jab tak Allah ne unhe apne paas bula nahi liya. Main Abu Bakr (RA) ke saath tha aur unhone do rakat mein koi izafa nahi kiya jab tak Allah ne unhe maut nahi de di. Main Umar (RA) ke saath tha aur unhone do rakat mein koi izafa nahi kiya jab tak Allah ne unhe maut nahi de di. Main Uthman (RA) ke saath tha aur unhone do rakat mein koi izafa nahi kiya, jab tak Allah ne unhe maut nahi de di, aur Allah ne farmaya hai: "Tumhare liye Rasoolullah mein ek behtareen namoona hai" (33:21).

e: Hafs b. 'Asim reported: I fell ill and lbn 'Umar came to inquire after my health, and I asked him about the glorification of Allah (i. e. prayer) while travelling. Thereupon he said: I accompanied the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on a journey but I did not see him glorifying Him, and were I to glorify (Him). I would have completed the prayer. Allah, the Exalted, has said:" Verily there is a model pattern for you in the Messenger of Allah."
hi: Hafs bin Asim ne bayan kiya: Main beemar pad gaya aur Ibn Umar (RA) mera haal-chaal poochne aaye, aur maine unse safar mein Allah ki tasbeeh, yaani namaz, ke baare mein poocha. Isper unhone kaha: Main Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath ek safar mein tha lekin maine unhe namaz mein izafa karke tasbeeh karte nahi dekha, aur agar main aisa karta, to main namaz mukammal kar leta. Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya hai: "Yaqeenan tumhare liye Rasoolullah mein ek behtareen namoona hai."

e: Anas reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said four rak'ahs in the noon prayer while at Medina, but he offered two rak'ahs in the afternoon prayer at Dhu'l-Hulaifa.
hi: Anas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Madina mein zohar ki namaz char rakat padhi, lekin unhone Dhu'l-Hulaifa mein asr ki namaz do rakat padhi.

e: Anas b. Malik is reported to have said: I observed four rak'ahs in the noon prayer with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) at Medina, and said two rak'ahs in the afternoon prayer at Dhu'l-Hulaifa.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne kaha: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath Madina mein zohar ki namaz char rakat padhi, aur Dhu'l-Hulaifa mein asr ki namaz do rakat padhi.

e: Yahya b. Yazid al-Huna'i reported: I asked Anas b. Malik about shortening of prayer. He said: When the Messenger of' Allah (ﷺ) had covered a distance of three miles or three farsakh (Shu'ba, one of the narrators, had some doubt about it) he observed two rak'ahs.
hi: Yahya bin Yazid al-Huna'i ne bayan kiya: Maine Anas bin Malik se namaz kam karne ke baare mein poocha. Unhone kaha: Jab Rasoolullah (SAW) teen mil ya teen farsakh ka faasla tay kar lete the, Shu'ba, raawiyon mein se ek, ko iske baare mein shaq tha, to woh do rakat padhte the.

e: Jubair b. Nufair reported: I went along with Shurahbil b. al-Simt to a village which was situated at a distance of seventeen or eighteen miles, and he said only two rak'ahs of prayer. I said to him (about it) and he said: I saw 'Umar observing two rak'ahs at Dhu'l-Hulaifa and I (too) said to him (about it) and he said: I am doing the same as I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) doing.
hi: Jubair bin Nufair ne bayan kiya: Main Shurahbil bin al-Simt ke saath ek gaanv gaya jo satrah ya atharah mil ke faasle par tha, aur unhone sirf do rakat namaz padhi. Maine unse iske baare mein kaha aur unhone kaha: Maine Umar (RA) ko Dhu'l-Hulaifa mein do rakat padhte dekha aur maine bhi unse iske baare mein kaha aur unhone kaha: Main wahi kar raha hoon jo maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko karte dekha.

e: This hadith has been transmitted by Shu'ba with the same chain of narrators and it is narrated from Simt, and the name of Shurahbil has not been mentioned, and he said that he had gone to a place called Dumin, situated at a distance of eighteen miles from Hims.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai aur ye Simt se riwayat ki gayi hai, aur Shurahbil ka naam nahi liya gaya, aur unhone kaha ki woh Dumin naam ki ek jagah gaye the, jo Hims se atharah mil ke faasle par thi.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: We went out from Medina to Mecca with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he prayed two rak'ahs at each time of prayer till we returned to Medina. I said: For how long did he stay in Mecca? He said: (For) ten (days).
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath Madina se Makkah nikle aur unhone har namaz ke waqt do rakat padhi yahan tak ki hum Madina wapas laut aaye. Maine kaha: Woh Makkah mein kitne din rahe? Unhone kaha: Das din.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated by Anas by another chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Anas ne ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki hai.

e: Yahya b. Abu Ishaq reported: I heard Anas b. Malik say: We went out for Pilgrimage from Medina. The rest is the same.
hi: Yahya bin Abu Ishaq ne bayan kiya: Maine Anas bin Malik ko kehte suna: Hum Hajj ke liye Madina se nikle. Baaki waisi hi hai.

e: A hadith like this has been transmitted by Anas, but no mention has been made of Pilgrimage.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Anas ne bayan ki hai, lekin ismein Hajj ka koi zikr nahi kiya gaya.

e: Salim b. 'Abdullah (b. 'Umar) reported on the authority of his father that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) observed the prayer of a traveller, i. e. two rak'ahs in Mina, and other places; so did Abu Bakr and 'Umar, and 'Uthman too observed two rak'ahs at the beginning of his caliphate, but he then completed four.
hi: Salim bin Abdullah bin Umar ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne musafir ki namaz, yaani do rakat, Mina aur doosri jagah padhi; aisa hi Abu Bakr aur Umar ne kiya, aur Uthman ne bhi apni khilafat ki shuruaat mein do rakat padhi, lekin phir unhone char rakat padhna shuru kar diya.

e: A hadith like this has been reported by Zuhri, with the same chain of transmitters, and in it mention was made of Mina only, but not of other places.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Zuhri ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai, aur ismein sirf Mina ka zikr kiya gaya hai, doosri jagahon ka nahi.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said two rak'ahs at Mina, and Abu Bakr after him, and 'Umar after Abu Bakr, and 'Uthman at the beginning of his caliphate; then 'Uthman observed four rak'ahs, and when Ibn 'Umar prayed with the Imam, he said four rak'ahs, but when he observed prayer alone, he said two rak'ahs.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Mina mein do rakat padhi, aur unke baad Abu Bakr ne, aur Abu Bakr ke baad Umar ne, aur Uthman ne apni khilafat ki shuruaat mein; phir Uthman ne char rakat padhna shuru kar diya, aur jab Ibn Umar Imam ke saath namaz padhte, to woh char rakat padhte, lekin jab woh akele namaz padhte, to woh do rakat padhte.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated by the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees isi sanad se bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) said in Mina the prayer of a traveller (short prayer) ; Abu Bakr and 'Umar did the same and 'Uthmia did it for eight years or six years. Hafs (one of the narrators) said: Ibn 'Umar would also say two rak'ahs at Mina and then go to bed. I said to him: O uncle, I wish you could have said two rak'ahs (of Sunnah prayer after shorenting the Fard prayer). He said: Were I to do that, I would have completed the prayer.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Mina mein musafir ki namaz, chhoti namaz, padhi; Abu Bakr aur Umar ne bhi aisa hi kiya aur Uthman ne aath ya chhe saal tak aisa kiya. Hafs, raawiyon mein se ek, ne kaha: Ibn Umar Mina mein bhi do rakat padhte aur phir bistar par chale jaate. Maine unse kaha: Aye chacha, kaash aap do rakat, Sunnat namaz, farz namaz kam karne ke baad, padh lete. Unhone kaha: Agar main aisa karta, to main namaz mukammal kar leta.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters but no mention has been made of Mina, but they (the narrators) only said: He prayed while travelling.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai lekin ismein Mina ka koi zikr nahi kiya gaya, unhone sirf itna kaha: Unhone safar mein namaz padhi.

e: Ibrahim reported: I heard 'Abd al-Rahman as saying; 'Uthman led us four rak'ahs of prayer at Mina. It was reported to Abdullah b. Mas'ud and he recited:" Surely we are Allah's and to Him shall we return," and then said: I prayed with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) at Mina two rak'ahs of prayer. I prayed along with Abu Bakr al-Siddiq two rak'ahs of prayer at Mina. I prayed along with 'Umar b. Khattab two rak'ahs of prayer at Mina. I wish I had my share of the two rak'ahs acceptable (to God) for the four rak'ahs.
hi: Ibrahim ne bayan kiya: Maine Abdur-Rahman ko ye kehte suna: Uthman (RA) ne humein Mina mein char rakat namaz padhayi. Ye khabar Abdullah bin Mas'ud tak pahunchi aur unhone padha: "Yaqeenan hum Allah ke hain aur usi ki taraf humein laut kar jaana hai," aur phir kaha: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath Mina mein do rakat namaz padhi. Maine Abu Bakr Siddiq (RA) ke saath Mina mein do rakat namaz padhi. Maine Umar bin Khattab (RA) ke saath Mina mein do rakat namaz padhi. Kaash mujhe in do rakaton ka apna hissa milta jo Allah ko unke char rakaton se zyada qubool hoti.

e: A hadith like this has been reported by A'mash with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees A'mash ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: Haritha b. Wahb reported: I prayed with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) two rak'ahs and most of them offered two rak'ahs only in Mina, while the people felt secure.
hi: Haritha bin Wahb (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath do rakat namaz padhi aur zyadatar logon ne Mina mein sirf do rakat hi padhi, jabki log mahfooz mahsoos kar rahe the.

e: Wahb al-Khuza'i reported: I prayed behind the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) at Mina, and there was the greatest number of people, and they prayed two rak'ahs on the occasion of the Farewell Pilgrimage. (Muslim said: Haritha b. Wahb al-Khuza'i is the brother of 'Ubaidullah b. 'Umar son of Khattab from the side of his mother.)
hi: Wahb al-Khuza'i ne bayan kiya: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ke peeche Mina mein namaz padhi, aur wahan logon ki sabse zyada tadaad thi, aur unhone Hajjat-ul-Wida ke mauqe par do rakat padhi. Muslim ne kaha: Haritha bin Wahb al-Khuza'i, Ubaidullah bin Umar bin Khattab ke maa ki taraf se bhai hain.

e: Ibn 'Umar announced Adhan for prayer on a cold, windy night. Then added: Pray in your dwellings; and then said: When it was a cold, rainy night, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to command the Mu'adhdhin to say" Pray in your dwellings."
