hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne ek sardi bhari, tez hawaon wali raat ko namaz ki azaan di. Phir izafa kiya: Apne ghar mein namaz padho; aur phir kaha: Jab sardi bhari, baarish wali raat hoti, to Rasoolullah (SAW) muazzin ko hukum dete ki woh kahe "Apne ghar mein namaz padho."

e: Ibn 'Umar reported that he summoned (people) to pray on a cold, windy and rainy night, and then observed at the end of the Adhin: Pray in your dwellings, pray in your dwellings, and then said: When it was a cold night or it was raining in a journey the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) used to command the Mu'adhdhin to announce: Pray in your dwellings.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unhone ek sardi bhari, tez hawaon aur baarish wali raat ko namaz ke liye bulaya, aur phir azaan ke akhir mein kaha: Apne ghar mein namaz padho, apne ghar mein namaz padho, aur phir kaha: Jab safar mein sardi bhari raat hoti ya baarish ho rahi hoti, to Rasoolullah (SAW) muazzin ko hukum dete ki woh ailaan kare: Apne ghar mein namaz padho.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported that he summoned (people) to prayer at a place (known as) Dajnan, and the rest of the hadith is the same, and then said: Pray in your dwellings, but he did not repeat for the second time words of Ibn 'Umar (Pray in your dwellings).
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unhone Dajnan naam ki jagah par namaz ke liye bulaya, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai, aur phir kaha: Apne ghar mein namaz padho, lekin unhone Ibn Umar ke alfaaz apne ghar mein namaz padho doosri baar nahi dohraye.

e: Jabir reported: We set cut with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on a journey when it began to rain. Upon this he said: He who desires may pray in his dwelling.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath ek safar par nikle jab baarish shuru ho gayi. Isper unhone kaha: Jo chahe apne ghar mein namaz padh sakta hai.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Abbas reported that he said to the Mu'adhdhin on a rainy day: When you have announced" I testify that there is no god but Allah; I testify that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah," do not say:" Come to the prayer," but make this announcement:" Say prayer in your houses." He (the narrator) said that the people disapproved of it. Ibn 'Abbas said: Are you astonished at it? He (the Holy Prophet), who is better than I, did it. Jumu'a prayer is no doubt obligatory, but I do not like that I should (force you) to come out and walk in mud and slippery ground.
hi: Abdullah bin Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unhone ek baarish wale din muazzin se kaha: Jab tum ye ailaan kar chuko "Main gawaahi deta hoon ki Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi hai; main gawaahi deta hoon ki Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain," to "Namaz ki taraf aao" mat kaho, balki ye ailaan karo: "Apne gharon mein namaz padho." Raawi ne kaha ki logon ne ise napasand kiya. Ibn Abbas ne kaha: Kya tum ispar hairaan ho? Nabi (SAW), jo mujhse behtar hain, aisa kiya. Jumma ki namaz shaq ke bagair farz hai, lekin mujhe pasand nahi ki main tumhe kichad aur phisalne wali zameen mein chalne ke liye majboor karun.

e: 'Abd al-Hamid reported: I heard 'Abdullah b. al-Harith say: 'Abdullah b. 'Abbas addressed us on a rainy day, and the rest of the hadith is the same, but he made no mention of Jumu'a prayer, and added: He who did it (who commanded us to say prayer in our houses), i. e. the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), is better than I.
hi: Abdul Hamid ne bayan kiya: Maine Abdullah bin al-Harith ko ye kehte suna: Abdullah bin Abbas ne humein ek baarish wale din khitaab kiya, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai, lekin unhone jumma ki namaz ka zikr nahi kiya, aur izafa kiya: Jinhone aisa kiya, jinhone humein apne gharon mein namaz padhne ka hukum diya, yaani Rasoolullah (SAW), woh mujhse behtar hain.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Ayyub and 'Asim al-Ahwal with the same chain of transmitters, but in this hadith it is not recorded: " i. e. the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)."
hi: Ye hadees Ayyub aur Asim al-Ahwal ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai, lekin is hadees mein "yaani Rasoolullah (SAW)" darj nahi hai.

e: 'Abdullah b. Harith reported that Ibn 'Abbas commanded the Mu'adhdhin to (summon the people to prayer on Friday and make announcement to say prayer in their houses) when it was rainy, and the rest of the hadith is the same (except this) that he said: I do not like you should walk in muddy slippery place.
hi: Abdullah bin Harith ne bayan kiya ki Ibn Abbas ne muazzin ko hukum diya, jumma ke din logon ko namaz ke liye bulaane aur unhe apne gharon mein namaz padhne ka ailaan karne ka, jab baarish ho rahi thi, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai siwaay is baat ke ki unhone kaha: Mujhe pasand nahi ki tum kichad wali, phisalne wali jagah mein chalo.

e: 'Abdullah b. Harith reported that the Mu'adhdhin of Ibn 'Abba said Adhan on Friday (and then made the announcement to say prayer in houses) because it was a rainy day; as it has been narrated by Ma'mar and others, and in this hadith it was mentioned: He who did it, i. e. the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), was better than I.
hi: Abdullah bin Harith ne bayan kiya ki Ibn Abbas ke muazzin ne jumma ke din azaan di, aur phir gharon mein namaz padhne ka ailaan kiya, kyunki woh ek baarish wala din tha; jaisa Ma'mar aur doosron ne bayan kiya hai, aur is hadees mein zikr hua hai: Jinhone aisa kiya, yaani Rasoolullah (SAW), woh mujhse behtar the.

e: A hadith like this that Ibn 'Abbas ordered his Mu'adhdhin (to summon people to prayer and then make announcement to say prayer in their houses) on Friday which was a rainy day, has been transmitted by 'Abdullah b. Harith. Wuhaib, however, says that he did not hear it from him.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees ki Ibn Abbas ne apne muazzin ko hukum diya, jumma ke din logon ko bulaane aur unhe apne gharon mein namaz padhne ka ailaan karne ka, jo ek baarish wala din tha, Abdullah bin Harith ne bhi bayan ki hai. Wuhaib, halaanki, kehte hain ki unhone ise unse nahi suna.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to say Nafl prayer on (the back of) his camel in whatever direction it took him.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) apne oont ki peeth par nafil namaz padha karte the chahe woh kisi bhi taraf mudta.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported that the Apostle (ﷺ) used to pray on (the back of) his camel in whatever direction it took him.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasool (SAW) apne oont ki peeth par namaz padha karte the chahe woh kisi bhi taraf mudta.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to say prayer on his camel while coming from Mecca to Medina, in whatever direction his face had turned; and its was (in this context) that this verse was revealed: " So whether you turn thither is Allah's face" (ii. 115).
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) Makkah se Madina aate hue apne oont par namaz padha karte the, jis taraf bhi unka mooh muda hota; aur isi silsile mein ye aayat nazil hui: "To jis taraf bhi tum mudo, Allah ka mooh wahin hai" (2:115).

e: This hadith has been narrated by another chain of transmitters and in the one narrated by Ibn Mubarak and Ibn Abu Za'ida (these words are narrated). Ibn 'Umar then recited: " Whether you turn thither is Allah's face," and it was revealed in this context.
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se bayan ki gayi hai aur Ibn Mubarak aur Ibn Abu Za'ida ki riwayat mein ye alfaaz bayan hue hain. Ibn Umar ne phir padha: "Jis taraf bhi tum mudo, Allah ka mooh wahin hai," aur ye isi silsile mein nazil hui.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported: I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) praying (Nafl prayer) on a donkey's back while his face was turned towards Khaibar.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ek gadhe ki peeth par nafil namaz padhte dekha jabki unka mooh Khaibar ki taraf muda hua tha.

e: Sa'id b. Yasar reported: I was travelling along with Ibn 'Umar on the way to Mecca. Sa'id said: When I apprehended dawn, I dismounted (the ride) and observed Witr prayer and then again joined him. Ibn 'Umar said to me: Where were you? I said: I apprehended the appearance of dawn, so I dismounted and observed Witr prayer. Upon this 'Abdullah said: Is there not a model pattern for you in the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)? I said: Yes, by Allah, and (then) he said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to observe Witr prayer on the camel's back.
hi: Sa'id bin Yasar ne bayan kiya: Main Ibn Umar (RA) ke saath Makkah ke raaste par safar kar raha tha. Sa'id ne kaha: Jab mujhe subah hone ka andesha hua, to main sawari se utra aur Witr ki namaz padhi aur phir dobara unse jaa mila. Ibn Umar ne mujhse kaha: Tum kahan the? Maine kaha: Mujhe subah hone ka andesha hua, is liye main utra aur Witr ki namaz padhi. Isper Abdullah, Ibn Umar, ne kaha: Kya tumhare liye Rasoolullah mein koi behtareen namoona nahi hai? Maine kaha: Haan, Allah ki qasam, aur phir unhone kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) apne oont ki peeth par Witr ki namaz padha karte the.

e: 'Abdullah b. Dinar reported on the authority of Ibn 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to observe prayer on his ride (no matter) in which direction it had its face turned. 'Abdullah b. Dinar said that Ibn 'Umar used to do like that.
hi: Abdullah bin Dinar ne Ibn Umar (RA) ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Rasoolullah (SAW) apni sawari par namaz padha karte the chahe woh kisi bhi taraf mudi ho. Abdullah bin Dinar ne kaha ki Ibn Umar bhi aisa hi kiya karte the.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Umar reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to observe Witr prayer on his ride.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) apni sawari par Witr ki namaz padha karte the.

e: Salim b. 'Abdullah reported on the authority of his father that the Messenger of Allah (may peace be. upon him) used to observe Nafl (supererogatory) prayer on his ride no matter in what direction it turned its face, and he observed Witr too on it, but did not observe obligatory prayer on it.
hi: Salim bin Abdullah ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Rasoolullah (SAW) apni sawari par nafil namaz padha karte the chahe woh kisi bhi taraf muda hota, aur unhone Witr bhi usper padhi, lekin farz namaz usper nahi padhi.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Amir b. Rabi'a has reported on the authority of his father that he had seen the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observing Nafl player at night on a journey on the back of his ride in whichever direction it turned its face.
hi: Abdullah bin Amir bin Rabi'a ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) ko raat mein safar ke dauran apni sawari ki peeth par nafil namaz padhte dekha tha, chahe woh kisi bhi taraf mudti.

e: Anas b. Sirin reported: We met Anas b. Malik as he came to Syria at a place known as 'Ain-al-Tamar and saw him observing prayer on the back of his donkey with his face turned in that direction. (Hammam one of the narrators) pointed towards the left of Qibla, so I said to him: I find you observing prayer towards the side other than that of Qibla. Upon this he said: Had I not seen the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) doing like this, I would not have done so at all.
hi: Anas bin Sirin ne bayan kiya: Hum Anas bin Malik (RA) se mile jab woh Syria aate hue Ain-al-Tamar naam ki jagah par pahunche aur humne unhe apne gadhe ki peeth par namaz padhte dekha, unka mooh us taraf muda hua tha. Hammam, raawiyon mein se ek, ne Qibla ki baayi taraf ishara kiya, to maine unse kaha: Main aapko Qibla ke ilawa kisi doosri taraf namaz padhte hue paa raha hoon. Isper unhone kaha: Agar maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko aisa karte na dekha hota, to main bilkul aisa nahi karta.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was in a state of hurry on a journey, he combined the sunset and 'Isha' prayers.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya: Jab Rasoolullah (SAW) safar mein jaldi mein hote, to woh maghrib aur isha ki namazon ko jama karte, yaani ek saath padhte.

e: Nafi' reported that when Ibn 'Umar was in a state of hurry on a journey, he combined the sunset and 'Isha' prayers after the twilight had disappeared, and he would say that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was in a state of hurry on a journey, he combined the sunset and 'Isha' prayers.
hi: Nafi' ne bayan kiya ki jab Ibn Umar safar mein jaldi mein hote, to woh maghrib aur isha ki namazon ko shafaq khatam hone ke baad jama karte, aur woh kaha karte the ki jab Rasoolullah (SAW) safar mein jaldi mein hote, to woh maghrib aur isha ki namazon ko jama karte.

e: Salim reported from his father to be saying: I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) combining the sunset and Isha' prayers when he was in a hurry on a journey.
hi: Salim ne apne walid ke hawale se ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko maghrib aur isha ki namazein jama karte dekha jab woh safar mein jaldi mein the.

e: Salim b. 'Abdullah reported that his father had said: I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) delaying the sunset prayer till he would combine it with the 'Isha' when he hastened to set out on a journey.
hi: Salim bin Abdullah ne apne walid ke hawale se bayan kiya ki unhone kaha: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko maghrib ki namaz der karte dekha yahan tak ki woh use isha ke saath jama kar dete, jab woh safar par nikalne ki jaldi mein hote.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) set out on a journey before the sun declined (from the meridian), he delayed the noon prayer till the afternoon prayer, and then dismounted (his ride) and combined them (noon and afternoon prayers), but if the sun had declined before his setting out on a journey, he observed the noon prayer and then mounted (the ride).
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya: Jab Rasoolullah (SAW) suraj ke darmiyan-bindu se dhalne se pehle safar par nikalte, to woh zohar ki namaz ko asr ke waqt tak der karte, aur phir sawari se utar kar unhe, zohar aur asr ko, jama karte, lekin agar suraj safar par nikalne se pehle dhal chuka hota, to woh zohar ki namaz padhte aur phir sawari par sawaar hote.

e: Anas reported: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) intended to combine two prayers on a journey, he delayed the noon prayer till came the early time of the afternoon prayer, and then combined the two.
hi: Anas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Jab Rasoolullah (SAW) safar mein do namazon ko jama karna chahte, to woh zohar ki namaz ko asr ki namaz ke shuruaati waqt tak der karte, aur phir dono ko jama karte.

e: Anas reported that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had to set out on a journey hurriedly, he delayed the noon prayer to the earlier time for the afternoon prayer, and then he would combine them, and he would delay the sunset prayer to the time when the twilight would disappear and then combine it with the 'Isha' prayer.
hi: Anas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab Rasoolullah (SAW) ko jaldi mein safar par nikalna padta, to woh zohar ki namaz ko asr ke shuruaati waqt tak der karte, aur phir unhe jama karte, aur woh maghrib ki namaz ko shafaq khatam hone tak der karte aur phir use isha ki namaz ke saath jama karte.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed the noon and afternoon prayers together, and the sunset and Isha' prayers together without being in a state of fear or in a state of journey.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne zohar aur asr ki namazein ikattha padhin, aur maghrib aur isha ki namazein bhi ikattha padhin, bina kisi khauf ke ya safar ki halat mein hue.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed the noon and afternoon prayers together in Medina without being in a state of fear or in a state of journey. (Abu Zubair said: I asked Sa'id  hardship.)
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne zohar aur asr ki namazein Madina mein ikattha padhin, bina kisi khauf ke ya safar ki halat mein hue.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) combined the prayers as he set on a journey in the expedition to Tabuk. He combined the noon prayer with the afternoon prayer and the sunset prayer with the 'Isha' prayer. Sa'id (one of the rawis) said to Ibn 'Abbas: What prompted him to do this? He said: He wanted that his Ummah should not be put to (unnecessary) hardship.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Tabuk ki muhim ke safar par nikalte hue namazon ko jama kiya. Unhone zohar ki namaz ko asr ke saath aur maghrib ki namaz ko isha ke saath jama kiya. Sa'id, raawiyon mein se ek, ne Ibn Abbas se poocha: Unhone aisa karne ki wajah kya thi? Unhone kaha: Woh chahte the ki unki ummat ko bila zaroorat mushkil na ho.

e: Mu'adh reported: We set out with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the Tabuk expedition, and he observed the noon and afternoon prayers together and the sunset and 'Isha' prayers together.
hi: Mu'adh (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath Tabuk ki muhim par nikle, aur unhone zohar aur asr ki namazein ikattha padhin aur maghrib aur isha ki namazein bhi ikattha padhin.

e: Mu'adh b. Jabal reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) combined in the expedition to Tabuk the noon prayer with the afternoon prayer and the sunset prayer with the 'Isha' prayer. He (one of the narrators) said: What prompted him to do that? He (Mu'adh) replied that he (the Holy Prophet) wanted that his Ummah should not be put to (unnecessary) hardship.
hi: Mu'adh bin Jabal (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Tabuk ki muhim mein zohar ki namaz ko asr ke saath aur maghrib ki namaz ko isha ke saath jama kiya. Raawi ne poocha: Aisa karne ki wajah kya thi? Mu'adh ne jawab diya ki woh chahte the ki unki ummat ko bila zaroorat mushkil na ho.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) combined the noon prayer with the afternoon prayer and the sunset prayer with the 'Isha' prayer in Medina without being in a state of danger or rainfall. And in the hadith transmitted by Waki' (the words are): " I said to Ibn 'Abbas: What prompted him to do that? He said: So that his (Prophet's) Ummah should not be put to (unnecessary) hardship." And in the hadith transmitted by Mu'awiya (the words are):" It was said to Ibn 'Abbas: What did he intend thereby? He said he wanted that his Ummah should not be put to unnecessary hardship."
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne zohar ki namaz ko asr ke saath aur maghrib ki namaz ko isha ke saath Madina mein jama kiya, bina kisi khatre ya baarish ke. Aur Waki' ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: "Maine Ibn Abbas se poocha: Unhone aisa karne ki wajah kya thi? Unhone kaha: Taaki unki, Nabi ki, ummat ko bila zaroorat mushkil na ho." Aur Muawiya ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: "Ibn Abbas se poocha gaya: Unka isse kya maqsad tha? Unhone kaha: Woh chahte the ki unki ummat ko bila zaroorat mushkil na ho."

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported: I observed with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) eight (rak'ahs) in combination, and seven rak'ahs in combination. I (one of the narrators) said: O Abd Sha'tha', I think that he (the Holy Prophet) had delayed the noon prayer and hastened the afternoon prayer, and he delayed the sunset prayer and hastened the 'Isha' prayer. He said: I also think so.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath aath rakat jama karke aur saat rakat jama karke padhi. Raawiyon mein se ek ne kaha: Aye Abu Sha'tha, mera khayal hai ki unhone zohar ki namaz der ki aur asr jaldi padhi, aur unhone maghrib der ki aur isha jaldi padhi. Unhone kaha: Mera bhi yehi khayal hai.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed in Medina seven (rak'ahs) and eight (rak'ahs), i. e. (be combined) the noon and afternoon prayers (eight rak'ahs) and the sunset and 'Isha' prayers (seven rak'ahs).
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Madina mein saat rakat aur aath rakat padhin, yaani jama karke zohar aur asr ki namazein aath rakat aur maghrib aur isha ki namazein saat rakat.

e: 'Abdullah b. Shaqiq reported: Ibn 'Abbas one day addressed us in the afternoon (after the afternoon prayer) till the sun disappeared and the stars appeared, and the people began to say: Prayer, prayer. A person from Banu Tamim came there. He neither slackened nor turned away, but (continued crying): Prayer, prayer. Ibn 'Abbas said: May you be deprived of your mother, do you teach me Sunnah? And then he said: I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) combining the noon and afternoon prayers and the sunset and 'Isha' prayers. 'Abdullah b. Shaqiq said: Some doubt was created in my mind about it. So I came to Abu Huraira and asked him (about it) and he testified his assertion.
hi: Abdullah bin Shaqiq ne bayan kiya: Ibn Abbas ne ek din humein asr ke baad khitaab kiya yahan tak ki suraj chhup gaya aur sitare nikal aaye, aur log kehne lage: Namaz, namaz. Banu Tamim ka ek shakhs wahan aaya. Woh na dheela pada na hi door mudkar gaya, balki chillata raha: Namaz, namaz. Ibn Abbas ne kaha: Tumhari maa tumse mehroom ho jaye, kya tum mujhe Sunnat sikhaate ho? Aur phir unhone kaha: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko zohar aur asr, aur maghrib aur isha ki namazein jama karte dekha. Abdullah bin Shaqiq ne kaha: Iske baare mein mere zehan mein shaq paida ho gaya. To main Abu Huraira ke paas gaya aur unse iske baare mein poocha aur unhone unke dawe ki tasdeeq ki.

e: 'Abdullah b. Shaqiq al-'Uqaili reported: A person said to Ibn 'Abbas (as he delayed the prayer): Prayer. He kept silence. He again said: Prayer. He again kept silence, and he again cried: Prayer. He again kept silence and said: May you be deprived of your mother, do you teach us about prayer? We used to combine two prayers during the life of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).
hi: Abdullah bin Shaqiq al-Uqaili ne bayan kiya: Ek shakhs ne Ibn Abbas se kaha, jab unhone namaz der kar di: Namaz. Woh khamosh rahe. Unhone dobara kaha: Namaz. Woh phir khamosh rahe, aur unhone phir chillaya: Namaz. Woh phir khamosh rahe aur kaha: Tumhari maa tumse mehroom ho jaye, kya tum humein namaz ke baare mein sikhaate ho? Hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke zamaane mein do namazein jama kiya karte the.

e: Abdullah reported: None of you should give a share to Satan out of your self. He should not deem that it is necessary for him to turn but to the right only (after prayer). I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) turning to the left.
hi: Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Tum mein se koi apni namaz ka koi hissa Shaitaan ko na de. Use ye nahi samajhna chahiye ki namaz ke baad sirf daayi taraf hi mudna zaroori hai. Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko baayi taraf mudte dekha hai.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated by A'mash, with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees A'mash ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: Suddi reported: I asked Anas how I should turn-to the right or to the left-when I say my prayers. He said: I have very often seen the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) turning to the right.
hi: Suddi ne bayan kiya: Maine Anas se poocha ki namaz padhte waqt mujhe kis taraf mudna chahiye - daayi taraf ya baayi taraf. Unhone kaha: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko aksar daayi taraf mudte dekha hai.

e: Anas reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) used to turn to the right (at the end of the prayer).
hi: Anas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) namaz ke akhir mein daayi taraf mudte the.

e: Bara' reported: When we prayed behind the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) we cherished to be on his right side so that his face would turn towards us (at the end of the prayer), and he (the narrator) said: I heard him say: O my Lord! save me from Thy torment on the Day when Thoil, wouldst raise or gather Thy servants.
hi: Bara (RA) ne bayan kiya: Jab hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke peeche namaz padhte, to hum unki daayi taraf hona pasand karte taaki unka chehra namaz ke akhir mein hamari taraf mude, aur raawi ne kaha: Maine unhe kehte suna: Aye mere Rab! Mujhe Tere azaab se bacha us din jab Tu apne bandon ko utha ya ikattha karega.

e: This hadith has been reported by Mis'ar with the same chain of transmitters, but he made no mention of: " His face would turn towards us."
hi: Ye hadees Mis'ar ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai, lekin unhone "unka chehra hamari taraf mudta" ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: Abu Huraira reported the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: When the prayer commences then there is no prayer (valid), but the obligatory prayer. This hadith has been narrated by Warqa' with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Jab namaz shuru ho jaye, to koi aur namaz jaiz nahi hai siwaay farz namaz ke. Ye hadees Warqa ne isi sanad se bhi bayan ki hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: When the prayer commences, there is no prayer but the obligatory one.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Jab namaz shuru ho jaye, to koi namaz nahi hai siwaay farz namaz ke.

e: A hadith like this has been reported by Ishaq with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Ishaq ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Abu Huraira with another chain of transmitters. Hammad (one of the narrators) said: I then met 'Amr (the other narrator) and he narrated it to me, but it was not transmitted directly from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ne ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki hai. Hammad, raawiyon mein se ek, ne kaha: Phir main Amr, doosre raawi, se mila aur unhone mujhe ye bayan ki, lekin ye seedhe Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat nahi ki gayi thi.

e: 'Abdullah b. Malik b. Buhaina reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) happened to pass by a person who was busy in praying while the (Fard of the) dawn prayer had commenced. He said something to him, which we do not know what it was. When we turned back we surrounded him and said: What is it that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to you? He replied: He (the Holy Prophet) had said to me that he perceived as if one of them was about to observe four (rak'ahs) of the dawn prayer. Qa'nabi reported that 'Abdullah b. Malik b. Buhaina narrated it on the authority of his father. (Abu'l-Husain Muslim said): His assertion that he has narrated this hadith on the authority of his father is not correct.
hi: Abdullah bin Malik bin Buhaina (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ek aise shakhs ke paas se guzre jo namaz padhne mein masroof tha jabki fajr ki farz namaz shuru ho chuki thi. Unhone usse kuch kaha, jo humein nahi pata ki kya tha. Jab hum wapas mude to humne unhe ghera aur poocha: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne aapko kya kaha? Unhone jawab diya: Unhone mujhse kaha ki unhe mehsoos hua ki unmein se koi fajr ki namaz char rakat padhne wala hai. Qa'nabi ne bataya ki Abdullah bin Malik bin Buhaina ne ye apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki. Abu'l-Husain Muslim ne kaha: Unka ye dawa ki unhone ye hadees apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki, sahi nahi hai.

e: Ibn Buhaina reported: The dawn prayer had commenced when the Messen- ger of Allah (ﷺ) saw a person observing prayer, whereas the Mu'adhdhin had pronounced the Iqama. Upon this he (the Holy Prophet) remarked: Do you say four (rak'ahs) of Fard in the dawn prayer?
hi: Ibn Buhaina (RA) ne bayan kiya: Fajr ki namaz shuru ho chuki thi jab Rasoolullah (SAW) ne ek shakhs ko namaz padhte dekha, jabki muazzin ne iqaamat kahi thi. Isper unhone kaha: Kya tum fajr ki namaz mein char rakat farz padhte ho?

e: 'Abdullah b. Sarjis reported: A person entered the mosque, while the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was leading the dawn prayer. He observed two rak'ahs in a corner of the mosque, and then joined the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in prayer. When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had pronounced salutations (he had concluded the prayer), he said: O, so and so, which one out of these two prayers did you count (as your Fard prayer), the one that you observed alone or the prayer that you observed with us?
hi: Abdullah bin Sarjis (RA) ne bayan kiya: Ek shakhs masjid mein daakhil hua, jabki Rasoolullah (SAW) fajr ki namaz padha rahe the. Usne masjid ke ek konay mein do rakat padhin, aur phir Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath namaz mein shaamil ho gaya. Jab Rasoolullah (SAW) ne salaam pheera, namaz mukammal ki, to unhone kaha: Aye falan, in do namazon mein se tumne kaunsi ko apni farz namaz shumaar kiya - woh jo tumne akele padhi thi, ya woh jo tumne hamare saath padhi?

e: Abu Usaid reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When any one of you enters the mosque, he should say:" O Allah! open for me the doors of Thy mercy" ; and when he steps out he should say: 'O Allah! I beg of Thee Thy Grace." (Imam Muslim said: I heard Yahya saying: I transcribed this hadith from the compilation of Sulaiman b. Bilal.)
hi: Abu Usaid (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab tum mein se koi masjid mein daakhil ho, to use kehna chahiye: "Aye Allah! Mere liye Apni rahmat ke darwaze khol de"; aur jab woh bahar nikle to kahe: "Aye Allah! Main Tujhse Tera fazl maangta hoon." Imam Muslim ne kaha: Maine Yahya ko ye kehte suna: Maine ye hadees Sulaiman bin Bilal ki tasneef se naql ki.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) by Abu Usaid.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Abu Usaid ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki hai.

e: Abu Qatada (a Companion of the Prophet) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When any one of you enters the mosque, he should observe two rak'ahs (of Nafl prayer) before sitting.
hi: Abu Qatada, Nabi ke Sahabi, ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Jab tum mein se koi masjid mein daakhil ho, to use baithne se pehle do rakat nafil namaz padhni chahiye.

e: Abu Qatada, a Companion of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), said: I entered the mosque, when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had been sitting among people, and I also sat down among them. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: What prevented you from offering two rak'ahs (of Nafl prayer) before sitting down? I said: Messenger of Allah, I saw you sitting and people sitting (around you and I, therefore, sat in your company). He (the Holy Prophet) then said: When anyone among you enters the mosque, he should not sit till he has observed two rak'ahs.
hi: Abu Qatada, Rasoolullah (SAW) ke ek sahabi, ne kaha: Main masjid mein daakhil hua, jab Rasoolullah (SAW) logon ke beech baithe hue the, aur main bhi unke beech baith gaya. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Tumhe baithne se pehle do rakat nafil namaz padhne se kis cheez ne roka? Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, maine aapko baithe hue aur logon ko aapke aas-paas baithe hue dekha, is liye main bhi aapki sohbat mein baith gaya. Unhone phir kaha: Jab tum mein se koi masjid mein daakhil ho, to use tab tak nahi baithna chahiye jab tak woh do rakat na padh le.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) owed me a debt; he paid me back and made an addition (of this). I entered the mosque and he (the Holy Prophet) said to me: Observe two rak'ahs of prayer.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) par mera ek qarz tha; unhone mujhe wapas kiya aur ismein izafa bhi kiya. Main masjid mein daakhil hua aur unhone mujhse kaha: Do rakat namaz padho.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) bought a camel from me. When he came back to Medina, he ordered me to come to the mosque and observed two rak'ahs of prayer.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne mujhse ek oont khareeda. Jab woh Madina wapas aaye, to unhone mujhe masjid mein aane ka hukum diya aur do rakat namaz padhi.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported: I went with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on an expedition and my camel delayed me and I was exhausted. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) thus came earlier than I, whereas I came on the next day and went to the mosque and found him (the Holy Prophet) at the gate of the mosque. He said: It is now that you have come. I said. Yes. He said: Leave your camel and enter (the mosque) and observe two rak'ahs. He (the narrator) said: So I entered and observed (two rak'ahs) of prayer and then went back.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Main Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath ek muhim par gaya aur mera oont mujhe der kar gaya aur main thak gaya. Rasoolullah (SAW) mujhse pehle pahunch gaye, jabki main agle din pahuncha aur masjid gaya aur unhe masjid ke darwaze par paaya. Unhone kaha: Ab tum aaye ho? Maine kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha: Apna oont chhodo aur andar aao aur do rakat padho. Raawi ne kaha: To main andar gaya aur namaz padhi aur phir wapas chala gaya.

e: Ka'b b. Malik reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not come back from the journey but by day in the forenoon, and when he arrived, he went first to the mosque, and having prayed two rak'ahs in it he sat down in it.
hi: Ka'b bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) safar se din ke pehle hisse mein hi wapas aate the, aur jab woh pahunchte, to sabse pehle masjid jaate, aur usmein do rakat padhne ke baad usmein baith jaate.

e: 'Abdullah b. Shaqiq reported: I asked 'A'isha whether the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to observe the forenoon prayer. She said: No, but when he came back from the journey.
hi: Abdullah bin Shaqiq ne bayan kiya: Maine Aisha (RA) se poocha ki kya Rasoolullah (SAW) chaasht ki namaz padha karte the. Unhone kaha: Nahi, lekin jab woh safar se wapas aate to padhte.

e: 'Abdullah b. Shaqiq reported: I aksed 'A'isha whether the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to observe the forenoon prayer. She said: No, except when he came back from a journey.
hi: Abdullah bin Shaqiq ne bayan kiya: Maine Aisha (RA) se poocha ki kya Rasoolullah (SAW) chaasht ki namaz padha karte the. Unhone kaha: Nahi, siwaay jab woh safar se wapas aate.

e: 'Urwa reported 'A'isha to be sayidg: I have never seen the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observing the supererogatory prayer of the forenoon, but I observed it. And if the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) abandoned any act which he in fact loved to do, it was out of fear that if the people practised it constantly, it might become obligatory for them.
hi: Urwa ne bayan kiya ki Aisha (RA) ne kaha: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko kabhi chaasht ki nafil namaz padhte nahi dekha, lekin maine ise padha hai. Aur agar Rasoolullah (SAW) ne koi aisa amal chhoda jo unhe waaqai pasand tha, to ye is dar se tha ki agar log ise musalsal karte rahen, to ye unke liye farz ban jaaye.

e: Mu'adha asked 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) how many rak'ahs Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prayed at the forenoon prayer. She replied: Four rak'ahs, but sometimes more as he pleased.
hi: Mu'adha ne Aisha (RA) se poocha ki Rasoolullah (SAW) chaasht ki namaz mein kitni rakat padhte the. Unhone jawab diya: Char rakat, lekin kabhi kabhi jitni woh chahte usse zyada bhi.

e: A hadith like this has been reported by the same chain of transmitters, but with this alteration that the transmitter said: " As Allah pleased."
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees isi sanad se bayan ki gayi hai, lekin is tabdeeli ke saath ki raawi ne kaha: "Jitna Allah ne chaha."

e: Mua'ada 'Adawiyya reported 'A'isha as saying: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to observe four rak'ahs in the forenoon prayer and he sometimes observed more as Allah pleased.
hi: Mu'adha al-Adawiyya ne Aisha (RA) se ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Rasoolullah (SAW) chaasht ki namaz mein char rakat padha karte the aur kabhi kabhi jitna Allah ne chaha usse zyada bhi padhte.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated by Qatada with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Qatada ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: Abd al-Rahman b. Abu Laila reported: No one has ever narrated to me that he saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observing the forenoon prayer, except Umm Hani. She, however, narrated that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) entered her house on the day of the Conquest of Mecca and prayed eight rak'ahs (adding): I never saw a shorter prayer than it except that he performed the bowing and prostration completely. But (one of the narrators) Ibn Bashshar in his narration made no mention of the word:" Never".
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Laila ne bayan kiya: Kisi ne bhi mujhe kabhi ye nahi bataya ki unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) ko chaasht ki namaz padhte dekha ho, siwaay Umm Hani ke. Unhone, halaanki, ye bayan ki ki Rasoolullah (SAW) Makkah fatah ke din unke ghar aaye aur aath rakat padhi, aur izafa kiya: Maine kabhi isse mukhtasar namaz nahi dekhi siwaay is baat ke ki unhone ruku aur sajda mukammal taur par kiye. Lekin Ibn Bashshar, raawiyon mein se ek, ne apni riwayat mein "kabhi" lafz ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: 'Abdullah b. Harith b. Naufal reported: I had been asking about, as I was desirous to find one among people who should inform me, whether the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed the forenoon prayer, but I found none to narrate that to me except Umm Hani, daughter of Abu Talib (the real sister of Hadrat 'Ali), who told me that on the day of the Conquest the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came (to our house) after the dawn had (sufficiently) arisen. A cloth was brought and privacy was provided for him (the Holy Prophet). He took a bath and then stood up and observed eight rak'ahs. I do not know whether his Qiyam (standing posture) was longer, or bending or prostration or all of them were of equal duration. She (Umm Hani) further said: I never saw him saying this Nafl prayer prior to it or subsequently. (Al-Muradi narrated on the authority of Yunus that he made no mention of the words:" He informed me." )
hi: Abdullah bin Harith bin Naufal ne bayan kiya: Main ye poochta phir raha tha, kyunki main logon mein koi aisa dhoondhna chahta tha jo mujhe bata sake, ki kya Rasoolullah (SAW) chaasht ki namaz padha karte the, lekin mujhe koi bhi aisa nahi mila jo mujhe ye bata sake siwaay Umm Hani, Abu Talib ki beti, Hazrat Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki asal behn, ke, jinhone mujhe bataya ki fatah ke din Rasoolullah (SAW) hamare ghar aaye jab subah kaafi ho chuki thi. Ek kapda laaya gaya aur unke liye parda kiya gaya. Unhone ghusl kiya aur phir khade hokar aath rakat padhi. Mujhe nahi pata ki unka qiyaam lamba tha, ya ruku, ya sajda, ya sab barabar waqt ke the. Unhone aage kaha: Maine unhe kabhi ye nafil namaz uske pehle ya baad mein padhte nahi dekha. Al-Muradi ne Yunus ke hawale se riwayat ki ki unhone "Unhone mujhe bataya" alfaaz ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: Abu Murra, the freed slave of Umm Hani, daughter of Abu Talib, reported Umm Hani to be saying: I went to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the day of the Conquest of Mecca and found him taking a bath, and Fatimah, his daughter, had provided him privacy with the help of a cloth. I gave him salutation and he said: Who is she? I said: It is Umm Hani, daughter of Abu Talib. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Greeting for Umm Hani. When he had completed the bath, he stood up and observed eight rak'ahs wrapped up in one cloth. When he turned back (after the prayer), I said to him: Messenger of Allah, the son of my mother 'Ali b. Abu Talib is going to kill a person, Fulan b. Hubaira whom I have given protection. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: We too have given protection whom you have given protection, O Umm Hani. Umm Hani said: It was the forenoon (prayer).
hi: Abu Murra, Umm Hani, Abu Talib ki beti, ke aazad kiye hue ghulam, ne Umm Hani ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Main Makkah fatah ke din Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas gayi aur unhe ghusl karte paaya, aur unki beti Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ne ek kapde ki madad se unke liye parda kiya hua tha. Maine unhe salaam kiya aur unhone poocha: Ye kaun hai? Maine kaha: Ye Umm Hani hai, Abu Talib ki beti. Unhone kaha: Umm Hani ko khushamdeed. Jab unhone ghusl mukammal kiya, to woh khade hue aur ek hi kapde mein lipatkar aath rakat padhin. Jab woh namaz ke baad mude, to maine unse kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, mere maa ke bete Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ek shakhs, Fulan bin Hubaira, ko qatal karne ja rahe hain jise maine panah di hai. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Hum bhi usi ko panah dete hain jise tumne panah di hai, Aye Umm Hani. Umm Hani ne kaha: Ye chaasht ki namaz thi.

e: Abu Murra narrated on the authority of Umm Hani that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the day of the Conquest of Mecca observed in her house eight rak'ahs of prayer in one cloth, its opposite corners having been tied from the opposite sides.
hi: Abu Murra ne Umm Hani ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Makkah fatah ke din unke ghar mein aath rakat namaz ek hi kapde mein padhi, jiske dono kinaray, ulti taraf se, baandh diye gaye the.

e: Abu Dharr reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: In the morning charity is due from every bone in the body of every one of you. Every utterance of Allah's glorification is an act of charity. Every utterance of praise of Him is an act of charity, every utterance of profession of His Oneness is an act of charity, every utterance of profession of His Greatness is an act of charity, enjoining good is an act of charity, forbidding what is distreputable is an act of charity, and two rak'ahs which one prays in the forenoon will suffice.
hi: Abu Dharr (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Subah ke waqt tum mein se har ek ke jism ki har haddi jod par sadaqa farz hai. Allah ki tasbeeh ka har lafz sadaqa hai. Uski hamd ka har lafz sadaqa hai. Uski wahdaniyat ki gawaahi ka har lafz sadaqa hai. Uski takbeer ka har lafz sadaqa hai. Nekii ka hukum dena sadaqa hai. Buraai se rokna sadaqa hai, aur chaasht ki do rakat namaz jo koi padhta hai woh in sab ke liye kaafi hoti hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported. My friend (the Holy Prophet, may peace be upon him) has instructed me to do three things: three fasts during every month, two rak'ahs of the forenoon prayer, and observing Witr prayer before going to bed.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Mere dost, Nabi (SAW), ne mujhe teen cheezon ki hidayat di: har mahine teen roze, chaasht ki do rakat namaz, aur sone se pehle Witr ki namaz padhna.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated by Abu Huraira by another chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ne ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: My friend Abu'l-Qasim (ﷺ) instructed me to do three things, and the rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Mere dost Abu'l-Qasim (SAW) ne mujhe teen cheezon ki hidayat di, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Abu Murra, the freed slave of Umm Hani, narrated on the authority of Abu Darda': My Friend (ﷺ) instructed me in three (acts), and I would never abandon them as long as I live. (And these three things are): Three fasts during every month, the forenoon prayer, and this that I should not sleep till I have observed the Witr prayer.
hi: Abu Murra, Umm Hani ke aazad kiye hue ghulam, ne Abu Darda (RA) ke hawale se riwayat ki: Mere dost, Nabi (SAW), ne mujhe teen kaamon ki hidayat di, aur main jab tak zinda rahunga inhe kabhi nahi chhodunga. Aur ye teen cheezein ye hain: Har mahine teen roze, chaasht ki namaz, aur ye ki main tab tak na sooun jab tak Witr ki namaz na padh lun.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported that Hafsa, the Mother of the Believers, informed him that when the Mu'adhdhin became silent after calling (people) to the dawn prayer, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commenced the dawn (prayer) when it dawned by observing two short rak'ahs before the commencement of the (Fard) prayer.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Ummul-Momineen Hafsa (RA) ne unhe bataya ki jab muazzin fajr ki azaan dene ke baad khamosh ho jaata, to Rasoolullah (SAW) subah hote hi farz namaz shuru hone se pehle do chhoti rakat padha karte the.

e: This hadith has been transmitted by Nafi' with the same chain of narrators.
hi: Ye hadees Nafi' ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: Hafsa reported that when it was dawn, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not observe (any other prayers) but two short rak'ahs.
hi: Hafsa (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab subah hoti, to Rasoolullah (SAW) koi doosri namaz nahi padhte the siwaay do chhoti rakaton ke.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated by Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Shu'ba ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: Hafsa reported: When the dawn appeared, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed two rak'ahs (of Sunnah prayers).
hi: Hafsa (RA) ne bayan kiya: Jab subah numaayan hoti, to Rasoolullah (SAW) do rakat Sunnat namaz padhte the.

e: 'A'isha reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to observe two rak'ahs of Sunnah (prayer) when he heard the Adhin and shortened them.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) azaan sunte hi do rakat Sunnat namaz padhte the aur unhe mukhtasar rakhte the.

e: This hadith has been narrated by the same chain of transmitters and in the hadith narrated by Usama the words are: " When it was dawn".
hi: Ye hadees isi sanad se bayan ki gayi hai aur Usama ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: "Jab subah hoti."

e: 'A'isha reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to observe two (supererogatory) rak'ahs in between the call to prayer and the Iqama of the dawn prayer.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) fajr ki azaan aur iqaamat ke darmiyan do nafil rakat padha karte the.

e: 'A'isha reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed two rak'ahs of the dawn prayer and he shortened them (to the extent) that I (out of surprise) said: Did he recite in them Surah Fatiha (only)?
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) fajr ki do rakat padhte aur unhe itna mukhtasar rakhte ki main hairaani se kehti: Kya unhone inmein sirf Surah Fatiha hi padhi?

e: 'A'isha reported: When it was dawn, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed two rak'ahs, and I would say: Does he recite only the opening chapter of the Qur'an in it?
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Jab subah hoti, to Rasoolullah (SAW) do rakat padhte, aur main kehti: Kya woh ismein sirf Quran ka pehla surah hi padhte hain?

e: 'A'isha reported that the Apostle (ﷺ) was not so much particular about observing supererogatory rak'ahs as in case of the two rak'ahs of the dawn prayer.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasool (SAW) kisi bhi nafil rakat ke baare mein utni ehtiyaat nahi barete the jitni fajr ki do rakat ke maamle mein barte the.

e: 'A'isha reported: I have never seen the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) hastening as much in observing supererogatory as two rak'ahs before the (Fard) of the dawn prayer.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko kabhi kisi nafil namaz mein utni jaldi karte nahi dekha jitni fajr ki farz namaz se pehle wali do rakat mein karte dekha hai.

e: 'A'isha reported Allah's Messenger as saying: The two rak'ahs at dawn are better than this world and what it contains.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Fajr ki do rakat is duniya aur jo kuch ismein hai usse behtar hain.

e: 'A'isha reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said about the two (supererogatory) rak'ahs of the dawn: They are dearer to me than the whole world.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne fajr ki do nafil rakat ke baare mein farmaya: Woh mujhe poori duniya se zyada azeez hain.

e: Abu Huraira reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) recited in the two (supererogatory) rak'ahs of the dawn (prayer): " Say: O unbelievers," (Qur'an, cix.) and" Say: Allah is one" (cxii.).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) fajr ki do nafil rakat mein "Qul yaa ayyuhal kaafiroon" (109) aur "Qul huwallahu ahad" (112) padhte the.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to recite in first of the two (supererogatory) rak'ahs of the dawn: "Say: We believed in Allah and what was revealed to us..." verse 136 from Surah Baqara, and in the second of the two: "I believe in Allah and I bear testimony that we are Muslims" (iii. 52).
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) fajr ki do nafil rakaton mein se pehli mein "Qulu aamanna billahi wa maa unzila ilaina..." Surah Baqara ki aayat 136 padhte the, aur doosri mein: "Aamantu billahi washhadu bi-anna muslimoon" (3:52).

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to recite in the two (supererogatory) rak'ahs of the dawn prayer: " Say: We believed in Allah and what was revealed to us" and that which is found in Surah Al-i-'lmran:" Come to that word (creed) which is common between you and us" (iii. 64).
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) fajr ki do nafil rakaton mein "Qulu aamanna billahi wa maa unzila ilaina" padhte the, aur woh jo Surah Al-e-Imran mein hai: "Aao us baat, aqeeda, ki taraf jo tumhare aur hamare darmiyan mushtarak hai" (3:64).

e: This hadith has been transmitted by another chain of narrators.
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Umm Habiba (the wife of the Holy Prophet) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: A house will be built in Paradise, for anyone who prays in a day and a night twelve rak'ahs; and she added: I have never abandoned (observing them) since I heard it from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). Some of the other narrators said the same words: I have never abandoned (observing them) since I heard (from so and so).
hi: Umm Habiba, Nabi ki zauja, ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Jo koi ek din aur raat mein baarah rakat namaz padhe, uske liye Jannat mein ek ghar banaya jayega; aur unhone izafa kiya: Maine ye jab se Rasoolullah (SAW) se suna hai, kabhi nahi chhoda. Kuch doosre raawiyon ne bhi yehi alfaaz kahe: Maine ye jab se suna hai, kabhi nahi chhoda.

e: Nu'man b. Salim reported with the same chain of transmitters: He who observed twelve voluntary rak'ahs, a house will be built for him in Paradise.
hi: Nu'man bin Salim ne isi sanad se riwayat ki: Jo koi baarah nafil rakat padhe, uske liye Jannat mein ek ghar banaya jayega.

e: Umm Habiba, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If any Muslim servant (of Allah) prays for the sake of Allah twelve rak'ahs (of Sunan) every day, over and above the obligatory ones, Allah will build for him a house in Paradise, or a house will be built for him in Paradise; and I have not abandoned observing them after (hearing it from the Messenger of Allah). (So said also 'Amr and Nu'man.)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ki zauja Umm Habiba (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Agar koi bhi Musalman banda Allah ki khaatir har din baarah rakat Sunan padhe, farz namazon ke ilawa, to Allah uske liye Jannat mein ek ghar banayega, ya uske liye Jannat mein ek ghar banaya jayega; aur maine, ye Rasoolullah (SAW) se sunne ke baad, inhe kabhi chhoda nahi hai. Aisa hi Amr aur Nu'man ne bhi kaha.

e: Umm Habiba reported the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) having said: If any Muslim servant (of Allah) performed ablution, and performed it well, and then observed every day, the rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Umm Habiba ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Agar koi bhi Musalman banda wuzu kare, aur ise achhi tarah kare, aur phir har din padhe, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported: I prayed along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) two rak'ahs before and two rak'ahs after the noon prayer, two rak'ahs after the sunset prayer and two rak'ahs after the 'Isha' prayer and two rak'ahs after the Friday prayer; and so far as the sunset, 'Isha' and Friday prayers are concerned, I observed (them) along with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in his house.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath zohar se pehle do rakat aur baad mein do rakat, maghrib ke baad do rakat aur isha ke baad do rakat, aur jumma ke baad do rakat padhi; aur jahan tak maghrib, isha aur jumma ki namazon ka sawal hai, maine unhe Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath unke ghar mein padha.

e: 'Abdullah b. Shaqiq said: I asked 'A'isha about the Messenger of Allah's (ﷺ) voluntary prayers, and she replied: Before the noon prayer, he used to pray four rak'ahs in my house; then would go out and lead the people in prayer; then come in and pray two rak'ahs. He would then lead the people in the sunset prayer; then come in and pray two rak'ahs. Then he would lead the people in the 'Isha' prayer, and enter my house and pray two rak'ahs. He would pray nine rak'ahs during the night, including Witr. At night he would pray for a long time standing and for a long time sitting, and when he recited the Holy Qur'an while standing, he would bow and prostrate himself from the standing position, and when he recited while sitting, he would bow and prostrate himself from the sitting position, and when it was dawn he would pray two rak'ahs.
hi: Abdullah bin Shaqiq ne kaha: Maine Aisha (RA) se Rasoolullah (SAW) ki nafil namazon ke baare mein poocha, aur unhone jawab diya: Zohar se pehle, woh mere ghar mein char rakat padhte the; phir bahar jaate aur logon ko namaz padhate; phir andar aakar do rakat padhte. Phir woh logon ko maghrib ki namaz padhate; phir andar aakar do rakat padhte. Phir woh logon ko isha ki namaz padhate, aur mere ghar mein daakhil hokar do rakat padhte. Woh raat ko nau rakat padhte the, jinmein Witr shaamil hai. Raat ko woh lambe waqt tak khade hokar aur lambe waqt tak baithkar namaz padhte, aur jab woh khade hokar Quran padhte, to woh khade hone ki halat se hi ruku aur sajda karte, aur jab woh baithkar padhte, to woh baithne ki halat se hi ruku aur sajda karte, aur jab subah hoti to woh do rakat padhte.

e: 'A'isha reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would pray in the night for a long time, and when he prayed standing be bowed in a standing posture, and when he prayed sitting, he bowed in a sitting posture.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) raat ko lambe waqt tak namaz padhte the, aur jab woh khade hokar namaz padhte to khade hone ki halat mein hi ruku karte, aur jab woh baithkar namaz padhte to baithne ki halat mein hi ruku karte.

e: 'Abdullah b. Shaqiq reported: I fell ill in Persia and therefore, prayed in a sitting posture, and I asked 'A'isha about it and she said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prayed for a long time in the night sitting.
hi: Abdullah bin Shaqiq ne bayan kiya: Main Fars mein beemar pad gaya aur is liye baithkar namaz padhi, aur maine iske baare mein Aisha (RA) se poocha aur unhone kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) raat ko lambe waqt tak baithkar namaz padhte the.

e: 'Abdullah b. Shaqiq al-'Uqaili reported: I asked 'A'isha about the prayer of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) during the night (i. e. Tahajjud prayer) She replied: He used to pray for a long time standing and for a long time sitting in the night, and when he recited the Qur'an while standing, he would bow himself from the standing position, and when he recited while sitting, he would bow from the sitting position.
hi: Abdullah bin Shaqiq al-Uqaili ne bayan kiya: Maine Aisha (RA) se Rasoolullah (SAW) ki raat ki namaz, yaani Tahajjud, ke baare mein poocha. Unhone jawab diya: Woh raat ko lambe waqt tak khade hokar aur lambe waqt tak baithkar namaz padhte the, aur jab woh khade hokar Quran padhte, to woh khade hone ki halat se hi ruku karte, aur jab woh baithkar padhte, to woh baithne ki halat se hi ruku karte.

e: 'Abdullah b. Shaqiq al-'Uqaili reported: I asked 'A'isha about the prayer of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). She said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would observe prayer (Nafl) in a standing position as well as in a sitting position, and when he commenced the prayer in a standing position, he bowed in this very position, and when he commenced the prayer in a sitting position, he bowed in this very position.
hi: Abdullah bin Shaqiq al-Uqaili ne bayan kiya: Maine Aisha (RA) se Rasoolullah (SAW) ki namaz ke baare mein poocha. Unhone kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) namaz, nafil, khade hokar bhi padhte the aur baithkar bhi, aur jab woh namaz khade hone ki halat mein shuru karte, to woh isi halat mein ruku karte, aur jab woh namaz baithne ki halat mein shuru karte, to woh isi halat mein ruku karte.

e: 'A'isha reported: I did not see the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) reciting (the Qur'an) in the night prayer in a sitting position, till he grew old and then he recited (it) in a sitting position, but when thirty or forty verses were left out of the Surah, he would then stand up, recite them and then bowed.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko raat ki namaz mein baithkar Quran padhte nahi dekha, jab tak woh boodhe nahi ho gaye aur phir woh baithkar ise padhte, lekin jab surah ke tees ya chalis aayaten baaki reh jaatin, to woh khade hokar unhe padhte aur phir ruku karte.

e: 'A'isha reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to pray while sitting (when he grew old) and he recited in this position and when the recitation equal to thirty or forty verses was left, he would then stand up and recite (for this duration) in a standing position and then bowed himself and then prostrated himself and did the same in the second rak'ah.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) baithkar namaz padha karte the, jab woh boodhe ho gaye, aur woh is halat mein padhte aur jab tees ya chalis aayaton ke barabar tilawat baaki rehti, to woh khade hokar khade hone ki halat mein us waqt ke liye padhte aur phir ruku karte aur phir sajda karte aur doosri rakat mein bhi yehi karte.

e: 'A'isha reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to recite in sitting position (while observing the Tahajjud prayer) and when he intended to bow, he would stand up and recite (for the duration in which) a man (ordinarily) recites forty verses.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) baithkar padha karte the, Tahajjud ki namaz mein, aur jab woh ruku karna chahte, to woh khade hote aur itni der ke liye padhte jitni der mein koi aadmi aam taur par chalis aayaten padhta hai.

e: Alqama b. Waqqas reported: I asked 'A'isha how the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did in the two rak'ahs as he (observed them) sitting. She said: He would recite (the Qur'an) in them, and when he intended to bow, he would stand up and then bowed.
hi: Alqama bin Waqqas ne bayan kiya: Maine Aisha (RA) se poocha ki Rasoolullah (SAW) un do rakaton mein kya karte the jinhe woh baithkar padha karte the. Unhone kaha: Woh unmein Quran padhte, aur jab woh ruku karna chahte, to woh khade hote aur phir ruku karte.

e: 'Abdullah b. Shaqiq reported: I asked 'A'isha whether the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed (Nafl) sitting. She said: Yes, when the people had made him old.
hi: Abdullah bin Shaqiq ne bayan kiya: Maine Aisha (RA) se poocha ki kya Rasoolullah (SAW) baithkar nafil namaz padhte the. Unhone kaha: Haan, jab logon ne unhe boodha kar diya.

e: 'Abdullah b. Shaqiq reported: I said to 'A'isha and she made a mention of that (recorded above) about the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).
hi: Abdullah bin Shaqiq ne bayan kiya: Maine Aisha (RA) se kaha aur unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) ke baare mein upar bayan hui baat ka zikr kiya.

e: 'A'isha reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) died (in this very state) that he observed most of his (Nafl) prayers in a sitting position.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ki wafat isi haal mein hui ki woh zyadatar apni nafil namazein baithkar padhte the.

e: 'A'isha reported: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) grew bulky and heavy he would observe (most of his Nafl) prayers sitting.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Jab Rasoolullah (SAW) mote aur bhaari ho gaye, to woh zyadatar apni nafil namazein baithkar padhne lage.

e: Hafsa reported: Never did I see the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observing supererogatory prayer sitting till one year before his death when he would observe Nafl prayer in a sitting position, and he would recite the Surah (of the Qur'an) in such a slow-measured tone (that duration of its recital) became more lengthy than the one longer than this.
hi: Hafsa (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko kabhi baithkar nafil namaz padhte nahi dekha, unki wafat se ek saal pehle tak, jab woh baithkar nafil namaz padhne lage, aur woh Surah, Quran ki, itni dheemi aur naapi-tuli aawaaz mein padhte ki uski tilawat ka waqt us surah se bhi zyada lamba ho jaata jo usse lambi hoti.

e: Zuhri reported this hadith with the same chain of transmitters, except this that he made a mention of one year or two years.
hi: Zuhri ne ye hadees isi sanad se bayan ki hai, siwaay is baat ke ki unhone ek saal ya do saal ka zikr kiya.

e: Jabir b. Samura reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed (Nafl) prayer sitting before his death.
hi: Jabir bin Samura (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne apni wafat se pehle nafil namaz baithkar padhi.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Amr reported: It was narrated to me that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had said: The prayer observed by a person sitting is half of the prayer. I came to him (ﷺ) and found him praying in a sitting position. I placed my hand on his head. He said: O 'Abdullah b. 'Amr, what is the matter with you? I said: Messenger of Allah, it has been narrated to me that you said: The prayer of a man in a sitting position is half of the prayer, whereas you are observing prayer sitting. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Yes, it is so, but I am not like anyone amongst you.
hi: Abdullah bin Amr (RA) ne bayan kiya: Mujhe bataya gaya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya tha: Baithkar padhi gayi namaz aadhi namaz ke barabar hai. Main unke paas aaya aur unhe baithkar namaz padhte paaya. Maine apna haath unke sar par rakha. Unhone kaha: Aye Abdullah bin Amr, kya baat hai? Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, mujhe bataya gaya hai ki aapne farmaya tha ki baithkar padhi gayi namaz aadhi namaz ke barabar hai, jabki aap baithkar namaz padh rahe hain. Unhone kaha: Haan, ye sahi hai, lekin main tum mein se kisi ke jaisa nahi hoon.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated by Abu Yahya al-A'raj with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Abu Yahya al-A'raj ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: 'A'isha reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to pray eleven rak'ahs at night, observing the Witr with a single rak'ah, and when he had finished them, he lay down on his right side, till the Mu'adhdhin came to him and he (the Holy Prophet) then observed two short rak'ahs (of Sunan of the dawn prayer).
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) raat ko gyarah rakat namaz padha karte the, Witr ek rakat ke saath padhte, aur jab woh inhe mukammal kar lete, to woh apni daayi karvat let jaate, yahan tak ki muazzin unke paas aata aur woh phir do chhoti rakat, fajr ki sunnat, padhte.

e: 'A'isha, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), said that between the time when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) finished the 'Isha' prayer which is called 'Atama by the people, he used to pray eleven rak'ahs, uttering the salutation at the end of every two rak'ahs, and observing the Witr with a single one. And when the Mu'adhdhin had finished the call (for the) dawn prayer and he saw the dawn clearly and the Mu'adhdhin had come to him, he stood up and prayed two short rak'ahs. Then he lay down on his right side till the Mu'adhdhin came to him for lqama. (This hadith has been narrated with the same chain of transmitters by Ibn Shihab, but in it no mention has been made of Iqama )
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ki zauja Aisha (RA) ne kaha ki jab se Rasoolullah (SAW) isha ki namaz, jise log "Atama" kehte hain, mukammal karte, woh gyarah rakat padha karte the, har do rakat ke akhir mein salaam pheerte, aur ek rakat se Witr ada karte. Aur jab muazzin fajr ki azaan mukammal kar leta aur unhe subah saaf dikhayi deti aur muazzin unke paas aa jaata, to woh khade hokar do chhoti rakat padhte. Phir woh apni daayi karvat let jaate yahan tak ki muazzin iqaamat ke liye unke paas aata. Ye hadees Ibn Shihab ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai, lekin ismein iqaamat ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: 'A'isha reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to observe thirteen rak'ahs of the night prayer. Five out of them consisted of Witr, and he did not sit, but at the end (for salutation).
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) raat ki namaz mein terah rakat padha karte the. Unmein se paanch Witr thin, aur woh unmein beech mein nahi baithte the, siwaay akhir mein salaam ke liye.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Hisham with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Hisham ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: 'A'isha reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to pray thirteen rak'ahs during the night including the two rak'ahs (Sunan) of the dawn prayer.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) raat ko terah rakat namaz padhte the, jinmein fajr ki do Sunnat rakaten shaamil thin.

e: Abu Salama b. Abd al-Rahman asked 'A'isha about the (night) prayer of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) during the month of Ramadan. She said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not observe either in Ramadan or in other months more than eleven rak'ahs (of the night prayer). He (in the first instance) observed four rak'ahs. Ask not about their excellence and their length (i. e. these were matchless in perfection and length). He again observed four rak'ahs, and ask not about their excellence and their length. He would then observe three rak'ahs (of the Witr prayer). 'A'isha again said: I said: Messenger of Allah, do you sleep before observing the Witr prayer? He said: O 'A'isha, my eyes sleep but my heart does not sleep.
hi: Abu Salama bin Abdur-Rahman ne Aisha (RA) se Ramzan mein Rasoolullah (SAW) ki raat ki namaz ke baare mein poocha. Unhone kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) na Ramzan mein aur na hi doosre mahinon mein gyarah rakat se zyada raat ki namaz padhte the. Unhone pehle char rakat padhi. Unki khoobsurati aur lambaai ke baare mein mat poochho, yaani ye kamaal aur lambaai mein bemisaal thin. Unhone phir char rakat padhi, aur unki khoobsurati aur lambaai ke baare mein mat poochho. Phir woh teen rakat, Witr ki namaz, padhte. Aisha ne phir kaha: Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, kya aap Witr ki namaz padhne se pehle sote hain? Unhone kaha: Aye Aisha, meri aankhein sotin hain lekin mera dil nahi sota.

e: Abu Salama asked 'A'isha about the prayer of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) She said: He observed thirteen rak'ahs (in the night prayer). He observed eight rak'ahs and would then observe Witr and then observe two rak'ahs sitting, and when he wanted to bow he stood up and then bowed down, and then observed two rak'ahs in between the Adhan and lqama of the dawn prayer.
hi: Abu Salama ne Aisha (RA) se Rasoolullah (SAW) ki namaz ke baare mein poocha. Unhone kaha: Woh raat ki namaz mein terah rakat padhte the. Woh aath rakat padhte aur phir Witr padhte aur phir baithkar do rakat padhte, aur jab woh ruku karna chahte to khade hote aur phir ruku karte, aur phir fajr ki azaan aur iqaamat ke darmiyan do rakat padhte.

e: Abu Salama reported that he asked 'A'isha about the prayer of the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) (during the night). The rest of the hadith is the same but with this exception that he (the Holy Prophet) observed nine rak'ahs including Witr.
hi: Abu Salama ne bayan kiya ki unhone Aisha (RA) se Rasoolullah (SAW) ki raat ki namaz ke baare mein poocha. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai, lekin is farq ke saath ki unhone Witr samet nau rakat padhi.

e: Abu Salama is reported to have said. I came to 'A'isha. I said: O mother, inform me about the prayer of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). She said: His (night prayer) in Ramadan and (during other months) was thirteen rak'ahs at night including two rak'ahs of fajr.
hi: Abu Salama ne bayan kiya: Main Aisha (RA) ke paas aaya. Maine kaha: Aye Ammi Jaan, mujhe Rasoolullah (SAW) ki namaz ke baare mein bataiye. Unhone kaha: Unki raat ki namaz Ramzan aur doosre mahinon mein raat ko terah rakat hoti thi, jinmein fajr ki do rakat shaamil thin.

e: It is reported on the authority of 'A'isha that the prayer of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the night consisted of ten rak'ahs. He observed a Witr and two rak'ahs (of Sunan) of the dawn prayer, and thus the total comes to thirteen rak'ahs.
hi: Aisha (RA) ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ki raat ki namaz das rakat ki hoti thi. Woh ek Witr aur fajr ki do Sunan rakat padhte, aur is tarah kul terah rakat ban jaati thin.

e: 'A'isha thus reported about the (night prayer) of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): He used to sleep in the early part of the night, and woke up in the latter part. If he then wished intercourse with his wife, he satisfied his desire, and then went to sleep; and when the first call to prayer was made he jumped up (by Allah, she, i. e. 'A'isha, did not say" he stood up" ), and poured water over him (by Allah she, i. e. 'A'isha, did not say that he took a bath but I know what she meant) and if he did not have an intercourse, he performed ablution, just as a man performs ablution for prayer and then observed two rak'ahs.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ki raat ki namaz ke baare mein yun bayan kiya: Woh raat ke pehle hisse mein sote the, aur aakhri hisse mein jaagte the. Agar phir unki apni zauja se sohbat karne ki khwahish hoti, to woh apni khwahish poori karte, aur phir sone chale jaate; aur jab pehli azaan hoti to woh chaunk kar uth khade hote (Allah ki qasam, unhone, yaani Aisha ne, "woh khade hote" nahi kaha), aur apne badan par paani daalte (Allah ki qasam, unhone ye nahi kaha ki unhone ghusl kiya, lekin mujhe pata hai unka kya matlab tha), aur agar unhone sohbat na ki hoti, to woh waise hi wuzu karte jaise koi shakhs namaz ke liye wuzu karta hai aur phir do rakat padhte.

e: 'A'isha observed that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to observe prayer in the night and the last of his (night) prayer was Witr.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) raat ko namaz padha karte the aur unki raat ki aakhri namaz Witr hoti thi.

e: Masruq is reported to have asked 'A'isha about the action (most pleasing to) the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). She said: He (the Holy Prophet) loved (that action) which one keeps on doing regularly. I said (to 'A'isha): When did he pray (at night)? She replied: When he heard the cock crow, he got up and observed prayer.
hi: Masruq ne, ye kaha jaata hai, Aisha (RA) se Rasoolullah (SAW) ke sabse zyada pasandeeda amal ke baare mein poocha. Unhone kaha: Woh us amal ko pasand karte the jise koi musalsal karta rahe. Maine poocha: Woh raat ko kab namaz padhte the? Unhone jawab diya: Jab woh murgh ki bang sunte, to woh uthte aur namaz padhte.

e: 'A'isha reported: Never did the earlier part of the dawn find the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) but sleeping in my house or near me.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Subah ka pehla hissa Rasoolullah (SAW) ko kabhi bhi mere ghar mein ya mere paas sote hue paane ke siwaay nahi milta tha.

e: 'A'isha reported: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had prayed the two rak'ahs (Sunan) of the dawn prayer, he would talk to me if I was awake, otherwise he would lie down.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Jab Rasoolullah (SAW) fajr ki do Sunan rakat padh lete, to woh mujhse baat karte agar main jaag rahi hoti, warna woh let jaate.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated by 'A'isha by another chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Aisha (RA) ne ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki hai.

e: 'A'isha reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to pray in the night and when he observed Witr, he said to me: O 'A'isha, get up and observe Witr.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) raat ko namaz padha karte the aur jab woh Witr padhte, to mujhse kehte: Aye Aisha, utho aur Witr padho.

e: 'A'isha reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to offer prayer at night while she lay in front of him, and when the Witr prayer was yet to be observed, he would awaken her and she observed Witr.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) raat ko namaz padha karte the jabki woh unke saamne leti hoti thi, aur jab Witr ki namaz padhna baaki hoti, to woh use jagate aur woh Witr padhti.

e: 'A'isha reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed the Witr prayer every night and he completed Witr at the time of dawn.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) har raat Witr ki namaz padhte the aur woh apna Witr fajr ke waqt tak mukammal karte.

e: Masruq reported on the authority of 'A'isha that she said that the Messenger Of Allah (ﷺ) used to observe the Witr prayer every night, maybe in the early part of night, at midnight and in the latter part, finishing his Witr at dawn.
hi: Masruq ne Aisha (RA) ke hawale se riwayat ki ki unhone kaha ki Rasoolullah (SAW) har raat Witr ki namaz padha karte the, kabhi raat ke pehle hisse mein, kabhi aadhi raat mein, aur kabhi aakhri hisse mein, apna Witr subah tak mukammal karte hue.

e: 'A'isha reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to observe Witr every night, and he would (at times) complete his Witr at the end of the night.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) har raat Witr padha karte the, aur woh kabhi kabhi apna Witr raat ke akhir mein mukammal karte.

e:
Sa'd b. Hisham b. 'Amir decided to participate in the expedition for the sake of Allah, so he came to Medina and he decided to dispose of his property there and buy arms and horses instead and fight against the Romans to the end of his life. When he came to Medina, he met the people of Medina. They dissuaded him to do such a thing, and informed him that a group of six men had decided to do so during the lifetime of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade them to do it, and said: Is there not for you a model pattern in me? And when they narrated this to him (Sa'd b. Hisham), he returned to his wife, though he had divorced her and made (people) witness to his reconciliation. He then came to Ibn 'Abbas and asked him about the Witr of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). Ibn 'Abbas said: Should I not lead you to one who knows best amongst the people of the world about the Witr of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)? He said: Who is it? He (Ibn 'Abbas) said: It is 'A'isha. So go to her and ask her (about Witr) and then come to me and inform me about her answer that she would give you. So I came to Hakim b. Aflah and requested him to take me to her. He said: I would not go to her, for I forbade her to speak anything (about the conflict) between the two groupS, but she refused (to accept my advice) and went (to participate in that corflict). I (requested) him (Hakim) with an oath to lead me to her. So we went to 'A'isha and we begged permission to meet her. She granted us permission and we went in. She said: Are you Hakim? (She recognised him.) He replied: Yes. She said: Who is there with you? He said: He is Sa'd b. Hisham. She said: Which Hisham? He said: He is Hisham b. 'Amir. She blessed him ('Amir) with mercy from Allah and spoke good of him (Qatada said that he died as a martyr in Uhud). I said: Mother of the Faithful, tell me about the character of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). She said: Don't you read the Qur'an? I said: Yes. Upon this she said: The character of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was the Qur'an. He said: I felt inclined to get up and not ask anything (further) till death. But then I changed my mind and said: Inform me about the observance (of the night prayer) of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). She said: Did you not recite:" O thou wrapped up"? He said: Yes. She said: Allah, the Exalted and the Glorious, made the observance of the night prayer at the beginning of this Surah obligatory. 
So the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him and his Companions around him observed this (night prayer) for one year. Allah held back the concluding portion of this Surah for twelve months in the Heaven till (at the end of this period) Allah revealed the concluding verses of this Surah which lightened (the burden of this prayer), and the night prayer became a supererogatory prayer after being an obligatory one. I said: Mother of the Faithful, inform me about the Witr of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). She said: I used to prepare tooth stick for him and water for his ablution, and Allah would rouse him to the extent He wished during the night. He would use the tooth stick, and perform ablution, and would offer nine rak'ahs, and would not sit but in the eighth one and would remember Allah, and praise Him and supplicate Him, then he would get up without uttering the salutation and pray the ninth rak'ah. He would then sit, remember, praise Him and supplicate Him and then utter a salutation loud enough for us to hear. He would then pray two rak'ahs sitting after uttering the salutation, and that made eleven rak'ahs. O my son, but when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) grew old and put on flesh, he observed Witr of seven, doing in the two rak'ahs as he had done formerly, and that made nine. O my son, and when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed prayer, he liked to keep on observing it, and when sleep or pain overpowered him and made it impossible (for him) to observe prayer in the night, he prayed twelve rak'ahs daring the day. I am not aware of Allah's Prophet (ﷺ) having recited the whole Qur'an during one single night, or praying through the night till morning, or fasting a complete month, except Ramadan. He (the narrator) said: I then went to Ibn 'Abbas and narrated to him the hadith (transmitted from her), and he said: She says the truth If I went to her and got into her presence, I would have listened to it orally from her. He said: If I were to know that you do not go to her. I would not have transmitted this hadith to you narrated by her.
hi: Sa'd bin Hisham bin Amir ne Allah ki khaatir jung mein shaamil hone ka faisla kiya, is liye woh Madina aaye aur unhone wahan apni maal bech kar iske badle hathiyaar aur ghode khareedne aur apni zindagi ke akhir tak Romiyon ke khilaaf ladne ka faisla kiya. Jab woh Madina pahunche, to unki mulaqaat Madina ke logon se hui. Unhone unhe aisa karne se roka, aur unhe bataya ki chhe logon ke ek giroh ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ke daur mein aisa hi karne ka faisla kiya tha aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unhe aisa karne se mana kiya, aur farmaya: Kya tumhare liye mujhme koi behtareen namoona nahi hai? Aur jab unhone Sa'd bin Hisham ko ye bataya, to woh apni biwi ke paas laut aaye, halaanki unhone use talaaq de di thi, aur logon ko apni sulah ka gawaah banaya. Woh phir Ibn Abbas ke paas aaye aur unse Rasoolullah (SAW) ke Witr ke baare mein poocha. Ibn Abbas ne kaha: Kya main tumhe us shakhs ke paas na le jaun jo duniya ke logon mein Rasoolullah (SAW) ke Witr ke baare mein sabse zyada jaanta hai? Unhone kaha: Woh kaun hain? Unhone kaha: Woh Aisha hain. To unke paas jao aur unse Witr ke baare mein poocho aur phir mere paas aakar mujhe unka jawab bataana. To main Hakim bin Aflah ke paas aaya aur unse guzarish ki ki woh mujhe unke paas le jaayein. Unhone kaha: Main unke paas nahi jaunga, kyunki maine unhe do giroahon ke darmiyan jhagde ke baare mein kuch bhi bolne se mana kiya tha, lekin unhone mera mashwara maanne se inkaar kiya aur us jhagde mein shaamil hone chali gayin. Maine unse qasam khila kar guzarish ki ki woh mujhe unke paas le jaayein. To hum Aisha (RA) ke paas gaye aur humne unse milne ki ijazat maangi. Unhone humein ijazat de di aur hum andar gaye. Unhone kaha: Kya tum Hakim ho? Unhone jawab diya: Haan. Unhone kaha: Tumhare saath kaun hai? Unhone kaha: Ye Sa'd bin Hisham hain. Unhone kaha: Kaunse Hisham? Unhone kaha: Woh Hisham bin Amir hain. Unhone unke liye Allah ki rahmat ki dua ki aur unke baare mein achhi baat kahi. Qatada ne kaha ki woh Uhud mein shaheed hue the. Maine kaha: Aye Ummul-Momineen, mujhe Rasoolullah (SAW) ke akhlaaq ke baare mein bataiye. Unhone kaha: Kya tum Quran nahi padhte? Maine kaha: Haan. Isper unhone kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) ka akhlaaq Quran hi tha. Unhone kaha: Mera dil chaha ki main khada ho jaun aur maut tak kuch bhi na poochun. Lekin phir maine apna irada badal diya aur kaha: Mujhe Rasoolullah (SAW) ki raat ki namaz ki paabandi ke baare mein bataiye. Unhone kaha: Kya tumne "Ya ayyuhal muzzammil" (73:1) nahi padhi? Unhone kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha: Allah Ta'ala ne is Surah ki shuruaat mein raat ki namaz ki paabandi ko farz kar diya tha. To Rasoolullah (SAW) aur unke sahaba, jo unke aas-paas the, ne ise ek saal tak paaband kiya. Allah ne is Surah ke aakhri hisse ko baarah mahinon tak aasmaan mein rok kar rakha yahan tak ki is arse ke aakhir mein Allah ne is Surah ki aakhri aayaten nazil ki jinhone is namaz ka bojh halka kar diya, aur raat ki namaz farz hone ke baad nafil namaz ban gayi. Maine kaha: Aye Ummul-Momineen, mujhe Rasoolullah (SAW) ke Witr ke baare mein bataiye. Unhone kaha: Main unke liye miswak aur wuzu ka paani taiyaar kiya karti thi, aur Allah unhe raat mein jitna chahta jagata.
