Woh miswak istemal karte, aur wuzu karte, aur nau rakat padhte, aur woh sirf aathwin mein baithte aur Allah ko yaad karte, uski tareef karte aur uska istighfaar karte, phir woh salaam pheere bagair khade ho jaate aur nauvin rakat padhte. Phir woh baithte, Allah ko yaad karte, uski tareef karte aur uska istighfaar karte aur phir itni zor se salaam pheerte ki hum sun sakein. Phir salaam pheerne ke baad woh baithkar do rakat padhte, aur is tarah kul gyarah rakat ban jaatin. Aye mere bete, lekin jab Rasoolullah (SAW) boodhe ho gaye aur unka jism bhaari ho gaya, to unhone saat rakat Witr padhi, jaise pehle do rakaton mein karte the, waise hi kiya, aur is tarah kul nau ban jaati thin. Aye mere bete, aur jab Rasoolullah (SAW) koi namaz padhte, to unhe use musalsal karna pasand tha, aur jab neend ya taklif unpar itni haawi ho jaati ki raat ki namaz padhna namumkin ho jaata, to woh din mein baarah rakat padhte. Mujhe nahi maloom ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kabhi ek hi raat mein poora Quran padha ho, ya poori raat subah tak namaz padhi ho, ya Ramzan ke ilawa poore ek mahine ke roze rakhe hon. Raawi ne kaha: Phir main Ibn Abbas ke paas gaya aur unhe ye hadees, jo Aisha se riwayat hui, sunayi, aur unhone kaha: Woh sach kehti hain. Agar main khud unke paas jaata aur unke saamne hota, to main ye seedhe unse sunta. Unhone kaha: Agar mujhe pata hota ki tum unke paas nahi jaate, to main tumhe ye hadees unse riwayat karke na sunaata.

e: Zurara b. Aufa said that Sa'd b. Hisham divorced his wife, and then proceeded to Medina to sell his property, and the rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Zurara bin Aufa ne kaha ki Sa'd bin Hisham ne apni biwi ko talaaq di, aur phir apni maal bechne Madina gaye, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Sa'd b. Hisham reported: I went to 'Abdullah b. 'Abbas and asked him about the Witr prayer, and the rest of the hadith is the same as recorded in this event. She (Hadrat 'A'isha) said: Who is that Hisham? I said: Son of 'Amir. She said: What a fine man 'Amir was! He died as a martyr in the Battle of Uhud.
hi: Sa'd bin Hisham ne bayan kiya: Main Abdullah bin Abbas (RA) ke paas gaya aur unse Witr ki namaz ke baare mein poocha, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai jaisa is waaqiye mein darj hai. Unhone, Hazrat Aisha ne, kaha: Ye Hisham kaun hain? Maine kaha: Amir ke bete. Unhone kaha: Amir kitne achhe aadmi the! Woh Uhud ki jung mein shaheed hue.

e: Zurara b. Aufa reported that Sa'd b. Hisham was his neighbour and he informed him that he had divorced his wife and he narrated the hadith like the one transmitted by Sa'd. She ('A'isha) said: Who is Hisham? He said: The son of 'Amir. She said: What a fine man he was; he participated in the Battle of Uhud along with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). Hakim b. Aflah said: If I ever knew that you do not go to 'A'isha, I would not have informed you about her hadith (So that you would have gone to her and heard it from her orally).
hi: Zurara bin Aufa ne bayan kiya ki Sa'd bin Hisham unke padosi the aur unhone unhe bataya ki unhone apni biwi ko talaaq de di thi aur unhone Sa'd ki bayan ki hui hadees jaisi hi hadees bayan ki. Unhone, Aisha ne, kaha: Hisham kaun hain? Unhone kaha: Amir ke bete. Unhone kaha: Woh kitne achhe aadmi the; unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath Uhud ki jung mein hissa liya. Hakim bin Aflah ne kaha: Agar mujhe kabhi pata chalta ki tum Aisha ke paas nahi jaate, to main tumhe unki hadees ke baare mein nahi bataata, taaki tum khud unke paas jaakar seedhe unse sunte.

e: 'A'isha reported that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) missed the night prayer due to pain or any other reason, he observed twelve rak'ahs during the daytime.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab Rasoolullah (SAW) taklif ya kisi aur wajah se raat ki namaz chhod dete, to woh din mein baarah rakat padhte.

e: 'A'isha reported that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) decided upon doing any act, he continued to do it, and when he slept at night or fell sick he observed twelve rak'ahs during the daytime. I am not aware of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) observing prayer during the whole of the night till morning, or observing fast for a whole month continuously except that of Ramadan.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab Rasoolullah (SAW) koi kaam karne ka faisla karte, to woh use karte rehte, aur jab woh raat ko so jaate ya beemar pad jaate, to woh din mein baarah rakat padhte. Mujhe nahi maloom ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kabhi poori raat subah tak namaz padhi ho, ya Ramzan ke siwaay poore ek mahine musalsal roze rakhe hon.

e: 'Umar b. Khattab reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Should anyone fall asleep and fail to recite his portion of the Qur'an, or a part of it, if he recites it between the dawn prayer and the noon prayer, it will be recorded for him as though he had recited it during the night.
hi: Umar bin Khattab (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Agar koi so jaaye aur apna Quran ka muqarrar hissa, ya uska koi hissa, padhna bhool jaaye, to agar woh use fajr ki namaz aur zohar ki namaz ke darmiyan padh le, to ye uske liye aise likha jayega jaise usne ise raat ko padha ho.

e: Zaid b. Arqam, on seeing some people praying in the forenoon, said: They well know that prayer at another time than this is more excellent, for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The prayer of those who are penitent is observed when your weaned camels feel the heat of the sun.
hi: Zaid bin Arqam (RA) ne kuch logon ko chaasht mein namaz padhte dekha to kaha: Unhe achhi tarah pata hai ki is waqt ke ilawa doosre waqt mein namaz padhna zyada behtar hai, kyunki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Tauba karne walon ki namaz tab padhi jaati hai jab tumhare doodh chhude hue oont ke bachche suraj ki garmi mahsoos karte hain.

e: Zaid b. Arqam reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went out to the people of Quba' and saw them observing prayer; upon this he said: The prayer of the penitent should be observed when the young weaned camels feel heat of the sun.
hi: Zaid bin Arqam (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) Quba ke logon ke paas gaye aur unhe namaz padhte dekha; isper unhone kaha: Tauba karne walon ki namaz tab padhni chahiye jab jawaan doodh chhude hue oont ke bachche garmi mahsoos karte hain.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported that a person asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about the night prayer. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Prayer during the night should consist of pairs of rak'ahs, but if one of you fears morning is near, he should pray one rak'ah which will make his prayer an odd number for him.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se raat ki namaz ke baare mein poocha. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Raat ki namaz do-do rakaton mein honi chahiye, lekin agar tum mein se kisi ko subah hone ka khauf ho, to use ek rakat padhni chahiye jo uski namaz ko taaq bana degi.

e: Salim reported on the authority of his father that a person asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about the night prayer. He said: It consists of pairs of rak'ahs, but if one fears morning is near, he should make it an odd number by praying one rak'ah.
hi: Salim ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki ek shakhs ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se raat ki namaz ke baare mein poocha. Unhone kaha: Ye do-do rakaton mein hoti hai, lekin agar kisi ko subah hone ka khauf ho, to use ek rakat padhkar ise taaq bana lena chahiye.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Umar reported: A man stood up and said. Messenger of Allah, how is the night prayer? The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The night prayer consists of pair, but if you apprehend the rise of dawn, make it odd number by observing one rak'ah.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya: Ek shakhs khada hua aur kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, raat ki namaz kaisi hai? Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Raat ki namaz do-do rakaton mein hoti hai, lekin agar tumhe subah hone ka andesha ho, to ek rakat padhkar ise taaq bana lo.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Umar reported: A person asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as I stood between him (the Holy Prophet) and the inquirer and he said: Messenger of Allah, how is the night prayer? He (the Holy Prophet) said: It consists of pairs of rak'ahs, but if you apprehend morning, you should pray one rak'ah and make the end of your prayer as Witr. Then a person asked him (the Holy Prophet) at the end of the year and I was at that place near the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ; but I do not know whether he was the same person or another person, but he (the Holy Prophet) gave him the same reply.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya: Ek shakhs ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se poocha jabki main unke aur poochne wale ke darmiyan khada tha aur unhone kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, raat ki namaz kaisi hai? Unhone kaha: Ye do-do rakaton mein hoti hai, lekin agar tumhe subah ka andesha ho, to tumhe ek rakat padhni chahiye aur apni namaz ke aakhir ko Witr banana chahiye. Phir saal ke akhir mein ek shakhs ne unse ye poocha jab main Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas usi jagah tha; lekin mujhe nahi pata ki woh wahi shakhs tha ya koi doosra, lekin unhone use bhi wahi jawab diya.

e: This hadith his been narrated by Ibn 'Umar by another chain of trans- mitters but it does not have these words: " Then a person asked him at the end of the year," and what follows subsequently.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Umar (RA) ne ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki hai lekin ismein ye alfaaz nahi hain: "Phir ek shakhs ne unse saal ke akhir mein poocha," aur uske baad ki baat bhi nahi.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as say- ing: Hasten to pray Witr before morning.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Subah hone se pehle Witr padhne mein jaldi karo.

e: Ibn 'Umar said: He who prayed at night should make Witr the end of his prayer, for the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ordered this.
hi: Ibn Umar ne kaha: Jo raat ko namaz padhe, use apni namaz ke akhir mein Witr padhna chahiye, kyunki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne aisa hukum diya tha.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Make Witr the end of your night prayer.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Apni raat ki namaz ke aakhir ko Witr banao.

e: Nafi' reported Ibn 'Umar as saying: He who observed the night prayer should make Witr the end of his prayer before dawn. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to order them thus.
hi: Nafi' ne Ibn Umar ke hawale se ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Jo raat ki namaz padhe, use subah se pehle apni namaz ke akhir mein Witr padhna chahiye. Rasoolullah (SAW) unhe isi tarah hukum diya karte the.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Witr is a rak'ah at the end of the prayer.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Witr namaz ke akhir mein ek rakat hai.

e: Ibn Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Witr is a rak'ah at the end of the night prayer.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Witr raat ki namaz ke akhir mein ek rakat hai.

e: Abu Mijlaz reported: I asked Ibn 'Abbas about the Witr prayer. He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: It is a rak'ah at the end of the night prayer.
hi: Abu Mijlaz ne bayan kiya: Maine Ibn Abbas se Witr ki namaz ke baare mein poocha. Unhone kaha: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ye raat ki namaz ke akhir mein ek rakat hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported: A person called (the attention) of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as he was in the mosque, and said: Messenger of Allah, how should I make the rak'ahs of the night prayer an odd number? Upon this the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) said: He who prays (night prayer) he should observe it in pairs, but if he apprehends the rise of morning, he should observe one rak'ah; that would make the number odd (for the rak'ahs) observed by him. This was narrated by Abu Kuraib 'Ubaidullah b. 'Abdullah and Ibn 'Umar did not make mention of it.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya: Ek shakhs ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ka dhyaan aakarshit kiya jab woh masjid mein the, aur kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, main raat ki namaz ki rakaton ko taaq kaise banaun? Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jo raat ko namaz padhe, use do-do rakaton mein padhna chahiye, lekin agar use subah hone ka andesha ho, to use ek rakat padhni chahiye; isse uski padhi hui rakaton ki tadaad taaq ho jayegi. Ye Abu Kuraib Ubaidullah bin Abdullah ne bayan ki thi aur Ibn Umar ne iska zikr nahi kiya.

e: Anas b. Sirin reported: I asked Ibn 'Umar to tell me about the practice of the Prophet (ﷺ) in regard to two rak'ahs before the dawn prayer: Should I make lengthy recitation in them? He said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to observe, the night prayer in pairs and then made the number odd by observing one rak'ah. I said: I am not asking you about it. He said: You are a bulky man, will you not show me the patience to narrate to you the hadith completely? The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to observe the night prayer in pairs and then made the number odd by observing one rak'ah, and then he observed two rak'ahs before dawn quite close to the call for prayer (Khalaf said:" Did you see  the two rak'ahs before the dawn?" and he made no mention of prayer.)
hi: Anas bin Sirin ne bayan kiya: Maine Ibn Umar se kaha ki mujhe Nabi (SAW) ke fajr se pehle wali do rakaton ke baare mein amal bataiye: Kya mujhe unmein lambi qiraat karni chahiye? Unhone kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) raat ki namaz do-do rakaton mein padha karte the aur phir ek rakat padhkar tadaad ko taaq bana dete. Maine kaha: Main aapse iske baare mein nahi poochh raha. Unhone kaha: Tum ek moti-taazi aadmi ho, kya tum mujhe hadees poori tarah bayan karne ka sabr nahi dikhaoge? Rasoolullah (SAW) raat ki namaz do-do rakaton mein padha karte the aur phir ek rakat padhkar tadaad ko taaq bana dete, aur phir woh fajr se pehle azaan ke bahut qareeb do rakat padhte. Khalaf ne kaha: "Kya tumne fajr se pehle wali do rakat dekhi hain?" aur unhone namaz ka koi zikr nahi kiya.

e: Anas b. Sirin reported: I asked Ibn 'Umar like this (as recorded in the previous hadith) and he made this addition:" And he (the Holy Prophet) made the end of the night prayer as odd number by one rak'ah." And there is also (this addition):" Stop, stop, you are bulky."
hi: Anas bin Sirin ne bayan kiya: Maine Ibn Umar se isi tarah poocha jaisa pichhli hadees mein darj hai aur unhone ye izafa kiya: "Aur unhone raat ki namaz ke akhir ko ek rakat se taaq banaya." Aur ye izafa bhi hai: "Ruko, ruko, tum moti-taaze ho."

e: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The night prayer consists of pairs and when you see the approach of dawn, make this number odd by one rak'ah. It was said to Ibn 'Umar: What does the (word) pair imply? He said: (It means) that salutation is uttered after every two rak'ahs.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Raat ki namaz do-do rakaton mein hoti hai aur jab tum subah ko qareeb aata dekho, to ek rakat se ise taaq bana lo. Ibn Umar se poocha gaya: "Do-do" juft ka kya matlab hai? Unhone kaha: Iska matlab hai ki har do rakat ke baad salaam pheera jaata hai.

e: Abu Sa'id (al Khudri) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Observe Witr prayer before it is morning. Abu Sa'id reported that they (the Prophet's Companions) asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about Witr (prayer). (In reply to their inquiry) he said: Observe Witr prayer before it is morning.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Subah hone se pehle Witr ki namaz padho. Abu Sa'id ne bayan kiya ki unhone, Nabi ke sahaba ne, Rasoolullah (SAW) se Witr ki namaz ke baare mein poocha. Unke sawal ke jawab mein unhone kaha: Subah hone se pehle Witr ki namaz padho.

e: Abu Sa'id reported that they (some of the Companions) of the Prophet (ﷺ) asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about Witr. He said: Observe Witr before morning.
hi: Abu Sa'id ne bayan kiya ki Nabi (SAW) ke kuch sahaba ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se Witr ke baare mein poocha. Unhone kaha: Subah se pehle Witr padho.

e: Jabir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If anyone is afraid that he may not get up in the latter part of the night, he should observe Witr in the first part of it; and if anyone is eager to get up in the last part of it, he should observe Witr at the end of the night, for prayer at the end of the night is witnessed (by the angels) and that is preferable.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Agar kisi ko dar ho ki woh raat ke aakhri hisse mein na uth paayega, to use raat ke pehle hisse mein hi Witr padh lena chahiye; aur agar kisi ko yaqeen ho ki woh raat ke aakhri hisse mein uth jayega, to use raat ke akhir mein Witr padhna chahiye, kyunki raat ke akhir ki namaz farishton ke zariye mushaahida ki jaati hai aur ye zyada behtar hai.

e:
Jabir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who amongst you is afraid that he may not be able to get up at the end of the night should observe Witr (in the first part) and then sleep, and he who is confident of getting up and praying at night (i. e. Tahajjud prayer) should observe it at the end of it, for the recitation at the end of the night is witnessed*, and that is better.

*: meaning, "by angels" (Sharh an-Nawawi)
hi: Jabir (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Jo tum mein se ye dar rakhta ho ki woh raat ke akhir mein nahi uth paayega, use Witr padhkar phir so jaana chahiye, aur jo raat mein uthkar namaz, yaani Tahajjud, padhne ka yaqeen rakhta ho, use isse raat ke akhir mein padhna chahiye, kyunki raat ke akhir ki qiraat ka mushaahida kiya jaata hai, aur ye zyada behtar hai.

e: Jabir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The most excellent prayer is that in which the duration of standing is longer.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Sabse afzal namaz woh hai jismein qiyaam, khada rehne, ki muddat sabse lambi ho.

e: Jabir reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was asked about the prayer which was most excellent. He said: That in which the standing is longer. (This hadith is narrated by another chain of transmitters too.)
hi: Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) se poocha gaya ki kaunsi namaz sabse afzal hai. Unhone kaha: Woh jismein qiyaam sabse lamba ho. Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Jabir said he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say: There is an hour during the night in which no Muslim individual will ask Allah for good in this world and the next without His giving it to him; and that applies to every night.
hi: Jabir ne kaha ki unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Raat mein ek aisi ghadi hoti hai jismein koi bhi Musalman shakhs Allah se is duniya aur agli duniya ki bhalaai maange to Allah use zaroor ata karta hai; aur ye har raat mein hota hai.

e: Jabir reported: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: There is an hour during the night in which no Muslim bondman will ask Allah for good in this world and the next but He will grant it to him.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Raat mein ek ghadi hoti hai jismein koi bhi Musalman banda Allah se is duniya aur agli duniya ki bhalaai maange, lekin Woh use zaroor ata karega.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Our Lord, the Blessed and the Exalted, descends every night to the lowest heaven when one-third of the latter part of the night is left, and says: Who supplicates Me so that I may answer him? Who asks Me so that I may give to him? Who asks Me forgiveness so that I may forgive him?
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Hamara Rab, jo Mubaarak aur Buland-o-Barter hai, har raat aasmaan-e-duniya, sabse nazdeeki aasmaan, par utarta hai jab raat ka aakhri tihaai baaki reh jaata hai, aur farmata hai: Kaun hai jo mujhse dua kare taaki main uski dua qubool karun? Kaun hai jo mujhse maange taaki main use dun? Kaun hai jo mujhse maafi maange taaki main use maaf kar dun?

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Allah descends every night to the lowest heaven when one-third of the first part of the night is over and says: I am the Lord; I am the Lord: who is there to supplicate Me so that I answer him? Who is there to beg of Me so that I grant him? Who is there to beg forgiveness from Me so that I forgive him? He continues like this till the day breaks.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Allah har raat aasmaan-e-duniya par utarta hai jab raat ke pehle tihaai ka waqt guzar chuka hota hai aur farmata hai: Main Rab hoon; Main Rab hoon: Kaun hai jo mujhse dua kare taaki main uski dua qubool karun? Kaun hai jo mujhse maange taaki main use dun? Kaun hai jo mujhse maafi maange taaki main use maaf kar dun? Woh isi tarah kehta rehta hai yahan tak ki subah ho jaati hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When half of the night or two-third of it is over. Allah, the Blessed and the Exalted, descends to the lowest heaven and says: Is there any beggar, so that he be given? Is there any supplicator so that he be answered? Is there any beggar of forgiveness so that he be forgiven? (And Allah continues it saying) till it is daybreak.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Jab aadhi raat ya raat ka do-tihaai hissa guzar jaata hai, to Allah, jo Mubaarak aur Buland-o-Barter hai, aasmaan-e-duniya par utarta hai aur farmata hai: Kya koi maangne wala hai, taaki use diya jaaye? Kya koi dua karne wala hai, taaki uski dua qubool ki jaaye? Kya koi maafi maangne wala hai, taaki use maaf kiya jaaye? Aur Allah ye kehta rehta hai yahan tak ki subah ho jaati hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Allah descends to the lowest heaven at half of the night or at one-third of the latter part and says: Who is there to supplicate Me so that I answer him? Who is there to ask Me so that I grant him? And then says: Who will lend to One Who is neither indigent nor tyrant? (This hadith has been narrated by Sa'd b. Sa'id with the same chain of transmitters with this addition:" Then the Blessed and the Exalted (Lord) stretches His Hands and says: Who will lend to One Who is neither indigent nor tyrant? )
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Allah aasmaan-e-duniya par aadhi raat mein ya raat ke aakhri tihaai mein utarta hai aur farmata hai: Kaun hai jo mujhse dua kare taaki main uski dua qubool karun? Kaun hai jo mujhse maange taaki main use dun? Aur phir farmata hai: Kaun hai jo Use qarz de jo na muhtaaj hai na zaalim? Ye hadees Sa'd bin Sa'id ne isi sanad se is izafe ke saath bayan ki hai: "Phir Mubaarak aur Buland-o-Barter Rab apne Haath phaila deta hai aur farmata hai: Kaun hai jo Use qarz de jo na muhtaaj hai na zaalim?"

e: Abu Sa'id and Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Allah waits till when one-third of the first part of the night is over; He descends to the lowest heaven and says: It there any supplicator of forgiveness? Is there any penitant? Is there any petitioner (for mercy and favour)? Is there any solicitor? -till it is daybreak.
hi: Abu Sa'id aur Abu Huraira (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Allah tab tak intezaar karta hai jab tak raat ka pehla tihaai guzar nahi jaata; Woh aasmaan-e-duniya par utarta hai aur farmata hai: Kya koi maafi maangne wala hai? Kya koi tauba karne wala hai? Kya koi rahmat aur inaam ke liye darkhaast karne wala hai? Kya koi maangne wala hai? - yahan tak ki subah ho jaati hai.

e: This hadith is narrated by Ishaq with the same chain uf transmitters except this that the hadith transmitted by Mansur (the above one) is more comprehensive and lengthy.
hi: Ye hadees Ishaq ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai siwaay is baat ke ki Mansur ki bayan ki hui hadees, upar wali, zyada jame' aur lambi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who observed prayer at night during Ramadan, because of faith and seeking his reward from Allah, his previous sins would be forgiven.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Jo Ramzan mein imaan aur Allah se sawaab ki ummeed rakhte hue raat ki namaz, Taraweeh, padhe, uske pichhle gunah maaf kar diye jaayenge.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to exhort (his Companions) to pray (at night) during Ramadan without commanding them to observe it as an obligatory act, and say: He who observed the night prayer in Ramadan because of faith and seeking his reward (from Allah), all his previous sins would be forgiven. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died, this was the practice, and it continued thus during Abu Bakr's caliphate and the early part of 'Umar's caliphate.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) apne sahaba ko Ramzan mein raat ko namaz padhne ki targheeb diya karte the bina unhe ise farz karne ka hukum diye, aur kehte: Jo Ramzan mein imaan aur Allah se sawaab ki ummeed rakhte hue raat ki namaz padhe, uske pichhle saare gunah maaf kar diye jaayenge. Jab Rasoolullah (SAW) ki wafat hui, to yehi amal jaari raha, aur ye Abu Bakr ki khilafat aur Umar ki khilafat ke shuruaati hisse mein bhi isi tarah jaari raha.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who observed the fasts of Ramadan with faith and seeking reward (from Allah), all his previous sins would be forgiven, and he who observed prayer on Lailat-ul- Qadr with faith and seeking reward (from Allah), all his previous sins would be forgiven.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Jo Ramzan ke roze imaan aur Allah se sawaab ki ummeed rakhte hue rakhe, uske pichhle saare gunah maaf kar diye jaayenge, aur jo Lailat-ul-Qadr ki raat imaan aur sawaab ki ummeed rakhte hue namaz padhe, uske pichhle saare gunah maaf kar diye jaayenge.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: He who prayed on the Lailat-ul-Qadr (the Majestic Night) knowing that it is (the same night). I (believe) that he (the Prophet also) said: (He who does) it with faith and seeking reward (from Allah), his sins would be forgiven.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Jo Lailat-ul-Qadr, Qadr ki azmat wali raat, mein ye jaante hue namaz padhe ki ye wahi raat hai. Main yaqeen karta hoon ki unhone ye bhi kaha: Jo koi aisa kare imaan aur sawaab ki ummeed rakhte hue, uske gunah maaf kar diye jaayenge.

e: 'A'isha reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prayed one night in the mosque and people also prayed along with him. He then prayed on the following night and there were many persons. Then on the third or fourth night (many people) gathered there, but the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not come out to them (for leading the Tarawih prayer). When it was morning he said: I saw what you were doing, but I desisted to come to you (and lead the prayer) for I feared that this prayer might become obligatory for you. (He the narrator) said: It was the month of Ramadan.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne ek raat masjid mein namaz padhi aur log bhi unke saath padhne lage. Phir unhone agli raat namaz padhi aur log kaafi zyada the. Phir teesri ya chauthi raat bahut se log jama ho gaye, lekin Rasoolullah (SAW) unke paas Taraweeh padhane nahi aaye. Jab subah hui to unhone farmaya: Maine dekha ki tum kya kar rahe the, lekin main tumhare paas aane se is liye ruka aur namaz na padhayi kyunki mujhe dar tha ki kahin ye namaz tum par farz na ho jaaye. Raawi ne kaha: Ye Ramzan ka mahina tha.

e: 'A'isha reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came out during the night and observed prayer in the mosque and some of the people prayed along with him. When it was morning the people talked about this and so a large number of people gathered there. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went out for the second night, and they (the people) prayed along with him. When it was morning the people began to talk about it. So the mosque thronged with people on the third night. He (the Holy Prophet) came out and they prayed along with him. When it was the fourth night, the mosque was filled to its utmost capacity but the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not come out. Some persons among then cried:" Prayer." But the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not come to them till he came out for the morning prayer. When he had completed the morning prayer, he turned his face to the people and recited Tashahhud (I bear testi- mony that there is no god but Allah and I bear testimony that Muhammad is His Messen- ger) and then said: Your affair was not hidden from me in the night, but I was afraid that (my observing prayer continuously) might make the night prayer obligatory for you and you might be unable to perform it.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) raat ko nikle aur masjid mein namaz padhi aur kuch log unke saath namaz mein shaamil hue. Jab subah hui to log iske baare mein baat karne lage, is liye wahan bahut zyada log jama ho gaye. Rasoolullah (SAW) doosri raat bhi nikle, aur unhone unke saath namaz padhi. Jab subah hui to log iske baare mein baat karne lage. To teesri raat masjid mein bheed ho gayi. Woh nikle aur unhone unke saath namaz padhi. Jab chauthi raat aayi, to masjid apni poori gunjaayish tak bhar gayi lekin Rasoolullah (SAW) bahar nahi aaye. Unmein se kuch log chillaaye: "Namaz." Lekin Rasoolullah (SAW) unke paas tab tak nahi aaye jab tak woh fajr ki namaz ke liye bahar nahi aa gaye. Jab unhone fajr ki namaz mukammal ki, to woh logon ki taraf mudkar tashahhud padha aur phir kaha: Tumhara maamla raat ko mujhse chhupa nahi tha, lekin mujhe dar tha ki mera musalsal namaz padhna kahin raat ki namaz tumpar farz na kar de aur tum ise ada karne mein asamarth ho jaao.

e: Zirr (b. Hubaish) reported: I heard from Ubayy b. Ka'b a statement made by 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud in which he said: He who gets up for prayer (every night) during the year will hit upon Lailat-ul-Qadr. Ubayy said: By Allah I there is no god but He, that (Lailat-ul-Qadr) is in Ramadhan (He swore without reservation: ) By Allah, I know the night; it is the night on which the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commanded us to pray. It is that which precedes the morning of twenty-seventy and its indication is that the sun rises bright on that day without rays.
hi: Zirr bin Hubaish ne bayan kiya: Maine Ubayy bin Ka'b se ek baat suni jo Abdullah bin Mas'ud ne kahi thi, jismein unhone kaha: Jo saal bhar har raat namaz ke liye uthega, use Lailat-ul-Qadr zaroor mil jayegi. Ubayy ne kaha: Allah ki qasam jiske siwa koi ma'bood nahi, ye Lailat-ul-Qadr Ramzan mein hai, unhone bina kisi shak ke qasam khayi: Allah ki qasam, mujhe ye raat pata hai; ye woh raat hai jispar Rasoolullah (SAW) ne humein namaz padhne ka hukum diya. Ye woh raat hai jo sattaisvi tareekh ki subah se pehle aati hai, aur iski nishaani ye hai ki us din suraj bina kiran ke chamakdaar taur par nikalta hai.

e: Ubayy b Ka'b reported: By Allah, I know about Lailat-ul Qadr and I know it fully well that it is the twenty-seventh night (during Ramadan) on which the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commanded us to observe prayer. (Shu'ba was in doubt about these words:" the night on which the Messenger of Allah  commanded us to observe the prayer." This has been transmitted to me by a friend of mine.)
hi: Ubayy bin Ka'b (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ki qasam, mujhe Lailat-ul-Qadr ke baare mein pata hai aur mujhe achhi tarah pata hai ki ye Ramzan mein sattaisvi raat hai jispar Rasoolullah (SAW) ne humein namaz padhne ka hukum diya. Shu'ba ko in alfaaz ke baare mein shaq tha: "woh raat jispar Rasoolullah ne humein namaz padhne ka hukum diya." Ye mujhe mere ek dost ne bataya hai.

e: Shu'ba reported this hadith with the same chain of transmitters, but he made no mention that Shu'ba was in doubt and what follows subsequently.
hi: Shu'ba ne ye hadees isi sanad se bayan ki hai, lekin unhone ye zikr nahi kiya ki Shu'ba ko shaq tha aur uske aage ki baat.

e:
Ibn `Abbas reported: I spent a night with my maternal aunt (sister of my mother) Maimuna. The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) got up during the night and relieved himself, then washed his face and hands and went to sleep. He then got up again, and came to the water skin and loosened its straps, then performed good ablution between the two extremes. He then stood up and observed prayer. I also stood up and stretched my body fearing that he might be under the impression that I was there to find out (what he did at night). So I also performed ablution and stood up to pray, but I stood on his left. He took hold of my hand and made me go around to his right side. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) completed thirteen rak`ahs of his night prayer. He then lay down and slept and snored (and it was his habit to snore while asleep). Then Bilal came and he informed him about the prayer. He (the Holy Prophet) then stood up for prayer and did not perform ablution, and his supplication included these words: "O Allah, place light in my heart, light in my sight, light in my hearing, light on my right hand, light on my left hand, light above me, light below me, light in front of me, light behind me, and enhance light for me." 
Kuraib (the narrator) said: There are seven (words more) which are in my heart (but I cannot recall them) and I met some of the descendants of Al-`Abbas and they narrated these words to me and mentioned in them: (Light) in my sinew, in my flesh, in my blood, in my hair, in my skin, and made a mention of two more things.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine apni khala, maa ki behn, Maimuna ke ghar ek raat guzaari. Rasoolullah (SAW) raat ko uthe aur qaza-e-hajat ki, phir apna chehra aur haath dhoye aur so gaye. Phir woh dobara uthe, aur mashk ke paas aaye aur uski daudi khol di, phir do inteha'on ke darmiyan achhi tarah wuzu kiya. Phir woh khade hue aur namaz padhi. Main bhi khada hua aur apna badan phaila diya, is dar se ki kahin unhe ye na lage ki main unka mushaahida karne ke liye waha aaya hoon. To maine bhi wuzu kiya aur namaz ke liye khada hua, lekin main unki baayi taraf khada hua. Unhone mera haath pakda aur mujhe apni daayi taraf le gaye. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne apni raat ki namaz ki terah rakat mukammal ki. Phir woh let gaye aur so gaye aur khanraate lene lage, aur ye unki aadat thi ki so jaane par khanraate lete. Phir Bilal aaye aur unhe namaz ke baare mein bataya. Unhone phir namaz ke liye khade hue aur wuzu nahi kiya, aur unki dua mein ye alfaaz shaamil the: "Aye Allah, mere dil mein noor rakh, meri nazar mein noor, mere kaanon mein noor, meri daayi taraf noor, meri baayi taraf noor, mere upar noor, mere neeche noor, mere aage noor, mere peeche noor, aur mere liye noor badha de." Kuraib, raawi, ne kaha: Saat aur alfaaz hain jo mere dil mein hain, lekin mujhe yaad nahi, aur main Al-Abbas ki kuch aulaad se mila aur unhone mujhe ye alfaaz bataye, aur unmein zikr hua: Noor mere pattho mein, mere gosht mein, mere khoon mein, mere baalon mein, meri khaal mein, aur do aur cheezon ka zikr kiya.

e: Kuraib, the freed slave of Ibn `Abbas, reported that Ibn `Abbas narrated to him that he spent a night in the house of Maimuna, the mother of the believers, who was his mother's sister. I lay down across the cushion, whereas the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and his wife lay down on it length-wise. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) slept till midnight, or a little before midnight, or a little after midnight, and then got up and began to cast off the effects of sleep from his face by rubbing with his hand, and then recited the ten concluding verses of Surah Al-`Imran. He then stood up near a hanging water-skin and performed ablution well, and then stood up and prayed, Ibn `Abbas said: I also stood up and did the same, as the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had done, and then went to him and stood by his side. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) placed his right hand upon my head and took hold of my right ear and twisted it, and then observed a pair of rak`ahs, again a pair of rak`ahs, again a pair of rak`ahs, again a pair of rak`ahs, again a pair of rak`ahs, again a pair of rak`ahs, and then observed Witr and then lay down till the Mu'adhdhin came to him. He (the Holy Prophet) then stood up and observed two short rak`ahs, and then went out (to the mosque) and observed the dawn prayer.
hi: Kuraib, Ibn Abbas ke aazad kiye hue ghulam, ne riwayat ki ki Ibn Abbas ne unhe bataya ki unhone ek raat Ummul-Momineen Maimuna, jo unki maa ki behn thin, ke ghar guzaari. Main takiye ke aar-paar leta, jabki Rasoolullah (SAW) aur unki zauja uski lambaai mein lete the. Rasoolullah (SAW) aadhi raat tak so gaye, ya aadhi raat se thoda pehle, ya thoda baad, aur phir uthe aur apne haath se apne chehre se neend ke asaraat mitaane lage, aur phir Surah Al-e-Imran ki aakhri das aayaten padhin. Phir woh ek latakti hui mashk ke paas khade hue aur achhi tarah wuzu kiya, aur phir khade hokar namaz padhi. Ibn Abbas ne kaha: Main bhi khada hua aur maine wahi kiya jo Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kiya tha, aur phir unke paas gaya aur unki bagal mein khada ho gaya. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne apna daayan haath mere sar par rakha aur mera daayan kaan pakadkar use moda, aur phir do rakat padhi, phir do rakat, phir do rakat, phir do rakat, phir do rakat, phir do rakat, aur phir Witr padha aur phir let gaye yahan tak ki muazzin unke paas aaye. Unhone phir khade hokar do chhoti rakat padhi, aur phir masjid ki taraf nikle aur fajr ki namaz padhi.

e: Makhrama b. Sulaiman narrated it with the same chain of narrators and he made this addition: "He then went to the water-skin and brushed his teeth and performed ablution well. He did not pour water but a little. He then awakened me and I stood up," and the rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Makhrama bin Sulaiman ne ise isi sanad se riwayat ki aur ye izafa kiya: "Phir woh mashk ke paas gaye aur miswak ki aur achhi tarah wuzu kiya. Unhone paani zyada nahi daala balki thoda hi daala. Phir unhone mujhe jagaaya aur main khada ho gaya," aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Ibn `Abbas reported: I slept (one night) in the house of Maimuna, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was with her that night. He (after sleeping for half of the night got up and) then performed ablution and then stood up and observed prayer. I too stood on his left side. He took hold of me and made me stand on his right side. He (the Holy Prophet) observed thirteen rak`ahs on that night. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) then slept and snored and it was a habit with him to snore while sleeping. The Mu'adhdhin then came to him (to inform him about the prayer). He then went out and observed prayer without performing ablution. (`Amr said: Bukair b. Ashajj had narrated it to me )
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Main ek raat Rasoolullah (SAW) ki zauja Maimuna ke ghar soya, aur Rasoolullah (SAW) us raat unke saath the. Aadhi raat sone ke baad woh uthe aur phir wuzu kiya aur phir khade hokar namaz padhi. Main bhi unki baayi taraf khada hua. Unhone mujhe pakda aur apni daayi taraf khada kar diya. Unhone us raat terah rakat padhi. Rasoolullah (SAW) phir so gaye aur khanraate lene lage aur ye unki aadat thi ki so jaane par khanraate lete. Phir muazzin unke paas aaye unhe namaz ke baare mein bataane. Woh phir bahar gaye aur bina wuzu kiye namaz padhi. Amr ne kaha: Bukair bin Ashajj ne mujhe ye riwayat ki thi.

e: Ibn `Abbas reported: I spent one night in the house of my mother's sister Maimuna, daughter of Al-Harith, and said to her: Awake me when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stands to pray (at night). (She woke me up when) the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stood up for prayer. I stood on his left side. He took hold of my hand and made me stand on his right side, and whenever I dozed off he took hold of my earlobe (and made me alert). He (the narrator) said: He (the Holy Prophet) observed eleven rak`ahs. He then sat with his legs drawn and wrapped in his garment and slept so that I could hear his breathing while asleep. And when the dawn appeared, he observed two short rak`ahs of (Sunnah) prayer.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine apni maa ki behn Maimuna, jo Al-Harith ki beti hain, ke ghar ek raat guzaari, aur unse kaha: Jab Rasoolullah (SAW) namaz ke liye khade hon, raat ko, to mujhe jaga dena. Unhone mujhe jagaya jab Rasoolullah (SAW) namaz ke liye khade hue. Main unki baayi taraf khada hua. Unhone mera haath pakda aur mujhe apni daayi taraf khada kar diya, aur jab bhi mujhe unghayi aati, to woh mera kaan pakad lete, mujhe hoshiyaar karne ke liye. Raawi ne kaha: Unhone gyarah rakat padhi. Phir woh apni taangein samet kar aur apne kapde mein lipatkar baithe aur so gaye yahan tak ki main unki saans ki awaaz sun sakta tha jab woh so rahe the. Aur jab subah numaayan hui, to unhone Sunnat namaz ki do chhoti rakat padhi.

e: Ibn `Abbas reported that he spent a night in the house of his maternal aunt, Maimuna. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) got up at night and performed a short ablution (taking water) from the water-skin hanging there. (Giving a description of the ablution Ibn `Abbas said: It was short and performed with a little water.) I also got up and did the same as the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had done. I then came (to him) and stood on his left. He then made me go around to his right side. He then observed prayer and went to sleep till he began to snore. Bilal came to him and informed him about the prayer. He (the Holy Prophet) then went out and observed the dawn prayer without performing ablution. Sufyan said: It was a special (prerogative of the) Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) for it has been conveyed to us that the eyes of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sleep, but his heart does not sleep.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unhone apni khala Maimuna ke ghar ek raat guzaari. Rasoolullah (SAW) raat ko uthe aur wahan latakti hui mashk se paani lekar chhota sa wuzu kiya. Wuzu ki tafseel dete hue Ibn Abbas ne kaha: Ye chhota tha aur thode se paani se kiya gaya. Main bhi utha aur maine wahi kiya jo Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kiya tha. Main phir unke paas aaya aur unki baayi taraf khada hua. Phir unhone mujhe apni daayi taraf le gaye. Phir unhone namaz padhi aur so gaye yahan tak ki woh khanraate lene lage. Bilal unke paas aaye aur unhe namaz ke baare mein bataya. Unhone phir bahar jaakar bina wuzu kiye fajr ki namaz padhi. Sufyan ne kaha: Ye Rasoolullah (SAW) ki khaas khaasiyat thi kyunki humein bataya gaya hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ki aankhein sotin hain lekin unka dil nahi sota.

e: Ibn `Abbas said: I spent the night in the house of my mother's sister, Maimuna, and observed how the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prayed (at night). He got up and relieved himself. He then washed his face and hands and then went to sleep. He again got up and went near the water-skin and loosened its straps and then poured some water in a bowl and inclined it with his hands (towards himself). He then performed a good ablution between the two extremes and then stood up to pray. I also came and stood by his left side. He took hold of me and made me stand on his right side. It was in thirteen rak`ahs that the (night) prayer of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was completed. He then slept till he began to snore, and we knew that he had gone to sleep by his snoring. He then went out (for the dawn prayer), and said while praying or prostrating himself: "O Allah! place light in my heart, light in my hearing, light in my sight, light on my right, light on my left, light in front of me, light behind me, light above me, light below me, make light for me," or he said: "Make me light."
hi: Ibn Abbas ne kaha: Maine apni maa ki behn Maimuna ke ghar raat guzaari, aur dekha ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne raat ko kaise namaz padhi. Woh uthe aur qaza-e-hajat ki. Phir unhone apna chehra aur haath dhoye aur so gaye. Woh phir uthe aur mashk ke paas gaye aur uski daudi khol di aur phir kuch paani ek bartan mein dala aur use apne haathon se apni taraf jhukaya. Phir unhone do inteha'on ke darmiyan achhi tarah wuzu kiya aur phir namaz ke liye khade hue. Main bhi aaya aur unki baayi taraf khada hua. Unhone mujhe pakda aur apni daayi taraf khada kar diya. Rasoolullah (SAW) ki raat ki namaz terah rakaton mein mukammal hui. Phir woh so gaye yahan tak ki woh khanraate lene lage, aur humein pata chal gaya ki woh so gaye hain unke khanraaton se. Phir woh fajr ki namaz ke liye bahar gaye, aur namaz padhte ya sajda karte hue kaha: "Aye Allah! Mere dil mein noor rakh, mere kaanon mein noor, meri nazar mein noor, meri daayi taraf noor, meri baayi taraf noor, mere aage noor, mere peeche noor, mere upar noor, mere neeche noor, mere liye noor bana," ya unhone kaha: "Mujhe noor bana de."

e: Salama said: I met Kuraib and he reported Ibn `Abbas as saying: I was with my mother's sister Maimuna and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came there, and then he narrated the rest of the hadith as was narrated by Ghundar and said these words: "Make me light," beyond any doubt.
hi: Salama ne kaha: Main Kuraib se mila aur unhone Ibn Abbas se riwayat ki ki: Main apni maa ki behn Maimuna ke saath tha aur Rasoolullah (SAW) wahan aaye, aur phir unhone baaki hadees waisi hi bayan ki jaisi Ghundar ne bayan ki thi aur "Mujhe noor bana de" alfaaz bina kisi shak ke kahe.

e: Ibn `Abbas reported: I spent a night in the house of my mother's sister, Maimuna, and then narrated (the rest of the) hadith, but he made no mention of the washing of his face and two hands but he only said: He then came to the water-skin and loosened its straps and performed ablution between the two extremes, and then came to his bed and slept. He then got up for the second time and came to the water-skin and loosened its straps and then performed ablution which was in fact an ablution (it was performed well), and implored (the Lord) thus: "Give me abundant light," and he made no mention of: "Make me light."
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine apni maa ki behn Maimuna ke ghar ek raat guzaari, aur phir baaki hadees bayan ki, lekin unhone chehre aur dono haathon ke dhone ka zikr nahi kiya balki sirf itna kaha: Phir woh mashk ke paas aaye aur uski daudi khol di aur do inteha'on ke darmiyan wuzu kiya, aur phir apne bistar par aaye aur so gaye. Phir woh doosri baar uthe aur mashk ke paas aaye aur uski daudi khol di aur phir wuzu kiya jo waaqai ek mukammal wuzu tha, ye achhi tarah kiya gaya tha, aur Rab se yun dua ki: "Mujhe khoob noor de," aur unhone "Mujhe noor bana de" ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: Kuraib reported that Ibn `Abbas spent a night in the house of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stood near the water-skin and poured water out of it and performed ablution in which he neither used excess of water nor too little of it, and the rest of the hadith is the same, and in this mention is also made (of the fact) that on that night the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) made supplication before Allah in nineteen words. Kuraib reported: I remember twelve words out of these, but have forgotten the rest. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Place light in my heart, light in my tongue, light in my hearing, light in my sight, light above me, light below me, light on my right, light on my left, light in front of me, light behind me, place light in my soul, and make light abundant for me."
hi: Kuraib ne bayan kiya ki Ibn Abbas ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ke ghar ek raat guzaari aur unhone kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) mashk ke paas khade hue aur usmein se paani dala aur wuzu kiya jismein na paani ki ziyaadti thi na kami, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai, aur ismein ye bhi zikr hua ki us raat Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Allah se unnees alfaaz mein dua ki. Kuraib ne bayan kiya: Mujhe inmein se baarah alfaaz yaad hain, lekin baaki bhool gaya hoon. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: "Mere dil mein noor rakh, meri zubaan mein noor, mere kaanon mein noor, meri nazar mein noor, mere upar noor, mere neeche noor, meri daayi taraf noor, meri baayi taraf noor, mere aage noor, mere peeche noor, meri rooh mein noor rakh, aur mere liye noor badha de."

e: Ibn `Abbas reported: I slept one night in the house of Maimuna when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was there, with a view to seeing the prayer of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) at night. The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) entered into conversation with his wife for a short while, and then went to sleep, and the rest of the hadith is the same and in it mention is made of: "He then got up, performed ablution and brushed his teeth."
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine ek raat Maimuna ke ghar soya jab Rasoolullah (SAW) wahan the, ye dekhne ke liye ki Rasoolullah (SAW) raat ko kaise namaz padhte hain. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne thodi der apni zauja se baatcheet ki, aur phir so gaye, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai aur ismein ye bhi zikr hua hai: "Phir woh uthe, wuzu kiya aur miswak ki."

e: `Abdullah b. `Abbas reported: He spent (one night) in the house of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He (the Holy Prophet) got up, brushed his teeth and performed ablution and said: "In the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the alternation of the night and the day, there are indeed signs for people of understanding" (al-Qur'an, iii. 190), to the end of the Surah. He then stood up and prayed two rak`ahs, standing, bowing and prostrating himself at length in them. Then he finished, went to sleep and snored. He did that three times, six rak`ahs altogether, each time cleaning his teeth, performing ablution, and reciting these verses. Then he observed three rak`ahs of Witr. The Mu'adhdhin then pronounced the Adhan and he went out for prayer and was saying: "O Allah! place light in my heart, light in my tongue, place light in my hearing, place light in my eyesight, place light behind me, and light in front of me, and place light above me, and light below me. O Allah! grant me light."
hi: Abdullah bin Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Unhone ek raat Rasoolullah (SAW) ke ghar guzaari. Woh uthe, miswak ki aur wuzu kiya aur kaha: "Yaqeenan aasmaanon aur zameen ki takhleeq mein, aur raat aur din ke aane-jaane mein, aqlmand logon ke liye zaroor nishaniyan hain" (3:190), surah ke akhir tak. Phir woh khade hue aur do rakat padhi, jismein khade hone, ruku aur sajde mein lambi der ki. Phir unhone namaz mukammal ki, so gaye aur khanraate lene lage. Unhone aisa teen baar kiya, kul milakar chhe rakat, har baar apni miswak karte, wuzu karte, aur ye aayaten padhte. Phir unhone teen rakat Witr padhi. Phir muazzin ne azaan di aur woh namaz ke liye bahar gaye aur keh rahe the: "Aye Allah! Mere dil mein noor rakh, meri zubaan mein noor, mere kaanon mein noor rakh, meri nazar mein noor rakh, mere peeche noor rakh, aur mere aage noor, aur mere upar noor rakh, aur mere neeche noor. Aye Allah! Mujhe noor ata farma."

e: Ibn `Abbas reported: I spent a night in the house of my mother's sister Maimuna. The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) got up for observing voluntary prayer (Tahajjud) at night. The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) stood by the water-skin and performed ablution and then stood up and prayed. I also got up when I saw him doing that. I also performed ablution from the water-skin and then stood at his left side. He took hold of my hand from behind his back and then turned me from his back to his right side. I (`Ata', one of the narrators) said: Did it concern the voluntary prayer (at night)? He (Ibn `Abbas) said: Yes.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine apni maa ki behn Maimuna ke ghar ek raat guzaari. Rasoolullah (SAW) raat ko nafil namaz, Tahajjud, ke liye uthe. Rasoolullah (SAW) mashk ke paas khade hue aur wuzu kiya aur phir khade hokar namaz padhi. Jab maine unhe aisa karte dekha to main bhi utha. Maine bhi mashk se wuzu kiya aur phir unki baayi taraf khada ho gaya. Unhone apni peeth ke peeche se mera haath pakda aur phir mujhe apni peeth ke peeche se apni daayi taraf mudwa diya. Maine, Ata, raawiyon mein se ek, ne poocha: Kya ye nafil namaz, raat ki, se mutalliq tha? Unhone, Ibn Abbas ne, kaha: Haan.

e: Ibn `Abbas reported: (My father) Al-`Abbas sent me to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he was in the house of my mother's sister Maimuna and I spent that night along with him. He (the Holy Prophet) got up and prayed at night, and I stood up on his left side. He caught hold of me from behind his back and made me stand on his right side.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Mere waalid Al-Abbas ne mujhe Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas bheja aur woh mere maa ki behn Maimuna ke ghar the aur maine woh raat unke saath guzaari. Woh uthe aur raat ko namaz padhi, aur main unki baayi taraf khada hua. Unhone mujhe apni peeth ke peeche se pakda aur apni daayi taraf khada kar diya.

e: Ibn `Abbas reported: I spent a night in the house of my mother's sister Maimuna, and the rest of the hadith is the same as narrated above.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine apni maa ki behn Maimuna ke ghar ek raat guzaari, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai jaisi upar bayan hui.

e: Abu Jamra reported: I heard Ibn 'Abbas saying that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed thirteen rak'ahs at night.
hi: Abu Jamra ne bayan kiya: Maine Ibn Abbas ko ye kehte suna ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne raat ko terah rakat padhi.

e: Zaid b Khalid al-Juhani said: I would definitely watch at night the prayer observed by the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He prayed two short rak'ahs, then two long, long, long rak'ahs, then he prayed two rak'ahs which were shorter than the two preceding rak'ahs, then he prayed two rak'ahs which were shorter than the two preceding, then he prayed two rak'ahs which were shorter than the two preceding, then observed a single one (Witr), making a total of thirteen rak'ahs
hi: Zaid bin Khalid al-Juhani ne kaha: Main zaroor Rasoolullah (SAW) ki raat ki namaz ka mushaahida karta. Unhone do chhoti rakat padhin, phir do lambi, lambi, lambi rakat, phir unhone do rakat padhi jo pichhli do rakaton se chhoti thin, phir unhone do rakat padhi jo pichhli se chhoti thin, phir unhone do rakat padhi jo pichhli se chhoti thin, phir unhone ek akeli rakat, Witr, padhi, jisse kul terah rakat ban jaati thin.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported: I accompanied the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in a journey and we reached a watering place. He said: Jabir, are you going to enter it? I said: Yes. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) then got down and I entered it. He (the Holy Prophet) then went away to relieve himself and I placed for him water for ablution. He then came back and performed ablution, and then stood and prayed in one garment, having its ends tied from the opposite sides. I stood behind him and he caught hold of my ear and made me stand on his right side.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Main Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath ek safar mein tha aur hum ek paani ki jagah pahunche. Unhone kaha: Jabir, kya tum ismein daakhil hoge? Maine kaha: Haan. Rasoolullah (SAW) phir utre aur main daakhil hua. Woh phir qaza-e-hajat ke liye chale gaye aur maine unke liye wuzu ka paani rakha. Woh phir wapas aaye aur wuzu kiya, aur phir khade hokar ek hi kapde mein namaz padhi, jiske dono kinaray ulti taraf se baandhe hue the. Main unke peeche khada hua aur unhone mera kaan pakadkar mujhe apni daayi taraf khada kar diya.

e: 'A'isha reported that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stood up at night to pray, he began his prayer with two short rak'ahs.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab Rasoolullah (SAW) raat ko namaz padhne ke liye khade hote, to woh apni namaz do chhoti rakaton se shuru karte the.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying When any one of you gets up at night, he should begin the prayer with two short rak'ahs.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Jab tum mein se koi raat ko uthe, to use apni namaz do chhoti rakaton se shuru karni chahiye.

e: Ibn `Abbas reported that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) got up during the night to pray, he used to say: O Allah, to Thee be the praise Thou art the light of the heavens and the earth. To Thee be the praise; Thou art the Supporter of the heavens and the earth. To Thee be the praise; Thou art the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is therein. Thou art the Truth; Thy promise is True, the meeting with Thee is True. Paradise is true, Hell is true, the Hour is true. O Allah, I submit to Thee; affirm my faith in Thee; repose my trust in Thee, and I return to Thee for repentance; by Thy help I have disputed; and to Thee I have come for decision, so forgive me my earlier and later sins, the sins that I committed in secret and openly. Thou art my God. There is no god but Thee.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab Rasoolullah (SAW) raat ko namaz ke liye uthte, to woh kehte: "Aye Allah, Teri hi hamd hai, Tu aasmaanon aur zameen ka noor hai. Teri hi hamd hai; Tu aasmaanon aur zameen ka sahaara hai. Teri hi hamd hai; Tu aasmaanon aur zameen aur jo kuch unmein hai uska Rab hai. Tu haq hai; Tera wada haq hai, Tujhse mulaqat haq hai. Jannat haq hai, Jahannam haq hai, Qayamat haq hai. Aye Allah, main Tera farmaanbardaar hoon; main Tujhpar imaan laata hoon; main Tujhpar bharosa karta hoon, aur main Teri taraf tauba karta hoon; Teri madad se maine jhagda kiya hai; aur main Teri taraf faisle ke liye aaya hoon, is liye mujhe mere pehle aur baad ke gunah maaf kar de, jo gunah maine chhup kar aur khule aam kiye. Tu hi mera Ma'bood hai. Tere siwa koi ma'bood nahi hai."

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas through another chain of transmitters and with slight alteration of two words. Instead of the word Qayyam (Supporter, as used in the above hadith here the word) Qayyim (the Custodian) has been used, and he (further said): " What I did in secret." And in the hadith narrated by Ibn 'Uyaina there is some addition.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Abbas (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki gayi hai aur do alfaaz mein halki tabdeeli ke saath. "Qayyam", sahaara, ki jagah "Qayyim", nigraan, lafz istemal hua hai, aur unhone aage kaha: "Jo maine chhup kar kiya." Aur Ibn Uyaina ki bayan ki hui hadees mein kuch izafa hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Ibn 'Abbas by another chain of transmitters and the words are nearly the same (as recorded in the above-mentioned hadith).
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Abbas (RA) ne ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki hai aur alfaaz taqreeban wahi hain jaisa upar zikr hui hadees mein hai.

e: 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Auf reported: I asked 'A'isha, the mother of the believers, (to tell me) the words with which the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commenced the prayer when he got up at night. She said: When he got up at night he would commence his prayer with these words: O Allah, Lord of Gabriel, and Michael, and Israfil, the Creator of the heavens and the earth, Who knowest the unseen and the seen; Thou decidest amongst Thy servants concerning their differences. Guide me with Thy permission in the divergent views (which the people) hold about Truth, for it is Thou Who guidest whom Thou wilt to the Straight Path.
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Auf ne bayan kiya: Maine Ummul-Momineen Aisha (RA) se bataane ko poocha ki Rasoolullah (SAW) raat ko uthkar namaz kis alfaaz se shuru karte the. Unhone kaha: Jab woh raat ko uthte, to woh apni namaz in alfaaz se shuru karte: "Aye Allah, Jibra'eel, Mikaeel aur Israfeel ke Rab, aasmaanon aur zameen ke Khaaliq, jo ghaib aur zaahir ko jaanta hai; Tu apne bandon ke darmiyan unke ikhtilaafaat ke baare mein faisla karta hai. Mujhe Apni ijazat se haq ke baare mein us ikhtilaaf mein hidayat de jo log rakhte hain, kyunki Tu hi jise chahe seedhe raaste ki taraf hidayat deta hai."

e: 'Ali b. Abu Talib reported that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) got up at night for prayer he would say: I turn my face in complete devotion to One Who is the Originator of the heaven and the earth and I am not of the polytheists. Verily my prayer, my sacrifice, my living and my dying are for Allah, the Lord of the worlds; There is no partner with Him and this is what I have been commanded (to profess and believe) and I am of the believers. O Allah, Thou art the King, there is no god but Thee, Thou art my Lord, and I am Thy bondman. I wronged myself and make a confession of my Sin. Forgive all my sins, for no one forgives the sins but Thee, and guide me in the best of conduct for none but Thee guideth anyone (in) good conduct. Remove sins from me, for none else but Thou can remove sins from me. Here I am at Thy service, and Grace is to Thee and the whole of good is in Thine hand, and one cannot get nearneststo Thee through evil. My (power as well as existence) is due to Thee (Thine grace) and I turn to Thee (for supplication). Thou art blessed and Thou art exalted. I seek forgiveness from Thee and turn to Thee in repentance: and when he would bow, he would say: O Allah, it is for Thee that I bowed. I affirm my faith in Thee and I submit to Thee, and submit humbly before Thee my hearing, my eyesight, my marrow, my bone, my sinew; and when he would raise his head, he would say: O Allah, our Lord, praise is due to Thee, (the praise) with which is filled the heavens and the earth, and with which is filled that (space) which exists between them, and filled with anything that Thou desireth afterward. And when he prostrated himself, he (the Holy Prophet) would say: O Allah, it is to Thee that I prostrate myself and it is in Thee that I affirm my faith, and I submit to Thee. My face is submitted before One Who created it, and shaped it, and opened his faculties of hearing and seeing. Blessed is Allah, the best of Creators; and he would then say between Tashahhud and the pronouncing of salutation: Forgive me of the earlier and later open and secret (sins) and that where I made transgression and that Thou knowest better than I. Thou art the First and the Last. There is no god, but Thee.
hi: Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ne bayan kiya ki jab Rasoolullah (SAW) raat ko namaz ke liye uthte, to woh kehte: "Maine apna chehra poori ekaagrata se us hasti ki taraf mod diya jo aasmaan aur zameen ka paida karne wala hai aur main mushrikeen mein se nahi hoon. Yaqeenan meri namaz, meri qurbani, mera jeena aur mera marna Allah, jo saare jahaanon ka Rab hai, ke liye hai; Uska koi shareek nahi hai aur yehi mujhe hukum diya gaya hai, maanne aur yaqeen karne ke liye, aur main momino mein se hoon. Aye Allah, Tu Baadshah hai, Tere siwa koi ma'bood nahi hai, Tu mera Rab hai, aur main Tera banda hoon. Maine apne aap par zulm kiya aur main apne gunah ka iqraar karta hoon. Mere saare gunah maaf kar de, kyunki Tere siwa koi gunah maaf nahi karta, aur mujhe behtareen akhlaaq ki hidayat de kyunki Tere siwa koi kisi ko achhe akhlaaq ki hidayat nahi de sakta. Mujhse gunahon ko door kar de, kyunki Tere siwa koi mujhse gunahon ko door nahi kar sakta. Main Teri khidmat mein haazir hoon, aur sara fazl Tera hai aur sari bhalaai Tere haath mein hai, aur buraai ke zariye Tere qareeb nahi hua ja sakta. Meri taaqat aur wajood Teri hi wajah se hai aur main Teri taraf dua ke liye rujoo karta hoon. Tu Mubaarak hai aur Tu Buland hai. Main Tujhse maafi maangta hoon aur Teri taraf tauba karta hoon"; aur jab woh ruku karte, to woh kehte: "Aye Allah, ye Teri hi khaatir hai ki maine ruku kiya. Main Tujhpar imaan laata hoon aur main Tera farmaanbardaar hoon, aur main Tere saamne apna sunna, apni nazar, apni maghz ki haddiyan, apni haddiyan, apne pattho ko jhukata hoon"; aur jab woh apna sar uthate, to woh kehte: "Aye Allah, hamare Rab, Teri hi hamd hai, itni hamd ki aasmaan aur zameen bhar jaayein, aur woh bhi bhar jaaye jo unke darmiyan hai, aur woh bhi bhar jaaye jo Tu iske baad chahe." Aur jab woh sajda karte, to unhone kaha: "Aye Allah, ye Teri hi khaatir hai ki main sajda karta hoon aur Tujhi par main imaan rakhta hoon, aur main Tera farmaanbardaar hoon. Mera chehra usi hasti ke saamne jhuka hai jisne ise banaya, aur ise shakl di, aur uske sunne aur dekhne ki salaahiyaton ko khola. Mubaarak hai Allah, sabse behtareen paida karne wala"; aur phir woh tashahhud aur salaam ke darmiyan kehte: "Mujhe mere pehle aur baad ke, khule aur chhupe gunah maaf kar de aur jo mujhse hadd se aage nikal gaya ho aur jo Tu mujhse behtar jaanta hai. Tu Awwal hai aur Tu Aakhir hai. Tere siwa koi ma'bood nahi hai."

e: A'raj reported that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would start the prayer, he would pronounce takbir (Allah-o-Akbar) and then say: I turn my face (up to Thee), I am the first of the believers; and when he raised his head from ruku' he said: Allah listened to him who praised Him; O our Lord, praise be to Thee; and he said: He shaped (man) and how fine is his shape? And he (the narrator) said: When he pronounced salutation he said: O Allah, forgive me my earlier (sins), to the end of the hadith; and he did not say it between the Tashahhud and salutation (as mentioned above).
hi: A'raj ne bayan kiya ki jab Rasoolullah (SAW) namaz shuru karte, to woh takbeer, Allahu Akbar, kehte aur phir kehte: Maine apna chehra Teri taraf mod diya, main sabse pehla momino mein se hoon; aur jab woh ruku se apna sar uthate, to woh kehte: Allah ne uski suni jisne uski hamd ki; Aye hamare Rab, Teri hi hamd hai; aur woh kehte: Usne insaan ko banaya aur kitni khoob shakl banaayi hai. Aur raawi ne kaha: Jab woh salaam pheerte to woh kehte: Aye Allah, mujhe mere pehle gunah maaf kar de, hadees ke akhir tak; aur unhone ise tashahhud aur salaam ke darmiyan nahi kaha jaisa upar zikr hua.

e: Hudhaifa reported: I prayed with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) one night and he started reciting al-Baqara. I thought that he would bow at the end of one hundred verses, but he proceeded on; I then thought that he would perhaps recite the whole (surah) in a rak'ah, but he proceeded and I thought he would perhaps bow on completing (this surah). He then started al-Nisa', and recited it; he then started Al-i-'Imran and recited leisurely. And when he recited the verses which referred to the Glory of Allah, he glorified (by saying Subhan Allah-Glory to my Lord the Great), and when he recited the verses which tell (how the Lord) is to be begged, he (the Holy Prophet) would then beg (from Him), and when he recited the verses dealing with protection from the Lord, he sought (His) protection and would then bow and say: Glory be to my Mighty Lord; his bowing lasted about the same length of time as his standing (and then on returning to the standing posture after ruku') he would say: Allah listened to him who praised Him, and he would then stand about the same length of time as he had spent in bowing. He would then prostrate himself and say: Glory be to my Lord most High, and his prostration lasted nearly the same length of time as his standing. In the hadith transmitted by Jarir the words are:" He (the Holy Prophet) would say:" Allah listened to him who praised Him, our Lord, to Thee i the praise."
hi: Hudhaifa (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine ek raat Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath namaz padhi aur unhone Surah Baqara padhna shuru ki. Maine socha ki woh sau aayaton ke baad ruku karenge, lekin woh aage badhte rahe; phir maine socha ki shayad woh poori surah ek rakat mein padhenge, lekin woh aage badhte rahe aur maine socha ki shayad woh is surah ko mukammal karke ruku karenge. Phir unhone Surah An-Nisa shuru ki, aur ise padha; phir unhone Surah Al-e-Imran shuru ki aur itminaan se padha. Aur jab woh un aayaton ko padhte jinmein Allah ki azmat ka zikr hota, to woh tasbeeh karte, Subhan Allah kehte - Allah ki tasbeeh, jo Buland hai, aur jab woh un aayaton ko padhte jinmein bataya jaata hai ki Rab se kaise maanga jaaye, to woh phir Usse maangte, aur jab woh un aayaton ko padhte jinmein Rab ki panah ka zikr hota, to woh Uski panah maangte aur phir ruku karte aur kehte: Meri buland Rab ki tasbeeh hai; unka ruku unke qiyaam jitni hi der tak chalta aur phir ruku se seedhe hote hue woh kehte: Allah ne uski suni jisne uski hamd ki, aur phir woh utni hi der tak khade rehte jitni der unhone ruku mein guzaari thi. Phir woh sajda karte aur kehte: Meri buland Rab ki tasbeeh hai, aur unka sajda unke qiyaam jitni hi der tak chalta. Jarir ki bayan ki hui hadees mein alfaaz hain: "Woh kehte: Allah ne uski suni jisne uski hamd ki, Aye hamare Rab, Teri hi hamd hai."

e: 'Abdullah reported: I prayed with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he lengthened it till I entertained an evil thought. It was said to him what that thought was. He said: I thought that I should sit down and forsake him.
hi: Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath namaz padhi aur unhone ise itna lamba kiya ki mere zehan mein ek buri soch aayi. Unse poocha gaya ki woh soch kya thi. Unhone kaha: Maine socha ki main baith jaun aur unhe chhod dun.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated by A'mash with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees A'mash ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: 'Abdullah (b. Mas'ud) reported that a mention was made of a man who slept the whole night till morning. He (the Holy Prophet) remarked: That is a man in whose ears (or in whose ear) the devil urinated.
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs ka zikr hua jo poori raat subah tak sota raha. Unhone farmaya: Ye woh shakhs hai jiske kaanon mein, ya jiske kaan mein, shaitaan ne peshaab kiya.

e: Husain b. 'Ali narrated on the authority of (his father) 'Ali b. Abu Talib that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came one night to see him ('Ali) and Fatimah (the daughter of the Holy Prophet) and said: Don't you observe (Tahajjud) prayer? I ('Ali) said: Messenger of Allah, verily our souls are in the hands of Allah and when He wants to awaken us, He awakens us. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went back when I said this to him. He was striking his hand on his thigh while returning, and I heard him say: Verily the man disputes with many things.
hi: Husain bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne apne walid Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ek raat unhe Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko aur Fatima (Alayhas Salam), Nabi ki beti, ko dekhne aaye aur kaha: Kya tum Tahajjud ki namaz nahi padhte? Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, hamari roohein Allah ke haath mein hain, aur jab Woh humein jagana chahega, Woh humein jaga dega. Rasoolullah (SAW) jab maine unse ye kaha to wapas laut gaye. Woh wapas jaate hue apni raan par apna haath maar rahe the, aur maine unhe kehte suna: Yaqeenan insaan bahut si baaton par bahas karta hai.

e: Abu Huraira transmitted it from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): When any one of you goes to sleep, the devil ties three knots at the back of his neck, sealing every knot with:" You have a long night, so sleep." So if one awakes and mentions Allah, a knot will be loosened; if he performs ablution two knots are loosened; and if he prays (all) knots will be loosened, and in the morning he will be active and in good spirits; otherwise we will be in bad spirits and sluggish in the morning.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne ise Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki: Jab tum mein se koi sone jaata hai, to shaitaan uski gardan ke peeche teen gaanthein baandhta hai, har gaanth par ye mohar lagate hue: "Tumhari raat lambi hai, is liye sote raho." To agar woh jaage aur Allah ka zikr kare, to ek gaanth khul jaati hai; agar woh wuzu kare to do gaanthein khul jaati hain; aur agar woh namaz padhe to sari gaanthein khul jaati hain, aur subah woh phurtila aur khush-mizaaj hoga; warna woh subah bad-mizaaj aur susta hoga.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Observe some of your prayers in your houses and do not make them graves.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Apni kuch namazein apne gharon mein padho aur unhe qabristan mat banao.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Pray in your houses, and do not make them graves.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Apne gharon mein namaz padho, aur unhe qabristan mat banao.

e: Jabir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When any one of you observes prayer in the mosque he should reserve a part of his prayer for his house, for Allah would make the prayer as a means of betterment in his house.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Jab tum mein se koi masjid mein namaz padhe, to use apni namaz ka kuch hissa apne ghar ke liye bhi bacha kar rakhna chahiye, kyunki Allah us namaz ko uske ghar mein bhalaai ka zariya banayega.

e: Abu Musa reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: The house in which remembrance of Allah is made and the house in which Allah is not remembered are like the living and the dead.
hi: Abu Musa (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Woh ghar jismein Allah ka zikr hota hai aur woh ghar jismein Allah ka zikr nahi hota, unki misaal zinda aur murda jaisi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Do not make your houses as graveyards. Satan runs away from the house in which Surah Baqara is recited.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Apne gharon ko qabristan mat banao. Shaitaan us ghar se bhaag jaata hai jismein Surah Baqara padhi jaati hai.

e: Zaid b. Thabit reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) made an apartment with the help of the leaves of date trees or of mats. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went out to pray in it. People followed him and came to pray with him. Then they again came one night and waited (for him), but the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) delayed in coming out to them. And when he did not come out, they cried aloud and threw pebbles at the door. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came out in anger and said to them: By what you have been constantly doing, I was inclined to think that it (prayer) might not become obligatory for you. So you must observe prayer (optional) in your houses, for the prayer observed by a man in the house is better except an obligatory prayer.
hi: Zaid bin Thabit (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne khajoor ke pattoon ya chataayiyon ki madad se ek kamra banaya. Rasoolullah (SAW) usmein namaz padhne ke liye nikle. Log unke peeche gaye aur unke saath namaz padhne aaye. Phir woh dobara ek raat aaye aur unka intezaar kiya, lekin Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unke paas aane mein der kar di. Aur jab woh nahi aaye, to unhone zor se aawaaz lagayi aur darwaze par kankariyan phenki. Rasoolullah (SAW) gusse mein bahar aaye aur unse kaha: Jo tum musalsal karte rahe ho, usse mujhe lagne laga ki kahin ye namaz tumpar farz na ho jaaye. Is liye tumhe nafil namaz apne gharon mein padhni chahiye, kyunki ghar mein padhi gayi namaz behtar hai, siwaay farz namaz ke.

e: Zaid b. Thabit reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) made an apartment in the mosque of mats, and he observed in it prayers for many nights till people began to gather around him, and the rest of the hadith is the same but with this addition: " Had this (Nafl) prayer become obligatory for you, you would not be able to observe it."
hi: Zaid bin Thabit (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne masjid mein chataayiyon ka ek kamra banaya, aur unhone usmein kayi raaton tak namaz padhi yahan tak ki log unke aas-paas jama hone lage, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai lekin is izafe ke saath: "Agar ye nafil namaz tumpar farz ho jaati, to tum ise ada nahi kar paate."

e: 'A'isha reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had a mat and he used it for making an apartment during the night and observed prayer in it, and the people began to pray with him, and he spread it (the mat) during the day time. The people crowded round him one night. He (the Holy Prophet) then said: O people, perform such acts as you are capable of doing, for Allah does not grow weary but you will get tired. The acts most pleasing to Allah are those which are done continuously, even if they are small. And it was the habit of the members of Muhammad's (ﷺ) household that whenever they did an act they did it continuously.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas ek chataayi thi aur woh use raat ko ek kamra banane mein istemal karte aur usmein namaz padhte, aur log unke saath namaz padhne lage, aur woh use din mein bichha dete. Log ek raat unke aas-paas bheed lagaane lage. Isper unhone kaha: Aye logo, aise amal karo jinki tum taaqat rakhte ho, kyunki Allah kabhi nahi thakta lekin tum thak jaoge. Allah ko sabse zyada woh amal pasand hain jo musalsal kiye jaate hain, chahe woh kitne bhi chhote hon. Aur Muhammad (SAW) ke ghar walon ki ye aadat thi ki jab bhi woh koi amal karte, to use musalsal karte.

e: 'A'isha is reported to have said that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was asked about the act most pleasing to Allah. He replied: That which is done continuously, even if it is small.
hi: Aisha (RA) se ye kaha jaata hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) se poocha gaya ki Allah ko sabse zyada kaunsa amal pasand hai. Unhone jawab diya: Woh jo musalsal kiya jaaye, chahe woh chhota hi ho.

e: Alqama reported: I asked 'A'isha, the mother of the believers, saying O mother of the believers, how did the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) act? Did he choose a particular act for a particular day? She said: No. He act was continuous, and who amongst you is capable of doing what the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did?
hi: Alqama ne bayan kiya: Maine Ummul-Momineen Aisha (RA) se poocha: Aye Ummul-Momineen, Rasoolullah (SAW) kaise amal karte the? Kya woh kisi khaas din ke liye koi khaas amal chunte the? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Unka amal musalsal hota tha, aur tum mein se kaun aisa hai jo woh kar sake jo Rasoolullah (SAW) kiya karte the?

e: 'A'isha reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The acts most pleasing to Allah are those which are done continuously, even if they are small. and when 'A'isha did any act she did it continuously.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Allah ko sabse zyada pasand aane wale amal woh hain jo musalsal kiye jaayein, chahe woh chhote hi hon, aur jab Aisha koi amal karti thin, to woh use musalsal karti thin.

e: Anas reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) entered the mosque (and he found) a rope tied between the two pillars; so he said: What is this? They said: It is for Zainab. She prays and when she slackens or feels tired she holds it. Upon this he (the Holy Prophet) said: Untie it. Let one pray as long as one feels fresh but when one slackens or becomes tired one must stop it. (And in the hadith transmitted by Zuhair it is:" He should sit down." )
hi: Anas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) masjid mein daakhil hue aur unhone dekha ki do khambon ke darmiyan ek rassi baandhi hui thi; to unhone kaha: Ye kya hai? Unhone kaha: Ye Zainab ke liye hai. Woh namaz padhti hain aur jab woh dhili pad jaati hain ya thak jaati hain, to woh ise pakad leti hain. Isper unhone kaha: Ise khol do. Namaz padho jab tak taaza ho, lekin jab dhile pad jao ya thak jao to ruk jao. Aur Zuhair ki bayan ki hui hadees mein hai: "Use baith jaana chahiye."

e: A hadith like this has been narrated from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the authority of Anas by another chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Anas (RA) ki sanad se Rasoolullah (SAW) se ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki gayi hai.

e: 'Urwa b. Zubair reported that 'A'isha, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), told him that (once) Haula' dint Tuwait b. Habib b. Asad b. 'Abd al-'Uzzi passed by her (at the time) when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was with her. I ('A'Isha) said: It Is Haula' bint Tuwait and they say that she does not sleep at night. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: (Oh) she does not sleep at night! Choose an act which you are capable of doing (continuously). By Allah, Allah would not grow weary, but you will grow weary.
hi: Urwa bin Zubair ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ki zauja Aisha (RA) ne unhe bataya ki ek baar Haula bint Tuwait bin Habib bin Asad bin Abdul-Uzza unke paas se guzri jab Rasoolullah (SAW) unke paas the. Maine kaha: Ye Haula bint Tuwait hain aur log kehte hain ki woh raat ko nahi soti. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Kya woh raat ko nahi soti! Woh amal chuno jise tum musalsal karne ki taaqat rakhte ho. Allah ki qasam, Allah kabhi nahi thakega, lekin tum thak jaoge.

e: 'A'isha said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to me when a woman was sitting with me. He said: Who is she? I said: She is a woman who does not sleep but prays.
