He said: Do such acts which you are capable of doing. By Allah, Allah does not grow weary but you will grow weary. The religious act most pleasing to Him is one the doer of which does it continuously. (And in the hadith transmitted by Abu Usama :" She was a woman from Banu Asad." )
hi: Aisha ne kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) mere paas aaye jab ek aurat mere saath baithi thi. Unhone kaha: Ye kaun hai? Maine kaha: Ye ek aurat hai jo sotay nahi balki namaz padhti hain. Unhone kaha: Aise amal karo jinki tum taaqat rakhte ho. Allah ki qasam, Allah kabhi nahi thakta lekin tum thak jaoge. Allah ko sabse zyada pasand aane wala deeni amal woh hai jise karne wala use musalsal kare. Aur Abu Usama ki bayan ki hui hadees mein hai: "Woh Banu Asad ki ek aurat thin."

e: 'A'isha reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: When anyone amongst you dozes in prayer, he should sleep, till sleep is gone, for when one of you prays while dozing he does not know whether he may be asking pardon or vilifying himself.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Jab tum mein se koi namaz mein unghne lage, to use so jaana chahiye, jab tak unghai khatam na ho jaaye, kyunki jab tum mein se koi unghte hue namaz padhta hai, to use pata nahi hota ki woh maafi maang raha hai ya apne aap ko bura-bhala keh raha hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When any one of you gets up at night (for prayer) and his tongue falters in (the recitation) of the Qar'an, and he does not know what he is reciting, he should go to sleep.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Jab tum mein se koi raat ko namaz ke liye uthe aur uski zubaan Quran padhne mein ladkhadaane lage, aur use pata na chale ki woh kya padh raha hai, to use so jaana chahiye.

e: 'A'isha reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) heard a person reciting the Qur'an at night. Upon this he said: May Allah show mercy to him; he has reminded me of such and such a verse which I had missed in such and such a surah.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne ek shakhs ko raat ko Quran padhte suna. Isper unhone kaha: Allah ispar rahem kare; usne mujhe ek aisi aayat yaad dilayi jo main falan surah mein bhool gaya tha.

e: 'A'isha reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) listened to the recitation of the Qur'an by a man in the mosque. Thereupon he said: May Allah have mercy upon him; be reminded me of the verse which I had been made to forget.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne masjid mein ek shakhs ki Quran tilawat suni. Isper unhone kaha: Allah ispar rahem kare; usne mujhe woh aayat yaad dilayi jo mujhe bhulwa di gayi thi.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The example of a man who has memorised the Qur'an is like that of a hobbled camel. If he remained vigilant, he would be able to retain it (with him), and if he loosened the hobbled camel it would escape.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Us aadmi ki misaal jisne Quran yaad kiya ho, ek bandhe hue oont jaisi hai. Agar woh chaukas raha, to woh use apne paas rakh paayega, aur agar usne bandhe hue oont ko dheela chhod diya, to woh bhaag jayega.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Ibn 'Umar from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), but in the hadith transmited by Musa b. 'Uqba, this addition is made: " When one who had committed the Qur'an to memory (or who is familiar with it) gets up (for night prayer) and recites it night and day, it remains fresh in his mind, but if he does not get up (for prayer and thus does not recite it) he forgets it."
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Umar (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki hai, lekin Musa bin Uqba ki bayan ki hui hadees mein ye izafa hai: "Jab jisne Quran yaad kiya ho, ya jo isse waaqif ho, raat ki namaz ke liye uthta hai aur ise raat aur din padhta hai, to ye uske zehan mein taaza rehta hai, lekin agar woh namaz ke liye nahi uthta aur is liye ise nahi padhta, to woh use bhool jaata hai."

e: 'Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: What a wretched person is he amongst them who says: I have forgotten such and such a verse. (He should instead of using this expression say): I have been made to forget it. Try to remember the Qur'an for it is more apt to escape from men's minds than a hobbled camel.
hi: Abdullah (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Woh shakhs kitna badnaseeb hai jo kehta hai: Main falan aayat bhool gaya. Uski jagah use kehna chahiye: Mujhe ye bhulwa di gayi. Quran ko yaad rakhne ki koshish karo kyunki ye insaan ke zehan se bandhe hue oont se bhi zyada aasani se nikal jaata hai.

e: 'Abdullah is reported to have said: Keep refreshing your knowledge of the sacred books (or always renew your knowledge of these sacred books) and sometimes he would mention the Qur'an for it is more apt to escape from men's minds than animals which are hobbled, and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: None of you should say: I forgot such and such a verse, but he has been made to forget.
hi: Abdullah ne, ye kaha jaata hai, kaha: Pak kitaabon ke apne ilm ko taaza rakho, ya in pak kitaabon ke ilm ko hamesha naya rakho, aur kabhi kabhi woh Quran ka zikr karte, kyunki ye bandhe hue jaanwaron se bhi zyada aasani se insaanon ke zehan se nikal jaata hai, aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Tum mein se koi ye na kahe: Main falan aayat bhool gaya, balki kahe: Use bhulwa diya gaya hai.

e: Ibn Mas'ud reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Wretched is the man who says: I forgot such and such a sura, or I forget such and such a verse, but he has been made to forget.
hi: Ibn Mas'ud (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Woh shakhs badnaseeb hai jo kehta hai: Main falan surah bhool gaya, ya main falan aayat bhool gaya, balki use bhulwaya gaya hai.

e: Abu Musa al-Ash'ari reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Keep refreshing your knowledge of the Qur'an, for I swear by Him in Whose Hand is the life of Mahammad that it is more liable to escape than camels which are hobbled.
hi: Abu Musa al-Ash'ari (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Quran ke apne ilm ko taaza rakho, kyunki us hasti ki qasam jiske haath mein Muhammad ki zindagi hai, ye bandhe hue oonton se bhi zyada aasani se nikal jaata hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported this directly from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): God has not listened to anything as He listens to a Prophet reciting the Qur'an in a sweet voice.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne ise seedhe Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki: Allah ne kisi cheez ko itni tawajjo se nahi suna jitni tawajjo se Woh kisi Nabi ko meethi aawaaz mein Quran padhte hue sunta hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Ibn Shihab with the same chain of transmitters with words: " As He listens to a Prophet reciting the Qur'an in a sweet voice."
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Shihab ne isi sanad se in alfaaz ke saath bayan ki hai: "Jitna Woh kisi Nabi ko meethi aawaaz mein Quran padhte hue sunta hai."

e: Abu Huraira is reported to have heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Allah does not listen to anything, (more approvingly) as He listens to a Prophet reciting loudly the Qur'an in a sweet voice.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Allah kisi cheez ko itni tawajjo se, mahboob rakhkar, nahi sunta jitni tawajjo se Woh kisi Nabi ko meethi, buland aawaaz mein Quran padhte hue sunta hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated with the same chain of transmitters by Ibn al-Had except this that Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying and he did not say: " He heard it."
hi: Ye hadees Ibn al-Had ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai siwaay is baat ke ki Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone ye farmaya, aur unhone ye nahi kaha: "Unhone use suna."

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Allah has not heard anything (more pleasing) than listening to the Prophet reciting the Qur'an in a sweet loud voice.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Allah ne kisi cheez ko itna pasand karke nahi suna jitna kisi Nabi ko meethi, buland aawaaz mein Quran padhte hue sunna.

e: This hadith has been narrated by another chain of transmitters but with a slight modification of words.
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki gayi hai lekin alfaaz mein halki tabdeeli ke saath.

e: Buraida reported on the authority of his father that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had said: 'Abdullah b. Qais or al-Ash'ari has been gifted with a sweet melodious voice out of the voices of the family of David.
hi: Buraida ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya tha: Abdullah bin Qais, ya al-Ash'ari, ko Dawood (AS) ke gharane ki aawaazon mein se ek meethi, sureeli aawaaz ata ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Burda narrated on the authority of Abu Musa that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had said to Abu Musa: If you were to see me, as I was listening to your recitation (of the Qur'an) yester-night (you would have felt delighted). You are in fact endowed with a sweet voice like that of David himself.
hi: Abu Burda ne Abu Musa ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Abu Musa se kaha tha: Agar tum mujhe dekhte, jab main pichhli raat tumhari Quran ki tilawat sun raha tha, to tum khush ho jaate. Tumhe dar-asal Dawood (AS) jaisi hi meethi aawaaz ata hui hai.

e: Mu'awiya b. Qurra reported 'Abdullah b. Mughaffal al-Muzani as saying: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) recited on his ride Surat al Fath during a journey in the year of the Conquest (of Mecca), and he repeated (the words) in his recitation. Mu'awiya said: If I were not afraid that the people would crowd around me, I would have given a demonstration of (the Prophet's) recitation before you.
hi: Muawiya bin Qurra ne Abdullah bin Mughaffal al-Muzani se ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Makkah fatah ke saal ek safar ke dauran apni sawari par Surah al-Fath ki tilawat ki, aur unhone apni qiraat mein alfaaz dohraye. Muawiya ne kaha: Agar mujhe dar na hota ki log mere aas-paas jama ho jaayenge, to main tumhare saamne Nabi (SAW) ki tilawat ka namoona dikhaata.

e: Mu'awiya b. Qurra is reported to have heard 'Abdullah b. Mughaffal as saying: I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) reciting Surah Fath on his camel on the day of the Conquest of Mecca. He (the narrator) said: Ibn Mughaffal recited it and repeated it. Mu'awiya said: Had there been (no crowed of) people, I would have given a practical demonstration of that which Ibn Mughaffal had mentioned from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).
hi: Muawiya bin Qurra ne Abdullah bin Mughaffal ko ye kehte suna: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko Makkah fatah ke din apne oont par Surah Fath padhte dekha. Raawi ne kaha: Ibn Mughaffal ne ise padha aur dohraya. Muawiya ne kaha: Agar logon ki bheed na hoti, to main us cheez ka amali namoona dikhaata jo Ibn Mughaffal ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se zikr ki thi.

e: This hadlth has been narrated by Khalid al-Harith with the same chain of transmitters (with these words): (The Holy Prophet) was reciting Surat al-Fath as he was travelling on his mount.
hi: Ye hadees Khalid al-Harith ne isi sanad se in alfaaz ke saath bayan ki hai: Nabi (SAW) Surah al-Fath padh rahe the jab woh apni sawari par safar kar rahe the.

e: Al-Bara' reported that a person was reciting Surat al-Kahf and there was a horse tied with two ropes at his side, a cloud overshadowed him, and as it began to come nearer and nearer his horse began to take fright from it. He went and mentioned that to the Prophet (ﷺ) in the morning, and he (the Holy Prophet) said: That was tranquillity which came down at the recitation of the Qur'an.
hi: Al-Bara (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs Surah al-Kahf padh raha tha aur uske paas ek ghoda do rassiyon se baandha hua tha, ek baadal ne use dhaank liya, aur jaise-jaise woh qareeb aata gaya, uska ghoda usse ghabraane laga. Woh subah gaya aur Nabi (SAW) se iska zikr kiya, aur unhone farmaya: Woh sukoon tha jo Quran ki tilawat par utra.

e: Ibn Ishaq reported: I heard al-Bara' as saying that a man recited al-Kahf when an animal was there in the house and it began to take fright. And as he looked around, he found a cloud overshadowing it. He mentioned that to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). Upon this he said: O so and so, recite on (the surah) as- Sakina descends at the (recitation of the Qur'an) or on account (of the recitation) of the Qur'an.
hi: Ibn Ishaq ne bayan kiya: Maine Al-Bara ko ye kehte suna ki ek shakhs ne Surah al-Kahf padhi jab ghar mein ek jaanwar tha aur woh ghabraane laga. Aur jab usne aas-paas dekha, to usne paaya ki ek baadal use dhaank raha tha. Unhone iska zikr Rasoolullah (SAW) se kiya. Isper unhone farmaya: Aye falan, padhte raho kyunki Sakina, sukoon, Quran ki tilawat par ya Quran ki wajah se utarta hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of al-Bara' with a slight modification of words.
hi: Ye hadees Al-Bara ki sanad se alfaaz mein halki tabdeeli ke saath bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri told of Usaid b. Hudair saying that one night he recited the Qur'an in his enclosure, when the horse began to jump about. He again recited and (the horse) again jumped. He again recited and it jumped as before. Usaid said: I was afraid lest it should trample (his son) Yahya. I stood near it (the horse) and saw something like a canopy over my head with what seemed to be lamps in it, rising up in the sky till it disappeared. I went to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the next day and said: Messenger of Allah, I recited the Qur'an during the night in my enclosure and my horse began to jump. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: You should have kept on reciting, Ibn Hudair. He (Ibn Hudair) said: I recited. It jumped (as before). Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) again said: You should have kept on reciting, Ibn Hudair. He (Ibn Hudair) said: I recited and it again jumped (as before). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) again said: You should kave kept on reciting, Ibu Hudair. He (Ibn Hudair) said: (Messenger of Allah) I finished (the recitation) for Yahya was near (the horse) and I was afraid lest it should trample him. I saw something like a canopy with what seemed to be lamps in it rising up in the sky till it disappeared. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Those were the angels who listened to you; and if you had continued reciting, the people would have seen them in the morning and they would not have concealed themselves from them.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne Usaid bin Hudair ke hawale se bayan kiya ki ek raat unhone apni baadi mein Quran padha, jab ghoda uchalne laga. Unhone dobara padha aur ghoda phir uchala. Unhone dobara padha aur woh pehle jaisa hi uchala. Usaid ne kaha: Mujhe dar tha ki kahin woh, mere bete, Yahya ko na kuchal de. Main uske ghode ke paas khada hua aur maine apne sar ke upar ek chandni jaisi cheez dekhi jismein diyon jaisi cheezein thin, jo aasmaan mein upar uthti gayi yahan tak ki woh gaayab ho gayi. Main agle din Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas gaya aur kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, maine raat ko apni baadi mein Quran padha aur mera ghoda uchalne laga. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Tumhe padhna jaari rakhna chahiye tha, Ibn Hudair. Unhone kaha: Maine padha. Woh pehle jaisa uchala. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne phir kaha: Tumhe padhna jaari rakhna chahiye tha, Ibn Hudair. Unhone kaha: Maine padha aur woh phir pehle jaisa uchala. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne phir kaha: Tumhe padhna jaari rakhna chahiye tha, Ibn Hudair. Unhone kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, maine tilawat rok di kyunki Yahya ghode ke qareeb tha aur mujhe dar tha ki kahin woh use kuchal na de. Maine ek chandni jaisi cheez dekhi jismein diyon jaisi cheezein thin, jo aasmaan mein upar uthti gayi yahan tak ki woh gaayab ho gayi. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Woh farishte the jo tumhe sun rahe the; aur agar tum padhte rehte, to log subah unhe dekh paate aur woh unse khud ko chhupate nahi.

e: Abu Musa al-Ash'ari reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: A believer who recites the Qur'an is like an orange whose fragrance is sweet and whose taste is sweet; a believer who does not recite the Qur'an is like a date which has no fragrance but has a sweet taste; and the hypocrite who recites the Qur'an is like a basil whose fragrance is sweet, but whose taste is bitter; and a hypocrite who does not recite the Qur'an is like the colocynth which has no fragrance and has a bitter taste.
hi: Abu Musa al-Ash'ari (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Woh momin jo Quran padhta hai, uski misaal santare jaisi hai jiski khushboo bhi meethi hai aur jiska zaayqa bhi meetha hai; woh momin jo Quran nahi padhta, uski misaal khajoor jaisi hai jismein koi khushboo nahi hai lekin zaayqa meetha hai; aur woh munaafiq jo Quran padhta hai, uski misaal rehaan, tulsi, jaisi hai jiski khushboo meethi hai, lekin jiska zaayqa kadwa hai; aur woh munaafiq jo Quran nahi padhta, uski misaal hanzal jaisi hai jismein koi khushboo nahi hai aur jiska zaayqa kadwa hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Qatada with the same chain of transmitters but with one alteration that instead of the word: " hypocrite" (Munafiq), there it is" wicked" (fajir).
hi: Ye hadees Qatada ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai lekin ek tabdeeli ke saath ki "munaafiq" lafz ki jagah "faajir", badkaar, lafz istemal hua hai.

e: `A'isha reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (as saying): One who is proficient in the Qur'an is associated with the noble, upright, recording angels; and he who falters in it, and finds it difficult for him, will have two rewards.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone kaha: Jo Quran mein maahir hai, woh izzat wale, sacche, likhne wale farishton ke saath hoga; aur jo isme ladkhadata hai, aur ise mushkil paata hai, use dohra sawaab milega.

e: This hadith has been reported with the same chain of transmitters by Qatada except with this change: " He who finds it hard (to recite the Qur'an) will have a double reward."
hi: Ye hadees Qatada ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai siwaay is tabdeeli ke: "Jo ise mushkil paata hai, Quran padhna, use dohra sawaab milega."

e: Anas reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying to Ubayy b. Ka'b: Allah has commanded me to recite the Qur'an to you. He said: Did Allah mention me to you by name? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Allah made a mention of your name to me. (On hearing this) Ubayy b. Ka'b wept.
hi: Anas (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone Ubayy bin Ka'b se kaha: Allah ne mujhe hukum diya hai ki main tumhe Quran padhkar sunaun. Unhone kaha: Kya Allah ne mera naam lekar aapse zikr kiya? Unhone kaha: Allah ne mera zikr tumhare naam se mujhse kiya. Ye sunkar Ubayy bin Ka'b ro pade.

e: Anas reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying to Ubayy b. Ka`b: Allah has commanded me to recite to you:" Those who disbelieve were not..." (al-Qur'an, xcviii. 1). He said: Did He mention me by name? He (the Prophet said): Yes. Upon this he shed tears (of gratitude).
hi: Anas (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone Ubayy bin Ka'b se kaha: Allah ne mujhe hukum diya hai ki main tumhe padhkar sunaun: "Woh log jinhone kufr kiya..." (98:1). Unhone kaha: Kya Usne mera naam lekar zikr kiya? Unhone kaha: Haan. Isper unhone shukriye ke aansu bahaye.

e: Qatada said: I heard Anas saying that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to Ubayy the same thing.
hi: Qatada ne kaha: Maine Anas ko ye kehte suna ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Ubayy se yehi baat kahi.

e: 'Abdullah (b. Mas'ud) reported: The Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon (him) asked me to recite the Qur'an. He said: Messenger of Allah, (how) should I recite to you whereas it has been sent down to you? He (the Holy Prophet) said: I desire to hear it from someone else. So I recited Surat al-Nisa' till I reached the verse: How then shall it be when We shall bring from every people a witness and bring you against them as a witness?" (verse 41). I lifted my head or a person touched me in my side, and so I lifted my head and saw his tears falling (from the Holy Prophet's eyes).
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne mujhse Quran padhne ko kaha. Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, main aapko Quran kaise padh kar sunaun jabki ye aap par hi utaara gaya hai? Unhone kaha: Main ise kisi aur se sunna chahta hoon. To maine Surah An-Nisa padhi yahan tak ki main is aayat par pahuncha: "Phir kaisa hoga jab hum har ummat mein se ek gawaah laayenge aur tumhe unke khilaaf gawaah bana kar laayenge?" aayat 41. Maine apna sar uthaya ya kisi shakhs ne mujhe mere pehlu mein chhua, to maine apna sar utha kar dekha ki unke aansu bah rahe the.

e: This hadith has been narratted by A'mash with the same chain of transmitters but with this addition: " The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was on the pulpit when he asked me to recite to him."
hi: Ye hadees A'mash ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai lekin is izafe ke saath: "Rasoolullah (SAW) mimbar par the jab unhone mujhse Quran padhne ko kaha."

e: Ibrahim reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) asked 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud to recite to him (the Qur'an). He said: Should I recite it to you while it has been sent down or revealed to you? He (the Holy Prophet) said: I love to hear it from someone else. So he ('Abdullah b. Mas'ud) recited to him (from the beginning of Surat al Nisa' up to the verse:" How shall then it be when We bring from every people a witness and bring you as a witness against them?" He (the Holy Prophet) wept (on listening to it). It is narrated on the authority of Ibn Mas'ud through another chain of transmitters that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) also said that he had been a witness to his people as long as (said he): I lived among them or I had been among them.
hi: Ibrahim ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Abdullah bin Mas'ud se Quran padhne ko kaha. Unhone kaha: Kya main ise aapko padhkar sunaun jabki ye aap par hi utaara ya nazil kiya gaya hai? Unhone kaha: Mujhe ise kisi aur se sunna pasand hai. To unhone, Abdullah bin Mas'ud ne, unhe Surah An-Nisa ki shuruaat se lekar is aayat tak padhkar sunaya: "Phir kaisa hoga jab hum har ummat mein se ek gawaah laayenge aur tumhe unke khilaaf gawaah bana kar laayenge?" Unhone ise sunkar rona shuru kar diya. Ibn Mas'ud se ek doosri sanad se ye riwayat hui hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne ye bhi kaha ki woh apni ummat ke liye tab tak gawaah rahenge jab tak unhone kaha: Main unke beech raha, ya main unke saath tha.

e: 'Abdullah (b. Mas'ud) reported: I was in Hims when some of the people asked me to recite the Qur'an to them. So I recited Surah Yusuf to them. One of the persons among the people said: By Allah, this is not how it has been sent down. I said: Woe upon you! By Allah, I recited it to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he said to me: You have (recited) it well. I was talking with him (the man who objected to my recitation) that I sensed the smell of wine from him. So I said to him. Do you drink wine and belie the Book (of Allah)? You would not depart till I would whip you. So I lashed him according to the prescribed punishment (for the offence of drinking wine).
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud ne bayan kiya: Main Hims mein tha jab kuch logon ne mujhse Quran padhne ko kaha. To maine unhe Surah Yusuf padhkar sunayi. Unmein se ek shakhs ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, ye is tarah nazil nahi hui thi. Maine kaha: Tumpar afsos! Allah ki qasam, maine ise Rasoolullah (SAW) ko padhkar sunaya tha aur unhone mujhse kaha tha: Tumne ise achhi tarah padha hai. Main unse, us shakhs se jisne meri qiraat par aitraaz kiya tha, baat kar hi raha tha ki mujhe usse sharaab ki badboo mahsoos hui. To maine usse kaha: Kya tum sharaab peete ho aur Allah ki Kitaab ko jhutlaate ho? Tum tab tak nahi jaoge jab tak main tumhe koda na maar lun. To maine use sharaab peene ki muqarrar saza ke mutabik koda maara.

e: This hadith has been narrated by A'mash with the same chain of transmitters but with an exception that it is not mentioned in it: " He said to me: You recited (the Qur'an) well."
hi: Ye hadees A'mash ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai lekin is farq ke saath ki isme zikr nahi hai: "Unhone mujhse kaha: Tumne Quran achhi tarah padha."

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Would any one of you like, when he returns to his family, to find there three large, fat, pregnant she-camels? We said: Yes. Upon this he said: Three verses that one of you recites in his prayer are better for him than three large, fat, pregnant she-camels.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Kya tum mein se koi pasand karega ki jab woh apne gharwalon ke paas laute, to use wahan teen badi, moti-taazi, hamil-oontniyaan milein? Humne kaha: Haan. Isper unhone farmaya: Teen aayaten jo koi apni namaz mein padhta hai, uske liye teen badi, moti-taazi, hamil-oontniyon se behtar hain.

e: 'Uqba b. 'Amir reported: When we were in Suffa, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came out and said: Which of you would like to go out every morning to Buthan or al-'Aqiq and bring two large she-camels without being guilty of sin or without severing the ties of kinship? We said: Messenger of Allah, we would like to do it. Upon this he said: Does not one of you go out in the morning to the mosque and teach or recite two verses from the Book of Allah. the Majestic and Glorious? That is better for him than two she-camels, and three verses are better (than three she-camels). and four verses are better for him than four (she-camels), and to on their number in camels.
hi: Uqba bin Aamir (RA) ne bayan kiya: Jab hum Suffa mein the, Rasoolullah (SAW) bahar aaye aur kaha: Tum mein se kaun pasand karega ki har subah Buthan ya al-Aqiq jaaye aur do badi oontniyaan le aaye bina kisi gunah ya rishtedaari todne ke? Humne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, hum ye karna pasand karenge. Isper unhone farmaya: Kya tum mein se koi subah masjid nahi jaata aur Allah, jo Buland aur Azeem hai, ki Kitaab se do aayaten nahi sikhaata ya padhta? Ye uske liye do oontniyon se behtar hai, aur teen aayaten teen oontniyon se behtar hain, aur char aayaten char oontniyon se behtar hain, aur isi tarah oonton ki tadaad ke hisaab se.

e: Abu Umama said he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say: Recite the Qur'an, for on the Day of Resurrection it will come as an intercessor for those who recite It. Recite the two bright ones, al-Baqara and Surah Al 'Imran, for on the Day of Resurrection they will come as two clouds or two shades, or two flocks of birds in ranks, pleading for those who recite them. Recite Surah al-Baqara, for to take recourse to it is a blessing and to give it up is a cause of grief, and the magicians cannot confront it. (Mu'awiya said: It has been conveyed to me that here Batala means magicians.)
hi: Abu Umama ne kaha ki unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Quran padho, kyunki Qayamat ke din ye apne padhne walon ke liye shafaa'at karne wale ke taur par aayega. Do roshan surahtein padho, al-Baqara aur Surah Al-e-Imran, kyunki Qayamat ke din woh do baadal, ya do saaye, ya safon mein udte hue do parindon ke jhund ki tarah aayengi, apne padhne walon ke liye guzarish karte hue. Surah al-Baqara padho, kyunki ise apnaana barkat hai aur ise chhodna afsos ka baais hai, aur jaadugar iska muqaabla nahi kar sakte. Muawiya ne kaha: Mujhe bataya gaya hai ki yahan "Batala" ka matlab jaadugar hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Mu'awiya with the same chain of transmitters but with this exception that in this the words of Mu'awiya: " It has been conveyed to me..." have not been mentioned.
hi: Ye hadees Muawiya ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai lekin is farq ke saath ki ismein Muawiya ke alfaaz "Mujhe bataya gaya hai..." ka zikr nahi hai.

e: An-Nawwas b. Sam'an said he heard the Apostle (ﷺ) say: On the Day of Resurrection the Qur'an and those who acted according to it will be brought with Surah al-Baqara and AI 'Imran preceding them. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) likened them to three things, which I did not forget afterwards. He (the Holy Prophet) likened them to two clouds, or two black canopies with light between them, or like two flocks of birds in ranks pleading for one who recited them.
hi: An-Nawwas bin Sam'an ne kaha ki unhone Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Qayamat ke din Quran aur jinhone iske mutabik amal kiya unhe laaya jayega, aur Surah al-Baqara aur Al-e-Imran unke aage honge. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unhe teen cheezon se tashbeeh di, jinhe main uske baad kabhi nahi bhoola. Unhone unhe do baadalon, ya do kaali chhatriyon jinke beech roshni ho, ki tarah tashbeeh di, ya safon mein udte hue do parindon ke jhund ki tarah, apne padhne walon ke liye guzarish karte hue.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported that while Gabriel was sitting with the Apostle (ﷺ) he heard a creaking sound above him. He lifted his head and said: This is a gate opened in heaven today which had never been opened before. Then when an angel descended through it, he said: This is an angel who came down to the earth who had never come down before. He greeted and said: Rejoice in two lights given to you which have not been given to any prophet before you: Fatihat al-Kitab and the concluding verses of Surah al-Baqara. You will never recite a letter from them for which you will not be given (a reward).
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab Jibra'eel Rasool (SAW) ke saath baithe hue the, to unhone apne upar ek chirchiraahat ki aawaaz suni. Unhone apna sar utha kar kaha: Ye aasmaan mein aaj khula ek darwaza hai jo isse pehle kabhi nahi khula tha. Phir jab ek farishta usse utra, to unhone kaha: Ye ek farishta hai jo zameen par utra hai jo isse pehle kabhi nahi utra tha. Usne salaam kiya aur kaha: Khush ho jao do noor jo tumhe diye gaye hain jo tumse pehle kisi Nabi ko nahi diye gaye: Fatiha-tul-Kitaab, Surah al-Fatiha, aur Surah al-Baqara ki aakhri aayaten. Tum inmein se koi bhi harf nahi padhoge jiske liye tumhe sawaab na diya jaaye.

e: 'Abd al-Rahman b. Yazid reported: I met Abu Mas'ud near the House (Ka'ba) and said to him: A hadith has been conveyed to me on your authority about the two (concluding verses of Surah al-Baqara. He said: Yes. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) (in fact) said: Anyone who recites the two verses at the end of Surah al-Baqara at night, they would suffice for him.
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Yazid ne bayan kiya: Main Abu Mas'ud se Ka'ba ke paas mila aur unse kaha: Mujhe aapke hawale se Surah al-Baqara ki do aakhri aayaton ke baare mein ek hadees pahunchi hai. Unhone kaha: Haan. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne dar-asal kaha: Jo koi raat ko Surah al-Baqara ki aakhri do aayaten padhe, woh uske liye kaafi honge.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Mansur with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Mansur ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: Abu Mas'ud reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If anyone recites the two verses at the end of Surah al-Baqara at night, they would suffice for him 'Abd al-Rahman said: I met Abu Mas'ud and he was circumambulating the House (of Allah) and asked him about this (tradition) and he narrated it to me from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).
hi: Abu Mas'ud (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Agar koi raat ko Surah al-Baqara ki aakhri do aayaten padhe, woh uske liye kaafi honge. Abdur-Rahman ne kaha: Main Abu Mas'ud se mila aur woh Baitullah ka tawaaf kar rahe the aur maine unse iske baare mein poocha aur unhone mujhse ise Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat kiya.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated by Abu Mas'ud from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Abu Mas'ud ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki hai.

e: It is through another chain of transmitters that this hadith has been reported by Abu Mas'ud from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).
hi: Ye hadees Abu Mas'ud ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se ek doosri sanad ke zariye bhi bayan ki hai.

e: Abu Darda' reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: If anyone learns by heart the first ten verses of the Surah al-Kahf, he will be protected from the Dajjal.
hi: Abu Darda (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Agar koi Surah al-Kahf ki pehli das aayaten yaad kar le, to use Dajjal se hifazat mil jayegi.

e: This hadith has been transmitted by Qatada with the same chain of transmitters. But Shu'ba (one of the narrators) said: At the end of Surah al-Kahf, but Hammam said: At the beginning of Surah al-Kahf.
hi: Ye hadees Qatada ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai. Lekin Shu'ba, raawiyon mein se ek, ne kaha: Surah al-Kahf ke akhir mein, lekin Hammam ne kaha: Surah al-Kahf ki shuruaat mein.

e: Ubayy b. Ka'b said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: O Abu' al-Mundhir, do you know the verse from the Book of Allah which, according to you, is the greatest? I said: Allah and His Apostle (ﷺ) know best. He again said: Abu'l-Mundhir, do you know the verse from the Book of Allah which, according to you, is the greatest? I said: Allah, there is no god but He, the Living, the Eternal. Thereupon he struck me on my breast and said: May knowledge be pleasant for you, O Abu'l-Mundhir!
hi: Ubayy bin Ka'b ne kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Aye Abu'l-Mundhir, kya tumhe pata hai Allah ki Kitaab ki kaunsi aayat, tumhare khayal mein, sabse azeem hai? Maine kaha: Allah aur uske Rasool (SAW) behtar jaante hain. Unhone dobara poocha: Abu'l-Mundhir, kya tumhe pata hai Allah ki Kitaab ki kaunsi aayat, tumhare khayal mein, sabse azeem hai? Maine kaha: "Allahu la ilaha illa huwal hayyul qayyum" - Allah, uske siwa koi ma'bood nahi, Hamesha Zinda, Sabka Sambhaale Rakhne Wala. Isper unhone mere seene par haath se maara aur kaha: Ilm tumhare liye khushi ka baais ho, Aye Abu'l-Mundhir!

e: Abu Darda' reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Is any one of you incapable of reciting a third of the Qur'an in a night? They (the Companions) asked: How could one recite a third of the Qur'an (in a night)? Upon this he (the Holy Prophet) said: "'Say: He is Allah, One' (Qur'an. cxii) is equivalent to a third of the Qur'an."
hi: Abu Darda (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Kya tum mein se koi ek raat mein Quran ka teesra hissa padhne mein asamarth hai? Unhone poocha: Koi Quran ka teesra hissa ek raat mein kaise padh sakta hai? Isper unhone kaha: "Qul huwallahu ahad" (112) Quran ke teesre hisse ke barabar hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Qatada with the same chain of transmitters in these words: He (the Messenger of Allah) said: Allah divided the Qur'an into three parts, and he made:" Say: He, Allah is One." one part out of the (three) parts of the Qur'an.
hi: Ye hadees Qatada ne isi sanad se in alfaaz mein bayan ki hai: Unhone kaha: Allah ne Quran ko teen hisson mein baanta, aur "Qul huwallahu ahad" ko Quran ke teen hisson mein se ek hissa banaya.

e: It is reported on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Get together. for I am going to recite one-third of the Qur'an before you. And those who could get together gathered there. Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came out and recited:" Say: He, Allah, is One." He then entered (his house). Some of us said to the others: Perhaps there has been some news from the heaven on account of which he has gone Inside (the house). The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) again came out and said: I told you that I was going to recite one-third of the Qur'in; keep in mind, this (Surah Ikhlas) is equivalent to one-third of the Qur'an.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Ikattha ho jao, kyunki main tumhare saamne Quran ka ek-tihaai hissa padhne wala hoon. Aur jo ikattha ho sakte the, wahan jama ho gaye. Phir Rasoolullah (SAW) bahar aaye aur padha: "Qul huwallahu ahad." Phir woh ghar ke andar chale gaye. Humme se kuch ne doosron se kaha: Shayad aasmaan se koi khabar aayi hogi jiski wajah se woh andar gaye. Rasoolullah (SAW) phir bahar aaye aur kaha: Maine tumse kaha tha ki main Quran ka teesra hissa padhne wala hoon; yaad rakho, ye Surah Ikhlas Quran ke teesre hisse ke barabar hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came out to us and said: I am going to recite before you one-third of the Qur'an. He (the Holy Prophet) then recited:" Say: He is Allah, One--Allah, the Eternal," to the end of the Surah.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) humare paas aaye aur kaha: Main tumhare saamne Quran ka teesra hissa padhne wala hoon. Unhone phir padha: "Qul huwallahu ahad, Allahus-samad," surah ke akhir tak.

e: 'A'isha reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent a man in charge of an expedition and he would recite for his Companions during their prayer, ending (recitation) with:" Say, He is God, One." When they returned mention was made of it to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He (the Holy Prophet) told them to ask him why he had done like that. So they asked him and he said: Verily, it is an attribute of the Compassionate One, and (for this reason) I love to recite it. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) thereupon said: Inform him that Allah loves him.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne ek shakhs ko ek muhim ka zimmedaar banakar bheja aur woh apne sathiyon ke liye namaz mein qiraat "Qul huwallahu ahad" padhkar khatam karte the. Jab woh wapas aaye, to iska zikr Rasoolullah (SAW) se kiya gaya. Unhone unse kaha ki us shakhs se poochho ki usne aisa kyun kiya. To unhone usse poocha aur usne kaha: Yaqeenan ye Rahman, Allah, ki ek sifat hai, aur isi wajah se mujhe ise padhna pasand hai. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Usse bata do ki Allah use mohabbat karta hai.

e: 'Uqba b. 'Amir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: What wonderful verses have been sent down today. the like of which has never been seen! They are:" Say: I seek refuge with the Lord of the dawn," and" Say: I seek refuge with the Lord of men."
hi: Uqba bin Aamir (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Aaj kitni ajeeb aayaten nazil hui hain, jaisi pehle kabhi nahi dekhi gayi thin! Woh hain: "Kaho: Main subah ke Rab ki panah maangta hoon," aur "Kaho: Main logon ke Rab ki panah maangta hoon."

e: 'Uqba b. 'Amir reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me: There have been sent down to me verses the like of which had never been seen before. They are the Mu'awwadhatain.
hi: Uqba bin Aamir (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne mujhse kaha: Mujhpar aisi aayaten nazil hui hain jaisi pehle kabhi nahi dekhi gayi thin. Woh Mu'awwadhatain, Surah Falaq aur Surah Naas, hain.

e: This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters directly from the Companions of Muhammad (ﷺ).
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se seedhe Muhammad (SAW) ke sahaba se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Salim narrated on the authority of his father (Ibn 'Umar) that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Envy is not justified but in case of two persons only: one who, having been given (knowledge of) the Qur'an by Allah, recites it during the night and day (and also acts upon it) and a man who, having been given wealth by God, spends it during the night and the day (for the welfare of others. seeking the pleasure of the Lord).
hi: Salim ne apne walid, Ibn Umar, ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Rashk sirf do logon ke maamle mein jaayaz hai: ek woh jise Allah ne Quran ka ilm diya ho aur woh use raat aur din padhta ho aur uspar amal bhi karta ho, aur doosra woh shakhs jise Allah ne maal diya ho aur woh use raat aur din, logon ki bhalaai ke liye, Rab ki raza chahte hue, kharch karta ho.

e: Salim son of Abdullah b. 'Umar is reported to have said on the authority of his father that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed: Envy is not justified but in case of two persons only: one who, having been given (knowledge of) the Qur'an by Allah, recites it during the night and during the day (and acts upon it), and the person who, having been given wealth by God, gives it in charity during the night and the day.
hi: Salim, Abdullah bin Umar ke bete, ne apne walid ke hawale se ye bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Rashk sirf do logon ke maamle mein jaayaz hai: ek woh jise Allah ne Quran ka ilm diya ho aur woh use raat aur din padhta ho aur uspar amal karta ho, aur woh shakhs jise Allah ne maal diya ho aur woh use raat aur din sadqe mein deta ho.

e: 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There should be no envy but only in case of two persons: one having been endowed with wealth and power to spend it in the cause of Truth, and (the other) who has been endowed with wisdom and he decides cases with the help of it and teaches it (to others).
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Rashk sirf do logon ke maamle mein jaayaz hai: ek jise maal aur usse haq ki raah mein kharch karne ki taaqat di gayi ho, aur doosra jise hikmat di gayi ho aur woh iski madad se faisle karta ho aur ise doosron ko sikhata ho.

e: 'Amir b. Wathila reported that Nafi' b. 'Abd al-Harith met 'Umar at 'Usfan and 'Umar had employed him as collector in Mecca. He (Hadrat 'Umar) said to him (Nafi'): Whom have you appointed as collector over the people of the valley? He said: Ibn Abza. He said: Who is Ibn Abza? He said: He is one of our freed slaves. He (Hadrat 'Umar) said: So you have appointed a freed slave over them. He said: He is well versed In the Book of Allah. the Exalted and Great, and he is well versed In the commandments and injunctions (of the Shari'ah). 'Umar said: So the Prophet (ﷺ) said: By this Book, Allah would exalt some peoples and degrade others.
hi: Aamir bin Wathila ne bayan kiya ki Nafi' bin Abdul-Harith Usfaan mein Umar (RA) se mile aur Umar ne unhe Makkah mein wasooli-kaar muqarrar kiya tha. Unhone unse kaha: Tumne wadi ke logon par kis ko wasooli-kaar muqarrar kiya hai? Unhone kaha: Ibn Abza. Unhone kaha: Ibn Abza kaun hai? Unhone kaha: Woh hamare aazad kiye hue ghulamon mein se ek hai. Unhone kaha: To tumne unpar ek aazad kiye hue ghulam ko muqarrar kar diya. Unhone kaha: Woh Allah, jo Buland aur Azeem hai, ki Kitaab ka achha ilm rakhta hai, aur woh Shariat ke ahkaam aur hukmon mein bhi achhi tarah maahir hai. Umar ne kaha: Isper Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Is Kitaab ki wajah se, Allah kuch qaumon ko buland karega aur doosron ko past karega.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Zuhri through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ne ek doosri sanad ke zariye bayan ki hai.

e: 'Umar b. Khattab said: I heard Hisham b. Hakim b. Hizam reciting Surah al-Furqan in a style different from that in which I used to recite it, and in which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had taught me to recite it. I was about to dispute with him (on this style) but I delayed till he had finished that (the recitation). Then I caught hold of his cloak and brought him to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: Messenger of Allah, I heard this man reciting Surah al-Furqan in a style different from the one in which you taught me to recite. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) told (me) to leave him alone and asked him to recite. He then recited in the style in which I beard him recite it. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) then said: Thus was it sent down. He then told me to recite and I recited it, and he said: Thus was it sent down. The Qur'an was sent down in seven dialects. So recite what seems easy therefrom.
hi: Umar bin Khattab ne kaha: Maine Hisham bin Hakim bin Hizam ko Surah al-Furqan ek aise andaaz mein padhte suna jo us andaaz se alag tha jismein main ise padha karta tha, aur jismein Rasoolullah (SAW) ne mujhe ise padhna sikhaya tha. Main unse is andaaz par bahas karne wala tha lekin maine intezaar kiya yahan tak ki unhone ise mukammal kar liya. Phir maine unka kapda pakda aur unhe Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas laaya aur kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, maine is shakhs ko Surah al-Furqan ko us andaaz se alag andaaz mein padhte suna hai jismein aapne mujhe padhna sikhaya. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne mujhse kaha ki main unhe chhod dun aur unhe padhne ko kaha. Unhone phir usi andaaz mein padha jismein maine unhe padhte suna tha. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne phir farmaya: Isi tarah ye nazil hui thi. Unhone phir mujhse padhne ko kaha aur maine ise padha, aur unhone kaha: Isi tarah ye nazil hui thi. Quran saat lehjon mein nazil hua tha. Is liye inmein se jo aasaan lage woh padho.

e: This hadith has been transmitted thus by 'Umar b. Khattab (with a slight change of words): " I heard Hisham b. Hakim reciting Surah al-Furqan during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." The rest is the same but with this addition:" I was about to catch hold of him in prayer, but I exercised patience till he pronounced salutation.
hi: Ye hadees Umar bin Khattab ne is tarah bayan ki hai, alfaaz mein halki tabdeeli ke saath: "Maine Hisham bin Hakim ko Rasoolullah (SAW) ke daur mein Surah al-Furqan padhte suna." Baaki waisa hi hai lekin is izafe ke saath: "Main unhe namaz mein pakadne wala tha, lekin maine sabar kiya yahan tak ki unhone salaam pheera."

e: This hadith has been transmitted by Zuhri.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ne bayan ki hai.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Gabriel taught me to recite in one style. I replied to him and kept asking him to give more (styles), till he reached seven modes (of recitation). Ibn Shibab said: It has reached me that these seven styles are essentially one, not differing about what is permitted and what is forbidden.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Jibra'eel ne mujhe ek lehje mein padhna sikhaya. Maine unse aur lehje maangte hue unhe jawab diya aur unse aur lehje dene ki maang karta raha, yahan tak ki woh saat lehjon tak pahunch gaye. Ibn Shihab ne kaha: Mujhe pata chala hai ki ye saat lehje asal mein ek hi hain, jo halal aur haraam ke maamle mein aapas mein alag nahi hain.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Zuhri with the same chain of trans- mitters.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: Ubayy b. Ka'b reported: I was in the mosque when a man entered and prayed and recited (the Qur'in) in a style to which I objected. Then another man entered (the mosque) and recited in a style different from that of his companion. When we had finished the prayer, we all went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said to him: This man recited in a style to which I objected, and the other entered and recited in a style different from that of his companion. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) asked them to recite and so they recited, and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) expressed approval of their affairs (their modes of recitation). and there occurred In my mind a sort of denial which did not occur even during the Days of Ignorance. When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saw how I was affected (by a wrong idea), he struck my chest, whereupon I broke into sweating and felt as though I were looking at Allah with fear. He (the Holy Prophet) said to me: Ubayy. a message was sent to me to recite the Qur'an in one dialect, and I replied: Make (things) easy for my people. It was conveyed to me for the second time that it should be recited in two dialects. I again replied to him: Make affairs easy for my people. It was again conveyed to me for the third time to recite in seven dialects And (I was further told): You have got a seeking for every reply that I sent you, which you should seek from Me. I said: O Allah! forgive my people, forgive my people, and I have deferred the third one for the day on which the entire creation will turn to me, including even Ibrahim (peace be upon him) (for intercession).
hi: Ubayy bin Ka'b (RA) ne bayan kiya: Main masjid mein tha jab ek shakhs daakhil hua aur namaz padhi aur Quran ki tilawat aise andaaz mein ki jispar mujhe aitraaz hua. Phir ek doosra shakhs masjid mein daakhil hua aur apne saathi se alag andaaz mein tilawat ki. Jab humne namaz mukammal ki, to hum sab Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas gaye aur unse kaha: Is shakhs ne aise andaaz mein tilawat ki jispar mujhe aitraaz hua, aur doosra daakhil hua aur apne saathi se alag andaaz mein tilawat ki. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unse padhne ko kaha to unhone padha, aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unke maamlon ki taaeed ki, aur mere zehan mein ek tarah ka inkaar paida hua jo jaahiliyat ke daur mein bhi nahi hua tha. Jab Rasoolullah (SAW) ne dekha ki mujh par ek galat khayal ka kaisa asar ho raha hai, to unhone mere seene par thapki di, jispar main paseeney se bhar gaya aur mujhe aisa laga jaise main khauf ke saath Allah ko dekh raha hoon. Unhone mujhse kaha: Aye Ubayy, mujhe ek payaam bheja gaya ki main Quran ek lehje mein padhun, aur maine jawab diya: Mere logon ke liye cheezein aasan bana. Mujhe doosri baar bataya gaya ki ise do lehjon mein padha jaaye. Maine unse phir jawab diya: Mere logon ke liye maamlaat aasan bana. Mujhe teesri baar phir bataya gaya ki saat lehjon mein padho. Aur mujhe ye bhi bataya gaya: Tumhe har jawab jo maine tumhe bheja, uski koi khaas dar-khaast hai jo tumhe mujhse maangni chahiye. Maine kaha: Aye Allah! Mere logon ko maaf kar de, mere logon ko maaf kar de, aur teesri dar-khaast maine us din ke liye rakh li hai jab poori makhlooq meri taraf rujoo karegi, Ibrahim (AS) samet bhi, sifaarish ke liye.

e: Ubayy b. Ka'b reported that he was sitting in a mosque that a person entered it and he observed prayer, and made recitation, the rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Ubayy bin Ka'b (RA) ne bayan kiya ki woh ek masjid mein baithe the ki ek shakhs usmein daakhil hua aur unhone namaz padhi, aur tilawat ki, baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Ubayy b. Ka'b reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was near the tank of Banu Ghifar that Gabriel came to him and said: Allah has commanded you to recite to your people the Qur'an in one dialect. Upon this he said: I ask from Allah pardon and forgiveness. My people are not capable of doing it. He then came for the second time and said: Allah has commanded you that you should recite the Qur'an to your people in two dialects. Upon this he (the Holy prophet) again said: I seek pardon and forgiveness from Allah, my people would not be able to do so. He (Gabriel) came for the third time and said: Allah has commanded you to recite the Qur'an to your people in three dialects. Upon this he said: I ask pardon and forgiveness from Allah. My people would not be able to do it. He then came to him for the fourth time and said: Allah has commanded you to recite the Qur'an to your people in seven dialects, and in whichever dialect they would recite, they would be right.
hi: Ubayy bin Ka'b (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) Banu Ghifar ke hauz ke paas the ki Jibra'eel (AS) unke paas aaye aur kaha: Allah ne aapko hukum diya hai ki aap apni qaum ko Quran ek lehje mein padhkar sunaayein. Isper unhone kaha: Main Allah se maafi aur bakhshish maangta hoon. Meri qaum aisa nahi kar sakti. Woh phir doosri baar aaye aur kaha: Allah ne aapko hukum diya hai ki aap apni qaum ko Quran do lehjon mein padhkar sunaayein. Isper unhone phir kaha: Main Allah se maafi aur bakhshish maangta hoon, meri qaum ye nahi kar payegi. Woh teesri baar aaye aur kaha: Allah ne aapko hukum diya hai ki aap apni qaum ko Quran teen lehjon mein padhkar sunaayein. Isper unhone kaha: Main Allah se maafi aur bakhshish maangta hoon. Meri qaum ye nahi kar payegi. Phir woh chauthi baar unke paas aaye aur kaha: Allah ne aapko hukum diya hai ki aap apni qaum ko Quran saat lehjon mein padhkar sunaayein, aur jis bhi lehje mein woh padhein, woh sahi honge.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: Abu Wa'il reported that a person named Nabik b. Sinan came to Abdullah (b. Mas'ud) and said: Abu 'Abd al-Rahman, how do you recite this word (alif) or (ya)? Would you read It as: min ma'in ghaira asin or au min ma'in ghaira ghaira yasin. (al-Qur'an, xlvii. 15)? 'Abdullah said: You (seem to) have memorised the whole of the Qur'an except this. He (again) said: I recite all the mufassal surahs in one rak'ah. Upon this 'Abdullah said: (You must have been reciting It) hastily like the recitation of poetry. Verily. there are people who recite the Qur'an, but it does not go down beyond their collar bones. It is (a fact with the Qur'an) that it is beneficial only when it settles in the heart and is rooted deeply in it. The best of (the acts) in prayer are bowing and prostration. I am quite aware of the occasions when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) combined together two surahs in every rak'ah. 'Abdullah then stood up and went out with 'Alqama following in his footstep. He said Ibn Numair had told him that the narration was like that:" A person belonging to Banu Bajila came to 'Abdullah," and he did not mention (the name of) Nahik b. Sinan.
hi: Abu Wa'il ne bayan kiya ki Nahik bin Sinan naam ka ek shakhs Abdullah bin Mas'ud ke paas aaya aur kaha: Aye Abu Abdur-Rahman, aap ye lafz kaise padhte hain? Kya aap ise "min ma'in ghaira asin" padhenge ya "au min ma'in ghaira yasin" (47:15)? Abdullah ne kaha: Aisa lagta hai tumne poora Quran yaad kar liya hai siwaay isi ke. Unhone phir kaha: Main saari mufassal surahon ko ek hi rakat mein padhta hoon. Isper Abdullah ne kaha: Tum ise shayari ki tarah jaldi jaldi padhte hoge. Yaqeenan, kuch log Quran padhte hain, lekin ye unke gale ki haddi se aage nahi jaata. Ye Quran ki khaasiyat hai ki ye tabhi faayda deta hai jab ye dil mein basta hai aur usmein gehra jad pakadta hai. Namaz mein sabse behtareen amal ruku aur sajda hai. Mujhe achhi tarah pata hai un mauqon ke baare mein jab Rasoolullah (SAW) har rakat mein do surahon ko ikattha padhte the. Abdullah phir khade hue aur Alqama unke peeche peeche bahar chale gaye. Raawi ne kaha ki Ibn Numair ne unhe bataya tha ki riwayat isi tarah thi: "Banu Bajila ka ek shakhs Abdullah ke paas aaya," aur unhone Nahik bin Sinan ka naam zikr nahi kiya.

e: Abu Wa'il reported: A person came to 'Abdullah, who was called Nahik b. Sinan, and the rest of the hadith is the same but for this:" Alqama came to him ('Abdullah b. Mas'ud) and we said to him: Ask him about the manners in which he combined (two surahs) in one rak'ah. So he went to him and asked him and then came to us and said: Twenty are the mufassal surahs in the compilation (of the Qur'an) made by 'Abdullah."
hi: Abu Wa'il ne bayan kiya: Ek shakhs Abdullah ke paas aaya, jise Nahik bin Sinan kaha jaata tha, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai siwaay is baat ke: "Alqama unke paas aaye aur humne unse kaha: Unse poocho ki unhone ek rakat mein do surahon ko kis tarah ikattha kiya. To woh unke paas gaye aur unse poocha aur phir hamare paas aakar kaha: Abdullah ki tarteeb mein bees mufassal surahen hain."

e: This hadith has been narrated by A'mash with the same chain of transmitters in which ('Abdullah b. Mas'ud) said: " I know the manners in which the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) recited the two surahs in one rak'ah and then twenty surahs in ten rak'ahs."
hi: Ye hadees A'mash ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai jismein Abdullah bin Mas'ud ne kaha: "Mujhe pata hai us tareeqe ke baare mein jismein Rasoolullah (SAW) ne ek rakat mein do surahen padhi thin aur phir das rakaton mein bees surahen."

e: Abu Wa'il reported: One day we went to 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud after we had observed the dawn prayer and we paid salutation at the door. He permitted us to enter, but we stayed for a while at the door, when the slave-girl came out and said: Why don't you come in? So we went in and (we found 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud) sitting and glorifying Allah (i. e. he was busy in dhikr) and he said: What obstructed you from coming in though you had been granted permission for it? We said: There was nothing (behind it) but we entertained the idea that some inmate of the house might be sleeping. He said: Do you presume any idleness on the part of the family of Ibn Umm 'Abd (the mother of Abdullah b. Mas'ud)? He was again busy with the glorification of Allah till he thought that the sun had risen. He said: Girl, see whether (the sun) has arisen. She glanced but it had not risen (by that time). He was again busy with the glorification (of Allah) and he (again) thought that the sun had arisen. She glanced (and confirmed) that, it had risen. Upon this he ('Abdullah b. Mas'ud) said: Praise be to Allah Who did not call us to account for our sins today. Mahdi said: I think that he said, He did not destroy us for our sins. One among the people said: I recited all the mufassal surahs during the night. 'Abdullah said: (You must have recited them) like the (recitation) of poetry. I heard (the Holy Prophet) combining (the sarahs) and I remember the combinations which the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) made In the recitation (of surahs). These were constituted of eighteen mufassal surahs and two surahs (commencing with) Ha-Mim.
hi: Abu Wa'il ne bayan kiya: Ek din hum Abdullah bin Mas'ud ke paas gaye jab hum fajr ki namaz padh chuke the aur humne darwaze par salaam kiya. Unhone humein andar aane ki ijazat di, lekin hum darwaze par thodi der ruke rahe, jab tak ki ek laundi bahar aayi aur kaha: Tum andar kyun nahi aate? To hum andar gaye aur Abdullah bin Mas'ud ko baitha hua paaya aur woh Allah ki tasbeeh kar rahe the, yaani zikr mein masroof the, aur unhone kaha: Ijazat milne ke baawajood tumhe andar aane se kis cheez ne roka? Humne kaha: Kuch nahi iske peeche siwaay is khayal ke ki shayad ghar ka koi shakhs so raha ho. Unhone kaha: Kya tumhe Ibn Umm Abd, Abdullah bin Mas'ud ki maa, ke gharwalon mein koi susti ka andesha hai? Woh phir Allah ki tasbeeh mein masroof ho gaye yahan tak ki unhe laga ki suraj nikal aaya hai. Unhone kaha: Aye laundi, dekho kya suraj nikla hai. Usne dekha lekin us waqt tak woh nahi nikla tha. Woh phir tasbeeh mein masroof ho gaye aur unhe dobara laga ki suraj nikal aaya hai. Usne dekha aur tasdeeq ki ki woh nikal chuka hai. Isper unhone kaha: Allah ki hamd hai jisne humein aaj hamare gunahon par pakad mein nahi liya. Mahdi ne kaha: Mera khayal hai unhone kaha, Usne humein hamare gunahon ki wajah se tabaah nahi kiya. Logon mein se ek ne kaha: Maine raat ko saari mufassal surahen padhin. Abdullah ne kaha: Tumne unhe zaroor shayari ki tarah padha hoga. Maine Nabi (SAW) ko surahon ko ikattha karte suna hai aur mujhe woh tarkeeben yaad hain jo Rasoolullah (SAW) ne surahon ki tilawat mein banayi thin. Ye athaarah mufassal surahon aur Ha-Mim se shuru hone wali do surahon par mushtamil hoti thin.

e: Shaqiq reported: A person from Banu Bajila who was called Nabik b. Sinan came to Abdullah and said: I recite mufassal surahs in one rak'ah. Upon this 'Abdullah said: (You recite) like the recitation of poetry. I know the manner in which the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) recited two surahs in one rak'ah.
hi: Shaqiq ne bayan kiya: Banu Bajila ka ek shakhs, jise Nahik bin Sinan kaha jaata tha, Abdullah ke paas aaya aur kaha: Main mufassal surahen ek rakat mein padhta hoon. Isper Abdullah ne kaha: Tum ise shayari ki tarah padhte hoge. Mujhe pata hai us tareeqe ke baare mein jismein Rasoolullah (SAW) ne ek rakat mein do surahen padhi thin.

e: Abu Wa'il reported: A person came to 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud and said: I recited all the mufassal surahs in one rak'ah during the night. 'Abdullah said: You must have recited hastily like the recitation of poetry. 'Abdullah said: I remember well the manner in which the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to combine them, and he then mentioned twenty of the mufassal surahs, and (their combinations in) two in every rak'ah.
hi: Abu Wa'il ne bayan kiya: Ek shakhs Abdullah bin Mas'ud ke paas aaya aur kaha: Maine raat ko saari mufassal surahen ek rakat mein padhin. Abdullah ne kaha: Tumne zaroor unhe shayari ki tarah jaldi jaldi padha hoga. Abdullah ne kaha: Mujhe achhi tarah yaad hai us tareeqe ke baare mein jismein Rasoolullah (SAW) unhe ikattha kiya karte the, aur phir unhone bees mufassal surahon ka zikr kiya, aur unki jodiyan har rakat mein do-do.

e: Abu Ishaq reported: I saw a man asking Aswad b. Yazid who taught the Qur'an in the mosque: How do you recite the verse (fahal min muddakir) whether (the word muddakir) Is with (d) or (dh)? He (Aswad) said: It was with (d). I heard Abdullah b. Mas'ud saying that he had heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) reciting (muddakir) with (d).
hi: Abu Ishaq ne bayan kiya: Maine ek shakhs ko dekha jo Aswad bin Yazid se, jo masjid mein Quran padhaate the, poochh raha tha: Aap aayat "fahal min muddakir" kaise padhte hain, "d" ke saath ya "dh" ke saath? Unhone kaha: Ye "d" ke saath thi. Maine Abdullah bin Mas'ud ko ye kehte suna ki unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) ko "muddakir" ko "d" ke saath padhte suna tha.

e: Ishaq is reported to have said on the authority of Aswad who quoted on the authority of 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to recite these words as (fahal min muddakir).
hi: Ishaq ne, ye kaha jaata hai, Aswad ke hawale se kaha jinhone Abdullah bin Mas'ud ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Rasoolullah (SAW) in alfaaz ko "fahal min muddakir" padha karte the.

e: 'Alqama reported. We went to Syria and Abu Darda' came to us and said: Is there anyone among you who recites according to the recitation of Abdullah? I said: Yes, it is I. He again said: How did you hear 'Abdullah reciting this verse: (wa'l-lail-i-idha yaghsha = when the night covers)? He ('Alqama) said: I heard him reciting it (like this) (wa'l-lail-i-idha yaghsha) wa-dhakar wal untha = when the night covers and the males and the females). Upon this he said: By Allah, I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) reciting in this way, but they (the Muslims of Syria) desire us to recite: (wa ma khalaqa), but I do not yield to their desire.
hi: Alqama ne bayan kiya: Hum Syria gaye aur Abu Darda hamare paas aaye aur kaha: Kya tum mein koi hai jo Abdullah ki qiraat ke mutabik padhta hai? Maine kaha: Haan, ye main hoon. Unhone phir kaha: Tumne Abdullah ko ye aayat "wa'l-lail-i-idha yaghsha", jab raat chhaa jaaye, kaise padhte suna? Unhone kaha: Maine unhe isi tarah padhte suna: "wa'l-lail-i-idha yaghsha wa-dhakar wal untha", jab raat chhaa jaaye aur mard aur aurat. Isper unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko isi tarah padhte suna, lekin woh Syria ke Musalman chahte hain ki hum "wa maa khalaqa" padhein, lekin main unki khwahish ke aage nahi jhukta.

e: Ibrahim reported: 'Alqama came to Syria and entered the mosque and prayed there and then went to a (place where people were sitting in a) circle and he sat therein. Then a person came there and I perceived that the people were annoyed and perturbed (on this arrival). and he sat on my side and then said: Do you remember how 'Abdullah used to recite (the Qur'an)? And then the rest of the hadith was narrated.
hi: Ibrahim ne bayan kiya: Alqama Syria aaye aur masjid mein daakhil hue aur wahan namaz padhi aur phir ek daayre mein, jahan log baithe the, gaye aur usmein baith gaye. Phir ek shakhs wahan aaya aur maine mahsoos kiya ki log iske aane par pareshaan aur naraaz the, aur woh mere bagal mein baithe aur phir kaha: Kya tumhe yaad hai Abdullah Quran kaise padha karte the? Aur phir baaki hadees bayan ki gayi.

e: 'Alqama reported: I met Abu Darda', and he said to me: To which country do you belong? I said: I am one of the people of Iraq. He again said: To which city? I replied: City of Kufa. He again said: Do you recite according to the recitation of 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud? I said: Yes. He said: Recite this verse (By the night when it covers) So I recited it: (By the night when it covers, and the day when it shines, and the creating of the male and the female). He laughed and said: I have heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) reciting like this.
hi: Alqama ne bayan kiya: Main Abu Darda se mila, aur unhone mujhse kaha: Tum kis mulk se ho? Maine kaha: Main Iraq ke logon mein se hoon. Unhone phir kaha: Kaunse shehar se? Maine jawab diya: Kufa shehar se. Unhone phir kaha: Kya tum Abdullah bin Mas'ud ki qiraat ke mutabik padhte ho? Maine kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha: Ye aayat padho, us raat ki qasam jab woh chhaa jaaye. To maine ise padha: us raat ki qasam jab woh chhaa jaaye, aur din ki jab woh chamke, aur mard aur aurat ki takhleeq ki. Woh muskuraaye aur kaha: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko isi tarah padhte suna hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated by another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira is reported to have said that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited to observe prayer after the 'Asr prayer till the sun is set, and after the dawn till the sun rises.
hi: Abu Huraira ne, ye kaha jaata hai, kaha ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne asr ki namaz ke baad suraj doobne tak, aur fajr ke baad suraj nikalne tak, namaz padhne se mana kiya.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported: I heard it from so many Companions of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and one among them is 'Umar b. Khattab, and he is most dear to me among them that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited observing of prayer after the dawn prayer till the sun rose and after the 'Asr till the sun set.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ke itne saare sahaba se ye suna hai, aur unmein se ek Umar bin Khattab hain, aur woh mujhe unmein sabse aziz hain, ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne fajr ki namaz ke baad, suraj nikalne tak, aur asr ke baad, suraj doobne tak, namaz padhne se mana kiya.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Qatada with the same chain of transmitters with a minor alteration of words.
hi: Ye hadees Qatada ne isi sanad se alfaaz ki halki tabdeeli ke saath bayan ki hai.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: No prayer is valid after the 'Asr prayer till the sun sets and no prayer is valid after the dawn prayer till the sun rises.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Asr ki namaz ke baad koi bhi namaz sahih nahi hai jab tak suraj doob na jaaye, aur fajr ki namaz ke baad koi bhi namaz sahih nahi hai jab tak suraj nikal na aaye.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Let not any one of you intend to observe prayer at the time of the rising of the sun or of the setting sun.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Tum mein se koi suraj nikalne ya suraj doobne ke waqt namaz padhne ka irada na kare.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Do not intend to observe prayer at the time of the rising of the sun nor at its setting, for it rises between the horns of Satan.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Suraj nikalne ke waqt ya doobne ke waqt namaz padhne ka irada mat karo, kyunki ye shaitaan ke seengon ke beech nikalta hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When the rim of the sun starts appearing defer prayer till it completely appears, and when the rim of the sun disappears defer prayer till it completely disappears.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Jab suraj ka kinaara dikhna shuru ho, to namaz ko der karo jab tak woh poori tarah nazar na aa jaaye, aur jab suraj ka kinaara gaayab hone lage, to namaz ko der karo jab tak woh poori tarah gaayab na ho jaaye.

e: Abu Basra Ghifari reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led us in the 'Asr prayer at (the place known as) Mukhammas, and then said: This prayer was presented to those gone before you, but they lost it, and he who guards it has two rewards in store for him. And no prayer is valid after till the onlooker appears (by onlooker is meant the evening star).
hi: Abu Basra Ghifari (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne humein Mukhammas naam ki jagah par asr ki namaz padhayi, aur phir farmaya: Ye namaz tumse pehle logon ke saamne bhi rakhi gayi thi, lekin unhone ise khoya, aur jo ise mehfooz rakhta hai uske liye do sawaab hain. Aur koi bhi namaz sahih nahi hai, asr ke baad, jab tak "dekhne wala", yaani shaam ka sitara, numaayan na ho jaaye.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Abu Basra Ghifari through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Basra Ghifari ne ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki hai.

e: Uqba b. 'Amir said: There were three times at which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade us to pray, or bury our dead: When the sun begins to rise till it is fully up, when the sun is at its height at midday till it passes over the meridian, and when the sun draws near to setting till it sets.
hi: Uqba bin Amir (RA) ne kaha: Teen aise waqt the jinmein Rasoolullah (SAW) ne humein namaz padhne, ya apne murdon ko dafnaane se mana kiya: Jab suraj nikalna shuru hota yahan tak ki poora nikal aata, jab suraj apni buland-tareen halat mein dopahar ko hota yahan tak ki woh darmiyan-bindu se guzar jaata, aur jab suraj doobne ke qareeb hota yahan tak ki woh doob jaata.

e:
'Amr b. 'Abasa Sulami reported: In the state of the Ignorance (before embracing Islam), I used to think that the people were in error and they were not on anything (which may be called the right path) and worshipped the idols. Meanwhile, I heard of a man in Mecca who was giving news (on the basis of his prophetic knowledge) ; so I sat on my ride and went to him. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was at that time hiding as his people had made life hard for him. I adopted a friendly attitude (towards the Meccans and thus managed) to enter Mecca and go to him (the Holy Prophet) and I said to him: Who are you? He said: I am a Prophet (of Allah). I again said: Who is a Prophet? He said: (I am a Prophet in the sense that) I have been sent by Allah. I said: What is that which you have been sent with? He said: I have been sent to join ties of relationship (with kindness and affection), to break the Idols, and to proclaim the oneness of Allah (in a manner that) nothing is to be associated with Him. I said: Who is with you in this (in these beliefs and practices)? He said: A free man and a slave. He (the narrator) said: Abu Bakr and Bilal were there with him among those who had embraced Islam by that time. I said: I intend to follow you. He said: During these days you would not be able to do so. Don't you see the (hard) condition under which I and (my) people are living? You better go back to your people and when you hear that I have been granted victory, you come to me. So I went to my family. I was in my home when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to Medina. I was among my people and used to seek news and ask people when he arrived in Medina. Then a group of people belonging to Yathrib (Medina) came. I said (to them): How is that person getting on who has come to Medina? They said: The people are hastening to him, while his people (the polytheists of Mecca) planned to kill him, but they could not do so. I (on hearing it) came to Medina and went to him and said: Messenger of Allah, do you recognise me? He said: Yes, you are the same man who met me at Mecca. I said: It is so. I again said: Prophet of Allah, tell me that which Allah has taught you and which I do not know, tell me about the prayer. 
He said: Observe the dawn prayer, then stop praying when the sun is rising till it is fully up, for when it rises it comes up between the horns of Satan, and the unbelievers prostrate themselves to it at that time. Then pray, for the prayer is witnessed and attended (by angels) till the shadow becomes about the length of a lance; then cease prayer, for at that time Hell is heated up. Then when the shadow moves forward, pray, for the prayer is witnessed and attended by angels, till you pray the afternoon prayer, then cease prayer till the sun sets, for it sets between the horns of devil, and at that time the unbelievers prostrate themselves before it. I said: Apostle of Allah, tell me about ablution also. He said: None of you who uses water for ablution and rinses his mouth, snuffs up water and blows it, but the sins of his face, and his mouth and his nostrils fall out. When he washes his face, as Allah has commanded him, the sins of his face fall out from the end of his beard with water. Then (when) he washes his forearms up to the elbows, the sins of his arms fall out along with water from his finger-tips. And when he wipes his head, the sins of his head fall out from the points of his hair along with water. And (when) he washes his feet up to the ankles, the sins of his feet fall out from his toes along with water. And if he stands to pray and praises Allah, lauds Him and glorifies Him with what becomes Him and shows wholehearted devotion to Allah, his sins would depart leaving him (as innocent) as he was on the day his mother bore him. 'Amr b. 'Abasa narrated this hadith to Abu Umama, a Companion of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and Abu Umama said to him: 'Amr b. 'Abasa, think what you are saying that such (a great reward) is given to a man at one place (only in the act of ablution and prayer). Upon this 'Amr said: Abu Umama, I have grown old and my bones have become weak and I am at the door of death; what impetus is there for me to attribute a lie to Allah and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)? Had I heard it from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) once, twice, or three times (even seven times), I would have never narrated it, but I have heard it from him on occasions more than these.
hi: Amr bin Abasa Sulami ne bayan kiya: Jaahiliyat ke daur mein, Islam qubool karne se pehle, main sochta tha ki log galti mein hain aur woh kisi aise raaste par nahi hain jise seedha raasta kaha ja sake, aur woh buton ki parastish karte the. Isi dauran, maine Makkah mein ek shakhs ke baare mein suna jo apne nabuwat ke ilm ke aadhar par khabar de raha tha; to main apni sawari par baitha aur unke paas gaya. Rasoolullah (SAW) us waqt chhup rahe the kyunki unki qaum ne unki zindagi mushkil kar di thi. Maine dosti ka rukh apnaya, Makkah walon ke saath, aur is tarah main Makkah mein daakhil hone aur unke paas jaane mein kaamyaab hua aur maine unse kaha: Aap kaun hain? Unhone kaha: Main ek Nabi hoon. Maine phir kaha: Nabi kya hota hai? Unhone kaha: Main us mafhoom mein Nabi hoon ki mujhe Allah ne bheja hai. Maine kaha: Aapko kis cheez ke saath bheja gaya hai? Unhone kaha: Mujhe rishton ko meherbaani aur mohabbat se jodne ke liye, buton ko todne ke liye, aur Allah ki wahdaniyat ka ailaan karne ke liye is andaaz mein ki Uske saath kisi ko shareek na kiya jaaye, bheja gaya hai. Maine kaha: Is mein aapke saath kaun hai? Unhone kaha: Ek azaad aadmi aur ek ghulam. Raawi ne kaha: Us waqt tak jo log Islam qubool kar chuke the unmein Abu Bakr aur Bilal unke saath the. Maine kaha: Mera irada hai ki main aapki pairvi karun. Unhone kaha: Abhi in dinon mein tum aisa nahi kar paoge. Kya tum nahi dekhte ki main aur mere log kis mushkil haalat mein reh rahe hain? Tumhe apne logon ke paas wapas jaana chahiye aur jab tum sunno ki mujhe fatah mil gayi hai, to mere paas aana. To main apne gharwalon ke paas gaya. Main apne ghar mein tha jab Rasoolullah (SAW) Madina aaye. Main apne logon mein raha aur khabrein talaash karta aur logon se poochta jab woh Madina pahunche. Phir Yathrib, Madina, se taalluq rakhne wale logon ka ek giroh aaya. Maine kaha: Woh shakhs jo Madina aaya hai kaisa kar raha hai? Unhone kaha: Log unki taraf jaldi jaldi aa rahe hain, jabki unki qaum, Makkah ke mushrikeen, ne unhe qatal karne ki saazish rachi, lekin woh aisa nahi kar sake. Main ye sunkar Madina aaya aur unke paas gaya aur kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, kya aap mujhe pehchaante hain? Unhone kaha: Haan, tum wohi shakhs ho jo mujhse Makkah mein mile the. Maine kaha: Ye sahi hai. Maine phir kaha: Aye Allah ke Nabi, mujhe woh bataiye jo Allah ne aapko sikhaya hai aur jo mujhe nahi pata, mujhe namaz ke baare mein bataiye. Unhone farmaya: Fajr ki namaz padho, phir namaz padhna band kar do jab suraj nikal raha ho yahan tak ki woh poora nikal aaye, kyunki jab woh nikalta hai to shaitaan ke seengon ke beech se nikalta hai, aur kaafir us waqt usse sajda karte hain. Phir namaz padho, kyunki namaz ka is waqt mushaahida hota hai aur farishte uspar hazir hote hain, yahan tak ki saaya bhaale ki lambaai jitna ho jaaye; phir namaz padhna band kar do, kyunki us waqt jahannam garam ki jaati hai. Phir jab saaya aage badhe, to namaz padho, kyunki namaz ka mushaahida hota hai aur farishte hazir hote hain, yahan tak ki tum asr ki namaz padh lo, phir namaz padhna band kar do jab tak suraj doob na jaaye, kyunki ye shaitaan ke seengon ke beech doobta hai, aur us waqt kaafir usse sajda karte hain. Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, mujhe wuzu ke baare mein bhi bataiye. Unhone farmaya: Tum mein se koi bhi jab wuzu ke liye paani istemal karta hai aur apna munh dhota hai, naak mein paani chadhata hai aur use nikaalta hai, to uske chehre, uske munh aur uski naak ke gunah gir jaate hain. Jab woh apna chehra dhota hai, jaise Allah ne use hukum diya hai, to uske chehre ke gunah paani ke saath uski dadhi ke kinaron se gir jaate hain. Phir jab woh apni kohniyon tak apni baahein dhota hai, to uski baahon ke gunah uski ungliyon ke sirhon se paani ke saath gir jaate hain. Aur jab woh apna sar mash karta hai, to uske sar ke gunah uske baalon ke sirhon se paani ke saath gir jaate hain. Aur jab woh apne takhno tak apne paon dhota hai, to uske paon ke gunah uski ungliyon se paani ke saath gir jaate hain. Aur agar woh khada hokar namaz padhe aur Allah ki tareef kare, uski hamd kare aur usi tarah uski tasbeeh kare jiske woh laayak hai, aur poore dil se Allah ke liye khud ko waqf kar de, to uske gunah aise chale jaayenge ki woh paak hoga jaisa woh us din tha jab uski maa ne use paida kiya tha. Amr bin Abasa ne ye hadees Abu Umama, Rasoolullah (SAW) ke ek Sahabi, ko sunayi, aur Abu Umama ne unse kaha: Amr bin Abasa, socho tum kya keh rahe ho ki itna bada sawaab ek jagah par, sirf wuzu aur namaz ke amal mein, diya jaata hai. Isper Amr ne kaha: Abu Umama, main boodha ho chuka hoon aur meri haddiyan kamzor pad gayi hain aur main maut ke darwaze par hoon; mere paas Allah aur Rasoolullah (SAW) se jhoot bolne ki kya wajah ho sakti hai? Agar maine ise Rasoolullah (SAW) se ek baar, do baar, ya teen baar, yahan tak ki saat baar, suna hota, to main ise kabhi bayan na karta, lekin maine ise unse in se bhi zyada mauqon par suna hai.

e: 'A'isha reported that 'Umar misconstrued the fact that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had prohibited the observance of prayer at the time of the rising sun and at the time of its setting.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Umar (RA) ne is baat ko galat samjha ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne suraj nikalne ke waqt aur suraj doobne ke waqt namaz padhne se mana kiya tha.

e: 'A'isha said that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not abandon observing two rak'ahs after 'Asr, but she reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Do not get used to observe prayer at the time of the rising sun and at the time of its setting and (exhorted the Muslims) to pray at their times.
hi: Aisha ne kaha ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne asr ke baad do rakat padhna kabhi nahi chhoda, lekin unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) se ye bhi riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Suraj nikalne ke waqt aur suraj doobne ke waqt namaz padhne ki aadat mat daalo aur Musalmaanon ko unke muqarrar auqaat par namaz padhne ki hidayat di.

e: Kuraib, the freed slave of Ibn 'Abbas, reported that 'Abdullah b. 'Abbas, 'Abd al-Rahman b. Azhar, al-Miswar b. Makhrama sent him to 'A'isha, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), telling him to give her their greetings, and ask her about the two rak'ahs after the afternoon prayer, (for)" we have heard that you observe them whereas it has been conveyed to us that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited their observance." Ibn 'Abbas said: I along with 'Umar b. al-Khattab dissuaded people to do so (to observe two rak'ahs of prayer). Kuraib said: I went to her ('A'isha) and conveyed to her the message with which I was sent. She said: (Better) ask Umm Salama. So I went to them (those who had sent him to Hadrat 'A'isha) and informed them about what she had said. They sent me back to Umm Salama with that with which I was sent to 'A'isha. Umm Salama said: I beard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibiting them, and then afterwards I saw him observing them. And when he observed them (two rak'ahs) he had already observed the 'Asr prayer. Then he (the Holy Prophet) came, while there were with me ladies of Banu Haram, a tribe of the Ansar and he (the Holy Prophet) observed them (the two rak'ahs).
