I sent a slave-girl to him asking her to stand by his side and say to him that Umm Salama says: Messenger of Allah, I heard you prohibiting these two rak'ahs, whereas I saw you observing them; and if he (the Holy Prophet) points with his hand (to wait), then do wait. The slave-girl did like that. He (the Holy Prophet) pointed out with his hand and she got aside and waited, and when he had finished (the prayer) he said: Daughter of Abu Umayya. you have asked about the two rak'ahs after the 'Asr prayer. Some people of 'Abu al-Qais came to me for embracing Islam and hindered me from observing the two rak'ahs which come after the noon prayer. So those are the two I have been praying.
hi: Kuraib, Ibn Abbas ke aazad kiye hue ghulam, ne bayan kiya ki Abdullah bin Abbas, Abdur-Rahman bin Azhar, aur Miswar bin Makhrama ne unhe Rasoolullah (SAW) ki zauja Aisha (RA) ke paas bheja, unhe hukum diya ki unhe unka salaam pahunchayein aur unse asr ki namaz ke baad wali do rakaton ke baare mein poochein, kyunki "humne suna hai ki aap ye padhti hain jabki humein bataya gaya hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne inhe padhne se mana kiya tha." Ibn Abbas ne kaha: Main aur Umar bin Khattab (RA) logon ko ye do rakat namaz padhne se rokte the. Kuraib ne kaha: Main unke paas gaya aur unhe woh sandesh diya jiske saath mujhe bheja gaya tha. Unhone kaha: Behtar hoga tum Umm Salama se poocho. To main un logon ke paas gaya aur unhe bataya ki unhone kya kaha tha. Unhone mujhe wapas Umm Salama ke paas bheja usi sandeshe ke saath jiske saath mujhe Aisha ke paas bheja gaya tha. Umm Salama ne kaha: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko inhe mana karte suna, aur phir baad mein maine unhe padhte dekha. Aur jab unhone woh do rakat padhi, to woh pehle hi asr ki namaz padh chuke the. Phir woh aaye jab mere paas Banu Haram ki, Ansar ke ek qabile ki, auraten thin aur unhone woh do rakat padhi. Maine ek laundi ko unke paas bheja aur usse kaha ki woh unke bagal mein khadi ho aur unse kahe ki Umm Salama kehti hain: Ya Rasoolullah, maine aapko in do rakaton ko mana karte suna, jabki maine aapko inhe padhte dekha; aur agar woh apne haath se ishara karein, rukne ke liye, to woh intezaar kare. Laundi ne aisa hi kiya. Unhone apne haath se ishara kiya aur woh ek taraf hoke intezaar karne lagi, aur jab unhone namaz mukammal kar li, to unhone kaha: Aye Abu Umayya ki beti, tumne asr ki namaz ke baad wali do rakaton ke baare mein poocha hai. Abu'l-Qais ke kuch log mere paas Islam qubool karne aaye aur unhone mujhe woh do rakat padhne se roka jo zohar ki namaz ke baad aati hain. To ye wohi do rakat hain jo main tab se padh raha hoon.

e: Abu Salama asked 'A'isha about the two prostrations (i. e. rak'ahs) which the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) made after the 'Asr. She said: He (the Holy Prophet) observed them before the 'Asr prayer, but then he was hindered to do so, or he forgot them and then he observed them after the 'Asr, and then he continued observing them. (It was his habit) that when he (the Holy Prophet) observed prayer, he then continued observing it. Isma'il said: It implies that he always did that.
hi: Abu Salama ne Aisha (RA) se un do sajdon, yaani rakaton, ke baare mein poocha jo Rasoolullah (SAW) asr ke baad padhte the. Unhone kaha: Unhone inhe asr ki namaz se pehle padha, lekin phir unhe padhne se roka gaya, ya woh unhe bhool gaye aur phir unhone inhe asr ke baad padha, aur phir woh musalsal inhe padhte rahe. Ye unki aadat thi ki jab woh koi namaz padhte, to woh use musalsal karte. Ismail ne kaha: Iska matlab hai ki woh hamesha aisa karte the.

e: 'A'isha reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not abandon at all observing two rak'ahs after the 'Asr in my house.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne mere ghar mein asr ke baad do rakat padhna kabhi bilkul nahi chhoda.

e: 'A'isha reported: Two are the prayers which the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) always observed in my house-openly or secretly-two rak'ahs before the dawn and two rak'ahs after the 'Asr.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Do namazein hain jo Rasoolullah (SAW) hamesha mere ghar mein padhte the - khule taur par ya chhup kar - fajr se pehle do rakat aur asr ke baad do rakat.

e: Aswad and Masruq reported: We bear testimony to the fact that 'A'isha said: Never was there a day that he (the Holy Prophet) was with me and he did not observe two rak'ahs of prayer in my house, i. e. two rak'ahs after the Asr.
hi: Aswad aur Masruq ne bayan kiya: Hum is baat ki gawaahi dete hain ki Aisha ne kaha: Kabhi aisa din nahi tha ki woh mere saath hon aur unhone mere ghar mein do rakat namaz na padhi ho, yaani asr ke baad do rakat.

e: Mukhtar b. Fulful said: I asked Anas b. Malik about the voluntary prayers after the afternoon prayer, and he replied: 'Umar struck hit hands on prayer observed after the 'Asr prayer and we used to observe two rak'ahs after the sun set before the evening prayer during the time of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). I said to him: Did the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observe them? He said: He saw us observing them, but he neither commanded us nor forbade us to do so.
hi: Mukhtar bin Fulful ne kaha: Maine Anas bin Malik se asr ki namaz ke baad ki nafil namazon ke baare mein poocha, aur unhone jawab diya: Umar (RA) ne asr ki namaz ke baad padhi jaane wali namaz ke khilaaf apne haath maare, aur hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke daur mein suraj doobne ke baad, maghrib ki namaz se pehle, do rakat padha karte the. Maine unse kaha: Kya Rasoolullah (SAW) ne inhe padha? Unhone kaha: Unhone humein inhe padhte dekha, lekin unhone na to humein aisa karne ka hukum diya, na hi humein aisa karne se mana kiya.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: When we were in Medina, the moment the Mu'adhdhin made the call to the sunset prayer, the people hastened to the pillars of the mosque and prayed two rak'ahs with the result that any stranger coming into the mosque would think that the obligatory prayer had been observed owing to the number who were praying then.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya: Jab hum Madina mein the, jaise hi muazzin maghrib ki namaz ki azaan deta, log masjid ke khambon ki taraf jaldi karte aur do rakat padhte, aur is tarah masjid mein koi ajnabi shakhs aakar ye sochta ki farz namaz padh li gayi hai, kyunki us waqt itne saare log namaz padh rahe hote.

e: Abdullah b. Mughaffal reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) u saying: There Is between the two calls (Adhan and Iqama) a prayer. And he mentioned it three times, and at the third time he said: This applies to those who wish to do it.
hi: Abdullah bin Mughaffal (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Do azaanon, Azaan aur Iqamat, ke darmiyan ek namaz hai. Aur unhone ise teen baar kaha, aur teesri baar unhone kaha: Ye un logon ke liye hai jo aisa karna chahte hain.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Abdullah b. Mughaffal by another chain of transmitters, but with this variation that he (the Holy Prophet) said at the fourth time: " He who wishes (may do to)."
hi: Ye hadees Abdullah bin Mughaffal ne ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki hai, lekin is farq ke saath ki unhone chauthi baar kaha: "Jo chahe aisa kar sakta hai."

e: Salim b. Abdullah b. 'Umar reported: The Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) led on* of the two groups In one rak'ah of prayer in danger, while the other group faced the -enemy. Then they (the members of the first group) went back and replaced their companions who were facing the enemy. and then they (the members of the second group) came and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led them in one rak'ah of prayer. Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) pronounced salutation, and then they (the members of the Ant group) completed the rak'ah and they (the members of the second group) completed the rak'ah.
hi: Salim bin Abdullah bin Umar ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne khatre ke waqt do giroahon mein se ek ki ek rakat namaz mein imamat ki, jabki doosra giroh dushman ka saamna kar raha tha. Phir woh, pehle giroh ke log, wapas gaye aur apne un saathiyon ki jagah le li jo dushman ka saamna kar rahe the, aur phir woh, doosre giroh ke log, aaye aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unki ek rakat namaz mein imamat ki. Phir Rasoolullah (SAW) ne salaam pheera, aur phir unhone, pehle giroh ke logon ne, apni rakat mukammal ki aur unhone, doosre giroh ke logon ne, bhi apni rakat mukammal ki.

e: This hadith has been narrated by another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn Umar reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed prayer in danger on some day (in this way): a group stood with him (the Holy Prophet) (for prayer) and the other group stood In front of the enemy. Then those who were with (him) observed one rak'ah of prayer and they went back and the others came and they observed one rak'ah (with him). Then both the groups completed one rak'ah each. Ibn Umar said: When there is greater danger, then observe prayer even on the ride or with the help of gestures in a standing posture.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kisi din khatre ki halat mein namaz padhi is tarah: ek giroh unke saath namaz ke liye khada hua aur doosra giroh dushman ke saamne khada hua. Phir jo unke saath the unhone ek rakat namaz padhi aur woh wapas gaye aur doosre aaye aur unhone unke saath ek rakat padhi. Phir dono giroahon ne apni-apni ek-ek rakat mukammal ki. Ibn Umar ne kaha: Jab khatra zyada ho, to sawaari par ya khade ho kar ishaaron ki madad se bhi namaz padho.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported: I observed prayer in danger with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). We drew ourselves up in two rows, one row behind him with the enemy between us and the Qibla. The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) said: Allah is Most Great, and we all said it. He then bowed and we all bowed. He then raised his head from bowing, we all raised (our heads). He then went down in prostration along with the row close to him, and the rear row faced the enemy; then when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) completed the prostration, ; and then stood up, the row near to him also did it; then went down the rear row in prostration; then they stood up; then the rear row went to the front and the front row went to the rear. Then the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) bowed down and we all bowed. He then raised his head from bowing and we also raised (our heads). He and the row close to him which I had been in the rear then went down in prostration In the first rak'ah, whereas the rear row faced the enemy. And when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and the rear row close to him had finished the prostration, the rear row went down and prostrated themselves; then the Messenger of Allah pronounced the salutation and we also pronounced the salutation. (Jabir said we hadith) as your guards behave with their chiefs.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath khatre ki namaz padhi. Humne apne aap ko do safon mein taiyaar kiya, ek saf unke peeche jabki dushman aur Qibla ke beech hum the. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Allahu Akbar, aur humne sab ne bhi kaha. Phir unhone ruku kiya aur hum sab ne bhi ruku kiya. Phir unhone ruku se apna sar uthaya, hum sab ne bhi uthaya. Phir woh apne qareeb wali saf ke saath sajde mein gaye, aur peechli saf ne dushman ka saamna kiya; phir jab Rasoolullah (SAW) ne sajda mukammal kiya, aur phir khade hue, to unke qareeb wali saf ne bhi aisa hi kiya; phir peechli saf ne sajda kiya; phir woh khade hue; phir peechli saf aage aayi aur agli saf peeche chali gayi. Phir Rasoolullah (SAW) ne ruku kiya aur humne sab ne bhi ruku kiya. Unhone phir ruku se apna sar uthaya aur humne bhi uthaya. Woh aur unke qareeb wali saf, jismein main peeche tha, phir pehli rakat mein sajde mein gaye, jabki peechli saf ne dushman ka saamna kiya. Aur jab Rasoolullah (SAW) aur unke qareeb wali peechli saf ne sajda mukammal kar liya, to peechli saf niche gayi aur unhone sajda kiya; phir Rasoolullah (SAW) ne salaam pheera aur humne bhi salaam pheera. Jabir ne kaha, hum ne aisa kiya jaise tumhare pahredaar apne sardaron ke saath karte hain.

e: Jabir reported: We fought In the company of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) with the tribe of Juhaina. They fought with us terribly. When we had finished the noon prayer, the polytheists said: Had we attacked them at once. we would have killed them. Gabriel informed the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about It (about their evil design). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) made a mention of it to us, adding that they (the polytheists) had also said: Shortly there would be time for the 'Asr prayer. which is dearer o them (the Muslims) than even their children. So when the time of the 'Asr prayer came. we formed ourselves into two rows, while the polytheists were between us and the Qibla. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Allah is Most Great, and we also said so. He bowed and we also bowed. He went down in prostration and the first row prostrated along with him. When they stood up, the second row went down in prostration. Then the first row went into the rear, and the second row came in the front and occupied the place of the first row. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) then said: Allah is Most Great, and we also said so. He then bowed, and we also bowed. He then went down in prostration and along with him the row also (went down in prostration), and the second row remained standing. And when the second row had also prostrated and all of them sat down then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) pronounced salutation to them. Abu Zubair said: Jabir made a mention specially of this thing: just as your chiefs observe prayer.
hi: Jabir ne bayan kiya: Humne Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath Juhaina qabile ke khilaaf jung ladi. Unhone humse zabardast jung ladi. Jab humne zohar ki namaz mukammal ki, to mushrikeen ne kaha: Kaash humne unpar ek saath hamla kiya hota, to hum unhe qatal kar dete. Jibra'eel (AS) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko is baare mein, unke buri niyat ke baare mein, bataya. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne humein iska zikr kiya, aur izafa kiya ki unhone, mushrikeen ne, ye bhi kaha tha: Jald hi asr ki namaz ka waqt aayega, jo unhe, Musalmaanon ko, apne bachchon se bhi zyada azeez hai. To jab asr ki namaz ka waqt aaya, hum do safon mein taiyaar hue, jabki mushrikeen humare aur Qibla ke darmiyan the. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Allahu Akbar, aur humne bhi kaha. Unhone ruku kiya aur humne bhi ruku kiya. Unhone sajda kiya aur pehli saf ne unke saath sajda kiya. Jab woh khade hue, to doosri saf ne sajda kiya. Phir pehli saf peechhe chali gayi, aur doosri saf aage aayi aur pehli saf ki jagah le li. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne phir kaha: Allahu Akbar, aur humne bhi kaha. Phir unhone ruku kiya, aur humne bhi ruku kiya. Phir unhone sajda kiya aur unke saath saf bhi sajde mein gayi, aur doosri saf khadi rahi. Aur jab doosri saf ne bhi sajda kar liya aur sab baith gaye, to Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unke liye salaam pheera. Abu Zubair ne kaha: Jabir ne is baat ka khaas taur par zikr kiya: Bilkul waise hi jaise tumhare sardaar namaz padhte hain.

e: Sahl b. Abu Hathma reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led his Companions in prayer in danger. He made them stand in two rows behind him. He led them who were close to him in one rak'ah. He then stood up and kept standing till those who were behind them observed one rak'ah. Then they (those standing in the second row) came in front and those who were in front went into the rear. He then led them In one rak'ah. He then sat down, till those who were behind him observed one rak'ah and then pronounced salutation.
hi: Sahl bin Abu Hathma (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne apne sahaba ko khatre ki halat mein namaz padhayi. Unhone unhe apne peeche do safon mein khada kiya. Unhone unki, jo unke qareeb the, ek rakat mein imamat ki. Phir woh khade hue aur khade rahe yahan tak ki jo unke peeche the unhone ek rakat mukammal ki. Phir woh doosri saf mein khade log aage aaye aur jo aage the woh peeche chale gaye. Phir unhone unki ek rakat mein imamat ki. Phir woh baithe, yahan tak ki jo unke peeche the unhone ek rakat padh li aur phir salaam pheera.

e: Yazid b. Ruman told on the authority of Salih b. Khawwat on the authority of one who prayed in time of danger with Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) at the Battle of Dhat ar-Riqa' that a group formed a row and prayed along with him, and a group faced the enemy. He led the group which was along with him in a rak'ah, then remained standing while they finished the prayer by themselves. Then they departed and formed a row facing the enemy. Then the second group came and he led them in the remaining rak'ah, after which he remained seated while they finished the prayer themselves. He then led them in salutation.
hi: Yazid bin Ruman ne Salih bin Khawwat ke hawale se, ek aise shakhs se jinhone Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath Dhat ar-Riqa ki jung mein khatre ki namaz padhi, riwayat ki ki ek giroh ne ek saf banayi aur unke saath namaz padhi, aur ek giroh ne dushman ka saamna kiya. Unhone us giroh ki, jo unke saath tha, ek rakat mein imamat ki, phir khade rahe jabki unhone khud apni namaz mukammal ki. Phir woh chale gaye aur dushman ka saamna karte hue ek saf banayi. Phir doosra giroh aaya aur unhone baaki rakat mein unki imamat ki, jiske baad woh baithe rahe jabki unhone khud apni namaz mukammal ki. Unhone phir unke saath salaam pheera.

e: Jabir reported: We went forward with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and when we reached Dhat ar-Riqa', we came to a shady tree which -we left for him One of the polytheists came there and, seeing the sword of the Messenger (ﷺ) hanging by a free. took it up. drew it from the scabbard and said to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): Are you afraid of Me? He (the Holy Prophet) said: No. He again said: Who would protect you from me? He said: Allah will protect me from you. The Companions of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) threatened him. He sheathed the sword and hung it up. Then call to prayer was made and he (the Holy Prophet) led a group in two rak'ah. Then (the members of this group) withdrew and he led the second group in two rak'ah. So the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed four rak'ah and people observed two rak'ah.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath aage badhe aur jab hum Dhat ar-Riqa pahunche, to hum ek saayedar darakht ke paas aaye jise humne unke liye chhod diya. Mushrikeen mein se ek shakhs wahan aaya aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ki talwaar ko darakht par latki dekhkar, use utha liya, myaan se nikaala aur Rasoolullah (SAW) se kaha: Kya tum mujhse darte ho? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Usne phir kaha: To mujhse tumhe kaun bachayega? Unhone kaha: Allah mujhe tumse bachayega. Rasoolullah (SAW) ke sahaba ne use dhamki di. Usne talwaar myaan mein daal di aur use latka diya. Phir namaz ki azaan hui aur unhone ek giroh ki do rakat mein imamat ki. Phir woh giroh ke log hat gaye aur unhone doosre giroh ki do rakat mein imamat ki. To Rasoolullah (SAW) ne char rakat padhi aur logon ne do-do rakat padhi.

e: Abu Salama b. 'Abd al-Rahman reported that Jabir told him that he had observed the prayer in danger with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) (first) led one of the two groups in two rak'ah of prayer. and then led the second group in two rak'ah of prayer. So the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed four rak'ah and led in two rak'ah each of the groups.
hi: Abu Salama bin Abdur-Rahman ne bayan kiya ki Jabir ne unhe bataya ki unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath khatre ki namaz padhi. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne pehle do giroahon mein se ek ki do rakat namaz mein imamat ki, aur phir doosre giroh ki do rakat namaz mein imamat ki. To Rasoolullah (SAW) ne char rakat padhi aur har giroh ki do-do rakat mein imamat ki.

e: Abdullah is reported to have heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When any one of you intends to come for Jumu'a prayer, he should take a bath.
hi: Abdullah (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab tum mein se koi jumma ki namaz ke liye aane ka irada kare, to use ghusl karna chahiye.

e: Abdullah b. Umar is reported to have said that The Messenger of Allah (may peace be up on him) was standing on the pulpit when he said this: He who comes for Jumu'a he should take a bath.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne kaha ki Rasoolullah (SAW) mimbar par khade hue jab unhone ye kaha: Jo jumma ke liye aaye use ghusl karna chahiye.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Ibn Umar by another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Umar ne ek doosri sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: 'Abdullah (b. Umar) reported on the authority of his father that he heard like this from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).
hi: Abdullah bin Umar ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) se isi tarah suna.

e: 'Abdullah (b. 'Umar) reported from his father that while he was addressing the people on Friday (sermon), a person, one of the Companions of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), entered (the mosque). Umar said to him loudly: What is this hour (for attending the prayer)? He said: I was busy today and I did not return to my house when I heard the call (to Friday prayer), and I did no more but performed ablution only. Upon this Umar said: just ablution! You know that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commanded (us) to take a bath (on Friday).
hi: Abdullah bin Umar ne apne walid ke hawale se bayan kiya ki jab woh, Umar (RA), jumma ke din logon ko khitaab kar rahe the, to ek shakhs, jo Rasoolullah (SAW) ke sahaba mein se the, masjid mein daakhil hue. Umar ne unse zor se kaha: Ye kya waqt hai namaz mein aane ka? Unhone kaha: Main aaj masroof tha aur maine ghar wapas jaakar namaz ki azaan nahi suni, aur maine sirf wuzu kiya. Isper Umar ne kaha: Sirf wuzu! Tumhe pata hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne humein ghusl karne ka hukum diya tha, jumma ke din.

e: Abu Huraira reported: Umar b. Khattab was delivering a sermon to the people on Friday when 'Uthman b. 'Affan came there. 'Umar hinting to him said: What would become of those persons who come after the call to prayer? Upon this 'Uthman said: Commander of the faithful, I did no more than this that after listening to the call, I performed ablution and came (to the mosque). 'Umar said: Just ablution! Did you not hear the Messenger of Allah (my peace be upon him) say this: When any one of you comes for Jumu'a, he should take a bath.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya: Umar bin Khattab (RA) jumma ke din logon ko khutba de rahe the jab Uthman bin Affan (RA) wahan aaye. Umar ne unhe ishaara karte hue kaha: Unn logon ka kya hoga jo azaan ke baad aate hain? Isper Uthman ne kaha: Ameer-ul-Momineen, maine bas itna hi kiya ki azaan sunne ke baad, maine wuzu kiya aur masjid aaya. Umar ne kaha: Sirf wuzu! Kya tumne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte nahi suna: Jab tum mein se koi jumma ke liye aaye, to use ghusl karna chahiye.

e: Sa'id al-Khudri reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Taking a bath on Friday is essential for every adult person.
hi: Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaya: Jumma ke din ghusl karna har baaligh shakhs ke liye zaroori hai.

e: 'Aisha reported: The people came for Jumu'a prayer from their houses in the neighbouring villages dressed in woollen garments on which dust was settled and this emitted a foul smell. A person among them (those who were dressed so) came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) while he was in my house. The Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) said to him: Were you to cleanse yourselves on this day.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Log jumma ki namaz ke liye aas-paas ke gaanvon se apne gharon se oon ke kapdon mein aate the, jinpar dhool jami hoti aur jismein se badboo aati thi. Unmein se ek shakhs Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aaya jab woh mere ghar mein the. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unse kaha: Kaash tum is din khud ko saaf-suthra karte.

e: 'Aisha reported: The people (mostly) were workers and they had no servants. Ill-smell thus emitted out of them. It was said to them: Were you to take bath on Friday.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Log zyadatar mazdoor the aur unke paas naukar nahi the. Is liye unmein se badboo aati thi. Unse kaha gaya: Kaash tum jumma ke din ghusl karte.

e: 'Abd al-Rahman son of Abd Sa'id al-Khudri reported on the authority of his father that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Bathing on Friday for every adult, using of Miswak and applying some perfume, that is available-these are essential. So far as the perfume is concerned, it may be that used by a lady.
hi: Abdur-Rahman, Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ke bete, ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jumma ke din har baaligh shakhs ke liye ghusl karna, miswak istemal karna aur jo khushboo miley usse lagaana zaroori hai. Jahan tak khushboo ka sawal hai, ho sakta hai woh khushboo ho jo unki biwi istemal karti ho.

e: Tawus reported that Ibn Abbas narrated the words of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about taking bath on Friday. Tawus said: I asked Ibn Abbas it one should apply to oneself perfume or oil which is available with his wife. He (Ibn Abbas) said: I do not know of it.
hi: Tawus ne bayan kiya ki Ibn Abbas ne jumma ke din ghusl karne ke baare mein Rasoolullah (SAW) ke alfaaz bayan kiye. Tawus ne kaha: Maine Ibn Abbas se poocha ki kya khud par woh khushboo ya tel lagaana chahiye jo apni biwi se milta ho. Unhone kaha: Mujhe iske baare mein pata nahi.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Ibn Juraij with the came chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Juraij ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said. it is the right of Allah upon every Muslim that he should take a bath (at least) on one day (Friday) during the seven days (of the week) and he should wash his head and body.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Har Musalman par Allah ka ye haq hai ki woh saat dinon, hafte, mein se ek din, jumma, ghusl kare, aur apna sar aur badan dhoye.

e: Abu Huraira reported that the Messenger of, Allah (ﷺ) said. He who takes a bath on Friday, the bath which is obligatory after the sexual discharge and then goes (to the mosque), he is like one who offers a she-camel as a sacrifice, and he who comes at the second hour would be like one who offers a cow, and he who comes at the third hour is live one who offers a ram with horns, and he who comes at the fourth hour is like one who offers a hen, and he who comes at the fifth hour is like one who offers an egg. And when the Imam comes out, the angels are also present and listen to the mention of God (the sermon).
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jo jumma ke din ghusl kare, woh ghusl jo jinsi milaap ke baad farz hai, aur phir masjid jaaye, woh us shakhs jaisa hai jo Allah ki raah mein ek oontni qurbaan kare, aur jo doosri ghadi, namaz ke waqt, mein aaye, woh us shakhs jaisa hai jo ek gaay qurbaan kare, aur jo teesri ghadi mein aaye, woh us shakhs jaisa hai jo seengon wala ek menda qurbaan kare, aur jo chauthi ghadi mein aaye, woh us shakhs jaisa hai jo ek murgi qurbaan kare, aur jo paanchvi ghadi mein aaye, woh us shakhs jaisa hai jo ek anda qurbaan kare. Aur jab Imam bahar aata hai, to farishte bhi maujood hote hain aur Allah ke zikr, khutbe, ko sunte hain.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If you (even) ask your companion to be quiet on Friday while the Imam is delivering the sermon, you have in fact talked irrelevance.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se ye kehte suna: Agar tum jumma ke din apne saathi se khaamosh rehne ko bhi kaho jab Imam khutba de raha ho, to tumne dar-asal fuzool baat ki hai.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated by Abu Huraira by another chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Abu Huraira ne ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki hai.

e: Ibn Juraij narrated a similar Hadith (as no. 1965) from Ibn Shihab with both chains, except that Ibn Juraij said: "Ibrahim bin 'Abdullah bin Qariz."
hi: Ibn Juraij ne isi tarah ki hadees Ibn Shihab se dono sanadon ke saath bayan ki, siwaay is baat ke ki Ibn Juraij ne kaha: "Ibrahim bin Abdullah bin Qariz."

e: The same hadith has been narrated by Abu Huraira, but instead of the word laghauta the word laghita has been used. Abu Zinad (one of the narrators) says that laghita is the dialect of Abu Huraira, whereas it is laghauta.
hi: Yehi hadees Abu Huraira ne bayan ki hai, lekin "laghauta" lafz ki jagah "laghita" lafz istemal hua hai. Abu Zinad, raawiyon mein se ek, kehte hain ki "laghita" Abu Huraira ka lehja hai, jabki asal lafz "laghauta" hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There is a time on Friday at which no Muslim servant would pray and would ask Allah for a thing (that is good) but He would give it to him. Qutaiba pointed with the help of his hand that it (the time) is short.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se ye kehte suna: Jumma ke din ek aisa waqt hota hai jismein koi bhi Musalman banda namaz padhkar Allah se koi achhi cheez na maange jise Woh use na de. Qutaiba ne apne haath se ishara karke bataya ki woh waqt chhota hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Abu'l-Qasim (the kunya of the Holy Prophet) (ﷺ) as saying: There is a time on Friday at which no Muslim would stand and pray and beg Allah for what Is good but He would give it to him; and he pointed with his hand that (this time) is short and narrow.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Abu'l-Qasim, Nabi (SAW) ki kunyat, ko ye kehte suna: Jumma ke din ek aisa waqt hota hai jismein koi bhi Musalman khada hokar namaz padhe aur Allah se achhaai maange jise Woh use na de; aur unhone apne haath se ishara karke bataya ki ye waqt bahut chhota aur tang hai.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated by Abu Huraira.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Abu Huraira ne bayan ki hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Abu Huraira by another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira ne ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: "There is a time on Friday at which no Muslim would ask Allah for what is good but He would give it to him." And further said: "This is a very short time."
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: "Jumma ke din ek aisa waqt hota hai jismein koi bhi Musalman Allah se achhaai na maange jise Woh use na de." Aur aage kaha: "Ye ek bahut hi chhota waqt hai."

e: Hammam b. Munabbih reported this hadith from Abu Huraira who reported from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) but he did not say: " That time is short."
hi: Hammam bin Munabbih ne ye hadees Abu Huraira se riwayat ki jinhone Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki, lekin unhone ye nahi kaha: "Woh waqt chhota hai."

e: Abu Burda b. Abu Musa al-Ash'ari reported: 'Abdullah b. Umar said to me: Did you hear anything from your father narrating something from the messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about the time on Friday? I said: Yes, I heard him say from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) (these words):" It is between the time when the Imam sits down and the end of the prayer."
hi: Abu Burda bin Abu Musa al-Ash'ari ne bayan kiya: Abdullah bin Umar ne mujhse kaha: Kya tumne apne walid se jumma ke din ke us waqt ke baare mein, jo Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat karte hue, kuch suna hai? Maine kaha: Haan, maine unhe Rasoolullah (SAW) se ye alfaaz kehte suna: Ye Imam ke baithne aur namaz ke khatam hone ke darmiyan ka waqt hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The best day on which the sun has risen is Friday; on it Adam was created, on it he was made to enter Paradise, on it he. was expelled from it.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se ye kehte suna: Sabse behtareen din jispar suraj nikla hai, woh jumma hai; isi din Aadam (AS) ko banaya gaya, isi din unhe Jannat mein daakhil kiya gaya, isi din unhe usse nikaala gaya.

e: Abu Huraira reported the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: The best day on which the sun has risen is Friday; on it Adam was created. on it he was made to enter Paradise, on it he was expelled from it. And the last hour will take place on no day other than Friday.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Sabse behtareen din jispar suraj nikla hai, woh jumma hai; isi din Aadam (AS) ko banaya gaya, isi din unhe Jannat mein daakhil kiya gaya, isi din unhe usse nikaala gaya. Aur Qayamat bhi jumma ke din ke siwaay kisi aur din nahi aayegi.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: We who are the last shall be the first on the Day of Resurrection, except that every Ummah was given the Book before us and we were given it after them. It was this day which Allah prescribed for us and guided us to it and the people came after us with regard to it, the Jews observing the next day and the Christians the day following that.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Hum jo sabse aakhri hain, Qayamat ke din sabse pehle honge, siwaay is baat ke ki har ummat ko humse pehle Kitaab di gayi thi aur humein woh unke baad di gayi. Yehi woh din tha jo Allah ne hamare liye muqarrar kiya aur humein iski taraf hidayat di, aur log iske baare mein humare baad aaye, Yahudiyon ne agla din maanaya aur Isaiyon ne uske baad wala din.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated by Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: We are the last and would be the first on the Day of Resurrection.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Abu Huraira ne bayan ki hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Hum sabse aakhri hain aur Qayamat ke din sabse pehle honge.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: We are the last (but) we would be the first on the Day of Resurrection, and we would be the first to enter Paradise, but that they were given the Book before us and we were given after them. They disagreed and Allah guided us aright on whatever they disagreed regarding the truth. And it was this day of theirs about which they disagreed, but Allah guided us to it, and that is Friday for us; the next day is for the Jews and the day following for the Christians.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Hum sabse aakhri hain, lekin Qayamat ke din hum sabse pehle honge, aur hum sabse pehle Jannat mein daakhil honge, lekin unhe humse pehle Kitaab di gayi thi aur humein unke baad. Unhone, pichhli ummaton ne, ikhtilaaf kiya aur Allah ne humein haq ke us maamle mein, jismein woh ikhtilaaf rakhte the, sahi raah dikhayi. Aur ye unka wohi din tha jiske baare mein unhone ikhtilaaf kiya, lekin Allah ne humein iski taraf hidayat di, aur woh hamare liye jumma hai; agla din Yahudiyon ke liye hai aur uske baad wala din Isaiyon ke liye.

e: Abu Huraira reported Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), as saying: We who are the last would be the first on the Day of Resurrection but they (other Ummahs) were given the Book before us and we were given after them, and this was the day that was prescribed for them but they disagreed on it. And Allah guided us to it. and they came after us with regard to it, the Jews observing the next day and the Christians the day following that.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Muhammad, Rasoolullah (SAW), ko ye kehte suna: Hum jo sabse aakhri hain, Qayamat ke din sabse pehle honge lekin unhe, doosri ummaton ko, humse pehle Kitaab di gayi thi aur humein unke baad. Aur ye woh din tha jo unke liye muqarrar kiya gaya tha lekin unhone iske baare mein ikhtilaaf kiya. Aur Allah ne humein iski taraf hidayat di, aur woh iske baare mein humare baad aaye, Yahudiyon ne agla din maanaya aur Isaiyon ne uske baad wala din.

e: It is narrated by Abu Huraira and Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: It was Friday from which Allah diverted those who were before us. For the Jews (the day set aside for prayer) was Sabt (Saturday), and for the Christians it was Sunday. And Allah turned towards us and guided us to Friday (as the day of prayer) for us. In fact, He (Allah) made Friday, Saturday and Sunday (as days of prayer). In this order would they (Jews and Christians) come after us on the Day of Resurrection. We are the last of (the Ummahs) among the people in this world and the first among the created to be judged on the Day of Resurrection. In one narration it is: ', to be judged among them".
hi: Abu Huraira aur Huraira ne riwayat ki ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Ye jumma tha jisse Allah ne hamse pehle logon ko mode diya. Yahudiyon ke liye, namaz ke liye muqarrar din, Sabt, shanivar, tha, aur Isaiyon ke liye Sunday tha. Aur Allah ne humari taraf rukh kiya aur humein jumma, namaz ke din ke taur par, ki hidayat di. Dar-asal, Usne jumma, shanivar aur Sunday, namaz ke dinon ke taur par, banaye. Isi tarteeb mein woh Yahudi aur Isai Qayamat ke din hamare baad aayenge. Hum is duniya mein logon mein sabse aakhri ummat hain aur Qayamat ke din faisla hone mein makhlooqaat mein sabse pehle honge. Ek doosri riwayat mein hai: "unke darmiyan faisle mein pehla."

e: Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: We were guided aright to Friday (as a day of prayer and meditation), but Allah diverted those who were before us from it. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Humein jumma ki taraf, namaz aur zikr ke din ke taur par, sahi tareeke se hidayat di gayi, lekin Allah ne hamse pehle logon ko isse mode diya. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When it is Friday, the angels stand at every door of the mosque and record the people in the order of their arrival, and when the Imam sits (on the pulpit for delivering the sermon) they fold up their sheets (manuscripts of the Qur'an) and listen to the mention (of Allah). And he who comes early is like one who offers a she-camel as a sacrifice, the next like one who offers a cow, the next a ram, the next a hen, the next an egg.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab jumma hota hai, to farishte masjid ke har darwaze par khade hote hain aur logon ko unke aane ki tarteeb mein darj karte hain, aur jab Imam baithta hai mimbar par, khutba dene ke liye, to woh apne parchay, Quran ki likhawaton ko, samet lete hain aur Allah ke zikr ko sunte hain. Aur jo jaldi aata hai, woh us shakhs jaisa hai jo ek oontni qurbaan karta hai, agla us shakhs jaisa hai jo ek gaay qurbaan karta hai, agla ek menda, agla ek murgi, agla ek anda.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira ne ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There is an angel on every door of the mosque recording him first who (comes) first (to the mosque for Friday prayer). And he  likened him to one who offers a camel as a sacrifice and then he went on in the descending order till he reached the point at which the minimum (sacrifice) is that of an egg. And when the Imam sits (on the pulpit) the sheets are folded and they (the angels) attend to the mention of Allah.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Masjid ke har darwaze par ek farishta hota hai jo sabse pehle masjid mein jumma ki namaz ke liye aane wale ko sabse pehle darj karta hai. Aur unhone use ek oont qurbaan karne wale shakhs se tashbeeh di aur phir ghatte hue tarteeb mein aage badhte gaye yahan tak ki woh us bindu par pahunche jahan sabse kam qurbaani ek anda hai. Aur jab Imam baithta hai mimbar par, to parchay samet liye jaate hain aur woh farishte Allah ke zikr par tawajjo dete hain.

e: Abu-Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: He who took a bath and then came for Jumu'a prayer and then prayed what was fixed for him, then kept silence till the Imam finished the sermon, and then prayed along with him, his sins between that time and the next Friday would be forgiven, and even of three days more.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jisne ghusl kiya aur phir jumma ki namaz ke liye aaya aur phir uske liye jo muqarrar tha woh padha, phir khaamosh raha yahan tak ki Imam ne khutba khatam kiya, aur phir unke saath namaz padhi, uske us waqt se lekar agle jumma tak ke gunah maaf kar diye jayenge, aur teen din aur bhi.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who performed ablution well, then came to Friday prayer, listened (to the sermon), kept silence all (his sins) between that time and the next Friday would be forgiven with three days extra, and he who touched pebbles caused an interruption.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jisne achhi tarah wuzu kiya, phir jumma ki namaz ke liye aaya, khutba suna, khaamosh raha, uske us waqt se agle jumma tak ke saare gunah maaf kar diye jayenge, teen din ki ziyaadti ke saath, aur jisne kankariyon ko chhua usne rukaawat paida ki.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported: We used to observe (Jumu'a) prayer with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and then we returned and gave rest to our camels used for carrying water. Hassan[ (one of the narrators) said: I asked Ja'far what time that was. He said.. It is the time when the sun passes the meridian.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath jumma ki namaz padha karte the aur phir wapas jaakar apne paani dhone wale oonton ko aaraam dete the. Hassan, raawiyon mein se ek, ne kaha: Maine Ja'far se poocha ki ye kaunsa waqt tha. Unhone kaha: Ye woh waqt hai jab suraj darmiyan-bindu se guzarta hai.

e: Ja'far reported on the authority of his father: that he asked Jabir b. 'Abdullah when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed Jumu'a prayer. He said: He used to observe prayer, and we then went (back) to our camels and gave them rest. 'Abdullah made this addition in his narration: "Till the sun passed the meridian. and the camels used for carrying water (took rest)."
hi: Ja'far ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki unhone Jabir bin Abdullah se poocha ki Rasoolullah (SAW) jumma ki namaz kis waqt padhte the. Unhone kaha: Woh namaz padha karte the, aur phir hum apne oonton ki taraf laut aate aur unhe aaraam dete. Abdullah ne apni riwayat mein ye izafa kiya: "Yahan tak ki suraj darmiyan-bindu se guzar jaata, aur paani dhone wale oont aaraam karte."

e: Sahl b. Said said: We did not have a siesta or lunch till after the Friday prayer. (Ibn Hajr added: ) "During the lifetime of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)."
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd ne kaha: Hum jumma ki namaz se pehle na qailula, dopahar ki neend, karte the na khana khaate the. Ibn Hajr ne izafa kiya: "Rasoolullah (SAW) ke daur mein."

e: Iyas b. Salama b. al-Akwa' reported on the authority of his father: We used to observe the Friday prayer with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) when the sun passed the meridian. and we then returned and tried to find out afternoon shadow (of the walls for protecting themselves from the heat of the sun).
hi: Iyas bin Salama bin al-Akwa ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki: Hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath jumma ki namaz tab padha karte the jab suraj darmiyan-bindu se guzarta, aur phir hum wapas jaate aur deewaron ke daupahar ke saaye dhoondte, khud ko suraj ki garmi se bachaane ke liye.

e: Iyas b. Salama b. Akwa' reported on the authority of his father, saying: We used to observe the Friday prayer with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and when we returned we did not find the shadow of the walls in which we could take protection (from the heat of the sun).
hi: Iyas bin Salama bin Akwa ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki, ye kehte hue: Hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath jumma ki namaz padha karte the, aur jab hum wapas aate to hamein deewaron ka koi saaya nahi milta jismein hum panah le sakein, suraj ki garmi se.

e: Ibn 'Umar said that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to deliver the sermon on Friday while standing. He would then sit and then stand (for the second sermon) as they (the Muslims) do nowadays.
hi: Ibn Umar ne kaha ki Rasoolullah (SAW) jumma ke din khade hokar khutba diya karte the. Woh phir baithte aur phir doosre khutbe ke liye khade hote, jaise woh Musalman aajkal karte hain.

e: Jabir b. Samura said: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) gave two sermons between which he sat, recited the Qur'an and exhorted the people.
hi: Jabir bin Samura ne kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) do khutbe diya karte the jinke darmiyan woh baithte, Quran padhte aur logon ko naseehat karte.

e: Jabir b. Samura said that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to deliver the sermon while standing. He would then sit down and then stand up and address in a standing posture; and whoever informed you that he (the Holy Prophet) delivered the sermon while sitting told a lie. By Allah. I prayed with him more than two thousand times.
hi: Jabir bin Samura ne kaha ki Rasoolullah (SAW) khade hokar khutba diya karte the. Woh phir baith jaate aur phir khade hote aur khade hokar khitaab karte; aur jo bhi tumhe bataye ki unhone baithkar khutba diya, usne jhoot kaha. Allah ki qasam, maine unke saath do hazaar se zyada baar namaz padhi.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah reported that the Apostle (ﷺ) was delivering the sermon on Friday in a standing posture when a caravan from Syria arrived. The people flocked towards it till no one was left (with the Holy Prophet) but twelve persons, and it was on this occasion that this verse in regard to Jumu'a was revealed." And when they see merchandise or sport. they break away to it and leave thee standing."
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya ki Rasool (SAW) jumma ke din khade hokar khutba de rahe the ki Syria se ek kaafila aaya. Log uski taraf jhund lekar chal diye yahan tak ki Nabi (SAW) ke saath sirf baarah log reh gaye, aur isi mauqe par jumma ke baare mein ye aayat nazil hui: "Aur jab woh tijarat ya khel dekhte hain, to woh uski taraf toot padte hain aur tumhe khada chhod dete hain."

e: This hadith has been narrated by Husain with the same chain of transmitters but with this alteration that he did not make mention of the standing position.
hi: Ye hadees Husain ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai lekin is tabdeeli ke saath ki unhone khade hone ki halat ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah reported: I was along with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on Friday when a caravan arrived. The people went to it, and none but twelve persons were left behind and I was one of them; and it was on this occasion that this verse was revealed:" And when they see merchandise or sport away to it, and leave thee standing" (lxii. 1 1). they break
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya: Main jumma ke din Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath tha jab ek kaafila aaya. Log uski taraf gaye, aur sirf baarah log peeche reh gaye aur main unmein se ek tha; aur isi mauqe par ye aayat nazil hui: "Aur jab woh tijarat ya khel dekhte hain, to woh uski taraf toot padte hain aur tumhe khada chhod dete hain" (62:11).

e: Jabir b. Abdullah reported: While the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was delivering (a sermon) on Friday, a caravan of merchandise came to Medina. The Companions of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) rushed towards it till only twelve persons were left with him including Abu Bakr and 'Umar; and it was at this occasion that this verse was revealed." And when they see merchandise or sport, they break away to it."
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya: Jab Rasoolullah (SAW) jumma ke din khutba de rahe the, tab Madina mein tijarat ka ek kaafila aaya. Rasoolullah (SAW) ke sahaba uski taraf daude yahan tak ki sirf baarah log unke saath reh gaye, jinmein Abu Bakr aur Umar bhi the; aur isi mauqe par ye aayat nazil hui: "Aur jab woh tijarat ya khel dekhte hain, to woh uski taraf toot padte hain."

e: Ka'b b. 'Ujra reported that he entered the mosque and saw Abd al-Rahman b. Umm Hakam delivering the sermon in a sitting posture. Upon this he said: Look at this wretched person; he delivers the sermon while sitting, whereas Allah said:" And when they see merchandise or sport, they break away to it and leave thee standing."
hi: Ka'b bin Ujra ne bayan kiya ki woh masjid mein daakhil hue aur unhone Abdur-Rahman bin Umm Hakam ko baithkar khutba dete dekha. Isper unhone kaha: Is badnaseeb shakhs ko dekho; ye baithkar khutba de raha hai, jabki Allah ne farmaya: "Aur jab woh tijarat ya khel dekhte hain, to woh uski taraf toot padte hain aur tumhe khada chhod dete hain."

e: Abdullah b. Umar and Abu Huraira said that they heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say on the planks of his pulpit: People must cease to neglect the Friday prayer or Allah will seal their hearts and then they will be among the negligent.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar aur Abu Huraira ne kaha ki unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) ko apne mimbar ke takhton par ye kehte suna: Logon ko jumma ki namaz mein ghaflat karna band kar dena chahiye, warna Allah unke dilon par mohar laga dega aur phir woh ghaafilon mein shaamil ho jaayenge.

e: Jabir b. Samura reported: I used to pray with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and both his prayer and sermon were of moderate length.
hi: Jabir bin Samura ne bayan kiya: Main Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath namaz padha karta tha aur unki namaz aur khutba dono ausat lambaai ke hote the.

e: Jabir b. Samura reported: I used to observe prayer with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and his prayer was of moderate length and his sermon too was of moderate length.
hi: Jabir bin Samura ne bayan kiya: Main Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath namaz padha karta tha aur unki namaz ausat lambaai ki hoti thi aur unka khutba bhi ausat lambaai ka hota tha.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah said: When Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) delivered the sermon, his eyes became red, his voice rose, and his anger increased so that he was like one giving a warning against the enemy and saying: "The enemy has made a morning attack on you and in the evening too." He would also say: "The Last Hour and I have been sent like these two." And he would join his forefinger and middle finger; and would further say: "The best of the speech is embodied in the Book of Allah, and the best of the guidance is the guidance given by Muhammad. And the most evil affairs are their innovations; and every innovation is error." He would further say:, I am more dear to a Muslim even than his self; and he who left behind property that is for his family; and he who dies under debt or leaves children (in helplessness), the responsibility (of paying his debt and bringing up his children) lies on me."
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne kaha: Jab Rasoolullah (SAW) khutba dete, to unki aankhein laal ho jaatin, unki aawaaz buland ho jaati, aur unka gussa badh jaata, yahan tak ki woh aisa lagta jaise woh dushman ke khilaaf khabardaar kar rahe hon aur keh rahe hon: "Dushman ne tumpar subah bhi hamla kiya hai aur shaam ko bhi." Woh ye bhi kehte: "Aakhri ghadi aur main in do ki tarah, ek doosre ke kareeb, bheje gaye hain," aur woh apni shahadat ki ungli aur beech ki ungli ko jodte; aur aage kehte: "Sabse behtareen kalaam Allah ki Kitaab mein hai, aur sabse behtareen hidayat Muhammad ki di gayi hidayat hai. Aur sabse buri baaten unke bidatein hain; aur har bidaat gumraahi hai." Woh aage kehte: Main kisi Musalman ko uski apni jaan se bhi zyada azeez hoon; aur jo koi maal chhod jaaye, woh uske gharwalon ke liye hai; aur jo qarz mein maut paaye ya bachche, laachaari mein, chhod jaaye, uski zimmedaari mujhpar hai, uska qarz chukaana aur uske bachchon ki parvarish karna.

e: Ja'far b. Muhammad said on the authority of his father: I heard Jabir b. 'Abdullah saying that in the sermon of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) he praised Allah, lauded Him (and subsequently said  and raised his voice, and the rest of the hadith is the same).
hi: Ja'far bin Muhammad ne apne walid ke hawale se kaha: Maine Jabir bin Abdullah ko ye kehte suna ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ke khutbe mein unhone Allah ki tareef ki, uski hamd ki, aur baad mein kaha aur apni aawaaz buland ki, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Jabir reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), while delivering the sermon' to the people, praised Allah, and lauded Him for what He deserves, and would then say: He whom Allah guides aright, there is none to mislead him, and he who is led astray, there is none to guide him (aright), and the best of the talk is embodied in the Book of Allah. And the rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Jabir ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW), logon ko khutba dete waqt, Allah ki tareef karte, aur uski utni hamd karte jiske Woh laayak hai, aur phir kehte: Jise Allah hidayat de, use koi gumraah nahi kar sakta, aur jo gumraah ho jaaye, use koi hidayat nahi de sakta, aur sabse behtareen baat Allah ki Kitaab mein hai. Aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported: Dimad came to Mecca and he belonged to the tribe of Azd Shanu'a, and he used to protect the person who was under the influence of charm. He heard the foolish people of Mecca say that Muhammad (ﷺ) was under the spell. Upon this he said: If I were to come across this man, Allah might cure him at my hand. He met him and said: Muhammad, I can protect (one) who is under the influence of charm, and Allah cures one whom He so desires at my hand. Do you desire (this)? Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Praise is due to Allah, we praise Him, ask His help; and he whom Allah guides aright there is none to lead him astray, and he who is led astray there is none to guide him, and I bear testimony to the fact that there is no god but Allah, He is One, having no partner with Him, and that Muhammad is His Servant and Messenger. Now after this he (Dimad) said: Repeat these words of yours before me, and the messenger of Allah (ﷺ) repeated these to him thrice; and he said I have heard the words of soothsayers and the words of magicians, and the words of poets, but I have never heard such words as yours, and they reach the depth (of the ocean of eloquence) ; bring forth your hand so that I should take oath of fealty to you on Islam. So he took an oath of allegiance to him. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: It (this allegiance of yours) is on behalf of your people too. He said: It is on behalf of my people too. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent an expedition and the flying column passed by his people. The leader of the flying column said to the detachment: Did you find anything from these people? One of the people said: I found a utensil for water. Upon this he (the commander) said: Return it, for he is one of the people of Dimad.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bayan kiya: Dimad Makkah aaye aur woh Azd Shanu'a qabile se taalluq rakhte the, aur woh un logon ki hifazat kiya karte the jo jaadu ke asar mein hote. Unhone Makkah ke naadaan logon ko ye kehte suna ki Muhammad (SAW) par jaadu ka asar hai. Isper unhone kaha: Agar main is shakhs se milun, to shayad Allah mere haath se use theek kar de. Woh unse mile aur kaha: Muhammad, main jaadu ke asar mein aaye shakhs ki hifazat kar sakta hoon, aur Allah jise chahe mere haath se theek kar deta hai. Kya aap ye chahte hain? Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Hamd Allah ke liye hai, hum Uski tareef karte hain, Usi se madad maangte hain; aur jise Allah hidayat de use koi gumraah nahi kar sakta, aur jo gumraah ho jaaye use koi hidayat nahi de sakta, aur main gawaahi deta hoon ki Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi hai, Woh akela hai, uska koi shareek nahi, aur Muhammad uske Banda aur Rasool hain. Ab iske baad unhone kaha: Apne ye alfaaz mujhse pehle dohraiye, aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ne ye teen baar unhe dohraye; aur unhone kaha: Maine ganon ke alfaaz, jaadugaron ke alfaaz, aur shayaron ke alfaaz sune hain, lekin maine kabhi aapke jaise alfaaz nahi sune, aur woh fasaahat ke samundar ki tah tak pahunchte hain; apna haath aage badhaiye taaki main aapse Islam par bai'at karun. To unhone unse bai'at li. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Ye tumhari ye bai'at tumhari qaum ki taraf se bhi hai. Unhone kaha: Ye meri qaum ki taraf se bhi hai. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne ek muhim bheji aur us fauji dastay ne unki qaum se guzarte hue poocha. Dastay ke sardaar ne dastay se kaha: Kya tumhe in logon se kuch mila? Logon mein se ek ne kaha: Mujhe paani ka ek bartan mila. Isper unhone kaha: Ise wapas kar do, kyunki woh Dimad ki qaum mein se hai.

e: Abu Wa'il reported: 'Ammar delivered to us the sermon. It was short and eloquent. When he (, Ammir) descended (from the pulpit) we said to him: 0 Abd al-Yaqzn, you have delivered a short and eloquent sermon. Would that you had lengthened (the sermon). He said: I have heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: The lengthening of prayer by a man and the shortness of the sermon is the sign of his understanding (of faith). So lengthen the prayer and shorten the sermon, for there is charm (in precise) expression.
hi: Abu Wa'il ne bayan kiya: Ammar ne hamein khutba diya. Ye chhota aur balaaghat bhara tha. Jab woh mimbar se utre to humne unse kaha: Aye Abd al-Yaqzn, aapne ek chhota aur balaaghat bhara khutba diya. Kaash aap ise lamba karte. Unhone kaha: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Kisi shakhs ki namaz ka lamba hona aur khutbe ka chhota hona uske imaan ki samajh ki nishaani hai. Is liye namaz ko lamba karo aur khutbe ko chhota, kyunki sateek bayaan mein jaadu hota hai.

e: 'Adi b. Hatim reported: that a person recited a sermon before the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) thus: He who obeys Allah and His Apostle, he in fact follows the right path, and he who disobeys both of them, he goes astray. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: What a bad speaker you are; say: He who disobeys Allah and His Apostle. Ibn Numair added: He in fact went astray.
hi: Adi bin Hatim ne bayan kiya: Ek shakhs ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saamne ek khutba is tarah padha: Jo Allah aur uske Rasool ki itaat kare, woh dar-asal seedhe raaste par chalta hai, aur jo dono ki naafarmani kare, woh gumraah ho jaata hai. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Tum kitne bure khutba dene wale ho; kaho: Jo Allah aur uske Rasool ki naafarmani kare. Ibn Numair ne izafa kiya: Woh dar-asal gumraah ho gaya.

e: Safwan b. Ya'la reported on the authority of his father that he heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) reciting (verses of the Qur'an) on the pulpit. and" They cried: 0 Malik."
hi: Safwan bin Ya'la ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) ko mimbar par Quran ki aayaton ki tilawat karte suna, aur "Woh chillaayenge: Aye Malik" (43:77).

e: 'Amra daughter of Abd al-Rahman reported on the authority of the sister of Amra: I memorised (surah) "Qaf, by the glorious Qur'an" from the mouth of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on Friday for he recited it on the pulpit on every Friday.
hi: Amra, Abdur-Rahman ki beti, ne Amra ki behn ke hawale se riwayat ki: Maine Surah "Qaf, us shaandar Quran ki qasam" Rasoolullah (SAW) ke munh se jumma ke din yaad ki, kyunki woh ise har jumma ko mimbar par padhte the.

e: The daughter of Haritha b. Nu'man said: I did not memorise (Surah) Qaf but from the mouth of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as he used to deliver the. sermon along with it on every Friday. She also added: Our oven and that of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was one.
hi: Haritha bin Nu'man ki beti ne kaha: Maine Surah Qaf sirf Rasoolullah (SAW) ke munh se yaad ki jab woh har jumma ko ise khutba mein shaamil karte the. Unhone ye bhi izafa kiya: Hamara tandoor aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ka tandoor ek hi tha.

e: Umm Bisham hint Haritha b. Nu'man said: Our oven and that of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was one for two years, or for one year or for a part of a year; and I learnt" Qaf. By the Glorious Qur'an" from no other source than the tongue of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who used to recite it every Friday on the pulpit when he delivered the sermon to the people.
hi: Umm Bisham bint Haritha bin Nu'man ne kaha: Hamara tandoor aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ka tandoor do saal tak, ya ek saal tak, ya saal ke ek hisse tak ek hi tha; aur maine "Qaf. Us shaandar Quran ki qasam" kisi aur zariye se nahi balki Rasoolullah (SAW) ki zubaan se seekhi, jise woh har jumma ko mimbar par tab padhte the jab logon ko khutba dete.

e: It was narrated that Umm Hisham bin Harithah bin An-Nu'man said: "Our oven and the oven of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) were the same for two years, or for one year and part of a year. And I only learned "Surah Qaf. By the Glorious Quran" from the tongue of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), who used to recited it every Friday from the Minbar, when he addresses the people."
hi: Ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Umm Hisham bint Haritha bin Nu'man ne kaha: "Hamara tandoor aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ka tandoor do saal tak, ya ek saal aur saal ke ek hisse tak, ek hi tha. Aur maine sirf 'Surah Qaf. Us shaandar Quran ki qasam' Rasoolullah (SAW) ki zubaan se seekhi, jise woh har jumma ko mimbar se tab padhte the jab woh logon se khitaab karte."

e: Umara b. Ruwaiba said he saw Bishr b. Marwan on the pulpit raising his hands and said: Allah, disfigure these hands! I have seen Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gesture no more than this with his hands, and he pointed with his forefinger.
hi: Umara bin Ruwaiba ne kaha ki unhone Bishr bin Marwan ko mimbar par apne haath uthaate dekha aur kaha: Allah in haathon ko bad-namoona kar de! Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko apne haathon se isse zyada koi ishara karte nahi dekha, aur unhone apni shahadat ki ungli se ishara kiya.

e: This hadith has been narrated by another chain of transmitters on the authority of Husain b. Abd al-Rahman.
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se Husain bin Abdur-Rahman ke hawale se bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was delivering the sermon on Friday a person came there, and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to him: So and so, have you prayed (two rak'ahs)? He said: No. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Then stand and pray.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya ki jab Rasoolullah (SAW) jumma ke din khutba de rahe the, to ek shakhs wahan aaya, aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unse kaha: Aye falan, kya tumne do rakat namaz padhi hai? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Unhone kaha: To khade ho aur namaz padho.

e: This hadith is narrated by Jabir through another chain of transmitters but Hammad (one of the narrators) made no mention of the two rak'ahs.
hi: Ye hadees Jabir ne ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki hai lekin Hammad, raawiyon mein se ek, ne do rakaton ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah said that a person entered the Mosque while the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was delivering the sermon on Friday. Upon this he (the Holy Prophet) said: Have you observed prayer? He said: No. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Stand and offer the two rak'ahs. According to Qutaiba, the words are:" He said: Offer two rak'ahs."
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne kaha ki ek shakhs masjid mein daakhil hua jabki Rasoolullah (SAW) jumma ke din khutba de rahe the. Isper unhone kaha: Kya tumne namaz padhi hai? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Unhone kaha: Khade ho jao aur do rakat padho. Qutaiba ke mutabik, alfaaz hain: "Unhone kaha: Do rakat padho."

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that a person came (in the Mosque) while the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was delivering the sermon on Friday (standing) on the pulpit. He (the Holy Prophet) said to him: Have you offered two rak'ahs? He said: No. Upon this he said: Then observe (them).
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs masjid mein aaya jabki Rasoolullah (SAW) jumma ke din mimbar par khutba de rahe the. Unhone unse kaha: Kya tumne do rakat padhi hain? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Isper unhone kaha: To padho.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah said that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) delivered the sermon and said: When any one of you comes for the Friday (prayer) and the Imam comes out (from his apartment), (even then) should observe two rak'ahs (of prayer).
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne kaha ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne khutba diya aur kaha: Jab tum mein se koi jumma ke liye aaye aur Imam apne kamre se bahar aa chuka ho, tab bhi use do rakat padhni chahiye.

e: Jabir reported that Sulaik Ghatafani came on Friday (for prayer) while the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was sitting on the pulpit. Sulaik also sat down before observing prayer. The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) said: Have you observed two rak'ahs? He said: No. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Stand and observe them
hi: Jabir ne bayan kiya ki Sulaik Ghatafani jumma ke din aaye jabki Rasoolullah (SAW) mimbar par baithe the. Sulaik bhi bina namaz padhe baith gaye. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Kya tumne do rakat padhi hain? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Unhone kaha: Khade ho aur unhe padho.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported: Sulaik Ghatafani came on Friday when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was delivering the sermon. He (Sulaik) sat down. He (the Holy Prophet) said to him: 0 Sulaik I stand and observe two rak'ahs and make them short, and then said: When any one of you comes on Friday, while the Imam delivers the sermon, he should observe two rak'ahs and should make them short.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya: Sulaik Ghatafani jumma ke din aaye jab Rasoolullah (SAW) khutba de rahe the. Unhone baith gaye. Unhone unse kaha: Aye Sulaik, khade ho aur do rakat padho aur unhe mukhtasar rakho, aur phir kaha: Jab tum mein se koi jumma ke din aaye, jabki Imam khutba de raha ho, to use do rakat padhni chahiye aur unhe mukhtasar rakhna chahiye.

e: Abu Rifa'a reported: I came to the Prophet (ﷺ) when he was delivering the sermon, and I said: Messenger of Allah, here is a stranger and he wants to learn about this religion and he does not know what this religion is. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) looked at me and left his sermon till he came to me, and he was given a chair and I thought that Its legs were made of iron. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sat In it and he began to teach me what Allah had taught him. He then came (to the pulpit) for his sermon and completed it to the end.
hi: Abu Rifa'a ne bayan kiya: Main Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya jab woh khutba de rahe the, aur maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, ye ek ajnabi shakhs hai aur woh is deen ke baare mein seekhna chahta hai aur use nahi pata ki ye deen kya hai. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne meri taraf dekha aur apna khutba chhod diya yahan tak ki woh mere paas aaye, aur unhe ek kursi di gayi aur mujhe laga ki uski taangein loha ki bani thin. Rasoolullah (SAW) usmein baithe aur unhone mujhe woh sikhaana shuru kiya jo Allah ne unhe sikhaya tha. Woh phir mimbar par apne khutbe ke liye aaye aur ise akhir tak mukammal kiya.

e: Ibn Abu Rafi' said: Marwan appointed Abu Huraira as his deputy in Medina and he himself left for Mecca. Abu Huraira led us in the Jumu'a prayer and recited after Surah Jumu'a in the second rak'ah:" When the hypocrites came to thee" (Surah 63). I then met Abu Huraira as he came back and said to him: You have recited two surahs which 'Ali b. Abu Talib used to recite in Kufah. Upon this Abu Huraira said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) reciting these two in the Friday (prayer).
hi: Ibn Abu Rafi' ne kaha: Marwan ne Abu Huraira ko Madina mein apna naa'ib banaya aur khud Makkah chale gaye. Abu Huraira ne humein jumma ki namaz padhayi aur Surah Jumma ke baad doosri rakat mein padha: "Jab munaafiq tumhare paas aaye" (Surah 63). Main phir Abu Huraira se mila jab woh wapas aaye aur unse kaha: Aapne do surahen padhin jo Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) Kufa mein padha karte the. Isper Abu Huraira ne kaha: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye do surahen jumma ki namaz mein padhte suna.

e: This hadith is narrated by Abdullah b. Abu Rafi' with the same chain of transmitters but with this modification: " That he recited Surah Jumu'a (lxii.) in the first rak'ah and" The hypocrites came" in the second rak'ah.
hi: Ye hadees Abdullah bin Abu Rafi' ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai lekin is tabdeeli ke saath: "Ki unhone pehli rakat mein Surah Jumma, 62, padhi aur doosri rakat mein 'munaafiq aaye.'"

e: Nu'man b. Bashir reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to recite on two 'Ids and in Friday prayer: " Glorify The name of Thy Lord, the Most High" (Surah lxxxvii.), and:" Has there come to thee the news of the overwhelming event" (lxxxviii.). And when the 'Id and Jumu'a combined on a day he recited these two (surah) in both the prayers.
hi: Nu'man bin Bashir ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) dono Eidon aur jumma ki namaz mein padha karte the: "Apne Buland Rab ke naam ki tasbeeh karo" (Surah 87), aur "Kya tumhare paas us bhaari haadse ki khabar aayi hai" (88). Aur jab Eid aur jumma ek din par ikattha hote, to woh ye dono surahen dono namazon mein padhte.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Ibrahim b Muhammad b. al-Muntashir with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ibrahim bin Muhammad bin al-Muntashir ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: Dahhak b. Qais wrote to Nu'man b. Bashir asking him what the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) recited on Friday besides Surah Jumu'a He said that he recited: " Has there reached..." (Surah lxxxviii, ).
hi: Dahhak bin Qais ne Nu'man bin Bashir ko likha aur unse poocha ki Surah Jumma ke ilawa Rasoolullah (SAW) jumma ke din aur kya padhte the. Unhone kaha ki woh "Kya tumhare paas aa chuki hai..." (Surah 88) padhte the.

e: Ibn Abbas reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) used to recite in the morning prayer on Friday Surah" Alif-Lam-Mim, Tanz'il ul-Sajda" (Surah xxxii.): Surely there came over the man a time" (Surah lxxvii) and he used to recite in Jumu'a prayer Surahs Jumu'a and al-Munafiqin.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bayan kiya: Rasool (SAW) jumma ke din subah ki namaz mein Surah "Alif-Lam-Mim, Tanzil us-Sajda" (32) padhte the: "Yaqeenan insaan par ek waqt aaya" (76), aur woh jumma ki namaz mein Surah Jumma aur al-Munafiqin padhte the.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated by Sufyan with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Sufyan ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: Mukhawwil has narrated this hadith on the authority of Sufyan.
hi: Mukhawwil ne ye hadees Sufyan ke hawale se riwayat ki hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to recite in the dawn prayer on Friday" Alif-Lam-Mim, Tanzil" and" Surely there came."
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) jumma ke din subah ki namaz mein "Alif-Lam-Mim, Tanzil" aur "Yaqeenan aaya" padhte the.

e: Abu Huraira reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to recite in the dawn prayer on Friday: " Alif-Lam-Mim, Tanzil" in the first rak'ah, and in the second one:" Surely there came over the man a time when he was nothing that could be mentioned."
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) jumma ke din subah ki namaz mein "Alif-Lam-Mim, Tanzil" pehli rakat mein aur doosri mein: "Yaqeenan insaan par ek waqt aaya jab woh kuch bhi zikr karne laayak nahi tha" padhte the.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When any one of you observes the Jumu'a prayer (two obligatory rak'ahs in congregation), he should observe four (rak'ahs) afterwards.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab tum mein se koi jumma ki namaz, jamaat mein do farz rakat, padhe, to use uske baad char rakat padhni chahiye.

e: Suhail reported on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When you observe prayer after (the two obligatory rak'ahs) of Jumu'ah, you should observe four rak'ahs (and 'Amr in his narration has made this addition that Ibn Idris said this on the authority of Suhail): And if you are in a hurry on account of something, you should observe two rak'ahs in the mosque and two when you return (to your house).
hi: Suhail ne Abu Huraira ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab tum jumma ke, do farz rakaton ke, baad namaz padho, to tumhe char rakat padhni chahiye, aur Amr ne apni riwayat mein ye izafa kiya ki Ibn Idris ne ye Suhail ke hawale se kaha: Aur agar tumhe kisi wajah se jaldi ho, to tumhe do rakat masjid mein padhni chahiye aur do jab tum wapas jao apne ghar.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When any one amongst you observes prayer after Jumu'a, he should observe four rak'ahs. (In the hadith transmitted by Jarir the word minkum is not recorded.)
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab tum mein se koi jumma ke baad namaz padhe, to use char rakat padhni chahiye. Jarir ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein lafz "minkum" darj nahi hai.

e: Nafi' reported that when 'Abdullah (b. 'Umar) observed the Friday prayer and came back he observed two rak'ahs in his house, and then said: The Messenger of Allah (may peace be updn him) used to do this.
hi: Nafi' ne bayan kiya ki jab Abdullah bin Umar jumma ki namaz padhkar wapas aate, to woh apne ghar mein do rakat padhte, aur phir kehte: Rasoolullah (SAW) aisa kiya karte the.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Umar, while describing the Nafl prayer of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), said: He did not observe (Nafl) prayer after Jumu'a till he went back and observed two rak'ahs in his house. Yahya said: I guess that I uttered these words (before Imam Malik) that he of course observed (them).
hi: Abdullah bin Umar ne, Rasoolullah (SAW) ki Nafil namaz ka bayaan karte hue, kaha: Unhone jumma ke baad Nafil namaz tab tak nahi padhi jab tak woh wapas jaakar apne ghar mein do rakat na padh len. Yahya ne kaha: Mera khayal hai ki maine ye alfaaz Imam Malik ke saamne kahe ki unhone zaroor inhe padha.

e: Salim narrated on the authority of his father that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to observe two rak'ahs after Jumu'a.
hi: Salim ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Rasoolullah (SAW) jumma ke baad do rakat padha karte the.

e: `Umar b. `Ata' b. Abu Khuwar said that Nafi` b. Jubair sent him to al- Sa'ib the son of Namir's sister to ask him about what he had seen in the prayer of Mu`awiya. He said: Yes, I observed the Jumu`a prayer along with him in Maqsura and when the Imam pronounced salutation I stood up at my place and observed (Sunan rak`ahs). As he entered (the apartment) he sent for me and said: Do not repeat what you have done. Whenever you have observed the Jumu`a prayer, do not observe (Sunan prayer) till you, have talked or gone out, for the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had ordered us to do this and not to combine two (types of) prayers without talking or going out.
hi: Umar bin Ata bin Abu Khuwar ne kaha ki Nafi' bin Jubair ne unhe al-Sa'ib, Namir ki behn ke bete, ke paas bheja ki woh un se poochein ki unhone Muawiya ki namaz mein kya dekha tha. Unhone kaha: Haan, maine unke saath Maqsura mein jumma ki namaz padhi aur jab Imam ne salaam pheera, to main apni jagah par khada hua aur Sunan rakat padhi. Jab woh Muawiya andar gaye, apne kamre mein, to unhone mujhe bulwaya aur kaha: Jo tumne kiya usse dobara mat karna. Jab bhi tum jumma ki namaz padho, Sunan namaz tab tak na padho jab tak tum baat na kar lo ya bahar na chale jao, kyunki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne humein aisa hi hukum diya tha ki hum do tarah ki namazon ko bina baat kiye ya bahar gaye ikattha na karein.

e: The same hadith is narrated on the authority of 'Umar b. Ata' but with this modification: When he (the Imam) pronounced salutation I stood up at my place. No mention was made of the Imam in it.
hi: Yehi hadees Umar bin Ata ke hawale se bayan ki gayi hai lekin is tabdeeli ke saath: Jab unhone, Imam ne, salaam pheera, main apni jagah par khada hua. Ismein Imam ka koi zikr nahi kiya gaya.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported: I participated in the Fitr prayer with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr, 'Umar and 'Uthman, and all of them observed this prayer before the Khutba, and then he (the Holy Prophet) delivered the sermon. Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) descended (from the pulpit) and I (perceive) as if I am seeing him as he is commanding people with his hand to sit down. He then made his way through their (assembly) till he came to the women. Bilal was with him. He then recited (this verse): O Prophet, when believing women come to thee giving thee a pledge that they will not associate aught with Allah" (lx. 12) till he finished (his address to) them and then said: Do you conform to it (what has been described in the verse)? Only one woman among them replied: Yes, Apostle of Allah, but none else replied. He (the narrator) said: It could not be ascertained who actually she was. He (the Holy Prophet) exhorted them to give alms. Bilal stretched his cloth and then said: Come forward with alms. Let my father and mother be taken as ransom for you. And they began to throw rings and ringlets in the cloth of Bilal.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bayan kiya: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW), Abu Bakr, Umar aur Uthman ke saath Eid-ul-Fitr ki namaz mein shirkat ki, aur unn sab logon ne khutbe se pehle ye namaz padhi, aur phir unhone khutba diya. Phir Rasoolullah (SAW) mimbar se neeche utre aur mujhe aisa lagta hai jaise main dekh raha hoon unhe apne haath se logon ko baithne ka ishara karte hue. Woh phir unke majme'e ke beech se apna raasta banaate hue auraton tak pahunche. Bilal unke saath the. Unhone phir ye aayat padhi: "Aye Nabi, jab momin auraten tumhare paas aaye is bai'at ke saath ki woh Allah ke saath kuch shareek nahi karengi" (60:12), yahan tak ki unhone unse khitaab khatam kiya aur phir kaha: Kya tum ispar amal karti ho? Unmein se sirf ek aurat ne jawab diya: Haan, Ya Rasoolullah, lekin kisi aur ne jawab nahi diya. Raawi ne kaha: Ye pata nahi chal saka ki woh asal mein kaun thi. Unhone unhe sadaqa dene ki targheeb di. Bilal ne apna kapda phaila diya aur phir kaha: Sadaqe ke saath aage aao. Mere maa-baap tumpar qurbaan hon. Aur woh apni angoothiyaan aur chhoti angoothiyaan Bilal ke kapde mein daalne lagin.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported: I bear testimony to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) offering prayer before Kbutba. He (after saying prayer) delivered the Kutba, and he found that the women could not hear it, so he came to them and exhorted them and preached them and commanded them to give alms, and Bilal had stretched his cloth and the women were throwing rings, earrings and other things. This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ayyub with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bayan kiya: Main gawaahi deta hoon ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne khutbe se pehle namaz padhi. Unhone namaz ke baad khutba diya, aur unhone paaya ki auraten use sun nahi pa rahi thin, is liye woh unke paas gaye aur unhe targheeb di aur naseehat ki aur unhe sadaqa dene ka hukum diya, aur Bilal ne apna kapda phaila diya tha aur auraten angoothiyaan, kaan ki baaliyaan aur doosri cheezein daal rahi thin. Ye hadees Ayyub ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) stood up on the day of 'Id al-Fitr and observed prayer. And he commenced the prayer before the sermon. He then delivered the sermon. When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had finished (the sermon) he came down from (the pulpit), and made his way to the women and exhorted them (to do good acts), and he was leaning on the hand of Bilal. Bilal had stretched his cloth in which women were throwing alms. I (one of the narrators) said to 'Ata' (the other narrator): It must be Zakat on the day of Fitr. He ('Ata') said: No. It was alms (which) they were giving on that occasion, and a woman gave her ring, and then others gave, and then others gave. I said to 'Ata': Is It right now for the Imam to come to the women when he has finished (his address to the men) that he should exhort them (to good deeds)? He said: (Why not) by my life, it is right for them (to do so). What is the matter with them that they do not do it now?
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya: Rasool (SAW) Eid-ul-Fitr ke din khade hue aur namaz padhi. Aur unhone namaz khutbe se pehle shuru ki. Phir unhone khutba diya. Jab Rasoolullah (SAW) khutba mukammal kar chuke, to woh mimbar se neeche utre, aur auraton ki taraf gaye aur unhe achhe amal ki targheeb di, aur woh Bilal ke haath ka sahara le rahe the. Bilal ne apna kapda phaila diya tha jismein auraten sadaqa daal rahi thin. Maine, raawiyon mein se ek ne, Ata, doosre raawi, se kaha: Ye zaroor Fitr ke din ki zakaat hogi. Unhone kaha: Nahi. Ye sadaqa tha jo woh us mauqe par de rahe thin, aur ek aurat ne apni angoothi di, aur phir doosron ne di, aur phir doosron ne di. Maine Ata se kaha: Kya ab bhi Imam ke liye ye theek hai ki woh auraton ke paas jaaye jab woh mardon se khitaab khatam kar chuke ho aur unhe achhe amal ki targheeb de? Unhone kaha: Kyun nahi, meri jaan ki qasam, ye unke liye theek hai. Unhe kya ho gaya hai ki woh ab aisa nahi karte?

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported: I observed prayer with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the 'Id day. He commenced with prayer before the sermon without Adhan and Iqama.
