He then stood up leaning on Bilal, and he commanded (them) to be on guard (against evil for the sake of) Allah, and he exhorted (them) on obedience to Him, and he preached to the people and admonished them. He then walked on till he came to the women and preached to them and admonished them, and asked them to give alms, for most of them are the fuel for Hell. A woman having a dark spot on the cheek stood up and said: Why is it so, Messenger of Allah? He said: For you grumble often and show ingratitude to your spouse. And then they began to give alms out of their ornaments such as their earrings and rings which they threw on to the cloth of Bilal.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya: Maine Eid ke din Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath namaz padhi. Unhone khutbe se pehle, bina Azaan aur Iqamat ke, namaz shuru ki. Woh phir Bilal ka sahara lete hue khade hue, aur unhone logon ko Allah se darne, buraai se bachne, ka hukum diya, aur Uski itaat ki targheeb di, aur logon ko naseehat aur ta'leem di. Woh phir chalte gaye yahan tak ki auraton ke paas pahunche aur unhe naseehat di aur ta'leem di, aur unhe sadaqa dene ko kaha, kyunki unmein se zyadatar jahannam ka indhan hain. Ek aurat, jiske gaal par ek kaala nishaan tha, khadi hui aur kaha: Aisa kyun hai, Ya Rasoolullah? Unhone kaha: Kyunki tum aksar shikaayat karti ho aur apne shauhar ke prati na-shukri dikhaati ho. Aur phir woh apni zeenat, jaise apni baaliyan aur angoothiyaan, sadaqe mein dene lagin jinhe unhone Bilal ke kapde mein daala.

e: Ibn 'Abbas and Jaibir b. 'Abdullah al-Ansari reported: There was no Adhan on the (occasion) of Id-ul-Fitr and Id-ul-Adha. I (Ibn Juraij) said: I asked him after some time about it. He ('Ata', one of the narrators) said: Jabir b. 'Abdullah al-Ansari told me: There is neither any Adhan on Id-ul-Fitr when the Imam comes out, nor even after his coming out; their is neither lqama nor call nor anything of the sort of calling on that day and nor Iqama.
hi: Ibn Abbas aur Jabir bin Abdullah al-Ansari ne bayan kiya: Eid-ul-Fitr aur Eid-ul-Adha ke mauqe par koi Azaan nahi hoti thi. Maine, Ibn Juraij ne, kuch der baad unse iske baare mein poocha. Unhone, Ata ne, raawiyon mein se ek, kaha: Jabir bin Abdullah al-Ansari ne mujhe bataya: Na Eid-ul-Fitr par jab Imam bahar aata hai koi Azaan hoti hai, na hi unke bahar aane ke baad; na Iqamat hoti hai, na koi pukaar, na is qism ki koi cheez us din, aur na hi Iqamat.

e: 'Ata' reported that Ibn 'Abbas sent (him) to Ibn Zubair at the commencement of the oath of allegiance to him (for Caliphate saying): As there is no Adhan on 'Id-ul-Fitr, so you should not pronounce it. Ibn Zubair did not pronounce Adhan on that day. He (Ibn 'Abbas) also sent him (with this message) that sermon (is to be delivered) after the prayer, and thus it was done. So lbn Zubair observed prayer before Khutba.
hi: Ata ne bayan kiya ki Ibn Abbas ne unhe Ibn Zubair ke paas bheja jab unki khilafat ke liye bai'at ki shuruaat ho rahi thi, ye kehte hue: Chunki Eid-ul-Fitr par Azaan nahi hoti, is liye tumhe bhi ise nahi kehna chahiye. Ibn Zubair ne us din Azaan nahi kahi. Unhone ye bhi kehla bheja ki khutba namaz ke baad dena chahiye, aur aisa hi kiya gaya. To Ibn Zubair ne khutbe se pehle namaz padhi.

e: Jabir b. Samura said: I prayed with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prayers on two I'ds wore than once or twice without there being Adhan and Iqama.
hi: Jabir bin Samura ne kaha: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath do Eidon ki namaz ek se zyada baar, bina Azaan aur Iqamat ke, padhi.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), Abu Bakr and 'Umar used to observe the two 'Id prayers before the sermon.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW), Abu Bakr aur Umar do Eidon ki namaz khutbe se pehle padha karte the.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to go out on the day of Adha and on the day of Fitr and commenced the prayer. And after having observed his prayer and pronounced the salutation, he stood up facing people as they were seated at their places of worship. And if he intended to send out an army he made mention of it to the people, and if he intended any other thing besides it, he commanded them (to do that). He used to say (to the people): Give alms, give alms, give alms, and the majority that gave alms was of women. He then returned and this (practice) remained (in vogue) till Marwan b. al- Hakam (came into power). I went out hand in hand with Marwan till we came to the place of worship and there Kathir b. Salt had built a pulpit of clay and brick. Marwan began to tug me with his hand as though he were pulling me towards the pulpit, while I was pulling him towards the prayer. When I saw him doing that I said: What has happened to the practice of beginning with prayer? He said: No, Abu Sa'id, what you are familiar with has been abandoned. I thereupon said (three times and went back): By no means, by Him in Whose hand my life is, you are not doing anything better than what I am familiar with.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) Adha ke din aur Fitr ke din nikalte aur namaz shuru karte. Aur apni namaz padhne aur salaam pheerne ke baad, woh logon ki taraf mudkar khade hote jabki woh apni namaz ki jagahon par baithe hote. Aur agar unka koi lashkar bhejne ka irada hota, to woh iska logon se zikr karte, aur agar unka koi aur kaam karne ka irada hota, to woh unhe aisa karne ka hukum dete. Woh logon se kehte: Sadaqa do, sadaqa do, sadaqa do, aur zyadatar sadaqa dene wali auraten hoti thin. Woh phir wapas jaate aur ye amal tab tak jaari raha jab tak Marwan bin al-Hakam satta mein nahi aaye. Main Marwan ke haath mein haath daale bahar nikla yahan tak ki hum namaz ki jagah par pahunche aur wahan Kathir bin Salt ne mitti aur eenton se ek mimbar banaya tha. Marwan mujhe apne haath se khaenchne laga jaise woh mujhe mimbar ki taraf khinch rahe hon, jabki main use namaz ki taraf khinch raha tha. Jab maine unhe aisa karte dekha to maine kaha: Namaz se shuru karne ke amal ka kya hua? Unhone kaha: Nahi, Abu Sa'id, jo tumhe pata hai woh amal chhod diya gaya hai. Isper maine teen baar kaha, aur wapas chala gaya: Kabhi nahi, us hasti ki qasam jiske haath mein meri zindagi hai, tum jo kuch bhi kar rahe ho, woh usse behtar nahi hai jo main jaanta hoon.

e: Umm 'Atiyya said: He (the Messenger of Allah) commanded us that we should take out unmarried women and the screened away ladies for 'Id prayers, and he commanded the menstruating women to remain away from the place of worship of the Muslims.
hi: Umm Atiyya ne kaha: Unhone humein hukum diya ki hum kunwari ladkiyon aur pardaanashin auraton ko Eid ki namaz ke liye bahar le jaayein, aur unhone haiz mein aayi auraton ko Musalmaanon ki namaz ki jagah se door rehne ka hukum diya.

e: Umm Atiyya reported: We were commanded to go out as well as the hidden away ladies and those unmarried. She said menstruating women were to come out amongst you, but remain behind people and pronounce takbir (Allah-o-Akbar) along with them.
hi: Umm Atiyya ne bayan kiya: Humein hukum diya gaya ki hum bahar jaayein, aur usi tarah pardaanashin aur kunwari ladkiyan bhi. Unhone kaha ki haiz mein aayi auraton ko tum mein shaamil hokar aana chahiye, lekin log se peeche rehna chahiye aur unke saath takbeer kehni chahiye.

e: Umm 'Atiyya reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commanded us to bring out on'Id-ul-Fitr and 'Id-ul-Adha young women, menstruating women and screened away ladies, menstruating women kept back from prayer, but participated in goodness and supplication of the Muslims. I said: Messenger of Allah, one of us does not have an outer garment (to cover her face and body). He said: Let her sister cover her with her outer garment.
hi: Umm Atiyya ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne humein hukum diya ki hum Eid-ul-Fitr aur Eid-ul-Adha ke din jawaan auraton, haiz mein aayi auraton, aur pardaanashin auraton ko bahar le jaayein, haiz mein aayi auraton ko namaz se door rakha jaata, lekin unhe Musalmaanon ki bhalaai aur dua mein shaamil hona chahiye. Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, hummein se kisi ke paas bahri kapda, apna chehra aur badan dhakne ke liye, nahi hai. Unhone kaha: Uski behn use apna bahri kapda de de.

e:
Ibn 'Abbas reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went out on the day of Adha or Fitr and observed two rak'ahs, and did not observe prayer (at that place) before and after that. He then came to the women along with Bilal and commanded them to give alms and the women began to give their rings and necklaces. 
This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) Adha ya Fitr ke din bahar gaye aur do rakat padhi, aur is jagah par isse pehle ya baad mein koi aur namaz nahi padhi. Woh phir Bilal ke saath auraton ke paas aaye aur unhe sadaqa dene ka hukum diya aur auraten apni angoothiyaan aur haaron dene lagin. Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Umar reported that (his father) 'Umar b. Khattab asked Abu Waqid al-Laithi what the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to recite on 'Id-ul-Adha and 'Id-ul-Fitr. He said: He used to recite in them:" Qaf. By the Glorious Qur'an" (Surah 1)," The Hour drew near, and the moon was rent asunder" (Surah liv.).
hi: Abdullah bin Umar ne bayan kiya ki Umar bin Khattab (RA) ne Abu Waqid al-Laithi se poocha ki Rasoolullah (SAW) Eid-ul-Adha aur Eid-ul-Fitr par kya padhte the. Unhone kaha: Woh inmein "Qaf. Us shaandar Quran ki qasam" (Surah 50), "Ghadi qareeb aa gayi, aur chaand phat gaya" (Surah 54) padha karte the.

e: 'Utba reported that his father Waqid al-Laithi said: 'Umar b. Khattab asked me what the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) recited on 'Id day. I said:" The Hour drew near" and Qaf. By the Glorious Qur'an".
hi: Utba ne bayan kiya ki unke walid Waqid al-Laithi ne kaha: Umar bin Khattab ne mujhse poocha ki Rasoolullah (SAW) Eid ke din kya padhte the. Maine kaha: "Ghadi qareeb aa gayi" aur "Qaf. Us shaandar Quran ki qasam."

e: 'A'isha reported: Abu Bakr came to see me and I had two girls with me from among the girls of the Ansar and they were singing what the Ansar recited to one another at the Battle of Bu'ath. They were not, however, singing girls. Upon this Abu Bakr said: What I (the playing of) this wind instrument of Satan in the house of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and this too on 'Id day? Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Abu Bakr, every people have a festival and it is our festival (so let them play on).
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Abu Bakr mujhse milne aaye aur mere paas Ansar ki do larkiyaan thin aur woh woh gaana ga rahi thin jo Ansar ne Buath ki jung mein ek doosre ko sunaaya tha. Woh, halaanki, peshevar gaane wali nahi thin. Isper Abu Bakr ne kaha: Kya ye Shaitaan ka baaja Rasoolullah (SAW) ke ghar mein, aur woh bhi Eid ke din? Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Abu Bakr, har qaum ka apna tyohar hota hai aur ye hamara tyohar hai, is liye unhe bajaane do.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Hisham with the same chain of transmitters, but there the words are: " Two girls were playing upon a tambourine."
hi: Ye hadees Hisham ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai, lekin wahan alfaaz hain: "Do larkiyaan daf baja rahi thin."

e: 'A'isha reported that Abu Bakr came to her and there were with her two girls on Adha days who were singing and beating the tambourine and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had wrapped himself with his mantle. Abu Bakr scolded them. The Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) uncovered (his face) and said: Abu Bakr, leave them alone for these are the days of 'Id. And 'A'isha said: I recapitulate to my mind the fact that once the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) screened me with his mantle and I saw the sports of the Abyssinians, and I was only a girl, and so you can well imagine how a girl of tender age is fond of watching the sport.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Abu Bakr unke paas aaye aur unke paas do larkiyaan Adha ke dinon mein thin jo gaana ga rahi thin aur daf baja rahi thin, aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ne apni chadar odh rakhi thi. Abu Bakr ne unhe daanta. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne apna chehra khola aur kaha: Abu Bakr, unhe rehne do, kyunki ye Eid ke din hain. Aur Aisha ne kaha: Mujhe yaad hai ki ek baar Rasoolullah (SAW) ne mujhe apni chadar se dhaank diya aur maine Habashiyon ka khel dekha, aur main sirf ek larki thi, is liye tum khud andaaza laga sakte ho ki ek chhoti umar ki larki khel dekhne ki kitni shauqeen hoti hai.

e: 'A'isha reported: BY Allah, I remember the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) standing on the door of my apartment screening me with his mantle enabling me to see the sport of the Abyssinians as they played with their daggers in the mosque of the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upom him). He (the Holy Prophet) kept standing for my sake till I was satiated and then I went back; and thus you can well imagine how long a girl tender of age who is fond of sports (could have watched it).
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ki qasam, mujhe yaad hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) mere kamre ke darwaze par khade hue mujhe apni chadar se dhaank rahe the taaki main Habashiyon ka khel dekh sakoon jaisa woh Rasoolullah (SAW) ki masjid mein apne barchhon, khanjaron, se khel rahe the. Woh mere liye tab tak khade rahe jab tak main seer nahi ho gayi aur phir main wapas chali gayi; aur is tarah tum khud andaaza laga sakte ho ki ek chhoti umar ki larki, jo khel ki shauqeen ho, kitni der tak ye dekh sakti thi.

e: `A'isha reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came (to my apartment) while there were two girls with me singing the song of the Battle of Bu`ath. He lay down on the bed and turned away his face. Then came Abu Bakr and he scolded me and said: Oh! this musical instrument of the devil in the house of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)! The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) turned towards him and said: Leave them alone. And when he (the Holy Prophet) became unattentive, I hinted them and they went out, and it was the day of `Id and the black men were playing with shields and spears. (I do not remember) whether I asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) or whether he said to me if I desired to see (that sport). I said: Yes. I stood behind him with his face parallel to my face, and he said: O Banu Arfada, be busy (in your sports) till I was satiated. He said (to me): Is that enough? I said: Yes. Upon this he asked me to go.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) mere kamre mein aaye jabki mere paas do larkiyaan thin jo Buath ki jung ka gaana ga rahi thin. Woh bistar par let gaye aur apna chehra mod liya. Phir Abu Bakr aaye aur mujhe daanta aur kaha: Oh! Ye Shaitaan ka baaja Rasoolullah (SAW) ke ghar mein! Rasoolullah (SAW) unki taraf mude aur kaha: Unhe rehne do. Aur jab unhone tawajjo nahi di, to maine unhe ishara kiya aur woh bahar chali gayin, aur ye Eid ka din tha aur kaale log dhaal aur bhaale lekar khel rahe the. Mujhe yaad nahi ki maine Rasoolullah (SAW) se poocha ya unhone mujhse kaha agar main woh khel dekhna chahti hoon. Maine kaha: Haan. Main unke peeche khadi hui, unka chehra mere chehre ke barabar tha, aur unhone kaha: Aye Banu Arfada, apne khel mein masroof raho, yahan tak ki main seer ho gayi. Unhone mujhse kaha: Kya bas ho gaya? Maine kaha: Haan. Isper unhone mujhe jaane ko kaha.

e: 'A'isha reported that some Abyssinians came and gave a demonstration of armed fight on the 'Id day in the mosque. The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) invited me (to see that fight). I placed my head on his shoulder and began to see their sport till it was I who turned away from watching them.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki kuch Habashi aaye aur Eid ke din masjid mein hathiyaaron ke saath ladaai ka mujaahira kiya. Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe ye ladaai dekhne ke liye bulaya. Maine apna sar unke kandhe par rakha aur unka khel dekhne lagi yahan tak ki main hi thi jisne unhe dekhna chhoda.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Hisham with the same chain of transmitters but (the narrators) did not make mention of the mosque.
hi: Ye hadees Hisham ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai lekin raawiyon ne masjid ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: 'A'isha said that she sent a message to the players (of this armed fight) saying: I like to see them (fighting). She further said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stood up and I stood at the door (behind him) and saw (this fight) between his ears and his shoulders they played in the mosque. 'Ata' (one of the narra- tors) said: Were they persians or Abyssinians? Ibn 'Atiq told me they were Abyssinians.
hi: Aisha ne kaha ki unhone khiladiyon, is hathiyaaron wali ladaai ke, ko sandesh bheja ye kehte hue: Mujhe unhe ladte hue dekhna pasand hai. Unhone aage kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) khade hue aur main darwaze par, unke peeche, khadi hui aur ye ladaai unke kaanon aur kandhon ke beech se dekhi jo woh masjid mein khel rahe the. Ata, raawiyon mein se ek, ne poocha: Kya woh Farsi the ya Habashi? Ibn Atiq ne mujhe bataya ki woh Habashi the.

e: Abu Huraira reported: While the Abyssinians were busy playing with their arms in the presence of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) 'Umar b. Khattab came there. He bent down to take up pebbles to throw at them (in order to make them go off). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to him: 'Umar, leave them alone.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya: Jab Habashi Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saamne apne hathiyaaron se khel rahe the, Umar bin Khattab (RA) wahan aaye. Woh unhe bhagane ke liye kankariyan uthaane ke liye jhuke. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unse kaha: Umar, unhe chhod do.

e: 'Abdullah b. Zaid b. Mazini reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went to the place of prayer and prayed for rain and turned round his mantle while facing the Qibla.
hi: Abdullah bin Zaid bin Mazini ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) namaz ki jagah gaye aur baarish ke liye dua ki aur Qibla ki taraf mudkar apni chadar ulti kar li.

e: Ibn Tamim narrated on the authority of his uncle ('Abdullah b. Zaid) that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went out to the place of prayer and prayed for rain and faced towards Qibla, and turned round his mantle and prayed two rak'ahs.
hi: Ibn Tamim ne apne chacha, Abdullah bin Zaid, ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Rasoolullah (SAW) namaz ki jagah nikle aur baarish ke liye dua ki aur Qibla ki taraf mude, aur apni chadar ulti ki aur do rakat namaz padhi.

e: 'Abdullah b. Zaid al-Ansari reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went out to the place of prayer in order to offer prayer for rainfall. And when he intended to make supplication he faced Qibla and turned round his mantle.
hi: Abdullah bin Zaid al-Ansari ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) namaz ki jagah baarish ki namaz padhne ke liye nikle. Aur jab unhone dua karne ka irada kiya, to woh Qibla ki taraf mude aur apni chadar ulti ki.

e: 'Abbad b. Tamim Mazini heard his uncle, who was one of the Companions of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), as saying: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went out one day in order to pray for rain. He turned his back towards people, supplicated before Allah, facing towards Qibla, and turned his mantle round and then observed two rak'ahs of prayer.
hi: Abbad bin Tamim Mazini ne apne chacha, jo Rasoolullah (SAW) ke sahaba mein se the, ko ye kehte suna: Rasoolullah (SAW) ek din baarish ke liye dua karne nikle. Unhone logon ki taraf apni peeth ki, Allah se dua ki, Qibla ki taraf mudkar, aur apni chadar ulti ki aur phir do rakat namaz padhi.

e: Anas reported: I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) raising his hands (high enough) in supplication (for rain) that the whiteness of his armpits became visible.
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko dua, baarish ke liye, mein apne haath itne buland karte dekha ki unki bagalon ki safedi nazar aane lagi.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prayed for rain pointing the back of his hands to the sky.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne baarish ki dua ki, apne haathon ki pusht aasman ki taraf karte hue.

e: Anas reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was not accustomed to raice his hands in any supplication he made except when praying for rain. (He would then raise  high enough) that the whiteness of his armpits became visible. 'Abd al-A'la said that (he was in doubt whether it was) the whiteness of his armpit or armpits.
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) apni kisi bhi dua mein apne haath buland karne ke aadi nahi the siwaay jab woh baarish ke liye dua karte. Woh phir itne buland karte ki unki bagal ki safedi nazar aa jaati. Abdul A'la ne kaha ki unhe shaq tha ki ye ek bagal ki safedi thi ya donon bagalon ki.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Anas b. Malik through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Anas bin Malik ne ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that a person entered the mosque through the door situated on theside of Daral-Qada' during Friday (prayer) and the messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was delivering the sermon while standing. He came and stood in front of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: Messenger of Allah, the camels died and the passages were blocked; so supplicate Allah to send down rain upon us. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) raised his hands and then said: (O Allah, send down rain upon us; O Allah, send dowp rain upon us; O Allah, send down rain upon us. Anas said: By Allah, we did not see any cloud or any patch of it, and there was neither any house or building standing between us and the (hillock) Sal'a. There appeared a cloud in the shape of a shield from behind it, and as it (came high) in the sky it spread and then there was a downpour of rain. By Allah, we did not see the sun throughout the week. Then (that very man) came on the coming Friday through the same door when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was standing and delivering the sermon. He stood in front of him and said: Messenger of Allah, our animals died and the passages blocked. Supplicate Allah to stop the rain for us. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) again raised his hands and said: O Allah, let it (rain) fall in our suburbs and not on us, O Allah (send it down) on the hillocks and small mountains and the river-beds and at places where trees grow. The rain stopped, and as we stepped out we were walking in sun- shine. He (the narrator) said to Sharik: I asked Anas b. Malik if he was the same man. He said: I do not know.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs jumma ke din Dar-al-Qada ki taraf wale darwaze se masjid mein daakhil hua aur Rasoolullah (SAW) khade hokar khutba de rahe the. Woh aaya aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saamne khada hua aur kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, oont mar gaye hain aur raste band ho gaye hain; is liye Allah se dua kijiye ki Woh humpar baarish barsaaye. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne apne haath buland kiye aur phir kaha: Aye Allah, humpar baarish barsa; Aye Allah, humpar baarish barsa; Aye Allah, humpar baarish barsa. Anas ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, humne koi baadal ya uska koi tukda nahi dekha, aur hamare aur pahaadi Sal'a ke darmiyan koi ghar ya imaarat nahi thi. Uske peeche se ek dhaal jaisa baadal numaayan hua, aur jaise-jaise woh aasmaan mein buland hua, ye phaila aur phir zordaar baarish hui. Allah ki qasam, humne pura hafta suraj nahi dekha. Phir wahi shakhs agle jumma ko usi darwaze se aaya jab Rasoolullah (SAW) khade hokar khutba de rahe the. Woh unke saamne khada hua aur kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, hamare jaanwar mar gaye hain aur raste band ho gaye hain. Allah se dua kijiye ki Woh baarish rok de. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne phir apne haath buland kiye aur kaha: Aye Allah, ise, baarish ko, hamare aas-paas girao, humpar nahi, Aye Allah, ise tilon aur choti pahaadiyon par, nadi ke kinaron par aur un jagahon par barsao jahan darakht ugte hain. Baarish ruk gayi, aur jab hum bahar nikle to hum dhoop mein chal rahe the. Raawi ne Sharik se kaha: Maine Anas bin Malik se poocha ki kya woh wahi shakhs tha. Unhone kaha: Mujhe nahi pata.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: The people were in the grip of famine during the lifetime of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and (once) as the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was delivering the sermon standing on the pulpit on Friday, a bedouin stood up and said: Messenger of Allah, the animals died and the children suffered starvation. The rest of the hadith is the same (and the words are) that he (the Holy Prophet) said: O Allah, send down rain in our suburbs but not on us. He (the narrator) said: To whichever directions he pointed with his hands, the clouds broke up and I saw Medina like the opening of a (courtyard) and the stream of Qanat flowed for one month, and none came from any part (of Arabia) but with the news of heavy rainfall.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya: Log Rasoolullah (SAW) ke daur mein akaal ki chapet mein the, aur ek baar jab Rasoolullah (SAW) jumma ke din mimbar par khade hokar khutba de rahe the, ek badawi khada hua aur kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, jaanwar mar gaye hain aur bachche bhookh se pareshaan hain. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai aur alfaaz hain ki unhone kaha: Aye Allah, humpar nahi balki hamare aas-paas baarish barsa. Raawi ne kaha: Jis bhi taraf woh apne haathon se ishara karte, baadal chhatt jaate aur maine Madina ko ek aangan ke khulne jaisa dekha, aur Qanat ki nadi ek mahine tak behti rahi, aur Arab ke kisi bhi hisse se koi bhi shakhs bina bhaari baarish ki khabar ke nahi aaya.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that while the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was delivering the sermon on Friday, people stood up before him and said in a loud voice: Apostle of Allah, there is a drought and the trees have become yellow, the animals have died; and the rest of the hadith is the same, and in the narration transmitted by 'Abd al-A'la the words are:" The clouds cleard from Medina and it began to rain around it and not a single drop of rain fell in Medina. And as I looked towards Medina, I found it hollow like (the hollowness of) a basin.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki jab Rasoolullah (SAW) jumma ke din khutba de rahe the, log unke saamne khade hue aur zor se kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, sookha pad gaya hai aur darakht peele pad gaye hain, jaanwar mar gaye hain; aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai, aur Abdul A'la ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: "Madina ke aas-paas se baadal chhat gaye aur uske aas-paas baarish hone lagi aur Madina mein ek bhi boond nahi giri. Aur jab maine Madina ki taraf dekha, to maine use ek tashtari ki khaali jagah jaisa khaali paaya."

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Anas but with this addition: " Allah gathered the clouds and as we (were obliged) to stay back I saw that even the strong man, impelled by a desire to go to his family, (could not do so)."
hi: Ye hadees Anas ki sanad se bayan ki gayi hai lekin is izafe ke saath: "Allah ne baadalon ko ikattha kiya aur jab hum majboor hue rukne ke liye, to maine dekha ki ek taakatvar aadmi bhi, apne gharwalon ke paas jaane ki khwahish ke bawajood, aisa nahi kar saka."

e: 'Ubaidullah b. Anas b. Malik heard (his father) Anas b. Malik as saying: A bedouin came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on Friday as he was (delivering the sermon on his) pulpit; and the rest of the hadith is the same but with this addition:" I saw the cloud clearing just as a sheet is folded."
hi: Ubaidullah bin Anas bin Malik ne apne walid Anas bin Malik ko ye kehte suna: Ek badawi Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas jumma ke din aaya jab woh apne mimbar par khutba de rahe the; aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai lekin is izafe ke saath: "Maine baadal ko aise chhattte dekha jaise koi chadar ko sameta jaaye."

e: Anas (b. Malik) reported: It rained upon us as we were with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). The Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him) removed his cloth (from a part of his body) till the rain fell on it. We said: Messenger of Allah, why did you do this? He said: It is because it (the rainfall) has just come from the Exalted Lord.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya: Humpar baarish hui jab hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath the. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne apna kapda apne badan ke ek hisse se hataya yahan tak ki baarish uspar padi. Humne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, aapne aisa kyun kiya? Unhone kaha: Kyunki ye baarish abhi-abhi Buland Rab se aayi hai.

e: 'Ata' b. Abi Rabah reported that he heard 'A'isha, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him), as saying: When there was on any day windstorm or dark cloud (its effects) could be read on the face of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and he moved forward and backward (in a state of anxiety) ; and when it rained, he was delighted and it (the state of restlessness) disappeared. 'A'isha said: I asked him the reason of this anxiety and he said: I was afraid that it might be a calamity that might fall upon my Ummah, and when he saw rainfall he said: It is the mercy (of Allah).
hi: Ata bin Abi Rabah ne bayan kiya ki unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) ki zauja Aisha (RA) ko ye kehte suna: Jab kisi din tez aandhi ya kaale baadal hote, to unke asraat Rasoolullah (SAW) ke chehre par padhe jaa sakte the, aur woh fikr ki halat mein aage-peeche chalte; aur jab baarish hoti, to woh khush ho jaate aur behchaini ki halat khatam ho jaati. Aisha ne kaha: Maine unse is fikr ki wajah poochi aur unhone kaha: Mujhe dar tha ki kahin ye koi museebat na ho jo meri ummat par aaye, aur jab woh baarish dekhte to kehte: Ye Allah ki rahmat hai.

e: 'Ata' b. Rabah reported on the authority of 'A'isha, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him), who said: Whenever the wind was stormy, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to say: O Allah! I ask Thee for what is good in it, and the good which it contains, and the good of that which it was sent for. I seek refuge with Thee from what is evil in it, what evil it contains, and the evil of that what it was sent for; and when there was a thunder and lightning in the sky, his colour underwent a change, and he went out and in, backwards and forwards; and when the rain came, he felt relieved, and I noticed that (the sign of relief) on his face. 'A'isha asked him (about it) and he said: It may be as the people of 'Ad said: When they saw a cloud formation coming to their valley they said:" It is a cloud which would give us rain" (Qur'an, xlvi. 24).
hi: Ata bin Rabah ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ki zauja Aisha (RA) ke hawale se riwayat ki jinhone kaha: Jab bhi hawa tez hoti, Rasoolullah (SAW) kaha karte the: Aye Allah! Main Tujhse iske achhe pehlu ki, aur usmein jo achhaai hai uski, aur jiske liye ye bheja gaya hai uski achhaai maangta hoon. Main Teri panah maangta hoon usse jo isme bura hai, aur jo buraai isme hai, aur jiske liye ye bheja gaya hai uski buraai se; aur jab aasmaan mein garaj-chamak hoti, to unka rang badal jaata, aur woh andar-bahar, aage-peeche jaate; aur jab baarish aati, to woh aaraam mahsoos karte, aur maine aaraam ki nishaani unke chehre par dekhi. Aisha ne unse iske baare mein poocha aur unhone kaha: Ye waisa ho sakta hai jaisa Aad ki qaum ne kaha: Jab unhone apni wadi ki taraf ek baadal ka silsila aata dekha to unhone kaha: "Ye woh baadal hai jo hamein baarish dega" (Quran, 46:24).

e: 'A'isha, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), reported: I never saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) laugh to such an extent that I could see his uvula-whereas he used to smile only-and when he saw dark clouds or wind, (the signs of fear) were depicted on his face. I said: Messenger of Allah, I find people being happy when they ace the dark cloud in the hope that it would bring rain, but I find that when you see that (the cloud) there is an anxiety on your face. He said: 'A'isha, I am afraid that there may be a calamity in it, for a people was afflicted with wind, when the people saw the calamity they said:" It is a cloud which would give us rain" (Qur'an. xlvi. 24).
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ki zauja Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko kabhi itna hansta nahi dekha ki unka kaua nazar aaye - woh sirf muskuraate the - aur jab woh kaale baadal ya hawa dekhte, to dar ki nishaniyaan unke chehre par ubhar aatin. Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, main dekhti hoon ki log kaale baadal dekhkar khush hote hain is ummeed mein ki ye baarish laayega, lekin main dekhti hoon ki jab aap ise baadal ko dekhte hain to aapke chehre par fikr hoti hai. Unhone kaha: Aisha, mujhe dar hai ki kahin ismein koi museebat na ho, kyunki ek qaum tez hawa ki chapet mein aayi thi, jab logon ne museebat dekhi to unhone kaha: "Ye woh baadal hai jo hamein baarish dega" (Quran, 46:24).

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: I have been helped by the east wind and the 'Ad were destroyed by the west wind.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Mujhe purvaai, poorab se aane wali, hawa se madad mili hai aur Aad ki qaum pachvaai, pashchim se aane wali, hawa se tabaah hui thi.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Abbas ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki gayi hai.

e: 'A'isha reported that there was a solar eclipse in the time of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He stood up to pray and prolonged his stand very much. He then bowed and prolonged very much his bowing. He then raised his head and prolonged his stand much, but it was less than the (duration) of the first stand. He then bowed and prolonged bowing much, but it was less than the duration of his first bowing. He then prostrated and then stood up and prolonged the stand, but it was less than the first stand. He then bowed and prolonged his bowing, but it was less than the first bowing. He then lifted his head and then stood up and prolonged his stand, but it was less than the first stand. He then bowed and prolonged bowing and it was less than the first bowing. He then prostrated himself; then he turned about, and the sun had become bright, and he addressed the people. He praised Allah and landed Him and said: The sun and the moon are two signs of Allah; they are not eclipsed on account of anyones death or on account of anyone's birth. So when you see them, glorify and supplicate Allah, observe prayer, give alms. O Ummah of Muhammad, none is more indignant than Allah When His servant or maid commits fornication. O people of Muhammad, by Allah, if you knew what I know, you would weep much and laugh little.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ke daur mein suraj grahan hua. Woh namaz ke liye khade hue aur apna qiyaam bahut lamba kiya. Phir unhone ruku kiya aur apna ruku bahut lamba kiya. Phir unhone apna sar uthaya aur apna qiyaam bahut lamba kiya, lekin ye pehle qiyaam se kam tha. Phir unhone ruku kiya aur apna ruku bahut lamba kiya, lekin ye pehle ruku se kam tha. Phir unhone sajda kiya aur phir khade hue aur qiyaam ko lamba kiya, lekin ye pehle qiyaam se kam tha. Phir unhone ruku kiya aur ruku lamba kiya, lekin ye pehle ruku se kam tha. Phir unhone apna sar uthaya aur khade hue aur qiyaam ko lamba kiya, lekin ye pehle qiyaam se kam tha. Phir unhone ruku kiya aur ruku lamba kiya aur ye pehle ruku se kam tha. Phir unhone sajda kiya; phir woh mude, aur suraj chamakdaar ho chuka tha, aur unhone logon se khitaab kiya. Unhone Allah ki tareef ki aur uski hamd ki aur kaha: Suraj aur chaand Allah ki do nishaniyaan hain; ye kisi ki maut ki wajah se ya kisi ki paidaish ki wajah se grahan mein nahi aate. Is liye jab tum inhe grahan mein dekho, to Allah ki tasbeeh karo aur Usse dua karo, namaz padho, sadaqa do. Aye Muhammad ki ummat, Allah se zyada koi bhi is baat par gussa nahi hota jab Uska banda ya laundi zina karta ya karti hai. Aye Muhammad ki qaum, Allah ki qasam, agar tumhe woh pata hota jo mujhe pata hai, to tum bahut rote aur bahut kam haste.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Hisham b. 'Urwa with the same chain of transmitters but with this addition: " Verily the sun and the moon are among the signs of Allah." And similarly this addition was made:" He then lifted his hands and said: O Allah! have I not conveyed it?"
hi: Ye hadees Hisham bin Urwa ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai lekin is izafe ke saath: "Yaqeenan suraj aur chaand Allah ki nishaniyon mein se hain." Aur isi tarah ye izafa bhi kiya gaya: "Phir unhone apne haath uthaye aur kaha: Aye Allah, kya maine ise pahuncha nahi diya?"

e: 'A'isha, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), reported There was an eclipse of the sun during the lifetime of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). So, the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) went to the mosque and stood up and glorified Allah, and the people formed themselves in rows behind him. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) made a long recital (of the Qur'an) and then pronounced takbir and then observed a long ruku'. He then raised his head and said: Allah listened to him who praised Him: our Lord, praise is due to Thee. He then again stood up and made a long recital, which was less than the first recital. He pronounced takbir and observed a long ruku', and it was less than the first one. He again said: Allah listened to him who praised Him; our Lord, praise is due to Thee. (Abu Tahir, one of the narrators) made no mention of:" He then prostrated himself." He did like this in the second rak'ah, till he completed four rak'ahs and four prostrations and the sun became bright before he deported. He then stood up and addressed people, after lauding Allah as He deserved, and then said: The sun and the moon are two signs among the signs of Allah These do not eclipse either on the death of anyone or on his birth. So when you see them, hasten to prayer. He also said this: Observe prayer till Allah dispels the anxiety (of this extraordinary phenomenon) from you. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: I saw in my place everything which you have been promised. I even saw myself desiring to pluck a bunch (of grapes) from Paradise (and it was at the time) when you saw me moving forward. And I saw Hell and some of its parts crushing the others, when you saw me moving back; and I saw in it Ibn Luhayy and he was the person who made the she-camels loiter about. In the hadith transmitted by Abu Tahir the words are:" He hastened to prayer," and he made no mention of what follows.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ki zauja Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ke daur mein suraj grahan hua. To Rasoolullah (SAW) masjid gaye aur khade hokar Allah ki tasbeeh ki, aur log unke peeche safon mein khade ho gaye. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Quran ki lambi tilawat ki aur phir takbeer kahi aur phir lamba ruku kiya. Phir unhone apna sar uthaya aur kaha: Allah ne uski suni jisne uski hamd ki: hamare Rab, Teri hi hamd hai. Woh phir dobara khade hue aur lambi tilawat ki, jo pehli tilawat se kam thi. Unhone takbeer kahi aur lamba ruku kiya, aur ye pehle se kam tha. Unhone phir kaha: Allah ne uski suni jisne uski hamd ki; hamare Rab, Teri hi hamd hai. Abu Tahir, raawiyon mein se ek, ne "Phir unhone sajda kiya" ka zikr nahi kiya. Unhone doosri rakat mein bhi aisa hi kiya, yahan tak ki unhone char rakat aur char sajde mukammal kiye aur unke wapas jaane se pehle suraj chamakdaar ho gaya. Woh phir khade hue aur logon se khitaab kiya, Allah ki laayaq tareef karne ke baad, aur phir kaha: Suraj aur chaand Allah ki nishaniyon mein se do nishaniyaan hain. Ye kisi ki maut ya paidaish par grahan mein nahi aate. Is liye jab tum inhe dekho, to namaz ki taraf jaldi karo. Unhone ye bhi kaha: Namaz padho yahan tak ki Allah tumse ye fikr, is ajeeb ghatna ki, door kar de. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Maine apni jagah par woh sab kuch dekha jiska tumse wada kiya gaya hai. Maine khud ko Jannat se angoor ka guccha todne ki khwahish rakhte hue dekha, aur ye us waqt tha jab tumne mujhe aage badhte dekha. Aur maine jahannam dekhi aur uske kuch hisse doosron ko kuchal rahe the, jab tumne mujhe peeche hatte dekha; aur maine usmein Ibn Luhayy ko dekha aur woh woh shakhs tha jisne oontniyon ko bhatka diya tha. Abu Tahir ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: "Woh namaz ki taraf jaldi kare," aur unhone iske baad ka koi zikr nahi kiya.

e: 'A'isha reported that there was a solar eclipse during the lifetime of the Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him) and he sent the announcer (to summon them) for congregational prayer. The people gathered together and he pronounced takbir and he observed four rak'ahs, in the form of two rak'ahs (i. e. he observed two qiyams and two ruku's in one rak'ah) and four prostrations.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ke daur mein suraj grahan hua aur unhone jamaat ki namaz ke liye ailaan karne wale ko bheja. Log ikattha ho gaye aur unhone takbeer kahi aur char rakat padhi, do rakaton ki shakl mein, yaani har rakat mein do qiyaam aur do ruku, aur char sajde.

e: 'A'isha reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) recited loudly in the eclipse prayer, and he observed four rak'ahs in the form of two rak'ahs and four prostrations. Zuhri said: Kathir b. 'Abbas narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed four rak'ahs and four prostrations in two rak'ahs.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne grahan ki namaz mein zor se tilawat ki, aur unhone char rakat padhi do rakaton ki shakl mein aur char sajde. Zuhri ne kaha: Kathir bin Abbas ne Ibn Abbas ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne do rakaton mein char rakat aur char sajde kiye.

e: Zuhri said: Kathir b. Abbas used to narrate that Ibn 'Abbas used to relate about the prayer of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in regard to the eclipse of the sun like that what was narrated by 'Urwa on the authority of 'A'isha.
hi: Zuhri ne kaha: Kathir bin Abbas kaha karte the ki Ibn Abbas Rasoolullah (SAW) ki grahan ki namaz ke baare mein waisa hi bayan karte the jaisa Urwa ne Aisha (RA) ke hawale se riwayat ki thi.

e: 'Ata' reported: I heard 'Ubaid b. 'Umair say: It has been narrated to me by one whom I regard as truthful, (the narrator says: I can well guess that he meant 'A'isha) that the sun eclipsed during the lifetime of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he stood up (in prayer) for a rigorously long time. He then bowed and then stood up and then bowed and then stood up and then bowed, thus observing three ruku's in two rak'ahs and four prostrations. He then departed and the sun brightened. He pronounced" Allah is the Greatest" while bowing. He would then bow and say:" Allah listened to him who praised Him" while lifting up his head. He then stood up, and praised Allah and lauded Him, and then said: The sun and the moon do not eclipse on the death of anyone or on his birth. But both of them are among the signs of Allah with which Allah terrifies His servants. So when you see them under eclipse, remember Allah till they are brightened.
hi: Ata ne bayan kiya: Maine Ubaid bin Umair ko kehte suna: Mujhe ek aise shakhs ne bataya jise main sacha maanta hoon, raawi kehta hai: mera achha khayal hai ki unka matlab Aisha se tha, ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ke daur mein suraj grahan hua aur woh bahut lambe waqt tak namaz mein khade rahe. Phir unhone ruku kiya aur phir khade hue aur phir ruku kiya aur phir khade hue aur phir ruku kiya, is tarah do rakaton mein teen ruku aur char sajde kiye. Woh phir mude aur suraj chamakdaar ho gaya. Unhone ruku karte waqt "Allahu Akbar" kaha. Woh phir ruku karte aur kehte "Allah ne uski suni jisne uski hamd ki" jab woh apna sar uthate. Phir woh khade hue, aur Allah ki tareef ki aur uski hamd ki, aur phir kaha: Suraj aur chaand kisi ki maut ya paidaish par grahan mein nahi aate. Balki ye dono Allah ki nishaniyon mein se hain jinse Allah apne bandon ko darata hai. Is liye jab tum unhe grahan mein dekho, to Allah ka zikr karo yahan tak ki woh chamakdaar ho jaayein.

e: This hadith is narrated thus on the authority of 'A'isha through another chain of transmitters: " The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed six ruku's and four prostration in (two rak'ahs)."
hi: Ye hadees Aisha (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki gayi hai is tarah: "Rasoolullah (SAW) ne chhe ruku aur char sajde, do rakaton mein, kiye."

e: 'Amra reported that a Jewess came to 'A'isha to ask (about something) and said: May Allah protect you from the torment of the grave! 'A'isha said: Messenger of Allah, would people be tormented in the graves? The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: (May there be) protection of Allah! The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) mounted one morning on the ride, and the sun eclipsed. 'A'isha said: I came in the company of the women in the mosque from behind the rooms. The Messenger of Allah (way peace he upon him) dismounted from his ride and came to the place of worship where he used to pray. He stood up (to pray) and the people stood behind him. 'A'isha said: He stood for a long time. He then bowed and it was a long ruku'. He then raised his head and he stood for a long time, less than the first standing. He then bowed and his ruku' was long, but it was less than that (the first) ruku'. He then raised (his head) and the sun had become bright. He (the Holy Prophet) then said: I saw you under trial in the grave like the turmoil of Dajjal. 'Amra said: I heard 'A'isha say: I listened after this to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) seeking refuge from the torment of Fire and the torment of the grave.
hi: Amra ne bayan kiya ki ek Yahudi aurat Aisha (RA) ke paas poochhne aayi aur kaha: Allah aapko qabr ke azaab se bachaaye! Aisha ne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, kya logon ko qabron mein azaab diya jaayega? Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Allah ki panah! Rasoolullah (SAW) ek subah apni sawari par charhe aur suraj grahan ho gaya. Aisha ne kaha: Main auraton ke saath kamron ke peeche se masjid aayi. Rasoolullah (SAW) apni sawari se utre aur namaz ki jagah gaye jahan woh namaz padha karte the. Woh namaz ke liye khade hue aur log unke peeche khade huye. Aisha ne kaha: Woh lambe waqt tak khade rahe. Phir unhone ruku kiya aur ye ek lamba ruku tha. Phir unhone apna sar uthaya aur woh lambe waqt tak khade rahe, jo pehle qiyaam se kam tha. Phir unhone ruku kiya aur unka ruku lamba tha, lekin ye us pehle ruku se kam tha. Phir unhone sar uthaya aur suraj chamakdaar ho chuka tha. Unhone phir kaha: Maine tumhe qabr mein aazmaish mein dekha, Dajjal ke fitne jaisi hulchul mein. Amra ne kaha: Maine Aisha ko ye kehte suna: Maine iske baad Rasoolullah (SAW) ko aag ke azaab aur qabr ke azaab se panah maangte suna.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Yahya b. Sa'id with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Yahya bin Sa'id ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported: The sun eclipsed on one extremely hot day during the lifetime of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prayed along with his Companions. He prolonged his qiyam (standing posture in prayer) till they (his Companions) began to fall down. He then observed a long ruku'. He raised his head (and stood up for long) and then observed a long ruku'. He then raised (his head and stood up) for a long time and then made two prostrations. He then stood up and did like this and thus he observed four ruku's and four prostrations (in two rak'ahs) and then said: All these things were brought to me in which you will be made to enter. Paradise was brought to me till (I was so close to it) that if I (had intended) to pluck a bunch (of grapes) out of it. I would have got it, or he (the Holy Prophet) said: I intended to get a bunch (out of that) but my hand could not reach it. Hell was also brought to me and I saw in it a woman belonging to the tribe of Israel who was tormented for a cat whom she had tied, but did not give it food nor set it free to eat the creatures of the earth; and I saw Abu Thumama 'Amr b. Malik who was dragging his intestines in Hell. They (the Arabs) used to say that the sun and the moon do not eclipse but on the death of some great person; but (in reality) both these (the sun and the moon) are among the signs of Allah which are shown to you; so when there is an eclipse, observe prayer till it (the sun or the moon) brightens. This hadith has been narrated by Hisham with the same chain of transmitters except this" I saw a dark woman with a tail stature and loud voice," but he made no mention of" from among Bani Israel".
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ke daur mein ek bahut hi garam din suraj grahan hua. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne apne sahaba ke saath namaz padhi. Unhone apna qiyaam itna lamba kiya ki woh apne sahaba girne lage. Phir unhone lamba ruku kiya. Unhone apna sar uthaya aur lambe waqt tak khade rahe aur phir lamba ruku kiya. Phir unhone sar uthaya aur khade rahe lambe waqt tak aur phir do sajde kiye. Phir woh khade hue aur aisa hi kiya aur is tarah unhone char ruku aur char sajde, do rakaton mein, kiye aur phir kaha: Ye sab cheezein mujhe dikhayi gayin jinmein tumhe daakhil kiya jaayega. Jannat mujhe dikhayi gayi yahan tak ki main isse itna qareeb tha ki agar main isse ek guccha todne ka irada karta, to woh mujhe mil jaata, ya unhone kaha: Maine ek guccha lene ka irada kiya lekin mera haath usse tak nahi pahuncha. Jahannam bhi mujhe dikhayi gayi aur maine usmein Bani Israel ki ek aurat dekhi jo ek billi ke liye azaab mein thi jise usne baandh rakha tha, lekin use na khaana diya na hi use zameen ke jeev khane ke liye chhoda; aur maine Abu Thumama Amr bin Malik ko dekha jo jahannam mein apni antdiyaan ghaseet raha tha. Woh Arab kehte the ki suraj aur chaand kisi bade shakhs ki maut ke bagair grahan mein nahi aate; lekin haqeeqat mein ye dono Allah ki nishaniyaan hain jo tumhe dikhayi jaati hain; is liye jab grahan ho, to namaz padho yahan tak ki woh suraj ya chaand chamakdaar ho jaaye. Ye hadees Hisham ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai siwaay is baat ke: "Maine ek kaali aurat, lambe kad aur zor ki aawaaz wali, dekhi," lekin unhone "Bani Israel mein se" ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: Jabir reported that the sun eclipsed during the lifetime of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on that very day when Ibrahim (the Prophet's son) died. The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) stood up and led people in (two rak'ahs of) prayer with six ruku's and four prostrations. He commenced (the prayer) with takbir (Allah-o-Akbar) and then recited and prolonged his recital. He then bowed nearly the (length of time) that he stood up. He then raised his head from the ruku' and recited but less than the first recital. He then bowed (to the length of time) that he stood up. He then raised his head from the ruku' and again recited but less than the second recital. He then bowed (to the length of time) that he stood up. He then lifted his head from the ruku'. He then fell in prostration and observed two prostrations. He stood up and then bowed, observing six ruku's like it, without (completing) the rak'ah in them, except (this difference) that the first (qiyam of ruku') was longer than the later one, and the ruku' was nearly (of the same length) as prostration. He then moved backward and the rows behind him also moved backward till we reached the extreme (Abu Bakr said: till he reached near the women) He then moved forward and the people also moved forward along with him till he stood at his (original) place (of worship). He then completed the prayer as it was required to complete and the sun brightened and he said: O people! verily the sun and the moon are among the signs of Allah and they do not eclipse at the death of anyone among people (Abu Bakr said: On the death of any human being). So when you see anything like it (of the nature of eclipse), pray till it is bright. There is nothing which you have been promised (in the next world) but I have seen it in this prayer of mine. Hell was brought to me as you saw me moving back on account of fear lest its heat might affect me; and I saw the owner of the curved staff who dragged his intestines in the fire, and he used to steal (the belongings) of the pilgrims with his curved staff. If he (the owner of the staff) became aware, he would say: It got (accidentally) entangled in my curved staff, but if he was unaware of that, he would take that away. I also saw in it (in Hell) the owner of a cat whom she had tied and did not feed her nor set her free so that she could eat the creatures of the earth, till the cat died of starvation. Paradise was brought to me, and it was on that occasion that you saw me moving forward till I stood at my place (of worship). I stretched my hand as I wanted to catch hold of its fruits so that you may see them. Then I thought of not doing it. Nothing which you have been promised was there that I did not see in this prayer of mine.
hi: Jabir ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ke daur mein suraj grahan hua usi din jis din Ibrahim, Nabi ke bete, ka intiqaal hua. Rasool (SAW) khade hue aur logon ki chhe ruku aur char sajdon wali namaz mein imamat ki. Unhone takbeer se namaz shuru ki aur phir tilawat ki aur apni tilawat ko lamba kiya. Phir unhone taqreeban utni hi der ruku kiya jitni der woh khade the. Phir unhone ruku se apna sar uthaya aur tilawat ki lekin pehli tilawat se kam. Phir unhone utni hi der ruku kiya jitni der woh khade the. Phir unhone ruku se apna sar uthaya aur dobara tilawat ki lekin doosri tilawat se kam. Phir unhone utni hi der ruku kiya jitni der woh khade the. Phir unhone ruku se apna sar uthaya. Phir woh sajde mein gaye aur do sajde kiye. Woh khade hue aur phir ruku kiya, isi tarah chhe ruku kiye, bina poori rakat dohraaye, siwaay is farq ke ki pehla ruku ka qiyaam baad wale se lamba tha, aur ruku sajde jaisa hi tha waqt mein. Woh phir peeche hate aur unke peeche wali safen bhi peeche hatin yahan tak ki hum inteha tak pahunche, Abu Bakr ne kaha: yahan tak ki woh auraton ke qareeb pahunche. Phir woh aage badhe aur log bhi unke saath aage badhe yahan tak ki woh apni asal namaz ki jagah par khade hue. Phir unhone namaz mukammal ki jaisi zaroori thi aur suraj chamakdaar ho gaya aur unhone kaha: Aye logo! Yaqeenan suraj aur chaand Allah ki nishaniyon mein se hain aur ye logon mein se kisi ki maut par grahan mein nahi aate, Abu Bakr ne kaha: Kisi insaan ki maut par. Is liye jab tum aisa kuch dekho, grahan jaisa, to namaz padho yahan tak ki woh chamakdaar ho jaaye. Aisa kuch bhi nahi hai jiska tumse agli duniya mein wada kiya gaya ho jise maine apni is namaz mein na dekha ho. Jahannam mujhe dikhayi gayi jaise tumne mujhe is dar se peeche hatta dekha ki kahin uski garmi mujhe na chhue; aur maine jahannam mein ek tedhi lakdi wale shakhs ko dekha jo aag mein apni antdiyaan ghaseet raha tha, aur woh apni tedhi lakdi se haajiyon ka saamaan chura leta tha. Agar woh lakdi ka maalik dhyaan de leta, to woh kehta: Ye galti se meri tedhi lakdi mein phans gaya, lekin agar use pata nahi chalta, to woh use le jaata. Maine jahannam mein ek billi ke maalik ko bhi dekha jise usne baandh rakha tha aur na use khaana diya na hi use zameen ke jeev khane ke liye chhoda, yahan tak ki billi bhookh se mar gayi. Jannat mujhe dikhayi gayi, aur isi mauqe par tumne mujhe aage badhte dekha yahan tak ki main apni jagah par khada hua. Maine apna haath phailaya kyunki main uske phal pakadna chahta tha taaki tum unhe dekh sako. Phir maine socha aisa na karun. Kuch bhi nahi tha jiska tumse wada kiya gaya tha jo maine apni is namaz mein na dekha ho.

e: Asma' reported: The sun eclipsed during the lifetime of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). As I went to 'A'isha who was busy in prayer. I said: What is the matter with the people that they are praying (a special prayer)? She ('A'isha) pointed towards the sky with her head. I said: Is it (an unusual) sign? She said: Yes. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stood up for prayer for such a long time that I was about to faint. I caught hold of a waterskin lying by my side, and began to pour water over my head, or (began to sprinkle water) on my face. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) then finished and the sun had brightened. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) then addressed the people, (after) praising Allah and lauding Him, and then said: There was no such thing as I did not see earlier, but I saw it at this very place of mine. I ever saw Paradise and Hell. It was also revealed to me that you would be tried in the graves, as you would he tried something like the turmoil of the Dajjal. Asma' said: I do not know which word he actually used (qariban or mithl), and each one of you would be brought and it would be said: What is your knowledge about this man? If the person is a believer, (Asma' said: I do not know whether it was the word al-Mu'min or al-Mu'qin) he would say: He is Muhammad and he is the Messenger of Allah. He brought to us the clear signs and right guidance. So we responded and obeyed him. (He would repeat this three times), and it would be said to him: You should go to sleep. We already knew that you are a believer in him. So the pious man would go to sleep. So far as the hypocrite or sceptic is concerned (Asma' said: I do not know which word was that: al-Munafiq (hypocrite) or al-Murtad (doubtful) he would say: I do not know. I only uttered whatever I heard people say.
hi: Asma ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ke daur mein suraj grahan hua. Jab main Aisha ke paas gayi jo namaz mein masroof thin. Maine kaha: Logon ko kya ho gaya hai ki woh ek khaas namaz padh rahe hain? Aisha ne apne sar se aasmaan ki taraf ishara kiya. Maine kaha: Kya ye ek ajeeb nishaani hai? Unhone kaha: Haan. Rasoolullah (SAW) namaz ke liye itni der khade rahe ki main behosh hone hi wali thi. Maine apne paas rakhi ek mashk pakdi aur apne sar par, ya apne chehre par, paani chhirakne lagi. Rasoolullah (SAW) phir namaz se faaregh hue aur suraj chamakdaar ho gaya tha. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne phir logon se khitaab kiya, Allah ki tareef aur hamd karne ke baad, aur phir kaha: Koi bhi aisi cheez nahi thi jo maine pehle na dekhi ho, lekin maine ise apni isi jagah par dekha. Maine hamesha Jannat aur Jahannam dekhi hai. Mujhpar ye bhi wahi hui ki tumhari qabron mein aazmaish hogi, jaisi ki Dajjal ke fitne jaisi aazmaish hogi. Asma ne kaha: Mujhe nahi pata ki unhone kaunsa lafz istemal kiya, qareeban ya misl, aur tum mein se har ek ko laaya jaayega aur poocha jaayega: Is shakhs ke baare mein tumhara kya ilm hai? Agar woh shakhs momin hai, Asma ne kaha: Mujhe nahi pata ki ye lafz al-Momin tha ya al-Mu'qin, to woh kahega: Woh Muhammad hain aur woh Allah ke Rasool hain. Woh humare paas saaf nishaniyaan aur seedhi hidayat laaye. To humne unka jawab diya aur unki itaat ki. Woh ye teen baar dohrayega, aur usse kaha jaayega: Ab so jao. Humein pehle se pata tha ki tum unpar imaan rakhte ho. To woh nek shakhs so jaayega. Jahan tak munaafiq ya shakki shakhs ka sawal hai, Asma ne kaha: Mujhe nahi pata ki ye lafz al-Munafiq tha ya al-Murtad, woh kahega: Mujhe nahi pata. Maine bas woh kaha jo maine logon ko kehte suna.

e: Asma' said: I came to 'A'isha when the people were standing (in prayer) and she was also praying. I said: What is this excitement of the people for? And the rest of the hadith was narrated like one, (narrated above). 'Urwa said: Do not say Kasafat-ush-Shamsu, but say Khasafat-ush-Shamsu.
hi: Asma ne kaha: Main Aisha ke paas aayi jab log namaz mein khade the aur woh bhi namaz padh rahi thin. Maine kaha: Logon mein ye hulchul kis liye hai? Aur baaki hadees pehle jaisi hi bayan ki gayi. Urwa ne kaha: "Kasafat-ush-Shamsu" mat kaho, balki "Khasafat-ush-Shamsu" kaho.

e: Asma' bint Abu Bakr said: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) was one day (i. e. on the day when the sun eclipsed) so perturbed that he (in haste) took hold of the outer garment (of a female member of his family) and it was later on that his (own) cloak was sent to him. He stood in prayer along with people for such a long time that if a man came he did not realise that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had observed ruku', as it has been narrated about ruku' in connection with long qiyam.
hi: Asma bint Abu Bakr ne kaha: Rasool (SAW) ek din, yaani jis din suraj grahan hua, itne pareshaan hue ki unhone jaldi mein apne ghar ki kisi aurat ka bahri kapda pakad liya aur baad mein unki apni chadar bheji gayi. Woh logon ke saath itni der tak namaz mein khade rahe ki agar koi aadmi aata to use pata na chalta ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne ruku kiya hai, jaisa lambe qiyaam ke silsile mein ruku ke baare mein riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Juraij narrated this hadith with the same chain of transmitters (but with the addition of these words): " It was for a long duration that he (the Holy Prophet) observed qiyam and he would then observe ruku'. (The narrator also added) I (Asma') looked at a woman who was older than I, and at another who was weaker than I.
hi: Abu Juraij ne ye hadees isi sanad se bayan ki hai lekin in alfaaz ke izafe ke saath: "Ye lambi muddat ke liye tha ki unhone qiyaam kiya aur phir woh ruku karte. Raawi ne ye bhi izafa kiya: Maine, Asma ne, ek aurat ki taraf dekha jo mujhse buzurg thi, aur ek aur ki taraf jo mujhse kamzor thi."

e: Asma' daughter of Abu Bakr reported: The sun eclipsed during the lifetime of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ; so he felt perturbed and he, by mistake, took hold of the outer garment of a woman till he was given his own cloak. After this I satisfied my need and then came and entered the mosque. I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) standing in prayer. I stood along with him. He prolonged his qiyam till I wished to sit down. Then I cast a glance towards an old woman. So I said: She is older than I. I, therefore, kept standing. He (the Holy Prophet) then observed ruku', and prolonged his ruku'. He then raised his head. He then prolonged his qiyam to such an extent that if a person happened to come he would have thought that he had not observed the ruku'.
hi: Asma, Abu Bakr ki beti, ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ke daur mein suraj grahan hua; to woh pareshaan hue aur unhone galti se ek aurat ka bahri kapda pakad liya yahan tak ki unhe unki apni chadar di gayi. Iske baad main apni zaroorat poori karke aayi aur masjid mein daakhil hui. Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko namaz mein khada dekha. Main bhi unke saath khadi ho gayi. Unhone apna qiyaam itna lamba kiya ki mera dil chaha ki main baith jaun. Phir maine ek boodhi aurat ki taraf dekha. To maine kaha: Woh mujhse buzurg hai. Is liye main khadi rahi. Unhone phir ruku kiya, aur apne ruku ko lamba kiya. Phir unhone apna sar uthaya. Phir unhone apna qiyaam itna lamba kiya ki agar koi shakhs aata to woh sochta ki unhone ruku nahi kiya.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported: There was an eclipse of the sun during the lifetime of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). The Messenger of Allah, (ﷺ) prayed accompanied by the people. He stood for a long time, about as long as it would take to recite Surah al-Baqara; then he bowed for a long time; then he raised his head and stood for a long time, but it was less than the first qiyam. He then bowed for a long time but for a shorter while than the first. He then prostrated and then stood for a long time, but it was less than the first qiyam. He then bowed for a long time, but it was less than the first bowing. He then raised (his head) and stood for a long time, but it was less than the first qiyam. He then bowed for a long time but it was less than the first bowing. He then observed prostration, and then he finished, and the sun had cleared (by that time). He (the Holy Prophet) then said: The sun and moon are two signs from the signs of Allah. These two do not eclipse on account of the death of anyone or on account of the birth of anyone. So when you see that, remember Allah. They (his Companions) said: Messenger of Allah, we saw you reach out to something, while you were standing here, then we saw you restrain yourself. He said: I saw Paradise and reached out to a bunch of its grapes; and had I taken it you would have eaten of it as long as the world endured. I saw Hell also. No such (abominable) sight have I ever seen as that which I saw today; and I observed that most of its inhabitants were women. They said: Messenger of Allah, on what account is it so? He said: For their ingratitude or disbelief (bi-kufraihinna). It was said: Do they disbelieve in Allah? He said: (Not for their disbelief in God) but for their ingratitude to their husbands and ingratitude to kindness. If you were to treat one of them kindly for ever, but if she later saw anything (displeasing) in you, she would say: I have never seen any good in you.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ke daur mein suraj grahan hua. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne logon ke saath namaz padhi. Woh lambe waqt tak khade rahe, taqreeban itni der jitni Surah al-Baqara padhne mein lagti; phir unhone lamba ruku kiya; phir unhone apna sar uthaya aur lambe waqt tak khade rahe, lekin ye pehle qiyaam se kam tha. Phir unhone lamba ruku kiya lekin pehle se kam waqt ke liye. Phir unhone sajda kiya aur phir lambe waqt tak khade rahe, lekin ye pehle qiyaam se kam tha. Phir unhone lamba ruku kiya, lekin ye pehle ruku se kam tha. Phir unhone sar uthaya aur lambe waqt tak khade rahe, lekin ye pehle qiyaam se kam tha. Phir unhone lamba ruku kiya lekin ye pehle ruku se kam tha. Phir unhone sajda kiya, aur phir woh namaz se faaregh hue, aur suraj us waqt tak saaf ho chuka tha. Unhone phir kaha: Suraj aur chaand Allah ki nishaniyon mein se do nishaniyaan hain. Ye dono kisi ki maut ya kisi ki paidaish ki wajah se grahan mein nahi aate. Is liye jab tum aisa dekho, to Allah ka zikr karo. Unhone, unke sahaba ne, kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, humne aapko kisi cheez ki taraf haath badhaate dekha, jab aap yahan khade the, phir humne aapko apne aap ko rokte dekha. Unhone kaha: Maine Jannat dekhi aur uske angooron ke ek guchhe ki taraf haath badhaya; aur agar main use le leta to tum use tab tak khaate jab tak duniya rehti. Maine Jahannam bhi dekhi. Maine aaj se pehle kabhi aisa bhayaanak manzar nahi dekha jaisa maine aaj dekha; aur maine paaya ki uske zyadatar rehne wale auraten thin. Unhone kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, aisa kyun hai? Unhone kaha: Unki na-shukri, kufr, ki wajah se. Poocha gaya: Kya woh Allah ka inkaar karti hain? Unhone kaha: Allah ka inkaar nahi karti balki apne shauharon ki na-shukri karti hain aur meherbaani ki na-shukri karti hain. Agar tum unmein se kisi ke saath hamesha achhaai karo, lekin phir agar use tummein kuch napasand dikhe, to woh kahegi: Maine tumse kabhi koi achhaai nahi dekhi.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zaid b. Aslam with the same chain of transmitters except with this difference that he (the narrator said): " then we saw you keeping aloof (back)."
hi: Ye hadees Zaid bin Aslam ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai siwaay is farq ke ki unhone kaha: "Phir humne aapko peeche hatte dekha."

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported: When there was a solar eclipse the Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him) observed eight ruku's and four prostrations (in two rak'ahs). This has been narrated by 'Ali also.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bayan kiya: Jab suraj grahan hota, to Rasoolullah (SAW) aath ruku aur char sajde, do rakaton mein, karte. Ye Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne bhi riwayat ki hai.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) observed prayer while it was (solar) eclipse. He recited (the Qur'an in qiyam) and then bowed. He again recited and again bowed. He again recited and again bowed and again recited and again bowed, and then prostrated; and the second (rak'ah) was like this.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bayan kiya: Rasool (SAW) ne namaz padhi jab suraj grahan tha. Unhone tilawat ki, qiyaam mein, aur phir ruku kiya. Unhone dobara tilawat ki aur dobara ruku kiya. Unhone dobara tilawat ki aur dobara ruku kiya aur dobara tilawat ki aur dobara ruku kiya, aur phir sajda kiya; aur doosri rakat bhi isi tarah thi.

e: 'Amr b. al-'As reported: When the sun eclipsed during the lifetime of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), they (the people) were called to congregational prayers. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed two ruku's in one rak'ah. He then stood and observed two ruku's in (the second) rak'ah. The sun then became bright, and 'A'isha said; Never did I observe, ruku' and prostration longer than this (ruku' and prostration).
hi: Amr bin al-As ne bayan kiya: Jab Rasoolullah (SAW) ke daur mein suraj grahan hua, to unhe, logon ko, jamaat ki namaz ke liye bulaya gaya. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne ek rakat mein do ruku kiye. Phir woh khade hue aur doosri rakat mein do ruku kiye. Suraj phir chamakdaar ho gaya, aur Aisha ne kaha: Maine kabhi bhi isse lamba ruku aur sajda nahi dekha.

e: Abu Mas'ud al-Ansari reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Verily the sun and the moon are the two signs among the signs of Allah by which He frightens his servants and they do not eclipse on account of the death of any one of the people. So when you see anything about them, observe prayer, supplicate Allah till it is cleared from you.
hi: Abu Mas'ud al-Ansari ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Yaqeenan suraj aur chaand Allah ki nishaniyon mein se do nishaniyaan hain jinse Woh apne bandon ko darata hai aur ye logon mein se kisi ki maut ki wajah se grahan mein nahi aate. Is liye jab tum inke baare mein kuch dekho, to namaz padho, Allah se dua karo yahan tak ki ye tumse dur ho jaaye.

e: Abu Mas'ud reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Verily the sun and the moon do not eclipse on account of the death of any one of the people, but they are the two signs among the signs of Allah. So when you see it, stand up and observe prayer.
hi: Abu Mas'ud ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Yaqeenan suraj aur chaand logon mein se kisi ki maut ki wajah se grahan mein nahi aate, balki ye dono Allah ki nishaniyon mein se hain. Is liye jab tum ise dekho, to khade ho jao aur namaz padho.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Isma'il with the same chain of transmitters and in the hadith narrated by Sufyan and Waki' (the words are): " The sun eclipsed on the day when Ibrahim died, and the people said: It has eclipsed on the death of Ibrahim."
hi: Ye hadees Ismail ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai aur Sufyan aur Waki ki bayan ki hui hadees mein alfaaz hain: "Suraj us din grahan hua jis din Ibrahim ka intiqaal hua, aur logon ne kaha: Ye Ibrahim ki maut par grahan hua hai."

e: Abu Musa reported: The sun eclipsed during the time of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He stood in great anxiety fearing that it might be the Doomsday, till he came to the mosque. He stood up to pray with prolonged qiyam, ruku', and prostration which I never saw him doing in prayer; and then he said: These are the signs which Allah sends, not on account of the death of anyone or life of any one, but Allah sends them to frighten thereby His servants. So when you see any such thing, hasten to remember Him, supplicate Him and beg pardon from Him, and in the narration transmitted by Ibn 'Ala the words are:" The sun eclipsed"."" He frightens His servants."
hi: Abu Musa ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ke daur mein suraj grahan hua. Woh bahut fikr mein khade hue, is dar se ki kahin ye Qayamat na ho, yahan tak ki woh masjid aaye. Woh namaz ke liye khade hue lambe qiyaam, ruku aur sajde ke saath jo maine unhe kabhi namaz mein karte nahi dekha; aur phir unhone kaha: Ye woh nishaniyaan hain jo Allah bhejta hai, na kisi ki maut ki wajah se na kisi ki zindagi ki wajah se, balki Allah inhe apne bandon ko darane ke liye bhejta hai. Is liye jab tum aisi koi cheez dekho, to Usse yaad karne, Usse dua karne aur Usse maafi maangne mein jaldi karo, aur Ibn Ala ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: "Suraj grahan mein aaya," "Woh apne bandon ko darata hai."

e: 'Abd al-Rahman b. Samura said: During the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) I was shooting my arrows in Medina, when an eclipse of the sun took place. I, therefore, threw them away and said, I must see how the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) acts in a solar eclipse today. When I came to him, he had been supplicating with his hands, raised, pronouncing Allah-o-Akbar, praising Him, acknowledging that He is One God till the eclipse was over, then he recited two surahs and prayed two rak'ahs.
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Samura ne kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) ke daur mein main Madina mein apne teer chala raha tha jab suraj grahan ho gaya. To maine unhe teeron ko phenk diya aur kaha: Mujhe zaroor dekhna hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) aaj suraj grahan mein kaise amal karte hain. Jab main unke paas aaya, to woh apne haath uthaye dua kar rahe the, Allahu Akbar keh rahe the, uski tareef kar rahe the, uski wahdaniyat ka iqraar kar rahe the yahan tak ki grahan khatam ho gaya, phir unhone do surahen padhin aur do rakat namaz padhi.

e: 'Abd al-Rahman b. Samura, who was one of the Companions of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: During the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) I was shooting some of my arrows in Medina, when the sun eclipsed. I threw (the arrows) and said: By Allah, I must see how the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) acts in solar eclipse. So I came to him and he was standing in prayer, raising his hands, glorifying Him, praising Him, acknowledging His Oneness, declaring His greatness, and supplicating Him, till the sun cleared. When the eclipse was over, he recited two surahs and prayed two rak'ahs.
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Samura, jo Rasoolullah (SAW) ke sahaba mein se the, ne kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) ke daur mein main Madina mein apne kuch teer chala raha tha jab suraj grahan hua. Maine teer phenk diye aur kaha: Allah ki qasam, mujhe zaroor dekhna hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) suraj grahan mein kaise amal karte hain. To main unke paas aaya aur woh namaz mein khade the, apne haath uthaye, uski tasbeeh kar rahe the, uski hamd kar rahe the, uski wahdaniyat ka iqraar kar rahe the, uski azmat ka ailaan kar rahe the, aur usse dua kar rahe the, yahan tak ki suraj chamakdaar ho gaya. Jab grahan khatam ho gaya, to unhone do surahen padhin aur do rakat namaz padhi.

e: 'Abd al-Rahman b. Samura reported: I was shooting some of my arrows during the lifetime of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that the sun eclipsed. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Samura ne bayan kiya: Main Rasoolullah (SAW) ke daur mein apne kuch teer chala raha tha ki suraj grahan ho gaya. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Umar reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed: Verily the sun and the moon do not eclipse on account of the death or life of anyone. They are in fact the signs among the signs of Allah. So when you see them, observe prayer.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Yaqeenan suraj aur chaand kisi ki maut ya zindagi ki wajah se grahan mein nahi aate. Woh dar-asal Allah ki nishaniyon mein se hain. Is liye jab tum unhe dekho, to namaz padho.

e: Ziyad b. 'Ilaqa reported: I heard Mughira b. Shu'ba saying that the sun eclipsed during the lifetime of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the day when Ibrahim died. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Verily the sun and the moon are the two signs among the signs of Allah. They do not eclipse on account of the death of anyone or on account of the birth of anyone. So when you see them, supplicate Allah, and observe prayer till it is over.
hi: Ziyad bin Ilaqa ne bayan kiya: Maine Mughira bin Shu'ba ko ye kehte suna ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ke daur mein suraj grahan hua usi din jis din Ibrahim ka intiqaal hua. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Yaqeenan suraj aur chaand Allah ki nishaniyon mein se do nishaniyaan hain. Ye kisi ki maut ki wajah se ya kisi ki paidaish ki wajah se grahan mein nahi aate. Is liye jab tum inhe dekho, to Allah se dua karo, aur namaz padho yahan tak ki woh khatam ho jaaye.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Exhort to recite" There is no god but Allah" to those of you who are dying.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Apne murne wale logon ko "La ilaha illallah" ki tarjeeh do, kehne ki targheeb do.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Sulaiman b. Bilal with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Sulaiman bin Bilal ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Exhort to recite" There is no god but Allah" to those of you who are dying.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Apne murne wale logon ko "La ilaha illallah" ki tarjeeh do.

e: Umm Salama reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If any Muslim who suffers some calamity says, what Allah has commanded him," We belong to Allah and to Him shall we return; O Allah, reward me for my affliction and give me something better than it in exchange for it," Allah will give him something better than it in exchange. When Abu Salama died she said: What Muslim is better than Abu Salama whose family was the first to emigrate to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). I then said the words, and Allah gave me God's Messenger (ﷺ) in exchange. She said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent Hatib b. Abu Balta'a to deliver me the message of marriage with him. I said to him: I have a daughter (as my dependant) and I am of jealous temperament. He (the Holy Prophet) said: So far as her daughter is concerned, we would supplicate Allah, that He may free her (of her responsibility) and I would also supplicate Allah to do away with (her) jealous (temperament).
hi: Umm Salama ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Agar koi Musalman jispar koi museebat aaye, woh kahe, jo Allah ne use hukum diya hai, "Hum Allah ke hain aur usi ki taraf humein laut kar jaana hai; Aye Allah, meri museebat ka mujhe ajr de aur mujhe iske badle usse behtar cheez ata farma," to Allah use uske badle behtar cheez ata karega. Jab Abu Salama ka intiqaal hua to unhone kaha: Kaunsa Musalman Abu Salama se behtar hai jinke gharwale Rasoolullah (SAW) ki taraf hijrat karne wale sabse pehle log the. Maine phir ye alfaaz kahe, aur Allah ne mujhe uske badle Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ata kiye. Unhone kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Hatib bin Abu Balta'a ko bheja taaki woh mujhe shaadi ka payaam pahunchayein. Maine unse kaha: Meri ek beti hai, jo meri zimmedaari hai, aur mera mizaaj rashk karne wala hai. Unhone kaha: Jahan tak uski beti ka sawal hai, hum Allah se dua karenge ki Woh use is zimmedaari se azaad kar de aur main Allah se ye bhi dua karunga ki Woh uska rashk karne wala mizaaj khatam kar de.

e: Umm Salama, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If any servant (of Allah) who suffers a calamity says:" We belong to Allah and to Him shall we return; O Allah, reward me for my affliction and give me something better than it in exchange for it," ' Allah will give him reward for affliction, and would give him something better than it in exchange. She (Umm Salama) said: When Abu Salama died. I uttered (these very words) as I was commanded (to do) by the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). So Allah gave me better in exchange than him. i. e. (I was taken as the wife of) the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ki zauja Umm Salama ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Agar Allah ka koi banda jispar koi museebat aaye woh kahe: "Hum Allah ke hain aur usi ki taraf humein laut kar jaana hai; Aye Allah, meri museebat ka mujhe ajr de aur mujhe iske badle usse behtar cheez ata farma," to Allah use museebat ka ajr dega, aur usse behtar cheez uske badle ata karega. Unhone kaha: Jab Abu Salama ka intiqaal hua, to maine ye alfaaz kahe jaisa Rasoolullah (SAW) ne mujhe hukum diya tha. To Allah ne mujhe unse behtar cheez badle mein di, yaani mujhe Rasoolullah (SAW) ki zauja bana liya gaya.

e: Umm Salama, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him), reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying like the hadith transmitted by Abu Usama, but with this addition that she said: " When Abu Salama died I said: Who is better than Abu Salama, the Companion of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and Allah decided for me and I said (these words contained in the supplication mentioned above) and I was married to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ki zauja Umm Salama ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko Abu Usama ki bayan ki hui hadees jaisi hi kehte suna, lekin is izafe ke saath ki unhone kaha: "Jab Abu Salama ka intiqaal hua to maine kaha: Kaun Abu Salama se behtar hai, jo Rasoolullah (SAW) ke sahabi the, aur Allah ne mere liye faisla kiya aur maine upar zikr hui dua ke alfaaz kahe aur meri shaadi Rasoolullah (SAW) se ho gayi."

e: Umm Salama reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Whenever you visit the sick or the dead, supplicate for good because angels say" Amen" to whatever you say.
