She added: When Abu Salama died, I went to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: Messenger of Allah, Abu Salama has died. He told me to recite:" O Allah! forgive me and him (Abu Salama) and give me a better substitute than he." So I said (this), and Allah gave me in exchange Muhammad, who is better for me than him (Abu Salama).
hi: Umm Salama ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab bhi tum kisi beemar ya murde se milne jao, to unke liye achhaai ki dua karo, kyunki farishte tumhare kahe har baat par "Ameen" kehte hain. Unhone izafa kiya: Jab Abu Salama ka intiqaal hua, to main Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas gayi aur kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, Abu Salama ka intiqaal ho gaya hai. Unhone mujhse ye padhne ko kaha: "Aye Allah! Mujhe aur unhe, Abu Salama ko, maaf farma aur mujhe unse behtar badla de." To maine aisa kaha, aur Allah ne badle mein mujhe Muhammad (SAW) diye, jo unse, Abu Salama se, behtar hain.

e: Umm Salama reported: The Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon came to Abu Salama (as he died). His eyes were fixedly open. He closed them, and then said: When the soul is taken away the sight follows it. Some of the people of his family wept and wailed. So he said: Do not supplicate for yourselves anything but good, for angels say" Amen" to what you say. He then said: O Allah, forgive Abu Salama, raise his degree among those who are rightly guided, grant him a successor in his descendants who remain. Forgive us and him, O Lord of the Universe, and make his grave spacious, and grant him light in it.
hi: Umm Salama ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) Abu Salama ke paas aaye, jab unka intiqaal ho gaya. Unki aankhein khuli aur khaali taak rahi thin. Unhone unhe band kiya aur phir kaha: Jab rooh nikal jaati hai, to nazar uska peecha karti hai. Unke gharwalon mein se kuch log rone aur cheekhne lage. To unhone kaha: Apne liye sirf achhaai ki dua karo, kyunki farishte tumhare kahe har baat par "Ameen" kehte hain. Unhone phir kaha: Aye Allah, Abu Salama ko maaf farma, unhe hidayat yaafta logon mein buland darja ata farma, unke chhode hue peeche waalon mein unka jaanshin ata farma, humein aur unhe maaf farma, Aye saare jahaanon ke Rab, aur unki qabr ko kushaada bana de aur usmein unhe noor ata farma.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Khalid al Hadhdha' with the same chain of transmitters but with this alteration that he said: (O Allah! ) let Thee be the caretaker of what is left by him, and he said: Grant him expansion of the grave, but he did not say: Make his grave spacious. Khalid said: He supplicated for the seventh (thing too) which I have forgotten.
hi: Ye hadees Khalid al-Hadhdha ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai lekin is tabdeeli ke saath ki unhone kaha: Aye Allah! jo unhone chhoda hai uska nigraan Tu ho, aur unhone kaha: Unki qabr ko kushaada bana de, lekin unhone "Unki qabr ko kushaada bana de" nahi kaha. Khalid ne kaha: Unhone saatvi cheez ke liye bhi dua ki jo maine bhula diya hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Did you not see when the man died and his eyes were fixedly open? He (Abu Huraira) said: Yes. He (the Holy Prophet) said: It is due to the fact that when (the soul leaves the body) his eyesight follows the soul.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Kya tumne nahi dekha jab woh shakhs mar gaya aur uski aankhein khuli taak rahi thin? Unhone kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha: Ye is liye hai kyunki jab rooh badan se nikalti hai to uski nazar rooh ka peecha karti hai.

e: This hadith is narrated on the authority of 'Ala' with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ala ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Umm Salama reported: When Abu Salama died I said: I am a stranger in a strange land; I shall weep for him in a manner that would be talked of. I made preparation for weeping for him when a woman from the upper side of the city came there who intended to help me (in weeping). She happened to come across the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he said: Do you intend to bring the devil into a house from which Allah has twice driven him out? I (Umm Salama), therefore, refrained from weeping and I did not weep.
hi: Umm Salama ne bayan kiya: Jab Abu Salama ka intiqaal hua, to maine kaha: Main ek ajnabi zameen mein pardesi hoon; main unke liye aise roungi ki ye baat charcha ban jaayegi. Maine unke liye rone ki taiyaari ki jab shehar ke upari hisse se ek aurat aayi jo rone mein meri madad karna chahti thi. Woh Rasoolullah (SAW) se milne pahunch gayi aur unhone kaha: Kya tum us ghar mein Shaitaan ko laana chahti ho jismein se Allah ne use do baar nikaala hai? Main, is liye, rone se ruk gayi aur maine roya nahi.

e: Usama b. Zaid reported: While we were with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), one of his daughters sent to him (the Messenger) to call him and inform him that her child or her son was dying. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) told the messenger to go back and tell her that what Allah had taken belonged to Him, and to him belonged what He granted; and He has an appointed time for everything. So you (the messenger) order her to show endurance and seek reward from Allah. The messenger came back and said: She adjures him to come to her. He got up to go accompanied by Sa'd b. 'Ubada, Mu'adh b. Jabal, and I also went along with them. The child was lifted to him and his soul was feeling as restless as if it was in an old (waterskin). His (Prophet's) eyes welled up with tears. Sa'd said: What is this, Messenger of Allah? He replied: This is compassion which Allah has placed in the hearts of His servants, and God shows compassion only to those of His servants who are compassionate.
hi: Usama bin Zaid ne bayan kiya: Jab hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath the, unki ek beti ne unhe bulane bheja aur unhe bataya ki uska bachcha ya uska beta marne wala hai. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne payaam laane wale se kaha ki woh wapas jaaye aur usse bataye ki jo Allah ne liya hai woh Uska hi hai, aur Usi ka hai jo Usne diya; aur Uske paas har cheez ke liye ek muqarrar waqt hai. Is liye tum usse sabar rakhne aur Allah se ajr talaash karne ka hukum do. Payaam laane wala wapas aaya aur kaha: Woh unse aane ki qasam de rahi hai. Woh khade hue aur unke saath Sa'd bin Ubada, Mu'adh bin Jabal chale, aur main bhi unke saath gaya. Bachche ko unke paas utha kar laaya gaya aur uski rooh aise bechain thi jaise woh ek purani mashk mein ho. Unki aankhon mein aansu bhar aaye. Sa'd ne kaha: Ye kya hai, Ya Rasoolullah? Unhone jawab diya: Ye woh rehmat hai jo Allah ne apne bandon ke dilon mein rakhi hai, aur Allah sirf apne un bandon par rehmat karta hai jo rehmat karne wale hain.

e: This hadith has been narrated by another chain of transmitters on the authority of 'Asim al-Ahwal.
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se Asim al-Ahwal ke hawale se bayan ki gayi hai.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Umar said that Sa'd b. Ubada complained of illness. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to visit him accompanied by 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Auf, Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas and 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud. As he entered (his room) he found him in a swoon. Upon this he said: Has he died? They said: Messenger of Allah, it is not so. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) wept. When the people saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) weeping, they also began to weep. He said. Listen, Allah does not punish for the tears that the eye sheds or the grief the heart feels, but He punishes for this (pointing to his tongue), or He may show mercy.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar ne kaha ki Sa'd bin Ubada beemar pad gaye. Rasoolullah (SAW) unse milne aaye, unke saath Abdur-Rahman bin Auf, Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas aur Abdullah bin Mas'ud the. Jab woh kamre mein daakhil hue to unhe behoshi mein paaya. Isper unhone kaha: Kya unka intiqaal ho gaya? Unhone kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, aisa nahi hai. Rasoolullah (SAW) rone lage. Jab logon ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko rote dekha, to woh bhi rone lage. Unhone kaha: Suno, Allah aankhon se bahne wale aansuon ya dil ke gam par saza nahi deta, balki Woh iske liye, apni zubaan ki taraf ishara karte hue, saza deta hai, ya Woh rehmat karta hai.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Umar reported: While we were sitting with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), a person, one of the Ansar, came to him and greeted him. The Ansari then turned back. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: o brother of Ansar, how is my brother Sa'd be 'Ubada? He said: He is better. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Who amongst you would visit him? He (the Holy Prophet) stood up and we also got up along with him, and we were more than ten persons. We had neither shoes with us, nor socks, nor caps, nor shirts. We walked on the barren land till we came to him. The people around him kept away till the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and his Companions with him came near him (Sa'd b. 'Ubada).
hi: Abdullah bin Umar ne bayan kiya: Jab hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath baithe the, ek shakhs, Ansar mein se ek, unke paas aaya aur unhe salaam kiya. Ansari phir wapas mud gaye. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Aye Ansar ke bhai, mere bhai Sa'd bin Ubada ka kya haal hai? Unhone kaha: Woh behtar hain. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Tum mein se unse milne kaun jaayega? Woh khade hue aur hum bhi unke saath khade huye, aur hum das se zyada log the. Hamare paas na joote the, na moze, na topi, na kameez. Hum banjar zameen par chalte gaye yahan tak ki hum unke paas pahunche. Unke aas-paas ke log door hate yahan tak ki Rasoolullah (SAW) aur unke saath ke sahaba unke, Sa'd bin Ubada ke, qareeb aa gaye.

e: Anas b. Malik reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Endurance is to be shown at the first blow.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Sabar pehli chot par dikhaana chahiye.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to a woman who had been weeping for her (dead) child, and said to her: Fear Allah and show endurance. She (not recognising him) said: You have not been afflicted as I have been. When he (the Holy Prophet) had departed, it was said to her that he was the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), she was mortally shocked. She came to his door and she did not find doorkeepers at his door. She said: Messenger of Allah. I did not recognise you. He said: Endurance is to be shown at first blow, or at the first blow.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ek aurat ke paas aaye jo apne mare hue bachche ke liye ro rahi thi, aur unhone unse kaha: Allah se daro aur sabar karo. Unhone, unhe pehchaane bina, kaha: Aap par woh museebat nahi aayi jo mujhpar aayi hai. Jab woh chale gaye, to unse kaha gaya ki woh Rasoolullah (SAW) the, to unhe bahut sadma pahuncha. Woh unke darwaze par aayin aur unhone wahan koi darbaan nahi paaya. Unhone kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, main aapko pehchaan nahi payi. Unhone kaha: Sabar pehli chot par dikhaaya jaata hai, ya pehli chot par.

e: A hadith like this is narrated with the same chain of transmitters but with the addition of these words: " The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) happened to pass by a woman (who was sitting) by the side of a grave."
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees isi sanad se bayan ki gayi hai lekin in alfaaz ke izafe ke saath: "Rasoolullah (SAW) ek qabr ke paas baithi ek aurat ke paas se guzre."

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Umar reported that Hafsa wept for 'Umar (when he was about to die). He ('Umar) said: Be quiet, my daughter. Don't you know that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had said:" The deceased is punished because of his family's weeping over the death"?
hi: Abdullah bin Umar ne bayan kiya ki Hafsa ne Umar ke marne ke qareeb hone par unke liye roya. Unhone kaha: Khamosh raho, meri beti. Kya tumhe nahi pata ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha tha: "Murda uske gharwalon ke rone ki wajah se azaab mein daala jaata hai"?

e: Umar reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: The dead is punished in the grave because of wailing on it.
hi: Umar ne Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Murda apni qabr mein uspar hue nauhe, waailagi, ki wajah se azaab mein daala jaata hai.

e: The same hadith is narrated on the authority of 'Umar through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Yehi hadees Umar ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported: When 'Umar was wounded he fainted, and there was a loud lamentation over him. When he regained consciousness he said: Didn't you know that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:" The dead is punished because of the weeping of the living"?
hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya: Jab Umar zakhmi hue, to woh behosh ho gaye, aur unke liye zor se maatam kiya gaya. Jab unhe hosh aaya, to unhone kaha: Kya tumhe nahi pata ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: "Murda zindon ke rone ki wajah se azaab mein daala jaata hai"?

e: Abu Burda narrated on the authority of his father that when 'Umar was wounded Suhaib uttered (loudly in lamentation): O brother! Upon this 'Umar said: Suhaib, did you not know that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:" The dead is punished because of the lamentation of the living"?
hi: Abu Burda ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki jab Umar zakhmi hue, to Suhaib ne zor se maatam mein kaha: Aye bhai! Isper Umar ne kaha: Suhaib, kya tumhe nahi pata ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: "Murda zindon ke nauhe ki wajah se azaab mein daala jaata hai"?

e: Abu Musa reported that when 'Umar was wounded, there came Suhaib from his house and went to 'Umar and stood by his side, and began to wail. Upon this 'Umar said: What are you weeping for? Are you weeping for me? He said: By Allah, it is for you that I weep, O Commander of the believers. He said: By Allah, you already know that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had said: He who is lamented upon is punished. I made a mention of it to Musa b. Talha, and he said that 'A'isha told that it concerned the Jews (only).
hi: Abu Musa ne bayan kiya ki jab Umar zakhmi hue, to Suhaib apne ghar se aaye aur Umar ke paas gaye aur unke bagal mein khade hue, aur woh maatam karne lage. Isper Umar ne kaha: Tum kis liye ro rahe ho? Kya tum mere liye ro rahe ho? Unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, main aapke liye hi ro raha hoon, Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen. Unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, tumhe pehle se pata hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha tha: Jispar maatam kiya jaata hai use azaab diya jaata hai. Maine iska zikr Musa bin Talha se kiya, aur unhone kaha ki Aisha ne bataya ki ye sirf Yahudiyon se mutalliq tha.

e: Anas reported that when 'Umar b. Khattab was wounded Hafsa lamented for him. Upon this he said: O Hafsa, did you not hear the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying:" One who is lamented would be punished"? Suhaib also lamented over him. 'Umar told him also: O Suhaib, didn't you know that one who is lamented is punished?
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki jab Umar bin Khattab zakhmi hue, to Hafsa ne unke liye maatam kiya. Isper unhone kaha: Aye Hafsa, kya tumne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte nahi suna: "Jispar maatam kiya jaata hai use azaab diya jaayega"? Suhaib ne bhi unke liye maatam kiya. Umar ne unse bhi kaha: Aye Suhaib, kya tumhe nahi pata ki jispar maatam kiya jaata hai use azaab diya jaata hai?

e: 'Abdullah b. Abu Mulaika reported: I was sitting by the side of Ibn 'Umar, and we were waiting for the bier of Umm Aban, daughter of 'Uthman, and there was also 'Amr b. 'Uthman. In the meanwhile there came Ibn 'Abbas led by a guide. I conceive that he was informed of the place of Ibn 'Umar. So he came till he sat by my side. While I was between them (Ibn 'Abbas and Ibn 'Umar) there came the noise (of wailing) from the house. Upon this Ibn 'Umar said (that is, he pointed out to 'Amr that he should stand and forbid them, for): I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: The dead is punished because of the lamentation of his family. 'Abdullah made it general (what was said for a particular occasion). Ibn 'Abbas said: When we were with the Commander of the believers, 'Umar b. Khattab, we reached Baida', and there was a man under the shadow of the tree. He said to me: Go and inform me who is that person. So I went and (found) that he was Suhaib. I returned to him and said: You commanded me to find out for you who that was, and he is Suhaib. He (Hadrat 'Umar) said: Command him to see us. I said: He has family along with him. He said: (That is of no account) even if he has family along with him. So he (the narrator) told him to see (the Commander of the believers and his party). When we came (to Medina), it was before long that the Commander of the believers was wounded, and Suhaib came weeping and crying: Alas for the brother, alas for the companion. Upon this 'Umar said: Didn't you know, or didn't you hear, that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:" The dead is punished because of the lamentation of his family"? Then 'Abdullah made it general and 'Umar told it of certain occasions. So I ('Abdullah b. Abu Mulaika) stood up and went to 'A'isha and told her what Ibn 'Umar had said. Upon this she said: I swear by Allah that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) never said that dead would be punished because of his family's lamenting (for him). What he said was that Allah would increase the punishment of the unbeliever because of his family's lamenting for him. Verily it is Allah Who has caused laughter and weeping. No bearer of a burden will bear another's burden. Ibn Abu Mulaika said that al-Qasim b. Muhammad said that when the words of 'Umar and Ibn 'Umar were conveyed to 'A'isha, she said: You have narrated it to me from those who are neither liar nor those suspected of lying but (sometimes) hearing misleads.
hi: Abdullah bin Abu Mulaika ne bayan kiya: Main Ibn Umar ke bagal mein baitha tha, aur hum Umm Aban, Uthman ki beti, ka janaza ka intezaar kar rahe the, aur Amr bin Uthman bhi wahan the. Isi dauran Ibn Abbas ek raahnuma ke saath aaye. Mera khayal hai ki unhe Ibn Umar ki jagah ke baare mein bataya gaya tha. To woh aaye yahan tak ki woh mere bagal mein baith gaye. Jab main unke, Ibn Abbas aur Ibn Umar ke, beech tha, to ghar se maatam ki aawaaz aayi. Isper Ibn Umar ne kaha, yaani unhone Amr ko ishara kiya ki woh khade hokar unhe rokein: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Murda apne gharwalon ke maatam ki wajah se azaab mein daala jaata hai. Abdullah ne ise aam, khaas mauqe ke bajaye, bana diya. Ibn Abbas ne kaha: Jab hum Ameer-ul-Momineen, Umar bin Khattab, ke saath the, hum Baida pahunche, aur wahan ek shakhs ek darakht ke saaye mein tha. Unhone mujhse kaha: Jao aur mujhe bataao woh shakhs kaun hai. To main gaya aur paaya ki woh Suhaib the. Main unke paas wapas aaya aur kaha: Aapne mujhe hukum diya tha ki main pata karun woh kaun hai, aur woh Suhaib hain. Unhone kaha: Unhe humse milne ka hukum do. Maine kaha: Unke saath unka gharana bhi hai. Unhone kaha: Isse koi farq nahi padta, chahe unke saath gharana bhi ho. To unhone unhe milne ko kaha. Jab hum Madina pahunche, to jald hi Ameer-ul-Momineen zakhmi ho gaye, aur Suhaib rote-chillaate aaye: Haaye bhai, haaye saathi. Isper Umar ne kaha: Kya tumhe nahi pata, ya tumne suna nahi, ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: "Murda apne gharwalon ke maatam ki wajah se azaab mein daala jaata hai"? Phir Abdullah ne ise aam bana diya aur Umar ne ise khaas mauqon ke liye bataya. To main khada hua aur Aisha ke paas gaya aur unhe bataya jo Ibn Umar ne kaha tha. Isper unhone kaha: Main Allah ki qasam khaati hoon ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kabhi ye nahi kaha ki murda apne gharwalon ke maatam ki wajah se azaab mein daala jaayega. Unhone kaha tha ki Allah kaafir ka azaab uske gharwalon ke maatam ki wajah se badhaayega. Yaqeenan Allah hi hai jisne hansi aur rona banaya hai. Koi bhi bojh uthaane wala doosre ka bojh nahi uthaayega. Ibn Abu Mulaika ne kaha ki al-Qasim bin Muhammad ne kaha ki jab Umar aur Ibn Umar ke alfaaz Aisha tak pahunchaaye gaye, to unhone kaha: Tumne ye mujhe un logon se riwayat ki hai jo na jhoote hain na jhoot bolne ke shaki, lekin kabhi-kabhi sunna galat samajh mein le jaata hai.

e: 'Abdullah b. Abu Mulaika said: The daughter of 'Uthman b. 'Affan died in Mecca. We came to attend her (funeral). Ibn 'Umar and Ibn 'Abbas were also present there, and I was sitting between them. He added: I (first sat) by the side of one of them, then the other one came and he sat by my side. 'Abdullah b. 'Umar said to 'Amr b. 'Uthman who was sitting opposite to him: Will you not prevent the people from lamenting, for the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had said:" The dead is punished because of the lamenting of his family for him"? Ibn 'Abbas then said that Umar used to say someting of that nature, and then narrated saying: I proceeded from Mecca along with 'Umar till we reached al-Baida' and there was a party of riders under the shade of a tree. He said (to me): Go and find out who this party is. I cast a glance and there was Suhaib (in that party). So I informed him ('Umar) about it. He said: Call him to me. So I went back to Suhaib and said: Go and meet the Commander of the believers. When 'Umar was wounded, Suhaib came walling: Alas, for the brother! alas for the companion! 'Umar said: O Suhaib, do you wail for me, whereas the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:" The dead would be punished on account of the lamentation of the (members of his family)"? Ibn 'Abbas said: When 'Umar died I made a mention of it to 'A'isha. She said: May Allah have mercy upon 'Umar! I swear by Allah that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) never said that Allah would punish the believer because of the weeping (of any one of the members of his family), but he said that Allah would increase the punishment of the unbeliever because of the weeping of his family over him. 'A'isha said: The Qur'an is enough for you (when it states):" No bearer of burden will bear another's burden" (vi. 164). Thereupon Ibn 'Abbas said: Allah is He Who has caused laughter and weeping. Ibn Abu Mulaika said: By Allah, Ibn 'Umar said nothing.
hi: Abdullah bin Abu Mulaika ne kaha: Uthman bin Affan ki beti Makkah mein guzar gayin. Hum unke janaze mein shaamil hone aaye. Ibn Umar aur Ibn Abbas bhi wahan maujood the, aur main unke beech baitha tha. Unhone izafa kiya: Main pehle unmein se ek ke bagal mein baitha, phir doosre aaye aur woh mere bagal mein baith gaye. Abdullah bin Umar ne Amr bin Uthman se, jo unke saamne baithe the, kaha: Kya tum logon ko maatam karne se nahi rokoge, kyunki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha tha: "Murda apne gharwalon ke maatam ki wajah se azaab mein daala jaata hai"? Ibn Abbas ne phir kaha ki Umar aisi hi baat kaha karte the, aur phir bayaan karte hue kaha: Main Makkah se Umar ke saath nikla yahan tak ki hum al-Baida pahunche aur wahan ek darakht ke saaye mein sawaaron ka ek giroh tha. Unhone kaha: Jao aur pata karo ye giroh kaun hai. Maine nazar daali aur wahan Suhaib the us giroh mein. To maine unhe iski khabar di. Unhone kaha: Unhe mere paas bulao. To main wapas Suhaib ke paas gaya aur kaha: Jao aur Ameer-ul-Momineen se milo. Jab Umar zakhmi hue, to Suhaib maatam karte hue aaye: Haaye bhai! Haaye saathi! Umar ne kaha: Aye Suhaib, kya tum mere liye maatam kar rahe ho, jabki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha tha: "Murde ko uske gharwalon ke maatam ki wajah se azaab diya jaayega"? Ibn Abbas ne kaha: Jab Umar ka intiqaal hua, to maine iska zikr Aisha se kiya. Unhone kaha: Allah Umar par rehmat kare! Main Allah ki qasam khaati hoon ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kabhi ye nahi kaha ki Allah momin ko uske kisi gharwale ke rone ki wajah se azaab dega, lekin unhone kaha ki Allah kaafir ka azaab uske gharwalon ke uspar rone ki wajah se badhaayega. Aisha ne kaha: Tumhare liye Quran hi kaafi hai jab woh kehta hai: "Koi bhi bojh uthaane wala doosre ka bojh nahi uthaayega" (6:164). Isper Ibn Abbas ne kaha: Allah hi hai jisne hansi aur rona banaya. Ibn Abu Mulaika ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, Ibn Umar ne kuch nahi kaha.

e: 'Amr reported on the authority of Ibn Abu Mulaika: We were with the bier of Umm Aban, daughter of 'Uthman, and the rest of the hadith is the same, but he did not narrate it as a marfu' hadith on the authority of 'Umar from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as it was narrated by Ayyub and Ibn Juraij, and the hadith narrated by them (Ayyub and Ibn Juraij) is more complete than that of 'Amr.
hi: Amr ne Ibn Abu Mulaika ke hawale se riwayat ki: Hum Umm Aban, Uthman ki beti, ke janaze ke saath the, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai, lekin unhone ise Umar se Rasoolullah (SAW) tak pahunchne wali, Marfu, hadees ke taur par riwayat nahi ki jaisa Ayyub aur Ibn Juraij ne ki thi, aur unki, Ayyub aur Ibn Juraij ki, riwayat ki hui hadees Amr ki hadees se zyada mukammal hai.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Umar reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The dead is punished because of the lamentation of the living.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Murda zindon ke maatam ki wajah se azaab mein daala jaata hai.

e: Hisham b. 'Urwa narrated on the authority of his father that the saying of Ibn 'Umar, viz." The dead would be punished because of the lamentation of his family over him" was mentioned to 'A'isha. Upon this she said: May Allah have mercy upon Abu 'Abd al-Rahman (the kunya of Ibn 'Umar) that he heard something but could not retain it (well). (The fact is) that the bier of a Jew passed before the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and (the members of his family) were waiting over him. Upon this he said: You are wailing and he is being punished.
hi: Hisham bin Urwa ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Ibn Umar ki baat, "Murda uske gharwalon ke maatam ki wajah se azaab mein daala jaayega," Aisha ke saamne rakhi gayi. Isper unhone kaha: Allah Abu Abdur-Rahman, Ibn Umar ki kunyat, par rehmat kare, unhone kuch suna lekin use achhi tarah yaad nahi rakh sake. Haqeeqat ye hai ki ek Yahudi ka janaza Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saamne se guzra aur uske gharwale uspar rone mein masroof the. Isper unhone kaha: Tum log maatam kar rahe ho aur usse azaab diya jaa raha hai.

e: Hisham narrated on the authority of his father that it was mentioned to 'A'isha that Ibn 'Umar had narrated as marfu' hadith from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that the dead would be punished in the grave because of the lamentation of his family for him. Upon this she said: He (Ibn 'Umar) missed (the point). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had (in fact) said: He (the dead) is punished for his faults or for his sins, and the members of his family are wailing for him now. (This misunderstanding of Ibn 'Umar is similar to his saying: ) The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stood by the well in which were lying the dead bodies of those polytheists who had been killed on the Day of Badr, and he said to them what he had to say, i. e.: They hear what I say. But he (Ibn 'Umar) misunderstood. The Prophet (ﷺ) had only said: They (the dead) understand that what I used to say to them was truth. She then recited:" Certainly, thou canst not make the dead hear the call" (xxvii. 80), nor can you make those hear who are in the graves, nor can you inform them when they have taken their seats in Hell.
hi: Hisham ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Aisha ke saamne ye baat rakhi gayi ki Ibn Umar ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se ek Marfu hadees riwayat ki thi ki murda apni qabr mein uske gharwalon ke maatam ki wajah se azaab mein daala jaata hai. Isper unhone kaha: Unhone baat ko galat samjha. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne dar-asal kaha tha: Use uski galtiyon ya uske gunahon ki wajah se azaab diya jaata hai, aur uske gharwale ab uske liye maatam kar rahe hain. Ibn Umar ki ye galatfehmi kuch aisi hi hai jaisi unki ye baat: Rasoolullah (SAW) us kunwe ke paas khade hue jismein Badr ki jung mein maare gaye un mushrikon ki laashein padi thin, aur unhone unse woh baat kahi jo unhe kehni thi, yaani: Woh sunte hain jo main kehta hoon. Lekin unhone galat samjha. Nabi (SAW) ne sirf ye kaha tha: Woh murde samajhte hain ki jo main unse kaha karta tha woh haq tha. Unhone phir padha: "Yaqeenan tum murdon ko apni awaaz nahi sunwa sakte" (27:80), na hi tum unhe sunwa sakte ho jo qabron mein hain, na hi tum unhe iski khabar de sakte ho jab woh jahannam mein baith chuke hon.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Ibn 'Urwa with the same chain of transmitters. The hadith narrated by Abu Usama is more complete.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Urwa ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai. Abu Usama ki bayan ki hui hadees zyada mukammal hai.

e: 'Amra daughter of 'Abd al Rahman narrated that she heard (from) 'A'isha and made a mention to her about 'Abdullah b. 'Umar as saying: The dead is punished because of the lamentation of the living. Upon this 'A'isha said: May Allah have mercy upon the father of 'Abd al-Rahman (Ibn 'Umar). He did not tell a lie, but he forgot or made a mistake. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) happened to pass by a (dead) Jewess who was being lamented. Upon this he said: They weep over her and she is being punished in the grave.
hi: Amra, Abdur-Rahman ki beti, ne riwayat ki ki unhone Aisha se suna aur Abdullah bin Umar ka zikr karte hue unse kaha jo unhone kaha tha: Murda zindon ke maatam ki wajah se azaab mein daala jaata hai. Isper Aisha ne kaha: Allah Abdur-Rahman, Ibn Umar, ke waalid par rehmat kare. Unhone jhoot nahi bola, lekin woh bhool gaye ya galti ki. Rasoolullah (SAW) ek Yahudi aurat ke janaze ke paas se guzre jispar maatam kiya ja raha tha. Isper unhone kaha: Woh uspar rote hain aur woh qabr mein azaab mein hai.

e: 'Ali b. Rabi'a reported that the first one who was lamented upon in Kufa was Qaraza b. Ka'b. Mughira b. Shu'ba said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: He who is lamented upon would be punished because of the lamentation for him on the Day of judgment.
hi: Ali bin Rabi'a ne bayan kiya ki Kufa mein sabse pehla shakhs jispar maatam kiya gaya woh Qaraza bin Ka'b the. Mughira bin Shu'ba ne kaha: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jispar maatam kiya jaata hai use Qayamat ke din uspar hue maatam ki wajah se azaab diya jaayega.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated by Mughira b. Shu'ba from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Mughira bin Shu'ba ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Rasoolullah (SAW) se ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Malik al-Ash'ari reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Among my people there are four characteristics belonging to pre-Islamic period which they do not abandon: boasting of high rank, reviling other peoples' genealogies, seeking rain by stars, and walling. And he (further) said: If the wailing woman does not repent before she dies, she will be made to stand on the Day of Resurrection wearing a garment of pitch and a chemise of mange.
hi: Abu Malik al-Ash'ari ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Meri ummat mein jaahiliyat ke daur ki chaar aadatein hain jinhe woh nahi chhodte: darje par fakhr karna, doosron ke naslon par tanz karna, sitaron se baarish talaash karna, aur maatam karna. Aur unhone aage kaha: Agar maatam karne wali aurat apni maut se pehle tauba nahi karti, to use Qayamat ke din daamar ka libaas aur khaarish ki kameez pehnaa kar khada kiya jaayega.

e: 'A'isha reported that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was told that Ibn Haritha, Ja'far b. Abu Talib and Abdullah b. Rawaha were killed, he sat down, showing signs of grief. She (further) said: I was looking (at him) through the crevice of the door. A man came to him and mentioned that Ja'far's women were lamenting. He (the Holy Prophet) commanded him to go and forbid them (to do so). So he went away but came back and told (him) that they did not obey (him). He commanded him a second time to go and forbid them (to do so). He again went but came back to him and said: I swear by God, Messenger of Allah, that they have overpowered us. She ('A'isha) said that she thought the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had told (her) to throw dust in their mouths. Thereupon 'A'isha said: May Allah humble you! You did not do what Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered you, nor did you stop annoying Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab Rasoolullah (SAW) ko bataya gaya ki Ibn Haritha, Ja'far bin Abu Talib aur Abdullah bin Rawaha maare gaye hain, to woh baith gaye, gam ki nishaniyaan dikhate hue. Unhone aage kaha: Main darwaze ki daraar se unhe dekh rahi thi. Ek shakhs unke paas aaya aur zikr kiya ki Ja'far ki auraten maatam kar rahi hain. Unhone use hukum diya ki woh jaakar unhe rokein. To woh gaye lekin wapas aakar bataya ki unhone unki baat nahi maani. Unhone dobara hukum diya ki woh jaakar unhe rokein. Woh phir gaye lekin unke paas wapas aakar kaha: Allah ki qasam, Ya Rasoolullah, unhone humein qaboo mein kar liya hai. Aisha ne kaha ki unhe laga ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unse auraton ke muhon mein mitti daalne ko kaha. Isper Aisha ne kaha: Allah tumhe zaleel kare! Na tumne woh kiya jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne tumhe hukum diya, na hi tumne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko pareshaan karna band kiya.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Yahya b. Sa'id with the same chain of transmitters like one narrated by 'Abd al-'Aziz (with the change of these words): " You did not spare the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) the botheration."
hi: Ye hadees Yahya bin Sa'id ne isi sanad se Abdul Aziz ki bayan ki hui hadees jaisi bayan ki hai in alfaaz ki tabdeeli ke saath: "Tumne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko pareshaani se nahi bachaya."

e: Umm 'Atiyya reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took a promise from us along with the oath of Allegiance that we would not lament. But only five among us fulfilled the promise (and they are) Umm Sulaim, and Umm al-'Ala', and the daughter of Abu Sabra the wife of Mu'adh, or daughter of Abu Sabra and wife of Mu'adh.
hi: Umm Atiyya ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne humse bai'at ke saath ye wada bhi liya ki hum maatam nahi karengi. Lekin humme se sirf paanch ne is wade ko poora kiya, aur woh hain Umm Sulaim, Umm al-Ala, aur Abu Sabra ki beti, Mu'adh ki biwi, ya Abu Sabra ki beti aur Mu'adh ki biwi.

e: Umm 'Atiyya reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took pledge from us (including this promise) that we would not lament. Only five amongst us fulfilled the promise, and one of them (who fulfilled the promise) was Umm Sulaim.
hi: Umm Atiyya ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne humse ye ehed liya, is wade samet, ki hum maatam nahi karengi. Humme se sirf paanch ne is wade ko poora kiya, aur unmein se ek, jinhone wada poora kiya, Umm Sulaim thin.

e: Hafsa narrated on the authority of Umm 'Atiyya that she said: When this verse was revealed:" When believing women came to thee giving thee a pledge that they will not associate aught with Allah, and will not disobey thee in good" (lx. 12), she (Umm Atiyya) said: In (this pledge) was also included wailing. I said: Messenger of Allah, except members of such a tribe who helped me (in lamentation) during pre-Islamic days, there is left no alternative for me, but that I should also help them. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: (Yes) but only in case of the members of such a tribe.
hi: Hafsa ne Umm Atiyya ke hawale se riwayat ki ki unhone kaha: Jab ye aayat nazil hui: "Jab momin auraten tumhare paas aaye tumse bai'at karne, is baat par ki woh Allah ke saath kuch shareek nahi karengi, aur bhalaai mein tumhari naafarmani nahi karengi" (60:12), unhone kaha: Is bai'at mein maatam bhi shaamil tha. Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, siwaay us qabile ke logon ke jinhone jaahiliyat ke daur mein meri maatam mein madad ki thi, mere paas koi doosra raasta nahi hai balki main bhi unki madad karun. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Haan lekin sirf us qabile ke logon ke maamle mein.

e: Umm 'Atiyya reported: We were forbidden to follow the bier, but it was not made absolute on us.
hi: Umm Atiyya ne bayan kiya: Humein janaze ke saath jaane se mana kiya gaya, lekin ise humpar mukammal taur par laazim nahi kiya gaya.

e: Umm 'Atiyya reported: We were refrained from following the bier, but it was not made absolute on us.
hi: Umm Atiyya ne bayan kiya: Humein janaze ke saath jaane se roka gaya, lekin ise humpar mukammal taur par laazim nahi kiya gaya.

e: Umm 'Atiyya reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) came to us when we were bathing his daughter, and he told us: Wash her with water and (with the leaves of) the lote tree, three or five times, or more than that if you think fit, and put camphor or something like camphor in the last washing; then inform me when you have finished. So when we had finished, we informed him, and he gave to us his (own) under-garment saying:" Put it next her body."
hi: Umm Atiyya ne bayan kiya: Rasool (SAW) hamare paas aaye jab hum unki beti ko ghusl de rahe the, aur unhone humse kaha: Unhe paani aur beri ke pattoon se dhoo lo, teen ya paanch baar, ya usse zyada agar tumhe munaasib lage, aur aakhri baar dhote waqt kaafoor ya kaafoor jaisi koi cheez daal do; phir jab tum khatam kar lo to mujhe bataana. Jab hum khatam kar chuke, to humne unhe bataya, aur unhone humein apna khud ka andarooni kapda diya ye kehte hue: "Ise unke badan ke qareeb rakh do."

e: Umm 'Atiyya reported: We braided her hair in three plaits.
hi: Umm Atiyya ne bayan kiya: Humne unke baalon ki teen choti banayi.

e: Umm 'Atiyya reported: One of the daughters of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) died. And in the hadith transmitted by Ibn 'Ulayya (the words are): The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to us and we were washing his daughter. And in the hadith transmitted by Malik (the words are): There came in (our apartment) the Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him) when his daughter died. The rest of the hadith is the same as narrated by Yazid b. Zurai' from Ayyub from Muhammad from Umm 'Atiyya.
hi: Umm Atiyya ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ki ek beti ka intiqaal hua. Aur Ibn Ulayya ki bayan ki hui hadees mein alfaaz hain: Rasoolullah (SAW) humare paas aaye aur hum unki beti ko dhoo rahe the. Aur Malik ki bayan ki hui hadees mein alfaaz hain: Rasoolullah (SAW) hamare kamre mein aaye jab unki beti ka intiqaal hua tha. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai jaisi Yazid bin Zurai ne Ayyub se, Muhammad se, Umm Atiyya se riwayat ki hai.

e: A hadith like this has been transmitted by Hafsa on the authority of Umm 'Atiyya with the exception (of these words that the Prophet asked them to wash her dead body): " three times, five times, seven times, or more than that, if you deem fit:" Hafsa (further) said on the authority of Umm 'Atiyya: We braided (the hair) of her head in three plaits.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Hafsa ne Umm Atiyya ke hawale se bayan ki hai siwaay is izafe ke, ki Nabi ne unse unke murde badan ko dhone ko kaha: "Teen baar, paanch baar, saat baar, ya usse zyada, agar tumhe munaasib lage." Hafsa ne aage Umm Atiyya ke hawale se kaha: Humne unke sar ke baalon ki teen choti banayi.

e: Umm 'Atiyya reported: We washed her an odd number of times, i. e. three, five or seven times; and Umm 'Atiyya (further) said: We braided her hair in three plaits.
hi: Umm Atiyya ne bayan kiya: Humne unhe taaq tadaad mein dhoya, yaani teen, paanch ya saat baar; aur Umm Atiyya ne aage kaha: Humne unke baalon ki teen choti banayi.

e: Umm 'Atiyya reported: When Zainab the daughter of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) died, he said to us: Wash her odd number of times, i. e. three or five times, and put camphor or something-like camphor at the fifth time, and after you have washed her inform me. So we informed him and he gave us his under-garment, saying:" Put it next her body."
hi: Umm Atiyya ne bayan kiya: Jab Rasoolullah (SAW) ki beti Zainab ka intiqaal hua, to unhone humse kaha: Unhe taaq tadaad mein dhoo lo, yaani teen ya paanch baar, aur paanchvi baar kaafoor ya kaafoor jaisi koi cheez daal do, aur jab tum unhe dhoo lo to mujhe bataana. To humne unhe bataya aur unhone humein apna andarooni kapda diya ye kehte hue: "Ise unke badan ke qareeb rakh do."

e: Umm 'Atiyya reported: There came to us the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as we were washing one of his daughters. So he said: Wash her (dead body) an odd number of times, five times or more than that, the rest of the hadith is the same. She (further) said: We braided her hair in three plaits: (two) on the sides of her head and one on her forehead.
hi: Umm Atiyya ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) hamare paas aaye jab hum unki ek beti ko dhoo rahe the. To unhone kaha: Unhe taaq tadaad mein dhoo lo, paanch baar ya usse zyada, baaki hadees waisi hi hai. Unhone aage kaha: Humne unke baalon ki teen choti banayi: do unke sar ke aas-paas aur ek unki peshani par.

e: Umm 'Atiyya reported that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) asked her to wash his daughter, he told her to start from the right side, and with those parts of the body over which Wudu' is performed.
hi: Umm Atiyya ne bayan kiya ki jab Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unse apni beti ko dhone ko kaha, to unhone unhe daayi taraf se shuru karne ko kaha, aur badan ke un hisson se jinpar Wuzu kiya jaata hai.

e: Umm 'Atiyya reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to them (the women) in regard to the washing of his daughter to start from the right side and with those parts of the body over which Wudu' is performed.
hi: Umm Atiyya ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unse, auraton se, apni beti ko dhone ke baare mein kaha ki daayi taraf se shuru karein, aur badan ke un hisson se jinpar Wuzu kiya jaata hai.

e: Khabbab al-Aratt reported: We migrated with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in the path of Allah seeking Allah's pleasure alone. Thus our reward was assured with Allah. And amongst us were those who spent life (in such a state of piety and austerity) that nothing consumed their reward. Mus'ab b. 'Umair was one of them. He was killed on the Day of Uhud, and nothing but a woollen cloak was found to shroud him. When we covered his head with it, his feet became uncovered, and when we covered his feet, his head was uncovered. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Place it (this cloak) on the side of his head and cover his feet with grass. And there is one amongst us for whom the fruit is ripened and he enjoys it.
hi: Khabbab al-Aratt ne bayan kiya: Humne Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath Allah ki raah mein hijrat ki, sirf Allah ki raza chahte hue. Is liye hamara ajr Allah ke paas mahfooz hai. Aur hummein se kuch aise the jinhone itni takwa aur sakhti ki zindagi guzaari ki unke ajr mein se kuch bhi kharch nahi hua. Mus'ab bin Umair unmein se ek the. Woh Uhud ke din maare gaye, aur unhe kafan dene ke liye sirf ek oon ki chadar mili. Jab humne unke sar ko usse dhaanka, to unke paon khul jaate, aur jab humne unke paon dhaanke, to unka sar khul jaata. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Ise unke sar ki taraf rakho aur unke paon ghaas se dhaank do. Aur hummein se ek aisa hai jiske liye phal pak chuka hai aur woh iska mazaa le raha hai.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated by 'Uyaina on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Uyaina ne A'mash ke hawale se isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: 'A'isha reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was shrouded in three cotton garments of white Yamani stuff from Sahul, among which was neither a shirt nor a turban; and so far as Hullah is concerned there was some doubt about it in the minds of people, that it was brought for him in order to shroud him with it, but it was abandoned, and he was shrouded in three cotton garments of white Yamani stuff from Sahul. Then 'Abdullah b. Abu Bakr got it and said: I would keep it in order to shroud myself in it. He then said: If Allah, the Exalted and Majestic, would have desired it for His Apostle, he would have been shrouded with it. So he sold it and gave its price in charity.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ko Sahul ke safed Yemeni kapde ke teen sooti tukdon mein kafan diya gaya, jinmein na koi kameez thi na koi pagdi; aur jahan tak Hulla, khaas kapde, ka sawal hai, logon ke zehan mein iske baare mein kuch shaq tha, ki use unhe kafan dene ke liye laaya gaya tha, lekin ise chhod diya gaya, aur unhe Sahul ke safed Yemeni kapde ke teen sooti tukdon mein kafan diya gaya. Phir Abdullah bin Abu Bakr ko woh Hulla mila aur unhone kaha: Main ise apne pass rakhunga taaki main khud ko usmein kafan de sakoon. Unhone phir kaha: Agar Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, apne Rasool ke liye ise chahta, to unhe usmein kafan diya jaata. To unhone use bech diya aur uski keemat sadaqe mein de di.

e: 'A'isha reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was wrapped in a Yamani wrapper which belonged to 'Abdullah b Abu Bakr; then it was removed from him, and he was shrouded in three cotton sheets of white Yamani stuff from Sahul among which was neither a shirt nor a turban. 'Abdullah took up the Hullah and said: I would be shrouded in it, but then said: How is it that I should be shrouded in it in which the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was not shrouded! So he gave it in charity.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ek Yemeni chadar mein lapeta gaya jo Abdullah bin Abu Bakr ki thi; phir use unse hataya gaya, aur unhe Sahul ke safed Yemeni kapde ke teen sooti tukdon mein kafan diya gaya jinmein na koi kameez thi na koi pagdi. Abdullah ne Hulla utha li aur kaha: Main isme kafan diya jaunga, lekin phir kaha: Ye kaise ho sakta hai ki main isme kafan diya jaun jismein Rasoolullah (SAW) ko kafan nahi diya gaya! To unhone ise sadaqe mein de diya.

e: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters, but in the hadith narrated by him there is no mention of the story of 'Abdullah b. Abu Bakr.
hi: Ye hadees Hisham ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai, lekin unki bayan ki hui hadees mein Abdullah bin Abu Bakr ke waaqiye ka zikr nahi hai.

e: Abu Salama said: I asked 'A'isha with how many garments the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was shourded. She said: With three garments of Sahul.
hi: Abu Salama ne kaha: Maine Aisha se poocha ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ko kitne kapdon mein kafan diya gaya. Unhone kaha: Sahul ke teen kapdon mein.

e: 'A'isha reported: When the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upom him) died, he was covered with a Yamani wrapper.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Jab Rasoolullah (SAW) ka intiqaal hua, to unhe ek Yemeni chadar se dhaanka gaya.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) one day in the course of his sermon made mention of a person among his Companions who had died and had been wrapped in a shroud not long (enough to cover his whole body) and was buried during the night. The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) reprimanded (the audience) that a person was buried during the night (in a state that) funeral prayer could not be offered (over him by the Messenger of Allah). (And this is permissible only) when it becomes a dire necessity for a man. The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) also said: When any one of you shrouds his brother, he should shroud him well.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne ek din apne khutbe mein apne ek sahabi ka zikr kiya jo intiqaal kar gaye the aur unhe ek chhote kafan mein lapeta gaya tha, jo unke poore badan ko dhankne ke liye kaafi nahi tha, aur unhe raat ko dafan kiya gaya tha. Rasool (SAW) ne sunne walon ko daanta ki kisi shakhs ko raat ko us haalat mein dafan kiya gaya ki uski janaze ki namaz Rasoolullah (SAW) ke zariye padhi hi nahi ja saki. Aur ye sirf tab jaayez hai jab kisi shakhs ke liye ye sakht majboori ban jaaye. Rasool (SAW) ne ye bhi kaha: Jab tum mein se koi apne bhai ko kafan de, to use achhi tarah kafan dena chahiye.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Make haste at a funeral; if the dead person was good, it is a good state to which you are sending him on; but if he was otherwise it is an evil of which you are ridding yourselves.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Janaze mein jaldi karo; agar murda achha tha, to ye ek achhi cheez hai jiski taraf tum use bhej rahe ho; lekin agar woh aisa nahi tha, to ye ek buraai hai jisse tum apne aap ko chhutkaara dila rahe ho.

e: This hadith has been narrated by another chain of transmitters except with this variation (of words) that in the hadith narrated by Ma'mar (the words are): " I do not know whether the hadith is marfu'."
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se bayan ki gayi hai siwaay is tabdeeli, alfaaz mein, ke ki Ma'mar ki bayan ki hui hadees mein alfaaz hain: "Mujhe nahi pata ki hadees Marfu hai ya nahi."

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger as saying: Hasten at a funeral, for if (the dead person) is good, you would (soon) bring him close to the good. And if it is otherwise, it is an evil of which you are ridding yourselves.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Janaze mein jaldi karo, kyunki agar murda achha hai, to tum use jald hi achhaai ke qareeb le jaate ho. Aur agar aisa nahi hai, to ye ek buraai hai jisse tum apne aap ko chhutkaara dila rahe ho.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who attends the funeral till the prayer is offered for (the dead), for him is the reward of one qirat, and he who attends (and stays) till he is buried, for him is the reward of two qirats. It was said: What are the qirats? He said: They are equivalent to two huge mountains. Two other narrators added: Ibn 'Umar used to pray and then depart (without waiting for the burial of the dead). When the tradition of Abu Huraira reached him, he said:" We have lost many qirats."
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo janaze mein tab tak shaamil rahe jab tak murde ke liye namaz na padh li jaaye, uske liye ek qirat ka sawaab hai, aur jo tab tak rahe jab tak use dafan na kar diya jaaye, uske liye do qirat ka sawaab hai. Poocha gaya: Qirat kya hai? Unhone kaha: Ye do bade pahaadon ke barabar hai. Do doosre raawiyon ne izafa kiya: Ibn Umar namaz padhkar chale jaate the, murde ke dafan hone ka intezaar kiye bagair. Jab unhe Abu Huraira ki riwayat pahunchi, to unhone kaha: "Humne kayi qirat kho diye."

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of narrators up to these words: " two great mountains." No mention is made of what followed (these words) ; and in the hadith transmitted by 'Abd al- A'la (the words are):" till (the burial) is complete." In the hadith transmitted by 'Abd ar-Razzaq (the words are):" till he is placed in the grave."
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se in alfaaz tak bayan ki gayi hai: "do bade pahaad." Iske baad ka koi zikr nahi kiya gaya; aur Abdul A'la ki bayan ki hui hadees mein alfaaz hain: "jab tak dafan mukammal na ho jaaye." Abdur-Razzaq ki bayan ki hui hadees mein alfaaz hain: "jab tak use qabr mein rakh na diya jaaye."

e: This hadith is narrated on thp authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters (with these words): " He who followed it (the bier) till he (the dead) is buried."
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se in alfaaz ke saath bayan ki gayi hai: "Jo iske, janaze ke, saath tab tak chala jab tak use dafan na kar diya jaaye."

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: He who offered prayer over the dead, but did not follow the bier, for him is the reward of one qirat, and he who followed it, for him is the reward of two qirats. It was asked what the qirats were. He said: The smaller amongst the two is equivalent to Uhud.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jisne murde ke liye namaz padhi lekin janaze ke saath nahi gaya, uske liye ek qirat ka sawaab hai, aur jo iske saath gaya, uske liye do qirat ka sawaab hai. Poocha gaya ki qirat kya hai. Unhone kaha: Do mein se chota Uhud pahaad ke barabar hai.

e: Nafi' narrated that it was said to Ibn 'Umar that Abu Huraira reported to have heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who follows the bier, for him is the reward of one qirat. Ibn 'Umar said: Abu Huraira narrated it too often. So he sent (a messenger to) 'A'isha to ascertain (the fact). She ('A'isha) testified Abu Huraira. Ibn 'Umar said: We missed so many qirats.
hi: Nafi ne riwayat ki ki Ibn Umar se kaha gaya ki Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna hai: Jo janaze ke saath jaaye, uske liye ek qirat ka sawaab hai. Ibn Umar ne kaha: Abu Huraira ne ise bahut zyada riwayat kiya hai. To unhone Aisha ke paas ek payaam laane wala bheja iski tasdeeq ke liye. Aisha (RA) ne Abu Huraira ki tasdeeq ki. Ibn Umar ne kaha: Humne itne saare qirat kho diye.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who offers prayer for the dead, for him is (the reward of) one qirat; and he who follows the bier till it is placed in the grave, for him (is the reward of) two qirats. I (Abu Hazim, one of the narrators) said: Abu Huraira, what is a qirat? He said: It is like the hill of Uhud.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo murde ke liye namaz padhta hai, uske liye ek qirat ka sawaab hai; aur jo janaze ke saath tab tak jaata hai jab tak use qabr mein rakh na diya jaaye, uske liye do qirat ka sawaab hai. Maine, Abu Hazim, raawiyon mein se ek, ne kaha: Abu Huraira, qirat kya hai? Unhone kaha: Ye Uhud pahaad jaisa hai.

e: Dawud b. 'Amir b. Sa'd b. Abu Waqqas reported on the authority of his father that while he was sitting along with 'Abdullah b. 'Umar, Khabbab, the owner of Maqsura, said: Ibn 'Umar, do you hear what Abu Huraira says that he heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say:" He who goes out with the bier when taken out from its residence and offers prayer for it and he then follows it till it is buried, he would have two qirats of reward, each qirat being equivalent to Uhud; and he who, after having offered prayer, (directly) came back would have his reward (as great) as Uhud"? Ibn 'Umar sent Khabbab to 'A'isha in order to ask her about the words of Abu Huraira (and also told him) to come back to him (Ibn 'Umar) and inform him what 'A'isha said. (In the meanwhile) Ibn 'Umar took up a handful of pebbles and turned them over in his hand till the messenger (Khabbab) came back to him and told (him) that 'A'isha testified (the statement of) Abu Huraira. Ibn 'Umar threw the pebbles he had in his hand on the ground and then said: We missed a large number of qirats.
hi: Dawud bin Amir bin Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki jab woh Abdullah bin Umar ke saath baithe the, Khabbab, Maqsura ke maalik, ne kaha: Ibn Umar, kya aap sunte hain jo Abu Huraira kehte hain ki unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: "Jo janaze ke saath uske ghar se nikalte hi jaata hai aur uske liye namaz padhta hai aur phir uske saath tab tak chalta hai jab tak use dafan na kar diya jaaye, uske liye do qirat ka sawaab hoga, har qirat Uhud ke barabar; aur jo, namaz padhne ke baad, seedhe wapas aa jaaye, uska sawaab utna bada Uhud jaisa hoga"? Ibn Umar ne Khabbab ko Aisha ke paas bheja ki unse Abu Huraira ke alfaaz ke baare mein poochein aur unhe ye bhi kaha ki unke, Ibn Umar ke, paas wapas aakar bataayein ki Aisha ne kya kaha. Isi dauran Ibn Umar ne mutthi bhar kankariyaan uthayin aur unhe apne haath mein palatte rahe yahan tak ki payaam laane wala Khabbab unke paas wapas aaya aur unhe bataya ki Aisha ne Abu Huraira ki tasdeeq ki. Ibn Umar ne apne haath mein rakhi kankariyaan zameen par phenk din aur phir kaha: Humne bahut saare qirat kho diye.

e: Thauban, the freed slave of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who offered prayer for the dead, for him is the reward of one qirat, and he who attended its burial, he would have two qirats as his reward. And qirat is equivalent to Uhud.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ke aazad kiye hue ghulam Thauban ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jisne murde ke liye namaz padhi, uske liye ek qirat ka sawaab hai, aur jo uske dafan mein shaamil raha, uske liye do qirat ka sawaab hai. Aur qirat Uhud ke barabar hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Qatada with the same chain of transmitters. And in the hadith transmitted by Sa'id and Hisham, (the words are): " The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) was asked about qirat, and he said: It is equivalent to Uhud."
hi: Ye hadees Qatada ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai. Aur Sa'id aur Hisham ki bayan ki hui hadees mein alfaaz hain: "Rasool (SAW) se qirat ke baare mein poocha gaya, aur unhone kaha: Ye Uhud ke barabar hai."

e: 'A'isha reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) saying: If a company of Muslims numbering one hundred pray over a dead person, all of them interceding for him, their intercession for him will be accepted.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Agar sau Musalmaanon ka ek giroh kisi murde ke liye namaz padhe, sab uski shafaa'at karte hue, to unki shafaa'at qubool ki jaayegi.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Abbas reported that his son died in Qudaid or 'Usfan. He said to Kuraib to see as to how many people had gathered there for his (funeral). He (Kuraib) said: So I went out and I informed him about the people who had gathered there. He (Ibn 'Abbas) said: Do you think they are forty? He (Kuraib) said: Yes. Ibn 'Abbas then said to them: Bring him (the dead body) out for I have heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If any Muslim dies and forty men who associate nothing with Allah stand over his prayer (they offer prayer over him), Allah will accept them as intercessors for him.
hi: Abdullah bin Abbas ne bayan kiya ki unke bete ka intiqaal Qudaid ya Usfan mein hua. Unhone Kuraib se kaha ki dekho wahan unke janaze mein kitne log jama hue hain. Unhone kaha: To main bahar gaya aur unhe wahan jama huye logon ke baare mein bataya. Unhone kaha: Kya aapko lagta hai woh chaalis hain? Unhone kaha: Haan. Ibn Abbas ne phir unse kaha: Unhe janaze ko bahar laao kyunki maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Agar koi Musalman intiqaal kare aur chaalis aadmi, jo Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek nahi karte, uski namaz mein khade hon, uske liye namaz padhein, to Allah unhe uske liye shafaa'at karne walon ke taur par qubool karega.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: There passed a bier (being carried by people) and it was lauded in good terms. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: It has become certain, it has become certain, it has become certain. And there passed a bier and it was condemned in bad words. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: It has become certain, it has become certain, it has become certain. 'Umar said: May my father and mother be ransom for you! There passed a bier and it was praised in good terms, and you said: It has become certain, it has become certain, it has become certain. And there passed a bier and it was condemned in bad words, and you said: It has become certain, it has become certain, it has become certain. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him) said: He whom you praised in good terms, Paradise has become certain for him, and he whom you condemned in bad words, Hell has become certain for him. You are Allah's witnesses in the earth, you are Allah's witnesses in the earth, you are Allah's witnesses in the earth.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya: Ek janaza, logon ke haathon uthaya hua, guzra aur uski achhi alfaazon mein tareef ki gayi. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Ye pakka ho gaya, ye pakka ho gaya, ye pakka ho gaya. Aur ek janaza guzra aur uski buri alfaazon mein burai ki gayi. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Ye pakka ho gaya, ye pakka ho gaya, ye pakka ho gaya. Umar ne kaha: Mere maa-baap aap par qurbaan hon! Ek janaza guzra aur uski achhi alfaazon mein tareef ki gayi, aur aapne kaha: Ye pakka ho gaya, ye pakka ho gaya, ye pakka ho gaya. Aur ek janaza guzra aur uski buri alfaazon mein burai ki gayi, aur aapne kaha: Ye pakka ho gaya, ye pakka ho gaya, ye pakka ho gaya. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Jiski tumne achhi alfaazon mein tareef ki, uske liye Jannat pakki ho gayi, aur jiski tumne buri alfaazon mein burai ki, uske liye Jahannam pakki ho gayi. Tum zameen par Allah ke gawaah ho, tum zameen par Allah ke gawaah ho, tum zameen par Allah ke gawaah ho.

e: This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Qatada b. Rib'i reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Whenever a bier passed before him, he said: He is the one to find relief and the one with (the departure of him) other will find relief. They said: Apostle of Allah, who is al-Mustarih and al-Mustarah? Upon this he said: The believing servant finds relief from the troubles of the world, and in the death of a wicked person, the people, towns, trees and animals find rellef.
hi: Qatada bin Rib'i ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab bhi koi janaza unke saamne se guzarta, woh kehte: Ye woh hai jisne aaraam paaya, aur woh hai jisse, uske jaane se, doosron ko aaraam milega. Unhone poocha: Ya Rasoolullah, al-Mustarih aur al-Mustarah kaun hain? Isper unhone kaha: Momin banda duniya ki takleefon se aaraam paata hai, aur ek buray shakhs ki maut se, log, shehar, darakht aur jaanwar sab ko aaraam milta hai.

e: In the hadith transmitted by Yahya b. Sa'id on the authority of Qatada (the words are): (The believing servant) finds relief from the troubles of the world and its hardships and (gets into) the Mercy of Allah.
hi: Yahya bin Sa'id ki, Qatada ki sanad se, bayan ki hui hadees mein alfaaz hain: Momin banda duniya ki takleefon aur mushkilon se aaraam paata hai aur Allah ki rehmat mein chala jaata hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) gave the people news of the death of Negus on the day he died, and he took them out to the place of prayer and observed four takbirs.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne logon ko Najashi, Habsha ke badshah, ki maut ki khabar di usi din jis din unka intiqaal hua, aur unhe namaz ki jagah le gaye aur char takbeeren kahin.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) gave us the news of the death of Negus, the ruler of Abyssinia, on the day when he died, and he said (to us): Beg pardon for your brother. Ibn Shihab said that Sa'id b. Musayyib had told that Abu Huraira had narrated to him that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) drew them up in a row in a place of prayer, and offered prayer and recited four takbirs for him.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne humein Najashi, Habsha ke hukmaraan, ki maut ki khabar di usi din jis din unka intiqaal hua, aur unhone humse kaha: Apne bhai ke liye maafi maango. Ibn Shihab ne kaha ki Sa'id bin Musayyib ne unhe bataya ki Abu Huraira ne unse riwayat ki ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unhe namaz ki jagah ek saf mein khada kiya, aur namaz padhi aur unke liye char takbeeren kahin.

e: This hadith is narrated through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) offered prayer for Ashama, the Negus, and recited four takbirs.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Ashama, Najashi, ke liye namaz padhi aur char takbeeren kahin.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There died today the pious servant of Allah, Ashama. So he stood up and led us in (funeral prayer) over him.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Aaj Allah ke ek nek banda, Ashama, ka intiqaal ho gaya. To woh khade hue aur unke liye janaze ki namaz mein hamari imamat ki.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: A brother of yours has died, so stand up and offer prayer over him. So we stood up and drew ourselves up into two rows.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Tumhare ek bhai ka intiqaal ho gaya hai, is liye khade ho jao aur unke liye namaz padho. To hum khade hue aur do safon mein taiyaar hue.

e: 'Imran b. Husain reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: A brother of yours has died; so stand up and offer prayer for him, i. e. Negus. And in the hadith transmitted by Zubair (the words are):" Your brother."
hi: Imran bin Husain ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Tumhare ek bhai ka intiqaal ho gaya hai; is liye khade ho jao aur unke liye namaz padho, yaani Najashi. Aur Zubair ki bayan ki hui hadees mein alfaaz hain: "Tumhara bhai."

e: Sha'bi reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed prayer over a grave after the dead was buried and he recited four takbirs over him. Shaibani said: I said to Sha'bi: Who narrated it to you? He said: An authentic one, 'Abdullah b. 'Abbas. This is the word of a hasan hadith. In the narration of Ibn Numair (the words are): The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went to the grave which had been newly prepared and prayed over it, and they also prayed who were behind him and he recited four takbirs. I said to 'Amir: Who narrated it to you? He said: An authentic one who saw him, i e. Ibn 'Abbas.
hi: Sha'bi ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne ek qabr par namaz padhi jab murda dafan ho chuka tha aur unhone uske liye char takbeeren kahin. Shaibani ne kaha: Maine Sha'bi se kaha: Ye aapko kisne bataya? Unhone kaha: Ek qaabil-e-etemaad shakhs, Abdullah bin Abbas. Ye ek hasan hadees ke alfaaz hain. Ibn Numair ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: Rasoolullah (SAW) us qabr ke paas gaye jo abhi-abhi taiyaar ki gayi thi aur uspar namaz padhi, aur unke peeche wale bhi namaz padhne lage, aur unhone char takbeeren kahin. Maine Amir se poocha: Ye aapko kisne bataya? Unhone kaha: Ek qaabil-e-etemaad shakhs jisne use dekha tha, yaani Ibn Abbas.

e: This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters, but in one of them (these words are found): " The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) recited four takbirs."
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki gayi hai, lekin unmein se ek mein ye alfaaz mile hain: "Rasoolullah (SAW) ne char takbeeren kahin."

e: The hadith as narrated by Shaibani has been narrated through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Shaibani ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Anas reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed prayer on the grave.
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne qabr par namaz padhi.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that a dark-complexioned woman (or a youth) used to sweep the mosque. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) missed her (or him) and inquired about her (or him). The people told him that she (or he) had died. He asked why they did not inform him, and it appears as if they had treated her (or him) or her (or his) affairs as of little account. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Lead me to her (or his) grave. They led him to that place and he said prayer over her (or him) and then remarked: Verily, these graves are full of darkness for their dwellers. Verily, the Mighty and Glorious Allah illuminates them for their occupants by reason of my prayer over them.
hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se riwayat hai ki ek saanwli aurat, ya jawaan larka, masjid ki safaai kiya karti thi. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne use na paakar uske baare mein poocha. Logon ne unhe bataya ki unka intiqaal ho gaya hai. Unhone poocha ki unhone unhe kyun nahi bataya, aur aisa lagta hai ki unhone unhe, unke intiqaal ko, mamooli baat samjha. Unhone kaha: Mujhe unki qabr tak le chalo. Woh unhe wahan le gaye aur unhone unke liye namaz padhi aur phir kaha: Yaqeenan, ye qabren apne rehne walon ke liye andhere se bhari hain. Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, mere namaz padhne ki wajah se inhe apne rehne walon ke liye roshan karta hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of 'Abd al-Rahman b. Abu Laila that Zaid used to recite four takbirs on our funerals and he recited five takbirs on one funeral. I asked him the reason (for this variation), to which he replied: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) recited thus.
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Laila ke hawale se riwayat hai ki Zaid hamare janazon mein char takbeeren kaha karte the aur unhone ek janaze mein paanch takbeeren kahin. Maine unse is farq ki wajah poochi, jispar unhone jawab diya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne isi tarah kahi thin.

e: It is narrated on the authority of 'Amir Ibn Rabi'a (may Allah be pleased with him) that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: Whenever you see a funeral procession, stand up for that until it moves away or is lowered on the ground.
hi: Aamir bin Rabi'a (RA) ke hawale se riwayat hai ki Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Jab bhi tum kisi janaze ke jalus ko dekho, tab tak khade raho jab tak woh nikal na jaaye ya zameen par rakh na diya jaaye.

e: It is narrated on the authority of 'Amir ibn Rabi'a (may Allah be pleased with him) that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: Should any one of you come across a funeral procession, and if he does not intend to accompany it, he must stand up until it passes by him or is placed upon the ground before it passes him.
hi: Aamir bin Rabi'a (RA) ke hawale se riwayat hai ki Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Agar tum mein se koi kisi janaze ke jalus ke saamne aaye, aur agar uska iske saath jaane ka irada na ho, to use tab tak khada rehna chahiye jab tak woh uske paas se guzar na jaaye ya zameen par rakh na diya jaaye guzarne se pehle.

e: It is reported on the authority of Ibn Juraij that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: Should anyone amongst you see a bier he must stand up so long as it is within sight in case he does not intend to follow it.
hi: Ibn Juraij ke hawale se riwayat hai ki Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Agar tum mein se koi janaza dekhe to use tab tak khada rehna chahiye jab tak woh nazar mein rahe, agar uska iske saath jaane ka irada na ho.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Sa'id al-Khudri that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: When you follow a bier, do not sit until it is placed on the (ground).
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ke hawale se riwayat hai ki Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Jab tum janaze ke saath jao, to tab tak na baitho jab tak use zameen par rakh na diya jaaye.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Sa'id al-Khudri that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: Whenever you come across a bier you should stand up, and he who follows it should not sit down till it is placed on the ground.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ke hawale se riwayat hai ki Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Jab bhi tum kisi janaze ka saamna karo tumhe khada hona chahiye, aur jo iske saath jaaye use tab tak nahi baithna chahiye jab tak use zameen par rakh na diya jaaye.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Jabir ibn 'Abdullah: There passed a bier and the Prophet (ﷺ) stood up for it and we also stood up along with him. We said: Messenger of Allah, that was the bier of a Jewess. Upon this he remarked: Verily, death is a matter of consternation, so whenever you come across a bier stand up.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ke hawale se riwayat hai: Ek janaza guzra aur Nabi (SAW) uske liye khade huye aur hum bhi unke saath khade huye. Humne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, ye ek Yahudi aurat ka janaza tha. Isper unhone kaha: Yaqeenan, maut ek dahla dene wali baat hai, is liye jab bhi tum kisi janaze ka saamna karo, khade ho jao.

e: Ibn Juraij told me that Abu Zubair heard Jabir say that the Prophet (ﷺ) kept standing for a bier until it disappeared.
hi: Ibn Juraij ne mujhe bataya ki Abu Zubair ne Jabir ko kehte suna ki Nabi (SAW) ek janaze ke liye tab tak khade rahe jab tak woh gaayab na ho gaya.

e: Again Abu Zubair heard Jabir say that the Prophet (ﷺ) and his Companions kept standing for a bier of a Jew until it disappeared from sight.
hi: Abu Zubair ne dobara Jabir ko kehte suna ki Nabi (SAW) aur unke sahaba ek Yahudi ke janaze ke liye tab tak khade rahe jab tak woh nazron se ojhal na ho gaya.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Ibn Abu Laila that while Qais b. Sa'd and Sahl b. Hunaif were both in Qadislyya a bier passed by them and they both stood up. They were told that it was the bier of one of the people of the land (non-Muslim). They said that a bier passed before the Prophet (ﷺ) and he stood up. He was told that he (the dead man) was a Jew. Upon this he remarked: Was he not a human being or did he not have a soul? And in the hadith narrated by 'Amr b. Murra with the same chain of transmitters, (the words) are:" There passed a bier before us."
hi: Ibn Abu Laila ke hawale se riwayat hai ki jab Qais bin Sa'd aur Sahl bin Hunaif dono Qadisiyya mein the, ek janaza unke paas se guzra aur dono khade ho gaye. Unhe bataya gaya ki ye zameen ke logon mein se ek ka janaza tha, ghair-Musalman. Unhone kaha ki ek janaza Nabi (SAW) ke saamne se guzra aur woh khade huye. Unhe bataya gaya ki woh murda ek Yahudi tha. Isper unhone kaha: Kya woh ek insaan nahi tha, ya uski koi rooh nahi thi? Aur Amr bin Murra ki isi sanad se bayan ki hui hadees mein alfaaz hain: "Hamare saamne se ek janaza guzra."

e: It is narrated on the authority of Waqid: Nafi' b. Jubair saw me and we were standing for a bier, while he was sitting and waiting for the bier to be placed on the ground. He said to me: What makes you keep standing? I said: I am waiting that the bier may be placed on the ground (and I am doing that) on the hadith narrated to me by Abu Sa'id al-Khudri. Upon this Nafi' said: Verily, Mas'ud b. Hakam reported to me on the authority of Hadrat 'Ali b. Abu Talib that the Prophet (ﷺ) stood up first (for a bier) and then sat down.
hi: Waqid ke hawale se riwayat hai: Nafi bin Jubair ne mujhe dekha aur hum ek janaze ke liye khade the, jabki woh baithe hue janaze ka zameen par rakhe jaane ka intezaar kar rahe the. Unhone mujhse kaha: Tumhe kya cheez khade rehne par majboor karti hai? Maine kaha: Main intezaar kar raha hoon ki janaza zameen par rakh diya jaaye, aur main ye Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ki bayan ki hui hadees par kar raha hoon. Isper Nafi ne kaha: Yaqeenan, Mas'ud bin Hakam ne mujhe Hazrat Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ke hawale se bataya ki Nabi (SAW) pehle janaze ke liye khade hote aur phir baith jaate the.

e: Mas'ud b. al-Hakam al-Ansari informed Nafi' that he had heard Hadrat 'Ali (may Allah be pleased with him), son of Abu Talib, say about the biers: Verily, the Prophet (ﷺ) used to stand first but later on kept sitting; but it is also narrated that Nafi' ibn Jubair saw Waqid b. 'Amr standing for a bier till it was placed down.
hi: Mas'ud bin al-Hakam al-Ansari ne Nafi ko bataya ki unhone Hazrat Ali (Alayhis Salam), Abu Talib ke bete, ko janaazon ke baare mein ye kehte suna: Yaqeenan, Nabi (SAW) pehle khade hote lekin baad mein baithe rehte the; lekin ye bhi riwayat ki gayi hai ki Nafi bin Jubair ne Waqid bin Amr ko ek janaze ke liye khade dekha tha jab tak use zameen par rakh na diya gaya.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Yahya b. Sa'id with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Yahya bin Sa'id ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Muhammad b. Munkadir that he said: I heard from Mas'ud b. al-Hakam who narrated it on the authority of Hadrat 'Ali that he said: We saw the Prophet (ﷺ) stood up for a (bier) and we also stood up; he sat down and we too sat down.
hi: Muhammad bin Munkadir ke hawale se riwayat hai ki unhone kaha: Maine Mas'ud bin al-Hakam se suna jinhone Hazrat Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke hawale se riwayat ki ki unhone kaha: Humne Nabi (SAW) ko ek janaze ke liye khade dekha aur hum bhi khade ho gaye; woh baith gaye aur hum bhi baith gaye.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: Jubair b. Nufair says: I heard it from 'Auf b. Malik that the Prophet (ﷺ) said prayer on the dead body, and I remembered his prayer:" O Allah! forgive him, have mercy upon him, give him peace and absolve him. Receive him with honour and make his grave spacious; wash him with water, snow and hail. Cleanse him from faults as Thou wouldst cleanse a white garment from impurity. Requite him with an abode more excellent than his abode, with a family better than his family, and with a mate better than his mate. Admit him to the Garden, and protect him from the torment of the grave and the torment of the Fire." ('Auf bin Malik) said: I earnestly desired that I were this dead body.
hi: Jubair bin Nufair kehte hain: Maine Auf bin Malik se ye suna ki Nabi (SAW) ne murde ke jism par namaz padhi, aur mujhe unki dua yaad hai: "Aye Allah! Ise maaf farma, ispar rahem farma, ise salaamati de aur ise bakhsh de. Ise izzat ke saath qubool farma aur uski qabr ko kushaada bana de; use paani, baraf aur olon se dho de. Ise gunahon se aise paak kar jaise Tu ek safed kapde ko gandagi se saaf karta hai. Iski jagah, uski jagah se behtar de, iske gharwalon se behtar gharwale de, aur iske jeevansaathi se behtar jeevansaathi de. Ise Jannat mein daakhil kar, aur ise qabr ke azaab aur jahannam ke azaab se bacha." Auf bin Malik ne kaha: Maine dil se chaha ki kaash main hi ye murda hota.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki gayi hai.

e: 'Anas b. Malik said: I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) say (while offering prayer on a dead body): O Allah! forgive him, have mercy upon him. Give him peace and absolve him. Receive him with honour and make his grave spacious. Wash him with water, snow and hail, cleanse him from faults as is cleaned a white garment from impurity. Requite him with an abode more excellent than his abode, with a family better than his family, and with a mate better than his mate, and save him from the trial of the grave and torment of Hell. 'Auf b. Malik said: I earnestly desired that I were the dead person to receive the prayer of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as this dead body had (received).
hi: Anas bin Malik ne kaha: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko murde ke jism par namaz padhte hue ye kehte suna: Aye Allah! Ise maaf farma, ispar rahem farma. Ise salaamati de aur ise bakhsh de. Ise izzat ke saath qubool farma aur uski qabr ko kushaada bana de. Use paani, baraf aur olon se dho de, ise gunahon se aise paak kar jaise ek safed kapda gandagi se saaf kiya jaata hai. Iski jagah, uski jagah se behtar de, iske gharwalon se behtar gharwale de, aur iske jeevansaathi se behtar jeevansaathi de, aur ise qabr ki aazmaish aur jahannam ke azaab se bacha. Auf bin Malik ne kaha: Maine dil se chaha ki kaash main woh murda hota jise Rasoolullah (SAW) ki ye dua mili jaisi is murde ko mili.

e: Samura b. Jundub said: I prayed behind the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he prayed for a woman who had died in the state of delivery. He stood in front of her waist.
hi: Samura bin Jundub ne kaha: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ke peeche namaz padhi aur unhone ek aisi aurat ke liye namaz padhi jo bacche ki paidaish ke daur mein guzar gayi thin. Woh unki kamar ke saamne khade huye.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Husain with the same chain of transmitters, but no mention is made of Umm Ka'b.
hi: Ye hadees Husain ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai, lekin Umm Ka'b ka koi zikr nahi kiya gaya.

e: Samura b. Jundub said: I was a young boy during the time of the Prophet (ﷺ) and I retained in my mind (what I learnt from him), and nothing restrained me from speaking except the fact that there were persons far more advanced in age than I. Verily, I said prayer behind the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) over a woman who had died in the state of delivery, and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stood up to say prayer in front of the middle part of her body. And in the tradition narrated on the authority of Ibn Muthanna the words are:" (The Holy Prophet) stood in the middle part of her body for offering prayer for her."
hi: Samura bin Jundub ne kaha: Main Nabi (SAW) ke daur mein ek chhota larka tha aur jo maine unse seekha use apne zehan mein rakha, aur mujhe bolne se sirf is liye roka gaya kyunki mujhse umar mein bahut aage log maujood the. Yaqeenan, maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ke peeche namaz padhi ek aisi aurat ke liye jo bacche ki paidaish ke daur mein guzar gayin, aur Rasoolullah (SAW) unke badan ke beech wale hisse ke saamne unke liye namaz padhne ke liye khade hue. Aur Ibn Muthanna ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: "Nabi (SAW) unke badan ke beech wale hisse mein khade hokar unke liye namaz padhi."

e: It is reported on the authority of Jabir ibn Samura that an unsaddled horse was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he rode on it when he returned after having offered the funeral prayer of Ibn Dahdah and we walked on foot around him.
hi: Jabir bin Samura ke hawale se riwayat hai ki Nabi (SAW) ke paas ek bina zeen wala ghoda laaya gaya aur woh uspar sawaar hue jab woh Ibn Dahdah ke janaze ki namaz padhkar wapas aa rahe the aur hum unke aas-paas paidal chal rahe the.
