e: Jabir ibn Samura reported that the Prophet (ﷺ) said (funeral) prayer on Ibn Dahdah: then an unsaddled horse was brought to him and a person hobbled it, and he (the Messenger of Allah) rode upon it and it bounded and we followed it and ran after it. One of the people said that the Prophet (ﷺ) remarked: How many among hanging bunches in the Paradise are meant for Ibn Dahdah?
hi: Jabir bin Samura ne bayan kiya ki Nabi (SAW) ne Ibn Dahdah ke liye janaze ki namaz padhi; phir unke paas ek bina zeen wala ghoda laaya gaya aur ek shakhs ne uski taangein baandhin, aur unhone usper sawaari ki aur woh uchalne laga aur hum uske peeche chale aur uske peeche daude. Logon mein se ek ne kaha ki Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Jannat mein latakte huye guchchon mein se kitne guchche Ibn Dahdah ke liye hain?

e: 'Amir b. Sa'd b. Abu Waqqas told that Sa'd b. Abu Waqqas said during his illness of which he died: " Make a niche for me in the side of the grave and set up bricks over me as was done in case of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).
hi: Aamir bin Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas ne bataya ki Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas ne apni us beemari ke dauran jismein unka intiqaal hua, kaha: "Meri qabr ke ek taraf ek darza, lahad, bana do aur mujhpar eenten uthaa do, jaisa Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke maamle mein kiya gaya tha."

e: Ibn 'Abbas said that a piece of red stuff was put in the grave of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).
hi: Ibn Abbas ne kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki qabr mein ek laal kapde ka tukda rakha gaya.

e: Thumama b. Shafayy reported: When we were with Fadala b. 'Ubaid in the country of the Romans at a place (known as) Rudis, a friend of ours died. Fadala b. 'Ubaid ordered to prepare a grave for him and then it was levelled; and then he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commanding (us) to level the grave.
hi: Thumama bin Shafayy ne bayan kiya: Jab hum Fadala bin Ubaid ke saath Rome ke ilaake mein, ek jagah jise Rudis kaha jaata hai, the, hamara ek dost intiqaal kar gaya. Fadala bin Ubaid ne unke liye ek qabr taiyaar karne ka hukum diya aur phir use barabar kar diya gaya; aur phir unhone kaha: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko qabr ko barabar karne ka hukum dete suna.

e: Abu'l-Hayyaj al-Asadi told that 'Ali (b. Abu Talib) said to him: Should I not send you on the same mission as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent me? Do not leave an image without obliterating it, or a high grave without levelling It. This hadith has been reported by Habib with the same chain of transmitters and he said: (Do not leave) a picture without obliterating it.
hi: Abu'l-Hayyaj al-Asadi ne bataya ki Ali (Alayhis Salam), bin Abu Talib, ne unse kaha: Kya main tumhe usi kaam par na bhejun jispar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe bheja tha? Koi bhi murti bina mitaaye na chhodo, ya koi bhi buland qabr bina barabar kiye na chhodo. Ye hadees Habib ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai aur unhone kaha: Na chhodo koi tasveer bina mitaaye.

e: Jabir said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade that the graves should be plastered or they be used as sitting places (for the people), or a building should be built over them.
hi: Jabir ne kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne mana kiya ki qabron par plaster, chuna, laga diya jaaye ya unhe logon ke baithne ki jagah banaya jaaye, ya unpar koi imaarat banayi jaaye.

e: A hadith like this has been transmitted on the authority of Jabir b. 'Abdullah.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Jabir bin Abdullah ki sanad se bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Jabir said that he was forbidden to plaster graves.
hi: Jabir ne kaha ki unhe qabron par plaster lagaane se mana kiya gaya tha.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: It is better that one of you should sit on live coals which would burn his clothing and come in contact with his skin than that he should sit on a grave.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Tum mein se kisi ke liye behtar hoga ki woh dahakte huye koyle par baithe jo uske kapdon ko jala den aur uski khaal tak pahunch jaayein, bajaye is ke ki woh kisi qabr par baithe.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated by Suhail with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Suhail ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: Abu Marthad al-Ghanawi reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Do not sit on the graves and do not pray facing towards them.
hi: Abu Marthad al-Ghanawi ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Qabron par mat baitho aur unki taraf mooh karke namaz mat padho.

e: Abu Marthad al-Ghanawi reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Do not pray facing towards the graves, and do not sit on them.
hi: Abu Marthad al-Ghanawi ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Qabron ki taraf mooh karke namaz mat padho, aur unpar mat baitho.

e: 'Abbad b. 'Abdullah b. Zubair reported that 'A'isha ordered the bier of Sa'd b. Abu Waqqas to be brought into the mosque so that she should pray for him. The people disapproved this (act) of hers. She said: How soon the people have forgotten that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) offered not the funeral prayer of Suhail b al-Baida' but in a mosque.
hi: Abbad bin Abdullah bin Zubair ne bayan kiya ki Aisha (RA) ne Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas ke janaze ko masjid mein laane ka hukum diya taaki woh unke liye namaz padh sakein. Logon ne unke is amal ko napasand kiya. Unhone kaha: Log kitni jaldi ye bhool gaye ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Suhail bin al-Baida ki janaze ki namaz masjid mein hi padhi thi.

e: 'Abbad b. 'Abdullah b. Zubair reported on the authority of 'A'isha that when Sa'd b. Abu Waqqas died, the wives of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent message to bring his bier into the mosque so that they should offer prayer for him. They (the participants of the funeral) did accordingly, and it was placed in front of their apartments and they offered prayer for him. It was brought out of the door (known as) Bab al-Jana'iz which was towards the side of Maqa'id, and the news reached them (the wives of the Holy Prophet) that the people bad criticised this (i. e. offering of funeral prayer in the mosque) saying that it was not desirable to take the bier inside the mosque. This was conveyed to 'A'isha. She said: How hastily the people criticise that about which they know little. They criticise us for carrying the bier in the mosque. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) offered not the funeral prayer of Suhail b. Baida' but in the innermost part of the mosque.
hi: Abbad bin Abdullah bin Zubair ne Aisha ke hawale se riwayat ki ki jab Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas ka intiqaal hua, to Rasoolullah (SAW) ki zaujaon ne unke janaze ko masjid mein laane ka sandesh bheja taaki woh unke liye namaz padh sakein. Unhone, janaze mein shaamil logon ne, aisa hi kiya, aur use unke kamron ke saamne rakha gaya aur unhone unke liye namaz padhi. Ise Bab al-Jana'iz naam ke darwaze se, jo Maqa'id ki taraf tha, bahar le jaaya gaya, aur unhe khabar mili ki logon ne is masjid mein janaze ki namaz padhne ki aalochana ki ye kehte hue ki janaze ko masjid ke andar le jaana munaasib nahi tha. Ye Aisha tak pahunchaaya gaya. Unhone kaha: Log kitni jaldi us baat ki aalochana karte hain jiske baare mein unhe kam pata hota hai. Woh hamari aalochana karte hain masjid mein janaza le jaane ki. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Suhail bin Baida ke do beton, yaani Suhail aur unke bhai, ki janaze ki namaz masjid ke andaruni hisse mein hi padhi thi.

e: Abu Salama b. 'Abd al-Rahman reported on the authority ot 'A'isha that when Sa'd b. Abu Waqqas died she said: Bring it (the bier) into the mosque so that I offer prayer for him. But, this act of hers was disapproved. She said: By Allah, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) offered prayer in the mosque for the two sons of Baida', viz, for Suhail and his brother.
hi: Abu Salama bin Abdur-Rahman ne Aisha ke hawale se riwayat ki ki jab Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas ka intiqaal hua to unhone kaha: Ise masjid mein le aao taaki main unke liye namaz padhun. Lekin unke is amal ki aalochana ki gayi. Unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Baida ke do beton, yaani Suhail aur unke bhai, ke liye masjid mein namaz padhi thi.

e: 'A'isha reported (that whenever it was her turn for Allah's Messenger  to spend the night with her) he would go out towards the end of the night to al-Baqi' and say: Peace be upon you, abode of a people who are believers. What you were promised would come to you tomorrow, you receiving it after some delay; and God willing we shall join you. O Allah, grant forgiveness to the inhabitants of Baqi' al-Gharqad. Qutaiba did not mention his words:" would come to you".
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya, ki jab bhi Rasoolullah (SAW) ki unke saath raat guzarne ki baari hoti, to woh raat ke aakhri hisse mein al-Baqi ki taraf jaate aur kehte: Tumpar salaamati ho, momino ke ghar walo. Jiska tumse wada kiya gaya hai woh kal tumhare paas aayega, tumhe ye kuch der ke baad milega; aur Allah chahe to hum bhi tumse aa milenge. Aye Allah, Baqi al-Gharqad ke rehne walon ko maafi ata farma. Qutaiba ne unke alfaaz "tumhare paas aayega" ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: Muhammad b. Qais said (to the people): Should I not narrate to you (a hadith of the Holy Prophet) on my authority and on the authority of my mother? We thought that he meant the mother who had given him birth. He (Muhammad b. Qais) then reported that it was 'A'isha who had narrated this: Should I not narrate to you about myself and about the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)? We said: Yes. She said: When it was my turn for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to spend the night with me, he turned his side, put on his mantle and took off his shoes and placed them near his feet, and spread the corner of his shawl on his bed and then lay down till he thought that I had gone to sleep. He took hold of his mantle slowly and put on the shoes slowly, and opened the door and went out and then closed it lightly. I covered my head, put on my veil and tightened my waist wrapper, and then went out following his steps till he reached Baqi'. He stood there and he stood for a long time. He then lifted his hands three times, and then returned and I also returned. He hastened his steps and I also hastened my steps. He ran and I too ran. He came (to the house) and I also came (to the house). I, however, preceded him and I entered (the house), and as I lay down in the bed, he (the Holy Prophet) entered the (house), and said: Why is it, O 'A'isha, that you are out of breath? I said: There is nothing. He said: Tell me or the Subtle and the Aware would inform me. I said: Messenger of Allah, may my father and mother be ransom for you, and then I told him (the whole story). He said: Was it the darkness (of your shadow) that I saw in front of me? I said: Yes. He gave me a nudge on the chest which I felt, and then said: Did you think that Allah and His Apostle would deal unjustly with you? She said: Whatsoever the people conceal, Allah will know it. He said: Gabriel came to me when you saw me. He called me and he concealed it from you. I responded to his call, but I too concealed it from you (for he did not come to you), as you were not fully dressed. I thought that you had gone to sleep, and I did not like to awaken you, fearing that you may be frightened. He (Gabriel) said: Your Lord has commanded you to go to the inhabitants of Baqi' (to those lying in the graves) and beg pardon for them. I said: Messenger of Allah, how should I pray for them (How should I beg forgiveness for them)? He said: Say, Peace be upon the inhabitants of this city (graveyard) from among the Believers and the Muslims, and may Allah have mercy on those who have gone ahead of us, and those who come later on, and we shall, God willing, join you.
hi: Muhammad bin Qais ne logon se kaha: Kya main tumhe apni aur apni maa ki riwayat na sunaun? Humein laga ki unka matlab unki asal maa se hai jinhone unhe paida kiya tha. Unhone phir bataya ki ye Aisha thin jinhone ye riwayat ki thi: Kya main tumhe apne aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ke baare mein na batau? Humne kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha: Jab Rasoolullah (SAW) ki mere saath raat guzarne ki baari thi, to woh apni karvat badalte, apni chadar odhi, apne joote utaare aur apne paon ke qareeb rakhe, aur apni chadar ka konaa apne bistar par phailaya aur phir let gaye yahan tak ki unhe laga ki main so gayi hoon. Unhone dheere se apni chadar uthayi aur dheere se apne joote pehne, aur darwaza khola aur bahar gaye aur phir usse halke se band kiya. Maine apna sar dhaanka, apna niqab pehna aur apni kamar ki chadar tang ki, aur phir unke kadmon ka peecha karte hue bahar gayi yahan tak ki woh Baqi pahunche. Woh wahan khade huye aur lambe waqt tak khade rahe. Phir unhone teen baar apne haath uthaye, aur phir wapas mude aur main bhi wapas mudi. Unhone apni raftaar tez ki aur maine bhi apni raftaar tez ki. Woh daude aur main bhi daudi. Woh ghar aaye aur main bhi aayi. Main, halaanki, unse pehle ghar mein daakhil ho gayi, aur jaise main bistar par leti, woh andar aaye aur kaha: Aye Aisha, kya baat hai ki tumhari saans phool rahi hai? Maine kaha: Kuch nahi. Unhone kaha: Mujhe bataao warna Allah, jo Baareek-bin aur Khabardaar hai, mujhe bata dega. Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, mere maa-baap aap par qurbaan hon, aur phir maine unhe poora waaqiya bataya. Unhone kaha: Kya woh andhera, jo teri parchhaayi jaisa tha, tha jo maine apne saamne dekha tha? Maine kaha: Haan. Unhone mere seene par ek dhakka diya jo maine mahsoos kiya, aur phir kaha: Kya tumhe laga ki Allah aur uske Rasool tumhare saath naa-insaafi karenge? Unhone kaha: Log jo bhi chhupaate hain, Allah use zaroor jaanta hai. Unhone kaha: Jibra'eel mere paas aaye jab tumne mujhe dekha. Unhone mujhe bulaya aur ise tumse chhupaya. Maine unki pukaar ka jawab diya, lekin maine bhi ise tumse chhupaya, kyunki tum poori tarah kapde pehne nahi thi. Mujhe laga ki tum so gayi ho, aur mujhe tumhe jagana pasand nahi tha, is dar se ki kahin tum dar na jao. Unhone kaha: Tumhare Rab ne tumhe hukum diya hai ki tum Baqi ke rehne walon, qabron mein pade logon, ke paas jao aur unke liye maafi maango. Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, main unke liye kaise dua karun? Unhone kaha: Kaho, Salaamati ho is shehar, qabristan, ke rehne walon par, momino aur Musalmaano mein se, aur Allah un logon par rehmat kare jo humse pehle guzar gaye, aur jo baad mein aayenge, aur hum, Allah chahe to, tumse aa milenge.

e: Sulaiman b. Buraida narrated on the authority of his father that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to teach them when they went out to the graveyard. One of the narrators used to say this in the narration transmitted on the authority of Abu Bakr: " Peace be upon the inhabitants of the city (i. e. graveyard)." In the hadith transmitted by Zuhair (the words are):" Peace be upon you, the inhabitants of the city, among the believers, and Muslims, and God willing we shall join you. I beg of Allah peace for us and for you."
hi: Sulaiman bin Buraida ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Rasoolullah (SAW) unhe ye sikhaya karte the jab woh qabristan jaate the. Ek raawi Abu Bakr ki riwayat mein ye kaha karte the: "Salaamati ho is shehar, yaani qabristan, ke rehne walon par." Zuhair ki bayan ki hui hadees mein alfaaz hain: "Tumpar salaamati ho, is shehar ke rehne walo, momino, aur Musalmano mein se, aur Allah chahe to hum tumse aa milenge. Main Allah se apne aur tumhare liye salaamati maangta hoon."

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger, (ﷺ) as saying: I sought permission to beg forgiveness for my mother, but He did not grant it to me. I sought permission from Him to visit her grave, and He granted it (permission) to me.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Maine apni maa ke liye maafi maangne ki ijazat maangi, lekin Usne mujhe woh nahi di. Maine Usse unki qabr ki ziyarat karne ki ijazat maangi, aur Usne ijazat mujhe de di.

e: Abu Huraira reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) visited the grave of his mother and he wept, and moved others around him to tears, and said: I sought permission from my Lord to beg forgiveness for her but it was not granted to me, and I sought permission to visit her grave and it was granted to me so visit the graves, for that makes you mindful of death.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya: Rasool (SAW) ne apni maa ki qabr ki ziyarat ki aur woh rone lage, aur unke aas-paas ke logon ko bhi rulaaya, aur kaha: Maine apne Rab se apni maa ke liye maafi maangne ki ijazat maangi lekin ye mujhe nahi di gayi, aur maine unki qabr ki ziyarat ki ijazat maangi aur ye mujhe de di gayi, is liye qabron ki ziyarat karo, kyunki ye tumhe maut ki yaad dilaati hai.

e: Ibn Buraida reported on the authority of his father that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: I forbade you to visit graves, but you may now visit them; I forbade you to eat the flesh of sacrificial animals after three days, but you way now keep it as along as you feel inclined; and I forbade you nabidh except in a water-skin, you may drink it from all kinds of water-skins, but you must not drink anything intoxicating.
hi: Ibn Buraida ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Maine tumhe qabron ki ziyarat karne se mana kiya tha, lekin ab tum unki ziyarat kar sakte ho; maine tumhe teen din ke baad qurbaani ke jaanwar ka gosht khaane se mana kiya tha, lekin ab tum ise jab tak chaho rakh sakte ho; aur maine tumhe mashk ke ilawa kisi aur bartan mein nabidh, khajoor ya angoor ka ras, rakhne se mana kiya tha, tum ise kisi bhi tarah ke mashk mein pee sakte ho, lekin tumhe koi bhi nasha wali cheez nahi peeni chahiye.

e: This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Jabir b. Samura reported: (The dead body) of a person who had killed himself with a broad-headed arrow was brought before the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), but he did not offer prayers for him.
hi: Jabir bin Samura ne bayan kiya: Ek shakhs ka jism, jisne khud ko chaude sar wale teer se maar liya tha, Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saamne laaya gaya, lekin unhone uske liye namaz nahi padhi.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) as saying: No sadaqa (zakat) is payable on less than five wasqs of (dates or grains), on less than five camel-heads and on less than five uqiyas (of silver).
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Paanch wasq, khajoor ya anaaj, se kam, paanch oont ke sar se kam, aur paanch uqiya, chandi, se kam par koi sadaqa, zakaat, nahi hai.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated by 'Amr b. Yahya with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Amr bin Yahya ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: 'Umara reported: I heard Abd Sa'id al-Khudri as saying that he had heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) make (this) observation with a gesture of his five fingers, and then he narrated the hadith as transmitted by 'Uyaina (hadith 2134).
hi: Umara ne bayan kiya: Maine Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ko ye kehte suna ki unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye baat apni paanch ungliyon ke ishare ke saath kehte suna, aur phir unhone hadees bayan ki jaisi Uyaina ne riwayat ki thi.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: No Sadaqa (zakat) is due on less than five wasqs of (dates or grains), on less than five camel-heads, and on less than five uqiyas (of silver).
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Paanch wasq, khajoor ya anaaj, se kam, paanch oont ke sar se kam, aur paanch uqiya, chandi, se kam par koi sadaqa, zakaat, laazim nahi hai.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: No Sadaqa is payable on less than five wasqs of dates or grains.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Paanch wasq khajoor ya anaaj se kam par koi sadaqa nahi hai.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: No Sadaqa is payable on the grains and dates till it (comes to the Weight) of five wasqs, or less than five heads of camels, or less than five uqiyas (of silver).
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Anaaj aur khajoor par koi sadaqa laazim nahi hai jab tak ye paanch wasq ke wazan tak na pahunche, ya paanch oont ke sar se kam par, ya paanch uqiya chandi se kam par.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated by Isma'il b. Umayya with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Ismail bin Umayya ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated by Isma'il b. Umayya with the same chain of transmitters, but instead of the word dates, fruit has been used.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Ismail bin Umayya ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai, lekin "khajoor" ki jagah "phal" lafz istemal hua hai.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: No Sadaqa is payable on less than five fiqiyas of silver, and on less than five heads of camels, and less than five wasqs of dates.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Paanch uqiya chandi se kam, aur paanch oont ke sar se kam, aur paanch wasq khajoor se kam par koi sadaqa laazim nahi hai.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: A tenth is payable on what is watered by rivers, or rains, and a twentieth on what is watered by camels.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo zameen nadiyon ya baarish se sinchi jaati hai uspar dasvaan hissa, zakaat, laazim hai, aur jo oonton ki madad se sinchi jaati hai uspar bisvaan hissa.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messsenger (ﷺ) as saying: No Sadaqa is due from a Muslim on his slave or horse.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Musalman par apne ghulam ya ghode par koi sadaqa laazim nahi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: No Sadaqa is due from a Muslim on his slave or horse.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Musalman par apne ghulam ya ghode par koi sadaqa laazim nahi hai.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated by Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Abu Huraira ne ek doosri sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There is no Sadaqa on a slave except Sadaqat-ul-Fitr.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ghulam par koi sadaqa laazim nahi hai siwaay Sadaqat-ul-Fitr ke.

e: Abu Huraira reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent Umar for (collecting) Sadaqa (zakat), and it was said that Ibn Jamil, Khalid b. Walid and 'Abbas the uncle of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), refused (to pay it). Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Ibn Jamil is taking revenge but for this that he was destitute and Allah made him rich. As regards Khalid, you are unjust to Khalid, for be reserved his armours and weapons for the sake of Allah, and as for 'Abbas, I shall be responsible for it and an equal amount along with it. And he again said: 'Umar, bear this in mind, the uncle of a person is like his father.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Umar ko sadaqa, zakaat, jama karne ke liye bheja, aur kaha gaya ki Ibn Jamil, Khalid bin Walid, aur Abbas, Rasoolullah (SAW) ke chacha, ne ise dene se inkaar kiya. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Ibn Jamil badla le raha hai sirf is liye kyunki woh nirdhan tha aur Allah ne use maaldaar bana diya. Jahan tak Khalid ka sawal hai, tum Khalid ke saath naa-insaafi kar rahe ho, kyunki unhone apne hathiyaar aur zire Allah ki raah ke liye rakh chhode hain, aur jahan tak Abbas ka sawal hai, main iski zimmedaari lunga aur uske saath ek barabar raqam bhi. Aur unhone phir kaha: Umar, ye baat yaad rakho, kisi shakhs ka chacha uske waalid jaisa hota hai.

e: Ibn Umar said that Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) prescribed the payment of Zakat-ul-Fitr (on breaking the fast) of Ramadan for people, for every freeman, or slave, male and female among the Muslims-one sa' of dried dates, or one sa' of barley.
hi: Ibn Umar ne kaha ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Ramzan ke roze khatam karte waqt mein Zakaat-ul-Fitr ada karne ka hukum diya logon ke liye, har azaad shakhs ya ghulam, mard ya aurat, Musalmaanon mein - ek sa sukhi khajoor, ya ek sa jau.

e: Ibn 'Umar said that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prescribed Zakat-ul-Fitr one sa' of dates or one sa' of barley for every slave or freeman, young or old.
hi: Ibn Umar ne kaha ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Zakaat-ul-Fitr muqarrar ki, ek sa khajoor ya ek sa jau, har ghulam ya azaad, jawaan ya boodhe ke liye.

e: Ibn 'Umar said that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prescribed the Sadaqa of Ramadan (Sadaqat-al-Fitr) one sa' of dates or one sa' of barley for every free man or a slave, male or female, and then the people equalised (one sa' of dates or barley) with half a sa' of wheat.
hi: Ibn Umar ne kaha ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Ramzan ka sadaqa, Sadaqat-al-Fitr, muqarrar ki, ek sa khajoor ya ek sa jau, har azaad shakhs ya ghulam, mard ya aurat ke liye, aur phir logon ne ek sa khajoor ya jau ko aadhe sa gehun ke barabar mana.

e: Abdullah b. Umar reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ordered the (payment of) Zakat-ul-Fitr one sa' of dates, or one sa' of barley. Ibn 'Umar ('Abdullah b. 'Umar) further said: The people equalised it (then) with two mudds of fine wheat.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Zakaat-ul-Fitr, ek sa khajoor, ya ek sa jau, ada karne ka hukum diya. Ibn Umar ne aage kaha: Logon ne phir ise do mudd behtareen gehun ke barabar mana.

e: Ibn Umar reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prescribed Zakat-ul-Fitr of Ramadan one sa' of dates or one sa' of barley for every individual among the Muslims (whether) free man or slave, male or female, young or old.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Ramzan ki Zakaat-ul-Fitr muqarrar ki, ek sa khajoor ya ek sa jau, Musalmaanon mein se har shakhs ke liye, chahe azaad ho ya ghulam, mard ho ya aurat, jawaan ho ya boodha.

e: Sad b. Abu Sarh heard Abu Sa'id al-Khudri as saying: We used to take out as the Zakat of Fitr one sa' of grain, or one sa' of barley or one sa' of dates, or one sa' of cheese or one sa' of raisins.
hi: Sa'd bin Abu Sarh ne Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ko ye kehte suna: Hum Fitr ki Zakaat mein ek sa anaaj, ya ek sa jau, ya ek sa khajoor, ya ek sa panir, ya ek sa kishmish nikala karte the.

e: Abd Sa'id al-Khudri reported: We, on behalf of every young or old, free man or slave (amongst us), used to take out during the lifetime of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as the Zakat of Fitr one sa' of grain, or one sa' of cheese or one sa' of raisins. And we continued taking out these till Mu'awiya b. Abu Sufyan came to us for pilgrimage or 'Umra, and addressed the people on the pulpit and said to them: I see that two mudds of zakat out of the wheat (red) of Syria is equal to one sa' of dates. So the people accepted it. But Abu Sa'id said: I would continue to take out as I used to take out (before, i e. one sa') as long as I live.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne bayan kiya: Hum, har jawaan ya boodhe, azaad ya ghulam ki taraf se, Rasoolullah (SAW) ke daur mein Fitr ki Zakaat mein ek sa anaaj, ya ek sa panir ya ek sa kishmish nikala karte the. Aur hum ye nikalte rahe yahan tak ki Muawiya bin Abu Sufyan Hajj ya Umra ke liye hamare paas aaye, aur mimbar par logon se khitaab kiya aur unse kaha: Mujhe lagta hai ki Syria ke gehun, laal wale, ka do mudd zakaat ek sa khajoor ke barabar hai. To logon ne ise qubool kar liya. Lekin Abu Sa'id ne kaha: Main jab tak zinda rahunga wahi nikalta rahunga jo pehle nikala karta tha, yaani ek sa.

e: Sa'd b. Abu Sarh heard Abu Sa'id al-Khudri as saying: We, on behalf of young or old, free or slave, used to take out the Zakat of Fitr while the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) was among us, in three kinds, one sa' of dates, one sa' of cheese, or one sa' of barley, and we continued to take that out till the time of Mu'awiya, for he saw that two mudds of wheat were equal to one sa' of dates. Abu Sa'id sald: I would continue to take that out as before (i e. one sa' of wheat).
hi: Sa'd bin Abu Sarh ne Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ko ye kehte suna: Hum, jawaan ya boodhe, azaad ya ghulam ki taraf se, Fitr ki Zakaat nikala karte the jab Rasoolullah (SAW) hamare beech maujood the, teen tarah ki cheezon mein, ek sa khajoor, ek sa panir, ya ek sa jau, aur hum ye Muawiya ke daur tak nikalte rahe, kyunki unhone dekha ki gehun ka do mudd ek sa khajoor ke barabar hai. Abu Sa'id ne kaha: Main pehle jaisa hi nikalta rahunga, yaani ek sa gehun.

e: Abu Sa'id al Khudri reported: We used to take out the Zakat of Fitr in three kinds, cheese, dates and barley.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne bayan kiya: Hum Fitr ki Zakaat teen tarah ki cheezon mein nikala karte the, panir, khajoor aur jau.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported that when Mu'awiya prescribed half a sa' of wheat equal to one sa' of dates, he (Abu Sa'id al-Khudri) objected to it, and said: I would take out (Sadaqat-ul-Fitr) but that which I used to bring forth during the lifetime of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) one sa' of dates, or one sa' of raisins, or one sa' of barley, or one sa' of cheese.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne bayan kiya ki jab Muawiya ne aadha sa gehun ek sa khajoor ke barabar muqarrar kiya, to unhone iska aitraaz kiya, aur kaha: Main wahi nikaalunga jo main Rasoolullah (SAW) ke daur mein nikalta tha - ek sa khajoor, ya ek sa kishmish, ya ek sa jau, ya ek sa panir.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ordered that the Sadaqat-ul-Fitr should be paid before the people go out for prayer.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne hukum diya ki Sadaqat-ul-Fitr logon ke namaz ke liye jaane se pehle ada kiya jaaye.

e: Abdullah b 'Umar reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ordered the payment of Sadaqat-ul-Fitr before people go out for prayer.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Sadaqat-ul-Fitr ko logon ke namaz ke liye jaane se pehle ada karne ka hukum diya.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) as saying: If any owner of gold or silver does not pay what is due on him, when the Day of Resurrection would come, plates of fire would be beaten out for him; these would then be heated in the fire of Hell and his sides, his forehead and his back would be cauterized with them. Whenever these cool down, (the process is) repeated during a day the extent of which would be fifty thousand years, until judgment is pronounced among servants, and he sees whether his path is to take him to Paradise or to Hell. It was said: Messenger of Allah, what about the camel? He (the Holy Prophet) said: If any owner of the camel does not pay what is due on him, and of his due in that (camel) is (also) to milk it on the day when it comes down to water. When the Day of Resurrection comes a soft sandy plain would be set for him, as extensive as possible, (he will find) that not a single young one is missing, and they will trample him with their hoofs and bite him with their mouths. As often as the first of them passes him, the last of them would be made to return during a day the extent of which would be fifty thousand years, until judgment is pronounced among servants and he sees whether his path is to take him to Paradise or to Hell. It was (again) said: Messenger of Allah, what about cows (cattle) and sheep? He said: It any owner of the cattle and sheep does not pay what is due on them, when the Day of Resurrection comes a soft sandy plain would be spread for them, he will find none of them missing, with twisted horns, without horns or with a broken horn, and they will gore him with their horns and trample him with their hoofs. As often as the first of them passes him the last of them would be made to return to him during a day the extent of which would be fifty thousand years, until judgment would be pronounced among the servants. And he would be shown his path-path leading him to Paradise or to Hell. It was said: Messenger of Allah, what about the horse? Upon this he said: The horses are of three types. To one than (these are) a burden, and to another man (these are) a covering, and still to another man (these are) a source of reward. The one for whom these are a burden is the person who rears them in order to show off, for vainglory and for opposing the Muslims; so they are a burden for him. The one for whom these are a covering is the person who rears them for the sake of Allah but does not forget the right of Allah concerning their backs and their necks, and so they are a covering for him. As for those which bring reward (these refer to) the person who rears them for the sake of Allah to be used for Muslims and he puts them in meadow and field. And whatever thing do these eat from that meadow and field would be recorded on his behalf as good deeds, as would also the amount of their dung and urine. And these would not break their halter and prance a course or two without having got recorded the amount of their hoof marks and their dung as a good deed on his behalf (on behalf of their owner). And their master does not bring them past a river from which they drink, though he did not intend to quench their thirst, but Allah would record for him the amount of what they drink on his behalf as deeds. It was said: Messenger of Allah, what about the asses?, Upon this he said: Nothing has been revealed to me in regard to the asses (in particular) except this one verse of a comprehensive nature:" He who does an atom's weight of good will see it, and he who does an atom's weight of evil will see it" (xcix. 7)
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Agar sone ya chandi ka koi maalik apni zimmedaari ada nahi karta, to jab Qayamat ka din aayega, uske liye aag ke thaal peete jaayenge; unhe phir jahannam ki aag mein garam kiya jaayega aur unse uski karvatein, uski peshani aur uski peeth daagi jaayegi. Jab bhi ye thande hote hain, ye amal ek aise din mein dohraya jaayega jiski lambaai pachaas hazaar saal hogi, yahan tak ki bandon ke darmiyan faisla ho jaaye, aur woh dekhega ki uska raasta use Jannat ki taraf le jaata hai ya Jahannam ki taraf. Poocha gaya: Ya Rasoolullah, oont ke baare mein kya khayal hai? Unhone kaha: Agar oont ka koi maalik apni zimmedaari ada nahi karta, aur uski zimmedaari mein ye bhi shaamil hai ki jab woh paani peene aaye to use doodh nikaale, garibon ke liye, to jab Qayamat ka din aayega, uske liye ek narm reti ka maidan bichhaya jaayega, jitna ho sake bada, usko ye milega ki ek bhi bachcha kam nahi hoga, aur woh use apne khuron se kuchlenge aur apne munhon se kaatenge. Jitni baar unmein se pehla usse guzarta hai, aakhri ko lautaya jaayega, ek aise din mein jiski lambaai pachaas hazaar saal hogi, yahan tak ki bandon ke darmiyan faisla ho jaaye aur woh dekhega ki uska raasta use Jannat ki taraf le jaata hai ya Jahannam ki taraf. Isper dobara poocha gaya: Ya Rasoolullah, gaayon, maweshiyon, aur bakriyon ke baare mein kya khayal hai? Unhone kaha: Agar maweshi aur bakri ka koi maalik unpar apni zimmedaari ada nahi karta, to jab Qayamat ka din aayega, unke liye ek narm reti ka maidan phaila diya jaayega, use unmein se koi kam nahi milega, moudi seengon wale, bina seengon wale ya toote hue seengon wale, aur woh use apne seengon se maarenge aur apne khuron se kuchlenge. Jitni baar unmein se pehla usse guzarta hai aakhri ko usse lautaya jaayega, ek aise din mein jiski lambaai pachaas hazaar saal hogi, yahan tak ki bandon ke darmiyan faisla ho jaaye. Aur use apna raasta dikhaya jaayega - raasta jo use Jannat ya Jahannam ki taraf le jaata hai. Poocha gaya: Ya Rasoolullah, ghode ke baare mein kya khayal hai? Isper unhone kaha: Ghode teen tarah ke hote hain. Kisi ke liye ye ek bojh hain, aur kisi ke liye ye ek dhaal hai, aur kisi ke liye ye ek sawaab ka zariya hai. Jiske liye ye ek bojh hain woh shakhs hai jo unhe dikhawe, ghamand aur Musalmaanon ke khilaaf istemal ke liye palta hai; is liye woh uske liye bojh hain. Jiske liye ye ek dhaal hain woh shakhs hai jo unhe Allah ki khaatir palta hai lekin unki peeth aur unki gardan ke baare mein Allah ke haq ko nahi bhoolta, is liye ye uske liye dhaal hain. Aur jo sawaab laate hain ye us shakhs ki baat hai jo unhe Allah ki khaatir Musalmaanon ke istemal ke liye palta hai aur unhe chaargaah aur khet mein rakhta hai. Aur woh chaargaah ya khet se jo bhi khaate hain woh uske haq mein achhe amal ke taur par darj kiya jaata hai, jitna unke gobar aur peshaab ki maqdaar bhi. Aur woh apni rassi na todein aur ek ya do rasta bhaag len bina ki unke khuron ke nishaanon aur unke gobar ki maqdaar unke maalik ke liye achhe amal ke taur par darj ki jaaye. Aur unka maalik unhe kabhi kisi nadi se guzaarte hue nahi le jaata jismein se woh peete hon, halaanki uska irada unki pyaas bujhaana nahi tha, lekin Allah uske haq mein jo unhone piya uski maqdaar amal ke taur par darj karta hai. Poocha gaya: Ya Rasoolullah, gadhon ke baare mein kya khayal hai? Isper unhone kaha: Mujhpar gadhon ke baare mein khaas taur par kuch nazil nahi hua siwaay is ek jaame aayat ke: "Jo koi zarre barabar bhalaai kare, woh use dekhega, aur jo koi zarre barabar buraai kare, woh use dekhega" (99:7).

e: This hadith has been narrated by Zaid b. Aslam with the same chain of transmitters except that he said: " None among the owners of camels who does not pay their due," but did not say" their due (Zakat) out of them." and he make a mention:" He did not miss a single young one out of them." and he said:" Their sides. their foreheads and their backs would be cauterised."
hi: Ye hadees Zaid bin Aslam ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai siwaay is baat ke ki unhone kaha: "Oonton ke maalikon mein se koi bhi jo unki zimmedaari ada nahi karta," lekin unhone "unmein se unka haq" nahi kaha, aur unhone zikr kiya: "Usne unmein se ek bhi bachcha kam nahi paaya," aur unhone kaha: "Unki karvatein, unki peshaniyaan aur unki peeth daagi jaayengi."

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: No owner of the treasure who does not pay Zakat (would be spared) but (his hoards) would be heated in the Fire of Hell and these would be made into plates and with these his sides, his forehead would be cauterised till Allah would pronounce judgment among His servants during a day, the extent of which would be fifty thousand years. He would then see his path, leading either to Paradise or to Hell. And no owner of the camels who does not pay Zakat (would be spared) but a soft sandy plain would be set for him and they (the camels) would be made to pass over him till the last of them would be made to return till Allah would pronounce judgment among His servants during a day the extent of which would be fifty thousand years. He would then see his path leading him to Paradise or leading him to Hell. And no owner of the (cattle and) goats who does not pay Zakat (would be spared) but a soft sandy plain would be set for him, he would find none of them missing, with twisted horns, without horns, or with broken horns, and they will gore him with their horns and trample him with their hoofs and they would be made to pass over him till the last of them would be made to return till Allah would pronounce judgment among His servants, during a day the extent of which would be fifty thousand years, and he would see the paths leading to Paradise or to Hell. Suhail said: I do not know whether he made mention of the cows. They said: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), what about the horses? He said: The horses have goodness in their foreheads (or he said) or goodness is ingrained in the foreheads of the horses (Suhail said: I am in doubt as to what was actually said) up till the Day of judgement. The horses are of three kinds. They are a source of reward to a person, they are a covering to a person, and they are a burden to a person. As for those which bring reward is that a person would get reward who rears them for the sake of Allah and trains them for Him, and nothing disappears in their stomachs but Allah would record for him a good deed. And if they were to graze in the meadow, they would eat nothing but Allah would record for him a reward. And if they were to drink water from the canal, with every drop that, would disappear in their stomachs there would be reward (for the owner). He went on describing till a reward was mentioned for their urine and dung. And if they pranced a course or two, there would be recorded a reward for every pace that they covered. As for one for whom they are a covering, he is the man who rears them for honour and dignity but does not forget the right of their backs and their stomachs, in plenty and adversity, As regards one for whom they are a burden, he is that who rears them for vainglory and showing off to the people; for him they are, the burden. They said: Messenger of Allah, what about asses? He said: Allah has not revealed to me anything in regards to it except this one comprehensive verse:" He who does an atom's weight of good will see it, and he who does an atom's weight of evil will see it" (xcix. 7).
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Khazaane ka koi bhi maalik jo Zakaat ada nahi karta, bacha nahi paayega balki uske khazaane ko jahannam ki aag mein garam kiya jaayega aur unhe thaal banaya jaayega aur unse uski karvatein, uski peshani daagi jaayegi yahan tak ki Allah apne bandon ke darmiyan faisla kare, ek aise din mein jiski lambaai pachaas hazaar saal hogi. Woh phir apna raasta dekhega, ya to Jannat ki taraf ya Jahannam ki taraf. Aur oonton ka koi bhi maalik jo Zakaat ada nahi karta, bacha nahi payega balki uske liye ek narm reti ka maidan bichhaya jaayega aur woh oont uspar se guzarenge yahan tak ki aakhri ko lautaya jaaye, yahan tak ki Allah apne bandon ke darmiyan faisla kare, ek aise din mein jiski lambaai pachaas hazaar saal hogi. Woh phir apna raasta dekhega jo use Jannat ki taraf le jaata hai ya Jahannam ki taraf. Aur bakriyon ka koi bhi maalik jo Zakaat ada nahi karta, bacha nahi paayega, balki uske liye ek narm reti ka maidan bichhaya jaayega, use unmein se koi kam nahi milega, moudi seengon wale, bina seengon wale, ya toote hue seengon wale, aur woh use apne seengon se maarenge aur apne khuron se kuchlenge, aur woh uspar se guzarenge yahan tak ki aakhri ko lautaya jaaye, yahan tak ki Allah apne bandon ke darmiyan faisla kare, ek aise din mein jiski lambaai pachaas hazaar saal hogi, aur woh raaste dekhega jo Jannat ki taraf le jaate hain ya Jahannam ki taraf. Suhail ne kaha: Mujhe nahi pata ki unhone gaayon ka zikr kiya ya nahi. Unhone kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, ghodon ke baare mein kya khayal hai? Unhone kaha: Ghodon ki peshaaniyon mein bhalaai hai, ya unhone kaha, ya bhalaai ghodon ki peshaaniyon mein bunee hui hai, Suhail ne kaha: Mujhe shaq hai ki asal mein kya kaha gaya tha, Qayamat ke din tak. Ghode teen tarah ke hote hain. Woh kisi shakhs ke liye sawaab ka zariya hain, kisi ke liye dhaal hain, aur kisi ke liye bojh hain. Jahan tak sawaab laane walon ka sawal hai, ye ek aisa shakhs hai jo unhe Allah ki khaatir palta hai aur unhe Uske liye tarbiyat deta hai, aur unke pet mein jo bhi ghayab hota hai uske badle Allah uske liye ek achha amal darj karta hai. Aur agar woh chaargaah mein charte, to woh kuch nahi khaate magar Allah uske liye sawaab darj karta. Aur agar woh nahar ka paani peete, to unke pet mein jo bhi boond ghayab hoti uska bhi sawaab, maalik ke liye, hota. Unhone bataana jaari rakha yahan tak ki unke peshaab aur gobar ka bhi sawaab zikr kiya gaya. Aur agar woh ek ya do rasta bhaagte, to unke chale gaye har kadam ka sawaab darj hota. Jahan tak us shakhs ka sawal hai jiske liye ye ek dhaal hain, woh woh aadmi hai jo unhe izzat aur waqaar ke liye palta hai lekin unki peeth aur unke pet ke haq ko, chahe wafar mein ho ya tangi mein, nahi bhoolta. Jahan tak us shakhs ka sawal hai jiske liye ye ek bojh hain, woh woh hai jo unhe dikhawe aur logon ko jataane ke liye palta hai; uske liye ye ek bojh hain. Unhone poocha: Ya Rasoolullah, gadhon ke baare mein kya khayal hai? Unhone kaha: Allah ne mujhpar iske baare mein kuch bhi nazil nahi kiya siwaay is ek jaame aayat ke: "Jo koi zarre barabar bhalaai kare, woh use dekhega, aur jo koi zarre barabar buraai kare, woh use dekhega" (99:7).

e: This hadith has been narrated by Suhail b. Abu Salih with the same chain of transmitters, and he said he substituted the word aqsa' with 'adba' and said: " his side and his back," but he made no mention of his forehead.
hi: Ye hadees Suhail bin Abu Salih ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai, aur unhone kaha ki unhone "aqsa" lafz ki jagah "adba" istemal kiya aur kaha: "uski karvat aur uski peeth," lekin unhone uski peshani ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:" When a person does not pay what is due to Allah or Sadaqa of his camels...." The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira se ek doosri sanad se bayan ki gayi hai: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: "Jab koi shakhs Allah ka haq ya apne oonton ki Sadaqa ada nahi karta..." Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah al-Ansari reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The owner of a camel who does not pay what is due on it (would be punished in this way) that on the Day of Resurrection many more (along with his camel) would come and the owner would be made to sit on a soft sandy ground and they would trample him with their feet and hooves. And no owner of the cattle who does not pay what is due on them (would be spared the punishment) but on the Day of Resurrection, many more would come and he (the owner) would be made to sit on the soft sandy ground and would be gored by their horns and trampled under their feet. And no owner of the goats and sheep who does not pay what is due on them (would be spared of punishment) but many more would come on the Day of Resurrection and he (the owner) would be made to sit on a soft sandy ground and they would gore him with their horns and trample him under their hooves. And there would be more (among this flock of sheep and goat) without horns or with broken horns. And no owner of the treasure who does not pay its due but his treasure would come on the Day of Resurrection like a bald snake and would pursue him with its mouth open, and when it would come near he would run away from it, and he would be called thus:" Take your treasure which you concealed, for I do not need it." When he would find no way out he would put his hand in its mouth and it would gnaw it like a he-camel. Abu Zubair said: We heard Ubaid b. Umair saying this. We then asked Jabir b. 'Abdullah about this. And he also said like Ubaid b. Umair, Abu Zubair said: I heard 'Ubaid b. 'Umair saying: A man said: Messenger of Allah, what is due on camels? He said: Milking them near water, and lending of bucket (used for drawing water from it), or lending its male for mating with a she-camel and providing it as a ride for the sake of Allah.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah al-Ansari ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Oont ka woh maalik jo uski zimmedaari ada nahi karta, use is tarah saza di jaayegi ki Qayamat ke din unke saath, uske oonton ke saath, bahut saare aur aa jaayenge aur maalik ko ek narm reti par baithaya jaayega aur woh use apne paon aur khuron se kuchlenge. Aur maweshiyon ka koi bhi maalik jo unpar apni zimmedaari ada nahi karta, saza se nahi bacha jaayega, balki Qayamat ke din bahut saare aur aa jaayenge aur woh maalik narm reti par baithaya jaayega aur unke seengon se ghayal kiya jaayega aur unke paon se kuchla jaayega. Aur bakriyon aur bheedon ka koi bhi maalik jo unpar apni zimmedaari ada nahi karta, saza se nahi bacha jaayega, balki Qayamat ke din bahut saare aur aa jaayenge aur woh maalik narm reti par baithaya jaayega aur woh use apne seengon se ghayal karenge aur apne khuron se kuchlenge. Aur inmein se, is bheedon aur bakriyon ke jhund mein, aur bhi honge, bina seengon wale ya toote hue seengon wale. Aur khazaane ka koi bhi maalik jo iski zimmedaari ada nahi karta, saza se nahi bacha jaayega, balki Qayamat ke din uska khazaana ek gunje saanp jaisa ban kar aayega aur khule munh se uska peecha karega, aur jab woh khazaana qareeb aayega to woh maalik usse bhaagega, aur usse maalik ko yun pukara jaayega: "Apna khazaana le lo jo tumne chhupaya tha, mujhe iski zaroorat nahi hai." Jab use kahin bhi jaane ka raasta nahi milega, to woh apna haath uske munh mein daalega aur woh saanp use ek nar oont ki tarah chabaaega. Abu Zubair ne kaha: Humne Ubaid bin Umair ko ye kehte suna. Phir humne Jabir bin Abdullah se iske baare mein poocha. Aur unhone bhi Ubaid bin Umair jaisa hi kaha. Abu Zubair ne kaha: Maine Ubaid bin Umair ko ye kehte suna: Ek shakhs ne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, oonton par kya zimmedaari hai? Unhone kaha: Unhe paani ke paas doodh dena, aur paani nikaalne wali baalti udhaar dena, ya unke nar ko oontni ke saath milaap ke liye udhaar dena aur unhe Allah ki khaatir sawaari ke liye dena.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah reported the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: No owner of camels or cattle or flock of sheep or goats who does not pay his due (would be spared punishment) but would be made to sit on the Day of Resurrection on a soft sandy ground and the hoofed animals would trample him with their hoofs and gore him with their horns. And none of them on that day would be without horns, or with broken horns. We said: Messenger of Allah, but what is due on them? He said: Lending of the male (for use) and lending of the bucket (used for drawing water for them) and for mating and milking them near water and providing them as a ride for the sake of Allah. And no owner of the property who does not pay Zakat (would be spared punishment) but it (his property) would turn into a bald snake and would follow its owner wherever he would go, and he would run away from it, and it would be said to him: That is your property about which you were stingy. And when he would find no other way out he would thrust his hand in its mouth and it would gnaw it like a male camel.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Oonton ya maweshiyon ya bheed-bakriyon ke jhund ka koi bhi maalik jo apni zimmedaari ada nahi karta, saza se nahi bacha jaayega, balki Qayamat ke din use ek narm reti par baithaya jaayega aur khur wale jaanwar use apne khuron se kuchlenge aur seengon se ghayal karenge. Aur us din unmein se koi bhi bina seengon ke ya toote hue seengon wale nahi hoga. Humne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, lekin unpar kya zimmedaari hai? Unhone kaha: Nar ko istemal ke liye udhaar dena aur paani nikaalne wali baalti udhaar dena aur unhe milaap ke liye dena aur unhe paani ke paas doodh dena aur unhe Allah ki khaatir sawaari ke liye dena. Aur maal ka koi bhi maalik jo Zakaat ada nahi karta, saza se nahi bacha jaayega, balki woh, uska maal, ek gunje saanp mein badal jaayega aur apne maalik ka peecha karega jahan bhi woh jaaye, aur woh usse bhaagega, aur usse kaha jaayega: Ye tumhara maal hai jiske baare mein tum kanjoosi karte the. Aur jab use kahin bhi jaane ka raasta nahi milega to woh apna haath uske munh mein daalega aur woh use ek nar oont ki tarah chabaaega.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported: There came people from among the Bedouins to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: Collectors of Sadaqa come to us and treat us unjustly. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Please your collectors. Jarir said: Ever since I heard it from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) no collector had departed but was pleased with me.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya: Dehaati logon mein se kuch log Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: Sadaqa jama karne wale hamare paas aate hain aur hamare saath naa-insaafi karte hain. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Apne jama karne walon ko khush rakho. Jarir ne kaha: Jab se maine ye Rasoolullah (SAW) se suna, koi bhi jama karne wala mujhse, mujhse naaraaz hokar, nahi gaya balki hamesha khush hokar gaya.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Muhammad b. Isma'il with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Muhammad bin Ismail ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: Abu Dharr reported: I went to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he was sitting under the shade of the Ka'ba. As he saw me he said: By the Lord of the Ka'ba, they are the losers. I came there till I sat and I could not stay (longer) and (then) stood up. I said: Messenger of Allah, let my father, be ransom for you, who are they (the losers)? He said: They are those having a huge amount of wealth except so and so and (those who spend their wealth generously on them whom they find in front of them, behind them and on their right side and on their left side) and they are a few. And no owner of camels, or cattle or goat and sheep, who does not pay Zakat (would be spared punishment) but these (camels, cattle, goats and sheep) would come on the Day of Resurrection wearing more flesh and would gore him with their horns and trample them with their hooves. And when the last one would pass away, the first one would return (to trample him) till judgment would be pronounced among people.
hi: Abu Dharr ne bayan kiya: Main Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas gaya aur woh Kaaba ke saaye mein baithe the. Jab unhone mujhe dekha to unhone kaha: Kaaba ke Rab ki qasam, woh nuksaan uthaane wale hain. Main wahan gaya yahan tak ki main baith gaya aur main der tak ruk nahi saka aur khada ho gaya. Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, mere maa-baap aap par qurbaan hon, woh kaun hain, nuksaan uthaane wale? Unhone kaha: Woh log hain jinke paas bahut zyada daulat hai, siwaay falan-falan ke, aur un logon ke jo apni daulat un logon par kholkar kharch karte hain jinhe woh apne saamne, apne peeche, apni daayi taraf aur apni baayi taraf paate hain, aur woh log kam hain. Aur oonton, ya maweshiyon, ya bakri-bheedon ka koi bhi maalik jo Zakaat ada nahi karta, saza se nahi bacha jaayega, balki ye oont, maweshi, bakriyaan aur bheed Qayamat ke din pehle se zyada gosht pahne huye aayenge aur unhe apne seengon se ghayal karenge aur apne khuron se kuchlenge. Aur jab aakhri jaanwar guzar jaayega, to pehla wapas aa jaayega, usse kuchlne ke liye, yahan tak ki logon ke darmiyan faisla ho jaaye.

e: Abu Dbarr reported: I went to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he was sitting under the shade of the Ka'ba, and the rest of the hadith it the same but for this that he (the Holy Prophet) said:" By Allah, in Whose hand is my life, no person on earth who dies and leaves behind camels, or cattle or goat and sheep, and does not pay Zakat (would be spared the punishment)."
hi: Abu Dharr ne bayan kiya: Main Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas gaya aur woh Kaaba ke saaye mein baithe the, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai siwaay is baat ke ki unhone kaha: "Allah ki qasam, jiske haath mein meri zindagi hai, zameen par koi bhi shakhs nahi hai jo mare aur peeche oont, ya maweshi, ya bakri-bheed chhod jaaye, aur Zakaat ada na kare, saza se bach jaaye."

e: Abu Huraira reported that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: Nothing is more delighting to me than this that Uhud should be of gold for me, and no dinar is left with me out of it before three nights pass except a dinar which I would set aside for the repayment of debt upon me.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Mujhe isse zyada koi cheez khush nahi karti ki Uhud mere liye sona ban jaaye, aur usmein se koi dinar teen raaton ke guzarne se pehle mere paas na bache siwaay ek dinar ke jise main apne qarz ki adaayagi ke liye rakh lunga.

e: Abu Huraira reported the same from the Prophet (ﷺ).
hi: Abu Huraira ne yehi Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki hai.

e: Abu Dharr reported: I walked with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the stony ground of Medina in the afternoon and we were looking at Uhud. The Messenger of Allah (way peace by upon him) said: Abu Dharr! I said: Messenger of Allah, I am here at thy beck and call. He said: What I desire is that Uhud be gold with me and three nights should pass and there is left with me any dinar but one coin which I would keep to pay debt. (I love) to spend it among the servants of Allah like this and he pointed in front of him, and on his right side and on his left side. We then proceeded on and he said: Abu Dharr. I said: At thy beck and call, Messenger of Allah. He (the Holy Prophet) said: The rich would be poor on the Day of Resurrection, but he who spent like this and like this and like this, and he pointed as at the first time. We again went on when he said. Abu Dharr, stay where you are till I come back to you. He (the Holy Prophet) then moved on till he disappeared from my sight He (Abu Dharr) said: I heard a sound and I heard a noise. I said (to myself): The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) might have met (mishap or an enemy). I wished to follow him but I remembered his command for not departing till he would come back. So I waited for him, and when he came I made a mention of what I heard. He said: it was Gabriel, who came to me and said:" He who dies among your Ummah without associating Anything with Allah would enter Paradise. I said: Even if he committed fornication or theft? He said: Even if he committed fornication or theft.
hi: Abu Dharr ne bayan kiya: Main Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath Madina ki patthreeli zameen par shaam ko chala aur hum Uhud ko dekh rahe the. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Abu Dharr! Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, main haazir hoon. Unhone kaha: Meri khwahish ye hai ki Uhud mere liye sona ho jaaye aur teen raaten guzar jaayein aur mere paas koi dinar na bache siwaay ek sikke ke jise main qarz chukaane ke liye rakhunga. Mujhe pasand hai ki main ise Allah ke bandon mein isi tarah kharch karun, aur unhone apne saamne, apni daayi taraf aur apni baayi taraf ishara kiya. Hum phir aage badhe aur unhone kaha: Abu Dharr. Maine kaha: Haazir hoon, Ya Rasoolullah. Unhone kaha: Maaldaar log Qayamat ke din gareeb honge, siwaay us shakhs ke jo isi tarah, aur isi tarah, aur isi tarah kharch kare, aur unhone pehli baar jaisa hi ishara kiya. Hum phir chale jab unhone kaha: Abu Dharr, yahin ruko yahan tak ki main tumhare paas laut aaun. Unhone phir aage kadam badhaya yahan tak ki woh mujhse ojhal ho gaye. Unhone kaha: Maine ek aawaaz suni aur mujhe ek shor suna. Maine khud se kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) shayad kisi museebat ya dushman se mile hon. Mera dil chaha ki main unka peecha karun lekin mujhe unka hukum yaad aaya ki jab tak woh wapas na aayein main na jaun. To main unka intezaar karta raha, aur jab woh aaye to maine jo suna tha uska zikr kiya. Unhone kaha: Ye Jibra'eel the, jo mere paas aaye aur kaha: "Jo bhi tumhari ummat mein Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek kiye bagair mare, woh Jannat mein daakhil hoga." Maine kaha: Chahe usne zina kiya ho ya chori? Unhone kaha: Chahe usne zina kiya ho ya chori.

e: Abu Dharr reported: I went out one night (and found) the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) walking all alone. There was no man with him. I thought that he did not like anyone walking along with him. So I began to walk in the light of the moon. He, however turned his attention to me and saw me and said: Who is this? I said: It is Abu Dharr. Let Allah make me as ransom for you. He said: Abu Dharr, come on. He (Abu Dharr) said: So I walked along with him for some time and he said: The wealthy persons would have little (reward) on the Day of Resurrection, except upon whom Allah conferred goodness (wealth). He dispensed it to his right, left, in front of him and at his back (just as the wind diffuses fragrance) and did good with it (riches). I went along with him for some time when He said: Sit here. And he made me sit at a safe place and there were stones around it, and he said to me: Sit here till I come to you. He went away on the stony ground till I could not see him. He stayed away from me, and he prolonged his stay. Then I heard him as he came back and he was saying: Even if he committed theft and even if he committed fornication. When he came I could not help asking him: Apostle of Allah, let Allah make me ransom for you, whom were you speaking on the stony ground? I heard nobody responding to you. He (the Holy Prophet) said: It was Gabriel who met me by the side of the stony ground and said: Give glad tidings to your Ummah that he who died without associating ought with Allah would go into Paradise. I said: Gabriel, even if he committed theft and fornication? He said: Yes. I said: Even it he committed theft and fornication? He said: Yes, I again said: Even if he committed theft and fornication? He said: Yes, even if he drank wine.
hi: Abu Dharr ne bayan kiya: Main ek raat bahar nikla aur paaya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) akele chal rahe the. Unke saath koi aadmi nahi tha. Maine socha ki unhe pasand nahi ki koi unke saath chale. To main chaandni mein chalne laga. Woh, halaanki, mujhe dekh liye aur unhone kaha: Ye kaun hai? Maine kaha: Ye Abu Dharr hai. Allah mujhe aap par qurbaan kare. Unhone kaha: Abu Dharr, aao. Unhone kaha: To main kuch der unke saath chala aur unhone kaha: Maaldaar logon ko Qayamat ke din bahut kam sawaab milega, siwaay us shakhs ke jispar Allah ne achhaai, daulat, ata ki ho. Usne use apni daayi taraf, baayi taraf, apne saamne aur apni peeth ke peeche, bilkul jaise hawa khushboo phailaati hai, taqseem kiya, aur us daulat se bhalaai ki. Main kuch der unke saath chalta raha jab unhone kaha: Yahan baitho. Aur unhone mujhe ek mahfooz jagah baithaya aur uske aas-paas pathhar the, aur unhone mujhse kaha: Yahan baitho yahan tak ki main tumhare paas aaun. Woh patthreeli zameen par gaye yahan tak ki main unhe dekh na saka. Woh mujhse door rahe, aur unhone apna wahan rukna lamba kar diya. Phir maine unhe wapas aate suna aur woh keh rahe the: Chahe usne chori ki ho aur chahe usne zina kiya ho. Jab woh aaye to main unse poochhe bagair na reh saka: Allah ke Rasool, Allah mujhe aap par qurbaan kare, aap patthreeli zameen par kisse baat kar rahe the? Maine kisi ko aapko jawab dete nahi suna. Unhone kaha: Ye Jibra'eel the jo mujhse patthreeli zameen ke paas mile aur kaha: Apni ummat ko khushkhabri do ki jo bhi Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek kiye bagair mara, woh Jannat mein jaayega. Maine kaha: Jibra'eel, chahe usne chori aur zina kiya ho? Unhone kaha: Haan. Maine kaha: Chahe usne chori aur zina kiya ho? Unhone kaha: Haan, Maine phir kaha: Chahe usne chori aur zina kiya ho? Unhone kaha: Haan, chahe usne sharaab bhi pi ho.

e: Ahnaf b. Qais reported: I came to Medina and when I was in the company of the grandees of Quraish a man with a crude body and an uncouth face wearing coarse clothes came there. He stood up before them and said: Give glad tidings to those whom who amass riches of the stones which would be heated in the Fire of Hell, and would be placed at the tick of the chest till it would project from the shoulder bone and would he put on the shoulder bone till it would project from the tick of his chest, and it (this stone) would continue passing and repassing (from one side to the other). He (the narrator) said: Then people hung their heads and I saw none among them giving any answer. He then returned and I followed him till he sat near a pillar. I said: I find that these (people) disliked what you said to them and they do not understand anything. My friend Abu'l-Qasim (Muhammad) (may peace he upon him) called me and I responded to him, and he said: Do you see Uhud? I saw the sun (shining) on me and I thought that he would send me on an errand for him. So I said: I see it. Upon this he said: Nothing would delight me more than this that I should have gold like it (equal to the bulk of Uhud), and I should spend it all except three dinars. (How sad it is) that they hoard worldly riches, and they know nothing. I said: What about you and your brothers Quraish? You do not go to thein for any need and do not accept anything from them. He said: By Allah, I neither beg anything from them (from worldly goods), nor do I ask them anything about religion till I meet my Allah and His Messenger.
hi: Ahnaf bin Qais ne bayan kiya: Main Madina aaya aur jab main Quraish ke sardaron ki sohbat mein tha, ek moti-taazi jism aur khurdare chehre wala aadmi, mote kapde pehne hue, wahan aaya. Woh unke saamne khada hua aur kaha: Un logon ko khushkhabri do jo daulat jama karte hain, ki unke liye jahannam ki aag mein garam kiye jaane wale patthar hain, jinhe seene ke ubhaar par rakha jaayega yahan tak ki woh kandhe ki haddi se bahar nikal aaye, aur phir kandhe ki haddi par rakha jaayega yahan tak ki woh seene ke ubhaar se bahar nikal aaye, aur ye patthar is tarah aana-jaana jaari rakhega, ek taraf se doosri taraf. Raawi ne kaha: Phir logon ne apne sar jhuka liye aur maine unmein se kisi ko koi jawab dete nahi dekha. Woh phir wapas mud gaye aur main unke peeche gaya yahan tak ki woh ek khambe ke paas baithe. Maine kaha: Mujhe lagta hai ki inhone, in logon ne, jo aapne unse kaha usse napasand kiya aur woh kuch samajhte nahi hain. Mere dost Abu'l-Qasim, Muhammad, ne mujhe bulaya aur maine unke bulaawe ka jawab diya, aur unhone kaha: Kya tum Uhud ko dekhte ho? Maine suraj ko apne upar chamakte dekha aur socha ki woh mujhe apne kisi kaam ke liye bhejenge. To maine kaha: Main use dekh raha hoon. Isper unhone kaha: Mujhe isse zyada koi cheez khush nahi karti ki mere paas Uhud jitna sona ho, aur main use sara kharch kar dun siwaay teen dinaar ke. Kitna afsos hai ki woh duniyavi daulat jama karte hain, aur unhe kuch nahi pata. Maine kaha: Aap ka aur aapke bhai Quraish ka kya haal hai? Aap kisi zaroorat ke liye unke paas nahi jaate aur unse kuch qubool nahi karte. Unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, main na to unse, duniyavi cheezon ke liye, bhikh maangta hoon, na hi main unse deen ke baare mein kuch poochta hoon, jab tak main apne Allah aur uske Rasool se na mil jaun.

e: Ahnaf b. Qais reported: While I was in the company of the (elites) of Quraiah, Abu Dharr came there and he was saying: Give glad tidings to the hoarders of riches that their backs would be branded (so deeply) that (the hot Iron) would come out of their sides, and when the backs of their necks would be branded, it would come out of their foreheads. He (Abu Dharr) then went away and sat down. I asked who he was. They said: He is Abu Dharr. I went to him and said to him: What is this that I heard from you which you were saying before? He said: I said nothing but only that which I heard from their Prophet (ﷺ). I again said: What do you say about this gift? He said: Take it, for today it is a help. But when it becomes a price for your religion, then abandon it.
hi: Ahnaf bin Qais ne bayan kiya: Jab main Quraish ke buzurgon ki sohbat mein tha, Abu Dharr wahan aaye aur keh rahe the: Daulat jama karne walon ko khushkhabri do ki unki peethein itni gehri daagi jaayengi ki garam loha unke pehluon se bahar aayega, aur jab unki gardan ki peethein daagi jaayengi, to woh unki peshaniyon se bahar aayega. Woh phir chale gaye aur baith gaye. Maine poocha woh kaun the. Unhone kaha: Woh Abu Dharr hain. Main unke paas gaya aur unse kaha: Ye kya hai jo maine aapse suna, jo aap pehle keh rahe the? Unhone kaha: Maine kuch nahi kaha siwaay uske jo maine unke Nabi (SAW) se suna. Maine phir kaha: Aap is tohfe ke baare mein kya kehte hain? Unhone kaha: Ise lo, kyunki aaj ye ek madad hai. Lekin jab ye tumhare deen ki keemat ban jaaye, to ise chhod do.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying that Allah, the Most Blessed and High, said: O son of Adam, spend. I will spend on you. The right hand of Allah is full and overflowing and in nothing would diminish it, by overspending day and night.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna ki Allah, jo Buland-o-Barter hai, ne farmaya: Aye Aadam ki aulaad, kharch kar. Main tujhpar kharch karunga. Allah ka daayan haath bhara hua aur chhalakta hua hai aur din-raat kharch karne se ise koi kami nahi aati.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying that Allah said to him: " Spend, I will bestow upon you." And the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The right hand of Allah is full and spending (the riches) liberally during day and night will not diminish (the resources of Allah). Don't you see what (an enormous amount of resources) He has spent since He created the heaven and the earth, and what is in His right hand has not decreased? His Throne is upon the water. And in His other hand is death, and He elevates and degrades (whom He likes).
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna ki Allah ne unse kaha: "Kharch kar, main tujhpar ata karunga." Aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Allah ka daayan haath bhara hua hai aur din-raat khule dil se daulat kharch karne se Allah ke zakhaayer mein koi kami nahi aati. Kya tumhe nahi dikhta kitna bhaari zakhaaya Usne kharch kiya hai jab se Usne aasmaan aur zameen banaayi hai, aur jo Uske daayen haath mein hai woh kam nahi hua hai? Uska Arsh paani par hai. Aur Uske doosre haath mein maut hai, aur Woh jise chahe buland karta hai aur jise chahe zaleel karta hai.

e: Thauban reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The most excellent dinar is one that a person spends on his family, and the dinar which he spends on his animal in Allah's path, and the dinar he spends on his companions in Allah's path. Abu Qilaba (one of the narrators) said: He (the narrator) started with family, and then Abu Qilaba said: Who is the person with greater reward than a person who spends on young members of his family (and thus) preserves (saves them from want) (and by virtue of which) Allah brings profit for them and makes them rich.
hi: Thauban ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Sabse behtareen dinaar woh hai jo koi shakhs apne gharwalon par kharch karta hai, aur woh dinaar jo woh apne jaanwar par Allah ki raah mein kharch karta hai, aur woh dinaar jo woh apne saathiyon par Allah ki raah mein kharch karta hai. Abu Qilaba, raawiyon mein se ek, ne kaha: Unhone gharwalon se shuru kiya, aur phir Abu Qilaba ne kaha: Us shakhs se zyada sawaab kis shakhs ko milega jo apne gharwalon ke chhote bacchon par kharch karta hai aur is tarah unhe bachaata hai, unhe zaroorat se bachaata hai, jiski wajah se Allah unke liye faayda laata hai aur unhe maaldaar banaata hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Of the dinar you spend as a contribution in Allah's path, or to set free a slave, or as a sadaqa given to a needy, or to support your family, the one yielding the greatest reward is that which you spent on your family.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Us dinaar mein se jo tum Allah ki raah mein sadaqe ke taur par kharch karte ho, ya kisi ghulam ko azaad karne ke liye, ya kisi zaroorat-mand ko sadaqa dene ke liye, ya apne gharwalon ki madad ke liye, sabse zyada sawaab wala woh hai jo tum apne gharwalon par kharch karte ho.

e: Khaithama reported: While we were sitting in the company of 'Abdullah b. 'Umar there came in his steward. He (Ibn 'Umar) said: Have you supplied the provision to the slaves? He said: No. Upon this he said: Go and give (the provision) to them, for the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) has said: This sin is enough for a man that he withholds the subsistence from one whose master he is.
hi: Khaithama ne bayan kiya: Jab hum Abdullah bin Umar ki sohbat mein baithe the, unka karinda, nigraan, andar aaya. Unhone kaha: Kya tumne ghulamon ko unka raashan diya? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Isper unhone kaha: Jao aur unhe raashan do, kyunki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha hai: Ye gunah kisi aadmi ke liye kaafi hai ki woh us shakhs se zindagi ka saamaan roke jiska woh maalik hai.

e: Jabir reported: A person from the Banu 'Udhra set a slave free after his death. This news reached the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon hhn). Upon this he said: Have you any property besides it? He said: No. Upon this he said: Who would buy (this slave) from me? Nulaim b. Abdullah bought it for eight hundred dirhams and (this amount was) brought to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) who returned it to him (the owner), and then said: Start with your own self and spend it on yourself, and if anything is left, it should be spent on your family, and if anything is left (after meeting the needs of the family) it should be spent on relatives, and if anything is left from the family, it should be spent like this, like this. And he was saying: In front of you, on your right and on your left.
hi: Jabir ne bayan kiya: Banu Udhra ke ek shakhs ne apni maut ke baad ek ghulam ko azaad kiya. Ye khabar Rasoolullah (SAW) tak pahunchi. Isper unhone kaha: Kya iske ilawa tumhare paas koi aur maal hai? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Isper unhone kaha: Kaun ise, is ghulam ko, mujhse khareedega? Nulaim bin Abdullah ne ise aath sau dirham mein khareeda aur ye raqam Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas laayi gayi jinhone use maalik ko wapas kar di, aur phir kaha: Sabse pehle apne aap se shuru karo aur ise apne upar kharch karo, aur agar kuch bache, to ise apne gharwalon par kharch karo, aur agar kuch bache, gharwalon ki zarooraton ke baad, to ise rishtedaaron par kharch karo, aur agar gharwalon ke baad kuch bache, to ise is tarah, is tarah kharch karo. Aur woh keh rahe the: Apne saamne, apni daayi taraf aur apni baayi taraf.

e: Jabir reported that a person among the Ansar who was called Abu Madhkur granted posthumous freedom to his slave who was called Ya'qub. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Jabir ne bayan kiya ki Ansar mein se ek shakhs, jise Abu Madhkur kaha jaata tha, ne apne intiqaal ke baad apne ghulam ko, jise Yaqub kaha jaata tha, azaad kar diya. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Anas b. Malik is reported as saying: Abu Talha was the one among the Ansar of Medina who possessed the largest property and among his property he valued most was his garden known as Bairaha' which was opposite the mosque, and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) often visited it and he drank of its sweet water. When this verse was revealed: "You will never attain righteousness till you give freely of what you love" (iii. 91), Abu Talha got up and, going to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), said: Allah says in His Book: "You will never attain righteousness till you give freely of what you love," and the dearest of my property is Bairaha' so I give it as Sadaqa to God from Whom I hope for reward for it and the treasure with Allah; so spend it, Messenger of Allah, on whatever purpose you deem it proper. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Well done! that is a profitable deal, that is a profitable deal. I have heard what you have said, but I think you should spend it on your nearest relatives. So Abu Talha distributed it among the nearest relatives and his cousins on his father's side.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya: Abu Talha Madina ke Ansar mein sabse zyada maal rakhne wale the aur unki maal mein jo sabse zyada unhe aziz thi woh unka baagh tha jise Bairaha kaha jaata tha, jo masjid ke saamne tha, aur Rasoolullah (SAW) aksar wahan jaate the aur uske meethe paani se piya karte the. Jab ye aayat nazil hui: "Tum kabhi nekii tak nahi pahunch sakte jab tak tum us cheez se kharch na karo jo tumhein aziz hai" (3:91), Abu Talha khade hue aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaye aur kaha: Allah apni Kitaab mein kehta hai: "Tum kabhi nekii tak nahi pahunch sakte jab tak tum us cheez se kharch na karo jo tumhein aziz hai," aur meri sabse aziz maal Bairaha hai, is liye main ise Allah ke liye sadaqe mein deta hoon jisse mujhe sawaab aur Allah ke paas khazaane ki ummeed hai; is liye ise, Ya Rasoolullah, jahan bhi aap munaasib samjhein wahan kharch kijiye. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Waah! Ye ek faayde ka sauda hai, ye ek faayde ka sauda hai. Maine woh sun liya jo tumne kaha, lekin mera khayal hai ki tumhe ise apne sabse qareebi rishtedaaron par kharch karna chahiye. To Abu Talha ne ise apne sabse qareebi rishtedaaron aur apne chachere bhai-behnon, waalid ki taraf se, mein taqseem kar diya.

e: Anas reported that when this verse was tevealed: " You will not attain righteousness till you give freely of what you love," Abu Talha said: I see that our Lord has demanded from us out of our property; so I make you a witness, Messenger of Allah. that I give my land known as Bairaha' for the sake of Allah. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Give that to your relatives. So he gave it to Hassan b. Thabit and Ubayy b. Ka'b.
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki jab ye aayat nazil hui: "Tum nekii tak tab tak nahi pahunchoge jab tak tum us cheez se kharch na karo jo tumhein aziz hai," Abu Talha ne kaha: Mujhe lagta hai ki hamare Rab ne hamse hamari maal mein se maanga hai; is liye main aapko gawaah banata hoon, Ya Rasoolullah, ki main apni zameen, jise Bairaha kaha jaata hai, Allah ki khaatir deta hoon. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Ise apne rishtedaaron ko de do. To unhone ise Hassan bin Thabit aur Ubayy bin Ka'b ko de diya.

e: Maimuna bint Harith reported that she set free a slave-girl during the lifetime of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and she made a mention of that to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he said: Had you gives her to your maternal uncles, you would have a greater reward.
hi: Maimuna bint Harith ne bayan kiya ki unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) ke daur mein ek laundi ko azaad kiya aur iska zikr Rasoolullah (SAW) se kiya, aur unhone kaha: Agar tumne use apne mama-mausi ke gharane ko di hoti, to tumhe zyada sawaab milta.

e: Zainab, the wife of 'Abdullah (b. Mas'ud ), reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 0 women, give sadaqa even though it be some of your jewellery. She returned to 'Abdullah and said: You are a person with empty hands, whereas the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) has commanded us to give sadaqa, so better go to him and ask and if this will suffice for me; otherwise I shall give it to someone else. 'Abdullah said to me (his wife): You better go yourself. So I went and there was another woman of the Ansar at the door of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) having the same porpose as I had. Now Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was invested with awe (so we did not like to knock). Then Bilal came out and we said to him: Go to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and inform him that there are two women at the door asking him whether it will serve them to give sadaqa to their spouses and to orphans who are under their charge, but do not inform him who we are. Bilal went to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and asked him (what these women had instructed him to ask). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) asked him who these women were. He (Bilal) said: They are women from Ansar and Zainab. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Which of the Zainabs? He said: The wife of 'Abdullah. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: There are two rewards for them, the reward of kinship and the reward of Sadaqa.
hi: Zainab, Abdullah bin Mas'ud ki zauja, ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Aye auraton, sadaqa do, chahe woh tumhare gehnon mein se hi kyun na ho. Woh Abdullah ke paas wapas aayin aur kaha: Aap ek khaali-haath aadmi hain, jabki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne humein sadaqa dene ka hukum diya hai, is liye behtar hoga ki aap unke paas jaakar poochhein ki kya ye aapko dena mere liye kaafi hoga; warna main ise kisi aur ko de dungi. Abdullah ne mujhse, apni biwi se, kaha: Tum khud ja karo. To main gayi aur wahan ek doosri Ansar aurat bhi Rasoolullah (SAW) ke darwaze par thi jinka maqsad wahi tha jo mera tha. Ab Rasoolullah (SAW) mein rob tha, is liye humein dastak dena pasand nahi tha. Phir Bilal bahar aaye aur humne unse kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas jaao aur unhe bataao ki do auraten darwaze par hain jo unse poochh rahi hain ki kya unhe apne shohar aur apni zimmedaari mein aane wale yateemon ko sadaqa dena kaafi hoga, lekin unhe mat bataana ki hum kaun hain. Bilal Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas gaye aur unse poocha jo in auraton ne unse poochhne ko kaha tha. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unse poocha ki ye auraten kaun hain. Unhone kaha: Ye Ansar aur Zainab ki auraten hain. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Kaunsi Zainab? Unhone kaha: Abdullah ki zauja. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Unke liye do sawaab hain, rishtedaari ka sawaab aur Sadaqe ka sawaab.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Zainab the wife of 'Abdullah, and she said: I was in the mosque and the Prophet of Allah (ﷺ) saw me and said: Give Sadaqa even though it is out of your jewellery. The rest of the hadith is the same.
