hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Zainab, Abdullah ki zauja, ke hawale se bayan ki gayi hai, aur unhone kaha: Main masjid mein thi aur Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne mujhe dekha aur kaha: Sadaqa do chahe woh tumhare gehnon mein se hi ho. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Umm Salama said: I asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) whether there is a reward for me if I spend on Abu Salama's sons, and I am not going to abandon them in this state (of helplessness) for they are my sons. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Yes. For you is the reward for what you spend on them.
hi: Umm Salama ne kaha: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) se poocha ki kya mujhe koi sawaab milega agar main Abu Salama ke beton par kharch karun, aur main unhe is bebasi ki haalat mein chhodne wali nahi hoon kyunki woh mere bete hain. Unhone kaha: Haan. Tumhe unpar jo bhi kharch karogi uska sawaab milega.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Ibn 'Urwa with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Urwa ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: Abu Mas'ud reported Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) as saying: When a Muslim spends on his family seeking reward for it from Allah, it counts for him as sadaqa.
hi: Abu Mas'ud ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab koi Musalman apne gharwalon par kharch karta hai, Allah se iska sawaab chahte hue, to ye uske liye sadaqa shumaar hota hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: Asma' daughter of Abu Bakr reported: I said: Messenger of Allah, my mother, who is inclined or scared has come to me. Should I (even An her position of being opposed to Islam) treat her well? He said: Yes.
hi: Asma, Abu Bakr ki beti, ne bayan kiya: Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, meri maa, jo Islam ki taraf jhukav rakhti hain ya deen se darti hain, mere paas aayi hain. Kya mujhe unke Islam ke khilaaf hone ki halat mein bhi unke saath achha bartaav karna chahiye? Unhone kaha: Haan.

e: Asma' bint Abu Bakr reported: My mother who was a polytheist came to me when he (the Holy Prophet) entered into treaty with, the Quraish (of Mecca). I inquired from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: Messenger of Allah, there has come to me my mother and she is inclined; should I (in this state of her mind) show her kindness? He said: Yes, treat her kindly.
hi: Asma bint Abu Bakr ne bayan kiya: Meri maa, jo mushrik thin, mere paas aayin jab unhone Quraish, Makkah, ke saath sandhi ki thi. Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) se poocha: Ya Rasoolullah, meri maa aayi hain aur woh Islam ki taraf jhukav rakhti hain; kya mujhe unke is zehni haalat mein unse achhaai dikhaani chahiye? Unhone kaha: Haan, unse achhi tarah pesh aao.

e: 'A'isha said that a person came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: My mother died suddenly without having made any will. I think she would have definitely given Sadaqa if she had been able to speak. Would she have a reward if I gave Sadaqa on her behalf? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Yes.
hi: Aisha ne kaha ki ek shakhs Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Meri maa achaanak intiqaal kar gayin bina koi vaseeyat kiye. Mujhe lagta hai ki agar unhe bolne ki taaqat hoti, to woh zaroor sadaqa deti. Kya agar main unki taraf se sadaqa dun to unhe sawaab milega? Unhone kaha: Haan.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters. And in the hadith transmitted by Abu Usama the words are: " She did not make any will," as it has been reported by Ibn Bishr, but it was not reported by the rest of the narrators.
hi: Ye hadees Hisham ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai. Aur Abu Usama ki bayan ki hui hadees mein alfaaz hain: "Unhone koi vaseeyat nahi ki thi," jaisa Ibn Bishr ne riwayat kiya hai, lekin baaki raawiyon ne ye riwayat nahi ki.

e: Hudhaifa and Abu Shaiba reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Every act of goodness is sadaqa.
hi: Hudhaifa aur Abu Shaiba ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Har nek amal sadaqa hai.

e: Abu Dharr reported: some of the people from among the Companions of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to him: Messenger of Allah, the rich have taken away (all the) reward. They observe prayer as we do; they keep the fasts as we keep, and they give Sadaqa out of their surplus riches. Upon this he (the Holy Prophet) said: Has Allah not prescribed for you (a course) by following which you can (also) do sadaqa? In every declaration of the glorification of Allah (i. e. saying Subhan Allah) there is a Sadaqa, and every Takbir (i. e. saying Allah-O-Akbar) is a sadaqa, and every praise of His (saying al-Hamdu Lillah) is a Sadaqa and every declaration that He is One (La illha ill-Allah) is a sadaqa, and enjoining of good is a sadaqa, and forbidding of that which is evil is a Sadaqa, and in man's sexual Intercourse (with his wife, ) there is a Sadaqa. They (the Companions) said: Messenger of Allah, is there reward for him who satisfies his sexual passion among us? He said: Tell me, if he were to devote it to something forbidden, would it not be a sin on his part? Similarly, if he were to devote it to something lawful, he should have a reward.
hi: Abu Dharr ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ke kuch sahaba ne unse kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, maaldaar logon ne saara sawaab le liya hai. Woh humari tarah namaz padhte hain; woh humari tarah roze rakhte hain, aur woh apni ziyaada daulat mein se sadaqa dete hain. Isper unhone kaha: Kya Allah ne tumhare liye koi raasta muqarrar nahi kiya jispar chalkar tum bhi sadaqa kar sako? Allah ki tasbeeh ke har ailaan, yaani "Subhan Allah" kehna, mein ek sadaqa hai, aur har takbeer, yaani "Allahu Akbar" kehna, ek sadaqa hai, aur uski har tareef, "Alhamdulillah" kehna, ek sadaqa hai aur ye ailaan ki Woh Akela hai, "La ilaha illallah", ek sadaqa hai, aur bhalaai ka hukum dena ek sadaqa hai, aur buraai se rokna ek sadaqa hai, aur mard ki apni biwi ke saath jinsi milaap mein bhi ek sadaqa hai. Unhone kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, kya hummein se kisi ko apni jinsi khwahish poori karne par bhi sawaab milega? Unhone kaha: Mujhe batao, agar woh ise haraam cheez mein lagaata, to kya ye uski taraf se gunah na hota? Isi tarah, agar woh ise jaayez cheez mein lagaata hai, to use sawaab milna chahiye.

e:
'A'isha reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Every one of the children of Adam has been created with three hundred and sixty joints; so he who declares the Glory of Allah, praises Allah, declares Allah to be One, Glorifies Allah, and seeks forgiveness from Allah, and removes stone, or thorn, or bone from people's path, and enjoins what is good and forbids from evil, to the number of those three hundred and sixty joints, will walk that day having saved himself from the Fire.

Abu Taubah said: "Perhaps he said: 'Will reach the evening.'"
hi: Aisha ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Aadam ki har aulaad teen sau saath jodon ke saath paida ki gayi hai; is liye jo Allah ki tasbeeh kare, uski hamd kare, uski wahdaniyat ka ailaan kare, uski tasbeeh kare, aur Allah se maafi maange, aur logon ke raaste se koi patthar, kaanta, ya haddi hataaye, aur bhalaai ka hukum de aur buraai se roke, un teen sau saath jodon ki tadaad tak, woh us din chalega, khud ko jahannam se bacha kar. Abu Taubah ne kaha: "Shayad unhone kaha: 'Shaam ho jaayegi.'"

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zaid with the same chain of transmitters except with (a slight) change of words (i.e. he ) said: Or he enjoined what is good, ... and said: He enters the evening .
hi: Ye hadees Zaid ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai siwaay alfaaz mein halki tabdeeli ke, unhone kaha: Ya usne bhalaai ka hukum diya, ... aur kaha: Woh shaam mein daakhil hota hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated by 'A'isha through anothr chain of transmitters in which she reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: " Every man is created" ; the rest of the hadith is the same and he said:" He walks on that day."
hi: Ye hadees Aisha ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki gayi hai jismein unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: "Har aadmi paida kiya jaata hai"; baaki hadees waisi hi hai aur unhone kaha: "Woh us din chalta hai."

e: Sa'id b. Abu Burda reported on the authority of his grandfather that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Giving of Sadaqa is essential for every Muslim. It was said (to him): What do you say of him who does not find (the means) to do so? He said: Let him work with both his hands, thus doing benefit to himself and give Sadaqa. It was said to him: What about him who does not have (the means) to do so? He said: Then let him assist the needy, the aggrieved. It was said: What do you say of one who cannot even do this? He said: Then he should enjoin what is reputable or what is good. He said: What about him if he cannot do that? He (the Holy Prophet) said: He should then abstain from evil, for verify that is Sadaqa on his behalf.
hi: Sa'id bin Abu Burda ne apne dada ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Har Musalman ke liye sadaqa dena zaroori hai. Poocha gaya: Aap us shakhs ke baare mein kya kehte hain jise aisa karne ke zaraaye nahi milte? Unhone kaha: Use apne dono haathon se kaam karna chahiye, is tarah khud ko faayda pahunchaana aur sadaqa dena. Unse kaha gaya: Us shakhs ke baare mein kya jise ye zaraaye nahi milte? Unhone kaha: To use zaroorat-mand, museebat mein pade shakhs ki madad karni chahiye. Poocha gaya: Aap us shakhs ke baare mein kya kehte hain jo ye bhi nahi kar sakta? Unhone kaha: To use aacchaai ka hukum dena chahiye, ya jo bhalaai hai uska. Unhone kaha: Uska kya jo ye bhi nahi kar sakta? Unhone kaha: To use buraai se ruk jaana chahiye, kyunki yaqeenan ye uski taraf se sadaqa hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: Hammam b. Munabbih reported that-this is out of (those ahadith) which Abu Huraira narrated to us from Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). And he while making a mention of ahadith reported from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said this: Sadaqa is due on every joint of a person, every day the sun rises. Administering of justice between two men is also a Sadaqa. And assisting a man to ride upon his beast, or helping him load his luggage upon it, is a Sadaqa; and a good word is a Sadaqa; and every step that you take towards prayer is a Sadaqa, and removing of harmful things from the pathway is a Sadaqa.
hi: Hammam bin Munabbih ne bayan kiya ki ye un hadeeson mein se hai jo Abu Huraira ne humein Muhammad, Rasoolullah (SAW), se riwayat ki. Aur unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki hui hadeeson ka zikr karte hue ye kaha: Har jod par sadaqa laazim hai, har din jab suraj nikalta hai. Do aadmiyon ke darmiyan insaaf karna bhi ek sadaqa hai. Aur kisi aadmi ki apne jaanwar par sawaar hone mein madad karna, ya uska saamaan uspar lada dena, ek sadaqa hai; aur ek achha lafz ek sadaqa hai; aur namaz ki taraf tumhara har kadam ek sadaqa hai, aur raste se nuksaandeh cheezein hataana ek sadaqa hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There is never a day wherein servants (of God) get up at morn, but are not visited by two angels. One of them says: 0 Allah, give him more who spends (for the sake of Allah), and the other says: 0 Allah, bring destruction to one who withholds.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Aisa koi din nahi jab Allah ke bande subah utthte hain lekin do farishte unke paas na aayein. Unmein se ek kehta hai: Aye Allah, jo kharch kare use aur de, aur doosra kehta hai: Aye Allah, jo dena roke, use tabaah kar de.

e: Haritha b. Wahb reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Give Sadaqa for a time is about to come when a person would walk with alms and the one whom it is to be given would say: Had you brought it yesterday, I would have accepted it. For the present I do not need it. (And the giver of Sadaqa) I would not find anyone to accept it.
hi: Haritha bin Wahb ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Sadaqa do, kyunki jald hi woh waqt aane wala hai jab koi shakhs sadaqa lekar chalega aur jise woh dena chahega woh kahega: Agar tumne ise kal laaya hota, to main ise qubool kar leta. Abhi mujhe iski zaroorat nahi hai. Aur sadaqa dene wale ko koi bhi qubool karne wala nahi milega.

e: Abu Musa reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There would come a time for the people when a person would roam about with Sadaqa of gold, but he would find no one to accept it from him. And a man would be seen followed by forty women seeking refuge with him on account of the scarcity of males and abundance of females."
hi: Abu Musa ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Logon ke liye ek aisa waqt aayega jab koi shakhs sone ki Sadaqa lekar ghoomega, lekin use koi bhi milega jo ise usse qubool kare. Aur ek shakhs dikhega jiske peeche chaalis auraten hongi, mardon ki kami aur auraton ki bahulta ki wajah se unse panah maangte hue.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) as saying: The Last Hour will not come before wealth becomes abundant and overflowing, so much so that a man takes Zakat out of his property and cannot find anyone to accept it from him and till the land of Arabia reverts to meadows and rivers.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Aakhri ghadi tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak daulat itni zyada aur bhaari na ho jaaye ki koi shakhs apni maal par Zakaat nikaale aur use koi na mile jo ise usse qubool kare, aur jab tak Arabiya ki zameen chaargaahon aur nadiyon mein badal na jaaye.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The Last Hour will not come till wealth is abundant and overflowing, so much so that the owner of the property will think as to who will accept Sadaqa from him, and a person would be called to accept Sadaqa and he would say: I do not need it.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Aakhri ghadi tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak daulat itni zyada aur bhaari na ho jaaye ki maal ka maalik sochega ki kaun uski Sadaqa qubool karega, aur ek shakhs ko Sadaqa qubool karne ke liye bulaaya jaayega aur woh kahega: Mujhe iski zaroorat nahi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenaer (ﷺ) as saying: The earth will vomit long pieces of its liver like columns of gold and silver, and the murderer will come and say: It was for this that I committed murder. The breaker of family ties will come and say: It was for this that I broke the family ties; and the thief will come and say: It is for this that my hands were cut off. They will then leave it and will not take anything out of it.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Zameen apne kaleje ke lambe tukde ugal degi, sona aur chandi ke sitoonon ki tarah, aur qaatil aayega aur kahega: Ye isi ke liye tha ki maine qatl kiya. Rishtedaari todne wala aayega aur kahega: Ye isi ke liye tha ki maine rishtedaari todi; aur chor aayega aur kahega: Ye isi ke liye tha ki mere haath kaate gaye. Phir woh ise chhod denge aur usmein se kuch bhi nahi lenge.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If anyone gives as Sadaqa the equivalent of a date from that (earning) earned honestly, for Allah accepts that which is lawful, the Lord would accept it with His Right Hand, and even if it is a date, it would foster in the Hand of the lord, as one of you fosters his colt, till it becomes bigger than a mountain.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Agar koi imandaari se kamaayi hui kamaai mein se ek khajoor ke barabar bhi sadaqa de, kyunki Allah sirf woh qubool karta hai jo halaal hai, to Rab use apne Daaye Haath se qubool karega, aur chahe woh ek hi khajoor ho, ye Rab ke Haath mein aise badhega jaise tum mein se koi apne bachhde ko palta hai, yahan tak ki ye ek pahaad se bhi bada ho jaaye.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: No one gives Sadaqa of a date out of his honest earning, but Allah accepts it with His Right Hand, and then fosters it as one of you fosters the colt or a young she-camel, till it becomes like a mountain or even greater.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Koi bhi apni halaal kamaai mein se ek khajoor ka sadaqa nahi deta, lekin Allah use apne Daaye Haath se qubool karta hai, aur phir use aise palta hai jaise tum mein se koi ek bachhde ya jawaan oontni ko palta hai, yahan tak ki ye ek pahaad jitna ya usse bhi bada ho jaaye.

e: This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters with a change of words. In the hadith transmitted Rauh (the words are): " Out of the honest earning and its spending at what is its (due) right" ; and in the hadith transmitted by Sulaiman (the words are):" And its spending at its proper place."
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se, alfaaz ki tabdeeli ke saath, bayan ki gayi hai. Rauh ki bayan ki hui hadees mein alfaaz hain: "Halaal kamaai mein se aur ise sahi jagah kharch karna"; aur Sulaiman ki bayan ki hui hadees mein alfaaz hain: "Aur ise sahi jagah kharch karna."

e: Narrated Abu Huraira: This hadith has been transmitted through another chain the same as the narration of Ya'qub from Suhail (# 2212).
hi: Abu Huraira se bayan hua hai: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se, Yaqub ki Suhail se riwayat jaisi hi, bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: O people, Allah is Good and He therefore, accepts only that which is good. And Allah commanded the believers as He commanded the Messengers by saying: "O Messengers, eat of the good things, and do good deeds; verily I am aware of what you do" (xxiii. 51). And He said: "O those who believe, eat of the good things that We gave you" (ii. 172). He then made a mention of a person who travels widely, his hair disheveled and covered with dust. He lifts his hand towards the sky (and thus makes the supplication): "O Lord, O Lord," whereas his diet is unlawful, his drink is unlawful, and his clothes are unlawful and his nourishment is unlawful. How can then his supplication be accepted?
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Aye logo, Allah Pak hai aur Woh sirf woh qubool karta hai jo pak hai. Aur Allah ne momino ko wahi hukum diya jo usne Rasoolon ko diya ye kehte hue: "Aye Rasoolo, pak cheezein khao, aur nek amal karo; yaqeenan main jo tum karte ho usse waaqif hoon" (23:51). Aur Usne kaha: "Aye imaan waalo, un pak cheezon mein se khao jo humne tumhe di hain" (2:172). Unhone phir ek aise shakhs ka zikr kiya jo lambe safar karta hai, uske baal bikhre aur dhool se dhankay hue, woh apne haath aasmaan ki taraf uthaata hai aur yun dua karta hai: "Aye Rab, Aye Rab," jabki uska khaana haraam hai, uska peena haraam hai, aur uske kapde haraam hain aur uski parvarish haraam hai. Isper uski dua kaise qubool ho sakti hai?

e: 'Adi b. Hatim reported that he heard Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) as saying: He who among you can protect himself against Fire, he should do so, even if it should be with half a date.
hi: Adi bin Hatim ne bayan kiya ki unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Tum mein se jo bhi khud ko jahannam ki aag se bacha sake, use aisa karna chahiye, chahe aadhi khajoor se hi kyun na ho.

e: 'Adi b. Hatim reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Allah will speak with everyone amongst you without any interpreter between them. He (the man) would see towards his right and would not find anything but (the deeds) which he had done before, and he would see towards the left and would not find anything but (the deeds) which he had done before. He would see in front of him and would find nothing but Fire just before his face. So protect (yourselves) against Fire even if it is with the help of half a date. A hadith like this has been transmitted by Khaithama and addition has been made in this of (these words) ;" Even if it is with a good word."
hi: Adi bin Hatim ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Allah tum mein se har ek se bina kisi tarjumaan ke seedhe baat karega. Woh aadmi apni daayi taraf dekhega aur use kuch nahi milega siwaay un amalon ke jo usne pehle kiye hain, aur woh apni baayi taraf dekhega aur use kuch nahi milega siwaay un amalon ke jo usne pehle kiye hain. Woh apne saamne dekhega aur use kuch nahi milega siwaay aag ke, jo bilkul uske chehre ke saamne hogi. Is liye khud ko aag se bachaao, chahe aadhi khajoor ki madad se hi kyun na ho. Isi tarah ki ek hadees Khaithama ne bhi bayan ki hai aur isme ye izafa hai: "Chahe ek achhe lafz ke saath hi kyun na ho."

e: 'Adi b. Hatim reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) made a mention of Fire. He turned his face aside and diverted his attention and then said: Guard (yourselves) against Fire. He turned his face and diverted his attention till we thought as if he were (actually seeing it and then said: Protect yourselves against Fire even if it is with half a date, and he who does not find it, (he should do so) with pleasant words. Abu Kuraib did not mention the word: (as if).
hi: Adi bin Hatim ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne aag ka zikr kiya. Unhone apna chehra mod liya aur apni tawajjo hataayi aur phir kaha: Khud ko aag se bachao. Unhone apna chehra moda aur apni tawajjo hataayi yahan tak ki hamein laga jaise woh use waaqai dekh rahe hon, aur phir kaha: Khud ko aag se bachao, chahe aadhi khajoor se hi kyun na ho, aur jo use na paaye, use aisa karna chahiye achhe alfaazon se. Abu Kuraib ne lafz "jaise" ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: Adi b. Hatim reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) made a mention of the Fire and sought refuge (with Allah against it). He turned aside his face three times and then said: Protect yourselves against Fire even if with half a date. But if you fail to find it (then protect yourselves against Fire) with the help of a pleasant word).
hi: Adi bin Hatim ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne aag ka zikr kiya aur Allah se uski panah maangi. Unhone apna chehra teen baar mod liya aur phir kaha: Khud ko aag se bachao chahe aadhi khajoor se hi kyun na ho. Lekin agar tumhe ye na mile, to khud ko aag se bachao ek achhe lafz ki madad se.

e: Mundhir b. Jarir reported on the authority of his father: While we were in the company of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in the early hours of the morning, some people came there (who) were barefooted, naked, wearing striped woollen clothes, or cloaks, with their swords hung (around their necks). Most of them, nay, all of them, belonged to the tribe of Mudar. The colour of the face of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) underwent a change when he saw them in poverty. He then entered (his house) and came out and commanded Bilal (to pronounce Adhan). He pronounced Adhan and Iqima, and he (the Holy Prophet) observed prayer (along with his Companion) and then addressed (them reciting verses of the Holy Qur'an): '" 0 people, fear your Lord, Who created you from a single being" to the end of the verse," Allah is ever a Watcher over you" (iv. 1). (He then recited) a verse of Sura Hashr:" Fear Allah. and let every soul consider that which it sends forth for the morrow and fear Allah" (lix. 18). (Then the audience began to vie with one another in giving charity.) Some donated a dinar, others a dirham, still others clothes, some donated a sa' of wheat, some a sa' of dates; till he (the Holy Prophet) said: (Bring) even if it is half a date. Then a person from among the Ansar came there with a money bag which his hands could scarcely lift; in fact, they could not (lift). Then the people followed continuously, till I saw two heaps of eatables and clothes, and I saw the face of the Messenger (ﷺ) glistening, like gold (on account of joy). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: He who sets a good precedent in Islam, there is a reward for him for this (act of goodness) and reward of that also who acted according to it subsequently, without any deduction from their rewards; and he who sets in Islam an evil precedent, there is upon him the burden of that, and the burden of him also who acted upon it subsequently, without any deduction from their burden.
hi: Mundhir bin Jarir ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki: Jab hum subah ke pehle pehr mein Rasoolullah (SAW) ki sohbat mein the, kuch log wahan aaye jo nange paon the, nange the, dhaari-daar oon ke kapde ya chadar pehne hue, apni talwaaren apni gardanon mein latkaaye hue. Unmein se zyadatar, balki sab, Mudar qabile se the. Rasoolullah (SAW) ke chehre ka rang badal gaya jab unhone unhe garibi mein dekha. Woh phir apne ghar andar gaye aur bahar aaye aur Bilal ko hukum diya, azaan dene ka. Unhone azaan aur iqamat kahi, aur unhone namaz padhi apne sahaba ke saath aur phir khitaab kiya, unhe Quran ki aayaten padhkar sunaate hue: "Aye logo, apne Rab se daro, jisne tumhe ek hi jaan se paida kiya" hadees ke aakhir tak, "Allah hamesha tumpar nigraan hai" (4:1). Unhone phir Surah Hashr ki ek aayat padhi: "Allah se daro, aur har jaan ko ye dekhna chahiye ki usne kal ke liye kya bheja hai, aur Allah se daro" (59:18). Phir sunne wale ek-doosre se aage badhkar khairaat dene lage. Kuchne ek dinaar diya, doosron ne ek dirham, aur doosron ne kapde, kuchne ek sa gehun, kuchne ek sa khajoor; yahan tak ki unhone kaha: Laao, chahe woh aadhi khajoor hi kyun na ho. Phir Ansar mein se ek shakhs ek thaili lekar aaye jise unke haath mushkil se utha paa rahe the; asal mein, woh utha nahi paa rahe the. Phir log lagataar aate rahe, yahan tak ki maine khaane-peene ki cheezon aur kapdon ke do dher dekhe, aur maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ke chehre ko sone ki tarah chamakte dekha, khushi ki wajah se. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Jo Islam mein ek achhi misaal qaayam kare, uske liye uska is nek amal ka sawaab hai aur un logon ka bhi sawaab hai jo baad mein isper amal karein, bina unke sawaab mein koi kami kiye; aur jo Islam mein ek buri misaal qaayam kare, uspar uska bojh hai, aur un logon ka bhi bojh hai jo baad mein isper amal karein, bina unke bojh mein koi kami kiye.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Mandhir through another chain of transmitters. And the hadith transmitted by Ibn Mu'adh contains an addition: " He then observed the noon prayer and then gave the sermon."
hi: Ye hadees Mundhir ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki gayi hai. Aur Ibn Mu'adh ki bayan ki hui hadees mein ye izafa hai: "Unhone phir zohar ki namaz padhi aur phir khutba diya."

e: Mundhir b. Jarir narrated on the authority of his father: When we were sitting in the company of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). There came people dressed in striped woollen clothes, and the rest of the hadith in the same, and there (it is also mentioned):" He observed the Zuhr prayer and then climbed up a small pulpit, praised Allah, lauded Him, and then said: Verily Allah in His Book has revealed: 'O people, fear your Lord, ' etc." (iv. 1).
hi: Mundhir bin Jarir ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki: Jab hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ki sohbat mein baithe the. Kuch log dhaari-daar oon ke kapde pehne hue aaye, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai, aur wahan ye bhi zikr hai: "Unhone zohar ki namaz padhi aur phir ek chhote mimbar par chadhe, Allah ki tareef ki, uski hamd ki, aur phir kaha: Yaqeenan Allah ne apni Kitaab mein nazil kiya hai: 'Aye logo, apne Rab se daro,' waghera" (4:1).

e: Jarir b. 'Abdullah reported: People came to to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and they ware dressed in woollen clothes. He (the Holy Prophet) saw their dismal state, as they were suffering from want and the rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Jarir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya: Log Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aaye aur woh oon ke kapde pehne hue the. Unhone unki dukhi haalat dekhi, kyunki woh takleef mein the, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Abu Mas'ud reported: We were commanded to give charity (despite the fact.) that we were coolies. Abu 'Aqil donated half a sa'. And there came another man with more than this. The hypocrites said: Verily Allah does not stand in need of the charity of this, and the second one has done nothing but only made a show (of his charity). Then this verse was revealed." Those who scoff at the voluntary givers of charity among the believers as well as those who cannot find anything (to give) but with their hard labour" (ix. 80). And Bishr did not utter the word Muttawwi'in.
hi: Abu Mas'ud ne bayan kiya: Humein sadaqa dene ka hukum diya gaya, iske baawajood ki hum mazdoor the. Abu Aqil ne aadha sa diya. Aur ek doosra shakhs isse zyada lekar aaya. Munaafiqon ne kaha: Yaqeenan Allah ko is chhote sadaqe ki koi zaroorat nahi hai, aur doosre ne dikhawe ke siwaay kuch nahi kiya. Isper ye aayat nazil hui: "Woh jo momino mein se raazi-khushi sadaqa dene walon par taana kasein aur woh jinhe apni mehnat mazdoori ke siwaay kuch aur nahi milta" (9:80). Aur Bishr ne "Muttawwi'in" lafz nahi bola.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters and in the hadith transmitted by Sa'id b. al Rabi (the words are): " We used to carry loads on our backs."
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai aur Sa'id bin al-Rabi ki bayan ki hui hadees mein alfaaz hain: "Hum apni peeth par bojh dhote the."

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira (that the Messenger of Allah) said: Of course the person who gives to the family a she-camel as a gift, which gives milk morning and evening equal to a large bowl, its reward (the reward of the gift) is great.
hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Zaroor jo shakhs kisi gharane ko ek oontni tohfe mein deta hai, jo subah aur shaam ek badi katori ke barabar doodh de, uska sawaab, is tohfe ka sawaab, bahut bada hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade (to do certain things) and then he made a mention of certain habits and said: He who gives a she-camel as a gift, for him is the reward (of the gift) both morning and evening - a reward for drinking milk in the morning and a reward for drinking milk in the evening.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kuch cheezon se mana kiya aur phir kuch aadaton ka zikr kiya aur kaha: Jo koi ek oontni tohfe mein de, uske liye subah aur shaam dono ka sawaab hai - subah doodh peene ka sawaab aur shaam doodh peene ka sawaab.

e: Abu Haraira reported that the likeness of one who spends or one who gives charity is that of a person who has two cloaks or two coats-of-mail over him right from the breast to the collar bones. And when the spender (and the other narrator said, when the giver of charity) makes up his mind to give charity, it (coat-mail) becomes expanded for him. But when a miserly person intends to spend, it contracts and every ring grips the place where it is. For the giver of charity, this coat-of. mail expands to cover his whole body and obliterates even his footprints. Abu Huraira said: (The miserly man) tries to expand it (the coat-of-mail) but it does not expand.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki kharch karne wale ya sadaqa dene wale ki misaal ek aise shakhs jaisi hai jiske paas do chogay ya do zire hon, seene se lekar gale ki haddi tak. Aur jab kharch karne wala, aur doosre raawi ne kaha, jab sadaqa dene wala, sadaqa dene ka irada karta hai, to woh zira uske liye phail jaata hai. Lekin jab ek kanjoos shakhs kharch karne ka irada karta hai, to ye simat jaata hai aur har kadi apni jagah ko jakad leti hai. Sadaqa dene wale ke liye, ye zira uske poore badan ko dhaank ne ke liye phail jaata hai aur uske paon ke nishaan tak mita deta hai. Abu Huraira ne kaha: Kanjoos shakhs ise phailaane ki koshish karta hai lekin ye phailta nahi.

e: Abu Haraira reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) gave similitudes of a miserly man and the giver of charity as two persons who have two coats-of-mail over them with their hands pressed closely to their breasts and their collar bones. Whenever the giver of charity gives charity it (the coat-of mail) expands so much as to cover his finger tips and obliterate his foot prints. And whenever the miserly person intends to give charity (the coat-of-mail) contracts and every ring grips the place where it is. He (Abu Huraira) said: I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying with fingers in the opening of his shirt:" If you had seen him trying to expand it, it will not expand."
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne ek kanjoos shakhs aur sadaqa dene wale ki misaal do aise logon jaisi di jinke paas do zire hon, jinke haath unke seene aur unke gale ki haddi ke saath kaskar dabe hon. Jab bhi sadaqa dene wala sadaqa deta hai, to woh zira itna phailta hai ki uski ungliyon ke sirhon ko dhaank leta hai aur uske paon ke nishaan mita deta hai. Aur jab bhi kanjoos shakhs sadaqa dene ka irada karta hai, to zira simat jaata hai aur har kadi apni jagah ko jakad leti hai. Unhone kaha: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko apni ungliyaan apni qamees ke galey ke khule hisse mein daalte hue ye kehte dekha: "Agar tum use phailaane ki koshish karte dekho, to ye nahi phailega."

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: . The similitude of a miserly man and the giver of charity is that of two persons with coats of mail over them; when the giver of charity intends to give charity, it expands over him (to much so) that the footprints are also obliterated. And when the miserly man intends to give charity, it contracts over him, and his hands are tied up to his collar bone, and every ring is fixed up to another. He (the narrator) said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: He would try to expand it. but he would not be able to do so.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ek kanjoos shakhs aur sadaqa dene wale ki misaal do aise logon jaisi hai jinke paas zire hon; jab sadaqa dene wala sadaqa dene ka irada karta hai, to woh zira uspar itna phail jaata hai ki uske paon ke nishaan bhi mit jaate hain. Aur jab kanjoos shakhs sadaqa dene ka irada karta hai, to woh zira uspar simat jaata hai, aur uske haath uski gale ki haddi tak baandh diye jaate hain, aur har kadi doosri kadi se jud jaati hai. Raawi ne kaha: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Woh use phailaane ki koshish karega, lekin woh aisa nahi kar payega.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: A man expressed his intention to give charity, so he came out with charity and placed it in the hand of an adulteress. In the morning, the people were talking and saying: charity was given to an adulteress last night. He (the giver of Sadaqa) said: 0 Allah, to Thee be the praise-to an adulteress. He then again expressed his intention to give charity; so he went out with the charity and placed it in the hand of a rich person. In the morning the people were talking and saying: Charity was given to a rich person. He (the giver of charity) said: 0 Allah, to Thee be the praise-to a well-to-do person. He then expressed his intention to give charity, so he went out with charity and placed it in the hand of a thief. In the morning, the people were talking and saying: Charity was given to a thief. So (one of the persons) said: 0 Allah, to Thee be the praise (what a misfortune it is that charity has been given to) the adulteress, to a rich person. to a thief! There came (the angel to him) and he was told: Your charity has been accepted. As for the adulteress (the charity might become the means) whereby she might restrain herself from fornication. The rich man might perhaps learn a lesson and spend from what Allah has given him, and the thief might thereby refrain from committing theft.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ek shakhs ne sadaqa dene ka irada zaahir kiya, is liye woh sadaqa lekar nikla aur use ek zaani aurat ke haath mein rakh diya. Subah ko log baaten karne lage aur kehne lage: Kal raat sadaqa ek zaani aurat ko diya gaya. Unhone kaha: Aye Allah, Teri hi tareef hai - ek zaani aurat ko. Unhone phir sadaqa dene ka irada zaahir kiya; is liye woh sadaqa lekar bahar gaye aur use ek maaldaar shakhs ke haath mein rakh diya. Subah ko log baaten karne lage aur kehne lage: Sadaqa ek maaldaar shakhs ko diya gaya. Unhone kaha: Aye Allah, Teri hi tareef hai - ek khushhaal shakhs ko. Unhone phir sadaqa dene ka irada zaahir kiya, is liye woh sadaqa lekar bahar gaye aur use ek chor ke haath mein rakh diya. Subah ko log baaten karne lage aur kehne lage: Sadaqa ek chor ko diya gaya. Isper unmein se ek ne kaha: Aye Allah, Teri hi tareef hai, kitni bad-kismati hai ki sadaqa diya gaya zaani aurat ko, maaldaar shakhs ko, chor ko! Unke paas farishta aaya aur unse kaha gaya: Tumhara sadaqa qubool kar liya gaya hai. Jahan tak zaani aurat ka sawal hai, sadaqa uske liye zina se rukne ka zariya ban sakta hai. Maaldaar shakhs shayad sabaq seekhe aur Allah ne jo use diya hai usmein se kharch kare, aur chor is tarah chori karne se ruk sakta hai.

e: Abu Musa reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: The honest Muslim trustee who spends (sometimes he said" who gives" ) what he is commanded to do and he gives that in full with his heart overflowing with cheerfulness and he gives it to one to whom he is ordered, he is one of the givers of charity.
hi: Abu Musa ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Woh imaandaar Musalman jimmedaar jo, kabhi kabhi unhone kaha "jo deta hai", jiska hukum use diya gaya hai use ada karta hai aur ise poore taur par apne dil mein khushi bharkar deta hai, aur ise us shakhs ko deta hai jise dene ka use hukum diya gaya hai, woh bhi sadaqa dene walon mein se ek hai.

e: 'A'isha reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When a woman gives in charity some of the food in her house, without causing any damage, there is reward for her for whatever she has given, and a reward for her husband for what he earned. The same applies to the trustee. In no respect does the one diminish the reward of the other.
hi: Aisha ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab koi aurat apne ghar mein khaane mein se kuch sadaqe mein deti hai, bina koi nuksaan pahunchaaye, to use jo bhi usne diya uska sawaab milta hai, aur uske shohar ko unki kamaai ka sawaab milta hai. Yehi baat jimmedaar, khaazin, par bhi laagu hoti hai. Kisi bhi tarah se ek doosre ke sawaab ko kam nahi karta.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Mansur with the same chain of transmitters (with this alteration of words): " from the food of her husband".
hi: Ye hadees Mansur ne isi sanad se in alfaaz ki tabdeeli ke saath bayan ki hai: "unke shohar ke khaane mein se."

e: 'A'isha reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When a woman spends (something as Sadaqa) out of the household of her husband without causing any damage, there is a reward for her and for him too like it for whatever he earned, and for her (for the wife) because of her spending (for the sake of Allah), and for the trustee also (there is a reward like it), without any reduction from their rewards.
hi: Aisha ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab koi aurat apne shohar ke ghar mein se kuch, Sadaqe ke taur par, kharch karti hai bina koi nuksaan pahunchaaye, to use bhi sawaab milta hai aur usse, shohar ko, bhi jo usne kamaya uska sawaab, aur use, biwi ko, uske kharch karne ki wajah se, Allah ki khaatir, aur jimmedaar ko bhi waisa hi sawaab milta hai, bina unke sawaab mein koi kami kiye.

e: This hadith has been narrated by A'mash with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees A'mash ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: Umair, the freed slave of Abi'l-Lahm reported: I was the slave (of Abi'l-Lahm). I asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) if I could give some charity out of my master's wealth. He said: Yes, and the reward is half and half between you two.
hi: Umair, Abi'l-Lahm ke aazad kiye hue ghulam, ne bayan kiya: Main Abi'l-Lahm ka ghulam tha. Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) se poocha ki kya main apne maalik ki daulat mein se kuch sadaqa de sakta hoon. Unhone kaha: Haan, aur sawaab tum dono ke beech aadha-aadha hoga.

e: 'Umair, the freed slave of Abi'l-Lahm, said: My master commanded me to cut some meat in strips; (as I was doing it) a poor man came to me and I gave him some of it to eat. My master came to know of that, and he beat me. I came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and narrated it to him. He (the Holy Prophet) summoned him and said: Why did you beat him? He (Abi'l-Lahm) said: He gives away my food without being commanded to do so. Upon this he (the Holy Prophet) said: The reward would be shared by you two.
hi: Umair, Abi'l-Lahm ke aazad kiye hue ghulam, ne kaha: Mere maalik ne mujhe hukum diya ki main kuch gosht ki patti kaat lun; jab main ye kar raha tha, ek gareeb shakhs mere paas aaya aur maine use usmein se kuch khaane ke liye diya. Mere maalik ko iski khabar mili, aur unhone mujhe maara. Main Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unhe ye bataya. Unhone unhe bulaya aur kaha: Tumne use kyun maara? Unhone kaha: Woh bina mere hukum ke mera khaana de deta hai. Isper unhone kaha: Sawaab tum dono ke beech baant diya jaayega.

e: Hammam b. Munabbih said: These are some of the a hadith of Muhammad. the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), transmitted to us on the authority of Abu Huraira. So he narrated one hadith out of them (as this): The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: No woman should observe fast when her spouse is present (in the house) but with his permission. And she should not admit any (mahram) in his house, while he (her husband) is present, but with his permission. And whatever she spends from his earnings without his sanction, for him is half the reward.
hi: Hammam bin Munabbih ne kaha: Ye Muhammad, Rasoolullah (SAW), ki kuch hadeesein hain jo humein Abu Huraira ne riwayat ki hain. To unhone unmein se ek hadees bayan ki is tarah: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Koi bhi aurat roza na rakhe jab uska shohar ghar mein maujood ho, siwaay uski ijazat ke. Aur use uske ghar mein kisi ko mahram daakhil nahi karna chahiye, jab woh uska shohar maujood ho, siwaay uski ijazat ke. Aur woh jo bhi uski kamaai mein se uski ijazat ke bagair kharch karti hai, uske liye aadha sawaab hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If anyone contributes a pair of anything for the sake of Allah, he would be invited to enter Paradise (with these words): O servant of Allah, it is good (for you). Those who engage in prayer will he invited to enter by the gate of prayer; those who take part in Jihad will be invited to enter by the gate of Jihad; those who give charity will be invited to enter by the gate of charity; and those who observe fast will be invited to enter by the gate ar-Rayyan. Abu Bakr Siddiq said: Messenger of Allah, is it necessary that a person be invited through one of these gates? Will anyone be invited to enter by all those gates? The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Yes, and I hope you will be one of them.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Agar koi Allah ki khaatir kisi bhi cheez ka jodaa deta hai, to use Jannat mein daakhil hone ke liye bulaaya jaayega in alfaazon ke saath: Aye Allah ke banda, ye tumhare liye achha hai. Jo namaz mein masroof rehte hain unhe namaz ke darwaze se andar aane ka bulaawa diya jaayega; jo Jihad mein hissa lete hain unhe Jihad ke darwaze se andar aane ka bulaawa diya jaayega; jo sadaqa dete hain unhe sadaqe ke darwaze se andar aane ka bulaawa diya jaayega; aur jo roze rakhte hain unhe ar-Rayyan ke darwaze se andar aane ka bulaawa diya jaayega. Abu Bakr Siddiq ne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, kya ye zaroori hai ki kisi shakhs ko in darwazon mein se ek se bulaaya jaaye? Kya kisi ko in sab darwazon se andar aane ka bulaawa milega? Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Haan, aur mujhe ummeed hai ki tum unmein se ek hoge.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Zuhri through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who spent pairs for the sake of Allah, the guardians of Paradise would call him, (in fact) every guardian of the door (of Paradise would welcome him saying): O, so and so, come on. Upon this Abu Bakr said: Messenger of Allah, (it means) there would be no distress on this person. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said. I hope you would be among them.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jisne Allah ki khaatir jodaa kharch kiya, use Jannat ke darbaan bulaayenge, dar-asal har darwaze ka darbaan use khushamdeed kehta hua bulaayega: Aye falan, aao. Isper Abu Bakr ne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, iska matlab hai ki is shakhs ko koi taklif nahi hogi. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Mujhe ummeed hai ki tum unmein se hoge.

e: Abu Huraira reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Who fasted among you today? Abu Bakr (Allah be pleased with him) replied: I did. He (the Prophet again) said: Who among you followed a bier today? Abu Bakr (Allah be pleased with him) replied: I did. He (the Prophet again) said: Who among you fed a poor man today? Abu Bakr (Allah he pleased with him) replied: I did. He (again) said: Who among you visited an invalid today? Abu Bakr (Allah be pleased with him) said: I did. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Anyone in whom (these good deeds) are combined will certainly enter paradise.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Tum mein se aaj kisne roza rakha? Abu Bakr ne jawab diya: Maine. Unhone dobara kaha: Tum mein se aaj kisne kisi janaze ke saath jaan? Abu Bakr ne jawab diya: Maine. Unhone dobara kaha: Tum mein se aaj kisne kisi gareeb ko khaana khilaya? Abu Bakr ne jawab diya: Maine. Unhone dobara kaha: Tum mein se aaj kisne kisi beemar ki tabiyat poochi? Abu Bakr ne kaha: Maine. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Jismein bhi ye nek amal ikattha ho jaayein, woh zaroor Jannat mein daakhil hoga.

e: Asma', daughter of Abu Bakr (Allah be pleased with him), reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me: Spend, and do not calculate, or otherwise Allah would also calculate in your case.
hi: Asma, Abu Bakr ki beti, ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne mujhse kaha: Kharch kar, aur hisaab mat laga, warna Allah bhi tumhare maamle mein hisaab lagaayega.

e: Asma' reported Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) as saying (to her): Spend and do not calculate, (for) Allah would calculate in your case; and do not hoard, otherwise Allah would be withholding from you.
hi: Asma ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko unse ye kehte suna: Kharch karo aur hisaab mat lagao, kyunki Allah tumhare maamle mein hisaab lagaayega; aur daulat jama karke mat rakho, warna Allah tumse apna anugrah rok lega.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Asma' through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Asma ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Asma', daughter of Abu Bakr, reported that abe came to the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) and said: Apostle of Allah, I have nothing with me, but only, that which is given to me by Zubair (for household expenses). Is there any sin for me if I spend out of that which is given to me (by Zabair)? Upon this he (the Holy Prophet) said: Spend according to your means; and do not hoard, for Allah will withhold from you.
hi: Asma, Abu Bakr ki beti, ne bayan kiya ki woh Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aayin aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mere paas kuch nahi hai siwaay uske jo Zubair, ghar ke kharche ke liye, mujhe deta hai. Kya mujhpar koi gunah hoga agar main us mein se kharch karun jo mujhe Zubair se diya jaata hai? Isper unhone kaha: Apni haisiyat ke mutabik kharch karo; aur jama karke mat rakho, kyunki Allah tumse apna anugrah rok lega.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: O Muslim women, none of you should consider even a sheep's trotter too insignificant to give to her neighbour.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Aye Musalman auraton, tum mein se koi bhi bakri ke khur ko apni padosan ko dene ke liye itna mamooli na samjhe.

e: Abu Huraira reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had said: Seven are (the persons) whom Allah would give protection with His Shade on the Day when there would be no shade but that of Him (i. e. on the Day of Judgment, and they are): a just ruler, a youth who grew up with the worship of Allah; a person whose heart is attached to the mosques; two persons who love and meet each other and depart from each other for the sake of Allah; a man whom a beautiful woman of high rank seduces (for illicit relation), but he (rejects this offer by saying):" I fear Allah" ; a person who gives charity and conceals it (to such an extent) that the right hand does not know what the left has given: and a person who remembered Allah in privacy and his eyes shed tears.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Saat log hain jinhe Allah apne Saaye mein panah dega us Din jab koi bhi saaya nahi hoga siwaay Uske Saaye ke, yaani Qayamat ke Din, aur woh hain: ek insaaf-pasand hukmaraan, ek jawaan jo Allah ki ibadat mein bada hua; ek shakhs jiska dil masjidon se juda hua ho; do log jo Allah ki khaatir ek doosre se mohabbat karte hain aur milte hain aur alag hote hain; ek aadmi jise ek khoobsurat, ooncha darja rakhne wali aurat behka de, naajaayez taalluq ke liye, lekin woh isse mana kar de ye kehte hue: "Main Allah se darta hoon"; ek aisa shakhs jo sadaqa deta hai aur ise itna chhupata hai ki uska daayan haath nahi jaanta ki baaye haath ne kya diya; aur ek aisa shakhs jisne akele mein Allah ko yaad kiya aur uski aankhon se aansu bahe.

e: This hadith has been narrated, on the authority, of Abu Huraira (with this change of words)." A person whose heart is attached to the mosque when he goes out of it till he returns to it."
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se in alfaaz ki tabdeeli ke saath bayan ki gayi hai: "Ek shakhs jiska dil masjid se juda hua ho jab woh usse bahar jaaye yahan tak ki woh wapas usmein aa jaaye."

e: Abu Huraira reported that there came a person to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: Messenger of Allah, which charity is the best? Upon this he said: That you should give charity (in a state when you are) healthy and close-fisted, one haunted by the fear of poverty, hoping to become rich (charity in such a state of health and mind is the best). And you must not defer (charity to such a length) that you are about to die and would he saying: This is for so and so, and this is for so and so. Lo, it has already come into (the possession of so and so).
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, kaunsi sadaqa sabse behtar hai? Isper unhone kaha: Ye ki tum sadaqa do jab tum sehatmand ho aur kanjoos ho, gareebi ke dar mein raha ho, ameer banne ki ummeed rakhte ho, aisi sehat aur zehniyat mein sadaqa dena sabse behtar hai. Aur tumhe sadaqa ko itni der tak taalna nahi chahiye ki tum marne ke qareeb ho aur keh rahe ho: Ye falan ke liye hai, aur ye falan ke liye hai. Dekho, ye pehle hi falan ke maalikaana mein aa chuka hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported that a person came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: Messenger of Allah, which charity is the greatest in reward? (The Prophet said): By your father, beware, you should give charity (in a state when you are) healthy and close-fisted, haunted by the fear of poverty, and still hoping to live (as rich). And you must not defer charity (to the time) when you are about to die, and would then say:" This is for so and so, and this for so and so." It has already become the possession of so and so.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, kaunsi sadaqa sawaab mein sabse buland hai? Nabi ne kaha: Tumhare waalid ki qasam, khabardaar, tumhe sadaqa dena chahiye jab tum sehatmand ho aur kanjoos ho, gareebi ke dar mein raha ho, aur phir bhi, ameer ki tarah, jeene ki ummeed rakhte ho. Aur tumhe sadaqa us waqt ke liye nahi taalna chahiye jab tum marne ke qareeb ho, aur phir kaho: "Ye falan ke liye hai, aur ye falan ke liye hai." Ye pehle hi falan ke maalikaana mein aa chuka hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated with the same chain of transmitters except with this change (of words): " Which charity is most excellent?"
hi: Ye hadees isi sanad se bayan ki gayi hai siwaay is tabdeeli, alfaaz mein, ke: "Kaunsa sadaqa sabse behtareen hai?"

e: Abdullah b. Umar reported that as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was sitting on the pulpit and talking about Sadaqa and abstention from begging, he said: The upper hand is better than the lower one, the upper being the one which bestows and the lower one which begs.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar ne bayan kiya ki jab Rasoolullah (SAW) mimbar par baithe the aur sadaqa aur bhikh se bachne ke baare mein baat kar rahe the, to unhone kaha: Ooparwaala haath neeche wale haath se behtar hai, ooparwaala woh hai jo deta hai aur neeche wala woh jo maangta hai.

e: Hakim b. Hizam reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said this: The most excellent Sadaqa or the best of Sadaqa is that after giving which the (giver) remains rich and the upper hand is better than the lower hand, and begin from the members of your household.
hi: Hakim bin Hizam ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Sabse behtareen sadaqa, ya sadaqe mein sabse achha, woh hai jise dene ke baad dene wala maaldaar hi rahe aur ooparwaala haath neeche wale haath se behtar hai, aur apne gharwalon se shuru karo.

e: Hakim b. Hizam reported: I begged the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and he gave me. I again begged, he again gave me. I again begged, he again gave me, and then said: This property is green and sweet; he who receives it with a cheerful heart is blessed in it, and he who receives it with an avaricious mind would not be blessed in it, he being like one who eats without being satished, and the upper hand is better thad the lower hand.
hi: Hakim bin Hizam ne bayan kiya: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) se maanga, aur unhone mujhe diya. Maine phir maanga, unhone phir mujhe diya. Maine phir maanga, unhone phir mujhe diya, aur phir kaha: Ye maal hari-bhari aur meethi hai; jo ise khush dil se qubool karta hai, usmein barkat hoti hai, aur jo ise lalchai nazar se qubool karta hai, usmein barkat nahi hoti, woh us shakhs jaisa hai jo khaata hai lekin seer nahi hota, aur ooparwaala haath neeche wale haath se behtar hai.

e: Abu Umama reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: O son of Adam, it is better for you if you spend your surplus (wealth), but if you withhold it, it is evil for you. There is (however) no reproach for you (if you withhold means necessary) for a living. And begin (charity) with your dependents; and the upper hand is better than the lower hand.
hi: Abu Umama ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Aye Aadam ke bete, tumhare liye behtar hai ki tum apni zyaada daulat kharch karo, lekin agar tum ise roke rakho, to ye tumhare liye buraai hai. Tumhare liye koi malamat nahi hai agar tum ise roke rakho jo zindagi guzarne ke liye zaroori ho. Aur sadaqa apni zimmedaari mein aane walon se shuru karo; aur ooparwaala haath neeche wale haath se behtar hai.

e: Mu'awiya said: Be cautious about ahadith except those which were current during the reign of Umar, for he exhorted people to fear Allah, the Exalted and mMajestic. I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: He upon whom Allah intends to bestow goodness, He confers upon him an insight in religion; and I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: I am the treasurer. To one whom I give out of (my own) sweet will, he would be blessed in that, but he whom I give (yielding to) his constant begging and for his covetousness is like one who would eat, but would not be satisfied.
hi: Muawiya ne kaha: Hadeeson ke baare mein ehtiyaat rakho siwaay unke jo Umar ke daur mein raaij thin, kyunki unhone logon ko Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, se darne ki targheeb di. Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jispar Allah bhalaai ata karna chahta hai, Woh use deen ki samajh deta hai; aur maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Main khazaanchi hoon. Jise main apni khushi se deta hoon, use isme barkat milegi, lekin jise main uski musalsal bhikh aur uske lalach ki wajah se deta hoon, woh us shakhs jaisa hai jo khaayega, lekin seer nahi hoga.

e: Mu'awiya reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Do not press in a matter, for I swear by Allah, none of you who asks me for anything and manages to get his request while I disdain it, will he be blessed in that which I give him.
hi: Muawiya ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Kisi maamle mein zor mat daalo, kyunki Allah ki qasam, tum mein se koi bhi jo mujhse kuch maangta hai aur apni khwahish paane mein kaamyaab hota hai jabki main ise napasand karta hoon, use usmein koi barkat nahi milegi jo main use dunga.

e: 'Amr b. Dinar reported from Wahb b. Munabbih: I went to his house in San'a' and he offered me nuts grown in his house to eat. And his brother said: I heard Mu'awiya b. Abu Sufyan saying that he had heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying, and then he made a mention (of a hadith) like one mentioned above.
hi: Amr bin Dinar ne Wahb bin Munabbih se riwayat ki: Main San'a mein unke ghar gaya aur unhone mujhe unke ghar ugaayi hui mewe khaane ko dee. Aur unke bhai ne kaha: Maine Muawiya bin Abu Sufyan ko ye kehte suna ki unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, aur phir unhone ek hadees ka zikr kiya jaisa upar zikr hua hai.

e: Abd al-Rahman b. Auf reported: I heard Mu'awiya b. Abu Sufyan saying in an address that he had heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: He to whom Allah intends to do good, He gives him insight into religion. And I am only the distributor while Allah is the Bestower.
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Auf ne bayan kiya: Maine Muawiya bin Abu Sufyan ko ek khitaab mein ye kehte suna ki unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jise Allah bhalaai karna chahta hai, Woh use deen ki samajh deta hai. Aur main sirf baantne wala hoon jabki Allah dene wala hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The poor man (miskin) is not the one who goes round to the people and is dismissed with one or two morsels. and one or two dates. They (the Prophet's Companions) said: Messenger of Allah, then who is miskin? He said: He who does not get enough to satisfy him, and he is not considered so (as to elicit the attention of the benevolent people), so that charity way be given to him. and he does not beg anything from people.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Miskeen, asal muhtaaj, woh nahi hai jo logon ke paas jaata hai aur use ek ya do niwaale, aur ek ya do khajooren dekar vida kar diya jaata hai. Unhone poocha: Ya Rasoolullah, phir miskeen kaun hai? Unhone kaha: Woh jise itna nahi milta ki woh seer ho sake, aur usse log ye nahi samajhte, ki woh madad ka mustahiq hai, taaki use sadaqa diya jaaye, aur woh khud logon se kuch nahi maangta.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Miskin is not he who is dismissed with one or two dates, and with one morsel or two morsels. (In fact) miskin is he who abstains (from begging). Read if you so desire (the verse):" They beg not of men importunately)" (ii. 273).
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Miskeen woh nahi hai jise ek ya do khajooron, aur ek ya do niwaalon dekar vida kar diya jaata hai. Asal mein miskeen woh hai jo bhikh maangne se parhez karta hai. Agar tum chaho to ye padho, aayat: "Woh logon se zid karke nahi maangte" (2:273).

e: This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Hamza. son of 'Abdullah, reported on the authority of his father that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When a man is always begging from people. he would meet Allah (in a state) that there would be no flesh on his face.
hi: Hamza, Abdullah ke bete, ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Jab koi aadmi hamesha logon se bhikh maangta rehta hai, to woh Allah se aisi haalat mein milega ki uske chehre par koi gosht nahi hoga.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of the brother of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters, but no mention has been made of the word" muz'a" (piece).
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ke bhai ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai, lekin "tukda" lafz ka koi zikr nahi kiya gaya.

e: Hamza b. 'Abdullah b. Umar heard his father say that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had said: The person would continue begging from people till he would come on the Day of Resurrection and there would be no flesh on his face.
hi: Hamza bin Abdullah bin Umar ne apne walid ko ye kehte suna ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha tha: Shakhs logon se bhikh maangta rahega yahan tak ki woh Qayamat ke din is haalat mein aayega ki uske chehre par koi gosht nahi hoga.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who begs the riches of others to increase his own is asking only for live coals, so let him ask a little or much.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo doosron ki daulat maangkar apni daulat badhana chahta hai, woh sirf dahakte huye koyle maang raha hai, is liye use chahiye woh kam maange ya zyada.

e: Abu Huraira is reported to have heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: It is better for one among you to bring a load of firewood on his back and give charity out of it (and satisfy his own need) and be independent of people, than that he should beg from people, whether they give him anything or refuse him. Verily the upper hand is better than the lower hand, and begin (charity) with your dependents.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Tum mein se kisi ke liye behtar hai ki woh apni peeth par lakdiyon ka bojh laaye aur usmein se sadaqa de aur apni zaroorat poori kare aur logon se aazad rahe, is baat se ki woh logon se bhikh maange, chahe woh use kuch dein ya use inkaar karein. Yaqeenan ooparwaala haath neeche wale haath se behtar hai, aur apni zimmedaari mein aane walon se sadaqa shuru karo.

e: Qais b. Abu Hizam reported: We came to Abu Huraira and he told Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said this: By Allah, (it is better) that one among you should go and bring a load of firewood on his back and he should sell it, and the rest of the hadith was narrated (like the previous one).
hi: Qais bin Abu Hizam ne bayan kiya: Hum Abu Huraira ke paas aaye aur unhone bataya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne ye kaha: Allah ki qasam, ye behtar hai ki tum mein se koi jaaye aur apni peeth par lakdiyon ka bojh laaye aur use beche, aur baaki hadees waisi hi bayan ki gayi jaisi pehle wali thi.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: It is better for any one of you to tie a bundle of firewood and carry it on his back and sell it than to beg a person, he may give or may refuse.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Tum mein se kisi ke liye behtar hai ki woh lakdiyon ka bandhan baandhe aur use apni peeth par laadkar le jaaye aur use beche, bajaye is ke ki woh kisi shakhs se bhikh maange, chahe woh use de ya inkaar kar de.

e: Malik al-Ashja'i reported: We, nine, eight or seven men, were in the company of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he said: Why don't you pledge allegiance to the Messenger of Allah? -while we had recently pledged allegiance. So we said: Messenger of Allah, we have already pledged allegiance to you. He again said: Why don't you pledge allegiance to the Messenger of Allah? And we said: Messenger of Allah, we have already pledged allegiance to you. He again said: Why don't you pledge allegiance to the Messenger of Allah? We stretched our hands and said: Messenger of Allah. we have already pledged allegiance to you. Now tell (on what things) should we pledge allegiance to you. He said I (You must pledge allegiance) that you would worship Allah only and would not associate with Him anything, (and observe) five prayers, and obey- (and he said onething in an undertone) -that you would not beg people of anything. (And as a consequence of that) I saw that some of these people did not ask anyone to pick up the whip for them if it fell down.
hi: Malik al-Ashja'i ne bayan kiya: Hum, nau, aath ya saat aadmi, Rasoolullah (SAW) ki sohbat mein the aur unhone kaha: Tum Rasoolullah (SAW) se bai'at kyun nahi karte? - jabki humne haal hi mein bai'at ki thi. To humne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, humne pehle hi aapse bai'at kar li hai. Unhone phir kaha: Tum Rasoolullah (SAW) se bai'at kyun nahi karte? Aur humne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, humne pehle hi aapse bai'at kar li hai. Unhone phir kaha: Tum Rasoolullah (SAW) se bai'at kyun nahi karte? Humne apne haath phailaaye aur kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, humne pehle hi aapse bai'at kar li hai. Ab bataiye kin baaton par hum aapse bai'at karein. Unhone kaha: Tumhe is baat par bai'at karni chahiye ki tum sirf Allah ki ibadat karoge aur Uske saath kisi ko shareek nahi karoge, aur paanch namazon ki paalna karoge, aur itaat karoge - aur unhone dheemi awaaz mein ek baat kahi - ki tum logon se kuch nahi maangoge. Aur iske natije mein maine dekha ki inmein se kuch log kisi se apni koda uthaane ke liye bhi nahi kehte the agar woh gir jaati.

e: Qabisa b. Mukhariq al-Hilali said: I was under debt and I came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and begged from him regarding it. He said: Wait till we receive Sadaqa, so that we order that to be given to you. He again said: Qabisa, begging is not permissible but for one of the three (classes) of persons: one who has incurred debt, for him begging is permissible till he pays that off, after which he must stop it; a man whose property has been destroyed by a calamity which has smitten him, for him begging is permissible till he gets what will support life, or will provide him reasonable subsistence; and a person who has been smitten by poverty. the genuineness of which is confirmed by three intelligent members of this peoples for him begging is permissible till he gets what will support him, or will provide him subsistence. Qabisa, besides these three (every other reason) for begging is forbidden, and one who engages in such consumes that what is forbidden.
hi: Qabisa bin Mukhariq al-Hilali ne kaha: Main qarz mein tha aur main Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unse iske baare mein bhikh maangi. Unhone kaha: Intezaar karo yahan tak ki humein sadaqa mile, taaki hum use tumhe dene ka hukum dein. Unhone phir kaha: Qabisa, bhikh maangna sirf teen tarah ke logon ke liye jaayez hai: ek woh jo qarzdaar ho gaya hai, uske liye bhikh maangna tab tak jaayez hai jab tak woh use chuka na de, jiske baad use ise rok dena chahiye; ek aadmi jiski maal ek museebat se tabaah ho gayi ho jo uspar aayi hai, uske liye bhikh maangna tab tak jaayez hai jab tak use itna na mil jaaye jisse uski zindagi ka sahaara mile, ya jo use munaasib guzaara de; aur ek shakhs jispar gareebi aayi hai, jiski asliyat is qaum ke teen aqlmand logon ne tasdeeq ki ho, uske liye bhikh maangna tab tak jaayez hai jab tak use itna na mil jaaye jo use sahaara de, ya jo use guzaara de. Qabisa, in teenon ke ilawa, har doosri wajah se, bhikh maangna haraam hai, aur jo aisa karta hai woh haraam khaata hai.

e: Salim b. Abdullah b. 'Umar reported on the authority of his father ('Abdullah b. 'Umar) that he had heard 'Umar b. Khattab (Allah be pleased with him) saying: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) gave me a gift, but I said: Give it to one who needs it more than I. He gave me wealth for the second time but I said: Give it to one who needs it more than I. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Take out of this wealth which comes to you without your being avaricious and without begging, but in other circumstance's do not let your heart hanker after it.
hi: Salim bin Abdullah bin Umar ne apne walid, Abdullah bin Umar, ke hawale se riwayat ki ki unhone Umar bin Khattab (RA) ko ye kehte suna: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne mujhe ek tohfa diya, lekin maine kaha: Ise us shakhs ko de dijiye jisko iski mujhse zyada zaroorat hai. Unhone mujhe doosri baar daulat di lekin maine kaha: Ise us shakhs ko de dijiye jisko iski mujhse zyada zaroorat hai. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Is daulat mein se le lo jo tumhare paas bina tumhari lalach ke aur bina bhikh maange aaye, lekin doosri sooraton mein apne dil ko iski taraf lalchaane mat do.

e: Salim b. 'Abdullah reported on the authority of his father that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) gave to 'Umar b. Khattab some gift. Umar said to him: Messenger of Allah, give it to one who needs it more than I. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Take it; either keep it with you or give it as a charity, and whatever comes to you in the form of this type of wealth, without your being avaricious or begging for it, accept it, but in other circumstances do not let your heart hanker after it. And it was on account of this that Ibn 'Umar never begged anything from anyone, nor refused anything given to him.
hi: Salim bin Abdullah ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Umar bin Khattab ko kuch tohfa diya. Umar ne unse kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, ise us shakhs ko de dijiye jisko iski mujhse zyada zaroorat hai. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Ise le lo; ise apne paas rakho ya sadaqe mein de do, aur jo bhi tumhare paas is tarah ki daulat aaye, bina tumhari lalach ke ya bhikh maange, use qubool karo, lekin doosri sooraton mein apne dil ko iski taraf lalchaane mat do. Aur isi wajah se, Ibn Umar ne kabhi bhi kisi se kuch nahi maanga, na hi kabhi unhe jo diya gaya use inkaar kiya.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Abdullah b. al-Sa'di from 'Umar b. al-Khattab who heard it from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).
hi: Ye hadees Abdullah bin al-Sa'di ke hawale se bayan ki gayi hai jinhone ise Umar bin Khattab se suna, jinhone ise Rasoolullah (SAW) se suna.

e: Ibn al-Sa'di Maliki reported: 'Umar b. Khattab (Allah be pleased with him) appointed me as a collector of Sadaqa. When I had finished that (the task assigned to me) and I handed over that to him (to 'Umar), he commanded me to (accept) some remuneration (for the work). I said: I performed this duty for Allah and my reward is with Allah. He said: Take whatever has been given to you, for I also performed this duty during the time of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He assigned me the task of a collector and I said as you say, and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me: When you are given anything without your begging for it, (then accept it), eat it and give it in charity.
hi: Ibn al-Sa'di Maliki ne bayan kiya: Umar bin Khattab (RA) ne mujhe Sadaqa jama karne wale ke taur par muqarrar kiya. Jab main woh, mujhe di gayi zimmedaari, mukammal kar chuka aur maine use, Umar ko, sonp diya, to unhone mujhe kuch mehnataana, kaam ke badle, dene ka hukum diya. Maine kaha: Maine ye zimmedaari Allah ke liye poori ki hai aur mera badla Allah ke paas hai. Unhone kaha: Jo bhi tumhe diya jaaye use le lo, kyunki maine bhi Rasoolullah (SAW) ke daur mein ye zimmedaari nibhaayi thi. Unhone mujhe bhi jama karne wale ka kaam diya tha aur maine wahi kaha jo tum keh rahe ho, aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ne mujhse kaha: Jab tumhe kuch diya jaaye bina tumhare bhikh maange, to use qubool karo, use khao aur ise sadaqe mein bhi do.

e: Ibn al-Sa'di reported: 'Umar b. Khattab (Allah be pleased with him) appointed me as a collector of Sadaqat. The rest of the hadith in the same.
hi: Ibn al-Sa'di ne bayan kiya: Umar bin Khattab (RA) ne mujhe Sadaqaat jama karne wale ke taur par muqarrar kiya. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as having said this: The heart of an old person feels young for the love of two things: love for long life and wealth.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Boodhe shakhs ka dil do cheezon ki mohabbat mein jawaan mehsoos karta hai: lambi umar ki chaahat aur daulat ki chaahat.

e: Abu Huraira reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had said this: The heart of an old person is young for two things: for long life and love for wealth.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Boodhe shakhs ka dil do cheezon ke liye jawaan rehta hai: lambi umar ke liye aur daulat ki mohabbat ke liye.

e: Anas reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The son of Adam grows old, but two (desires) in him remain young: desire for wealth and desire for life.
hi: Anas ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Aadam ki aulaad boodhi ho jaati hai, lekin usmein do khwahishen jawaan hi rehti hain: daulat ki khwahish aur zindagi ki khwahish.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated by Anas through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Anas ne ek doosri sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Anas through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Anas ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Anas reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If the son of Adam were to possess two valleys of riches. he would long for the third one. And the stomach of the son of Adam is not filled but with dust. And Allah returns to him who repents.
hi: Anas ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Agar Aadam ke bete ke paas daulat ki do wadiyaan hon, to woh teesri wadi ki khwahish karega. Aur Aadam ke bete ka pet sirf mitti se hi bharta hai. Aur Allah us shakhs ki taraf mudta hai jo tauba karta hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying this, but I do not know whether this thing was revealed to him or not, but he said to.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, lekin mujhe nahi pata ki ye baat unpar wahi ke taur par nazil hui thi ya nahi, lekin unhone kaha.

e: Anas b. Malik reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If there were two valleys of gold for the son of Adam, he would long for another one. and his mouth will not be filled but with dust, and Allah returns to him who repents.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Agar Aadam ke bete ke paas sone ki do wadiyaan hotin, to woh ek aur ki khwahish karega, aur uska munh sirf mitti se hi bharega, aur Allah us shakhs ki taraf mudta hai jo tauba karta hai.

e: Ibn Abbas reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If there were for the son of Adam a valley full of riches, he would long to possess another one like it. and Ibn Adam does not feel satiated but with dust. And Allah returns to him who returns (to Him). Ibn Abbas said: I do not know whether it is from the Qur'an or not; and in the narration transmitted by Zuhair it was said: I do not know whether it is from the Qur'an, and he made no mention of Ibn Abbas.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Agar Aadam ke bete ke paas daulat se bhari ek wadi hoti, to woh iski hi tarah ek aur ki khwahish karega, aur Ibn Aadam sirf mitti se hi seer hota hai. Aur Allah us shakhs ki taraf mudta hai jo Uski taraf laut aata hai. Ibn Abbas ne kaha: Mujhe nahi pata ki ye Quran mein se hai ya nahi; aur Zuhair ki riwayat mein kaha gaya: Mujhe nahi pata ki ye Quran mein se hai, aur unhone Ibn Abbas ka koi zikr nahi kiya.

e: Abu Harb b. Abu al-Aswad reported on the authority of his father that Abu Musa al-Ash'ari sent for the reciters of Basra. They came to him and they were three hundred in number. They recited the Qur'an and he said: You are the best among the inhabitants of Basra, for you are the reciters among them. So continue to recite it. (But bear in mind) that your reciting for a long time may not harden your hearts as were hardened the hearts of those before you. We used to recite a surah which resembled in length and severity to (Surah) Bara'at. I have, however, forgotten it with the exception of this which I remember out of it:" If there were two valleys full of riches, for the son of Adam, he would long for a third valley, and nothing would fill the stomach of the son of Adam but dust." And we used so recite a surah which resembled one of the surahs of Musabbihat, and I have forgotten it, but remember (this much) out of it:" Oh people who believe, why do you say that which you do not practise" (lxi 2.) and" that is recorded in your necks as a witness (against you) and you would be asked about it on the Day of Resurrection" (xvii. 13).
hi: Abu Harb bin Abu al-Aswad ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Abu Musa al-Ash'ari ne Basra ke qaariyon ko bulwaaya. Woh unke paas aaye aur woh teen sau ki tadaad mein the. Unhone Quran ki tilawat ki aur unhone kaha: Tum Basra ke rehne walon mein sabse behtareen ho, kyunki tum unmein Quran padhne wale ho. Is liye ise padhna jaari rakho. Lekin ye dhyaan rakho ki tumhara lambe waqt tak padhna kahin tumhare dilon ko sakht na bana de jaisa tumse pehle logon ke dil sakht ho gaye the. Hum ek surah padha karte the jo lambaai aur shiddat mein Surah Bara'at jaisi thi. Main, halaanki, ise bhool gaya hoon siwaay is ek cheez ke jo mujhe usmein se yaad hai: "Agar Aadam ke bete ke paas daulat se bhari do wadiyaan hotin, to woh teesri wadi ki khwahish karega, aur Aadam ke bete ka pet sirf mitti se hi bharega." Aur hum ek surah padha karte the jo Musabbihat ki surahon mein se ek jaisi thi, aur main use bhool gaya hoon, lekin mujhe itna yaad hai usmein se: "Aye imaan waalo, tum aisa kyun kehte ho jo tum karte nahi" (61:2) aur "ye tumhari gardanon mein ek gawaah ke taur par darj hai aur tumse Qayamat ke din iske baare mein poocha jaayega" (17:13).

e: Abu Huraira reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had said: Richness does not lie in the abundance of (worldly) goods but richness is the richness of the soul (heart, self).
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Maaldaari duniyavi cheezon ki bahulta mein nahi hai balki maaldaari rooh, dil, khud, ki maaldaari hai.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stood up and addressed the people thus: O people, by Allah, I do not entertain fear about you in regard to anything else than that which Allah would bring forth for you in the form of adornment of the world. A person said: Messenger of Allah, does good produce evil? The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) remained silent for a while and he then said: What did you say? He replied: Messenger of Allah, I said: Does good produce evil? The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to him: The good does not produce but good. but among the plants the spring rain produces There some which kill with a tremour or nearly kill all but the animal which feeds on vegetation. It eats and when its flanks are distended, it faces the can. then when it has donged or urinated and chewed it returns and eats. He who accepts wealth rightly, Allah confers blessing on it for him. and he who takes wealth without any right, he is like one who eats and is not satisfied.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) khade hue aur logon se yun khitaab kiya: Aye logo, Allah ki qasam, mujhe tumhare baare mein kisi aur cheez ka utna khauf nahi jitna is baat ka hai ki Allah tumhare liye duniya ki zeenat ke soorat mein kya laayega. Ek shakhs ne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, kya achhaai buraai paida karti hai? Rasoolullah (SAW) thodi der khamosh rahe aur phir kaha: Tumne kya kaha? Unhone jawab diya: Ya Rasoolullah, maine kaha: Kya achhaai buraai paida karti hai? Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unse kaha: Achhaai sirf achhaai hi paida karti hai. Lekin paudhon mein se, bahaar ki baarish kuch aisi cheezein bhi ugaati hai jo sooj ke maar dalti hain ya taqreeban maar dalti hain, siwaay us jaanwar ke jo ghaas khaata hai. Woh khaata hai aur jab uske pehlu phool jaate hain, to woh suraj ka saamna karta hai, phir jab usne gobar ya peshaab kar diya aur jugaali kar li, to woh laut aata hai aur phir khaata hai. Jo koi daulat ko sahi tareeke se qubool karta hai, Allah use isme barkat ata karta hai, aur jo koi daulat bina kisi haq ke leta hai, woh us shakhs jaisa hai jo khaata hai aur seer nahi hota.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had said: The most dreadful thing I fear in your case is what Allah brings forth for you in the form of the adornment of the world. They (the Prophet's Companions) said: Messenger of Allah, what is the adornment of the world? He said: Blessings (the natural resources) of the earth. They (again) said: Messenger of Allah, does good produce evil? He said: No, only good comes out of good. No, only good comes out of good. No. only good comes out of good.
