All that which the spring rain helps to grow kills or is about to kill but (the animal) which feeds on vegetation. It eats and when its flanks are distended, it faces the sun, it chews the cud, it has dunged and urinated. it returns and eats. This wealth is green and sweet, and he who accepts it and applies it rightly, finds it a good help, but he who takes it wrongfully is like one who eats without being satisfied.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Sabse bhayanaak cheez jiska mujhe tumhare maamle mein dar hai woh hai jo Allah tumhare liye duniya ki zeenat ke soorat mein laayega. Unhone kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, duniya ki zeenat kya hai? Unhone kaha: Zameen ki barkatein, praakritik sansaadhan. Unhone phir kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, kya achhaai buraai paida karti hai? Unhone kaha: Nahi, achhaai se sirf achhaai hi nikalti hai. Nahi, achhaai se sirf achhaai hi nikalti hai. Nahi, achhaai se sirf achhaai hi nikalti hai. Woh sab kuch jo bahaar ki baarish ugne mein madad karti hai maar dalta hai ya maar dalne ke qareeb hota hai siwaay us jaanwar ke jo ghaas khaata hai. Woh khaata hai aur jab uske pehlu phool jaate hain, to woh suraj ka saamna karta hai, jugaali karta hai, gobar aur peshaab kar chuka hota hai, phir woh laut aata hai aur khaata hai. Ye daulat hari-bhari aur meethi hai, aur jo ise qubool karta hai aur sahi tareeke se istemal karta hai, use ye ek achhi madad paata hai, lekin jo ise naa-haq tareeke se leta hai woh us shakhs jaisa hai jo khaata hai lekin seer nahi hota.

e: Abu Said al-Khudri reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was sitting on the pulpit and we were sitting around him, and he said: What I am afraid of in regard to you after my death is that there would be opened for you the adornments of the world and its beauties. A person said: Messenger of Allah, does good produce evil? The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) remained silent. And it was said to him (the man who had asked the question from the Holy Prophet): What Is the matter with you, that you speak with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) but he does not speak with you? We thought as if revelation was descending upon him. He regained himself and wiped the sweat from him and said: He was the inquirer (and his style of expression showed as if he praised him and then added): Verily good does not produce evil. Whatever the spring rainfall causes to grow kills or is about to kill, but that (animal) which feeds on vegetation. It eats till its flanks are filled; it faces the sun and dungs and urinates. and then returns to eat. And this Wealth is a sweet vegetation, and it is a good companion for a Muslim who gives out of it to the needy, to the orphan. to the wayfarer, or something like that as the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: He who takes it without his right is like one who eats but does not feel satisfied, and it would stand witness against him on the Day of judgment.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) mimbar par baithe the aur hum unke aas-paas baithe the, aur unhone kaha: Jis cheez ka mujhe apni maut ke baad tumhare baare mein dar hai woh ye hai ki tumhare liye duniya ki zeenat aur raunaq khol di jaayengi. Ek shakhs ne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, kya achhaai buraai paida karti hai? Rasoolullah (SAW) khamosh rahe. Aur uss shakhs se, jisne Nabi (SAW) se sawal poocha tha, kaha gaya: Tumhe kya ho gaya hai ki tum Rasoolullah (SAW) se baat karte ho lekin woh tumse baat nahi karte? Humein laga jaise unpar wahi utar rahi ho. Woh apne hosh mein aaye aur apna paseena poncha aur kaha: Woh poochhne wala kahan hai, aur unke lehje se aisa laga jaise unhone use sarahaya aur phir izafa kiya: Yaqeenan achhaai buraai paida nahi karti. Jo bhi bahaar ki baarish ugaati hai woh maar dalta hai ya maar dalne ke qareeb hota hai, siwaay uske jo ghaas khaata hai. Woh khaata hai yahan tak ki uske pehlu bhar jaate hain; woh suraj ka saamna karta hai aur gobar aur peshaab karta hai, aur phir khaane ke liye laut aata hai. Aur ye daulat ek meethi hariyaali hai, aur ye us Musalman ke liye ek achha saathi hai jo isme se zaroorat-mand ko, yateem ko, musaafir ko, ya isi tarah ki kisi cheez ko deta hai, jaisa Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Jo ise bina apne haq ke leta hai woh us shakhs jaisa hai jo khaata hai lekin seer mahsoos nahi karta, aur ye Qayamat ke din uske khilaaf gawaahi degi.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported that some people from among the Ansar begged from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he gave them. They again begged him and he again gave them, till when what was in his possession was exhausted he said: Whatever good (riches, goods) I have, I will not withhold it from you. He who refrains from begging Allah safeguards him against want. and he who seeks sufficiency, Allah would keep him in a state of sufficiency, and he who shows endurance. Allah would grant him power to endure, and none is blessed with an endowment better and greater than endurance.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne bayan kiya ki Ansar mein se kuch log Rasoolullah (SAW) se bhikh maange, aur unhone unhe diya. Unhone phir unse bhikh maangi aur unhone phir unhe diya, yahan tak ki jab unke paas jo tha woh khatam ho gaya, to unhone kaha: Jo bhi achhaai, daulat, saamaan, mere paas hai, main use tumse nahi rokunga. Jo bhikh maangne se bacha rahta hai, Allah use zaroorat se bachaata hai, aur jo bhi kaafi hone ka talab karta hai, Allah use kaafi-haali ki halat mein rakhega, aur jo dheeraj dikhata hai, Allah use dheeraj rakhne ki taaqat dega, aur dheeraj se behtar aur badi koi nemat kisi ko nahi di jaati.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: 'Amr b. al-'As reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He Is successful who has accepted Islam, who has been provided with sufficient for his want and been made contented by Allah with what He has given him.
hi: Amr bin al-As ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Woh kaamyaab hai jisne Islam qubool kiya hai, jise uski zaroorat ke liye kaafi diya gaya hai, aur jise Allah ne uske diye hue par santusht kar diya hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: O Allah, make the provision of Muhammad's family sufficient just to sustain life.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Aye Allah, Muhammad ke gharane ke rizq ko sirf itna kaafi bana de jitna zindagi ko sahaara dene ke liye zaroori ho.

e: Umar b. Khattab (Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) distributed something. Upon this I said: Messenger of Allah, I swear by God, the others besides them were more deserving than these (to whom you gave charity). He said: They had in fact left no other alternative for me. but (that they should) either beg importunately from me or they would regard me as a miser, but I am not a miser.
hi: Umar bin Khattab (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kuch cheez taqseem ki. Isper maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, Allah ki qasam, unke ilawa doosre log inse, jinhe aap sadaqa de rahe hain, zyada mustahiq the. Unhone kaha: Unhone dar-asal mere liye koi doosra raasta nahi chhoda siwaay is ke ki woh mujhse zid karke maangte ya mujhe kanjoos samajhte, lekin main kanjoos nahi hoon.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: I was walking with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he had put on a mantle of Najran with a thick border. A bedouin met him and pulled the mantle so violently that I saw this violent pulling leaving marks of the border of the mantle on the skin of the neck of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). And he (the bedouin) said: Muhammad, issue command that I should be given out of the wealth of Allah which is at your disposal. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) turned his attention to him and smiled, and then ordered for him a gift (provision).
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya: Main Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath chal raha tha aur unhone Najran ki ek moti kinaar wali chadar odh rakhi thi. Ek badawi unse mila aur usne chadar itni zor se khaenchi ki maine dekha ki us zordaar khinchaav ki wajah se Rasoolullah (SAW) ki gardan ki khaal par chadar ke kinaar ke nishaan pad gaye. Aur usne kaha: Muhammad, hukum do ki mujhe Allah ki daulat mein se diya jaaye jo aapke ikhtiyaar mein hai. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne uski taraf mudkar dekha aur muskuraaye, aur phir uske liye ek tohfa, rizq, dene ka hukum diya.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik through another chain of transmitters. And In the hadith transmitted by Ikrima b. 'Ammir there is an addition: " He (the bedouin) pulled his (mantle) so violently that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was drifted very close to the bedouin." And in the hadith transmitted by Hammam, (the words are):" He pulled it so violently that the mantle was torn and the border was left around the neck of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)."
hi: Ye hadees Anas bin Malik ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki gayi hai. Aur Ikrima bin Ammir ki bayan ki hui hadees mein ye izafa hai: "Usne, badawi ne, unki chadar itni zor se khaenchi ki Rasoolullah (SAW) badawi ke bahut qareeb kheech gaye." Aur Hammam ki bayan ki hui hadees mein alfaaz hain: "Usne ise itni zor se khaencha ki chadar phat gayi aur uska kinaar Rasoolullah (SAW) ki gardan ke aas-paas reh gaya."

e: Miswar b. Makhrama reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) distributed some cloaks but did not bestow one upon Makhrama. Upon this Makhrama said: O my son, come along with me to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). So I went with him. He said: Enter the house and call him (to come out) for me. So I called him and he (the Holy Prophet) came out, and there was a cloak (from those already distributed) on him. He (the Holy Prophet) said: I had kept it for you. He (Makhrama), looked at it and was pleased.
hi: Miswar bin Makhrama ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kuch chogay, chaadaren, taqseem kin lekin unhone Makhrama ko koi nahi diya. Isper Makhrama ne kaha: Aye mere bete, mere saath Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas chalo. To main unke saath gaya. Unhone kaha: Ghar mein jao aur mere liye unhe bahar aane ko bulao. To maine unhe bulaya aur woh bahar aaye, aur unpar ek chogha, in taqseem ki hui cheezon mein se, tha. Unhone kaha: Maine ise tumhare liye rakh liya tha. Unhone use dekha aur khush hue.

e: Miswar b. Makhrama reported: Some cloaks were presented to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). My father Makhrama said to me: Come along with me to him; perhaps we may be able to get anything out of that (stock of cloaks). My father stood at the door and began to talk. The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) recognised him by his voice and came out and there was a cloak with him, and he was showing its beauties and saying: I kept it for you, I kept it for you.
hi: Miswar bin Makhrama ne bayan kiya: Kuch chogay Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas laaye gaye. Mere waalid Makhrama ne mujhse kaha: Mere saath unke paas chalo; shayad hum usmein se, in chogon ke bhandaar mein se, kuch pa sakein. Mere waalid darwaze par khade hue aur baat karne lage. Rasool (SAW) ne unhe unki aawaaz se pehchaan liya aur bahar aaye aur unke paas ek chogha tha, aur woh uski zeenat dikha rahe the aur keh rahe the: Maine ise tumhare liye rakh liya, maine ise tumhare liye rakh liya.

e: Sa'd reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) bestowed (some gifts) upon a group of people and I was sitting amongst them. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), however, left a person and he did not give him anything. and he seemed to me the most excellent among them (and thus deserved the gifts more than anyone else). So I stood up before the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said to him in undertone: Messenger of Allah, what about so and so? By Allah, I find him a believer. He (the Messenger of Allah) said: He may be a Muslim. I kept quiet for a short while, and then what I knew of him urged me (to plead his case again) and I said: Messenger of Allah, what about so and so? By Allah, I find him a believer. Upon this he (the Holy Prophet) said: He may be a Muslim. I again remained quiet for a short while, and what I knew of him again urged me (to plead his case so I) said: Messenger of Allah, what about so and so? By Allah, I find him a believer. Upon this he (the Holy Prophet) said: He may be a Muslim. I often bestow (something) upon a person, whereas someone else is dearer to me than he, because of the fear that he may fall headlong into the fire. And in the hadith transmitted by Hulwani this statement was repeated twice.
hi: Sa'd ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kuch logon ke ek giroh ko kuch tohfe ata kiye aur main unke beech baitha tha. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne, halaanki, ek shakhs ko chhod diya aur unhe kuch nahi diya, aur woh mujhe unmein sabse behtareen lagta tha, aur is tarah usse behtar in tohfon ka mustahiq tha kisi aur se. To main Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saamne khada hua aur unse dheemi aawaaz mein kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, falan ka kya haal hai? Allah ki qasam, main use momino mein paata hoon. Unhone kaha: Ya woh Musalman hai. Main thodi der khamosh raha, aur phir jo main unke baare mein jaanta tha usne mujhe majboor kiya, unka mamla dobara uthhaane par, aur maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, falan ka kya haal hai? Allah ki qasam, main use momino mein paata hoon. Isper unhone kaha: Ya woh Musalman hai. Main phir thodi der khamosh raha, aur jo main unke baare mein jaanta tha usne mujhe phir majboor kiya, unka mamla phir uthaane par, to maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, falan ka kya haal hai? Allah ki qasam, main use momino mein paata hoon. Isper unhone kaha: Ya woh Musalman hai. Main aksar kisi shakhs ko kuch deta hoon, jabki koi aur mujhe usse zyada aziz hota hai, is dar se ki kahin woh, jise diya nahi jaata, jahannam mein saar ke bal na gir jaaye. Aur Hulwani ki bayan ki hui hadees mein ye baat do baar dohrayi gayi.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Muhammad b. Sa'd through another chain of transmitters (and the words are): " The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) struck between my neck and shoulder with his hand and said: Do you wrangle, O Sa'd, because I bestow (some gifts) upon a person?"
hi: Ye hadees Muhammad bin Sa'd ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se bayan ki gayi hai aur alfaaz hain: "Rasoolullah (SAW) ne mere gardan aur kandhe ke beech apne haath se maara aur kaha: Kya tum jhagda karte ho, Aye Sa'd, kyunki main kisi shakhs ko kuch deta hoon?"

e: Anas b. Malik reported that when on the Day of Hunain Allah conferred upon His Apostle (ﷺ) the riches of Hawazin (without armed encounter), the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) set about distributing to some persons of Quraish one hundred camels Upon this they (the young people from the Ansar) said: May Allah grant pardon to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that he bestowed (these camels) upon the people of Quraish, and he ignored us, whereas our swords are still dripping blood. Anas b. Malik said: Their statement was conveyed to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he sent (someone) to the Ansar and gathered them under a tent of leather. When they had assembled, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to them and said: What is this news that has reached me from you? The wise people of the Ansar said: Messenger of Allah, so far as the sagacious amongst us are concerned they have said nothing, but we have amongst us persons of immature age; they said: May Allah grant pardon to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that he gave to the Quraish and ignored us (despite the fact) that our swords are besmeared with their blood. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: I give (at times material gifts) to persons who were quite recently in the state of unbelief, so that I may incline them to truth Don't you feel delighted that people should go with riches, and you should go back to your places with the Messenger of Allah? By Allah, that with which you would return is better than that with which they would return. They said: Yes, Messenger of Allah, we are pleased. The Prophet said too: You would find marked preference (in conferring of the material gifts) in future, so you should show patience till you meet Allah and His Messenger and I would he at the Haud Kauthar. They said: We would show patience.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki jab Hunain ki jung ke din Allah ne apne Rasool (SAW) ko Hawazin ki daulat ata ki, bina hathiyaaron ke muqable ke, to Rasoolullah (SAW) Quraish ke kuch logon ko sau-sau oont taqseem karne lage. Isper unhone, Ansar ke jawaanon ne, kaha: Allah Rasoolullah (SAW) ko maaf kare ki unhone Quraish ke logon ko ye oont ata kiye, aur humein nazarandaaz kiya, jabki hamari talwaaren abhi bhi khoon se tapak rahi hain. Anas bin Malik ne kaha: Unka ye bayaan Rasoolullah (SAW) tak pahunchaaya gaya aur unhone kisi ko Ansar ke paas bheja aur unhe ek chamde ke tambu ke neeche ikattha kiya. Jab woh jama ho gaye, to Rasoolullah (SAW) unke paas aaye aur kaha: Ye kya khabar hai jo mujhe tumhari taraf se pahunchi hai? Ansar ke aqlmand logon ne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, jahan tak hummein se aqlmand logon ka sawal hai, unhone kuch nahi kaha, lekin hummein kuch kachi umar ke log bhi hain; unhone kaha: Allah Rasoolullah (SAW) ko maaf kare ki unhone Quraish ko diya aur humein nazarandaaz kiya, is haalat mein ki hamari talwaaren unke khoon se lathpath hain. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Main kabhi kabhi maaddi tohfe un logon ko deta hoon jo abhi haal hi mein kufr ki haalat mein the, taaki main unhe haq ki taraf jhukaa sakoon. Kya tumhe khushi nahi hoti ki log daulat lekar jaayein, aur tum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath apni jagahon ko lautoge? Allah ki qasam, jiske saath tum lautoge woh usse behtar hai jiske saath woh lautenge. Unhone kaha: Haan, Ya Rasoolullah, hum khush hain. Nabi ne ye bhi kaha: Aage tum, maaddi tohfe dene mein, tarjeeh dekhoge, is liye tumhe sabar rakhna chahiye jab tak tum Allah aur uske Rasool se na mil jaao aur main Haud Kauthar par hoonga. Unhone kaha: Hum sabar rakhenge.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that when Allah conferred upon His Messenger (ﷺ) the riches of Hawazin (without armed encounter) ; the rest of the hadith is the same except some variation (of words): " Anas said: We could not tolerate it and he also said: The people were immature in age."
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki jab Allah ne apne Rasool (SAW) ko Hawazin ki daulat ata ki, bina hathiyaaron ke muqable ke; baaki hadees waisi hi hai siwaay kuch alfaazon ki tabdeeli ke: "Anas ne kaha: Hum ise bardaasht na kar sake aur unhone ye bhi kaha: Log kachi umar ke the."

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Anas bin Malik ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) gathered the Ansar and said: Is there someone alien among you? They said: No, but only the son of our sister. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The son of the sister of the people is included among the tribe, and (farther) said: The Quraish have recently abandoned Jahillyya and have just been delivered from distress; I, therefore, intend to help them and conciliate them. Don't you feel happy that the people should return with worldly riches and you return with the Messenger of Allah to your houses? (So far as my love for you is concerned I should say) if the people were to tread a valley and the Ansar tread a narraw path (in a mountain) I would tread the narrow path of the Ansar.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Ansar ko ikattha kiya aur kaha: Kya tum mein koi ajnabi hai? Unhone kaha: Nahi, siwaay hamari behn ke bete ke. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Logon ki behn ka beta qabile mein shaamil samjha jaata hai, aur aage kaha: Quraish ne haal hi mein Jahiliyat chhodi hai aur woh tangi se abhi-abhi bache hain; is liye main unki madad karna aur unhe sulah dena chahta hoon. Kya tumhe khushi nahi hoti ki log duniyavi daulat lekar laute, aur tum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath apne gharon ko laut jaao? Jahan tak meri tumse mohabbat ka sawal hai to main kehta hoon, agar log ek wadi mein chalein aur Ansar ek tang raaste, pahaad mein, chalein to main Ansar ke tang raaste par chalunga.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: When Mecca was conquered, he (the Holy Prophet) distributed the spoils among the Quraish. Upon this the Ansar said: It is strange that our swords are dripping with their blood, whereas our spoils have been given to them (to the Quraish). This (remark) reached the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and so he gathered them and said: What is this that has been conveyed to me about you? They said: (Yes) it is that very thing that, has reached you and they were not (the people) to speak a lie. Upon this he said: Don't you like that the people should return to their houses along with worldly riches, whereas you should return to your houses with the Messenger of Allah? If the people were to tread a valley or a narrow path, and the Ansar were also to tread a valley or a narrow path, I would tread the valley (along with the) Ansar or the narrow path (along with the) Ansar.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya: Jab Makkah fatah hua, to unhone Quraish mein maal-e-ganimat taqseem kiya. Isper Ansar ne kaha: Ye ajeeb baat hai ki hamari talwaaren unke khoon se tapak rahi hain, jabki hamara maal-e-ganimat unhe, Quraish ko, diya gaya hai. Ye baat Rasoolullah (SAW) tak pahunchi, is liye unhone unhe ikattha kiya aur kaha: Ye kya hai jo mujhe tumhare baare mein bataaya gaya hai? Unhone kaha: Haan yahi baat hai jo aap tak pahunchi hai aur woh log jhoot bolne wale nahi the. Isper unhone kaha: Kya tumhe pasand nahi ki log duniyavi daulat lekar apne gharon ko laut jaayein, jabki tum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath apne gharon ko lautoge? Agar log ek wadi ya ek tang raaste par chalein, aur Ansar bhi ek wadi ya ek tang raaste par chalein, to main Ansar ke saath wadi ya tang raaste par chalunga.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that when it was the Day of Hunain there came the tribes of Hawazin, Ghatafan and others along with their children and animals, and there were with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that day ten thousand (soldiers), and newly freed men (of Mecca after its conquest). All these men (once) turned their backs, till he (the Holy Prophet) was left alone. He (the Messenger of Allah) on that day called twice and he did not interpose anything between these two (announcements). He turned towards his right and said: O people of Ansar! They said: At thy beck and call (are we), Messenger of Allah. Be glad we are with thee. He then turned towards his left and said: O people of Ansar. They said: At thy beck and call (are we). Be glad we are with thee. He (the Holy Prophet) was riding a white mule. He dismounted and said: I am the servant of Allah and His Apostle. The polytheists suffered defeat and the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) acquired a large quantity of spoils, and he distributed them among the refugees and the people recently delivered (of Mecca) but did not give anything to the Ansar. The Ansar said: In the hour of distress it is we who are called (for help). but the spoils are given to other people besides us. This (remark) reached him (the Holy Prophet). and he gathered them In a tent. and said: What is this news that has reached me on your behalf? They kept silence. Upon this he said: O people of Ansar, don't you like that people should go away with worldly (riches), and you go away with Muhammad taking him to your houses? They said: Yes, happy we are. Messenger of Allah. He (the Holy Prophet) said: If the people were to tread a valley, and the Ansar were to tread a narrow path, I would take the narrow path of the Ansar. Hisham said: I asked Abu Hamza if he was present there. He said: How could I be absent from him?
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki jab Hunain ka din tha, Hawazin, Ghatafan aur doosre qabile apne bachchon aur jaanwaron ke saath aaye, aur us din Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath das hazaar sipaahi the, aur woh log jo haal hi mein azaad kiye gaye the, Makkah fatah hone ke baad. Ye sab log peeth mode, peeche haate hue, yahan tak ki woh akele reh gaye. Unhone us din do baar bulaya aur unhone in do ailaanon ke beech kuch bhi baaqi nahi rakha. Woh apni daayi taraf mude aur kaha: Aye Ansar ke logo! Unhone kaha: Aapki khidmat mein haazir hain, Ya Rasoolullah. Khush ho jaayiye, hum aapke saath hain. Woh phir apni baayi taraf mude aur kaha: Aye Ansar ke logo. Unhone kaha: Aapki khidmat mein haazir hain. Khush ho jaayiye, hum aapke saath hain. Unhone ek safed khachcher par sawaari ki thi. Woh utre aur kaha: Main Allah ka aur uske Rasool ka banda hoon. Mushrikeen shikast khaa gaye aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ko bahut zyada maal-e-ganimat mila, aur unhone use muhajiron aur haal hi mein azaad kiye gaye logon, Makkah ke, mein taqseem kiya lekin Ansar ko kuch nahi diya. Ansar ne kaha: Museebat ke waqt hamein bulaaya jaata hai, lekin maal-e-ganimat doosre logon ko diya jaata hai jo hum nahi hain. Ye baat unhe pahunchi, aur unhone unhe ek tambu mein ikattha kiya, aur kaha: Ye kaisi khabar hai jo mujhe tumhari taraf se pahunchi hai? Woh khamosh rahe. Isper unhone kaha: Aye Ansar ke logo, kya tumhe pasand nahi ki log duniyavi daulat lekar jaayein, aur tum Muhammad ko apne gharon mein lekar jaao? Unhone kaha: Haan, ham khush hain, Ya Rasoolullah. Unhone kaha: Agar log ek wadi mein chalein, aur Ansar ek tang raaste par chalein, to main Ansar ka tang raasta lunga. Hisham ne kaha: Maine Abu Hamza se poocha ki kya woh wahan maujood the. Unhone kaha: Main unse, Anas se, door kaise ho sakta tha?

e: Anas b. Malik reported: We conquered Mecca and then we went on an expedition to Hunain. The polytheists came, forming themselves into the best rows that I have seen. They first formed the rows of cavalry, then those of infantry, and then those of women behind them. Then there were formed the rows of sheep and goats and then of other animals. We were also people large in number, and our (number) had reached six thousand. And on one side Khalid b. Walid was in charge of the cavalry. And our horses at once turned back from our rear. And we could hardly hold our own when our horses were exposed, and the bedouins and the people whom we knew took to their heels. (Seeing this) the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) called thus: O emigrants, O emigrants. He then. said: O Ansar, O Ansar. (Anas said: This hadith is transmitted by a group of eminent persons.) We said: At thy beck and call are we, Messenger of Allah. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) then advanced and he (Anas) said: By Allah, we had not yet reached them when Allah defeated them. and we took possession of the wealth and we then marched towards Ta'if, and we besieged them for forty nights. and then came back to Mecca and encamped (at a place), and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) began to bestow a hundred camels upon each individual. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya: Humne Makkah fatah kiya aur phir hum Hunain ke liye ek muhim par gaye. Mushrikeen aaye, apne aap ko behtareen safon mein taiyaar karte hue jo maine kabhi dekhi thin. Unhone pehle ghudsawaaron ki safen banayin, phir paidal fauj ki, aur phir unke peeche auraton ki. Phir bakriyon aur bheedon ki safen bani, aur phir doosre jaanwaron ki. Hum bhi ek badi tadaad mein log the, aur hamari tadaad chhe hazaar tak pahunch gayi thi. Aur ek taraf, Khalid bin Walid ghudsawaar dastay ke incharge the. Aur hamare ghode achaanak hamare peechhe se mud gaye. Aur hum apna jagah mushkil se sambhal paaye jab hamare ghode ke saamne aaye, aur badawi aur log jinhe hum jaante the bhaag khade huye. Ye dekhkar Rasoolullah (SAW) ne is tarah pukaara: Aye Muhajiro, Aye Muhajiro. Unhone phir kaha: Aye Ansar, Aye Ansar. Anas ne kaha: Ye hadees kayi mashhoor logon ne bayan ki hai. Humne kaha: Aapki khidmat mein haazir hain, Ya Rasoolullah. Rasoolullah (SAW) phir aage badhe aur unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, hum unke paas abhi pahunche bhi nahi the ki Allah ne unhe shikast de di, aur humne daulat ko qabze mein le liya aur phir hum Ta'if ki taraf march kiye, aur humne unhe chaalis raaton tak ghera, aur phir Makkah wapas aaye aur ek jagah khema laga liya, aur Rasoolullah (SAW) har ek shakhs ko sau-sau oont dene lage. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e:
Rafi' b. Khadij reported that the Messenger of Allah; (ﷺ) gave to Abu Sufyan b. Harb and Safwan. b. Umayya and 'Uyaina b. Hisn and Aqra' b. Habis, i.e. to every one of these persons, one hundred camels, and gave to 'Abbas b. Mirdas less than this number. Upon this 'Abbas b. Mirdis said: You allot the share of my booty and that of my horse between 'Uyaina and Aqra'. 
Both Uyaina and Aqra' are in no way more eminent than Mirdas (my father) in the assembly. 
I am in no way inferior to any one of these persons. 
And he who is let down today would not be elevated. 
He (the narrator) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) then completed one hundred camels for him.
hi: Rafi' bin Khadij ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Abu Sufyan bin Harb, Safwan bin Umayya, Uyaina bin Hisn aur Aqra bin Habis ko diya, yaani in logon mein se har ek ko sau-sau oont, aur Abbas bin Mirdas ko isse kam diya. Isper Abbas bin Mirdas ne kaha: Aap mere maal-e-ganimat ka hissa aur mere ghode ka hissa Uyaina aur Aqra ke darmiyan taqseem karte hain. Na Uyaina aur na Aqra kisi tarah Mirdas, mere waalid, se buland hain majlis mein. Main kisi tarah in mein se kisi se kam nahi hoon. Aur jo aaj zaleel kiya jaaye woh buland nahi hoga. Raawi ne kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne phir unke liye sau oont poore kar diye.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Sa'id b. Masruq with the same chain of transmitters (with the words): " The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) distributed the spoils of Hunain, and he (the Holy Prophet) gave one hundred camels to Abu Sufyan b. Harb. The rest of the hadith is the same, but with this addition:" He bestowed upon" Alqama b. 'Ulatha one hundred (camels)."
hi: Ye hadees Sa'id bin Masruq ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai, in alfaaz ke saath: "Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Hunain ke maal-e-ganimat ko taqseem kiya, aur unhone Abu Sufyan bin Harb ko sau oont diye. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai, lekin is izafe ke saath: 'Unhone Alqama bin Ulatha ko sau oont ata kiye.'"

e: This hadith has been narrated by Sa'id with the same chain of transmitters, but no mention has been made of Alqama b. 'Ulatha, nor of safwin b. Umayya, and he did not mention the verse in his hadith.
hi: Ye hadees Sa'id ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai, lekin Alqama bin Ulatha ka koi zikr nahi kiya gaya, na hi Safwan bin Umayya ka, aur unhone apni hadees mein aayat ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: Abdullah b. Zaid reported that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) conquered Hunain he distributed the booty, and he bestowed upon those whose hearts it was intended to win. It was conveyed to him (the Holy Prophet) that the Ansar cherished a desire that they should be given (that very portion) which the people (of Quraish) had got. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stood up and, after having praised Allah and lauded Him, addressed them thus: O people of Ansar, did I not find you erring and Allah guided you aright through me, and (in the state of) being destitute and Allah made you free from want through me, and in a state of disunity and Allah united you through me, and they (the Ansar) said: Allah and His Messenger are most benevolent. He (again) said: Why do you not answer me? They said: Allah and His Messenger are the most benevolent. He said, If you wish you should say so and so, and the event (should take) such and such course (and in this connection he made a mention) of so many things. 'Amr is under the impression that he has not been able to remember them. He (the Holy Prophet) further said: Don't you feel happy (over this state of affairs) that the people should go away with goats and camels, and you go to your places along with the Messenger of Allah? The Ansar are inner garments (more close to me) and (other) people are outer garments. Had there not been migration, I would have been a man from among the Ansar. If the people were to tread a valley or a narrow path, I would tread the valley (chosen) by the Ansar or narrow path (trodden) by them. And you would soon find after me preferences (over you in getting material benefits). So you should show patience till you meet me at the Haud (Kauthar).
hi: Abdullah bin Zaid ne bayan kiya ki jab Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Hunain fatah kiya to unhone maal-e-ganimat taqseem kiya, aur unhone un logon ko ata kiya jinke dilon ko jeetna maqsad tha. Unhe khabar pahunchi ki Ansar ye khwahish rakhte hain ki unhe wahi hissa mile jo Quraish walon ko mila hai. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) khade hue aur, Allah ki tareef aur hamd karne ke baad, unse yun khitaab kiya: Aye Ansar ke logo, kya maine tumhe gumraah nahi paaya aur Allah ne mere zariye tumhe hidayat di, aur muhtaaji mein aur Allah ne mere zariye tumhe zaroorat se aazad kiya, aur be-mel-jol ki halat mein aur Allah ne mere zariye tumhe ekjut kiya, aur unhone, Ansar ne, kaha: Allah aur uske Rasool sabse zyada meherbaan hain. Unhone dobara kaha: Tum mujhe jawab kyun nahi dete? Unhone kaha: Allah aur uske Rasool sabse zyada meherbaan hain. Unhone kaha: Agar tum chaho to tum yun aur yun keh sakte the, aur ghatna aisi hi hoti, aur isi silsile mein unhone kai cheezon ka zikr kiya. Amr ko lagta hai ki woh unhe yaad nahi rakh paaye. Unhone aage kaha: Kya tumhe khushi nahi ki log bakriyaan aur oont lekar jaayein, aur tum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath apni jagahon ko lauto? Ansar mujhse itne qareeb hain jitne andaruni kapde hote hain aur doosre log baahri kapde hain. Agar hijrat na hoti, to main Ansar mein se ek hota. Agar log ek wadi ya ek tang raaste par chalein, to main Ansar ke zariye chuni gayi wadi ya unke ke zariye chala gaya tang raasta chalunga. Aur mere baad tum jald hi maaddi faayde paane mein tarjeehen dekhoge. Is liye tumhe sabar rakhna chahiye jab tak tum mujhse Haud, Kauthar, par na mil jaao.

e: Abdullah reported: On the day of Hunain, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) showed preference (to some) people in the distribution of the spoils. He bestowed on Aqra' b. Habis one hundred camels, and bestowed an equal (number) upon 'Uyaina, and bestowed on people among the elites of Arabia, and preferred them (to others) on that day, in the distribution (of spoils). Upon this a person said: By Allah, neither justice has been done in this distribution (of spoils), nor has the pleasure of Allah been sought in it. I (the narrator ) said: By Allah, I will certainly inform the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about it. I came to him and informed him about what he had said. The colour of his (the Prophet's) face changed red like blood and he then said: "Who would do justice, if Allah and His Messenger do not do justice?" He further said: "May Allah have mercy upon Moses; he was tormented more than this, but he showed patience." I said: Never would I convey him (the Holy Prophet) after this (unpleasant) narration.
hi: Abdullah ne bayan kiya: Hunain ke din, Rasoolullah (SAW) ne maal-e-ganimat ki taqseem mein kuch logon ko tarjeeh di. Unhone Aqra bin Habis ko sau oont ata kiye, aur Uyaina ko bhi utni hi tadaad ata ki, aur unhone Arab ke uch-varg ke logon ko bhi ata kiya, aur us din maal-e-ganimat ki taqseem mein unhe doosron par tarjeeh di. Isper ek shakhs ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, is taqseem mein na insaaf kiya gaya hai, na hi ismein Allah ki raza talaash ki gayi hai. Maine kaha: Allah ki qasam, main zaroor Rasoolullah (SAW) ko iske baare mein bataunga. Main unke paas aaya aur unhe bataya ki usne kya kaha tha. Unke chehre ka rang khoon jaisa laal ho gaya aur phir unhone kaha: "Kaun insaaf karega, agar Allah aur uska Rasool insaaf nahi karte?" Unhone aage kaha: "Allah Musa (AS) par rehmat kare; unhe isse zyada satayaa gaya tha, lekin unhone sabar dikhaya." Maine kaha: Is napasandeeda waaqiye ke baad main unhe kabhi kuch nahi bataunga.

e: Abdullah reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) distributed spoils (of war). Upon this a person said: This is a distribution In which the pleasure of Allah has not been sought. I came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and informed him in an undertone. He (the Holy Prophet) was deeply angry at this and his face became red till I wished that I had not made a mention of it to him. He (the Holy Prophet) then said: Moses was tormented more than this, but he showed patience.
hi: Abdullah ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne maal-e-ganimat taqseem kiya. Isper ek shakhs ne kaha: Ye ek aisi taqseem hai jismein Allah ki raza talaash nahi ki gayi. Main Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unhe dheemi aawaaz mein bataya. Woh isse bahut naaraaz hue aur unka chehra laal ho gaya yahan tak ki main chahne laga ki kaash maine unhe iska zikr na kiya hota. Unhone phir kaha: Musa (AS) ko isse zyada satayaa gaya tha, lekin unhone sabar dikhaya.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah reported that a person came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) at Jirana on his way back from Hunain, and there was in the clothes of Bilal some silver. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took a handful out of that and bestowed it upon the people. He (the person who had met the Prophet at Ji'rana) said to him: Muhammad, do justice. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Woe be upon thee, who would do justice if I do not do justice, and you would be very unfortunate and a loser if I do not do justice. Upon this Umar b. Khattab (Allah be pleased with him) said: Permit me to kill this hypocrite. Upon this he (the Holy Prophet) said: May there be protection of Allah! People would say that I kill my companions. This man and his companions would recite the Qur'an but it would not go beyond their throat, and they swerve from it just as the arrow goes through the prey.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya ki Ji'rana mein ek shakhs Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aaya jab woh Hunain se wapas lautte waqt the, aur Bilal ke kapdon mein kuch chandi thi. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne usmein se ek mutthi bhar li aur use logon mein ata kiya. Usne unse kaha: Muhammad, insaaf karo. Unhone kaha: Tumpar afsos ho, kaun insaaf karega agar main insaaf nahi karta, aur tum bahut hi badnaseeb aur ghaate mein rahoge agar main insaaf nahi karta. Isper Umar bin Khattab (RA) ne kaha: Mujhe is munaafiq ko qatal karne ki ijazat dijiye. Isper unhone kaha: Allah ki panah! Log kahenge ki main apne saathiyon ko qatal karta hoon. Ye shakhs aur uske saathi Quran padhenge lekin ye unke gale se aage nahi jaayega, aur woh isse aise mud jaayenge jaise teer shikaar ke jism se guzar jaata hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Jabir b. 'Abdullah through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Jabir bin Abdullah ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Said Khudri reported that 'Ali (Allah be pleased with him) sent some gold alloyed with dust to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) distributed that among four men, al-Aqra b. Habis Hanzali and Uyaina b. Badr al-Fazari and 'Alqama b. 'Ulatha al-'Amiri, then to one person of the tribe of Kilab and to Zaid al-Khair al-Ta'l, and then to one person of the tribe of Nabhan. Upon this the people of Quraish felt angry and said: He (the Holy Prophet) gave to the chiefs of Najd and ignored us. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: I have done it with a view to conciliating between them. Then there came a person with thick beard, prominent cheeks, deep sunken eyes and protruding forehead and shaven head. He said: Muhammad, fear Allah. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "If I disobey Allah, who would then obey Him? Have I not been (sent as the) most trustworthy among the people of the world? But you do not repose trust in me." That person then went back. A person among the people then sought permission (from the Holy Prophet) for his murder. According to some, it was Khalid b. Walid who sought the permission. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), said: From this very person's posterity there would arise people who would recite the Qur'an, but it would not go beyond their throat; they would kill the followers of Islam and would spare the idol-worshippers. They would glance through the teachings of Islam so hurriedly just as the arrow passes through the pray. If I were to ever find them I would kill them like 'Ad.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne bayan kiya ki Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kuch sona bheja jo mitti mein mila hua tha, Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas, aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ne use char logon mein taqseem kiya, al-Aqra bin Habis al-Hanzali, aur Uyaina bin Badr al-Fazari, aur Alqama bin Ulatha al-Amiri, phir Kilab qabile ke ek shakhs ko aur Zaid al-Khair al-Ta'i ko, aur phir Nabhan qabile ke ek shakhs ko. Isper Quraish ke log naaraaz hue aur kaha: Unhone Najd ke sardaron ko diya aur humein nazarandaaz kiya. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Maine ye unke darmiyan sulah karaane ki neeyat se kiya hai. Phir ek ghani daadhi wala, ubhre gaal wale, gehri dhansi hui aankhon wale, ubhri hui peshani wala aur mundhe sar wala shakhs aaya. Usne kaha: Muhammad, Allah se daro. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: "Agar main Allah ki naafarmani karun, to phir Uski itaat kaun karega? Kya mujhe duniya bhar ke logon mein sabse zyada bharosemand nahi bheja gaya? Lekin tum mujhpar bharosa nahi karte." Woh shakhs phir wapas gaya. Logon mein se ek shakhs ne uske qatl ki ijazat maangi. Kuch riwayaton ke mutabik, ye Khalid bin Walid the jinhone ijazat maangi. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Isi shakhs ki naslon mein se aise log paida honge jo Quran padhenge, lekin ye unke gale se aage nahi jaayega; woh Islam ke pairvon ko qatal karenge aur but-parasto ko bakhsh denge. Woh Islam ki taalimaat se aise jaldi-jaldi guzar jaayenge jaise teer shikaar se guzarta hai. Agar mujhe kabhi woh mile, to main unhe Aad ki tarah qatl karunga.

e: Abu Said al-Khudri reported: 'Ali b. Abu Talib sent to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) from Yemen some gold alloyed with clay in a leather bag dyed in the leaves of Mimosa flava. He distributed it among four men. 'Uyaina b. Hisna, Aqra' b. Habis and Zaid al-Khail, and the fourth one was either Alqama b. 'Ulatha or 'Amir b. Tufail. A person from among his (Prophet's) Companions said: We had a better claim to this (wealth) than these (persons). This (remark) reached the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) upon which he said: Will you not trust me, whereas I am a trustee of Him Who is in the heaven? The news come to me from the heaven morning and evening. Then there stood up a person with deep sunken eyes, prominent cheek bones, and elevated forehead, thick beard, shaven head, tucked up loincloth, and he said: Messenger of Allah, fear Allah. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Woe to thee. Do I not deserve most to fear Allah amongst the people of the earth? That man then returned. Khalid b. Walid then said: Messenger of Allah, should I not strike his neck? Upon this he (the Holy Prophet) said: Perhaps he may be observing the prayer. Khalid said: How many observers of prayer are there who profess with their tongue what is not in their heart? Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: I have not been commanded to pierce through the hearts of people, nor to split their bellies (insides). He again looked at him and he was going back. Upon this he (the Holy Prophet) said: There would arise a people from the progeny of this (man) who would recite the Qur'an glibly, but it would not go beyond their throats; they would (hurriedly) pass through (the teachings of their) religion just as the arrow passes through the prey. I conceive that he (the Holy Prophet) also said this: If I find them I would certainly kill them as were killed the (people of) Thamud.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne bayan kiya: Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ne Yemen se Rasoolullah (SAW) ko kuch sona bheja jo mitti mein mila hua tha, ek chamde ke thaile mein jo Mimosa flava ke pattoon se rangaa hua tha. Unhone use char logon mein taqseem kiya. Uyaina bin Hisn, Aqra bin Habis aur Zaid al-Khail, aur chautha ya to Alqama bin Ulatha the ya Amir bin Tufail. Unke sahaba mein se ek shakhs ne kaha: Humein is daulat ka in logon se zyada haq tha. Ye baat Rasoolullah (SAW) tak pahunchi isper unhone kaha: Kya tum mujhpar bharosa nahi karte, jabki main Us hasti ka amaanatdaar hoon jo aasmaan mein hai? Khabar mere paas subah aur shaam aasmaan se aati hai. Phir ek gehri dhansi hui aankhon wala, ubhre gaal wale, buland peshani wala, ghani daadhi wala, mundhe sar wala aur uchi lungi baandhe hua shakhs khada hua, aur usne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, Allah se daro. Unhone kaha: Tumpar afsos. Kya main zameen ke logon mein sabse zyada Allah se darne ka haqdaar nahi hoon? Woh shakhs phir wapas gaya. Khalid bin Walid ne phir kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, kya main iski gardan na maaru? Isper unhone kaha: Shayad woh namaz padh raha ho. Khalid ne kaha: Kitne namaz padhne wale hain jo apni zubaan se woh kehte hain jo unke dil mein nahi hota? Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Mujhe logon ke dilon ko chirfaad karne ka, na hi unke peton ko cheerne ka hukum diya gaya hai. Unhone phir usse dekha aur woh wapas jaa raha tha. Isper unhone kaha: Iski naslon se ek qaum uthhegi jo Quran ko roani se padhegi, lekin ye unke gale se aage nahi jaayega; woh jaldi jaldi deen se aise guzrenge jaise teer shikaar se guzarta hai. Mujhe khayal hai ki unhone ye bhi kaha: Agar main unhe pau to unhe zaroor is tarah qatl karunga jaise Thamud qaum qatl ki gayi thi.

e: This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters and (the narrator) made a mention of elevated forehead, but he made no mention of tucked-up loin cloth and made this addition: " There stood up 'Umar b. Khattab (Allah be pleased with him), and said: Should I not strike his neck? Upon this he said: No. Then he turned away, and Khalid the Sword of Allah stood up against him, and said: Prophet of Allah. shall I not strike off his neck? He said, No, and then said: A people would rise from his progeny who would recite the Book of Allah glibly and fluently. 'Umar said: I think he (the Holy Prophet) also said this: If I find them I would certainly kill them like Thamud."
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se bayan ki gayi hai aur raawi ne buland peshani ka zikr kiya, lekin unhone lungi baandhne ka zikr nahi kiya aur ye izafa kiya: "Umar bin Khattab (RA) khade hue aur kaha: Kya main iski gardan na maaru? Isper unhone kaha: Nahi. Phir woh mudkar chala gaya, aur Khalid, Allah ki Talwaar, uske khilaaf khade hue, aur kaha: Nabi Allah ke, kya main iski gardan na uda dun? Unhone kaha: Nahi, aur phir kaha: Iski naslon se ek qaum uthegi jo Allah ki Kitaab ko roani aur khoobsurati se padhegi. Umar ne kaha: Mera khayal hai unhone ye bhi kaha: Agar main unhe paun to unhe zaroor Thamud ki tarah qatl karunga."

e: This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters, but no mention has been made of: " If I find them, I would kill them as the Thamud were killed."
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se bayan ki gayi hai, lekin iska koi zikr nahi kiya gaya: "Agar main unhe paun, to unhe Thamud ki tarah qatl karunga jaise Thamud qaum qatl ki gayi thi."

e: Abu Salama and 'Ata' b. Yasar came to Abu Sa'id al-Khudri and asked him about Haruriya, saying: Did you hear the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) making a mention of them? He (Abu Sai'd al-Khudri) said: I don't know who the Haruriya are, but I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: There would arise in this nation (and he did not say" out of them" ) a people and you would hold insignificant your prayers as compared with their prayers. And they would recite the Qur'an which would not go beyond their throats and would swerve through the religion (as blank) just as a (swift) arrow passes through the prey. The archer looks at his arrow, at its iron head and glances at its end (which he held) in the tip of his fingers to see whether it had any stain of blood.
hi: Abu Salama aur Ata bin Yasar Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ke paas aaye aur unse Haruriya ke baare mein poocha, ye kehte hue: Kya aapne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko unka zikr karte suna? Unhone kaha: Mujhe nahi pata Haruriya kaun hain, lekin maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Is ummat mein, aur unhone "unmein se" nahi kaha, ek qaum uthegi aur tum apni namaz ko unki namaz ke muqable mein mamooli samjhoge. Aur woh Quran padhenge jo unke gale se aage nahi jaayega aur woh deen se aise mud jaayenge jaise ek tez teer shikaar se guzar jaata hai. Teer chalaane wala apne teer ki taraf dekhta hai, uske lohe wale sar ki taraf, aur uske aakhri hisse ki taraf, jise woh apni ungliyon ke sirhon mein pakde hota hai, ye dekhne ke liye ki ismein khoon ka koi dhabba to nahi.

e: Abu Sai'd al-Khudri reported: When we were in the company of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he was distributing the spoils of war, there came to him Dhul-Khuwasira, one of Banu Tamim. He said: Messenger of Allah, do justice. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Woe be upon thee! Who would do justice, if I do not do justice? You would be unsuccessful and incurring a loss, if I do not do justice. Upon this Umar b. Khattab (Allah be pleased with him) said: Messenger of Allah, permit me to strike off his neck. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Leave him, for he has friends (who would outwardly look to be so religious and pious) that everyone among you would consider his prayer insignificant as compared with their prayer, and his fast as compared with their fasts. They would recite the Qur'an but it would not go beyond their collar-bones. They would pass through (the teachings of Islam so hurriedly) just as the arrow passes through the prey. He would look at its Iron head, but would not find anything ticking) there. He would then see at the lowest end, but would not find anything sticking there. He would then see at its grip but would not find anything sticking to it. He would then see at its feathers and he would find nothing sticking to them (as the arrow would pass so quickly that nothing would stick to it) neither excrement nor blood. They would be recognised by the presence of a black man among them whose upper arms would be like a woman's breast, or like a piece of meat as it quivers, and they would come forth at the time when there is dissension among the people. Abu Sai'd said: I testify to the fact that I heard it from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and I testify to the fact that 'Ali b. Abu Talib fought against them and I was with him. He gave orders about that man who was sought for, and when he was brought in, and when I looked at him, he was exactly as the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had described him.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne bayan kiya: Jab hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ki sohbat mein the aur woh maal-e-ganimat taqseem kar rahe the, to unke paas Dhul-Khuwasira aaye, jo Banu Tamim mein se the. Unhone kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, insaaf karo. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Tumpar afsos ho! Kaun insaaf karega, agar main insaaf nahi karta? Tum badnaseeb aur ghaate mein rahoge, agar main insaaf nahi karta. Isper Umar bin Khattab (RA) ne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, mujhe iski gardan udaane ki ijazat dijiye. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Ise chhod do, kyunki uske aise saathi hain, jo zaahir taur par itne deendaar aur nek dikhenge, ki tum mein se har ek apni namaz ko unki namaz ke muqable mein aur apna roza unke roze ke muqable mein mamooli samjhega. Woh Quran padhenge lekin ye unki gale ki haddi se aage nahi jaayega. Woh Islam ki taalimaat se itni jaldi guzrenge jaise teer shikaar se guzarta hai. Woh uske lohe wale sar ki taraf dekhega, lekin usmein kuch chipka hua nahi paayega. Woh phir uske sabse neeche wale sirhe ki taraf dekhega, lekin usmein bhi kuch chipka hua nahi paayega. Woh phir uski pakad ki taraf dekhega lekin usmein bhi kuch chipka hua nahi paayega. Woh phir uske paron ki taraf dekhega aur unhe kuch bhi chipka hua nahi milega, kyunki teer itni jaldi guzar jaayega ki usmein kuch bhi nahi chipkega, na gu na khoon. Unhe ek kaale aadmi ki maujoodgi se pehchaana jaayega jinke baazu ki upari haddi ek aurat ki chhati jaisi hogi, ya jaise gosht ka tukda kaanpta hai, aur woh us waqt saamne aayenge jab logon mein phoot padegi. Abu Sa'id ne kaha: Main is baat ki gawaahi deta hoon ki maine ye Rasoolullah (SAW) se suna hai, aur main is baat ki bhi gawaahi deta hoon ki Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ne unke khilaaf jung ladi aur main unke saath tha. Unhone us aadmi ke baare mein hukum diya jise talaash kiya ja raha tha, aur jab use laaya gaya, aur jab maine use dekha, to woh bilkul waisa hi tha jaisa Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unka bayaan kiya tha.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri said that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) made a mention of a sect that would be among his Ummah which would emerge out of the dissension of the people. Their distinctive mark would be shaven heads. They would be the worst creatures or the worst of the creatures. The group who would be nearer to the truth out of the two would kill them. The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) gave an example (to give their description) or he said: A man throws an arrow at the prey (or he said at the target), and sees at its iron head, but finds no sign (of blood there), or he sees at the lowest end, but would not see or find any sign (of blood there). He would then see into the grip but would not find (anything) sticking to it. Abu Sai'd then said: People of Iraq. it is you who have killed them.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne kaha ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne ek aise firqe ka zikr kiya jo unki ummat mein hoga jo logon ke phoot ki wajah se paida hoga. Unki khaas pehchaan mundhe sar honge. Woh sabse buri makhlooq, ya makhlooqaat mein se sabse buray honge. Jo giroh sach ke zyada kareeb hoga, unmein se woh unhe qatl karega. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unki tafseer dene ke liye ek misaal di, ya unhone kaha: Ek aadmi shikaar par ek teer chalaata hai, ya unhone kaha: nishaane par, aur uske lohe wale sar ki taraf dekhta hai, lekin use koi nishaan, khoon ka, nahi milta, ya woh uske sabse neeche wale sirhe ki taraf dekhta hai, lekin usse koi nishaan nahi dikhta ya milta. Woh phir uski pakad ki taraf dekhta hai lekin usmein kuch chipka hua nahi paata. Abu Sa'id ne phir kaha: Iraq ke logo, tum hi ho jinhone unhe qatl kiya.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: A group would secede itself (from the Ummah) when there would be dissension among the Muslims. Out of the two groups who would be nearer the truth would kill them.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Ek giroh alag ho jaayega, ummat se, jab Musalmaanon mein phoot hogi. In do giroahon mein se jo sach ke zyada kareeb hoga woh unhe qatl karega.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There would be two groups in my Ummah, and there would emerge another group (seceding itself from both of them), and the party nearer to the truth among the two would kill them (the group of the Khawarij).
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Meri ummat mein do giroh honge, aur unse ek aur giroh niklega, dono se alag hokar, aur do mein se jo giroh sach ke zyada kareeb hoga woh unhe, Khawarij ke giroh ko, qatl karega.

e: It was narrated from Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "A group will secede at a time of division among the people, and they will be killed by the group that is closer to the truth."
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri se riwayat ki gayi hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: "Ek giroh alag ho jaayega jab logon mein phoot ka waqt hoga, aur unhe woh giroh qatl karega jo sach ke zyada kareeb hoga."

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that a group (Khawarij) would emerge from the different parties (the party of Hadrat 'Ali and the party of Amir Mu'awiya), the group nearer the truth between the two would kill them.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ki ek giroh, Khawarij, mukhtalif giroahon se, Hazrat Ali (Alayhis Salam) ka giroh aur Amir Muawiya ka giroh, niklega, aur dono mein se jo giroh sach ke zyada kareeb hoga woh unhe qatl karega.

e: 'Ali said: Whenever I narrate to you anything from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) believe it to be absolutely true as falling from the sky is dearer to me than that of attributing anything to him (the Holy Prophet) which he never said. When I talk to you of anything which is between me and you (there might creep some error in it) for battle is an outwitting. I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: There would arise at the end of the age a people who would be young in age and immature in thought, but they would talk (in such a manner) as if their words are the best among the creatures. They would recite the Qur'an, but it would not go beyond their throats, and they would pass through the religion as an arrow goes through the prey. So when you meet them, kill them, for in their killing you would get a reward with Allah on the Day of Judgement.
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: Jab bhi main tumhe Rasoolullah (SAW) se kuch bayan karun, ise bilkul sach maan lo, kyunki mere liye aasmaan se girna is baat se zyada aziz hai ki main unse koi aisi baat mansoob karun jo unhone kabhi kahi hi nahi. Jab main tumse aisi kisi baat par baat karta hoon jo mere aur tumhare darmiyan hai, to usmein koi galti ho sakti hai, kyunki jung dhoka-dhadi hai. Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Zamane ke aakhir mein aise log uthenge jo umar mein jawaan aur soch mein kachche honge, lekin woh aisi tarah baat karenge jaise unke alfaaz makhlooqaat mein sabse behtareen hon. Woh Quran padhenge, lekin ye unke gale se aage nahi jaayega, aur woh deen se aise guzrenge jaise teer shikaar se guzarta hai. To jab tum unse milo, unhe qatl karo, kyunki unhe qatl karne mein tumhe Qayamat ke din Allah ke paas sawaab milega.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters, but (these words) are not there: " They pass through the religion clean as the arrow passes through the prey."
hi: Ye hadees A'mash ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai, lekin ye alfaaz nahi hain: "Woh deen se aise saaf guzrenge jaise teer shikaar se guzarta hai."

e: 'Abida narrated from 'Ali that he made a mention of the Khawarij (and in this connection) said that there would be a person among them with a defective hand (or with a short hand) or a fleshy hand. If you were to exercise restraint, I would tell you what Allah has promised to those who would kill them on the order of Muhammad (ﷺ). I (the narrator) said to him: Did you hear it from Muhammad (ﷺ)? He (Hadrat 'Ali) said: Yes, by the Lord of the Ka'bah; Yes, by the Lord of the Ka'bah; yes, by the Lord of the Ka'bah.
hi: Abida ne Ali (Alayhis Salam) se riwayat ki ki unhone Khawarij ka zikr kiya aur isi silsile mein kaha ki unmein ek shakhs hoga jiska haath khraab, ya chota, ya gosht-bhara hoga. Agar tum sabar rakho, to main tumhe bataunga ki Allah ne un logon se kya wada kiya hai jo Muhammad (SAW) ke hukum par unhe, Khawarij ko, qatl karenge. Maine unse kaha: Kya aapne ye Muhammad (SAW) se suna? Unhone, Hazrat Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne, kaha: Haan, Kaaba ke Rab ki qasam; Haan, Kaaba ke Rab ki qasam; Haan, Kaaba ke Rab ki qasam.

e: 'Abida said: I will not narrate to you except what I heard from him (Hadrat 'Ali), and then he narrated from him.
hi: Abida ne kaha: Main tumhe sirf woh bataunga jo maine unse, Hazrat Ali (Alayhis Salam) se, suna, aur phir unhone unse riwayat ki.

e: Zaid b. Wahb Juhani reported and he was among the squadron which was under the command of Ali (Allah be pleased with him) and which set out (to curb the activities) of the Khawarij. 'Ali (Allah be pleased with him) said: O people, I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: There would arise from my Ummah a people who would recite the Qur'an, and your recital would seem insignificant as compared with their recital, your prayer as compared with their prayer, and your fast, as compared with their fast. They would recite the Qur'an thinking that it supports them, whereas it is an evidence against them. Their prayer does not get beyond their collar bone; they would swerve through Islam just as the arrow passes through the prey. If the squadron which is to encounter them were to know (what great boon) has been assured to them by their Messenger (ﷺ) they would completely rely upon this deed (alone and cease to do other good deeds), and their (that of the Khawarij) distinctive mark is that there would be (among them) a person whose wrist would be without the arm, and the end of his wrist would be fleshy like the nipple of the breast on which there would be white hair. You would be marching towards Muawiya and the people of Syria and you would leave them behind among your children and your property (to do harm). By Allah, I believe that these are the people (against whom you have been commanded to fight and get reward) for they have shed forbidden blood, and raided the animals of the people. So go forth in the name of Allah (to fight against them). Salama b. Kuhail mentioned that Zaid b. Wahb made me alight at every stage, till we crossed a bridge. 'Abdullah b. Wahb al-Rasibi was at the head of the Khawarij when we encountered them. He ('Abdullah) said to his army: Throw the spears and draw out your swords from their sheaths, for I fear that they would attack you as they attacked you on the day of Harura. They went back and threw their spears and drew out their swords, and people fought against them with spears and they were killed one after another. Only two persons were killed among the people (among the army led by 'Ali) on that day. 'Ali (Allah be pleased with him) said: Find out from among them (the dead bodies of the Khawarij) (the maimed). They searched but did not find him. 'Ali (Allah be pleased with him) then himself stood up and (walked) till he came to the people who had been killed one after another. He ('Ali) said: Search them to the last, and then ('Ali's companions) found him (the dead body of the maimed) near the earth. He ('Ali) then pronounced Allahu Akbar (Allah is the Greatest) and then said, Allah told the Truth and His Messenger (ﷺ) conveyed it. Then there stood before him 'Abida Salmani who said: Commander of the Believers, by Allah, besides Whom there is no god but He, (tell me) whether you heard this hadith from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He said: Yes, by Allah, besides Whom there is no god but He. He asked him to take an oath thrice and he took the oath.
hi: Zaid bin Wahb Juhani ne bayan kiya aur woh us dastay mein the jo Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki command mein tha aur jo Khawarij ki karwaayi rokne ke liye nikla. Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: Aye logo, maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Meri ummat mein se aise log uthenge jo Quran padhenge, aur tumhari tilawat unki tilawat ke muqable mein mamooli lagegi, tumhari namaz unki namaz ke muqable mein, aur tumhara roza unke roze ke muqable mein. Woh Quran padhenge ye sochte hue ki ye unke haq mein hai, jabki ye unke khilaaf gawaah hoga. Unki namaz unki gale ki haddi se aage nahi jaati; woh Islam se aise mud jaayenge jaise teer shikaar se guzarta hai. Agar dastaa jo unse mukaabla karega ye jaan le ki unhe, Khawarij ko qatl karne walon ko, unke Rasool (SAW) ne kya vaada diya hai, to woh poori tarah is amal, akele, par bharosa karenge, aur doosre nek amal karna chhod denge, aur unki, Khawarij ki, khaas pehchaan ye hai ki unmein ek shakhs hoga jiski kalaai bina baazu ke hogi, aur uski kalaai ka sirha, gosht-bhara hoga jaise chhati ka nipple, jispar safed baal honge. Tum Muawiya aur Syria ke logon ki taraf march karoge aur unhe, Khawarij ko, apne bachhon aur apni maal ke beech, nuksaan pahunchaane ke liye, peeche chhod jaaoge. Allah ki qasam, mera imaan hai ki ye wohi log hain, jinke khilaaf tumhe ladne aur sawaab paane ka hukum diya gaya hai, kyunki unhone haraam khoon bahaaya hai, aur logon ke jaanwaron par hamla kiya hai. Is liye Allah ke naam par nikal padho, unse ladne ke liye. Salama bin Kuhail ne zikr kiya ki Zaid bin Wahb ne mujhe har padaav par ruka, yahan tak ki humne ek pul paar kiya. Abdullah bin Wahb al-Rasibi Khawarij ke sarbaraah the jab humne unka saamna kiya. Unhone apni fauj se kaha: Bhaale phenko aur apni talwaaren myaanon se nikaalo, kyunki mujhe dar hai ki woh tumpar hamla karenge jaisa unhone Harura ke din kiya tha. Woh wapas gaye aur apne bhaale phenke aur apni talwaaren nikaalin, aur logon ne unse bhaalon se jung ladi aur woh ek-doosre ke baad qatl kiye gaye. Sirf do log Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki fauj mein us din maare gaye. Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: Unmein se, Khawarij ki laashon mein se, us naqas waale shakhs ko dhoondo. Unhone talaash ki lekin unhe woh nahi mila. Ali (Alayhis Salam) phir khud khade hue aur chalte hue un logon ke paas gaye jo ek ke baad ek maare gaye the. Unhone kaha: Unhe aakhir tak talaash karo, aur phir Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke saathiyon ne use zameen ke qareeb paaya. Unhone phir Allahu Akbar kaha aur phir kaha, Allah ne sach kaha aur uske Rasool (SAW) ne ye pahunchaaya. Phir unke saamne Abida Salmani khade hue jinhone kaha: Ameer-ul-Momineen, Allah ki qasam, jiske siwaay koi ma'bood nahi, mujhe bataiye kya aapne ye hadees Rasoolullah (SAW) se suni hai. Unhone kaha: Haan, Allah ki qasam, jiske siwaay koi ma'bood nahi. Unhone unse teen baar qasam khilwaayi aur unhone qasam khayi.

e: 'Ubaidullah b. Abu Rafi', the freed slave of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), said: When Haruria (the Khawarij) set out and as he was with 'Ali b. Abu Talib (Allah be pleased with him) they said, "There is no command but that of Allah." Upon this 'Ali said: The statement is true but it is intentionally applied (to support) a wrong (cause). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) described their characteristics and I found these characteristics in them. They state the truth with their tongue, but it does not go beyond this part of their bodies (and the narrator pointed towards his throat). The most hateful among the creation of Allah is one black man among them (Khawarij). One of his hand is like the teat of a goat or the nipple of the breast. When 'Ali b. Abu Talib (Allah be pleased with him) killed them, he said: Search (for his dead body). They searched for him, but they did not find it (his dead body). Upon this he said: Go (and search for him). By Allah, neither I have spoken a lie nor has the lie been spoken to me. 'Ali said this twice and thrice. They then found him (the dead body) in a rain. They brought (his dead) body till they placed it before him (Hadrat 'Ali). 'Ubaidullah said: And, I was present at (that place) when this happened and when 'Ali said about them. A person narrated to me from Ibn Hanain that he said: I saw that black man.
hi: Ubaidullah bin Abu Rafi, Rasoolullah (SAW) ke aazad kiye hue ghulam, ne kaha: Jab Haruriya, Khawarij, nikle aur jab woh Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ke saath the, unhone kaha, "Hukum sirf Allah ka hai." Isper Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: Ye baat sach hai lekin ise jaan-boojh kar galat maqsad ke liye istemal kiya ja raha hai. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unki khaasiyat bayan ki thi aur maine woh khaasiyaten unmein paayin. Woh apni zubaan se sach bolte hain, lekin ye unke jism ke is hisse, aur raawi ne apne gale ki taraf ishara kiya, se aage nahi jaata. Allah ki makhlooq mein sabse zyada napasandeeda unmein se ek kaala aadmi hai. Uska ek haath bakri ke thann jaisa ya chhati ke nipple jaisa hai. Jab Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ne unhe qatl kiya, to unhone kaha: Uske jism ko dhoondo. Unhone use dhoonda, lekin unhe woh nahi mila. Isper unhone kaha: Jao aur use dhoondo. Allah ki qasam, na maine jhoot kaha hai na mujhse jhoot kaha gaya hai. Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne ye do-teen baar kaha. Woh phir use ek naali mein paate hain. Woh uska murda jism laaye yahan tak ki unhone use unke, Hazrat Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke, saamne rakh diya. Ubaidullah ne kaha: Aur main wahan maujood tha jab ye hua aur jab Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne unke baare mein kaha. Ek shakhs ne mujhse Ibn Hanain ke hawale se riwayat ki ki unhone kaha: Maine woh kaala aadmi dekha.

e: Abu Dharr reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Verily there would arise from my Ummah after me or soon after me a group (of people) who would recite the Qur'an, but it would not go beyond their throats, and they would pass clean through their religion just as the arrow passes through the prey, and they would never come back to it. They would be the worst among the creation and the creatures. Ibn Samit (one of the narrators) said: I met Rafi' b. 'Amr Ghifari, the brother of Al-Hakam Ghifari and I said: What is this hadith that I heard from Abu Dharr, i. e. so and so?  and then I narrated that hadith to him and said: I heard it from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).
hi: Abu Dharr ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Yaqeenan mere baad ya mere baad jald hi meri ummat mein se ek giroh uthega jo Quran padhega, lekin ye unke gale se aage nahi jaayega, aur woh apne deen se aise saaf guzrenge jaise teer shikaar se guzarta hai, aur woh kabhi ismein wapas nahi aayenge. Woh makhlooq aur makhlooqaat mein sabse buray honge. Ibn Samit, ek raawi, ne kaha: Main Rafi bin Amr Ghifari se mila, jo Al-Hakam Ghifari ke bhai the, aur maine kaha: Ye kaisi hadees hai jo maine Abu Dharr se suni, yaani falan-falan? Aur phir maine unhe ye hadees sunayi aur kaha: Maine ise Rasoolullah (SAW) se suna.

e: Yusair b. 'Amr reported that he inquired of Sahl b. Hunaif: Did you hear the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) making a mention of the Khawarij? He said: I heard him say (and he pointed with his hand towards the east) that these would be a people who would recite the Qur'an with their tongues and it would not go beyond their collar bones. They would pass clean through their religion just as the arrow passes through the prey.
hi: Yusair bin Amr ne bayan kiya ki unhone Sahl bin Hunaif se poocha: Kya aapne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko Khawarij ka zikr karte suna? Unhone kaha: Maine unhe ye kehte suna, aur unhone apne haath se poorab ki taraf ishara kiya, ki ye ek aisi qaum hogi jo Quran ko apni zubaan se padhegi lekin ye unki gale ki haddi se aage nahi jaayega. Woh apne deen se aise saaf guzrenge jaise teer shikaar se guzarta hai.

e: This hadith had been transmitted by Sulaiman Shaibani with the same chain of narrators (and the words are)," There would arise out of (this group) many a group"
hi: Ye hadees Sulaiman Shaibani ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai, aur alfaaz hain, "Isse kayi giroh niklenge."

e: Sahl b. Hunaif reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: There would arise from the east a people with shaven heads.
hi: Sahl bin Hunaif ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Poorab se ek aisi qaum uthegi jinke sar mundhe honge.

e: Abu Huraira reported that Hasan b. 'Ali took one of The dates of the sadaqa and put it in his mouth, whereupon the Prophet (ﷺ) said: Leave it, leave it, throw it; don't you know that we do not eat the sadaqa?
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki Hasan bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne sadaqe ki khajooron mein se ek li aur use apne munh mein daala, isper Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Chhod do, chhod do, ise phenk do; kya tumhe nahi pata ki hum sadaqa nahi khaate?

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters (and the words of the Holy Prophet) are: " Sadaqa is not permissible for us."
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai, aur Nabi ke alfaaz hain: "Sadaqa hamare liye jaayez nahi hai."

e: This very hadith has been narrated on the authority of Sbu'ba with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Yehi hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: I go back to my family and I find a date lying on my bed. I then take it up to eat it, but then I throw it away fearing that it may be a Sadaqa.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Main apne gharwalon ke paas wapas jaata hoon aur apne bistar par ek khajoor padi paata hoon. Main use uthaata hoon use khaane ke liye, lekin phir ise phenk deta hoon is dar se ki kahin ye sadaqe ka na ho.

e: Out of so many ahadith which Hammam b. Munabbih narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) one is this that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: I go back to my family and I find a date lying on my bed or in my house, and I take it up to eat it, but then I throw it away fearing that it may be a Sadaqa or from Sadaqa.
hi: Un kayi hadeeson mein se jo Hammam bin Munabbih ne Abu Huraira ki sanad se Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat kin, ek ye hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Main apne gharwalon ke paas wapas jaata hoon aur apne bistar par ya apne ghar mein ek khajoor padi paata hoon, aur main use uthaata hoon use khaane ke liye, lekin phir ise phenk deta hoon is dar se ki kahin ye sadaqe ka ya sadaqe mein se ho.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) found a date in the street and said: If it were not of sadaqa I would have eaten it.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ko galiyaare mein ek khajoor mili aur unhone kaha: Agar ye sadaqe ka na hota, to main use khaa leta.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) found a date lying on the path and said: If it were not out of Sadaqa, I would have eaten it.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ko raste mein padi ek khajoor mili aur unhone kaha: Agar ye sadaqe mein se na hota, to main use khaa leta.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) found a date and said: Were it not (that I fear) it may be part of sadaqa, I would have eaten it.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ek khajoor mili aur unhone kaha: Agar mujhe ye dar na hota ki ye sadaqe ka hissa hai, to main use khaa leta.

e: 'Abd al-Muttalib b. Rabi'a b. al-Harith reported that Rabi'a b. al-Harith and Abbas b. Abd al-Muttalib gathered together and said: By Allah, if we had sent these two young boys (i. e. I and Fadl b. 'Abbas) to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and they had spoken to him, he would have appointed them (as the collectors) of these sadaqat; and they would (collect them) and pay (to the Holy Prophet) as other people (collectors) paid and would get a share as other people got it. As they were talking about it there came 'Ali b. Abu Talib and stood before them, and they made a mention of it to him. 'Ali b. Abu Talib said: Don't do that; by Allah he (the Holy Prophet) would not do that (would not accept your request). Rabi'a b. Harith turned to him and said: By Allah, you are not doing so but out of jealousy that you nurse against us By Allah, you became the son-in-law of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) but we felt no jealousy against you (for this great privilege of yours). 'Ali then said: Send them (if you like). They set out and 'Ali lay on the bed. When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) offered the noon prayer. we went ahead of him to his apartment and stood near it till he came out. He took hold of our ears (out of love and affection) and then said: Give out what you have kept in your hearts. He then entered (the apartment) and we also went in and he (the Holy Prophet) was on that day (in the house of) Zainab b. jahsh. We urged each (of us) to speak. Then one of us thus spoke: Messenger of Allah, you are the best of humanity and the best to cement the ties of blood-relations. We have reached the-marriageable age. We have come (to you) so that you may appoint us (as collectors) of these sadaqat. and we would pay you just as thin people (other collectors) pay you, and get our share as others get it. He (the Holy Prophet) kept silence for a long time till we wished that we should speak with him (again), and Zainab pointied to us from behind the curtain not to talk (any more). He (the Holy Prophet) said; It does not become the family of Muhammad (to accept) sadaqat for they are the impurities of people. You call to me Mahmiya (and he was in charge of khums, i. e, of the one-fifth part that goes to the treasury out of the spoils of war), and Naufal b. Harith b. 'Abd al-Muttalib. They both came to him, and he (the Holy Prophet) said to Mahmiya: Marry your daughter to this young man (i. e. Fadl b. 'Abbas), and he married her to him And he said to Naufal b. Harith: Marry your daughter to this young man (i e. 'Abd al-Muttalib b. Rabi'a, the narrator of this hadith) and he married her to me, and he said to Mahmiya: Pay so much mahr on behalf of both of them from this khums Zuhri, however. said: He did not determine (the amount of mahr).
hi: Abdul Muttalib bin Rabi'a bin al-Harith ne bayan kiya ki Rabi'a bin al-Harith aur Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib ikattha hue aur kaha: Allah ki qasam, agar humne in do jawaan larkon, yaani main aur Fadl bin Abbas, ko Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas bheja hota aur unhone unse baat ki hoti, to woh unhe in sadaqaat jama karne walon ke taur par muqarrar kar dete; aur woh unhe jama karke doosre logon, jama karne walon, ki tarah bhugtaan karte aur doosron ki tarah hissa paate. Jab woh isi baat par charcha kar rahe the, Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) aaye aur unke saamne khade huye, aur unhone unse iska zikr kiya. Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: Aisa mat karo; Allah ki qasam, woh aisa nahi karenge, tumhari darkhaast qubool nahi karenge. Rabi'a bin Harith unki taraf mude aur kaha: Allah ki qasam, tum aisa nahi kar rahe siwaay is jalan ke jo tum hamare khilaaf rakhte ho. Allah ki qasam, tum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke damaad ban gaye, lekin humne tumhare is bade saubhagya ke liye tumse koi jalan mehsoos nahi ki. Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne phir kaha: Unhe bhejo, agar tum chaho. Woh nikle aur Ali (Alayhis Salam) bistar par let gaye. Jab Rasoolullah (SAW) ne zohar ki namaz padhi, hum unse pehle unke kamre ki taraf gaye aur uske paas khade rahe yahan tak ki woh bahar aaye. Unhone muhabbat aur shafqat mein hamare kaan pakde aur phir kaha: Jo tumne apne dilon mein rakha hai woh bata do. Woh phir andar gaye aur hum bhi andar gaye aur woh us din Zainab bint Jahsh ke ghar the. Humne ek-doosre ko bolne par ubhaara. Phir hummein se ek ne yun kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, aap insaaniyat mein sabse behtareen hain aur rishton ko jodne mein sabse behtareen. Hum shaadi ki umar ko pahunch chuke hain. Hum aapke paas is liye aaye hain taaki aap humein in sadaqaat ke jama karne walon ke taur par muqarrar karein, aur hum aapko waise hi bhugtaan karenge jaise doosre jama karne wale log aapko dete hain, aur hissa paayenge jaise doosre paate hain. Woh lambe waqt tak khamosh rahe yahan tak ki hum chahne lage ki hum unse dobara baat karein, aur Zainab ne parde ke peeche se humein ishara kiya ki ab baat na karein. Unhone kaha: Ye Muhammad ke gharane ke liye munaasib nahi ki woh sadaqaat qubool karein kyunki ye logon ki gandagi hain. Tum mujhe Mahmiya bulaao, aur woh khums ke incharge the, yaani maal-e-ganimat se aane wale ek-panchvein hisse ke jo khazaane mein jaata hai, aur Naufal bin Harith bin Abdul Muttalib. Woh dono unke paas aaye, aur unhone Mahmiya se kaha: Apni beti ki shaadi is jawaan larke se karo, yaani Fadl bin Abbas se, aur unhone unki shaadi unse kar di. Aur unhone Naufal bin Harith se kaha: Apni beti ki shaadi is jawaan larke se karo, yaani Abdul Muttalib bin Rabi'a se, is hadees ke raawi, aur unhone unki shaadi mujhse kar di, aur unhone Mahmiya se kaha: Dono ki taraf se itna mehr is khums se ada karo. Zuhri ne, halaanki, kaha: Unhone mehr ki raqam muqarrar nahi ki.

e: Rabi'a b. Harith b. 'Abd al-Muttalib and Abbas b. 'Abd al-Muttalib said to Abd al-Muttalib b. Rabi'a and Fadl b. Ibn Abbas: Go to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and the rest of the hadith is the same (but with this addition):" 'Ali spread his cloak and then lay down on it and said: I am the father of Hasan, and I am the chief. By Allah, I would not move from my place till your sons come back to you with the reply to that for which you sent them to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).
