And he then also said: Verily these sadaqat are the impurities of people, and they are not permissible for Muhammad (may peaace be upon him), and for the family of Muhammad. And he also said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) also said to me: Call Mahmiya b. Jaz', and he was person from Banu Asad. and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had appointed him as a collector of khums.
hi: Rabi'a bin Harith bin Abdul Muttalib aur Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib ne Abdul Muttalib bin Rabi'a aur Fadl bin Ibn Abbas se kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas jao, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai, lekin is izafe ke saath: "Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne apna chogha phaila diya aur phir usmein let gaye aur kaha: Main Hasan (Alayhis Salam) ka waalid hoon, aur main sardaar hoon. Allah ki qasam, main apni jagah se nahi hilunga jab tak tumhare bete us jawaab ke saath tumhare paas wapas na aa jaayen jiske liye tumne unhe Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas bheja. Aur unhone ye bhi kaha: Yaqeenan ye sadaqaat logon ki gandagi hain, aur ye Muhammad (SAW) ke liye jaayez nahi hain, aur na hi Muhammad ke gharane ke liye. Aur unhone ye bhi kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne mujhse bhi kaha: Mahmiya bin Jaz ko bulaao, aur woh Banu Asad ke ek shakhs the, aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unhe khums ka jama karne wala muqarrar kiya tha."

e: Juwayriya, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)" said that Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to her and said: Is there anything to eat? She said: Messenger of Allah, I swear by God, there is no food with us except a bone of goat which my freed maid-servant was given as sadaqa. Upon this he said: Bring that to me, for it (the sadaqa) has reached its destination.
hi: Juwayriya, Rasoolullah (SAW) ki zauja, ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) unke paas aaye aur kaha: Kya khaane ko kuch hai? Unhone kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, Allah ki qasam, hamare paas koi khaana nahi hai siwaay bakri ki ek haddi ke jo meri aazad ki hui laundi ko sadaqe mein di gayi thi. Isper unhone kaha: Use mere paas laao, kyunki woh sadaqa apni manzil tak pahunch chuka hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Zuhri with the same chain of trainsmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Barira presented to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) a piece of meat which had been given to her as sadaqa. Upon this he (the Holy Prophet) said: That is a Sadaqa for her and a gift for us.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki Barira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko gosht ka ek tukda pesh kiya jo unhe sadaqe mein diya gaya tha. Isper unhone kaha: Ye uske liye sadaqa hai aur hamare liye tohfa.

e: 'A'isha reported that (once) the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him, ) was presented with beef. It was said (by someone) that it had been given to Barira as Sadaqa. Upon this he (the Prophet) said: It is a Sadaqa for her and a gift for us.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki ek baar Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saamne gaay ka gosht pesh kiya gaya. Kaha gaya, kisi ne, ki ye Barira ko sadaqe mein diya gaya tha. Isper unhone kaha: Ye uske liye sadaqa hai aur hamare liye tohfa.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) said: Three are the decions (of the Shari'ah that we have come to know) through Barira. The people gave her sadaqa and she offered us as gift. We made a mention of it to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), whereupon he said: It is a sadaqa for her and a gift for you; so eat it.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne kaha: Teen faisle, Shariat ke, hain jinke baare mein hum Barira ke zariye jaan paaye. Logon ne unhe sadaqa diya aur unhone hamein woh tohfe mein diya. Humne iska zikr Rasoolullah (SAW) se kiya, isper unhone kaha: Ye uske liye sadaqa hai aur tumhare liye tohfa; is liye ise khao.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of A'isha through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Aisha ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of 'A'isha in a similar manner except a slight variation that he said: " That is a gift for us out of it."
hi: Ye hadees Aisha ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai siwaay is halki tabdeeli ke ki unhone kaha: "Ye hamare liye usmein se ek tohfa hai."

e: Umm 'Atiyya, said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent me some mutton of sadaqa. I sent a piece out of that to 'A'isha. When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to 'A'isha, he said: Have you anything with you (to eat)? She said: Nothing, except only that mutton sent to us by Nusaiba (the kunya of Umm 'Atiyya) which you had sent to her. Whereupon he said: It has reached its proper place.
hi: Umm Atiyya ne kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne mujhe sadaqe ka kuch bakri ka gosht bheja. Maine usmein se ek tukda Aisha ko bheja. Jab Rasoolullah (SAW) Aisha ke paas aaye, to unhone kaha: Kya tumhare paas khaane ko kuch hai? Unhone kaha: Kuch nahi, siwaay sirf uss bakri ke gosht ke jo Nusaiba, Umm Atiyya ki kunyat, ne hamein bheja hai jo aapne unhe bheja tha. Isper unhone kaha: Ye apni sahi manzil tak pahunch gaya hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: Whenever the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was presented with food, he asked about it, If he was told that it was a gift, he ate out of that, and if he was told that it was a sadaqa he did not eat out of that.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya: Jab bhi Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saamne khaana pesh kiya jaata, woh iske baare mein poochte. Agar unhe bataya jaata ki ye ek tohfa hai, to woh usmein se khaate, aur agar unhe bataya jaata ki ye sadaqa hai, to woh usmein se nahi khaate.

e: 'Abdullah b. Abu Aufa said that it was the common practice of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that when the people brought to him sadaqa he blessed them: O Allah, bless them. So when Abu Aufa brought to him Sadaqa he (the Holy Prophet) said: O Allah, bless, the posterity of Abu Aufa.
hi: Abdullah bin Abu Aufa ne kaha ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ka ye aam amal tha ki jab log unke paas sadaqa laate, to woh unhe barkat ki dua dete: Aye Allah, unhe barkat de. To jab Abu Aufa unke paas Sadaqa laaye, to unhone kaha: Aye Allah, Abu Aufa ki naslon ko barkat de.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters (but with a slight variation of words, that he said): (O Allah), bless them."
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai, lekin alfaaz mein halki tabdeeli ke saath ki unhone kaha: "Aye Allah, unhe barkat de."

e: Jarir b. 'Abdullah said: 'When the collector of sadaqat (Zakat) comes to you, (you should see) that he goes away pleased with you.
hi: Jarir bin Abdullah ne kaha: "Jab tumhare paas sadaqaat, Zakaat, jama karne wala aaye, to tumhe dekhna chahiye ki woh tumse khush hokar jaaye."

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When there comes the month of Ramadan, the gates of mercy are opened, and the gates of Hell are locked and the devils are chained,
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab Ramzan ka mahina aata hai, to rehmat ke darwaze khol diye jaate hain, aur jahannam ke darwaze band kar diye jaate hain aur shaitaanon ko zanjeeron mein jakad diya jaata hai.

e: Narrated Abu Huraira: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When it is the month of Ramadan, the gates of mercy are opened, and the gates of Hell are locked and the devils are chained.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab Ramzan ka mahina hota hai, to rehmat ke darwaze khol diye jaate hain, aur jahannam ke darwaze band kar diye jaate hain aur shaitaanon ko zanjeeron mein jakad diya jaata hai.

e: This hadith is reported by Abu Huraira (with a slight alteration of words) that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: " When (the month of) Ramadan begins."
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira ne alfaaz mein halki tabdeeli ke saath bayan ki hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: "Jab Ramzan ka mahina shuru hota hai."

e: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with both of them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying in connection with Ramadan: Do not fast till you see the new moon, and do not break fast till you see it; but if the weather is cloudy calculate about it.
hi: Ibn Umar ne Ramzan ke silsile mein Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Roza tab tak na rakho jab tak tum naya chaand na dekh lo, aur roza tab tak na khatam karo jab tak tum ise na dekh lo; lekin agar mausam badal, baadal, ho, to iska hisaab lagao.

e: Ibn Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) made a mention of Ramadan and he with the gesture of his hand said: The month is thus and thus. (He then withdrew his thumb at the third time). He then said: Fast when you see it, and break your fast when you see it, and if the weather is cloudy calculate it (the months of Sha'ban and Shawwal) as thirty days.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Ramzan ka zikr kiya aur apne haath ke ishare se kaha: Mahina aise aur aise hai. Unhone teesri baar apna angootha rok liya. Unhone phir kaha: Jab tum ise dekho to roza rakho, aur jab tum ise dekho to roza khatam karo, aur agar mausam badal ho, to iska, Sha'baan aur Shawwal mahinon ka, teesa din tak hisaab lagao.

e: This hadith is narrated on the authority of 'Ubaidullah with the same chain of transmitters, and he said: If (the sky) is cloudy for you, then calculate thirty days (for the month of Ramadan).
hi: Ye hadees Ubaidullah ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai, aur unhone kaha: Agar aasmaan tumhare liye badal hai, to teesa din, Ramzan mahine ke liye, hisaab lagao.

e: 'Ubaidullah narrated on the authority of the same chain of transmitters that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) made a mention of Ramadan and said: The month may consist of twenty-nine days, and it may be thus, thus and thus, and (he further) said: Calculate it, but he did not say thirty.
hi: Ubaidullah ne isi sanad se riwayat ki ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Ramzan ka zikr kiya aur kaha: Mahina untees din ka bhi ho sakta hai, aur ye aise, aise, aur aise ho sakta hai, aur unhone aage kaha: Iska hisaab lagao, lekin unhone teesa nahi kaha.

e: Ibn'Umar (Allah be pleased with-both of them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The month of Ramadan may consist of twenty-nine days. So do not fast till you have sighted it (the new moon) and do not break fast, till you have sighted it (the new moon of Shawwal), and if the sky is cloudy for you, then calculate.
hi: Ibn Umar ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ramzan ka mahina untees din ka bhi ho sakta hai. Is liye roza tab tak na rakho jab tak tumne ise, naya chaand, na dekh liya ho aur roza tab tak na khatam karo, jab tak tumne ise, Shawwal ka naya chaand, na dekh liya ho, aur agar aasmaan tumhare liye badal hai, to hisaab lagao.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with both of them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The month (of Ramadan) may consist of twenty nine days; so when you see the new moon observe fast and when you see (the new moon again at the commencement of the month of Shawwal) then break It, and if the sky is cloudy for you, then calculate it (and complete thirty days).
hi: Abdullah bin Umar ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Mahina, Ramzan, untees din ka bhi ho sakta hai; is liye jab tum naya chaand dekho to roza rakho aur jab tum use dekho, Shawwal mahine ki shuruaat mein naya chaand dobara, to use khatam karo, aur agar aasmaan tumhare liye badal hai, to iska hisaab lagao aur teesa din poora karo.

e: 'Abdullah b. Umar (Allah be pleased with both of them) reported Allah's Measenger (ﷺ) as saying: When you see the new moon, observe fast, and when you see it (again) then break it, and if the sky is cloudy for you, then calculate it.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab tum naya chaand dekho, roza rakho, aur jab tum ise dobara dekho to use khatam karo, aur agar aasmaan tumhare liye badal hai, to iska hisaab lagao.

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with both of them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The month may consist of twenty-nine nights. So do not fast till you have sighted it (the new moon) and do not break it till you have sighted it, except when the sky is cloudy for you, and if it is so, then calculate it.
hi: Ibn Umar ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Mahina untees raaton ka bhi ho sakta hai. Is liye roza tab tak na rakho jab tak tumne ise, naya chaand, dekh na liya ho aur ise tab tak na khatam karo jab tak tumne ise dekh na liya ho, siwaay iske ki aasmaan tumhare liye badal ho, aur agar aisa ho, to iska hisaab lagao.

e: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with both of them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The month is thus and thus and thus (i. e. pointing with his fingers thrice), and he held back his thumb at the third time (in order to show that it can also consist of twenty-nine days).
hi: Ibn Umar ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Mahina aise, aise aur aise hai, yaani apni ungliyon se teen baar ishara karte hue, aur unhone teesri baar apna angootha rok liya, ye dikhaane ke liye ki ye untees din ka bhi ho sakta hai.

e: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with both of them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The month may consist of twenty-nine days.
hi: Ibn Umar ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Mahina untees din ka bhi ho sakta hai.

e: Abdullah b. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with both of them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The month (of Ramadan) is thus and thus, and thus. i.e. ten, ten and nine.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Mahina, Ramzan, aise, aur aise, aur aise hai, yaani das, das aur nau.

e: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with both of them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The month is thus, and thus, and thus, and he flapped his hands with all their fingers twice. but at the third turn, folded his right thumb or left thumb (in order to give an idea of twenty-nine).
hi: Ibn Umar ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Mahina aise, aur aise, aur aise hai, aur unhone apne dono haath saari ungliyon ke saath do baar phadphadaaye, lekin teesri baar apna daaya angootha ya baaya angootha mod liya, untees ka andaaza dene ke liye.

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with both of them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The month (of Ramadan) may consist of twenty nine days, and Shu'ba (one of the narrators) (gave a practical demonstration how the Holy prophet (ﷺ) explained to them) by unfolding his hands thrice and folding his thumb at the third turn. 'Uqba (one of the narrators in this chain of transmitters) said: I think that he said that the month consists of thirty days and unfolded his palm three times.
hi: Ibn Umar ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Mahina, Ramzan, untees din ka bhi ho sakta hai, aur Shu'ba, ek raawi, ne amali taur par ye dikhaaya ki Nabi (SAW) ne unhe kaise samjhaya, apne haath teen baar khole aur teesri baar apna angootha mod liya. Uqba, is sanad ke ek raawi, ne kaha: Mujhe lagta hai ki unhone kaha ki mahina tees din ka bhi hota hai aur apni hatheli teen baar kholi.

e: Ibn 'Umar (may Allah be pleased with both of them) reported Allah's Apostle as saying: We are an unlettered people who can neither write nor count. The month is thus, and thus. folding his thumb when he said it the third time.
hi: Ibn Umar ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Hum aise anpad log hain jo na likh sakte hain na gin sakte hain. Mahina aise, aur aise hai, teesri baar kehte hue unhone apna angootha mod liya.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Aswad b. Qais with the same chain of transmitters, but herein no mention has been made of the other month (consisting of) thirty days.
hi: Ye hadees Aswad bin Qais ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai, lekin ismein doosre mahine, jo teesa din ka hota hai, ka koi zikr nahi kiya gaya.

e: Sa'd b. 'Ubaida reported that Ibn'Umar (Allah be pleased with both of them) heard a person saying: This night is the midnight (of the month). Upon this he said to him: How do you know that it is the midnight (of the month), for I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: The month is thus and thus (and he pointed with his ten fingers twice) and thus (i. e. at the third time he pointed with all his fingers but withdrew or folded his thumb)?
hi: Sa'd bin Ubaida ne bayan kiya ki Ibn Umar ne ek shakhs ko ye kehte suna: Ye raat mahine ki adhi raat hai. Isper unhone usse kaha: Tumhe kaise pata ki ye mahine ki adhi raat hai, kyunki maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Mahina aise aur aise hai, aur unhone apni das ungliyon se do baar ishara kiya, aur aise, yaani teesri baar unhone apni saari ungliyon se ishara kiya lekin apna angootha peeche khainch liya ya mod liya?

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Whenever you sight the new moon (of the month of Ramadan) observe fast. and when you sight it (the new moon of Shawwal) break it, and if the sky is cloudy for you, then observe fast for thirty days.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab bhi tum naya chaand, Ramzan ka, dekho to roza rakho, aur jab tum ise, Shawwal ka naya chaand, dekho to ise khatam karo, aur agar aasmaan tumhare liye badal hai, to tees din roza rakho.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Observe fast on sighting it (the new moon) and break (fast) on sighting it (the new moon), but if the sky is cloudy for you, then complete the number (of thirty).
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ise, naya chaand, dekhkar roza rakho aur ise dekhkar roza khatam karo, lekin agar aasmaan tumhare liye badal hai, to tadaad, tees ki, poori karo.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Observe fast on sighting it (the new moon) and break it on sighting it. But if (due to clouds) the actual position of the month is concealed from you, you should then count thirty (days).
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ise, naya chaand, dekhkar roza rakho aur ise dekhkar khatam karo. Lekin agar baadalon ki wajah se mahine ki asal haalat tumse chhupi ho, to tumhe tees din ginne chahiye.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) narrated that the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) made a mention of the new moon and (in this connection) said: Observe fast when you see it (the new moon) and break fast when you see it (the new moon of Shawwal), but when (the actual position of the month is) concealed from you (on account of cloudy sky), then count thirty days.
hi: Abu Huraira ne riwayat ki ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne naye chaand ka zikr kiya aur isi silsile mein kaha: Jab tum ise, naya chaand, dekho to roza rakho aur jab tum ise, Shawwal ka naya chaand, dekho to roza khatam karo, lekin jab mahine ki asal haalat tumse, badal wale aasmaan ki wajah se, chhupi ho, to tees din ginno.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Do not observe fast for a day, or two days ahead of Ramadan except a person who is in the habit of observing a particular fast; he may fast on that day.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ramzan se ek ya do din pehle roza mat rakho siwaay us shakhs ke jo kisi khaas roze ka aadi ho; woh us din roza rakh sakta hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Yahya b. Abi Kathir with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Yahya bin Abi Kathir ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Zuhri reported that (once) the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took an oath that he would not go to his wives for one Month. Zuhri said that 'Urwa narrated to him from 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) that she said: When twenty-nine nights were over, which I had counted, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to me (he came to me first of all). I said: Messenger of Allah, you had taken an oath that you would not come to us for a month, whereas you have come after twenty nine days which I have counted. Whereupon he said: The month may also consist of twenty-nine days.
hi: Zuhri ne bayan kiya ki ek baar Rasoolullah (SAW) ne qasam khayi ki woh ek mahine tak apni zaujaon ke paas nahi jaayenge. Zuhri ne kaha ki Urwa ne unhe Aisha (RA) ke hawale se ye bataya ki unhone kaha: Jab untees raaten guzar chuki thin, jinhe maine gina tha, Rasoolullah (SAW) mere paas aaye, sabse pehle mere paas aaye. Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, aapne qasam khayi thi ki aap ek mahine tak hamare paas nahi aayenge, jabki aap untees din ke baad aaye hain jinhe maine gina hai. Isper unhone kaha: Mahina untees din ka bhi ho sakta hai.

e: Jabir (Allah be pleased with her) narrated that the Prophet (ﷺ) separated himself from his wives for a month. (His wives said: ) He came to us on the twenty-ninth day, whereupon we said: It is the twenty-ninth (day) today. Thereupon he said: So far as the month is concerned, (and he, with a view to explaining it) flapped his hands thrice, but held back one finger at the last turn.
hi: Jabir ne bayan kiya ki Nabi (SAW) ne apni zaujaon se ek mahine ke liye alag rehne ka faisla kiya. Unki zaujaon ne kaha: Woh untisvein din hamare paas aaye, isper humne kaha: Aaj untisvaan din hai. Isper unhone kaha: Jahan tak mahine ka sawal hai, aur isse samjhaane ke liye unhone apne haath teen baar phadphadaaye, lekin aakhri baar ek ungli rok li.

e: Abu Zubair is reported to have heard Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with both of them) as saying: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) separated himself from his wives for a month. (His wives said: ) He came to us on the morning of the twenty-ninth. Upon this some, of the people said: It is the morning of twenty- ninth (according to our calculation). Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The month. may also consist of twenty-nine days. The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) then flapped his bands thrice, twice with all the fingers of both his hand (to indicate twenty-nine) and by the third time with nine (fingers).
hi: Abu Zubair ne Jabir bin Abdullah ko ye kehte suna: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne apni zaujaon se ek mahine ke liye alag rehne ka faisla kiya. Unki zaujaon ne kaha: Woh untisvein din ki subah hamare paas aaye. Isper kuch logon ne kaha: Ye untisvein din ki subah hai, hamare hisaab se. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Mahina untees din ka bhi ho sakta hai. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne phir apne haath teen baar phadphadaaye, do baar dono haathon ki saari ungliyon se, untees dikhaane ke liye, aur teesri baar nau ungliyon se.

e: Umm Salama (Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took an oath that he would not go to some of his wives for the whole of the month. When twenty-nine days bad passed he (the Holy Prophet) went to them in the morning or in the evening. Upon this it was said to him: Apostle of Allah, you took an oath that you would not come to us for a month, whereupon he said: The month may also consist of twenty-nine days.
hi: Umm Salama ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne qasam khayi ki woh apni kuch zaujaon ke paas poore mahine tak nahi jaayenge. Jab untees din guzar gaye, to woh subah ya shaam unke paas gaye. Isper unse kaha gaya: Allah ke Rasool, aapne qasam khayi thi ki aap hamare paas ek mahine tak nahi aayenge, isper unhone kaha: Mahina untees din ka bhi ho sakta hai.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Juraij with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Ibn Juraij ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas (Allah be pleased with him) said that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) struck his hand against the other and (then with the gesture of his two hands) said: The month is thus, thus (two times). He then withdrew (one of) his fingers at the third turn.
hi: Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas ne kaha ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne apna haath doosre haath se maara aur phir apne dono haathon ke ishare se kaha: Mahina aise, aise hai, do baar. Unhone phir teesri baar apni ungli rok li.

e: Muhammad b. Sa'd reported on the authority of his father (Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas (Allah be pleased with him) that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had said: Tho month is thus and thus, and thus, i. e. ten, ten and nine.
hi: Muhammad bin Sa'd ne apne walid, Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas, ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha tha: Mahina aise aur aise, aur aise hai, yaani das, das aur nau.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Ibn Abu Khalid with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Abu Khalid ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Kuraib reported that Umm Fadl, daughter of Harith, sent him (Fadl, i.e. her son) to Mu'awiya in Syria. I (Fadl) arrived in Syria, and did the needful for her. It was there in Syria that the month of Ramadan commenced. I saw the new moon (of Ramadan) on Friday. I then came back to Medina at the end of the month. Abdullah b. 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with him) asked me (about the new moon of Ramadan) and said: When did you see it? I said: We saw it on the night of Friday. He said: (Did) you see it yourself? I said: Yes, and the people also saw it and they fasted and Mu'awiya also fasted, whereupon he said: But we saw it on Saturday night. So we will continue to fast till we complete thirty (fasts) or we see it (the new moon of Shawwal). I said: Is the sighting of the moon by Mu'awiya not valid for you? He said: No; this is how the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) has commanded us. Yahya b. Yahya was in doubt (whether the word used in the narration by Kuraib) was Naktafi or Taktafi.
hi: Kuraib ne bayan kiya ki Umm Fadl, Harith ki beti, ne unhe, Fadl, yaani unke bete, Muawiya ke paas Syria bheja. Main Fadl Syria pahuncha, aur unke liye zaroori kaam kiya. Wahin Syria mein Ramzan ka mahina shuru hua. Maine juma ke din naya chaand, Ramzan ka, dekha. Main phir mahine ke akhir mein Madina wapas aaya. Abdullah bin Abbas (RA) ne mujhse Ramzan ke naye chaand ke baare mein poocha aur kaha: Tumne ise kab dekha? Maine kaha: Humne ise juma ki raat ko dekha. Unhone kaha: Kya tumne ise khud dekha? Maine kaha: Haan, aur logon ne bhi dekha aur unhone roza rakha aur Muawiya ne bhi roza rakha, isper unhone kaha: Lekin humne ise shanivar ki raat ko dekha. Is liye hum roza rakhte rahenge yahan tak ki hum tees roze poore kar lein ya hum ise, Shawwal ka naya chaand, dekh lein. Maine kaha: Kya Muawiya ka chaand dekhna aapke liye jaayez nahi hai? Unhone kaha: Nahi; Rasoolullah (SAW) ne humein isi tarah hukum diya hai. Yahya bin Yahya ko shaq tha ki Kuraib ki riwayat mein istemal hua lafz Naktafi tha ya Taktafi.

e: Abu'l-Bakhtari reported: We went out to perform Umra and when we encamped in the valley of Nakhla, we tried to see the new moon. Some of the people said: It was three nights old, and others (said) that it was two nights old. We then met Ibn 'Abbas and told him we had seen the new moon, but that some of the people said it was three nights old and others that it was two nights old. He asked on which night we had seen it; and when we told him we had seen it on such and such night, he said the Prophet of Allah (ﷺ) had said: Verily Allah deferred it till the time it is seen, so it is to be reckoned from the night you saw it.
hi: Abu'l-Bakhtari ne bayan kiya: Hum Umra karne nikle aur jab hum Nakhla ki wadi mein utre, to humne naya chaand dekhne ki koshish ki. Kuch logon ne kaha: Ye teen raaton ka tha, aur doosron ne kaha ki ye do raaton ka tha. Hum phir Ibn Abbas se mile aur unhe bataya ki humne naya chaand dekha, lekin kuch logon ne kaha ki ye teen raaton ka tha aur doosron ne ki ye do raaton ka. Unhone poocha ki humne ise kis raat dekha; aur jab humne unhe bataya ki humne ise falan-falan raat dekha, to unhone kaha ki Nabi Allah ke (SAW) ne kaha tha: Yaqeenan Allah ne ise us waqt tak taala jab tak ye dekha na jaaye, is liye iska hisaab us raat se lagaya jaayega jab tumne ise dekha.

e: Abu'l-Bakhtari reported: We saw the new moon of Ramadan as we were at Dhit-i-'Irq. We sent a man to Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with both of them) to ask him (whether the sighting of a small moon had something of the nature of defect in it). Upon this Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with both of them) said that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had said: Verily Allah deferred its sight, but if (the new moon) is hidden from you, then, complete its number (thirty).
hi: Abu'l-Bakhtari ne bayan kiya: Humne Ramzan ka naya chaand dekha jab hum Dhi-i-Irq mein the. Humne ek shakhs ko Ibn Abbas (RA) ke paas bheja unse poochhne ke liye, ki kya chhote chaand ko dekhne mein koi kami thi. Isper Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha tha: Yaqeenan Allah ne iska dikhna taal diya, lekin agar naya chaand tumse chhupa hua ho, to iski tadaad, tees, poori karo.

e: The son of Abu Bakra reported it on the authority of his father that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had said: The two months of 'Id, Ramadan and Dhu'l-Hijja (are not incomplete).
hi: Abu Bakra ke bete ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha tha: Do Eidon ke mahine, Ramzan aur Zul-Hijja, kam nahi hote.

e: 'Abd ar-Rahman b. Abu Bakra reported on the authority of Abu Bakra that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had said: The months of 'Id are not incomplete. And in the hadith narrated by Khalid (the words are):" The months, of 'Id are Ramadan and Dhu'l-Hijja."
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Bakra ne Abu Bakra ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha tha: Eid ke mahine kam nahi hote. Aur Khalid ki bayan ki hui hadees mein alfaaz hain: "Eid ke mahine Ramzan aur Zul-Hijja hain."

e: 'Adi b. Hatim (Allah be pleased with him) reported that when (this verse) was revealed: " Until the white streak of the dawn becomes distinct from the dark streak" (ii. 187) Adi b. Hatim said: Messenger of Allah, verily I keep underneath my pillow two strings, one white and the other black, by which I distinguish night from dawn. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Your pillow seems to be very large. For the word khait implies the blackness of the night and the whiteness of the dawn.
hi: Adi bin Hatim (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab ye aayat nazil hui: "Yahan tak ki subah ki safed lakeer raat ki kaali lakeer se alag na ho jaaye" (2:187), Adi bin Hatim ne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, main apne takiye ke neeche do dhaage rakhta hoon, ek safed aur doosra kaala, jisse main raat aur subah mein farq kar sakoon. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Tumhara takiya bahut bada lagta hai. Kyunki lafz "khait" raat ki kaali aur subah ki safedi ko darsaata hai.

e: Sahl b. Sa'd said that when this verse was revealed: " Eat and drink till the white streak is distinct from the dark streak," a person would take hold of a white thread and a black thread and keep on eating till he could find them distinct (in the light of the dawn). It was then that Allah, the Majestic and Great, reveiled (the words) min al-fajr (from the dawn), and then it became clear (that the word khait refers to the streak of light in the dawn).
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd ne kaha ki jab ye aayat nazil hui: "Khao aur piyo yahan tak ki safed lakeer kaali lakeer se alag ho jaaye," ek shakhs ek safed dhaaga aur ek kaala dhaaga pakadta aur khaata rehta jab tak use dono alag na dikhte, subah ki roshni mein. Tab Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, ne "min al-fajr", subah se, ke alfaaz nazil kiye, aur tab ye saaf ho gaya, ki khait subah ki roshni ki lakeer ko darsaata hai.

e: Sahl b. Sa'd (Allah be pleased with him) said: When this verse was revealed." Eat and drink till the white streak becomes distinct from the dark streak for you," the person who decided to observe fast tied on one of his feet a black thread and on the other a white thread. And he went on eating and drinking till he could distinguish (between their colour) on seeing them. It was after this that Allah reveal- ed (the words): min al-fajr. And they (the Muslims) came to know that (the word khait) refers to the night and day.
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (RA) ne kaha: Jab ye aayat nazil hui: "Khao aur piyo yahan tak ki safed lakeer tumhare liye kaali lakeer se alag ho jaaye," jis shakhs ne roza rakhne ka faisla kiya, usne apne ek paon par kaala dhaaga aur doosre par safed dhaaga baandh liya. Aur woh khaata aur peeta raha jab tak woh unhe dekhkar unke rangon mein farq na kar sake. Isi ke baad Allah ne "min al-fajr" ke alfaaz nazil kiye. Aur unhe, Musalmaanon ko, pata chal gaya ki lafz khait raat aur din ko darsaata hai.

e: 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud (Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had said: Bilal would pronounce Adhan (at the fag end of the night in order to inform the people about the time of the Sahri). So you eat and drink till you hear the Adhan of Ibn Umm Maktum (which was pro- nounced at the conclusion of the Sahri and the commencement of the fast).
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha tha: Bilal Azaan denge, raat ke aakhri hisse mein taaki logon ko Sahri ke waqt ke baare mein bataya jaaye. Is liye tum khao aur piyo yahan tak ki tum Ibn Umm Maktum ki Azaan sun lo, jo Sahri ke khatam hone aur roze ki shuruaat par di jaati thi.

e: Abdullah b. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with both of them) reported: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: Bilal announces Adhan during the night, so you eat and drink, till you hear the Adhan of Ibn Umm Maktum.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Bilal raat mein Azaan dete hain, is liye tum khao aur piyo, jab tak tum Ibn Umm Maktum ki Azaan na sun lo.

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with both of them) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had two Mu'adhdhins, Bilal and son of Umm Maktum, the blind. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Bilal announces Adhan at (the fag end of the) night (i. e. Sahri), so eat and drink till the son of Umm Maktum announces Adhan. And he (the narrator) said: And the (difference of time) between their (Adhans) was not more than this that one climbed down (from the minaret) and the other climbed up (to announce Adhan).
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ke do Muazzin the, Bilal aur nabina Umm Maktum ke bete. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Bilal raat mein, Sahri ke waqt, Azaan dete hain, is liye khao aur piyo yahan tak ki Umm Maktum ke bete Azaan de. Aur unhone kaha: Aur unki Azaanon ke waqt ke beech itna hi farq tha ki ek, minaar se, neeche utarta aur doosra Azaan dene ke liye minaar par chadhta.

e: A hadith like this has been transmitted on the authority of 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her).
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Aisha (RA) ki sanad se bayan ki gayi hai.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of 'Ubaidullah on the two chains of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Ubaidullah ki sanad se do sanadon ke zariye bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn Mas'ud (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying The Adhan of Bilal should not restrain anyone among you from eating Sahur (last meal before daybreak during the month of Ramadan) for he announces Adhan (or he calls) at (the fag end of) the night to make him turn who stands for prayer among you, and to awaken those who are sleeping among you. And he said: The dawn is not like it, as one says (and he lifted his hand) till he (dispersed his fingers) and said: It is like this.
hi: Ibn Mas'ud (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Bilal ki Azaan tum mein se kisi ko Sahri, Ramzan ke daurane subah se pehle aakhri khaana, khaane se rokni nahi chahiye, kyunki woh raat ke aakhri hisse mein Azaan dete hain, ya woh pukaarte hain, taaki tum mein se namaz padhne wale apni Sahri ki taraf mud jaayein, aur taaki tum mein se sote hue log jaag jaayein. Aur unhone kaha: Subah waisi nahi hoti jaisa koi kehta hai, aur unhone apna haath uthaya, jab tak woh apni ungliyaan phailaakar kahen: Ye is tarah hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Sulaiman al-Taimi with the same chain of transmitters (but with a slight variation of words) that he (the Holy Prophet) said: The dawn is not like it as it is said; he then gathered his fingers and lowered them. But he said, it is like this (and he placed the index finger upon the other one and spread his hand).
hi: Ye hadees Sulaiman al-Taimi ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai, lekin alfaaz mein halki tabdeeli ke saath, ki unhone kaha: Subah waisi nahi hoti jaisa kaha jaata hai; unhone phir apni ungliyaan jama kin aur unhe neeche kiya. Lekin unhone kaha, ye is tarah hai, aur unhone shahadat ki ungli doosri par rakhi aur apni hatheli phailaayi.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Sulaiman Taimi with the same chain of transmitters and, at the end, it was said that the first Adhan was meant to awaken those who were in slumber amongst them and in order to make them turn who stand in (prayer) among them (towards food at the commencement of the fast). Jarir (one of the narrators) said that the Messenger (ﷺ) did not say like this but he said like it (true dawn) that the streaks of (true dawn ) are horizontal and not vertical.
hi: Ye hadees Sulaiman Taimi ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai aur, akhir mein, kaha gaya ki pehli Azaan ka maqsad unmein se sote hue logon ko jagana tha aur taaki woh Sahri khaane ke liye mud jaayen jo unmein khade the, namaz mein, roze ki shuruaat mein khaane ki taraf. Jarir, ek raawi, ne kaha ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne aise nahi kaha balki unhone, asli subah ki tarah, kaha ki asli subah ki lakeeren afqi, samatal, hoti hain, khadi nahi.

e: Samura b. Jandub reported Muhammad (ﷺ) as saying. The call of Bilal may not mislead any one of you (and he may, under the wrong impression gathered from it, refrain) from taking meal before the commencement of the fast (for the streaks) of this whiteness (which are vertical indicate the false dawn and the true dawn with which the fast commences is that when the streaks of light are) spread.
hi: Samura bin Jandub ne Muhammad (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Bilal ki pukaar tum mein se kisi ko gumraah na kare, aur woh, galat tathakathit dhaaranaa mein, Sahri khaane se ruk jaaye, roze ki shuruaat se pehle, kyunki is safedi ki, jo khadi hoti hai, lakeeren jhooti subah ki nishaani hain, aur asli subah, jiske saath roza shuru hota hai, woh hai jab roshni ki lakeeren phaili hoti hain.

e: Samura b. Jundub reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The Adhan of Bilal should not mislead you nor the whiteness (of the pillar) of dawn, for it is not the whiteness of the true dawn, but that of the false dawn which is vertical like a pillar and you can eat food till the streaks of whiteness spread like it.
hi: Samura bin Jundub ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Bilal ki Azaan tumhe gumraah na kare na hi khambe ki safedi subah ki, kyunki ye asli subah ki safedi nahi hai, balki ye jhooti subah ki hai jo khambe jaisi khadi hoti hai aur tum khaana tab tak kha sakte ho jab tak safedi ki lakeeren is tarah phail na jaayein.

e: Samura b. Jundub (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The Adhan of Bilal may not mislead you with regard to your food at the commencement of the fast, nor the vertical (streaks) of whiteness in the horizon (for it is an indication of false dawn). You should stop eating (food) till (the whiteness) spreads like it. Hammad narrated it and with the gesture of his band he explained, the horizontal position (of the streaks of light).
hi: Samura bin Jundub (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Bilal ki Azaan tumhe tumhare khaane ke baare mein gumraah na kare roze ki shuruaat mein, na hi ufaq mein safedi ki khadi lakeeren, kyunki ye jhooti subah ki nishaani hai. Tumhe khaana khaana band kar dena chahiye jab tak safedi is tarah phail na jaaye. Hammad ne ise riwayat ki aur apne haath ke ishare se lakeeron ki afqi, samantar, haalat samjhaayi.

e: Samura b. Jundub addressed and narrated from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) having said (these words): Neither the call of Bilal should mislead you nor this whiteness (of false dawn) till (the true) dawn appears (or he said) till the dawn breaks.
hi: Samura bin Jundub ne khitaab kiya aur Rasoolullah (SAW) se ye alfaaz riwayat kiye: Na Bilal ki pukaar tumhe gumraah kare na ye safedi, jhooti subah ki, jab tak asli subah numaayan na ho, ya unhone kaha, jab tak subah numaayan na ho.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Samura b. Jundub.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Samura bin Jundub ki sanad se bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Anas (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Take meal a little before dawn, for there is a blessing in taking meal at that time.
hi: Anas (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Subah se thodi der pehle khaana khaao, kyunki us waqt khaana khaane mein barkat hai.

e: 'Amr b. al-'As reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The difference between our fasting and that of the people of the Book is eating shortly before dawn.
hi: Amr bin al-As ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Hamare roze aur Ahl-e-Kitaab ke roze mein farq subah se thodi der pehle khaana khaana hai.

e: Musa b. 'Ali has narrated this hadith through the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Musa bin Ali ne ye hadees isi sanad se riwayat ki hai.

e: Zaid b. Thabit (Allah be pleased with him) said: We took meal shortly before dawn along with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). We then stood up for prayer. I said: How much span of time was there between the two (acts, i. e. taking of Sahri and observing of prayer)? He said (a span of reciting) fifty verses.
hi: Zaid bin Thabit (RA) ne kaha: Humne Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath subah se thodi der pehle khaana khaya. Hum phir namaz ke liye khade hue. Maine kaha: In dono kaamon, yaani Sahri khaana aur namaz padhna, ke beech kitna waqt tha? Unhone kaha, itna waqt jitna pachaas aayaten padhne mein lagta.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Qatada too.
hi: Ye hadees Qatada ki sanad se bhi bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Sahl b. Sa'd (Allah be pleased with him) repotted Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The people will continue to prosper as long as they hasten the breaking of the fast.
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Log tab tak taraqqi karte rahenge jab tak woh roza iftaar karne mein jaldi karenge.

e: A hadith like this has been transmitted by Sahl b. Sa'd.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Sahl bin Sa'd ki sanad se bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Abu 'Atiyya reported: I and Masruq went to 'A'isha and said to her: Mother of the Believers, there are two persons among the Companions of Muhammad (ﷺ) one among whom hastens in breaking the fast and in observing prayer, and the other delays breaking the fast and delays observing prayer. She said: Who among the two hastens in breaking fast and observing prayers? We said, It is 'Abdullah. i. e. son of Mas'ud. whereupon she said: This is how the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did. Abu Kuraib added: The second one was Abu Musa.
hi: Abu Atiyya ne bayan kiya: Main aur Masruq Aisha ke paas gaye aur unse kaha: Momino ki maa, Muhammad (SAW) ke sahaba mein do log hain, unmein se ek roza iftaar karne aur namaz padhne mein jaldi karta hai, aur doosra roza iftaar karne mein aur namaz padhne mein der karta hai. Unhone kaha: Unmein se kaun roza iftaar karne aur namaz padhne mein jaldi karta hai? Humne kaha, Ye Abdullah hain, yaani Ibn Mas'ud ke bete, isper unhone kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) isi tarah karte the. Abu Kuraib ne izafa kiya: Doosre Abu Musa the.

e: Abu 'Atiyya reported: I and Misruq went to 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) and Masruq said to her: There are two persons among the Companions of Muhammad (ﷺ) none of whom abandons the good, but one of them hastens to observe sunset prayer and break the fast, and the other delays in observing the sunset prayer and in breaking the fast, whereupon she said: Who hastens to observe sunset prayer and break the fast? He said: It is 'Abdullah. Upon this she said: This is how the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to do.
hi: Abu Atiyya ne bayan kiya: Main aur Masruq Aisha (RA) ke paas gaye aur Masruq ne unse kaha: Muhammad (SAW) ke sahaba mein do log hain, unmein se koi bhi achhaai ko nahi chhodta, lekin unmein se ek maghrib ki namaz padhne aur roza iftaar karne mein jaldi karta hai, aur doosra maghrib ki namaz padhne mein aur roza iftaar karne mein der karta hai, isper unhone kaha: Kaun maghrib ki namaz padhne aur roza iftaar karne mein jaldi karta hai? Unhone kaha: Ye Abdullah hain. Isper unhone kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) isi tarah kiya karte the.

e: 'Umar (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When the night approaches and the day retreates and the sun sinks down, then the observer of the fast should break it. Ibn Numair made no mention of the word" then".
hi: Umar (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab raat qareeb aa jaaye aur din peeche hat jaaye aur suraj doob jaaye, to roza rakhne wale ko ise iftaar kar lena chahiye. Ibn Numair ne "phir" lafz ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: 'Abdullah b. Abi Aufa reported: We were with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on a journey during the month of Ramadan. When the sun had sunk he said: So and so, get down (from your ride) and prepare the meal of parched barley for us. He said: Messenger of Allah, still (there is light of) day. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Get down and prepare meal of parched barley for us. So he got down and prepared the meal of parched barley and offered him, and the apostle of Allah (ﷺ) drank that (liquid meal). He then told with the gesture of his hand that when the sun sank from that side and the night appeared from that side, then the observer of the fast should break it.
hi: Abdullah bin Abu Aufa ne bayan kiya: Hum Ramzan ke mahine mein Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath ek safar mein the. Jab suraj doob gaya to unhone kaha: Falan, apni sawari se utro aur hamare liye bhuni hui jau ka khaana taiyaar karo. Unhone kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, abhi bhi din ki roshni baaki hai. Unhone kaha: Utro aur hamare liye bhuni hui jau ka khaana taiyaar karo. To woh utre aur bhuni hui jau ka khaana taiyaar kiya aur unhe pesh kiya, aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ne woh tarl khaana piya. Unhone phir apne haath ke ishare se bataya ki jab suraj us taraf se doob jaaye aur raat us taraf se numaayan ho jaaye, to roza rakhne wale ko ise iftaar kar lena chahiye.

e: Ibn Abi Aufa (Allah be pleased with him) reported: We were with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on a journey. When the sun sank he said to a person: Get down and prepare barley meal for us. Upon this he said: Messenger of Allah, let there be dusk. (He the Holy Prophet) said: Get down and prepare barley meal for us. He (the person) said: There is still (the light of) day upon us. (But) he got down (in obedience to the command of the Holy Prophet) and prepared a barley meal for him and he (the Holy Prophet) drank that (liquid meal) and then said: When you see the night approaching from that side (west) (and he pointed towards the east with his hand), then the observer of the fast should break it.
hi: Ibn Abu Aufa (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath ek safar mein the. Jab suraj doob gaya, to unhone ek shakhs se kaha: Utro aur hamare liye jau ka khaana taiyaar karo. Isper unhone kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, andhera hone do. Unhone kaha: Utro aur hamare liye jau ka khaana taiyaar karo. Unhone us shakhs ne kaha: Abhi bhi hampar din ki roshni hai. Lekin woh, Nabi (SAW) ke hukum ki itaat mein, utre aur unke liye jau ka khaana taiyaar kiya aur unhone woh tarl khaana piya aur phir kaha: Jab tum us taraf se, paschim se, raat aati dekho, aur unhone apne haath se poorab ki taraf ishara kiya, to roza rakhne wale ko ise iftaar kar lena chahiye.

e: Abdullah b. Abi Aufa (Allah be pleased with him) reported: We travelled with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as he had been observing fast. When the sun sank he said: So and so, get down and prepare barley meal for us. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Abdullah bin Abu Aufa (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath safar kiya jab woh roza rakhe hue the. Jab suraj doob gaya to unhone kaha: Falan, utro aur hamare liye jau ka khaana taiyaar karo. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Abi Aufa (Allah be pleased with him) through another chain of transmitters (but with a sight alteration of words): In this hadith transmitted by one of the narrators (neither these words are found): During the month of Ramadan." nor his statement:" And the night prevails from that side (the eastern side)." (These words are found in the narration of) Hushaim only.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Abu Aufa (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se bayan ki gayi hai, lekin alfaaz mein halki tabdeeli ke saath: Is hadees mein jo ek raawi ne bayan ki hai, na ye alfaaz mile hain: "Ramzan ke mahine mein" na hi unka ye bayaan: "Aur raat us taraf se, poorab ki taraf, chhaa jaati hai." Ye alfaaz sirf Hushaim ki riwayat mein hain.

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with both of them) said that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade uninterrupted fasting. They (some of the Companions) said: You yourself fast uninterruptedly, whereupon he said: I am not like you. I am fed and supplied drink (by Allah).
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne kaha ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Wisal, bina roza kholne lagataar roza rakhna, ka roza rakhne se mana kiya. Unhone, kuch sahaba ne, kaha: Aap khud bhi lagataar roza rakhte hain, isper unhone kaha: Main tum jaisa nahi hoon. Mujhe Allah ke zariye khilaaya aur pilaya jaata hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed fasts uninterruptedly in Ramadan and the people (in his wake) did this. But he forbade them to do so. It was said to him (to the Holy Prophet): You yourself observe the fasts uninterruptedly (but you forbid us to do so) Upon this he said: I am not like you; I am fed and supplied drink (by Allah).
hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Ramzan mein Wisal ke roze rakhe aur logon ne unki dekhaadekhi aisa kiya. Lekin unhone unhe aisa karne se mana kiya. Unse kaha gaya: Aap khud lagataar roza rakhte hain, lekin aap humein aisa karne se mana karte hain, isper unhone kaha: Main tum jaisa nahi hoon; mujhe Allah ke zariye khilaaya aur pilaya jaata hai.

e: A hadith like this has been transmitted by Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with both of them), but he did not make mention of (the words): " During the month of Ramadan."
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Ibn Umar (RA) ki sanad se bayan ki gayi hai, lekin unhone in alfaazon ka zikr nahi kiya: "Ramzan ke mahine mein."

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade (his Companions) from observing fast uninterruptedly. One of the Muslims said: Messenger of Allah, you yourself observe Saum Wisal, whereupon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Who among you is like me? I spend night (in a state) that my Allah feeds me and provides me drink. When they (the Companions of the Holy Prophet) did not agree in abandoning the uninterrupted fast, then the Prophet (ﷺ) also observed this fast with them for a day, and then for a day. They then saw the new moon and he (the Holy Prophet) said: If the appearance of the new moon were delayed. I would have observed more (fasts) with you (and he did it) by way of warning to them as they had not agreed to refrain (from observing Saum Wisal)
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne apne sahaba ko lagataar roza rakhne se mana kiya. Musalmaanon mein se ek ne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, aap khud Saum Wisal rakhte hain, isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Tum mein se kaun mere jaisa hai? Main raat is haalat mein guzaarta hoon ki mera Allah mujhe khilaata hai aur pilaata hai. Jab woh Nabi ke sahaba is lagataar roze ko chhodne par razi nahi hue, to Nabi (SAW) ne bhi unke saath ye roza ek din tak rakha, aur phir ek din aur. Unhone phir naya chaand dekha aur unhone kaha: Agar naya chaand dikhna der se hota, to main tumhare saath aur bhi roze rakhta, aur unhone ye unhe ehsaas dilaane ke liye kiya kyunki woh Saum Wisal se parhez karne par razi nahi hue the.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Abstain from Saum-Wisal. They (his Companions) said: Messenger of Allah, but you observe Saum Wisal. Upon this he said: You are not like me in this matter, for I spend my night (in a state) that my Lord feeds me and provides me drink Devote yourselves to the deeds (the burden of which) you can bear.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Saum-Wisal se bacho. Unhone, unke sahaba ne, kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, lekin aap Saum Wisal rakhte hain. Isper unhone kaha: Tum is maamle mein mere jaise nahi ho, kyunki main apni raat is haalat mein guzaarta hoon ki mera Rab mujhe khilaata hai aur pilaata hai. Apne aap ko un amalon mein lagaao jinka bojh tum uthaa sakte ho.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying (the words as said in the previous hadith) but with this alteration (of words): " Take upon yourselves (the burden of the deeds) for which you have the strength to bear."
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko, pichhli hadees ki tarah, ye kehte suna, lekin is alfaaz ki tabdeeli ke saath: "Apni zimmedaari mein woh amal lo jinke liye tum mein taaqat hai unhe uthaane ki."

e: Abu Huraira reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade (his Companions) to observe Saum Wisal.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne apne sahaba ko Saum Wisal rakhne se mana kiya.

e: Anas (Allah be pleased with him) reported The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was observing prayer during Ramadan. I came and stood by his side. Then another man came and he stood likewise till we became a group. When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) perceived that we were behind him, he lightened the prayer. He then went to his abode and observed such (a long) prayer (the like of which) he never observed with us. When it was morning we said to him: Did you perceive us during the night? Upon this he said: Yes, it was this (realisation) that induced me to do that which I did. He (the narrator) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) began to observe Saum Wisal at the end of the month (of Ramadan), and some persons among his Companions began to observe this uninter- rupted fast, whereupon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: What about such persons who observe uninterrupted fasts? You are not like me. By Allah. if the month were lengthened for me, I would have observed Saum Wisal, so that those who act with an exaggeration would (have been obliged) to abandon their exaggeration.
hi: Anas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) Ramzan mein namaz padh rahe the. Main aaya aur unke bagal mein khada ho gaya. Phir ek aur shakhs aaya aur woh bhi isi tarah khada ho gaya yahan tak ki hum ek giroh ban gaye. Jab Rasoolullah (SAW) ne mehsoos kiya ki hum unke peeche hain, to unhone namaz mukhtasar ki. Woh phir apni jagah gaye aur aisi lambi namaz padhi jaisi lambi namaz unhone humare saath kabhi nahi padhi thi. Jab subah hui to humne unse kaha: Kya aap raat ko humein mehsoos kar paaye the? Isper unhone kaha: Haan, isi ehsaas ne mujhe woh karne par majboor kiya jo maine kiya. Raawi ne kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne mahine, Ramzan, ke akhir mein Saum Wisal shuru kiya, aur unke sahaba mein se kuch logon ne bhi ye lagataar roza rakhna shuru kar diya, isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Un logon ka kya jo lagataar roze rakhte hain? Tum mein se koi bhi mere jaisa nahi hai. Allah ki qasam, agar mahina mere liye lamba kar diya jaata, to main Saum Wisal rakhta, taaki jo log ziyaadti karte hain unhe apni ziyaadti chhodni pade.

e: Anas (Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed Saum Wisal during the early part of the month of Ramadan. The people among Muslims also observed uninterrupted fast. This (news) reached him (the Holy Prophet) and he said: Had the month been lengthened for me I would have continued observing Saum Wisal, so that those who act with forced hardness would (have been obliged) to abandon it. You are not like me (or he said): I am not like you. I continue to do so (in a state) that my Lord feeds me and provides me drink.
hi: Anas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Ramzan ke mahine ke shuruaati hisse mein Saum Wisal rakha. Musalmaanon mein se logon ne bhi lagataar roza rakha. Ye khabar unhe pahunchi aur unhone kaha: Agar mahina mere liye lamba kar diya jaata, to main Saum Wisal rakhna jaari rakhta, taaki woh log jo zabardasti sakhti se amal karte hain use chhodne par majboor ho jaayein. Tum mere jaise nahi ho, ya unhone kaha: Main tum jaisa nahi hoon. Main isi tarah karta rahta hoon ki mera Rab mujhe khilaata hai aur pilaata hai.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) said: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) forbade them (his Companions) to observe Saum Wisal out of mercy for them. They said: You (Holy Prophet) yourself observe it. Upon this he said: I am not like you. My Lord feeds me and provides me drink.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unhe, apne sahaba ko, unpar rehm karte hue Saum Wisal rakhne se mana kiya. Unhone kaha: Aap khud ise rakhte hain. Isper unhone kaha: Main tum jaisa nahi hoon. Mera Rab mujhe khilaata hai aur pilaata hai.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) said that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) kissed one of his wives while he was fasting, and then she ('A'isha) smiled (as she narrated).
hi: Aisha (RA) ne kaha ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne apni ek zauja ko busa diya jabki woh roze mein the, aur phir woh Aisha muskurayi, jab woh ye bayan kar rahi thin.

e: Sufyan reported: I said to 'Abd al-Rahman b. Qasim: Have you heard from your father narrating from 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) that he kissed her while observing fast? He ('Abd al-Rahman b. Qasim) kept silence for a short while and then said:" Yes."
hi: Sufyan ne bayan kiya: Maine Abdur-Rahman bin Qasim se kaha: Kya aapne apne waalid se suna hai ki unhone Aisha (RA) se riwayat ki ki unhone Nabi (SAW) ne unhe busa diya jab woh roze mein the? Unhone, Abdur-Rahman bin Qasim ne, thodi der khamosh rahe aur phir kaha: "Haan."

e: 'A'isha reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to kiss me while observing fast; and who among you can control his desire as the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) could control his desire.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) mujhe busa dete the jab woh roze mein hote; aur tum mein se kaun apni khwahish ko utna kaboo mein kar sakta hai jitna Rasoolullah (SAW) apni khwahish ko kaboo kar sakte the.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to kiss (his wives) while fasting and embraced (them) while fasting; but he had the greatest mastery over his desire among you.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) roze ki halat mein apni zaujaon ko busa dete the aur unhe apnaate the; lekin unhe tum mein se sabse zyada apni khwahish par qaboo tha.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to kiss (his wives) while fasting; and he had the greatest control over his desire (as compared with you).
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) roze mein apni zaujaon ko busa dete the; aur unhe apni khwahish par tumhare muqable sabse zyada qaboo tha.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) said that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to embrace (his wives) while fasting.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne kaha ki Rasoolullah (SAW) roze mein apni zaujaon ko apnaate the.

e: Aswad reported: I and Masruq went to 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) and asked. her if the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) embraced (his wives) while fasting. She said: Yes; but he had the greatest control over his desire among you: or he was one of those who had control over his desire.
hi: Aswad ne bayan kiya: Main aur Masruq Aisha (RA) ke paas gaye aur unse poocha ki kya Rasoolullah (SAW) roze mein apni zaujaon ko apnaate the. Unhone kaha: Haan; lekin unhe tum mein se sabse zyada apni khwahish par qaboo tha: ya woh un logon mein se ek the jinhe apni khwahish par qaboo tha.

e: It is further narrated on the authority of Aswad and Masruq that they went to the Mother of the Believers and they asked her (and the rest of the hadith is the same)
hi: Ye bhi Aswad aur Masruq ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai ki woh Ummul-Momineen ke paas gaye aur unse poocha, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: 'Urwa b. Zubair narrated that 'A'isha the Mother of the Believers (Allah be pleased with her) informed him that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) kissed her while fasting.
hi: Urwa bin Zubair ne bayan kiya ki Ummul-Momineen Aisha (RA) ne unhe bataya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unhe roze mein busa diya.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated by Yahya b. Abu Kathir with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Yahya bin Abu Kathir ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to kiss her during the month of fasting.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) unhe roze ke mahine mein busa dete the.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) kissed (his wives) during Ramadan while observing fast.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Ramzan mein roza rakhte hue apni zaujaon ko busa diya.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that Allah's Apostle (peace be upon him) kissed (his wives) while fasting.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) roze mein apni zaujaon ko busa dete the.

e: Hafsa (Allah be pleased with her) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) kissed (his wives) while fasting.
hi: Hafsa (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) roze mein apni zaujaon ko busa dete the.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated by Hafsa (Allah be pleased with her) through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Hafsa (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Umar b Abu Salama reported that he asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): Should one observing fast kiss (his wife)? The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to him: Ask her (Umm Salama). She informed him that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did that, where upon he said: Messenger of Allah, Allah pardoned thee all thy sins, the previous and the later ones. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ) said: By Allah, I am the most God conscious among you and I fear Him most among you.
hi: Umar bin Abu Salama ne bayan kiya ki unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) se poocha: Kya roza rakhne wale ko apni biwi ko busa dena chahiye? Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unse kaha: Unse, Umm Salama se, poochho. Unhone unhe bataya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne aisa kiya, isper unhone kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, Allah ne aapke saare gunah maaf kar diye hain, pehle aur baad ke. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, main tum mein sabse zyada Allah se dartein waala hoon aur main tum mein se Usse sabse zyada darta hoon.

e: Abu Bakr (he is Abu Bakr b. Abd al-Rahman b. Harith) reported: I heard Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) narrating that he who is overtaken by dawn in a state of seminal emission should not observe fast. I made a mention of it to 'Abd al-Rahman b. Harith (i. e. to his father) but he denied it. 'Abd al-Rahman went and I also went along with him till we came to'A'isha and Umm Salama (Allah be pleased with both of them) and Abd al-Rahman asked them about it. Both of them said: (At times it so happened) that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) woke up in the morning in a state of junub (but without seminal emission in a dream) and observed fast He (the narrator) said: We then proceeded till we went to Marwan and Abd al-Rahman made a mention of it to him. Upon this Marwan said: I stress upon you (with an oath) that you better go to Abu Huraira and refer to him what is said about it. So we came to Abu Huraira and Abu Bakr had been with us throughout and 'Abd al-Rahman made a mention of it to him, whereupon Abu Huraira said: Did they (the two wives of the Holy Prophet) tell you this? He replied: Yes Upon this (Abu Huraira) said: They have better knowledge. Abu Huraira then attributed that what was said about it to Fadl b. 'Abbas and said: I heard it from Fadl and not from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). Abu Huraira then retracted from what he used to say about it. Ibn Juraij (one of the narrators) reported: I asked 'Abd al-Malik, if they (the two wives) said (made the statement) in regard to Ramadan, whereupon he said: It was so, and he (the Holy Prophet) (woke up in the) morning in a state of junub which was not due to the wet dream and then observed fast.
hi: Abu Bakr, ye Abu Bakr bin Abdur-Rahman bin Harith hain, ne bayan kiya: Maine Abu Huraira (RA) ko ye riwayat karte suna ki jo shakhs subah tak nafeel ki haalat mein rehta hai use roza nahi rakhna chahiye. Maine iska zikr Abdur-Rahman bin Harith se, yaani apne waalid se, kiya lekin unhone ise jhutlaya. Abdur-Rahman gaye aur main bhi unke saath gaya yahan tak ki hum Aisha aur Umm Salama (RA) ke paas pahunche aur Abdur-Rahman ne unse iske baare mein poocha. Dono ne kaha: Kabhi kabhi aisa hota tha ki Rasoolullah (SAW) subah nafeel ki halat mein utthe, lekin khwaab mein nafeel hone ke bagair, aur roza rakha. Raawi ne kaha: Hum phir aage badhe yahan tak ki hum Marwan ke paas gaye aur Abdur-Rahman ne unse iska zikr kiya. Isper Marwan ne kaha: Main tumpar zor daalta hoon, qasam ke saath, ki tum behtar hoga ki Abu Huraira ke paas jao aur unse ye maamla bataao jo iske baare mein kaha gaya hai. To hum Abu Huraira ke paas aaye aur Abu Bakr poore waqt hamare saath rahe the aur Abdur-Rahman ne unse iska zikr kiya, isper Abu Huraira ne kaha: Kya unhone, Nabi ki dono zaujaon ne, tumhe ye bataya? Unhone jawab diya: Haan. Isper Abu Huraira ne kaha: Unhe isse behtar ilm hai. Abu Huraira ne phir ye jo unhone iske baare mein kaha tha uska mansooba Fadl bin Abbas ki taraf kiya aur kaha: Maine ise Fadl se suna, na ki Rasoolullah (SAW) se. Abu Huraira ne phir jo woh iske baare mein kaha karte the usse peeche hat gaye. Ibn Juraij, ek raawi, ne bayan kiya: Maine Abdul Malik se poocha ki kya unhone, dono zaujaon ne, Ramzan ke baare mein baat ki thi, isper unhone kaha: Aisa hi tha, aur woh subah nafeel ki halat mein utthe jo geele khwaab ki wajah se nahi thi aur phir roza rakha.

e: 'A'isha, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), said: The dawn broke upon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) during the Ramadan in a state of junub not because of sexual dream (but on account of intercourse) and he washed himself and observed fast.
hi: Aisha, Rasoolullah (SAW) ki zauja, ne kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) par subah Ramzan mein nafeel ki halat mein hoti thi, jinsi khwaab ki wajah se nahi, balki jinsi milaap ki wajah se, aur unhone ghusl kiya aur roza rakha.

e: Abu Bakr reported that Marwan sent him to Umm Salama to ask whether a person should observe fast who is in a state of junub and the dawn breaks upon him, whereupon she said that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) (was at times) junbi on account of intercourse and not due to sexual dream, and the dawn broke upon him, but he neither broke the fast nor recompensed.
hi: Abu Bakr ne bayan kiya ki Marwan ne unhe Umm Salama ke paas bheja poochne ke liye ki kya ek shakhs ko roza rakhna chahiye jo nafeel ki halat mein hai aur uspar subah ho jaati hai, isper unhone kaha ki Rasoolullah (SAW) kabhi kabhi jinsi milaap ki wajah se nafeel mein hote the aur jinsi khwaab ki wajah se nahi, aur unpar subah ho jaati thi, lekin unhone na roza toda na hi baad mein uski qaza ki.

e: Abu Bakr b. 'Abd al-Rahman b. al-Harith b. Hisham reported on the authority of 'A'isha and Umm Salama, the wives of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) at times got up in the morning in a state of junub on account of having a sexual intercourse (with his wives during night) but not due to sexual dreams in the month of Ramadan, and would observe fast.
hi: Abu Bakr bin Abdur-Rahman bin al-Harith bin Hisham ne Aisha aur Umm Salama, Rasoolullah (SAW) ki zaujaon, ke hawale se riwayat ki: Rasoolullah (SAW) kabhi kabhi subah nafeel ki halat mein utthe, raat ko apni zaujaon ke saath jinsi milaap ki wajah se, na ki jinsi khwaabon ki wajah se, Ramzan ke mahine mein, aur roza rakhte.

e: 'A'isha reported that a person came to the Apottle of Allah (ﷺ) asking for a fatwa (religious verdict). She ('A'isha) had been overhearing it from behind the curtain. 'A'isha added that he (the person) had said: Messenger of Allah, (the time) of prayer overtakes me as I am in a state of junub; should I observe fast (in this state)? Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: (At times the time) of prayer overtakes me while I am in a state of junub, and I observe fast (in that very state), whereupon he said: Messenger of Allah, you are not like us Allah has pardoned all your sins, the previous ones and the later ones. Upon this he (the Holy Prophet) said: By Allah, I hope I am the most God-fearirg of you, and possess the best knowledge among you of those (things) against which I should guard.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas fatwa poochhne aaya. Woh Aisha parde ke peeche se ye sun rahi thin. Aisha ne izafa kiya ki usne kaha tha: Ya Rasoolullah, namaz ka waqt mujhpar aa jaata hai jab main nafeel ki halat mein hota hoon; kya mujhe is halat mein roza rakhna chahiye? Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Kabhi kabhi namaz ka waqt mujhpar bhi aata hai jab main nafeel ki halat mein hota hoon, aur main roza rakhta hoon isi halat mein, isper usne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, aap hamari tarah nahi hain, Allah ne aapke saare gunah maaf kar diye hain, pehle aur baad ke. Isper unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, mujhe ummeed hai ki main tum mein sabse zyada Allah se darta hoon, aur mujhe tum mein sabse zyada ilm hai un cheezon ka jinse mujhe bachna chahiye.

e: Sulaiman b. Yasar reported that he asked Umm Salama whether a person (who gets up) in the morning in a state of junub should observe fast. She said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) (at times) got up in the morning in a state of junub, not because of sexual dreams (but on account of intercourse at night), and then observed fast.
hi: Sulaiman bin Yasar ne bayan kiya ki unhone Umm Salama se poocha ki kya kisi shakhs ko roza rakhna chahiye jo jaagta hai subah nafeel ki halat mein. Unhone kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) kabhi kabhi subah nafeel ki halat mein jaagte, jinsi khwaabon ki wajah se nahi, balki raat mein jinsi milaap ki wajah se, aur phir roza rakhte.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported that a person came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: Messenger of Allah, I am undone. He (the Holy Prophet) said: What has brought about your ruin? He said: I have had intercourse with my wife during the month of Ramadan. Upon this he (the Holy prophet) said: Can you find a slave to set him free? He said: NO He (the Prophet again) said: Can you observe fast for two consecutive months? He said: No. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Can you provide food to sixty poor people?, He said: No. He then sat down and (in the meanwhile) there was brought to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) a basket which contained dates. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Give these (dates) in charity. He (the man) said: Am I to give to one who is poorer than I? There is no family poorer than mine between the two lava plains of Medina. The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) laughed so that his molar teeth became visible and said: Go and give it to your family to eat.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, main tabaah ho gaya hoon. Unhone kaha: Tumhari tabaahi ka kya sabab bana? Usne kaha: Maine Ramzan ke mahine mein apni biwi se jinsi taalluqaat kiye. Isper unhone kaha: Kya tum kisi ghulam ko azaad karne ke liye pa sakte ho? Usne kaha: Nahi. Unhone dobara kaha: Kya tum lagataar do mahine roza rakh sakte ho? Usne kaha: Nahi. Unhone kaha: Kya tum saath gareebon ko khaana khila sakte ho? Usne kaha: Nahi. Woh phir baith gaya aur isi dauran Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas ek tokri laayi gayi jismein khajooren thin. Unhone kaha: Ye khajooren sadaqe mein do. Usne kaha: Kya main use dun jo mujhse zyada gareeb hai? Madina ki do lava ki chatanon ke beech mere gharane se zyada gareeb koi gharana nahi hai. Rasoolullah (SAW) itne hanse ki unke daadh ke daant dikhne lage aur unhone kaha: Jao aur apne gharwalon ko ye khilaao.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Muhammad b. Muslim al-Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters, and he said: There was brought an 'araq containing dates, an 'araq being a huge basket. But in this hadith no mention has been made of (the fact) that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) laughed till his molar teeth became visible.
hi: Ye hadees Muhammad bin Muslim al-Zuhri ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai, aur unhone kaha: Ek "araq" laaya gaya jismein khajooren thin, araq ek badi tokri hoti hai. Lekin is hadees mein iska zikr nahi kiya gaya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) itne hanse ki unke daadh ke daant dikhne lage.

e: Abu Huraira reported that a person had intercourse with his wife during Ramadan (while fasting). He asked for the religious verdict (about it) from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Can you find a slave (to grant him freedom)? He said: No. He (the Prophet again) said: Can you afford to observe fasts for two (consecutive) months? He said: No. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Then feed sixty poor men.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs ne Ramzan mein, roza rakhte hue, apni biwi se jinsi milaap kiya. Usne Rasoolullah (SAW) se iske baare mein fatwa maanga, isper unhone kaha: Kya tum kisi ghulam ko pa sakte ho, use azaad karne ke liye? Usne kaha: Nahi. Unhone dobara kaha: Kya tumhe lagataar do mahine roza rakhne ki taaqat hai? Usne kaha: Nahi. Unhone kaha: To saath gareebon ko khaana khilaao.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters that a person broke fast in Ramadan whereupon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commanded him to free a slave (as an atonement), and the rest of the hadith is the same as narrated by Ibn Uyaina.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai ki ek shakhs ne Ramzan mein roza toda, isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unhe kaffaray ke taur par ek ghulam azaad karne ka hukum diya, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai jaisi Ibn Uyaina ne bayan ki hai.

e: Humaid b. 'Abd al-Rahman reported that Abu Huraira had narrated to him that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commanded the person (who) broke the fast in Ramadan to free a slave or observe fasts for two (consecutive) months or feed sixty poor persons.
hi: Humaid bin Abdur-Rahman ne bayan kiya ki Abu Huraira ne unhe ye riwayat ki ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne us shakhs ko jisne Ramzan mein roza toda, ek ghulam azaad karne ka, ya lagataar do mahine roza rakhne ka, ya saath gareebon ko khaana khilaane ka hukum diya.

e: This hadith has been narrated with the same chain of transmitters on the authority of Zuhri.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that a person came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: I am burnt, whereupon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: How is it? He (the person) said: I had intercourse with my wife during the day in Ramadan. Upon this (the Holy Prophet) said: Give charity, give charity. He (the person) said: There is nothing with me. He commanded him to sit down, (In the meanwhile) there were brought to him (to the Holy Prophet) two baskets containing eatables, whereupon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) told him to give them as sadaqa.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Main jal gaya hoon, isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Ye kaise hai? Usne kaha: Maine Ramzan mein din mein apni biwi se jinsi milaap kiya. Isper unhone kaha: Sadaqa do, sadaqa do. Usne kaha: Mere paas kuch nahi hai. Unhone use baithne ka hukum diya. Isi dauran unke paas do tokriyaan laayi gayin jinmein khaane ki cheezein thin, isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unse kaha ki woh unhe sadaqe mein de de.

e: 'Abbad b. Abdullah b. Zubair narrated that he heard 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) saying: A person came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and he then narrated the hadith. But (neither these words are found):" Give charity, give charity" (nor) his words:" during the day time".
hi: Abbad bin Abdullah bin Zubair ne bayan kiya ki unhone Aisha (RA) ko ye kehte suna: Ek shakhs Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aaya, aur phir unhone hadees bayan ki. Lekin na ye alfaaz mile hain: "Sadaqa do, sadaqa do" na unke alfaaz "din mein."

e: Abbad b. Abdullah b. Zubair reported that he had heard 'A'isha, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), as saying: A person came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in the mosque during (the month of) Ramadan and said: Messenger of Allah, I am burnt, I am burnt, whereupon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) asked him as to what the matter was. Upon this he said: I had intercourse with my wife (in a state of fasting) Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Give charity. Upon this he said: Apostle of Allah, I swear by God, there is nothing with me (to give in charity) as I do not possess anything. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Sit down. So he sat down and he was in this very state when there came a person urging a donkey with a load of eatables upon it. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Where is that burnt one who was just here? Thereupon the person stood up. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Give this (eatables brought by the man) in charity. Upon this the person said: Messenger of Allah, can there be anyone else (more deserving than I)? By Allah. we are hungry, we have nothing with us. Upon this he (the Holy Prophet) said: Then eat (these eatables).
hi: Abbad bin Abdullah bin Zubair ne bayan kiya ki unhone Aisha, Rasoolullah (SAW) ki zauja, ko ye kehte suna: Ek shakhs Ramzan mein masjid mein Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, main jal gaya hoon, main jal gaya hoon, isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne usse poocha ki kya baat hai. Isper usne kaha: Maine, roze ki halat mein, apni biwi se jinsi milaap kiya. Isper unhone kaha: Sadaqa do. Isper usne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Allah ki qasam, mere paas kuch nahi hai dene ke liye sadaqe mein kyunki mere paas kuch bhi nahi hai. Unhone kaha: Baith jao. To woh baith gaya aur isi haalat mein tha jab ek shakhs ek gadhe ko haankte hue aaya jispar khaane ki cheezon ka bojh tha. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Woh jala hua shakhs kahan hai jo abhi yahan tha? Isper woh shakhs khada hua. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Ise sadaqe mein do. Isper us shakhs ne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, kya koi aur ho sakta hai, mujhse zyada mustahiq? Allah ki qasam, hum bhookhe hain, hamare paas kuch nahi hai. Isper unhone kaha: To ise khao.

e: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went out during the month of Ramadan in the year of Victory (when Mecca was conquered) and was fasting till he reached Kadid (a canal situated at a distance of forty-two miles from Mecca) and he then broke the fast. And it was the habit of the Companions of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) to follow him in every new thing (or act). So they followed him also (in this matter).
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) Fatah ke saal Ramzan ke mahine mein, Makkah fatah karne ke waqt, bahar nikle aur roza rakh rahe the yahan tak ki woh Kadid, Makkah se battees mil ki doori par ek nahar, pahunche aur phir unhone roza toda. Aur ye Rasoolullah (SAW) ke sahaba ki aadat thi ki woh har nayi cheez ya amal mein unki pairvi karte. To unhone bhi unki pairvi ki is maamle mein.

e: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters. Yahya (one of the narrators) said that Sufyan (the narrator) had stated: I do not know whose statement it is:" It is the last word of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) which is accepted as (final as it abrogates the previous ones)."
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai. Yahya, ek raawi, ne kaha ki Sufyan, raawi, ne bayan ki tha: Mujhe nahi pata ye kiska bayaan hai: "Ye Rasoolullah (SAW) ka aakhri alfaaz hai jo aakhri, aur pichhle ko mansookh karne wale, ke taur par qubool kiya jaata hai."

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters that breaking of fast (in a journey) is the final of the two commands (whether one may fast or one may break it), and it is the last command of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) which is to be accepted as final.
