Zuhri said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) marched on Mecca on the morning of 14th of Ramadan (lit. when thirteen nights had passed).
hi: Ye Zuhri ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai ki roza todna, safar mein, do hukmon, chahe koi roza rakhe ya toda, mein se aakhri hai, aur ye Rasoolullah (SAW) ka aakhri hukum hai jise aakhri ke taur par qubool kiya jaana chahiye. Zuhri ne kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Ramzan ki chaudhvin, yaani jab terah raaten guzar chuki thin, ki subah Makkah ki taraf march kiya.

e: A hadlth like this has been transmitted on the authority of Ibn Shibab who said that they (the Compnions of the Holy Prophet) followed the latest of his commands and looked upon it as one abrogating (the previous ones) and the most firm.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Ibn Shihab ki sanad se bayan ki gayi hai jinhone kaha ki unhone, Nabi ke sahaba ne, unke aakhri hukum ki pairvi ki aur ise, pehle ko, mansookh karne wala aur sabse mazboot samjha.

e: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) journeyed during the month of Ramadan in a state of fasting till he reached 'Usfan. He then ordered a cup containing drinking water and he drank that openly so that the people might see it, and broke the fast (and did not resume it) till he reached Mecca. Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with him) said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) fasted and broke the fast, so he who wished fasted and he who wished to break it broke it.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Ramzan ke mahine mein roza rakhte hue safar kiya yahan tak ki woh Usfan pahunche. Unhone phir ek pyaala mangwaaya jismein peene ka paani tha aur unhone use khule aam piya taaki log ise dekh sakein, aur roza toda, aur use phir se shuru nahi kiya, jab tak woh Makkah nahi pahunche. Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne roza rakha aur roza toda, is liye jo chahe roza rakhe aur jo chahe roza tode.

e: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with him) reported: Do not condemn one who observes fast, or one who does not observe (in a journey). for the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed fast in a journey or he did not observe it (too).
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Us shakhs ki nindaa mat karo jo roza rakhta hai, ya jo, safar mein, roza nahi rakhta, kyunki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne safar mein roza rakha bhi aur roza nahi bhi rakha.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with both of them) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went out to Mecca in Ramadan in the year of Victory, and he and the people fasted till he came to Kura' al-Ghamim and the people also fasted. He then called for a cup of water which he raised till the people saw it, and then he drank. He was told afterwards that some people had continued to fast, and he said: These people are the disobedient ones; these are the disobedient ones.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Fatah ke saal Ramzan mein Makkah ki taraf nikle, aur woh aur log Kura al-Ghamim tak pahunchne tak roza rakhte rahe aur log bhi roza rakhte rahe. Unhone phir paani ka ek pyaala mangwaaya jise unhone itna buland kiya ki log use dekh saken, aur phir piya. Baad mein unhe bataya gaya ki kuch log abhi bhi roza rakhe hue hain, aur unhone kaha: Ye log naafarmaan hain; ye log naafarmaan hain.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Ja'far with the same chain of transmitters and he added: It was said to him (to the Holy Prophet): There are people to whom fasting has become unbearable and they are waiting how you do. He (the Holy Prophet) then called for a cup of water when it was afternoon. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Ye hadees Ja'far ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai aur unhone izafa kiya: Unse kaha gaya, Nabi (SAW) se: Kuch log hain jinke liye roza rakhna namumkin ho gaya hai aur woh intezaar kar rahe hain ki aap kya karte hain. Unhone phir dopahar hote hi ek pyaala paani mangwaaya. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with both of them) reported that in the course of a journey Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw a man, people crowding around him and providing him a shade. Upon this he (the Holy Prophet) said: What is the matter with him? They said: He is a person observing fast. Whereupon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: It is no righteousness that you fast on journey.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki safar ke dauran Rasoolullah (SAW) ne ek shakhs ko dekha, log uske aas-paas jama the aur usse saaya de rahe the. Isper unhone kaha: Isko kya hua hai? Unhone kaha: Ye roza rakhne wala shakhs hai. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Ye nekii nahi hai ki tum safar mein roza rakho.

e: 'Amr b. al-Hasan is reported to have said that he heard Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with both of them) as saying that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saw a man. The rest of the hadith is the same as mentioned above.
hi: Amr bin al-Hasan ne, ye kaha jaata hai, ki unhone Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ko ye kehte suna ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne ek shakhs ko dekha. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai jaisi upar zikr hui.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters but with this addition that he (the Holy Prophet) said: " Take advantage of the concession of Allah Who Wanted it to you." When he (one of the narrators) asked him (the other one, Yabya b. Abi Kathar) he did not retain it in his mind.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai lekin is izafe ke saath ki unhone kaha: "Allah ki di hui rukhsat, chhoot, ka faayda uthaao jo Usne tumhe di hai." Jab unhone, ek raawi ne, usse, doosre se, Yahya bin Abi Kathir se, poocha, to unhe ye yaad nahi tha.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) reported: We went out on an expedition with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the 16th of Ramadan. Some of us fasted and some of us broke the fast. But neither the observer of the fast found fault with one who broke it, nor the breaker of the fast found fault with one who observed it.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath Ramzan ki solhvin tareekh ko ek muhim par nikle. Hummein se kuchne roza rakha aur kuchne roza toda. Lekin na roza rakhne wale ne roza todne wale mein koi galti nikaali, na roza todne wale ne roza rakhne wale mein koi galti nikaali.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Qatada with the same chain of transmitters by different narrators (except this difference) that in the hadith transmitted by Taimi and Umar b. Amir and Hisham (the date of setting out is) 18th, and in the hadith transmitted by Sa'id it is the 12th, and in the one transmitted by Shu'ba it is the 17th or 19th.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Qatada ki sanad se mukhtalif raawiyon ke zariye bayan ki gayi hai siwaay is farq ke, ki Taimi, Umar bin Amir aur Hisham ki bayan ki hui hadees mein rawaana hone ki tareekh atharvi hai, aur Sa'id ki bayan ki hui hadees mein ye barhvin hai, aur Shu'ba ki bayan ki hui mein ye satarvin ya unnisvin hai.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) reported: We went out on an expedition with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) during Ramadan and neither the observer of the fast was found fault with for his fasting, nor the breaker of the fast for breaking it.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath Ramzan mein ek muhim par nikle aur na roza rakhne wale mein uske roza rakhne ke liye koi galti nikaali gayi, na roza todne wale mein uske roza todne ke liye.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) reported: We went out on an expedition with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) during Ramadan. Some of us observed the fast and some of us broke it. Neither the observer of the fast had any grudge against one who broke it, nor the breaker of the fast had any grudge against one who had fasted They knew that he who had strength enough (to bear its rigour) fasted and that was good, and they also found that he who felt weakness (and could not bear the burden) broke it, and that was also good.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath Ramzan mein ek muhim par nikle. Hummein se kuchne roza rakha aur kuchne roza toda. Na roza rakhne wale ko roza todne wale se koi shikaayat thi, na roza todne wale ko roza rakhne wale se koi shikaayat thi. Unhe pata tha ki jispas taaqat thi, uski sakhti bardaasht karne ki, usne roza rakha, aur ye achha tha, aur unhone ye bhi paaya ki jisne kamzori mahsoos ki, aur bojh bardaasht na kar saka, usne roza toda, aur ye bhi achha tha.

e: Abu Nadra reported Abu Sa'id al. Khudri and Jabir b. Abdullah as saying: We travelled with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). The observer of the fast observed it, and the breaker of the fast broke it, but none of them found fault with each other.
hi: Abu Nadra ne Abu Sa'id al-Khudri aur Jabir bin Abdullah ko ye kehte suna: Hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath safar kiya. Roza rakhne wale ne roza rakha, aur roza todne wale ne roza toda, lekin unmein se kisi ne bhi ek-doosre mein koi galti nahi nikaali.

e: Humaid reported that Anas (Allah be pleased with him) was asked about fasting during Ramadan while travelling. He said: We travelled with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) during the month of Ramadan, but neither the observer of the fast found fault with the breaker of the fast, nor the breaker of the fast found fault with the observer of the fast.
hi: Humaid ne bayan kiya ki Anas (RA) se Ramzan mein safar ke dauran roze ke baare mein poocha gaya. Unhone kaha: Hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath Ramzan ke mahine mein safar kiya, lekin na roza rakhne wale ne roza todne wale mein galti nikaali, na roza todne wale ne roza rakhne wale mein galti nikaali.

e: Abu Khalid al-Ahmar narrated from Humaid who said: I went out and was fasting; they said to me: Break (lit. go back, repeat). He said that Anas reported that the Companions of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to set out on a journey and neither the observer of the fast found fault with the breaker of the fast, nor the breaker of the fast found fault with the observer of the fast. (One of the narrators Humaid said): I met Ibn Abi Mulaika who informed me the same thing on the authority of 'A'isha.
hi: Abu Khalid al-Ahmar ne Humaid ke hawale se riwayat ki jinhone kaha: Main bahar gaya aur roza rakhe hue tha; unhone, logon ne, mujhse kaha: Ise tod do, dohraao, yaani wapas jaao. Unhone kaha ki Anas ne riwayat ki ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ke sahaba safar par nikalte the aur na roza rakhne wale ne roza todne wale mein koi galti nikaali, na roza todne wale ne roza rakhne wale mein. Ek raawi Humaid ne kaha: Main Ibn Abu Mulaika se mila jinhone mujhe yehi baat Aisha ki sanad se bataayi.

e: Anas (Allah be pleased with him) reported: We were with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on a journey. Some of us had been observing the fast and some of us had not been fasting. We got down at a place on a hot day. Most of us had the cloth for shelter. There were also those amongst us who sheltered (themselves against the rays of the) sun with the help of their hands. The observers of the fast fell down (on account of weakness). Those who had not observed it got up and pitched tents and watered the mounts. Thereupon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The breakers of the fast have taken away the reward today.
hi: Anas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath ek safar mein the. Hummein se kuchne roza rakha hua tha aur kuchne roza nahi rakha tha. Hum ek garam din mein ek jagah utre. Hummein se zyadatar ke paas parde, kapde ke liye saaya, chhipne ka saadhan, tha. Hummein se aise bhi the jo apne haathon ki madad se, suraj ki kiranon se, khud ko saaya de rahe the. Roza rakhne wale, kamzori ki wajah se, gir gaye. Jinhone roza nahi rakha tha woh utthe aur khaimein laga diye aur sawaariyon ko paani pilaaya. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Roza todne walon ne aaj sawaab le liya.

e: Anas (Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was journeying (along with his Companions). Some of them had observed the fast whereas the others had broken it. Those who did not fast girded up their loins and worked, but the observers of the fast were too weak to work. Upon this he (the Messenger of Allah) said: Today the breakers of the fast have gone with the reward.
hi: Anas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) safar kar rahe the apne sahaba ke saath. Unmein se kuchne roza rakha tha jabki doosron ne toda tha. Jinhone roza nahi rakha unhone apni kamar kase aur kaam kiya, lekin roza rakhne wale kaam karne mein bahut kamzor the. Isper unhone, Allah ke Rasool ne, kaha: Aaj roza todne wale sawaab lekar gaye.

e: Qaza'a reported: I came to Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) and he was surrounded (by people), and when they dispersed I said to him: I am not going to ask you about what these people were asking. I ask you about fasting on a journey. Upon this he said: We travelled with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) towards Mecca and we had been observing fast. We halted at a place. There the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: You are nearing your enemy and breaking of fast would give you greater strength, and that was a concession (given to us). But some of us continued to observe the fast and some of us broke it. We then got down at another place and he (the Holy Prophet) said: You are going to encounter the enemy in the morning and breaking of the fast would give you strength, so break the fast. As it was a point of stress, so we broke the fast. But subsequently we saw ourselves observing the fast with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on a journey.
hi: Qaza'a ne bayan kiya: Main Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ke paas aaya aur woh logon se ghire hue the, aur jab woh chale gaye to maine unse kaha: Main aapse woh nahi poochunga jo ye log poochh rahe the. Main aapse safar mein roze ke baare mein poochunga. Isper unhone kaha: Hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath Makkah ki taraf safar kiya aur hum roza rakhe hue the. Hum ek jagah utre. Wahan Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Tum apne dushman ke qareeb pahunch rahe ho aur roza todne se tumhe zyada taaqat milegi, aur ye ek chhoot thi jo humein di gayi. Lekin hummein se kuchne roza rakha jaari rakha aur kuchne roza toda. Hum phir ek doosri jagah utre aur unhone kaha: Tum kal subah dushman ka saamna karne wale ho aur roza todna tumhe taaqat degi, is liye roza todo. Chunki ye ek dabaav wala mauqa tha, is liye humne roza toda. Lekin baad mein humne khud ko Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath safar mein roza rakhte dekha.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that Hamza b. 'Amr al-Aslami asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about fasting on a journey, and he (the Holy Prophet) said: Fast if you like and break it if you like.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Hamza bin Amr al-Aslami ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se safar mein roze ke baare mein poocha, aur unhone kaha: Agar tum chaho to roza rakho aur agar tum chaho to ise todo.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that Hamza b. Amr al-Aslami asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) thus: Messenger of Allah, I am a person devoted much to fasting. Should I fast during the journey? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Fast if you like and break it if you like.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Hamza bin Amr al-Aslami ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se yun poocha: Ya Rasoolullah, main ek aisa shakhs hoon jo roze rakhne ka bahut aadi hoon. Kya mujhe safar mein roza rakhna chahiye? Unhone kaha: Agar tum chaho to roza rakho aur agar tum chaho to ise todo.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Hisham ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters that Hamza said: I am a person much used to fasting. Should I fast during the journey? (The rest of the hadith is the same.)
hi: Ye hadees Hisham ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai ki Hamza ne kaha: Main ek aisa shakhs hoon jo roze rakhne ka bahut aadi hoon. Kya mujhe safar mein roza rakhna chahiye? Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Hamza b. 'Amr al-Aslami (Allah be pleased with him) said: Messenger of Allah, I find strength in me for fasting on a journey; is there any sin upon me (in doing it)? Thereupon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: It is a concession from Allah. He who took advantage of it, it is good for him, and he who preferred to observe fast, there is no sin upon him. Harun (one of the narrators) in his narration said: 'lt is a concession, and he made no mention of" from Allah".
hi: Hamza bin Amr al-Aslami (RA) ne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, mujhe apne andar safar mein roza rakhne ki taaqat mehsoos hoti hai; kya aisa karne mein mujhpar koi gunah hai? Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Ye Allah ki taraf se ek chhoot hai. Jo ismein faayda uthaaye, uske liye achha hai, aur jo roza rakhna behtar samjhe, uspar koi gunah nahi hai. Harun, ek raawi, ne apni riwayat mein kaha: "Ye ek chhoot hai," aur unhone "Allah ki taraf se" ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: Abu Darda' (Allah be pleased with him) reported: We set out during the month of Ramadan with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in such an intense heat that one of us would place his hand over his head (in order to protect himself) against the excessive heat, and none among us was observing the fast, except the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and 'Abdullah b. Rawaha.
hi: Abu Darda (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Ramzan ke mahine mein Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath itni shadeed garmi mein nikle ki hummein se koi apna haath apne sar par rakhta, khud ko bachaane ke liye shadeed garmi se, aur hummein se koi bhi roza nahi rakhe hue tha, siwaay Rasoolullah (SAW) aur Abdullah bin Rawaha ke.

e: Abu Darda' reported: We were with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on some of his journeys on an intensely hot day so much so that a person would place his hand on his head (in order to protect himself) against excessive heat, and none amongst us was fasting but the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and Abdullah b. Rawaha
hi: Abu Darda ne bayan kiya: Hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath unke kuch safaron mein the ek itni shadeed garm din mein ki ek shakhs apna haath apne sar par rakhta, khud ko bachaane ke liye shadeed garmi se, aur hummein se koi bhi roza nahi rakhe hue tha siwaay Rasoolullah (SAW) aur Abdullah bin Rawaha ke.

e: Umm al-Fadl bint- al-Harith reported that some people argued about the fasting of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the day of 'Arafa. Some of them said that he had been fasting, whereas the others said that he had not been fasting. I sent a cup of milk to him while he was riding his camel at 'Arafa, and he drank it.
hi: Umm al-Fadl bint al-Harith ne bayan kiya ki kuch logon ne Arafa ke din Rasoolullah (SAW) ke roze ke baare mein bahas ki. Unmein se kuchne kaha ki woh roza rakhe hue the, jabki doosron ne kaha ki woh roza nahi rakhe hue the. Maine unke paas doodh ka ek pyaala bheja jab woh Arafa mein apne oont par sawaar the, aur unhone use piya.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Nadr with the same chain of transmitters, but he did not mention that he was mounting (riding on) his camel.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Nadr ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai, lekin unhone iska zikr nahi kiya ki woh apne oont par sawaar the.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Abu Nadr on the authority of Umair, the freed slave of Umm al-Fadl, through the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Nadr ne Umair, Umm al-Fadl ke aazad kiye hue ghulam, ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki hai.

e: Umm al-Fadl (Allah be pleased with her) is reported to have said that some people among the Companions of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) were in doubt about fasting on the day of 'Arafa and we were with him on that day. I (Umm al-Fadl) sent him a cup of milk and he was halting at 'Arafa, and he drank that.
hi: Umm al-Fadl (RA) ne, ye kaha jaata hai, kaha ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ke sahaba mein se kuch logon ko Arafa ke din roze ke baare mein shaq tha aur hum us din unke saath the. Maine, Umm al-Fadl ne, unhe doodh ka ek pyaala bheja aur woh Arafa mein ruke hue the, aur unhone use piya.

e: Kuraib, the freed slave of Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with him), reported from Maimuna, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), that people had doubt about the fasting of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the day of 'Arafa. Maimuna sent him a cup of milk and he was halting at a place and he drank it and the people were seeing him.
hi: Kuraib, Ibn Abbas (RA) ke aazad kiye hue ghulam, ne Maimuna, Rasoolullah (SAW) ki zauja, ke hawale se riwayat ki ki logon ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke Arafa ke din roze ke baare mein shaq tha. Maimuna ne unhe doodh ka ek pyaala bheja aur woh ek jagah ruke hue the aur unhone use piya aur log unhe dekh rahe the.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that the Quraish used to fast on the day of 'Ashura in the pre-Islamic days and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) also observed it. When he migrated to Medina, he himself observed this fast and commanded (others) to observe it. But when fasting during the month of Ramadan was made obligatory he said: He who wishes to observe this fast may do so, and he who wishes to abandon it may do so.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Quraish jaahiliyat ke daur mein Ashura ke din roza rakha karte the aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ne bhi ise rakha. Jab woh Madina hijrat karke aaye, to unhone khud ye roza rakha aur doosron ko bhi ise rakhne ka hukum diya. Lekin jab Ramzan mein roza farz kiya gaya, to unhone kaha: Jo ye roza rakhna chahe, woh rakh sakta hai, aur jo ise chhodna chahe, woh chhod sakta hai.

e: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters, but he made no mention in the first part of the hadith that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to observe fast, and said about the second part that he abandoned the (fast) of Ashura, and he who wished observed the fast and who wished otherwise abandoned it, and he did not hold it as the words of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as mentioned in the narration transmitted by Jarir.
hi: Ye hadees Hisham ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai, lekin unhone hadees ke pehle hisse mein iska zikr nahi kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) roza rakha karte the, aur doosre hisse ke baare mein kaha ki unhone Ashura ka roza chhod diya, aur jo chahe roza rakhta aur jo chahe chhod deta, aur unhone ise Rasoolullah (SAW) ke alfaaz nahi maana jaisa Jarir ki riwayat mein bayan hua hai.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported. In the pre-Islamic days fast was observed on the day of Ashura, but with the advent of Islam (its position was ascertained as that of a voluntary fast). Then he who wished to fast fasted, and he who liked to abandon it abandoned it.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Jaahiliyat ke daur mein Ashura ke din roza rakha jaata tha, lekin Islam ke aane par iski haalat ek nafil roze ki tay hui. Phir jo roza rakhna chahta woh rakhta, aur jo chhodna chahta woh chhod deta.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had ordered to observe fast (on 'Ashura) before the fasting in Ramadan was made obligatory. But when it became obligatory, then he who wished fasted on the day of Ashura, and he who wished did not observe it (on that day).
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Ashura ka roza rakhne ka hukum diya tha isse pehle ki Ramzan mein roza farz kiya jaaye. Lekin jab ye farz ho gaya, to jo chahta woh Ashura ke din roza rakhta, aur jo chahta woh us din roza nahi rakhta.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that the Quraish used to fast on the day of Ashura during the pre-Islamic days. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) then commanded to fast on that day till (fasting) in Ramadan became obligatory. Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: He who wishes to fast should do so, and he who wishes to break it may do so.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Quraish jaahiliyat ke daur mein Ashura ke din roza rakha karte the. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne phir us din roza rakhne ka hukum diya, yahan tak ki Ramzan mein roza farz ho gaya. Phir Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Jo roza rakhna chahe use rakhna chahiye, aur jo ise todna chahe use tod dena chahiye.

e: Abdullah b. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that (the Arabs of) pre-Islamic days used to observe fast on the day of Ashura and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed it and the Muslims too (observed it) before fasting in Ramadan became obligatory. But when it became obligatory, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Ashura is one of the days of Allah, so he who wished should observe fast and he who wished otherwise should abandon it.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Arab jaahiliyat ke daur mein Ashura ke din roza rakha karte the aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ne bhi ise rakha aur Musalmaanon ne bhi, Ramzan mein roza farz hone se pehle. Lekin jab ye farz ho gaya, to Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Ashura Allah ke dinon mein se ek hai, is liye jo chahe roza rakhe aur jo chahe use chhod de.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Abdullah through the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Abdullah ki sanad se isi sanad se bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) said that the day of 'Ashura was mentioned before the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him). Thereupon the Messenger of Allah, (ﷺ) said: That was a day on which the people of pre-Islamic days used to observe fast. So he who amongst you likes to observe fast should do so, and he who does not like it should abandon it.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne kaha ki Ashura ke din ka zikr Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saamne hua. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Ye woh din tha jispar jaahiliyat ke daur ke log roza rakha karte the. Is liye tum mein se jo koi roza rakhna chahe use rakhna chahiye, aur jo ise pasand na kare use chhod dena chahiye.

e: Abdullah b. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with both of them) reported that he heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say about the day of Ashura: It is a day on which the people of pre-Islamic days observed fast. So he who liked to fast on this day should do so, and he who liked to abandon it should abandon it. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with him) did not observe fast except when it coincided (with the days when he was in the habit of observing voluntary fasts during every month).
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) ko Ashura ke din ke baare mein ye kehte suna: Ye woh din hai jispar jaahiliyat ke daur ke log roza rakha karte the. Is liye jo is din roza rakhna chahe use rakhna chahiye, aur jo ise chhodna chahe use chhod dena chahiye. Abdullah (RA) ne roza tab hi rakha jab ye Ashura unke Nafil roze rakhne ki aam tareekhon se mel khaata tha, jo woh har mahine rakha karte the.

e: Abdullah b. Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that the day of 'Ashura was mentioned before the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he narrated a hadith like one (narrated above).
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Ashura ke din ka zikr Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saamne hua aur unhone upar bayan hui hadees jaisi ek hadees bayan ki.

e: 'Abdullah b. Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that the day of 'Ashura was mentioned before the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he said: It is a day when the people in the pre-Islamic days need to observe fast, so he who wishes to observe fast should do so, and he who wishes to abandon it should do so.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Ashura ke din ka zikr Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saamne hua aur unhone kaha: Ye woh din hai jab jaahiliyat ke daur ke log roza rakha karte the, is liye jo roza rakhna chahe use rakhna chahiye, aur jo ise chhodna chahe use chhodna chahiye.

e: Abd al-Rahman b. Yazid said: When al-Ash'ath b. Qais entered the house of 'Abdullah he was having his breakfast. He ('Abdullah b. Umar) said: Abd Muhammad (al-Asha'th), come near to the breakfast. Thereupon he said: Is not today the day of 'Ashura? He ('Abd al-Rahman) said: Do you know what the day of 'Ashura is? He said: What is it? He said: It is a day on which the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to observe fast before the (fasting) in the month of Ramadan (became) obligatory. But when it became obligatory the (fasting of 'Ashura) was abandoned (as compulsory). Abu Kuraib said: He (the Holy Prophet) abandoned it.
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Yazid ne kaha: Jab al-Ash'ath bin Qais Abdullah ke ghar daakhil hue, to woh Abdullah apna naashta kar rahe the. Unhone kaha: Abd Muhammad, al-Asha'th, naashte ke qareeb aao. Isper unhone kaha: Kya aaj Ashura ka din nahi hai? Unhone kaha: Kya tumhe pata hai Ashura ka din kya hai? Unhone kaha: Kya hai? Unhone kaha: Ye woh din hai jispar Rasoolullah (SAW) roza rakha karte the isse pehle ki Ramzan mein roza farz ho jaaye. Lekin jab ye farz ho gaya, to Ashura ka roza chhod diya gaya, farz ke taur par. Abu Kuraib ne kaha: Unhone ise chhod diya.

e: This hadith has been narrated from Jarir on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters and he said (these words with a little bit of variation from the previous hadith): When (fasting) in Ramadan was (made) obligatory, he abandoned it (the practice of observing fast on Ashura).
hi: Ye hadees Jarir ki sanad se A'mash ki hawale se bayan ki gayi hai aur unhone kaha, in alfaazon mein, pichhli hadees se thodi tabdeeli ke saath: Jab Ramzan mein roza farz kar diya gaya, to unhone ise, Ashura par roza rakhne ki adat, chhod diya.

e: Qais b Sakan reported that al-Ash'ath b. Qais went to 'Abdullah on the day of 'Ashura while he was eating. He said: Abu Muhammad, come near and dine. Upon this he said: I am fasting. Thereupon he said: We used to observe fast and then (this practice) was abandoned.
hi: Qais bin Sakan ne bayan kiya ki al-Ash'ath bin Qais Abdullah ke paas Ashura ke din gaye jabki woh khaana kha rahe the. Unhone kaha: Abu Muhammad, qareeb aao aur khaana khao. Isper unhone kaha: Main roza rakhe hue hoon. Isper unhone kaha: Hum roza rakha karte the aur phir ye amal chhod diya gaya.

e: 'Alqama reported that Ash'ath b. Qais went to Ibn Mas'udd while he was eating on the day of Ashura. Thereupon he said: Abu Abd al-Rahman, it is the day of 'Ashura (and you are eating). Upon this he said: Fast was observed on (this day) before the (fasting) in Ramadan was made obligatory, but when it was made obligatory, (fasting on the day of 'Ashura) was abandoned. So if you are not fasting, then take food.
hi: Alqama ne bayan kiya ki Ash'ath bin Qais Ibn Mas'ud ke paas gaye jabki woh Ashura ke din khaana kha rahe the. Isper unhone kaha: Abu Abdur-Rahman, ye Ashura ka din hai, aur aap khaana kha rahe hain. Isper unhone kaha: Is din roza rakha jaata tha isse pehle ki Ramzan mein roza farz kiya jaaye, lekin jab ye farz kiya gaya, to Ashura ke din roza rakhna chhod diya gaya. Is liye agar tum roza nahi rakhe hue ho, to khaana kha lo.

e: Jabir b Samura reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commanded us to observe fast on the day of Ashura and exhorted us to do it and was particular about it But when (fasting) in Ramadan was made obligatory, he hence. forth neither commanded us nor forbade us, nor was he so particular about it.
hi: Jabir bin Samura ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne humein Ashura ke din roza rakhne ka hukum diya aur humein aisa karne ki targheeb di aur iske baare mein khaas taur par sanjeeda the. Lekin jab Ramzan mein roza farz kar diya gaya, to unhone iske baad na humein aisa karne ka hukum diya na hi humein mana kiya, na hi woh iske baare mein utne sanjeeda rahe.

e: Abd al-Rahman reported that he heard Mu'awiya b. Abu Sufyan delivering a sermon in Medina. i. e. when he came there (for Hajj). He delivered a sermon on the day of 'Ashura and said: People of Medina, where are your scholars? I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say on this very day: It is the day of 'Ashura. Allah has not made fasting on This day obligatory for you but I am fasting. He who likes to observe fast among you should do so, and he who likes not to observe it may not observe it.
hi: Abdur-Rahman ne bayan kiya ki unhone Muawiya bin Abu Sufyan ko Madina mein khutba dete suna, yaani jab woh wahan Hajj ke liye aaye the. Unhone Ashura ke din khutba diya aur kaha: Madina walo, tumhare ulama kahan hain? Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko isi din ye kehte suna: Ye Ashura ka din hai. Allah ne tumpar is din roza farz nahi kiya hai lekin main roza rakhe hue hoon. Tum mein se jo koi roza rakhna chahe use rakhna chahiye, aur jo ise na rakhna chahe woh na rakhe.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Shihab through the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Ibn Shihab ki sanad se isi sanad se bayan ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters that be heard Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying on a similar day: I am fasting today, so he who wishes to observe fast should do so; but he did not make mention of the rest of the hadith.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ek aisi hi din par ye kehte suna: Main aaj roza rakhe hue hoon, is liye jo roza rakhna chahe use rakhna chahiye; lekin unhone hadees ka baaki hissa zikr nahi kiya.

e: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with both of them) reported that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to Medina, he found the Jews observing the fast on the day of Ashura. They (the Jews) were asked about it and they said: It is the day on which Allah granted victory to Moses and (his people) Bani Isra'il over the Pharaoh and we observe fast out of gratitude to Him. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: We have a closer connection with Moses than you have, and he commanded to observe fast on this day.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Madina aaye, to unhone paaya ki Yahudi Ashura ke din roza rakh rahe hain. Unse, Yahudiyon se, iske baare mein poocha gaya aur unhone kaha: Ye woh din hai jispar Allah ne Musa (AS) aur unke logon, Bani Israel, ko Firaun par fatah di, aur hum Uske shukriye mein roza rakhte hain. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Humara Musa se tumse zyada gehra taalluq hai, aur unhone is din roza rakhne ka hukum diya.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Ibn Bishr with the same chain of transmitters (but with a slight variation) that he (the Holy Prophet) inquired of them (Jews) about it (fasting on the day of 'Ashura).
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Bishr ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai, lekin halki tabdeeli ke saath, ki unhone unse, Yahudiyon se, iske baare mein, Ashura ke din roza rakhne ke baare mein, poocha.

e: Ibn'Abbas (Allah be pleased with both of them) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) arrived in Medina and found the Jews observing fast on the day of 'Ashura. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to them: What is the (significance) of this day that you observe fast on it? They said: It is the day of great (significance) when Allah delivered Moses and his people, and drowned the Pharaoh and his people, and Moses observed fast out of gratitude and we also observe it. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: We have more right, and we have a closer connection with Moses than you have; so Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) observed fast (on the day of 'Ashura), and gave orders that it should be observed.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) Madina pahunche aur unhone paaya ki Yahudi Ashura ke din roza rakh rahe hain. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unse kaha: Is din ki kya ahmiyat hai ki tum isper roza rakhte ho? Unhone kaha: Ye ek bahut hi ahem din hai jab Allah ne Musa (AS) aur unke logon ko bachaaya, aur Firaun aur uske logon ko doba diya, aur Musa (AS) ne shukriye mein roza rakha aur hum bhi ise rakhte hain. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Humara zyada haq hai, aur humara Musa se tumse zyada gehra taalluq hai; to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ashura ke din roza rakha, aur hukum diya ki ise rakha jaaye.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ayyub with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ayyub ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Musa (Allah be pleased with him) reported: The day of 'Ashura was one which the Jews respected and they treated it as Id. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: You also observe fast on this day.
hi: Abu Musa (RA) ne bayan kiya: Ashura ka din woh tha jise Yahudi izzat dete the aur woh ise Eid ki tarah manaate the. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Tum bhi is din roza rakho.

e: Abu Musa reported that the people of Khaibar (most of them were Jews) observed fast on the day of 'Ashura and they treated it as 'Id and gave their women ornaments and beautiful dresses to wear. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: You (only) observe fast on this day.
hi: Abu Musa ne bayan kiya ki Khaibar ke log, jinmein zyadatar Yahudi the, Ashura ke din roza rakhte the aur ise Eid ki tarah manaate the aur apni auraton ko gehne aur khoobsurat kapde pehnaate the. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Tum sirf is din roza rakho.

e: Ibn Abbas was asked about observing of fast on the day of Ashura, whereupon he said: I do not know Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) singling out any day's fast and considering it more excellent than another, except this day (the day of Ashura) and this month, meaning the month of Ramadan.
hi: Ibn Abbas se Ashura ke din roze ke baare mein poocha gaya, isper unhone kaha: Mujhe nahi pata Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kisi din ko chunkar use kisi doosre din se zyada afzal maana ho, siwaay is din, Ashura ke din, aur is mahine ke, matlab Ramzan ke mahine ke.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of 'Ubaidullah b. Abi Yazid.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Ubaidullah bin Abu Yazid ki sanad se bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Hakam b. al-'Araj reported: I went to Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be Pleased with both of them) and he was reclining using his mantle as a pillow near the fountain of Zamzam. I said to him: Tell me about fasting on Ashura. He said: When you see the new moon of Muharram then count the (days) and observe fast on the 9th. I said to him: Is it how the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed the fast? He said: Yes.
hi: Hakam bin al-Araj ne bayan kiya: Main Ibn Abbas (RA) ke paas gaya aur woh Zamzam ke chashme ke qareeb apni chadar ko takiya banaakar leta hua the. Maine unse kaha: Mujhe Ashura ke roze ke baare mein bataiye. Unhone kaha: Jab tum Muharram ka naya chaand dekho to din ginno aur nauveen tareekh ko roza rakho. Maine unse kaha: Kya Rasoolullah (SAW) ne isi tarah roza rakha? Unhone kaha: Haan.

e: Hakam b. 'Araj reported: I asked Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) as he was reclining using his cloak as a pillow near Zamzam about fasting on 'Ashura. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Hakam bin Araj ne bayan kiya: Maine Ibn Abbas (RA) se, jab woh Zamzam ke paas apna chogha takiya banaakar leta hue the, Ashura ke roze ke baare mein poocha. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) fasted on the day of 'Ashura and commanded that it should he observed as a fast, they (his Companions) said to him: Messenger of Allah, it is a day which the Jews and Christians hold in high esteem. Thereupon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When the next year comes, God willing, we would observe fast on the 9th But the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) died before the advent of the next year.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bayan kiya ki jab Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Ashura ke din roza rakha aur doosron ko bhi ise roze ke taur par rakhne ka hukum diya, to unhone, unke sahaba ne, unse kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, ye woh din hai jise Yahudi aur Isai bahut izzat dete hain. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Jab agla saal aayega, Allah chahe to, hum nauveen tareekh ko roza rakhenge. Lekin Rasoolullah (SAW) ka intiqaal agle saal aane se pehle hi ho gaya.

e: Abdullah b 'Abbas reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had said: If I live till the next (year), I would definitely observe fast on the 9th, and the narration transmitted by Abu Bakr is:" He meant the day of Ashura."
hi: Abdullah bin Abbas ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha tha: Agar main agle saal tak zinda raha, to main zaroor nauveen tareekh ko roza rakhunga, aur Abu Bakr ke zariye riwayat ki hui hadees mein hai: "Unka matlab Ashura ke din se tha."

e: Salama b. al-Akwa' (Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent a person of the tribe of Aslam on the day of 'Ashura and commanded him to declare to the people to observe fast in case they had not observed it, and to complete fast till evening if they had taken food
hi: Salama bin al-Akwa (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Aslam qabile ke ek shakhs ko Ashura ke din bheja aur unhe hukum diya ki logon ko ye ailaan karein ki agar unhone roza nahi rakha hai, to roza rakhein, aur agar unhone khaana kha liya hai, to shaam tak roza mukammal karein.

e: Rubayyi' daughter of Mu'awwidh b. 'Afra' said that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent (a person) on the morning of Ashura to the villages of Ansar around Medina (with this message): He who got up in the morning fasting (without eating anything) he should complete his fast, and he who had had his breakfast in the morning, he should complete the rest of the day (without food). The Companions said; We henceforth observed fast on it (on the day of 'Ashura) and, God willing, made our children observe that. We went to the mosque and made toys out of wool for them and when anyone felt hungry and wept for food we gave them these toys till it was the time to break the fast.
hi: Rubayyi, Mu'awwidh bin Afra ki beti, ne kaha ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Ashura ki subah Madina ke aas-paas Ansar ke gaanvon mein kisi shakhs ko bheja, is sandeshe ke saath: Jo koi subah roza rakhe hue jaage, bina kuch khaaye, use apna roza mukammal karna chahiye, aur jisne subah naashta kar liya ho, use din ka baaki hissa, bina khaane ke, mukammal karna chahiye. Sahaba ne kaha: Hum iske baad is din, yaani Ashura ke din, roza rakhte the aur, Allah chahe to, apne bacchon ko bhi ye roza rakhwaate. Hum masjid jaate aur unke liye oon se khilaune banaate aur jab koi bhookh mahsoos karta aur khaane ke liye rota to hum use ye khilaune dete jab tak roza iftaar karne ka waqt na aa jaata.

e: Khalid b. Dhakwan reported: I asked Rubayyi' daugther of Mu'awwidh about fasting on the day of 'Ashura. Thereupon she said: The Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) sent his messenger to the villages of the Ansar, and the rest of the hadith is the same (but with this variation that one of the Companions) said:" We used to make toys out of wool and took (them to the mosque) along with us. When they (the children) asked us for food, we gave them these toys to play with, and these made them forgetful till they completed their fast."
hi: Khalid bin Dhakwan ne bayan kiya: Maine Rubayyi, Mu'awwidh ki beti, se Ashura ke din roze ke baare mein poocha. Isper unhone kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne apna payaam laane wala Ansar ke gaanvon mein bheja, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai, lekin is farq ke saath ki ek sahabi ne kaha: "Hum oon se khilaune banaate aur unhe apne saath masjid le jaate. Jab woh bachche humse khaana maangte, to hum unhe ye khilaune de dete unke saath khelne ke liye, aur ye unhe bhookh se bhula dete jab tak woh apna roza mukammal na kar lete."

e: Abu Ubaid, the freed slave of Ibn Azhar, reported: I observed Id along with Umar b. al-Khattab (Allah be pleased with him). He came (out in an open space) and prayed and (after) completing it addressed the people and said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) has forbidden the observing of fast on these two days. One is the day of Fitr (at the end of your fasts), and the second one, the day when you eat (the meat) of your sacrifices.
hi: Abu Ubaid, Ibn Azhar ke aazad kiye hue ghulam, ne bayan kiya: Main Umar bin Khattab (RA) ke saath Eid manaayi. Woh bahar khule maidan mein aaye aur namaz padhi aur namaz mukammal karne ke baad logon se khitaab kiya aur kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne in do dinon mein roza rakhne se mana kiya hai. Ek Fitr ka din hai, tumhare roze ke akhir mein, aur doosra woh din hai jab tum apni qurbaaniyon ka gosht khaate ho.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade fasting on these two days. 'Id-ul-Adha and 'Id-ul-Fitr.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne in do dinon mein roza rakhne se mana kiya, Eid-ul-Adha aur Eid-ul-Fitr.

e: Qaza'a related from Abu Sa'id. He said: I heard from him (Abu Sa'id) a hadith which impressed me, and I said to him: Did you hear it from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)? Thereupon he said: (Is it possible) that (I should) say about the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that which I have not heard? I heard him saying: It is not proper to fast on two days, Adha and Fitr (at the end) of Ramadan.
hi: Qaza'a ne Abu Sa'id se riwayat ki. Unhone kaha: Maine unse, Abu Sa'id se, ek hadees suni jisne mujhe prabhaavit kiya, aur maine unse kaha: Kya aapne ise Rasoolullah (SAW) se suna hai? Isper unhone kaha: Kya ye mumkin hai ki main Rasoolullah (SAW) ke baare mein woh keh dun jo maine suna hi na ho? Maine unhe ye kehte suna: Do dinon mein roza rakhna theek nahi hai, Adha aur Fitr ke, Ramzan ke aakhir mein.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade to observe fast on two days the day of Fitr and the day of Sacrifice ('Id-ul-Adha).
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne do dinon mein roza rakhne se mana kiya, Fitr ke din aur Qurbaani ke din, Eid-ul-Adha.

e: Ziyad b. Jubair reported that a person came to Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) and said: I had taken a vow that I would fast on the day (but it accidentally) synchronises with the day of Adha or the day of Fitr. Thereupon Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with him) said: Allah, the Exalted, has commanded fulfilling of the vow, but the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) has forbidden the observance of fast on this day.
hi: Ziyad bin Jubair ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs Ibn Umar (RA) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Maine nazar maani thi ki main us din roza rakhunga lekin ye achaanak Adha ke din ya Fitr ke din se mel khaata hai. Isper Ibn Umar (RA) ne kaha: Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, ne nazar poori karne ka hukum diya hai, lekin Rasoolullah (SAW) ne is din roza rakhne se mana kiya hai.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) said that the Prophet (ﷺ) forbade to observe fast on two days-the day of Fitr and the day of Adha.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne kaha ki Nabi (SAW) ne do dinon mein roza rakhne se mana kiya - Fitr ka din aur Adha ka din.

e: Nubaisha al-Hudhali reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The days of Tashriq are the days of eating and drinking.
hi: Nubaisha al-Hudhali ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Tashriq ke din khaane aur peene ke din hain.

e: Nabaisha reported that Khalid said: I met Abu Malih and asked him and he narrated it to me from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). a hadith like one (narrated above) with this addition:" And remembrance of Allah"
hi: Nabaisha ne bayan kiya ki Khalid ne kaha: Main Abu Malih se mila aur unse poocha aur unhone mujhe ise Rasoolullah (SAW) se, upar bayan hui hadees jaisi, is izafe ke saath riwayat ki: "Aur Allah ka zikr."

e: Ibn Ka'b b. Malik reported on the authority of his father that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent him and Aus b. Hadathan during the days of Tashriq to make this announcement: None but the believer would be admitted into Paradise, and the days of Mina' are the days meant for eating and drinking.
hi: Ibn Ka'b bin Malik ne apne waalid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unhe aur Aus bin Hadathan ko Tashriq ke dinon mein ye ailaan karne bheja: Sirf momino ko Jannat mein daakhil kiya jaayega, aur Mina ke din khaane aur peene ke liye muqarrar din hain.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibrahim b. Tahman with the same chain of transmitters but with this variation that he said: Both of them made the announcement."
hi: Ye hadees Ibrahim bin Tahman ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai lekin is farq ke saath ki unhone kaha: Dono ne mil kar ailaan kiya.

e: Muhammad b. 'Abbas b. Ja'far reported: I asked Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with both of them) as he was circumambulating the House (Ka'ba) whether the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had forbidden the fasting on Friday, whereupon he said: Yes, by the Lord of this House.
hi: Muhammad bin Abbas bin Ja'far ne bayan kiya: Maine Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) se poocha jab woh Kaaba ka tawaaf kar rahe the, ki kya Rasoolullah (SAW) ne juma ke din roza rakhne se mana kiya tha, isper unhone kaha: Haan, is Ghar ke Rab ki qasam.

e: Muhammad b. 'Abbas b. Ja'far reported that he asked Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them), whether he had heard like this from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).
hi: Muhammad bin Abbas bin Ja'far ne bayan kiya ki unhone Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) se poocha, ki kya unhone ye Rasoolullah (SAW) se suna tha.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: None among you should observe fast on Friday, but only that he observes fast before it and after it.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Tum mein se koi bhi juma ke din roza na rakhe, siwaay is baat ke ki woh isse pehle aur baad mein bhi roza rakhta ho.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Do not single out the night (preceding) Friday among the nights for prayer and do not single out Friday among days for fasting but only when anyone among you is accustomed to fast (on dates) which coincide with this day (Friday).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Juma ki raat ko doosri raaton mein se khaas mat samjho namaz ke liye aur juma ke din ko doosre dinon mein se khaas mat samjho roze ke liye, siwaay is baat ke ki tum mein se koi is din, juma, se mel khaane wali tareekhon mein roza rakhne ka aadi ho.

e: Salama b. Akwa' (Allah be pleased with him) reported that when this verse was revealed: "And as for those who can fast (but do not) expiation is the feeding of a needy person" (ii. 183), (he who liked to observe fast did observe it) and he who felt reluctant to observe it ate and expiated till the verse was revealed which abrogated it.
hi: Salama bin Akwa (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab ye aayat nazil hui: "Aur jo log roza rakh sakte hain, lekin nahi rakhte, unke liye kaffara ek zaroorat-mand ko khaana khilaana hai" (2:183), jo roza rakhna chahta woh rakhta aur jise ise rakhna napasand hota woh khaata aur kaffara deta, jab tak ki woh aayat nazil hui jisne ise mansookh kiya.

e: Salama b. Akwa' reported: We, during the lifetime of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), in one month of Ramadan (observed fast according to our liking). He who wished to fast lasted and he who wished to break broke it and fed a needy person as an expiation 1544 till this verse was revealed:" He who witnesses among you the month (of Ramadan) he should observe fast during it" (ii. 184).
hi: Salama bin Akwa ne bayan kiya: Hum, Rasoolullah (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein, Ramzan ke ek mahine mein apni marzi ke mutabik roza rakhte the. Jo roza rakhna chahta usne roza rakha aur jo tod na chahta usne toda aur kaffare ke taur par ek zaroorat-mand ko khilaya, jab tak ye aayat nazil hui: "Jo tum mein se is mahine, Ramzan, ko dekhe use isme roza rakhna chahiye" (2:184).

e: Abu Salama reported: I heard 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) as saying: I had to complete some of the fasts of Ramadan, but I could not do it but during the month of Sha'ban due to my duties to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) or with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).
hi: Abu Salama ne bayan kiya: Maine Aisha (RA) ko ye kehte suna: Mujhe Ramzan ke kuch roze poore karne hote the, lekin main aisa Sha'baan ke mahine ke ilawa nahi kar paati thi, Rasoolullah (SAW) ke prati apni zimmedaariyon ki wajah se ya Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath masroof rehne ki wajah se.

e: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Yahya b. Sa'id with the same chain of transmitters but with this variation that he said that ('A'isha did not observe fast but in Sha'ban) out of regard for the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).
hi: Ye hadees Yahya bin Sa'id ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai lekin is farq ke saath ki unhone kaha ki Aisha ne Sha'baan mein hi roza rakha tha, Rasoolullah (SAW) ke prati izzat ki wajah se.

e: In another version of the previous hadith, the words are: " Yahya said: I think it was due to the regard for the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)."
hi: Pichhli hadees ki ek doosri riwayat mein, alfaaz hain: "Yahya ne kaha: Mera khayal hai ki ye Rasoolullah (SAW) ke prati izzat ki wajah se thi."

e: This hadith is reported on the authority of Yahya with the same chain of transmitters but no mention is made of the duty to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).
hi: Ye hadees Yahya ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai lekin isme Rasoolullah (SAW) ke prati zimmedaari ka koi zikr nahi kiya gaya.

e: 'A'isha reported: If one amongst us had to break fasts (of Ramadan due to natural reasons, i. e. menses) during the life of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) she could not find it possible to complete them so long she had been in the presence of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) till Sha'ban commenced.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya: Agar hum mein se kisi ko Rasoolullah (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein Ramzan ke roze todne padte the, praakritik karano ki wajah se, yaani haiz, to woh unhe poora karna mumkin nahi paati thi jab tak woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki maujoodgi mein hoti, yahan tak ki Sha'baan shuru ho jaata.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If anyone dies in a state (that he had to complete) some fasts, his heir must fast on his behalf.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Agar koi is haalat mein intiqaal kare ki usse kuch roze poore karne baaki hon, to uske waaris ko uski taraf se roza rakhna chahiye.

e: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with both of them) reported: A woman came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: My mother has died, and fasts of a month are due from her. Thereupon he said: Don't you see that if debt was due from her, would you not pay it? She said: Yes (I would pay on her behalf). Thereupon he said: The debt of Allah deserves its payment more than (the payment of anyone else).
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Ek aurat Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha: Meri maa ka intiqaal ho gaya hai, aur unpar ek mahine ke roze baaki hain. Isper unhone kaha: Kya tumhe nahi lagta ki agar unpar koi qarz hota, to kya tum use ada nahi karti? Unhone kaha: Haan, main unki taraf se ada karti. Isper unhone kaha: Allah ka qarz iski adaayagi ka sabse zyada haqdaar hai.

e: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported: A man came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: Messenger of Allah, my mother has died (in a state) that she had to observe fasts of a month (of Ramadan). Should I complete (them) on her behalf? thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Would you not pay the debt if your mother had died (without paying it)? He said: Yes. He (the Holy Prophet) said: The debt of Allah deserves more that it should he paid.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Ek shakhs Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, meri maa ka intiqaal is haalat mein hua ki unhe Ramzan ke ek mahine ke roze rakhne the. Kya main unki taraf se poore karun? Isper unhone kaha: Kya tum qarz ada nahi karte agar tumhari maa ka intiqaal, bina use ada kiye, ho jaata? Unhone kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha: Allah ka qarz iske ada hone ka sabse zyada haqdaar hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Abbas (RA) ki sanad se Rasoolullah (SAW) se bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported: A woman came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: Messenger of Allah, my mother has died and there is due from her a fast of vow; should I fast on her behalf? Thereupon he said: You see that if your mother had died in debt, would it not have been paid on her behalf? She said: Yes. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Then observe fast on behalf of your mother.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Ek aurat Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, meri maa ka intiqaal ho gaya hai aur unpar ek nazar ka roza baaki hai; kya main unki taraf se roza rakhun? Isper unhone kaha: Tum dekhti ho ki agar tumhari maa qarz mein marti, to kya woh unki taraf se ada nahi kiya jaata? Unhone kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha: To apni maa ki taraf se roza rakho.

e: Abdullah b. Buraida (Allah be pleased with him) reported on the authority of his father: When we were sitting with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), a woman came to him and said: I had gifted to my mother a maid-servant, and now she (the mother) has died. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: There is a definite reward for you and she (the maid-servant) has been returned to you as an inheritance. She (that woman) again said: Fasts of a month (of Ramadan) are due upon her; should I observe them on her behalf? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Observe fasts on her behalf. She (again) said: She did not perform Hajj, should I perform it on her behalf? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Perform Hajj on her behalf.
hi: Abdullah bin Buraida (RA) ne apne waalid ke hawale se riwayat ki: Jab hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath baithe the, ek aurat unke paas aayi aur kaha: Maine apni maa ko ek laundi tohfe mein di thi, aur ab unka intiqaal ho gaya hai. Isper unhone kaha: Tumhare liye ek pakka sawaab hai aur woh laundi tumhe virasat mein wapas mil gayi hai. Usne phir kaha: Unpar ek mahine, Ramzan, ke roze baaki hain; kya main unki taraf se ye rakhun? Unhone kaha: Unki taraf se roza rakho. Usne dobara kaha: Unhone Hajj nahi kiya, kya main unki taraf se karun? Unhone kaha: Unki taraf se Hajj karo.

e: 'Abdullah b. Buraida (Allah be pleased with him) reported on the authority of his father: I was sitting with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ; the rest of the hadith is the same but with this variation that the (the narrator) said:" Fasts of two months."
hi: Abdullah bin Buraida (RA) ne apne waalid ke hawale se riwayat ki: Main Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath baitha tha; baaki hadees waisi hi hai lekin is farq ke saath ki raawi ne kaha: "Do mahine ke roze."

e: Ibn Buraida (Allah be pleased with him) reported on the authority of his father: A woman came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and the rest of the hadith is the same, but he said:" Fasting of one month."
hi: Ibn Buraida (RA) ne apne waalid ke hawale se riwayat ki: Ek aurat Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aayi, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai, lekin unhone kaha: "Ek mahine ka roza."

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Sufyan with the same chain of transmitters in which it is said: " Fasting of two months."
hi: Ye hadees Sufyan ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai jismein kaha gaya hai: "Do mahine ke roze."

e: Buraida (Allah be pleased with him) reported a similar hadith on the authority of his father that a woman came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he said: " Fasting for one month."
hi: Buraida (RA) ne apne waalid ke hawale se isi tarah ki ek hadees riwayat ki ki ek aurat Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aayi aur unhone kaha: "Ek mahine ke roze."

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: If any one of you is invited to a meal when he is fasting, he should say:" I am fasting."
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Agar tum mein se kisi ko khaane ki dawat di jaaye jabki woh roza rakhe hue ho, to use kehna chahiye: "Main roza rakhe hue hoon."

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported: When any one of you gets up in the morning in the state of fasting, he should neither use obscene language nor do any act of ignorance. And if anyone slanders him or quarrels with him, he should say:" I am fasting, I am fasting."
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Jab tum mein se koi roze ki halat mein subah utthe, to use na koi ashleel baat karni chahiye na hi koi jaahiliyat ka amal karna chahiye. Aur agar koi uski bura-bhala kahe ya usse jhagda kare, to use kehna chahiye: "Main roza rakhe hue hoon, main roza rakhe hue hoon."

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Allah, the Majestic and the Exalted, said: Every act of the son of Adam is for him except fasting. It is done for My sake, and I will give a reward for it. By Allah in Whose Hand is the life of Muhammad, the breath of the observer of fast is sweeter to Allah than the fragrance of musk.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Allah, jo Azeem-o-Buland hai, ne farmaya: Aadam ke bete ka har amal uske liye hai siwaay roze ke. Ye Mere liye kiya jaata hai, aur Main iska sawaab dunga. Us Zaat ki qasam jiske Haath mein Muhammad ki zindagi hai, roza rakhne wale ki saans Allah ke nazdeek mushk ki khushboo se bhi zyada meethi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Fasting is a shield.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Roza ek dhaal hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Allah the Exalted and Majestic said: Every act of the son of Adam is for him, except fasting. It is (exclusively) meant for Me and I (alone) will reward it. Fasting is a shield. When any one of you is fasting on a day, he should neither indulge in obscene language, nor raise the voice; or if anyone reviles him or tries to quarrel with him he should say: I am a person fasting. By Him, in Whose Hand is the life of Muhammad, the breath of the observer of fast is sweeter to Allah on the Day of judgment than the fragrance of musk. The one who fasts has two (occasions) of joy, one when he breaks the fast he is glad with the breaking of (the fast) and one when he meets his Lord he is glad with his fast.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, ne farmaya: Aadam ke bete ka har amal uske liye hai, siwaay roze ke. Ye khaas taur par mere liye hai aur main akela iska sawaab dunga. Roza ek dhaal hai. Jab tum mein se koi ek din roza rakhta hai, to use na ashleel baat karni chahiye, na hi aawaaz uthaani chahiye; aur agar koi uski bura-bhala kahe ya usse jhagda karne ki koshish kare to use kehna chahiye: Main roza rakhne wala shakhs hoon. Us Zaat ki qasam jiske Haath mein Muhammad ki zindagi hai, roza rakhne wale ki saans Qayamat ke din Allah ke nazdeek mushk ki khushboo se bhi zyada meethi hai. Roza rakhne wale ke liye do khushi ke mauqe hain, ek jab woh roza todta hai woh roza todne par khush hota hai, aur ek jab woh apne Rab se milta hai to apne roze ke saath khush hota hai.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Every (good) deed of the son of Adam would be multiplied, a good deed receiving a tenfold to seven hundredfold reward. Allah, the Exalted and Majestic, has said: With the exception of fasting, for it is done for Me and I will give a reward for it, for one abandons his passion and food for My sake. There are two occasions of joy for one who fasts, joy when he breaks it, and joy when he meets his Lord, and the breath (of an observer of fast) is sweeter to Allah than the fragrance of musk.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Aadam ke bete ka har achha amal badhaaya jaayega, ek achhe amal ko das guna se lekar sat sau guna tak ka sawaab milega. Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, ne farmaya: Roze ke ilawa, kyunki ye mere liye kiya jaata hai aur main iska sawaab dunga, kyunki roza rakhne wala apni khwahish aur khaana mere liye chhodta hai. Roza rakhne wale ke liye do khushi ke mauqe hain, ek khushi jab woh ise todta hai, aur ek khushi jab woh apne Rab se milta hai, aur roza rakhne wale ki saans Allah ke nazdeek mushk ki khushboo se bhi zyada meethi hai.

e: Abu Huraira and Abu Sa'id (Allah be pleased with both of them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (as saying): Allah, the Exalted and Majestic, said: Fast (is exclusively) meant for Me and I would give its reward. There are two (occasions) of joy for the observer of fast. He feels joy when he breaks the fast and he is happy when he meets Allah. By Allah in Whose Hand is the life of Muhammad, the breath of the observer of fast is sweeter to Allah than the fragrance of musk.
hi: Abu Huraira aur Abu Sa'id (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, ne farmaya: Roza khaas taur par mere liye hai aur main iska sawaab dunga. Roza rakhne wale ke liye do khushi ke mauqe hain. Woh khushi mehsoos karta hai jab woh roza todta hai aur woh khush hota hai jab woh Allah se milta hai. Us Zaat ki qasam jiske Haath mein Muhammad ki zindagi hai, roza rakhne wale ki saans Allah ke nazdeek mushk ki khushboo se bhi zyada meethi hai.

e: A hadith like this is narrated on the authority of Abu Sinan with the same chain of transmitters (and the words are): " As he meets Allah, He rewards him, and he is happy."
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Abu Sinan ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai, aur alfaaz hain: "Jab woh Allah se milta hai, Woh use sawaab deta hai, aur woh khush hota hai."

e: Sahl b. Sa'd (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: In Paradise there is a gate which is called Rayyan through which only the people who fast would enter on the Day on Resurrection. None else would enter along with them. It would be proclaimed: Where are the people who fast that they should be admitted into it? And when the last of them would enter, it would be closed and no one would enter it.
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jannat mein ek darwaza hai jise Rayyan kaha jaata hai jismein se sirf roza rakhne wale log Qayamat ke din daakhil honge. Koi aur unke saath daakhil nahi hoga. Ailaan kiya jaayega: Roza rakhne wale kahan hain ki unhe ismein daakhil kiya jaaye? Aur jab unmein se aakhri shakhs daakhil ho jaayega, to ise band kar diya jaayega aur koi aur ismein daakhil nahi hoga.

e: Abu Sa'id al Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Every servant of Allah who observes fast for a day in the way of Allah, Allah would remove, because of this day, his face farther from the Fire (of Hell) to the extent of seventy years' distance.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Allah ka har banda jo Allah ki raah mein ek din roza rakhta hai, Allah, is din ki wajah se, uske chehre ko jahannam ki aag se sattar saal ki doori jitna door kar dega.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Suhail with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Suhail ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who observes fast for a day in the way of Allah He would remove his face from the Hell to the extent of seventy years' distance.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo Allah ki raah mein ek din roza rakhta hai, Woh uske chehre ko jahannam se sattar saal ki doori jitna door kar dega.

e: 'A'isha, the Mother of the Believers (Allah be pleased with her), reported that one day the Messenger of Allah may peace be upon him) said to me: 'A'isha, have you anything (to eat)? I said: 'Messenger of Allah, there is nothing with us. Thereupon he said: I am observing fast. She said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went out, and there was a present, for us and (at the same time) some visitors dropped in. When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came back, I said to him: Messenger of Allah, a present was given to us, (and in the meanwhile) there came to us visitors (a major Portion of it has been spent on them), but I have saved something for you. He said: What is it? I said: It is hais (a compound of dates and clarified butter). He said: Bring that. So I brought it to him and he ate it and then said: I woke up in the morning observing fast. Talha said: I narrated this hadith to Mujahid and he said: This (observing of voluntary fast) is like a person who sets apart Sadaqa out of his wealth. He may spend it if he likes, or he may retain it if he so likes.
hi: Aisha, Ummul-Momineen (RA), ne bayan kiya ki ek din Rasoolullah (SAW) ne mujhse kaha: Aisha, kya tumhare paas khaane ko kuch hai? Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, hamare paas kuch nahi hai. Isper unhone kaha: To main roza rakhe hue hoon. Unhone kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) bahar gaye, aur hamare liye ek tohfa aaya aur isi waqt kuch mehmaan bhi aa gaye. Jab Rasoolullah (SAW) wapas aaye, to maine unse kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, hamein ek tohfa diya gaya, aur isi dauran hamare paas mehmaan aaye, jinpar iska zyada hissa kharch ho gaya, lekin maine aapke liye kuch bacha ke rakha hai. Unhone kaha: Ye kya hai? Maine kaha: Ye hais, khajoor aur ghee ka mishran, hai. Unhone kaha: Use laao. To main use unke paas laayi aur unhone use khaya aur phir kaha: Main subah roza rakhe hue jaagi thi. Talha ne kaha: Maine ye hadees Mujahid ko bayan ki aur unhone kaha: Ye, nafil roza rakhna, us shakhs jaisa hai jo apni daulat mein se Sadaqa alag rakhta hai. Woh agar chahe to ise kharch kar sakta hai, ya agar chahe to ise rakh sakta hai.

e: 'A'isha, the Mother of the Believers (Allah be pleased with her), reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) came to me one day and said: Is there anything with you (to eat)? I said: No. Thereupon he said: I shall then be fasting. Then he came to us another day and we said: Messenger of Allah, hais has been offered to us as a gift. Thereupon he said: Show that to me; I had been fasting since morning. He then ate it.
hi: Aisha, Ummul-Momineen (RA), ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek din mere paas aaye aur kaha: Kya tumhare paas khaane ko kuch hai? Maine kaha: Nahi. Isper unhone kaha: To main roza rakhunga. Woh phir doosre din hamare paas aaye aur humne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, hais humein tohfe mein diya gaya hai. Isper unhone kaha: Mujhe woh dikhao; main subah se roza rakhe hue hoon. Unhone phir use khaya.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If anyone forgets that he is fasting and eats or drinks he should complete his fast, for it is only Allah Who has fed him and given him drink.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Agar koi bhool jaaye ki woh roza rakhe hue hai aur khaana ya paani le le, to use apna roza mukammal karna chahiye, kyunki Allah hi hai jisne use khilaaya aur pilaaya.

e: Abdullah b. Shaqiq reported: I said to'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her): Did the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) fast for a full month besides Ramadan? She said: I do not know of any month in which he fasted throughout, but that of the month of Ramadan and (the month) in which he did not fast at all, till he ran the course of his life.
hi: Abdullah bin Shaqiq ne bayan kiya: Maine Aisha (RA) se kaha: Kya Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Ramzan ke ilawa kabhi poora mahina roza rakha? Unhone kaha: Mujhe koi aisa mahina yaad nahi jismein unhone poora roza rakha ho, siwaay Ramzan ke mahine ke, aur koi aisa mahina bhi nahi jismein unhone bilkul roza na rakha ho, yahan tak ki unki zindagi khatam ho gayi.

e: 'Abdullah b. Shaqiq reported: I said to 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her): Did the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observe fast during a month? She said, I do not know of any month in which he fasted throughout except Ramadan and (the month) in which he did not fast at all till he ran the course of his life. May peace be upon him.
hi: Abdullah bin Shaqiq ne bayan kiya: Maine Aisha (RA) se kaha: Kya Rasoolullah (SAW) kisi mahine mein roza rakhte the? Unhone kaha, Mujhe koi aisa mahina yaad nahi jismein unhone poora roza rakha ho siwaay Ramzan ke, aur koi aisa mahina bhi nahi jismein unhone bilkul roza na rakha ho, yahan tak ki unki zindagi khatam ho gayi.

e: Abdullah b. Shaqiq reported. I asked 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) about fasting of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). She said: He used to observe fast (at times) so continuously that we said: He has fasted, he has fasted. And (at times) he did not observe fast (for days) and we began to say: He has abandoned fasting, he has abandoned fasting. She said: I did not see him observing fast throughout the whole of the month since he arrived in Medina, but that of Ramadan.
hi: Abdullah bin Shaqiq ne bayan kiya. Maine Aisha (RA) se Rasoolullah (SAW) ke roze ke baare mein poocha. Unhone kaha: Woh kabhi kabhi itni lagataar roza rakhte ki hum kehte: Unhone roza rakh liya hai, unhone roza rakh liya hai. Aur kabhi kabhi woh kayi dinon tak roza nahi rakhte aur hum kehne lagte: Unhone roza chhod diya hai, unhone roza chhod diya hai. Unhone kaha: Maine unhe Madina pahunchne ke baad kabhi poore mahine roza rakhte nahi dekha, siwaay Ramzan ke.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Abdullah b. Shaqiq but in the chain of transmitters no mention is made of Hisham and Muhammad.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Abdullah bin Shaqiq ki sanad se bayan ki gayi hai lekin raawiyon ki sanad mein Hisham aur Muhammad ka koi zikr nahi kiya gaya.

e: 'A'isha, the Mother of the Believers (Allah be pleased with her), reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to fast (so continuously) that we said that he would not break, and did not fast at all till we said that he would not fast. And I did not see the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) completing the fast of a month, but that of Ramadan, and I did not see him fasting more in any other month than that of Sha'ban.
hi: Aisha, Ummul-Momineen (RA), ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) itna lagataar roza rakhte ki hum kehte ki woh roza nahi todenge, aur bilkul roza nahi rakhte yahan tak ki hum kehne lagte ki woh roza nahi rakhenge. Aur maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko kabhi poore mahine ka roza mukammal karte nahi dekha, siwaay Ramzan ke, aur maine unhe kisi doosre mahine mein Sha'baan se zyada roza rakhte nahi dekha.

e: Abu Salama reported: I asked 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) about the fasting of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). She said: He used to observe fast (at times so continuously) that we said: He has fasted (never to break), and he did not observe fast till we said: He has given up perhaps never to fast, and I never saw him observing (voluntary fasts) more in any other month than that of Sha'ban. (lt appeared as if) he observed fast throughout the whole of Sha'ban except a few (days).
hi: Abu Salama ne bayan kiya: Maine Aisha (RA) se Rasoolullah (SAW) ke roze ke baare mein poocha. Unhone kaha: Woh itna, kabhi kabhi lagataar, roza rakhte ki hum kehte: Unhone roza rakha hai, kabhi na todne ke liye, aur woh roza nahi rakhte yahan tak ki hum kehte: Unhone chhod diya hai, shayad kabhi roza na rakhein, aur maine unhe kisi doosre mahine mein Sha'baan se zyada nafil roza rakhte nahi dekha. Aisa lagta tha ki unhone poora Sha'baan roza rakha siwaay kuch dinon ke.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not observe fast in any month of the year more than in the month of Sha'ban, and used to say: Do as many deeds as you are capable of doing, for Allah will not become weary (of giving you reward), but you would be tired (of doing good deeds) ; and he also said: The deed liked most by Allah is one to which the doer adheres constantly even if it is small.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne saal ke kisi bhi mahine mein Sha'baan ke mahine se zyada roza nahi rakha, aur woh kaha karte the: Utne hi amal karo jitne tum kar sakte ho, kyunki Allah kabhi thakega nahi tumhe sawaab dete-dete, lekin tum achhe amal karte-karte thak jaoge; aur unhone ye bhi kaha: Allah ko sabse pasand aane wala amal woh hai jisse karne wala musalsal karta rahe, chahe woh chhota hi kyun na ho.

e: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with both of them) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not fast throughout any month except during ramadan. And when he observed fast (he fasted so continuously) that one would say that he would not break (them) and when he Abandoned, he abandoned (so continuously) that one would say: By Allah, perhaps he would never fast.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Ramzan ke ilawa kisi mahine poora roza nahi rakha. Aur jab unhone roza rakha to itna lagataar rakha ki koi kehta ki woh isse todenge nahi, aur jab unhone roza chhoda, to itna lagataar chhoda ki koi kehta: Allah ki qasam, shayad woh kabhi roza na rakhein.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Bishr with the same chain of transmitters (with a slight variation of words and these are), that he (the narrator) said: " During any month continuously since he came to Medina."
hi: Ye hadees Abu Bishr ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai, alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath, aur ye hain, ki unhone kaha: "Kisi bhi mahine lagataar jab se woh Madina aaye."

e: 'Uthman b. Hakim al-Ansari said: I asked Sa'id b. Jubair about fasting In Rajab, and we were then passing through the month of Rajab, whereupon he said: I heard Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with both of them) as saying: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to observe fast (so continuously) that we (were inclined) to say that he would not break (them) and did not observe them so conti- nuously) that we (were inclined to say) that he would not observe fast.
hi: Uthman bin Hakim al-Ansari ne kaha: Maine Sa'id bin Jubair se Rajab mein roze ke baare mein poocha, aur hum us waqt Rajab ke mahine se guzar rahe the, isper unhone kaha: Maine Ibn Abbas (RA) ko ye kehte suna: Rasoolullah (SAW) itna lagataar roza rakhte ki hum kehna chahte ki woh ise todenge nahi, aur itna lagataar roza nahi rakhte ki hum kehna chahte ki woh roza nahi rakhenge.

e: The same hadith as the previous hadith has been transmitted through another chain.
hi: Isi hadees jaisi ek hadees ek doosri sanad se bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Anas (Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to observe fast till it was said that he had observed fast, he had observed fast (perhaps never to break it), and he did not fast till it was said that he had given up fast, he had given up fast (perhaps never to observe it).
hi: Anas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) itna roza rakhte ki kaha jaata ki unhone roza rakha hai, unhone roza rakha hai, shayad kabhi na tode, aur woh itna roza nahi rakhte ki kaha jaata ki unhone roza chhod diya hai, unhone roza chhod diya hai, shayad kabhi na rakhe.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Amr b. al-'As reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was informed that he could stand up for (prayer) throughout the night and observe fast every day so long as he lived. Thereupon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Is it you who said this? I said to him: Messenger of Allah, it is I who said that. Thereupon the Messenger of Allah may peace be upon him) said: You are not capable enough to do so. Observe fast and break it; sleep and stand for prayer, and observe fast for three days during the month; for every good is multiplied ten times and this is like fasting for ever. I said: Messenger of Allah. I am capable of doing more than this. Thereupon he said: Fast one day and do not fast for the next two days. I said: Messenger of Allah, I have the strength to do more than that. The Prophet (ﷺ), said: Fast one day and break on the other day. That is known as the fasting of David (peace be upon him) and that is the best fasting. I said: I am capable of doing more than this. Thereupon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: There is nothing better than this. 'Abdullah b. 'Amr (Allah be pleased with them) said: Had I accepted the three days (fasting during every month) as the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had said, it would have been more dear to me than my family and my property.
hi: Abdullah bin Amr bin al-As (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ko bataya gaya ki woh poori raat, namaz mein, khada rehte hain aur jab tak zinda hain roz roza rakhte hain. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Kya tumne ye kaha? Maine unse kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, main hi hoon jisne ye kaha. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Tum aisa karne ki taaqat nahi rakhte.
