Roza rakho aur ise todo; so jao aur namaz ke liye khade ho jao, aur mahine mein teen din roza rakho; kyunki har achhaai das guna badh jaati hai aur ye hamesha ke roze ki tarah hai. Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, main isse zyada karne ki taaqat rakhta hoon. Isper unhone kaha: Ek din roza rakho aur agle do din roza mat rakho. Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, mujhe isse zyada karne ki taaqat hai. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Ek din roza rakho aur doosre din todo. Ye Dawood (AS) ka roza kehlaata hai aur ye sabse behtareen roza hai. Maine kaha: Mujhe isse zyada karne ki taaqat hai. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Isse behtar kuch nahi hai. Abdullah bin Amr (RA) ne kaha: Kaash maine har mahine teen din ka roza rakhna qubool kar liya hota jaisa Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha tha, ye mujhe mere gharwalon aur mera maal se bhi zyada aziz hota.

e: Yahya reported: I and 'Abdullah b. Yazid set out till we came to Abu Salama. We sent a messenger to him (in his house in order to inform him about our arrival) and he came to us. There was a mosque near the door of his house, and we were in that mosque, till he came out to us. He said: If you like you may enter (the house) and, if you like, you may sit here (in the mosque). We said: We would rather sit here and (you) relate to us. He (Yahya) then narrated that 'Abdullah b Amr b. al-'As (Allah be pleased with them) told him: I used to observe fast uninterruptedly and recited the (whole of the) Qur'an every night. It (the uninterrupted fasting and recital of the Qur'an every night) was mentioned to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) or he sent for me, and I went to him and he said to me: I have been informed that you fast continuously and recite (the whole of the Qur'an) every night. I said: Apostle of Allah, it is right, but I covet thereby nothing but good, whereupon he said: It suffices for you that you should observe fast for three days during every month. I said: Apostle of Allah, I am capable of doing more than this. He said: Your wife has a right upon you, your visitor has a right upon you, your body has a right upon you; so observe the fast of David, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), for he was the best worshipper of Allah. I said: Apostle of Allah, what is the fast of David? He said: He used to fast one day and did not fast the other day. He (also) said: Recite the Qur'an during every month. I said: Apostle of Allah, I am capable of doing more than this, whereupon he said: Recite it in twenty days; recite it in ten days. I said: I am capable of doing more than this, whereupon he said: Recite it every week, and do not exceed beyond this, for your wife has a right upon you, your visitor has a right upon you, your body has a right upon you. He ('Amr b. 'As) said: I was hard to myself and thus I was put to hardship. The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) had told me: 'You do not know you may live long (thus and bear the hardships for a long time), and I accepted that which the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had told me. When I grew old I wished I had availed myself of the concession (granted by) the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).
hi: Yahya ne bayan kiya: Main aur Abdullah bin Yazid nikle yahan tak ki hum Abu Salama ke paas pahunche. Humne unke paas ek payaam laane wala bheja, unke ghar mein hamare aane ke baare mein bataane ke liye, aur woh hamare paas aaye. Unke ghar ke darwaze ke qareeb ek masjid thi, aur hum us masjid mein the, jab tak woh hamare paas bahar nahi aaye. Unhone kaha: Agar tum chaho to andar aa sakte ho, aur agar tum chaho to yahan, masjid mein, baith sakte ho. Humne kaha: Hum yahin baithenge aur aap hamein sunaaiye. Unhone phir riwayat ki ki Abdullah bin Amr bin al-As (RA) ne unhe bataya: Main lagataar roza rakha karta tha aur har raat poora Quran padhta tha. Iska, lagataar roza aur har raat Quran ki tilawat ka, zikr Rasoolullah (SAW) se kiya gaya ya unhone mujhe bulaaya, aur main unke paas gaya aur unhone mujhse kaha: Mujhe bataaya gaya hai ki tum lagataar roza rakhte ho aur har raat poora Quran padhte ho. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ye sahi hai, lekin ismein mera iraada sirf achhaai hai, isper unhone kaha: Tumhare liye kaafi hai ki tum har mahine mein teen din roza rakho. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mujhe isse zyada karne ki taaqat hai. Unhone kaha: Tumhari biwi ka tumpar haq hai, tumhare mehmaan ka tumpar haq hai, tumhare badan ka tumpar haq hai; is liye Dawood ka roza rakho, Allah ke Rasool (SAW), kyunki woh Allah ke sabse behtareen ibadat karne wale the. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Dawood ka roza kya hai? Unhone kaha: Woh ek din roza rakhte the aur doosre din nahi rakhte the. Unhone ye bhi kaha: Har mahine mein Quran padho. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mujhe isse zyada karne ki taaqat hai, isper unhone kaha: Ise bees dinon mein padho; ise das dinon mein padho. Maine kaha: Mujhe isse zyada karne ki taaqat hai, isper unhone kaha: Ise har hafte padho, aur isse aage mat badho, kyunki tumhari biwi ka tumpar haq hai, tumhare mehmaan ka tumpar haq hai, tumhare badan ka tumpar haq hai. Unhone kaha: Main apne aap se sakht tha aur is tarah mujhe mushkil mein daala gaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse kaha tha: 'Tumhe nahi pata tum lambi umar jee sakte ho, aisa hi aur isi tarah lambe waqt tak mushkilein bardaasht kar sakte ho,' aur maine woh qubool kiya jo Rasoolullah (SAW) ne mujhse kaha tha. Jab main boodha ho gaya to maine chaha ki kaash maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ki di hui chhoot ka faayda utha liya hota.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Yahya b. Abu Kathir with the same chain of transmitters and he made this addition after these words: During every month, (fasting) for three days, there is for you ten times for every good and that is perpetual fasting (for three days would bring a reward for full thirty days). I said: What is the fast of the Messenger of Allah, David? He said: Half of the age (observing fast on alternate days for the whole life). And in the hadith no mention has been made of the recital of the Qur'an, and he did not say: Your visitor has a right upon you, but (instead) he said: Your son has a right upon you.
hi: Ye hadees Yahya bin Abu Kathir ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai aur unhone in alfaazon ke baad ye izafa kiya: Har mahine mein, teen din, ke liye tumhe har achhaai ka das guna milta hai aur ye hamesha ke roze jaisa hai, kyunki teen din har mahine poore tees dinon ke barabar sawaab laayenge. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Dawood ka roza kya hai? Unhone kaha: Aadhi zindagi, ek din chhodkar poori zindagi roza rakhna. Aur is hadees mein Quran ki tilawat ka koi zikr nahi kiya gaya, aur unhone ye nahi kaha: Tumhare mehmaan ka tumpar haq hai, balki iske badle unhone kaha: Tumhare bete ka tumpar haq hai.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Amr (Allah be pleased with them) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me: Recite the whole of the Qur'An during every month. I said: I find power (to recite it) in a shorter period. He said: Then recite it in twenty nights. I said: I find power (to recite it in a shorter period even than this), whereupon he said: Then recite it in seven (nights) and do not exceed beyond it.
hi: Abdullah bin Amr (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne mujhse kaha: Har mahine poora Quran padho. Maine kaha: Mujhe isse chhote arse mein padhne ki taaqat mehsoos hoti hai. Unhone kaha: To ise bees raaton mein padho. Maine kaha: Mujhe taaqat mehsoos hoti hai isse bhi chhote arse mein padhne ki, isper unhone kaha: To ise saat raaton mein padho aur isse aage mat badho.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Amr b. al-'As (Allah be pleased with them) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Abdullah, don't be like so and so who observed prayer during the whole night and then abandoned it (altogether).
hi: Abdullah bin Amr bin al-As (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Abdullah, falan-falan ki tarah mat bano jinhone poori raat namaz padhi aur phir use bilkul hi chhod diya.

e: Abdu'llah b. 'Amr b. 'As (Allah be pleased with them) reported: It was conveyed to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that I observe fast successively and pray during the whole night. He sent for me or I met him and he (the Holy Prophet) said: It has been conveyed to me that you observe fast continuously and do not break it and pray during the whole night. Don't do that. for there is share for your eyes, share for your own self, share for your family; so observe fast and break it, pray and sleep and observe fast for one day during the ten days, and there is a reward for you (for other) nine (days besides the tenth day of the fast). I said: Apostle of Allah, I find myself more powerful than this. He said: Then observe the fast of David (peace be upon him). He ('Amr) said: Apostle of Allah, how did David observe fast? He (the Holy Prophet) said: He used to fast one day and break it on the other day, and he did not run (from the battlefield) as he encountered (the enemy). He said: Apostle of Allah, who can guarantee this for me (will I also encounter the enemy dauntlessly)? 'Ata', the narrator of the hadith, said: I do not know how there (crept in) the matter of perpetual fast. The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ), however, said: He who observed perpetual fast did not fast at all; he who observed perpetual fast did not fast at all, he who observed perpetual fast did not fast at all.
hi: Abdullah bin Amr bin al-As (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) tak khabar pahunchi ki main lagataar roza rakhta hoon aur poori raat namaz padhta hoon. Unhone mujhe bulwaaya ya main unse mila aur unhone kaha: Mujhe bataaya gaya hai ki tum lagataar roza rakhte ho aur ise todte nahi ho, aur poori raat namaz padhte ho. Aisa mat karo, kyunki tumhari aankhon ka haq hai, tumhari khud ki zaat ka haq hai, tumhare gharwalon ka haq hai; is liye roza rakho aur ise todo, namaz padho aur so jao, aur das dinon mein se ek din roza rakho, aur baaki nau dinon ka sawaab, dus din ke roze ki tarah, tumhe milega. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, main khud ko isse zyada taaqatvar paata hoon. Unhone kaha: To Dawood (AS) ka roza rakho. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Dawood ne kaise roza rakha? Unhone kaha: Woh ek din roza rakhte the aur doosre din todte the, aur woh, jung ke maidan mein, dushman ka saamna karte hue kabhi peeche nahi hatte the. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, isse kaun mujhe zamanat de sakta hai ki main bhi dushman ka saamna itni bahaduri se karunga? Ata, hadees ke raawi, ne kaha: Mujhe nahi pata lagataar roze ka mudda kaise baat mein aa gaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne, halaanki, kaha: Jisne lagataar roza rakha usne koi roza nahi rakha; jisne lagataar roza rakha usne koi roza nahi rakha; jisne lagataar roza rakha usne koi roza nahi rakha.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Ibn Juraij with the same chain of transmitters. Imam Muslim has narrated this hadith on the authority of Abu 'Abbas al-Sa'ib b. Farrukh and he was a trustworthy and reliable (narrator) among the people of Mecca.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Juraij ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai. Imam Muslim ne ye hadees Abu Abbas al-Sa'ib bin Farrukh ki sanad se bayan ki hai aur woh Makkah walon mein ek bharosemand aur qaabil-e-etemaad raawi the.

e: Abdullah b. Amr (Allah be pleased with both of them) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me: 'Abdullah b. Amr, you fast continuously and stand in prayer for the whole of night. If you do like that, your eyes would be highly strained and would sink and lose sight. There is no (reward for) fasting (for him) who fasts perpetually. Fasting for three days during the month is like fasting, the whole of the month. I said: I am capable of doing more than this, whereupon he said: Observe the fast of David. He used to fast one day and break (the other) day. And he did not turn back in the encounter.
hi: Abdullah bin Amr (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne mujhse kaha: Abdullah bin Amr, tum lagataar roza rakhte ho aur poori raat namaz mein khade rehte ho. Agar tum aisa karte rahoge, to tumhari aankhein bahut zyada dabaav mein aa jaayengi aur dhaans jaayengi aur unki roshni chali jaayegi. Us shakhs ke liye koi sawaab nahi hai jo lagataar roza rakhta hai. Mahine mein teen din roza rakhna poore mahine roza rakhne jaisa hai. Maine kaha: Mujhe isse zyada karne ki taaqat hai, isper unhone kaha: Dawood (AS) ka roza rakho. Woh ek din roza rakhte the aur doosre din todte the. Aur woh, jung mein, peeche nahi hatte the.

e: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Habib b. Abu Thabit with the same chain of transmitters and he said: " And you would become exhausted."
hi: Ye hadees Habib bin Abu Thabit ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai aur unhone kaha: "Aur tum thak jaoge."

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Amr (Allah be pleased with both of them) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me: I have been informed that you stand for prayer the whole of night and fast during the day. I said: I do that, whereupon he said: If you did that you in fact strained heavily your eyes and made yourself weak. There is a right of your eyes (upon you) and a right of your self (upon you) and a right of your family (upon you). Stand for prayer and sleep. observe fasts and break (them).
hi: Abdullah bin Amr (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne mujhse kaha: Mujhe bataaya gaya hai ki tum poori raat namaz mein khade rehte ho aur din mein roza rakhte ho. Maine kaha: Main aisa karta hoon, isper unhone kaha: Agar tum aisa karte ho to dar-asal tum apni aankhon par bahut zyada zor daal rahe ho aur khud ko kamzor bana rahe ho. Tumhari aankhon ka ek haq hai tum par, aur tumhari khud ki zaat ka ek haq hai tum par, aur tumhare gharwalon ka ek haq hai tum par. Namaz ke liye khade ho aur so jao. Roza rakho aur ise todo bhi.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Amr (Allah be pleased with both of them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: With Allah the best fasting is that of David and the best prayer is that of David (peace be upon him) for he slept half of the night and stood for prayer for the third of it and (then) slept the sixth part of it and he observed fast one day and broke on the other.
hi: Abdullah bin Amr (RA) ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Allah ke nazdeek sabse behtareen roza Dawood ka hai aur sabse behtareen namaz Dawood (AS) ki hai, kyunki woh aadhi raat sote the aur uske teesre hisse mein namaz ke liye khade hote the aur phir chhathe hisse mein so jaate the, aur woh ek din roza rakhte the aur doosre din todte the.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Amr b. al-'As reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The best fasting in the eye of Allah is that of David, for he fasted for half of the age (he fasted on alternate days), and the best prayer in the eye of Allah, the Exalted and Majestic, is that of David (peace be upon him), for he slept for half of the night and then stood for prayer and then again slept. He prayed for one-third of the night after midnight. He (the narrator) said: I asked 'Amr b. Dinar whether 'Amr b. Aus said that he stood for prayer one-third of the night after midnight. He said: Yes.
hi: Abdullah bin Amr bin al-As ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Allah ki nazar mein sabse behtareen roza Dawood ka hai, kyunki woh aadhi umar roza rakhte the, unhone alternate dinon mein roza rakha, aur Allah ki nazar mein, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, sabse behtareen namaz Dawood (AS) ki hai, kyunki woh aadhi raat sote the aur phir namaz ke liye khade hote the aur phir dobara so jaate the. Woh raat ke ek-tihaai hisse mein namaz padhte the aadhi raat ke baad. Raawi ne kaha: Maine Amr bin Dinar se poocha ki kya Amr bin Aus ne kaha tha ki woh raat ke ek-tihaai hisse mein namaz padhte the aadhi raat ke baad. Unhone kaha: Haan.

e: Abu Qatada reported that Abu al Malih informed me: I went along with your father to 'Abdullah b. Amr, and he narrated to us that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was informed about my fasting and he came to me, and I placed a leather cushion filled with fibre of date-palms for him. He sat down upon the ground and there was that cushion between me and him, and he said to me: Does three days' fasting in a month not suffice you? I said: Messenger of Allah, (I am capable of observing more fasts). He said: (Would) five (not suffice for you)? I said: Messenger of Allah, (I am capable of observing more fasts) He said: (Would) seven (fasts) not suffice you? I said: Messenger of Allah, (I am capable of observing more fasts). He (the Holy Prophet) then said: (Would) nine (fasts not suffice you)? I said: Messenger of Allah, (I am capable of observing more fasts). He said: (Would) eleven (fasts not suffice you)? I said: Messenger of Allah, (I am capable of observing more fasts than these). Thereupon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: There is no fasting (better than) the fasting of David which comprises half of the age, fasting a day and not fasting a day.
hi: Abu Qatada ne bayan kiya ki Abu al-Malih ne mujhe bataya: Main tumhare waalid ke saath Abdullah bin Amr ke paas gaya, aur unhone humein bataya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ko mere roze ke baare mein bataya gaya aur woh mere paas aaye, aur maine unke liye khajoor ke pattoon se bhara ek chamde ka takiya rakha. Woh zameen par baith gaye aur woh takiya mere aur unke darmiyan tha, aur unhone mujhse kaha: Kya mahine mein teen din roza rakhna tumhare liye kaafi nahi hai? Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, main isse zyada roza rakhne ki taaqat rakhta hoon. Unhone kaha: Kya paanch nahi kaafi honge tumhare liye? Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, main isse zyada roza rakhne ki taaqat rakhta hoon. Unhone kaha: Kya saat roze nahi kaafi honge tumhare liye? Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, main isse zyada roza rakhne ki taaqat rakhta hoon. Unhone phir kaha: Kya nau roze nahi kaafi honge? Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, main isse zyada roza rakhne ki taaqat rakhta hoon. Unhone kaha: Kya gyarah roze nahi kaafi honge? Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, main in sabse zyada roza rakhne ki taaqat rakhta hoon. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Koi roza, Dawood ke roze se behtar, nahi hai jismein aadhi umar shaamil ho, ek din roza rakhna aur ek din na rakhna.

e: 'Abdullah b. Amr (Allah be pleased with them) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had said to him: Observe fast for a day and there would be reward for you for the rest (of the days). He said: I am capable of doing more than this. He then said: Observe fast for two days, and there would be reward for you for the rest (of the days). He said: I am capable of doing more than this. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Observe fast for three days and there would be reward for you for the rest of the days. He said: I am capable of doing more than this, whereupon he said: Observe fast for four days and there would be reward for you for the rest of the days. He said: I am capable of doing more than this. Thereupon he said: Then observe fast (which is the) best in the eye of Allah, the fast of David (peace be upon him) ; he used to observe fast one day and break on the other day.
hi: Abdullah bin Amr (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unse kaha tha: Ek din roza rakho aur tumhe baaki dinon ka bhi sawaab milega. Unhone kaha: Mujhe isse zyada karne ki taaqat hai. Unhone phir kaha: Do din roza rakho, aur tumhe baaki dinon ka bhi sawaab milega. Unhone kaha: Mujhe isse zyada karne ki taaqat hai. Unhone kaha: Teen din roza rakho aur tumhe baaki dinon ka bhi sawaab milega. Unhone kaha: Mujhe isse zyada karne ki taaqat hai, isper unhone kaha: Char din roza rakho aur tumhe baaki dinon ka bhi sawaab milega. Unhone kaha: Mujhe isse zyada karne ki taaqat hai. Isper unhone kaha: To roza rakho, jo Allah ki nazar mein sabse behtareen hai, Dawood (AS) ka roza; woh ek din roza rakhte the aur doosre din todte the.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Amr (Allah be pleased with them) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me! 'Abdullah b. 'Amr, it has been conveyed to me that you observe fast during the day and stand in prayer during the whole night. Don't do that, for your body has a share of its own in you, your eye has a share of its own in you, your wife has a share of her own in you. Observe fast and break it too. Fast for three days in every month and that is a prepetual fasting. I said! Messenger of Allah, I have got strength enough (to do more than this), whereupon he said: Then observe the fast of David (peace be upon him). Observe fast one day and break it (on the other) day. And he ('Abdullah b. 'Amr) used to say: Would that I had availed myself of this concession.
hi: Abdullah bin Amr (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne mujhse kaha: Abdullah bin Amr, mujhe bataaya gaya hai ki tum din mein roza rakhte ho aur poori raat namaz mein khade rehte ho. Aisa mat karo, kyunki tumhare badan ka apna hissa tummein hai, tumhari aankh ka apna hissa tummein hai, tumhari biwi ka apna hissa tummein hai. Roza rakho aur ise bhi todo. Har mahine teen din roza rakho aur ye hamesha ka roza hai. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mujhe isse zyada karne ki taaqat hai, isper unhone kaha: To Dawood (AS) ka roza rakho. Ek din roza rakho aur doosre din todo. Aur woh, Abdullah bin Amr, kaha karte the: Kaash maine is chhoot ka faayda utha liya hota.

e: Mu'adha al-'Adawiyya reported that she asked 'A'isha, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), whether the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed fasts for three days during every month. She said: Yes I said to her: Which were (the particular) days of the month on which he observed fast? She said: He was not particular about the days of the month on which to observe fast.
hi: Mu'adha al-Adawiyya ne bayan kiya ki unhone Aisha, Rasoolullah (SAW) ki zauja, se poocha ki kya Rasoolullah (SAW) har mahine teen din roza rakhte the. Unhone kaha: Haan. Maine unse kaha: Mahine ke kaunse khaas din the jispar woh roza rakhte the? Unhone kaha: Woh mahine ke kisi khaas din roza rakhne ke baare mein sanjeeda nahi the.

e: 'Imran b. Husain (Allah be pleased with them) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to him (or he said to another person and he was listening to it): O, so and so, did you observe fast in the middle of the month? He said: No. Thereupon he (the Messenger of Allah) said: When you break it, then observe fast for two days.
hi: Imran bin Husain (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unse kaha, ya unhone kisi aur se kaha aur woh, Imran, sun rahe the: Aye falan, kya tumne mahine ke beech mein roza rakha? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Isper unhone kaha: Jab tum Ramzan ka roza tod lo, to do din roza rakho.

e: Abu Qatada reported that a person came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: How do you fast? The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) felt annoyed. When 'Umar (Allah be pleased with him) noticed his annoyance, he said: We are well pleased with Allah as our Lord, with Islam as our code of life, and with Muhammad as our Prophet. We seek refuge with Allah from the anger of Allah and that of His Messenger. 'Umar kept on repeating these words till his (the Prophet's) anger calmed down. Then Umar said: Messenger of Allah, what is the position of one who fasts perpetually? He (ﷺ) said: He neither fasted nor broke it, or he said: He did not fast and he did not break it. 'Umar said: What about him who fasts for two days and does not fast one day? He (ﷺ) said: Is anyone capable of doing that? He ('Umar) said: What is the position of him who fasts for a day and doesn't fast on the other day? Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: That is the fast of David (peace be upon him). He ('Umar) said: What about him who fasts one day and doesn't fast for two days. Thereupon he (the Messenger of Allah) said: I wish I were given the strength to do that. Thereafter he (ﷺ) said: Fasting three days every month and that of Ramadan every year is a perpetual fasting. I seek from Allah that fasting on the day of 'Arafa may atone for the sins of the preceding and the coming years, and I seek from Allah that fasting on the day of Ashura may atone for the sins of the preceding year.
hi: Abu Qatada ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Aap kaise roza rakhte hain? Rasoolullah (SAW) ko bura laga. Jab Umar (RA) ne unki naaraazgi dekhi, to unhone kaha: Hum Allah ke apne Rab hone par, Islam ke apni zindagi ka tareeqa hone par, aur Muhammad ke apna Nabi hone par bahut khush hain. Hum Allah ki panah maangte hain Allah aur uske Rasool ke gusse se. Umar ye alfaaz baar-baar dohraate rahe jab tak unki naaraazgi shaant na ho gayi. Phir Umar ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, us shakhs ki kya haalat hai jo lagataar roza rakhta hai? Unhone kaha: Usne na roza rakha na hi toda, ya unhone kaha: Usne roza nahi rakha aur na hi toda. Umar ne kaha: Uske baare mein kya jo do din roza rakhta hai aur ek din nahi rakhta? Unhone kaha: Kya koi aisa karne ki taaqat rakhta hai? Unhone kaha: Us shakhs ki kya haalat hai jo ek din roza rakhta hai aur doosre din nahi rakhta? Isper unhone kaha: Ye Dawood (AS) ka roza hai. Unhone kaha: Uske baare mein kya jo ek din roza rakhta hai aur do din nahi rakhta. Isper unhone kaha: Kaash mujhe aisa karne ki taaqat di jaati. Iske baad unhone kaha: Har mahine teen din roza rakhna aur har saal Ramzan ka roza ek hamesha ka roza hai. Main Allah se chahta hoon ki Arafa ke din ka roza pichhle aur aane wale saal ke gunahon ka kaffara ban jaaye, aur main Allah se chahta hoon ki Ashura ke din ka roza pichhle saal ke gunahon ka kaffara ban jaaye.

e: Abu Qatada al-Ansari (Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was asked about his fasting. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) felt annoyed. Thereupon 'Umar (Allah be pleased with him) said: We are pleased with Allah as the Lord, with Islam as our Code of Life, with Muhammad as the Messenger and with our pledge (to you for willing and cheerful submission) as a (sacred) commitment. He was then asked about perpetual fasting, whereupon he said: He neither fasted nor did he break it, or he did not fast and he did not break it. He was then asked about fasting for two days and breaking one day. He (the Holy Prophet) said: And who has strength enough to do it? He was asked about fasting for a day and breaking for two days, whereupon he said: May Allah bestow upon us strength to do it. He was then asked about fasting for a day and breaking on the other, whereupon he said: That is the fasting of my brother David (peace be upon him). He was then asked about fasting on Monday, whereupon he said: It was the day on which I was born. on which I was commissioned with prophethood or revelation was sent to me, (and he further) said: Three days' fasting every month and of the whole of Ramadan every year is a perpetual fast. He was asked about fasting on the day of 'Arafa (9th of Dhu'I-Hijja), whereupon he said: It expiates the sins of the preceding year and the coming year. He was asked about fasting on the day of 'Ashura (10th of Muharram), whereupon be said: It expiates the sins of the preceding year. (Imam Muslim said that in this hadith there is a) narration of Imam Shu'ba that he was asked about fasting on Monday and Thursday, but we (Imam Muslim) did not mention Thursday for we found it as an error (in reporting).
hi: Abu Qatada al-Ansari (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) se unke roze ke baare mein poocha gaya. Rasoolullah (SAW) ko bura laga. Isper Umar (RA) ne kaha: Hum Allah ko Rab, Islam ko apni zindagi ka tareeqa, Muhammad ko Rasool, aur apni bai'at ko, aapki khaatir puri tarah tabedaar hone ke liye, ek muqaddas wada maankar khush hain. Unse phir lagataar roze ke baare mein poocha gaya, isper unhone kaha: Usne na roza rakha na toda, ya usne roza nahi rakha aur na hi toda. Unse phir do din roza rakhkar ek din todne ke baare mein poocha gaya. Unhone kaha: Aur kisme itni taaqat hai ki aisa kare? Unse ek din roza rakhkar do din todne ke baare mein poocha gaya, isper unhone kaha: Kaash Allah humein aisa karne ki taaqat ata kare. Unse phir ek din roza rakhkar doosre din todne ke baare mein poocha gaya, isper unhone kaha: Ye mere bhai Dawood (AS) ka roza hai. Unse phir somvaar ke roze ke baare mein poocha gaya, isper unhone kaha: Ye woh din hai jispar main paida hua, jispar mujhe Nabuwat ya wahi di gayi, aur unhone aage kaha: Har mahine teen din ka roza aur har saal poore Ramzan ka roza ek hamesha ka roza hai. Unse Arafa ke din, 9 Zul-Hijja, ke roze ke baare mein poocha gaya, isper unhone kaha: Ye pichhle aur aane wale saal ke gunahon ka kaffara hai. Unse Ashura ke din, 10 Muharram, ke roze ke baare mein poocha gaya, isper unhone kaha: Ye pichhle saal ke gunahon ka kaffara hai. Imam Muslim ne kaha ki is hadees mein Imam Shu'ba ki riwayat hai ki unse somvaar aur guruvaar ke roze ke baare mein poocha gaya, lekin humne, Imam Muslim ne, guruvaar ka zikr nahi kiya kyunki humein ye riwayat mein galti lagi.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Ghailan b. Jarir with the same chain of transmitters, but with one variation, that there has been made mention of Monday and not of Thursday.
hi: Ye hadees Ghailan bin Jarir ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai, lekin ek farq ke saath, ki isme somvaar ka zikr hai, guruvaar ka nahi.

e: Abu Qatada Ansari (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Massenger (ﷺ) was asked about fasting on Monday, whereupon he said: It is (the day) when I was born and revelation was sent down to me.
hi: Abu Qatada Ansari (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se somvaar ke roze ke baare mein poocha gaya, isper unhone kaha: Ye woh din hai jab main paida hua aur mujhpar wahi nazil ki gayi.

e: 'Imran b. Husain (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) having said to him or to someone else: Did you fast in the middle of Sha'ban? He said: No. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: If you did not observe fast, then you should observe fast for two days.
hi: Imran bin Husain (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, unse ya kisi aur se: Kya tumne Sha'baan ke beech mein roza rakha? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Isper unhone kaha: Agar tumne roza nahi rakha, to tumhe do din roza rakhna chahiye.

e: Imran b. Husain (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said to a person: Did you observe any fast in the middle of this month (Sha'ban)? He said: No. Thereupon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Fast for two days instead of (one fast) when you have completed (fasts of) Ramadan.
hi: Imran bin Husain (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek shakhs se kaha: Kya tumne is mahine, Sha'baan, ke beech mein koi roza rakha? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Isper Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Do din roza rakho ek roze ke badle jab tum Ramzan ke roze mukammal kar chuke ho.

e: 'Imran b. Husain (Allah be pleased with them) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to a person: Did you observe fast in the middle of this month. i. e. Sha'ban? He said: No. Thereupon he said to him: When it is the end of Ramadan, then observe fast for one day or two (Shu'ba had some doubt about it) but he said: I think that he has said: two days.
hi: Imran bin Husain (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne ek shakhs se kaha: Kya tumne is mahine, yaani Sha'baan, ke beech mein roza rakha? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Isper unhone usse kaha: Jab Ramzan ka akhir ho, to ek din ya do din roza rakho, Shu'ba ko iske baare mein kuch shaq tha, lekin unhone kaha: Mujhe lagta hai unhone kaha: Do din.

e: This hadith is narrated by 'Abdullah b. Hani b. Akhi Mutarrif with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abdullah bin Hani bin Akhi Mutarrif ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Haraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The most excellent fast after Ramadan is God's month. al-Muharram, and the most excellent prayer after what is prescribed is prayer during the night.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ramzan ke baad sabse behtareen roza Allah ke mahine, al-Muharram, mein hai, aur farz namazon ke baad sabse behtareen namaz raat ki namaz hai.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported that he (the Messenger of Allah) was asked as to which prayer was most excellent after the prescribed prayer, and which fast was most excellent after the month of Ramadan. He said: Prayer offered in the middle of the night and the most excellent fast after (fasting) in the month of Ramadan is the fast in God's month al-Muharram.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unse poocha gaya ki farz namaz ke baad kaunsi namaz sabse behtareen hai, aur Ramzan ke mahine ke baad kaunsa roza sabse behtareen hai. Unhone kaha: Raat ke beech mein padhi jaane wali namaz, aur Ramzan ke roze ke baad sabse behtareen roza Allah ke mahine al-Muharram ka roza hai.

e: A hadith like this has been reported from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) by 'Abd al-Malik with the same chain of transmitters in connection with fast.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Abdul Malik ki sanad se Rasoolullah (SAW) se roze ke silsile mein bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Ayyub al-Ansari (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who observed the fast of Ramadan and then followed it with six (fasts) of Shawwal. it would be as if he fasted perpetually.
hi: Abu Ayyub al-Ansari (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jisne Ramzan ka roza rakha aur phir uske baad Shawwal ke chhe roze rakhe, ye aisa hoga jaise usne hamesha roza rakha ho.

e: Abu Ayyub al-Ansari reported (through another chain of transmitters): I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying like this.
hi: Abu Ayyub al-Ansari ne, ek doosri sanad se, riwayat ki: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko isi tarah kehte suna.

e: Abu Ayyub reported a hadith like this (through another chain of transmitters).
hi: Abu Ayyub ne isi tarah ki ek hadees, ek doosri sanad se, bayan ki hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that some persons among the Companions of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) were shown Lailat- ul-Qadr while sleeping in the last week (of Ramadan). Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I see that your dreams agree regarding the last week; so he who wants to seek it should seek it in the last week (during the night).
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ke sahaba mein se kuch logon ne Lailat-ul-Qadr Ramzan ke aakhri hafte mein sote hue dekhi. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Mujhe lagta hai ki tumhare khwaab aakhri hafte ke baare mein mel khaate hain; is liye jo ise dhoondhna chahe use aakhri hafte mein dhoondhna chahiye, raat mein.

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Seek Lailat-ul-Qadr in the last week (of Ramadan).
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Lailat-ul-Qadr ko Ramzan ke aakhri hafte mein dhoondho.

e: Salim reported on the authority of his father that a person saw Lailat-ul- Qadr on the 27th (of Ramadan). Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: I see that your dreams agree regarding the last ten (nights of Ramadan). So seek it on an odd number (of these ten nights).
hi: Salim ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki ek shakhs ne Lailat-ul-Qadr saatvi tareekh, 27 Ramzan, ko dekhi. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Mujhe lagta hai ki tumhare khwaab aakhri das raaton ke baare mein mel khaate hain. Is liye ise in das raaton mein se kisi taaq, odd numbered, raat mein dhoondho.

e: Salim b. 'Abdullah b. 'Umar reported that his father said: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: So far as Lailat-ul-Qadr is concerned. some persons among you have seen it (in a dream) in the first week and some persons among you have been shown that it is in the last week; so seek it in the last ten (nights).
hi: Salim bin Abdullah bin Umar ne bayan kiya ki unke walid ne kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jahan tak Lailat-ul-Qadr ka sawal hai, tum mein se kuch logon ne ise khwaab mein pehle hafte mein dekha hai aur tum mein se kuch logon ko dikhaaya gaya hai ki ye aakhri hafte mein hai; is liye ise aakhri das raaton mein dhoondho.

e: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Seek it (Lailat-ul-Qadr) in the last (ten nights). If one among you shows slackness and weakness (in the earlier part of Ramadan), it should not be allowed to prevail upon him in the last week.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ise, Lailat-ul-Qadr ko, aakhri das raaton mein dhoondho. Agar tum mein se koi Ramzan ke pehle hisse mein susti aur kamzori dikhaaye, to ise aakhri hafte mein haavi nahi hone dena chahiye.

e: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who is anxious to seek it (Lailat-ul-Qadr) should seek it in the last ten (nights of Ramadan).
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo ise, Lailat-ul-Qadr ko, dhoondhne ke liye betaab hai, use Ramzan ke aakhri das raaton mein ise dhoondhna chahiye.

e: 'Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with both of them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Seek the time of Lailat-ul-Qadr in the last (ten nights), or he said: in the last nine (nights).
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Lailat-ul-Qadr ke waqt ko aakhri das raaton mein dhoondho, ya unhone kaha: aakhri nau raaton mein.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: I was shown Lailat-ul-Qadr; then some members of my family awoke me up, then I was caused to forget it. So seek it in the last week. Harmala said: (The Prophet did not say:" I was made to forget," but he stated):" But I forgot it."
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Mujhe Lailat-ul-Qadr dikhaayi gayi thi; phir mere ghar ke kuch logon ne mujhe jagaya, phir mujhe ye bhulwaa diya gaya. Is liye ise aakhri hafte mein dhoondho. Harmala ne kaha: Nabi ne ye nahi kaha "Mujhe bhulwaaya gaya," balki unhone kaha: "Lekin main use bhool gaya."

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) spent in devotion (in i'tikaf) the middle ten nights of the month of Ramadan, and when twenty nights were over and it was the twenty-first night, he went back to his residence and those who were along with him also returned (to their respective residences). He spent one month in devotion. Then he addressed the people on the night he came back (to his residence) and commanded them as Allah desired (him to command) and then said: I used to devote myself (observe i'tikaf) during these ten (nights). Then I started devoting myself in the last ten (nights). And he who desires to observe i'tikaf along with me should spend the night) at his place of i'tikaf. And I saw this night (Lailat-ul-Qadr) but I forgot it (the exact night) ; so seek it;In the last ten nights on odd numbers. I saw (the glimpses of that dream) that I was prostrating in water and mud. Abu Sa'id al-Khudri said: It rained on the twenty-first night and the water dripped (from the roof) of the mosque at the place where the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed prayer. I looked at him and as he completed the dawn prayer, (I found) his face was wet with mud and water.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ramzan ke mahine ke beech ke das dinon mein itikaaf kiya, aur jab bees raaten guzar chuki thin aur ikkeesvi raat thi, to woh apne ghar wapas gaye aur jo unke saath the woh bhi apne-apne gharon ko wapas gaye. Unhone ek mahina itikaaf mein guzaara. Phir unhone us raat logon se khitaab kiya jab woh wapas aaye aur unhe jo Allah chahta tha hukum diya, aur phir kaha: Main in das raaton mein itikaaf kiya karta tha. Phir maine aakhri das raaton mein itikaaf karna shuru kiya. Aur jo mere saath itikaaf karna chahe use apni itikaaf ki jagah par raat guzaarni chahiye. Aur maine ye raat, Lailat-ul-Qadr, dekhi lekin main ise theek raat bhool gaya; is liye ise aakhri das raaton mein taaq numberon par dhoondho. Maine dekha, ki us khwaab ki jhalak thi, ki main paani aur kichad mein sajda kar raha tha. Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne kaha: Ikkeesvi raat ko baarish hui aur masjid ki chhat se paani tapka jahan Allah ke Rasool (SAW) namaz padh rahe the. Maine unki taraf dekha aur jab unhone fajr ki namaz mukammal ki, to unka chehra kichad aur paani se geela tha.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) devoted (himself to prayer) in the middle (ten nights) of Ramadan. The rest of the hadith is the same except for these words: " That he adhered to his place of i'tikaf and his forehead was besmeared with mud and water."
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Ramzan ke beech ke das dinon mein namaz mein apne aap ko waqf kiya. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai siwaay in alfaazon ke: "Ki woh apni itikaaf ki jagah se juda rahe aur unki peshani kichad aur paani se lipti thi."

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed i'tikaf (confined himself for devotion and prayer) in the first ten (days) of Ramadan; he then observed i'tikaf in the middle ten (days) in a Turkish tent with a mat hanging at its door. He (the Holy Prophet) took hold of that mat and placed it in the nook of the tent. He then put his head out and talked with people and they came near him, and he (the Holy Prophet) said: I observed i'tikaf in the first ten (nights and days) in order to seek that night (Lailat-ul-Qadr). I then observed i'tikaf in the middle ten days. Then (an angel) was sent to me and I was told that this (night) is among the last ten (nights). He who among you likes to observe i'tikaf should do so; and the people observed it along with him, and he (the Holy Prophet) said: That (Lailat-ul-Qadr) was shown to me on an odd (night) and I (saw in the dream) that I was prostrating in the morning in clay and water. So in the morning of the twenty-first night when he (the Holy Prophet) got up for dawn (prayer). there was a rainfall and the mosque dripped, and I saw clay and water. When he came out after completing the morning prayer (I saw) that his forehead and the tip of his nose had (traces) of clay and water, and that was the twenty-first night among the last ten (nights).
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Ramzan ke pehle das dinon mein itikaaf kiya; unhone phir beech ke das dinon mein ek Turki khaime mein itikaaf kiya jismein uske darwaze par ek chataayi latak rahi thi. Unhone us chataayi ko pakda aur use khaime ke ek konay mein rakh diya. Unhone phir apna sar bahar nikaala aur logon se baat ki aur woh unke qareeb aaye, aur unhone kaha: Maine pehle das raaton aur dinon mein itikaaf kiya taaki main woh raat, Lailat-ul-Qadr, dhoondh sakoon. Maine phir beech ke das dinon mein itikaaf kiya. Phir ek farishta mere paas bheja gaya aur mujhe bataya gaya ki ye raat aakhri das raaton mein hai. Tum mein se jo koi itikaaf karna chahe use aisa karna chahiye; aur logon ne unke saath itikaaf kiya, aur unhone kaha: Ki woh Lailat-ul-Qadr mujhe ek taaq raat mein dikhaayi gayi aur maine khwaab mein dekha ki main subah mitti aur paani mein sajda kar raha tha. To ikkeesvi raat ki subah jab woh fajr ki namaz ke liye utthe, to baarish hui aur masjid se paani tapka, aur maine mitti aur paani dekha. Jab woh subah ki namaz mukammal karke bahar aaye to maine dekha ki unki peshani aur unki naak ki nok par mitti aur paani ke nishaan the, aur ye ikkeesvi raat aakhri das raaton mein se thi.

e: Abu Salama reported: 'We discussed amongst ourselves Lailat-ul-Qadr. I came to Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) who was a friend of mine and said to him: Would you not go with us to the garden of date trees? He went out with a cloak over him. I said to him: Did you hear the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) making mention of Lailat-ul-Qadr? He said: Yes, (and added) we were observing i'tikaf with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in the middle ten days of Ramadan, and came out on the morning of the twentieth and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) addressed us and said: I was shown Lailat-ul-Qadr, but I forgot (the exact night) or I was caused to forget it, so seek it in the last ten odd (nights), and I was shown that I was prostrating in water and clay. So he who wanted to observe i'tikaf with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) should return (to the place of i'tikaf). He (Abu Sa'id al-Khudri) said: And we returned and did not find any patch of cloud in the sky. Then the cloud gathered and there was (so heavy) a downpour that the roof of the mosque which was made of the branches of date-palms began to drip. Then there was prayer and I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prostrating in water and clay till I saw the traces of clay on his forehead.
hi: Abu Salama ne bayan kiya: Humne apas mein Lailat-ul-Qadr ke baare mein charcha ki. Main Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ke paas aaya jo mera dost tha aur unse kaha: Kya aap humare saath khajoor ke baagh mein nahi chalenge? Woh apni chadar odhkar bahar nikle. Maine unse kaha: Kya aapne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Lailat-ul-Qadr ka zikr karte suna hai? Unhone kaha: Haan, aur izafa kiya, hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Ramzan ke beech ke das dinon mein itikaaf kar rahe the, aur bees ki subah bahar aaye aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humse khitaab kiya aur kaha: Mujhe Lailat-ul-Qadr dikhaayi gayi, lekin main ise theek raat bhool gaya ya mujhe bhulwaa diya gaya, is liye ise aakhri das taaq raaton mein dhoondho, aur mujhe dikhaaya gaya ki main paani aur kichad mein sajda kar raha tha. To jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath itikaaf karna chahe use itikaaf ki jagah par wapas jaana chahiye. Unhone kaha: Aur hum wapas gaye aur aasmaan mein baadal ka koi tukda nahi paaya. Phir baadal ikattha hue aur itni bhaari baarish hui ki masjid ki chhat, jo khajoor ki daaliyon se bani thi, tapakne lagi. Phir namaz hui aur maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko paani aur kichad mein sajda karte dekha yahan tak ki maine unki peshani par kichad ke nishaan dekhe.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Yahya b. Abu Kathir with the same chain of transmitters (with a slight variation of these words): I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) after he had completed (the prayer) and there was a trace of clay on his forehead and tip (of the nose).
hi: Ye hadees Yahya bin Abu Kathir ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai, alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko namaz mukammal karne ke baad dekha aur unki peshani aur naak ki nok par kichad ka nishaan tha.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed i'tikaf in the middle ten days of Ramadan to seek Lailat-ul-Qadr before it was made manifest to him. When (these nights) were over, he commanded to strike the tent. Then it was made manifest to him that (Lailat-ul-Qadr) was in the last ten nights (of Ramadan), and commanded to pitch the tent (again). He then came to the people and said: O people, Lailat-ul-Qadr was made manifest to me and I came out to inform you about it that two persons came contending with each other and there was a devil along with them and I forgot it. So seek it in the last ten nights of Ramadan. Seek it on the ninth, on the seventh and on the fifth. I (one of the narrators) said: Abu Sa'id, you know more than us about numbers. He said: Yes, indeed we have better right than you. I said: What is this ninth, seventh, and fifth? He said: When twenty-one (nights are over) and the twenty-second begins, it is the ninth, and when twenty-three (nights) are over, that which follows (the last night) is the seventh, and when twenty-five nights are over, what follows it is fifth. Ibn Khallad said: Instead of the word Yahliqan (contending), he said Yakhtasiman, (they are disputing).
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ramzan ke beech ke das dinon mein itikaaf kiya taaki woh Lailat-ul-Qadr dhoondh sakein isse pehle ki ye unpar zaahir kiya jaaye. Jab ye raaten guzar gayin, to unhone khaima ukhaadne ka hukum diya. Phir unpar zaahir kiya gaya ki ye Lailat-ul-Qadr aakhri das raaton mein hai, aur unhone khaima phir se lagaane ka hukum diya. Woh phir logon ke paas aaye aur kaha: Aye logo, Lailat-ul-Qadr mujhpar zaahir ki gayi thi aur main tumhe iske baare mein bataane bahar aaya ki do log jhagadte hue aaye aur unke saath ek shaitaan tha aur main use bhool gaya. Is liye ise Ramzan ki aakhri das raaton mein dhoondho. Ise nauvi, saatvi aur paanchvi mein dhoondho. Maine kaha: Abu Sa'id, aap numberon ke baare mein humse zyada jaante hain. Unhone kaha: Haan, dar-asal humein tumse zyada haq hai. Maine kaha: Ye nauvi, saatvi aur paanchvi kya hai? Unhone kaha: Jab ikkees raaten guzar chuki hon aur bees-do shuru ho, to ye nauvi hai, aur jab teis raaten guzar chuki hon, to jo uske baad aakhri raat aati hai woh saatvi hai, aur jab paccis raaten guzar chuki hon, to jo uske baad aati hai woh paanchvi hai. Ibn Khallad ne kaha: Lafz "Yahliqan", jhagadte hue, ki jagah, unhone "Yakhtasiman" kaha, woh bahas kar rahe hain.

e: 'Abdullah b. Unais reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: I was shown Lailat-ul-Qadr; then I was made to forget it, and saw that I was prostrating in water and clay in the morning of that (night). He (the narrator) said: There was a downpour on the twenty-third night and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led us in prayer, and as he went back, there was a trace of water and clay on his forehead and on his nose. He (the narrator) said: 'Abdullah b. Unais used to say that it was the twenty-third (night).
hi: Abdullah bin Unais ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Mujhe Lailat-ul-Qadr dikhaayi gayi; phir mujhe ise bhulwaa diya gaya, aur maine dekha ki main uski subah paani aur kichad mein sajda kar raha tha. Raawi ne kaha: Teisvi raat ko bhaari baarish hui aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein namaz padhayi, aur jab woh wapas gaye, to unki peshani aur unki naak par paani aur kichad ke nishaan the. Raawi ne kaha: Abdullah bin Unais kaha karte the ki ye teisvi raat thi.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) and Ibn Numair reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Look for (and in the words of Waki, seek) Lailat-ul-Qadr in the last ten nights of Ramadan.
hi: Aisha (RA) aur Ibn Numair ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ramzan ki aakhri das raaton mein Lailat-ul-Qadr dhoondho, aur Waki ke alfaazon mein, talaash karo.

e: Zirr b. Habaish reported: I thu asked Ubayy b. Ka'b (Allah be pleased with him): Your brother (in faith) Ibn Mas'ud says: He who stands (for the night prayer) throughout the year would find Lailat-ul-Qadr, whereupon he said: May Allah have mercy upon him; (he said these words) with the intention that people might not rely only (on one night), whereas he knew that it (Lailat-ul-Qadr) is in the month of Ramadan and it is the twenty-seventh night. He then took oath (without making any exception, i. e. without saying In sha Allah) that it was the twenty-seventh night. I said to him: Abu Mundhir, on what ground do you say that? Thereupon he said: By the indication or by the sign which the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) gave us, and that is that on that day (the sun) would rise without having any ray in it.
hi: Zirr bin Habaish ne bayan kiya: Maine Ubayy bin Ka'b (RA) se poocha: Aapke bhai, deen mein, Ibn Mas'ud kehte hain: Jo saal bhar raat ki namaz ke liye khada rahega use Lailat-ul-Qadr mil jaayegi, isper unhone kaha: Allah unpar rehmat kare; unhone ye alfaaz is iraade se kahe hain ki log sirf ek raat par bharosa na karein, jabki unhe pata tha ki ye Lailat-ul-Qadr Ramzan mahine mein hai aur ye sattaisvi raat hai. Unhone phir qasam khayi, bina koi apwaad kiye, yaani bina "In sha Allah" kahe, ki ye sattaisvi raat thi. Maine unse kaha: Abu Mundhir, aap ye kis buniyaad par kehte hain? Isper unhone kaha: Us ishaare ya nishaani ki wajah se jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein di, aur woh ye hai ki us din suraj bina kiran ke nikalta hai.

e: Zirr b. Hubaish reported that Ubayy b. Ka'b (Allah be pleased with him) said about Lailat-ul-Qadr: By Allah, I know well about it. Shu'ba said: To the best of my knowledge it was the twenty-seventh night for which the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commanded us to stand for prayer. Shu'ba doubted these words: That it was the night for which the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commanded us to stand for prayer. And (he further) said: This was narrated to me by a friend of mine from him (the Holy Prophet).
hi: Zirr bin Hubaish ne bayan kiya ki Ubayy bin Ka'b (RA) ne Lailat-ul-Qadr ke baare mein kaha: Allah ki qasam, mujhe iska achhi tarah pata hai. Shu'ba ne kaha: Mere jaisi jaankaari ke mutabik, ye sattaisvi raat thi jiske liye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein namaz ke liye khade hone ka hukum diya tha. Shu'ba ko in alfaazon mein shaq tha: Ki ye woh raat thi jiske liye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein namaz ke liye khade hone ka hukum diya tha. Aur unhone aage kaha: Ye mujhe mere ek dost ne unse riwayat ki.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported: We were talking about Lailat-ul-Qadr in the presence of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he said: He who amongst you remembers (the night) when the moon arose and it was like a piece of plate (at the fag end of the month in a state of waning).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki maujoodgi mein Lailat-ul-Qadr ke baare mein baat kar rahe the aur unhone kaha: Tum mein se jise woh raat yaad hai jab chaand nikla aur woh ek plate ke tukde jaisa tha, mahine ke aakhir mein dhalte hue.

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with both of them) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to observe i'tikaf in the last ten days of Ramadan.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) Ramzan ke aakhri das dinon mein itikaaf kiya karte the.

e: Abdullah b. Umar (Allah be pleased with both of them) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to observe i'tikaf in the last ten days of Ramadan. Nafi' said: Abdullah (Allah be pleased with him) showed me the place in the mosque where the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to observe i'tikaf.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) Ramzan ke aakhri das dinon mein itikaaf kiya karte the. Nafi ne kaha: Abdullah (RA) ne mujhe masjid mein woh jagah dikhaayi jahan Rasoolullah (SAW) itikaaf kiya karte the.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to observe i'tikaf in the last ten days of Ramadan.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) Ramzan ke aakhri das dinon mein itikaaf kiya karte the.

e: This hadith has been narrated by 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Aisha (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se bayan ki gayi hai.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) used to observe i'tikif in the last ten days of Ramadan till Allah called him back (to his heavenly home). Then his wives observed i'tikaf after him.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) Ramzan ke aakhri das dinon mein itikaaf kiya karte the yahan tak ki Allah ne unhe apni aasmaani duniya mein wapas bula liya. Iske baad unki zaujaon ne unke baad itikaaf kiya.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) decided to observe i'tikaf, he prayed in the morning and then went to the place of his i'tikaf, and he commanded that a tent should be pitched for him, and it was pitched. He (once) decided to observe i'tikaf in the last ten days of Ramadan. Zainab (the wife of the Holy Prophet) commanded that a tent should be pitched for her. It was pitched accordingly. And some other wives of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) commanded that tents should be pitched for them too. And they were pitched. When the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) offered the morning prayer, he looked and found (so many) tents. Thereupon he said: What is this virtue that these (ladies) have decided to acquire? He commanded his tent to be struck and abandoned i'tikaf in the month of Ramadan and postponed it to the first ten days of Shawwal.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab Rasoolullah (SAW) ne itikaaf karne ka faisla kiya, to unhone subah ki namaz padhi aur phir apni itikaaf ki jagah gaye, aur unhone hukum diya ki unke liye ek khaima lagaya jaaye, aur woh lagaya gaya. Unhone ek baar Ramzan ke aakhri das dinon mein itikaaf karne ka faisla kiya. Zainab, Nabi ki zauja, ne hukum diya ki unke liye bhi ek khaima lagaya jaaye. Ye usi tarah lagaya gaya. Aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki kuch aur zaujaon ne bhi hukum diya ki unke liye bhi khaime lagaaye jaayein. Aur ye lagaaye gaye. Jab Rasoolullah (SAW) ne subah ki namaz padhi, to unhone dekha aur bahut saare khaime paaye. Isper unhone kaha: Ye kaisa mazhabi sadgun hai jo ye auraten haasil karna chahti hain? Unhone apna khaima ukhaadne ka hukum diya aur Ramzan ke mahine mein itikaaf chhod diya aur ise Shawwal ke pehle das dinon tak taal diya.

e: This hadith has been reported through another chain of transmitters, and there it is mentioned that. 'A'isha, Hafsa and Zainab (Allah be pleased with them) pitched the tents for i'tikaf.
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se bayan ki gayi hai, aur usmein zikr hai ki Aisha, Hafsa aur Zainab (RA) ne itikaaf ke liye khaime lagaaye.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that when the last ten nights began Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) kept awake at night (for prayer and devotion), wakened his family, and prepared himself to observe prayer (with more vigour).
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab aakhri das raaten shuru hoti thin, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) raat mein, namaz aur ibadat ke liye, jaagte, apne gharwalon ko jagaate, aur khud ko namaz padhne ke liye zyada jazbe se taiyaar karte.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to exert himself in devotion during the last ten nights to a greater extent than at any other time.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aakhri das raaton mein doosre kisi bhi waqt se zyada apne aap ko ibadat mein lagaate the.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: I never saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) fasting in the ten days of Dhu'I-Hijja.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko kabhi Zul-Hijja ke das dinon mein roza rakhte nahi dekha.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) did not observe fast in the ten days of Dhul-Hijja.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Zul-Hijja ke das dinon mein roza nahi rakha.

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that a person asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) what a Muhrim should put on as dress. Thereupon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Do not put on a shirt or a turban, or trousers or a cap, or leather stockings except one who does not find shoes; he may put on stockings but he should trim them below the ankles. And do not wear clothes to which saffron or wars is applied.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se poocha ki Muhrim ko kya kapda pehnana chahiye. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Kameez, ya pagdi, ya pajama, ya topi mat pehno, aur na hi chamde ke moze pehno, siwaay us shakhs ke jise joote na milein; woh moze pehen sakta hai lekin unhe takhno se neeche kaat lena chahiye. Aur aise kapde mat pehno jinme zafraan ya wars lagaya gaya ho.

e: Salim reported on the authority of his father ('Abdullah b. 'Umar) that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was asked what a Muhrim should wear, whereupon he said: A Muhrim should not wear a shirt, or a turban, or a cap, or trousers, or a cloth touched with wars or with saffron, nor (should he wear) stockings, but in case he does not find shoes, but (before wearing stockings) be should trim them (in such a way) that these should become lower than the ankles.
hi: Salim ne apne walid, Abdullah bin Umar, ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se poocha gaya ki Muhrim ko kya pehnana chahiye, isper unhone kaha: Muhrim ko kameez, ya pagdi, ya topi, ya pajama, ya wars ya zafraan se rangaa hua kapda nahi pehnana chahiye, na hi unhe moze pehnane chahiye, lekin agar use joote na milein, to moze pehnane se pehle unhe is tarah kaat lena chahiye ki woh takhno se neeche ho jaayein.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade the Muhrim to put on a cloth dyed in saffron or wars and he further said: One who does not find shoes (to wear) he may wear stockings, but (only) after trimming them below the ankles.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Muhrim ko zafraan ya wars se rangaa hua kapda pehnane se mana kiya aur unhone aage kaha: Jise joote na milein, woh moze pehen sakta hai, lekin sirf unhe takhno se neeche kaatne ke baad.

e: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with both of them) reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say as he was delivering an address: So far as the trousers are concerned, one who does not find lower garment, he may wear them; as also socks, he may wear them who does not find shoes. It concerns the Muhrim.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ek khitaab dete hue ye kehte suna: Jahan tak pajame ka sawal hai, jise neeche pehnne ka kapda na mile, woh use pehen sakta hai; usi tarah moze bhi, jise joote na milein woh unhe pehen sakta hai. Ye Muhrim se mutalliq hai.

e: 'Amr b. Dinar narrated with the same chain of transmitters that he heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) delivering sermon at 'Arafat, and he made a mention of this hadith (as quoted above).
hi: Amr bin Dinar ne isi sanad se riwayat ki ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Arafat mein khutba dete suna, aur unhone ye hadees, upar bayan hui jaisi, ka zikr kiya.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Amr b. Dinar with the same chain of transmitters, but none of them (the narrators) made a mention that he (the Holy Prophet) was delivering address at 'Arafat except Shu'ba.
hi: Ye hadees Amr bin Dinar ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai, lekin unmein se kisi ne bhi raawiyon ne ye zikr nahi kiya ki woh Arafat mein khutba de rahe the siwaay Shu'ba ke.

e: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who does not find shoes to wear may wear socks, and he who does not find lower garment to wear may put on trousers.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jise joote na milein woh moze pehen sakta hai, aur jise neeche pehnne ka kapda na mile woh pajama pehen sakta hai.

e: Ya'la b. Umayya reported on the authority of his father (Allah be pleased with them) that a person came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as he was at Ji'rana and he (the person) had been putting on a cloak which was perfumed, or he (the narrator) said: There was a trace of yellowness on it. He said (to the Holy Prophet): What do you command me to do during my Umra? (It was at this juncture) that the revelation came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he was covered with a cloth, and Ya'la said: Would that I see revelation coming to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He (Hadrat 'Umar) said: Would it please you to see the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) receiving the revelations 'Umar lifted a corner of the cloth and I looked at him and he was emitting a sound of snorting. He (the narrator) said: I thought it was the sound of a camel. When he was relieved of this he said: Where is he who asked about Umra? When the person came, the Prophet (ﷺ) said: Wash out the trace of yellowness, or he said: the trace of perfume and put off the cloak and do in your 'Umra what you do in your Hajj.
hi: Ya'la bin Umayya ne apne walid (RA) ke hawale se riwayat ki ki ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya jab woh Ji'rana mein the aur woh shakhs ek aisa chogha pehne hue tha jismein khushboo lagi hui thi, ya raawi ne kaha: Usmein peelaapan ka nishaan tha. Usne kaha: Aap mujhe apni Umra mein kya karne ka hukum dete hain? Isi mauqe par Allah ke Rasool (SAW) par wahi nazil hui aur unhe ek kapde se dhaanka gaya, aur Ya'la ne kaha: Kaash main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) par wahi nazil hote dekh paata. Unhone, Hazrat Umar ne, kaha: Kya tumhe pasand aayega ki tum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko wahi paate hue dekho? Umar ne kapde ka ek konaa uthaya aur maine unhe dekha aur woh khanraate jaisi aawaaz nikaal rahe the. Raawi ne kaha: Mujhe laga ki ye ek oont ki aawaaz thi. Jab woh isse azad hue, to unhone kaha: Woh kahan hai jisne Umra ke baare mein poocha tha? Jab woh shakhs aaya, to Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Peelaapan ka nishaan dho do, ya unhone kaha: Khushboo ka nishaan, aur chogha utaar do aur apni Umra mein woh karo jo tum apne Hajj mein karte ho.

e: Safwan b. Ya'la reported on the authority of his father (who said): A person came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as he was staying at Ji'rana and I (the narrator's father) was at that time in the apostle's (ﷺ) company and (the person) was donning a cloak having the marks of perfume on it, and he said: I am in a state of Ihram for the sake of Umra, and it (this cloak) is upon me and I am perfumed. The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) said to him: What would you do in your Hajj? He said: I would take off the clothes and would wash from me this perfume. Thereupon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: What you do in your Hajj do it in your Umra.
hi: Safwan bin Ya'la ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki, jinhone kaha: Ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya jab woh Ji'rana mein theher hue the aur main, raawi ke walid, us waqt Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein tha, aur woh shakhs ek chogha pehne hue tha jispar khushboo ke nishaan the, aur usne kaha: Main Umra ke liye ehram ki halat mein hoon, aur ye chogha mujhpar hai aur main khushboo lagaaye hue hoon. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne usse kaha: Tum apne Hajj mein kya karoge? Usne kaha: Main kapde utaar dunga aur khud se ye khushboo dho dunga. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jo tum apne Hajj mein karte ho woh apni Umra mein karo.

e: Safwan b. Ya'la b. Umayya reported that Ya'la used to say to 'Umar b. Khattab (Allah be pleased with him): Would that I see revelation descending upon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). (Once) when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was in Ji'rana and there was a cloth which provided shade over him, and there were his Companions with him. 'Umar being one of them, there came a person with a cloak of wool on him daubed with perfume and he said: Messenger of Allah, what about the person who entered upon the state of Ihram with a cloak after daubing it with perfume? The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) looked at him for a short while, and then became quiet, and revelation began descending upon him, and 'Umar gestured (with his hand) to Ya'la b. Umayya to come. Ya'la came and he entered his head (beneath the cloth and saw) the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) with his face red, and breathing heavily. Then he felt relieved (of that burden) and he said: Where is the man who was just asking me about Umra? The man was searched for and he was brought, and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: So far as the perfume is concerned, wash it three times, and remove the cloak too (as it was sewn) and do in 'Umra as you do in Hajj.
hi: Safwan bin Ya'la bin Umayya ne bayan kiya ki Ya'la Umar bin Khattab (RA) se kaha karte the: Kaash main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) par wahi utarte hue dekhta. Ek baar jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Ji'rana mein the aur ek kapda tha jo unhe saaya de raha tha, aur unke sahaba unke saath the, jismein Umar bhi ek the, ek shakhs oon ke chogha pehne hue aaya jispar khushboo lagi hui thi, aur usne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, us shakhs ke baare mein kya hukum hai jo khushboo lagakar ehram mein daakhil hua? Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne thodi der usse dekha aur phir khamosh ho gaye, aur wahi unpar nazil hone lagi, aur Umar ne Ya'la bin Umayya ko aane ka ishara kiya. Ya'la aaye aur unhone apna sar kapde ke andar daala aur dekha Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka chehra laal tha, aur saans tez tez le rahe the. Phir woh usse azad hue aur unhone kaha: Woh aadmi kahan hai jo abhi mujhse Umra ke baare mein poochh raha tha? Aadmi ko dhoonda gaya aur woh laaya gaya, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jahan tak khushboo ka sawal hai, use teen baar dho lo, aur chogha bhi utaar do kyunki ye sila hua tha aur Umra mein woh karo jo tum Hajj mein karte ho.

e: Ya'la b. Umayya (Allah be pleased with him) reported that a person came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as he was staying at Ji'rana and he had put on Ihram for 'Umra and he had dyed his beard and his head with yellow colour and there was a cloak on him. He said: I put on Ihram for 'Umra and I am in this state as you see (with dyed beard and head and a cloak over me). He (the Holy Prophet) said: Take off the cloak and wash the yellowness and do in your 'Umra what you do in Hajj.
hi: Ya'la bin Umayya (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya jab woh Ji'rana mein theher hue the aur usne Umra ke liye ehram baandh rakha tha aur usne apni daadhi aur sar ko peele rang se rangaa tha aur usper ek chogha tha. Usne kaha: Maine Umra ke liye ehram baandha hai aur main is haalat mein hoon jaisa aap dekh rahe hain, rangi hui daadhi aur sar aur ek chogha mere upar. Unhone kaha: Chogha utaar do aur peelaapan dho do aur apni Umra mein woh karo jo tum Hajj mein karte ho.

e: Ya'la reported: We were with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that a person came to him with a cloak on him having the traces of scent. He said, Messenger of Allah, I put on Ihram for 'Umra: what should I do? He (the Holy Prophet) kept quiet and did not make him any reply. And 'Umar screened him and it was (usual) with 'Umar that when the revelation descended upon him, he provided him shade (with the help of a piece of cloth). I (the person who came to the Holy Prophet) said: I said to 'Umar I wish to project my head into the cloth (to see how the Prophet receives revelation). So when the revelation began to descend upon him 'Umar wrapped him (the Holy Prophet) with cloth I came to him and projected my head with him into the cloth, and saw him (the Holy Prophet) (receiving the revelation). When he (the Holy Prophet) was relieved (of its burden), he said: Where is the inquirer who was just inquiring about 'Umra? That man came to him. Thereupon he (the Messenger of Allah) said: Take off the cloak from (your body) and wash the traces of perfume which were upon you, and do in 'Umra what you did in Hajj.
hi: Ya'la ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath the ki ek shakhs unke paas aaya, uspar khushboo ke nishaan wala ek chogha tha. Usne kaha, Allah ke Rasool, maine Umra ke liye ehram baandha hai: mujhe kya karna chahiye? Unhone khamoshi rakhi aur usse koi jawab nahi diya. Aur Umar ne unhe parde se dhaank diya aur ye Umar ki aadat thi ki jab unpar wahi nazil hoti, to woh Nabi ko kapde ki madad se saaya dete. Maine, jo shakhs Nabi ke paas aaya tha, kaha: Maine Umar se kaha ki main apna sar kapde mein daalna chahta hoon, ye dekhne ke liye ki Nabi wahi kaise paate hain. To jab unpar wahi nazil hone lagi Umar ne unhe kapde se lapeta. Main unke paas aaya aur maine bhi apna sar unke saath kapde mein daala, aur unhe dekha, wahi paate hue. Jab woh usse azad hue, to unhone kaha: Poochhne wala kahan hai jo abhi Umra ke baare mein poochh raha tha? Woh aadmi unke paas aaya. Isper unhone kaha: Chogha apne badan se utaar do aur khushboo ke nishaan dho do jo tumpar the, aur Umra mein woh karo jo tumne Hajj mein kiya tha.

e: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) specified Dhu'l-Hulaifa, for the people of Medina; Juhfa for the people of Syria; Qarn al-Manazil, for the people of Najd; Yalamlam for the people of Yemen (the Mawaqit) and those (Mawaqit) are also meant for those who live at these (places) and for those too who come from without towards them for the sake of Hajj or 'Umra. And those who live within them (within the bounds of these places) or in the suburbs of Mecca or within Mecca, they should enter upon the state of Ihram at these very places.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Madina ke logon ke liye Dhu'l-Hulaifa, Syria ke logon ke liye Juhfa, Najd ke logon ke liye Qarn al-Manazil, aur Yemen ke logon ke liye Yalamlam muqarrar kiya, ye Mawaqit hain, aur ye Mawaqit un logon ke liye bhi hain jo in jagahon par rehte hain aur un logon ke liye bhi jo Hajj ya Umra ke liye inki taraf bahar se aate hain. Aur jo log inke andar, in jagahon ki seemaon ke andar, ya Makkah ke aas-paas, ya Makkah ke andar rehte hain, unhe usi jagah ehram mein daakhil hona chahiye.

e: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) specified Dhu'l-Hulaifa for the people of Medina; Juhfa for the people of Syria, Qarn al-Manazil for the people of Najd, Yalamlam for the people of Yemen (as their respective Mawaqit), and he also said: These are (Mawaqit) of them too (who live there) and everyone who comes from outside (through) their (directions) for the sake of Hajj and 'Umra and for those who live within (those bounds their Miqat is that) from which they commenced (their journey), and for the people of Mecca, Mecca itself is (the Miqat).
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Madina ke logon ke liye Dhu'l-Hulaifa, Syria ke logon ke liye Juhfa, Najd ke logon ke liye Qarn al-Manazil, aur Yemen ke logon ke liye Yalamlam muqarrar kiya, unke apne Mawaqit ke taur par, aur unhone ye bhi kaha: Ye Mawaqit un logon ke bhi hain jo wahan rehte hain aur har us shakhs ke bhi jo Hajj aur Umra ke liye bahar se unki taraf aata hai, aur un logon ke liye jo unke andar rehte hain unka Miqat woh hai jahan se unhone apna safar shuru kiya, aur Makkah walon ke liye, Makkah khud Miqat hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The people of Medina should enter upon the state of Ihram at Dhu'l-Hulaifa, and people of Syria at Juhfa, and people of Najd at Qarn (al-Manazil), and 'Abdullah (further) said: It has reached me that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) also caid: The people of Yemen should enter upon the state of Ihram at Yalamlam.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Madina ke logon ko Dhu'l-Hulaifa mein ehram baandhna chahiye, aur Syria ke logon ko Juhfa mein, aur Najd ke logon ko Qarn al-Manazil mein, aur Abdullah ne aage kaha: Mujhe pata chala hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ye bhi kaha: Yemen ke logon ko Yalamlam mein ehram baandhna chahiye.

e: Salim reported on the authority of his father ('Abdullah b. 'Umar) that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The people of Medina should enter upon the state of Ihram at Dhu'l-Hulaifa; the people of Syria at Juhfa, the people of Najd at Qarn (al-Manazil). Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) said: It was mentioned to me but I did not myself bear it (directly) from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) having said this: The people of Yemen should enter upon the state of Ihram at Yalamlam.
hi: Salim ne apne walid, Abdullah bin Umar, ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Madina ke logon ko Dhu'l-Hulaifa mein ehram baandhna chahiye; Syria ke logon ko Juhfa mein, Najd ke logon ko Qarn al-Manazil mein. Ibn Umar (RA) ne kaha: Mujhe ye bataaya gaya lekin maine khud ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye kehte hue nahi suna: Yemen ke logon ko Yalamlam mein ehram baandhna chahiye.

e: Salim b. 'Abdullah b. 'Umar b. al-Khattab (Allah be pleased with them) reported his father as saying: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying that the people of Medina should enter upon the state of Ihram at Dhu'l- Hulaifa, the people of Syria at Mahya'a and that is Juhfa, and the people of Najd at Qarn (al-Manazil). 'Abdullah b. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) said: (I did not hear it myself from him) but heard from them saying that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had (also) said: The people of Yemen should enter upon the state of Ihram at Yalamlam.
hi: Salim bin Abdullah bin Umar bin al-Khattab (RA) ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna ki Madina ke logon ko Dhu'l-Hulaifa mein ehram baandhna chahiye, Syria ke logon ko Mahya'a mein aur woh Juhfa hai, aur Najd ke logon ko Qarn al-Manazil mein. Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne kaha: Maine ye khud unse nahi suna, lekin unse, logon se, ye sunkar ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne bhi kaha tha: Yemen ke logon ko Yalamlam mein ehram baandhna chahiye.

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had commanded the people of Medina to enter upon the state of Ihram at Dhu'l-Hulaifa; the people of Syria at Juhfa; the people of Najd at Qarn (al-Manazil). 'Abdullah b. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) said: I was informed that he said that the people of Yemen should enter upon the state of Ihram at Yalamlam.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Madina ke logon ko Dhu'l-Hulaifa mein ehram baandhne ka hukum diya tha; Syria ke logon ko Juhfa mein; Najd ke logon ko Qarn al-Manazil mein. Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne kaha: Mujhe bataya gaya ki unhone kaha ki Yemen ke logon ko Yalamlam mein ehram baandhna chahiye.

e: Abu Zubair reported that he heard Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) saying that as he was asked about (the places for entering upon the) state of ihram, he said: I heard (and he then carried the narration directly, I think to) the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).
hi: Abu Zubair ne bayan kiya ki unhone Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ko ye kehte suna ki jab unse ehram baandhne ki jagahon ke baare mein poocha gaya, to unhone kaha: Maine suna, aur phir unhone seedhe riwayat ki, mujhe lagta hai, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se.

e: Abu Zubair heard Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) as saying as he was asked about (the place for entering upon the) state of Ihram: I heard (and I think he carried it directly to the Messenger of Allah) him saying: For the people of Medina Dhu'l-Hulaifa is the place for entering upon the state of Ihram, and for (the people coming through the other way, i.e. Syria) it is Juhfa; for the people of Iraq it is Dhat al-'Irq; for the people of Najd it is Qarn (al-Manazil) and for the people of Yemen it is Yalamlam.
hi: Abu Zubair ne Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ko ye kehte suna jab unse ehram baandhne ki jagah ke baare mein poocha gaya: Maine suna, aur mujhe lagta hai unhone ise seedhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat ki: Madina ke logon ke liye Dhu'l-Hulaifa ehram baandhne ki jagah hai, aur Syria ki taraf se aane wale logon ke liye ye Juhfa hai; Iraq ke logon ke liye ye Dhat al-Irq hai; Najd ke logon ke liye ye Qarn al-Manazil hai aur Yemen ke logon ke liye ye Yalamlam hai.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that the Talbiya of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was this: Here I am at Thy service. O Allah, here I am at Thy service, here I am at Thy service. There is no associate with Thee; here I am at Thy service. Verily all praise and grace is due to Thee, and the sovereignty (too). There is no associate with Thee. He (the narrator) further said that 'Abdullah b. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) made this addition to it: Here I am at Thy service; here I am at Thy service; ready to obey Thee, and good is in Thy Hand; here I am at Thy service; unto Thee is the petition, and deed (is also for Thee).
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki Talbiya ye thi: Main haazir hoon, Aye Allah, main haazir hoon, main haazir hoon. Tera koi shareek nahi hai; main haazir hoon. Yaqeenan saari tareef aur fazl Tere hi liye hai, aur baadshahat bhi Teri hi hai. Tera koi shareek nahi hai. Raawi ne aage kaha ki Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne ismein ye izafa kiya: Main haazir hoon; main haazir hoon; Teri itaat ke liye taiyaar hoon, aur bhalaai Tere Haath mein hai; main haazir hoon; Tujhi se dua hai, aur amal bhi Tere hi liye hai.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) entered upon the state of Ihram near the mosque at Dhu'l-Hulaifa as his camel stood by it and he said: Here I am at Thy service, O Lord; here I am at Thy service: here I am at Thy service.
