There is no associate with Thee. Here I am at Thy service. All praise and grace is due to Thee and the sovereignty (too). There is no associate with Thee. They (the people) said that 'Abdullah b. 'Umar said that that was the Talbiya of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). Nafi' said: 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with him) made this addition to it: Here I am at Thy service; here I am at Thy service; ready to obey Thee. The Good is in Thy Hand. Here I am at Thy service. Unto Thee is the petition and deed (is also for Thee).
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Dhu'l-Hulaifa mein masjid ke qareeb ehram baandha jab unka oont uske paas khada hua aur unhone kaha: Main haazir hoon, Aye Rab; main haazir hoon: main haazir hoon. Tera koi shareek nahi hai. Main haazir hoon. Saari tareef aur fazl Tere hi liye hai aur baadshahat bhi Teri hi hai. Tera koi shareek nahi hai. Logon ne kaha ki Abdullah bin Umar ne kaha ki ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki Talbiya thi. Nafi ne kaha: Abdullah (RA) ne ismein ye izafa kiya: Main haazir hoon; main haazir hoon; Teri itaat ke liye taiyaar hoon. Bhalaai Tere Haath mein hai. Main haazir hoon. Tujhi se dua hai aur amal bhi Tere hi liye hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with him) reported: I immediately learnt Talbiya from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and he then narrated the hadith.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Talbiya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se turant seekh li, aur phir unhone hadees bayan ki.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) pronouncing Talbiya with compacted hair: Here I am at Thy service. O Allah: here I am at Thy service; here I am at Thy service. There is no associate with Thee; here I am at Thy service. Verily all praise and grace is due to Thee and the Sovereignty (too). There is no associate with Thee; and he did not make any addition to these words. 'Abdullah b. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) (further) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to offer two rak'ahs of prayer at Dhu'l-Hulaifa and then when his camel stood up with him on its back near the mosque at Dhu'l-Hulaifa, he pronounced these words (of Talbiya). And 'Abdullah b. 'Umar (Allah be pleased'with them) said that 'Umar b. Khattab (Allah be pleased with him) pronounced, the Talbiya of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in these words of his (Prophet's words) and said: Here I am at Thy service, O Lord; here I am at Thy service, ready to obey Thee, and good is in Thy Hand, Here I am at Thy service. Unto Thee is the petition and deed (is also for Thee).
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko baalon ko jamaa karke Talbiya kehte suna: Main haazir hoon, Aye Allah: main haazir hoon; main haazir hoon. Tera koi shareek nahi hai; main haazir hoon. Yaqeenan saari tareef aur fazl Tere hi liye hai aur Baadshahat bhi Teri hi hai. Tera koi shareek nahi hai; aur unhone in alfaazon mein koi izafa nahi kiya. Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne aage kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Dhu'l-Hulaifa mein do rakat namaz padha karte the aur phir jab unka oont unke saath, unki peeth par, Dhu'l-Hulaifa ki masjid ke qareeb khada hota, to woh ye alfaaz, Talbiya ke, kahte. Aur Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne kaha ki Umar bin Khattab (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki Talbiya inhi alfaazon, Nabi ke alfaazon, mein padhi aur kaha: Main haazir hoon, Aye Rab; main haazir hoon, Teri itaat ke liye taiyaar hoon, aur bhalaai Tere Haath mein hai, Main haazir hoon. Tujhi se dua hai aur amal bhi Tere hi liye hai.

e: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported that the polytheists also pronounced (Talbiya) as: Here I am at Thy service, there is no associate with Thee. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Woe be upon them, as they also said: But one associate with Thee, you possess mastery over him, but he does not possess mastery (over you). They used to say this and circumambulate the Ka'ba.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki mushrik bhi Talbiya yun padhte the: Main haazir hoon, Tera koi shareek nahi hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Haaye afsos unpar, unhone ye bhi kaha: Siwaay ek shareek ke jo Tera hai, Tujhe uspar poori taaqat hai, lekin usko Tujhpar koi taaqat nahi hai. Woh ye kehte the aur Kaaba ka tawaaf karte the.

e: Salim b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported that he heard his father saying: This place Baida' is for you that about which you attribute lie to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). And the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not enter upon the state of Ihram but near the mosque at Dhu'l- Hulaifa.
hi: Salim bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unhone apne waalid ko ye kehte suna: Ye jagah Baida hai jiske baare mein tum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) par jhoot mansoob karte ho. Aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Dhu'l-Hulaifa ki masjid ke qareeb hi ehram baandha tha.

e: Salim reported that when it was said to Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) that the state of Ihram (commences from)a  al-Baida' he said: Al-Baida', you attribute lie about it to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). And the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not enter upon the state of Ihram but near the tree when his camel stood up with him.
hi: Salim ne bayan kiya ki jab Ibn Umar (RA) se kaha gaya ki ehram baandhne ki jagah al-Baida hai, to unhone kaha: Al-Baida, tum iske baare mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) par jhoot mansoob karte ho. Aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne darakht ke qareeb hi ehram baandha tha jab unka oont unke saath khada hua.

e: 'Ubaid b. Juraij said to 'Ahdullah b. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them): 'Abd al-Rahman, I find you doing four things which I do not see anyone among your companions doing. He said: Son of Juraij, what are these? Thereupon he said: You (while circumambulating the Ka'ba) do not touch but the two pillars situated on the side of yaman (south), and I find you wearing the sandals of tanned leather, and I find you with dyed beard and head, and I also found that, when you were at Mecca, the people pronounced Talbiya as they saw the new moon (Dhu'l-Hijja), but you did not do it till the 8th of Dhu'l-Hijja. Upon this 'Abdullab b. 'Umar said: (So far as the touching of) the pillars is concerned, I did not see the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) touching them but only those situated on the side of yaman. (So far as the wearing of) the shoes of tanned leather is concerned, I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) wearing shoes without hair on them, and he (wore them with wet feet) after performing ablution, and I like to wear them. So far as the yellowness is concerned, I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) dyeing (head, beard and cloth) with this colour and I love to dye (my head, beard or cloth) with this colour. And so far as the pronouncing of Talbiya is concerned, I did not see the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) pronouncing it until his camel proceeded on (to Dhu'l-Hulaifa).
hi: Ubaid bin Juraij ne Abdullah bin Umar (RA) se kaha: Abdur-Rahman, main aapko chaar cheezein karte paata hoon jinhe main aapke saathiyon mein se kisi ko karte hue nahi dekhta. Unhone kaha: Ibn Juraij ke bete, ye kya hain? Isper unhone kaha: Aap, Kaaba ka tawaaf karte hue, sirf yamani, dakshin, taraf ke do khambon, kono, ko chhoote hain, aur main aapko rangaaye hue chamde ke joote pehne dekhta hoon, aur main aapko rangi hui daadhi aur sar ke saath paata hoon, aur maine ye bhi paaya ki jab aap Makkah mein the, to logon ne naya chaand, Zul-Hijja ka, dekhkar Talbiya padhi, lekin aapne aisa Zul-Hijja ki aathvi tareekh tak nahi kiya. Isper Abdullah bin Umar ne kaha: Jahan tak khambon ko chhoone ka sawal hai, maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko unhe chhoote nahi dekha siwaay unke jo yamani taraf par hain. Jahan tak rangaaye hue chamde ke jooton pehnane ka sawal hai, maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko baal-rahit joote pehnte dekha, aur woh unhe wuzu karne ke baad, geele paon ke saath, pehante the, aur mujhe unhe pehnna pasand hai. Jahan tak peelaapan ka sawal hai, maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko is rang se, sar, daadhi ya kapda, rangte dekha aur mujhe apne sar, daadhi ya kapde ko is rang se rangna pasand hai. Aur jahan tak Talbiya padhne ka sawal hai, maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ise tab tak padhte nahi dekha jab tak unka oont Dhu'l-Hulaifa ki taraf aage nahi badha.

e: 'Ubaid b. Juraij reported: I remained in the company of 'Abdullah b. 'Umar b. al-Khattab (Allah be pleased with them) its twelve Hajjs and 'Umras and I said to him: I saw four characteristics (peculiar in you), and the rest of the hadith is the same except the case of Talbiya. There he offered the narration given by al-Maqburi and he stated the facts excepting the one given above.
hi: Ubaid bin Juraij ne bayan kiya: Main Abdullah bin Umar bin al-Khattab (RA) ki sohbat mein baarah Hajj aur Umre kiye, aur maine unse kaha: Maine char khoobiyaan, aapmein khaas, dekhin, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai siwaay Talbiya ke maamle ke. Wahan unhone al-Maqburi ki riwayat pesh ki aur unhone upar bayan hue ke ilawa ke tathya bataye.

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) pronounced Talbiya in Dhu'l-Hulaifa as he put his feet in the stirrup and his camel stood up and proceeded.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Dhu'l-Hulaifa mein Talbiya padhi jab unhone apne paon rikaab mein rakhe aur unka oont khada hokar aage badha.

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) pronounced Talbiya as his camel stood up.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Talbiya padhi jab unka oont khada hua.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Umar reported: I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) riding on his camel at Dhu'l-Hulaifa and pronouncing Talbiya as it stood up with him.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Dhu'l-Hulaifa mein apne oont par sawaar dekha aur woh Talbiya padh rahe the jab woh unke saath khada hua.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) spent the night at Dhu'l-Hulaifa while commencing (the rites of) Pilgrimage and he observed prayer in the mosque.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Dhu'l-Hulaifa mein raat guzaari jab woh Hajj shuru kar rahe the aur unhone masjid mein namaz padhi.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: I applied perfume to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) before he entered upon the state of lhram and (concluding) before circumambulating the (sacred) House.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ehram mein daakhil hone se pehle aur Kaaba ka tawaaf mukammal karne se pehle khushboo lagayi.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her), the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), reported: I applied perfume to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) with my own hand before he entered upon the state of Ihram, and as he concluded it before circumambulating the House (for Tawaf-i-lfada).
hi: Aisha (RA), Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ne bayan kiya: Maine apne haath se Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko khushboo lagayi isse pehle ki woh ehram mein daakhil hon, aur jab unhone ise mukammal kiya, isse pehle ki woh Kaaba ka tawaaf karein, Tawaf-i-Ifada ke liye.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: I used to apply perfume to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) before his entering upon the state of Ihram and at the conclusion of it, before circumambulating the House (for Tawaf Ifada).
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko unke ehram mein daakhil hone se pehle aur uske mukammal hone par, Kaaba ka tawaaf, Tawaf Ifada ke liye, karne se pehle khushboo lagati thi.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) said: I applied perfume to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as he became free from Ihram and as he entered upon it.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko khushboo lagayi jab woh ehram se aazad huye aur jab woh ismein daakhil huye.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) said: I applied perfume of Dharira to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) with my hand (on the occasion of) the Farewell Pilgrimage on freeing from the state of Ihram and entering upon it.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Dharira ki khushboo apne haath se lagayi, Vida ke Hajj ke mauqe par, ehram se aazad hone par aur ismein daakhil hone par.

e: 'Uthman b. 'Urwa reported on the authority of his father that he said: I asked 'A'isha with what thing she perfumed the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) at the time of entering upon the state of Ihram. She said: With the best of perfume.
hi: Uthman bin Urwa ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki unhone kaha: Maine Aisha se poocha ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ehram mein daakhil hone ke waqt kis cheez se khushboo lagayi. Unhone kaha: Sabse behtareen khushboo se.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: I applied the best perfume, which I could get, to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) before entering upon the state of Ihram (and after this) he put on the Ihram.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko sabse behtareen khushboo lagayi jo main pa sakti thi, ehram mein daakhil hone se pehle, aur iske baad unhone ehram baandha.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: I applied the best available perfume I could find to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) before he entered upon the state of Ihram and after he was free from it.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko sabse behtareen upalabdh khushboo lagayi jo main dhoondh sakti thi isse pehle ki woh ehram mein daakhil hon aur uske baad jab woh ismein se aazad hue.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: I still seem to see the glistening of the perfume where the hair parted on Allah's Messenger's (ﷺ) head as he was in the state of Ihram, and Khalaf (one of the narrators) did not say: As he was in the state of Ihram, but said: That was the perfume of Ihram.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Mujhe abhi bhi lagta hai ki main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke sar ke baalon ke bataavat mein khushboo ki chamak dekh rahi hoon jab woh ehram ki halat mein the, aur Khalaf, raawiyon mein se ek, ne "jab woh ehram ki halat mein the" nahi kaha, balki kaha: Ye ehram ki khushboo thi.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: I still seem to see the glistening of the perfume where the hair parted on Allah's Messenger's (ﷺ) head and he was free from Ihram.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Mujhe abhi bhi lagta hai ki main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke sar ke baalon ke bataavat mein khushboo ki chamak dekh rahi hoon aur woh ehram se aazad the.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: I still seem to see the glistening of the perfume where the hair parted on Allah's Messenger's (ﷺ) head, while he was pronouncing Talbiya.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Mujhe abhi bhi lagta hai ki main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke sar ke baalon ke bataavat mein khushboo ki chamak dekh rahi hoon, jab woh Talbiya padh rahe the.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: I still seem to see; the rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Mujhe abhi bhi lagta hai ki main dekh rahi hoon; baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) said: I still seem to see the glistening of the perfume where the hair was parted on Allah's Messeinger's (ﷺ) head while he was in the state of Ihram.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne kaha: Mujhe abhi bhi lagta hai ki main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke sar ke baalon ke bataavat mein khushboo ki chamak dekh rahi hoon jab woh ehram ki halat mein the.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: I still seem to perceive the glistening of perfume where the hair was parted on Allah's Messenger's (ﷺ) head as he was in the state of Ihram.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Mujhe abhi bhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke sar ke baalon ke bataavat mein khushboo ki chamak mehsoos ho rahi hai jab woh ehram ki halat mein the.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) intended to enter upon the state of Ihram he perfumed himself with the best of perfumes which he could find and after that I saw the glistening of oil on his head and beard.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ehram mein daakhil hone ka irada karte to woh sabse behtareen khushboo lagaate jo unhe milti, aur uske baad maine unke sar aur daadhi mein tel ki chamak dekhi.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: I still seem to see the glistening of musk (in the parting of the head) of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) while he was in the state of Ihram.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Mujhe abhi bhi lagta hai ki main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke baalon ke bataavat mein mushk ki chamak dekh rahi hoon jab woh ehram ki halat mein the.

e: This hadith has been narrated by 'Ubaidullah with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ubaidullah ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: I used to perfume the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) with a perfume containing musk before entering upon the state of Ihram and on the day of sacrifice (10th of Dhu'l-Hijja) and (at the conclusion of Ihram) before circumambulating the House (for Tawaf-i-Ifada).
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko mushk wali khushboo lagati thi ehram mein daakhil hone se pehle aur qurbaani ke din, 10 Zul-Hijja, aur ehram ke mukammal hone par Kaaba ka tawaaf, Tawaf-i-Ifada ke liye, karne se pehle.

e: Muhammad b. al-Muntashir reported on the authority of his father: I asked 'Abdullah b. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) about a person who applied perfume and then (on the following) morning entered upon the state of lhram. Thereupon he said: I do not like to enter upon the state of Ihram shaking off the perfume. Rubbing of tar (upon my body) is dearer to me than doing this (i. e. the applying of perfume), I went to 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) and told her that Ibn 'Umar stated:" I do not like to enter upon the state of Ihram shaking off the perfume. Rubbing of tar (upon my body) is dearer to me than doing it (the applying of perfume)." Thereupon 'A'isha said: I applied perfume to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) at the time of his entering upon the state of Ihram. He then went round his wives and then put on Ihram in the morning.
hi: Muhammad bin al-Muntashir ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki: Maine Abdullah bin Umar (RA) se us shakhs ke baare mein poocha jisne khushboo lagayi aur phir agli subah ehram mein daakhil hua. Isper unhone kaha: Mujhe pasand nahi ki main khushboo jhaadte hue ehram mein daakhil hoon. Apne badan par taar malna mujhe isse, khushboo lagane se, zyada aziz hai. Main Aisha (RA) ke paas gaya aur unhe bataya ki Ibn Umar ne kaha: "Mujhe pasand nahi ki main khushboo jhaadte hue ehram mein daakhil hoon. Apne badan par taar malna mujhe isse zyada aziz hai." Isper Aisha ne kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko unke ehram mein daakhil hone ke waqt khushboo lagayi. Woh phir apni zaujaon ke paas gaye aur phir subah ehram baandha.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: I used to apply perfume to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He then went round his wives, and entered upon the state of Ihram in the morning and the perfume was shaken off.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko khushboo lagaya karti thi. Woh phir apni zaujaon ke paas jaate aur phir subah ehram mein daakhil hote aur khushboo jhaad di jaati.

e: Muhammad b. al-Muntashir reported on the authority of his father: I heard from Ibn 'Umar having said this:" It is dearer to me to rub tar (on my body) than to enter upon the state of Ihram (in a state) of shaking off the perfume." He (the narrator) said: I went to 'A'isha and told her about this statement of his (of Ibn 'Umar). Thereupon she said: I applied perfume to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he then went round his wives and then entered upon the state of Ihram in the morning.
hi: Muhammad bin al-Muntashir ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki: Maine Ibn Umar se ye kehte suna: "Apne badan par taar malna mujhe isse zyada aziz hai ki main khushboo jhaadte hue ehram mein daakhil hoon." Raawi ne kaha: Main Aisha ke paas gaya aur unhe unke, Ibn Umar ke, is bayaan ke baare mein bataya. Isper unhone kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko khushboo lagayi aur woh phir apni zaujaon ke paas gaye aur phir subah ehram mein daakhil hue.

e: Al-Sa'b b. Jaththama al-Laithi reported that he presented a wild ass to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) when he was at al-Abwa', or Waddan, and he refused to accept it. He (the narrator) said: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) looked into my face (which had the mark of dejection as my present had been rejected by him) he (in order to console me) said: We have refused it only because we are in a state of Ihram.
hi: Al-Sa'b bin Jaththama al-Laithi ne bayan kiya ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ek jangli gadha tohfe mein diya jab woh al-Abwa, ya Waddan mein the, aur unhone use qubool karne se inkaar kiya. Raawi ne kaha: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mere chehre ko dekha, jispar udaasi ka nishaan tha kyunki mera tohfa unhone thukra diya tha, to unhone, mujhe tasalli dene ke liye, kaha: Humne ise sirf is liye mana kiya hai kyunki hum ehram ki halat mein hain.

e: A hadith (pertaining to this topic), has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri (and the words are): " I presented to him (the Holy Prophet) a wild ass."
hi: Ek hadees, isi mudde se mutalliq, Zuhri ki sanad se bayan ki gayi hai, aur alfaaz hain: "Maine unhe, Nabi ko, ek jangli gadha tohfe mein diya."

e: It is narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters (the narrator having) said this: " I presented to him the flesh of a wild ass."
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai, raawi ne ye kaha: "Maine unhe jangli gadhe ka gosht tohfe mein diya."

e: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported that al-Sa'b b. Jaththama presented to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) a wild ass as he was in a state of Ihram, and he returned it to him saying: If we were not in a state of Ihram, we would have accepted it from you.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki al-Sa'b bin Jaththama ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ek jangli gadha tohfe mein diya jab woh ehram ki halat mein the, aur unhone use wapas kar diya ye kehte hue: Agar hum ehram ki halat mein na hote, to hum ise tumse qubool kar lete.

e: The narration transmitted by Hakam (the words are): Al-Sa'b b. Jaththama presented to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) the leg of a wild ass. And in the narration transmitted by Shu'ba (the words are): (He presented to him) the rump of a wild ass as the blood was trickling from it. In the narration transmitted by Shu'ba on the authority of Habib (the words are): A part of a wild ass was presented to the Apostle (may peace he upon him) and he returned it to him (who presented it).
hi: Hakam ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: Al-Sa'b bin Jaththama ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ek jangli gadhe ki taang tohfe mein di. Aur Shu'ba ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: Unhone unhe ek jangli gadhe ki chaanp di jismein se khoon tapak raha tha. Shu'ba ki Habib ki sanad se riwayat mein alfaaz hain: Ek jangli gadhe ka hissa Rasool (SAW) ko diya gaya aur unhone use, dene wale ko, wapas kar diya.

e: Tawus reported on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) that Zaid b. Arqam went to him (Ibn 'Abbas) and said: Narrate how you informed me about the meat of the game presented to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as he was in the state of Ihram. Thereupon he said: He was presented with a slice of the meat of game, but he returned it to him (who presented it) saying: We are not going to eat it, as we are in the state of Ihram.
hi: Tawus ne Ibn Abbas (RA) ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Zaid bin Arqam unke, Ibn Abbas, paas gaye aur kaha: Bataao tumne mujhe kaise bataya tha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko shikaar ka gosht tohfe mein diya gaya jab woh ehram ki halat mein the. Isper unhone kaha: Unhe shikaar ke gosht ka ek tukda diya gaya, lekin unhone use, dene wale ko, wapas kar diya ye kehte hue: Hum ise nahi khaayenge, kyunki hum ehram ki halat mein hain.

e: Abu Qatada reported: We went with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) till we reached al-Qaha (a place three stages away from Medina). Some of us were in the state of Ihram and some of us were not. I saw my companions looking towards something, and as I saw I found It to be a wild ass. I saddled my horse and took up my spear and then mounted upon (the horse) and my whip, fell down. I said to my companions as they were in the state of Ihram to pick up the whip for me but they said: By Allah, we cannot help you in any (such) thing (i. e. hunting). So i dismounted (the horse) and picked it (whip) up and mounted again and caught the wild ass after chasing it. It was behind a hillock and I attacked it with my spear and killed it. Then I brought it to my companions. Some of them said: Eat it, while others said: Do not eat it. The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) was in front of us. I moved my horse and came to him (and asked him), whereupon he said: It is permissible, so eat it.
hi: Abu Qatada ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath nikle yahan tak ki hum al-Qaha, Madina se teen manzil door ek jagah, pahunche. Hummein se kuch ehram ki halat mein the aur kuch nahi the. Maine apne saathiyon ko kuch dekhte hue paaya. Jab maine dekha, to mujhe pata chala ki woh ek jangli gadha tha. Maine apne ghode par zeen kasi aur apna bhaala uthaya aur phir ghode par sawaar hua, aur meri koda gir gayi. Maine apne saathiyon se, jo ehram ki halat mein the, kaha ki meri koda utha do, lekin unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, hum tumhari kisi aisi cheez mein madad nahi kar sakte, yaani shikaar mein. To main ghode se utra aur ise uthaya aur phir dobara sawaar hua aur peecha karte hue jangli gadhe ko pakad liya. Woh ek teeley ke peeche tha aur maine use apne bhaale se hamla kiya aur maar diya. Phir main use apne saathiyon ke paas laaya. Unmein se kuch ne kaha: Ise khaao, jabki doosron ne kaha: Ise mat khaao. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) hamare aage the. Maine apna ghoda moda aur unke paas aaya aur unse poocha, isper unhone kaha: Ye jaayez hai, is liye ise khaao.

e: Abu Qatada (Allah be pleased with him) reported that while he was with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on one of the highways of Mecca, he lagged behind him (the Holy Prophet) along with companions who were in the state of Ihram, whereas he was himself not Muhrim. He saw a wild ass. As he was mounting his horse he asked his companions to pick up for him his whip (which had dropped) but they refused to do so. He asked them to hand him over the spear, but they refused. He then himself took hold of it and chased the wild ass and killed it. Some of the Companions of the Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him) ate (its meat), but some of them refused to do so. They overtook the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and asked him about it, and he said: It is a food which Allah provided you (so eat it).
hi: Abu Qatada (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Makkah ke ek raaste par the, to woh unse peeche reh gaye apne un saathiyon ke saath jo ehram ki halat mein the, jabki woh khud Muhrim nahi the. Unhone ek jangli gadha dekha. Jab woh apne ghode par sawaar ho rahe the, unhone apne saathiyon se apni koda, jo gir gayi thi, uthaane ko kaha lekin unhone aisa karne se inkaar kiya. Unhone unse bhaala dene ko kaha, lekin unhone inkaar kiya. Unhone phir khud ise uthaya aur jangli gadhe ka peecha kiya aur use maar diya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke kuch Sahaba ne uska gosht khaya, lekin kuchne aisa karne se inkaar kiya. Unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko pakad liya aur unse iske baare mein poocha, aur unhone kaha: Ye ek khaana hai jo Allah ne tumhe diya hai, is liye ise khaao.

e: This hadith pertaining to the wild ass is reported on the authority of Abu Qatada. The rest of the hadith is the same but with this (variation of words) that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: " Is there with you some of its flesh?"
hi: Ye hadees jangli gadhe se mutalliq Abu Qatada ki sanad se bayan ki gayi hai. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai lekin is tabdeeli ke saath ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: "Kya tumhare paas uska kuch gosht bacha hai?"

e: 'Abdullah b. Abu Qatada reported: My father went with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in the year of Hudaibiya. His Companions entered upon the state of Ihram whereas he did not, for it was conveyed to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that the enemy (was hiding at) Ghaiqa. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went forward. He (Abu Qatada) said: Meanwhile I was along with his Companions, some of them smiled (to one another) As I cast a glance I saw a wild ass. I attacked It with a spear and held it, and begged for their (i. e. of his companions) assistance, but they refused to help me and we ate its meat. But we were afraid lest we should be separated (from the Messenger of Allah). So I proceeded on (with a view to) seeking the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). Some- times I'dashed my horse and sometimes I made it run at a leisurely pace (keeping pace with others). (In the meanwhile) I met a person from Banfu Ghifar in the middle of the night. I said to him: Where did you meet the messenger of Allah (ﷺ)? He said: I left him at Ta'bin and he intended to halt at Suqya to spend the afternoon. I met him and said: Messenger of Allah. your Companions convey salutations and benedictions of Allah to you and they fear that they may not be separated from you (and the enemy may do harm to you), so wait for them, and he (the Holy Prophet) waited for them. I said: Messenger of Allah, I killed a game and there is left with me (some of the meat). The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) said to his people: Eat it. And they were in the state of Ihram.
hi: Abdullah bin Abu Qatada ne bayan kiya: Mere waalid Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Hudaibiya ke saal gaye. Unke saathiyon ne ehram baandha jabki unhone nahi baandha, kyunki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko bataya gaya tha ki dushman Ghaiqa mein chhupa hua hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aage badhe. Unhone kaha: Isi dauran main unke saathiyon ke saath tha, unmein se kuch ek-doosre ko muskuraaye. Jab maine nazar daali to maine ek jangli gadha dekha. Maine ise bhaale se hamla kiya aur ise pakad liya, aur unse, apne saathiyon se, madad maangi, lekin unhone meri madad karne se inkaar kiya aur humne uska gosht khaya. Lekin humein dar tha ki kahin hum, Allah ke Rasool se, alag na ho jaayein. To main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko dhoondhne ke liye aage badha. Kabhi main apne ghode ko daudaata aur kabhi use aaram se chalne deta, doosron ke saath taal-mel mein. Isi dauran main aadhi raat mein Banu Ghifar ke ek shakhs se mila. Maine usse kaha: Tum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kahan mile? Usne kaha: Maine unhe Ta'bin mein chhoda aur unka iraada Suqya mein dopahar guzaarne ka tha. Main unse mila aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aapke saathi aapko salaam aur Allah ki barkat bhejte hain aur unhe dar hai ki kahin woh aapse alag na ho jaayein, aur dushman aapko nuksaan pahunchaaye, is liye unka intezaar kijiye, aur unhone unka intezaar kiya. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, maine ek shikaar maara hai aur mere paas kuch gosht bacha hai. Rasool (SAW) ne apne logon se kaha: Ise khaao. Aur woh ehram ki halat mein the.

e: 'Abdullah b. Abu Qatada reported on the authority of his father (Allah be pleased with him): The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) set out for Pilgrimage and we also set out along with him. He (Abu Qatada) said: There proceeded on some of his Companions and Abu Qatada was (one of them). He (the Prophet) said: You proceed along the coastline till you meet me. He (Abu Qatada) said: So they proceeded ahead of the Prophet of Allah (ﷺ), all of them had entered upon the state of Ihram, except Abu Qatada; he had not put on ihram. As they went on they saw a wild ass, and Abu Qatada attacked it and cut off its hind legs. They got down and ate its meat. They said: We ate meat In the state of Ihram. They carried the meat that was left of it. As they came to the Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him) they said: Messenger of Allah, we were in the state of Ihram whereas Abu Qatada was not. We saw a wild ass and Abu Qatada attacked it and cut off its hind legs. We got down and ate its meat and we thus ate the meat of a game while we were In the state of Ihram. We have (carried to you) what was left out of its meat. Thereupon he (the holy Prophet) said: Did anyone among you command him (to hunt) or point to him with anything (to do so)? They said: No. Thereupon he said: Then eat what is left out of its meat.
hi: Abdullah bin Abu Qatada ne apne walid (RA) ke hawale se riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Hajj ke liye nikle aur hum bhi unke saath nikle. Unhone kaha: Unke kuch sahaba aage badhe aur Abu Qatada bhi unmein se ek the. Unhone kaha: Tum samundar ke kinaare-kinaare chalte raho jab tak tum mujhse na milo. Unhone kaha: To woh Nabi Allah ke (SAW) se aage badhe, unmein se sabne ehram baandh rakha tha, siwaay Abu Qatada ke; unhone ehram nahi baandha tha. Jab woh aage badhe to unhone ek jangli gadha dekha, aur Abu Qatada ne use hamla kiya aur uski peechhli taangein kaat din. Woh ghode se utre aur uska gosht khaya. Unhone kaha: Humne ehram ki halat mein gosht khaya. Woh uska bacha hua gosht le gaye. Jab woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye to unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, hum ehram ki halat mein the jabki Abu Qatada nahi the. Humne ek jangli gadha dekha aur Abu Qatada ne use hamla kiya aur uski peechhli taangein kaat din. Hum ghode se utre aur uska gosht khaya aur is tarah humne shikaar ka gosht khaya jabki hum ehram ki halat mein the. Hum aapke paas laaye hain jo uske gosht mein se bach gaya. Isper unhone kaha: Kya tum mein se kisi ne unhe aisa karne ka hukum diya ya kisi cheez se ishara kiya, aisa karne ke liye? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Isper unhone kaha: To jo uske gosht mein se bacha hai use khaao.

e: This hadith is narrated'on the authority of 'Uthman b. 'Abdullah b. Mauhab with the same chain of transmitters. And in the narration transmitted on the authority of Shaiban (the words are): " The Messenoer of Allah (ﷺ) said: Did any one of you command him to attack it or point towards it?" And in the narration transmitted by Shu'ba (the words are):" Did you point out or did you help or did you hunt?" Shu'ba said: I do not know whether he said:" Did you help or did you hunt?"
hi: Ye hadees Uthman bin Abdullah bin Mauhab ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai. Aur Shaiban ki sanad se bayan ki hui riwayat mein alfaaz hain: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Kya tum mein se kisi ne unhe use hamla karne ka hukum diya ya kisi taraf ishara kiya?" Aur Shu'ba ki bayan ki hui riwayat mein alfaaz hain: "Kya tumne ishara kiya ya madad ki ya shikaar kiya?" Shu'ba ne kaha: Mujhe nahi pata unhone kaha: "Kya tumne madad ki ya shikaar kiya?"

e: Abdullah b. Abu Qatada narrated on the authority of his father (Allah be pleased with him) that they went with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on an expedition to Hudaibiya. He (further) said: They had entered upon the state of Ihram except I for 'Umra. He (again) said: I (Abu Qatada) hunted a wild ass and fed my companions in the state of their being Muhrim. 1 then came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and informed him that we had with us the meat that was left out of it. Thereupon he said: "Eat it," while they were in the state of Ihram.
hi: Abdullah bin Abu Qatada ne apne walid (RA) ke hawale se riwayat ki ki woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Hudaibiya ki muhim par gaye. Unhone aage kaha: Unhone Umra ke liye ehram baandh liya tha, siwaay mere. Unhone dobara kaha: Maine ek jangli gadha shikaar kiya aur apne saathiyon ko unki Muhrim halat mein khilaaya. Main phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unhe bataya ki humare paas iska bacha hua gosht hai. Isper unhone kaha: "Ise khaao," jabki woh ehram ki halat mein the.

e: 'Abdullah b. Abu Qatada reported on the authority of his father (Allah be pleased with him) that they went out with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and they were Muhrim except Abu Qatada. The rest of the hadith Is the same (but with the exception of these words): " He (the Holy Prophet) said: 15 there any- thing out of it? They said: We have its leg with us. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took it and ate it."
hi: Abdullah bin Abu Qatada ne apne walid (RA) ke hawale se riwayat ki ki woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath nikle aur woh Muhrim the siwaay Abu Qatada ke. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai, lekin in alfaazon ke apwaad ke saath: "Unhone kaha: Kya usmein se kuch bacha hai? Unhone kaha: Uski taang hamare paas hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne use liya aur khaya."

e: Abdullah b. Abi Qatada reported that Abu Qatada was among the party of those who had entered upon the state of Ihram whereas he was not. The rest of the hadith is the same (and herein it is also narrated): " He (the Holy Prophet) said: Did any person among you point to him (to hunt) or command him (in any form)? They said: Messenger of Allah, not at all. Thereupon he said: Then eat it."
hi: Abdullah bin Abi Qatada ne bayan kiya ki Abu Qatada un logon ke giroh mein the jinhone ehram baandh liya tha jabki woh khud nahi baandhe hue the. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai, aur isme ye bhi riwayat ki gayi hai: "Unhone kaha: Kya tum mein se kisi ne use, shikaar karne ke liye, ishara kiya ya kisi bhi soorat mein hukum diya? Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, bilkul nahi. Isper unhone kaha: To ise khaao."

e: `Abd al-Rahman b. `Uthman Taimi reported on the authority of his father: While we were with Talha b. Ubaidullah and were in the state of Ihram we were presented a (cooked) bird. Talha was sleeping. Some of us ate it and some of us refrained from (eating) it. When Talha awoke he agreed with him who ate it, and said: We ate it along with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Uthman Taimi ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki: Jab hum Talha bin Ubaidullah ke saath the aur ehram ki halat mein the, humein ek pakaayi hui chidiya pesh ki gayi. Talha so rahe the. Hummein se kuchne use khaya aur kuchne parhez kiya. Jab Talha jaage to unhone us shakhs se sehmat hui jisne ise khaya tha, aur kaha: Humne ise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath khaya tha.

e: `A'isha, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Four are the vicious (birds, beasts and reptiles) which should be killed in the state of Ihram or otherwise: kite (and vulture), crow, rat, and the voracious dog. I (one of the narrators, `Ubaidullah b. Miqsam) said to Qasim (the other narrator who heard it from `A'isha): What about the snake? He said: Let it be killed with disgrace.
hi: Aisha (RA), Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ne kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Chaar aise khatarnaak parinde, jaanwar aur reptile hain jinhe ehram ki halat mein ya usse bahar maar dena chahiye: cheel aur gidh, kauwa, chuha, aur ghaatak kutta. Maine, raawiyon mein se ek, Ubaidullah bin Miqsam ne, Qasim, doosre raawi jinhone ise Aisha se suna, se kaha: Saanp ka kya? Unhone kaha: Ise zillat ke saath maara jaaye.

e: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported Allah'* Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Five are the harmful things which should be killed in the state of Ihram or otherwise: snake, speckled crow. rat. voracious dog, and kite.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Paanch nuksaandeh cheezein hain jinhe ehram ki halat mein ya usse bahar maar dena chahiye: saanp, dhabbedaar kauwa, chuha, ghaatak kutta, aur cheel.

e: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Five are the vicious beasts which should be killed even in the state of Ihram: scorpion, rat, kite, crow and voracious dog.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Paanch aise khatarnaak jaanwar hain jinhe ehram ki halat mein bhi maar dena chahiye: bicchhu, chuha, cheel, kauwa aur ghaatak kutta.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Hisham ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai.

e: A'isha reported Allah's Mdssenger (ﷺ) having said this: Five are the vicious and harmful things which should be killed even within the precincts of Haram: rat, scorpion, crow. kite and voracious dog.
hi: Aisha ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Paanch aise khatarnaak aur nuksaandeh cheezein hain jinhe Haram, Makkah, ki seemaon ke andar bhi maar dena chahiye: chuha, bicchhu, kauwa, cheel aur ghaatak kutta.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters that she (A'isha) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commanded to kill five harmful things in the state of lhram or otherwise. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai ki unhone, Aisha ne, riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ehram ki halat mein ya usse bahar paanch nuksaandeh cheezon ko maarne ka hukum diya. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: IA'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Five are the beasts 1618 harmful and vicious and these must be killed even within the precincts of the Ka'ba: crow, kite, voracio@s dog, kcorpion and rat.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Paanch jaanwar khatarnaak aur nuksaandeh hain aur inhe Kaaba ki seemaon ke andar bhi maar dena chahiye: kauwa, cheel, ghaatak kutta, bicchhu aur chuha.

e: Salim reported on the authority of his father (Allah be pleased with them) that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Five are the (beasts) which if one kills them in the precincts of the Ka'ba or in the state of lhram entail no sin: rat, scorpion, crow, kite and voracious dog. In another version the words are:" as a Muhrim and in the state of lhram".
hi: Salim ne apne walid (RA) ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Paanch aise jaanwar hain jinhe agar koi Kaaba ki seemaon mein ya ehram ki halat mein maare, to koi gunah nahi hota: chuha, bicchhu, kauwa, cheel aur ghaatak kutta. Ek doosri riwayat mein alfaaz hain: "Muhrim aur ehram ki halat mein."

e: Hafsa, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said this: There are five beasts, all of them are vicious and harmful and there is no sin for one who kills them (and these are): scorpion, crow, kite, rat and voracious dog.
hi: Hafsa, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Paanch jaanwar hain, sab khatarnaak aur nuksaandeh hain aur unhe maarne wale ke liye koi gunah nahi hai, aur ye hain: bicchhu, kauwa, cheel, chuha aur ghaatak kutta.

e: Zaid b. Jubair reported: A person asked Ibn Umar which beast a Muhrim could kill. Thereupon he said: One of the wives of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) told me: He (the Holy Prophet) commanded to kill rat, scorpion, kite, voracious dog and crow.
hi: Zaid bin Jubair ne bayan kiya: Ek shakhs ne Ibn Umar se poocha ki Muhrim kaunse jaanwar maar sakta hai. Isper unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki ek zauja ne mujhe bataya: Unhone chuha, bicchhu, cheel, ghaatak kutta aur kauwa maarne ka hukum diya.

e: Zaid b. Jubair reported: A person asked Ibn 'Umar which beast a Muhrim could kill, whereupon he said: One of the wives of Allahs Apostle (ﷺ) told me: He (the Holy Prophet) commanded to kill voracious dog, rat, scorpion, kite, crow, and snake (and this is allowed) likewise in prayer.
hi: Zaid bin Jubair ne bayan kiya: Ek shakhs ne Ibn Umar se poocha ki Muhrim kaunse jaanwar maar sakta hai, isper unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki ek zauja ne mujhe bataya: Unhone ghaatak kutta, chuha, bicchhu, cheel, kauwa, aur saanp maarne ka hukum diya, aur ye namaz mein bhi jaayez hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Five are the beasts for killing which there is no sin for the Muhrim: crows, kites, scorpions, rats and wild dogs.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Paanch aise jaanwar hain jinke maarne mein Muhrim ke liye koi gunah nahi hai: kauwe, cheelein, bicchhu, chuhe aur jangli kutte.

e: Ibn Juraij reported: I said to Nafi: What is that which you heard Ibn, Umar declaring permissible for a Muhrim to kill some of the beasts? Nafi, said to me that 'Abdullah had reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Five are the beasts in killing which or their being killed, there is no sin: crow, kite, scorpion, rat and voracious dog.
hi: Ibn Juraij ne bayan kiya: Maine Nafi se kaha: Ye kya hai jo aapne Ibn Umar ko Muhrim ke liye kuch jaanwaron ko maarna jaayez kehte hue suna hai? Nafi ne mujhse kaha ki Abdullah ne riwayat ki thi: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Paanch aise jaanwar hain jinhe maarne mein, ya unke maare jaane mein, koi gunah nahi hai: kauwa, cheel, bicchhu, chuha aur ghaatak kutta.

e: The above hadith was reported with other chains from Nafi' on the authority of Ibn 'Umar, but there was difference in the wording in how the attributed the chain.
hi: Upar bayan hui hadees Nafi ki sanad se, Ibn Umar ki riwayat mein, doosri sanadon ke saath bhi bayan ki gayi hai, lekin isme sanad ke bataane mein alfaazon ka farq tha.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Umar through be upon him) as saying: Five (are the beasts) in killing which or their being killed in the precinct of the Ka'ba there is no sin." The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Umar ki sanad se bhi Nabi ki ye kehte hue riwayat ki gayi hai: "Paanch aise jaanwar hain jinhe Kaaba ki seemaon ke andar maarne mein, ya unke maare jaane mein, koi gunah nahi hai." Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: 'Abdullah b. Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messen- ger (ﷺ) as saying: Five (are the animals) which, it one kills them In the state of Ihram, entail no sin for one (who does it): scorpion, rat, voracious dog, crow and kite.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Paanch aise jaanwar hain jinhe agar koi ehram ki halat mein maare, to usse koi gunah nahi hota: bicchhu, chuha, ghaatak kutta, kauwa aur cheel.

e: Ka'b b. 'Ujra (Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to me on the occasion of Hudaibiya and I was kindling fire under my cooking pot and lice were creeping on my face. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Do the vermins harm your head? I said: Yes. He said: Get your head shaved and (in lieu of it) observe fasts for three days or feed six needy persons, or offer sacrifice (of an animal). Ayyub said: I do not know with what (type of expiation) did he commence (the statement).
hi: Ka'b bin Ujra (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Hudaibiya ke mauqe par mere paas aaye aur main apni pakaane ki degchi ke neeche aag jala raha tha aur jooen mere chehre par rengti hui the. Isper unhone kaha: Kya keede-makode tumhare sar ko taklif de rahe hain? Maine kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha: Apna sar mundwaao aur uske badle teen din roza rakho, ya chhe zaroorat-mand logon ko khaana khilaao, ya ek jaanwar ki qurbaani do. Ayyub ne kaha: Mujhe nahi pata unhone kis tarah ke kaffare se shuru kiya.

e: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Ayyub.
hi: Ye hadees Ayyub ki sanad se bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Kalb b. Ujra (Allah be pleased with him) reported: It was I for whom this verse was revealed (to the Holy Prophet):" Whoever among you is sick or has an ail- ment of the head, he (may effect) a compensation by lasting or alms or a sacrifice" He said: I came to him (the Holy Prophet) and he said: Come Dear. So I went near. He (again) said: Come near. So I went near. Thereupon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Do the vermins trouble you? Ibn Aun (one of the narrators) said: I think he (Ka'b b. Ujra) replied in the affirmative. He (the Holy Prophet) then commanded to do compensation by fasting or by giving sadaqa (feeding six needy persons) or by sacrifice (of a animal) that is available.
hi: Kalb bin Ujra (RA) ne bayan kiya: Ye main hi tha jiske liye ye aayat nazil hui: "Tum mein se jo bimaar ho ya jiske sar mein takleef ho, use roza rakhkar, ya sadaqa dekar, ya qurbaani dekar iska muaaviza dena chahiye." Unhone kaha: Main unke paas aaya aur unhone kaha: Aao qareeb. To main qareeb gaya. Unhone dobara kaha: Aao qareeb. To main qareeb gaya. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Kya keede-makode tumhe pareshaan karte hain? Ibn Aun, raawiyon mein se ek, ne kaha: Mujhe lagta hai unhone, Ka'b bin Ujra ne, haan mein jawab diya. Unhone phir roza rakhkar, ya sadaqa dekar, chhe zaroorat-mand logon ko khilaakar, ya jo bhi qurbaani ka jaanwar upalabdh ho use dekar, muaaviza dene ka hukum diya.

e: Ka'b b. 'Ujra (Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah (may peace be, upon him) stood near him and lice were falling from his head. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Do these vermins trouble you? I said: Yes. Thereupon he said: Then shave your head; and it was in connection with me that this verse was revealed:" Whoever among you is sick or has an ailment of the head, he (may effect) a compensation by fasting or alms or a sacrifice". He (the Holy Prophet, therefore) said to me: Observe fast for three days or give a quantity of alms enough to feed six needy persons or offer sacrifice (of an animal) that is available.
hi: Ka'b bin Ujra (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unke qareeb khade hue aur jooen unke sar se gir rahi thin. Isper unhone kaha: Kya ye keede-makode tumhe pareshaan karte hain? Maine kaha: Haan. Isper unhone kaha: To apna sar mundwaao; aur mere hi mamle mein ye aayat nazil hui: "Tum mein se jo bimaar ho ya jiske sar mein takleef ho, use roza rakhkar ya sadaqa dekar ya qurbaani dekar iska muaaviza dena chahiye." Unhone is liye mujhse kaha: Teen din roza rakho, ya itna sadaqa do ki chhe zaroorat-mand logon ko khilaaya jaa sake, ya jo bhi qurbaani ka jaanwar upalabdh ho use qurbaan karo.

e: Ka`b b. 'Ujra (Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) happened to pass by him at Hudaibiya before entering Mecca in a state of Ihram and he (Ka'b) was kindling fire under the cooking pot and vermin were creeping on his (Ka`b's) face. Thereupon (the Holy Prophet) said: Do these vermin trouble you? He (Ka'b) said: Yes. The Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him) said: Shave your head and give some quantity of food enough to feed six needy persons (faraq is equal to three sa's), or observe fast for three days or offer sacrifice of a sacrificial animal. Ibn Najih (one of the narrators) said:" Or sacrifice a goat."
hi: Ka'b bin Ujra (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unke paas se guzre Hudaibiya mein, Makkah mein daakhil hone se pehle, ehram ki halat mein, aur woh Ka'b apni pakaane ki degchi ke neeche aag jala rahe the aur keede-makode unke chehre par rengte hue the. Isper unhone kaha: Kya ye keede-makode tumhe pareshaan karte hain? Unhone kaha: Haan. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Apna sar mundwaao aur itna khaana do jisse chhe zaroorat-mand logon ko khilaaya jaa sake, faraq teen sa ke barabar hota hai, ya teen din roza rakho, ya qurbaani ke ek jaanwar ki qurbaani do. Ibn Najih, ek raawi, ne kaha: "Ya ek bakri qurbaan karo."

e: Ka'b b. Ujra (Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) happened to pass by him during the period of Hudaibiya. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said to him (Ka'b b. Ujra): Do these vermins trouble your head? He said: Yes. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Shave your head. Then sacrifice a goat or observe fasts for three days or give three sits of dates to feed six needy persons.
hi: Ka'b bin Ujra (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unke paas se guzre Hudaibiya ke daur mein. Isper unhone unse, Ka'b bin Ujra se, kaha: Kya ye keede-makode tumhare sar ko pareshaan karte hain? Unhone kaha: Haan. Isper unhone kaha: Apna sar mundwaao. Phir ek bakri qurbaan karo ya teen din roza rakho ya teen sa khajoor do chhe zaroorat-mand logon ko khilaane ke liye.

e: Abdullah b. Ma'qil said: I sat with Ka'b (Allah be pleased with him) and he was in the mosque. I asked him about this verse:" Compensation in (the form of) fasting, or Sadaqa or sacrifice." Ka'b (Allah be pleased with him) said: It was reveal- ed In my case. There was some trouble in my head. I was taken to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and lice were creeping upon my face. Thereupon he said: I did not think that your trouble had become so unbearable as I see. Would you be able to afford (the sacrificing) of a goat? I (Ka'b) said: Then this verse was revealed:" Com- pensation (in the form of) fasting or alms or a sacrifice." He (the Holy Prophet) said: (It Implies) fasting for three days, or feeding six needy perscins, half sa' of food for every needy person. This verse was revealed particularly for me and (now) Its applica- tion is general for all of you.
hi: Abdullah bin Ma'qil ne kaha: Main Ka'b (RA) ke saath baitha tha aur woh masjid mein the. Maine unse is aayat ke baare mein poocha: "Roza rakhkar, ya Sadaqa dekar, ya qurbaani dekar muaaviza." Ka'b (RA) ne kaha: Ye mere mamle mein nazil hui. Mere sar mein koi takleef thi. Mujhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laaya gaya aur jooen mere chehre par rengti hui thi. Isper unhone kaha: Mujhe nahi laga ki tumhari takleef itni na-qaabil-e-bardaasht ho gayi hai jitni main dekh raha hoon. Kya tum ek bakri qurbaan karne ka intezaam kar sakte ho? Maine kaha, main nahi kar sakta. Phir ye aayat nazil hui: "Roza rakhkar ya sadaqa dekar ya qurbaani dekar muaaviza." Unhone kaha: Iska matlab hai teen din roza rakho, ya chhe zaroorat-mand logon ko khilaao, har zaroorat-mand ko aadha sa khaana. Ye aayat khaas taur par mere liye nazil hui aur ab iska istemal tum sab ke liye aam hai.

e: Ka'b b. Ujra (Allah be pleased with him) reported that he went out with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in the state of Ihram, and his (Ka'b's) head and beard were infested with lice. This was conveyed to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He sent for him (Ka'b) and called a barber (who) shaved his head. He (the Holy Prophet) said. Is there any sacrificial animal with you? He (Kalb) said: I cannot afford it. He then commanded him to observe fasts for three days or feed six needy persons, one sa' for every two needy persons. And Allah the Exalted and Majestic revealed this (verse) particular with regard to him:" So whosoever among you is sick and has an ailment of the head.." ; then (its application) became general for the Muslims.
hi: Ka'b bin Ujra (RA) ne bayan kiya ki woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath ehram ki halat mein nikle, aur unke sar aur daadhi mein jooen bhari hui thin. Ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) tak pahunchi. Unhone unke liye bulwaaya aur ek naai bulwaaya jisne unka sar mundwaaya. Unhone kaha: Kya tumhare paas koi qurbaani ka jaanwar hai? Unhone kaha: Main iska intezaam nahi kar sakta. Unhone phir unhe teen din roza rakhne ya chhe zaroorat-mand logon ko khilaane ka hukum diya, do zaroorat-mand logon ke liye ek sa. Aur Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, ne ye aayat khaas taur par unke baare mein nazil ki: "Is liye jo koi bimaar ho ya sar mein takleef ho.."; phir iska istemaal Musalmaanon ke liye aam ho gaya.

e: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) got himself cupped in the state of lhrim.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ehram ki halat mein khud pe cupping, hijama, karwaya.

e: Ibn Buhaina reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) got himself cupped in the middle of his head on his way to Mecca.
hi: Ibn Buhaina ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Makkah jaate waqt apne sar ke beech mein khud pe cupping karwaya.

e: Nubaih b. Wabb reported: We went with Aban b. Uthman (in a state of lhram). When we were at Malal the eyes of Umar b. Ubaidullah became sore and, when we reached Rauba' the pain grew intense. He (Nubaib b. Wahb) sent (one) to Aban b. Uthman to ask him (what to do). He sent him (the message) to apply aloes to them, for 'Uthman (Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) applied aloes to the person whose eyes were sore and he was in the state of Ihram.
hi: Nubaih bin Wabb ne bayan kiya: Hum Aban bin Uthman ke saath ehram ki halat mein nikle. Jab hum Malal mein the, Umar bin Ubaidullah ki aankhein takleefdeh ho gayin, aur jab hum Rauba pahunche to dard aur badh gaya. Unhone Aban bin Uthman ke paas ek aadmi bheja unse poochhne, kya karna chahiye. Unhone unhe payaam bheja ki aankhon par aloe lagayein, kyunki Uthman (RA) ne riwayat ki thi ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek shakhs ki takleefdeh aankhon par aloe lagaayi thi jab woh ehram ki halat mein tha.

e: Nubaih b Wahb reported that the eyes of Umar b. Ubaidnllah b. Ma'mar were swollen, and he decided to use antimony. Aban b. 'Uthman forbade him to do so and commanded him to apply aloes on them, and reported on the authority of 'Uthman b. Affan that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had done that.
hi: Nubaih bin Wahb ne bayan kiya ki Umar bin Ubaidullah bin Ma'mar ki aankhein sooj gayin, aur unhone antimony istemal karne ka faisla kiya. Aban bin Uthman ne unhe aisa karne se mana kiya aur unhe hukum diya ki woh unpar aloe lagaayein, aur Uthman bin Affan ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne aisa kiya tha.

e: Ibrahim b. 'Abdullah narrated on the authorrity of his father that there cropped up a difference of opinion between Abdullah b. 'Abbas and al-Miswar b. Makhrama at a place (called) Abwa'. Abdullah b. 'Abbas contended that a Muhrim (is permitted) to wash his head, whereas Miswar contended that a Muhrim is not (permit- fed) to wash his head. So Ibn Abbas sent me (the father of Ibrabim) to Abu Ayyub al- Ansirl to ask him about it. (So I went to him) and found him taking bath behind two poles covered by a cloth. I gave him salutation, whereupon be asked: Who is this? I said: I am 'Abdullah b. Hunain. 'Abdullah b. 'Abbas has sent me to you to find out how the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) washed his head in the state of Ihram. Abu Ayyub (Allah be pleased with him) placed his hand on the cloth and lowered it (a little) till his head became visible to me; and he said to the man who was pouring water upon him to pour water. He poured water on his head. He then moved his head with the help of his hands and moved them (the hands) forward and backward and then said: This is how I saw him (the Messenger of Allah) doing.
hi: Ibrahim bin Abdullah ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Abdullah bin Abbas aur al-Miswar bin Makhrama ke beech ek jagah, jise Abwa kehte hain, mein ek mat-bhinnata paida ho gayi. Abdullah bin Abbas ne dalil di ki Muhrim ko ijazat hai ki woh apna sar dho sake, jabki Miswar ne dalil di ki Muhrim apna sar nahi dho sakta. To Ibn Abbas ne mujhe, Ibrahim ke walid ko, Abu Ayyub al-Ansari ke paas bheja unse poochhne ke liye. To main unke paas gaya aur unhe do khambon ke peeche nahaate hue paaya jo ek kapde se dhake hue the. Maine unhe salaam kiya, isper unhone poocha: Ye kaun hai? Maine kaha: Main Abdullah bin Hunain hoon. Abdullah bin Abbas ne mujhe aapke paas ye jaanne bheja hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ehram ki halat mein apna sar kaise dhoya. Abu Ayyub (RA) ne apna haath kapde par rakha aur use thoda neeche kiya yahan tak ki unka sar mujhe nazar aane laga; aur unhone us aadmi se, jo unpar paani daal raha tha, kaha ki paani daale. Usne unke sar par paani daala. Unhone phir apna sar apne haathon ki madad se hilaaya aur unhe aage-peeche kiya aur phir kaha: Maine unhe, Allah ke Rasool ko, isi tarah karte dekha tha.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zaid b. Aslam with the same chain of transmitters that Abu Ayyub rubbed his whole head with his hands and then moved them forward and backward. Miswar said to Ibn 'Abbas: I would never dispute with you (in future).
hi: Ye hadees Zaid bin Aslam ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai ki Abu Ayyub ne apna poora sar apne haathon se mala aur phir unhe aage-peeche kiya. Miswar ne Ibn Abbas se kaha: Main aapse aage kabhi bahas nahi karunga.

e: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported that a person fell down from his camel (in a state of Ihram) and his neck was broken and he died. Thereupon Allah's Apostle. (ﷺ) said: Bathe him with water mixed with the leaves of the lote tree and shroud him in his two (pieces of) cloth (Ihbram), and do not cover his head for Allah will raise him on the Day of Resurrection Pronouncing Talbiya.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs apne oont se gir gaya, ehram ki halat mein, aur uski gardan toot gayi aur woh mar gaya. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Use ber ke pattoon mile paani se ghusl do aur use uske do kapdon, Ihram, mein kafan do, aur uska sar mat dhaanko kyunki Allah use Qayamat ke din Talbiya padhte hue uthaayega.

e: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported: While a person was standing in 'Arafat with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) he fell down from his camel and broke his neck. This was mentioned to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), whereupon he said: Bathe him with water mixed with the leaves of the lote tree and shroud him in two (pieces of) cloth and neither perfume him nor cover his head; (Ayyub said) for Allah would raise him on the Day of Resurrection in the state of pronouncing Talbiya. ('Amr. however, said): Verily Allah would raise him on the Day of Resurrection pronouncing Talbiya. Sa'id b. Jubair narrated this hadith on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) that a person was standing with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as he was in the state of Ihram. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Jab ek shakhs Arafat mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath khada tha, woh apne oont se gir gaya aur uski gardan toot gayi. Ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko bataya gaya, isper unhone kaha: Use ber ke pattoon mile paani se ghusl do aur use do kapdon mein kafan do aur na to use khushboo lagaao na uska sar dhaanko; Ayyub ne kaha, kyunki Allah use Qayamat ke din Talbiya padhne ki halat mein uthaayega. Amr ne, halaanki, kaha: Yaqeenan Allah use Qayamat ke din Talbiya padhte hue uthaayega. Sa'id bin Jubair ne ye hadees Ibn Abbas (RA) ki sanad se riwayat ki ki ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath khada tha jab woh ehram ki halat mein the. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported that a person proceeded along with the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) in the state of Ihram and fell down from his camel and his neck was broken, and he died. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Bathe him with water mixed with lote (leaves) and shroud him in two (pieces of) cloth and do'not cover his head for he would come on the Day of Resurrection pronouncing Talbiya.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath aage badha ehram ki halat mein aur apne oont se gir gaya aur uski gardan toot gayi, aur woh mar gaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Use ber ke pattoon mile paani se ghusl do aur use do kapdon mein kafan do aur uska sar mat dhaanko kyunki woh Qayamat ke din Talbiya padhte hue aayega.

e: Sa'id b. Jubair reported on the authority of Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with him) that a person proceeded with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in the state of Ihram. The rest of the hadith th is the same except that he (the Holy Prophet) (is reported to have) said: He would be raised on the Day of Resurrection pronouncing Talbiya. Sa'id b. Jubair did not name the place where he fell down.
hi: Sa'id bin Jubair ne Ibn Abbas (RA) ke hawale se riwayat ki ki ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath aage badha ehram ki halat mein. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai siwaay is baat ke ki unhone kaha: Woh Qayamat ke din Talbiya padhte hue uthaaya jaayega. Sa'id bin Jubair ne us jagah ka naam nahi liya jahan woh gira tha.

e: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported that there was a person in the state of Ihram whose camel broke his neck and he died. Thereupon the Mes- senger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Bathe him with water mixed (with the leaves of) lote tree and shroud him In his two (pieces of) cloth and cover neither his head nor his face, for he would be raised on the Day of Resurrection pronouncing Talbiya.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs ehram ki halat mein tha jiske oont ne uski gardan tod di aur woh mar gaya. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Use ber ke pattoon mile paani se ghusl do aur use uske do kapdon mein kafan do aur na uska sar dhaanko na uska chehra, kyunki woh Qayamat ke din Talbiya padhte hue uthaaya jaayega.

e: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported that when a person who was in the state of Ihram was in the company of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), his camel broke his neckand he died. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Bathe him with water (mixed with the leaves) of the lute tree and shroud him in his two (pieces of) cloth and, neither perfume him nor cover his head, for he would be raised on the Day of Resurrection pronouncing Talbiya.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab ehram ki halat mein ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein tha, uske oont ne uski gardan tod di aur woh mar gaya. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Use ber ke pattoon mile paani se ghusl do aur use uske do kapdon mein kafan do aur na use khushboo lagaao na uska sar dhaanko, kyunki woh Qayamat ke din Talbiya padhte hue uthaaya jaayega.

e: Sa'id b. Jubair reported on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) that a camel broke the neck of its owner while he was in the state of lhram and he was at that time in the company of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded that he should be bathed with water mixed with (leaves of the) lote (tree) and no perfume should be applied to him and his head should not be covered, for he would be raised on the Day of Resurrection pronouncing Talblya.
hi: Sa'id bin Jubair ne Ibn Abbas (RA) ke hawale se riwayat ki ki ek oont ne apne maalik ki gardan tod di jab woh ehram ki halat mein tha aur us waqt Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne hukum diya ki use ber ke pattoon mile paani se ghusl diya jaaye aur usse koi khushboo na lagaayi jaaye aur uska sar na dhaanka jaaye, kyunki woh Qayamat ke din Talbiya padhte hue uthaaya jaayega.

e: Sa'id b. Jubair heard Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) as saying: A person came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) while he was in the state of lhram. He fell down from his camel and broke his neck. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) commanded to bathe him with water (mixed with the leaves of) the lote (tree), and shroud him in two (pieces of) cloth and not to apply perfume (to him), keeping his head out (of the shroud). Shu'ba said: He then narrated to me after this (the words)" keeping his head out," his face out, for he would be raised on the Day of Resurrection pronouncing Talbiya.
hi: Sa'id bin Jubair ne Ibn Abbas (RA) ko ye kehte suna: Ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya jab woh ehram ki halat mein the. Woh apne oont se gir gaya aur uski gardan toot gayi. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne hukum diya ki use ber ke pattoon mile paani se ghusl diya jaaye, aur use do kapdon mein kafan diya jaaye aur khushboo na lagayi jaaye usse, uska sar bahar rakhte hue. Shu'ba ne kaha: Unhone phir mujhe iske baad riwayat ki alfaaz "uska sar bahar rakhte hue," uska chehra bahar, kyunki woh Qayamat ke din Talbiya padhte hue uthaaya jaayega.

e: Sa`id b. Jubair reported on the authority of Ibn `Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) that the camel of a person broke his neck as he was in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commanded them (Companions) to wash him with water mixed (with the leaves of) the lote (tree) and to keep his face exposed; (he, the narrator) said: And his head (too), for he would be raised on the Day of Resurrection pronouncing Talbiya.
hi: Sa'id bin Jubair ne Ibn Abbas (RA) ke hawale se riwayat ki ki ek shakhs ke oont ne uski gardan tod di jab woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe, Sahaba ko, hukum diya ki woh use ber ke pattoon mile paani se dhoyein aur uska chehra khula rakhein; raawi ne kaha: Aur uska sar bhi, kyunki woh Qayamat ke din Talbiya padhte hue uthaaya jaayega.

e: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with him) reported that there was a person in the company of Allah's Messenger (may peace' be upon him) whose camel broke his neck and he died. thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Wash him, but do not apply perfume and do not cover his face, for he would be raised (on the Day of Resurrection) pronouncing Talbiya.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein ek shakhs tha jiske oont ne uski gardan tod di aur woh mar gaya. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Use dhoyo, lekin khushboo na lagaao aur uska chehra na dhaanko, kyunki woh Qayamat ke din Talbiya padhte hue uthaaya jaayega.

e: `A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went (into the house of) Duba`a bint Zubair and said to her: Did you intend to perform Hajj? She said: By Allah, (I intend to do so) but I often remain ill, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said to her: Perform Hajj but with condition, and say: O Allah, I shall be free from Ihram where you detain me. And she (Duba`a) was the wife of Miqdad.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Duba'a bint Zubair ke ghar gaye aur unse kaha: Kya tumhara Hajj karne ka irada hai? Unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, mera irada hai, lekin main aksar bimaar rehti hoon, isper unhone unse kaha: Hajj karo lekin shart ke saath, aur kaho: Aye Allah, main wahin ehram se aazad ho jaungi jahan Tu mujhe roke. Aur woh Duba'a Miqdad ki zauja thin.

e: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) went (to the house of) Duba'a bint al-Zubair b. Abd al-Muttalib. She said: Messenger of Allah, I intend to perform Hajj, but I am ill. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Enter Into the state of Ihram on condition that you would abandon it when Allah would detain you.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Duba'a bint al-Zubair bin Abd al-Muttalib ke ghar gaye. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mera irada Hajj karne ka hai, lekin main bimaar hoon. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ehram is shart ke saath baandho ki tum ise chhod dogi jab Allah tumhe roke.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of A'isha through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Aisha (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn Abbas reported that Duba'a bint al-Zubair b. 'Abd al-Muttalib (Allah be pleased with her) came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: I am an ailing woman but I intend to perform Hajj; what you command me (to do)? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Enter into the state of Ihram (uttering these words) of condition: I would be free from it when Thou wouldst detain me. 'He (the narrator) said: But she was able to complete (the Hajj without breaking down).
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bayan kiya ki Duba'a bint al-Zubair bin Abd al-Muttalib (RA) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayin aur kaha: Main ek bimaar aurat hoon lekin mera Hajj karne ka irada hai; aap mujhe kya karne ka hukum dete hain? Unhone kaha: Ehram is shart ke alfaaz mein baandho: Main isse aazad ho jaungi jab Tu mujhe roke. Raawi ne kaha: Lekin woh Hajj mukammal kar paayi, bina beech mein rukaawat ke.

e: Ibn `Abbas (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Duba`a intended to perform Hajj, and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commanded her (to enter into the state of Ihram) with condition. She did it in compliance with the command of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ).
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Duba'a ka Hajj karne ka irada tha, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe ehram baandhne ka hukum diya shart ke saath. Unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke hukum ki paalna karte hue aisa kiya.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas with a slight variation of words.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Abbas ki sanad se alfaazon mein thodi tabdeeli ke saath bayan ki gayi hai.

e: `A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that Asma' bint `Umais gave birth to Muhammad b Abu Bakr near Dhu'l-Hulaifa. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commanded Abu Bakr to convey to her that she should take a bath and then enter into the state of Ihram.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Asma bint Umais ne Dhu'l-Hulaifa ke qareeb Muhammad bin Abu Bakr ko paida kiya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Abu Bakr ko hukum diya ki unhe ye bataayein ki woh ghusl karein aur phir ehram mein daakhil hon.

e: Jabir b. `Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported that when Asma' bint `Umais gave birth (to a child) in Dhu'l-Hulaifa. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded Abu Bakr (to convey to her) that she should take a bath and enter into the state of Ihram.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab Asma bint Umais ne Dhu'l-Hulaifa mein ek bachche ko paida kiya, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Abu Bakr ko hukum diya ki unhe bataayein ki woh ghusl karein aur ehram mein daakhil hon.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) said: We went with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) during the year of the Farewell Pilgrimage. We entered into the state of Ihram for Umra. Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Who has the sacrificial animal with him, he should put on Ihram for Hajj along with Umra. and should not put it off till he has completed them (both Hajj and Umra). She said: When I came to Mecca. I was having menses, I neither circumambulated the House, nor ran between as-safa' and al-Marwa. I complained about it to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he said: Undo your hair, comb it, and pronounce Talbiya for Hajj, and give up Umra (for the time being), which I did. When we had performed the Hajj, the Messenger of Allah (way peace he upon him) sent me with Abd al-Rabman b. Abu Bakr to Tan'im saying: This is the place for your Umra. Those who had put on Ihram for Umra circumambulated the House, and ran between al-safa' and al-Marwa. They then put off Ihram and then made the last circuit after they had returned from Mina after performing their Hajj, but those who had combined the Hajj and the Umra made only one circuit (as they had combined Hajj and 'Umra).
hi: Aisha (RA) ne kaha: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Vida ke Hajj ke saal nikle. Humne Umra ke liye ehram baandha. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jiske paas qurbaani ka jaanwar hai, use Hajj ke saath Umra ke liye ehram baandhna chahiye, aur use tab tak nahi utaarna chahiye jab tak woh dono, Hajj aur Umra, mukammal na kar le. Unhone kaha: Jab main Makkah pahunchi, mujhe haiz aa gaya tha, maine na to Ghar, Kaaba, ka tawaaf kiya, na as-Safa aur al-Marwa ke beech daudi. Maine iski shikaayat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ki aur unhone kaha: Apne baal khol do, unhe kanghi karo, aur Hajj ke liye Talbiya padho, aur Umra chhod do, kuch waqt ke liye, jo maine kiya. Jab humne Hajj mukammal kar liya, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Bakr ke saath Tan'im bheja ye kehte hue: Ye tumhari Umra ke liye jagah hai. Jinhone Umra ke liye ehram baandha tha unhone Ghar ka tawaaf kiya, aur as-Safa aur al-Marwa ke beech daude. Woh phir ehram se aazad hue aur phir aakhri tawaaf kiya jab woh Mina se apna Hajj mukammal karke wapas aaye, lekin jinhone Hajj aur Umra ko jodkar kiya, Qiran, unhone sirf ek tawaaf kiya, kyunki unhone Hajj aur Umra ko jodkar kiya tha.

e: 'A'isha, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), said: We went out with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) during the year of the Farewell Pilgrimage. There were some amongst us who had put on IHram for Umra and there were some who had put on Ihram for Hajj. (We proceeded on till) we came to Mecca. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: He who put on Ihram for 'Umra but did not bring the sacrificial animal with him should put it off. and he who put on Ihram for Umra and he who had brought the sacrificial animal with him should not put it off until he had slaughtered the animal; and he who put on lhram for Hajj should complete it. A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) said: I was in the monthlyperiod, and I remained In this state till the day of 'Arafa, and I had entered into the state of Ihram for 'Umra. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) thus commanded me to undo my hair and comb them (again) and enter into the state of Ihram for Hajj, and abandon (the rites of 'Umra). She ('A'isha) said: I did so, and when I had completed my Pilgrimage, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent with me 'Abd al-Rabman b. Abu Bakr and commanded me to (resume the rites of) 'Umra at Tan'im. the place where (I abandoned) 'Umra and put on Ihram for Hajj (before completing Umra).
hi: Aisha (RA), Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ne kaha: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Vida ke Hajj ke saal nikle. Hummein se kuch aise the jinhone Umra ke liye ehram baandha tha aur kuch aise the jinhone Hajj ke liye ehram baandha tha. Hum aage badhte rahe yahan tak ki hum Makkah pahunche. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jisne Umra ke liye ehram baandha lekin apne saath qurbaani ka jaanwar nahi laaya use ise utaar dena chahiye, aur jisne Umra ke liye ehram baandha aur jo apne saath qurbaani ka jaanwar laaya use tab tak nahi utaarna chahiye jab tak usne jaanwar ki qurbaani na de di ho; aur jisne Hajj ke liye ehram baandha use ise mukammal karna chahiye. Aisha (RA) ne kaha: Main mahine ke usool mein thi, aur main is halat mein tab tak rahi jab tak Arafa ka din nahi aa gaya, aur maine Umra ke liye ehram baandha tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne is liye mujhe hukum diya ki main apne baal khol dun aur unhe phir kanghi karun aur Hajj ke liye ehram mein daakhil ho jaun, aur Umra ke riti-rivaz chhod dun. Unhone kaha: Maine aisa kiya, aur jab maine apna Hajj mukammal kar liya, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mere saath Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Bakr ko bheja aur mujhe hukum diya ki main Tan'im mein Umra ke riti-rivaz phir se karun, woh jagah jahan maine Umra chhoda aur Hajj ke liye ehram baandha, Umra mukammal karne se pehle.

e: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: We went with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) during the year of the Farewell Pilgrimage. I put on Ihram for Umra and did not bring the sacrificial animal. The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) said: He who has the sacrihcial animal with him should enter into the state of Ihram for Hajj along with 'Umra, and. he should not put the Ihram off till he has completed both of them. She (Hadrat A'isha) said: The monthly period began. When it was the night of Arafa, I said to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): I entered into the state of Ihram for 'Umra. but now how should I perform the Hajj? Thereupon he said: Undo your hair and comb them, and desist from performing Umra, and put on Ihram for Hajj She (A'isha, said: When I had completed my Hajj he commanded 'Abd al-Rahman b. Abu Bakr to carry me behind him (on boneback) in order to enable me to resume the rituals of Umra from Tan'im, the place where I abandoned its rituals.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Vida ke Hajj ke saal nikle. Maine Umra ke liye ehram baandha aur qurbaani ka jaanwar nahi laayi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jiske paas qurbaani ka jaanwar hai use Hajj ke saath Umra ke liye ehram baandhna chahiye, aur use tab tak ehram nahi utaarna chahiye jab tak woh dono mukammal na kar le. Unhone kaha: Mahine ka usool shuru ho gaya. Jab Arafa ki raat aayi, maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kaha: Maine Umra ke liye ehram baandha tha, lekin ab main Hajj kaise karun? Isper unhone kaha: Apne baal khol do aur unhe kanghi karo, aur Umra karne se bacho, aur Hajj ke liye ehram baandho. Unhone kaha: Jab maine apna Hajj mukammal kar liya, unhone Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Bakr ko hukum diya ki mujhe apne peeche oont par le jaayein taaki main Tan'im se Umra ke riti-rivaz phir se kar sakoon, woh jagah jahan maine iske riti-rivaz chhode the.

e: `A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: 'We went with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) (to Mecca). He said: He who intended among you to put on Ihram for Hajj and `Umra should do so. And he who intended to put on Ihram for Hajj may do so.
